Gufa rabbi shimon ben elazar omer en madlikin bitzri vechen haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer tzori eno ella seraf meatze hakketaf rabbi yishmael omer kol hayyotze min haetz en madlikin bo rabbi yishmael ben beroka omer en madlikin ella bayyotze min happeri rabbi tarfon omer en madlikin ella beshemen zayit bilvad

Amad rabbi yochanan ben nuri al raglav veamar ma yaasu anshe vavel sheen lahem ella shemen shumshemin uma yaasu anshe maday sheen lahem ella shemen egozim uma yaasu anshe alekkesanderiyya sheen lahem ella shemen tzenonot uma yaasu anshe kappotkiyya sheen lahem lo kach velo kach ella nefte ella en lecha ella ma sheamru chachamim en madlikin

Umadlikin beshemen dagim uvitran rabbi shimon shezuri omer madlikin beshemen pakkuot uvnefte somchos omer kol hayyotze min habbasar en madlikin bo ella beshemen dagim somchos hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu derav berona amar rav vela mesayemi
Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer kol hayyotze min haetz en bo mishshum shalosh al shalosh umsakkechin bo chutz mippishtan amar abbaye
b: Rabbi shimon ben elazar vetanna deve rabbi yishmael amru davar echad rabbi shimon ben elazar ha daamaran tanna deve rabbi yishmael may hi detane deve rabbi yishmael hoil veneemru begadim battora setam ufarat lecha hakkatuv beechad mehen tzemer ufishtim ma lehallan tzemer ufishtim af kol tzemer ufishtim
Rava amar shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim ika benayehu derabbi shimon ben elazar it leh letanna deve rabbi yishmael let leh

Dechulle alma mihat shalosh al shalosh betzemer ufishtim mitamme bingaim menalan detanya beged en li ella beged shalosh al shalosh minnayin talmud lomar vehabbeged veema lerabbot shelosha al shelosha lav kal vachomer hu hashta sheti vaerev mitamme shelosha al shelosha mibaya

I hachi shalosh al shalosh name lete bekal vachomer ella shelosha al shelosha dachazu ben laashirim ben laaniyyim ate bekal vachomer shalosh al shalosh laaniyyim hu dechazyan laashirim la chazyan la ate bekal vachomer tama dechatveh kera ha la katveh kera la gamrinan bekal vachomer

Veema lerabbot shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim amar kera beged tzemer ufishtim beged tzemer ufishtim in mide acharine la veema ki imaut mishshalosh al shalosh aval shelosha al shelosha mitamme tere miute ketivi beged tzemer o beveged pishtim chad lemaote mishshalosh al shalosh vechad lemaote mishshelosha al shelosha
Ulrava deamar shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim ika benayehu lerabbi shimon ben elazar it leh letanna deve rabbi yishmael let leh shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim

a: Mena leh nafka meo veged detanya beged en li ella beged shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim minnayin talmud lomar o veged
Veabbaye hay o veged may aved leh mibe leh lerabbot shalosh al shalosh betzemer ufishtim demittamme bishratzim
Verava galli rachamana gabbe negaim vehu haddin lishratzim
Veabbaye ika lemifrach ma lingaim shekken sheti vaerev mittamme bahem
Veidach i salka datach negaim chamiri lichtov rachamana gabbe sheratzim veletu negaim minayehu
Veidach negaim mishsheratzim la atu deika lemifrach ma lishratzim shekken metammein bechaadasha

Amar abbaye hay tanna deve rabbi yishmael mappek meidach tanna deve rabbi yishmael detane deve rabbi yishmael beged en li ella beged tzemer ufishtim minnayin lerabbot tzemer gemallim vetzemer arnavim notza shel izzim vehashshirin vehakkalach vehasserikin talmud lomar o veged
Rava amar ki let leh lehach tanna deve rabbi yishmael bishar begadim shalosh al shalosh shelosha al shelosha it leh
Veha rava hu deamar shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim lerabbi shimon ben elazar it leh letanna deve rabbi yishmael let leh hadar beh rava mehahi vei baet ema ha rav pappa amrah
Rav pappa amar af kol leetuye kilayim kilayim behedya ketivi beh lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav salka datach amena hane mile derech levisha aval behaalaa kol tere mine asur
Velav kal vachomer hu uma levisha deka mithane kulle gufeh mikkilayim amratte tzemer ufishtim en mide acharina la haalaa lo kol shekken ella derav pappa beduta hi
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar af kol
b: Leetuye tzitzit tzitzit behedya ketiv lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim uchtiv gedilim taase lach salka datach amena kidrava derava rame ketiv hakkanaf min kanaf uchtiv tzemer ufishtim yachdav ha chetzad tzemer ufishtim potrin ben beminan ben shello beminan shear minin beminan potrin shello beminan en potrin salka datach kidrava ka mashma lan

Amar rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe letanna deve rabbi yishmael may shena leinyan tuma dimrabbe shear begadim dichtiv o veged hacha name lema lerabbot shear begadim measher techasse bah hahu leetuye kesut some hu daata detanya uritem oto perat lichsut layela atta omer perat lichsut layela o eno ella perat lichsut some keshehu omer asher techasse bah hare kesut some amur ha ma ani mekayyem uritem oto perat lichsut layela
Uma raita lerabbot some ulhotzi kesut layela merabbe ani kesut some sheyyeshnah biriyya etzel acherim umotzi ani kesut layela sheenah biriyya etzel acherim
Veema lerabbot shear begadim mistabbera kae betzemer ufishtim merabbe tzemer ufishtim kae betzemer ufishtim merabbe shear begadim
Amar abbaye rabbi shimon ben elazar vesomchos amru davar echad rabbi shimon ben elazar ha daamaran somchos detanya somchos omer sikchah bitviy pesula mippene shemmittammea bingaim
Keman ki hay tanna ditnan sheti vaerev mittamme bingaim miyyad divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omer hashsheti mishsheyyishshale vehaerev miyyad vehaunnin shel pishtan mishsheyyitlabbenu
Matni kol hayyotze min haetz en madlikin bo ella pishtan vechol hayyotze min haetz eno mittamme tumat ohalim ella pishtan
Gema menalan defishtan ikri etz amar mar zutra deamar kera vehi heelatam haggaga vattitmenem befishte haetz
Vehayyotze min haetz eno mittamme tumat ohalim ella pishtan menalan amar rabbi elazar gamar ohel ohel

a: Mimmishkan ketiv hacha zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel uchtiv hatam vayyifros et haohel al hammishkan ma lehallan shel pishtan karuy ohel af kan shel pishtan karuy ohel i ma lehallan shezurin vechutan kaful shishsha af kan shezurin vechutan kaful shishsha talmud lomar ohel ohel riba i ohel ohel riba afilu kol mile name im ken gezera shava may ahani leh

Veema ma lehallan kerashim af kan kerashim amar kera veasita kerashim lammishkan mishkan karuy mishkan veen kerashim keruyin mishkan ella meatta veasita michse laohel hachi name michse la ikri ohel ella ha devae rabbi elazar or behema temea mahu sheyyittamme beohel hammet hashta or behema tehora la mittamme or behema temea mibaya shane hatam dahadar ahdereh kera dichtiv venasu et yeriot hammishkan veet ohel moed michsehu umichse hattachash asher alav makkish elon letachton ma tachton karuy ohel af elon karuy ohel

Gufa bae rabbi elazar or behema temea mahu sheyyittamme tumat ohalin may kamibaya leh amar rav adda bar ahava tachash shehaya bime moshe kamibaya leh tame haya o tahor haya amar rav yosef may tibe leh tenena lo huchsheru limlechet shamayim ella or behema tehora bilvad

Rava amar or behema temea demittamme beohel hammet mehacha detanya or o veor riba or behema temea veshellaka beyad kohen katzatz mikkullan veasa achat mehen minnayin talmud lomar o bechol melechet or veika lemifrach ma lingaim shekken sheti vaerev tame bahen

Ella amar rava mibbarnish
b: Atya bekal vachomer minnotza shel izzim sheen mittamme bingaim mittamme beohel hammet or behema temea shemmittammea bingaim eno din shemmittammea beohel hammet
Veella ha detane rav yosef lo huchsheru bimlechet shamayim ella or behema tehora bilvad lemay hilcheta litfilin tefilin behedya ketiv behu lemaan tihye torat Adonai beficha min hammuttar befich

Ella lirtzuot vehaamar rabbi yitzchak retzuot shechorot halacha lemoshe missinay nehi digmiri shechorot tehorot mi gemiri

Amar rav yosef hayenu detanena shalosh al shalosh metzumtzamot vela yadana lemay hilcheta
Umiddeka metaretz rav adda bar ahava alliba derabbi yehuda shema minah kerabbi yehuda sevira leh umi amar rav adda bar ahava hachi vehaamar rav adda bar ahava

a: Goy shechakak kav bivkaat yisrael massikah beom tov veammay nolad hu ledivrehem derabbi eliezer verabbi akiva kaamar leh veleh la sevira leh

Rava amar hayenu tama derabbi eliezer lefi sheen madlikin biftila sheenah mechorechet velo bismartutin sheenan mechorachin ella ha detane rav yosef shalosh al shalosh metzumtzamot lemay hilcheta leinyan tuma ditnan shalosh al shalosh sheamru chutz min hammelal divre rabbi shimon vachachamim omrim shalosh al shalosh mechuuonot

Veha derav lav beferush itmar ella mikkelala itmar derav achal tamre ushda kashyata levuchya amar leh rabbi chiyya bar pachate kenegdo beom tov asur kabbelah mineh o la kabbelah mineh
Ta shema dechi ata rav levavel achal tamre ushda kashyata lechevata may lav befarsayata vela kabbelah la baarammayata hoil vachaze aggav imayehu

Amar leh rav shemuel bar bar chana lerav yosef lerabbi yehuda deamar massikin bechelim veen massikin beshivre chelim kevan deadlek behu purta have leh shivre chelim vechi ka mehappech beisura ka mehappech daavad kidrav matna deamar rav matna amar rav etzim shennashru min haddekel letannur beom tov marbe etzim muchanin umassikan
Rav hamnuna amar hacha befachot mishshelosha al shelosha askinan mikkulle matlaniyyot shanu kan

Veazda rabbi eliezer letameh verabbi akiva letameh ditnan pachot mishshelosha al shelosha shehitkino lifkok bo et hammerchatz ulnaer bo et hakkedera ulkanneach bo et harechayim ben min hammuchan uven sheen min hammuchan tame divre rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua omer ben min hammuchan uven shello min hammuchan tahor rabbi akiva omer min hammuchan tame veshello min hammuchan tahor veamar ulla veitema rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim zerako baashpa divre hakkol tahor
b: Hinnicho bekufsa divre hakkol tame lo nechleku ella shettelao bemaggod o shehinnicho laachore haddelet rabbi eliezer savar middelo zerako baashpa dateh ilaveh umay kare leh shello min hammuchan dilgabbe kufsa lav muchan hu verabbi yehoshua savar middelo hinnicho bekufsa battole batteleh umay kare leh muchan dilgabbe ashpa muchan hu verabbi akiva bitlao bemaggod savar kerabbi eliezer behinnicho achore haddelet savar lah kerabbi yehoshua
Vahadar beh rabbi akiva legabbeh derabbi yehoshua mimmay amar rava middekatane petilat habbeged may irya detane petilat habbeged litne petila shel beged may petilat habbeged daadayin beged hu

Matni lo yikkov adam shefoferet shel betza vimalleenna shemen veyittenenna al pi hanner bishvil shettehe menattefet vaafilu hi shel cheres verabbi yehuda mattir aval im chibberah hayyotzer mittechilla muttar mippene shehu keli echad lo yemalle adam keara shel shemen veyittenenna betzad hanner veyitten rosh happetila betochah bishvil shettehe shoevet verabbi yehuda mattir

Gema utzricha dei ashmeinan shefoferet shel betza beha kaamri rabbanan dechevan dela meisa ate leistappoke minah aval shel cheres dimisa ema modu leh lerabbi yehuda vei ashmeinan shel cheres beha kaamar rabbi yehuda aval behahi ema mode lehu lerabbanan vei ashmeinan hanach tarte behane kaamar rabbi yehuda mishshum dela mipsak aval keara demipaska ema mode lehu lerabbanan vei ashmeinan behahi behahi kaamri rabbanan aval behane tarte ema modu lerabbi yehuda tzericha
Veim chibberah hayyotzer mittechilla muttar vechu tana im chibberah besid uvcharsit muttar vehaanan yotzer tenan may yotzer keen yotzer

Tanya amar rabbi yehuda paam achat shavatnu baaliyyat bet natteza belod veheviu lanu shefoferet shel betza umillenuha shemen unkavnuha vehinnachnuha al pi hanner vehaya sham rabbi tarfon uzkenim velo amru lanu davar amru lo mishsham reaya shane bet natteza dizrizin hen

Ulla metaretz letameh verabbi yirmeya rabba metaretz letameh ulla metaretz letameh mitta dumya dechisse verabbi yirmeya rabba metaretz letameh kisse dumya demitta

b: Aval asur velo yitka veim taka chayyav chattat rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im haya rafuy muttar

Be rav chama hava mitta gelalnita hava mehadderi lah beoma tava amar leh hahu midderabbanan lerava may datach binyan min hatztzad hu nehi deisura deorayeta leka isura derabbanan miha ika amar leh ana kerabban shimon ben gamliel sevira li deamar im haya rafuy muttar
Matni notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot velo yitten letocho mayim mippene shehu mechabbe
Gema veha kamvattel keli mehechano amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua nitzotzot en bahen mammash
Velo yitten letocho mayim mippene shehu mechabbe lema tenan setama kerabbi yose deamar gorem lechibuy asur

Vetisbera emor deamar rabbi yose beshabbat beerev shabbat mi amar vechi tema hacha name beshabbat vehatanya notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot beshabbat veen tzarich lomar beerev shabbat velo yitten letocho mayim mippene shehu mechabbe meerev shabbat veen tzarich lomar beshabbat ella amar rav ashe afilu tema rabbanan shane hacha mippene shemmekarev et kibuo
Matni bamme tomnin uvamma en tomnin en tomnin lo baggefet velo bazzevel lo bammelach velo bassid velo bachol ben lachin ben yeveshin
Velo batteven velo bazzaggin velo bammochin velo baasavin bizman shehen lachin aval tomnin bahen keshehen yeveshin
Gema ibaya lehu gefet shel zetim tenan aval deshumshemin shappir dame o dilma deshumshemin tenan vechal shekken dezetim
Ta shema deamar rabbi zera mishshum chad deve rabbi yannay kuppa shettaman bah asur lehannichah al gefet shel zetim shema minah shel zetim tenan
Leolam ema lach leinyan hatmana deshumshemin name asur leinyan

a: Assoke havla dezetim masseki havla deshumshemin la masseki havla

Rabba verabbi zera iklau leve resh galuta chazuh lehahu avda deannach kuza demayya appumma dekumkuma nazheh rabba amar leh rabbi zera may shena mimmecham al gabbe mecham amar leh hatam okome ka mokem hacha olode ka moled

Hadar chazyeh difras dastodar appummeh dechubba veannach natla ilaveh nazheh rabba amar leh rabbi zera ammay amar leh hashta chazet lesof chazyeh deka meatztzar leh amar leh may shena mipperonka amar leh hatam la kafed ilaveh hacha kafed ilaveh
Velo batteven bea mineh rav adda bar matna meabbaye mochin shettaman bahen mahu letaltelan beshabbat
Amar leh vechi mippene sheen lo kuppa shel teven omed umafkir kuppa shel mochin
Lema mesayya leh tomnin begize tzemer uvtzipe tzemer uvilshonot shel argaman uvmochin veen metaltelin otan
I mishshum ha la irya hachi kaamar im lo taman bahen en metaltelin otan
I hachi may lememra mahu detema chaze lemizga alayehu kamashma lan

Rav chisda shera leahdore udra leve sadya beshabbeta etiveh rav chanan bar chisda lerav chisda mattirin bet hatztzavar beshabbat aval lo potchin veen notnin et hammochin lo letoch hakkar velo letoch hakkeset beom tov veen tzarich lomar beshabbat
La kashya ha bechadte ha beattike
Tanya name hachi en notnin et hammochin lo letoch hakkar velo letoch hakkeset beom tov veen tzarich lomar beshabbat nashru machazirin otan beshabbat veen tzarich lomar beom tov
Amar rav yehuda amar rav happoteach bet hatztzavar beshabbat chayyav chattat
Matkif lah rav kahana
b: Ma ben zo limgufat chavit amar leh rava ze chibur veze eno chibur

Rame leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera tenan shelal shel kovsin veshalshelet shel maftechot vehabbeged shehu tafur bechilayim chibur lattuma ad sheyyatchil lehattir alma shello bishat melacha name chibur
Urminhu makkel sheasao yad lekurdom chibur lattuma bishat melacha bishat melacha in shello bishat melacha la
Amar leh hatam shello bishat melacha adam asuy lezorko leven haetzim hacha shello bishat melacha name nicha leh dei mitannefu hadar mechavar lehu
Besura matnu lah leha shemata mishshemeh derav chisda befumbedita matnu mishshemeh derav kahana veamri lah mishshemeh derava man tena ha milleta daamur rabbanan kol hamchubbar lo hare hu kamohu
Amar rav yehuda amar rav rabbi meir hi ditnan bet happach uvet hattavlin uvet hanner shebbakkira metammein bemagga veen metammein baavir divre rabbi meir verabbi shimon metaher
Bishlama lerabbi shimon kasavar lav kechira damu ella lerabbi meir i kechira damu afilu baavir name litammu i lav kechira damu afilu bemagga name la litammu
Leolam lav kechira damu verabbanan hu digzaru behu i gezaru behu afilu baavir name litammu
Avadu behu rabbanan hekera ki hechi dela ate lemisraf aleh teruma vekodashim
Tanu rabbanan masporet shel perakim veizmel shel rahitne chibur lattuma veen chibur lahazzaa

Ma nafshach i chibur hu afilu lehazzaa name i lav chibur hu afilu letuma name la amar rava devar tora bishat melacha chibur ben letuma ben lehazzaa veshello bishat melacha eno chibur lo letuma velo lehazzaa

a: Vegazru rabbanan al tuma shello bishat melacha mishshum tuma shebbishat melacha veal hazzaa shebbishat melacha mishshum hazzaa shello bishat melacha
Bizman shehen lachin ibaya lehu lachin mechamat atzman o dilma lachin mechamat davar acher

Ta shema lo batteven velo bazzaggim velo bammochin velo baasavim bizman shehen lachin i amratte bishlama lachin mechamat davar acher shappir ella i amratte lachin mechamat atzman mochin lachin mechamat atzman hechi mashkachatte lah mimmirta devene atme
Veha detane rabbi oshaya tomnin bichsut yevesha uvferot yeveshin aval lo bichsut lacha velo beferot lachin kesut lacha mechamat atzmah hechi mashkachatte lah mimmirta devene atme
Matni tomnin bichsut uvferot bechanfe yona uvinsoret shel charashim uvinoret shel pishtan dakka rabbi yehuda oser baddakka umattir baggassa
Gema amar rabbi yannay tefilin tzerichin guf naki keelisha baal kenafayim may hi abbaye amar shello yafiach bahen rava amar shello yishan bahen

Veammay kare leh baal kenafayim sheppaam achat gazra malchut romi harshaa shemad al yisrael shekkal hammanniach tefilin yenakkeru et mocho vehaya elisha mannicham veotze lashshuk raahu kasdor echad ratz mippanav veratz acharav vechevan shehiggia etzlo netalan merosho vaachazan beyado amar lo ma ze beyadcha amar lo kanfe yona pashat et yado venimtzeu kanfe yona lefichach korin oto elisha baal kenafayim
Umay shena kanfe yona mishshear ofot mishshum deimmetil keneset yisrael leona shenneemar kanfe yona nechpa vakkesef vego ma yona kenafeha meginot aleha af yisrael mitzot meginot alehen
Binsoret shel charashin ku ibaya lehu rabbi yehuda annesoret shel charashin kae o anneoret shel pishtan kae
Ta shema detanya rabbi yehuda omer neoret shel pishtan dakka hare hi kezevel shema minah anneoret shel pishtan kae shema minah
Matni tomnin beshilchin umtaltelin otan begize tzemer veen metaltelin otan ketzad hu ose notel et hakkissuy vehen noflot
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer kuppa mattah al tziddah venotel shemma yittol veeno yachol lehachazir vachachamim omrim notel umachazir

Gema yatev rabbi yonatan ben achinay verabbi yonatan ben elazar veyatev rabbi chanina bar chama gabbayehu veka mibaya lehu shelachin shel baal habbayit tenan aval shel umman kevan dekafed alayehu la metaltelinan lehu o dilma shel umman tenan vechal shekken shel baal habbayit
Amar lehu rabbi yonatan ben elazar mistabbera shel baal habbayit tenan aval shel umman kafed alayehu amar lehu rabbi chanina bar chama kach amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose
b: Abba shallacha hava veamar haviu shelachin veneshev alehen
Metivi nesarin shel baal habbayit metaltelin otan veshel umman en metaltelin otan veim chishev latet alehen pat laorchin ben kach uven kach metaltelin shane nesarim dekafed alayehu
Ta shema orot ben avudin uven sheen avudin muttar letaltelan beshabbat lo amru avudin ella leinyan tuma bilvad may lav la shena shel baal habbayit vela shena shel umman la shel baal habbayit

Aval shel umman may en metaltelin i hachi ha detane velo amru avudin ella leinyan tuma bilvad liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim beshel baal habbayit aval beshel umman lo kullah bevaal habbayit kamayere
Ketannae orot shel baal habbayit metaltelin otan veshel umman en metaltelin otan rabbi yose omer echad ze veechad ze metaltelin otan
Hadur yatvi vekamibaya lehu ha ditnan avot melachot arbaim chaser achat keneged mi

Amar lehu rabbi chanina bar chama keneged avodot hammishkan amar lehu rabbi yonatan berabbi elazar kach amar rabbi shimon berabbi yose ben lakonya keneged melacha melachto umlechet shebbattora arbaim chaser achat

Bae rav yosef vayyavo habbayeta laasot melachto mimminyana hu o la amar leh abbaye velayete sefer tora velimne mi la amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo zazu mishsham ad sheheviu sefer tora umnaum
Amar leh ki ka mesappeka li mishshum dichtiv vehammelacha hayeta dayyam mimminyana hu veha keman deamar laasot tzerachav nichnas
O dilma vayyavo habbayeta laasot melachto mimminyana hu vehay vehammelacha hayeta dayyam hachi kaamar dishlima leh avidta teku
Tanya keman deamar keneged avodot hammishkan detanya en chayyavin ella al melacha shekkayyotze bah hayeta bammishkan hem zaru veattem lo tizreu hem katzru veattem lo tiktzeru

Hem heelu et hakkerashim mikkarka laagala veattem lo tachnisu mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid hem horidu et hakkerashim meagala lekarka veattem lo totziu mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim hem hotziu meagala laagala veattem lo totziu mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid
Mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid may ka aved abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu veitema rav adda bar ahava mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derech reshut harabbim
Begize tzemer veen metaltelin amar rava lo shanu ella shello taman bahen aval taman bahen metaltelin otan
Etiveh hahu merabbanan bar yomeh lerava tomnin begize tzemer veen metaltelin otan ketzad hu ose

a: Notel et hakkisuy vehen noflot
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rava lo shanu ella shello yichadan lehatmana aval yichadan lehatmana metaltelin otan
Itmar name ki ata ravin amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi assi ben shaul amar rabbi lo shanu ella shello yichadan lehatmana aval yichadan lehatmana metaltelin otan
Ravina omer beshel heftek shanu tanya name hachi gize tzemer shel heftek en metaltelin otan veim hitkinan baal habbayit lehishtammesh bahen metaltelin otan

Tana rabba bar bar channa kammeh derav chariyyot shel dekel sheggedaran leetzim venimlach alehen lishiva tzarich lekashsher rabban shimon ben gamliel omer en tzarich lekashsher hu tane lah vehu amar lah halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Itmar rav amar kosher ushmuel amar choshev verav assi amar yoshev af al pi shello kisher veaf al pi shello chishev
Bishlama rav hu deamar ketanna kamma ushmuel name hu deamar kerabban shimon ben gamliel ella rav assi deamar keman

Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya yotzin befakorin uvtzifa bizman shetztzevaan beshemen uchrachan bimshicha lo tzevaan beshemen velo kerachan bimshicha en yotzin bahem veim yatza bahen shaa achat mibbeod yom af al pi shello tzava velo kerachan bimshicha muttar latzet bahen

Amar rav ashe af anan name tenena hakkash sheal gabbe hammitta lo yenaneennu beyado aval menaano begufo aval im haya alav maachal behema o shehaya alav kar o sadin mibbeod yom menaano beyado shema mina

Uman tena diflig aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel rabbi chanina ben akiva dechi ata rav dimi amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina paam achat halach rabbi chanina ben akiva lemakom echad umatza chariyyot shel dekel sheggedarum leshum etzim veamar lahem letalmidav tzeu vechashshevu kede shenneshev alehen lemachar vela yadana i bet hammishte hava i bet haevel hava
Middekaamar i bet hammishte hava i bet haevel hava daveka bet haevel o bet hammishte ditridi aval hacha kashar in lo kashar la
Amar rav yehuda machnis adam melo kuppato afar veose bah kol tzarko daresh mar zutra mishshemeh demar zutra rabba vehu sheyyiched lo keren zavit
Amaru rabbanan kammeh derav pappa keman kerabban shimon ben gamliel dei kerabbanan haamri baenan maase
Amar lehu rav pappa afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan devaenan maase ella mide devar mebad beh maase aval mide dela bar mebad beh maase la
Nema ketannae bakkol chofin et hakkelim chutz mikkele chesef bigratkon ha neter vachol muttar
Vehatanya neter vachol asur may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar baenan maase umar savar la baenan maase
La dechulle alma la baenan maase vela kashya ha rabbi yehuda ha rabbi shimon
Ha rabbi yehuda deamar davar sheen mitkaven asur ha rabbi shimon deamar davar sheen mitkaven muttar
Bemay okemta leha deshare kerabbi shimon ema sefa aval lo yachof bahem searo vei rabbi shimon mishra kashare ditnan
b: Nazir chofef umfaspes aval lo sorek
Ella ha veha rabbi yehuda hi utre tannae alliba derabbi yehuda hay tanna alliba derabbi yehuda savar garer vehay tanna alliba derabbi yehuda savar la garer
Bemay okemta kerabbi yehuda ema sefa aval panav yadav veraglav muttar ha meabbar sear
Ibaet ema bekatan veibaet ema baishsha veibaet ema besaris
Amar rav yehuda afar leventa shere amar rav yosef kuspa deyasmin shere amar rava afar pilpele shere amar rav sheshet barda shere
May barda amar rav yosef tilta ahala vetilta asa vetilta sigle amar rav nechemya bar yosef kol hecha deleka rubba ahala shappir dame
Beo mineh merav sheshet mahu liftzoa zetim beshabbat amar lehu vechi bechol mi hittiru kasavar mishshum hefsed ochalin
Lema peliga dishmuel deamar shemuel ose adam kol tzorko befat amri pat la meisa hane meise

Ammemar umar zutra verav ashe hao yatvi ayeto lekammayehu barda ammemar verav ashe mesho mar zutra la mesha amaru leh la savar lah mar leha deamar rav sheshet barda shere amar lehu rav mardochay bar mineh demar daafilu bechol name la sevira leh
Savar lah ki ha detanya megarer adam gilde tzoa vegilde makka sheal besaro bishvil tzaaro im bishvil leyappot asur
Veinhu keman savruha ki ha detanya rochetz adam panav yadav veraglav bechol yom bishvil kono mishshum shenneemar kol paal Adonai lammaanehu
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer kuppa mattah al tziddah venotel shemma yittol vechu amar rabbi abba amar rabbi chiyya bar ashe amar rav hakkol modim sheim nitkalkela haggumma sheasur lehachazir
Tenan vachachamim omrim notel umachazir hechi dame i dela nitkalkela haggumma shappir ka amri rabbanan ella lav af al pi denitkalkela haggumma
La leolam dela nitkalkela vehacha bechoshshin kamipalgi mar savar choshshin shemma nitkalkela haggumma umar savar en choshshin
Amar rav huna hay selikusta datzah shalfa vahadar datzah shere vei lav asir
Amar shemuel hay sakkina devene urve datzah shalfah vahadar datzah shere vei lav asir
Mar zutra veitema rav ashe amar begurdeyata dikne shappir dame
Amar leh rav mardochay lerava metiv rav kattina teuvta hattomen lefet utznonot tachat haggefen im haya miktzat alav megullim eno choshesh

a: Lo mishshum kilayim velo mishshum sheviit velo mishshum maaser venitalin beshabbat teuvta
Matni lo kissahu mibbeod yom lo yechassennu mishshettechshach kissahu venitgalla muttar lechassoto memalle et hakkiton venoten letachat hakkar o tachat hakkeset
Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel muttar lehatmin et hatztzonen amar rav yosef may kamashma lan tenena memalle adam kiton venoten tachat hakkar o tachat hakkeset
Amar leh abbaye tuva kamashma lan dei mimmatni hava amena hane mile davar sheen darko lehatmin aval davar sheddarko lehatmin la kamashma lan

Amar rav huna amar rav asur lehatmin et hatztzonen vehatanya rabbi hittir lehatmin et hatztzonen la kashya ha mikkammeh delishmeeh merabbi yishmael berabbi yose ha levatar delishmeeh ki ha deyatev rabbi veamar asur lehatmin et hatztzonen amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose abba hittir lehatmin et hatztzonen amar kevar hora zaken

Amar rav pappa bo ure kamma mechabbevin ze et ze sheilu rabbi yose kayyam haya kafuf veoshev lifne rabbi deha rabbi yishmael berabbi yose dimmalle mekom avotav hava vechafuf veoshev lifne rabbi vekaamar kevar hora zaken
Amar leh rav nachman ledaru avdeh atmen li tzonen veayeti li mayya deachem kappila arammaa shema rabbi amme veikfad amar rav yosef may tama ikfad kerabbeoteh aved chada kerav vachada kishmuel
Kishmuel deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel muttar lehatmin et hatztzonen kerav deamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav kol shehu neechal kemot shehu chay en bo mishshum bishshule goyim
Hu savar adam chashuv shane

Tanu rabbanan af al pi sheamru en tomnin afilu bedavar sheeno mosif hevel mishshechashecha im ba lehosif mosif ketzad hu ose rabban shimon ben gamliel omer notel et hassedinin umanniach et haggelufkerin o notel et haggelufkerin umanniach et hassedinin
Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo asru ella oto mecham aval pina mimmecham lemecham muttar hashta okore ka meker lehu artoche ka martach lehu
Taman vechisa bedavar hannital beshabbat o taman bedavar sheeno nital beshabbat vechisa bedavar hannital beshabbat hare ze notel umachazir
Taman vechisa bedavar sheeno nital beshabbat o shettaman bedavar hannital beshabbat vechisa bedavar sheeno nital beshabbat im haya megulle miktzato notel umachazir veim lav
b: Eno notel umachazir
Rabbi yehuda omer neoret shel pishtan dakka hare hi kezevel
Mannichin mecham al gabbe mecham ukdera al gabbe kedera aval lo kedera al gabbe mecham umecham al gabbe kedera vetach et piha bevatzek velo bishvil sheyyechammu ella bishvil sheyyihu meshummarim
Uchshem sheen tomnin et hachammin kach en tomnin et hatztzonen rabbi hittir lehatmin et hatztzonen
Veen merazzekin lo et hashsheleg velo et habbarad beshabbat bishvil sheyyazuvu memav aval noten hu letoch hakkos o letoch hakkeara veeno choshesh
Matni bamme behema yotza uvamma enah yotza yotze haggamal beafsar venaaka bachatam veluvdekim bifrumbeya vesus besher
Vechal baale hashsher yotzin besher venimshachin besher
Umazzin alehen vetovlan bimkoman
Gema may naka bachatam amar rabba bar bar chana nakta chivarti bizmama defarzela veluvdekim bifrumbeya amar rav huna chamara luva befagge defarzela
Levi shaddar zuze leve chozae lemizban leh chamara luva tzaru shaddaru leh seare lememar denigre dachamara seare
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel machlifin lifne rabbi shel zo bazo mahu
Naka beafsar la tibe lach kevan dela minatra beh massooy hu ki tibe lach gamal bachatam may kevan desaggi leh beafsar massooy hu o dilma netiruta yattirta la amrinan massooy hu
Amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose kach amar abba arba behemot yotzot beafsar hassus vehappered vehaggamal vehachamor lemaote may lav lemaote gamal bachatam la lemaote naka beafsar
Bematnita tana luvdekim vegamal yotzin beafsar ketannae en chayya yotza besugar chananya omer yotza besugar uvchol davar hammishtammer
Bemay askinan ilema bechayya gedola mi saggi lah sugar veella bechayya ketanna mi la saggi lah sugar

Ella lav chatul ika benayehu tanna kamma savar kevan desaggi lah bemitna bealma massooy hu vachananya savar kol netiruta yattirta la amrinan massooy hu amar rav huna bar chiyya amar shemuel halacha kachananya
Levi bereh derav huna bar chiyya verabba bar rav huna hao kaazli beorcha kadmeh chamara delevi lachamara derabbah bar rav huna chalash dateh derabba bar rav huna amar ema leh milta ki hechi

a: Detitotav dateh amar leh chamor sheasakav raim kegon ze mahu latzet bifrumbeya beshabbat amar leh hachi amar avuch mishshemeh dishmuel halacha kachananya

Tana deve menashsheya ez shechakak lah ben karneha yotza beafsar beshabbat bae rav yosef tachav lah bizkanah mahu kevan dei menattach lah kaev lah la atya lenattocheh o dilma zimnin derafe venafel veate leetuye arba ammot birshut harabbim teku
Tenan hatam velo birtzua shebben karneha amar leh rabbi yirmeya bar abba peligi bah rav ushmuel chad amar ben lenoy ben leshammer asur vechad amar lenoy asur ulshammer muttar
Amar rav yosef tistayyem dishmuel hu deamar lenoy asur leshammer muttar deamar rav huna bar chiyya amar shemuel halacha kachananya

Amar leh abbaye adderabba tistayyem dishmuel hu deamar ben lenoy ben leshammer asur deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel machlifin lifne rabbi shel zo bezo mahu amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose kach amar abba arba behemot yotzot beafsar hassus happered vehaggamal vehachamor lav lemaote gamal bachatam sami ha mikkamme ha

Umay chazet dimsammet ha mikkamme ha sami ha mikkamme ha deashkechan shemuel hu deamar lenoy asur leshammer muttar deittemar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav ben lenoy ben leshammer asur verav chiyya bar avin amar shemuel lenoy asur leshammer muttar
Metivi kesharah bealeha bemosera keshera vei salka datach massooy hu asher lo ala aleha ol amar rachamana
Amar abbaye bemolichah meir lair rava amar shane para dedameha yekarin ravina amar bemoredet
Hassus besher vechu may yotzin umay nimshachin amar rav huna o yotzin keruchin o nimshachin ushmuel amar yotzin nimshachin veen yotzin keruchin
Bematnita tana yotzin keruchin limashech amar rav yosef chazena lehu leigle deve rav huna yotzin beafserehen keruchin beshabbat
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi chanina mulaot shel bet rabbi yotzot beafserehen beshabbat ibaya lehu keruchin o nimshachin
Ta shema ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi chanina mulaot shel bet rabbi yotzot beafserehen keruchim beshabbat
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav assi ha derav shemuel bar yehuda la tzericha midderav dimi nafka dei salka datach derav dimi nimshachin kaamar midderav yehuda amar shemuel nafka
Deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel machlifin hau lifne rabbi shel zo bazo mahu amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose kach amar abba arba behemot yotzet baafsar hassus vehappered vehaggamal vehachamor
Amar lehu rav assi itzterich lehu dei midderav yehuda nafka hava amena amar lefanav vela kablah mineh ka mashma lan derav dimi
Vei derav dimi hava amena hane mile nimshachin aval keruchin la ka mashma lan derav shemuel bar rav yehuda
Umazzin alehen vetovlan bimkoman lememra divne kabbole tuma ninhu vehatnan tabbaat adam temea vetabbaat behema vechelim ushar kol hattabbaot
b: Tehorot
Amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha bevain minnoy adam lenoy behema
Verav yosef amar hoil veadam moshech bahem et habbehema mi la tanya makkel shel behema shel mattechet mekabbel tuma ma taam hoil veadam rodah bahen hacha name hoil veadam moshech bahen
Vetovlan bimkoman vehaika chatzitza
Amar rabbi amme besheritchan
Lema rabbi amme kerav yosef sevira leh dei kerabbi yitzchak nappacha deamar bevain minnoy adam lenoy behema kevan deritchan avad behu maase ufracha lah tuma minayehu
Ditnan kol hakkelim yordin lide tumatan bemachshava veen olin mittumatan ella beshinuy maase
Savar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar maase letakken lav maase hu detanya rabbi yehuda omer lo amru shinuy maase letakken ella lekalkel
Bematnita tane bimchullalin
Shaal talmid echad miggalil haelon et rabbi eliezer shamati shecholkin ben tabbaat letabbaat amar lo shemma lo shamata ella leinyan shabbat dei leinyan tuma da veda chada hi
Ulinyan tuma da veda achat hi vehatnan tabbaat adam temea vetabbaat behema vechelim ushar kol hattabbaot tehorot ki kaamar leh ihu name deadam kaamar leh
Udadam da veda achat hi vehatanya tabbaat shehitkina lachgor bah motnav ulkashsher bah ben ketefav tehora velo amru temea ella shel etzba bilvad ki kaamar leh ihu name deetzba kaamar leh
Udetzba da veda achat hi vehatnan tabbaat shel mattechet vechotamah shel almog temea hi shel almog vechotamah shel mattechet tehora ki kaamar leh ihu name kullah shel mattechet kaamar leh
Veod shaal shamati shecholkin ben machat lemachat amar lo shemma lo shamatte ella leinyan shabbat dei leinyan tuma da veda achat hi
Ulinyan tuma da veda achat hi vehatnan machat shennital chorah o uktzah tehora ki kaamar leh bishlema
Uvishlema da veda achat hi vehatnan machat sheheelta chaluda im meakkev et hattefira tehora veim lav temea veamri deve rabbi yannay vehu sherishumah nikar ki kaamar leh beshifa kaamar leh
Uvshifa da veda achat hi vehatanya machat ben nekuva ben enah nekuva muttar letaltelah beshabbat vela amrinan nekuva ella leinyan tuma bilvad
Ha targemah abbaye alliba derava begulme

Matni chamor yotze bammardaat bizman shehi keshura bo zecharim yotzin levuvin rechelot yotzot shechuzot kevulot uchvunot haizzim yotzot tzerurot rabbi yose oser bechullan chutz min harchelin hakkevunot
Rabbi yehuda omer izzim yotzot tzerurot leyabbesh aval lo lechalev

a: Gema amar shemuel vehu shekkeshura lo meerev shabbat amar rav nachman matnitin name dayeka dekatane en hachamor yotze bammardaat bizman sheenah keshura lo
Hechi dame ilema sheenah keshura lo kelal peshita dilma nafla leh veate leetuye ella lav sheenah keshura meerev shabbat mikkelal deresha shekkeshura lo meerev shabbat shema minah

Tanya name hachi chamor yotze bammardaat bizman shekkeshura lo meerev shabbat velo baukkaf af al pi shekkashur lo meerev shabbat rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af baukkaf bizman shekkashur lo meerev shabbat uvilvad shello yikshor lo masrechan uvilvad shello yifshol lo retzua tachat zenavo
Bea mineh rav assi bar natan merabbi chiyya bar rav ashe mahu liten mardaat al gabbe chamor beshabbat amar leh muttar amar leh vechi ma ben ze leukkaf ishtik
Etiveh ukkaf sheal gabbe chamor lo yetaltelennu beyado ella molichah umviah bechatzer vehu nofel meelav hashta litol amratte la lehanniach mibaya

Amar leh rabbi zera shivkeh kerabbeh sevira leh deamar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav tolin teraskal livhema beshabbat vekal vachomer lemardaat uma hatam demishshum taanug shere hacha demishshum tzaar lo kol shekken
Shemuel amar mardaat muttar teraskal asur azal rabbi chiyya bar yosef amrah lishmata derav kammeh dishmuel amar leh i hachi amar abba la yada bemile deshabbeta vela kelum
Ki salek rabbi zera ashkecheh lerabbi binyamin bar yefet deyatev vekaamar leh mishshemeh derabbi yochanan notnin mardaat al gabbe chamor beshabbat amar leh yishar vechen targemah aroch bevavel
Aroch mannu shemuel veha rav name amrah ella shameh dahava mesayyem bah veen tolin teraskal beshabbat amar leh yishar vechen targemah aroch bevavel
Dechulle alma mihat mardaat muttar may shena meukkaf shane hatam deefshar denafel mimmela
Rav pappa amar kan lechammemah kan letzannenah lechammemah it lah tzaara letzannenah let lah tzaara vehayenu deamri inashe chamara afilu bitkufat tammuz karir lah

Metivi lo yetze hassus biznav shual velo bazzaharurit shebben enav lo yetze hazzav bakkis shello velo izzim bakkis shebbedaddehen velo para bachissum shebbefiha velo seyachim batteraskalin shebbefihem lirshut harabbim velo behema bassandal shebberagleha velo bakkamea af al pi shehu mumche veze chomer babbehema mibbaadam
Aval yotze hu baeged sheal gabbe hammakka uvakkeshishin sheal gabbe hashshever uvashshilya hamduldelet bah ufokkin lah zug betzavarah umtayyelet immo bechatzer
Katane mihat velo seyachin bitraskalim shebbefihem lirshut harabbim lirshut harabbim hu dela ha bechatzer shappir dame may lav bigdolim umishshum taanug
La biktannim umishshum tzaar dayeka name dekatane
b: Dumya dekamea shema mina
Amar mar velo bakkamea af al pi shehu mumche veha anan tenan velo bakkamea sheeno mumche ha mumche shappir dame hacha name sheeno mumche
Veha af al pi shehu mumche katane mumche leadam veeno mumche livhema umi ika mumche leadam vela have mumche livhema in adam deit leh mazzala mesayya leh behema delet lah mazzala la mesayya lah
I hachi may ze chomer babbehema mibbaadam mi savratte akkamea kae assandal kae
Ta shema sachin umfarkesin leadam veen sachin umfarkesin labbehema may lav deika makka umishshum tzaar la digmar makka umishshum taanug
Ta shema behema sheachazah dam en maamidin otah bemayim bishvil shettitztannen adam sheachazo dam maamidin oto bemayim bishvil sheyyitztannen amar ulla gezera mishshum shechikat sammanin
I hachi adam name adam nire kemeker
I hachi behema name nire kemeker en meker livhema
Velivhema mi gazrinan vehatanya hayeta omedet chutz lattechum kore lah vehi baa vela gazrinan dilma ate leetuye
Amar ravina kegon shehaya techum shellah muvla betoch techum shello
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar shechikat sammanin gufa tannae hi detanya behema sheachla karshinin lo yeritzenna bechatzer bishvil shettitrappe verabbi oshaya mattir daresh rava halacha kerabbi oshaya
Amar mar lo yetze hazzav bakkis shello velo izzim bakkis shebbedaddehen vehatanya yotzot izzim bakkis shebbedaddehen
Amar rav yehuda la kashya ha demihaddak ha dela mihaddak

Rav yosef amar tannae shaklatte mealma tannae hi ditnan haizzim yotzot tzerurot rabbi yose oser bechullan chutz min harchelot hakkevunot rabbi yehuda omer izzim yotzot tzerurot leyabbesh aval lo lechalev
Veibaet ema ha veha rabbi yehuda vela kashya kan leyabbesh kan lechalev
Tanya amar rabbi yehuda maase beizzim shel antochya shehau daddehen gassin veasu lahen kisin kede shello yissartu daddehen
Tanu rabbanan maase beechad shemmeta ishto vehinnicha ben linak velo haya lo sechar menika liten venaasa lo nes veniftechu lo daddin kishne dadde ishsha vehenik et beno
Amar rav yosef bo ure kamma gadol adam ze shennaasa lo nes kaze amar leh abbaye adderabba kamma garua adam ze shennishtannu lo sidre vereshit
Amar rav yehuda bo ure kamma kashim mezonotav shel adam shennishtannu alav sidre vereshit amar rav nachman tidda demitrechish nisa vela ibberu mezone

Tanu rabbanan maase beadam echad shennasa ishsha gidemet velo hikkir bah ad yom motah amar rav bo ure kamma tzenua ishsha zo shello hikkir bah baalah amar lo rabbi chiyya zo darkah bechach ella kamma tzanua adam ze shello hikkir beishto
Zecharim yotzin levuvin may levuvin amar rav huna tutare may mashma dehay levuvin lishana dekarove hu dichtiv libbavtini achoti challa

Ulla amar or shekkoshrin lahem keneged libbam kede shello yippelu alehen zeevim zeevim azzecharim nafli annekevot la nafli mishshum dimsaggu beresh edra uzevin beresh edra nafli besof edra la nafli ella mishshum deshammine uvinkevot leka deshamminan vetu mi yadi ben hane lehane ella mishshum dezakfi chutmayehu umsaggu ki dau

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar or shekkoshrin lahen tachat zachrutan kede shello yaalu al hannekevot mimmay middekatane sefa veharchelim yotzot shechuzot may shechuzot sheochazin haalya shellahen lemala kede sheyyaalu alehen zecharim resha kede shello yaalu al hannekevot vesefa kede sheyyaalu alehen zecharim
May mashma dehay shechuzot lishana degalloye hu dichtiv vehinne ishsha likrato

a: Shit zona untzurat lev

Harchelim yotzot kevulot may kevulot shemmechabbelin alya shellahen lematta kede shello yaalu alehen zecharim may mashma dehay kavul lishana dela aved pere hu dichtiv ma hearim haelle asher natatta li achi vayyikra lahen eretz kavul ad hayyom hazze

May eretz kavul amar rav huna shehau bah bene adam shemmechubbalin bechesef uvzahav amar leh rava i hachi hayenu dichtiv ki lo yashru beenav mippene shemmechubbalin bechesef uvzahav lo yashru beenav amar leh in kevan deattire umfanneki la avdi avidta
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar eretz chomton hayeta veammay kare lah kavul demistarga bah kara ad kavla veamri inashe ara mechabbalta dela avda pere
Kevunot may kevunot shemchabbenin otan lemelat keditnan seet ketzemer lavan may tzemer lavan amar rav bivi bar abbaye ketzemer naki ben yomo shemchabbenin oto lemelat
Vehaizzim yotzot tzerurot itmar rav amar halacha kerabbi yehuda ushmuel amar halacha kerabbi yose
Veika dematne leha shemata beappe nafshah rav amar leyabbesh muttar velo lechalev ushmuel amar echad ze veechad ze asur

Veika dematne lah aha izzim yotzot tzerurot leyabbesh aval lo lechalev mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betera amru kach halacha aval mi mefis ezo leyabbesh veezo lechalev umittoch sheen makkirim echad ze veechad ze asur amar shemuel veamri lah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betera ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan halacha ketanna kamma
Matni uvamma enah yotza lo yetze gamal bimtultelet lo akud velo ragul vechen shear kol habbehemot
Lo yikshor gemallim ze baze veyimshoch aval machnis chavalim letoch yado veyimshoch uvilvad shello yichroch
Gema tana lo yetze haggamal bimtultelet hakkeshura lo biznavo aval yotze hu bimtultelet hakkeshura biznavo uvchotarto amar rabba bar rav huna yotze haggamal bimtultelet hakkeshura lo beshilyeta
Lo akud velo ragul amar rav yehuda akud akedat yad varegel keyitzchak ben avraham ragul shello yachof yado al gabbe zeroo veyikshor

Metivi akud shette yadayim ushte raglayim ragul shello yachof yado al gabbe zeroo veyikshor hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya akud akedat yad varegel o shette yadayim ushte raglayim ragul shello yachof yado al gabbe zeroo veyikshor
Veakkatti la dame bishlama resha vesefa nicha metziata kashya
Ella hu deamar ki hay tanna akud akedat yad varegel keyitzchak ben avraham ragul shello yachof yado al gabbe zeroo veyikshor
Velo yikshor gemallim may tama amar rav ashe mishshum demechze keman deazel lechinga
Aval machnis amar rav ashe lo shanu ella leinyan kilayim kilayim demay ilema kilayim deadam vehatnan adam muttar im kullam lacharosh velimshoch
Ella kilayim dachavalim vehatanya hattochef techifa achat enah chibur
Leolam kilayim dachavalim vehachi kaamar uvilvad shello yichroch veyikshor
Amar shemuel uvilvad shello yetze chevel mittachat yado tefach veha tana deve shemuel tifchayim
Amar abbaye hashta deamar shemuel tefach vetana deve shemuel tifchayim shemuel halacha lemaase ata leashmoinan
b: Vehatanya uvilvad sheyyagbiha min hakkarka tefach ki tanya hahi bechavla devene bene
Matni en chamor yotze bammardaat bizman sheenah keshura lo velo bazzug af al pi shehu pakuk velo besullam shebbetzavaro velo birtzua shebberaglo
Veen hattarnegolim yotzin bechutin velo birtzua shebberaglehem veen hazzecharim yotzin baagala shettachat haalya shellahen

Veen harchelim yotzot chanunot veen haegel yotze begimon velo para beor hakkuppar velo birtzua shebben karneha parato shel rabbi elazar ben azarya hayeta yotza birtzua shebben karneha shello birtzon chachamim
Gema may tama kedaamaran
Velo bazzug af al pi shehu pakuk mishshum demechze keman deazel lechinga
Velo besullam shebbetzavaro amar rav huna be loa lemay avdi leh lehecha deit leh makka dela hadar chayech bah
Velo birtzua shebberaglo deavdi leh legizra
Veen hattarnegolin yotzin bechutin deavdi lehu simana ki hechi dela lichlefu
Velo birtzua deavdi lehu ki hechi dela litberu mane veen hazzecharim yotzin baagala ki hechi dela lichmetan alyatayehu

Veen harchelim yotzot chanunot yatev rav acha bar ulla kammeh derav chisda veyatev vekaamar mishshaa sheggozzin otah tomnin lah ezek beshemen umannichin lah al paddachtah kede shello titztannen amar leh rav chisda im ken asitah mar ukva

Ella yatev rav pappa bar shemuel kammeh derav chisda veyatev vekaamar beshaa shekkoraat leled tomnin lah shene azakin shel shemen umannichin lah echad al paddachtah veechad al harechem kede shettitchammem amar leh rav nachman im ken asitah yalta

Ella amar rav huna etz echad yesh bichrakke hayyam veyachnun shemo umviin kesam umannichin lah bechotmah kede shettitattesh veyippelu darne roshah i hachi zecharim name kevan dimnaggeche zecharim bahadade mimmela naflan shimon nezira amar kisma deritma
Bishlama derav huna hayenu dekatane chanunot ella lerabbanan may chanunot deavdinan lehu milta dimrachaminan alayehu
Veen haegel yotze begimon may egel begimon amar rav huna bar nira amar rabbi elazar may mashma dehay gimon lishana demechaf dichtiv halachof keagmon rosho
Velo para beor hakkuppar deavdi lah ki hechi dela limtzeuha yale
Velo birtzua shebben karneha i lerav deamar ben lenoy ben leshammer asur i lishmuel deamar lenoy asur leshammer muttar
Parato shel rabbi elazar ben azarya vachada para haveya leh veha amar rav veamri lah amar rav yehuda amar rav teresar alfe igle hava meassar rabbi elazar ben azarya meedreh kol shatta veshatta
Tana lo shello hayeta ella shel shechento hayeta umittoch shello micha bah nikret al shemo

Rav verabbi chanina verabbi yochanan verav chaviva matnu bechulleh deseder moed kal ki hay zuga challofe rabbi yochanan umayyel rabbi yonatan kol mi sheefshar limchot leanshe veto velo micha nitpas al anshe veto beanshe iro nitpas al anshe iro bechal haolam kullo nitpas al kal haolam kullo
Amar rav pappa vehane deve resh galuta mitafsu akkulle alma ki ha deamar rabbi chanina may dichtiv Adonai bammishpat yavo im zikne ammo vesarav im sarim chatu

a: Zekenim me chatu ella ema al zekenim shello michu bassarim

Rav yehuda hava yatev kammeh dishmuel atay hahi itta ka tzavecha kammeh vela hava mashgach bah amar leh la savar leh mar otem ozno mizzaakat dal gam hu yikra velo yeane amar leh shinana reshach bekarire resha dereshach bechammime ha yatev mar ukva av bet din
Dichtiv bet david ko amar Adonai dinu labboker mishpat vehatztzilu gazul miyyad oshek pen tetze chaesh chamati uvaara veen mechabbe mippene roa maallehem vego
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi simon lochchinhu mar lehane deve resh galuta amar leh la mekabbeli minay amar leh af al gav dela mekabbeli lochchinhu mar

Deamar rabbi acha berabbi chanina meolam lo yatzta midda tova mippi hakkadosh baruch hu vechazar bah leraa chutz middavar ze dichtiv vayyomer Adonai elav avor betoch hair betoch yerushalam vehitvita tav al mitzchot haanashim hanneenachim vehanneenakim al kol hattoevot hannaasot betochah vego

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu legavriel lech urshom al mitzchan shel tzaddikim tav shel deo shello yishletu bahem malache chabbala veal mitzcham shel reshaim tav shel dam kede sheyyishletu bahen malache chabbala

Amra middat haddin lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam ma nishtannu ellu meellu amar lah hallalu tzaddikim gemurim vehallalu reshaim gemurim amra lefanav ribbono shel olam haya beyadam limchot velo michu
Amar lah galuy veyadua lefanay sheim michu bahem lo yekabbelu mehem amar amra lefanav ribbono shel olam im lefanecha galuy lahem mi galuy

Vehayenu dichtiv zaken bachur uvtula taf venashim tahargu lemashchit veal kol ish asher alav hattav al tiggashu umimmikdashi tachellu uchtiv vayyachellu baanashim hazzekenim asher lifne habbayit tane rav yosef al tikre mikdashi ella mekuddashay ellu bene adam shekkiyemu et hattora kullah mealef vead tav umiyyad vehinne shishsha anashim baim midderech shaar haelon asher mofne tzafona veish keli mappatzo beyado veish echad betocham lavush habbaddim vekeset hassofer bemotnav vayyavou vayyaamdu etzel mizbach hannechoshet
Mizbeach hannechoshet mi hava amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu hatchilu mimmekom sheomrim shira lefanay uman ninhu shishsha anashim amar rav chisda ketzef af vechema umashchit umshabber umchalle
Umay shena tav amar rav tav tichye tav tamut ushmuel amar tamma zechut avot verabbi yochanan amar tachon zechut avot

Veresh lakish amar tav sof chotamo shel hakkadosh baruch hu deamar rabbi chanina chotamo shel hakkadosh baruch hu emet amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar ellu bene adam shekkiyemu et hattora kullah mealef vead tav
Meematay tamma zechut avot amar rav mimot hoshea ben beeri shenneemar agalle et navlutah leene meahaveha veish lo yatztzilenna miyyadi

Ushmuel amar mime chazael shenneemar vachazael melech aram lachatz et yisrael kol yeme yehoachaz uchtiv vayyachon Adonai otam vayerachamem vayyifen alehem lemaan berito et avraham yitzchak veyaakov velo ava hashchitam velo hishlicham meal panav ad atta

Rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar mime eliyyahu shenneemar vayehi baalot hammincha vayyiggash eliyyahu hannavi vayyomar Adonai elohe avraham yitzchak veyisrael hayyom yivada ki atta elohim beyisrael vaani avdecha uvidvarcha asiti et kol haddevarim haelle vego

Verabbi yochanan amar mime chizkiyyahu shenneemar lemarbe hammisra ulshalom en ketz al kisse david veal mamlachto lehachin otah ulsaadah bemishpat uvitzdaka meatta vead olam kinat Adonai tzevaot taase zot vego
Amar rav amme en mita belo chet veen yissurin belo aon

En mita belo chet dichtiv hannefesh hachotet hi tamut ben lo yissa baaon haav veav lo yissa baaon habben tzidkat hatztzaddik alav tihye verishat harasha alav tihye vego en yissurin belo aon dichtiv ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim aonam
b: Metivi amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam mippene ma kanasta mita al adam harishon amar lahem mitzva kalla tzivitiv veavar aleha amru lo vahalo moshe veaharon shekkiyemu kol hattora kullah umetu amar lahem mikre echad latztzaddik velarasha lattov vego
Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af moshe veaharon bechetam metu shenneemar yaan lo heemantem bi ha heemantem bi adayin lo higgia zemannechem lipater min haolam

Metivi arbaa metu beeto shel nachash veellu hen binyamin ben yaakov veamram avi moshe veyishay avi david vechilav ben david vechullehu gemara levar miyyishay avi david dimfaresh bah kera dichtiv veet amasa sam avshalom tachat yoav sar al hatztzava vaamasa ven ish ushmo yitra hayyisreeli asher ba el avigayil bat nachash achot tzeruya em yoav
Vechi bat nachash havay vahalo bat yishay havay dichtiv veachotehen tzeruya vaavigayil ella bat mi shemmet beeto shel nachash
Manni ilema tanna demalache hashsharet veha ika moshe veaharon ella lav rabbi shimon ben elazar hi ushma minah yesh mita belo chet veyesh yissurin belo aon utuvta derav amme teuvta

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol haomer reuven chata eno ella toe shenneemar vayyihu vene yaakov shenem asar melammed shekkullan shekulim keechad ella ma ani mekayyem vayyishkav et bilha pilegesh aviv melammed shebbilbel matztzao shel aviv umaale alav hakkatuv keilu shachav immah

Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mutztzal oto tzaddik meoto aon velo ba maase ze leyado efshar atid zaro laamod al har eval velomar arur shochev im eshet aviv veyavo chet ze leyado ella ma ani mekayyem vayyishkav et bilha pilegesh aviv elbon immo tava amar im achot immi hayeta tzara leimmi shifchat achot immi tehe tzara leimmi amad uvilbel et matztzaah
Acherim omrim shette matztzaot bilbel achat shel shechina veachat shel aviv vehayenu dichtiv az chillalta yetzui ala al tikre yetzui ella yetzuay
Ketannae pachaz kammayim al totar rabbi eliezer omer pazzota chavta zalta rabbi yehoshua omer pasata al dat chatata zanita rabban gamliel omer pilalta chalta zarcha tefillatecha

Amar rabban gamliel adayin tzerichin anu lammodai rabbi elazar hammodai omer hafoch et hatteva vedorshah zizata hirtata parach chet mimmecha rava amar veamri leh rabbi yirmeya bar abba zacharta onsho shel davar chillita atzmecha choli gadol perashta millachto
Reuven bene eli bene shemuel david ushlomo veoash siman
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol haomer bene eli chatu eno ella toe shenneemar vesham shene vene eli im aron berit haelohim chofni ufinchas kohanim la

Savar lah kerav deamar rav pinchas lo chata makkish chafni lefinchas ma pinchas lo chata af chafni lo chata ella ma ani mekayyem asher yishkevun et hannashim mittoch sheshshihu et kinehen shello halchu etzel baalehen maale alehen hakkatuv keilu shechavum
Gufa amar rav pinchas lo chata shenneemar vaachiyya ven achituv achi i chavod ben pinchas ben eli kohen Adonai vego efshar chet ba leyado vehakkatuv meyachaso

Vahalo kevar neemar yachret Adonai laish asher yaasenna er veone meohole yaakov umaggish mincha la tzevaot im yisrael hu lo yihye lo er bachachamim velo one battalmidim veim kohen hu lo yihye lo ben maggish mincha ella lav shema minah pinchas lo chata
Ella ha chetiv asher yishkevun yishkaven ketiv
Vehachtiv al banay ki lo tova hashshemua amar rav nachman bar yitzchak beni ketiv
Vehachtiv maavirim amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua maaviram ketiv
Vehachtiv bene veliyyaal mittoch shehaya lo lefinchas lemachot lechofni velo micha maale alav hakkatuv keillu chata
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol haomer

a: Bene shemuel chatu eno ella toe shenneemar vayehi ki zaken shemuel uvanav lo halchu bidrachav bidrachav hu delo halchu michta name la chatu

Ella ma ani mekayyem vayyittu achare habbatza shello asu kemaase avihem shehaya shemuel hatztzaddik mechazzer bechal mekomot yisrael vedan otam bearehem shenneemar vehalach midde shana beshana vesavav bet el vehaggilgal vehammitzpa veshafat et yisrael vehem lo asu ken ella yashvu bearehem kede leharbot sachar lechazzanehen ulsofrehen

Ketannae vayyittu achare habbatza rabbi meir omer chelkam shaalu befihem rabbi yehuda omer melay hittilu al baale vattim rabbi akiva omer kuppa yetera shel maaser natlu bizroa rabbi yose omer mattanot natlu bizroa
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol haomer david chata eno ella toe shenneemar vayehi david lechol derachav maskil va immo vego efshar chet ba leyado ushchina immo
Ella ma ani mekayyem maddua bazita et devar Adonai laasot hara shebbikesh laasot velo asa

Amar rav rabbi deate middavid mehappech vedaresh bizchuteh dedavid maddua bazita et devar Adonai laasot hara rabbi omer meshunna raa zo mikkol raot shebbattora shekkal raot shebbattora ketiv behu vayyaas vechan ketiv laasot shebbikesh laasot velo asa
Et uriyya hachitti hikkita vacherev shehaya lecha leduno besanhedrin velo danta veet ishto lakachta lecha leishsha likuchin yesh lecha bah

Deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol hayyotze lemilchemet bet david kotev get keritut leishto shenneemar veet aseret charitze hechalav haelle tavi lesar haalef veet achecha tifkod leshalom veet arubbatam tikkach
May arubbatam tane rav yosef devarim hamoravim beno levenah
Veoto haragta becherev bene ammon ma cherev bene ammon i atta neenash alav af uriyya hachitti i atta neenash alav
May tama mored bammalchut hava daamar leh vadoni yoav veavde adoni al pene hassade chonim
Amar rav ki meayenatte beh bedavid la mashkachatte beh bar middeuriyya dichtiv rak bidvar uriyya hachitti
Abbaye kashshisha rame derav adderav mi amar rav hachi vehaamar rav kibel david lashon hara kashya

Gufa rav amar kibel david lashon hara dichtiv vayyomer lo hammelech efo hu vayyomer tziva el hammelech hinne hu bet machir ben ammiel belo devar uchtiv vayyishlach hammelech vayyikkachehu mibbet machir ben ammiel millo devar

Mikkedi chazyeh deshakkara hu ki hadar alshen ilaveh may tama kabbel mineh dichtiv vayyomer hammelech el tziva ayye ben adonecha vayyomer tziva el hammelech hinne hu yoshev birushalayim vego umna lan dekabbel mineh dichtiv vayyomer hammelech hinne lecha kol asher limfivoshet vayyomer tziva hishtachaveti emtza chen beene hammelech

Ushmuel amar lo kibel david lashon hara devarim hannikarim chaza beh dichtiv umfivoshet ben shaul yarad lifne hammelech velo asa raglav velo asa sefamo veet begadav lo chibbes vego uchtiv vayehi ki va yerushalam likrat hammelech vayyomer lo hammelech lamma lo halachta immi mefivoshet vayyomar adoni hammelech avdi rimmani ki amar avdecha echbesha li hachamor veerkav aleha veelech et hammelech ki fisseach
b: Avdecha vayeraggel beavdecha el adoni hammelech vadoni hammelech kemalach haelohim vaase hattov beenecha vayyomer lo hammelech lamma tedabber od devarecha amarti atta vetziva tachleku et hassade vayyomer mefivoshet el hammelech gam et hakkol yikkach achare asher ba adoni hammelech beshalom el beto amar lo ani amarti matay tavo beshalom veatta ose li kach lo alecha yesh li taromot ella al mi sheheviacha beshalom

Hayenu dichtiv uven yehonatan meriv baal vechi meriv baal shemo vahalo mefivoshet shemo ella mittoch sheasa meriva im bealav yatzta bat kol veamra lo natztza bar natztza natztza ha daamaran bar natztza dichtiv vayyavo shaul ad ir amalek vayyarev bannachal amar rabbi mani al iske nachal
Amar rav yehuda amar rav beshaa sheamar david limfivoshet atta vetziva tachleku et hassade yatzta bat kol veamra lo rechavam veyaravam yachleku et hammelucha
Amar rav yehuda amar rav ilmale lo kibel david lashon hara lo nechleka malchut bet david velo avdu yisrael avoda zara velo galinu meartzenu

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol haomer shelomo chata eno ella toe shenneemar velo haya levavo shalem im Adonai elohav kilvav david aviv kilvav david aviv hu dela hava michta name la chata

Ella ma ani mekayyem vayehi leet ziknat shelomo nashav hittu et levavo hahi kerabbi natan derabbi natan rame ketiv vayehi leet ziknat shelomo nashav hittu et levavo vehachtiv kilvav david aviv kilvav david aviv hu dela hava michta name la chata hachi kaamar vayehi leet ziknat shelomo nashav hittu et levavo lalechet achare elohim acherim velo halach
Vehachtiv az yivne shelomo bama lichmosh shikkutz moav shebbikkesh livnot velo bana
Ella meatta az yivne yehoshua mizbeach la shebbikkesh livnot velo bana ella divna hacha name divna
Ella kidtanya rabbi yose omer veet habbamot asher al pene yerushalam asher mimin lehar hammishcha asher bana shelomo melech yisrael leashtoret shikkutz tzidonim vego

Efshar ba asa velo biaram yehoshafat velo biaram ad shebba yoshiyya uviaram vahalo kol avoda zara shebbeeretz yisrael asa vihoshafat biarum ella makkish rishonim laacharonim ma acharonim lo asu vetala bahen leshevach af rishonim lo asu vetala bahen lignay
Vehachtiv vayyaas shelomo hara beene Adonai ella mippene shehaya lo limchot benashav velo micha maale alav hakkatuv keillu chata
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel noach lo leoto tzaddik sheyehe shammash ledavar acher veal yikkatev bo vayyaas hara beene Adonai
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel beshaa shennasa shelomo et bat paro hichnisa lo elef mine zemer veamra lo kach osin laavoda zara pelonit vechach osim laavoda zara pelonit velo micha bah
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel beshaa shennasa shelomo et bat paro yarad gavriel venaatz kane bayyam veala bo sirton vealav nivna kerach gadol shel romi
Bematnita tana oto hayyom shehichnis yaravam shene egle zahav echad bevet el veechad bedan nivna tzerif echad vezehu italya shel yavan

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol haomer yoshiyyahu chata eno ella toe shenneemar vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai vayyelech bechol derech david aviv ella ma ani mekayyem vechamohu lo haya lefanav melech asher shav vego
Shekkal din sheddan mibben shemone ad shemone esre hechziran lahen shemma tomar natal mizze venatan laze talmud lomar bechal meodo shennatan lahem mishshello

Ufliga derav deamar rav en lecha gadol bevaale teshuva yoter miyyoshiyyahu bedoro veechad bedorenu umannu abba avuh derabbi yirmeya bar abba veamri lah acha achuh deabba avuh derav yirmeya bar abba deamar mar rabbi abba veacha ache hao

Amar rav yosef veod echad bedorenu umannu ukvan bar nechemya resh galuta vehayenu natan detzutzita amar rav yosef hava yatevna befirka vahava ka menamnamna vachazay bechelma deka peshat yedeh vekabbeleh

a: Matni bamma ishsha yotza uvamma enah yotza
Lo tetze ishsha lo bechute tzemer velo bechute pishtan velo birtzuot shebberoshah velo titbol bahen ad shetterappem
Velo betotefet velo besarbitin bizman sheenan tefurim velo bechavul lirshut harabbim
Velo beir shel zahav velo bekatla velo binzamim velo betabbaat sheen aleha chotam velo bemachat sheenah nekuva
Veim yatzat enah chayyevet chattat
Gema tevila man dechar shemah

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar rabba bar avuh ma taam kaamar ma taam lo tetze ishsha lo bechute tzemer velo bechute pishtan mippene sheamru chachamim bachol la titbol bahen ad shetterappem vechevan divchol la titbol bahen ad shetterappem beshabbat lo tetze dilma mitreme lah tevila shel mitzva vesharya lehu veate leetoyinhu arba ammot birshut harabbim
Bea mineh rav kahana merav tiche chalilata may amar leh arig kaamratte kol shehu arig lo gazru itmar name amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua kol shehu arig lo gazru
Veika deamri amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chazena leachoti dela kafdan alayehu
May ika ben hach lishana uven hach lishana
Ika benayehu ditnifan lehach lishana deamar kol shehu arig lo gazru hane name arig ninhu ulhach lishana deamratte mishshum kefida kevan ditnifa mikpad kafda alayehu

Tenan hatam veellu chotztzin baadam chute tzemer vechute pishtan vehartzuot shebberashe habbanot rabbi yehuda omer shel tzemer veshel sear en chotztzin mippene shehammayim bain bahen amar rav huna vechullan berashe habbanot shaninu
Matkif lah rav yosef lemaote may ilema lemaote detzavar udmay ilema lemaote detzemer hashta rach al gabbe kashe chotzetz rach al gabbe rach mibaya
Veella lemaote dechute fishtan hashta kashe al gabbe kashe chotzetz kashe al gabbe rach mibaya
Ella amar rav yosef hayenu tama derav huna lefi sheen ishsha choneket et atzmah
Etiveh abbaye habbanot yotzot bechutin shebbeoznehen aval lo bachavakin shebbetzavverehen vei amratte en ishsha choneket atzmah chavakin shebbetzavverehen ammay la
Amar ravina
b: Hacha bekatla askinan deishsha choneket et atzmah denicha lah shetterae kevaalat basar
Rabbi yehuda omer shel tzemer veshel sear en chotztzin mippene shehammayim bain bahen
Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda bechute sear
Amar leh abbaye halacha mikkelal difligi
Vechi tema i lav deshameh letanna kamma deayeri bechute sear ihu name la hava mayere vedilma keshem kaamar lehu ki hechi demoditu li bechute sear odo li name bechute tzemer
Itmar amar rav nachman amar shemuel modim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bechute sear
Tanya name hachi chute tzemer chotztzin chute sear en chotztzin rabbi yehuda omer shel tzemer veshel sear en chotztzin

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak matnitin name dayeka dekatane yotza ishsha bechute sear ben mishshella ben mishshel chavertah manni ilema rabbi yehuda afilu chute tzemer name ella lav rabbanan hi ushma minah bechute sear la peligi shema minah
Lo betotefet may totefet amar rav yosef chumarta diktifta
Amar leh abbaye tihve kekamea mumche vetishtere
Ella amar rav yehuda mishshemeh deabbaye afuzyane tanya name hachi yotza ishsha bisvacha hammuzhevet uvtotefet uvsarbitin hakkevuin bah
Ezo totefet veezo sarbitin amar rabbi avahu totefet hammukkefet lah meozen leozen sarbitin hammaggiin lah ad lechayeha
Amar rav huna aniyyot osin otan shel mine tzivonin ashirot osin otan shel kesef veshel zahav
Velo bechavul amar rabbi yannay kavul ze eni yodea mahu i kavla deavda tenan aval kipa shel tzemer shappir dame o dilma kipa shel tzemer tenan vechal shekken kavla deavda

Amar rabbi avahu mistabbera keman deamar kipa shel tzemer tenan vetanya name hachi yotza ishsha bechavul uvistama lechatzer rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af bechavul lirshut harabbim kelal amar rabbi shimon ben elazar kol shehu lematta min hassevacha yotzin bo kol shehu lemala min hassevacha en yotzin bo
May istama amar rabbi avahu bizone may bizone amar abbaye amar rav kalya paroche
Tanu rabbanan shelosha devarim neemru beistama en bah mishshum kilayim veenah metammea bingaim veen yotzin bah lirshut harabbim
Mishshum rabbi shimon amru af

a: En bah mishshum atrot kallot
Ushmuel amar kavla deavda tenan umi amar shemuel hachi vehaamar shemuel yotze haeved bechotam shebbetzavaro aval lo bechotam shebbichsuto
La kashya ha daavad leh rabbeh ha daavad ihu lenafsheh
Bemay okimta leha dishmuel daavad leh rabbeh bechotam shebbichsuto ammay la

Dilma mipsak umirtat umkappel leh umachet leh akkatpeh kidrav yitzchak bar yosef deamar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan hayyotze betallit mekuppelet umunnachat lo al ketefav beshabbat chayyav chattat
Vechi ha daamar leh shemuel lerav chinana bar shela kullehu rabbanan deve resh galuta la lipku besarbale chatime levar minach dela kafdi alach deve resh galuta
Gufa amar shemuel yotze haeved bechotam shebbetzavaro aval lo bechotam shebbichsuto tanya name hachi yotze haeved bechotam shebbetzavaro aval lo bechotam shebbichsuto
Urminhu lo yetze haeved bechotam shebbetzavaro velo bechotam shebbichsuto ze vaze en mekabbelin tuma velo bezog shebbetzavaro aval yotze hu bezog shebbichsuto ze vaze mekabbelin tuma
Velo tetze behema lo bechotam shebbetzavarah velo bechotam shebbichsutah velo bezog shebbichsutah velo bezog shebbetzavarah ze vaze en mekabbelin tuma
Lema ha daavad leh rabbeh ha daavad ihu lenafsheh
La idi veidi daavad leh rabbeh vechan beshel mattechet vechan beshel tit vechidrav nachman amar rabba bar avuh davar hammakpid alav rabbo en yotzin bo davar sheen makpid alav yotzin bo
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane ze vaze en mekabbelin tuma i amratte bishlama shel mattechet hane hu dela mekabbeli tuma ha kelim didhu mekabbeli tuma
Ella i amratte beshel tit tenan hane hu dela mekabbeli tuma ha kelim didhu mekabbeli tuma
Veha tanya kele avanim kele gelalim uchle adama en mekabbelin tuma lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim ella shema minah shel mattechet shema minah
Amar mar velo bezog shebbetzavaro aval yotze hu bezog shebbichsuto
Zog shebbetzavaro ammay la dilma mipsik veate leetoye zog shebbichsuto name lichush dilma mipsik veate leetoye
Hacha vemay askinan dimcha beh mumcha vechidrav huna bereh derav yehoshua deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua kol shehu arug lo gazru
Amar mar lo tetze behema lo bechotam shebbetzavarah velo bechotam shebbichsutah velo bezog shebbetzavarah velo bezog shebbichsutah ze vaze en mekabbelin tuma
Vezog divhema en mekabbelin tuma urminhu zog shel behema temea
b: Veshel delet tahor

Shel delet vaasao livhema tame shel behema vaasao ledelet af al pi shechibbero laddelet ukvao bemasmerim tame shekkol hakkelim yordin lide tumatan bemachshava veen olin mide tumatan ella beshinnuy maase
La kashya ha deit leh inbal ha delet leh inbal
Ma nafshach i mana hu af al pi delet leh inbal i lav mana hu inbal meshave leh mana

In kidrabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan minnayin lemashmia kol bichle mattachot shehu tame shenneemar kol davar asher yavo vaesh taaviru vaesh afilu dibbur yavo baesh
Bemay okimta bidlet leh inbal ema metziata velo bezog shebbetzavaro aval yotze hu bezog shebbichsuto veze vaze mekabbelin tuma i delet leh inbal mi mekabbeli tuma
Urminhu haose zogin lemachteshet velaarisa ulmitpechot sefarim ulmitpechot tinokot yesh lahem inbal temein en lahem inbal tehorin nitlu inbelehen adayin tumatan alehem
Hane mile betinok dilkala avdi leh aval gadol tachshit hu leh af al gav delet leh inbal
Amar mar nitlu inbelehen adayin tumatan alehen lemay chazu amar abbaye hoil shehahedot yachol lehachaziro
Metiv rava hazzug vehainbal chibbur
Vechi tema hachi kaamar af al gav dela mechabbar keman dimchabbar dame vehatanya masporet shel perakim veizmel shel rahitne chibbur lattuma veen chibbur lahazzaa
Veamrinan ma nafshach i chibbur hu afillu lehazzaa vei la chibbur hu afilu letuma name la

Veamar rabba devar tora bishat melacha chibbur ben letuma ben lehazzaa shello bishat melacha eno chibbur lo letuma velo lehazzaa vegazru al tuma shello bishat melacha mishshum tuma shehi bishat melacha veal hazzaa shehi bishat melacha mishshum hazzaa shello bishat melacha
Ella amar rava

a: Hoil verauy lehakkisho al gabbe cheres
Itmar name amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina hoil verauy lehakkisho al gabbe cheres rabbi yochanan amar hoil verauy legammea bo mayim letinok

Verabbi yochanan la bae meen melacha rishona vehatanya vechol keli asher yeshev alav vego yachol kafa sea veyashav aleha kafa tarkav veyashav aleha yehe tame talmud lomar asher yeshev alav hazzav mi shemuchad lishiva yatza ze sheomrim lo amod venaase melachtenu
Rabbi elazar omer bemidrasot omrim amod venaase melachtenu veen omrim bitme met amod venaase melachtenu verabbi yochanan amar af omer bitme met amod venaase melachtenu
Efoch kammayeta umay chazet deafchatte kammayeta efoch batrayeta

Ha shaminan leh lerabbi yochanan devae meen melacha rishona detanya sandal shel behema shel mattechet tame lemay chaze amar rav rauy lishtot bo mayim bammilchama verabbi chanina amar rauy lasuch bo shemen bammilchama verabbi yochanan amar beshaa shebboreach min hakkerav mannicho beraglav veratz al kotzin veal habbarkanim
May ben rav lerabbi chanina ika benayehu dimis
Ben rabbi yochanan lerabbi chanina ika benayehu deyakkir
Velo beir shel zahav may beir shel zahav rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan yerushalayim dedahava
b: Kedaavad leh rabbi akiva lidvethu

Tanu rabbanan lo tetze ishsha beir shel zahav veim yatzta chayyevet chattat divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim lo tetze veim yatzta petura rabbi eliezer omer yotza ishsha beir shel zahav lechattechilla

Bemay kamipalgi rabbi meir savar massoy hu verabbanan savri tachshit hu dilma shalfa umachveya leh veatya leetoye verabbi eliezer savar man dirkeh lemipak beir shel zahav ishsha chashuva veishsha chashuva la shalfa umachveya
Kelila rav asar ushmuel share
Daaniska kulle alma la peligi daasir ki peligi daarukta mar savar aniska ikkar umar savar arukta ikkar

Rav ashe matne lekulla daarukta dechulle alma la peligi dishre ki peligi daaniska mar savar dilma shalfa umachveya veate leetuye umar savar man dirkeh lemipak bichlila ishsha chashuva veishsha chashuva la shalfa umachveya
Amar leh rav shemuel bar bar chana lerav yosef beferush amarte lan mishshemeh derav kelila shere

Amaru leh lerav ata gavra rabba aricha linhardea umittela vedaresh kelila shere amar man gavra rabba aricha deitla levi shema minah nach nafsheh derabbi appas vitiv rabbi chanina beresha vela hava leh inish lelevi lemetav gabbeh vekaate lehacha

Vedilma nach nafsheh derabbi chanina verabbi appas kidkae kae vela hava leh inish lelevi lemetav gabbeh vekaate lehacha im ita derabbi chanina shechev levi lerabbi appas mikaf hava keyif leh vetu derabbi chanina la saggi dela malech dechi hava ka nicha nafsheh derabbi amar chanina berabbi chama yeshev barosh uchtiv behu betzaddikim vetigzar omer veyakom lach vego
Derash levi binhardea kelila shere nefuk esrin vearba kelile mikkullah nehardea derash rabba bar avuh bemachoza kelila shere unfaku tamne sere kelile mechada mevoa
Amar rav yehuda amar rav shemuel kamra shere ika deamri daarukta veamar rav safra mide dehave attallit muzhevet
Veika deamri daaniska veamar rav safra mide dehave aavnet shel melachim
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe kamra ilave hemyana may amar leh tere hemyane kaamratte
Amar rav ashe hay resoka i it leh mafrechayata shere vei la asir
Velo bekatla may katla menakketa pare nezamim nizme haaf
Velo betabbaat sheen aleha chotam ha yesh aleha chotam chayyevet alma lav tachshit hu
Urminhu tachshite nashim temeim veellu hen tachshite nashim katlaot nezamim vetabbaot vetabbaat ben sheyyesh aleha chotam ben sheen aleha chotam venizme haaf
Veamar rabbi zera la kashya ha rabbi nechemya ha rabbanan

Detanya hi shel mattechet vechotamah shel almog temea hi shel almog vechotamah shel mattechet tehora verabbi nechemya metamme shehaya rabbi nechemya omer betabbaat hallech achar chotamah beol hallech achar simlonav

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar tuma ashshabbat karamet tuma keli maase amar rachamana uchli hu shabbat mishshum massoy amar rachamana en aleha chotam tachshit yesh aleha chotam massoy
Velo bemachat sheenah nekuva lemay chazya amar rav yosef hoil veishsha ogeret bah searah
