Amar shemuel shilfe hashshemad hau vehau nechbain bimara veamru hannichnas yikkanes vehayyotze al yetze
Nehpach sandalo shel echad mehen kisvurin hem echad mehen yatza verauhu oyevim veachshav bain alehen dachaku ze baze vehargu ze et ze yoter mimma shehargu bahem oyevim
Rabbi ilay ben elazar omer bimara hau yoshvin veshamu kol meal gabbe hammeara kisvurin hau shebbau alehem oyevim dachaku ze baze vehargu ze et ze yoter mimma shehargu bahen oyevim
Rame bar yechezkel amar bevet hakkeneset hau yoshvin veshamu kol meachore bet hakkeneset kisvurin hau shebbau alehem oyevim dachaku ze baze vehargu ze et ze yoter mimma shehargu bahen oyevim
Beotah shaa amru al yetze adam besandal hamsummar i hachi bechol name litsar maase ki hava beshabbat hava beom tov lishtere allema tenan
b: Meshallechin kelim beom tov ben tefurin ben sheenan tefurin aval lo sandal hamsummar velo minal sheeno tafur beom tov
Beshabbat may tama deika kinufya beom tov name ika kinufya taanit tzibbur ika kinufya litsar maase ki hava bechinufya deisura hacha kinufya dehettera hava

Vaafilu lerabbi chanina ben akiva deamar lo asru ella beyarden uvisfina uchmaase shehaya hane mile yarden deshane mishshear neharot aval yom tov veshabbat ki hadade ninhu ditnan en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella lechazzek aval lenoy muttar vechamma lenoy rabbi yochanan amar chamesh baze vechamesh baze verabbi chanina amar sheva baze vesheva baze
Amar leh rabbi yochanan lerav shemen bar abba asberah lach ledidi shettayim mikkan ushtayim mikkan veachat bitresiyyotav lerabbi chanina shalosh mikkan veshalosh mikkan veachat bitresiyyotav
Metivi sandal hannote ose lo sheva divre rabbi natan verabbi mattir bishlosh esre
Bishlama lerabbi chanina hu deamar kerabbi natan ella rabbi yochanan deamar keman hu deamar kerabbi nehoray detanya rabbi nehoray omer chamesh muttar vesheva asur
Amar leh efa lerabba bar bar channa attun talmide rabbi yochanan avidu kerabbi yochanan anan naaved kerabbi chanina
Bea mineh rav huna merav ashe chamesh mahu amar leh afilu sheva muttar tesha may amar leh afilu shemone asur
Bea mineh hahu ratzana merabbi amme tefaro mibbifnim mahu amar leh muttar vela yadana may tama
Amar rav ashe vela yada mar may tama kevan ditfaro mibbifnim have leh minal besandal gezaru beh rabbanan beminal la gezaru beh rabbanan
Bea mineh rabbi abba bar zavda merabbi abba bar avina asao kemin kalbos mahu amar leh muttar itmar name amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina asao kemin kalbos muttar
Amar rav sheshet chipahu kullo bemasmerot kede shello tehe karka ochalto muttar

Tanya keoteh derav sheshet lo yetze haish besandal hamsummar velo yetayyel mibbayit levayit afillu mimmitta lemitta aval metaltelin oto lechassot bo et hakkeli velismoch bo kare hammitta verabbi elazar berabbi shimon oser nashru rov masmerotav venishtayeru bo arba o chamesh muttar verabbi mattir ad sheva chipahu beor millematta vekava lo masmerot millemala muttar asao kemin kalbos o kemin tas o kemin yated o shechipahu kullo bemasmerot kede shello tehe karka ochalto muttar
Ha gufah kashya amratte nashru rov masmerotav af al gav denishtayeru beh tuva vahadar tane arba o chamesh in tefe la
Amar rav sheshet la kashya kan shennigmemu kan shenneekru
Arba o chamesh muttar hashta chamesh shere arba mibaya amar rav chisda arba missandal katan vechamesh missandal gadol
Verabbi mattir ad sheva vehatanya rabbi mattir ad shelosh esre note shane
Hashta daatet lehachi lerabbi yochanan name la kashya note shane

Amar rav matna veamri lah amar rav achadvuy bar matna amar rav matna en halacha kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon peshita yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim mahu detema mistabbera tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon beha ka mashma lan

Amar rabbi chiyya i lav dekaru li bavlay share isure sharena beh tuva vechamma befumbedita amrin esrin vearba besura amrin esrin vetarten amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vesimanach ad daata mippumbedita lesura chasar tarte
Velo beyachid bizman sheen beraglo makka

a: Ha yesh beraglo makka nafek behe minayehu nafek amar rav huna beotah sheyyesh bah makka alma kasavar sandal leshum tzaar avid
Vechiyya bar rav amar beotah sheen bah makka alma kasavar leshum taanug avid vezo sheyyesh bah makka makkatah mochachat aleha
Veaf rabbi yochanan savar lah leha derav huna deamar leh rabbi yochanan lerav shemen bar abba hav li mesanay yehav leh deyamin amar leh asito makka
Vedilma kechiyya bar rav sevira leh vehachi kaamar asita shel semol makka
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh daamar rabbi yochanan kitfilin kach minalin ma tefilin bismol af minalin bismol
Metivi keshehu noel noel shel yamin veachar kach noel shel semol
Amar rav yosef hashta detanya hachi veamar rabbi yochanan hachi daavad hachi avad vedaavad hachi avad
Amar leh abbaye dilma rabbi yochanan ha matnitin la hava shemia leh vei hava shemia leh hava hadar beh vei name shemia leh vekasavar en halacha keotah mishna

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak yere shamayim yotze yede shettehen umannu mar bereh deravna hechi aved sayem deyammineh vela katar vesayem dismaleh vekatar vahadar katar deyammineh amar rav ashe chazena lerav kahana dela kafed
Tanu rabbanan keshehu noel noel shel yamin veachar kach noel shel semol keshehu choletz choletz shel semol veachar kach choletz shel yamin
Keshehu rochetz rochetz shel yamin veachar kach rochetz shel semol keshehu sach sach shel yamin veachar kach shel semol veharotze lasuch kol gufo sach rosho techila mippene shehu melech al kol evarav
Velo bitfilin amar rav safra la tema alliba deman deamar shabbat lav zeman tefilin hu ella afilu leman deamar shabbat zeman tefilin hu lo yetze dilma ate leetuye birshut harabbim

Veika dematne lah assefa veim yatza eno chayyav chattat amar rav safra la tema alliba deman deamar shabbat zeman tefilin hu ella afilu leman deamar shabbat lav zeman tefilin hu eno chayyav chattat may tama derech malbush avida
Velo bekamea bizman sheeno min hammumche amar rav pappa la tema ad demumche gavra umumche kamea ella kevan demumche gavra af al gav dela mumche kamea
Dayeka name dekatane velo bekamea bizman sheeno min hammumche vela katane bizman sheeno mumche shema minah
Tanu rabbanan ezehu kamea mumche kol sheripe veshana veshillesh echad kamea shel ketav veechad kamea shel ikarin echad chole sheyyesh bo sakkana veechad chole sheen bo sakkana
Lo shennichpa ella shello yikkafe
Vekosher umattir afilu birshut harabbim uvilvad shello yiksherennu
b: Besher uvtabbaat veyetze bo birshut harabbim mishshum marit haayin
Vehatanya ezehu kamea mumche kol sheripe shelosha bene adam keechad
La kashya ha limmechoye gavra ha limmechoye kemia

Amar rav pappa peshita li telata kemee litlata gavre telata telata zimne itmachi gavra veitmachi kamea telata kemee litlata gavre chad chad zimna gavra itmachi kemia la itmachi chad kamea litlata gavre kemia itmachi gavra la itmachi
Bae rav pappa telata kemee lechad gavra may kemia vadday la itmachi gavra itmachi o la itmachi mi amrinan ha assi leh o dilma mazzala dehay gavra hu deka mekabbel ketava teku

Ibaya lehu kemein yesh bahen mishshum kedushsha o dilma en bahen mishshum kedushsha lemay hilcheta ilema leatztzolinhu mippene haddeleka ta shema habberachot vehakkemein af al pi sheyyesh bahen otiyyot umeinyanot harbe shebbattora en matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka venisrafim bimkoman
Ella leinyan geniza ta shema haya katuv al yedot hakkelim veal kare hammitta yagod veyignezennu
Ella likanes bahen bevet hakkisse may yesh bahen kedushsha vaasir o dilma en bahen kedushsha ushre ta shema velo bekamea bizman sheeno min hammumche ha min hammumche nafek
Vei amratte kemein yesh bahen mishshum kedushsha zimnin demitzterich levet hakkisse veate leetoyinhu arba ammot birshut harabbim hacha vemay askinan bekamea shel ikarin
Vehatanya echad kamea shel ketav veechad kamea shel ikarin ella hacha vemay askinan bechole sheyyesh bo sakkana vehatanya echad chole sheyyesh bo sakkana veechad chole sheen bo sakkana
Ella kevan demasse af al gav denaket leh bideh name shappir dame

a: Vehatanya rabbi oshaya omer uvilvad shello yochazennu beyado veyaavirennu arba ammot birshut harabbim
Ella hacha bemay askinan bimchuppe or
Vahare tefilin dimchuppot or vetanya hannichnas levet hakkisse choletz tefilin berichuk arba ammot venichnas
Hatam mishshum shin deamar abbaye shin shel tefilin halacha lemoshe missinay veamar abbaye dalet shel tefilin halacha lemoshe missinay veamar abbaye yod shel tefilin halacha lemoshe missinay
Velo beshiron velo bekasda velo bemaggafayim
Shiron zarda kasda amar rav sanvarta maggafayim amar rav puzmake
Matni lo tetze ishsha bammachat hannekuva velo betabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam velo becholear velo bechovelet velo bitzlochit shel pilyaton
Veim yatzta chayyevet chattat divre rabbi meir vachachamim potrin bechovelet uvitzlochit shel pilyaton
Gema amar ulla vechilufehen beish alma kasavar ulla kal mide dachaze leish la chaze leishsha umidi dachaze leishsha la chaze leish
Metiv rav yosef haroim yotzin besakkin velo haroim bilvad amru ella kal adam ella sheddarkan shel haroim latzet besakkin
Ella amar rav yosef kasavar ulla nashim am bifne atzman hen

Etiveh abbaye hammotze tefilin machnisan zug zug echad haish veechad haishsha vei amratte nashim am bifne atzman hen veha mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot
Hatam kasavar rabbi meir layela zeman tefilin hu veshabbat zeman tefilin hu have leh mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama vechol mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama nashim chayyavot
Veha hotzaa kilachar yad hi
Amar rabbi yirmeya baishsha gizbarit askinan amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan teratzta ishsha ish may ika lememar

Ella amar rava peamim sheadam noten leishto tabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam leholichah lakkufsa umannichatah beyadah ad shemmaggaat lakkufsa ufamim shehaishsha notenet levaalah tabbaat sheen aleha chotam leholichah etzel umman letakken umannichah beyado ad shemmaggia etzel umman
Velo becholear velo bechovelet may kolear amar rav machbanta kovelet amar rav chumarta defilon vechen amar rav assi chumarta defilon
Tanu rabbanan lo tetze bechovelet veim yatzta chayyevet chattat divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim lo tetze veim yatzta petura rabbi eliezer omer yotza ishsha bechovelet lechattechilla

Bemay kamipalgi rabbi meir savar massooy hu verabbanan savri tachshit hu vedilma shalfa umachveya veatya leetoyeh verabbi eliezer savar man dirkah lemirmeh ishsha sherechah ra ishsha sherechah ra la shalfa umachveya vela atya leetoyeh arba ammot birshut harabbim
Vehatanya rabbi eliezer poter bechovelet uvitzlochit shel pelayeton
La kashya ha ki kae adderabbi meir ha ki kae adderabbanan ki kae adderabbi meir deamar chayyav chattat amar ihu patur ki kae adderabbanan deamri patur aval asur amar ihu muttar lechattechilla
b: Umay rabbi meir detanya lo tetze ishsha bemafteach shebbeyadah veim yatzat chayyevet chattat divre rabbi meir rabbi eliezer poter bechovelet uvitzlochit shel pilyaton
Kovelet man dechar shemah

Chassore michassera vehachi katane vechen bechovelet vechen bitzlochit shel pilyaton lo tetze veim yatza chayyevet chattat divre rabbi meir rabbi eliezer poter bechovelet uvitzlochit shel pilyaton bamme devarim amurim kesheyyesh bahem bosem aval en bahem bosem chayyevet
Amar rav adda bar ahava zot omeret hammotzi ochalin pachot mikkeshiur bichli chayyav deha en bah bosem kefachot mikkeshiur bichli dame vekatane chayyevet
Rav ashe amar bealma ema lach patur veshane hacha deleteh lemammasha kelal
Vereshit shemanim yimshachu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel ze pilyaton
Metiv rav yosef af al pilyaton gezar rabbi yehuda ben bava velo hodu lo vei amratte mishshum taanug ammay lo hodu lo

Amar leh abbaye ultamach ha dichtiv hashshotim bemizreke yayin rabbi amme verabbi assi chad amar kenishkenin vechad amar shemmezarkin kosotehen ze laze hachi name daasir veha rabba bar rav huna ikla leve resh galuta veishti biknishkenin vela amar leh vela mide
Ella kol mide deit beh taanug veit beh simcha gezaru rabbanan aval mide deit beh taanug velet beh simcha la gezaru rabbanan
Hashshochvim al mittot shen usruchim al arsotam amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina melammed shehau mashtinin mayim bifne mittotehen arummim
Megaddef bah rabbi avahu i hachi hayenu dichtiv lachen atta yiglu berosh golim mishshum demashtinin mayim bifne mittotehem arummim yiglu berosh golim
Ella amar rabbi avahu ellu bene adam shehau ochlim veshotim ze im ze vedovkin mittotehen zo bazo umachalifin neshotehen ze im ze umasrichin arsotam beshichvat zera sheeno shellahen
Amar rabbi avahu veamri lah bematnita tana shelosha devarim meviin et haadam lide aniyyut veellu hen hammashtin mayim bifne mittato arom umzalzel bintilat yadayim vesheishto mekallalto befanav
Hammashtin mayim bifne mittato arom amar rava la amaran ella demahdar appeh lefuryeh aval levaray let lan bah
Umahdar appeh lefuryeh name la amaran ella leara aval bemana let lan bah
Umzalzel bintilat yadayim amar rava la amaran ella dela mesha yedeh kelal aval mesha vela mesha let lan bah
Velav milleta hi deamar rav chisda ana meshay mele chafnay mayya vihavu li mele chafnay tevuta
Vesheishto mekallalto befanav amar rava al iske tachshiteha vehane mile hu deit leh vela aved

Daresh rava bereh derav ilae may dichtiv vayyomer Adonai yaan ki gavhu benot tziyyon shehau mehallechot bekoma zekufa vattelachna netuot garon shehau mehallechot akev betzad gudal umsakkerot enayim dahava malyan kuchla leenayehu umrammezan haloch vetafof shehau mehallechot arukka betzad ketzara uvraglehen teakkasna amar rav yitzchak deve rabbi amme melammed shemmattilot mor vaafarsemon beminalehen umhallechot beshuke yerushalayim vechevan shemmaggiot etzel bachure yisrael boatot bakkarka umattizot alehem umachnisot bahen yetzer hara keeres bechaus

May puranutayehi kiddaresh rabba bar ulla vehaya tachat bosem mak yihye makom shehau mitbassemot bo naasa nemakim nemakim vetachat chagora nikpa makom shehau chagurot betziltzol naasa nekafim nekafim vetachat maase mikshe korcha makom shehau mitkashshetot bo naasa kerachim kerachim vetachat petigil machagoret sak petachim hammeviin lide gila yihu lemachagoret sak ki tachat yofi amar rava hayenu deamri inashe challofe shufra keva
Vesippach Adonai kodkod benot tziyyon amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina melammed shepparcha bahen tzaraat ketiv hacha vesippach uchtiv hatam laset velassappachat
Va pothen yeare rav ushmuel chad amar shennishpechu kekiton vechad amar shennaasu pitchehen keyaar
Amar rav yehuda amar rav anshe yerushalayim anshe shachatz hau adam omer lachavero bamme saadta hayyom befat amila o befat sheenah amila beyayin gordali o

a: Beyayin chardali bemesav rachav o bemesav katzar bechaver tov o bechaver ra amar rav chisda vechullan liznut

Amar rachava amar rabbi yehuda atze yerushalayim shel kinamon hau uvshaa shehau massikin mehen rechan nodef bechal eretz yisrael umishshecharva yerushalayim nignezu velo nishtayyer ella kisora umishtechach be gazza detzimtzemay malketa
Matni lo yetze haish lo besayif velo bekeshet velo bitris velo bealla velo beromach veim yatza chayyav chattat
Rabbi eliezer omer tachshitin hen lo
Vachachamim omrim enan ella lignay shenneemar vechittetu charvotam leittim vachanitotehem lemazmerot velo yissa goy el goy cherev velo yilmedu od milchama
Birit tehora veotzin bah beshabbat
Kevalim temeim veen yotzin bahen beshabbat
Gema may bealla kulfa

Rabbi eliezer omer tachshitin hen lo tanya amru lo lerabbi eliezer vechi meachar detachshitin hen lo mippene ma hen betelin limot hammashiach amar lahen lefi sheenan tzerichin shenneemar lo yissa goy el goy cherev veteheve lenoy bealma amar abbaye mide dehave ashsheraga betihara
Ufliga dishmuel deamar shemuel en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud galuot bilvad shenneemar ki lo yechdal evon mikkerev haaretz
Mesayya leh lerabbi chiyya bar abba deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba kol hanneviim lo nitnabbeu ella limot hammashiach aval leolam habba ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha

Veika deamri amru lo lerabbi eliezer vechi meachar detachshitin hen lo mippene ma hen betelin limot hammashiach amar lahen af limot hammashiach enan betelin hayenu dishmuel ufliga derabbi chiyya bar abba

Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi veamri lah lerav aveya veamri lah rav yosef lerav dimi veamri lah lerav aveya veamri lah abbaye lerav yosef may tama derabbi eliezer deamar tachshitin hen lo dichtiv chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor hodcha vahadarecha
Amar leh rav kahana lemar bereh derav huna hay bedivre tora ketiv amar leh en mikra yotze mide peshuto
Amar rav kahana kad havena bar tamne sere shenin vahava gemirna leh lechulleh talmuda vela hava yadana deen mikra yotze mide peshuto ad hashta may ka mashma lan deligmar inish vahadar lisbar
Siman zarot

Amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi elazar shene talmide chachamim hamchaddedin ze leze bahalacha hakkadosh baruch hu matzliach lahem shenneemar vahadarcha tzelach al tikre vahadarcha ella vachadadcha velo od ella sheolin ligdulla shenneemar tzelach rechav yachol afilu shello lishmah talmud lomar al devar emet yachol im heges dato talmud lomar veanva tzedek veim osin ken zochin lattora shennitna beyamin shenneemar vetorcha noraot yeminecha

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar zochin lidvarim shenneemru biminah shel tora deamar rava bar rav shela veamri lah amar rav yosef bar chama amar rav sheshet may dichtiv orech yamim biminah bismolah osher vechavod ella biminah orech yamim ika osher vechavod leka ella lammayeminin bah orech yamim ika vechal shekken osher vechavod lammasmeilim bah osher vechavod ika orech yamim leka

Amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi shimon ben lakish shene talmide chachamim hannochin ze laze bahalacha hakkadosh baruch hu makshiv lahen shenneemar az nidberu yire Adonai vego en dibbur ella nachat shenneemar yadber ammim tachtenu
May ulchoshve shemo amar rabbi amme afilu chishev laasot mitzva veneenas velo asaah maale alav hakkatuv keilu asaah
Amar rav chinana bar idi kal haose mitzva kemaamarah en mevasserin oto besorot raot shenneemar shomer mitzva lo yeda davar ra
Amar rav assi veitema rabbi chanina afilu hakkadosh baruch hu gozer gezera hu mevattelah shenneemar baasher devar melech shilton umi yomar lo ma taase usmich leh shomer mitzva lo yeda davar ra

Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi shimon ben lakish shene talmide chachamim hammakshivim ze laze bahalacha hakkadosh baruch hu shomea lekolan shenneemar hayyoshevet baggannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashmiini
Veim en osin ken gormin lashshechina shemmistalleket miyyisrael shenneemar berach dodi udme vego

Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi shimon ben lakish shene talmide chachamim hammadgilim ze laze bahalacha hakkadosh baruch hu ohavan shenneemar vediglo alay ahava amar rava vehu deyadi tzurta dishmata vehu delet lehu rabba bemata lemigmar mineh
Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi shimon ben lakish gadol hammalve yoter min haose tzedaka umetil bakkis yoter mikkullan
Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi shimon ben lakish im talmid chacham nokem venoter kenachash hu chogrehu al motnecha im am haaretz hu chasid al tadur bishchunato

Amar rav kahana amar rabbi shimon ben lakish veamri lah amar rav assi amar resh lakish veamri lah amar rabbi abba amar rabbi shimon ben lakish kol hamgaddel kelev ra betoch beto monea chesed mittoch beto shenneemar lammas
b: Mereehu chased shekken belashon yevanit korin lechelev lammas rav nachman bar yitzchak amar af porek mimmennu yirat shamayim shenneemar veyirat shadday yaazov
Hahi itta daayala lehahu beta lemefa nevach bah kalba itakar valdah amar lah mare deveta la tidchali dishkili niveh ushkilin tufreh amara leh shekila tevutach veshadya achizre kevar nad valad

Amar rav huna may dichtiv semach bachur beyaldutecha vitivcha libbecha bime vechurotecha vehallech bedarche libbecha uvmare enecha veda ki al kol elle yeviacha haelohim bammishpat ad kan divre yetzer hara mikkan veelach divre yetzer tov
Resh lakish amar ad kan ledivre tora mikkan veelach lemaasim tovim
Birit tehora amar rav yehuda birit zo etzada
Metiv rav yosef birit tehora veotze bah beshabbat veilu etzada temea hi
Hachi kaamar birit tachat etzada omedet
Yatev ravin verav huna kammeh derav yirmeya veyatev rav yirmeya veka menamnem veyatev ravin vekaamar birit beachat kevalim bishtayim
Amar leh rav huna ellu veellu bishtayim umtilin shalshelet benehen venaasu kevalim
Veshalshelet shebbo meshavveya leh mana

Vechi tema kerabbi shemuel bar nachmani deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan minnayin lemashmia kol bichle mattachot shehu tame shenneemar kol davar asher yavo vaesh afilu dibur bammashma
Bishlama hatam ka vau lah lekala vekaaved maase hacha may maase kaaved

Hacha name ka aved maase deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishpacha achat hayeta birushalayim shehau pesiotehen gassot vehau betulotehen noshrot asu lahen kevalim vehetilu shalshelet benehen shello yihu pesiotehen gassot velo hau betulotehen noshrot itar behu rabbi yirmeya amar lehu yishar vechen amar rabbi yochanan
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan minnayin learig kol shehu shehu tame mitztzitz
Amar leh abbaye vetzitz arig hu vehatanya tzitz kemin tas shel zahav verochav shette etzbaot umukkaf meozen leozen vechatuv alav bishte shitin yod he lemala vekodesh lamed lematta
Veamar rabbi eliezer berabbi yose ani reitiv beromi vechatuv alav kodesh la beshita achat

Neemar beged vaor besheretz veneemar beged vaor bemet ma beged vaor haamur besheretz lo time ella teviy vearig af beged vaor haamur bemet lo time ella teviy vearig

En li ella davar habba min haizzim minnayin lerabbot davar habba mizzenav hassus umizzenav happara talmud lomar o sak

Veen li ella besheretz betumat met minnayin

Vedin hu time bemet vetime besheretz ma keshettime besheretz asa davar habba mizzenav hassus umizzenav happara kemaase izzim af keshettime bemet asa davar habba mizzenav hassus umizzenav happara kemaase izzim
Hen im riba betumat erev shehi merubba nerabbe betumat shiva shehi muetet

Tibe leman deamar maarimin bidleka hatam hu dei la sharet leh ate lechabboye aval hacha i la sharet leh la ate leappoke

a: Verabbi yose oser
Veim yesh lo bet kibul ketitin tame

Kisse vesamochot shello temein midras veen yotzin bahen beshabbat veen nichnasin bahen baazara
Lukatmin tehorin veen yotzin bahen

Veaf shemuel hadar beh ditnan chaltza besandal sheeno shello besandal shel etz o shel semol beyamin chalitza keshera
Veamrinan man tanna amar shemuel rabbi meir hi ditnan hakkitea yotze bekav shello divre rabbi meir rabbi yose oser

Veamar avin bar huna amar rav chama bar gurya muttar lasuch shemen umelach beshabbat

b: Karu hen tehorin keman azla ha detanya kol hattumot hammesitot tehorot chutz meheseto shel zav shello matzinu lo chaver bechol hattora kullah lema dela kerabbi akiva dei kerabbi akiva ika name avoda zara afilu tema rabbi akiva tena zav vechol dedame leh

Bae rav achadvuy bar amme avoda zara pechuta mikkezayit mahu matkif lah rav yosef lemay ilema leinyan isura lo yehe ella zevuv baal ekron detanya vayyasimu lahem baal berit leelohim ze zevuv baal ekron melammed shekkol echad veechad ose demut yirato umannichah betoch kiso kevan shezzochrah motziah mittoch kiso umchabbekah umnashshekah ella leinyan tuma may kevan deitakkash lesheretz ma sheretz bechaadasha af avoda zara name bechaadasha o dilma ha itakkash lemet ma met bichzayit af avoda zara bichzayit

Matni minnayin lisfina shehi tehora shenneemar derech oniyya velev yam

Gema peshita oniyya belev yam hi ha ka mashma lan keyam ma yam tahor af sefina tehora tanya chananya omer nilmedenna missak ma sak mitaltel male verekan af kol mitaltel male verekan leappoke sefina deenah mitaltelet melea

May benayehu ika benayehu sefina shel cheres man deamar oniyya belev yam ha name belev yam hi leman deamar kesak hanach hu dichtivi gabbe sak dei mitaltel male verekan in i la la aval sefina shel cheres af al gav deenah mitaltelet melea

I name sefinat hayyarden leman deamar oniyya belev yam hi ha name oniyya belev yam hi leman deamar mitaltelet male verekan ha name mitaltelet melea verekanit deamar rabbi chanina ben akavya mippene ma amru sefinat hayyarden temea mippene shettoanim otah bayyabbasha umoridin otah lammayim amar rav yehuda amar rav leolam al yimna adam et atzmo mibbet hammidrash vaafilu shaa achat shehare kamma shanim nishnet mishna zo bevet hammidrash velo nitgalla tamah ad shebba rabbi chanina ben akavya ufershah

Amar rabbi yonatan leolam al yimna adam et atzmo mibbet hammidrash umiddivre tora vaafilu bishat mita shenneemar zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel afilu bishat mita tehe osek battora amar resh lakish en divre tora mitkayemin ella bemi shemmemit atzmo aleha shenneemar zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel amar rava

a: Velachananya tiltul al yede shevarim shemeh tiltul in ditnan shalosh agalot hen asuya kekatedra temea midras kemitta temea teme met shel avanim tehora mikkelum veamar rabbi yochanan veim yesh bah bet kibbul rimmonim temea teme met
Shalosh tevot hen teva sheppitchah mitztziddah temea midras millemala temea teme met vehabbaa bemidda tehora mikkelum

Tanu rabbanan midras keli cheres tahor rabbi yose omer af hassefina may kaamar amar rav zevid hachi kaamar midras keli cheres tahor umaggao tame usfina shel cheres temea kachananya rabbi yose omer af hassefina tehora ketanna didan matkif lah rav pappa may af ella amar rav pappa hachi kaamar midras keli cheres tahor umaggao tame veshel etz ben midraso uven maggao tame usfinat hayyarden tehora ketanna didan rabbi yose omer af hassefina temea kachananya
Umidras keli cheres menalan detahor amar chizkiyya deamar kera veish asher yigga bemishkavo makkish mishkavo lo ma hu it leh tohora bemikve af mishkavo name it leh tohora bemikve

Deve rabbi yishmael tana kemishkav niddatah yihye lah makkish mishkavah lah ma hi it lah tohora bemikve af mishkavah name it lah tohora bemikve leappoke keli cheres delet leh tohora bemikve metiv rabbi ila mappatz bemet minnayin
b: Vedin hu uma pakkin ketannim shettehorin bezav temeim bemet mappatz shettame bezav eno din sheyehe tame bemet veammay ha let leh tohora bemikve amar leh rabbi chanina shane hatam hoil veika bemino

Amar leh rachamana litzlan mehay data adderabba rachamana litzlan middata didach vetama may tere kerae ketivi ketiv veish asher yigga bemishkavo uchtiv vechol hammishkav asher yishkav alav hazzav yitma ha ketzad yesh bemino af al gav delet leh tohora bemikve en bemino makkish mishkavo lo
Rava amar midras keli cheres tahor mehacha vechol keli fatuach asher en tzamid patil alav ha yesh tzemid patil alav tahor hu mi la askinan deyachadinhu leishto nidda vekaamar rachamana tahor

Gema may mashma amar rav yehuda ki chaaretz totzi tzimchah totzi chad tzimchah chad hare tere zerueha tere ha arbea tatzmiach chad ha chamsha

Umnalan deha dekim lehu lerabbanan dechamsha beshita milta hi deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv lo tassig gevul reacha asher gavlu rishonim gevul sheggavlu rishonim lo tassig may gavlu rishonim amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan may dichtiv elle vene seir hachori yoshve haaretz attu kulle alma yoshve rakia ninhu ella shehau bekiin beyishshuvah shel eretz shehau omrim melo kane ze lezayit melo kane ze ligfanim melo kane ze litenim vechori shemmerichim et haaretz vechivi amar rav pappa shehau toamin et haaretz kechiveya rav acha bar yaakov amar chori shennaasu bene chorin minnichsehen

Amar rav assi aruga tochah shishsha chutz miggevuleha tanya name hachi aruga tochah shishsha gevuleha bechamma keditnan rabbi yehuda omer rochav kimlo rochav parsa amar rabbi zera veitema rabbi chanina bar pappa may tama derabbi yehuda dichtiv vehishkita veraglecha kegan hayyarak ma regel tefach af gevul name tefach
Amar rav aruga bechurba shaninu vehaika makom keranot amri be rav mishshemeh derav bimmalle et hakkeranot velizra meabbaray vela limalle miggavay
b: Gezera shemma yemalle et hakkeranot velo yehe ella rosh tor yarak mi la tenan haya rosh tor yarak nichnas letoch sade acher muttar mippene shennire sof sade en rosh tor baaruga
Ushmuel amar aruga ben haarugot shaninu veha ka mitarvi bahadade benote shura lechan veshura lechan

Amar ulla beo bemareva hifkia telem echad al pene kullah mahu amar rav sheshet ba irbuv uvitel et hashshura rav assi amar en eruvo mevattel et hashshura etiveh ravina lerav ashe hannotea shette shurot shel kishuin shette shurot shel diluin shette shurot shel pol hammitzri muttar shura achat shel kishuin veshura achat shel diluin veshura achat shel pol hammitzri asur shane hacha deika sheracha
Amar rav kahana amar rabbi yochanan harotze lemallot kol ginato yarak ose aruga shishsha al shishsha veogel bah chamishsha ummalle karnoteha kol ma sheyyirtze

Veha ika devene uvene amri deve rabbi yannay bemachariv ben habbenayim rav ashe amar im hau zeruin sheti zoran erev erev zoran sheti etiveh ravina lerav ashe avodat yarak beyarak acher shishsha tefachim veroin otam

Tanu rabbanan poletet shichvat zera beom hashshelishi tehora divre rabbi elazar ben azarya rabbi yishmael omer peamim shehen arba onot peamim shehen chamesh onot peamim shehen shesh onot rabbi akiva omer leolam chamesh veim yatzata miktzat ona rishona notnin lah miktzat ona shishshit

Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa veamri lah rav pappa lerava bishlama rabbi elazar ben azarya kerabbanan deamri bechamsha avud perisha verabbi yishmael kerabbi yose deamar bearbea avud perisha ella rabbi akiva keman leolam kerabbi yose kidamar rav adda bar ahava moshe behashkama ala uvhashkama yarad
Behashkama ala dichtiv vayyashkem moshe vabboker vayyaal el har sinay behashkama yarad dichtiv lech red vealita atta veaharon immach makkish yerida laaliyya ma aliyya behashkama af yerida behashkama

Lema leh lememra lehu veha amar rav huna yisrael kedoshim hen veen meshammeshin mittotehen bayyom ha amar rava im haya bayit afel muttar veamar rava veitema rav pappa talmid chacham maafil betallito umuttar
b: Veha tevule yom ninhu abbaye bar ravin verav chanina bar avin deamri tarvayehu nitna tora litvul yom yatev marimar vekaamar lah leha shemata amar leh ravina lemarimar nitna kaamratte o reuya kaamratte amar leh reuya kaamena

Velitbelu bene shimshe velikabbelu tora bene shimshe amar rabbi yitzchak lo merosh basseter dibbarti velitbelu betzafra deshabbeta velikabbelu tora betzafra deshabbeta amar rabbi yitzchak shello yehe hallalu holchin lekabbel tora vehallalu holchin litvila

Amar rabbi chiyya berabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva aval chachamim omrim shesh onot shelemot baenan amar rav chisda machaloket sheppersha min haishsha aval persha min haish temea kol zeman shehi lacha metiv rav sheshet vechol beged vechol or asher yihye alav shichvat zara perat leshichvat zera shehi serucha may lav sheppersha min haish la sheppersha min haishsha

Bae rav pappa shichvat zera shel yisrael bime goya mahu yisrael didigi bemitzot chavil gufayehu goyim dela deigi bemitzot la o dilma kevan deachlin shekatzim urmasim chavil gufayehu veim timtze lomar kevan deachli shekatzim urmasim chavil gufayehu bime behema mahu ishsha hi deit lah perozdor masrecha aval behema delet lah perozdor la o dilma la shena teku

Tanu rabbanan beshishshi bachodesh nitnu aseret haddibberot leyisrael rabbi yose omer beshiva bo amar rava dechulle alma berosh chodesh ato lemidbar sinay ketiv hacha bayyom hazze bau midbar sinay uchtiv hatam hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim ma lehallan rosh chodesh af kan rosh chodesh udchulle alma beshabbat nitna tora leyisrael ketiv hacha zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchtiv hatam vayyomer moshe el haam zachor et hayyom hazze ma lehallan beitztzumo shel yom af kan beitztzumo shel yom ki peligi bikvia deyarcha rabbi yose savar bechad beshabba ikva yarcha uvchad beshabba la amar lehu vela mide mishshum chulsha deorcha bitre beshabba amar lehu veattem tihu li mamlechet kohanim

a: Bitlata amar lehu mitzvat hagbala bearbea avud perisha verabbanan savri bitre beshabba ikva yarcha bitre beshabba la amar lehu vela mide mishshum chulsha deorcha bitlata amar lehu veattem tihu li bearbea amar lehu mitzvat hagbala bechamsha avud perisha metivi vekiddashtam hayyom umachar kashya lerabbi yose
Amar lecha rabbi yose yom echad hosif moshe middato detanya shelosha devarim asa moshe middato vehiskim hakkadosh baruch hu immo hosif yom echad middato uferash min haishsha veshavar et halluchot

Hosif yom echad middato may derash hayyom umachar hayyom kemachar ma lemachar lelo immo af hayyom lelo immo velayela dehaidana nefak leh shema minah tere yome levar mehaidana umnalan dehiskim hakkadosh baruch hu al yado dela sheray shechina ad tzafra deshabbeta

Uferash min haishsha may derash nasa kal vachomer beatzmo amar uma yisrael shello dibbera shechina immahen ella shaa achat vekava lahen zeman amra tora vehau nechonim vego al tiggeshu ani shekkol shaa veshaa shechina medabberet immi veeno kovea li zeman al achat kamma vechamma umnalan dehiskim hakkadosh baruch hu al yado dichtiv lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem uchtiv batreh veatta po amod immadi veit deamri pe el pe adabber bo

Shavar et halluchot may derash amar uma pesach shehu echad mittaryag mitzot amra tora vechol ben nechar lo yochal bo hattora kullah kan veyisrael meshummadim al achat kamma vechamma umnalan dehiskim hakkadosh baruch hu al yado shenneemar asher shibbarta veamar resh lakish yishar kochacha sheshshibbarta

Ta shema vehau nechonim layyom hashshelishi kashya lerabbi yose ha amrinan yom echad hosif moshe middato ta shema shelishi shelishi bachodesh ushlishi bashshabbat kashya lerabbanan amri lach rabbanan ha manni rabbi yose hi
Shelishi lemay lechidtanya vayyashev moshe et divre haam el Adonai uchtiv vayyagged moshe et divre haam el Adonai

Ma amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe uma amar lahem moshe leyisrael uma amru yisrael lemoshe uma heshiv moshe lifne haggevura zo mitzvat hagbala divre rabbi yose bar yehuda rabbi omer battechila peresh onshah dichtiv vayyashev moshe devarim shemmeshabbevin dato shel adam ulvassof peresh mattan secharah dichtiv vayyagged moshe devarim shemmoshchin libbo shel adam keaggada veika deamri battechila peresh mattan secharah dichtiv vayyashev moshe devarim shemmeshivin dato shel adam ulvassof peresh onshah dichtiv vayyagged moshe devarim shekkashin laadam kegidin
Ta shema shishshi shishshi bachodesh shishshi bashshabbat kashya lerabbanan ha name rabbi yose hi shishshi lemay rava amar
b: Lachaniyyatan rav acha bar yaakov amar lemassaan vekamipalgi beshabbat demara dichtiv kaasher tzivvecha Adonai elohecha veamar rav yehuda amar rav kaasher tzivvecha bemara mar savar ashshabbat ipkud attechumin la ipkud umar savar attechumin name ipkud

Ta shema nisan shebbo yatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim bearbaa asar shachatu pischehem uvachamishsha asar yatzu velaerev laku bechorot laerev salka datach ella mibbaerev laku bechorot veoto hayyom chamishi bashshabbat haya middachamesar benisan chamsha beshabba resh yarcha deiyyar shabbeta veresh yarcha desivan chad beshabbat kashya lerabbanan

Amri lach rabbanan iyyar dehahi shatta abbore abberuh ta shema dela abberuh nisan shebbo yatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim bearbaa asar shachatu pischehem bachamishsha asar yatzu velaerev laku bechorot laerev salka datach ella ema mibbaerev laku bechorot veoto hayyom chamishi bashshabbat haya hishlim nisan veera iyyar lihot bashshabbat
Chasar iyyar veera sivan lihot beechad bashshabbat kashya lerabbanan ha manni rabbi yose hi

Amar rav pappa ta shema vayyisu meelim vayyavou kol adat bene yisrael vego bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashsheni veoto hayyom shabbat haya dichtiv uvoker uritem et kevod Adonai uchtiv sheshet yamim tilketuhu umiddachamesar beiyyar shabbeta resh yarcha desivan chad beshabba kashya lerabbanan amri lach rabbanan iyyar dehahi shatta abbore abberuh

Amar leh rav chavivi machoznaa lerav ashe ta shema vayehi bachodesh harishon bashshana hashshenit beechad lachodesh hukam hammishkan tana oto yom natal eser atarot rishon lemaase vereshit rishon lannesiim rishon lakkehunna rishon laavoda rishon liridat haesh rishon laachilat kadashim rishon lishkon shechina rishon levarech et yisrael rishon leisur habbamot rishon lechodashim umidderesh yarcha denisan deha shatta chad beshabba deeshtakad bearbea

Detanya acherim omrim en ben atzeret laatzeret veen ben rosh hashshana lerosh hashshana ella arbaa yamim bilvad veim hayeta shana meubberet chamishsha hava leh resh yarcha deiyyar maale shabbeta veresh yarcha desivan shabbeta kashya ben lerabbi yose ben lerabbanan lerabbi yose shiva chaserin avud

a: Lerabbanan shemona chaserim avud

Ta shema detanya beseder olam nisan shebbo yatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim bearbaa asar shachatu pischehen bachamishsha asar yatzu veoto hayyom erev shabbat haya umidderesh yarcha denisan erev shabbat resh yarcha deiyyar chad beshabba vesivan bitre beshabba kashya lerabbi yose amar lach rabbi yose ha manni rabbanan hi

Ta shema rabbi yose omer bashsheni ala moshe veyarad bashshelishi ala veyarad birvii yarad veshuv lo ala umeachar shello ala mehechan yarad ella barvii ala veyarad bachamishi bana mizbeach vehikriv alav korban bashshishshi lo haya lo penay may lav mishshum tora
La mishshum torach shabbat derash hahu galilaa aleh derav chisda berich rachamana dihav oryan telitay leam telitay al yede telitay beom telitay beyarcha telitay keman kerabbanan

Vayyityatztzevu betachtit hahar amar rav avdimi bar chama bar chassa melammed shekkafa hakkadosh baruch hu alehem et hahar kegigit veamar lahem im attem mekabbelim hattora mutav veim lav sham tehe kevuratchem amar rav acha bar yaakov mikkan modaa rabba leorayeta amar rava af al pi chen hadur kabbeluha bime achashverosh dichtiv kiyemu vekibbelu hayehudim kiyemu ma shekkiblu kevar

Amar chizkiyya may dichtiv mishshamayim hishmata din eretz yara veshakata im yara lamma shakta veim shakta lamma yara ella battechila yara ulvassof shakta velamma yara kidresh lakish deamar resh lakish may dichtiv vayehi erev vayehi voker yom hashshishshi Adonai yetera lamma li melammed shehitna hakkadosh baruch hu im maase vereshit veamar lahem im yisrael mekabbelim hattora attem mitkayemin veim lav ani machazir etchem letohu vavohu

Darash rabbi simay beshaa shehikdimu yisrael naase lenishma bau shishshim ribo shel malache hashsharet lechol echad veechad miyyisrael kashru lo shene chetarim echad keneged naase veechad keneged nishma vechevan shechatu yisrael yardu mea veesrim ribo malache chabbala uferkum shenneemar vayyitnatztzelu vene yisrael et edyam mehar chorev amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina bechorev taanu bechorev perku bechorev taanu kedaamaran bechorev perku dichtiv vayyitnatztzelu vene yisrael vego amar rabbi yochanan vechullan zacha moshe untalan dismich leh umoshe yikkach et haohel amar resh lakish atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziran lanu shenneemar ufduye Adonai yeshuvun uvau tziyyon berinna vesimchat olam al rosham simcha shemmeolam al rosham

Amar rabbi elazar beshaa shehikdimu yisrael naase lenishma yatzta bat kol veamra lahen mi gilla levanay raz ze shemmalache hashsharet mishtammeshin bo dichtiv barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro beresha ose vahadar lishmoa amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina may dichtiv ketappuach baatze hayyaar vego lamma nimshelu yisrael letappuach lomar lach ma tappuach ze piro kodem lealav af yisrael hikdimu naase lenishma

Gema lema leh lemitne hammatznia litne hammotzi lezera uldugma velirfua chayyav bechol shehu amar abbaye hacha bemay askinan kegon shehitznio veshachach lamma hitznio vehashta ka mappek leh setama
