Gema amar rabbi elazar hammotzi massooy lemala measara tefachim chayyav shekken massa bene kehat umassa bene kehat menalan dichtiv al hammishkan veal hammizbeach saviv makkish mizbeach lemishkan ma mishkan eser ammot af mizbeach eser ammot

Umishkan gufeh menalan dichtiv eser ammot orech hakkaresh uchtiv vayyifros et haohel al hammishkan veamar rav moshe rabbenu peraso mikkan atta lamed govhan shel leviyyim eser ammot ugmiri dechol tuna demidle bemotot tilta milleel utre tilte milletachat ishtechach dahava midle tuva

Veibaet ema mearon deamar mar aron tisha vechapporet tefach hare kan asara ugmiri dechol tuna demidle bemotot tilta milleel utre tilte millera ishtechach demillemala measara hava kae veligmar mimmoshe dilma moshe shane deamar mar en hashshechina shora ella al chacham gibbor veashir uvaal koma

Amar rav mishshum rabbi chiyya hammotzi massooy beshabbat al rosho chayyav chattat shekken anshe hutzal osin ken veanshe hutzal rubba dealma ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav mishshum rabbi chiyya echad mibbene hutzal shehotzi massoy al rosho beshabbat chayyav shekken bene iro osin ken vetivtal dato etzel kol adam ella i itmar hachi itmar hammotzi massoy al rosho patur
b: Veim timtza lomar anshe hutzal osin ken batla datan etzel kol adam

Matni hammitkaven lehotzi lefanav uva lo leacharav patur leacharav uva lo lefanav chayyav beemet amru haishsha hachogeret besinar ben millefaneha uven milleachareha chayyevet shekken rauy lihot chozer rabbi yehuda omer af mekabbele fitkin

Gema may shena lefanav uva lo leacharav defatur dela itavida machshavto leacharav uva lo lefanav name ha la itavida machshavto amar rabbi elazar tavrah mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo amar rava umay kushya dilma lefanav uva lo leacharav hayenu tama defatur denitkaven lishmira meulla vealta beyado shemira pechuta leacharav uva lo lefanav hayenu tama dechayyav denitkaven lishmira pechuta vealta beyado shemira meulla

Ella may kushya diyyuka dematnitin kashya hammitkaven lehotzi lefanav uva lo leacharav patur ha leacharav uva lo leacharav chayyav ema sefa leacharav uva lo lefanav hu dechayyav ha leacharav uva lo leacharav patur amar rabbi elazar tavrah mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo

Amar rav ashe may kushya dilma la mibaya kaamar la mibaya leacharav uva lo leacharav dechayyav deitavida machshavto ella afilu leacharav uva lo lefanav itztericha leh salka datach amena hoil vela itavida machshavto la lichayyav ka mashma lan denitkaven lishmira pechuta vealta beyado shemira meulla dechayyav

Ulacharav uva lo leacharav tannae hi detanya hammotzi maot befundato ufiha lemala chayyav piha lematta rabbi yehuda mechayyev vachachamim potrin amar lahen rabbi yehuda i attem modim bilacharav uva lo leacharav shehu chayyav veamru lo vei atta mode kilachar yado veraglo shehu patur

Amar rabbi yehuda ani amarti davar echad vehen amru davar echad ani lo matzati teshuva ledivrehem vehen lo matzu teshuva lidvaray middekaamar lehu i attem modin lav mikkelal defatri rabbanan velitamach dekaamri leh i atta mode mikkelal dimchayyev rabbi yehuda vehatanya leachar yado veraglo divre hakkol patur

Ella leacharav uva lo leacharav divre hakkol chayyav leachar yado veraglo divre hakkol patur ki peligi befundato ufiha lematta mar medamme leh leacharav uva lo leacharav umar medamme leh leachar yado veraglo
Beemet amru haishsha ku tana kol beemet halacha hi rabbi yehuda omer af mekabbele fitkin tana shekken lavlare malchut osin ken
Matni hammotzi kikkar lirshut harabbim chayyav hotziuhu shenayim peturin lo yachol echad lehotzio vehotziuhu shenayim chayyavin verabbi shimon poter

Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav veamri lah amar abbaye veamri lah bematnita tana ze yachol veze yachol rabbi meir mechayyev verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon potrim ze eno yachol veze eno yachol rabbi yehuda verabbi meir mechayevim verabbi shimon poter ze yachol veze eno yachol divre hakkol chayyav

Tanya name hachi hammotzi kikkar lirshut harabbim chayyav hotziuhu shenayim rabbi meir mechayyev verabbi yehuda omer im lo yachol echad lehotzio vehotziuhu shenayim chayyavin veim lav peturim verabbi shimon poter mena hane mile detanu rabbanan baasotah haose et kullah velo haose et miktzatah ketzad shenayim shehau ochazin bemalgez velogzin becharker veshovtin bekulmos vechotvin bekane vehotziuhu lirshut harabbim yachol yehu chayyavin talmud lomar baasotah haose et kullah velo haose miktzatah

a: Beigul shel devela vehotziuhu lirshut harabbim bekora vehotziuha lirshut harabbim rabbi yehuda omer im lo yachol echad lehotzio vehotziuhu shenayim chayyavin veim lav peturin rabbi shimon omer af al pi shello yachol echad lehotzio vehotziuhu shenayim peturim lechach neemar baasotah yachid sheasaah chayyav shenayim sheasauha peturin

Bemay kamipalgi behay kera veim nefesh achat techeta vishgaga meam haaretz baasotah rabbi shimon savar telata miute ketivi nefesh techta achat techta baasotah techta chad lemaote ze oker veze manniach vechad lemaote ze yachol veze yachol vechad lemaote ze eno yachol veze eno yachol
Verabbi yehuda chad lemaote ze oker veze manniach vechad lemaote ze yachol veze yachol vechad lemaote yachid sheasaah behoraat bet din verabbi shimon yachid sheasaah behoraat bet din chayyav
Verabbi meir mi ketiv nefesh techta achat techta baasotah techta tere miute ketivi chad lemaote ze oker veze manniach vechad lemaote yachid sheasaah behoraat bet din

Amar mar ze yachol veze eno yachol divre hakkol chayyav he minnayehu michayyav amar rav chisda ze sheyyachol dei ze sheeno yachol may ka aved amar leh rav hamnuna deka mesayya bahadeh amar leh mesayyea en bo mammash

Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava af anan name tenena haya yoshev al gabbe hammitta vearba talliyyot tachat ragle hammitta temeot mippene sheenah yechola laamod al shalosh verabbi shimon metaher haya rochev al gabbe behema vearba talliyyot tachat ragle habbehema tehorot mippene sheyechola laamod al shalosh veammay ha kamsayyaa bahade hadade lav mishshum deamrinan mesayyea en bo mammash

Amar rav yehuda middiskarta leolam ema lach mesayyea yesh bo mammash veshane hacha deakra lah ligmare vechevan dezimnin akra ha vezimnin akra ha leheve kezav hammithappech mi la tenan zav shehaya muttal al chamishsha safsalin o al chamesh pundaot leorkan temeim lerochban tehorin yashen safek mithappech alehen temein
Ella lav mishshum deamrinan mesayyea en bo mammash amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava af anan name tenena
b: Rabbi yose omer hassus metamme al yadav hachamor al raglav shemmishenet hassus al yadav vachamor al raglav veammay ha ka mesayya bahade hadade lav mishshum deamrinan mesayyea en bo mammash amar rav ashe af anan name tenena rabbi eliezer omer raglo achat al hakkeli veraglo achat al haritzpa raglo achat al haeven veraglo achat al haritzpa roin kol sheilu yinnatel hakkeli vetinatel haeven yachol laamod al raglo achat avodato keshera veim lav avodato pesula

Veammay ha ka mesayya bahade hadade lav mishshum deamrinan mesayyea en bo mammash amar ravina af anan name tenena kibel beyamin usmol mesayyato avodato keshera veammay ha ka mesayya bahade hadade lav mishshum deamrinan mesayyea en bo mammash shema minah

Amar mar ze yachol veze yachol rabbi meir mechayyav ibaya lehu baenan shiur laze veshiur laze o dilma shiur echad lechullam rav chisda verav hamnuna chad amar shiur laze veshiur laze vechad amar shiur echad lechullan amar rav pappa mishshemeh derava af anan name tenena haya yoshev al gabbe mitta vearba talliyyot tachat arba ragle hammitta temeot mippene sheen yechola laamod al shalosh veammay live shiur ziva laze veshiur ziva laze lav mishshum deamrinan shiur echad lechullan

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak af anan name tenena tzevi shennichnas labbayit venaal echad befanav chayyav naalu shenayim peturin lo yachol echad linol venaalu shenayim chayyavim veammay live shiur tzeda laze veshiur tzeda laze lav mishshum deamrinan shiur echad lechullam amar ravina af anan name tenena hashshuttafin shegganvu vetavchu chayyavin veammay live shiur tevicha laze veshiur tevicha laze lav mishshum deamrinan shiur echad lechullam

Veamar rav ashe af anan name tenena shenayim shehotziu kane shel gardi chayyavin veammay live shiur hotzaa laze veshiur hotzaa laze lav mishshum deamrinan shiur echad lechullam amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe dilma deit beh kede levashshel betza kalla laze uvetza kalla laze im ken lashmeinan kane dealma may shena degardi vedilma deit beh kede leerog mappa laze uchde leerog mappa laze ella meha leka lemishma minah
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman shenayim shehotziu kane shel gardi peturin verabbi shimon mechayyev kelappe leya ella ema chayyavin verabbi shimon poter

Matni hammotzi ochalin pachot mikkeshiur bichli patur af al hakkeli shehakkeli tefela lo et hachay bammitta patur af al hammitta shehammitta tefela lo et hammet bammitta chayyav vechen kezayit min hammet uchzayit min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz chayyav verabbi shimon poter

Gema tanu rabbanan hammotzi ochalin keshiur im bichli chayyav al haochalin ufatur al hakkeli veim haya keli tzarich lo chayyav af al hakkeli shema minah ochel shene zete chelev behelem echad chayyav shettayim amar rav sheshet hacha bemay askinan kegon

a: Sheshshagag al haochalin vehezid al hakkeli matkef lah rav ashe veha af al hakkeli katane ella amar rav ashe kegon sheshshagag baze uvaze venoda lo vechazar venoda lo uviflugta derabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish

Et hachay bammitta patur af al hammitta lema matnitin rabbi natan hi vela rabbanan detanya hammotzi behema chayya vaof lirshut harabbim ben chayyin uven shechutin chayyav rabbi natan omer al shechutin chayyav veal chayyin patur shehachay nose et atzmo amar rava afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi natan ella bivhema chayya vaof dimsharbeti nafshayehu aval adam chay denose et atzmo afilu rabbanan modu

Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava veha ditnan ben betira mattir bassus vetanya ben betira mattir bassus mippene shehu ose bo melacha sheen chayyavin alav chattat veamar rabbi yochanan ben betira verabbi natan amru davar echad vei amratte dela peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi natan ella bivhema chayya vaof mishshum dimsharbeti nafshayehu may irya ben betira verabbi natan vehaamratte afilu rabbanan modu ki amar rabbi yochanan besus hamuchad leofot umi ika sus hamuchad leofot in ika devi zeyarin

Amar rabbi yochanan umode rabbi natan bechafut amar leh rav adda bar matna leabbaye veha hane parsae dichman dichfiti damu veamar rabbi yochanan ben betira verabbi natan amru davar echad hatam ramut rucha hu denaket lehu dehahu pardashcha dirtach malka ilaveh urhat telata parse bechareh
Et hammet bammitta chayyav vechen kezayit min hammet vechu amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan veamar rav yosef amar rabbi shimon ben lakish poter haya rabbi shimon
b: Af bemotzi et hammet lekovro amar rava umode rabbi shimon bemar lachpor bo vesefer tora likrot bo dechayyav peshita dei ha name melacha sheenah tzericha legufah hi ella melacha shetztzericha legufah lerabbi shimon hechi mashkachatte lah mahu detema ad deika legufo ulgufah kegon mar laasot lo tas velachpor sefer tora lehaggiha velikrot bo ka mashma lan

Hahu shachva dahava bidrokeret shera rav nachman bar yitzchak leappokeh lecharmelit amar leh rabbi yochanan achuh demar bereh deravna larav nachman bar yitzchak keman kerabbi shimon emar defatar rabbi shimon mechiyyuv chattat isura derabbanan miha ika amar leh haelohim deayelatte beh atte vaafilu lerabbi yehuda shere demi kaamena lirshut harabbim lecharmelit kaamena gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora

Tenan hatam hattolesh simane tuma vehakkove et hammichya over belo taase itmar achat mishshettayim chayyav achat mishshalosh rav nachman amar chayyav rav sheshet amar patur rav nachman amar chayyav ahni maasav dei mishtakla chada achariti azla lah tuma rav sheshet amar patur hashta mihat ha ita letuma

Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah ditnan vechen kezayit min hammet uchzayit min hannevela chayyav ha chatzi zayit patur vehatanya chatzi zayit chayyav may lav ha detanya chayyav deappek chatzi zayit mikkezayit veha ditnan patur deappek chatzi zayit mikkezayit umechetza verav nachman ide veide chayyav veha ditnan patur deappek chatzi zayit mimmet gadol
Matni hannotel tzippornav zo bazo o beshinav vechen searo vechen sefamo vechen zekano vechen haggodelet vechen hakkochelet vechen happokeset rabbi eliezer mechayyev vachachamim osrin mishshum shevut
Gema amar rabbi elazar machaloket bayyad aval bichli chayyav peshita zo bazo tenan mahu detema rabbanan bichli name patri veha dekatane zo bazo lehodiacha kocho derabbi eliezer ka mashma lan

Veamar rabbi elazar machaloket leatzmo aval lachavero divre hakkol patur peshita tzippornav tenan mahu detema rabbi eliezer lachavero name mechayyav veha dekatane tzippornav lehodiacha kochan derabbanan ka mashma lan
Vechen searo ku tana hannotel melo fi hazzug chayyav vechamma melo fi hazzug amar rav yehuda shettayim vehatanya velakkorcha shettayim ema vechen lakkorcha shettayim

Tanya name hachi hannotel melo fi hazzug beshabbat chayyav vechamma melo fi hazzug shettayim rabbi eliezer omer achat umodim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bimlakket levanot mittoch shechorot sheafilu achat chayyav vedavar ze af bachol asur mishshum shenneemar lo yilbash gever simlat ishsha

Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer tzipporen shepperesh rubbah vetzitzin sheppershu rubban bayyad muttar bichli chayyav chattat mi ika mide devichli chayyav chattat uvayyad muttar lechattechilla hachi kaamar pershu rubban bayyad muttar bichli patur aval asur lo pershu rubban bayyad patur aval asur bichli chayyav chattat amar rav yehuda halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan vehu sheppershu kelappe mala umtzaarot oto

Vechen haggodelet ku godelet kochelet ufokeset mishshum may mechayeva amar rabbi avin amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina godelet mishshum oreget kochelet mishshum kotevet pokeset mishshum tova amaru rabbanan kammeh derabbi avahu vechi derech ariga bechach vechi derech ketiva bechach vechi derech teviyya bechach ella amar rabbi avahu ledidi mipparsha li mineh derabbi yose berabbi chanina

a: Kochelet mishshum tzovaat godelet ufokeset mishshum bona vechi derech binyan bechach in kiddaresh rabbi shimon ben menasya vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela melammed shekkilah hakkadosh baruch hu lechava veheviah etzel adam shekken bichrakke hayyam korin lekallaita bannayeta tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer godelet kochelet ufokeset leatzmah petura lachavertah chayyevet vechen haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi eliezer ishsha lo taavir serak al paneha mippene shetztzovaat

Tanu rabbanan hacholev vehamchabbetz vehamgabben kigrogeret hamchabbed vehamrabbetz veharode challot devash shagag beshabbat chayyav chattat hezid beom tov loke arbaim divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze eno ella mishshum shevut

Rav nachman bar gurya ikla linhardaa beo mineh cholev mishshum may michayyav amar lehu mishshum cholev mechabbetz mishshum may michayyav amar lehu mishshum mechabbetz megabben mishshum may chayyav amar lehu mishshum megabben amaru leh rabbach katel kene beagma hava ata sheel be midresha amaru leh cholev chayyav mishshum mefarek mechabbetz chayyav mishshum borer megabben chayyav mishshum bone

Hamchabbed hamrabbetz veharode challot devash shagag beshabbat chayyav chattat hezid beom tov loke arbaim divre rabbi eliezer amar rabbi elazar may tama derabbi eliezer dichtiv vayyitbol otah beyarat haddevash vechi ma inyan yaar etzel devash ella lomar lach ma yaar hattolesh mimmennu beshabbat chayyav chattat af challot devash harode mimmennu beshabbat chayyav chattat

Ammemar shera zilcha bemachoza amar tama may amur rabbanan dilma ate leashoye gummot hacha leka gummot rava tosfaa ashkecheh leravina deka mitztaar mehavla veamri lah mar kashshisha bereh derava ashkecheh larav ashe deka mitztaar mehavla amar leh la savar lah mar leha detanya harotze lerabbetz et beto beshabbat mevi areva melea mayim verochetz panav bezavit zo yadav bezavit zo raglav bezavit zo venimtza habbayit mitrabbetz meelav amar leh lav addatay
Tana ishsha chachama merabbetzet betah beshabbat vehaidana disvira lan kerabbi shimon shere afilu lechattechilla
Matni hattolesh meatzitz nakuv chayyav vesheeno nakuv patur verabbi shimon poter baze uvaze

Gema rame leh abbaye lerava veamri lah rabbi chiyya bar rav lerav tenan rabbi shimon poter baze uvaze alma nakuv lerabbi shimon kesheeno nakuv meshave leh urminhu rabbi shimon omer en ben nakuv lesheeno nakuv
b: Ella lehachshir zeraim bilvad amar leh lechol mile rabbi shimon ketalush meshave leh veshane leinyan tuma dehattora ribta tohora etzel zeraim shenneemar al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea

Bea mineh hahu sava merabbi zera shoresh keneged nekev ma li amar rabbi shimon ishtik vela amar leh vela mide zimna chada ashkecheh deyatev vekaamar umode rabbi shimon sheim nikav bichde tohorato amar leh hashta shoresh keneged nekev beay minach vela amarte li vela mide nikav bichde tohorato mibaya
Amar abbaye vei itmar leha derabbi zera hachi hu deitmar umode rabbi shimon sheim nikav lematta merviit

Amar rava chamesh middot bichle cheres nikav kemotzi mashke tahor milletamme gistera vaadayin keli hu lekaddesh bo me chattat nikav kechones mashke tahor millekaddesh bo me chattat vaadayin keli hu lehachshir bo zeraim nikav keshoresh katan tahor millehachshir bo zeraim vaadayin keli hu lekabbel bo zetim nikav kemotzi zetim tahor millekabbel bo zetim vaadayin keli hu lekabbel bo rimonim nikav kemotzi rimonim tahor mikkelum veim hukkaf tzamid patil ad sheyyippachet rubbo
Amar rav assi shamati keli cheres shiuro kemotzi rimon amar leh rava shemma lo shamata ella bemukkaf tzemid patil veha rava hu deamar mukkaf tzemid patil ad sheyyippachet rubbo la kashya

a: Ha beravreve veha bezutre amar rav assi shonin kele cheres shiuro bechones mashke velo amru motzi mashke ella leinyan gistera bilvad may tama amar mar zutra bereh derav nachman lefi sheen omrim have gistera legistera

Amar ulla peligi bah tere amorae bemareva rabbi yose berabbi avin verabbi yose bar zavda chad amar kemotzi rimmon vechad amar keshoresh katan vesimanach echad hammarbe veechad hammamit amar rav chinana bar kahana mishshemeh derabbi eliezer keli cheres shiuro kemotzi zetim umar kashshisha bereh derabba mesayyem bah mishshemeh derabbi eliezer vahare hen kichle gelalim uchle avanim uchle adama sheen mekabbelin tuma lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim ulinyan tzamid patil ad sheyyifchat rubbo
Matni hazzorek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid chayyav mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid urshut harabbim baemtza rabbi akiva mechayyev vachachamim potrin
Ketzad shette gezuzteraot zo keneged zo birshut harabbim hammoshit vehazzorek mizzo lazo patur hau shettehen bidota achat hammoshit chayyav vehazzorek patur shekkach hayeta avodat halviyyim
Shette agalot zo achar zo birshut harabbim moshitin hakkerashim mizzo lazo aval lo zorkin
b: Gema mikkede zerika tolada dehotzaa hi hotzaa gufah hecha ketiva amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera vayetzav moshe vayyaaviru kol bammachane moshe hechan hava yatev bemachane leviyya umachane leviyya reshut harabbim havay vekaamar lehu leyisrael la tappiku vetayeto mershut hayyachid didchu lirshut harabbim
Umimmay divshabbat kae dilma bechol kae umishshum dishlima lah melacha kedichtiv vehammelacha hayeta dayyam vego gamar haavara haavara miyyom hakkippurim
Ketiv hacha vayyaaviru kol bammachane uchtiv hatam vehaavarta shofar terua ma lehallan bayyom asur af kan bayyom asur
Ashkechan hotzaa hachnasa menalan sevara hi mikkede mershut lirshut hu ma li appoke uma li ayyole mihu hotzaa av hachnasa tolada
Umikkede aha michayyav veaha michayyav ammay kare lah hay av veammay kare lah hay tolada
Nafka minah dei aved shette avot bahade hadade i name shette toladot bahade hadade michayyav tarte vei aved av vetolada dideh la michayyav ella chada

Ulrabbi eliezer dimchayyev attolada bimkom av ammay karu lah av veammay karu lah tolada hach dahavay bemishkan chashiva kare lah av hach dela havay bammishkan chashiva la kare lah av i name hach dichtiva kare av vehach dela ketiva kare tolada
Veha ditnan hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel lemala measara tefachim kezorek baavir lematta measara tefachim kezorek baaretz vehazzorek baaretz arba ammot chayyav
Zarak arba ammot birshut harabbim menalan demichayyav amar rabbi yoshiyya shekken orge yeriot zorkin machatehen ze laze orgin mechatin lema lehu ella shekken tofre yeriot zorkin machatehen ze laze
Vedilma gabbe hadade hao yatvi matu hadade bemachtin dilma betoch arba hao yatvi
Ella amar rav chisda shekken orge yeriot zorkin buchyar bayeria vahalo ogdo beyado beniska batra
Veha bimkom petur kaazla ella shekken orge yeriot zorkin buchyar leshoalehen vedilma gabbe hadade hao yatvi matu hadade bechefet
Vedilma shalchofe hao meshalchafi vetu mi shayeli mehadade vehatane ludda ish ish mimmelachto asher hemma osim mimmelachto hu ose veeno ose mimmelechet chavero
Vetu maavir arba ammot birshut harabbim menalan demichayyav ella kol arba ammot birshut harabbim gemara gemiri lah
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mekoshesh maavir arba ammot birshut harabbim hava bematnita tana tolesh hava rav acha berabbi yaakov amar meammer hava

Lemay nafka minah lechidrav deamar rav matzati megillat setarim be rabbi chiyya vechatuv bah isi ben yehuda omer avot melachot arbaim chaser achat veim asaan kullan behelem achat veeno chayyav ella achat achat vetu la vehatnan avot melachot arbaim chaser achat vehavenan bah minyana lema li veamar rabbi yochanan sheim asaan kullam behelem achat chayyav al kol achat veachat
Ema eno chayyav al achat mehem
Rav yehuda peshita leh dehammaavir chayyav umatnitin peshita leh detolesh chayyav verav acha bar yaakov peshita leh dimammer chayyav mar savar ha mihat la mesappeka umar savar ha mihat la mesappeka
Tanu rabbanan mekoshesh ze tzelafchad vechen hu omer vayyihu vene yisrael bammidbar vayyimtzeu ish vego ulhallan hu omer avinu met bammidbar ma lehallan tzelafchad af kan tzelafchad divre rabbi akiva
Amar lo rabbi yehuda ben betira akiva ben kach uven kach atta atid liten et haddin im kidvarecha hattora kisattu veatta megalle oto veim lav atta motzi laaz al oto tzaddik

a: Veella ha gamar gezera shava gezera shava la gamar ella mehecha hava mivayyapilu hava

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer vayyichar af Adonai bam vayyelach melammed sheaf aharon nitztara divre rabbi akiva amar lo rabbi yehuda ben betira akiva ben kach uven kach atta atid liten et haddin im kidvarecha hattora kissattu veatta megalle oto veim lav atta motzi laaz al oto tzaddik
Veella hachtiv bam hahu binzifa bealma tanya keman deamar af aharon nitztara dichtiv vayyifen aharon el miryam vehinne metzoraat tana sheppana mitztzarato
Amar resh lakish hachoshed bichsherim loke begufo dichtiv vehen lo yaaminu li vego vegalya kamme kudsha berich hu dimhemni yisrael amar lo hen maaminim bene maaminim veatta en sofcha lehaamin
Hen maaminim dichtiv vayyaamen haam bene maaminim veheemin baya atta en sofcha lehaamin shenneemar yaan lo heemantem bi vego mimmay dilka dichtiv vayyomer Adonai lo od have na yadcha bechekecha vego

Amar rava veitema rabbi yose berabbi chanina midda tova memaheret lavo mimmiddat puranut deilu bemiddat puranut ketiv vayyotziah vehinne yado metzoraat kashshaleg veilu bemidda tova ketiv vayyotziah mecheko vehinne shava kivsaro mecheko hu deshava kivsaro
Vayyivla matte aharon et mattotam amar rabbi elazar nes betoch nes
Mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid

Bae rabba lematta measara peligi uvha peligi demar savar amrinan keluta kema shehunnecha umar savar la amrinan keluta kema shehunnecha aval lemala measara divre hakkol patur vela yalfinan zorek mimmoshit
O dilma lemala measara peligi uvha peligi demar savar yalfinan zorek mimmoshit umar savar la yalfinan zorek mimmoshit aval lematta measara divre hakkol chayyav may tama keluta kema shehunnecha damya

Amar rav yosef ha milta ibaya leh lerav chisda ufashtah nihaleh rav hamnuna meha mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid veover birshut harabbim atzmah rabbi akiva mechayyev vachachamim potrim middekaamar birshut harabbim atzmah peshita lematta measara peligi

Uvmay ilema bemaavir lematta measara hu dimchayyev lemala measara la mechayyev vehaamar rabbi elazar hammotzi massoy lemala measara chayyav shekken massa bene kehat ella lav bezorek ulmatta measara hu dimchayyev lemala measara la mechayyev shema minah bikluta kema shehunnecha peligi shema minah
Ufliga derabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar mechayyev haya rabbi akiva afilu lemala measara vehay dekatane reshut harabbim atzmah lehodiacha kochan derabbanan
Ufliga derav chilkiyya bar tovi daamar rav chilkiyya bar tovi toch shelosha divre hakkol chayyav lemala measara divre hakkol patur mishshelosha vead asara banu lemachloket rabbi akiva verabbanan
Tanya name hachi betoch shelosha divre hakkol chayyav lemala measara eno ella mishshum shevut veim hau reshuot shello muttar mishshelosha vead asara rabbi akiva mechayyev vachachamim potrin

Amar mar im hau reshuot shello muttar lema tihve teuvteh derav deitmar shene vattim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim rabba bar rav huna amar rav asur lizrok mizze laze ushmuel amar muttar lizrok mizze laze velav mi okemna lehahi kegon demidle chad umittatte chad dezimnin nafel veate leetuye

Amar leh rav chisda lerav hamnuna veamri lah rav hamnuna lerav chisda mena ha milta daamur rabbanan kol pachot mishshelosha kelavud dame amar leh lefi shei efshar lah lirshut harabbim shettilaket bemalket uvrahitane
I hachi shelosha name vetu ha ditnan hamshalshel defanot millemala lematta im hen gevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim pesula ha pachot mishshelosha keshera
Hatam hayenu tama mishshum dehaveya lah mechitza shehaggedayim bokin bah tinach lematta lemala may ika lememar ella kol pachot mishshelosha kelavud dame hilcheta gemiri lah

Tanu rabbanan mershut harabbim lirshut harabbim urshut hayyachid baemtza rabbi mechayyev vachachamim potrin rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu lo chiyyev rabbi ella birshut hayyachid mekore deamrinan beta keman demalya dame aval sheeno mekore la amar rav chana amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mechayyev haya rabbi shettayim achat mishshum hotzaa veachat mishshum hachnasa
Yatev rav chana veka kashya leh
b: Lememra dimchayyev rabbi attolada bimkom av
Vehatanya rabbi omer devarim haddevarim elle haddevarim ellu sheloshim vatesha melachot shenneemru lemoshe besinay
Amar leh rav yosef mar aha matne lah vekashya leh derabbi adderabbi anan adderabbi yehuda matninan vela kashya lan
Detanya mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim veavar arba ammot birshut harabbim rabbi yehuda mechayyev vachachamim potrin

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mechayyev haya rabbi yehuda shettayim achat mishshum hotzaa veachat mishshum haavara dei salka datach chada hu dimchayyev mikkelal derabbanan patri ligmare ha appek lah mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim mimmay dilma leolam ema lach rabbi yehuda chada hu dimchayyev verabbanan patri ligmare vehechi mashkachatte lah kegon deamar ad denafka leh lirshut harabbim tenuch

Uvha kamipalgi derabbi yehuda savar amrinan keluta kema shehunnecha veitavida leh machshavto verabbanan savri la amrinan keluta kema shehunnecha vela itavida leh machshavto aval attolada bimkom av la mechayyev rabbi yehuda

La salka datach detanya rabbi yehuda mosif af hashshovet vehamdakdek amru lo shovet hare hu bichlal mesech medakdek hare hu bichlal oreg may lav deavdinhu letarvayehu bahade hadade ushma minah mechayyev haya rabbi yehuda attolada bimkom av
Mimmay dilma leolam deavdah leha lechuddah veha lechuddah verabbi yehuda attolada bimkom av la mechayyev uvha kamipalgi derabbi yehuda savar hane avot ninhu verabbanan savri hane toldot ninhu
Teda dekatane rabbi yehuda mosif i amratte bishlama avot may mosif mosif avot ella i amratte toladot may mosif itmar name rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu lo chiyyev rabbi yehuda ella achat

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ulmay dislek addatin meikara dimchayyev haya rabbi yehuda shettayim i lehacha kavae lah lehacha la kavae lah i lehacha kavae lah lehacha la kavae lah amar leh beomer kol makom shettirtze tanuach

Peshita nitkaven lizrok shemone vezarak arba hare katav shem mishshimon nitkaven lizrok arba vezarak shemone mahu mi amrinan ha appek leh o dilma hecha devae ha la nach velav hayenu daamar leh ravina lerav ashe vaamar leh beomer kol makom shettirtze tanuach
Udkaamratte hare katav shem mishshimon mi dame hatam kamma dela ketiv shem la mikketiv leh shimon hacha kamma dela zarek arba la mizdarki leh tamne
Tanu rabbanan hazzorek mershut harabbim lirshut harabbim urshut hayyachid baemtza arba ammot chayyav

a: Pachot mearba ammot patur may ka mashma lan ha ka mashma lan reshuot mitztarfot udla amrinan keluta kema shehunnecha

Amar rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rav abba amar rav huna amar rav hammaavir arba ammot birshut harabbim mekore patur lefi sheeno dome ledigle midbar ini veha agalot dimkorot haveyan veamar rav mishshum rabbi chiyya agalot tachtehen uvenehen vetziddehen reshut harabbim ki kaamar rav bedarata

Mikkede urka daagala kamma havay chamesh ammin putya dekeresh kamma havay ammeta ufalga kamma motev telata pash leh palga deammeta ki shade leh mar bene uvene kelavud dame mi savratte kerashim apputayehu hava mannach lehu achuddan mannach lehu

Sof sof sumcha dekeresh kamma have ammeta kamma hava motiv arbea pasha lah ammeta ki shade lah mar bene uvene kelavud dame hanicha leman deamar kerashim millemattan ovyan amma millemalan kalin veholchin ad keetzba shappir ella leman deamar keshem shemmillemattan ovyan amma kach millemalan ovyan amma may ika lememar
Amar rav kahana beatbee atbee hecha mannach lehu aggabba daagala agala gufah mekora havay
b: Amar shemuel bitedot

Tanu rabbanan kerashim millemattan ovyan amma umillemalan kalin veholchin ad keetzba shenneemar yihu tammim al rosho ulhallan hu omer tammu nichratu divre rabbi yehuda rabbi nechemya omer keshem shemmillemattan ovyan amma kach millemalan ovyan amma shenneemar yachdav
Vehachtiv tammim hahu deleto shalmin vela leto denisra veidach name hachtiv yachdav hahu dela lishalchofinhu mehadade

Bishlama leman deamar keshem shemmillemattan ovyan amma kach millemalan ovyan amma hayenu dichtiv ulyarkete hammishkan yamma taase shishsha kerashim ushne kerashim taase limkutzot deate putya dehane memalle leh lesumcha dehane ella leman deamar millemattan ovyan amma millemalan kalin veholchin ad keetzba hay ayel vehay nafek deshafe lehu ki turin
Vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim tana benes haya omed

Veet hammishkan taase eser yeriot orech hayeria haachat shemone veesrim baamma shedi urkayehu lefutya demishkan kamma haveya esrin vetamne dal asar leigara pashu lehu tesha lehay gisa vetesha lehay gisa lerabbi yehuda migalleya amma daadanim lerabbi nechemya migalleya amma dikrashim
Shedi putayehu leurkeh demishkan kamma haveya arbein dal telatin leigara pasha lehu asar lerabbi yehuda mikkasseya amma daadanim lerabbi nechemya migalleya amma daadanim

Veasita yeriot izzim leohel vego orech hayeria haachat sheloshim baamma vego shedi urkayehu lefutya demishkan kamma haveya telatin dal asar leigara pashu lehu asar lehay gisa vaasar lehay gisa lerabbi yehuda mikasseya amma daadanim lerabbi nechemya migalleya amma daadanim

Tanya name hachi vehaamma mizze vehaamma mizze baodef lechassot amma shel adanim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi nechemya omer lechassot amma shel kerashim shedi putayehu leurkeh demishkan kamma haveya arbein vearbee dal telatin leigara pashu lehu arbesre dal tarte lechafla dichtiv vechafalta et hayeria hashshishshit el mul pene haohel pashu lehu tarte sere

Bishlama lerabbi yehuda hayenu dichtiv chatzi hayeria haodefet tisrach ella lerabbi nechemya may tisrach tisrach mechavroteha tana deve rabbi yishmael lema mishkan dome leishsha shemhallechet bashshuk veshippuleha mehallechin achareha
Tanu rabbanan charutzim hau kerashim vachalulim hau adanim

a: Venirin kerasin ballulaot kechochavim barakia

Tanu rabbanan yeriot hattachtonot shel techelet veshel argaman veshel tolaat shani veshel shesh veelonot shel maase izzim ugdola chachma shenneemra baelonot yoter mimma shenneemra betachtonot deilu betachtonot ketiv vechol ishsha chachmat lev beyadeha tau veilu beelonot ketiv vechol hannashim asher nasa libban otana bechochma tau et haizzim vetanya mishshum rabbi nechemya shatuf baizzim vetauy min haizzim

Shette gezuzteraot ku amar rav mishshum rabbi chiyya agalot tachtehen uvenehen vetzidehen reshut harabbim amar abbaye ben agala laagala kimlo orech agala vechamma orech agala chamesh ammot lema li bearba ufalga saggi ki hechi dela lidachku kerashim
Amar rava tzide agala kimlo rochav agala vechamma rochav agala shette ammot umechetza lema li beammeta ufalga saggi ki hechi dela lidaddu kerashim
Ella dekayema lan derech reshut harabbim shesh esre amma anan degamrinan lah mimmishkan demishkan chamesre havay ammeta yattira havay dahava kae ben levi dechi mishtallefi kerashim hava naket lehu
Matni chulyat habbor vehassela shehen gevohin asara verochban arbaa hannotel mehen vehannoten al gabban chayyav pachot mikken patur

Gema lema li lemitne chulyat habbor vehassela litne habbor vehassela mesayya leh lerabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan bor vechulyatah mitztarfin laasara tanya name hachi bor birshut harabbim amukka asara urchava arbaa en memallein hemenna beshabbat
b: Ella im ken asu lah mechitza gevoha asara tefachim veen shotin hemenna beshabbat ella im ken hichnis lah rosho verubbo uvor vechulyatah mitztarfin laasara

Bea mineh rav mardochay merava ammud birshut harabbim gavoha asara verachav arbaa vezarak venach al gabbav mahu mi amrinan hare akira beisur hare hannacha beisur o dilma kevan demimmekom petur kaatya la
Amar leh matnitin hi ata shayeleh lerav yosef amar leh matnitin hi ata shayeleh leabbaye amar leh matnitin hi amar lehu kullechu berukka dahadade tafitu
Amaru leh veatte la tisbera vehatnan hannotel mehen venoten al gabban chayyav amar lehu dilma matnitin bemachat
Machat name i efshar dela middalya purta deit leh mursha i name deramya bacharitza

Amar rav meyasha bae rabbi yochanan kotel birshut harabbim gavoha asara veeno rachav arba umukkaf lecharmelit vaasao reshut hayyachid vezarak venach al gabbav mahu mi amrinan kevan deeno rachav arba mekom petur hu o dilma kevan daasao reshut hayyachid keman demalya damya

Amar ulla kal vachomer laacherim ose mechitza leatzmo lo kol shekken itmar name amar rabbi chiyya bar ashe amar rav vechen amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan kotel birshut harabbim gavoha asara veeno rachav arba umukkaf lecharmelit vaasao reshut hayyachid vezarak venach al gabbav chayyav laacherim ose mechitza leatzmo lo kol shekken

Bae rabbi yochanan bor tisha veakar mimmenna chulya vehishlimah laasara mahu akirat chefetz vaasiyyat mechitza bahade hadade kaatu michayyav o la michayyav veim timtze lomar kevan dela have mechitza asara meikara la michayyav bor asara venatan letochah chulya umiatah mahu hannachat chefetz vesiluk mechitza bahade hadade kaatu michayyav o la michayyav
Tifshot leh middideh datnan hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel lemala measara tefachim kezorek baavir lematta measara kezorek baaretz vehazzorek baaretz arba ammot chayyav vehavenan bah veha la nach
Veamar rabbi yochanan bidvela shemena shaninu veammay ha ka memaet mearba ammot
Hatam la mevattel lah hacha mevattel lah
Bae rava zarak daf venach al gabbe yetedot mahu may kamibaya leh hannachat chefetz vaasiyyat mechitza bahade hadade kaatu hayenu derabbi yochanan

Ki kamibaya leh lerava kegon dezarak daf vechefetz al gabbav may kevan devahade hadade kaatu kehannachat chefetz vaasiyyat mechitza dame o dilma kevan dela efshar dela midle purta vahadar nayach kaasiyyat mechitza vehannachat chefetz dame teku
Amar rava peshita li mayim al gabbe mayim hayenu hannachatan egoz al gabbe mayim

a: Lav hayenu hannachatan bae rava egoz bichli uchli tzaf al gabbe mayim mahu mi amrinan batar egoz azlinan veha nayach o dilma batar keli azlinan veha la nayach teku

Shemen al gabbe yayin machaloket rabbi yochanan ben nuri verabbanan ditnan shemen shetztzaf al gabbe yayin venaga tevul yom bashshemen lo pasal ella shemen rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer shenehem chibur ze laze

Amar abbaye bor birshut harabbim amukka asara urchava shemona vezarak letochah machtzelet chayyav chilkah bemachtzelet patur leabbaye difshita leh demachtzelet mevattela mechitzta kol shekken chulya dimvattela mechitzta lerabbi yochanan demibaya leh chulya machtzelet peshita dela mevattela mechitzta

Veamar abbaye bor birshut harabbim amukka asara urchava arbaa melea mayim vezarak letochah chayyav melea perot vezarak letochah patur may tama mayim la mevatteli mechitzta perot mevatteli mechitzta tanya name hachi hazzorek min hayyam leisratya umin haisratya layyam patur rabbi shimon omer im yesh bimkom shezzarak amok asara verachav arbaa chayyav
Matni hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel lemala measara tefachim kezorek baavir lematta measara tefachim kezorek baaretz hazzorek baaretz arba ammot chayyav
Gema veha la nach amar rabbi yochanan bidvela shemena shaninu

Amar rav yehuda amar rav amar rabbi chiyya zarak lemala measara vehalcha venacha bechor kol shehu banu lemachloket rabbi meir verabbanan lerabbi meir deamar chokkin lehashlim michayyav lerabbanan deamri en chokkin lehashlim la michayyav tanya name hachi zarak lemala measara vehalcha venacha bechor kol shehu rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrin

Amar rav yehuda amar rav tel hammitlakket asara mittoch arba vezarak venach al gabbav chayyav tanya name hachi mavoy sheshshava letocho venaasa midron lirshut harabbim o shava lirshut harabbim venaasa midron letocho oto mavoy eno tzarich lo lechi velo kora rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer tel hammitlakket asara mittoch arba vezarak venach al gabbav chayyav
Matni zarak letoch arba ammot venitgalgel chutz learba ammot patur chutz learba ammot venitgalgel letoch arba ammot chayyav

Gema veha la nach amar rabbi yochanan vehu shennach al gabbe mashshehu tanya name hachi zarak chutz learba ammot udchafattu haruach vehichnisattu veaf al pi shechazra vehotziattu patur achazattu haruach mashshehu af al pi shechazra vehichnisattu chayyav
Amar rava toch shelosha lerabbanan tzarich hannacha al gabbe mashshehu yatev marimar vekaamar lah leha shemata amar leh ravina lemarimar
b: Lav hayenu matnitin veamar rabbi yochanan vehu shennach al gabbe mashshehu amar leh mitgalgel kaamratte mitgalgel en sofo lanuach aval hay kevan desofo lanuach af al gav dela nach keman denach dame ka mashma lan

Matni hazzorek bayyam arba ammot patur im haya rekak mayim urshut harabbim mehallechet bo hazzorek letocho arba ammot chayyav vechamma hu rekak mayim pachot measara tefachim rekak mayim urshut harabbim mehallechet bo hazzorek betocho arba ammot chayyav

Gema amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava bishlama hiluch hiluch tere zimne ha ka mashma lan hiluch al yede haddechak shemeh hiluch tashmish al yede haddechak la shemeh tashmish ella rekak rekak tere zimne lema li chad bimot hachamma vechad bimot haggeshamim utzrichi dei tena chada hava amena hane mile bimot hachamma daavidi inashe dimsaggi leokore nafshayehu aval bimot haggeshamim la vei ashmeinan bimot haggeshamim dechevan demitannefi la ichpat lehu aval bimot hachamma la
Abbaye amar itzterich salka datach amena hane mile hecha dela have arba ammot aval hecha dehave arba ammot akkofe makkefi leh

Rav ashe amar itzterich salka datach amena hane mile hecha dahavay arbaa aval hecha dela havay arbaa mifsa pasi leh veazda rav ashe letameh deamar rav ashe hay man dezarek venach aggudda degamla michayyav shehare rabbim bokin bo

Matni hazzorek min hayyam layyabbasha umin hayyabbasha layyam umin hayyam lassefina umin hassefina layyam umin hassefina lachavertah patur sefinot keshurot zo bazo metaltelin mizzo lazo im enan keshurot af al pi shemmukkafot en metaltelin mizzo lazo
Gema itmar sefina rav huna amar motziin hemenna ziz kol shehu ummalle rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri ose mekom arbaa ummalle
Rav huna amar motzi hemenna ziz kol shehu ummalle kasavar karmelit meara mashchinan veavera mekom petur hu uvdin hu deziz name la live ella ki hechi delehve leh hekera
Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri ose mekom arbaa ummalle kasavri karmelit missefat mayya mashchinan mayya ara semichta i la aved mekom arbaa ka metaltel mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid

Amar leh rav nachman lerabba bar avuh ulrav huna deamar motzi hemenna ziz kol shehu ummalle zimnin deleka asara veka metaltel mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid amar leh gamrinan deen sefina mehallechet befachot measara veha mursha it lah amar rav safra gashoshe azli kammah

Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav chiyya bar avin lerav chisda ulrabba bar rav huna deamri ose mekom arbaa ummalle shofchin dideh hechi shade lehu vechi tema deshade lehu beoto makom meisi leh deshade lehu addufna disfina veha ika kocho kocho becharmelit la gezaru umna temra detanya sefina en metaltelin lo mittochah layyam velo min hayyam letochah

a: Rabbi yehuda omer amukka asara veen gevoha asara mittaltelin mittochah layyam aval lo min hayyam letochah may shena min hayyam letochah dela deka metaltelin mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid mittochah layyam name kamtaltel mershut hayyachid lecharmelit ella lav achuddah ushma minah kocho becharmelit la gezaru shema minah

Amar rav huna hane bitziyyata demeshan en metaltelin bahen ella bearba ammot vela amaran ella sheen befachot mishshelosha arbaa aval yesh befachot mishshelosha arbaa let lan bah vei melanhu kene veurbane let lan bah

Matkef lah rav nachman velema gud achet mechitzata mi la tanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer naatz kane birshut harabbim uvrosho teraskal vezarak venach al gabbav chayyav alma amrinan gud achet mechitzata hacha name nema gud achet mechitzata

Matkef lah rav yosef vela shemia lehu leha deamar rav yehuda amar rav umatu bah mishshum rabbi chiyya vetane alah vachachamim potrin amar leh abbaye veatte la tisbera vehatanya ammud birshut harabbim gavoha asara verachav arbaa veen beikaro arbaa veyesh bakkatzar shello shelosha vezarak venach al gabbav chayyav alma amrinan gud achet mechitzata hacha name gud achet mechitzata

a: Devarim sheen bene adam omdin alehem ella im ken nichshalim bahen yeshnan tachat yadecha katzin tihye lanu yissa vayyom hahu lemor lo ehye chovesh vego en yissa ella leshon shevua vechen hu omer lo tissa et shem Adonai lo ehye chovesh lo ehye mechovshe atzman bevet hammidrash uvveti en lechem veen simla sheen beyadi lo mikra velo mishna velo gemara umimmay dilma shane hatam dei amar lehu gemirna amaru leh ema lan hava leh lememar gemar ushchach may lo ehye chovesh kelal la kashya kan bedivre tora kan bemassa umattan
Matni matztzilin sal male kikkarot af al pi sheyyesh bo mea seudot veigul shel devela vechavit shel yayin veomer laacherim bou vehatztzilu lachem veim hau pikchin osin immo cheshbon achar hashshabbat

Lehechan matztzilin otan lechatzer hamorevet ben betira omer af lesheenah meorevet ulsham motzi kol kele tashmisho velovesh kol ma sheyyachol lilbosh veotef kol ma sheyyachol laatof rabbi yose omer shemona asar kelim vechozer velovesh umotzi veomer laacherim bou vehatztzilu immi

Gema veha tena leh resha shalosh seudot vetu la amar rav huna la kashya kan beva lehatztzil kan beva lekappel uva lehatztzil matztzil et kullan ba lekappel eno mekappel ella mezon shalosh seudot rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav ide veide bava lekappel vela kashya kan leotah chatzer kan lechatzer acheret bae rav huna bereh derav yehoshua peras tallito vekipel vehinniach vekipel vehinniach may keva lehatztzil dame o keva lekappel dame

Middeamar rava atayeh rav shezvi lerav chisda udrash uvilvad shello yavi keli shehu machazik yoter mishshalosh seudot shema minah keva lehatztzil dame veshappir dame amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava may tauta amar leh dekatane uvilvad shello yavi keli acher veyiklot keli acher vitzaref keli acher hu dela aval behahu mana kamma devae matztzil

Veigul shel devela ku cheshbon may avidteh mehefkera kazachu amar rav chisda middat chasidut shanu kan amar rava chaside agra deshabbeta shakli ella amar rava hacha bire shamayim askinan vela nicha leh delithane meacherim uvchinnam name la nicha leh delitrach vehachi kaamar veim hau pikchin deyadi dichhay gavena lav sechar shabbat hu osin immo cheshbon leachar hashshabbat

Ulhechan matztzilin ku may shena hacha dekatane lachem umay shena hacha dekatane immi amri gabbe mezonot katane lachem mishshum dela ka chaze ella mezon shalosh seudot aval gabbe levushim katane immi mishshum dekachaze leh lechulle yoma

Tanu rabbanan lovesh motzi ufoshet vechozer velovesh umotzi ufoshet vaafilu kol hayyom kullo divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer shemona asar kelim veellu hem shemona asar kelim miktoren unkele ufunda kalbos shel pishtan vechaluk veappilon umaporet ushne safrekin ushne minalim ushne anpilaot ushne pargod vachagor shebbemotnav vechova shebberosho vesudar shebbetzavaro

Matni rabbi shimon ben nannas omer porsin or shel gedi al gabbe shida teva umigdal sheachaz bahen et haur mippene shehu mecharech veosin mechitza bechol hakkelim ben melein ben rekanim bishvil shello taavor haddeleka rabbi yose oser bichle cheres chadashim melein mayim lefi sheen yecholin lekabbel et haur vehen mitbakkein umchabbin et haddeleka

Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav tallit sheachaz bah haur mitztzad echad notnin aleha mayim mitztzad acher veim kavta kavta metivi tallit sheachaz bah haur mitztzad echad poshtah umitkasse bah veim kavta kavta vechen sefer tora sheachaz bo haur poshto vekore bo veim kava kava
b: Hu deamar kerabbi shimon ben nannas

Emar deamar rabbi shimon ben nannas mippene shehu mecharech geram kibuy mi amar in middekatane sefa rabbi yose oser bichle cheres chadashim meleim mayim sheenan yecholim lekabbel et haur vehen mitbakkein umchabbin et haddeleka mikkelal detanna kamma share
Tanu rabbanan ner sheal gabbe tavla menaer et hattavla vehi nofelet veim kavta kavta amri deve rabbi yannay lo shanu ella beshocheach aval bemanniach naasa basis ledavar haasur

Tana ner sheachore haddelet poteach venoel kedarko veim kavta kavta layet alah rav amar leh ravina lerav acha bereh derava veamri lah rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe may tama layet alah rav ilema mishshum derav savar lah kerabbi yehuda vetana katane lah kerabbi shimon mishshum derav savar lah kerabbi yehuda kol detane kerabbi shimon melat layet leh
Amar leh beha afilu rabbi shimon mode deha abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut

Amar rav yehuda poteach adam delet keneged medura beshabbat layet alah abbaye bemay askinan ilema beruach metzuya may tameh deman deasar i beruach sheenah metzuya may tama deman deshare leolam beruach metzuya mar savar gazrinan umar savar la gazrinan

Osin mechitza ku lememra derabbanan savri geram kibbuy muttar verabbi yose savar geram kibbuy asur veha ipcha shaminan lehu detanya osin mechitza bechelim rekanin uvimlein sheen darkan lehishtabber veellu melein sheen darkan lehishtabber kele mattachot rabbi yose omer af kele kefar shichin uchle kefar chananya en darkan lehishtabber vechi tema efoch matnitin verabbi yose devarayeta ledivrehem kaamar umi matzet afchatte lah vehaamar rabba bar tachlifa mishshemeh derav man tana geram kibbuy asur rabbi yose

Ella leolam la tefoch uvarayeta kullah rabbi yose hi vechassore mechassera vehachi katane osin mechitza bechelim rekanin uvimleim sheen darkan lehishtabber veellu hen kelim sheen darkan lehishtabber kele mattachot uchle kefar shichin uchle kefar chananya name en darkan lehishtabber sherabbi yose omer af keli kefar shichin uchle kefar chananya en darkan lehishtabber

Verame derabbanan adderabbanan verame derabbi yose adderabbi yose detanya hare shehaya shem katuv lo al besaro hare ze lo yirchotz velo yasuch velo yaamod bimkom hattinofet nizdammena lo tevila shel mitzva korech aleha gemi veored vetovel rabbi yose omer leolam yored vetovel kedarko uvilvad shello yeshafshef
Shane hatam deamar kera veibbadtem et shemam min hammakom hahu lo taasun ken la elohechem asiyya hu deasur gerama shere
I hachi hacha name ketiv lo taase chol melacha asiyya hu deasur gerama shere mittoch sheadam bahul al mamono i sharet leh ate lechabboye
I hachi kashya derabbanan adderabbanan uma hatam deadam bahul al mamono shere hacha lo kol shekken

Vetisbera hay gemi hechi dame i demihaddak ka have chatzitza i la mihaddak ayeli beh mayya chatzitza tipok leh mishshum deo belacha detanya haddam vehaddeo haddevash vehechalav yeveshin chotztzin lachim en chotztzin mikkol makom kashya
Ella amar rava bar rav shela hayenu tamayehu derabbanan dekasavri asur laamod bifne hashshem arom mikkelal derabbi yose savar muttar laamod bifne hashshem arom demannach yedeh ilaveh
Lerabbanan name demannach yedeh ilaveh zimnin demishtele veshakel leh lerabbi yose name zimnin demishtele veshakel leh ella i deika gemi hachi name hacha bemay askinan lehaddore aggemi rabbanan savri

a: Tevila bizmannah lav mitzva umahderinan verabbi yose savar tevila bizmannah mitzva vela mahderinan

Vesavar rabbi yose tevila bizmannah mitzva vehatanya hazzav vehazzava hamtzora vehamtzoreet boel nidda utme met tevilatan bayyom nidda veoledet tevilatan ballayela baal keri tovel veholech kol hayyom kullo rabbi yose omer min hammincha ulmala eno tzarich litbol hahi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi deamar dayyah tevila baacharona
Matni goy shebba lechabbot en omrim lo kabbe veal techabbe mippene sheen shevitato alehen aval katan shebba lechabbot en shomin lo mippene sheshshevitato alehen

Gema amar rabbi amme bidleka hittiru lomar kol hamchabbe eno mafsid nema mesayya leh goy shebba lechabbot en omrim lo kabbe veal techabbe mippene sheen shevitato alehen kabbe hu dela amrinan leh ha kol hamchabbe eno mafsid amrinan leh ema sefa al techabbe la amrinan leh vechol hamchabbe eno mafsid name la amrinan leh ella meha leka lemishma minah

Tanu rabbanan maase venafla deleka bachatzero shel yosef ben simay beshichin uvau anshe gistera shel tzipori lechabbot mippene sheappitroppos shel melech haya velo hinnichan mippene kevod hashshabbat venaasa lo nes veyardu geshamim vechibu laerev shiger lechol echad mehen shette selain velaipparchos shebbahen chamishshim uchsheshshamu chachamim bedavar amru lo haya tzarich lechach shehare shaninu goy shebba lechabbot en omrim lo kabbe veal techabbe

Aval katan shebba lechabbot en shomin lo mippene sheshshevitato alehen shamatte minah katan ochel nevelot bet din metzuviyn alav lehafrisho amar rabbi yochanan bekatan haose ledaat aviv dichotah gabbe goy deka aved ledateh deyisrael mi shere goy ledateh denafsheh aved

Matni kofin keara al gabbe hanner bishvil shello teechoz bakkora veal tzoa shel katan veal akrav shello tishach amar rabbi yehuda maase ba lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay baarav veamar choshshani lo mechattat
Gema rav yehuda verav yirmeya bar abba verav chanan bar rava iklau leve avin demin neshikya lerav yehuda verav yirmeya bar abba
b: Ayeto lehu puryata lerav chanan bar rava la ayeto leh ashkecheh matne leh livreh veal tzoa shel katan mippene katan amar leh avin shatya matne shetuta livneh vahalo hi atzmah muchenet lichlavim vechi tema dela chazya leh meetmol vehatanya neharot hammoshchin umaayanot hannovin hare hen keragle kol adam
Veella hechi atneyeh ema al tzoa shel tarnegolim mippene katan

Vetipok leh dehave geraf shel rei vechi tema geraf shel rei aggav mana in ihu gufeh la veha hahu achbar deishtechach beisparmake derav ashe vaamar lehu niktuh betzutziteh veappekuh beashpa vekatan beashpa may bae leh bechatzer chatzer name geraf shel rei hu beashpa shebbechatzer

Veal akrav shello tishach amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol hammazzikin neheragin beshabbat metiv rav yosef chamishsha neheragin beshabbat veellu hen zevuv shebbeeretz mitzrayim vetzira shebbeninve veakrav shebbechadyav venachash shebbeeretz yisrael vechelev shote bechol makom manni ilema rabbi yehuda ha amar melacha sheenah tzericha legufah chayyav aleha ella lav rabbi shimon vehane hu deshare acharine la
Amar rabbi yirmeya uman nema lan deha metaratzta hi dilma meshabbashta hi amar rav yosef ana matnena lah veotevna lah vaana metaretzna lah beratzin acharav vedivre hakkol

Tane tanna kammeh derava bar rav huna hahoreg nechashim veakrabbim beshabbat en ruach chasidim nocha hemennu amar leh veotan chasidim en ruach chachamim nocha mehem ufliga derav huna derav huna chazyeh lehahu gavra deka katel zibura amar leh shallemtinhu lechullehu

Tanu rabbanan nizdammenu lo nechashim veakrabbim haragan beyadua shennizdammenu lo lehorgan lo haragan beyadua shennizdammenu lehorgo venaasa lo nes min hashshamayim amar ulla veitema rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan benishofin bo
Amar rabbi abba bar kahana paam achat nafal echad bevet hammidrash veamad nivetti echad vaharago amar rabbi paga bo kayyotze bo

Ibaya lehu paga bo kayyotze bo deshappir avad o la ta shema derabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba verabbi zera hao yatvi akkila deve rabbi yannay nefak milta mibbenayehu beo mineh merabbi yannay mahu laharog nechashim veakrabbim beshabbat amar lehu tzira ani horeg nachash veakrav lo kol shekken dilma lefi tummo daamar rav yehuda rok dorso lefi tummo veamar rav sheshet nachash dorso lefi tummo veamar rav kattina akrav dorso lefi tummo

Abba bar marta dehu abba bar minome hao masseki beh deve resh galuta zuze ayetuh ka metzaari leh hava shede rukka amar lehu resh galuta ayeto mana sechifu illaveh amar lehu la tzerichitu hachi amar rabbi yehuda rok dorso lefi tummo amar lehu tzurba merabbanan hu shivkuh
Amar rabbi abba bar kahana amar rabbi chanina pamotot shel bet rabbi muttar letaltelan beshabbat amar leh rabbi zera benitalin beyado achat o bishte yadayim

a: Amar leh keotan shel bet avicha
Veamar rabbi abba bar kahana amar rabbi chanina keronot shel bet rabbi muttar letaltelan beshabbat amar leh rabbi zera benitalin beadam echad o bishne bene adam amar leh keotan shel bet avicha
Veamar rabbi abba bar kahana hittir lahem rabbi chanina levet rabbi lishtot yayin bikronot shel goy bechotam echad vela yadana i mishshum desavar lah kerabbi eliezer i mishshum emta deve nesia

Matni goy shehidlik et hanner mishtammesh leoro yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur mile mayim lehashkot behemto mashke acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur asa goy kevesh lered bo yored acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur maase berabban gamliel uzkenim shehau bain bisfina veasa goy kevesh lered bo veyardu bo rabban gamliel uzkenim
Gema utzricha dei ashmeinan ner mishshum dener leechad ner lemea aval mayim ligzar dilma ate leapposhe bishvil yisrael vechevesh lema li maase derabban gamliel uzkenim ka mashma lan

Tanu rabbanan goy shelliket asavim maachil acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur mile mayim lehashkot behemto mashke acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur bamme devarim amurim sheen makkiro aval makkiro asur
Ini vehaamar rav huna amar rabbi chanina maamid adam behemto al gabbe asavim beshabbat aval lo al gabbe muktze beshabbat dekaem lah beappah veazla hi veachla
Amar mar bamme devarim amurim sheen makkiro aval makkiro asur ha rabban gamliel makkiro hava amar abbaye shello befanav hava rava amar afilu tema befanav ner leechad ner lemea
Metivi amar lahen rabban gamliel hoil veshello befanenu asao nered bo ema hoil vaasao nered bo

Ta shema ir sheyyisrael vegoyim darin betochah vehayeta bah merchatz hammarchetzet beshabbat im rov goyim muttar lirchotz bah miyyad im rov yisrael yamtin bichde sheyyechammu chammin hatam ki mechammemi addata derubba mechammemi
Ta shema ner haddaluk bimsiba im rov goyim muttar lehishtammesh leorah im rov yisrael asur mechetza al mechetza asur hatam name ki madleki
b: Addata derubba madleki
Shemuel ikla leve avi toran ata hahu goy adlek sheraga ahderinhu shemuel leappeh kevan dachaza deayeti shetar veka kare amar addata denafsheh hu deadlek ahderinhu ihu leappeh gabbe sheraga
Matni kol hakkelim nitalin bashshabbat vedaltotehen immahen af al pi shennitparku bashshabbat sheenan domin ledaltot habbayit lefi sheenan min hammuchan
Notel adam kurnas lefatztzea bo et haegozin kardom lachtoch bo et haddevela megera lagor bah et haggevina magrefa ligrof bah et haggerogrot
Et harachat veet hammalgez latet alav lekatan et hakkush veet hakkarker litchov bo machat shel yad litol bo et hakkotz veshel sakkaim liftoach bo et haddelet
Gema kol hakkelim nitalin veaf al pi shennitparku bashshabbat vela mibaya bechol
Adderabba bashshabbat muchanin al gabbe avihen bachol en muchanin al gabbe avihen
Amar abbaye hachi kaamar kol hakkelim nitalin bashshabbat vedaltotehen immahen af al pi shennitparku bachol nitalin bashshabbat
Tanu rabbanan delet shel shida veshel teva veshel migdal notlin aval lo machazirin veshel lul shel tarnegolim lo notlin velo machazirin
Bishlama shel lul shel tarnegolim kasavar kevan dimchabberi beara yesh binyan bekarka yesh setira bekarka ella shel shida veshel teva veshel migdal may kasavar
I kasavar yesh binyan bechelim yesh setira bechelim vei en setira bechelim en binyan bechelim
Amar abbaye leolam kasavar yesh binyan bechelim veyesh setira bechelim veshennitlu kaamar
Amar leh rava shette teshuvot baddavar chada denitalin katane veod may aval lo machazirin ella amar rava kasavar en binyan bechelim veen setira bechelim ugzera shemma yitka
Notel adam kurnas ku amar rav yehuda kurnas shel egozin lefatztzea bo et haegozin aval shel nappachin lo
Kasavar davar shemmelachto leisur afilu letzorech gufo asur
Amar leh rabba ella meatta sefa dekatane veet harachat veet hammalgez latet alav lekatan rachat umalgez mi meyachadi leh lekatan ella amar rabba kurnas shel nappachin lefatztzea bo haegozin
Kasavar

a: Davar shemmelachto leisur letzorech gufo muttar
Etiveh abbaye lerabba medocha im yesh bah shum metaltelin otah veim lav en metaltelin otah
Amar leh ha manni rabbi nechemya hi deamar en keli nital ella letzorech tashmisho
Etiveh bet shammay omrim en notlin et haeli lekatztzev alav basar uvet hillel mattirin veshavin sheim kitztzev alav basar sheasur letaltelo

Sevar leshannoye leh kerabbi nechemya kevan deshamah leha deamar rav chinana bar shelemya mishshemeh derav hakkol modim besike zeyare umazure dechevan dekafed alayehu meyached lehu makom ha name meyached lehu makom
Itmar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan kurnas shel zehavim shaninu rav shemen bar abba amar kurnas shel bassamim shaninu
Man deamar devassamim kol shekken dezehavim man deamar shel zehavim aval devassamim kafed alayehu
Veet hakkush veet hakkarker ku tanu rabbanan paga shettemanah beteven vacharara shettemanah begechalim im megulla miktzatah muttar letaltelah veim lav asur letaltelah
Rabbi elazar ben tadday omer tochavan bakkush o bakkarker vehen ninarot meelehen amar rav nachman halacha kerabbi elazar ben tadday
Lememra desavar rav nachman tiltul min hatztzad la shemeh tiltul vehaamar rav nachman hay pugla millemala lematta shere mimmatta lemala asir hadar beh rav nachman mehahi
Machat shel yad litol bah ku shelach leh rava bereh derabba lerav yosef yelammedenu rabbenu machat shennital chararah o uktzah mahu
Amar leh tenetuha machat shel yad litol bah et hakkotz vechi ma ichpat leh lakkotz ben nekuva leven sheenah nekuva
Etiveh machat shennital chararah o uktzah tehora
Amar abbaye tuma ashshabbat karamet tuma keli maase baenan leinyan shabbat mide dachaze baenan veha name chazya lemishkal bah kotz
Amar rava man dekamotev shappir kamotev middilinyan tuma lav mana hu leinyan shabbat name lav mana hu
Metivi machat ben nekuva ben sheenah nekuva muttar letaltelah beshabbat velo amru nekuva ella leinyan tuma bilvad
Targemah abbaye alliba derava begulme askinan zimnin demimlich alayehu umshave lehu mana aval hecha denital chararah o uktzah adam zorkah leven gerutaot
Assove yanoka rav nachman asar verav sheshet share amar rav nachman mena amena lah ditnan en osin
b: Appiktevizin bashshabbat verav sheshet hatam lav orcheh hacha orcheh
Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah ditnan machat shel yad litol bah et hakkotz verav nachman hatam pekid hacha la pekid
Matni kane shel zetim im yesh kesher berosho mekabbel tuma veim lav en mekabbel tuma ben kach uven kach nital bashshabbat
Gema ammay peshute chele etz hu ufshute chele etz enan mekabbelin tuma may tama dumya desak baenan tana mishshemeh derabbi nechemya beshaa shemmehappech bezetim hofcho veroe bo
Matni rabbi yose omer kol hakkelim nitalin chutz min hammassar haggadol veyated shel macharesha
Gema amar rav nachman hay uchla dekatztzare keyated shel macharesha damya
Amar abbaye charba deushkafe vesakkina deashkavta vachatzina denaggare keyated shel macharesha dame

Tanu rabbanan barishona hau omrim shelosha kelim nitalin bashshabbat miktzoa shel devela vezuhama listeron shel kedera vesakkin ketanna sheal gabbe shulchan hittiru vechazru vehittiru vechazru vehittiru ad sheamru kol hakkelim nitalin bashshabbat chutz min massar haggadol veyated shel macharesha
May hittiru vechazru vehittiru vechazru vehittiru

Amar abbaye hittiru davar shemmelachto leheter letzorech gufo vechazru vehittiru davar shemmelachto leheter letzorech mekomo vechazru vehittiru davar shemmelachto leisur letzorech gufo in letzorech mekomo la vaadayin beyado achat in bishte yadav la ad sheamru kol hakkelim nitalin bashshabbat vaafilu bishte yadayim

Amar leh rava mikkede hittiru katane ma li letzorech gufo ma li letzorech mekomo ella amar rava hittiru davar shemmelachto leheter ben letzorech gufo uven letzorech mekomo vechazru vehittiru mechamma latztzel vechazru vehittiru davar shemmelachto leisur letzorech gufo ultzorech mekomo in mechamma latztzel la vaadayin beadam echad in bishne bene adam la ad sheamru kol hakkelim nitalin bashshabbat afilu bishne bene adam

Etiveh abbaye medocha im yesh bah shum metaltelin otah veim lav en metaltelin otah hacha bemay askinan mechamma latztzel etiveh veshavin sheim kitztzev alav basar sheasur letaltelo hacha name mechamma latztzel
Amar rabbi chanina bime nechemya ben chachalya nishnet mishna zo dichtiv bayyamim hahemma raiti vihuda dorchim gittot bashshabbat umviim haaremot
Amar rabbi elazar kanin umaklot gelustera umdocha kullan kodem hattarat kelim nishnu
Kanin ditnan lo sidur hakkanin velo netilatan docha et hashshabbat
Maklot ditnan maklot dakkin chalakin hau sham umannicho al ketefo veal ketef chavero vetole umafshit amar rabbi elazar arbaa asar shechal lihot beshabbat manniach

Gema may letzorech umay shello letzorech

Ella amar rava letzorech davar shemmelachto leheter ben letzorech gufo ben letzorech mekomo shello letzorech vaafilu mechamma latztzel vedavar shemmelachto leisur letzorech gufo ultzorech mekomo in mechamma latztzel la vaata rabbi nechemya lememar vaafilu davar shemmelachto leheter letzorech gufo ultzorech mekomo in mechamma latztzel la
Yatev rav safra verav acha bar huna verav huna bar chanina veyatvi vekaamri lerabba alliba derabbi nechemya hane kearot hechi metaltelinan amar lehu rav safra mide dehave aggeraf shel rei
Amar leh abbaye lerabba lemar alliba derabbi nechemya hane kearot hechi metaltelinan lehu amar leh rav safra chavrin targemah mide dehave aggeraf shel rei

Etiveh abbaye medocha im yesh bah shum metaltelin otah veim lav en metaltelin otah hacha bemay askinan mechamma latztzel etiveh veshavin sheim kitztzev alav basar sheasur letaltelo hacha name mechamma latztzel

Veha ditnan en somchin et hakkedera bivkaat vechen baddelet veha bekaat divom tov davar shemmelachto leheter hu alma davar shemmelachto leheter ben letzorech gufo ben letzorech mekomo asur hatam may tama kevan divshabbat davar shemmelachto leisur hu gezera yom tov attu shabbat
Vechi tema shabbat gufeh tishtere deha davar shemmelachto leisur letzorech gufo ultzorech mekomo shere hane mile hecha deika torat keli alav hecha deleka torat keli alav la
Umi gazrinan vehatnan mashshilin perot derech arubba beom tov aval lo beshabbat
Umi la gazrinan vehatnan en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad

b: En motziin et hakkatan veet hallulav veet sefer tora lirshut harabbim uvet hillel mattirin

Ini veha rav kahana ikla leve rav vaamar ayeto leh shuta lechahana litiv alah lav lememra dedavar shemmelachto leisur letzorech gufo in letzorech mekomo la
Hachi amar lehu shekulu shuta mikkamme kahana vei baet ema hatam mechamma latztzel hava

Rav mari bar rachel hava leh hahu be sadyevata beshimsha ata lekammeh derava amar leh mahu letaltolinhu amar leh shere it li acharina chazu leorchin it li name leorchim amar leh gallit addatach dichrabba sevira lach lechulle alma shere ledidach asir
Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi chiyya bar ashe amar rav machbedot shel melat muttar letaltelan beshabbat aval shel temara la

Rabbi elazar omer af shel temara bemay askinan ilema letzorech gufo ultzorech mekomo beha lema rav shel temara la veha rav kerava sevira leh ella mechamma latztzel beha lema rabbi elazar af shel temara leolam mechamma latztzel ema vechen amar rabbi elazar
Matni kol hakkelim hannitalin bashshabbat shivrehen nitalin immahen uvilvad sheyehu osin meen melacha
Shivre areva lechassot bahen et pi hechavit shivre zechuchit lechassot bahen et pi happach
Rabbi yehuda omer bilvad sheyehu osin meen melachtan shivre areva latzuk letochan mikpa veshel zechuchit latzuk letochan shemen
Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel machaloket shennishberu meerev shabbat demar savar meen melachtan in meen melacha acheret la umar savar afilu meen melacha acheret
Aval nishberu beshabbat divre hakkol muttarin hoil umuchanin al gabbe avihen muttar
Motev rav zutra massikin bechelim veen massikin beshivre chelim
Denishberu emat ilema denishberu meerev yom tov etzim bealma ninhu ella lav beom tov vekatane massikin bechelim veen massikim beshivre chelim

Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav yehuda amar shemuel machaloket shennishberu beshabbat demar savar muchan hu umar savar nolad hu aval meerev shabbat divre hakkol muttarin hoil vehuchnu limlacha mibbeod yom
Tane chada massikin bechelim veen massikin beshivre chelim vetanya idach keshem shemmassikin bechelim kach massikin beshivre chelim vetanya idach en massikin lo bechelim vela beshivre chelim
Ha rabbi yehuda ha rabbi shimon ha rabbi nechemya

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel cheres ketanna muttar letaltelah bechatzer aval becharmelit lo verav nachman dideh amar afilu becharmelit aval birshut harabbim lo verava amar afilu birshut harabbim

a: Im zerakah mibbeod yom leashpa asura

Amar bar hamdure amar shemuel kerumiyyot shel machtzelet muttar letaltelan beshabbat may tama amar rava bar hamdure asberah li machtzelet gufah lemay chazya lechassoye bah afra hane name chazyan lechassoye behu tinufa
Amar rabbi zera amar rav sheyare peruzmaot asur letaltelan beshabbat amar abbaye bematlaniyyot sheen bahen shalosh al shalosh dela chazyan la laaniyyim vela laashirim

Tanu rabbanan shivre tannur yashan hare hen kechol hakkelim hannitalin bechatzer divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer en nitalin heid rabbi yose mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov al shivre tannur yashan shennitalin bashshabbat veal kisuo sheeno tzarich bet yad
Bemay kamipalgi amar abbaye beosin meen melacha veen osin meen melachtan kamipalgi veazda rabbi yehuda letameh verabbi meir letameh
Matkif lah rava i hachi addemipalgi beshivre tannur lipalgu beshivre chelim bealma

Ella amar rava beshivre dehay tannur kamipalgi ditnan netano al pi habbor o al pi haddut venatan sham even rabbi yehuda omer im massik millematta vehu nissok millemala tame veim lav tahor vachachamim omrim hoil vehussak mikkol makom tame

Uvmay kamipalgi behay kera tannur vechirayim yuttatz temeim hem utmeim yihu lachem rabbi yehuda savar mechussar netitza tame sheen mechussar netitza tahor verabbanan savri temeim yihu lachem mikkol makom
Verabbanan name hachtiv yuttatz hahu leidach gisa desalka datach amena kevan dechabbereh beara kegufa deara dame ka mashma lan
Veidach name hachtiv temeim yihu lachem hahi kidrav yehuda amar shemuel deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel machaloket behesek rishon aval behesek sheni afilu taluy betzavar gamal
Amar ulla vehesek rishon lerabbanan afilu taluy betzavar gamal
Matkef lah rav ashe i hachi addemipalgi beshivre tannur lipalgu betannur gufeh hashta tannur gufeh lerabbi yehuda la have mana shevarav mibaya
Ella amar rav ashe leolam kedaamaran meikara uvose maase tafka verabbi meir lidvarav derabbi yehuda kaamar ledidi afilu beosin meen melacha ella ledidach odi li miha dichhay gavena melachto hu
Verabbi yehuda la dame hatam hesseko mibbifnim hacha hesseko mibbachutz hatam meummad hacha lav meummad

Heid rabbi yose mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov al shivre tannur yashan shennitalin bashshabbat veal kisuo sheeno tzarich bet yad amar ravina keman metaltelinan haidana kisuy detannure demata machseya deen lahem bet achiza keman kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov
Matni haeven shebbekeruya im memallein bah veenah nofelet memallein bah veim lav en memallein bah
b: Zemora shehi keshura battafiach memallein bah beshabbat
Pekak hachallon rabbi eliezer omer bizman shehu kashur vetaluy pokkin bo veim lav en pokkin bo vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach pokkin bo

Gema tenan hatam even sheal pi hechavit mattah al tzidah vehi nofelet amar rabba amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella beshocheach aval bemanniach naasa basis ledavar haasur verav yosef amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella beshocheach aval bemanniach naasa kisuy lechavit
Amar rabba motvinan ashshematin haeven shebbekeruya im memallein bah veenah nofelet memallein bah vela hi hatam kevan dehaddekah shavveyah dofen
Amar rav yosef umotvinan ashshematin im lav en memallein bah vela hi hatam kevan dela haddekah battole battelah
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar baenan maase umar savar la baenan maase

Rabbi yochanan amar hitzrichan rabbi lemaase may amar lehu rabbi amme amar tzeu velammedum amar lehu rabbi assi amar tzeu veshafshefum amar lehu
Itmar rabbi yose ben shaul amar sevar shel korot hava verabbi yochanan ben shaul amar gashosh shel sefina hava man daamar gashosh kol shekken sevar uman deamar sevar aval gashosh kafed aleh
Zemora shehi keshura ku keshura in lo keshura la lema matnitin dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Detanya chariyyot shel dekel sheggedaran leetzim venimlach alehen lishiva tzarich likshor rabban shimon ben gamliel omer en tzarich likshor

Amar rav sheshet afilu tema rabban shimon ben gamliel hacha bemay askinan bimchubberet beibbeha i hachi ka mishtammesh bimchubbar lakkarka lematta mishshelosha rav ashe amar afilu tema bitlusha gezera shemma yiktom

Pekak hachallon ku amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim sheen osin ohel aray battechilla beom tov veen tzarich lomar beshabbat lo nechleku ella lehosif sherabbi eliezer omer en mosifin beom tov veen tzarich lomar beshabbat vachachamim omrim mosifin beshabbat veen tzarich lomar beom tov
Vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach pokkin bo may ben kach uven kach amar rabbi abba amar rav kahana

Vetanya ezehu neger hannigrar shennoalin bo bammikdash aval lo bimdina kol shekkashur vetaluy verosho maggia laaretz rabbi yehuda omer ze af bammedina muttar ella ezehu shebbammedina asur kol sheeno lo kashur vela taluy veshomto umannicho bekeren zavit
Veamar rabbi yehoshua bar abba mishshemeh deulla man tanna neger hannigrar rabbi eliezer hi

Amar leh ana daamari ki hay tanna detanya kane shehitkino baal habbayit lihot poteach venoel bo bizman shekkashur vetaluy bappetach poteach venoel bo en kashur vetaluy en poteach venoel bo rabban shimon ben gamliel omer metukkan af al pi sheeno kashur
Amar rav yehuda bar shilat amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehatnan kol kissuye hakkelim
b: Sheyyesh lahem bet achiza nitalin bashshabbat veamar rav yehuda bar shela amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan vehu sheyyesh torat keli alehen

Vechi tema hacha name deika torat keli alav umi bae rabban shimon ben gamliel torat keli alav vehatanya chariyyot shel dekel sheggedaran leshem etzim venimlach alehen lishiva tzarich lekashsher rabban shimon ben gamliel omer en tzarich lekashsher

Derash rabbi yitzchak nappacha appitcha deresh galuta halacha kerabbi eliezer metiv rav amram umiddivrehem lamadnu sheppokkin umoddin vekoshrin beshabbat
Amar leh abbaye may datach mishshum dekatane setama neger hannigrar name setama hi vaafilu hachi maase rav
Matni kol kisuye hakkelim sheyyesh lahem bet achiza nitalin bashshabbat amar rabbi yose bamme devarim amurim bechisuy karkaot aval bechisuy hakkelim ben kach uven kach nitalin bashshabbat

Gema amar rav yehuda bar shela amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan vehu sheyyesh torat keli alehen dechulle alma kissuy karkaot im yesh lahen bet achiza in i la la kissuy hakkelim af al gav deen lahem bet achiza
Ki peligi bechelim dechabberinhu beara mar savar gazrinan umar savar la gazrinan
Lishana acharina ki peligi bechisuy tannur mar medamme leh lechisuy karka umar medamme leh lechisuy kelim
Matni mefannin afilu arba vechamesh kuppot shel teven veshel tevua mippene haorchim umippene bittul bet hammidrash aval lo et haotzar
Mefannin teruma tehora udmay umaaser rishon shennitlah terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu vehattormos hayyavesh mippene shehu maachal leizzim

Aval lo et hattevel velo et maaser rishon shello nittela terumato velo et maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu velo et halluf vela et hachardal rabbi shimon ben gamliel mattir balluf mippene shehu maachal orvin
Chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradim im hitkinan lemaachal behema metaltelin otan veim lav en metaltelin otan

Amar rav chisda arba mechamesh ika deamri arba meotzar katan vechamesh meotzar gadol
Umay aval lo et haotzar shello yatchil baotzar techilla umanni rabbi yehuda hi deit leh muktze
Ushmuel amar arba vechamesh

a: Kidamri inashe vei bae afilu tuva name mefannin umay aval lo et haotzar shello yigmor kullo dilma ate leashoye gummot aval atchole matchil umanni rabbi shimon hi delet leh muktze
Tanu rabbanan en matchilin baotzar techila aval ose bo shevil kede sheyyikkanes veyetze ose bo shevil veha amratte en matchilin hachi kaamar ose bo shevil beraglav bichnisato uvitziato

Tanu rabbanan tevua tzevura bizman shehitchil bah meerev shabbat muttar lehistappek mimmenna beshabbat veim lav asur lehistappek mimmenna beshabbat divre rabbi shimon rabbi acha mattir kelappe leya ella ema divre rabbi acha verabbi shimon mattir
Tana kamma shiur tevua tzevura letech bea mineh rav nechumi bar zecharya meabbaye shiur tevua tzevura bechamma amar leh hare amru shiur tevua tzevura letech
Ibaya lehu hane arba vechamesh kuppot dekaamar bearba vechamesh kuppot in tefe la alma lemaote behilucha adif o dilma lemaote massoy adif

Ta shema detane chada mefannin afilu arba vechamesh kuppot shel kadde shemen veshel kadde yayin vetanya idach beeser uvachamesh esre may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar maote behilucha adif umar savar maote bemassoy adif

La dechulle alma maote behilucha adif umi savratte beeser uvachamesh esre akkuppot kae akkaddin kae vela kashya ha demishtakli chad chad bekuppa veha demishtakli tere tere veha demishtakli telata telata uvidkure deharpanya

Ibaya lehu hane arba vechamesh dekaamar af al gav deit leh orchin tuva o dilma hakkol lefi haorchin veim timtze lomar hakkol lefi haorchin chad gavra mefanne lechullehu o dilma gavra gavra mefanne lenafsheh

Ta shema deamar rabba amar rabbi chiyya paam achat halach rabbi lemakom echad veraa makom dachuk lattalmidim veyatza lassade umatza sade melea omarim veimer rabbi kol hassade kullah shema minah hakkol lefi haorchin

Verav yosef amar rabbi hoshaya paam achat halach rabbi chiyya lemakom echad veraa makom dachuk lattalmidim veyatza lassade umatza sade melea omarim veimer rabbi chiyya kol hassade kullah shema minah hakkol lefi haorchin
Vaadayin tibbee lach chad gavra mefanne leh lechullehu o dilma kol gavra vegavra mefanne lenafsheh
Ta shema veimer rabbi ultamach rabbi bedinfasheha imer ella tziva veimer ulolam kol chad vechad mefanne lenafsheh

Mippene haorchin vechu amar rabbi yochanan gedola hachnasat orchin kehashkamat bet hammidrash dekatane mippene haorchin umippene bittul bet hammidrash verav dimi minnehardea amar yoter mehashkamat bet hammidrash dekatane mippene haorchin vahadar umippene bittul bet hammidrash amar rav yehuda amar rav gedola hachnasat orchin mehakbalat pene shechina dichtiv vayyomar Adonai im na matzati chen beenecha al na taavor vego amar rabbi elazar bo ure shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam middat basar vedam en katan yachol lomar laggadol hamten ad sheavo etzlecha veilu behakkadosh baruch hu ketiv vayyomar Adonai im na matzati vego

Amar rav yehuda bar shela amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan shishsha devarim adam ochel perotehen baolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba veellu hen hachnasat orchin uvikur cholim veiyyun tefilla vehashkamat bet hammidrash vehamgaddel banav letalmud tora vehaddan et chavero lechaf zechut

Ini veha anan tenan ellu devarim sheadam ose otam veochel perotehen baolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba veellu hen kibud av vaem ugmilut chasadim vahavaat shalom shebben adam lachavero vetalmud tora keneged kullam hane in mide acharina la
b: Hane name bigmilut chasadim shayechi lishana acharina hane behane shayechi

Tanu rabbanan haddan chavero lechaf zechut danin oto lizchut umaase beadam echad sheyyarad miggalil haelon veniskar etzel baal habbayit echad baddarom shalosh shanim erev yom hakkippurim amar lo ten li sechari veelech veazun et ishti uvanay amar lo en li maot amar lo ten li perot amar lo en li ten li karka en li ten li behema en li ten li karim uchsatot en li hifshil kelav laachorav vehalach leveto befache nefesh

Leachar haregel natal baal habbayit secharo beyado veimmo massoy shelosha chamorim echad shel maachal veechad shel mishte veechad shel mine megadim vehalach lo leveto achar sheachlu veshatu natan lo secharo

Amar lo beshaa sheamarta li ten li sechari veamarti en li maot bamme chashadtani amarti shemma perakmatya bezol nizdammena lecha velakachta bahen uvshaa sheamarta li ten li behema veamarti en li behema bamme chashadtani amarti shemma muskeret beyad acherim beshaa sheamarta li ten li karka veamarti lecha en li karka bamme chashadtani amarti shemma muchkeret beyad acherim hi uvshaa sheamarti lecha en li perot bamme chashadtani amarti shemma enan meussarot uvshaa sheamarti lecha en li karim uchsatot bamme chashadtani amarti shemma hikdish kal nechasav lashshamayim

Amar lo haavoda kach haya hiddarti kol nechasay bishvil hurkanos beni shello asak battora uchshebbati etzel chaveray baddarom hittiru li kal nedaray veatta keshem sheddantani lizchut hammakom yadin otcha lizchut
Tanu rabbanan maase bechasid echad sheppada riva achat bat yisrael velammalon hishkivah tachat margelotav lemachar yarad vetaval veshana letalmidav
Veamar lahen beshaa shehishkavtiha tachat margelotay bamme chashadtuni amarnu shemma yesh banu talmid sheeno baduk lerabbi

Beshaa sheyyaradti vetavalti bamme chashadtuni amarnu shemma mippene torach hadderech era keri lerabbi amar lahem haavoda kach haya veattem keshem sheddantuni lechaf zechut hammakom yadin etchem lechaf zechut
Tanu rabbanan paam achat hutzrach davar echad letalmide chachamim etzel matronita achat shekkol gedole romi metzuyin etzlah amru mi yelech amar lahem rabbi yehoshua ani elech
Halach rabbi yehoshua vetalmidav kevan shehiggia lefetach betah chalatz tefilav berichuk arba ammot venichnas venaal haddelet bifnehen achar sheyyatza yarad vetaval veshana letalmidav
Veamar lahen beshaa shechalatzti tefilin bamme chashadtuni amarnu kesavur rabbi lo yikkansu divre kedushsha bimkom tuma
Beshaa shennaalti bamme chashadtuni amarnu shemma devar malchut yesh beno levenah
Beshaa sheyyaradti vetavalti bamme chashadtuni amarnu shemma nitza tzinora mippiha al begadav shel rabbi amar lahem haavoda kach haya veattem keshem sheddantuni lizchut hammakom yadin etchem lizchut
Mefannin teruma tehora vechu peshita la tzericha demannecha beyad yisrael mahu detema kevan dela chazya leh asur ka mashma lan kevan dechazya lechohen shappir dame
