Umaaser rishon shennitla terumato vechu peshita la tzericha shehikdimo beshibbolim venittela hemennu terumat maaser velo nittela hemennu teruma gedola

Vechi ha deamar rabbi avahu amar resh lakish maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibbolin patur mitteruma gedola shenneemar vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai maaser min hammaaser maaser min hammaaser amarti lecha velo teruma gedola utrumat maaser min hammaaser

Umaaser sheni vechu peshita la tzericha shennatan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh ha ka mashma lan deen chomesh meakkev
Vehattormos hayyavesh ku daveka yavesh aval lach la may tama kevan demarir la achla

Velo et maaser sheni vechu peshita la tzericha denifdu velo nifdu kehilchatan maaser sheppedao al gabbe asimon derachamana amar vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha davar sheyyesh bo tzura hekdesh shechillo al gabbe karka derachamana amar venatan hakkesef vekam lo

Velo et halluf tanu rabbanan metaltelin et hechatzav mippene shehu maachal litzvayim veet hachardal mippene shehu maachal leonim rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af metaltelin shivre zechuchit mippene shehu maachal lenaamiyyot
Amar leh rabbi natan ella meatta chavile zemorot yetaltelu mippene shehu maachal lefilin verabban shimon ben gamliel naamiyyot shechichi pilin la shechichi

Amar ammemar vehu deit leh naamiyyot amar rav ashe leammemar ella dekaamar leh rabbi natan lerabban shimon ben gamliel chavile zemorot yetaltel mippene shehu maachal lefilin i it leh pilin ammay la ella rauy hacha name rauy
Amar abbaye rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi shimon verabbi yishmael verabbi akiva kullehu sevira lehu kol yisrael bene melachim hem
Rabban shimon ben gamliel ha daamaran
Rabbi shimon ditnan bene melachim sachin al gabbe makkotehen shemen vered shekken darkan shel bene melachim lasuch bachol rabbi shimon omer kol yisrael bene melachim hem

Rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva detanya hare shehau noshin bo elef mane velavush itztela bat mea mane mafshitin oto umalbishin oto itztela haruya lo tana mishshum rabbi yishmael umishshum rabbi akiva kol yisrael reuyin leotah itztela

Chavile kash vachavile ku tanu rabbanan chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradim im hitkinan lemaachal behema metaltelin otan veim lav en metaltelin otan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer chavilin hannitalin beyad achat muttar letaltelan bishte yadayim asur letaltelan
Chavile sia ezov vekoranit hichnisan leetzim en mistappek mehen beshabbat lemaachal behema mistappek mehen beshabbat

Vekotem bayyad veochel uvilvad shello yiktom bichli umolel veochel uvilvad shello yimlol bichli harbe divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim molel berashe etzbeotav veochel uvilvad shello yimlol beyado harbe kederech shehu ose bachol
Vechen beammita vechen befegam vechen bishar mine tavlin may ammita ninya sia amar rav yehuda sia tzitri ezov avrata koranit koranita shemah
Veha hahu daamar lehu man bae koranita veishtechach chashe ella sia tzitri ezov avrata koranita chashe
Itmar basar maliach muttar letaltelo beshabbat basar tafel rav huna amar muttar letaltelo rav chisda amar asur letaltelo
Rav huna amar muttar letaltelo veha rav huna talmid derav hava verav kerabbi yehuda sevira leh deit leh muktze
Bemuktze laachila savar lah kerabbi yehuda bemuktze letaltel savar lah kerabbi shimon

Rav chisda amar asur letaltelo veha rav yitzchak bar amme ikla leve rav chisda vachaza hahu bar aoza dahao ka metaltelu leh mishshimsha letulla veamar rav chisda chesron kis ka chazenan hacha shane bar aoza dachaze leumtza
Tanu rabbanan dag maliach muttar letaltelo dag tafel asur letaltelo basar ben tafel uven maliach muttar letaltelo ustama kerabbi shimon
Tanu rabbanan metaltelin et haatzamot mippene shehu maachal lichlavim
b: Basar tafuach mippene shehu maachal lechayya mayim megullin mippene shehen reuyin lechatul rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol atzman asur leshahotan mippene hassakkana
Matni kofin et hassal lifne haefrochim kede sheyyaalu veyerdu tarnegolet shebbarcha dochin otah ad shettikkanes
Medaddin agalin usyachin ishsha medadda et benah amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shehu notel achat umanniach achat aval im haya gorer asur
Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav behema shennafla leammat hammayim mevi karim uchsatot umanniach tachteha veim alta alta
Metivi behema shennafla leammat hammayim ose lah parnasa bimkomah bishvil shello tamut parnasa in karim uchsatot la
La kashya ha deefshar befarnasa ha dei efshar befarnasa efshar befarnasa in vei la mevi karim uchsatot umanniach tachteha
Veha ka mevattel keli mehecheno savar mevattel keli mehecheno derabbanan tzaar baale chayyim deorayeta veate deorayeta vedache derabbanan
Tarnegolet shebbarcha vechu dochin in medaddin la tenena leha detanu rabbanan medaddin behema chayya vaof bechatzer aval lo et hattarnegolet
Tarnegolet may tama la amar abbaye mishshum demakpeya nafshah

Tane chada medaddin behema vechayya vaof bechatzer aval lo birshut harabbim vehaishsha medadda et benah birshut harabbim veen tzarich lomar bechatzer vetanya idach en okrin behema vechayya vaof bechatzer aval dochin bahen sheyyikkansu
Ha gufa kashya amratte en okrin aval daddoye medaddinan hadar amratte dochin in medaddin la amar abbaye sefa atan letarnegolet
Amar abbaye hay man deshachet tarnegolta lichbeshinhu lechareh beara i name nedel lehu medel dedilma mannach lehu letufreh beara veakar lehu lesimanim

Matni en meyalledin et habbehema beom tov aval mesaadin umyalledin et haishsha beshabbat vekorin lah chachama mimmakom lemakom umchallelin aleha et hashshabbat vekoshrin et hattibur rabbi yose omer af chotchin vechol tzorche mila osin beshabbat
Gema ketzad mesaadin rav yehuda amar ochez et havalad shello yippol laaretz rav nachman amar dochek babbasar kede sheyyetze havalad
Tanya keoteh derav yehuda ketzad mesaadin ochazin et havalad shello yippol laaretz venofeach lo bechotmo venoten lo dad letoch piv kede sheyyinak

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel merachamin hayinu al behema tehora beom tov hechi aved amar abbaye mevi bul shel melach umanniach lah betoch harechem kede shettizkor tzaarah utrachem alav umzallefin me shilya al gabbe valad kede shettariach recho utrachem alav vedaveka tehora aval temea la
May tama temea la merachaka velada vei merachaka velada la mekarva
Meyalledin et haishsha vechu mikkede tena leh meyalledin et haishsha vekorin lah chachama mimmakom lemakom umchallelin aleha et hashshabbat leetoye may

Leetoye ha detanu rabbanan im hayeta tzericha lener chavertah madleket lah et hanner veim hayeta tzericha leshemen chavertah mevia lah shemen bayyad veim eno sofek bayyad mevia bisarah veim eno sofek bisarah mevia lah bichli

Amar mar im hayeta tzericha lener chavertah madleket lah et hanner peshita la tzericha besuma mahu detema kevan dela chazya asir ka mashma lan iyyattove miyyatteva datah savra i ika mide chazya chavirtay veavda li
Im hayeta tzericha leshemen vechu tipok leh mishshum sechita
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu en sechita besear rav ashe amar afilu tema yesh sechita besear mevia lah bichli derech searah dechamma deefshar leshannoye meshanninan
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel chayya kol zeman shehakkever patuach ben amra tzericha ani ben lo amra tzericha ani mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat
Nistam hakkever ben amra

a: Tzericha ani ben lo amra tzericha ani en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat

Rav ashe matne hachi mar zutra matne hachi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel chayya kol zeman shehakkever patuach ben amra tzericha ani uven amra en tzericha ani mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat nistam hakkever amra tzericha ani mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat lo amra tzericha ani en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat
Amar leh ravina lemarimar mar zutra matne lekulla verav ashe matne lechumra hilcheta keman amar leh halacha kemar zutra safek nefashot lehakel
Meematay petichat hakkever amar abbaye mishshaa shetteshev al hammashber rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar mishshaa shehaddam shotet veored veamri lah mishshaa shechavroteha nosot otah baagappeha
Ad matay petichat hakkever amar abbaye shelosha yamim rava amar mishshemeh derav yehuda shiva veamri lah sheloshim

Amri nehardae chayya shelosha shiva ushloshim shelosha ben amra tzericha ani uven amra lo tzericha ani mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat shiva amra tzericha ani mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat amra lo tzericha ani en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat sheloshim afilu amra tzericha ani en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat aval osin al yede armay
Kidrav ulla bereh derav ilay deamar kol tzorche chole naasin al yede armay beshabbat vechidrav hamnuna deamar rav hamnuna davar sheen bo sakkana omer legoy veose
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lechayya sheloshim yom lemay hilcheta amri nehardae litvila

Amar rava la amaran ella sheen balah immah aval balah immah balah mechammema ki ha divratte derav chisda tevala bego telatin yomin shello bifne balah veitzteniat veamteuha learsah batreh derava lefumbedita

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel osin medura lechayya beshabbat bimot haggeshamim sevur mina lechayya in lachole la bimot haggeshamim in bimot hachamma la vela hi la shena chayya vela shena chole la shena bimot haggeshamim vela shena bimot hachamma middeittemar amar rav chiyya bar avin amar shemuel hikkiz dam venitztannen osin lo medura afilu bitkufat tammuz
Shemuel tzallachu leh tachtaka deshaga rav yehuda tzallachu leh patura deona lerabba tzallachu leh sharshifa
Vaamar leh abbaye lerabba veha kaavar mar mishshum bal tashchit amar leh bal tashchit degufay adif li
Amar rav yehuda amar rav leolam yimkor adam korot beto veyikkach minalim leraglav hikkiz dam veen lo ma yochal yimkor minalim shebberaglav veyaspik mehen tzorche seuda
May tzorche seuda rav amar basar ushmuel amar yayin rav amar basar nafsha chalaf nafsha ushmuel amar yayin summaka chalaf summaka
Siman shennimsar

Shemuel beoma daavad milta avdi leh tavshila ditchale rabbi yochanan shate ad denafek tihya meunneh verav nachman shate ad dekafe techaleh rav yosef shate ad denafek merivda dechusilta rava mehaddar achamra bar telata tarfe
Amar lehu rav nachman bar yitzchak lerabbanan bematuta minayechu beoma dehakkaza emaru levetayechu nachman ikkela legabban

Vechullehu iarome asiri bar mehay orma dishre man deaved milta vela efshar leh lishkol zuza macha velezil leshav chanvata ad detaem shiur reviata vei la lechol shav tamre ukkamata veleshuf mishcha betzideh venigne beshimsha
Avlet ashkecheh lishmuel degane beshimsha amar leh chakkima dihudae bisha mi have tava amar leh yoma dehakkaza hu
Vela hi ella ika yoma dimalle beh shimsha bechullah shatta yoma denafla beh tekufat tammuz vesavar la egalle leh
Hekel beruach tama shaha siman rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kol hammakkel bisudat hakkazat dam mekilin lo mezonotav min hashshamayim veomrim hu al chayyav lo chas ani achus alav
Rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu hay man deaved milta la litiv hecha dichrich zika dilma shafe leh ummana umokem leh arvieta veate zika veshaef mineh veate lide sakkana
Shemuel hava regil deaved milta beveta deshav livne vearcha yoma chada avad veargish benafsheh bedak vachasar chad archa
Rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu hay man deaved milta litom mide vahadar lipok dei la taem mide i paga beshachva yarki appeh i paga beman dekatel nafsha mayet i paga
b: Bedavar acher kashe ledavar acher

Amar shemuel pursa didma kol telatin yomin uven happerakim yemaet uven happerakim yachzor vimaet
