Ibaya lehu achila ad chatzi mil hu dekamalle ha batar hachi umikkamme hachi kashe o dilma la kashe vela mealle teku
Machriz rav mea kare bezuza mea reshe bezuza mea sefame vela chelum amar rav yosef ki havenan be rav huna yoma dimfaggeri beh rabbanan amri haidana yoma disfame hu vela yadana may kaamri

Vekoshrin hattabbur tanu rabbanan koshrin hattabbur rabbi yose omer af chotchin vetomnin hashshilya kede sheyyecham havalad amar rabban shimon ben gamliel benot melachim tomnot bisfalim shel shemen benot ashirim bisfogim shel tzemer benot aniyyim bemochin
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav halacha kerabbi yose
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav modim chachamim lerabbi yose betabbur shel shene tinokot shechotchin may tama dimnattechi ahadade

Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav kol haamur befarashat tochacha osin lechayya beshabbat shenneemar umoldotayich beom hulledet otach lo chorrat shorrech uvmayim lo ruchatzte lemishi vehomleach lo humlachatte vehochtel lo chuttalte

Umoldotayich beom hulledet mikkan shemyaldim et havalad beshabbat lo chorrat shorrech mikkan shechotchin hattabbur beshabbat uvmayim lo ruchatzte lemishi mikkan sherochatzin havalad beshabbat vehomleach lo humlachatte mikkan shemmolchin havalad beshabbat vehochtel lo chuttalte mikkan shemmelappefin havalad beshabbat

a: Matni rabbi eliezer omer im lo hevi keli meerev shabbat mevio beshabbat megulle uvassakkana mechassehu al pi edim
Veod amar rabbi eliezer kortim etzim laasot pechamin laasot keli barzel
Kelal amar rabbi akiva kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat enah docha et hashshabbat umila shei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat docha et hashshabbat

Gema ibaya lehu tama derabbi eliezer mishshum chabbove mitzva o dilma mishshum chashada lemay nafka minah leetoye mechusse al pi edim i amratte mishshum chabbove mitzva megulle in mechusse la ella i amratte mishshum chashada afilu mechusse shappir dame may

Itmar amar rabbi levi lo amarah rabbi eliezer ella lechabbove mitzva tanya name hachi mevio megulle veen mevio mechusse divre rabbi eliezer amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane uvishat hassakkana mechassehu al pi edim besakkana in shello besakkana la shema minah mishshum chabbove mitzva shema minah
Tanya idach mevio megulle veen mevio mechusse divre rabbi eliezer rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer nohagin hau bishat hassakkana shehau meviin mechusse al pi edim
Ibaya lehu edim dekaamar ihu vechad o dilma hu utre
Ta shema uvassakkana mechassehu al pi edim i amratte bishlama hu utre shappir ella i amratte hu vechad may edim sheruyim lehaid bimkom acher
Veod amar rabbi eliezer tanu rabbanan bimkomo shel rabbi eliezer hau kortin etzim laasot pechamin laasot barzel beshabbat bimkomo shel rabbi yose haggelili hau ochlin besar of bechalav

Levi ikla leve yosef rishba karivu leh resha detauosa bachalava la achal ki ata lekammeh derabbi amar leh ammay la teshammetinhu amar leh atreh derabbi yehuda ben betira hava veamena dilma derash lehu kerabbi yose haggelili

Ditnan rabbi yose haggelili omer neemar lo tochlu chol nevela veneemar lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo et sheasur mishshum nevela asur levashshel bechalav of sheasur mishshum nevela yachol yehe asur levashshel bechalav talmud lomar bachalev immo yatza of sheen lo chalev em

Amar rabbi yitzchak ir achat hayeta beeretz yisrael shehau osin kerabbi eliezer vehau metim bizmannan velo od ella sheppaam achat gazra malchut harshaa gezera al yisrael al hammila veal otah hair la gazra

Tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol mitzva shekkiblu alehem besimcha kegon mila dichtiv sas anochi al imratecha kemotze shalal rav adayin osin otah besimcha vechol mitzva shekkibbelu alehem biktata kegon araot dichtiv vayyishma moshe et haam boche lemishpechotav al iske mishpechotav adayin osin otah biktata deleka ketubba dela ramu bah tigra

Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer kol mitzva shemmasru yisrael atzman alehem lemita bishat gezerat hammalchut kegon avoda zara umila adayin hi muchzeket beyadam vechol mitzva shello masru yisrael atzman aleha lemita bishat gezerat hammalchut kegon tefilin adayin hi meruppa beyadam
Deamar rabbi yannay tefilin tzerichin guf naki keelisha baal kenafayim may hi amar abbaye shello yafiach bahem rava amar shello yishan bahem

Veammay karu leh elisha baal kenafayim sheppaam achat gazra malchut harshaa gezera al yisrael shekkol hammanniach tefilin al rosho yikkeru et mocho vehaya elisha manniach tefilin veyatza lashshuk veraahu kasdor echad ratz millefanav veratz acharav kevan shehiggia etzlo netalan merosho vaachazan beyado amar lo ma beyadcha amar lo kanfe yona pashat et yado venimtzeu bah kanfe yona lefichach hau korin oto baal kenafayim

May shena kanfe yona daamar leh vela amar leh shear ofot mishshum dedamya keneset yisrael leona shenneemar kanfe yona nechpa vakkesef veevroteha birakrak charutz ma yona zo kenafeha meginot aleha af yisrael mitzot meginot alehen
Amar rabbi abba bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak paam achat shachchu velo heviu izmel meerev shabbat veheviuhu beshabbat derech gaggot vederech chatzerot
b: Shello birtzon rabbi eliezer

Matkif lah rav yosef shello birtzon rabbi eliezer adderabba rabbi eliezer hu deshare vechi tema shello birtzon rabbi eliezer deshare afilu birshut harabbim ella birtzon rabbanan deasri derech reshut harabbim vesharu derech gaggot derech chatzerot vekarpefot umi sharu vehatanya keshem sheen meviin oto derech reshut harabbim kach en meviin oto lo derech gaggot velo derech karpefot velo derech chatzerot

Ella amar rav ashe shello birtzon rabbi eliezer umachlukto ella birtzon rabbi shimon ditnan rabbi shimon omer echad gaggot veechad karpefot veechad chatzerot kullan reshut echad hen lechelim sheshshavtu betochan velo lechelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit

Bea mineh rabbi zera merabbi assi mavoy shello nishtattefu bo mahu letaltel bechullo mi amrinan kechatzer dame ma chatzer af al gav delo ervu muttar letaltel bechullo hay name af al gav delo nishtattefu bo muttar letaltel bechullo o dilma la dame lechatzer dechatzer it leh arba mechitzot hay let leh arba mechitzot i name chatzer it beh daorin hay let beh daorin shetik vela amar leh vela mide

Zimnin ashkecheh deyatev veka amar amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda hannasi paam achat shachchu velo heviu izmel meerev shabbat veheviuhu beshabbat vehaya haddavar kashe lachachamim heach mannichin divre chachamim veosin kerabbi eliezer chada derabbi eliezer shammuti hu veod yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim

Veamar rabbi oshaya sheelit et rabbi yehuda haggozer veamar li mavoy shello nishtattefu bo hava veayetuhu mehay resha lehay resha amar leh sevira leh lemar mavoy shello nishtattefu muttar letaltel bechullo vaamar leh in amar leh veha zimnin beay minach vela amarte li hachi dilma aggav shitfach rehit lecha gemarach amar leh in aggav shitfa rehit li gemaray
Itmar amar rabbi zera amar rav mavoy shello nishtattefu bo en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot

Amar abbaye ha milta amrah rabbi zera vela pershah ad daata rabba bar avuh ufershah deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav mavoy shello nishtattefu bo ervu chatzerot im battim en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot lo ervu chatzerot im battim muttar letaltel bechullo
Amar leh rav chanina chozaa lerabba may shena ki ervu chatzerot im battim denitku chatzerot venaasu battim verav letameh daamar rav en hammavoy nitar belechi vekora ad sheyehu

a: Battim vachatzerot petuchin letocho vehacha battim ika chatzerot leka ki lo ervu name lechzinhu lehane battim keman distimi damu vachatzerot ika uvattim leka
Efshar dimvattele leh reshuta dechullehu legabbe chad sof sof bayit ika battim leka
Efshar demitztzafra vead palga deoma legabbe chad mippalgeh deoma ulfanya legabbe chad sof sof beidana deiteh lehay leteh lehay ella amar rav ashe mi garam lachatzerot sheyyeasru battim veleka

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lo lakkol amar rabbi eliezer machshire mitzva dochin et hashshabbat shehare shette hallechem chovat hayyom hen velo lemadan rabbi eliezer ella miggezera shava detanya rabbi eliezer omer minnayin lemachshire shette hallechem sheddochin et hashshabbat neemra havaa baomer veneemra havaa bishte hallechem ma havaa haamura baomer machshirin dochin et hashshabbat af havaa haamura bishte hallechem machshirin dochin et hashshabbat

Mufne dei la mufne ika lemifrach ma laomer shekken im matza katzur kotzer tomar bishte hallechem sheim matza katzur eno kotzer laye ippenoye mufne mikkede ketiv vahavetem et omer reshit ketzirchem el hakkohen miyyom haviachem lema li shema minah leafnoye
Veakkatti mufne mitztzad echad hu veshaminan leh lerabbi eliezer deamar mufne mitztzad echad lemedin umshivin taviu ribbuya hu

Lemaote may ilema lemaote lulav vehatanya lulav vechol machshirav dochin et hashshabbat divre rabbi eliezer veella lemaote sukka vehatanya sukka vechol machshireha dochin et hashshabbat divre rabbi eliezer veella lemaote matztza vehatanya matztza vechol machshireha dochin et hashshabbat divre rabbi eliezer veella lemaote shofar vehatanya shofar vechol machshirav dochin et hashshabbat divre rabbi eliezer
Amar rav adda bar ahava lemaote tzitzit letallito umzuza lefitcho tanya name hachi veshavin sheim tziyyetz tallito veasa mezuza lefitcho shehu chayyav
May tama amar rav yosef lefi sheen kavua lahem zeman amar leh abbaye adderabba middeen kavua lahem zeman
b: Kol shata veshata zimneh hu ella amar rav nachman amar rabbi yitzchak veitema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hoil uvyado lehafkiran
Amar mar lulav vechol machshirav dochin et hashshabbat divre rabbi eliezer mena leh lerabbi eliezer ha i meomer ushte hallechem shekken tzorech gavoha ella amar kera bayyom bayyom afilu beshabbat
Ulmay hilcheta ilema letiltul itzterich kera lemishre tiltul ella lemachshirav
Verabbanan hahu mibe leh bayyom velo ballayela
Verabbi eliezer bayyom velo ballayela mena leh nafka leh miusmachtem lifne Adonai elohechem shivat yamim yamim velo lelot
Verabbanan itzterich salka datach amena nelaf shivat yamim missukka ma lehallan yamim vaafilu lelot af kan yamim vaafilu lelot ka mashma lan
Velichtov rachamana belulav veneto hanach venelfu mineh mishshum deika lemifrach ma lelulav shekken taun arbaa minim
Sukka vechol machshireha dochin et hashshabbat divre rabbi eliezer mena leh lerabbi eliezer ha i meomer ushte hallechem shekken tzorech gavoha hu i millulav shekken taun arbaa minim
Ella gamar shivat yamim millulav ma lehallan machshirav dochin et hashshabbat af kan name machshirav dochin et hashshabbat
Velichtov rachamana besukka venete hanach veligmeru mineh mishshum deika lemifrach ma lesukka shekken noheget ballelot kevayyamim

Matztza vechol machshireha dochin et hashshabbat divre rabbi eliezer mena leh lerabbi eliezer ha i meomer ushte hallechem shekken tzorech gavoha i millulav shekken taun arbaa minim i missukka shekken noheget ballelot kevayyamim
Ella gamar chamishsha asar chamishsha asar mechag hassukkot ma lehallan machshireha dochin et hashshabbat af kan machshireha dochin et hashshabbat
Velichtov rachamana bematztza veneto hanach veligmeru mineh mishshum deika lemifrach ma lematztza shekken noheget benashim kevaanashim

Shofar vechol machshirav dochin et hashshabbat divre rabbi eliezer mena leh lerabbi eliezer ha i meomer ushte hallechem shekken tzorech gavoha i millulav shekken taun arbaa minim i missukka shekken noheget ballelot kevayyamim i mimmatztza shekken noheget bannashim kevaanashim ella amar kera yom terua yihye lachem yom afilu beshabbat
Ulmay ilema litkia ha tana deve shemuel kol melechet avoda lo taasu yatzta tekiat shofar urdiyyat happat shehi chachma veenah melacha ella lemachshirin
Verabbanan hahu mibe leh bayyom velo ballayela verabbi eliezer bayyom velo ballayela mena leh nafka leh mibbeom hakkippurim taaviru shofar bechol artzechem vegamri mehadade

Velichtov rachamana beshofar veleto hanach veligmeru mineh mittekiat shofar derosh hashshana leka lemigmar shekken machneset zichronot shel yisrael laavihen shebbashshamayim mittekia deom hakkippurim leka lemigmar deamar mar taku bet din shofar nifteru avadim levattehem vesadot chozrot levaalehen
Amar mar mila vechol machshireha dochin et hashshabbat divre rabbi eliezer mena leh lerabbi eliezer ha i mikkullehu gamar kidamrinan veod ma lehanach

a: Shekken im avar zemannah batla ella hayenu tama derabbi eliezer deamar kera uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar orlato vaafilu beshabbat
Velichtov rachamana bemila veleto hanach veligmeru mineh mishshum deika lemifrach ma lemila shekken nichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot
Ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh ella bemachshire mila aval mila gufah divre hakkol docha shabbat menalan amar ulla halacha vechen amar rabbi yitzchak halacha

Metivi minnayin lefikuach nefesh sheddoche et hashshabbat rabbi elazar ben azarya omer ma mila shehi achat meevarav shel adam docha et hashshabbat kal vachomer lefikuach nefesh sheddoche et hashshabbat
Vei salka datach halacha kal vachomer mehalacha mi ate vehatanya amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya akiva etzem kisora metamme halacha urviit dam kal vachomer veen danin kal vachomer mehalacha
Ella amar rabbi elazar atya ot ot
Ella meatta tefilin dichtiv behu ot lidche shabbat
Ella atya berit berit
Gadol dichtiv beh berit lidche shabbat
Ella atya dorot dorot
Tzitzit dichtiv beh dorot lidche shabbat
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak danin ot berit vedorot meot berit vedorot leappoke hanach dechad chad hu dichtiv bahen
Verabbi yochanan amar amar kera bayyom bayyom afilu beshabbat
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan ella meatta mechussere kappara dichtiv behu bayyom hachi name dedachu shabbat hahu mibe leh bayyom velo ballayela
Hay name mibe leh bayyom velo ballayela hahu mibben shemonat yamim nafka
Hay name mibbeom tzauoto nafka
Af al gav denafka mibbeom tzauoto itztericha salka datach amena hoil vechas rachamana aleh leetoye bedallut ballayela name layete ka mashma lan
Matkef lah ravina ella meatta yehe zar kasher bahen vihe onen kasher bahen ha ahdereh kera
Rav acha bar yaakov amar amar kera shemini shemini afilu beshabbat
Hay shemini mibe leh lemaote shevii shevii mibben shemonat yamim nafka
Veakkatti mibe leh chad lemaote shevii vechad lemaote teshii dei mechad hava amena shevii hu dela meta zimneh aval mishshemini veelach zimneh hu ella mechavarta kidrabbi yochanan

Tanya keoteh derabbi yochanan udla kerav acha bar yaakov shemini yimmol afilu beshabbat uma ani mekayyem mechalleleha mot yumat bishar melachot chutz mimmila o eno ella afilu mila uma ani mekayyem shemini yimmol chutz mishshabbat talmud lomar bayyom afilu beshabbat
Amar rava hay tanna meikara may ka nicha leh ulvassof may ka kashya leh
Hachi kaamar shemini yimmol afilu beshabbat uma ani mekayyem mechalleleha mot yumat bishar melachot chutz mimmila aval mila dachaya
May tama kal vachomer hu uma tzaraat sheddoche et haavoda
b: Vaavoda docha et hashshabbat mila docha otah shabbat shennidchet mippene haavoda eno din shettehe mila docha otah

Umay o eno dekaamar hadar amar umimmay detzaraat chamura dilma shabbat chamura shekken yesh bah onashin veazharot harbe i name umimmay mishshum dachamira tzaraat hi dilma mishshum gavra hu dela chaze uma ani mekayyem shemini yimmol chutz mishshabbat talmud lomar bayyom afilu beshabbat
Tanu rabbanan mila docha et hatztzaraat ben bizmannah ben shello bizmannah yom tov enah docha ella bizmannah bilvad
Menahane mile detanu rabbanan yimmol besar orlato veaf al pi sheyyesh sham baheret yakotz uma ani mekayyem hishshamer benega hatztzaraat bishar mekomot chutz mimmila
O eno ella afilu mila uma ani mekayyem yimmol besar orlato bizman sheen bah baheret talmud lomar basar veaf al pi sheyyesh sham baheret
Amar rava hay tanna meikara may nicha leh ulvassof may kashya leh

Hachi kaamar yimmol besar orlato veaf al pi sheyyesh sham baheret uma ani mekayyem hishshamer benega hatztzaraat bishar mekomot chutz mimmila aval mila docha et hatztzaraat may tama deatya mikkal vechomer uma shabbat chamura mila docha otah tzaraat lo kol shekken
Umay o eno dekaamar hadar kaamar mimmay deshabbat chamira dilma tzaraat chamira shekken docha et haavoda vaavoda docha et hashshabbat talmud lomar basar veaf al pi sheyyesh sham baheret

Lishana acharina mila docha et hatztzaraat may tama deate ase vedache lo taase umay o eno dekaamar hadar kaamar emar deamrinan deate ase vedache et lo taase lo taase gereda hay ase velo taase hu uma ani mekayyem yimmol besar orlato bizman sheen bah baheret talmud lomar basar veaf al pi sheyyesh sham baheret
Tinach gadol dichtiv beh basar katan name ketiv beh basar benoni menalan

Amar abbaye atya mibbenayya miggadol la atya shekken anush karet mikkatan la atya shekken mila bizmannah hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken nimolin vedochin et hatztzaraat af kol shennimolin dochin et hatztzaraat
Rava amar mila bizmannah docha la tzericha kera mikkal vachomer atya uma shabbat dachamira docha tzaraat lo kol shekken

Amar leh rav safra lerava mimmay deshabbat chamira dilma tzaraat chamira shekken docha et haavoda vaavoda docha et hashshabbat hatam lav mishshum dachamira tzaraat ella mishshum degavra hu dela chazi ammay veyakotz baharto veyaavod mechussar tevila hu
Tinach negaim temeim negaim tehorim may ika lememar
Ella amar rav ashe hecha amrinan deate ase vedache lo taase kegon mila betzaraat i name tzitzit vechilayim dividana demitakar lav ka mokem ase hacha beidana demitakar lelav la ka mokem ase
Veha derava verav safra

a: Tannae hi detanya basar veaf al pi sheyyesh sham baheret yimmol divre rabbi yoshiyya rabbi yonatan omer eno tzarich shabbat chamura docha tzaraat lo kol shekken
Amar mar basar af al pi sheyyesh sham baheret yimmol divre rabbi yoshiyya ha lema li kera davar sheen mitkaven hu vedavar sheen mitkaven muttar

Amar abbaye la nitzrecha ella lerabbi yehuda deamar davar sheen mitkaven asur rava amar afilu tema rabbi shimon mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut veabbaye let leh hay sevara veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut batar deshamah merava savrah
Ika dematne leha deabbaye verava aha hishshamer benega hatztzaraat lishmor meod velaasot laasot i atta ose aval ose atta besiv sheal gabbe raglo uvmot sheal gabbe ketefo veim avra avra

Veha lema li kera davar sheen mitkaven hu vedavar sheen mitkaven muttar amar abbaye lo nitzrecha ella lerabbi yehuda deamar davar sheen mitkaven asur verava amar afilu tema rabbi shimon mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut veabbaye let leh hay sevara veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut levatar deshameh merava savrah
Veabbaye alliba derabbi shimon hay besar may aved leh amar rav amram beomer lakotz baharto hu mitkaven
Tinach gadol katan may ika lememar amar rav mesharsheya beomer avi habben lakotz baheret divno hu ka mitkaven
Vei ika acher lebed acher deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase im atta yachol lekayyem shenehem mutav veim lav yavo ase veyidche lo taase deleka acher
Amar mar yom tov enah docha ella bizmannah bilvad mena hane mile
Amar chizkiyya vechen tana deve chizkiyya amar kera lo totiru mimmennu ad boker sheen talmud lomar ad boker ma talmud lomar ad boker ba hakkatuv liten lo boker sheni lisrefato
Abbaye amar amar kera olat shabbat beshabbatto velo olat chol beshabbat velo olat chol beom tov
Rava amar amar kera hu levaddo yease lachem hu velo machshirin levaddo velo mila shello bizmannah deatya mikkal vachomer
Rav ashe amar shabbaton ase hu vehave leh yom tov ase velo taase veen ase doche et lo taase vaase
Kelal amar rabbi akiva vechu amar rav yehuda amar rav halacha kerabbi akiva

Utnan name gabbe fesach ki hay gavena kelal amar rabbi akiva kol melacha sheefshar lah laasotah meerev shabbat enah docha et hashshabbat shechita shei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat docha et hashshabbat veamar rav yehuda amar rav halacha kerabbi akiva
Utzricha dei ashmeinan gabbe mila hatam hu demachshirin efshar laasot meetmol la dachu shabbat deleka karet aval pesach deika karet ema lidcho shabbat
Vei ashmeinan gabbe fesach mishshum delo nichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot aval mila denichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot ema lidcho shabbat tzericha
Matni osin kol tzorche mila beshabbat mohalin uforin umotztzin venotnin aleha ispelanit vechammon
Im lo shachak meerev shabbat loes beshinav venoten im lo taraf yayin vashemen meerev shabbat noten ze beatzmo veze beatzmo
Veen osin lah chaluk lechattechila aval korech aleha semartut im lo hitkin meerev shabbat korech al etzbao umevi vaafilu mechatzer acheret
b: Gema mikkede katane kullehu kol tzorche mila leetoye may

Leetoye ha detanu rabbanan hammal kol zeman shehu osek bammila chozer ben al hatztzitzin hamakkevin et hammila ben al hatztzitzin sheen meakkevin et hammila perash al tzitzin hamakkevin et hammila chozer al tzitzin sheen meakkevin et hammila eno chozer

Man tanna perash eno chozer amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi detanya arbaa asar shechal lihot beshabbat mafshit adam happesach ad hechaze divre rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka vachachamim omrim mafshitin et kullo
Mimmay ad kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hatam mishshum dela baenan ze eli veanvehu aval hacha devaenan ze eli veanvehu hachi name

Detanya ze eli veanvehu hitnae lefanav bemitzot ase lefanav sukka naa velulav nae veshofar nae tzitzit naa sefer tora nae uchtov bo lishmo bido nae bekulmos nae belavlar umman vechorcho beshirain nain
Abba shaul omer veanvehu heve dome lo ma hu channun verachum af atta heye channun verachum
Ella amar rav ashe ha manni rabbi yose hi ditnan ben shennira baalil uven shello nira baalil mechallelin alav et hashshabbat rabbi yose omer nira baalil en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat
Mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hatam delo nitna shabbat lidachot aval hacha denitna shabbat lidachot hachi name

Ella amri nehardae rabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yose hi ditnan arbaa kohanim nichnasin shenayim beyadam shene sedarim ushnayim beyadam shene vazikin vearbaa makdimin lifnehem shenayim litol shene sedarim ushnayim litol shene vazikin hammachnisin omdim batztzafon ufnehem laddarom vehammotziin omdim baddarom ufnehem latztzafon ellu moshchim veellu mannichin tifcho shel ze betzad tifcho shel ze mishshum shenneemar lifne Adonai tamid
Rabbi yose omer afilu ellu notlin veellu mannichin af ze haya tamid
Tanu rabbanan mehalketin et hammila veim lo hilket anush karet manni amar rav kahana umman
Matkef lah rav pappa umman lema lehu ana avadi palga demitzva attun name avidu palga demitzva ella amar rav pappa gadol

Matkef lah rav ashe gadol behedya ketiv beh vearel zachar asher lo yimmol ella amar rav ashe leolam umman uchgon daata ben hashshemashot deshabbat vaamaru leh la maspekatte vaamar lehu maspekena vaavad vela istappak veishtechach dechabbura hu daavad veanush karet
Motztzin vechu amar rav pappa hay ummana dela mayetz sakkana hu umabberinan leh
Peshita middeka mechalleli aleh shabbeta sakkana hu mahu detema hay dam mifkad pekid ka mashma lan chabbore michabbar
Vedumya deispelanit vechammon ma ispelanit vechammon ki la aved sakkana hu af hacha name ki la aved sakkana hu
Venotnin aleha ispelanit amar abbaye amara li em ispelanita dechullehon kive shav mane tarba vachada kira rava amar kira vekalba
Darshah rava bemachoza karinhu bene minome asya lemanayehu amar lehu shevaki lechu chada daamar shemuel hay man demashe appeh vela minnaggev tuva nikteru leh

a: Chaspanita may takkanteh limshe tuva bemayya desilka
Lo shachak meerev shabbat tanu rabbanan devarim sheen osin lammila beshabbat osin lah beom tov shochakin lah kammon vetorfin lah yayin vashemen

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef may shena kammon beom tov dachaze likdera yayin vashemen chaze name beshabbat lechole detanya en torfin yayin vashemen lachole beshabbat amar rabbi shimon ben elazar mishshum rabbi meir af torfin yayin vashemen

Amar rabbi shimon ben elazar paam achat chash rabbi meir bemeav uvikkashnu litrof lo yayin vashemen velo hinnichanu amarnu lo devarecha yivtelu bechayyecha amar lanu af al pi sheani omer kach vachaveray omrim kach miyyamay lo melaani libbi laavor al divre chaveray hu nihu demachmir annafsheh aval lechulle alma shere
Hatam la bae lika hacha bae lika hacha name nebed vela lelech hayenu dekatane noten ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo
Tanu rabbanan en mesannenin et hachardal bimsannenet shello veen memattekin oto begachelet amar leh abbaye lerav yosef may shena meha ditnan notnim betza bimsannenet shel chardal
Amar leh hatam la michze kevorer hacha michze kevorer
Veen memattekin oto begachelet vehatanya memattekin oto begachelet la kashya kan begachelet shel mattechet kan begachelet shel etz
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef may shena mibbisra aggumre amar leh hatam la efshar hacha efshar
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef mahu legabben amar leh asur may shena millisha amar leh hatam la efshar hacha efshar
Veha amri nehardae gevina bat yoma mealleya hachi kaamri daafilu gevina bat yoma mealleya

En osin lah chaluk ku amar abbaye amara li em hay chaluk deyanoka lappecheh lesitreh leilay dilma midvik girda mineh veate lide kerut shofcha imeh deabbaye avda kista lefalga amar abbaye hay yanoka delet leh chaluk layete belita deit leh sifta velichrecheh lesifta letattay veayef leh leilay

Veamar abbaye amara li em hay yanoka dela yedia mappakteh leshayefeh mishcha velokmeh lahade yoma vehecha dezig likreeh bisarta sheti vaerev aval bichli mattachot la mishshum dezaref veamar abbaye amara li em hay yanoka dela mayetz mekar hu dekar pummeh may takkanteh layeto kasa gumre velanketeh leh lahade pummeh dechayem pummeh umayetz veamar abbaye amara li em hay yanoka dela minnashtem linpefeh benafota uminnashtem

Veamar abbaye amara li em hay yanoka dela meave layeto silta deimeh velishrekeh ilaveh umave veamar abbaye amara li em hay yanoka dekattin layeto lesilta deimeh velishrekeh ilaveh mikkutna leulma vei allim meulma lekutna veamar abbaye amara li em hay yanoka desummak deakkatti la ibla beh demeh litarchu leh ad demibla beh demeh velimhaluh deyarok deakkatti la nefal beh demeh litarchu ad denafel beh demeh velimhaluh

Detanya amar rabbi natan paam achat halachti lichrakke hayyam uvat ishsha achat lefanay shemmala benah rishon vamet sheni vamet shelishi heviattu lefanay reitiv shehu adom amarti lah hamtini lo ad sheyyibbala bo damo himtina lo ad shennivla bo damo umala oto vechaya vehau korin oto natan habbavli al shemi

Shuv paam achat halachti limdinat kappotkeya uvat ishsha achat lefanay shemmala benah rishon vamet sheni vamet shelishi heviattu lefanay reitiv shehu yarok hetzatzti bo velo raiti bo dam berit amarti lah hamtini lo ad sheyyippol bo damo vehimtina lo umala oto vechaya vehau korin shemo natan habbavli al shemi
b: Matni marchitzin et hakkatan ben lifne hammila uven leachar hammila umzallefin alav bayyad aval lo bichli rabbi elazar ben azarya omer marchitzin et hakkatan bayyom hashshelishi shechal lihot beshabbat shenneemar vayehi vayyom hashshelishi bihotam koavim
Safek veanderoginos en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat verabbi yehuda mattir beanderoginos
Gema veha amratte resha marchitzin
Rav yehuda verabba bar avuh deamri tarvayehu ketzad tane marchitzin et hakkatan ben lifne mila ben leachar mila ketzad mezallefin alav bayyad aval lo bichli

Amar rava veha marchitzin katane ella amar rava hachi katane marchitzin et hakkatan ben millifne mila ben leachar hammila bayyom harishon kedarko uvayyom hashshelishi shechal lihot beshabbat mezallefin alav bayyad aval lo bichli rabbi elazar ben azarya omer marchitzin et hakkatan bayyom hashshelishi shechal lihot beshabbat shenneemar vayehi vayyom hashshelishi bihotam koavim

Tanya keoteh derava marchitzin hakkatan ben lifne mila ben leachar mila beom harishon kedarko uvayyom hashshelishi shechal lihot beshabbat mezallefin alav bayyad rabbi elazar ben azarya omer marchitzin et hakkatan bayyom hashshelishi shechal lihot beshabbat veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar shenneemar vayehi vayyom hashshelishi bihotam koavim
Uchshehen mezallefin en mezallefin lo bechos velo bikara velo bichli ella bayyad atan letanna kamma
May af al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar mishshum degadol la salek bisreh hayya katan salek beh bisreh hayya
Hahu daata lekammeh derava ori leh kishmateh ichalash rava amar ana bahade targuma desave lema li
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava vehatanya keoteh demar amar lehu matnitin keotayehu dayeka

Mimmay middekaamar rabbi elazar ben azarya omer marchitzin et hakkatan beom hashshelishi shechal lihot beshabbat i amratte bishlama tanna kamma mezallefin kaamar hayenu dekaamar leh rabbi elazar ben azarya marchitzin ella i amratte tanna kamma marchitzin beom harishon kaamar umzallefin beom hashshelishi hay rabbi elazar ben azarya omer marchitzin af marchitzin mibe leh
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi elazar halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya
Hao bah bemareva harchatzat kol gufo o harchatzat mila

Amar lehu hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh mistabbera harchatzat kol gufo dei salka datach harchatzat mila mi gara mechammin al gabbe makka deamar rav en monin chammin vashemen meal gabbe makka beshabbat
Matkef lah rav yosef vela shane lach ben chammin shehuchammu beshabbat lechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat

Matkef lah rav dimi umimmay dehacha bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat peligi dilma bechammin shehuchammu beerev shabbat peligi amar abbaye ana beay deeshanne leh ukdam veshanni leh rav yosef mippene shessakkana hu lo

Itmar name ki ata ravin amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar veamri lah amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya ben bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat ben bechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat ben harchatzat kol gufo ben harchatzat mila mippene shessakkana hi lo
Gufa amar rav en monin chammin vashemen meal gabbe makka beshabbat ushmuel amar noten chutz lammakka veshotet veored lammakka
Metivi en notnin shemen vechammin al gabbe moch liten al gabbe makka bashshabbat hatam mishshum sechita
Ta shema en notnin chammin vashemen al gabbe moch sheal gabbe makka bashshabbat hatam name mishshum sechita
Tanya keoteh dishmuel en notnin chammin vashemen al gabbe makka bashshabbat aval notnin chutz lammakka veshotet veored lammakka

Tanu rabbanan notnin al gabbe hammakka moch yavesh usfog yavesh aval lo gemi yavesh velo ketitin yeveshin kashya ketitin akketitin la kashya ha bechadte ha beattike amar abbaye shema minah hane ketitin massu
Safek veanderoginos ku tanu rabbanan orlato orlato vadday doche et hashshabbat

a: Velo safek doche et hashshabbat orlato vadday doche et hashshabbat velo anderoginos doche et hashshabbat

Rabbi yehuda omer anderoginos doche et hashshabbat veanush karet orlato vadday doche et hashshabbat velo nolad ben hashshemashot doche et hashshabbat orlato vadday doche et hashshabbat velo nolad keshehu mahul doche et hashshabbat shebbet shammay omrim tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit uvet hillel omrim eno tzarich

Amar rabbi shimon ben elazar lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al nolad keshehu mahul shetztzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit mippene sheorla kevusha hi al ma nechleku al ger shennitgayyer keshehu mahul shebbet shammay omrim tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit uvet hillel omrim en tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit

Amar mar velo safek doche et hashshabbat leetoye may leetoye ha detanu rabbanan ben shiva mechallelin alav et hashshabbat uven shemona en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat safek ben shiva safek ben shemona en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat
Ben shemona hare hu keeven veasur letaltelo aval immo shocha umnikato mippene hassakkana
Itmar rav amar halacha ketanna kamma ushmuel amar halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar
Rav adda bar ahava ityelid leh hahu yanoka keshehu mahul ahdereh attelesar maholae ad deshavveyeh kerut shafcha amar tete li daavari adderav

Amar leh rav nachman veaddishmuel la avar emar deamar shemuel bachol beshabbat mi amar hu savar vadday orla kevusha hi deitmar rabba amar chayeshinan shemma orla kevusha hi rav yosef amar vadday orla kevusha hi

Amar rav yosef mena amena lah detanya rabbi eliezer hakkappar omer lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al nolad keshehu mahul shetztzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit al ma nechleku lechallel alav et hashshabbat bet shammay omrim mechallelin alav et hashshabbat uvet hillel omrim en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat lav mikkelal detanna kamma savar mechallelin alav et hashshabbat
Vedilma tanna kamma divre hakkol en mechallelin kaamar im ken rabbi eliezer hakkappar tama devet shammay ata leashmoinan dilma hachi kaamar lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel bedavar ze
Amar rabbi assi kol sheimmo temea leda nimol lishmona vechol sheen immo temea leda en nimol lishmona shenneemar ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vetama vego uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar orlato
Amar leh abbaye dorot harishonim yochichu sheen immo temea leda venimol lishmona
Amar leh nittena tora
b: Venitchaddesha halacha

Ini veha itmar yotze dofen umi sheyyesh lo shette aralot rav huna verav chiyya bar rav chad amar mechallelin alav et hashshabbat vechad amar en mechallelin ad kan la peligi ella lechallel alav et hashshabbat aval lishmona vadday mahalinan leh ha beha talya
Ketannae yesh yelid bayit shennimol leechad veyesh yelid bayit shennimol lishmona yesh miknat kesef shennimol leechad veyesh miknat kesef shennimol lishmona

Yesh miknat kesef shennimol leechad veyesh miknat kesef shennimol lishmona ketzad lakach shifcha meubberet veachar kach yalda zehu miknat kesef hannimol lishmona lakach shifcha uveladah immah zo hi miknat kesef shennimol leechad

Veyesh yelid bayit shennimol lishmona ketzad lakach shifcha venitabbera etzlo veyalda zehu yelid bayit hannimol lishmona rav chama omer yalda veachar kach hitbilah zehu yelid bayit shennimol leechad hitbilah veachar kach yalda zehu yelid bayit hannimol lishmona
Vetanna kamma la shane leh ben hitbilah veachar kach yalda ben yalda veachar kach hitbilah deaf al gav deen immo temea leda nimol lishmona

Amar rava bishlama lerabbi chama mashkachatte lah yelid bayit nimol leechad yelid bayit nimol lishmona miknat kesef nimol leechad umiknat kesef nimol lishmona yalda veachar kach hitbilah zehu yelid bayit shennimol leechad hitbilah veachar kach yalda zehu yelid bayit shennimol lishmona
Miknat kesef nimol lishmona kegon shellakach shifcha meubberet vehitbilah veachar kach yalda miknat kesef nimol leechad kegon shellakach ze shifcha veze ubbarah
Ella letanna kamma bishlama kullehu mashkachatte lehu ella yelid bayit nimol leechad hechi mashkachatte lah
Amar rabbi yirmeya belokeach shifcha leubbarah
Hanicha leman deamar kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame ella leman deamar kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame may ika lememar
Amar rav mesharsheya belokeach shifcha al menat shello lehatbilah

Tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol sheshshaha sheloshim yom baadam eno nefel shenneemar ufduyav mibben chodesh tifde shemonat yamim babbehema eno nefel shenneemar umiyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze lekorban vego
Ha lo shaha sefeka have

a: Mimhal hechi mahalinan leh
Amar rav adda bar ahava malin oto mimma nafshach im chay hu shappir ka mahel veim lav mechattech bevasar hu
Veella ha detanya safek ben shiva safek ben shemona en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat ammay nimhaleh mimma nafshach im chay hu shappir ka mahel veim lav mechattech bevasar hu
Amar mar bereh deravina ana verav nechumi bar zecharya targemna mimhal hachi name mahalinan leh lo nitzrecha ella lemachshire mila vealliba derabbi eliezer
Amar abbaye ketannae vechi yamut min habbehema asher hi lachem leochla lehavi ben shemone sheen shechitato metaharto rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon omrim shechitato metaharto
May lav beha ka mipalgi demar savar chay hu umar savar met hu
Amar rava i hachi addemipalgi leinyan tuma vetohora lipalgi leinyan achila

Ella dechulle alma met hu verabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savri kitrefa terefa lav af al gav demeta hi shechitatah metahartah hacha name la shena verabbanan la dame litrefa terefa hayeta lah sheat hakkosher hay lo hayeta lah sheat hakkosher
Vechi tema terefa mibbeten may ika lememar hatam yesh beminah shechita hacha en beminah shechita
Ibaya lehu mi peligi rabbanan aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel o la im timtze lomar peligi halacha kemoto o en halacha kemoto
Ta shema egel shennolad beom tov shochatin oto beom tov hacha bemay askinan dekim leh begaveyh shekkalu lo chodashav
Ta shema veshavin sheim nolad hu umumo immo shezze min hammuchan hacha name shekkalu lo chodashav
Ta shema deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel halacha mikkelal difligi shema minah
Amar abbaye nafal min haggag o achalo ari divre hakkol chay hu ki peligi sheppihek vamet mar savar chay hu umar savar met hu
Lemay nafka mineh liftor min hayyibum

Nafal min haggag o achalo ari divre hakkol chay hu veha rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua iklau leve bereh derav idi bar avin vaavadu lehu igla tilta bimama deshiva veamri leh i itarchitu leh ad leurta hava achlinan mineh hashta la achlinan mineh
Ella kesheppihek vamet divre hakkol met hu ki peligi benafal min haggag vaachalo ari mar savar met hu umar savar chay hu
Bereh derav dimi bar yosef ityelid leh hahu yanoka bego telatin yomin shechev yatev kamitabbel ilaveh amar leh avuh tzeoronyata kavaet lemechal amar leh kim li beh shekkalu lo chodashav

Rav ashe ikla leve rav kahana itra beh milta bego telatin yomin chazyeh deyatev veka mitabbal ilaveh amar leh la savar leh mar leha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel amar leh kim li begaveh shekkalu lo chodashav
Itmar met betoch sheloshim veamda venitkaddesha amar ravina mishshemeh derava
b: Im eshet yisrael hi choletzet im eshet kohen hi enah choletzet
Verav sherevya mishshemeh derava amar achat zo veachat zo choletzet
Amar leh ravina lerav sherevya beurta amar rava hachi letzafra hadar beh amar leh sherituha yehe raava detishro tarba
Rabbi yehuda mattir vechu amar rav shezvi amar rav chisda lo lakkol amar rabbi yehuda anderoginos zachar hu sheim atta omer ken baarachin yearech

Umnalan dela miarach detanya hazzachar velo tumtum veanderoginos yachol lo yehe beerech ish aval yehe beerech ishsha talmud lomar hazzachar veim nekeva hi zachar vadday nekeva vaddait velo tumtum veanderoginos

a: Ustam sifra rabbi yehuda
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak af anan name tenena hakkol kesherim lekaddesh chutz mecheresh shote vekatan rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan ufosel beishsha veanderoginos shema minah
Umay shena mila mishshum dichtiv himmol lachem kol zachar
Matni mi shehau lo shene tinokot echad lamul achar hashshabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat chayyav
Echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter
Gema rav huna matne chayyav rav yehuda matne patur

Rav huna matne chayyav detanya amar rabbi shimon ben elazar lo nechleku rabbi elazar verabbi yehoshua al mi shehau lo shene tinokot echad lamul bashshabbat veechad lamul achar hashshabbat veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat shehu chayyav

Al ma nechleku al mi shehau lo shene tinokot echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter
Ushnehem lo lemaduha ella meavoda zara rabbi eliezer savar kaavoda zara ma avoda zara amar rachamana la taaved vechi avid michayyav hacha name la shena
Verabbi yehoshua hatam delav mitzva hacha mitzva

Rav yehuda matne patur detanya amar rabbi meir lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al mi shehau lo shene tinokot echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat shehu patur

Al ma nechleku al mi shehau lo shene tinokot echad lamul achar hashshabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter
Ushnehem lo lemaduha ella meavoda zara rabbi eliezer savar kaavoda zara ma avoda zara amar rachamana la taaved vechi aved michayyav hacha name la shena
Verabbi yehoshua hatam la terid bemitzva hacha terid

Tane rabbi chiyya omer haya rabbi meir lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al mi shehau lo shene tinokot echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat shehu chayyav

Al ma nechleku al mi shehau lo shene tinokot echad lamul achar hashshabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat veshachach umal shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter
Hashta rabbi yehoshua sefa dela ka aved mitzva poter resha deka aved mitzva mechayyev
Amri deve rabbi yannay resha kegon shekkadam umal shel shabbat beerev shabbat delo nitna shabbat lidachot sefa nitna shabbat lidachot
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana resha name nitna shabbat lidachot legabbe tinokot dealma lehay gavra miha la ityehiv
Matni katan nimol lishmona letisha velaasara ulachad asar velishnem asar lo pachot velo yoter
Ha ketzad kedarko lishmona nolad leven hashshemashot nimol letisha ben hashshemashot shel erev shabbat nimol laasara
Yom tov leachar hashshabbat nimol leachad asar shene yamim shel rosh hashshana nimol lishnem asar
Katan hachole en mohalin oto ad sheyyavri
Gema amar shemuel chalatzattu chamma notnin lo kol shiva lehavroto
Ibaya lehu mi baenan meet leet
Ta shema detane ludda yom havraato keom hivaldo may lav ma yom hivaldo la baenan meet leet af yom havraato la baenan meet leet
La adif yom havraato miyyom hivaldo deilu yom hivaldo la baenan meet leet veilu yom havraato baenan meet leet
Matni ellu hen tzitzin hamakkevin et hammila basar hachofe et rov haatara veeno ochel bitruma
Veim haya baal basar metakkeno mippene marit haayin
b: Mal velo para et hammila keilu lo mal
Gema amar rabbi avina amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav basar hachofe et rov govhah shel atara
Veim haya baal basar vechu amar shemuel katan hamsurbal bevasar roin oto kol zeman shemmitkashshe venire mahul eno tzarich lamul veim lav tzarich lamul
Bematnita tana rabban shimon ben gamliel omer katan hamsurbal bevasar roin oto kol zeman shemmitkashshe veeno nire mahul tzarich lemulo veim lav eno tzarich lemulo
May benayehu ika benayehu nire veeno nire

Mal velo para tanu rabbanan hammal omer asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al hammila avi habben omer asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lehachniso bivrito shel avraham avinu haomdim omrim keshem shennichnas labberit kach yikkanes letora lechuppa ulmaasim tovim

Vehamvarech omer asher kidesh yadid mibbeten chok bishero sam vetzeetzaav chatam beot berit kodesh al ken bischar zot el chay chelkenu tzurenu tziva lehatztzil yedidut sheerenu mishshachat lemaan berito asher sam bivsarenu baruch atta Adonai koret habberit

Hammal et haggerim omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al hammila vehamvarech omer asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lamul et haggerim ulhattif mehem dam berit sheilmale dam berit lo nitkayemu shamayim vaaretz shenneemar im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti baruch atta Adonai koret habberit

Hammal et haavadim omer asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al hammila vehamvarech omer asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lamul et haavadim ulhattif mehem dam berit sheilmale dam berit chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo nitkayemu shenneemar im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti baruch atta Adonai koret habberit

Matni rabbi eliezer omer tolin et hamshammeret beom tov venotnin latteluya bashshabbat vachachamim omrim en tolin et hamshammeret beom tov veen notnin latteluya bashshabbat aval notnin latteluya beom tov
Gema hashta rabbi eliezer osofe ohel aray la mosfinan lemibad lechattechilla shere
May hi ditnan pekak hachallon rabbi eliezer omer bizman shekkashur vetaluy pokkin bo veim lav en pokkin bo vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach pokkin bo

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim sheen osin ohel aray battechilla beom tov veen tzarich lomar bashshabbat lo nechleku ella lehosif sherabbi eliezer omer en mosifin beom tov veen tzarich lomar bashshabbat vachachamim omrim mosifin bashshabbat veen tzarich lomar beom tov
Rabbi eliezer savar lah kerabbi yehuda detanya en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad rabbi yehuda mattir af machshire ochel nefesh
Emar deshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda bemachshirin shei efshar laasotam meerev yom tov bammachshirin sheefshar laasotam meerev yom tov mi shamatte leh
Derabbi eliezer adifa midderabbi yehuda
Vachachamim omrim ibaya lehu tala may amar rav yosef tala chayyav chattat
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta tela kuza besikta hachi name demichayyav

a: Ella amar abbaye midderabbanan hi shello yaase kederech shehu ose bachol

Menakket abbaye chumre matneyata vetane haggod vehamshammeret kila vechisse gallin lo yaase veim asa patur aval asur ohole keva lo yaase veim asa chayyav chattat aval mitta vechisse teraskal veasla muttar lintotan lechattechila
Veen notnin latteluya bashshabbat ibaya lehu shimer may amar rav kahana shimer chayyav chattat
Matkef lah rav sheshet mi ika mide derabbanan mechayevi chattat verabbi eliezer share lechattechila
Matkef lah rav yosef allema la hare ir shel zahav derabbi meir mechayyev chattat verabbi eliezer share lechattechila
May hi detanya lo tetze ishsha beir shel zahav veim yatza chayyevet chattat divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim lo tetze veim yatza petura rabbi eliezer omer yotza ishsha beir shel zahav lechattechila
Amar leh abbaye mi savratte rabbi eliezer adderabbi meir kae deamar chayyevet chattat adderabbanan kae deamri patur aval asur vaamar lehu ihu muttar lechattechila
Mishshum may matrinan beh rabba amar mishshum borer rabbi zera amar mishshum merakked
Amar rabba keoti didi mistabbera ma darko shel borer notel ochel umanniach happesolet af hacha name notel et haochel umanniach et happesolet
Amar rabbi zera keoti didi mistabbera ma darko shel merakked pesolet millemala veochel millematta af hacha name pesolet millemala veochel millematta
Tane rame bar yechezkel tallit kefula lo yaase veim asa patur aval asur haya karuch aleha chut o meshicha muttar lintotah lechattechila
Bea mineh rav kahana merav kila mahu amar leh af mitta asura mitta mahu amar leh af kila mutteret kila umitta mahu amar leh kila asura umitta mutteret
Vela kashya ha dekaamar af mitta asura kidkarmonae ha dekaamar leh af kila mutteret kidrame bar yechezkel kila asura umitta mutteret kiddidan
Amar rav yosef chazena lehu lechile deve rav huna demeurta negida umitztzafra chavita ramya
Amar rav mishshum rabbi chiyya vilon muttar lintoto umuttar leforko
Veamar shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyya
b: Kilat chatanim muttar lintotah umuttar leforkah

Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi la amaran ella sheen begaggah tefach aval yesh begaggah tefach asura vechi en begaggah tefach name la amaran ella sheen befachot mishshelosha samuch legaggah tefach aval yesh befachot mishshelosha samuch legaggah tefach asur vela amaran ella sheen beshipuah tefach aval yesh beshipuah tefach shippue ohalim keohalim damu vela amaran ella dela nachet mippurya tefach aval nachet mippurya tefach asur
Veamar rav sheshet bereh derav idi hay seyana share vehaitmar seyana asur la kashya ha deit beh tefach ha delet beh tefach
Ella meatta sharbev biglima tefach hachi name demichayyav ella la kashya ha demihaddak ha dela mihaddak
Shelach leh rame bar yechezkel lerav huna ema lan izi hanach mile mealleyata daamarte lan mishshemeh derav tarte beshabbat vachada betora
Shelach leh ha detanya god bechisana muttar lintotah beshabbat amar rav lo shanu ella bishne bene adam aval beadam echad asur
Amar abbaye vechila afilu baasara bene adam asur i efshar dela mimatcha purta
Idach may hi detanya kira shennishmeta achat miyyarchoteha muttar letaltelah shettayim asur rav amar afilu chad name asur gezera shemma yitka

Tora deamar rav atida tora shettishtakkach miyyisrael shenneemar vehifla Adonai et makkotcha haflaa zo eni yodea mahi keshehu omer lachen hinni yosif lehafli et haam hazze hafle vafele heve omer haflaa zo tora

Tanu rabbanan keshennichnesu rabbotenu lakkerem beyavne amru atida tora shettishtakkach miyyisrael shenneemar hinne yamim baim neum Adonai elohim vehishlachti raav baaretz lo raav lallechem velo tzama lammayim ki im lishmoa et divre Adonai uchtiv venau miyyam ad yam umitztzafon vead mizrach yeshottu levakkesh et devar Adonai velo yimtzau
Devar Adonai zo halacha devar Adonai ze hakketz devar Adonai zo nevua
Umay yeshottu levakkesh et devar Adonai amru atida ishsha shettittol kikkar shel teruma vetachazor bevatte chenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot leda im temea hi veim tehora hi veen mevin
Im tehora hi veim temea hi behedya ketiv beh mikkol haochel asher yeachel ella leda im rishona hi veim sheniyya hi veen mevin
Ha name matnitin hi keditnan hashsheretz shennimtza battannur happat shebbetocho sheniyya shehattannur techila
Mistappeka lehu ha daamar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava lechzeyeh lehay tannura keman dimle tuma vetihve pat rishona

Amar leh la amrinan lechzeyeh lehay tannura keman dimle tuma detanya yachol yehu kol hakkelim mitammein baavir keli cheres talmud lomar kol asher betocho yitma mikkol haochel asher yeachel ochalin mittammein baavir keli cheres veen kelim mittammein baavir keli cheres

Tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer chas veshalom shettishtakkach tora miyyisrael shenneemar ki lo tishshachach mippi zaro ella ma ani mekayyem yeshottu levakkesh et devar Adonai velo yimtzau shello yimtzeu

a: Halacha berura umishna berura bimkom echad

Tanya rabbi yose ben elisha omer im raita dor shetztzarot rabbot baot alav tze uvdok bedayyane yisrael shekkol puranut shebbaa leolam lo baa ella bishvil dayyane yisrael shenneemar shimu na zot rashe bet yaakov uktzine bet yisrael hamtaavim mishpat veet kol hayeshara yeakkeshu bone tziyyon bedamim virushalam beavela rasheha beshochad yishpotu vechohaneha bimchir yoru unvieha bechesef yiksomu veal Adonai yishshaenu vego

Reshaim hen ella shettalu bitchonam bemi sheamar vehaya haolam lefichach mevi hakkadosh baruch hu alehen shalosh puraniyyot keneged shalosh averot shebbeyadam shenneemar lachen biglalchem tziyyon sade techaresh virushalam iyyin tihye vehar habbayit levamot yaar

Veen hakkadosh baruch hu mashre shechinato al yisrael ad sheyyichlu shoftim veshotrim raim miyyisrael shenneemar veashiva yadi alayich veetzrof kabbor sigayich veasira kol bedilayich veashiva shoftayich kevarishona veoatzayich kevattechilla vego
Amar ulla en yerushalayim nifdet ella bitzdaka shenneemar tziyyon bemishpat tippade veshaveha bitzdaka
Amar rav pappa i batli yehire batli amgushe i batli dayyane batli gezirpate
I batli yehire batli amgushe dichtiv veetzrof kabbor sigayich
I batli dayyane batli gezirpate dichtiv hesir Adonai mishpatayich pinna oyevech

Amar rabbi mallay mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon may dichtiv shavar Adonai matte reshaim shevet moshlim shavar Adonai matte reshaim ellu haddayyanin shennaasu makkel lechazzanehem shevet moshlim ellu talmide chachamim shebbemishpechot haddayyanin mar zutra amar ellu talmide chachamim shemlammedim hilchot tzibur ledayyane bur
Amar rabbi eliezer ben mallay mishshum resh lakish may dichtiv ki chappechem negoalu vaddam veetzbeotechem beaon siftotechem dibberu sheker leshonchem avela tehge
Ki chappechem negoalu vaddam ellu haddayyanin veetzbeotechem beaon ellu sofre haddayyanin siftotechem devaro sheker ellu orche haddayyanin leshonchem avela tehge ellu baali dinin
Veamar rabbi mallay mishshum rabbi yitzchak magdelaa miyyom shepperash yosef meechav lo taam taam yayin dichtiv ulkodkod nezir echav
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar af hen lo taamu taam yayin dichtiv vayyishtu vayyishkeru immo mikkelal dead haidana la hava shichrut veidach shichrut hu dela hava shetiyyah miha hava
Vaamar rabbi mallay bischar veraacha vesamach belibbo zacha lechoshen hammishpat al libbo
Shelachu leh bene bashkar lelevi kila mahu keshuta becharma mahu met beom tov mahu
Addeazel nach nafsheh delevi amar shemuel lerav menashsheya i chakkimatte shelach lehu shelach lehu kila chazarnu al kol tzide kila velo matzinu lah tzad heter
Velishlach lehu kidrame bar yechezkel lefi sheenan bene tora

Keshuta becharma irbuva velishlach lehu kidrabbi tarfon detanya keshut rabbi tarfon omer en kilayim bakkerem vachachamim omrim kilayim bakkerem vekayema lan kol hammekel baaretz halacha kemoto bechutz laaretz lefi sheenan bene tora
Machriz rav hay man devae lemizra keshuta becharma lizra rav amram chasida menagged ilaveh
Rav mesharsheya yahev leh peruta letinok goy vezara leh veliten leh letinok yisrael ate lemisrach veliten leh legadol goy ate leichallofe beyisrael
Met shelach lehu met lo yitasseku bo lo yehudain velo armain lo beom tov rishon velo beom tov sheni
Ini vehaamar rabbi yehuda bar shilat amar rabbi assi ovada hava beve chenishta demaon beom tov hassamuch lashshabbat
b: Vela yadana i millefaneha i milleachareha vaato lekammeh derabbi yochanan vaamar lehu yitassekun beh ammin
Veamar rava met beom tov rishon yitasseku bo ammin beom tov sheni yitasseku bo yisrael vaafilu beom tov sheni shel rosh hashshana ma sheen ken bevetza lefi sheenan bene tora
Amar rabbi avin bar rav huna amar rav chama bar gurya mitattef adam bechila uvchiskaseha veotze lirshut harabbim beshabbat veeno choshesh
May shena midderav huna deamar rav huna amar rav hayyotze betallit sheenah metzuyyetzet kehilchatah beshabbat chayyav chattat tzitzit legabbe tallit chashivi vela batli hane la chashivi uvatli
Amar rabba bar rav huna maarim adam al hamshammeret beom tov litlot bah rimmonim vetole bah shemarim amar rav ashe vehu detala bah rimmonim
May shena meha detanya metilin shechar bammoed letzorech hammoed shello letzorech hammoed asur echad shechar temarim veechad shechar seorim af al pi sheyyesh lahen yashan maarim veshote min hechadash
Hatam la mochcha milta hacha mochcha milta

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav ashe chazi mar hay tzurba merabbanan verav huna ben rabbi chiyyon shemeh veamri lah rav huna berabbi chilon shemeh deshakel bera detuma umannach bevarza dedanna veamar leatztzenoeh kamikavena veazel venaem bemabbara veavar lehach gisa vesayar pire veamar ana lemenam kamikavena
Amar lehu haarama kaamratte haarama bidrabbanan hi vetzurba merabbanan la ate lemibad lechattechila
Matni notnin mayim al gabbe hashshemarim bishvil sheyyitztzollu umsannenin et hayyayin besudarin uvichfifa mitzrit
Venotnin betza bimsannenet shel chardal veosin enomelin beshabbat rabbi yehuda omer bashshabbat bechos beom tov belagin uvammoed bechavit rabbi tzadok omer hakkol lefi haorchin
Gema amar zeeri noten adam yayin tzalul umayim tzelulin letoch hamshammeret beshabbat veeno choshesh aval achurin la
Metivi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer tored adam chavit shel yayin yenah ushmareha venoten letoch hamshammeret bashshabbat veeno choshesh targemah zeeri ben haggitot shanu
Mesannenin et hayyayin besudarin amar rav shimi bar chiyya uvilvad shello yaase gumma
Uvichfifa mitzrit amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav uvilvad shello yagbiha mikkarkaito shel keli tefach
Amar rav hay peronka appalgeh dechubba shere akkulleh kubba asir
Amar rav pappa la nihaddak inish tzinyata befummeh dechuzanta dechavita mishshum demechze kimshammeret
Deve rav pappa shafu shichra mimmana lemana amar leh rav acha middifti leravina haika nitzotzot nitzotzot leve rav pappa la chashivi
Venotnin betza bimsannenet tane yaakov karcha

a: Lefi sheen osin otah ella legaven
Itmar chardal shellasho meerev shabbat lemachar amar rav memacho bichli aval lo bayyad
Amar leh shemuel bayyad attu kol yoma beyad memachu leh maachal chamorim hu ella amar shemuel memacho bayyad veeno memacho bichli
Ittemar rabbi elazar amar echad ze veechad ze asur verabbi yochanan amar echad ze veechad ze muttar abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu en halacha kerabbi yochanan
Kam rabbi yochanan beshitteh derabbi elazar kam rabbi elazar beshitteh dishmuel abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu halacha kerabbi yochanan

Imeh deabbaye avada leh vela achal devethu dizira avada leh lerav chiyya bar ashe vela achal amara leh lerabbach avadi leh vaachal veatte la achlatte amar rava bar sheva hava kaemna kammeh deravina uvchashi leh beshufta detuma vaachal
Amar mar zutra let hilcheta kechol hane shematata ella ki ha deittemar chardal shellasho meerev shabbat lemachar memacho ben bayyad ben bichli venoten letocho devash velo yitrof ella mearev

Shachalayim sheshshechakan meerev shabbat lemachar noten letochan shemen vachometz umamshich letochan ammita velo yitrof ella mearev shum sherisko meerev shabbat lemachar noten letocho pol ugrisin velo yishchok ella mearev umamshich et ammita letochan may ammita ninya amar abbaye shema minah hay ninya mealleya letachle

Veosin enomelin beshabbat tanu rabbanan osin enomelin beshabbat veen osin aluntit veezo hi enomelin veezo hi aluntit enomelin yayin udvash ufilpelin aluntit yayin yashan umayim tzelulin vaafarsemon deavdi leve massuta lemekar

Amar rav yosef zimna chada allit batar mar ukva leve vane ki nefaki atay ashkeyan chamra chad kasa vechashshi mibbinta dereshi vead tufra dechari vei ashkeyan kasa acharina havay mistefena dilma menakku li mizzachvata dealma deate veha mar ukva deshate kol yoma shane mar ukva dedash beh
Matni en shorin et hachiltit befoshrin aval noten letoch hachometz veen sholin et hakkarshinin velo shafin otan aval noten letoch hakkevara o letoch hakkalkala
En kovrin et hatteven bichvara velo yittenennu al gabbe makom gavoha bishvil sheyyered hammotz aval notel hu bakkevara venoten letoch haevus
Gema ibaya lehu shara may targema rav adda narshaa kammeh derav yosef shara chayyav chattat
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta shera umtza bemayya hachi name demichayyav ella amar abbaye midderabbanan shello yaase kederech shehu ose bachol
Bea mineh rabbi yochanan merabbi yannay mahu lishrot et hachiltit betzonen amar leh asur veha anan tenan en shorin et hachiltit befoshrin ha betzonen muttar
Amar leh im ken ma ben li velach matnitin yechidaa hi detanya en shorin et hachiltit lo bechammin velo betzonen rabbi yose omer bechammin asur betzonen muttar

Lemay avdi leh leukra deliba rav acha bar yosef chash beukra deliba ata lekammeh demar ukva amar leh zil sheti telata tikle chiltita bitlata yome azal ishti chamsha beshabbeta umaale shabbeta letzafra azal sheal be midresha amaru leh tana deve rav adda veamri lah tana deve mar bar rav adda shote adam kav o kabbayim veeno choshesh

Amar lehu lishtot la kamibaya li ki ka mibaya li lishrot may amar lehu rav chiyya bar avin bedidi hava ovada vaatay sheelteh lerav adda bar ahava vela hava bideh atay sheelteh lerav huna vaamar hachi kaamar rav shore betzonen umanniach bachamma
Keman deshare afilu leman deasar hane mile hecha dela ishti kelal aval hacha kevan deishti chamsha umaale shabbeta i la shate beshabbat mistakkan

Mistemich veazel rav acha bar yosef akkatpeh derav nachman bar yitzchak bar achateh amar leh ki matenan leve rav safra ayelinan ki meto ayeleh bea mineh mahu lechaskose kitanita beshabbeta lerakkoche kitanita ka mikaven veshappir dame o dilma leolode chivara kamikaven vaasir amar leh lerakkoche ka mikaven veshappir dame
Ki nefak ata amar leh may bea mar mineh amar leh beay mineh mahu lechaskose kitanita beshabbeta vaamar li shappir dame
Vetibbee leh lemar sudara sudara la ka mibaya li divay merav huna ufshat li
Vetipshit leh lemar missudara amar leh hatam michze ki olode chivara hacha la michze keolode chivara
Amar rav chisda hay kitanita
b: Mishlefa ledidah mikkanya shere kanya minah asir amar rava veim keli kivae hu muttar
Amar rav chisda hay kishta deyarka i chazya lemaachal behema shere letaltolah vei la asir
Amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav hay talya devisra shere letaltoleh dechavere asir
Amar rav kattina haomed baemtza hammitta keilu omed bichresah shel ishsha velav milta hi
Veamar rav chisda bar be rav dezaven yarka lizben aricha kisha ki chisha veurka mimmela
Veamar rav chisda bar be rav dezaven kanya lizben aricha tuna ki tuna veurka mimmela

Veamar rav chisda bar be rav dela nefisha leh rifta la lechol yarka mishshum degarer veamar rav chisda ana la baaniyyuti achali yarka vela beattiruti achali yarka baaniyyuti mishshum degarer beattiruti deamena hecha deayel yarka leul bisra vechavere

Veamar rav chisda bar be rav dela nefisha leh rifta la livtza batztzoe veamar rav chisda bar be rav dela nefisha leh rifta la livtza may tama dela aved beayin yafa veamar rav chisda ana meikara la havay batzana ad dishday yadi bechulle mana veashkachi beh kol tzurki

Veamar rav chisda hay man deefshar leh lemechal nahama disare veachal dechite kaavar mishshum bal tashchit veamar rav pappa hay man deefshar lemishte shichra veshate chamra over mishshum bal tashchit velav milta hi bal tashchit degufa adif
Veamar rav chisda bar be rav delet leh mishcha nimshe bemayya dacharitzi
Veamar rav chisda bar be rav dezaven umtza lizben unka deit beh telata mine visra
Veamar rav chisda bar be rav dezaven kitonita lizban middinhar abba venichavverah kol telatin yomin dimfatteya leh teresar yarche shatta vaana arva may kitonita kita naa
Veamar rav chisda bar be rav la litiv atztzipta chadta dimchalleya maneh
Veamar rav chisda bar be rav la lishaddar maneh leushpizeh lechauoreh leh delav orach ara dilma chaze beh mide veate lemigganneya
Amar lehu rav chisda livnateh tihveyan tzenian beappe gavrayechu la techlun nahama beappe gavrayechu
La techlun yarka belelya la techlun tamre belelya vela tishton shichra belelya vela tipnon hecha demippenu gavrayechu
Vechi ka kare inish abbava la temrun mannu ella manni
Naket marganita bachada yedeh vechura bachada yedeh marganita achvi lehu vechura la achvi lehu ad demitztaaran vahadar achvi lehu
En sholin et hakkarshinin matnitin dela chi hay tanna detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer en mashgichin bakkevara kol ikar
Matni gorfin millifne happattam umsallekin litzdadin mippene hari divre rabbi dosa vachachamim osrin notlin millifne behema zo venotnin lifne behema zo beshabbat
Gema ibaya lehu rabbanan aresha peligi o assefa peligi o attarvayehu peligi
Ta shema detanya vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze lo yesallekennu litzdadin

Amar rav chisda machaloket beevus shel karka aval beevus shel keli divre hakkol muttar veevus shel karka mi ika leman deshare ha ka mashve gummot ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav chisda machaloket beevus shel keli aval beevus shel karka divre hakkol asur
Venotlin millifne behema tena chada notlin millifne behema sheppiha yafe venotnin lifne behema sheppiha ra vetanya idach notlin millifne behema sheppiha ra venotnin lifne behema sheppiha yafe

Amar abbaye ide veide mikkamme chamra lekamme tora shaklinan mikkamme tora lekamme chamra la shaklinan veha dekatane notel millifne behema sheppiha yafe bachamor delet leh rire venotnin lifne behema sheppiha ra befara

a: Deit lah rire
Veha dekatane notlin millifne behema sheppiha ra bachamor dela dayek veachel venotnin lifne behema sheppiha yafe befara dedayeka veachla
Matni hakkash sheal gabbe hammitta lo yenaneennu beyado ella menaano begufo veim haya maachal behema o shehaya alav kar o sadin menaano beyado
Machbesh shel baale vattim mattirin aval lo kovshin veshel kovsin lo yigga bo rabbi yehuda omer im haya muttar meerev shabbat mattir et kullo veshomto
Gema amar rav nachman hay pugla millemala lematta shere millematta lemala asir

Amar rav adda bar abba amri be rav tenena dela kerav nachman hakkash sheal gabbe hammitta lo yenaanennu beyado aval menaano begufo veim haya maachal behema o shehaya alav kar o sadin menaano beyado shema minah tiltul min hatztzad la shemeh tiltul shema minah
Amar rav yehuda hane pilpele medak chada chada bekatta desakkina shere tarte asir rava amar kevan dimshanne afilu tuva name
Amar rav yehuda man desache bemayya linaggev nafsheh beresha vahadar lislek dilma ate leetoye arba ammot becharmelit
I hachi ki ka nachet name ka dache kocho arba ammot vaasir kocho becharmelit la gezaru
Amar abbaye veitema rav yehuda tit sheal gabbe raglo mekannecho bakkarka veen mekannecho bakkotel
Amar rava may tama bakkotel la mishshum demechze kevone ha binyan chaklaa hu
Ella amar rava mekannecho bakkotel veen mekannecho bakkarka dilma ate leashoye gummot
Itmar mar bereh deravina amar echad ze veechad ze asur rav pappa amar echad ze veechad ze muttar
Lemar bereh deravina bemay mekannechi leh mekannechi leh bekora
Amar rava la litiv inish appummeh delichya dilma migandera leh chefetz veate leetoye
Veamar rava la litzadded inish kubba dilma ate leashoye gummot
Veamar rava la lihaddek inish udra befumma deshisha dilma ate lide sechita
Amar rav kahana tit sheal gabbe bigdo mechaskeso mibbifnim veen mechaskeso mibbachutz
Metivi tit sheal gabbe minalo megarro begav sakkin vesheal bigdo megarro betzipporen uvilvad shello yechaskes may lav shello yechaskes kelal la shello yechaskes mibbachutz ella mibbifnim
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi yannay megarrin minal chadash aval lo yashan
b: Bamme megarro amar rabbi avahu begav sakkin

Amar leh hahu sava semi didach mikkamme ha detane rabbi chiyya en megarrin lo minal chadash velo minal yashan velo yasuch et raglo shemen vehu betoch hamminal o betoch hassandal aval sach et raglo shemen umanniach betoch hamminal o betoch hassandal vesach kol gufo shemen umitaggel al gabbe katvulya veeno choshesh
Amar rav chisda lo shanu ella letzachtzecho aval leabbedo asur
Leabbedo peshita vetu letzachtzecho mi ika man deshare
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav chisda lo shanu ella shiur letzachtzecho aval shiur leabbedo asur
Tanu rabbanan lo yetze katan beminal gadol aval yotze hu bechaluk gadol
Velo tetze ishsha beminal meruppat velo tachalotz bo veim chaltza chalitzatah keshera
Veen yotzin beminal chadash beeze minal amru beminal shel ishsha
Tane bar kappara lo shanu ella shello yatza bo shaa achat mibbeod yom aval yatza bo meerev shabbat muttar
Tane chada shomtin minal meal gabbe emus vetanya idach en shomtin la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ha rabbanan
Ditnan minal sheal gabbe emus rabbi eliezer metaher vachachamim metammeim
Hanicha lerava deamar davar shemmelachto leisur ben letzorech gufo ben letzorech mekomo muttar shappir
Ella leabbaye deamar letzorech gufo muttar letzorech mekomo asur may ika lememar
Hacha bemay askinan berafuy detanya rabbi yehuda omer im haya rafuy muttar
Tama derafuy ha lo rafuy la hanicha leabbaye deamar davar shemmelachto leisur letzorech gufo muttar letzorech mekomo asur shappir
Ella lerava deamar ben letzorech gufo ben letzorech mekomo muttar may irya rafuy afilu lo rafuy name
Derabbi yehuda mishshum derabbi eliezer hu detanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer im haya rafuy muttar
Matni notel adam et beno vehaeven beyado vechalkalla vehaeven betochah umtaltelin teruma temea im hattehora veim hachullin
Rabbi yehuda omer af maalin et hamdumma beechad umea
Gema amar rava hotzi tinok chay vechis taluy betzavaro chayyav mishshum kis tinok met vechis taluy lo betzavaro patur
Tinok chay vechis taluy lo betzavaro chayyav mishshum kis velichayyav name mishshum tinok
Rava kerabbi natan sevira leh deamar chay nose et atzmo
Velivtal kis legabbe tinok mi la tenan et hachay bammitta patur af al hammitta shehammitta tefela lo
Mitta legabbe chay mevatteli leh kis legabbe tinok la mevatteli leh
Tinok met vechis taluy lo betzavaro patur velichayyav mishshum tinok rava kerabbi shimon sevira leh deamar kol melacha sheen tzarich legufah patur aleha
Tenan notel adam et beno vehaeven beyado amri deve rabbi yannay betinok sheyyesh lo gaaguin al aviv
I hachi

a: May irya even afilu dinar name allema amar rava lo shanu ella even aval dinar asur even i nafla lah la ate avuh leetoye dinar i nafel ate avuh leetoye
Tanya keoteh derava hammotzi kelav mekuppalim umunnachim al ketefo vesandalav vetabbeotav beyado chayyav veim haya melubbash bahen patur
Hammotzi adam vechelav alav vesandalav beraglav vetabbeotav beyadav patur veilu hotzian kemot shehen chayyav

Kalkalla vehaeven betochah veammay tehve kalkala basis ledavar haasur amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan hacha bechalkalla melea perot askinan velishdinhu lefere venishde leeven veninketinhu beyadayim kidrabbi ilay amar rav beferot hammitannefin hacha name beferot hammitannefin
Velinaarinhu naore amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rava hacha bechalkalla pechuta askinan deeven gufah naaset dofen lakkalkalla
Metaltelin teruma vechu amar rav chisda lo shanu ella shettehora lematta utmea lemala aval tehora lemala utmea lematta shakel leh lithora veshavek leh litmea
Vechi tehora lematta name lishdinhu velinketinhu amar rabbi ilay amar rav beferot hammitannefin askinan
Metivi metaltelin teruma temea im hattehora veim hachullin ben shettehora lemala utmea lematta ben shettemea lemala uthora lematta teuvta derav chisda
Amar lecha rav chisda matnitin letzorech gufo barayeta letzorech mekomo
May duchkeh derav chisda leokome matnitin letzorech gufo

Amar rava matnitin keoteh dayeka dekatane sefa maot sheal hakkar menaer et hakkar vehen noflot veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella letzorech gufo aval letzorech mekomo metaltelo veodan alav umiddesefa letzorech gufo resha name letzorech gufo
Rabbi yehuda omer af maalin vechu veammay ha ka metakken
Rabbi yehuda kerabbi eliezer sevira leh deamar teruma beenah machata
Ditnan sea teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea venidmeu venafal min hamdumma lemakom acher rabbi eliezer omer medammaat kitrumat vadday
Vachachamim omrim en hamdumma medammea ella lefi cheshbon
Emar deshamatte leh lechumra lekulla mi shamatte leh
Ella hu deamar kerabbi shimon keditnan sea teruma shennafla lemea velo hispik lehagbiha ad shennafla acheret hare zo asura verabbi shimon mattir

Umimmay dilma hatam beha kamipalgi detanna kamma savar af al gav denaflu baze achar ze keman denafal bevat achat dame veha lechamshin nefala veha lechamshin nefala verabbi shimon savar kammayeta betil bima veha tivtel bima vechad
Ella hu deamar kerabbi shimon ben elazar detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer noten enav betzad ze veochel mitztzad acher
Umi savar leh keoteh
b: Veha miflag pelig ilaveh detanya rabbi yehuda omer maalin et hamdumma beechad umea rabbi shimon ben elazar omer noten enav betzad ze veochel mitztzad acher
Derabbi yehuda adifa midderabbi shimon ben elazar
Matni haeven sheal pi hechavit mattah al tziddah vehi nofelet hayeta ben hechaviyyot magbihah umattah al tziddah vehi nofelet
Maot sheal hakkar menaer et hakkar vehen noflot hayeta alav lishleshet mekannechah bismartut hayeta shel or notnin aleha mayim ad shettichle
Gema amar rav huna amar rav lo shanu ella beshocheach aval bemanniach naasa basis ledavar haasur
Hayeta ben hechaviyyot ku man tanna dechol hecha deika isura vehetera behetera tarchinan beisura la tarchinan
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan rabban shimon ben gamliel hi ditnan habborer kitnit beom tov bet shammay omrim borer ochel veochel uvet hillel omrim borer kedarko becheko uvattamchuy
Vetanya amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim shehaochel merubbe al happesolet aval pesolet merubba al haochel divre hakkol borer ochel
Veha hacha dechi ochel merubbe al happesolet dame
Hacha name kevan dei bae lemishkal la mishtekil leh yayin ad deshakel lah leeven kifsolet merubba al haochel dame

Ema sefa sefog im yesh lo bet achiza mekannechin bo veim lav en mekannechin bo atan lerabbi yehuda deamar davar sheen mitkaven asur
Beha afilu rabbi shimon mode deabbaye verava deamri tarvayehu mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut

Amar rabba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mode haya rabbi yehuda lachachamim bezetim vaanavim umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bishar perot
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi abba ella bemay peligi amar leh lechi tashkach amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mistabbera betutim verimmonim peligi

Detanya zetim shemmashach mehen shemen vaanavim shemmashach mehen yayin vehichnisan ben leochel ben lemashkin hayyotze mehen asur tutim shemmashach mehen mayim verimmonim shemmashach mehen yayin vehichnisan laochalin hayyotze mehen muttar lemashkin velistam hayyotze mehen asur divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim ben laochalin ben lemashkin hayyotze mehen asur
Vesavar rabbi yehuda setam asur vehatnan chalev haishsha metamme leratzon veshello leratzon chalev behema eno metamme ella leratzon

Amar rabbi akiva kal vachomer hu ume chalev haishsha sheeno meuchad ella liktannim metamme leratzon veshello leratzon chalev habbehema shemuchad ben liktannim ben ligdolim eno din sheyetamme ben leratzon uven shello leratzon amru lo im tame chalev haishsha shello leratzon sheddam maggefatah tame yetamme chalev habbehema

a: Shello leratzon sheddam maggefatah tahor amar lahen machmir ani bechalav mibbaddam shehacholev lirfua tame vehammakkiz lirfua tahor amru lo salle zetim vaanavim yochichu shehammashkin hayyotzin mehen leratzon temein shello leratzon tehorim

Lo leratzon bistama shello leratzon degalli addateh deamar la nicha li veibaet ema shane salle zetim vaanavim kevan dilibud kayemi meikara afkore mafkar lehu
Ashkechan rabbi yehuda demode lerabbanan bezetim uvaanavim rabbanan demodu leh lerabbi yehuda bishar perot menalan detanya sochatin
b: Bifgain uvifrishin uvuzradin aval lo berimmonim veshel bet menashsheya bar menachem hau sochatin berimmonim

Umimmay derabbanan hi dilma rabbi yehuda hi veteheve name rabbi yehuda emar deshamatte leh lerabbi yehuda yatzu meatzman sochatin lechattechila mi shamatte leh ella may it lach lememar kevan delav bene sechita ninhu afilu lechattechila afilu tema rabbanan kevan delav bene sechita ninhu afilu lechattechila shema minah rabbanan hi shema minah
Shel bet menashsheya bar menachem hau sochatin berimmonim amar rav nachman halacha keshel bet menashsheya bar menachem

Amar leh rava lerav nachman menashsheya ben menachem tanna hu vechi tema halacha ki hay tanna desavar lah keshel menashsheya ben menachem umishshum desavar kimnashsheya ben menachem halacha kemoto menashsheya ben menachem have rubba dealma

In ditnan hamkayyem kotzim bakkerem rabbi eliezer omer kiddesh vachachamim omrim eno mekaddesh ella davar shekkamohu mekayemin veamar rabbi chanina may tama derabbi eliezer shekken baaravya mekayemin kotze sadot ligmallehem
Mide irya daaravya atra hacha batla dato etzel kol adam

Ella hayenu tama kidrav chisda deamar rav chisda teradin shessechatan untanan bemikve poslin et hammikve beshinuy mare veha lav bene sechita ninhu ella may it lach lememar kevan deachshevinhu hau lehu mashke hacha name kevan deachshevinhu hau lehu mashke
Rav pappa amar mishshum dehave davar sheen osin mimmennu mikve lechattechila vechol davar sheen osin mimmennu mikve lechattechila posel et hammikve beshinuy mare

Tenan hatam nafal letocho yayin o chometz umochal veshina marav pasul man tanna demochal mashke hu amar abbaye rabbi yaakov hi detanya rabbi yaakov omer mochal hare hu kemashke uma taam amru mochal hayyotze battechilla tahor lefi sheeno rotze bekiyyumo
Rabbi shimon omer mochal eno kemashke uma taam amru mochal hayyotze meikul bet habbad tame lefi shei efshar lo belo tzichtzuche shemen
May benayehu ika benayehu deate batar itztzata rava amar mishshum dehave davar sheen osin hemennu mikve ufosel et hammikve beshinuy mare

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel sochet adam eshkol shel anavim letoch hakkedera aval lo letoch hakkeara amar rav chisda middivre rabbenu nilmad cholev adam ez letoch hakkedera aval lo letoch hakkeara alma kasavar mashke habba leochel ochel hu
Metiv rame bar chama zav shecholev et haez hechalav tame vei amratte mashke habba laochalin ochel hu bemay itachshar
Kidamar rabbi yochanan betipa hamluchlechet al pi haddad hacha name betipa hamluchlechet al pi haddad
Metiv ravina teme met shessachat zetim vaanavim

a: Kevetza mechuvenet tahor ha yoter mikkevetza tame vei amratte mashke habba leochel ochel hu bemay itachshar hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah besochet letoch hakkeara
Amar rabbi yirmeya ketannae hammachalik baanavim lo huchshar rabbi yehuda omer huchshar may lav beha kamipalgi mar savar mashke habba leochel ochel hu umar savar lav ochel hu

Leda im higgiu zetav limsok im lav lo huchshar rabbi yehuda omer huchshar may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar mashke haomed leibud mashke hu umar savar lav mashke hu
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hane tannae bemashke haomed leibud peligi vehanach tannae bemashke haomed letzachtzecho kamipalgi
Amar rabbi zera amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav sochet adam eshkol shel anavim letoch hakkedera aval lo letoch hakkeara vedag letziro afilu letoch hakkeara

Yatev rav dimi vekaamar lah leha shemata amar leh abbaye lerav dimi attun mishshemeh derav matnitun vela kashya lechu anan mishshemeh dishmuel matninan lah vekashya lan mi amar shemuel dag letziro afilu letoch hakkeara vehaitmar kevashim shessechatan amar rav legufan muttar lememehen patur aval asur
Ushlakot ben legufan ben lememehen muttar ushmuel amar echad kevashim veechad shelakot legufan muttar lememehen patur aval asur
Amar leh haelohim enay rau velo zar kalu chilotay becheki vego mippummeh derabbi yirmeya shemia li verabbi yirmeya merabbi zera verabbi zera merav chiyya bar ashe verav chiyya bar ashe merav

Vehacha menalan diglo detanya rabbi yehuda omer chamishshim ushtayim shana lo avar ish bihuda shenneemar al heharim essa vechi vanehi vego meof hashshamayim vead behema naddu halachu behema begimatriyya chamshin vetarten hau
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan kullan chazru chutz mikkolyas haispenin daamar rav hane midre devavel mehadderi mayya leen etam vehay kevan dela sharir shidreh la matze salek

Mippene ma moadim shebbevavel semechim mippene shello hau beotah kelala dichtiv vehishbatti kol mesosah chaggah chodshah veshabbattah vechol moadah uchtiv chodshechem umoadechem sana nafshi hau alay latorach may hau alay latorach amar rabbi elazar amar hakkadosh baruch hu lo dayyan leyisrael shechotin lefanay ella shemmatrichin oti leda ezo gezera kasha avi alehen amar rabbi yitzchak en lecha kol regel varegel shello bata boleshet letzipori veamar rabbi chanina en lecha kol regel varegel shello ba litverya agmon vekomton uvaal zemora

Mippene ma goyim mezohamin shello amdu al har sinay shebbeshaa
