Matni shover adam et hechavit leechol hemenna gerogrot uvilvad shello yitkaven laasot keli veen nokvin megufa shel chavit divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim mattirin velo yikkevenna mitztziddah veim hayeta nekuva lo yitten aleha shaava mippene shehu memareach amar rabbi yehuda maase ba lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay baarav veamar choshshani lo mechattat
Gema amar rabbi oshaya lo shanu ella derusot aval meforadot lo umforadot lo
Metivi rabbi shimon ben gamliel omer mevi adam et hechavit shel yayin umattiz roshah besayif umannichah lifne haorchim beshabbat veeno choshesh hahi rabbanan matnitin rabbi nechemya hi
Umay duchkeh derabbi oshaya leokome matnitin kerabbi nechemya uvidrusot lokmah bimforadot verabbanan amar rava matnitin keshiteh may irya detane gerogrot litne perot ella shema minah bidrusot

Tanya chada chotalot shel gerogrot veshel temarim mattir umafkia vechotech vetanya idach mattir aval lo mafkia velo chotech la kashya ha rabbanan ha rabbi nechemya detanya rabbi nechemya omer afilu tarod vaafilu tallit vaafilu sakkin en nitalin ella letzorech tashmishan
Beo mineh merav sheshet mahu lemivraz chavita bevurteya beshabbeta lefitcha kamikaven vaasir o dilma leayin yafa kamikaven ushre amar leh lefitcha ka mechaven vaasir
Metivi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mevi adam chavit shel yayin umattiz roshah besayif hatam vadday leayin yafa kamikaven hacha im ita dilayin yafa kamikaven liftecheh miftach

En nokvin megufa vechu amar rav huna machaloket lemala aval min hatztzad divre hakkol asur vehayenu dekatane lo yikkevenna mitztziddah verav chisda amar machaloket min hatztzad aval al gabbah divre hakkol muttar veha dekatane lo yikkevenna mitztziddah hatam begufah dechavit

Tanu rabbanan en nokvin nekev chadash beshabbat veim ba lehosif mosif veyesh omrim en mosifin veshavin shennokvin nekev yashan lechattechila vetanna kamma may shena minnekev chadash dela deka metakken pitcha osofe name ka metakken pitcha

Amar rabba devar tora kol petach sheeno asuy lehachnis ulhotzi eno petach verabbanan hu digzur mishshum lul shel tarnegolin deaved leayyole avera ulappoke havla veim ba lehosif mosif osofe vadday belul shel tarnegolim la ate leosofe
b: Mishshum richsha veyesh omrim en mosifim zimnin dela takkeneh meikara veate learoche beh daresh rav nachman mishshum rabbi yochanan halacha keyesh omrim

Amar leh abbaye lerava tanya dimsayya lach bayit satum yesh lo arba ammot paratz et patztzimav en lo arba ammot bayit satum eno metamme kol sevivav paratz et patztzimav metamme kol sevivav

Guvta rav asar ushmuel share mechattech lechattechilla dechulle alma la peligi daasir ahdore dechulle alma la peligi dishre ki peligi dachaticha vela metakkena man deasar gazrinan dilma ate lemichtach lechattechilla uman deshare la gazrinan
Ketannae en chotchin shefoferet beom tov veen tzarich lomar beshabbat nafla en machazirin otah beshabbat veen tzarich lomar beom tov verabbi yoshiyya mekel

Rabbi yoshiyya aheya ilema aresha ha kamtakken mana ella assefa tanna kamma name mishre kashare ella dachaticha vela metakkena ika benayehu mar savar gazrinan umar savar la gazrinan darash rav shisha bereh derav ide mishshemeh derabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yoshiyya

Veim hayeta nekuva vechu mishcha rav asar ushmuel share man deasar gazrinan mishshum shaava uman deshare la gazrinan amar leh rav shemuel bar bar chana lerav yosef beferush amarte lan mishshemeh derav mishcha shere
Amar tavut rishba amar shemuel hay tirfa deassa asur may tama rav yemar middifti amar gezera mishshum marzev rav ashe amar gezera shemma yiktom may benayehu ika benayehu diktim umannach
Be sadya rav asar ushmuel share berakkin dechulle alma la peligi dishre bekashin dechulle alma la peligi daasir ki peligi bemitze man deasar michze kemassoy uman deshare la michze kemassoy

Veha derav lav beferush itmar ella mikkelala itmar derav ikla lehahu atra dela hava leh ravecha nefak yetev becharmelit ayeto leh be sadya la yetev man dachaza savar mishshum deve sadya asir vela hi derav achroze machriz be sadya shere umishshum kevod rabbotenu lo yashav alav uman ninhu rav kahana verav assi

En machshichin tanu rabbanan maase bechasid echad shennifretza lo pirtza betoch sadehu venimlach aleha legodrah venizkar sheshshabbat hu venimna oto chasid velo gedarah venaasa lo nes vealta bo tzalaf umimmenna hayeta parnasato ufarnasat anshe veto
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel muttar laadam lomar lachavero lichrach peloni ani holech lemachar sheim yesh burganin holech

Tenan en machshichin al hattechum liskor poalim ulhavi perot bishlama liskor poalim divshabbat la matze agar ella lehavi perot lema sheim yesh sham mechitzot mevi mashkachatte lah beferot hamchubbarim
Vehatane rabbi oshaya en machshichin al hattechum lehavi teven vakash bishlama kash mashkachatte lah bimchubbar ella teven hechi mashkachatte lah betivna sarya
Ta shema machshichin al hattechum lefakkeach al iske challa veal iske hammet al iske challa vamet in al iske acher la
Bishlama acher dumya dechalla mashkachatte lah lemegaz leh assa ella met may nihu lehavi lo aron vetachrichin vekatane met in aval acher la
Veammay lema sheim yesh sham mechitzot mevi met name mashkachatte lah lemegaz leh gelima

Aval machshichin veaf al gav dela avdel vehaamar rabbi elazar ben antignos mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov asur lo laadam sheyyaase chafatzav kodem sheyyavdil vechi tema deavdel bitfilla vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel hammavdil battefilla tzarich sheyyavdil al hakkos vechi tema deavdel al hakkos kos bassade mi ika targema rabbi natan bar amme kammeh derava ben haggitot shanu
Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe bemareva amrinan hachi hammavdil ben kodesh lechol veavdinan tzurkin amar rav ashe ki havena be rav kahana hava amar hammavdil ben kodesh lechol umsalletinan silte
Kelal amar abba shaul kol sheani vechu ibaya lehu abba shaul aheya ilema aresha kae en machshichin al hattechum liskor poalim lehavi perot

a: Hay kol sheani zakkay baamirato rashshay ani bachashichatv kol sheeni zakkay baamirato eni rashshay bachashichato mibe leh ella assefa kae aval machshich hu lishmor umevi perot beyado hay kol sheani zakkay bachashichato rashshay ani baamirato mibe leh

Leolam assefa kae veabba shaul aha kae deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel muttar laadam lomar lachavero shemor li perot shebbitchumcha vaani eshmor lecha perot shebbitchumi vekaamar abba shaul letanna kamma mi la modet demuttar adam lomar lachavero shemor li perot shebbitchumcha vaani eshmor lecha perot shebbitchumi

Veema kol sheani zakkay baamirato rashshay ani lehachshich alav kelal leetoye may leetoye ha detanu rabbanan en machshichin al hattechum lehavi behema hayeta omedet chutz lattechum kore lah vehi baa kelal amar abba shaul kol sheani zakkay baamirato rashshay ani lehachshich alav

Umachshichin lefakkeach al iske kalla veal iske hammet lehavi lo aron vetachrichin veomrim lo lech lemakom peloni veim lo matzata bemakom peloni have mimmakom peloni lo matzata bemane have bematayim rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer uvilvad shello yazkir lo sechum mikkach

Matni machshichin al hattechum lefakkeach al iske kalla veal iske hammet lehavi lo aron vetachrichim goy shehevi chalilin beshabbat lo yispod bahen yisrael ella im ken bau mimmakom karov asu lo aron vechafru lo kever yikkaver bo yisrael veim bishvil yisrael lo yikkaver bo olamit
Gema may mimmakom karov rav amar mimmakom karov mammash ushmuel amar chayeshinan shemma chutz lachoma lanu
Dayeka matnitin keoteh dishmuel dekatane asa lo aron vechafar lo kever yikkaver bo yisrael alma missefeka shere hacha name missefeka shere

Vetanya keoteh derav ir sheyyisrael vegoyim darim bah vehayeta bah merchatz hammarchetzet beshabbat im rov goyim laerev rochetz bah miyyad im rov yisrael yamtin ad kede sheyyechammu chammin mechetza al mechetza asur veyamtin ad kede sheyyechammu chammin rabbi yehuda omer beambati ketanna im yesh bah reshut rochetz bah miyyad

May reshut amar rav yehuda amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda im yesh bah adam chashuv sheyyesh lo asara avadim shemmechammemin lo asara kumkumin bevat achat beambati ketanna muttar lirchotz bah miyyad
Asu lo aron vechafru lo kever vechu ammay hacha name yamtin bichde sheyyeasu amar ulla beomed beasratya tinach kever aron may ika lememar amar rabbi avahu bemutal al kivro
Matni osin kol tzorche hammet sachin umdichin oto uvilvad shello yaziz bo ever shomtin et hakkar mittachtav umtilin oto al hachol bishvil
b: Sheyyamtin koshrin et hallechi lo sheyyaale ella shello yosif vechen kora shennishbera somchin otah besafsal o baarukkot hammitta lo shettaale ella shello tosif

Gema vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel maase betalmido shel rabbi meir shennichnas acharav levet hammerchatz bikesh lehadiach karka amar lo en medichin lasuch karka amar lo en sachin karka bekarka michallefa met bekarka la michallaf
Kol leetoye may leetoye ha detanu rabbanan meviin keli mekar uchle mattachot umannichin al kereso kede shello tafuach ufokkin et nekavav kede shello tikanes bahen haruach
Veaf shelomo amar bechochmato ad shello yeratek chevel hakkesef ze chut hashshidra vetarutz gullat hazzahav ze amma vetishshaver kad al hammabbua ze hakkares venarotz haggalgal el habbor ze peresh

Vechen hu omer vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem amar rav huna veamri lah amar rav chagga ellu bene adam shemmannichin divre tora veosin kol yemehem kechaggim amar rabbi levi amar rav pappe amar rabbi yehoshua leachar shelosha yamim kereso nivkaat venofelet lo al panav veomeret lo tol ma shennatatta bi
Matni en meatztzemin et hammet bashshabbat velo bachol im yetziat nefesh vehamatztzem im yetziat hannefesh hare ze shofech damim

Gema tanu rabbanan hamatztzemo im yetziat hannefesh hare ze shofech damim mashal lener shekkava veholechet adam manniach etzbao aleha miyyad kavta tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer harotze sheyyitatztzemu enav shel met nofeach lo yayin bechotmo venoten shemen ben rise enav veochez bishne gudle raglav vehen mitatztzemin mealehen

Tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer tinok ben yomo chay mechallelin alav et hashshabbat david melech yisrael met en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat tinok ben yomo chay mechallelin alav et hashshabbat amra tora challel alav shabbat achat kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harbe david melech yisrael met en mechallelin alav kevan shemmet adam batel min hammitzot vehayenu deamar rabbi yochanan bammetim chofshi kevan shemmet adam naasa chofshi min hammitzot

Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer tinok ben yomo chay en tzarich leshomro min hachulda umin haachbarim aval og melech habbashan met tzarich leshomro min hachulda umin haachbarim shenneemar umoraachem vechittechem yihye kol zeman sheadam chay emato muttelet al habberiyyot kevan shemmet batla emato

Amar rav pappa nekitinan arye abbe tere la nafel ha ka chazenan denafel hahu kidrame bar abba deamar rame bar abba en chayya sholetet baadam ad shennidma lo kivhema shenneemar adam bikar bal yalin nimshal kabbehemot nidmu amar rabbi chanina asur lishan babbayit yechidi vechol hayyashen babbayit yechidi ochazto lilit

Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer ase ad sheatta motze umatzuy lecha veodcha beyadecha veaf shelomo amar bechochmato uzchor et borecha bime bechurotecha ad asher shelo yavou yeme haraa ellu yeme hazzikna vehiggiu shanim asher tomar en li vahem chefetz ellu yeme hammashiach sheen bahem lo zechut velo chova
Ufliga dishmuel deamar shemuel en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud malchiyyot bilvad shenneemar ki lo yechdal evon mikkerev haaretz

Tanya rabbi elazar hakkappar omer leolam yevakkesh adam rachamim al midda zo sheim hu lo ba ba beno veim beno lo ba ben beno ba shenneemar ki biglal haddavar hazze tana deve rabbi yishmael galgal hu shechozer baolam amar rav yosef nekitinan hay tzurba merabbanan la miane veha ka chazenan demiane im ita demiane ahdore appitcha la mahdar

Amar lah rabbi chiyya lidvethu ki ate anya akdimi leh rifta ki hechi delakdemu livnayich amara leh melat ka layetatte lehu amar lah kera ka ketiv ki biglal haddavar hazze vetana deve rabbi yishmael galgal hu shechozer baolam tanya rabbi gamliel berabbi omer venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha vehirbecha kol hamrachem al habberiyyot merachamin alav min hashshamayim vechol sheeno merachem al habberiyyot en merachamin alav min hashshamayim

Ad asher lo techshach hashshemesh vehaor zo paddachat vehachotem vehayyareach zo neshama vehakkochavim ellu hallesatot veshavu heavim achar haggashem zo meor enav shel adam sheholech achar habbechi amar shemuel hay dimata ad arbein shenin hadra mikkan veelach la hadra
Veamar rav nachman hay kuchla ad arbein shenin marvach mikkan veelach afilu mele keachsena degardae okome mokem aroche la marvach may ka mashma lan dechamma deallim mikkuchla tefe mealle

Rabbi chanina shechiva leh barteh la hava ka vache alah amara leh devethu tarnegolta appekte mibbetach amar lah tarte techala veivera savar lah ki ha daamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben katztzarta shesh demaot hen shalosh yafot veshalosh raot shel ashan veshel bechi

a: Veshel bet hakkisse raot shel sam veshel sechok veshel perot yafot

Bayyom sheyyazuu shomre habbayit vehitavvetu vego bayyom sheyyazuu shomre habbayit ellu hakkesalim vehatztzelaot vehitavvetu anshe hechayil ellu shokayim uvatlu hattochanot ellu shinayim vechashchu haroot baarubbot ellu enayim
Amar leh kesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya may tama la atet leve avidan amar leh tur telag sachranohi gelidin kalvohi la navchin tachanohi la tachanin be rav amri addela abbedna bacheshna

Tanya rabbi yose bar kisma omer tava tere mittelat vay lah lachada deazla vela atya may hi amar rav chisda yankuta ki ata rav dimi amar yankuta kelila devarda savuta kelila dechilfa tana mishshemeh derabbi meir dok bechakke vetashkach benigre shenneemar vannisba lechem vannihye tovim veraa lo rainu amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana shere sakkacha veayyel lachmach ad arbein shenin mechla mealle mikkan veelach mishteya mealle
Amar leh hahu gozaa lerabbi yehoshua ben korcha mehacha lekarchina kamma have amar leh kemehacha legozanya amar leh barcha karcha bearbea amar leh ikra shelifa bitmanya

Chazyeh dela sayem mesaneh amar leh deal sus melech deal chamor ben chorin udmanale beriglohi bar inish dela ha vela ha dachafir ukvir tav mineh amar leh goza goza telat amarte li telat shamatte hadrat panim zakan simchat lev ishsha nachalat Adonai banim baruch hammakom shemmenaacha mikkullam amar leh karcha metzave amar leh ikra shelifa tochecha

Amar leh rabbi lerabbi shimon ben chalafta mippene ma lo hikbalnu panecha baregel kederech shehikbilu avotay laavotecha amar leh selaim naasu gevohim kerovim naasu rechokim mishtayim naasu shalosh mesim shalom babbayit batal

Vesuggeru delatayim bashshuk vego ellu nekavav shel adam bishfal kol hattachana bishvil kurkevan sheeno tochen veyakum lekol hatztzippor sheafilu tzippor menaarto mishshenato veyishshachu kol benot hashshir sheafilu kol sharim vesharot domot alav kesicha

Veaf barzilay haggiladi amar ledavid ben shemonim shana anochi hayyom haeda ben tov lera mikkan sheddatan shel zekenim mishtannot im yitam avdecha et asher ochal veet asher eshte mikkan shessiftotehen shel zekenim mitrappetot im eshma od bekol sharim vesharot mikkan sheoznehem shel zekenim mitkabbedot

Amar rav barzilay haggiladi shakkara hava dehahi ammeta dahavay be rabbi bat tishin vetarten shenin vahavat taama kidra rava amar barzilay haggiladi shatuf bezimma hava vechol hashshatuf bezimma zikna kofetzet alav tanya rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer talmide chachamim kol zeman shemmazkinin chachma nittosefet bahem shenneemar bishishim chochma veorech yamim tevuna veamme haaretz kol zeman shemmazkinin tippeshut nittosefet bahen shenneemar mesir safa leneemanim vetaam zekenim yikkach

Gam miggavoha yirau sheafilu gavshushit ketanna doma alav kehare harim vechatchattim badderech beshaa shemmehallech badderech naasu lo tevahim veyanetz hashshaked zo kelivoset veyistabbel hechagav ellu agavot vetafer haaviyyona zo chemda

Rav kahana hava pasek sidra kammeh derav ki meta lehay kera neged veittenach amar shema minah betel leh chemdeh derav amar rav kahana may dichtiv ki hu amar vayyehi zo ishsha hu tziva vayyaamod ellu banim tana ishsha chemet male tzoa ufiha male dam vehakkol ratzin achareha

Ki holech haadam el bet olamo amar rabbi yitzchak melammed shekkol tzaddik vetzaddik notnin lo mador lefi kevodo mashal lemelech shennichnas hu vaavadav lair keshehen nichnasin kullan beshaar echad nichnasin keshehen lanin kol echad veechad notnin lo mador lefi kevodo
Veamar rabbi yitzchak may dichtiv ki hayyaldut vehashshacharut havel devarim sheadam ose beyalduto mashchirim panav leet ziknato

Veamar rabbi yitzchak kasha rima lammet kemachat babbasar hachay shenneemar ach besaro alav yichav amar rav chisda nafsho shel adam mitabbelet alav kol shiva shenneemar venafsho alav teeval uchtiv vayyaas leaviv evel shivat yamim
Amar rav yehuda met sheen lo menachamin holchin asara bene adam veoshvin bimkomo hahu dishchev beshivavuteh derav yehuda lo hau lo menachamin
b: Kol yoma hava davar rav yehuda be asra veyatvi beduchteh leachar shiva yamim itchazi leh bechelmeh derav yehuda vaamar leh tanuach datecha shehinnachta et dati
Amar rabbi avahu kol sheomrim bifne hammet yodea ad sheyyissatem haggolel peligi bah rabbi chiyya verabbi shimon berabbi chad amar ad sheyyissatem haggolel vechad amar ad sheyyitakkel habbasar
Man deamar ad sheyyitakkel habbasar dichtiv ach besaro alav yichav venafsho alav teeval man deamar ad sheyyissatem haggolel dichtiv veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya vego

Tanu rabbanan veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah tenah lo kemo shennetanah lecha betohora af atta betahora mashal lemelech basar vadam shechalak bigde malchut laavadav pikchin shebbahen kiplum vehinnichum bekufsa tippeshim shebbahen halchu veasu bahen melacha leyamim bikesh hammelech et kelav pikchin shebbahen hechezirum lo keshehen megohatzin tippeshin shebbahen hechezirum lo keshehen meluchlachin sameach hammelech likrat pikchin vechaas likrat tippeshin
Al pikchin amar yinnatnu kelay laotzar vehem yelchu levattehem leshalom veal tippeshin amar kelay yinnatnu lechoves vehen yechavshu bevet haasurim

Af hakkadosh baruch hu al gufan shel tzaddikim omer yavo shalom yanuchu al mishkevotam veal nishmatan hu omer vehayeta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim al gufan shel reshaim hu omer en shalom amar Adonai larshaim veal nishmatan hu omer veet nefesh oyevecha yekalleenna betoch kaf hakkala

Tanya rabbi eliezer omer nishmatan shel tzaddikim genuzot tachat kisse hakkavod shenneemar vehayeta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim veshel reshaim zommot veholchot umalach echad omed besof haolam umalach acher omed besof haolam umkallein nishmatan ze laze shenneemar veet nefesh oyevecha yekalleenna betoch kaf hakkala

Amar leh rabba lerav nachman shel benonim may amar leh iko shachevna la amari lechu hay milta hachi amar shemuel ellu vaellu leduma nimsarin hallalu yesh lahen manoach hallalu en lahen manoach amar leh rav mari atidi tzaddike dehau afra dichtiv veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya

Hanhu kafolae dahao kafli beara derav nachman nechar behu rav achay bar yoshiyya ato vaamaru leh lerav nachman nechar ban gavra ata vaamar leh man nihu mar amar leh ana achay bar yoshiyya amar leh velav amar rav mari atidi tzaddike dehau afra amar leh umanni mari dela yadana leh amar leh veha kera ketiv veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya
Amar leh deakreyach kohelet la akreyach mishle dichtiv urkav atzamot kina kal mi sheyyesh lo kina belibbo atzmotav markivim kol sheen lo kina belibbo en atzmotav markivim
Gashshesheh chazyeh deit beh meshasha amar leh lekum mar legaveyh deveta amar leh gallet addatach daafilu nevie la keret dichtiv vidatem ki ani Adonai befitchi et kivrotechem
Amar leh vehachtiv ki afar atta veel afar tashuv amar leh hahu shaa achat kodem techiyyat hammetim

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi avahu amritu nishmatan shel tzaddikim genuzot tachat kisse hakkavod ova tamya hecha assekeh lishmuel bingida amar leh hatam betoch shenem asar chodesh hava detanya kol shenem asar chodesh gufo kayyam venishmato ola veoredet leachar shenem asar chodesh hagguf batel

a: Venishmato ola veshuv enah yoredet

Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav mehespedo shel adam nikar im ben haolam habba hu im lav ini vehaamar leh rav lerav shemuel bar shilat achem behespeda dehatam kaemna la kashya ha dimchammu leh vechaem ha dimchammu leh vela chaem
Amar leh abbaye lerabba kegon mar desanu leh kullehu pumbeditae man machem hespeda amar leh misatay atte verabba bar rav chanan

Bea minneh rabbi elazar merav ezehu ben haolam habba amar leh veoznecha tishmana davar meacharecha lemor ze hadderech lechu vo ki taaminu vechi tasmeilu rabbi chanina amar kol sheddaat rabbotenu nocha hemennu vesavvu bashshuk hassofdim bene galila amri ase devarim lifne mittatecha bene yehuda amri ase devarim leachar mittatecha vela peligi mar ki atreh umar ki atreh

Tenan hatam rabbi eliezer omer shuv yom echad lifne mitatecha shaalu talmidav et rabbi eliezer vechi adam yodea ezehu yom yamut amar lahen vechol shekken yashuv hayyom shemma yamut lemachar venimtza kol yamav bitshuva veaf shelomo amar bechochmato bechol et yihu vegadecha levanim veshemen al roshcha al yechsar

Amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay mashal lemelech shezzimen et avadav lisuda velo kava lahem zeman pikchin shebbahen kishtu et atzman veyashvu al petach bet hammelech amru kelum chaser levet hammelech tipshin shebbahen halchu limlachtan amru kelum yesh seuda belo torach

Pitom bikesh hammelech et avadav pikchin shebbahen nichnesu lefanav keshehen mekushshatin vehattipshim nichnesu lefanav keshehen meluchlachin samach hammelech likrat pikchim vechaas likrat tipshim amar hallalu shekkishtu et atzman lasseuda yeshvu veyochlu veyishtu hallalu shello kishtu atzman lasseuda yaamdu veyiru

Chatano shel rabbi meir mishshum rabbi meir amar af hen nirin kimshammeshin ella ellu vaellu yoshvin hallalu ochlin vehallalu reevin hallalu shotin vehallalu tzemeim shenneemar ko amar Adonai hinne avaday yochelu veattem tiravu hinne avaday yishtu veattem titzmau hinne avaday yaronnu mittuv lev veattem titzaku mikkeev lev
Davar acher bechol et yihu vegadecha levanim ellu tzitzit veshemen al roshcha al yechsar ellu tefilin

Matni mi shehecheshich badderech noten kiso legoy veim en immo goy mannicho al hachamor higgia lechatzer hachitzona notel et hakkelim hannitalin bashshabbat vesheenan nitalin bashshabbat mattir hachavalim vehassakkin noflin mealehem
Gema may tama sharu leh rabbanan lemitav kiseh legoy kim lehu lerabbanan deen adam maamid atzmo al mamono i la sharet leh ate leetoye arba ammot birshut harabbim

Amar rava daveka kiso aval metzia la peshita kiso tenan mahu detema hu haddin afilu metzia vehay dekatane kiso orcha demilta katane ka mashma lan vela amaran ella dela atay lideh aval atay lideh kechiseh dame
Ika deamri bae rava metzia habbaa leyado mahu kevan daatay lideh kechiseh dame o dilma kevan dela tarach bah lav kechiseh dame teku
En immo goy tama deen immo goy ha yesh immo goy legoy yahev leh may tama chamor atta metzuve al shevitato goy i atta metzuve al shevitato
Chamor vecheresh shote vekatan achamor mannach leh lecheresh shote vekatan la yahev leh may tama hane adam hay lav adam cheresh veshote leshote shote vekatan leshote
Ibaya lehu cheresh vekatan may alliba derabbi eliezer la tibe lach detanya rabbi yitzchak omer mishshum rabbi eliezer terumat cheresh
b: Lo tetze lechullin mippene shehu safek

Ki tibe lach alliba derabbanan ditnan chamishsha lo yitromu veim tarmu en terumatan teruma ellu hen cheresh shote vekatan vehattorem et sheeno shello vegoy shettaram et shel yisrael afilu birshuto en terumato teruma
May lecheresh yahev leh dekatan ate lichlal daat o dilma lekatan yahev leh decheresh ate leichallofe begadol pikeach ika deamri lecheresh yahev leh ika deamri lekatan yahev leh

En sham lo goy velo chamor velo cheresh velo shote velo katan may amar rabbi yitzchak od acheret hayeta velo ratzu chachamim legallotah may od acheret hayeta molicho pachot pachot mearba ammot ammay lo ratzu chachamim legallotah mishshum kevod elohim haster davar uchvod melachim chakor davar vehacha may kevod elohim ika dilma ate leetoye arba ammot birshut harabbim
Tanya rabbi eliezer omer bo bayyom gadshu sea rabbi yehoshua omer bo bayyom machaku sea

Tanya mashal derabbi eliezer lema haddavar dome lakkuppa melea kishuin vediluin adam noten letochah chardal vehi machzeket mashal derabbi yehoshua lema haddavar dome laareva melea devash noten letochah rimonim veegozim vehi mekia
Amar mar en immo goy mannicho al hachamor vahalo mechammer verachamana amar lo taase chol melacha

Amar rav adda bar ahava mannicho aleha keshehi mehallechet veha i efshar dela kayema lehashtin mayim ulhattil gelalim veika akira vehannacha keshehi mehallechet mannicho aleha keshehi omedet notlo hemenna i hachi afilu chavero name
Amar rav pappa kol shebbegufo chayyav chattat bachavero patur aval asur kol shechavero patur aval asur bachamoro muttar lechattechilla
Amar rav adda bar ahava hayeta chavilato munnachat lo al ketefo ratz tachteha ad shemmaggia leveto daveka ratz aval kalli kalli la
May tama kevan delet leh hekera ate lemibad akira vehannacha sof sof ki mate leveteh i efshar dela kae purta vekamayyel mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid dezarek leh kilachar yad

Amar rame bar chama hamchammer acher behemto beshabbat beshogeg chayyav chattat bemezid chayyav sekila may tama amar rava deamar kera lo taase chol melacha atta uvhemtecha behemto dumya dideh ma hu beshogeg chayyav chattat bemezid chayyav sekila af behemto name beshogeg chayyav chattat bemezid chayyav sekila

Tenan en merassekin et hashshachat veet hecharuvin lifne behema ben dakka uven gassa may lav charuvin dumya deshachat ma shachat derakkicha af charuvin derakkiche alma la tarchinan beuchla utuvteh derav huna
Amar lecha rav huna la shachat dumya decharuvin ma charuvin daakoshe af shachat daakoshe hechi mashkachatte lah beile zutre

Ha middekatane resha ben dakka uven gassa mikkelal derabbi yehuda dakka dakka mammash kaamar kashya

b: Et haddilluin lifne habbehema veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim may lav dilluin dumya dinvela ma nevela derakkicha af dilluin derakkiche alma tarchinan beuchla utuvta derav yehuda amar lach rav yehuda la nevela dumya dedilluin ma dilluin deashshune af nevela deashshuna vehechi mashkachatte lah bivsar pile i name beguryata zutre

Veibaet ema deorayeta name tane takkanta ella sukka dinfishin mileh pasek vetane pesula mavoy dela nefishi mileh tane takkanta
Amar rav yehuda amar rav chachamim lo lemaduha ella mippitcho shel hechal verabbi yehuda lo lemadah ella mippitcho shel ulam
Ditnan pitcho shel hechal govho esrim amma verochbo eser ammot veshel ulam govho arbaim amma verochbo esrim ammot
Ushnehen mikra echad darshu ushchato petach ohel moed derabbanan savri kedushshat hechal lechud ukdushshat ulam lechud vechi ketiv petach ohel moed ahechal ketiv
Verabbi yehuda savar hechal veulam kedushsha achat hi vechi ketiv petach ohel moed attarvayehu hu dichtiv
Veibaet ema lerabbi yehuda name kedushshat ulam lechud ukdushshat hechal lechud vehacha hayenu tama derabbi yehuda dichtiv el petach ulam habbayit
Verabbanan i hava ketiv el petach ulam kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv el petach ulam habbayit habbayit happatuach laulam
Veha ki ketiv hay bemishkan ketiv

Ashkechan mishkan deikri mikdash umikdash deikri mishkan dei la tema hachi ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel shelamim sheshshechatan kodem petichat daltot hahechal pesulin shenneemar ushchato petach ohel moed bizman sheppetuchin velo bizman shehen neulim veha ki chetiv hahi bemishkan ketiv ella ashkechan mikdash deikri mishkan umishkan deikri mikdash
Bishlama mikdash deikri mishkan dichtiv venatatti et mishkani betochchem ella mishkan deikri mikdash menalan ilema middichtiv venasu hakkehatim nose hammikdash vehekimu et hammishkan ad boam
b: Hahu bearon ketiv ella mehacha veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham

Ben lerabbanan uven lerabbi yehuda lelfu mippetach shaar hechatzer dichtiv orech hechatzer mea vaamma verochav chamishshim bachamishshim vekoma chamesh ammot uchtiv vachamesh esre amma kelaim lakkatef uchtiv velakkatef hashshenit mizze umizze leshaar hechatzer kelaim chamesh esre amma ma lehallan chamesh berochav esrim af kan chamesh berochav esrim
Petach shaar hechatzer ikri petach setama la ikri
Veibaet ema ki chetiv kelaim chamesh esre amma lakkatef beguvha hu dichtiv
Guvha veha ketiv vekoma chamesh ammot hahu missefat mizbeach ulmala
Verabbi yehuda mippitcho shel ulam gamar veha tenan veharachav meeser ammot yemaet vela pelig rabbi yehuda
Amar abbaye pelig bevarayeta detanya veharachav meeser ammot yemaet rabbi yehuda omer eno tzarich lemaet
Veliflog bematnitin pelig beguvha vehu haddin leruchba
Veakkatti rabbi yehuda mippitcho shel ulam gamar vehatanya mavoy shehu gavoha meesrim amma yemaet verabbi yehuda machshir ad arbaim vachamishshim amma vetane bar kappara ad mea
Bishlama levar kappara guzma ella lerav yehuda may guzma bishlama lerabbi yehuda arbaim gamar mippitcho shel ulam ella chamishshim mena leh

Amar rav chisda ha matnita atiteh lerav detanya mavoy shehu gavoha meesrim amma yoter mippitcho shel hechal yemaet hu savar midderabbanan mippitcho shel hechal gamri rabbi yehuda mippitcho shel ulam gamar vela hi rabbi yehuda mippitcha demalchin gamar
Verabbanan i mippitcho shel hechal gemiri livo delatot kehechal allema tenan hechsher mavoy bet shammay omrim lechi vekora uvet hillel omrim lechi o kora
Daltot hechal litzniut bealma hu daavidan

Ella meatta la tahane leh tzurat happetach deha hechal tzurat happetach haveya lo afilu hachi eser ammot hu dirvich allema tenan im yesh lo tzurat happetach af al pi sherachav meeser ammot eno tzarich lemaet
Mide hu tama ella lerav ha matne leh rav yehuda lechiyya bar rav kammeh derav eno tzarich lemaet vaamar leh atneyeh tzarich lemaet
Ella meatta

a: La tahane leh amaltera deha hechal amaltera haveya leh vaafilu hachi esrim amma hu degavoha ditnan chamesh amalteraot shel mela hau al gabbav zo lemala mizzo vezo lemala mizzo
Vehay may teuvta dilma ki tanya hahi daamalteraot baulam tanya
Vehay may kushya dilma tavnit hechal ketavnit ulam
Allema amar rabbi ila amar rav rechava arbaa af al pi sheenah beria veim yesh lah amaltera afilu gevoha yoter meesrim amma eno tzarich lemaet
Amar rav yosef amaltera matnita hi man katane lah
Amar abbaye veha chama bereh derabba bar avuh katane lah vetihve amaltera matnita vetikshe lerav
Amar lecha rav dal ana mehacha matneyata mi la kashyan ahadade ella may it lach lememar tannae hi ledidi name tannae hi
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar bela rav matneyata ahadade la kashyan lerabbanan kora tama may mishshum hekera vehay dekatane yater mippitcho shel hechal simana bealma

Verav nachman bar yitzchak hanicha i la sevira leh ha derabba ella i sevira leh ha derabba deamar rabba ketiv lemaan yedu dorotechem ki vassukkot hoshavti ad esrim amma adam yodea sheddar bassukka lemala meesrim amma en adam yodea mishshum dela shalta beh ena
Alma gabbe sukka name behekera peligi iploge betarte lema li

Tzericha dei ashmeinan gabbe sukka beha kaamar rabbi yehuda kevan delishiva avida shalta beh ena aval mavoy dilhiluch avid ema mode lehu lerabbanan vei ashmeinan beha beha kaamri rabbanan aval behach ema modu leh lerabbi yehuda tzericha
May amaltera rav chama bereh derabba bar avuh amar kine ki ata rav dimi amar amri bemareva piske dearza
Man deamar piske dearza kol shekken kine man deamar kine aval piske dearza la
Uman deamar piske dearza may tama mishshum dinfish meshacheh veha sukka dinfish meshacheh vekaamri rabbanan dela
Ella kevan deka chashiv it leh kala
Miktzat kora betoch esrim umiktzat kora lemala meesrim miktzat sechach betoch esrim umiktzat sechach lemala meesrim amar rabba bemavoy kasher besukka pasul
May shena bemavoy dechasher deamrinan kelosh sukka name lema kelosh
I kalshatte haveya lah chamatah merubba mitztzilatah
Hacha name i kalshatte haveya lah kora hannitelet baruach ella al korchach naasu keshappudin shel mattechet hacha name al korchach naaset tzilatah merubba mechammatah
Amar rava mipparzakya sukka dilyachid hi la middechar mavoy dilrabbim madkeri ahadade
Ravina amar sukka deorayeta achmiru bah rabbanan mavoy derabbanan la achmiru beh rabbanan
Rav adda bar matna matne leha shemata derabba ipcha amar rabba bemavoy pasul besukka keshera
May shena sukka dichshera deamrinan kelosh bemavoy name lema kelosh

I kelashat have lah kora hannitelet beruach hacha name i kalshatte haveya lah chamatah merubba mitztzilatah ella al korchacha naaset tzilatah merubba mechammatah hacha name al korchach naasu keshappudin shel mattechet
Amar rava mipparzakya sukka dilyachid hi rame annafsheh umiddechar mavoy dilrabbim hi samchi ahadade vela middachri deamri inashe kidra deve shuttafe la chammima vela karira
Ravina amar sukka deorayeta la bae chizuk mavoy derabbanan bae chizuk
May have alah rabba bar rav ulla amar ze vaze pasul rava amar ze vaze kasher
b: Chalal sukka tenan chalal mavoy tenan
Amar leh rav pappa lerava tanya dimsayya lach mavoy shehu gavoha meesrim amma yoter mippitcho shel hechal yemaet vehechal gufo chalalo esrim
Etiveh rav shimi bar rav ashe lerav pappa ketzad haya ose manniach kora missefat esrim ulmatta
Ema ulmala veha lematta katane
Ha ka mashma lan dilmatta kilmala ma lemala chalalah esrim af lematta chalalah asara
Amar abbaye mishshemeh derav nachman ammat sukka veammat mavoy beamma bat chamishsha ammat kilayim beamma bat shishsha
Ammat mavoy beamma bat chamishsha lemay hilcheta legovho ulfirtzat mavoy
Veha ika meshech mavoy bearba ammot dilkulla
Keman deamar bearbaa tefachim
Veibaet ema bearba ammot verov ammot kaamar
Ammat sukka beamma bat chamishsha lemay hilcheta legovhah uldofen akumma
Veha ika meshech sukka bearba ammot dilkulla detanya rabbi omer omer ani kol sukka sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot pesula
Kerabbanan deamri afilu enah machzeket ella rosho verubbo veshulchano
Veibaet ema leolam rabbi hi verov ammot kaamar
Ammat kilayim beamma bat shishsha lemay hilcheta lekarachat hakkerem velimchol hakkerem
Ditnan karachat hakkerem bet shammay omrim esrim vearba ammot uvet hillel omrim shesh esre ammot umchol hakkerem bet shammay omrim shesh esre ammot uvet hillel omrim shettem esre ammot
Ezo hi karachat hakkerem kerem shecharav emtzaito en sham shesh esre ammot lo yavi zera lesham hau sham shesh esre amma noten lo kede avodato vezorea et hammotar
Veezehu mechol hakkerem ben kerem laggader en sham shettem esre amma lo yavi zera lesham hau sham shettem esre amma noten lo kede avodato vezorea et hashshear
Veha ika retzufim bearba ammot dilkulla ditnan kerem hannatua al pachot mearba ammot rabbi shimon omer eno kerem vachachamim omrim kerem veroin et haemtzaiyyim keilu enam
Kerabbanan deamri have kerem veibaet ema leolam rabbi shimon verov ammot kaamar
Verava mishshemeh derav nachman amar kol ammot beamma bat shishsha ella hallalu sochakot vehallalu atzevot
Metivi kol ammot sheamru chachamim beamma bat shishsha uvilvad

a: Shello yehu mechuuonot bishlama lerava ki hechi deliheveyan hallalu sochakot vehallalu atzevot ella leabbaye kashya
Amar lach abbaye ema ammat kilayim beamma bat shishsha
Veha middekatane sefa rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol ammot sheamru chachamim bechilayim beamma bat shishsha uvilvad shello yehu metzumtzamot mikkelal detanna kamma kol ammot kaamar
Amar lach abbaye velav mi ika rabban shimon ben gamliel dekae keoti ana daamari kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Leabbaye vadday tannae hi lerava mi lema tannae hi
Amar lach rava rabban shimon ben gamliel ha ata leashmoinan ammat kilayim lo yetzamtzem
Velema ammat kilayim lo yetzamtzem beamma bat shishsha lemaote may lav lemaote ammat sukka veammat mavoy
La lemaote amma yesod veamma sovev

Dichtiv veelle middot hammizbeach baammot amma amma vatofach vechek haamma veamma rochav ugvulah el sefatah saviv zeret haechad veze gav hammizbeach chek haamma ze yesod veamma rochav ze sovev ugvulah el sefatah saviv ellu hakkeranot veze gav hammizbeach ze mizbach hazzahav
Amar rabbi chiyya bar ashe amar rav shiurin chatzitzin umchitzin halacha lemoshe missinay
Shiurin deorayeta hu dichtiv eretz chitta usora vego veamar rav chanan kol happasuk hazze leshiurin neemar

Chitta lichditnan hannichnas labbayit hamnugga vechelav al ketefav vesandalav vetabbeotav beyadav hu vehem temein miyyad haya lavush kelav vesandalav beraglav vetabbeotav beetzbeotav hu tame miyyad vehen tehorin ad sheyyishhe bichde achilat peras pat chitin velo pat seorin mesev veochel beliftan
Seora ditnan etzem kisora metamme bemagga uvmassa veeno metamme beohel
Gefen kede reviit yayin lenazir
b: Teena kigrogeret lehotzaat shabbat
Rimmon keditnan kol kele baale vattim shiuran kerimonim
Eretz zet shemen udvash eretz shekkol shiureha kezetim kol shiureha salka datach vehaika hane daamaran ella ema eretz sherov shiureha kezetim
Devash kechotevet haggassa leom hakkipurim
Vetisbera shiurin michtav ketivi ella hilcheta ninhu veasmechinhu rabbanan akkerae

Chatzitzin deorayeta ninhu dichtiv verachatz et kal besaro bammayim shello yehe davar chotzetz ben besaro lammayim bammayim beme mikve kol besaro mayim shekkol gufo ole bahen vechamma hen amma al amma berum shalosh ammot veshiaru chachamim me mikve arbaim sea
Ki itzterich hilcheta lisaro vechidrabba bar rav huna deamar rabba bar rav huna nima achat keshura chotzetzet shalosh enan chotztzot shettayim eni yodea
Searo name deorayeta hu detanya verachatz et kal besaro et hattafel livsaro vezehu sear
Ki atay hilcheta lerubbo ulmiuto ulmakpid ulsheen makpid vechidrabbi yitzchak
Deamar rabbi yitzchak devar tora rubbo umakpid alav chotzetz vesheeno makpid alav eno chotzetz vegazru al rubbo sheeno makpid mishshum rubbo hammakpid veal miuto hammakpid mishshum rubbo hammakpid
Veligzor name al miuto sheeno makpid mishshum miuto hammakpid i name mishshum rubbo sheeno makpid
Hi gufah gezera vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera
Mechitzot deorayeta ninhu
Deamar mar aron tisha vechapporet tefach hare kan asara
La tzericha lerabbi yehuda deamar ammat binyan beamma bat shishsha ammat kelim beamma bat chamishsha
Ulrabbi meir deamar kol haammot hau bevenonit may ika lememar
Lerabbi meir ki atay hilcheta legud ullavud uldofen akumma
Haya gavoha meesrim amma uva lemaato kamma memaet kamma memaet kamma ditzrich leh
Ella rochbo bechamma rav yosef amar tefach abbaye amar arbaa
Lema beha ka mipalgi deman deamar tefach kasavar muttar lehishtammesh tachat hakkora

a: Uman deamar arbaa kasavar asur lehishtammesh tachat hakkora
La dechulle alma kasavri muttar lehishtammesh tachat hakkora uvha ka mipalgi mar savar kora mishshum heker umar savar kora mishshum mechitza

Veibaet ema dechulle alma kora mishshum heker vehacha beheker shel matta uvheker shel mala ka mipalgi demar savar amrinan heker shel matta keheker shel mala umar savar la amrinan heker shel matta keheker shel mala
Veibaet ema dechulle alma amrinan heker shel matta keheker shel mala vehacha bigzera shemma yifchot kamipalgi
Haya pachot measara tefachim vechakak bo lehashlimo laasara kamma chokek kamma chokek kamma ditzrich leh ella mishko bechamma rav yosef amar bearbaa abbaye amar bearba ammot
Lema bidrabbi amme verabbi assi kamipalgi deitmar mavoy shennifratz mitztzido kelappe rosho itmar mishshemeh derabbi amme verabbi assi im yesh sham pas arbaa mattir befirtza ad eser
Veim lav pachot mishshelosha mattir shelosha eno mattir lerav yosef it leh derabbi amme leabbaye let leh derabbi amme
Amar lach abbaye hatam sof mavoy hacha techillat mavoy i ika arba ammot in i la la
Amar abbaye mena amena lah detanya en mavoy nitar belechi vekora ad sheyehu battim vachatzerot petuchin letocho
Vei bearbaa hechi mashkachatte leh
Vechi tema defatach leh bedofen haemtzai vehaamar rav nachman nekitinan ezehu mavoy shennitar belechi vekora kol sheorko yater al rochbo uvattim vachatzerot petuchin letocho
Verav yosef defatach le bekeren zavit

Amar abbaye mena amena lah deamar rame bar chama amar rav huna lechi habbolet middofno shel mavoy pachot mearba ammot nidon mishshum lechi veeno tzarich lechi acher lehattiro arba ammot nidon mishshum mavoy vetzarich lechi acher lehattiro
Verav yosef leappoke mittorat lechi ad deika arba ammot lemihve mavoy afilu bearbaa tefachim name have mavoy
Gufa amar rame bar chama amar rav huna lechi habbolet middofno shel mavoy
b: Pachot mearba ammot nidon mishshum lechi veen tzarich lechi acher lehattiro arba ammot nidon mishshum mavoy vetzarich lechi acher lehattiro
Oto lechi hechan maamido i demoke leh bahadeh osofe hu deka mosif aleh
Amar rav pappa demoke leh leidach gisa rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar afilu tema demoke leh bahadeh dimtappe beh o dimvatztzar beh
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua la amaran ella bemavoy shemona aval bemavoy shiva nitar beomed merubbe al happarutz
Vekal vachomer mechatzer uma chatzer sheenah niteret belechi vekora niteret beomed merubbe al happarutz mavoy shennitar belechi vekora eno din shennitar beomed merubbe al happarutz
Ma lechatzer shekken pirtzatah beeser tomar bemavoy sheppirtzato bearba
Kasavar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua mavoy name pirtzato beeser leman kaamrinan lerav huna veha rav huna pirtzato bearba sevira leh
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua tama denafsheh kaamar
Rav ashe amar afilu tema bemavoy shemone name la tzerich lechi ma nafshach i omed nefish nitar beomed merubbe al happarutz vei parutz nefish nidon mishshum lechi
May amratte deshau tarvayehu ki hadade have leh sefek divrehen usfek divrehen lehakel
Amar rav chanin bar rava amar rav mavoy shennifratz

a: Mitztzido beeser merosho bearbaa
May shena mitztzido beeser deamar pitcha hu merosho name nema pitcha hu
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua kegon shennifratz bekeren zavit defitcha bekeren zavit la avdi inashe
Verav huna amar echad ze veechad ze bearbaa vechen amar leh rav huna lerav chanan bar rava la tiflog illay derav ikla ledamcharya vaavad ovada keoti amar leh rav bika matza vegadar bah gader
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak keoteh derav huna mistabbera deitmar mavoy akom rav amar torato kimfullash ushmuel amar torato kesatum
Bemay askinan ilema beoter meeser beha lema shemuel torato kesatum
Ella lav beeser vekaamar rav torato kimfullash alma pirtzat mavoy mitztzido bearbaa
Verav chanan bar rava shane hatam deka baki bah rabbim
Mikkelal derav huna savar af al gav dela baki bah rabbim may shena midderabbi amme verabbi assi
Hatam deika gidude hacha deleka gidude

Tanu rabbanan ketzad mearvin derech reshut harabbim ose tzurat happetach mikkan velechi vekora mikkan chananya omer bet shammay omrim ose delet mikkan vedelet mikkan uchshehu yotze venichnas noel bet hillel omrim ose delet mikkan velechi vekora mikkan
Urshut harabbim mi miarva vehatanya yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda
b: Mi shehau lo shene vattim mishshene tzide reshut harabbim ose lechi mikkan velechi mikkan o kora mikkan vekora mikkan venose venoten baemtza amru lo en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach
Vechi tema bechach hu dela miarva ha bidlatot miarva vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan yerushalayim ilmale daltoteha ninalot ballayela chayyavin aleha mishshum reshut harabbim
Veamar ulla hane avulle demachoza ilmale daltotehen ninalot chayyavin alehen mishshum reshut harabbim
Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar ketzad mearvin mevoot hamfullashin lirshut harabbim ose tzurat happetach mikkan velechi vekora mikkan
Itmar rav amar hilcheta ketanna kamma ushmuel amar halacha kachananya

Ibaya lehu lachananya alliba devet hillel tzarich linol o en tzarich linol ta shema deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel eno tzarich linol vechen amar rav matna amar shemuel eno tzarich linol ika deamri amar rav matna bedidi hava ovada veamar li shemuel en tzarich linol
Beo mineh merav anan tzarich linol o en tzarich linol amar lehu ta chazi hane avulle dinhardaa detiman ad palgayehu beafra veayel venafek mar shemuel vela amar lehu vela mide
Amar rav kahana hanach megufot havay
Ki ata rav nachman amar panneuh leafrayehu lema kasavar rav nachman tzarich linol la kevan diruot linol af al pi sheen ninalot
Hahu mavoy akom dahava binhardea reme aleh chumreh derav vechumreh dishmuel veatzrechuhu delatot chumreh derav deamar torato kimfullash vehaamar rav halacha ketanna kamma
Kishmuel deamar halacha kachananya vehaamar shemuel torato kesatum kerav deamar torato kimfullash

Umi avdinan kitre chumre veha tanya leolam halacha kevet hillel veharotze laasot kedivre bet shammay ose kedivre bet hillel ose mikkulle bet shammay umikkulle bet hillel rasha mechumre bet shammay umechumre bet hillel alav hakkatuv omer hakkesil bechoshech holech ella i kevet shammay kekullehon uchchumrehon i kevet hillel kekullehon uchchumrehon
Ha gufa kashya amratte leolam halacha kevet hillel vahadar amratte harotze laasot kedivre bet shammay ose
La kashya kan kodem bat kol kan leachar bat kol
Veibaet ema ha veha leachar bat kol

a: Verabbi yehoshua hi dela mashgach bevat kol

Veibaet ema hachi kaamar kol hecha demashkachatte tere tannae utre amorae difligi ahadade keen machaloket bet shammay uvet hillel la lebad ki kulleh demar vechi kulleh demar vela kechumreh demar vechi chumreh demar ella o ki kulleh demar uchchumreh aved o kekulleh demar uchchumreh aved
Mikkol makom kashya
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak kulleh kerav avduh deamar rav huna amar rav halacha veen morin ken
Ulrav adda bar ahava amar rav deamar halacha umorin ken may ika lememar
Amar rav shezvi ki la avdinan kechumre deve tere hecha desatri ahadade

Kegon shidra vegulgolet ditnan hashshidra vehaggulgolet shechasru vechamma chesron bashshidra bet shammay omrim shette chulot uvet hillel omrim chulya achat uvaggulgolet bet shammay omrim kimlo makdeach uvet hillel omrim kede sheyyinnatel min hachay veyamut
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel vechen leinyan terefa
Aval hecha dela satri ahadade avdinan
Vehecha desatri ahadade la avdinan metiv rav mesharsheya maase berabbi akiva shelliket etrog beechad bishvat venahag bo shene isurin echad kedivre bet shammay veechad kedivre bet hillel
Rabbi akiva gemareh istappek leh vela yeda i bet hillel bechad bishvat amur i bachamesar bishvat amur vaavad hacha lechumra vehacha lechumra
Yatev rav yosef kammeh derav huna veyatev vekaamar amar rav yehuda amar rav machaloket bisratya mikkan usratya mikkan uflatya mikkan uflatya mikkan
Aval seratya mikkan uvika mikkan o bika mikkan uvika mikkan ose tzurat happetach mikkan velechi vekora mikkan
Hashta seratya mikkan uvika mikkan ose lo tzurat happetach mikkan velechi vekora mikkan bika mikkan uvika mikkan mibaya
Hachi kaamar seratya mikkan uvika mikkan naase kevika mikkan uvika mikkan
Umsayyem bah mishshemeh derav yehuda im haya mavoy kale lirchava en tzarich kelum
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef ha derav yehuda dishmuel hi
b: Dei derav kashya derav adderav betarte deamar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav mavoy shennifratz bimloo lechatzer venifretza chatzer kenegdo chatzer mutteret umavoy asur veammay leheve kemavoy shekkale lirchava

Amar leh ana la yadana ovada hava bedura deraavata mavoy shekkale lirchava hava vaata lekammeh derav yehuda vela atzrecheh vela mide vei kashya mishshemeh derav tehve mishshemeh dishmuel vela kashya mide
Hashta daamar leh rav sheshet lerav shemuel bar abba veamri leh lerav yosef bar abba asbera lach kan sheervu kan shello ervu
Derav adderav name la kashya kan sheervu bene chatzer im bene mavoy kan shello ervu

a: Ulmay dislek addatin meikara ben sheervu uven shello ervu peligi beervu bemay peligi beshello ervu bemay peligi
Beshello ervu peligi benire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim
Beervu kamipalgi bidrav yosef deamar rav yosef lo shanu ella shekkale leemtza rechava aval kale letzide rechava asur
Amar rabba ha deamratte leemtza rechava muttar la amaran ella ze shello keneged ze aval ze keneged ze asur

Amar rav mesharsheya ha deamratte ze shello keneged ze muttar la amaran ella rechava derabbim aval rechava deyachid zimnin demimlach alah uvne lah battim vehave lah kemavoy shekkale leh letzide rechava veasur

Umna temra deshane lan ben rechava derabbim lirchava deyachid deamar ravin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak maase bemavoy echad shetztzido echad kale layyam vetzido echad kale leashpa uva maase lifne rabbi velo amar bah lo heter velo isur
Isur la amar bah deha kayemi mechitzot heter la amar bah chayeshinan shemma tinatel ashpa veyaale hayyam sirton
Umi chayeshinan shemma tinatel ashpa vehatnan ashpa birshut harabbim gavoha asara tefachim challon sheal gabbah zorkin lah beshabbat
Alma shane ben ashpa derabbim leashpa deyachid
Hacha name shane ben rechava derabbim lirchava deyachid
Verabbanan may

Amar rav yosef bar avdimi tana vachachamim osrin amar rav nachman halacha kedivre chachamim ika deamri amar rav yosef bar avdimi tana vachachamim mattirin amar rav nachman en halacha kedivre chachamim
Marimar pasek lah lesura beuzle amar chayeshinan shemma yaale hayyam sirton

Hahu mavoy akom dahava besura keruch budya otivu beh beakmumiteh amar rav chisda ha la kerav vela kishmuel lerav deamar torato kimfullash tzurat happetach bae lishmuel deamar torato kesatum hane mile lechi mealleya aval hay kevan denashev beh zika veshade leh lo kelum hu
Vei naetz beh sikta vechabbereh chabbereh
Gufa amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav mavoy shennifratz bimloo lechatzer venifretza chatzer kenegdo chatzer mutteret umavoy asur
Amar leh rabba bar ulla lerav bivi bar abbaye rabbi lo mishnatenu hi zo chatzer ketanna shennifretza ligdola gedola mutteret uktanna asura mippene shehi kefitchah shel gedola
Amar leh i mehatam hava amena hane mile hecha dela ka darsi bah rabbim aval hecha deka darsi bah rabbim ema afilu chatzer name
Veha name tenena chatzer sheharabbim nichnasin lah bazo veotzin lah bezo reshut harabbim lattuma urshut hayyachid lashshabbat
I mehatam hava amena hane mile ze shello keneged ze
b: Aval ze keneged ze ema la
Ulrabba deamar ze keneged ze asur ha derav bemay moke lah beze shello keneged ze tarte lema li
I mehatam hava amena hane mile lizrok aval letaltel ema la ka mashma lan
Itmar mavoy heasuy kenaddal amar abbaye ose tzurat happetach laggadol vehanach kullehu mishteru belechi vekora
Amar leh rava keman kishmuel deamar torato kesatum lema leh tzurat happetach veod ha hahu mavoy akom dahava binhardea vechashshu lah lidrav
Ella amar rava ose tzurat happetach lechullehu lehay gisa veidach gisa mishteru belechi vekora

Amar rav kahana bar tachlifa mishshemeh derav kahana bar minome mishshemeh derav kahana bar malkiyyo mishshemeh derav kahana rabbeh derav veamri lah rav kahana bar malkiyyo hayenu rav kahana rabbeh derav mavoy shetztzido echad aroch vetzido echad katzar pachot mearba ammot manniach et hakkora baalachson arba ammot eno manniach et hakkora ella keneged hakkatzar rava amar echad ze veechad ze eno manniach et hakkora ella keneged hakkatzar
Veema tama didi veema tama didhu ema tama didi kora tama may mishshum heker uvaalachson la have heker
Veema tama didhu kora mishshum may mishshum mechitza uvaalachson name have mechitza

Amar rav kahana hoil ushmateta dechahane hi ema bah milta ha deamratte manniach hakkora baalachson la amaran ella sheen baalachsono yoter meeser aval yesh baalachsono yoter meeser divre hakkol eno manniach ella keneged hakkatzar

Ibaya lehu mahu lehishtammesh tachat hakkora rav verabbi chiyya verabbi yochanan amru muttar lehishtammesh tachat hakkora shemuel verabbi shimon bar rabbi verabbi shimon ben lakish amru asur lehishtammesh tachat hakkora
Lema beha kamipalgi demar savar kora mishshum heker umar savar kora mishshum mechitza
La dechulle alma kora mishshum heker vehacha beha kamipalgi demar savar hekera millegav umar savar hekera millevar
Veibaet ema dechulle alma mishshum mechitza vehacha beha kamipalgi demar savar chuddo happenimi yored vesotem umar savar chuddo hachitzon yored vesotem
Amar rav chisda hakkol modim beven lechayayim sheasur
Bea mineh rame bar chama merav chisda naatz shette yetedot bishne kotle mavoy mibbachutz vehinniach kora al gabbehen mahu
Amar leh ledivre hammattir asur ledivre haoser muttar
Rava amar ledivre haoser name asur bainan kora al gabbe mavoy veleka
Etiveh rav adda bar matna lerava hayeta korato

a: Meshucha o teluya pachot mishshelosha en tzarich lehavi kora acheret shelosha tzarich lehavi kora acheret rabban shimon ben gamliel omer pachot mearbaa en tzarich lehavi kora acheret arbaa tzarich lehavi kora acheret
May lav meshucha mibbachutz utluyah mibbifnim
La idi veidi mibbifnim meshucha meruach achat utluya mishte ruchot
Mahu detema meruach achat amrinan lavud mishte ruchot la amrinan lavud ka mashma lan

Rav ashe amar meshucha vehi teluya vehechi dame kegon shennaatz shette yetedot akummot al shene kotle mavoy sheen begovhan shelosha veen beakmumitan shelosha mahu detema o lavud amrinan o chavot amrinan lavud vachavot la amrinan ka mashma lan
Tane rabbi zakkay kammeh derabbi yochanan ben lechayayim vetachat hakkora nidon kecharmelit amar leh pok teni levarra
Amar abbaye mistabbera milteh derabbi yochanan tachat hakkora aval ben lechayayin asur verava amar ben lechayayim name muttar
Amar rava mena amena lah dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan makom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa muttar livne reshut harabbim velivne reshut hayyachid lechattef alav uvilvad shello yachalifu
Veabbaye hatam begavoha shelosha
Amar abbaye mena amena lah deamar rav chama bar gurya amar rav toch happetach tzarich lechi acher lehattiro
Vechi tema deit beh arbaa al arbaa vehaamar rav chanin bar rava amar rav toch happetach af al pi sheen bo arbaa al arbaa tzarich lechi acher lehattiro
Verava hatam defatuach lecharmelit
Aval lirshut harabbim may shere yatztziva beara vegiyyora bishme shemayya
In matza min et mino veneor

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava veatte la tisbera deven lechayayin asur vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mavoy shertzafo bilchayayin pachot pachot mearbaa banu lemachloket rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan

Lerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar amrinan lavud mishtammesh ad chuddo happenimi shel lechi happenimi lerabbanan deamri la amrinan lavud mishtammesh ad chuddo happenimi shel chitzon aval ben lechayayin dechulle alma asur
Verava hatam name defatuach lecharmelit
Aval lirshut harabbim may shere yatztziva beara vegiyyora bishme shemayya in matza min et mino veneor
b: Rav ashe amar kegon shertzafo bilchayayim pachot pachot mearbaa bemeshech arba ammot
Lerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar amrinan lavud have leh mavoy vetzarich lechi acher lehattiro ulrabbanan deamri la amrinan lavud lo tzarich lechi acher lehattiro
Ulribben shimon ben gamliel leheve kenire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim
Mide hu tama ella lerabbi yochanan ha ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim eno nidon mishshum lechi
Itmar nire mibbifnim veshave mibbachutz nidon mishshum lechi nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim rabbi chiyya verabbi shimon berabbi chad amar nidon mishshum lechi vechad amar eno nidon mishshum lechi

Tistayyem derabbi chiyya hu deamar nidon mishshum lechi detane rabbi chiyya kotel shetztzido echad kanus mechavero ben shennire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim uven shennire mibbifnim veshave mibbachutz nidon mishshum lechi tistayyem
Verabbi yochanan mi la shemia leh ha ella shemia leh vela savar lah rabbi chiyya name la savar lah
Hay may bishlama rabbi yochanan la savar lah mishshum hachi la tane lah ella rabbi chiyya i ita dela savar lah lema leh lemitna

Amar rabba bar rav huna nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim nidon mishshum lechi amar rabba umotvinan ashshematin chatzer ketanna shennifretza ligdola gedola mutteret uktanna asura mippene shehi kefitchah shel gedola veim ita ketanna name tishtere benire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim
Amar rabbi zera benichnasin kotle ketanna ligdola
Velema lavud vetishtere
Vechi tema demaflegi tuva veha tane rav adda bar avimi kammeh derabbi chanina ketanna beeser gedola beachat esre
Amar ravina bemuflagin mikkotel ze bishnayim umikkotel ze bearbaa
Velema lavud meruach achat vetishtere

a: Rabbi hi deamar bainan shene passin detanya chatzer niteret befas echad rabbi omer bishne passin

Hay may i amratte bishlama nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim eno nidon mishshum lechi verabbi savar lah kerabbi yose udrabbi zera udravina leta mishshum hachi ketanna beeser ugdola beachat esre mishshum derabbi savar lah kerabbi yose
Ella i amratte nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim nidon mishshum lechi udrabbi zera udravina ita verabbi la savar lah kerabbi yose gedola beachat esre lema li
Mimma nafshach i lemishreyah ligdola kaate beeser ushne tefachim saggi vei lemesrah liktanna kaate leashmoinan demaflegi tuva
Ella lav shema minah nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim eno nidon mishshum lechi shema minah
Amar rav yosef la shemia li ha shemateta

Amar leh abbaye atte amarte nihalan veaha amarte nihalan deamar rame bar abba amar rav huna lechi hammoshech im dofno shel mavoy pachot mearba ammot nidon mishshum lechi umishtammesh im chuddo happenimi arba ammot nidon mishshum mavoy veasur lehishtammesh bechullo
Veatte amarte lan alah shema minah telat shema minah ben lechayayin asur ushma minah meshech mavoy bearba ushma minah nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim nidon mishshum lechi
Vehilcheta nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim nidon mishshum lechi teuvta vehilcheta
In mishshum detane rabbi chiyya keoteh
Veharachav meeser yemaet amar abbaye tana veharachav meeser yemaet rabbi yehuda omer eno tzarich lemaet vead kamma
Savar rav achay kammeh derav yosef lememar ad shelosh esre amma ushlish vekal vachomer mippasse viraot

Uma passe viraot shehittarta bahen parutz merubbe al haomed lo hittarta bahen yoter mishshelosh esre amma ushlish mavoy shello hittarta bo parutz merubbe al haomed eno din shello tattir bo yoter mishshelosh esre amma ushlish

Vehi hannotenet passe viraot shehittarta bahen parutz merubbe al haomed lo tattir bahen yoter mishshelosh esre amma ushlish mavoy shello hittarta bo parutz merubbe al haomed tattir bo yoter mishshelosh esre ammot ushlish
I name leidach gisa passe viraot deakkelte behu chad kulla akkel behu kulla acharina mavoy kelal kelal la
Tane levi mavoy shehu rachav esrim amma noatz kane beemtzaito vedayyo hu tane lah vehu amar lah deen halacha keotah mishna ika deamri amar shemuel mishshemeh delevi en halacha keotah mishna
Ella hechi aved amar shemuel mishshemeh delevi
b: Ose pas gavoha asara bemeshech arba ammot umaamido leorko shel mavoy
I name kidrav yehuda deamar rav yehuda mavoy shehu rachav chamesh esre amma marchik shette ammot veose pas shalosh ammot
Veammay yaase pas amma umechetza veyarchik shette ammot veyaase pas amma umechetza shema minah omed merubbe al happarutz mishte ruchot la have omed
Leolam ema lach have omed veshane hacha deate avera dehay gisa veavera dehay gisa umvattel leh
Veyaase pas amma veyarchik amma veyaase pas amma veyarchik amma veyaase pas amma shema minah omed kefarutz asur
Leolam ema lach muttar veshane hacha deate avera dehay gisa udhay gisa umvattel leh
Veyarchik amma veyaase pas amma umechetza veyarchik amma veyaase pas amma umechetza
In hachi name vechulle hay la atrechuh rabbanan
Velechush dilma shavek pitcha rabba veayel befitcha zuta amar rav adda bar matna chazaka en adam manniach petach gadol venichnas befetach katan
Umay shena midderabbi amme udrabbe assi
Hatam ka memaet behilucha hacha la ka memaet behilucha
Tenan hatam or haasla vechalal shello mitztarfin betefach
May or haasla amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan or kisuy shel bet hakkisse
Vechamma ki ata rav dimi amar etzbaayim mikkan veetzbaayim mikkan veetzbaayim revach baemtza ki ata ravin amar etzba umechetza mikkan veetzba umechetza mikkan veetzba revach baemtza
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi mi peligitu amar leh la ha beravrevata ha bezutrata vela peligin
Amar leh laye peligitu uvomed merubbe al happarutz mishte ruchot peligitu ledidach have omed mishte ruchot leravin meruach achat have omed mishte ruchot la have omed
Dei salka datach la peligitu leravin hachi ibi leh lememar etzba ushlish mikkan veetzba ushlish mikkan veetzba ushlish revach baemtza
Veella may peliginan ledidi hachi ibi li lememar etzba ushne shelishim mikkan veetzba ushne shelishim mikkan veetzbaayim ushne shelishim revach baemtza
Ella i ika lememar difliginan bifarutz keomed peliginan
Im yesh lo tzurat happetach af al pi sherachav meeser eno tzarich lemaet ashkechan tzurat happetach demahneya berachbo vaamaltera demahneya begovho

a: Ipcha may
Ta shema detanya mavoy shehu gavoha meesrim amma yemaet veim yesh lo tzurat happetach eno tzarich lemaet
Amaltera berochbo may ta shema detanya mavoy shehu gavoha meesrim amma yemaet veharachav meeser yemaet veim yesh lo tzurat happetach eno tzarich lemaet veim yesh lo amaltera eno tzarich lemaet
May lav assefa la aresha
Matne leh rav yehuda lechiyya bar rav kammeh derav eno tzarich lemaet amar leh atneyeh tzarich lemaet
Amar rav yosef middivre rabbenu nilmad chatzer sherubbah petachim vechallonot enah niteret betzurat happetach

May tama hoil veoter meeser oser bemavoy ufarutz merubbe al haomed oser bechatzer ma yoter meeser haoser bemavoy eno nitar betzurat happetach af parutz merubbe al haomed haoser bechatzer eno nitar betzurat happetach
Ma leoter meeser haoser bemavoy shekken lo hittarta bo etzel passe viraot lerabbi meir tomar befarutz merubbe al haomed haoser bechatzer shekken hittarta etzel passe viraot ledivre hakkol
Lema mesayya leh defanot hallalu sherubban petachim vechallonot muttar uvilvad sheyehe omed merubbe al happarutz
Sherubban salka datach ella ema sheriba bahen petachim vechallonot uvilvad sheyehe omed merubbe al happarutz
Amar rav kahana ki tanya hahi befitche shimae
May pitche shimae peligi bah rav rechumi verav yosef chad amar delet lehu shikfe vechad amar delet lehu tikra

Veaf rabbi yochanan savar lah leha derav deamar ravin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak maase beadam echad mibbikat bet chortan shennaatz arbaa kundesin bearba pinot hassade umatach zemora alehem uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiru lo leinyan kilayim
Veamar resh lakish kederech shehittiru lo leinyan kilayim kach hittiru lo leinyan shabbat rabbi yochanan amar lechilayim hittiru lo leinyan shabbat lo hittiru lo
Bemay askinan ilema min hatztzad vehaamar rav chisda tzurat happetach sheasaah min hatztzad lo asa velo chelum
Ella al gabban uvmay ilema beeser beha lema rabbi yochanan beshabbat la
Ella lav beyater meeser
La leolam beeser umin hatztzad uvidrav chisda ka mipalgi
Urmi derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan urmi deresh lakish adderesh lakish deamar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda berabbi chanina
b: Pea mutteret leinyan kilayim aval lo leshabbat verabbi yochanan amar kimchitzot leshabbat dela kach mechitzot lechilayim delo
Bishlama deresh lakish adderesh lakish la kashya ha dideh ha derabbeh ella derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan kashya
I amratte bishlama hatam al gabban hacha min hatztzad shappir ella i amratte ide veide min hatztzad may ika lememar
Leolam ide veide min hatztzad hatam beeser hacha beoter meeser

Umna temra deshane lan ben eser leoter meeser daamar leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish lo kach haya hammaase shehalach rabbi yehoshua etzel rabbi yochanan ben nuri lilmod tora af al pi shebbaki behilchot kilayim umtzao sheyyoshev ben hailanot umatach zemora meilan leilan veamar lo rabbi i gefanim kan mahu lizroa kan amar lo beeser muttar beoter meeser asur
Bemay askinan ilema al gabban yoter meeser asur vehatanya hau sham kanin haddokranin veasa lahen pea milmala afilu beoter meeser muttar
Ella lav min hatztzad vekaamar leh beeser muttar yoter meeser asur shema minah
Gufa amar rav chisda tzurat happetach sheasaah min hatztzad lo asa velo chelum
Veamar rav chisda tzurat happetach sheamru tzericha shettehe beria kede lehaamid bah delet vaafilu delet shel kashshin
Amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yannay tzurat happetach tzericha heker tzir may heker tzir amar rav aveya avkata
Ashkechinhu rav acha bereh derav aveya letalmide derav ashe amar lehu amar mar mide betzurat happetach amaru leh lo amar velo kelum
Tana tzurat happetach sheamru kane mikkan vekane mikkan vekane al gabbehen tzerichin liga o en tzerichin liga rav nachman amar en tzerichin liga verav sheshet amar tzerichin liga

Azal rav nachman vaavad ovada be resh galuta kishmateh amar leh rav sheshet leshammaeh rav gadda zil shelof shedinhu azal shelaf shedinhu ashkechuhu deve resh galuta chavshuhu azal rav sheshet kam abbava amar leh gadda pok ta nefak vaata

Ashkecheh rav sheshet lerabba bar shemuel amar leh tane mar mide betzurat happetach amar leh in tenena kipa rabbi meir mechayyev bimzuza vachachamim potrin veshavin sheim yesh beragleha asara shehi chayyevet
Amar abbaye hakkol modim im gevoha asara veen beragleha shelosha i name yesh beragleha shelosha veen gevoha asara velo kelum
Ki peligi beyesh beragleha shelosha ugvoha asara veen rechava arbaa veyesh bah lachok lehashlimah learbaa
Rabbi meir savar chokkin lehashlim verabbanan savri en chokkin lehashlim
Amar leh i mashkachatte lehu la tema lehu leve resh galuta vela mide meha matnita dechipa
Matni hechsher mavoy bet shammay omrim lechi vekora uvet hillel omrim o lechi o kora rabbi eliezer omer lechayayin

Mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad lifne rabbi akiva lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mavoy shehu pachot mearba ammot shehu nitar o belechi o bekora al ma nechleku al rachav mearba ammot vead eser shebbet shammay omrim lechi vekora uvet hillel omrim o lechi o kora amar rabbi akiva al ze veal ze nechleku
Gema keman dela kachananya vela ketanna kamma
Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar hechsher mavoy satum ketzad bet shammay omrim lechi vekora uvet hillel omrim o lechi o kora
Bet shammay omrim lechi vekora lememra deka savri bet shammay arba mechitzot deorayeta
La lizrok mishshalosh hu demichayyav letaltel ad deika arba
Bet hillel omrim o lechi o kora lema ka savri bet hillel shalosh mechitzot deorayeta
La lizrok mishshettayim hu demichayyav letaltel ad deika shalosh
Rabbi eliezer omer lechayayin ibaya lehu rabbi eliezer lechayayin vekora kaamar o dilma lechayayin belo kora kaamar
Ta shema maase berabbi eliezer shehalach etzel rabbi yose ben perida talmido

a: Leovalin umtzao sheyyoshev bemavoy sheen lo ella lechi echad amar lo beni ase lechi acher amar lo vechi lesotmo ani tzarich amar lo yissatem uma bechach

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mavoy shehu pachot mearba ammot sheeno tzarich kelum al ma nechleku al rachav mearba ammot vead eser shebbet shammay omrim lechi vekora uvet hillel omrim o lechi o kora
Katane mihat vechi lesotmo ani tzarich i amratte bishlama lechayayin vekora mishshum hachi amar vechi lesotmo ani tzarich ella i amratte lechayayin belo kora may lesotmo
Hachi kaamar vechi lesotmo bilchayayin ani tzarich

Amar mar amar rabban shimon ben gamliel lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mavoy sheppachot mearba ammot sheeno tzarich kelum veha anan tenan mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad lifne rabbi akiva lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mavoy shehu pachot mearba ammot shehu nitar o belechi o bekora
Amar rav ashe hachi kaamar eno tzarich lechi vekora kevet shammay velo lechayayin kerabbi eliezer ella o lechi o kora kevet hillel
Vechamma amar rav achlay veitema rav yechiel ad arbaa
Amar rav sheshet amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer befasse chatzer verav nachman amar halacha kerabbi eliezer befasse chatzer
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak man modim rabbi halacha mikkelal difligi man pelig aleh rabbanan detanya chatzer niteret befas echad rabbi omer bishne fassin

Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan chatzer tzericha shene fassin amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi mi amar rabbi yochanan hachi veha atte hu deamratte mishshemeh derabbi yochanan passe chatzer tzerichin sheyehe bahen arbaa vechi tema arbaa mikkan vearbaa mikkan
Vehatane rav adda bar avimi kammeh derabbi chanina veamri lah kammeh derabbi chanina bar pappi ketanna beeser ugdola beachat esre
Ki salek rabbi zera miyyamme parshah baruach achat bearbaa mishte ruchot mashshehu lechan umashshehu lechan
Vehadtane adda bar avimi rabbi hi vesavar lah kerabbi yose

Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel chatzer niteret befas echad amar leh abbaye lerav yosef mi amar shemuel hachi veha amar leh shemuel lerav chananya bar shela atte la taaved ovada ella o berov dofen o bishne fassin
Amar leh vaana la yadana deovada hava bedura diruta leshon yam hannichnas lechatzer hava vaata lekammeh derav yehuda vela atzrecheh ella pas echad
Amar leh leshon yam kaamratte kal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim
Kediva mineh rabbi tavla merav mechitza teluya mahu shettattir bechurba amar leh en mechitza teluya matteret ella bemayim kal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim
Mikkol makom kashya
Ki ato rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua mibbe rav pershuha meruach achat bearbaa mishte ruchot mashshehu lechan umashshehu lechan
Amar rav pappa i kashya li ha kashya li daamar leh shemuel lerav chananya bar shela atte la taaved ovada ella o berov dofen o bishne fassin
Lema li rov dofen befas arbaa saggi vechi tema may berov dofen bedofen shiva divarbea hava leh rov dofen lema li arbaa bishlosha umashshehu saggi deha amar rav achlay veitema rav yechiel ad arbaa
Ibaet ema kan bechatzer kan bemavoy veibaet ema derav achlay gufeh tannae hi

Tanu rabbanan leshon yam hannichnas lechatzer en memallein hemennu beshabbat ella im ken yesh lo mechitza gavoha asara tefachim bamme devarim amurim sheppirtzato beoter measara aval asara en tzarich kelum
Mimla hu dela memalleinan ha taltole metaltelinan veha nifretza chatzer bimloah lemakom haasur lah
b: Hacha vemay askinan deit leh gidude
Amar rav yehuda mavoy shello nishtattefu bo hichshiro belechi hazzorek letocho chayyav hichshiro bekora hazzorek letocho patur
Matkef lah rav sheshet tama delo nishtattefu bo ha nishtattefu bo afilu hichshiro bekora name chayyav vechi kikkar zo osa oto reshut hayyachid o reshut harabbim
Vehatanya chatzerot shel rabbim umvoot sheenan mefullashin ben ervu uven lo ervu hazzorek letochan chayyav
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav yehuda mavoy sheeno rauy leshituf hichshiro belechi hazzorek letocho chayyav hichshiro bekora hazzorek letocho patur
Alma kasavar lechi mishshum mechitza vekora mishshum heker vechen amar rabba lechi mishshum mechitza vekora mishshum heker verava amar echad ze veechad ze mishshum heker
Etiveh rabbi yaakov bar abba lerava hazzorek lemavoy yesh lo lechi chayyav en lo lechi patur
Hachi kaamar eno tzarich ella lechi hazzorek letocho chayyav lechi vedavar acher hazzorek letocho patur
Etiveh yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda mi sheyyesh lo shene vattim bishne tzide reshut harabbim ose lechi mikkan velechi mikkan o kora mikkan vekora mikkan venose venoten baemtza
Amru lo en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach
Hatam kasavar rabbi yehuda shette mechitzot deorayeta
Amar rav yehuda amar rav mavoy sheorko kerochbo eno nitar belechi mashshehu amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav mavoy sheorko kerochbo eno nitar bekora tefach
Amar rabbi zera kamma mechavvenan shemata desave kevan deorko kerochbo have leh chatzer vechatzer enah niteret belechi vekora ella befas arbaa
Amar rabbi zera i kashya li ha kashya li leheve hay lechi kefas mashshehu venishtere
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan passe chatzer tzerichin sheyehe bahen arbaa

Amar rav nachman naktinan ezehu mavoy shennitar belechi vekora kol sheorko yater al rochbo uvattim vachatzerot petuchim letocho veezo hi chatzer sheenah niteret belechi vekora ella befas arbaa kol shemmerubbaat
Merubbaat in agulla la hachi kaamar i orkah yater al rochbah have leh mavoy umavoy belechi vekora saggi vei la have lah chatzer
Vechamma savar shemuel lememar ad deika pi shenayim berochbah amar leh rav hachi amar chavivi afilu mashshehu
Mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad ku

a: Rabbi akiva omer al ze veal ze nechleku ku
Rabbi akiva hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu derav achlay veitema rav yechiel vela mesayemi
Tanya amar rabbi akiva la amar rabbi yishmael davar ze ella oto talmid amar davar ze vahalacha keoto talmid
Ha gufah kashya amratte la amar rabbi yishmael davar ze alma let hilcheta keoteh vahadar amratte halacha keoto talmid
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo amarah rabbi akiva ella lechadded bah hattalmidim
Verav nachman bar yitzchak amar nirin itmar
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol makom sheatta motze mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad lifne rabbi akiva eno ella rabbi meir sheshshimesh et rabbi yishmael veet rabbi akiva
Detanya amar rabbi meir keshehayiti etzel rabbi yishmael hayiti metil kankantom letoch haddeo velo amar li davar keshebbati etzel rabbi akiva asarah alay

Ini vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi meir keshehayiti lomed etzel rabbi akiva hayiti metil kankantom letoch haddeo velo amar li davar uchshebbati etzel rabbi yishmael amar li beni ma melachtecha amarti lo lavlar ani amar li beni heve zahir bimlachtecha shemmelachtecha melechet shamayim hi shemma atta mechasser ot achat o meyater ot achat nimtzeta machariv et kal haolam kullo
Amarti lo davar echad yesh li vekankantom shemo sheani metil letoch haddeo amar li vechi metilin kankantom letoch haddeo vahalo amra tora vechatav umacha ketav sheyyachol limmachot
May kaamar leh umay ka mehaddar leh

Hachi kaamar leh la mibaya bachaserot uviterot dela taena devaki ana ella afilu mechash lizvuv name dilma ate veyatev attageh dedalet umachek leh umshave leh resh davar echad yesh li vekankantom shemo sheani metil letoch haddeo
Kashya shimush ashshimush kashya asarah aasarah
Bishlama shimush ashshimush la kashya meikara ata lekammeh derabbi akiva umiddela matze lemekam allibeh ata lekammeh derabbi yishmael ugmar gemara vahadar ata lekammeh derabbi akiva usvar sevara
Ella asarah aasarah kashya kashya
Tanya rabbi yehuda omer rabbi meir haya omer lakkol metilin kankantom letoch haddeo chutz mipparashat sota verabbi yaakov omer mishshemo chutz mipparashat sota shebbammikdash
May benayehu amar rav yirmeya limchok lah min hattora ika benayehu
Vehane tannae chi hane tannae detanya en megilatah keshera lehashkot bah sota acheret rabbi achay bar yoshiyya amar megilatah keshera lehashkot bah sota acheret
Amar rav pappa dilma la hi ad kan la kaamar tanna kamma hatam ella kevan deintik leshum rachel tu la hadra minatka leshum lea aval gabbe tora distama mikatva hachi name demachakinan
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak dilma la hi ad kan la kaamar rabbi achay bar yoshiyya hatam ella deiktiv mihat leshum sota baolam aval gabbe tora dilhitlammed ketiva hachi name dela mechakyanan
Velet leh lerabbi achay bar yoshiyya ha ditnan katav get legaresh et ishto
b: Venimlach umtzao ben iro veamar shimcha kishmi veshem ishtecha keshem ishti pasul legaresh bo
Hachi hashta hatam vechatav lah ketiv bainan ketiva lishmah hacha veasa lah ketiv bainan asiyya lishmah asiyya didah mechika hi

Amar rabbi acha bar chanina galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam sheen bedoro shel rabbi meir kemoto umippene ma lo kavu halacha kemoto shello yachlu chaverav laamod al sof dato shehu omer al tame tahor umare lo panim al tahor tame umare lo panim

Tana lo rabbi meir shemo ella rabbi nehoray shemo velamma nikra shemo rabbi meir shehu meir ene chachamim bahalacha velo nehoray shemo ella rabbi nechemya shemo veamri lah rabbi elazar ben arach shemo velamma nikra shemo nehoray shemmanhir ene chachamim bahalacha
Amar rabbi hay dimchaddadna mechavray dachaziteh lerabbi meir meachoreh veilu chaziteh mikkammeh hava mechaddadna tefe dichtiv vehau enecha root et morecha

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan talmid haya lo lerabbi meir vesomchos shemo shehaya omer al kol davar vedavar shel tuma arbaim ushmone taame tuma veal kol davar vedavar shel tohora arbaim ushmone taame tohora
Tana talmid vatik haya beyavne shehaya metaher et hashsheretz bemea vachamishshim teamim
Amar ravina ani adun vaataharennu uma nachash shemmemit umarbe tuma tahor sheretz sheen memit umarbe tuma lo kol shekken
Vela hi maase kotz bealma kaaved

Amar rabbi abba amar shemuel shalosh shanim nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel hallalu omrim halacha kemotenu vehallalu omrim halacha kemotenu yatza bat kol veamra ellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim hen vahalacha kevet hillel

Vechi meachar sheellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim mippene ma zachu bet hillel likboa halacha kemotan mippene shennochin vaaluvin hau veshonin divrehen vedivre bet shammay velo od ella shemmakdimin divre bet shammay ledivrehen

Keotah sheshshaninu mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin amru bet hillel levet shammay lo kach haya maase shehalchu zikne bet shammay vezikne bet hillel levakker et rabbi yochanan ben hachoranit umtzauhu yoshev rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit amru lahen bet shammay i mishsham reaya af hen amru lo im kach hayita noheg lo kiyyamta mitzvat sukka miyyamecha

Lelammedcha shekkol hammashpil atzmo hakkadosh baruch hu magbiho vechol hammagbiha atzmo hakkadosh baruch hu mashpilo kol hamchazzer al haggedulla gedulla borachat mimmennu vechol habboreach min haggedulla gedulla mechazzeret acharav vechol haddochek et hashshaa shaa dochakto vechol hannidche mippene shaa shaa omedet lo

Tanu rabbanan shette shanim umechetza nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel hallalu omrim noach lo leadam shello nivra yoter mishshennivra vehallalu omrim noach lo leadam shennivra yoter mishshello nivra nimnu vegamru noach lo leadam shello nivra yoter mishshennivra achshav shennivra yefashpesh bemaasav veamri lah yemashmesh bemaasav
Matni hakkora sheamru rechava kede lekabbel ariach veariach chatzi levena shel shelosha tefachim dayyah lakkora shettehe rechava tefach kede lekabbel ariach lerochbo
Rechava kede lekabbel ariach uvria kede lekabbel ariach rabbi yehuda omer rechava af al pi sheen beria hayeta shel kash veshel kanim roin otah keilu hi shel mattechet
Akumma roin otah keilu hi peshuta agulla roin otah keilu hi merubbaat kol sheyyesh behekefo shelosha tefachim yesh bo rochav tefach

a: Gema tefach tefach umechetza bae
Kevan derachav lekabbel tefach idach chatzi tefach melabben leh betina mashshehu mehay gisa umashshehu mehay gisa vekayema

Amar rabba bar rav huna kora sheamru tzericha shettehe beria kede lekabbel ariach umaamide kora enan tzerichin sheyyihu beriin kede lekabbel kora veariach verav chisda amar echad ze veechad ze tzerichin sheyyihu beriin kede lekabbel kora veariach

Amar rav sheshet hinniach kora al gabbe mavoy ufaras aleha machtzelet vehigbiha min hakkarka shelosha kora en kan mechitza en kan kora en kan deha mikasseya mechitza en kan dehaveya lah mechitza shehaggedayim bokin bah

Tanu rabbanan kora hayyotza mikkotel ze veenah nogaat bechotel ze vechen shette korot achat yotza mikkotel ze veachat yotza mikkotel ze veenan nogot zo bazo pachot mishshelosha en tzarich lehavi kora acheret shelosha tzarich lehavi kora acheret
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer pachot mearba en tzarich lehavi kora acheret arba tzarich lehavi kora acheret
Vechen shette korot hammatimot lo bezo kede lekabbel ariach velo bazo kede lekabbel ariach im mekabbelot ariach lerochbo tefach en tzarich lehavi kora acheret veim lav tzarich lehavi kora acheret
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im mekabbelet ariach leorko shelosha en tzarich lehavi kora acheret veim lav tzarich lehavi kora acheret

Hau achat lemala veachat lematta rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer roin et haelona keilu hi lematta veet hattachtona keilu hi lemala uvilvad shello tehe elona lemala meesrim amma vetachtona lematta measara
Amar abbaye rabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar lah kaavuh bachada uflig aleh bachada savar lah kaavuh bachada deit leh roin
Uflig aleh bachada deilu rabbi yehuda savar lemala meesrim verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar betoch esrim in lemala meesrim la
Rabbi yehuda omer rechava af al pi sheenah beria matne leh rav yehuda lechiyya bar rav kammeh derav rechava af al pi sheenah beria amar leh atneyeh rechava uvria
Vehaamar rabbi ilay amar rav rechava arbaa af al pi sheenah beria rechava arbaa shane
Hayeta shel kash ku may ka mashma lan deamrinan roin hayenu hach
Mahu detema beminah amrinan shello beminah la amrinan ka mashma lan
