Akumma roin otah keilu hi peshuta peshita ka mashma lan kidrabbi zera deamar rabbi zera hi betoch hammavoy veakmumitah chutz lammavoy hi betoch esrim veakmumitah lemala meesrim hi lemala measara veakmumitah lematta measara roin kol sheilu yinnatel akmumitah veen ben ze laze shelosha en tzarich lehavi kora acheret veim lav tzarich lehavi kora acheret
Ha name peshita hi betoch mavoy veakmumitah chutz lammavoy itztericha leh mahu detema lechush dilma ate leimmeshoche batrah ka mashma lan
Agulla roin otah keilu hi merubbaat ha tu lema li sefa itztericha leh kol sheyyesh behekefo shelosha tefachim yesh bo rochav tefach
Mena hane mile amar rabbi yochanan amar kera vayyaas et hayyam mutzak eser baamma missefato ad sefato agol saviv vechamesh baamma komato vekav sheloshim baamma yasov oto saviv
Veha ika sefato
Amar rav pappa sefato sefat perach shoshan ketiv beh dichtiv veovo tefach usfato kemaase kos perach shoshan alpayim bat yachil
Vehaika mashshehu ki ka chashev miggavay ka chashev
Tanya rabbi chiyya yam sheasa shelomo haya machazik mea vachamishshim mikve tohora mikkedi mikve kamma have arbaim sea kidtanya verachatz et besaro
b: Bemayim beme mikve kol besaro mayim shekkol gufo ole bahen vechamma hen amma al amma berum shalosh ammot veshiaru chachamim me mikve arbaim sea
Kamma hau lehu chamesh mea garmide litlat mea mea lemea vechamshin chamshin bearba mea vechamshin saggi
Hane mile beribua yam sheasa shelomo agol haya
Mikkede kamma merubba yater al heagol revia learba mea mea lemea esrim vachamishsha hane mea veesrim vachamishsha hau lehu
Tane rame bar yechezkel yam sheasa shelomo shalosh ammot tachtonot merubbaot ushtayim elonot agullot
Nehi deipcha la matzet amratte disfato agol ketiv ella ema chada
La salka datach dichtiv alpayim bat yachil bat kamma haveya shalosh sein dichtiv masar habbat min hakkor dehave lehu shita alfe gerive
Veha ketiv machazik battim sheloshet alafim hahu legudsha

Amar abbaye shema minah hay gudsha tilta have utnan name shida teva umigdal kaveret hakkash vechaveret hakkanim uvor sefina alekkesanderit af al pi sheyyesh lahen shulayim vehen machazikot arbaim sea ballach shehen korayim bayyavesh tehorin
Matni lechayayin sheamru govhan asara tefachim verochban veovyan kol shehu rabbi yose omer rochban shelosha tefachim
Gema lechayayin sheamru ku lema tenan setama kerabbi eliezer deamar lechayayin bainan
La may lechayayin lechayayin dealma i hachi kora name nitne korot umay korot korot dealma
Hachi kaamar otan lechayayin shennechleku bahen rabbi eliezer vachachamim govhan asara tefachim verochban veovyan kol shehu vechamma kol shehu tane rabbi chiyya afilu kechut hassarbal
Tana asa lechi lachatzi mavoy en lo ella chatzi mavoy peshita ella ema yesh lo chatzi mavoy ha name peshita mahu detema lechush dilma ate leishtammoshe bechulleh ka mashma lan

Amar rava asa lechi lemavoy vehigbiho min hakkarka shelosha o shehifligo min hakkotel shelosha lo asa velo chelum afilu lerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar amrinan lavud hane mile lemala aval lematta kevan dehaveya mechitza shehaggedayin bokin bah la kaamar
Rabbi yose omer rochban shelosha tefachim amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel en halacha kerabbi yose lo behelme velo bilchayayin

Amar leh rav huna bar chinana behelme amarte lan bilchayayin la amarte lan may shena behelme difligi rabbanan aleh lechayayin name peligi rabbanan aleh amar leh shane lechayayin mishshum dekae rabbi keoteh

Rav rechumi matne hachi amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav en halacha kerabbi yose lo behelme velo bilchayayin amar leh amarte amar lehu la amar rava haelohim amrah ugmirna lah mineh umay tama ka hadar beh mishshum derabbi yose nimuko immo
Amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye hilcheta may amar leh pok chazi may amma davar

Ika dematne lah aha hashshote mayim litzmao omer shehakkol nihya bidvaro rabbi tarfon omer bore nefashot rabbot vechesronan al kal ma shebbarata amar leh rav chanan leabbaye hilcheta may amar leh pok chazi may amma davar

a: Itmar lechi haomed meelav abbaye amar have lechi rava amar la have lechi

Hecha dela samchinan aleh meetmol kulle alma la peligi dela have lechi ki peligi hecha desamchinan aleh meetmol abbaye amar have lechi deha samchinan aleh meetmol rava amar la have lechi kevan demeikara lav addateh dehachi avidi la have lechi
Ka salka datach ki hechi difligi belechi peligi name bimchitza
Ta shema haose sukkato ben hailanot veilanot defanot lah keshera hacha bemay askinan shennetaan mittechila lechach i hachi peshita mahu detema ligzor dilma ate leishtammoshe beilan ka mashma lan
Ta shema haya sham ilan o gader o chitzat hakkanim nidon mishshum deomad
Hacha name bemay askinan sheasaan mittechila lechach i hachi may ka mashma lan ka mashma lan chitzat hakkanim kane kane pachot mishshelosha tefachim kediva mineh abbaye merabba
Ta shema ilan hammesech al haaretz im en nofo gavoha min haaretz shelosha tefachim metaltelin tachtav hacha name bemay askinan shennetao mittechila lechach
I hachi litaltel bechullo allema amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua en metaltelin bo ella bet satayim
Mishshum dehave dira shettashmishah laavir vechol dira shettashmishah laavir en metaltelin bah ella bet satayim

Ta shema shavat betel shehu gavoha asara vehu mearba ammot vead bet satayim vechen beneka shehu amok asara vehu mearba ammot vead bet satayim vekama ketzura veshibolot makkifot otah mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma
Vechi tema hacha name sheasa mittechila lechach bishlama kama lechayye ella tel vaneka may ika lememar

Ella bimchitzot kulle alma la peligi dehaveya mechitza ki peligi belechi abbaye letameh deamar lechi mishshum mechitza umchitza haasuya meeleha haveya mechitza verava letameh deamar lechi mishshum heker i avida beyadayim haveya heker vei la la have heker
Ta shema avne gader hayyotzot min haggader muvdalot zo mizzo pachot mishshelosha en tzarich lechi acher shelosha tzarich lechi acher
Hacha name shebbenaan mittechila lechach i hachi peshita mahu detema lemesar binyana hu daavida ka mashma lan
Ta shema detane rabbi chiyya kotel shetztzido echad kanus mechavero ben shennire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim uven shennire mibbifnim veshave mibbachutz niddon mishshum lechi
Hacha name sheasao mittechila lechach i hachi may ka mashma lan ha ka mashma lan nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim niddon mishshum lechi

Ta shema derav hava yatev behahu mevoa hava yatev rav huna kammeh amar leh leshammaeh zil ayeti li kuza demayya ad daata nefal lechya achvi leh bideh kam adduchteh amar leh rav huna la savar lah mar lismoch addikla amar dame hay merabbanan keman dela parshi inashe shemata mi samchinan aleh meetmol
Tama dela samchinan ha samchinan have lechi
Lema abbaye verava bidla samchinan aleh peligi ha samchinan aleh have lechi la salka datach dehahu barka dahava be bar chavu dahao peligi bah abbaye verava kulle shenayehu
Matni bakkol osin lechayayin afilu bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim verabbi meir oser umtamme mishshum golel
b: Verabbi meir metaher vechotvin alav gite nashim verabbi yose haggelili posel

Gema tanya rabbi meir omer kal davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim en osin oto lo dofen lesukka velo lechi lemavoy lo passin leveraot velo golel lekever mishshum rabbi yose haggelili amru af en kotvin alav gite nashim

May tama derabbi yose haggelili detanya sefer en li ella sefer minnayin lerabbot kal davar talmud lomar vechatav lah mikkol makom im ken ma talmud lomar sefer lomar lach ma sefer davar sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel af kal davar sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel
Verabbanan mi ketiv besefer sefer ketiv lisfirut devarim bealma hu daata

Verabbanan hay vechatav lah may darshi beh hahu mibbee leh bichtiva mitgareshet veenah mitgareshet bechesef salka datach amena hoil veitakkash yetzia lahavaya ma havaya bechesef af yetzia bechesef ka mashma lan
Verabbi yose haggelili hay sevara mena leh nafka leh missefer keritut sefer kortah veen davar acher kortah

Verabbanan hay sefer keritut mibe leh ledavar hakkoret beno levenah lechidtanya hare ze gitech al menat shello tishti yayin al menat shello telchi levet avich leolam en ze keritut kal sheloshim yom hare ze keritut
Verabbi yose haggelili nafka leh mikkaret keritut
Verabbanan karet keritut la darshi
Matni sheyara shechanta bevika vehikkifuha kele vehema metaltelin betochah uvilvad sheyehe gader gavoha asara tefachim velo yehu pirtzot yeterot al habbinyan
Kal pirtza shehi keeser ammot mutteret mippene shehi kefetach yater mikkan asur
Gema itmar parutz keomed rav pappa amar muttar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar asur
Rav pappa amar muttar hachi agmereh rachamana lemoshe la tifrotz rubba rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar asur hachi agmereh rachamana lemoshe gedor rubba
Tenan velo yehu pirtzot yeterot al habbinyan ha kabbinyan muttar
La tema ha kabbinyan muttar ella ema im binyan yater al happirtza muttar
Aval kabbinyan may asur i hachi litne lo yehu pirtzot kabbinyan kashya
Ta shema hamkare sukkato beshappudin o baarukkot hammitta im yesh revach benehen kemotan keshera
Hacha bemay askinan keshennichnas veotze
Veha efshar letzamtzem
Amar rabbi amme bemaadif
Rava amar im hau netunin erev notno sheti sheti notno erev
Ta shema sheyara shechanta bevika vehikkifuha bigmallin beukkafot

a: Baavitin bishlifin bekanim bekolachot metaltelin betochah uvilvad shello yehe ben gamal legamal kimlo gamal uven ukkaf leukkaf kimlo ukkaf uven avit leavit kimlo avit
Hacha name keshennichnas veotze
Ta shema nimtzeta atta omer shalosh middot bimchitzot kol shehu pachot mishshelosha tzarich shello yehe ben ze laze shelosha kede shello yizdakker haggedi bevat rosh
Kol shehu shelosha umishshelosha ad arbaa tzarich shello yehe ben ze laze kimloo kede shello yehe parutz keomed veim haya parutz merubbe al haomed af keneged haomed asur

Kol shehu arbaa umearbaa ad eser ammot tzarich shello yehe ben ze laze kimloo shello yehe parutz keomed veim haya parutz keomed keneged haomed muttar keneged happarutz asur veim haya omed merubbe al happarutz af keneged happarutz muttar
Nifretza beoter meeser asur hau sham kanim haddokranim veose lahen pea milmala afilu beoter meeser muttar
Katane mihat resha mishshelosha ad arbaa uvilvad shello yehe ben ze laze kimloo teuvta derav pappa
Amar lecha rav pappa may meloo nichnas veotze
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane im haya parutz merubbe al haomed af keneged haomed asur ha keomed muttar shema minah
Lema tehve teuvteh derav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar lach velitamach ema sefa im haya omed merubbe al happarutz af keneged happarutz muttar ha kapparutz asur
Sefa kashya lerav pappa resha kashya lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua
Sefa lerav pappa la kashya ayede ditna resha parutz merubbe al haomed tena sefa omed merubbe al happarutz
Resha lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua la kashya ayede devae lemitne sefa omed merubbe al happarutz tena resha parutz merubbe al haomed
Bishlama lerav pappa mishshum hachi la arev lehu vetane lehu
Ella lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua liarvinhu velitninhu kol shehu pachot mishshelosha ushlosha tzarich shello yehe ben ze laze shelosha
Mishshum dela dame pesula deresha lifsula desefa pesula deresha kede shello yizdakker haggedi bevat achat pissula desefa shello yehe parutz kaomed
Pachot mishshelosha manni rabbanan hi deamri pachot mishshelosha amrinan lavud shelosha la amrinan lavud
Ema sefa kol shehu shelosha umishshelosha vead arbaa
b: Atan lerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar pachot mearbaa lavud dei rabbanan mishshelosha vead arbaa shelosha vearbaa chad hu
Amar abbaye midderesha rabbanan sefa name rabbanan umodu rabbanan dechol lemishre kenegdo i ika makom arbaa chashiv vei la la chashiv

Rava amar middesefa rabban shimon ben gamliel resha name rabban shimon ben gamliel vechi amar rabban shimon ben gamliel amrinan lavud hane mile lemala aval lematta have leh kimchitza shehaggedayim bokin bah la amrinan lavud
Ta shema defanot hallalu sherubban petachim vechallonot muttar uvilvad sheyehe omed merubbe al happarutz
Sherubban salka datach ella sheriba bahen petachim vechallonot muttar uvilvad sheyehe omed merubbe al happarutz
Ha kapparutz asur teuvta derav pappa teuvta vehilcheta keoteh derav pappa
Teuvta vehilcheta in mishshum dedayeka matnitin keoteh ditnan lo yihu peratzot yeterot al habbinyan ha kabbinyan muttar
Matni makkifin shelosha chavalim ze lemala mizze vaze lemala mizze uvilvad shello yehu ben chevel lachavero shelosha tefachim
Shiur chavalim veovyan yater al tefach kede sheyehe hakkol asara tefachim
Makkifin bekanim uvilvad shello yehe ben kane lachavero shelosha tefachim
Bishyara dibberu divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim lo dibberu bishyara ella bahove
Kol mechitza sheenah shel sheti veshel erev enah mechitza divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim echad mishshene devarim
Gema amar rav hamnuna amar rav hare amru omed merubbe al happarutz bishti have omed bae rav hamnuna beerev may
Amar abbaye ta shema shiur chavalim veovyan yater al tefach sheyehu hakkol asara tefachim vei ita lema li yater al tefach
Lebed pachot mishshelosha vechevel mashshehu pachot mishshelosha vechevel mashshehu pachot mearbaa vechevel mashshehu
Vetisbera hay pachot mearbaa hecha mokem leh i mokem leh tattay have leh kimchitza shehaggedayim bokin bah
I mokem leh ilay ate avera dehay gisa udhay gisa umvattel leh
I mokem leh bemitze have leh omed merubbe al happarutz mishte ruchot shamatte minah omed merubbe al happarutz mishte ruchot have omed
Ella rav hamnuna hachi ka mibaya leh kegon deayeti machtzelet dehave shiva umashshehu vachakak bah shelosha ushvak bah arbaa umashshehu veokmeh befachot mishshelosha
Rav ashe amar mechitza teluya ibaya leh kediva mineh rabbi tavla merav mechitza teluya mahu shettattir bechurba amar leh en mechitza teluya matteret ella bammayim kal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim
Makkifin bekanim vechu bishyara in beyachid la vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer kol mechitzot shabbat lo hittiru leyachid yoter mibbet satayim
Kidamar rav nachman veitema rav bivi bar abbaye la nitzrecha ella liten lahen kol tzarkan hacha name liten lahen kol tzarkan
Hecha itmar derav nachman veitema rav bivi bar abbaye aha ditnan kol mechitza sheenah shel sheti vaerev enah mechitza divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda

Umi amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hachi vehatanya echad yachid veechad sheyara lachavalim uma ben yachid lishyara yachid notnin lo bet satayim shenayim notnin lahem bet satayim shelosha naasu sheyara venotnin lahen bet shesh divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda
Vachachamim omrim echad yachid veechad sheyara notnin lahen kol tzarkan uvilvad shello yehe bet satayim panuy
Amar rav nachman veitema rav bivi bar abbaye la nitzrecha ella liten lahen kol tzarkan
Darash rav nachman mishshum rabbenu shemuel yachid notnin lo bet satayim shenayim notnin lehu bet satayim shelosha naasu sheyara venotnin lahen bet shesh
Shavakte rabbanan veavdatte kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda

Hadar okem rav nachman amora aleh udrash devarim sheamarti lifnechem taut hen beyadi beram kach amru yachid notnin lo bet satayim shenayim notnin lahen bet satayim shelosha naasu sheyara venotnin lahen kal tzarkan

a: Resha rabbi yose berabbi yehuda vesefa rabbanan
In mishshum dekae avuh beshitteh
Amar rav gidel amar rav shelosha bechamesh asurin besheva muttarin amaru leh amar rav hachi amar lehu orayeta nevie uchtive daamar rav hachi
Amar rav ashe may kashya dilma hachi kaamar hutzrechu leshesh vehikkifu besheva afilu besheva muttarin lo hutzrechu ella lechamesh vehikkifu besheva afilu bechamesh asurin
Veella ha dekatane uvilvad shello yehe bet satayim panuy may lav panuy meadam la panuy mikkelim
Itmar shelosha umet echad mehen shenayim venittosfu alehen rav huna verabbi yitzchak chad amar shabbat goremet vechad amar daorin gormin

Tistayyem derav huna hu deamar shabbat goremet deamar rabba beay merav huna uvay merav yehuda erav derech happetach venistam happetach derech hachallon venistam hachallon mahu veamar li shabbat hoil vehutra huttera tistayyem

Lema rav huna verabbi yitzchak biflugta derabbi yose verabbi yehuda kamipalgi ditnan chatzer shennifretza mishte ruchoteha vechen bayit shennifratz mishte ruchotav vechen mavoy shennitlu korotav o lechayav muttarin leotah shabbat vaasurin leatid lavo divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi yose omer im muttarin leotah shabbat muttarin leatid lavo veim asurin leatid lavo asurin leotah shabbat
Lema rav huna deamar kerabbi yehuda verabbi yitzchak deamar kerabbi yose
Amar lecha rav huna ana daamari afilu lerabbi yose ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hatam ella deletanhu limchitzot hacha itanhu limchitzot
Verabbi yitzchak amar ana daamari afilu lerabbi yehuda ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam ella deitanhu ledaorin hacha letanhu ledaorin
Vachachamim omrim echad mishshene devarim hayenu tanna kamma
Ika benayehu yachid bayyishuv
Matni arbaa devarim patru bammachane meviin etzim mikkol makom ufturin merchitzat yadayim umiddemay umillearev
Gema tanu rabbanan machane hayyotzet lemilchemet harshut muttarin begezel etzim yeveshim rabbi yehuda ben tema omer af chonin bechol makom uvimkom shennehergu sham nikbarin
Muttarin begezel etzim yeveshim hay takkanta dihoshua hava deamar mar asara tenaim hitna yehoshua sheyehu marin bachorashin umlakketin etzim missedotehen
Hatam behizme vehige hacha bishar etzim
I name hatam bimchubbarin hacha bitlushin
I name hatam belachin hacha biveshim
Rabbi yehuda ben tema omer af chonin bechol makom uvimkom shenneheragim sham nikbarim peshita met mitzva hu umet mitzva kone mekomo
La tzericha af al gav
b: Deit leh kovrin detanya ezehu met mitzva kol sheen lo kovrin kore vaacherim onin oto en ze met mitzva
Umet mitzva kana mekomo vehatanya hammotze met mutal bisratya mefannehu limin isratya o lismol isratya
Sede vur usde nir mefannehu lisde vur sede nir usde zera mefannehu lisde nir hau shettehen nirot shettehen zeruot shettehen burot mefannehu lechol ruach sheyyirtze
Amar rav bivi hacha bemet muttal al hammetzar askinan mittoch shennitna reshut lefannoto min hammetzar mefannehu lechol ruach sheyyirtze
Ufturin merchitzat yadayim amar abbaye lo shanu ella mayim rishonim aval mayim acharonim chova
Amar rav chiyya bar ashe mippene ma amru mayim acharonim chova mippene shemmelach sedomit yesh shemmesamme et haenayim
Amar abbaye umishtachcha kekurta bechora amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe kayel milcha may amar leh ha la mibaya

Umiddemay ditnan maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet achsanya demay amar rav huna tana bet shammay omrim en maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet achsanya demay uvet hillel omrim maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet achsanya demay
Umillearev amri deve rabbi yannay lo shanu ella eruve chatzerot aval eruve techumin chayyavin
Detane rabbi chiyya lokin al eruve techumin devar tora
Matkef lah rabbi yonatan vechi lokin al lav shebbeal matkef rav acha bar yaakov ella meatta dichtiv al tifnu el haovot veel hayyiddeonim hachi name dela lake
Rabbi yonatan hachi kashya leh lav shennitan leazharat mitat bet din vechol lav shennitan leazharat mitat bet din en lokin alav
Amar rav ashe mi ketiv al yotzi al yetze ketiv
Hadaran alach mavoy
Matni osin passin leveraot
Arbaa deomdin nirin kishmona divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer shemona nirin kishnem asar arbaa deomdim vearbaa peshutin
Govhan asara tefachim verochban shishsha veovyam kol shehu uvenehen kimlo shette revakot shel shalosh shalosh bakar divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda omer shel arba keshurot velo muttarot achat nichneset veachat yotzet
Muttar lehakriv labbeer uvilvad shettehe para roshah verubbah bifnim veshota
Muttar

a: Leharchik kol shehu uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin rabbi yehuda omer ad bet satayim

Amru lo lo amru bet satayim ella leginna ulkarpef aval im haya dir o sahar o muktze o chatzer afilu bet chameshet korin afilu bet asara korin muttar umuttar leharchik kol shehu uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin
Gema lema matnitin dela kachananya detanya osin passin levor vachavalin lishyara vachananya omer chavalin levor aval lo passin
Afilu tema chananya bor lechud beer lechud
Ika deamri middela katane chananya omer osin chavalin levor ufassin liver mikkelal delachananya la shena bor vela shena beer chavalin in passin la lema matnitin dela kachananya
Afilu tema chananya lemay dekaamar tanna kamma ka mahdar leh
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi akiva ditnan echad beer harabbim uvor harabbim uver hayyachid osin lahen passin aval bor hayyachid osin lo mechitza gavoha asara tefachim divre rabbi akiva
Veilu hacha katane leveraot leveraot in levorot la
Afilu tema rabbi akiva beer mayim chayyim difsika leh la shena derabbim vela shena deyachid katane bor mechunnasin dela pesika leh la katane
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda ben bava ditnan rabbi yehuda ben bava omer en osin passin ella liver harabbim bilvad veilu hacha katane leveraot la shena derabbim vela shena deyachid
Afilu tema rabbi yehuda ben bava may beraot beraot dealma
May deomdin amar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar deo ammudin
Deo limnudde shevach zonit nitkalkel bemida shelosha siman
Tenan hatam rabbi yehuda omer kol hashshitin peturin chutz min haddeofra may deofra amar ulla ilan haose deo perot bashshana

Amar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar deo partzuf panim haya lo leadam harishon shenneemar achor vakedem tzartani ketiv vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela vego rav ushmuel chad amar partzuf vechad amar zanav
Bishlama leman deamar partzuf hayenu dichtiv achor vakedem tzartani ella leman deamar zanav may achor vakedem tzartani
Kidrabbi amme deamar rabbi amme achor lemaase vereshit vakedem lefuranut
Bishlama achor lemaase vereshit dela ibri ad maale shabbeta ella vakedem lefuranut may hi ilema mishshum kelala ha battechila nitkallel nachash ulvassof nitkallela chava ulvassof nitkallel adam
Ella lammabbul dichtiv vayyimach et kol hayekum asher al pene haadama meadam vead behema vego
Bishlama leman deamar partzuf hayenu dichtiv vayyitzer teren yodin ella leman deamar zanav may vayyitzer
Kidrabbi shimon ben pazzi deamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi oy li miyyitzri oy li miyyotzri
Bishlama leman deamar partzuf hayenu dichtiv zachar unkeva beraam ella leman deamar zanav may zachar unkeva beraam
Lechidrabbi avahu derabbi avahu rame ketiv zachar unkeva beraam uchtiv ki betzelem elohim bara oto battechilla alta bemachshava livroot shenayim ulvassof lo nivra ella echad
Bishlama leman deamar partzuf hayenu dichtiv vayyisgor basar tachtenna ella leman deamar zanav may vayyisgor basar tachtenna
Amar rav zevid veitema rabbi yirmeya veitema rav nachman bar yitzchak lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach
Bishlama leman deamar zanav hayenu dichtiv vayyiven ella leman deamar partzuf may vayyiven

Lechidrabbi shimon ben menasya dedaresh rabbi shimon ben menasya vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela melammed shekkilah hakkadosh baruch hu lechava veheviah leadam harishon shekken bichrakke hayyam korin lekallaita bannayeta
Davar acher vayyiven Adonai elohim amar rav chisda veamri lah bematnita tana melammed shebbenaah hakkadosh baruch hu lechava kevinyan
b: Otzar ma otzar ze rachav millematta vekatzar milmala kede lekabbel et happerot af haishsha rechava millematta uktzara milmala kede lekabbel et havalad
Vayevieha el haadam melammed sheasa hakkadosh baruch hu shoshvinut laadam harishon mikkan laggadol sheyyaase shoshvinut lakkatan veal yera lo

Ulman deamar partzuf he minayehu sage beresha amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mistabbera dezachar sage beresha detanya lo yehallech adam achore ishsha badderech vaafilu hi ishto nizdammena al haggesher yesallekenna litzdadin vechol haover achore ishsha bannahar en lo chelek laolam habba

Tanu rabbanan hammartze maot leishsha miyyado leyadah o miyyadah leyado bishvil sheyyistakkel bah afilu dome lemoshe rabbenu shekkibel tora mehar sinay lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam vealav hakkatuv omer yad leyad lo yinnake ra lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam
Amar rav nachman manoach am haaretz haya shenneemar vayyakom vayyelech manoach achare ishto
Matkef lah rav nachman bar yitzchak ella meatta gabbe elkana dichtiv vayyelech elkana achare ishto hachi name vegabbe elisha dichtiv vayyakom vayyelech achareha hachi name
Ella achare devareha vaatzatah hacha name achare devareha vaatzatah
Amar rav ashe ulmay deamar rav nachman manoach am haaretz haya afilu be rav name la kera dichtiv vattakom rivka venaaroteha vattirkavna al haggemallim vattelachna achare haish vela lifne haish
Amar rabbi yochanan achare ari velo achare ishsha achare ishsha velo achare avoda zara achore avoda zara velo achore bet hakkeneset beshaa shemmitpallelin

Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar kal otan hashshanim shehaya adam harishon beniduy holid ruchin veshedin velilin shenneemar vayechi adam sheloshim umat shana vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo mikkelal dead haidana lav ketzalmo oled

Metivi haya rabbi meir omer adam harishon chasid gadol haya kevan sheraa shenniknesa mita al yado yashav betaanit mea sheloshim shana uferash min haishsha mea sheloshim shana veheela zirze teenim al besaro mea sheloshim shana
Ki kaamrinan hahu beshichvat zera dachaza leunseh
Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar miktzat shivcho shel adam omrim befanav vechullo shello befanav miktzat shivcho befanav dichtiv ki otcha raiti tzaddik lefanay baddor hazze
Kullo shello befanav dichtiv noach ish tzaddik tamim haya bedorotav

Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar may dichtiv vehinne ale zayit taraf befiha amra yona lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam yihu mezonotay merorin kezayit umsurin beyadcha veal yihu metukin kidvash utluyin beyad basar vadam ketiv hacha taraf uchtiv hatam hatrifeni lechem chukki
Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar kol bayit shennishmain bo divre tora ballayela shuv eno nechrav shenneemar velo amar ayye eloha osay noten zemirot ballayela
Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash dayyo laolam sheyyishtammesh bishte otiyyot shenneemar kol hanneshama tehallel yah halluyah

Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar nitkallela bavel nitkallelu shecheneha nitkallela shomron nitbarchu shecheneha nitkallela bavel nitkallelu shecheneha dichtiv vesamtiha lemorash kipod veagme mayim nitkallela shomron nitbarchu shecheneha dichtiv vesamti shomron lei hassade

a: Lemattae charem

Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar bo ure shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam middat basar vadam mitchayyev adam hariga lammalchut metilin lo chakka letoch piv kede shello yekallel et hammelech

Middat hakkadosh baruch hu adam mitchayyev hariga lammakom shotek shenneemar lecha dumiyya tehilla velo od ella shemmeshabbeach shenneemar tehilla velo od ella sheddome lo keilu makriv korban shenneemar ulcha yeshullam neder
Hayenu deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may dichtiv ovre beemek habbacha mayan yeshituhu gam berachot yate more

Ovre ellu bene adam sheovrin al retzono shel hakkadosh baruch hu emek shemmaamikin lahem gehinnam habbacha shebbochin umoridin demaot kemayan shel shitin gam berachot yate more shemmatzdikin alehem et haddin veomrim lefanav ribbono shel olam yafe danta yafe zikketa yafe chiyyavta veyafe tikkanta gehinnam larshaim gan eden latztzaddikim

Ini vehaamar rabbi shimon ben lakish reshaim afilu al pitcho shel gehinnam enam chozrin bitshuva shenneemar veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi vego sheppashu lo neemar ella happoshim shepposhim veholchin leolam
La kashya ha befoshe yisrael ha befoshe ummot haolam
Hachi name mistabbera deim ken kashya deresh lakish adderesh lakish deamar resh lakish poshe yisrael en ur gehinnam sholetet bahen kal vachomer mimmizbach hazzahav

Ma mizbach hazzahav sheen alav ella keovi dinar zahav amad kamma shanim velo shalta bo haur poshe yisrael shemmelein mitzot kerimmon shenneemar kefelach harimmon rakkatech veamar rabbi shimon ben lakish al tikre rakkatech ella rekatech sheafilu rekanin shebbach melein mitzot kerimmon al achat kamma vechamma
Ella ha dichtiv ovre beemek habbacha hahu dimchayevi hahi shata begehinnam veate avraham avinu umassek lehu umkabbel lehu bar miyyisrael shebba al haggoya demashcha orlato vela mevashkar leh
Matkef lah rav kahana hashta deamratte happoshim defashi veazli ella meatta dichtiv hammotzi vehammaale demassek udmappek hu ella deassek veappek hachi name defashi hu
Veamar rabbi yirmeya bar elazar shelosha petachim yesh laggehinnam echad bammidbar veechad bayyam veechad birushalayim bammidbar dichtiv vayyerdu hem vechol asher lahem chayyim sheola
Bayyam dichtiv mibbeten sheol shivati shamata koli
Birushalayim dichtiv neum Adonai asher ur lo betziyyon vetannur lo birushalam vetana deve rabbi yishmael asher ur lo betziyyon zo gehinnam vetannur lo birushalayim zo pitchah shel gehinnam

Vetu leka vehaamar rabbi mariyyon amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi veamri lah tana rabba bar mariyyon bidve rabbi yochanan ben zakkay shette temarot yesh bege ben hinnom veole ashan mibbenehen vezo hi sheshshaninu tzine har habbarzel kesherot vezo hi pitchah shel gehinnam dilma hayenu dirushalayim
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi shiva shemot yesh legehinnam veellu hen sheol vaavaddon uver shachat uvor shaon vetit hayyaven vetzalmavet veeretz hattachtit

Sheol dichtiv mibbeten sheol shivati shamata koli avaddon dichtiv hayesuppar bakkever chasdecha emunatcha baavaddon beer shachat dichtiv ki lo taazov nafshi lishol lo titten chasidcha lirot shachat uvor shaon vatit hayyaven dichtiv vayyaaleni mibbor shaon mittit hayyaven vetzalmavet dichtiv yoshve choshech vetzalmavet veeretz hattachtit gemara hu
Vetu leka vehaika gehinnam ge sheamukka begehinnam shehakkol yored lah al iske hinnam
Vehaika tofte dichtiv ki aruch meetmul tofte hahu shekkol hammitpatte beyitzro yippol sham

Gan eden amar resh lakish im beeretz yisrael hu bet shean pitcho veim baaravya bet gerem pitcho veim ben hanneharot hu dumaskenin pitcho bevavel abbaye mishtabbach befere demaavar yammina rava mishtabbach befere deharpanya
Uvenehen kimlo shette vechu peshita kevan ditna leh dikshurot hau anan yadinan dela hau muttarot
Mahu detema keshurot keen keshurot aval mammash la ka mashma lan velo muttarot
Achat nichneset veachat yotzet tana rivka nichneset verivka yotzet tanu rabbanan kamma roshah verubbah shel para shette ammot vechamma ovyah shel para amma ushne shelishe amma
b: Shehen keeser divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer kishlosh esre amma ucharba esre amma
Keeser ha eser haveyan mishshum devae lemitna sefa kishlosh esre
Kishlosh esre tefe haveyan mishshum devae lemitne kearba esre ucharba esre ha la haveya amar rav pappa yeterot al shelosh esre veenan maggiot learba esre
Amar rav pappa bevor shemone dechulle alma la peligi dela bainan peshutin
Bevor shettem esre dechulle alma la peligi devaenan peshutin
Ki peligi mishshemone ad shettem esre lerabbi meir bainan peshutin lerabbi yehuda la bainan peshutin
Verav pappa may ka mashma lan tenena
Rav pappa barayeta la shemia leh veka mashma lan kevarayeta
Arich yoter betel chitzat chatzer sheyyavsha siman bea mineh abbaye merabba heerich bidomdin keshiur peshutin lerabbi meir mahu
Amar leh tenetuha uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin may lav demaarich bidomdin la demappesh veaved peshutin
I hachi hay uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin ad sheyyarbe passin mibe leh teni ad sheyyarbe passin
Ika deamri amar leh tenetuha uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin may lav demappesh veaved peshutin la demaarich bidomdin
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin shema minah
Bea mineh abbaye merabba yoter mishshelosh esre amma ushlish lerabbi yehuda mahu peshutin aved o bidomdin maarech
Amar leh tenetuha kamma hen mekoravin kede roshah verubbah shel para vechamma meruchakin afilu kor vaafilu korayim
Rabbi yehuda omer bet satayim muttar yoter mibbet satayim asur amru lo lerabbi yehuda i atta mode bedir vesahar umuktze vechatzer afilu bat chameshet korim vaafilu bat asara korim shemmuttar
Amar lahen zo mechitza veellu passin
Veim ita zo mechitza vezo hi mechitza mibe leh
Hachi kaamar zo torat mechitza aleha ufirtzoteha beeser veellu torat passin alehen ufirtzotehen bishlosh esre amma ushlish
Bea mineh abbaye merabba tel hammitlakket asara mittoch arba nidon mishshum deomad o eno nidon mishshum deomad
Amar leh tenetuha rabbi shimon ben elazar omer hayeta sham even merubbaat roin kol sheilu techallek veyesh bah amma lechan veamma lechan nidon mishshum deomad veim lav eno nidon mishshum deomad

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer hayeta sham even agulla roin kol sheilu techakek vetechalek veyesh bah amma lechan veamma lechan nidon mishshum deomad veim lav eno nidon mishshum deomad
Bemay ka mipalgi mar savar chad roin amrinan tere roin la amrinan umar savar afilu tere roin name amrinan
Bea mineh abbaye merabba chitzat hakkanim kane kane pachot mishshelosha nidon mishshum deomad o lav
Amar leh tenetuha haya sham ilan o gader o chitzat hakkanim nidon mishshum deomad may lav kane kane pachot mishshelosha
La gudreyata dikne i hachi hayenu ilan
Veella may kane kane pachot mishshelosha hayenu gader ella may it lach lememar tere gavene gader hacha name tere gavene ilan
Ika deamri gudreyata dikne ka mibaya leh gudreyata dikne may amar leh tenetuha haya sham gader o ilan o chitzat hakkanim nidon mishshum deomad may lav gudreyata dikne
La kana kane pachot mishshelosha i hachi hayenu gader
Veella may gudreyata dikne hayenu ilan ella may it lach lememar

a: Tere gavene ilan hacha name tere gavene gader
Bea mineh abbaye merabba chatzer sheroshah nichnas leven happassin mahu letaltel mittochah leven happassin umibben happassin letochah amar leh muttar
Shettayim may amar leh asur
Amar rav huna shettayim asurin vaafilu ervu gezera shemma yomru eruv moil leven happassin rava amar ervu muttar

Amar leh abbaye lerava tanya dimsayya lach chatzer sheroshah echad nichnas leven happassin muttar letaltel mittochah leven happassin umibben happassin letochah aval shettayim asur bamme devarim amurim shello ervu aval ervu muttarin
Lema tehve teuvta derav huna amar lecha rav huna hatam dehadran vearvan
Bea mineh abbaye merabba yavshu mayim beshabbat mahu amar leh kelum naaset mechitza ella bishvil mayim mayim en kan mechitza en kan
Bae ravin yavshu mayim beshabbat uvau beshabbat mahu amar leh abbaye yavshu beshabbat la tibe lach divay mineh demar ufshet li daasir
Bau name la tibe lach dehave leh mechitza haasuya beshabbat vetanya kol mechitza haasuya beshabbat ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben birtzon shemah mechitza
Velav itmar alah amar rav nachman lo shanu ella lizrok aval letaltel lo
Ki itmar derav nachman ammezid itmar
Amar rabbi elazar hazzorek leven passe habberaot chayyav peshita i lav mechitza hi hechi mishtere leh lemalloot
La tzericha daavad keen passe veraot birshut harabbim vezarak letochah chayyav
Ha name peshita i lav divalma mechitza hi gabbe vor hechi mishtere leh letaltole la tzericha af al gav deka baki bah rabbim
Umay ka mashma lan dela atu rabbim umvatteli mechitzta ha amar rabbi elazar chada zimna

Ditnan rabbi yehuda omer im hayeta derech reshut harabbim mafsaktan yesallekenna litzdadin vachachamim omrim eno tzarich rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayehu kan hodiacha kochan shel mechitzot
I mehatam hava amena kan vela sevira leh ka mashma lan kan usvira leh
Velema ha vela bae hach chada mikkelal chavertah itmar
Muttar lehakriv labbeer vechu tenan hatam lo yaamod adam birshut harabbim veyishte birshut hayyachid birshut hayyachid veyishte birshut harabbim ella im ken machnis rosho verubbo limkom shehu shote
b: Vechen baggat
Gabbe adam ha amar devae rosho verubbo gabbe para mi bainan lah roshah verubbah o la
Kol hecha deka naket mana vela naket lah la tibe lach devae roshah verubbah millegav ki tibbee lach hecha denaket mana venaket lah may
Amar leh tenetuha uvilvad shettehe happara roshah verubbah mibbifnim veshota may lav denaket lah venaket mana la denaket mana vela naket lah
Vechi naket mana vela naket lah mi shere vehatanya lo yemalle adam mayim veyitten beshabbat lifne vehemto aval memalle hu veshofech vehi shota meeleha
Ha ittemar alah amar abbaye hacha beevus haomed birshut harabbim gavoha asara tefachim verochav arbaa verosho echad nichnas leven happassin
Gezera dilma chaze leh leevus dimkalkal veate letakkoneh vedare leh ledavela bahadeh veka mappek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim
Vechi hay gavena mi michayyav vehaamar rav safra amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan hamfanne chafatzav mizzavit lezavit venimlach alehen vehotzian patur shello hayeta akira mishshaa rishona lechach
Ella zimnin dimtakken leh vahadar meayyel leh veka meayyel mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid
Ika deamri gabbe adam ha kaamrinan desaggi leh berosho verubbo gabbe fara mi saggi lah beroshah verubbah o la
Hecha denaket mana venaket lah la tibe lach desaggi lah beroshah verubbah ella ki tibe lach denaket mana vela naket lah may
Amar leh tenetuha uvilvad shettehe para roshah verubbah mibbifnim veshota may lav denaket mana vela naket lah la denaket mana venaket lah
Vehachi name mistabbera dei naket mana vela naket lah mi shere vehatanya lo yemalle adam mayim veyitten lifne behemto aval memalle veshofech vehi shota meeleha

Ha itmar alah amar abbaye hacha beevus haomed birshut harabbim gavoha asara tefachim verochav arbaa verosho nichnas leven happassin dezimnin dechaze leh leevus dimkalkal veate letakkoneh vedare leh ledavela bahadeh veka mappek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim
Vechi hay gavena mi michayyav vehaamar rav safra amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan hamfanne chafatzav mizzavit lezavit venimlach alehen vehotzian patur shello hayeta akira mishshaa rishona lechach
Ella zimnin dimtakken leh vahadar meayyel leh veka meayyel leh mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid
Ta shema gamal sherosho verubbo mibbifnim ovsin oto mibbifnim veha ibus keman denaket mana venaket lah damya veka bainan roshah verubbah
Amar rav acha bar rav huna amar rav sheshet shane gamal hoil vetzavaro aroch
Ta shema behema sheroshah verubbah bifnim ovsin otah mibbifnim veha evus keman denaket mana venaket lah veka bainan rosho verubbo may behema name dekatane gamal
Vehatanya behema vehatanya gamal
Mide gabbe hadade tanya tanya name hachi rabbi elazar oser begamal hoil vetzavaro aroch
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar adda lo hutteru passe veraot ella leole regalim bilvad vehatanya lo hutteru passe veraot ella legabbe vehema bilvad may behema behemat ole regalim aval adam

a: Metappes veole metappes veored
Ini vehaamar rav yitzchak amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo hutteru passe veraot ella liver mayim chayyim bilvad vei livhema ma li chayyim ma li mechunnasin bainan mide dachaze leadam

Gufa lo hutteru passe veraot ella livhema bilvad aval adam metappes veole metappes veored veim hau rechavin afilu leadam name velo yemalle adam mayim veyitten lifne vehemto aval memalle hu veshofech lifne behema veshota meeleha
Matkef lah rav anan im ken ma hoilu passe veraot ma hoilu lemalloot mehen
Ella ma hoil roshah verubbah shel para
Amar abbaye hacha bemay askinan beevus haomed birshut harabbim gavoha asara verochav arbaa verosho nichnas leven happassin vechu
Amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav en burganin bevavel velo passe veraot bechutz laaretz
Burganin bevavel la dishchichi bidke passe veraot bechutz laaretz la dela shechichi metivata aval ipcha avdinan
Ika deamri amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav en burganin ufasse veraot lo bevavel velo bachutz laaretz burganin bevavel lo dishchichi bidke bechutz laaretz name la dishchichi gannave
Passe veraot bevavel la dishchichi mayya bechutz laaretz name la dela shechichi metivata

Amar leh rav chisda lemari bereh derav huna bereh derav yirmeya bar abba amri atetu mibbarnish leve chenishta dedaniyyel dahava telata parse beshabbeta ammay samchitu abburganin ha amar avuh daavuh mishshemeh derav en burganin bevavel
Nafek veachvi leh hanhu mataota demibbalan beshivim amma veshirayim

Amar rav chisda daresh mari bar mar may dichtiv lechol tichla raiti ketz rechava mitzvatcha meod davar ze amaro david velo persho amaro iyyov velo persho amaro yechezkel velo persho ad shebba zecharya ben iddo ufersho
Amaro david velo persho dichtiv lechol tichla raiti ketz rechava mitzvatcha meod amaro iyyov velo persho dichtiv arukka meeretz middah urchava minni yam
Amaro yechezkel velo persho dichtiv vayyifros otah lefanay vehi chetuva panim veachor vechatuv eleha kinim vahege vahi

Kinim zo puranutan shel tzaddikim baolam hazze vechen hu omer kina hi vekonnuha vahege zo mattan secharan shel tzaddikim leatid lavo vechen hu omer ale higgaon bechinnor vahi zo hi puranutan shel reshaim leatid lavo vechen hu omer hova al hova tavo

Ad shebba zecharya ben iddo ufersho dichtiv vayyomer elay ma atta roe vaomar ani roe megila afa orkah esrim baamma verochbah eser baamma vechi pashtatte lah haveya lah esrin beesrin uchtiv hi chetuva panim veachor vechi kalfatte lah kamma haveya lah arbein beesrin
Uchtiv mi madad beshoolo mayim veshamayim bazzeret tikken vego nimtza kol haolam kullo echad mishsheloshet alafim umatayim battora
Veamar rav chisda daresh mari bar mar may dichtiv vehinne shene dudae teenim muadim lifne hechal Adonai haddud haechad teenim tovot meod kitene
b: Habbakkurot vehaddud haechad teenim raot meod asher lo teachalna meroa
Teenim hattovot ellu tzaddikim gemurim teenim haraot ellu reshaim gemurim veshemma tomar avad sivram uvatal sikuyam talmud lomar haddudaim natnu reach ellu vaellu atidin sheyyittenu reach
Daresh rava may dichtiv haddudaim natnu reach ellu bachure yisrael shello taamu taam chet
Veal petachenu kol megadim ellu benot yisrael shemmaggidot pitchehen levaalehen lashon acher sheogdot pitchehen levaalehen
Chadashim gam yeshanim dodi tzafanti lach amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam harbe gezerot gazarti al atzmi yoter mimma sheggazarta alay vekiyyamtim
Amar leh rav chisda lehahu midderabbanan dahava ka mesaddar aggadata kammeh mi shemia lach chadashim gam yeshanim mahu amar leh ellu mitzot kallot veellu mitzot chamurot
Amar leh vechi tora peamim peamim nitna ella hallalu middivre tora vehallalu middivre sofrim

Daresh rava may dichtiv veoter mehemma beni hizzaher asot sefarim harbe vego beni hizzaher bedivre sofrim yoter middivre tora sheddivre tora yesh bahen ase velo taase vedivre sofrim kol haover al divre sofrim chayyav mita
Shemma tomar im yesh bahen mammash mippene ma lo nichtevu amar kera asot sefarim harbe en ketz
Velahag harbe yegiat basar amar rav pappa bereh derav acha bar adda mishshemeh derav acha bar ulla melammed shekkol hammalig al divre chachamim nidon betzoa rotachat
Matkef lah rava mi ketiv laag lahag ketiv ella kol hahoge bahen toem taam basar

Tanu rabbanan maase berabbi akiva shehaya chavush bevet haasurin vehaya rabbi yehoshua haggarsi mesharto bechol yom vaom hau machnisin lo mayim bemidda yom echad metzao shomer bet haasurin amar lo hayyom memecha merubbin shemma lachtor bet haasurin atta tzarich shafach chetzyan venatan lo chetzyan
Keshebba etzel rabbi akiva amar lo yehoshua en atta yodea shezzaken ani vechayyay teluyin bechayyecha
Sach lo kol oto hamora amar lo ten li mayim sheettol yaday amar lo lishtot en maggiin litol yadecha maggiin amar lo ma eese shechayyavim alehen mita mutav amut mitat atzmi velo eevor al daat chaveray

Amru lo taam kelum ad shehevi lo mayim venatal yadav kesheshshamu chachamim baddavar amru ma beziknuto kach beyalduto al achat kamma vechamma uma bevet haasurin kach shello bevet haasurin al achat kamma vechamma

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel beshaa shettiken shelomo eruvin untilat yadayim yatzta bat kol veamra beni im chacham libbecha yismach libbi gam ani veomer chacham beni vesammach libbi veashiva chorfi davar
Daresh rava may dichtiv lecha dodi netze hassade nalina bakkefarim nashkima lakkeramim nire im parcha haggefen pittach hassemadar henetzu harimmonim sham etten et doday lach

Lecha dodi netze hassade amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam al tedineni keoshve cherakkim sheyyesh bahen gazel vaaraot ushvuat shave ushvuat sheker netze hassade bo vearacha talmide chachamim sheoskin battora mittoch haddechak
Nalina bakkefarim al tikre bakkefarim ella bakkofrim bo vearacha otam shehishpata lahen tova vehen kafru becha

Nashkima lakkeramim ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot nire im parcha haggefen ellu baale mikra pittach hassemadar ellu baale mishna henetzu harimmonim ellu baale gemara sham etten et doday lach aracha kevodi vegodli shevach banay uvnotay

Amar rav hamnuna may dichtiv vayedabber sheloshet alafim mashal vayehi shiro chamishsha vaalef melammed sheamar shelomo al kol davar vedavar shel tora sheloshet alafim mashal al kol davar vedavar shel sofrim chamishsha veelef teamim
Daresh rava may dichtiv veoter shehaya kohelet chacham od limad daat et haam veizen vechikker tiken meshalim harbe limad daat et haam deagmerah besimane teamim veasberah bemay dedame lah
Veizen vechikker tiken meshalim harbe amar ulla amar rabbi eliezer battechila hayeta tora doma lichfifa sheen lah oznayim ad shebba shelomo veasa lah oznayim
Keutztzotav taltallim amar rav chisda amar mar ukva melammed sheyyesh lidrosh al kol kotz vakotz tile tilim shel halachot
Shechorot kaorev bemi atta motzan bemi

a: Shemmashkim umaariv alehen levet hammidrash rabba amar bemi shemmashchir panav alehen keorev
Rava amar bemi shemmesim atzmo achzari al banav veal bene beto keorev ki ha derav adda bar matna hava kaazel leve rav amara leh devethu yanoke didach may eeved lehu amar lah mi shelimu kurame beagma
Umshallem lesonav el panav lehaavido amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi ilmale mikra katuv i efshar leomro kivyachol keadam shennose massoy al panav umvakkesh lehashlicho mimmennu
Lo yeacher lesono amar rabbi ila lesonav hu delo yeacher aval yeacher latztzaddikim gemurim
Vehayenu deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may dichtiv asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom laasotam hayyom laasotam velo lemachar laasotam hayyom laasotam lemachar lekabbel secharam
Amar rabbi chaggay veitema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani may dichtiv erech appayim erech af mibbee leh
Ella erech appayim letzaddikim erech appayim larshaim
Rabbi yehuda omer ad bet satayim vechu ibaya lehu bor ufassin kaamar o dilma bor velo passin kaamar
Adam noten enav bevoro vela gazrinan dilma ate letaltole yoter mibbet satayim bekarpef
O dilma adam noten enav bimchitzato vegazrinan dilma ate leichallofe yoter mibbet satayim bekarpef
Ta shema kamma hen mekoravin kede roshah verubbah shel para vechamma hen meruchakin afilu kor afilu korayim rabbi yehuda omer bet satayim muttar yater mibbet satayim asur
Amru lerabbi yehuda i atta mode bedir vesahar muktze vechatzer afilu bet chameshet korim uvet aseret korim shemmuttar
Amar lahem zo mechitza veellu passin
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer bor bet satayim abbet satayim muttar velo amru leharchik ella kede roshah verubbah shel para
Ha middekaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar bor velo passin mikkelal derabbi yehuda bor ufassin kaamar vela hi rabbi yehuda bor belo passin kaamar
I hachi hayenu derabbi shimon ben elazar ika benayehu arich vekattin
Kelal amar rabbi shimon ben elazar kol avir shettashmisho ledira kegon dir vesahar muktze vechatzer afilu bet chameshet korim uvet aseret korim muttar
Vechol dira shettashmishah laavir kegon burganin shebbassadot bet satayim muttar yeter mibbet satayim asur
Matni rabbi yehuda omer im haya derech reshut harabbim mafsaktan yesallekenna litzdadin vachachamim omrim eno tzarich
Gema rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayehu kan hodiacha kochan shel mechitzot
Kan usvira leh vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan yerushalayim ilmale daltoteha ninalot ballayela chayyavin aleha mishshum reshut harabbim
Ella kan vela sevira leh
Urmi derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda urmi derabbanan adderabbanan

Detanya yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda mi shehau lo shene vattim mishshene tzide reshut harabbim ose lo lechi mikkan velechi mikkan o kora mikkan vekora mikkan venose venoten baemtza amru lo en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach
Kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda kashya derabbanan adderabbanan
Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya hatam deika shette mechitzot mealleyata hacha leka shette mechitzot mealleyata
Derabbanan adderabbanan name la kashya hacha ika shem arba mechitzot hatam leka shem arba mechitzot
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan eretz yisrael en chayyavin aleha mishshum reshut harabbim yatev rav dimi vekaamar leh leha shemata amar leh abbaye lerav dimi may tama
b: Ilema mishshum demakkef lah sullema detzor mehach gisa umachtana degader mehach gisa bavel name makkif leh perat mehach gisa vediglat mehay gisa dechulla alma name makkif okyanos dilma maalot umoradot kaamratte
Amar leh karkafna chaziteh lereshach be ammude ki amar rabbi yochanan leha shemata

Itmar name ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan veamri lah amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan maalot umoradot shebbeeretz yisrael en chayyavin alehen mishshum reshut harabbim lefi sheenan kedigle midbar
Bea mineh rachava merava tel hammitlakket asara mittoch arba verabbim bokin bo chayyavin alav mishshum reshut harabbim o en chayyavin alav
Alliba derabbanan la tibe lach hashta uma hatam denicha tashmishteh amri rabbanan la atu rabbim umvatteli lah mechitzta hacha dela nicha tashmishteh lo kol shekken
Ki tibe lach alliba derabbi yehuda may hatam hu denicha tashmishteh hacha hu dela nicha tashmishteh la atu rabbim umvatteli mechitzta o dilma la shena amar leh chayyavin
Vaafilu olin lo bechevel amar leh in vaafilu bemaalot bet maron amar leh in
Etiveh chatzer sheharabbim nichnasin lah bazo veotzin bazo reshut harabbim lattuma urshut hayyachid lashshabbat
Manni ilema rabbanan hashta uma hatam denicha tashmishteh amri rabbanan la atu rabbim umvatteli mechitzta hacha dela nicha tashmishteh lo kol shekken
Ella lav rabbi yehuda hi
La leolam rabbanan urshut harabbim lattuma itztericha leh
Ta shema mevoot hamfullashot bevorot beshichin uvimarot reshut hayyachid leshabbat urshut harabbim lattuma
Bevorot salka datach ella levorot reshut hayyachid leshabbat urshut harabbim lattuma
Manni ilema rabbanan hashta uma hatam denicha tashmishteh amri la atu rabbim umvatteli lah hacha dela nicha tashmishteh lo kol shekken ella lav rabbi yehuda hi
La leolam rabbanan urshut harabbim lattuma itztericha leh
Ta shema shevile bet gilgul vechayyotze bahen reshut hayyachid lashshabbat urshut harabbim lattuma
Veezehu shevile bet gilgul amri deve rabbi yannay kol sheen haeved yachol litol sea shel chitin veyarutz lifne sardeot
Manni ilema rabbanan hashta uma hatam denicha tashmishta amri rabbanan la atu rabbim umvatteli lah mechitzta hacha dela nicha tashmishta lo kol shekken ella lav rabbi yehuda hi
Amar leh shevile bet gilgul kaamratte yehoshua ohev yisrael haya amad vetiken lahem derachim usratya kol hecha denicha tashmishta mesarah larabbim kol hecha dela nicha tashmishta mesarah layyachid
Matni echad bor harabbim uver harabbim uver hayyachid osin lahen passin
Aval levor hayyachid osin lo mechitza gavoha asara tefachim divre rabbi akiva
Rabbi yehuda ben bava omer en osin passin ella liver harabbim bilvad velashshear osin chagora gavoha asara tefachim

a: Gema amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda ben bava veamar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo hutteru passe veraot ella liver mayim chayyim bilvad
Utzricha dei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yehuda ben bava hava amena derabbim vaafilu mechunnasin
Vehay dekatane beer harabbim leappoke midderabbi akiva ka mashma lan delo hutteru passe veraot ella liver mayim chayyim
Vei ashmeinan beer mayim chayyim hava amena la shena derabbim vela shena deyachid ka mashma lan halacha kerabbi yehuda ben bava

Matni veod amar rabbi yehuda ben bava haggina vehakkarpef shehen shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim hammukkafot gader gavoha asara tefachim metaltelin betochah uvilvad sheyehe bah shomera o bet dira o shettehe semucha lair

Rabbi yehuda omer afilu en bah ella bor veshiach umara metaltelin betochah rabbi akiva omer afilu en bah achat mikkol ellu metaltelin betochah uvilvad sheyehe bah shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim
Rabbi eliezer omer im hayeta orkah yater al rochbah afilu amma achat en metaltelin betochah rabbi yose omer afilu orkah pi shenayim berochbah metaltelin betochah
Amar rabbi ilay shamati merabbi elazar vaafilu hi kevet kor
Vechen shamati mimmennu anshe chatzer sheshshachach echad mehen velo erav beto asur millehachnis ulhotzi lo aval lahem muttar
Vechen shamati mimmennu sheyyotzin bearkabbalin bappesach vechazarti al kol talmidav uvikkashti li chaver velo matzati
Gema may tanna dekatane veod
Ilema mishshum ditna leh chada lechumra vekatane achariti mishshum hachi katane veod veha rabbi yehuda ditna leh chada lechumra vekatane achariti vela katane veod
Hatam afsekuh rabbanan hacha la afsekuh rabbanan
Vechol hecha deafsekuh rabbanan la katane veod veha rabbi eliezer desukka deafsekuh rabbanan vekatane veod
Hatam bemilteh hu deafsekuh hacha bemilta achariti afsekuh
Rabbi akiva omer afilu en bah echad mikkol ellu metaltelin betochah
b: Rabbi akiva hayenu tanna kamma
Ika benayehu davar muat detanya rabbi yehuda omer davar muat yesh al shivim amma veshirayim velo natnu chachamim bo shiur
Vechamma shiur satayim kachatzar hammishkan
Mena hane mile
Amar rav yehuda deamar kera orech hechatzer mea vaamma verochav chamishshim bachamishshim amra tora tol chamishshim vesabbev chamishshim
Peshateh dikra bemay ketiv amar abbaye haamed mishkan al sefat chamishshim kede sheyehe chamishshim amma lefanav veesrim amma lechol ruach varuach
Rabbi eliezer omer im hayeta orkah ku vehatanya rabbi eliezer omer im hayeta orkah yater al pi shenayim berochbah afilu amma achat en metaltelin betochah
Amar rav bivi bar abbaye ki tenan name matnitin yater al pi shenayim berochbah tenan i hachi hayenu rabbi yose
Ika benayehu ribua deribuha rabbanan
Rabbi yose omer ku itmar amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose verav bivi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi akiva
Vetarvayehu lekulla utzricha dei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yose hava amena ad deika shomera o bet dira ka mashma lan halacha kerabbi akiva
Vei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi akiva hava amena daarich vekattin la ka mashma lan halacha kerabbi yose
Karpef shehu yoter mibbet satayim shehukkaf ledira nizra rubbo hare hu kegina veasur
Nata rubbo hare hu kechatzer umuttar
Nizra rubbo amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua la amaran ella yoter mibbet satayim aval bet satayim muttar
Keman kerabbi shimon ditnan rabbi shimon omer echad gaggot veechad chatzerot veechad karpefot reshut achat hen lechelim sheshshavtu betochan velo lechelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit
Lerabbi shimon name kevan denizra rubbo have hahu miuta

a: Betil leh legabbay rubba vehave leh karpef yoter mibbet satayim veasur
Ella i itmar hachi itmar ha miuta share amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua la amaran ella dela have bet satayim aval bet satayim asur
Keman kerabbanan
Verav yirmeya middifti matne lekulla ha miuta shere amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua la amaran ella bet satayim aval yoter mibbet satayim asur keman kerabbi shimon
Nata rubbo hare hu kechatzer umuttar amar rav yehuda amar avimi vehu sheasuyin itztabbelaot verav nachman amar af al pi sheen asuyin itztabbelaot
Mar yehuda ikkela leve rav huna bar yehuda chazanhu lehanhu dela avidi itztabbelaot veka metalteli begavayehu amar leh la savar lah mar leha daavimi amar leh ana kerav nachman sevira li
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel karpef yoter mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira ketzad hu ose poretz bo pirtza yoter meeser vegodro umaamido al eser umuttar
Ibaya lehu paratz amma vegadar amma ufaratz amma ugdarah ad shehishlimo leoter meeser mahu
Amar leh lav hayenu ditnan kol kele baale vattim shiuran kerimmonim
Uvae chizkiyya nikav kemotzi zayit ustamo vechazar venikav kemotzi zayit ustamo ad shehishlimo lemotzi rimmon mahu
Vaamar leh rabbi yochanan rabbi shanita lanu sandal shennifseka achat meoznav vetiknah tame midras
Nifseka sheniyya vetiknah tahor bah min hammidras aval tame magga midras
Vaamarte alah may shena rishona deha kayema sheniyya sheniyya name ha kayema rishona
Vaamarte lan alah panim chadashot bau lechan hacha name panim chadashot bau lechan
Kare aleh let den bar inash ika deamri kegon den bar nash
Amar rav kahana rechava sheachore habbattim en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot
Veamar rav nachman im patach lo petach muttar letaltel bechullo petach mattiro vela amaran ella sheppatach ulvassof hukkaf aval hukkaf ulvassof patach la
Patach ulvassof hukkaf peshita la tzericha deit beh be dare mahu detema addata deve dare avdeh ka mashma lan
Karpef yoter mibbet satayim shehukkaf ledira venitmalle mayim sevur rabbanan lememar kizraim damu vaasir
Amar lehu rav abba avuh derav bereh derav mesharsheya hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava mayim kintaim damu ushre
b: Amar ammemar vehu dechazyin letashmishta aval la chazyin letashmishta la
Amar rav ashe udchazyin letashmishta name la amaran ella sheen beomko yoter mibbet satayim aval im yesh beomko yoter mibbet satayim asur
Velav milta hi mide dehave akkarya defere
Hahi rechava dahavay befum nahara dechad gisa hava petiach lemata vechad gisa hava petiach lishvil shel keramim ushvil shel keramim hava salek legudda denahara
Amar abbaye hechi naaved laaved leh mechitza aggudda denahara en osin mechitza al gabbe mechitza
Velaaved leh tzurat happetach appumma dishvil shel keramim atu gamle shadyan leh
Ella amar abbaye lebed lechi appitcha dishvil shel keramim demiggo demahneya lishvil shel keramim mehanne name lirchava
Amar leh rava yomru lechi moil lishvil shel keramim dealma
Ella amar rava avdinan leh lechi lefitcha demata demiggo demahne leh lechi lemata mahne name lirchava
Hilkach taltole bemata gufah shere taltole birchava gufah shere mimmata lirchava umerchava lemata peligi bah rav acha veravina chad asar vechad share

a: Man deshare deha leka daorin uman deasar zimnin dehave bah daorin veate letaltole
Karpef yoter mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira uva lemaato miato bailanot la have miut
Bana bo ammud gavoha asara verachav arbaa have miut pachot mishshelosha la have miut mishshelosha vead arbaa rabba amar have miut verava amar la have miut
Rabba amar have miut deha nafek leh mittorat lavud rava amar la have miut kevan dela have mekom arbaa la chashiv
Hirchik min hakkotel arbaa veasa mechitza hoil pachot mishshelosha lo hoil mishshelosha vead arbaa rabba amar hoil rava amar eno moil
Rabba amar hoil deha nafek leh mittorat lavud rava amar eno moil kevan dela have mekom arbaa la chashiv
Rav shimi matne lekulla tach bo tit veyachol laamod bifne atzmo have miut eno yachol laamod bifne atzmo rabba amar have miut rava amar la have miut
Rabba amar have miut hashta miha kae rava amar la have miut kevan dela yachol lemekam bifne atzmo lo kelum hu
Hirchik min hattel arbaa veasa mechitza hoil
Pachot mishshelosha o al sefat hattel rav chisda verav hamnuna chad amar hoil vechad amar lo hoil
Tistayyem derav chisda amar hoil deittemar haose mechitza al gabbe mechitza amar rav chisda beshabbat hoil
Benichse hagger lo kana
Verav sheshet amar af beshabbat name lo hoil tistayyem
Amar rav chisda umode li rav sheshet sheim asa mechitza al hattel shehoil
May tama hoil uvaavir mechitzot haelonot hu dar
Bae rabba bar bar chana nivleu mechitzot hattachtonot vehaelonot kayyamot mahu
Lemay i lenichse hagger hayenu deyirmeya biraa deamar yirmeya biraa amar rav yehuda hay man dishda lifta appila deara deger vaata yisrael acharina refak bah purta batra kane kamma la kane
May tama beidana dishda la ka shavach ki ka shavcha mimmela ka meshabbecha
Veella leinyan shabbat have mechitza hannaase beshabbat
Vetanya kol mechitza hannaase beshabbat ben beshogeg ben bemezid shemah mechitza
Lav itmar alah amar rav nachman lo shanu ella lizrok aval letaltel asur
Ki itmar derav nachman ammezid itmar

Hahi itta daavada mechitza al gabbe mechitza benichse hagger ata hahu gavra refak bah purta ata lekammeh derav nachman okmah bideh atay ihi veka tzavecha kammeh amar lah may ebed lach dela machzekatte kidmachzeki inashe
Karpef bet shalosh vekera bo bet sea rava amar avir keruo meyatro verabbi zera amar en avir keruo meyatro
Lema rava verabbi zera biflugta derav ushmuel ka mipalgi deitmar achsadra bevika rav amar muttar letaltel bechullah ushmuel amar en metaltelin ella bearba ammot
Rav amar muttar letaltel bechullah amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem ushmuel amar en metaltelin ella bearba ammot la amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem
b: I daavida ki achsadra hachi name hacha bemay askinan deavdah ki urzila
Amar rabbi zera umodena bekarpef shennifratz bimloo lechatzer sheasur may tama hoil vaavir chatzer meyatro
Matkef lah rav yosef vechi avir hammuttar lo osro
Amar leh abbaye keman kerabbi shimon lerabbi shimon name ha ika avir mekom mechitzot
Deamar rav chisda karpef shennifratz bimloo lechatzer chatzer mutteret vekarpef asur
Chatzer may tama deit leh gipufe veha zimnin demashkachatte lah ipcha
Ella mishshum deamrinan ze avir mechitzot meyatro veze en avir mechitzot meyatro
Hahu bustana dahava semich legudda deappadna nefal ashita barayeta deappadna savar rav bivi lememar lismoch aggudda gauoyata
Amar leh rav pappi mishshum deattu mimmulae amritu mile mulyata hanach mechitzot legavay avidan levaray la avidan
Hahi abbeoranka dahava leh leresh galuta bevustaneh amar leh lerav huna bar chinana lebed mar takkanta delimchar nechul nahama hatam
Azal avad kane kane pachot mishshelosha azal rava

a: Shalfinhu azal rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua naktinhu mibbatreh
Limchar etiveh ravina lerava ir chadasha moddin lah miyeshivatah vishana mechomatah
Ezo hi chadasha veezo hi yeshana chadasha shehukkefa ulvassof yashva yeshana yashva ulvassof hukkefa vehay name kehukkefa ulvassof yashva dame
Amar leh rav pappa lerava vehaamar rav assi mechitzot adrechalin la shemah mechitza alma kevan delitzniuta avida lah la haveya mechitza hacha name kevan delitzniuta avida la haveya mechitza
Veamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava vehaamar rav huna mechitza haasuya lenachat lo shemah mechitza
Deha rabba bar avuh mearev lah lechullah machoza arseyata arseyata mishshum pera deve tore veha pera deve tore kimchitza haasuya lenachat damya
Kare alayehu resh galuta chachamim hemma lehara ulhetiv lo yadau
Amar rabbi ilay shamati merabbi eliezer vaafilu bet kor matnitin dela kachananya detanya chananya omer vaafilu hi arbaim sea keisteratya shel melech
Amar rabbi yochanan ushnehem mikra echad darshu shenneemar vayehi yeshayahu lo yatza el chatzer hattichona ketiv hair vekarenan chatzer mikkan laisteratya shel melech shehau kaayarot benoniyyot
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar ayarot benoniyyot haveyan bet kor umar savar arbaim sea haveyan
Vishayahu may bae hatam amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan melammed shechala chizkiyya vehalach yeshayahu vehoshiv yeshiva al pitcho
Mikkan letalmid chacham shechala shemmoshivin yeshiva al pitcho velav milta hi dilma ate leigaroye beh satan
Vechen shamati hemennu anshe chatzer sheshshachach echad velo erav beto asur
Vehatnan beto asur lehotzi ulhachnis lo velahen
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar rav sheshet la kashya
b: Ha rabbi eliezer veha rabbanan
Keshettimtze lomar ledivre rabbi eliezer hamvattel reshut chatzero reshut beto bitel lerabbanan hamvattel reshut chatzero reshut beto lo bitel
Peshita
Amar rachava ana verav huna bar chinana targemna lo nitzrecha ella lachamishsha sheshsheruyin bechatzer echad veshachach echad mehen velo erav
Ledivre rabbi eliezer keshehu mevattel reshuto en tzarich levattel lechol echad veechad
Lerabbanan keshehu mevattel reshuto tzarich levattel lechol echad veechad
Keman azla ha detanya chamishsha sheshsheruyin bechatzer echad veshachach echad mehen velo erav keshehu mevattel reshuto en tzarich levattel reshut lechol echad veechad keman kerabbi eliezer

Rav kahana matne hachi rav tavome matne hachi keman azla ha detanya chamishsha sheshsheruyim bechatzer echad veshachach echad mehen velo erav keshehu mevattel reshuto eno tzarich levattel reshut lechol echad veechad keman amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet keman kerabbi eliezer
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye lerabbi eliezer i amar la mevattelna ulrabbanan i amar mevattelna may
Tama derabbi eliezer mishshum dekasavar hamvattel reshut chatzero reshut beto bitel vehay amar ana la mevattelna
O dilma tama derabbi eliezer mishshum devayit bela chatzer la avidi inashe dedayeri vechi kaamar la mevattelna lav kal kemineh af al gav deamar dayarna lav kelum kaamar
Ulrabbanan i amar mevattelna may tama derabbanan mishshum dekasavri hamvattel reshut chatzero reshut beto lo bitel vehay amar mevattelna
O dilma tama derabbanan mishshum dela avid inish dimsallek nafsheh ligmare mibbayit vechatzer vehave ki oreach legabbayehu vehay ki amar mevattelna lav kal kemineh kaamar
Amar leh ben lerabbanan ben lerabbi eliezer kevan degalli dateh galli
Vechen shamati mimmennu sheyyotzim bearkabbalin befesach may arkabbalin amar resh lakish atzota charuzyata
Hadaran alach osin passin
Matni bakkol mearvin umishtattefin chutz min hammayim umin hammelach
Vehakkol nikach bechesef maaser chutz min hammayim umin hammelach hannoder min hammazon muttar bemelach uvmayim
Mearvin lannazir beyayin ulyisrael bitruma somchos omer bechullin
Velakkohen bevet happeras rabbi yehuda omer afilu ben hakkevarot

a: Mippene sheyyachol lachotz velelech veleechol
Gema amar rabbi yochanan en lemedin min hakkelalot vaafilu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz
Middekaamar afilu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz mikkelal delav hacha kae hecha kae
Hatam kae kol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama anashim chayyavin venashim peturot veshello hazzeman gerama echad nashim veechad anashim chayyavin
Uchlala hu dechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot hare matztza simcha vehakhel demitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu venashim chayyavot

Vechol mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama nashim chayyavot hare talmud tora periyya urviyya ufidon habben demitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama venashim peturot ella amar rabbi yochanan en lemedin min hakkelalot vaafilu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz

Amar abbaye veitema rabbi yirmeya af anan name tenena od kelal acher amru kol shennisa al gabbe hazzav tame vechol shehazzav nisa alav tahor chutz min harauy lemishkav umoshav vehaadam vetu leka veha ika merkav

Merkav hechi dame i deyatev aleh hayenu moshav anan hachi kaamrinan ha ika gabba deukkafa detanya haukkaf tame moshav vehattefus tame merkav ella shema minah en lemedin min hakkelalot vaafilu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz

Amar ravina veitema rav nachman af anan name tenena bakkol mearvin umishtattefin chutz min hammayim vehammelach vetu leka veha ika kemehin ufitriyyot ella shema minah en lemedin min hakkelalot vaafilu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz
Hakkol nikach bechesef maaser ku rabbi eliezer verabbi yose bar chanina chad matne aeruv vechad matne ammaaser
Chad matne aeruv lo shanu ella mayim bifne atzmo umelach bifne atzmo deen mearvin aval bemayim umelach mearvin
Vechad matne ammaaser lo shanu ella mayim bifne atzmo umelach bifne atzmo deen nikachin aval mayim umelach nikachin bechesef maaser
Man dematne ammaaser kol shekken aeruv uman dematne aeruv aval ammaaser la may tama pera bainan

Ki ata rabbi yitzchak matne ammaaser metivi heid rabbi yehuda ben gadish lifne rabbi eliezer shel bet abba hau lokchin tzir bechesef maaser amar lo shemma lo shamata ella keshekkirve dagim meoravin bahen vaafilu rabbi yehuda ben gadish la kaamar ella betzir deshumna defera hi aval mayim umelach lo
Amar rav yosef
b: Lo nitzrecha ella shennatan letochan shemen
Amar leh abbaye vetipok leh mishshum shemen lo tzericha shennatan deme mayim umelach behavlaa

Uvhavlaa mi shere in vehatanya ben bag bag omer babbakar melammed shellokchin bakar al gav oro uvatztzon melammed shellokchin tzon al gav gizatah uvayyayin melammed shellokchin yayin al gav kankanno uvashshechar melammed shellokchin temed mishshehechmitz
Amar rabbi yochanan man dimtargem li babbakar alliba deven bag bag movelna maneh abbatreh leve massuta

May tama kullehu tzerichi levar mibbabbakar dela tzerich may tzerichi dei ketav rachamana babbakar hava amena bakar hu demizdabban al gav oro mishshum degufeh hu aval tzon al gav gizatah delav gufeh hu ema la
Vei ketav rachamana batztzon al gav gizatah hava amena mishshum dimchubbar bah aval yayin al gav kankanno ema la
Vei ketav rachamana bayyayin hava amena mishshum dehayenu netiruteh aval temed mishshehechmitz dekiyyuha bealma hu ema la ketav rachamana shechar
Vei ketav rachamana bashshechar hava amena may shechar devela keilit defera hu aval yayin al gav kankanno ema la
Vei ketav rachamana yayin al gav kankanno dehayenu netiruteh aval tzon al gav gizatah ema la ketav rachamana tzon daafilu al gav gizatah
Babbakar lema li vechi tema i la ketav rachamana babbakar hava amena tzon al gav orah in al gav gizatah la ketav rachamana babbakar leetoye oro iyyatar leh tzon leetoye gizatah
I la ketav rachamana bakar la hava amena tzon al gav orah in al gav gizatah la deim ken lichtov rachamana bakar demimmela iyyatar leh tzon

Vechevan dichtav rachamana tzon daafilu al gav gizatah babbakar lema li hashta tzon al gav gizatah mizdabbena bakar al gav oro mibaya hayenu dekaamar rabbi yochanan man dimtargem li babbakar alliba deven bag bag movelna maneh leve massuta
Bemay ka mipalgi rabbi yehuda ben gadish verabbi eliezer vehane tannae dilkamman rabbi yehuda ben gadish verabbi eliezer darshi ribbuye umiute vehane tannae darshi kelale ufrate

Rabbi yehuda ben gadish verabbi eliezer darshi ribuye umiute venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teave nafshecha riba babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar miet uvchol asher tisholcha nafshecha chazar veriba riba umiet veriba riba hakkol may rabbi rabbi kol mile umay miet lerabbi eliezer miet tzir lerabbi yehuda ben gadish miet mayim umelach

Vehane tannae darshi kelale ufrate detanya venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teave nafshecha kalal babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar parat uvchol asher tisholcha nafshecha chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat uma happerat meforash peri mipperi vegidule karka af kol peri mipperi vegidule karka
Vetanya idach ma happerat meforash velad valdot haaretz af kol velad valdot haaretz
May benayehu amar abbaye dagim ika benayehu leman deamar peri mipperi vegidule karka hane dagim gidule karka ninhu leman deamar velad valdot haaretz dagim mimmayya ibro
Umi amar abbaye dagim gidule karka ninhu vehaamar abbaye

a: Achal putita loke arba nemala loke chamesh tzira loke shesh veim ita putita name lilke mishshum hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz
Ella amar ravina ofot ika benayehu leman deamar peri mipperi vegidule karka hane name gidule karka ninhu leman deamar velad valdot haaretz hane ofot min harkak nivreu
Man dimrabbe ofot may tameh uman dimmaet ofot may tameh
Man dimrabbe ofot kasavar kelala batra daveka perat uchlal naase kelal musaf al happerat veitrabbu lehu kol mile veahni kelala kamma lemaote kol dela dame leh mishshene tzedadin
Uman dimmaet ofot kasavar kelala kamma daveka kelal ufrat veen bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat hane in mide acharina la veahni kelala batra lerabboye kol dedame leh mishshelosha tzedadin
Amar rav yehuda mishshemeh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav mearvin befapuin uvachalaglogot uvgudgedaniyyot aval lo bachaziz velo bechafniyyot
Uvgudgedaniyyot mi mearvin vehatanya gudgedaniyyot merubbe vanim yochelu chasuche vanim lo yochelu veim hukshu lezera af merubbe banim lo yochelu
Targema ashshelo hukshu lezera umrubbe vanim

Veibaet ema leolam lachasuche vanim deha chazu limrubbe vanim mi la tenan mearvin lannazir beyayin ulyisrael bitruma alma af al gav dela chaze lehay chaze lehay hacha name af al gav dela chaze lehay chaze lehay
Veibaet ema ki kaamar rav behandekoke madae
Uvachaziz la vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav keshut vachaziz mearvin bahen umvarchin alehen bore peri haadama
La kashya ha mikkamme daata rav levavel ha levatar daata rav levavel

Uvavel haveya rubba dealma vehatanya happol vehasseora vehattiltan shezzeraan leyarak batla dato etzel kol adam lefichach zaran chayyav veyarkan patur hashshachalayim vehaggargir shezzeraan leyarak mitasserin yarak vezera zeraan lezera mitasserin zera veyarak
Ki kaamar rav
b: Bidginnunyata
Zera gargir lemay chaze amar rabbi yochanan shekken rishonim shello haya lahen pilpelin shochakin oto umatbilin bo et hatztzali
Rabbi zera ki hava chalish miggirseh hava azel veyatev appitcha derav yehuda bar amme amar ki nafki veayeli rabbanan ekum mikkammayehu vaakabbel behu agra

Nefak ata yanoka deve rav amar leh may agmerach rabbach amar leh keshut bore peri haadama chaziz shehakkol nihye bidvaro amar leh adderabba ipcha mistabbera hay meara ka mirabbe vehay meavera ka mirabbe

Vehilcheta keyanoka deve rav may tama hay gemar pere vehay lav gemar pere umay dekaamratte hay meara ka rave vehay meavera ka rave la hi keshut name meara ka rave deha ka chazenan dekatlinan lah lehizmeta umayeta keshuta
Uvchafniyyot en mearvin vehatanya kor nikach bechesef maaser veen mittamme tumat ochalin vechafniyyot nikkachot bechesef maaser umittammeot tumat ochalim
Rave yehuda omer kor hare hu keetz lechol devarav ella shennikach bechesef maaser vechafniyyot hare hen kifri lechol divrehem ella sheppeturot min hammaaser
Hatam bidnischane
I hachi beha lema rabbi yehuda peturot min hammaaser vehatanya amar rabbi yehuda lo huzkeru pagge vetone ella leinyan maaser bilvad pagge vetone vaahine detovina chayyavin bemaaser
Ella leolam lav benischane ulinyan tumat ochalin shane kidamar rabbi yochanan hoil verauy lemattekan al yede haur hacha name hoil veyachol lemattekan al yede haur

Vehecha ittemar derabbi yochanan aha detanya shekedim hammarim ketannim chayyavin gedolim peturin metukim gedolim chayyavin ketannim peturin rabbi shimon berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv ze vaze liftur veamri lah ze vaze lechiyyuv amar rabbi ila hora rabbi chanina betzipori kedivre haomer ze veze liftur
Ulman deamar ze vaze lechiyyuv lemay chaze amar rabbi yochanan hoil verauy lemattekan al yede haur
Amar mar rabbi yehuda omer kor hare hu keetz lechol devarav ella shennikach bechesef maaser hayenu tanna kamma
Amar abbaye shelako vetiggeno ika benayehu
Matkef lah rava mi ika leman deamar shelako vetiggeno la vehatanya haor vehashshilya en mittammein tumat ochalin or sheshshelako veshilya shechishev aleha mittammein tumat ochalin
Ella amar rava ika benayehu beracha deittemar kor rav yehuda amar bore peri haadama ushmuel amar shehakkol nihye bidvaro
Rav yehuda amar bore peri haadama uchla hu ushmuel amar shehakkol nihye bidvaro kevan shessofo lehakshot la mevarchinan ilaveh bore peri haadama
Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana keotach mistabbera deha tzenon shessofo lehakshot umvarchinan aleh bore peri haadama
Vela hi tzenon nati inashe addata defugla dikla la nati inashe addata dekora veaf al gav dekalleseh shemuel lerav yehuda hilcheta keoteh dishmuel
Gufa amar rav yehuda amar rav keshut vachaziz mearvin bahen umvarchin alehem bore peri haadama keshut bechamma kidamar rav yechiel kimlo hayyad hacha name kimlo hayyad
Chaziz bechamma amar rabba bar toviyya bar yitzchak amar rav kimlo uzilta deikare
Amar rav chilkiyya bar toviyya mearvin bekilya bekilya salka datach ella beyarka dekilya vechamma amar rav yechiel kimlo hayyad
Rabbi yirmeya nefak lekiryata beo mineh mahu learev befolin lachin la hava bideh ki ata leve midresha amaru leh hachi amar rabbi yannay mearvin befolin lachin vechamma amar rav yechiel kimlo hayyad
Amar rav hamnuna mearvin bitradin chayyin ini vehaamar rav chisda silka chayya katel gavra chayya

a: Hahu bivshil vela beshil
Ika deamri amar rav hamnuna en mearvin bitradin chayyin deamar rav chisda silka chayya katel gavra chayya veha ka chazenan deka achli vela mayeti hatam bivshil vela beshil
Amar rav chisda tavshil shel teradin yafe lallev vetov laenayim vechol shekken livne meayim amar abbaye vehu deyatev abbe tafe veaved toch toch
Amar rava hareni keven azzay beshuke teverya amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava tappuchim bechamma amar leh vechi mearvin betappuchim
Vela vehatnan kol haochalin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviya bachatzi feras uvimzon shette seudot leeruv uchvetza letamme tumat ochalim
Vehay may teuvta ilema mishshum dekatane kol haochalin vehane bene achila ninhu vehaamar rabbi yochanan en lemedin min hakkelalot vaafilu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz
Ella mishshum dekatane uvimzon shette seudot leeruv uchvetza letamme tumat ochalin vehane name bene tammoye tumat ochalin ninhu
Vechamma amar rav nachman tappuchim bekav

Metivi rabbi shimon ben elazar omer uchla tavlin velitra yarak vaasara egozin vachamishsha afarsekin ushne rimmonim veetrog echad veamar gursak bar dare mishshemeh derav menashsheya bar seguvli mishshemeh derav vechen leeruv vehane name liho ki afarsekin
Hane chashivi vehane la chashivi

Amar rav yosef shera leh mareh lerav menashsheya bar seguvli ana amrita nihaleh ammatnitin vehu amrah abbarayeta ditnan en pochatin leani baggoren mechatzi kav chittin vekav seorin rabbi meir omer chatzi kav seorin vekav vachatzi chussemin vekav gerogrot o mane devela rabbi akiva omer peras vachatzi log yayin rabbi akiva omer reviit urviit shemen rabbi akiva omer sheminit ushar kol happerot amar abba shaul kede sheyyimkerem veyikkach bahen mezon shette seudot veamar rav vechen leeruv
Umay ulmeh dehay mehach ilema mishshum deka tane behach tavlin vetavlin lav bene achila ninhu attu hacha mi la katane chittin usorin velav bene achila ninhu
Ella mishshum dekatane chatzi log yayin veamar rav mearvin bishte reviiyyot shel yayin middevainan kulle hay shema minah ki amar rav vechen leeruv aha matnitin kaamar shema minah
Amar mar uvimzon shette seudot leeruv savar rav yosef lememar ad deika seuda mehay usuda mehay amar leh rabba afilu lemechetza lishlish velirvia

Gufa amar rav mearvin bishte reviiyyot shel yayin umi bainan kulle hay vehatanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer yayin kede leechol bo chometz kede letabbel bo zetim uvtzalim kede leechol bahen shette seudot
Hatam bechamra mevashshela
Amar mar chometz kede letabbel bo amar rav gidel amar rav kede letabbel bo mezon shette seudot shel yarak ika deamri amar rav gidel amar rav yarak hanneechal bishte seudot

Amar mar zetim uvtzalim kede leechol bahen mezon shette seudot uvivtzalim mi mearvin vehatanya amar rabbi shimon ben elazar paam achat shavat rabbi meir beardiska uva adam echad lefanav amar lo rabbi eravti bivtzalim letivin vehoshivo rabbi meir bearba ammot shello
La kashya ha bealim ha beimahot detanya achal batzal vehishkim umet en omrin mimma met veamar shemuel lo shanu ella bealim aval beimahot let lan bah uvalin name la amaran ella
b: Dela ibbetzil zirta aval ibbetzil zirta let lan bah
Amar rav pappa la amaran ella dela ishti shichra aval ishti shichra let lan bah

Tanu rabbanan lo yochal adam batzal mippene nachash shebbo umaase berabbi chanina sheachal chatzi vatzal vachatzi nachash shebbo vechala venata lamut uvikkeshu chaverav rachamim alav vechaya mippene shehashshaa tzericha lo

Amar rabbi zera amar shemuel shechar mearvin bo ufosel et hammikve bishloshet luggin matkef lah rav kahana peshita vechi ma ben ze leme tzeva ditnan rabbi yose omer me tzeva poslin et hammikve bishloshet luggin amri hatam mayya detziva mikre hacha shichra ikri

Uvchamma mearvin savar rav acha bereh derav yosef kammeh derav yosef lememar bitren rive shichra keditnan hammotzi yayin kede mezigat hakkos vetane alah kede mezigat kos yafe may kos yafe kos shel beracha veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh kos shel beracha tzarich sheyehe bo rova reviit kede sheyyimzegennu veyaamod al reviit vechidrava deamar rava kol chamra dela dare al chad telat mayya lav chamra hu
Vekatane sefa ushar kol hammashkin birviit vechol hashshofchin birviit middehatam al chad arba hacha name al chad arba
Vela hi hatam hu divtzir mehachi la chashiv aval hacha la daavidi inashe deshatu kasa betzafra vechasa befanya vesamchi ilavayehu
Temarim bechamma amar rav yosef temarim bekav amar rav yosef mena amena lah detanya achal gerogrot veshilem temarim tavo alav beracha

Hechi dame ilema lefi damim daachal mineh bezuza veka meshallem leh bezuza may tavo alav beracha bezuza achal bezuza ka meshallem ella lav lefi midda daachal mineh geriva digrogrot deshaveya zuza veka meshallem leh geriva ditmarim deshave arbea vekatane tavo alav beracha alma temarim adifi
