Amar leh abbaye leolam daachal mineh bezuza veka meshallem bezuza umay tavo alav beracha daachal mineh mide dela kafetz aleh zavena veka meshallem leh mide dekafetz aleh zavena
Shetita amar rav acha bar pinchas tere shargushe kisane amar abbaye tere vune defumbedita
Amar abbaye amara li em hane kisane meallu leliba umvatteli machshevata

Veamar abbaye amara li em hay man deit leh chulsha deliba layete bisra deatma yammina dedichra velayete kabbuye dereita denisan vei leka kabbuye dereita layete sugyane daaravta venichabbeveh venechul venishte batreh chamra marka

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol shehu liftan kede leechol bo kol sheeno liftan kede leechol hemennu basar chay kede leechol hemennu basar tzali rabba amar kede leechol bo verav yosef amar kede leechol hemennu
Amar rav yosef mena amena lah dehane parsae achli tavhaki bela nahama amar leh abbaye ufarsae hao rubba dealma vehatnan bigde aniyyim laaniyyim bigde ashirim laashirim

a: Aval bigde ashirim laaniyyim la
Vechi tema hacha lechumra vehacha lechumra vehatanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mearvin lechole ulzaken kede mezono ulraavtan bisuda benonit shel kol adam kashya
Umi amar rabbi shimon ben elazar hachi vehatanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer og melech habbashan pitcho kimloo
Veabbaye hatam hechi lebed haddome nehaddemeh venappekeh
Ibaya lehu peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi shimon ben elazar o la ta shema deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan og melech habbashan pitcho bearbaa
Hatam deika petachim ketannim tuva veika chad dehave arbaa devadday ki ka meravach behahu ka meravach
Amar rav chiyya bar rav ashe amar rav mearvin bevasar chay amar rav shimi bar chiyya mearvin bevetzim chayyot vechamma amar rav nachman bar yitzchak achat sinay amar shettayim

Hannoder min hammazon muttar bammayim ku melach umayim hu dela ikri mazon ha kol mile ikri mazon lema tehve teuvta derav ushmuel derav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu en mevarchin bore mine mezonot ella al chameshet hamminin bilvad
Vela otvineh chada zimna lema tehve teuvtayehu name meha
Amar rav huna beomer kol hazzan alay mayim umelach hu dela zayeni ha kol mile zayeni

Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana ki hava azelna batreh derabbi yochanan lemechal pere deginosar ki havenan be mea hava menakketinan lechol chad vechad asra asra ki havenan be asra hava menakketinan lechol chad vechad mea mea vechol mea minayehu la have machazik lehu tzanna bat telata save vahava achel lehu lechullehon veamar shevuata dela teim li ziyyuna ema mezona
Amar rav huna amar rav shevua shello ochal kikkar zo mearvin lo bah kikkar zo alay en mearvin lo bah
Metivi hannoder min hakkikkar mearvin lo bah may lav deamar alay la deamar zo
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa ematay bizman sheamar shevua shello etamenna

Aval amar alay may hachi name deen mearvin lo bah i hachi addetane kikkar zo hekdesh en mearvin lo bah lefi sheen mearvin bahekdeshot liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim deamar zo aval amar alay en mearvin lo bah
Amar lecha rav huna ella may kol hecha deamar alay mearvin kashya resha
Chassore michassera vehachi katane hannoder min hakkikkar mearvin lo bah vaafilu amar alay naasa keomer shevua shello etamenna
Mikkol makom kashya lerav huna hu deamar kerabbi eliezer detanya rabbi eliezer omer shevua shello ochal kikkar zo mearvin lo bah kikkar zo alay en mearvin lo bah

Umi amar rabbi eliezer hachi vehatanya ze hakkelal adam oser atzmo beochel mearvin lo bah ochel hannesar lo leadam en mearvin lo bah rabbi eliezer omer kikkar zo alay mearvin lo bah kikkar zo hekdesh en mearvin lo bah lefi sheen mearvin lo bahekdeshot
Tere tannae vealliba derabbi eliezer

Mearvin lannazir beyayin ku matnitin dela kevet shammay detanya bet shammay omrim en mearvin lannazir beyayin ulyisrael bitruma bet hillel omrim mearvin lannazir beyayin ulyisrael bitruma amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay i attem modim
b: Shemmearvin legadol beom hakkippurim
Amru lahen aval amru lahen keshem shemmearvin laggadol beom hakkippurim ken mearvin lannazir beyayin ulyisrael bitruma
Uvet shammay hatam ika seuda haruya mibbeod yom hacha leka seuda haruya mibbeod yom
Keman dela kachananya detanya chananya omer kol atzman shel bet shammay lo hau modim beeruv ad sheyyotzi mittato vechol kele tashmishav lesham
Keman azla ha detanya erav bishchorim lo yetze bilvanim bilvanim lo yetze bishchorim keman amar rav nachman bar yitzchak chananya hi vealliba devet shammay

Velachananya bishchorim hu delo yetze ha bilvanim yetze haamar ad sheyyotzi mittato uchle tashmishav lesham hachi kaamar erav bilvanim vehutzrach lishchorim af bilvanim lo yetze keman amar rav nachman bar yitzchak chananya hi vealliba devet shammay
Somchos omer bechullin veilu lannazir beyayin la pelig may tama efshar demitteshil anneziruteh
I hachi teruma name efshar demitshil ilavah i mitteshil alah hadra letivla
Velafrosh alah mimmakom acher la nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf
Velafrosh alah mineh uveh delet bah shiura
Umay paska ella somchos savar lah kerabbanan deamri kol davar shehu mishshum shevut gazru alav ben hashshemashot

Keman azla ha ditnan yesh sheamru hakkol lefi ma shehu adam melo kumtzo mincha umlo chofnav ketoret vehashshote melo lugmav beom hakkippurim uvimzon shette seudot leeruv keman amar rabbi zera somchos hi deamar may dachaze leh bainan
Lema peliga adderabbi shimon ben elazar detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mearvin lechole ulzaken kede mezono ulraavtan bisuda benonit shel kol adam
Targuma achole vezaken aval raavtan batla dato etzel kol adam
Velakkohen bevet happeras deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel menappeach adam bet happeras veholech rabbi yehuda bar amme mishshemeh derav yehuda amar bet happeras shennidash tahor
Rabbi yehuda omer af bet hakkevarot tana mippene sheyyachol lachotz velelech beshida teva umigdal ka savar ohel zaruk shemeh ohel
Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya hannichnas leeretz haammim beshida teva umigdal rabbi metamme rabbi yose berabbi yehuda metaher
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar ohel zaruk lav shemeh ohel umar savar ohel zaruk shemeh ohel
Veha detanya rabbi yehuda omer

a: Mearvin lechohen tahor bitruma tehora bekever hechi azel beshida teva umigdal
Veha kevan deachata itammeya lah beshello huchshera o shennilosha beme perot
Vehechi mayete lah bifshute chele etz dela mekabbeli tuma
Veha ka maahil demayete lah achoreh
I hachi may tama derabbanan kasavri asur liknot bayit beisure hanaa
Mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar muttar kasavar mitzot lav lehanot nitnu

Ella ha deamar rava mitzot lav lehanot nitnu lema ketannae amrah lishmateh amar lach rava i sevira lehu deen mearvin ella lidvar mitzva dechulle alma mitzot lav lehanot nitnu vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar en mearvin ella lidvar mitzva umar savar mearvin afilu lidvar harshut
Ella ha deamar rav yosef en mearvin ella lidvar mitzva lema ketannae amrah lishmateh

Amar lecha rav yosef dechulle alma en mearvin ella lidvar mitzva udchulle alma mitzot lav lehanot nitnu uvha kamipalgi mar savar kevan dikna leh eruv la nicha leh deminatra umar savar nicha leh deminatra dei itzterich achel leh
Matni mearvin bidmay uvmaaser rishon shennittela terumato uvmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu vehakkohanim bechalla
Aval lo betevel velo bemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato velo bemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu
Gema demay ha la chaze leh migo dei bae mafkar lehu lenichseh vehave ani vachazu leh hashta name chaze leh ditnan maachilin et haaniyyim demay
b: Veet achsanya demay
Amar rav huna tana bet shammay omrim en maachilin et haaniyyim demay uvet hillel omrim maachilin et haaniyyim demay
Uvmaaser rishon shennittela ku peshita la tzericha shehikdimo beshibbolin venittela mimmennu terumat maaser velo nittela mimmennu teruma gedola

Vechidrabbi avahu amar resh lakish deamar rabbi avahu amar resh lakish maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibbolin patur mitteruma gedola shenneemar vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai maaser min hammaaser maaser min hammaaser amarti lecha velo teruma gedola utrumat maaser min hammaaser
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye i hachi afilu hikdimo bichri name amar leh alecha amar kera mikkol maserotechem tarimu et kol terumat Adonai
Uma raita hay idgan vehay la idgan
Uvmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu peshita la tzericha shennatan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh veka mashma lan deen hachomesh meakkev
Aval lo betevel peshita la tzericha betevel tavul midderabbanan uchgon shezzerao beatzitz sheeno nakuv
Velo bemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato peshita la tzericha shehikdimo bichri venittela mimmennu terumat maaser velo nittela mimmennu teruma gedola
Mahu detema kedaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye ka mashma lan kidshanni leh
Velo bemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu peshita
La tzericha sheppedaan velo pedaan kehilchatan maaser sheppedao al gav asimon verachamana amar vetzarta hakkesef kesef sheyyesh alav tzura
Hekdesh shechillo al gav karka derachamana amar venatan hakkesef vekam lo
Matni hashsholeach eruvo beyad cheresh shote vekatan o beyad mi sheeno mode beeruv eno eruv veim amar leacher lekabbelo mimmennu hare ze eruv
Gema vekatan la vehaamar rav huna katan gove et haeruv la kashya kan beeruve techumin kan beeruve chatzerot
O beyad mi sheeno mode beeruv man amar rav chisda kutae
Veim amar leacher lekabbelo hemennu hare ze eruv velechush dilma la mamte leh kidamar rav chisda beomed veroehu hacha name beomed veroehu
Velechush dilma la shakel mineh kidamar rav yechiel chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto hacha name chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto

Vehecha itmar derav chisda verav yechiel aha ittemar detanya netano lappil veholicho lakkof veholicho en ze eruv veim amar leacher lekabbelo hemennu hare ze eruv vedilma la mamte leh amar rav chisda beomed veroehu vedilma la mekabbel leh mineh amar rav yechiel chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto
Amar rav nachman beshel tora en chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto

a: Beshel sofrim chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto verav sheshet amar echad ze veechad ze chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto
Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah ditnan mishshekkarav haomer huttar hechadash miyyad
Veharchokim muttarim mechatzot hayyom veelach veha chadash deorayeta hu vekatane harchokim muttarin mechatzot hayyom veelach lav mishshum chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto
Verav nachman hatam kidkatane tama lefi sheyyodin sheen bet din mitatztzelin bo
Veika deamri amar rav nachman mena amena lah dekatane tama lefi sheyyodin sheen bet din mitatztzelin bo bet din hu dela mitatztzelin bo ha sheliach mitatztzel bo
Verav sheshet amar lach bet din ad palgeh deoma shaliach kulle yoma

Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah detanya haishsha sheyyesh aleha leda o ziva mevia maot venotenet bashshofar vetovelet veochelet bakkodashim laerev may tama lav mishshum deamrinan chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto
Verav nachman hatam kidrav shemaya deamar rav shemaya chazaka en bet din shel kohanim omdim mishsham ad sheyyichlu kol maot shebbashshofar

Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah detanya haomer lachavero tze velakket lecha teenim mitteenati ochel mehen aray umasseran vadday malle lecha kalkalla zo teenim mitteenati ochel mehen aray umasseran demay

Bamme devarim amurim beam haaretz aval bechaver ochel veeno tzarich leasser divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer bamme devarim amurim beam haaretz aval bechaver eno ochel ad sheyeasser lefi shello nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf
Amar rabbi nirin devaray middivre abba mutav sheyyechashdu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf velo yaachilu leamme haaretz tevalim
Ad kan la peligi ella demar savar nechshedu umar savar lo nechshedu aval kulle alma chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto
Verav nachman hatam kidrav chanina chozaa deamar rav chanina chozaa chazaka hu al chaver sheeno motzi davar sheeno metukkan mittachat yado
Amar mar bamme devarim amurim beam haaretz aval bechaver ochel veeno tzarich leasser divre rabbi

Hay am haaretz dekaamar leh leman ilema dekaamar leam haaretz chavreh measseran demay mi tzayet ella beam haaretz dekaamar leh lechaver ema sefa nirin devaray middivre abba mutav sheyyechashdu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf veal yaachilu leamme haaretz tevalin amme haaretz may bae hatam
Amar ravina resha beam haaretz sheamar lechaver sefa bechaver sheamar leam haaretz vechaver acher shomo rabbi
b: Savar oto chaver ochel veeno tzarich leasser devadday asore meassar hahu chaver kamma ilaveh verabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo yochal ad sheyeasser lefi shello nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf vaamar leh rabbi mutav sheyyechashdu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf veal yaachilu amme haaretz tevalim

Bemay kamipalgi rabbi savar nicha leh lechaver deleeved hu isura kallila vela leeved am haaretz isura rabba verabban shimon ben gamliel savar nicha leh lechaver deleeved am haaretz isura rabba veihu afilu isura kallila la leeved
Matni netano beilan lemala measara tefachim en eruvo eruv lematta measara tefachim eruvo eruv netano bevor afilu amok mea amma eruvo eruv

Gema yatev rabbi chiyya bar abba verabbi assi verava bar natan veyatev rav nachman gabbayehu veyatvi vekaamri hay ilan dekae hecha ilema dekae birshut hayyachid ma li lemala ma li lematta reshut hayyachid ola ad larakia
Veella dekae birshut harabbim demitkaven lishbot hecha ilema denitkaven lishbot lemala hu veeruvo bimkom echad hu ella nitkaven lishbot lematta veha ka mishtammesh beilan
Leolam dekae birshut harabbim venitkaven lishbot lematta verabbi hi deamar kol davar shehu mishshum shevut lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot

Amar lehu rav nachman yishar vechen amar shemuel amaru leh patritu bah kulle hay inhu name hachi ka patri bah ella hachi amaru leh kavitu leh bigmara amar lehu in ittemar name amar rav nachman amar shemuel hacha bailan haomed birshut harabbim askinan gavoha asara verachav arbaa venitkaven lishbot lematta verabbi hi deamar kol davar shehu mishshum shevut lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot
Amar rava lo shanu ella beilan haomed chutz leiburah shel ir aval ilan haomed betoch iburah shel ir afilu lemala measara hare ze eruv demata keman demalya damya
I hachi chutz leiburah shel ir name kevan deamar rava hannoten eruvo yesh lo arba ammot haveya lah reshut hayyachid urshut hayyachid ola ad larakia
Amar rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya hacha bailan hannote chutz learba ammot askinan

a: Venitkaven lishbot beikaro umay lemala umay lematta dahadar zakef
Veha i bae mayete lah derech alav
Kesherabbim mechattefin alav vechidulla deamar ulla ammud tisha birshut harabbim verabbim mechattefin alav vezarak venach al gabbav chayyav
May rabbi umay rabbanan

Detanya netano beilan lemala measara tefachim en eruvo eruv lematta measara tefachim eruvo eruv veasur litlo betoch shelosha muttar litlo netano bechalkalla utlao beilan afilu lemala measara tefachim eruvo eruv divre rabbi vachachamim omrim kol makom sheasur litlo en eruvo eruv
Vachachamim omrim aheya ilema assefa lema kasavri rabbanan tzedadin asurin ella aresha
Hay ilan hechi dame i delet beh arbaa mekom petur hu vei deit beh arbaa ki netano bechalkalla may have
Amar ravina resha deit beh arbaa sefa delet beh arbaa vechalkalla mashlimato learbaa
b: Verabbi savar lah kerabbi meir vesavar lah kerabbi yehuda
Savar lah kerabbi meir deamar chokkin lehashlim
Vesavar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar bainan eruv al gabbe mekom arbaa veleka
May rabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer naatz kora birshut harabbim vehinniach eruvo aleha gavoha asara urchava arbaa eruvo eruv veim lav en eruvo eruv
Adderabba hu veeruvo bimkom echad ella hachi kaamar gavoha asara tzarich sheyehe beroshah arbaa en gevoha asara en tzarich sheyehe beroshah arbaa
Keman dela kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer naatz kane birshut harabbim vehinniach berosho teraskal vezarak venach al gabbav chayyav
Afilu tema rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hatam hadran mechitzata hacha la hadran mechitzata
Rabbi yirmeya amar shane kalkalla hoil veyachol lintotah velahaviah letoch asara
Yatev rav pappa veka amar leha shemata etiveh rav bar shabba lerav pappa ketzad hu ose molicho barishon umachshich alav venotlo uva lo bashsheni machshich alav veochlo uva lo

a: Ammay nema kevan dei bae amtoye matze mamte leh af al gav dela amteyeh keman deamteyeh dame
Amar rabbi zera gezera mishshum yom tov shechal lihot achar shabbat

Etiveh nitkaven lishbot birshut harabbim vehinniach eruvo bakkotel lematta measara tefachim eruvo eruv lemala measara tefachim en eruvo eruv nitkaven lishbot berosh hashshovach o berosh hammigdal lemala measara tefachim eruvo eruv lematta measara tefachim en eruvo eruv
Veammay hachi name nema hoil veyachol lintoto velahavio letoch asara amar rabbi yirmeya hacha bemigdal mesummar askinan
Rava amar afilu tema bemigdal sheeno mesummar vehacha bemigdal aroch askinan dei mamte leh purta azel chutz learba ammot
Hechi dame i deika kavveta umitna layeteh bechavveta umitna delet leh kavveta umitna
Netano bevor afilu amok mea amma vechu hay bor dekae hecha ilema dekae birshut hayyachid
b: Peshita reshut hayyachid ola ad larakia vechi hechi desalka leel hachi name denachata letachat veella dekae birshut harabbim
Denitkaven lishbot hecha i lemala hu bemakom echad veeruvo bemakom acher hu i lematta peshita hu veeruvo bimkom echad
La tzericha dekae becharmelit venitkaven lishbot lemala verabbi hi deamar kol davar shehu mishshum shevut lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot
Matni netano berosh hakkane o berosh hakkundas bizman shehu talush venautz afilu gavoha mea amma hare ze eruv

Gema rame leh rav adda bar matna lerava talush venautz in lo talush venautz la manni rabbanan hi deamri kol davar shehu mishshum shevut gazru alav ben hashshemashot veha amratte resha rabbi resha rabbi vesefa rabbanan
Amar leh kevar rame leh rame bar chama lerav chisda veshanni leh resha rabbi vesefa rabbanan
Ravina amar kullah rabbi hi vesefa gezera shemma yiktom
Hahu pulmusa daata linhardea amar lehu rav nachman puku avidu kevushe kavshe beagma ulmachar nezil venitev illavayehu
Etiveh rame bar chama lerav nachman veamri lah rav ukva bar abba lerav nachman talush venautz in lo talush velo nautz la

Amar leh hatam beuzradin umna temra deshane lan ben uzradin lesheen uzradin detanya hakkanin vehaatadin vehahiggin min ilan hen veenan kilayim bakkerem vetanya idach hakkanim vehakkidan vehaurbanin min yarak hen vehen kilayim bakkerem kashya ahadade
Ella shema minah kan beuzradin kan besheen uzradin shema minah
Vekida min yarak hu vehatnan en markivin pegam al gabbe kida levana mippene shehu yarak beilan amar rav pappa kida lechud vekida levana lechud
Matni netano bemigdal veavad hammafteach hare ze eruv rabbi eliezer omer im eno yodea shehammafteach bimkomo eno eruv
Gema veammay hu bemakom echad veeruvo bemakom acher hu

Rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu hacha bemigdal shel levenim askinan verabbi meir hi deamar pochet lechattechila venotel ditnan bayit shemmilahu perot satum venifchat notel mimmekom happechat rabbi meir omer pochet venotel lechattechila
Vehaamar rav nachman bar adda amar shemuel beavera delivne hacha name baavera delivne
Veha amar rabbi zera beom tov amru aval lo beshabbat hacha name beom tov
I hachi hayenu dekatane alah rabbi eliezer omer im bair avad eruvo eruv veim bassade avad en eruvo eruv vei beom tov ma li ir ma li sade

a: Chassore michassera vehachi katane netano bemigdal venaal befanav veavad hammafteach hare ze eruv bamme devarim amurim beom tov aval beshabbat en eruvo eruv nimtza hammafteach ben bair ben bassade en eruvo eruv rabbi eliezer omer bair eruvo eruv bassade en eruvo eruv
Bair eruvo eruv kerabbi shimon deamar echad gaggot veechad chatzerot veechad karpefot reshut achat hen lechelim sheshshavtu betochan bassade en eruvo eruv kerabbanan
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu hacha bemigdal shel etz askinan demar savar keli hu veen binyan bechelim veen setira bechelim umar savar ohel hu
Uviflugta dehane tannae ditnan hikkish al gabbe shida teva umigdal temein rabbi nechemya verabbi shimon metaharin
May lav beha kamippalgi mar savar keli hu umar savar ohel hu
Amar abbaye vetisbera vehatanya ohel venisat tame keli veeno nisat tahor vekatane sefa veim hau nisotin temeim ze hakkelal nisat mechamat kocho tame mechamat reada tahor
Ella amar abbaye dechulle alma heset mechamat kocho tame mechamat reada tahor vehacha birada mechamat kocho askinan uvha ka mipalgi demar savar have heset umar savar la have heset
Umatnitin bemay mokminan lah abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu bemanul uktir bemitna askinan uvae sakkina lemifsekeh
Tanna kamma savar lah kerabbi yose deamar kal hakkelim nitalin beshabbat chutz mimmassar haggadol veyated shel macharesha
Verabbi eliezer savar lah kerabbi nechemya deamar afilu tallit afilu tarod en nitalin ella letzorech tashmishan
Matni nitgalgel chutz lattechum nafal alav gal o nisraf teruma venitmet mibbeod yom eno eruv mishshechashecha hare ze eruv
Im safek rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim hare ze chammar gammal
Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim sefek eruv kasher amar rabbi yose avtulmos heid mishshum chamishsha zekenim al sefek eruv shekkasher
Gema nitgalgel chutz lattechum amar rava lo shanu ella shennitgalgel chutz learba ammot aval letoch arba ammot hannoten eruvo yesh lo arba ammot
Nafal alav gal vechu ka salka datach dei bae matze shakel leh
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi dei kerabbi haamar kal davar shehu mishshum shevut lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot
Afilu tema kerabbi la tzericha devae mara vachatzina
Utzrichi dei tena nitgalgel mishshum deleta gabbeh aval nafal alav gal deiteh gabbeh ema leheve eruv
Vei tena nafal alav gal mishshum demikasse aval nitgalgel zimnin deate zika umayete leh ema leheve eruv tzericha
O nisraf teruma venitmet lema li tena nisraf
b: Lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose tena teruma venitmet lehodiacha kocho derabbi meir

Vesavar rabbi meir sefeka lechumra vehatnan tame sheyyarad litbol safek taval safek lo taval vaafilu taval safek taval bearbaim sea safek lo taval bearbaim sea vechen shene mikoot beachat yesh bah arbaim sea uvachat en bah arbaim sea vetaval beachat mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen taval sefeko tame
Bamme devarim amurim betuma chamura

Aval betuma kalla kegon sheachal ochalin temein veshata mashkin temein vehabba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin o shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin veyarad litbol safek taval safek lo taval vaafilu taval safek taval bearbaim sea safek lo taval bearbaim sea vechen shene mikoot beachat yesh bah arbaim sea veachat en bah arbaim sea vetaval beachat mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen taval sefeko tahor
Rabbi yose metamme
Kasavar rabbi meir techumin deorayeta ninhu
Vesavar rabbi meir techumin deorayeta veha tenan im en yachol lehavlio bezo amar rabbi dostay bar yannay mishshum rabbi meir shamati shemmekadderin beharim
Vei salka datach techumin deorayeta mi mekadderin veha amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh en mekadderin lo beare miklat velo beegla arufa mippene shehen shel tora
La kashya ha dideh ha derabbeh dayeka name dekatane bezo amar rabbi dostay bar yannay mishshum rabbi meir shamati shemmekadderin beharim shema minah
Urmi deorayeta addeorayeta lerabbi meir
Ditnan naga beechad ballayela veeno yodea im chay im met ulmachar hishkim umtzao met rabbi meir metaher vachachamim metammein shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan
Amar rabbi yirmeya mishnatenu shehaya aleha sheretz kal ben hashshemashot i hachi beha lema rabbi yose sefek eruv kasher
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu hacha bishte kite edim askinan achat omeret mibbeod yom nitmaa veachat omeret mishshechashecha

a: Rava amar hatam tere chezke lekulla vehacha chada chazaka lekulla
Kashya derabbi yose adderabbi yose
Amar rav huna bar chinana shane tuma hoil veyesh lah ikar min hattora shabbat name deorayeta hi kasavar rabbi yose techumin derabbanan
Veibaet ema ha dideh ha derabbeh dayeka name dekatane amar rabbi yose avtulmos heid mishshum chamishsha zekenim shessefek eruv kasher shema minah
Rava amar hatam hayenu tama derabbi yose haamed tame al chezkato veema lo taval
Adderabba haamed mikve al chezkato veema lo chasar bemikve shello nimdad

Tanya ketzad amar rabbi yose sefek eruv kasher erav bitruma safek mibbeod yom nitmet safek mishshechashecha nitmet vechen beferot safek mibbeod yom nittakkenu safek mishshechashecha nittakkenu ze hu safek eruv kasher
Aval erav bitruma safek tehora safek temea vechen beferot safek nittakkenu safek lo nittakkenu en ze sefek eruv kasher
May shena teruma deamar haamed teruma al chezkatah veema tehora hi perot name haamed tevel al chezkato veema lo nittakkenu
La tema safek mibbeod yom nittakkenu ella ema safek mibbeod yom nidmeu safek mishshechashecha nidmeu
Bea rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak merav huna hau lefanav shette chikkarot achat temea veachat tehora veamar arvu li battehora bechol makom shehi mahu

Tibe lerabbi meir tibe lerabbi yose tibe lerabbi meir ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam deleka tehora hacha ha ika tehora o dilma afilu lerabbi yose la kaamar ella hatam deim ita dehi tehora yada lah aval hacha ha la yada lah
Amar leh ben lerabbi yose ben lerabbi meir bainan seuda haruya mibbeod yom veleka
Bea mineh rava merav nachman kikkar zo hayyom chol ulmachar kodesh veamar arvu li baze mahu amar leh eruvo eruv
Hayyom kodesh ulmachar chol veamar arvu li baze mahu amar leh en eruvo eruv may shena
Amar leh lechi techul aleh kora demilcha hayyom chol ulmachar kodesh missefeka la nachata leh kedushsha hayyom kodesh ulmachar chol missefeka la paka leh kedushteh mineh
Tenan hatam lagin tevul yom shemmilleo min hechavit shel maaser tevel veamar hare ze terumat maaser lichshettecheshach devarav kayyamin
Veim amar arvu li baze lo amar kelum amar rava zot omeret sof hayyom kone eruv
b: Dei salka datach techilat hayyom kone eruv i amar arvu li baze ammay lo amar kelum
Amar rav pappa afilu tema techilat hayyom kone eruv bainan seuda haruya mibbeod yom veleka
Matni matne adam al eruvo veomer im bau goyim min hammizrach eruvi lammaarav min hammaarav eruvi lammizrach im bau lechan ulchan limkom sheertze elech lo bau lo lechan velo lechan hareni kivne iri

Im ba chacham min hammizrach eruvi lammizrach min hammaarav eruvi lammaarav ba lechan ulchan limkom sheertze elech lo lechan velo lechan hareni kivne iri rabbi yehuda omer im haya echad mehen rabbo holech etzel rabbo veim hau shenehen rabbotav limkom sheyyirtze yelech
Gema ki ata rabbi yitzchak tane ipcha kullah matnitin kashya goyim aggoyim kashya chacham achacham
Goyim aggoyim la kashya ha befarhagbana ha bemare demata
Chacham achacham la kashya ha bemotev pirke ha bemakre shema
Rabbi yehuda omer im haya echad mehen vechu verabbanan zimnin denicha leh bechavreh tefe merabbeh

Amar rav leta lematnitin middetane ayyo detane ayyo rabbi yehuda omer en adam matne al shene devarim keechad ella im ken ba chacham lammizrach eruvo lammizrach veim ba chacham lammaarav eruvo lammaarav aval lechan ulchan la
May shena lechan ulchan dela deen berera lammizrach lammaarav name en berera
Amar rabbi yochanan uchvar ba chacham
Adderabba leta lidayyo mimmatnitin
La salka datach deha shaminan leh lerabbi yehuda delet leh berera ditnan hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim

a: Omer shene luggin sheani atid lehafrish hare hen teruma asara maaser rishon tisha maaser sheni umechel veshote miyyad divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin
Ulla amar leta leayyo mimmatnitin veella ha dekatane rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin
Ulla zuze zuze katane divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda rabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin
Vesavar rabbi yose en berera vehatnan rabbi yose omer shette nashim shellakchu et kinehen beeruv o shennatnu kinehen lakkohen ezehu sheyyirtze kohen yakriv ola uleze sheyyirtze yakriv chattat
Amar rabba hatam keshehitnu
I hachi may lememra ka mashma lan kidrav chisda deamar rav chisda en hakkinin mitparshot
b: Ella i bilkichat bealim i baasiyyat kohen
Veakkatti savar rabbi yose en berera vehatanya am haaretz sheamar lechaver kach li agudda achat shel yarak o geluska achat eno tzarich leasser divre rabbi yose
Vachachamim omrim tzarich leasser efoch
Ta shema haomer maaser sheyyesh li beveti mechullal al sela shettaale beyadi min hakkis rabbi yose omer mechullal
Efoch ema rabbi yose omer lo chilel umay chazet deafchatte tarte mikkamme chada efoch chada mikkamme tarte

Ha vadday ipcha tanya dekatane sefa umode rabbi yose beomer maaser sheyyesh li betoch beti yehe mechullal al sela chadasha shettaale beyadi min hakkis shechilel middekaamar hacha shechilel mikkelal dehatam lo chilel
Hay sela chadasha hechi dame i deika tarte telat deyesh berera hayenu kammayeta ella deleka ella chada may taale
Ayede detane resha taale tena sefa name taale

Amar leh rava lerav nachman man hay tanna daafilu bidrabbanan let leh berera detanya amar lachamishsha hareni mearev al eze mikkem sheertze ratziti yelech lo ratziti lo yelech ratza mibbeod yom eruvo eruv mishshechashecha en eruvo eruv
Ishtik vela amar leh vela mide velema leh tanna deve ayyo hu la shemia leh

Rav yosef amar tannae shaklatte mealma tannae hi detanya hareni mearev leshabbatot shel kol hashshana ratziti elech lo ratziti lo elech ratza mibbeod yom eruvo eruv mishshechashecha rabbi shimon omer eruvo eruv vachachamim omrim en eruvo eruv
Veha shaminan lerabbi shimon delet leh berera kashya derabbi shimon adderabbi shimon ella efoch
May kashya dilma ki let leh lerabbi shimon berera bidorayeta aval bidrabbanan it leh
Kasavar rav yosef man deit leh berera la shena bidorayeta la shena bidrabbanan it leh uman delet leh berera la shena bidorayeta vela shena bidrabbanan let leh
Rava amar shane hatam devaenan reshit sheshsheyareha nikarin

Amar leh abbaye ella meatta hau lefanav shene rimmonim shel tevel veamar im yerdu geshamim hayyom yehe ze teruma al ze veim lo yerdu geshamim hayyom yehe ze teruma al ze hachi name ben yardu ben lo yardu deen bidvarav kelum
Vechi tema hachi name vehatnan terumat hakkeri hazze umaserotav betocho utrumat maaser ze betocho rabbi shimon omer kara hashshem
Shane hatam deika sevivav
Vei baet ema kidkatane tama amru lo lerabbi meir i atta mode shemma yibbaka hannod venimtza ze shote tevalim lemafrea amar lahen lichsheyyibbaka
Ulmay dislek addatin meikara devaenan reshit sheshsheyareha nikarin may kaamri leh
Hachi kaamri leh ledidan bainan reshit sheshsheyareha nikarin ledidach

a: I atta mode shemma yibbaka hannod venimtza shote tevalim lemafrea amar lahen lichsheyyibbaka

Matni rabbi eliezer omer yom tov hassamuch lashshabbat ben millefaneha uven milleachareha mearev adam shene eruvin veomer eruvi barishon lammizrach uvashsheni lammaarav barishon lammaarav uvashsheni lammizrach eruvi barishon uvashsheni kivne iri eruvi bashsheni uvrishon kivne iri
Vachachamim omrim o mearev leruach achat o eno mearev kol ikar o mearev lishne yamim o eno mearev kol ikar
Ketzad yaase molicho barishon umachshich alav venotlo uva lo bashsheni machshich alav veochlo uva lo venimtza mistakker bahalichato umistakker beeruvo
Neechal barishon eruvo larishon veen eruvo lashsheni
Amar lahen rabbi eliezer modim attem li shehen shette kedushshot
Gema leruach achat may nihu lishne yamim lishne yamim may nihu leruach achat hayenu kammayeta

Hachi kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi eliezer i atta mode sheen mearvin leom echad chetzo latztzafon vechetzo laddarom amar lahen aval keshem sheen mearvin leom echad chetzo laddarom vechetzo latztzafon kach en mearvin lishne yamim yom echad lammizrach veom echad lammaarav
Verabbi eliezer hatam kedushsha achat hacha shette kedushshot
Amar lahen rabbi eliezer i attem modim sheim erav beraglav beom rishon mearev beraglav beom sheni neechal eruvo beom rishon en yotze alav beom sheni
Amru lo aval ha laye shette kedushshot hen verabbanan sappoke mesappeka lehu vehacha lechumra vehacha lechumra
Amru lo lerabbi eliezer i atta mode sheen mearvin battechila miyyom tov lashshabbat amar lahen aval ha laye kedushsha achat hi
Verabbi eliezer hatam mishshum hachana
Tanu rabbanan erav beraglav beom rishon mearev beraglav beom sheni neechal eruvo beom rishon en yotze alav beom sheni divre rabbi
Rabbi yehuda omer
b: Hare ze chammar gammal
Rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omrim erav beraglav barishon en mearev beraglav bashsheni neechal eruvo beom rishon yotze alav bashsheni

Amar rav halacha kearbaa zekenim hallalu vealliba derabbi eliezer deamar shette kedushshot hen veellu hen arbaa zekenim rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yishmael berabbi yochanan ben beroka verabbi eliezer berabbi shimon verabbi yose bar yehuda setimtaa veika deamri chad minayehu rabbi elazar umappek rabbi yose bar yehuda setimtaa
Veha rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yishmael bar rabbi yochanan ben beroka ipcha shaminan lehu efoch
I hachi hayenu rabbi ema vechen amar rabban shimon ben gamliel vechu
Velichshov name rabbi rabbi tane lah vela savar lah
Rabbanan name tanu lah vela savri lah rav gemara gemir lah
Ki nach nafsheh derav huna ayel rav chisda lemirma derav adderav mi amar rav halacha kearbaa zekenim vealliba derabbi eliezer deamar shette kedushshot hen
Veha itmar shabbat veom tov rav amar nolda baze asura baze
Amar rabba hatam mishshum hachana
Detanya vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehechinu chol mechin leshabbat vechol mechin leom tov veen yom tov mechin leshabbat veen shabbat mechina leom tov
Amar leh abbaye ella ha ditnan ketzad hu ose molicho barishon umachshich alav venotlo uva lo bashsheni machshich alav veochlo uva lo ha ka mechin miyyom tov leshabbat
Amar leh rabba mi savratte sof hayyom kone eruv techillat hayyom kona eruv veshabbat mechina leatzmah
Ella meatta yearvu belagin
Bainan seuda haruya mibbeod yom veleka
Ella ha ditnan rabbi eliezer omer yom tov hassamuch lashshabbat ben millefaneha uven milleachareha mearev adam shene eruvin ha bainan seuda haruya mibbeod yom veleka
Mi savratte demannach leh besof alpayim amma lechan uvsof alpayim amma lechan la demannach leh besof elef amma lechan uvsof elef amma lechan
Ella ha deamar rav yehuda erav beraglav yom rishon mearev beraglav yom sheni erav befat beom rishon mearev befat beom sheni ha ka mechin miyyom tov lashshabbat
Amar leh mi savratte deazel veamar mide deazel veshatek veyatev
Keman kerabbi yochanan ben nuri deamar cheftze hefker konin shevita
Afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yochanan ben nuri ella beyashen dela matze amar aval beneor dei bae lememar matze amar af al gav dela amar keman deamar dame
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanin leabbaye i hava shemia leh lemar ha detanya lo yehallech adam lesof sadehu leda ma hi tzericha kayyotze bo

a: Lo yetayyel adam al petach medina kede sheyyikkanes lammerchatz miyyad hadar beh
Vela hi shemia leh vela hadar beh hatam mochcha milta hacha lav mochcha milta hi
I tzurba merabbanan hu amrinan shemata meshachteh vei am haaretz hu amrinan chamra irchas leh
Gufa amar rav yehuda erav beraglav beom rishon mearev beraglav besheni erav befat beom rishon mearev befat beom sheni
Erav befat barishon mearev beraglav bashsheni erav beraglav barishon en mearev befat bashsheni sheen mearvin battechilla befat

Erav befat beom rishon mearev befat beom sheni amar shemuel uvotah happat amar rav ashe dayeka name matnitin dekatane ketzad hu ose molicho barishon umachshich alav venotlo uva lo bashsheni machshich alav veochlo uva lo
Verabbanan dilma hatam etza tova ka mashma lan

Matni rabbi yehuda omer rosh hashshana shehaya yare shemma titabber mearev adam shene eruvin veomer eruvi barishon lammizrach uvashsheni lammaarav barishon lammaarav uvashsheni lammizrach eruvi barishon uvashsheni kivne iri eruvi bashsheni uvrishon kivne iri velo hodu lo chachamim
Veod amar rabbi yehuda matne adam al hakkalkalla beom tov rishon veochlah bashsheni
Vechen betza shennolda barishon teachel bashsheni velo hodu lo chachamim

Rabbi dosa ben harkinas omer haover lifne hatteva beom tov shel rosh hashshana omer hachlitzenu Adonai elohenu et yom rosh hachodesh hazze im hayyom im lemachar ulmachar hu omer im hayyom im emesh velo hodu lo chachamim

Gema man lo hodu lo amar rav rabbi yose hi detanya modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer berosh hashshana shehaya yare shemma titabber mearev adam shene eruvin veomer eruvi barishon lammizrach uvashsheni lammaarav barishon lammaarav uvashsheni lammizrach eruvi barishon uvashsheni kivne iri eruvi bashsheni uvarishon kivne iri rabbi yose oser
Amar lahen rabbi yose i attem modim sheim bau edim min hammincha ulmala shennohagin oto hayyom kodesh ulmachar kodesh
b: Verabbanan hatam ki hechi dela lezalzole beh
Veod amar rabbi yehuda vechu
Utzricha dei ashmeinan rosh hashshana beha kaamar rabbi yehuda mishshum dela kaaved mide aval kalkala demechze kimtakken tivla ema mode lehu lerabbanan
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte mishshum deleka lemigzar alayehu aval betza deika lemigzar bah mishshum perot hannoshrin umishshum mashkin shezzavu ema mode lehu lerabbanan tzericha

Tanya ketzad amar rabbi yehuda matne adam al hakkalkala beom tov rishon veochlah bashsheni hau lefanav shette kalkallot shel tevel omer im hayyom chol ulmachar kodesh tehe zo teruma al zo veim hayyom kodesh ulmachar chol en bidvaray kelum vekore aleha shem umannichah
Ulmachar hu omer im hayyom chol tehe zo teruma al zo veim hayyom kodesh en bidvaray kelum vekore aleha shem veochlah rabbi yose oser vechen haya rabbi yose oser bishne yamim tovim shel galiyyot
Hahu bar tavya daata leve resh galuta deittetzid beom tov rishon shel galiyyot veishtechit beom tov sheni

Rav nachman verav chisda achalu rav sheshet la achal amar rav nachman may eeved leh lerav sheshet dela achel bisra detavya amar leh rav sheshet vehechi echol detane isi veamri lah isi tane vechen haya rabbi yose oser shene yamim tovim shel galiyyot
Amar rava umay kushya dilma hachi kaamar vechen haya rabbi yose oser bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana baggola i hachi shel galiyyot baggola mibe leh
Amar rav assi umay kushya dilma hachi kaamar vechen haya rabbi yose ose isur shene yamim tovim shel galiyyot kishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana lerabbanan desharu
Ashkecheh rav sheshet lerabba bar shemuel amar leh tane mar mide bikdushshot amar leh tenena mode rabbi yose bishne yamim tovim shel galiyyot amar leh i mashkachatte lehu la tema lehu vela mide
Amar rav ashe ledidi amar li ammemar hahu bar tavya lav ittzude ittzid

a: Ella michutz lattechum ata man daachal savar habba bishvil yisrael ze muttar leyisrael acher
Uman dela achal savar kol deate leve resh galuta addata dechullehu rabbanan ate
Veha ashkecheh rav sheshet lerabba bar shemuel vaamar leh lo hau devarim meolam
Hahu lifta deate lemachoza nefak rava chazya dichmisha shera rava lemizban mineh amar ha vadday meetmol neekra
May amratte michutz lattechum atya habba bishvil yisrael ze muttar leechol leyisrael acher vechol shekken hay deaddata degoyim ata
Kevan dachaza deka mappeshi umayeti lehu asar lehu
Hanhu bene genana degazzu lehu asa beom tov sheni leurta shera lehu ravina leoroche beh lealtar amar leh rava bar tachlifa leravina lesar lehu mar mippene sheenan bene tora
Matkef lah rav shemaya tama deenan bene tora ha bene tora shere veha bainan bichde sheyyeasu azalu shayeluh lerava amar lehu bainan bichde sheyyeasu
Rabbi dosa omer haover lifne hatteva ku
Amar rabba ki havenan be rav huna ibaya lan mahu lehazkir shel rosh chodesh berosh hashshana kevan dachalukin bemusafin amrinan o dilma zikkaron echad ole lechan ulchan
Amar lan tenetuha rabbi dosa omer haover lifne hatteva ku may lav lehazkir
Lo lehatnot
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane bevarayeta vechen haya rabbi dosa ose berashe chodashim shel kol hashshana kullah velo hodu lo
I amratte bishlama lehatnot mishshum hachi lo hodu lo ella i amratte lehazkir ammay lo hodu lo

Veella may lehatnot lema li leiploge betarte tzericha dei ashmeinan rosh hashshana hava amena beha kaamri rabbanan dela mishshum deate lezalzole beh aval berashe chodashim shel kol hashshana kullah ema modu leh lerabbi dosa
Vei ittemar beha beha kaamar rabbi dosa aval behach ema mode lehu lerabbanan tzericha
Metivi rosh hashshana shechal lihot beshabbat bet shammay omrim mitpallel eser uvet hillel omrim mitpallel tesha veim ita bet shammay achat esre mibbee leh
b: Amar rabbi zera shane rosh chodesh mittoch shekkolel leshacharit vearvit kolel name bemusafin
Umi it lehu levet shammay kolel vehatanya rosh chodesh shechal lihot beshabbat bet shammay omrim mitpallel shemone uvet hillel omrim mitpallel sheva kashya

Vecholel atzmo tannae hi detanya shabbat shechal lihot berosh chodesh o bechullo shel moed arvit shacharit umincha mitpallel kedarko sheva veomer meen hamora baavoda rabbi eliezer omer bahodaa veim lo amar machazirin oto
Uvmusafin matchil beshel shabbat umsayyem beshel shabbat veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza
Rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omrim kol makom shezzakuk lesheva matchil beshel shabbat umsayyem beshel shabbat veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza
May hava alah amar rav chisda zikkaron echad ole lo lechan ulchan vechen amar rabba zikkaron echad ole lo lechan ulchan
Veamar rabba ki havena be rav huna ibaya lan mahu lomar zeman berosh hashshana uvom hakkippurim kevan demizzeman lizman ate amrinan o dilma kevan delo ikru regalim la amrinan la hava bideh
Ki atay be rav yehuda amar ana akkara chadta name amena zeman amri leh reshut la ka mibaya li ki ka mibaya li chova may amar li rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu en omer zeman ella beshalosh regalim

Metivi ten chelek leshiva vegam lishmona rabbi eliezer omer shiva ellu shiva yeme bereshit shemona ellu shemona yeme mila rabbi yehoshua omer shiva ellu shiva yeme fesach shemona ellu shemona yeme hachag uchshehu omer vegam lerabbot atzeret verosh hashshana veom hakkippurim
May lav lizman lo livracha
Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach lizman zeman kol shiva mi ika ha la kashya dei la mevarech haidana mevarech limchar ulom uchra
Mikkol makom bainan kos lema mesayya leh lerav nachman deamar rav nachman zeman omro afilu bashshuk ha la kashya deikla leh kos
Hatinach atzeret verosh hashshana yom hakkippurim hechi aved i mevarech aleh veshate leh kevan deamar zeman kabbeleh aleh vaasir leh
Dehaamar leh rav yirmeya bar abba lerav mi badlatte vaamar leh in badelna
Livroch aleh velannecheh hamvarech tzarich sheyyitom litveh leyanoka let hilcheta kerav acha dilma ate lemisrach

May have alah shadderuh rabbanan lerav yemar sava kammeh derav chisda bemaale yoma deresh shatta amaru leh zil chazi hechi aved ovada ta ema lan ki chazyeh amar leh daluh lirtiva rafsa leh beduchteh ayeto leh kasa dechamra kaddesh vaamar zeman
Vehilcheta omer zeman berosh hashshana veom hakkippurim vehilcheta zeman omro afilu bashshuk
Veamar rabba ki havenan be rav huna ibaya lan bar be rav deyatev betaanita bemaale shabbeta mahu leashlome la hava bideh atay lekammeh derav yehuda vela hava bideh
Amar rava nechzeyeh anan detanya tisha beav shechal lihot beshabbat

a: Vechen erev tisha beav shechal lihot beshabbat ochel veshote kol tzarko umaale al shulchano afilu kisudat shelomo bishato chal lihot tisha beav beerev shabbat meviin lo kevetza veochel kede shello yikkanes lashshabbat keshehu meunne

Tanya amar rabbi yehuda paam achat hayinu yoshvin lifne rabbi akiva vetisha beav shechal lihot beerev shabbat haya veheviu lo betza megulgelet ugmaah belo melach velo shehaya taev lah ella leharot lattalmidim halacha

Verabbi yose omer mitanne umashlim amar lahen rabbi yose i attem modim li betisha beav shechal lihot beechad bashshabbat shemmafsik mibbeod yom amru lo aval amar lahem ma li likanes bah keshehu meunne ma li latzet mimmenna keshehu meunne
Amru lo im amarta latzet mimmenna shehare achal veshata kol hayyom kullo tomar likanes bah keshehu meunne shello achal veshata kol hayyom kullo

Veamar ulla halacha kerabbi yose umi avdinan kerabbi yose urminhi en gozrin taanit al hatztzibur berashe chodashim bachanukka uvfurim veim hitchilu en mafsikin divre rabban gamliel amar rabbi meir af al pi sheamar rabban gamliel en mafsikin mode haya sheen mashlimin vechen betisha beav shechal lihot beerev shabbat

Vetanya leachar petirato shel rabban gamliel nichnas rabbi yehoshua lehafer et devarav amad rabbi yochanan ben nuri al raglav veamar chaze ana devatar resha gufa azel kol yamav shel rabban gamliel kavanu halacha kemoto achshav atta mevakkesh levattel devarav yehoshua en shomin lecha shekkevar nikbea halacha kerabban gamliel velo haya adam sheirer baddavar kelum
Bedoro shel rabban gamliel avud kerabban gamliel bedoro shel rabbi yose avud kerabbi yose

Uvdoro shel rabban gamliel avud kerabban gamliel vehatanya amar rabbi elazar ben tzadok ani hayiti mibbene senaav ben binyamin paam achat chal tisha beav lihot beshabbat udchinuhu leachar hashshabbat vehitanninu bo velo hishlamnuhu mippene sheyyom tov shellanu haya tama deom tov ha erev yom tov mashlimin
Amar ravina shane yom tov shel divrehem mittoch shemmitannin bo shaot mashlimin bo arviyyot shabbat hoil veen mitannin bah shaot en mashlimin bah arviyyot

Amar rav yosef la shemia li ha shemata amar leh abbaye atte amarte nihalan veaha amarte nihalan en gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur berashe chodashim vechu veamrinan alah amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi meir sheamar mishshum rabban gamliel aval chachamim omrim mitanne umashlim
May lav akkullehu la achanukka ufurim
Hachi name mistabbera
b: Dei salka datach akkullehu ha bae mineh rabba merav yehuda vela peshat leh
Ultamach ha dedaresh mar zutra mishshemeh derav huna halacha mitanne umashlim ha bea mineh rabba merav huna vela peshat leh
Ella ha mikkamme deshamah veha levatar deshamah hacha name ha mikkamme deshamah ha levatar deshamah
Daresh mar zutra mishshemeh derav huna halacha mitannin umashlimin
Hadran alach bakkol mearvin
Matni mi shehotziuhu nochrim o ruach raa en lo ella arba ammot
Hechziruhu keilu lo yatza
Holichuhu leir acheret netanuhu bedir o besahar rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya omrim mehallech et kullah rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva omrim en lo ella arba ammot
Maase shebbau mippelandarsin vehifliga sefinatam bayyam rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya halchu et kullah rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva lo zazu mearba ammot sheratzu lehachamir al atzman
Paam achat lo nichnesu lannamal ad shechashecha amru lo lerabban gamliel ma anu lered
Amar lahem muttarim attem shekkevar hayiti mistakkel vehayinu betoch hattechum ad shello chashecha
Gema tanu rabbanan shelosha devarim maavirin et haadam al dato veal daat kono ellu hen nochrim veruach raa vedikduke aniyyut
Lemay nafka minah lemive rachame alayehu
Shelosha en roin pene gehinnam ellu hen dikduke aniyyut vechole meayin veharshut veyesh omrim af mi sheyyesh lo ishsha raa
Veidach ishsha raa mitzva legarshah
Veidach zimnin dichtubbatah merubba i name it leh banim minah vela matze megaresh lah
Lemay nafka minah lekabbole meahava
Shelosha metin keshehen mesapperin veellu hen choli meayin vechayya vehidrokan
Lemay nafka minah lemashmoshe behu zevadta
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel yatza ledaat en lo ella arba ammot peshita hashta mi shehotziuhu nochrim en lo ella arba ammot yatza ledaat mibaya
Ella ema chazar ledaat en lo ella arba ammot
Ha name tenena hechziruhu nochrim keilu lo yatza hechziruhu hu dichilu lo yatza aval hotziuhu nochrim vechazar ledaat en lo ella arba ammot
Ella ema yatza ledaat vehechziruhu nochrim en lo ella arba ammot
Ha name tenena hotziuhu vehechziruhu keilu lo yatza hotziuhu vehechziruhu hu dichilu lo yatza aval yatza ledaat la
Mahu detema litzdadin katane mi shehotziuhu nochrim vechazar ledaat en lo ella arba ammot aval yatza ledaat vehechziruhu nochrim keilu lo yatza ka mashma lan
Beo mineh merabba hutzrach linkavav mahu amar lahem gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora
Amri nehardae i pikeach hu ayel litchuma vechevan deal al
Amar rav pappa perot sheyyatzu chutz lattechum vechazru afilu bemezid lo hifsidu et mekoman may tama anusin ninhu
Etiveh rav yosef bar shemaya lerav pappa rabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omrim leolam asurin ad sheyyachzeru limkoman shoggin beshogeg in bemezid la
Tannae hi detanya perot sheyyatzu chutz lattechum beshogeg yeachelu bemezid lo yeachelu

a: Rabbi nechemya omer bimkoman yeachelu shello bimkoman lo yeachelu
May bimkoman ilema bimkoman bemezid veha katane behedya rabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omrim leolam asurin ad sheyyachzeru limkoman shoggin beshogeg in bemezid la
Ella lav bimkoman beshogeg vechassore mechassera vehachi katane perot sheyyatzu chutz lattechum beshogeg yeachelu bemezid lo yeachelu
Bamme devarim amurim shello bimkoman aval bimkoman afilu bemezid yeachelu vaata rabbi nechemya lememar afilu bimkoman name beshogeg in bemezid la

La bemezid bimkoman dechulle alma la peligi deasur vehacha beshogeg shello bimkoman peligi tanna kamma savar beshogeg shere shello bimkoman verabbi nechemya savar afilu shogeg bimkoman in shello bimkoman la
Veha middekatane sefa rabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omrim leolam asurin ad sheyyachzeru limkoman shoggin shogeg in bemezid la mikkelal detanna kamma savar bemezid name shere shema minah
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel haya mehallech veeno yodea techum shabbat mehallech alpayim pesiot benoniyyot vezo hi techum shabbat
Veamar rav nachman amar shemuel shavat bevika vehikkifuha nochrim mechitza beshabbat mehallech alpayim amma umtaltel bechullah al yede zerika
Verav huna amar mehallech alpayim amma umtaltel arba ammot venitaltel bechullah al yede zerika
Shemma yimmashech achar cheftzo
Bealpayim mihat litaltel ki orcheh
Mishshum dehave kimchitza shennifretza bimloah lemakom haasur lah
Chiyya bar rav amar mehallech alpayim amma umtaltel bealpayim amma keman dela kerav nachman vela kerav huna
Ema metaltel bearba i hachi hayenu derav huna ema vechen amar rabbi chiyya bar rav
Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna la tiflog aleh dishmuel detanya keoteh detanya
b: Haya moded uva vechalta middato bachatzi hair muttar letaltel bechol hair kullah uvilvad shello yaavor et hattechum beraglav may metaltel lav al yede zerika
Amar rav huna la al yede meshicha
Amar rav huna haya moded uva vechalta middato bachatzi chatzer en lo ella chatzi chatzer
Peshita ema yesh lo chatzi chatzer
Hay name peshita mahu detema lechush dilma ate letaltole bechullah ka mashma lan
Amar rav nachman mode li huna haya moded uva vechalta middato al sefat tikra muttar letaltel bechol habbayit
May tama hoil vetikrat habbayit chovetet

Amar rav huna bereh derav natan ketannae holichuhu leir acheret untanuhu bedir o besahar rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya omrim mehallech et kullah verabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva omrim en lo ella arba ammot
May lav rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya deamru mehallech et kullah dela gazri hiluch dir vesahar attu hiluch bevika
Umiddehiluch attu hiluch la gazri tiltul attu hiluch la gazri
Verabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva deomrim en lo ella arba ammot degazri hiluch dir vesahar attu hiluch devikah umiddehiluch attu hiluch gazri tiltul attu hiluch name gazri
Mimmay dilma ki la gazri rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya hiluch sahar vedir attu hiluch bika hane mile hatam dishne mekomot hen
Aval tiltul attu hiluch demakom echad hu hachi name degazri gezera shemma yimmashech acher cheftzo
Verabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva name mimmay demishshum degazri hu dilma mishshum deka savri ki amrinan kal habbayit kullo kearba ammot dame hane mile hecha deshavat baavir mechitzot mibbeod yom
Aval hecha delo shavat baavir mechitzot mibbeod yom la
Amar rav hilcheta kerabban gamliel bedir vesahar usfina ushmuel amar hilcheta kerabban gamliel bisfina aval bedir vesahar la
Dechulle alma mihat halacha kerabban gamliel bisfina may tama
Amar rabba hoil veshavat baavir mechitzot mibbeod yom
Rabbi zera amar hoil usfina notalto mittechilat arba umannachto besof arba
May benayehu ika benayehu shennifchatu dofne sefina i name bekofetz missefina lisfina
Verabbi zera may tama la amar kerabba amar lach mechitzot

a: Lehavriach mayim asuot
Verabba may tama la amar kerabbi zera bimhallechet kulle alma la feligi ki peligi besheamda

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak matnitin name dayeka devimhallechet la peligi mimmay middekatane maase shebbau mippelandarsin vehifliga sefinatam bayyam rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya halchu et kullah verabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva lo zazu mearba ammot sheratzu lehachamir al atzman
I amratte bishlama bimhallechet la peligi hayenu dekatane ratzu dilma amda
Ella i amratte peligi hay ratzu lehachamir isura hu
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane sefina dumya dedir vesahar ma dir vesahar dikvii af sefina name dikvia
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe hilcheta kerabban gamliel bisfina hilcheta mikkelal difligi
In vehatanya chananya ben achi rabbi yehoshua omer kol oto hayyom yashvu vedanu bidvar halacha emesh hichria achi abba halacha kerabban gamliel bisfina vahalacha kerabbi akiva bedir vesahar
Bae rav chananya yesh techumin lemala measara o en techumin lemala measara
Ammud gavoha asara verachav arbaa la tibe lach deara semichta hi
Ki tibe lach beammud gavoha asara veeno rachav arbaa i name dekaazel bikfitza
Lishana acharina bisfina may
Amar rav hoshaya ta shema maase shebbau mippelandarsin vehifliga sefinatam bayyam vechu i amratte bishlama yesh techumin mishshum hachi ratzu ella i amratte en techumin ammay ratzu
Kidamar rava bimhallechet birkak hacha name bimhallechet birkak
Ta shema paam achat lo nichnesu lannamal ad shechashecha vechu i amratte bishlama yesh techumin shappir ella i amratte en techumin ki lo hayinu betoch hattechum may have
Amar rava bimhallechet birkak
Ta shema hane shav shemata deitamran betzafra beshabbeta kammeh derav chisda besura bahade panya beshabbeta kammeh derava befumbedita
Man amrinhu lav eliyyahu amrinhu alma en techumin lemala measara la dilma yosef sheda amrinhu
Ta shema hareni nazir bayyom shebben david ba muttar lishtot yayin beshabbatot uvyamim tovim
b: Veasur lishtot yayin kol yemot hachol
I amratte bishlama yesh techumin hayenu divshabbatot uvyamim tovim muttar ella i amratte en techumin beshabbatot uvyamim tovim ammay muttar
Shane hatam deamar kera hinne anochi sholeach lachem et eliyya hannavi vego veha la ata eliyyahu meetmol
I hachi bechol kol yoma veoma name lishtere deha la ata eliyyahu meetmol ella amrinan levet din haggadol ata hacha name lema levet din haggadol ata
Kevar muvtach lahen leyisrael sheen eliyyahu ba lo bearve shabbatot velo bearve yamim tovim mippene hattorach
Ka salka datach middeeliyyahu la ata mashiach name la ate bemaale shabbeta lishtere eliyyahu la ate mashiach ate dechevan deate meshicha hakkol avadim hen leyisrael
Bechad beshabba lishtere lifshot minah deen techumin dei yesh techumin bechad beshabba lishtere dela ata eliyyahu beshabbat
Hay tanna sappoke mesappeka leh i yesh techumin o en techumin ulchumra
Dekae emat deka nadar ilema dekae bechol kevan dechal aleh nezirut hechi atya shabbeta umafkea leh
Ella dekae beshabbeta veka nadar uvom tov veka nadar vehahu yoma deshare leh mikan veelach asir leh
Paam achat lo nichnesu lannamal vechu
Tana shefoferet hayeta lo lerabban gamliel shehaya mabbit vetzofe bah alpayim amma bayyabbasha uchnegdah alpayim bayyam
Harotze leda kamma omko shel ge mevi shefoferet umabbit bah veyeda kamma omko shel gaye
Veharotze leda kamma govho shel dekel moded komato vetzillo vetzel komato veyeda kamma govah shel dekel
Harotze shello tishre chayya raa betzel kever noetz kane bearba shaot bayyom veyire lehechan tzillo note meshappea veole meshappea veored
Nechemya bereh derav chanilay meshachteh shemata unfak chutz lattechum amar leh rav chisda lerav nachman nechemya talmidcha sharuy betzaar
Amar lo ase lo mechitza shel bene adam veyikkanes
Yatev rav nachman bar yitzchak achoreh derava veyatev rava kammeh derav nachman amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava may ka mibbaya leh lerav chisda
Ilema bidmalu gavre askinan veka mibbaya leh hilcheta kerabban gamliel

a: O en halacha kerabban gamliel o dilma bidla malu gavre askinan veka mibbaya leh halacha kerabbi eliezer o en halacha kerabbi eliezer

Peshita bidla malu gavre askinan dei salka datach bidmalu gavre askinan may tibe leh haamar rav halacha kerabban gamliel bedir vesahar usfina ella vadday bidla malu gavre askinan udrabbi eliezer kamibaya leh
Dayeka name dekaamar leh yikkanes may yikkanes lav belo mechitza

Etiveh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava nafal dofnah lo yaamid bah adam behema vechelim velo yizkof et hammitta lifros aleha sadin lefi sheen osin ohel aray battechila beom tov veen tzarich lomar bashshabbat

Amar leh atte amratte li meha vaana amena lach meha ose adam et chavero dofen kede sheyyochal veyishte veyishan veyizkof et hammitta veyifros aleha sadin kede shello tippol chamma al hammet veal haochalin

Kashyan ahadade la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ha rabbanan ditnan pekak hachallon rabbi eliezer omer bizman shekkashur vetaluy pokkin bo veim lav en pokkin bo vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach pokkin bo

Veha itmar alah amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim sheen osin ohel aray battechila beom tov veen tzarich lomar beshabbat lo nechleku ella lehosif sherabbi eliezer omer en mosifin beom tov veen tzarich lomar beshabbat vachachamim omrim mosifin beshabbat veen tzarich lomar beom tov
Ella la kashya ha kerabbi meir ha kerabbi yehuda detanya asaah livhema dofen lassukka rabbi meir posel verabbi yehuda machshir
Rabbi meir deka pasel hatam alma la mechitza hi hacha share delav mide ka aved
Verabbi yehuda deka machshir hatam alma mechitza hi hacha asar
Vetisbera emar deshamatte leh lerabbi meir behema adam vechelim mi shamatte leh
Vetu rabbi meir alliba deman i alliba derabbi eliezer lehosif name asar
Ella alliba derabbanan emar deamri rabbanan lehosif lechattechila mi amur
Ella ha veha rabbanan vechelim akkelim la kashya ha bedofen shelishit ha bedofen reviit
Dayeka name dekatane nafal dofnah shema minah
b: Ella adam aadam kashya
Adam aadam name la kashya kan ledaat kan shello middaat
Veha derabbi nechemya bereh derabbi chanilay ledaat hava shello middaat hava
Rav chisda miha ledaat hava rav chisda shello min hamminyan hava
Hanhu bene genana deailu mayya bimchitza shel bene adam naggedinhu shemuel amar im amru shello middaat yomru ledaat
Hanhu zike dahava shadyan beristeka demachoza bahade daata rava mippirkeh alinhu nihaleh leshabbeta achariti bae ayelinhu vaasar lehu dehave leh kildaat veasur
Levi ailu leh tivna zeeri aspasta rav shimi bar chiyya mayya
Matni mi sheyyatza birshut veamru lo kevar naasa maase yesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach
Im haya betoch hattechum keilu lo yatza kol hayyotzim lehatztzil chozrin limkoman
Gema may im haya betoch hattechum keilu lo yatza amar rabba hachi kaamar im haya betoch techum shello keilu lo yatza mittoch beto dame
Peshita mahu detema hoil veakar akar ka mashma lan
Rav shimi bar chiyya amar hachi kaamar im hau techumin shennatnu lo chachamim muvlain betoch hattechum shello keilu lo yatza mittechumo
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar havlaat techumin milta hi umar savar lav milta hi

Amar leh abbaye lerabba veatte la tisbera dehavlaat techumin milta hi uma ilu shavat bimara shebbetochah arbaat alafim veal gaggah pachot mearbaat alafim amma lo nimtza mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma
Amar leh vela shane lach ben hecha deshavat baavir mechitzot mibbeod yom lehecha delo shavat baavir mechitzot mibbeod yom
Vehecha delo shavat la

a: Vehatnan rabbi eliezer omer shettayim yikkanes shelosha lo yikkanes may lav rabbi eliezer letameh deamar vehu beemtzaan
Vearba ammot dihavu leh rabbanan keman demibalan damu vekaamar yikkanes alma havlaat techumin milta hi

Amar leh rabba bar bar chana leabbaye umidderabbi eliezer kamotvatte leh lemar amar leh in dishmia li mineh demar ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ella lidvar harshut aval lidvar mitzva modu leh
Vechol hayyotzin lehatztzil chozrin limkoman vaafilu tuva veha amratte resha alpayim amma vetu la
Amar rav yehuda amar rav shechozrin bichle zayin limkoman umay kushya dilma lehatztzil shane
Ella i kashya ha kashya ditnan barishona lo hau zazin mishsham kol hayyom kullo

Hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken sheyyesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach velo ellu bilvad amru ella afilu chachama habbaa leyalled vehabba lehatztzil min haggayis umin hannahar umin hammappolet umin haddeleka hare hen keanshe hair veyesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach
Vetu la veha amratte kol hayyotzin lehatztzil chozrin limkoman afilu tuva
Amar rav yehuda amar rav shechozrin bichle zayin limkoman kidtanya barishona hau mannichin kele zeynan babbayit hassamuch lachoma

Paam achat hikkiru bahen oyevim veradfu acharehem venichnesu litol kele zeynan venichnesu oyevim acharehen dachaku ze et ze vehargu ze et ze yoter mimma shehargu oyevim beotah shaa hitkinu sheyehu chozrin limkoman bichle zeynan
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar la kashya kan shennitztzechu yisrael et ummot haolam kan shennitztzechu ummot haolam et atzman
Amar rav yehuda amar rav nochrim shetztzaru al ayerot yisrael en yotzin alehem bichle zeynan veen mechallelin alehen et hashshabbat
Tanya name hachi nochrim shetztzaru vechu bamme devarim amurim keshebbau al iske mamon aval bau al iske nefashot yotzin alehen bichle zeynan umchallelin alehen et hashshabbat
Uvair hassemucha lassefar afilu lo bau al iske nefashot ella al iske teven vakash yotzin alehen bichle zeynan umchallelin alehen et hashshabbat
Amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman uvavel kair hassemucha lassefar damya vetarguma nehardea
Daresh rabbi dostay demin bere may dichtiv vayyaggidu ledavid lemor hinne felishtim nilchamim bikila vehemma shosim et haggoranot

Tana keila ir hassemucha lassefar hayeta vehem lo bau ella al iske teven vakash dichtiv vehemma shosim et haggoranot uchtiv vayyishal david ba lemor haelech vehikketi bappelishtim haelle vayyomer Adonai el david lech vehikkita vappelishtim vehoshata et keila
May kamibbaya leh ilema i shere i asur hare bet dino shel shemuel haramati kayyam
Ella i matzlach i la matzlach dayeka name dichtiv lech vehikkita vappelishtim vehoshata et keila shema minah
Matni mi sheyyashav badderech veamad veraa hare ze hu samuch lair hoil velo hayeta kauonato lechach lo yikkanes divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda omer yikkanes amar rabbi yehuda maase haya venichnas rabbi tarfon belo mitkaven

Gema tanya amar rabbi yehuda maase berabbi tarfon shehaya mehallech badderech vechashcha lo velan chutz lair leshacharit metzauhu roe vakar amru lo rabbi hare hair lefanecha hikkanes nichnas veyashav bevet hammidrash vedarash kol hayyom kullo
Amru lo mishsham reaya shemma belibbo hayeta o bet hammidrash muvla betoch techumo haya
Matni mi sheyyashan badderech vela yada shechashecha yesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri
Vachachamim omrim en lo ella arba ammot rabbi eliezer omer vehu beemtzaan
Rabbi yehuda omer leeze ruach sheyyirtze yelech umode rabbi yehuda sheim berar lo sheeno yachol lachazor bo
Hau shenayim miktzat ammotav shel ze betoch ammotav shel ze meviin veochlin baemtza
b: Uvilvad shello yotzi ze mittoch shello letoch shel chavero
Hau shelosha vehaemtzai muvla benehen hu muttar immahen vehen muttarin immo ushnayim hachitzonim asurin ze im ze

Amar rabbi shimon lema haddavar dome leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo uftuchot lirshut harabbim ervu shettayim im haemtzait hi mutteret immahen vehem muttarot immah ushtayim hachitzonot asurot zo im zo
Gema bae rava may kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri misbar ka savar cheftze hefker konin shevita
Uvdin hu deliflog bechelim veha dekamipalgi beadam lehodiacha kochan derabbanan deaf al gav deika lememar hoil veneor kana yashen name kana ka mashma lan dela
O dilma kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri bealma cheftze hefker en konin shevita vehacha hayenu tama hoil veneor kana yashen name kana
Amar rav yosef ta shema geshamim sheyyardu meerev yom tov yesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach beom tov hare hen keragle kol adam
I amratte bishlama kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri cheftze hefker konin shevita ha manni rabbi yochanan hi
Ella i amratte cheftze hefker en konin shevita ha manni la rabbi yochanan velo rabbanan
Yetev abbaye vekaamar lah leha shemata amar leh rav safra leabbaye vedilma bigshamim hassemuchin lair askinan veanshe otah hair datam ilayehu
Amar leh la salka datach ditnan bor shel yachid keragle yachid veshel otah hair keragle otah hair veshel ole bavel keragle hammalle
Vetanya bor shel shevatim yesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach kashyan ahadade
Ella lav shema minah ha rabbi yochanan ben nuri ha rabbanan

Ki ata lekammeh derav yosef amar leh hachi kaamar rav safra vehachi ahdari leh amar leh veammay la tema leh miggufah i salka datach geshamim hassemuchin lair askinan hay yesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach
Ha keragle anshe otah hair mibaya leh
Amar mar beom tov hare hen keragle kol adam veammay likne shevita beokyanos
Lema dela kerabbi eliezer dei kerabbi eliezer ha amar kal haolam kullo mimme okyanos hu shote
Amar rabbi yitzchak hacha beavim shennitkashsheru meerev yom tov askinan
Vedilma hanach azli vehanach acharine ninhu deit lehu simana begavayehu
Veibaet ema have safek dedivrehem vesafek dedivrehem lehakel
Velikni shevita beavim tifshot minah deen techumin lemala measara dei yesh techumin likne shevita beavim
Leolam ema lach yesh techumin umayya beeva mivla belii

a: Kol shekken dehau lehu nolad daasiri
Ella mayya beavim menad nayedi hashta deatet lehachi okyanos name la liksho lach mayya beokyanos name menad nayedi vetanya neharot hammoshchin umayanot hannovin hare hen keragle kol adam

Amar rabbi yaakov bar ide amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi yaakov bar idi beferush shemia lach o mikkelala shemia lach amar leh beferush shemia li
May kelala deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha kedivre hammekel beeruv
Vetarte lema li
Amar rabbi zera tzerichi dei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri hava amena ben lekulla uven lechumra ka mashma lan halacha kedivre hammekel beeruv
Velema halacha kedivre hammekel beeruv halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri lema li
Itzterich salka datach amena hane mile yachid bimkom yachid verabbim bimkom rabbim aval yachid bimkom rabbim ema la
Amar leh rava leabbaye mikkede eruvin derabbanan ma li yachid bimkom yachid uma li yachid bimkom rabbim
Amar leh rav pappa lerava uvidrabbanan la shane lan ben yachid bimkom yachid leyachid bimkom rabbim
Vehatnan rabbi elazar omer kol ishsha sheavru aleha shalosh onot dayyah sheatah
Vetanya maase veasa rabbi kerabbi elazar leachar shennizkar amar keday hu rabbi elazar lismoch alav bishat haddechak
May leachar shennizkar ilema leachar shennizkar deen halacha kerabbi elazar ella kerabbanan bishat haddechak hechi aved keoteh
Ella dela itmar hilcheta la kerabbi elazar vela kerabbanan leachar shennizkar delav yachid pelig aleh ella rabbim peligi aleh amar keday hu rabbi elazar lismoch alav bishat haddechak
Amar rav mesharsheya lerava veamri lah rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava uvidrabbanan la shane ben yachid bimkom yachid ben yachid bimkom rabbim
Vehatanya shemua kerova noheget shiva ushloshim rechoka enah noheget ella yom echad
Vee zo hi kerova veezo hi rechoka betoch sheloshim kerova leachar sheloshim rechoka divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim achat shemua kerova veachat shemua rechoka noheget shiva ushloshim

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol makom sheatta motze yachid mekel verabbim mechamirin halacha kedivre hammachmirin hamrubbim chutz mizzo sheaf al pi sherabbi akiva mekel vachachamim mechamirin halacha kedivre rabbi akiva
Vesavar lah kishmuel deamar shemuel halacha kedivre hammekel beevel
Baavelut hu deakkilu bah rabbanan aval bealma afilu bidrabbanan shane ben yachid bimkom yachid ben yachid bimkom rabbim
b: Verav pappa amar itzterich salka datach amena hane mile beeruve chatzerot aval beeruve techumin ema la tzericha

Umna temra deshane lan ben eruve chatzerot leeruve techumin ditnan amar rabbi yehuda bamme devarim amurim beeruve techumin aval beeruve chatzerot mearvin ben ledaat uven shello ledaat shezzachin leadam shello befanav veen chavin leadam ella befanav
Rav ashe amar itzterich salka datach amena hane mile beshiyyure eruv aval bitchilat eruv ema la
Umna temra deshane lan ben shiyyure eruv litchilat eruv ditnan amar rabbi yose bamme devarim amurim bitchilat eruv aval beshiyyure eruv afilu kal shehu
Velo amru learev chatzerot ella kede shello leshakkeach torat eruv min hattinokot
Rabbi yaakov verabbi zerika amru halacha kerabbi akiva mechavero uchrabbi yose mechaverav uchrabbi mechavero
Lemay hilcheta rabbi assi amar halacha verabbi chiyya bar abba amar mattin verabbi yose berabbi chanina amar nirin

Kallashon hazze amar rabbi yaakov bar ide amar rabbi yochanan rabbi meir verabbi yehuda halacha kerabbi yehuda rabbi yehuda verabbi yose halacha kerabbi yose veen tzarich lomar rabbi meir verabbi yose halacha kerabbi yose hashta bimkom rabbi yehuda leta bimkom rabbi yose mibaya

Amar rav assi af ani lomed rabbi yose verabbi shimon halacha kerabbi yose deamar rabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon halacha kerabbi yehuda hashta bimkom rabbi yehuda leta bimkom rabbi yose mibaya
Ibaya lehu rabbi meir verabbi shimon may teku
Amar rav mesharsheya letanhu lehane kelale mena leh lerav mesharsheya ha

Ilema meha ditnan rabbi shimon omer lema haddavar dome leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo uftuchot lirshut harabbim ervu shettayim hachitzonot im haemtzait hi mutteret immahen vehen muttarot immah ushtayim hachitzonot asurot zo im zo
Veamar rav chama bar gurya amar rav halacha kerabbi shimon uman pelig aleh rabbi yehuda veha amratte rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon halacha kerabbi yehuda ella lav shema minah letanhu
Umay kushya dilma hecha deitmar itmar hecha dela itmar la itmar

Ella meha ditnan ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim mearvin et kullah shel rabbim venaaset shel yachid en mearvin et kullah ella im ken ose chutza lah kair chadasha shebbihuda sheyyesh bah chamishshim daorin divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi shimon omer

a: Shalosh chatzerot shel shene vattim veamar rav chama bar gurya amar rav halacha kerabbi shimon uman pelig aleh rabbi yehuda veha amratte rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon halacha kerabbi yehuda
Vmay kushya dilma hacha name hecha deitmar itmar hecha dela itmar la itmar
Ella meha ditnan hammanniach et beto vehalach lishbot beir acheret echad nachri veechad yisrael oser livne chatzerot divre rabbi meir

Rabbi yehuda omer eno oser rabbi yose omer nachri oser yisrael eno oser mippene sheen derech yisrael lavo bashshabbat rabbi shimon omer afilu hinniach et beto vehalach lishbot etzel bitto beotah hair eno oser shekkevar hissiach dato
Veamar rav chama bar gurya amar rav halacha kerabbi shimon uman pelig aleh rabbi yehuda veha amratte rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon halacha kerabbi yehuda
Umay kushya dilma hacha name hecha deitmar itmar hecha dela itmar la itmar
Ella meha ditnan vezehu sheamru heani mearev beraglav rabbi meir omer anu en lanu ella ani
Rabbi yehuda omer echad ani veechad ashir lo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel al heashir shello yetze viarev beraglav
Umatne leh rav chiyya bar ashe lechiyya bar rav kammeh derav echad ani veechad ashir vaamar leh rav sayyem bah name halacha kerabbi yehuda
Tarte lema li veha amratte rabbi meir verabbi yehuda halacha kerabbi yehuda
Umay kushya dilma rav let leh lehane kelale
Ella meha ditnan hayevama lo tachalotz velo tityabem ad sheyehu lah shelosha chodashim
Vechen shear kol hannashim lo yinnasu velo yitarsu ad sheyehu lahen shelosha chodashim echad betulot veechad beulot echad almanot veechad gerushot echad arusot veechad nesuot
Rabbi yehuda omer nesuot yitarsu
Vaarusot yinnasu chutz mearusa shebbihuda mippene shellibbo gas bah
Rabbi yose omer kol hannashim yitarsu chutz min haalmana mippene haibul
Veamrinan rabbi eliezer la al leve midresha ashkecheh lerabbi assi dahava kaem amar leh may amur beve midresha amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yose mikkelal dichidaa pelig aleh

In vehatanya hare shehayeta redufa lelech levet aviha o shehayeta lah kaas im balah o shehaya balah zaken o chole o shehayeta hi chola akara zekena ketanna veayelonit vesheenah reuya leled o shehaya balah chavush bevet haasurin hammappelet leachar mitat balah kullan tzerichin lehamtin shelosha chodashim divre rabbi meir rabbi yose mattir leares velinase miyyad
Lema li veha amratte rabbi meir verabbi yose halacha kerabbi yose
Umay kushya dilma leappoke midderav nachman amar shemuel deamar halacha kerabbi meir bigzerotav
Ella meha detanya holchin leyarid shel nochrim velokchim mehen behema vaavadim ushfachot battim sadot uchramim vechotev umaale bearkaot shellahen mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadan
Veim haya kohen mittamme bechutza laaretz ladun ularer immahen uchshem shemmittamme bechutza laaretz kach mittamme bevet hakkevarot
Bet hakkevarot salka datach tuma deorayeta hi
Ella bevet happeras derabbanan
Umittamme lisa ishsha velilmod tora amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman sheen motze lilmod aval motze lilmod lo yittamma
Rabbi yose omer af bizman shemmotze lilmod name yittamma lefi
b: Sheen min hakkol zoche adam lilmod veamar rabbi yose maase beosef hakkohen shehalach etzel rabbo letzayeddan lilmod tora
Veamar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yose ulma li veha amratte rabbi yehuda verabbi yose halacha kerabbi yose
Amar abbaye itzterich salka datach amena hane mile bematnitin aval bevarayeta ema la ka mashma lan
Ella hachi kaamar hane kelale lav divre hakkol ninhu deha rav let leh hane kelale
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel cheftze nachri en konin shevita
Leman ilema lerabbanan peshita hashta cheftze hefker delet lehu bealim en konin shevita cheftze hannochri deit lehu bealim mibaya
Ella alliba derabbi yochanan ben nuri veka mashma lan emar deamar rabbi yochanan ben nuri konin shevita hane mile cheftze hefker delet lehu bealim aval cheftze hannochri deit lehu bealim la

Metivi rabbi shimon ben elazar omer hashshoel keli min hannochri beom tov vechen hammashil lo lannochri keli meerev yom tov vehechziro lo beom tov vehakkelim vehaotzarot sheshshavtu betoch hattechum yesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach venochri shehevi lo perot michutz lattechum hare ze lo yezizem mimmekoman
I amratte bishlama kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri cheftze nochri konin shevita ha manni rabbi yochanan ben nuri hi
Ella i amratte kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri cheftze hannochri en konin shevita ha manni la rabbi yochanan ben nuri vela rabbanan
Leolam kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri cheftze hannochri konin shevita ushmuel deamar kerabbanan udkaamratte lerabbanan peshita mahu detema gezera bealim denochri attu bealim deyisrael ka mashma lan
Verav chiyya bar avin amar rabbi yochanan cheftze nochri konin shevita gezera bealim denochri attu bealim deyisrael
Hanhu dichre daato limvarachta shera lehu rava livne machoza lemizban minayehu
Amar leh ravina lerava may datach deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel cheftze nochri en konin shevita
Veha shemuel verabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yochanan veamar rav chiyya bar avin amar rabbi yochanan cheftze nochri konin shevita gezera bealim denochri attu bealim deyisrael
Hadar amar rava lizdabbenu livne mevarachta dechullah mevarachta ledidhu kearba ammot damya
Tane rabbi chiyya cherem shebben techume shabbat tzarich

a: Mechitza shel barzel lehafsiko mechayyech aleh rabbi yose berabbi chanina
May tama ka mechayyech ilema mishshum detane lah kerabbi yochanan ben nuri lechumra veihu sevira leh kerabbanan lekulla vmishshum desavar lekulla man detane lechumra mechayyech aleh
Ella mishshum detanya neharot hammoshchin umayanot hannovin hare hen keragle kol adam
Vedilma bimchunnasin
Ella mishshum dekatane tzarich mechitza shel barzel lehafsiko umay shena kanim dela deayeli behu mayya shel barzel name ayeli behu mayya
Vedilma tzarich veen lo takkana kaamar
Mishshum dekal hu shehekelu chachamim bemayim
Kidrabbi tavla diva mineh rabbi tavla merav mechitza teluya mahu shettattir bechurba
Amar leh en mechitza teluya matteret ella bemayim kal hu shehekelu chachamim bemayim
Vachachamim omrim en lo ella arba vechu rabbi yehuda hayenu tanna kamma
Amar rava shemone al shemone ika benayehu tanya name hachi yesh lo shemone al shemone divre rabbi meir
Veamar rava machaloket lehallech aval letaltel divre hakkol arba ammot in tefe la
Vehane arba ammot hecha ketiva

Kidtanya shevu ish tachtav ketachtav vechamma tachtav gufo shalosh ammot veamma kede lifshot yadav veraglav divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer gufo shalosh ammot veamma kede sheyyittol chefetz mittachat margelotav umanniach tachat meraashotav
May benayehu ika benayehu arba ammot metzumtzamot
Amar leh rav mesharsheya livreh ki ayelatte lekammeh derav pappa bei mineh arba ammot sheamru beamma dideh yahavinan leh o beamma shel kodesh yahavinan leh
Im amar lach ammot shel kodesh yahavinan leh og melech habbashan ma tehe alav veim amar lach beamma dideh yahavinan leh ema leh may tama la katane lah gabbe yesh sheamru hakkol lefi ma shehu adam
Ki ata lekammeh derav pappa amar leh i dayekinan kulle hay la have tanenan
Leolam beamma dideh yahavinan leh udka kashya lach may tama la katane gabbe yesh sheamru dela pesika leh mishshum deika nannas beevarav
Hau shenayim miktzat ammotav shel ze vechu lema leh lememar lema haddavar dome
Hachi kaamar lehu rabbi shimon lerabbanan mikkedi lema haddavar dome leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo uftuchot lirshut harabbim may shena hatam difligitu umay shena hacha dela peligitu
Verabbanan hatam aveshi daorin hacha la aveshi daorin
Ushtayim hachitzonot ku veammay kevan dearvi lehu chitzonot bahade emtzait haveya lehu chada
Amar rav yehuda kegon shennatna emtzait eruvah bazo veeruvah bazo
Verav sheshet amar afilu tema shennatnu eruvan baemtzait kegon shennetanuhu
b: Bishne vattim
Keman kevet shammay detanya chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan untanuhu bishne chelim bet shammay omrim en eruvan eruv uvet hillel omrim eruvan eruv
Afilu tema bet hillel ad kan la kaamri bet hillel hatam ella bishne chelim bevayit echad aval bishne vattim la

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe lerav yehuda kashya ulrav sheshet kashya lerav yehuda kashya deamar kegon shennatna emtzait eruvah bazo veeruvah bazo vechevan deerva emtzait bahade chitzona haveya leh chada vechi hadra vearva bahade idach shelichutah avda
Ulrav sheshet kashya tehve kachamishsha sheshsheruyin bechatzer achat veshachach echad mehen velo erav deasri ahadade

Amar leh rav ashe la lerav yehuda kashya vela lerav sheshet kashya lerav yehuda la kashya kevan deerva lah emtzait bahade chitzona ushtayim chitzonot bahade hadade la ervu galleya dateh divha nicha leh uvha la nicha leh
Ulrav sheshet la kashya im amru daorin lehakel yomru daorin lehachmir
Amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi shimon aval chachamim omrim reshut achat meshammeshet lishte reshuot aval la shette reshuot meshammeshot lirshut achat
Ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li

a: Af zo divre rabbi shimon aval chachamim omrim shelashtan asurot

Tanya keoteh derav yehuda alliba dishmuel amar rabbi shimon lema haddavar dome leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo uftuchot lirshut harabbim ervu shettayim im haemtzait zo mevia mittoch betah veochelet vezo mevia mittoch betah veochelet zo machzeret motarah letoch betah vezo machzeret motarah letoch betah
Aval chachamim omrim shelashtan asurot
Veazda shemuel letameh deamar shemuel chatzer shebben shene mevoot erva im shenehem asura im shenehem
Lo erva im shenehem oseret al shenehen
Hayeta beechad regila uvechad enah regila ze shergila bo asur veze sheenah regila bo muttar
Amar rabba bar rav huna erva im sheenah regila bo huttar regila leatzmo
Veamar rabba bar rav huna amar shemuel im erva regila leatzmo veze sheenah regila bo lo erav vehi atzmah lo erva dochin otah etzel sheenah regila bo
Uchgon ze kofin al middat sedom
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hammakpid al eruvo en eruvo eruv ma shemo eruv shemo
Rabbi chanina amar eruvo eruv ella shennikra meanshe vardina
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hacholek et eruvo eno eruv
Keman kevet shammay detanya chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan untanuhu bishne chelim bet shammay omrim en ze eruv uvet hillel omrim hare ze eruv
Afilu tema bet hillel ad kan la kaamri bet hillel hatam ella demalyan lemana veiyyatar aval hecha defalgeh miflag la
Vetarte lema li tzerichi dei ashmeinan hatam mishshum dekafed aval hacha ema la
Vei ashmeinan hacha mishshum defalgeh miflag aval hatam ema la tzericha
