Amar leh rabbi abba lerav yehuda beve matzarta deve rav zakkay mi amar shemuel hacholek et eruvo eno eruv vehaamar shemuel bayit shemmannichin bo eruv eno tzarich liten et happat may tama lav mishshum deamar dechevan demannach besalla keman demannach hacha dame hachi name kevan demannach besalla keman demannach hacha dame
Amar leh hatam af al pi sheen pat may tama dechullehu hacha dayeri
Amar shemuel eruv mishshum kinyan
Veim tomar mippene ma en konin bemaa mippene sheenah metzuya bearve shabbatot
Hecha deerav mihu likne
Gezera shemma yomru maa ikar vezimnin dela shechiach maa vela ate leiarove befat deate eruv leikalkole
Rabba amar eruv mishshum dira
May benayehu ika benayehu keli
Ufachot mishshave peruta
b: Vekatan

Amar leh abbaye lerabba ledidach kashya velishmuel kashya ha tanya chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan keshehem molichin et eruvan lemakom acher echad molich lechullan hu nihu deka kane vetu la hu nihu deka dayar vetu la
Amar leh la ledidi kashya vela lishmuel kashya shelichut dechullehu ka aved
Amar rabba amar rav chama bar gurya amar rav halacha kerabbi shimon
Matni mi shebba bederech vechashcha lo vehaya makkir ilan o gader veamar shevitati tachtav lo amar kelum
Shevitati beikaro mehallech mimmekom raglav vead ikaro alpayim amma umeikaro vead beto alpayim amma nimtza mehallech mishshechashecha arbaat alafim amma
Im eno makkir o sheeno baki bahalacha veamar shevitati bimkomi zacha lo mekomo alpayim amma lechol ruach
Agullot divre rabbi chanina ben antignos vachachamim omrim merubbaot ketavla merubbaat kede sheyyihye niskar lazzaviyyot
Vezo hi sheamru heani mearev beraglav amar rabbi meir anu en lanu ella ani rabbi yehuda omer echad ani veechad ashir lo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel al heashir shello yetze viarev beraglav
Gema may lo amar kelum
Amar rav lo amar kelum kol ikar daafilu letachtav shel ilan la matze azel
Ushmuel amar lo amar kelum leveto aval letachtav shel ilan matze azel
Venaase tachtav shel ilan chammar gammal
Ba limdod min hatztzafon moddin lo min haddarom ba limdod min haddarom moddin lo min hatztzafon

a: Amar rabba may tama derav mishshum dela mesayyam atreh
Veika deamri amar rabba may tama derav mishshum dekasavar kol sheeno beze achar ze afilu bevat achat eno
May benayehu ika benayehu deamar likno li bearba ammot miggo shemone
Man deamar mishshum dela mesayyam atreh ha la mesayyam atreh
Uman deamar mishshum kol sheeno beze achar ze afilu bevat achat eno hay kearba ammot dame dehacha arba ammot kaamar
Gufa amar rabba kol davar sheeno beze achar ze afilu bevat achat eno etiveh abbaye lerabba hammarbe bemaasrot perotav metukkanin umaserotav mekulkalin
Ammay lema kol sheeno beze achar ze afilu bevat achat eno
Shane maaser deiteh lachatzain dei amar tikdosh palga palga dechitta kadsha
Masar behema deleteh lachatzain
Veamar rabba yatzu shenayim baasiri ukraan asiri asiri veachad asar meoravin ze baze
Shane masar behema deiteh beze achar ze betaut
Ditnan kara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri shelashtan mekuddashin

Vahare toda deletah betaut veletah beze achar ze veitmar toda shennishchata al shemonim challot chizkiyya amar kadshu alah arbaim mittoch shemonim rabbi yochanan amar lo kadshu alah arbaim mittoch shemonim
Ha itmar alah amar rabbi zera hakkol modim hecha deamar likdeshu arbaim mittoch shemonim dekadshi lo yikdeshu arbaim ella im ken kadshu shemonim kulle alma la peligi delo kadshu
Ki peligi bistama mar savar leachraut ka mechaven veal tenay ayetinhu
b: Umar savar lekorban gadol ka mechaven
Amar abbaye lo shanu ella beilan shettachtav shettem esre amma aval beilan sheen shettem esre amma hare miktzat beto nikar
Matkef lah rav huna bereh derav yehoshua mimmay divarbei metziata ka mesayyam dilma bearbei dehay gisa uvarbei dehay gisa kamsayyam
Ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lo shanu ella beilan shettachtav shemone ammot aval beilan shettachtav sheva ammot hare miktzat beto nikar
Tanya keoteh derav tanya keoteh dishmuel

Tanya keoteh derav mi shebba badderech vechashcha lo vehaya makkir ilan o gader veamar shevitati tachtav lo amar kelum aval im amar shevitati bemakom peloni mehallech ad shemmaggia leoto makom higgia leoto makom mehallech et kullo vechutza lo alpayim amma
Bamme devarim amurim bemakom hamsuyyam kegon sheshshavat betel shehu gavoha asara tefachim vehu mearba ammot vead bet satayim
Vechen bika shehi amukka asara vehi mearba ammot vead bet satayim aval bemakom sheen mesuyyam en lo ella arba ammot
Hau shenayim echad makkir veechad sheeno makkir ze sheeno makkir moser shevitato lammakkir vehammakkir omer shevitati bemakom peloni
Bamme devarim amurim keshessiyyem arba ammot shekkava aval lo siyyem arba ammot shekkava lo yazuz mimmekomo
Lema tehve teuvteh dishmuel amar lach shemuel hacha bemay askinan kegon deika mimmekom raglav vead ikaro tere alfe vearba garmide dei mokmet leh beidach gisa deilan kam leh levar mittechuma
I sayyem arba ammot matze azel vei la la matze azel

Tanya keoteh dishmuel taa veerav lishte ruchot kimdumme hu shemmearvin lo lishte ruchot o sheamar laavadav tzeu vearvu li echad erav alav latztzafon veechad erav alav laddarom mehallech latztzafon keeruvo laddarom veladdarom keeruvo latztzafon
Veim mitzu alav et hattechum lo yazuz mimmekomo
Lema tehve teuvteh derav rav tanna hu ufaleg
Amar shevitati beikaro mehallech mimmekom raglav vead ikaro alpayim amma umeikaro leveto alpayim amma nimtza mehallech mishshechashecha arbaat alafim amma

a: Amar rava vehu dechi rahet leikaro mate amar leh abbaye veha chashcha lo katane
Chashcha leveto aval leikaro shel ilan matze azel ika deamri amar rava chashcha lo ki mesagge kalli kalli aval rahet mate
Rabba verav yosef hao ka azli beorcha amar leh rabba lerav yosef tehe shevitatenu tute dikla desavel achuh veamri lah tute dikla defarek mareh mikkeraga

Yada leh mar amar leh la yadana leh amar leh semoch alay detanya rabbi yose omer im hau shenayim echad makkir veechad sheeno makkir ze sheeno makkir moser shevitato lammakkir ze shemmakkir omer tehe shevitatenu bemakom peloni
Vela hi la tena leh kerabbi yose ella ki hechi delikabbel lah mineh mishshum derabbi yose nimuko immo
Im eno makkir o sheeno baki vechu
Hane alpayim amma hechan ketivan detanya shevu ish tachtav ellu arba ammot al yetze ish mimmekomo ellu alpayim amma

Mena lan amar rav chisda lamadnu makom mimmakom umakom minnisa venisa minnisa venisa miggevul ugvul miggevul ugvul michutz vechutz michutz dichtiv umaddotem michutz lair et peat kedma alpayim baamma vego
Venelaf mikkir hair vachutza elef amma danin chutz michutz veen danin chutz mechutza
Umay nafka minah ha tana deve rabbi yishmael veshav hakkohen uva hakkohen zo hi shiva zo hi bia
Hane mile hecha deleka mide dedame leh aval hecha deika mide dedame leh middame leh yalfinan
Alpayim amma agullot verabbi chanina ben antignos ma nafshach i it leh gezera shava peot ketivan i let leh gezera shava alpayim amma mena leh
Leolam it leh gezera shava veshane hacha deamar kera ze yihye lahem migreshe hearim laze atta noten peot vei atta noten peot leshovte shabbat
Verabbanan tane rav chananya omer kaze yehu kol shovte shabbat
Amar rabbi acha bar yaakov hammaavir arba ammot birshut harabbim eno chayyav ad shemmaavir hen vaalachsonan

Amar rav pappa badek lan rava ammud birshut harabbim gavoha asara verochav arbaa tzarich hen vaalachsonan o la veamrinan leh lav hayenu derav chananya detanya rav chananya omer kaze yehu kol shovte shabbat
Veze hu sheamru heani mearev beraglav amar rabbi meir anu en lanu ella ani vechu
Amar rav nachman machaloket bimkomi derabbi meir savar ikar eruv befat
b: Ani hu deakkilu rabbanan ilaveh aval ashir la
Verabbi yehuda savar ikar eruv baregel echad ani veechad ashir aval bemakom peloni divre hakkol ane in ashir la
Vezo hi sheamru man katane lah rabbi meir veaheya kae aeno makkir o sheeno baki bahalacha velo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel man katane lah rabbi yehuda
Verav chisda amar machaloket bemakom peloni derabbi meir savar ani in ashir la verabbi yehuda savar echad ani veechad ashir aval bimkomi divre hakkol echad ani veechad ashir deikar eruv baregel
Vezo hi sheamru man katane lah rabbi meir veaheya kae aha mi shebba badderech vechashecha velo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel man katane lah divre hakkol

Tanya keoteh derav nachman echad ani veechad ashir mearvin befat velo yetze ashir chutz lattechum veyomar shevitati bimkomi lefi shello amru mearvin baregel ella lemi shebba badderech vechashecha divre rabbi meir

Rabbi yehuda omer echad ani veechad ashir mearvin baregel veyetze ashir chutz lattechum veyomar tehe shevitati bimkomi veze hu ikaro shel eruv vehittiru chachamim levaal habbayit leshalleach eruvo beyad avdo beyad beno beyad shelucho bishvil lehakel alav

Amar rabbi yehuda maase beanshe bet memel uvanshe bet guron bearoma shehau mechallekin gerogrot vetzimukin laaniyyim bishne vatztzoret uvain aniyye kefar shichin vaaniyye kefar chananya umachshichin al hattechum lammochorat mashkimin uvain
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane mi sheyyatza lelech leir shemmearvin lah vehechziro chavero hu muttar lelech vechol bene hair asurin divre rabbi yehuda
Vahavenan bah may shena ihu umay shena inhu veamar rav huna hacha bemay askinan kegon sheyyesh lo shene vattim ushne techume shabbat benehen
Ihu kevan denafka leh leorcha hava leh ani
Vehanach ashirim ninhu alma kal bemakom peloni ani in ashir la shema minah
Matne leh rav chiyya bar ashe lechiyya bar rav kammeh derav echad ani veechad ashir amar leh rav sayyem bah name halacha kerabbi yehuda
Rabba bar rav chanan hava regil deate meartivna lefumbedita

a: Amar tehe shevitati betzinta amar leh abbaye may datach rabbi meir verabbi yehuda halacha kerabbi yehuda veamar rav chisda machaloket bemakom peloni
Veha rav nachman vetanya keoteh amar leh hadari bi
Amar rame bar chama hare amru shavat yesh lo arba ammot hannoten et eruvo yesh lo arba ammot o la
Amar rava ta shema lo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel al heashir shello yetze viarev beraglav vei amratte en lo hay lehakel lehachamir hu
Afilu hachi nicha leh ki hechi dela nitrach venipok
Matni mi sheyyatza lelech beir shemmearvin bah vehechziro chavero hu muttar lelech vechol bene hair asurin divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi meir omer kol shehu yachol learev velo erav hare ze chammar gammal
Gema may shena ihu umay shena inhu amar rav huna hacha bemay askinan kegon sheyyesh lo shene vattim uvenehen shene techume shabbat
Ihu kevan dinfak leh leorcha have leh ani vehane ashire ninhu
Tanya name hachi mi sheyyesh lo shene vattim uvenehen shene techume shabbat kevan shehechzik badderech kana eruv divre rabbi yehuda
Yater al ken amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda afilu metzao chavero veamar lo lin po et chamma hu et tzina hu lemachar mashkim veholech
Amar rabba lomar kulle alma la peligi ditzrich ki peligi lehachzik
Verav yosef amar lehachzik dechulle alma la peligi ditzrich ki peligi lomar
Keman azla ha deamar ulla mi shehechzik badderech vehechziro chavero hare hu muchzar umuchzak
I muchzar lamma muchzak vei muchzak lamma muchzar
Hachi kaamar af al pi shemmuchzar muchzak keman kerav yosef vealliba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda
Rav yehuda bar ishtata ayeti leh kalkalla defere lerav natan bar oshaya ki hava azel shavkeh ad dinchet darga amar leh bit hacha limchar kaddem veezil
b: Keman kerav yosef vealliba derabbi yose bar yehuda
La kerabba vealliba derabbi yehuda
Rabbi meir omer kol sheyyachol learev ku ha tenena chada zimna safek rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim hare ze chammar gammal
Amar rav sheshet la tema tama derabbi meir safek erav safek lo erav hu dehave chammar gammal aval vadday lo erav la have chammar gammal
Ella afilu vadday lo erav have chammar gammal deha hacha vadday lo erav veka have chammar gammal
Matni mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum afilu amma achat lo yikkanes rabbi eliezer omer shettayim yikkanes shalosh lo yikkanes
Gema amar rabbi chanina raglo achat betoch hattechum veraglo achat chutz lattechum lo yikkanes dichtiv im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha raglecha ketiv
Vehatanya raglo achat betoch hattechum veraglo achat chutz lattechum yikkanes ha manni acherim hi detanya acherim omrim limkom sherubbo hu nizkar
Ika deamri amar rabbi chanina raglo achat betoch hattechum veraglo achat chutz lattechum yikkanes dichtiv im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha raglecha karenan
Vehattanya lo yikkanes hu deamar kaacherim detanya limkom sherubbo hu nizkar
Rabbi eliezer omer shettayim yikkanes shalosh lo yikkanes vehatanya rabbi eliezer omer achat yikkanes shettayim lo yikkanes la kashya ha daakar chada vekam attarte ha daakar tarte vekam attelat
Vehatanya rabbi eliezer omer afilu amma achat lo yikkanes ki tanya hahi lemoded ditnan velammoded sheamru notnin lo alpayim amma afilu sof middato kale bimara
Matni mi shehecheshich chutz lattechum afilu amma achat lo yikkanes rabbi shimon omer afilu chamesh esre ammot yikkanes sheen hammashochot mematztzin et hammiddot mippene hattoin
Gema tana mippene toe hammidda
Hadran alach mi shehotziuhu
Matni ketzad meabberin et hearim bayit nichnas bayit yotze piggum nichnas piggum yotze hau sham gedudiyyot gevohot asara tefachim

a: Ugsharim unfashot sheyyesh bahen bet dira motziin et hammidda kenegdan veosin otah kemin tavla merubbaat kede sheyehe niskar et hazzaviyyot
Gema rav ushmuel chad tane meabberin vechad tane meabberin
Man detane meabberin ever ever uman detane meabberin keishsha ubbarah
Mearat hammachpela rav ushmuel chad amar shene vattim ze lifnim mizze vechad amar bayit vaaliyya al gabbav
Bishlama leman deamar ze al gav ze hayenu machpela ella leman deamar shene vattim ze lifnim mizze may machpela
Shekkefula bezugot mamre kiryat arba amar rabbi yitzchak kiryat haarba zugot adam vechava avraham vesara yitzchak verivka yaakov velea

Vayehi bime amrafel rav ushmuel chad amar nimrod shemo velamma nikra shemo amrafel sheamar vehippil leavraham avinu betoch kivshan haesh vechad amar amrafel shemo velamma nikra shemo nimrod shehimrid et kal haolam kullo alav bemalchuto
Vayyakom melech chadash al mitzrayim rav ushmuel chad amar chadash mammash vechad amar shennitchaddeshu gezerotav
Man deamar chadash mammash dichtiv chadash uman deamar shennitchaddeshu gezerotav middela ketiv vayyamot vayyimloch
Ulman deamar shennitchaddeshu gezerotav ha chetiv asher lo yada et yosef may asher lo yada et yosef dahava dame keman dela yada leh leosef kelal
Siman shemone esre ushnem asar lamadnu bedavid vayyiven
Amar rabbi yochanan shemona asar yamim gidalti etzel rabbi oshaya beribi velo lamadti mimmennu ella davar echad bemishnatenu ketzad meabberin et hearim bealef
Ini vehaamar rabbi yochanan shenem asar talmidim hau lo lerabbi oshaya beribi ushmona asar yamim gidalti benehen velamadti lev kol echad veechad vechochmat kol echad veechad
Lev kol echad veechad vechochmat kol echad veechad gemar gemara la gemar ibaet ema minnayehu didhu gemar mineh dideh la gemar veibaet ema davar echad bemishnatenu kaamar

Veamar rabbi yochanan keshehayinu lomdin tora etzel rabbi oshaya hayinu yoshvin arbaa arbaa beamma amar rabbi keshehayinu lomdin tora etzel rabbi elazar ben shammua hayinu yoshvin shishsha shishsha beamma
Amar rabbi yochanan rabbi oshaya beribi bedoro kerabbi meir bedoro ma rabbi meir bedoro lo yachlu chaverav laamod al sof dato af rabbi oshaya lo yachlu chaverav laamod al sof dato
Amar rabbi yochanan libban shel rishonim kefitcho shel ulam veshel acharonim kefitcho shel hechal veanu kimlo nekev machat sidkit
Rishonim rabbi akiva acharonim rabbi elazar ben shammua ika deamri rishonim rabbi elazar ben shammua acharonim rabbi oshaya beribi veanu kimlo nekev machat sidkit
Amar abbaye vaanan ki sikta begudda ligmara amar rava vaanan ki etzbata bekira lisvara amar rav ashe anan ki etzbata bevera leshichcha
Amar rav yehuda amar rav bene yehuda shehikpidu al leshonam nitkayema toratam beyadam bene galil shello hikpidu al leshonam lo nitkayema toratam beyadam
Mide bikfeda talya milta ella bene yehuda dedayeki lishana umatnechi lehu simana nitkayema toratan beyadan bene galil dela dayeki lishana vela matnechi lehu simana lo nitkayema toratan beyadam
Bene yehuda gemaru mechad rabba nitkayema toratan beyadam bene galil dela gamri mechad rabba lo nitkayema toratan beyadam
Ravina amar bene yehuda degallo massechta nitkayema toratan beyadam bene galil dela gallo massechta lo nitkayema toratan beyadam
David galli massechta shaul la galli massechta david degalli massechta ketiv beh yereecha yiruni veyismachu shaul dela galli massechta ketiv beh el kol asher yifne
b: Yarshia
Veamar rabbi yochanan minnayin shemmachal lo hakkadosh baruch hu al oto aon shenneemar machar atta uvanecha immi immi bimchitzati
Amar rabbi abba i ika dimshael lehu livne yehuda dedayeki lishshane meabberin tenan o meabberin tenan akkuzo tenan o akkuzo tenan yadi
Sheelinhu veamri leh ika detane meabberin veika detane meabberin ika detane akkuzo veika detane akkuzo
Bene yehuda dayeki lishana may hi dehahu bar yehuda daamar lehu tallit yesh li limkor amaru leh may goon tallitcha amar lehu kitradin ale adama

Bene galil dela dayeki lishana may hi detanya dehahu bar galila dahava kaazel vaamar lehu amar leman amar leman amaru leh galilaa shote chamar lemirkav o chamar lemishte amar lemilbash o imar leitkassaa
Hahi itta devaaya lememar lachavertah tai deochlich chalava amara lah sheluchati tochlicha lavi
Hahi itteta deatya lekammeh dedayyana amara leh mari kiri tafla havat li veganvuch min vechaddu haot dechad shadru lach ilavah la mate karach aara
Amhata deve rabbi ki hava mishtaya bilshon chochma amra hachi elet nekafat bechad yidon nishrayya lekinehon
Vechad hava bae delitvun hava amra lehu yide batar chavertah minah vetitkefe elet bechad keilfa deazla beyamma
Rabbi yose bar asyan ki hava mishtae bilshon chochma amar asu li shor bemishpat betur misken
Vechad hava shael beushpiza amar hachi gevar pum den chay ma zo tova yesh
Rabbi avahu ki hava mishtae bilshon chochma hava amar hachi atrigu lefechamin arkiu lizhavin vaasu li shene maggide baalata ika deamri veyaasu li bahen shene maggide baalata
Amaru leh rabbanan lerabbi avahu hatzpinenu hechan rabbi ilay tzafun amar lahen alatz benaara aharonit acharonit eranit vehinirattu
Amri lah ishsha
Veamri lah massechta
Amri leh lerabbi ilay hatzpinenu hechan rabbi avahu tzafun amar lahen nityaetz bammachtir vehingiv limfivoshet

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben chananya miyyamay lo nitztzechani adam chutz meishsha tinok vetinoket ishsha may hi paam achat nitarachti etzel achsanya achat asta li polin beom rishon achaltim velo shiyyarti mehen kelum sheniyya velo shiyyarti mehen kelum beom shelishi hikdichatan bemelach kevan shettaamti mashachti yaday mehen
Amra li rabbi mippene ma encha soed amarti lah kevar saadti mibbeod yom amra li haya lecha limshoch yadecha min happat
Amra li rabbi shemma lo hinnachta pea barishonim velo kach amru chachamim en meshayerin pea bailpas aval meshayerin pea bakkeara

Tinoket may hi paam achat hayiti mehallech badderech vehayeta derech overet bassade vehayiti mehallech bah amra li tinoket achat rabbi lo sade hi zo amarti lah lo derech kevusha hi amra li listim kemotcha kevashuha

Tinok may hi paam achat hayiti mehallech badderech veraiti tinok yoshev al parashat derachim veamarti lo beeze derech nelech lair amar li zo ketzara vaarukka vezo arukka uktzara vehalachti biktzara vaarukka kevan shehiggati lair matzati shemmakkifin otah gannot ufardesin

Chazarti laachoray amarti lo beni halo amarta li ketzara amar li velo amarti lecha arukka neshaktiv al rosho veamarti lo ashrechem yisrael shekkullechem chachamim gedolim attem miggedolchem vead ketannechem
Rabbi yose haggelili hava ka azel beorcha ashkechah livrurya amar lah beezo derech nelech lelod amara leh galili shote lo kach amru chachamim al tarbe sicha im haishsha haya lecha lomar beeze lelod
Berurya ashkachteh lehahu talmida dahava ka gares bilchisha

a: Betasha beh amara leh lo kach katuv arucha vakkol ushmura im arucha birmach evarim shellecha mishtammeret veim lav enah mishtammeret tana talmid echad haya lerabbi eliezer shehaya shone belachash leachar shalosh shanim shachach talmudo
Tana talmid echad haya lo lerabbi eliezer shennitchayyev bisrefa lammakom amru hannichu lo adam gadol shimmesh

Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana petach pummach keri petach pummach teni ki hechi detitkayyam bach vetorich chayye shenneemar ki chayyim hem lemotzehem ulchol besaro marpe al tikre lemotzehem ella lemotziehem bappe
Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana chatof veechol chatof veishti dealma deazlinan mineh kehillula dame

Amar leh rav lerav hamnuna beni im yesh lach hetev lach sheen bashsheol taanug veen lammavet hitmahmeha veim tomar anniach levanay chok bashsheol mi yaggid lach bene haadam domim leisve hassade hallalu notztzin vehallalu novlin
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hamhallech badderech veen immo levaya yaasok battora shenneemar ki liveyat chen hem

Chash berosho yaasok betora shenneemar ki liveyat chen hem leroshecha chash bigrono yaasok battora shenneemar vaanakim legargerotecha chash bemeav yaasok battora shenneemar rifut tehi lesharrecha chash beatzmotav yaasok battora shenneemar veshikkuy leatzmotecha chash bechol gufo yaasok battora shenneemar ulchol besaro marpe

Amar rav yehuda berabbi chiyya bo ure shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam middat basar vadam adam noten sam lachavero laze yafe velaze kashe aval hakkadosh baruch hu eno ken natan tora leyisrael sam chayyim lechol gufo shenneemar ulchol besaro marpe

Amar rav amme may dichtiv ki naim ki tishmerem bevitnecha yikkonu yachdav al sefatecha ematay divre tora neimim bizman shettishmerem bevitnecha veematay tishmerem bevitnecha bizman sheyyikkonu yachdav al sefatecha
Rabbi zera amar mehacha simcha laish bemaane fiv vedavar beitto ma tov ematay simcha laish bizman shemmaane befiv lashon acher ematay simcha laish bemaane fiv bizman sheddavar beitto ma tov
Rabbi yitzchak amar mehacha ki karov elecha haddavar meod beficha uvilvavcha laasoto ematay karov elecha bizman shebbeficha uvilvavcha laasoto
Rava amar mehacha taavat libbo natatta lo vaareshet sefatav bal manata sela ematay taavat libbo natatta lo bizman sheareshet sefatav bal manata sela
Rava rame ketiv taavat libbo natatta lo uchtiv vaareshet sefatav bal manata sela zacha taavat libbo natatta lo lo zacha vaareshet sefatav bal manata sela
Tana deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov kol makom shenneemar netzach sela vaed en lo hefsek olamit netzach dichtiv ki lo leolam ariv velo lanetzach ekketzof
Sela dichtiv kaasher shamanu ken rainu beir Adonai tzevaot beir elohenu elohim yechonneha ad olam sela vaed dichtiv Adonai yimloch leolam vaed

Siman anakim lechayav luchot charut amar rabbi eliezer may dichtiv vaanakim legargerotecha im mesim adam atzmo kaanak ze sheraf al hatztzavar venire veeno nire talmudo mitkayyem beyado veim lav en talmudo mitkayyem beyado
Veamar rabbi eliezer may dichtiv lechayav kaarugat habbosem im mesim adam atzmo kaaruga zo shehakkol dashin bah uchvosem ze shehakkol mitbassemin bah talmudo mitkayyem veim lav en talmudo mitkayyem
Veamar rabbi eliezer may dichtiv luchot even im adam mesim atzmo et lechayav keeven zo sheenah nimchet talmudo mitkayyem beyado veim lav en talmudo mitkayyem beyado
Veamar rabbi eliezer may dichtiv charut al halluchot ilmale lo nishtabberu luchot harishonot lo nishtakkecha tora miyyisrael
Rav acha bar yaakov amar en kol umma velashon sholetet bahen shenneemar charut al tikre charut ella cherut
Amar rav matna may dichtiv umimmidbar mattana im mesim adam atzmo kemidbar ze shehakkol dashin bo talmudo mitkayyem beyado veim lav en talmudo mitkayyem beyado

Rava bereh derav yosef bar chama hava leh milleta lerav yosef bahadeh ki meta maale yoma dechipure amar ezil vaafayeseh azal ashkecheh leshammaeh deka mazeg leh kasa amar hav li veemzegeh ana yehav leh mazgeh kidtameh amar dame hay meziga limziga derava bereh derav yosef bar chama amar leh ana hu
Amar leh la tittev akkaracha ad dimfarshatte li hane kerae may dichtiv umimmidbar mattana umimmattana nachaliel uminnachaliel bamot umibbamot haggaye

Amar leh im adam mesim atzmo kemidbar ze shehakkol dashin bo tora nitna lo bemattana vechevan shennitna lo bemattana nechalo el shenneemar umimmattana nachaliel vechevan shennechalo el ole ligdulla shenneemar uminnachaliel bamot
Veim meges libbo hakkadosh baruch hu mashpilo shenneemar umibbamot haggaye veim chozer bo hakkadosh baruch hu magbiho shenneemar kol ge yinnase

Amar rav huna may dichtiv chayyatcha yashvu vah tachin betovatcha leani elohim im adam mesim atzmo kechayya zo sheddoreset veochelet veika deamri shemmasrachat veochelet talmudo mitkayyem beyado veim lav en talmudo mitkayyem beyado veim ose ken hakkadosh baruch hu ose lo seuda beatzmo shenneemar tachin betovatcha leani elohim
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv notzer teena yochal piryah lamma nimshelu divre tora kitena ma teena zo
b: Kol zeman sheadam memashmesh bah motze bah teenim af divre tora kol zeman sheadam hoge bahen motze bahen taam

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani may dichtiv ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen vego lamma nimshelu divre tora leayyelet lomar lach ma ayyala rachmah tzar vachaviva al boalah kol shaa veshaa keshaa rishona af divre tora chavivin al lomdehen kol shaa veshaa keshaa rishona

Veyaalat chen shemmaalat chen al lomdeha daddeha yeravucha vechol et lamma nimshelu divre tora kedad ma dad ze kol zeman shehattinok memashmesh bo motze bo chalav af divre tora kol zeman sheadam hoge bahen motze bahen taam

Beahavatah tishge tamid kegon rabbi eliezer ben pedat amru alav al rabbi eliezer shehaya yoshev veosek battora bashshuk hattachton shel tzipori usdino mutal bashshuk haelon shel tzipori tanya amar rabbi yitzchak ben elazar paam achat ba adam litlo umatza bo saraf

Tana deve rav anan may dichtiv rochve atonot tzechorot yoshve al middin veholche al derech sichu rochvay atonot ellu talmide chachamim shemmehallechin meir leir umimmedina limdina lilmod bo tora tzechorot sheosin otah ketzahorayim yoshve al middin sheddanin din emet laamito veholche ellu baale mikra al derech ellu baale mishna sichu ellu baale talmud shekkol sichatan divre tora
Amar rav shezvi mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya may dichtiv lo yacharoch remiyya tzedo lo yichye velo yaarich yamim tzayyad harammay
Rav sheshet amar tzayyad harammay yacharoch
Ki ata rav dimi amar mashal letzayyad shetztzad tzipporim im rishon rishon meshabber kenafav mishtammer veim lav en mishtammer
Amar rabba amar rav sechora amar rav huna may dichtiv hon mehevel yimat vekovetz al yad yarbe im ose adam torato chavilot chavilot mitmaet veim lav kovetz al yad yarbe
Amar rabba yadi rabbanan leha milleta veavri alah amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ana avadtah veikayyam biday

Tanu rabbanan ketzad seder mishna moshe lamad mippi haggevura nichnas aharon veshana lo moshe pirko nistallek aharon veyashav lismol moshe nichnesu banav veshana lahen moshe pirkan nistalleku banav elazar yashav limin moshe veitamar lismol aharon rabbi yehuda omer leolam aharon limin moshe chozer nichnesu zekenim veshana lahen moshe pirkan nistalleku zekenim nichnesu kol haam veshana lahen moshe pirkan nimtzeu beyad aharon arbaa beyad banav shelosha uvyad hazzekenim shenayim uvyad kol haam echad
Nistallek moshe veshana lahen aharon pirko nistallek aharon shanu lahen banav pirkan nistalleku banav shanu lahen zekenim pirkan nimtza beyad hakkol arbaa
Mikkan amar rabbi eliezer chayyav adam lishnot letalmido arbaa peamim vekal vachomer uma aharon shellamad mippi moshe umoshe mippi haggevura kach hedot mippi hedot al achat kamma vechamma
Rabbi akiva omer minnayin shechayyav adam lishnot letalmido ad sheyyilmadennu shenneemar velammedah et bene yisrael uminnayin ad shettehe sedura befihem shenneemar simah befihem
Uminnayin shechayyav leharot lo panim shenneemar veelle hammishpatim asher tasim lifnehem
Veligmeru kullehu mimmoshe kede lachalok kavod leaharon uvanav vechavod lazzekenim
Veneul aharon venigmar mimmoshe veliayelu banav veligmeru meaharon veliayelu zekenim velelfu mibbanav velezlu velagmerinhu lechullehu yisrael kevan demoshe mippi haggevura gamar mistayea milleteh
Amar mar rabbi yehuda omer leolam aharon limin moshe chozer keman azla ha detanya shelosha shehau mehallechin badderech harav baemtza vegadol bimino vekatan bismolo lema rabbi yehuda hi vela rabbanan
Afilu tema rabbanan mishshum tircha deaharon
Rabbi perida hava leh hahu talmida dahava tane leh arba mea zimne vegamar yoma chad bayuh lemilleta demitzva tena leh vela gemar

Amar leh haidana may shena amar leh middehahi shata daamar leh lemar ika milta demitzva assechay ledatay vechol shata amena hashta kae mar hashta kae mar amar leh hav datach veatne lich hadar tena leh arba mea zimne acharine
Nefaka bat kala vaamar leh nicha lach delispo lach arba mea shene o detizko atte vedarach lealma deate amar denizko ana vedaray lealma deate amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu tenu lo zo vazo
Amar rav chisda en tora niknet ella besimanin shenneemar simah befihem al tikre simah ella sayemennah

Shamah rav tachlifa mimmareva azal amrah kammeh derabbi avahu amar attun mehatam matnitu lah anan mehacha matninan lah hatztzivi lach tziyyunim simi lach vego asu tziyyunim lattora umay mashma dehay tziyyun lishana desimana hu dichtiv veraa etzem adam uvana etzlo tziyyun
Rabbi eliezer amar mehacha emor lachochma achoti atte umoda labbina tikra ase modaim lattora rava amar ase moadim lattora

a: Vehayenu deamar avdimi bar chama bar dosa may dichtiv lo vashshamayim hi velo meever layyam hi la bashshamayim hi sheim bashshamayim hi atta tzarich laalot achareha veim meever layyam hi atta tzarich laavor achareha
Rava amar lo vashshamayim hi lo timmatze bemi shemmagbiha dato aleha kashshamayim velo timmatze bemi shemmarchiv dato aleha kayyam
Rabbi yochanan amar lo bashshamayim hi lo timmatze begassay ruach velo meever layyam hi lo timmatze lo besachranim velo betaggarim
Tanu rabbanan ketzad meabberin et hearim arukka kemot shehi agulla osin lah zaviyyot merubbaat en osin lah zaviyyot hayeta rechava mitztzad echad uktzara mitztzad acher roin otah keilu hi shava

Haya bayit echad yotze kemin piggum o shene vattim yotzin kemin shene figgumin roin otan keilu chut matuach alehen umoded mimmennu ulhallan alpayim amma hayeta asuya kemin keshet o kemin gam roin otah keilu hi melea battim vachatzerot umoded mimmennu ulhallan alpayim amma
Amar mar arukka kemot shehi peshita la tzericha daaricha vekattina mahu detema liten lah putya aurkah ka mashma lan
Merubbaat en osin lah zaviyyot peshita la tzericha dimrabbea vela merabbea beribua olam mahu detema lirabbea beribua olam ka mashma lan
Haya bayit echad yotze kemin piggum o shene vattim yotzin kemin shene figgumin hashta bayit echad amratte shene vattim mibaya
La tzericha mishte ruchot mahu detema meruach achat amrinan mishte ruchot la amrinan ka mashma lan

Hayeta asuya kemin keshet o kemin gam roin otah keilu hi melea vattim vachatzerot umoded mimmenna ulhallan alpayim amma amar rav huna ir haasuya kekeshet im yesh ben shene rasheha pachot mearbaat alafim amma moddin lah min hayyeter veim lav moddin lah min hakkeshet
Umi amar rav huna hachi vehaamar rav huna chomat hair shennifretza bemea vearbaim veachat ushlish
Amar rabba bar ulla la kashya kan beruach achat kan mishte ruchot
Umay ka mashma lan denotnin karpef lazo vekarpef lazo ha amrah rav huna chada zimna ditnan
b: Notnin karpef lair divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim lo amru karpef ella ben shette ayarot
Veitmar rav huna amar karpef lazo vekarpef lazo vechiyya bar rav amar en notnin ella karpef echad lishnehem
Tzericha dei ashmeinan hacha mishshum dahava leh tzad heter meikara aval hatam ema la
Vei ashmeinan hatam mishshum didchika tashmishtayehu aval hacha dela dechika tashmishtayehu ema la tzericha
Vechamma have ben yeter lakkeshet rabba bar rav huna amar alpayim amma rava bereh derabba bar rav huna amar afilu yater mealpayim amma
Amar abbaye keoteh derava bereh derabba bar rav huna mistabbera dei bae hadar ate derech battim
Hau sham gedudiyyot gevohot asara tefachim ku may gedudiyyot amar rav yehuda shalosh mechitzot sheen alehen tikra

Ibaya lehu shette mechitzot veyesh alehen tikra mahu ta shema ellu shemmitabberin immah nefesh sheyyesh bah arba ammot al arba ammot vehaggesher vehakkever sheyyesh bahen bet dira uvet hakkeneset sheyyesh bah bet dira lachazzan uvet avoda zara sheyyesh bah bet dira lakkomarim vehaurot vehaotzarot shebbassadot veyesh bahen bet dira vehabburganin shebbetochah vehabbayit shebbayyam hare ellu mitabberin immah

Veellu sheen mitabberin immah nefesh shennifretza mishte ruchoteha elach veelach vehaggesher vehakkever sheen lahen bet dira uvet hakkeneset sheen lah bet dira lachazzan uvet avoda zara sheen lah bet dira lakkomarim vehaurot vehaotzarot shebbassadot sheen lahen bet dira uvor veshiach umara vegader veshovach shebbetochah vehabbayit shebbassefina en ellu mitabberin immah
Katane mihat nefesh shennifretza mishte ruchoteha elach veelach may lav deika tikra la deleka tikra
Bayit shebbayyam lemay chaze amar rav pappa bayit sheasuy lefannot bo kelim shebbassefina
Umara en mitabberet immah vehatane rabbi chiyya meara mitabberet immah amar abbaye kesheyyesh binyan al piha
Vetipok leh mishshum binyan gufeh la tzericha lehashlim
Amar rav huna yoshve tzerifin en moddin lahen ella mippetach battehen
Metiv rav chisda vayyachanu al hayyarden mibbet hayeshimot veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan ledidi chaze li hahu atra vehave telata parse al telata parse
Vetanya keshehen nifnin en nifnin lo lifnehem velo letziddehen ella leacharehen
Amar leh rava digle midbar kaamratte kevan dichtiv behu al pi Adonai yachanu veal pi Adonai yissau keman dikvia lehu dame
Amar rav chinana bar rav kahana amar rav ashe im yesh sham shalosh chatzerot shel shene vattim hukbeu
Amar rav yehuda amar rav yoshve tzerifin veholche midbarot chayyehen enan chayyim unshehen uvnehen enan shellahen
Tanya name hachi eliezer ish birya omer yoshve tzerifin keoshve kevarim veal benotehem hu omer arur shochev im kol behema
May tama ulla amar sheen lahen merchatzaot verabbi yochanan amar mippene shemmargishin ze laze bitvila
May benayehu ika benayehu nahara dismich leveta

Amar rav huna kol ir sheen bah yarak en talmid chacham rashshay ladur bah lememra deyarak mealleya vehatanya shelosha marbin et hazzevel vechoffin et hakkoma venotlin echad mechamesh meot mimmeor enav shel adam veellu hen

a: Pat kibar veshechar chadash veyarak la kashya ha betume vecharrate ha bishar yarke kidtanya shum yarak kereshin chatzi yarak nire tzenon nire sam chayyim
Veha tanya nire tzenon nire sam hammavet la kashya kan bealin kan baimmahot kan bimot hachamma kan bimot haggeshamim

Amar rav yehuda amar rav kol ir sheyyesh bah maalot umoradot adam uvhema shebbah metim bachatzi yemehen metim salka datach ella ema mazkinim bachatzi yemehen amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hane mulyata deve vere udve naresh azkenun
Tanu rabbanan ba lerabbeah merabbeah beribua olam noten tzefonah litzfon olam udromah lidrom olam vesimanach agala batztzafon veakrav baddarom

Rabbi yose omer im eno yodea lerabbeah beribua shel olam merabbeah kemin hattekufa ketzad chamma yotza beom aroch veshokaat beom aroch ze hu pene tzafon chamma yotza beom katzar veshokaat beom katzar ze hu pene darom tekufat nisan utkufat tishre chamma yotza bachatzi mizrach veshokaat bachatzi maarav
Shenneemar holech el darom vesovev el tzafon holech el darom bayyom vesovev el tzafon ballayela sovev sovev holech haruach ellu pene mizrach ufne maarav peamim mehallachtan ufamim mesabbavtan

Amar rav mesharsheya letanhu lehane kelale detanya lo yatza chamma meolam mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit veshaka bekeren maaravit tzefonit velo yatza chamma mikkeren mizrachit deromit veshaka bekeren maaravit deromit
Amar shemuel en tekufat nisan nofelet ella bearbaa rive hayyom o bitchillat hayyom o bitchillat hallayela o bachatzi hayyom o bachatzi hallayela

Veen tekufat tammuz nofelet ella o beachat umechetza o besheva umechetza ben bayyom uven ballayela veen tekufat tishre nofelet ella o beshalosh shaot o betesha shaot ben bayyom uven ballayela veen tekufat tevet nofelet ella o bearba umechetza o beeser umechetza ben bayyom uven ballayela
Veen ben tekufa litkufa ella tishim veechad yom vesheva shaot umechetza veen tekufa moshechet mechavertah ella chatzi shaa

Veamar shemuel en lecha tekufat nisan shennofelet betzedek sheenah meshabberet et hailanot veen lecha tekufat tevet shennofelet betzedek sheenah meyabeshet et hazzeraim vehu deityelid levana o bilvana o betzedek
b: Tanu rabbanan hamrabbea et hair ose otah kemin tavla merubbaat vechozer umrabbea et hattechumin veose otan kemin tavla merubbaat
Uchshehu moded lo yimdod meemtza hakkeren alpayim amma mippene shehu mafsid et hazzaviyyot ella mevi tavla merubbaat shehi alpayim amma al alpayim amma umannichah bekeren baalachsonah

Nimtzeta hair mistakkeret arba meot ammot lechan vearba meot ammot lechan nimtzeu techumin mistakkerin shemone meot ammot lechan ushmone meot lechan nimtzeu hair utchumin mistakkerin elef umatayim lechan veelef umatayim lechan
Amar abbaye umashkachatte lah bemata dehaveya tere alfe attere alfe
Tanya amar rabbi eliezer berabbi yose techum are leviyyim alpayim amma tze mehen elef amma migrash nimtza migrash revia vehashshear sadot uchramim
Mena hane mile amar rava deamar kera mikkir hair vachutza elef amma saviv amra tora sabbev et hair beelef nimtza migrash revia

Revia palga have amar rava bar adda mashochaa asberah li mashkachatte lah bemata dehaveya tere alfe attere alfe techum kamma haveya shitsar keranot kamma haveyan shitsar dal temanya ditchumin vearbea dikranot kamma have teresar
Nimtza migrash revia tefe mittilta ninhu
Ayeti arbea demata shedi alayehu akkatti tilta have
Mi savratte beribua kaamar beigula kaamar
Kamma merubba yater al heagol revia dal revia minayehu pashu lehu tisha vetisha mittelatin veshita riva have
Abbaye amar mashkachatte lah name bemata dehaveya alfa bealfa techumin kamma hau temanya keranot kamma have shitsar

a: Dal arba ditchumin vearba dikranot kamma have temanya
Tilta hau mi savratte beribbua kaamar beigula kaamar kamma merubba yater al heagol revia dal revia pashu lah shita veshita meesrim vearba riva have
Ravina amar may revia revia ditchumin
Rav ashe amar may revia revia dikranot
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe veha saviv ketiv

May saviv saviv dikranot dei la tema hachi gabbe ola dichtiv vezarku bene aharon et haddam al hammizbeach saviv hachi name saviv mammash ella may saviv saviv dikranot hachi name may saviv saviv dikranot
Amar leh rav chavivi machoznaa lerav ashe veha ika mursha dekarnata
Bemata igulta veha rabuha emor deamrinan chazenan keman dimrabbea rabboe vadday mi merabbana
Amar leh rav chanilay machoznaa lerav ashe mikkedi kamma merubba yater al heagol revia hane tamne mea shet mea veshitin ushva nache tilta have
Amar leh hane mile beigula miggo ribbua aval baalachsona baena tefe deamar mar kol ammeta beribua ammeta utre chummeshe baalachsona
Matni notnin karpef lair divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim lo amru karpef ella ben shette ayarot im yesh lazo shivim amma veshirayim ulazo shivim amma veshirayim ose karpef et shettehen lihot echad
Vechen shelosha kefarim hamshullashin im yesh ben shenayim chitzonim mea vearbaim veachat ushlish asa emtzai et shelashtan lihot echad
Gema mena hane mile amar rava deamar kera mikkir hair vachutza amra tora ten chutza veachar kach medod
Vachachamim omrim lo amru vechu itmar rav huna amar notnin karpef lazo vekarpef lazo chiyya bar rav amar karpef echad lishtehen
Tenan vachachamim omrim lo amru karpef ella ben shette ayarot teuvta derav huna
Amar lecha rav huna may karpef torat karpef ulolam karpef lazo vekarpef lazo
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane sefa im yesh lazo shivim amma veshirayim velazo shivim amma veshirayim ose karpef lishtehen lihot echad shema minah
Lema tehve teuvteh dechiyya bar rav amar lecha chiyya bar rav
b: Ha manni rabbi meir hi
I rabbi meir hi ha tane leh resha notnin karpef lair divre rabbi meir
Tzericha dei mehahi hava amena chad lachada vechad letarte ka mashma lan diltarte tere yahavinan lehu
Vei ashmeinan hacha mishshum didchika tashmishtayehu aval hatam dela dechika tashmishtayehu ema la tzericha

Tenan vechen shelosha kefarim hamshullashin im yesh ben shenayim hachitzonim mea vearbaim veachat amma ushlish ose emtzai et shelashtan lihot echad tama deika emtzai ha leka emtzai lo teuvta derav huna

Amar lecha rav huna ha ittemar alah amar rabba amar rav idi amar rabbi chanina lo meshullashin mammash ella roin kol sheilu metil emtzai benehen veyihu meshullashin veen ben ze laze ella mea vearbaim amma veachat ushlish asa emtzai et shelashtan lihot echad
Amar leh rava leabbaye kamma yehe ben chitzon laemtzai amar leh alpayim amma
Veha atte hu deamratte keoteh derava bereh derabba bar rav huna mistabbera deamar yoter mealpayim amma
Hachi hashta hatam ika battim hacha leka battim
Vaamar leh rava leabbaye kamma yehe ben chitzon lechitzon kamma yehe may nafka lach minah kol sheilu machnis emtzai benehen veen ben ze laze ella mea vearbaim veachat ushlish
Vaafilu arbaat alpayim amma amar leh in vehaamar rav huna ir haasuya kekeshet im yesh ben shene rasheha pachot mearbaat alafim amma moddin lah min hayyeter veim lav moddin lah min hakkeshet
Amar leh hatam leka lememar malle hacha ika lememar malle

Amar leh rav safra lerava hare bene akistefon demashchinan lehu techuma mehay gisa deardashir uvne techuma deardashir mashchinan lehu techuma mehay gisa daakistefon ha ika diglat demafseka yater mimmea vearbaim veachat ushlish
Nefak achvi leh hanach atmahata deshura demibbali bediglat beshivim amma veshirayim
Matni en moddin ella bechevel shel chamishshim amma lo pachot velo yoter velo yimdod ella keneged libbo
Haya moded vehiggia legaye o legader mavlio vechozer lemiddato higgia lehar mavlio vechozer lemiddato

a: Uvilvad shello yetze chutz lattechum
Im eno yachol lehavlio bezo amar rabbi dostay bar yannay mishshum rabbi meir shamati shemmekadderin beharim
Gema mena hane mile amar rav yehuda amar rav deamar kera orech hechatzer mea vaamma verochav chamishshim bachamishshim amra tora bechevel shel chamishshim amma medod
Hay mibe leh litol chamishshim ulsabbev chamishshim
Im ken lema kera chamishshim chamishshim may chamishshim bachamishshim shamatte minah tarte
Lo pachot velo yoter tana lo pachot mippene shemmarbe velo yoter mippene shemmemaet

Amar rabbi assi en moddin ella bechevel shel afsekima may afsekima amar rabbi abba nargila may nargila amar rabbi yaakov dikla dechad nevara ika deamri may afsekima rabbi abba amar nargila rabbi yaakov amar dikla dechad nevara
Tanya amar rabbi yehoshua ben chananya en lecha sheyyafe limdida yoter mishshalshelaot shel barzel aval ma naase shehare amra tora uvyado chevel midda
Vehachtiv uvyad haish kene hammidda hahu letare
Tane rav yosef shelosha chavalim hem shel magag shel netzer veshel pishtan
Shel magag lefara ditnan kefatuha bechevel hammagag untanuha al gav maarachtah shel netzarim lesota ditnan veachar kach mevi chevel hammitzri vekoshro lemala middaddeha shel pishtan limdida
Haya moded vehiggia middetane chozer lemidato mikkelal deim eno yachol lehavlio holech lemakom sheyyachol lehavlio umavlio vetzofe keneged midato vechozer
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan haya moded vehiggia hammida legaye im yachol lehavlio bechevel shel chamishshim amma mavlio veim lav holech limkom sheyyachol lehavlio umavlio vetzofe vechozer lemidato
Im haya ge meukkam makdir veole makdir veored higgia lechotel en omrim yikkov hakkotel ella omdo veholech lo
Veha anan tenan mavlio vechozer lemidato hatam nicha tashmishta hacha la nicha tashmishta
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella sheen chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo
b: Aval chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo moddo medida yafa
Vechamma omko shel ge amar rav yosef alpayim
Etiveh abbaye amok mea verochav chamishshim mavlio veim lav en mavlio hu deamar kaacherim detanya acherim omrim afilu amok alpayim verochav chamishshim mavlio
Ika deamri amar rav yosef afilu yater mealpayim keman dela ketanna kamma vela kaacherim
Hatam sheen chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo hacha bechut hammishkolet yored kenegdo
Vechi en chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo ad kamma amar avimi arba vechen tane rame bar yechezkel arba
Higgia lehar mavlio vechozer lemidato amar rava lo shanu ella behar hammitlakket asara mittoch arba aval behar hammitlakket asara mittoch chamesh moddo medida yafa
Rav huna bereh derav natan matne lekulla amar rava lo shanu ella behar hammitlakket asara mittoch chamesh aval behar hammitlakket asara mittoch arba omdo veholech lo
Uvilvad shello yetze chutz lattechum may tama amar rav kahana gezera shemma yomru middat techumin baa lechan
Im eno yachol lehavlio tanu rabbanan ketzad mekadderin tachton keneged libbo elon keneged margelotav amar abbaye nekitinan en mekadderin ella bechevel shel arba ammot
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh nekitinan en mekadderin lo beegla arufa velo beare miklat mippene shehen shel tora
Matni en moddin ella min hammumche riba lemakom echad umiet lemakom acher shomin limkom sheriba riba leechad umiet leechad shomin lamrubbe
Vaafilu eved afilu shifcha neemanin lomar ad kan techum shabbat shello amru chachamim et haddavar lehachamir ella lehakel

a: Gema limkom sheriba in limkom shemmiet la ema af limkom sheriba
Riba leechad umiet leechad ku ha tu lema li hayenu hach hachi kaamar riba echad umiet echad shomin leze sheriba
Amar abbaye uvilvad shello yarbe yoter mimmiddat hair baalachsona
Shello amru chachamim et haddavar lehachamir ella lehakel vehatanya lo amru chachamim et haddavar lehakel ella lehachamir
Amar ravina lo lehakel al divre tora ella lehachmir al divre tora utchumin derabbanan
Matni ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim mearvin et kullah

Veshel rabbim venaaset shel yachid en mearvin et kullah ella im ken asa chutza lah kair chadasha shebbihuda sheyyesh bah chamishshim daorin divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer shalosh chatzerot shel shene vattim
Gema hechi dame ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim amar rav yehuda kegon diyskarta deresh galuta
Amar leh rav nachman may tama ilema mishshum dishchichi gabbe harmana madkeri ahadade kullehu yisrael name betzafra deshabbeta shechichi gabbe hadade ella amar rav nachman kegon diskarta denattezui

Tanu rabbanan ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim urshut harabbim overet betochah ketzad mearvin otah ose lechi mikkan velechi mikkan o kora mikkan vekora mikkan venose venoten baemtza veen mearvin otah lachatzain ella o kullah o mavoy mavoy bifne atzmo
Hayeta shel rabbim vahare hi shel rabbim
b: Veen lah ella petach echad mearvin et kullah

Man tanna demiarva reshut harabbim amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua rabbi yehuda hi detanya yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda mi sheyyesh lo shene battim bishne tzide reshut harabbim ose lechi mikkan velechi mikkan o kora mikkan vekora mikkan venose venoten baemtza amru lo en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach
Amar mar veen mearvin otah lachatzain amar rav pappa lo amru ella leorkah aval lerochbah mearvin
Keman dela kerabbi akiva dei kerabbi akiva ha amar regel hammutteret bimkomah oseret afilu shello bimkomah
Afilu tema rabbi akiva ad kan la kaamar rabbi akiva hatam ella bishte chatzerot zo lefanim mizzo difnimit let lah pitcha acharina aval hacha hane nafki behay pitcha vehane nafki behay pitcha
Ika deamri amar rav pappa la tema leorkah hu dela mearvin aval lerochbah mearvin ella afilu lerochbah name la mearvin

Keman kerabbi akiva afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella bishte chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo difnimit achada ledashsha umishtammesha aval hacha mi matzu mesalleki reshut harabbim mehacha
Amar mar o kullah o mavoy mavoy bifne atzmo may shena delachatzain dela deasri ahadade mavoy mavoy name asri ahadade
Hacha bemay askinan kegon daavud dakka vechi ha deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav chisda echad mibbene mavoy sheasa dakka lefitcho eno oser al bene mavoy
Hayeta shel rabbim vahare hi ku rabbi zera arvah lemata deve rabbi chiyya vela shevak lah shiyyur amar leh abbaye may tama avad mar hachi
Amar leh save didah amri li rav chiyya bar assi mearev kullah veamena shema minah ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim hi
Amar leh ledidi amaru li hanhu save hahi ashpa hava lah mechad gisa vehashta deipanya lah ashpa have lah kishne petachim vaasir amar leh lav addatay
Bae mineh rav amme bar adda harpannaa merabba sullam mikkan ufetach mikkan mahu amar leh hachi amar rav sullam torat petach alav

Amar lehu rav nachman la tetzitu leh hachi amar rav adda amar rav sullam torat petach alav vetorat mechitza alav torat mechitza alav kedaamaran torat petach alav besullam shebben shette chatzerot ratzu echad mearev ratzu shenayim mearvin
Umi amar rav nachman hachi vehaamar rav nachman amar shemuel anshe chatzer veanshe mirpeset sheshshachchu

a: Velo ervu im yesh lifnehem dakka arbaa enah oseret veim lav oseret
Hacha bemay askinan bidlo gevoha mirpeset asara
Vei lo gevoha mirpeset asara ki ka aved dakka may have bimguppefet ad eser ammot dechevan deaved dakka istalloke istalluk leh mehacha
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kotel shertzafah besullamot afilu beyater meeser torat mechitza alav

Rame leh rav berona lerav yehuda bematzarta deve rav chanina mi amar shemuel torat mechitza alav vehaamar rav nachman amar shemuel anshe mirpeset veanshe chatzer sheshshachchu velo ervu im yesh lefaneha dakka arbaa enah oseret veim lav oseret
Hacha bemay askinan delo gevoha mirpeset asara vei lo gevoha mirpeset asara ki aved dakka may have bimguppefet ad eser ammot dechevan deaved dakka istalloke istallak mehacha

Hanhu bene kakunae deate lekammeh derav yosef amaru leh hav lan gavra deliarev lan matin amar leh leabbaye zil arev lehu vachazi dela metzavechatte alah beve midresha azal chaza lehanhu batte diftichi lenahara amar hane leheve shiyyur lemata
Hadar amar en mearvin et kullah tenan mikkelal dei bae learove matze mearvi ella ebed lehu kavey dei bau learove derech challonot matzu mearvi

Hadar amar la bae deha rabba bar avuh mearev lah lechullah machoza arseyata arseyata mishshum pera deve tore dechol chad vechad have shiyyur lechavreh veaf al gav dei bau learove bahade hadade la matzu mearvi
Hadar amar la dame hatam i bae learove derech gaggot vehane la mearvi hilkach nabedan kavey
Hadar amar kavey name la bae dehahu be tivna dahava leh lemar bar pofidta mippumbedita veshavveyah shiyyur lefumbedita
Amar hayenu deamar li mar chazi dela metzavechatte alah beve midresha

Ella im ken asa chutza lah kair chadasha tanya amar rabbi yehuda ir achat hayeta bihuda vachadasha shemah vehau bah chamishshim daorim anashim venashim vataf uvah hau meshaarim chachamim vehi hayeta shiyyur
Ibaya lehu chadasha mahu chadasha ki hechi deihi haveya shiyyur ligdola gedola name haveya shiyyur liktanna
Ella keen chadasha mahu rav huna verav yehuda chad amar baaya shiyyur vechad amar la baaya shiyyur

Rabbi shimon omer shalosh chatzerot vechu amar rav chama bar gurya amar rav halacha kerabbi shimon rabbi yitzchak amar afilu bayit echad vechatzer achat chatzer achat salka datach ella ema bayit echad bechatzer achat
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef ha derabbi yitzchak gemara o sevara amar leh may nafka lan minah amar leh gemara gemor zemorta tehe
Matni mi shehaya bammizrach veamar livno arev li bammaarav bammaarav vaamar livno arev li bammizrach im yesh hemennu ulveto alpayim amma uleruvo yoter mikkan muttar leveto veasur leeruvo
Leeruvo alpayim amma ulveto yater mikkan asur leveto umuttar leeruvo
Hannoten et eruvo beiburah shel ir lo asa velo chelum
Netano chutz lattechum afilu amma achat
b: Ma shenniskar hu mafsid
Gema ka salka datach lammizrach lemizrach beto lammaarav lemaarav beto
Bishlama hemennu ulveto alpayim amma uleruvo yater mikkan mashkachatte lah demate leveteh vela mate leeruvo ella hemennu uleruvo alpayim amma ulveto yater mikkan hechi mashkachatte lah
Amar rabbi yitzchak mi savratte lammizrach lemizrach beto lammaarav lemaarav beto lo lammizrach lemizrach beno lammaarav lemaarav beno
Rava bar rav shela amar afilu tema lammizrach lemizrach beto velammaarav lemaarav beto kegon dekae beteh baalachsona
Hannoten eruvo betoch iburah vechu chutz lattechum salka datach ella ema chutz leiburah

Ma shenniskar hu mafsid ma shenniskar vetu la vehatanya hannoten et eruvo betoch iburah shel ir lo asa velo chelum netano chutz leiburah shel ir afilu amma achat mistakker otah amma umafsid et kal hair kullah mippene shemmiddat hair ola lo bemiddat hattechum
La kashya kan shekkalta middato bachatzi hair kan shekkalta middato besof hair

Vechidrabbi idi deamar rabbi idi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi haya moded uva vechalta middato bachatzi hair en lo ella chatzi hair kalta middato besof hair naaset lo hair kullah kearba ammot umashlimin lo et hashshear
Amar rabbi idi en ellu ella divre neviut ma li kalta bachatzi hair ma li kalta besof hair
Amar rava tarvayehu tenanhi anshe ir gedola mehallechin et kol ir ketanna

a: Veen anshe ir ketanna mehallechin et kol ir gedola
May tama lav mishshum dehane kalta middatan bachatzi hair vehane kalta middatan besof hair
Verabbi idi anshe anshe tane umokem lah benoten aval moded la tenan
Vela vehatnan velammoded sheamru notnin lo alpayim amma sheafilu sof middato kale bimara
Sof hair itztericha leh dela tenan
Amar rav nachman man detane anshe la mishtabbash uman detane en anshe la mishtabbash
Man detane anshe la mishtabbash demokem lah benoten uman detane en anshe la mishtabbash demokem lah bemoded

Vechassore mechassera vehachi katane anshe ir gedola mehallechin et kol ir ketanna veen anshe ir ketanna mehallechin et kol ir gedola bamme devarim amurim bemoded aval mi shehaya beir gedola vehinniach et eruvo beir ketanna haya beir ketanna vehinniach et eruvo beir gedola mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma
Amar rav yosef amar rame bar abba amar rav huna ir sheyyoshevet al sefat hannachal im yesh lefaneha dakka arbaa moddim lah missefat hannachal veim lav en moddin lah ella mippetach beto
Amar leh abbaye dakka arba ammot amarte lan alah may shena mikkol dakke dealma dearbea
Amar leh hatam la beita tashmishta hacha beita tashmishta
Amar rav yosef mena amena lah detanya hittir rabbi sheyehu bene gader yordin lechammatan veen bene chammatan olin legader may tama lav mishshum dehane avud dakka vehane la avud dakka
Ki ata rav dimi amar tatroge metatregi lehu bene gader livne chammatan umay hittir hitkin
Umay shena shabbat dishchicha bah shichrut
Ki azli lehatam name metatregi lehu kalba bela mateh shav shenin la navach
Hashta name metatregi bene chammatan livne gader kulle hay la kayefi lehu
Rav safra amar ir haasuya kekeshet havay
Rav dimi bar chinana amar anshe ir gedola veanshe ir ketanna havay
Rav kahana matne hachi rav tavome matne hachi rav safra verav dimi bar chinana chad amar ir haasuya kekeshet havay vechad amar anshe ir ketanna veanshe ir gedola havay

Matni anshe ir gedola mehallechin et kol ir ketanna veanshe ir ketanna mehallechin et kol ir gedola ketzad mi shehaya beir gedola venatan et eruvo beir ketanna beir ketanna venatan et eruvo beir gedola mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma
Rabbi akiva omer en lo ella mimmekom eruvo alpayim amma amar lahen rabbi akiva i attem modim li benoten eruvo bimara sheen lo ella mimmekom eruvo alpayim amma
Amru lo ematay bizman sheen bah daorin aval yesh bah daorin mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma nimtza kal tochah meal gabbah
Velammoded sheamru notnin alpayim amma sheafilu sof middato kale bimara
b: Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shavat beir chareva lerabbanan mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma hinniach et eruvo beir chareva en lo mimmekom eruvo ella alpayim amma rabbi elazar omer echad shavat veechad hinniach mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma
Metivi amar lahen rabbi akiva i attem modim li benoten et eruvo bimara sheen lo mimmekom eruvo ella alpayim amma amru lo ematay bizman sheen bah daorin ha been bah daorin modu leh
May en bah daorin enah reuya ledira

Ta shema shavat beir afilu hi gedola keantiyyochya bimara afilu hi kimarat tzidkiyyahu melech yehuda mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma katane ir dumya dimara ma meara chareva af ir chareva veshavat in aval hinniach la
Manni ilema rabbi akiva may irya chareva afilu yeshiva name ella lav rabbanan vetama deshavat in aval hinniach la
La tema ir dumya dimara ella ema meara dumya deir ma ir yeshiva af meara yeshiva verabbi akiva hi deamar en lo mimmekom eruvo ella alpayim amma uvshavat mode
Veha kimarat tzidkiyyahu katane kimarat tzidkiyyahu velo kimarat tzidkiyyahu kimarat tzidkiyyahu gedola velo kimarat tzidkiyyahu deilu hatam chareva vehacha yeshiva
Mar yehuda ashkechinhu livne mevarachta deka motvi eruvayehu beve kenishta deve aggovar amar lehu gauo beh tefe ki hechi delishtere lechu tefe
Amar leh rava palgaa beeruvin let dechash leha derabbi akiva
Hadran alach ketzad meabberin
Matni haddar im hannochri bechatzer o im mi sheeno mode baeruv hare ze oser alav
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer leolam eno oser ad sheyehu shene yisreelim osrin ze al ze
Amar rabban gamliel maase betzadduki echad shehaya dar immanu bemavoy birushalayim veamar lanu abba maharu vehotziu et hakkelim lammavoy ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem
Rabbi yehuda omer belashon acher maharu vaasu tzorchechem bammavoy ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem

a: Gema yatev abbaye bar avin verav chinana bar avin veyatev abbaye gabbayehu veyatvi vekaamri bishlama rabbi meir kasavar dirat goy shemah dira vela shena chad vela shena tere
Ella rabbi eliezer ben yaakov may kasavar i kasavar dirat goy shemah dira afilu chad name nitsar vei la shemah dira afilu tere name la nitsar
Amar lehu abbaye vesavar rabbi meir dirat goy shemah dira vehatanya chatzero shel nochri hare hu kedir shel behema
Ella dechulle alma dirat goy lo shemah dira vehacha bigzera shemma yilmad mimmaasav ka mipalgi
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar kevan degoy chashud ashshefichut damim tere dishchichi dedayeri gezaru behu chad la shechiach la gezaru beh rabbanan
Verabbi meir savar zimnin demikkere vedayer vaamaru rabbanan en eruv moil bimkom goy veen bitul reshut moil bimkom goy ad sheyyaskir vegoy la mogar
May tama ilema mishshum desavar dilma ate leachzoke birshuto hanicha leman deamar sechirut beria bainan
Ella leman deamar sechirut reua bainan may ika lememar deittemar rav chisda amar sechirut beria verav sheshet amar sechirut reua

May reua may beria ilema beria bifruta reua pachot mishshave peruta mi ika leman deamar miggoy befachot mishshave peruta la veha shalach rabbi yitzchak berabbi yaakov bar giyyore mishshemeh derabbi yochanan hao yodin shessochrin min haggoy afilu befachot mishshave peruta
Veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan ben noach neherag al pachot mishshave peruta velo nitan lehishshavon
Ella beria bemuhreke vavurgane reua bela muhreke vavurgane hanicha leman deamar sechirut beria bainan
Ella leman deamar sechirut reua bainan may ika lememar afilu hachi chashesh goy lichshafim vela mogar
Gufa chatzero shel goy hare hu kedir shel behema umuttar lehachnis ulhotzi min chatzer labbattim umin battim lechatzer
Veim yesh sham yisrael echad oser divre rabbi meir
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer leolam eno oser ad sheyehu shene yisreelim osrim ze al ze
b: Amar mar chatzero shel goy hare hu kedir shel behema veha anan tenan haddar im hannochri bechatzer hare ze oser alav
La kashya ha deiteh ha deleteh
Umay kasavar i kasavar dira belo bealim shemah dira afilu goy name nitsar vei kasavar dira belo bealim lo shemah dira afilu yisrael name la nitsar
Leolam kasavar dira belo bealim lo shemah dira veyisrael dechi iteh asar ki leteh gezaru beh rabbanan
Goy dechi iteh gezera shemma yilmad mimmaasav ki iteh asar ki leteh la asar

Veika leman deamar en potchin bacharata
