Metiv rav huna bar chinana sela shebbayyam gavoha asara verochav arbaa en metaltelin lo min tocho layyam velo min hayyam letocho pachot mikkan metaltelin ad kamma ad bet satayim
Aheya ilema assefa bet satayim tefe la veha mikkarmelit lecharmelit ka metaltel

Ella lav aresha vehachi kaamar sela shebbayyam gavoha asara verochav arbaa en metaltelin lo mittocho layyam velo min hayyam letocho vead kamma ad bet satayim ha yater mibbet satayim metaltelin alma karmelit hi teuvta derabbi yochanan
Amar rava man dela yada tarotze matneyata teuvta motev leh lerabbi yochanan leolam aresha vehachi kaamar ha betocho metaltelin vead kamma ad bet satayim
Rav ashe amar leolam aresha hen amru vehen amru
Hen amru karpef yater mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot vehen amru en metaltelin mershut hayyachid lecharmelit
Bet satayim deshare letaltole bechulleh asri rabbanan letaltole lo min hayyam letocho velo mittocho layyam may tama reshut hayyachid gemura hi
Yater mibbet satayim deasur letaltole bechulleh sharu rabbanan letaltole mittocho layyam umin hayyam letocho may tama dilma amri reshut hayyachid gemura hi veate letaltole bechulleh
Umay shena tocho shechiach mittocho layyam umin hayyam letocho la shechiach
Hahu yanoka deishtefich chammimeh amar lehu rabba nayeto leh chammime miggo betay amar leh abbaye veha la arvinan
Amar leh nismoch ashshituf amar leh ha la shattefinan nemru leh legoy layete leh

Amar abbaye beay leotoveh lemar vela shavkan rav yosef deamar rav yosef amar rav kahana ki havenan be rav yehuda hava amar lan bidorayeta motvinan teuvta vahadar avdinan maase bidrabbanan avdinan maase vahadar motvinan teuvta
Levatar hachi amar leh may baet leotoveh lemar amar leh detanya hazzaa shevut vaamira legoy shevut

a: Ma hazzaa shevut veenah docha et hashshabbat af amira legoy shevut veenah docha et hashshabbat
Amar leh vela shane lach ben shevut deit beh maase lishvut delet beh maase deha mar la amar legoy zil achem
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanan leabbaye mevoa deit beh tere gavre ravreve kerabbanan la leheve beh la eruv velo shituf amar leh may naaved mar lav orcheh ana teridna begirsay inhu la mashgechi
Vei akni lehu pita besalla kevan dei bau lah minay vela efshar litvah nihalayehu batel shituf
Detanya echad mibbene mavoy shebbikesh yayin vashemen velo natnu lo batel hashshittuf
Venakne lehu mar reviata dechalla bechavita tanya en mishtattefin baotzar
Veha tanya mishtattefin amar rav oshaya la kashya ha bet shammay ha bet hillel
Ditnan hammet babbayit velo petachim harbe kullan temein
Niftach echad mehen hu tame vechullan tehorin chishev lehotzio beechad mehen o bachallon sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa matztzil al kol happetachim kullan
Bet shammay omrim vehu shechishev ad shello yamut hammet uvet hillel omrim af mishsheyyamut hammet
Hahu yanoka deishtefuch chammimeh amar lehu rava nishayelah leimeh i tzericha nachem leh goy aggav imeh
Amar leh rav mesharsheya lerava imeh ka achla tamre amar leh emor tunba bealma hu denaket lah
Hahu yanoka deishtefuch chammimeh amar lehu rava pannu li mane mibbe gavre leve neshe veezil veitev hatam veevattel lehu ha chatzer
Amar leh ravina lerava vehaamar shemuel en bitul reshut mechatzer lechatzer amar leh ana kerabbi yochanan sevira li deamar yesh bitul mechatzer lechatzer
Vei la savar lah mar kishmuel
b: Nitev mar beduchteh venivattel lehu ledidhu venihderu inhu venivattelu leh lemar deha amar rav mevattelin vechozrin umvattelin
Ana beha kishmuel sevira li deamar en mevattelin vechozrin umvattelin

Velav chad tama hu may tama en mevattelin vechozrin umvattelin lav mishshum dechevan devatteleh lirshuteh istallak leh mehacha ligmare vehave leh keven chatzer acheret veen bitul reshut mechatzer lechatzer mar name la nivattel
Hatam hayenu tama ki hechi dela leheve milleta derabbanan kechucha veitlula
Gufa rav amar mevattelin vechozrin umvattelin ushmuel amar en mevattelin vechozrin umvattelin
Lema rav ushmuel biflugta derabbanan verabbi eliezer ka mipalgi
Derav deamar kerabbanan ushmuel deamar kerabbi eliezer

Amar lecha rav ana daamari afilu lerabbi eliezer ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam hammevattel reshut chatzero reshut beto bitel mishshum divvayit bela chatzer la dayeri inashe aval leinyan istalloke mi amar
Ushmuel amar ana daamari afilu kerabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella may devattel battel udla battel la battel aval may devattel miha istallak ligmare
Amar rav acha bar chana amar rav sheshet ketannae mi shennatan reshuto vehotzi ben beshogeg ben bemezid oser divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer bemezid oser beshogeg eno oser
May lav beha kamipalgi demar savar mevattelin vechozrin umvattelin umar savar en mevattelin vechozrin umvattelin

Amar rav acha bar tachlifa mishshemeh derava la dechulle alma en mevattelin vechozrin umvattelin vehacha bekansu shogeg attu mezid ka mipalgi mar savar kansu shogeg attu mezid umar savar lo kansu shogeg attu mezid
Rav ashe amar rav ushmuel biflugta derabbi eliezer verabbanan ka mipalgi
Amar rabban gamliel maase betzadduki echad shehaya dar immanu tzadduki man dechar shemeh

Chassore michassera vehachi katane tzadduki hare hu kegoy verabban gamliel omer tzadduki eno kegoy veamar rabban gamliel maase betzadduki echad shehaya dar immanu bemavoy birushalayim veamar lanu abba maharu vehotziu et hakkelim lammavoy ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem

Vehatanya haddar im hannochri tzadduki uvayettosi hare ellu osrin alav rabban gamliel omer tzadduki uvayettosi enan osrin umaase betzadduki echad shehaya dar im rabban gamliel bemavoy birushalayim veamar lahem rabban gamliel levanav banay maharu vehotziu ma sheattem motziin vehachnisu ma sheattem machnisin ad shello yotzi hattoev hazze veyeesor alechem shehare bitel reshuto lachem divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda omer belashon acheret maharu vaasu tzorchechem bammavoy ad shello techshach veyeesor alechem
Amar mar hotziu ma sheattem motziin vehachnisu ma sheattem machnisin ad shello yotzi hattoev hazze veyeesor alechem lememra dechi mappeki inhu vahadar mappek ihu la asar

a: Vehatnan mi shennatan reshuto vehotzi ben beshogeg ben bemezid oser divre rabbi meir
Amar rav yosef ema eno oser abbaye amar la kashya kan shehecheziku bene mavoy bammavoy kan shello hechziku bene mavoy bammavoy
Vehatanya ad shello natan reshuto hotzi ben beshogeg ben bemezid yachol levattel divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer beshogeg yachol levattel bemezid eno yachol levattel

Mi shennatan reshuto vehotzi ben beshogeg ben bemezid oser divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer bemezid oser beshogeg eno oser bamme devarim amurim beshello hechziku bene mavoy bammavoy aval hechziku bene mavoy bammavoy ben beshogeg uven bemezid eno oser
Amar mar rabbi yehuda omer belashon acheret maharu vaasu tzorchechem bammavoy ad shello techshach veyeesor alechem alma goy hu veha anan ad shello yotzi tenan
Ema ad shello yotzi hayyom veibaet ema la kashya kan bemumar lechallel shabbatot betzina kan bemumar lechallel shabbatot befarhesya
Keman azla ha detanya mumar vegiluy panim hare ze eno mevattel reshut giluy panim mumar have
Ella mumar begiluy panim eno yachol levattel reshut keman kerabbi yehuda
Hahu dinfak bechumarta dimdusha kevan dechazyeh lerabbi yehuda nesia kasseyah amar kegon ze mevattel reshut lerabbi yehuda

Amar rav huna ezehu yisrael mumar ze hamchallel shabbatot befarhesya amar leh rav nachman keman i kerabbi meir deamar chashud ledavar echad chashud lechol hattora kullah afilu beechad mikkol isurin shebbattora name
I kerabbanan haamri chashud ledavar echad la have chashud lechol hattora kullah
b: Ad dehave mumar laavoda zara
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak liten reshut ulvattel reshut vechidtanya yisrael mumar meshammer shabbatto bashshuk mevattel reshut sheeno meshammer shabbatto bashshuk eno mevattel reshut
Mippene sheamru yisrael notel reshut venoten reshut uvgoy ad sheyyaskir ketzad omer lo reshuti kenuya lach reshuti mevuttelet lach kana veen tzarich lizkot
Rav ashe amar hay tanna hu dachamira aleh shabbat kaavoda zara
Kidtanya mikkem velo kullechem perat lammumar mikkem bachem chillakti velo baummot
Min habbehema lehavi bene adam haddomin livhema mikkan amru mekabbelin korbanot mipposhe yisrael kede sheyyachzeru bitshuva chutz min hammumar vehamnassech yayin vehamchallel shabbatot befarhesya
Ha gufa kashya amratte mikkem velo kullechem lehotzi et hammumar vahadar tane mekabbelin korbanot mipposhe yisrael ha la kashya resha bemumar lechol hattora kullah metziata bemumar ledavar echad
Ema sefa chutz min hammumar vehamnassech yayin hay mumar hechi dame i mumar lechol hattora hayenu resha i ledavar echad kashya metziata
Ella lav hachi kaamar chutz min hammumar lenassech ulchallel shabbatot befarhesya alma avoda zara veshabbat ki hadade ninhu shema minah
Matni anshe chatzer sheshshachach echad mehen velo erav beto asur millehachnis umillehotzi lo velahem veshellahem muttarin lo velahem natnu lo reshutan hu muttar vehen asurin
Hau shenayim osrin ze al ze sheechad noten reshut venotel reshut shenayim notnin reshut veen notlin reshut

Meematay notnin reshut bet shammay omrim mibbeod yom bet hillel omrim mishshechashecha mi shennatan reshuto vehotzi ben beshogeg ben bemezid hare ze oser divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer bemezid oser beshogeg eno oser
Gema beto hu deasur ha chatzero sharya

Hechi dame i devattel beto ammay asur i dela battel chatzero ammay sharya hacha bemay askinan kegon shebbitel reshut chatzero velo bitel reshut beto veka savri rabbanan hamvattel reshut chatzero reshut beto lo bitel dedayar inish bevayit bela chatzer
Veshellahen muttar lo velahen may tama dehave oreach legabbayehu
Natnu lo reshutan hu muttar vehen asurin veneheve inhu legabbeh ki orchin chad legabbe chamishsha have oreach chamishsha legabbe chad la have oreach
Shema minah mevattelin vechozrin umvattelin
Hachi kaamar natnu lo reshutan meikara hu muttar vehen asurin
Hau shenayim osrin ze al ze peshita la tzericha dahadar chad minayehu uvattel leh lechavreh mahu detema lishtere ka mashma lan dechevan dividana devattel la hava leh sharuta behay chatzer
Sheechad noten reshut ha tu lema li i noten tenena i notel tenena
Sefa itztericha leh shenayim notnin reshut ha name peshita mahu detema

a: Ligzar dilma ate levattole lehu ka mashma lan
Veen notlin reshut lema li la tzericha af al gav deamri leh keni al menat lehaknot

Bea mineh abbaye merabba chamishsha sheshsheruyin bechatzer achat veshachach echad mehen velo erav keshehu mevattel reshuto tzarich levattel lechol echad veechad o la amar leh tzarich levattel lechol echad veechad
Etiveh echad shello erav noten reshuto leechad sheerav shenayim sheervu notnin reshutan leechad shello erav ushnayim shello ervu notnin reshutan lishnayim sheervu o leechad shello erav
Aval lo echad sheerav noten reshuto leechad shello erav veen shenayim sheervu notnin reshutan lishnayim shello ervu veen shenayim shello ervu notnin reshutan lishnayim shello ervu
Katane mihat resha echad shello erav noten reshuto leechad sheerav hechi dame i deleka acharina bahadeh bahade man erav
Ella peshita deika acharina bahadeh vekatane leechad sheerav
Verabba hacha bemay askinan dahava umit
I dahava umit ema sefa aval en echad sheerav noten reshuto leechad shello erav vei dahava umit ammay la
Ella peshita deiteh umiddesefa iteh resha name iteh
Mide irya ha kidita veha kidita
Teda dekatane sefa deresha ushnayim shello ervu notnin reshutan lishnayim sheervu lishnayim in leechad la
Veabbaye amar may lishnayim leechad mishshenayim i hachi litne leechad sheerav o leechad shello erav kashya
Echad shello erav noten reshuto leechad sheerav leabbaye deiteh veka mashma lan deen tzarich levattel reshut lechol echad veechad lerabba dahava umit vela gezur zimnin deiteh
Ushnayim sheervu notnin reshutan leechad shello erav peshita mahu detema kevan dela erav likneseh ka mashma lan
Ushnayim shello ervu notnin reshutan lishnayim sheervu lerabba tena sefa legalloye resha leabbaye shenayim shello ervu itztericha leh salka datach amena ligzar dilma ate levattole lehu ka mashma lan
O leechad shello erav lema li mahu detema hane mile hecha demiktzatan ervu umiktzatan lo ervu aval hecha dechullan lo ervu liknesinhu kede shello tishtakkach torat eruv ka mashma lan
Aval en echad sheerav noten reshuto leechad shello erav leabbaye tena sefa legalloye resha lerabba ayede ditna resha tena name sefa

Veen shenayim sheervu notnin reshutan lishnayim shello ervu ha tu lema li la tzericha devattel leh chad minayehu lechavreh mahu detema lishtere leh ka mashma lan kevan dividana devattel la hao leh sharuta beha chatzer la
Veen shenayim shello ervu notnin reshutan lishnayim shello ervu ha tu lema li la tzericha deamri keni al menat lehikkanot
Bea mineh rava merav nachman yoresh mahu sheyevattel reshut
b: Hecha dei bae learove meetmol matze mearev battole name matze mevattel aval hay kevan dei bae learove meetmol la matze mearev la matze mevattel
O dilma yoresh kareh daavuh hu

Amar leh ani omer mevattel vehane deve shemuel tanu en mevattel etiveh ze hakkelal kol shemmuttar lemiktzat shabbat huttar lechol hashshabbat vechol shennesar lemiktzat shabbat nesar lechol hashshabbat chutz mimmevattel reshut
Kol shehuttar lemikketzat shabbat muttar lechol hashshabbat kegon erav derech happetach venistam happetach erav derech challon venistam challon
Ze hakkelal leetoye mavoy shennitlu korotav o lechayav
Kol shennesar lemiktzat shabbat nesar lechol hashshabbat kullah kegon shene vattim bishne tzide reshut harabbim vehikkifum goyim mechitza beshabbat
Ze hakkelal leetoye may leetoye met goy beshabbat
Vekatane chutz mimmevattel reshut ihu in yoresh la
Ema chutz mittorat bitul reshut
Etiveh echad mibbene chatzer shemmet vehinniach reshuto leechad min hashshuk mibbeod yom oser mishshechashecha eno oser
Veechad min hashshuk shemmet vehinniach reshuto leechad mibbene chatzer mibbeod yom eno oser mishshechashecha oser
Ammay oser nivattel may oser name dekatane ad sheyevattel
Ta shema yisrael veger sheruyin bimgura achat umet ger mibbeod yom

a: Af al pi shehechezik yisrael acher binchasav oser mishshechashecha af al pi shello hechzik yisrael acher eno oser
Ha gufa kashya amratte mibbeod yom af al pi shehechzik vela mibaya ki lo hechzik adderabba ki lo hechzik la asar
Amar rav pappa ema af al pi shello hechzik veha af al pi shehechzik katane
Hachi kaamar af al pi shello hechzik mibbeod yom ella mishshechashecha kevan dahava leh lehachzik mibbeod yom oser mishshechashecha af al pi shello hechzik yisrael acher eno oser
Af al pi shello hechzik yisrael acher vela mibaya ki hechzik adderabba ki hechzik asar
Amar rav pappa ema af al pi shehechzik veha af al pi shello hechzik katane hachi kaamar af al pi shehechzik mishshechashecha kevan dela hava leh lehachzik mibbeod yom eno oser
Katane mihat resha oser ammay oser nivattel
May oser dekatane ad sheyevattel
Rabbi yochanan amar matnitin manni bet shammay hi deamri en bitul reshut beshabbat ditnan meematay notnin reshut bet shammay omrim mibbeod yom uvet hillel omrim mishshettechshach
Amar ulla may tama devet hillel naasa keomer kelach etzel yafot
Amar abbaye met goy beshabbat may kelach etzel yafot ika
Ella hacha beha kamipalgi bet shammay savri bitul reshut mikne reshuta hu umikne reshuta beshabbat asur uvet hillel savri istalloke reshuta bealma hu veistalloke reshuta beshabbat shappir dame
Matni baal habbayit shehaya shuttaf lishchenav laze beyayin velaze beyayin enan tzerichin learev
Laze beyayin velaze beshemen tzerichin learev rabbi shimon omer echad ze veechad ze enan tzerichin learev

Gema amar rav uvichli echad amar rava dayeka name dekatane laze beyayin velaze beshemen tzerichin learev i amratte bishlama resha bichli echad vesefa bishne chelim shappir ella i amratte resha bishne chelim vesefa bishne chelim ma li yayin vayayin ma li yayin vashemen
Amar leh abbaye yayin vayayin rauy learev yayin veshemen en rauy learev
Rabbi shimon omer echad ze veechad ze en tzerichin learev vaafilu laze beyayin velaze beshemen amar rabba hacha bemay askinan bechatzer shebben shene mevoot verabbi shimon letameh

Ditnan amar rabbi shimon lema haddavar dome leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo uftuchot lirshut harabbim ervu shettayim hachitzonot im haemtzait hi mutteret immahen vehen muttarot immah ushtayim hachitzonot asurot zo im zo
Amar leh abbaye mi dame hatam katane shettayim hachitzonot asurot hacha katane en tzerichin learev kelal
May en tzerichin learev shechenim bahade baal habbayit aval shechenim bahade hadade tzerichin learev
b: Verav yosef amar rabbi shimon verabbanan biflugta derabbi yochanan ben nuri verabbanan ka mipalgi ditnan shemen shetztzaf al gabbe yayin venaga tevul yom beshemen lo pasal ella shemen bilvad verabbi yochanan ben nuri omer shenehen chiburin ze laze
Rabbanan kerabbanan verabbi shimon kerabbi yochanan ben nuri
Tanya rabbi eliezer ben tadday omer echad ze veechad ze tzerichin learev vaafilu laze beyayin velaze beyayin
Amar rabba ze ba bilgino veshafach vaze ba bilgino veshafach kulle alma la peligi dehave eruv
Ki peligi kegon shellakchu chavit shel yayin beshuttafut rabbi eliezer ben tadday savar en berera verabbanan savri yesh berera
Rav yosef amar rabbi eliezer ben tadday verabbanan besomchin al shituf bimkom eruv kamipalgi
Demar savar en somchin umar savar somchin
Amar rav yosef mena amena lah deamar rav yehuda amar rav halacha kerabbi meir veamar rav berona amar rav halacha kerabbi eliezer ben tadday may tama lav mishshum dechad tama hu
Amar leh abbaye vei chad tama tarte hilcheta lema li ha ka mashma lan dela avdinan kitre chumre beeruvin
May rabbi meir umay rabbanan detanya mearvin bachatzerot befat veim ratzu learev beyayin en mearvin mishtattefin bemavoy beyayin veim ratzu lehishtattef befat mishtattefin
Mearvin bachatzerot umishtattefin bemavoy shello leshakkeach torat eruv min hattinokot sheyyomru avotenu lo ervu divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim o mearvin o mishtattefin
Peligi bah rabbi nechumi verabba chad amar befat dechulle alma la peligi devachada saggi ki peligi beyayin

a: Vechad amar beyayin dechulle alma la peligi devaenan tarte ki peligi befat
Metivi vachachamim omrim o mearvin o mishtattefin may lav o mearvin bechatzer befat o mishtattefin bemavoy beyayin
Amar rav gidel amar rav hachi kaamar o mearvin bechatzer befat umuttarin kan vechan o mishtattefin bemavoy befat umuttarin kan vechan
Amar rav yehuda amar rav halacha kerabbi meir verav huna amar minhag kerabbi meir verabbi yochanan amar nahagu haam kerabbi meir
Matni chamishsha chavurot sheshshavtu bitraklin echad bet shammay omrim eruv lechol chavura vachavura uvet hillel omrim eruv echad lechullan
Umodim bizman shemmiktzatan sheruyin bachadarim o baaliyyot shehen tzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura
Gema amar rav nachman machloket bimsifas aval bimchitza asara divre hakkol eruv lechol chavura vachavura ika deamri amar rav nachman af bimsifas machloket

Peligi bah rabbi chiyya verabbi shimon berabbi chad amar machloket bimchitzot hammaggiot lattikra aval mechitzot sheen maggiot lattikra divre hakkol eruv echad lechullan vechad amar machloket bimchitzot sheen maggiot lattikra aval mechitzot hammaggiot lattikra divre hakkol tzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura
b: Metivi amar rabbi yehuda hassabbar lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mechitzot hammaggiot lattikra shetztzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura al ma nechleku al mechitzot sheen maggiot lattikra shebbet shammay omrim eruv lechol chavura vachavura uvet hillel omrim eruv echad lechullan
Leman deamar bimchitzot hammaggiot lattikra machloket teuvta ulman deamar bimchitzot sheen maggiot lattikra machloket siyyata lehach lishana deamar rav nachman machloket bimsifas teuvta
Lehach lishana deamar rav nachman af bimsifas machloket lema tihve teuvta
Amar lecha rav nachman peligi bimchitza vehu haddin bimsifas vehay deka mipalgi bimchitza lehodiacha kochan devet hillel
Veliflegi bimsifas lehodiacha kochan devet shammay koach dehetera adif
Amar rav nachman amar rav halacha kerabbi yehuda hassabbar

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak matnitin name dayeka dekatane umodim bizman shemmiktzatan sheruyin bachadarim uvaaliyyot shetztzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura may chadarim umay aliyyot ilema chadarim chadarim mammash vaaliyyot aliyyot mammash peshita ella lav keen chadarim keen aliyyot umay nihu mechitzot hammaggiot lattikra shema minah
Tana bamme devarim amurim keshemmolichin et eruvan lemakom acher aval im haya eruvan ba etzlan divre hakkol eruv echad lechullan
Keman azla ha detanya chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan keshemmolichin et eruvan lemakom acher eruv echad lechullan keman kevet hillel
Veika deamri bamme devarim amurim keshehaya eruv ba etzlan aval im hau molichin et eruvan lemakom acher divre hakkol tzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura
Keman azla ha detanya chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan keshemmolichin et eruvan lemakom acher eruv echad lechullan keman dela kechad
Matni haachin shehau ochlin al shulchan avihem vishenim bevattehem tzerichin eruv lechol echad veechad lefichach im shachach echad mehem velo erav mevattel et reshuto
Ematay bizman shemmolichin eruvan bimkom acher aval im haya eruv ba etzlan o sheen immahen daorin bechatzer enan tzerichin learev
Gema shema minah mekom lina gorem amar rav yehuda amar rav bimkabbele feras shanu

Tanu rabbanan mi sheyyesh lo bet shaar achsadra umirpeset bachatzar chavero hare ze en oser alav et bet hatteven veet bet habbakar bet haetzim uvet haotzarot hare ze oser alav rabbi yehuda omer eno oser ella mekom dira bilvad
Amar rabbi yehuda maase beven nappacha shehau lo chamesh chatzerot beusha uva maase lifne chachamim veamru eno oser ella bet dira bilvad
Bet dira salka datach ella ema mekom dira
May mekom dira rav amar

a: Mekom pita ushmuel amar mekom lina
Metivi haroim vehakkayyatzin vehabburganin veshomre ferot bizman sheddarkan lalin bair hare hen keanshe hair bizman sheddarkan lalin bassade yesh lahem alpayim lechol ruach
Hatam anan sahadi dei mamtu lehu rifta hatam tefe nicha lehu

Amar rav yosef la shemia li ha shemata amar leh abbaye atte amarte nihalan veaha amarte nihalan haachin shehau ochlin al shulchan avihen vishenim bevattehen tzerichin eruv lechol echad veechad veamrinan lach shema minah mekom lina gorem vaamarte lan alah amar rav yehuda amar rav bimkabbele feras shanu
Tanu rabbanan mi sheyyesh lo chamesh nashim mekabbelot peras mibbaalehen vachamishsha avadim mekabbelin peras merabbehen rabbi yehuda ben betira mattir bannashim veoser baavadim
Rabbi yehuda ben bava mattir baavadim veoser bannashim
Amar rav may tama derabbi yehuda ben bava dichtiv vedaniyyel bitra malka
Peshita ben etzel aviv kedaamaran ishsha etzel balah veeved etzel rabbo pelugta derabbi yehuda ben betira verabbi yehuda ben bava talmid etzel rabbo may

Ta shema derav be rabbi chiyya amar en anu tzerichin learev shehare anu somchin al shulchano shel rabbi chiyya verabbi chiyya be rabbi amar en anu tzerichin learev shehare anu somchin al shulchano shel rabbi
Bea mineh abbaye merabba chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan keshemmolichin et eruvan lemakom acher eruv echad lechullan o tzerichin eruv lechol echad veechad amar leh eruv echad lechullan
Veha achin dechi gavu damu vekatane tzerichin eruv lechol echad veechad hacha bemay askinan kegon deika daorin bahadayehu demiggo dehane asri hane name asri
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane ematay bizman shemmolichin et eruvan bemakom acher aval im haya eruvan ba etzlam o sheen daorin immahen bechatzer en tzerichin learev shema minah

Bea mineh rav chiyya bar avin merav sheshet bene ve rav deachli nahama bevaga veatu uvayeti beve rav ki mashchinan lehu techuma mibbe rav mashchinan lehu o mibbaga mashchinan lehu amar leh mashchinan mibbe rav
Vahare noten et eruvo betoch alpayim amma veate uvayet beveteh demashchinan leh techuma meeruveh
Behahu anan sahadi uvhada anan sahadi behahu anan sahadi dei mitdar leh hatam nicha leh uvahada anan sahadi dei mayetu lehu rifta leve rav nicha lehu tefe
Bae rame bar chama merav chisda av uvno harav vetalmido kerabbim damu o kichidim damu tzerichin eruv o en tzerichin eruv mavoy shellahen nitar belechi vekora o en nitar belechi vekora
Amar leh tenetuha av uvno harav vetalmido bizman sheen immahen daorin hare hen kichidim veen tzerichin learev umavoy shellahen nitar belechi vekora
Matni chamesh chatzerot petuchot zo lazo uftuchot lemavoy ervu bachatzerot velo nishtattefu bammavoy muttarin bachatzerot vaasurin bemavoy
b: Veim nishtattefu bammavoy muttarin kan vechan
Ervu bachatzerot venishtattefu bammavoy veshachach echad mibbene chatzer velo erav muttarin kan vechan
Mibbene mavoy velo nishtattef muttarin bachatzerot vaasurin bammavoy shehammavoy lachatzerot kechatzer labbattim
Gema manni rabbi meir hi deamar bainan eruv uvainan shituf
Ema metziata veim nishtattefu bammavoy muttarin kan vechan atan lerabbanan deamri bachada saggi
Ha la kashya veim nishtattefu name kaamar

Ema sefa ervu bachatzerot venishtattefu bammavoy veshachach echad mibbene chatzer velo erav muttarim kan vechan hechi dame i dela battel ammay muttarim ella peshita devattel ema sefa shachach echad mibbene mavoy velo nishtattefu muttarin bachatzerot vaasurin bammavoy vei devattel ammay asurin bammavoy
Vechi tema kasavar rabbi meir en bitul reshut bemavoy veha tanya shehare bitel lachem reshuto divre rabbi meir
Ella peshita dela battel umiddesefa dela battel resha name dela battel resha vesefa rabbi meir metziata rabbanan
Kullah rabbi meir hi vetama may amar rabbi meir bainan eruv uvainan shituf shello leshakkeach torat eruv min hattinokot vehacha kevan derubbah ervu la mishtachcha
Amar rav yehuda rav la tane petuchot zo lazo vechen amar rav kahana rav la tane petuchot zo lazo ika deamri rav kahana gufeh la tane petuchot zo lazo
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef may tama dela tane petuchot zo lazo kasavar kol shituf sheen machniso umotzio derech petachim bammavoy lav shemeh shituf
Etiveh baal habbayit shehaya shuttaf lishchenav laze beyayin velaze beyayin en tzerichin learev hatam deappekeh veayeleh
Etiveh ketzad mishtattefin bammavoy vechu hatam name deappekeh veayeleh

Matkef lah rabba bar chanan ella meatta hikna lo pat besallo hachi name dela have shituf vechi tema hachi name veha amar rav yehuda amar rav bene chavura shehau mesubbin vekiddesh alehen hayyom happat sheal shulchan somchim aleha mishshum eruv veamri lah mishshum shituf
Veamar rabba la peligi kan bimsubbin babbayit kan bamsubbin bechatzer
Ella tama derav deka savar en mavoy nitar belechi vekora ad sheyehu battim vachatzerot petuchim letocho
Gufa amar rav en mavoy nitar belechi vekora

a: Ad sheyehu battim vachatzerot petuchin letocho ushmuel amar afilu bayit echad vechatzer achat verabbi yochanan amar afilu churba
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef amar rabbi yochanan afilu bishvil shel keramim amar leh la amar rabbi yochanan ella bechurba dachaze ledira aval shevil shel keramim dela chaze ledira la

Amar rav huna bar chinana veazda rabbi yochanan letameh ditnan amar rabbi shimon echad gaggot veechad karpefot veechad chatzerot reshut achat hen lechelim sheshshavtu letochan velo lechelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit
Veamar rav halacha kerabbi shimon vehu shello ervu aval ervu gazrinan dilma ate leappoke mane devattim lechatzer

Ushmuel amar ben ervu uven lo ervu vechen amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi shimon ben ervu uven lo ervu alma la gazrinan dilma ate leappoke mane devattim lechatzer hacha name la gazrinan dilma ate leappoke mane dechatzer lechurba
Yatev rav berona vekaamar leha shemata amar leh rabbi elazar bar be rav amar shemuel hachi amar leh in amar leh achvi li ushpizeh achvi leh ata lekammeh dishmuel amar leh amar mar hachi amar leh in
Veha mar hu deamar en lanu beeruvin ella kilshon mishnatenu shehammavoy lachatzerot kechatzer labbattim ishtik
Kabbelah mineh o la kabbelah mineh ta shema dehahu mevoa dahava dayar beh ayevut bar ihi avad leh lichya ushra leh shemuel
b: Ata rav anan shadyeh amar mevoa dedayarna beh veatena mishshemeh demar shemuel nete rav anan bar rav nishdeyeh min shema minah la kablah mineh
Leolam ema lach kablah mineh vehacha chazzana hu dahava achel nahama beveteh veate bayet beve chenishta
Veayevut bar ihi savar mekom pita garem ushmuel letameh deamar makom lina garem
Amar rav yehuda amar rav mavoy shetztzido echad goy vetzido echad yisrael en mearvin oto derech challonot lehattiro derech petachim lammavoy
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef amar rav afilu bechatzer amar leh in dei la amar may
Hava amena tama derav mishshum dekasavar en mavoy nitar belechi vekora ad sheyehu battim vachatzerot petuchin letocho
Vetarte lema li tzericha dei mehahi

a: Hava amena dirat goy shemah dira ka mashma lan dedirat goy lo shemah dira vei mehacha hava amena la yadana battim kamma ka mashma lan battim teren
Hashta deamar rav afilu chatzer tama derav deka savar asur laasot yachid bimkom goy
Amar rav yosef i hachi hayenu dishmana leh lerabbi tavla deamar goy goy tere zimne vela yadana may amar
Matni shette chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo erva happenimit velo erva hachitzona happenimit mutteret vehachitzona asura
Hachitzona velo happenimit shettehen asurot erva zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah zo mutteret bifne atzmah vezo mutteret bifne atzmah
Rabbi akiva oser hachitzona shedderisat haregel osartah vachachamim omrim en derisat haregel osartah
Shachach echad min hachitzona velo erav happenimit mutteret vehachitzona asura min happenimit velo erav shettehen asurot
Natnu eruvan bemakom echad veshachach echad ben min happenimit ben min hachitzona velo erav shettehen asurot veim hau shel yechidim enan tzerichin learev

Gema ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yannay zo divre rabbi akiva deamar afilu regel hammutteret bimkomah oseret shello bimkomah aval chachamim omrim keshem sheregel hammutteret enah oseret kach regel haasura enah oseret
Tenan erva chitzona velo penimit shettehen asurot manni ilema rabbi akiva may irya regel asura afilu regel mutteret name ella lav rabbanan
Leolam rabbi akiva velo zo af zo katane
Tenan erva zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah zo mutteret bifne atzmah vezo mutteret bifne atzmah tama deerva ha lo erva shettehen asurot

Veha hay tanna deamar regel hammutteret enah oseret regel haasura oseret manni ha ilema rabbi akiva hi afilu regel hammutteret name ella lav rabbanan hi veod middesefa rabbi akiva resha lav rabbi akiva

Kullah rabbi akiva hi vechassore michassera vehachi katane erva zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah zo mutteret bifne atzmah vezo mutteret bifne atzmah bamme devarim amurim sheasta dakka aval lo asta dakka chitzona asura divre rabbi akiva sherabbi akiva oser et hachitzona mippene shedderisat haregel oseret vachachamim omrim en derisat haregel oseret
Metiv rav bivi bar abbaye veim hau shel yechidim en tzerichin learev ha shel rabbim tzerichin learev alma regel hammutteret bimkomah enah oseret regel haasura oseret

Veod metiv ravina shachach echad min hachitzona velo erav happenimit mutteret vechitzona asura shachach echad min happenimit velo erav shettehen asurot tama deshechach ha la shachach shettehen muttarot alma regel hammutteret enah oseret regel haasura oseret

Ella ki ata ravin amar rabbi yannay shalosh machlokot baddavar tanna kamma savar regel hammutteret enah oseret regel haasura oseret rabbi akiva savar afilu regel hammutteret oseret verabbanan batrae savri keshem sheregel mutteret enah oseret kach regel haasura enah oseret
Natnu eruvan bemakom echad veshachach echad ben min happenimit vechu may makom echad
Siman chitzona atzmah bevet yechidaa ravina dela meshakkach bifnim
Amar rav yehuda amar rav chitzona umay karu lah makom echad makom hamuchad lishtehen
b: Tanya name hachi natnu eruvan bachitzona veshachach echad ben min hachitzona uven min happenimit velo erav shettehen asurot natnu eruvan bappenimit veshachach echad min happenimit velo erav shettehen asurot min hachitzona velo erav shettehen asurot divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim bazo penimit mutteret vechitzona asura
Amar leh rabba bar chanan leabbaye may shena lerabbanan deamri penimit mutteret mishshum deachada dashsha umishtammesha lerabbi akiva name techad dashsha utshammesh amar leh eruv margilah
Lerabbanan name eruv margilah deamra letakkone shataftich vela leauote
Lerabbi akiva name tema letakkone shataftich vela leauote deamra lah mevattelinan lach reshuti verabbanan en bitul reshut mechatzer lechatzer
Lema shemuel verabbi yochanan biflugta derabbanan verabbi akiva ka mipalgi dishmuel amar kerabbanan verabbi yochanan deamar kerabbi akiva
Amar lecha shemuel ana daamari afilu lerabbi akiva ad kan la kaamar rabbi akiva hacha ella bishte chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo deasran ahadade aval hatam mi ka asran ahadade
Verabbi yochanan amar ana daamari afilu lerabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hacha ella deamra lah addimvattelatte li ka asratte illay aval hatam mi kaasra alah
Veim hau shel yechidim vechu amar rav yosef tane rabbi hau shelosha asurin

Amar lehu rav bivi la tetzitu leh ana amritah nihaleh umishshemeh derav adda bar ahava amritah nihaleh hoil vaani kore bahen rabbim bachitzona amar rav yosef mareh deavraham rabbim berabbi ichallaf li
Ushmuel amar leolam muttarot ad sheyehu shenayim bappenimit veechad bachitzona
Amar rabbi elazar vegoy hare hu kerabbim may shena yisrael dela asar deman deyada yada uman dela yada savar arove arev goy name amrinan deyada yada dela yada savar agire ogar
Setam goy i ita deogar mifa pae
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel asara battim ze lifnim mizze penimi noten et eruvo vedayyo
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu chitzon chitzon bet shaar hu chitzon shel penimi
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar bet shaar deyachid shemeh bet shaar umar savar la shemeh bet shaar
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav shette chatzerot ushlosha battim benehen ze ba derech ze venoten eruvo baze veze ba derech ze venoten eruvo baze

a: Ze naase bet shaar laze veze naase bet shaar laze emtzai have leh bayit shemmannichin bo eruv veen tzarich liten et happat

Badek lehu rachava lerabbanan shette chatzerot ushne vattim benehem ze ba derech ze venatan eruvo baze vaze ba derech ze venatan eruvo baze kanu eruv o la mi meshavet lehu legabbe dehay bayit ulgabbe dehay bet shaar ulgabbe dehay bet shaar ulgabbe dehay bayit
Amaru leh shenehen lo kanu eruv ma nafshach i bet shaar meshavet leh hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar achsadra umirpeset eno eruv i bayit meshavet leh ka metaltel levayit dela mearev leh

Umay shena midderava deamar rava amru lo shenayim tze vearev alenu leechad erav alav mibbeod yom ulechad erav alav ben hashshemashot ze sheerav alav mibbeod yom neechal eruvo ben hashshemashot veze sheerav alav ben hashshemashot neechal eruvo mishshettechshach shenehem kanu eruv
Hachi hashta hatam safek yemama safek lelya la minachra milta aval hacha i dilgabbe dehay bayit legabbe dehay bayit i legabbe dehay bet shaar legabbe dehay name bet shaar
Hadran alach haddar
Matni challon shebben shette chatzerot arbaa al arbaa betoch asara mearvin shenayim veim ratzu mearvin echad
Pachot mearbaa al arbaa o lemala measara mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad
Gema lema tenan setama kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar kol pachot mearbaa kelavud dame
Afilu tema kerabbanan ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel ella leinyan levudin aval leinyan pitcha afilu rabbanan modu dei ika arbaa al arbaa chashiv vei la la chashiv
Pachot mearbaa vechu peshita kevan deamar arbaa al arbaa betoch asara mimmela ana yadana defachot mearbaa ulmala measara la
Ha ka mashma lan tama dechulleh lemala measara aval miktzato betoch asara mearvin shenayim veim ratzu mearvin echad
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan kullo lemala measara umiktzato betoch asara kullo betoch asara umiktzato lemala measara mearvin shenayim veim ratzu mearvin echad
Hashta kullo lemala measara umiktzato betoch asara amratte mearvin shenayim veim ratzu mearvin echad kullo betoch asara umiktzato lemala measara mibaya
Zo veen tzarich lomar zo katane
Amar rabbi yochanan challon agol tzarich sheyehe behekefo esrim vearbaa tefachim ushnayim umashshehu mehen betoch asara sheim yerabbeennu nimtza mashshehu betoch asara
Mikkedi kol sheyyesh behekefo shelosha tefachim yesh bo berochbo tefach bitresar saggi
b: Hane mile beigula aval beribua bainan tefe
Mikkede kamma merubba yater al heagol revia beshitsar saggi
Hane mile igula denafek miggo ribua aval ribua denafek miggo igula bainan tefe may tama mishshum mursha dekarnata
Mikkede kol ammeta beribua ammeta utre chummeshe baalachsona beshevsar neche chumsha saggi
Rabbi yochanan amar ki dayyane dekesari veamri lah kerabbanan dekesari deamri igula miggo ribua riva ribua miggo igula palga

Pachot mearbaa al arbaa vechu amar rav nachman lo shanu ella challon shebben shette chatzerot aval challon shebben shene vattim afilu lemala measara name im ratzu learev mearvin echad may tama beta keman dimle dame

Etiveh rava lerav nachman echad li challon shebben shette chatzerot veechad li challon shebben shene vattim veechad li challon shebben shette aliyyot veechad li challon shebben shene gaggin veechad li challon shebben shene chadarim kullan arbaa al arbaa betoch asara
Targuma achatzerot veha echad li katane targuma aarbaa al arbaa
Bea mineh rabbi abba merav nachman lul happatuach min bayit laaliyya tzarich sullam kavua lehattiro o en tzarich sullam kavua lehattiro
Ki amrinan beta keman dimle dame hane mile min hatztzad aval baemtza la o dilma la shena
Amar leh eno tzarich sevur mina sullam kavua hu deeno tzarich ha sullam aray tzarich itmar amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman echad sullam kavua veechad sullam aray eno tzarich
Matni kotel shebben shette chatzerot gavoha asara verochav arbaa mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad
Hau berosho perot ellu olin mikkan veochlin veellu olin mikkan veochlin uvilvad shello yoridu lemattan
Nifretza hakkotel ad eser ammot mearvin shenayim veim ratzu mearvin echad mippene shehu kefetach yoter mikkan mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim
Gema en bo arbaa may amar rav avir shette reshuot sholetet bo lo yaziz bo afilu melo nima

a: Verabbi yochanan amar ellu maalin mikkan veochlin veellu maalin mikkan veochlin
Tenan ellu olin mikkan veochlin veellu olin mikkan veochlin olin in maalin la
Hachi kaamar yesh bo arbaa al arbaa olin in maalin la en bo arbaa al arbaa maalin name
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan makom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa muttar livne reshut harabbim velivne reshut hayyachid lechattef alav uvilvad shello yachalifu
Verav let leh derav dimi i birshuot deorayeta hachi name
Hacha bemay askinan birshuot derabbanan vachachamim asu chizuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora
Amar rabba amar rav huna amar rav nachman kotel shebben shette chatzerot tzido echad gavoha asara tefachim vetzido echad shave laaretz notnin oto laze sheshshave laaretz
Mishshum dehave laze tashmisho benachat velaze tashmisho bekashe vechol laze benachat velaze bekashe notnin oto laze shettashmisho benachat

Amar rav shezvi amar rav nachman charitz shebben shette chatzerot tzido echad amok asara vetzido echad shave laaretz notnin oto laze sheshshave laaretz mishshum dehave leh laze tashmisho benachat velaze tashmisho bekashe vechu
Utzrichi dei ashmeinan kotel mishshum divguvha mishtammeshi inashe aval charitz beumka la mishtammeshi inashe ema la
Vei ashmeinan becharitz mishshum dela beita tashmishta aval kotel divita tashmishta ema la tzericha
Ba lemaato im yesh bemiuto arbaa muttar lehishtammesh bechol hakkotel kullo veim lav en mishtammesh ella keneged hammiut
Ma nafshach i ahani miuta bechulleh kotel lishtammesh i la ahani afilu keneged hammiut name la amar ravina kegon sheakar chulya merosho
Amar rav yechiel kafa sefel memaet
Veammay davar hannital beshabbat hu vedavar hannital beshabbat eno memaet la tzericha dechabbereh beara
Vechi chabbereh beara may have veha tanya pagga shehitminah beteven vacharara shehitminah begechalim im megulla miktzatah nittelet beshabbat
Hacha bemay askinan deit leh ognayim
Vechi it leh ognayim may have vehatnan hattomen lefet utznon tachat haggefen bizman
b: Shemmiktzat alin megullin eno choshesh lo mishshum kilayim velo mishshum maaser velo mishshum sheviit venitalin bashshabbat
La tzericha devae mara vachatzina
Sullam hammitzri eno memaet vehatztzori memaet hechi dame sullam hammitzri amri deve rabbi yannay kol sheen lo arbaa chaokim

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe may tama desullam hammitzri dela memaet amar leh la shemia lach ha deamar rav acha bar adda amar rav hamnuna amar rav mishshum dehave leh davar shennital beshabbat vechol davar shennital beshabbat eno memaet
I hachi afilu tzori name hatam kovdo kovo
Amar abbaye kotel shebben shette chatzerot gavoha asara tefachim vehinniach sullam rachav arbaa mikkan vesullam rachav arbaa mikkan veen ben ze laze shelosha tefachim memaet shelosha eno memaet
Vela amaran ella dela have kotel arbaa aval have kotel arbaa afilu muflag tuva name
Amar rav bivi bar abbaye bana itzteva al gav itzteva im yesh baitzteva hattachtona arbaa memaet i name en battachtona arbaa veyesh baelona arbaa veen ben ze laze shelosha memaet

Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh sullam sheshshelivotav porchot im yesh bashsheliva hattachtona arbaa memaet i name en bashsheliva hattachtona arbaa veyesh bashsheliva haelona arbaa veen ben ze laze shelosha memaet
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh

a: Ziz hayyotze min hakkotel arbaa al arbaa vehinniach alav sullam kol shehu miato
Vela amaran ella deotveh aleh aval otveh bahadeh aroche arvecheh
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh kotel tisha asar tzarich ziz echad lehattiro
Kotel esrim tzarich shene zizim lehattiro amar rav chisda vehu sheheemidan ze shello keneged ze
Amar rav huna ammud birshut harabbim gavoha asara verachav arbaa venaatz bo yated kol shehu miato
Amar rav adda bar ahava uvgavoha shelosha abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu af al pi sheen gavoha shelosha
May tama la mishtammesh leh
Rav ashe amar afilu sheggavoha shelosha may tama efshar detale beh mide
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe milleo kullo bitedot mahu
Amar leh la shemia lach ha deamar rabbi yochanan bor vechulyatah mitztaref laasara
Veammay ha la mishtammesh leh ella may it lach lememar demannach mide umishtammesh hacha name demannach mide umishtammesh
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kotel asara tzarich sullam arbaa asar lehattiro rav yosef amar afilu shelosha asar umashshehu
Abbaye amar afilu achad asar umashshehu
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar afilu shiva umashshehu
Amar rav sullam zakuf memaet gemara vela yadana may tama

O dilma afilu lerabbanan pitcha hu vearya dirvia aleh

Ashera sheisur davar acher gorem lo la nitsar

Gema veteven la chayetz veha anan tenan matben shebben shette chatzerot gavoha asara tefachim mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad

Dekaem lah beappah veazla veachla

Ketzad hu ose noel et beto umvattel et reshuto hu asur vachavero muttar
Vechen atta omer begov shel teven shebben shene techume shabbat katane mihat ze noten letoch kuppato veyaachil veze noten letoch kuppato veyaachil
Amri bayit kevan deika mechitzot vettikra ki mipchit minachra leh milleta hacha la minachra leh milleta
Nitmaet hatteven measara tefachim shenehen asurin ha asara shere veaf al gav demidalya tikra tuva shema minah mechitzot sheen maggiot lattikra sheman mechitzot
Amar abbaye hacha bevayit shelosha asar chaser mashshehu askinan veteven asara

Amar ammemar ha name save defumbedita amrinhu deitmar ezo hi ashera setam

a: Veen toamin mipperoteha
Ushmuel amar kegon deamri hane tamre leshichra deve nitzrefe deshatu leh beom chaggam amar ammemar vaamaru li save defumbedita hilcheta keoteh dishmuel
Metivi ketzad mishtattefin bemavoy meviim chavit shel yayin veshel shemen veshel temarim veshel gerogrot veshel shear mine perot
Im mishshello tzarich lezakkot veim mishshellahen tzarich lehodia umagbiha min hakkarka mashshehu may mashshehu name dekaamar tefach
Itmar shitufe mevoot rav amar en tzarich lezakkot ushmuel amar tzarich lezakkot eruve techumin rav amar tzarich lezakkot ushmuel amar en tzarich lezakkot
Bishlama lishmuel hacha tenan vehacha la tenan ella lerav may tama
Tannae hi deamar rav yehuda amar rav maase bechallato shel rabbi oshaya shehalcha levet hammerchatz vechashcha lah veerva lah chamotah
Uva maase lifne rabbi chiyya veasar amar lo rabbi yishmael berabbi yose bavlay kol kach atta machmir beeruvin kach amar abba kol sheyyesh lecha lehakel beeruvin hakel
Veibbaya lehu mishshel chamotah erva lah umishshum delo zikta lah o dilma mishshellah erva lah umishshum deshello middatah
Amar lahen hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh ledidi miparsha lah mineh derabbi yochanan mishshel chamotah erva umishshum delo zikta lah
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi yaakov bereh devat yaakov ki matet hatam akkef vezil lesullama detzor uvaya mineh merav yaakov bar idi
Bea mineh mishshel chamotah erva umishshum delo zikta lah o dilma mishshellah erva umishshum deshello middatah
Amar leh mishshel chamotah erva lah umishshum delo zikta lah
Amar rav nachman naktinan echad eruve techumin veechad eruve chatzerot echad shitufe mevoot tzarich lezakkot bae rav nachman eruve tavshilin tzarich lezakkot o en tzarich lezakkot
Amar rav yosef umay tibe leh la shemia leh ha deamar rav nachman bar rav adda amar shemuel eruve tavshilin tzarich lezakkot amar leh abbaye peshita dela shemia leh dei shemia leh may tibe leh
Amar leh attu eruve techumin mi la amar shemuel en tzarich lezakkot veamar ihu tzarich lezakkot
Hachi hashta bishlama hatam peligi rav ushmuel veka mashma lan kechumrin demar vechi chumrin demar aval hacha i ita dishmia leh mi ika deman diflig
Hahu turzina dahava beshivavuteh derabbi zera amaru leh ogar lan reshutach la ogar lehu ato lekammeh derabbi zera amaru leh mahu lemegar middevethu
Amar lehu hachi amar resh lakish mishshemeh degavra rabba umannu rabbi chanina ishto shel adam mearevet shello middato

Ittemar rav chiyya bar ashe amar osin lechi ashera verabbi shimon ben lakish amar osin kora ashera

Matni nitmaet haochel mosif umzakke veen tzarich lehodia nittosfu alehen mosif umzakke vetzarich lehodia
Kamma hu shiuran bizman shehen merubbin mezon shette seudot lechullam bizman shehen muatin kigrogeret lechol echad veechad
Amar rabbi yose bamme devarim amurim bitchilat eruv aval bishyare eruv kol shehu

Ibaet ema mimmin echad veibaet ema mishshene minin ibaet ema mimmin echad may nitmaet nitmatmet
Veibaet ema mishshene minin kala shane

Ditnan amar rabbi yehuda bamme devarim amurim beeruve techumin aval beeruve chatzerot mearvin ben ledaat uven shello ledaat peshita dachalukin
Mahu detema hane mile bechatzer shebben shene mevoot aval chatzer shel mavoy echad ema la kamashma lan
Kamma hu shiuro vechu kamma hu merubbin amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shemone esre bene adam shemone esre vetu la ema mishshemone esre veelach

Veaggav orcheh ka mashma lan dishte seudot haveyan shemone esre gerogrot

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe halacha mikkelal difligi vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol makom sheamar rabbi yehuda ematay uvamme bemishnatenu eno ella lefaresh divre chachamim

Vei dirushalmit mea shivim veshalosh haveya
Vei detziporit matayim vesheva haveyan
Leolam detziporit ayeti challeta shedi alayehu
Challeta kamma haveyan tamne akkatti batzar leh
Ella ayeti veodot derabbi shedi alayehu
I hachi have leh tefe kevan dela have kevetza la chashev leh
Tanu rabbanan sea yerushalmit yetera al midbarit shetut veshel tziporit yetera al yerushalmit shetut nimtzet shel tziporit yetera al midbarit shelish
Shelish deman ilema shelish demidbarit mikkedi shelish demidbarit kamma have arbein utmanya veilu udpa shitin utlat
Veella shelish dirushalmit shelish didah kamma have chamshin utmanya neche tilta veilu udpa shittin utlat veella detzipori shelish didah kamma have shivin neche chada veilu udpa shishshim veshalosh
Ella amar rabbi yirmeya hachi kaamar nimtzet sea shel tzipori yetera al midbarit karov lishlish shellah ushlish shellah karov lemechetza demidbarit
Matkef lah ravina mide karov karov katane ella amar ravina hachi kaamar nimtzet shelish shel tzipori biveodaot shel rabbi yetera al mechetza shel midbarit shelish betza
Tanu rabbanan reshit arisotechem
b: Kede isotechem vechamma isotechem kede isat hammidbar vechamma isat hammidbar
Dichtiv vehaomer asirit haefa hu mikkan amru shiva revaim kemach vaod chayyevet bechalla shehen shishsha shel yerushalmit shehen chamishsha shel tzipori
Mikkan amru haochel kemidda zo hare ze bari umvorach yater al ken raavtan pachot mikkan mekulkal bemeav
Matni anshe chatzer veanshe mirpeset sheshshachchu velo ervu kol sheggavoha asara tefachim lemirpeset pachot mikkan lechatzer
Chulyat habbor vehassela gevohim asara tefachim lammirpeset pachot mikkan lechatzer
Bamme devarim amurim bismucha aval bemufleget afilu gavoha asara tefachim lechatzer veezo hi semucha kol sheenah rechoka arbaa tefachim
Gema peshita laze befetach velaze befetach hayenu challon shebben shette chatzerot
Laze bizrika velaze bizrika hayenu kotel shebben shette chatzerot laze beshilshul velaze beshilshul hayenu charitz shebben shette chatzerot
Laze befetach velaze bizrika hayenu derabba bar rav huna amar rav nachman laze befetach velaze beshilshul hayenu derav shezvi amar rav nachman
Laze beshilshul velaze bizrika may

Amar rav shenehen asurin ushmuel amar notnin oto laze shebbeshilshul shellaze tashmisho benachat velaze tashmisho bekashe vechol davar shettashmisho laze benachat velaze bekashe notnim oto laze shettashmisho benachat
Tenan anshe chatzer veanshe mirpeset sheshshachchu velo ervu kal sheggavoha asara tefachim lammirpeset pachot mikkan lechatzer
Ka salka datach may mirpeset

a: Bene aliyya umay karu lah mirpeset dekasalki bemirpeset alma kal laze beshilshul velaze bizrika notnin oto laze shebbeshilshul
Kidamar rav huna leotan haddarim bammirpeset hachi name leotan haddarin bammirpeset
I hachi ema sefa pachot mikkan lechatzer ammay laze befetach velaze befetach hu
May lechatzer af lechatzer ushnehen asurin
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane sefa bamme devarim amurim bismucha aval bemufleget afilu gavoha asara tefachim lechatzer may lechatzer ilema lechatzer ushre ammay reshuta detarvayehu hu
Ella may lechatzer af lechatzer ushnehen asurin hachi name may lechatzer af lechatzer ushnehen asurin shema minah
Tenan chulyat habbor vehassela shehen gevohin asara lammirpeset pachot mikkan lechatzer amar rav huna leotan haddarim bammirpeset
Tinach sela bor may ika lememar
Amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda hacha bevor melea mayim askinan veha chasra
Kevan dechi malya sharya ki chasra name sharya adderabba kevan dechi chasra asira ki malya name asira
Ella amar abbaye hacha bevor melea perot askinan veha chasri
Betivla
Dayeka name dekatane dumya desela shema minah
Ulma li lemitne bor ulma li lemitne sela tzericha dei ashmeinan sela deleka lemigzar aval bor ligzor zimnin demalya perot metukkanin tzericha

Ta shema anshe chatzer veanshe aliyya sheshshachchu velo ervu anshe chatzer mishtammeshin baasara hattachtonim veanshe aliyya mishtammeshin baasara haelonim ketzad ziz yotze min hakkotel lematta measara lechatzer lemala measara laaliyya
Ha devene bene asur
Amar rav nachman hacha bechotel tisha asar askinan veziz yotze mimmennu lematta measara laze befetach velaze beshilshul lemala measara laze befetach velaze bizrika
b: Ta shema shette gezuzteraot zo lemala mizzo asu laelona velo asu lattachtona shettehen asurot ad sheyearvu
Amar rav adda bar ahava bevain bene tachtona derech elona lemalloot
Abbaye amar kegon dekayyamin betoch asara dahadade vela mibaya kaamar la mibaya asu lattachtona velo asu laelona daasiri dechevan divgo asara dahadade kayyamin asran ahadade
Ella afilu asu laelona velo asu lattachtona salka datach amena kevan delaze benachat velaze bekashe litveh laze shettashmisho benachat ka mashma lan kevan divgo asara kayyamin asran ahadade

Ki ha deamar rav nachman amar shemuel gag hassamuch lirshut harabbim tzarich sullam kavua lehattiro sullam kavua in sullam aray la may tama lav mishshum dechevan divtoch asara dahadade kayemi asran ahadade
Matkef lah rav pappa vedilma kesherabbim mechattefin alav bechumta vesudara
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel

a: Bor shebben shette chatzerot mufleget mikkotel ze arbaa umikkotel ze arbaa ze motzi ziz kol shehu ummalle veze motzi ziz kol shehu ummalle verav yehuda dideh amar afilu kanya
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef ha derav yehuda dishmuel hi dei derav ha amar en adam oser al chavero derech avir
Vedishmuel mehecha ilema meha deamar rav nachman amar shemuel gag hassamuch lirshut harabbim tzarich sullam kavua lehattiro dilma kidrav pappa
Ella meha ze motzi ziz kol shehu ummalle veze motzi ziz kol shehu ummalle tama deappek ha la appek amrinan adam oser al chavero derech avir
Udrav mehecha ilema meha shette gezuzteraot zo lemala mizzo asu mechitza laelona velo asu mechitza lattachtona shettehen asurot ad sheyyaarvu
Veamar rav huna amar rav lo shanu ella bismucha aval bemufleget arbaa elona mutteret vetachtona asura
Dilma shane hacha dechevan delaze bizrika veshilshul velaze beshilshul lechodeh kelaze bizrika velaze befetach dame
Ella meha deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav shene vattim veshalosh choravot benehem ze mishtammesh bassamuch shello al yede zerika vaze mishtammesh bassamuch shello al yede zerika
b: Vehaemtzai asur
Yatev rav berona vekaamar leha shemata amar leh rabbi eliezer bar be rav amar rav hachi amar leh in achvi li ushpizeh achvi leh ata lekammeh derav amar leh amar mar hachi amar leh in
Amar leh veha mar hu deamar laze beshilshul velaze bizrika shenehen asurin
Amar leh mi savratte dekayemi keshura la dekayemi kachatzuva

Amar leh rav pappa lerava lema shemuel let leh derav dimi dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan makom sheen bo arba al arba muttar livne reshut harabbim velivne reshut hayyachid lechattef alav uvilvad shello yachalifu
Hatam reshuot deorayeta hacha reshuot derabbanan vachachamim asu chizuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora
Amar leh ravina lerava mi amar rav hachi veha itmar shene vattim mishshene tzide reshut harabbim rabba bar rav huna amar rav asur lizrok mizze laze ushmuel amar muttar lizrok mizze laze
Amar leh lav mi okemna demiddele chad umittatte chad zimnin demiggandar venafel veate leetoye
Matni hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar achsadra umirpeset eno eruv vehaddar sham eno oser alav
Bet hatteven uvet habbakar uvet haetzim uvet haotzarot hare ze eruv vehaddar sham oser rabbi yehuda omer im yesh sham tefisat yad shel baal habbayit eno oser

Gema amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat kol makom sheamru haddar sham eno oser hannoten et eruvo eno eruv chutz mibbet shaar deyachid vechol makom sheamru chachamim en mannichin bo eruv mannichin bo shituf chutz meavir mavoy
May ka mashma lan tenena hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar achsadra umirpeset eno eruv eruv hu dela have ha shituf have
Bet shaar deyachid vaavir demavoy itztericha leh dela tenan tanya name hachi hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar achsadra umirpeset uvchatzer uvmavoy hare ze eruv vehatnan en ze eruv ema hare ze shituf
Shituf bemavoy la mintar ema bechatzer shebbemavoy
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel bene chavura shehau mesubbin vekiddesh alehen hayyom pat sheal hashshulchan somchin alehen mishshum eruv veamri lah mishshum shituf
Amar rabba vela peligi kan bimsubbin babbayit kan bimsubbin bechatzer

Amar leh abbaye lerabba tanya dimsayya lach eruve chatzerot bechatzer veshitufe mevoot bammavoy vehavenan bah eruve chatzerot bechatzer vehatnan hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar achsadra umirpeset eno eruv ema eruve chatzerot babbayit shebbechatzer shitufe mevoot bechatzer shebbammavoy
Rabbi yehuda omer im yesh sham tefisat yad vechu hechi dame tefisat yad kegon chatzero shel bonyas
Ben bonyas ata lekammeh derabbi amar lehu pannu makom leven mea mane ata inish acharina amar lehu

a: Pannu makom leven matayim mane amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose rabbi aviv shel ze yesh lo elef sefinot bayyam uchnegdan elef ayarot bayyabbasha amar lo lichshettaggia etzel aviv emor lo al teshaggerehu bakkelim hallalu lefanay

Rabbi mechabbed ashirim rabbi akiva mechabbed ashirim kiddaresh rava bar mari yeshev olam lifne elohim chesed veemet man yintzeruhu ematay yeshev olam lifne elohim bizman shechesed veemet man yintzeruhu
Rabba bar bar chana amar kegon yated shel macharesha
Amar rav nachman tana deve shemuel davar hannital beshabbat oser davar sheeno nital beshabbat eno oser
Tanya name hachi yesh lo tevel yesh lo ashashit vechol davar sheeno nital beshabbat eno oser
Matni hammanniach beto vehalach lishbot beir acheret echad nochri veechad yisrael hare ze oser divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer eno oser
Rabbi yose omer nochri oser yisrael eno oser sheen derech yisrael lavo bashshabbat
Rabbi shimon omer afilu hinniach beto vehalach lishbot etzel bitto beotah hair eno oser shekkevar hissia millibbo
Gema amar rav halacha kerabbi shimon vedaveka bitto aval beno la deamri inashe nevach bach kalba ul nevach bach gurayeta pok
Matni bor shebben shette chatzerot en memallein mimmennu bashshabbat ella im ken asu lo mechitza gevoha asara tefachim ben millematta ben mittoch ogno
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer bet shammay omrim millematta uvet hillel omrim millemala amar rabbi yehuda lo tehe mechitza gedola min hakkotel shebbenehem
Gema amar rav huna lematta lematta mammash lemala lemala mammash veze vaze bevor verav yehuda amar lematta lematta min hammayim lemala lemala min hammayim
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanan leabbaye ha deamar rav yehuda lematta lematta min hammayim may shena lematta mammash dela daarivi mayya lematta min hammayim name ha arivi mayya
Amar leh la shemia lach ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav umatu bah mishshum rabbi chiyya tzarich sheyyerau roshan shel kanim lemala min hammayim tefach

Vetu ha deamar rav yehuda lemala lemala min hammayim may shena lemala mammash dela daarivi mayya lemala min hammayim name ha arivi mayya amar leh la shemia lach ha detane yaakov karchinaa tzarich sheyeshakka rashe kanim bammayim tefach
Veella ha deamar rav yehuda kora arba matteret bechurba verav nachman amar rabba bar avuh
b: Kora arbaa matteret bemayim
Ha ka azel deli leidach gisa umayete kim lehu lerabbanan deen deli mehallech yoter mearbaa tefachim

Tachat kora miha ha arivi mayya ella mishshum dekal hu shehekelu chachamim bemayim kediva mineh rabbi tavla merav mechitza teluya mahu shettattir bechurba amar leh en mechitza teluya matteret ella bemayim kal hu shehekelu chachamim bammayim
Amar rabbi yehuda lo tehe mechitza amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan rabbi yehuda beshitat rabbi yose amarah deamar mechitza teluya matteret afilu bayyabbasha
Ditnan hamshalshel defanot millemala lematta bizman sheggevohot min haaretz shelosha tefachim pesula mimmatta lemala im gevohot asara tefachim keshera
Rabbi yose omer keshem shemmillematta lemala asara kach millemala lematta asara
Vela hi la rabbi yehuda savar lah kerabbi yose vela rabbi yose savar lah kerabbi yehuda
Rabbi yehuda la savar lah kerabbi yose ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda ella beeruve chatzerot derabbanan aval sukka deorayeta la
Vela rabbi yose savar lah kerabbi yehuda ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose ella besukka deisur ase hu aval shabbat deisur sekila hu lo amar
Veim tomar oto maase shennaasa betzipori al pi mi naasa lo al pi rabbi yose ella al pi rabbi yishmael berabbi yose naasa
Dechi ata rav dimi amar paam achat shachchu velo heviu sefer tora mibbeod yom lemachar parsu sadin al haammudim veheviu sefer tora vekaru bo
Parsu lechattechila mi shere veha hakkol modim sheen osin ohel aray beshabbat
Ella matzu sedinin perusin al haammudim veheviu sefer tora vekaru bo

Amar rabba rabbi yehuda verabbi chananya ben akavya amru davar echad rabbi yehuda ha daamaran rabbi chananya ben akavya ditnan rabbi chananya ben akavya omer gezuztera sheyyesh bah arba ammot al arba ammot

a: Chokek bah arba al arba ummalle
Amar leh abbaye vedilma la hi ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam ella deamar gud achet mechitzta aval kof vegud la
Vead kan la kaamar rabbi chananya ben akavya hatam ella beyammah shel teverya hoil veyesh lah oganim vaayarot vekarpefot makkifot otah aval bishar memot lo
Amar abbaye uldivre rabbi chananya ben akavya hayeta semucha lakkotel befachot mishshelosha tefachim tzarich sheyehe orkah arba ammot verochbah achad asar umashshehu
Hayeta zekufa tzarich sheyehe govhah asara tefachim verochbah shishsha tefachim ushne mashshehuyin
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hayeta omedet bekeren zavit tzarich sheyehe govhah asara tefachim verochbah shene tefachim ushne mashshehuyin
Veella ha detanya rabbi chananya ben akavya omer gezuztera sheyyesh bah arba ammot al arba ammot chokek bah arbaa al arbaa ummalle hechi mashkachatte lah
Daavida ki asita

Matni ammat hammayim shehi overet bechatzer en memallein hemenna beshabbat ella im ken asu lah mechitza gevoha asara tefachim bichnisa uvitzia rabbi yehuda omer kotel sheal gabbah tidon mishshum mechitza
Amar rabbi yehuda maase beamma shel avel shehau memallein mimmenna al pi zekenim beshabbat amru lo mippene shello haya bah kashshiur

Gema tanu rabbanan asu lah bichnisa velo asu lah bitzia asu lah bitzia velo asu lah bichnisa en memallein hemenna beshabbat ella im ken asu lah mechitza asara tefachim bitzia uvichnisa rabbi yehuda omer kotel sheal gabbah tidon mishshum mechitza
Amar rabbi yehuda maase beammat hammayim shehayeta baa meavel letzippori vehau memallein hemenna beshabbat al pi hazzekenim
Amru lo mishsham reaya mippene shello hayeta amukka asara tefachim verochbah arbaa

Tanya idach ammat hammayim haoveret ben hachallonot pachot mishshelosha meshalshel deli ummalle shelosha en meshalshel deli ummalle rabban shimon ben gamliel omer pachot mearbaa meshalshel deli ummalle arbaa en meshalshel deli ummalle
Bemay askinan ilema beammat hammayim gufah veella ha dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan en karmelit pechuta mearbaa
Lema ketannae amrah lishmateh
Ella baagappeha ulhachlif
Veha ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan makom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa muttar livne reshut hayyachid velivne reshut harabbim lechattef alav uvilvad shello yachlifu
Hatam reshuot deorayeta
b: Hacha reshuot derabbanan
Veha rabbi yochanan barshuot derabbanan name amar detanya kotel shebben shette chatzerot gavoha asara tefachim verochav arbaa mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad
Hau berosho perot ellu olin mikkan veochlin veellu olin mikkan veochlin
Nifratz hakkotel ad eser ammot mearvin shenayim veim ratzu mearvin echad mippene shehu kefetach yoter mikkan mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim
Vehavenan bah en bo arbaa may amar rav avir shette reshuot sholetet bo velo yaziz bo melo nima
Verabbi yochanan amar ellu maalin mikkan veochlin veellu maalin mikkan veochlin
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan makom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa muttar livne reshut harabbim velivne reshut hayyachid lechattef alav uvilvad shello yachalifu
Hahi zeeri amrah velizeri kashya ha
Zeeri mokem lah beammat hammayim gufah verav dimi tannae hi
Vetihve ki chore karmelit
Abbaye bar avin verav chanina bar avin deamri tarvayehu en chorin lecharmelit
Rav ashe amar afilu tema yesh chorin lecharmelit hane mile bismucha hacha bemufleget
Ravina amar kegon daavad lah nifke appummah
Veazdu rabbanan letamayehu verabbi shimon ben gamliel letameh
Matni gezuztera shehi lemala min hammayim en memallein hemenna beshabbat ella im ken asu lah mechitza gevoha asara tefachim ben millemala ben millematta
Vechen shette gezuzteraot zo lemala mizzo asu leelona velo asu letachtona shettehen asurot ad sheyearvu
Gema matnitin dela kachananya ben akavya detanya chananya ben akavya omer gezuztera sheyyesh bah arba al arba ammot chokek bah arbaa al arbaa ummalle
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra lo hittir rabbi chananya ben akavya ella beyammah shel teverya hoil veyesh lah oganim vaayarot vekarpefot makkifot otah aval bishar memot lo
Tanu rabbanan shelosha devarim hittir rabbi chananya ben akavya leanshe teverya memallein mayim miggezuztera bashshabbat vetomnin beetza umistappegin baaluntit
Memallein mayim miggezuztera bashshabbat ha daamaran vetomnin beetza may hi detanya hishkim lehavi pesolet im bishvil sheyyesh alav tal hare hu bechi yuttan
Veim bishvil shello yibbatel mimmelachto eno bechi yuttan ustam

a: Anshe teverya kemi shello yivtal mimmelachto dame
Umistappegin baaluntit may hi detanya mistappeg adam baaluntit umannichah bachallon velo yimserenna laolyarin mippene shechashudin al oto davar rabbi shimon omer af meviah beyado letoch beto
Amar rabba bar rav huna lo shanu ella lemalloot aval lishpoch asur
Matkef lah rav shezvi vechi ma ben ze leuka
Hane tayemi vehane la tayemi
Ika deamri amar rabba bar rav huna la tema lemalloot hu dishre lishpoch asur ella lishpoch name shere amar rav shezvi peshita hayenu uka mahu detema hane tayemi vehane la tayemi ka mashma lan
Vechen shette gezuzteraot zo vechu amar rav huna amar rav lo shanu ella bismucha aval bemufleget elona mutteret
Verav letameh daamar rav en adam oser al chavero derech avir
Amar rabba amar rabbi chiyya verav yosef amar rabbi oshaya yesh gazel beshabbat vechurba machazir labbealim
Ha gufa kashya amratte yesh gazel beshabbat alma kanya vechurba machazir livalim alma la kanya
Hachi kaamar yesh din gazel beshabbat ketzad dechurba machazir labbealim
Amar rabba umotvinan ashshematin vechen shette gezuzteraot zo lemala mizzo vechu vei amratte yesh din gazel beshabbat ammay asurot
Amar rav sheshet hacha bemay askinan kegon sheasu mechitza beshuttafut
I hachi ki asu lattachtona name
Kevan deasu lattachtona galloye galli datah daana bahadach la nicha li
Matni chatzer shehi pechuta mearba ammot en shofchin betochah mayim beshabbat ella im ken asu lah uka machzeket satayim min hannekev ulmatta
Ben mibbachutz ben mibbifnim ella shemmibbachutz tzarich likmor mibbifnim en tzarich likmor

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer biv shehu kamur arba ammot birshut harabbim shofchim letocho mayim bashshabbat vachachamim omrim afilu gag o chatzer mea amma lo yishpoch al pi habbiv aval shofech hu laggag vehammayim yordin labbiv
Hechatzer vehaachsadra mitztarfin learba ammot vechen shette deotaot zo keneged zo miktzatan asu uka umiktzatan lo asu uka et sheasu uka muttarin et shello asu uka asurin
Gema may tama amar rabba mippene sheadam asuy lehistappek satayim mayim bechol yom bearba ammot adam rotze lezallefan
b: Pachot mearba shofchan i daavid uka shere i la asur
Rabbi zera amar arba ammot tayemi pachot mearba ammot la tayemi
May benayehu amar abbaye arich vekattin ika benayehu
Tenan chatzer veachsadra mitztarfin learba ammot bishlama lerabbi zera nicha ella lerabba kashya
Targema rabbi zera alliba derabba beachsadra mehallechet al pene kal hechatzer kullah
Ta shema chatzer sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot en shofchin letochah mayim bashshabbat bishlama lerabba nicha ella lerabbi zera kashya
Amar lach rabbi zera ha manni rabbanan hi umatnitin rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi
Umay duchkeh derabbi zera leokomah lematnitin kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov amar rava matnitin keshiteh may irya detane chatzer shehi pechuta litne chatzer sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot
Ella lav shema minah derabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi shema minah
Veha middesefa rabbi eliezer ben yaakov resha lav rabbi eliezer ben yaakov

Kullah rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi vechassore michassera vehachi katane chatzer shehi pechuta mearba ammot en shofchin letochah mayim beshabbat ha arba ammot shofchin sherabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer biv hakkamur arba ammot birshut harabbim shofchin letocho mayim bashshabbat
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer biv hakkamur
Matnitin dela kachananya detanya chananya omer afilu gag mea amma lo yishpoch lefi sheen haggag asuy livloa ella lekalleach
Tana bamme devarim amurim bimot hachamma aval bimot haggeshamim shofech veshone veeno nimna may tama amar rava adam rotze sheyyibbalu mayim bimkoman
Amar leh abbaye vahare shofchin deadam rotze sheyyibbalu vekatane lo yishpoch
Amar leh hatam lemay nechush lah i mishshum kilkul chatzero ha mikalkela vekayema vei mishshum gezera shemma yomru tzinnoro shel peloni mekalleach mayim setam tzinnorot mekallechim hem
Amar rav nachman bimot haggeshamim uka machazik satayim notnin lo satayim machazik sea notnin lo sea bimot hachamma machazik satayim notnin lo satayim sea en notnin lo kal ikar
Bimot hachamma name machazik sea nitev leh sea gezera dilma ate liten leh satayim i hachi bimot haggeshamim name ligzor
Hatam may nechush lah i mishshum kilkul ha mikalkela vekayema i mishshum gezera shemma yomru tzinnoro shel peloni mekalleach mayim setam tzinnorot mekallechin hen
Amar abbaye hilkach afilu kor vaafilu korayim
Vechen shette deotaot zo keneged zo amar rava afilu ervu
Amar leh abbaye may tama ilema mishshum nefisha demayya vehatanya achat li uka veachat li gistera berecha vaareva af al pi shennitmalleu mayim meerev shabbat shofchin letochan mayim bashshabbat
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rava

a: Lo shanu ella shello ervu aval ervu muttarin
Vechi lo ervu may tama la amar rav ashe gezera dilma ate leappoke mimmane devattim lehatam
Hadran alach ketzad mishtattefin
Matni kal gaggot hair reshut achat uvilvad shello yehe gag gavoha asara o namuch asara divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim kal echad veechad reshut bifne atzmo
Rabbi shimon omer echad gaggot veechad chatzerot veechad karpefot reshut achat hen lechelim sheshshavtu letochan velo lechelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit
Gema yatev abbaye bar avin verabbi chanina bar avin veyatev abbaye gabbayehu veyatvi vekaamri bishlama rabbanan savri keshem sheddiyyurin chalukin lematta kach diyyurin chalukin lemala

Ella rabbi meir may kasavar i kasavar keshem sheddiyyurin chalukin lematta kach diyyurin chalukin lemala ammay reshut achat hen vei kasavar en chalukin dechol lemala measara reshut achat hi afilu gag gavoha asara venamuch asara name

Amar lehu abbaye la shemia lechu ha deamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi omer haya rabbi meir kal makom sheatta motze shette reshuot vehen reshut achat kegon ammud birshut hayyachid gavoha asara verachav arbaa asur lechattef alav gezera mishshum tel birshut harabbim hachi name gezera mishshum tel birshut harabbim
Sevur mina afilu machteshet vaafilu gigit
Amar lehu abbaye hachi amar mar lo amar rabbi meir ella ammud veammat harechayim hoil veadam kovea lahen makom
Vahare kotel shebben shette chatzerot dekavua veamar rav yehuda keshettimtze lomar ledivre rabbi meir gaggin reshut leatzman chatzerot reshut leatzman karpefot reshut leatzman
May lav dishre letaltole derech kotel
Amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet la lehachnis ulhotzi derech petachim
Vachachamim omrim kal echad veechad reshut bifne atzmo itmar rav amar en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot ushmuel amar muttar letaltel bechullo
Bimchitzot hannikarot dechulle alma la peligi ki peligi bimchitzot sheenan nikarot
Rav amar en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot la amar gud assek mechitzta ushmuel amar muttar letaltel bechullo deamar gud assek mechitzta
Tenan vachachamim omrim kal echad veechad
b: Reshut leatzmo bishlama lishmuel nicha ella lerav kashya
Amri be rav mishshemeh derav shello yetaltel shette ammot begag ze ushte ammot begag ze
Veha amar rabbi elazar ki havenan bevavel hava amrinan be rav mishshemeh derav amru en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot vehane deve shemuel tanu en lahen ella gaggan

May en lahen ella gaggan lav dishru letaltole bechulleh umi allima mimmatnitin deokemna shello yetaltel shette ammot begag ze ushte ammot begag ze hachi name shette ammot begag ze ushte ammot begag ze
Amar rav yosef la shemia li ha shemata amar leh abbaye atte amarte nihalan veaha amarte nihalan gag gadol hassamuch lekatan haggadol muttar vehakkatan asur
Vaamarte lan alah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella sheyyesh diyyurin al ze vediyyurin al ze dehaveya lah ha dekatan mechitza nidreset
Aval en diyyurin al ze veal ze shenehen muttarin
Amar leh ana hachi amari lechu lo shanu ella sheyyesh mechitza al ze umchitza al ze degadol mishtere begipufe vekatan nifratz bimloo aval en mechitza lo al ze velo al ze shenehen asurin
Veha diyyurin amarte lan i amari lechu diyyurin hachi amari lechu lo shanu ella sheyyesh mechitza reuya ledira al ze umchitza reuya ledira al ze degadol mishtere begipufe vekatan nifratz bimloo
Aval yesh mechitza reuya ledira al haggadol veen reuya ledira al hakkatan afilu katan shere livne gadol may tama kevan dela avud mechitza salloke salliku nafshayehu mehacha
Keha deamar rav nachman asa sullam kavua legaggo huttar bechol haggaggin kullan
Amar abbaye bana aliyya al gabbe beto veasa lefaneha dakka arba huttar bechol haggaggin kullan
Amar rava peamim shehaddakka leisur hechi dame daavida lahade tarbitza deveteh deamar

a: Lenattore tarbitza hu daavida
Beay rame bar chama shette ammot begag ushte ammot beammud mahu amar rabba may ka mibaya leh karmelit urshut hayyachid ka mibaya leh
Verame bar chama aggav churpeh la ayyen bah ella hachi kamibaya leh shette ammot begag ushte ammot beachsadra mahu
Mi amrinan kevan dela hay chaze ledira vela hay chaze ledira chada reshuta hi o dilma kevan demiggag legag asir miggag leachsadra name asir
Bae rav bivi bar abbaye shette ammot begag ushte ammot bechurba mahu
Amar rav kahana lav hayenu derame bar chama amar rav bivi bar abbaye vechi meacher atay untzay achsadra la chazya ledira vechurba chazya ledira
Vechi meachar dechazya ledira may kamibaya leh im timtze lomar kaamar im timtze lomar achsadra la chazya ledira churba chazya ledira o dilma hashta miha let bah daorin teku
Gaggin hashshavin lerabbi meir vegag yechidi lerabbanan rav amar muttar letaltel bechullo ushmuel amar en metaltelin bo ella bearba
Rav amar muttar letaltel bechullo kashya derav adderav hatam la minachra mechitzta hacha minachra mechitzta

Ushmuel amar en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot kashya dishmuel addishmuel hatam la have yoter mibbet satayim hacha have yoter mibbet satayim vehane mechitzot lematta avidan lemala la avidan vehave kekarpef yater mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira vechol karpef yoter mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira en metaltelin bo ella bearba
Itmar sefina rav amar muttar letaltel bechullah ushmuel amar en metaltelin bah ella bearba rav amar muttar letaltel bechullah
b: Deha ika mechitzata ushmuel amar en metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot mechitzot lehavriach mayim asuot
Amar leh rav chiyya bar yosef lishmuel hilcheta keotach o hilcheta kerav amar leh hilcheta kerav
Amar rav gidel amar rav chiyya bar yosef umode rav sheim kefaah al piha sheen metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot kefaah lemay ilema ladur tachteha may shena miggag yechidi
Ella shekkefaah lezoftah
Rav ashe matne lah assefina verav acha bereh derava matne lah aachsadra deitmar achsadra bevika rav amar muttar letaltel bechullah ushmuel amar en metaltelin bah ella bearba
Rav amar muttar letaltel bechullah amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem ushmuel amar en metaltelin bah ella bearba la amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem
Verav alliba derabbi meir litaltele miggag lechatzer gezera mishshum derav yitzchak bar avdimi
Ushmuel alliba derabbanan nitaltel miggag lekarpef amar rava bar ulla gezera shemma yippachet haggag
I hachi mikkarpef lekarpef name la yetaltel dilma mipchit veate letaltole hatam i mipchit minachra leh milta hacha i mipchit la minachra milta
Amar rav yehuda keshettimtza lomar ledivre rabbi meir gaggin reshut leatzman chatzerot reshut leatzman

a: Karpefot reshut leatzman ledivre chachamim gaggin vachatzerot reshut achat karpefot reshut achat hen ledivre rabbi shimon kullan reshut achat hen

Tanya keoteh derav tanya keoteh derav yehuda tanya keoteh derav kol gaggot hair reshut achat hen veasur lehaalot ulhorid min haggaggin lechatzer umin hechatzer legaggin vechelim sheshshavtu bechatzer muttar letaltelan bechatzer baggaggin muttar letaltelan baggaggin uvilvad shello yehe gag gavoha asara o namuch asara divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim kol echad veechad reshut leatzmo veen metaltelin bo ella bearba

Tanya keoteh derav yehuda amar rabbi keshehayinu lomdim tora etzel rabbi shimon bitkoa hayinu maalin shemen vaaluntit miggag legag umiggag lechatzer umechatzer lechatzer umechatzer lekarpef umikkarpef lekarpef acher ad shehayinu maggiin etzel hammayan shehayinu rochatzin bo
Amar rabbi yehuda maase bishat hassakkana vehayinu maalin tora mechatzer legag umiggag lechatzer umechatzer lekarpef likrot bo
Amru lo en sheat hassakkana reaya
Rabbi shimon omer echad gaggin vechu
Amar rav halacha kerabbi shimon vehu shello ervu aval ervu la degazrinan dilma ate leappoke mane devattim lechatzer
Ushmuel amar ben ervu ben shello ervu vechen amar rabbi yochanan mi lechashcha ben ervu uven shello ervu
Matkef lah rav chisda lishmuel ulrabbi yochanan yomru shene chelim bechatzer achat ze muttar veze asur

Rabbi shimon letameh dela gazar ditnan amar rabbi shimon lema haddavar dome leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo uftuchot lirshut harabbim veervu shette hachitzonot im haemtzait hi mutteret immahen vehen muttarot immah ushte hachitzonot asurin zo im zo
Vela gazar dilma ate leappoke mane deha chatzer leha chatzer hachi name la gazrinan dilma ate leappoke mane devattim lechatzer

Metiv rav sheshet rabbi shimon omer echad gaggot echad chatzerot veechad karpefot reshut achat hen lechelim sheshshavtu betochan velo lechelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit i amratte bishlama deervu hayenu demashkachatte lah mane devattim bechatzer
Ella i amratte beshello ervu hechi mashkachatte lah mane devattim bechatzer hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah bechumta vesudara
b: Ta shema anshe chatzer veanshe mirpeset sheshshachchu velo ervu kol sheggavoha asara tefachim lammirpeset pachot mikkan lechatzer bamme devarim amurim shehau ellu shel rabbim veellu shel rabbim veervu ellu leatzman veellu leatzman o shel yechidim sheen tzerichin learev
Aval hau shel rabbim veshachchu velo ervu gag vechatzer veachsadra umirpeset kullan reshut achat hen
Tama delo ervu ha ervu la ha manni rabbanan hi
Dayeka name dela katane karpef umavoy shema minah

Ta shema chamesh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo uftuchot lemavoy veshachchu kullam velo ervu asur lehachnis ulhotzi mechatzer lammavoy umin hammavoy lechatzer vechelim sheshshavtu bechatzer muttar letaltelan bechatzer uvammavoy asur
Verabbi shimon mattir shehaya rabbi shimon omer kol zeman shehen shel rabbim veshachchu velo ervu gag vechatzer veachsadra umirpeset vekarpef umavoy kullan reshut achat hen
Tama delo ervu ha ervu la may lo ervu lo ervu chatzerot bahade hadade ha chatzer uvattim ervu
Veha lo ervu katane may lo ervu lo nishtattefu
Veibaet ema rabbi shimon ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi la shena ervu vela shena la ervu ella ledidchu odo li mihat dehecha delo ervu reshut achat hi
Vaamaru leh rabbanan la shette reshuot hen
Amar mar uvammavoy asur lema mesayya leh lerabbi zera amar rav deamar rabbi zera amar rav mavoy shello nishtattefu bo en metaltelin ella bearba ammot ema ulmavoy asur
Hayenu resha mishna yattira itztericha leh mahu detema ki peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi shimon hane mile hecha deervu aval hecha dela ervu modu leh ka mashma lan
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe

a: Mi amar rabbi yochanan hachi veha amar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna utnan kotel shebben shette chatzerot gavoha asara verochav arbaa mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad hau berosho perot ellu olin mikkan veochlim veellu olin mikkan veochlim uvilvad shello yoridu lematta
May lematta lematta labbattim veha tane rabbi chiyya uvilvad shello yehe ze omed bimkomo veochel veze omed bimkomo veochel
Amar leh vechi rabbi lo shenaah rabbi chiyya minnayin lo
Ittemar shette chatzerot vechurba achat benehem achat erva veachat lo erva amar rav huna notnin otah lazo shello erva aval lesheerva la dilma ate leappoke mane devattim lechurba
Vechiyya bar rav amar af lesheerva ushtehen asurot veim tomar shettehen muttarot mippene ma en notnin chatzer shello erva lechatzer sheerva
Hatam kevan deminnatri mane devattim bechatzer ate leappoke hacha bechurba kevan dela minnatri mane dechatzer bechurba la ate leappoke

Ika deamri chiyya bar rav amar af lesheerva ushtehen muttarot veim tomar shettehen asurot lefi sheen notnim chatzer shello erva lechatzer sheerva hatam kevan deminnatri mane devattim bechatzer la sharu behu rabbanan deate leappoke aval bechurba la minnatri
Matni gag gadol samuch lekatan haggadol muttar vehakkatan asur chatzer gedola shennifretza liktanna gedola mutteret uktanna asura mippene shehi kefitchah shel gedola
