Gema lema leh lemitne tarte
Lerav katane gag dumya dechatzer ma chatzer minnachra mechitzta af gag name minnachra mechitzta
Velishmuel gag dumya dechatzer ma chatzer deka darsi lah rabbim af gag name deka darsi leh rabbim
Yatev rabba verabbi zera verabba bar rav chanan veyatev abbaye gabbayehu veyatvi vekaamri shema minah mimmatnitin daore gedola bakketanna veen daore ketanna baggedola
Ketzad gefanim baggedola asur lizroa et hakketanna veim zara zerain asurin
b: Gefanim muttarin gefanim bakketanna muttar lizroa et haggedola
Ishsha baggedola vaget bakketanna mitgareshet ishsha bakketanna veget baggedola enah mitgareshet
Tzibbur baggedola ushliach tzibbur bakketanna yotzin yede chovatan tzibur bakketanna ushliach tzibbur baggedola en yotzin yede chovatan
Tisha baggedola veyachid bakketanna mitztarfin tisha bakketanna veechad baggedola en mitztarfin
Tzoa baggedola asur likrot keriat shema bakketanna tzoa bakketanna muttar likrot keriat shema baggedola
Amar lehu abbaye im ken matzinu mechitza leisur sheilmale en mechitza marchik arba ammot vezorea veilu hashta asura
Amar leh rabbi zera leabbaye velo matzinu mechitza leisur veha tenan chatzer gedola shennifretza liktanna gedola mutteret uktanna asura mippene shehi kefitchah shel gedola
Veilu hishva et gipufeha gedola name asura
Amar leh hatam siluk mechitzot hu
Amar leh rava leabbaye velo matzinu mechitza leisur veha ittemar

a: Sikech al gabbe achsadra sheyyesh lah patztzimin keshera veilu hishva patztzimeha pesula
Amar leh abbaye ledidi keshera ledidach siluk mechitzot hi
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanan leabbaye velo matzinu mechitza leisur vehatanya bayit shechetzo mekore vechetzo eno mekore gefanim kan muttar lizroa kan
Veilu hishva et keruo asur amar leh hatam siluk mechitzot hu

Shelach leh rava leabbaye beyad rav shemaya bar zeera velo matzinu mechitza leisur vehatanya yesh bimchitzot hakkerem lehakel ulhachamir ketzad kerem hannatua ad ikar mechitza zorea meikar mechitza veelach sheilu en sham mechitza marchik arba ammot vezorea veze hu mechitzot hakkerem lehakel
Ulhachamir ketzad haya mashuch min hakkotel achat esre amma lo yavi zera lesham sheilmale en mechitza marchik arba ammot vezorea vezohi mechitzot hakkerem lehachmir

Amar leh velitamach otvan mimmatnitin ditnan karachat hakkerem bet shammay omrim esrim vearba ammot uvet hillel omrim shesh esre amma mechol hakkerem bet shammay omrim shesh esre amma uvet hillel omrim shettem esre amma
Veezo hi karachat hakkerem kerem shecharav emtzaito im en sham shesh esre amma lo yavi zera lesham hau sham shesh esre amma noten lo kede avodato vezorea et hammotar
E zo hi mechol hakkerem ben hakkerem laggader sheim en sham shettem esre amma lo yavi zera lesham hau sham shettem esre amma noten lo kede avodato vezorea et hammotar
Ella hatam lav hayenu tama dechol arba ammot legabbe cherem avodat hakkerem legabbe gader kevan dela mizdaran afkore mafkar lehu devene bene i ika arba chashivan vei la la chashivan
Amar rav yehuda shelosha karpefot ze betzad ze ushnayim hachitzonim meguppafim vehaemtzai eno meguppaf veyachid baze veyachid baze naase kishyara venotnin lahen kol tzorkan vadday
Emtzai meguppaf ushnayim hachitzonim enan meguppafin veyachid baze veyachid ze veyachid baze en notnin lahem ella bet shesh
Ibaya lehu echad baze veechad baze ushnayim baemtzai mahu i lehacha nafki telata hau vei lehacha nafki telata hau
O dilma chad lehacha nafek vechad lehacha nafek

Veim timtze lomar chad lehacha nafek vechad lehacha nafek shenayim baze ushnayim baze veechad beemtzai mahu hacha vadday i lehacha nafek telata hau vei lehacha nafek telata hau o dilma emar lehacha nafek veemar lehacha nafek
Vehilcheta bayan lekulla
Amar rav chisda
b: Gidud chamishsha umchitza chamishsha en mitztarfin ad sheyehe o kullo begidud o kullo bimchitza

Metivi shette chatzerot zo lemala mizzo veelona gevoha min hattachtona asara tefachim o sheyyesh bah gidud chamishsha umchitza chamishsha mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad pachot mikkan mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim
Amar rav mode rav chisda battachtona hoil veroe pene asara i hachi tachtona tearev shenayim velo tearev echad elona lo tearev lo echad velo shenayim
Amar rabba bar ulla kegon shehayeta elona meguppefet ad eser ammot
I hachi ema sefa pachot mikkan mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim i baaya chad tearev i baaya tere tearev
Amar rabba bereh derava kegon shennifretza hattachtona bimloah laelona
I hachi tachtona chad tearev tere la tearev elona i baaya tere tearev i baaya chad tearev
In hachi name vechi katane pachot mikkan mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim attachtona

Derash marimar gidud chamishsha umchitza chamishsha mitztarfin ashkecheh ravina lerav acha bereh derava amar leh tane mar mide bimchitza amar leh la vehilcheta gidud chamishsha umchitza chamishsha mitztarfin
Bae rav hoshaya daorin habbain beshabbat mahu sheyyeasru
Amar rav chisda ta shema chatzer gedola shennifretza liktanna haggedola mutteret vehakketanna asura mippene shehi kefitchah shel gedola amar rabba emar mibbeod yom nifretza

Amar leh abbaye la tema mar emar ella vadday mibbeod yom nifretza deha mar hu deamar beay mineh merav huna uvay mineh merav yehuda erav derech happetach venistam happetach erav derech challon venistam hachallon mahu veamar li shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera
Ittemar kotel shebben shette chatzerot shennafal rav amar en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot
Ushmuel amar

a: Ze metaltel ad ikar mechitza veze metaltel ad ikar mechitza
Veha derav lav beferush ittemar ella mikkelala ittemar derav ushmuel hao yatvi behahu chatzer nefal gudda devene bene amar lehu shemuel shekulu gelima negidu bah
Ahderinhu rav leappeh amar lehu shemuel i kafed abba shekulu hemyaneh uktaru bah
Velishmuel lema li ha ha amar ze metaltel ad ikar mechitza veze metaltel ad ikar mechitza
Shemuel aved litzniuta bealma
Verav i sevira leh daasir lema leh atreh dishmuel hava
I hachi may tama ahderinhu leappeh dela nemru kishmuel sevira leh vahadar beh mishshemateh
Matni chatzer shennifretza lirshut harabbim hammachnis mittochah lirshut hayyachid o mershut hayyachid letochah chayyav divre rabbi eliezer
Vachachamim omrim mittochah lirshut harabbim o mershut harabbim letochah patur mippene shehi kecharmelit
Gema verabbi eliezer mishshum denifretza lirshut harabbim haveya lah reshut harabbim in rabbi eliezer letameh
Detanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer rabbim shebberru derech leatzman ma shebberru berru
Ini vehaamar rav gidel amar rav vehu sheavda lahen derech beoto sade
Vechi tema hacha name kegon sheavda lahen derech beotah chatzer vehaamar rabbi chanina ad mekom mechitza machaloket
Ema al mekom mechitza machaloket
Veibaet ema betzide reshut harabbim kamipalgi derabbi eliezer savar tzide reshut harabbim kirshut harabbim damu verabbanan savri tzide reshut harabbim lav kirshut harabbim damu

Veliflog betzide reshut harabbim bealma i ipligu betzide reshut harabbim bealma hava amrinan ki peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer hane mile hecha deika chipufe aval hecha deleka chipufe ema modu leh ka mashma lan
Veha mittochah kaamar
Ayede daamur rabbanan mittochah amar ihu name mittochah
Verabbanan amar rabbi eliezer tzide reshut harabbim umahderu leh inhu mittochah
Hachi kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi eliezer mi la ka modet lan hecha detiltel mittochah lirshut harabbim umershut harabbim letochah defatur mippene shehi karmelit tzide name la shena
Verabbi eliezer hatam la ka darsi lah rabbim hacha ka darsi lah rabbim

Matni chatzer shennifretza lirshut harabbim mishte ruchoteha vechen bayit shennifratz mishte ruchotav vechen mavoy shennittelu korotav o lechayav muttarim beoto shabbat vaasurim leatid lavo divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi yose omer im muttarin leoto shabbat muttarin leatid lavo veim asurin leatid lavo asurin leoto shabbat
Gema bemay askinan ilema beeser may shena meruach achat deamar pitcha hu mishte ruchot name pitcha hu ella beyater meeser i hachi afilu meruach achat name
Amar rav leolam beeser
b: Uchgon shennifretza bekeren zavit defitcha bekeren zavit la avdi inashe
Vechen bayit shennifratz mishte ruchotav may shena meruach achat deamrinan pi tikra yored vesotem mishte ruchot name lema pi tikra yored vesotem
Amri deve rav mishshemeh derav kegon shennifratz bekeren zavit vekeruo baalachson deleka lememar pi tikra yored vesotem
Ushmuel amar afilu beyater meeser i hachi meruach achat name
Mishshum bayit
Uvayit gufeh tikshe may shena meruach achat deamrinan pi tikra yored vesotem mishshette ruchot name nema pi tikra yored vesotem
Vetu mi it leh lishmuel pi tikra yored vesotem veha ittemar achsadra bevika rav amar muttar letaltel bechullah ushmuel amar en metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot
Ha la kashya ki let leh bearba aval beshalosh it leh
Mikkol makom kashya
Kidamri be rav mishshemeh derav kegon shennifratz bekeren zavit vekeruo baalachson hacha name kegon shennifratz bekeren zavit vekeruo bearba
Shemuel lo amar kerav alachson la katane verav la amar kishmuel im ken haveya leh achsadra verav letameh deamar achsadra muttar letaltel bechullah
Deitmar achsadra bevika rav amar muttar letaltel bechullah ushmuel amar en metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot
Rav amar muttar letaltel bechullah amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem ushmuel amar en metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot la amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem
Beeser kulle alma la peligi ki peligi beyater meeser
Veika deamri beyater kulle alma la peligi ki peligi beeser
Veha deamar rav yehuda

a: Kora arbaa mattir bechurba verav nachman amar rabba bar avuh kora arbaa mattir bemayim manni
Lehach lishana deamratte beeser la peligi beeser vedivre hakkol lehach lishana deamratte beeser peligi kerav
Lema abbaye verava biflugta derav ushmuel kamipalgi deitmar sikech al gabbe achsadra sheyyesh lah patztzimin keshera en lah patztzimin abbaye amar keshera verava amar pesula
Abbaye amar keshera amar pi tikra yored vesotem verava amar pesula la amar pi tikra yored vesotem lema abbaye kerav verava kishmuel
Alliba dishmuel kulle alma la feligi ki peligi alliba derav abbaye kerav verava ad kan la kaamar rav hatam ella dehane mechitzot leachsadra avidi aval hacha dehane mechitzot lav lesukka avidi la
Rabbi yose omer im muttarin ibaya lehu rabbi yose leesor o lehattir
Amar rav sheshet leesor vechen amar rabbi yochanan leesor tanya name hachi amar rabbi yose keshem sheasurin leatid lavo kach asurin leoto shabbat
Itmar rav chiyya bar yosef amar halacha kerabbi yose ushmuel amar halacha kerabbi yehuda

Umi amar shemuel hachi vehatnan amar rabbi yehuda bamme devarim amurim beeruve techumin aval beeruve chatzerot mearvin ben ledaat ben shello ledaat lefi shezzachin leadam shello befanav veen chavin shello befanav
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda velo od ella kol makom sheshshana rabbi yehuda beeruvin halacha kemoto
Vaamar leh rav chana bagdataa lerav yehuda amar shemuel afilu bemavoy shennital korato o lechayav vaamar leh beeruvin amarti lecha velo bimchitzot
Amar rav anan ledidi miparsha li mineh dishmuel kan shennifretza lecharmelit kan shennifretza lirshut harabbim
Matni habbone aliyya al gabbe shene vattim vechen gesharim hamfullashim metaltelin tachtehen bashshabbat divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim osrin
Veod amar rabbi yehuda mearvin lemavoy hamfullash vachachamim osrin
Gema amar rabba la tema hayenu tama derabbi yehuda mishshum deka savar shette mechitzot deorayeta ella mishshum dekasavar pi tikra yored vesotem

Etiveh abbaye yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda mi sheyyesh lo shene vattim mishshene tzide reshut harabbim ose lechi mikkan velechi mikkan o kora mikkan vekora mikkan venose venoten baemtza amru lo en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach
Amar leh mehahi in meha leka lemishma minah
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka middekatane veod amar rabbi yehuda mearvin bemavoy hamfullash vachachamim osrin
I amratte bishlama mishshum deka savar pi tikra yored vesotem hayenu dekatane veod
Ella i amratte mishshum deka savar shette mechitzot deorayeta may veod shema minah
Hadran alach kol gaggot
Matni hammotze tefilin machnisan zug zug rabban gamliel omer shenayim shenayim bamme devarim amurim bishanot aval bachadashot patur
Metzaan tzevatim o cherichot machshich alehen umvian
b: Uvassakkana mechassan veholech lo
Rabbi shimon omer notnan lachavero vachavero lachavero ad shemmaggia lechatzer hachitzona
Vechen beno notno lachavero vachavero lachavero afilu mea rabbi yehuda omer noten adam chavit lachavero vachavero lachavero afilu chutz lattechum amru lo lo tehallech zo yoter meragle vealeha
Gema zug echad in tefe la lema tenan setama dela kerabbi meir
Dei kerabbi meir haamar lovesh kol ma sheyyachol lilbosh veotef kol ma sheyyachol laatof ditnan ulsham motzi kol kele tashmisho velovesh kol ma sheyyachol lilbosh veotef kol ma sheyyachol laatof
Vehahi setama mimmay derabbi meir hi dekatane alah lovesh umotzi ufoshet velovesh umotzi ufoshet afilu kol hayyom kullo divre rabbi meir
Amar rava afilu tema rabbi meir hatam derech malbusho kechol shaveyuh rabbanan vehacha derech malbusho kechol shaveyuh rabbanan
Hatam divchol kamma devae lavesh leinyan hatztzala name sharu le rabbanan hacha divchol name zug echad in tefe la leinyan hatztzala name zug echad in tefe la
Rabban gamliel omer shenayim shenayim may kasavar i kasavar shabbat zeman tefilin hu zug echad in tefe la
Vei kasavar shabbat lav zeman tefilin hu umishshum hatztzala derech malbush sharu leh rabbanan afilu tefe name
Leolam kasavar shabbat lav zeman tefilin hu vechi shero rabbanan leinyan hatztzala derech malbush bimkom tefilin
I hachi zug echad name en tefe la amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak makom yesh barosh lehanniach bo shette tefilin
Hanicha derosh deyad may ika lememar
Kidrav huna deamar rav huna peamim sheadam ba min hassade vachavilato al rosho umsallekan merosho vekoshran bizroo
Emar deamar rav huna shello yinhag bahen derech bizzaon rauy mi amar
Ella kidamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak makom yesh barosh sherauy lehanniach bo shette tefilin hacha name makom yesh bayyad sherauy lehanniach bo shette tefilin
Tanna deve menashshe al yadcha zo kiboret ben enecha zo kodkod hecha amri deve rabbi yannay mekom shemmocho shel tinok rofes
Lema bidrav shemuel bar rav yitzchak kamipalgi detanna kamma let leh derav shemuel bar rav yitzchak verabban gamliel it leh derav shemuel bar rav yitzchak
La dechulle alma it lehu derav shemuel bar rav yitzchak vehacha beshabbat zeman tefilin kamipalgi detanna kamma savar shabbat zeman tefilin hu
Verabban gamliel savar shabbat lav zeman tefilin hu
Veibaet ema dechulle alma shabbat zeman tefilin hu vehacha bemitzot tzerichot kauona kamipalgi tanna kamma savar latzet bae kauona
Verabban gamliel savar la bae kauona

a: Veibaet ema dechulle alma latzet la bae kauona vehacha laavor mishshum bal tosif kamipalgi detanna kamma savar laavor mishshum bal tosif la bae kauona verabban gamliel savar laavor mishshum bal tosif bae kauona
Veibaet ema i disvira lan deshabbat zeman tefilin dechulle alma la laavor bae kauona vela latzet bae kauona
Vehacha belaavor shello bizmanno kamipalgi tanna kamma savar la bae kauona verabban gamliel savar laavor shello bizmanno bae kauona
I hachi lerabbi meir zug echad name la
Veod hayyashen bashshemini besukka yilke ella mechavarta chidshanninan meikara

Uman shamatte leh shabbat zeman tefilin rabbi akiva detanya veshamarta et hachukka hazzot lemoadah miyyamim yamima yamim velo lelot miyyamim velo kol yamim perat leshabbatot veyamim tovim divre rabbi yose haggelili
Rabbi akiva omer lo neemar chukka zo ella leinyan pesach bilvad

Veella ha ditnan happesach vehammila mitzvat ase lema dela kerabbi akiva dei rabbi akiva kevan demoke lah befesach lav name ika kidrabbi avin amar rabbi ilay deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ilay kol makom shenneemar hishshamer pen veal eno ella belo taase
Afilu tema rabbi akiva hishshamer delav lav hishshamer daase ase

Vesavar rabbi akiva shabbat zeman tefilin hu vehatanya rabbi akiva omer yachol yanniach adam tefilin beshabbatot veyamim tovim talmud lomar vehaya lecha leot al yadcha mi shetztzerichin ot yatzu ellu shehen gufan ot

Ella hay tanna hu detanya hanneor ballayela ratza choletz ratza manniach divre rabbi natan yonatan hakkitoni omer en mannichin tefilin ballayela middelayela letanna kamma zeman tefilin shabbat name zeman tefilin
Dilma sevira leh layela zeman tefilin hu shabbat lav zeman tefilin hu deha shaminan leh lerabbi akiva deamar layela zeman tefilin hu shabbat lav zeman tefilin hu

Ella hay tanna hu detanya michal bat kushi hayeta mannachat tefilin velo michu bah chachamim veishto shel yona hayeta ola laregel velo michu bah chachamim middelo michu bah chachamim alma kasavri mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama hi
Vedilma savar lah
b: Kerabbi yose deamar nashim somchot reshut
Dei la tema hachi ishto shel yona hayeta ola laregel velo michu bah mi ika leman deamar regel lav mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu ella kasavar reshut hacha name reshut
Ella hay tanna hi detanya hammotze tefilin machnisan zug zug echad haish veechad haishsha echad chadashot veechad yeshanot divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda oser bachadashot umattir bishanot
Ad kan la peligi ella bachadashot vishanot aval beishsha la peligi shema minah mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama hu vechol mitzvat ase sheen hazzeman gerama nashim chayyavot
Vedilma savar lah kerabbi yose deamar nashim somchot reshut la salka datach dela rabbi meir savar lah kerabbi yose vela rabbi yehuda savar lah kerabbi yose
La rabbi meir savar lah kerabbi yose ditnan en meakkevin et hattinokot millitkoa ha nashim meakkevin ustam matnitin rabbi meir
Vela rabbi yehuda savar lah kerabbi yose detanya dabber el bene yisrael vesamach bene yisrael somchin veen benot yisrael somchot rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim nashim somchot reshut
Ustam sifra manni rabbi yehuda
Amar rabbi elazar hammotze techelet bashshuk leshonot pesulot chutin kesherin
May shena leshonot deamar addata diglima tzavinhu chutin name nema addata diglima tevinhu bishzurim
Shezurim name nema addata desifta diglima ayefinhu bemufsakin dechulle hay vadday la tarchi inashe
Amar rava vechi adam toreach laasot kamea kemin tefilin ditnan bamme devarim amurim bishanot aval bachadashot patur
Amar rabbi zera leahava bereh pok teni lehu hammotze techelet bashshuk leshonot pesulin chutin mufsakin kesherin lefi sheen adam toreach
Amar rava umishshum detane lah ahava bereh derabbi zera kefe tela lah vehatnan bamme devarim amurim bishanot aval bachadashot patur
Ella amar rava tarach vela tarach tannae hi
Detanya hammotze tefilin machnisan zug zug echad haish veechad haishsha

a: Echad chadashot veechad yeshanot divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda oser bachadashot umattir bishanot alma mar savar tarach inish umar savar la tarach inish
Siman vehashta detane avuh dishmuel bar rav yitzchak ellu hen yeshanot kol sheyyesh bahen retzuot umkushsharot chadashot yesh bahen retzuot velo mekushsharot dechulle alma la tarach inish
Velinevinhu minav amar rav chisda zot omeret aniva pesula bitfilin
Abbaye amar rabbi yehuda letameh deamar aniva keshira meallayeta hi

Tama daaniva keshira meallayeta hi ha lav hachi anev lehu vehaamar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav kesher shel tefilin halacha lemoshe missinay hu veamar rav nachman venoyehen levar
Deanev lehu keen keshira didhu
Amar rav chisda amar rav hallokeach tefilin mimmi sheeno mumche bodek shettayim shel yad veachat shel rosh o shettayim shel rosh veachat shel yad
Ma nafshach i mechad gavra ka zaven livdok o shalosh shel yad o shalosh shel rosh
I mittere telata gavre zaven kol chad vechad live bedika leolam mechad gavra zaven uvaenan demitmache beshel yad uvshel rosh
Ini veha tane rabba bar shemuel bitfilin bodek shalosh shel yad veshel rosh may lav o shalosh shel yad o shalosh shel rosh la shalosh mehen shel yad mehen shel rosh
Vehatane rav kahana bitfilin bodek shettayim shel yad veshel rosh ha manni rabbi hi deamar bitre zimne have chazaka
I rabbi ema sefa vechen batztzevet hashsheni vechen batztzevet hashshelishi vei rabbi shelishi mi it leh
Mode rabbi bitzvatim demittere telata gavre zaven i hachi afilu revii name vaafilu chamishi name
In hachi name vehay dekatane shelishi leappoke mechezkeh ulolam afilu revii vachamishi name
Metzaan tzevatim o cherichot vechu may tzevatim umay kerichot amar rav yehuda amar rav hen hen tzevatim hen hen kerichot tzevatim zavey zavey kerichot dichrichan tuva

Machshich alehen umvian veammay leayelinhu zug zug amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda ledidi miparsha leh mineh deabba kol sheilu machnisan zug zug vechalot kodem shekiat hachamma machnisan zug zug vei la machshich alehen umvian
Uvassakkana mechassan veholech vehatanya uvassakkana molichan pachot pachot mearba ammot amar rav la kashya ha besakkanat goyim ha besakkanat listim
b: Amar leh abbaye bemay okemta lematnitin besakkanat goyim ema sefa rabbi shimon omer notnan lachavero vachavero lachavero kol shekken deavesha milta
Chassore michassera vehachi katane bamme devarim amurim besakkanat goyim aval besakkanat listim molichan pachot pachot mearba ammot
Rabbi shimon omer notnan lachavero vechu bemay kamipalgi mar savar pachot mearba ammot adif dei amratte notnan lachavero vachavero lachavero avesha milleta deshabbat
Umar savar notnan lachavero adif dei amratte molichan pachot mearba ammot zimnin delav addateh veate leetoyinhu arba ammot birshut harabbim
Vechen beno beno may bae hatam deve menashshe tana besheyeladattu immo bassade
Umay afilu hen mea deaf al gav dekashya leh yeda afilu hachi ha adifa
Rabbi yehuda omer noten adam chavit velet leh lerabbi yehuda ha ditnan habbehema vehakkelim keragle habbealim
Amar resh lakish mishshum levi sava hacha bemay askinan bimaran mechavit lechavit verabbi yehuda letameh deamar mayim en bahem mammash
Ditnan rabbi yehuda poter bemayim mippene sheen bahen mammash
Umay lo tehallech zo lo yehallech ma shebbezo yoter meragle habbealim

Emar deshamatte leh lerabbi yehuda hecha divlian beisa hecha deitanhu beenayehu mi shamatte leh hashta bikdera amar rabbi yehuda la batli beenayehu batli detanya rabbi yehuda omer mayim umelach betelin baisa veen betelin bakkedera mippene rotbah
Ella amar rava hacha bechavit shekkanta shevita umayim shello kanu shevita askinan devatla chavit legabbe mayim
Keditnan hammotzi hachay bemitta patur af al hammitta mippene shehammitta tefela lo
Hammotzi ochalin pachot mikkashshiur bichli patur af al hakkeli mippene shehakkeli tafel lo
Metiv rav yosef rabbi yehuda omer bishyara noten adam chavit lachavero vachavero lachavero bishyara in shello bishyara la ella amar rav yosef ki tenan name bematnitin bishyara tenan
Abbaye amar bishyara afilu chavit shekkanta shevita umayim shekkanu shevita shello bishyara chavit shekkanta shevita umayim shello kanu shevita

Rav ashe amar hacha bechavit dehefker askinan umayim dehefker askinan uman amru lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri hi deamar cheftze hefker konin shevita umay lo tehallech zo yoter meragle habbealim lo yehallechu ellu yoter mikkelim sheyyesh lahem bealim
Matni haya kore besefer al haiskuppa venitgalgel hassefer miyyado gollo etzlo
Haya kore berosh haggag venitgalgel hassefer miyyado ad shello higgia laasara tefachim gollo etzlo mishshehiggia laasara tefachim hofcho al hakketav
Rabbi yehuda omer afilu en mesullak min haaretz ella kimlo machat gollo etzlo rabbi shimon omer afilu baaretz atzmo gollo etzlo sheen lecha davar mishshum shevut omed bifne kitve hakkodesh
Gema hay iskuppa hechi dame ilema iskuppa reshut hayyachid vekama reshut harabbim vela gazrinan dilma nafel veate leetoye

a: Manni rabbi shimon hi deamar kol davar shehu mishshum shevut eno omed bifne kitve hakkodesh ema sefa rabbi yehuda omer afilu en mesullak min haaretz ella melo hachut gollo etzlo rabbi shimon omer afilu baaretz atzmah gollo etzlo
Resha vesefa rabbi shimon metziata rabbi yehuda amar rav yehuda in resha vesefa rabbi shimon metziata rabbi yehuda
Rabba amar hacha beiskuppa hannidreset askinan umishshum bizon kitve hakkodesh shero rabbanan
Etiveh abbaye toch arba ammot gollo etzlo chutz learba hofcho al hakketav vei amratte beiskuppa nidreset askinan ma li toch arba ammot ma li chutz learba ammot
Ella amar abbaye hacha beiskuppa karmelit askinan urshut harabbim overet lefaneha
Toch arba ammot dei nafel umayeti leh la ate lide chiyyuv chattat sharu leh rabbanan
Chutz learba ammot dei mayete leh ate lide chiyyuv chattat la sharu leh rabbanan

I hachi toch arba ammot name nigzar dilma meayyel mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid vechi tema kevan demafseket karmelit let lan bah vehaamar rava hammaavir chefetz mittechillat arba lesof arba veheeviro derech alav chayyav
Hacha bemay askinan beiskuppa arukka addehachi vehachi midchar
Veibaet ema leolam beiskuppa sheenah arukka ustam kitve hakkodesh ayyone meayyen behu umannach lehu velechush dilma meayyen behu birshut harabbim veayel lehu behedya lirshut hayyachid
Ha manni ben azzay hi deamar mehallech keomed dame vedilma zarek lehu mizrak deamar rabbi yochanan mode ben azzay bezorek
Amar rav acha bar ahava zot omeret en mezarkin kitve hakkodesh
Haya kore berosh haggag vechu umi shere vehatanya kotve sefarim tefilin umzuzot lo hittiru lahen lehappech yeria al paneha ella pores aleha et habbeged
Hatam efshar hacha la efshar vei la afech ika bizon kitve hakkodesh tefe
Hofcho al hakketav veha la nach amar rava bechotel meshuppa
Amar leh abbaye bemay okemta lematnitin bechotel meshuppa ema sefa rabbi yehuda omer afilu eno mesullak min haaretz ella melo hachut gollo etzlo veha nach leh
Chassore michassera vehachi katane bamme devarim amurim bechotel meshuppa aval
b: Bechotel sheeno meshuppa lemala mishshelosha gollo etzlo lematta mishshelosha hofcho al hakketav
Rabbi yehuda omer afilu eno mesullak min haaretz vechu devaenan hannacha al gabbe mashshehu
Veella ha deamar rava toch shelosha lerabbanan tzarich hannacha lema ketannae amrah lishmateh

Ella kullah rabbi yehuda hi vechassore michassera vehachi katane bamme devarim amurim bechotel meshuppa aval bechotel sheeno meshuppa afilu pachot mishshelosha tefachim gollo etzlo sherabbi yehuda omer afilu eno mesullak min haaretz ella melo hachut gollo etzlo
May tama devaenan hannacha al gabbe mashshehu
Matni ziz shellifne challon notnin alav venotlin mimmennu beshabbat
Gema hay ziz demappek lehecha ilema demappek lirshut harabbim lechush dilma nafel veate leetoye ella demappek lirshut hayyachid peshita
Amar abbaye leolam demappek lirshut harabbim umay notnin alav dekatane kelim hannishbarim
Tanya name hachi ziz shellifne hachallon hayyotze lirshut harabbim notnin alav kearot vechosot kitoniyyot utzlochiyyot
Umishtammesh bechol hakkotel ad asara hattachtonim veim yesh ziz echad lematta mimmennu mishtammesh bo uvaelon en mishtammesh bo ella keneged challono
Hay ziz hechi dame i delet beh arbaa mekom petur hu vaafilu keneged challono name la yishtammesh vei it beh arbaa bechulle hakkotel lishtammesh
Amar abbaye tachton deit beh arbaa veelon let beh arbaa vechallon mashlimato learbaa keneged challon mishtammesh dechore challon hu dehay gisa udhay gisa asur
Matni omed adam birshut hayyachid umtaltel birshut harabbim birshut harabbim umtaltel birshut hayyachid uvilvad shello yotzi chutz mearba ammot
Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyashtin birshut harabbim birshut harabbim veyashtin birshut hayyachid vechen lo yarok
Rabbi yehuda omer af mishshennitlash rukko befiv lo yehallech arba ammot ad sheyyarok
Gema matne leh rav chinana bar shelemya lechiyya bar rav kammeh derav lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid umtaltel birshut harabbim amar leh shavkatte rabbanan veavdatte kerabbi meir

a: Hu savar middesefa rabbi meir resha name rabbi meir vela hi sefa rabbi meir veresha rabbanan
Uvilvad shello yotzi chutz ha hotzi chayyav chattat lema mesayya leh lerava deamar rava hammaavir chefetz mittechilat arba lesof arba veheeviro derech alav chayyav
Mi katane im hotzi chayyav chattat dilma im hotzi patur aval asur

Ika deamri ha hotzi patur aval asur lema tehve teuvteh derava deamar rava hammaavir mittechilat arba lesof arba veheeviro derech alav chayyav mi katane hotzi patur aval asur dilma im hotzi chayyav chattat
Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid vechu amar rav yosef hishtin verak chayyav chattat
Veha bainan akira vehannacha meal gabbe mekom arbaa veleka
Machshavto meshavveya leh makom dei la tema hachi ha deamar rava zarak venach befi hakkelev o befi hakkivshan chayyav chattat veha bainan hannacha al gabbe mekom arbaa veleka
Ella machshavto meshavveya leh makom hachi name machshava meshavveya lah makom
Bae rava hu birshut hayyachid ufi amma birshut harabbim mahu batar akira azlinan o batar yetzia azlinan teku
Vechen lo yarok rabbi yehuda omer vechu af al gav dela happech bah
Vehatnan haya ochel devela beyadayim mesoavot vehichnis yado letoch piv litol tzeror rabbi meir metamme verabbi yose metaher
Rabbi yehuda omer hipech bah tame lo hipech bah tahor
Amar rabbi yochanan muchlefet hashshita
Resh lakish amar leolam la tachlef vehacha bemay askinan bechicho

Vehattanya rabbi yehuda omer kicho venitlash may lav rok venitlash la kicho venitlash veha tanya rabbi yehuda omer kicho shennitlash vechen rukko shennitlash lo yehallech arba ammot ad sheyyarok ella mechavarta chidshanninan meikara
Amar resh lakish kiyyach bifne rabbo chayyav mita shenneemar kol mesanay ahavu mavet al tikre limsanay ella lemasniay
Veha menas anis kiyyach verak kaamrinan
Matni lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyishte birshut harabbim birshut harabbim veyishte birshut hayyachid ella im ken hichnis rosho verubbo limkom shehu shote vechen baggat
Gema resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir
Amar rav yosef bachafetzin shetztzerichin lo vedivre hakkol
Ibaya lehu karmelit may amar abbaye hi hi amar rava hi gufa gezera vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera
Amar abbaye mena amena lah middekatane
b: Vechen baggat
Verava amar leinyan maaser vechen amar rav sheshet vechen baggat leinyan maaser
Ditnan shotin al haggat ben bechammin uven betzonen ufatur divre rabbi meir rabbi eliezer bar tzadok mechayyev
Vachachamim omrim al hachammin chayyav veal hatztzonen patur mippene shemmachazir et hammotar
Matni kolet adam min hammazchela lematta measara tefachim umin hatztzinor mikkol makom shote
Gema kolet in aval metzaref la may tama amar rav nachman hacha bemazchela pachot mishshelosha samuch laggag askinan dechol pachot mishshelosha samuch laggag kegag dame
Tanya name hachi omed adam birshut hayyachid umagbiha yado lemala measara tefachim lefachot mishshelosha samuch laggag vekolet uvilvad shello yetzaref
Tanya idach lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyagbiha yado lemala measara tefachim lefachot mishshelosha samuch laggag vitzaref aval kolet hu veshote
Min hatztzinor mikkol makom shote tana im yesh betzinor arbaa al arbaa asur mippene shehu kemotzi mershut lirshut
Matni bor birshut harabbim vechulyato gavoha asara tefachim challon sheal gabbav memallein hemennu beshabbat
Ashpa birshut harabbim gevoha asara tefachim challon sheal gabbav shofchin letochah mayim beshabbat
Gema bemay askinan ilema bismucha lema li chulya asara
Amar rav huna hacha bemay askinan bemufleget min hakkotel arbaa
Vetama deika chulya asara ha leka chulya asara ka metaltel mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derech reshut harabbim
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu tema bismucha ha ka mashma lan devor vechulyato mitztarfin laasara
Ashpa birshut harabbim vechu vela chayeshinan shemma tinnatel ashpa
Veha ravin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak maase bemavoy echad shetztzido echad kale layyam vetzido echad kale leashpa uva maase lifne rabbi velo amar bo lo isur velo heter
Heter lo amar bo dechayeshinan shemma tinnatel ashpa veyaale hayyam sirton
Isur lo amar bo deha kayemin mechitzot
La kashya ha deyachid ha derabbim
Matni ilan shehaya mesech al haaretz im en gufo gavoha min haaretz shelosha tefachim metaltelim tachtav
Shorashav gevohim min haaretz shelosha tefachim lo yeshev alehen
Gema amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua en metaltelin bo yater mibbet satayim may tama

a: Mishshum dehave dira shettashmishah laavir vechol dira shettashmishah laavir en metaltelin bah yater mibbet satayim
Shorashav gevohin min haaretz vechu itmar shorshe ilan habbain millemala mishshelosha letoch shelosha rabba amar muttar lehishtammesh bahen rav sheshet amar asur lehishtammesh bahen
Rabba amar muttar lehishtammesh bahen dechol pachot mishshelosha deara ara hi rav sheshet amar asur lehishtammesh bahen dechevan demikkoach isur kaate asurin
Dedamu kimshunnita desalkin leela asurin denachatin letattay sheru litzdadin pelugta derabba verav sheshet
Vechen annigra vechen bekeren zavit
Hahu dikla dahava leabbaye vahava salek beipuma ata lekammeh derav yosef ushra leh
Amar rav acha bar tachlifa dishra lach kerabba shera lach
Peshita mahu detema afilu lerav sheshet beta keman dimle dame velishtammesh befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag ka mashma lan
Tenan shorashav gevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim lo yeshev alehem hechi dame i dela hadri kayefi peshita ella lav af al gav dehadri kayefi
La leolam dela hadari kayefi veha ka mashma lan af al gav detzido echad shave laaretz

Tanu rabbanan shorshe ilan sheggevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim o sheyyesh chalal tachtehen shelosha tefachim af al pi shetztzido echad shave laaretz hare ze lo yeshev alehen lefi sheen olin beilan veen nitlin beilan veen nishanin beilan
Velo yaale beilan mibbeod yom veyeshev sham kol hayyom kullo echad ilan veechad kol habbehema aval bor shiach umara vegader metappes veole metappes veored vaafilu hen mea amma
Tane chada im ala muttar lered vetane chada asur lered la kashya kan mibbeod yom kan mishshechashecha
Veibaet ema ha veha mishshechashecha vela kashya kan beshogeg kan bemezid
Veibaet ema ha veha beshogeg vehacha bekansu shogeg attu mezid kamipalgi mar savar kansinan umar savar la kansinan
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua ketannae hannitanin bemattana achat shennitarvu benitanin mattana achat yinnatnu bemattana achat mattan arba bemattan arba yinnatnu bemattan arba
Mattan arba bemattan achat rabbi eliezer omer yinnatnu bemattan arba verabbi yehoshua omer yinnatnu bemattana achat
Amar lo rabbi eliezer hare hu over al bal tigra amar lo rabbi yehoshua hare hu over beval tosif
Amar rabbi eliezer lo amru ella keshehu beatzmo amar lo rabbi yehoshua lo neemar bal tigra ella keshehu beatzmo
Veod amar rabbi yehoshua keshennatatta avarta al bal tosif veasita maase beyadecha keshello natatta avarta al bal tigra velo asita maase beyadecha
Lerabbi eliezer deamar hatam kum ase adif hachi name yered lerabbi yehoshua deamar hatam shev veal taase adif hachi name lo yered
Dilma la hi ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam kum ase adif ella deka aved mitzva aval hacha dela aved mitzva hachi name lo yered
Vei name ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam shev veal taase adif ella
b: Dela ka aved isura aval hacha deka aved isura hachi name deyered
Tane chada echad ilan lach veechad ilan yavesh vetanya idach bamme devarim amurim belach aval beyavesh muttar
Amar rav yehuda la kashya kan besheggizo machlif kan besheen gizo machlif
Gizo machlif yavesh karet leh ella la kashya kan bimot hachamma kan bimot haggeshamim
Bimot hachamma ha natri pere bidlika pere veha ka natri kinse begidduda
Ini veha rav ikla leafsatya vaasar begidduda rav bika matza vegadar bah gader
Amar rame bar abba amar rav assi asur leadam sheyehallech al gabbe asavim beshabbat mishshum shenneemar veatz beraglayim chote
Tane chada muttar lelech al gabbe asavim beshabbat vetanya idach asur la kashya ha belachim ha biveshim
Vei baet ema ha veha belachim vela kashya kan bimot hachamma kan bimot haggeshamim
Veibaet ema ha veha bimot hachamma vela kashya ha desayem mesaneh ha dela sayem mesaneh
Veibaet ema ha veha desayem mesaneh vela kashya ha deit leh uktze ha delet leh uktze
Veibaet ema ha veha deit leh uktze ha deit leh sheracha ha delet leh sheracha
Vehaidana dekayema lan kerabbi shimon kullehu shere
Veamar rame bar chama amar rav assi asur leadam sheyyachof ishto lidvar mitzva shenneemar veatz beraglayim chote
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol hakkofe ishto lidvar mitzva haveyan lo banim sheenan mehugganin amar rav ika bar chinana may keraa gam belo daat nefesh lo tov
Tanya name hachi gam belo daat nefesh lo tov ze hakkofe ishto lidvar mitzva veatz beraglayim chote ze habboel veshone
Ini vehaamar rava harotze laasot kol banav zecharim yivol veyishne la kashya kan ledaat kan shello ledaat

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan kol ishsha shettovaat balah lidvar mitzva hovin lah banim sheafilu bedoro shel moshe lo hau kemotan deilu bedoro shel moshe ketiv havu lachem anashim chachamim unvonim viduim leshivtechem uchtiv vaekkach et rashe shivtechem anashim chachamim viduim veilu nevonim la ashkach
Veilu gabbe lea ketiv vattetze lea likrato vattomer elay tavo ki sachor secharticha uchtiv umibbene yissashchar yode vina laittim ladaat ma yaase yisrael rashehem matayim vechol achehem al pihem
Ini vehaamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi eser kelalot nitkallela chava dichtiv
El haishsha amar harba arbe ellu shene tippe damim achat dam nidda veachat dam betulim itztzevonech ze tzaar gidul banim veheronech ze tzaar haibur beetzev teldi banim kemashmao
Veel ishech teshukatech melammed shehaishsha mishtokeket al balah beshaa sheyyotze ladderech vehu yimshol bach melammed shehaishsha tovaat ballev vehaish tovea bappe zo hi midda tova bannashim
Ki kaamrinan demartzeya artzoye kammeh
Hane sheva haveyan ki ata rav dimi amar atufa keavel umnudda mikkol adam vachavusha bevet haasurin
May menudda mikkol adam ilema mishshum daasir lah yichud ihu name asir leh yichud ella daasira leve tere
Bematnita tana megaddelet sear kelilit veoshevet umashtenet mayim kivhema venaaset kar levalah
Veidach hane shevach hu lah

Deamar rabbi chiyya may dichtiv mallefenu mibbahamot aretz umeof hashshamayim yechakkemenu mallefenu mibbahamot zo pereda shekkoraat umashtenet mayim umeof hashshamayim yechakkemenu ze tarnegol shemmefayyes veachar kach boel
Amar rabbi yochanan ilmale lo nitna tora hayinu lemedin tzeniut mechatul vegazel minnemala vaaraot miyyona derech eretz mittarnegol shemmefayyes veachar kach boel
Umay mefayyes lah amar rav yehuda amar rav hachi kaamar lah zavenna lich ziga dematu lich ad karach levatar hachi amar lah lishmatteh lecharbalteh dehahu tarnegola i it leh vela zavenna lich

a: Matni haddelet shebbammuktze vachadakim shebbappirtza umachtzalot en noalin bahen ella im ken gevohim min haaretz
Gema urminhu delet hannigreret umachtzelet hannigreret vekankan hannigrar bizman shekkeshurin utluyin noalin bahen beshabbat veen tzarich lomar beom tov
Amar abbaye besheyyesh lahem tzir rava amar beshehaya lahen tzir
Metivi delet hannigreret umachtzelet hannigreret vekankan hannigrar bizman shekkeshurin utluyin ugvohim min haaretz afilu melo nima noalin bahen veim lav en noalin bahen
Abbaye metaretz letameh verava metaretz letameh abbaye metaretz letameh o sheyyesh lahen tzir o sheggevohin min haaretz rava metaretz letameh keshehaya lahen tzir o sheggevohin min haaretz
Tanu rabbanan soche kotzim vachavilin shehitkinan lefirtza shebbechatzer bizman shekkeshurin utluyin noalin bahen beshabbat veen tzarich lomar beom tov
Tane rabbi chiyya delet almana hannigreret en noalin bah hechi dame delet almana ika deamri dechad shifa veika deamri delet leh gashma
Amar rav yehuda hay medurta mimmala lematta shere mimmatta lemala asir
Vechen beata vechen kidra vechen purya vechen chavita

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya chidkaa dichtiv bechu tovam kechedek amar leh shatya shefel lesefeh dikra dichtiv yashar mimmesucha veella may tovam kechedek keshem shechadakim hallalu meginin al happirtza kach tovim shebbanu meginim alenu davar acher tovam kechedek shemmehaddekin et ummot haolam legehinnam shenneemar kumi vadoshi vat tziyyon ki karnech asim barzel ufarsotayich asim nechusha vahadikot ammim rabbim vego
Matni lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyiftach birshut harabbim birshut harabbim veyiftach birshut hayyachid ella im ken asa mechitza gevoha asara tefachim divre rabbi meir
Amru lo maase beshuk shel pattamim shehaya birushalayim veshehau noalin umannichin et hammafteach bachallon sheal gabbe happetach rabbi yose omer shuk shel tzammarim hava

Gema verabbanan amar rabbi meir reshut harabbim umahderu inhu karmelit deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan yerushalayim ilmale daltoteha ninalot ballayela chayyavin aleha mishshum reshut harabbim
Amar rav pappa kan kodem shennifretzu bah peratzot kan leachar shennifretzu bah peratzot
Rava amar sefa atan leshaare gina vehachi kaamar vechen lo yaamod birshut hayyachid veyiftach becharmelit becharmelit veyiftach birshut hayyachid
b: Ella im ken asa mechitza gevoha asara tefachim divre rabbi meir amru lo maase beshuk shel pattamim shehaya birushalayim shehau noalin umannichin et hammafteach bachallon sheal gabbe happetach rabbi yose omer shuk shel tzammarim haya

Tanu rabbanan pitche shaare gina bizman sheyyesh lahen bet shaar mibbifnim poteach venoel mibbifnim mibbachutz poteach venoel mibbachutz mikkan umikkan poteach venoel kan vechan en lahen lo lechan velo lechan asurin kan vechan
Vechen chanuot happetuchot lirshut harabbim bizman shehammanul lematta measara mevi mafteach meerev shabbat umannicho baiskuppa lemachar poteach venoel umachziro laiskuppa
Uvizman shehammanul lemala measara mevi mafteach meerev shabbat umannicho bammanul lemachar poteach venoel umachziro limkomo divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim af bizman shehammanul lemala measara tefachim mevi mafteach meerev shabbat umannicho baiskuppa lemachar poteach venoel umachziro limkomo o bachallon sheal gabbe happetach
Im yesh bachallon arbaa al arbaa asur mippene shehu kemotzi mershut lirshut
Middekaamar vechen chanuot mikkelal diviskuppat karmelit askinan hay manul hechi dame i delet beh arbaa mekom petur hu

Vei it beh arbaa beha lema rabbanan af bizman shehammanul lemala measara mevi mafteach meerev shabbat umannicho baiskuppa lemachar poteach venoel bo umachziro laiskuppa o lachallon sheal gabbe happetach veha ka metaltel mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid
Amar abbaye leolam deen bo arbaa veyesh bo lachok ulhashlimo learbaa
Uvha peligi derabbi meir savar chokkin lehashlim verabbanan savri en chokkin lehashlim
Amar rav bivi bar abbaye shema minah meha matnita telat shema minah chokkin lehashlim ushma minah hadar beh rabbi meir mishshaare gina

Veshamatte minah midderabbanan ita lidrav dimi dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan makom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa muttar livne reshut harabbim velivne reshut hayyachid lechattef alav uvilvad shello yachalifu
Matni neger sheyyesh berosho gelostera rabbi eliezer oser verabbi yose mattir

Amar rabbi eliezer maase bichneset shebbitverya shehau nohagin bo heter ad shebba rabban gamliel vehazzekenim veasru lahen rabbi yose omer isur nahagu bo uva rabban gamliel vehazzekenim vehittiru lahen
Gema benital beigdo kulle alma la peligi ki peligi

a: Besheeno nital beigdo demar savar kevan deyesh berosho gelostera torat keli alav umar savar kevan deeno nital beigdo lo
Matni neger hannigrar noalin bo bemikdash aval lo bimdina
Vehammunnach kan vechan asur rabbi yehuda omer hammunnach muttar bammikdash vehannigrar bammedina

Gema tanu rabbanan ezehu neger hannigrar shennoalin bammikdash aval lo bammedina kol shekkashur vetaluy verosho echad maggia laaretz rabbi yehuda omer ze af bammedina muttar ella ezehu neger shennoalin bammikdash aval lo bammedina kol sheeno lo kashur velo taluy veshomto umannicho bekeren zavit
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda benigrar
Amar rava vehu shekkashur baddelet ini veha rabbi tavla ikla lemachoza vachaza lehahu dahava tele beivra dedashsha vela amar lehu vela mide hahu nital beigdo hava
Rav aveya ikla linhardea chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava ka kater begemi amar den la nitrok
Bae rabbi zera nikmaz mahu amar rav yosef may tibe leh la shemia leh ha detanya nishmat asur nikmaz muttar verabbi yehuda amar nikmaz af al pi sheeno nishmat asur
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda benikmaz vetama may amar abbaye mishshum demechze kevone
Bea mineh rav nechumi bar zecharya meabbaye asa lo bet yad mahu amar leh buchna kaamratte itmar amar rav nechumi bar adda asa lo bet yad muttar
Hahu sharita dahava be rabbi pedat dahava madlu lah be asra veshadu lah addesha vela amar lehu vela mide amar torat keli aleha
Hahi asita dahavat be mar shemuel dahava machzeket adriba shera mar shemuel lemishdeyah addasha amar torat keli aleha

Shelach leh rame bar yechezkel lerav amram nema lan mar mehalen mile mealleyata daamarte lan mishshemeh derav assi bechipe dearba shelach leh hachi amar rav assi hane kipe dearba bizman sheyyesh bahen tefach i name en bahen tefach veen ben ze laze shelosha lemachar mevi machtzelet ufores alehen
May tama mosif al ohel aray hu veshappir dame
Hanhu dichre dahao leh lerav huna devimama beo tulla uvlelya beo avera ata lekammeh derav
Amar leh zil keroch budya veshayyar bah tefach limchar pashtah umosif al ohel aray hu veshappir dame
Amar rav mishshum rabbi chiyya vilon muttar lintoto umuttar leforko beshabbat
Kilat chatanim muttar leforkah velintotah beshabbat amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi la amaran ella sheen begaggah tefach aval yesh begaggah tefach asur
Vechi en begaggah tefach la amaran ella sheen befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag tefach aval yesh befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag tefach asur
Vechi en befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag tefach name la amaran ella sheen
b: Beshipuah tefach aval yesh beshipuah tefach shipue ohalim keohalim damu
Veamar rav shisha bereh derav idi seyana shere vehatanya asur la kashya ha deit beh tefach ha delet beh tefach
Ella meatta sharbev biglimeh tefach hachi name deasur
Ella la kashya ha demihaddak ha dela mihaddak
Matni machzirin tzir hattachton bammikdash aval lo bammedina vehaelon kan vechan asur rabbi yehuda omer haelon bammikdash vehattachton bammedina
Gema tanu rabbanan tzir delet shida teva umigdal bammikdash machazirin bammedina dochakin vehaelon kan vechan lo yachazir gezera shemma yitka veim taka chayyav chattat
Shel bor veshel dut veshel yatzia lo yachzir veim hechzir chayyav chattat
Matni machzirin retiyya bammikdash aval lo bammedina im battechila kan vechan asur

Gema tanu rabbanan retiyya sheppersha meal gabbe makka machzirin beshabbat rabbi yehuda omer huchleka lematta dochakah lemala lemala dochakah lematta umgalle miktzat hartiyya umkanneach pi hammakka vechozer umgalle miktzat retiyya umkanneach pi hammakka
Urtiyya atzmah lo yekanneach mippene shehu memareach veim merach chayyav chattat
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda amar rav chisda lo shanu ella sheppersha al gabbe keli aval persha al gabbe karka divre hakkol asur

Amar mar bar rav ashe hava kaemna kammeh abba nefala leh abbe sadya veka mahdar leh amena leh la savar lah mar leha deamar rav chisda machloket sheppersha al gabbe keli aval persha al gabbe karka asur veamar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda
Amar li la shemia li kelomar la sevira li
Matni koshrin nima bammikdash aval lo bammedina veim battechila kan vechan asur
Gema urminhu nimat kinnor shennifseka lo haya koshrah ella onvah la kashya ha rabbanan veha rabbi eliezer
Lerabbi eliezer deamar machshire mitzva dochin et hashshabbat koshrah lerabbanan deamri en dochin onvah
I rabbi eliezer afilu lechattechila name
Ella la kashya ha rabbi yehuda veha rabbanan
Verabbi yehuda alliba deman

a: I alliba derabbi eliezer kaamar afilu lechattechila name
Ella la kashya ha rabbi shimon ha rabbanan detanya ben levi shennifseka lo nima bechinnor koshrah rabbi shimon omer onvah
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af hi enah mashmaat et hakkol ella meshalshel millematta vechorech millemala o meshalshel millemala vechorech millematta
Veibaet ema ha veha rabbanan vela kashya kan baemtza kan min hatztzad
Veibaet ema ha veha baemtza mar savar gazrinan umar savar la gazrinan
Matni chotchin yabbelet bammikdash aval lo bimdina veim bichli kan vechan asur
Gema urminhu herkevo vahavaato michutz lattechum vachatichat yabbalto en dochin rabbi eliezer omer dochin
Rabbi elazar verabbi yose ben chanina chad amar ha veha belacha vela kashya kan bayyad kan bichli
Vechad amar ha veha bayyad vela kashya ha belacha ha bivesha
Ulman deamar ha bayyad ha bichli may tama la amar ha belacha ha bivesha amar lach yevesha afilu bichli name shere may tama iparoche iparcha
Ulman deamar ha belacha veha bivesha may tama la amar ha bayyad ha bichli amar lach bichli ha tenan im bichli kan vechan asur
Veidach ha dekatane hatam mishshum deka bae iploge rabbi eliezer verabbanan
Veidach dumya deherkevo vahavaato michutz lattechum katane derabbanan
Veidach herkevo dela kerabbi natan deamar hachay nose et atzmo havaato michutz lattechum kerabbi akiva deamar techumin deorayeta
Metiv rav yosef amar rabbi eliezer kal vachomer uma shechita shehi mishshum melacha docha et hashshabbat ellu shemmishshum shevut eno din sheyyidchu et hashshabbat
Ella amar rav yosef ha veha bayyad ushvut mikdash bammikdash hittiru shevut demikdash bammedina lo hittiru

Yetev abbaye vekaamar leha shemata etiveh rav safra leabbaye haya kore bassefer al haiskuppa venitgalgel hassefer miyyado gollo etzlo veha hacha dishvut demikdash bammedina hu vela gazrinan dilma nafel veate leetoye
Vela okemna beiskuppa karmelit urshut harabbim overet lefaneha dechevan deigdo beyado afilu shevut name leka
Etiveh meshalshelin et happesach letannur im chashecha veha hacha dishvut demikdash bammedina vela gazrinan shemma yechatte baggechalim
Ishtik ki ata lekammeh derav yosef amar leh hachi amar li rav safra amar leh may tama la teshanne leh bene chavura zerizin hen
Veabbaye kohanim zerizin hen amrinan bene chavura zerizin hen la amrinan
Rava amar rabbi eliezer hi deamar machshire mitzva dochin et hashshabbat umode rabbi eliezer dechamma deefshar leshannoye meshanninan
b: May hi detanya kohen shealta bo yabbelet chavero chotchah lo beshinav beshinav in bichli la chavero in ihu la
Manni ilema rabbanan uvammikdash kevan deamri rabbanan bealma mishshum shevut hacha ma li hu ma li chavero
Ella lav rabbi eliezer deamar bealma chayyav chattat vehacha af al gav demachshire mitzva dochin et hashshabbat kamma deefshar leshannoye meshanninan
La leolam rabbanan vei alta bichreso hachi name
Hacha bemay askinan kegon shealta lo neshicha begabbo uvatztzile yadav deihu la matze shakel lah
Vei rabbanan nishkeleh nihaleh beyad vetifshot derabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar machaloket bayyad aval bichli divre hakkol chayyav
Velitamach lerabbi eliezer name lishkeleh nihaleh beyad hay may i amratte bishlama rabbi eliezer hayenu degazar yad attu keli ella i amratte rabbanan hi nishkeleh nihaleh beyad vetu la mide
Matni kohen shellaka beetzbao korech aleha gemi bammikdash aval lo bammedina im lehotzi dam kan vechan asur
Gema amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya lo shanu ella gemi aval tziltzol katan have yittur begadim
Verabbi yochanan amar lo amru yittur begadim ella bimkom begadim aval shello bimkom begadim la have yittur begadim
Vetipok leh mishshum chatzitza bismol
I name beyamin veshello bimkom avoda
Ufliga derava deamar rava amar rav chisda bimkom begadim afilu nima achat chotzetzet shello bimkom begadim shalosh al shalosh chotztzot pachot mishshalosh al shalosh enan chotztzot
Adderabbi yochanan vadday peliga adderav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya mi nema peliga
Shane tziltzol katan dachashiv
Lishana acharina amri lah amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya lo shanu ella gemi aval tziltzol katan chotzetz
Verabbi yochanan amar lo amru chatzitza befachot mishshalosh al shalosh ella bimkom begadim aval shello bimkom begadim

a: Shalosh al shalosh chotztzot pachot mishshalosh en chotztzot vehayenu derava amar rav chisda
Lema peliga derav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya shane tziltzol katan dachashiv
Ulrabbi yochanan addeashmeinan gemi lashmeinan tziltzol katan
Milta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan degemi masse
Matni bozkin melach al gabbe kevesh bishvil shello yachliku ummallein mibbor haggola umibbor haggadol baggalgal bashshabbat umibbeer hakkar beom tov

Gema rame leh rav ika mippashrunya lerava tenan bozkin melach al gabbe hakkevesh bishvil shello yachaliku bammikdash in bammedina la urminhi chatzer shennitkalkela bememe geshamim mevi teven umradde bah
Shane teven dela mevattel leh
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe hay melach hechi dame i dimvatteleh ka mosef abbinyan uchtiv hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil
Vei dela ka mevatteleh ka haveya chatzitza
Beholachat evarim lakkevesh delav avoda hi
Vela veha ketiv vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol vehiktir hammizbecha veamar mar zo holachat evarim lakkevesh ella ema beholachat etzim lammaaracha delav avoda hi
Daresh rava chatzer shennitkalkela bememe geshamim mevi teven umradde bah amar leh rav pappa lerava vehatanya keshehu meradde eno meradde lo besal velo bekuppa ella beshule kuppa
Hadar okem rava amora aleh udrash devarim sheamarti lifnechem taut hen beyadi beram kach amru mishshum rabbi eliezer uchshehu meradde eno meradde lo besal velo bekuppa ella beshule kuppa
Memallein mibbor haggola ulla ikla leve rav menashshe ata hahu gavra teraf abbava amar man hay litachal gufeh deka machel leh leshabbeta
Amar leh rabba lo asru ella kol shel shir etiveh abbaye maalin bidofi umattifin meerek lachole bashshabbat
Lachole in labbari la hechi dame lav denayem veka bae delitar shema minah olode kala asir
La detir veka bae delenim demishtammea ki kala dezimzume
Etiveh hamshammer perotav mippene haofot udluav mippene hachayya meshammer kedarko beshabbat uvilvad shello yispok velo yetappeach velo yerakked kederech shehen osin bachol
May tama lav dekamoled kala vechol olode kala asir amar rav acha bar yaakov gezera shemma yittol tzeror
Veella ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav nashim hamsachakot beegozim asur may tama lav deka moled kala vechol olode kala asir
La dilma ate leashoye gummot
Dei la tema hachi ha deamar rav yehuda nashim mesachakot betappuchim asur hatam may olode kala ika ella dilma ate leashoye gummot
Tenan memallein mibbor haggola umibbor haggadol baggalgal beshabbat bemikdash in bimdina la may tama lav mishshum deolode kala vaasir
La gezera shemma yemalle leginato ulchurbato
Ammemar shera lemimle begilgela bemachoza amar may tama gezaru rabbanan shemma yemalle leginato ulchurbato hacha la gina ika vela churba ika
Kevan deka chaze deka
b: Taru bah kitana asar lehu
Umibbeer hakkar may beer hakkar amar shemuel bor shehikru aleha devarim vehittiruha
Metivi lo kol habborot hakkarot hittiru ella zo bilvad vei amratte shehikru devarim aleha may zo bilvad
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak beer mayim chayyim shenneemar kehakir bayir memeha vego
Gufa lo kol habborot hakkarot hittiru ella zo bilvad uchshealu bene haggola chanu aleha unviim shebbenehen hittiru lahen velo neviim shebbenehen ella minhag avotam bidehem
Matni sheretz shennimtza bammikdash kohen motzio behemyano shello lishhot et hattuma divre rabbi yochanan ben beroka rabbi yehuda omer bitzvat shel etz shello lerabbot et hattuma
Mehechan motziin oto min hahechal umin haulam umibben haulam velammizbeach divre rabbi shimon ben nannas
Rabbi akiva omer kol makom shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat mishsham motziin oto ushar kol hammekomot kofin alav pesachter
Rabbi shimon omer makom shehittiru lecha chachamim mishshellecha natnu lach shello hittiru lecha ella mishshum shevut

Gema amar rav tavi bar kisna amar shemuel hammachnis teme sheretz lammikdash chayyav sheretz atzmo patur may tama amar kera mizzachar vead nekeva teshallechu mi sheyyesh lo tohora bemikve yatza sheretz sheen lo tohora
Lema mesayya leh mizzachar ad nekeva teshallechu perat lichli cheres divre rabbi yose haggelili may tama lav mishshum delet leh tohora bemikve
La mi shennaasa av hattuma yatza keli cheres sheeno naasa av hattuma
Lema ketannae sheretz shennimtza bammikdash kohen motzio behemyano shello leshahot et hattuma divre rabbi yochanan ben beroka rabbi yehuda omer bitzvat shel etz motzio shello lerabbot et hattuma
May lav beha ka mipalgi deman deamar shello leshahot kasavar hammachnis sheretz lammikdash chayyav uman deamar shello lerabbot kasavar hammachnis sheretz lammikdash patur
La dechulle alma chayyav vehacha beha ka mipalgi mar savar shahoye tuma adif umar savar apposhe tuma adif
Ella kehane tannae ditnan mehechan motziin oto ku
May lav beha ka mipalgi deman deamar meazara la kasavar hammachnis sheretz lammikdash patur uman deamar mikkullah azara kasavar chayyav

a: Amar rabbi yochanan ushnehem mikra echad darshu vayyavou hakkohanim lifnima vet Adonai letaher vayyotziu et kol hattuma asher matzu behechal Adonai lachatzar bet Adonai vayekabbelu halviyyim lehotzi lenachal kidron chutza
Mar savar middeishtanni baazara bilviyyim tuma baazara leka
Umar savar ad hecha dela efshar bilviyyim mappeki kohanim hashta deefshar bilviyyim tu la mittammei kohanim

Tanu rabbanan hakkol nichnasin bahechal livnot letakken ulhotzi et hattuma umitzva bechohanim im en sham kohanim nichnasin leviyyim en sham leviyyim nichnasin yisreelim veide veide tehorin in temein la
Amar rav huna rav kahana mesayya kahane detane rav kahana mittoch shenneemar ach el happarochet lo yavo yachol lo yehu kohanim baale mumin nichnasin ben haulam velammizbeach laasot rikue fachim
Talmud lomar ach chillek mitzva bitmimim en sham temimim nichnasin baale mumin mitzva bithorin en sham tehorin nichnasin temein ide veide kohanim in yisreelim la
Ibaya lehu tame uvaal mum ezo mehen nichnas rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav tame nichnas deha ishteri baavodat tzibur rabbi elazar omer baal mum nichnas deha ishteri baachilat kadashim

Rabbi shimon omer vechu rabbi shimon hecha kae hatam kae ditnan mi shehecheshich chutz lattechum afilu amma achat lo yikkanes rabbi shimon omer afilu chamesh esre amma yikkanes lefi sheen hammashochot mematztzein et hammiddot mippene hattoim
Dekaamar tanna kamma lo yikkanes vaamar leh rabbi shimon yikkanes
Shello hittiru lach ella mishshum shevut hecha kae hatam kae dekaamar tanna kamma koshrah vaamar leh rabbi shimon onvah
Aniva dela ate lide chiyyuv chattat sharu leh rabbanan keshira deate lide chiyyuv chattat la sharu leh rabbanan
Hadran alach hammotze tefilin uslika lah massechet eruvin

Matni or learbaa asar bodkin et hechametz leor hanner kol makom sheen machnisin bo chametz en tzarich bedika uvamma amru shette shurot bammartef makom shemmachnisin bo chametz bet shammay omrim shette shurot al pene kol hammartef uvet hillel omrim shette shurot hachitzonot shehen haelonot
Gema may or rav huna amar naghe verav yehuda amar lele ka salka datach deman deamar naghe naghe mammash uman deamar lele lele mammash

Metivi habboker or vehaanashim shullechu alma or yemama hu mi ketiv haor boker habboker or ketiv keman deamar tzafra nehar vechidrav yehuda amar rav deamar rav yehuda amar rav leolam yikkanes adam bechi tov veyetze bechi tov
Metivi uchor boker yizrach shamesh alma or yemama hu mi ketiv or boker uchor boker ketiv vehachi kaamar uchor boker baolam hazze keen zerichat shemesh latztzaddikim laolam habba
Metivi vayyikra elohim laor yom alma or yemama hu hachi kaamar lammeir uva kerao yom ella meatta velachoshech kara layela lammachshich uva kara layela veha kayema lan dead tzet hakkochavim yemama hu
Ella hachi kaamar karyeh rachamana linhora ufakkedeh ammitzveta dimama vekaryeh rachamana lachashocha ufakkedeh ammitzveta delela

Metivi halluhu kol kochve or alma or urta hu hachi kaamar halluhu kol kochavim hammeirim ella meatta kochavim hammeirim hu devau shabboche sheenan meirin la bau shabboche veha ketiv halluhu kal tzevaav
Ella ha ka mashma lan deor dechochavim name or hu lemay nafka minah lenoder min haor ditnan hannoder min haor asur beoran shel kochavim
Metivi laor yakum rotzeach yiktol ani veevon uvallayela yehi chaggannav
b: Ha middekaamar uvallayela yehi chaggannav alma or yemama hu hatam hachi kaamar i peshita lach milta kinhora deannefashot kaate rotzeach hu venitan lehatztzilo benafsho vei mesappeka lach milta kelelya yehi beenecha kegannav velo nitan lehatztzilo benafsho

Metivi yechshechu kochve nishpo yekav leor vaayin veal yire beafappe shachar middekaamar yekav leor vaayin alma or yemama hu hatam melat hu deka layet leh iyyov lemazzaleh amar yehe raava delitzpeh hach gavra linhora vela lashkecheh

Metivi vaomar ach choshech yeshufeni velayela or baadeni alma or yemama hu hatam hachi kaamar david ani amarti ach choshech yeshufeni laolam habba shehu dome leom achshav haolam hazze shehu dome lelayela or baadeni
Metivi rabbi yehuda omer bodkin or learbaa asar uvarbaa asar shacharit uvishat habbiur middekaamar rabbi yehuda bodkin or arbaa asar uvarbaa asar shacharit alma or urta hu shema minah
Metivi meematay arbaa asar asur baasiyyat melacha rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer mishsheat haor rabbi yehuda omer mishsheat hanetz hachamma

Amar leh rabbi eliezer ben yaakov lerabbi yehuda vechi hechan matzinu yom shemmiktzato asur baasiyyat melacha umiktzato muttar baasiyyat melacha amar leh hu atzmo yochiach shemmiktzato muttar baachilat chametz umiktzato asur baachilat chametz
Middekaamar rabbi yehuda mishsheat hanetz hachamma alma or dekaamar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov urta hu la may or ammud hashshachar
I hachi dekaamar leh hechan matzinu yom shemmiktzato muttar baasiyyat melacha umiktzato asur baasiyyat melacha nema ihu lenafsheh ha ika layela deka share rabbi eliezer ben yaakov

Hachi kaamar bishlama ledidi ashkachna deka palgi rabbanan ben yemama lelelya ditnan gabbe taanit tzibbur ad matay ochel veshote ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar divre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov rabbi shimon omer ad kerot haggever ella ledidach hecha ashkachna yemama gufeh defalgi beh rabbanan

Amar leh hu atzmo yochiach shemmiktzato muttar baachilat chametz umiktzato asur baachilat chametz shappir kaamar leh rabbi yehuda lerabbi eliezer hachi kaamar leh rabbi eliezer amena lach ana melacha derabbanan veatte amratte li chametz deorayeta dead hacha asar rachamana vead hacha shera rachamana
Veidach shaot derabbanan
Veidach harchaka hu daavud rabbanan lidorayeta
Metivi en massiin massuot ella al hachodesh shennira bizmanno lekaddesho veematay massiin massuot leor ibburo alma or urta hu shema minah
Metivi haya omed kol hallayela umakriv al hammizbeach laora taun kidush yadayim veraglayim divre rabbi ora shane
Metivi mar zutra

a: Hammappelet or lishmonim veechad bet shammay potrin mikkorban uvet hillel mechayevim

Amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay may shena or shemonim veechad miyyom shemonim veechad im shiva lo letuma lo yishve lo lekorban middekaamar bet hillel levet shammay may shena or shemonim veechad miyyom shemonim veechad shema minah or urta hu shema minah
Metivi yachol yehe neechal or lashshelishi vedin hu zevachim neechalim leom echad ushlamim neechalim lishne yamim ma lehallan layela achar hayyom af kan layela achar hayyom
Talmud lomar beom zivchachem yeachel umimmochorat vehannotar ad yom beod yom hu neechal veeno neechal leor shelishi
Yachol yissaref miyyad vedin hu zevachim neechalin leom velayela echad ushlamim neechalin lishne yamim velayela echad ma lehallan techef laachila serefa af kan techef laachila serefa
Talmud lomar vehannotar mibbesar hazzevach bayyom hashshelishi baesh yissaref bayyom atta soref vei atta sorfo ballayela middekaamar yehe neechal or lashshelishi alma or urta hu shema minah

Ta shema or shel yom hakkippurim mitpallel sheva umitvadde shacharit mitpallel sheva umitvadde bemusaf mitpallel sheva umitvadde bemincha mitpallel sheva umitvadde bearvit mitpallel meen shemona asar rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer mishshum avotav mitpallel shemona asar shelemot mippene shetztzarich lomar havdala bechonen haddaat alma or urta hu shema minah
Ta shema detane deve shemuel lele arbaa asar bodkin et hechametz leor hanner alma or urta hu
Ella ben rav huna uven rav yehuda dechulle alma or urta hu vela peligi mar ki atreh umar ki atreh beatreh derav huna karu naghe uvatreh derav yehuda karu lele

Vetanna didan may tama la katane lele lishana mealleya hu denaket vechidrabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi leolam al yotzi adam davar megunne mippiv shehare ikkem hakkatuv shemone otiyyot velo hotzi davar megunne mippiv shenneemar min habbehema hattehora umin habbehema asher enenna tehora

Rav pappa amar tesha shenneemar ki yihye vecha ish asher lo yihye tahor mikkere layela ravina amar eser vav detahor rav acha bar yaakov amar shesh esre shenneemar ki amar mikre hu bilti tahor hu ki lo tahor
Tanya deve rabbi yishmael leolam yesapper adam belashon nekiyya shehare bazzav kerao merkav uvaishsha kerao moshav veomer vetivchar leshon arumim veomer vedaat sefatay barur millelu
May veomer vechi tema hane mile bidorayeta aval bidrabbanan la ta shema veomer vetivchar leshon arumim vechi tema hane mile bidrabbanan aval bemile dealma la veomer vedaat sefatay barur millelu

Uvishsha la ketiv bah merkav vehachtiv vattakom rivka venaaroteha vattirkavna al haggemallim hatam mishshum biatuta digmallim orcha hi vehachtiv vayyikkach moshe et ishto veet banav vayyarkivem al hachamor hatam
b: Mishshum banav orcha hu

Vehachtiv vehi rochevet al hachamor hatam mishshum biatuta delelya orcha hu veibaet ema mishshum biatuta delelya leka mishshum biatuta dedavid ika veibaet ema biatuta dedavid name leka mishshum biatuta dehar ika

Uvorayeta mi la ketiv tame ella kol hecha dechi hadade ninhu mishtae belashon nekiyya kol hecha dinfishin mile mishtae belashon ketzara kidamar rav huna amar rav veamri lah amar rav huna amar rav mishshum rabbi meir leolam yishne adam letalmido derech ketzara
Vechol hecha dechi hadade ninhu mishtae bilshon kavod veha rochevet veoshevet dechi hadade ninhu vekaamar rochevet rochevet ketiv
Hanhu tere talmide dahao yatvi kammeh derav chad amar shavitinan hay shemata kedavar acher mesannekan vechad amar shavitinan hay shemata kigdi mesannekan vela ishtai rav bahade dehayeche

Hanhu tere talmide dahao yatvi kammeh dehillel vechad minayehu rabban yochanan ben zakkay veamri lah kammeh derabbi vechad minayehu rabbi yochanan chad amar mippene ma botzrin betahora veen moskin betahora vechad amar mippene ma botzrin betahora umoskin betuma amar muvtach ani baze shemmore horaa beyisrael velo haya yamim muatim ad shehora horaa beyisrael
Hanhu telata chahane chad amar lehu higgiani kefol vechad amar higgiani kezayit vechad amar higgiani kiznav halletaa badku acharav umatzu bo shemetz pesul
Veha tanya en bodkin min hammizbeach ulmala
La tema shemetz pesul ella ema shachatz pesul vei baet ema shane hatam deihu dearra nafsheh
Hahu armaa dahava salek veachel pesachim birushalayim amar ketiv kol ben nechar lo yochal bo kol arel lo yochal bo vaana ha kaachelna mishufre shufre
Amar leh rabbi yehuda ben betera mi ka safu lach mealya amar leh la ki salkatte lehatam ema lehu sefo li mealya ki selek amar lehu mealya sefo li amaru leh alya legavoha salka

Amaru leh man amar lach hachi amar lehu rabbi yehuda ben betira amaru may hay dekamman bedaku batreh veashkechuhu dearmaa hu vekatluhu shelachu leh lerabbi yehuda ben betira shelam lach rabbi yehuda ben betira deatte bintzivin umtzudatcha perusa birushalayim

Rav kahana chalash shadderuh rabbanan lerabbi yehoshua bereh derav idi amaru leh zil bedok may dineh ata ashkecheh denach nafsheh kareh lilvusheh veahdereh lekireh laachoreh uvache veate amaru leh nach nafsheh amar lehu ana la kaamena umotzi dibba hu chesil

Yochanan chakokaa nefak lekiryata ki ata amaru leh chitin naasu yafot amar lahem seorim naasu yafot amaru leh tze uvasser lassusim velachamorim dichtiv hasseorim vehatteven lassusim velarachesh may have leh lememar eshtakad naasu chitin yafot i name adashim naasu yafot

a: Rav bar achuh derabbi chiyya uvar achateh ki selek lehatam amar leh ayevu kayyam amar leh ima kayyemet amar leh ima kayyemet amar leh ayevu kayyam

Amar leh leshammaeh chalotz li minalay veholech kelay achare levet hammerchatz shema minah telat shema minah avel asur binilat hassandal ushma minah shemua rechoka enah noheget ella yom echad ushma minah miktzat hayyom kechullo
Hahu deamar dunu dini amri shema minah middan kaate dichtiv dan yadin ammo keachad shivte yisrael
Hahu dahava ka azel veamar akkef yamma asesni birata bedaku veashkechuhu demizzevulun kaate dichtiv zevulun lechof yammim yishkon
Vehashta dekayema lan dilchulle alma or urta hu mikkede ben lerabbi yehuda uven lerabbi meir chametz eno asur ella mishshesh shaot ulmala venivdok beshet

Vechi tema zerizin makdimin lemitzot nivdok mitztzafra dichtiv uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar arlato vetanya kal hayyom kullo kasher lemila ella shezzerizin makdimim lemitzot shenneemar vayyashkem avraham babboker
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak beshaa shebbene adam metzuyin bevattehem veor hanner yafe livdika
Amar abbaye hilkach hay tzurba merabbanan la liftach beidaneh beurta ditlesar denaghe arbesar dilma mashcha leh shemateh veate leimnoe mimmitzva

Beo mineh merav nachman bar yitzchak hammaskir bayit lachavero bearbaa asar al mi livdok al hammaskir livdok dachamira dideh hu o dilma al hassocher livdok deisura birshuteh kae ta shema hammaskir bayit lachavero al hassocher laasot lo mezuza

Hatam ha amar rav mesharsheya mezuza chovat haddar hi hacha may amar lehu rav nachman bar yitzchak tenena hammaskir bayit lachavero im ad shello masar lo maftechot chal arbaa asar al hammaskir livdok veim mishshemmasar lo maftechot chal arbaa asar al hassocher livdok
Beo mineh merav nachman bar yitzchak hammaskir bayit lachavero bearbaa asar chezkato baduk o en chezkato baduk lemay nafka minah lishayeleh deleteh lehay dilshayyoleh leatroche lehay may
Amar lehu rav nachman bar yitzchak tenetuha hakkol neemanim al biur chametz afilu nashim afilu avadim afilu ketannim may tama mehemne
b: Lav mishshum dechezkato baduk dekasavar hakkol chaverim hem etzel bedikat chametz detanya chaver shemmet vehinniach megura melea perot afilu hen bene yoman hare hen bechezkat metukkanim
Umimmay dilma shane hacha mishshum dekaamri hane attu amira dehane mide meshasha it beh
Ella may dechazkato baduk hay hakkol neemanim kal habbattim bechezkat bedukin bearbaa asar mibe leh
Ella may mishshum amira dehane ha la amri hane la tifshot mineh deen chezkato baduk

La leolam ema lach chezkato baduk vehacha bemay askinan demuchzak lan dela bedak vekaamri hane badkineh mahu detema la lehemninhu rabbanan ka mashma lan kevan divdikat chametz midderabbanan hu demiddeorayeta bevitul bealma saggi leh hemnuhu rabbanan bidrabbanan
Ibaya lehu hammaskir bayit lachavero bechezkat baduk umtzao sheeno baduk mahu mi have kemikkach taut o la
Ta shema deamar abbaye la mibaya beatra dela yahavi agra uvdaku denicha leh leinish lekayyome mitzva begufeh ella afilu beatra deyahavi agra uvdaku denicha leh leinish lekayyome mitzva bemamoneh

Tenan hatam rabbi meir omer ochlin kal chamesh vesorfin bitchillat shesh rabbi yehuda omer ochlin kal arba vetolin kal chamesh vesorfin bitchillat shesh dechulle alma miha chametz mishshesh shaot ulmala asur menalan
Amar abbaye tere kerae ketivi ketiv shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem uchtiv ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem ha ketzad lerabbot arbaa asar leviur
Veema lerabbot lele chamishsha asar leviur desalka datach amena yamim ketiv yamim in lelot la ka mashma lan afilu lelot hahu la itztericha leh

a: Deha itakkash hashbatat seor laachilat chametz vaachilat chametz laachilat matztza
Hashbatat seor laachilat chametz dichtiv shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem ki kal ochel machmetzet venichreta
Vaachilat chametz laachilat matztza dichtiv kal machmetzet lo tochelu bechol moshvotechem tochlu matztzot vego uchtiv beh bematztza baerev tochlu matztzot
Veema lerabbot lel arbaa asar leviur bayyom ketiv
Veema mitztzafra ach chillek
Deve rabbi yishmael tana matzinu arbaa asar shennikra rishon shenneemar barishon bearbaa asar yom lachodesh rav nachman bar yitzchak amar rishon demeikara mashma deamar kera harishon adam tivaled
Ella meatta ulkachtem lachem bayyom harishon hachi name rishon demeikara mashma
Shane hatam dichtiv usmachtem lifne Adonai elohechem shivat yamim ma shevii shevii lechag af rishon rishon lechag
Hacha name ketiv ach bayyom harishon tashbitu shivat yamim matztzot tochelu im ken nichtov kera rishon harishon lema li shema minah lichdaamaran

I hachi hatam name harishon lema li vetu hatam dichtiv bayyom harishon shabbaton uvayyom hashshemini shabbaton emar rishon demeikara mashma shane hatam deamar kera uvayyom hashshemini shabbaton ma shemini shemini dechag af rishon rishon dechag
Harishon lema li lemaote chullo shel moed chullo shel moed merishon ushmini nafka
Itzterich salka datach amena hoil dichtav rachamana uvayyom hashshemini vav mosif al inyan rishon daafilu bechullo shel moed ka mashma lan
Vela lichtov rachamana la vav vela he vetu hatam dichtiv bayyom harishon mikra kodesh yihye lachem rishon demeikara mashma

Ella hane shelosha rishon mibe leh lechidtane deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael bischar shelosha rishon zachu lishlosha rishon lehachrit zaro shel esav levinyan bet hammikdash velishmo shel mashiach

Lehachrit zaro shel esav dichtiv vayyetze harishon admoni kullo keadderet sear ulvinyan bet hammikdash dichtiv kisse chavod marom merishon mekom mikdashenu velishmo shel mashiach dichtiv rishon letziyyon hinne hinnam
Rava amar mehacha lo tishchat al chametz dam zivchi lo tishchat happesach vaadayin chametz kayyam
Veema kal chad vechad ki shachet zeman shechita amar rachamana

Tanya name hachi ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem meerev yom tov o eno ella beom tov atzmo talmud lomar lo tishchat al chametz dam zivchi lo tishchat et happesach vaadayin chametz kayyam divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich hare hu omer ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem uchtiv kal melacha lo taasu umatzinu lahavara shehi av melacha

Rabbi yose omer eno tzarich hare hu omer ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem meerev yom tov o eno ella beom tov talmud lomar ach chillek vei beom tov atzmo mi shere ha itakkash hashbatat seor laachilat chametz vaachilat chametz laachilat matztza amar rava
b: Shema minah midderabbi akiva telat shema minah en biur chametz ella serefa ushma minah havara lechallek yatzat ushma minah la amrinan hoil vehuttera havara letzorech huttera name shello letzorech
Tanu rabbanan shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem ma talmud lomar vahalo kevar neemar lo yerae lecha seor velo yerae lecha chametz bechol gevulecha
Lefi shenneemar lo yerae lecha seor shellecha i atta roe aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoha yachol yatmin vikabbel pikdonot min haggoy talmud lomar lo yimmatze
En li ella begoy shello kibashto veen sharuy immecha bechatzer goy shekkibashto vesharuy immecha bechatzer minnayin talmud lomar lo yimmatze bevattechem
En li ella shebbevattechem bevorot beshichin uvimarot minnayin talmud lomar bechol gevulecha

Vaadayin ani omer babbattim over mishshum bal yerae uval yimmatze uval yatmin uval yekabbel pikdonot min haggoy baggevulin shellecha i atta roe aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoha minnayin liten et haamur shel ze baze veshel ze baze

Talmud lomar seor seor ligzera shava neemar seor babbattim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem veneemar seor baggevulin lo yerae lecha seor ma seor haamur babbattim over mishshum bal yerae uval yimmatze uval yatmin uval yekabbel pikdonot min haggoyim af seor haamur baggevulin over mishshum bal yerae uval yimmatze uval yatmin uval yekabbel pikdonot min haggoyim
Uma seor haamur baggevulin shellecha i atta roe aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoha af seor haamur babbattim shellecha i atta roe aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoha
Amar mar en li ella begoy shello kibashto veen sharuy immecha bechatzer goy shekkibashto vesharuy immecha bechatzer minnayin talmud lomar lo yimmatze
Kelappe leya amar abbaye efoch

Rava amar leolam la tefoch vearesha kae shellecha i atta roe aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoha en li ella begoy shello kibashto veen sharuy immecha bechatzer goy shekkibashto vesharuy immecha bechatzer minnayin talmud lomar lo yimmatze
Vehay tanna mehaddar ahetera venasev leh kera leisura mishshum shenneemar lecha lecha tere zimne
Amar mar yachol yatmin vikabbel pikdonot min haggoyim talmud lomar lo yimmatze ha amratte resha shellecha i atta roe aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoha
La kashya ha dekabbel aleh achraut ha dela kabbel aleh achraut
Ki ha deamar lehu rava livne machoza bairu chamira divne chela mibbattayechu kevan deilu mignev veilu mitvid birshutayechu kae uvaitu leshallome kedilchon dame veasur
Hanicha leman deamar davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame ella leman deamar lav kemamon dame may ika lememar
Shane hacha deamar lo yimmatze
Ika deamri hanicha leman deamar davar haggorem lemamon lav kemamon dame

a: Hayenu deitzterich lo yimmatze ella leman deamar kemamon dame lo yimmatze lema li itzterich salka datach amena hoil vechi iteh hadar beeneh lav birshuteh kae kamashma lan
Beo mineh merava behemat arnona chayyevet bivchora o en chayyevet bivchora kol hecha dematze mesallek leh bezuze la ka mibaya lan dechayyav
Ki ka mibaya lan hecha dela matze mesallek leh bezuze may amar lehu petura vehatanya chayyevet hatam dematze mesallek leh
Ika deamri amar rava behemat arnona petura min habbechora veaf al gav dematze mesallek leh isat arnona chayyevet bechalla veaf al gav dela matze mesallek leh
May tama behema it lah kala isa let lah kala
Tanu rabbanan goy shennichnas lachatzero shel yisrael uvtzeko beyado en zakuk levaer hifkido etzlo zakuk levaer yiched lo bayit en zakuk levaer shenneemar lo yimmatze
May kaamar amar rav pappa aresha kae vehachi kaamar hifkido etzlo zakuk levaer shenneemar lo yimmatze
Rav ashe amar leolam assefa kae vehachi kaamar yiched lo bayit en zakuk levaer shenneemar lo yimmatze bevattechem veha lav dideh hu degoy ki ka meayyel leveta denafsheh ka meayyel

Lememra dischirut kanya vehatnan af bemakom sheamru lehaskir lo levet dira amru mippene shemmachnisin letocho avodat gillulim vei salka datach dischirut kanya ki ka meayyel leveteh denafsheh ka meayyel
Shane hacha deappekeh rachamana bilshon lo yimmatze mi shemmatzuy beyadcha yatza ze sheeno matzuy beyadcha
Amar rav yehuda amar rav hammotze chametz beveto beom tov kofe alav et hakkeli amar rava im shel hekdesh hu eno tzarich may tama mivdal bedili mineh
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav chametzo shel goy ose lo mechitza asara tefachim mishshum heker veim shel hekdesh hu eno tzarich may tama mivdal bedili inashe mineh

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav hamfaresh vehayyotze bishyara kodem sheloshim yom en zakuk levaer toch sheloshim yom zakuk levaer amar abbaye ha deamratte toch sheloshim yom zakuk levaer la amaran ella sheddato lachazor aval en dato lachazor en zakuk levaer

Amar leh rava vei dato lachazor afilu merosh hashshana name ella amar rava ha deamratte kodem sheloshim yom en zakuk levaer la amaran ella sheen dato lachazor aval dato lachazor afilu merosh hashshana zakuk levaer
Veazda rava letameh deamar rava haose beto otzar kodem sheloshim yom en zakuk levaer toch sheloshim yom zakuk levaer
Vekodem sheloshim name la amaran ella sheen dato lefannoto aval dato lefannoto afilu kodem sheloshim yom name zakuk levaer
Hane sheloshim yom may avidtayehu kidtanya shoalin vedorshin behilchot happesach kodem happesach sheloshim yom rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shette shabbatot may tama detanna kamma
b: Shehare moshe omed befesach rishon umazhir al happesach sheni shenneemar veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach bemoado uchtiv vayehi anashim asher hau temeim lenefesh adam
Verabban shimon ben gamliel amar lach ayede deayeri bemile defischa massik lehu lechol mile defischa

May tama derabban shimon ben gamliel shehare moshe omed berosh hachodesh umazhir al happesach shenneemar hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim uchtiv dabberu el kol adat yisrael lemor beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu lahem ish se levet avot vego
Mimmay divresh yarcha kae dilma bearbea beyarcha o bechamsha beyarcha kae

Ella amar rabba bar shimi mishshemeh deravina mehacha vayedabber Adonai el moshe vemidbar sinay bashshana hashshenit bachodesh harishon uchtiv veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach bemoado hacha name mimmay divresh yarcha kae dilma bearbea beyarcha o bechamsha beyarcha kae
