Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak atya midbar mimmidbar ketiv hacha bemidbar sinay uchtiv hatam vayedabber Adonai el moshe bemidbar sinay beohel moed beechad lachodesh hashsheni ma lehallan berosh chodesh af kan berosh chodesh
Venichtov beresha dechodesh rishon vahadar nichtov dechodesh sheni amar rav menashsheya bar tachlifa mishshemeh derav zot omeret en mukdam umuchar battora
Amar rav pappa la amaran ella bitre inyane aval bechad inyana may demukdam mukdam umay dimuchar meuchar dei la tema hachi kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat dilma perat uchlal hu
Vetu perat uchlal naase kelal musaf al happerat dilma kelal ufrat hu
I hachi afilu bitre inyane name hanicha leman deamar kelal ufrat hamruchakin ze mizze en danin oto bichlal ufrat shappir ella leman deamar danin may ika lememar
Afilu leman deamar danin hane mile bechad inyana aval bitre inyane en danin
Amar rav yehuda amar rav habbodek tzarich sheyevattel may tama i nema mishshum perurin ha la chashivi
Vechi tema kevan dimnattar lehu aggav beteh chashivi vehatanya sofe teenim umshammer sadehu mippene anavim sofe anavim umshammer sadehu mippene mikshaot umippene midlaot
Bizman shebbaal habbayit makpid alehen asurin mishshum gezel vechayyavin bemaaser bizman sheen baal habbayit makpid alehen muttarin mishshum gezel ufturin mishshum maaser
Amar rava gezera shemma yimtza geluska yafa vedateh ilaveh vechi mashkachatte leh levatteleh

Dilma mashkachatte leh levatar isura velav birshuteh kayema vela matze mevattel deamar rabbi elazar shene devarim enan birshuto shel adam vaasaan hakkatuv keilu birshuto veellu hen bor birshut harabbim vechametz mishshesh shaot ulmala
Venivatteleh bearba venivatteleh bechamesh kevan delav zeman isura hu velav zeman biura hu dilma pasha vela mevattel leh

a: Venivatteleh beshet kevan deisura derabbanan ilaveh kidorayeta damya velav birshuteh kayema vela matze mevattel
Deamar rav gidel amar rabbi chiyya bar yosef amar rav hamkaddesh mishshesh shaot ulmala afilu bechite kurdinyata en choshshin lekidushin

Ulvatar isura la matze mevattel leh veha tanya haya yoshev bevet hammidrash venizkar sheyyesh chametz betoch beto mevattelo belibbo echad shabbat veechad yom tov bishlama shabbat mashkachatte lah kegon shechal arbaa asar lihot bashshabbat ella yom tov batar isura hu
Amar rav acha bar yaakov hacha betalmid yoshev lifne rabbo askinan venizkar sheyyesh isa megulgelet betoch beto umityare shemma tachamitz kadem umvattel lah mikamme detachmitz
Dayeka name dekatane haya yoshev betoch bet hammidrash shema minah
Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav happat sheipsha kevan sheravta matztza mutteret hechi dame ilema deyada bah dechametz hi ki ravta matztza may have
Ella dela yadinan bah i chametz hu i matztza hu may irya ki ravta matztza afilu ki lo ravta matztza name nezil batar batra
Mi la tenan maot shennimtzeu lifne sochare vehema leolam maaser behar habbayit chullin
Birushalayim bishat haregel maaser bishar yemot hashshana chullin

Veamar rav shemaya bar zera may tama hoil veshuke yerushalayim asuyin lehitkabbed bechol yom alma amrinan kammae kammae azli leh vehane acharine ninhu hacha name nema kamma kamma azel vehay dehaidana hu
Shane hacha deipushah mochiach ilavah i ipushah mochiach ilavah ki ravta matztza may have amar rabba la tema sheravta matztza ella ema sherabbu yeme matztza ilavah
I hachi peshita la tzericha deipushah merubbe mahu detema kevan deipushah merubbe igalleya milta devadday chametz mealleya hu ka mashma lan
Kevan sherabbu yeme matztza ilavah amrinan kol yoma veoma nahama chammima afa ushda ilavah veafsha tefe
Umi azlinan batar batra veha tanya rabbi yose bar yehuda omer teva shennishtammeshu bah meot chullin umot maaser im rov chullin chullin im rov maaser maaser veammay lezil batar batra

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hacha bemay askinan kegon shennishtammeshu bah meot chullin umot maaser veen yodea eze mehen bassof rav zevid amar kegon shennishtammeshu bah tziburin tziburin rav pappa amar kegon deishtechach begumma

Amar rav yehuda habbodek tzarich sheyevarech may mevarech rav pappe amar mishshemeh derava omer levaer chametz rav pappa amar mishshemeh derava al biur chametz bilvaer kulle alma la peligi devadday lehabba mashma
b: Ki peligi beal biur mar savar meikara mashma umar savar lehabba mashma
Metivi baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al hammila
Hatam hechi nema nema lamul la saggi delav ihu mahel avi habben may ika lememar in hachi name
Metivi baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al hashshechita hatam name hechi nema nema lishchot la saggi delav ihu shachet
Pesach vekodashim may ika lememar in hachi name

Metivi haose lulav leatzmo mevarech shehecheyanu vekiyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze netalo latzet bo omer asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al netilat lulav shane hatam dividana deagbeheh nefak beh
I hachi latzet bo yatza bo mibe leh in hachi name umishshum deka bae lemitna sefa leshev bassukka tena resha name latzet bo

Dekatane sefa haose sukka leatzmo omer baruch atta Adonai shehecheyanu vekiyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze nichnas leshev bah omer baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu leshev bassukka vehilcheta al biur chametz
Dechulle alma miha meikara bainan levaroche menalan deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol hammitzot mevarech alehen over laasiyyatan

May mashma dehay over lishana deakdome hu amar rav nachman bar yitzchak deamar kera vayyarotz achimaatz derech hakkikkar vayyaavor et hakkushi abbaye amar mehacha vehu avar lifnehem veibaet ema mehacha vayyaavor malkam lifnehem va berosham
Be rav amri chutz min hattevila veshofar bishlama tevila deakkatti gavra la chaze ella shofar may tama vechi tema mishshum dilma mikalkela tekia i hachi afilu shechita umila name
Ella amar rav chisda chutz min hattevila bilvad itmar tanya name hachi taval veala baaliyyato omer baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al hattevila
Leor hanner vechu mena hane mile amar rav chisda lamadnu metzia mimmetzia umtzia mechipus vechipus mechipus vechipus minnerot venerot minner
Metzia mimmetzia ketiv hacha shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem uchtiv hatam vayechappes baggadol hechel uvakkaton killa vayyimmatze umtzia mechipus dideh
Vechipus minnerot dichtiv baet hahi achappes et yerushalam bannerot venerot minner dichtiv ner elohim Adonai nishmat adam chofes kol chadre vaten

Tana deve rabbi yishmael lele arbaa asar bodkim et hechametz leor hanner af al pi sheen reaya ledavar zecher laddavar shenneemar shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze veomer vayechappes baggadol hechel uvakkaton killa veomer baet hahi achappes et yerushalam bannerot veomer ner elohim Adonai nishmat adam chofes
May veomer

Vechi tema hay baet hahi kulla hu dekaamar rachamana la badekna lah birushalayim binhora daavuka dinfish nehora tuva ella binhora dishraga dezutar nehora tefe deaon rabba mishtechach veaon zutar la mishtechach ta shema ner Adonai nishmat adam
Tanu rabbanan en bodkin lo leor hachamma velo leor hallevana velo leor haavuka ella leor hanner

a: Mippene sheor hanner yafe labbedika veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar shenneemar shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem veomer vayechappes baggadol hechel veomer baet hahi achappes et yerushalam bannerot veomer ner Adonai nishmat adam chofes kol chadre vaten
Hay or hachamma hechi dame i nema bechatzer haamar rava chatzer enah tzericha bedika mippene shehaorvin metzuyin sham ella beachsadra haamar rava achsadra leorah nivdeket
La tzericha laarubba divcheder udhecha i levahade arubba hayenu achsadra ella litzdadin

Vaavuka la vehaamar rava may dichtiv venogah kaor tihye karnayim miyyado lo vesham chevon uzzo lema tzaddikim domin bifne shechina kanner bifne haavuka veamar rava avuka lehavdala mitzva min hammuvchar

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ze yachol lehachniso lechorin velisdakin veze eno yachol lehachniso lechorin velisdakin rav zevid amar ze oro lefanav vaze oro leacharav rav pappa amar hay beit vehay la beit ravina amar hay meshich nehora vehay mikattaf ikattofe

Kol makom sheen machnisin ku kol makom leetoye may leetoye ha detanu rabbanan chore bayit haelonim vehattachtonim vegag hayyatzia vegag hammigdal verefet bakar velulin umatben veotzrot yayin veotzrot shemen en tzerichin bedika rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mitta hacholeket betoch habbayit umafseket tzericha bedika

Urminhu chor shebben adam lachavero ze bodek ad makom sheyyado maggaat veze bodek ad makom sheyyado maggaat vehashshear mevattelo belibbo rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mitta hacholeket betoch habbayit veetzim vaavanim sedurim tachteha umafseket enah tzericha bedika
Kashya mitta ammitta kashya chorin achorin
Chorin achorin la kashya ha beilae uvtattae veha bemitze mitta ammitta la kashya ha demidalleya ha demitattay
Veotzrot yayin en tzarich bedika vehatanya otzrot yayin tzarich bedika otzrot shemen en tzarich bedika hacha bemay askinan bemistappek i hachi shemen name
Shemen yesh keva laachila yayin en keva lishtiyya
Tane rabbi chiyya asu otzrot shechar bevavel keotzrot yayin beeretz yisrael bemistappek
Amar rav chisda be dagim en tzarich bedika vehatanya tzerichin bedika la kashya ha beravreve ha bezutre
Amar rabba bar rav huna be milche uve kire tzarich bedika amar rav pappa be tzive uve tamre tzarich bedika
Tana en mechayevin oto lehachnis yado lechorin velisdakin livdok mippene hassakkana may sakkana i nema mippene sakkanat akrav ki mishtammash hechi ishtammash la tzericha dinfal
I nefal lema li bedika vehatnan chametz shennafla alav mappolet hare hu kimvoar hatam sheen hakkelev yachol lechappes acharav hacha keshehakkelev yachol lechappes acharav
Veha amar rabbi elazar sheluche mitzva enan nizokin amar rav ashe shemma tovad lo machat veate leayyone batrah
Uchhay gavena lav mitzva hu vehatanya haomer sela zo litzdaka bishvil sheyyichye beni o sheehye ben haolam habba
b: Hare ze tzaddik gamur dilma batar devadek ate leayyone batrah

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mishshum sakkanat haggoyim uflemo hi detanya chor shebben yehudi learmay bodek ad mekom sheyyado maggaat vehashshear mevattelo belibbo pelemo amar kol atzmo eno bodek mippene hassakkana
May sakkana i nema sakkanat keshafim ki ishtammash hechi ishtammash hatam ki ishtammash yemama unhora vela massik addateh hacha lelya ushraga hu umassek addateh
Vehaamar rabbi elazar sheluche mitzva enan nizokin hecha dishchiach hezeka shane shenneemar vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani vayyomer Adonai eglat bakar tikkach beyadecha vego
Beo mineh merav hane bene be rav dedayeri bevaga mahu lemete kadma vachashocha leve rav amar lehu neto alay veal tzavari nezil may amar lehu la yadana
Itmar amar rabbi elazar sheluche mitzva enan nizokin lo bahalichatan velo bachaziratan keman

Ki hay tanna detanya isi ben yehuda omer kelappe sheamra tora velo yachmod ish et artzecha melammed shettehe paratcha roa baafar veen chayya mazzikatah tarnegoltecha menakkeret baashpa veen chulda mazzikatah

Vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma ellu sheddarkan lizzok enan nizokin bene adam sheen darkan lizzok al achat kamma vechamma en li ella bahalicha bachazara minnayin talmud lomar ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha melammed shettelech vetimtza ahalcha beshalom
Vechi meachar daafilu bachazira bahalicha lema li lechidrabbi amme deamar rabbi amme kol adam sheyyesh lo karka ole laregel vesheen lo karka en ole laregel

Amar rabbi avin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak mippene ma en perot ginosar birushalayim kede shello yehu ole regalim omrim ilmale lo alinu ella leechol perot ginosar birushalayim dayyenu nimtzet aliyya shello lishmah

Kayyotze bo amar rabbi dostay berabbi yannay mippene ma en chamme teverya birushalayim kede shello yehu ole regalim omrim ilmale lo alinu ella lirchotz bechamme teverya dayyenu venimtzet aliyya shello lishmah
Uvamma amru shette shurot vechu martef man dechar shemeh

Hachi kaamar kol makom sheen machnisin bo chametz en tzarich bedika veotzrot yayin veotzrot shemen name en tzarich bedika uvamma amru shette shurot bammartef makom shemmachnisin bo chametz uvmistappek
Bet shammay omrim shette shurot vechu amar rav yehuda shette shurot sheamru min haaretz vead sheme kora verabbi yochanan amar shura achat kemin gam

Tanya kevateh derav yehuda tanya keoteh derabbi yochanan tanya keoteh derav yehuda bet shammay omrim shette shurot al pene kol hammartef ushte shurot sheamru min haaretz vead sheme kora tanya keoteh derabbi yochanan shette shurot al pene kol hammartef chitzona roa et happetach veelona roa et hakkora shellifnim hemenna veshellematta hemenna en tzarich bedika

Bet hillel omrim shette shurot hachitzonot shehen haelonot amar rav elona veshellematta hemenna ushmuel amar elona veshellifnim hemenna may tama derav dayek chitzonot veha elonot katane lemaote tattae detattayata

Ushmuel amar elona veshellifnim hemenna may tama dayek elonot veha chitzona katane lemaote gavayata degavayata rabbi chiyya tane keoteh derav vechullehu tannae tanu keoteh dishmuel vehilcheta keoteh dishmuel

a: Matni en choshshin shemma gerra chulda mibbayit levayit umimmakom lemakom deim ken mechatzer lechatzer umeir lair en laddavar sof
Gema tama dela chazena dishkal ha chazena dishkal chayeshinan uvae bedika
Veammay nema achalteh mi la tenan medorot haggoyim temeim vechamma yishhe bemador vihe hammador tzarich bedika arbaim yom
Veaf al pi sheen lo ishsha vechol makom shechulda vachazir yecholin lahaloch en tzarich bedika
Amar rabbi zera la kashya ha bevasar veha belechem bevasar la meshayera belechem meshayera
Amar rava hay may bishlama hatam emor hava emor la hava veim timtza lomar hava emor achalteh aval hacha devadday dachazena dishkal mi yemar daachalteh have safek uvadday veen safek motzi mide vadday

Veen safek motzi mide vadday veha tanya chaver shemmet vehinniach megura melea perot vaafilu hen bene yoman hare hen bechezkat metukkanin veha hacha devadday tevili hane pere vesafek meussarin vesafek lo meussarin vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday
Hatam vadday uvadday hu devadday measseri kidrabbi chanina chozaa deamar rabbi chanina chozaa chazaka al chaver sheen motzi mittachat yado davar sheeno metukkan
Vei baet ema safek vesafek hu dilma meikkara emor dela tevili kerabbi oshaya
Deamar rabbi oshaya maarim adam al tevuato umachnisah bammotz shellah kede shettehe behemto ochelet uftura min hammaaser
Veen safek motzi mide vadday vehatanya amar rabbi yehuda maase beshifchato shel metzik echad berimon shehetila nefel levor
b: Uva kohen vehetzitz bo leda im zachar hu im nekeva hi uva maase lifne chachamim vetiharuhu mippene shechulda uvardelas metzuyin sham
Veha hacha devadday hetila vesafek gerruhu vesafek lo gerruhu hahi shata vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday la tema shehetila nefel levor ella ema shehippila kemin nefel levor vehave safek vesafek
Veha leda im zachar hu im nekeva hi katane hachi kaamar leda im ruach hippila im nefel hippila veim timtza lomar nefel hippila leda im zachar hu veim nekeva hi

Veibaet ema hatam vadday uvadday hu kevan dechulda uvardelas metzuyin sham vadday gerruhu behahi shata nehi deshayyore meshayera migrar mihat vadday gerrum behahi shata lishana acharina nehi devadday achalum la amrinan vadday gerruhu lechorayehu amrinan
Umi amrinan en choshshin shemma gerra chulda veha katane sefa ma shemmeshayyer yannichennu betzina shello yehe tzarich bedika acharav
Amar abbaye la kashya ha bearbaa asar ha bishlosha asar bishlosha asar dishchiach rifta bechullehu batte la matznea bearbaa asar dela shechicha rifta bechullehu batte matznea

Amar rava vechi chulda nevia hi deyada dehaidana arbesar vela afe ad leurta umshayera umtammera ella amar rava ma shemmeshayyer yannichennu betzina shemma tittol chulda befanenu vihe tzarich bedika acharav
Tanya keoteh derava harotze leechol chametz achar bedika ketzad yaase ma shemmeshayyer yannichennu betzina shello tavo chulda vetitol befanenu vihe tzarich bedika acharav
Rav mari amar gezera shemma yanniach eser veyimtza tesha
Tesha tziburin shel matztza veechad shel chametz vaata achbar ushkal vela yadinan i matztza shekal i chametz shekal hayenu tesha chanuot peresh vaata achbar ushkal hayenu sefa
Ditnan tesha chanuot kullan mochrin besar shechuta veachat mocheret besar nevela velakach meachat mehen veeno yodea meeze mehen lakach sefeko asur
Uvannimtza hallech achar harov

Shene tziburin echad shel matztza veechad shel chametz velifnehem shene vattim echad baduk veechad sheeno baduk vaato shene achbarim echad shekal matztza veechad shekal chametz vela yadinan he lehay ayel vehe lehay ayel hayenu shette kuppot

Ditnan shette kuppot achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma velifnehem shene sein echad shel chullin veechad shel teruma venaflu ellu letoch ellu muttarin sheani omer chullin letoch chullin naflu utruma letoch teruma nafla
Emor deamrinan sheani omer

a: Bitruma derabbanan bechametz deorayeta mi amrinan attu bedikat chametz deorayeta derabbanan hi demiddeorayeta bevitul bealma saggi leh

Tzibbur echad shel chametz ulfanav shene vattim bedukin vaata achbar ushkal vela yadinan i lehay al i lehay al hayenu shene shevilin ditnan shene shevilin echad tame veechad tahor vehalach beechad mehen veasa teharot uva chavero vehalach bashsheni veasa teharot
Rabbi yehuda omer im nishalu ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo tehorin shenehen bevat achat temein rabbi yosi omer ben kach uven kach temein

Amar rava veitema rabbi yochanan bevat achat divre hakkol temein beze achar ze divre hakkol tehorin lo nechleku ella beva lehishshael alav veal chavero rabbi yose medamme leh levat achat verabbi yehuda medamme leh leze achar ze
Safek al safek la al hayenu bika uviflugta derabbi eliezer verabbanan

Ditnan hannichnas levika bimot haggeshamim vetuma besade pelonit veamar echad halachti bammakom hallaz veeni yodea im nichnasti beotah sade veim lo nichnasti rabbi eliezer metaher vachachamim metammein
Shehaya rabbi eliezer omer sefek bia tahor sefek magga tuma tame
Al uvdak vela ashkach pelugta derabbi meir verabbanan ditnan haya rabbi meir omer kol davar shebbechezkat tuma leolam hu betumato ad sheyyivada lach hattuma hechan hi
Vachachamim omrim bodek ad shemmaggia lesela o lekarka betula
Al uvdak veashkach pelugta derabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel

Detanya sade shenneevad bah kever hannichnas letochah tame nimtza bah kever hannichnas letochah tahor sheani omer kever sheavad hu kever shennimtza divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer tibadek kol hassade kullah

Hinniach eser umatza tesha hayenu sefa detanya hinniach matayim umatza mane mane munnach umane mutal divre rabbi
Vachachamim omrim hakkol chullin
b: Hinniach bezavit zo umatza bezavit acheret pelugta derabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan detanya kardom sheavad bevayit habbayit tame sheani omer adam tame nichnas lesham untalo rabban shimon ben gamliel omer habbayit tahor sheani omer hishilo leacher veshachach o shennetalo mizzavit zo vehinniach bezavit haacheret veshachach
Zavit man dechar shemeh

Chassore mechassera vehachi katane kardom sheavad bevayit habbayit tame sheani omer adam tame nichnas lesham untalo o shehinnicho bezavit zo umtzao bezavit acheret habbayit tame sheani omer adam tame nichnas lesham untalo mizzavit zo vehinnicho bezavit acheret rabban shimon ben gamliel omer habbayit tahor sheani omer hishilo leacher veshachach o shennetalo mizzavit zo vehinniach bezavit zo veshachach

Amar rava achbar nichnas vechikkar befiv venichnas acharav umatza perurin tzarich bedika mippene sheen darko shel achbar lefarer veamar rava tinok nichnas vechikkar beyado venichnas acharav umatza perurin en tzarich bedika mippene sheddarko shel tinok lefarer
Bae rava achbar nichnas vechikkar befiv veachbar yotze vechikkar befiv mahu mi amrinan hayenu hay deal vehayenu hay dinfak o dilma acharina hu
Im timtza lomar hayenu hay deal vehayenu hay dinfak achbar lavan nichnas vechikkar befiv veachbar shachor yotze vechikkar befiv mahu hay vadday acharina hu o dilma armoye armeyeh mineh

Veim timtza lomar achbarim la shakli mehadade achbar nichnas vechikkar befiv vechulda yotza vechikkar befiha mahu chulda vadday meachbar shekalteh o dilma acharina hu deim ita demeachbar shekalteh achbar befiha hava mishtechach

Veim timtza lomar im ita demeachbar shekalteh achbar befiha hava mishtechach achbar nichnas vechikkar befiv vechulda yotza vechikkar veachbar befi chulda mahu hacha vadday ihu hu o dilma im ita deihu nihu kikkar befi achbar mishtechach hava bae ishtechoche o dilma mishshum biatuta hu nefal ushkalteh teku
Bae rava kikkar bishme kora tzarich sullam lehoridah o en tzarich mi amrinan kulle hay la atrechuhu rabbanan kevan dela nachet minnafsheh la ate lemechlah o dilma zimnin denafel veate lemechlah
Veim timtze lomar zimnin denafel veate lemechlah kikkar bevor tzarich sullam lehaalotah o en tzarich hacha vadday dela avida desalka minnafshah o dilma zimnin denachet lemebad tzurkeh veate lemechlah
Im timtza lomar zimnin denachet letzurkeh veate lemechlah kikkar befi nachash tzarich chabbar lehotzi o en tzarich
Begufeh atrechuhu rabbanan bemamoneh la atrechuhu rabbanan o dilma la shena teku
Matni rabbi yehuda omer bodkin or arbaa asar uvarbaa asar shacharit uvishat habbiur vachachamim omrim lo badak or arbaa asar yivdok bearbaa asar
Lo badak bearbaa asar yivdok betoch hammoed lo badak betoch hammoed yivdok leachar hammoed uma shemmeshayyer yannichennu betzina kede shello yehe tzarich bedika acharav

Gema may tama derabbi yehuda rav chisda verabba bar rav huna deamri tarvayehu keneged shalosh hashbatot shebbattora lo yerae lecha chametz velo yerae lecha seor shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem
Metiv rav yosef rabbi yehuda omer kol shello badak bishlosha perakim hallalu shuv eno bodek alma bemikkan veelach hu difligi
Mar zutra matne hachi metiv rav yosef rabbi yehuda omer kol shello badak beechad mishshelosha perakim hallalu shuv eno bodek alma beshuv eno bodek hu difligi
Ella rabbi yehuda name im lo badak kaamar
Vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar mikkamme isura in batar isura la gezera dilma ate lemechal mineh verabbanan savri la gazrinan
Umi gazar rabbi yehuda dilma ate lemechal mineh veha tenan mishshekkarav haomer yotzin umotzin shuke yerushalayim shehem meleim kemach vekali

a: Shello birtzon chachamim hen osin divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer birtzon chachamim hau osin vela ka gazar rabbi yehuda dilma ate lemechal mineh amar rava shane chadash mittoch shello hittarta lo ella al yede kittuf hu zachur
Amar leh abbaye tinach bishat ketifa techina veharkada may ika lememar ha la kashya techina berichya deyad harkada al gabbe nafa
Ella ha ditnan kotzrin bet hashshelachim veshebbaamakim aval lo godshin veokimna kerabbi yehuda may ika lememar
Ella amar abbaye chadash badel mineh chametz la badel mineh
Amar rava derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda kashya derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya
Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya kidshanninan derabbanan adderabbanan name la kashya hu atzmo mechazzer alav lesorfo mechal kaachel mineh
Rav ashe amar derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya kemach vekali tenan
Ha derav ashe beduta hi hatinach mikkali veelach meikara ad kali may ika lememar
Vechi tema al yede kituf kidrava ella kotzrin bet hashshelachin veshebbaamakim veokimna kerabbi yehuda may ika lememar ella derav ashe beduta hi
Vechol hecha dela badel mineh mi gazar rabbi yehuda
Vehatnan lo yikkov adam shefoferet shel betza vimalleenna shemen veyittenenna betzad hanner bishvil shettehe menattefet vaafilu hi shel cheres
Verabbi yehuda mattir hatam mishshum chumra deshabbat mivdal bedili
Urmi deshabbat ashshabbat detanya chevel deli shennifsak lo yehe koshro ella onvo rabbi yehuda omer korech alav punda o pasikya uvilvad shello yaanvennu
Kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda kashya derabbanan adderabbanan
Derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya shemen beshemen michallaf aniva bikshira la michallaf
Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya tama derabbi yehuda lav mishshum degazar aniva attu keshira ella mishshum dekasavar aniva gufah keshira hi
Verame rabbanan adderabbanan ditnan koshrin deli befasikya aval lo bechevel verabbi yehuda mattir chevel demay ilema chevel dealma verabbi yehuda mattir kesher shel kayyama hu devadday ate levattole
Ella peshita degardi
Ugzaru rabbanan chevel degardi attu chevel dealma in chevel bechevel michallaf aniva bikshira la michallefa
Vechol hecha devadel mineh la gazar rabbi yehuda vehatanya bechor sheachazo dam afilu hu met en makkizin lo dam divre rabbi yehuda
Vachachamim omrim yakkiz uvilvad shello yatil bo mum hatam mittoch sheadam bahul
b: Al mamono amrinan i sharet leh bimkom sheen osin bo mum ate lemebad bimkom sheosin bo mum
Verabbanan kol shekken dei la sharet leh kelal ate lemebad

Umi amrinan lerabbi yehuda adam bahul al mamono vehatnan rabbi yehuda omer en mekadderin habbehema beom tov mippene shehu ose chabbura aval mekartzefin vachachamim omrim en mekadderin af en mekartzefin
Vetanya ezehu kidur veezehu kirtzuf kidur ketannim veosin chabbura kirtzuf gedolim veen osin chabbura
Hatam dei shavek leh mayet amrinan adam bahul al mamono hacha i shavek leh tzaara bealma hu la amrinan adam bahul al mamono
Verabbi yehuda may shena gabbe chametz degazar umay shena gabbe kirtzuf dela gazar lechem belechem michallaf kidur bekirtzuf la michallaf
Matni rabbi meir omer ochlim kol chamesh vesorfin bitchillat shesh rabbi yehuda omer ochlin kol arba vetolin kol chamesh vesorfin bitchillat shesh

Veod amar rabbi yehuda shette challot shel toda pesulot munnachot al gav haitzteva kol zeman shemmunnachot kol haam ochlin nitla achat tolin lo ochlin velo sorfin nitlu shettehen hitchilu kol haam sorfin
Rabban gamliel omer chullin neechalin kol arba utruma kol chamesh vesorfin bitchillat shesh
Gema tenan hatam echad omer bishnayim bachodesh veechad omer bishlosha edutan kayyemet
Shezze yodea beibburo shel chodesh veze eno yodea beibburo shel chodesh

Echad omer bishlosha veechad omer bachamishsha edutan betela echad omer bishte shaot veechad omer beshalosh shaot edutan kayyemet echad omer beshalosh veechad omer bechamesh edutan betela divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda omer edutan kayyemet echad omer bechamesh veechad omer besheva edutan betela shebbechamesh chamma bemizrach uvsheva chamma bemaarav

Amar abbaye keshettimtza lomar ledivre rabbi meir en adam toe velo kelum ledivre rabbi yehuda adam toe chatzi shaa ledivre rabbi meir en adam toe velo kelum maase ki hava bemipak tarte umayyel telat veha dekaamar shettayim besof shettayim veha dekaamar shalosh bitchillat shalosh

Ledivre rabbi yehuda adam toe chatzi shaa maase ki hava befalga dearba hava vehay dekaamar shalosh besof shalosh vekatae palga deshata lekammeh vehay dekaamar chamesh bitchillat chamesh vekatae palga deshata laachoreh

Ika deamri amar abbaye keshettimtza lomar ledivre rabbi meir adam toe mashshehu ledivre rabbi yehuda adam toe shaa umashshehu ledivre rabbi meir adam toe mashshehu maase ki hava o besof shettayim hava o bitchillat shalosh vechad minayehu toe mashshehu ledivre rabbi yehuda adam toe shaa umashshehu maase ki hava o besof shalosh o bitchillat chamesh

Azal rav huna bereh derav yehuda amrah lishmateta kammeh derava amar uma ilu dayekinan behane sahade dehay dekaamar shalosh bitchillat shalosh vehay dekaamar chamesh besof chamesh vehaveya edut muchcheshet vela katlinan vaanan nekum venikketol missefeka verachamana amar veshaftu haeda vehitztzilu haeda

Ella amar rava ledivre rabbi meir adam toe shette shaot chaser mashshehu ledivre rabbi yehuda adam toe shalosh shaot chaser mashshehu ledivre rabbi meir adam toe shette shaot chaser mashshehu maase ki hava o bitchillat shettayim o besof shalosh vechad minayehu katae shette shaot chaser mashshehu
Ledivre rabbi yehuda adam toe shalosh shaot chaser mashshehu maase ki hava o bitchillat shalosh o besof chamesh vechad minayehu katae shalosh shaot chaser mashshehu

Tenan hau bodkin oto besheva chakirot beezo shavua beezo shana beeze chodesh bechamma bachodesh beeze yom beezo shaa beeze makom vetanya ma ben chakirot livdikot chakirot amar echad mehen eni yodea edutan betela bedikot afilu shenehem omrim en anu yodim edutan kayyemet
Vehavinan bah may shena chakirot umay shena bedikot
Veamrinan chakirot amar echad mehen eni yodea edutan betela dehaveya lah edut shei atta yachol lahazimah
Bedikot edut sheatta yachol lahazimah hi
Vei amratte tae inish kulle hay chakirot deezo shaa name edut shei atta yachol lahazimah hi deamri mite katainan
Deyahavinan lehu kulle tautayehu lerabbi meir yahavinan lehu mittechilat shaa rishona ad sof chamesh
Uvdin hu denitev lehu meikara tefe ella ben yemama lelelya la tau inashe
Ulrabbi yehuda yahavinan lehu mittechilat shaa rishona vead sof shishshit uvdin hu denitev lehu meikara tefe
b: Ella ben yemama lelelya la tau inashe uvdin hu denitev lekammeh tefe ella shebbechamesh chamma bammizrach uvsheva chamma bammaarav

Leabbaye alliba derabbi meir deamar en adam toe velo kelum nechol kullah shet ulhach lishana name deamar adam toe mashshehu nechol ad sof shet
Veabbaye alliba derabbi yehuda deamar adam toe chatzi shaa nechol ad palga deshet ulhach lishana name deamratte adam toe shaa umashshehu nechol ad sof chamesh
Ella amar abbaye edut mesura lizrizim chametz lakkol masur
Verava alliba derabbi meir deamar adam toe shette shaot chaser mashshehu mittechilat chamesh la nechol chamesh chamma bammizrach vesheva chamma bammaarav
I hachi beshet name nechol amar rav adda bar ahava shet yoma bekarnata kae

Verava alliba derabbi yehuda deamar adam toe shalosh shaot chaser mashshehu mittechilat arba la nechol chamesh chamma bammizrach vesheva chamma bammaarav vechol shekken arba i hachi bechamesh name nechol
Targemah abbaye alliba derava edut mesura lizrizim chametz lakkol masur
Verava amar lav hayenu tama derabbi yehuda ella rabbi yehuda letameh deamar en biur chametz ella serefa vihavu leh rabbanan shaa achat lilkot bah etzim
Etiveh ravina lerava amar rabbi yehuda ematay shello bishat biuro aval bishat biuro hashbatato bechol davar
Ella amar rava gezera mishshum yom hamunnan i hachi afilu bearba shaot name la nechol amar rav pappa arba zeman seuda lakkol hi
Tanu rabbanan shaa rishona maachal ludim sheniyya maachal listin shelishit maachal yorshin reviit maachal poalin chamishit maachal talmide chachamim shishshit maachal kol adam
Vehaamar rav pappa reviit zeman seuda lechol hi ella efoch reviit maachal kol adam chamishit maachal poalim shishshit maachal talmide chachamim
Mikkan veelach kezorek even lachemet amar abbaye la amaran ella dela taem mide betzafra aval taem mide betzafra let lan bah
Amar rav ashe kemachloket beedut kach machloket bechametz peshita hayenu hach deamrinan ha ka mashma lan shinuye deshanninan shinuya hu vela tema tannae hi
Amar rav shimi bar ashe lo shanu ella beshaot aval echad omer kodem hanetz hachamma veechad omer achar hanetz hachamma edutan betela peshita
Ella echad omer kodem hanetz hachamma veechad omer betoch hanetz hachamma edutan betela ha name peshita mahu detema tarvayehu chada milta kaamri veha dekaamar

Amar rav nachman amar rav halacha kerabbi yehuda amar leh rava lerav nachman venema mar halacha kerabbi meir distam lan tena keoteh
Ditnan kol shaa shemmuttar leechol maachil
Hahi lav setama hu mishshum dekashya muttar
Venema mar halacha kerabban gamliel dehave leh machria amar leh rabban gamliel lav machria hu taam denafsheh kaamar

Veibaet ema rav deamar ki hay tanna detanya arbaa asar shechal lihot beshabbat mevaarin et hakkol millifne hashshabbat vesorfin terumot temeot teluot uthorot umshayerin min hattehorot mezon shette seudot kede leechol ad arba shaot divre rabbi elazar ben yehuda ish bartota sheamar mishshum rabbi yehoshua
Amru lo tehorot lo yissarfu shemma yimmatzu lahen ochlin amar lahen kevar bikkeshu velo matzu amru lo shemma chutz lachoma lanu
Amar lahem ledivrechem af teluot lo yissarfu shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharem amru lo kevar muvtach lahen leyisrael sheen eliyyahu ba lo bearve shabbatot velo bearve yamim tovim mippene hattorach
Amru lo zazu mishsham ad shekkavu halacha kerabbi elazar ben yehuda ish bartota sheamar mishshum rabbi yehoshua
May lav afilu leechol amar rav pappa mishshemeh derava lo levaer

Veaf rabbi savar leha derav nachman deamar ravin bar rav adda maase beadam echad shehifkid disakkayya melea chametz etzel yochanan chakokaa unkavuha achbarim vehaya chametz mevatzbetz veotze uva lifne rabbi shaa rishona amar lo hamten sheniyya amar lo hamten shelishit amar lo hamten reviit amar lo hamten chamishit amar lo tze umochreha bashshuk
May lav legoyim kerabbi yehuda amar rav yosef la leyisrael kerabbi meir amar leh abbaye i leyisrael nishkeleh lenafsheh
Mishshum chashada detanya gabbae tzedaka sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek portin laacherim veen portin leatzman
Gabbae tamchuy sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek mochrin laacherim veen mochrin leatzman mishshum shenneemar vihyitem nekiyyim me umiyyisrael
Amar leh rav adda bar matna lerav yosef beferush amarte lan tze umochren laggoyim kerabbi yehuda

Amar leh abbaye velav itmar alah amar rabba bar bar chana amar rav yochanan lo shanu ella

Mishshum rabbi yannay amru kesherot hau veella ammay kare lehu pesulot shello nishchat alehen hazzevach venishchot sheavad hazzevach
Venayete zevach acher venishchot deamar zo toda vezo lachmah vechidrabba deamar rabba avad hallechem mevi lechem acher avda toda en mevi toda acheret may tama lechem gelal toda veen toda gelal lechem
Venifrekinhu venappekinhu lechullin ella leolam shennishchat alehen hazzevach venishpach haddam

Uchman kerabbi deamar rabbi shene devarim hammattirin maalin ze belo ze detanya kivse atzeret en mekaddeshin et hallechem ella bishchita ketzad shechatan lishman vezarak daman lishman kidesh hallechem
Shechatan shello lishman vezarak daman shello lishman lo kidesh hallechem shechatan lishman vezarak daman shello lishman lechem kadosh veeno kadosh divre rabbi
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer leolam eno kadosh hallechem ad sheyyishchot lishman veyizrok daman lishman
Afilu tema rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hacha bemay askinan kegon shennitkabbel haddam bechos venishpach
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar leh kaavuh deamar kol haomed lizrok kezaruk dame
Tana mishshum rabbi elazar amru kesherot hau kol zeman shemmunnachot kol haam ochlin nitla achat mehen tolin lo ochlin velo sorfin nitlu shettehen hitchilu kullan sorfin
Tanya abba shaul omer

a: Shette farot hau chorshot behar hammishcha kol zeman sheshshettehen chorshot kol haam ochlin nitelet achat mehen tolin lo ochlin velo sorfin nitlu shettehen hitchilu kol haam sorfin
Matni rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millisrof et habbasar shennitma bivelad hattuma im habbasar shennitma beav hattuma af al pi shemmosifin tuma al tumato
Hosif rabbi akiva veamar mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millehadlik et hashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom bener shennitma bitme met af al pi shemmosifin tuma al tumato
Amar rabbi meir middivrehem lamadnu shessorfin teruma tehora im hattemea bappesach amar rabbi yose enah hi hammidda

Umodim rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua shessorfin zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah al ma nechleku al hatteluya veal hattemea sherabbi eliezer omer tissaref zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah verabbi yehoshua omer shettehen keachat
Gema mikkede basar shennitma bivelad hattuma may have sheni ki saref leh bahade basar shennitma beav hattuma may have sheni
Sheni vesheni hu may mosif lo tuma al tumato ika
Amar rav yehuda hacha bivelad velad askinan dehave leh shelishi vekasavar shelishi muttar laasoto sheni
Veha en ochel metamme ochel detanya yachol yehe ochel metamme ochel talmud lomar vechi yuttan mayim al zera venafal minnivlatam alav tame hu hu tame veen ose kayyotze bo tame
Hanicha leabbaye deamar lo shanu ella bechullin aval bitruma vekodashim ose kayyotze bo
Ulrav adda bar ahava mishshemeh derava name deamar lo shanu ella chullin utruma aval bekadashim ose kayyotze bahen shappir
Ella leravina mishshemeh derava deamar mikra male diber hakkatuv la shena chullin la shena teruma la shena kadashim eno ose kayyotze bo may ika lememar
Hacha vemay askinan deika mashkin bahade basar deka mitamme mechamat mashkin
I hachi hay im habbasar shennitma beav hattuma im habbasar umashkin mibe leh ella nehi deen ochel metamme ochel middeorayeta midderabbanan mihu metamme
Hosif rabbi akiva mimehen shel kohanim lo nimneu millehadlik ku mikkede shemen shennifsal bitvul yom may have shelishi vechi madlek leh bener shennitma bitme met may have sheni
May ka mashma lan shelishi muttar laasoto sheni hayenu hach amar rav yehuda hacha bener shel mattechet askinan derachamana amar
b: Bachalal cherev cherev hare hu kechalal vehaveya lah av hattuma vekasavar shelishi muttar laasoto rishon
Umay duchkeh derav yehuda leokmeh bener shel mattechet nokmeh bener shel cheres
Umay hosif deilu hatam tame vetame veilu hacha pasul vetame
Amar rava matnitin keshiteh may irya detane ner shennitma bitme met nitne shennitma besheretz
Ella ezehu davar shechaluka tumato ben tumat met lesheretz heve omer ze mattechet
Amar rava shema minah kasavar rabbi akiva tumat mashkin letamme acherim deorayeta dei salka datach derabbanan mikkedi hay ner may ka mahneya lehay shemen i leipsole gufeh ha pesil vekae
Mimmay dilma letamme acherim midderabbanan i midderabbanan may irya beav hattuma afilu berishon vesheni name techilla have
Ditnan kol happosel et hatteruma metamme mashkin lihot techilla chutz mittevul yom
Ella shema minah deorayeta hi
Amar rabbi meir middivrehem lamadnu vechu middivrehem deman ilema middivre rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim mi dame hatam tame vetame hacha tahor vetame
Veella middivre rabbi akiva mi dame hatam pasul vetame hacha tahor vetame
Nema kasavar rabbi meir matnitin beav hattuma deorayeta velad hattuma derabbanan demiddeorayeta tahor mealleya

a: Umay middivrehem middivre rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim
Amar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara matnitin beav hattuma deorayeta velad hattuma deorayeta umay middivrehem middivre rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua

He rabbi yehoshua ilema ha rabbi yehoshua ditnan chavit shel teruma shennolad lah sefek tuma rabbi eliezer omer im hayeta munnachat bimkom hatturpa yannichenna bemakom hammutzna veim hayeta megulla yechassenna
Rabbi yehoshua omer im hayeta munnachat bemakom hammutzna yannichenna bimkom hatturpa veim hayeta mechussa yegallenna
Mi dame hatam gerama bealma hacha beyadayim
Ella ha rabbi yehoshua ditnan chavit shel teruma shennishbera baggat haelona vetachtona chullin temein

Mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora yatztzil veim lav rabbi eliezer omer tered vetittame veal yetammeenna bayyad rabbi yehoshua omer af yetammeenna bayyad
I hachi hay middivrehem middevarav mibe leh
Hachi kaamar mimmachloktan shel rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua lamadnu dayeka name dekatane mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua shema minah
Vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh matnitin beav hattuma deorayeta velad hattuma deorayeta umay middivrehem middivre rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua

Etiveh rava lerav nachman amar rabbi yose en hannadon dome liraya shekkesheheidu rabbotenu al ma heidu im al habbasar shennitma bivelad hattuma shessorfin oto im habbasar shennitma beav hattuma ze tame veze tame

Im al hashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom shemmadlikin oto bener shennitma bitme met ze pasul veze tame af anu modim bitruma shennitmet bivelad hattuma shessorfin otah im hatteruma shennitmet beav hattuma
Aval heach nisrof hatteluya im hattemea shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna
b: Happigul vehannotar vehattame bet shammay omrim en nisrafin keachat uvet hillel omrim nisrafin keachat

Vei salka datach rabbi meir middivre rabbi yehoshua kaamar ammay mahdar leh rabbi yose midderabbi chanina segan hakkohanim amar leh rav nachman rabbi yose lav addateh dehu savar rabbi meir midderabbi chanina segan hakkohanim kaamar leh vaamar leh ana midderabbi yehoshua kaamena
Vaamar leh vaafilu lerabbi yehoshua name enah hi hammidda deha mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua shessoref zo bifne atzmah vezo bifne atzmah
Veammay enah hi hammidda midda umidda hi
Shane hatam deika hefsed chullin
Matkef lah rav yirmeya matnitin name ika hefsed deetzim amar leh hahu sava lehefsed merubbe chashshu lehefsed muat lo chashshu
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan machaloket beshesh aval besheva divre hakkol sorfin
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi nema kasavar rabbi yochanan matnitin beav hattuma deorayeta velad hattuma derabbanan umay middivrehem middivre rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim

Amar leh in itmar name amar rabbi yochanan matnitin beav hattuma deorayeta velad hattuma derabbanan umay middivrehem middivre rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim umachloket beshesh aval besheva divre hakkol sorfin
Lema mesayya leh happigul vehannotar vehattame bet shammay omrim en nisrafin keachat uvet hillel omrim nisrafin keachat
Shane hatam deit lehu tuma midderabbanan ditnan happigul vehannotar metammein et hayyadayim
Lema mesayya leh happat sheipsha venifsela milleechol leadam vehakkelev yachol leochlah metammea tumat ochalin bichvetza venisrefet im hattemea bappesach
Shane hatam deafra bealma hu
I hachi may mode hachi kaamar leh rabbi yose lerabbi meir afilu lerabbi yehoshua demekel ki mekel bitluya utmea aval bithora utmea la
I hachi ammay enah hi hammidda midda umidda hi
Amar rabbi yirmeya hacha bevasar shennitma bemashkin shennitmeu mechamat sheretz veazda rabbi meir letameh verabbi yose letameh
Rabbi meir letameh deamar tumat mashkin letamme acherim derabbanan
Verabbi yose letameh deamar tumat mashkin letamme acherim deorayeta detanya

a: Sefek mashkin litame tame letamme acherim tahor divre rabbi meir vechen haya rabbi elazar omer kidvarav rabbi yehuda omer lakkol tame
Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim laochalin temein lechelim tehorin

Vesavar rabbi elazar mashkin it lehu tuma baolam vehatanya rabbi elazar omer en tuma lemashkin kol ikar teda shehare heid yosef ben yoezer ish tzereda al el kamtza dechan veal mashkin bet matbechayya dechan
Hanicha lishmuel deamar dechan milletamme tumat acherim aval tumat atzman yesh lahen shappir ella lerav deamar dechan mammash may ika lememar
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak achada
Veha kidvarav kaamar dinfishi veod veha vechen katane kashya

Gufa rav amar dechan mammash ushmuel amar dechan milletamme tumat acherim aval tumat atzman yesh lahen rav amar dechan mammash kasavar tumat mashkin derabbanan vechi gezaru rabbanan bemashkin dealma uvmashkin bet matbechayya la gezur

Ushmuel amar dechan milletamme tumat acherim aval tumat atzman yesh lahen kasavar tumat mashkin atzman deorayeta letamme acherim derabbanan vechi gezur rabbanan bemashkin dealma bemashkin bet matbechayya la gezur vechi la gezur rabbanan letammoye acherim aval tumat atzman yesh lahen

Amar leh rav huna bar chinana livreh ki ayelatte lekammeh derav pappa remi leh mi amar shemuel dechan milletamme tumat acherim aval tumat atzman yesh lahen keri kan vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel
Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi mide dehave arvii bakkodesh matkef lah rav ashe revii bakkodesh la ikri tame hay ikri tame kashya
Ta shema vechol mashke asher yishshate bechol keli yitma may yitma hechsher
Hechsher meresha dikra shamatte leh mikkol haochel asher yeachel vego chad bitlushin vechad bimchubbarin
Utzrichi dei ashmeinan bitlushin mishshum deachshevinhu aval mechubbarin ema la
Vei tena mechubbarin mishshum dekayemi beduchtayehu chashivi aval telushin ema la tzerichi
Ta shema ach mayan uvor mikve mayim yihye tahor may yihye tahor mittumato
Utlushin mi machshirin vehaamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mashkin bet matbechayya lo dayyan shehen dechan ella sheen machshirin
Targema al dam deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan minnayin ledam kadashim sheeno machshir shenneemar al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim dam shennishpach kammayim machshir
b: Dam sheeno nishpach kammayim eno machshir matkef lah rav shemuel bar amme hare dam hattamtzit denishpach kammayim veeno machshir
Amar leh rabbi zera hannach ledam hattamtzit daafilu bechullin name la machshir
Kabbelah mineh rav shemuel bar amme deamar rachamana rak chazak levilti achol haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh dam shehannefesh yotza bo karuy dam dam sheen hannefesh yotza bo eno karuy dam
Ta shema dam shennitma uzrako beshogeg hurtza bemezid lo hurtza midderabbanan udla kerabbi yose ben yoezer ish tzereda
Ta shema al ma hatztzitz meratztze al haddam veal habbasar veal hachelev shennitma ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon ben beyachid ben betzibbur
Midderabbanan udla keosef ben yoezer ish tzereda
Ta shema venasa aharon et aon hakkodashim
Vechi eze aon hu nose im aon pigul hare kevar neemar lo yeratze im aon notar hare kevar neemar lo yechashev
Ha eno nose ella aon tuma shehuttera mikkelalah betzibur may lav tumat dam amar rav pappa la tumat kematzim
Ta shema hen yissa ish besar kodesh bichnaf bigdo venaga bichnafo el hallechem veel hannazid veel hayyayin veel shemen veel kol maachal hayikdash vayyaanu hakkohanim vayyomru lo yikdash

a: Veamar rav ishtabbush kahane mide hu tama ella lerav rav mashke bet matbechayya tane aval mashke be madbechayya metamme
Gufa rav amar ishtabbush kahane ushmuel amar la ishtabbush kahane
Rav amar ishtabbush kahane revii bakkodesh bea minayehu vaamaru leh tahor
Vshmuel amar la ishtabbush kahane chamishi bakkodesh bea minayehu vaamaru leh tahor
Bishlama lerav hayenu dichtiv arbea lechem venazid veyayin vashemen ella lishmuel chamsha mena leh
Mi ketiv venaga kenafo venaga bichnafo ketiv bema shennaga bichnafo

Ta shema vayyomer chaggay im yigga teme nefesh bechol elle hayitma vayyaanu hakkohanim vayyomru yitma bishlama lishmuel middehacha la ishtabbush hatam name la ishtabbush ella lerav may shena hacha deishtabbush umay shena hatam dela ishtabbush
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh bekiin hen betumat met veen bekiin hen betumat sheretz
Ravina amar hatam revii hacha shelishi
Ta shema vayyaan chaggay vayyomer ken haam hazze vechen haggoy hazze lefanay neum Adonai vego bishlama lerav hayenu dichtiv tame ella lishmuel ammay tame
Atmohe ka matmah veha vechen kol maase yedehem ketiv amar mar zutra veitema rav ashe mittoch shekkilkelu et maasehem maale alehem hakkatuv keilu hikrivu betuma
Gufa rav tane mashke bet matbechayya velevi tane mashke be madbechayya
Lelevi hanicha i sevira leh kishmuel deamar dechan milletamme tumat acherim aval tumat atzman yesh lahen mashkachatte lah denagi kullehu berishon
Ella i savar leh kerav deamar dechan mammash hechi mashkachatte lah al korchach kishmuel sevira leh
Velishmuel hanicha i savar lah kerav detane mashke bet matbechayya aval mashke be madbechayya acharine name metammeu revii hu dela aved chamishi ha shelishi aved revii
Ella i savar leh kelevi detane mashke be madbechayya may irya revii dela aved chamishi afilu sheni ushlishi name la avdi al korchach kerav sevira leh

Tanya keoteh derav tanya keoteh delevi tanya keoteh delevi haddam vehayyayin vehashshemen vehammayim mashke be madbechayya shennitmeu bifnim vehotzian lachutz tehorin nitmeu bachutz vehichnisan bifnim temein
Ini vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mashke be madbechayya lo amru dechan ella bimkoman may lav lemaote nitmeu bifnim vehotzian lachutz la lemaote nitmeu bachutz vehichnisan bifnim
Veha bimkoman kaamar hachi kaamar lo amru dechan ella shennitmeu bimkoman
Tanya keoteh derav haddam vehammayim mashke bet matbechayya shennitmeu ben bechelim ben bekarka tehorin
b: Rabban shimon omer bechelim temein bekarka tehorin

Amar rav pappa afilu leman deamar tumat mashkin deorayeta mashke bet matbechayya hilcheta gemiri lah amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa veella ha deamar rabbi eliezer en tuma lemashkin kol ikar teda shehare heid yosef ben yoezer ish tzereda al mashke bet matbechayya dechan
Vei hilcheta gemiri lah mi gamrinan minah
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe veha rabbi shimon deamar tumat mashkin deorayeta detanya rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim lechelim tehorin laochalin temein
Vehacha kaamar rabban shimon bechelim temein bekarka tehorin vei hilcheta hi ma li bechelim ma li bekarka kashya
Amar rav pappa ha deamratte bekarka tehorin lo shanu ella mayim aval dam lo
Umayim name la amaran ella dehave reviit dechaze lehatbil beh mechatin vetzinorot aval la have reviit temein
Amar mar rabbi yehuda omer lakkol tame lememra desavar rabbi yehuda tumat mashkin letamme tumat kelim deorayeta
Vehatnan kol hakkelim sheyyesh lahen achorayim vatoch kegon hakkarim vehakkesatot vehassakkin vehammartzufin nitma tocho nitma gabbo nitma gabbo lo nitma tocho
Amar rabbi yehuda bamme devarim amurim shennitmeu mechamat mashkin aval nitmeu mechamat sheretz nitma tocho nitma gabbo nitma gabbo nitma tocho
Vei salka datach tumat mashkin letamme kelim deorayeta ma li nitma mechamat mashkin ma li nitma mechamat sheretz amar rav yehuda amar shemuel chazar bo rabbi yehuda
Ravina amar leolam la hadar ha bemashkin habbain mechamat yadayim ha bemashkin habbain mechamat sheretz

I hachi addetane bamme devarim amurim shennitmeu mechamat mashkin liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim bemashkin habbain mechamat yadayim aval bemashkin habbain mechamat sheretz nitma tocho nitma gabbo nitma gabbo nitma tocho ella mechavarta kidshannin meikara chazar bo rabbi yehuda
Ibaya lehu mikkelim hu dahadar beh aval baochalin kerabbi yose verabbi shimon sevira leh o dilma ligmare hadar beh kerabbi meir
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ta shema para sheshshatta me chattat besarah tame rabbi yehuda omer

a: Batlu bemeeha vei salka datach mikkelim hu dahadar beh aval baochalin kerabbi yose verabbi shimon sevira leh ammay batlu bemeeha ligmare
Nehi detuma chamura la metammeu tuma kalla miha nitammeu
May batlu bemeeha name batlu mittuma chamura aval tuma kalla metammeu mikkelal detanna kamma savar tuma chamura name metammeu ha besarah tame katane
Kulleh rabbi yehuda hi vechassore michassera vehachi katane para sheshshatta me chattat besarah tame bamme devarim amurim tuma kalla aval tuma chamura lo sherabbi yehuda omer batlu bemeeha
Rav ashe amar leolam batlu bemeeha ligmare mishshum dehave leh mashke saruach
Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim laochalin temein lechelim tehorim amar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish rabbi yose beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo amarah dedaresh yitma yetamme
Ditnan bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva vechol keli cheres asher yippol mehem vego eno omer tame ella yitma yetamme acherim limed al kikkar sheni sheose shelishi bechullin
Vehacha hechi daresh vechol mashke asher yishshate bechol keli yitma yetamme letamme tumat ochalin atta omer letamme tumat ochalin o eno ella letamme tumat mashkin amarta lo kach haya
May lo kach haya amar rav pappa la matzinu tuma sheosa kayyotze bah

Ravina amar miggufeh dikra name la matzet amratte yitma letamme tumat mashkin dei salka datach yitma desefa letamme tumat mashkin yitma deresha name letamme tumat mashkin niarvinhu venichtevinhu mikkol haochel asher yeachel asher yavo alav mayim vechol mashke asher yishshate bechol keli yitma
Tere yitma lema li ella yitma deresha letamme tumat mashkin yitma desefa letamme tumat ochalin
Veema letamme et hakkelim velav kal vachomer hu uma keli shemmetamme mashke en metamme keli mashkin habbain mechamat keli eno din shello yetammeu et hakkelim
Veema ki la metammeu mashkin habbain mechamat keli aval mashkin habbain mechamat sheretz hachi name dimtammeu mashkin habbain mechamat sheretz mi ketivi
b: Velav mikkal vachomer kaate uma mashkin habbain mechamat keli metammein mashkin habbain mechamat sheretz lo kol shekken
Dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon
Yitma deresha hechi daresh mikkol haochel asher yeachel asher yavo alav mayim yitma yitma letamme et hammashkin atta omer letamme et hammashkin o eno ella letamme et hakkeli
Amarta kal vachomer uma mashke shemmetamme ochel eno metamme keli ochel sheen metamme ochel eno din shello yetamme keli ha ma ani mekayyem yitma letamme et hammashkin shehen alulin lekabbel tuma
May irya mashkin mishshum daalulin lekabbel tuma tipok leh mishshum deleka mide acharina
Hachi kaamar vechi tema ochel chamur dimtamme mashkin nitammeyeh lichli hahu chumra demashkin hu mishshum demashkin alulin lekabbel tuma
Uma hi alilatan shemmekabbelin tuma shello behechsher

Yitma deen osa kayyotze bah mehacha nafka mehatam nafka vechi yuttan mayim al zera venafal minnivlatam alav tame hu hu tame veen ose tuma kayyotze bah chad bemashkin habbain mechamat sheretz vechad bemashkin habbain mechamat keli
Utzrichi dei ashmoinan bemashkin habbain mechamat keli mishshum dela chamiri aval bemashkin habbain mechamat sheretz dachamiri ema ose tuma kayyotze bah
Velashmeinan mashkin habbain mechamat sheretz vechol shekken mashkin habbain mechamat keli milta deatya bekal vachomer tarach vechatev lah kera
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe veha amar rava la rabbi yose savar kerabbi akiva
Vela rabbi akiva savar kerabbi yose
Amar leh rabbi yose beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo amarah veleh la sevira leh
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana bishlama rabbi yose la savar lah kerabbi akiva detanya amar rabbi yose minnayin larvii bakkodesh shehu pasul
Vedin hu uma mechussar kippurim shemmuttar bitruma pasul bakkodesh shelishi sheppasul bitruma eno din sheyyaase revii bakkodesh
Velamadnu shelishi bakkodesh min hattora urvii mikkal vachomer
Shelishi min hattora dichtiv vehabbasar asher yigga

a: Bechol tame lo yeachel mi la askinan denaga besheni revii mikkal vachomer kidamrinan
Vei salka datach savar kerabbi akiva nitne name revii batteruma vachamishi bakkodesh
Ella rabbi akiva la savar kerabbi yose menalan
Amar leh dela lishtemit tanna velitne revii batteruma vachamishi bakkodesh venema rabbi akiva hi vaanan ahachi nekum venismoch
Nefak rav ashe vei tema rav kahana dak veashkach ha ditnan hakkeli metzaref et ma shebbetocho lakkodesh aval lo latteruma veharvii bakkodesh pasul vehashshelishi batteruma

Veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan meeduto shel rabbi akiva nishnet mishna zo detanya hosif rabbi akiva hassolet vehakketoret vehallevona vehaggechalim sheim naga tevul yom bemiktzatan pasal et kullan
Revii in chamishi la shelishi in revii la
Alma kasavar tzeruf derabbanan ufliga derabbi chanin deamar tzeruf deorayeta shenneemar kaf achat asara zahav melea ketoret hakkatuv asa kol ma shebbakkaf achat
Tenan hatam al machat shennimtzet babbasar shehassakkin vehayyadayim tehorot vehabbasar tame nimtzet bapperesh hakkol tahor amar rabbi akiva zachinu sheen tumat yadayim bammikdash
b: Venema sheen tumat yadayim vechelim bammikdash amar rav yehuda amar rav veitema rabbi yose berabbi chanina yadayim kodem gezerat kelim nishnu
Amar rava veha tarvayehu bo bayyom gazru ditnan hassefer vehayyadayim vehattevul yom vehaochalin vehakkelim shennitmeu bemashkin
Ella amar rava hannach letumat sakkin daafilu bechullin name la metamme hay sakkin dinga bemay ilema dinga bevasar ha en ochel metamme keli veella dinga bemachat veha en keli metamme keli

Hay machat may avidteh i nema sefek machat veha itmar rabbi elazar verabbi yose berabbi chanina chad amar lo gazru al sefek harukkin shebbirushalayim vechad amar lo gazru al sefek hakkelim shebbirushalayim
Amar rav yehuda amar rav kegon sheavda lo machat teme met vehikkirah babbasar rabbi yose berabbi avin amar kegon shehayeta para chasuma uvaa michutz lirushalayim
Gufa rabbi elazar verabbi yose berabbi chanina chad amar lo gazru al sefek harukkin shebbirushalayim vechad amar lo gazru al sefek hakkelim shebbirushalayim rukkin tenena kelim tenena
Rukkin tenena ditnan kol harukkin hannimtzain birushalayim tehorin chutz mishshel shuk haelon la tzericha af al gav deitachzak zav
Kelim tenena ditnan kol hakkelim hannimtzaim birushalayim derech yerida levet hattevila temein ha dealma tehorin
Ultamach ema sefa derech aliyya tehorin ha dealma temein
Ella resha daveka vesefa lav daveka ulappoke gazyata
Ulrav deamar kegon sheavda lo machat teme met vehikkirah babbasar kevan deamar mar bachalal cherev cherev hare hu kechalal adam vechelim name litamme
Amar rav ashe zot omeret azara reshut harabbim hi vehave leh sefek tuma birshut harabbim vechol sefek tuma birshut harabbim sefeko tahor
Ha birshut hayyachid sefeko tame hu mikkede hay machat davar sheen bo daat lishael hu vechol davar sheen bo daat lishael ben birshut harabbim ben birshut hayyachid sefeko tahor
Mishshum dehave sefek tuma habbaa bide adam veamar rabbi yochanan sefek tuma habbaa bide adam

a: Nishalin aleha afilu bichli hammunnach al gabbe karka kedavar sheyyesh bo daat lishael
Vehabbasar tame hay basar deitachshar bemay

I nema deitachshar bedam veha amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan minnayin ledam kadashim sheeno machshir shenneemar lo tochlennu al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim dam shennishpach kammayim machshir vesheeno nishpach kammayim eno machshir
Veella deitachshar bemashke bet matbechayya veha amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mashke bet matbechayya lo dayyan shehen dechan ella sheen machshirin
Veella deitachshar bechibat hakkodesh emor demahneya leh chibat hakkodesh leipsole gufeh lemimne beh rishon vesheni name
Tifshot devae resh lakish tzarid shel menachot monin bo rishon vesheni o lo
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kegon shehayeta para shel zivche shelamim veheevirah benahar ushchatah vaadayin mashke tofeach aleha
Nimtzet bapperesh hakkol tahor venihdar peresh venitammeyeh levasar amar rav adda bar ahava beferesh ava rav ashe amar afilu tema beferesh rakka mishshum dehave mashke saruach

Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet sheretz metamme et hammashkin umashkin metammein et hakkeli uchli metamme et haochalin vehaochalin metammein et hammashkin velamadnu shalosh tumot besheretz hane arbaa hen goz mashkin deresha
Adderabba goz mashkin desefa la ashkechan tanna deamar mashkin metammein keli ella rabbi yehuda vahadar beh vesimanach nazyeta
Tenan hatam sheretz shennimtza betannur happat shebbetocho sheniyya mippene shehattannur techilla
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava venichze lehay tannur keman dimle tuma dame vetihve hay pat rishona
Amar leh la salka datach detanya yachol yehu kol hakkelim mittammein meavir keli cheres
b: Talmud lomar kol asher betocho yitma usmich leh mikkol haochel ochel mittamme meavir keli cheres veen kol hakkelim mittammein meavir keli cheres
Rav chisda rame pischa appischa umshanne mi amar rabbi yehoshua shettehen keachat
Urminhu amar rabbi yose en hanniddon dome liraya kesheheidu rabbotenu al ma heidu im al habbasar shennitma bivelad hattuma shessorfin oto im habbasar shennitma beav hattuma ze tame veze tame

Im al hashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom shemmadlikin oto bener shennitma bitme met ze pasul veze tame af anu modim bitruma shennitmet bivelad hattuma shessorfin otah im hatteruma shennitmet beav hattuma aval heach nisrof afilu teluya im hattemea shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharem
Umshanne ha rabbi shimon vealliba derabbi yehoshua ha rabbi yose vealliba derabbi yehoshua

Detanya arbaa asar shechal lihot beshabbat mevaarin et hakkol millifne hashshabbat vesorfin terumot temeot teluot uthorot divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer tehora bifne atzmah utluya bifne atzmah utmea bifne atzmah

Amar rabbi shimon lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al hattehora veal hattemea sheen sorfin al hatteluya veal hattehora shessorfin al ma nechleku al hatteluya veal hattemea sherabbi eliezer omer tisaref zo beatzmah vezo beatzmah verabbi yehoshua omer shettehen keachat
Veha matnitin rabbi yose hi hachi kaamar rabbi yose lerabbi meir afilu rabbi shimon vealliba derabbi yehoshua demekel ki mekel bitluya utmea aval bithora utmea la
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina rame teruma appischa umshanne mi amar rabbi yehoshua shettehen keachat

Urminhu chavit shel teruma shennolad bah sefek tuma rabbi eliezer omer im hayeta munnachat bimkom hatturpa yannichenna bemakom hammutzna veim hayeta megulla yechassenna rabbi yehoshua omer im hayeta munnachat bemakom hammutzna yannichenna bimkom hatturpa veim hayeta mechusse yegallenna
Gerama in beyadayim la umshanne ha rabbi shimon alliba derabbi yehoshua ha rabbi yose alliba derabbi yehoshua
Rabbi elazar rame teruma atteruma umshanne mi amar rabbi yehoshua gerama in beyadayim la
Urminhu chavit shel teruma shennishbera baggat haelona vetachteha chullin temein
Mode rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora yatztzil veim lav rabbi eliezer omer tered vetittamme veal yetammeenna bayyad
Rabbi yehoshua omer yetammeenna bayyad
Umshanne shane hatam deika hefsed chullin
Matkef lah rava matnitin name ika hefsed etzim amar leh abbaye lehefsed merubbe chashshu lehefsed muat lo chashshu

Vmna temra dilhefsed merubbe chashshu ulhefsed muat lo chashshu detanya chavit shel shemen teruma shennishbera baggat haelona uvattachtona chullin temein mode rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora yatztzil veim lav tered vetittamme veal yetammeenna bayyad
May shena shemen derauy lehadlik yayin name rauy leziluf
Vechi tema ziluf lav milta hi vehaamar shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyya shotin millog besela umzallefin millog bishtayim bechadash
Veha rauy leyashsheno ate beh lide takkala shemen name ate beh lide takkala
Derame leh bichli maus yayin name rame leh bichli maus leziluf ka vae leh bichli maus rame leh
Vetakkala atzmah tannae hi detanya chavit shel yayin shel teruma shennitmet bet shammay omrim tishshafech chaval uvet hillel omrim tease ziluf
Amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose ani achria bassade tishshafech chaval babbayit tease ziluf ika deamri bechadash tishshafech chaval beyashan tease ziluf amru lo

a: En hachraat shelishit machraat
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina machloket shennafla lefachot mimmea sea chullin temein
Aval nafla lemea chullin temein divre hakkol tered vetittamme veal yetammeenna bayyad

Tanya name hachi chavit shennishbera baggat haelona vetachteha mea chullin temein mode rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora yatztzil veim lav tered vetittamme veal yetammeenna bayyad
Hay mode rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua mode rabbi yehoshua lerabbi eliezer mibe leh amar rava efoch
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar leolam la tefoch hacha bemay askinan bichli shettocho tahor vegabbo tame mahu detema nigzor dilma naga gabbo bitruma ka mashma lan
Hadran alach or learbaa asar

Matni kol shaa shemmuttar leechol maachil labbehema lachayya velaofot umocher lannochri umuttar bahanaato avar zemanno asur bahanaato velo yassik bo tannur vechirayim rabbi yehuda omer en biur chametz ella serefa vachachamim omrim af mefarer vezore leruach o metil layyam

Gema kol shaa shemmuttar leechol maachil ha kol shaa sheeno muttar leechol eno maachil lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda dei rabbi yehuda ha ika chamesh deeno ochel umaachil ditnan rabbi meir omer ochlin kol chamesh vesorfin bitchillat shesh rabbi yehuda omer ochlin kol arba vetolin kol chamesh vesorfin bitchillat shesh
Veella may rabbi meir hi hay kol shaa shemmuttar leechol maachil kol shaa sheochel maachil mibe leh

Amar rabba bar ulla matnitin rabban gamliel hi ditnan rabban gamliel omer chullin neechalin kol arba teruma kol chamesh vesorfin bitchillat shesh vehachi kaamar kol shaa shemmuttar leechol kohen bitruma yisrael maachil chullin labbehema lachayya velaofot
Lema li lemitna behema lema li lemitna chayya tzericha dei tena behema dei meshayera chaze lah aval chayya dei meshayera kamatznea lah ema la
Vei tena chayya mishshum dei meshayera mihat matznea aval behema zimnin dimshayera vela massek addateh vekae aleh beval yerae uvval yimmatze ema la tzericha
Ofot lema li ayede ditna behema vechayya tena name ofot

Umochro legoy peshita leappoke mehay tanna detanya bet shammay omrim lo yimkor adam chametzo legoy ella im ken yodea bo sheyyichle kodem pesach uvet hillel omrim kol shaa shemmuttar leechol muttar limkor
b: Rabbi yehuda ben betera omer kuttach vechol mine chuttach asur limkor sheloshim yom kodem lappesach
Umuttar bahanaa peshita la tzericha shecharacho kodem zemanno veka mashma lan kidrava deamar rava characho kodem zemanno muttar bahanaa afilu leachar zemanno

Avar zemanno asur bahanaato peshita la tzericha leshaot derabbanan deamar rav gidel amar rav chiyya bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan hamkaddesh mishshesh shaot ulmala afilu bechite kurdinyata en choshshin lekiddushin

Velo yassik bo tannur vechirayim peshita la tzericha lerabbi yehuda deamar en biur chametz ella serefa salka datach amena hoil veamar rabbi yehuda mitzvato bisrefa bahade deka saref leh lithane mineh ka mashma lan

Amar chizkiyya minnayin lechametz bappesach sheasur bahanaa shenneemar lo yeachel chametz lo yehe bo heter achila tama dichtav rachamana lo yeachel chametz ha la ketav lo yeachel hava amena isur achila mashma isur hanaa la mashma
Ufliga derabbi avahu deamar rabbi avahu kol makom shenneemar lo yeachel lo tochal lo tochlu echad isur achila veechad isur hanaa mashma ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv kederech shepparat lecha binvela

Detanya lo tochlu kol nevela lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenochri vego en li ella lagger bintina velaggoy bimchira lagger bimchira minnayin talmud lomar lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna o machor laggoy bintina minnayin talmud lomar tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenachri nimtzeta omer echad ger veechad goy ben bimchira ben bintina divre rabbi meir

Rabbi yehuda omer devarim kichtavan lagger bintina velaggoy bimchira may tama derabbi yehuda i salka datach kidamar rabbi meir lichtov rachamana lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah umachor o lema li shema minah lidvarim kichtavan
Verabbi meir o lehakdim netina deger limchira degoy verabbi yehuda ha la tzarich kera kevan deger atta metzuve lehachoto vegoy i atta metzuve lehachaoto la tzerich kera sevara hu
Bishlama lerabbi meir deamar echad ger veechad goy ben bimchira ben bintina middeitzterich kera lemishre nevela bahanaa ha kol isurin shebbattora asurin ben baachila ben bahanaa
Ella lerabbi yehuda deamar lidvarim kichtavan hu daata ha kol isurim shebbattora mena leh daasurin bahanaa nafka leh millakkelev tashlichun oto

a: Oto atta mashlich lakkelev vei atta mashlich lakkelev kol isurin shebbattora verabbi meir oto atta mashlich lakkelev vei atta mashlich lakkelev chullin shennishchatu baazara
Veidach chullin shennishchatu baazara lav deorayeta hi
Metiv rabbi yitzchak nappacha vahare gid hannashe derachamana amar al ken lo yochlu vene yisrael et gid hannashe utnan sholeach adam yarech legoy vegid hannashe betocho mippene shemmekomo nikar
Kasavar rabbi avahu keshehuttera nevela hi vechelbah vegidah huttera hanicha leman deamar yesh begidin benoten taam ella leman deamar en begidin benoten taam may ika lememar
Man shamatte leh deamar en begidin benoten taam rabbi shimon detanya haochel miggid hannashe shel behema temea rabbi yehuda mechayyev shettayim verabbi shimon poter
Rabbi shimon hachi name deasar bahanaa detanya gid hannashe muttar bahanaa divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon oser
Vahare dam derachamana amar kol nefesh mikkem lo tochal dam utnan ellu vaellu mitarvin baamma veotzin lenachal kidron venimkarin laggannanin lezabbel umoalin bo
Shane dam deitakkash lemayim dichtiv lo tochlennu al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim ma mayim muttarin af dam muttar
Veema kammayim hammitnassechim al gabbe hammizbeach amar rabbi avahu kammayim rov mayim mide rov mayim ketiv ella amar rav ashe kammayim hannishpachin velo kammayim hannisachin
Veema kammayim hannishpachin lifne avoda zara hatam name nisuch ikri dichtiv yishtu yen nesicham
b: Ulchizkiyya lemay hilcheta itakkash dam lemayim lechidrabbi chiyya bar abba deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan minnayin ledam kadashim sheeno machshir shenneemar lo tochlennu al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim dam shennishpach kammayim machshir sheeno nishpach kammayim eno machshir

Vahare ever min hachay dichtiv lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar vetanya rabbi natan omer minnayin shello yoshit adam kos yayin lenazir veever min hachay livne noach talmud lomar velifne iver lo titten michshol ha lichlavim shere
Shane ever min hachay deitakkash ledam dichtiv rak chazak levilti achol haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh
Ulchizkiyya lemay hilcheta itakkash ever min hachay ledam amar lach dam hu deitakkash leever min hachay ma ever min hachay asur af dam min hachay asur vei ze ze dam hakkaza shehannefesh yotza bo

Vahare shor hanniskal derachamana amar lo yeachel et besaro vetanya mimmashma shenneemar sakol yissakel hashshor eni yodea shehi nevela unvela asura baachila uma talmud lomar lo yeachel maggid lecha hakkatuv sheim shechato leachar shennigmar et dino asur
En li ella baachila bahanaa minnayin talmud lomar uvaal hashshor naki may mashma shimon ben zoma omer keadam sheomer lachavero yatza peloni naki minnechasav veen lo bahem hanaa shel kelum
Tama dichtav uvaal hashshor naki dei millo yeachel isur achila mashma isur hanaa la mashma
Leolam lo yeachel isur achila veisur hanaa mashma uvaal hashshor naki lahanaat oro hu daata veitzterich salka datach amena lo yeachel et besaro ketiv besaro in oro la ka mashma lan
Ulhanach tannae demappeki leh lehay kera lidrasha acharina lachatzi kofer velidme veladot hanaat oro mena lehu nafka lehu meet besaro et hattafel livsaro
Veidach et la daresh

Kidtanya shimon haamsoni veamri lah nechemya haamsoni haya doresh kol ettim shebbattora kevan shehiggia leet Adonai elohecha tira perash amru lo talmidav rabbi kol ettim sheddarashta ma tehe alehen amar lahem keshem shekkibbalti sachar al hadderisha kach ani mekabbel sachar al happerisha ad shebba rabbi akiva vedarash et Adonai elohecha tira lerabbot talmide chachamim

Vahare orla derachamana amar arelim lo yeachel vetanya arelim lo yeachel en li ella isur achila minnayin shello yehane mimmennu shello yitzba bo velo yadlik bo et hanner talmud lomar vaaraltem orlato arelim lo yeachel lerabbot et kullam
Tama dichtav rachamana vaaraltem orlato arelim ha lav hachi hava amena isur achila mashma isur hanaa la mashma
Leolam lo yeachel mashma ben isur achila ben isur hanaa veshane hatam dichtiv lachem veitzterich salka datach amena hoil uchtav lachem shellachem yehe kamashma lan
Veella hashta dichtivi hanach kerae lachem lema li lechidtanya lachem lerabbot et hannatua

a: Lerabbim rabbi yehuda omer lehotzi et hannatua lerabbim

May tama detanna kamma dichtiv untatem leyachid mashma lerabbim la mashma ketav rachamana lachem lehavi et hannatua lerabbim verabbi yehuda untatem mashma ben lerabbim ben leyachid velachem ben yachid ben rabbim mashma have ribbuy achar ribbuy veen ribbuy achar ribbuy ella lemaet
Vahare teruma derachamana amar vechol zar lo yochal kodesh utnan mearvin lenazir beyayin ulyisrael bitruma
Amar rav pappa shane hatam deamar kera terumatchem shellachem tehe veidach terumatchem dechol yisrael kaamar
Vahare nazir derachamana amar mechartzannim vead zag lo yochel utnan mearvin lannazir beyayin amar mar zutra shane hatam deamar kera nizro shello yehe
Rav ashe amar kadosh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho gidulo kadosh veen davar acher kadosh mide veen davar acher ketiv ella mechavarta kidmar zutra
Vahare chadash derachamana amar lechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu ad etzem hayyom hazze utnan kotzer leshachat umaachil labbehema
Amar rav shemaya shane hatam deamar kera ketzirchem ketzirchem shellachem yehe veidach ketzirchem dechol yisrael mashma

Vahare sheratzim derachamana amar sheketz hu lo yeachel utnan tzayyade chayya veofot vedagim shennizdammenu lahem minin temein muttarin lemochran legoyim shane hatam deamar kera lachem shellachem yehe
I hachi afilu lechattechilla name shane hacha deamar kera yihu bahavayatan yehu
Ulchizkiyya lema li lemichtav lo yeachel umayete lachem lemishreyeh la lichtov rachamana lo yeachel vela bae lachem amar lach chizkiyya tama didi name mehacha

Vahare chametz derachamana amar lo yeachel chametz vetanya rabbi yose haggelili omer temah al atzmecha heach chametz asur bahanaa kol shiva shane hatam deamar kera velo yerae lecha seor shellecha yehe
Verabbanan shellecha i atta roe aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoha veidach tere lecha ketivi
Veidach chad begoy shekkibashto vechad begoy shello kibashto veidach telata lecha ketivi veidach chad bisor vechad bechametz utzrichi
Lema ketannae yease lechol melacha ma talmud lomar lechol melacha sheyyachol limlechet gavoha yehe muttar limlechet hedot yehe asur talmud lomar lechol melacha divre rabbi yose haggelili
Rabbi akiva omer sheyyachol limlechet hedot yehe tahor limlechet gavoha yehe tame talmud lomar lechol melacha
Verabbi yose haggelili letuma ultohora la itzterich kera ki itzterich kera leisur ulheter verabbi akiva isur veheter la tzerich kera ki itzterich kera letuma ultohora
b: May lav beha kamipalgi derabbi yose haggelili savar lo tochlu mashma ben isur achila ben isur hanaa vechi ata kera lemishreyah linvela bahanaa hu daata verabbi akiva savar isur achila mashma isur hanaa la mashma vechi ata kera letuma vetohora

La dechulle alma lo tochlu mashma ben isur achila ben isur hanaa vehacha beha kamipalgi rabbi yose haggelili savar keshehuttera nevela hi huttera chelbah vegidah lo hutteru vechi itzterich kera leheter hanaa hu daata verabbi akiva savar keshehuttera nevela chelbah vegidah name hutteru vechi itzterich kera letuma vetohora

Verabbi yose haggelili ashkechan chelev desharyeh rachamana bahanaa ella gid nema deasur ibaet ema hachi name deasur ibaet ema mayete lah bekal vachomer uma chelev sheanush karet muttar bahanaa gid sheeno anush karet lo kol shekken
Verabbi shimon deasar ika lemifrach ma lechelev shekken huttar mikkelalo etzel chayya tomar begid shello huttar mikkelalo etzel chayya
Veidach bivhema kaamrinan bivhema mihat la ishteri

Mikkede otvinhu kol hane kerae veshanninhu chizkiyya verabbi avahu bemay peligi bechametz bappesach vealliba derabbanan beshor hanniskal vealliba dedivre hakkol chizkiyya nafek leh millo yeachel verabbi avahu nafek leh minnevela
Mikkedi ben lemar uven lemar asurin bahanaa may benayehu ika benayehu chullin shennishchatu baazara chizkiyya savar lo yeachel lemaote hane oto lemaote chullin shennishchatu baazara
Rabbi avahu savar oto lemaote hane chullin shennishchatu baazara lav deorayeta ninhu

Yatev hahu merabbanan kammeh derabbi shemuel bar nachmani veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi minnayin lechol isurin shebbattora dechi hechi daasurin baachila hachi name asurin bahanaa umay nihu chametz bappesach veshor hanniskal minnayin tipok leh millo yeachel lo yeachel isur achila mashma leh isur hanaa la mashma leh
Tipok leh minnevela savar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar devarim kichtavan
I savar lah kerabbi yehuda tipok leh mehecha denafka leh lerabbi yehuda millakkelev tashlichun oto
Kasavar chullin shennishchatu baazara deorayeta minnayin dichtiv kol chattat asher yuva middamah vego
Sheen talmud lomar baesh tissaref uma talmud lomar baesh tissaref im eno inyan legufo dichtiv vehinne soraf tenehu inyan lechol isurin shebbattora

a: Veim eno inyan laachila tenehu inyan leisur hanaa
I ma kan bisrefa af kol isurin shebbattora bisrefa amar kera bakkodesh baesh tissaref bakkodesh bisrefa veen kol isurin shebbattora bisrefa

Vehay bakkodesh baesh tissaref lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidrabbi shimon detanya rabbi shimon omer bakkodesh baesh tissaref limed al chattat shessorfin otah bakkodesh veen li ella zo bilvad pesule kodshe kadashim veemure kadashim kallim minnayin talmud lomar vechol bakkodesh baesh tissaref

Amar leh rabbi yonatan rabbach mehay kera kaamar lah veim yivater mibbesar hammilluim umin hallechem ad habboker vego sheen talmud lomar lo yeachel uma talmud lomar lo yeachel im eno inyan legufeh deha ketiv vesarafta et hannotar baesh tenehu inyan lishar isurin shebbattora veim eno inyan laachila tenehu inyan leisur hanaa
I ma kan bisrefa af kol isurin shebbattora bisrefa amar kera vesarafta et hannotar notar bisrefa veen kol isurin shebbattora bisrefa
Vehay lo yeachel lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidrabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar lo yeachel ki kodesh hu kol shebbakkodesh pasul ba hakkatuv liten lo taase al achilato

Amar abbaye leolam mikra kamma veefoch delichtov baesh tissaref vela bae lo teachel ma talmud lomar lo teachel im eno inyan legufo denafka leh midderabbi elazar tenehu inyan lechol isurin shebbattora veim eno inyan laachila tenehu inyan leisur hanaa
I ma kan bisrefa af kol isurin shebbattora bisrefa amar kera hannotar hannotar bisrefa veen kol isurin shebbattora bisrefa
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veema leyachode leh lav legufeh hu daata dei midderabbi elazar en lokin al lav shebbichlalot
Ella amar rav pappa mehacha vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel baesh yissaref sheen talmud lomar lo yeachel ma talmud lomar lo yeachel
Im eno inyan legufo deha nafka leh mikkal vachomer mimmaaser hakkal uma maaser hakkal amra tora lo viarti mimmennu betame besar kodesh chamur lo kol shekken
Vechi tema en mazhirin min haddin hekkesha hu dichtiv lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvchorot bekarcha vego
Ma talmud lomar lo yeachel im eno inyan legufo tenehu inyan lechol isurin shebbattora veim eno inyan laachila tenehu inyan lahanaa
I ma kan bisrefa af kol isurin shebbattora bisrefa amar kera hannotar hannotar bisrefa veen kol isurin shebbattora bisrefa
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe veema laavor alav bishne lavin lav mi amar abbaye achal putita loke arba
Nemala loke chamesh
b: Tzira loke shesh amar leh kol hecha deika lemidrash darshinan vela mokminan belave yattire
Vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel deresheh lema li lerabbot etzim ulvona vehabbasar kol tahor yochal basar desefeh lema li lerabbot emurin
Emurin mehatam nafka detanya vehannefesh asher tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim asher la lerabbot et haemurin
Hatam tumat hagguf becharet hacha tumat basar belav
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan kol isurin shebbattora en lokin alehen ella derech achilatan lemaote may amar rav shimi bar ashe lemaote sheim achal chelev chay sheppatur

Ika deamri amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan kol isurin shebbattora en lokin alehen ella derech hanaatan lemaote may amar rav shimi bar ashe lemaote sheim hinniach chelev shel shor hanniskal al gabbe makkato shehu patur vechol shekken ochel chelev chay shehu patur
Ittemar name amar rav acha bar aveya amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan hinniach chelev shel shor hanniskal al gabbe makkato patur lefi shekkol isurin shebbattora en lokin alehem ella derech hanaatan

Amar rabbi zera af anan name tenena en sofgin et haarbaim mishshum orla ella al hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim bilvad veilu mittutim teenim verimmonim la may tama lav mishshum dela kaachel lehu derech hanaatan
Amar leh abbaye bishlama i ashmeinan peri gufa dela kaachel leh derech hanaato shappir ella hacha mishshum dezea bealma hu
Amar abbaye hakkol modim bechile hakkerem shellokin alehen afilu shello kederech hanaatan may tama mishshum dela ketiv behu achila
Metivi isi ben yehuda omer minnayin levasar bechalav shehu asur neemar kan ki am kadosh atta veneemar lehallan veanshe kodesh tihun li ma lehallan asur af kan asur
Veen li ella baachila bahanaa minnayin amarta kal vachomer uma orla shello neevda bah avera asura bahanaa basar bechalav shenneevda bo avera eno din sheyehe asur bahanaa

a: Ma leorla shekken lo hayeta lah sheat hakkosher tomar bevasar bechalav shehayeta lo sheat hakkosher chametz bappesach yochiach shehaya lo sheat hakkosher veasur bahanaa
Ma lechametz bappesach shekken anush karet tomar bevasar bechalav sheeno anush karet kile hakkerem yochichu sheen anush karet veasur bahanaa
Veim ita nifroch ma lechile hakkerem shekken lokin alehen afilu shello kederech hanaatan
Veabbaye tomar bemay tomar bevasar bechalav sheen lokin alav ella derech hanaato attu bevasar bechalav achila ketiva beh
Veidach deka motev lah savar lehachi ka gamar minnevela ma nevela derech hanaatah af basar bechalav derech hanaato
Veabbaye lehachi lo katav achila begufo lomar shellokin alav afilu shello kederech hanaato
Velifroch ma lechile hakkerem shekken lo hayeta lo sheat hakkosher amar rabbi adda bar ahava zot omeret kile hakkerem ikaran neesarin hoil vehayeta lahen sheat hakkosher kodem hashrasha
Metiv rav shemaya hammaavir atzitz nakuv bakkerem im hosif matayim asur hosif in lo hosif la
Amar rava tere kerae ketivi ketiv hazzara uchtiv hammelea ha ketzad zarua meikaro behashrasha zarua uva hosif in lo hosif la
