Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan bakkol mitrappein chutz meatze ashera hechi dame i nema deika sakkana afilu atze ashera name vei deleka sakkana afilu kol isurin shebbattora name la
Leolam deika sakkana vaafilu hachi atze ashera la detanya rabbi eliezer omer im neemar bechol nafshecha lamma neemar bechol meodecha veim neemar bechol meodecha lamma neemar bechol nafshecha
Ella lomar lach im yesh adam sheggufo chaviv alav mimmamono lechach neemar bechol nafshecha veyesh adam shemmamono chaviv alav miggufo lechach neemar bechol meodecha
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan bakkol mitrappein chutz meavoda zara vegiluy araot
b: Ushfichut damim
Avoda zara ha daamaran giluy araot ushfichut damim detanya rabbi omer ki kaasher yakum ish al reehu urtzacho nefesh ken haddavar hazze vechi ma inyan rotzeach etzel naara hamorasa

Hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed makkish rotzeach lenaara hamorasa ma naara hamorasa nitan lehatztzilah benafsho af rotzeach nitan lehatztzilo benafsho venaara hamorasa merotzeach ma rotzeach yehareg veal yaavor af naara hamorasa tehareg veal taavor

Ushfichut damim gufeh menalan sevara hu ki hahu daata lekammeh derava amar leh mare duray amar li zil katleh liflanya vei la katlina lach amar leh likteluch vela tiktol may chazet didma didach summak tefe dilma dema dehahu gavra summak tefe
Mar bar rav ashe ashkecheh leravina deshayef lah livratteh beguharke deorla amar leh emor daamur rabbanan bishat hassakkana shello bishat hassakkana mi amur
Amar leh hay ishata tzemirta name kishat hassakkana damya ika deamri amar leh mide derech hanaa ka avedna
Itmar hanaa habbaa lo leadam beal korcho abbaye amar mutteret verava amar asura
Efshar veka mikaven la efshar vekamikaven kulle alma la peligi deasur la efshar vela mikaven kulle alma la peligi dishre ki peligi deefshar vela mikaven

Vealliba derabbi yehuda deamar davar sheen mitkaven asur kulle alma la peligi deasur ki peligi alliba derabbi shimon deamar davar sheen mitkaven muttar abbaye kerabbi shimon verava amar ad kan la ka amar rabbi shimon ella hecha dela efshar aval hecha deefshar la

Ika deamri efshar vela mikaven hayenu pelugtayehu derabbi yehuda verabbi shimon la efshar vela ka mikaven kulle alma la peligi dishre ki peligi dela efshar veka mikaven vealliba derabbi shimon deazel batar kauona kulle alma la peligi deasur ki peligi alliba derabbi yehuda deamar la shena mitkaven vela shena sheen mitkaven efshar asur
Abbaye kerabbi yehuda

a: Verava amar lach ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda sheen mitkaven kemitkaven ella lechumra aval mitkaven kesheen mitkaven lekulla la
Amar abbaye mena amena lah detanya amru alav al rabban yochanan ben zakkay shehaya yoshev betzilo shel hechal vedoresh kol hayyom kullo veha hacha dela efshar umikaven veshare
Verava amar shane hechal diltocho asuy

Amar rava mena amena lah detanya lulin hau petuchin baaliyyat bet kodshe hakkodashim shebbahen meshalshelin et haummanim betevot kede shello yazunu enehem mibbet kodshe hakkodashim veha hacha dela efshar veka mikaven veasur
Vetisbera vehaamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara kol umare vareach en bahen mishshum meila ella maala asu bevet kodshe hakkodashim
Ika deamri amar rava mena amena lah detanya amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara kol umare vareach en bahen mishshum meila meila hu deleka ha isura ika
May lav leotan haomdin bifnim dela efshar veka mikaven veasur la leotan haomdin bachutz

Gufa amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara kol umare vareach en bahen mishshum meila vereach en bo mishshum meila veha tanya hamfattem et hakketoret lehitlammed bah o lemosrah latztzibur patur lehariach bah chayyav vehammeriach bah patur ella shemmaal
Ella amar rav pappa kol umare en bahen mishshum meila lefi sheen bahen mammash vereach leachar shettaale timroto en bo mishshum meila hoil venaaset mitzvato
Lememra dechol hecha denaaset mitzvato en bo mishshum meila vahare terumat haddeshen denaaset mitzvatah veyesh bah mishshum meila dichtiv vesamo etzel hammizbeach shello yefazzer vesamo shello yehane
Mishshum dehau terumat haddeshen uvigde chehunna shene chetuvin habbain keechad vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Terumat haddeshen ha daamaran bigde chehunna dichtiv vehinnicham sham melammed shetteunin geniza

Hanicha lerabbanan deamri melammed shetteunin geniza ella lerabbi dosa diflig alayehu deamar aval reuyin hen lechohen hedot umay vehinnicham sham shello yishtammesh bahem beom kippurim acher may ika lememar
Mishshum dehau terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene chetuvin habbain keechad vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar tere miute ketivi ketiv vesamo uchtiv haarufa
Ta shema hichnisa lerivka vedasha keshera bishvil shettinak vetadush pesula
Veha hacha dela efshar veka mikaven vekatane pesula shane hatam dichtiv asher lo ubbad bah mikkol makom
I hachi afilu resha name
b: Ha la damya ella leha shachan aleha of keshera ala aleha zachar pesula may tama
Amar rav pappa i ketiv avad vekarenan avad ad deaved bah ihu i ketiv ubbad vekarenan ubbad afilu mimmela name
Hashta dichtiv avad vekarenan ubbad ubbad dumya deavad ma avad denicha leh af ubbad denicha leh

Ta shema aveda lo yishtachenna lo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe maggod letzorko aval shotchah letzorkah al gabbe mitta veal gabbe maggod nizdammenu lo orchin lo yishtachenna lo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe maggod ben letzorkah ben letzorko
Shane hatam dekale lah i mishshum ena bisha i mishshum gannave
Ta shema mochre chesut mochrin kedarkan uvilvad shello yitkaven bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim vehatztzenuin mafshilin laachorehem bemakkel
Veha hacha deefshar lemebad kitznuin vechi la mechaven shere teuvta leman dematne lishana kamma derava teuvta
Velo yassik bo vechu tanu rabbanan tannur shehissiko biklipe orla o bekashshin shel kile hakkerem chadash yuttatz yashan yutzan
Afa bo et happat rabbi omer happat asura vachachamim omrim happat mutteret bishlah al gabbe gechalim divre hakkol muttar
Veha tanya ben chadash uven yashan yutzan la kashya ha rabbi veha rabbanan
Emor deshamatte leh lerabbi mishshum deyesh shevach etzim bappat ze vaze gorem mi shamatte leh ella la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ha rabbanan

He rabbi eliezer ilema rabbi eliezer disor ditnan seor shel chullin veshel teruma shennaflu letoch isa veen baze kede lehachmitz veen baze kede lehachmitz venitztarfu vechimmetzu rabbi eliezer omer achar acharon ani ba vachachamim omrim ben shennafal isur lechattechilla uven shennafal isur levassof leolam eno oser

a: Ad sheyehe bo kede lehachmitz veamar abbaye lo shanu ella shekkadam vesilek et haisur aval lo kadam vesilek et haisur asur alma ze veze gorem asur

Umimmay detama derabbi eliezer keabbaye dilma tama derabbi eliezer mishshum deachar acharon ani ba la shena kadam vesilek et haisur la shena lo kadam vesilek et haisur aval bevat achat hachi name dishre
Ella rabbi eliezer daatze ashera ditnan natal hemenna etzim asurin bahanaa hissik bahen et hattannur chadash yuttatz yashan yutzan
Afa bo et happat asurin bahanaa nitarva beacharot vaacherot baacherot kullan asurin bahanaa rabbi eliezer omer yolich hanaa leyam hammelach amar lo en pidon laavoda zara

Emor deshamatte leh lerabbi eliezer baavoda zara dachamir isurah bishar isurin shebbattora mi shamatte leh ella im ken amman tirmeyah veod ha tanya behedya vechen haya rabbi eliezer oser bechol isurin shebbattora
Amar abbaye im timtza lomar ze vaze gorem asur rabbi hayenu rabbi eliezer veim timtze lomar ze vaze gorem muttar vehacha mishshum deyesh shevach etzim befat hu hane kearot vechosot utzlochiyyot asiri
Ki peligi betannur ukdera leman deamar ze vaze gorem asur asur leman deamar ze vaze gorem muttar shere
Ika deamri afilu leman deamar ze vaze gorem muttar kedera asura deha kabbela bishula mikkamme deniten etzim dehetera

Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel tannur shehissiko biklipe orla o bekashshin shel kile hakkerem chadash yuttatz yashan yutzan afa bo et happat rabbi omer happat mutteret vachachamim omrim happat asura vehatanya ipcha shemuel ipcha tane
Veibaet ema bealma kasavar shemuel halacha kerabbi mechavero velo mechaverav uvha afilu mechaverav vesavar atneyah ipcha ki hechi denekum rabbanan leisura

Bishlah al gabbe gechalim divre hakkol happat mutteret amar rav yehuda amar shemuel verabbi chiyya bar ashe amar rabbi yochanan chad amar lo shanu ella gechalim ommot aval gechalim lochashot asurin vechad amar afilu gechalim lochashot name muttarin

Bishlama leman deamar lochashot asurin mishshum deyesh shevach etzim bappat ella leman deamar afilu lochashot muttarot pat deasar deyesh shevach etzim bappat lerabbi hechi mashkachatte leh amar rav pappa kesheavuka kenegdo
b: Mikkelal derabbanan difligi aleh sharu afilu kesheavuka kenegdo ella etzim deisura lerabbanan hechi mashkachatte lehu amar rav amme bar chama besharshifa

Bea mineh rame bar chama merav chisda tannur shehissiko baatze hekdesh veafa bo happat lerabbanan desharu bekammayeta may amar leh happat asura uma ben zo leorla amar rava hachi hashta orla betela bematayim hekdesh afilu beelef lo batel
Ella amar rava i kashya leh ha kashya vahalo maal hammassik vechol hecha demaal hammassik nafku lehu lechullin
Amar rav pappa hacha baatze shelamim askinan vealliba derabbi yehuda deamar hekdesh beshogeg mitchallel bemezid eno mitchallel
Bemezid may tama la kevan delav bar meila hu la nafek lechullin shelamim name kevan delav bar meila ninhu la nafka lechullin
Vechol hecha demaal hammassik nafki lechullin veha tanya kol hannisrafin efran muttar chutz meatze ashera veefer hekdesh leolam asur
Amar rame bar chama kegon shennafla deleka meeleha baatze hekdesh deleka inash denimol rav shemaya amar beotan shetteunin geniza detanya vesamo benachat vesamo kullo vesamo shello yefazzer

Rabbi yehuda omer en biur vechu tanya amar rabbi yehuda en biur chametz ella serefa vehaddin noten uma notar sheeno beval yerae uval yimmatze taun serefa chametz sheyyeshno beval yerae uval yimmatze lo kol shekken shettaun serefa
Amru lo kol din sheatta dan techillato lehachmir vesofo lehakel eno din lo matza etzim lesorfo yehe yoshev uvatel vehattora amra tashbitu seor mibbattechem bechol davar sheatta yachol lehashbito
Chazar rabbi yehuda vedano din acher notar asur baachila vechametz asur baachila ma notar bisrefa af chametz bisrefa
Amru lo nevela tochiach sheasura baachila veenah teuna serefa amar lahen hefresh notar asur baachila uvahanaa vechametz asur baachila uvahanaa ma notar taun serefa af chametz taun serefa

Amru lo shor hanniskal yochiach sheasur baachila uvahanaa veeno taun serefa amar lahen hefresh notar asur baachila uvahanaa veanush karet vechametz asur baachila uvahanaa veanush karet ma notar bisrefa af chametz bisrefa amru lo chelbo shel shor hanniskal yochiach sheasur baachila uvahanaa veanush karet veen taun serefa

a: Chazar rabbi yehuda vedano din acher notar yeshno beval totiru vechametz beval totiru ma notar bisrefa af chametz bisrefa
Amru lo asham taluy vechattat haof habba al hassafek lidvarecha yochichu shehen beval totiru sheanu omrim bisrefa veatta omer bikvura shatak rabbi yehuda
Amar rav yosef hayenu deamri inashe kappa dachata naggara begavah nisrof chardela
Amar abbaye saddana besaddane yetev middevil yedeh mishtallem
Rava amar giraa begireh mikketil middevil yedeh mishtallem

Vachachamim omrim mefarer vezore vechu ibaya lehu hechi kaamar mefarer vezore laruach umfarer umetil layyam o dilma mefarer vezore laruach aval metil layyam beeneh tenan name gabbe avoda zara ki hay gavena rabbi yose omer shochek vezore laruach o metil layyam veibaya lehu hechi kaamar shochek vezore laruach veshochek umetil layyam o dilma shochek vezore laruach aval metil layyam beeneh

Amar rabba mistabbera avoda zara dilyam hammelach ka azla la bae shechika chametz delishar neharot kaazel bae perur amar leh rav yosef adderabba ipcha mistabbera avoda zara dela mimmisa bae shechika chametz demimmis la bae perur

Tanya keoteh derabba tanya keoteh derav yosef tanya keoteh derabba haya mehallech bammidbar mefarer vezore laruach haya mehallech bisfina mefarer umetil layyam tanya keoteh derav yosef haya mehallech bammidbar shochek vezore laruach haya mehallech bisfina shochek umetil layyam
Shechika kashya lerabba perur kashya lerav yosef shechika lerabba la kashya ha leyam hammelach ha lishar neharot perur lerav yosef la kashya ha bechite ha benahama
Matni chametz shel goy sheavar alav happesach muttar bahanaa veshel yisrael asur bahanaa shenneemar lo yerae lecha seor

Gema manni matnitin la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi shimon vela rabbi yose haggelili may hi detanya chametz ben lifne zemanno ben leachar zemanno over alav belav toch zemanno over alav belav vecharet divre rabbi yehuda
b: Rabbi shimon omer chametz lifne zemanno ulachar zemanno eno over alav belo kelum toch zemanno over alav becharet uvlav umishshaa sheasur baachila asur bahanaa atan letanna kamma rabbi yose haggelili omer temah al atzmecha heach chametz asur bahanaa kol shiva
Uminnayin laochel chametz mishshesh shaot ulmala shehu over belo taase shenneemar lo tochal alav chametz divre rabbi yehuda

Amar lo rabbi shimon vechi efshar lomar ken vahalo kevar neemar lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot im ken ma talmud lomar lo tochal alav chametz beshaa sheyyeshno bekum echol matztza yeshno beval tochal chametz uvshaa sheeno bekum echol matztza eno beval tochal chametz
May tama derabbi yehuda telata kerae ketivi lo yeachel chametz vechol machmetzet lo tochelu lo tochal alav chametz chad lifne zemanno vechad leachar zemanno vechad letoch zemanno
Verabbi shimon chad letoch zemanno vechol machmetzet mibbee leh lechidtanya en li ella shennitchammetz meelav mechamat davar acher minnayin talmud lomar kol machmetzet lo tochelu
Lo yeachel chametz mibe leh lechidtanya rabbi yose haggelili omer minnayin lefesach mitzrayim sheen chimutzo noheg ella yom echad talmud lomar lo yeachel chametz usmich leh hayyom attem yotzim
Verabbi yehuda mechamat davar acher mena leh middeappekeh rachamana bilshon machmetzet
Derabbi yose haggelili mena leh i baet ema middismich leh hayyom i baet ema semuchin la daresh

Amar mar uminnayin leochel chametz mishshesh shaot ulmala shehu over belo taase shenneemar lo tochal alav chametz divre rabbi yehuda amar lo rabbi shimon vechi efshar lomar ken vahalo kevar neemar lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot
Verabbi yehuda shappir kaamar leh rabbi shimon verabbi yehuda amar lach hahu lekovo chova afilu bazzeman hazze hu daata

Verabbi shimon lekovo chova mena leh nafka leh mibbaerev tochlu verabbi yehuda mibe leh letame veshehaya bederech rechoka salka datach amena hoil uvfesach lo yochal matztza umaror name la nechol ka mashma lan

Verabbi shimon tame veshehaya bederech rechoka la itzterich kera dela gara mearel uven nechar dichtiv vechol arel lo yochal bo bo hu eno ochel aval ochel hu bematztza uvmaror verabbi yehuda ketiv behay uchtiv behay
Manni matnitin i rabbi yehuda chametz setama kaamar afilu degoy vei rabbi shimon

a: Deyisrael name mishre ka share vei rabbi yose haggelili afilu toch zemanno name mishre ka share bahanaa

Amar rav acha bar yaakov leolam rabbi yehuda hi veyalef seor daachila misseor diriyya ma seor diriyya shellecha i atta roe aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoha af seor daachila shellecha i atta ochel aval atta ochel shel acherim veshel gavoha

Uvdin hu deibi leh lemitne daafilu baachila name shere veayede ditna deyisrael asur bahanaa tena name degoy muttar bahanaa uvdin hu deibi leh lemitne daafilu betoch zemanno muttar bahanaa veayede ditna deyisrael leachar zemanno tena name degoy leachar zemanno
Rava amar leolam rabbi shimon hi verabbi shimon kenasa kanes hoil veavar aleh beval yerae uval yimmatze
Bishlama lerava hayenu dekatane shel yisrael asur mishshum shenneemar lo yerae ella lerav acha bar yaakov mishshum lo yeachel chametz mibe leh

Mi savratte assefa kae aresha kae vehachi kaamar chametz shel goy sheavar alav happesach muttar bahanaa mishshum shenneemar lo yerae lecha shellecha i atta roe aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoha veyalef seor daachila misseor diriyya
Veazdu letamayehu deitmar haochel seor shel goy sheavar alav happesach ledivre rabbi yehuda rava amar loke verav acha bar yaakov amar eno loke
Rava amar loke la yalef rabbi yehuda seor daachila misseor diriyya verav acha bar yaakov amar eno loke yalef seor daachila misseor diriyya
Vahadar beh rav acha bar yaakov mehahi detanya haochel chametz shel hekdesh bammoed maal veyesh omrim lo maal
Man yesh omrim amar rabbi yochanan rabbi nechunya ben hakkana hi detanya rabbi nechunya ben hakkana haya ose et yom hakkippurim kashshabbat letashlumin
Ma shabbat mitchayyev benafsho ufatur min hattashlumin af yom hakkippurim mitchayyev benafsho ufatur mittashlumin
Rav yosef amar befodin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim kamipalgi
Man deamar maal kasavar podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim uman deamar lo maal kasavar en podin
Rav acha bar rava tena lah
b: Leha shemata mishshemeh derav yosef beha lishana dechulle alma en podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim vehacha beha kamipalgi bedavar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame
Man deamar maal kasavar davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame uman deamar lo maal kasavar davar haggorem lemamon lav kemamon dame
Rav acha bar yaakov amar dechulle alma davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame vehacha biflugta derabbi yehuda verabbi shimon kamipalgi man deamar lo maal kerabbi yehuda uman deamar maal kerabbi shimon
Veha rav acha bar yaakov hu deamar derabbi yehuda yalef seor daachila misseor diriyya ella hadar beh rav acha bar yaakov mehahi
Rav ashe amar dechulle alma en podin vedavar haggorem lemamon lav kemamon dame vehacha biflugta derabbi yose haggelili verabbanan kamipalgi man deamar maal kerabbi yose uman deamar lo maal kerabbanan
Amar rav chametz bizmanno ben bemino ben shello bemino asur shello bizmanno bemino asur shello bemino muttar
Bemay askinan ilema benoten taam shello bizmanno shello bemino muttar ha yehev tama
Ella bemashshehu chametz bizmanno ben bemino ben shello bemino asur rav letameh derav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kol isurin shebbattora bemino bemashshehu shello bemino benoten taam
Rav gazar chametz bizmanno shello bemino attu mino veshello bizmanno bemino asur kerabbi yehuda
Veshello bemino muttar deshello bizmanno veshello bemino attu mino kulle hay la gazrinan

Shemuel amar chametz bizmanno bemino asur shello bemino muttar shello bizmanno ben bemino ben shello bemino muttar chametz bizmanno bemino asur shemuel letameh derav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kol isurin shebbattora bemino asurin bemashshehu shello bemino benoten taam
Shello beminan attu minan la gazar shello bizmanno ben beminan ben shello beminan muttarin kerabbi shimon
Verabbi yochanan amar chametz bizmanno ben bemino uven shello bemino asur benoten taam shello bizmanno ben beminan ben shello beminan muttar

Chametz bizmanno ben bemino ben shello bemino benoten taam rabbi yochanan letameh derabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu kol isurin shebbattora ben beminan ben shello beminan benoten taam shello bizmanno ben bemino ben shello bemino muttarin kerabbi shimon

a: Amar rava hilcheta chametz bizmanno ben bemino ben shello bemino asur bemashshehu kerav shello bizmanno ben bemino ben shello bemino muttar kerabbi shimon
Umi amar rava hachi vehaamar rava rabbi shimon kenasa kanes hoil veavar alav beval yerae uval yimmatze
Hane mile beeneh aval al yede taarovet la veazda rava letameh deamar rava ki havenan be rav nachman ki hao nafki shiva yome defischa amar lan puku uzvinu chamira divne chela
Amar rav kederot bappesach yishshavru veammay lashhinhu achar happesach velebad behu shello beminan gezera dilma atu lemebad behu bemino
Ushmuel amar lo yishshavru aval mashhe lehu leachar zemanno veaved behu ben bemino ben shello bemino
Veazda shemuel letameh deamar shemuel lehanhu dimzabbene kande asho zevine akkandayechi vei la darshina lechu kerabbi shimon
Velidrosh lehu deha shemuel kerabbi shimon sevira leh atreh derav hava
Hahu tannura ditcho beh tichya asreh rava bar ahilay lemechleh lerifta afilu bemilcha leolam dilma ate lemechleh bechuttacha
Metivi en lashin et haisa bechalav veim lash kol happat kullah asura mippene hergel avera kayyotze vo
b: En tashin et hattannur bealya veim tash kol happat kullah asura ad sheyyassik et hattannur ha hussak hattannur miha shere teuvta derava bar ahilay teuvta
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe vechi meachar deitotav rava bar ahilay ammay kaamar rav kederot bappesach yishshavru amar leh hatam tannur shel mattechet hacha bikdera shel cheres
Veibaet ema ha veha beshel cheres ze hessekan mibbifnim veze hessekan mibbachutz vechi tema hachi name lebad leh hassaka mibbifnim chayes aleh mishshum defaka
Hilkach hay buchya hesseko mibbachutz hu veasur vei malleyeh gumre shappir dame

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe hane sakkine befischa hechi avdinan lehu amar leh ledidi chadta ka avdinan amar leh tinach mar deefshar leh dela efshar leh may amar leh ana keen chadta kaamena kattayehu betina ufarzelayehu benura vahadar meayyelna lekattayehu berotchin vehilcheta ide veide berotchin uvichli rishon
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua etz parur magilo berotchin uvichli rishon kasavar kevolo kach polto

Beo mineh meammemar hane mane dekunya mahu leishtammoshe behu befischa yerukka la tibe lach devadday asiri ki tibe lach ukkame vechivare may vehecha deit behu kartufane la tibe lach devadday asiri ki tibe lach deshii may
Amar leh chazena lehu demidayete alma bali vaasiri vehattora heida al keli cheres sheeno yotze mide dofo leolam

Umay shena leinyan yen nesech dedaresh marimar mane dekunya ben ukkame ben chivare uven yerukke shere vechi tema yen nesech derabbanan chametz deorayeta kol detakkun rabbanan keen deorayeta takkun amar leh ze tashmisho al yede chammin veze tashmisho al yede tzonen

Amar rava bar abba amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar shemuel kol hakkelim shennishtammeshu bahen chametz betzonen mishtammesh bahen matztza chutz min bet seor hoil shechimutzo kashe amar rav ashe uvet charoset kevet seor shechimutzo kashe dame
Amar rava hane aggane demachoza hoil utdiri lemelash behu chamira umshahu behu chamira kevet seor shechimutzo kashe dame peshita mahu detema kevan dirvicha shalet behu avera vela bali ka mashma lan
Matni goy shehilva et yisrael al chametzo achar happesach muttar bahanaa veyisrael shehilva et goy al chametzo achar happesach asur bahanaa
Gema itmar baal chov abbaye amar lemafrea hu gove verava amar mikkan ulhabba hu gove kol hecha deakdesh love vezabben love kulle alma la peligi deate malve vetaref

a: Veate malve ufarek ditnan mosif od dinar ufode et hannechasim haellu ki peligi dezabben malve vekaddesh malve

Abbaye amar lemafrea hu gove kevan dimta zimneh vela pareh igallay milta lemafrea demeikara birshuteh hava kae veshappir akdesh veshappir zabben verava amar mikkan ulhabba hu gove kevan deilu hao leh zuze hava mesallek lehu bezuze ishtechach dehashta ka kane
Umi amar rava hachi vehaamar rame bar chama reuven shemmachar sade leshimon beachraut uzkafan alav bemilve umet reuven vaata baal chov diruven vetaref leh mishshimon vaata shimon ufayeseh bezuze
Dina hu deatu bene reuven veamri leh leshimon anan mittaltele shevak avun gabbach umittaltele deyatme levaal chov la mishtabedi
Veamar rava i pikeach shimon magbe lehu ara vahadar gave lah minayehu deamar rav nachman yetomim sheggavu karka bechovat avihem baal chov chozer vegove otah mehen

I amratte bishlama lemafrea hu gove ammetu lehachi chozer vegove otah mehen dichman degavu mechayyim daavuhon dame ella i amratte mikkan ulhabba hu gove ammay chozer vegove otah mehen ha have keman dizven yatme nichse dame veilu kane yatme nichse mi ka mishtabedi levaal chov

Shane hatam deamar lehu ki hechi demishtabadna leh laavuchon mishtabadna name levaal chov daavuchon midderabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane vachavero bachavero shemmotziin mizze venotnin laze talmud lomar venatan laasher asham lo
Tenan goy shehilva et yisrael al chametzo achar happesach muttar bahanaa i amratte bishlama lemafrea hu gove ammetu lehachi muttar bahanaa
Ella i amratte mikkan ulhabba hu gove ammay muttar bahanaa birshuta deyisrael hava kae hacha bemay askinan keshehirhino etzlo
Lema ketannae yisrael shehilva legoy al chametzo leachar happesach eno over mishshum rabbi meir amru over may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar lemafrea hu gove umar savar mikkan ulhabba hu gove
Vetisbera ema sefa aval goy shehilva leyisrael al chametzo leachar happesach divre hakkol over veha ipcha mibe leh leman deamar hatam eno over hacha over leman deamar hatam over hacha eno over
b: Ella hacha bemay askinan kegon shehirhino etzlo vekamipalgi bidrabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak minnayin levaal chov shekkone mashkon shenneemar ulcha tihye tzedaka im eno kone mashkon tzedaka minnayin mikkan levaal chov shekkone mashkon
Tanna kamma savar hane mile yisrael miyyisrael hu dekarena beh ulcha tihye tzedaka aval yisrael miggoy la kane
Verabbi meir savar kal vachomer yisrael miyyisrael kane yisrael miggoy lo kol shekken aval goy shehilva et yisrael al chametzo achar happesach divre hakkol over hatam vadday goy miyyisrael la kane
Tenan goy shehilva yisrael al chametzo achar happesach muttar bahanaa nehi name dehirhino etzlo ha amratte goy miyyisrael la kane la kashya ha deamar leh meachshav ha dela amar leh meachshav

Vmna temra deshane leh ben hecha deamar meachshav uven hecha dela amar meachshav detanya goy shehirhin pat purni etzel yisrael eno over veim amar lo higgaticha over may shena resha umay shena sefa ella lav shema minah shane hecha deamar leh meachshav lehecha dela amar leh meachshav shema minah

Tanu rabbanan chanut shel yisrael umlay shel yisrael ufoale goyim nichnasin lesham chametz shennimtza sham achar happesach asur bahanaa veen tzarich lomar baachila chanut shel goy umlay shel goy ufoale yisrael nichnasin veotzin lesham chametz shennimtza sham achar happesach muttar baachila veen tzarich lomar bahanaa
Matni chametz shennafla alav mappolet hare hu kimvoar rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol sheen hakkelev yachol lechappes acharav
Gema amar rav chisda vetzarich sheyevattel belibbo tana kamma chafisat hakkelev shelosha tefachim

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe ha deamar shemuel kesafim en lahem shemira ella bakkarka mi baenan shelosha tefachim o la amar leh hacha mishshum recha baenan shelosha tefachim hatam mishshum ikassoye meena hu vela bae shelosha vechamma amar rafram bar pappa missichra tefach
Matni haochel terumat chametz bappesach beshogeg meshallem keren vachomesh bemezid patur mittashlumin umiddeme etzim
Gema tenan hatam haochel teruma beshogeg meshallem keren vachomesh echad haochel veechad hashshote

a: Veechad hassach echad teruma temea veechad teruma tehora meshallem chomesh vechumsha dechumsha

Ibaya lehu keshehu meshallem lefi midda meshallem o lefi damim meshallem kol hecha demeikara shaveya arbea zuze ulvassof shaveya zuza la tibe lach devadday kidmeikara meshallem lefi damim dela gara miggazlan ditnan kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela
Ki tibe lach demeikara shaveya zuza ulvassof shaveya arbea may lefi midda meshallem deamar leh geriva achal geriva meshallem o dilma lefi damim meshallem bezuza achal bezuza meshallem

Amar rav yosef ta shema achal gerogrot veshilem lo temarim tavo alav beracha i amratte bishlama lefi midda meshallem ammetu lehachi tavo alav beracha deachel geriva digrogrot deshaveya zuza veka yahev geriva ditmarim deshaveya arbea ella i amratte lefi damim meshallem ammay tavo alav beracha bezuza achal bezuza ka meshallem
Amar abbaye leolam lefi damim meshallem veammay tavo alav beracha daachal mide dela kafetz aleh zavoneh veka meshallem mide dekafetz aleh zavoneh

Tenan haochel terumat chametz bappesach beshogeg meshallem keren vachomesh i amratte bishlama lefi midda meshallem shappir ella i amratte lefi damim meshallem chametz bappesach bar damim hu in ha manni rabbi yose haggelili hi deamar chametz bappesach muttar bahanaa
I hachi ema sefa bemezid patur min hattashlumin umiddeme etzim i rabbi yose haggelili ammay patur min hattashlumin umiddeme etzim
Savar lah kerabbi nechunya ben hakkana detanya rabbi nechunya ben hakkana haya ose et yom hakkippurim kashshabbat letashlumin vechu

Ketannae haochel terumat chametz bappesach patur min hattashlumin umiddeme etzim divre rabbi akiva rabbi yochanan ben nuri mechayyev amar lo rabbi akiva lerabbi yochanan ben nuri vechi ma hanaa yesh lo bah amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri lerabbi akiva uma hanaa yesh laochel teruma temea bishar kol yemot hashshana shemmeshallem

Amar lo lo im amarta bitruma temea bishar yemot hashshana sheaf al pi sheen lo bah heter achila yesh lo bah heter hassaka tomar baze sheen lo bah lo heter achila velo heter hassaka ha lema ze dome litrumat tutim vaanavim shennitmea sheen lo bah lo heter achila velo heter hassaka
Bamme devarim amurim bemafrish teruma vehechemitza aval mafrish terumat chametz divre hakkol enah kedosha

Tanya idach venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh davar harauy lihot kodesh perat laochel terumat chametz bappesach sheppatur min hattashlumim umiddeme etzim divre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbi elazar chassama mechayyev amar lo rabbi eliezer ben yaakov lerabbi elazar chassama vechi ma hanaa yesh lo bah amar lo rabbi elazar chassama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov vechi ma hanaa yesh lo laochel teruma temea bishar yemot hashshana shemmeshallem

Amar lo lo im amarta bitruma temea bishar yemot hashshana sheaf al pi sheen lo bah heter achila yesh lo bah heter hassaka tomar bazo sheen lo bah lo heter achila velo heter hassaka amar lo af bezo yesh lo bah heter hassaka sheim ratza hakkohen meritzah lifne kalbo o massikah tachat tavshilo
b: Amar abbaye rabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbi akiva verabbi yochanan ben nuri kullehu sevira lehu chametz bappesach asur bahanaa uvha peligi derabbi akiva savar lefi damim meshallem verabbi yochanan ben nuri savar lefi midda meshallem

Peshita mahu detema rabbi yochanan ben nuri name kerabbi akiva sevira leh deamar lefi damim meshallem vehatam hayenu tama deka mechayyev mishshum desavar lah kerabbi yose haggelili deamar chametz bappesach muttar bahanaa ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name im ken nahdar leh rabbi yochanan ben nuri lerabbi akiva ki hechi demahdar leh rabbi elazar chassama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov
Tanu rabbanan haochel kezayit teruma meshallem keren vachomesh abba shaul omer ad sheyehe bo shave peruta may tama detanna kamma amar kera veish ki yochal kodesh bishgaga vaachila bichzayit
Veabba shaul may tama amar kera venatan veen netina pachot mishshave peruta veidach name ha ketiv yochal hahu perat lemazzik hu daata
Vetanna kamma hachtiv venatan hahu mibe leh ledavar harauy lihot kodesh perat laochel terumat chametz bappesach

Tanu rabbanan haochel teruma pachot mikkezayit meshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh hechi dame i delet beh shave peruta keren name la lishallem vei deit beh shave peruta chomesh name lishallem leolam deit beh shave peruta vaafilu hachi kevan delet beh kezayit meshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh

Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa ha dela keabba shaul dei keabba shaul haamar kevan sheyyesh bah shave peruta af al gav delet beh kezayit amar lehu rav pappa afilu tema abba shaul abba shaul tarte bae

Umi bae abba shaul tarte veha tenan abba shaul omer et sheyyesh bo shave peruta chayyav betashlumin et sheen bo shave peruta eno chayyav betashlumin amru lo lo amru shave peruta ella leinyan meila bilvad aval litruma eno chayyav ad sheyehe bo kezayit veim ita kevan sheyyesh bo kezayit mibe leh teuvta
Veaf rav pappa hadar beh detanya vechata bishgaga perat lemezid vahalo din hu uma shear mitzot shechayyav bahen karet poter bahen et hammezid meila sheen bah karet eno din sheppatar et hammezid
Lo im amarta bishar mitzot shekken lo chiyyev bahen mita tomar bimila shechiyyev bah mita talmud lomar bishgaga perat lemezid
Vaamar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav chiyya bar avin hay tanna meikara allima leh karet ulvassof allima leh mita

Vaamar leh hachi kaamar lo im amarta bishar mitzot shekken lo chiyyev bahen mita befachot mikkezayit tomar bimila shechiyyev bah mita befachot mikkezayit vaamar leh tanuach datecha shehinnachta et dati vaamar leh may nichuta derabba verav sheshet shadu beh narga man shamatte leh deamar

a: Hezid bimila bemita rabbi hi detanya hezid bimila rabbi omer bemita vachachamim omrim baazhara
May tama derabbi amar rabbi avahu gamar chet chet mitteruma ma teruma bemita af meila bemita
Uminah ma teruma bichzayit af meila bichzayit
Umatkif lah rav pappa mimmay derabbi kerabbanan sevira leh dilma keabba shaul sevira leh deamar yesh bah shave peruta af al gav delet bah kezayit
Veha rav pappa hu deamar deabba shaul tarte bae ella shema minah hadar beh

Mar bereh deravna amar hachi kaamar lo im amarta bishar mitzot shello asa bahen sheen mitkaven kemitkaven sheim nitkaven lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamchubbar sheppatur tomar bimila sheim nitkaven lehitchammem begize chullin venitchammem begize ola shemmaal

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar hachi kaamar lo im amarta bishar mitzot shekken lo mitchayyev bahen sheen mitassek kemitassek sheim nitkaven lehagbiha et hattalush vechatach et hamchubbar sheppatur tomar bimila sheim hoshit yado lichli litol chefetz vesach yado beshemen shel kodesh shemmaal
Amar mar bamme devarim amurim bemafrish teruma vehechmitza aval hifrish chametz teruma divre hakkol enah kedosha
Mena hane mile amar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar kera titten lo velo leuro

Metiv rav huna bereh derav yehoshua en tormin min hattemea lattehora veim taram beshogeg terumato teruma veammay lema lo velo leuro la kashya hatam hayeta lo sheat hakkosher hacha lo hayeta lo sheat hakkosher

Udlo hayeta lo sheat hakkosher hechi dame kegon deachmetz bimchubbar aval achmetz betalush hachi name dekadsha amar leh in bigzerat irin pitgama uvmemar kaddishin sheelta vechen morin beve midresha keoti
Ki ata rav huna bereh derav yehoshua
b: Amar amar kera reshit sheshsheyareha nikarin leyisrael yatzta zo sheen sheyareha nikarin

Yatev rav acha bar rav aveya kammeh derav chisda veyatev veamar mishshemeh derabbi yochanan anavim shennitmeu dorchan pachot pachot mikkevetza veyenan kasher linsachin alma kasavar mashkin mifkad pekidi leemat ka mitammei lechi sachet lehu lechi sachet lehu leteh leshiureh
I hachi kevetza name dehatnan teme met shessachat zetim vaanavim kevetza mechuvenet tehorin hatam dei avad hacha lechattechilla gezera dilma ate lemebad yoter mikkevetza
Amar leh rav chisda man tzayet lach ulrabbi yochanan rabbach vechi tuma shebbahen lehechan halcha alma ka savar mashkin mivla belii vechevan deitammo leh uchla itammo leh mashkin

Amar leh veatte la tisbera demashkin mifkad pekidi vehatnan teme met shessachat zetim vaanavim mechuvenet kevetza tehorin i amratte bishlama mifkad pekidi mishshum hachi tehorin ella i amratte mivla belii ammay tehorin

Amar leh hacha bemay askinan baanavim shello huchsheru leemat mittachsheri lechi sachet lehu ki sachet lehu betzir lehu shiura dei la tema hachi ha detanya ha lema ze dome litrumat tutin zetim vaanavim shennitmea sheen lo bah lo heter achila velo heter hassaka ha heter achila name it beh dei bae darech lehu pachot pachot mikkevetza

Amar rava gezera dilma ate behu lide takkala amar leh abbaye umi chayeshinan letakkala veha tanya madlikin befat uvshemen shel teruma shennitmet amar leh pat zarek leh ben haetzim shemen shel teruma rame leh bichli maus

Gufa madlikin befat uvshemen shel teruma shennitmet abbaye amar mishshemeh dechizkiyya verava amar deve rabbi yitzchak bar marta amar rav huna lo shanu ella pat aval chite lo shemma yavo bahen lide takkala verabbi yochanan amar afilu chite veammay nechush dilma ate bahen lide takkala kidamar rav ashe

a: Bishlikata umisata hachi name bishlikata umisata vehecha itmar derav ashe aha deamar rabbi avin bar rav acha amar rabbi yitzchak abba shaul gabbal shel bet rabbi haya vehau mechammin lo chammin bechitin shel teruma temea lalush bahen isa betohora ammay nechush dilma ate behu lide takkala amar rav ashe bishlikata umisata

Abbaye bar avin verav chananya bar avin tanu terumot be rabba pega behu rava bar matna amar lehu may amritu bitrumot deve mar amaru leh umay kashya lach amar lehu tenan shetile terumot shennitmeu ushtalan tehorim milletamme vaasurin milleechol bitruma vechi meachar dithorin milletamme ammay asurin milleechol
Amaru leh hachi amar rabba may asurin asurin lezarim umay ka mashma lan gidule teruma teruma tenena gidule teruma teruma

Vechi tema gidule gidulin umay ka mashma lan bedavar sheen zaro kale ha name tenena hattevel gidulav muttarin bedavar shezzaro kale aval bedavar sheen zaro kale afilu gidule gidulin asurin baachila ishtiku
Amaru leh mide shemia lach beha amar lehu hachi amar rav sheshet may asurin asurin lechohanim hoil veipsilu lehu behesach haddaat
Hanicha leman deamar hesach haddaat pesul hagguf have shappir ella leman deamar hesach haddaat pesul tuma have may ika lememar
Deittemar hesach haddaat rabbi yochanan amar pesul tuma have verabbi shimon ben lakish amar pesul hagguf have
Rabbi yochanan amar pesul tuma have sheim yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna shomin lo rabbi shimon ben lakish omer pesul hagguf have sheim yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna en shomin lo

Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer lul katan haya ben kevesh lammizbeach bemaaravo shel kevesh sheshsham hau zorkin pesule chattat haof utubbar tzuratan veotzin levet hasserefa i amratte bishlama pesul tuma have mishshum hachi bae ibur tzura shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna ella i amratte pesul hagguf lema li ibur tzura vehatnan ze hakkelal
b: Kol sheppesulo begufo yissaref miyyad baddam uvabbealim teubbar tzuratan veotzin levet hasserefa amar leh hay tanna tanna deve rabba bar avuh hu deamar afilu pigul taun ibur tzura
Etiveh nitma o shennifsal habbasar o sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim rabbi eliezer omer yizrok rabbi yehoshua omer lo yizrok umode rabbi yehoshua sheim zarak hurtza
May nifsal lav behesach haddaat i amratte bishlama pesule tuma have hayenu demashkachatte lah dimratztze tzitz ella i amratte pesul hagguf have ammay hurtza tzitz
May nifsal nifsal bitvul yom i hachi hayenu tame tere gavene tame

Ki selek ravin amrah lishmateh kammeh derabbi yirmeya vaamar bavlae tafshae mishshum deyatvi beara dachashocha amritun shematata dimchashshechu la shemia lechu ha derabbi shimon ben lakish mishshemeh derabbi oshaya
Me hachag shennitmeu hishshikan veachar kach hikdishan tehorin hikdishan veachar kach hishshikan temeim
Mikkede zeria ninhu ma li hishshikan veachar kach hikdishan ma li hikdishan veachar kach hishshikan alma en zeria lehekdesh hacha name en zeria litruma
Yatev rav dimi vekaamar lah leha shemata amar leh abbaye hikdishan bichli kaamar aval bappe la avud rabbanan maala o dilma bappe name avud rabbanan maala

Amar leh zo lo shamati kayyotze bah shamati deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan anavim shennitmeu derachan veachar kach hikdishan tehorim hikdishan veachar kach derachan temein veha anavim dikdushshat pe ninhu vaafilu hachi avud rabbanan maala
Amar rav yosef anavim kaamratte hacha baanavim shel teruma askinan dikdushshat pe didhu kikdushshat keli damya aval hane devae keli bappe la avud rabbanan maala
Derachan vaafilu tuva umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan anavim shennitmeu dorchan pachot pachot mikkevetza
Ibaet ema hacha name pachot pachot mikkevetza veibaet ema hatam denagu lehu berishon dehau lehu inhu sheni hacha denagu besheni dehau lehu shelishi
Amar rava af anan name tenena venatan alav mayim chayyim el keli shettehe chiyyutan bichli venatan alma telushin ninhu veha mechubbarin ninhu

a: Ella maala hachi name maala
Amar rav shimi bar ashe af anan name tenena taval veala ochel bemaaser heeriv shimsho ochel bitruma bitruma in bekadashim la ammay tahor hu ella maala hachi name maala
Amar rav ashe af anan name tenena vehabbasar lerabbot et haetzim ulvona etzim ulvona bene itammoye ninhu ella maala hacha name maala

Matni ellu devarim sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach bechittim bisorim bechussemin uvshifon uvshibolet shual veotzin bidmay uvmaaser rishon shennittela terumato uvmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu vehakkohanim bachalla uvatteruma
Aval lo betevel velo bemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato velo bemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu challot hattoda urkike nazir asaan leatzmo en yotze bahen asaan limkor bashshuk yotzin bahen
Gema tana kussemin min chitin shibolet shual veshifon min seorin kussemin gulba shifon dishra shibolet shual shuvle taala hane in orez vedochan la

Menahane mile amar rabbi shimon ben lakish vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael vechen tana deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov amar kera lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot devarim habbaim lide chimutz adam yotze bahen yede chovato bematztza yatzu ellu sheen bain lide chimutz ella lide sirchon
Matnitin dela kerabbi yochanan ben nuri deamar orez min dagan hu vechayyavin al chimutzo karet detanya rabbi yochanan ben nuri oser beorez vedochan mippene shekkarov lehachmitz
Ibaya lehu shekkarov lehachmitz dekadem umachmitz o dilma karov lehachmitz have chametz gamur la have
Ta shema detanya amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri orez min dagan hu vechayyavin al chimutzo karet veadam yotze bo yede chovato bappesach
Vechen haya rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer karmit chayyevet bechalla may karmit amar abbaye shetznita may shetznita amar rav pappa shetznita demishtachcha bene kallanyata

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish isa shennilosha beyayin veshemen udvash en chayyavin al chimutzah karet yatev rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua kammeh derav idi bar avin veyatev rav idi bar avin veka menamnem amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa may tama deresh lakish

Amar leh deamar kera lo tochal alav chametz vego devarim sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bematztza chayyavin al chimutzo karet veha hoil veen adam yotze bah yede chovato dehaveya lah matztza ashira en chayyavin al chimutzah karet

Etiveh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa himchahu ugmao im chametz hu anush karet veim matztza hu en adam yotze yede chovato bappesach veha hacha deen adam yotze yede chovato bematztza vechayyavin al chimutzo karet
Itar behu rav idi bar avin amar lehu dardeke hayenu tama deresh lakish mishshum dehau lehu me ferot
b: Ume ferot en machmitzin
Yotze bidmay uvmaaser vechu demay ha la chaze leh kevan dei bae mafkar lenichseh have ani veochel demay hashta name chaze leh
Ditnan maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet achsanya demay veamar rav huna tana bet shammay omrim en maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet haachsanya demay uvet hillel omrim maachilin
Maaser rishon shennittela terumato vechu peshita dechevan shennittela terumato chullin have
La tzericha shehikdimo beshibolim venittela hemennu terumat maaser velo nittela hemennu teruma gedola vechidrabbi avahu

Deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi shimon ben lakish maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibolim patur mitteruma gedola shenneemar vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai maaser min hammaaser maaser min hammaaser amarti lecha velo teruma gedola utrumat maaser min hammaaser
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye ella meatta afilu hikdimo bichri name liptar amar leh alecha amar kera mikkol mattenotechem tarimu et kol terumat Adonai
Uma raita hay idgan vehay la idgan
Maaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu vechu peshita hacha bemay askinan shennatan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh veka mashma lan deen chomesh meakkev
Vehakkohanim bechalla uvitruma vechu peshita mahu detema matztza shava lechol adam baenan ka mashma lan matztzot matztzot riba
Aval lo betevel vechu peshita la tzericha betevel tavul midderabbanan shezzerao beatzitz sheeno nakuv
Velo bemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato peshita la tzericha shehikdimo bichri
Mahu detema kedaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye ka mashma lan kidshanni leh
Velo bemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu vechu peshita
Leolam denifdu umay lo nifdu shello nifdu kehilchatan maaser sheni sheppedao al gav asimon derachamana amar vetzarta hakkesef davar sheyyesh lo tzura
Vehekdesh shechillo al gabbe karka derachamana amar venatan hakkesef vekam lo
Tanu rabbanan yachol yotze adam yede chovato betevel shello nitkan kol tevel name ha lo nitkan
Ella betevel shello nitkan kol tzorko shennittela mimmennu teruma gedola velo nittela mimmennu terumat maaser maaser rishon velo maaser sheni vaafilu masar ani minnayin
Talmud lomar lo tochal alav chametz mi sheisuro mishshum bal tochal alav chametz yatza ze sheen isuro mishshum bal tochal chametz ella mishshum bal tochal tevel
Veisura dechametz lehechan azala amar rav sheshet ha manni rabbi shimon hi deamar en isur chal al isur detanya rabbi shimon omer

a: Haochel nevela beom hakkippurim patur
Ravina amar afilu tema rabbanan mi sheisuro mishshum bal tochal chametz bilvad yatza ze sheen isuro mishshum bal tochal chametz bilvad ella af mishshum bal tochal tevel
Mide bilvad ketiv ella mechavarta kidrav sheshet
Tanu rabbanan yachol yotze adam yede chovato bemaaser sheni birushalayim talmud lomar lechem oni ma shenneechal baaninut yatza ze sheeno neechal baaninut ella besimcha divre rabbi yose haggelili
Rabbi akiva omer matztzot matztzot riba im ken ma talmud lomar lechem oni perat leisa shennilosha beyayin veshemen udvash
May tama derabbi akiva mi ketiv lechem oni ani ketiv
Verabbi yose haggelili mi karenan ani oni karenan verabbi akiva hay dekarenan beh oni kedishmuel deamar shemuel lechem oni lechem sheonin alav devarim harbe

Vesavar rabbi akiva isa shennilosha beyayin veshemen udvash la vehatanya en lashin isa bappesach beyayin veshemen udvash veim lash rabban gamliel omer tissaref miyyad vachachamim omrim yeachel veamar rabbi akiva shabbatti hayeta etzel rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua velashti lahem isa beyayin veshemen udvash velo amru li davar
Veaf al pi sheen lashin mekattefin bo atan letanna kamma vachachamim omrim et shellashin bo mekattefin bo veet sheen lashin bo en mekattefin bo veshavin sheen lashin et haisa befoshrin
La kashya ha beom tov rishon ha beom tov sheni

Kedaamar lehu rabbi yehoshua livneh yoma kamma la telushu li bachalava mikkan veelach lushu li bachalava vehatanya en lashin et haisa bechalav veim lash kol happat asura mippene hergel avera ella hachi kaamar yoma kamma la telushu li beduvsha mikkan veelach lushu li beduvsha
Veibaet ema leolam bachalava kedaamar ravina keen tora shere hacha name keen tora
Veshavin sheen lashin et haisa befoshrin may shena mimmenachot ditnan kol hammenachot niloshot befoshrin umishtammerin shello yechmetzu im amru bizrizin yomru besheen zerizin
I hachi miltat name latet allema amar rabbi zera amar rabba bar yirmeya amar shemuel chitin shel menachot en lottin otah lisha bizrizin ita letita leta bizrizin
Velisha mi ita bizrizin vehachtiv veyatzak aleha shemen vego veheviah el hakkohen mikkemitza veelach mitzvat kehunna limed al yetzika uvlila shekkeshera bechol adam
Lisha nehi devizrizin leta bimkom zerizin ita deamar mar belila keshera bezar chutz lechomat azara pesula leappoke letita deenah bizrizin vela bimkom zerizin
Umay shena mimminchat haomer detanya minchat haomer lottin otah vetzovrin otah tzibur shane

Tanu rabbanan yachol yotze adam yede chovato bevikkurim talmud lomar bechol moshvotechem tochlu matztzot matztza hanneechelet bechol moshvotechem yatzu bikkurim sheen neechalin bechol moshvotechem ella birushalayim divre rabbi yose haggelili
Rabbi akiva omer matztza umaror ma maror sheeno bikkurim af matztza sheenah bikkurim i ma maror sheen bemino bikkurim af matztza sheen beminah bikkurim
b: Otzi chitin usorin sheyyesh beminan bikurim talmud lomar matztzot matztzot riba i matztzot matztzot riba afilu bikurim name hadar beh rabbi akiva

Detanya yachol yetze adam yede chovato bevikurim talmud lomar bechol moshvotechem tochlu matztzot matztza hanneechelet bechol moshavot yatzu bikurim sheenan neechalin bechol moshavot ella birushalayim yachol sheani motzi af maaser sheni talmud lomar matztzot matztzot riba
Uma raita lerabbot maaser sheni ulhotzi bikurim merabbe ani maaser sheni sheyyesh lo heter bechol moshavot kidrabbi eliezer umotzi ani bikurim sheen lahen heter bechol moshavot
Deamar rabbi eliezer minyan lemaaser sheni shennitma sheppodin oto afilu birushalayim talmud lomar ki lo tuchal seeto
Veen seet ella achila shenneemar vayyissa masot meet panav
Man shamatte leh deamar bemaaser sheni nafek beh rabbi akiva vekammaet lehu levikurim mibbechol moshvotechem shema minah hadar beh
Verabbi yose haggelili tipok leh millechem oni mi shenneechal beoni yatza ze sheen neechal ella besimcha
Savar leh kerabbi shimon detanya bikurim asurin leonen verabbi shimon mattir
May tama derabbanan dichtiv lo tuchal leechol bisharecha veamar mar terumat yadecha ellu bikurim deitakkash bikurim lemaaser ma maaser asur leonen af bikurim asur leonen
Verabbi shimon teruma kerinhu rachamana kitruma ma teruma mutteret leonen af bikurim muttar leonen
Verabbi shimon nehi dehekesh let leh simcha miha michtav ketiva behu dichtiv vesamachta vechol hattov
Hahu lizman simcha hu daata ditnan meatzeret vead hachag mevi vekore mehachag vead chanukka mevi veeno kore

Tanu rabbanan lechem oni perat lechalut velaashisha yachol lo yetze adam yede chovato ella befat hadraa talmud lomar matztzot matztzot riba vaafilu kematztzot shel shelomo im ken ma talmud lomar lechem oni perat lechalut velaashisha
Umay mashma dehay ashisha lishana dachashivuta dichtiv vayechallek lechol haam lechol hamon yisrael lemeish vead ishsha leish challat lechem achat veeshpar echad vaashisha echat vego
Veamar rav chanan bar abba eshpar echad mishshishsha bappar ashisha echad mishshishsha baefa vfliga dishmuel deamar shemuel ashisha garba dechamra dichtiv veohave ashishe anavim
Tanu rabbanan en ofin pat ava beom tov bappesach divre bet shammay

a: Uvet hillel mattirin vechamma pat ava amar rav huna tefach shekken matzinu belechem happanim tefach
Matkef lah rav yosef im amru bizrizin yomru besheenan zerizin im amru befat amila yomru befat sheenah amila
Im amru beetzim yeveshin yomru beetzim lachim im amru betannur cham yomru betannur tzonen im amru betannur shel mattechet yomru betannur shel cheres

Amar rav yirmeya bar abba sheelit et rabbi beyichud umannu rav ika deamri rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav sheelit et rabbi beyichud umannu rabbenu hakkadosh may pat ava pat merubba veammay karu leh pat ava mishshum dinfisha belisha vei baet ema beatreh dehay tanna lefat merubba pat ava karu leh
May tama i mishshum deka tarach tircha dela tzerich may irya befesach afilu beom tov name
In hachi name vehay tanna beom tov shel pesach kae tanya name hachi bet shammay omrim en ofin pat ava beom tov uvet hillel mattirin

Tanu rabbanan yotzin befat nekiyya uvhadraa uvisrikin hamtzuyyarin bappesach af al pi sheamru en osin serikin hamtzuyyarin bappesach amar rav yehuda davar ze shaal bayetos ben zonin lachachamim mippene ma amru en osin serikin hamtzuyyarin bappesach amru lo mippene shehaishsha shoha aleha umchammatztah
Amar lahem efshar yaasenna bidfus veyikbaenna kevan amru lo yomru kol hasserikin asurin usrike bayetos muttarin

Amar rabbi elazar bar tzadok paam achat nichnasti achar abba levet rabban gamliel veheviu lefanav serikin hamtzuyyarin bappesach amarti abba lo kach amru chachamim en osin serikin hamtzuyyarin bappesach amar li beni lo shel kol adam amru ella shel nachtomin amru
Ika deamri hachi kaamar leh lo shel nachtomin amru ella shel kol adam amar rabbi yose osin serikin kemin rekikin veen osin serikin kemin geluskaot
Tanu rabbanan hassufganin vehadduvshanin veiskeritin vechallat hammasret vehamdumma peturim min hachalla may challat hammasret amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi ze chalut shel baale vattim
Amar resh lakish hallalu maase ilpas hen verabbi yochanan amar maase ilpas chayyavin vehallalu sheasaan bachamma

Metivi hassufganin vehadduvshanin vehaiskeritin asaan beilpas chayyavin bachamma peturin teuvteh derabbi shimon ben lakish amar ulla amar lecha rabbi shimon ben lakish hacha bemay askinan shehirtiach ulvassof hidbik

Aval hidbik ulvassof hirtiach may hachi name difturin addetane sefa asaan bachamma peturin liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim kegon shehirtiach ulvassof hidbik aval hidbik ulvassof hirtiach peturin
Chassore mechassera vehachi katane bamme devarim amurim shehirtiach ulvassof hidbik aval hidbik ulvassof hirtiach naasa kemi sheasaan bachamma ufturin
Ta shema yotzin bematztza hina uvmatztza haasuya beilpas hacha name shehirtiach ulvassof hidbik
May matztza hina amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol shepporsah veen chutin nimshachin hemenna amar rava vechen lachme toda peshita hacha lechem ketiv vehacha lechem ketiv
Mahu detema hoil uchtiv vehikriv mimmennu
b: Echad mikkol korban echad shello yittol parus vehacha keman difrisa damya ka mashma lan

Metivi hammeisa bet shammay potrin uvet hillel mechayevin hachalita bet shammay mechayevin uvet hillel potrin ezehu hammeisa veezehu hachalita hammeisa kemach sheal gabbe muglashin hachalita muglashin sheal gabbe kemach
Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv ze vaze liftur veamri lah ze vaze lechiyyuv vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze asaan beilpas patur betannur chayyav

Vetanna kamma may shena hammeisa umay shena chalita amar rav yehuda amar shemuel vechen amar rav yehuda veitema rabbi yehoshua ben levi kemachaloket bezo kach machaloket bezo vetavra mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo

Katane mihat vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze sheasaan beilpas patur betannur chayyav teuvta derabbi yochanan amar lach rabbi yochanan tannae hi detanya yachol yehe meisa vachaluta chayyavin bachalla talmud lomar lechem
Rabbi yehuda omer en lechem ella haafuy betannur rabbi yehuda hayenu tanna kamma ella lav maase ilpas ika benayehu tanna kamma savar maase ilpas chayyavin verabbi yehuda savar maase ilpas peturin

La dechulle alma maase ilpas peturin vehacha kegon shechazar vaafao betannur ka mipalgi detanna kamma savar kevan shechazar vaafao betannur lechem karenan beh verabbi yehuda savar en lechem ella haafuy betannur meikara vechevan demeikara lav betannur afiyya lav lechem hu
Amar rava may tama derabbi yehuda dichtiv veafu eser nashim lachmechem betannur echad lechem haafuy betannur echad karuy lechem vesheen afuy betannur echad en karuy lechem

Yatev rabba verav yosef achoreh derabbi zera veyatev rabbi zera kammeh deulla amar leh rabba lerabbi zera bei mineh meulla hidbik mibbifnim vehirtiach mibbachutz mahu amar leh may ema leh dei amena leh amar li he nihu maase ilpas
Amar leh rav yosef lerabbi zera beo mineh meulla hidbik mibbifnim vaavuka kenegdo mahu amar leh may ema leh dei amena leh amar li rov aniyyim osin ken
Amar rav assi isa shel maaser sheni ledivre rabbi meir petura min hachalla ledivre chachamim chayyevet bechalla

a: Matztzot shel maaser sheni ledivre rabbi meir en adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach ledivre chachamim yotze bah yede chovato bappesach
Etrog shel maaser sheni ledivre rabbi meir en yotze bo yede chovato beom tov ledivre chachamim adam yotze bo yede chovato beom tov
Matkef lah rav pappa bishlama isa dichtiv arisotechem mishshellachem
Etrog name dichtiv ulkachtem lachem lachem mishshellachem yehe ella matztza mi ketiv matztzatchem
Amar rava veitema rav yemar bar shelemya atya lechem lechem ketiv hacha lechem oni uchtiv hatam vehaya baacholchem millechem haaretz ma lehallan mishshellachem af kan mishshellachem
Lema mesayya leh isa shel maaser sheni petura min hachalla divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim chayyevet lema mesayya hayenu hach
Hachi kaamar leh lema middifligi beisa behanach name peligi o dilma shane hatam dichtiv arisotechem arisotechem tere zimne

Bae rabbi shimon ben lakish mahu sheyyetze adam yede chovato bechalla shel maaser sheni birushalayim alliba derabbi yose haggelili la tibe lach hashta bechullin la nafek bechallato mibaya ki tibe lach alliba derabbi akiva
Bechullin hu denafek dei mitammu yesh lahen heter bemoshavot aval challa dei mittammeya let lah heter bemoshavot velisrefa azla la nafek
O dilma amrinan hoil veilu lo kara aleha shem veitammay it lah heter bemoshavot venafek bah hashta name nafek
Ika deamri ha vadday la tibe lach devadday amrinan hoil ki tibe lach challa hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni
Vealliba derabbanan la tibe lach kevan deamri yippade hayenu maaser ki tibe lach alliba derabbi yehuda deamar yikkaver
Ditnan hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni shennitma yippade rabbi yehuda omer yikkaver
Mi amrinan hoil vei la lakuach have vehoil velo kara aleha shem veitammay yesh lo heter bemoshavot venafek beh hashta name nafek beh
O dilma chad hoil amrinan tere hoil la amrinan amar rava mistabbera shem maaser chad hu
Challat toda urkike nazir vechu mena hane mile amar rabba deamar kera
b: Ushmartem et hammatztzot matztza hammishtammeret leshem matztza yatzta zo sheen mishtammeret leshem matztza ella leshum zevach
Rav yosef amar amar kera shivat yamim matztzot tochelu matztza hanneechelet leshivat yamim yatzta zo sheenah neechelet leshivat yamim ella leom valayela

Tanya keoteh derabba vetanya keoteh derav yosef tanya keoteh derabba yachol yetze yede chovato bechallot toda urkike nazir talmud lomar ushmartem et hammatztzot matztza hammishtammeret leshem matztza yatzta zo sheenah mishtammeret leshem matztza ella leshum zevach

Tanya keoteh derav yosef yachol yetze adam yede chovato bechallot toda urkike nazir talmud lomar shivat yamim matztzot tochelu matztza hanneechelet leshiva yatzta zo sheenah neechelet leshiva ella leom valayela
Vetipok leh millechem oni mi shenneechal baaninut yatza ze sheeno neechal baaninut ella besimcha
Savar lah kerabbi akiva deamar ani ketiv
Vetipok leh dehave leh matztza ashira
Amar shemuel bar rav yitzchak reviit hi umitchalleket hi lechamma challot
Vetipok leh deenan neechalot bechol moshavot
Amar resh lakish zot omeret challot toda urkike nazir neechalin benov vegivon

Tanya amar rabbi ilay shaalti et rabbi eliezer mahu sheyyetze adam bechallot toda urkike nazir amar li lo shamati bati veshaalti lifne rabbi yehoshua amar li hare amru challot toda urkike nazir sheasaan leatzmo en adam yotze bahen limkor bashshuk yotze bahen
Keshebbati vehirtzeti devarim lifne rabbi eliezer amar li berit hen hen haddevarim shenneemru lo lemoshe besinay ika deamri berit hen hen haddevarim shenneemru lo lemoshe besinay vela tama baaya
Vetama may amar rabba kol lashshuk imloche mimlech amar i mizdabban mizdabban i la mizdabban ipok behu ana

a: Matni veellu yerakot sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach bachazeret betamcha uvcharchavina uvulshin uvmaror yotzin bahen ben lachin ben yeveshin aval lo kevushin velo shelukin velo mevushshalin
Umitztarfin lichzayit veotzin bakkelach shellahen uvidmay uvmaaser rishon shennittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu
Gema chazeret chassa ulshin hindevi tamcha amar rabba bar bar chana temachta shemah charchavina amar rabbi shimon ben lakish atzota dedikla uvmaror merirata
Tane bar kappara ellu yerakot sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach beulshin uvtamcha becharchalin becharchavinin uvchizrin rav yehuda omer af ulshe sade veulshe gina vachazeret
Ulshe gina vachazeret ha tena lah resha hachi kaamar af ulshe sade keulshe gina vachazeret rabbi meir omer af asos vetura umar yeroar amar leh rabbi yose asos vetura echad hu umar ze hu yeroar

Tane deve rabbi shemuel ellu yerakot sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach bachazeret beulshin uvtamcha uvcharbinin uvcharginin uvhirdufnin rabbi yehuda omer af chazeret yulin vachazeret gallin kayyotze bahen
Rabbi ila omer mishshum rabbi eliezer af arkabbalim vechazarti al kol talmidav uvikkashti li chaver velo matzati uchshebbati lifne rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hoda lidvaray

Rabbi yehuda omer kol sheyyesh lo saraf rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer kol sheppanav machsifin acherim omrim kol yarak mar yesh lo saraf ufanav machsifin amar rabbi yochanan middivre kullan nilmad yarak mar yesh lo saraf ufanav machsifin amar rav huna halacha kaacherim

Ravina ashkecheh lerav acha bereh derava dahava mehaddar ammerirata amar leh may datach dimririn tefe veha chazeret tenan vetanna deve shemuel chazeret veamar rabbi oshaya mitzva bachazeret veamar rava may chazeret chassa

May chassa dechas rachamana ilavan veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan lamma nimshelu mitzriyyim kemaror lomar lach ma maror ze shettechilato rach vesofo kashe af mitzriyyim techilatan rakka vesofan kasha amar leh hadari bi

Amar leh rav rechumi leabbaye mimmay dehay maror min yarak hu ema merirata dechufya dumya dematztza ma matztza gidule karka af maror gidule karka veema hirduf dumya dematztza ma matztza min zeraim af maror min zeraim
Veema harzifu dumya dematztza ma matztza shennikachat bechesef maaser af maror shennikach bechesef maaser
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanin leabbaye ema maror chad merorim ketiv veema merorim tere dumya dematztza ma matztza minin harbe af maror minin harbe
Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav yerakot sheamru chachamim sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach kullan nizrain baaruga achat lememra delet behu mishshum kilayim

Metiv rava chazeret vachazeret gallin ulshin veulshe sade kereshin uchreshe sade kusbar vechusbar sade chardal vechardal mitzri vedallaat hammitzri veharmutza enam kilayim ze baze chazeret vachazeret gallin in chazeret veulshin lo

May nizrain deamar rav nizrain kehilchatan kehilchatan tenena
b: Aruga shehi shishsha al shishsha tefachim zorin betochah chamishsha zeronin arba al arba ruchot haaruga veachat baemtza mahu detema hane mile bizrain aval birakot la ka mashma lan
Lememra dirakot allima mizzeraim vehatnan kol mine zeraim en zorin baaruga achat kol mine yerakot zorin baaruga achat mahu detema hane maror min zeraim ninhu ka mashma lan
Zeraim salka datach veha tenan yerakot vetane bar kappara yerakot vetane deve shemuel yerakot chazeret itztericha leh salka datach amena hoil vesofah lehakshot nitev lah ravecha tefe
Lav amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina kelach shel keruv shehuksha marchivin lo bet rova alma kevan desofo lehakshot yahavinan leh ravecha tefe hacha name nitev lah ravecha tefe ka mashma lan
Yotzin bahen ben lachin ben yeveshin ku amar rav chisda lo shanu ella bakkelach aval bealin lachin in yeveshin la
Veha middekatane sefa bakkelach shellahen michlal deresha alin paroshe ka mefaresh ki katane ben lachin ben yeveshin akkelach

Metivi yotzin bahen uvakkelach shellahen ben lachin ben yeveshin divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim lachin yotzin bahen yeveshin en yotzin bahen veshavin sheyyotzin bahen kemushin aval lo kevushin velo shelukin velo mevushshalin

Kelalo shel davar kol sheyyesh bo taam maror yotzin bo vechol sheen bo taam maror en yotzin bo targuma akkelach tanu rabbanan en yotzin bahen kemushin mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok amru yotzin bahen kemushin
Bae rame bar chama mahu sheyyetze adam yede chovato bemaror shel maaser sheni birushalayim alliba derabbi akiva la tibe lach hashta bematztza deorayeta nafek bemaror derabbanan mibaya
Ki tibe lach alliba derabbi yose haggelili may bematztza deorayeta hu dela nafek aval maror derabbanan nafek
O dilma kol detakkinu rabbanan keen deorayeta takkun amar rava mistabbera matztza umaror

Matni en shorin et hammursan letarnegolim aval choltin haishsha lo tishre et hammursan shettolich beyadah lammerchatz aval shafa hi bivsarah yavesh lo yilos adam chitin veyanniach al makkato mippene shehen machmitzot
Gema tanu rabbanan ellu devarim sheen bain lide chimutz haafuy vehamvushshal vechalut shechalato berotchin mevushshal addimvashshel leh machma amar rav pappa haafuy shebbishlo kaamar
Tanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer kemach shennafal letocho delef afilu kol hayyom kullo eno ba lide chimutz amar rav pappa vehu deaved tif lahade tif
Amri deve rabbi shela vatika shere vehatanya vatika asur la kashya ha deavdeh bemishcha umilcha ha deavdeh bemayya umilcha
Amar mar zutra la limache inish kidra bekimcha daavishuna dilma la beshil shappir veate lide chimutz amar rav yosef la lichlot inish

a: Tere chite bahade hadade dilma azla chada veyatva betzirya dachavertah vela salek lehu dikula demayya mearba ruchata veate lide chimutz

Veamar abbaye la lichroch inish tere shuvle bahade hadade dilma nafki mayya mehay uvala idach veatya lide chimutz amar leh rava i hachi afilu chada name dilma nafek mehay resha uvala idach resha ella amar rava me ferot ninhu ume ferot enan machmitzin

Vahadar beh abbaye mehahi dechol aggav medalayehu la machmetzi deamar abbaye hay chatzba daavishuna sechifa shere zekifa asur rava amar afilu zekifa name shere me ferot ninhu ume ferot enan machmitzin
Tanu rabbanan en lottin seorin bappesach veim latat nitbakkeu asurot lo nitbakkeu muttarot
Rabbi yose omer shoran bechometz vechometz tzomtan amar shemuel en halacha kerabbi yose

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukva lo nitbakkeu mammash ella kol sheilu mannichan al pi chavit vehen nitbakkeot meelehen ushmuel amar nitbakkeu mammash avad shemuel ovada bedura deve bar chashu nitbakkeu mammash
Amar rabba baal nefesh lo yiltot may irya baal nefesh afilu kulle alma name deha tanya en lottin seorin bappesach hachi kaamar baal nefesh afilu chitin dishriri lo yiltot
Amar leh rav nachman man detzayet leh leabba achel nahama deipusha deha be rav huna latti uve rava bar avin latti verava amar asur liltot
Ella ha detanya en lottin seorin bappesach seorin hu dela ha chite shere la mibaya kaamar la mibaya chitin kevan deit beh tzirya ayeli behu mayya aval seare deshii ema shappir dame ka mashma lan
Hadar amar rava muttar liltot detanya yotzin befat nekiyya vehadraa vei efshar nekiyya belo letita
Etiveh rav pappa lerava hakkemachin vehasselatot shel goyim shel kefarim tehorim veshel kerakkin temein
Dichfarim may tama lav mishshum dela latti veka kare leh solet
Targuma akkimcha batar denafek amar may tama la ema leh meha deamar rabbi zera amar rav yirmeya amar shemuel chitin shel menachot en lottin otam veka kare lehu solet
Hadar amar rava mitzva liltot shenneemar ushmartem et hammatztzot i la devae letita shimur lemay i shimur delisha shimur delisha lav shimur hu
Deamar rav huna betzekot shel goyim adam memalle kereso mehen uvilvad sheyyochal kezayit matztza baacharona baacharona in barishona la
May tama mishshum dela avad behu shimur velabed leh shimur meafiyya veelach ella lav shema minah shimur meikara baenan
Vmimmay dilma shane hatam dividana denachet leshimur la aved lah shimur aval hecha dividana denachet leshimur aved lah shimur hachi name deshimur delisha have shimur
Vaafilu hachi la hadar beh rava deamar lehu lehanhu dimhappechi kefe ki mehappechitu happichu leshum mitzva alma kasavar shimur meikara mittechillato vead sofo baenan
Mar bereh deravina
b: Menakketa leh imeh bearve
Hahu arba dechite ditvaa bechishta sharya rava lezabbone legoyim
Etiveh rabba bar levay lerava beged sheavad bo kilayim hare ze lo yimkerennu legoy velo yaase bo mardaat lachamor aval osin oto tachrichin lemet
Legoy may tama la lav mishshum dahadar mezabben leyisrael
Hadar amar rava lezabbinhu kabba kabba leyisrael ki hechi dechalya kamme pischa
Tanu rabbanan en mollin et hakkedera bappesach veharotze sheyyimlol noten et hakkemach veachar kach noten et hachometz veyesh omrim af noten et hachometz veachar kach noten et hakkemach
Man yesh omrim

Amar rav chisda rabbi yehuda hi ditnan hailpas vehakkedera sheheeviran meruttachin lo yitten letochan tavlin aval noten letoch hakkeara o letoch hattamchuy rabbi yehuda omer lakkol hu noten chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz vatzir
Venokmah kerabbi yose ditnan rabbi yose omer shoran bechometz vechometz tzomtan
Ki ashmeinan leh lerabbi yose hane mile deiteh beeneh aval al yede taarovet la
Ulla amar echad ze veechad ze asur mishshum lech lech amrinan nezira sechor sechor lecharma la tikrav
Rav pappi share leh levurdiki deve resh galuta lemimche kedera bachasise amar rava ika deshare ki hay milta beduchta dishchichi avdi ika deamri rava gufa mache leh kidra bachasise
Matni en notnin kemach letoch charoset o letoch hachardal veim natan yeachel miyyad verabbi meir oser
En mevashshelin et happesach lo bemashkin velo beme ferot aval sachin umatbilin oto bahen
Me tashmisho shel nachtom yishshafchu mippene shehen machmitzin
Gema amar rav kahana machaloket letoch hachardal aval letoch charoset divre hakkol yissaref miyyad

Vetanya name hachi en notnin kemach letoch hacharoset veim natan yissaref miyyad letoch hachardal rabbi meir omer yissaref miyyad vachachamim omrim yeachel miyyad amar rav huna bereh derav yehuda amar rav nachman amar shemuel halacha kedivre chachamim amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav huna bereh derav yehuda

a: Acharoset kaamar mar o achardal kaamar mar amar leh lemay nafka minah
Lidrav kahana deamar rav kahana machaloket letoch hachardal aval letoch hacharoset divre hakkol yissaref miyyad
Amar leh la shemia li kelomar la sevira li
Amar rav ashe keoteh derav kahana mistabbera middeamar shemuel en halacha kerabbi yose may lav tzammote hu dela tzamet ha chammoe mechammea
La dilma la mitzmat tzamet vela chammoe mechamma
En mevashshelin vechu tanu rabbanan bemayim en li ella bemayim shear mashkin minnayin
Amarta kal vachomer uma mayim sheen mefigin taman asurin shear mashkin shemmefigin taman lo kol shekken
Rabbi omer bemayim en li ella mayim shear mashkin minnayin talmud lomar uvashel mevushshal mikkol makom
May benayehu ika benayehu tzeli kedar
Verabbanan hay bashel mevushshal may avdi lehu mibbee leh lechidtanya bishshelo veachar kach tzelao o shetztzelao veachar kach bishshelo chayyav
Bishlama bishshelo veachar kach tzelao chayyav deha bashsheleh ella tzelao veachar kach bishshelo ha tzeli esh hu ammay

Amar rav kahana ha manni rabbi yose hi detanya yotzin berakik hashsharuy uvimvushshal shello nimoach divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer yotzin berakik hashsharuy aval lo bimvushshal af al pi shello nimoach
Ulla amar afilu tema rabbi meir shane hacha deamar kera uvashel mevushshal mikkol makom
Tanu rabbanan yachol tzelao kol tzorko yehe chayyav talmud lomar al tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal bammayim na uvashel mevushshal amarti lecha velo shetztzelao kol tzorko
Hechi dame amar rav ashe deshavveye charocha
Tanu rabbanan yachol achal kezayit chay yehe chayyav talmud lomar al tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal na uvashel amarti lecha velo chay
Yachol yehe muttar talmud lomar ki im tzeli esh hechi dame na amar rav kidamri parsae avarnim
Amar rav chisda hamvashshel bechamme teverya beshabbat patur pesach shebbishshelo bechamme teverya chayyav
May shena beshabbat dela detoldot esh baenan veleka pesach name lav toldot esh hu
Amar rava may chayyav dekatane deka avar mishshum tzali esh
Rav chiyya bereh derav natan matne lah leha derav chisda behedya amar rav chisda hamvashshel bechamme teverya beshabbat patur ufesach shebbishshelo bechamme teverya chayyav sheavar mishshum tzeli esh
Amar rava achalo na
b: Loke shettayim mevushshal loke shettayim na umvushshal loke shalosh
Abbaye amar en lokin al lav shebbichlalot
Ika deamri tarte hu dela lake chada mihat lake
Ika deamri chada name la lake dela meyachad laveh kelav dachasima
Rava amar achal zag loke shettayim chartzan loke shettayim zag vechartzan loke shalosh
Abbaye amar en lokin al lav shebbichlalot ika deamri tarte hu dela lake chada mihat lake ika deamri chada name la lake dela meyachad laveh kelav dachasima

Tanu rabbanan achal kezayit na mibbeod yom patur kezayit na mishshechashecha chayyav achal kezayit tzali mibbeod yom lo pasal atzmo mibbene chavura kezayit tzali mishshechashecha pasal atzmo mibbene hachavura
Tanya idach yachol achal kezayit na mibbeod yom yehe chayyav vedin hu uma beshaa sheyyeshno bekum echol tzali yeshno beval tochal na beshaa sheeno bekum echol tzali eno din sheyyeshno beval tochal na
O lo beshaa sheeno bekum echol tzali yeshno beval tochal na beshaa sheyyeshno bekum echol tzali eno beval tochal na
Veal titmah shehare huttar mikkelalo etzel tzali

Rabbi omer ekra ani bashel ma talmud lomar mevushshal sheyyachol en li ella shebbishlo mishshechashecha bishshelo mibbeod yom minnayin talmud lomar bashel mevushshal mikkol makom
Vehay bashel mevushshal appekeh rabbi litzli kedar velishar mashkin
Im ken lema kera o bashel bashel o mevushshal mevushshal may bashel mevushshal shamatte minah tarte
Tanu rabbanan achal tzali mibbeod yom chayyav uchzayit na mishshechashecha chayyav
Katane tzali dumya dena ma na belav af tzali belav
Bishlama na ketiv al tochlu mimmennu na ella tzali menalan
Dichtiv veachlu et habbasar ballayela hazze ballayela in bayyom la
Hay lav habba mikkelal ase hu vechol lav habba mikkelal ase ase
Amar rav chisda ha manni

a: Rabbi yehuda hi detanya shor vase sarua vekalut nedava taase oto oto atta matpis levedek habbayit vei atta matpis temimim levedek habbayit mikkan amru kol hammatpis temimim levedek habbayit over baase
En li ella baase belo taase minnayin talmud lomar vayedabber Adonai el moshe lemor limed al kol happarasha kullah sheyehe belo taase divre rabbi yehuda
Amar lo rabbi levar kappara may mashma
Amar lo dichtiv lemor lo neemar baddevarim
Be rav amri lemor lav emor
Me tashmisho shel nachtom vechu tane chada shofchin bimkom midron veen shofchin bimkom haeshboren vetanya idach shofchin bimkom haeshboren
La kashya ha dinfishi diku ha dela nefishi dela keu
Amar rav yehuda ishsha lo talush ella bemayim shellanu
Darshah rav matna befapponya lemachar ayeto kulle alma chatzvayehu vaato legabbeh vaamaru leh hav lan mayya amar lehu ana bemayya devitu amari

Daresh rava ishsha lo talush bachamma velo bechamme chamma velo bammayim haggerufin min hammulyar velo tagbiha yadah min hattannur ad shettigmor et kol happat vetzarich shene chelim echad shemmekattefet bo veechad shemmetzannenet bo et yadeha
Ibaya lehu avra velasha mahu mar zutra amar muttar rav ashe amar asur
Amar mar zutra mena amena lah detanya en lottin hasseorin bappesach veim latat nitbakkeu asurim lo nitbakkeu muttarin
Verav ashe amar attu kullehu chada mechita mechitinhu hecha deitmar itmar vehecha dela itmar la itmar
Hadran alach kol shaa
Matni veellu ovrin bappesach kuttach habbavli veshechar hammadi vechometz haadomi vezetom hammitzri vezoman shel tzabbaim vaamilan shel tabbachim vekolan shel sofrim
Rabbi eliezer omer af tachshite nashim
Ze hakkelal kol shehu mimmin dagan hare ze over bappesach hare ellu baazhara veen bahen mishshum karet
Gema tanu rabbanan shelosha devarim neemarim bechuttach habbavli metamtem et hallev umsamme et haenayim umachchish et hagguf
Metamtem et hallev mishshum nasuve dachalava umsamme et haenayim mishshum milcha umachchish et hagguf mishshum komanita deuma
Tanu rabbanan shelosha devarim marbin hazzevel vechoffin et hakkoma venotlin echad mechamesh meot mimmeor enav shel adam ellu hen pat kibar veshechar chadash veyarak chay
Tanu rabbanan shelosha devarim memaatin et hazzevel vezokfin et hakkoma umirin et haenayim ellu hen pat nekiyya basar shamen veyayin yashan pat nekiyya
b: Dismida basar shamen ditzfirta dela ippetach yayin yashan attik attike
Kol mile dimalle lehay kashe lehay udkashe lehay mealle lehay bar mizzangevila rattiva ufilpele arichta ufat nekiyya uvasar shamen veyayin yashan dimalle lechulle gufeh
Shechar hammadi deramu beh me seare
Vechometz haadomi deshadu beh seare
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak battechilla keshehau meviin nesachim miyehuda lo haya yenam shel yehuda machmitz ad shennotnin letochan seorin vehau korin oto chometz setam

Veachshav en yenam shel adomiyyim machmitz ad shennotnin letochan seorin vekorin oto chometz haadomi lekayyem ma shenneemar immala hachorava im melea zo chareva zo veim melea zo chareva zo rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha ulom milleom yeematz

Tanya amar rabbi yehuda bihuda barishona hallokeach chometz meam haaretz eno tzarich leasser mippene shechazaka eno ba ella min hattemed veachshav hallokeach chometz meam haaretz tzarich leasser shechezkato eno ba ella min hayyayin
Vesavar rabbi yehuda temed lav bar assore hu veha tenan hamtammed venatan mayim bammidda umatza kede middato patur verabbi yehuda mechayyev
Hachi kaamar lo nechshedu amme haaretz al hattemed i baet ema nechshedu vela kashya ha bediroka ha bidfurtzane
Vezetom hammitzri vechu may zetom hammitzri
Tana rav yosef telata seare telata kurteme utlata milcha
Rav pappa mappek seare umayyel chite vesimanach sisane
Taru lehu vekalu lehu vetachani lehu veshatu lehu middivcha vead atzarta dikmit merappe leh vedirfe mekammet leh lechole ulishsha ubbara sakkanta
Vezoman shel tzabbaim vechu hacha targimu mayya dechivare detzavi behu libba
Vaamilan shel tabbachim vechu pat tevua shello hevia shelish shemmannichah al pi kedera veshoevet hazzuhama
Vekolan shel sofrim vechu hacha targuma perura deushkafe
Rav shimi machoznaa amar ze tipulan shel benot ashirim shemmeshayerot oto livnot aniyyim
Ini veha tane rabbi chiyya arbaa mine medina ushlosha mine ummanut vei amratte tipulan shel benot ashirim may mine ummanut ika

Veella may perura deushkafe ammay kare leh hay kolan shel sofrim kolan shel ratzanin mibaya leh amar rav oshaya leolam perura deushkafe umay kare leh kolan shel sofrim desofrim name medabbekin behu neyarotehen
Rabbi eliezer omer af tachshite nashim vechu tachshite nashim salka datach ella ema af tipule nashim deamar rav yehuda amar rav benot yisrael

a: Shehiggiu lefirkan velo higgiu leshanim benot aniyyim toflot otan besid benot ashirim toflot otan besolet benot melachim beshemen hammor shenneemar shishsha chodashim beshemen hammor
May shemen hammor rav huna bar yirmeya omer setachat rav yirmeya bar abba amar shemen zayit shello hevi shelish
Tanya rabbi yehuda omer anpiknin shemen zayit shello hevi shelish velamma sachin oto mippene shemmashshir et hassear umadden et habbasar
Ze hakkelal kol shehu mimmin dagan tanya amar rabbi yehoshua vechi meachar sheshshaninu kol shehu min dagan hare ze over befesach lamma manu chachamim et ellu kede sheyehe ragil bahen uvishmotehen
Ki ha dehahu bar mareva ikla levavel hava bisra bahadeh amar lehu karivu li matkilta shema dekaamri karivu leh kuttach kevan dishma kuttach perash
Hare ellu beazhara
Man tanna dechametz dagan gamur al yede taarovot venukshe beeneh belav
Amar rav yehuda amar rav rabbi meir hi detanya siur yissaref venotno lechalbo vehaochlo bearbaim
Ha gufa kashya amratte siur yissaref alma asur bahanaa vahadar tane venotno lifne kalbo alma muttar bahanaa
Hachi kaamar siur yissaref derabbi meir lerabbi meir derabbi yehuda lerabbi yehuda venotno lifne kalbo derabbi meir lerabbi yehuda
Vehaochlo bearbaim atan lerabbi meir
Shaminan leh lerabbi meir nukshe beeneh belav vechol shekken chametz dagan gamur al yede taarovet

Rav nachman amar rabbi eliezer hi detanya al chametz dagan gamur anush karet al eruvo belav divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim al chametz dagan gamur anush karet al eruvo belo kelum veshaminan leh lerabbi eliezer deamar chametz dagan gamur al yede taarovet belav vechol shekken nukshe beeneh
Verav nachman may tama la amar kerav yehuda
Amar lach dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella nukshe beeneh aval chametz dagan gamur al yede taarovet la
Verav yehuda may tama la amar kerav nachman
Amar lach ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam ella chametz dagan gamur al yede taarovet aval nukshe beeneh la amar

Tanya keoteh derav yehuda kol machmetzet lo tochelu lerabbot kuttach habbavli veshechar hammadi vechometz haadomi vezetom hammitzri yachol yehe anush karet talmud lomar ki kol ochel chametz venichreta al chametz dagan gamur anush karet veal eruvo belav
Man shamatte leh deamar al eruvo belav rabbi eliezer hi veilu nukshe beeneh la kaamar shema minah nukshe lerabbi eliezer let leh
Verabbi eliezer eruvo belav mena leh dichtiv kol machmetzet lo tochelu
I hachi karet name lechayyev deha ketiv ki kol ochel machmetzet venichreta
Hahu mibe leh lechidtanya machmetzet en li ella shennitchammetz meelav mechamat davar acher minnayin talmud lomar kol machmetzet venichreta
I hachi delav name lehachi hu daata
