Deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish vayyikra yaakov el banav vayyomer heasfu veaggida lachem bikesh yaakov legallot levanav ketz hayyamin venistalleka mimmennu shechina amar shemma chas veshalom yesh bemittati pesul keavraham sheyyatza mimmennu yishmael veavi yitzchak sheyyatza mimmennu esav amru lo banav shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad amru keshem sheen belibbecha ella echad kach en belibbenu ella echad beotah shaa patach yaakov avinu veamar baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed

Amri rabbanan hechi naaved nemreh lo amaro moshe rabbenu la nemreh amaro yaakov hitkinu sheyehu omrim oto bachashay amar rabbi yitzchak amri deve rabbi amme mashal levat melech shehericha tzike kedera im tomar yesh lah genay lo tomar yesh lah tzaar hitchilu avadeha lehavi bachashay
Amar rabbi avahu hitkinu sheyehu omrim oto bekol ram mippene taromet hamminin uvinhardea deleka minin ad hashta amri lah bachashay

Tanu rabbanan shishsha devarim asu anshe yericho shelosha birtzon chachamim ushlosha shello birtzon chachamim veellu birtzon chachamim markivin dekalim kol hayyom vechorchin et shema vekotzrin lifne haomer veellu shello birtzon chachamim godshin lifne haomer ufortzin peratzot begannotehen uvfardesotehen lehaachil nesher laaniyyim bishne vatztzoret beshabbatot veyamim tovim umattirin gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma divre rabbi meir
Amar lo rabbi yehuda im birtzon chachamim hau osin yehu kol adam osin ken ella ellu vaellu shello birtzon chachamim hau osin al shelosha michu beyadam veal shelosha lo michu beyadam

Veellu shello michu beyadam markivin dekalim kol hayyom vechorchin et shema vekotzrin vegodshin lifne haomer veellu shemmichu beyadam mattirin gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma ufortzin peratzot begannotehen ufardesehen lehaachil nesher laaniyyim beshabbatot veyamim tovim bishne vatztzoret notnin pea layyarak umichu beyadam chachamim
Vesavar rabbi yehuda ketzira shello birtzon chachamim hi vehatnan anshe yericho kotzrin lifne haomer birtzon chachamim vegodshin lifne haomer shello birtzon chachamim velo michu beyadam chachamim
b: Man shamatte leh deamar michu velo michu rabbi yehuda vekatane kotzrin birtzon chachamim velitamach hane arbea hava ella semi mikan ketzira

Umattirin gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma amru avotenu lo hikdishu ella korot veanu nattir gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma uvgidulin habbain leachar mikkan askinan vesavri lah keman deamar en meila begidulin verabbanan savri nehi dimila leka isura miha ika

Ufortzin peratzot amar ulla amar rabbi shimon ben lakish machloket beshel machbedot derabbanan savri gazrinan shemma yaale veyitlosh veanshe yericho savri la gazrinan shemma yaale veyitlosh aval beshel ben hakkipin divre hakkol muttar

Amar leh rava veha muktzot ninhu vechi tema hoil dachaze leorvin hashta muchan leadam la have muchan lichlavim ditnan rabbi yehuda omer im lo hayeta nevela meerev shabbat asura lefi sheenah min hammuchan muchan leorvim have muchan leadam
Amar leh in muchan leadam la have muchan lichlavim dechol mide dachaze leinish la maktze leh middateh muchan leorvim have muchan leadam kol mide dachaze leinish dateh illaveh

Ki ata ravin amar rabbi shimon ben lakish machloket beshel ben kipin derabbanan savri muchan leorvim la have muchan leadam veanshe yericho savri muchan laorvim have muchan leadam aval beshel machbedot divre hakkol asur gazrinan shemma yaale veyitlosh
Venotnin pea layyarak velet lehu leanshe yericho ha ditnan kelal amru bappea kol shehu ochel venishmar vegidulo min haaretz ulkitato keachat umachniso lekiyyum chayyav befea
Kol shehu ochel perat lisfiche setis vekotza venishmar perat lehefker vegidulo min haaretz perat lichmehin ufitriyyot ulkitatan keachat perat litenim umachniso lekiyyum perat leyarak
Amar rav yehuda amar rav hacha berashe lefatot askinan umachniso lekiyyum al yede davar acher kamipalgi mar savar machniso lekiyyum al yede davar acher shemeh kiyyum umar savar la shemeh kiyyum
Tanu rabbanan barishona hau notnin pea lelefet velichruv rabbi yose omer af lekaflot vetanya idach hau notnin pea lelefet ulkaflot rabbi shimon omer af lichruv

a: Nema telata tannae hao la tere tannae hao vetanna kamma derabbi shimon hayenu rabbi yose vetanna kamma derabbi yose hayenu rabbi shimon umay af akkammayeta

Tanu rabbanan ben buhyan natan pea layyarak uva aviv umtzaan laaniyyim shehau teunin yarak veomdin al petach haggina amar lahem banay hashlichu mealechem vaani noten lachem kiflayim bamussar lo mippene sheeni tzara ella mippene sheamru chachamim en notnin pea layyarak
Lema leh lememra lehu lo mippene sheeni tzara ki hechi dela lemru dachoye ka medache lan

Tanu rabbanan barishona hau mannichin orot kadashim belishkat bet happarva laerev hau mechallekin otan leanshe bet av vehau baale zeroot notlin otan bizroa hitkinu sheyyihu mechallekin otan meerev shabbat leerev shabbat deatyan kullehu mishmarot veshaklan bahadade
Vaadayin hau gedole chehunna notlin otan bizroa amdu bealim vehikdishum lashshamayim

Amru lo hau yamim muatim ad shechipu et hahechal kullo betavlaot shel zahav shehen amma al amma keovi dinar zahav ulregel hau mekappelin otan umannichin otan al gav maala behar habbayit kede sheyehu ole regalim roin shemmelachtam naa veen bah delem
Tana abba shaul omer korot shel shikma hau biricho vehau baale zeroot notlin otan bizroa amdu bealim vehikdishum lashshamayim

Alehem veal kayyotze bahem amar abba shaul ben batnit mishshum abba yosef ben chanin oy li mibbet bayetos oy li mealatan oy li mibbet chanin oy li millechishatan oy li mibbet katros oy li mikkulmosan oy li mibbet yishmael ben piachi oy li meegrofan shehem kohanim gedolim uvnehen gizbarin vechatnehem amarkalin veavdehen chovtin et haam bemaklot

Tanu rabbanan arba tzeochot tzavecha azara rishona tzeu mikkan bene eli shettimu hechal Adonai veod tzavecha tze mikan yissaschar ish kefar barkay shemmechabbed et atzmo umchallel kodshe shamayim dahava karech yedeh beshirae veaved avoda

Veod tzavecha haazara seu shearim rashechem veyikkanes yishmael ben piachi talmido shel pinchas vishammesh bichhunna gedola veod tzavecha haazara seu shearim rashechem veyikkanes yochanan ben nirbay talmido shel pinkay vimalle kereso mikkodshe shamayim

Amru alav al yochanan ben nirbay shehaya ochel shelosh meot agalim veshote shelosh meot garve yayin veochel arbaim sea gozalot bekinuach seuda amru kol yamav shel yochanan ben nirbay lo nimtza notar bemikdash may selika beh beyissasochar ish kefar barkay amri malka umalketa hao yatvi malka amar gadya yae umalketa amra imra yae amaru man mochach kohen gadol deka massek korbanot kol yoma ata ihu
b: Achvi bideh i gadya yae yissak litmida amar malka hoil vela have leh emta demalchuta nifseku leyammineh yehav shochad ufaskeh lismaleh shema malka ufaskeh leyammineh amar rav yosef berich rachamana deashkeleh leyissasochar ish kefar barkay lemitrafseh mineh behay alma

Amar rav ashe yissaschar ish kefar barkay la tena matnitin ditnan rabbi shimon omer kevasim kodmim laizzim bechol makom yachol mippene shemmuvcharin beminan talmud lomar im keves yavi korbano melammed sheshshenehen shekulin keechad ravina amar afilu mikra name la kera dichtiv im keves im ez i bae keves layeteh i bae ez layeteh
Hadran alach makom shennahagu uslika lah pesach rishon

a: Matni tamid nishchat bishmona umechtza vekarev betisha umechtza bearve fesachim nishchat besheva umechtza vekarev bishmone umechtza ben bachol ben beshabbat chal erev pesach lihot beerev shabbat nishchat beshesh umechtza vekarev besheva umechtza vehappesach acharav
Gema mena hane mile

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar kera et hakkeves echad taase vabboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim challekehu leven shene aravim shette shaot umechtza lechan shette shaot umechtza lechan veshaa achat laasiyyato
Metiv rava bearve fesachim nishchat besheva umechtza vekarev bishmone umechtza ben bachol ben beshabbat vei salka datach bishmone umechtza deorayeta hechi makdeminan leh
Ella amar rava mitzvato detamid mishsheyyinnatu tzille erev may tama deamar kera ben haarbayim meidana dematchel shimsha lemirav
Hilkach bishar yemot hashshana deika nedarim undavot derachamana amar aleha chelve hashshelamim
Veamar mar aleha chelve hashshelamim aleha hashlem kol hakkarbanot kullam meacharinan leh tarte shae veavdinan leh bishmone umechtza

Bearve fesachim deika pesach acharav kadminan leh shaa achat veavdinan leh besheva umechtza chal erev pesach lihot erev shabbat deika name tzeliyyato dela dache shabbat mokminan leh addineh beshesh umechtza
Tanu rabbanan kesiduro bachol kach siduro bashshabbat divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer kesiduro beerev pesach

May kaamar amar abbaye hachi kaamar kesiduro bachol beerev happesach kach siduro bashshabbat beerev happesach divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer kesiduro beerev happesach shechal lihot beerev shabbat kach siduro bashshabbat umatnitin dekatane ben bachol ben bashshabbat rabbi yishmael hi

Bemay ka mipalgi bemusafin kodmin levazichin kamipalgi rabbi yishmael savar musafin kodmin levazichin aved lehu lemusafin beshesh uvazichin besheva veaved leh letamid besheva umechtza rabbi akiva savar bazichin kodmin lemusafin bazichin bechamesh umusafin beshesh veaved leh letamid beshesh umechtza

Matkef lah rava mide rabbi akiva kesidro beerev happesach shechal lihot beerev shabbat katane kesidro beerev happesach setama katane ella amar rava hachi kaamar kesidro bechol dealma kach sidro bashshabbat beerev happesach divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer kesidro beerev happesach umatnitin dekatane ben bachol ben bashshabbat rabbi akiva hi
Bemay ka mipalgi bemichmar bisra kamipalgi rabbi yishmael savar chayeshinan lemichmar bisra verabbi akiva savar la chayeshinan lemichmar bisra
b: I la chayeshinan nibedeh beshesh umechtza ka savar musafin kodmin levazichin aved lehu lemusafin beshesh uvazichin besheva veaved leh letamid besheva umechtza
Matkef lah rabba bar ulla mide kesidro bachol kach sidro bashshabbat beerev happesach divre rabbi yishmael katane kach sidro bashshabbat setama katane
Ella amar rabba bar ulla hachi katane kesidro bechol dealma kach sidro beshabbat dealma divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer kesidro beerev happesach dealma kach sidro beshabbat dealma umatnitin dekatane ben bachol ben bashshabbat divre hakkol hi
Bemay kamipalgi bigzerat nedavot undarim kamipalgi rabbi yishmael savar gazrinan shabbat attu chol verabbi akiva savar la gazrinan
I la gazrinan nibedeh beshesh umechtza kasavar musafin kodmin levazichin musafin beshesh uvazichin besheva veaved leh letamid besheva umechtza

Metivi tamid kol hashshana kullah karev kehilchato nishchat bishmone umechtza vekarev betesha umechtza uvaerev happesach nishchat besheva umechtza vekarev bishmone umechtza chal lihot bashshabbat kechal lihot besheni bashshabbat divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer kesidro beerev happesach
Bishlama leabbaye nicha ella lerava kashya amar lach rava la tema kechal besheni bashshabbat ella ema kesheni bashshabbat dealma
Metivi chal lihot bashshabbat kesidro kol hashshana kullah divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer kesidro beerev happesach dealma bishlama lerava nicha ella leabbaye kashya
Amar lach abbaye la tema kesidro kol hashshana ella ema kesidro kol hashshanim kullan divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer kesidro erev happesach shechal lihot beerev shabbat
Tanu rabbanan minnayin shello yehe davar kodem letamid shel shachar talmud lomar vearach aleha haola may talmuda amar rava haola ola rishona
Uminnayin sheen davar karev achar tamid shel ben haarbayim talmud lomar vehiktir aleha chelve hashshelamim may talmuda amar abbaye aleha shelamim velo al chavertah shelamim
Matkef lah rava ema shelamim hu dela nakrev ha olot nakrev ella amar rava hashshelamim aleha hashlem kol hakkarbanot kullan
Tanu rabbanan tamid kodem lefesach pesach kodem liktoret ketoret kodemet lenerot

a: Yeuchar davar shenneemar bo baarev uven haarbayim ledavar shello neemar bo baerev ella ben haarbayim bilvad
I hachi ketoret venerot name nikdemu lefesach yeuchar davar shenneemar bo baarev uven haarbayim ledavar shello neemar bo ella ben haarbayim bilvad
Shane hatam demiet rachamana oto detanya meerev vead boker ten lah middatah shettehe doleket meerev ad boker
Davar acher en lecha avoda shekkeshera meerev ad boker ella zo bilvad may tama amar kera yaaroch oto aharon uvanav meerev ad boker oto meerev ad boker veen davar acher meerev ad boker
Veitakkash ketoret lenerot
Vetanya ki kushyan tamid kodem liktoret ketoret kodemet lenerot venerot kodmot lefesach yeuchar davar shenneemar bo baarev uven haarbayim ledavar shello neemar bo ella ben haarbayim bilvad

Veha ketiv oto hay oto mibe leh lemaote avoda shebbifnim umay nihu ketoret salka datach amena hoil uchtiv uvhaalot aharon et hannerot ben haarbayim yaktirenna ema nadlek nerot beresha vahadar nakter ketoret miet rachamana oto
Ella ben haarbayim yaktirenna lema li hachi kaamar rachamana beidan demadlekatte nerot tehe mikkatra ketoret

Tanu rabbanan en lecha davar shekkodem letamid shel shachar ella ketoret bilvad shenneemar bah babboker babboker veukdam ketoret davar shenneemar bo babboker babboker dichtiv vehiktir alav aharon ketoret sammim babboker babboker ledavar shello neemar bo ella boker echad
Veen lecha davar shemmitakkev achar tamid shel ben haarbayim ella ketoret venerot ufesach umchussar kippurim beerev happesach shettovel shenit veochel et pischo laerev
Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer af mechussar kippurim bishar yemot hashshana shettovel veochel bakkodashim laerev
Bishlama letanna kamma yavo ase defesach sheyyesh bo karet veyidche ase dehashlama sheen bo karet ella lerabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka may ulmeh dehay ase mehay ase
Amar ravina amar rav chisda hacha bechattat haof askinan sheen lemizbeach ella damah
Rav pappa amar afilu tema bechattat behema maaleha umlinah berosho shel mizbeach
Vehaika asham bishlama lerav pappa hayenu demelin lah ella lerav chisda may ika lememar amri shekkarav ashamo
Vehaika ola vechi tema ola la meakkeva vehatanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer keshem shechattato vaashamo meakkevin oto kach olato meakkavto

Vechi tema beshekkarva olato umi karva olato kodem lechattato rishon vehatanya vehikriv et asher lachattat rishona ma talmud lomar im lelammed shettehe kodemet laola hare kevar neemar veet hashsheni yaase ola kammishpat
Ella ze bana av lechol chattaot sheyehu kodmot lechol olot habbaot immahen vekayema lan daafilu chattat haof kodemet leolat behema
Amar rava shane olat metzora derachamana amar
b: Veheela hakkohen et haola sheheelah kevar

Amar leh rav shemen bar abba lerav pappa ledidach deamratte maaleha umlinah berosho shel mizbeach kayyamin veavdinan milta lechohanim deatu bah lide takkala desavri deomeh hu veatu leaktore amar leh kohanim zerizin hen

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana veamri lah rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa veha kamma dela mitkatteri emurin kohanim la matzu achli basar detanya yachol yehu kohanim rashshain bechaze vashok kodem haktarat emurin talmud lomar vehiktir hakkohen et hachelev hammizbecha vahadar vehaya hechaze leaharon ulvanav
Vechamma dechohanim la achli basar bealim la mitkapperi detanya veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem melammed shehakkohanim ochlim uvalim mitkapperin
Amar leh kevan dela efshar ashaum kemi shennitmeu o sheavdu detanya yachol nitmeu emurin o sheavdu lo yehu kohanim zakkain bechaze vashok talmud lomar vehaya hechaze leaharon ulvanav mikkol makom
Rav kahana rame ketiv lo yalin chelev chaggi ad boker ad boker hu dela yalin ha kol hallayela kullah yalin uchtiv vehiktir aleha chelve hashshelamim aleha hashlem kol hakkarbanot kullan
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah keshennittotru

Rame leh rav safra lerav ketiv lo yalin labboker zevach chag happasach labboker hu delo yalin ha kol hallayela yalin vehachtiv olat shabbat beshabbatto velo olat chol beshabbat velo olat chol beom tov
Amar leh kevar ramyah nihaleh rav abba bar chiyya lerabbi avahu veshanni leh hacha bearbaa asar shechal lihot beshabbat askinan dechelve shabbat kerevin beom tov
Amar leh mishshum dechelve shabbat kerevin beom tov anan neku venema leh dehay kera bearbaa asar shechal lihot beshabbat hu dichtiv amar leh shivkeh likra dehu dachek umokem annafsheh
Matni happasach sheshshechato shello lishmo vekibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishmo o lishmo veshello lishmo o shello lishmo velishmo pasul
Ketzad lishmo veshello lishmo leshem pesach ulshem shelamim shello lishmo velishmo leshem shelamim ulshem pesach
Gema bae rav pappa baavoda achat tenan o bishte avodot tenan
Baavoda achat tenan verabbi yose hi deamar af bigmar devarav adam nitpas
Dei rabbi meir ha amar tefos lashon rishon

a: O dilma bishte avodot tenan vaafilu lerabbi meir deamar tefos lashon rishon hane mile baavoda achat aval bishte avodot mode demipsil

Amri aheya i nema ashshello lishmo velishmo ben baavoda achat ben bishte avodot ben lerabbi meir ben lerabbi yose ipsil leh mikkammayeta deha lerabbi yose name af bigmar devarav adam nitpas it leh ella allishmo veshello lishmo may
Ta shema happesach sheshshechato shello lishmo vekibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishmo hechi dame i nema kidkatane lema li ad dimchashshev lechullehu mikkammayeta ipsil leh

Ella lav hachi katane happesach sheshshechato shello lishmo i name shechato lishmo vekibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishmo i name shechato vekibbel vehillech lishmo vezarak shello lishmo dehaveya lah shette avodot
Ema sefa lishmo veshello lishmo hechi dame i nema bishte avodot hayenu resha ella lav baavoda achat verabbi yose hi deamar af bigmar devarav adam nitpas
La leolam bishte avodot veresha dekae bishchita veka mechashshev bishchita i name kae bizrika veka mechashshev bizrika
Sefa dekae bishchita vekachashev bizrika deamar hareni shochet et happesach lishmo lizrok damo shello lishmo veka mashma lan dimchashshevin meavoda laavoda vehayenu baya derav pappa
Ta shema o shello lishmo velishmo pasul hechi dame i nema bishte avodot hashta lishmo veshello lishmo amratte pasul shello lishmo velishmo mibaya
Ella lav baavoda achat umiddesefa baavoda achat resha name baavoda achat
La leolam bishte avodot uvdin hu dela itzterich leh veayede ditna lishmo veshello lishmo tena name shello lishmo velishmo
Ta shema shechato shello leochlav veshello limnuyav laarelim velitmein pasul hacha peshita baavoda achat umiddesefa baavoda achat resha name baavoda achat
Mide irya ha kidita veha kidita sefa baavoda achat resha i baavoda achat i bishte avodot
Ta shema leochlav veshello leochlav kasher hechi dame i nema bishte avodot vetama dechashshev bizrika deen machshevet ochlin bizrika
Ha baavoda achat kegon bishchita demahneya bah machshevet ochlin pasul veha kayema lan miktzat ochlin la pasla
b: Ella lav baavoda achat umiddesefa baavoda achat resha name baavoda achat
Mide irya ha kidita veha kidita sefa baavoda achat veresha o baavoda achat o bishte avodot
Ibaya lehu pesach sheshshechato bishar yemot hashshana lishmo veshello lishmo mahu mi ate shello lishmo umappek leh mide lishmo umachshir leh o la

Ki ata rav dimi amar amrita lishmata kammeh derabbi yirmeya hoil velishmo machshiro bizmanno veshello lishmo machshiro shello bizmanno ma lishmo hammachshiro bizmanno en motzio mide shello lishmo af shello lishmo hammachshiro shello bizmanno en motzio mide lishmo ufasul
Vaamar li lo im amarta beshello lishmo shekken noheg bechol hazzevachim tomar belishmo shekken eno noheg bechol hazzevachim ella bappesach bilvad
May have alah amar rava pesach sheshshechato bishar yemot hashshana lishmo veshello lishmo kasher deha setamo lishmo kae vaafilu hachi ki shachet leh shello lishmo kasher
Alma ate shello lishmo umappek leh mide lishmo ki shachet name lishmo veshello lishmo ate shello lishmo umappek leh mide lishmo

Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava dilma shane hecha deamar mehecha dela amar deha leochlav veshello leochlav kasher vechol hecha deshachet leh shello leochlav lechodeh pasul veammay ha setama leochlav kae ella shane hecha deamar mehecha dela amar hachi name shane hecha deamar mehecha dela amar
Amar leh mide irya bishlama hatam kamma dela akar leh bishchita setameh vadday lishmo kae ella hacha setameh leochlav kae
Dilma mimashchi hane veate acharine umimni illaveh acharine ditnan nimnin umoshchin et yedehem mimmennu ad sheyyishchat
Ibaya lehu pesach sheshshechato bishar yemot hashshana beshinuy bealim mahu shinuy bealim keshinuy kodesh dame umachshar leh o la

Amar rav pappa amrita lishmata kammeh derava hoil veshinuy kodesh poslo bizmanno veshinuy bealim poslo bizmanno ma shinuy kodesh shepposlo bizmanno machshiro leachar zemanno af shinuy bealim shepposlo bizmanno machshiro leachar zemanno
Veamar li lo im amarta beshinuy kodesh shekken pesulo begufo veyeshno bearba avodot

a: Veyeshno leachar mita veyeshno betzibbur kevayyachid tomar beshinuy bealim deen pesulo begufo veeno bearba avodot veeno leachar mita veeno betzibbur kevayyachid
Veaf al gav detarte lav daveka tarte miha daveka demay shena shinuy bealim dela have pesulo begufo difsulo machshava bealma hi shinuy kodesh name pesulo machshava bealma hi
Vetu ha deamar shinuy bealim eno leachar mita ulrav pinchas bereh derav amme deamar yesh shinuy bealim leachar mita may ika lememar tarte mihat daveka ninhu
Ella amar rava pesach sheshshechato bishar yemot hashshana beshinuy bealim naasa kemi sheen lo bealim bizmanno ufsul
Matni shechato shello leochlav veshello limnuyav laarelim velitmeim pasul leochlav veshello leochlav limnuyav veshello limnuyav lemulim velaarelim litmeim velithorim kasher
Shechato kodem chatzot pasul mishshum shenneemar ben haarbayim shechato kodem lattamid kasher uvilvad sheyehe acher memares bedamo ad sheyyizzarek hattamid veim nizrak kasher
Gema tanu rabbanan ketzad shello leochlav leshum chole o leshum zaken ketzad shello limnuyav nimnu alav chavura zo ushchato leshem chavura acheret
Menahane mile detanu rabbanan bemichsat melammed sheen happesach nishchat ella limnuyav
Yachol shechato shello limnuyav yehe keover al hammitzva vechasher talmud lomar bemichsat tachossu hakkatuv shana alav leakkev
Rabbi omer lashon sursi hu keadam sheomer lachavero kos li tale ze
Ashkechan shello limnuyav shello leochlav mena lan amar kera ish lefi ochlo tachossu itakkash ochlin limnuyin
b: Shechato lemulin al menat sheyyitkapperu bo arelim bizrika rav chisda amar pasul rabba amar kasher rav chisda amar pasul yesh machshevet arelim bizrika rabba amar kasher en machshevet arelim bizrika

Amar rabba mena amena lah detanya yachol yifsol bene chavura habbain immo vedin hu hoil veorla poselet vetuma poselet ma tuma lo asa bah miktzat tuma kechol tuma af orla lo asa bah miktzat orla kechol orla
O kallech lederech zo hoil veorla poselet uzman posel ma zeman asa bah miktzat zeman kechol zeman af orla asa bah miktzat orla kechol orla
Nire lemi dome danin davar sheeno noheg bechol hazzevachim middavar sheeno noheg bechol hazzevachim veal yochiach zeman shennoheg bechol hazzevachim
O kallech lederech zo danin davar shello huttar mikkelalo middavar shello huttar mikkelalo veal tochiach tuma shehuttera mikkelalah
Talmud lomar zot may zot ilema dechullah orla pasla miktzatah la pasla hay mivvechol arel nafka

Ella lav hachi katane talmud lomar vechol arel kullah orla pasla miktzatah la pasla vechi tema hu haddin lizrika dechullah orla miha pasla talmud lomar zot bishchita hu dechullah orla miha pasla aval zerika afilu kullah orla name la pasla
Vechi tema may kulla dizrika deen machshevet ochlin bizrika

Verav chisda adderabba leidach gisa talmud lomar vechol arel kullah orla pasla miktzatah la pasla aval zerika afilu miktzatah name pasla vechi tema hu haddin lizrika dead deika kullah orla la pasla talmud lomar zot shechita hu demiktzatah la pasla aval zerika afilu miktzatah pasla
Vechi tema umay chumreh dizrika dela mikkeva pigul ella bizrika

Matkef lah rav ashe mimmay dehay vechol arel kullah mashma dilma hay vechol arel mashma kol dehu orla ketav rachamana zot dead deika kullah orla la pasla la shena bishchita vela shena bizrika ella amar rav ashe rav chisda verabba

a: Behay kera kamipalgi venirtza lo lechapper alav alav velo al chavero rabba savar chavero dumya dideh ma hu devar kappara af chavero devar kappara leappoke hay arel delav bar kappara hu
Verav chisda savar hay arel name kevan devar chiyyuva hu bar kappara hu hoil dei bae metakken nafsheh
Umi it leh lerav chisda hoil veha itmar haofe miyyom tov lechol rav chisda amar loke rabba amar eno loke
Rabba amar eno loke amrinan hoil vei mikkali leh orchim chaze leh hashta name chaze leh vela lake rav chisda amar loke la amrinan hoil
Bishlama derabba adderabba la kashya hacha mechussar maase hatam dela mechussar maase ella derav chisda adderav chisda kashya amri ki let leh lerav chisda hoil lekulla lechumra it leh

Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina katane hoil vearla poselet vetuma poselet ma tuma lo asa bah miktzat tuma kechol tuma af orla lo asa miktzat orla kechol orla hay tuma hechi dame ilema betumat gavre umay lo asa bah miktzat tuma kechol tuma dei ika arbea vechamsha gavre temein vearbea vechamsha gavre tehorin la pasli lehu temein lithorin
Gabbe orla name ha la pasli ditnan lemulin velaarelim kasher may shena tuma difshita leh umay shena orla dimsappeka leh
Ella betumat basar umay lo asa bah miktzat tuma kechol tuma deilu itammi chad meevarim hay deitammi sarfinan leh veidach achlinan leh

Bemay okemta betumat basar ema sefa danin davar sheeno noheg bechol hazzevachim middavar sheeno noheg bechol hazzevachim veal yochiach zeman shennoheg bechol hazzevachim umay tuma i nema tumat basar ammay eno noheg bechol hazzevachim

Ella peshita betumat gavre umay eno noheg bechol hazzevachim deilu bechol hazzevachim arel vetame meshallechin korbenotehen veilu befesach arel vetame en meshallechin pischehen resha betumat basar vesefa betumat gavre
Amar leh in shem tuma ka farech
Veibaet ema sefa name betumat basar umay eno noheg bechol hazzevachim deilu bechol hazzevachim ben shennitma chelev uvasar kayyam ben shennitma basar vechelev kayyam zorek et haddam
Veilu befesach nitma chelev uvasar kayyam zorek et haddam nitma basar vechelev kayyam eno zorek et haddam
Bemay okemta betumat basar ema sefa danin davar shello huttar mikkelalo middavar shello huttar mikkelalo veal tochiach tuma shehare huttera mikkelalah bemay ilema
b: Betumat basar hecha huttera ella peshita betumat gavre vehecha huttera mikkelalah betzibur
Resha betumat basar sefa betumat gavre in shem tuma kafarech
Veibaet ema kullah betumat basar vehecha huttera betumat pesach ditnan pesach habba betuma neechal betuma shello ba mittechilato ella laachila
Metiv rav huna bereh derav yehoshua happesach sheavra shenato ushchato bizmanno lishmo vechen hashshochet acherim leshem pesach bizmanno rabbi eliezer posel verabbi yehoshua machshir
Tama bizmanno ha shello bizmanno kasher veammay nema hoil uvizmanno posel shello bizmanno name posel
Amar rav pappa shane hatam deamar kera vaamartem zevach pesach hu hu bahavayato lo hu leshum acherim velo acherim lishmo
Bizmanno shehu pasul leshum acherim acherim pesulin lishmo shello bizmanno shehu kasher leshum acherim acherim kesherim lishmo

Rabbi simlay ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh nitne li mar sefer yuchasin amar leh mehechan atte amar leh millod vehechan motvach binhardea amar leh en nidonin lo leluddim velo linhardeim vechol shekken deatte millod umotvach binhardea kafyeh veiratztzi

Amar leh nitneyeh bitlata yarche shekal kala petak beh amar leh uma berurya devethu derabbi meir beratte derabbi chananya ben teradon detanya telat mea shematata beoma mittelat mea rabbeota vaafilu hachi lo yatzta yede chovatah bitlat shenin veatte amratte bitlata yarche
Ki shakel veazel amar leh rabbi ma ben lishmo veshello lishmo leochlav veshello leochlav
Amar leh hoil vetzurba merabbanan atte ta veema lecha lishmo veshello lishmo pesulo begufo leochlav veshello leochlav en pesulo begufo
Lishmo veshello lishmo i efshar levarer isuro leochlav veshello leochlav efshar levarer isuro
Lishmo veshello lishmo yeshno bearba avodot leochlav veshello leochlav eno bearba avodot lishmo veshello lishmo yeshno betzibur kivyachid leochlav veshello leochlav eno betzibur kivyachid
Rav ashe amar pesulo begufo vei efshar levarer isuro chada milta hi dema taam amar pesulo begufo mishshum dei efshar levarer isuro
Amar rame bar rav yuda amar rav miyyom shennignaz sefer yuchasin tashash kochan shel chachamim vechaha meor enehem
Amar mar zutra ben atzel leatzal teinu arba mea gamle didrasha
Tanya acherim omrim hikdim mulim laarelim kasher arelim lemulim pasul may shena mulin laarelim dechasher dechullah orla baenan veleka arelim lemulin name kullah orla baenan veleka

a: Lema kasavri acherim enah lishchita ella bassof vechidrava deamar rava adayin hi machaloket
Hilkach hikdim mulin laarelim mulin chayeli arelim la chayeli hikdim arelim lemulin arelim chayeli mulin la chayeli

Amar rabba la leolam kasavri acherim yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof vehacha bemay askinan kegon sheggamar belibbo letarvayehu ben lemulin ben laarelim vehotzi befiv laarelim velo hispik lomar lemulin ad shennigmera shechita baarelim uvha peligi derabbi meir savar la baenan piv velibbo shavim verabbanan savri baenan piv velibbo shavim

Vekasavar rabbi meir la baenan piv velibbo shavin urminhu hammitkaven lomar teruma veamar maaser maaser veamar teruma o sheeni nichnas levayit ze veamar laze sheeni nehene laze veamar laze lo amar kelum ad sheyehu piv velibbo shavin

Ella amar abbaye resha deamar siman rishon lemulin vesiman sheni af laarelim divsiman sheni name petichi beh mulin sefa deamar siman rishon laarelim siman sheni lemulim divsiman rishon ha la petichi beh mulin
Verabbi meir letameh deamar mefaggelin bachatzi mattir verabbanan letamayehu deamri en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir

Matni hashshochet et happesach al hechametz over belo taase rabbi yehuda omer af hattamid rabbi shimon omer happesach bearbaa asar lishmo chayyav veshello lishmo patur ushar kol hazzevachim ben lishman uven shello lishman patur
Uvammoed lishmo patur shello lishmo chayyav ushar kol hazzevachim ben lishman ben shello lishman chayyav chutz min hachattat sheshshechato shello lishmah
Gema amar rabbi shimon ben lakish leolam eno chayyav ad sheyehe hechametz lashshochet o lazzorek
b: O leechad mibbene chavura vead sheyehe immo baazara rabbi yochanan amar af al pi sheen immo baazara bemay kamipalgi ilema beal besamuch kamipalgi derabbi shimon ben lakish savar al besamuch verabbi yochanan savar la baenan al besamuch veha ipligu bah chada zimna
Ditnan hashshochet toda lifnim velachmah chutz lachoma lo kadash hallechem

May chutz lachoma rabbi yochanan amar chutz lechomat bet page aval chutz lechomat haazara kadesh vela baenan al besamuch rabbi shimon ben lakish amar afilu chutz lechomat azara la kadesh alma baenan al besamuch
Ella behatraat safek kamipalgi beha name ha peligi vah chada zimna

Deitmar shevua sheochal kikkar zo hayyom veavar hayyom velo achalah rabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish deamri tarvayehu eno loke rabbi yochanan amar eno loke mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav aval hatraat safek shemah hatraa
Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar eno loke mishshum dehave leh hatraat safek vehatraat safek lo shemah hatraa aval lav sheen bo maase lokin alav
Amri leolam beal besamuch ka mipalgi utzricha dei ipligu leinyan chametz hava amena behahu hu dekaamar rabbi yochanan dela baenan al besamuch mishshum deisur hu vechol hecha deiteh iteh
Aval leinyan mikdash lechem la kadesh ella bifnim ema mode leh lerabbi shimon ben lakish devaenan al besamuch dei iteh gavay kadesh i la la kadesh mide dehave akkele sharet tzericha

Vei ashmeinan leinyan mikdash lechem hava amena behach kaamar rabbi shimon ben lakish devaenan al besamuch dei iteh gavay kadesh i la la kadesh aval leinyan chametz mode leh lerabbi yochanan dela baenan al besamuch deisura hu vechol hecha deiteh iteh tzericha
Bea mineh rav oshaya merabbi amme en lo lashshochet veyesh lo leechad mibbene chavura mahu amar leh mi ketiv lo tishchat al chametzcha lo tishchat al chametz ketiv
Amar leh i hachi afilu leechad besof haolam name amar leh amar kera lo tishchat velo yalin lo tishchat al chametz hanach dekayemi aleh mishshum lo yalin
Amar rav pappa hilkach kohen hammaktir et hachelev over belo taase hoil veyeshno bichlal halanat emurin

Tanya keoteh derav pappa hashshochet et happesach al hechametz over belo taase ematay bizman shehu lashshochet o lazzorek o leechad mibbene chavura haya leechad besof haolam en zakuk lo veechad hashshochet veechad hazzorek veechad hammaktir chayyav aval hammolek et haof bearbaa asar eno over belo kelum

Urminhi hashshochet et happesach al hechametz over belo taase rabbi yehuda omer af hattamid amru lo lo amru ella befesach bilvad ematay bizman sheyyesh lashshochet o lazzorek o leechad mibbene chavura haya leechad besof haolam en zakuk lo
Veechad hashshochet veechad hazzorek veechad hammolek veechad hammazze chayyav aval hakkometz et hammincha eno over belo taase hammaktir et haemurin eno over belo taase

a: Kashya melika ammelika kashya haktara ahaktara
Ultamach tikshe lach hi gufa dekatane lo amru ella befesach bilvad vahadar tane echad hashshochet veechad hazzorek veechad hammolek veechad hammazze
Ella ha veha rabbi shimon melika ammelika la kashya kan bearbaa asar kan bechullo shel moed veide veide rabbi shimon hi
Haktara ahaktara name la kashya tannae hi deika demakkesh haktara lishchita veika man dela makkesh
Rabbi yehuda omer af hattamid vechu may tama derabbi yehuda amar lach zivchi zevach hamuchad li umay nihu tamid
Rabbi shimon omer happesach bearbaa asar vechu may tama derabbi shimon dichtiv zivchi zivchi tere zimne keri beh zevach zevachay
Lemay hilcheta palginhu rachamana mehadade vela ketav zevachay lememar bizman deika zevach la michayyav azzevachay bizman deleka zevach michayyav azzevachay
Uvammoed lishmo patur vechu tama deshello lishmo ha setama patur
Ammay pesach bishar yemot hashshana shelamim have shamatte minah pesach bishar yemot hashshana bae akira
Amar rabbi chiyya bar gamda nizreka mippi chavura veamru kegon shehau bealim temee met venidchin lefesach sheni distameh leshum pesach kae
Matni happesach nishchat beshalosh kittot shenneemar veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael kahal veeda veyisrael nichnesa kat harishona nitmallea haazara naalu daltot haazara taku heriu vetaku

Hakkohanim omdim shurot shurot uvidehem bezichi chesef uvziche zahav shura shekkullah kesef kesef veshura shekkullah zahav zahav lo hau meoravin velo hau labbazichin shulayim shemma yannichum veyikkaresh haddam
Shachat yisrael vekibbel hakkohen notno lachavero vachavero lachavero umkabbel et hammale umachazir et harekan kohen hakkarov etzel hammizbeach zorko zerika achat keneged hayesod

Yatzta kat rishona venichnesa kat sheniyya yatzta sheniyya nichnesa shelishit kemaase harishona kach maase hashsheniyya vehashshelishit karu et hahallel im gamru shanu veim shanu shilleshu af al pi shello shilleshu mimehem rabbi yehuda omer mimehem shel kat shelishit lo higgiu leahavti ki yishma Adonai mippene sheammah muatin

Kemaasehu bachol kach maasehu bashshabbat ella shehakkohanim medichim et haazara shello birtzon chachamim rabbi yehuda omer kos haya memalle middam hattaarovet zerako zerika achat al gabbe hammizbeach velo hodu lo chachamim

Ketzad tolin umafshitin unkelaot shel barzel hau kevuim bakketalim uvaammudim shebbahen tolin umafshitin kol mi sheen lo makom litlot ulhafshit maklot dakkim vachalakim hau sham manniach al ketefo veal ketef chavero vetole umafshit rabbi eliezer omer arbaa asar
b: Shechal lihot bashshabbat manniach yado al ketef chavero veyad chavero al ketefo vetole umafshit kerao vehotzi et emurav netano bemages vehiktiran al gabbe hammizbeach
Yatzta kat harishona veyashva lah behar habbayit sheniyya bachel vehashshelishit bimkomah omedet chashecha yatzu vetzalu et pischehen
Gema amar rabbi yitzchak en happesach nishchat ella beshalosh kittot shel sheloshim sheloshim bene adam may tama kahal veeda veyisrael mesappeka lan i bevat achat i beze achar ze

Hilkach baenan shalosh kittot shel sheloshim sheloshim bene adam dei bevat achat ha ika vei baze achar ze ha ika hilkach bechamshin name saggi deayeli telatin veavdi ayeli asra venafki asra ayeli asra venafki asra
Nichnesa kat rishona vechu itmar abbaye amar ninalu tenan rava amar noalin tenan
May benayehu ika benayehu lemismach annisa abbaye amar ninalu tenan kamma daayalu meallu vesamchinan annisa rava amar noalin tenan vela samchinan annisa

Veha ditnan amar rabbi yehuda chas veshalom sheakavya ben mahalalel nitnadda sheen azara ninelet al kol adam beyisrael bechochma uvyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel abbaye metaretz letameh verava metaretz letameh abbaye metaretz letameh en baazara beshaa shenninala al kol adam beyisrael bechochma uvyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel rava metaretz letameh en baazara beshaa shennoalin otah al kol yisrael bechochma uvyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel
Tanu rabbanan meolam la nitmaech adam baazara chutz mippesach echad shehaya bime hillel shennitmaech bo zaken echad vehau korin oto pesach meuchin

Tanu rabbanan paam achat bikesh agripas hammelech liten enav beuchluse yisrael amar leh lechohen gadol ten enecha bappesachim natal kulya mikkol echad venimtzeu sham shishshim ribo zuge chelaot kiflayim keotze mitzrayim chutz mittame veshehaya bederech rechoka veen lach kol pesach ufesach shello nimnu alav yoter measara bene adam vehau korin oto pesach meubbin
Natal kulya ha bae akturah dahadar makter lehu vehachtiv vehiktiro shello yearev chalavav shel ze baze
Dahadar makter lehu chada chada vehatanya vehiktiram sheyehe kullo keechad ella tefisa bealma deshakel minayehu ad deyahavin leh mide acharina
Kohanim omdin shurot vechu may tama ilema dilma shakli dedahava umayeli dechaspa hachi name dilma shakli bar matan umayeli bar mea ella dehachi shappir tefe
Velo hau labbazichin shulayim vechu tanu rabbanan kol habbazichin shebbammikdash lo hau lahen shulayim chutz mibbeziche levona shel lechem happanim shemma yannichum veyifros hallechem
Shachat yisrael vekibbel hakkohen vechu la saggi delav yisrael hi gufa ka mashma lan dishchita bezar keshera vekibbel hakkohen ha kamashma lan mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna
Notno lachavero shamatte minah holacha shello baregel haveya holacha dilma hu nayed purta veella may ka mashma lan ha kamashma lan berov am hadrat melech
Kibbel et hammale umachzir et harekan vechu aval ipcha la mesayya leh lerabbi shimon ben lakish deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish en maavirin al hammitzot
Kohen hakkarov etzel hammizbeach vechu man tana pesach bizrika amar rav chisda rabbi yose haggelili hi

Detanya rabbi yose haggelili omer et damam tizrok al hammizbeach veet chelbam taktir damo lo neemar ella damam chelbo lo neemar ella chelbam limmed al bechor umaaser ufesach shehen teunin mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach

Menalan ditunin yesod amar rabbi elazar atya zerika zerika meola ketiv hacha et damam tizrok al hammizbeach uchtiv hatam vezarku bene aharon hakkohanim et damo al hammizbeach saviv ma ola teuna yesod af pesach name taun yesod

a: Veola gufah menalan amar kera el yesod mizbach haola alma ola teuna yesod
Yatzta kat rishona vechu tana hi nikret kat atzlanit veha la saggi delav hachi may have lehu lemibad

Afilu hachi ibi lehu lezaroze nafshayehu kidtanya rabbi omer i efshar leolam belo bassam uvlo bursi ashre mi sheummanuto bassam oy lo mi sheummanuto bursi vei efshar leolam belo zecharim uvlo nekevot ashre mi shebbanav zecharim oy lo mi shebbanav nekevot
Kemaasehu bachol vechu shello birtzon man amar rav chisda shello birtzon rabbi eliezer dei rabbanan ha amri shevut hu veen shevut bemikdash

May hi detanya echad hacholev vehamchabbetz vehamgabben kigrogrot hamchabbed vehamrabbetz veharode challot devash beshogeg beshabbat chayyav chattat hezid beom tov loke et haarbaim divre rabbi eliezer
Vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze eno ella mishshum shevut
Rav ashe amar afilu tema shello birtzon chachamim verabbi natan hi detanya rabbi natan omer shevut tzericha hittiru shevut sheenah tzericha lo hittiru
Rabbi yehuda omer kos haya memalle vechu tanya rabbi yehuda omer kos haya memalle middam hattaarovot sheim yishshafech damo shel echad mehen nimtza ze machshiro
Amru lo lerabbi yehuda vahalo lo nitkabbel bichli mena yadi ella hachi kaamri leh shemma lo nitkabbel bichli amar lahen af ani lo amarti ella benitkabbel bichli
Mena yada kohanim zerizin hen i zerizin ammay mishtefich aggav zerizutayehu deavdi mishtefich
Vahalo dam hattamtzit meorav bo rabbi yehuda letameh deamar dam hattamtzit dam mealleya hu detanya dam hattamtzit beazhara rabbi yehuda omer behikaret
Vehaamar rabbi elazar mode rabbi yehuda leinyan kappara sheeno mechapper shenneemar ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper
b: Dam shehannefesh yotza bo mechapper dam sheen hannefesh yotza bo eno mechapper ella rabbi yehuda letameh deamar en dam mevattel dam
Tanya amar lahen rabbi yehuda lachachamim ledivrechem lamma pokkin et haazara amru lo shevach hu livne aharon sheyyelchu ad arkubbotehem bedam
Veha ka chayetz lach hu veeno chotzetz kidtanya haddam vehaddeo vehechalav vehaddevash yeveshim chotztzin lachin en chotztzin

Veha kamittavvesi manayehu utnan hau begadav metushtashin veavad avodato pesula vechi tema dimdallu lehu lemanayehu vehatanya middo bad middo kemiddato shello yechasser velo yotir beholachat evarin lakkevesh delav avoda hi
Vela veha middevae kehunna avoda hi detanya vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha zo holachat evarim lakkevesh ella beholachat etzim lammaaracha delav avoda hi
Beholachat evarim lakkevesh uvholachat dam miha hechi azli dimsaggi aitzteve
Ketzad tolin umafshitin vechu kerao vehotziu et emurav netanam bemages lehaktiram attu hu gufeh hava maktar lehu ema lehaktiran al gabbe hammizbeach
Yatzta kat rishona vechu tana kol echad veechad noten pischo beoro umafshil laachorav amar rav ilish tayyaut
Hadaran alach tamid nishchat

Matni ellu devarim bappesach dochin et hashshabbat shechitato uzrikat damo umichuy keravav vehaktarat chalavav aval tzeliyyato vahadachat keravav enan dochin et hashshabbat harkavato vahavaato michutz lattechum vachatichat yabbalto en dochin et hashshabbat rabbi eliezer omer dochin

Amar rabbi eliezer vahalo din hu ma im shechita shehi mishshum melacha docha et hashshabbat ellu shehen mishshum shevut lo yidchu et hashshabbat amar leh rabbi yehoshua yom tov yochiach shehittiru bo mishshum melacha veasur bo mishshum shevut

Amar leh rabbi eliezer ma ze yehoshua ma reaya reshut lemitzva heshiv rabbi akiva veamar hazzaa tochiach shehi mishshum mitzva vehi mishshum shevut veenah docha et hashshabbat af atta al titmah al ellu sheaf al pi shehen mishshum mitzva vehen mishshum shevut lo yidchu et hashshabbat
Amar lo rabbi eliezer vealeha ani dan uma im shechita shehi mishshum melacha docha et hashshabbat hazzaa shehi mishshum shevut eno din sheddocha et hashshabbat

a: Amar lo rabbi akiva o chilluf ma im hazzaa shehi mishshum shevut enah docha et hashshabbat shechita shehi mishshum melacha eno din shello tidche et hashshabbat amar lo rabbi eliezer akiva akarta ma shekkatuv battora bemoado ben bachol ben bashshabbat

Amar lo rabbi have li moed leellu kemoed lashshechita kelal amar rabbi akiva kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat enah docha et hashshabbat shechita shei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat docha et hashshabbat

Gema tanu rabbanan halacha zo nitallema mibbene vetira paam achat chal arbaa asar lihot beshabbat shachchu velo yadu im pesach doche et hashshabbat im lav amru kelum yesh adam sheyyodea im pesach doche et hashshabbat im lav amru lahem adam echad yesh sheala mibbavel vehillel habbavli shemo sheshshimesh shene gedole haddor shemaya veavtalon veodea im pesach doche et hashshabbat im lav shalchu vekaru lo amru lo kelum atta yodea im happesach doche et hashshabbat im lav amar lahem vechi pesach echad yesh lanu bashshana sheddoche et hashshabbat vahalo harbe yoter mimmatayim pesachim yesh lanu bashshana sheddochin et hashshabbat
Amru lo minnayin lecha amar lahem neemar moado bappesach veneemar moado battamid ma moado haamur battamid doche et hashshabbat af moado haamur bappesach doche et hashshabbat
Veod kal vachomer hu uma tamid sheen anush karet doche et hashshabbat pesach sheanush karet eno din sheddoche et hashshabbat

Miyyad hoshivuhu barosh uminuhu nasi alehem vehaya doresh kol hayyom kullo behilchot happesach hitchil mekanteran bidvarim amar lahen mi garam lachem sheele mibbavel veehye nasi alechem atzlut shehayeta bachem shello shimmashtem shene gedole haddor shemaya veavtalon
Amru lo rabbi shachach velo hevi sakkin meerev shabbat mahu amar lahen halacha zo shamati veshachachti ella hannach lahen leyisrael im en neviim hen bene neviim hen
Lemachar mi sheppischo tale tochavo betzamro mi sheppischo gedi tochavo ben karnav raa maase venizkar halacha veamar kach mekubbelani mippi shemaya veavtalon

Amar mar neemar moado bappesach veneemar moado betamid ma moado haamur battamid doche et hashshabbat af moado haamur bappesach doche shabbat vetamid gufeh menalan dedache shabbat ilema mishshum dichtiv beh bemoado pesach name ha ketiv beh moado
Ella moado la mashma leh hacha name moado la mashma leh ella amar kera olat shabbat beshabbatto al olat hattamid mikkelal ola detamid kereva beshabbat

Amar mar veod kal vachomer uma tamid sheen anush karet doche et hashshabbat pesach sheanush karet eno din sheddoche et hashshabbat ika lemifrach ma letamid shekken tadir vechalil kal vachomer amar lehu beresha ufarchuh vahadar amar lehu gezera shava

Vechi meachar degamar gezera shava kal vachomer lema li ella ledidhu kaamar lehu bishlama gezera shava la gamritu deen adam dan gezera shava meatzmo ella kal vachomer deadam dan meatzmo ibi lechu lemedan amaru leh kal vachomer pericha hu
Amar mar lemachar mi sheppischo tale tochev lo betzamro gedi tochev lo ben karnav
b: Veha ka aved avoda bekadashim kehillel detanya amru alav al hillel miyyamav lo maal adam beolato ella meviah chullin laazara umakdishah vesomech yado aleha veshochatah
Pesach beshabbat hechi matze makdesh leh vehatnan en makdishin veen maarichin veen machrimin veen magbihin teruma umaasrot kol ellu beom tov amru kal vachomer bashshabbat
Hane mile bechovot sheen kavua lahen zeman aval bechovot shekkavua lahen zeman makdishin deamar rabbi yochanan makdish adam et pischo beshabbat vachagigato beom tov
Vahalo mechammer mechammer kilachar yad mechammer kilachar yad name nehi deisura deorayeta leka isura midderabbanan miha ika

Hayenu deka bae mineh davar sheyyesh lo heter min hattora udvar shevut omed lefanav leokro kilachar yad bimkom mitzva may amar lahen halacha zo shamati veshachachti ella hannichu lahen leyisrael im en neviim hen bene neviim hen

Amar rav yehuda amar rav kol hammityaher im chacham hu chochmato mistalleket mimmennu im navi hu nevuato mistalleket mimmennu im chacham hu chochmato mistalleket mimmennu mehillel deamar mar hitchil mekanteran bidvarim vekaamar lehu halacha zo shamati veshachachti im navi hu nevuato mistalleket mimmennu middevora dichtiv chadlu ferazon beyisrael chadellu ad shakkamti devora shakkamti em beyisrael vego uchtiv uri uri devora uri uri dabberi shir vego

Resh lakish amar kol adam shekkoes im chacham hu chochmato mistalleket mimmennu im navi hu nevuato mistalleket mimmennu im chacham hu chochmato mistalleket mimmennu mimmoshe dichtiv vayyiktzof moshe al pekude hechayil vego uchtiv vayyomer elazar hakkohen el anshe hatztzava habbaim lammilchama zot chukkat hattora asher tziva Adonai et moshe vego mikkelal demoshe ialam mineh

Im navi hu nevuato mistalleket mimmennu meelisha dichtiv lule pene yehoshafat melech yehuda ani nose im abbit elecha veim erekka vego uchtiv veatta kechu li menaggen vehaya kenaggen hamnaggen vattehi alav yad Adonai vego

Amar rabbi mani bar pattish kol shekkoes afilu poskin alav gedulla min hashshamayim moridin oto menalan meeliav shenneemar vayyichar af eliav bedavid vayyomer lamma ze yaradta veal mi natashta meat hatztzon hahenna bammidbar ani yadati et zedoncha veet roa levavecha ki lemaan reot hammilchama yaradta vechi azal shemuel lemimshechinhu bechullehu ketiv lo baze vachar Adonai uveeliav ketiv vayyomer Adonai el shemuel al tabbet el marehu veel gevoha komato ki meastihu mikkelal dahava rachem leh ad haidana
Ashkechan tamid ufesach dedachu shabbat dedachu tuma mena lan amri ki hechi deyalef pesach mittamid leinyan shabbat hachi name yalef tamid mippesach leinyan tuma
Ufesach gufeh mena lan amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera ish ish ki yihye tame lanefesh ish nidche lefesach sheni veen tzibur nidchin lefesach sheni ella avdi betuma
Amar leh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan ema ish nidche lefesach sheni tzibur let lehu takkanta la befesach rishon vela befesach sheni

Ella amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mehacha vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanafesh yeamer temee metim veal yeamer zavin umtzorain vaani omer im temee metim mishtalchin zavin umtzorain lo kol shekken

a: Ella yesh lecha shaa shezzavin umtzorain mishtallechin veen temee metim mishtallechin veeze ze pesach habba betuma

Amar abbaye i hachi lema name yeamer zav utmee metim veal yeamer metzora vaani omer zav mishtalleach metzora lo kol shekken ella yesh lecha shaa shemmetzorain mishtallechin veen zavin utmee metim mishtallechin veeze ze pesach habba betuma
Vechi tema hachi name vehatnan pesach habba betuma lo yochlu mimmennu zavim vezavot niddot veoldot veim achlu peturin
Ella amar abbaye leolam mikkera kamma im ken nichtov rachamana ish ish ki yihye tame lanefesh lema li

Vechi tema hay lanefesh lehachi hu daata hatteme met hu denidche lefesach sheni aval shear temein la vehatanya yachol lo yehu osin pesach sheni ella temee metim veshehaya bederech rechoka zavin umtzorain uvoale niddot minnayin talmud lomar ish ish lanefesh dichtav rachamana lema li
Ella hachi kaamar ish nidche lefesach sheni veen tzibur nidche lefesach sheni ella avdi betuma vechi avdi tzibur betuma bitme met aval shear tumot la avdi
Amar rav chisda metzora shennichnas lefanim mimmechitzato patur shenneemar badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo
Badad yeshev levaddo yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo hakkatuv nitteko laase
Etiveh metzora shennichnas lifnim mimmechitzato bearbaim zavin vezavot shennichnesu lifnim mimmechitzatan bearbaim utme met muttar likanes lemachane leviyya
Velo teme met bilvad amru ella afilu met atzmo shenneemar vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo immo bimchitzato

Tannae hi detanya badad yeshev levaddo yeshev shello yehu temein acherim yoshvin immo yachol yehu zavin utmee metim mishtallechin lemachane achat talmud lomar velo yetammeu et machanehem liten machane laze umachane laze divre rabbi yehuda

Rabbi shimon omer eno tzarich hare hu omer vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanefesh yeamer temee met veal yeamer temee zav vaani omer temee metim mishtallechin zavin lo kol shekken lamma neemar zav liten lo machane sheniyya
Veyeamer zav veal yeamer metzora vaani omer zavin mishtallechin metzorain lo kol shekken lamma neemar metzora liten lo machane shelishit keshehu omer badad yeshev hakkatuv nitteko laase
May chumreh dezav mitteme met shekken tuma yotza alav miggufo adderabba teme met chamur shekken taun hazzaa shelishi ushvii
Amar kera tame vechol tame lerabbot teme sheretz vezav chamur mitteme sheretz
Umay chumreh kedaamaran adderabba sheretz chamur shekken metamme beones amri
b: Ki hay gavena zav name tammoye metamme beones kidrav huna deamar rav huna reiyya rishona shel zav metammea beones
May chumreh dimtzora mizzav shekken taun peria ufrima veasur betashmish hammitta adderabba zav chamur shekken metamme mishkav umoshav umtamme keli cheres beheset
Amar kera zav vechol zav lerabbot baal keri umtzora chamur mibbaal keri
Umay chumreh kedaamaran adderabba baal keri chamur shekken metamme bemashshehu
Savar lah kerabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer mishshum rabbi yishmael zav tzarich kachatimat pi haamma velo hodu lo chachamim veitakkash leh baal keri lezav
Vechol tzarua lema li ayede dichtiv kol zav ketiv name kol tzarua
Verabbi yehuda shappir kaamar rabbi shimon

Hahu mibe leh lechidtanya rabbi eliezer omer yachol dachaku zavin umtzorain venichnesu laazara befesach habba betuma yachol yehu chayyavin talmud lomar vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanefesh beshaa shettemee metim mishtallechin zavin umtzorain mishtallechin en temee metim mishtallechin en zavin umtzorain mishtallechin
Amar mar zav vechol zav lerabbot baal keri mesayya leh lerabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan mechilot lo nitkaddeshu uvaal keri mishtalleach chutz lishte machanot
Metivi baal keri kemagga sheretz may lav lemachanotam lo letumatam
Letumatam hay tumat erev ketiv beh vehay tumat erev ketiv beh ella lav lemachanotam
La leolam letumatam veha kamashma lan devaal keri kemagga sheretz ma magga sheretz metamme beones af baal keri metamme beones
Metivi

a: Boel nidda kitme met lemay ilema letumatam hay tumat shiva ketiv beh vehay tumat shiva ketiv beh
Ella lav lemachanotam umiddesefa lemachanotam have resha name lemachanotam mide irya ha kidita veha kidita
Metivi metzora chamur mizzav vezav chamur mitteme met yatza baal keri shetteme met chamur mimmennu
May yatza lav yatza mikkelal zav uva lichlal teme met deha teme met chamur mimmennu umuttar bemachane leviyya
Lo yatza mimmachane teme met venichnas lemachane zav veaf al gav ditme met chamur mimmennu demuttar bemachane leviyya lemay dedame leh medammenan leh
Tane tanna kammeh derav yitzchak bar avdimi veyatza el michutz lammachane zo machane shechina lo yavo el toch hammachane zo machane leviyya mikkan levaal keri sheyyetze chutz lishte machanot
Amar leh akkatti la ayyelteh appekteh lishana acharina akkatti la appekteh ayyelteh ella ema michutz lammachane zo machane leviyya la yavo el toch hammachane zo machane shechina

Matkef lah ravina ema ide veide lemachane shechina velaavor alav baase velo taase im ken lema kera veyatza el michutz lammachane velo yavo el toch hammachane lema li shema minah liten lo machane acheret
Umichuy keravav vechu may michuy keravav rav huna amar shemmenakkevan besakkin rav chiyya bar rav amar shirka dimiyya denafka aggav duchka desakkina
Amar rabbi eliezer may tama dechiyya bar rav dichtiv vechorvot mechim garim yochelu may mashma kedimtargem rav yosef venichsehon derashshiayya tzaddikayya yachsenun

Verau chevasim kedovram amar menashsheya bar yirmeya amar rav kamdubbar bam may kamdubbar bam amar abbaye vechorvot mechim garim yochelu amar leh rava bishlama i ketiv chorvot kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv vechorvot milta achariti kaamar
Ella amar rava kidrav chananel amar rav deamar rav chananel amar rav atidin tzaddikim sheyechayyu et hammetim ketiv hacha verau chevasim kedovram uchtiv hatam yiru vashan vegilad kime olam

Bashan ze elisha habba min habbashan shenneemar veyanay veshafat babbashan uchtiv po elisha ben shafat asher yatzak mayim al yede eliyyahu gilad ze eliyyahu shenneemar vayyomer eliyyahu hattishbi mittoshave gilad vego

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan atidim tzaddikim sheyechayyu metim shenneemar od yeshvu zekenim uzkenot birchovot yerushalam veish mishanto beyado merov yamim uchtiv vesamta mishanti al pene hannaar

Ulla rame ketiv billa hammavet lanetzach uchtiv ki hannaar ben mea shana yamut la kashya kan beyisrael kan baggoyim vegoyim may bau hatam dichtiv veamdu zarim verau tzonchem uvne nechar ikkarechem vechormechem
Rav chisda rame ketiv vechafra hallevana uvosha hachamma uchtiv vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shivat hayyamim la kashya kan laolam habba kan limot hammashiach
Velishmuel deamar en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud malchiyyot bilvad may ika lememar ide veide laolam habba vela kashya kan bemachane shechina kan bemachane tzaddikim
Rava rame ketiv ani amit vaachayye uchtiv machatzti vaani erpa hashta achoye machaye merappe lo kol shekken ella amar hakkadosh baruch hu ma sheani memit ani mechayye kemo shemmachatzti vaani erpa

Tanu rabbanan ani amit vaachayye yachol mita beechad vechayyim beechad kederech shehaolam noheg talmud lomar machatzti vaani erpa ma makka urfua beechad af mita vechayyim beechad mikkan teshuva laomrim en techiyyat hammetim min hattora davar acher battechilla ma sheani memit ani mechayye vahadar ma shemmachatzti vaani erpa
b: Vehekter chalavav vechu tanya amar rabbi shimon bo ure kamma chaviva mitzva bishatah shehare hekter chalavim veevarim ufdarim kesherim kol hallayela veen mamtinim lahem ad shettechshach
Harkavato vahavaato vechu urminhu chotchin yabbelet bammikdash aval lo bammedina veim bichli kan vechan asur
Rabbi elazar verabbi yose bar chanina chad amar ide veide bayyad ha belacha ha bivesha vechad amar ide veide belacha vela kashya ha bayyad ha bichli
Ulman deamar ha bayyad ha bichli may tama la amar ide veide bayyad vela kashya ha belacha ha bivesha amar lach yevesha mifrach pericha
Ulman deamar ide veide bayyad vela kashya ha belacha ha bivesha may tama la amar ide veide belacha vela kashya ha bayyad ha bichli amar lach keli ha katane hatam im bichli kan vechan asur
Veidach ha dekatane keli hacha pelugta derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua ata leashmoinan
Amar rabbi eliezer uma im shechita vechu rabbi yehoshua letameh deamar simchat yom tov name mitzva hi
Detanya rabbi eliezer omer en lo leadam beom tov ella o ochel veshote o yoshev veshone rabbi yehoshua omer challekehu chetzo laachila ushtiyya vechetzo levet hammidrash

Veamar rabbi yochanan ushnehem mikra echad darshu katuv echad omer atzeret la elohecha vechatuv echad omer atzeret tihye lachem rabbi eliezer savar o kullo la o kullo lachem verabbi yehoshua savar challekehu chetzo la vechetzo lachem

Siman amar rabbi elazar hakkol modim baatzeret devaenan name lachem may tama yom shennitna bo tora hu amar rabba hakkol modim beshabbat devaenan name lachem may tama vekarata lashshabbat oneg amar rav yosef hakkol modim befurim devaenan name lachem may tama yeme mishte vesimcha ketiv beh

Mar bereh deravina kullah shatta hava yatev betaanita levar meatzarta ufurya umaale yoma dechipure atzeret yom shennitna bo tora purya yeme mishte vesimcha ketiv maale yoma dechipure detane chiyya bar rav middifti veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha lachodesh vechi betisha hem mitannin vahalo baasiri mitannin ella lomar lecha kol haochel veshote betisha bo maale alav hakkatuv keilu mitanne teshii vaasiri
Rav yosef beoma daatzarta amar avdi li igla tilta amar i la hay yoma deka garem kamma yosef ika beshuka

Rav sheshet kol telatin yomin mehaddar leh talmudeh vetale vekae beivra dedashsha vaamar chaday nafshay chaday nafshay lach keray lach tenay ini vehaamar rabbi elazar ilmale tora lo nitkayemu shamayim vaaretz shenneemar im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti meikara ki aved inish addata denafsheh ka aved

Amar rav ashe ulmay dekaamar rabbi eliezer name yom tov reshut it leh pircha uma yom tov shehittir bo melacha shel reshut lo hittir shevut sheimmah shabbat shello hittir bah ella melacha shel mitzva eno din shello tattir shevut sheimmah

a: Verabbi eliezer shevut demitzva adif leh
Tanya amar rabbi eliezer uma li im dachu machshire mitzva shelleachar shechita et hashshabbat deitavid leh mitzva lo yidchu machshire mitzva shellifne shechita et hashshabbat

Amar lo rabbi akiva dema li im dachu machshire mitzva shelleachar shechita et hashshabbat shehare dachata shechita et hashshabbat tomar yidchu machshire mitzva shellifne shechita et hashshabbat shello dachata shechita et hashshabbat davar acher shemma yimmatze zevach pasul venimtza mechallel et hashshabbat lemafrea
I hachi mishchat name la nishchot shemma yimmatze zevach pasul venimtza mechallel et hashshabbat lemafrea ella ha amar leh beresha ufarcheh vahadar amar leh hach dema li im dachu

Heshiv rabbi akiva veamar hazzaa tochiach vechu tanya amar lo rabbi eliezer akiva bishchita heshavtani bishchita tehe mitato amar lo rabbi al tachpireni bishat haddin kach mekubbelani mimmecha hazzaa shevut hi veenah docha et hashshabbat
Vechi meachar dehu agmereh may tama ka hadar beh amar ulla rabbi eliezer ki agmereh hazzaa ditruma agmereh ditruma gufah la dachaya shabbat
Rabbi akiva name ki otveh hazzaa ditruma otveh shehi mitzva vehi mishshum shevut vehu savar hazzaa defesach ka motev leh
Metiv rabba heshiv rabbi akiva veamar hazzaat teme met tochiach shechal shevii shello lihot bashshabbat uverev happesach shehi mitzva vehi mishshum shevut veenah docha et hashshabbat

Ella vaday hazzaa defesach agmereh vechi meachar deagmereh may tama ka parech leh rabbi eliezer rabbi eliezer gemareh itakar leh vaata rabbi akiva leadkore gemareh venema leh behedya savar lav orach ara
Vehazzaa may tama la dachaya shabbat mikkede taltole bealma hu tiddeche shabbat mishshum pesach amar rabba gezera shemma yittelenna veyaavirenna arba ammot birshut harabbim

Ulrabbi eliezer nabereh deha amar rabbi eliezer machshire mitzva dochin et hashshabbat amri hane mile hecha degavra gufeh chaze urme chiyyuva aleh aval hacha degavra gufeh la chaze la reme chiyyuva aleh
Amar rabba ledivre rabbi eliezer katan bari mechammin lo chammin lehavroto ulmulo beshabbat deha chaze leh katan chole en mechammin lo chammin lehavroto ulmulo deha la chaze leh
Amar rava vei bari hu lema leh chammin lehavroto ella amar rava hakkol cholin hen etzel mila echad katan bari veechad katan chole en mechammin lo chammin lehavroto ulmulo beshabbat deha la chaze
Etiveh abbaye arel shello mal anush karet divre rabbi eliezer veha hacha degavra gufeh la chaze vekatane anush karet alma reme chiyyuva aleh
Amar rabba kasavar rabbi eliezer en shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz
b: Vechol sheilu beyachid nidche betzibur avdi betuma vechol milta deita betzibur ita beyachid vechol milta deleta betzibur leta beyachid
Arelut dei kulleh tzibur arelim ninhu amrinan lehu kumu mehulu nafshayechu vaavide pischa yachid name amrinan leh kum mehol vaaved pischa vei la mahel veaved anush karet
Tuma dei kulleh tzibura temein ninhu la maddenan alayehu ella avdi betuma yachid name patur
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava vahare pesach sheni deleteh betzibur veiteh beyachid amar leh shane hatam deha avad leh tzibura berishon
Metivi yachol lo yehe anush karet ella shehaya tahor veshello haya bederech rechoka arel utme sheretz ushar kol hattemeim minnayin talmud lomar vehaish

Middeka mehaddar atteme sheretz kasavar en shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz dei shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz lema leh leahadore aleh hayenu tahor alma af al gav dela chaze chiyyuva aleh veaf al gav deleteh betzibur iteh beyachid
Ella amar rava kasavar rabbi eliezer shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz vehu haddin litme met bishvii shello hazzaa lemay laachila achilat pesachim la meakkeva
Amar leh rav adda bar abba lerava im ken nimtza pesach nishchat shello leochlav amar leh shello leochlav lechole ulzaken dela chaze aval hay michze chaze takkone hu dela metakkan

Kelal amar rabbi akiva vechu amar rav yehuda amar rav halacha kerabbi akiva utnan name gabbe mila ki hay gavena kelal amar rabbi akiva kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat enah docha et hashshabbat mila shei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat docha et hashshabbat veamar rav yehuda amar rav halacha kerabbi akiva
Utzricha dei ashmeinan gabbe fesach hatam dehu machshire mitzva la dachu shabbat mishshum delo nichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot aval mila denichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot ema lidche
Vei ashmeinan mila hatam hu demachshire mitzva la dachu shabbat deleka karet aval pesach deika karet ema lidche tzericha
Matni ematay mevi chagiga immo bizman shehu ba bachol betahora uvmuat uvizman shehu ba beshabbat bimrubbe uvtuma en meviin immo chagiga
Chagiga hayeta baa min hatztzon min habbakar min hakkevasim umin haizzim min hazzecharim umin hannekevot veneechelet lishne yamim velayela echad
Gema may tanna dekatane chagiga tana harkavato vahavaato dela dache shabbat vekatane name chagiga dela dachaya shabbat vehachi kaamar ematay meviin immo chagiga bizman shehu ba bechol betohora uvmuat
Amar rav ashe shema minah chagigat arbaa asar

a: Lav chova hi dei salka datach chova hi tete beshabbat vetete bimrubbe vetete betuma
Uvmuat mihu may tama atya kidtanya chagiga habbaa im happesach neechelet techila kede sheyehe pesach neechal al hassava

Veneechelet lishne yamim vechu matnitin dela keven tema detanya ben tema omer chagiga habbaa im happesach hare hi kappesach veenah neechelet ella leom valayela vachagigat chamishsha asar neechelet lishne yamim velayela echad
Vachagigat arbaa asar yotze bah mishshum simcha veen yotze bah mishshum chagiga
May tama deven tema kidmatne rav lechiyya bereh velo yalin labboker zevach chag happasach zevach chag ze chagiga happasach kemashmao veamar rachamana lo yalin
Ibaya lehu leven tema neechelet tzali o en neechelet tzali ki akkesheh rachamana lefesach lelina aval letzali la o dilma la shena
Ta shema hallayela hazze kullo tzali veamar rav chisda zo divre ben tema shema minah
Ibaya lehu leven tema baa min habbakar o enah baa min habbakar baa min hannekevot o enah baa min hannekevot baa bat shette shanim o enah baa bat shette shanim
Ki akkesheh rachamana lefesach lemide daachila aval lechol mile la o dilma la shena

Ta shema chagiga habbaa im happesach hare hi kefesach baa min hatztzon veenah baa min habbakar baa min hazzecharim veenah baa min hannekevot baa bat shenatah veenah baa bat shette shanim veenah neechelet ella leom valayela veenah neechelet ella tzali veenah neechelet ella limnuyav
Man shamatte leh deit leh hay sevara ben tema shema minah kullehu milta baenan shema minah

Ibaya lehu leven tema yesh bah mishshum shevirat etzem o en bah mishshum shevirat haetzem af al gav dechi akkesheh rachamana lefesach amar kera bo bo velo bachagiga o dilma hay bo bechasher velo befasul hu daata
Ta shema sakkin shennimtzet bearbaa asar shochet bah miyyad bishlosha asar shone umatbil kofitz ben baze uven baze shone umatbil
Manni ilema rabbanan may shena sakkin dematbil dechazya lefesach kofitz name ha chaze lachagiga
Ella lav deven tema hi ushma minah yesh bah mishshum shevirat haetzem
La leolam rabbanan uchgon shebba bashshabbat
Veha middekatane sefa chal arbaa asar lihot beshabbat shochet bah miyyad uvachamishsha asar shochet bah miyyad nimtzet kofitz keshura lesakkin hare hi kassakkin mikkelal deresha lav beshabbat askinan
Veella shebba
