Veella shebba betuma sof sof mena yadi
Demit nasi demit nasi emat ilema demit bishlosha asar sakkin lema li dematbeleh veella demit bearbaa asar may shena sakkin dematbel umay shena kofitz dela matbel leh
La tzericha denasi goses bishlosha asar sakkin dechad sefeka matbel leh kofitz ditre sefeke la matbel leh

Tanya yehuda ben dortay perash hu vedortay beno vehalach veyashav lo baddarom amar im yavo eliyyahu veyomar lahem leyisrael mippene ma lo chagagtem chagiga bashshabbat ma hen omrim lo temehani al shene gedole haddor shemaya veavtalon shehen chachamim gedolim vedarshanin gedolim velo amru lahen leyisrael chagiga docha et hashshabbat

Amar rav may tama deven dortay dichtiv vezavachta pesach la elohecha tzon uvakar vahalo en pesach ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim ella tzon ze pesach bakar zo chagiga veamar rachamana vezavachta pesach
Amar rav ashe vaanan tama difrushim neku venifrosh ella kera lechidrav nachman hu daata deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh minnayin lemotar happesach shekkarev shelamim

Shenneemar vezavachta pesach la elohecha tzon uvakar vechi pesach min habbakar ba vahalo en pesach ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim ella motar happesach yehe ledavar habba min hatztzon umin habbakar
Verabbanan may tama la dache shabbat ha vadday korban tzibur hu
Amar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi yehuda ben safra amar kera vechaggotem oto chag la shivat yamim bashshana shiva shemona hao ella mikkan lachagiga sheenah docha et hashshabbat

Ki ata ravin amar amarti lifne rabbotay peamim shei atta motze ella shishsha kegon shechal yom tov harishon shel chag bashshabbat amar abbaye avin takkala lema ki ha milta shemona la mashkachatte lah kelal shiva ita berov shanim
Amar ulla amar rabbi elazar shelamim sheshshechatan meerev yom tov eno yotze bahen lo mishshum simcha velo mishshum chagiga mishshum simcha dichtiv vezavachta vesamachta baenan zevicha

a: Bishat simcha veleka mishshum chagiga have davar shebbechova vechol davar shebbechova eno ba ella min hachullin
Lema mesayya leh vehayita ach sameach lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon lesimcha atta omer lele yom tov haacharon o eno ella lele yom tov harishon talmud lomar ach sameach chalak
May tama lav mishshum deen lo bamme yismach
La kidtane tama ma raita lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon ulhotzi lele yom tov rishon merabbe ani lele yom tov haacharon sheyyesh simcha lefanav umotzi ani lele yom tov rishon sheen simcha lefanav
Metiv rav yosef chagigat arbaa asar yotze bah mishshum simcha veen yotze bah mishshum chagiga ammay ha baenan zevicha bishat simcha veleka amar rav idi bar avin sheikev ushchatah
Amar rav ashe hachi name mistabbera dei la tema hachi ha matnita man katane lah ben tema ben tema ha pasla lah belina shema minah

Metiv rava hahallel vehassimcha shemona vei amratte baenan zevicha bishat simcha ha zimnin saggiin dela mashkachatte lah ella shiva kegon shechal yom tov harishon lihot beshabbat amar rav huna bereh derav yehuda mesammecho bisire hargalim

Amar rava shette teshuvot baddavar chada disire hargalim chay neechalin tzali en neechalin vesimcha bechay leka veod kohanim ochlin veyisrael bamme semechim ella amar rav pappa mesammecho bichsut nekiyya veyayin yashan

Ki ata ravin amar rabbi elazar shelamim sheshshechatan meerev yom tov yotze bahen mishshum simcha veen yotze bahen mishshum chagiga yotze mishshum simcha la baenan zevicha bishat simcha vela mishshum chagiga have davar shebbechova vechol davar shebbechova eno ba ella min hachullin
Metivi vehayita ach sameach lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon lesimcha atta omer lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon o eno ella lerabbot lele yom tov harishon talmud lomar ach chalak

May tama lav mishshum deen lo bamme yismach lo kidtanya ma raita lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon ulhotzi lele yom tov harishon merabbe ani lele yom tov haacharon sheyyesh simcha lefanav umotzi ani lele yom tov harishon sheen simcha lefanav
Amar rav kahana minnayin leemure chagigat chamishsha asar shennifsalin belina shenneemar velo yalin chelev chaggi ad boker usmich leh reshit lememra dehay boker boker rishon
Matkef lah rav yosef tama dichtav reshit ha la ketav reshit hava amena may boker boker sheni mi ika mide devasar ipsil leh meurta veemurin ad tzafra
Amar leh abbaye allema la vahare pesach lerabbi elazar ben azarya devasar ipsil leh mechatzot veemurin ad tzafra
Amar rava rav yosef hachi ka kashya leh mi ika mide deillu tanna levasar la bae reshit verav kahana leemurin bae reshit
May hi detanya lo yalin min habbasar asher tizbach baerev bayyom harishon labboker
b: Limed al chagigat arbaa asar shenneechelet lishne yamim velayela echad o eno ella leom valayela keshehu omer beom harishon labboker hare boker sheni amur

O eno ella boker rishon uma ani mekayyem chagiga hanneechelet lishne yamim valayela echad chutz mizzo keshehu omer bo im neder o nedava limed al chagigat arbaa asar shenneechelet lishne yamim valayela echad

Amar mar o eno ella boker rishon ha amarta keshehu omer bayyom harishon labboker hare boker sheni amur hachi kaamar o eno ella bishte chagigot hakkatuv medabber achat chagigat arbaa asar veachat chagigat chamishsha asar vezo levokrah vezo levokrah

Hadar amar ella dekayema lan chagiga hanneechelet lishne yamim valayela echad im ken im neder o nedava bemay i chagigat arbaa asar ha ketiv bah yom valayela i chagigat chamishsha asar ha ketiv bah yom valayela
Ella hay lachagigat chamishsha asar vehayeche kulleh kera lachagigat arbaa asar limed al chagigat arbaa asar shenneechelet lishne yamim valayela echad
Tama dichtiv bayyom harishon labboker demay boker boker sheni ha kol hecha dichtiv boker setama boker rishon veaf al gav dela ketav beh reshit
Matni happesach sheshshechato shello lishmo beshabbat chayyav alav chattat
Ushar kol hazzevachim sheshshechatan leshem pesach im enan reuyin chayyav veim reuyin hen rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter

Amar leh rabbi eliezer ma im happesach shehu muttar lishmo kesheshshina et shemo chayyav zevachim shehen asurin lishman kesheshshina et sheman eno din sheyehe chayyav amar leh rabbi yehoshua la im amarta bappesach sheshshinahu bedavar asur tomar bizvachim sheshshinan bedavar hammuttar

Amar leh rabbi eliezer emure tzibur yochichu shehen muttarin lishman vehashshochet lishman chayyav amar leh rabbi yehoshua lo im amarta beemure tzibur sheyyesh lahen kitzva tomar bappesach sheen lo kitzva
Rabbi meir omer af hashshochet leshem emure tzibur patur
Shechato shello leochlav veshello limnuyav laarelin velitmein chayyav leochlav veshello leochlav limnuyav veshello limnuyav lemulin velaarelim litmein velithorin patur
Shechato venimtza baal mum chayyav shechato venimtza terefa basseter patur
Shechato venoda shemmashchu habbealim et yadam o shemmetu o shennitmeu patur mippene sheshshachat birshut

a: Gema bemay askinan ilema betoe shamatte minah akira betaut haveya akira ella beoker
Ema sefa ushar kol hazzevachim sheshshechatan leshum happesach im enan reuyin chayyav im reuyin hen rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter vei beoker ma li reuyin ma li sheenan reuyin
Ella peshita betoe resha beoker vesefa betoe amar rabbi avin in resha beoker vesefa betoe
Ashkecheh rav yitzchak bar yosef lerabbi avahu dahava kae beuchlusa deinashe amar leh matnitin may amar leh resha beoker vesefa betoe tena mineh arbein zimnin vedame leh keman demannecha bechiseh

Tenan amar rabbi eliezer ma im pesach shemmuttar lishmo kesheshshina et shemo chayyav zevachim shehen asurin lishman kesheshshina et sheman eno din sheyehe chayyav veim ita ha la dame deresha beoker vesefa betoe
Lerabbi eliezer la shane leh lerabbi yehoshua deshane leh lishanne leh hachi
Hachi kaamar leh ledidi la dame resha beoker vesefa betoe ledidach lo im amarta befesach sheshshina et shemo ledavar haasur tomar bizvachim sheshshina et sheman ledavar hammuttar

Amar leh rabbi eliezer emure tzibur yochichu shehen muttarin lishman vehashshochet lishman chayyav amar lo rabbi yehoshua lo im amarta beemure tzibur shekken yesh lahen kitzva tomar befesach sheen lo kitzva

Lememra dechol hecha deit leh kitzva mechayyev rabbi yehoshua vahare tinokot deyesh lahen kitzva utnan mi shehau lo shene tinokot echad lemulo achar hashshabbat veechad lemulo bashshabbat veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat chayyav
Echad lemulo beerev shabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter
Amar rabbi amme hacha bemay askinan kegon shekkadam umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat deika hach deshabbat ditrid beh hacha kegon shekkadam veshachtinhu leemure tzibur beresha

I hachi rabbi meir omer af hashshochet leshem emure tzibur patur af al gav dikdem veshachtinhu leemure tzibur beresha vehattanya rabbi chiyya meavel arav amar rabbi meir lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al shehau lo shene tinokot echad lamul erev shabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat dechayyav

Al ma nechleku al shehau lo shene tinokot echad lamul achar hashshabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat derabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter
Vetisbera ma hatam dela aved mitzva patar rabbi yehoshua hecha deka aved mitzva mechayyev
Amri deve rabbi yannay resha kegon shekkadam umal shel shabbat beerev shabbat
b: Shello nittena shabbat liddachot vesefa nittena shabbat liddachot etzlo
Hacha hare nittena shabbat liddachot etzel korban tzibur
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana hacha name hare nittena shabbat liddachot etzel tinokot dealma amar leh legabbe dehay gavra mihat la ityehiv
Ushar kol hazzevachim sheshshechatan leshum pesach im enan reuyin chayyav veim reuyin rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter man tanna deshane leh ben reuyin lesheenan reuyin

Rabbi shimon hi detanya echad hazzevachim haruyin veechad zevachim sheenan reuyin vechen hashshochet leshem emure tzibur patur divre rabbi meir amar rabbi shimon lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al sheenan reuyin shechayyav al ma nechleku al haruyin sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter

Amar rav bivi amar rabbi elazar poter haya rabbi meir afilu egel shel zivche shelamim sheshshechato leshum happesach amar leh rabbi zera lerav bivi vehaamar rabbi yochanan mode haya rabbi meir bevaale mumin amar leh bevaale mumin la terid behu vehay terid beh
Bea mineh rava merav nachman chullin leshum pesach may li amar rabbi meir amar leh poter haya rabbi meir afilu chullin leshum pesach
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan mode haya rabbi meir bevaale mumin baale mumin la michallefi hane michallefi

Vetama derabbi meir mishshum ichallofe vela ichallofe vehaamar rav bivi amar rabbi elazar poter haya rabbi meir afilu egel shel zivche shelamim sheshshechato leshum happesach alma tama derabbi meir mishshum ditrid
Amar leh terid af al gav dela michallaf michallaf af al gav dela terid leappoke baale mumin dela ichallofe michallaf vela mitrid terid

Yatev rabbi zera verabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak akkila derabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak veyatvi veka amri amar rabbi shimon ben lakish nitchallef lo shappud shel notar beshappud shel tzali vaachalo chayyav
Verabbi yochanan amar ishto nidda baal chayyav yevimto nidda baal patur
Ika deamri kol shekken behahi demichayyav delo asa mitzva
It deamri behahi patur may tama hatam hu dahava leh leshayyole aval hacha dela hava leh leshayyole la
Verabbi yochanan may shena yevimto deka aved mitzva ishto name ka aved mitzva beishto meubberet
Veha ika simchat ona shello bishat onatah
Vehaamar rava chayyav adam lesammeach ishto bidvar mitzva samuch levistah
I hachi afilu yevimto name yevimto beziz minah ishto la beziz minah
Verabbi yochanan keman ilema kerabbi yose ditnan rabbi yose omer yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihot bashshabbat veshachach vehotzi et hallulav lirshut harabbim patur mippene shehotzi birshut
Dilma shane hatam dizmanno bahul
Veella rabbi yehoshua dizvachim dilma hatam name zemanno bahul
Veella kerabbi yehoshua detinokot hatam name zemanno bahul
Veella kerabbi yehoshua ditruma ditnan haya ochel bitruma venoda shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vachomesh rabbi yehoshua poter
Dilma kidrav bivi bar abbaye deamar rav bivi bar abbaye bitruma beerev happesach dizmannah bahul
I name shane teruma deikri avoda vaavoda rachamana achshar

Ditnan haya omed umakriv venoda shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza kol hakkarbanot kullan shehikriv al gabbe hammizbeach pesulin verabbi yehoshua machshir veamrinan may tama derabbi yehoshua dichtiv barech Adonai chelo ufoal yadav tirtze

Utruma hecha ikri avoda detanya maase berabbi tarfon shello ba emesh levet hammidrash leshacharit metzao rabban gamliel amar lo mippene ma lo bata emesh levet hammidrash amar lo avoda avadti amar lo kol devarecha enan ella divre tema vechi avoda bazzeman hazze minnayin amar lo hare hu omer

a: Avodat mattana etten et kehunnatchem vehazzar hakkarev yumat asu achilat teruma bigvulin kaavodat bet hammikdash
Shechato shello leochlav peshita kevan dehatam pasul hacha chayyav mishshum detanna sefa patur tena resha chayyav

Veha name peshita mishshum dehatam kasher hacha patur ella ayede ditna shechato shello lishmo beshabbat tena name shello leochlav vehi gufa lema li mishshum dekavae leiploge rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua
Amar leh rav huna bar chinana livreh ki azlatte lekammeh derabbi zerika bae mineh ledivre haomer mekalkel bechabbura patur shechato shello leochlav chayyav ma tiken
Tiken im alu lo yerdu
Shechato venimtza baal mum chayyav ma tiken tiken bedukkin shebbaayin vealliba derabbi akiva deamar im alu lo yerdu
Shechato venimtza terefa basseter patur ha begaluy chayyav ma tiken tiken lehotzi mide nevela
Matkef lah ravina ha detanya hashshochet chattat bashshabbat bachutz laavoda zara chayyav aleha shalosh chattaot ma tiken
Amar rav avira shemmotzio mide ever min hachay
Shechato venoda vechu amar rav huna amar rav asham shennitak liriyya ushchato setam kasher laola alma kasavar la bae akira
I hachi ki lo nitak name gezera leachar kappara attu lifne chappara
Umna temra ditnan asham shemmetu bealav o shennitkapperu bealav yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava rabbi eliezer omer yamut rabbi yehoshua omer yimmacher veyavi bedamav ola
Bedamav in aval gufo la degazar leachar kappara attu lifne kappara shema minah
Etiveh rav chisda lerav huna shechato venoda shemmashchu bealim et yadam vechu
b: Vetane alah bachol ki hay gavena yissaref miyyad i amratte bishlama bae akira hay pesach hu vechevan delet leh bealim have leh pesulo begufo ammetu lehachi yissaref miyyad
Ella i amratte la bae akira meresha have leh shelamim pesulo mishshum may mishshum davar acher deka shachet leh achar tamid shel ben haarbayim ibur tzura bae
Detanya ze hakkelal kol sheppesulo begufo yissaref miyyad baddam uvabbealim teubbar tzurato veyetze levet hasserefa
Ella la tema shechato setam kasher leshum ola ella ema shechato leshum ola kasher alma bae akira
Ulrabbi chiyya bar gammada deamar nizreka mippi chavura veamri kegon shehau bealim temee metim venidchin lefesach sheni
Hay hu devae akira ha bealma la bae akira may ika lememar
Ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hacha bemay askinan kegon shehifrisho kodem chatzot umetu bealim achar chatzot dehave leh nire venidche vechol hannire venidche shuv eno chozer venire
Mide hu tama ella lerav ha amar rav baale chayyim enam nidchim
Ella amar rav pappa ha manni rabbi eliezer hi deamar vechen hashshochet acherim leshem pesach pasul dehave leh pesulo begufo
Vei rabbi eliezer hi chattat name michayyav deha let leh lerabbi eliezer toe bidvar mitzva patur

Ella targema rav yosef bereh derav salla chasida kammeh derav pappa ha manni yosef ben chonay hi ditnan yosef ben chonay omer hannishchatim leshem pesach ulshem chattat pesulim alma pesulo begufo hi umishshum hachi yissaref miyyad uviftore savar lah kerabbi yehoshua

Rav ashe amar rav deamar kerabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka detanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer im yesh shehut beom leda im mashchu bealim et yedehem o shemmetu o shennitmeu chayyav utubbar tzurato veotze levet hasserefa may tama lav mishshum dela bae akira
Mimmay dilma mishshum desavar lah ketanna deve rabba bar avuh deamar afilu pigul name bae ibur tzura deyalef aon aon minnotar
Dei la tema hachi nitmeu bealim may ika lememar ha vadday bae akira deamar rabbi chiyya bar gammada nizreka mippi chavura kegon shehau bealim temee met venidchu lefesach sheni
Ella mechavarta kidshanni meikara yosef ben chonay hi
Hadran alach ellu devarim

a: Matni ketzad tzolin et happesach meviin shappud shel rimmon vetochavo letoch piv ad bet nekuvato venoten et keraav veet bene meav letocho divre rabbi yose haggelili rabbi akiva omer kemin bishul hu ze ella tolin chutza lo en tzolin et happesach lo al hashshappud velo al haaskala amar rabbi tzadok maase berabban gamliel sheamar letavi avdo tze utzle lanu et happesach al haaskala

Gema venayete shel mattechet ayede decham miktzato cham kullo vekamitteve mechamat hashshappud verachamana amar tzeli esh velo tzali mechamat davar acher venayete shel dekel ayede deit leh shibe mappek mayya vehave kimvushshal venayete shel teena ayedi dimchalchel mappek mayya vehave leh kimvushshal
Venayete shel allon shel charuv veshel shikma ayede deit beh kitre mappek mayya
Shel rimmon name it beh kitre shii kitre veibaet ema benavga bar shatta delet beh kitre veha ika be fiskeh demappek leve fiskeh levar

Matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer keshem sheshshappud shel etz eno nisraf kach shappud shel mattechet eno martiach amru lo ze cham miktzato cham kullo veze cham miktzato eno cham kullo
Venoten et keraav vechu tanya rabbi yishmael korehu toch toch rabbi tarfon korehu gedi mekullas
Tanu rabbanan ezehu gedi mekullas deasur leechol belele fesach bazzeman hazze kol shetztzelao kullo keechad nechtach mimmennu ever nishlak mimmennu ever en ze gedi mekullas

Ella la kashya roe ani et divre rabbi eliezer benitma vedivre rabbi yehoshua beavud vesaruf
Benitma may tama mishshum dimratztze tzitz ha shamatte leh lerabbi yose deamar en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot
Ella la kashya roe ani et divre rabbi eliezer betzibur roe ani et divre rabbi yehoshua beyachid
Betzibur may tama mishshum detuma huttera betzibur chada deshamatte leh lerabbi yose deamar tuma dechuya hi betzibur veod i betzibur rabbi eliezer machshir vela rabbi yehoshua
b: Ha amratte betzibur afilu rabbi yehoshua mode
Ella roe ani divre rabbi eliezer bediavad vedivre rabbi yehoshua lechattechilla diavad afilu rabbi yehoshua name mode hu dekatane mode rabbi yehoshua sheim zarak hurtza
Ha betuma ha beavud vesaruf ki katane mode rabbi yehoshua sheim zarak hurtza benitma aval beavud vesaruf la ki kaamar rabbi yose roe ani et divre rabbi eliezer bediavad beavud vesaruf
Matni nitma basar vechelev kayyam eno zorek et haddam nitma hachelev vehabbasar kayyam zorek et haddam uvammukdashim eno ken ella af al pi shennitma habbasar vehachelev kayyam zorek et haddam
Gema amar rav gidel amar rav im zarak hurtza veha baenan achila achila la meakkeva
Veha ketiv ish lefi ochlo lemitzva

Ulakkev la vehatanya bemichsat melammed sheen happesach nishchat ella limnuyav yachol shechato shello limnuyav yehe keover al hammitzva vechasher talmud lomar ish lefi ochlo tachossu hakkatuv shana alav leakkev
Veitakkash ochlin limnuyin
Ella rav deamar kerabbi natan deamar achilat pesachim la meakkeva

He rabbi natan ilema ha rabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer minnayin shekkol yisrael yotzin befesach echad talmud lomar veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael ben haarbayim vechi kal hakkahal shochatin vahalo en shochet ella echad ella melammed shekkol yisrael yotzin befesach echad
Dilma shane hatam dei mimmashchi hane chaze lehane vei mimmashchi hane chaze lehane

Ella ha rabbi natan detanya nimnu alav chavura achat vechazru venimnu alav chavura acheret rishonim sheyyesh lahen kezayit ochlin ufturin millaasot pesach sheni acharonim sheen lahem kazzayit en ochlin vechayyavin laasot pesach sheni
Rabbi natan omer ellu veellu peturin millaasot pesach sheni shekkevar nizrak haddam
Akkatti dilma shane hatam dei mimmashchi hane chaze lehu im ken litne hoil uruyim limashech may shekkevar nizrak haddam shema minah bedam talya milta aval achila la meakkeva

May duchkeh derav demokem lah matnitin lechattechilla verabbi natan nokmah kerabbanan vaafilu diavad name la rav matnitin keshiteh ammay tane en zorek et haddam litne pasul ella shema minah en zorek lechattechilla aval diavad shappir dame
Ulrabbi natan ish lefi ochlo lema li devaenan gavra dachaze laachila
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan shachatu leochlav vezarku damo shello leochlav happesach atzmo kasher veadam yotze bo yede chovato keman nema rabbi natan hi vela rabbanan
Afilu tema rabbanan en machshevet ochlin bizrika

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan hare shehaya chole bishat shechita vechalim bishat zerika chalim bishat shechita vechole bishat zerika en shochatin vezorkin alav ad sheyehe chalim mishsheat shechita ad sheat zerika keman nema rabbanan hi vela rabbi natan afilu tema rabbi natan gavra dachaze laachila baenan
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan shechato betohora veachar kach nitmeu habbealim yizzarek haddam betohora veal yeachel basar betuma keman
Amar rabbi eliezer bemachloket shenuya verabbi natan hi verabbi yochanan amar afilu tema rabbanan hi hacha bemay askinan betzibur daafilu betuma name avdi

I betzibur ammay en habbasar neechal betuma gezera shemma yittamu habbealim leachar zerika veyomru eshtakad lo nitmenu veachalnu hashta name nechol vela yadi deeshtakad ki izderik dam bealim temeim hao hashta bealim tehorin hau

a: Veibaet ema rav deamar kerabbi yehoshua detanya rabbi yehoshua omer kol hazzevachim shebbattora ben shennitma basar vechelev kayyam ben shennitma chelev uvasar kayyam zorek et haddam
Nazir veose fesach nitma chelev uvasar kayyam zorek et haddam nitma basar vechelev kayyam en zorek et haddam veim zarak hurtza
Nitmeu habbealim bemet lo yizrok veim zarak lo hurtza
Bammukdashin eno ken vechu matnitin manni

Rabbi yehoshua hi detanya rabbi yehoshua omer kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer mehen kezayit basar o kezayit chelev zorek et haddam kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev en zorek et haddam
Uvaola afilu kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev zorek et haddam mippene shekkullah kalil uvammincha af al pi shekkullah kayyemet lo yizrok
Mincha may avidteh amar rav pappa minchat nesachim salka datach amena kevan deka atya mikkoach zevach kegufeh dezevach dame ka mashma lan
Chelev mena lan amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael umatu bah mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben chananya deamar kera vehiktir hachelev lereach nichoach la chelev af al pi sheen basar
Ashkechan chelev yoteret hakkaved ushte chelaot mena lan
Hecha amrinan dezarkinan middekatane uvammincha af al pi shekkullah kayyemet lo yizrok mincha hu dela aval yoteret hakkaved ushte hakkelaot shappir dame mena lan
Rabbi yochanan dideh amar amar kera lereach nichoach kol sheatta maale lereach nichoach

Veitzterich lemichtav chelev veitzterich lemichtav reach nichoach dei ketav rachamana chelev hava amena chelev in yoteret hakkaved ushte hakkelaot la ketav rachamana lereach nichoach vei ketav rachamana lereach nichoach have amena kol haolin lereach nichoach vaafilu mincha ketav rachamana chelev
Matni nitma kahal o rubbo o shehau hakkohanim temeim vehakkahal tehorim yaasu betuma nitma miut hakkahal hattehorin osin et harishon vehattemein osin et hashsheni

Gema tanu rabbanan hare shehau yisrael temein vechohanim uchle sharet tehorin o shehau yisrael tehorin vechohanim uchle sharet temein vaafilu yisrael vechohanim tehorin uchle sharet temein yaasu betuma sheen korban tzibur chaluk
Amar rav chisda lo shanu ella shennitma hassakkin bitme met derachamana amar bachalal cherev cherev hare hu kechalal
Veka metamme legavra demeikara ki mitavid betumat hagguf decharet ka mitavid
Aval nitma hassakkin betumat sheretz devasar hu dimtammeya leh legavra la metammeya leh tehorin aved temein la aved mutav yeachel betumat basar belav veal yeachel basar betumat hagguf shehu becharet
Alma kasavar rav chisda tuma dechuya hi betzibur vechen amar rabbi yitzchak tuma dechuya hi betzibur
Verava amar afilu temein name avdi may tama dichtiv vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel baesh yissaref vehabbasar kol tahor yochal basar

Kol hecha dela karenan beh vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel la karenan beh vehabbasar kol tahor yochal basar kol hecha dekarenan beh vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel karenan beh vehabbasar kol tahor yochal basar
Itmar hare shehau yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein rav amar mechetza al mechetza kerov verav kahana amar mechetza al mechetza eno kerov
Rav amar mechetza al mechetza kerov hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman verav kahana amar mechetza al mechetza eno kerov tehorin osin et harishon utmein osin et hashsheni
Ika deamri amar rav kahana mechetza al mechetza eno kerov tehorin osin et harishon
b: Utmein en osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni barishon la avdi dela hau rubba bashsheni la avdi dela hau miuta
Tenan nitma kahal o rubbo o shehau hakkohanim temein vehakkahal tehorim yease betuma rubbo hu deavdi betuma aval palga ufalga la avdi barishon kashya lerav
Amar lach rav rubba avdi kullehu betuma palga ufalga hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman

Hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa nitma miut hakkahal tehorin osin et harishon utmein osin et hashsheni miut hu deavdi bashsheni aval palga ufalga la veavdi barishon vehallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman

Veella kashya lerav kahana amar lach rav kahana nitmeu miut hakkahal tehorin osin et harishon utmein osin et hashsheni ha palga ufalga tehorin osin et harishon aval temein enan osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni
Hatinach lelishana batra derav kahana ella lehach lishana deamar rav kahana tehorim osin et harishon utmein osin et hashsheni may ika lememar
Amar lecha rav kahana hu haddin daafilu palga ufalga name tehorin osin et harishon utmein osin et hashsheni vehay dekatane miut hakkahal ayede ditna resha rubbo tena name sefa miuto
Tanya keoteh derav tanya keoteh derav kahana kitre lishane tanya keoteh derav hau yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman
Tanya kelishna kamma derav kahana hare shehau yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein tehorin osin et harishon utmein osin et hashsheni
Vetanya kelishana batra derav kahana hare shehau yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein tehorin osin et harishon utmein enan osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni
Lerav ullishana batra derav kahana ha detana tehorin osin et harishon utmein et hashsheni hechi metartzi lah kegon shehau yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein venashim mashlimot lattemeim
Vekasavar nashim barishon reshut dal nashim mittemein vehau lehu temein miuta umiuta yidchu lefesach sheni
Lerav ullishana kamma derav kahana ha detanya tehorin osin et harishon utmein en osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni hechi metartzi lah
Rav metaretz lah kegon shehau yisrael mechetza temein umechetza tehorin venashim odfot al hattehorim vekasavar nashim barishon chova uvashsheni reshut
Barishon la avdi dehave leh miut umiuta la avdi barishon uvashsheni la avdi dal nashim minayehu vehau lehu palga ufalga ufalga la avdi bashsheni
Ulrav kahana daamar palga name avdi bashsheni hachi metaretz lah kegon shehau yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein venashim mashlimot lattehorin vekasavar nashim barishon chova uvashsheni reshut
Barishon la avdi dehau lehu palga ufalga ufalga barishon la avdi bashsheni name la avdi dal nashim minayehu min hattehorin hau lehu temein rubba verubba la avdi bashsheni

Ulrav kahana ha detanya hare shehau yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman hechi metaretz lah amar lach rav kahana tannae hi ika leman deamar mechetza al mechetza kerov veika leman deamar mechetza al mechetza eno kerov
Gufa hare shehau yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman hau temein odfin al hattehorin afilu echad yaasu betuma lefi sheen korban tzibur chaluk
Rabbi elazar ben matya omer en hayyachid machria et hatztzibur letuma shenneemar

a: Lo tuchal lizboach et happasach beachad shearecha
Rabbi shimon omer afilu shevet echad tame ushar kol hashshevatim tehorim hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman may tama derabbi shimon kasavar shevet echad ikri kahal

Rabbi yehuda omer afilu shevet echad tame ushar kol hashshevatim tehorin yaasu betuma sheen korban tzibur chaluk rabbi yehuda savar shevet echad ikri kahal vehau lehu palga ufalga veen korban tzibur chaluk veavdi kullehu betuma
Itmar hau yisrael mechetza tehorin umechetza temein amar rav metammein echad mehen besheretz
Veammay nibedu hane lechodayehu vehane lechodayehu deha amar rav hallalu osin leatzman vehallalu osin leatzman amri hacha bemay askinan kegon shehau temein odfin al hattehorin echad

I hachi hau lehu rubba temeim nibedu kullehu betuma savar lah kerabbi elazar ben matya deamar en hayyachid machria et hatztzibur letuma i hachi hadar kushyan leduchteh nibedu hane lechodayehu vehane lechodayehu
Ella hachi kaamar i ika tanna desavar lah ketanna kamma deamar palga ufalga la avdi kullehu betuma vesavar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar en korban tzibur chaluk metammein echad mehen besheretz
Veulla amar meshallechin echad mehen lederech rechoka vitammeennu besheretz
Kasavar shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz
Vitammeennu bemet madchehu atta mechagigato
Hashta name madchehu atta mippischo efshar deaved bashsheni
Bemet name efshar deaved bashshevii dahava leh shemini shello
Kasavar ulla kullehu tashlumin derishon ninhu dachaze barishon chaze bechullehu vechol hecha dela chaze barishon la chaze bechullehu
Amar lehu rav nachman zilu veemaru leh leulla man tzayet deakar sikeh umashkeneh verahet
Itmar hau rubban zavin umiutan temee metim amar rav otan temee metim enan osin lo barishon velo bashsheni
Rishon la avdi dehau miuta umiuta la avdi barishon bashsheni name la avdi kol hecha deavdi tzibur barishon aved yachid bashsheni kol hecha dela avdi tzibur barishon la aved yachid bashsheni

Amar lehu shemuel zilu emaru leh leabba veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach bemoado may avdatte leh amar lehu zilu emaru leh ki hao kullehu zavin may avdatte leh ella kevan dela efshar la efshar hacha name la efshar
Itmar hau rubban temee metim umiutan zavin
Rav huna amar en tashlumin lefesach habba betuma verav adda bar ahava amar yesh tashlumin lefesach habba betuma
Nema beha kamipalgi deman deamar en tashlumin lefesach habba betuma kasavar tuma dechuya hi betzibur
Uman deamar yesh tashlumin lefesach habba betuma kasavar tuma huttera betzibur
Amri la dechulle alma tuma dechuya betzibur uvha peligi mar savar
b: Tohora medachaya tuma la medachaya umar savar afilu tuma name medachaya
Itmar hau shelishitan zavin ushlishitan tehorin ushlishitan temee metim amar rabbi mani bar pattish otan temee metim enan osin lo et harishon velo hashsheni

Barishon la avdi higdilu zavin al hattehorim dela avdi betuma have leh temee metim miuta umiuta la avdi barishon bashsheni la avdi nitztzarfu zavin im temee metim dela avdi barishon hau lehu rubba verubba la middechu lefesach sheni

Matni happesach shennizrak damo veachar kach noda shehu tame hatztzitz meratztze nitma hagguf en hatztzitz meratztze mippene sheamru hannazir veose fesach hatztzitz meratztze al tumat haddam veen hatztzitz meratztze al tumat hagguf
Nitma tumat hattehom hatztzitz meratztze
Gema tama denizrak veachar kach noda aval noda veachar kach nizrak lo meratztze
Urminhu al ma hatztzitz meratztze al haddam veal habbasar veal hachelev shennitma ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon ben beyachid ben betzibur
Amar ravina tumato ben beshogeg ben bemezid hurtza zerikato beshogeg hurtza bemezid lo hurtza
Rabbi shela amar zerikato ben beshogeg ben bemezid hurtza tumato beshogeg hurtza bemezid lo hurtza
Ella ha dekatane ben beshogeg ben bemezid hachi kaamar nitma beshogeg uzrako ben beshogeg ben bemezid hurtza
Veha dekatane dam shennizrak veachar kach noda tama denizrak veachar kach noda aval noda veachar kach nizrak la hu haddin daafilu noda veachar kach nizrak
Vehay dekatane nizrak veachar kach noda mishshum devae lemitne sefa nitma hagguf en hatztzitz meratztze daafilu nizrak veachar kach noda la katane resha name nizrak veachar kach noda

Nitma tumat hattehom vechu bae rame bar chama kohen hamratztze bekorbenotehen huttera lo tumat hattehom o la mi amrinan ki gemiri tumat hattehom bivalim bechohen la gemiri o dilma bezivcha gemiri la shena bechohen vela shena bivalim
Amar rava ta shema detane rabbi chiyya lo amru tumat hattehom ella lemet bilvad met lemaote may lav lemaote tumat hattehom desheretz
Uvmay askinan i nema bivalim uvman i benazir mi mahane beh ki yamut met alav amar rachamana
Ella beose fesach hanicha leman deamar en shochatin vezorkin al temee sheretz ella leman deamar shochatin vezorkin al temee sheretz hashta tuma yedua huttera lo tumat hattehom lo kol shekken
Ella lav bechohen ushma minah huttera lo tumat hattehom
Amar rav yosef lo leolam bivalim uvfesach ulmaote tumat hattehom deziva
Vetumat tehom deziva lo meratztze vehatanya rabbi yose omer shomeret yom keneged yom sheshshachatu vezarku aleha

a: Bashsheni shellah veachar kach raata enah ochelet uftura millaasot pesach sheni
May tama lav mishshum dimratztze tzitz amri la mishshum dekasavar rabbi yose mikkan ulhabba hi metammea

Vehatanya rabbi yose omer zav baal shette reiyyot sheshshachatu vezarku alav bashshevii shello veachar kach raa vechen shomeret yom keneged yom sheshshachatu vezarku aleha bashsheni shellah veachar kach raata hare ellu metammein mishkav umoshav lemafrea
Ufturim millaasot pesach sheni
Amri may lemafrea midderabbanan
Veaf rabbi oshaya savar metamme lemafrea midderabbanan detanya rabbi oshaya omer aval zav sheraa bashshevii shello soter et shellefanav vaamar leh rabbi yochanan lo yistor ella yomo
Mimma nafshach i kasavar lemafrea hu metamme afilu kullehu nistor i kasavar mikkan ulhabba hu metamme yomo name la nistor ella ema lo yistor velo yomo
Vaamar leh rabbi yose kae keotach veha rabbi yose omer metammein mishkav umoshav lemafrea ella lav shema minah metamme lemafrea midderabbanan shema minah
Ulrabbi yose hashta deamar mikkan ulhabba hu metamme lemet bilvad lemaote may
Nifshot minah divchohen vehutra lo tumat hattehom
Amri leolam bivalim uvfesach vekasavar en shochatin vezorkin al temee sheretz veitzterich lemaote
Ella lerabbi yose zava gemura hechi mashkachatte lah
Beshofaat i baet ema kegon sheraata kol shene ben hashshemashot

Bae rav yosef kohen hamratztze betamid huttera lo tumat hattehom o la im timtza lomar kohen hamratztze bekorbenotehen shel nazir veose fesach huttera lo tumat hattehom kohen hamratztze betamid may mi amrinan ki gemiri tumat hattehom befesach betamid la gemiri o dilma yalef tamid mippesach
Amar rabba kal vachomer uma bemakom shello huttera lo tuma yedua huttera lo tumat hattehom makom shehuttera lo tuma yedua
b: Eno din shehuttera lo tumat hattehom
Amri umi dayeninan kal vachomer mehalacha vehatanya amar lo rabbi eliezer akiva etzem kisora halacha reviit dam kal vechomer veen danin kal vachomer mehalacha
Ella amar rava yalef moado moado mippesach
Vetumat hattehom gufa hecha ketiva amar rabbi elazar amar kera vechi yamut met alav bimchuveret alav
Ashkechan nazir ose fesach menalan amar rabbi yochanan amar kera bederech rechoka lachem bimchuveret lachem
Rabbi shimon ben lakish amar kederech ma derech begaluy af tuma name begaluy
Metivi e zehu tumat hattehom kol shello hikkir bah echad besof haolam hikkir bah echad besof haolam en ze tumat hattehom lerabbi elazar deamar bimchuveret alav ad deyada hu
Lerabbi yochanan deamar lachem bimchuveret lachem ad deyadi bah teren
Lerabbi shimon ben lakish deamar kederech ad deyadi kulle alma
Ella tumat hattehom hilcheta gemiri lah ukra asmachta bealma
Amar mar bar rav ashe lo shanu ella shennoda lo leachar zerika dechi izderik dam shappir izderik aval noda lo lifne zerika lo meratztze
Metivi hammotze met mushkav lerochbo shel derech litruma tame lenazir veose fesach tahor vechol tame vetahor lehabba hu
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar mar bar rav ashe la tema noda lo leachar zerika hu dimratztze aval noda lo lifne zerika lo meratztze ella afilu noda lo lifne zerika meratztze
Gufa hammotze met mushkav lerochbo shel derech litruma tame lenazir veose fesach tahor
Bamme devarim amurim sheen lo makom laavor aval yesh makom laavor af litruma tahor
Bamme devarim amurim shemmetzao shalem aval meshubbar umforak tahor shemma ben happerakim avar uvakkever afilu meshubbar umforak tame mippene shehakkever metzarfo
Bamme devarim amurim bimhallech beraglav aval taun o rachuv tame lefi shemmehallech beraglav efshar shello yigga velo yaahil aval taun o rachuv i efshar shello yigga velo yaahil
Bamme devarim amurim betumat hattehom aval betuma yedua tame
Vee ze hi tumat hattehom kol shello hikkir bah echad besof haolam aval hikkir bah echad besof haolam en ze tumat hattehom
Metzao tamun beteven beafar uvitzrorot hare ze tumat hattehom bemayim baafela binkike hasselaim en ze tumat hattehom velo amru tumat hattehom ella lemet bilvad

Matni nitma shalem o rubbo sorfin oto lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha nitma miuto vehannotar sorfin oto bechatzrotehen o al gaggotehen meatze atzman hatztzikanin sorfin oto lifne habbira bishvil lehanot meatze hammaaracha
Gema may tama amar rabbi yose bar chanina kede levayeshan
Nitma miuto vechu urminhu vechen mi sheyyatza mirushalayim venizkar sheyyesh beyado besar kodesh im avar tzofim sorfo bimkomo veim lav

a: Chozer vesorfo lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha
Amar rav chama bar ukva la kashya kan beachsenay kan bevaal habbayit
Rav pappa amar ha veha beachsenay kan shehechzik badderech kan shello hechzik badderech

Rav zevid amar leolam kidamar meikara kan beachsenay kan bevaal habbayit veaf al gav dela hechzik badderech achsenay kevan delet leh asauhu ketzikanin ditnan hatztzikanin sorfin oto lifne habbira bishvil lehanot meatze hammaaracha
Tanu rabbanan bau lesorfo bechatzrotehen umeatze hammaaracha en shomin lahen lifne habbira umeatze atzman en shomin lahen
Bishlama meatze hammaaracha bechatzrotehen en shomin lahen dilma payeshan minayehu veatu behu lide takkala ella lifne habbira meatze atzman may tama la
Rav yosef amar shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo rava amar mippene hachashad
May benayehu ika benayehu deayeti kene vecharyavata dela chaze lammaaracha
Tenan hatam rosh hammaamad haya maamid et hattemein al shaar hammizrach may tama amar rav yosef kede levayeshan rava amar mippene hachashad
May benayehu ika benayehu mefanneki i name deka gadel shishura
Matni happesach sheyyatza o shennitma yissaref miyyad nitmeu habbealim o shemmetu teubbar tzurato veyissaref beshishsha asar rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer af ze yissaref miyyad lefi sheen lo ochlin
Gema bishlama tame ketiv vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel baesh yissaref ella yotze menalan
Dichtiv hen lo huva et damah el hakkodesh penima amar lo moshe leaharon maddua lo achaltem et hachattat shemma nichnas damah lifnay velifnim amar lo lav

Amar lo shemma chutz limchitzatah yatzta amar lo lav bakkodesh hayeta amar lo i bakkodesh hayeta vehen lo huva et damah el hakkodesh penima maddua lo achaltem otah mikkelal dei nafka i name ayel damah lifnim bat serefa hi
Bishlama nitma galli rachamana bekadashim kallim kol shekken bekodshe kadashim ella yotze ashkechan kodshe hakkodashim kadashim kallim menalan vetu ha detanya lan damah
b: Nishpach damah yatza damah chutz lakkelaim dekayema lan bisrefa menalan

En li ella zo bilvad shear pesule kodshe kadashim veemure kadashim kallim minnayin talmud lomar vechol bakkodesh baesh tissaref

Ashkechan kodshe kadashim kadashim kallim menalan ella kol pesulo bakkodesh bisrefa la shena kadashim kallim vela shena kodshe kadashim gemara gemiri lah vechattat deaharon mishshum maase shehaya kach haya

Yalef aon aon minnotar
Venelaf aon aon mechattat deaharon amar lach chattat deaharon ki hay gavena name ibur tzura ledorot baaya vehatam horaat shaa hayeta
Hashta deamrinan kal pesule dekodesh bisrefa la shena dekodshe kadashim vela shena kadashim kallim gemara gemiri lah bakkodesh baesh tissaref lema li hahu mibbee leh shesserefatah bakkodesh
Vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel baesh yissaref lema li
Hahu legufeh itzterich salka datach amena kol pesule dekodesh kegon lan damah venishpach damah veyatza damah venishchata ballayela devisrefa deletanhu bechullin
Aval nitma divchullin name mippesil ema hoil veitavid beh ovadin dechol ema la tibe serefa vetisge leh bikvura ka mashma lan

Metivi ze hakkelal kol sheppesulo begufo yissaref miyyad baddam uvabbealim teubbar tzurato veyetze levet hasserefa
Katane bealim dumya dedam ma dam lifne zerika af bealim lifne zerika

a: Rabba mosif af rabbi yose haggelili detanya rabbi yose haggelili omer kol hainyan kullo eno medabber ella befarim hannisrafim uvisirin hannisrafin lisrof pesulehen abbet habbira veliten lo taase al achilatan
Amru lo chattat shennichnas damah lifnay velifnim minnayin amar lahen hen lo huva et damah el hakkodesh penima mikkelal dei nafek ihi i name ayel damah bisrefa
Verabbi yochanan savar dam uvasar chada milta hi bealim milleta achariti hi
Matni haatzamot vehaggidin vehannotar yissarfu beshishsha asar chal shishsha asar lihot beshabbat yissarfu beshiva asar lefi sheenan dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov

Gema amar rav mari bar avuh amar rabbi yitzchak atzmot kadashim sheshshimshu notar metammein et hayyadayim hoil venaasa basis ledavar haasur nema mesayya leh haatzamot vehaggidim vehannotar yissarfu leshishsha asar
Hane atzamot hechi dame ilema delet behu moach lamma bisrefa nishdinhu ella peshita deit behu moach

I amratte bishlama shimush notar milta hi ammetu lehachi bae serefa ella i amratte shimush notar lav milta hi lema lehu serefa nitberinhu venachletzeh lemoach didhu venisrefeh venishdinhu ledidhu ella lav shema minah shimush notar milta hi
Amri la leolam ema lach shimush notar lav milta vekasavar bo bechasher vaafilu befasul
Afilu befasul salka datach veha tenan aval hammotir battahor vehashshover battame eno sofeg et haarbaim la kashya kan shehayeta lo sheat hakkosher kan shello hayeta lo sheat hakkosher

Uman tanna deshane leh ben shehayeta lo sheat hakkosher lelo hayeta lo sheat hakkosher rabbi yaakov hi detanya veetzem lo tishberu vo bo bechasher velo befasul rabbi yaakov omer hayeta lo sheat hakkosher venifsal yesh bo mishshum shevirat haetzem lo hayeta lo sheat hakkosher en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem rabbi shimon omer echad ze veechad ze en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem

Metivi kol atzmot hakkodashim en teunin serefa chutz meatzmot happesach mippene hattakkala hane atzamot hechi dame ilema delet behu moach lema lehu serefa ella peshita deit behu moach vei salka datach shimush notar milta hi atzmot kadashim ammay en teunin serefa
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hacha bemay askinan kegon shemmetzaan chalutzin atzmot kadashim deen bahen mishshum shevirat haetzem kamme deneho notar chaltzinhu vela hau shimush notar vela bau serefa
Atzmot happesach deyesh bahen mishshum shevirat haetzem levatar deneho notar hu dechaltzinhu vehau lehu shimush notar uvau serefa

b: Shemmetzaan tzibburin tzibburin umehen chalutzin atzmot kadashim deen bahen mishshum shevirat haetzem lechullehu hava chaletz lehu veachel lehu vela bae serefa

Detanya rabbi yehuda omer eno noheg ella beachat vehaddaat machraat shel yamin
Veella tifshot desappoke mesappeka leh lerabbi yehuda dei mipshit peshita leh hahi dehetera nechleh udisura nishdeyeh lema leh serefa
Amar rav ika bar chinana kegon shehukkeru ulvassof nitarvu
Rav ashe amar lo nitzrecha ella leshummano degid hannashe detanya shummano muttar veyisrael kedoshim hem venohagin bo isur

Chal shishsha asar vechu veammay nete ase veyidche lo taase

a: Velo mila shello bizmannah habbaa mikkal vachomer
Rav ashe amar shabbaton deom tov ase hu veen ase doche lo taase vaase
Matni kol hanneechal beshor haggadol yeachel bigdi harach verashe chenafayim vehassechusim
Gema rabba rame tenan kol hanneechal beshor haggadol yeachel bigdi harach vesheeno neechal lo ema sefa rashe chenafayim vehassechusim veha hane la mitachli beshor haggadol
Ella tannae hi vehachi katane kol hanneechal beshor haggadol yeachel bigdi harach vesheeno neechal lo veyesh omrim af rashe chenafayim vehassechusim
Rava amar ma hen katane vehachi katane kol hanneechal beshor haggadol beshilka yeachel bigdi harach betzali uma hen rashe chenafayim vehassechusim
Tanya keoteh derava kol hanneechal beshor haggadol beshilka yeachel bigdi harach betzali uma hen rashe chenafayim vehassechusim vegidin harakkin nidonin kevasar

Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan kol hanneechal beshor haggadol yeachel bigdi harach uma hen rashe chenafayim vehassechusim hane in aval gidin shessofan lehakshot la amar leh tena hane vehu haddin lehanach hane may tama deha mitachli beshor haggadol beshilka hanach name mitachli beshor haggadol beshilka

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi avin ki azlatte lekammeh derabbi avahu remi leh mi amar rabbi yochanan gidin shessofan lehakshot nimnin alehen bappesach alma batar hashta azlinan veha bea mineh resh lakish merabbi yochanan or harosh shel egel harach mahu sheyetamme veamar lo en metamme alma batar bassof azlinan
Amar leh dirma lach ha la chash lekimcheh ha hadar beh rabbi yochanan legabbe deresh lakish vaamar leh al takniteni shebbilshon yachid ani shone otah
Matni hashshover et haetzem bappesach hattahor hare ze loke arbaim aval hammotir battahor vehashshover betame eno loke et haarbaim
Gema bishlama motir battahor detanya lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vehannotar mimmennu ad boker vego ba hakkatuv liten ase achar lo taase lomar sheen loke divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi yaakov omer lo min hashshem hu ze ella mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase veen lokin alav ella shover battame menalan deamar kera veetzem lo tishberu vo bo bechasher velo befasul

Tanu rabbanan veetzem lo tishberu vo bo bechasher velo befasul rabbi omer bevayit echad yeachel veetzem lo tishberu bo kol harauy laachila yesh bo mishshum shevirat etzem vesheen rauy laachila en bo mishshum shevirat etzem
May benayehu amar rabbi yirmeya pesach habba betuma ika benayehu leman deamar kasher
b: Hay pasul leman deamar rauy laachila hay name rauy laachila hu
Rav yosef amar ki hay gavena dechulle alma en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem derabbi leakkole ka ate vehay ha pasul hu
Ella hayeta lo sheat hakkosher venifsal ika benayehu leman deamar kasher ha kasher hu leman deamar rauy laachila ha hashta lav rauy laachila hu

Abbaye amar kulle alma kal ki hay gavena en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem may tama hashta mihat ha pasul hu ella shevirat haetzem mibbeod yom ika benayehu leman deamar kasher ha kasher hu leman deamar rauy laachila hashta lav bar achila hu

Metivi rabbi omer nimnin al moach shebbarosh veen nimnin al moach shebbakkulit al moach shebbarosh may tama hoil veyachol legorro ulhotzio vei salka datach shevirat haetzem mibbeod yom shappir dame kulit name nitbereh mibbeod yom venappekuh lemoach dideh venimno aleh

Amar lach abbaye ultamach mishshechashecha name nayete gumarta venachet aleh venikleh venappekeh lemoach dideh venimne aleh deha tanya aval hassoref baatzamot vehamchattech begidin en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem

Ella may it lach lememar abbaye amar mishshum peka rava amar mishshum hefsed kadashim deka mafsed leh beyadayim dilma achel nura mimmoach dideh mibbeod yom name gezera mibbeod yom attu mishshechashecha

Rav pappa amar kal ki hay gavena kulle alma yesh bo mishshum shevirat haetzem may tama leurta michaze laachila ella beever sheyyatza miktzato kamipalgi man deamar kasher ha kasher hu uman deamar rauy laachila hay lav bar achila hu
Kidtanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer ever sheyyatza miktzato ushvaro en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem

Rav sheshet bereh derav idi amar kal ki hay gavena dechulle alma en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem dehay ever ha pasul hu ella shevirat haetzem bena ika benayehu man deamar kasher ha kasher hu uman deamar rauy laachila hashta eno rauy laachila

Rav ashe amar kal ki hay gavena vadday en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem deha vadday eno rauy laachila kelal ella ever sheen alav kazzayit basar ika benayehu leman deamar kasher ha kasher hu leman deamar rauy laachila baenan shiur achila veleka

Ravina amar kol ki hay gavena let beh mishshum shevirat haetzem devaenan shiur achila ella ever sheen alav kezayit basar bemakom ze veyesh alav kezayit basar bimkom acher ika benayehu leman deamar kasher ha kasher hu leman deamar rauy laachila baenan shiur achila bimkom shevira veha leka
Tanya kearbea minayehu detanya rabbi omer bevayit echad yeachel veetzem lo tishberu bo al hakkasher hu chayyav veeno chayyav al happasul

Yesh bo shiur achila yesh bo mishshum shevirat etzem en bo shiur achila en bo mishshum shevirat etzem
Harauy lammizbeach en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem
Bishat achila yesh bo mishshum shevirat etzem shello bishat achila en bo mishshum shevirat etzem
Itmar ever sheen alav kezayit basar bimkom ze veyesh alav kezayit basar bimkom acher rabbi yochanan amar yesh bo mishshum shevirat haetzem rabbi shimon ben lakish amar en bo mishshum shevirat etzem

Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish veetzem lo tishberu bo echad etzem sheyyesh alav kezayit basar veechad etzem sheen alav kezayit basar may en alav kezayit basar ilema deen alav kezayit basar kelal ammay yesh bo mishshum shevirat haetzem ella lav hachi kaamar echad etzem sheyyesh alav kezayit basar bemakom ze veechad sheen alav kezayit basar bemakom ze veyesh alav kezayit basar bemakom acher kashya lerabbi shimon ben lakish

Vehatanya veetzem lo tishberu bo echad etzem sheyyesh bo moach veechad etzem sheen bo moach uma ani mekayyem veachlu et habbasar ballayela hazze bevasar sheal gabbe haetzem

Ibaya lehu yotze gezaru rabbanan tuma o la mi amrinan notar digzaru tuma deate leiatzole beh aval yotze appoke beyadayim la mappeki leh beyadayim la gezaru beh rabbanan tuma o dilma la shena
Ta shema ever sheyyatza miktzato chotech ad shemmaggia laetzem vekolef ad shemmaggia lapperek vechotech vei amratte gezaru beh rabbanan tuma ki chatech leh may have ha kamtamme leh
Tumat setarim hi vetumat setarim la metammeya

Veha ka tane sefa haochlo hare ze belo taase bishlama leman deamar kevetza deit beh kezayit velet beh kevetza ella leman deamar kezayit may ika lememar
Ella beotze bappesach la mibaya lan dela gezaru rabbanan tuma may tama bene chavura zerizin hen umizhar zehiri beh ella ki kamibaya lan beotze bekadashim may teku

b: Yachol yehe neechal bishte chavurot talmud lomar bevayit echad yeachel
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi yehuda savar yesh em lammasoret verabbi shimon savar yesh em lammikra
Hau yoshvin venifresa mechitza benehem ledivre haomer pesach neechal bishte chavurot ochlin ledivre haomer en happesach neechal bishte chavurot en ochlin
Hau yoshvin venistalleka mechitza benehen ledivre haomer haochel ochel bishne mekomot ochlin ledivre haomer en haochel ochel bishne mekomot en ochlin
Yatev rav kahana ka pashet leh mifshat amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana vetibe lach ibaya siluk mechitza vaasiyyat mechitza mi have kishne mekomot vechishte chavurot dame o la teku
Hakkalla hofechet et paneha vechu may tama amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan mippene shehi bosha

Rav huna bereh derav natan ikla leve rav nachman bar yitzchak amaru leh ma shemach amar lehu rav huna amaru nitev mar appurya yetev yehavu leh kasa kabbeleh bechad zimna veshatyeh bitre zimne vela ahdar appeh
Amaru leh may tama karet lecha rav huna amar lehu baal hashshem ani may tama ki amaru lach nitev appurya yetevte amar lehu kol ma sheyyomar lecha baal habbayit ase chutz mitztze

May tama ki yahavi lach kasa kabbelte bechad zimna amar lehu mesarvin lakkatan veen mesarvin laggadol may tama ishteteh bitre zimne amar lehu detanya hashshote koso bevat achat hare ze gargeran shenayim derech eretz shelosha miggasse haruach may tama la ahdarte appach amar lehu kalla hofechet paneha tenan

Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose ikla leve rabbi shimon berabbi yose ben lakonya yehavu leh kasa kabbeleh bechad zimna veshatyeh bechad zimna amri leh la savar lah mar hashshote koso bevat achat hare ze gargeran amar lehu la amri bechoscha katan veyencha matok uchresi rechava
Amar rav huna bene chavura nichnasin bishlosha veotzin afilu beechad amar rabba vehu deayel beidana dirgili lemeal vehu dirgash behu dayyala
Amar ravina venotnin sechar damim vetzarich haacharon lehosif damim velet hilcheta keoteh
Hadran alach ketzad tzolin

a: Matni haishsha bizman shehi bevet balah shachat aleha balah veshachat aleha aviha tochal mishshel balah halcha regel rishon laasot bevet aviha shachat aleha aviha veshachat aleha balah tochal bimkom shehi rotza
Yatom sheshshachatu alav appotroppesin yochal bimkom shehu rotze eved shel shene shuttafin lo yochal mishshel shenehen mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin lo yochal mishshel rabbo
Gema shamatte minah yesh berera may rotza bishat shechita
Urminhu ishsha regel harishon ochelet mishshel aviha mikkan veelach rotza ochelet mishshel aviha rotza mishshel balah
La kashya kan birdufa lelech kan besheenah redufa

Dichtiv az hayiti veenav kemotzet shalom veamar rabbi yochanan kechalla shennimtzet shelema bevet chamiha urdufa lelech lehaggid shivchah bevet aviha kedichtiv vehaya bayyom hahu neum Adonai tikrei ishi velo tikrei li od bali amar rabbi yochanan kechalla bevet chamiha velo kechalla bevet aviha
Achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah amar rabbi yochanan zo elam shezzachta lilmod velo zachta lelammed

Ani choma veshaday kammigdalot amar rabbi yochanan ani choma zo tora veshaday kammigdalot ellu talmide chachamim verava amar ani choma zo keneset yisrael veshaday kammigdalot ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot
Amar rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav may dichtiv asher banenu kintiim meguddalim binurehem benotenu chezaviyyot mechuttavot tavnit hechal

Asher banenu kintiim ellu bachure yisrael shello taamu taam chet benotenu chezaviyyot ellu betulot yisrael sheogdot pitchehen levaalehen vechen hu omer umalu kammizrak kezaviyyot mizbeach ibaet ema mehacha mezavenu meleim mefikim mizzan el zan
Mechuttavot tavnit hechal ellu vaellu maale alehen hakkatuv keilu nivna hechal bimehen

Devar Adonai asher haya el hoshea vego bime uzziyyahu yotam achaz yechizkiyya melech yehuda beferek echad nitnabbeu arbaa neviim vegadol shebbechullan hoshea shenneemar techillat dibber Adonai behoshea vechi behoshea dibber techilla vahalo mimmoshe ad hoshea kamma neviim amar rabbi yochanan techilla learbaa neviim shennitnabbeu beoto happerek veellu hen hoshea yeshaya amos umicha

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lehoshea banecha chatu vehaya lo lomar banecha hem bene chanunecha hem bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov galgel rachamecha alehen lo dayyo shello amar kach ella amar lefanav ribbono shel olam kol haolam shellecha hu haavirem beumma acheret

Amar hakkadosh baruch hu ma eese lezaken ze omar lo lech vekach ishsha zona veholed lecha banim zenunim veachar kach omar lo shallechah meal panecha im hu yachol lishloach af ani ashallach et yisrael shenneemar vayyomer Adonai el hoshea lech kach lecha eshet zenunim veyalde zenunim uchtiv vayyelech vayyikkach et gomer bat divlayim gomer amar rav shehakkol gomrim bah bat
b: Divlayim dibba raa bat dibba raa ushmuel amar shemmetuka befi hakkol kidvela verabbi yochanan amar shehakkol dashin bah kidvela
Davar acher gomer amar rabbi yehuda shebbikkeshu legammer mamonan shel yisrael beyameha rabbi yochanan amar bazzu vegamru shenneemar ki ibbedam melech aram vayesimem keafar ladush

Vattahar vatteled lo ben vayyomer Adonai elav kera shemo yizreel ki od meat ufakadti et deme yizreel al bet yehu vehishbatti mamlechut bet yisrael vattahar od vatteled bat vayyomer lo kera shemah lo ruchama ki lo osif od arachem et bet yisrael ki naso essa lahem vattahar vatteled ben vayyomer Adonai elav kera shemo lo ammi ki attem lo ammi veanochi lo ehye lachem

Leachar shennoldu lo shene vanim uvat achat amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lehoshea lo haya lecha lilmod mimmoshe rabbach shekkevan sheddibbarti immo perash min haishsha af atta bedol atzmecha mimmenna amar lo ribbono shel olam yesh li banim mimmenna veen ani yachol lehotziah velo legarshah

Amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu uma atta sheishtecha zona uvanecha bene zenunim veen atta yodea im shellecha hen im shel acherim hen kach yisrael shehen banay bene bechunay bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov echad mearbaa kinyanin shekkaniti beolami

Tora kinyan echad dichtiv Adonai kanani reshit darko shamayim vaaretz kinyan echad dichtiv kone shamayim vaaretz bet hammikdash kinyan echad dichtiv har ze kanta yemino yisrael kinyan echad dichtiv am zu kanita veatta amarta haavirem beumma acheret

Kevan sheyyada shechata amad levakkesh rachamim al atzmo amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu ad sheatta mevakkesh rachamim al atzmecha bakkesh rachamim al yisrael sheggazarti alehem shalosh gezerot baavurecha

Amad uvikkesh rachamim uvittel gezera vehitchil levarchan shenneemar vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam vego vehaya bimkom asher yeamer lahem lo ammi attem yeamer lahem bene el chay venikbetzu bene yehuda uvne yisrael yachdav vego uzratiha li baaretz verichamti et lo ruchama veamarti lelo ammi ammi atta

Amar rabbi yochanan oy lah larabbanut shemmekabberet et bealeha sheen lach kol navi venavi shello kipeach arbaa melachim beyamav shenneemar chazon yeshayahu ven amotz asher chaza al yehuda virushalayim vego
Amar rabbi yochanan mippene ma zacha yarovam ben yoash melech yisrael lehimmanot im malche yehuda mippene shello kibbel lashon hara al amos
Menalan deimni dichtiv devar Adonai asher haya el hoshea ben beeri bime uzziyya yotam achaz yechizkiyya malche yehuda uvime yarovam ben yoash melech yisrael

Umnalan delo kibel lashon hara dichtiv vayyishlach amatzya kohen bet el el yarovam melech yisrael lemor kashar alecha vego uchtiv ki cho amar amos bacherev yamut yarovam vego amar chas veshalom amar oto tzaddik kach veim amar ma eese lo shechina amra lo
Amar rabbi elazar afilu bishat kaso shel hakkadosh baruch hu zocher et harachamim shenneemar ki lo osif od arachem et bet yisrael rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina amar mehacha ki naso essa lahem
Veamar rabbi elazar lo higla hakkadosh baruch hu et yisrael leven haummot ella kede sheyyittosfu alehem gerim shenneemar uzratiha li baaretz kelum adam zorea sea ella lehachnis kamma korin
Verabbi yochanan amar mehacha verichamti et lo ruchama

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay may dichtiv al talshen eved el adonav pen yekallelcha veashamta uchtiv dor aviv yekallel veet immo lo yevarech mishshum deaviv yekallel veet immo lo yevarech al talshen
Ella afilu dor sheaviv yekallel veet immo lo yevarech al talshen eved el adonav menalan mehoshea

Amar rabbi oshaya may dichtiv tzidkat pirzono beyisrael tzedaka asa hakkadosh baruch hu beyisrael sheppizzeran leven haummot vehayenu daamar leh hahu mina lerabbi chanina anan meallinan minayechu ketiv bechu ki sheshet chodashim yashav sham vego veillu anan itinchu gabban kamma shene vela ka avdinan lechu mide amar lo retzoncha yittafel lach talmid echad

Nitpal leh rabbi oshaya amar leh mishshum dela yaditu hechi tabedu techallinan kullehu letanhu gabbayechu may deika gabbayechu kare lechu malchuta ketiata amar leh gappa deromae beha nachatinan uvha salkinan

Tane rabbi chiyya may dichtiv elohim hevin darkah vehu yada et mekomah yodea hakkadosh baruch hu et yisrael sheenan yecholin lekabbel gezerot shel romiyyim lefichach higla otam levavel veamar rabbi elazar lo higla hakkadosh baruch hu et yisrael levavel ella mippene sheamukka kishol shenneemar miyyad sheol efdem mimmavet egalem rabbi chanina amar mippene shekkarov leshonam lilshon tora
Rabbi yochanan amar mippene sheshshigran levet imman mashal leadam shekkaas al ishto lehechan meshaggerah levet immah

Vehayenu derabbi alekkesanderi deamar shelosha chazru lemattaatan ellu hen yisrael kesef mitzrayim uchtav luchot yisrael ha daamaran kesef mitzrayim dichtiv vayehi bashshana hachamishit lammelech rechavam ala shishak melech mitzrayim al yerushalayim vego ketav halluchot dichtiv vaashabberem leenechem tana luchot nishberu veotiyyot porchot
Ulla amar kede sheyyochlu

a: Temarim veyaasku battora ulla ikla lefumbedita karivu leh tiryana detamre amar lehu kamma ki hane bezuza amaru leh telat bezuza amar mela tzanna deduvsha bezuza uvavlae la aski beorayeta
Belelya tzaaruhu amar mela tzanna samma demota bezuza bevavel uvavlae aski beorayeta
Veamar rabbi elazar may dichtiv vehalchu ammim rabbim veamru lechu venaale el har Adonai el bet elohe yaakov vego elohe yaakov velo elohe avraham veyitzchak

Ella lo keavraham shekkatuv bo har shenneemar asher yeamer hayyom behar Adonai yerae velo keyitzchak shekkatuv bo sade shenneemar vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade ella keyaakov shekkerao bayit shenneemar vayyikra et shem hammakom hahu bet el

Amar rabbi yochanan gadol kibbutz galiyyot kayyom shennivreu bo shamayim vaaretz shenneemar venikbetzu bene yehuda uvne yisrael yachdav vesamu lahem rosh echad vealu min haaretz ki gadol yom yizreel uchtiv vayehi erev vayehi voker yom echad
Yatom sheshshachatu alav appotroppesin vechu shamatte minah yesh berera amar rabbi zera se labbayit mikkol makom

Tanu rabbanan se labbayit melammed sheadam mevi veshochet al yede beno uvitto hakketannim veal yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim ben middatan ben shello middatan aval eno shochet al yede beno uvitto haggedolim veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim veal yad ishto ella middatan

Tanya idach lo yishchot adam lo al yede beno uvitto haggedolim veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim veal yad ishto ella middatan aval shochet hu al yede beno uvitto hakketannim veal yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim ben middatan uven shello middatan vechullan sheshshachatu veshachat rabban alehen yotzin beshel rabban veen yotzin beshel atzman
Chutz min haishsha sheyechola lemachot
May shena ishsha amar rava ishsha vechol dedame lah
Ha gufa kashya amratte chutz min haishsha sheyechola lemachot tama demachay ha la machay nafka beshel balah veha katane resha velo al yede ishto ella middatan ha setama la nafka
May ella middatan lav deamri in ella bistama leappoke hecha daamur la
Veha kullam sheshshachatu veshachat rabban alehen yotzin beshel rabban devistama vekatane chutz min haishsha mippene sheyechola lemachot
Amar rava kevan sheshshachatu en lecha michuy gadol mizze
Eved shel shene shuttafin vechu rame leh rav ena sava lerav nachman tenan eved shel shene shuttafin lo yochal mishshel shenehen vehatanya ratza mizze ochel ratza mizze ochel
Amar leh ena sava veamri lah patya ukkama mini uminach tistayyem shemateta matnitin bidkafdi ahadade barayeta dela kafdi ahadade
Mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin lo yochal mishshel rabbo vechu mishshel rabbo hu delo yochal aval mishshel atzmo yochal veha tanya lo yochal lo mishshello velo mishshel rabbo
La kashya kan kemishna rishona kan kemishna acharona ditnan mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin oved et rabbo yom echad veet atzmo yom echad divre bet hillel bet shammay omrim
b: Tikkantem et rabbo veet atzmo lo tikkantem lisa shifcha eno yachol shekkevar chetzo ben chorin lisa bat chorin eno yachol sheadayin chetzo eved yivtal vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya urviyya shenneemar lo tohu veraah ella lashevet yetzarah ella mippene tikun haolam kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin vechotev shetar al chatzi damav
Vechazru bet hilel lehorot kevet shammay
Matni haomer leavdo tze ushchot alay et happesach shachat gedi yochal shachat tale yochal shachat gedi vetale yochal min harishon
Shachach ma amar lo rabbo ketzad yaase yishchat tale ugdi veyomar im gedi amar li rabbi gedi shello vetale shelli veim tale amar li rabbi hattale shello ugdi shelli
Shachach rabbo ma amar lo shenehen yetzu levet hasserefa ufturin millaasot pesach sheni
Gema peshita shachat gedi yochal af al gav dirgil betale shachat tale yochal af al gav dirgil bigdi
Shachat gedi vetale yochal min harishon veha tanya en nimnin al shene fesachim keechad
Matnitin bemelech umalka

Vehatanya en nimnin al shene fesachim keechad umaase bemelech umalka sheamru leavdehem tzeu veshachatu alenu et happesach veyatzu veshachatu alehen shene fesachim bau veshaalu et hammelech amar lahem lechu veshaalu et hammalka bau veshaalu min hammalka amra lahem lechu veshaalu et rabban gamliel
Bau veshaalu et rabban gamliel amar lahem malka umelech dedatan kalla alehen yochlu min harishon anan lo nochal lo min harishon velo min hashsheni

Veshuv paam achat nimtzet haltaa bevet hammitbachayim uvikkeshu letamme kal hasseuda kullah bau veshaalu et hammelech amar lahem lechu veshaalu et hammalka bau veshaalu et hammalka amra lahem lechu veshaalu et rabban gamliel

Bau veshaalu oto amar lahem bet hammitbachayim roteach o tzonen amru lo roteach amar lahem lechu vehatilu aleha kos shel tzonen halchu vehetilu aleha kos shel tzonen verichasha vetiher rabban gamliel kol hasseuda kullah
Nimtza melech taluy bammalka venimtzeta malka teluya berabban gamliel nimtzet kol hasseuda teluya berabban gamliel
Shachach ma sheamar lo rabbo vechu shelli ma shekkana eved kana rabbo
Amar abbaye holech etzel roe haragil rabbo etzlo denicha leh betakkanta derabbeh umakne leh chad minayehu al menat sheen lerabbo reshut bo

Shachach rabbo ma sheamar lo vechu amar abbaye lo shanu ella sheshshachach achar zerika dividana deizrik dam hava chaze laachila aval shachach lifne zerika dechi izrik dam la hava chaze laachila chayyavin laasot pesach sheni
Ika dematne lah abbarayeta chamishsha shennitarvu orot pischehen ze baze venimtzet yabbelet beechad mehen kullan yotzin levet hasserefa ufturin millaasot pesach sheni
Amar abbaye lo shanu ella shennitarvu leachar zerika dividana deizrik dam miha hava chaze laachila aval nitarvu lifne zerika chayyavin laasot pesach sheni
Man dematne ammatnitin kol shekken abbarayeta man dematne abbarayeta aval ammatnitin la kevan dichsherin ninhu dei idchar have chaze laachila kamme shemayya galya
Amar mar ufturin millaasot pesach sheni veha ika chad dela nafek
Mishshum dela ifshar hechi lebed layete kol chad vechad pesach ka mayete chullin laazara dearbea minayehu avdi lehu
Layete kullehu chad pesach nimtza pesach neechal shello limnuyav
Hay may nayete kol chad minayehu pischo venatne venema i didi baal mum hay deayetay hashta nihve pesach vei didi tam hay deayetay hashta nihve shelamim
La efshar

a: Mishshum deika chaze vashok dechohanim hu deachli leh
Venayete kol chad vechad kohen bahadeh
Hay kohen hechi dame i deaved pesach dilma hay pesach hu venimtza pesach neechal shello limnuyav vei dela aved pesach dilma shelamim hu vela aved pesach
Venayete kol chamsha chad kohen dela avad pesach venimne ilaveh hane chamishsha pesachim demimma nafshach ika chad dela aved pesach veka nafki beh
Ella mishshum deka memaet baachilat shelamim deilu pesach leom velayela veilu shelamim lishne yamim velayela echad
Venayete motar happesach
Venema i didi baal mum hay deayetay hashta nihve pesach i didi tam hu nihve hay deayetay hashta shelamim demotar happesach neechal leom velayela echad
Vechi mafrishin techilla lammotarot venitrechu venayete motar happesach
Ella mishshum semicha deilu pesach la bae semicha veilu motar bae semicha
Ha tinach korban anashim korban nashim may ika lememar
Ella mishshum mattanot deilu pesach mattana achat veilu shelamim shettayim shehen arba
May nafka minah veha tenan kol hannitanin al mizbeach hachitzon shennetanan bemattan achat kipper
Ella mishshum deilu pesach bishficha veilu shelamim bizrika
May nafka minah veha tanya kol hannitanin bizrika shennetanan bishficha yatza emar deka amrinan dei avad lechattechilla name
Matni haomer levanav hareni shochet et happesach al mi sheyyaale mikkem rishon lirushalayim kevan shehichnis harishon rosho verubbo zacha bechelko umzakke et echav immo
Gema shema minah yesh berera
Amar rabbi yochanan kede lezarzan bemitzot kaamar

Dayeka name dekatane umzakke echav immo i amratte bishlama deamninhu meikara shappir ella i amratte dela amninhu meikara levatar deshachet mi ka mitmannu veha tenan nimnin umoshchin yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet shema minah
Tanya name hachi maase vekadmu banot levanim venimtza banot zerizot uvanim shefalim
Matni leolam nimnin alav ad sheyyihye bo kezayit lechol echad veechad nimnin umoshchin et yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet rabbi shimon omer ad sheyyizzarek et haddam
Gema may ka mashma lan ha ka mashma lan deaf al gav deimni alav chavura zo chozeret venimnin alav chavura acheret
Nimnin umoshchin et yedehen ad sheyyishshachet vechu amar abbaye machaloket limashech
Derabbanan savri mihot misse mechayyuteh dese verabbi shimon savar mehavayateh dese aval limanot divre hakkol ad sheyyishshachet deamar kera bemichsat nefashot vahadar tachossu
Tanya name hachi nimnin umoshchin et yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet rabbi shimon omer nimnin ad sheyyishshachet umoshchin ad sheyyizzarek haddam
b: Matni hammanne immo acher bechelko rashshain bene chavura liten lo et shello vehu ochel mishshello vehen ochlin mishshellahen

Gema ibaya lehu bene chavura shehau yadav shel echad mehen yafot mahu sheyyomru lo tol chelkecha vatze mi amrinan matze amar lehu ha kabbeltun o dilma matzu lememar leh ki kabbelnan letakone zevicha addata deachlatte tefe minan la kabbelnach

Ta shema hammanne acherim immo al chelko rashshain bene chavura liten lo et shello vehu ochel et shello vehen ochlin et shellahen may tama lav mishshum dehave leh keyadayim shel echad mehen yafot vei salka datach yadav yafot matze amar lehu kabbeltun nihve hay keyadav yafot
Amri la deot shane dei name tarvayehu kechad mibbene chavura hu deachli matze amri leh dela nicha lan inash nuchra gabban

Ta shema hashshammash sheachal kezayit basar betzad hattannur im haya pikkeach memalle kereso mimmennu im ratzu bene chavura laasot tova immo bain veoshvin betziddo veochlin divre rabbi yehuda ratzu in lo ratzu la veammay nema lehu ha kabbeltun
Shane hatam deamri leh ki kabbelnach addata denatrechach kamman lemitrach lan ledidach la kabbelnach
Ta shema bene chavura shehaya yadav shel echad mehen yafot rashshain lomar tol chelkecha vatze velo od ella afilu chamishsha veasu sibolet rashshain lomar lo tol chelkecha vatze shema minah
May velo od la mibaya kaamar la mibaya pesach dematze amri leh ki kabbelnach letakkone zevicha ella afilu sibolet name detzaveta bealma hu rashshain lomar lo tol chelkecha vatze
Ika deamri ha la ibaya lan ella hachi hu deibaya lan bene chavura rashshain lechallek o enan rashshain lechallek
Ta shema bene chavura shehau yadav shel echad mehen yafot rashshain lomar lo tol chelkecha vatze yadav yafot in en yadav yafot la shema minah
Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua arivu rifta bahade hadade addeachel rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chada achel rav pappa arba amar leh pelag li amar leh kabbeltun
Etiveh kol hane teuvata veshanni kidshanninan etiveh bene chavura amar leh hatam deamri leh ki kabbelnach letakone zevicha etiveh sibolet pelag leh
Azal arev bahade ravina addeachel rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chada achel ravina temanya amar mea pappe vela chada ravina
Tanu rabbanan hammanne acherim immo al pischo veal chagigato maot shebbeyado chullin vehammocher olato ushlamav lo asa velo kelum umaot kol shehen yippelu lindava
Vechi meachar delo asa velo kelum maot ammay yippelu lindava amar rava kenasa umay kol shehen af al gav dela hao shau ella arbea vihavu leh chamsha afilu behahi yattira name kansuhu rabbanan
Amar ulla veitema rabbi oshaya efshar yadi chavrin bavlae tama dehay milleta ze hifrish tale lefischo veze hifrish maot lefischo heach hekdesh chal al hekdesh dekatane maot shebbeyado chullin

a: Amar abbaye i lav deokmeh rabbi oshaya lehahi bimmanne zona al pischo verabbi hi hava mokemna lah lehahi bekadashim kallim vealliba derabbi yose haggelili deamar kadashim kallim mamon bealim hu
Aval befesach la meshayyar inish bemaot vadday meshayyar inish demeikara ki mafresh lehu addata dehachi mafresh lehu
Veha rabbi hi umishshum hachi maot shebbeyado chullin devappesach la meshayyar inish uvmaot vadday meshayyar inish
Vehahi deka moke lah rabbi oshaya kerabbi la mokemna leh ana kerabbi divfesach la meshayyar inish uvmaot meshayyar inish demeikara ki mafresh lehu addata dehachi mafresh lehu
Veha leka leokome kerabbi yose deha tane bah vehammocher olato ushlamav lo asa velo chelum
Vehashta deokmeh rabbi oshaya lehahi bimmanne zona al pischo verabbi hi shema minah disvira leh afilu befischo meshayyar inish
May hi derabbi oshaya ditnan natan lah mukdashin beetnannah hare ellu muttarin

Ofot dechullin hare ellu asurin shehaya baddin uma im mukdashim shehammum posel bahen en etnan umchir chal alehen ofot sheen hammum posel bahen eno din sheen etnan umchir chal alehen talmud lomar lechol neder lerabbot et haofot
Kal vachomer lammukdashin meatta ma ofot sheen hammum posel bahen etnan umchir chal alehen mukdashin shehammum posel bahen eno din sheetnan umchir chal alehen talmud lomar lechol neder perat lindor
Ella tama dichtav rachamana neder ha lav hachi hava amena mukdashim chal isur etnan alehen veha en adam oser davar sheeno shello
Amar rabbi oshaya bimmanne zona al pischo verabbi hi
May rabbi detanya im yimat habbayit mihot misse hachayehu misse mikkede achila velo mikkede mikkach
Rabbi omer af mikkede mikkach sheim en lo memanne acher immo al pischo veal chagigato umaot shebbeyado chullin sheal menat ken hikdishu yisrael et pischehen
Rabba verabbi zera chad amar beetzim litzliyyato kulle alma la peligi dechevan detakkanta defesach hu kegufa defesach dame ki peligi bematztza umaror
Rabbanan savri ha achila achariti hi verabbi savar kevan dehechshero defesach hu kegufa defesach dame

Vechad amar bematztza umaror name kulle alma la peligi dichtiv al matztzot umrorim yochluhu dechevan demachshirin defesach ninhu kefesach dame ki peligi likach bo chaluk likach bo tallit rabbanan savri mihot misse amar rachamana hachayehu lasse verabbi savar hachaye atzmecha misse

Ulabbaye deamar i lav deokmah rabbi oshaya lehahi bimmanne zona al pischo verabbi hi have mokminan lah bekadashim kallim vealliba derabbi yose haggelili deamar kadashim kallim memon bealim hu aval befesach la meshayyar inish
Ha katane behedya sheal menat ken hikdishu yisrael et pischehen ema sheal menat ken hikdishu yisrael meot pischehen
Matni zav sheraa shette reiyyot shochatin alav bashshevii raa shalosh shochatin alav bashshemini shello
Shomeret yom keneged yom shochatin aleha bashsheni shellah raata shene yamim shochatin aleha bashshelishi
Vehazzava shochatin aleha bashshemini
Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav shochatin vezorkin al tevul yom umchussar kippurim
b: Veen shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz veulla amar af shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz
Lerav may shena tevul yom dachaze leurta teme sheretz name chaze leurta mechussar tevila
Tevul yom name mechussar heerev shemesh shimsha mimmela arva
Mechussar kippurim name ha mechussar kappara shekkino beyado
Teme sheretz name hare mikve lefanav dilma pasha i hachi mechussar kippurim name dilma pasha kegon demasrinhu levet din
Vechidrav shemaya deamar chazaka en bet din shel kohanim omdin mishsham ad sheyyichlu maot shebbashshofarot
Ulrav middeorayeta michze chaze verabbanan hu digzaru beh allema amar rav metammein echad mehen besheretz
Ella lerav middeorayeta name la chaze dichtiv ish ish ki yihye tame lanefesh mi la askinan shechal shevii shello lihot beerev happesach dehayenu tumat sheretz veamar rachamana nidche
Vechi tema mimmay dehachi

Savar lah kerabbi yitzchak deamar temee met mitzva hau shechal shevii shellahen lihot beerev happesach shenneemar velo yachlu laasot happesach bayyom hahu beom hahu hu deenan yecholin laasot aval lemachar yecholin laasot veamar rachamana niddecho
Tenan zav sheraa shette reiyyot shochatin alav bashshevii may lav dela tavel ushma minah shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz
La detavel i tavel may ka mashma lan ha ka mashma lan deaf al gav dimchussar heerev hashshemesh ka mashma lan deshimsha mimmela arva
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane sefa raa shalosh reiyyot shochatin alav bashshemini i amratte bishlama zav sheraa shette reiyyot shochatin alav bashshevii detavel itzterich

Salka datach amena raa shette reiyyot bishvii hu dela mechussar maase aval raa shalosh bashshemini dimchussar maase mechussar kappara la ka mashma lan deaf al gav dimchussar kappara shochatin vezorkin ilaveh
Ella i amratte raa shette reiyyot bishvii dela tavel raa shalosh bashshemini lema li

Hashta yesh lomar raa shette reiyyot bashshevii dela tavel detame mealleya hu shachatinan vezarkinan ilaveh raa shalosh bashshemini detavel leh bashshevii diklisha tuma lo kol shekken deshachatinan vezarkinan ilaveh
Ella lav shema minah raa shette reiyyot bashshevii deshachatinan ilaveh detavel
La leolam ema lach dela tavel veitzterich salka datach amena bashshevii hu divyado letakken
Aval bashshemini deen beyado lehakriv korban ema pashi beh kohanim ka mashma lan kidrav shemaya

Vehazzava shochatin vechu tane tanna kammeh derav adda bar ahava vehazzava shochatin aleha bashshevii shellah amar leh zava bashshevii shellah mi chazya afilu leman deamar shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz hane mile teme sheretz dachaze leurta ha ad limchar dematya kappara la chazya ema bashshemini
Peshita mahu detema kevan dimchassera kappara la ka mashma lan kidrav shemaya
Ravina amar nidda tena kammeh vehannidda shochatin aleha bashshevii

Amar leh nidda bashshevii mi chazya afilu leman deamar shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz dachaze leurta nidda leurta dishvii hu detavla ad shemini deavda heerev shemesh la chazya ella ema bashshemini
Peshita hashta uma zava dimchassera kappara shochatin vezorkin aleha bashshemini nidda dela mechassera kappara tzericha lememar deshachatinan vezarkinan alah
Nidda itztericha leh ha ka mashma lan bashshemini in bashshevii la kidtanya kol chayyave tevilot tevilatan bayyom nidda veoledet tevilatan ballayela
Detanya yachol tehe tovelet mibbeod yom talmud lomar shivat yamim tihye beniddatah tehe beniddatah kol shiva veoledet itakkash lenidda
Matni haonen

a: Vehamfakkeach et haggal vechen mi shehivtichuhu lehotzio mibbet haasurim vehachole vehazzaken shehen yecholin leechol kezayit shochatin alehen
Al kullam en shochatin alehen bifne atzman shemma yaviu et happesach lide fesul
Lefichach im era bahen pesul peturin millaasot pesach sheni chutz min hamfakkeach baggal shehu tame mittechillato

Gema amar rabba bar huna amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella bet haasurin degoy aval bet haasurin deyisrael shochatin bifne atzmo kevan deavtechinhu mappek leh dichtiv sheerit yisrael lo yaasu avela velo yedabberu chazav
Amar rav chisda ha deamratte bet haasurin degoyim la amaran ella chutz lechomat bet page aval lifnim mechomat bet page shochatin alav bifne atzmo may tama efshar deamtu leh veachel leh
Lefichach im era vechu amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella gal agol aval gal aroch patur millaasot pesach sheni ema tahor haya bishat shechita

Tanya name hachi rabbi shimon beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer mefakkeach baggal ittim patur ittim chayyav ketzad gal agol venimtzet tuma tachtav chayyav gal aroch venimtzet tuma tachtav patur ema tahor haya bishat shechita
Matni en shochatin et happesach al hayyachid divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose mattir vaafilu chavura shel mea sheenan yecholin leechol kezayit en shochatin alehen
Veen osin chavurat nashim vaavadim uktannim

Gema tanu rabbanan minnayin sheen shochatin et happesach al hayyachid talmud lomar lo tuchal lizboach et happasach beachad divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose omer yachid veyachol leochlo shochatin alav asara veen yecholin leochlo en shochatin alehen
Verabbi yose hay beachad may aved leh mibe leh lechidrabbi shimon detanya rabbi shimon omer minnayin lazzoveach et pischo bevamat yachid bishat isur habbamot shehu belo taase
