Talmud lomar lo tuchal lizboach et happasach beachad shearecha yachol af bishat heter habbamot ken talmud lomar beachad shearecha lo amru ella beshaa shekkol yisrael nichnasin beshaar echad
Verabbi yehuda hay mena leh tarte shamatte minah
Ulrabbi yose mimmay dilhachi dekaamar rabbi shimon dilma kidkaamar rabbi yehuda hu daata amar lach la salka datach deha ketiv ish lefi ochlo

Rame leh rav ukva bar chinana mipparishna lerava mi amar rabbi yehuda en shochatin et happesach al hayyachid urminhu ishsha barishon shochatin aleha bifne atzmah uvashsheni osin otah tefela laacherim divre rabbi yehuda amar leh la tema bifne atzmah ella ema bifne atzman

Amar leh mi avdinan chavura shekkullah nashim vehatnan en osin chavurat nashim vaavadim uktannim may lav nashim lechodayehu vaavadim lechodayehu uktannim lechodayehu amar leh la nashim vaavadim uktannim nashim vaavadim mishshum tiflut ketannim vaavadim mishshum
b: Peritzuta

Gufa ishsha barishon shochatin aleha bifne atzmah uvashsheni osin otah tefela laacherim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer ishsha bashsheni shochatin aleha bifne atzmah veen tzarich lomar barishon rabbi shimon omer ishsha barishon osin otah tefela laacherim bashsheni en shochatin aleha kal ikar
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi yehuda savar bemichsat nefashot vaafilu nashim vechi tema i hachi afilu bashsheni name ketiv cheto yissa haish hahu ish in ishsha la
Vechi tema i hachi afilu tefila name bashsheni la ahani kechol chukkat happesach litfila bealma

Verabbi yose may tama dichtiv barishon bemichsat nefashot vaafilu ishsha uchtiv befesach sheni venichreta hannefesh hahi meammeha nefesh vaafilu nashim veella cheto yissa haish hahu lemaote may lemaote katan mikkaret
Verabbi shimon ketiv barishon ish ish in ishsha la vechi tema i hachi afilu tefila name la ahani leh bemichsat nefashot litfila
Vechi tema afilu bashsheni name miet rachamana bashsheni dichtiv cheto yissa haish ish in ishsha la mimmay kammaet leh i mechiyyuv hashta barishon la bashsheni mibaya ella lav mittefila
Umay ish dekaamar rabbi shimon i nema veyikchu lahem ish se levet avot vego hahu mibe leh lechidrabbi yitzchak deamar ish zoche veen katan zoche
Veella meish lefi ochlo ha midderabbi yose savar lah kerabbi shimon rabbi shimon name savar lah kerabbi yose vehahu mibe leh deshochatin et happesach al hayyachid
Amar lach im ken nichtov rachamana lefi ochlo may ish shamatte minah tarte

Keman azla ha deamar rabbi elazar ishsha barishon chova uvashsheni reshut vedoche et hashshabbat i reshut ammay doche et hashshabbat ella ema bashsheni reshut uvarishon chova vedoche et hashshabbat keman kerabbi yehuda
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan en osin chavura shekkullah gerim shemma yedakdeku bo viviuhu lide pesul
Tanu rabbanan pesach umatztza umaror barishon chova mikkan veelach reshut rabbi shimon omer baanashim chova uvannashim reshut
Aheya kae ilema appesach pesach kol shiva mi ika veella ammatztza umaror ema sefa rabbi shimon omer baanashim chova uvnashim reshut

Let leh lerabbi shimon ha deamar rabbi elazar nashim chayyavot baachilat matztza devar tora shenneemar lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot kol sheyyeshno beval tochal chametz yeshno bekum echol matztza vehane nashim hoil veyeshnan beval tochal chametz yeshnan bekum echol matztza
Ella ema pesach matztza umaror barishon chova mikkan veelach reshut rabbi shimon omer pesach baanashim chova bannashim reshut
Matni onen tovel veochel et pischo laerev aval lo bakkodashim hashshomea al meto

a: Vehamlakket lo atzamot tovel veochel bakkodashim
Ger shennitgayyer beerev pesach bet shammay omrim tovel veochel et pischo laerev uvet hillel omrim happoresh min haorla keforesh min hakkever
Gema may tama ka savar aninut delayela derabbanan vegabbe pesach lo heemidu divrehem bimkom karet gabbe kadashim haamidu divrehem bimkom ase
Hashshomea al meto vechu melakket atzamot ha bae hazzaat shelishi ushvii ema shelliktu lo atzamot
Ger shennitgayyer vechu amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan machaloket bearel goy

Devet hillel savri gezera shemma yittame leshana habbaa veyomar eshtakad mi lo tavalti veachalti achshav name etbol veochal vela yada deeshtakad goy hava vela mekabbel tuma achshav yisrael umkabbel tuma
Uvet shammay savri la gazrinan aval arel yisrael divre hakkol tovel veochel et pischo laerev vela gazrinan arel yisrael mishshum arel goy

Tanya name hachi amar rabbi shimon ben elazar lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al arel yisrael shettovel veochel et pischo laerev al ma nechleku al arel goy shebbet shammay omrim tovel veochel et pischo laerev uvet hillel omrim happoresh min haorla keforesh min hakkever
Amar rava arel hazzaa veizmel heemidu divrehen bimkom karet onen umtzora uvet happeras lo heemidu divrehen bimkom karet
Arel ha daamaran
Hazzaa deamar mar hazzaa shevut veeno doche et hashshabbat
Izmel detanya keshem sheen meviin oto derech reshut harabbim kach en meviin oto derech gaggot vederech chatzerot vederech karpefot
Onen ha daamaran
Metzora may hi detanya metzora shechal shemini shello beerev happesach veraa keri bo bayyom tovel veochel
Amru chachamim af al pi shettevul yom eno nichnas ze nichnas mutav yavo ase sheyyesh bo karet veyidche ase sheen bo karet

Veamar rabbi yochanan devar tora afilu ase en bo shenneemar vayyaamod yehoshafat bikhal yehuda virushalam bevet Adonai lifne hechatzer hachadasha may chatzer hachadasha shechiddeshu bo davar veamru tevul yom lo yikkanes bemachane leviyya
Bet happeras ditnan veshavin bet shammay uvet hillel
b: Shebbodkin leose fesach veen bodkin leochle teruma
May bodkin leose pesach amar rav yehuda amar shemuel menappeach bet happeras veholech rav yehuda bar abbaye mishshemeh derav yehuda amar bet happeras shennidash tahor
Hadaran alach haishsha

Matni mi shehaya tame o bederech rechoka velo asa et harishon yaase et hashsheni shagag o neenas velo asa et harishon yaase et hashsheni im ken lamma neemar tame o shehaya bederech rechoka sheellu peturin mehikkaret veellu chayyavin behikkaret

Gema itmar haya bederech rechoka ushchato vezarku alav rav nachman amar hurtza rav sheshet amar lo hurtza rav nachman amar hurtza mechas hu dechas rachamana alav vei aved tavo alav beracha verav sheshet amar lo hurtza midche dachyeh rachamana ketame
Amar rav nachman mena amena lah ditnan mi shehaya tame o bederech rechoka velo asa et harishon yaase et hashsheni mikkelal dei bae aved
Verav sheshet amar lach i hachi sefa dekatane shagag o neenas velo asa et harishon yaase et hashsheni middekatane velo asa mikkelal dei bae aved hare shagag vahare neenas
Ella mezid katane bahadayehu hacha name onen katane bahadayehu
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane ellu peturin mehikkaret veellu chayyavin behikkaret aheya ilema ashshogeg veneenas shogeg veneenas bene charet ninhu ella lav ammezid veonen
Verav nachman amar lach leolam ammezid lechodeh uvdin hu deibi leh lemitne chayyav vehay dekatane chayyavin ayede ditna resha peturin tena sefa chayyavin
Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah detanya rabbi akiva omer neemar tame veneemar bederech rechoka

a: Ma tame shessippek beyado laasot veeno ose af derech rechoka name shessippek beyado laasot veeno ose
Verav nachman amar lach rabbi akiva letameh dekasavar en shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz vaana sevira li keman deamar shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz
Tanu rabbanan ellu sheosin et hashsheni hazzavin vehazzavot hamtzorain vehamtzoraot veniddot uvoale niddot vehayyoldot hashshoggin vehaanusin vehammezidin vetame veshehaya bederech rechoka
Im ken lamma neemar tame lamma neemar dei bae lemibad barishon la shavkinan leh ella im ken lamma neemar bederech rechoka lefotro min hikkaret uchman deamar hurtza
Ishsha bashsheni mi michayeva veha tanya yachol lo yehu osin et hashsheni ella teme nefesh veshehaya bederech rechoka zavin umtzorain uvoale niddot minnayin talmud lomar ish ish
La kashya ha rabbi yose ha rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon

Tanu rabbanan chayyav karet al harishon vechayyav karet al hashsheni divre rabbi rabbi natan omer chayyav karet al harishon ufatur al hashsheni rabbi chananya ben akavya omer af al harishon eno chayyav karet ella im ken lo asa et hashsheni

Veazdu letamayehu detanya ger shennitgayyer ben shene fesachim vechen katan shehigdil ben shene fesachim chayyav laasot pesach sheni divre rabbi rabbi natan omer kol shezzakuk larishon zakuk lashsheni kol sheen zakuk larishon en zakuk lashsheni
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi savar sheni regel bifne atzmo hu
Rabbi natan savar sheni tashlumin derishon hu takkone larishon la metakken leh
Verabbi chananya ben akavya savar sheni takkanta derishon hu
Ushloshtan mikra echad darshu vehaish asher hu tahor uvderech lo haya rabbi savar vechadal laasot happesach venichreta dela avad barishon i name korban Adonai lo hikriv bemoado bashsheni
Umimmay deha cheto yissa karet hu
b: Kasavar megaddef hayenu mevarech hashshem uchtiv bimvarech et hashshem venasa cheto
Vegamar hay cheto dehacha mecheto dehatam ma lehallan karet af kan name karet
Verabbi natan savar vechadal laasot happesach venichreta dehay ki leshon deha hu vehachi kaamar rachamana deha korban Adonai lo hikriv bemoado barishon
Hay cheto yissa may aved leh kasavar megaddef lav hayenu mevarech et hashshem vegamar hay cheto dehatam mehay cheto dehacha ma hacha karet af hatam karet
Verabbi chananya ben akavya savar vechadal laasot happesach venichreta i korban Adonai lo hikriv bemoado bashsheni
Vehay cheto yissa may aved leh kedaamaran
Hilkach hezid baze uvaze divre hakkol chayyav shagag baze uvaze divre hakkol patur
Hezid barishon veshagag bashsheni lerabbi ulrabbi natan michayevi lerabbi chananya ben akavya patur
Shagag barishon vehezid bashsheni lerabbi chayyav lerabbi natan ulrabbi chananya ben akavya patur

Matni ezo hi derech rechoka min hammodiim velachutz uchmiddatah lechol ruach divre rabbi akiva rabbi eliezer omer meiskuppat haazara velachutz amar leh rabbi yose lefichach nakud al Adonai lomar la mippene sherachok vadday ella meiskuppat haazara velachutz

Gema amar ulla min hammodiim lirushalayim chamishsha asar milin haveya savar lah ki ha deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kamma mahalach adam bayyom asara parsaot mealot hashshachar vead hanetz hachamma chameshet milin mishshekiat hachamma vead tzet hakkochavim chameshet milin pashu leh telatin chamesar mitztzafra lefalga deoma vachamesar mippalga deoma leurta
Ulla letameh deamar ulla e ze hu derech rechoka kol sheen yachol likanes bishat shechita

Amar mar mealot hashshachar ad hanetz hachamma chameshet milin mena lan dichtiv uchmo hashshachar ala vayyaitzu hammalachim vego uchtiv hashshemesh yatza al haaretz velot ba tzoara veamar rabbi chanina ledidi chaze li hahu atra vehaveya chamishsha milin
Gufa amar ulla eze hu derech rechoka kol sheen yachol likanes bishat shechita verav yehuda amar kol sheen yachol likanes bishat achila

Amar leh rabba leulla ledidach kashya ulrav yehuda kashya ledidach kashya deamratte kol sheen yachol likanes bishat shechita veha teme sheretz deen yachol likanes bishat shechita vekaamratte shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz
Ulrav yehuda kashya deamar kol sheen yachol likanes bishat achila veha teme sheretz deyachol likanes bishat achila vekaamar en shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz
Amar leh la ledidi kashya vela lerav yehuda kashya ledidi la kashya derech rechoka lattahor veen derech rechoka lattame

a: Lerav yehuda la kashya teme sheretz rachamana dachyeh dichtiv ish ish ki yihye tame lanefesh mi la askinan shechal shevii shello lihot beerev happesach vaafilu hachi amar rachamana lidche
Tanu rabbanan haya omed chutz lammodiim veyachol likanes besusim uvifradim yachol yehe chayyav talmud lomar uvderech lo haya vehalla haya badderech
Haya omed lifnim min hammodiim veen yachol likanes mippene gemallim ukronot hamakkevot oto yachol lo yehe chayyav talmud lomar uvderech lo haya vahare lo haya badderech
Amar rava shita alfe parse have alma vesumcha dirkia alpa parse chada gemara vachada sevara

Savar lah ki ha deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kamma mahalach adam benoni bayyom eser parsaot mealot hashshachar vead hanetz hachamma chamishsha milin mishshekiat hachamma ad tzet hakkochavim chamishsha milin nimtza ovo shel rakia echad mishshishsha bayyom

Metivi rabbi yehuda omer ovo shel rakia echad measara bayyom teda kamma mahalach adam benoni bayyom eser parsaot umealot hashshachar ad hanetz hachamma arbaat milin mishshekiat hachamma vead tzet hakkochavim arbaat milin nimtzet ovo shel rakia echad measara bayyom teuvta derava teuvta deulla teuvta
Lema tehve teuvta derabbi yochanan amar lach ana bimama hu daamari verabbanan hu deka tau deka chashvin dekadma vachashocha
Lema tehve teuvta derabbi chanina la vayyaitzu shane

Ta shema mitzrayim haya arba meot parsa al arba meot parsa umitzrayim echad mishshishshim bechush vechush echad mishshishshim baolam veolam echad mishshishshim baggan vegan echad mishshishshim beeden veeden echad mishshishshim begehinnam nimtza kol haolam kullo kechisuy kedera legehinnam teuvta

Ta shema detana deve eliyyahu rabbi natan omer kol hayyishshuv kullo tachat kochav echad yoshev teda shehare adam noten eno bechochav echad holech lammizrach omed kenegdo learba ruchot haolam omed kenegdo mikkelal dechol hayyishshuv kullo tachat kochav echad yoshev teuvta

Ta shema agala batztzafon veakrav baddarom vechol hayyishshuv kullo eno yoshev ella ben agala leakrav vechol hayyishshuv kullo eno hove ella shaa achat bayyom sheen chamma nichneset layyishshuv ella shaa achat bayyom
Teda shebbechamesh chamma bammizrach uvsheva chamma bammaarav chatzi shesh vachatzi sheva chamma omedet berosh kol adam teuvta
Ta shema deamar rabban yochanan ben zakkay ma teshuva heshivattu bat kol leoto rasha beshaa sheamar eele al bamote av eddamme leelon yatzta bat kol veamra lo rasha ben rasha
b: Ben beno shel nimrod harasha shehimrid et kal haolam kullo alay bemalchuto kamma shenotav shel adam shivim shana veim bigvurot shemonim shana shenneemar yeme shenotenu vahem shivim shana veim bigvurot shemonim shana

Min haaretz ad larakia mahalach chamesh meot shana veovo shel rakia mahalach chamesh meot shana uven kol rakia lerakia mahalach chamesh meot shana vechen ben kol rakia verakia ach el sheol turad el yarkete vor teuvta

Tanu rabbanan chachme yisrael omrim galgal kavua umazzalot chozrin vechachme ummot haolam omrim galgal chozer umazzalot kevuin amar rabbi teshuva ledivrehem meolam lo matzinu agala baddarom veakrav batztzafon
Matkef lah rav acha bar yaakov vedilma kevutzina derichya i name ketzinora dedashsha

Chachme yisrael omrim bayyom chamma mehallechet lematta min harakia uvallayela lemala min harakia vechachme ummot haolam omrim bayyom chamma mehallechet lematta min harakia uvallayela lematta min hakkarka amar rabbi venirin divrehen middevarenu shebbayyom maayanot tzonnin uvallayela rotchin

Tanya rabbi natan omer bimot hachamma chamma mehallechet begovah shel rakia lefichach kal haolam kullo roteach umaayanot tzonnin bimot haggeshamim chamma mehallechet beshipule rakia lefichach kal haolam kullo tzonen umaayanot rotchin

Tanu rabbanan bearbaa shevilin chamma mehallechet nisan iyyar vesivan mehallechet beharim kede lefashsher et hashshelagin tammuz av veelul mehallechet bayyishshuv kede levashshel et happerot tishre merachshevan vechislev mehallechet bayyammim kede leyabbesh et hanneharot tevet shevat vaadar mehallechet bammidbar shello leyabbesh et hazzeraim
Verabbi eliezer omer meiskuppat ku veaf al gav dematze ayel vela amrinan leh kum eyel vehatanya yehudi arel shello mal anush karet divre rabbi eliezer
Amar abbaye derech rechoka lattahor veen derech rechoka lattame
Rava amar tannae hi detanya rabbi eliezer omer neemar richuk makom bappesach veneemar richuk makom bammaaser ma lehallan chutz laachilato af kan chutz laachilato
Rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer chutz laasiyyato
Keman azla ha deamar rabbi yitzchak bar rav yosef bitmeim hallech achar rov haomdin baazara keman kerabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi eliezer

Amar lo rabbi yose lefichach vechu tanya rabbi yose haggelili omer derech shomea ani mahalach shenayim o shelosha yamim keshehu omer uvderech lo haya maggid shemmeiskuppat haazara velachutz karuy derech

a: Matni ma ben pesach harishon lashsheni harishon asur beval yerae uval yimmatze vehashsheni chametz umatztza immo babbayit harishon taun hallel baachilato vehashsheni eno taun hallel baachilato ze vaze taun hallel baasiyyatan veneechalin tzali al matztza umrorim vedochin et hashshabbat
Gema tanu rabbanan kechol chukkat happesach yaasu oto bemitzva shebbegufo hakkatuv medabber

Mitzva sheal gufo minnayin talmud lomar al matztzot umrorim yochluhu yachol afilu mitzot shello al gufo talmud lomar veetzem lo yishberu vo ma shevirat haetzem meuchad mitzva shebbegufo af kol mitzva shebbegufo
Isi ben yehuda omer yaasu oto bemitzot shebbegufo hakkatuv medabber
Amar mar yachol af mitzva shello al gufo ha amratte bemitzva shebbegufo hakkatuv medabber
Hachi kaamar hashta deamratte al matztzot umrorim yochluhu alma yaasu oto lav daveka hu ema have leh kifrat uchlal venaasa kelal mosif al happerat vaafilu kol mile name ka mashma lan
Isi ben yehuda hay etzem may aved leh mibe leh leechad etzem sheyyesh bo moach veechad etzem sheen bo moach
Verabbanan hay yaasu oto may avdi leh mibe leh sheen shochatin et happesach al hayyachid dechamma deefshar leahdore mahderinan
Tanu rabbanan kechol chukkat happesach yaasu oto yachol keshem sheharishon asur beval yerae uval yimmatze kach sheni asur beval yerae uval yimmatze talmud lomar al matztzot umrorim yochluhu
Veen li ella mitzvat ase mitzvat lo taase minnayin talmud lomar lo yashiru mimmennu ad boker

Veen li ella mitzvat lo taase shennitak laase mitzvat lo taase gamur minnayin talmud lomar veetzem lo yishberu vo ma happerat meforash mitzvat ase velo taase shennitak laase velo taase gamur af kol mitzvat ase velo taase shennitak laase velo taase gamur
Bichlaleh dematztzot umrorim may ka merabbe tzeli esh bifrateh may memaet leh hashbatat seor efoch ana mitzva degufeh adif
Bichlaleh delo yashiru mimmennu ad boker may ka merabbe leh lo totzi mimmennu dedame leh dehay mipsal benotar vehay mipsal beotze
Bifrateh may ka memaet leh lo yerae velo yimmatze dedame leh dehay eno loke dehave lav shennitak laase vehay eno loka dehave leh lav shennitak laase efoch ana mitzva degufeh adif
Bichlaleh deetzem lo yishberu vo
b: May ka merabbe al tochlu mimmennu na bifrateh may ka memaati lo tishchat al chametz dam zivchi efoch ana mitzva degufeh adif

Harishon taun hallel baachilato vechu mena hane mile amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak amar kera hashshir yihye lachem kelel hitkaddesh chag layela hamkuddash lechag taun hallel layela sheen mekuddash lechag en taun hallel
Ze vaze teunin hallel baasiyyatan ku may tama ibaet ema layela ka memaet yom la ka memaet veibaet ema efshar yisrael shochatin et pischehen venotlin et lulvehen veen omrim hallel
Veneechalin tzali vechu shabbat in tuma la matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda detanya doche et hashshabbat veen doche et hattuma rabbi yehuda omer af doche et hattuma
May tama detanna kamma mippene tuma dechitiv yachzor veyease betuma verabbi yehuda hattora chazra alav laasoto betohora lo zacha yease betuma
Tanu rabbanan pesach rishon doche et hashshabbat pesach sheni doche et hashshabbat pesach rishon doche et hattuma pesach sheni doche et hattuma pesach rishon taun lina pesach sheni taun lina
Doche et hattuma keman kerabbi yehuda

Ulrabbi yehuda taun lina veha tanya rabbi yehuda omer minnayin lefesach sheni sheen taun lina shenneemar ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha uchtiv sheshet yamim tochal matztzot hanneechal leshishsha taun lina sheen neechal leshishsha en taun lina
Tere tannae vealliba derabbi yehuda
Matni happesach shebba betuma lo yochlu mimmennu zavin vezavot niddot veoldot veim achlu peturin mikkaret
Verabbi eliezer poter af al biat mikdash

Gema tanu rabbanan zavin vezavot niddot veoldot sheachlu befesach shebba betuma yachol yehu chayyavin talmud lomar kol tahor yochal basar vehannefesh asher tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim asher la vetumato alav venichreta
Neechal lithorim chayyavim alav mishshum tame vesheeno neechal lithorin en temein chayyavin alav mishshum tame

Rabbi eliezer omer yachol dachaku zavin venichnesu laazara befesach habba betuma yachol yehu chayyavin talmud lomar vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanafesh bizman shettemee metim mishtallechin zavin umtzorain mishtallechin en temee metim mishtallechin en zavin umtzorain mishtallechin
Bae rav yosef dachaku temee metim venichnesu lahechal befesach habba betuma mahu middeishteray tumat azara ishteray name tumat hechal o dilma may deishteray ishteray may dela ishteray la ishteray
Amar rava amar kera vishallechu min hammachane afilu miktzat machane
Ika deamri amar rava amar kera vishallechu min hammachane el michutz lammachane teshallechum kol hecha dekarenan beh el michutz lammachane teshallechum karenan beh vishallechu min hammachane
Bae rav yosef dachaku temee metim veachlu emure pesach habba betuma

a: Mahu middeishteray tumat basar ishteray name tumat emurin o dilma may deishteray ishteray may dela ishteray la ishteray
Amar rava mikkede tumat emurin mehecha itrabbay mittumat basar dichtiv asher la lerabbot et haemurin
Kol hecha deiteh letumat basar iteh letumat emurin kol hecha deleteh letumat basar leteh letumat emurin
Bae rabbi zera emure pesach mitzrayim hecha akterinhu amar leh abbaye uman lema lan dela sheviske avud
Veod ha tena rav yosef shelosha mizbechot hau sham al hammashkof veal shette hammezuzot vetu mide acharina la hava

Matni ma ben pesach mitzrayim lefesach dorot pesach mitzrayim mikkacho mibbeasor vetaun hazzaa baaguddat ezov veal hammashkof veal shette hammezuzot veneechal bechippazon ballayela echad ufesach dorot noheg kol shiva
Gema mena lan dichtiv dabberu el kol adat yisrael lemor beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu ze mikkacho mibbeasor veen pesach dorot mikkacho mibbeasor
Ella meatta vehaya lachem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar yom lachodesh hazze hachi name ze taun bikur arbaa yamim kodem shechita veen acher taun bikur

Vehatanya ben bag bag omer minnayin letamid shettaun bikur arbaa yamim kodem shechita shenneemar tishmeru lehakriv li bemoado ulhallan hu omer vehaya lachem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar ma lehallan taun bikur arbaa yamim kodem shechita af kan taun bikur arbaa yamim kodem shechita
Shane hatam dichtiv tishmeru
Ufesach dorot name hachtiv veavadta et haavoda hazzot bachodesh hazze sheyehu kol avodot chodesh ze kaze
Ella hahu hazze lemaote pesach sheni dichoteh
Ella meatta dichtiv veachlu et habbasar ballayela hazze hachi name deze neechal ballayela veen acher neechal ballayela amar kera veavadta et haavoda
Ella hazze lema li lechidrabbi elazar ben azarya verabbi akiva
Ella meatta dichtiv vechol arel lo yochal bo hachi name devo eno ochel aval ochel befesach dorot amar kera veavadta
Ella bo lema li devo eno ochel aval hu ochel bematztza umaror
Ella meatta vechol ben nechar lo yochal bo hachi name devo eno ochel aval ochel hu pesach ledorot amar kera veavadta
Ella bo lema li bo meshummadut poselet veen meshummadut poselet bitruma

Veitzterich lemichtav arel veitzterich lemichtav ben nechar dei ketav rachamana arel mishshum dimis aval ben nechar la meis ema la tzericha vei ashmeinan ben nechar mishshum deen libbo lashshamayim aval arel delibbo lashshamayim ema la tzericha
Ella meatta toshav vesachir lo yochal bo hachi name devo hu eno ochel aval ochel hu befesach dorot amar kera veavadta ella bo lema li bo meshummadut poselet veen meshummadut poselet bitruma

Ella meatta umalta oto az yochal bo hachi name devo eno ochel aval ochel befesach dorot amar kera veavadta ella bo lema li bo milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet veen milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet bitruma
Ella meatta dichtiv veetzem lo yishberu bo hachi name devo eno shover aval shover befesach dorot amar kera veavadta ella bo lema li bo bechasher velo befasul
Ella meatta dichtiv al tochlu mimmennu na mimmennu i atta ochel aval atta ochel na befesach dorot amar kera veavadta ella mimmennu lema li lechidrabba amar rabbi yitzchak
Veneechal bechippazon vechu mena lan deamar kera vaachaltem oto bechippazon oto neechal bechippazon veen acher neechal bechippazon
Ufesach dorot noheg kol shiva vechu ammay kae i lema appesach pesach kol shiva mi ika
b: Ella achametz mikkelal defesach mitzrayim layela echad vetu la vehatanya rabbi yose haggelili omer minnayin lefesach mitzrayim sheen chimutzo noheg ella yom echad talmud lomar lo yeachel chametz usmich leh hayyom attem yotzim
Ella hachi kaamar layela echad vehu haddin lefesach dorot vechimutzo kol hayyom ufesach dorot noheg kol shiva
Matni amar rabbi yehoshua shamati shettemurat pesach kereva utmurat pesach enah kereva veen li lefaresh
Amar rabbi akiva ani afaresh happesach shennimtza kodem shechitat happesach yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyavi bedamav shelamim vechen temurato
Achar shechitat happesach karev shelamim vechen temurato
Gema velema pesach karev ufesach eno karev ha ka mashma lan deika temurat happesach dela karva
Itmar rabba amar kodem shechita ulachar shechita shaninu rabbi zera amar kodem chatzot ulachar chatzot shaninu
Ulrabbi zera ha katane kodem shechitat happesach ema kodem zeman shechitat happesach
Ketannae happesach shennimtza kodem shechita yire leachar shechita yikrav rabbi eliezer omer kodem chatzot yire leachar chatzot yikrav

Achar shechitat happesach yavi shelamim vechu amar rava lo shanu ella shennimtza achar shechita vehemir bo achar shechita aval nimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo achar shechita temurato mikkoach kedushsha dechuya ka ata vela karva
Etiveh abbaye im kesev ma talmud lomar im kesev lerabbot temurat happesach achar happesach shekkereva shelamim
Hechi dame ilema shennimtza achar shechita vehemir bo achar shechita peshita lema li kera ella lav shennimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo achar shechita
La leolam shennimtza achar shechita vehemir bo achar shechita ukra asmachta bealma
Ella kera lemay ata kidtanya kesev lerabbot et happesach lealya
Keshehu omer im kesev lerabbot pesach sheavra shenato ushlamim habbain mechamat pesach lechol mitzvat shelamim shettaun semicha unsachim utnufat chaze vashok
Uchshehu omer veim ez hifsik hainyan limed al haez sheen teuna alya
Ika dematne lah aresha happesach shennimtza kodem shechitat happesach yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyavi bedamav shelamim vechen temurato

Amar rava lo shanu ella shennimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo kodem shechita aval nimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo achar shechita temurato kereva shelamim may tama ki kava shechita mide dachaze leh mide dela chaze leh la kava
Etiveh abbaye im kesev ma talmud lomar lerabbot temurat happesach achar happesach shekkereva shelamim

a: Yachol af lifne happesach ken talmud lomar hu hu karev veen temurat happesach kereva
Hechi dame ilema shennimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo kodem shechita peshita lema li kera ella lav shennimtza kodem shechita vehemir bo achar shechita teuvta derava teuvta

Amar shemuel kol shebbachattat meta bappesach karev shelamim vechol shebbachattat roe bappesach name roe verabbi yochanan amar en happesach karev shelamim ella shennimtza achar shechita aval kodem shechita lo
Matkef lah rav yosef uchlala hu vahare chattat sheavra shenatah deliriyya azla deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish chattat sheavra shenatah roin otah keilu hi omedet bevet hakkevarot veroe

Veilu befesach ki hay gavena karev shelamim detanya kesev lerabbot et happesach lealya keshehu omer im kesev lerabbot et happesach sheavra shenato ushlamim habbain mechamat pesach lechol mitzvat shelamim shetteunim semicha unsachim utnufat chaze vashok keshehu omer im ez hifsik hainyan limed al haez sheen taun alya
Amar leh ki kaamar shemuel baavudin bidchuyin la amar

Veavud mi mashkachatte lah vahare avuda bishat hafrasha lerabbanan deliriyya azla ditnan hifrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzet harishona vahare shettehen omdot achat mehen tikrav ushniyya tamut divre rabbi vachachamim omrim en chattat meta ella shennimtzet leachar shennitkapperu bealim ha kodem shennitkapperu bealim roa
Veilu befesach hecha deavad venimtza achar chatzot kodem shechita karev shelamim shemuel kerabbi sevira leh deamar avuda lemita azla
Veha kol avuda lerabbi meta veilu befesach hecha deavad kodem chatzot venimtza kodem chatzot roe kodem chatzot lav avud hu kidrava deamar rava avedat layela lav shemah aveda
Ella roa lerabbi hechi mashkachatte lah
b: Kidrabbi oshaya deamar rabbi oshaya hifrish shette chattaot leachraut mitkapper beachat mehen ushniyya tire
Veha ilu befesach ki hay gavena karev shelamim ella shemuel kerabbi shimon sevira leh deamar chamesh chattaot metot
Veha roa lerabbi shimon let leh kelal shemuel name chada kaamar kol shebbachattat meta befesach karev shelamim
Umay ka mashma lan leappoke midderabbi yochanan deamar en happesach karev shelamim ella shennimtza achar shechita aval kodem shechita la alma shechita kava ka mashma lan chatzot kava
Lishana acharina veilu befesach hecha deavad venimtza achar chatzot kodem shechita yikrav shelamim shemuel kerabba sevira leh deamar shechita kava
Veha middekaamar rabbi yochanan alah en happesach karev shelamim ella shennimtza achar shechita aval kodem shechita la alma shechita kava mikkelal dishmuel savar chatzot kava

Ella shemuel kerabbi sevira leh deamar avuda lemita azla veha kol avudin lerabbi metin veilu befesach hecha deavad kodem chatzot venimtza kodem chatzot roe kasavar kodem chatzot lav avud hu vekasavar chatzot kava
Matni hammafrish nekeva lefischo o zachar ben shette shanim yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava lishlamim

a: Hammafrish pischo umet lo yeviennu beno acharav leshem pesach ella leshem shelamim
Gema amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua shema minah telat shema minah baale chayyim nidchin
Ushma minah dachuy meikara have dachuy ushma minah yesh dichuy bedamim

Hammafrish pischo vechu tanu rabbanan hammafrish et pischo umet im beno memunne immo yeviennu leshum pesach en beno memunne immo yeviennu leshum shelamim leshishsha asar leshishsha asar in lachamishsha asar la ka savar nedarim undavot en kerevin beom tov
Demit haav emat ilema demit kodem chatzot beno memunne immo yeviennu leshum pesach ha chala aninut ilaveh meikara
Ella demit achar chatzot en beno memunne immo yeviennu leshum shelamim ha kevateh chatzot
Amar rava leolam demit kodem chatzot umay yeviennu leshum pesach leshum pesach sheni
Abbaye amar litzdadin katane met achar chatzot beno memunne immo yeviennu leshum pesach met kodem chatzot en beno memunne immo yeviennu leshum shelamim
Rav sherevya amar leolam demit leachar chatzot uchgon shehaya aviv goses bachatzot
Rav ashe amar leolam demit leachar chatzot verabbi shimon hi deamar en baale chayyim nidchin
Ravina amar kegon shehifrisho achar chatzot umetu bealim achar chatzot veka savar chatzot kava
Matni happesach shennitarev bizvachim kullan yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyavi bidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze uvidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze veyafsid hammotar mibbeto
Nitarev bivchorot rabbi shimon omer im chavurat kohanim yochelu
b: Gema veha ka mayete kadashim levet happesul
Rabbi shimon letameh deamar meviin kadashim levet happesul ditnan asham shennitarev bishlamim rabbi shimon omer yishshachatu batztzafon veyeachlu kachomer shebbahen
Amru lo en meviin kadashim levet happesul
Verabbanan hechi avdinan amar rava namtin lo ad sheyyummu veyavi behema shemena velema kol hecha deiteh lefesach techul aleh dehay veachel lehu betorat bechor baal mum

Matni chavura sheavad pischah veamru leechad tze uvakkesh ushchot alenu vehalach umatza veshachat vehem lakchu veshachatu im shello nishchat rishon hu ochel mishshello vehem ochlin immo mishshello veim shellahen nishchat rishon hem ochlin mishshellahen vehu ochel mishshello
Veim eno yadua eze mehen nishchat rishon o sheshshachatu shenehem keechad hu ochel mishshello vehem enam ochlin immo veshellahen yetze levet hasserefa ufturin millaasot pesach sheni

Amar lahen im echarti tzeu veshachatu alay halach umatza veshachat vehen lakchu veshachatu im shellahen nishchat rishon hen ochlin mishshellahen vehu ochel immahen veim shello nishchat rishon hu ochel mishshello vehen ochlin mishshellahem
Veim eno yadua eze mehen nishchat rishon o sheshshachatu shenehem keechad hen ochlin mishshellahen vehu eno ochel immahen veshello yetze levet hasserefa ufatur millaasot pesach sheni
Amar lahen veamru lo ochlin kullan min harishon veim en yadua eze mehen nishchat rishon shenehen yotzin levet hasserefa
Lo amar lahen velo amru lo en acharain ze laze

Shette chavurot shennitarvu pischehen ellu moshchin lahen echad veellu moshchin lahen echad echad meellu ba lo etzel ellu veechad meellu ba lo etzel ellu vechach hem omrim im shellanu hu happesach hazze yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shellanu veim shellecha hu happesach hazze yadenu meshuchot mishshellanu venimnenu al shellach
Vechen chamesh chavurot shel chamishsha chamishsha veshel asara asara moshchin lahen echad mikkol chavura vachavura vechen hem omrim
Shenayim shennitarvu pischehen ze moshech lo echad veze moshech lo echad ze memanne immo echad min hashshuk veze memanne immo echad min hashshuk

Ze ba etzel ze veze ba etzel ze vechach hem omrim im shelli hu pesach ze yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shelli veim shellecha hu pesach ze yaday meshuchot mishshelli venimneti al shellach
Gema tanu rabbanan amar lahen veamru lo ochel min harishon lo amar lahen velo amru lo enan acharain ze laze

a: Mikkan amru chachamim yafa shetika lachachamim kal vachomer lattippeshim shenneemar evil macharish chacham yechashev

Shenayim shennitarvu pischehem vechu lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda detanya veim yimat habbayit mihot misse melammed shemmitmaatin veholchin uvilvad sheyehe echad mibbene chavura kayyam divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer uvilvad shello yannichu et happesach kemot shehu
Amar rabbi yochanan afilu tema rabbi yehuda kevan deamar rabbi yehuda en shochatin et happesach al hayyachid meikara leamnoye acharina bahadeh kae uchechad mibbene chavura dame

Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane vechen chamesh chavurot shel chamishsha chamishsha shel chamishsha in aval shel chamishsha vearbaa la lav mishshum dela payesh chad mibbene chavura gabbeh shema minah
Hadran alach mi shehaya tame uslika lah pesach sheni
b: Matni erev pesachim samuch lammincha lo yochal adam ad shettechshach afilu ani shebbeyisrael lo yochal ad sheyyasev velo yifchatu lo mearba kosot shel yayin vaafilu min hattamchuy

Gema may irya arve fesachim afilu arve shabbatot veyamim tovim name detanya lo yochal adam bearve shabbatot veyamim tovim min hammincha ulmala kede sheyyikkanes lashshabbat keshehu taava divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer ochel veholech ad shettechshach
Amar rav huna la tzericha ella lerabbi yose deamar ochel veholech ad shettechshach hane mile bearve shabbatot veyamim tovim aval beerev happesach mishshum chiyyuva dematztza mode
Rav pappa amar afilu tema rabbi yehuda hatam bearve shabbatot veyamim tovim min hammincha ulmala hu daasir samuch lammincha shere aval beerev happesach afilu samuch lammincha name asur

Uvaerev shabbat samuch lammincha shere vehatanya lo yochal adam beerev shabbat veyamim tovim mittesha shaot ulmala kede sheyyikkanes lashshabbat keshehu taava divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer ochel veholech ad shettechshach
Amar mar zutra man lema lan dimtaratzta hi

a: Dilma meshabbashta hi
Amar leh marimar veitema rav yemar ana iklai lefirkeh derav pinchas bereh derav amme vekam tanna vetane kammeh vekablah mineh i hachi kashya ella mechavarta kidrav huna
Ulrav huna mi nicha vehaamar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan veitema amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina halacha kerabbi yehuda beerev happesach vahalacha kerabbi yose beerev shabbat
Halacha kerabbi yehuda beerev happesach mikkelal diflig rabbi yose betarvayehu
La halacha mikkelal difligi behafsaka
Detanya mafsikin leshabbatot divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer en mafsikin

Umaase berabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yehuda verabbi yose shehau mesubbin beakko vekiddesh alehem hayyom amar leh rabban shimon ben gamliel lerabbi yose berabbi retzoncha nafsik venechush ledivre yehuda chaverenu
Amar lo bechol yom veom atta mechabbev devaray lifne rabbi yehuda veachshav atta mechabbev divre rabbi yehuda befanay hagam lichbosh et hammalka immi babbayit
Amar leh im ken lo nafsik shemma yiru hattalmidim veyikbeu halacha ledorot amru lo zazu mishsham ad shekkavu halacha kerabbi yose
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel en halacha lo kerabbi yehuda velo kerabbi yose ella pores mappa umkaddesh ini veha amar rav tachlifa bar avdimi amar shemuel keshem shemmafsikin lekidush
b: Kach mafsikin lahavdala may mafsikin lav laakirat shulchan la lemappa
Rabba bar rav huna ikla leve resh galuta ayeto takka kammeh peras mappa vekadesh tanya name hachi veshavin sheen meviin et hashshulchan ella im ken kidesh veim hevi pores mappa umkaddesh
Tane chada shavin sheen matchilin vetanya idach shavin shemmatchilin bishlama ha detanya shavin sheen matchilin mashkachatte lah beerev happesach
Ella ha detanya shavin shemmatchilin emat i nema beerev shabbat ha miflag peligi la kashya kan kodem tisha kan leachar tisha
Otam bene adam shekkidshu bevet hakkeneset amar rav yede yayin lo yatzu yede kidush yatzu ushmuel amar

a: Af yede kidush lo yatzu ella lerav lema leh lekaddoshe beveteh kede lehotzi banav uvne veto
Ushmuel lema li lekaddoshe beve chenishta leappoke orchim yede chovatan deachlu veshatu veganu beve chenishta
Veazda shemuel letameh deamar shemuel en kidush ella bimkom seuda sevur minah hane mile mibbayit levayit aval mimmakom lemakom bechad beta la
Amar lehu rav anan bar tachlifa zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh dishmuel venachet meigara leara vahadar mekaddesh

Veaf rav huna savar en kidush ella bimkom seuda derav huna kaddesh veitakara leh sheraga veayyali leh lemaneh leve genaneh derabba bereh dahava sheraga vekaddesh utem mide alma kasavar en kidush ella bimkom seuda

Veaf rabba savar en kidush ella bimkom seuda daamar abbaye ki havena be mar ki hava mekaddesh amar lan teimu mide dilma addeazlitu leushpiza mitakra lechu sheraga vela mekaddesh lechu bevet achila uvkidusha dehacha la nafkitu deen kidush ella bimkom seuda
Ini vehaamar abbaye kol mile demar hava aved kerav levar mehane telat deaved kishmuel mattirin mibbeged leveged umadlikin minner lener vahalacha kerabbi shimon bigrira
Detanya rabbi shimon omer gorer adam mitta kisse vesafsal bashshabbat uvilvad shello yitkaven laasot charitz
Kechumre derav hava aved kekulle derav la hava avid
Verabbi yochanan amar af yede yayin name yatzu veazda rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi chanin bar abbaye amar rabbi pedat amar rabbi yochanan echad shinuy yayin
b: Veechad shinuy makom en tzarich levarech metivi shinuy makom tzarich levarech shinuy yayin en tzarich levarech teuvta derabbi yochanan teuvta
Yatev rav idi bar avin kammeh derav chisda veyatev rav chisda vekaamar mishshemeh derav huna ha deamratte shinuy makom tzarich levarech lo shanu ella mibbayit levayit aval mimmakom lemakom la
Amar leh rav idi bar avin hachi tenena leh bematnita deve rav henak veamri leh bematnita deve bar henak keotach veella rav huna matnita ka mashma lan rav huna matnita la shemia leh
Vetu yatev rav chisda vekaamar mishshemeh denafsheh ha deamratte shinuy makom tzarich levarech la amaran ella bidvarim sheen teunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman
Aval devarim hatteunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman en tzarich levarech may tama lekiva kamma hadar verav sheshet amar echad ze veechad ze tzarich levarech
Metivi bene chavura shehau mesubbin lishtot veakru raglehen latzet likrat chatan o likrat kalla keshehen yotzin en teunin beracha lemafrea keshehen chozrin en teunin beracha lechattechilla
Bamme devarim amurim shehinnichu sham zaken o chole aval lo hinnichu sham lo zaken velo chole keshehen yotzin teunin beracha lemafrea keshehen chozrin teunin beracha lechattechilla

Middekatane akru raglehen mikkelal devidvarim hatteunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman askinan vetama dehinnichu sham zaken o chole hu dichshehen yotzin en teunin beracha lemafrea uchshehen chozrin en teunin beracha lechattechilla
Aval lo hinnichu sham zaken o chole keshehen yotzin teunin beracha lemafrea uchshehen chozrin teunin beracha lechattechilla kashya lerav chisda
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak

a: Man tanna akirot

Rabbi yehuda detanya chaverim shehau mesubbin veakru raglehem lelech levet hakkeneset o levet hammidrash keshehen yotzin en teunin beracha lemafrea uchshehen chozrin en teunin beracha lechattechilla amar rabbi yehuda bamme devarim amurim bizman shehinnichu sham miktzat chaverim aval lo hinnichu sham miktzat chaverim keshehen yotzin teunin beracha lemafrea uchshehen chozrin teunin beracha lechattechilla

Ella tama devidvarim hatteunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman dichshehen yotzin en teunin beracha lemafrea uchshehen chozrin en teunin beracha lechattechilla aval devarim sheen teunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman afilu lerabbanan keshehen yotzin teunin beracha lemafrea uchshehen chozrin teunin beracha lechattechila
Lema tehve teuvta derabbi yochanan velav mi otvineh chada zimna nema meha name tehve teuvta
Amar lach rabbi yochanan hu haddin daafilu devarim sheen teunin beracha leacharehem bimkoman name en tzerichin levarech veha dekatane akru raglehen lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehuda

Daafilu devarim shetteunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman tama dehinnichu miktzat chaverim aval lo hinnichu miktzat chaverim keshehen yotzin teunin beracha lemafrea uchshehen chozrin teunin beracha lechattechilla
Tanya keoteh derav chisda chaverim shehau mesubbin lishtot yayin veakru raglehen vechazru en tzerichin levarech

Tanu rabbanan bene chavura shehau mesubbin vekiddesh alehen hayyom meviin lo kos shel yayin veomer alav kedushshat hayyom vesheni omer alav birkat hammazon divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer ochel veholech ad shettechshach
b: Gamru kos rishon mevarech alav birkat hammazon vehashsheni omer alav kedushshat hayyom ammay venemrinhu letarvayehu achada kasa
Amar rav huna amar rav sheshet en omrim shette kedushshot al kos echad may tama amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lefi sheen osin mitzot chavilot chavilot

Vela veha tanya hannichnas leveto bemotzae shabbat mevarech al hayyayin veal hammaor veal habbesamim veachar kach omer havdala al hakkos veim en lo ella kos echad mannicho leachar hammazon umshalshelan kullan leacharav en lo shane
Veha yom tov shechal lihot achar hashshabbat deit leh veamar rav yakne
Amri middela amar zeman mikkelal devishvii shel pesach askinan dechol may dahava leh achel leh velet leh
Veha yom tov rishon deit leh veamar abbaye yakzena verava amar yaknehaz
Ella havdala vekidush chada milta hi birkat hammazon vekidush tere mile ninhu
Gufa yom tov shechal lihot achar hashshabbat rav amar yakne ushmuel amar yinhak

a: Verabba amar yahnek velevi amar keniyya verabbanan amri kina mar bereh deravna amar nekiyya marta amar mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua nihak
Shelach leh avuh dishmuel lerabbi yelammedenu rabbenu seder havdalot heach shelach leh kach amar rabbi yishmael bar rabbi yose sheamar mishshum aviv sheamar mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben chananya nehik
Amar rabbi chanina mashal derabbi yehoshua ben chananya lemelech sheyyotze veipparchos nichnas melaviyn et hammelech veachar kach yotzim likrat ipparchos
May have alah abbaye amar yakzena verava amar yaknehaz vehilcheta kerava
Rav huna bar yehuda ikla leve rava ayeto lekammayehu maor uvsamim barech rava abbesamim beresha vahadar ammaor amar leh veha ben bet shammay uven bet hilel maor beresha vahadar abbesamim
Umay hi ditnan bet shammay omrim ner umazon besamim vehavdala uvet hilel omrim ner uvsamim umazon vehavdala
Ane rava batreh veamar zo divre rabbi meir aval rabbi yehuda omer lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hilel al hammazon shehu battechilla veal havdala shehi bassof
Al ma nechleku al hammaor veal habbesamim bet shammay omrim maor veachar kach besamim uvet hilel omrim besamim veachar kach maor veamar rabbi yochanan nahagu haam kevet hilel vealliba derabbi yehuda

Rav yaakov bar abba ikla leve rava chazyeh devarech bore peri haggefen akkasa kamma vahadar barech akkasa devirketa veishti amar leh lema lach kulle hay ha barech lan mar chada zimna amar leh ki havenan be resh galuta hachi avdinan

Amar leh tinach be resh galuta dehachi aved desafek mayete lan safek la mayete lan hacha ha mannach kasa kamman vedatan ilaveh amar leh ana avadi ketalmide derav derav berona verav chananel talmide derav hao yatvi bisodta
b: Kae alayehu rav yeva sava amaru leh hav lan venivarech lesof amaru leh hav lan venishte amar lehu hachi amar rav kevan deamritu hav lan venivarech itasra lechu lemishte may tama deaschitu datayechu

Ammemar umar zutra verav ashe hao yatvi bisuda vekae alayehu rav acha bereh derava ammemar barech al kol kasa vechasa umar zutra barech akkasa kamma veakkasa batra rav ashe barech akkasa kamma vetu la barech
Amar lehu rav acha bar rava anan keman naaved ammemar amar nimlach ana mar zutra amar ana daavadi ketalmide derav
Verav ashe amar let hilcheta ketalmide derav deha yom tov shechal lihot achar hashshabbat veamar rav yakne
Vela hi hatam akar dateh mimmishteya hacha la akar dateh mimmishteya

Ki meta leavdole kam shammaeh veadlek avuka mishsheraga amar leh lema lach kulle hay ha mancha sheraga amar leh shammaa middateh denafsheh ka aved amar leh i la shemia leh mineh demar la hava aved amar leh la savar leh mar avuka lehavdala mitzva min hammuvchar

Patach veamar hammavdil ben kodesh lechol ben or lechoshech ben yisrael laammim ben yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase amar leh lema lach kulle hay vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav hammavdil ben kodesh lechol zo hi havdalato shel rabbi yehuda hannasi
Amar leh ana keha sevira li deamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya happochet lo yifchot mishshalosh vehammosif lo yosif al sheva amar leh

a: Veha mar la telata amar vela sheva amar amar leh ivra ben yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase meen chatima hi veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel hammavdil tzarich sheyyomar meen chatima samuch lachatimato ufumbeditae amri meen petichatan samuch lachatimatan
May benayehu ika benayehu yom tov shechal lihot achar hashshabbat dechatminan ben kodesh lekodesh

Man deamar meen petichatan samuch lachatimatan la bae lememar ben kedushshat shabbat likdushshat yom tov hivdalta uman deamar meen chatimatan samuch lachatimatan bae lememar ben kedushshat shabbat likdushshat yom tov hivdalta
Gufa amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya happochet lo yifchot mishshalosh vehammosif lo yosif al sheva

Metivi omer havdalot bemotzae shabbatot uvmotzae yamim tovim uvmotzae yom hakkippurim uvmotzae shabbat leom tov uvmotzae yom tov lechullo shel moed aval lo bemotzae yom tov leshabbat haragil omer harbe vesheeno ragil omer achat

Tannae hi deamar rabbi yochanan benan shel kedoshim omer achat venahagu haam lomar shalosh man nihu benan shel kedoshim rabbi menachem bar simay veammay karu leh benan shel kedoshim dela istakkal betzurta dezuza shelach leh rav shemuel bar idi chananya achi omer achat velet hilcheta keoteh

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hammavdil tzarich sheyyomar meen havdalot haamurot battora metivi seder havdalot heach omer hammavdil ben kodesh lechol ben or lechoshech ben yisrael laammim uven yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase ben tame letahor ben hayyam lecharava ben mayim haelonim lemayim hattachtonim ben kohanim lilviyyim veyisreelim

Vechotem beseder bereshit vaacherim omrim beotzer bereshit rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer chotem mekaddesh yisrael veim ita ha ben hayyam lecharava la ketiva beh havdala semi mikkan ben hayyam lecharava
I hachi ben yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase name meen chatima hu betzar chada veleka sheva

Amri kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim tere mile ninhu ben leviyyim leyisreelim dichtiv baet hahi hivdil Adonai et shevet hallevi ben hakkohanim lalviyyim dichtiv bene amram aharon umoshe vayyibbadel aharon lehakdisho kodesh kadashim
Michtam may chatem rav amar mekaddesh yisrael ushmuel amar hammavdil ben kodesh lechol layet alah abbaye veitema rav yosef aha derav
Tana mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben chananya kol hachotem mekaddesh yisrael vehammavdil ben kodesh lechol maarichin lo yamav ushnotav
b: Velet hilcheta keoteh

Ulla ikla lefumbedita amar leh rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh zil amti leh kalkalla defere vachazi hechi avdel la azal shaddar leh leabbaye ki ata abbaye amar leh hechi amar amar leh baruch hammavdil ben kodesh lechol amar vetu la

Ata lekammeh daavuh amar leh hechi amar amar leh ana la azali ana shadderiteh leabbaye vaamar li hammavdil ben kodesh lechol amar leh ravrevanuteh demar usraruteh demar gerama leh lemar dela tema shemateh mippummeh
Metivi kol habberachot kullan poteach bevaruch vechotem bahen bevaruch chutz mibbirkat mitzot uvirkat happerot uvracha hassemucha lachavertah uvracha acharona shebbikriyyat shema
Sheyyesh mehen poteach bahen bevaruch veen chotem bevaruch veyesh mehen shechotem bevaruch veen poteach bevaruch vehattov vehammetiv poteach bevaruch veeno chotem bevaruch

a: Kashya leulla amar lach ulla ha name kevirkat hammitzot damya birkat hammitzot may tama mishshum dehodaa hi ha name hodaa hi

Rav chananya bar shelemya vetalmide derav hao yatvi bisodta vekae alayehu rav hamnuna sava amaru leh zil chazi i mikkedish yoma nafsik venikbeeh leshabbeta amar lehu la tzerichitu shabbeta kava nafshah
Deamar rav keshem shehashshabbat kovaat lemaaser kach shabbat kovaat lekidush
Sevur minah ki hechi dekava lekidush kach kava lehavdala amar lehu rav amram hachi amar rav lekidush kovaat velo lehavdala kovaat
Vehane mile leinyan mifsak dela mafsekinan aval atchole la matchalinan umifsak name la amaran ella baachila aval bishtiyya la
Ushtiyya name la amaran ella bechamra veshichra aval mayya let lan bah

Ufliga derav huna derav huna chazyeh lehahu gavra dishta mayya kodem havdala amar leh la mistefe mar measkara detana mishshemeh derabbi akiva kol hattoem kelum kodem sheyyavdil mitato beaskara rabbanan deve rav ashe la kafdi ammayya

Bea mineh ravina merav nachman bar yitzchak mi shello kidesh beerev shabbat mahu sheyekaddesh veholech kal hayyom kullo amar leh middeamri bene rabbi chiyya mi shello hivdil bemotzae shabbat mavdil veholech kol hashshabbat kullo hacha name mi shello kidesh beerev shabbat mekaddesh veholech kol hayyom kullo
Etiveh lele shabbat velele yom tov yesh bahen kedushsha al hakkos veyesh bahen hazkara bevirkat hammazon shabbat veom tov en bahem kedushsha al hakkos veyesh bahen hazkara bevirkat hammazon

Vei salka datach mi shello kidesh beerev shabbat mekaddesh veholech kol hayyom kullo shabbat veom tov name mashkachatte lehu deyesh bahen kedushsha al hakkos dei la kaddesh meurta mekaddesh limchar amar leh dei la katane
Etiveh kevod yom uchvod layela kevod yom kodem veim en lo ella kos echad omer alav
b: Kidush hayyom mippene shekkidush hayyom kodem lichvod yom uchvod layela veim ita lishbekeh ad limchar velebed beh tarte amar leh chaviva mitzva bishatah

Umi amrinan chaviva mitzva bishatah veha tanya hannichnas leveto bemotzae shabbat mevarech al hayyayin veal hammaor veal habbesamim veachar kach omer havdala al hakkos veim en lo ella kos echad mannicho ad leachar hammazon umshalshelan kullan leacharav vela amrinan chaviva mitzva bishatah

Amar leh ana la chakkimaa ana vela chozaa ana vela yechidaa ana ella gamrana vesadrana ana vechen morin beve midresha keoti shane lan ben ayyole yoma leappoke yoma ayyole yoma kol kamma demakdeminan leh adif umchabbevinan leh appoke yoma meacharinan leh ki hechi dela leheve alan ketuna
Shema minah miha matnita tamne shema minah hammavdil bitfilla tzarich sheyyavdil al hakkos
Ushma minah beracha teuna kos ushma minah kos shel beracha tzarich shiur
Ushma minah hamvarech tzarich sheyyitom ushma minah teamo pegamo ushma minah taam mavdil

a: Ushma minah omer shette kedushshot al kos echad ushma minah bet shammay hi vealliba derabbi yehuda
Rav ashe amar teamo pegamo vechos shel beracha tzarich shiur chada milta hi
Vehachi kaamar may tama teamo pegamo mishshum dechos shel beracha tzarich shiur
Rabbi yaakov bar idi kafed achatzba pegima rav idi bar shisha kafed akkasa pegima mar bar rav ashe kafed afilu achavita pegimta
Tanu rabbanan zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho zochrehu al hayyayin en li ella beom ballayela minnayin talmud lomar zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho

Ballayela minnayin adderabba ikar kiddusha ballayela hu kadesh dechi kadesh techillat yoma bae lekadoshe vetu ballayela minnayin talmud lomar zachor et yom tanna mehaddar allayela veka nasev leh kera dimama
Hachi kaamar zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho zochrehu al hayyayin bichnisato en li ella ballayela bayyom minnayin talmud lomar zachor et yom hashshabbat
Beom may mevarech amar rav yehuda bore peri haggefen rav ashe ikla lemachoza amaru leh likaddesh lan mar kidusha rabba havu leh

Sevar may nihu kidusha rabba amar mikkede kol habberachot kullan bore peri haggefen amri beresha amar bore peri haggefen veagged beh chazyeh lehahu sava degachen veshate kare annafsheh hechacham enav berosho
Amri bene rabbi chiyya mi shello hivdil bemotzae shabbat mavdil veholech bechol hashshabbat kullo vead kamma amar rabbi zera ad revii beshabbat

Ki ha deyatev rabbi zera kammeh derav assi veamri lah rav assi kammeh derabbi yochanan veyatev vekaamar leinyan gitin chada beshabbeta tere utlata batar shabbeta arba vechamsha umaale yoma kamme shabbeta
Amar rabbi yaakov bar idi aval lo al haur
Amar rav berona amar rav
b: Hannotel yadav lo yekaddesh amar lehu rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta akkatti la nach nafsheh derav shechachninhu lishmateteh zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav zimnin dachaviva aleh rifta mekaddesh arifta zimnin dachaviva leh chamra mekaddesh achamra
Amar rav huna amar rav taam eno mekaddesh bea mineh rav chana bar chinana merav huna taam mahu sheyyavdil amar leh ani omer taam mavdil verav assi amar taam eno mavdil
Rav yirmeya bar abba ikla leve rav assi ishteli vetaim mide havu leh kasa veavdel amara leh devethu veha mar la aved hachi amar lah shivkeh kerabbeh sevira leh
Amar rav yosef amar shemuel taam eno mekaddesh taam eno mavdil verabba amar rav nachman amar shemuel taam mekaddesh vetaam mavdil

a: Amar rava hilcheta taam mekaddesh vetaam mavdil umi shello kidesh beerev shabbat mekaddesh veholech kol hayyom kullo ad motzae shabbat mi shello hivdil bemotzae shabbat mavdil veholech kol hashshabbat kullo

Matztza al shum shennigalu avotenu mimmitzrayim shenneemar vayyofu et habbatzek asher hotziu mimmitzrayim vego maror al shum shemmerru hammitzriyyim et chayye avotenu bemitzrayim shenneemar vayemarru et chayyehem vego
Bechol dor vador chayyav adam lirot et atzmo keilu hu yatza mimmitzrayim shenneemar vehiggadta levincha bayyom hahu lemor baavur ze asa Adonai li betzeti mimmitzrayim

Lefichach anachnu chayyavim lehodot lehallel leshabbeach lefaer leromem lehadder levarech lealle ulkalles lemi sheasa laavotenu velanu et kol hannissim haellu hotzianu meavdut lecherut miyyagon lesimcha umeevel leom tov umeafela leor gadol umishshibud ligulla venomar lefanav halluyah

Ad hechan hu omer bet shammay omrim ad em habbanim semecha uvet hillel omrim ad challamish lemayeno mayim vechotem bigulla rabbi tarfon omer asher gealanu vegaal et avotenu mimmitzrayim velo haya chotem

Rabbi akiva omer ken Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu yaggienu lemoadim velirgalim acherim habbaim likratenu leshalom semechim bevinyan irecha vesasim baavodatech venochal sham min happesachim umin hazzevachim ku ad baruch atta Adonai gaal yisrael
Gema amar rava tzarich sheyyomar veotanu hotzi mishsham amar rava matztza tzarich lehagbiha umaror tzarich lehagbiha basar en tzarich lehagbiha velo od ella shennire keochel kadashim bachutz
Amar rav acha bar yaakov some patur millomar haggada ketiv hacha baavur ze uchtiv hatam benenu ze ma lehallan perat lesome af kan perat lesomin

Ini vehaamar marimar sheeltinhu lerabbanan deve rav yosef man deamar aggadta be rav yosef amaru rav yosef man deamar aggadta be rav sheshet amru rav sheshet kasavri rabbanan matztza bizman hazze derabbanan
Mikkelal derav acha bar yaakov savar matztza bizman hazze deorayeta veha rav acha bar yaakov hu deamar matztza bizman hazze derabbanan kasavar kol detakkun rabbanan keen deorayeta takun
Lerav sheshet ulrav yosef name ha vadday kol detakkun rabbanan keen deorayeta takun
Hachi hashta bishlama hatam middahava leh lemichtav benenu hu uchtiv benenu ze shema minah perat lesomin hu daata aval hacha i lav baavur ze may lichtov ella baavur matztza umaror hu daata
Lefichach anachnu chayyavim

a: Amar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan halluyah vechesyah vididya achat hen rav amar kesyah umerchavyah achat hen rabba amar merchavyah bilvad
Ibaya lehu merchav yah lerav chisda may teku
Ibaya lehu yedidyah lerav may ta shema deamar rav yedidyah nechlak lishnayim lefichach yedid chol yah kodesh
Ibaya lehu halluyah lerav may ta shema deamar rav chazena tile deve chabbiva dichtiv behu hallu bechad gisa veyah bechad gisa
Ufliga derabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may halluyah halleluhu behillulim harbe

Vfliga dideh addideh deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi baasara maamarot shel shevach neemar sefer tehillim benitzuach beniggun bemaskil bemizmor beshir beashre bithilla bitfilla behodaa behalluyah gadol mikkullan halluyah shekkolel shem vashevach bevat achat

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shir shebbattora moshe veyisrael amaruhu beshaa shealu min hayyam vehallel ze mi amaro neviim shebbenehen tikkenu lahen leyisrael sheyehu omrin oto al kol perek uferek veal kol tzara vetzara shello tavo alehen velichshennigalin omrim oto al geullatan
Tanya haya rabbi meir omer kol tushbachot haamurot besefer tehillim kullan david amaran shenneemar kollu tefillot david ben yishay al tikre kollu ella kol ellu

Hallel ze mi amaro rabbi yose omer elazar beni omer moshe veyisrael amaruhu beshaa shealu min hayyam vachalukin alav chaverav lomar sheddavid amaro venirin devarav middivrehen efshar yisrael shachatu et pischehen venatlu lulvehen velo amru shira
Davar acher pislo shel micha omed bivchi veyisrael omrim et hahallel

Tanu rabbanan kol shirot vetushbachot sheamar david besefer tehillim rabbi eliezer omer keneged atzmo amaran rabbi yehoshua omer keneged tzibur amaran vachachamim omrim yesh mehen keneged tzibur veyesh mehen keneged atzmo haamurot bilshon yachid keneged atzmo haamurot bilshon rabbim keneged tzibur
Nitzuach venigun leatid lavo maskil al yede turgeman ledavid mizmor melammed sheshsharta alav shechina veachar kach amar shira mizmor ledavid melammed sheamar shira veachar kach sharta alav shechina

Lelammedcha sheen hashshechina shora lo mittoch atzlut velo mittoch atzvut velo mittoch sechok velo mittoch kallut rosh velo mittoch devarim betelim ella mittoch devar simcha shel mitzva shenneemar veatta kechu li menaggen vehaya kenaggen hamnaggen vattehi alav yad Adonai
Amar rav yehuda amar rav vechen lidvar halacha amar rav nachman vechen lachalom tov

Ini vehaamar rav gidel amar rav kol talmid chacham hayyoshev lifne rabbo veen siftotav notfot mar tikkavena shenneemar siftotav shoshannim notfot mor over al tikre shoshannim ella sheshshonim al tikre mor over ella mar over
La kashya ha berabba ha betalmida

Vei baet ema ha veha berabba vela kashya ha mikkamme defatach veha levatar defatach ki ha derabba mikkamme defatach lehu lerabbanan amar milta divdichuta uvadchu rabbanan ulvassof yatev beemta ufatach bishmata

Tanu rabbanan hallel ze mi amaro rabbi eliezer omer moshe veyisrael amaruhu beshaa sheamdu al hayyam hem amru lo lanu Adonai lo lanu meshiva ruach hakkodesh veamra lahen lemaani lemaani eese rabbi yehuda omer yehoshua veyisrael amaruhu beshaa sheamdu alehen malche chenaan hem amru lo lanu umshiva vechu

Rabbi elazar hammodai omer devora uvarak amaruhu beshaa sheamad alehem sisra hem amru lo lanu veruach hakkodesh meshiva veomeret lahem lemaani lemaani eese rabbi elazar ben azarya omer chizkiyya vesiyato amaruhu beshaa sheamad alehem sancheriv hem amru lo lanu umshiva vechu rabbi akiva omer chananya mishael vaazarya amaruhu beshaa sheamad alehem nevuchadnetztzar harasha hem amru lo lanu umshiva vechu rabbi yose haggelili omer mardechay veester amaruhu beshaa sheamad alehem haman harasha hem amru lo lanu umshiva vechu
Vachachamim omrim neviim shebbenehen tiknu lahem leyisrael sheyehu omrim oto al kol perek uferek veal kol tzara vetzara shello tavo alehem leyisrael velichshennigalin omrim oto al geullatan
Amar rav chisda halluyah sof pirka rabba bar rav huna amar halluyah resh pirka amar rav chisda chazena lehu letile deve rav chanin bar rav dichtiv behu halluyah beemtza pirka alma mesappeka leh

Amar rav chanin bar rava hakkol modim bithillat Adonai yedabber pi vivarech kol basar shem kodsho leolam vaed halluyah halluyah devatreh resh pirka rasha yire vechaas shinnav yacharok venamas taavat reshaim toved halluyah devatreh resh pirka vesheomdim bevet Adonai halluyah devatreh resh pirka
Karae mosifin af et ellu minnachal badderech yishte al ken yarim rosh halluyah devatreh resh pirka reshit chochma yirat Adonai sechel tov lechol osehem halluyah devatreh resh pirka

Nema ketannae ad hechan hu omer bet shammay omrim ad em habbanim semecha uvet hillel omrim ad challamish lemayeno mayim vetanya idach ad hechan hu omer bet shammay omrim ad betzet yisrael mimmitzrayim uvet hillel omrim ad lo lanu Adonai lo lanu
b: May lav beha kamipalgi leman deamar ad em habbanim semecha savar halluyah resh pirka uman deamar ad betzet yisrael savar halluyah sof pirka
Rav chisda metaretz letameh dechulle alma savri halluyah sof pirka man deamar ad betzet yisrael shappir uman deamar ad em habbanim semecha ad vead bakkelal
Venema ad halluyah vechi tema dela yadinan he halluyah venema halluyah shel em habbanim semecha kashya
Rabba bar rav huna metaretz letameh dechulle alma halluyah resh pirka man deamar ad em habbanim semecha shappir uman deamar ad betzet yisrael savar ad velo ad bakkelal
Venema ad halluyah vechi tema dela yadinan he halluyah venema ad halluyah shebbetzet yisrael kashya
Vechotem bigulla amar rava keriat shema vehallel gaal yisrael ditzlota goel yisrael may tama derachame ninhu
Amar rabbi zera dekidusha asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu ditzlota kaddeshenu bemitzotecha may tama derachame ninhu
Amar rav acha bar yaakov vetzarich sheyyazkir yetziat mitzrayim bekidush hayyom ketiv hacha lemaan tizkor et yom uchtiv hatam zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho
Amar rabba bar shela ditzlota matzmiach keren yeshua deaftarta magen david
Veasiti lecha shem gadol keshem haggedolim tane rav yosef zehu sheomrim magen david
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish veeescha legoy gadol zehu sheomrim elohe avraham vaavarechcha zehu sheomrim elohe yitzchak vaagaddela shemecha zehu sheomrim elohe yaakov
Yachol yehu chotmin bechullan talmud lomar vehye beracha becha chotmin veen chotmin bechullan

Amar rava ashkachtina lesave defumbedita deyatvi vekaamri beshabbeta ben bitzlota ben bekidusha mekaddesh hashshabbat beoma tava ben bitzlota uven bekidusha mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim veamena lehu ana adderabba ditzlota ben beshabbeta ben beoma tava mekaddesh yisrael bekidusha deshabbeta mekaddesh hashshabbat beoma tava mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim

Vaana amena tama didi vetama didchu tama didchu shabbat dikvia vekayema ben bitzlota uven bekidusha mekaddesh hashshabbat yoma tava deyisrael hu dekavi leh dekamabberi yarche vekavi leshane mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim
Tama didi tzelota divrabbim ita mekaddesh yisrael kidush divyachid ita beshabbat mekaddesh hashshabbat beom tov mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim
Vela hi tzelota beyachid mi leteh vekidusha berabbim mi leteh verava savar zil batar ikar

Ulla bar rav nechet kammeh derava amar kesave defumbedita vela amar leh vela mide alma hadar beh rava rav natan avuh derav huna bereh derav natan nechet kammeh derav pappa amar kesave defumbedita veshabbecheh rav pappa

Amar ravina ana iklai lesura kammeh demarimar unchet kammeh shelucha detzibura vaamar kesave defumbedita vahao meshatteki leh kulle alma amar lehu shivkuhu hilcheta kesave defumbedita vela hao meshatteku leh
Matni mazgu lo kos shelishi mevarech al mezono revii gomer alav et hallel veomer alav birkat hashshir ben hakkosot hallalu im rotze lishtot yishte ben shelishi lirvii lo yishte
Gema amar leh rav chanan lerava shema minah birkat hammazon teuna kos amar leh arba kase tiknu rabbanan derech cherut kol chad vechad naaved beh mitzva
Revii gomer alav et hahallel veomer alav birkat hashshir

a: May birkat hashshir rav yehuda amar yehallucha Adonai elohenu verabbi yochanan amar nishmat kal chay tanu rabbanan revii gomer alav et hahallel veomer hallel haggadol divre rabbi tarfon veyesh omrim Adonai roi lo echsar
Mehechan hallel haggadol rabbi yehuda omer mehodu ad naharot bavel verabbi yochanan omer mishshir hammaalot ad naharot bavel rav acha bar yaakov amar mikki yaakov bachar lo yah ad naharot bavel
Velamma nikra shemo hallel haggadol amar rabbi yochanan mippene shehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev berumo shel olam umchallek mezonot lechol beriyya
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hane esrim veshishsha hodu keneged mi keneged esrim veshishsha dorot shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beolamo velo natan lahem tora vezan otam bechasdo
Amar rav chisda may dichtiv hodu la ki tov hodu la sheggove chovato shel adam betovato ashir beshoro veet ani beseo yatom bevetzato almana betarnegoltah
Amar rabbi yochanan kashin mezonotav shel adam kiflayim kayyoleda deilu beoleda ketiv beetzev uvimzonot ketiv beitztzavon
Veamar rabbi yochanan kashin mezonotav shel adam yoter min haggeulla deilu bigulla ketiv hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra malach bealma veilu bimzonot ketiv haelohim haroe oti

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu laadam vekotz vedardar tatzmiach lach zalgu enav demaot amar lefanav ribbono shel olam ani vachamori nochal beevus echad kevan sheamar lo bezeat appecha tochal lechem nitkarra dato
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish ashrenu im amadnu barishona vaadayin la paltinan minah deka achlinan isve dedavra
Amar rav shezvi mishshemeh derabbi elazar ben azarya kashin mezonotav shel adam kikriat yam suf dichtiv noten lechem lechol basar usmich leh legozer yam suf ligzarim
Amar rabbi elazar ben azarya kashin nekavav shel adam keom hammita vechikriat yam suf shenneemar mihar tzoe lehippateach uchtiv batreh roga hayyam vayyehemu gallav
Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya kol hamvazze et hammoadot keilu oved avoda zara shenneemar elohe massecha lo taase lach uchtiv batreh et chag hammatztzot tishmor

Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya kol hamsapper lashon hara vechol hamkabbel lashon hara vechol hammeid edut sheker bachavero rauy lehashlicho lichlavim shenneemar lakkelev tashlichun oto uchtiv batreh lo tissa shema shave ukri beh lo tassi
Vechi meachar deika hallel haggadol anan may tama amrinan hay mishshum sheyyesh bo chamishsha devarim hallalu yetziat mitzrayim keriat yam suf umattan tora utchiyyat hammetim vechevlo shel mashiach
Yetziat mitzrayim dichtiv betzet yisrael mimmitzrayim ukriat yam suf dichtiv hayyam raa vayyanos mattan tora dichtiv heharim rakdu cheelim techiyyat hammetim dichtiv ethallech lifne Adonai
Chevlo shel mashiach dichtiv lo lanu Adonai lo lanu veamar rabbi yochanan lo lanu Adonai lo lanu zo shibud malchiyyot ika deamri amar rabbi yochanan lo lanu Adonai lo lanu zo milchemet gog umagog

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mippene sheyyesh bo milut nefashot shel tzaddikim miggehinnam shenneemar anna Adonai malleta nafshi chizkiyya amar mippene sheyyesh bo yeridatan shel tzaddikim lechivshan haesh vaaliyyatan mimmennu
Yeridatan dichtiv lo lanu Adonai lo lanu amar chananya ki leshimcha ten kavod amar mishael al chasdecha veal amittecha amar azarya lamma yomru haggoyim amru kullan
Aliyyatan mikkivshan haesh dichtiv hallu et Adonai kol goyim amar chananya shabbechuhu kal haummim amar mishael ki gavar alenu chasdo amar azarya veemet Adonai leolam halluyah amru kullan

Veyesh omrim veemet Adonai leolam gavriel amaro beshaa shehippil nimrod harasha et avraham avinu letoch kivshan haesh amar gavriel lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam ered vaatzannen veatztzil et hatztzaddik mikkivshan haesh amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu ani yachid beolami vehu yachid beolamo nae layyachid lehatztzil et hayyachid ulfi shehakkadosh baruch hu eno mekappeach sechar kol beriyya amar tizke vetatztzil shelosha mibbene vanav

Darash rabbi shimon hashshiloni beshaa shehippil nevuchadnetztzar harasha chananya mishael vaazarya letoch kivshan haesh amad yorekmo sar habbarad lifne hakkadosh baruch hu amar lefanav ribbono shel olam ered vaatzannen et hakkivshan veatztzil latztzaddikim hallalu mikkivshan haesh amar lo gavriel en gevurato shel hakkadosh baruch hu bechach sheatta sar barad vehakkol yodin shehammayim mechabbin et haesh ella ani sar shel esh ered vaakarer mibbifnim
b: Veakdiach mibbachutz veeese nes betoch nes amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu red beotah shaa patach gavriel veamar veemet Adonai leolam

Rabbi natan omer veemet Adonai leolam dagim shebbayyam amaruhu kidrav huna deamar rav huna yisrael shebbeoto haddor mikketanne amana hau vechiddaresh rabba bar mari may dichtiv vayyamru al yam beyam suf melammed shehimru yisrael beotah shaa veamru keshem sheanu olin mitztzad echad kach mitzriyyim olim mitztzad acher

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lesar shel yam pelot otan layyabbasha amar lefanav ribbono shel olam kelum yesh eved shennoten lo rabbo mattana vechozer venotel mimmennu amar lo etten lach echad umechetza shebbahen

Amar lo ribbono shel olam yesh eved shettovea et rabbo amar lo nachal kishon yehe li arev miyyad palat otan layyabbasha uvau yisrael verau otan shenneemar vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met al sefat hayyam
May echad umechetza shebbahen deilu befaro ketiv shesh meot rechev bachur veilu besisra ketiv tesha meot rechev barzel

Ki ata sisra ata alayehu bedikre defarzela hotzi hakkadosh baruch hu alehem kochavim mimmesilotam dichtiv min shamayim nilchamu hakkochavim kevan dinchitu kochve shamayim alayehu akdiru hane dikre defarzela nechitu leakrore lemische nafshayehu benachal kishon

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lenachal kishon lech vehashlem ervoncha miyyad gerafam nachal kishon vehishlichan layyam shenneemar nachal kishon gerafam nachal kedumim may nachal kedumim nachal shennaasa arev mikkedem beotah shaa patchu dagim shel yam veamru veemet Adonai leolam
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish may dichtiv moshivi akeret habbayit amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam samuni banecha kechulda zo haddara beikare vattim

Daresh rava may dichtiv ahavti ki yishma Adonai amra keneset yisrael ribbono shel olam emat ani ahuva lefanecha bizman shettishma kol tachanunay dalloti veli yehoshia amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam af al pi sheddalla ani bemitzot lecha ani veli nae lehoshia
Amar rav kahana keshechala rabbi yishmael berabbi yose shalach lo rabbi emor lanu shenayim ushlosha devarim sheamarta lanu mishshum avicha

Shalach lo kach amar abba may dichtiv hallu et Adonai kol goyim ummot haolam may avidtayehu hachi kaamar hallalu et Adonai kol goyim aggevurot veniflaot deaved bahadayehu kol shekken anu degavar alenu chasdo

Veod atida mitzrayim shettavi doron lammashiach kesavur eno mekabbel mehem amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lammashiach kabbel mehem achsanya asu levanay bemitzrayim miyyad yeetau chashmannim minni mitzrayim
Nasa kush kal vachomer beatzmah uma hallalu shennishtabedu bahen kach ani shello nishtabadti bahen lo kol shekken amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu kabbel mehem miyyad kush taritz yadav lelohim
Nasa malchut romi harshaa kal vachomer beatzmah uma hallalu sheen achehen kach anu sheanu achehen lo kol shekken amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu legavriel gear chayyat kane geor chayya ukne lecha eda
Davar acher geor chayyat kane sheddara ben hakkanim dichtiv yecharsemenna chazir miyyaar veziz saday yirenna
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan geor bechayya shekkol maaseha nichtavin bekulmos echad adat abbirim beegle ammim sheshshachatu abbirim kaagalim sheen lahem bealim

Mitrappes beratztze chasef shepposhtin yad lekabbel mamon veen osin retzon bealim pizar ammim keravot yechpatzun mi garam lahem leyisrael sheyyitpazzeru leven ummot haolam kerivot shehau chafetzin bahen

Veod shalach lo shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha shevakim bichrach gadol shel romi vechol echad veechad hau yesh bo shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha biraniyyot vechol biranit uviranit hau bo yesh bah shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha maalot vechol maala umaala hau bo yesh bah kede lazun et kal haolam kullo

Amar rabbi yishmael shimon berabbi lerabbi veamri lah lerabbi yishmael bar yose lerabbi hane leman lach ulchavrach ulchavrutach shenneemar sachrah veetnannah kodesh la lo yeatzer velo yechasen ki layyoshvim lifne Adonai yihye vego
May lo yeatzer tane rav yosef lo yeatzer ze bet otzar velo yechasen ze bet geniza may ki layyoshvim lifne Adonai amar rabbi elazar

a: Ze hammakkir mekom chavero bayeshiva ika deamri amar rabbi elazar ze hamkabbel pene chavero bayeshiva
May limchasse atik ze hamchasse devarim shekkisa attik yomin umay ninhu sitre tora veika deamri ze hamgalle devarim shekkisa attik yomin may ninhu taame tora
Amar rav kahana mishshum rabbi yishmael berabbi yose may dichtiv lamnatztzeach mizmor ledavid zammeru lemi shennotzchin oto vesameach

Bo ure shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam basar vadam menatztzechin oto veatzev aval hakkadosh baruch hu notzchin oto vesameach shenneemar vayyomer lehashmidam lule moshe vechiro amad bapperetz lefanav

Amar rav kahana mishshum rabbi yishmael berabbi yose amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia may dichtiv vide adam mittachat kanfehem yado ketiv ze yado shel hakkadosh baruch hu shepperusa tachat kanfe hachayyot kede lekabbel baale teshuva miyyad middat haddin

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol kesef vezahav shebbaolam yosef likketo vehevio lemitzrayim shenneemar vayelakket yosef et kol hakkesef hannimtza en li ella shebbeeretz mitzrayim veshebbeeretz kenaan bishar aratzot minnayin talmud lomar vechol haaretz bau mitzrayema
Uchshealu yisrael mimmitzrayim heeluhu immahen shenneemar vayenatztzelu et mitzrayim rav assi amar asauha kimtzuda zo sheen bah dagan rabbi shimon amar kimtzula sheen bah dagim

Vehaya munnach ad rechavam ba shishak melech mitzrayim untalo merchavam shenneemar vayehi bashshana hachamishit lammelech rechavam ala shishak melech mitzrayim al yerushalam vayyikkach et otzrot bet Adonai veet otzrot bet hammelech ba zerach melech kush untalo mishshishak
Ba asa untalo mizzerach melech kush veshigro lehadrimon ben tavrimon bau bene ammon untalum mehadrimon ben tavrimon ba yehoshafat untalo mibbene ammon vehaya munnach ad achaz

Ba sancheriv untalo meachaz ba chizkiyya untalo missancheriv vehaya munnach ad tzidkiyya bau kasdiyyim untaluhu mitztzidkiyya bau parsiyyim untaluhu mikkasdiyyim bau yevanim untaluhu mipparsiyyim bau romiyyim untaluhu miyyad yevanim vaadayin munnach beromi
Amar rabbi chama bar chanina shalosh matmoniyyot hitmin yosef bemitzrayim achat nitgalla lekorach veachat nitgalla leantoninus ben asvirus veachat genuza letzaddikim leatid lavo

Osher shamur livalav leraato amar rabbi shimon ben lakish zo oshro shel korach shenneemar veet kol hayekum asher beraglehem amar rabbi elazar ze mamono shel adam shemmaamido al raglav amar rabbi levi massooy shelosh meot peradot levanot hau maftechot bet genazav shel korach vechullehu aklide uklipe degilda

Siman amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan odcha ki anitani amar david even maasu habbonim hayeta lerosh pinna amar yishay meet Adonai hayeta zot amru echav ze hayyom asa Adonai amar shemuel
