Uldorot mena lan dela meakkeva middeka tane matkinin vela katane mafrishin
Ravina amar ribuy shiva umshicha shiva ika benayehu leman deamar kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev bahen meakkeva leman deamar davar sheen meakkev ledorot en meakkev bahen la meakkeva
Uldorot mena lan dela meakkeva detanya vechipper hakkohen asher yimshach oto vaasher yemalle et yado lechahen tachat aviv ma talmud lomar

Lefi shenneemar shivat yamim yilbasham hakkohen tachtav mibbanav en li ella nitrabba shiva venimshach shiva nitrabba shiva venimshach yom echad nitrabba yom echad venimshach shiva minnayin talmud lomar asher yimshach oto vaasher yemalle et yado mikkol makom
Ashkechan ribuy shiva lechattechilla meshicha shiva lechattechilla mena lan

Ibaet ema middeitzterich kera lemaotah veibaet ema deamar kera uvigde hakkodesh asher leaharon yihu levanav acharav lemoshcha vahem ulmalle vam et yadam itakkash meshicha leribuy ma ribuy shiva af meshicha shiva
May tama deman deamar kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev amar rabbi yitzchak bar bisna amar kera veasita leaharon ulvanav kacha kacha ikuva hu tinach kol
b: Milta dichtiva behay inyana milta dela ketiva behay inyana mena lan
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak yalef petach petach rav mesharsheya amar ushmartem et mishmeret Adonai ikkuva rav ashe amar ki chen tzuveti ikkuva
Tanu rabbanan ki chen tzuveti kaasher tziveti kaasher tziva Adonai ki chen tzuveti baaninut yochluha kaasher tziveti bishat maase amar lahem kaasher tziva Adonai velo meelay ani omer
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina michnasayim en ketuvin bapparasha keshehu omer veze haddavar asher taase lahem lekaddesh otam lechahen lehavi hammichnasayim vaasirit haefa
Bishlama michnasayim ketivi beinyana divgadim ella asirit haefa mena lan atya ze ze mivveze korban aharon uvanav asher yakrivu la asirit haefa
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay minnayin sheaf mikra parasha meakkev talmud lomar vayyomer moshe el haeda ze haddavar asher tziva Adonai afilu dibur meakkev
Ketzad hilbishan ketzad hilbishan may dahava hava ella ketzad malbishan leatid lavo leatid lavo name lichsheyyavou aharon uvanav umoshe immahem
Ella ketzad hilbishan lemisbar kerae peligi bah bene rabbi chiyya verabbi yochanan chad amar aharon veachar kach banav vechad amar aharon uvanav bevat achat

Amar abbaye bechuttonet umitznefet kulle alma la peligi deaharon veachar kach banav deven betzauoa uven baasiyya aharon kadem ki peligi beavnet man deamar aharon veachar kach banav dichtiv vayyachgor oto baavnet vahadar ketiv vayyachgor otam avnet uman deamar aharon uvanav bevat achat dichtiv vechagarta otam ulman deamar aharon uvanav bevat achat hachtiv vayyachgor oto beavnet vahadar ketiv vayyachgor otam avnet

a: Amar lach hahu avneto shel kohen gadol lo ze hu avneto shel kohen hedot
Ulman deamar aharon veachar kach banav vehachtiv vechagarta otam avnet amar lach hahu ka mashma lan avneto shel kohen gadol zehu avneto shel kohen hedot
Vayyachgor oto avnet vayyachgor otam lema li shema minah aharon veachar kach banav uvvat achat mi mashkachatte lah la tzericha deakdem
Mafrishin kohen gadol vechu lamma mafrishin lamma mafrishin kidkaamrinan i lerabbi yochanan kidit leh i leresh lakish kidit leh
Hachi kaamar mibbeto lamma perash tanya rabbi yehuda ben betira omer shemma timmatze ishto safek nidda veyavo aleha
Attu berashshie askinan ella shemma yavo al ishto vetimmatze safek nidda
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav chisda keman kerabbi akiva deamar nidda metammea et boalah dei rabbanan ha amri en nidda metammea et boalah
Amar lehu rav chisda afilu temru rabbanan ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi akiva ella beachar achar aval bechad achar modu leh
Amar rabbi zera shema minah boel nidda eno kenidda vetovel bayyom
Dei amratte boel nidda kenidda emat tavel belelya limchar hechi aved avoda veha bae heerev hashshemesh ella lav shema minah boel nidda eno kenidda
Rav shimi minnehardea amar afilu tema boel nidda kenidda demafreshinan leh shaa achat samuch lishkiat hachamma
Metivi kol chayyave tevilot tevilatan bayyom nidda veoledet tevilatan ballayela nidda in boel nidda la
Nidda vechol deate meribbuya
Metivi baal keri kemagga sheretz boel nidda kitme met may lav litvila lo letumatan
Tumatan behedya ketiv behu hay tumat shiva ketiv beh vehay tumat shiva ketiv beh
b: Ella lav litvilatan
La leolam letumatan sefa itztericha leh ella shechamur mimmennu boel nidda shemmetamme mishkav umoshav betuma kalla letamme ochalin umashkin
Ta shema detane rabbi chiyya hazzav vehazzava vehammetzora vehamtzoraat uvoel nidda utme met tevilatan bayyom nidda veoledet tevilatan ballayela teuvta
Vead sheatta mafrisho mittumat beto hafrishehu mittumat hammet amar rav tachlifa avuh derav huna bar tachlifa mishshemeh derava zot omeret tumat hammet huttera hi betzibur
Ravina amar afilu tema tumat hammet dechuya hi betzibbur tumat hammet la shechicha tumat beto shechicha
Itmar tumat hammet rav nachman amar huttera hi betzibur verav sheshet amar dechuya hi betzibur
Hecha deika temein uthorin behahu bet av kulle alma la peligi dithorin avdi temein la avdi ki peligi leahdore uletoye tehorin mibbet av acharina
Rav nachman amar heter hi betzibur vela mahderinan verav sheshet amar dechuya hi betzibur umahderinan
Ika deamri afilu hecha deika tehorin utmein behahu bet av pelig rav nachman veamar avdi name temein

a: Dechol tumat met betzibur rachamana sharyah
Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah detanya haya omed umakriv minchat haomer venitmet beyado omer umviin acheret tachteha veim en sham ella hi omrin lo heve pikkeach ushtok
Katane mihat omer umviin acheret tachteha amar rav nachman modena hecha deika shirayim laachila
Metivi haya makriv minchat parim veelim uchvasim venitmet beyado omer umviin acheret tachteha veim en sham ella hi omrin lo heve pikkeach ushtok
May lav parim elim uchvasim dechag

Amar lecha rav nachman la parim par avoda zara af al gav detzibur hu kevan dela kevia leh zeman mahderinan elim beelo shel aharon deaf al gav dikvia leh zeman kevan deyachid hu mehadderinan kevasim becheves habba im haomer deika shirayim laachila
Metivi dam shennitma uzrako beshogeg hurtza bemezid lo hurtza ki tanya hahi deyachid

Ta shema al ma hatztzitz meratztze al haddam veal habbasar veal hachelev shennitma ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon ben beyachid ben betzibur vei salka datach tuma heter hi betzibur lema li leratztzoye
Amar lecha rav nachman ki katane hatztzitz meratztze addeyachid veibaet ema afilu tema betzibur behanach dela kevia lah zeman
Metivi venasa aharon et aon hakkodashim vechi eze aon hu nose im aon pigul hare kevar neemar lo yeratze veim aon notar hare kevar neemar lo yechashev
b: Ha eno nose ella aon tuma shehuttera mikkelalah betzibur vekashya lerav sheshet tannae hi detanya tzitz ben sheyyeshno al mitzcho ben sheeno al mitzcho meratztze divre rabbi shimon
Rabbi yehuda omer odehu al mitzcho meratztze en odehu al mitzcho eno meratztze amar lo rabbi shimon kohen gadol beom hakkippurim yochiach sheen odehu al mitzcho umratztze
Amar lo rabbi yehuda hannach lechohen gadol beom hakkippurim shettuma huttera lo betzibur mikkelal derabbi shimon savar tuma dechuya hi betzibur
Amar abbaye benishbar hatztzitz dechulle alma la peligi dela meratztze ki peligi ditle besikta rabbi yehuda savar al metzach venasa
Verabbi shimon savar tamid leratzon lifne Adonai may tamid ilema tamid al mitzcho mi mashkachatte lah mi la bae meal levet hakkisse umi la bae menam ella tamid meratztze hu
Ulrabbi yehuda name ha ketiv tamid hahu tamid shello yassiach dato mimmennu kidrabba bar rav huna deamar rabba bar rav huna chayyav adam lemashmesh bitfilav bechol shaa veshaa kal vachomer mitztzitz

a: Uma tzitz sheen bo ella azkara achat amra tora al mitzcho tamid shello yassiach dato mimmennu tefilin sheyyesh bahen azkarot harbe al achat kamma vechamma
Ulrabbi shimon deamar tamid meratztze veha ketiv al mitzcho venasa hahu likboa lo makom hu daata
Verabbi yehuda likboa lo makom mena leh nafka leh meal mitzcho verabbi shimon name tipok leh meal mitzcho in hachi name
Ella al mitzcho venasa may aved leh amar lach rauy lammetzach meratztze sheeno rauy lammetzach eno meratztze leappoke nishbar hatztzitz delo meratztze
Ulrabbi yehuda nishbar hatztzitz mena leh nafka leh mimmetzach mitzcho verabbi shimon metzach mitzcho la mashma leh

Nema hane tannae kehane tannae detanya echad ze veechad ze mazzin alav kol shiva mikkol chattaot shehau sham divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer en mazzin alav ella shelishi ushvii bilvad rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer kohen hassoref et happara mazzin alav kol shiva kohen gadol beom hakkippurim en mazzin alav ella shelishi ushvii
May lav beha ka mipalgi rabbi meir savar tuma dechuya hi betzibur verabbi yose savar tuma heter hi betzibur
Vetisbera i savar rabbi yose heter hi betzibur hazzaa kelal lema li ella dechulle alma hane tannae savri tuma dechuya hi betzibur
Vehacha beha kamipalgi rabbi meir savar amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva verabbi yose savar la amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva

Vesavar rabbi yose la amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva vehatanya hare shehaya shem katuv al besaro hare ze lo yirchatz velo yasuch velo yaamod bimkom hattinnofet nizdammena lo tevila shel mitzva korech alav gemi vetovel rabbi yose omer yored vetovel kedarko uvilvad shello yeshafshef

Vekayema lan devitvila bizmannah mitzva ka mipalgi detanna kamma savar la amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva verabbi yose savar amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva ella dechulle alma lehane tannae amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva
Vehacha beha kamipalgi rabbi meir savar makkeshinan hazzaa litvila verabbi yose savar la makkeshinan hazzaa litvila
Verabbi chanina segan hakkohanim i makkesh hazzaa litvila afilu kohen beom hakkippurim name i la makkesh hazzaa litvila afilu kohen hassoref et happara name la
Leolam la makkesh vechohen hassoref et happara maala bealma
Keman azla ha detanu rabbanan en ben kohen hassoref et happara lechohen gadol beom hakkippurim ella
b: Shezze perishato likdushsha veechav hakkohanim nogin bo veze perishato letohora veen echav hakkohanim nogin bo keman o rabbi meir o rabbi yose dei rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim ha ika name ha
Matkef lah rabbi yose berabbi chanina bishlama rishon shemma shelishi sheni shemma shelishi shelishi shemma shelishi chamishi shemma shevii shishshi shemma shevii shevii shemma shevii
Ella revii lema li hazzaa kelal la bishlishi ika lesappoke velo bishvii ika lesappoke
Ultamach hazzaa kol shiva mi ika veha kayema lan dehazzaa shevut veenah docha et hashshabbat ella may it lach lememar shiva levar mishshabbat hacha name shiva levar mervii

Amar rava hilkach kohen gadol beom hakkippurim dela bedidan talya milta ella bikvia deyarcha talya milta bitlata betishri bae leafroshe vechol emat demitreme telata betishri mafreshinan leh aval kohen hassoref et happara divdidan talya milta mafreshinan leh birvii beshabbat ki hechi denitreme revii shello beshabbat
Lelishkat parhedrin tanya rabbi yehuda vechi lishkat parhedrin hayeta vahalo lishkat balote hayeta

Ella battechilla hau korin otah lishkat balote umittoch shennotnin alav mamon lakkehunna umachalifin otah kol shenem asar chodesh kefarhedrin hallalu shemmachlifin otam kol shenem asar chodesh lefichach hau korin otah lishkat parhedrin
Tenan hatam hannachtomin lo chiyevu otan chachamim lehafrish ella terumat maaser vechalla
Bishlama teruma gedola la detanya

a: Lefi sheshshalach bechol gevule yisrael veraa sheen mafrishin ella teruma gedola bilvad
Maaser rishon umasar ani name la hammotzi mechavero alav haraya ella maaser sheni nafreshu venasseku venechluh birushalayim
Amar ulla mittoch shepparhedrin hallalu chovtin otan kol shenem asar chodesh veomrim lahen michru bezol michru bezol la atrechunhu rabbanan may parhedrin purse

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv yirat Adonai tosif yamim ushnot reshaim tiktzorna yirat Adonai tosif yamim ze mikdash rishon sheamad arba meot veeser shanim velo shimmeshu bo ella shemona asar kohanim gedolim

Ushnot reshaim tiktzorna ze mikdash sheni sheamad arba meot veesrim shana veshimmeshu bo yoter mishshelosh meot kohanim tze mehem arbaim shana sheshshimmesh shimon hatztzaddik ushmonim sheshshimmesh yochanan kohen gadol eser sheshshimmesh yishmael ben piavi veamri lah achat esre sheshshimmesh rabbi elazar ben charsom mikkan veelach tze vachashov kol echad veechad lo hotzi shenato

Amar rabbi yochanan ben torta mippene ma charva shilo mippene shehau bah shene devarim gilluy araot uvizon kodashim gilluy araot dichtiv veeli zaken meod veshama et kol asher yaasun banav lechol yisrael veet asher yishkevun et hannashim hatztzovot petach ohel moed veaf al gav deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan kol haomer bene eli chatu eno ella toe mittoch
b: Sheshshihu et kinehen miha maale alehen hakkatuv keilu shechavum

Bizon kodashim dichtiv gam beterem yaktirun et hachelev uva naar hakkohen veamar laish hazzoveach tena vasar litzlot lakkohen velo yikkach mimmecha basar mevushshal ki im chay vayyomer elav haish katter yaktirun kayyom hachelev vekach lecha kaasher teave nafshecha veamar lo ki atta titten veim lo lakachti vechozka vattehi chattat hannearim gedola meod et pene Adonai ki niatzu haanashim et minchat Adonai
Mikdash rishon mippene ma charav mippene shelosha devarim shehau bo avoda zara vegilluy araot ushfichut damim avoda zara dichtiv ki katzar hammatztza mehistarea
May katzar hammatztza mehistarea amar rabbi yonatan katzar matztza ze mehistarer alav shene reim keechad
Vehammassecha tzara kehitkannes amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani ki mate rabbi yonatan lehay kera bache amar man dichtiv beh kones kanned me hayyam naaset lo massecha tzara

Gilluy araot dichtiv vayyomer Adonai yaan ki gavhu benot tziyyon vattelachna netuot garon umsakkerot enayim haloch vetafof telachna uvraglehen teakkasna yaan ki gavhu benot tziyyon shehau mehallechot arukka betzad ketzara vattelachna netuot garon shehau mehallechot bekoma zekufa umsakkerot enayim dahao malyan kuchla enehen haloch vetafof telachna shehau mehallechot akev betzad gudal uvraglehen teakkasna amar rabbi yitzchak shehau meviot mor vaafarsemon umannichot beminalehen uchshemmaggiot etzel bachure yisrael boatot umattizot alehen umachnisin bahen yetzer hara keeres bechaus
Shefichut damim dichtiv vegam dam naki shafach menashshe harbe meod ad asher mille et yerushalam pe lafe

Aval mikdash sheni shehau oskin betora uvmitzot ugmilut chasadim mippene ma charav mippene shehayeta bo sinat chinnam lelammedcha sheshshekula sinat chinnam keneged shalosh averot avoda zara gilluy araot ushfichut damim

Reshaim hau ella shettalu bitchonam behakkadosh baruch hu atan lemikdash rishon dichtiv rasheha beshochad yishpotu vechohaneha bimchir yoru unvieha bechesef yiksomu veal Adonai yishshaenu lemor halo Adonai bekirbenu lo tavo alenu raa lefichach hevi alehen hakkadosh baruch hu shalosh gezerot keneged shalosh averot shebbeyadam shenneemar lachen biglalchem tziyyon sade techaresh virushalam iyyin tihye vehar habbayit levamot yaar

Uvmikdash rishon la hava beh sinat chinnam vehachtiv megure el cherev hau et ammi lachen sefok el yarech veamar rabbi eliezer ellu bene adam sheochlin veshotin ze im ze vedokrin ze et ze bacharavot shebbilshonam
Hahi binsie yisrael havay dichtiv zeak vehelel ben adam ki hi hayeta veammi vetanya zeak vehelel ben adam yachol lakkol talmud lomar hi bechol nesie yisrael
Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayehu rishonim shennitgalla aonam nitgalla kitztzam acharonim shello nitgalla aonam lo nitgalla kitztzam

Amar rabbi yochanan tova tzippornan shel rishonim mikkereso shel acharonim amar leh resh lakish adderabba acharonim adifi af al gav deika shibud malchiyyot ka aski betora amar leh bira tochiach shechazra larishonim velo chazra laacharonim
Shaalu et rabbi elazar rishonim gedolim o acharonim gedolim amar lahem tenu enechem babbira ika deamri amar lahem edechem bira

Resh lakish have sache beyardena ata rabba bar bar chana yehav leh yeda amar leh elaha sanena lechu dichtiv im choma hi nivne aleha tirat kasef veim delet hi natzur aleha luach arez im asitem atzmechem kechoma vaalitem kullechem bime ezra nimshaltem kechesef sheen rakav sholet bo achshav shealitem kidlatot nimshaltem keerez sheharakav sholet bo

May erez amar ulla sasmagor may sasmagor amar rabbi abba bat kol kidtanya mishshemmetu neviim haacharonim chaggay zecharya umalachi nistalleka ruach hakkodesh miyyisrael vaadayin hau mishtammeshin bevat kol

Veresh lakish mi mishtae bahade rabba bar bar chana uma rabbi eliezer demara deara deyisrael hava vela hava mishtae resh lakish bahadeh deman demishtae resh lakish bahadeh beshuka yahavu leh iska bela sahade bahade rabba bar bar chana mishtae

Amar rav pappa shedi gavra benayehu o resh lakish hava uzeri o rabba bar bar chana hava verabbi elazar ki ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh lav hayenu tama i name seliku kullehu bime ezra la hava sharya shechina bemikdash sheni dichtiv yafte elohim leyefet veyishkon beohole shem

a: Af al gav deyafte elohim leyefet en hashshechina shora ella beohole shem

Ufarsae mena lan demiyyefet kaatu dichtiv bene yefet gomer umagog umaday veyavan vetuval umeshech vetiras gomer ze germamya magog zo kandiyya maday zo makedonya yavan kemashmao tuval ze bet unayeki meshech zo musya tiras peligi bah rabbi simay verabbanan veamri lah rabbi simon verabbanan chad amar zo bet terayeki vechad amar zo paras tane rav yosef tiras zo paras
Savta verama vesavtecha tane rav yosef sakkistan gavayeta vesakkistan barayeta ben chada lachada mea parse vehekefah alpa parse
Vattehi reshit mamlachto bavel veerech veakkad vechalne bavel kemashmea erech ze orichut veakkad ze bashkar kalne ze nufar ninfi

Min haaretz hahi yatza ashshur tane rav yosef ashshur ze silak vayyiven et ninve veet rechovot ir veet kalach ninve kemashmao rechovot ir zo perat demeshan kalach zo perat devorsif veet resen ben ninve uven kalach hi hair haggedola resen ze aktisfon hi hair haggedola eni yodea im ninve hair haggedola im resen hair haggedola keshehu omer veninve hayeta ir gedola lelohim mahalach sheloshet yamim heve omer ninve hi hair haggedola

Vesham achiman sheshay vetalmay yelide haanak tana achiman meumman shebbaachim sheshay shemmesim et haaretz kishchitot talmay shemmesim et haaretz telamim telamim davar acher achiman bana anat sheshay bana alush talmay bana talbush yelide haanak shemmaanikin hachamma bekomatan

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar rabbi atida romi shettippol beyad paras shenneemar lachen shimu atzat Adonai asher yaatz al edom umachshevotav asher chashav al yoshve teman im lo yischavum tzeire hatztzon im lo yashshim alehem nevehem
Matkef lah rabba bar ulla may mashma dehay tzeire hatztzon paras hu dichtiv haayil asher raita baal hakkeranayim hu malche maday ufaras veema yavan dichtiv vehatztzafir hassair melech yavan
Ki selek rav chaviva bar sormaki amrah kammeh dehahu merabbanan amar leh man dela yada paroshe kerae motev teuvta lerabbi may tzeire hatztzon zutra daachohi detane rav yosef tiras ze paras

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay atida romi shettippol beyad paras kal vachomer uma mikdash rishon shebbenauhu bene shem vehechrivuhu kasdiyyim naflu kasdiyyim beyad parsiyyim mikdash sheni shebbenauhu parsiyyim vehechrivuhu romiyyim eno din sheyyippelu romiyyim beyad parsiyyim
Amar rav atida paras shettippol beyad romi amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav banoye beyad satore amar lehu in gezerat melech hi ika deamri amar leh inhu name ha ka satri be chenishta

Tanya name hachi atida paras shettippol beyad romi chada desatri be chenishta veod gezerat melech hu sheyyippelu bonin beyad sotrin deamar rav yehuda amar rav en ben david ba ad shettifshot malchut romi harshaa bechol haolam kullo tisha chodashim shenneemar lachen yittenem ad et yoleda yalada veyeter echav yeshuvun al bene yisrael
Tanu rabbanan kol halleshachot shehau bemikdash lo hau lahen mezuza chutz millishkat parhedrin shehaya bah bet dira lechohen gadol
Amar rabbi yehuda vahalo kamma leshachot hau bemikdash shehaya lahen bet dira velo haya lahen mezuza ella lishkat parhedrin gezera hayeta

May tama derabbi yehuda amar rava kasavar rabbi yehuda kol bayit sheeno asuy limot hachamma velimot haggeshamim eno bayit etiveh abbaye vehachtiv vehikketi et bet hachoref al bet hakkayitz amar leh bet choref uvet kayitz ikri bayit setama la ikri
Etiveh abbaye sukkat hechag bechag rabbi yehuda mechayyev vachachamim potrin vetane alah rabbi yehuda mechayyev beeruv uvimzuza uvmaaser
Vechi tema midderabbanan bishlama eruv umzuza ika lememar midderabbanan ella maaser mi ika lememar midderabbanan
b: Dilma ate leafroshe min hachiyyuv al happetur umin happetur al hachiyyuv
Ella amar abbaye beshiva dechulle alma la peligi demichayeva ki peligi bishar yemot hashshana rabbanan savri gazrinan shear yemot hashshana attu shiva verabbi yehuda savar la gazrinan
Amar leh rava veha sukkat hechag bechag katane
Ella amar rava bishar yemot hashshana kulle alma la peligi diftura ki peligi beshiva vesukka tama lechud velishka tama lechud
Sukka tama lechud rabbi yehuda letameh deamar sukka dirat keva baenan umichayeva bimzuza verabbanan letamayehu deamri sukka dirat aray baenan vela michayeva bimzuza
Velishka tama lechud rabbanan savri dira beal korchah shemah dira verabbi yehuda savar dira beal korchah lo shemah dira umidderabbanan hu detakkinu lah shello yomru kohen gadol chavush bevet haasurin
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan

a: Kol hashshearim shehau sham lo haya lahem mezuza chutz mishshaar nikanor shellifnim mimmennu lishkat parhedrin
Lema rabbanan hi vela rabbi yehuda dei rabbi yehuda hi gufah gezera vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera afilu tema rabbi yehuda kullah chada gezera hi

Tanu rabbanan bisharecha echad shaare vattim veechad shaare chatzerot veechad shaare medinot veechad shaare ayarot yesh bahen chovat mitzva lammakom mishshum shenneemar uchtavtam al mezuzot betecha uvisharecha

Amar leh abbaye lerav safra hane avulle demachoza may tama la avadu lehu rabbanan mezuza amar leh hanhu chizzuk leakra dechuve hu daavidi amar leh veakra dechuve gufah tive mezuza deha it bah dira leshomer bet haasurin deha tanya bet hakkeneset sheyyesh bo bet dira lechazzan hakkeneset chayyevet bimzuza
Ella amar abbaye mishshum sakkana detanya mezuzat yachid nivdeket paamayim bashshavua veshel rabbim paamayim bayyovel

Veamar rabbi yehuda maase beartavin echad shehaya bodek mezuzot bashshuk haelon shel tzippori umtzao kasdor echad venatal mimmennu elef zuz vehaamar rabbi elazar sheluche mitzva en nizokin hecha dikvia hezeka shane dichtiv vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani vayyomer Adonai eglat bakar tikkach beyadecha veamarta lizboach la bati

Tane rav kahana kammeh derav yehuda bet hatteven uvet habbakar uvet haetzim uvet haotzarot peturim min hammezuza mippene shehannashim neotot bahen umay neotot rochatzot amar leh rav yehuda tama derochatzot ha setama chayyavin vehatanya refet bakar petura min hammezuza

Ella may neotot mitkashshetot vehachi katane af al pi shehannashim mitkashshetot bahen peturin amar leh rav kahana veshehannashim mitkashshetot bahen peturin vehatanya refet bakar petura min hammezuza veshehannashim mitkashshetot bah chayyevet bimzuza

Ella may it lach lememar mitkashshetot tannae hi ledidi name setama tannae hi detanya betecha betcha hamuchad lach perat levet hatteven ulvet habbakar ulvet haetzim ulvet haotzarot sheppeturin min hammezuza veyesh mechayevin
Beemet amru bet hakkisse uvet habburseki uvet hammerchatz uvet hattevila veshehannashim neotot bahen peturim min hammezuza rav kahana metaretz letameh verav yehuda metaretz letameh

Rav kahana metaretz letameh betecha betcha hamuchad lach perat levet hatteven ulvet habbakar ulvet haetzim ulvet haotzarot sheppeturim min hammezuza bistam veyesh shemmechayevim bistam beemet amru bet hakkisse uvet habburseki uvet hammerchatz uvet hattevila veshehannashim neotot bahen umay neotot rochatzot peturin min hammezuza

I hachi hayenu merchatz ashmeinan merchatz derabbim veashmeinan merchatz deyachid desalka datach amena merchatz derabbim dinfish zuhameh aval merchatz deyachid dela nefish zuhameh ema lichayyav bimzuza ka mashma lan

Verav yehuda metaretz letameh hachi katane betecha betcha hamuchad lach perat levet hatteven uvet habbakar uvet haetzim uvet haotzarot sheppeturin min hammezuza afilu mitkashshetot veyesh mechayevin bemitkashshetot aval setam divre hakkol patur beemet amru bet hakkisse uvet habburseki uvet hammerchatz uvet hattevila af al pi shehannashim mitkashshetot bahen peturin min hammezuza mishshum dinfish zuhameh

Ulrav yehuda setama divre hakkol patur vehatanya bisharecha echad shaare vattim veechad shaare chatzerot veechad shaare medinot veechad shaare ayarot verefet velulin umatben veotzrot yayin veotzrot shemen chayyavin bimzuza yachol sheani merabbe af
b: Bet shaar achsadra umirpeset talmud lomar bayit ma bayit meuchad ledira yatzu ellu sheen meuchadin ledira
Yachol sheani merabbe af bet hakkisse uvet habburseki uvet hammerchatz uvet hattevila talmud lomar bayit ma bayit heasuy lechavod af kol heasuy lechavod yatzu ellu sheen asuyin lechavod
Yachol sheani merabbe af har habbayit vehalleshachot vehaazarot talmud lomar bayit ma bayit shehu chol af kol shehu chol yatzu ellu shehen kodesh teuvta

Tane rav shemuel bar yehuda kammeh derava shishsha shearim peturin min hammezuza bet hatteven uvet habbakar uvet haetzim uvet haotzarot veshaar hammadi veshaar sheeno mekore veshaar sheeno gavoha asara amar leh patchatte beshishsha vesalkatte beshiva

Amar leh shaar hammadi tannae hi detanya kipa rabbi meir mechayyev bimzuza vachachamim potrim veshavin sheim yesh beraglah asara shechayyevet bimzuza amar abbaye dechulle alma gevoha asara veen beraglah shelosha velav kelum hi i name yesh beraglah shelosha veenah gevoha asara velav kelum hi
Lo nechleku ella bigvoha asara veyesh beraglah shelosha veen berochbah arbaa veyesh bah lachok lehashlimah learbaa rabbi meir savar chokkin lehashlim verabbanan savri en chokkin lehashlim
Tanu rabbanan bet hakkeneset uvet haishsha uvet hashshuttafin chayyevet bimzuza peshita mahu detema betecha velo betah betecha velo battehem kamashma lan
Veema hachi name amar kera lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem hane bau chayye vehane la bau chayye
Ella betecha lema li kidrava deamar rava derech biatcha vechi akar inish kareh deyammina akar beresha
Tanya idach bet hakkeneset uvet hashshuttafin uvet haishsha mittammein bingaim peshita mahu detema uva asher lo habbayit lo velo lah lo velo lahen ka mashma lan

Veema hachi name amar kera bevet eretz achuzzatchem ella lo lema li mi shemmeyached beto lo sheeno rotze lehashil kelav veomer sheen lo hakkadosh baruch hu mefarsemo keshemmefanne et beto perat lemashil kelav laacherim
Uvet hakkeneset mi mittamme bingaim vehatanya yachol yihu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot mittammein bingaim talmud lomar uva asher lo habbayit mi shemuchad lo yatzu ellu sheen meuchadin lo
La kashya ha rabbi meir ha rabbanan detanya bet hakkeneset sheyyesh bah bet dira lechazzan hakkeneset chayyav bimzuza vesheen bah bet dira rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrin
Veibaet ema ha veha rabbanan vela kashya ha deit bah bet dira ha delet bah bet dira
Vei baet ema ha veha delet bah bet dira

a: Veha dichrakkim veha dichfarim

Vedichrakkim en mittamme bingaim vehatanya achuzzatchem achuzzatchem mittammea bingaim veen yerushalayim mittammea bingaim amar rabbi yehuda ani lo shamati ella mekom mikdash bilvad ha batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot mittammein bingaim veaf al gav dichrachim ninhu ema amar rabbi yehuda ani lo shamati ella mekom mekuddash bilvad
Bemay ka mipalgi tanna kamma savar yerushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim verabbi yehuda savar yerushalayim nitchalleka lishvatim

Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya me haya bechelko shel yehuda har habbayit halleshachot vehaazarot ume haya bechelko shel binyamin ulam vehechal uvet kodshe hakkodashim urtzua hayeta yotza mechelko shel yehuda venichneset lechelko shel binyamin uvah haya mizbeach banuy uvinyamin hatztzaddik haya mitztaer aleha levolah bechol yom
Shenneemar chofef alav kol hayyom lefichach zacha binyamin hatztzaddik venaasa ushpizchan ligvura shenneemar uven ketefav shachen

Vehay tanna savar yerushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim detanya en maskirin battim birushalayim lefi sheenah shellahen rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer af lo mittot lefichach orot kadashim baale ushpizchanin notlin otan bizroa amar abbaye shema minah orach ara lemishbak inish gulpa umashka leushpizeh

Vedichfarim mi mittamme bingaim vehatanya laachuzza ad sheyyichbeshu otah kavshu otah velo chillekuha lishvatim chilleku lishvatim velo chilleku levet avot chilleku levet avot veen kol echad makkir et shello minnayin
Talmud lomar uva asher lo habbayit mi shemuchad lo yatza ellu sheen meuchadin lo ella mechavarta kidshannin meikara
Umatkinin lo kohen acher peshita era bo pesul kodem tamid shel shachar mechannechin oto betamid shel shachar ella era bo pesul achar tamid shel shachar bamme mechannechin oto
Amar rav adda bar ahava beavnet hanicha leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol ze hu avneto shel kohen hedot ella leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol lo zehu avneto shel kohen hedot may ika lememar
Amar abbaye lovesh shemona umhappech betzinora vechidrav huna deamar rav huna zar shehippech betzinora chayyav mita verav pappa amar
b: Avodato mechannachto mi la tanya kol hakkelim sheasa moshe meshichatan mekaddashtan mikkan veelach avodatan mechannachtan hacha name avodato mechannachto
Ki ata rav dimi amar avneto shel kohen hedot rabbi verabbi elazar berabbi shimon chad amar shel kilayim vechad amar shel butz

Tistayyem derabbi hu deamar shel kilayim detanya en ben kohen gadol lechohen hedot ella avnet divre rabbi rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer af lo avnet emat i nema bishar yemot hashshana tuva ika kohen gadol meshammesh bishmona vehedot bearbaa
Ella lav beom hakkippurim
Amri la leolam bishar yemot hashshana uvhanach deshavin

Ki ata ravin amar avneto shel kohen gadol beom hakkippurim divre hakkol shel butz bishar yemot hashshana divre hakkol shel kilayim lo nechleku ella beavneto shel kohen hedot ben bishar yemot hashshana ben beom hakkippurim sherabbi omer shel kilayim verabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer shel butz
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak af anan name tenena al besaro ma talmud lomar yilbash lehavi mitznefet veavnet laharamat haddeshen divre rabbi yehuda

Rabbi dosa omer lehavi bigde kohen gadol beom hakkippurim shehen kesherin lechohen hedot rabbi omer shette teshuvot baddavar chada deavneto shel kohen gadol beom hakkipurim lo ze hu avneto shel kohen hedot
Veod begadim shennishtammashta bahen kedushsha chamura teshammesh bahen kedushsha kalla ella ma talmud lomar yilbash lerabbot et hashshechakin
Veazda rabbi dosa letameh detanya vehinnicham sham melammed shetteunin geniza rabbi dosa omer shello yishtammesh bahen yom hakkippurim acher
Tanu rabbanan era bo pesul uminu acher tachtav rishon chozer laavodato sheni kol mitzot kehunna gedola alav divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yose omer rishon chozer laavodato sheni eno rauy lo lechohen gadol velo lechohen hedot

Amar rabbi yose maase beosef ben illem betzipori sheera bo pesul bechohen gadol uminuhu tachtav veamru chachamim rishon chozer laavodato sheni eno rauy lo lechohen gadol velo lechohen hedot kohen gadol mishshum eva kohen hedot mishshum maalin bakkodesh velo moridin
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan

a: Halacha kerabbi yose umode rabbi yose sheim avar veavad avodato keshera amar rav yehuda amar rav halacha kerabbi yose umode rabbi yose sheim met rishon shechozer laavodato
Peshita mahu detema haveya leh tzara mechayyim ka mashma lan
Rabbi yehuda omer af ishsha acheret matkinin lo verabbanan name ha chayeshi leshemma amri lach rabbanan tuma shechicha mita la shechicha

Amru lo im ken en laddavar sof shappir ka amri leh lerabbi yehuda verabbi yehuda amar lach lemita dachada chayeshinan lemita detarte la chayeshinan verabbanan i ika lemechash afilu lemita ditren chayeshinan
Verabbanan nemru inhu lenafshayehu amri lach rabbanan kohen gadol zariz hu i zariz hu lamma matkinin kohen acher kevan deavdinan leh tzara kol shekken demizdaraz tefe

Umi saggi leh betakkanta beto amar rachamana vehach lav beto hi dimkaddesh lah veha kamma dela kanes lah lav beto hi dechanes lah im ken have leh shene vattim verachamana amar vechipper baado uvad beto velo bead shene vattim
Dahadar megaresh lah i megaresh lah hadra kushyan leduchta la tzericha dimgaresh lah al tenay deamar lah hare ze gitech al menat shettamuti vedilma la mayeta vehave leh shene vattim
Ella deamar lah hare ze gitech al menat shello tamuti i la mayeta migarsha lah vei mayeta ha kayema hach vedilma hi la mayeta vehave leh gita dehay gita umayeta chavertah vekam leh belo bayit
Ella deamar lah al menat shettamut achat mikkem mayeta ha kayema hach mayeta hach ha kayema ha vedilma la mayeta vela chada minayehu vehave leh shene vattim
Veod ki hay gavena mi have gita vehaamar rava hare ze gitech al menat shello tishti yayin kol yeme chayyay vechayyayechi en ze keritut
Kol yeme chayyay peloni hare ze keritut
Ella deamar lah hare ze gitech al menat shello tamut chavertich i la mayeta chavertah migarsha vei mayeta ha ha kayema ha vedilma mayeta chavertah befalga daavoda veigallay milleta
b: Lemafrea degita deha lav gita hu veaved leh avoda bishne vattim ella deamar lah hare ze gitech al menat shettamut chavertich vedilma mayeta chavertah vehave leh gita deha gita vekam leh belo bayit

Ella dimgaresh lehu letarvayehu lachada amar lah hare ze gitech al menat shello tamut chavertich velachada amar lah hare ze gitech al menat shello tikkansi levet hakkeneset vedilma la mayeta chavertah vela ayela hi levet hakkeneset vehave leh gita detarvayehu gita vekam leh belo bayit

Ella lachada amar lah hare ze gitech al menat shello tamut chavertich velachada amar lah hare ze gitech al menat sheekkanes ani levet hakkeneset dei mayeta ha kayema ha vei mayeta ha kayema ha may ika lememar dilma mayeta chavertah befalga daavoda veaved leh avoda lemafrea bishne vattim i chaze lah deka baaya lememat kadem ihu veayel levet hakkeneset umshave legita deha gita lemafrea
Matkef lah rav assi veitema rav avira ella meatta shette yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad lo yityabmu yevimto yevimto riba
Matkef lah ravina veitema rav sherevya ella meatta arusa lo tityabem hachutza lerabbot et haarusa
Tanu rabbanan kohen gadol makriv onen veeno ochel rabbi yehuda omer kol hayyom may kol hayyom amar rava lo nitzrecha ella lahavio mittoch beto

Amar leh abbaye hashta lerabbi yehuda appoke mappekinan leh detanya haya omed umakriv al gabbe hammizbeach veshama shemmet lo met manniach avodato veotze divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer yigmor veatte amratte mayetinan leh mittoch beto
Ella amar rava may kol hayyom

a: Lomar sheeno oved kol hayyom gezera shemma yochal amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava umi gazar rabbi yehuda shemma yochal vehatnan rabbi yehuda omer af ishsha acheret matkinin lo shemma tamut ishto vei mayeta ishto aved avoda vela gazar rabbi yehuda shemma yochal amar leh hachi hashta hatam kevan deom hakkippurim hu dechulle alma la ka achli hu name la ate lemechal hacha dechulle alma achli hu name ate lemechal
Vechi hay gavena mi chayela aleh aninut veha migarsha nehi daaninut la chayela aleh itterode mi la mitrid

Matni kol shivat hayyamim hu zorek et haddam umaktir et hakketoret umetiv et hannerot umakriv et harosh veet haregel ushar kol hayyamim im ratza lehakriv makriv shekkohen gadol makriv chelek barosh venotel chelek barosh
Gema man tanna amar rav chisda dela kerabbi akiva dei rabbi akiva ha amar tahor shennafla alav hazzaa timmeattu hechi aved avoda
Detanya vehizza hattahor al hattame al hattame tahor veal hattahor tame divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim en haddevarim hallalu amurin ella bidvarim hamkabbelim tuma
May hi keditnan nitkaven lehazzot al habbehema vehizza al haadam im yesh baezov yishne nitkaven lehazzot al haadam vehizza al habbehema im yesh baezov lo yishne

May tama derabbi akiva nichtov rachamana vehizza hattahor alav may al hattame shema minah al hattame tahor veal hattahor tame verabbanan hay lidvarim hammekabbelin tuma hu daata aval hacha kal vachomer hu im al hattame tahor al hattahor lo kol shekken
Verabbi akiva hayenu dekaamar shelomo amarti echkama vehi rechoka mimmenni verabbanan hahu lammazze velammazzin alav tahor venogea bahen tame
Umazze tahor vehachtiv umazze me hannidda yechabbes begadav may mazze nogea vehachtiv mazze veha ketiv nogea veod mazze bae kibus begadim nogea la bae kibbus begadim
Ella may mazze nose venichtov rachamana nose may tama ketiv mazze ha ka mashma lan devaenan shiur hazzaa

Hanicha leman deamar hazzaa tzericha shiur ella leman deamar hazzaa en tzericha shiur may ika lememar afilu leman deamar hazzaa en tzericha shiur hane mile aggabba degavra aval bemana tzericha shiur ditnan kamma yehe bahen vihe kede hazzaa kede sheyyitbol
b: Rashe givolin veyazze abbaye amar afilu tema rabbi akiva deaved avoda kulleh yoma ulfanya maddu aleh vetavel veaved heerev hashshemesh
Umaktir et hakketoret umetiv et hannerot alma ketoret beresha vahadar nerot urminhu mi shezzacha bedishun mizbeach happenimi umi shezzacha bammenora umi shezzacha bakketoret
Amar rav huna man tana tamid rabbi shimon ish hammitzpa hu veha ipcha shaminan leh ditnan ba lo lekeren mizrachit tzefonit noten mizracha tzafona maaravit deromit noten maarava daroma
Vetane alah rabbi shimon ish hammitzpa meshanne battamid mizrachit tzefonit noten mizracha tzafona maaravit deromit noten maarava veachar kach noten daroma
Ella amar rabbi yochanan man tena seder yoma rabbi shimon ish hammitzpa hu

Urmi seder yoma asseder yoma ditnan payis hashsheni mi shochet mi zorek mi medashshen mizbeach happenimi umi medashshen et hamnora umi maale evarim lakkevesh payis hashshelishi chadashim lakketoret bou vehafisu
Amar abbaye la kashya kan bahatavat shette nerot kan bahatavat chamesh nerot

Lememra deviktoret mafsek lehu veha abbaye mesadder maaracha mishshemeh digmara bedam hattamid mafsek lehu amri la kashya hahi leabba shaul ha lerabbanan detanya lo yetiv et hannerot veachar kach yaktir ella yaktir veachar kach yetiv abba shaul omer metiv veachar kach maktir
May tama deabba shaul dichtiv babboker babboker behetivo et hannerot vahadar yaktirenna verabbanan may kaamar rachamana

a: Beidan hatava tehe mikketar ketoret dei la tema hachi ben haarbayim dichtiv uvhaalot aharon et hannerot ben haarbayim yaktirenna hachi name divresha madlik nerot vahadar maktir ketoret shel ben haarbayim vechi tema hachi name vehatanya meerev ad boker

Ten lah middatah shettehe doleket veholechet kol hallayela meerev vead boker davar acher meerev ad boker en lecha avoda shekkeshera meerev ad boker ella zo bilvad ella may kaamar rachamana beidan hadlaka tehe mikketar ketoret hacha name beidan hatava tehe mikketar ketoret
Veabba shaul amar lach shane hatam dichtiv oto
Rav pappa amar la kashya ha rabbanan ha abba shaul bemay okemta lematnitin dehacha kerabbanan payis keabba shaul

Ema sefa heviu lo et hattamid keratzo umerak acher shechita al yado nichnas lehaktir et hakketoret ulhetiv et hannerot atan lerabbanan resha vesefa rabbanan umtziata abba shaul amar lecha rav pappa in resha vesefa rabbanan umtziata abba shaul

Bishlama abbaye la amar kerav pappa resha vesefa rabbanan umtziata abba shaul la mokem lah ella rav pappa may tama la amar keabbayye amar lach tena beresha hatavat shette nerot vahadar hatavat chamesh nerot
Veabbaye amar lach oroye bealma hu deka more vesidra ha hadar tane leh

Gufa ba lo lekeren mizrachit tzefonit noten mizrachit tzefonit maaravit deromit noten maaravit deromit vetane alah rabbi shimon ish hammitzpa meshanne battamid ba lo lekeren mizrachit tzefonit noten mizrachit tzefonit maaravit deromit noten maarava veachar kach noten daroma may tama derabbi shimon ish hammitzpa
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum chad deve rabbi yannay amar kera usir izzim echad lechattat la al olat hattamid yease venisko ola hi veamar rachamana aved bah maase chattat
Ha ketzad noten achat shehi shettayim kemaase ola shettayim shehen shettayim kemaase chattat veliten shettayim shehen arba kemaase ola vearba shehen arba kemaase chattat
Lo matzinu damim shemmechapperin vechozrin umchapperin vechi matzinu damim shechetzyan chattat vechetzyan ola ella al korchan hakkishan hakkatuv hacha name beal korchan hakkishan hakkatuv
Hatam pisuk mattanot bealma hi venitev achat shehi shettayim lematta kemaase ola shettayim shehen shettayim lemala kemaase chattat
Lo matzinu damim shechetzyan lemala vechetzyan lematta vela vehatnan hizza mimmennu achat lemala vesheva lematta
Kematzlif may kematzlif machve rav yehuda kimnaggedana
Vela vehatnan hizza mimmennu al tohoro shel mizbeach sheva peamim may lav appalgeh demizbeach kidamri inashe tehar tihara hu palga deoma

Urminhu arba leshachot hau levet hammoked kekittoniyyot happetuchot latteraklin shettayim bakkodesh ushtayim bachol verashe pesefasin mavdilin ben kodesh lachol uma hau meshammeshot maaravit deromit hi hayeta lishkat tele korban

a: Deromit mizrachit hi lishka shehau osin bah lechem happanim mizrachit tzefonit bah ganzu bet chashmonay avne mizbeach sheshshikketzum malche goyim tzefonit maaravit bah yordin levet hattevila amar rav huna man tana middot rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi

Ditnan ezrat nashim hayeta orech mea ushloshim vechamesh al rochav mea ushloshim vechamesh vearba leshachot hau bearba miktzooteha ume hau meshammeshot deromit mizrachit hi hayeta lishkat hannezirim sheshsham nezirim mevashshelim et shalmehen umgallechin searan umshallechin tachat haddud mizrachit tzefonit hi hayeta lishkat dir haetzim sheshsham kohanim baale mumin omdin umatliin beetzim shekkol etz sheyyesh bo tolaat pasul legabbe mizbeach

Tzefonit maaravit hi hayeta lishkat hamtzorain maaravit deromit amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov shachachti me hayeta meshammeshet abba shaul omer bah hau notnin yayin vashemen vehi hayeta nikret lishkat bet shemanayya

Hachi name mistabbera derabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi ditnan kol hakketalim shehau sham hau gevohin chutz mikkotel mizrachi shehakkohen hassoref et happara omed behar hammishcha umchaven veroe keneged pitcho shel hechal bishat hazzaat haddam

Utnan kol happetachim shehau sham govhan esrim amma verochban eser ammot utnan lifnim mimmennu soreg utnan lifnim mimmennu hachel eser ammot ushtem esre maalot hau sham rum maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma

Chamesh esre maalot olot mittochah hayyordot meezrat yisrael leezrat nashim rum maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma utnan ben haulam velammizbeach esrim ushtayim amma ushtem esre maalot hau sham rum maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma
Utnan rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer maala hayeta sham ugvoha amma veduchan natun aleha uvo shalosh maalot shel chatzi chatzi amma
I amratte bishlama rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi hayenu deikassi leh pitcha
Ella i amratte rabbanan ha ika palga deammeta demitchaze leh pitcha begaveyh
Ella lav shema minah rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi rav adda bar ahava amar ha manni rabbi yehuda hi detanya rabbi yehuda omer hammizbeach memutztza veomed beemtza azara ushloshim ushtayim ammot hau lo
b: Eser ammot keneged pitcho shel hechal achat esre amma latztzafon veachat esre amma laddarom nimtza mizbeach mechuuon keneged hechal uchtalav

Vei salka datach middot rabbi yehuda hi mizbeach beemtza azara mi mashkachatte leh vehatnan kol haazara hayeta orech mea ushmonim vasheva al rochav mea ushloshim vechamesh min hammizrach lammaarav mea ushmonim vasheva mekom derisat ragle yisrael achat esre amma mekom derisat ragle hakkohanim achat esre amma mizbeach sheloshim ushtayim ben haulam velammizbeach esrim ushtayim vehahechal mea amma veachat esre amma achore bet hakkapporet

Min haddarom latztzafon mea ushloshim vechamesh hakkevesh vehammizbeach shishshim ushtayim min hammizbeach velattabbaot shemone ammot mekom hattabbaot esrim vearba min hattabbaot lashshulchanot arba min hashshulchanot lannannasin arba min hannannasin lechotel azara shemone ammot vehammotar ben hakkevesh velakkotel umkom hannannasin
Vei salka datach middot rabbi yehuda hi mizbeach beemtza azara mi mashkachatte leh ha rubba demizbeach bedarom kae

a: Ella lav shema minah rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi shema minah
Rav adda bereh derav yitzchak amar hay lishka aktzoye maktzeya udate mitztzafon mitchazya leh bedarom udate middarom mitchazya leh betzafon
Umistabbera divmaaravit deromit havay mimmay midderamenan lechem happanim allechem happanim
Umshannenan amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua mar ka chashev derech yamin umar ka chashev derech semol
b: I amratte bishlama bemaaravit deromit havay hayenu dimtaretz lechem happanim allechem happanim ella i amratte tzefonit maaravit havay sof sof may terutza delechem happanim ella lav shema minah bemaaravit deromit havay shema minah
Vehaamar mar kol pinot sheatta pone lo yihu ella derech yamin lammizrach hane mile baavoda aval hacha chushbana bealma hu
Shekkohen gadol makriv chelek barosh venotel chelek barosh tanu rabbanan ketzad makriv chelek barosh omer ola zo ani makriv mincha zo ani makriv

Ketzad notel chelek barosh omer chattat zo ani ochel asham ze ani ochel venotel challa mishte challot arba o chamesh mimmaase lechem happanim rabbi omer leolam chamesh shenneemar vehayeta leaharon ulvanav mechetza leaharon umechetza levanav

Ha gufah kashya amratte notel challa achat mishte challot manni rabbi hi deamar palga shakel ema metziata arba o chamesh mimmaase lechem happanim atan lerabbanan deamri la shakel palga ema sefa rabbi omer leolam chamesh resha vesefa rabbi umtziata rabbanan
Amar abbaye resha umtziata rabbanan umodu rabbanan bifrusa delav orach ara lemitvah lechohen gadol

a: Umay arba o chamesh lerabbanan deamri nichnas notel shesh veotze notel shesh uschar haggafat delatot la mishtem esre bae miflag batztzer chada mippalga chamesh shakel
Lerabbi yehuda deamar nichnas notel sheva shettayim bischar haggafat delatot veotze notel chamesh meeser bae miflag batztzer chada mippalga veshakel arba
Rava amar kullah rabbi hi vesavar lah kerabbi yehuda veella may arba ha chamesh bae lemishkal
La kashya ha deika mishmar hammitakkev ha deleka mishmar hammitakkev
I ika mishmar hammitakkev mishshemone bae lemiflag veshakel arba i leka mishmar hammitakkev meeser bae lemiflag veshakel chamesh
I hachi may rabbi omer leolam chamesh kashya

Matni masru lo zekenim mizzikne bet din vekorin lefanav beseder hayyom veomrim lo ishi kohen gadol kera atta befich shemma shachachta o shemma lo lamadta erev yom kippurim shacharit maamidin oto beshaar mizrach umaavirin lefanav parim veelim uchvasim kede sheyehe makkir veragil baavoda kol shivat hayyamim lo hau monin mimmennu maachal umishte erev yom hakkippurim im chashecha lo hau mannichin oto leechol harbe mippene shehammaachal mevi et hashshena
Gema bishlama shemma shachach lechayye ella shemma lo lamad mi mokminan ki hay gavena

Vehatanya vehakkohen haggadol meechav sheyehe gadol meechav bechoach benoy bechachma uvosher acherim omrim minnayin sheim en lo sheechav hakkohanim megaddelin oto talmud lomar vehakkohen haggadol meechav gaddelehu mishshel echav
Amar rav yosef la kashya kan bemikdash rishon kan bemikdash sheni deamar rav assi tarkabba dedinare ayyila leh marta bat bayetos leyannay malka al deokmeh lihoshua ben gamla bechahane ravreve
Erev yom hakkippurim shacharit vechu tana af hasseirim vetanna didan may tama la tena seirim kevan deal chet ka atu chalsha dateh
I hachi par name al chet hu deate par kevan dealav veal echav hakkohanim hu deate beechav hakkohanim i ika inish deit beh milta mida yada leh umahdar leh bitshuva bechullehu yisrael la yada
Amar ravina hayenu deamri inashe i bar achatach dayyala have chazi beshuka kammeh la tachlef
Kol shivat hayyamim la hau monin vechu tanya rabbi yehuda ben nakosa omer maachilin oto selatot uvetzim kede lemasmeso amru lo kol shekken sheatta mevio lide chimum

Tanya somchos amar mishshum rabbi meir en maachilin oto lo veamri lah lo veyesh omrim af lo yayin lavan lo lo etrog velo betzim velo yayin yashan veamri lah lo lo etrog velo betzim velo basar shamen velo yayin yashan veyesh omrim af lo yayin lavan mippene shehayyayin lavan mevi et haadam lide tuma

Tanu rabbanan zav tolin lo bemaachal vechol mine maachal elazar ben pinchas omer mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betera en maachilin oto lo velo velo kol devarim hammeviin lide tuma lo lo chalav velo gevina velo betza velo yayin velo me gerisin shel pol uvasar shamen umuryas
Velo kol devarim hammeviin lide tuma leetoye may leetoye ha detanu rabbanan chamishsha devarim meviim et haadam lide tuma veellu hen hashshum
b: Vehashshachalayim vachaloglogot vehabbetzim vehaggargir vayyetze echad el hassade lelakket orot tana mishshemeh derabbi meir ze gargir amar rabbi yochanan lamma nikra sheman orot shemmeirot et haenayim amar rav huna hammotze gargir im yachol leochlo ochlo veim lav maaviro al gabbe enav amar rav pappa begargira matzrana

Amar rav gidel amar rav achsenay lo yochal betzim velo yishan betallito shel baal habbayit rav ki mikkela ledarshish machrez man haveya leoma rav nachman kad mikkela leshachnetziv machrez man haveya leoma

Vehattanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer lo yissa adam ishsha bimdina zo veyelech veyissa ishsha bimdina acheret shemma yizdavvegu ze etzel ze venimtza ach nose achoto veav nose bitto ummalle kal haolam kullo mamzerut veal ze neemar umala haaretz zimma amri rabbanan kala it lehu
Vehaamar rava tevauha lehinnase venitpayesa tzericha leshev shiva nekiyyim rabbanan odoe hao modu lehu mikdam hao kadmi umshadderi shelucha
Vei baet ema yachode hao meyachadi lehu lefi sheeno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo lemi sheen lo pat besallo

Matni mesaruhu zikne vet din lezikne chehunna veheeluhu bet avtinas vehishbiuhu venifteru vehalchu lahem veamru lo ishi kohen gadol anu sheluche bet din veatta sheluchenu ushliach bet din mashbiin anu alecha bemi sheshshikken shemo babbayit hazze shello teshanne davar mikkol ma sheamarnu lach hu poresh uvoche vehen porshin uvochin

Im hu haya chacham doresh veim lav talmide chachamim dorshim lefanav veim ragil likrot kore veim lav korin lefanav uvamme korin lefanav beiyyov uvezra uvdivre hayyamim zecharya ben kevutal omer peamim harbe kariti lefanav bedaniyyel

a: Gema tana lelammedo chafina amar rav pappa shette leshachot hau lo lechohen gadol achat lishkat parhedrin veachat lishkat bet avtinas achat batztzafon veachat baddarom achat batztzafon ditnan shesh leshachot hau baazara shalosh batztzafon veshalosh baddarom

Shebbaddarom lishkat hammelach lishkat happarva lishkat hammedichin lishkat hammelach sheshsham hau notnin melach lakkorban lishkat happarva sheshsham hau molchin orot kadashim veal gaggah hayeta bet tevila lechohen gadol beom hakkippurim lishkat hammedichin sham hau medichin kirve kadashim umishsham mesiba ole legag bet happarva

Shalosh shebbatztzafon lishkat haetz lishkat haggola lishkat haggazit lishkat haetz amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov shachachti me hayeta meshammeshet abba shaul omer lishkat kohen gadol hayeta achore shettehen vegag sheloshtan shave

Lishkat haggola sham haya bor haggola vehaggalgal natun alav umishsham maspikin mayim lechol haazara lishkat haggazit sham hayeta sanhedrin shel yisrael yoshevet vedana et hakkohanim umi shennimtza bo pesul haya lovesh shechorim umitattef shechorim veyatza vehalach lo veshello nimtza bo pesul haya lovesh levanim umitattef levanim venichnas umshammesh im echav hakkohanim

Achat baddarom ditnan shiva shearim hau baazara shalosh batztzafon veshalosh baddarom veechad bammizrach shebbaddarom shaar hadlaka sheni lo shaar hakkarban shelishi lo shaar hammayim shebbammizrach shaar nikkanor ushte leshachot hau sham achat bimino veachat bismolo achat lishkat pinchas hammalbish veachat lishkat ose chavitin

Shebbatztzafon shaar nitzotz binyan achsadra haya vaaliyya benuya lo al gabbav vesham kohanim shomrim milmala ulviyyim millematta veshellifnim hemennu hachel sheni lo shaar hakkarban shelishi lo shaar bet hammoked
Vetanya chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel kohen gadol umkaddesh bo bayyom vechullan bakkodesh al gag bet happarva chutz mizzo shehayeta bachol al gabbe shaar hammayim uvtzad lishkato hayeta
Vela yadana i lishkat parhedrin batztzafon velishkat bet avtinas baddarom o lishkat bet avtinas batztzafon velishkat parhedrin baddarom umistabbera delishkat parhedrin baddarom havay
May tama makdem kae umesech et raglav vetavel veazel latztzafon vegamar chafina veate levet hammikdash veaved avoda kulle yoma levahade panya maddu aleh vahadar azel laddarom vetavel venayach

Dei amratte lishkat parhedrin batztzafon makdem kae umesech raglav veazel laddarom vetavel vegamar chafina veate levet hammikdash veaved avoda kulleh yoma lahade panya maddu aleh vahadar azel laddarom vetavel uvae mehdar umezal latztzafon umenach umi tarach matrechinan leh kulle hay
Allema la matrechinan leh tefe dei tzadduki hu lifrosh
I name shello tazuach dato alav dei la tema hachi nabedinhu letarvayehu bahade hadade i name tisge leh bachada
Veamru lo ishi kohen gadol vechu lema tihve teuvta derav huna bereh derav yehoshua deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hane kahane sheluche derachamana ninhu dei amratte sheluche didan ninhu
b: Mi ika mide daanan la matzenan lemebad ushluche didan matzu avdi hachi kaamri leh mashbiin anu alecha al datenu veal daat bet din
Hu poresh uvoche vehen porshin uvochin vechu hu poresh uvoche shechashaduhu tzadduki vehem porshin uvochin deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol hachoshed bichsherim loke begufo
Vechol kach lamma shello yetakken mibbachutz veyachnis kederech shehatztzaddukin osin

Tanu rabbanan maase betzadduki echad shehitkin mibbachutz vehichnis bitziato haya sameach simcha gedola paga bo aviv amar lo beni af al pi shetztzaddukin anu mityarin anu min happerushim amar lo kol yamay hayiti mitztaer al hammikra hazze ki beanan erae al hakkapporet amarti matay yavo leyadi vaakayemennu achshav shebba leyadi lo akayemennu

Amru lo hau yamim muatin ad shemmet vehutal baashpa vehau tolain yotzin mechotmo veyesh omrim bitziato nigaf detane rabbi chiyya kemin kol nishma baazara shebba malach vachavato al panav venichnesu echav hakkohanim umatzu kechaf regel egel ben ketefav shenneemar veraglehem regel yeshara vechaf raglehem kechaf regel egel
Amar rabbi zecharya ben kevutal vechu matne leh rav chanan bar rava lechiyya bar rav kammeh derav amar rabbi zecharya ben kefutal umachve leh rav bideh kevutal venema leh memar keriat shema hava kare

Vechi hay gavena mi shere veha amar rabbi yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta hakkore et shema lo yirmoz beenav velo yikrotz besiftotav velo yore beetzbeotav vetanya rabbi elazar chassama omer hakkore et shema umrammez beenav umkaretz besiftotav umare beetzbao alav hakkatuv omer velo oti karata yaakov
La kashya ha beferek rishon ha beferek sheni
Tanu rabbanan vedibbarta bam bam velo bitfilla vedibbarta bam bam yesh lecha reshut ledabber velo bidvarim acherim

Rabbi acha omer vedibbarta bam ase otan keva veal taasem aray amar rava hassach sichat chullin over baase shenneemar vedibbarta bam bam velo bidvarim acherim rav acha bar yaakov amar over belav shenneemar kol haddevarim yegeim lo yuchal ish ledabber
Matni bikkesh lehitnamnem pirche chehunna makkin lefanav beetzba tzerada veomrim lo ishi kohen gadol amod vehafeg achat al haritzpa umaasikin oto ad sheyyaggia zeman hashshechita
Gema may tzerada amar rav yehuda tzaratah deda may hi gudal machve rav huna veazel kala bechulle be rav
Veomrim lo ishi kohen gadol hafeg achat al haritzpa vechu amar rav yitzchak al chadat may hi amri leh achvi kida
Umaasikin oto ad sheyyaggia zeman shechita vechu tana lo hau maasikin oto lo benevel velo bechinnor ella bappe uma hau omrin im Adonai lo yivne vayit shave amlu vonav bo

Miyyakkire yerushalayim lo hau yeshenin kol hallayela kede sheyyishma kohen gadol kol havara velo tehe shena chotafto tanya abba shaul amar af bigvulin hau osin ken zecher lammikdash ella shehau chotin

Amar abbaye veitema rav nachman bar yitzchak targuma nehardea daamar leh eliyyahu lerav yehuda achuh derav salla chasida amritu ammay la ate mashiach veha haidana yoma dechipure hu veibbeul kamma betulata binhardea amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu may amar amar leh

a: Lappetach chattat rovetz vesatan may amar amar leh satan beoma dechipure let leh reshuta leastone mimmay amar rame bar chama hassatan begimatriyya telat mea veshitin vearbea have telat mea veshitin vearbea yome it leh reshuta leastone beoma dechipure let leh reshuta leastone

Matni bechol yom tormin et hammizbeach bikriat haggever o samuch lo ben lefanav ben leacharav uvom hakkippurim mechatzot uvargalim meashmura harishona velo hayeta keriat haggever maggaat ad shehayeta azara melea miyyisrael
Gema tenan hatam evarim sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach kodem chatzot yachzir umoalin bahen leachar chatzot lo yachzir veen moalin bahen
Mena hane mile amar rav katuv echad omer kol hallayela vehiktir vechatuv echad omer kol hallayela veherim ha ketzad challekehu chetzo lehaktara vechetzo laharama
Metiv rav kahana bechol yom tormin et hammizbeach bikriat haggever o samuch lo ben millefanav ben milleacharav uvom hakkippurim mechatzot uvargalim meashmura harishona
b: Vei salka datach mechatzot deorayeta hi hechi makdeminan vehechi meacharinan
Ella amar rabbi yochanan mimmashma shenneemar kol hallayela eni yodea shehu ad habboker uma talmud lomar ad habboker ten boker levokro shel layela

Hilkach bechol yom tormin et hammizbeach bikriat haggever o samuch lo ben millefanav ben milleacharav saggi beom hakkippurim deika chulsha dechohen gadol avdinan mechatzot uvirgalim dinfishi yisrael unfishi korbanot avdinan meashmoret harishona kidkatane tama lo hayeta keriat haggever maggaat ad shehayeta azara melea miyyisrael
May keriat haggever rav amar kera gavra rabbi shela amar kera tarnegola

Rav ikla leatreh derabbi shela la hava amora lemekam aleh derabbi shela kam rav aleh veka mefaresh may keriat haggever kera gavra amar leh rabbi shela velema mar kera tarnegola amar leh abbuv lechare zamar legardae la mekabbeluh mineh

Ki hava kaemna aleh derabbi chiyya umfareshna may keriat haggever kera gavra vela amar li vela mide veatte amratte li ema kera tarnegola amar leh mar nihu rav ninach mar amar leh amri inashe itgarte leh putz amreh ika deamri hachi amar leh maalin bakkodesh velo moridin
Tanya kevateh derav tanya kevateh derabbi shela tanya kevateh derav gevini karoz mahu omer imdu kohanim laavodatchem ulviyyim leduchanchem veyisrael lemaamadchem vehaya kolo nishma beshalosh parsaot

Maase beagripas hammelech shehaya ba badderech veshama kolo beshalosh parsaot uchshebba leveto shiger lo mattanot veaf al pi chen kohen gadol meshubbach mimmennu deamar mar uchvar amar ana hashshem venishma kolo biricho veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mirushalayim liricho asar parse
Veaf al gav dehacha ika chulsha vehacha leka chulsha vehacha yemama vehatam lelya

Deamar rabbi levi mippene ma en kolo shel adam nishma bayyom kederech shennishma ballayela mippene galgal chamma shemmenasser barakia kecharash hamnasser baarazim vehay chirga deoma la shemeh vehayenu dekaamar nevuchadnetztzar vechol dayere ara kela chashivin

Tanu rabbanan ilmale galgal chamma nishma kol hamonah shel romi veilmale kol hamonah shel romi nishma kol galgal chamma tanu rabbanan shalosh kolot holchin missof haolam vead sofo veellu hen kol galgal chamma vekol hamonah shel romi vekol neshama beshaa sheyyotza min hagguf veyesh omrim af leda

a: Veyesh omrim af ridya uvo rabbanan rachame anneshama beshaa sheyyotza min hagguf uvatteluh
Tanya keoteh derabbi shela hayyotze ladderech kodem keriat haggever damo berosho rabbi yoshiyya omer ad sheyyishne veyesh omrim ad sheyeshallesh uveze tarnegol amru betarnegol benoni

Amar rav yehuda amar rav beshaa sheyyisrael olin laregel omdin tzefufin umishtachavim reochim venimshachin achat esre amma achore bet hakkapporet may kaamar hachi kaamar af al pi shennimshachin achat esre amma achore bet hakkapporet veomdim tzefufin keshehen mishtachavin mishtachavin reochim veze echad measara nissim shennaasu bammikdash

Ditnan asara nissim naasu bevet hammikdash lo hippila ishsha mereach besar hakkodesh velo hisriach besar hakkodesh meolam velo nira zevuv bevet hammitbachayim velo era keri lechohen gadol beom hakkippurim velo nimtza pesul baomer uvishte hallechem uvlechem happanim omdim tzefufim umishtachavim reochim velo hizzik nachash veakrav birushalayim meolam velo amar adam lachavero tzar li hammakom shealin birushalayim

Patach bemikdash vesiyyem birushalayim ika tarte achranyata bemikdash detanya meolam lo kibbu geshamim esh shel atze hammaaracha vaashan hammaaracha afilu kol haruchot shebbaolam baot umnashshevot bo en mezizot oto mimmekomo
Vetu leka vehatanya rav shemaya bekalnevo shivre kele cheres nivlain bimkoman veamar abbaye mura venotza vedishun mizbeach happenimi vedishun hammenora nivlain bimkoman

Pesule telata hau chashvinhu bechad appek tere veayyel tere i hachi beluin name tere hau chashshevinhu bechad chasru lehu ika name achariti deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi nes gadol haya naasa belechem happanim silluko kesidduro shenneemar lasum lechem chom beom hillakcho
Vetu leka vehaamar rabbi levi davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu mekom aron eno min hammidda veamar ravnay amar shemuel keruvim benes hau omdin

Nise devaray ka chashev nise degavay la ka chashev i hachi lechem happanim name nise degavay hu lechem happanim nise devaray hu deamar resh lakish may dichtiv al hashshulchan hattahor tahor mikkelal shehu tame
b: Keli etz heasuy lenachat hu vechol keli etz heasuy lenachat eno mekabbel tuma vechotzetz bifne tuma ella melammed shemmagbihin oto leole regalim veomrim lahem reu chibatchem lifne hammakom shessiluko kesidduro shenneemar lasum lechem chom beom hillakcho

Vetu leka vehaamar rav oshaya beshaa shebbana shelomo bet hammikdash nata bo kol mine megadim shel zahav vehau motziin perotehen bizmannan uchsheharuach menashshevet bahen noshrin shenneemar yirash kallevanon piro uchshennichnesu goyim lahechal yavash shenneemar uferach levanon umlal veatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziran shenneemar paroach tifrach vetagel af gilat verannen kevod hallevanon nittan lah
Nise dikvii la ka chashev hashta deatet lehachi aron uchruvim name nise dikvii ninhu

Amar mar vaashan hammaaracha umi hava ashan bemaaracha vehatanya chamishsha devarim neemru baesh shel maaracha revutza kaari uvara kachamma veyesh bah mammash veochelet lachin kiveshin veenah maala ashan
Ki ka amrinan bidhedot detanya venatnu bene aharon hakkohen esh al hammizbeach af al pi sheesh yoredet min hashshamayim mitzva lehavi min hahedot
Revutza kaari vehattanya amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim ani reitiha urvutza kechelev la kashya kan bemikdash rishon kan bemikdash sheni

Uvmikdash sheni mi havay vehaamar rav shemuel bar inya may dichtiv veertze bo veekkaved vekarenan veekkavda may shena dimchussar he ellu chamishsha devarim shehau ben mikdash rishon lemikdash sheni veellu hen aron vechapporet uchruvim esh ushchina veruach hakkodesh veurim vetummim amri in mi-Adonai hava sayyoe la mesayea
Tanu rabbanan shesh ishshot hen yesh ochelet veenah shota veyesh shota veenah ochelet veyesh ochelet veshota veyesh ochelet lachin kiveshin veyesh esh docha esh veyesh esh ochelet esh

Yesh esh ochelet veenah shota ha didan shota veenah ochelet decholin ochelet veshota deeliyyahu dichtiv veet hammayim asher batteala lichecha ochelet lachin kiveshin demaaracha yesh esh docha esh degavriel veyesh esh ochelet esh dishchina deamar mar hoshit etzbao benehem usrafan

Vaashan hammaaracha afilu kol haruchot shebbaolam en mezizot oto mimmekomo vehaamar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi bemotzae yom tov haacharon shel chag hakkol tzofin laashan hammaaracha note kelappe tzafon aniyyim semechin uvaale vattim atzevin mippene sheggishme shana merubbin uferotehen markivin nata kelappe darom aniyyim atzevin uvaale vattim semechin mippene sheggishme shana muatin uferotehen mishtammerin
Nata kelappe mizrach hakkol semechin kelappe maarav hakkol atzevin deazel veate kedikle veibbaddore la hava mibaddar

Amar mar kelappe mizrach hakkol semechin kelappe maarav hakkol atzevin urminhu mizrachit leolam yafa maaravit leolam kasha ruach tzefonit yafa lachittin beshaa sheheviu shelish vekasha lazzetim bizman shehen chontin ruach deromit kasha lachittin beshaa sheheviu shelish veyafa lazzetim bizman shehen chontin
Veamar rav yosef veitema mar zutra vesimanach shulchan batztzafon umnora baddarom hay merabbe dideh vehay merabbe dideh
La kashya ha lan veha lehu
Hadaran alach shivat yamim

a: Barishona kol mi sherotze litrom et hammizbeach torem uvizman shehen merubbin ratzin veolin bakkevesh kol hakkodem et chavero bearba ammot zacha veim hau shenehen shavin hammunne omer lahen hatzbiu
Uma hen motziin achat o shettayim veen motziin agudal bammikdash

Maase shehau shenehem shavin veratzin veolin bakkevesh vedachaf echad mehen et chavero venafal venishbera raglo vechevan sherau bet din shebbain lide sakkana hitkinu shello yehu tormin et hammizbeach ella befayis arba peyasot hau sham veze happayis harishon
Gema veha meikara may tama la takkinu lah rabbanan payesa meikara sevur kevan daavodat layela hi la chashiva lehu vela atu kevan dechazu dekaatu veatu lide sakkana takkinu lah payesa
Vahare evarim ufdarim daavodat layela hi vetakkinu lah rabbanan payesa sof avoda dimama hi
Hay name techillat avoda dimama hi deamar rabbi yochanan kidesh yadav litrumat haddeshen lemachar en tzarich lekaddesh shekkevar kidesh mittechilat avoda
Ema shekkevar kidesh mittechila laavoda

Ika deamri meikara sevur kevan deika ones shena la atu kevan dachazo deatu vekaatu name lide sakkana takkinu lah rabbanan payesa vahare evarim ufdarim deika ones shena vetakkinu lah rabbanan payesa shane migne mimmekam
Vetakkanta lehach gisa havay takkanta lehay gisa havay detanya mi shezzacha bitrumat haddeshen yizke besidur maaracha uvishne geziri etzim

Amar rav ashe shette takkanot hao meikara sevur la atu kevan dachazu dekaatu veatu name lide sakkana takkinu lah payesa kevan detakkinu lah payesa la ato amri mi yemar demitreme lan hadar takkinu lehu mi shezzacha bitrumat haddeshen yizke besidur maaracha uvishne gezire etzim ki hechi deneto venifayeso
Uvizman shehen merubbin vechu amar rav pappa peshita li arba ammot deara la ratzin veolin bakkevesh tenan kammayata name la ratzin veolin bakkevesh tenan vahadar kol hakkodem et chavero
Devene bene name la dela mesayema milta peshita li degabbe mizbeach tenan
Bae rav pappa arba ammot sheamru bahade amma yesod veamma sovev
b: O dilma bar meamma yesod veamma sovev teku

Veim hau shenehen shavin hammemunne omer lahem hatzbiu vechu tana hotziu etzbeotechem leminyan venimninhu ledidhu mesayya leh lerabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak asur limnot et yisrael afilu lidvar mitzva dichtiv vayyifkedem bevezek
Matkef lah rav ashe mimmay dehay bezek lishana demivzak hu vedilma shema demata hu kedichtiv vayyimtzeu adoni vezek ella mehacha vayeshamma shaul et haam vayyifkedem battelaim

Amar rabbi elazar kol hammone et yisrael over belav shenneemar vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam asher lo yimmad rav nachman bar yitzchak amar over bishne lavin shenneemar lo yimmad velo yissafer
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani rabbi yonatan rame ketiv vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam uchtiv asher lo yimmad velo yissafer
La kashya kan bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom kan bizman sheen osin retzono shel makom rabbi amar mishshum abba yose ben dostay la kashya kan bide adam kan bide shamayim

Amar rav nehilay bar idi amar shemuel kevan shennitmanna adam parnas al hatztzibur mitashsher meikara ketiv vayyifkedem bevezek ulvassof ketiv vayyifkedem battelaim vedilma middidhu im ken may revuta demilta

Vayyarev bannachal amar rabbi mani al iske nachal beshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu leshaul lech vehikkita et amalek amar uma nefesh achat amra tora have egla arufa kol hannefashot hallalu al achat kamma vechamma

Veim adam chata behema me chata veim gedolim chatu ketannim me chatu yatza bat kol veamra lo al tehi tzaddik harbe uvshaa sheamar lo shaul ledoeg sov atta ufga bakkohanim yatza bat kol veamra lo al tirsha harbe

Amar rav huna kamma la chale vela margesh gavra demareh sayeeh shaul beachat vealta lo david bishtayim velo alta lo shaul beachat may hi maase daagag veha ika maase denov ir hakkohanim ammaase daagag ketiv nichamti ki himlachti et shaul lemelech
David bishtayim may ninhu deuriyya vedahasata
Veha ika name maase devat sheva hatam ipperau mineh dichtiv veet hakkivsa yeshallem arbatayim yeled amnon tamar veavshalom
Hatam name ipperau mineh dichtiv vayyitten Adonai dever baam min habboker vead et moed hatam la ipperau miggufeh

Hatam name la ipperau miggufeh laye ipperau miggufeh deamar rav yehuda amar rav shishsha chodashim nitztara david ufarshu hemennu sanhedrin venistalleka hemennu shechina dichtiv yashuvu li yereecha veode edotecha uchtiv hashiva li seson yishecha
Veha amar rav kibbel david lashon hara kishmuel deamar lo kibbel david lashon hara

Ulrav name deamar kibbel david lashon hara ha iprau mineh deamar rav yehuda amar rav beshaa sheamar lo david limfivoshet amarti atta vetziva tachleku et hassade yatza bat kol veamra lo rechavam veyarovam yachleku et hammalchut
Ben shana shaul bemolcho amar rav huna keven shana shello taam taam chet

Matkef lah rav nachman bar yitzchak veema keven shana shemmeluchlach betit uvtzoa achviu leh lerav nachman siyyuta bechelmeh amar naaneti lachem atzmot shaul ben kish hadar chaza siyyuta bechelmeh amar naaneti lachem atzmot shaul ben kish melech yisrael

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mippene ma lo nimshecha malchut bet shaul mippene shello haya bo shum dofi deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak en maamidin parnas al hatztzibur ella im ken kuppa shel sheratzim teluya lo meachorav sheim tazuach dato alav omrin lo chazor laachorecha

Amar rav yehuda amar rav mippene ma neenash shaul mippene shemmachal al kevodo shenneemar uvne veliyyaal amru ma yoshienu ze vayyivzuhu velo heviu lo mincha vayehi kemacharish uchtiv vayyaal nachash haammoni vayyichan al yavesh gilad vego
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak kol talmid chacham

a: Sheeno nokem venoter kenachash eno talmid chacham vehachtiv lo tikkom velo tittor hahu bemamon hu dichtiv detanya ezo hi nekima veezo hi netira nekima amar lo hashileni maggalcha amar lo lav lemachar amar lo hu hashileni kardummecha amar lo eni mashilcha kederech shello hishaltani zo hi nekima
Veezo hi netira amar lo hashileni kardummecha amar lo lo lemachar amar lo hashileni chalukcha amar lo helach eni kemotcha shello hishaltani zo hi netira
Vetzaara degufa la veha tanya hanneelavin veenan olvin shomin cherpatan veenan meshivin osin meahava usmechin beyissurin alehen hakkatuv omer veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato
Leolam denaket leh belibeh vehaamar rava kol hammaavir al middotav maavirin lo al kol peshaav dimfayesu leh umippayyas
Uma hen motziin achat o shettayim vechu hashta shettayim motziin achat mibbaya

Amar rav chisda la kashya kan bevari kan bechole vehatanya achat motziin shettayim en motziin bamme devarim amurim bevari aval bechole afilu shettayim motziin vehayechidin motziin shettayim veen monin lahen ella achat
Veen monin lo ella achat vehatanya en motziin lo shalish velo gudal mippene harammaim veim hotzi shalish monin lo gudal en monin lo velo od ella shelloke min hammunne bappekia
May monin lo name achat
May pekia amar rav madra may madra amar rav pappa matreka detayyae difsik resheh

Amar abbaye meresh hava amena ha ditnan ben bevay memunne al happekia amena petilata keditnan mibbelae michnese hakkohanim umehemyanehen mehen hau mafkiin uvahen hau madlikin kevan dishmana leha detanya velo od ella shelloke min hammunne bappekia amena may pekia nagda

Maase shehau shenehen shavin veratzin veolin bakkevesh tanu rabbanan maase bishne chohanim shehau shenehen shavin veratzin veolin bakkevesh kadam echad mehen letoch arba ammot shel chavero natal sakkin vetaka lo belibbo

Amad rabbi tzadok al maalot haulam veamar achinu bet yisrael shimu hare hu omer ki yimmatze chalal baadama veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha anu al mi lehavi egla arufa al hair o al haazarot gau kol haam bivchiyya

Ba aviv shel tinok umtzao keshehu mefarper amar hare hu kapparatchem vaadayin beni mefarper velo nitmea sakkin lelammedcha shekkasha alehem tohorat kelim yoter mishshefichut damim vechen hu omer vegam dam naki shafach menashshe harbe meod ad asher mille et yerushalam pe lafe
Hay maase kadem ilema dishfichut damim hashta ashshefichut damim la takkinu payesa annishbera raglo takkinu ella denishbera raglo kadem
Vechevan detakkinu payesa arba ammot may avidtayehu ella leolam dishfichut damim kadem umeikara sevur akray bealma hu kevan dachazo afilu mimmela atu lide sakkana takkinu rabbanan payesa

Amad rabbi tzadok al maalot haulam veamar achenu bet yisrael shimu hare hu omer ki yimmatze chalal baadama anan al mi lehavi al hair o al haazarot virushalayim bat etoye egla arufa hi vehatanya asara devarim neemru birushalayim vezo achat mehen
b: Enah mevia egla arufa veod lo noda mi hikkahu ketiv veha noda mi hikkahu ella kede leharbot bivchiyya

Ba aviv shel tinok umtzao keshehu mefarper amar hare hu kapparatchem vaadayin beni kayyam ku lelammedcha shekkasha alehem tohorat kelim yoter mishshefichut damim ibaya lehu shefichut damim hu dezal aval tohorat kelim kidkayema kayema o dilma shefichut damim kidkayema kayema aval tohorat kelim hi dachamira
Ta shema middeka nasev lah talmuda vegam dam naki shafach menashshe shema minah shefichut damim hu dezal vetaharat kelim kidkayema kayema
Tanu rabbanan ufashat velavash begadim acherim vehotzi et haddeshen shomani kederech yom hakkippurim shepposhet bigde kodesh velovesh bigde chol
Talmud lomar ufashat et begadav velavash begadim acherim makkish begadim shellovesh livgadim shepposhet ma lehallan bigde kodesh af kan bigde kodesh
Im ken ma talmud lomar acherim pechutin mehen rabbi eliezer omer acherim vehotzi limed al hakkohanim baale mumin shekkesherin lehotzi haddeshen
Amar mar acherim pechutin mehen kidtana deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael begadim shebbishshel bahen kedera lerabbo lo yimzog bahen kos lerabbo
Amar resh lakish kemachloket behotzaa kach machloket baharama verabbi yochanan amar machloket behotzaa aval baharama divre hakkol avoda hi
May tama deresh lakish amar lach i salka datach avoda hi yesh lecha avoda shekkeshera bishne chelim
Verabbi yochanan galli rachamana bechuttonet umichnasayim vehu haddin lemitznefet veavnet
Umay shena hane middo bad middo kemiddato michnese vad lechidtanya minnayin shello yehe davar kodem lammichnasayim shenneemar umichnese vad yilbash al besaro
Veresh lakish middo kemiddato middeappekeh rachamana bilshon middo shello yehe davar kodem lammichnasayim meal besaro nafka
Nema ketannae al besaro ma talmud lomar yilbash lehavi mitznefet veavnet laharama divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi dosa omer lerabbot bigde kohen gadol beom hakkippurim shekkesherin lechohen hedot

Amar rabbi shette teshuvot bedavar chada deavneto shel kohen gadol lo ze hu avneto shel kohen hedot veod begadim shennishtammashta bahen kedushsha chamura tishtammesh bahen kedushsha kalla ella ma talmud lomar yilbash

a: Lerabbot et hashshechakim
Vehinnicham sham melammed shetteunin geniza rabbi dosa omer reuyin hen lechohen hedot uma talmud lomar vehinnicham sham shello yishtammesh bahen yom hakkippurim acher
May lav beha ka mipalgi demar savar avoda hi umar savar lav avoda hi
La dechulle alma avoda hi vehacha beha ka mipalgi mar savar tzericha kera lerabboye umar savar la tzericha kera lerabboye

Bae rabbi avin terumat haddeshen bechamma mitterumat maaser yalfinan lah o mitterumat midyan yalfinan lah ta shema detane rabbi chiyya neemar kan veherim veneemar lehallan veherim ma lehallan bekumtzo af kan bekumtzo
Amar rav arba avodot zar chayyav alehen mita zerika vehaktara venisuch hammayim venisuch hayyayin velevi amar af terumat haddeshen vechen tane levi bematniteh af terumat haddeshen

May tama derav dichtiv veatta uvanecha ittecha tishmeru et kehunnatchem lechol devar hammizbeach ulmibbet lapparochet vaavadtem avodat mattana etten et kehunnatchem vehazzar hakkarev yumat avodat mattana velo avodat siluk vaavadtem avoda tamma velo avoda sheyyesh achareha avoda
Velevi rabbi rachamana lechol devar hammizbeach verav hahu leetoye sheva hazzaot shebbifnim veshebbimtzora
Velevi nafka leh middevar vechol devar verav devar vechol devar la daresh
Veema lechol devar hammizbeach kalal avodat mattana parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat avodat mattana in avodat siluk la amar kera
b: Ulmibbet lapparochet vaavadtem el mibbet lapparochet hu daavodat mattana velo avodat siluk ha bachutz afilu avodat siluk
I hachi vaavadtem name el mibbet lapparochet hu daavoda tamma velo avoda sheyyesh achareha avoda ha bachutz afilu avoda sheyyesh achareha avoda
Vaavadtem hadar arveh kera
Bae rava avodat siluk bahechal mahu lifnim medammenan leh o lechutz medammenan leh
Hadar pashtah mibbet ulmibbet
Ella meatta zar shessider et hashshulchan lichayyav ika sidur bazichin sider bazichin lichayyav ika siluk vehaktara
Zar shessider et hamnora lichayyav ika netinat petila natan petila lichayyav ika netinat shemen
Natan shemen lichayyav ika hadlaka hidlik lichayyav hadlaka lav avoda hi

Vela vehatanya venatnu bene aharon hakkohen esh al hammizbeach vearchu etzim al haesh limed al hatztzatat alita shello tehe ella bechohen kasher uvichli sharet hatztzatat alita avoda hi hadlaka lav avoda hi
Ella meatta zar shessider et hammaaracha lichayyav ika sidur shene gezire etzim sider shene gezirin lichayyav ika sidur evarim
Veha amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan zar shessider shene gezire etzim chayyav beha peligi mar savar avoda tamma hi umar savar lav avoda tamma hi

Tanya keoteh derav tanya keoteh delevi tanya keoteh derav avodot shezzar chayyav alehem mita zerikat dam ben lefanim ben lifnay velifnim vehammazze bechattat haof vehammatztze vehammaktir beolat haof vehamnassech shelosha luggin mayim ushlosha luggin yayin
Tanya keoteh delevi avodot shezzar chayyav alehen mita hammerim et haddeshen vesheva hazzaot shebbifnim veshebbimtzora vehammaale al gabbe hammizbeach ben davar kasher ben davar pasul
Lamma mefayesin lamma mefayesin kedaamaran ella lamma mefayesin vechozrin umfayesin
Amar rabbi yochanan kede lehargish kol haazara shenneemar asher yachdav namtik sod bevet elohim nehallech beragesh
Bamme mefayesin rav nachman amar bevigde chol verav sheshet amar bevigde kodesh
Rav nachman amar bevigde chol dei amratte bevigde kodesh ika baale zeroot dechamsi veavdi rav sheshet amar bevigde kodesh dei amratte bevigde chol aggav chabbivuteh mikru veavdi
Amar rav nachman mena amena lah ditnan mesarun lachazzanin vehau mafshitin otan et bigdehen velo hau mannichin alehen ella michnasayim bilvad

a: May lav beotan shezzachu lappayis amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet la beotan shello zachu lappayis

Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach beotan shezzachu lappayis lo hau mannichin alehen ella michnasayim bilvad vehatanya minnayin shello yehe davar kodem lammichnasayim talmud lomar umichnese vad yihu al besaro
Veidach ha la kashya hachi katane ad sheodan alehen bigde chol malbishin otan michnese kodesh vehau mafshitin otan bigde chol velo hau mannichin ella michnasayim bilvad

Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah detanya lishkat haggazit kemin basilke gedola hayeta payis bemizrachah vezaken yoshev bemaaravah vehakkohanim mukkafin veomdin kemin bekkulyar vehammunne ba venotel mitznefet merosho shel echad mehen veodin shemmimmennu payis matchil vei salka datach bevigde chol mitznefet bevigde chol mi ika
In kidtane rav yehuda veitema rav shemuel bar yehuda kohen sheasta lo immo ketonet oved bah avodat yachid

Amar abbaye shema minah lishkat haggazit chetzyah bakkodesh vechetzyah bachol ushma minah shene fetachim hau lah echad patuach bakkodesh veechad patuach bachol dei salka datach kullah bakkodesh zaken yoshev bemaaravah vehaamar mar en yeshiva baazara ella lemalche vet david bilvad
