Vei salka datach kullah bachol payis bemizrachah veha baenan bevet elohim nehallech beragesh veleka ella shema minah chetzyah bakkodesh vechetzyah bachol

Vei salka datach petach echad yesh lah ufatuach lakkodesh zaken yoshev bemaaravah vehatnan halleshachot habbenuot bachol uftuchot lakkodesh tochan kodesh vei salka datach patuach lachol payis bemizrachah vehatnan benuot bakkodesh uftuchot lachol tochan chol ella lav shema minah shene fetachim hau lah echad patuach bakkodesh veechad patuach lachol
Matni happayis hashsheni mi shochet mi zorek mi medashshen mizbeach happenimi umi medashshen et hammenora umi maale evarim lakkevesh
Harosh veharegel ushte hayyadayim haoketz veharegel vehechaze vehaggera ushte haddefanot vehakkeravayim vehassolet vehachavitin vehayyayin shelosha asar kohanim zachu bo
Amar ben azzay lifne rabbi akiva mishshum rabbi yehoshua derech hillucho haya karev

Gema ibaya lehu keshehen mefayesin laavoda achat mefayesin o dilma lechol avoda vaavoda hen mefayesin ta shema arba peyasot hau sham vei salka datach lechol avoda hen mefayesin tuva hao amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hachi kaamar arba peamim nichnasin lehafis ulchol chada vachada hau bah tuva peyasot
b: Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer lo haya payis lammachta ella kohen shezzacha biktoret omer laze sheimmo zeche immi bammachta
Shane machta uktoret dachada avoda hi
Ika deamri daveka machta uktoret dachada avoda hi aval shear avodot bae payis
Machta itztericha leh salka datach amena hoil vela shechicha umattera natken lah payis bifne atzmah ka mashma lan
Ta shema detane rabbi chiyya lo lechol avoda vaavoda mefayesin ella kohen shezzacha betamid shenem asar echav hakkohanim nimshachin immo shema minah
Payis hashsheni vechu ibaya lehu mi mekabbel shochet mekabbel dei amratte zorek mekabbel aggav chabbivuteh la mekabbel leh lechulleh dam
O dilma zorek mekabbel dei amratte shochet mekabbel zimnin deshachet zar
Ta shema ben katin asa shenem asar dad lakkiyyor kede sheyyihu shenem asar echav hakkohanim haasukin battamid mekaddeshin yedehen veraglehen bevat achat
Vei salka datach shochet mekabbel telesar have ella lav shema minah zorek mekabbel shema minah
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe af anan name tenena shachat hashshochet vekibbel hamkabbel uva lo lizrok shema minah

Amar ben azzay lifne rabbi akiva vechu tanu rabbanan ketzad derech hillucho harosh veharegel hechaze vehaggera ushte yadayim ushte defanot haoketz veharegel rabbi yose omer derech hefsheto haya karev ketzad derech hefsheto harosh veharegel haoketz veharegel ushte defanot ushte hayyadayim hechaze vehaggera

Rabbi akiva omer derech nitucho haya karev ketzad derech nitucho harosh veharegel ushte yadayim hechaze vehaggera ushte defanot vehaoketz veharegel rabbi yose haggelili omer derech iluo haya karev ketzad derech iluo harosh veharegel hechaze vehaggera ushte haddefanot vehaoketz veharegel ushte hayyadayim
Vehachtiv kol netach tov yarech vechatef hahi bichchusha
Amar rava ben tanna didan uven rabbi yose batar iluya devisra azlinan mar azel batar ivra devisra umar azel batar shumna devisra
May tama salka regel bahade resha mishshum deresha nefishi beh atzamot karva regel bahadeh
Dechulle alma mihat rosh karev beresha mena lan detanya minnayin lerosh ufeder shekkodmin lechol haevarim talmud lomar et rosho veet pidro vearach veidach pader acharina

a: Lemay ata lechidtanya ketzad haya ose noten et happeder abbet hashshechita umaalehu veze hu derech kavod shel mala
Matni happayis hashshelishi chadashim liktoret bou vehafisu veharvii chadashim im yeshanim mi maale evarim min hakkevesh lammizbeach
Gema tana meolam lo shana adam bah may tama amar rabbi chanina mippene shemmaasheret
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye may tama ilema mishshum dichtiv yasimu ketora beappecha uchtiv batreh barech Adonai chelo i hachi ola name hachtiv vechalil al mizbechecha
Amar leh ha shechicha veha la shechicha

Amar rava la mashkachatte tzurba merabbanan demore ella deate mishshevet levi o mishshevet yissashchar levi dichtiv yoru mishpatecha leyaakov yissashchar dichtiv uvne yissashchar yode vina laittim ladaat ma yaase yisrael veema yehuda name dichtiv yehuda mechokki assoke shemata alliba dehilcheta kaamena

Amar rabbi yochanan en mefayesin al tamid shel ben haarbayim ella kohen shezzacha bo beshacharit zoche bo arvit metivi keshem shemmefayesin shacharit kach mefayesin ben haarbayim ki tanya hahi biktoret
Vehatanya keshem shemmefayesin lo shacharit kach mefayesin lo arvit ema lah
Vehatanya keshem shemmefayesin lo shacharit kach mefayesin lo arvit uchshem shemmefayesin lah shacharit kach mefayesin lah arvit
Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak hacha beshabbat askinan hoil umishmarot mitchaddeshot
Ulmay dislek addatin meikara nefishi lehu peyasot mayete kullehu mitztzafra atu dezache beh shacharit zache dezache bearvit zache
Harvii chadashim im yeshanim vechu matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov ditnan rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer hammaale evarim lakkevesh hu maale otan lammizbeach
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar berov am hadrat melech umar savar mekom shechina lav orach ara
Amar rava la rabbi eliezer ben yaakov it leh derabbi yehuda vela rabbi yehuda it leh derabbi eliezer ben yaakov deim ken batzru lehu peyasot
Vei mashkachatte tanna detane chamesh
b: Hahu dela kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov udla kerabbi yehuda
Matni tamid karev betisha baasara beachad asar bishnem asar lo pachot velo yoter ketzad atzmo betisha bechag beyad echad tzelochit shel mayim hare kan asara

Ben haarbayim beachad asar hu atzmo betisha ushnayim beyadam shene gezire etzim bashshabbat beachad asar hu atzmo betisha ushnayim beyadam shene beziche levona shel lechem happanim uvshabbat shebbetoch hachag beyad echad tzelochit shel mayim

Gema amar rabbi abba veitema rame bar chama veitema rabbi yochanan en menassechin mayim bechag ella betamid shel shachar mimmay middekatane uvshabbat shebbetoch hechag beyad echad tzelochit shel mayim vei salka datach betamid shel ben haarbayim menassechin bachol name mashkachatte lah
Amar rav ashe af anan name tenena velamnassech omer lo hagbah yadecha sheppaam achat nissech al gabbe raglav urgamuhu kol haam beetrogehen shema minah

Tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer minnayin letamid shel ben haarbayim shettaun shene gezire etzim bishne chohanim shenneemar vearchu etzim im eno inyan letamid shel shachar dichtiv uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker babboker vearach aleha tenehu inyan letamid shel ben haarbayim
Veema ide veide betamid shel shachar veamar rachamana aved vahadar aved im ken nema kera uvier uvier
I ketav rachamana uvier hava amena chad in tere la ka mashma lan denabed chad venabed tere
Im ken nema kera uvier uviaru i name vearach vearchu may uvier vearchu shema minah kidka amrinan
Tane rabbi chiyya payis peamim shelosha asar peamim arbaa asar peamim chamishsha asar peamim shishsha asar
Vehatanya shiva asar
Hahi dela kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov ella kerabbi yehuda

Matni ayil karev beachad asar habbasar bachamishsha hakkeravayim vehassolet vehayyayin bishnayim shenayim par karev beesrim vearbaa harosh veharegel harosh beechad veharegel bishnayim haoketz veharegel haoketz bishnayim veharegel bishnayim hechaze vehaggera hechaze beechad vehaggera bishlosha shette yadayim bishnayim ushte defanot bishnayim hakkeravayim vehassolet vehayyayin bishlosha shelosha
Bamme devarim amurim bekorbenot tzibur aval bekorban yachid im ratza lehakriv makriv hefshetan venituchan shel ellu veellu shavin
Gema tana hefshetan venituchan shavin bezar
Amar chizkiyya minnayin lehefshet venituach sheshshave bezar shenneemar venatnu bene aharon hakkohen esh al hammizbeach netinat esh baaya kehunna hefshet venituach la baaya kehunna

a: Hay mibe leh legufeh amar rav shimi bar ashe ashkachteh leabbaye dahava masbar leh livreh veshachat shechita bezar keshera vechi meayin bata mikkelal shenneemar veatta uvanecha ittecha tishmeru et kehunnatchem shomea ani afilu shechita
Talmud lomar veshachat et ben habbakar lifne Adonai vehikrivu bene aharon hakkohanim et haddam mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna vesamach yado veshachat limed al hashshechita shekkeshera bezar
Mikkede mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna venatnu bene aharon lema li lemaote hefshet venituach
Veakkatti itzterich salka datach amena kevan delav avoda dimakkeva kappara hi la tive kehunna ka mashma lan devaaya kehunna
Ella mehacha vearchu bene aharon hakkohanim et hannetachim et harosh veet happader mikkede mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna vearchu lema li lemaote hefshet venituach
Veema lemaote sidur shene gezire etzim mistabbera divcha dichvateh memaet
Adderabba siddur dichvateh memaet

La salka datach deamar mar vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha zo holachat evarim lakkevesh holachat evarim lakkevesh hu devaaya kehunna holachat etzim la baaya kehunna ha sidur shene gezire etzim baaya kehunna
Vearchu lema li lemaote hefshet venituach veema hachi name legufeh
Ella vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol lemay ata lemaote hefshet venituach

Vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha zo holachat evarim lakkevesh holachat evarim lakkevesh hu devaaya kehunna holachat etzim la baaya kehunna ha siddur shene gezire etzim baaya kehunna venatnu legufeh
Vearchu shenayim bene aharon shenayim hakkohanim shenayim lamadnu letale shettaun shishsha

Amar rav hamnuna kashya leh lerabbi elazar hay beven habbakar ketiv uven habbakar esrim vearbaa bae venicha leh al haetzim asher al haesh asher al hammizbeach ezehu davar shenneemar bo etzim esh umizbeach
b: Heve omer ze tale
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan zar shessider et hammaaracha chayyav ketzad hu ose porkah vechozer vesodrah may ahani leh ella porkah zar vesodrah kohen
Matkef lah rabbi zera vechi yesh lecha avoda shekkeshera ballayela ufsula bezar
Vela vahare evarim ufdarim sof avoda dimama hi

Vahare terumat haddeshen techillat avoda dimama hi deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan kidesh yadav litrumat haddeshen lemachar eno tzarich lekaddesh shekkevar kidesh mittechillat avoda veella kashya

Ella ki itmar hachi itmar amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan zar shessider shene gezire etzim chayyav hoil vaavodat yom hi matkef lah rava ella meatta tibe payis ishtemitteh ha detanya mi shezzacha bitrumat haddeshen zacha besiddur maaracha uvsiddur shene gezire etzim
Lememra daavodat yom baaya payis avodat layela la baaya payis vahare evarim ufdarim sof avoda dimama hi vahare terumat haddeshen mishshum maase shehaya
Lememra daavodat yom veshezzar chayyav aleha mita baaya payis en zar chayyav aleha mita la baaya payis vahare shechita shane shechita ditchillat avoda hi
Amar mar zutra veitema rav ashe veha anan la tenan hachi amar lahem hammunne tzeu uru im higgia zeman hashshechita veilu zeman shene gezire etzim la katane
Hach delet lah takkanta katane hach deit lah takkanta la katane
Veika deamri matkef lah rabbi zera vechi yesh lecha avoda sheyyesh achareha avoda ufsula bezar

a: Vahare evarim ufdarim sof avoda dimama hi vahare terumat haddeshen techilat avoda dimama hi deamar rabbi yochanan kiddesh yadav litrumat haddeshen lemachar eno tzarich lekaddesh shekkevar kiddesh mittechillat avoda ella kashya
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan zar shessider shene gezire etzim chayyav hoil vaavoda tamma hi
Matkef lah rava ella meatta tive payis vela baaya payis vehatanya mi shezzacha bitrumat haddeshen yizke besidur shene gezire etzim
Hachi kaamar yefayesu lah bifne atzmah kidamrinan
Lememra daavoda tamma vezar chayyav aleha mita baaya payis en zar chayyav aleha mita la baaya payis vahare shechita shane shechita ditchilat avoda dimama hi
Lememra daavoda tamma baaya payis avoda sheyyesh achareha avoda la baaya payis vahare evarim ufdarim sof avoda dimama hi hare terumat haddeshen mishshum maase shehaya
Amar mar zutra veitema rav ashe af anan name tenena amar lahem hammunne tzeu uru im higgia zeman hashshechita veilu zeman sidur gezire etzim la katane
Hach delet lah takkanta katane hach deit lah takkanta la katane
Hadaran alach barishona

Amar lahem hammunne tzeu uru im higgia zeman hashshechita im higgia haroe omer barkay matya ben shemuel omer heir pene kol hammizrach ad shebbechevron vehu omer hen velamma hutzrechu lechach sheppaam achat ala meor hallevana vedimu sheheir mizrach veshachatu et hattamid vehotziuhu levet hasserefa
Horidu kohen gadol levet hattevila ze hakkelal haya bammikdash kal hammesech et raglav taun tevila vechol hammetil mayim taun kidush yadayim veraglayim
b: Gema tanya rabbi yishmael omer barak barkay rabbi akiva omer ala barkay nechuma ben afkashon omer af barkay bechevron matya ben shemuel omer hammunne al happeyasot omer heir pene kol hammizrach ad shebbechevron rabbi yehuda ben betera omer heir pene kol hammizrach ad bechevron veyatzu kol haam ish ish limlachto
I hachi negah leh tuva liskor poalim kaamrinan
Amar rav safra tzeloteh deavraham mikki mashchari kutle

Amar rav yosef anan meavraham nekum venigmar amar rava tena gamar meavraham vaanan la gamrinan mineh detanya uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar orlato melammed shekkol hayyom kasher lemila ella shehazzerizin makdimin lemitzot shenneemar vayyashkem avraham babboker vayyachavosh vego
Ella amar rava rav yosef ha ka kashya leh ditnan chal arve pesachim lihot beerev shabbat nishchat beshesh umechetza vekarev besheva umechetza venishchateh mikki mashchari kutle

May kushya vedilma kutle devet hammikdash beshesh umechetza mashchari mishshum dela mechavveni tuva i name shane avraham deitztagninut gedola hayeta belibbo i name mishshum dezaken veoshev bishiva hava deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina mimehen shel avotenu lo parsha yeshiva mehem

Hau bemitzrayim yeshiva immahem shenneemar lech veasafta et zikne yisrael hau bammidbar yeshiva immahem shenneemar esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael avraham avinu zaken veoshev bishiva shenneemar veavraham zaken ba bayyamim yitzchak avinu zaken veoshev bishiva haya shenneemar vayehi ki zaken yitzchak yaakov avinu zaken veoshev bishiva haya shenneemar veene yisrael kavdu mizzoken

Eliezer eved avraham zaken veoshev bishiva haya shenneemar vayyomer avraham el avdo zekan beto hammoshel bechol asher lo amar rabbi elazar shemmoshel betorat rabbo hu dammesek eliezer amar rabbi elazar sheddole umashke mittorato shel rabbo laacherim

Amar rav kiyyem avraham avinu kal hattora kullah shenneemar ekev asher shama avraham bekoli vego amar leh rav shimi bar chiyya lerav veema sheva mitzot ha ika name mila veema sheva mitzot umila amar leh im ken mitzotay vetorotay lema li
Amar rav veitema rav ashe kiyyem avraham avinu afilu eruve tavshilin shenneemar torotay achat tora shebbichtav veachat tora shebbeal pe
Matya ben shemuel omer vechu vehu omer hen man amar hen ilema hach dekae aigara hu chalem vehu mefashshar ella hach dekae aara mena yada
Ibaet ema hach dekae aara veibaet ema hach dekae aigara ibaet ema hach dekae aigara amar ihu heir pene kol hammizrach veamar leh hach dekae aara ad shebbechevron veamar leh ihu hen
Veibaet ema hach dekae aara amar ihu heir pene kol hammizrach veamar leh ad shebbechevron veamar leh hen

Velamma hutzrechu lechach vechu umi michallaf vehatanya rabbi omer eno dome timur shel levana letimur shel chamma timur shel levana mittammer veole kemakkel timur shel chamma maftzia lechan ulchan tana deve rabbi yishmael yom hamunnan haya umaftzia lechan ulchan amar rav pappa shema minah yoma deeva kulleh shimsha
Lemay nafka minah leshattoche orot i name lechiddaresh rava ishsha lo talush lo bachamma velo bechamme chamma
Amar rav nachman zuhama deshimsha keshe mishshimsha vesimanach danna dechalla shavrire deshimsha kashu mishshimsha vesimanach dilpa

a: Hirhure avera kashu meavera vesimanach recha devisra shilhe dekayeta keshe mikkayeta vesimanach tannura shegira
Ishata desitva kashya middekayeta vesimanach tannura karira migmar beattikta kashya mechadta vesimanach tina bar tina
Amar rabbi avahu may tama derabbi dichtiv lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar ma ayyala zo karneha maftzilot lechan ulchan af shachar ze maftzia lechan ulchan

Amar rabbi zera lamma nimshela ester leayyala lomar lach ma ayyala rachmah tzar vachaviva al balah kol shaa veshaa keshaa rishona af ester hayeta chaviva al achashverosh kol shaa veshaa keshaa rishona amar rabbi assi lamma nimshela ester leshachar lomar lach ma shachar sof kol hallayela af ester sof kol hannissim
Veha ika chanukka nitna lichtov ka amrinan hanicha leman deamar ester nitna lichtov ella leman deamar ester lo nitna lichtov may ika lememar

Mokem lah kerabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar deamar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar lamma nimshelu tefillatan shel tzaddikim keayyelet lomar lach ma ayyala zo kol zeman shemmagdelet karneha maftzilot af tzaddikim kol zeman shemmarbin bitfilla tefillatan nishmaat
Shachatu et hattamid emat ilema bishar yemot hashshana la saggi delav kohen gadol ella beom hakkippurim meor hallevana mi ika
Hachi kaamar uvom hakkippurim ki amar barak barkay horidu kohen gadol levet hattevila
Tane avuh derabbi avin lo zo bilvad amru ella af melikat haof ukmitzat mincha ballayela tissaref bishlama olat haof may dahava hava ella kometz
b: Nahdereh venehdar venikmetzah bimama hu tane lah vehu amar lah kele sharet mekaddeshin afilu shello bizmanno

Metivi ze hakkelal kol hakkarev bayyom kadosh bayyom vechol hakkarev ballayela kadosh ballayela vechol hakkarev ben bayyom uven ballayela kadosh ben bayyom uven ballayela katane mihat kal hakkarev bayyom kadosh bayyom bayyom in ballayela la dilma eno kadosh likrav aval kadosh lipasel
Metiv rabbi zera sider et hallechem veet habbazichin achar hashshabbat vehiktir et habbazichin bashshabbat pesula
Ketzad yaase yannichennu lashshabbat habbaa sheafilu amda al hashshulchan yamim rabbim en bechach kelum veammay tikdosh vetipsel
Amar rava man deka motev shappir ka motev vaavuh derabbi avin name matnita kaamar vekasavar layela en mechussar zeman yom mechussar zeman

Ki mate be shimshe tikdosh vetifsol amar ravina shekkadam vesilleko mar zutra veitema rav ashe amar afilu tema beshello kadam vesilleko kevan shessiddero shello kemitzvato naasa kemo shessiddero hakkof
Ze hakkelal haya bammikdash bishlama raglayim mishshum nitzotzot ella yadayim may tama amar rabbi abba zot omeret

a: Mitzva leshafshef mesayya leh lerabbi amme deamar rabbi amme asur leadam sheyyetze benitzotzot sheal gabbe raglav mippene shennire kichrut shofcha umotzi laaz al banav shehen mamzerim
Amar rav pappa tzoa bimkomah asur likrot keriat shema hechi dame i deniret peshita i delo niret lo nitna tora lemalache hashsharet la tzericha deoshev veniret omed veenah niret

Umay shena mitztzoa al besaro deitmar tzoa al besaro o shehau yadav bevet hakkisse rav huna amar muttar likrot keriat shema verav chisda amar asur likrot keriat shema bimkomah nefish zuhama shello bimkomah la nefish zuhama

Tanu rabbanan halacha bisuda adam yotze lehashtin mayim notel yado achat venichnas diber im chavero vehiflig notel shette yadav venichnas uchshehu notel lo yittol mibbachutz veyikkanes mippene chashad ella nichnas veoshev bimkomo venotel shette yadav umachazir hattafiach al haorchin
Amar rav chisda la amaran ella lishtot aval leechol notel mibbachutz venichnas demida yedia daanina dateh amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vaana afilu lishtot name mida yadi daanina datay

Matni en adam nichnas laazara laavoda afilu tahor ad sheyyitbol chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel kohen gadol umkaddesh bo bayyom vechullan bakkodesh al bet happarva chutz mizzo bilvad persu sadin shel butz beno leven haam kidesh yadav veraglav

Gema shaalu et ben zoma tevila zo lamma amar lahem uma hamshanne mikkodesh lekodesh umimmakom sheanush karet lemakom sheanush karet taun tevila hamshanne mechol lekodesh umimmakom sheen anush karet lemakom sheanush karet eno din shettaun tevila
Rabbi yehuda omer serech tevila hi zo kede sheyyizkor tuma yeshana shebbeyado veyifrosh
Bemay ka mipalgi
b: Beachole avoda ka mipalgi leven zoma machel avoda lerabbi yehuda la machel avoda

Ulven zoma mi machel vehatanya kohen gadol shello taval velo kidesh ben beged leveged uven avoda laavoda avodato keshera echad kohen gadol veechad kohen hedot shello kidesh yadav veraglav shacharit veavad avoda avodato pesula
Ella lemekam baase ka mipalgi leven zoma kae baase lerabbi yehuda la kae baase
Umi it leh lerabbi yehuda hay sevara vehatanya metzora tovel veomed beshaar nikanor rabbi yehuda omer eno tzarich tevila shekkevar taval mibbaerev
Hahu kidtane tama shekkevar taval mibbaerev
Udkaare lah may kaare lah mishshum deka bae lemirme achariti alah lishkat hamtzorain sheshsham metzorain tovlin rabbi yehuda omer lo metzorain bilvad amru ella kal adam
La kashya ha ditvel ha dela tevel i dela tevel heerev shemesh bae ella ide veide ditvel ha deassach dateh ha dela assach dateh
I assach dateh hazzaat shelishi ushvii bae deamar rabbi dostay bar matun amar rabbi yochanan hessach haddaat tzarich hazzaa shelishi ushvii
Ella ide veide dela assach dateh vela kashya ha ditvel al daat biat mikdash ha dela tevel al daat biat mikdash vei baet ema tane lo metzorain amru ella kal adam

Ravina amar rabbi yehuda ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi metzora en tzarich tevila ledidchu odo li izi mihat delo metzorain bilvad amru ella kal adam verabbanan metzora dayesh betuma kol adam la dayeshi betuma

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef nema rabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yehuda keven zoma sevira lehu vehay dekatane metzora lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehuda o dilma shane metzora dedayesh betuma amar leh shane metzora dedayesh betuma
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef lerabbi yehuda deamar serech tevila hi zo

a: Chotzetz o eno chotzetz amar leh kol detakkun rabbanan keen deorayeta takkun

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef bia bemiktzat shemah bia o la amar leh behonot yochichu shehen bia bemiktzat vetanya metzora tovel veomed beshaar nikanor ibaya lehu mahu sheyyaase sakkin arukka veyishchot
Tibe leven zoma tibe lerabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yehuda tibbee leven zoma ad kan la mechayyev ben zoma ella legavay aval levaray la o dilma ate leimshoche
Tibe lerabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yehuda ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam dela ka aved avoda aval hacha deka aved avoda la o dilma la shena teku

Chamesh tevilot vaasara kidushin tovel tanu rabbanan chamesh tevilot vaasara kidushin tovel kohen gadol umkaddesh bo bayyom vechullan bakkodesh bevet happarva chutz merishona shehayeta bachol al gabbe shaar hammayim uvtzad lishkato hayeta amar abbaye shema minah en etam gavoha mikkarka azara esrim veshalosh ammot

Ditnan kol happetachim shehau sham govhan esrim amma verochban eser ammot chutz mishshel ulam vetanya verachatz besaro bemayim beme mikve kol besaro mayim shekkol gufo ole bahen vechamma hen amma al amma berum shalosh ammot veshiaru chachamim me mikve arbaim sea
b: Veha ika amma tikra veamma maaziva shearim devet hammikdash kevan deshesha ninhu bemashshehu avdi lehu veha ika hayeche mashshehu kevan dela havay ammeta la chashev lah
Persu sadin shel butz vechu may shena shel butz kidamar rav kahana kede sheyyakkir sheavodat hayyom bevigde vutz hacha name sheyyakkir sheavodat hayyom bevigde vutz
Matni pashat yarad vetaval ala venistappag heviu lo bigde zahav velavash vekidesh yadav veraglav heviu lo et hattamid keratzo umerak acher shechita al yado kibbel et haddam uzrako

Nichnas lehaktir ketoret shel shachar ulhetiv et hannerot ulhakriv et harosh veet haevarim vehachavitin veet hayyayin ketoret shel shachar hayeta kereva ben dam leevarim shel ben haarbayim ben evarim linsachim
Im haya kohen gadol zaken o istenis mechammin lo chammin umtilin letoch hatztzonen kede shettafig tzinatan
Gema amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa ha dela kerabbi meir dei rabbi meir kevan deamar tere kidushe allevisha aved lehu hacha name lebed tere kidushe allevisha

Amar lehu rav pappa ben lerabbanan ben lerabbi meir chad appeshita devigde kodesh vechad allevisha vehacha beha ka mipalgi ufashat verachatz verachatz velavash rabbi meir savar makkish peshita lilvisha ma levisha lovesh veachar kach mekaddesh af peshita poshet veachar kach mekaddesh
Verabbanan savri makkish peshita lilvisha ma levisha keshehu lavush mekaddesh af peshita keshehu lavush mekaddesh

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav pappa umi matzet amratte hachi vehatanya persu sadin shel butz beno leven haam pashat veyarad vetaval ala venistappag heviu lo bigde zahav velavash vekidesh yadav veraglav rabbi meir omer pashat vekidesh yadav veraglav veyarad vetaval ala venistappag heviu lo bigde zahav velavash vekidesh yadav veraglav amar lehu i tanya tanya
Bishlama lerabbi meir hayenu demashkachatte lah

a: Asara kidushin ella lerabbanan tisha hao amri lach rabbanan kidusha batra ki pashet bigde kodesh velavesh bigde chol aved leh hatam
Tanu rabbanan uva aharon el ohel moed lama hu ba eno ba ella lehotzi et hakkaf veet hammachta shekkol happarasha kullah neemra al hasseder chutz mippasuk ze may tama
Amar rav chisda gemiri chamesh tevilot vaasara kidushin tovel kohen gadol umkaddesh bo bayyom vei kesidran la mashkachatte lehu ella shalosh tevilot veshishsha kidushin

Tanya amar rabbi yehuda minnayin lechamesh tevilot vaasara kidushin shettovel kohen gadol umkaddesh bo bayyom talmud lomar uva aharon el ohel moed ufashat et bigde habbad verachatz besaro vammayim bemakom kadosh velavash et begadav veyatza veasa ha lamadta shekkol hamshanne meavoda laavoda taun tevila

Amar rabbi minnayin lechamesh tevilot vaasara kidushin shettovel kohen gadol umkaddesh bo bayyom shenneemar ketonet bad kodesh yilbash umichnese vad yihu al besaro uvavnet bad yachgor uvmitznefet bad yitznof bigde kodesh hem verachatz bammayim et besaro ulvesham ha lamadta shekkol hamshanne meavoda laavoda taun tevila veomer bigde kodesh hem hukshu kol habbegadim kullan ze laze
Vechamesh avodot hen tamid shel shachar bevigde zahav avodat hayyom bevigde lavan elo veel haam bevigde zahav kaf umachta bevigde lavan tamid shel ben haarbayim bevigde zahav
Uminnayin shekkol tevila utvila tzericha shene kidushin talmud lomar ufashat verachatz verachatz velavash
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer kal vachomer uma bimkom sheen taun tevila taun kidush mekom shettaun tevila eno din shettaun kidush

I ma lehallan kidush echad af kan kidush echad talmud lomar uva aharon el ohel moed ufashat et bigde habbad asher lavash ma talmud lomar asher lavash kelum adam poshet ella ma shellavash ella lehakkish peshita lilvisha ma levisha taun kidush af peshita taun kidush

Amar rabbi yehuda minnayin lechamesh tevilot vaasara kidushin shettovel kohen gadol umkaddesh bo bayyom talmud lomar uva aharon el ohel moed verachatz et besaro vammayim bemakom kadosh ha lamadta shekkol hamshanne meavoda laavoda taun tevila ashkechan mibbigde lavan levigde zahav mibbigde zahav levigde lavan minnayin
b: Tana deve rabbi yishmael kal vachomer ma bigde zahav sheen kohen nichnas bahen lifnay velifnim taun tevila bigde lavan shennichnas bahen lifnay velifnim eno din shettaun tevila ika lemifrach ma levigde zahav shekken kapparatan merubba ella nafka leh midderabbi

Amar rabbi minnayin lechamesh tevilot vaasara kidushin shettovel kohen gadol umkaddesh bo bayyom talmud lomar ketonet bad kodesh yilbash ha lamadta shekkol hamshanne meavoda laavoda shettaun tevila ashkechan mibbigde zahav levigde lavan mibbigde lavan levigde zahav minnayin
Tana deve rabbi yishmael kal vachomer ma bigde lavan sheen kapparatan merubba teunin tevila bigde zahav shekkapparatan merubba eno din shetteunin tevila
Ika lemifrach ma levigde lavan shekken nichnas bahen lifnay velifnim hayenu dekatane veomer bigde kodesh hem verachatz et besaro bammayim ulvesham
Vechamesh avodot hen tamid shel shachar bevigde zahav avodat hayyom bevigde lavan elo veel haam bevigde zahav kaf umachta bevigde lavan tamid shel ben haarbayim bevigde zahav
Uminnayin shekkol tevila utvila tzericha shene kidushin talmud lomar ufashat verachatz verachatz velavash hay bitvila ketiv im eno inyan litvila denafka leh mibbigde kodesh hem tenehu inyan lekidush
Velichteveh rachamana bilshon kidush ha ka mashma lan ditvila kekidush ma kidush bemakom kadosh af tevila bemakom kadosh
Verabbi yehuda kidush mena leh nafka leh midderabbi elazar berabbi shimon

Amar rav chisda ha derabbi mappeka midderabbi meir umappeka midderabbanan mappeka midderabbanan deilu rabbanan amri keshehu lavush mekaddesh veihu amar keshehu poshet mekaddesh umappeka midderabbi meir deilu rabbi meir amar hach kidush batra keshehu lavush mekaddesh veihu amar keshehu poshet mekaddesh

Amar rav acha bar yaakov hakkol modin bekidush sheni shellovesh veachar kach mekaddesh may tama deamar kera o vegishtam el hammizbeach mi sheeno mechussar ella gisha yatza ze shemchussar levisha vegisha
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe la rav chisda it leh derav acha vela rav acha it leh derav chisda deim ken lerabbi hau lehu chamesar kidushin

Heviu lo et hattamid keratzo vechu may keratzo amar ulla lishana diktala hu amar rav nachman bar yitzchak may kera egla yefehfiyya mitzrayim keretz mitztzafon ba va may mashma kedimtargem rav yosef malchu yaaya havat mitzrayim ammin katolin mitztzipuna yeton alah keratzo bechamma amar ulla berov shenayim

Vechen amar rabbi yochanan berov shenayim veaf resh lakish savar berov shenayim deamar resh lakish vechi meachar sheshshaninu rubbo shel echad kamohu lamma shaninu rov echad baof verov shenayim babbehema lefi sheshshaninu heviu lo et hattamid keratzo umerak acher shechita al yado vekibel et haddam uzrako yachol lo merak yehe pasul
Yachol lo merak yehe pasul im ken haveya leh avoda beacher utnan kol avodot yom hakkippurim enan kesherot ella bo hachi kaamar yachol yehe pasul midderabbanan

a: Lechach shaninu rov echad baof verov shenayim babbehema vechi meachar daafilu pesula midderabbanan leka lema li lemarek mitzva lemarek

Abbaye mesadder maaracha mishshemeh digmara vealliba deabba shaul maaracha gedola kodemet lemaaracha sheniyya shel ketoret maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret kodemet lesidur shene gezire etzim vesidur shene gezire etzim kodem ledishun mizbeach happenimi vedishun mizbeach happenimi kodem lahatavat chamesh nerot

Vahatavat chamesh nerot kodem ledam hattamid vedam hattamid kodem lahatavat shette nerot vahatavat shette nerot kodem liktoret uktoret kodem leevarim veevarim lemincha umincha lachavitin vachavitin linsachin
Unsachin lemusafin umusafin levazichin uvazichin letamid shel ben haarbayim shenneemar vehiktir aleha chelve hashshelamim aleha hashlem kol hakkarbanot kullan

Amar mar maaracha gedola kodemet lemaaracha sheniyya shel ketoret mena lan detanya hi haola al mokda al hammizbeach kol hallayela zo maaracha gedola veesh hammizbeach tukad bo zo maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret
Veefoch ana mistabbera maaracha gedola adifa shekken kapparatah merubba
Adderabba maaracha sheniyya adifa shekken machnisin mimmenna lifnim afilu hachi kapparatah merubba adifa veibaet ema i la mashkach etzim lemaaracha sheniyya mi la meayyel mimmaaracha gedola
Maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret kodemet lesidur shene gezire etzim mena lan dichtiv uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker babboker aleha velo al chavertah mikkelal deita lachavertah
Vehay aleha mibe leh legufeh tere aleha ketivi

Sidur shene gezire etzim kodem ledishun mizbeach happenimi af al gav dehacha ketiv babboker babboker vehacha ketiv babboker babboker afilu hachi machshir adif machshir may nihu shene gezire etzim veha amratte shene gezire etzim lemaaracha gedola azli
Amar rabbi yirmeya shum etzim ravina amar hoil vehitchil bammaaracha gomer rav ashe amar i la mashkach etzim lemaaracha sheniyya mi la meayyel mimmaaracha gedola
Vedishun mizbeach happenimi kodem lahatavat chamesh nerot may tama amar abbaye gemara gemirna sevara la yadana verava amar keresh lakish deamar resh lakish en maavirin al hammitzot
b: Vechi ayel lehechal bemizbeach paga beresha detanya shulchan batztzafon mashuch min hakkotel shette ammot umechetza umnora baddarom meshucha min hakkotel shette ammot umechetza mizbeach memutztza veomed beemtza umashuch kelappe chutz kima venokmeh lahadayehu kevan dichtiv veet hammenora nochach hashshulchan baenan dechazu ahadade
Amar rava shema minah midderesh lakish abbore deraa attotefta asur hechi aved midderaa letotefta

Vahatavat chamesh nerot kodem ledam hattamid vedam hattamid kodem lahatavat shette nerot may tama amar abbaye hahu babboker babboker dishne gezire etzim dela tzerichi shedinhu lehacha chad shidyeh lahatavat chamesh nerot delikdemeh ledam hattamid vechad shidyeh ledam hattamid denikdemeh lahatavat shette nerot
Chad shidyeh lahatavat chamesh nerot delikdemeh ledam hattamid dehacha telata vehacha tere
Vechad shidyeh ledam hattamid denikdemeh lahatavat shette nerot af al gav dehacha tere vehacha tere mechapper adif

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veema chad shidyeh ledishun mizbeach happenimi denikdemeh ledam hattamid dehacha telata vehacha tere vechad shidyeh ledam hattamid denikdom lahatavat chamesh nerot deaf al gav dehacha tere vehacha tere mechapper adif im ken afsoke bemay mafsekatte lehu
Hanicha leresh lakish deamar lamma metivin vechozrim umtivin kede lehargish kol haazara kullah shappir
Ella lerabbi yochanan deamar babboker babboker challekehu lishne vekarim may ika lememar

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe hay babboker babboker deetzim mi meyatar ha mibe leh legufeh dekaamar rachamana nikdemu lemaaracha sheniyya shel ketoret amar leh velav mi okemna aleha velo al chavertah mikkelal deitah lachavertah

May shena deaved hatavat chamesh nerot beresha nebed hatavat shette nerot beresha kevan deatchel behu aved rubba venebed shet amar kera behetivo et hannerot yaktirenna veen nerot pechutot mishshettayim
Vahatavat shette nerot kodemet liktoret deamar kera behetivo et hannerot vahadar yaktirenna
Uktoret leevarim detanya yukdam davar shenneemar bo babboker babboker ledavar shello neemar bo ella boker echad bilvad
Veevarim lemincha detanya minnayin shello yehe davar kodem letamid shel shachar

a: Talmud lomar vearach aleha haola veamar rava haola hi ola rishona
Umincha lachavitin ola umincha
Vachavitin linsachim shum mincha
Unsachim lemusafin zevach unsachim umusafin levazichin vehatanya bazichin kodmin lemusafin tannae hi
Amar abbaye mistabbera keman deamar musafin kodmin levazichin lav mi amratte babboker babboker lehakdim hacha name bayyom bayyom leacher
May tama deman deamar bazichin kodmin lemusafin gamar chukka chukka mechavitin
I mehatam gamar ligmerah kullah milta mehatam lehachi ahani bayyom bayyom leacher
Ketoret shel shachar hayeta kereva ben dam leevarim vechu manni i rabbanan ben dam lenerot mibe leh i abba shaul ben nerot leevarim mibe leh
Leolam rabbanan hi uvsidra la ka mayere

Veshel ben haarbayim hayeta kereva ben evarim linsachim vechu mena hane mile amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera keminchat habboker uchnisko taase ma minchat habboker ketoret kodemet linsachim af kan ketoret kodemet linsachim
I ma lehallan ketoret kodemet leevarim af kan ketoret kodemet leevarim mi ketiv keevre habboker keminchat habboker ketiv keminchat habboker velo keevre habboker
Tanu rabbanan venisko reviit hahin yilmad shel shacharit mishshel arvit
b: Rabbi omer arvit mishshel shacharit
Bishlama lerabbanan hay betamid shel ben haarbayim ketiv ella rabbi may tama amar rabba bar ulla amar kera lakkeves haechad ezehu keves shenneemar bo echad heve omer ze tamid shel shachar
Verabbanan may echad meuchad shebbeedro verabbi mimivchar nedarecha nafka verabbanan chad bechova vechad bindava utzrichi

Im haya kohen gadol zaken o istenis vechu tanya amar rabbi yehuda ashashiyyot shel barzel hau mechammin meerev yom hakkippurim umtilin letoch tzonen kede shettafig tzinatan vahalo metzaref amar rav bivi shello higgia letzeruf abbaye amar afilu tema shehiggia letzeruf davar sheen mitkaven muttar
Umi amar abbaye hachi vehatanya besar orlato afilu bimkom sheyyesh sham baheret yakotz divre rabbi yoshiyya vehavenan bah kara lema li veamar abbaye lerabbi yehuda deamar davar sheen mitkaven asur
Hane mile bechol hattora kullah aval hacha tzeruf derabbanan hu

Matni heviuhu levet happarva uvakkodesh hayata persu sadin shel butz beno leven haam kiddesh yadav veraglav ufashat rabbi meir omer pashat kiddesh yadav veraglav yarad vetaval ala venistappag heviu lo bigde lavan lavash vekiddesh yadav veraglav

Bashshachar haya lovesh pillusin shel shenem asar mane ben haarbayim hindeviyin shel shemone meot zuz divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim bashshachar haya lovesh shel shemona asar mane uven haarbayim shel shenem asar mane hakkol sheloshim mane ellu mishshel tzibur veim ratza lehosif mosif mishshello

a: Gema may parva amar rav yosef parva amgusha
Persu sadin shel butz may shena shel butz amar rav kahana kede sheyyakkir sheavodat hayyom bevigde vutz
Bashshachar haya lovesh pillusin shel shemona asar vechu vetanna minyana ata leashmoinan ha ka mashma lan divtzir mehane la nebed ha i batzer mehane vetafe ahani let lan bah
Dechulle alma mihat deshachar adifi mena lan amar rav huna bereh derav ilae amar kera bad bad bad bad muvchar babbad
b: Metivi velavshu begadim acherim velo yekaddeshu et haam bevigdehem
May lav acherim chashuvin mehen lo acherim pechutim mehen
Tane rav huna bar yehuda veamri lah rav shemuel bar yehuda achar shekkalta avodat tzibur kohen sheasta lo immo ketonet lovshah veoved bah avodat yachid uvilvad sheyyimserenna latztzibur peshita
Mahu detema nechush shemma lo yimserenna yafe yafe ka mashma lan amru alav al rabbi yishmael ben piavi sheasta lo immo ketonet shel mea mane velovshah veoved bah avodat yachid umsarah latztzibur

Amru alav al rabbi elazar ben charsom sheasta lo immo ketonet mishte ribo velo henichuhu echav hakkohanim lelovshah mippene shennira kearom umi mitchaze vehaamar mar chutan kaful shishsha amar abbaye kechamra bemizga
Tanu rabbanan ani veashir verasha bain laddin leani omrim lo mippene ma lo asakta battora im omer ani hayiti vetarud bimzonotay omrim lo kelum ani hayita yoter mehillel

Amru alav al hillel hazzaken shebbechol yom vaom haya ose umistakker bitrappaik chetzo haya noten leshomer bet hammidrash vechetzo lefarnasato ulfarnasat anshe veto paam achat lo matza lehistakker velo hinnicho shomer bet hammidrash lehikkanes ala venitla veyashav al pi arubba kede sheyyishma divre elohim chayyim mippi shemaya veavtalon

Amru oto hayyom erev shabbat haya utkufat tevet hayeta veyarad alav sheleg min hashshamayim kesheala ammud hashshachar amar lo shemaya leavtalon avtalon achi bechol yom habbayit meir vehayyom afel shemma yom hamunnan hu hetzitzu enehen verau demut adam baarubba alu umatzu alav rum shalosh ammot sheleg perkuhu vehirchitzuhu vesachuhu vehoshivuhu keneged hammedura amru rauy ze lechallel alav et hashshabbat

Ashir omrim lo mippene ma lo asakta battora im omer ashir hayiti vetarud hayiti binchasay omrim lo kelum ashir hayita yoter merabbi elazar amru alav al rabbi elazar ben charsom shehinniach lo aviv elef ayarot bayyabbasha uchnegdan elef sefinot bayyam uvchol yom vaom notel nod shel kemach al ketefo umhallech meir leir umimmedina limdina lilmod tora

Paam achat metzauhu avadav veasu bo angarya amar lahen bevakkasha mikkem hannichuni veelech lilmod tora amru lo chayye rabbi elazar ben charsom sheen mannichin otcha umiyyamav lo halach veraa otan ella yoshev veosek battora kol hayyom vechol hallayela

Rasha omrim lo mippene ma lo asakta battora im amar nae hayiti vetarud beyitzri haya omrim lo kelum nae hayita miyyosef amru alav al yosef hatztzaddik bechol yom vaom hayeta eshet potifar meshaddalto bidvarim begadim shellavsha lo shacharit lo lavsha lo arvit begadim shellavsha lo arvit lo lavsha lo shacharit

Amra lo hishshama li amar lah lav amra lo hareni chovashtecha bevet haasurin amar lah Adonai mattir asurim hareni kofefet komatcha Adonai zokef kefufim hareni mesamma et enecha Adonai pokeach iverim natna lo elef kikkere chesef lishmoa eleha lishkav etzlah lihot immah velo ratza lishmoa eleha
Lishkav etzlah baolam hazze lihot immah laolam habba nimtza hillel mechayyev et haaniyyim rabbi elazar ben charsom mechayyev et haashirim yosef mechayyev et harshaim
Matni ba lo etzel paro ufaro haya omed ben haulam velammizbeach rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav vehakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav vesomech shette yadav alav umitvadde

Vechach haya omer ana hashshem aviti pashati chatati lefanecha ani uveti ana hashshem kapper na laaonot velappeshaim velachataim sheaviti vesheppashati veshechatati lefanecha ani uveti kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha ki vayyom hazze yechapper vego vehen onin acharav baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed

a: Gema man shamatte leh deamar ben haulam velammizbeach tzafon

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi detanya ezehu tzafon mikkir shel mizbeach tzefoni vead kotel haazara uchneged kol hammizbeach kullo tzafon divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda rabbi elazar berabbi shimon mosif af ben haulam velammizbeach rabbi mosif af mekom derisat ragle hakkohanim veaf mekom derisat ragle yisrael aval min hachalifot velifnim hakkol modim sheppasul
Lema rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi vela rabbi afilu tema rabbi verabbi hashta adderabbi yose berabbi yehuda mosif adderabbi elazar berabbi shimon la mosif
Anan hachi ka amrinan i rabbi hi nokmeh bechullah azara ella may rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi venokmeh ben mizbeach velakkotel
Ella may it lach lememar mishshum chulsha dechohen gadol lerabbi name mishshum chulsha dechohen gadol
Rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav hechi mashkachatte lah amar rav beokem et rosho venokmeh lehedya amar abbaye gezera shemma yarbitz gelalim

Tanu rabbanan ketzad somech hazzevach omed batztzafon ufanav lammaarav vehassomech omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav umanniach shette yadav ben shette keranot shel zevach uvilvad shello yehe davar chotzetz beno leven hazzevach umitvadde al chattat aon chattat veal asham aon asham veal ola aon leket shichcha ufea umasar ani divre rabbi yose haggelili
Rabbi akiva omer en ola baa ella al ase veal lo taase shennitak laase
Bemay ka mipalgi amar rabbi yirmeya
b: Belav dinvela ka mipalgi
Rabbi akiva savar lav mealleya hu verabbi yose haggelili savar lav lav mealleya hu
Abbaye amar dechulle alma lav dinvela lav mealleya have vehacha betaazov ka mipalgi
Derabbi akiva savar taazov meikara mashma verabbi yose haggelili savar hashta mashma

Tanu rabbanan ketzad mitvadde aviti pashati vechatati vechen besair hammishtalleach hu omer vehitvadda alav et kol aonot bene yisrael veet kol pishehem lechol chattotam vechen bemoshe hu omer nose aon vafesha vechattaa divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim aonot ellu hazzedonot vechen hu omer hikkaret tikkaret hannefesh hahi aona bah

Peshaim ellu hammeradim vechen hu omer melech moav pasha bi veomer az tifsha livna baet hahi lechol chattotam ellu hashshegagot vechen hu omer nefesh ki techeta vishgaga umeachar shehitvadda al hazzedonot veal hammeradim chozer umitvadde al hashshegagot

Ella kach haya mitvadde chatati veaviti ufashati lefanecha ani uveti vechu vechen bedavid hu omer chatanu im avotenu heevinu hirshanu vechen bishlomo hu omer chatanu vehirshanu umaradnu vechen bedaniyyel hu omer chatanu veheevinu vehirshanu umaradnu ella mahu sheamar moshe nose aon vafesha vechattaa amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam beshaa sheyyisrael chotin lefanecha veosin teshuva ase lahem zedonot kishgagot
Amar rabba bar shemuel amar rav halacha kedivre chachamim peshita yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim mahu detema mistabber tameh derabbi meir dekamsayya leh kera demoshe ka mashma lan
Hahu dinchet kammeh derabba vaavad kerabbi meir amar leh shavkatte rabbanan veavdatte kerabbi meir amar leh kerabbi meir sevira li kedichtiv besefer orayeta demoshe
Tanu rabbanan vechipper bechapparat devarim hakkatuv medabber atta omer bechapparat devarim o eno ella kapparat damim
Hare ani dan neemra kan kappara veneemra lehallan kappara ma kappara haamura bassair devarim af kappara haamura bappar devarim
Veim nafshecha lomar hare hu omer vehikriv aharon et par hachattat asher lo vechipper baado uvad beto vaadayin lo nishchat happar
May veim nafshecha lomar vechi tema nelaf missair hannaase bifnim shekkapparato bedamim hare hu omer vechipper vaadayin lo nishchat happar

a: Uminnayin shebbeanna neemar kan kappara veneemar lehallan bechorev kappara ma lehallan beanna af kan beanna uminnayin shebbashshem neemar kan kappara veneemra beegla arufa kappara ma lehallan bashshem af kan bashshem

Amar abbaye bishlama chorev meegla arufa la yalef may dahava hava ella egla arufa telaf mechorev vechi tema hachi name vehatnan hakkohanim omrim kapper leammecha yisrael veilu beanna la ka amar kashya

Vehen onin acharav tanya rabbi omer ki shem Adonai ekra havu godel lelohenu amar lahem moshe leyisrael beshaa sheani mazkir shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu attem havu godel chananya ben achi rabbi yehoshua omer zecher tzaddik livracha amar lahem navi leyisrael beshaa sheani mazkir tzaddik olamim attem tenu beracha
