Amar rav shimi bar ashe may tama derav chisda dichtiv velakcha veasa o bilkicha o baasiyya
Metivi veasahu chattat haggoral ose chattat veen hashshem ose chattat
Sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma bimkom shello kidesh haggoral kidesh hashshem mekom shekkidesh haggoral eno din sheyekaddesh hashshem
Talmud lomar veasahu chattat haggoral ose chattat veen hashshem ose chattat
Veha hacha delav sheat lekicha velav sheat asiyya hi vekatane dekava

Amar rava hachi kaamar ma bimkom shello kidesh haggoral vaafilu bishat lekicha vaafilu bishat asiyya kidesh hashshem bishat lekicha uvishat asiyya mekom shekkidesh haggoral shello bishat lekicha veshello bishat asiyya eno din sheyekaddesh hashshem bishat lekicha uvishat asiyya
Talmud lomar veasahu chattat haggoral ose chattat veen hashshem ose chattat
Ta shema metamme mikdash ani vehifrish maot lekino veheeshir veachar kach amar ellu lechattato veellu leolato
Mosif umevi chovato middeme chattato veen mosif umevi chovato middeme olato
Veha hacha delav sheat lekicha velav sheat asiyya hi vekatane dekava
Amar rav sheshet vetisbera vehaamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya metamme mikdash ashir vehevi korban ani lo yatza vechevan delo yatza hechi kava
Ella may it lach lememar shekkevar amar meaniyyuto hacha name shekkevar amar mishsheat hafrasha
Ulrabbi chagga amar rabbi yoshiyya deamar yatza
b: May ika lememar la tema veachar kach amar ella ema veachar kach lakach veamar
Lakach mosif umevi chovato may nihu
Defarek leh veha en pidon laof
Amar rav pappa kegon shellakach pereda achat i ola zevan mosif umevi chovato middeme chattato vehay ola azla lindava i chattat zevan en mosif umevi chovato middeme olato vehay chattat azla lemita
Gufa amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya metamme mikdash ashir vehevi korban ani lo yatza verabbi chagga amar rabbi hoshaya yatza
Metivi metzora ani shehevi korban ashir yatza ashir shehevi korban ani lo yatza shane hatam dichtiv zot
I hachi resha name ha rabbi rachamana torat vehatanya torat lerabbot metzora ani shehevi korban ashir yachol afilu ashir shehevi korban ani talmud lomar zot
Venelaf minah miet rachamana veim dal hu
Matni kashar lashon shel zehorit berosh sair hammishtalleach veheemido keneged bet shilucho velannishchat keneged bet shechitato

Ba lo etzel paro sheniyya vesomech shette yadav alav umitvadde vechach haya omer ana hashshem chatati aviti ufashati lefanecha ani uveti uvne aharon am kedoshecha ana hashshem kapper na laaonot velappeshaim velachataim sheaviti vesheppashati veshechatati lefanecha ani uveti uvne aharon am kedoshecha kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu vehen onin acharav baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vead
Gema ibaya lehu velannishchat akkeshira kae o ahaamada kae
Ta shema detane rav yosef kashar lashon shel zehorit berosh sair hammishtalleach veheemido keneged bet shilucho velannishchat keneged bet shechitato shello yitarev ze baze velo yitarev baacherim

I amratte bishlama akkeshira kae shappir ella i amratte ahaamada kae nehi divchavreh la miarav dehay ketir beh vehay la ketir beh beacharine mihat miarav ella lav shema minah akkeshira kae shema minah
Amar rabbi yitzchak shette leshonot shamati achat shel para veachat shel sair hammishtalleach achat tzericha shiur veachat enah tzericha shiur vela yadana he minayehu
Amar rav yosef nichze anan shel sair hammishtalleach devae chalukka bae shiur veshel para dela bae chalukka la bae shiur
Matkef lah rame bar chama defara name bae koved amar leh rava koved tannae hi
Udfara la bae chalukka etiveh abbaye ketzad hu ose korchan bishyare lashon ema biznav lashon
Amar rabbi chanin amar rav etz erez ushni tolaat shekkelatatan shalhevet keshera metivi nithavhev hallashon mevi lashon acher umkaddesh
Amar abbaye la kashya kan bekolachat kan benichpefet
Rava omer koved tannae hi detanya lamma korchan kede sheyyihu kullan baagudda achat divre rabbi rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer kede sheyehe bahen koved veyippelu letoch serefat happara

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan shalosh leshonot shamati achat shel para veachat shel sair hammishtalleach veachat shel metzora achat mishkal asara zuz veachat mishkal shene selaim veachat mishkal shekel veen li lefaresh
Ki ata ravin pershah mishshemeh derabbi yonatan

a: Shel para mishkal asara zuz veshel sair hammishtalleach mishkal shene selaim veshel metzora mishkal shekel
Amar rabbi yochanan peligi bah rabbi shimon ben chalafta verabbanan befara chad amar mishkal asara vechad amar mishkal shekel vesimanach echad hammarbe veechad hammamit

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya middifti leravina la befara peligi ella besair hammishtalleach peligi vehahu yoma nach nafsheh deravya bar kisi veannechu bah simana ravya bar kisi mechapper kesair hammishtalleach
Amar rabbi yitzchak shette shechitot shamati achat shel para veachat shel paro achat keshera bezar veachat pesula bezar vela yadana he minayehu
Itmar shechitat para ufaro rav ushmuel chad amar para pesula paro keshera vechad amar paro pesula para keshera
Tistayyem derav hu deamar para pesula deamar rabbi zera shechitat para bezar pesula veamar rav alah elazar vechukka shaninu bah
Verav may shena para dichtiv elazar vechukka paro name ha ketiv aharon vechukka
Shechita lav avoda hi i hachi para name shane para dekodshe bedek habbayit hi
Velav kal dechen hu amar rav shisha bereh derav idi mide dehave ammarot negaim delav avoda hi uvaaya kehunna
Velishmuel deamar paro pesula may shena paro dichtiv aharon vechukka para name ha ketiv elazar vechukka shane hatam dichtiv veshachat otah lefanav sheyehe zar shochet veelazar roe
Verav shello yassiach dato mimmenna ushmuel shello yassiach dato mena leh nafka leh mivvesaraf et happara leenav
Verav chad bishchita vechad bisrefa
Utzricha dei ketav rachamana bishchita mishshum ditchilat avoda hi aval serefa ema la tzericha vei ketav rachamana bisrefa mishshum dehashta hu demittachshera para aval shechita ema la tzericha
Lemaote may ilema lemaote asifat efrah umiluy mayim lekidush
b: Lemishmeret leme nidda ketiv ella lemaote hashlachat etz erez veezov ushni tolaat delav gufah defara ninhu
Itmar shechitat para bezar rabbi amme amar keshera verabbi yitzchak nappacha amar pesula ulla amar keshera veamri lah pesula
Metiv rabbi yehoshua bar abba lesayyoeh lerav en li ella hazzaat memeha sheen kesherin baishsha kevaish veen kesherin ella bayyom

Minnayin lerabbot shechitatah vekabbalat damah vehazzaat damah usrefatah vehashlachat etz erez veezov ushni tolaat talmud lomar tora yachol sheani merabbe af asifat efrah umiluy mayim vekidush talmud lomar zot

Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulhotzi et ellu achar sheriba hakkatuv umiet amratte hare anu lemedin kullan mehazzaat memeha ma hazzaat memeha enan kesherin baishsha kevaish veen kesherin ella bayyom af ani avi shechitatah vekabbalat damah vehazzaat damah usrefatah vehashlachat etz erez veezov ushni tolaat
Hoil veen kesherin baishsha kevaish en kesherin ella bayyom umotzi ani asifat efrah umiluy mayim vekidush hoil uchsherin baishsha kevaish kesherin name bayyom uvallayela
Vehay may teuvta ilema middifsulin baishsha pesulin name bezar hazzaat memeha tochiach sheppesulin baishsha uchsherin bezar
Amar abbaye hayenu teuvteh ishsha may tama elazar velo ishsha zar name elazar velo zar
Amar ulla kol happarasha kullah mashma motzi miyyad mashma umashma mimmela
Untattem otah el elazar hakkohen otah leelazar velo ledorot leelazar ika deamri ledorot bechohen gadol veika deamri ledorot bechohen hedot
Bishlama leman deamar ledorot bechohen hedot shappir ella leman deamar ledorot bechohen gadol mena leh gamar chukka chukka miyyom hakkippurim

Vehotzi otah shello yotzi acheret immah keditnan lo hayeta para rotza latzet en motziin immah shechora shello yomru shechora shachatu veen motziin immah adumma shello yomru shettayim shachatu rabbi omer lo min hashshem hu ze ella mishshum shenneemar otah levaddah
Vetanna kamma ha ketiv otah man tanna kamma rabbi shimon hi dedaresh tameh dikra may benayehu ika benayehu

a: Deappek chamor bahadah
Veshachat otah shello yishchot acheret immah lefanav lerav shello yassiach dato mimmenna lishmuel sheyehe zar shochet veelazar roe
Velakach elazar hakkohen middamah beetzbao lishmuel leahadoreh leelazar lerav have miut achar miut veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot daafilu kohen hedot
Velakach hakkohen etz erez veezov ushni tolaat lishmuel daafilu bechohen hedot lerav itzterich salka datach amena kevan delav gufah defara ninhu la live kohen ka mashma lan
Vechibbes begadav hakkohen bechihunno vetame hakkohen ad haarev kohen bechihunno ledorot
Hanicha leman deamar ledorot bechohen hedot shappir ella leman deamar ledorot bechohen gadol hashta kohen gadol baenan bechihunno mibaya in milta deatya bekal vechomer tarach vechatav lah kera
Veasaf ish tahor et efer happara vehinniach ish lehachshir et hazzar tahor lehachshir et haishsha vehinniach mi sheyyesh bo daat lehanniach yatzu cheresh shote vekatan sheen bahen daat lehanniach
Tenan hatam hakkol kesherin lekaddesh chutz mecheresh shote vekatan rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan ufosel beishsha uvanderoginos
May tama derabbanan dichtiv velakchu lattame meafar serefat hachattat hanach difsali lach baasifa pesali lach bekidush vehanach deachshari lach baasifa achshari lach bekidush
Verabbi yehuda im ken lema kera velakach may velakchu daafilu katan difsali lach hatam hacha kasher
Ishsha mena leh venatan velo venatna verabbanan i ketav rachamana velakach venatan hava amena ad deshakel chad veyahev chad ketav rachamana velakchu
Vei ketav rachamana velakchu venatnu hava amena ad deshakli tere veyahavi tere ketav rachamana velakchu venatan daafilu shakli tere veyahev chad
Velakach ezov vetaval bammayim ish tahor lerabbanan ish velo ishsha tahor lehachshir et hakkatan ulrabbi yehuda ish velo katan tahor lehachshir et haishsha
Metivi hakkol kesherin lehazzot chutz mittumtum veanderoginos veishsha vekatan sheyyesh bo daat ishsha mesayyato umazze
b: Vela pelig rabbi yehuda
Amar abbaye kevan deamar mar mashma motzi miyyad mashma umashma mimmela pelig
Vehizza hattahor al hattame tahor mikkelal shehu tame limed al tevul yom shekkasher befara
Amar rabbi assi ki hao bah rabbi yochanan veresh lakish befara la masseki minah ella kemay demassek taala mibbe cherava ella amri mashma motzi miyyad mashma umashma mimmela
Tane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan kol hashshechitot kesherot bezar chutz mishshel para amar leh rabbi yochanan pok teni levara lo matzinu shechita bezar pesula

Verabbi yochanan la mibaya letanna dela tzayet ella afilu lerabbeh la tzayet deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak shechitat para bezar pesula vaani omer keshera lo matzinu shechita sheppesula bezar
Ba lo etzel paro sheniyya may shena beviduy rishon dela amar uvne aharon am kedoshecha umay shena beviduy sheni deamar uvne aharon am kedoshecha
Tana deve rabbi yishmael kach hi middat haddin notenet mutav yavo zakkay vichapper al hachayyav veal yavo chayyav vichapper al hachayyav

Matni shechato vekibbel bemizrak et damo venotno lemi shehu memares bo al haroved harvii shebbahechal kede shello yikrosh natal machta veala lerosh hammizbeach ufinna gechalim elach veelach vechote min hamukkalot happenimiyyot veyarad vehinnichah al haroved harvii shebbaazara
Bechol yom haya chote beshel kesef umare betoch shel zahav vehayyom chote beshel zahav uvah haya machnis

Bechol yom chote beshel arbaat kabbin umare letoch sheloshet kabbin vehayyom chote bishloshet kabbin uvah haya machnis rabbi yose omer bechol yom chote beshel sea umare betoch sheloshet kabbin vehayyom chote bishloshet kabbin uvah haya machnis
Bechol yom hayeta keveda vehayyom kalla bechol yom hayeta yadah ketzara vehayyom arukka bechol yom hayeta zehava yarok vehayyom adom divre rabbi menachem
Bechol yom makriv peras beshacharit ufras ben haarbayim vehayyom mosif melo chofnav bechol yom hayeta dakka vehayyom dakka min haddakka
Bechol yom kohanim olin bemizracho shel kevesh veordin bemaaravo vehayyom kohen gadol ole baemtza veored baemtza rabbi yehuda omer leolam kohen gadol ole baemtza veored baemtza
Bechol yom kohen gadol mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiyyor vehayyom min hakkiton shel zahav rabbi yehuda omer leolam kohen gadol mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiton shel zahav
Bechol yom hau sham arba maarachot vehayyom chamesh divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer bechol yom shalosh vehayyom arba rabbi yehuda omer bechol yom shettayim vehayyom shalosh
Gema vehachtiv vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed amar rav yehuda teni shel hechal
Tanu rabbanan vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed

a: Yachol afilu baazara talmud lomar beohel moed en li ella beohel moed shebbammidbar shilo uvet olamim minnayin talmud lomar bakkodesh
En li ella bishat haktara bishat mattan damim minnayin talmud lomar bevoo lechapper en li ella bichnisato bitziato minnayin talmud lomar ad tzeto

Vechipper baado uvad beto uvad kol kehal yisrael kapparato kodemet lechapparat beto kapparat beto kodemet lechapparat echav hakkohanim vechapparat echav hakkohanim kodemet lechapparat kol kehal yisrael

Amar mar en li ella bishat haktara may mashma amar rava vechen amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi vechen amar rabbi elazar amar kera vechipper baado uvad beto uvad kol kehal yisrael ezehu kappara sheshshava lo ulveto ulechav hakkohanim ulchol kehal yisrael heve omer ze haktarat hakketoret

Uktoret mechapperet in deha tane rabbi chananya lamadnu liktoret shemmechapperet shenneemar vayyitten et hakketoret vayechapper al haam vetana deve rabbi yishmael al ma ketoret mechapperet al lashon hara yavo davar shebbachashay vichapper al maase chashay

Tenan hatam porshin mibben haulam velammizbeach bishat haktara amar rabbi elazar lo shanu ella bishat haktara dehechal aval bishat haktara delifnay lifnim mehechal parshi mibben haulam velammizbeach la parshi

Metiv rav adda bar ahava veamri lah kedi rabbi yose omer keshem shepporshin mibben haulam velammizbeach bishat haktara kach porshin bishat mattan par kohen mashiach ufar helem davar shel tzibur usire avoda zara
Ha ma maala yesh ben hahechal leven haulam velammizbeach ella shebbahechal porshin ben bishat haktara uven shello bishat haktara umibben haulam velammizbeach en porshin ella bishat haktara
Bishat haktara miha parshi may lav bishat haktara delifnay lifnim

La bishat haktara dehechal i hachi ha ma maala vetu la ha ika ha maala deilu mehechal parshi ben bishat haktara dideh ben bishat haktara delifnay lifnim veilu mibben haulam velammizbeach la parshi ella bishat haktara dehechal
Ha katane ella shebbahechal porshin ben bishat haktara uven shello bishat haktara umibben haulam velammizbeach en porshin
b: Ella bishat haktara
Veha ika ha maala deilu mehechal parshi ben bikdushsha dideh ben bikdushsha delifnay velifnim veilu mibben haulam velammizbeach la parshi ella bikdushsha dehechal amar rava shem perisha achat hi
Amar mar kach porshin bishat mattan par kohen mashiach ufar helem davar shel tzibbur usire avoda zara mena lan amar rabbi pedat atya kappara kappara miyyom hakkippurim
Amar rav acha bar ahava shema minah maalot deorayeta vehachi gemiri lehu
Dei salka datach derabbanan may shena ben haulam velammizbeach dilma mikru veayeli mikkullah azara name nifreshu dilma mikru veayeli
Ben haulam velammizbeach kevan dela mafsek mide la minachra milta azara kevan deika mizbeach hachitzon demafsek minachra milta
Amar rava shema minah kedushshat ulam vehechal chada milta hi dei salka datach shette kedushshot ninhu ulam gufeh gezera venekum venigzor gezera ligzera
La ulam uven haulam velammizbeach chada kedushsha hi hechal veulam shette kedushshot
Bechol yom haya chote beshel kesef vechu may tama hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael
Vehayyom chote beshel zahav uvah haya machnis may tama mishshum chulsha dechohen gadol
Bechol yom beshel arbaat kabbin vechu tana nitpazzeru lo kav gechalim mechabbedan laamma
Tane chada kav vetanya idach kabbayim bishlama hach detane kav rabbanan ella hach detane kabbayim manni la rabbanan vela rabbi yose
Amar rav chisda rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi detanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer beshel kabbayim haya machnis
Rav ashe amar afilu tema rabbi yose vehachi kaamar bechol yom haya chote beshel sea midbarit umare letoch sheloshet kabbin yerushalmiyyot
Bechol yom hayeta keveda vehayyom kalla tana bechol yom hayeta gildah ave vehayyom rach bechol yom hayeta ketzara vehayyom arukka may tama kede shettehe zeroo shel kohen gadol mesayyato
Tana bechol yom lo haya lah niashtik vehayyom haya lah niashtik divre ben hassegan

Bechol yom haya zehavah yarok amar rav chisda shiva zehavim hen zahav vezahav tov uzhav ofir vezahav mufaz vezahav shachut vezahav sagur uzhav parvayim zahav vezahav tov dichtiv uzhav haaretz hahi tov zehav ofir deate meofir zahav mufaz

a: Sheddome lefaz zahav shachut shennitve kechut zahav sagur beshaa shenniftach kal hachanuot nisgarot zehav parvayim sheddome ledam happarim
Rav ashe amar chamishsha hen vechol chad vechad it beh zahav vezahav tov tanya name hachi bechol yom haya zehavah yarok vehayyom adom vehayenu zehav parvayim sheddome ledam happarim

Bechol yom makriv peras shacharit vechu bechol yom hayeta dakka vehayyom dakka min haddakka tanu rabbanan dakka ma talmud lomar vahalo kevar neemar veshachakta mimmenna hadek ella lehavi dakka min haddakka
Bechol yom kohanim olin bemizracho shel kevesh deamar mar kol pinot sheatta pone lo yehu ella derech yamin lammizrach
Vehayyom olin baemtza veordin baemtza may tama mishshum kevodo dechohen gadol
Bechol yom kohen gadol mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiyyor vechu may tama mishshum kevodo shel kohen gadol

Bechol yom hau sham arba maarachot tanu rabbanan bechol yom hau shettayim maarachot vehayyom shalosh achat maaracha gedola veachat maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret veachat shemmosifin bo bayyom divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi yose omer bechol yom shalosh vehayyom arba achat shel maaracha gedola veachat maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret veachat shel kiyyum haesh veachat shemmosifin bo bayyom

Rabbi meir omer bechol yom arba vehayyom chamesh achat shel maaracha gedola veachat shel maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret veachat shel kiyyum haesh veachat leevarim ufdarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev veachat shemmosifin bo bayyom

Dechulle alma mihat tarte it lehu menalan amar kera hi haola al mokda al hammizbeach kol hallayela zo maaracha gedola veesh hammizbeach tukad bo zo maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret verabbi yose kiyyum haesh mena leh nafka leh mivvehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo

Verabbi yehuda hahu lehatztzatat alita hu daata detanya haya rabbi yehuda omer minnayin lehatztzatat alita shello tehe ella berosho shel mizbeach talmud lomar vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo amar rabbi yose minnayin sheose maaracha lekiyyum haesh talmud lomar vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo

Verabbi yose hatztzatat alita mena leh nafka leh mehecha denafka leh lerabbi shimon detanya venatnu bene aharon hakkohen esh al hammizbeach limed al hatztzatat alita shello tehe ella bechohen kasher uvichli sharet divre rabbi yehuda amar lo rabbi shimon vechi taale al datecha shezzar karev legabbe mizbeach ella limed al hatztzatat alita shello tehe ella berosho shel mizbeach
Verabbi yehuda i mehatam hava amena kae aara veaved bemappucha ka mashma lan
Verabbi meir evarim ufdarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev mena leh nafka leh mivveesh verabbanan vav la darshi
Verabbanan evarim ufdarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev may aved lehu mahdar lehu lemaaracha gedola detanya minnayin leevarim ufdarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev
b: Shessodran al gabbe mizbeach veim en machazikan shessodran al hakkevesh o al gabbe sovev ad sheyyaase maaracha gedola vesodran talmud lomar asher tochal haesh et haola al hammizbeach

Verabbi meir ikule ola atta machazir vei atta machazir ikule ketoret detane rabbi chananya bar minome bidve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov asher tochal haesh et haola al hammizbeach ikule ola atta machazir vei atta machazir ikule ketoret
Dechulle alma mihat mosifin bo bayyom it lehu mana lehu nafka lehu mivvehaesh vaafilu leman dela daresh vav vav he daresh
Esh tamid lemay ata mibbee leh lechidtanya esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach lo tichbe limed al maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret shello tehe ella al hammizbeach hachitzon
Esh machta umnora minnayin vedin hu neemra esh biktoret veneemra esh bemachta umnora ma lehallan al mizbeach hachitzon af kan al hammizbeach hachitzon
O kelach lederech zo neemra esh biktoret veneemra esh bemachta umnora ma lehallan besamuch lo af machta umnora besamuch lo
Talmud lomar esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach lo tichbe esh tamid sheamarti lach lo tehe ella berosho shel mizbeach hachitzon
Lamadnu esh lammenora esh lammachta minnayin vedin hu neemra esh bemachta veneemra esh bimnora ma lehallan al gabbe mizbeach hachitzon af kan al mizbeach hachitzon
O kelach lederech zo neemra esh biktoret veneemra esh bemachta ma lehallan besamuch lo af kan besamuch lo
Talmud lomar velakach melo hammachta gachale esh meal hammizbeach millifne Adonai ezehu mizbeach shemmiktzato lifne Adonai veen kullo lifne Adonai heve omer ze mizbeach hachitzon

Veitzterich lemichtav meal hammizbeach veitzterich lemichtav millifne Adonai dei ketav rachamana meal hammizbeach hava amena may mizbeach mizbeach penimi ketav rachamana millifne Adonai vei ketav rachamana millifne Adonai hava amena daveka millifne Adonai

a: Aval mehay gisa umehay gisa ema la tzericha
Amar rabbi elazar mishshum bar kappara omer haya rabbi meir evre ola shennittotru ose lahen maaracha bifne atzmah vesodran vaafilu beshabbat
May ka mashma lan tenena bechol yom hau sham arba maarachot amar rabbi avin lo nitzrecha ella lifsulin
Vedaveka shemmashla bahen haur aval lo mashla bahen haur lo
Ika deamri echad kesherin veechad pesulin i mashla bahen haur in vei la la
Vaafilu beshabbat tenena vehayyom chamesh
Amar rav acha bar yaakov itzterich salka datach amena hane mile hecha dechal yom hakkippurim lihot achar hashshabbat dechelve shabbat kerevin beom hakkippurim aval beemtza shabbat la ka mashma lan
Amar rava man hay dela chayesh lekimcheh ha bechol yom tenan kashya
Ufliga derav huna deamar techilato docha sofo eno doche
Gufa amar rav huna tamid techilato docha sofo eno doche
May eno doche rav chisda amar doche et hashshabbat veeno doche et hattuma verava amar doche et hattuma veeno doche et hashshabbat
Amar leh abbaye lerava ledidach kashya ulrav chisda kashya ledidach kashya may shena tuma dichtiv bemoado vaafilu betuma shabbat name bemoado vaafilu beshabbat
Ulrav chisda kashya may shena shabbat dichtiv bemoado afilu beshabbat tuma name bemoado vaafilu betuma
Amar leh la ledidi kashya vela lerav chisda kashya ledidi la kashya sofo kitchilato
b: Tuma ditchilato bar midche tuma hu sofo name dache shabbat ditchilato lav bar midche shabbat hu sofo name la dache
Lerav chisda la kashya sofo kitchilato techilato let leh shabbat dehuttera hi betzibur sofo name dache
Tuma didchuya hi betzibur techillato deikar kappara dache sofo delav ikar kappara la dache
Itmar hamchabbe esh machta umnora abbaye amar chayyav rava amar patur
Dechabbeyah berosho shel mizbeach dechulle alma la peligi dechayyav ki peligi deachatah aara vechabbeyah abbaye amar chayyav esh hammizbeach hu rava amar patur kevan denattekah nattekah
Ella ha deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh hammorid gachelet meal gabbe hammizbeach vechibah chayyav keman keabbayye
Afilu tema kerava hatam la intik lemitzvatah hacha intika lemitzvatah
Ika deamri
Deachatah aara vechabbeyah dechulle alma la peligi defatur ki peligi dechabbeyyah berosho shel mizbeach abbaye amar chayyav esh hammizbeach hu rava amar patur kevan denattekah nattekah
Ella ha deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh hammorid gachelet meal gabbe hammizbeach vechibbah chayyav keman la keabbayye vela kerava hatam la intik lemitzvatah hacha intik lemitzvatah
Hadaran alach taraf bakkalpi

a: Hotziu lo et hakkaf veet hammachta chafan melo chofnav venatan letoch hakkaf haggadol lefi godlo vehakkatan lefi kotno vechach hayeta middatah natal et hammachta bimino veet hakkaf bismolo

Gema machta tena leh natal et hammachta veala lerosh hammizbeach vechote veored hatam machta degechalim vehacha machta diktoret detanya hotziu lo kaf rekan millishkat hakkelim umachta gedusha shel ketoret millishkat bet avtinas
Chafan melo chofnav venoten letoch hakkaf haggadol lefi godlo vehakkatan lefi kotno vechach hayeta middatah kaf beom hakkippurim lema li melo chofnav vehevi amar rachamana
Mishshum dela efshar dehechi nebed neayyel vahadar neayyel havaa achat amar rachamana vela shette havaot

Nishkelah liktoret bechofnav venachatah lemachta alah veleul ki mate hatam hechi laaved nishkelah beshineh venachatah lemachta hashta lifne melech basar vedam en osin ken lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu al achat kamma vechamma
Hilkach la efshar vechevan dela efshar avdinan kidashkechan binsiim
Natal et hammachta beyamin veet hakkaf bismol yatztziva beara vegiyyora bishme shemayya
Zo merubba vezo muetet vaafilu bizman sheshshenehen shavin uchmaase derabbi yishmael ben kimchit zo chamma vezo tzonenet

Amru alav al rabbi yishmael ben kimchit shehaya chofen arbaat kabbin bimlo chofnav veomer kol hannashim zered zardu vezered ima ala laggag ika deamri bearsan vechidrabba bar yonatan deamar rabba bar yonatan amar rabbi yechiel arsan yafe lachole

Veika deamri beshichvat zera vechidrabbi avahu derabbi avahu rame ketiv vattazreni chayil lammilchama uchtiv hamazzereni chayil amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam zeritani vezeraztani

Amru alav al rabbi yishmael ben kimchit paam achat siper devarim im aravi echad bashshuk venitteza tzinora mippiv al begadav venichnas yeshevav achiv veshimmesh tachtav veraata imman shene kohanim gedolim beom echad

Veshuv amru alav al rabbi yishmael ben kimchit paam achat yatza vesiper im hegmon echad bashshuk venitteza tzinora mippiv al begadav venichnas yosef im achiv veshimmesh tachtav veraata imman shene kohanim gedolim beom echad

Tanu rabbanan shiva banim hau lah lekimchit vechullan shimmeshu bichhunna gedola amru lah chachamim ma asit shezzachit lechach amra lahem miyyamay lo rau korot beti kale seari amru lah harbe asu ken velo hoilu
Tanu rabbanan bekumtzo shello yaase midda lakkometz ibaya lehu mahu sheyyaase midda lachafina
Hatam hu dichtiv bekumtzo aval hacha dela ketiv bechofnav ella melo chofnav ketoret sammim dakka la o dilma yalef melo melo mikkumtzo
Ta shema vechach hayeta middatah may lav sheim ratza laasot midda acheret ose lo hachi kaamar vechach haya chozer vechofnah lifnim
Shamatte minah chofen vechozer vechofen
Dilma sheim ratza laasot midda ose i name shello yechasser veshello yotir

Tanu rabbanan melo kumtzo yachol mevoratz talmud lomar bekumtzo i bekumtzo yachol afilu berashe etzbeotav talmud lomar melo kumtzo kidkamtzi inashe ha ketzad chofe shelosh etzbeotav al pisat yado vekometz
b: Uvmachavat uvmarcheshet mochek begudalo millemala uvetzbao ketanna millematta vezo hi avoda kasha shebbammikdash zo hi vetu la veha ika melika veha ika chafina ella zo hi meavodot kashot shebbammikdash
Amar rabbi yochanan bae rabbi yehoshua ben uzzaa ben habbenayim shel melo kumtzo mahu amar rav pappa degavay la tibe lach devadday kometz hu devaray la tibe lach devadday shirayim hu
Ki tibe lach devene bene may amar rabbi yochanan hadar pashtah yehoshua ben uzzaa ben habbenayim safek ninhu

Hechi aved amar rabbi chanina maktir kometz lechodeh techilla vahadar ben habbenayim dei amratte ben habbenayim beresha dilma shirayim ninhu vehau lehu shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaktara veamar mar shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaktara en maktirin alehen et hakkometz
I hachi hashta name ikri kan kol shemmimmennu laishshim hare hu beval taktiru
Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi demakter leh leshum etzim kerabbi eliezer detanya rabbi eliezer omer lereach nichoach i atta maale aval atta maale leshum etzim
Hanicha lerabbi eliezer ella lerabbanan may ika lememar amar rav mari dekamtzi shammine hashta deatet lehachi rabbi eliezer name lechattechila dekamtzi shammine
Ben habbenayim pashat umachatz ufizzer vechishshev bachafinat chavero siman bae rav pappa ben habbenayim shel melo chofnav mahu may ka mibbaya leh i gamar melo melo mehatam hayenu hach
Rav pappa hachi bae leh melo chofnav vehevi baenan veha ika o dilma velakach vehevi baenan veha leka teku
Amar rav pappa peshita li melo kumtzo kidkamtzi inashe bae rav pappa kamatz berashe etzbeotav mahu
Millematta lemala mahu min hatztzedadin mahu teku
Amar rav pappa peshita li melo chofnav kidchafni inashe bae rav pappa chafan berashe etzbeotav mahu millematta lemala mahu min hatztzad mahu chafan bezo uvazo vekervan zo etzel zo mahu teku
Bae

a: Rav pappa dabbekeh lekometz bedufneh demana may toch keli baenan veha ika o dilma hannacha betocho ketikno baenan veha leka teku
Bae mar bar rav ashe afcheh lemana vedabbekeh lekometz beariteh demana mahu hannacha betocho baenan veha ika o dilma hannacha ketikno bainan veleka teku
Bae rav pappa melo chofnav sheamru mechukot o gedushot amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe ta shema melo chofnav sheamru lo mechukot velo gedushot ella tefufot
Tenan hatam nishpach haddam al haritzpa vaasafo pasul min hakkeli al haritzpa vaasafo kasher
Mena hane mile tanu rabbanan velakach middam happar middam hannefesh velo middam haor velo middam hattamtzit

Middam happar dam mehappar yekabbelennu dei salka datach middam happar middam vaafilu miktzat dam vehaamar rav yehuda hamkabbel tzarich sheyekabbel et kol damo shel par shenneemar veet kol dam happar yishpoch el yesod mizbach
Ella shema minah may middam happar dam mehappar yekabbelennu vekasavar gorin umosifin vedorshin
Bae rav pappa nitpazzer hakketoret mimmelo chofnav mahu yado ketzavar behema dame ufsula o dilma kichli sharet dame vela pesula teku
Bae rav pappa chishev bachafinat ketoret mahu mi amrinan yalef melo melo mimmincha ma hatam mahneya bah machshava hacha name mahneya bah machshava o lo
Amar leh rav shimi bar ashe lerav pappa ta shema hosif rabbi akiva hakkometz vehakketoret vehallevona vehaggechalim sheim naga tevul yom bemiktzatan pasal et kullan
Ka salka datach middefasal tevul yom pasla name lina umiddelina pasla pasla name machshava
Bae rav pappa
b: Chishev bachatiyyat gechalim mahu machshire mitzva kemitzva damu o la teku
Beo mineh merav sheshet holacha bismol mahu amar lehu rav sheshet tenetuha natal et hammachta bimino veet hakkaf bismolo
Venifshot lehu meha ditnan haregel shel yamin bismol uvet orah lachutz
I mehatam hava amena hane mile holacha dela meakkeva kappara aval holacha dimakkeva kappara la kamashma lan

a: Metivi zar veonen shikor uvaal mum bekabbala uvholacha uvizrika pasul vechen yoshev vechen semol pasul teuvta

Veha rav sheshet hu deotvah daamar leh rav sheshet leamoreh derav chisda bei mineh merav chisda holacha bezar mahu amar leh keshera umikra mesayeeni vayyishchatu happasach vayyizreku hakkohanim miyyadam vehalviyyim mafshitim
Umotev rav sheshet zar veonen shikor uvaal mum bekabbala uvholacha uvizrika pasul vechen yoshev vechen semol pasul
Batar deshamah hadar otvah veha rav chisda kera kaamar daavud maase itzteva
Bae rav pappa chafan chavero venatan letoch chofnav mahu melo chofnav baenan veha ika o dilma velakach vehevi baenan veha leka teku
Bae rabbi yehoshua ben levi chafan vamet mahu sheyyikkanes acher bachafinato amar rabbi chanina bo ure sheelat harishonim
Lememra derabbi yehoshua ben levi kashshish vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi li hittir rabbi chanina lishtot shachalayim beshabbat
Lishtot peshita ditnan kol haochalin ochel adam lirfua vechol hammashkin shote

Ella lishchok velishtot shachalayim beshabbat hechi dame i deika sakkanta mishra shere vei deleka sakkanta mesar asir leolam deika sakkanta vehachi ka mibbaya leh mi masseya denechul alayehu shabbeta o la masseya vela nechul alayehu shabbeta
Umay shena rabbi chanina mishshum devaki birfuot hu deamar rabbi chanina meolam lo shealani adam al makkat pirda levana vechaya
Veha ka chazenan dechayye ema vechayat veha ka chazenan demitassi besummakan inhu vechivaran resh karayehu kaamrinan
Mikkol makom shema minah derabbi chanina kashshish ella hachi kaamar sheelatan kishela shel rishonim
Ume amar rabbi chanina hachi vehaamar rabbi chanina befar velo bedamo shel par
Veamar rabbi chanina ketoret shechafanah kodem shechitat happar lo asa velo chelum
Hachi kaamar middeka mibaya leh ha mikkelal dekasavar befar vaafilu bedamo shel par ulmay disvira leh sheilato kishelat harishonim
May have alah amar rav pappa i chofen chozer vechofen chavero nichnas bachafinato deha mikkayema chafina i en chofen vechozer vechofen tibbee lach
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa adderabba i chofen vechozer vechofen lo yikkanes acher bachafinato i efshar shello yechasser veshello yotir vei en chofen chozer vechofen tibe lach
Deibaya lehu chofen chozer vechofen o la ta shema kach hayeta midatah may lav keshem shemmiddatah mibbachutz kach middatah mibbifnim
La dilma sheim ratza laasot midda ose i name shello yechasser veshello yotir
Ta shema
b: Ketzad hu ose ochez et habbazech berosh etzbeotav veyesh omrim beshinav umaale begudalo ad shemmaggaat leven atztzile yadav vechozer umachzirah letoch chofnav vetzovrah kede sheyehe ashanah shohe lavo veyesh omrim mefazzerah kede sheyehe ashanah memaheret lavo
Vezo hi avoda kasha shebbammikdash zo hi vetu la veha ika melika veha ika kemitza ella zo hi avoda kasha meavodot kashot shebbammikdash shema minah chofen vechozer vechofen shema minah
Ibaya lehu shachat vamet ma hu sheyyikkanes acher bedamo mi amrinan befar vaafilu bedamo shel par o dilma befar velo bedamo shel par
Rabbi chanina omer befar velo bedamo shel par veresh lakish amar befar vaafilu bedamo shel par rabbi amme amar befar velo bedamo shel par rabbi yitzchak amar befar vaafilu bedamo shel par
Etiveh rabbi amme lerabbi yitzchak nappacha nimnin umoshchin yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet veim ita ad sheyyizrok mibe leh
Shane hatam dichtiv mihot misse mechayyuteh dese
Metiv mar zutra veen podin lo baegel velo bechayya velo bishchuta velo bitrefa velo bechilayim velo bechoy ella bese shane hatam deyalef se se mippesach
I ma lehallan zachar tam uven shana af kan zachar tam uven shana talmud lomar tifde tifde riba
I tifde tifde riba afilu kullehu name im ken se may ahani leh

a: Etiveh rabbi yitzchak nappacha lerabbi amme vehotzi et kol happar sheyyotzi et kullo
Veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat amar rav pappa beor uvasar vaferesh dechulle alma la peligi ki peligi bedam mar savar dam ikri par umar savar dam la ikri par
Amar rav ashe mistabbera keman deamar dam ikri par dichtiv bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh befar ben bakar attu bekarneh meayyel leh ella bedamo vekare leh par
Veidach bamma huchshar aharon lavo el hakkodesh befar ben bakar lechattat
Vetipok leh dechattat shemmetu bealeha hi vechattat shemmetu bealeha lemita azla amar leh ravin bar rav adda lerava amri talmidacha amar rav amram chattat tzibbur hi vela lemita azla
Ditnan amar lo rabbi meir vahalo par yom hakkippurim vachavite kohen gadol ufesach dekarban yachid hu vedoche et hashshabbat veet hattuma lav mikkelal deika leman deamar detzibbur

Ultamach dekatane amar lo rabbi yaakov vahalo par helem davar shel tzibbur usire avoda zara vachagiga dekarban tzibbur veen dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma mikkelal deika leman deamar deyachid

Ella letanna kamma ka mahdar leh deshameh dekaamar korban tzibbur doche et hashshabbat veet hattuma vekarban yachid eno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma amar lo rabbi meir korban yachid kelala hu vahalo par yom hakkippurim vachavite kohen gadol ufesach dekarban yachid hu vedochin et hashshabbat veet hattuma
Veamar lo rabbi yaakov korban tzibbur kelala hu vahalo par helem davar shel tzibbur usire avoda zara vachagiga dekarban tzibbur hu veen dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma
Ella nekot hay kelala bidach kol shezzemanno kavua doche et hashshabbat veet hattuma afilu beyachid vechol sheen zemanno kavua eno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma vaafilu betzibbur

Etiveh abbaye par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen kullam yamutu vechen seire avoda zara sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen kullam yamutu divre rabbi yehuda rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon omrim yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava sheen chattat tzibbur meta
Amar leh may par par helem davar shel tzibbur veha shel yom hakkippurim katane ki katane addesair

Vehatanya par shel yom hakkippurim vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen kullam yamutu divre rabbi yehuda rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon omrim yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava sheen chattat tzibbur meta
La tema sheen chattat tzibbur meta ella ema sheen chattat hashshuttafin meta umay nafka minah
Dela mayetu kohanim par behoraa
Ta shema devae rabbi eliezer
b: Ledivre haomer par yom hakkippurim korban yachid ose temura o eno ose temura lav mikkelal deika leman deamar detzibbur
La mikkelal deika leman deamar deshuttafin
Gufa bae rabbi eliezer ledivre haomer par yom hakkippurim korban yachid ose temura o eno ose temura may ka mibaya leh
I batar makdish azlinan i batar mitkapper azlinan
Peshita devatar mitkapper azlinan deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan hammakdish mosif chomesh vehammitkapper ose bah temura
Vehattorem mishshello al shel chavero tovat hanaa shello
Leolam peshita leh devatar mitkapper azlinan vehachi ka mibaya leh echav hakkohanim bikviuta mitkapperi o dilma bekufya mitkapperi
Ta shema chomer bezevach mibbitmura vechomer bitmura mibbezevach chomer bezevach shehazzevach noheg beyachid kivtzibbur vedoche et hashshabbat veet hattuma veose temura ma sheen ken bitmura
Chomer bitmura mibbezevach shehattemura chala al baal mum kavua veenah yotza lechullin ligazez veleaved ma sheen ken bezevach
Hay zevach hechi dame ilema deyachid mi dache shabbat vetuma ella detzibbur mi ose temura ella lav defar vedoche et hashshabbat veet hattuma dikvia leh zeman veose temura dekarban yachid hu
Amar rav sheshet la beelo shel aharon
Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach defaro temura defar shabbat vetuma hu dela dachaya ha bechol mikrav karva ha temurat chattat hi utmurat chattat lemita azla
La leolam paro umay temura shem temura
I hachi zevach name shem zevach shem zevach la katane
Mimmay middekatane chomer bitmura shehattemura chala al baal mum kavua veenah yotza lechullin ligazez veleaved vei salka datach may zevach shem zevach veha ika

a: Bechor umaaser dechalin al baal mum kavua veen yotzin lechullin ligazez veleaved ella shem zevach la katane
Umay shena temura shem temura achat hi zevach ika bechor veika maaser
Ulrav sheshet addemokem lah beelo shel aharon lokmah befesach dedoche et hashshabbat veet hattuma veose temura dekorban yachid hu kasavar en shochatin happesach al hayyachid
Venokmeh befesach sheni mi dache tuma

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava vetanna may shena pesach dekare leh korban yachid umay shena chagiga dekare lah korban tzibur i mishshum deate bechinnufya pesach name ate bechinnufya ika pesach sheni dela ate bechinnufya

Amar leh im ken yehe doche et hashshabbat veet hattuma amar leh in keman deamar dache detanya pesach sheni doche et hashshabbat veeno doche et hattuma rabbi yehuda omer af doche et hattuma may tama detanna kamma amar lach mippene tuma dechito veyease betuma
Verabbi yehuda amar lach amar kera kechol chukkat happesach yaasu oto vaafilu betuma hattora hechzira alav laasoto betohora lo zacha yaasennu betuma
b: Vetipok li daasher lo amar rachamana mishshello hu mevi

Detanya asher lo mishshello hu mevi velo mishshel tzibur yachol lo yavi mishshel tzibur sheen hatztzibur mitkapperin bo aval yavi mishshel echav hakkohanim shehare echav hakkohanim mitkapperim bo talmud lomar asher lo
Yachol lo yavi veim hevi kasher talmud lomar shuv asher lo shana hakkatuv alav leakkev

Velitamach echav hakkohanim i lav dekanu begaveh hechi mechappar lehu ella shane be gazza deaharon deafkereh rachamana gabbe echav hakkohanim hacha gabbe temura name shane be gazza deaharon deafkereh rachamana gabbe echav hakkohanim

Matni haya mehallech bahechal ad shemmaggia leven shette happarochot hammavdilot ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim uvenehen amma rabbi yose omer lo hayeta sham ella parochet achat bilvad shenneemar vehivdila happarochet lachem ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim

Gema shappir kaamar lehu rabbi yose lerabbanan verabbanan amri lecha hane mile bemishkan aval bemikdash sheni kevan dela havay amma teraksin uvmikdash rishon hu dahavay veistappaka lehu lerabbanan bikdushsheteh i kelifnim i kelachutz vaavud shette parochot

Tanu rabbanan ben hammizbeach lammenora haya mehallech divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer ben shulchan lammizbeach veyesh omrim ben shulchan lakkotel man yesh omrim amar rav chisda rabbi yose hi deamar pitcha betzafon kae
Verabbi yehuda amar lach pitcha bedarom kae verabbi meir keman sevira leh i kerabbi yehuda sevira leh neul kerabbi yehuda i kerabbi yose sevira leh neul kerabbi yose
Leolam kerabbi yose sevira leh vaamar lecha shulchanot tzafon vedarom munnachin umafseka leh shulchan vela mitayyel leh
Veibaet ema leolam mizrach umaarav munnachin umishshum shechina lav orach ara

a: Lemeal lehedya verabbi yose amar lach chavivin yisrael shello hitzrichan hakkatuv leshaliach
Verabbi yehuda name neul ben menora lechotel mashchari maneh
Amar rabbi natan amma teraksin lo hichriu bo chachamim i kelifnim i kelachutz

Minnayin lechattat shekkibbel dama bearba kosot venatan mizze achat umizze achat shekkullan nishpachin layesod talmud lomar veet kol damah yishpoch

Ulrabbi eliezer berabbi shimon ha ketiv veet damo yishpoch amar rav ashe lemaote shirayim shebbetzavar behema
Era dam happar letoch dam hassair tenan keman deamar mearvin likranot deitmar rabbi yoshiyya verabbi yonatan chad amar mearvin vechad amar en mearvin
Tistayyem derabbi yoshiyya hu deamar mearvin deamar af al gav dela ketiv yachdav keman dichtiv yachdav dame
Afilu tema rabbi yonatan hu shane hacha dichtiv achat
Tanya dela keshinnuyan velakach middam happar umiddam hassair sheyyihu meoravin divre rabbi yoshiyya

a: Rabbi yonatan omer mizze bifne atzmo umizze bifne atzmo amar lo rabbi yoshiyya vahalo kevar neemar achat
Amar lo rabbi yonatan vahalo kevar neemar middam happar umiddam hassair im ken lamma neemar achat lomar lach achat velo shettayim middam happar achat velo shettayim middam hassair

Tanya idach velakach middam happar umiddam hassair sheyyihu meoravin ze baze atta omer sheyyihu meoravin ze baze o eno ella mizze bifne atzmo umizze bifne atzmo talmud lomar achat ustama kerabbi yoshiyya
Natan et hammale barekan vechu bea mineh rame bar chama merav chisda hinniach mizrak betoch mizrak vekibbel bo et haddam mahu min bemino chotzetz o eno chotzetz
Amar leh tenetuha natan et hammale barekan may lav hoshiv mizrak male letoch mizrak rekan
La era mizrak male letoch mizrak rekan ha tena leh resha era dam happar letoch dam hassair kede learvan yafe yafe
Ta shema haya omed al gabbe keli o al gabbe regel chavero pasul shane regel dela matze mevattel leh
Ika deamri hachi bea mineh derech sherut bechach o en derech sherut bechach ta shema detana deve rabbi yishmael et kol kele hashsharet asher yeshartu vam bakkodesh shene chelim vesherut achat
Bea mineh rame bar chama merav chisda hinniach siv betoch hammizrak vekibbel bo et haddam mahu min besheeno mino chotzetz o eno chotzetz kevan dimchalchel la chayetz o dilma la shena
Amar leh tenena zolef veholech ad shemmaggia lassefog shane mayya diklishi

b: Matni veyatza el hammizbeach asher lifne Adonai ze mizbach hazzahav hitchil mechatte veored mehechan hu matchil mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit tzefonit maaravit maaravit deromit deromit mizrachit makom shehu matchil bachattat al mizbeach hachitzon mishsham haya gomer al mizbeach happenimi
Rabbi eliezer omer bimkomo haya omed umchatte

Tanya idach lifne Adonai ma talmud lomar amar rabbi nechemya lefi shemmatzinu befar vesair shel yom hakkippurim shekkohen omed lifnim min hammizbeach umazze al happarochet beshaa shehu mazze yachol af ze ken
Talmud lomar mizbach ketoret hassammim lifne Adonai asher beohel moed mizbeach lifne Adonai veen kohen lifne Adonai ha ketzad omed chutz lammizbeach umazze

Hitchil mechatte veored vechu tanu rabbanan hitchil mechatte veored mehechan haya matchil mikkeren mizrachit deromit deromit maaravit maaravit tzefonit tzefonit mizrachit divre rabbi akiva rabbi yose haggelili omer mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit tzefonit maaravit maaravit deromit deromit mizrachit
Makom sherabbi yose haggelili matchil sham rabbi akiva posek makom sherabbi akiva matchil sham rabbi yose haggelili posek
Dechulle alma miha behahu keren defaga beresha la aved may tama amar shemuel deamar kera veyatza el hammizbeach ad denafek mikkulleh mizbeach
Ulrabbi akiva nakkef derech yamin lema bidrame bar yechezkel ka mipalgi

Deamar rame bar yechezkel yam sheasa shelomo omed al shenem asar bakar shelosha fonim tzafona ushlosha fonim yamma ushlosha ponim negba ushlosha ponim mizracha vehayyam alehem milmala vechol achorehem bayeta ha lamadta shekkol pinot sheatta pone lo yehu ella derech yamin lammizrach mar it leh derame bar yechezkel umar let leh derame bar yechezkel
La dechulle alma it lehu derame bar yechezkel vehacha beha ka mipalgi mar savar yalfinan penim michutz umar savar la yalfinan penim michutz

Verabbi akiva nehi dela yalef penim michutz i bae hachi naaved i bae hachi naaved amar lach rabbi akiva middina behahu keren defaga beresha behahu aved beresha deamar resh lakish en maavirin al hammitzot
Veammay la aved mishshum dichtiv veyatza el hammizbeach ad denafek mikkulleh mizbeach vechevan deyahev behahu keren hadar ate lehahu keren deichayyav lemitav beresha

a: Vei baet ema i sevira lan hakkafa baregel dechulle alma la peligi deyalfinan penim michutz vehacha beha ka mipalgi mar savar hakkafa bayyad umar savar hakkafa baregel
Vei baet ema dechulle alma hakkafa bayyad vehacha beha ka mipalgi mar savar yalfinan yad meregel umar savar la yalfinan

Vesavar rabbi yose haggelili hakkafa bayyad veha middekatane sefa rabbi eliezer omer bimkomo haya omed umchatte mikkelal detanna kamma la sevira leh ella mechavarta chidshanninan meikara mar savar hakkafa bayyad umar savar hakkafa baregel

Tanya amar rabbi yishmael shene chohanim gedolim nishtayeru bemikdash rishon ze omer beyadi hikkafti veze omer beraglay hikkafti ze noten taam lidvarav veze noten taam lidvarav
Ze noten taam lidvarav saviv demizbeach penimi kesaviv demizbeach hachitzon veze noten taam lidvarav kulleh mizbeach penimi bimkom chada keren dechitzon kae

Rabbi yehuda omer rabbi eliezer omer bimkomo omed umchatte veal kullan hu noten millematta lemala chutz mizzo shehayeta lefanav mammash shennoten mimmala lematta ki hechi dela nitavvesan maneh
Hizza mimmennu al tohoro shel mizbeach may tohoro amar rabba bar rav shela palgeh demizbeach kidamri inashe tehar tihara vehave palgeh deoma

Tanya chananya omer betzad tzefoni hu noten rabbi yose omer betzad deromi hu noten bemay kamipalgi mar savar pitcha bedarom kae umar savar pitcha betzafon kae
Dechulle alma miha hecha degamran mattanot dikranot hatam yahev al gaggo may tama amar kera vetiharo vekiddesho makom shekkiddesho sham tiharo
Sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon deamar kera veet kol dam happar yishpoch vechi nafek behahu paga beresha
Veshel mizbeach hachitzon haya shofech al yesod deromit tanu rabbanan yesod hammizbeach ze yesod deromit atta omer yesod deromit o eno ella yesod maaravit
Amarta yilmad yeridato min hakkevesh litziato min hahechal ma yetziato min hahechal besamuch lo vee ze ze yesod maaravi af yeridato min hakkevesh besamuch lo vee ze ze yesod deromi
Tanya rabbi yishmael omer ze vaze yesod maaravi rabbi shimon ben yochay omer ze vaze yesod deromi bishlama rabbi yishmael kasavar yilmad satum mimmeforash
Ella rabbi shimon ben yochay may tama amar rav ashe kasavar pitcha bedarom kae
Tana deve rabbi yishmael bidve rabbi shimon ben yochay ze vaze yesod deromit vesimanach mashchuh gavre legavra
Ellu vaellu mitarvin baamma veotzin vechu tanu rabbanan moalin bedamim divre rabbi meir verabbi shimon vachachamim omrim en moalin bahen
b: Ad kan la peligi ella midderabbanan aval middeorayeta en moalin bahen
Mena hane mile amar ulla amar kera lachem shellachem yehe deve rabbi shimon tana lechapper lechappara netattiv velo limila
Verabbi yochanan amar amar kera hu lifne chappara kilachar kappara ma leachar kappara en bo meila af lifne kappara en bo meila

Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene chetuvin habbain keechad vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar tere miute ketivi vesamo haarufa

Aval mippigul la tzerich lemaote kera ditnan kol sheyyesh lo mattirin ben leadam ben lemizbeach chayyavin alav mishshum pigul vedam atzmo mattir hu

Attu lerabbi yehuda makom ketiv ella hayenu tameh derabbi yehuda ketiv zot uchtiv achat chad lemaote bigde lavan mibbachutz vechad lemaote bigde zahav
Verabbi nechemya chad lemaote bigde zahav vechad lemaote shirayim dela meakkevi verabbi yehuda i meakkevi meakkevi vei la meakkevi la meakkevi

Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan tanna rabbi nechemya kedivre haomer shirayim meakkevi kashya

Natan miktzat mattanot shebbahechal venishpach haddam yavi dam acher veyatchil battechila bahechal rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim eno matchil ella mimmakom sheppasak

Gamar mattanot shebbahechal venishpach haddam yavi dam acher veyatchil battechila bemattenot hammizbeach natan miktzat mattanot shebbammizbeach venishpach haddam yavi dam acher veyatchil battechila bemattenot hammizbeach rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim mimmakom sheppasak hu matchil gamar mattanot shebbammizbeach venishpach haddam divre hakkol la meakkevi
Amar rabbi yochanan ushnehem mikra echad darshu middam chattat hakkippurim achat bashshana
