Shene seire yom hakkippurim mitzvatan sheyyihu shenehen shavin bammare uvakkoma uvaddamim uvilkichatan keechad veaf al pi sheen shavin kesherin lakach echad hayyom veechad lemachar kesherin
Met echad mehem im ad shello higril met yikkach zug lashsheni veim mishshehigril met yavi zug acher veyagril alehem battechila

Veyomar im shel shem met ze sheala alav haggoral lashshem yitkayyem tachtav veim shel azazel met ze sheala alav haggoral laazazel yitkayyem tachtav vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava sheen chattat tzibbur meta rabbi yehuda omer tamut
Veod amar rabbi yehuda nishpach haddam yamut hammishtalleach met hammishtalleach yishshafech haddam
b: Gema tanu rabbanan yikkach shene seire izzim miut seire shenayim ma talmud lomar shene sheyyihu shenehen shavim minnayin af al pi sheen shenehen shavin kesherin talmud lomar sair sair riba
Tama derabbi rachamana ha la rabbi rachamana hava amena pesulin ikuva mena lan
Salka datach amena shene shene shene ketiv
Vehashta derabbi rachamana sair sair shene shene shene lema li chad lemare vechad lekoma vechad ledamim

Tanya name hachi gabbe kivse metzora yikkach shene kevasim miut kevasim shenayim ma talmud lomar shene sheyyihu shenehen shavin uminnayin sheaf al pi sheen shenehen shavin kesherin talmud lomar keves keves riba
Tama derabbi rachamana ha la rabbi rachamana hava amena pesulin ikuva mena lan salka datach amena tihye ketiv
Vehashta derabbi rachamana keves keves tihye lema li lishar havayato shel metzora
Utnan name gabbe metzora ki hay gavena tzipporim miut tzipporim shenayim ma talmud lomar shette sheyyihu shettehen shaot uminnayin sheaf al pi sheenan shaot kesherot talmud lomar tzippor tzippor riba
Tama derabbi rachamana ha la rabbi rachamana pesulot ikkuva mena lan salka datach amena tihye ketiv
Vehashta derabbi rachamana tzippor tihye lema li lishar havayato shel metzora

I hachi gabbe temidin name nema kevasim miut kevasim shenayim ma talmud lomar shenayim sheyyihu shenehen shavin uminnayin sheaf al pi sheen shenehen shavin kesherin talmud lomar keves keves riba ulmitzva hachi name devaenan
Hahu mibe leh lechidtanya shenayim layyom keneged hayyom

Atta omer keneged hayyom o eno ella chovat hayyom keshehu omer et hakkeves echad taase vabboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim hare chovat hayyom amur uma ani mekayyem shenayim layyom keneged hayyom
Ketzad tamid shel shachar haya nishchat al keren tzefonit maaravit al tabbaat sheniyya veshel ben haarbayim haya nishchat al keren mizrachit tzefonit al tabbaat sheniyya
Musafin shel shabbat vadday tzerichin sheyyihu shenehen shavin
Tanu rabbanan shene seire yom hakkipurim sheshshechatan bachutz ad shello higril alehen chayyav al shenehem mishshehigril alehen chayyav al shel shem ufatur al shel azazel
Ad shello higril alehem chayyav al shenehem lemay chazu amar rav chisda hoil verauy lesair hannaase bachutz
Umay shena lesair hannaase bifnim dela dimchussar hagrala lesair hannaase bachutz name la chaze dimchasseri avodat hayyom
Kasavar rav chisda en mechussar zeman levo bayyom

Amar ravina hashta deamar rav chisda mechussar hagrala kimchussar maase dame ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel shelamim sheshshechatan kodem shenniftechu daltot hahechal pesulin shenneemar ushchato petach ohel moed bizman shehu patuach velo bizman shehu naul

a: Shechatan bachutz kodem shenniftechu daltot hahechal patur may tama mechussar peticha kimchussar maase dame
Umi it leh lerav chisda hoil
Vehaamar rav chisda pesach sheshshechato bachutz bishar yemot hashshana lishmo patur shello lishmo chayyav
Tama deshello lishmo ha setama lishmo hu ufatur veammay lema hoil verauy shello lishmo bifnim
Hachi hashta hatam bae akira hay la bae akira
Rabba bar shimi matne lehu bidrabba vekashya leh derabba adderabba umshanne kidshanninan
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan pesach sheshshechato bachutz bishar yemot hashshana ben lishmo ben shello lishmo patur
Amar rav dimi amritah lishmata kammeh derabbi yirmeya bishlama lishmo deha la chaze leh ella shello lishmo ammay ha chaze shello lishmo bifnim
Vaamar li akirat chutz lav shemah akira
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan pesach sheshshechato bachutz bishar yemot hashshana ben lishmo ben shello lishmo chayyav
Vaafilu lishmo vehatnan mechussar zeman ben begufo ben bivalim
Veezehu mechussar zeman bivalim hazzav vehazzava vehayyoledet vehamtzora
Shehikrivu chattatam vaashamam bachutz peturin olotehen veshalmehen bachutz chayyavin
Vaamar rav chilkiyya bar tovi lo shanu ella lishmo aval shello lishmo chayyav
Lishmo miha patur ammay nema hoil uruyin shello lishmo bifnim hachi hashta hatam bae akira hacha pesach bishar yemot hashshana shelamim ninhu
Rav ashe matne chayyav kidamrinan rav yirmeya middifti matne patur kasavar pesach bishar yemot hashshana bae akira vaakirat chutz lav shemah akira ufliga derav chilkiyya bar tovi
Amar mar mishshehigril alehen chayyav al shel shem ufatur al shel azazel
Tanu rabbanan ish ish mibbet yisrael asher yishchat shor o chesev o ez bammachane o asher yishchat michutz lammachane veel petach ohel moed lo hevio lehakriv korban la
b: I korban shomea ani afilu kodshe bedek habbayit shennikreu korban kainyan shenneemar vannakrev et korban Adonai talmud lomar veel petach ohel moed lo hevio kol harauy lefetach ohel moed chayyav alav bachutz kol sheeno rauy lefetach ohel moed en chayyavin alav bachutz
Otzi ellu sheen reuyin lefetach ohel moed velo otzi parat chattat vesair hammishtalleach shehu rauy lavo el petach ohel moed talmud lomar la mi shemmeuchadin la yatzu ellu sheen meuchadin lashshem
Vela lehotzi hu urminhu yeratze lekorban ishshe la ellu ishim
Minnayin shello yakdishennu mechussar zeman talmud lomar korban la lerabbot sair hammishtalleach
Amar rava hatam meinyana dikra vehacha meinyana dikra hatam deel petach lerabbot la lehotzi hacha deishshe lehotzi la lerabbot
Tama derabbi rachamana ha la rabbi hava amena sair hammishtalleach kadosh bimchussar zeman veha en haggoral kovea ella berauy lashshem
Amar rav yosef ha manni chanan hammitzri hi detanya chanan hammitzri omer afilu dam bakkos mevi chavero umzaveg lo
Emar deshamatte leh lechanan hammitzri delet leh dechuyin delet leh hagrala mi shamatte leh dilma mayete umagril
Ella amar rav yosef ha manni rabbi shimon hi detanya met echad mehen mevi chavero shello behagrala divre rabbi shimon
Ravina amar kegon shehumam vechillo al acher
Umna temra defasel beh muma detanya veishshe lo tittenu mehem ellu hachalavim
En li ella kullan miktzatan minnayin talmud lomar mehem mizbeach zo zerikat damim la lerabbot sair hammishtalleach

Veitzterich lemichtav baal mum veitzterich lemichtav mechussar zeman dei ketav rachamana mechussar zeman mishshum dela mate zimneh aval baal mum demate zimneh ema la vei ketav rachamana baal mum mishshum dimis aval mechussar zeman dela meis ema la tzericha

a: Rava amar kegon shehaya lo chole betoch beto veshachat immo beom hakkippurim
Vechi hay gavena mi asir lo tishchatu amar rachamana veha lav shechita hi ha amri bemareva dechiyyato latztzuk zo hi shechitato
Im shel shem met ze sheala alav vechu
Amar rav sheni shebbezug rishon yikrav sheni shebbezug sheni yire rabbi yochanan amar sheni shebbezug rishon yire sheni shebbazzug sheni yikrav
Bemay ka mipalgi rav savar baale chayyim enan nidchin verabbi yochanan savar baale chayyim nidchin
May tama derav deyalef mimmechussar zeman mechussar zeman lav af al gav dehashta la chaze ki hadar michaze shappir dame hacha name la shena mi dame hatam la itchazi kelal hacha nira venidcha
Ella hayenu tama derav deyalef mibbaal mum over baal mum over lav af al gav dela chaze hashta ki hadar michaze shappir dame hacha name la shena
Vehatam mena lan dichtiv ki moshchatam bahem mum bam mum bam hu delo yeratzu ha avar muman yeratzu
Verabbi yochanan miet rachamana bahem hem hu dechi avar muman yeratzu ha kol dechuyin hoil venidchu nidchu
Verav hahu bahem beenayehu hu dela mirtzu ha al yede taarovot mirtzu

Keditnan evarim temimim beevarim baale mumin rabbi eliezer omer im karav harosh shel echad mehen yakrivu kol harashin kullan keraav shel echad mehen yakrivu kal hakkeraayim kullan vachachamim omrim afilu karvu kullan chutz meechad mehen yetze levet hasserefa
Veidach nafka leh mibbam bahem veidach bam bahem la daresh
Ulrav nehi name devaale chayyim enan nidchin i bae hay nakrev i bae hay nakrev

Amar rava rav savar lah kerabbi yose deamar mitzva barishon he rabbi yose i nema rabbi yose dekuppot ditnan shalosh kuppot shel shalosh shalosh sein shebbahen tormin et hallishka vechatuv alehen alef bet gimel vetanya amar rabbi yose lamma katuv alehen alef bet gimel leda eze mehen nitrema rishon lehavi hemenna rishon shemmitzva barishon
Dilma shane hatam dividana deitchazay kammayeta la itchazay batrayeta

Ella rabbi yose defesach ditnan hammafrish pischo veavad vehifrish acher tachtav veachar kach nimtza harishon vahare shenehen omdin eze mehen sheyyirtze yikrav divre chachamim rabbi yose omer mitzva barishon
b: Veim haya hashsheni muvchar mimmennu yeviennu
Amar rava dayeka matnitin keoteh derav uvarayeta keoteh derabbi yochanan matnitin keoteh derav dekatane im shel shem met ze sheala alav haggoral lashshem yitkayyem tachtav veidach kidkae kae
Barayeta keoteh derabbi yochanan dekatane sheni eni yodea im sheni shebbezug rishon im sheni shebbezug sheni keshehu omer yoomad chay velo shechavero met may mashma yoomad chay velo shekkevar amad

Tenan veod amar rabbi yehuda nishpach haddam yamut hammishtalleach met hammishtalleach yishshafech haddam bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar baale chayyim nidchin mishshum hachi yamut hammishtalleach ella lerav deamar baale chayyim enan nidchin ammay yamut hammishtalleach
Amar lecha rav alliba derabbi yehuda la ka amena ki amena alliba derabbanan
Bishlama lerav beha peligi rabbi yehuda verabbanan ella lerabbi yochanan bemay peligi amar rava ha amrinan dayeka matnitin keoteh derav
Tenan sheen chattat tzibbur meta ha deyachid ki hay gavena meta bishlama lerabbi yochanan kidrabbi abba amar rav deamar rabbi abba amar rav

a: Hakkol modim sheim nitkapper besheenah avuda avuda meta
Ella lerav have leh kemafrish shette chattaot leachraut veamar rabbi oshaya hifrish shette chattaot leachraut mitkapper beachat mehem vehashsheniyya tire
Kevan deamar rava rav savar lah kerabbi yose deamar mitzva barishon meikara kemafrish leibud dame
Tenan rabbi yehuda omer tamut bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar sheni shebbezug rishon yire lerabbi yehuda yamut mitkapper bashsheni shebbezug sheni
Ella lerav deamar sheni shebbezug sheni yire lerabbi yehuda yamut lerabbi yehuda bemay mikappar mi savratte rabbi yehuda ashsheni shebbezug sheni kae rabbi yehuda ashsheni shebbezug rishon kae
Veika deka motev hachi veod amar rabbi yehuda nishpach haddam yamut hammishtalleach met hammishtalleach yishshafech haddam
Bishlama lerav resha peligi bechattat tzibbur vesefa peligi bevaale chayyim ella lerabbi yochanan may veod kashya
Veod amar rabbi yehuda nishpach haddam yamut hammishtalleach bishlama nishpach haddam yamut hammishtalleach deakkatti la itavid mitzveteh
Ella met hammishtalleach ammay yishshafech haddam ha itavid leh mitzveteh
Amri deve rabbi yannay amar kera yoomad chay lifne Adonai lechapper ad matay yehe zakuk lihot chay ad sheat mattan damim shel chavero
Tenan hatam bene hair sheshshalchu et shiklehen venignevu o sheavdu im nitrema teruma nishbain legizbarin
Veim lav nishbain livne hair uvne hair shoklin acherim tachtehen
Nimtzeu o shehechzirum haggannavim ellu vaellu shekalim hem veen olin lahen leshana habbaa rabbi yehuda omer olin lahen leshana habbaa
May tama derabbi yehuda amar rava kasavar rabbi yehuda chovot shel shana zo kerevot leshana habbaa

Etiveh abbaye par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen vechen seire avoda zara sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen kullan yamutu divre rabbi yehuda rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon omrim yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu demehem lindava sheen chattat tzibbur meta amar leh
b: Korbenot tzibbur ka amratte shane korbenot tzibbur kidrabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya deamar rabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya amar kera zot olat chodesh bechodsho amra tora chaddesh vehave li korban mitteruma chadasha
Tinach sair par may ika lememar gezera par attu sair

Umishshum gezera yamutu veod ha derabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya gufah mitzva hi deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel korbenot tzibbur habbain beechad benisan mitzva lehavi min hechadash veim hevi min hayyashan yatza ella shechisser mitzva
Ella amar rabbi zera lefi sheen haggoral kovea mishshana lachavertah venayete venagrel gezera shemma yomru haggoral kovea mishshana lachavertah
Ha tinach sair par may ika lememar gezera par attu sair umishshum gezera yamutu
Amruha rabbanan kammeh deabbaye gezera mishshum chattat shemmetu bealeha ha tinach par sair may ika lememar gezera sair attu par
Umishshum gezera yamutu ella gezera mishshum chattat sheibbera shenatah gezera hi gufah chattat sheibbera shenatah hi
Ha la kashya kerabbi detanya shana temima mone shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha yom keminyan yemot hachamma divre rabbi vachachamim omrim mone shenem asar chodesh miyyom leom

a: Veim nitabbera nitabbera lammocher hatinach sair par may ika lememar gezera par attu sair
Umishshum gezera yamut veod chattat sheibbera shenatah liriyya azla deamar resh lakish chattat sheibbera shenatah roin otah keilu hi omedet bevet hakkevarot veroa
Ella amar rava gezera mishshum takkala en makdishin veen maarichin veen machrimin bazzeman hazze
Veim hikdish veheerich vehechrim behema teaker perot kesut vechelim yerakvu maot uchle mattachot yolich hanaa leyam hammelach vee ze hu ikur noel delet lefaneha vehi meta meeleha
Takkala demay i takkala dehakrava afilu kol reiyyot name i takkala degiza vaavoda afilu kol reiyyot name
Leolam takkala dehakrava vehanach delav bene hakrava ninhu la terid behu hach devat hakrava hi terid bah
Vetakkala atzmah tannae hi detanya chada pesach shello karav berishon yikrav bashsheni bashsheni yikrav leshana habbaa vetanya idach lo yikrav may lav betakkala peligi
La dechulle alma la chayeshinan letakkala vehacha biflugta derabbi verabbanan ka mipalgi vela kashya ha rabbi ha rabbanan
Vehatanya vechen hammaot ella lav shema minah betakkala peligi shema minah

Matni ba lo etzel sair hammishtalleach vesomech shette yadav alav umitvadde vechach haya omer ana hashshem chatu au pashu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael ana hashshem kapper na lachataim velaaonot velappeshaim shechatu vesheau vesheppashu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha lemor ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu

Vehakkohanim vehaam haomdim baazara keshehau shomim shem hammeforash shehu yotze mippi kohen gadol hau korim umishtachavim venoflim al penehem veomrim baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed mesaro lemi shehaya molicho hakkol kesherin leholicho ella sheasu hakkohanim gedolim keva velo hau mannichin et yisrael leholicho
Amar rabbi yose maase veholicho arsela veyisrael haya vechevesh asu lo mippene habbavliyyim shehau metalleshim bisaro veomrim lo tol vatze tol vatze
Gema veilu bene aharon am kedoshecha la kaamar man tanna amar rabbi yirmeya dela kerabbi yehuda dei kerabbi yehuda ha amar yesh lahem kappara besair hammishtalleach
Abbaye amar afilu tema rabbi yehuda attu kohanim lav bichlal ammecha yisrael ninhu
Mesaro lemi shemmolicho tanu rabbanan ish lehachshir et hazzar itti
b: Sheyehe mezumman itti vaafilu beshabbat itti vaafilu betuma
Ish lehachshir et hazzar peshita mahu detema kappara ketiva beh ka mashma lan
Itti vaafilu beshabbat lemay hilcheta amar rav sheshet lomar sheim haya chole markivo al ketefo
Keman dela kerabbi natan dei rabbi natan haamar chay nose et atzmo afilu tema rabbi natan chala shane
Amar rafram zot omeret eruv vehotzaa leshabbat veen eruv vehotzaa leom hakkippurim
Itti vaafilu betuma lemay hilcheta amar rav sheshet lomar sheim nitma meshallecho nichnas tame laazara umshallecho
Shaalu et rabbi eliezer chala mahu sheyyarkivehu al ketefo amar lahem yachol hu leharkiv ani veattem chala meshallecho mahu sheyeshallechennu beyad acher amar lahem ehe beshalom ani veattem

Dechafo velo met mahu sheyyered acharav vimitennu amar lahem ken yovdu chol oyevecha Adonai vachachamim omrim chala markivo al ketefo chala meshallecho yeshallechennu beyad acher dechafo velo met yered acharav vimitennu
Shaalu et rabbi eliezer peloni mahu laolam habba amar lahem lo sheeltuni ella al peloni

Mahu lehatztzil roe kivsa min haari amar lahem lo sheeltuni ella al hakkivsa mahu lehatztzil haroe min haari amar lahem lo sheeltuni ella al haroe mamzer ma hu lirash mahu leyabbem mahu lasud et beto mahu lasud et kivro
Lo mippene shehifligan bidvarim ella mippene shello amar davar shello shama mippi rabbo meolam
Shaala ishsha chachama et rabbi eliezer meachar shemmaase haegel shavin mippene ma en mitatan shava amar lah en chochma laishsha ella befelech vechen hu omer vechol ishsha chachmat lev beyadeha tau
Itmar rav velevi chad amar zibeach vekiter besayif gippef venishek bemita samach bilvavo behidrokan
Vechad amar edim vehatraa besayif edim belo hatraa bemita lo edim velo hatraa behidrokan
Amar rav yehuda shivto shel levi lo avad avoda zara shenneemar vayyaamod moshe beshaar hammachane vego
Yatev ravina vekaamar leha shemata etiveh bene rav pappa bar abba leravina haomer leaviv ulimmo lo reitiv
Aviv avi immo miyyisrael echav echav meimmo miyyisrael banav bene vitto miyyisrael

Vechevesh asu lo ku amar rabba bar bar chana lo bavliyyim hau ella alekkesanderiyyim hau umittoch shessonim et habbavliyyim hau korin otan al sheman tanya rabbi yehuda omer lo bavliyyim hau ella alekkesanderiyyim hau amar lo rabbi yose tanuach datecha shehinnachta et dati
Tol vatze tana ma shahe tzafira den vechove dara saggiin
Matni miyyakkire yerushalayim hau melavin oto ad sukka harishona eser sukkot mirushalayim vead tzuk

a: Tishim ris shiva umechetza lechol mil al kol sukka vesukka omrin lo hare mazon vahare mayim umlavin oto missukka lesukka chutz meacharon shebbahen sheeno maggia immo latztzuk ella omed merachok veroe et maasav

Me haya ose cholek lashon shel zehorit chetzo kashur bassela vechetzo kashur ben shene karnav udchafo laachorav vehu mitgalgel veored velo haya maggia lachatzi hahar ad shennaase evarim evarim ba veyashav lo tachat sukka acharona ad shettechshach umeematay metamme begadim mishsheyyetze chutz lechomat yerushalayim rabbi shimon omer mishsheat dechiyyato latztzuk
Gema tanu rabbanan eser sukkot ushnem asar milin hau divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer tesha sukkot vaasara milin rabbi yose omer chamesh sukkot vaasara milin hau vechullan al yede eruv
Amar rabbi yose sach li elazar beni im al yede eruv yacholni laasot afilu shette sukkot vaasara milin
Keman azla ha detanya chutz meacharon shebbahen shello higgia immo latztzuk ella omed merachok veroe et maasav keman kerabbi meir
Al kol sukka vesukka omrim lo hare mazon vahare mayim tana meolam lo hutzrach adam lechach ella sheeno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo lemi sheen lo pat besallo
Me haya ose cholek lashon shel zehorit veniktereh kulleh besela kevan demitzva besair dilma kadem umalbin umiyyatteva dateh
Veniktereh kulleh ben karnav zimnin degamesh leh leresheh velav addateh

Tanu rabbanan barishona hau koshrin lashon shel zehorit al petach haulam mibbachutz hilbin hau semechin lo hilbin hau atzevin umitbayeshin hitkinu sheyyihu koshrin al petach ulam mibbifnim vaadayin hau metzitzin veroin hilbin hau semechin lo hilbin hau atzevin hitkinu sheyyihu koshrin oto chetzo besela vechetzo ben karnav

Amar rabbi nachum bar pappa mishshum rabbi elazar hakkappar barishona hau koshrin lashon shel zehorit al petach ulam mibbifnim vechevan shehiggia sair lammidbar haya malbin veyadu shennaaset mitzvato shenneemar im yihu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu
Lo haya maggia lemachatzit hahar ibaya lehu otan evarim ma hen bahanaa rav ushmuel chad amar muttarin vechad amar asurin
Man deamar muttarin
b: Dichtiv bammidbar uman deamar asurin dichtiv gezera
Uman deamar asurin hay midbar may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya hammidbara hammidbara bammidbar lerabbot nov vegivon shilo uvet olamim
Veidach hay gezera may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya gezera en gezera ella chatucha davar acher en gezera ella davar hammitgazzer veored
Davar acher gezera shemma tomar maase tohu hu talmud lomar ani Adonai ani Adonai gezartiv veen lecha reshut leharher bahen
Amar rava mistabbera keman deamar muttarin lo amra tora shallach letakkala
Tanu rabbanan azazel sheyehe az vekashe yachol bayyishshuv talmud lomar bammidbar uminnayin shebbetzuk talmud lomar gezera tanya idach azazel kashe shebbeharim vechen hu omer veet ele haaretz lakach
Tana deve rabbi yishmael azazel shemmechapper al maase uzza veazzael
Tanu rabbanan et mishpatay taasu devarim sheilmale lo nichtevu din hu sheyyikkatvu veellu hen avoda zara vegilluy araot ushfichut damim vegazel uvirkat hashshem

Et chukkotay tishmeru devarim shehassatan meshiv alehen veellu hen achilat chazir ulvishat shaatnez vachalitzat yevama vetohorat metzora vesair hammishtalleach veshemma tomar maase tohu hem talmud lomar ani Adonai ani Adonai chakaktiv veen lecha reshut leharher bahen
Ematay metamme begadim tanu rabbanan hamshalleach metamme begadim veen hashsholeach et hamshalleach metamme begadim

Yachol mishsheyyetze chutz lechomat azara talmud lomar hamshalleach i hamshalleach yachol ad sheyyaggia latztzuk talmud lomar vehamshalleach ha ketzad mishsheyyetze chutz lechomat yerushalayim divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi yose omer azazel vechibbes ad shehiggia latztzuk rabbi shimon omer vehamshalleach et hassair laazazel yechabbes begadav zorko bevat rosh umtamme begadim
Matni ba lo etzel par vesair hannisrafin keraan vehotzi et emurehen netanan bemages vehiktiran al gabbe hammizbeach
Kelaan bemiklaot vehotzian levet hasserefa umeematay metammein begadim mishsheyyetzu chutz lechomat haazara rabbi shimon omer mishsheyyatztzit haur berubban
Gema vehiktiran salka datach ella ema lehaktiran al gabbe mizbeach

Kelaan bemiklaot amar rabbi yochanan kemin kelia tana lo haya menattechan nituach besar ola ella or al gabbe basar mena hane mile detanya rabbi omer neemar kan or uvasar vaferesh veneemar lehallan or uvasar vaferesh

a: Ma lehallan al yede nituach velo al yede hefshet af kan al yede nituach velo al yede hefshet

Vehatam mena lan detanya vekirbo ufirsho vehotzi melammed shemmotzio shalem yachol yisrefennu shalem neemar kan rosho uchraav veneemar lehallan rosh uchraayim ma lehallan al yede nituach af kan al yede nituach
I ma lehallan al yede hefshet af kan al yede hefshet talmud lomar vekirbo ufirsho may talmuda amar rav pappa keshem sheppirsho bekirbo kach besaro beoro
Meematay metammein begadim tanu rabbanan yotzi el michutz lammachane vesarfu
Lehallan atta noten lahem shalosh machanot vechan atta noten lahem machane achat im ken lamma neemar michutz lammachane lomar lach kevan sheyyatza chutz lemachane achat metammeim begadim
Vehatam mena lan detanya vehotzi et kol happar chutz leshalosh machanot

Atta omer chutz leshalosh machanot o eno ella chutz lemachane achat keshehu omer befar haeda el michutz lammachane sheen talmud lomar shehare kevar neemar vesaraf oto kaasher saraf et happar harishon uma talmud lomar el michutz lammachane liten lo machane sheniyya
Uchshehu omer michutz lammachane baddeshen sheen talmud lomar shehare kevar neemar el shefech haddeshen ten lo machane shelishit

Verabbi shimon hay michutz lammachane may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya rabbi eliezer omer neemar kan michutz lammachane veneemar lehallan michutz lammachane ma kan chutz leshalosh machanot af lehallan chutz leshalosh machanot uma lehallan bemizrachah shel yerushalayim af kan bemizrachah shel yerushalayim
Verabbanan hecha saref lehu kidtanya hechan nisrafin
b: Litzfonah shel yerushalayim vechutz leshalosh machanot rabbi yose omer abbet haddeshen nisrafin
Amar rava man tena diflig aleh derabbi yose rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hu detanya el shefech haddeshen yissaref sheyehe leshem deshen rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer sheyehe mekomo meshuppach
Amar leh abbaye vedilma bimkomo meshuppach hu difligi
Tanu rabbanan vehassoref hassoref metamme begadim velo hammatztzit et haur velo hamsadder et hammaaracha vee zehu hassoref ze hamsayyea bishat serefa

Yachol af mishshennaasu efer metammein begadim talmud lomar otam otam metammein begadim velo mishshennaasu efer metammein begadim rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer happar metamme nitach habbasar eno metamme begadim
May benayehu ika benayehu deshavveyeh charocha
Matni amru lo lechohen gadol higgia sair lammidbar uminnayin hau yodin shehiggia sair lammidbar dirkaot hau osin umnifin besudarin veodin shehiggia sair lammidbar
Amar rabbi yehuda vahalo siman gadol haya lahem mirushalayim vead bet chadodo shelosha milin holchin mil vechozrin mil veshohin kede mil veodin shehiggia sair lammidbar

Rabbi yishmael omer vahalo siman acher haya lahem lashon shel zehorit haya kashur al pitcho shel hechal uchshehiggia sair lammidbar haya hallashon malbin shenneemar im yihu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu
Gema amar abbaye shema minah bet chadodo bammidbar kayema veha ka mashma lan dekasavar rabbi yehuda kevan shehiggia sair lammidbar naaset mitzvato
Hadaran alach shene seire
Ba lo kohen gadol likrot im ratza likrot bevigde vutz kore veim lav kore beitztelit lavan mishshello

Chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotno lerosh hakkeneset verosh hakkeneset notno lassegan vehassegan notno lechohen gadol vechohen gadol omed umkabbel vekore beachare mot veach beasor vegolel sefer tora umannicho becheko veomer yoter mimma shekkarati lifnechem katuv kan uveasor shebbechomesh happekudim kore al pe

Umvarech aleha shemone berachot al hattora veal haavoda veal hahodaa veal mechilat heaon veal hammikdash bifne atzmo veal yisrael bifne atzman veal yerushalayim bifne atzmah veal hakkohanim bifne atzman veal shear hattefilla

Haroe kohen gadol keshehu kore eno roe par vesair hannisrafin veharoe par vesair hannisrafin eno roe kohen gadol keshehu kore velo mippene sheeno rashshay ella shehayeta derech rechoka umlechet shenehen shava keachat
Gema middekatane beitztelit lavan mishshello mikkelal dikria lav avoda hi
Vekatane im ratza likrot bevigde vutz kore shamatte minah bigde chehunna nitnu lehanot bahen dilma shane keria detzorech avoda hi
Deibaya lan bigde chehunna nitnu lehanot bahen o lo nitnu lehanot bahen
Ta shema lo hau yeshenim bevigde kodesh shena hu dela ha mechal achli dilma shane achila detzorech avoda hi kidtanya veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem melammed shehakkohanim ochlim uvalim mitkapperin
Shena hu dela ha halloche mehallechi bedin hu dehalloche name la

a: Vesefa itztericha leh poshtin umkappelin umannichin tachat rashehem

Poshtin umkappelin umannichin otan tachat rashehen shamatte minah bigde kehunna nitnu lehanot bahen amar rav pappa la tema tachat rashehen ella ema keneged rashehen amar rav mesharsheya shamatte minah tefilin min hatztzad shappir dame
Hachi name mistabbera dichneged rashehen dei salka datach tachat rashehen vetipok li mishshum kilayim deha ika avnet unhi name denitnu lehanot bahen ha mithane mikkilayim
Hanicha leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol ze hu avneto shel kohen hedot ella leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol lo ze hu avneto shel kohen hedot may ika lememar

Vechi tema kilayim bilvisha vehaalaa hu daasir behatztzaa shere vehatanya lo yaale alecha aval atta muttar lehatztzio tachtecha aval amru chachamim asur laasot ken shemma tikarech nima achat al besaro

Vechi tema demafsek leh mide bene bene vehaamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar rabbi mishshum kehala kaddisha shebbirushalayim afilu eser matztzaot zo al gav zo vechilayim tachtehen asur lishan alehen ella lav shema minah keneged rashehen shema minah
Rav ashe amar leolam tachat rashehen veha ka mithane mikkilayim bigde chehunna kashin hen ki ha deamar rav huna bereh derabbi yehoshua hay namta gamda denaresh sharya
Ta shema bigde chehunna hayyotze bahen lammedina asur uvammikdash ben bishat avoda ben shello bishat avoda muttar mippene shebbigde chehunna nitnu lehanot bahen shema minah
Uvammedina la vehatanya beesrim vachamishsha betevet yom har gerizim hu dela lemispad

Yom shebbikkeshu kutiyyim et bet elohenu mealekkesanderos mokdon lehachrivo venatnu lahem bau vehodiu et shimon hatztzaddik me asa lavash bigde chehunna venitattef bevigde chehunna umiyyakkire yisrael immo vaavukot shel or bidehen vechol hallayela hallalu holchim mitztzad ze vehallalu holchim mitztzad ze ad sheala ammud hashshachar

Kevan sheala ammud hashshachar amar lahem mi hallalu amru lo yehudim shemmardu becha kevan shehiggia leantipatres zarcha chamma ufagu ze baze kevan sheraa leshimon hatztzaddik yarad mimmerkavto vehishtachava lefanav amru lo melech gadol kemotcha yishtachave lihudi ze amar lahem demut deokno shel ze menatztzachat lefanay bevet milchamti

Amar lahem lamma batem amru efshar bayit shemmitpallelim bo alecha veal malchutcha shello techrav yatucha goyim lehachrivo amar lahem mi hallalu amru lo kutiyyim hallalu sheomdim lefanecha amar lahem hare hem mesurin bidechem

Miyyad nekavum beikvehem utlaum bezanve susehem vehau megarrin otan al hakkotzim veal habbarkanim ad shehiggiu lehar gerizim kevan shehiggiu lehar gerizim charashuhu uzrauhu karshinin kederech shebbikkeshu laasot levet elohenu veoto hayyom asauhu yom tov
I baet ema reuyin levigde chehunna vei baet ema et laasot la heferu toratecha
Chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora shema minah cholkin kavod letalmid bimkom harav amar abbaye kullah mishshum kevodo dechohen gadol hi
Vechohen gadol omed mikkelal shehu yoshev veha anan tenan
b: En yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad shenneemar vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai kidamar rav chisda beezrat nashim hacha name beezrat nashim

Vehecha itmar derav chisda aha metivi detanya hechan korin bo baazara rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer behar habbayit shenneemar vayyikra vo lifne harchov asher lifne shaar hammayim veamar rav chisda beezrat nashim
Vayevarech ezra et Adonai haelohim haggadol may gadol amar rav yosef amar rav sheggiddelo beshem hamforash rav gidel amar baruch Adonai elohe yisrael min haolam vead haolam
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi vedilma sheggidlo beshem hamforash amar leh en omrim shem hamforash bigvulim
Vela vehachtiv vayyaamod ezra hassofer al migdal etz asher asu laddavar veamar rav gidel sheggiddelo beshem hamforash horaat shaa hayeta

Vayyitzaku el Adonai elohim bekol gadol may amur amar rav veitema rabbi yochanan biyya biyya hayenu hay deachreveh lemakdesha vekalyeh lehechleh vekatlinhu lechullehu tzaddike veaglinhu leyisrael mearahon vaadayin merakked benan kelum yehavteh lan ella lekabbole beh agra la ihu baenan vela agreh baenan
Nefal lehu pitka merkia dahava ketiv beh emet
Amar rav chanina shema minah chotamo shel hakkadosh baruch hu emet
Otivu betaanita telata yomin utlata lelavata masruhu nihalayehu nefak ata ki gurya denura mibbet kadshe hakkodashim amar lehu navi leyisrael hayenu yitzra daavoda zara shenneemar vayyomer zot harisha

Bahade detafsuh leh ishtemit binita mimmazzeye urma kala vaazal kaleh arba mea parse amru hechi naaved dilma chas veshalom merachami aleh min shemayya amar lehu navi shaduhu beduda daavara vechafuhu lefummeh baavara daavara mishav shaev kala shenneemar vayyomer zot harisha vayyashlech otah el toch haefa vayyashlech et even haoferet el piha
Amaru hoil veet ratzon hu nive rachame ayyitzra daavera beo rachame veimmesar bidayehu

Amar lehu chazo dei katlitu leh lehahu kale alma chavshuhu telata yome uvau beata bat yoma bechol eretz yisrael vela ishtechach amri hechi naaved nikteleh kale alma nive rachame appalga palga birkia la yahavi kachlinhu leeneh veshavkuhu veahni dela migare beh leinish bekarivteh
Bemareva matnu hachi rav gidel amar gadol sheggiddelo beshem hamforash verav matna amar hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora

Veha derav matna matya lidrabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi lamma nikra sheman anshe keneset haggedola shehechziru atara leoshnah ata moshe amar hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora ata yirmeya vaamar goyim mekarkerin behechalo ayye norotav la amar nora ata daniel amar goyim mishtabedim bevanav ayye gevurotav la amar gibbor

Ato inhu veamru adderabba zo hi gevurat gevurato shekkovesh et yitzro shennoten erech appayim larshaim veellu hen norotav sheilmale morao shel hakkadosh baruch hu heach umma achat yechola lehitkayyem ben haummot
Verabbanan hechi avdi hachi veakri takkanta detakken moshe amar rabbi elazar mittoch sheyyodin behakkadosh baruch hu sheamitti hu lefichach lo kizvu bo
Vekore achare mot veach beasor urminhi medallegin bannavi veen medallegin battora
La kashya kan bichde sheyyafsik hatturgeman kan bichde shello yafsik hatturgeman
Veha alah katane medallegin bannavi veen medallegin battora vead kamma medalleg bichde shello yafsik hatturgeman ha battora kelal kelal la
Amar abbaye la kashya kan beinyan echad kan bishne inyanin
Vehatanya medallegin battora beinyan echad uvannavi bishne inyanin kan vechan bichde shello yafsik hatturgeman veen medallegin minnavi lenavi uvannavi shel shenem asar medallegin

a: Uvilvad shello yedalleg missof hassefer litchilato
Vegolel sefer tora vechu vechol kach lamma kede shello lehotzi laaz al sefer tora
Uveasor shel chomesh happekudim kore al pe ammay niglol venikre amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar rav sheshet lefi sheen gollin sefer tora betzibur mippene kevod tzibur
Venayete acharina venikre rav huna bar yehuda amar mishshum pegamo shel rishon veresh lakish amar mishshum beracha sheenah tzericha

Umi chayeshinan lifgama vehaamar rabbi yitzchak nappacha rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihot beshabbat meviin shalosh torot vekorin achat beinyano shel yom veachat shel rosh chodesh veachat shel chanukka
Telata gavre bitlata sifre leka pegama chad gavra bitre sifre ika pegama

Umvarech aleha shemone berachot tanu rabbanan al hattora kederech shemmevarchim bevet hakkeneset al haavoda veal hahodaa veal mechilat heaon ketiknah veal hammikdash bifne atzmo veal hakkohanim bifne atzman veal yisrael bifne atzman veal shear tefilla

Tanu rabbanan ushar hattefilla rinna techina bakkasha millefanecha al ammecha yisrael shetztzerichin lehivasha vechotem beshomea tefilla veachar kach kol echad veechad mevi sefer tora mibbeto vekore bo kede leharot chazuto lerabbim
Haroe kohen gadol ku lo mippene sheeno rashshay peshita mahu detema kidresh lakish deamar resh lakish en maavirin al hammitzot
Umay mitzva berov am hadrat melech ka mashma lan
Matni im bevigde vutz kore kiddesh yadav veraglav pashat yarad vetaval ala venistappag veheviu lo bigde zahav velavash vekiddesh yadav veraglav

Veyatza veasa et elo veet el haam veet shivat kevasim temimim bene shana divre rabbi eliezer rabbi akiva omer im tamid shel shachar hau kerevin ufar haola vesair hannaase bachutz hau kerevin im tamid shel ben haarbayim
Kiddesh yadav veraglav ufashat veyarad vetaval veala venistappag
Heviu lo bigde lavan velavash vekiddesh yadav veraglav nichnas lehotzi et hakkaf veet hammachta kiddesh yadav veraglav ufashat veyarad vetaval ala venistappag
Heviu lo bigde zahav velavash vekiddesh yadav veraglav venichnas lehaktir ketoret shel ben haarbayim ulhetiv et hannerot vekiddesh yadav veraglav ufashat veyarad vetaval ala venistappag
Heviu lo bigde atzmo velavash umlavin oto ad beto veom tov haya ose leohavav beshaa sheyyatza beshalom min hakkodesh
Gema ibaya lehu hechi kaamar im tamid shel shachar hau kerevin ufar haola vesair hannaase bachutz im tamid shel ben haarbayim
O dilma hachi kaamar im tamid shel shachar hau kerevin ufar haola bahadayehu vesair hannaase bachutz im tamid shel ben haarbayim
Vetu par haola lerabbi eliezer deshayereh emat aved leh
Vetu ben lerabbi eliezer ben lerabbi akiva emure chattat emat aved lehu
Amar rava la mashkachatte lah metakkanta ella o lerabbi eliezer detana bidve shemuel o lerabbi akiva kidtosefta
Detana deve shemuel rabbi eliezer omer yatza veasa elo veel haam veemure chattat aval par haola veshivat kevasim vesair hannaase bachutz im tamid shel ben haarbayim
Rabbi akiva detosefta may hi detanya rabbi akiva omer par haola veshivat kevashim im tamid shel shachar hau kerevin shenneemar millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid veachar kach avodat hayyom
b: Veachar kach sair hannaase bachutz shenneemar seir izzim echad chattat millevad chattat hakkippurim veachar kach elo veel haam veachar kach emure chattat veachar kach tamid shel ben haarbayim
May tama derabbi eliezer aved kedichtiv aved beresha detorat kohanim vahadar aved dechomesh happekudim
Verabbi akiva kidkatane tama millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid alma musafin im tamid shel shachar aved lehu
Verabbi eliezer hay millevad chattat hakkippurim may aved leh hahu mibe leh al ma shezze mechapper ze mechapper

Rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo echad karev im tamid shel shachar veshishsha im tamid shel ben haarbayim rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer mishshemo shishsha kerevin im tamid shel shachar veechad im tamid shel ben haarbayim
May tamayehu derabbanan tere kerae ketivi ketiv millevad olat habboker uchtiv veyatza veasa et olato hilkach aved minnayehu hacha umanayehu hacha
Bemay ka mipalgi rabbi yehuda savar aved chad kedichtiv millevad olat habboker vahadar aved avodat hayyom dilma chulsha chalesh kohen gadol
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar kevan deatchel aved shishsha dilma pasha dilgabbe avodat hayyom zariz hu

Dechulle alma mihat chad ayil hu keman kerabbi detanya rabbi omer ayil echad haamur kan hu haamur bechomesh happekudim rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer shene elim hen echad haamur kan veechad haamur bechomesh happekudim
May tama derabbi dichtiv echad verabbi elazar berabbi shimon may echad meuchad shebbeedro
Verabbi nafka leh mimmivchar nedarecha verabbi elazar berabbi shimon chad bechova vechad bindava utzrichi
Kidesh yadav veraglav tanu rabbanan uva aharon el ohel moed lama hu ba lehotzi et hakkaf veet hammachta

a: Shekkol happarasha kullah neemra al hasseder chutz mippasuk ze
May tama amar rav chisda gemiri chamesh tevilot vaasara kidushin tovel kohen gadol umkaddesh bo bayyom
Vei amratte kesidran ketivi la mashkachatte lah ella shalosh tevilot veshishsha kidushin
Matkef lah rabbi zera vedilma mafsek leh besair hannaase bachutz
Amar abbaye amar kera veyatza veasa et olato mitzia rishona aved elo veel haam
Rava amar amar kera ufashat et bigde habbad sheen talmud lomar asher lavash kelum adam poshet ella ma shellovesh ella ma talmud lomar asher lavash shellavash kevar
Matkef lah rabba bar rav shela veema demafsek leh besair hannaase bachutz hachtiv veyatza veasa

Vechol happarasha kullah neemra al hasseder veha kerae ketivi veet chelev hachattat yaktir hammizbecha vahadar veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat veilu anan tenan haroe et kohen gadol keshehu kore eno roe par vesair hannisrafin veilu emure chattat batar hachi makter lehu
Ema chutz mippasuk ze veelach
Umay chazet dimshabbeshatte kerae shabbesh matnita
Amar abbaye amar kera vehamshalleach vehassoref ma meshalleach demeikara af soref demeikara
Adderabba ma soref dehashta af meshalleach dehashta
Vehamshalleach demeikara mashma rava amar amar kera yoomad chay ad matay yehe zakuk laamod chay ad sheat kappara veematay sheat kappara bishat mattan damim vetu la
Ate meshalleach metzao bashshuk lechohen gadol omer lo ishi kohen gadol asinu shelichutcha metzao beveto omer lo mechayye chayyim asinu shelichuto
Amar rabba ki mipatri rabbanan mehadade befumbedita amri hachi mechayye chayyim yitten lecha chayyim arukkim vetovim umtukkanin
Ethallech lifne Adonai beartzot hachayyim amar rav yehuda ze makom shevakim
Ki orech yamim ushnot chayyim veshalom yosifu lach vechi yesh shanim shel chayyim veyesh shanim sheenan shel chayyim amar rabbi elazar ellu shenotav shel adam hammithappechot alav meraa letova

Alechem ishim ekra amar rabbi berechya ellu talmide chachamim sheddomin lenashim veosin gevura kaanashim veamar rabbi berechya harotze lenassech yayin al gabbe hammizbeach yemalle geronam shel talmide chachamim yayin shenneemar alechem ishim ekra
Veamar rabbi berechya im roe adam shettora poseket mizzaro yissa bat talmid chacham shenneemar im yazkin baaretz shorsho uveafar yamut gizo
b: Mereach mayim yafriach veasa katzir kemo nata

Veom tov haya ose leohavav tanu rabbanan maase bechohen gadol echad sheyyatza mibbet hammikdash vahao azli kulle alma batreh kevan dechazunhu lishmaya veavtalon shavkuhu ledideh veazli batar shemaya veavtalon

Lesof ato shemaya veavtalon leiptore mineh dechohen gadol amar lahen yeton bene ammin lishlam amaru leh yeton bene ammin lishlam deavdin ovada deaharon vela yete bar aharon lishlam dela aved ovada deaharon

Matni kohen gadol meshammesh bishmona kelim vehahedot bearbaa bichtonet umichnasayim umitznefet veavnet mosif alav kohen gadol choshen veefod umil vetzitz beellu nishalin beurim vetummim veen nishalin ella lemelech ulav bet din ulmi shehatztzibur tzarich bo
Gema tanu rabbanan devarim shenneemar bahen shesh chutan kaful shishsha moshzar shemona meil shenem asar parochet esrim vearbaa choshen veefod esrim ushmona

Chutan kaful shishsha mena lan deamar kera vayyaasu et hakkotnot shesh veet hammitznefet shesh veet paare hammigbaot shesh veet michnese habbad shesh moshzar chamsha kerae ketivi chad legufeh dechitana niho vechad sheyehe chutan kaful shishsha vechad sheyyihu shezurin vechad lishar begadim shello neemar bahen shesh vechad leakkev

May mashma dehay shesh kitana hu amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar kera bad davar haole min hakkarka bad bad veema amra amra iptzole mipatzla kitana name iptzole mippetzil kitana aggav lakuteh mippetzil
Ravina amar mehacha paare fishtim yihu al rosham umichnese fishtim yihu al motnehem

Amar leh rav ashe ha mikkamme deate yechezkel man amrah ultamach ha deamar rav chisda davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu middivre yechezkel ben buzi lamadnu kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi ha mikkamme deate yechezkel man amrah ella gemara gemiri lah vaata yechezkel veasmechah akkera hacha name gemara gemiri lah vaata yechezkel veasmechah akkera

Moshzar shemona mena lan dichtiv vayyaasu al shule hammeil rimmone techelet veargaman vetolaat shani moshzar veyalef moshzar moshzar mipparochet ma lehallan esrim vearbaa af kan esrim vearbaa dahava kol chad vechad tamne

Venelaf mechoshen veefod ma lehallan esrim ushmona af kan esrim ushmona danin davar shello neemar bo zahav middavar shello neemar bo zahav leappoke choshen veefod shenneemar bahen zahav adderabba danin beged mibbeged leappoke parochet deohel hu
Ella danin meavnet vedanin beged vedavar shello neemar bo zahav mibbeged vedavar shello neemar bo zahav veen danin davar sheen bo zahav middavar sheyyesh bo zahav
Rav mari amar taasennu ketiv taasennu laze velo leacher
Rav ashe amar veasita ketiv sheyyihu kol asiyyot shaot vehechi nebed nebed telata deasra asra hau lehu telatin nebed tere detisha tisha vechad deasra amar kera veasita sheyyihu kol asiyyotav shaot
Meil shenem asar mena lan dichtiv veasita et meil haefod

a: Kelil techelet veyalef techelet techelet mipparochet ma lehallan shishsha af kan shishsha
Venelaf mishshulav verimmonav ma lehallan shemona af kan shemona danin keli mikkeli veen danin keli mittachshit keli
Adderabba danin gufo miggufo veen danin gufo mealma hayenu deamrinan lishar begadim shello neemar bahen shesh
Parochet esrim vearbaa arbea deshita shita la dina vela dayyana

Choshen veefod esrim ushmona mena lan dichtiv veasita choshen mishpat maase choshev kemaase efod taasennu zahav techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar arbea deshita shita esrin vearbea zahav arbea ha esrin utmanya
Veema zahav name shishsha amar rav acha bar yaakov amar kera vekitztzetz petilim petil petilim hare kan arbaa
Rav ashe amar amar kera laasot betoch hattechelet uvtoch haargaman hechi naaved naaved arbea ditre tere hau lehu temanya naaved tere ditre tere utre dechad chad veasita sheyyihu kol asiyyotav shaot

Amar rachava amar rav yehuda hamkarea bigde chehunna loke shenneemar lo yikkarea matkef lah rav acha bar yaakov vedilma hachi kaamar rachamana naaved leh safa ki hechi dela nikra mi ketiv shello yikkarea

Amar rabbi elazar hammazziach choshen meal haefod vehammesir badde aron loke shenneemar lo yizzach vela yasuru matkef lah rav acha bar yaakov vedilma ki kaamar rachamana chaddekinhu veavdinhu shappir kede shello yizzach velo yasuru mi ketiv shello yizzach veshello yasuru
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina rame ketiv betabbeot haaron yihu habbaddim lo yasuru mimmennu uchtiv vehuva et baddav battabbaot ha ketzad mitparkin veen nishmatin

Tanya name hachi betabbeot haaron yihu habbaddim yachol lo yihu zazin mimmekoman talmud lomar vehuva et baddav battabbaot i vehuva et baddav yachol yihu nichnasin veotzin talmud lomar betabbeot haaron yihu habbaddim ha ketzad mitparkin veen nishmatin

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina may dichtiv atze shittim omdim sheomdim derech gedilatan davar acher omdim shemmaamidin et tzippuyan davar acher omdim shemma tomar avad sivran uvatel sikkuyan talmud lomar omdim sheomdin leolam ulolamim
Amar rabbi chama bar chanina may dichtiv et bigde hasserad lesharet bakkodesh
b: Ilmale bigde chehunna lo nishtayyer missonehen shel yisrael sarid ufalit
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar deve rabbi shimon tana begadim sheggordin otan kivriyyatan mikkelehen umsardin mehen kelum may hi resh lakish amar ellu maase machat

Metivi bigde chehunna en osin otan maase machat ella maase oreg shenneemar maase oreg amar abbaye lo nitzrecha ella levet yad shellahem kidtanya bet yad shel bigde chehunna neereget bifne atzmah venidbeket im habbeged umaggaat ad pisat hayyad
Amar rachava amar rav yehuda shalosh aronot asa betzalel emtzai shel etz tisha penimi shel zahav shemona chitzon asara umashshehu
Vehatanya achad asar umashshehu la kashya ha keman deamar yesh beovo tefach ha keman deamar en beovo tefach umay mashshehu zer

Amar rabbi yochanan shelosha zerim hen shel mizbeach veshel aron veshel shulchan shel mizbeach zacha aharon untalo shel shulchan zacha david untalo shel aron adayin munnach hu kal harotze likach yavo veyikkach shemma tomar pachut hu talmud lomar bi melachim yimlochu
Rabbi yochanan rame ketiv zar vekarenan zer zacha naaset lo zer lo zacha zara hemennu
Rabbi yochanan rame ketiv veasita lecha aron etz uchtiv veasu aron atze shittim mikkan letalmid chacham shebbene iro metzuviyn laasot lo melachto
Mibbayit umichutz tetzappennu amar rava kol talmid chacham sheen tocho kevaro eno talmid chacham
Amar abbaye veitema rabba bar ulla nikra nitav shenneemar af ki nitav veneelach ish shote chammayim avela

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan may dichtiv lamma ze mechir beyad kesil liknot chochma velev ayin oy lahem lesonehen shel talmide chachamim sheoskin battora veen bahen yirat shamayim
Machriz rabbi yannay chaval al delet leh darta vetara ledarteh aved
Amar lehu rava lerabbanan bematuta minayechu la tirtun tarte gehinnam

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may dichtiv vezot hattora asher sam moshe zacha naaset lo sam chayyim lo zacha naaset lo sam mita vehayenu deamar rava deomen lah samma dechayya dela omen lah samma demota

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani rabbi yonatan rame ketiv pikkude Adonai yesharim mesammeche lev uchtiv imrat Adonai tzerufa zacha mesammachto lo zacha tzorafto resh lakish amar miggufeh dikra nafka zacha tzorafto lechayyim lo zacha tzorafto lemita
Yirat Adonai tehora omedet laad amar rabbi chanina ze hallomed tora betahora may hi nose ishsha veachar kach lomed tora
Edut Adonai neemana amar rabbi chiyya bar abba neemana hi lehaid belomdeha
Maase rokem maase choshev amar rabbi elazar sherokmin bimkom shechoshvin
Tana mishshemeh derabbi nechemya rokem maase machat lefichach partzuf echad choshev maase oreg lefichach shene partzufot

Beellu nishalin beurim vetummim ki ata rav dimi amar begadim shekkohen gadol meshammesh bahen meshuach milchama meshammesh bahen shenneemar uvigde hakkodesh asher leaharon yihu levanav acharav lemi shebba bigdulla acharav
Metiv rav adda bar ahava veamri lah kedi yachol yehe beno shel meshuach milchama meshammesh tachtav kederech shebbeno shel kohen gadol meshammesh tachtav

a: Talmud lomar shivat yamim yilbasham hakkohen tachtav mibbanav asher yavo el ohel moed mi sherauy lavo el ohel moed veim ita michze chaze
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hachi kaamar kol sheikar meshichato leohel moed yatza ze sheikar meshichato lemilchama
Metivi meshuach milchama eno meshammesh lo bearbaa kechohen hedot lo bishmona kechohen gadol
Amar leh abbaye ella zar meshavet leh ella kechohen gadol mishshum eva kechohen hedot mishshum maalin bakkodesh velo moridin
Amar leh rav adda bar abba lerava vehay tanna delet leh eva vela ka meshammesh
Detanya devarim shebben kohen gadol lechohen hedot par kohen mashiach ufar habba al kol hammitzot ufar yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa
Lo porea velo porem aval porem hu millematta vehahedot milmala veen mittamme likrovav umtzuve al habbetula umuzhar al haalmana umachazir et harotzeach
Umakriv onen veeno ochel veeno cholek venotel chelek barosh umakriv chelek barosh umshammesh bishmona kelim ufatur al tumat mikdash vekadashav vechol avodot yom hakkippurim enan kesherot ella bo
Vechullan nohagot bimrubbe begadim chutz mippar habba al kol hammitzot
Vechullan nohagot bemashuach sheavar chutz mippar yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa

Vechullan en nohagot bimshuach milchama chutz mechamishsha devarim haamurin bapparasha lo porea velo porem velo mittamme likrovav umtzuve al habbetula umuzhar al haalmana umachzir et harotzeach kedivre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim eno machzir
Ki let leh eva bedichoteh bidzutar mineh it leh

Yetev rabbi avahu vekaamar lah leha shemata mishshemeh derabbi yochanan ahderinhu rabbi amme verabbi assi leappayehu ika deamri rabbi chiyya bar abba amara veahderinhu rabbi amme verabbi assi leappayehu
Matkef lah rav pappa bishlama rabbi avahu mishshum yekara deve kesar ella lerabbi chiyya bar abba nemru leh memar la amar rabbi yochanan hachi
Ki ata ravin amar nishal itmar tanya name hachi begadim shekkohen gadol meshammesh bahen meshuach milchama nishal bahen
Tanu rabbanan ketzad shoalin hashshoel panav kelappe nishal vehannishal panav kelappe shechina
Hashshoel omer erdof achare haggedud hazze vehannishal omer ko amar Adonai ale vehatzlach rabbi yehuda omer en tzarich lomar ko amar Adonai ella ale vehatzlach
En shoalin bekol shenneemar veshaal lo lo meharher belibbo shenneemar veshaal lo lifne Adonai ella kederech sheamra channa bitfillatah shenneemar vechanna hi medabberet al libbah

En shoalin shene devarim keechad veim shaal en machzirin ella echad veen machzirin lo ella rishon shenneemar hayasgiruni vaale keila veyado hayered shaul vego vayyomer Adonai yered veha amratte en machzirin ella rishon david shaal
b: Shello kasseder vehechziru lo kasseder vechevan sheyyada sheshshaal shello kasseder chazar veshaal kasseder shenneemar hayasgiru baale keila oti veet anashay beyad shaul vayyomer Adonai yasgiru
Veim hutzrach haddavar lishnayim machzirin lo shenayim shenneemar vayyishal david ba lemor haerdof achare haggedud hazze haassigennu vayyomer Adonai lo redof ki hasseg tassig vehatztzel tatztzil
Veaf al pi sheggezerat navi chozeret gezerat urim vetummim enah chozeret shenneemar bemishpat haurim
Lamma nikra sheman urim vetummim urim shemmeirin et divrehen tummim shemmashlimin et divrehen
Veim tomar begivat binyamin mippene ma lo hishlimu

Hem shello bichanu im lenatztzeach im lehinnatzeach uvaacharona shebbichanu hiskimu shenneemar ufinchas ben elazar ben aharon omed lefanav bayyamim hahem lemor haosif od latzet lammilchama im bene vinyamin achi im echdal vayyomer Adonai alu ki machar ettenennu veyadecha
Ketzad naaset rabbi yochanan omer boltot resh lakish omer mitztarfot
Veha la ketiv behu tzadi amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak avraham yitzchak veyaakov ketiv sham veha la ketiv tet amar rav acha bar yaakov shivte yeshurun ketiv sham
Metivi kol kohen sheeno medabber beruach hakkodesh ushchina shora alav en shoalin bo shehare shaal tzadok vealta lo evyatar velo alta lo shenneemar vayyaal evyatar ad tom kol haam vego
Sayyoe hava mesayya bahadayehu

Veen shoalin ella lemelech mena hane mile amar rabbi avahu deamar kera velifne elazar hakkohen yaamod veshaal lo bemishpat haurim vego hu ze melech vechol bene yisrael itto ze meshuach milchama vechol haeda zo sanhedrin
Hadaran alach ba lo kohen gadol

Matni yom hakkippurim asur baachila uvishtiyya uvirchitza uvsicha uvinilat hassandal uvtashmish hammitta vehammelech vehakkalla yirchatzu et penehem vehachayya tinol et hassandal divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim osrin
Haochel kechotevet haggassa kamoha uchgarinatah vehashshote melo lugmav chayyav kol haochalim mitztarfin lechakkotevet vechol hammashkin mitztarfin limlo lugmav haochel veshote en mitztarfin
Gema asur anush karet hu amar rabbi ila veitema rabbi yirmeya lo nitzrecha ella lachatzi shiur
Hanicha leman deamar chatzi shiur asur min hattora ella leman deamar chatzi shiur muttar min hattora may ika lememar
Deitmar chatzi shiur rabbi yochanan amar asur min hattora resh lakish amar muttar min hattora hanicha lerabbi yochanan ella leresh lakish may ika lememar mode resh lakish sheasur midderabbanan
I hachi la nichayyav aleh korban shevua allema tenan shevua shello ochal veachal nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim chayyav verabbi shimon poter
Vehavenan bah ammay chayyav mushba veomed mehar sinay hu rav ushmuel verabbi yochanan deamri becholel devarim hammuttarim im devarim haasurin
Veresh lakish amar i atta motze ella bimfaresh chatzi shiur vealliba derabbanan o bistam

a: Vealliba derabbi akiva deamar adam oser atzmo bechol shehu
Vechi tema kevan deit leh heter min hattora ka chayel korban shevua vehatnan shevuat haedut enah noheget ella biruyin lehaid vehavenan bah lemaote may rav pappa amar lemaote melech
Rav acha bar yaakov amar lemaote mesachek bekuvya veha mesachek bekuvya middeorayeta michze chaze verabbanan hu defasluhu vela ka chayela aleh shevua
Shane hatam deamar kera im lo yaggid vehay lav bar haggada hu kelal

Vechol hecha detane anush karet la tane asur vehatanya af al pi sheamru asur bechullan lo amru anush karet ella al haochel veshote veose melacha bilvad hachi kaamar kesheamru asur la amru ella bechachatzi shiur aval keshiur anush karet veaf al pi sheanush karet en anush karet ella ochel veshote veose melacha bilvad

Vei baet ema ki katane asur ashsheara detanu rabba verav yosef bishar sifre deve rav minnayin leom hakkippurim sheasur birchitza besicha uvinilat hassandal uvtashmish hammitta talmud lomar shabbaton shevut

Gufa chatzi shiur rabbi yochanan amar asur min hattora resh lakish amar muttar min hattora rabbi yochanan amar asur min hattora kevan dachazi leitzterofe isura ka achel resh lakish amar muttar min hattora achila amar rachamana veleka

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish en li ella kol sheyyeshno beonesh yeshno beazhara koy vachatzi shiur hoil veeno beonesh yachol eno beazhara talmud lomar kol chelev midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma
Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach deorayeta koy sefeka hu itzterich kera leetoye sefeka i mishshum ha la irya kasavri
b: Koy beriyya bifne atzmah hi dei la tema hachi ha deamar rav idi bar avin af kol leetoye koy koy sefeka hu itzterich kera lerabboye sefeka ella beriyya shane hacha name beriyya shane
Tanu rabbanan teannu et nafshotechem yachol yeshev bachamma o batztzinna kede sheyyitztaer talmud lomar vechol melacha lo taasu ma melacha shev veal taase af innuy nefesh shev veal taase
Veema hecha deyatev beshimsha vechayem leh la nema leh kum tuv betulla yatev betulla vekarer leh la nema leh kum tuv beshimsha dumya dimlacha ma melacha lo chillakta bah af innuy lo tachlok bo

Tanya idach teannu et nafshotechem yachol yeshev bachamma uvatztzinna veyitztaer talmud lomar vechol melacha lo taasu ma melacha davar shechayyavin alav bimkom acher af innuy nefesh shechayyavin alav bimkom acher vei ze ze ze piggul venotar
Avi piggul venotar shehen becharet velo avi et hattevel sheeno becharet talmud lomar teannu veinnitem et nafshotechem riba
Avi hattevel shehu bemita velo avi et hannevela sheenah bemita talmud lomar teannu veinnitem et nafshotechem riba
Avi et hannevela shehu belav velo avi et hachullin sheenan belav talmud lomar teannu veinnitem et nafshotechem riba

Avi hachullin sheenan bekum echol velo avi et hatteruma shehi bekum echol talmud lomar teannu veinnitem et nafshotechem riba avi et hatteruma sheenah beval totiru velo avi et hakkodashim shehen beval totiru talmud lomar teannu veinnitem et nafshotechem riba
Veim nafshecha lomar hare hu omer vehaavadti et hannefesh hahi innuy shehu avedat hannefesh vee ze ze ze achila ushtiyya
May veim nafshecha lomar vechi tema baaraot ka mishtae kera hare hu omer vehaavadti hannefesh innuy sheyyesh bo avedat nefesh vee ze ze ze achila ushtiyya
Deve rabbi yishmael tana neemar kan innuy veneemar lehallan innuy ma lehallan innuy reavon af kan innuy reavon
Venelaf meim teanne et benotay danin innuy derabbim meinnuy derabbim veen danin innuy derabbim meinnuy deyachid
Venelaf meinnuy demitzrayim dichtiv vayyar et onyenu veamrinan zo perishut derech eretz ella danin innuy bide shamayim meinnuy bide shamayim veen danin innuy bide shamayim meinnuy bide adam

Hammaachilcha man bammidbar lemaan annotcha rabbi amme verabbi assi chad amar eno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo lemi sheen lo pat besallo vechad amar eno dome mi sheroe veochel lemi sheeno roe veochel

Amar rav yosef mikkan remez lesomin sheochlin veen sevein amar abbaye hilkach man deit leh seodta la lechlah ella bimama amar rabbi zera may kera tov mare enayim mehaloch nafesh amar resh lakish tov mare enayim beishsha yoter miggufo shel maase shenneemar tov mare enayim mehaloch nafesh
Ki yitten bakkos eno yithallech bemesharim rabbi amme verabbi assi chad amar kol hannoten

a: Eno bechoso araot kullan domot alav kemishor vechad amar kal hannoten eno bechoso kal haolam kullo dome alav kemishor
Deaga velev ish yashchenna rabbi amme verabbi assi chad amar yassichenna middato vechad amar yesichenna laacherim
Venachash afar lachmo rabbi amme verabbi assi chad amar afilu ochel kal maadanne olam toem bahem taam afar vechad amar afilu ochel kol maadanne olam en dato meushshevet alav ad sheyyochal afar

Tanya amar rabbi yose bo ure shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam middat basar vadam maknit et chavero yored immo lechayyav aval hakkadosh baruch hu eno ken killel et hannachash ole laggag mezonotav immo yored lematta mezonotav immo
Killel et kenaan ochel ma sherabbo ochel veshote ma sherabbo shote killel et haishsha hakkol ratzin achareha killel et haadama hakkol nizonin hemenna
Zacharnu et haddaga asher nochal bemitzrayim chinnam rav ushmuel chad amar dagim vechad amar araot man deamar dagim dichtiv nochal uman deamar araot dichtiv chinnam

Ulman deamar araot ha ketiv nochal lishana mealleya naket dichtiv achla umachata fiha veamra lo faalti aven ulman deamar dagim may chinnam dahao mayetin lehu mehefkera deamar mar keshehau yisrael shoavin mayim hakkadosh baruch hu mazmin lahem betoch hammayim dagim ketannim bechaddehen
Bishlama leman deamar dagim aval araot la peritzi behu hayenu dichtiv gan naul achoti challa go ella leman deamar araot may mayan chatum mehanach daasirin la peritzi behu

Bishlama leman deamar araot hayenu dichtiv vayyishma moshe et haam boche lemishpechotav al iske mishpechotav shenneesru lahem lishkav etzlam ella leman deamar dagim may boche lemishpechotav ha veha havay

Et hakkishshuim veet haavattichim rabbi amme verabbi assi chad amar taam kol hamminin taamu bamman taam chameshet hamminin hallalu lo taamu bo vechad amar taam kal hamminin taamu taman umammashan vehallalu taman velo mammashan
Vehamman kezera gad lavan vetamo amar rabbi assi agol kegida velavan kemargalit tanya name hachi gad sheddome lezera pishtan baggivolin
Acherim omrim gad sheddome lehaggada shemmoshechet libbo shel adam kammayim tanya idach gad shemmaggid lahem leyisrael i ben tisha larishon vei ben shiva laacharon
Lavan shemmalbin aonotehen shel yisrael

Tanya rabbi yose omer keshem shehannavi haya maggid lahem leyisrael ma shebbechorin uma shebbisdakin kach hamman maggid lahem leyisrael ma shebbechorin uma shebbisdakin ketzad shenayim shebbau lifne moshe ledin ze omer avdi ganavta veze omer atta mecharto li amar lahem moshe labboker mishpat lemachar im nimtza omro bevet rabbo rishon beyadua shezze genavo im nimtza omro bevet rabbo sheni beyadua shezze mecharo lo

Vechen ish veishsha shebbau lifne moshe laddin ze omer hi sarcha alay vehi omeret hu sarach alay amar lahem moshe labboker mishpat lemachar im nimtza omrah bevet balah beyadua shehi sarcha alav nimtza omrah bevet aviha beyadua shehu sarach aleha

Ketiv uvredet hattal al hammachane layela yered hamman alav uchtiv veyatza haam velaktu uchtiv shatu haam velaktu ha ketzad tzaddikim yarad al petach battehem benonim yatzu velaktu reshaim shatu velaktu
Ketiv lechem uchtiv ugot uchtiv vetachanu ha ketzad tzaddikim lechem benonim ugot reshaim tachanu barechayim

O dachu bammedocha amar rabbi yehuda amar rav veitema rabbi chama berabbi chanina melammed sheyyarad lahem leyisrael im hamman tachshite nashim davar shennidoch bimdocha uvishshelu bapparur amar rabbi chama melammed sheyyarad lahem leyisrael im hamman tzike kedera

Vehem heviu elav od nedava babboker babboker may babboker babboker amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan middavar sheyyarad lahem babboker babboker melammed sheyyardu lahem leyisrael avanim tovot umargaliyyot im hamman vehannesiim heviu et avne hashshoham tana nesiim mammash vechen hu omer nesiim veruach vegeshem ayin

Vehaya tamo ketaam leshad hashshamen amar rabbi avahu ma shad ze tinok toem bah kamma teamim af hamman kol zeman sheyyisrael ochlin oto motzin bo kamma teamim ika deamri leshed mammash ma shed ze mithappech lechamma geonin af hamman mithappech lechamma teamim
Vayyomer moshe betet Adonai lachem baerev basar leechol velechem babboker lisboa tana mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben karcha basar sheshshaalu shello kahogen nitan lahem shello kahogen
b: Lechem sheshshaalu kahogen nitan lahem kahogen mikkan limmeda tora derech eretz shello yochal adam basar ella ballayela vehaamar abbaye hay man deit leh seodta la lechlah ella bimama keen yemama ka amrinan amar rav acha bar yaakov battechilla hau yisrael domin ketarnegolim shemmenakkerin baashpa ad shebba moshe vekava lahem zeman seuda
Habbasar odennu ben shinehem uchtiv ad chodesh yamim ha ketzad benonim lealtar metu reshaim mitztaarin veholchin ad chodesh yamim

Vayyishtechu amar resh lakish al tikre vayyishtechu ella vayyishchatu melammed shennitchayevu sonehen shel yisrael shechita shatoach tana mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben karcha al tikre shatoach ella shachut melammed sheyyarad lahem leyisrael im hamman davar shettaun shechita amar rabbi vechi mikkan atta lamed vahalo kevar neemar vayyamter alehem keafar sheer uchchol hayyam of kanaf
