Amar abbaye lo shanu ella leachar achila aval kodem achila migrar garer dichtiv vayyimtzeu ish mitzri bassade vayyikchu oto el david vayyittenu lo lechem vayyochal vayyashkuhu mayim vayyittenu lo felach devela ushne tzimmukim vayyochal vattashov rucho elav ki lo achal lechem velo shata mayim shelosha yamim ushlosha lelot

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel mi sheachazo bulmus maachilin oto alya bidvash rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar af solet nekiyya bidvash rav pappa amar afilu kimcha disare beduvsha amar rabbi yochanan paam achat achazani bulmus veratzti lemizrachah shel teena vekiyyamti beatzmi hachochma techayye vealeha detane rav yosef harotze litom taam teena yifne lemizrachah shenneemar umimmeged tevuot shamesh

Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose hao ka azli beorcha achze bulmus lerabbi yehuda kappecheh leroe achleh lerifta amar leh rabbi yose kippachta et haroe ki meto lemata achze bulmus lerabbi yose ahderuhu belage vetzae amar leh rabbi yehuda ani kippachti et haroe veatta kippachta et hair kullah

Vetu rabbi meir verabbi yehuda verabbi yose hao ka azli beorcha rabbi meir hava dayek bishma rabbi yehuda verabbi yose la hao dayeki bishma ki meto lehahu duchta beo ushpiza yehavu lehu amaru leh ma shemach amar lehu kidor amar shema minah adam rasha hu shenneemar ki dor tahpuchot hemma rabbi yehuda verabbi yose ashlimu leh kisayehu rabbi meir la ashlem leh kiseh azal otveh be kivreh daavuh

Itchazi leh bechelmeh ta shekel kisa demannach aresha dehahu gavra limchar amar lehu hachi itchazi li bechelmay amri leh chelma deve shimshe let behu mammasha azal rabbi meir venatreh kulle yoma veayetyeh
Limchar amaru leh hav lan kisan amar lehu lo hau devarim meolam amar lehu rabbi meir ammay la dayekitu bishma amaru leh ammay la amarte lan mar amar lehu emar daamari ana chashasha achzoke mi amari
Mashchuhu veayeluhu lachanuta chazo telafche assefameh azalu vihavu simana lidvethu veshakluh lechisayehu veayeto azal ihu vekatleh leitteh
Hayenu ditnan mayim rishonim heechilu besar chazir mayim acharonim hargu et hannefesh
Ulvassof hao dayeki bishma ki meto lehahu beta dishmeh bala la ayalu legabbeh amri shema minah rasha hu dichtiv vaomar labbala niufim kemo achare veloti hayeta li edna kelomar zakna beniufim

Mi shenneshacho kelev shote vechu tanu rabbanan chamishsha devarim neemru bechelev shote piv patuach veriro notef veoznav seruchot uznavo munnach al yarchotav umhallech betzide derachim veyesh omrim af noveach veen kolo nishma mimmay have rav amar nashim kashfaniyyot mesachakot bo ushmuel amar ruach raa shora alav
May benayehu ika benayehu

a: Lemikteleh bedavar hannizrak

Tanya keoteh dishmuel keshehorgin oto en horgin oto ella bedavar hannizrak dechayef beh mistakkan denachet leh mayet dechayef beh mistakkan may takkanteh nishallach maneh venirhat rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chaf beh chad minayehu beshuka shallechinhu lemaneh verahet amar kiyyamti beatzmi hachochma techayye vealeha

Denachet leh mayet may takkanteh amar abbaye nete mashka deappa dichra venichtov aleh ana pelanya bar pelanita ammashka deappa dichra katevna alach kanti kanti keleros veamri lah kandi kandi keloros yah yah Adonai tzevaot amen amen sela venishlechinhu lemaneh velikberinhu be kivre ad teresar yarche shatta venappekinhu veniklinhu betannura unvadderinhu lekitmeh apparashat derachim vehanach teresar yarche shatta ki shate mayya la lishte ella beguvta dinchasha dilma chaze bavua desheda velistakkan ki ha deabba bar marta hu abba bar minome avada leh imeh guvta dedahava

Veod amar rabbi matya rabbi yochanan chash betzafdina azal gabbah dehahi matronita avada leh milleta chamsha umaale shabbeta amar lah beshabbat may amara leh la tzerichatte i mitzterichna may amara leh ishteva li dela megallet ishteva lelaha deyisrael la megallena nefak darshah befirka
Veha ishteva lah lelaha deyisrael la megallena ha leammo yisrael megallena veha ika chillul hashshem dimgalle lah meikara

May avada leh amar rav acha bereh derav amme me seor shemen zayit vamelach rav yemar amar seor gufeh shemen zayit vamelach rav ashe amar mishcha degadpa daaoza amar abbaye ana avadi lechullehu vela itassay ad daamar li hahu tayyaa ayeti kashyata dezeta dela melo tilta uklinhu benura ammara chadta veadbek bechakke dare avadi hachi veitassay

Mimmay hava mechammime chammime dechite umishshiyyure kasa deharsana umay simaneh kad rame mide bechakkeh veate dema mibbe dare rabbi yochanan ki chash betzafdina avad hachi beshabbeta veitassi verabbi yochanan hechi aved hachi amar rav nachman bar yitzchak shane tzafdina hoil umatchil bappe vegomer bivne meayim
Amar leh rav chiyya bar abba lerabbi yochanan keman kerabbi matya ben charash deamar hachoshesh befiv metilin lo sam beshabbat amar leh sheani omer bezo velo beacheret

Lema mesayya leh mi sheachazo yerakon maachilin oto besar chamor mi shenneshacho kelev shote maachilin oto mechatzar kaved shello vehachoshesh befiv metilin lo sam beshabbat divre rabbi matya ben charash vachachamim omrim beelu en bahem mishshum refua beellu lemaote may may lav lemaote sam

La lemaote makkizin dam lisronche hachi name mistabbera detanya shelosha devarim amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose sheshshama mishshum rabbi matya ben charash makkizin dam lisronche beshabbat umi shenneshacho kelev shote maachilin oto mechatzar kaved shello vehachoshesh befiv metilin lo sam beshabbat
Vachachamim omrim beelu en bahen mishshum refua beelu lemaote may may lav attarte batrayata ulmaote deresha la attarte deresha kammayata ulmaote desefa
b: Ta shema detane rabba bar shemuel ubbara shehericha maachilin otah ad shettashuv nafshah umi shenneshacho kelev shote maachilin oto mechatzar kaved shello vehachoshesh befiv metilin lo sam beshabbat divre rabbi elazar berabbi yose sheamar mishshum rabbi matya ben charash vachachamim omrim bazo velo beacheret bezo aheya ilema aubbara peshita ubbara mi ika leman deamar dela ella lav assam shema minah

Rav ashe amar matnitin name dayeka veod amar rabbi matya ben charash hachoshesh befiv metilin lo sam beshabbat vela peligi rabbanan aleh veim ita difligi rabbanan aleh liarvinhu velitninhu velipalgu rabbanan besefa shema minah
Mippene shessefek nefashot hu vechu lema li tu lememar vechol sefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat amar rav yehuda amar rav lo safek shabbat zo bilvad amru ella afilu safek shabbat acheret
Hechi dame kegon deamduh litmanya yome veoma kamma shabbeta mahu detema liakkav ad leurta ki hechi dela nechul aleh tere shabbata ka mashma lan

Tanya name hachi mechammin chammin lachole beshabbat ben lehashkoto ben lehavroto velo shabbat zo bilvad amru ella leshabbat acheret veen omrim namtin lo shemma yavri ella mechammin lo miyyad mippene shessefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat velo safek shabbat zo ella afilu safek shabbat acheret
Veen osin devarim hallalu lo al yede goyim velo al yede kutiyyim ella al yede gedole yisrael veen omrin yeasu devarim hallalu lo al pi nashim velo al pi kutiyyim aval mitztarfin ledaat acheret

Tanu rabbanan mefakkechin pikkuach nefesh beshabbat vehazzariz hare ze meshubbach veen tzarich litol reshut mibbet din ha ketzad raa tinok shennafal layyam pores metzuda umaalehu vehazzariz hare ze meshubbach veen tzarich litol reshut mibbet din veaf al gav deka tzayed keore raa tinok shennafal levor oker chulya umaalehu vehazzariz hare ze meshubbach veen tzarich litol reshut mibbet din af al gav dimtakken darga

Raa shenninala delet bifne tinok shovrah umotzio vehazzariz hare ze meshubbach veen tzarich litol reshut mibbet din veaf al gav deka mikaven lemitbar beshife mechabbin umafsikin mippene haddeleka beshabbat vehazzariz hare ze meshubbach veen tzarich litol reshut mibbet din veaf al gav deka memakkech makkoche
Utzricha dei ashmeinan yam mishshum deaddehachi vehachi azel leh aval bor deka yatev ema la tzericha
Vei ashmeinan bor mishshum deka mibit aval ninala delet efshar deyatev behay gisa umshabbesh leh beamgoze tzericha
Mechabbin umafsikin lema li daafilu lechatzer acheret

Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo halchu befikkuach nefesh achar harov hechi dame i nema deika tisha yisrael vegoy echad benayehu rubba yisrael ninhu ella palga ufalga sefek nefashot lehakel
Ella deika tisha goyim veyisrael echad ha name peshita dehave leh kavua vechol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame
La tzericha difrush lechatzer acheret mahu detema kol defaresh merubba paresh ka mashma lan dela halchu befikkuach nefesh achar harov
Ini vehaamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan tisha goyim veyisrael echad beotah chatzer mefakkechin bechatzer acheret en mefakkechin la kashya ha difrush kullehu ha difrush miktzatayehu
Umi amar shemuel hachi vehatnan matza vah tinok mushlach im rov goyim goy veim rov yisrael yisrael mechetza al mechetza yisrael veamar rav lo shanu ella lehachoto aval leyachaso lo

a: Ushmuel amar lefakkeach alav et haggal ki itmar dishmuel aresha itmar im rov goyim goy amar shemuel ulinyan pikkuach nefesh eno ken
Im rov goyim goy lemay hilcheta amar rav pappa lehaachilo nevelot im rov yisrael yisrael lemay hilcheta lehachzir lo avedato
Mechetza al mechetza yisrael lemay hilcheta amar resh lakish linzakin hechi dame i nema denagcheh tora didan letora dideh nayete reaya venishkol
La tzericha denagcheh tora dideh letora didan palga yahev leh idach palga nema leh ayeti reaya delav yisrael ana ushkol
Mi shennafla alav mappolet vechu may kaamar

La mibaya kaamar la mibaya safek hu sham safek eno sham dei iteh chay hu dimfakkechin ella afilu safek chay safek met mefakkechin vela mibaya safek chay safek met deyisrael ella afilu safek goy safek yisrael mefakkechin
Metzauhu chay mefakkechin metzauhu chay peshita la tzericha daafilu lechayye shaa

Veim met yannichuhu ha name peshita la tzericha lerabbi yehuda ben lakish detanya en matztzilin et hammet mippene haddeleka amar rabbi yehuda ben lakish shamati shemmatztzilin et hammet mippene haddeleka vaafilu rabbi yehuda ben lakish la kaamar ella mittoch sheadam bahul al meto i la sharet leh ate lechabboye aval hacha i la sharet leh may it leh lemebad
Tanu rabbanan ad hechan hu bodek ad chotmo veyesh omrim ad libbo badak umatza elonim metim lo yomar kevar metu hattachtonim maase haya umatzu elonim metim vetachtonim chayyim
Nema hane tannae ki hane tannae detanya mehechan havalad notzar merosho shenneemar mimmee immi atta gozi veomer gozzi nizrech vehashlichi abba shaul omer mittiburo umshalleach shorashav elach veelach

Afilu tema abba shaul ad kan la ka amar abba shaul hatam ella leinyan yetzira dechol mide mimmetziateh mittzar aval leinyan pikkuach nefesh afilu abba shaul mode deikar chayyuta beappeh hu dichtiv kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav
Amar rav pappa machloket mimmatta lemala aval mimmala lematta kevan divdak leh ad chotmo shuv eno tzarich dichtiv kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav

Uchvar haya rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva verabbi elazar ben azarya mehallechin badderech velevi hassaddar verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi elazar ben azarya mehallechin acharehen nishala sheela zo bifnehem minnayin lefikkuach nefesh sheddoche et hashshabbat

Naana rabbi yishmael veamar im bammachteret yimmatze haggannav uma ze shessafek al mamon ba safek al nefashot ba ushfichut damim metamme et haaretz vegorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael nitan lehatztzilo benafsho kal vachomer lefikkuach nefesh sheddoche et hashshabbat
Naana rabbi akiva veamar vechi yazid ish al reehu vego meim mizbechi tikkachennu lamut meim mizbechi velo meal mizbechi veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella lehamit
b: Aval lehachaot afilu meal mizbechi uma ze shessafek yesh mammash bidvarav safek en mammash bidvarav vaavoda docha shabbat kal vachomer lefikkuach nefesh sheddoche et hashshabbat naana rabbi elazar veamar uma mila shehi echad mimmatayim vearbaim ushmona evarim shebbaadam docha et hashshabbat kal vachomer lechol gufo sheddoche et hashshabbat
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer et shabbetotay tishmoru yachol lakkol talmud lomar ach chalak rabbi yonatan ben yosef omer ki kodesh hi lachem hi mesura beyedchem velo attem mesurim beyadah

Rabbi shimon ben menasya omer veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat amra tora challel alav shabbat achat kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harbe amar rav yehuda amar shemuel i havay hatam hava amena didi adifa middidhu vechay bahem velo sheyyamut bahem

Amar rava lechullehu it lehu pircha bar middishmuel delet leh pircha derabbi yishmael dilma kidrava deamar rava may tama demachteret chazaka en adam maamid atzmo al mamono vehay mida yada dekae leappeh veamar i kae leappay katelna leh vehattora amra ba lehorgecha hashkem lehorgo veashkechan vadday safek menalan
Derabbi akiva name dilma kidabbaye deamar abbaye masrinan leh zuga derabbanan leda im mammash bidvarav veashkechan vadday safek mena lan
Vechullehu ashkechan vadday safek mena lan vedishmuel vadday let leh pircha amar ravina veitema rav nachman bar yitzchak tava chada pilpalta charifa mimmela tzanna dekare

Matni chattat veasham vadday mechapperin mita veom hakkippurim mechapperin im hatteshuva teshuva mechapperet al averot kallot al ase veal lo taase veal hachamurot hu tole ad sheyyavo yom hakkippurim vichapper haomer echeta veashuv echeta veashuv en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva echeta veom hakkippurim mechapper en yom hakkippurim mechapper averot shebben adam lammakom yom hakkippurim mechapper averot shebben adam lachavero en yom hakkippurim mechapper ad sheyeratztze et chavero

Darash rabbi elazar ben azarya mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu averot shebben adam lammakom yom hakkippurim mechapper averot shebben adam lachavero en yom hakkippurim mechapper ad sheyeratztze et chavero amar rabbi akiva ashrechem yisrael lifne mi attem mittaharin mi metaher etchem avichem shebbashshamayim shenneemar vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim uthartem veomer mikve yisrael Adonai ma mikve metaher et hattemeim af hakkadosh baruch hu metaher et yisrael
Gema asham vadday in asham taluy la veha kappara ketiva beh hanach mechapperi kappara gemura asham taluy eno mechapper kappara gemura
I name hanach en acher mechapper kapparatan asham taluy acher mechapper kapparatan ditnan chayyave chattaot vaashamot vaddain sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim chayyavin ashamot teluyin peturin

Mita veom hakkippurim mechapperin im hatteshuva im hatteshuva in bifne atzman la nema dela kerabbi detanya rabbi omer al kol averot shebbattora ben asa teshuva ben lo asa teshuva yom hakkippurim mechapper chutz mipporek ol umgalle panim battora umefer berit basar sheim asa teshuva yom hakkippurim mechapper veim lo asa teshuva en yom hakkippurim mechapper
Afilu tema rabbi teshuva baaya yom hakkippurim yom hakkippurim la baaya teshuva
Teshuva mechapperet al averot kallot al ase veal lo taase hashta al lo taase mechapperet al ase mibaya amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar al ase veal lo taase shennitak laase
Veal lo taase gamur la urminhu ellu hen kallot ase velo taase

a: Chutz millo tissa lo tissa vechol dedame leh
Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer kol shehu millo tissa ulmatta teshuva mechapperet millo tissa ulmala teshuva tola veom hakkippurim mechapper lo tissa vechol dedame leh

Ta shema lefi shenneemar bechorev teshuva venakke yachol af lo tissa immahen talmud lomar lo yenakke yachol af shear chayyave lavin ken talmud lomar et shemo shemo hu deeno menakke aval menakke shear chayyave lavin
Tannae hi detanya al ma teshuva mechapperet al ase veal lo taase shennitak laase veal ma teshuva tola veom hakkippurim mechapper al karetot veal mitot bet din veal lo taase gamur

Amar mar lefi shenneemar bechorev venakke mena lan detanya rabbi elazar omer i efshar lomar nakke shekkevar neemar lo yenakke vei efshar lomar lo yenakke shekkevar neemar nakke ha ketzad menakke hu leshavin veeno menakke lesheenan shavin
Shaal rabbi matya ben charash et rabbi elazar ben azarya beromi shamata arbaa chilluke chappara shehaya rabbi yishmael doresh amar shelosha hen utshuva im kol echad veechad

Avar al ase veshav eno zaz mishsham ad shemmochalin lo shenneemar shuvu banim shovavim avar al lo taase veasa teshuva teshuva tola veom hakkippurim mechapper shenneemar ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem mikkol chattotechem avar al karetot umitot bet din veasa teshuva teshuva veom hakkippurim tolin veyissurin memarkin shenneemar ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim aonam

Aval mi sheyyesh chilul hashshem beyado en lo koach bitshuva litlot velo beom hakkippurim lechapper velo beyissurin lemarek ella kullan tolin umita memareket shenneemar venigla veoznay Adonai tzevaot im yechuppar heaon hazze lachem ad temutun
Hechi dame chilul hashshem amar rav kegon ana i shakelna bisra mittabbacha vela yahevna deme lealtar amar abbaye lo shanu ella beatra dela tavi aval beatra detavi let lan bah
Amar ravina umata machseya atra detavi hu abbaye kidshakel bisra mittere shuttafe yahev zuza lehay vezuza lehay vahadar mekarev lehu gabbe hadade veaved chushbana

Rabbi yochanan amar kegon ana dimsaggena arba ammot bela tora uvla tefilin yitzchak deve rabbi yannay amar kol shechaverav mitbayeshin mechamat shemuato hayenu chilul hashshem amar rav nachman bar yitzchak kegon deka amri inashe shera leh mareh liflanya

Abbaye amar kidtanya veahavta et Adonai elohecha sheyehe shem shamayim mitahev al yadcha sheyehe kore veshone umshammesh talmide chachamim vihe massao umattano benachat im habberiyyot ma habberiyyot omrot alav ashre aviv shellimmedo tora ashre rabbo shellimmedo tora oy lahem labberiyyot shello lamdu tora peloni shellimmedo tora reu kamma naim derachav kamma metukkanim maasav alav hakkatuv omer vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar

Aval mi shekkore veshone umshammesh talmide chachamim veen massao umattano beemuna veen dibburo benachat im habberiyyot ma habberiyyot omrot alav oy lo lifloni shellamad tora oy lo leaviv shellimmedo tora oy lo lerabbo shellimmedo tora peloni shellamad tora reu kamma mekulkalin maasav vechamma mechoarin derachav vealav hakkatuv omer beemor lahem am Adonai elle umeartzo yatzau
Amar rabbi chama bar chanina gedola teshuva shemmevia rifut leolam shenneemar erpa meshuvatam ohavem nedava
Rabbi chama bar chanina rame ketiv shuvu banim shovavim demeikara shovavim attem uchtiv erpa meshuvotechem la kashya kan meahava kan miyyira

Rav yehuda rame ketiv shuvu banim shovavim erpa meshuvotechem uchtiv hinne anochi baalti vachem velakachti etchem echad meir ushnayim mimmishpacha la kashya kan meahava o miyyira kan al yede yissurin amar rabbi levi gedola teshuva shemmaggaat ad kisse hakkavod shenneemar shuva yisrael ad Adonai elohecha
b: Amar rabbi yochanan gedola teshuva sheddocha et lo taase shebbattora shenneemar lemor hen yeshallach ish et ishto vehalcha meitto vehayeta leish acher hayashuv eleha od halo chanof techenaf haaretz hahi veatte zanit reim rabbim veshov elay neum Adonai
Amar rabbi yonatan gedola teshuva shemmekarevet et haggeulla shenneemar uva letziyyon goel ulshave fesha beyaakov ma taam uva letziyyon goel mishshum deshave fesha beyaakov

Amar resh lakish gedola teshuva shezzedonot naasot lo kishgagot shenneemar shuva yisrael ad Adonai elohecha ki chashalta baaonecha ha aon mezid hu veka kare leh michshol ini vehaamar resh lakish gedola teshuva shezzedonot naasot lo kizchiyyot shenneemar uvshuv rasha merishato veasa mishpat utzdaka alehem chayo yichye la kashya kan meahava kan miyyira
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan gedola teshuva shemmaarechet shenotav shel adam shenneemar uvshuv rasha merishato chao yichye

Amar rabbi yitzchak amri bemareva mishshemeh derabba bar mari bo ure shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam middat basar vadam maknit et chavero bidvarim safek mitpayyes hemennu safek en mitpayyes hemennu veim tomar mitpayyes hemennu safek mitpayyes bidvarim safek en mitpayyes bidvarim

Aval hakkadosh baruch hu adam over avera basseter mitpayyes mimmennu bidvarim shenneemar kechu immachem devarim veshuvu el Adonai velo od ella shemmachzik lo tova shenneemar vekach tov velo od ella shemmaale alav hakkatuv keilu hikriv parim shenneemar unshallema parim sefatenu shemma tomar pare chova talmud lomar erpa meshuvatam ohavem nedava
Tanya haya rabbi meir omer gedola teshuva shebbishvil yachid sheasa teshuva mochalin lechol haolam kullo shenneemar erpa meshuvatam ohavem nedava ki shav appi mimmennu mehem lo neemar ella mimmennu
Hechi dame baal teshuva amar rav yehuda kegon shebbat leyado devar avera paam rishona ushniyya venitzal hemenna machve rav yehuda beotah ishsha beoto perek beoto makom

Amar rav yehuda rav rame ketiv ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa uchtiv mechasse feshaav lo yatzliach la kashya ha bechet mefursam ha bechet sheeno mefursam rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav nachman kan baaverot shebben adam lachavero kan baaverot shebben adam lammakom

Tanya rabbi yose bar yehuda omer adam over avera paam rishona mochalin lo sheniyya mochalin lo shelishit mochalin lo reviit en mochalin lo shenneemar ko amar Adonai al shelosha pishe yisrael veal arbaa lo ashivennu veneemar hen kol elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver

May veomer vechi tema hane mile betzibur aval beyachid la ta shema hen kol elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver mikkan veelach en mochalin lo shenneemar al shelosha pishe yisrael veal arbaa lo ashivennu

Tanu rabbanan averot shehitvadda alehen yom hakkippurim ze lo yitvadde alehen yom hakkippurim acher veim shana bahen tzarich lehitvaddot yom hakkippurim acher veim lo shana bahen vechazar vehitvadda alehen alav hakkatuv omer kechelev shav al kio kesil shone beivalto

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer kol shekken shehu meshubbach shenneemar ki feshaay ani eda vechattati negdi tamid ella ma ani mekayyem kechelev shav al kio vego kidrav huna deamar rav huna kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah huttera lo huttera lo salka datach ella ema naaset lo keheter

Vetzarich lifrot et hachet shenneemar anna chata haam hazze chataa gedola vayyaasu lahem elohe zahav divre rabbi yehuda ben bava rabbi akiva omer ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa ella mahu sheamar moshe vayyaasu lahem elohe zahav kidrabbi yannay deamar rabbi yannay amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam kesef vezahav shehirbeta lahem leyisrael ad sheamru day garam lahem sheyyaasu elohe zahav

Shene parnasim tovim amdu lahem leyisrael moshe vedavid moshe amar yikkatev surchani shenneemar yaan lo heemantem bi lehakdisheni david amar al yikkatev surchani shenneemar ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa

Mashal demoshe vedavid lema haddavar dome lishte nashim shellaku bevet din achat kilkela veachat achla pagge sheviit amra lahen otah sheachla pagge sheviit bevakkasha mikkem hodiu al ma hi loka shello yomru al ma shezzo loka zo loka heviu pagge sheviit vetalu betzavarah vehau machrizin lefaneha veomrin al iske sheviit hi loka

Mefarsemin et hachanefin mippene chilul hashshem shenneemar uvshuv tzaddik mitztzidko veasa avel venatatti michshol lefanav teshuvat hammuchlatin meakkevet happuranut veaf al pi shennechtam alav gezar din shel puranut

Shalvat reshaim sofah takkala veharshut mekabberet et bealeha arom nichnas lah vearom yetze mimmenna ulvay shettehe yetzia kevia rav ki hava nafek lemedan dina amar hachi bitzvu nafsheh liktala nafek utzvu beteh let hu aved verekan leveteh azel ulvay shettehe bia kitzia
Rava ki hava nafek ledina amar hachi

a: Bitzvu nafsheh liktala nafek utzvu beteh let hu aved verekan leveteh azel ulvay shettehe bia kitzia vechi have chaze ambuha abbatreh amar im yaale lashshamayim sio verosho laav yaggia kegelalo lanetzach yoved roav yomru ayyo rav zutra ki hao mechattefi leh beshabbeta derigla hava amar ki lo leolam chosen veim nezer ledor vador
Seet pene rasha lo tov lo tov lahem larshaim shennosin lahem panim baolam hazze lo tov lo leachav shennasu lo panim baolam hazze shenneemar yaan ki nichna achav millefanay lo avi haraa beyamav

Lehattot tzaddik bammishpat tov lahem latztzaddikim sheen nosin lahem panim baolam hazze tov lo lemoshe shello nasu lo panim baolam hazze shenneemar yaan lo heemantem bi lehakdisheni ha ilu heemantem bi adayin lo higgia zemannam lipater min haolam

Ashrehem latztzaddikim lo dayyan shehen zochin ella shemmezakkin livnehem velivne venehem ad sof kol haddorot shekkamma banim hau lo leaharon sheruyin lisaref kenadav vaavihu shenneemar hannotarim ella sheamad lahem zechut avihem

Oy lahem larshaim lo dayyan shemmechayevin atzman ella shemmechayevin livnehem velivne venehem ad sof kol haddorot harbe banim hau lo lichnaan sheruyin lisamech ketavi avdo shel rabban gamliel ella shechovat avihem garma lahen

Kol hamzakke et harabbim en chet ba al yado vechol hammachti et harabbim kimat en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva kol hamzakke et harabbim en chet ba al yado may tama kede shello yehe hu begehinnam vetalmidav began eden shenneemar ki lo taazov nafshi lishol lo titten chasidcha lirot shachat vechol hammachti et harabbim en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva shello yehe hu began eden vetalmidav begehinnam shenneemar adam ashuk bedam nafesh ad bor yanus al yitmechu vo

Haomer echeta veashuv echeta veashuv lema li lememar echeta veashuv echeta veashuv tere zimne kidrav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah huttera lo huttera lo salka datach ella naaset lo keheter

Echeta veom hakkippurim mechapper en yom hakkippurim mechapper lema matnitin dela kerabbi detanya rabbi omer al kol averot shebbattora ben asa teshuva ben lo asa teshuva yom hakkippurim mechapper afilu tema rabbi aggav shane

Averot shebben adam lammakom vechu rame leh rav yosef bar chavu lerabbi avahu averot shebben adam lachavero en yom hakkippurim mechapper veha ketiv im yecheta ish leish ufillo elohim man elohim dayyana
I hachi ema sefa veim la yecheta ish mi yitpallel lo hachi kaamar im yecheta ish leish ufillo elohim yimchol lo veim la yecheta ish mi yitpallel baado teshuva umaasim tovim

Amar rabbi yitzchak kol hammaknit et chavero afilu bidvarim tzarich lefayeso shenneemar beni im aravta lereecha takata lazzar kappecha nokashta veimre ficha ase zot efo beni vehinnatzel ki vata vechaf reecha lech hitrappes urhav reecha im mamon yesh beyadcha hatter lo pissat yad veim lav harbe alav reim
Veamar rav chisda vetzarich lefayeso beshalosh shurot shel shelosha bene adam shenneemar yashor al anashim vayyomer chatati veyashar heeveti velo shava li

Veamar rabbi yose bar chanina kol hamvakkesh matu mechavero al yevakkesh mimmennu yoter mishshalosh peamim shenneemar anna sa na veatta sa na veim met mevi asara bene adam umaamidan al kivro veomer chatati la elohe yisrael velifloni shechavalti bo

Rabbi yirmeya hava leh milta lerabbi abba bahadeh azal itiv addashsha derabbi abba bahade deshadya ammeteh mayya meta zarzife demayya aresha amar asauni keashpa kera annafsheh meashpot yarim evon shema rabbi abba unfek leappeh amar leh hashta tzerichna lemipak addatach dichtiv lech hitrappes urhav reecha
Rabbi zera ki hava leh milta bahade inish hava chalef vetane lekammeh umamtze leh ki hechi denete venipok leh middateh

Rav hava leh milta bahade hahu tabbacha la ata lekammeh bemaale yoma dechippure amar ihu ezil ana lefayyose leh pega beh rav huna amar leh lehecha ka azel mar amar leh lefayyose liflanya amar azel abba lemiktal nafsha azal vekam ilaveh hava yatev veka fale resha dalli eneh vechazyeh amar leh abba atte zil let li milta bahadach bahade deka fale resha ishtemit garma umachyeh bekoeh vekatleh
Rav hava pasek sidra kammeh derabbi ayal
b: Ata rabbi chiyya hadar leresha ayal bar kappara hadar leresha ata rabbi shimon berabbi hadar leresha ata rabbi chanina bar chama amar kulle hay nehdar venezil la hadar ikfid rabbi chanina azal rav legabbeh telesar maale yome dechippure vela ipayyas

Vehechi aved hachi vehaamar rabbi yose bar chanina kol hamvakkesh matu mechavero al yevakkesh mimmennu yoter mishshalosh peamim rav shane verabbi chanina hechi aved hachi vehaamar rava kol hammaavir al middotav maavirin lo al kol peshaav
Ella rabbi chanina chelma chaze leh lerav dezakfuhu bedikla ugmiri dechol dezakfuhu bedikla resha have amar shema minah bae lemebad reshuta vela ipayyas ki hechi delezil veligmar orayeta bevavel

Tanu rabbanan mitzvat viduy erev yom hakkippurim im chashecha aval amru chachamim yitvadde kodem sheyyochal veyishte shemma tittaref dato bisuda veaf al pi shehitvadda kodem sheachal veshata mitvadde leachar sheyyochal veyishte shemma era devar kalkala basseuda veaf al pi shehitvadda arvit yitvadde shacharit shacharit yitvadde bemusaf bemusaf yitvadde bemincha bemincha yitvadde binila

Vehechan omro yachid achar tefillato ushliach tzibbur omro baemtza may amar amar rav atta yodea raze olam ushmuel amar mimmaamakke hallev velevi amar uvtoratcha katuv lemor rabbi yochanan amar ribbon haolamim

Rabbi yehuda amar ki aonotenu rabbu millimnot vechattotenu atzmu missapper rav hamnuna amar elohay ad shello notzarti eni keday achshav shennotzarti keilu lo notzarti afar ani bechayyay kal vachomer bemitati hare ani lefanecha kichli male busha uchlima yehi ratzon millefanecha shello echeta uma shechatati merok berachamecha aval lo al yede yissurin vehayenu viduya derava kullah shatta udrav hamnuna zuta beoma dechippure

Amar mar zutra la amaran ella dela amar aval anachnu chatanu aval amar aval anachnu chatanu tu la tzerich deamar bar hamdude hava kaemna kammeh dishmuel vahava yatev vechi meta shelicha detzibbura veamar aval anachnu chatanu kam mekam amar shema minah ikar viduy hay hu
Tenan hatam bishlosha perakim bashshana kohanim nosin et kappehen arbaa peamim bayyom beshacharit bemusaf bemincha uvinilat shearim veellu hen shelosha perakim betaaniyyot uvmaamadot uvom hakkippurim

May neilat shearim rav amar tzelota yattirta ushmuel amar ma anu me chayyenu metivi or yom hakkippurim mitpallel sheva umitvadde beshacharit mitpallel sheva umitvadde bemusaf mitpallel sheva umitvadde bemincha mitpallel sheva umitvadde binila mitpallel sheva umitvadde
Tannae hi detanya yom hakkippurim im chashecha mitpallel sheva umitvadde vechotem beviduy divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim mitpallel sheva veim ratza lachtom beviduy chotem teuvta dishmuel teuvta
Ulla bar rav nechet kammeh derava petach beatta bechartanu vesayyem bema anu me chayyenu veshabbecheh rav huna bereh derav natan amar veyachid omrah achar tefillato
Amar rav tefillat neila poteret et shel arvit rav letameh daamar tzelota yattira hi vechevan detzalli leh tu la tzerich
Umi amar rav hachi vehaamar rav halacha kedivre haomer tefillat arvit reshut ledivre haomer chova kaamar

Metivi or yom hakkippurim mitpallel sheva umitvadde shacharit sheva umitvadde musaf sheva umitvadde binila mitpallel sheva umitvadde arvit mitpallel sheva meen shemone esre rabbi chanina ben gamliel mishshum avotav mitpallel shemone esre shelemot

a: Mippene shetztzarich lomar havdala bechonen haddaat tannae hi detanya kol chayyave tevilot tovlin kedarkan beom hakkippurim nidda veoledet tovlot kedarkan belele yom hakkippurim
Baal keri tovel veholech ad hammincha rabbi yose omer kol hayyom kullo

Urminhu hazzav vehazzava hamtzora vehamtzoraat uvoel nidda utme met tovlin kedarkan beom hakkippurim nidda veoledet tovlot kedarkan belele yom hakkippurim baal keri tovel veholech kol hayyom kullo rabbi yose omer min hammincha ulmala en yachol litbol
La kashya ha detzalli tefillat neila ha dela tzalli
I detzalli may tamayehu derabbanan ka savri rabbanan tevila bizmannah mitzva

Mikkelal derabbi yose savar lav mitzva vehatanya hare shehaya shem katuv al besaro hare ze lo yirchatz velo yasuch velo yaamod bimkom hattinnofet nizdammena lo tevilat mitzva korech alav gemi veored vetovel rabbi yose omer yored vetovel kedarko uvilvad shello yeshafshef
Vekayema lan devitvila bizmannah mitzva peligi
Hahi rabbi yose bar yehuda hi detanya rabbi yose bar yehuda omer dayyah litvila shettehe baacharona
Tanu rabbanan haroe keri beom hakkippurim yored vetovel velaerev yeshafshef leerev may dahava hava ella ema mibbaerev yeshafshef ka savar mitzva leshafshef
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman haroe keri beom hakkippurim aonotav mechulin lo vehatanya aonotav sedurin may sedurin sedurin limachel

Tana deve rabbi yishmael haroe keri beom hakkippurim yidag kol hashshana kullah veim alta lo shana muvtach lo shehu ben haolam habba amar rav nachman bar yitzchak teda shekkol haolam kullo raev vehu savea ki ata rav dimi amar mappesh chayye sage umasge
Hadaran alach yom hakkippurim uslika lah massechet yoma
Sukka shehi gevoha lemala meesrim amma pesula verabbi yehuda machshir
Vesheenah gevoha asara tefachim vesheen lah shelosha defanot veshechamatah merubba metzillatah pesula
Gema tenan hatam mavoy shehu gavoha meesrim amma yemaet rabbi yehuda omer eno tzarich
May shena gabbe sukka detane pesula umay shena gabbe mavoy detane takkanta
Sukka deorayeta tane pesula mavoy derabbanan tane takkanta
Veibaet ema bidorayeta name tane takkanta mihu sukka dinfishi milatah pasek vetane pesula mavoy dela nefish mileh tane takkanta
Mena hane mile

Amar rabba deamar kera lemaan yedu dorotechem ki vassukkot hoshavti et bene yisrael ad esrim amma adam yodea shehu dar bassukka lemala meesrim amma en adam yodea sheddar bassukka mishshum dela shalta bah ena
Rabbi zera amar mehacha vesukka tihye letzel yomam mechorev ad esrim amma adam yoshev betzel sukka lemala meesrim amma en adam yoshev betzel sukka ella betzel defanot
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta haose sukkato beashterot karnayim hachi name dela have sukka
Amar leh hatam dal ashterot karnayim ika tzel sukka hacha dal defanot leka tzel sukka

Verava amar mehacha bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim amra tora kol shivat hayyamim tze middirat keva veshev bedirat aray ad esrim amma adam ose dirato dirat aray lemala meesrim amma en adam ose dirato dirat aray ella dirat keva
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta asa mechitzot shel barzel vesikech al gabban hachi name dela have sukka
Amar leh hachi kaamena lach ad esrim amma deadam ose dirato dirat aray ki aved leh dirat keva name nafek lemala meesrim amma deadam ose dirato dirat keva ki aved leh dirat aray name la nafek
b: Kullehu kerabba la amri hahu yedia ledorot hi
Kerabbi zera name la amri hahu limot hammashiach hu dichtiv
Verabbi zera im ken lema kera vechuppa tihye letzel yomam umay vesukka tihye letzel yomam shamatte minah tarte
Kerava name la amri mishshum kushya deabbaye
Keman azla ha deamar rabbi yoshiyya amar rav machloket besheen defanot maggiot lassechach aval defanot maggiot lassechach afilu lemala meesrim amma keshera keman
Kerabba deamar mishshum dela shalta bah ena vechevan didfanot maggiot lassechach mishlat shalta bah ena
Keman azla ha deamar rav huna amar rav machloket besheen bah ella arba ammot al arba ammot aval yesh bah yoter mearba ammot al arba ammot afilu lemala meesrim amma keshera keman
Kerabbi zera deamar mishshum tzel hu vechevan dirvicha ika tzel sukka

Keman azla ha deamar rav chanan bar rabba amar rav machloket besheenah machzeket ella kede rosho verubbo veshulchano aval machzeket yoter mikkede rosho verubbo veshulchano afilu lemala meesrim amma keshera keman dela kechad
Bishlama derabbi yoshiyya peliga adderav huna verav chanan bar rabba deinhu ka yahavi shiura bimshacha veihu la ka yahev shiura bimshacha
Ella rav huna verav chanan bar rabba nema behechsher sukka kamipalgi demar savar hechsher sukka bearba ammot umar savar hechsher sukka bemachzeket rosho verubbo veshulchano
La dechulle alma hechsher sukka rosho verubbo veshulchano vehacha beha kamipalgi demar savar bemachzeket rosho verubbo veshulchano peligi aval yoter merosho verubbo veshulchano divre hakkol keshera
Umar savar merosho verubbo veshulchano ad arba ammot peligi aval yoter mearba ammot divre hakkol keshera
Metivi sukka shehi gevoha lemala meesrim amma pesula verabbi yehuda machshir ad arbaim vachamishshim amma

Amar rabbi yehuda maase beheleni hammalka belod shehayeta sukkatah gevoha meesrim amma vehau zekenim nichnasin veotzin lesham velo amru lah davar amru lo mishsham reaya ishsha hayeta uftura min hassukka amar lahen vahalo shiva banim hao lah veod kol maaseha lo asta ella al pi chachamim
Lema li lemitne veod kol maaseha lo asta ella al pi chachamim
Hachi kaamar lehu ki tomru banim ketannim hau uktannim peturin min hassukka kevan deshiva hao i efshar dela have behu chad sheeno tzarich leimmo
Vechi temru katan sheeno tzarich leimmo midderabbanan hu demichayyav veihi bidrabbanan la mashgecha ta shema veod kol maaseha lo asta ella al pi chachamim
Bishlama leman deamar besheen defanot maggiot lassechach machloket darkah shel malka leshev besukka sheen defanot maggiot lassechach

a: Mishshum avera ella leman deamar besukka ketanna machloket vechi darkah shel malka leshev besukka ketanna amar rabba bar rav adda lo nitzrecha ella sukka haasuya kitoniyyot kitoniyyot
Vechi darkah shel malka leshev besukka haasuya kitoniyyot kitoniyyot amar rav ashe lo nitzrecha ella lekitoniyyot shebbah

Rabbanan savri baneha besukka mealleya hao yatvi veihi yatva bekitoniyyot mishshum tzeniuta umishshum hachi la amri lah davar verabbi yehuda savar baneha gabbah hao yatvi vaafilu hachi la amri lah davar
Amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak halacha tzericha shettehe machzeket rosho verubbo veshulchano amar leh rabbi abba keman kevet shammay amar leh ella keman
Ika deamri amar rabbi abba daamar lach manni amar leh bet shammay hi vela tezuz minah

Matkef lah rav nachman bar yitzchak mimmay devet shammay uvet hillel besukka ketanna peligi dilma besukka gedola peligi uchgon deyatev appumma dimtulleta veshulchano betoch habbayit devet shammay savri gazrinan shemma yimmashech achar shulchano uvet hillel savri la gazrinan
Vedayeka name dekatane mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin veim ita machzeket veenah machzeket mibe leh
Uvsukka ketanna la peligi vehatanya machzeket rosho verubbo veshulchano keshera rabbi omer ad sheyehe bah arba ammot al arba ammot

Vetanya idach rabbi omer kol sukka sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot pesula vachachamim omrim afilu enah machzeket ella rosho verubbo keshera veilu shulchano la katane kashyan ahadade ella lav shema minah ha bet shammay ha bet hillel
Amar mar zutra matnitin name dayeka middekatane bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin veim ita bet shammay omrim lo yatza uvet hillel omrim yatza mibe leh
Veella kashya mi shehaya

Leolam betarte peligi peligi besukka ketanna ufligi besukka gedola vechassore michassera vehachi katane mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit bet shammay omrim lo yatza uvet hillel omrim yatza vesheenah machzeket ella kede rosho verubbo bilvad bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan bayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot patur min hammezuza umin hammaake veeno mittamme bingaim veeno nechlat bevatte are choma
Veen chozrin alav meorche hammilchama veen mearvin bo veen mishtattefin bo veen mannichin bo eruv
b: Veen osin oto ibur ben shette ayarot veen haachin vehashshuttafin cholkin bo

Lema rabbi hi vela rabbanan afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella leinyan sukka dedirat aray hi aval legabbay bayit dedirat keva hu afilu rabbanan modu dei it beh arba ammot al arba ammot dayeri beh inashe vei la la dayeri beh inashe
Amar mar patur min hammezuza umin hammaake veen mittamme bingaim veeno nechlat bevatte are choma veen chozrin alav meorche hammilchama may tama devayit ketiv behu bechullehu
Veen mearvin bo veen mishtattefin bo veen mannichin bo eruv may tama dela chaze ledira eruve chatzerot en mannichin bo aval shituf mannichin bo
May tama dela gara mechatzer shebbemavoy ditnan eruve chatzerot bechatzer shitufe mavoy bammavoy
Vehavenan bah eruve chatzerot bechatzer vehatnan hannoten eruvo bevet shaar achsadra umirpeset eno eruv vehaddar sham eno oser
Ella ema eruve chatzerot bevayit shebbechatzer veshitufe mevoot bechatzer shebbammavoy vehay la gara mechatzer shebbemavoy
Veen osin oto ibur ben shette ayarot daafilu kevurganin la meshavenan leh may tama burganin chazu lemiltayehu vehay la chaze lemilteh
Veen haachin vehashshuttafin cholkin bo tama delet beh arba ammot ha it beh arba ammot cholkin
Vehatnan en cholkin et hechatzer ad sheyehe bah arba ammot laze vearba ammot laze
Ella ema en bo din chalukka kechatzer deamar rav huna chatzer lefi petacheha mitchalleket verav chisda amar noten lechol petach vafetach arba ammot vehashshear cholkin oto beshave
Dehane mile bayit dilmeheve kae yahavinan leh chatzer hay dilmistar kae la yahavinan leh chatzer
Hayeta gevoha meesrim amma uva lemaatah becharim uchsatot la have miut

a: Veaf al gav devattelinhu lechullehu mishshum devatla dato etzel kol adam
Teven uvittelo have miut vechol shekken afar uvittelo
Teven veen atid lefannoto veafar setam machloket rabbi yose verabbanan ditnan bayit shemmilahu teven o tzerorot uvitlo mevuttal
Bitlo in lo bitlo la vetane alah rabbi yose omer teven veen atid lefannoto hare hu keafar setam uvatel afar veatid lefannoto hare hu kistam teven vela batel
Hayeta gevoha meesrim amma vehutzin yordin betoch esrim amma im tzillatam merubba mechamatam keshera veim lav pesula
Hayeta gevoha asara tefachim vehutzin yordin letoch asara savar abbaye lememar im chamatam merubba mitztzillatam keshera
Amar leh rava ha dira serucha hi veen adam dar bedira serucha
Hayeta gevoha meesrim amma uvana bah itzteva keneged dofen haemtzai al pene kullah veyesh bah hechsher sukka keshera
Umin hatztzad im yesh missefat itzteva lakkotel arba ammot pesula pachot mearba ammot keshera
May ka mashma lan deamrinan dofen akumma tenena bayit shennifchat vesikech al gabbav im yesh min hakkotel lassikuch arba ammot pesula ha pachot mikkan keshera
Mahu detema hatam hu dechazya ledofen aval hacha dela chazya ledofen ema la ka mashma lan
Hayeta gevoha meesrim amma uvana itzteva beemtzaitah im yesh missefat itzteva veladdofen arba ammot lechol ruach varuach pesula pachot mearba ammot keshera
May ka mashma lan deamrinan dofen akumma hayenu hach

b: Devar tora rubbo umakpid alav chotzetz vesheeno makpid alav eno chotzetz vegazru al rubbo sheeno makpid mishshum rubbo hammakpid veal miuto hammakpid mishshum rubbo hammakpid

Tanu rabbanan shettayim kehilchatan ushlishit afilu tefach rabbi shimon omer shalosh kehilchatan urviit afilu tefach

Rabbanan savri yesh em lammasoret besukkat besukkat bassukkot hare kan arba
Dal chad legufeh pashu lehu telata shettayim kehilchatan vaatay hilcheta ugratah lishlishit veokemtah attefach
Rabbi shimon savar yesh em lammikra bassukkot bassukkot bassukkot hare kan shesh dal chad kera legufeh pashu lehu arba shalosh kehilchatan atay hilcheta ugratah lirviit veokemtah attefach
Vei baet ema dechulle alma yesh em lammikra vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar sechacha baaya kera umar savar sechacha la baaya kera

Umay shena hatam dekaamratte saggi tefach sochek umay shena hacha dekaamratte baaya pas arbaa hatam deika shette defanot kehilchatan saggi leh betefach sochek hacha deleka shette defanot i ika pas arbaa en i la la

Shettayim kehilchatan ku amar rava vechen leshabbat miggo dehaveya dofen leinyan sukka haveya dofen leinyan shabbat
Etiveh abbaye umi amrinan miggo vehatanya dofen sukka kedofen shabbat uvilvad shello yehe ben kane lachavero shelosha tefachim
Vitera shabbat al sukka shehashshabbat enah nitteret ella beomed merubbe al happarutz ma sheen ken besukka

I hachi litne name yetera sukka dealma assukka deshabbat deilu sukka dealma baaya tefach sochek veilu sukka deshabbat la baaya tefach sochek vesaggi belechi

a: Matni sukka yeshana bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin veezo hi sukka yeshana kol sheasaah kodem lechag sheloshim yom aval im asaah leshem chag afilu mittechilat hashshana keshera

Ella may tamayehu devet shammay ketiv kera acharina chag hassukkot taase lecha shivat yamim sukka haasuya leshem chag baenan

Uvet hillel let lehu derav yehuda amar rav deamar rav yehuda amar rav asaah min hakkotzin umin hannimin umin haggeradin pesula min hassisin keshera

Ha name tenena hidla aleha et haggefen veet haddelaat veet hakkisos vesikech al gabban pesula veim haya sikuch harbe mehen o shekketzatzan keshera
