Minyamin avdeh derav ashe itmisha leh kittunta bemayya veashtechah ammetallalta amar leh rav ashe dalyah dela lemru ka mesakkechi bedavar hamkabbel tuma veha ka chazu lah derattiva lechi yavsha kaamena lach
Ittemar noye sukka hammuflagin mimmenna arbaa rav nachman amar keshera rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri pesula

Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna iklau leve resh galuta agninhu rav nachman besukka shennoyeha muflagin mimmenna arbaa tefachim ishtiku vela amaru leh vela mide amar lehu hadur behu rabbanan mishshematayehu amaru leh anan sheluche mitzva anan ufturin min hassukka
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel muttar lishan bechila bassukka af al pi sheyyesh lah gag vehu sheenah gevoha asara
Ta shema hayyashen bechila bassukka lo yatza yede chovato hacha bemay askinan kesheggevoha asara
Metivi hayyashen tachat hammitta bassukka lo yatza yede chovato ha targemah shemuel bemitta gevoha asara
Ta shema o shepperas al gabbe kinofot pesula hatam name digvihi asara

Veha la katane hachi detanya naklitin shenayim vekinofot arbaa peras al gabbe kinofot pesula al gabbe naklitin keshera uvilvad shello yihu naklitin gevohin min hammitta asara mikkelal dekinofot af al pi sheen gevohin asara
Shane kinofot dikvii vahare sukka al gabbe sukka dikvia veamar shemuel kehechsherah kach pesulah amri hatam dilmifsal sukka baasara hacha dilshauoye uhla betzir measara name have uhla
Amar rav tachlifa bar avimi amar shemuel hayyashen bechila arom motzi rosho chutz lakkila vekore keriat shema
Metivi hayyashen bechila arom lo yotzi rosho chutz lakkila veyikra keriat shema hacha bemay askinan kesheggevoha asara
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane sefa ha lema ze dome leomed bevayit arom shello yotzi rosho chutz lachallon veyikra keriat shema shema minah

a: Uvayit name af al pi sheen gavoha asara kevan dikvia uhla hu dela gara mikkinofot
Lishana acharina amri lah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel muttar lishan bechilat chatanim bassukka lefi sheen lah gag af al pi sheggevoha asara
Metivi hayyashen bechila bassukka lo yatza yede chovato hacha bemay askinan besheyyesh lah gag

Ta shema naklitin shenayim vekinofot arbaa peras al gabbe kinofot pesula al gabbe naklitin keshera uvilvad shello yehu naklitin gevohin min hammitta asara tefachim ha gevohin min hammitta asara pesula af al pi sheen lah gag
Shane naklitin dikvii i kevii leheve kekinofot legabbay kinofot la kevii legabbe chila kevii

Daresh rabba bar rav huna muttar lishan bechila af al pi sheyyesh lah gag af al pi sheggevoha asara keman kerabbi yehuda deamar la ate ohel aray umvattel ohel keva ditnan amar rabbi yehuda nohagin hayinu lishan tachat hammitta bifne hazzekenim
Velema halacha kerabbi yehuda

I amar halacha kerabbi yehuda hava amena hane mile mitta dilgabbah asuya aval kila diltochah asuya ema la ka mashma lan tama derabbi yehuda dela ate ohel aray umvattel ohel kava la shena mitta vela shena kila
Matni hidla aleha et haggefen veet haddallaat veet hakkisos vesikech al gabbah pesula veim haya sikuch harbe mehen o shekketzatzan keshera
Ze hakkelal kol shehu mekabbel tuma veen gidulo min haaretz en mesakkechin bo vechol davar sheeno mekabbel tuma vegidulo min haaretz mesakkechin bo
Gema yatev rav yosef kammeh derav huna veyatev vekaamar o shekketzatzan keshera veamar rav tzarich lenanea

Amar leh rav huna ha shemuel amrah ahderinhu rav yosef leappeh vaamar leh attu mi kaamena lach dela amrah shemuel amrah rav veamrah shemuel amar leh rav huna hachi kaamena lach dishmuel amrah vela rav derav achshore machshar ki ha derav amram chasida rema techelta lefarzuma deinashe beteh telaan velo pasak rashe chutin shellahen
Ata lekammeh derav chiyya bar ashe amar leh hachi amar rav mefassekan vehen kesherin alma pesikatan zo hi asiyyatan hacha name ketzitzatan zo hi asiyyatan

Vesavar shemuel la amrinan pesikatan zo hi asiyyatan veha tane shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyya hetil lishne keranot bevat achat veachar kach pasak rashe chutin shellahen kesherin may lav shekkosher veachar kach posek lo shepposek veachar kach kosher
Posek veachar kach kosher may lememra mahu detema
b: Baenan kanaf bishat petil veleka ka mashma lan

Metivi telaan velo pasak rashe chutin shellahen pesulin may lav pesulin leolam utuvta derav amar lecha rav may pesulin pesulin ad sheyyippasku ushmuel amar pesulin leolam vechen amar levi pesulin leolam vechen amar rav matna amar shemuel pesulin leolam
Ika deamri amar rav matna bedidi hava ovada vaatay lekammeh demar shemuel vaamar li pesulin leolam

Metivi telaan veachar kach pasak rashe chutin shellahen pesulin veod tanya gabbe sukka taase velo min heasuy mikkan amru hidla aleha et haggefen veet haddallaat veet hakkisos vesikech al gabban pesula

Hechi dame ilema beshello ketzatzan may irya mishshum taase velo min heasuy tipok leh dimchubbarin ninhu ella beshekketzatzan vekatane pesula ushma minah dela amrinan ketzitzatan zo hi asiyyatan utuvta derav
Amar lecha rav hacha bemay askinan deshalfinhu shallofe dela minachra asiyya didhu mikkol makom telaan veachar kach pasak kashya lerav kashya
Lema ketannae avar veliktan pasul divre rabbi shimon bar yehotzadak vachachamim machshirin
Savruha dechulle alma lulav tzarich eged veyalfinan lulav missukka dichtiv gabbe sukka taase velo min heasuy

May lav beha ka mipalgi deman demachshar savar amrinan gabbe sukka ketzitzatan zo hi asiyyatan vegabbe lulav name amrinan lekitatan zo hi asiyyatan uman defasel savar la amrinan gabbe sukka ketzitzatan zo hi asiyyatan vegabbe lulav name la amrinan lekitatan zo hi asiyyatan
La dechulle alma la amrinan gabbe sukka ketzitzatan zo hi asiyyatan vehacha bemelaf lulav missukka kamipalgi man demachshar savar la yalfinan lulav missukka uman defasel savar yalfinan lulav missukka

Vei baet ema i sevira lan delulav tzarich eged kulle alma la peligi deyalfinan lulav missukka vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar tzarich eged umar savar en tzarich eged uviflugta dehane tannae detanya lulav ben agud ben sheeno agud kasher rabbi yehuda omer agud kasher sheeno agud pasul

May tameh derabbi yehuda yalef lekicha lekicha meaguddat ezov ketiv hatam ulkachtem aguddat ezov uchtiv hacha ulkachtem lachem bayyom harishon ma lehallan baagudda af kan name baagudda verabbanan lekicha millekicha la yalfinan

Keman azla ha detanya lulav mitzva leogdo veim lo agado kasher i rabbi yehuda ki lo agado ammay kasher i rabbanan ammay mitzva leolam rabbanan hi umishshum shenneemar ze eli veanvehu hitnae lefanav bemitzot

Ze hakkelal kol davar shemmekabbel tuma ku mena hane mile amar resh lakish amar kera veed yaale min haaretz ma ed davar sheeno mekabbel tuma vegidulo min haaretz af sukka davar sheen mekabbel tuma vegidulo min haaretz

Hanicha leman deamar anne chavod hau ella leman deamar sukkot mammash asu lahem may ika lememar detanya ki vassukkot hoshavti et bene yisrael anne chavod hau divre rabbi eliezer rabbi akiva omer sukkot mammash asu lahem hanicha lerabbi eliezer ella lerabbi akiva may ika lememar

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan amar kera chag hassukkot taase lecha makkish sukka lachagiga ma chagiga davar sheeno mekabbel tuma vegidulo min haaretz af sukka davar sheeno mekabbel tuma vegidulo min haaretz

a: I ma chagiga baale chayyim af sukka name baale chayyim
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan amar kera beospecha miggornecha umiyyikvecha bifsolet goren vayekev hakkatuv medabber
Veema goren atzmo vayekev atzmo amar rabbi zera yekev ketiv kan vei efshar lesakkech bo
Matkef lah rabbi yirmeya veema yayin karush habba missenir shehu dome leigule devela amar rabbi zera ha milleta hava bidan vaata rabbi yirmeya ushda bah narga
Rav ashe amar miggornecha velo goren atzmo miyyikvecha velo yekev atzmo
Rav chisda amar mehacha tzeu hahar vehaviu ale zayit vaale etz shemen vaale hadas vaale temarim vaale etz avot
Hayenu hadas hayenu etz avot amar rav chisda hadas shote lesukka veetz avot lelulav
Matni chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradin en mesakkechin bahen vechullan shehittiran kesherot vechullan kesherot lidfanot
Gema amar rabbi yaakov shemait mineh derabbi yochanan tarte chada ha veidach hachotet baggadish laasot lo sukka enah sukka
Chada mishshum gezerat otzar vachada mishshum taase velo min heasuy vela yadana he minayehu mishshum otzar vehe minayehu mishshum taase velo min heasuy

Amar rabbi yirmeya nichze anan deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan mippene ma amru chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradin en mesakkechin bahen peamim sheadam ba min hassade baerev vachavilato al ketefo umaalah umannichah al gabbe sukkato kede leyabbeshah venimlach aleha lesikuch vehattora amra taase velo min heasuy middeha mishshum gezerat otzar ha mishshum taase velo min heasuy
Verabbi yaakov hach derabbi chiyya bar abba la shemia leh
Amar rav ashe attu chavile kash vachavile etzim mishshum gezerat otzar ika mishshum taase velo min heasuy leka vehachotet begadish mishshum taase velo min heasuy ika mishshum gezerat otzar leka
Verabbi yochanan amar lach hacha dekatane en mesakkechin bahen lechattechilla hu
b: Deen mesakkechin mishshum gezerat otzar ha deorayeta shappir dame hatam dekatane enah sukka afilu diavad middeorayeta name enah sukka
Amar rav yehuda amar rav sikkechah bechitzin zecharim keshera binkevot pesula
Zecharim keshera peshita mahu detema nigzor zecharim attu nekevot ka mashma lan
Amar mar binkevot pesula peshita mahu detema bet kibbul heasuy lemalloot la shemeh kibul kamashma lan
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan sikkechah baanitze fishtan pesula behutzne fishtan keshera vehushne fishtan eni yodea mahu
Vehushne atzman eni yodea ma nafshach i deyik vela nefitz hushne kare leh aval tere vela deyik hutzne kare leh o dilma tere vela deyik name hushne kare leh
Amar rav yehuda hane shushe ushotzre mesakkechin behu abbaye amar beshushe mesakkechin bishotzre la mesakkechin may tama kevan

a: Desare rechayehu shavek lehu venafek
Amar rav chanan bar rava hane hizme vehige mesakkechin behu abbaye amar behizme mesakkechinan behige la mesakkechinan may tama kevan denatri tarfayehu shavek lah venafek
Amar rav gidel amar rav hay appakuta dedikla mesakkechin behu af al gav daagidi eged bide shamayim la shemeh eged af al gav dahadar aged lehu eged bechad la shemeh eged
Amar rav chisda amar ravina bar shela hane dukre dekane mesakkechin behu af al gav daagidi ninhu eged bide shamayim la shemeh eged af al gav dahadar aged lehu eged bechad la shemeh eged
Tanya name hachi kanim vedukranin mesakkechin bahen kanim peshita ema kanim shel dukranin mesakkechin bahen
Veamar rav chisda amar ravina bar shela hane meraryata deagma adam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach
Metivi ezov velo ezov yon velo ezov kocholi velo ezov midbari velo ezov romi velo ezov sheyyesh lo shem levay
Amar abbaye kol shennishtanna shemo kodem mattan tora uvata tora vehikpida alav beyadua sheyyesh lo shem levay vehane lo nishtanna shemayehu kodem mattan tora kelal
Rava amar hane meraryata setama shemayehu vehay dekare lehu meraryata deagma mishshum demishtechach beagma

Amar rav chisda eged bechad la shemeh eged shalosh shemeh eged shenayim machloket rabbi yose verabbanan ditnan mitzvat ezov shelosha kelachim uvahen shelosha givolin rabbi yose omer mitzvat ezov shelosha givolin ushyarav shenayim vegardummav kol shehu
Ka salka datin middishyarav shenayim techilato name shenayim vehay dekatane shelosha lemitzva umidderabbi yose shelosha lemitzva lerabbanan shelosha leakkev
Vehatanya rabbi yose omer ezov techilato shenayim ushyarav echad pasul veeno kasher ad sheyehe techilato shelosha ushyarav shenayim efoch lerabbi yose shelosha leakkev lerabbanan shelosha lemitzva
Vehatanya ezov techilato shenayim ushyarav echad kasher veeno pasul ad sheyehe techillato ushyarav echad
Sheyarav echad pasul ha amratte sheyarav echad kasher
b: Ella ema ad shettehe techillato kishyarav echad
Daresh marimar hane isuryata desura mesakkechin behu af al gav daagidan leminyana bealma hu daagidan
Amar rabbi abba hane tzerife deurbane kevan shehuttera rashe maadannim shellahen kesherin veha agidi mittattay amar rav pappa deshare lehu
Veamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua afilu tema dela share lehu kol eged sheeno asuy letaltelo la shemeh eged

Amar rabbi abba amar shemuel yerakot sheamru chachamim adam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach meviin et hattuma veen chotztzin bifne hattuma ufoslin bassukka mishshum avir may tama kevan dilchi yavshi parchi venafli keman deletanhu dame
Veamar rabbi abba amar rav huna habbotzer laggat en lo yadot
Verav menashsheya bar gadda amar rav huna hakkotzer lischach en lo yadot
Man deamar kotzer kol shekken botzer dela nicha leh dela nimtzeyeh lechamreh man deamar botzer sheen lo yadot aval kotzer yesh lo yadot denicha leh delisakkech behu ki hechi dela libadderan

Nema derav menashsheya bar gadda tannae hi detanya soche teenim uvahen teenim parkilin uvahen anavim kashshin uvahen shibbolim machbedot uvahen temarim kullan im pesolet merubba al haochalin keshera veim lav pesula acherim omrim ad sheyehu kashshin merubbin al hayyadot veal haochalin
May lav beha ka mipalgi demar savar yesh lahen yadot umar savar en lahen yadot

Lerabbi abba vadday tannae hi lerav menashsheya bar gadda mi lema tannae hi amar lach rav menashsheya dechulle alma savri hakkotzer lischach en lo yadot vehacha bemay askinan kegon shekketzatzan laachila venimlach alehen lesikuch
I ketzatzan laachila may tamayehu derabbanan vechi tema kasavri rabbanan kevan denimlach alehen lesikuch batla leh machshavto umi batla leh machshava behachi vehatnan kol hakkelim

a: Yordin lide tuma bemachshava veen olin mittumatan ella beshinuy maase maase motzi miyyad maase umiyyad machshava machshava enah motzia lo miyyad maase velo miyyad machshava
Vechi tema hane mile kelim dachashivi aval yadot diltzorech achila ninhu bemachshava naase uvmachshava salka vehatnan kal yedot haochalin shebbesasan baggoren tehorot verabbi yose metamme
Bishlama leman deamar besasan hittir iggudan shappir ella leman deamar may besasan besasan mammash may ika lememar
Hacha name shebbesasan mammash i hachi may tamayehu daacherim daamur kerabbi yose ditnan rabbi yose metamme
Hay may bishlama hatam tama derabbi yose chazya lechidrabbi shimon ben lakish deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish hoil uruot lehofchan beeter
Ella hacha lemay chazya chazya lechi satar leminkat lehu begilayehu
Gufa kal yedot haochalin shebbesasan baggoren tehorot verabbi yose metamme may besasan rabbi yochanan amar besasan mammash rabbi eliezer omer hittir agdan

Bishlama lerabbi eliezer deamar besasan hittir agdan hayenu dimtamme rabbi yose ella lerabbi yochanan deamar besasan mammash ammay metamme rabbi yose amar rabbi shimon ben lakish hoil uruot lehofchan beeter

Amar rabbi eliezer lamma nimshela tefillatan shel tzaddikim keeter lomar lach ma eter ze mehappech et hattevua baggoren mimmakom lemakom af tefillatan shel tzaddikim mehappechet dato shel hakkadosh baruch hu mimmiddat achzariyyut lemiddat rachamanut
Matni mesakkechin binsarim divre rabbi yehuda verabbi meir oser natan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim keshera uvilvad shello yishan tachtav

Gema amar rav machloket binsarin sheyyesh bahen arbaa derabbi meir it leh gezerat tikra verabbi yehuda let leh gezerat tikra aval binsarin sheen bahen arbaa divre hakkol keshera ushmuel amar besheen bahen arbaa machaloket aval yesh bahen arbaa divre hakkol pesula
En bahen arbaa vaafilu pachot mishshelosha ha kanim bealma ninhu

Amar rav pappa hachi kaamar yesh bahen arbaa divre hakkol pesula pachot mishshelosha divre hakkol keshera may tama kanim bealma ninhu ki peligi mishshelosha ad arbaa mar savar kevan deletanhu shiur makom la gazrinan umar savar kevan denafki lehu mittorat lavud gazrinan

Tenan natan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim keshera uvilvad shello yishan tachtav bishlama lishmuel deamar besheen bahen arbaa machloket aval yesh bahen arbaa divre hakkol pesula mishshum hachi la yishan tachtav ella lerav deamar besheyyesh bahen arbaa machloket aval en bahen arbaa divre hakkol keshera lerabbi yehuda ammay lo yishan tachtav
Mi savratte divre hakkol hi sefa atan lerabbi meir
Ta shema shene sedinin mitztarfin
b: Shene nesarin en mitztarfin rabbi meir omer af nesarin kisdinin
Bishlama lishmuel deamar besheen bahen arbaa machloket aval yesh bahen arbaa divre hakkol pesula may mitztarfin mitztarfin learbaa
Ella lerav deamar besheyyesh bahen arbaa machloket aval en bahen arbaa divre hakkol keshera hechi dame i deit behu arbaa lema lehu leitzterofe i delet behu arbaa ammay veha kanim bealma ninhu
Leolam deit behu arbaa umay mitztarfin mitztarfin learba ammot min hatztzad
Lishana acharina bishlama lishmuel deamar besheen bahen arbaa machloket aval yesh bahen arbaa divre hakkol pesula may mitztarfin mitztarfin learba ammot min hatztzad

Ella lerav bishlama lerabbi meir may mitztarfin mitztarfin learba ammot min hatztzad ella lerabbi yehuda deamar afilu yesh bahen arbaa keshera may en mitztarfin kanim bealma ninhu ayede dekaamar rabbi meir mitztarfin amar rabbi yehuda en mitztarfin
Tanya keoteh derav tanya keoteh dishmuel
Tanya keoteh derav sikkechah binsarim shel erez sheen bahen arbaa divre hakkol keshera yesh bahen arbaa rabbi meir posel verabbi yehuda machshir
Amar rabbi yehuda maase bishat hassakkana shehevenu nesarim shehau bahen arbaa vesikachnu al gabbe mirpeset veyashavnu tachtehen amru lo mishsham reaya en sheat hassakkana reaya

Tanya keoteh dishmuel sikkechah binsarim shel erez sheyyesh bahen arbaa divre hakkol pesula en bahen arbaa rabbi meir posel verabbi yehuda machshir umode rabbi meir sheim yesh ben neser leneser kimlo neser shemmanniach pesal benehem uchshera umode rabbi yehuda sheim natan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim keshera veen yeshenim tachtav vehayyashen tachtav lo yatza yede chovato
Ittemar hafachan al tzidehen rav huna amar pesula verav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri keshera
Ikla rav nachman lesura ul legabbeh rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri leh hafachan al tzidehen mahu amar lehu pesula naasu keshappudin shel mattechet
Amar lehu rav huna la amari lechu emaru keoti amaru leh umi amar lan mar tama vela kabbelnan mineh amar lehu umi beetu minay tama vela amari lechu

Lema mesayya leh enah machzeket kede rosho verubbo veshulchano o shennifretza bah pirtza kede sheyyizdakker bah gedi bevat rosh o shennatan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim af al pi shello hichnis letochah ella shelosha tefachim pesula

Hechi dame may lav kegon shehafachan al tzidehem la hacha bemay askinan kegon deannechah appumma dimtallalta deayel telata legav veappek chad levar dehave leh pesal hayyotze min hassukka vechol pesal hayyotze min hassukka nidon kassukka

a: Matni tikra sheen aleha maaziva rabbi yehuda omer bet shammay omrim mefakpek venotel achat mibbentayim uvet hillel omrim mefakpek o notel achat mibbentayim rabbi meir omer notel achat mibbentayim veeno mefakpek

Gema bishlama bet hillel tamayehu mishshum taase velo min heasuy i mefakpek aved leh maase i notel achat mibbentayim aved bah maase ella bet shammay may tamayehu i mishshum taase velo min heasuy bachada saggi i mishshum gezerat tikra benotel achat mibbentayim saggi
Leolam mishshum gezerat tikra vehachi kaamri af al pi shemmefakpek i notel achat mibbentayim in i la la
I hachi ema sefa rabbi meir omer notel achat mibbentayim aval lo yefakpek rabbi meir hayenu bet shammay
Hachi kaamar lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel bedavar ze
May ka mashma lan derabbi meir it leh gezerat tikra verabbi yehuda let leh gezerat tikra veha ippeligu bah chada zimna ditnan mesakkechin binsarim divre rabbi yehuda verabbi meir oser
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan resha binsarim meshuppin askinan umishshum gezerat kelim nagu bah
Ulrav yehuda amar rav deamar sikkechah bechitzin zecharim keshera binkevot pesula vela gazar zecharim attu nekevot hacha name la nigzar nesarim meshuppin attu kelim
Ella al korchach resha peligi bigzerat tikra vesefa peligi bigzerat tikra veippeloge betarte zimne lema li

Sefa rabbi yehuda hi deka amar leh lerabbi meir ammay ka asratte binsarim mishshum gezerat tikra hay sevara levet shammay hu deit lehu uvet hillel la gazri veamar rabbi meir lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel bedavar ze

Hanicha lerav deamar machloket besheyyesh bahen arbaa derabbi meir it leh gezerat tikra verabbi yehuda let leh gezerat tikra ella shemuel deamar besheen bahen arbaa machloket aval yesh bahen arbaa divre hakkol pesula sefa bemay peligi
Bevatole tikra ka mipalgi mar savar batla behachi umar savar behachi la batla
Matni hamkare sukkato beshappudin o baarukkot hammitta im yesh revach benehen kemotan keshera hachotet begadish laasot lo sukka enah sukka
Gema lema tehve teuvta derav huna bereh derav yehoshua deittemar parutz keomed rav pappa amar muttar verav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar asur
Amar lecha rav huna bereh derav yehoshua may kemotan benichnas veotze
b: Veha efshar letzamtzem amar rabbi amme bemaadif
Rava amar afilu tema besheen maadif im hau netunim sheti notnan erev erev notnan sheti
O baarukkot hammitta lema mesayya leh lerabbi amme bar tavome deamar rabbi amme bar tavome sikkechah bivlae chelim pesula
Kidamar rabbi chanan amar rabbi baarukka ushte cheraayim biktzara ushte cheraayim hacha name baarukka ushte cheraayim biktzara ushte cheraayim
Hecha itmar derabbi chanan amar rabbi aha ditnan

a: Mitta metammet chavila umtaheret chavila divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim metammet evarim umtaheret evarim may nihu amar rabbi chanan amar rabbi arukka ushte cheraayim ketzara ushte cheraayim
Lemay chazya lemismechinhu aggudda ulmetav alayehu umishde ashle
Gufa amar rabbi amme bar tavome sikkechah bivlae chelim pesula may belae chelim amar abbaye matlaniyyot sheen bahem shalosh al shalosh dela chazyan lo laaniyyim velo laashirim
Tanya keoteh derabbi amme bar tavome machtzelet shel shifa veshel gemi sheyareha af al pi shennifchatu mikkeshiurah en mesakkechin bahen
Machtzelet hakkanim gedola mesakkechin bah ketanna en mesakkechin bah rabbi eliezer omer af hi mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah
Hachotet begadish amar rav huna lo shanu ella sheen sham chalal tefach bemeshech shiva aval yesh sham chalal tefach bemeshech shiva hare zo sukka
Tanya name hachi hachotet begadish laasot lo sukka hare zo sukka vehaanan tenan enah sukka ella lav shema minah kidrav huna shema minah

Ika derame lah mirme tenan hachotet begadish laasot lo sukka enah sukka veha tanya hare zo sukka amar rav huna la kashya kan besheyyesh sham chalal tefach bemeshech shiva kan besheen sham chalal tefach bemeshech shiva

Matni hamshalshel defanot milmala lematta im gavoha min haaretz shelosha tefachim pesula millematta lemala im gavoha asara tefachim keshera rabbi yose omer keshem shemmillematta lemala asara tefachim kach milmala lematta asara tefachim
Gema bemay kamipalgi mar savar mechitza teluya matteret umar savar mechitza teluya enah matteret
Tenan hatam bor shebben shette chatzerot en memallein mimmenna beshabbat ella im ken asa lah mechitza asara tefachim ben milmala ben millematta ben betoch ogno rabban shimon ben gamliel omer
b: Bet shammay omrim milmala uvet hillel omrim millematta amar rabbi yehuda lo tehe mechitza gedola min hakkotel shebbenehen
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan rabbi yehuda beshitat rabbi yose amarah deamar mechitza teluya matteret
Vela hi la rabbi yehuda savar lah kerabbi yose vela rabbi yose savar lah kerabbi yehuda
La rabbi yehuda savar lah kerabbi yose ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam ella beeruve chatzerot derabbanan aval hacha sukka deorayeta la
Vela rabbi yose savar lah kerabbi yehuda ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hacha ella besukka demitzvat ase aval shabbat deisur sekila la
Veim tomar maase shennaasa betzipori al pi mi naasa lo al pi rabbi yose ella al pi rabbi yishmael berabbi yose
Umay maase dechi ata rav dimi amar paam achat shachchu velo heviu sefer tora meerev shabbat lemachar persu sedinin al gabbe haammudim veheviu sefer tora vekaru bo
Persu salka datach mehechan hevium beshabbat ella matzu sedinin perusin al gabbe haammudim veheviu sefer tora vekaru bo

Amar rav chisda amar avimi machtzelet arbaa umashshehu matteret besukka mishshum dofen hechi aved tale leh baemtza pachot mishshelosha lematta ufachot mishshelosha lemala vechol pachot mishshelosha kelavud dame
Peshita mahu detema chad lavud amrinan tere lavud la amrinan ka mashma lan
Metivi machtzelet shiva umashshehu matteret besukka mishshum dofen ki tanya hahi besukka gedola umay ka mashma lan dimshalshelin defanot milmala lematta kerabbi yose
Amar rabbi amme pas arbaa umashshehu mattir besukka mishshum dofen umokem leh befachot mishshelosha tefachim samuch dofen vechol pachot mishshelosha samuch laddofen kelavud dame
May ka mashma lan ha ka mashma lan shiur meshech sukka ketanna shiva

a: Matni hirchik et hassikuch min haddefanot shelosha tefachim pesula
Bayit shennifchat vesikech al gabbav im yesh min hakkotel lassikuch arba ammot pesula
Vechen chatzer shehi mukkefet achsadra sukka gedola shehikkifuha bedavar sheen mesakkechin bo im yesh tachtav arba ammot pesula
Gema kol hane lema li tzericha dei ashmeinan bayit shennifchat mishshum dehane mechitzot levayit avidan aval chatzer hammukkefet achsadra dimchitzot lav leachsadra avidi ema la tzericha
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte mishshum dischachan sechach kasher hu aval sukka gedola shehikkifuha bedavar sheen mesakkechin bo dischachah sechach pasul hu ema la tzericha
Amar rabba ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi vekaamri avir posel bishlosha sechach pasul posel bearbaa

Veamena lehu ana avir defosel bishlosha mena lechu ditnan hirchik et hassikuch min haddefanot shelosha tefachim pesula sechach pasul name la lifsol ella bearba ammot ditnan bayit shennifchat vesikech al gabbav im yesh ben hassikuch lakkotel arba ammot pesula
Vaamaru li bar minah dehahi derav ushmuel amri tarvayehu mishshum dofen akumma nagu bah
Veamena lehu ana ma ilu ika sechach pasul pachot mearbaa vaavir pachot mishshelosha may keshera malleyeh beshappudin may pesula velo yehe avir happosel bishlosha kischach pasul happosel bearbaa

Vaamaru li i hachi ledidach name deamratte sechach pasul posel bearba ammot ma ilu ika sechach pasul pachot mearba ammot vaavir pachot mishshelosha may keshera malleyeh beshappudin may pesula lo yehe avir happosel bishlosha kischach pasul happosel bearba ammot
Veamena lehu ana hay may bishlama ledidi deamena arba ammot
b: Mishshum shiura velav shiura hu hay lav shiura hu kevan dela shau shiurayehu lahadade la mitztarfi
Ella ledidchu deamritu shiur mishshum haflaga ma li itaflag bischach pasul ma li ittaflag bischach pasul vaavir
Amar leh abbaye ulmar name nehi dela shau shiurayehu besukka gedola besukka ketanna mi la shau shiurayehu
Amar leh hatam lav mishshum deshau shiurayehu lahadade hu ella mishshum deleteh leshiura desukka hu
Vechol hecha dela shau shiurayehu lahadade la mitztarfi vehatnan habbeged shelosha al shelosha hassak arbaa al arbaa haor chamishsha al chamishsha mappatz shishsha al shishsha
Vetane alah habbeged vehassak hassak vehaor haor vehammappatz mitztarfin ze im ze
Hatam kidkatane tama amar rabbi shimon ma taam hoil verauy letamme moshav keditnan hamkatztzea mikkullan tefach al tefach tame
Tefach al tefach lemay chaze veamar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi yannay hoil verauy litlo al gabbe hachamor

Besura amri leha shemata behay lishana binhardea matnu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel sechach pasul baemtza posel bearbaa min hatztzad posel bearba ammot verav amar ben min hatztzad ben baemtza bearba ammot

Tenan natan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim keshera bishlama lerav deamar ben baemtza ben min hatztzad bearba ammot mishshum hachi keshera ella lishmuel deamar baemtza bearbaa ammay keshera hacha bemay askinan min hatztzad
Ta shema shene sedinin mitztarfin shene nesarim en mitztarfin rabbi meir omer nesarim kisdinin

Bishlama lehach lishana deamar rav ben baemtza ben min hatztzad bearba ammot may mitztarfin mitztarfin learba ammot ella lehach lishana deamar rav baemtza bearbaa hechi dame i deit behu arbaa lema lehu itzterofe i delet behu arbaa kanya bealma ninhu
Leolam deit behu arbaa umay mitztarfin mitztarfin learba ammot min hatztzad
Ta shema sikkechah binsarin shel erez sheyyesh bahen arbaa divre hakkol pesula en bahen arbaa rabbi meir posel verabbi yehuda machshir

a: Umode rabbi meir sheim yesh ben neser leneser kimlo neser shemmanniach pesal benehem uchshera
Bishlama leman deamar ben baemtza ben min hatztzad bearba ammot mishshum hachi keshera ella leman deamar baemtza bearbaa ammay keshera

Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hacha besukka dela haveya ella shemone metzumtzamot askinan veyahev neser ufsal veneser ufsal veneser ufsal mehay gisa veneser ufsal veneser ufsal veneser ufsal mehay gisa
Dehau lehu shene fesalin baemtza veika hechsher sukka baemtza
Amar abbaye avir shelosha besukka gedola umiato ben bekanim ben beshappudin have miut besukka ketanna bekanim have miut beshappudin la have miut
Vehane mile min hatztzad aval baemtza peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar yesh lavud baemtza vechad amar en lavud baemtza

May tameh deman deamar yesh lavud baemtza detanya kora hayyotza mikkotel ze veenah nogaat bechotel acher vechen shette korot achat yotza mikkotel ze veachat yotza mikkotel acher veenan nogot zo bazo pachot mishshelosha eno tzarich lehavi kora acheret shelosha tzarich lehavi kora acheret
Veidach shane korot derabbanan
May tama deman deamar en lavud baemtza ditnan arubba shebbabbayit uvah poteach tefach tuma babbayit kullo tame ma shekkeneged arubba tahor tuma keneged arubba kal habbayit kullo tahor
En baarubba poteach tefach tuma babbayit keneged arubba tahor tuma keneged arubba kal habbayit kullo tahor
Veidach shane hilchot tuma dehachi gemiri lehu
Daresh rabbi yehuda bar ilay bayit shennifchat vesikech al gabbav keshera amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose rabbi paresh kach perash abba arba ammot pesula pachot mearba ammot keshera
Daresh rabbi yehuda bar ilay avruma sharya amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose rabbi paresh kach amar abba shel makom peloni asura shel makom peloni mutteret
Ki ha deamar abbaye hay tzachanta devav nahara sharya may tama ilema mishshum dirdifi mayya vehay dag tame kevan delet leh chut hashshidra la matze kaem veha ka chazenan dekae

Ella mishshum dimlichi mayya vehay dag tame kevan delet leh kilfe la matze kae veha ka chazenan dekae ella mishshum dela merabbe tinayehu dag tame amar ravina vehaidana deshafchi nehar etan unhar gamda lehatam asira
Ittemar sikech al gabbe achsadra sheyyesh lah patztzimin keshera sheen lah patztzimin abbaye amar keshera verava amar pesula abbaye amar keshera
b: Amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem rava amar pesula la amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem
Amar leh rava abbaye ledidach deamratte pi tikra yored vesotem afilu hifchit dofen emtzai amar leh modena lach behahi dehave leh kemavoy hamfullash

Lema abbaye verava biflugta derav ushmuel kamipalgi deittemar achsadra bevika rav amar muttar letaltel bechullo deamrinan pi tikra yored vesotem ushmuel amar en metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot dela amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem
Alliba dishmuel kulle alma la peligi

a: Ki peligi alliba derav abbaye kerav verava amar lach ad kan la amar rav hatam ella dimchitzot leachsadra hu daavidi aval hacha delav lehachi avidi la
Tenan vechen chatzer hammukkefet achsadra veammay nema pi tikra yored vesotem
Targemah rava alliba deabbaye keshehishva et keruo

Besura matni leha shemata behay lishana befumbedita matni sikech al gabbe achsadra sheen lah patztzimin divre hakkol pesula yesh lah patztzimin abbaye amar keshera rava amar pesula abbaye amar keshera amrinan lavud rava amar pesula la amrinan lavud vehilcheta kelishana kamma

Rav ashe ashkecheh lerav kahana deka mesakkech al gabbe achsadra sheen lah patztzimin amar leh la savar mar ha deamar rava yesh lah patztzimin keshera en lah patztzimin pesula achvi leh nire mibbifnim veshave mibbachutz
I name nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim
Deittemar nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim nidon mishshum lechi velechi hayenu patztzimin
Tana pesal hayyotze min hassukka nidon kassukka may pesal hayyotze min hassukka amar ulla kanim hayyotzim laachore sukka
Veha baenan shalosh defanot bidika veha baenan hechsher sukka bidika veha baenan tzillatah merubba mechammatah bidika
I hachi may lememra mahu detema hoil ulgavay avidi ulvaray la avidi ema la ka mashma lan
Rabba verav yosef amri tarvayehu hacha bekanim hayyotzim lifnim min hassukka umashcha veazla chada dofen bahadayehu mahu detema ha let bah hechsher sukka ka mashma lan

Rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo nitzrecha ella lesukka sherubbah tzillatah merubba mechammatah umiutah chamatah merubba metzillatah mahu detema tippesal behach purta ka mashma lan umay yotze yotze mehechsher sukka
Rabbi oshaya amar lo nitzrecha ella lischach pasul pachot mishshelosha besukka ketanna umay yotze yotze mittorat sukka
Matkef lah rav hoshaya lo yehe ella avir vaavir pachot mishshelosha tefachim besukka ketanna mi pasel
Amar leh rabbi abba ze mitztaref vishenim tachtav veze mitztaref veen yeshenim tachtav
Umi ika mide deitzterofe mitztaref vehu atzmo eno kasher amar rabbi yitzchak ben elyashiv in
b: Tit hannarok yochiach shemmitztaref learbaim sea vehattovel bo lo alta lo tevila
Matni haose sukkato kemin tzerif o shessemachah lechotel rabbi eliezer posel mippene sheen lah gag vachachamim machshirin
Gema tana mode rabbi eliezer sheim higbihah min hakkarka tefach o shehifligah min hakkotel tefach shehi keshera
May tamayehu derabbanan shipue ohalim keohalim damu
Abbaye ashkecheh lerav yosef deka gane bechilat chatanim bassukka amar leh keman kerabbi eliezer shavkatte rabbanan veavdatte kerabbi eliezer
Amar leh barayeta ipcha tane rabbi eliezer machshir vachachamim poslin shavkatte matnitin veavdatte kevarayeta
Amar leh matnitin yechidaa hi detanya haose sukkato kemin tzerif o shessemachah lechotel rabbi natan omer rabbi eliezer posel mippene sheen lah gag vachachamim machshirin

Matni machtzelet kanim gedola asaah lishchiva mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah lesikuch mesakkechin bah veenah mekabbelet tuma rabbi eliezer omer achat ketanna veachat gedola asaah lishchiva mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah lesikuch mesakkechin bah veenah mekabbelet tuma
Gema ha gufah kashya amratte asaah lishchiva mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah tama daasaah lishchiva ha setama lesikuch
Vahadar tane lesikuch mesakkechin bah veenah mekabbelet tuma tama daasaah lesikuch ha setama lishchiva
Ha la kashya kan bigdola kan biktanna

Bishlama lerabbanan la kashya ella lerabbi eliezer kashya ditnan rabbi eliezer omer achat ketanna veachat gedola asaah lishchiva mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah tama daasaah lishchiva ha setama lesikuch
Ema sefa asaah lesikuch mesakkechin bah veenah mekabbelet tuma tama daasaah lesikuch ha setama lishchiva
Ella amar rava bigdola kulle alma la peligi distama lesikuch ki peligi biktanna tanna kamma savar setam ketanna lishchiva verabbi eliezer savar setam ketanna name lesikuch

a: Vehachi kaamar machtzelet hakkanim gedola asaah lishchiva mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah tama daasaah lishchiva ha setama naasa kemi sheasaah lesikuch mesakkechin bah ketanna asaah lesikuch mesakkechin bah tama daasaah lesikuch ha setama naasa kemi sheasaah lishchiva veen mesakkechin bah vaata rabbi eliezer lememar achat ketanna veachat gedola setama keshera lesikuch
Amar leh abbaye i hachi rabbi eliezer omer achat ketanna veachat gedola achat gedola veachat ketanna mibe leh
Veod ki peligi bigdola hu difligi verabbi eliezer lechumra detanya machtzelet hakkanim gedola mesakkechin bah rabbi eliezer omer im enah mekabbelet tuma mesakkechin bah
Ella amar rav pappa biktanna kulle alma la peligi distama lishchiva ki peligi bigdola tanna kamma savar setam gedola lesikuch verabbi eliezer savar setam gedola name lishchiva
Umay asaah lishchiva dekaamar hachi kaamar setam asiyyatah name lishchiva ad deaved lesikuch
Tanu rabbanan machtzelet shel shifa veshel gemi gedula mesakkechin bah ketanna en mesakkechin bah shel kanim veshel chilat gedola mesakkechin bah aruga en mesakkechin bah
Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv achat zo veachat zo mesakkechin bah vechen haya rabbi dosa omer kidvarav
Tenan hatam kol hachotzalot metammein teme met divre rabbi dosa vachachamim omrim midras
Midras in teme met la veha anan tenan kol hammittamme midras mittamme teme met ema af midras
May chotzalot amar rav avdimi bar hamdure marzovle may marzovle amar rabbi abba mazbele rabbi shimon ben lakish omer machtzalot mammash

Veazda resh lakish letameh deamar resh lakish hareni kapparat rabbi chiyya uvanav shebbitchilla keshennishtakkecha tora miyyisrael ala ezra mibbavel veyissedah chazra venishtakkecha ala hillel habbavli veyissedah chazra venishtakkecha alu rabbi chiyya uvanav veyisseduha vechen amar rabbi chiyya uvanav lo nechleku rabbi dosa vachachamim al machtzalot shel usha
b: Shehen temeot veshel teverya shehen tehorot al ma nechleku al shear mekomot mar savar kevan deleka deyatev alayehu keditverya damyan umar savar kevan demikkere veyatvi alayehu kidusha damyan
Amar mar kol hachotzalot metammein teme met divre rabbi dosa vehatanya vechen haya rabbi dosa omer kidvarav
La kashya ha deit leh gedanfa ha delet leh gedanfa
Metivi chotzalot shel shaam veshel gemi veshel sak veshel sefira mittamme teme met divre rabbi dosa vachachamim omrim af midras

Bishlama leman deamar marzovle shel shaam veshel gemi chazu lechinta defere shel sak veshel sefira chazu ligvalke vetzanne ella leman deamar machtzalot mammash bishlama shel sak veshel sefira chazu lifrase venafota ella shel shaam veshel gemi lemay chazu chazu lenazyata

Ika deamri bishlama leman deamar machtzalot mammash shel shaam veshel gemi chazu lenazyata shel sak veshel sefira chazu lifrase venafota ella leman deamar marzovle bishlama shel sak veshel sefira chazu ligvalki vetzanne ella shel shaam veshel gemi lemay chazu chazu lechinta defere
Tanya amar rabbi chananya kesheyyaradti laggola matzati zaken echad veamar li mesakkechin bevudya uchshebbati etzel rabbi yehoshua achi abba hoda lidvarav amar rav chisda vehu delet leh gedanfa
Amar ulla hane budyata divne machoza ilmale kir shellahen mesakkechin behu tanya name hachi mesakkechin bevudya veim yesh lahen kir en mesakkechin bahen
Hadaran alach sukka
Hayyashen tachat hammitta bassukka lo yatza yede chovato amar rabbi yehuda nohagin hayinu shehayinu yeshenim tachat hammitta bifne hazzekenim velo amru lanu davar

Amar rabbi shimon maase betavi avdo shel rabban gamliel shehaya yashen tachat hammitta veamar lahen rabban gamliel lazzekenim reitem tavi avdi shehu talmid chacham veodea sheavadim peturin min hassukka lefichach yashen hu tachat hammitta ulfi darkenu lamadnu shehayyashen tachat hammitta lo yatza yede chovato
Gema veha leka asara targema shemuel bemitta asara
Tenan hatam echad chor shechararuhu mayim o sheratzim o sheachalattu melachat vechen midbach avanim vechen sevar shel korot maahil al hattuma
Rabbi yehuda omer kol ohel sheeno asuy bide adam eno ohel may tama derabbi yehuda

a: Yalef ohel ohel mimmishkan ketiv hacha zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel uchtiv hatam vayyifros et haohel al hammishkan ma lehallan bide adam af kan bide adam verabbanan ohel ohel riba

Vesavar rabbi yehuda kol ohel sheeno asuy bide adam eno ohel urminhu chatzerot hau benuot birushalayim al gabbe hassela vetachtehem chalal mippene kever hattehom umviin nashim ubbarot veoldot sham umgaddelot benehem sham lappara

Umviin shevarim veal gabbehen delatot vetinokot yoshvin al gabbehen vechosot shel even bidehem higgiu lashshiloach yardu letoch hammayim umilum vealu veyashvu lahem rabbi yose omer mimmekomo haya meshalshel ummalle mippene kever hattehom
Vetanya rabbi yehuda omer lo hau meviin delatot ella shevarim veha shevarim deohel sheeno asuy bide adam hu vekatane rabbi yehuda omer lo hau meviin delatot ella shevarim
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi elazar mode rabbi yehuda kimlo egrof tanya name hachi umode rabbi yehuda bishkifin uvinkike hasselaim
Vahare delet deyesh bah kamma egrofin vekatane rabbi yehuda omer lo hau meviin delatot ella shevarim amar abbaye la hutzrechu lehavi delatot
Rava amar lo hau meviin delatot kol ikar shemmippene sheddato shel tinok gassa alav shemma yotzi rosho o echad meevarav veyittame
b: Bekever hattehom

Tanya keoteh derava rabbi yehuda omer lo hau meviin delatot kol ikar mippene sheddato shel tinok gassa alav shemma yotzi rosho o echad meevarav veyittame bekever hattehom ella meviin shevarim hammitzrim shekkeresotehen rechavot vehattinokot yoshvin al gabbehen vechosot shel even bidehen higgiu lashshiloach yardu umilleum vealu veyashvu lahen al gabbehen
Vahare mitta deyesh bah kamma egrofim utnan rabbi yehuda omer nohagim hayinu shehayinu yeshenim tachat hammitta bifne hazzekenim shane mitta hoil ulgabbah asuya shevarim name legabban asuyim
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi elazar shane shevarim hoil umginim al haroim bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim i hachi mitta name hoil umgina al minalim vesandalim shettachteha
Ella amar rava shane shevarim hoil vaasuyim lehagen al bene meayim shellahen shenneemar or uvasar talbisheni uvaatzamot vegidim tesochcheni
Vei baet ema rabbi yehuda letameh deamar sukka dirat keva baenan vehave leh mitta dirat aray vesukka ohel keva vela ate ohel aray umvattel ohel keva
Veha rabbi shimon deamar name sukka dirat keva baenan ha veate ohel aray umvattel ohel keva in beha peligi mar savar ate ohel aray umvattel ohel keva umar savar la ate ohel aray umvattel ohel keva

Amar rabbi shimon maase betavi avdo tanya amar rabbi shimon missichato shel rabban gamliel lamadnu shene devarim lamadnu sheavadim peturim min hassukka velamadnu shehayyashen tachat hammitta lo yatza yede chovato

Velema middevarav shel rabban gamliel milta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan ki ha deamar rav acha bar adda veamri lah amar rav acha bar adda amar rav hamnuna amar rav minnayin sheafilu sichat talmide chachamim tzericha limud shenneemar vealehu lo yibbol
Matni hassomech sukkato bechare hammitta keshera rabbi yehuda omer im enah yechola laamod bifne atzmah pesula
Gema may tameh derabbi yehuda peligi bah rabbi zera verabbi abba bar memel chad amar mippene sheen lah keva vechad amar mippene shemmaamidah bedavar hamkabbel tuma

May benayehu kegon shennaatz shappudin shel barzel vesikech alehem leman deamar lefi sheen lah keva hare yesh lah keva uman deamar mippene shemmaamidah bedavar hamkabbel tuma hare maamidah bedavar hamkabbel tuma

Amar abbaye lo shanu ella samach aval sikech al gav hammitta keshera may tama leman deamar lefi sheen lah keva hare yesh lah keva leman deamar mippene shemmaamidah bedavar hamkabbel tuma hare en maamidah bedavar hamkabbel tuma

a: Matni sukka hamduvlelet veshetztzilatah merubba mechammatah keshera hamubba kemin bayit af al pi sheen hakkochavim nirin mittochah keshera
Gema may meduvlelet amar rav sukka aniyya ushmuel amar kane ole vekane yored

Rav tane chada ushmuel tane tarte rav tane chada sukka meduvlelet may meduvlelet meduldelet shetztzilatah merubba mechammatah keshera ushmuel tane tarte may meduvlelet mevulbelet vetarte katane sukka mevulbelet keshera vetzilatah merubba mechammatah keshera

Amar abbaye lo shanu ella sheen ben ze laze shelosha tefachim aval yesh ben ze laze shelosha tefachim pesula amar rava afilu yesh ben ze laze shelosha tefachim name la amaran ella sheen begaggo tefach aval yesh begaggo tefach keshera deamrinan chavot remi

Amar rava mena amena lah dechi it beh tefach amrinan chavot remi vechi let beh la amrinan chavot remi ditnan korot habbayit vehaaliyya sheen alehem maaziva vehen mechuuonot tuma tachat achat mehen tachteha tame
Ben hattachtona laelona benehen tame al gabbe haelona kenegdah ad larakia tame hau haelonot keven hattachtonot tuma tachtehen tachat kullan tame al gabbehen kenegdan ad larakia tame

Vetane alah bamme devarim amurim bizman sheyyesh bahen tefach uvenehen poteach tefach aval en benehen poteach tefach tuma tachat achat mehen tachteha tame benehen veal gabbehen tahor alma ki it beh tefach amrinan chavot remi vechi let beh tefach la amrinan chavot remi shema minah
Yatev rav kahana vekaamar leha shemata amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana vechol hecha delet beh tefach la amrinan chavot remi

Veha tanya kora hayyotza mikkotel ze veenah nogaat bechotel ze vechen shette korot achat yotza mikkotel ze veachat yotza mikkotel ze veenan nogot zo bazo pachot mishshelosha eno tzarich lehavi kora acheret shelosha tzarich lehavi kora acheret
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer
b: Pachot mearbaa en tzarich lehavi kora acheret arbaa tzarich lehavi kora acheret
Vechen shette korot hammatimot lo bazo kede lekabbel ariach velo bazo kede lekabbel ariach im mekabbelot ariach lerochbo tefach en tzarich lehavi kora acheret veim lav tzarich lehavi kora acheret
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im mekabbelot ariach leorko shelosha tefachim en tzarich lehavi kora acheret veim lav tzarich lehavi kora acheret

Hau achat lemala veachat lematta rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer roin haelona keilu hi lematta veet hattachtona keilu hi lemala uvilvad shello tehe elona lemala meesrim amma vehattachtona lematta measara ha ze veze betoch esrim amrinan chavot remi af al gav delet beh tefach

Amar leh taretz veema hachi uvilvad shello tehe elona lemala meesrim ella betoch esrim vehattachtona semucha lah befachot mishshelosha i name bilvad shello tehe tachtona lematta measara ella lemala measara veelona semucha lah befachot mishshelosha aval shelosha kevan delet beh tefach la amrinan chavot remi
Veshetztzilatah merubba mechammatah keshera ha ki hadade pesula veha tenan beidach pirkin veshechamatah merubba mitztzilatah pesula ha ki hadade keshera
La kashya kan millemala kan millematta amar rav pappa hayenu deamri inashe kezuza milleel keistera milletachat
Meubba kemin bayit tanu rabbanan hamubba kemin bayit af al pi sheen hakkochavim nirin mittochah keshera en kochve chamma nirin mittochah bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin
Matni haose sukkato berosh haagala o berosh hassefina keshera veolin lah beom tov berosh hailan o al gabbe gamal keshera veen olin lah beom tov
Shettayim bailan veachat bide adam o shettayim bide adam veachat bailan keshera veen olin lah beom tov shalosh bide adam veachat bailan keshera veolin lah beom tov

a: Ze hakkelal kol sheyyinnatel hailan vichola laamod bifne atzmah keshera veolin lah beom tov
Gema manni matnitin rabbi akiva hi detanya haose sukkato berosh hassefina rabban gamliel posel verabbi akiva machshir
Maase berabban gamliel verabbi akiva shehau bain bisfina amad rabbi akiva veasa sukka berosh hassefina lemachar nashva ruach vaakaratta amar lo rabban gamliel akiva hechan sukkatcha

Amar abbaye dechulle alma hecha deenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya deyabbasha lo kelum hi yechola laamod besheenah metzuya deyabbasha kulle alma la peligi dichshera ki peligi bedichola laamod beruach metzuya deyabbasha veenah yechola laamod beruach sheenah metzuya deyabbasha rabban gamliel savar sukka dirat keva baenan vechevan deenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya deyam lo kelum hi rabbi akiva savar sukka dirat aray baenan vechevan dichola laamod beruach metzuya deyabbasha keshera

O al gabbe gamal ku matnitin manni rabbi meir hi detanya haose sukkato al gabbe behema rabbi meir machshir verabbi yehuda posel may tameh derabbi yehuda amar kera chag hassukkot taase lecha shivat yamim sukka haruya leshiva shemah sukka sukka sheenah reuya leshiva lo shemah sukka
Verabbi meir ha name middeorayeta michze chazya verabbanan hu digzaru bah

Asaah livhema dofen lesukka rabbi meir posel verabbi yehuda machshir shehaya rabbi meir omer kol davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim en osin oto lo dofen lesukka velo lechi lemavoy velo passin leveraot velo golel lekever mishshum rabbi yose haggelili amru af en kotvin alav gite nashim

May tameh derabbi meir abbaye amar shemma tamut rabbi zera amar shemma tivrach befil kashur kulle alma la peligi dei name mayet yesh benivlato asara ki peligi befil sheeno kashur leman deamar shemma tamut la chayeshinan leman deamar gezera shemma tivrach chayeshinan

Leman deamar gezera shemma tamut nechush shemma tivrach ella befil sheeno kashur kulle alma la feligi ki feligi bivhema keshura leman deamar gezera shemma tamut chayeshinan ulman deamar gezera shemma tivrach la chayeshinan
Uman deamar gezera shemma tivrach nechush shemma tamut mita la shechicha vehaika ravecha devene bene deaved leh behutza vedafna
Vedilma rava dimticha beashle milleel ulman deamar gezera shemma tamut name ha meticha beashle milleel zimnin demokem befachot mishshelosha samuch lassechach
b: Vechevan demayeta kavetza velav addateh
Umi amar abbaye rabbi meir chayesh lemita verabbi yehuda la chayesh vehatnan bat yisrael shennisset lechohen vehalach balah limdinat hayyam ochelet bitruma bechezkat shehu kayyam
Veramenan alah hare ze gitich shaa achat kodem mitati asura leechol bitruma miyyad
Veamar abbaye la kashya ha rabbi meir dela chayesh lemita ha rabbi yehuda dechayesh lemita
Detanya hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim omer shene luggin sheani atid lehafrish hare hen teruma asara maaser rishon tisha maaser sheni umechel veshote miyyad divre rabbi meir

a: Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin
Efoch rabbi meir chayesh lemita verabbi yehuda la chayesh lemita detanya asaah labbehema dofen lassukka rabbi meir posel verabbi yehuda machshir
Kashya derabbi meir adderabbi meir amar lach rabbi meir mita shechicha bekiat hannod la shechicha efshar demasar leh leshomer
Kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda
Tama derabbi yehuda lav mishshum dechayesh livkiat nod ella mishshum delet leh berera

Vela chayesh rabbi yehuda livkiat nod veha middekatane sefa amru lo lerabbi meir i atta mode shemma yibbaka hannod venimtza ze shote tevalim lemafrea vaamar lehu lichsheyyibbaka mikkelal dechayesh rabbi yehuda livkiat hannod
Hatam rabbi yehuda hu dekaamar lerabbi meir ledidi let li berera ella ledidach deyesh berera i atta mode deshemma yibbaka hannod amar leh lichsheyyibbaka
Vela chayesh rabbi yehuda lemita veha tenan rabbi yehuda omer af ishsha acheret matkinin lo shemma tamut ishto ha itmar alah amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua maala asu bechappara

Ben leman deamar shemma tamut ben leman deamar shemma tivrach middeorayeta mechitza mealleya hi verabbanan hu digzaru bah ella meatta lerabbi meir tetamme mishshum golel allema tenan rabbi yehuda metamme mishshum golel verabbi meir metaher
Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov kasavar rabbi meir kal mechitza sheomedet beruach enah mechitza ika deamri amar rav acha bar yaakov kasavar rabbi meir kol mechitza sheenah asuya bide adam enah mechitza
May benayehu ika benayehu deokmah benod tafuach leman deamar mechitza omedet beruach enah mechitza hare omedet beruach leman deamar enah asuya bide adam
b: Hare asuya bide adam

Amar mar mishshum rabbi yose haggelili amru af en kotvin alav gite nashim may tameh derabbi yose haggelili detanya sefer en li ella sefer minnayin lerabbot kal davar talmud lomar vechatav lah mikkol makom
Im ken ma talmud lomar sefer lomar lach ma sefer davar sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel af kol davar sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel
Verabbanan i ketav besefer kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv sefer lisfirat devarim bealma hu daata

Verabbanan hay vechatav may darshi beh hahu mibe lehu bichtiva mitgareshet veenah mitgareshet bechesef salka datach amena hoil veitakkash yetzia lahavaya ma havaya bakkesef af yetzia bechesef ka mashma lan
Verabbi yose haggelili hay sevara mena leh missefer keritut nafka leh sefer kortah veen davar acher kortah
Veidach hahu mibe leh ledavar hakkoret beno levenah kidtanya hare ze gitich al menat shello tishti yayin veal menat shello telchi levet avich leolam en ze keritut kal sheloshim yom hare ze keritut
Veidach mikkaret keritut nafka veidach karet keritut la darshi
Matni haose sukkato ben hailanot vehailanot defanot lah keshera
Gema amar rav acha bar yaakov kol mechitza sheenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya enah mechitza
Tenan haose sukkato ben hailanot vehailanot defanot lah keshera veha kaazel veate hacha bemay askinan bekashin
Vehaika nofo deaved leh behutza vedafna i hachi may lememra mahu detema nigzar dilma ate leishtammoshe beilan ka mashma lan
Ta shema haya sham ilan o gader o mechitzat hakkanim nidon mishshum deomad hatam name mishshum deaved leh behutza vedafna
Ta shema ilan hammesech al haaretz im en nofo gavoha min haaretz shelosha tefachim metaltelin tachtav ammay ha ka azel veate hatam name deaved leh behutza vedafna
I hachi nitaltel bechulleh allema amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua en metaltelin bo

a: Ella bet satayim
Mishshum dehave dira shettashmisheha laavir vechol dira shettashmisheha laavir en metaltelin bo ella satayim

Ta shema shavat betel shehu gavoha asara vehu mearba ammot ad bet satayim vechen beneka shehu amok asara vehu mearba ammot ad bet satayim vechen kama ketzura veshibbolot makkifot otah mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma af al gav dekaazel veate hatam name deaved leh behutza vedafna
Matni sheluche mitzva peturin min hassukka cholin umshammeshehen peturin min hassukka ochlin veshotin aray chutz lassukka
Gema mena hane mile tanu rabbanan beshivtecha bevetecha perat leosek bemitzva uvlechtecha vadderech perat lechatan mikkan amru hakkones et habbetula patur veet haalmana chayyav
May mashma amar rav huna kederech ma derech reshut af kol reshut leappoke hay divmitzva asuk
Mi la askinan dekaazel lidvar mitzva veka amar rachamana likre im ken lema kera beshevet uvlechet may beshivtecha uvlechtecha belechet didach hu demichayevatte ha belechet demitzva petiratte
I hachi afilu kones et haalmana name kones et habbetula terid kones almana la terid

Vechol hecha ditrid hachi name defatur ella meatta tava sefinato bayyam ditrid hachi name defatur vechi tema hachi name vehaamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav avel chayyav bechol hammitzot haamurot battora chutz min hattefilin shehare neemar bahen peer
Hacha terid tirda demitzva hatam terid tirda dirshut
Vehaosek bemitzva patur min hammitzva mehacha nafka mehatam nafka detanya vayehi anashim asher hau temeim lenefesh adam vego otam anashim mi hau nose arono shel yosef hau divre rabbi yose haggelili
b: Rabbi akiva omer mishael veeltzafan hau shehau oskin benadav vaavihu rabbi yitzchak omer im nose arono shel yosef hau kevar hau yecholin litaher im mishael veeltzafan hau yecholin hau litaher
Ella oskin bemet mitzva hau shechal shevii shellahen lihot beerev pesach shenneemar velo yachlu laasot happesach bayyom hahu beom hahu en yecholin laasot ha lemachar yecholin laasot

Tzericha dei ashmeinan hatam mishshum dela meta zeman chiyyuva defesach aval hacha dimta zeman keriat shema ema la tzericha vei ashmeinan hacha mishshum deleka karet aval hatam deika karet ema la tzericha

Gufa amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav avel chayyav bechol mitzot haamurot battora chutz mittefilin shehare neemar bahen peer middaamar leh rachamana lichezkel peercha chavosh alecha vego atte hu demichayevatte aval kulle alma petiri
Vehane mile beom rishon dichtiv veacharitah keom mar

Veamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav avel chayyav bassukka peshita mahu detema hoil veamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav mitztaer patur min hassukka hay name mitztaer hu kamashma lan hane mile tzaara demimmela aval hacha ihu hu deka metzaar nafsheh ibi leh leyattove dateh

Veamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav chatan vehashshoshvinin vechol bene hachuppa peturin min hassukka kol shiva may tama mishshum devau lemichde velechlu bassukka velichdo bassukka en simcha ella bachuppa velechlu bassukka velichdo bachuppa en simcha ella bimkom seuda

Velebedu chuppa bassukka abbaye amar mishshum yichud verava amar mishshum tzaar chatan may benayehu ika benayehu dishchichi inashe denafki veayeli lehatam leman deamar mishshum yichud leka leman deamar mishshum tzaar chatan ika
Amar rabbi zera ana achali bassukka vachaday bachuppa vechol shekken dechade libay deka avedna tarte
Tanu rabbanan chatan vehashshoshvinin vechol bene chuppa peturin min hattefilla umin hattefilin vechayyavin bikriat shema

a: Mishshum rabbi shela amru chatan patur vehashshoshvinin vechol bene hachuppa chayyavin

Tanya amar rabbi chananya ben akavya kotve sefarim tefilin umzuzot hen vetaggarehen vetaggare taggarehen vechol haoskin bimlechet shamayim leetoye mochre techelet peturin mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umin hattefilin umikkol mitzot haamurot battora lekayyem divre rabbi yose haggelili shehaya rabbi yose haggelili omer haosek bemitzva patur min hammitzva

Tanu rabbanan holche derachim bayyom peturin min hassukka bayyom vechayyavin ballayela holche derachim ballayela peturin min hassukka ballayela vechayyavin bayyom holche derachim bayyom uvallayela peturin min hassukka ben bayyom uven ballayela holchin lidvar mitzva peturin ben bayyom uven ballayela ki ha derav chisda verabba bar rav huna ki hao ayeli beshabbeta derigla leve resh galuta hao ganu arakta desura amri anan sheluche mitzva anan ufturin

Tanu rabbanan shomre hair bayyom peturin min hassukka bayyom vechayyavin ballayela shomre hair ballayela peturin min hassukka ballayela vechayyavin bayyom shomre hair ben bayyom uven ballayela peturim min hassukka ben bayyom uven ballayela
Shomre gannot ufardesim peturin ben bayyom uven ballayela velibedu sukka hatam velitvu abbaye amar teshvu keen taduru
Rava amar pirtza kora laggannav may benayehu ika benayehu deka menattar karya defere

Cholim umshammeshehem tanu rabbanan chole sheamru lo chole sheyyesh bo sakkana ella afilu chole sheen bo sakkana afilu chash beenav vaafilu chash berosho amar rabban shimon ben gamliel paam achat chashti beene bekesari vehittir rabbi yose beribi lishan ani umshammeshay chutz lassukka
Rav shera lerav acha bardela lemigne bechilta bassukka mishshum bake rava shera leh lerabbi acha bar adda lemigne bar mimmetallalta mishshum sircha degargishta

Rava letameh deamar rava mitztaer patur min hassukka veha anan tenan cholin umshammeshehem peturim min hassukka chole in mitztaar la amri chole hu umshammeshav peturim mitztaer hu patur meshammeshav la

Ochlim achilat aray chutz lassukka vechamma achilat aray amar rav yosef tarte o telat bee amar leh abbaye veha zimnin saggiin saggi leh leinish behachi vehave leh seudat keva ella amar abbaye kidtaem bar be rav veayel lechalla
Tanu rabbanan ochlin achilat aray chutz lassukka veen yeshenim shenat aray chutz lassukka may tama amar rav ashe gezera shemma yeradem
Amar leh abbaye ella ha detanya yashen adam shenat aray bitfilin aval lo shenat keva lechush shemma yeradem amar rav yosef bereh derav ilay bemoser shenato laacherim
Matkef leh rav mesharsheya arvach arva tzerich ella amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan bemanniach rosho ben birkav askinan rava amar en keva lashshena

Tane chada yashen adam bitfilin shenat aray aval lo shenat keva vetanya idach ben keva ben aray vetanya idach lo keva velo aray la kashya ha denaket lehu bideh ha demannechi beresheh ha defares sudara illaveh
Vechamma shenat aray tane rame bar yechezkel kede hiluch mea amma tanya name hachi hayyashen bitfilin veroe keri ochez bartzua
b: Veeno ochez bakketzitza divre rabbi yaakov vachachamim omrim yashen adam bitfilin shenat aray aval lo shenat keva vechamma shenat aray kede hiluch mea amma
Amar rav asur laadam lishan bayyom yoter mishshenat hassus vechamma shenat hassus shitin nishme
Amar abbaye shinteh demar kidrav udrav kidrabbi udrabbi kiddavid uddavid kidsusya udsusya shitin nishme
Abbaye hava nayem kedimayyel mippumbedita leve chubbe kare aleh rav yosef ad matay atzel tishkav matay takum mishshenatecha

Tanu rabbanan hannichnas lishan bayyom ratza choletz ratza manniach ballayela choletz veeno manniach divre rabbi natan rabbi yose omer hayeladim leolam choltzin veenan mannichin mippene shergilin betuma
Lema kasavar rabbi yose baal keri asur lehanniach tefilin amar abbaye biladim unshotehen immahen askinan shemma yavou lide hergel davar
Tanu rabbanan shachach veshimmesh mittato bitfilin eno ochez lo bartzua velo bakketzitza ad sheyyittol yadav veyittelem mippene shehayyadayim askaniyyot hen
Matni maase veheviu lo lerabban yochanan ben zakkay litom et hattavshil ulrabban gamliel shene kotavot udli shel mayim veamru haalum lassukka
Uchshennatnu lo lerabbi tzadok ochel pachot mikkevetza netalo bammappa vaachalo chutz lassukka velo berach acharav

Gema maase listor chassore mechassera vehachi katane im ba lehachmir al atzmo machmir velet beh mishshum yuhara umaase name veheviu lo lerabban yochanan ben zakkay litom et hattavshil ulrabban gamliel shette chotavot udli shel mayim

a: Veamru haalum lassukka

Uchshennatnu lo lerabbi tzadok ochel pachot mikkevetza netalo bemappa vaachalo chutz lassukka velo berach acharav ha kevetza bae sukka lema tehve teuvteh derav yosef veabbaye dilma pachot mikkevetza netila uvracha la bae ha kevetza bae netila uvracha
Matni rabbi eliezer omer arba esre seudot chayyav adam leechol bassukka achat beom veachat ballayela vachachamim omrim en laddavar kitzva chutz millele yom tov rishon shel chag bilvad

Veod amar rabbi eliezer mi shello achal lele yom tov harishon yashlim lele yom tov haacharon shel chag vachachamim omrim en laddavar tashlumin veal ze neemar meuvat lo yuchal litkon vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot
Gema may tameh derabbi eliezer teshvu keen taduru ma dira achat bayyom veachat ballayela af sukka achat beom veachat ballayela
Verabbanan kedira ma dira i bae achel i bae la achel af sukka name i bae achel i bae la achel
I hachi afilu lele yom tov rishon name

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak neemar kan chamishsha asar veneemar chamishsha asar bechag hammatztzot ma lehallan layela harishon chova mikkan veelach reshut af kan layela harishon chova mikkan veelach reshut
Vehatam menalan amar kera baerev tochlu matztzot hakkatuv kevao chova
Veod amar rabbi eliezer veha amar rabbi eliezer arba esre seudot chayyav adam leechol bassukka achat bayyom veachat ballayela amar bera amar rabbi amme chazar bo rabbi eliezer
Mashlim bemay ilema berifta seuda deomeh ka achel ella may yashlim yashlim bemine targima tanya name hachi im hishlim bemine targima yatza

Shaal appotroppos shel agripas hammelech et rabbi eliezer kegon ani sheeni ragil leechol ella seuda achat bayyom mahu sheochal seuda achat veeppater amar lo bechol yom veom atta mamshich kamma parperaot lichvod atzmecha veachshav i atta mamshich parperet achat lichvod konecha

Veod shealo kegon ani sheyyesh li shette nashim achat bitverya veachat betzipori veyesh li shette sukkot achat bitverya veachat betzipori mahu sheetze missukka lesukka veeppater amar lo lo sheani omer kol hayyotze missukka lesukka bittel mitzvatah shel rishona
Tanya rabbi eliezer omer
b: En yotzin missukka lesukka veen osin sukka bechullo shel moed vachachamim omrim yotzin missukka lesukka veosin sukka bechullo shel moed veshavin sheim nafla shechozer uvonah bechullo shel moed
May tama derabbi eliezer amar kera chag hassukkot taase lecha shivat yamim ase sukka haruya leshiva verabbanan hachi kaamar rachamana ase sukka bechag
Veshavin sheim nafla shechozer uvone otah bechullo shel moed peshita mahu detema hay achariti hi veenah leshiva ka mashma lan

Tanya rabbi eliezer omer keshem sheen adam yotze yede chovato bayyom tov harishon shel chag belulavo shel chavero dichtiv ulkachtem lachem bayyom harishon peri etz hadar kappot temarim mishshellachem kach en adam yotze yede chovato besukkato shel chavero dichtiv chag hassukkot taase lecha shivat yamim mishshellecha

Vachachamim omrim af al pi sheamru en adam yotze yede chovato beom tov harishon belulavo shel chavero aval yotze yede chovato besukkato shel chavero dichtiv kol haezrach beyisrael yeshvu bassukkot melammed shekkol yisrael reuyim leshev besukka achat
Verabbanan hay lecha may darshi beh mibe leh lemaote gezula aval sheula ketiv kol haezrach
Verabbi eliezer hay kol haezrach may aved leh mibe leh leger shennitgayyer bentayim vekatan shennitgaddel bentayim verabbanan kevan sheamru osin sukka bechullo shel moed la itzterich kera

Tanu rabbanan maase berabbi ilay shehalach lehakbil pene rabbi eliezer rabbo belod baregel amar lo ilay encha mishshovte haregel shehaya rabbi eliezer omer meshabbeach ani et haatzlanin sheen yotzin mibbattehen baregel dichtiv vesamachta atta uvetecha

Tanu rabbanan maase berabbi eliezer sheshshavat baggalil haelon besukkato shel yochanan berabbi ilay bekesari veamri lah bekesaron vehiggia chamma lassukka amar lo mahu sheefros aleha sadin amar lo en lecha kol shevet veshevet miyyisrael shello heemid mimmennu shofet

Higgia chamma lachatzi hassukka amar lo mahu sheefros aleha sadin amar lo en lecha kol shevet veshevet miyyisrael shello yatzu mimmennu neviim shevet yehuda uvinyamin heemidu melachim al pi neviim higgia chamma lemargelotav shel rabbi eliezer natal yochanan sadin uferas aleha hifshil rabbi eliezer tallito laachorav veyatza lo mippene shehifligo bidvarim ella mippene shello amar davar shello shama mippi rabbo leolam
Hechi aved hachi vehaamar rabbi eliezer en yotzin missukka lesukka regel acher havay
Vehaamar rabbi eliezer meshabbeach ani et haatzlanin sheen yotzin mibbattehen baregel shabbat havay
Vetifshot leh middideh ditnan pekak hachallon rabbi eliezer omer bizman shekkashur vetaluy pokkin bo veim lav en pokkin bo vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach pokkin

Amru lo kol devarecha enan ella mippi hashshemua amar lahem hizkaktuni lomar davar shello shamati mippi rabbotay miyyamay lo kedamani adam bevet hammidrash velo yashanti bevet hammidrash lo shenat keva velo shenat aray velo hinnachti adam bevet hammidrash veyatzati velo sachti sichat chullin velo amarti davar shello shamati mippi rabbi meolam

Amru alav al rabban yochanan ben zakkay shello hinniach mikra umishna gemara halachot veaggadot dikduke tora vedikidduke sofrim kallim vachamurim ugzerot shaot tekufot vegimatriyyaot sichat malache hashsharet vesichat shedim vesichat dekalim mishlot kovsin mishlot shualim davar gadol vedavar katan

Davar gadol maase merkava davar katan havaot deabbaye verava lekayyem ma shenneemar lehanchil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle vechi meachar shekkatan shebbechullan kach gadol shebbechullan al achat kamma vechamma amru alav al yonatan ben uzziel beshaa sheyyoshev veosek battora kol of shepporeach alav miyyad nisraf

Matni mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay lo kach haya maase shehalchu zikne bet shammay vezikne bet hillel levakker et rabbi yochanan ben hachoranit umtzauhu shehaya yoshev rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit velo amru lo davar amru lahem bet shammay mishsham reaya af hem amru lo im ken hayita noheg lo kiyyamta mitzvat sukka miyyamecha
Nashim vaavadim uktannim peturin min hassukka katan sheeno tzarich leimmo chayyav besukka maase veyalda kallato shel shammay hazzaken ufichet et hammaaziva vesikech al gabbe hammitta bishvil katan
Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ezrach ze ezrach haezrach lehotzi et hannashim kol lerabbot et hakketannim

Amar mar haezrach lehotzi et hannashim lememra deezrach ben nashim ben gavre mashma vehatanya haezrach lerabbot et hannashim haezrachiyyot shechayyavot beinuy alma ezrach gavre mashma amar rabba hilcheta ninhu veasmechinhu rabbanan akkerae
He kera vehe hilcheta vetu kera lema li hilcheta lema li ha sukka mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot
Yom hakkippurim midderav yehuda amar rav nafka deamar rav yehuda amar rav vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael amar kera ish o ishsha
b: Hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashin shebbattora amar abbaye leolam sukka hilcheta veitzterich salka datach amena teshvu keen taduru ma dira ish veishto af sukka ish veishto ka mashma lan
Rava amar itzterich salka datach amena yalef chamishsha asar chamishsha asar mechag hammatztzot ma lehallan nashim chayyavot af kan nashim chayyavot ka mashma lan
Vehashta deamratte sukka hilcheta kara lema li lerabbot et haggerim salka datach amena haezrach beyisrael amar rachamana velo et haggerim ka mashma lan
Yom hakkippurim midderav yehuda amar rav nafka lo nitzrecha ella letosefet inuy salka datach amena hoil umiet rachamana letosefet inuy meonesh umeazhara lo nitchayevu nashim kelal ka mashma lan

Amar mar kol lerabbot et hakketannim vehatnan nashim vaavadim uktannim peturin min hassukka la kashya kan bekatan shehiggia lechinuch kan bekatan shello higgia lechinuch katan shehiggia lechinuch midderabbanan hu midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma hu

Katan sheeno tzarich leimmo ku hechi dame katan sheeno tzarich leimmo amri deve rabbi yannay kol shennifne veen immo mekannachto rabbi shimon omer kol shenneor mishshenato veeno kore imma imma gedolim name karu ella ema kal shenneor veeno kore imma imma

Gema tanu rabbanan kol shivat hayyamim adam ose sukkato keva uveto aray ketzad hau lo kelim naim maalan lassukka matztzaot naot maalan lassukka ochel veshote umtayyel bassukka mena hane mile detanu rabbanan teshvu keen taduru mikkan amru kol shivat hayyamim ose adam sukkato keva uveto aray ketzad hau lo kelim naim maalan lassukka matztzaot naot maalan lassukka ochel veshote umtayyel bassukka umshannen bassukka
Ini vehaamar rava mikra umitne bimtallalta vetannoye bar mimmetallalta la kashya ha bemigras ha beayyone

Yardu geshamim tana mishshettisrach hammikpa shel gerisin

Abbaye hava ka yatev kammeh derav yosef bimtallalta neshav zika veka mayete tzivvata amar lehu rav yosef pannu li manay mehacha amar leh abbaye veha tenan mishshettisrach hammikpa amar leh ledidi kevan daanina datay kemi shettisrach hammikpa dame li
Tanu rabbanan haya ochel bassukka veyardu geshamim veyarad en matrichin oto laalot ad sheyyigmor seuddato haya yashen tachat hassukka veyardu geshamim veyarad en matrichin oto laalot ad sheyyeor
Ibaya lehu ad sheyyeor o ad sheyyeor ta shema ad sheyyeor veyaale ammud hashshachar tarte ella ema ad sheyyeor veyaale ammud hashshachar
Mashal lema haddavar dome ibaya lehu mi shafach lemi ta shema detanya shafach lo rabbo kiton al panav veamar lo i efshi beshimmushecha

Tanu rabbanan bizman shehachamma loka siman ra lechol haolam kullo mashal lema haddavar dome lemelech basar vadam sheasa seudda laavadav vehinniach panas lifnehem kaas alehem veamar leavdo tol panas mippenehem vehoshivem bachoshech

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay

a: Mishshum dehave leh mitzva habbaa baavera shenneemar vahavetem gazul veet happisseach veet hachole gazul dumya defisseach ma pisseach let leh takkanta af gazul let leh takkanta la shena lifne yeush vela shena leachar yeush
Bishlama lifne yeush adam ki yakriv mikkem amar rachamana velav dideh hu ella leachar yeush ha kanyeh beyeush ella lav mishshum dehave leh mitzva habbaa baavera

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay may dichtiv ki ani Adonai ohev mishpat sone gazel beola mashal lemelech basar vadam shehaya over al bet hammeches amar laavadav tenu meches lammochsim amru lo vahalo kol hammeches kullo shellecha hu amar lahem mimmenni yilmedu kol ovre derachim velo yavrichu atzman min hammeches af hakkadosh baruch hu amar ani Adonai sone gazel beola mimmenni yilmedu banay veyavrichu atzman min haggazel
Ittemar name amar rabbi amme yavesh pasul mippene sheen hadar gazul pasul mishshum dehave leh mitzva habbaa baavera
Ufliga derabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani amar shemuel lo shanu ella beom tov rishon aval beom tov sheni mittoch sheyyotze beshaul yotze name begazul

Metiv rav nachman bar yitzchak lulav haggazul vehayyavesh pasul ha shaul kasher emat ilema beom tov rishon ha ketiv lachem mishshellachem vehay lav dideh hu ella lav beom tov sheni vekatane gazul pasul
Rava amar leolam beom tov rishon vela mibaya kaamar la mibaya shaul delav dideh hu aval gazul ema setam gezela yeush bealim hu uchdideh dame ka mashma lan
Amar lehu rav huna lehanhu avankare ki zavnitu asa miggoyim la tigzezu attun ella ligzezuh inhu veyahavu lechu may tama setam goyim gazlane arata ninhu
b: Vekarka enah nigzelet hilkach ligzezuh inhu ki hechi deliho yeush bealim bidayehu didhu veshinuy harshut bidayechu
Sof sof ki gazzu avankare leheve yeush bealim bidayehu veshinuy harshut bidan la tzericha behoshana daavankare gufayehu
Velikneuh beshinuy maase ka savar lulav en tzarich eged

Velikneuh beshinuy hashshem demeikara hava leh assa vehashta

Tana yavesh pasul rabbi yehuda machshir amar rava machaloket belulav derabbanan savri makkeshinan lulav leetrog ma etrog bae hadar af lulav bae hadar verabbi yehuda savar la makkeshinan lulav leetrog aval beetrog divre hakkol hadar baenan
Uvlulav la bae rabbi yehuda hadar vehatnan rabbi yehuda omer yaagdennu milmala may tama lav mishshum devae hadar
La kidkatane tama rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon kappot temarim kefot veim haya parud yichpetennu
Vela bae hadar vehatnan en ogdin et hallulav ella bemino divre rabbi yehuda may tama lav mishshum devae hadar
La deha amar rava afilu besiv vaafilu beikara dedikla veella may tama derabbi yehuda hatam deka savar lulav tzarich eged vei mayete mina acharina have lehu chamishsha minin

Uvetrog mi bae rabbi yehuda hadar vehatanya arbaat minin shebballulav keshem sheen pochatin mehen kach en mosifin alehen lo matza etrog lo yavi lo parish velo rimmon velo davar acher kemushin kesherin yeveshin pesulin rabbi yehuda omer af yeveshin
Veamar rabbi yehuda maase
b: Bivne cherakkin shehau morishin et lulvehen livne venehen amru lahem mishsham reaya en sheat haddechak reaya
Katane mihat rabbi yehuda omer af yeveshin kesherin may lav aetrog la allulav
Amar mar keshem sheen pochatin mehen kach en mosifin alehen peshita mahu detema hoil veamar rabbi yehuda lulav tzarich eged vei mayete mina acharina hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae ka mashma lan
Amar mar lo matza etrog lo yavi lo rimmon velo parish velo davar acher peshita mahu detema layete ki hechi shello tishshachach torat etrog ka mashma lan zimnin denafek churba mineh deate lemisrach
Ta shema etrog hayyashan pasul verabbi yehuda machshir teuvta derava teuvta
Vela bae hadar veha anan tenan hayyarok kecharrate rabbi meir machshir verabbi yehuda posel lav mishshum devae hadar la mishshum dela gemar pera
Ta shema shiur etrog katan rabbi meir omer keegoz rabbi yehuda omer kevetza lav mishshum devae hadar la mishshum dela gemar pera

Ta shema uvgadol kede sheyyeechoz shenayim beyado achat divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer afilu echad bishte yadav may tama lav mishshum devae hadar la kevan deamar rabba lulav beyamin veetrog bismol zimnin demichallefi leh veate leappuchinhu veate leipsole
