a: Kautz saduk akom dome lemaggal pasul charut pasul dome lecharut kasher amar rav pappa daavid kehemnek
Akom dome lemaggal amar rava la amaran ella lefanav aval leacharav biryateh hu
Amar rav nachman litzdadin kilfanav dame veamri lah kilacharav dame
Veamar rava hay lulabba desalek bechad hutza baal mum hu ufasul
Nifretzu alav ku amar rav pappa nifretzu deaved ki chufya nifredu deiparud ipparode
Bae rav pappa nechleka hatteomet mahu ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi nitla hatteomet pasul may lav hu haddin nechleka la nitla shane deha chasar leh
Ika deamri amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi nechleka hatteomet naasa kemi shennitla hatteomet ufsul
Rabbi yehuda omer tanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon kappot temarim kefot im haya parud yichpetennu
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe mimmay dehay kappot temarim delulabba hu ema charuta baena kefot veleka
Veema ufta kefot mikkelal deika parud vehay kafut veomed leolam
Veema kufra amar abbaye deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom ketiv
Amar leh rava tosfaa leravina veema tarte kappe detamre kappat ketiv veema chada lehahu kaf kare leh
Tzine har habbarzel keshera amar abbaye lo shanu ella sherosho shel ze maggia letzad ikaro shel ze aval en rosho shel ze maggia letzad ikaro shel ze pasul
Tanya name hachi tzine har habbarzel pesula veha anan tenan keshera ella shema minah keabbaye shema minah
b: Veika derame lah mirme tenan tzine har habbarzel kasher vehatanya pesula amar abbaye la kashya kan sherosho shel ze maggia letzad ikaro shel ze kan sheen rosho shel ze maggia letzad ikaro shel ze

Amar rabbi mariyyon amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi veamri lah tane rabba bar mari mishshum rabban yochanan ben zakkay shette temarot yesh bege ben hinnom veole ashan mibbenehem vezehu sheshshaninu tzine har habbarzel kesherot vezo hi pitchah shel gehinnam
Lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shiur hadas vaarava shelosha velulav arbaa kede sheyehe lulav yotze min hahadas tefach
Verabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan shidro shel lulav tzarich sheyyetze min hahadas tefach
Tenan lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim kede lenanea bo kasher ema uchde lenanea bo kasher mar kidit leh umar kidit leh
Ta shema shiur hadas vaarava shelosha velulav arbaa may lav bahade alin la levad mealin
Gufa shiur hadas vaarava shelosha velulav arbaa rabbi tarfon omer beamma bat chamishsha tefachim
Amar rava shera leh mareh lerabbi tarfon hashta avot shelosha la mashkechinan bat chamishsha mibbaya
Ki ata rav dimi amar amma bat shishsha tefachim ase otah bat chamishsha tze mehen shelosha lahadas vehashshear lallulav kamma hau lehu telata utlata chumshe

Kashya dishmuel addishmuel hacha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shiur hadas vaarava shelosha vehatam amar rav huna amar shemuel halacha kerabbi tarfon la dak emar deamrinan la dak lechumra lekulla mi amrinan la dak
Ki ata ravin amar amma bat chamishsha tefachim ase otah shishsha tze mehen shelosha lahadas vehashshear lallulav kamma have lehu tere ufalga
Sof sof kashya dishmuel addishmuel la dak vehayenu lechumra la dak deamar rav huna amar shemuel halacha kerabbi tarfon
Matni hadas haggazul vehayyavesh pasul shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat pasul niktam rosho nifretzu alav o shehau anavav merubbot mealav pasul veim miatan kasher veen memaatin beom tov
Gema tanu rabbanan anaf etz avot sheanafav chofin et etzo vee ze hu heve omer ze hadas veema zeta baenan avot veleka
Veema dulba baenan anafav chofin et etzo veleka
Veema hirduf amar abbaye deracheha darche noam veleka rava amar mehacha haemet vehashshalom ehavu
Tanu rabbanan kalua kemin kelia vedome leshalshelet zehu hadas rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer anaf etz avot etz shettaam etzo ufiro shave heve omer ze hadas
Tana etz avot kasher vesheeno avot pasul

Hechi dame avot amar rav yehuda vehu dekayemi telata telata tarfe bekina rav kahana amar afilu tere vechad rav acha bereh derava mehaddar attere vechad hoil unfak mippummeh derav kahana amar leh mar bar ammemar lerav ashe abba lehahu hadas shote kare leh
Tanu rabbanan nashru rov alav venishtayeru bo miut kasher uvilvad shettehe avoto kayyemet
Ha gufa kashya amratte nashru rov alav kasher vahadar tane uvilvad shettehe avoto kayyemet kevan denatri lehu tere avot hechi mashkachatte lah
Amar abbaye mashkachatte lah

a: Beassa mitzraa dekayemi shiva shiva bechad kina dechi natri arbea pashu lehu telata amar abbaye shema minah hay assa mitzraa kashar lehoshana
Peshita mahu detema hoil veit leh shem levay la mittachshar ka mashma lan veema hachi name etz avot amar rachamana mikkol makom
Tanu rabbanan yavshu rov alav venisharu bo shelosha badde alin lachin kasher veamar rav chisda uvrosh kol echad veechad
Niktam rosho tane ulla bar chinana niktam rosho vealta bo temara kasher
Bae rabbi yirmeya niktam rosho meerev yom tov vealta bo temara beom tov mahu yesh dichuy etzel mitzot o lo

Vetifshot leh meha ditnan kissahu venitgalla patur millechassot kissahu haruach chayyav lechassot veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shechazar venitgalla aval lo chazar venitgalla patur millechassot
Vehavenan bah ki chazar venitgalla ammay chayyav lechassot hoil veidchi idchi
Veamar rav pappa zot omeret en dichuy etzel mitzot
Derav pappa gufa mibaya leh mifshat peshit leh deen dichuy etzel mitzot la shena lekulla vela shena lechumra o dilma sappoke mesappeka leh lechumra amrinan lekulla la amrinan teku

Lema ketannae avar velikketan pasul divre rabbi elazar ben tzadok vachachamim machshirin savruha dechulle alma lulav en tzarich eged veim timtze lomar tzarich eged la yalfinan lulav missukka dichtiv bah taase velo min heasuy
May lav beha kamipalgi deman defasel savar amrinan yesh dichuy etzel mitzot uman demachshar savar la amrinan yesh dichuy etzel mitzot
La dechulle alma la amrinan yesh dichuy etzel mitzot vehacha bemelaf lulav missukka ka mipalgi mar savar yalfinan lulav missukka umar savar la yalfinan lulav missukka

Veibaet ema i sevira lan lulav tzarich eged dechulle alma yalfinan lulav missukka vehacha belulav tzarich eged ka mipalgi uviflugta dehane tannae detanya lulav ben agud ben sheeno agud kasher rabbi yehuda omer agud kasher sheeno agud pasul

May tama derabbi yehuda yalef lekicha lekicha meaguddat ezov ketiv hacha ulkachtem lachem bayyom harishon uchtiv hatam ulkachtem aguddat ezov ma lehallan agudda af kan agudda verabbanan let lehu lekicha lekicha
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan lulav mitzva leogdo veim lo agado kasher manni i rabbi yehuda ki lo agado ammay kasher i rabbanan may mitzva ka aved leolam rabbanan umitzva mishshum ze eli veanvehu
O shehau anavav merubbin amar rav chisda davar ze rabbenu haggadol amaro vehammakom yihye beezro lo shanu ella bemakom echad aval bishnayim o shelosha mekomot kasher
Amar leh rava
b: Shenayim ushlosha mekomot have menummar ufsul

Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar o shehau anavav merubbin mealav pasul amar rav chisda davar ze rabbenu haggadol amaro vehammakom yihye beezro lo shanu ella anavav shechorot aval anavav yerukkot mine dahadas hu vechasher
Amar rav pappa adummot kishchorot damyan deamar rabbi chanina hay dam shachor adom hu ella shellaka
Im miatan kasher demaatinhu emat ilema mikkamme delogdeh peshita ella levatar delogdeh dachuy meikara hu tifshot minah dachuy meikara la have dachuy
Leolam batar deagdeh vekasavar eged hazmana bealma hu vehazmana bealma lav kelum hu
Veen memaatin beom tov ha avar velikketan may kasher deashchur emat ilema deashchur meetmol dachuy meikara hu tifshot minah dachuy meikara dela have dachuy
Ella lav deashchur beom tov nire venidche hu shamatte minah nire venidche chozer venire
La leolam deashchur meikara dachuy meikara dela have dachuy tifshot minah aval nire venidche chozer venire la tifshot
Tanu rabbanan en memaatin beom tov mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon amru memaatin veha ka metakken mana beom tov
Amar rav ashe kegon shellikketan laachila verabbi eliezer berabbi shimon savar lah kaavuh deamar davar sheen mitkaven muttar
Veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut
Hacha bemay askinan deit leh hoshana achariti
Tanu rabbanan huttar agdo beom tov ogdo kaagudda shel yarak veammay lineveh minav ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar aniva keshira meallayeta hi
I rabbi yehuda eged meallayeta bae hay tanna savar lah keoteh bachada uflig aleh bachada
Matni arava gezula vivesha pesula shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat pesula niktam roshah nifretzu aleha vehatztzaftzafa pesula kemusha veshennashru miktzat aleha veshel baal keshera
Gema tanu rabbanan arve nachal haggedelin al hannachal davar acher arve nachal sheale shellah mashuch kenachal
Tanya idach arve nachal en li ella arve nachal shel baal veshel harim minnayin talmud lomar arve nachal mikkol makom

a: Abba shaul omer arve shettayim achat lallulav veachat lammikdash
Verabbanan lammikdash mena lehu hilcheta gemiri lehu deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan eser netiot arava venisuch hammayim halacha lemoshe missinay
Tanu rabbanan arve nachal haggedelot al hannachal perat letzaftzafa haggedela ben heharim amar rabbi zera may keraa kach al mayim rabbim tzaftzafa samo

Amar leh abbaye vedilma paroshe ka mefaresh kach al mayim rabbim umay nihu tzaftzafa im ken may samo amar rabbi avahu amar hakkadosh baruch hu ani amarti sheyehu yisrael lefanay kekach al mayim rabbim umay nihu arava vehen samu atzman ketzaftzafa shebbeharim

Ika dematne lah lehay kera ammatnita kach al mayim rabbim tzaftzafa samo matkef lah rabbi zera vedilma paroshe ka mefaresh kach al mayim rabbim may nihu tzaftzafa im ken may samo amar rabbi avahu amar hakkadosh baruch hu ani amarti sheyehu yisrael lefanay kekach al mayim rabbim umay nihu arava vehen samu atzman ketzaftzafa shebbeharim

Tanu rabbanan e zehu arava veezehu tzaftzafa arava kane shellah adom veale shellah mashuch ufiha chalak tzaftzafa kane shellah lavan veale shellah agol ufiha dome lemaggal veha tanya dome lemaggal kasher dome lemassar pasul amar abbaye ki tanya hahi bechilfa gila
Amar abbaye shema minah hay chilfa gila kasher lehoshana peshita mahu detema hoil veit leh shem levay la nittachshar ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name arve nachal amar rachamana mikkol makom
Amar rav chisda hane telat mile ishtanni shemayehu mikki charav bet hammikdash chalafta aravta aravta chalafta may nafka minah lelulav
Shipura chatzotzarta chatzotzarta shipura may nafka minah leshofar shel rosh hashshana
Paturta patura patura paturta lemay nafka minah lemikkach umimkar
Amar abbaye af ani omer be chase huvlila huvlila be chase
Lemay nafka minah lemachat hannimtza beovi bet hakkosot
Amar rava bar yosef af ani omer bavel borsif borsif bavel lemay
b: Nafka minah legite nashim

Matni rabbi yishmael omer shelosha hadassim ushte aravot lulav echad veetrog echad afilu shenayim ketumim veechad eno katum rabbi tarfon omer afilu shelashtan ketumim rabbi akiva omer keshem shellulav echad veetrog echad kach hadas echad vaarava achat

Gema tanya rabbi yishmael omer peri etz hadar echad kappot temarim echad anaf etz avot shelosha arve nachal shettayim vaafilu shenayim ketumim veechad sheeno katum rabbi tarfon omer shelosha vaafilu shelashtan ketumim rabbi akiva omer keshem shellulav echad veetrog echad kach hadas echad vaarava achat

Amar lo rabbi eliezer yachol yehe etrog immahen baagudda achat amarta vechi neemar peri etz hadar vechappot temarim vahalo lo neemar ella kappot uminnayin shemmeakkevin ze et ze talmud lomar ulkachtem shettehe lekicha tamma
Verabbi yishmael ma nafshach i shelemin bae live name kullehu i la bae shelemin afilu chad name la amar biraa amar rabbi amme chazar bo rabbi yishmael
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi tarfon veazda shemuel letameh daamar lehu shemuel lehanhu dimzabbene assa asho vezabbinu vei la dareshna lechu kerabbi tarfon
May tama ilema mishshum demekel velidrosh lehu kerabbi akiva demekel tefe telata ketimi shechichi chad vela ketim la shechiach

Matni etrog haggazul vehayyavesh pasul shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat pasul shel orla pasul shel teruma temea pasul shel teruma tehora lo yittol veim natal kasher shel demay bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin shel maaser sheni birushalayim lo yittol veim natal kasher

Alta chazazit al rubbo nittela pitmato niklaf nisdak nikav vechasar kol shehu pasul alta chazazit al miuto nittal uktzo nikav velo chasar kol shehu kasher etrog hakkushi pasul vehayyarok kecharrate rabbi meir machshir verabbi yehuda posel shiur etrog hakkatan rabbi meir omer keegoz rabbi yehuda omer kevetza uvaggadol kede sheyyochaz shenayim beyado divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose omer afilu echad bishte yadav

a: Gema tanu rabbanan peri etz hadar etz shettaam etzo ufiro shave heve omer ze etrog

Veema pilpelin kidtanya haya rabbi meir omer mimmashma shenneemar untatem kol etz eni yodea shehu etz maachal ma talmud lomar etz maachal etz shettaam etzo ufiro shave heve omer ze pilpelin lelammedcha shehappilpelin chayyavin beorla veen eretz yisrael chasera kelum shenneemar lo techsar kol bah
Hatam mishshum dela efshar hechi naaved ninkot chada la minachra lekichatah ninkot tere o telata echad amar rachamana velo shenayim ushlosha perot hilkach la efshar

Rabbi omer al tikre hadar ella haddir ma dir ze yesh bo gedolim uktannim temimim uvaale mumin hachi name yesh bo gedolim uktannim temimim uvaale mumin attu shear perot let behu gedolim uktannim temimin uvaale mumin ella hachi kaamar ad shebbain ketannim adayin gedolim kayyamim

Rabbi avahu amar al tikre hadar ella haddar davar sheddar beilano mishshana leshana ben azzay omer al tikre hadar ella idor shekken belashon yeoni korin lemayim idor veezo hi sheggadel al kol mayim heve omer ze etrog
Shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat pasul may tama kevan delisrefa kae kattote mechattat shiureh
Veshel orla pasul may tama peligi bah rabbi chiyya bar avin verabbi assi chad amar lefi sheen bah heter achila vechad amar lefi sheen bah din mamon

Ka salka dateh man devae heter achila la bae din mamon uman devae din mamon la bae heter achila tenan shel teruma temea pesula bishlama leman deamar lefi sheen bah heter achila shappir ella leman deamar lefi sheen bah din mamon ammay hare massikah tachat tavshilo
Ella beheter achila kulle alma la peligi devaenan ki peligi bedin mamon mar savar heter achila baenan din mamon la baenan umar savar din mamon name baenan may benayehu
Ika benayehu maaser sheni shebbirushalayim alliba derabbi meir leman deamar lefi sheen bah heter achila hare yesh bah heter achila leman deamar lefi sheen bah din mamon maaser sheni mamon gavoha hu

Tistayyam derabbi assi deamar lefi sheen bah din mamon deamar rabbi assi etrog shel maaser sheni ledivre rabbi meir en adam yotze bo yede chovato beom tov ledivre chachamim adam yotze bo yede chovato beom tov tistayyam

Gufa amar rabbi assi etrog shel maaser sheni ledivre rabbi meir en adam yotze bo yede chovato beom tov ledivre chachamim adam yotze bo yede chovato beom tov matztza shel maaser sheni divre rabbi meir en adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach ledivre chachamim adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach isa shel maaser sheni ledivre rabbi meir petura min hachalla ledivre chachamim chayyevet bachalla

Matkef lah rav pappa bishlama isa ketiv reshit arisotechem etrog name ketiv lachem mishshellachem ella matztza mi ketiv matztzatchem amar rabba bar shemuel veitema rav yemar bar shelemya atya lechem lechem ketiv hacha lechem oni uchtiv hatam
b: Vehaya baacholchem millechem haaretz ma lehallan mishshellachem velo mishshel maaser af kan mishshellachem velo mishshel maaser
Lema mesayya leh isa shel maaser sheni petura min hachalla divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim chayyevet bachalla lema mesayya leh hi hi
Ella middivha peligi beha name peligi o dilma shane isa deamar kera arisotechem arisotechem tere zimne
Shel teruma temea pesula delet bah heter achila
Veshel teruma tehora lo yittol peligi bah rabbi amme verabbi assi chad amar mippene shemmachshirah vechad amar mippene shemmafsidah
May benayehu kegon shekkara aleha shem chutz mikkelipatah chitzona leman deamar mippene shemmachshirah ika leman deamar mippene shemmafsidah leka
Veim natal keshera leman deamar mippene sheen bah heter achila hare yesh bah heter achila leman deamar lefi sheen bah din mamon hare yesh bah din mamon
Veshel demay may tamayehu devet hillel kevan dei bae mafkar lehu lenichseh vehave ani vachaze leh hashta name lachem karena beh ditnan maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet achsanya demay

Uvet shammay ani la achel demay ditnan en maachilin haaniyyim demay veet haachsenaim demay veamar rav huna tana bet shammay omrim en maachilin et haaniyyim veet haachsenaim demay uvet hillel omrim maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet haachsenaim demay
Shel maaser sheni shebbirushalayim leman deamar mippene shemmachshirah hare machshirah leman deamar mippene shemmafsidah hare mafsida
Veim natal keshera leman deamar mippene sheen bah heter achila divre hakkol leman deamar lefi sheen bah din mamon ha manni rabbanan hi

Alta chazazit amar rav chisda davar ze rabbenu haggadol amaro hammakom yihye beezro lo shanu ella bemakom echad aval bishnayim ushlosha mekomot kasher amar leh rava adderabba bishnayim ushlosha mekomot have leh kimnummar ufasul

Ella i ittemar assefa ittemar al miuto kasher amar rav chisda davar ze rabbenu haggadol amaro vehammakom yihye beezro lo shanu ella bemakom echad aval bishnayim ushlosha mekomot have leh kimnummar ufasul amar rava veal chotmo vaafilu bemashshehu name pasul
Nittela pitmato tana rabbi yitzchak ben elazar nittela buchnato
Niklaf amar rava hay etroga deagled kaahina summaka keshera veha anan tenan niklaf pasul la kashya

a: Ha bechullah ha bemiktzatah
Nisdak nikav tane ulla bar chanina nikav nekev mefullash bemashshehu vesheeno mefullash bichisar
Bae rava noldu baetrog simane terefa mahu may kamibaya leh i niklaf tenena i nisdak tenena i nikav tenena

Ki ka mibaya leh kidulla amar rabbi yochanan rea shennishpecha kekiton keshera veamar rava vehu dekayemi simponaha ha la kayemi simponaha terefa hacha may dilma hatam hu dela shalet bah avera hadar barya aval hacha deshalet bah avera saroche masrecha o dilma la shena

Ta shema etrog tafuach saruach kavush shaluk kushi lavan umnummar pasul etrog kechaddur pasul veyesh omrim af hatteom etrog habboser rabbi akiva posel vachachamim machshirin giddelo bidfus vaasao kemin beriyya acheret pasul
Katane mihat tafuach saruach may lav tafuach mibbachutz vesaruach mibbifnim la idi veidi mibbachutz vela kashya ha ditfach af al gav dela serach ha disrach af al gav dela tefach
Amar mar etrog kushi pasul vehatanya kushi kasher dome lechushi pasul amar abbaye ki tenan name matnitin dome lechushi tenan rava amar la kashya ha lan veha lehu

Etrog habboser rabbi akiva posel vachachamim machshirin amar rabba rabbi akiva verabbi shimon amru davar echad rabbi akiva ha daamaran rabbi shimon may hi detanya rabbi shimon poter et haetrogim bekotnan
Amar leh abbaye dilma la hi ad kan la kaamar rabbi akiva hacha devaenan hadar veleka aval hatam kerabbanan sevira leh
I name ad kan la kaamar rabbi shimon hatam ella dichtiv asser teasser et kol tevuat zarecha kederech shebbene adam motziin lizria aval hacha kerabbanan sevira leh
b: Vetu la mide
Giddelo bidfus vaasao kemin beriyya acheret pasul amar rava lo shanu ella kemin beriyya acheret aval kivriyyato kasher peshita kemin beriyya acheret tenan la tzericha daavida dappe dappe
Itmar etrog shennekavuhu achbarim amar rav en ze hadar ini veha rabbi chanina metabbel beh venafek beh ulrabbi chanina kashya matnitin
Bishlama matnitin lerabbi chanina la kashya kan beom tov rishon kan beom tov sheni ella lerav kashya amar lecha rav shane achbarim dimisi
Ika deamri amar rav ze hadar deha rabbi chanina metabbel beh venafek beh ulrabbi chanina kashya matnitin la kashya kan beom tov rishon kan beom tov sheni

Etrog katan vechu amar rafram bar pappa kemachloket kan kach machloket baavanim mekurzalot detanya beshabbat shalosh avanim mekurzalot muttar lehachnis levet hakkisse vechamma shiuran rabbi meir omer keegoz rabbi yehuda omer kevetza
Uvaggadol kede sheyyochaz ku tanya amar rabbi yose maase berabbi akiva shebba levet hakkeneset veetrogo al ketefo amar lo rabbi yehuda mishsham reaya af hem amru lo en ze hadar

Matni en ogdin et hallulav ella bemino divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer afilu bechut bimshicha amar rabbi meir maase beanshe yerushalayim shehau ogdin et lulvehen begimoniyyot shel zahav amru lo bemino hau ogdin oto millematta
Gema amar rava afilu besiv afilu beikara dedikla veamar rava may tameh derabbi yehuda kasavar lulav tzarich eged vei mayete mina acharina have chamsha mine

Veamar rava mena amena lah desiv veikara dedikla mina delulabba hu detanya bassukkot teshvu sukka shel kol davar divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer en sukka noheget ella bearbaa minim shebballulav vehaddin noten uma lulav sheen noheg ballelot kevayyamim eno noheg ella bearbaat minin sukka shennoheget ballelot kevayyamim eno din shello tehe ella bearbaat minin
Amru lo kol din sheatta dan techillato lehachmir vesofo lehakel eno din

a: Lo matza arbaat minin yehe yoshev uvatel vehattora amra bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim sukka shel kol davar vechen beezra omer tzeu hahar vehaviu ale zayit vaale etz shemen vaale hadas vaale temarim vaale etz avot vaasu sukkot kakkatuv
Verabbi yehuda savar hane lidfanot ale hadas vaale temarim vaale etz avot lischach utnan mesakkechin binsarin divre rabbi yehuda alma siv veikara dedikla mina delulabba hu shema minah

Umi amar rabbi yehuda arbaat minin in mide acharina la vehatanya sikchah binsarim shel erez sheyyesh bahen arbaa tefachim divre hakkol pesula en bahen arbaa tefachim rabbi meir posel verabbi yehuda machshir umode rabbi meir sheim yesh ben neser leneser kimlo neser shemmanniach pesal benehen uchshera
May erez hadas kidrabba bar rav huna deamar rabba bar rav huna amri be rav asara mine arazim hen shenneemar etten bammidbar erez shita vahadas vego
Rabbi meir omer afilu bimshicha ku tanya amar rabbi meir maase beyakkire yerushalayim shehau ogdin et lulvehen begimoniyyot shel zahav amru lo mishsham reaya bemino hau ogdin oto millematta
Amar lehu rabba lehanhu megaddele hoshana deve resh galuta ki gadlitu hoshana deve resh galuta shayyiru beh bet yad ki hechi dela tehve chatzitza
Rava amar kol lenaoto eno chotzetz veamar rabba la linkot inish hoshana besudara devaena lekicha tamma veleka verava amar lekicha al yede davar acher shemah lekicha

Amar rava mena amena lah dilkicha al yede davar acher shemah lekicha ditnan ezov katzar mesappeko bechut uvchush vetovel umaale veochez baezov umazze ammay velakach vetaval amar rachamana ella lav shema minah lekicha al yede davar acher shemah lekicha
Mimmay dilma shane hatam kevan dechabbereh kegufeh dame ella mehacha nafal mishshefoferet lashshoket pasul
b: Ha hippilo hu kasher ammay velakchu venatan amar rachamana ella lav shema minah lekicha al yede davar acher shemah lekicha
Veamar rabba la lidutz inish lulabba behoshana dedilma natri tarfe vehave chatzitza verava amar min bemino eno chotzetz
Veamar rabba la ligoz inish lulabba behoshana demishtayeri hutze vehave chatzitza verava amar min bemino eno chotzetz
Veamar rabba hadas shel mitzva asur lehariach bo etrog shel mitzva muttar lehariach bo may tama hadas dilrecha kae ki aktzeye merecha aktzeye etrog delaachila kae ki aktzeye meachila aktzeye
Veamar rabba hadas bimchubbar muttar lehariach bo etrog bimchubbar asur lehariach bo may tama hadas dilhariach kae i sharet leh la ate lemigzeyeh etrog delaachila kae i sharet leh ate lemigzeyeh

Veamar rabba lulav beyamin veetrog bismol may tama hane telata mitzot vehay chada mitzva amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zerika may taam la mevarchinan ella al netilat lulav hoil vegavoha mikkullan velagbeheh leetrog ulvarech amar leh hoil uvmino gavoha mikkullan

Matni vehechan hau menaanin behodu la techila vasof uvanna Adonai hoshia na divre bet hillel uvet shammay omrin af beanna Adonai hatzlicha na amar rabbi akiva tzofe hayiti berabban gamliel verabbi yehoshua shekkol haam hau menanein et lulvehen vehem lo nanao ella beanna Adonai hoshia na
Gema ninua man dechar shemeh hatam kae kol lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim kede lenanea bo kasher vekaamar hechan menanein

Tenan hatam shette hallechem ushne kivse atzeret ketzad hu ose manniach shette hallechem al gabbe shene hakkevasin umanniach yado tachtehen umenif umolich umevi maale umorid shenneemar asher hunaf vaasher huram

Amar rabbi yochanan molich umevi lemi shehaarba ruchot shello maale umorid lemi shehashshamayim vehaaretz shello bemareva matnu hachi amar rabbi chama bar ukva amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina molich umevi kede laatzor ruchot raot maale umorid kede laatzor telalim raim amar rabbi yose bar avin veitema rabbi yose bar zevida zot omeret

a: Sheyare mitzva meakkevin et happuranut shehare tenufa sheyare mitzva hi veotzeret ruchot utlalim raim veamar rava vechen belulav rav acha bar yaakov mamte leh umayete leh amar den gira beeneh desitna velav milleta hi mishshum deate leigaroye beh
Matni mi shebba badderech velo haya beyado lulav litol lichsheyyikkanes leveto yittol al shulchano lo natal shacharit yittol ben haarbayim shekkol hayyom kasher lelulav
Gema amratte notlo al shulchano lememra demafsek urminhi im hitchilu en mafsikin amar rav safra la kashya ha deika shehut bayyom ha deleka shehut bayyom

Amar rava may kushya dilma ha deorayeta ha derabbanan ella amar rava i kashya ha kashya lichsheyyikkanes leveto notlo al shulchano alma demafsek vahadar tane lo natal shacharit yittol ben haarbayim alma la mafsek
Amar rav safra la kashya ha deika shehut bayyom ha deleka shehut bayyom

Amar rabbi zera may kushya dilma mitzva leafsoke vei la pesak yittol ben haarbayim shekkol hayyom kasher lelulav ella amar rabbi zera leolam kidamrinan meikara udkashya lach ha deorayeta ha derabbanan hacha beom tov sheni derabbanan askinan
Dayeka name middekatane mi shebba badderech veen beyado lulav dei salka datach beom tov rishon mi shere

Matni mi shehaya eved o ishsha o katan makrin oto one acharehen ma shehen omrin vetavo lo meera im haya gadol makre oto one acharav halluyah makom shennahagu lichpol yichpol lifshot yifshot levarech yevarech hakkol keminhag hammedina
Gema tanu rabbanan beemet amru ben mevarech leaviv veeved mevarech lerabbo veishsha mevarechet levalah aval amru chachamim tavo meera leadam sheishto uvanav mevarchin lo
Amar rava
b: Hilcheta gibarata ika lemishma mimminhaga dehallela hu omer halluyah vehen omrim halluyah mikkan shemmitzva laanot halluyah

Hu omer hallalu avde Adonai vehen omrin halluyah mikkan sheim haya gadol makre oto one acharav halluyah hu omer hodu la vehen omrim hodu la mikkan shemmitzva laanot rashe ferakim ittemar name amar rav chanan bar rava mitzva laanot rashe ferakim
Hu omer ana Adonai hoshia na vehen omrim anna Adonai hoshia na mikkan sheim haya katan makre oto onin acharav ma shehu omer
Hu omer ana Adonai hatzlicha na vehen omrim anna Adonai hatzlicha na mikkan sheim ba lichpol kofel hu omer baruch habba vehen omrim beshem Adonai mikkan leshomea keone
Beo mineh merabbi chiyya bar abba shama velo ana mahu amar lehu chakkimayya vesafrayya vereshe amma vedarashayya amru shama velo ana yatza

Ittemar name amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara minnayin leshomea keone dichtiv et haddevarim asher kara yoshiyyahu vechi yoshiyyahu keraan vahalo shafan keraan dichtiv vayyikraehu shafan et kol haddevarim haelle lifne hammelech ella mikkan leshomea keone
Vedilma batar dikranhu shafan kera yoshiyyahu amar rav acha bar yaakov la salka datach dichtiv yaan rach levavcha vattikkana lifne Adonai beshomacha et haddevarim haelle beshomacha vela bekoracha
Amar rava la lema inish baruch habba vahadar beshem Adonai ella baruch habba beshem Adonai bahadade amar leh rav safra

a: Moshe shappir kaamratte ella hatam vehacha assoke milta hi velet lan bah amar rava la lema inish yehe shemeh rabba vahadar mevarach ella yehe shemeh rabba mevarach bahadade amar leh rav safra moshe shappir kaamratte ella hatam vehacha assoke milta hu velet lan bah
Makom shennahagu lichpol tana rabbi kofel bah devarim rabbi elazar ben parta mosif bah devarim may mosif amar abbaye mosif lichpol meodcha ulmatta

Levarech yevarech amar abbaye lo shanu ella leacharav aval lefanav mitzva levarech deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol hammitzot kullan mevarech alehen over laasiyyatan umay mashma dehay over lishana deakdome hu deamar rav nachman bar yitzchak dichtiv vayyarotz achimaatz derech hakkikkar vayyaavor et hakkushi abbaye amar mehacha vehu avar lifnehem veibaet ema mehacha vayyaavor malkam lifnehem va berosham
Matni hallokeach lulav mechavero bashsheviit noten lo etrog bemattana lefi sheen rashshay lelokcho bashsheviit
Gema lo ratza liten lo bemattana mahu amar rav huna mavla leh deme etrog belulav velitev leh behedya

Lefi sheen mosrin deme perot sheviit leam haaretz detanya en mosrin deme perot sheviit leam haaretz yoter mimmezon shalosh seudot veim masar yomar hare maot hallalu yehu mechullalin al perot sheyyesh li betoch beti
b: Uva veochlan bikdushshat sheviit
Bamme devarim amurim belokeach min hammufkar aval belokeach min hamshummar afilu bechachatzi isar asur

Metiv rav sheshet umin hammufkar shalosh seudot vetu la urminhi happegam vehayyarbuzin vehashshetim vachaloglogot vehakkusbar shebbeharim vehakkarpas shebbanneharot vehaggargir shel afar peturin min hammaaser venikachin mikkol adam bashsheviit lefi sheen kayyotze bahen nishmar
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah bichde man shanu vechen amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan bichde man shanu may mashma dehay man lishana dimzone hu dichtiv vayeman lahem hammelech vego
I hachi lulav name lulav bar shishshit hannichnas lishviit hu i hachi etrog name bat shishshit hannichneset lishviit hi etrog batar lekita azlinan
Veha ben rabban gamliel uven rabbi eliezer leinyan sheviit etrog batar chanata azlinan ditnan etrog shave lailan bishlosha derachim velayyarak bederech echad
Shave lailan bishlosha derachim leorla velirvai velishviit ulyarak bederech echad

a: Shebbishat lekitato isuro divre rabban gamliel rabbi eliezer omer etrog shave lailan lechol davar
Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya amar rabbi yose avtulmos heid mishshum chamishsha zekenim etrog achar lekita lammaaser verabbotenu nimnu beusha veamru ben lammaaser ben lashsheviit
Sheviit man dechar shemeh chassore michassera vehachi katane etrog achar lekita lammaaser veachar chanata lashsheviit verabbotenu nimnu beusha veamru etrog batar lekita ben lammaaser ben lashsheviit

Tama delulav bar shishshit hannichnas lishviit hu ha dishviit kadosh ammay etzim bealma hu veetzim en bahen mishshum kedushshat sheviit ditnan ale kanim vaale gefanim sheggibbevan lechubba al pene hassade likketan laachila yesh bahen mishshum kedushshat sheviit likketan leetzim en bahen mishshum kedushshat sheviit
Shane hatam deamar kera lachem leochla lachem dumya dilachla mi shehanaato uviuro shave yatzu etzim shehanaatan achar biuran
Vehaika etzim demishchan dahanaatan uviuran shave amar rava setam etzim lehassaka hen omdin
Veetzim lehassaka tannae hi detanya en mosrin perot sheviit lo lemishra velo lichvusa rabbi yose omer mosrin

May tameh detanna kamma deamar kera leochla velo lemishra velo lichvusa may tameh derabbi yose amar kera lachem lachem lechol tzorchechem vaafilu lemishra velichvusa vetanna kamma ha ketiv lachem hahu lachem dumya dilochla mi shehanaato uviuro shave yatzu mishra uchvusa shehanaatan achar biuran

Verabbi yose ha ketiv leochla hahu mibe leh leochla velo limlugma kidtanya leochla velo limlugma atta omer leochla velo limlugma o eno ella velo lichvusa keshehu omer lachem hare lichvusa amur ha ma ani mekayyem leochla leochla velo limlugma ma raita lerabbot et hakkevusa ulhotzi et hammelugma
b: Merabbe ani et hakkevusa sheshshava bechol adam umotzi et hammelugma sheenah shava lechol adam
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan leochla velo limlugma leochla velo leziluf leochla velo laasot mimmenna appiktevizin keman kerabbi yose dei rabbanan ha ika name mishra uchvusa
Amar rabbi elazar en sheviit mitchallelet ella derech mikkach verabbi yochanan amar ben derech mikkach ben derech chilul

May tameh derabbi elazar dichtiv bishnat hayyovel hazzot vego usmich leh vechi timkeru mimkar derech mikkach velo derech chilul verabbi yochanan may tameh dichtiv ki yovel hi kodesh ma kodesh ben derech mikkach ben derech chilul af sheviit ben derech mikkach ben derech chilul

Verabbi yochanan hay ki timkeru mimkar may aved leh mibe leh lechidrabbi yose bar chanina detanya amar rabbi yose bar chanina bo ure kamma kashe avakah shel sheviit vechu adam nose venoten beferot sheviit lesof mocher et mittaltelav veet kelav shenneemar bishnat hayyovel hazzot tashuvu ish el achuzzato usmich leh vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha vego
Verabbi elazar hay kera derabbi yochanan may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya ki yovel hi kodesh ma kodesh tofes et damav af sheviit tofeset et dameha

Tanya keoteh derabbi elazar vetanya keoteh derabbi yochanan tanya keoteh derabbi elazar sheviit tofeset et dameha shenneemar ki yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem ma kodesh tofes et damav veasur af sheviit tofeset et dameha vaasura
I ma kodesh tofes damav veotze lechullin af sheviit tofeset et dameha veotzet lechullin talmud lomar tihye bahavayatah tehe

Ha ketzad lakach beferot sheviit basar ellu vaellu mitbaarin bashsheviit lakach babbasar dagim yatza basar venichnesu dagim lakach baddagim yayin yatzu dagim venichnas yayin lakach bayyayin shemen yatza yayin venichnas shemen
Ha ketzad acharon acharon nichnas bashsheviit ufri atzmo asur middekatane lakach lakach alma derech mikkach in derech chilul la

Tanya keoteh derabbi yochanan echad sheviit veechad maaser sheni mitchallelin al behema chayya vaof ben chayyin ben shechutin divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim al shechutin mitchallelin al chayyin en mitchallelin gezera shemma yegaddel mehen adarim
Amar rava machloket

a: Bizcharim aval binkevot divre hakkol al shechutin mitchallelin al chayyin en mitchallelin gezera shemma yegaddel mehen adarim
Amar rav ashe machaloket bifri rishon aval bifri sheni divre hakkol ben derech mikkach ben derech chilul veha dekatane lakach lakach ayede ditna resha lakach tena name sefa lakach

Etiveh ravina lerav ashe mi sheyyesh lo sela shel sheviit uvikesh likach bo chaluk ketzad yaase yelech etzel chenoni haragil etzlo veomer lo ten li besela perot venoten lo vechozer veomer lo hare perot hallalu netunim lecha bemattana vehu omer lo he lecha sela zo bemattana vehalla lokeach bahen ma sheyyirtze veha hacha difri sheni hu vekatane derech mikkach in derech chilul la
Ella amar rav ashe machaloket bifri sheni aval bifri rishon divre hakkol derech mikkach in derech chilul la veha dekatane echad sheviit veechad maaser sheni may sheviit deme sheviit
Dei la tema hachi maaser maaser mammash veha ketiv vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha ella deme maaser hacha name deme sheviit
Matni barishona haya lulav nital bammikdash shiva uvammedina yom echad mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyehe lulav nital bammedina shiva zecher lammikdash
Vesheyehe yom henef kullo asur

Gema mena lan deavdinan zecher lammikdash amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera ki aale arucha lach umimmakkotayich erpaech neum Adonai ki niddacha karu lach tziyyon hi doresh en lah doresh en lah mikkelal devaaya derisha

Vesheyehe yom henef may tama mehera yibbane bet hammikdash veyomru eshtakad mi lo achalnu beheir mizrach hashta name nechol veinhu la yadi deeshtakad dela hava bet hammikdash heir mizrach hittir hashta deika bet hammikdash omer mattir

Deibni emat ilema deibni beshitsar hare hittir heir mizrach ella deibni bachamesar mechatzot hayyom ulhallan tishtere deha tenan harchokim muttarin mechatzot hayyom ulhallan lefi sheen bet din mitatztzelim bo
La tzericha deibni belelya i name samuch lishkiat hachamma amar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay beshitat rabbi yehuda amarah deamar min hattora hu asur dichtiv
b: Ad etzem hayyom hazze ad itzumo shel yom vekasavar ad vead bakkelal

Umi savar leh keoteh veha miflag pelig aleh detanya mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyehe yom henef kullo asur amar lo rabbi yehuda vahalo min hattora hu asur dichtiv ad etzem hayyom hazze ad itzumo shel yom
Rabbi yehuda hu deka tae hu savar midderabbanan kaamar vela hi middeorayeta kaamar veha hitkin kaamar may hitkin darash vehitkin

Matni yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihot beshabbat kol haam molichin et lulvehen levet hakkeneset lammochorat mashkimin uvain kol echad veechad makkir et shello venotlo mippene sheamru chachamim en adam yotze yede chovato beom tov harishon belulavo shel chavero ushar yemot hachag adam yotze yede chovato belulavo shel chavero rabbi yose omer yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihot beshabbat veshachach vehotzi et hallulav lirshut harabbim patur mippene shehotzio birshut

Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ulkachtem shettehe lekicha beyad kol echad veechad lachem mishshellachem lehotzi et hashshaul veet haggazul mikkan amru chachamim en adam yotze yede chovato beom tov harishon shel chag belulavo shel chavero ella im ken netano lo bemattana

Umaase berabban gamliel verabbi yehoshua verabbi elazar ben azarya verabbi akiva shehau bain bisfina velo haya lulav ella lerabban gamliel bilvad shellekacho beelef zuz netalo rabban gamliel veyatza bo untano lerabbi yehoshua bemattana netalo rabbi yehoshua veyatza bo untano lerabbi elazar ben azarya bemattana netalo rabbi elazar ben azarya veyatza bo untano bemattana lerabbi akiva netalo rabbi akiva veyatza bo vehechziro lerabban gamliel
Lema li lememar hechziro milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan mattana al menat lehachzir shemah mattana
Ki ha deamar rava he lecha etrog ze al menat shettachzirehu li netalo veyatza bo hechziro yatza lo hechziro lo yatza
Lema li lememar shellekacho beelef zuz lehodiacha kamma mitzot chavivot alehen

Amar leh mar bar ammemar lerav ashe abba tzalloye ka metzalle beh metivi lo yochaz adam tefilin beyado vesefer tora becheko veyitpallel velo yashtin bahen mayim velo yishan bahen lo shenat keva velo shenat aray
Veamar shemuel sakkin ukara kikkar umaot hare ellu kayyotze bahen hatam lav mitzva ninhu utrid behu hacha mitzva ninhu vela terid behu

Tanya rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer kach haya minhagan shel anshe yerushalayim adam yotze mibbeto velulavo beyado holech levet hakkeneset lulavo beyado kore keriat shema umitpallel velulavo beyado kore battora venose et kappav mannicho al gabbe karka holech levakker cholim ulnachem avelim lulavo beyado nichnas levet hammidrash meshagger lulavo beyad beno uvyad avdo uvyad shelucho
May ka mashma lan lehodiacha kamma hau zerizin bemitzot
Rabbi yose omer yom tov amar abbaye

a: Lo shanu ella shello yatza bo aval yatza bo chayyav ha middeagbeheh nefak beh amar abbaye keshehafacho
Rava amar afilu tema shello hafacho hacha bemay askinan kegon shehotzio bichli veha rava hu deamar lekicha al yede davar acher shemah lekicha hane mile derech kavod aval derech bizzaon la
Amar rav huna omer haya rabbi yose olat haof shennimtzet ben agappayim uchsavur chattat haof hi vaachalah patur may ka mashma lan detaa bidvar mitzva patur hayenu hach
Mahu detema hatam hu detaa bidvar mitzva patur hayenu daavad mitzva aval hacha detaa bidvar mitzva vela avad mitzva ema la ka mashma lan
Metivi rabbi yose omer hashshochet et hattamid sheeno mevukkar kehilchato bashshabbat chayyav chattat vetzarich tamid acher
Amar leh bar minah dehahi deha ittemar alah amar rav shemuel bar chattay amar rav hamnuna sava amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan amar rav huna amar rav kegon shehevio millishka sheenan mevukkarin
Matni mekabbelet ishsha miyyad benah umiyyad balah umachzirato lemayim beshabbat rabbi yehuda omer bashshabbat machzirin beom tov mosifin uvammoed machlifin
Katan hayyodea lenanea chayyav belulav
Gema peshita mahu detema hoil veishsha lav bat chiyyuva hi ema la tekabbel ka mashma lan
Katan hayyodea lenanea tanu rabbanan katan hayyodea lenanea chayyav belulav lehitattef chayyav betzitzit lishmor tefilin aviv lokeach lo tefilin yodea ledabber aviv melammedo tora ukriat shema
Tora may hi amar rav hamnuna tora tziva lanu moshe morasha kehillat yaakov keriat shema may hi pasuk rishon

Hayyodea lishmor gufo ochlin al gufo teharot lishmor et yadav ochlin al yadav teharot hayyodea lishael birshut hayyachid sefeko tame birshut harabbim sefeko tahor hayyodea lifros kappav cholkin lo teruma bevet haggoranot
b: Hayyodea lishchot ochlin mishshechitato amar rav huna vehu sheggadol omed al gabbav

Yachol leechol kezayit dagan marchikin mitztzoato umimmeme raglav arba ammot amar rav chisda vehu sheyyachol leochlo bichde achilat peras amar rav chiyya bereh derav yeva uvaggadol af al pi sheeno yachol leechol bichde achilat peras dichtiv veosif daat yosif machov
Yachol leechol kezayit tzali shochatin alav et happesach shenneemar ish lefi ochlo rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyachol levarer achila ketzad notnin lo tzeror vezorko egoz venotlo
Hadaran alach lulav haggazul
Lulav vaarava shishsha veshiva hahallel vehassimcha shemona sukka venisuch hammayim shiva hechalil chamishsha veshishsha
Lulav shiva ketzad yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihot bashshabbat lulav shiva ushar kol hayyamim shishsha
Arava shiva ketzad yom hashshevii shel arava shechal lihot bashshabbat arava shiva ushar kol hayyamim shishsha

Mitzvat lulav ketzad bashshabbat yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihot bashshabbat molichin et lulvehen lehar habbayit vehachazzanin mekabbelin mehen vesodrin otan al gabbe itzteva vehazzekenim mannichin et shellahen belishka umlammedin otam lomar kol mi shemmaggia lulavi leyado hare hu lo bemattana
Lemachar mashkimin uvain vehachazzanin zorkin otam lifnehem vehen mechattefin umakkin ish et chavero uchsherau bet din shebbau lide sakkana hitkinu sheyehe kol echad veechad notel beveto
Gema ammay tiltul bealma hu velidche shabbat amar rabba gezera shemma yittelennu beyado veyelech etzel baki lilmod

a: Veyaavirennu arba ammot birshut harabbim vehayenu tama deshofar vehayenu tama dimgila
I hachi yom rishon name rishon ha takkinu le rabbanan beveto hatinach achar takkana kodem takkana may ika lememar
Ella rishon deiteh min hattora bigvulin la gezaru behu rabbanan hanach deletanhu min hattora bigvulin gezaru behu rabbanan
I hachi haidana name anan la yadinan bekibua deyarcha inhu deyadi bekibua deyarcha lidcho

In hachi name detane chada beom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihot beshabbat kol haam molichin et lulvehen lehar habbayit vetanya idach levet hakkeneset shema minah kan bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam kan bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyam shema minah
Deiteh min hattora bigvulin mena lan detanya ulkachtem shettehe lekicha beyad kol echad veechad
Lachem mishshellachem lehotzi et hashshaul veet haggazul bayyom vaafilu bashshabbat rishon afilu bigvulin harishon melammed sheeno doche ella yom tov harishon bilvad

Amar mar bayyom vaafilu bashshabbat mikkede tiltul bealma hu itzterich kera lemishre tiltul amar rava lo nitzrecha ella lemachshire lulav vealliba dehay tanna detanya lulav vechol machshirav dochin et hashshabbat divre rabbi eliezer

May tama derabbi eliezer amar kera bayyom vaafilu bashshabbat verabbanan hay bayyom may avdi leh mibe leh bayyom velo ballayela verabbi eliezer bayyom velo ballayela mena leh nafka leh missefa dikra usmachtem lifne Adonai elohechem shivat yamim yamim velo lelot verabbanan i mehatam hava amena lelaf yamim yamim missukka ma lehallan yamim vaafilu lelot af kan name yamim vaafilu lelot

Vesukka gufah menalan detanu rabbanan bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim yamim vaafilu lelot atta omer yamim vaafilu lelot o eno ella yamim velo lelot vedin hu neemar kan yamim veneemar belulav yamim ma lehallan yamim velo lelot af kan yamim velo lelot
O kelach ladderech zo neemar kan yamim veneemar bemilluim yamim ma lehallan yamim vaafilu lelot af kan yamim vaafilu lelot

Nire lemi dome danin davar shemmitzvato kol hayyom middavar shemmitzvato kol hayyom veal yochiach davar shemmitzvato shaa achat o kelach lederech zo danin davar shemmitzvato ledorot middavar shemmitzvato ledorot veal yochichu milluim sheen nohagin ledorot
Talmud lomar
b: Teshvu teshvu ligzera shava neemar kan teshvu veneemar bemilluim teshvu ma lehallan yamim vaafilu lelot af kan yamim vaafilu lelot
Arava shiva ketzad arava bishvii may tama dachaya shabbat amar rabbi yochanan kede lefarsemah shehi min hattora i hachi lulav name lidche kede lefarsemo shehu min hattora
Lulav gezera mishshum derabba i hachi arava name nigzor arava sheluche bet din mayeti lah lulav lakkol masur
I hachi kol yoma name lidche ate lefakpoke belulav velidche beom tov rishon la mochcha milleta amri lulav hu deka dache
Velidche bechad mehanach kevan deka mappekatte lah merishon okmah ashshevii
I hachi haidana name lidche anan la yadinan bekibua deyarcha
Inhu deyadi bekibua deyarcha lidche ki ata bar hedya amar la ikla ki ata ravin vechol nachote amri ikla vela dache
Veella kashya amar rav yosef man lema lan daarava bintila dilma bizkifa
Etiveh abbaye lulav vaarava shishsha veshiva may lav kelulav ma lulav bintila af arava bintila mide irya ha kiditeh veha kiditeh

Etiveh abbaye bechol yom makkifin et hammizbeach paam achat veoto hayyom sheva peamim may lav baarava la belulav veha amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh baarava amar leh hu amar lach baarava vaana amena belulav ittemar rabbi elazar omer belulav rav shemuel bar natan amar rabbi chanina baarava vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh baarava

Amar lecha rav nachman gabbe shabbat distam lan tena kerabbi shimon ditnan mechattechin et haddilluin lifne habbehema veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim
Mokem lah levet hillel kerabbi shimon aval
b: Gabbe yom tov distam lan tanna kerabbi yehuda ditnan en mevakkein etzim min hakkorot velo min hakkora shennishbera beom tov mokem lah levet hillel kerabbi yehuda
Mikkede man satmah lematnitin rabbi may shena beshabbat distam lan kerabbi shimon umay shena beom tov distam lan kerabbi yehuda
Amri shabbat dachamira vela ate lezalzole bah satem lan kerabbi shimon demekel yom tov dekil veate lezalzole beh satem lan kerabbi yehuda demachmir
Bemay okemta betarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim umishshum muktze i hachi addemippalgi bevetza lippalgu betarnegolet
Lehodiacha kochan devet shammay divnolad shere
Veliflugoy betarnegolet lehodiacha kochan devet hillel divmuktze asri vechi tema koach dehettera adif veniflog betarvayehu
Tarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim hi uvetzatah bet shammay omrim teachel uvet hillel omrim lo teachel
Ella amar rabba leolam betarnegolet haomedet laachila uvom tov shechal lihot achar hashshabbat askinan umishshum hachana
Vekasavar rabba kol betza demityalda haidana meetmol gamra lah
Verabba letameh deamar rabba may dichtiv vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehechinu et asher yaviu chol mechin leshabbat vechol mechin leom tov veen yom tov mechin leshabbat veen shabbat mechina leom tov
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta yom tov bealma tishtere gezera mishshum yom tov achar hashshabbat shabbat dealma tishtere gezera mishshum shabbat achar yom tov
Umi gazrinan veha tanya hashshochet et hattarnegolet umatza bah betzim gemurot muttarot leachlan beom tov veim ita ligzar mishshum hanach demityalledan beomehen
Amar leh betzim gemurot bime imman milta dela shechicha hi umilta dela shechicha la gezaru bah rabbanan
Rav yosef amar gezera mishshum perot hannoshrin
Amar leh abbaye perot hannoshrin tama may

a: Gezera shemma yaale veyitlosh hi gufah gezera vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera kullah chada gezera hi
Rabbi yitzchak amar gezera mishshum mashkin shezzavu
Amar leh abbaye mashkin shezzavu tama may gezera shemma yischot hi gufah gezera vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera kullah chada gezera hi
Kullehu kerav nachman la amri ki kushyan kerabba name la amri hachana let lehu
Ella rav yosef may tama la amar kerabbi yitzchak amar lach betza uchla uferot uchla leappoke mashkin delav uchla
Verabbi yitzchak may tama la amar kerav yosef amar lach betza belua umashkin beluin leappoke perot demiggallu vekayemu
Veaf rabbi yochanan savar gezera mishshum mashkin shezzavu derabbi yochanan rame derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda umshanne
Tenan en sochatin et happerot lehotzi mehen mashkin veim yatzu meatzman asurin rabbi yehuda omer im laochalin hayyotze mehen muttar veim lemashkin hayyotze mehen asur
Alma kal ochalin lerabbi yehuda uchla deipperat hu
Urminhu veod amar rabbi yehuda matne adam al kalkala shel perot beom tov rishon
Veochlah bashsheni vechen betza shennolda barishon teachel bashsheni
Bashsheni in barishon la umshanne rabbi yochanan muchlefet hashshita
Umiddeka marme lehu ahadade shema minah chad tama hu
b: Ravina amar leolam la tefoch verabbi yehuda ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu
Ledidi afilu barishon name sharya deuchla deipperat hu ella ledidchu odo li mihat devashsheni sharya dishte kedushshot hen veamri leh rabbanan la kedushsha achat hi
Ravina bereh derav ulla amar hacha betarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim verabbi yehuda letameh deit leh muktze
Metivi echad betza shennolda beshabbat veechad betza shennolda beom tov en metaltelin otah lo lechassot bah et hakkeli velo lismoch bah kare hammitta
Aval kofe aleha et hakkeli bishvil shello tishshaver usfeka asura veim nitarva beelef kullan asurot
Bishlama lerabba deamar mishshum hachana have sefeka deorayeta vechol sefeka deorayeta lechumra
Ella lerav yosef ulrabbi yitzchak deamri mishshum gezera sefeka derabbanan hi vechol sefeka derabbanan lekulla
Amar leh sefa atan lisfek terefa
I hachi ema sefa nitarva beelef kullan asurot i amratte bishlama safek yom tov safek chol have davar sheyyesh lo mattirin vechol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin afilu beelef lo batel
Ella i amratte sefek terefa davar sheen lo mattirin hi vetivtal berubba
Vechi tema betza chashuva velo batla hanicha leman deamar kol sheddarko limanot shaninu
Ella leman deamar et sheddarko limanot shaninu may ika lememar
Ditnan mi shehau lo chavile tiltan shel kile hakkerem yidleku nitarvu baacherot vaacherot baacherot kullan yiddalku divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim yaalu beachat umatayim

Shehaya rabbi meir omer et sheddarko limmanot mekaddesh vachachamim omrim eno mekaddesh ella shishsha devarim bilvad rabbi akiva omer shiva veellu hen egoze perech verimmone badan vechaviyyot setumot vechilfe teradin vekilche cheruv vedallaat yevanit rabbi akiva mosif af kikkarot shel baal habbayit
Harauy leorla orla harauy lechile hakkerem kile hakkerem veittemar alah rabbi yochanan amar et sheddarko limmanot shaninu verabbi shimon ben lakish amar kol sheddarko limmanot shaninu
Hanicha lerabbi shimon ben lakish ella lerabbi yochanan may ika lememar
Amar rav pappa hay tanna tanna delitra ketziot hu deamar kol davar shebbeminyan afilu bidrabbanan lo batel vechol shekken bidorayeta

Ditnan litra ketziot shedderasah al pi iggul veeno yodea beeze iggul derasah al pi chavit veeno yodea beezo chavit derasah al pi kaveret veeno yodea beezo kaveret derasah rabbi meir omer rabbi eliezer

a: Omer roin et haelonot kaellu hen perudot vehattachtonot maalot et haelonot
Rabbi yehoshua omer im yesh sham mea pummin yaalu veim lav happummin asurin vehashshulayim muttarin
Rabbi yehuda omer rabbi eliezer omer im yesh sham mea pummin yaalu veim lav happummin asurin vehashshulayim muttarin rabbi yehoshua omer afilu yesh sham shelosh meot pummin lo yaalu
Derasah beiggul veeno yodea beeze iggul derasah divre hakkol yaalu divre hakkol hayenu pelugtayehu
Amar rav pappa hachi kaamar derasah beiggul veeno yodea beeze mekom iggul derasah i litzfonah i lidromah divre hakkol yaalu
Rav ashe amar leolam safek yom tov safek chol have davar sheyyesh lo mattirin vechol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin afilu bidrabbanan lo batel

Tanya acherim omrim mishshum rabbi eliezer betza teachel hi veimmah bemay askinan ilema betarnegolet haomedet laachila peshita dehi veimmah sharya ella betarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim hi veimmah asura amar rabbi zera teachel aggav immah
Hechi dame amar abbaye kegon shellekachah setam nishchata huvrera delaachila omedet lo nishchata huvrera dilgaddel betzim omedet
Rav mari amar guzma katane detanya acherim omrim mishshum rabbi eliezer betza teachel hi veimmah veefroach uklipato

May kelipato ilema kelipa mammash kelipa bat achila hi ella efroach biklipato ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ben yaakov ella hecha deyatza laavir haolam aval hecha delo yatza laavir haolam la peligi
Ella efroach uklipato guzma hacha name teachel hi veimmah guzma
Ittemar shabbat veom tov rav amar nolda baze asura baze verabbi yochanan amar nolda baze mutteret baze nema kasavar rav kedushsha achat hi
Vehaamar rav halacha kearbaa zekenim vealliba derabbi eliezer deamar shette kedushshot hen
Ella hacha bahachana derabbah kamipalgi rav it leh hachana derabba verabbi yochanan let leh hachana derabba
Ketannae nolda beshabbat teachel beom tov beom tov teachel beshabbat rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer adayin hi machaloket shebbet shammay omrim teachel uvet hillel omrim lo teachel
Ushpizkaneh derav adda bar ahava hao leh hanach betzim miyyom tov leshabbat ata lekammeh amar leh may leatoyinhu haidana venechlinhu limchar
Amar leh may datach rav verabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yochanan afilu rabbi yochanan la ka share ella legomah lemachar aval beomeh la
Vehatanya achat betza shennolda beshabbat veachat betza shennolda beom tov en metaltelin otah lo lechassot bah et hakkeli velo lismoch bah kare hammitta

Ushpizkaneh derav pappa veamri lah hahu gavra daata lekammeh derav pappa hao leh hanach betzim mishshabbat leom tov ata lekammeh amar leh mahu lemechlinhu limchar amar leh zil haidana uta limchar derav la moke amora illaveh miyyoma tava lechavreh mishshum shichrut
Ki ata limchar amar leh
b: Echu hashta ishtelay vaamari lecha rav verabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yochanan ha amar rava hilcheta kevateh derav behane telat ben lekulla ben lechumra

Amar rabbi yochanan etzim shennashru min haddekel beshabbat asur lehassikan beom tov veal teshiveni betza may tama betza mishshum divoma name chazya legomah vela ka share lah ad limchar mida yedia devat yoma asruha etzim dela chazu leomayehu i share lehu limchar ate lememar beomayehu name sheru veetmol mishshum shabbat hu dela chazu lehassaka

Amar rav matna etzim shennashru min haddekel letoch hattannur beom tov marbe alehem etzim muchanim umassikan veha ka mehappech beisura kevan derubba dehetera ninhu ki ka mehappech behetera ka mehappech
Veha ka mevattel isura lechattechilla utnan en mevattelin asur lechattechilla hane mile bidorayeta aval bidrabbanan mevattelin
Ulrav ashe deamar kol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin afilu bidrabbanan lo batel may ika lememar hane mile hecha deiteh leisura beeneh hacha mikla kali isura
Ittemar shene yamim tovim shel galiyyot rav amar nolda baze mutteret baze verav assi amar nolda baze asura baze
Lema ka savar rav assi kedushsha achat hi veha rav assi mavdel miyyoma tava lechavreh
Rav assi sappoke mesappeka leh veaved hacha lechumra vehacha lechumra
Amar rabbi zera kevateh derav assi mistabbera dehaidana yadinan bikvia deyarcha veka avdinan tere yome
Amar abbaye kevateh derav mistabbera ditnan barishona hau massiin massuot mishshekkilkelu hakkutim hitkinu sheyehu sheluchin yotzin
Veilu batlu kutim avdinan chad yoma vehecha dematu sheluchin avdinan chad yoma
Vehashta deyadinan bikvia deyarcha may tama avdinan tere yome mishshum dishlachu mittam hizzaharu beminhag avotechem bidechem zimnin degazru hammalchut gezera veate leikkalkule
Ittemar shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu nolda baze asura baze ditnan barishona hau mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom kullo paam achat nishtahu haedim lavo

a: Venitkalkelu halviyyim bashshir hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelim et haedim ella ad hammincha
Veim bau edim min hammincha ulmala nohagin oto hayyom kodesh ulmachar kodesh
Amar rabba mittakkanat rabban yochanan ben zakkay veelach betza mutteret ditnan mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyehu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom
Amar leh abbaye veha rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu betza asura amar leh amena lach ana rabban yochanan ben zakkay veatte amratte li rav ushmuel
Ulrav ushmuel kashya matnitin la kashya ha lan veha lehu
Verav yosef amar af mittakkanat rabban yochanan ben zakkay veelach betza asura may tama have davar shebbeminyan vechol davar shebbeminyan tzarich minyan acher lehattiro
Amar rav yosef mena amena lah dichtiv lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem veomer bimshoch hayyovel hemma yaalu vahar
Vetanya kerem revai haya ole lirushalayim mahalach yom echad lechol tzad vezo hi techumah elat min hatztzafon veakrabbat min haddarom lod min hammaarav veyarden min hammizrach
Veamar ulla veitema rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan ma taam kede leatter shuke yerushalayim beferot
Vetanya kerem revai haya lo lerabbi eliezer bemizrach lod betzad kefar tavi
b: Uvikkesh lehafkiro laaniyyim amru lo talmidav rabbi kevar nimnu alecha chaverecha vehittiruhu man chaverecha rabban yochanan ben zakkay
Tama denimnu ha la nimnu lo

May veomer hachi kaamar mikkede ketiv heu nechonim lishloshet yamim al tiggeshu el ishsha lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem lema li shema minah kol davar shebbeminyan tzarich minyan acher lehattiro
Vechi tema lemitzvat ona hu daata ta shema bimshoch hayyovel hemma yaalu vahar
Mikkede ketiv gam hatztzon vehabbakar al yiru el mul hahar hahu bimshoch hayovel lema li shema minah davar shebbeminyan tzarich minyan acher lehattiro
Vechi tema hane mile bidorayeta aval bidrabbanan la ta shema kerem revai veha kerem revai derabbanan vekaamri leh kevar nimnu alecha chaverecha vehittiruhu
Vechi tema betza name immeno alah rabban yochanan ben zakkay vesharuha ki immeno aedut abbetza la immeno
Amar leh abbaye attu betza beminyan mi havay betza beedut talya milleta ittesar edut ittesar betza ishteray edut ishteray betza

Rav adda verav shalman tarvayehu mibbe chelochit amri af mittakkanat rabban yochanan ben zakkay veelach betza asura may tama mehera yibbane bet hammikdash veyomru eshtakad mi lo achalnu betza beom tov sheni hashta name nechol vela yadi deeshtakad shette kedushshot hen vehashta kedushsha achat hi
I hachi edut name lo nekabbel may tama mehera yibbane bet hammikdash veyomru eshtakad mi lo kibbalnu edut hachodesh kol hayyom kullo hashta name nekabbel
Hachi hashta hatam edut mesura levet din betza lakkol mesura
Rava amar af mittakkanat rabban yochanan ben zakkay veelach betza asura mi lo mode rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheim bau edim min hammincha ulmala shennohagin oto hayyom kodesh ulmachar kodesh
Veamar rava hilcheta kevateh derav behane telat ben lekulla ben lechumra

a: Amar rava met beom tov rishon yitasseku bo amamim met beom tov sheni yitasseku bo yisrael vaafilu bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana ma sheen ken bevetza
Nehardae amri af bevetza dema datach dilma meabberi leh leelul ha amar rav chinana bar kahana amar rav mimot ezra veelach lo matzinu elul meubbar
Amar mar zutra la amaran ella deishtahi aval la ishtahi mashhinan leh
Rav ashe amar af al gav dela ishtahi name la mashhinan leh may tama yom tov sheni legabbe met kechol shavveuh rabbanan afilu lemegaz leh gelima ulmegaz leh asa
Amar ravina vehaidana deika chabbare chayeshinan
Ravina hava yatev kammeh derav assi bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana chazyeh dahava atziv amar leh ammay atziv mar amar leh dela otivi eruve tavshilin
Amar leh velotev mar haidana mi la amar rava manniach adam eruve tavshilin miyyom tov lachavero umatne
Amar leh emar deamar rava bishne yamim tovim shel galiyyot bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana mi amar
Veha amri nehardae af betza mutteret amar leh rav mardochay beferush amar li mar dela savar leha dinhardae
Ittemar efroach shennolad beom tov rav amar asur ushmuel veitema rabbi yochanan amar muttar rav amar asur muktze hu ushmuel veitema rabbi yochanan amar muttar hoil umattir atzmo bishchita
Amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav vechi ma ben ze leegel shennolad beom tov amar lehu hoil umuchan aggav immo bishchita
Uma ben ze leegel shennolad min hatterefa shetek rav
Amar rabba veitema rav yosef may tama shetek rav lema lehu hoil umuchan aggav immo lichlavim
Amar leh abbaye
b: Hashta muchan leadam la have muchan lichlavim ditnan mechattechin et haddilluin lifne habbehema veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim rabbi yehuda omer im lo hayeta nevela meerev shabbat asura lefi sheenah min hammuchan muchan lichlavim have muchan leadam
Amar leh in muchan leadam la have muchan lichlavim demay dachaze leh leinish la shade leh lichlavim muchan lichlavim have muchan leadam dedateh deinish akkol mide dachaze leh
Tanya kevateh derav tanya kevateh dishmuel veitema rabbi yochanan
Tanya kevateh derav egel shennolad beom tov muttar efroach shennolad beom tov asur uma hefresh ben ze laze ze muchan aggav immo bishchita veze eno muchan aggav immo
Tanya kevateh dishmuel veitema rabbi yochanan egel shennolad beom tov muttar veefroach shennolad beom tov muttar may tama ze muchan aggav immo veze mattir atzmo bishchita
Tanu rabbanan efroach shennolad beom tov asur rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer af bachol asur lefi shello nitpattechu enav
Keman azla ha detanya lechol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz lerabbot efrochim shello nitpattechu enehem keman kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov

Amar rav huna amar rav betza im yetziatah nigmera may im yetziatah nigmera ilema im yetziatah nigmera umutteret leochla bechalav ha bime immah asura leochla bechalav vehatanya hashshochet et hattarnegolet umatza bah betzim gemurot muttarot leachlan bechalav
Ella im yetziatah nigmera umutteret leochlah beom tov ha bime immah asura leochla beom tov veha tanya hashshochet et hattarnegolet umatza bah betzim gemurot muttarot leachlan beom tov

Vechi tema ka mashma lan bevarayeta may dela ashmeinan bematnitin ha name tenena betza shennolda beom tov bet shammay omrim teachel uvet hillel omrim lo teachel vead kan la peligi bet shammay uvet hillel ella benolda aval bime imman divre hakkol sharyan

Vechi tema bet hillel afilu bime imman name asri vehay dekatane nolda lehodiacha kochan devet shammay daafilu nolda name sharu ella ha detanya hashshochet et hattarnegolet umatza bah betzim gemurot muttarot leachlan beom tov manni la bet shammay vela bet hillel
Ella im yetziatah nigmera umgaddelet efrochim bime immah enah megaddelet efrochim lemay nafka minah lemikkach umimkar ki hahu daamar lehu bee

a: Defachaya leman yehavu leh bee dishchuta ata lekammeh derabbi amme amar lehu mikkach taut hu vehadar
Peshita mahu detema hay laachila ka bae lehu vehay dekaamar defachaya mishshum ditzrivan lemay nafka minah lemitva leh bene bene ka mashma lan
Hahu daamar lehu bee dedichra leman bee dedichra leman yehavu leh bee desafna meara ata lekammeh derabbi amme amar lehu mikkach taut hu vahadar
Peshita mahu detema hay laachila ka bae lehu vehay dekaamar dedichra mishshum deshamminan tefe lemay nafka minah lemitva leh bene bene ka mashma lan
Vei baet ema may im yetziatah nigmera im yetziat rubbah nigmera vechidrabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan betza sheyyatza rubbah meerev yom tov vechazra mutteret leochla beom tov
Veika deamar may im yetziatah nigmera im yetziat kullah nigmera im yetziat kullah in aval rubbah la ulappoke midderabbi yochanan
Gufa hashshochet et hattarnegolet umatza bah betzim gemurot muttarot leachlan bechalav rabbi yaakov omer im hau meorot begidin asurot
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan haochel minnivlat of tahor min hashshelal shel betzim min haatzamot umin haggidin umin habbasar shennitlash min hachay tahor
Min haeshkol shel betzim min hakkurkevan uvne meayin o shehimcha et hachelev ugmao tame
Man tanna min hashshelal shel betzim tahor amar rav yosef dela kerabbi yaakov dei kerabbi yaakov haamar im hau meorot begidin asurot
Amar leh abbaye mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yaakov hatam ella leinyan issura aval leinyan tuma la
Vechi tema leinyan tuma name nigzor apposhe tuma hu veapposhe tuma midderabbanan la mappeshinan
Veika deamri man tanna min haeshkol shel betzim tame amar rav yosef rabbi yaakov hi deamar im hau meorot begidin asurot amar leh abbaye mimmay deeshkol mehanach detalya beeshkol dilma eshkol gufeh

Vechi tema eshkol gufeh may lememra mide dehave akkurkevan uvne meayin deaf al gav devasar ninhu kevan deika inashe dela achli itzterich leashmoinan hacha name kevan deika inashe dela achli itzterich leashmoinan

Tanu rabbanan kol shettashmisho bayyom nolad bayyom kol shettashmisho ballayela nolad ballayela kol shettashmisho ben bayyom uven ballayela nolad ben bayyom uven ballayela kol shettashmisho bayyom nolad bayyom zo tarnegolet kol shettashmisho ballayela nolad ballayela zo atallef kol shettashmisho ben bayyom uven ballayela adam vechol dedame leh

Amar mar kol shettashmisho bayyom nolad bayyom zo tarnegolet lemay nafka minah lechidrav mari bereh derav kahana deamar rav mari bereh derav kahana badak bekinna shel tarnegolin meerev yom tov velo matza bah betza ulmachar hishkim umatza vah betza mutteret
Vahalo badak emar lo badak yafe yafe vaafilu badak yafe emar yatzta rubbah vechazra havay vechidrabbi yochanan
Ini veha amar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rav badak bekinna shel tarnegolet meerev yom tov velo matza bah betza ulmachar hishkim umatza vah betza asura hatam bidsafna meara
I hachi derav mari name ema meara safna bidika zachar bahadah bidika zachar name ema meara safna amar ravina gemiri kol hecha deika zachar la safna meara
Vead kamma amar rav gammada mishshemeh derav kol hecha
b: Deshama kaleh bimama
Avad rav mari ovada ad shittin batte
Vei ika nahara la avra vei ika mabbara avra vei ika mitzra la avra hava ovada veavra ammitzra
Bemay okemta bidsafna meara may irya badak ki la badak name
Ki la badak ema meetmol havay i hachi ki badak name ema yatzta rubbah vechazra hi vechidrabbi yochanan derabbi yochanan la shechiach
Veamar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rav hay tuma shechika sakkanta legilluya
Bet shammay omrim seor bechazzayit

May tamayehu devet shammay im ken lichtov rachamana chametz vela bae seor vaana amena uma chametz sheen chimmutzo kashe bichzayit seor shechimmutzo kashe lo kol shekken seor dichtav rachamana lema li lomar lecha shiuro shel ze lo keshiuro shel ze
Uvet hillel tzerichi dei ketav rachamana seor hava amena mishshum dechimmutzo kashe aval chametz deen chimmutzo kashe ema la tzericha
Vei ketav rachamana chametz mishshum derauy laachila aval seor sheen rauy laachila ema la tzericha
Uvet shammay let lehu derabbi zera deamar rabbi zera petach hakkatuv bisor vesiyyem bechametz lomar lecha zehu seor zehu chametz
Leinyan achila kulle alma la feligi ki peligi leinyan biur bet shammay savri la yalfinan biur meachila uvet hillel savri yalfinan biur meachila
Ittemar name amar rabbi yose bar chanina machloket leinyan biur aval leinyan achila divre hakkol ze veze bichzayit

Hichnis afar leginnato ulchurbato muttar lechassot bo veamar rav yehuda machnis adam melo kuppato afar veose bah kol tzarko

Ultamach lechasseyeh baefer kira o bedakar nautz ella delet leh hacha name delet leh
I hachi may irya safek afilu vadday name la
La mibbaya kaamar la mibbaya vadday dela lishchot aval safek ema mishshum simchat yom tov lishchot vela lechasseyeh ka mashma lan
b: Veha middekatane sefa veim shechato en mechassin et damo mikkelal deresha bidit leh askinan

Lesafek may tama la deka aved gumma vadday name ka aved gumma ella kidrabbi abba hacha name kidrabbi abba
Ella safek may tama dilma aved ketisha vadday name nigzor mishshum ketisha vadday ki ka aved ketisha ate ase vedache et lo taase
Emar deamrinan ate ase vedache et lo taase kegon mila betzaraat i name sadin betzitzit
Dividana deka miakar lav ka mokem laase hacha beidana deka miakar lav la mokem ase ha la kashya devahade dechatesh ka mikkasse

Uvet hillel savri la gazrinan aval bivricha sheniyya divre hakkol beomed veomer ze vaze ani notel saggi

Bet shammay omrim vehu shechishshev lehotzio ad shello yamut hammet uvet hillel omrim af mishsheyyamut hammet
Ha ittemar alah amar rabba letaher et happetachim mikkan ulhabba vechen amar rabbi oshaya letaher et happetachim mikkan ulhabba mikkan ulhabba in lemafrea la
