Vechach hau bet shammay danin challa umattanot mattana lakkohen utruma mattana lakkohen keshem sheen molichin et hatteruma kach en molichin et hammattanot amru lahem bet hillel lo im amartem bitruma sheeno zakkay baharamatah tomru bemattanot shezzakkay baharamatan

Amar rabbi yose lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hammattanot shemmolichin lo nechleku ella al hatteruma shebbet shammay omrim en molichin uvet hillel omrim molichin vechach hau bet hillel danin challa umattanot mattana lakkohen utruma mattana lakkohen keshem shemmolichin et hammattanot kach molichin et hatteruma amru lahem bet shammay lo im amartem bemattanot shezzakkay baharamatan tomru bitruma sheen zakkay baharamatah

Acherim omrim lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hatteruma sheen molichin lo nechleku ella al hammattanot shebbet shammay omrim en molichin uvet hillel omrim molichin lema acherim hi vela rabbi yehuda
Amar rava mi katane shehurmu mehayyom veshennishchatu mehayyom shehurmu katane ulolam shechitatan meemesh lema rabbi yehuda hi velo acherim afilu tema acherim uvhanach denishchatu meemesh
I hachi hayenu rabbi yehuda ika benayehu tefela

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose rav tovi bereh derav nechemya hava leh garba dechamra ditruma ata lekammeh derav yosef amar leh mahu leamtoye lechohen haidana amar leh hachi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose

Ushpizchaneh derava bar rav chanan hava leh issuryata dechardela amar leh mahu lefaroche umechal minnayehu beom tov la hava bideh ata lekammeh derava amar leh mollin melilot umfarchin kitniyyot beom tov
Etiveh abbaye hammolel melilot meerev shabbat lemachar menappeach miyyad leyad veochel aval lo bakkanon velo battamchuy
Hammolel melilot meerev yom tov lemachar menappeach al yad al yad veochel afilu bakkanon vaafilu battamchuy aval lo battavla velo bannafa velo bakkevara meerev yom tov in beom tov la
Afilu tema beom tov veayede ditna resha meerev shabbat tena sefa name meerev yom tov
Im ken matzinu teruma shezzakkay baharamatah utnan lo im amartem bitruma sheeno zakkay baharamatah vechu
La kashya

a: Ha rabbi ha rabbi yose berabbi yehuda detanya hichnis shibbolin laasot mehen isa ochel mehen aray ufatur
Lemollan bimlilot rabbi mechayyev verabbi yose berabbi yehuda poter
Ulrabbi yose berabbi yehuda name mashkachatte lah kegon shehichnis shibbolin laasot mehen isa venimlach alehen lemollan beom tov detavla beomeh
Ella may teruma rov teruma
Amar abbaye machloket beshibbolin aval bekitniyyot divre hakkol issuryata tavla

Lema mesayya leh mi shehau lo chavile tiltan shel tevel hare ze kotesh umchashshev kamma zera yesh bahem umafrish al hazzera veeno mafrish al haetz may lav rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi deamar hatam la tavla hacha tavla
La rabbi hi i rabbi hi may irya tiltan afilu shibbolin name
Ella may rabbi yose berabbi yehuda lashmeinan shear mine kitniyyot vechol shekken tiltan
Ella tiltan itztericha leh salka datach amena hoil vetaam etzo ufiro shave lifrosh name aetzo ka mashma lan

Ika deamri amar abbaye machloket beshibbolin aval bekitniyyot divre hakkol issuryata la tavla metivi mi shehau lo chavile tiltan shel tevel hare ze kotesh umchashshev kamma zera yesh bahen umafrish al hazzera veeno mafrish al haetz may lav tevel tavul shel teruma
La tevel tavul shel terumat maaser
Vechidrabbi avahu amar rabbi shimon ben lakish deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi shimon ben lakish maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibbolin
Shemo tovlo litrumat maaser
Kotesh lema li lema leh ki hechi dihavu li hachi yahevna lach amar rava kenasa

Tanya name hachi ben levi shennatnu lo shibbolin bemaasrotav ose otan goren anavim ose otan yayin zetim ose otan shemen umafrish alehem terumat maaser venotnan lakkohen shekkeshem shetteruma gedola enah nitelet
b: Ella min haggoren umin hayyekev kach terumat maaser enah nitelet ella min haggoren umin hayyekev
Mechashshev ha medida bae

Ha manni abba elazar ben gimel hi detanya abba elazar ben gimel omer venechshav lachem terumatchem bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber achat teruma gedola veachat terumat maaser keshem shetteruma gedola nitelet beomed uvmachshava kach terumat maaser nitelet beomed uvmachshava
Gufa amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi shimon ben lakish maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibbolin shemo tovlo litrumat maaser may tama amar rava hoil veyatza alav shem maaser
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibbolin patur mitteruma gedola
Shenneemar vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai maaser min hammaaser maaser min hammaaser amarti lecha velo teruma gedola utrumat maaser min hammaaser
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye i hachi afilu hikdimo bichri name amar leh alecha amar kera mikkol maserotechem tarimu et kol terumat Adonai
Uma raita hay iddegan vehay la iddegan
Tenan hatam hamkallef seorin mekallef achat achat veochel veim killef venatan letoch yado chayyav amar rabbi elazar vechen leshabbat

Ini veha rav mekallefa leh devethu kase kase verabbi chiyya mekallefa leh devethu kase kase ella i ittemar assefa ittemar hammolel melilot shel chittim menappeach al yad al yad veochel veim nippach venatan letoch cheko chayyav amar rabbi elazar vechen leshabbat
Matkef lah rabbi abba bar memel veresha lemaaser in leshabbat la umi ika mide dilinyan shabbat la have gemar melacha ulmaaser have gemar melacha

Matkef lah rav sheshet bereh derav idi vela veha gornan lemaaser ditnan ezehu gornan lemaaser hakkishshuin vehaddilluin mishsheyefakkesu veshello pikkesu mishsheyyaamid arema utnan name gabbe vetzalim mishsheyyaamid arema veellu gabbe shabbat haamadat arema patur
Ella may it lach lememar melechet machshevet asra tora hacha name melechet machshevet asra tora
Ketzad molel abbaye mishshemeh derav yosef amar chada achada verav aveya mishshemeh derav yosef amar chada attarte rava amar kevan dimshanne afilu chada akkullehu name
Ketzad menappeach amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav menappeach

a: Mikkishre etzbeotav ulmala
Machachu alah bemareva kevan dimshanne afilu bechullah yeda name ella amar rabbi elazar menappeach beyado achat uvchal kocho
Matni bet shammay omrim tavlin niddochin bemadoch shel etz vehammelach befach uvetz happarur uvet hillel omrim tavlin niddochin kedarkan bemadoch shel even vehammelach bemadoch shel etz
Gema dechulle alma mihat melach baaya shinnuy may tama rav huna verav chisda chad amar kol hakkederot kullan tzerichot melach veen kol hakkederot tzerichot tavlin
Vechad amar kol hattavlin mefigin taman umelach enah mefiga tamah
May benayehu ika benayehu deyada may kedera bae levashshole i name bemorika

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol hanniddochin niddochin kedarkan vaafilu melach veha amratte melach baaya shinnuy hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya amar rabbi meir lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hanniddochin shenniddochin kedarkan umelach immahen
Lo nechleku ella leduchah bifne atzmah shebbet shammay omrim melach befach uvetz happarur letzali aval lo likdera uvet hillel omrim bechol davar bechol davar salka datach ella ema lechol davar
Amar leh rav acha bardela livreh ki dayechat atzli atzloye veduch rav sheshet shema kal buchna amar hay lav miggaveyh devetay hu
Vedilma atzloye atzli deshameh dahava tzelil kaleh vedilma tavlin hao tavlin nabboche menabbach kalayehu
Tanu rabbanan en osin tisni veen kotshin bemachteshet tarte hachi kaamar ma taam en osin tisni lefi sheen kotshin bemachteshet
Velema en kotshin bemachteshet i tane en kotshin bemachteshet hava amena hane mile bemachteshet gedola aval bemachteshet ketanna ema shappir dame ka mashma lan
Vehatanya en kotshin bemachteshet gedola aval kotshin bemachteshet ketanna amar abbaye ki tanya name matnita machteshet gedola tanya
b: Rava amar la kashya ha lan veha lehu
Rav pappe ikkela leve mar shemuel ayeti leh dayesa vela achal vedilma bemachteshet ketanna avduh dechazyeh dahava deyik tefe
Vedilma meetmol avduh dechazyeh dahava kelif tzahareh vei baet ema shane be mar shemuel deika peritzuta deavde

Matni habborer kitniyyot beom tov bet shammay omrim borer ochel veochel uvet hillel omrim borer kedarko becheko bakkanon uvattamchuy aval lo battavla velo bannafa velo bakkevara rabban gamliel omer af mediach veshole
Gema tanya amar rabban gamliel bamme devarim amurim keshehaochel merubbe al happesolet aval pesolet merubba al haochel divre hakkol notel et haochel umanniach et happesolet
Pesolet merubba al haochel mi ika man deshare la tzericha dinfish betircha vezutar beshiura

Rabban gamliel omer af mediach veshole tanya amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok kach haya minhagan shel bet rabban gamliel shehau meviin deli male adashim umtzifin alav mayim venimtza ochel lematta ufsolet lemala
Vehatanya ipcha la kashya ha beafra ha begile

Matni bet shammay omrim en meshallechin beom tov ella manot uvet hillel omrim meshallechin behema chayya vaof ben chayyin ben shechutin meshallechin yenot shemanim uslatot vekitniyyot aval lo tevua verabbi shimon mattir bitvua
Gema tane rav yechiel uvilvad shello yaasennu beshura tana en shura pechuta mishshelosha bene adam bae rav ashe telata gavre utlata mine may teku
Rabbi shimon mattir bitvua tanya rabbi shimon mattir bitvua kegon chittin laasot mehen ludiyyot seorim liten lifne behemto adashim laasot mehen resisin

Matni meshallechin kelim ben tefurin ben sheenan tefurin veaf al pi sheyyesh bahen kilayim vehen letzorech hammoed aval lo sandal hamsummar velo minal sheeno tafur rabbi yehuda omer af lo minal lavan mippene shetztzarich umman ze hakkelal kol shenneotin bo beom tov meshallechin oto
Gema bishlama tefurin chazu lemalbush sheen tefurin name chazu lechassoye ella kilayim lemay chazu
Vechi tema chazu lememach tuteh vehatanya lo yaale alecha aval atta yachol lehatztzio tachtecha aval amru chachamim asur laasot ken shemma tikkarech lo nima al besaro

Vechi tema demafsek mide bene bene vehaamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rabbi mishshum kehala kaddisha devirushalayim afilu eser matztzaot zo al gabbe zo vechilayim tachtehen asur lishan alehem mishshum shenneemar lo yaale alecha
Ella bevilon vehaamar ulla mippene ma amru vilon tame mippene shehashshammash mitchammem kenegdo

a: Ella bekashin vechi ha deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hay namta gamda denaresh sharya

Amar rav pappa ardalin en bahen mishshum kilayim amar rava hane tzerare difshite en bahem mishshum kilayim devizrane yesh bahen mishshum kilayim rav ashe amar echad ze veechad ze en bahen mishshum kilayim lefi sheen derech chimmum bechach
Aval lo sandal hamsummar sandal hamsummar may tama la mishshum maase shehaya

Amar abbaye sandal hamsummar asur lenoolo umuttar letaltelo asur lenoolo mishshum maase shehaya umuttar letaltelo middekatane en meshallechin dei salka datach asur letaltelo hashta letaltole asur meshallechin mibbaya
Velo minal sheeno tafur peshita lo nitzrecha deaf al gav denaket besike
Rabbi yehuda omer af lo minal lavan tanya rabbi yehuda mattir beshachor veoser belavan mippene shetztzarich betzat haggir rabbi yose oser bashshachor mippene shetztzarich letzachtzecho
Vela peligi mar ki atreh umar ki atreh beatreh demar bisra letachat beatreh demar bisra leel

Ze hakkelal kol shenneotin bo beom tov rav sheshet shera lehu lerabbanan leshaddore tefillin beoma tava amar leh abbaye veha anan tenan kol shenneotin bo beom tov meshallechin oto hachi kaamar kol shenneotin bo bechol meshallechin oto beom tov

Amar abbaye tefillin hoil vaato leyadan nema behu milta haya ba badderech utfillin berosho veshaka alav chamma manniach yado alehem ad shemmaggia leveto haya yoshev bevet hammidrash utfillin berosho vekiddesh alav hayyom manniach yado alehen ad shemmaggia leveto

Metiv rav huna bereh derav ika haya ba badderech utfillin berosho vekiddesh alav hayyom manniach yado alehen ad shemmaggia levet hassamuch lachoma haya yoshev bevet hammidrash vekiddesh alav hayyom manniach yado alehen ad shemmaggia labbayit hassamuch levet hammidrash
La kashya ha deminnatra ha dela minnatra
I dela minnatra may irya berosho afilu machatan beara name deha tenan hammotze tefillin machnisan zug zug
La kashya ha deminnatra mechamat gannave umechamat kalve ha deminnatra mechamat kalve vela minnatra mechamat gannave
Mahu detema rov listim yisrael ninhu vela mezalzeli behu ka mashma lan
Hadaran alach betza
b: Yom tov shechal lihot erev shabbat lo yevashshel battechilla miyyom tov leshabbat aval mevashshel hu leom tov veim hotir hotir lashshabbat veose tavshil meerev yom tov vesomech alav lashshabbat
Bet shammay omrim shene tavshilin vvet hillel omrim tavshil echad veshavin bedag uvetza shealav shehen shene tavshilin
Achalo o sheavad lo yevashshel alav battechilla veim shiyyer mimmennu kol shehu somech alav lashshabbat
Gema mena hane mile amar shemuel deamar kera zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho zochrehu meacher shebba lehashkicho
May tama amar rava keday sheyyivror mana yafa lashshabbat umana yafa leom tov
Rav ashe amar kede sheyyomru en ofin miyyom tov lashshabbat kal vachomer miyyom tov lechol

Tenan ose tavshil meerev yom tov vesomech alav lashshabbat bishlama lerav ashe deamar kede sheyyomru en ofin miyyom tov lashshabbat hayenu demeerev yom tov in beom tov la ella lerava may irya meerev yom tov afilu beom tov name
In hachi name ella gezera shemma yifsha

Vetanna mayete lah mehacha et asher tofu efu veet asher tevashshelu bashshelu mikkan amar rabbi eliezer en ofin ella al haafuy veen mevashshelin ella al hamvushshal mikkan samchu chachamim leeruve tavshilin min hattora

Tanu rabbanan maase berabbi eliezer shehaya yoshev vedoresh kol hayyom kullo behilchot yom tov yatzta kat rishona amar hallalu baale fittasin kat sheniyya amar hallalu baale chaviyyot kat shelishit amar hallalu baale chaddin
Kat reviit amar hallalu baale leginin kat chamishit amar hallalu baale chosot hitchilu kat shishshit latzet amar hallalu baale meera
Natan enav battalmidim hitchilu penehem mishtannin amar lahem banay lo lachem ani omer ella lehallalu sheyyatzu shemmannichim chayye olam veoskim bechayye shaa
Bishat petiratan amar lahem lechu ichlu mashmannim ushtu mamtakkim veshilchu manot leen nachon lo ki kadosh hayyom laadonenu veal teatzevu ki chedvat Adonai hi mauzzechem
Amar mar shemmannichin chayye olam veoskin bechayye shaa veha simchat yom tov mitzva hi rabbi eliezer letameh deamar simchat yom tov reshut
Detanya rabbi eliezer omer en lo laadam beom tov ella o ochel veshote o yoshev veshone rabbi yehoshua omer challekehu chetzo la vechetzo lachem

Amar rabbi yochanan ushnehem mikra echad darshu katuv echad omer atzeret la elohecha vechatuv echad omer atzeret tihye lachem ha ketzad rabbi eliezer savar o kullo la o kullo lachem verabbi yehoshua savar challekehu chetzo la vechetzo lachem
May leen nachon lo amar rav chisda lemi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin ika deamri mi shello haya lo lehanniach eruve tavshilin aval mi shehaya lo lehanniach eruve tavshilin velo hinniach poshea hu

May ki chedvat Adonai hi mauzzechem amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael banay leu alay vekaddeshu kedushshat hayyom vehaaminu bi vaani porea
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon harotze sheyyitkayemu nechasav yitta bahen eder shenneemar addir bammarom Adonai
I name adra kishmeh kidamri inashe may adra dekayema ledare dare tanya name hachi sade sheyyesh bah eder enah nigzelet veenah nechmeset uferoteha mishtammerin
Tane rav tachlifa achuh deravnay chozaa

a: Kol mezonotav shel adam ketzuvim lo merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim chutz mehotzaat shabbatot vehotzaat yom tov vehotzaat banav letalmud tora sheim pachat pochatin lo veim hosif mosifin lo
Amar rabbi avahu may keraa tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leom chaggenu ezehu chag shehachodesh mitkasse bo heve omer ze rosh hashshana uchtiv ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat lelohe yaakov
May mashma dehay chok lishana dimzone hu dichtiv veachlu et chukkam asher natan lahem paro mar zutra amar mehacha hatrifeni lechem chukki
Tanya amru alav al shammay hazzaken kol yamav haya ochel lichvod shabbat matza behema naa omer zo lashshabbat matza acheret naa hemenna manniach et hashsheniyya veochel et harishona

Aval hillel hazzaken midda acheret hayeta lo shekkol maasav leshem shamayim shenneemar baruch Adonai yom yom tanya name hachi bet shammay omrim mechad shabbach leshabbetach uvet hillel omrim baruch Adonai yom yom
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina hannoten mattana lachavero en tzarich lehodio shenneemar umoshe lo yada ki karan or panav

Metivi ladaat ki ani Adonai mekaddishchem amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe moshe mattana tova yesh li bevet genazay veshabbat shemah vaani mevakkesh litnah leyisrael lech vehodia otam mikkan amar rabban shimon ben gamliel hannoten pat letinok tzarich lehodia leimmo
La kashya ha bemattana daavida leiggalloye ha bemattana dela avida leiggalloye shabbat name mattana daavida leiggalloye mattan secharah la avida leiggalloye

Amar mar mikkan amar rabban shimon ben gamliel hannoten pat letinok tzarich lehodia leimmo may aved leh shayef leh mishcha umale leh kuchla vehaidana dechayeshinan lichshafim may amar rav pappa shayef leh meoto hammin

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay kol mitzot shennatan lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael natan lahem befarhesya chutz mishshabbat shennatan lahem betzina shenneemar beni uven bene yisrael ot hi leolam
I hachi la lianshu goyim alah shabbat odoe odinhu mattan secharah la odinhu vei baet ema mattan secharah name odinhu neshama yetera la odinhu
Deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish neshama yetera noten hakkadosh baruch hu baadam erev shabbat ulmotzae shabbat notlin otah hemennu shenneemar shavat vayyinnafash kevan sheshshavat vay avda nefesh
Ose adam tavshil meerev yom tov amar abbaye lo shanu ella tavshil aval pat la

May shena pat dela ilema mide dimlappet baenan ufat la melappeta veha dayesa name dela melappeta deamar rabbi zera hane bavlae tafshae deachli nahama benahama veamar rav nechumi bar zecharya mishshemeh deabbaye mearvin bedayesa ella mide dela shechiach baenan ufat shechicha vedayesa la shechicha

Ika deamri amar abbaye lo shanu ella tavshil aval pat la may tama ilema demide dela shechiach baenan ufat shechicha veha dayesa la shechicha veamar rav nechumi bar zecharya mishshemeh deabbaye en mearvin bedayesa ella mide dimlappet baenan ufat la melappeta vedayesa name la melappeta deamar rabbi zera hane bavlae tafshae deachli nahama benahama

Tane rabbi chiyya adashim shebbeshule kedera somech alehen mishshum eruve tavshilin vehane mile deit behu kezayit amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda shamnunit sheal gabbe hassakkin gorro vesomech alav mishshum eruve tavshilin vehane mile deit behu kezayit
Amar rav assi amar rav dagim ketannim meluchim en bahem mishshum bishshule goyim amar rav yosef veim tzelaan goy somech alehem mishshum eruve tavshilin vei avdinhu goy kasa deharsana asur
Peshita mahu detema
b: Harsana ikar ka mashma lan kimcha ikar

Amar rabbi abba eruve tavshilin tzerichin kezayit ibaya lehu kezayit echad lechullan o dilma kezayit lechol echad veechad ta shema deamar rabbi abba amar rav eruve tavshilin tzerichin kezayit ben leechad ben lemea
Tenan achalo o sheavad lo yevashshel alav battechilla shiyyer mimmennu kol shehu somech alav leshabbat may kol shehu lav af al gav deleka kezayit la deit beh kezayit

Ta shema tavshil ze tzali vaafilu kavush shaluk umvushshal vekolyas haispenin shennatan alav chammin meerev yom tov techillato vesofo en lo shiur may lav en lo shiur kelal la en lo shiur lemala aval yesh lo shiur lematta
Amar rav huna amar rav eruve tavshilin tzerichin daat peshita daat manniach baenan daat mi shehinnichu lo baenan o la baenan

Ta shema daavuh dishmuel mearev akkullah nehardea rabbi amme verabbi assi mearvi akkullah teverya machriz rabbi yaakov bar idi mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin yavo veyismoch al shelli vead kamma amar rav nechumi bar zecharya mishshemeh deabbaye ad techum shabbat

Hahu samya dahava mesaddar matneyata kammeh demar shemuel chazyeh dahava atziv amar leh ammay atzivatte amar leh dela otivi eruve tavshilin amar leh semoch addidi leshana chazyeh dahava atziv amar leh ammay atzivatte amar leh dela otivi eruve tavshilin amar leh poshea atte lechulle alma shere ledidach asir
Tanu rabbanan yom tov shechal lihot beerev shabbat en mearvin lo eruve techumin velo eruve chatzerot
Rabbi omer mearvin eruve chatzerot aval lo eruve techumin mippene sheatta osro bedavar haasur lo vei atta osro bedavar hammuttar lo
Ittemar rav amar halacha ketanna kamma ushmuel amar halacha kerabbi

Ibaya lehu halacha kerabbi lekulla o lechumra peshita dilkulla kaamar mishshum deshalach rabbi elazar laggola lo kesheattem shonin bevavel rabbi mattir vachachamim osrin ella rabbi oser vachachamim mattirin may

Kevan demikkalkeli bah rabbim

Matni bet shammay omrim lo yachem adam chammin leraglav ella im ken reuyin lishtiyya uvet hillel mattirin ose adam medura umitchammem kenegdah

Ta shema bet shammay omrim lo yaase adam medura veyitchammem kenegdah uvet hillel mattirin

Verav huna letameh deamar rav huna mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin ofin lo pat achat umvashshelin lo kedera achat

Bea mineh abbaye merabba mahu lechabbot et haddeleka beom tov hecha deika sakkanat nefashot la ka mibbaya li daafilu beshabbat shere ki kamibbaya li mishshum ibbud mamon may amar leh asur
Etiveh en mechabbin et habbekaat kede lechus aleha veim bishvil shello yitashshen habbayit o hakkedera muttar hahi rabbi yehuda hi ki kaamena ana lerabbanan

Etiveh en mechabbin et habbekaat veshanni leh kidshannin

Hane mile hecha dela mesayya bahadeh aval mar ka mesayya bahadeh deka ametz ufatach amar leh ika rav zevid dekae kevatach veshannay leh mesayyea en bo mammash

b: Ma sheen ken bevetza

Im amru beetzim yeveshim yomru beetzim lachim im amru battannur cham yomru betannur tzonen im amru betannur shel mattechet yomru betannur shel cheres

Matni af hu amar shelosha devarim lehakel mechabbedin bet hammittot umannichin et hammugmar beom tov veosin gedi mekullas belele fesachim vachachamim osrin
Gema amar rav assi machloket legammer aval lehariach divre hakkol muttar

Amru lo im ken af bashshabbat muttar laasot ken
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar amar rav assi machloket lehariach aval legammer asur

Verabba amar al gabbe cheres name asur mishshum deka moled recha rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu sachofe kasa ashshirae beoma tava asur may tama mishshum dekamoled recha
Umay shena mimmollo umeriach bo vekotmo umereach bo hatam recha miha ita veosofe hu deka mosif recha hacha olode hu dekamoled recha rava amar al gabbe gachelet name muttar mide dehave abbisra aggumre

Daresh rav geviha mibbe chetil appitcha deve resh galuta kittura shere amar leh ammemar may kittura i kittura bide maase umman hu vei leashshen asur deha ka mechabbe amar leh rav ashe leolam leashshen mide dehave abbisra aggumre

Ika deamri amar leh ammemar may kittura i kittura bide maase umman hu i leashshen asur deka moled recha amar rav ashe ana amritah nihaleh umishshemeh degavra rabba amritah nihaleh leolam leashshen umide dehave abbisra aggumre

Veosin gedi mekullas tanya rabbi yose omer todos ish romi hinhig et bene romi leechol gedi mekullas belele pesachim shelachu leh ilmale todos atta gozranu alecha nidduy sheatta maachil et bene yisrael kadashim bachutz
Kadashim salka datach ella ema keen kadashim
Matni shelosha devarim rabbi elazar ben azarya mattir vachachamim osrim parato yotza birtzua shebben karneha
Umkardin et habbehema beom tov veshochakin et happilpelin barechayim shellahen
Rabbi yehuda omer en mekardin et habbehema beom tov mippene sheose chabbura aval mekartzefin vachachamim omrim en mekardin af lo mekartzefin

Umkardin et habbehema beom tov tanu rabbanan ezehu kerud veezehu kirtzuf kerud ketannim veosin chabbura kirtzuf gedolim veen osin chabbura
Veshalosh machlokot baddavar rabbi yehuda savar davar sheeno mitkaven asur mihu kerud ketannim veosin chabbura kirtzuf gedolim veen osin chabbura vela gazrinan kirtzuf attu kerud

Verabbanan savri name kerabbi yehuda davar sheeno mitkaven asur vegazrinan kirtzuf attu kerud verabbi elazar ben azarya savar lah kerabbi shimon deamar davar sheeno mitkaven muttar uven kerud uven kirtzuf shere

a: Hamchussar tzeda asur vesheeno mechussar tzeda muttar
Gema urminhu bevarin shel chayya veshel ofot en tzadin mehem beom tov veen notnin lifnehem mezonot kashya chayya achayya kashya ofot aofot
Bishlama chayya achayya la kashya ha rabbi yehuda ha rabbanan
Ditnan rabbi yehuda omer hatztzad tzippor lammigdal utzvi labbayit chayyav labbayit hu demichayyav aval levivarin la vachachamim omrim tzippor lammigdal utzvi lagginna velechatzer velabbivarin
Ella ofot aofot kashya vechi tema ha name la kashya ha bevivar mekore ha bevivar sheeno mekore
Veha bayit dichvivar mekore dame uven lerabbi yehuda uven lerabbanan tzippor lammigdal in labbayit la
Amar rabba bar rav huna hacha betzippor deror askinan sheenah mekabbelet marut detana deve rabbi yishmael lamma nikra shemah tzippor deror sheddara babbayit kevassade
Hashta deatet lehachi chayya achayya name la kashya ha bevivar katan ha bevivar gadol

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo kal habbevarin shavin vechu amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi shimon ben gamliel amar leh abbaye halacha mikkelal difligi
Amar leh umay nafka lach minah amar leh gemara gemor zemorta tehe
Ze hakkelal kol hamchussar tzeda vechu hechi dame mechussar tzeda amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol sheomer have metzuda untzudennu
Amar leh abbaye veha aozin vetarnegolin sheomrim have metzuda untzudennu vetanya hatztzad aozin vetarnegolin veone hardisaot patur

Vahare yone shovach veone aliyya devain lichluvan laerev vetanya hatztzad yone shovach veone aliyya vetzipporim shekkinnenu bitfichin babbirot chayyav
Ella amar rabba bar rav huna amar shemuel hallalu bain lichluvan laerev umzonotan alecha vehallalu bain lichluvan laerev veen mezonotan alecha
Rav mari amar hane avidi lerabboye vehane la avidi lerabboye kullehu name avidi lerabboye lichluvan kaamrinan daavidi lerabboye

Hatam la ka aved maase hacha ka aved maase
Vela baaya zimmun vehatanya chayya shekkinnena befardes tzericha lezammen vetzippor deror tzarich likshor bichnafeha kede shello titchallef beimmah vezo edut sheheidu mippi shemaya veavtalon teuvta

Umi baaya zimmun vehatanya amar rabbi shimon ben elazar modim bet shammay uvet hillel al shehizminan betoch hakken umatza lifne hakken sheasurin bamme devarim amurim beone shovach veone aliyya vetzipporim shekkinnenu bitfichin uvvira aval aozim vetarnegolim veone hardasiyyaot vechayya shekkinnena befardes muttarin veen tzerichin zimmun vetzippor deror tzericha lekashsher bichnafeha kede shello titchallef beimmah
Vehamkushsharim vehamnuanain bevorot uvvattim uvshichin uvimarot muttarin uvilanot asurin shemma yaale veyitlosh vehamkushsharin vehamnuanain bechol makom asurin mishshum gazel
Amar rav nachman la kashya ha bah ha beimmah immah bezimmun saggi lah tzeda mealleuta baaya
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ide veide bedidah ha beginna hassemucha lair ha beginna sheenah semucha
Matni behema mesukkenet lo yishchot ella im ken yesh shehut bayyom leechol mimmenna kezayit tzali rabbi akiva omer afilu kezayit chay mibbet tevichatah
Shechatah bassade lo yevienna bemot uvmota aval mevi beyado evarim evarim
Gema amar rame bar abba hefshet venittuach beola vehu haddin lekatztzavim mikkan limmeda tora derech eretz shello yochal adam basar kodem hefshet venittuach
Leappoke may ka mashma lan ilema leappoke midderav huna deamar rav huna behema bechayyeha bechezkat isur omedet ad sheyyivada lach bamme nishchata
Nishchata bechezkat heter omedet ad sheyyivada lach bamme nitrefa
Vehaanan tenan matnitin kidrav huna ditnan rabbi akiva omer afilu kezayit chay mibbet tevichatah may lav mibbet tevichatah mammash

b: Orach ara ka mashma lan

Netia mekatta raglehon dekatztzavayya udvoale niddot

Mimmashma shenneemar vayyaazvu et Adonai eni yodea shello avaduhu uma talmud lomar velo avaduhu amar rabbi elazar amar hakkadosh baruch hu afilu kattormos hazze sheshsholkin oto sheva peamim veochlin oto bekinnuach seuda lo asauni banay

Tana mishshemeh derabbi meir mippene ma nittena tora leyisrael mippene shehen azzin tana deve rabbi yishmael mimino esh dat lamo amar hakkadosh baruch hu reuyin hallalu shettinnaten lahem dat esh ika deamri datehem shel ellu esh sheilmale lo nittena tora leyisrael en kol umma velashon yecholin laamod bifnehem
Vehayenu deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish shelosha azzin hen yisrael baummot kelev bachayyot tarnegol baofot veyesh omrim af ez bivhema dakka veyesh omrim af tzalaf bailanot
Shechatah bassade lo yevienna bammot tanu rabbanan en hassome yotze bemaklo velo haroe betarmilo veen yotzin bechisse echad haish veechad haishsha
Ini veha shalach rabbi yaakov bar idi zaken echad haya bishchunatenu vehaya yotze bigludke shello uvau veshaalu et rabbi yehoshua ben levi veamar im rabbim tzerichin lo muttar

Amar leh rav nachman lechama bar adda sheliach tziyyon ki salkatte lehatam akkef vezil assullama detzor vezil legabbe derabbi yaakov bar idi uvi mineh kisse ma attun beh

Matni bechor shennafal labbor rabbi yehuda omer yered mumche veyire

Gema bemay ka mippalgi i nema beroin mumin kamippalgi derabbi yehuda savar roin mumin beom tov verabbi shimon savar en roin mumin beom tov velippalgu beroin mumin dealma
Bechor shennafal labbor itztericha leh salka datach amena mishshum tzaar baale chayyim laarem velassekeh kerabbi yehoshua ka mashma lan

Umay shena meha deittemar hifrish shiva etrogim leshivat hayyamim amar rav kol achat veachat yotze bah veochlah lealtar verav assi amar kol achat yotze bah veochlah lemachar
Hatam demafseku lelot miyyamim kol chad vechad yoma mitzva beappe nafsheh hu hacha dela mafseku lelot miyyamim kullehu yome kachada yoma arichta dame

a: Matni meviin etzim min hassade min hamchunnas umin hakkarpef afilu min hamfuzzar ezehu karpef kol shessamuch leir divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer kol shennichnasin lo befotachat vaafilu betoch techum shabbat
Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel en meviin etzim ella min hamchunnasin shebbakkarpef veha anan tenan min hakkarpef vaafilu min hamfuzzarim matnitin yechidaa hi

Amar rava ale kanim vaale gefanim af al gav dimchannefi lehu umotvi kevan dei middele zika mevaddar lehu kimfuzzarim damu vaasurin vei atnach mana meetmol alayehu shappir dame
Ezehu karpef vechu ibbaya lehu hechi kaamar kol shessamuch lair vehu deit leh potachat vaata rabbi yose lememar kevan deit leh potachat afilu betoch techum shabbat name

Matni en mevakkein etzim lo min hakkorot velo min hakkora shennishbera beom tov veen mevakkein lo bekardom velo bimgera velo bemaggal ella bekofitz
b: Gema vehaamratte resha en mevakkein kelal amar rav yehuda amar shemuel chassore mechassera vehachi katane en mevakkein min hassevar shel korot velo min hakkora shennishbera beom tov aval mevakkein min hakkora shennishbera meerev yom tov

Uchshehen mevakkein en mevakkein lo bekardom velo bemaggal velo bimgera ella bekofitz tanya name hachi en mevakkein etzim lo min hassevar shel korot velo min hakkora shennishbera beom tov lefi sheeno min hammuchan
Velo bekardom amar rav chinana bar shelemya mishshemeh derav lo shanu ella benakvut shello aval bezachrut shello muttar

Matni bayit shehu male perot venifchat notel mimmekom happechat rabbi meir omer af pochet lechattechilla venotel

Amar rabbi zera beom tov amru aval lo beshabbat tanya name hachi rabbi meir omer af pochet lechattechilla venotel beom tov amru aval lo beshabbat
Amar shemuel chotamot shebbakkarka mattir aval lo mafkia velo chotech shebbakkelim mattir umafkia vechotech echad shabbat veechad yom tov

I rabbi nechemya may irya shabbat afilu yom tov name vechi tema shanya leh lerabbi nechemya ben shevut shabbat lishvut yom tov umi shanya leh
Vehatane chada massikin bechelim veen massikin beshivre chelim vetanya idach massikin ben bechelim ben beshivre kelim vetanya idach en massikin lo bechelim velo beshivre chelim
Umshanne la kashya ha rabbi yehuda ha rabbi shimon ha rabbi nechemya
Tere tannae vealliba derabbi nechemya
Matni en pochatin et hanner mippene shehu ose keli veen osin pechamin beom tov veen chotchin et happetila rabbi yehuda omer chotchah baur
Gema man tena difchitat ner mana hu amar rav yosef rabbi meir hi detanya keli cheres meematay mekabbel tuma mishshennigmera melachto divre rabbi meir rabbi yehoshua omer mishsheyyitzrefo bakkivshan
Amar leh abbaye mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella dachaze lekabbole beh mide aval hacha lemay chazi lekabbole beh peshite
Ika deamri amar rav yosef rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok hi ditnan ilpasin chiraniyyot tehorot beohel hammet utmeot bemassa hazzav
Rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer af tehorot bemassa hazzav lefi shello nigmera melachtan
Amar leh abbaye dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok hatam ella dachaze lekabbole beh mide aval hacha lemay chaze lekabbole beh peshite

Veen osin pechamin peshita lemay chaze tane rabbi chiyya lo nitzrecha ella lemosran leolyarin levo bayyom
Uvo bayyom mi shere kidamar rava lehazzia vekodem gezera hacha name lehazzia vekodem gezera
Veen chotchin et happetila lishnayim may shena besakkin dela
b: Dekamtakken mana baur name ka metakken mana tane rabbi chiyya chotchah baur befi shette nerot amar rav natan bar abba amar rav mochatin et happetila beom tov may mochatin amar rav chanina bar shelemya mishshemeh derav leaddoye chushcha

Veamar rav natan bar abba amar rav attire bavel yorde gehinnam hem ki ha deshabbetay bar marinus ikkela levavel bea minnayehu iska vela yehavu leh mezone mezan name la zayenuhu

Veamar rav natan bar abba amar rav kol hamtzappe al shulchan acherim olam chashach baado shenneemar noded hu lallechem ayye yada ki nachon beyado yom choshech rav chisda amar af chayyav enan chayyim

Matni en shovrin et hacheres veen chotchin hanneyar litzlot bo maliach

Veen makkifin shette chaviyyot lishpot alehen et hakkedera veen somchin et hakkedera babbekaat vechen baddelet veen manhigin et habbehema bammakkel beom tov verabbi elazar berabbi shimon mattir

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe amar lan rav acha mehutzal demar sharkin leh tannura beoma tava amar leh anan arakta difrat samchinan vehane mile hu detzayereh meetmol amar ravina vekitma shere

Amar rav yehuda hay medurta millemala lematta shere millematta lemala asur

Ika deamri beyabbishta kulle alma la peligi dishre ki peligi berattivta man deasar dela chaze lehassaka uman deshare amar lach ha chaze lehesek gadol vehilcheta yabbishta shere rattivta asir
Daresh rava ishsha lo tikkanes ledir haetzim litol mehen ud veud shennishbar asur lehassiko beom tov lefi shemmassikin bechelim veen massikin beshivre chelim
Lememra derava kerabbi yehuda sevira leh deit leh muktze veha amar leh rava leshammaeh tevi li bar aoza ushdi meeh leshunnara hatam kevan demasrechi meetmol dateh illaveh
Matni rabbi eliezer omer notel adam kesam mishshellefanav lachtzotz bo shinav umgabbev min hechatzer umadlik shekkol ma shebbechatzer muchan hu vachachamim omrim megabbev mishshellefanav umadlik
En motziin et haur lo min haetzim velo min haavanim velo min heafar velo min harafim velo min hammayim veen melabbenin et harafim litzlot bahen
Gema amar rav yehuda

Amar leh hashta patur aval asur ka kashya li chayyav chattat mibbaya ella ki tanya hahi bekashin kashin bene melila ninhu

Tane chada kotmo umeriach bo tanya idach lo yiktemennu lehariach bo amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda la kashya ha berakkin ha bekashin

Matkef lah rav acha bar yaakov bekashin ammay la may shena meha ditnan shover adam et hechavit leechol mimmenna gerogrot uvilvad shello yitkaven laasot keli veod ha rava bar rav adda veravin bar rav adda deamri tarvayehu ki havenan be rav yehuda hava mefashshach veyahev lan alvata alvata af al gav dechazya lekattata denarge vachatzine

La kashya ha rabbi eliezer ha rabbanan detanya rabbi eliezer omer notel adam kesam mishshellefanav lachtzotz bo shinav vachachamim omrim lo yittol ella meevus shel behema veshavin shello yiktemennu veim ketamo lachtzotz bo shinav veliftoach bo haddelet beshogeg beshabbat chayyav chattat bemezid beom tov sofeg et haarbaim divre rabbi eliezer
Vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze eno ella mishshum shevut rabbi eliezer dekaamar hatam chayyav chattat hacha patur aval asur rabbanan deka amri hatam patur aval asur hacha muttar lechattechilla
Velet leh lerabbi eliezer ha ditnan shover adam et hechavit leechol mimmenna gerogrot uvilvad shello yitkaven laasot keli amar rav ashe ki tanya hahi bemustaki

En motziin et haur vechu may tama mishshum deka moled beom tov

Veen gozzin et hayyarak battisporet shello aval metakkenin et hakkundas veet haakkaviyyot umassikin veofin befurni umchammin chammin beantichi veen ofin befurni chadasha shemma tippachet

I name leidach gisa hatam hayenu tama deleka hefsed mamon aval hacha deika hefsed mamon afilu tuva name

a: Hatam tenan aval lo et haotzar veamar shemuel may aval lo et haotzar aval lo yigmor et haotzar kullo dilma ate leashoye gummot hacha may
Hatam hu beshabbat deasur mishshum dachamir aval yom tov dekil shappir dame o dilma hatam deika bittul bet hammidrash amratte la hacha deleka bittul bet hammidrash lo kol shekken
Vehacha tenan mashshilin perot derech arubba beom tov veamar rav nachman lo shanu ella beoto haggag aval miggag legag la vetanya name hachi en metaltelin miggag legag afilu kesheggaggotehen shavin
Hatam may kol shekken shabbat dachamira o dilma hacha hu deasur mishshum yom tov dekil veate lezalzole beh aval shabbat dachamira vela ate lezalzole bah shappir dame
O dilma ma hacha deika hefsed perot amratte la hatam deleka hefsed perot lo kol shekken
Hacha tenan lo yeshalshelem bechevel bechallonot velo yoridem derech sullamot hatam may hacha beom tov hu deasur deleka bittul bet hammidrash aval shabbat deika bittul bet hammidrash shappir dame
O dilma hacha deika hefsed perot amratte la hatam deleka hefsed perot lo kol shekken teku
Umchassin et happerot amar ulla vaafilu avera delivne rabbi yitzchak amar perot haruyin veazda rabbi yitzchak letameh deamar rabbi yitzchak en keli nital ella ledavar hannital beshabbat
Tenan mechassin et happerot bechelim perot in avera delivne la hu haddin daafilu avera delivne veayede ditna resha mashshilin perot tena sefa name mechassin et happerot
Tenan vechen kadde yayin vechen kadde shemen hacha bemay askinan betivla
Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach kadde yayin vechadde shemen dehettera ha tena leh resha perot
Kadde yayin vechadde shemen itztericha leh salka datach amena lehefsed merubbe chashshu lehefsed muat lo chashshu ka mashma lan
Tenan notnin keli tachat haddelef beshabbat bedelef harauy
Ta shema porsin machtzelet al gabbe levenim beshabbat deiyyatur mibbinyana dachaze lemizge alayehu
Ta shema porsin machtzelet al gabbe avanim beshabbat baavanim mekurzalot dechazyan levet hakkisse
Ta shema porsin machtzelet al gabbe kaveret devorim beshabbat bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim uvilvad shello yitkaven latzud hatam name deika devash

Amar leh rav ukva mimmeshan lerav ashe hatinach bimot hachamma deika devash bimot haggeshamim may ika lememar lo nitzrecha ella leotan shette challot otan shette challot muktzot hen hacha bemay askinan shechishshev alehem
Aval lo chishshev alehem may asur addetane uvilvad shello yitkaven latzud liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim shechishshev alehen aval lo chishshev alehem asur
Hachi kaamar af al pi shechishshev alehen uvilvad shello yitkaven latzud
Bemay okemta kerabbi yehuda deit leh muktze ema sefa uvilvad shello yitkaven latzud atan lerabbi shimon deamar davar sheen mitkaven muttar
Vetisbera derabbi shimon veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut
Leolam kullah rabbi yehuda hi vehacha bemay askinan deit beh kave vela tema lerabbi yehuda uvilvad shello yitkaven latzud
b: Ella ema uvilvad shello yaasenna metzuda peshita mahu detema bemino nitztzod asur shello bemino nitztzod muttar ka mashma lan
Rav ashe amar mi katane bimot hachamma uvimot haggeshamim bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim katane beome nisan uvome tishre deika chamma veika geshamim veika devash
Venotnin keli tachat haddelef beshabbat tana im nitmalle hakkeli shofech veshone veeno nimna
Be richya deabbaye deluf ata lekammeh derabba amar leh zil ayeleh lefuryach lehatam deleheve kigraf shel rei veappekeh
Yatev abbaye veka kashya leh vechi osin geraf shel rei lechattechilla addehachi nefal be richya deabbaye amar tete li daavari addemar
Amar shemuel geraf shel rei veavit shel meme raglayim muttar lehotzian laashpa uchshehu machziro noten bo mayim umachziro
Sevur minah geraf shel rei aggav mana in bifne atzmo la ta shema dehahu achbarta deishtechach be isparmake derav ashe amar lehu rav ashe niktuh betzutziteh veappekuh
Matni kol shechayyavin alav mishshum shevut mishshum reshut mishshum mitzva beshabbat chayyavin alav beom tov
Veellu hen mishshum shevut lo olin bailan velo rochvin al gabbe behema velo shatin al pene hammayim velo metappechin velo mesappekin velo merakkedin
Veellu hen mishshum reshut lo danin velo mekaddeshin velo choltzin velo meyabbemin
Veellu hen mishshum mitzva lo makdishin velo maarichin velo macharimin velo magbihin teruma umaaser
Kol ellu beom tov amru kal vachomer bashshabbat en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad
Gema lo olin bailan gezera shemma yitlosh
Velo rochvin al gabbe behema gezera shemma yetze chutz lattechum shema minah techumin deorayeta ella gezera shemma yachtoch zemora
Velo shatin al pene hammayim gezera shemma yaase chavit shel shayyatin
Velo metappechin velo mesappekin velo merakkedin gezera shemma yetakken kele shir
Veellu hen mishshum reshut lo danin veha mitzva kaaved la tzericha deika daadif mineh
Velo mekaddeshin veha mitzva kaaved la tzericha

a: Deit leh ishsha uvanim
Lo choltzin velo meyabbemin veha mitzva ka aved la tzericha deika gadol umitzva baggadol leyabbem
Vechullehu tama may gezera shemma yichtov
Veellu hen mishshum mitzva lo makdishin velo maarichin velo macharimin gezera mishshum mikkach umimkar
Velo magbihin terumot umaasrot peshita tane rav yosef lo nitzrecha ella litnah lechohen bo bayyom
Vehane mile pere ditvili meetmol aval pere ditvili haidana kegon isa leafroshe minah challa mafreshinan veyahavinan lechohen
Vehane mishshum reshut ika mishshum shevut leka vehane mishshum mitzva ika mishshum shevut leka
Amar rabbi yitzchak la mibbaya kaamar la mibbaya shevut geredta deasur ella afilu shevut dirshut name asur vela mibbaya shevut dirshut deasur ella afilu shevut demitzva name asur
Kol ellu beom tov amru urminhu mashshilin derech arubba beom tov aval lo beshabbat
Amar rav yosef la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ha rabbi yehoshua
Detanya oto veet beno shennaflu levor rabbi eliezer omer maale et harishon al menat leshochto veshochato vehashsheni ose lo parnasa bimkomo kede shello yamut
Rabbi yehoshua omer maale et harishon al menat leshochto veeno shochato vechozer umaarim umaale hashsheni ratza ze shochet ratza ze shochet
Amar leh abbaye mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam ella deefshar befarnasa aval hacha dela efshar befarnasa la
I name ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam ella deefshar leaarome aval hacha dela efshar leaarome la
Ella amar rav pappa la kashya ha bet shammay ha bet hillel
Ditnan bet shammay omrim en motziin lo et hakkatan velo et hallulav velo et sefer tora lirshut harabbim uvet hillel mattirin
Dilma la hi ad kan la ka amri bet shammay hatam ella ahotzaa aval attiltul la attu tiltul lav tzorech hotzaa hu
Matni habbehema vehakkelim keragle habbealim hammoser behemto livno o laroe hare ellu keragle habbealim
Kelim hamuchadin leechad min haachin shebbabbayit hare ellu keraglav vesheen meuchadin hare ellu kimkom sheholchin

Hashshoel keli mechavero meerev yom tov keragle hashshoel beom tov keragle hammashil vechen haishsha sheshshaala mechavertah tavlin umayim vamelach leisatah hare ellu keragle shettehen rabbi yehuda poter bammayim mippene sheen bahen mammash
Gema matnitin
b: Dela kerabbi dosa detanya rabbi dosa omer veamri lah abba shaul omer hallokeach behema mechavero meerev yom tov af al pi shello mesarah lo ella beom tov hare hi keragle hallokeach vehammoser behema laroe af al pi shello mesarah lo ella beom tov hare hi keragle haroe
Afilu tema rabbi dosa vela kashya kan beroe echad kan bishne roim dayeka name dekatane livno o laroe shema minah
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi dosa umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna utnan habbehema vehakkelim keragle habbealim
Velav okemna kan beroe echad kan bishne roim

Tanu rabbanan shenayim sheshshaalu chaluk echad beshuttafut ze lelech bo shacharit levet hammidrash veze likanes bo arvit levet hammishte ze erav alav latztzafon veze erav alav laddarom ze sheerav alav latztzafon mehallech latztzafon keragle mi sheerav alav laddarom
Vaze sheerav alav laddarom mehallech laddarom keragle mi sheerav alav latztzafon
Veim mitztzeu et hattechum hare ze lo yezizenna mimmekomah
Ittemar shenayim shellakchu chavit uvhema beshuttafut rav amar chavit mutteret uvhema asura ushmuel amar chavit name asura
May kasavar rav i ka savar yesh berera afilu behema tishtere vei kasavar en berera afilu chavit name asura
Leolam kasavar yesh berera veshanya behema deka yanki techumin mehadade amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav leisur muktze lo chashshu leisur techumin chashshu shatek rav
May have alah rabbi hoshaya amar yesh berera verabbi yochanan amar en berera

Vesavar rabbi hoshaya yesh berera vehatnan hammet bevayit velo petachim harbe kullan temeim niftach echad mehen hu tame vechullan tehorim chishshev lehotzio beechad mehen o bachallon sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa matztzelet al happetachim kullan
Bet shammay omrim vehu shechishshev alav ad shello yamut hammet uvet hillel omrim af mishsheyyamut hammet
Veittemar alah amar rabbi hoshaya letaher et happetachim mikkan ulhabba mikkan ulhabba in lemafrea la
Efoch rabbi hoshaya amar en berera verabbi yochanan amar yesh berera
Umi it leh lerabbi yochanan berera vehaamar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan haachin shechalku lakochot hen umachzirin ze laze bayyovel
Vechi tema ki let leh lerabbi yochanan berera bidorayeta aval bidrabbanan it leh
Uvidrabbanan mi it leh vehatane ayyo
Rabbi yehuda omer en adam matne al shene devarim keechad ella im ba chacham lammizrach eruvo lammizrach lammaarav eruvo lammaarav veilu lechan ulchan la

a: Vehavenan bah may shena lechan ulchan dela deen berera mizrach umaarav name en berera
Veamar rabbi yochanan uchvar ba chacham alma let leh lerabbi yochanan berera
Ella leolam la tefoch vechi let leh lerabbi oshaya berera bidorayeta aval bidrabbanan it leh
Daresh mar zutra halacha kerabbi oshaya
Amar shemuel shor shel pattam hare hu keragle kol adam shor shel roe hare hu keragle otah hair
Hashshoel keli mechavero meerev yom tov peshita la tzericha shello mesaro lo ella beom tov mahu detema lav birshuteh okmeh ka mashma lan
Mesayya leh lerabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan hashshoel keli mechavero meerev yom tov af al pi shello netano lo ella beom tov hare hu keragle hashshoel
Beom tov keragle hammashil peshita la tzericha dirgil veshael mineh mahu detema birshuteh ka mokem leh ka mashma lan memar amar dilma mashkach inish acharina veazel veshael mineh

Vechen haishsha sheshshaala mechavertah ki selek rabbi abba amar yehe raava deema milleta detitkabbal ki selek ashkecheh lerabbi yochanan verabbi chanina bar pappi verabbi zera veamri lah rabbi avahu verabbi shimon ben pazzi verabbi yitzchak nappacha veyatvi vekaamri ammay velivtil mayim vamelach legabbe isa amar lehu rabbi abba
b: Hare shennitarev lo kav chittin baasara kabbin chittin shel chavero yochal halla vechade achichu aleh amar lehu gulletayechu shekali hadur achichu aleh

Amar rav oshaya shappir avud deachichu aleh may shena chittin bisorim dela kaamar lehu dehave leh min besheeno mino umin besheeno mino batel chittin bechittin name nehi dilrabbi yehuda lo batel lerabbanan mivtal batel
Amar leh rav safra moshe shappir kaamratte vela shemia lehu ha deamar rabbi chiyya ketosfaa mishshemeh derav habborer tzerorot miggorno shel chavero chayyav leshallem lo deme chittim
Alma kayela chassereh hacha name kayela chassereh
Amar leh abbaye vela shane leh lemar ben mamon sheyyesh lo tovin lemamon sheen lo tovin
Amar leh velitamach ha deamar rav chisda nevela betela bishchuta lefi shei efshar lashshechuta shettease nevela
Shechuta enah betela binvela lefi sheefshar lannevela shettease shechuta
Hachi name dechi it lah bealim la batla vechi tema hachi name veha tanya amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri cheftze hefker konin shevita af al pi sheen lahem bealim domin kemi sheyyesh lahem bealim
Amar leh mi ka medammet isura lemamona isura batel mamona lo batel
Vetama may
Abbaye amar gezera shemma taase isa beshuttafut
Rava amar tavlin letama avidi vetama la batel

a: Verav ashe amar mishshum dehave leh davar sheyyesh lo mattirin vechol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin afilu beelef lo batel
Rabbi yehuda poter bammayim mayim in melach la veha tanya rabbi yehuda omer mayim vamelach betelin ben baisa ben bakkedera la kashya ha bemelach sedomit ha bemelach isterokanit
Vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer mayim vamelach betelin baisa veen betelin bakkedera mippene rotbah la kashya ha beava ha berakka
Matni haggachelet keragle habbealim veshalhevet bechol makom gachelet shel hekdesh moalin bah veshalhevet lo nehenin velo moalin hammotzi gachelet lirshut harabbim chayyav veshalhevet patur

Gema tanu rabbanan chamishsha devarim neemru baggachelet haggachelet keragle habbealim veshalhevet bechol makom gachelet shel hekdesh moalin bah veshalhevet lo nehenin velo moalin gachelet shel avoda zara asura veshalhevet mutteret hammotzi gachelet lirshut harabbim chayyav veshalhevet patur hammuddar hanaa mechavero asur begachalto umuttar beshalhavto
May shena shalhevet avoda zara desharya umay shena dehekdesh daasira avoda zara dimisa uvdili inashe minah la gezaru bah rabbanan hekdesh dela meis vela bedili inashe mineh gezaru beh rabbanan
Hammotzi gachelet lirshut harabbim chayyav veshalhevet patur veha tanya hammotzi shalhevet kol shehu chayyav amar rav sheshet kegon shehotzio bekesam
Vetipok leh mishshum kesam bidlet leh shiura ditnan hammotzi etzim kede levashshel betza kalla
Abbaye amar kegon deshayefeh lemana mishcha veatli beh nura vetipok leh mishshum mana bechaspa
Vetipok leh mishshum chaspa bidlet leh shiura ditnan cheres kede liten ben patztzim lachavero divre rabbi yehuda
Ella ha ditnan hammotzi shalhevet patur hechi mashkachatte lah kegon deaddeyeh addoye lirshut harabbim
Matni bor shel yachid keragle hayyachid veshel anshe otah hair keragle anshe otah hair veshel ole vavel keragle hammalle

Gema rame leh rava lerav nachman tenan bor shel yachid keragle hayyachid urminhu neharot hammoshchin umaayanot hannovin hare hen keragle kol adam amar rava hacha bemay askinan bimchunnasin veittemar name amar rabbi chiyya bar avin amar shemuel bimchunnasin
Veshel ole vavel keragle hammalle ittemar mile venatan lachavero rav nachman amar keragle mi shennitmalleu lo rav sheshet amar keragle hammalle
Bemay ka mipalgi mar savar bera dehefkera hu umar savar bera deshuttafe hu
Etiveh rava lerav nachman hareni alecha cherem hammuddar asur
b: Hare atta alay cherem hannoder asur hareni alecha veatta alay shenehem asurim ze baze umuttarin beshel ole vavel vaasurin beshel otah hair
Veellu hen devarim shel ole vavel har habbayit halleshachot vehaazarot uvor shel emtza hadderech veellu hen shel otah hair harchov uvet hakkeneset uvet hammerchatz
Vei amratte bera deshuttafe hu ammay muttar vehatnan hashshuttafin shennadru hanaa ze mizze asurim likanes lechatzer lirchotz babbor
Lirchotz hachi name vehacha bemay askinan lemalloot mar middideh ka memalle umar middideh ka memalle
Vesavar rav nachman yesh berera vehatnan haachin hashshuttafin keshechayyavin bakkalbon peturin mimmasar behema
Uchshechayyavin bemasar behema peturin min hakkalbon
Veamar rav anan lo shanu ella shechalku gedayim keneged telaim utlaim keneged gedayim
Aval chalku gedayim keneged gedayim utlaim keneged telaim omer zehu chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach
Verav nachman amar afilu chalku gedayim keneged gedayim utlaim keneged telaim en omer ze chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach
Ella dechulle alma bera dehefkera hi ella hacha bemagbiha metzia lachavero ka mipalgi mar savar kana umar savar la kana
Matni mi shehau perotav beir acheret veervu bene otah hair lehavi etzlo mipperotav lo yaviu lo veim erav hu perotav kamohu

a: Mi shezzimmen etzlo orchim lo yolichu beyadam manot ella im ken zikka lahem manotehem meerev yom tov

Gema ittemar hammafkid perot etzel chavero rav amar keragle mi shehifkidu lo ushmuel amar keragle hammafkid lema rav ushmuel deazdu letamayehu ditnan im hichnis birshut baal hechatzer chayyav rabbi omer leolam eno chayyav ad sheyekabbel alav baal habbayit lishmor
Veamar rav huna amar rav halacha kedivre chachamim ushmuel amar halacha kerabbi lema rav deamar kerabbanan ushmuel deamar kerabbi
Amar lecha rav ana daamari afilu lerabbi ad kan la kaamar rabbi hatam ella devistama la kabbel aleh netiruta aval hacha ha kabbel aleh netiruta

Ushmuel amar ana daamari afilu lerabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella denicha leh leinish denekum toreh birshuteh devaal chatzer dei mazzek leh la michayyav aval hacha mi nicha leh leinish delekum pereh birshuteh dechavreh
Tenan veim erav hu perotav kamohu vei amratte keragle mi shehifkidu etzlo ki erav hu may have amar rav huna amri be rav kegon sheyyiched lo keren zavit

Ta shema mi shezzimmen etzlo orchim lo yolichu beyadam manot ella im ken zikka lahem manotehem meerev yom tov vei amratte keragle mi shehifkido etzlo ki zikka lahem al yede acher may have hachi name kevan shezzikka lahem al yede acher kemi sheyyiched lo keren zavit dame
Veibaet ema zikka shane
Rav chana bar chanilay tela bisra beivra dedashsha ata lekammeh derav huna amar leh i atte telet zil shekel vei inhu telo lach la tishkol
Vei ihu tela mi shakel veha rav huna talmid derav hava veamar rav keragle mi shehifkidu etzlo shane ivra dedasha dichmi sheyyiched lo keren zavit dame
Amar leh rav hillel lerav ashe vei inhu talu leh la shakel vehaamar shemuel shor shel pattam hare hu keragle kol adam

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe vei inhu talu leh la shakel vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi dosa amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana vei inhu talu leh la shakel vehatnan habbehema vehakkelim keragle habbealim

Ella shane rav chana bar chanilay degavra rabba hu utrid bishmateh vehachi kaamar leh i atte telet it lach simana begaveyh vela massechatte datach minneh zil shekol vei inhu talu lach massechatte datach vela tishkol
Matni en mashkin veshochatin et hammidbariyyot aval mashkin veshochatin et habbayyatot ellu hen bayyatot hallanot bair midbariyyot hallanot baafar
Gema lema li lememar mashkin veshochatin milta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan delashke inash behemto vahadar lishchot mishshum sircha demashka

Tanu rabbanan ellu hen midbariyyot veellu hen bayyatot midbariyyot kol sheyyotzot bappesach veroot baafar venichnasot birvia rishona veellu hen bayyatot kol sheyyotzot veroot chutz lattechum uvaot velanot betoch hattechum rabbi omer ellu veellu bayyatot hen ella ellu hen midbariyyot kol sheyyotzot veroot baafar veen nichnasot layyishshuv lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim
Umi it leh lerabbi muktze veha bea mineh rabbi shimon bar rabbi merabbi patzile temara lerabbi shimon mahu amar leh en muktze lerabbi shimon
b: Ella gerogrot vetzimmukin bilvad
Ibaet ema hane name kigrogrot vetzimmukin dame veibaet ema lidvarav derabbi shimon kaamar veleh la sevira leh

Veibaet ema ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi en muktze ella ledidchu odo li mihat hecha deotzot veroot bappesach venichnasot birvia rishona devayyatot hen vaamaru leh rabbanan la midbariyyot hen
Hadaran alach mashshilin perot uslika massechet betza

a: Arbaa rashe shanim hem beechad benisan rosh hashshana lammelachim velargalim
Beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim beechad betishri
Beechad betishri rosh hashshana lashshanim velashshemitin velayyovlot lintia velirakot
Beechad bishvat rosh hashshana lailan kedivre bet shammay bet hillel omrim bachamishsha asar bo
Gema lammelachim lemay hilcheta amar rav chisda lishtarot
Ditnan shitre chov hammukdamin pesulin vehamucharin kesherin
Tanu rabbanan melech sheamad beesrim vetisha baadar kevan shehiggia echad benisan alta lo shana veim lo amad ella beechad benisan en monin lo shana ad sheyyaggia nisan acher
Amar mar melech sheamad beesrim vetisha baadar kevan shehiggia echad benisan alta lo shana ha
b: Ka mashma lan denisan rosh hashshana limlachim veom echad bashshana chashuv shana veim lo amad ella beechad benisan en monin lo shana ad sheyyaggia nisan acher peshita
La tzericha deimno aleh meadar mahu detema nimno leh tarten shenin ka mashma lan

Tanu rabbanan met baadar veamad acher tachtav baadar monin shana leze velaze met benisan veamad acher tachtav benisan monin shana leze velaze met baadar veamad acher tachtav benisan monin rishona larishon ushniyya lashsheni
Amar mar met baadar veamad acher tachtav baadar monin shana leze velaze peshita mahu detema shatta leve tere la maninan ka mashma lan
Met benisan veamad acher tachtav benisan monin shana leze velaze peshita mahu detema ki amrinan yom echad bashshana chashuv shana besof shana aval bitchillat shana la amrinan ka mashma lan
Met baadar veamad acher tachtav benisan monin rishona larishon ushniyya lashsheni peshita la tzericha deimno aleh meadar umelech ben melech hu mahu detema nimno leh tarten shenin ka mashma lan

Amar rabbi yochanan minnayin lammelachim sheen monin lahem ella minnisan shenneemar vayehi vishmonim shana vearba meot shana letzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim bashshana harviit bechodesh ziv hu hachodesh hashsheni limloch shelomo al yisrael makkish malchut shelomo litziat mitzrayim ma yetziat mitzrayim minnisan af malchut shelomo minnisan
Vitziat mitzrayim gufah menalan deminnisan maninan dilma mittishri maninan

La salka datach dichtiv vayyaal aharon hakkohen el hor hahar al pi Adonai vayyamot sham bishnat haarbaim letzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim bachodesh hachamishi beechad lachodesh uchtiv vayehi bearbaim shana beashte asar chodesh beechad lachodesh dibber moshe vego middekae beav vekare lah shenat arbaim vekae bishvat vekare lah shenat arbaim mikkelal derosh hashshana lav tishre hu
Bishlama hayech mefaresh delitziat mitzrayim ella hay mimmay delitziat mitzrayim dilma lahakamat hammishkan
Kidamar rav pappa shenat esrim shenat esrim ligzera shava hacha name shenat arbaim shenat arbaim ligzera shava ma kan litziat mitzrayim af kan litziat mitzrayim
Umimmay demaase deav kadem dilma maase dishvat kadem
La salka datach dichtiv achare hakkoto et sichon vechi nach nafsheh deaharon akkatti hava sichon kayyam dichtiv

a: Vayyishma hakkenaani melech arad ma shemua shama shama shemmet aharon venistalleku anne kavod uchsavur nitna reshut lehillachem beyisrael vehayenu dichtiv vayyiru kol haeda ki gava aharon
Veamar rabbi avahu al tikre vayyiru ella vayyirau kidresh lakish deamar resh lakish ki meshammesh bearba leshonot i dilma ella deha

Mi dame hatam kenaan hacha sichon tana hu sichon hu arad hu kenaan sichon sheddome lisyach bammidbar kenaan al shem malchuto uma shemo arad shemo ika deamri arad sheddome learod bammidbar kenaan al shem malchuto uma shemo sichon shemo
Veema rosh hashshana iyyar

La salka datach dichtiv vayehi bachodesh harishon bashshana hashshenit beechad lachodesh hukam hammishkan uchtiv vayehi bashshana hashshenit bachodesh hashsheni naala heanan meal mishkan haedut middekae benisan vekare lah shana shenit vekae beiyyar vekare lah shana shenit mikkelal derosh hashshana lav iyyar hu
Veema rosh hashshana sivan la salka datach dichtiv bachodesh hashshelishi letzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim veim ita bachodesh hashshelishi bashshana hashshenit letzet vego mibe leh
Veema tammuz veema av veema adar
Ella amar rabbi elazar mehacha vayyachel livnot bachodesh hashsheni bashsheni bishnat arba lemalchuto may sheni lav sheni leyerach shemmonin bo lemalchuto
Matkef lah ravina veema sheni bachodesh im ken sheni bachodesh behedya hava ketiv beh
Veema besheni bashshabbat chada dela ashkechan sheni bashshabbat dichtiv veod makkish sheni batra lesheni kamma ma sheni kamma chodesh af sheni batra chodesh

Tanya keoteh derabbi yochanan minnayin sheen monin lahem lammelachim ella minnisan shenneemar vayehi vishmonim shana vearba meot shana letzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim vego uchtiv vayyaal aharon hakkohen el hor hahar al pi Adonai vego uchtiv vayehi bearbaim shana beashte asar chodesh
Uchtiv achare hakkoto et sichon vego veomer vayyishma hakkenaani vego veomer vayyiru kol haeda ki gava aharon vego veomer vayehi bachodesh harishon bashshana hashshenit vego
Veomer vayehi bashshana hashshenit bachodesh hashsheni vego veomer bachodesh hashshelishi letzet bene yisrael vego veomer vayyachel livnot vego

Amar rav chisda lo shanu ella lemalche yisrael aval lemalche ummot haolam mittishri maninan shenneemar divre nechemya ben chachalya vayehi vechodesh kislev shenat esrim vego uchtiv vayehi bechodesh nisan shenat esrim leartachshaste vego
Middekae bechislev vekare leh shenat esrim vekae benisan vekare leh shenat esrim mikkelal derosh hashshana lav nisan hu
Bishlama hayech mefaresh dilartachshaste ella hay mimmay dilartachshaste dilma
b: Leminyana acharina hu amar rav pappa shenat esrim shenat esrim ligzera shava ma hatam leartachshaste af hacha leartachshaste
Umimmay demaase dechislev kadem dilma maase denisan kadem
La salka datach detanya devarim sheamar chanani linchemya bechislev amaran nechemya lammelech benisan

Devarim sheamar chanani linchemya bechislev shenneemar divre nechemya ben chachalya vayehi vechodesh kislev shenat esrim vaani hayiti beshushan habbira vayyavo chanani echad meachay hu vaanashim mihuda vaeshalem al hayehudim happeleta asher nisharu min hashshevi veal yerushalam vayyomru li hannisharim asher nisharu min hashshevi sham bammedina beraa gedola uvcherpa vechomat yerushalam meforatzet ushareha nitztzetu vaesh

Amaran nechemya lammelech benisan shenneemar vayehi bechodesh nisan shenat esrim leartachshaste hammelech yayin lefanav vaessa et hayyayin vaettena lammelech velo hayiti ra lefanav vayyomer li hammelech maddua panecha raim veatta encha chole en ze ki im roa lev vaira harbe meod vaomar lammelech hammelech leolam yichye maddua lo yeru fanay asher hair bet kivrot avotay chareva ushareha ukkelu vaesh

Vayyomer li hammelech al ma ze atta mevakkesh vaetpallel el elohe hashshamayim vaomar lammelech im al hammelech tov veim yitav avdecha lefanecha asher tishlacheni el yehuda el ir kivrot avotay veevnenna vayyomer li hammelech vehashshegal yoshevet etzlo ad matay yihye mahalachcha umatay tashuv vayyitav lifne hammelech vayyishlacheni vaettena lo zeman
Metiv rav yosef beom esrim vearbaa lachodesh bashshishshi bishnat shettayim ledaryavesh uchtiv bashshevii bishnat shettayim beesrim veechad lachodesh veim ita bashshevii bishnat shalosh mibe leh
Amar rabbi avahu koresh melech kasher haya lefichach manu lo kemalche yisrael

Matkef lah rav yosef chada deim ken kashu kerae ahadade dichtiv veshetzi bayeta dena ad yom telata lirach adar di hi shenat shet lemalchut daryavesh malka vetanya beoto zeman lashshana habbaa ala ezra mibbavel vegaluto immo uchtiv vayyavo yerushalam bachodesh hachamishi hi shenat hashsheviit lammelech veim ita shenat hashsheminit mibe leh
Veod mi dame hatam koresh hacha daryavesh tana hu koresh hu daryavesh hu artachshaste koresh shemmelech kasher haya artachshaste al shem malchuto uma shemo daryavesh shemo
Mikkol makom kashya amar rabbi yitzchak la kashya kan kodem shehechmitz kan leachar shehechmitz
Matkef lah rav kahana umi hechmitz vehachtiv

a: Uma chashchan uvne torin vedichrin veimmerin laalavan leelah shemayya chintin melach chamar umshach kememar kahanayya di virushlem leheve mityehev lehom yom beom di la shalu amar lo rabbi yitzchak rabbi mittunach di leheon mehakrevin nichochin leelah shemayya umtzallayin lechayye malka uvnohi
Uman deaved hachi lav mealleuta hi vehatanya haomer sela zo litzdaka bishvil sheyyichu banay uvishvil sheezke bah lechayye haolam habba hare ze tzaddik gamur
La kashya kan beyisrael kan begoyim
Veibaet ema menalan deachmitz dichtiv nidbachin di even gelal telata venidbach di a chadat venifketa min bet malka tityehiv lema leh daavad hachi savar i mardu bi yehudae ikleyeh benura

Attu shelomo la avad hachi vehachtiv shelosha ture gazit vetur kerutot arazim shelomo avad millemala veihu avad millematta shelomo shakkeeh bevinyana ihu la shakkeeh bevinyana shelomo sadyeh besida ihu la sadyeh besida
Amar rav yosef veitema rabbi yitzchak menalan deachmitz mehacha vayyomer li hammelech vehashshegal yoshevet etzlo may shegal amar rabba bar lima mishshemeh derav kalbeta

Ella meatta ha dichtiv veal mare shemayya hitromamta ulmanayya di vayeteh hayetiv kodamach veante veravrevanach sheglatach ulchenatach chamra shatayin behon vei shegal kalbeta hi kalbeta bat mishteya chamra hi ha la kashya demallefa la veshatya

Ella meatta dichtiv benot melachim beyikkerotecha nitztzeva shegal limincha bechetem ofir vei shegal kalbeta hi may ka mevassar lehu navi leyisrael hachi kaamar bischar shechaviva tora leyisrael keshegal laggoyim zechitem lechetem ofir
Veibaet ema leolam shegal malketa hi verabba bar lima gemara gemir lah veammay kare lah shegal shehayeta chaviva alav keshegal i name shehoshivah bimkom shegal
Veibaet ema menalan deachmitz mehacha ad kesaf kakkerin mea vead chintin korin mea vead chamar battin mea vead battin meshach mea umlach di la chetav vego meikara bela kitzuta vehashta bekitzuta
Vedilma meikara la hava kim leh bekitzuta ella mechavarta kidshanniyn meikara
Velargalim regalim beechad benisan hu bachamishsha asar benisan hu amar rav chisda regel shebbo rosh hashshana largalim
Nafka minah lenoder lemekam aleh beval teacher verabbi shimon hi detanya echad hannoder veechad hammakdish veechad hammaarich kevan sheavru alav shelosha regalim over beval teacher

Rabbi shimon omer shelosha regalim kesidran vechag hammatztzot techila vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer regalim peamim shelosha peamim arbaa peamim chamishsha ketzad nadar lifne happesach shelosha lifne atzeret chamishsha lifne hechag arbaa
Tanu rabbanan chayyave haddamin vehaarachin hacharamin vehahekdeshot chattaot vaashamot olot ushlamim tzedakot umaasrot bechor umaaser ufesach
b: Leket shichcha ufea kevan sheavru alehen shelosha regalim over beval teacher rabbi shimon omer shelosha regalim kesidran vechag hammatztzot techilla

Rabbi meir omer kevan sheavar alehen regel echad over beval teacher rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer kevan sheavru alehen shene regalim over beval teacher rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer kevan sheavar alehen chag hassukkot over alehen beval teacher
May tama detanna kamma mikkede minayehu salek lema li lemehdar umichtav bechag hammatztzot uvchag hashshavuot uvchag hassukkot shema minah leval teacher
Verabbi shimon omer eno tzarich lomar bechag hassukkot shebbo diber hakkatuv lamma neemar lomar shezze acharon
Verabbi meir may tama dichtiv uvata shamma vahavetem shamma
Verabbanan hahu laase
Verabbi meir kevan deamar leh rachamana ayeti vela ayeti mimmela kam leh beval teacher
Verabbi eliezer ben yaakov may tama dichtiv elle taasu la bemoadechem miut moadim shenayim
Verabbanan hahu lechidrabbi yona deamar rabbi yona hukshu kol hammoadim kullam ze laze shekkullan mechapperim al tumat mikdash vekadashav
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon may tama detanya rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer lo yeamer chag hassukkot shebbo diber hakkatuv lamma neemar lomar shezze gorem

Verabbi meir verabbi eliezer ben yaakov hay bechag hammatztzot uvchag hashshavuot uvchag hassukkot may darshu beh mibe lehu lechidrabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya deamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya minnayin laatzeret sheyyesh lah tashlumin kol shiva talmud lomar bechag hammatztzot uvchag hashshavuot uvchag hassukkot makkish chag hashshavuot lechag hammatztzot ma chag hammatztzot yesh lo tashlumin kol shiva af chag hashshavuot yesh lo tashlumin kol shiva
Velakish lechag hassukkot ma lehallan shemona af kan shemona shemini regel bifne atzmo hu
Emor deamrinan shemini regel bifne atzmo leinyan pazer kashev aval leinyan tashlumin divre hakkol tashlumin derishon hu
Ditnan mi shello chag yom tov harishon shel chag chogeg et kal haregel veom tov haacharon shel chag
Tafasta merubbe lo tafasta tafasta muat tafasta
Ella lemay hilcheta katveh rachamana lechag hassukkot leakkosheh lechag hammatztzot

a: Ma chag hammatztzot taun lina af chag hassukkot taun lina
Vehatam menalan dichtiv ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha
Vetanna kamma verabbi shimon ben elazar tashlumin laatzeret mena lehu
Nafka lehu middetane rabba bar shemuel detane rabba bar shemuel amra tora mene yamim vekaddesh chodesh mene yamim vekaddesh atzeret ma chodesh limnuyav af atzeret limnuyav
Ema atzeret chad yoma amar rava attu atzeret yome maninan shavue la maninan vehaamar mar mitzva lemimne yome umitzva lemimne shavue veod chag shavuot ketiv
Ufesach bar mikrav birgalim hu pesach zimna kevia leh i akreveh akreveh vei la akreveh idchi leh
Amar rav chisda pesach kedi nasveh
Rav sheshet amar may pesach shalme fesach
I hachi hayenu shelamim tena shelamim habbain mechamat pesach utna shelamim habbain mechamat atzman salka datach amena hoil umechamat pesach kaatu
b: Kefesach damu ka mashma lan
Menahane mile detanu rabbanan ki tiddor neder en li ella neder nedava minnayin
Neemar kan neder veneemar lehallan im neder o nedava ma lehallan nedava immo af kan nedava immo
La elohecha ellu haddamin haarachin vehacharamin vehahekdeshot lo teacher leshallemo hu velo chilufav ki darosh yidreshennu ellu chattaot vaashamot olot ushlamim
Adonai elohecha ellu tzedakot umaasrot uvchor meimmach ze leket shichcha ufea vehaya vecha chet velo bekorbancha chet
Amar mar lo teacher leshallemo hu velo chilufav chilufe may i chilufe ola ushlamim mikrav karvi
I chilufe chattat lemita azla ella may chilufav chilufe toda
Detane rabbi chiyya toda shennitarva bitmuratah umeta achat mehen chavertah en lah takkana
Hechi lebed lakrevah velakrev lechem bahadah dilma temura hi lakrevah bela lechem dilma toda hi
Veha kevan delav bat hakrava hi kera lemaote lema li

Amar rav sheshet leolam lemaote chilufe ola ushlamim vehacha bemay askinan kegon sheavru alav shene regalim vehumam vechillo al acher veavar alav regel echad salka datach amena hoil umikkoach kamma kaate keman deavru alav shelosha regalim dame ka mashma lan

Ulrabbi meir deamar kevan sheavar alav regel echad over beval teacher may ika lememar amar rava hacha bemay askinan kegon shehumam betoch haregel vechillo veavar alav haregel salka datach amena hoil umikkoach kamma kaate keman deavar aleh kulleh regel dame ka mashma lan
Vehaya becha chet velo bekorbancha chet veha mehacha nafka middaacherim nafka detanya acherim omrim yachol yehe bechor sheavra shenato kifsule hammukdashin veyippasel

Talmud lomar veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvchorot bekarcha vetzonecha makkish bechor lemaaser ma maaser eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah af bechor eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah
Itzterich salka datach amena hane mile bechor delav bar hartzaa hu aval kodashim divne hartzaa ninhu ema la liratztzo ka mashma lan
Veakkatti

a: Middeven azzay nafka detanya ben azzay omer oto
Ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar lo teacher leshallemo shomea ani af meacher nidro beval yeratze talmud lomar oto oto belo yeratze veen meacher nidro belo yeratze
Ella becha chet velo beishtecha chet

Salka datach amena hoil veamar rabbi yochanan vei tema rabbi elazar en ishto shel adam meta ella im ken mevakkeshin mimmennu mamon veen lo shenneemar im en lecha leshallem lamma yikkach mishkavcha mittachtecha ema behay aon deval teacher name ishto meta ka mashma lan

Tanu rabbanan motza sefatecha zo mitzvat ase tishmor zo mitzvat lo taase veasita azhara levet din sheyeassuch kaasher nadarta ze neder la elohecha ellu chattaot vaashamot olot ushlamim nedava kemashmao asher dibbarta ellu kodshe bedek habbayit befich zo tzedaka
Amar mar motza sefatecha zo mitzvat ase lema li miuvata shamma vahavetem shamma nafka tishmor zo mitzvat lo taase lema li millo teacher leshallemo nafka
Veasita azhara levet din sheyeassuch lema li miyyakriv oto nafka detanya yakriv oto melammed shekkofin oto yachol beal korcho talmud lomar lirtzono ha ketzad kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani
Chad daamar vela afresh vechad afresh vela akrev
Utzricha dei ashmeinan amar vela afresh mishshum dela kayemeh ledibureh aval afresh vela akrev ema kol hecha deiteh be gazza derachamana iteh tzericha
Vei ashmeinan afresh vela akrev deka mashhe leh gabbeh aval amar vela afresh ema dibura lo kelum hu tzericha
Umi matzet amratte deamar vela afresh veha nedava ketiva utnan e zehu neder haomer hare alay ola vee zo hi nedava haomer hare zo ola
Uma ben neder lindava neder met o nignav chayyav beachrauto nedava meta o nigneva eno chayyav beachrautah
Amar rava mashkachatte lah kegon deamar hare alay ola al menat sheeni chayyav beachrautah
Befich zo tzedaka amar rava utzdaka michayyav alah lealtar may tama deha kayemi aniyyim
Peshita mahu detema kevan divinyana dekorbanot ketiva ad deavri alah shelosha regalim kekorbanot ka mashma lan hatam hu ditlinhu rachamana birgalim aval hacha la deha shechichi aniyyim
Amar rava kevan sheavar alav regel echad over baase

Metivi heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi pappeyas al valad shelamim sheyyikrav shelamim amar rabbi pappeyas ani meid shehayeta lanu para shel zivche shelamim vaachalnuha bappesach veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag
Bishlama befesach la akrevuh emor dimchussar zeman hava ella valdah baatzeret hechi mashhi leh veavri aleh baase
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava kegon
b: Shehaya chole baatzeret rav ashe amar may veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag dekatane chag hashshavuot
Veidach kol hecha detane pesach tane atzeret

Amar rava kevan sheavru alav shelosha regalim bechol yom vaom over beval teacher metivi echad bechor veechad kol hakkodashim kevan sheavru alehem shana belo regalim regalim belo shana over beval teacher
Vehay may teuvteh amar rav kahana man deka motev shappir ka motev mikkede tanna allave ka mehaddar litne bechol yom vaom over beval teacher
Veidach tanna lemikbeeh belav ka mehaddar belave yeteri la ka mehaddar

Gufa echad bechor veechad kol hakkodashim kevan sheavru alehem shana belo regalim regalim belo shana over beval teacher bishlama regalim belo shana mashkachatte lah ella shana belo regalim hechi mashkachatte lah
Hanicha leman deit leh kesidran mashkachatte lah ella leman delet leh kesidran hechi mashkachatte lah
Bishlama lerabbi mashkachatte lah beshana meubberet detanya shana temima rabbi omer mone shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha yom keminyan yemot hachamma

Vachachamim omrim mone shenem asar chodesh miyyom leom veim nitabbera shana nitabbera lo mashkachatte lah lerabbi deakdeshah batar chag hammatztzot dechi meta shilhe adar batraa shana malya regalim la melu ella lerabbanan hechi mashkachatte lah
Kidtane rav shemaya atzeret peamim chamishsha peamim shishsha peamim shiva ha ketzad shenehen melein chamishsha shenehen chaserin shiva echad male veechad chaser shishsha
Uman tanna diflig aleh derav shemaya acherim hi detanya acherim omrim en ben atzeret laatzeret en ben rosh hashshana lerosh hashshana ella arbaa yamim bilvad veim hayeta shana meubberet chamishsha
Bae rabbi zera yoresh mahu beval teacher ki tiddor neder amar rachamana veha la nedar o dilma uvata shamma vahavetem shamma veha michayyav
Ta shema detane rabbi chiyya meimmach perat leoresh
Vehay meimmach mibe leh ze leket shichcha ufea keri beh immach ukri beh meimmach
Bae rabbi zera ishsha ma hi beval teacher mi amrinan ha la michayeva biriyya o dilma ha itah besimcha
Amar leh abbaye vetipok leh deha itah besimcha umi amar abbaye hachi vehaamar abbaye ishsha baalah mesammechah lidvarav derabbi zera kaamar
Ibaya lehu bechor meematay monin lo shana abbaye amar mishshaa shennolad rav acha bar yaakov amar mishshaa shennira lehartzaa
Vela peligi ha betam

a: Ha bevaal mum
Baal mum mi matze achel leh dekim leh beh shekkalu lo chodashav
Tanu rabbanan beechad benisan rosh hashshana lachodashim uliburin velitrumat shekalim veyesh omrim af lischirut battim

Lachodashim menalan dichtiv hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim rishon hu lachem lechodshe hashshana dabberu el kol adat yisrael lemor beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu lahem ish se levet avot se labbayit vehaya lachem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar yom lachodesh hazze veshachatu oto vego uchtiv shamor et chodesh haaviv ezehu chodesh sheyyesh bo aviv heve omer ze nisan vekare leh rishon
Veema iyyar baena aviv veleka veema adar baena rov aviv veleka mide rov aviv ketiv
Ella amar rav chisda mehacha ach bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashshevii beospechem et tevuat haaretz ezehu chodesh sheyyesh bo asifa heve omer ze tishri veka kare leh shevii
Veema merachshevan umay shevii shevii leiyyar baena asif veleka veema elul umay shevii shevii laadar baena rov asif veleka mide rov asif ketiv

Ella amar ravina davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu middivre kabbala lamadnu beom esrim vearbaa leashte asar chodesh hu chodesh shevat rabba bar ulla amar mehacha vattillakach ester el hammelech achashverosh el bet malchuto bachodesh haasiri hu chodesh tevet

Rav kahana amar mehacha bearbaa lachodesh hatteshii bechislev rav acha bar yaakov amar mehacha vayyikkaru sofre hammelech baet hahi bachodesh hashshelishi hu chodesh sivan rav ashe amar mehacha hippil pur hu haggoral lifne haman miyyom leom umechodesh lechodesh shenem asar hu chodesh adar veibaet ema mehacha bachodesh harishon hu chodesh nisan
Vechullehu may tama la amri mehay dilma may rishon rishon lemilteh
Vetanna didan beshanim kamayere bachodashim la kamayere

Uliburin leiburin minnisan maninan vehatanya en meabberin hashshana lifne rosh hashshana veim ibruha enah meubberet aval mippene haddechak meabberin otah achar rosh hashshana miyyad veaf al pi ken en meabberin ella adar
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak may iburin hafsakat iburin ditnan hen heidu shemmeabberin hashshana kol adar shehau omrim ad happurim
May tama deman deamar ad happurim kevan deamar mar shoalin behilchot happesach kodem lappesach sheloshim yom ate lezalzole bechametz
Veidach mida yedia deshatta meabbarta bechushbana talya milleta vesavri chushbana hu dela selek lehu lerabbanan ad haidana
Vetanna didan behatchala kamayere behafsaka la kamayere

Velitrumat shekalim menalan amar rabbi yoshiyya amar kera zot olat chodesh bechodsho lechodshe hashshana amra tora chaddesh vehave korban mitteruma chadasha vegamri shana shana minnisan dichtiv rishon hu lachem lechodshe hashshana

Veligmor shana shana mittishri dichtiv mereshit hashshana danin shana sheyyesh immah chodashim mishshana sheyyesh immah chodashim veen danin shana sheyyesh immah chodashim mishshana sheen immah chodashim
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel korbenot tzibbur habbain beechad benisan mitzva lehavi min hechadash veim hevi min hayyashan yatza ella shechiser mitzva

Peshita mahu detema lechush shemma
b: Lo yimserem latztzibbur yafe yafe ka mashma lan
Vetanna didan kevan dekatane im hevi yatza la pesika leh
