Vaafilu leman deamar yom echad bashshana chashuv shana shane hacha dela tarach inish lemegar beta livtzir mittelatin yomin
Veema tishri setam ki agar inish beta lechullehu yemot haggeshamim agar
Vetanna kamma devarayeta vetanna didan benisan name mishkach shechichi kitre
Beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema manni rabbi meir hi detanya rabbi meir omer beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema
Velargalim manni rabbi shimon hi ema sefa rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim beechad betishri resha vesefa rabbi shimon umtziata rabbi meir
Amar rav yosef rabbi hi venasev lah alliba detannae birgalim savar lah kerabbi shimon uvmasar behema savar lah kerabbi meir
I hachi arbaa chamishsha hau amar rava arbaa ledivre hakkol lerabbi meir arbaa dal regalim lerabbi shimon arbaa dal masar behema
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar arbaa chodashim uvahen kamma rashe shanim

Amar rav pappa ki ka chashev mide dechayel meurta mide dela chayel meurta la ka chashev
Vahare regalim dela chayeli meurta vekachashev kevan shetztzarich leetoye meikara michayyav vekae
Vahare yovlot dela chayeli meurta vekachashev rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi deamar merosh hashshana chayel yovel
Rav shisha bereh derav idi amar ki ka chashev mide dela tele bemaase mide ditle bemaase la ka chashev
Vahare regalim mide ditle bemaase veka chashev bal teacher mimmela chayel

a: Vahare yovlot rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi
Verav ashe amar arba rashe hashshanim hem shehen bearba rashe chodashim
Beechad bishvat kevet shammay hachi kaamar shelosha ledivre hakkol beechad bishvat machloket bet shammay uvet hillel

Rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim beechad betishri amar rabbi yochanan ushnehem mikra echad darshu shenneemar lavshu charim hatztzon vaamakim yaatfu var yitroau af yashiru rabbi meir savar ematay lavshu charim hatztzon bizman sheamakim yaatfu var veematay amakim yaatfu var baadar mitabberot baadar veoldot beav rosh hashshana shellahen elul
Rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim ematay lavshu charim hatztzon bizman sheyyitroau af yashiru ematay shibbolim omrot shira benisan mitabberot benisan veoldot beelul rosh hashshana shellahen tishre
Veidach name ha ketiv yitroau af yashiru hahu beaflata dehaveyan benisan veidach name hachtiv vaamakim yaatfu var hahu becharafyata deatyan meadar

Bishlama lerabbi meir kedichtiv lavshu charim hatztzon bizman sheamakim yaatfu var veika name yitroau af yashiru ella lerabbi elazar verabbi shimon ipcha mibe leh lavshu charim hatztzon bizman sheyyitroau af yashiru veika name daamakim yaatfu var

Ella amar rava dechulle alma lavshu charim hatztzon bizman sheamakim yaatfu var baadar vehacha behay kera kamipalgi asser teasser bishne maasrot hakkatuv medabber echad masar behema veechad maaser dagan

Rabbi meir savar makkish masar behema lemaaser dagan ma maaser dagan samuch ligmaro isuro af masar behema samuch ligmaro isuro verabbi elazar verabbi shimon savri makkish masar behema lemaaser dagan ma maaser dagan rosh hashshana shello tishri af masar behema rosh hashshana shello tishri
Beechad betishri rosh hashshana lashshanim lemay hilcheta amar rav pappa lishtarot ditnan shitre chov hammukdamin pesulin vehamucharin kesherin
Vehatnan beechad benisan rosh hashshana lammelachim veamrinan lemay hilcheta veamar rav chisda lishtarot
La kashya kan lemalche yisrael kan lemalche ummot haolam
Ella ha deamar rav chisda lo shanu ella lemalche yisrael aval lemalche ummot haolam mittishri maninan rav chisda matnitin ata leashmoinan
La rav chisda kerae ata leashmoinan
Veibaet ema rav chisda kerabbi zera matne lah derabbi zera amar lattekufa verabbi eliezer hi deamar betishri nivra haolam
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar laddin dichtiv mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana mereshit hashshana nidon ma yehe besofah
Mimmay detishri hu dichtiv tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leom chaggenu ezehu chag
b: Shehachodesh mitkasse bo heve omer ze rosh hashshana uchtiv ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat lelohe yaakov
Tanu rabbanan ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat lelohe yaakov melammed sheen bet din shel mala nichnasin laddin ella im ken kidshu bet din shel matta et hachodesh
Tanya idach ki chok leyisrael hu en li ella leyisrael leummot haolam minnayin talmud lomar mishpat lelohe yaakov im ken ma talmud lomar ki chok leyisrael melammed sheyyisrael nichnasin techila laddin
Kidrav chisda deamar rav chisda melech vetzibur melech nichnas techila laddin shenneemar mishpat avdo umishpat ammo
May tama i baet ema lav orach ara lemekam malka abbaray veibaet ema mikkamme deliposh charon af
Velashshemitin menalan dichtiv uvashshana hashsheviit shabbat shabbaton yihye laaretz vegamar shana shana mittishri dichtiv mereshit hashshana

Veligmor shana shana minnisan dichtiv rishon hu lachem lechodshe hashshana danin shana sheen immah chodashim mishshana sheen immah chodashim veen danin shana sheen immah chodashim mishshana sheyyesh immah chodashim
Velayyovlot yovlot beechad betishri hu yovlot baasara betishri hu dichtiv beom hakkippurim taaviru shofar

Ha manni rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi detanya vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar beom hakkippurim yachol lo tehe mitkaddeshet ella miyyom hakkippurim veelach talmud lomar vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim melammed shemmitkaddeshet veholechet mittechilatah

Mikkan amar rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka merosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim lo hau avadim niftarin levattehen velo mishtabedin laadonehem ella ochlin veshotin usmechin veatrotehen berashehen kevan shehiggia yom hakkippurim taku bet din beshofar nifteru avadim levattehen vesadot chozrot levalehen
Verabbanan shanim atta mekaddesh vei atta mekaddesh chodashim

Tanya idach yovel hi ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim yachol keshem shemmitkaddeshet veholechet mittechilatah kach mitkaddeshet veholechet besofah veal titmah shehare mosifin mechol al kodesh talmud lomar yovel hi shenat hachamishshim shenat hachamishshim atta mekaddesh vei atta mekaddesh shenat hachamishshim veachat

a: Verabbanan shenat chamishshim atta mone vei atta mone shenat chamishshim veachat leappoke midderabbi yehuda deamar shenat chamishshim ola lechan ulchan ka mashma lan dela
Udmosifin mechol al kodesh menalan

Detanya becharish uvakkatzir tishbot rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich lomar charish vekatzir shel sheviit shehare kevar neemar sadcha lo tizra vego ella charish shel erev sheviit hannichnas lishviit vekatzir shel sheviit hayyotze lemotzae sheviit
Rabbi yishmael omer ma charish reshut af katzir reshut yatza ketzir haomer shehu mitzva

Verabbi yishmael mosifin mechol al kodesh mena leh nafka leh middetanya veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha yachol betisha talmud lomar baerev i baerev yachol mishshettechshach talmud lomar betisha ha ketzad matchil umitanne mibbeod yom melammed shemmosifin mechol al kodesh
En li ella bichnisato bitziato minnayin talmud lomar meerev ad erev
En li ella yom hakkippurim shabbatot minnayin talmud lomar tishbetu yamim tovim minnayin talmud lomar shabbattechem ha ketzad kol makom sheyyesh bo shevut mosifin mechol al kodesh

Verabbi akiva hay veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha may aved leh mibe leh lechidtane chiyya bar rav middifti detane chiyya bar rav middifti veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha vechi betisha mitannin vahalo baasiri mitannin ella lomar lecha kal haochel veshote bitshii maale alav hakkatuv
b: Keilu hitanna teshii vaasiri
Tanu rabbanan yovel hi af al pi shello shamtu af al pi shello taku yachol af al pi shello shillechu talmud lomar hi divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi yose omer yovel hi af al pi shello shamtu af al pi shello shillechu yachol af al pi shello taku talmud lomar hi

Vechi meachar shemmikra echad merabbe umikra echad memaet mippene ma ani omer yovel hi af al pi shello shillechu veen yovel ella im ken taku lefi sheefshar laolam belo shiluach avadim vei efshar laolam belo tekiat shofar
Davar acher zo mesura levet din vezo enah mesura levet din
May davar acher vechi tema i efshar deleka chad besof haolam dela meshallach zo mesura levet din vezo enah mesura levet din
Bishlama lerabbi yose kidkaamar tameh ella lerabbi yehuda may tama amar kera ukratem deror baaretz vekasavar mikra nidrash lefanav velo lifne fanav
Dechulle alma deror leshon cherut may mashma detanya en deror ella leshon cherut amar rabbi yehuda ma leshon deror kimdayyar be dayyara umovil sechora bechol medina
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose aval chachamim omrim shelashtan meakkevot bo kasavri mikra nidrash lefanav velifne fanav ulacharav
Vehachtiv yovel hahu daafilu bechutza laaretz vehachtiv baaretz hahu bizman shennoheg deror baaretz noheg bechutza laaretz bizman sheeno noheg baaretz eno noheg bechutza laaretz
Velintia menalan dichtiv shalosh shanim arelim uchtiv uvashshana harviit veyalef shana shana mittishri dichtiv mereshit hashshana

a: Uferot netia zo asurin ad chamishsha asar bishvat im leorla orla veim lirvai revai
Mena hane mile amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan umatu bah mishshemeh derabbi yannay amar kera uvashshana harviit uvashshana hachamishit
Peamim shebbarviit vaadayin asura mishshum orla ufamim shebbachamishit vaadayin asura mishshum revai
Lema dela kerabbi meir dei rabbi meir ha amar yom echad bashshana chashuv shana detanya par haamur battora setam ben esrim vearbaa chodesh veom echad divre rabbi meir
Rabbi elazar omer ben esrim vearbaa chodesh ushloshim yom shehaya rabbi meir omer kol makom shenneemar egel battora setam ben shana ben bakar ben shettayim par ben shalosh
Afilu tema rabbi meir ki kaamar rabbi meir yom echad bashshana chashuv shana besof shana aval bitchillat shana la
Amar rava velav kal vachomer hu uma nidda sheen techilat hayyom ola lah besofah sof hayyom ole lah bitchillatah shana sheyyom echad ole lah besofah
b: Eno din sheyyom echad ole bitchillatah

Veella may rabbi elazar sheloshim ushloshim bae ditnan en notin veen mavrichin veen markivin erev sheviit pachot mishsheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana veim nata vehivrich vehirkiv yaakor divre rabbi elazar rabbi yehuda omer kol harkava sheenah koletet bishlosha yamim shuv enah koletet rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim shette shabbatot

Ella leolam rabbi meir vechi kaamar sheloshim liklita
I hachi sheloshim veechad bae ka savar yom sheloshim ole lechan ulchan

Amar rabbi yochanan ushnehen mikra echad darshu vayehi beachat veshesh meot shana barishon beechad lechodesh rabbi meir savar middeakkatti yom echad hu deayel bashshana veka kare lah shana shema minah yom echad bashshana chashuv shana
Veidach i ketiv beshesh meot veachat shana kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv beachat veshesh meot shana shana ashshesh meot kae umay achat atchalta deachat kaamar

Mikkelal detarvayehu sevira lehu benisan nivra haolam

Rabbi eliezer omer minnayin shebbetishri noldu avot shenneemar vayyikkahalu el hammelech shelomo kol ish yisrael beyerach haetanim bechag yerach shennoldu bo etane olam

May mashma dehay etan lishana detakkife hu kedichtiv etan moshavecha veomer shimu harim et riv Adonai vehaetanim mosde aretz veomer kol dodi hinne ze ba medalleg al heharim mekappetz al haggevaot medalleg al heharim bizchut avot mekappetz al haggevaot bizchut immahot

Rabbi yehoshua omer minnayin shebbenisan noldu avot shenneemar vayehi vishmonim shana vearba meot shana letzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim bashshana harviit bechodesh ziv beyerach shennoldu bo zivetane olam
Veidach name hachtiv beyerach haetanim hatam detakkife bemitzot

Veidach name hachtiv bechodesh ziv hahu deit beh ziva leilane deamar rav yehuda hay man dinfak beome nisan vechaze ilane dimlavlevi omer baruch shello chiser meolamo kelum uvara bo beriyyot tovot veilanot tovot lehitnaot bahen bene adam

Man deamar benisan noldu benisan metu man deamar betishri noldu betishri metu shenneemar vayyomer alehem ben mea veesrim shana anochi hayyom sheen talmud lomar hayyom uma talmud lomar hayyom hayyom malu yamay ushnotay lelammedcha shehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev ummalle shenotehem shel tzaddikim miyyom leom mechodesh lechodesh shenneemar et mispar yamecha amalle

Befesach nolad yitzchak menalan kedichtiv lammoed ashuv elecha emat kae ilema befesach vekaamar leh baatzeret bechamshin yomin mi ka yalda ella dekae baatzeret vekaamar leh betishri akkatti bechamsha yarche mi ka yalda ella dekae bechag vekaamar lah benisan
Akkatti beshita yarche mi ka yalda tana otah shana meubberet hayeta sof sof ki madle mar yome tuma batzri lehu
Amar mar zutra afilu leman deamar yoledet letisha enah yoledet limkuttain yoledet leshiva yoledet limkuttain shenneemar vayehi litkufot hayyamim miut tekufot shettayim umiut yamim shenayim

Pekida pekida ketiv bechanna ki fakad Adonai et channa uchtiv besara va pakad et sara
Berosh hashshana yatza yosef mibbet haasurin menalan dichtiv tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leom chaggenu ki chok leyisrael hu vego

Benisan nigalu kidita betishri atidin ligael atya shofar shofar ketiv hacha tiku vachodesh shofar uchtiv hatam beom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol
Rabbi yehoshua omer benisan nigalu benisan atidin ligael menalan amar kera lel shimmurim layil hamshummar uva mishsheshet yeme bereshit
Veidach layela hammeshummar uva min hammazzikin

a: Umittoch sheshshinu maasehem shina hakkadosh baruch hu alehem maase vereshit veheela mazzal kima bayyom venatal shene kochavim vehevi mabbul laolam
Bishlama lerabbi yehoshua hayenu dichtiv sheni ella lerabbi eliezer may sheni sheni ledin
Bishlama lerabbi yehoshua hayenu deshina ella lerabbi eliezer may shina
Kidrav chisda deamar rav chisda berotchin kilkelu uvrotchin nidonu berotchin kilkelu baavera uvrotchin nidonu ketiv hacha vayyashokku hammayim uchtiv hatam vachamat hammelech shachacha
Tanu rabbanan chachme yisrael monin lammabbul kerabbi eliezer velattekufa kerabbi yehoshua chachme ummot haolam monin af lammabbul kerabbi yehoshua
Velayerakot tana layerakot velammaasrot velannedarim layerakot may ninhu maaser yarak
Hayenu maasrot tena derabbanan vekatane deorayeta
Velitne deorayeta beresha ayede dachaviva leh akdemah vetanna didan tena derabbanan vechol shekken deorayeta
Velitne maaser echad masar behema veechad masar dagan velitne yarak tere gavene yarak ditnan yarak hanneegad mishsheyyeaged vesheeno neegad mishsheyemalle et hakkeli
Tanu rabbanan liket yarak erev rosh hashshana ad shello tavo hashshemesh vechazar veliket
b: Mishshettavo hashshemesh en tormin umasserin mizze al ze lefi sheen tormin umasserin lo min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash im hayeta sheniyya nichneset lishlishit sheniyya maaser rishon umaaser sheni shelishit maaser rishon umasar ani

Mena hane mile amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi ki techalle laser et kol masar tevuatcha bashshana hashshelishit shenat hammaaser shana sheen bah ella maaser echad ha ketzad maaser rishon umasar ani umaaser sheni yivtal

O eno ella af maaser rishon name yivtal talmud lomar veel halviyyim tedabber veamarta alehem ki tikchu meet bene yisrael et hammaaser asher natatti lachem meittam benachalatchem hikkisho hakkatuv lenachala ma nachala en lah hefsek af maaser rishon en lo hefsek

Tanya idach ki techalle laser vego shana sheen bah ella maaser echad ha ketzad maaser rishon umasar ani umaaser sheni yivtal yachol af maaser rishon name yivtal talmud lomar uva hallevi kol zeman shebba ten lo divre rabbi yehuda

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer eno tzarich hare hu omer veel halviyyim tedabber veamarta alehem ki tikchu meet bene yisrael et hammaaser asher natatti lachem meittam benachalatchem hikkisho hakkatuv lenachala ma nachala en lah hefsek af maaser rishon en lo hefsek

Velannedarim vechu tanu rabbanan hammuddar hanaa mechavero leshana mone shenem asar chodesh miyyom leom veim amar leshana zo afilu lo amad ella beesrim vetisha beelul kevan shehiggia yom echad betishri alta lo shana
Afilu leman deamar yom echad bashshana eno chashuv shana letzaoreh nafsheh kabbel aleh veha itztaar leh
Veema nisan bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam
Tenan hatam hattiltan mishshettitzmach hattevua vehazzetim mishsheyyaviu shelish
May mishshettitzmach mishshettitzmach lizraim

Ella lomar lach kol tevua shehevia shelish bashsheviit lifne rosh hashshana atta noheg bo minhag sheviit bashsheminit
Amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi

a: Vedilma la ayel kelal vekaamar rachamana teshammet vetezil ad chag hassukkot
La salka datach dichtiv vechag haasif betzet hashshana may asif ilema chag habba bizman asifa hachtiv beospecha
Ella may asif katzir vekim lehu lerabbanan dechol tevua shenniktzera bechag beyadua shehevia shelish lifne rosh hashshana veka kare lah betzet hashshana
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera vekim lehu lerabbanan ben shelish lefachot mishshelish amar leh lav amena lach la tappek nafshach levar mehilcheta kol middot chachamim ken hu
Arbaim sea hu tovel bearbaim sea chaser kurtov eno yachol litbol bahen kevetza metamme tumat ochalin kevetza chaser shumshum eno metamme tumat ochalin
Shelosha al shelosha mittamme midras shelosha al shelosha chaser nima achat eno mittamme midras

Hadar amar rabbi yirmeya lav milta hi daamari divo mineh chavrayya merav kahana omer shehikrivu yisrael bichnisatan laaretz mehechan hikrivuhu im tomar deayel beyad goy ketzirchem amar rachamana velo ketzir goy
Mimmay deakrivu dilma la akrivu la salka datach dichtiv vayyochlu meavur haaretz mimmochorat happesach mimmachorat happesach achul meikara la achul deakrivu omer vahadar achli mehechan hikrivu
Amar lahen kol shello hevi shelish beyad goy
Vedilma ayel vela kim lehu ella kim lehu hacha name kim lehu
Vedilma la ayel kelal aval hecha deayel riva ben shelish lefachot mishshelish la kim lehu
La salka datach dichtiv vehaam alu min hayyarden beasor lachodesh vei salka datach dela ayel kelal bechamsha yome mi ka malya
Ella may deayel riva o danka akkatti bechamsha yome mi ka malya ella may it lach lememar eretz tzevi ketiv bah hacha name eretz tzevi ketiv bah
Matkef lah rabbi chanina umi matzet amratte dehay asif katzir hu vehachtiv beospecha miggornecha umiyyikvecha veamar mar bifsolet goren veyekev hakkatuv medabber
Amar rabbi zera ha milta havay bidan vaata rabbi chanina sheda bah narga
Ella menalan kidtanya rabbi yonatan ben yosef omer veasat et hattevua lishlosh hashshanim
b: Al tikre lishlosh ella lishlish
Veha mibe leh legufeh ketiv kera acharina uzratem et hashshana hashsheminit vaachaltem min hattevua yashan ad hashshana hatteshiit
Tenan hatam haorez vehaddochan vehapperagin vehashshumshemin shehishrishu lifne rosh hashshana mitasserin lesheavar umuttarin bashsheviit veim lav asurin bashsheviit umitasserin leshana habbaa
Amar rabba amur rabbanan ilan batar chanata tevua vezetim batar shelish yarak batar lekita hane keman shavinhu rabbanan
Hadar amar rabba mittoch sheasuyin perachin perachin azli rabbanan batar hashrasha
Amar leh abbaye veyitzbor gorno letocho venimtza torem min hechadash shebbo al hechadash shebbo min hayyashan shebbo al hayyashan shebbo

Mi la tanya rabbi yose ben kipar amar mishshum rabbi shimon shezuri pol hammitzri shezzerao lezera miktzato hishrish lifne rosh hashshana umiktzato hishrish leachar rosh hashshana en tormin umasserin mizze al ze lefi sheen tormin umasserin lo min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash
Ketzad hu ose tzover gorno letocho venimtza torem umasser min hechadash shebbo al hechadash shebbo umin hayyashan shebbo al hayyashan shebbo
Amar leh rabbi shimon shezuri kaamratte rabbi shimon shezuri savar yesh bila
Verabbanan savri en bila

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose ben kipar sheamar mishshum rabbi shimon shezuri matkef lah rabbi zera umi amar shemuel hachi vehaamar shemuel lakkol en bila chutz miyyayin vashemen
Ishtemitteh ha deamar shemuel hakkol holech achar gemar peri

a: Utzricha dei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri hava amena mishshum dekasavar yesh bila ka mashma lan lakkol en bila
Vei ashmeinan lakkol en bila hava amena kerabbanan sevira leh ka mashma lan halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte hava amena kashya dishmuel addishmuel ka mashma lan hakkol holech achar gemar peri
Vei ashmeinan hakkol holech achar gemar peri hava amena afilu tevua vezetim name ka mashma lan halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri bemay diflig
Velashmeinan hane tarte lakkol en bila lema li ha ka mashma lan dilyayin vashemen yesh bila

Tanya rabbi yose haggelili omer beospecha miggornecha umiyyikvecha ma goren vayekev meuchadin sheggedelin al me shana sheavra umitasserin leshana sheavra af kol sheggedelin al me shana sheavra mitasserin leshana sheavra yatzu yerakot sheggedelin al me shana habbaa umitasserin leshana habbaa

Rabbi akiva omer beospecha miggornecha umiyyikvecha ma goren veyekev meuchadin sheggedelin al rov mayim umitasserin leshana sheavra af kol sheggedelin al rov mayim mitasserin leshana sheavra yatzu yerakot sheggedelin al kol mayim umitasserin leshana habbaa

May benayehu amar rabbi avahu betzalim hassarisin ufol hammitzri ika benayehu ditnan betzalim hassarisin ufol hammitzri shemmana mehen mayim sheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana mitasserin lesheavar umuttarin bashsheviit veim lav asurin bashsheviit umitasserin leshana habbaa
Beechad bishvat rosh hashshana lailan may tama amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya hoil veyatzu rov gishme shana vaadayin rov tekufa mibbachutz
May kaamar hachi kaamar af al pi sherov tekufa mibbachutz hoil veyatzu rov gishme shana
Tanu rabbanan maase berabbi akiva shelliket etrog beechad bishvat venahag bo shene isurin
b: Echad kedivre bet shammay veechad kedivre bet hillel
Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer lo minhag bet shammay uvet hillel nahag bah ella minhag rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer nahag bah
Ditnan etrog shave lailan bishlosha derachim velayyarak bederech echad shave lailan bishlosha derachim leorla velirvai velishviit ulyarak bederech echad shebbishat lekitato isuro divre rabban gamliel
Rabbi eliezer omer etrog shave lailan lechol davar

Umi avdinan kitre chumre vehatanya leolam halacha kedivre bet hillel veharotze laasot kedivre bet shammay ose kedivre bet hillel ose mikkulle bet shammay umikkulle bet hillel rasha mechumre bet shammay umechumre bet hillel alav hakkatuv omer vehakkesil bachoshech holech ella i kevet shammay bekullehon uvchumrehon i kevet hillel bekullehon uvchumrehon
Rabbi akiva gemareh istappak leh vela yeda i bet hillel beechad bishvat omer i bachamishsha asar bishvat omer
Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer lo minhag bet shammay uvet hillel nahag bah ella minhag rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer nahag bah beechad bishvat kevet shammay nahag bah
Amar rabbi chanina veitema rabbi chananya hacha beetrog shechantu perotav kodem chamishsha asar deidach shevat askinan uvdin hu afilu kodem lachen umaase shehaya kach haya
Ravina amar keroch utni lo echad bishvat haya ella chamishsha asar bishvat haya velo minhag bet shammay uvet hillel nahag bah ella minhag rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer nahag bah
Amar rabba bar rav huna hashta deamar rabban gamliel etrog achar lekitato isuro keyarak rosh hashshana shello tishri

Metivi rabbi shimon ben elazar omer liket etrog erev chamishsha asar bishvat ad shello tavo hashshemesh vechazar veliket mishshettavo hashshemesh en tormin umasserin mizze al ze lefi sheen tormin umasserin lo min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash hayeta shelishit nichneset lirviit shelishit maaser rishon umasar ani reviit maaser rishon umaaser sheni

a: Man shamatte leh deazel batar lekita rabban gamliel vekatane shevat
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar amar rabba bar rav huna af al gav deamar rabban gamliel etrog achar lekita keyarak rosh hashshana shello shevat
May shena hatam dekatane im hayeta sheniyya nichneset lishlishit umay shena hacha dekatane im hayeta shelishit nichneset lirviit
Milta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan deetrog kashya leh yeda veayede dimmashmeshi beh kulle alma bishviit la taen pere ad telat shenin
Bea mineh rabbi yochanan merabbi yannay etrog rosh hashshana shello ematay amar leh shevat shevat dachodashim o shevat ditkufa amar leh dachodashim
Bea mineh rava merav nachman veamri lah rabbi yochanan merabbi yannay hayeta shana meubberet mahu amar leh hallech achar rov shanim
Amar rabba etrog bat shishshit shennichnesa lishviit petura min hammaaser uftura min habbiur uvat sheviit shennichnesa lishminit petura bammaaser vechayyevet babbiur
Amar leh abbaye bishlama sefa lechumra ella resha petura min habbiur ammay deamrinan zil batar chanata i hachi tichayyav bemaaser
Amar leh yad hakkol memashmeshin bah veatte amratte tichayyav bemaaser
Verav hamnuna amar bat shishshit shennichneset lishviit leolam shishshit uvat sheviit hannichneset lishminit leolam sheviit

Metivi rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon etrog bat shishshit shennichneset lishviit petura min hammaaser uftura min habbiur sheen lecha davar shechayyav bemaaser ella im ken gadal bechiyyuv venilkat bechiyyuv uvat sheviit shennichneset lishminit petura min hammaaser uftura min habbiur sheen lecha davar shechayyav beviur ella im ken gadal bishviit venilkat bishviit
Resha kashya lerav hamnuna sefa kashya ben lerabba ben lerav hamnuna
Tannae hi detanya amar rabbi yose avtulmos heid mishshum chamishsha zekenim etrog achar lekitato lemaaser verabbotenu nimnu beusha veamru achar lekitato ben lemaaser ben lishviit
Sheviit man dechar shemeh
b: Chassore michassera vehachi katane etrog achar lekitato lemaaser veachar chanata lishviit verabbotenu nimnu beusha achar lekitato ben lemaaser ben lishviit

Itmar rabbi yochanan veresh lakish amri tarvayehu etrog bat shishshit shennichnesa lishviit leolam shishshit ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan etrog bat shishshit shennichnesa lishviit afilu kezayit venaaset kikkar chayyavin aleha mishshum tevel

Tanu rabbanan ilan shechantu perotav kodem chamishsha asar bishvat mitasser leshana sheavra achar chamishsha asar bishvat mitasser leshana habbaa amar rabbi nechemya bamme devarim amurim beilan sheose shette verichot bashshana
Shette verichot salka datach ella ema keen shette verichot
Aval ilan haose bericha achat kegon dekalim vezetim vecharuvin af al pi shechantu perotehen kodem chamishsha asar bishvat mitasserin leshana habbaa
Amar rabbi yochanan nahagu haam becharuvin kerabbi nechemya
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan benot shuach sheviit shellahen sheniyya mippene sheosot lishlosh hashshanim
Ishtik amar leh rabbi abba hakkohen lerabbi yose hakkohen ammay ishtik lema leh amena lach ana rabbi nechemya veatte amratte li rabbanan
Mishshum daamar leh shavkatte rabbanan veavdatte kerabbi nechemya
Velema leh kaamena lach nahagu veatte amratte li isura daamar leh bimkom isura ki nahagu shavkinan lehu
Velema leh ki amena lach ana maaser charuvin derabbanan veatte amratte li sheviit deorayeta
Ella amar rabbi abba hakkohen temehani im heshivah resh lakish litshuva zo im heshivah ha otvah ella ema im kiblah rabbi yochanan im la kiblah

a: Matni bearbaa perakim haolam nidon bappesach al hattevua baatzeret al perot hailan berosh hashshana kol bae olam ovrin lefanav kivne maron shenneemar hayyotzer yachad libbam hammevin el kol maasehem uvechag nidonin al hammayim
Gema he tevua ilema ha tevua dekayema kol hane harpatke daado alah emat itdun ella tevua demizdara

Lememra dechad dina mittadna vehatanya tevua sheera bah keri o ones kodem happesach nidonet lesheavar leachar happesach nidonet lehabba adam sheera bo keri o ones kodem yom hakkippurim nidon lesheavar leachar yom hakkippurim nidon lehabba
Amar rava shema minah tere dine mittadna amar abbaye hilkach ki chaze inash dematzlach zara afla likaddem velizra charfa dead demate lemedayeneh kadem salek
Manni matnitin la rabbi meir vela rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yose vela rabbi natan

Detanya hakkol nidonim barosh hashshana ugzar din shellahem nechtam beom hakkippurim divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer hakkol nidonin berosh hashshana ugzar din shellahem nechtam kol echad veechad bizmanno bappesach al hattevua baatzeret al perot hailan bechag nidonin al hammayim veadam nidon berosh hashshana ugzar din shello nechtam beom hakkippurim
Rabbi yose omer adam nidon bechol yom shenneemar vattifkedennu livkarim rabbi natan omer adam nidon bechol shaa shenneemar lirgaim tivchanennu
Vechi tema leolam rabbi yehuda hi vechi katane matnitin aggezar din i hachi kashya adam

Amar rava hay tana deve rabbi yishmael hi detana deve rabbi yishmael bearbaa perakim haolam nidon bappesach al hattevua baatzeret al perot hailan bechag nidonin al hammayim veadam nidon barosh hashshana ugzar din shello nechtam beom hakkippurim vechi katane matnitin attechillat din
Amar rav chisda may tama derabbi yose kidkaamar tameh vattifkedennu livkarim anan hachi kaamrinan may tama la amar kerabbi natan bechina ayyone bealma hi pekida name ayyone bealma hi
Ella amar rav chisda tameh derabbi yose mehacha laasot mishpat avdo umishpat ammo yisrael devar yom beomo

Veamar rav chisda melech vetzibbur melech nichnas techilla laddin shenneemar laasot mishpat avdo umishpat ammo yisrael may tama ibaet ema lav orach ara lemetav malka abbaray veibaet ema mikkamme deliposh charon af

Amar rav yosef keman metzallinan haidana akketzire veammerie keman kerabbi yose veibaet ema leolam kerabbanan vechidrabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak yafa tzeaka laadam ben kodem gezar din ben leachar gezar din

Tanya amar rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi akiva mippene ma amra tora haviu omer bappesach mippene shehappesach zeman tevua hu amar hakkadosh baruch hu haviu lefanay omer bappesach kede shettitbarech lachem tevua shebbassadot umippene ma amra tora haviu shette hallechem baatzeret mippene sheatzeret zeman perot hailan hu amar hakkadosh baruch hu haviu lefanay shette hallechem baatzeret kede sheyyitbarchu lachem perot hailan

Umippene ma amra tora nassechu mayim bechag amar hakkadosh baruch hu nassechu lefanay mayim bechag kede sheyyitbarchu lachem gishme shana veimru lefanay berosh hashshana malchiyyot zichronot veshofarot malchiyyot kede shettamlichuni alechem zichronot kede sheyyaale zichronchem lefanay letova uvamme beshofar

Amar rabbi avahu lama tokin beshofar shel ayil amar hakkadosh baruch hu tiku lefanay beshofar shel ayil kede sheezkor lachem akedat yitzchak ben avraham umaale ani alechem keilu akadtem atzmechem lefanay
Veamar rabbi yitzchak lamma tokin berosh hashshana lamma tokin rachamana amar tiku ella lamma meriin meriin rachamana amar zichron terua ella lamma tokin umriin keshehen yoshvin
b: Vetokin umriin keshehen omdin kede learbev hassatan
Veamar rabbi yitzchak kol shana sheen tokin lah bitchillatah meriin lah besofah may tama dela iarbav satan
Veamar rabbi yitzchak kol shana sherasha bitchillatah mitashsheret besofah shenneemar mereshit hashshana mereshit ketiv vead acharit sofah sheyyesh lah acharit
Veamar rabbi yitzchak en danin et haadam ella lefi maasav shel otah shaa shenneemar ki shama elohim el kol hannaar baasher hu sham

Veamar rabbi yitzchak shelosha devarim mazkirin aonotav shel adam ellu hen kir natuy veiyyun tefilla umoser din al chavero deamar rabbi avin kal hammoser din al chavero hu neenash techilla shenneemar vattomer saray el avram chamasi alecha uchtiv vayyavo avraham lispod lesara velivkotah

Veamar rabbi yitzchak arbaa devarim mekarin gezar dino shel adam ellu hen tzedaka tzeaka shinuy hashshem veshinuy maase tzedaka dichtiv utzdaka tatztzil mimmavet tzeaka dichtiv vayyitzaku el Adonai batztzar lahem umimmetzukotehem yotziem shinuy hashshem dichtiv saray ishtecha lo tikra et shemah saray ki sara shemah uchtiv uverachti otah vegam natatti mimmenna lecha ben shinuy maase dichtiv vayyar haelohim et maasehem uchtiv vayyinnachem haelohim al haraa asher dibber laasot lahem velo asa
Veyesh omrim af shinuy makom dichtiv vayyomer Adonai el avram lech lecha meartzecha vahadar veeescha legoy gadol veidach hahu zechuta deeretz yisrael hu deahanya leh
Veamar rabbi yitzchak chayyav adam lehakbil pene rabbo baregel shenneemar maddua atte holechet elav hayyom lo chodesh velo shabbat mikkelal divchodesh veshabbat ibi lah lemezal
Veamar rabbi yitzchak chayyav adam letaher et atzmo baregel shenneemar uvnivlatam lo tiggau
Tanya name hachi uvinvalatam lo tiggau yachol yehu yisrael muzharin al magga nevela talmud lomar emor el hakkohanim bene aharon bene aharon muzharin bene yisrael en muzharin
Vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma tuma chamura kohanim muzharin yisreelim enan muzharin tuma kalla lo kol shekken ella ma talmud lomar uvnivlatam lo tiggau baregel

Amar rabbi keruspaday amar rabbi yochanan shelosha sefarim niftachin berosh hashshana echad shel reshaim gemurin veechad shel tzaddikim gemurin veechad shel benoniyyim tzaddikim gemurin nichtavin venechtamin lealtar lechayyim reshaim gemurin nichtavin venechtamin lealtar lemita benoniyyim teluyin veomdin merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim zachu nichtavin lechayyim lo zachu nichtavin lemita

Amar rabbi avin may kera yimmachu missefer chayyim veim tzaddikim al yikkatevu yimmachu missefer ze sifran shel reshaim gemurin chayyim ze sifran shel tzaddikim veim tzaddikim al yikkatevu ze sifran shel benoniyyim
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha veim ayin mecheni na missifrecha asher katavta mecheni na ze sifran shel reshaim missifrecha ze sifran shel tzaddikim asher katavta ze sifran shel benoniyyim

Tanya bet shammay omrim shalosh kittot hen leom haddin achat shel tzaddikim gemurin veachat shel reshaim gemurin veachat shel benoniyyim tzaddikim gemurin nichtavin venechtamin lealtar lechayye olam reshaim gemurin nichtavin venechtamin lealtar legehinnam shenneemar verabbim miyeshene admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam veelle lacharafot lediron olam benoniyyim yordin legehinnam

a: Umtzaftzefin veolin shenneemar veheveti et hashshelishit baesh utzraftim kitzrof et hakkesef uvchantim kivchon et hazzahav hu yikra vishmi vaani eene oto vaalehem amra channa Adonai memit umchayye morid sheol vayyaal
Bet hillel omrim verav chesed matte kelappe chesed vaalehem amar david ahavti ki yishma Adonai et koli vaalehem amar david kol happarasha kullah dalloti veli yehoshia

Poshe yisrael begufan ufoshe ummot haolam begufan yordin legehinnam venidonin bah shenem asar chodesh leachar shenem asar chodesh gufan kale venishmatan nisrefet veruach mefazzartan tachat kappot ragle tzaddikim shenneemar veassotem reshaim ki yihu efer tachat kappot raglechem

Aval hamminin vehammasorot vehaeppikorsim shekkafru battora veshekkafru bitchiyyat hammetim vesheppershu middarche tzibbur veshennatnu chititam beeretz chayyim veshechatu vehechtiu et harabbim kegon yarovam ben nevat vachaverav yordin legehinnam venidonin bah ledore dorot shenneemar veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi vego

Gehinnam kale vehen enan kalin shenneemar vetzuram levallot sheol mizzevul lo vechol kach lamma mippene sheppashtu yedehem bizvul shenneemar mizzevul lo veen zevul ella bet hammikdash shenneemar bano vaniti bet zevul lach vaalehem amra channa Adonai yechattu merivav
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar avin ufnehem domin leshule kedera veamar rava veinhu mishshappire shappire bene machoza umikkaryin bene gehinnam
Amar mar bet hillel omrim verav chesed matte kelappe chesed vehachtiv veheveti et hashshelishit baesh hatam befoshe yisrael begufan

Poshe yisrael begufan veha amratte let lehu takkanta ki let lehu takkana berov aonot hacha mechetza aonot umechetza zechiyyot veit behu name aon defoshe yisrael begufan la sagya leh delav veheveti et hashshelishit baesh veim lav verav chesed matte kelappe chesed vaalehen amar david ahavti ki yishma Adonai

Daresh rava may dichtiv ahavti ki yishma Adonai amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam ematay ani ahuva lefanecha bizman sheatta shomea kol tachanunay dalloti veli yehoshia af al pi sheddalla ani min hammitzot li nae lehoshia
Poshe yisrael begufan may nihu amar rav karkafta dela mannach tefillin poshe ummot haolam begufan amar rav baavera

Veshennatnu chititam beeretz chayyim amar rav chisda ze parnas hammattil ema yetera al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim amar rav yehuda amar rav kol parnas hammattil ema yetera al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim eno roe ben talmid chacham shenneemar lachen yereuhu anashim lo yire kol chachme lev

Bet hillel omrim verav chesed matte kelappe chesed hechi aved rabbi eliezer omer kovsho shenneemar yashuv yerachamenu yichbosh aonotenu rabbi yose bar chanina amar nose shenneemar nose aon veover al pesha
Tana deve rabbi yishmael maavir rishon rishon vechen hi hammidda amar rava veaon atzmo eno nimchak dei ika rubba aonot michashiv bahadayehu
Rava amar kol hammaavir al middotav maavirin lo al kol peshaav shenneemar nose aon veover al pesha lemi nose aon lemi sheover al pesha

Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chalash al rav pappa leshayyole beh chazyeh dachalish leh alma amar lehu tzevitu leh zevadta lesof itfach hava miksif rav pappa lemichzeyeh amaru leh may chazet amar lehu in hachi hava vaamar lehu hakkadosh baruch hu hoil vela mokem bemileh la tekumu bahadeh shenneemar nose aon veover al pesha lemi nose aon leover pesha
Lisherit nachalato amar rabbi acha bar chanina alya vekotz bah lisherit nachalato velo lechol nachalato
b: Lemi shemmesim atzmo keshirayim
Rav huna rame ketiv tzaddik Adonai bechol derachav uchtiv vechasid bechol maasav battechilla tzaddik ulvassof chasid
Rabbi elazar rame ketiv ulcha Adonai chased uchtiv ki atta teshallem leish kemaasehu battechilla ki atta teshallem kemaasehu ulvassof ulcha Adonai chased
Ilfay veamri lah ilfa rame ketiv verav chesed uchtiv veemet battechilla veemet ulvassof verav chesed

Vayyaavor Adonai al panav vayyikra amar rabbi yochanan ilmale mikra katuv i efshar leomro melammed shennitattef hakkadosh baruch hu kishliach tzibbur vehera lo lemoshe seder tefilla amar lo kol zeman sheyyisrael chotin yaasu lefanay kasseder hazze vaani mochel lahem
Adonai Adonai ani hu kodem sheyyechta haadam vaani hu leachar sheyyechta haadam veyaase teshuva el rachum vechannun
Amar rav yehuda berit keruta lishlosh esre middot sheenan chozrot rekam shenneemar hinne anochi koret berit
Amar rabbi yochanan gedola teshuva shemmekaraat gezar dino shel adam shenneemar hashmen lev haam hazze veoznav hachbed veenav hasha pen yire veenav uvoznav yishma ulvavo yavin vashav verafa lo
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye vedilma lifne gezar din amar leh verafa lo ketiv ezehu davar shetztzarich refua heve omer ze gezar din
Metivi hashshav bentayim mochalin lo lo shav bentayim afilu hevi kol ele nevaot shebbaolam en mochalin lo la kashya ha beyachid ha betzibbur

Metivi ene Adonai elohecha bah ittim letova ittim leraa ittim letova ketzad hare shehau yisrael reshaim gemurin berosh hashshana ufasku lahem geshamim muatim lesof chazru bahen lehosif alehen i efshar shekkevar nigzera gezera ella hakkadosh baruch hu moridan bizmannan al haaretz hatztzericha lahen hakkol lefi haaretz

Ittim leraa ketzad hare shehau yisrael tzaddikim gemurin berosh hashshana ufasku alehen geshamim merubbin lesof chazru bahen lifchot mehen i efshar shekkevar nigzera gezera ella hakkadosh baruch hu moridan shello bizmannan al haaretz sheenah tzericha lahen
Letova miha likreeh ligzar dinayehu velosef lehu shane hatam deefshar behachi

Ta shema yorde hayyam booniyyot ose melacha bemayim rabbim hemma rau maase Adonai vego vayyomer vayyaamed ruach seara vatteromem gallav yachoggu veyanuu kashshikkor vego vayyitzaku el Adonai batztzar lahem vego yodu la chasdo vego
Asa lahen simaniyyot keakkin verakkin shebbattora lomar lach tzaaku kodem gezar din naanin tzaaku leachar gezar din enan naanin
Hane name kichidin damu
Ta shema shaala belorya haggiyyoret et rabban gamliel ketiv betoratchem asher lo yissa fanim uchtiv yissa Adonai panav elecha

Nitpal lah rabbi yose hakkohen amar lah emshol lacha mashal lema haddavar dome leadam shennoshe bachavero mane vekava lo zeman bifne hammelech venishba lo bechayye hammelech higgia zeman velo perao ba lefayyes et hammelech veamar lo elboni machul lach lech ufayyes et chavercha hacha name kan baaverot shebben adam lemakom kan baaverot shebben adam lachavero
Ad shebba rabbi akiva velimed

a: Kan kodem gezar din kan leachar gezar din hacha name beyachid
Ugzar din deyachid tannae hi detanya haya rabbi meir omer shenayim shealu lammitta vecholyan shave vechen shenayim shealu laggardom lidon vedinan shave ze yarad veze lo yarad ze nitzal veze lo nitzal

Mippene ma ze yarad veze lo yarad ze nitzal veze lo nitzal ze hitpallel venaana veze hitpallel velo naana mippene ma ze naana veze lo naana ze hitpallel tefilla shelema naana veze lo hitpallel tefilla shelema lo naana
Rabbi elazar amar kan kodem gezar din kan leachar gezar din rabbi yitzchak amar yafa tzeaka laadam ben kodem gezar din ben leachar gezar din
Ugzar din detzibbur mi mikra veha katuv echad omer kabbesi meraa libbech uchtiv ki im techabbesi banneter vetarbi lach borit nichtam aonech lefanay may lav kan kodem gezar din kan leachar gezar din
La ide veide leachar gezar din vela kashya kan bigzar din sheyyesh immo shevua kan bigzar din sheen immo shevua

Kidrav shemuel bar amme deamar rav shemuel bar amme veamri lah amar rav shemuel bar nachmani amar rav yonatan minnayin ligzar din sheyyesh immo shevua sheeno nikra shenneemar velachen nishbati levet eli im yitkapper aon bet eli bezevach uvmincha

Amar rava bezevach uvammincha eno mitkapper aval mitkapper betora abbaye amar bezevach umincha eno mitkapper aval mitkapper betora uvigmilut chasadim rabba veabbaye middevet eli kaatu rabba daasak battora chaya arbein shenin abbaye daasak betora uvigmilut chasadim chaya shitin shenin

Tanu rabbanan mishpacha achat hayeta birushalayim shehau meteha metin bene shemone esre shana bau vehodiu et rabban yochanan ben zakkay amar lahem shemma mimmishpachat eli attem dichtiv beh vechol marbit betcha yamutu anashim lechu veisku battora vichu halchu veasku battora vechau vehau korin otah mishpachat rabban yochanan al shemo

Amar rav shemuel bar inya mishshemeh derav minnayin ligzar din shel tzibbur sheeno nechtam eno nechtam vehachtiv nichtam aonech lefanay ella af al gav shennechtam nikra shenneemar ka elohenu bechol korenu elav
Vehachtiv dirshu Adonai behimmatzo hatam beyachid hacha betzibbur

Beyachid emat amar rabba bar avuh ellu asara yamim shebben rosh hashshana leom hakkippurim vayehi kaaseret hayyamim vayyiggof Adonai et naval asara yamim may avidtayehu amar rav yehuda amar rav keneged eser legimot shennatan naval leavde david amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh ellu asara yamim shebben rosh hashshana leom hakkippurim
Berosh hashshana kol bae haolam ovrin lefanav kivne maron may kivne maron hacha targimu kivne immerana resh lakish amar kemaalot bet maron amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kachayalot shel bet david

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan vechullan niskarin biskira achat amar rav nachman bar yitzchak af anan name tenena hayyotzer yachad libbam hammevin el kol maasehem may kaamar ilema hachi kaamar divranhu lechulle alma umyached libbayehu kahadaday veha ka chazenan delav hachi hu ella lav hachi kaamar hayyotzer roe yachad libbam umevin el kol maasehem

b: Deamar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida may dichtiv ko amar Adonai tzevaot tzom harvii vetzom hachamishi vetzom hashshevii vetzom haasiri yihye levet yehuda lesason ulsimcha kare lehu tzom vekare lehu sason vesimcha bizman sheyyesh shalom yihu lesason ulsimcha en shalom tzom
Amar rav pappa hachi kaamar bizman sheyyesh shalom yihu lesason ulsimcha yesh shemad tzom en shemad veen shalom ratzu mitannin ratzu en mitannin
I hachi tisha beav name amar rav pappa shane tisha beav hoil vehuchpelu bo tzarot deamar mar betisha beav charav habbayit barishona uvashsheniyya venilkeda betar venechersha hair

Tanya amar rabbi shimon arbaa devarim haya rabbi akiva doresh vaani en doresh kemoto tzom harvii ze tisha betammuz shebbo huvkea hair shenneemar barvii betisha lachodesh vayyechezak haraav bair velo haya lechem leam haaretz vattibbaka hair veammay kare leh revii revii lechodashim

Tzom hachamishi ze tisha beav shebbo nisraf bet elohenu veammay kare leh chamishi chamishi lechodashim tzom hashshevii ze shelosha betishri shebbo neherag gedalya ben achikam umi harago yishmael ben netanya harago lelammedcha sheshshekula mitatan shel tzaddikim kisrefat bet elohenu veammay kare leh shevii shevii lechodashim

Tzom haasiri ze asara betevet shebbo samach melech bavel al yerushalayim shenneemar vayehi devar Adonai elay bashshana hatteshiit bachodesh haasiri beasor lachodesh lemor ben adam ketov lecha et shem hayyom et etzem hayyom hazze samach melech bavel el yerushalam veammay kare leh asiri asiri lechodashim vahalo haya rauy ze lichtov rishon velamma nichtav kan kede lehasdir chodashim ketiknan

Vaani eni omer ken ella tzom haasiri ze chamishsha betevet shebbo bat shemua laggola shehukketa hair shenneemar vayehi bishte esre shana baasiri bachamishsha lachodesh legalutenu ba elay happalit mirushalam lemor hukketa hair veasu yom shemua keom serefa
Venirin devaray middevarav sheani omer al rishon rishon veal acharon acharon vehu omer al rishon acharon veal acharon rishon ella shehu mone leseder chodashim vaani mone leseder puraniyyot
Itmar rav verabbi chanina amri batla megilat taanit rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi amri lo batla megilat taanit
Rav verabbi chanina amri batla megilat taanit hachi kaamar bizman sheyyesh shalom yihu lesason ulsimcha en shalom tzom vehanach name ki hane
Rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi amri lo batla megilat taanit hane hu ditlinhu rachamana bevinyan bet hammikdash aval hanach kidkayemi kayemi
Metiv rav kahana maase vegazru taanit bachanukka belod veyarad rabbi eliezer verachatz verabbi yehoshua vesiper veamru lahem tzeu vehitannu al ma shehitannitem
Amar rav yosef shane chanukka deika mitzva amar leh abbaye vetivtal ihi vetivtal mitzvatah
Ella amar rav yosef shane chanukka demiparsam nisa

Motev rav acha bar huna bitlata betishri betelat adkarta min shetarayya sheggazra malchut yavan gezera shello lehazkir shem shamayim al pihem uchsheggavra malchut chashmonay venitztzechum hitkinu sheyehu mazkirin shem shamayim afilu bishtarot vechach hau kotvim bishnat kach vechach leochanan kohen gadol leel elon

Uchsheshshamu chachamim baddavar amru lemachar ze porea et chovo venimtza shetar muttal baashpa uvitlum veoto hayyom asauhu yom tov vei salka datach batla megilat taanit kammayata betul achranyata mosifin
Hacha bemay askinan bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam

a: Vetipok leh dehave leh yom shenneherag bo gedalya ben achikam amar rav lo nitzrecha ella leesor et shellefanav
Shellefanav name tipok leh dehave leh yom shelleachar rosh chodesh rosh chodesh deorayeta udorayeta la bae chizuk

Detanya hayyamim haelle hakketuvin bimgilat taanit asurin ben lifnehem ben leacharehem shabbatot veyamim tovim hem asurim lifnehen ulacharehen muttarin ma hefresh ben ze laze hallalu divre tora veen divre tora tzerichin chizuk hallalu divre sofrim vedivre sofrim tzerichin chizuk
Vetipok leh dehave leh yom shellifne yom shenneherag bo gedalya ben achikam amar rav ashe gedalya ben achikam divre kabbala hu vedivre kabbala kedivre tora damu

Metiv rav tovi bar matna beesrim utmanya beh atat besorta tavta lihudae dela yeidon meorayeta sheggazra malchut harshaa gezera shello yaasku battora veshello yamulu et benehem vesheyechallelu shabbatot ma asa yehuda ben shammua vachaverav halchu venatlu etza mimmatronita achat shekkol gedole romi metzuyin etzlah

Amra lahem bou vehafginu ballayela halchu vehifginu ballayela amru e shamayim lo achechem anachnu velo bene av echad anachnu velo bene em achat anachnu ma nishtannenu mikkol umma velashon sheattem gozrin alenu gezerot kashot uvitlum veoto hayyom asauhu yom tov vei salka datach batla megilat taanit kammayata betul achranyata mosifin

Vechi tema hacha name bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam veha yehuda ben shammua talmido shel rabbi meir verabbi meir batar hachi hava ditnan kele zechuchit shennikvu vehittif letochan avar amar rabban shimon ben gamliel yehuda ben shammua metamme mishshum rabbi meir
b: Vachachamim metaharin

Tannae hi detanya hayyamim haellu hakketuvin bimgilat taanit ben bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam ben bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyam asurin divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam asurin mippene shessimcha hi lahem en bet hammikdash kayyam muttarin mippene sheevel hu lahem
Vehilcheta batlu vehilcheta lo batlu kashya hilcheta ahilcheta la kashya kan bachanukka ufurim kan bishar yome
Al elul mippene rosh hashshana veal tishri mippene takkanat hammoadot kevan denafki lehu aelul attishri lema lehu
Vechi tema dilma abberuh leelul vehaamar rabbi chinana bar kahana amar rav mimot ezra veelach lo matzinu elul meubbar
Lo matzinu dela itzterich ha itzterich meabberinan leh
Ha mikalkal rosh hashshana mutav tikalkel rosh hashshana velo yitkalkelu kullehu moadot
Dayeka name dekatane al tishri mippene takkanat hammoadot shema minah

Veal kislev mippene chanukka veal adar mippene happurim veilu nitabbera hashshana yotzin af al adar sheni mippene happurim la katane matnitin dela kerabbi detanya rabbi omer im nitabbera hashshana yotzin af al adar hashsheni mippene happurim
Lema beha kamipalgi demar savar kol mitzot hannohagot bashsheni nohagot barishon umar savar kol mitzot hannohagot bashsheni en nohagot barishon
La dechulle alma mitzot hannohagot bashsheni en nohagot barishon vehacha beibur shana kamipalgi detanya kamma ibur shana sheloshim yom rabban shimon ben gamliel omer chodesh
May shena sheloshim deyadi chodesh name yadi amar rav pappa man deamar chodesh ratza chodesh ratza sheloshim
Heid rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum kehala kaddisha dirushalayim al shene adarim shemmekaddeshin otam beom iburehen

Lememra dachaserin avdinan melein la avdinan leappoke middedaresh rav nachman bar chisda heid rabbi simay mishshum chaggay zecharya umalachi al shene adarim sheim ratzu laasotan shenehen melein osin shenehen chaserin osin echad male veechad chaser osin vechach hau nohagin baggola umishshum rabbenu amru leolam echad male veechad chaser ad sheyyiuoda lach shehukba rosh chodesh bizmanno
Shelachu leh lemar ukva adar hassamuch lenisan leolam chaser
Metiv rav nachman al shene chodashim mechallelin et hashshabbat al nisan veal tishri i amratte bishlama zimnin male zimnin chaser mishshum hachi mechallelinan

a: Ella i amratte leolam chaser ammay mechallelinan mishshum demitzva lekaddesh al hariyya

Ika deamri amar rav nachman af anan name tenena al shene chodashim mechallelin et hashshabbat al nisan veal tishri i amratte bishlama leolam chaser mishshum hachi mechallelinan demitzva lekaddesh al hariyya
Ella i amratte zimnin male zimnin chaser ammay mechallelinan neabbereh haidana unkaddesheh limchar
I deikkela yom sheloshim beshabbat hachi name hacha bemay askinan deikkela yom sheloshim veechad beshabbat demitzva lekaddesh al hariyya
Metiv rav kahana keshehammikdash kayyam mechallelin af al kullan mippene takkanat hakkorban
Middechullehu lav mishshum demitzva lekaddesh al hariyya nisan vetishri name lav mishshum demitzva lekaddesh al hariyya
I amratte bishlama zimnin male vezimnin chaser mishshum hachi mechallelinan ella i amratte leolam chaser ammay mechallelinan teuvta
Ki ata ulla amar abberuh leelul amar ulla yadi chavrin bavlae may tevuta avdinan bahadayehu
May tevuta ulla amar mishshum yarkayya rabbi acha bar chanina amar mishshum mitayya
May benayehu ika benayehu yom hakkippurim shechal lihot achar hashshabbat man deamar mishshum mitayya meabberinan uman deamar mishshum yarkayya leemat ka bae lehu leurta leurta tarach umayete

Ulman deamar mishshum yarkayya leabbereh mishshum mitayya ella ika benayehu yom tov hassamuch lashshabbat ben millefaneha ben milleachareha man deamar mishshum yarkayya meabberinan uman deamar mishshum mitayya efshar beamme
Ulman deamar mishshum mitayya leabbereh mishshum yarkayya efshar bechammime
I hachi may shena ledidan afilu ledidhu name ledidan chavil lan alma ledidhu la chavil lehu alma
Ini vehatane rabba bar shemuel yachol keshem shemmeabberin et hashshana letzorech kach meabberin et hachodesh letzorech talmud lomar hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim kaze ree vekaddesh

Amar rava la kashya kan leabbero kan lekaddesho vehachi kaamar yachol keshem shemmeabberin et hashshana veet hachodesh letzorech kach mekaddeshin et hachodesh letzorech talmud lomar hachodesh hazze lachem kaze ree vekaddesh
Vechi ha deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi meayemin al haedim al hachodesh shennira bizmanno leabbero veen meayemin al haedim al hachodesh shello nira bizmanno lekaddesho

Ini veha shelach leh rabbi yehuda nesia lerabbi amme heu yodin shekkol yamav shel rabbi yochanan haya melammedenu meayemin al haedim al hachodesh shello nira bizmanno lekaddesho af al pi shello rauhu yomru rainu
Amar abbaye la kashya ha benisan vetishri ha bishar yarche
Rava amar ha detane rabba bar shemuel acherim hi detanya acherim omrim en ben atzeret laatzeret veen ben rosh hashshana larosh hashshana ella arbaa yamim bilvad veim hayeta shana meubberet chamishsha
Rav dimi minnehardea matne ipcha meayemin al haedim al hachodesh shello nira bizmanno lekaddesho veen meayemin al haedim al hachodesh shennira bizmanno leabbero

Rava amar chatzot layela ika benayehu

Amar leh mehecha atte amar leh middimharya amar leh dam tehe acharito kare aleh kallim hau rodfenu

b: Matni al shene chodashim mechallelin et hashshabbat al nisan veal tishri shebbahen sheluchin yotzin lesurya uvahen metakkenin et hammoadot uchshehaya bet hammikdash kayyam mechallelin af al kullan mippene takkanat hakkorban
Gema al shene chodashim vetu la urminhu al shishsha chodashim hashsheluchin yotzin
Amar abbaye hachi kaamar al kullan sheluchin yotzin mibbaerev al nisan veal tishri ad sheyyishmeu mippi bet din mekuddash
Tanya name hachi al kullan yotzin mibbaerev al nisan veal tishri ad sheyyishmeu mippi bet din mekuddash
Tanu rabbanan minnayin shemmechallelin alehen et hashshabbat talmud lomar elle moade Adonai asher tikreu otam bemoadam
Yachol keshem shemmechallelin ad sheyyitkaddeshu kach mechallelin ad sheyyitkayemu talmud lomar asher tikreu otam al keriatam atta mechallel vei atta mechallel al kiyyuman

Uchshehaya bet hammikdash kayyam mechallelin af al kullan mippene takkanat hakkorban tanu rabbanan barishona hau mechallelin af al kullan mishshecharav bet hammikdash amar lahen rabban yochanan ben zakkay vechi yesh korban hitkinu shello yehu mechallelin ella al nisan veal tishri bilvad
Matni ben shennira baalil ben shello nira baalil mechallelin alav et hashshabbat rabbi yose omer im nira baalil en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat
Maase sheavru yoter mearbaim zug veikvam rabbi akiva belod shalach lo rabban gamliel im meakkev atta et harabbim nimtzeta machshilan leatid lavo
Gema may mashma dehay alil lishana demigalle hu amar rabbi avahu amar kera imrot Adonai amarot tehorot kesef tzaruf baalil laaretz mezukkak shivatayim
Rav ushmuel chad amar chamishshim shaare vina nivreu baolam vechullan nitnu lemoshe chaser echad shenneemar vattechasserehu meat meelohim
Bikkesh kohelet limtzo divre chefetz bikkesh kohelet lihot kemoshe yatzta bat kol veamra lo vechatuv yosher divre emet velo kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe

Vechad amar banneviim lo kam bimlachim kam ella ma ani mekayyem bikkesh kohelet limtzo divre chefetz bikkesh kohelet ladun dinin shebballev shello beedim veshello behatraa yatzta bat kol veamra lo vechatuv yosher divre emet al pi shenayim edim vego

Amar rabbi yose maase betoviyya harofe sheraa et hachodesh birushalayim hu uvno veavdo meshuchrar vekibbelu hakkohanim oto veet beno ufaslu et avdo uchshebbau lifne bet din kibbelu oto veet avdo ufaslu et beno
Gema amar rabbi levi may tama derabbi shimon dichtiv vayyomer Adonai el moshe veel aharon beeretz mitzrayim lemor hachodesh hazze lachem edut zo tehe keshera bachem
Verabbanan edut zo tehe mesura lachem
Amar rabbi yose maase betoviyya harofe ku amar rav chanan bar rava hilcheta kerabbi shimon amar leh rav huna lerav chanan bar rava rabbi yose umaase veatte amratte hilcheta kerabbi shimon

Amar lo veha zimnin saggiin amarit kammeh derav hilcheta kerabbi shimon vela amar li vela mide amar leh hechi tanet amar leh ippecha amar leh mishshum hachi la amar lach vela mide amar tavi bereh demari tavi amar mar ukva amar shemuel hilcheta kerabbi shimon
Matni ellu hen happesulin hamsachek bekuvya umalve beribbit umafriche yonim vesochare sheviit vaavadim ze hakkelal kol edut sheen haishsha keshera lah af hen enan kesherin lah
Gema ha ishsha keshera lah af hen kesherin lah amar rav ashe zot omeret gazlan dedivrehem kesherin leedut ishsha
Matni mi sheraa et hachodesh veeno yachol lehallech molichim oto al hachamor afilu bemitta veim tzode lahem lokchin beyadan maklot
Veim hayeta derech rechoka lokchin beyadam mezonot sheal mahalach layela vaom mechallelin et hashshabbat veotzin leedut hachodesh shenneemar elle moade Adonai asher tikreu otam bemoadam
Hadaran alach arbaa rashe shanim
Im enan makkirin oto meshallechin immo acher lehaido barishona hau mekabbelin edut hachodesh mikkol adam mishshekkilkelu habbayetosim hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelin ella min hammakkirin
Gema may acher chad
b: Vechad mi meheman vehatanya maase shebba hu veedav immo lehaid alav amar rav pappa may acher zug acher
Hachi name mistabbera dei la tema hachi im enan makkirin oto may oto ilema oto chad vechad mi meheman mishpat ketiv beh ella may oto oto hazzug hachi name may acher zug acher
Vechad la meheman vehatanya maase berabbi nehoray shehalach etzel haed lehaid alav beshabbat beusha

Amri rabbi nehoray sahada acharina hava bahadeh veha dela chashev leh mishshum kevodo shel rabbi nehoray rav ashe amar rabbi nehoray sahada acharina hava beusha vaazal rabbi nehoray leitzterofe bahadeh
I hachi may lememra mahu detema missefeka la mechallelinan shabbeta ka mashma lan

Ki ata ulla amar kaddeshuh leyarcha bemareva amar rav kahana la mibaya ulla degavra rabba hu dimheman ella afilu inish dealma name meheman may tama kol milta daavida leiggalloye la meshakkeri bah inashe tanya name hachi ba echad besof haolam veamar kiddeshu bet din et hachodesh neeman

Barishona hau mekabbelin edut hachodesh mikkol adam vechu tanu rabbanan ma kilkul kilkelu habbayetosin paam achat bikkeshu bayetosin lehatot et chachamim sachru shene bene adam bearba meot zuz echad mishshellanu veechad mishshellahem

Shellahem heid eduto veyatza shellanu amru lo emor ketzad raita et hallevana amar lahem ole hayiti bemaale adummim uritiv shehu ravutz ben shene selaim rosho dome leegel oznav domin ligdi karnav domot litzvi uznavo munnachat lo ben yarchotav vehetzatzti bo venirtati venafalti laachoray veim en attem maaminim li hare matayim zuz tzerurin li bisdini
Amru lo mi hizkikcha lechach amar lahem shamati shebbikkeshu bayetosim lehatot et chachamim amarti elech ani veodia lahem shemma yavou bene adam sheenam mehugganin veyatu et chachamim
Amru lo matayim zuz netunin lecha bemattana vehassochercha yimmatach al haammud beotah shaa hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelin ella min hammakkirin
Matni barishona hau massiin massuot mishshekkilkelu hakkutim hitkinu sheyehu sheluchin yotzin

Ketzad hau massiin massuot meviin kelonsaot shel erez arukkin vekanim vaatze shemen unoret shel pishtan vechorech bimshicha veole lerosh hahar umatztzit bahen et haur umolich umevi umaale umorid ad shehu roe et chavero shehu ose ken berosh hahar hashsheni vechen berosh hahar hashshelishi

Umeayin hau massiin massuot mehar hammishcha lesarteva umissarteva ligrofina umiggerofina lechaveran umechaveran levet biltin umibbet biltin lo zazu mishsham ella molich umevi umaale umorid ad shehaya roe kol haggola lefanav kimdurat haesh
Gema may mashma demassiin lishana dikod hu dichtiv vayyissaem david vaanashav umtargeminan veokdinun david
Tanu rabbanan en massiin massuot ella al hachodesh shennira bizmanno lekaddesho veematay massiin leor iburo
Lememra deachaser avdinan ammale la avdinan may tama amar rabbi zera gezera mishshum rosh chodesh chaser shechal lihot beerev shabbat emat avdi beappoke shabbeta dei amratte naaved name amalle atu

a: Lemite amri hay chaser hu vehay dela avid meetmol mishshum dela efshar o dilma male hu uvizmanno avadu
Velebed ben ammale ben achaser vechi mikkela rosh chodesh beerev shabbat la lebed kelal vechevan dela avdinan motzae shabbat veavdinan ammale mida yadi dechaser hu
Afilu hachi atu lemite amri hay male hu vehay dela avdi itnose hu deitnusoy
Velebed ammale vela lebed achaser kelal amar abbaye mishshum bitul melacha laam shene yamim
Ketzad hau massiin massuot meviin kelonsot ku amar rav yehuda arbaa mine arazim hen erez katrom etz shemen uvrosh katrom amar rav adra deve rabbi shela amri mavliga veamri lah zo gulmesh

Ufliga derabba bar rav huna deamar rabba bar rav huna amri be rav asara mine arazim hem shenneemar etten bammidbar erez shitta vahadas veetz shamen asim baarava berosh tidhar utashshur yachdav erez arza shitta turnita hadas assa etz shemen afarsema berosh berata tidhar shaga teashshur shurivna
Hane shiva hau ki ata rav dimi amar hosifu alehem allonim almonim almuggin allonim butme almonim balute almuggin kesita ika deamri arunnim armonim almuggin arunnim are armonim dulve almuggin kesita
Vetzi addir lo yaavrennu amar rav zo burni gedola

Hechi avdi mayetu shet alfe gavre bitresar yarche shatta veamri lah teresar alfe gavre beshita yarche shatta vetaani lah chala ad deshachna venachet bar amoray vekatar atune dechitana bichsita vekatar lehu bisfinta venatli chala veshadu levaray vechamma demiddalya akra umatya
Umachlef al chad teren bechaspa telat parota haveyan tarte be romae vachada deve farsae deve romae massekan kesita deve farsae massekan marganyata umikkarya parota demashmehig

Amar rabbi yochanan kol shita veshita shennatlu goyim mirushalayim atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziran lah shenneemar etten bammidbar erez shitta veen midbar ella yerushalayim shenneemar tziyyon midbar hayeta vego
Veamar rabbi yochanan kol hallomed tora veeno melammedah dome lahadas bammidbar ika deamri kol hallomed tora umlammedah bimkom sheen talmide chachamim dome lahadas bammidbar dechabbiv

Veamar rabbi yochanan oy lahem laggoyim sheen lahem takkana shenneemar tachat hannechoshet avi zahav vetachat habbarzel avi chesef vetachat haetzim nechoshet vetachat haavanim barzel tachat rabbi akiva vachaverav may meviin vaalehem hu omer venikketi damam lo nikketi
Umeayin hau massiin massuot ku umibbet biltin may bet biltin amar rav

May gola amar rav yosef zo pumbedita may kimdurat haesh tana kol echad veechad notel avuka beyado veole lerosh gaggo

Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af charim uchyar ugdor vechavroteha ika deamri bene uvene hao kayemi ika deamri lehach gisa deeretz yisrael hao kayemi mar chashev dehay gisa umar chashev dehay gisa
Amar rabbi yochanan ben kol achat veachat shemone parsaot kamma hau lehu telatin vetarten veha haidana tuva hau amar abbaye istattome istattum lehu darche
Dichtiv lachen hinni sach et darkech bassirim rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha dichtiv netivotay iva
Matni chatzer gedola hayeta birushalayim uvet yazek hayeta nikret ulsham kol haedim mitkannesin uvet din bodkin otam sham usudot gedolot osin lahem bishvil sheyehu regilin lavo
Barishona lo hau zazin mishsham kol hayyom hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken sheyehu mehallechin alpayim amma lechol ruach
Velo ellu bilvad ella af chachama habbaa leyaled vehabba lehatztzil min haddeleka umin haggayis umin hannahar umin hammappolet hare ellu keanshe hair veyesh lahem alpayim lechol ruach
Gema ibaya lehu bet yazek tenan o bet yazek tenan bet yazek tenan lishana mealleya hu dichtiv vayeazzekehu vayesakkelehu o dilma bet yazek tenan lishana detzaara hu kedichtiv vehu asur bazikim
Amar abbaye ta shema seudot gedolot hau osin lahem sham kede sheyehu regilim lavo dilma tarte hao avdi behu

Matni ketzad bodkin et haedim zug shebba rishon bodkin oto rishon umachnisin et haggadol shebbahen veomrin lo emor ketzad raita et hallevana lifne hachamma o leachar hachamma litzfonah o lidromah kamma haya gavoha ulayin haya note vechamma haya rachav im amar lifne hachamma lo amar kelum

Veachar kach hau machnisin et hashsheni uvodkin oto im nimtzeu divrehem mechuuonim edutan kayyemet ushar kol hazzugot shoalin otan rashe devarim lo shehau tzerichim lahem ella kede shello yetzu befache nefesh bishvil sheyehu regilim lavo
Gema hayenu lifne hachamma hayenu litzfonah hayenu leachar hachamma hayenu lidromah amar abbaye pegimatah lifne hachamma o leachar hachamma im amar lifne hachamma la amar kelum

Deamar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv hamshel vafachad immo ose shalom bimromav meolam lo raata chamma pegimatah shel levana velo pegimatah shel keshet pegimatah shel levana dechalsha datah pegimatah shel keshet dela lemru ovde hachamma

La kashya kan bimot hachamma kan bimot haggeshamim
Tanu rabbanan echad omer gavoha shette mardeot veechad omer shalosh edutan kayyemet echad omer shalosh veechad omer chamesh edutan betela aval mitztarfin leedut acheret
Tanu rabbanan reinuhu bemayim reinuhu baashashit reinuhu beavim en meidin alav chetzo bemayim chetzo beavim chetzo baashashit en meidin alav
Hashta kullo amratte la chetzo mibbaya ella hachi kaamar chetzo bemayim chetzo barakia chetzo beavim chetzo barakia chetzo baashashit chetzo barakia en meidin
Tanu rabbanan reinuhu veshuv lo reinuhu en meidin alav kol hachi chazu leh veazli
Amar abbaye hachi kaamar reinuhu meelenu veshavnu liroto middatenu velo reinuhu en meidin alav may tama emor kovita deeva bealma hu dechaze
Matni rosh bet din omer mekuddash vechol haam onin acharav mekuddash mekuddash ben shennira bizmanno ben shello nira bizmanno mekaddeshin oto
Rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer im lo nira bizmanno en mekaddeshin oto shekkevar kidshuhu shamayim
Gema rosh bet din vechu menahane mile amar rabbi chiyya bar gamda amar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rabbi amar kera vayedabber moshe et moade Adonai mikkan sherosh bet din omer mekuddash
Vechol haam onin acharav mekuddash mekuddash menalan amar rav pappa amar kera asher tikreu otam keri beh attem rav nachman bar yitzchak amar elle hem moaday hem yomru moaday
Mekuddash mekuddash tere zimne lema li dichtiv mikrae kodesh
Rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer im lo nira bizmanno en mekaddeshin oto tanya pelemo omer bizmanno en mekaddeshin oto shello bizmanno mekaddeshin oto

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer ben kach uven kach en mekaddeshin oto shenneemar vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shanim atta mekaddesh vei atta mekaddesh chodashim amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi elazar berabbi tzadok
Amar abbaye af anan name tenena rauhu bet din vechol yisrael nechkeru haedim velo hispiku lomar mekuddash ad shechashecha hare ze meubbar meubbar in mekuddash la
Meubbar itztericha leh salka datach amena hoil verauhu bet din vechol yisrael iparsema vela liberuh ka mashma lan
Matni demut tzurot levana hau lo lerabban gamliel betavla uvchotel baaliyyato shebbahen mare et hahedotot veomer hachaze raita o kaze
Gema umi shere vehachtiv lo taasun itti lo taasun kidmut shammashay

Amar abbaye la asra tora ella shammashin sheefshar laasot kemotan kidtanya lo yaase adam bayit tavnit hechal achsadra tavnit ulam chatzer keneged azara shulchan keneged shulchan menora keneged menora aval ose
b: Shel chamishsha veshel shishsha veshel shemona veshel shiva lo yaase afilu shel shear mine mattachot rabbi yose bar yehuda omer af shel etz lo yaase kederech sheasu malche bet chashmonay
Amru lo mishsham reaya shappudin shel barzel hau vechipum bevaatz heeshiru asaum shel kesef chazru heeshiru asaum shel zahav
Veshammashin shei efshar laasot kemotan mi shere vehatanya lo taasun itti lo taasun kidmut shammashay hamshammeshin lefanay bammarom amar abbaye lo asra tora ella demut arbaa panim bahade hadade
Ella meatta partzuf adam lechodeh tishtere allema tanya kol happartzufot muttarin chutz mippartzuf adam amar rav huna bereh derav idi mippirkeh deabbaye shemia li lo taasun itti lo taasun oti

Ushar shammashin mi shere veha tanya lo taasun itti lo taasun kidmut shammashay hammeshammeshin lefanay bammarom kegon ofannim usrafim vechayyot hakkodesh umalache hashsharet amar abbaye lo asra tora ella shammashin shebbammador haelon
Veshebbammador hattachton mi shere vehatanya asher bashshamayim lerabbot chamma ulvana kochavim umazzalot mimmaal lerabbot malache hashsharet ki tanya hahi leovdam
I leovdam afilu shilshul katan name in hachi name detanya asher baaretz lerabbot harim ugvaot yammim unharot afikim vegeaot mittachat lerabbot shilshul katan
Vaasiyya geredta mi shere vehatanya lo taasun itti lo taasun kidmut shammashay hamshammeshin lefanay kegon chamma ulvana kochavim umazzalot
Shane rabban gamliel daacherim asu lo veha rav yehuda daacherim asu lo vaamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana sammi eneh deden
Hatam chotamo bolet hava umishshum chashada kidtanya tabbaat chotamo bolet asur lehannichah umuttar lachtom bah chotamo shokea muttar lehannichah veasur lachtom bah
Umi chayeshinan lachashada veha hahi be chenishta deshaf vitev binhardea dahava beh inderata vahao ayeli rav ushmuel vaavuh dishmuel velevi umtzallu hatam vela chayeshi lachashada rabbim shane
Veha rabban gamliel yachid hu kevan denasi hu shechichi rabbim gabbeh ibaet ema difrakim hava
Veibaet ema lehitlammed avad uchtiv lo tilmad laasot aval atta lamed lehavin ulhorot
Matni maase shebbau shenayim veamru reinuhu shacharit bammizrach

a: Vearvit bammaarav amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri ede sheker hem keshebbau leyavne kiblan rabban gamliel
Veod bau shenayim veamru reinuhu bizmanno uvlel iburo lo nira vekiblan rabban gamliel

Amar rabbi dosa ben horkinas ede sheker hen heach meidim al haishsha sheyyalda ulmachar keresah ben shineha amar lo rabbi yehoshua roe ani et devarecha shalach lo rabban gamliel gozrani alecha shettavo etzli bemakkelcha uvimotecha beom hakkippurim shechal lihot becheshbonecha

Halach umtzao rabbi akiva metzer amar lo yesh li lilmod shekkol ma sheasa rabban gamliel asuy shenneemar elle moade Adonai mikrae kodesh asher tikreu otam ben bizmannan ben shello bizmannan en li moadot ella ellu

Ba lo etzel rabbi dosa ben horkinas amar lo im bain anu ladun achar bet dino shel rabban gamliel tzerichin anu ladun achar kol bet din uvet din sheamad mimot moshe vead achshav shenneemar vayyaal moshe veaharon nadav vaavihu veshivim mizzikne yisrael velamma lo nitparshu shemotan shel zekenim ella lelammed shekkol shelosha ushlosha sheamdu bet din al yisrael hare hu kevet dino shel moshe

Natal maklo umotav beyado vehalach leyavne etzel rabban gamliel bayyom shechal yom hakkippurim lihot becheshbono amad rabban gamliel unshako al rosho amar lo bo beshalom rabbi vetalmidi rabbi bechochma vetalmidi shekkibbalta et devaray
Gema tanya amar lahem rabban gamliel lachachamim kach mekubbelani mibbet avi abba peamim shebba baarukka ufamim shebba biktzara
Amar rabbi yochanan may tama deve rabbi dichtiv asa yareach lemoadim shemesh yada mevoo shemesh hu deyada mevoo yareach lo yada mevoo

Rabbi chiyya chazye lesehara dahava kae betzafra deesrim vetisha shekal kala petak beh amar leurta baenan lekaddoshe bach veatte kayematte hacha zil ikassi amar leh rabbi lerabbi chiyya zil leen tav vekaddesheh leyarcha ushlach li simana david melech yisrael chay vekayyam

Tanu rabbanan paam achat nitkashsheru shamayim beavim veniret demut levana beesrim vetisha lachodesh kisvurim haam lomar rosh chodesh uvikkeshu bet din lekaddesho amar lahem rabban gamliel kach mekubbelani mibbet avi abba en chiddushah shel levana pechuta meesrim vetisha yom umechetza ushne shelishe shaa veshivim ushlosha chalakim
Veoto hayyom meta immo shel ben zaza vehispidah rabban gamliel hesped gadol lo mippene sheruya lechach ella kede sheyyedu haam shello kidshu bet din et hachodesh

Halach rabbi akiva umtzao metzer ku ibaya lehu mi metzer rabbi akiva metzer o rabbi yehoshua metzer ta shema detanya halach rabbi akiva umtzao lerabbi yehoshua keshehu metzer amar lo rabbi mippene ma atta metzer amar lo rabbi akiva rauy lo sheyyippol lammitta shenem asar chodesh veal yigzor alav gezera zo
Amar lo rabbi tarsheni lomar lefanecha davar echad shellimmadtani amar lo emor amar lo hare hu omer otam otam otam shalosh peamim
Attem afilu shoggin attem afilu mezidin attem afilu mutin ballashon hazze amar lo akiva nichamtani nichamtani
Ba lo etzel rabbi dosa ben horkinas ku tanu rabbanan lamma lo nitparshu shemotam shel zekenim hallalu shello yomar adam peloni kemoshe veaharon peloni kenadav vaavihu peloni keeldad umedad

Rauhu bet din vechol yisrael nechkeru haedim velo hispiku lomar mekuddash ad shechashecha hare ze meubbar

Rauhu bet din bilvad yaamdu shenayim veyaidu bifnehem veyomru mekuddash mekuddash rauhu shelosha vehen bet din yaamdu hashshenayim veoshivu mechaverehem etzel hayyachid veyaidu bifnehem veyomru mekuddash mekuddash sheen hayyachid neeman al yede atzmo
Gema lema li lemitne rauhu bet din vechol yisrael itzterich salka datach amena hoil verauhu bet din vechol yisrael iparsema lah vela liabberuh ka mashma lan
Vechevan ditna leh rauhu bet din vechol yisrael nechkeru haedim lema li hachi kaamar i name nechkeru haedim velo hispiku lomar mekuddash ad shechashecha hare ze meubbar
Vechevan ditna ad shechashecha hare ze meubbar lema li lemitneyah chakirat haedim kelal

Itzterich salka datach amena tehve chakirat edim kitchilat din umkuddash mekuddash kigmar din ulkaddesheh belelya mide dehave addine mamonot ditnan dine mamonot danin bayyom vegomrin ballayela hacha name mekaddeshin belelya ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name amar kera ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat lelohe yaakov emat have chok bigmar din veka kare leh rachamana mishpat ma mishpat bayyom af hacha name bayyom

Amar rabbi zera kegon sherauhu ballayela
Rauhu shelosha vehen bet din yaamdu shenayim veoshivu mechaverehem etzel hayyachid ammay hacha name nema lo tehe shemia gedola meriyya vechi tema hacha name kegon sherauhu ballayela hayenu hach

Sefa itztericha leh deen hayyachid neeman al yede atzmo desalka datach amena hoil utnan dine mamonot bishlosha veim haya mumche lerabbim dan afilu beyachid hacha name nikaddesheh bichidi ka mashma lan

Lememra deed naase dayyan lema matnitin dela kerabbi akiva detanya sanhedrin sherau echad sheharag et hannefesh

Matni kol hashshofarot kesherim chutz mishshel para mippene shehu keren amar rabbi yose vahalo kol hashshofarot nikreu keren shenneemar bimshoch bekeren hayyovel

b: Umiyyavne leusha umeusha leyavne umiyyavne leusha umeusha lishfaram umishshefaram levet shearim umibbet shearim letzippori umitztzippori litverya utverya amukka mikkullan shenneemar veshafalte meeretz tedabberi

Rabbi elazar omer shesh galut shenneemar ki heshach yoshve marom kirya nisgava yashpilenna yashpilah ad eretz yaggienna ad afar amar rabbi yochanan umishsham atidin ligael shenneemar hitnaari meafar kumi shevi
Matni amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha veod zot hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheafilu rosh bet din bechol makom shello yehu haedim holchin ella limkom havaad

Amar leh hane mile leinyan edut hachodesh deim ken nimtzeta machshilan leatid lavo aval hacha eved love leish malve
Tanu rabbanan en kohanim rashshain laalot besandelehen ladduchan vezo echad mittesha takkanot shehitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay shet dehay pirka vachada defirka kamma
Veidach detanya ger shennitgayyer bazzeman hazze tzarich sheyyafrish rova lekino amar rabbi shimon ben elazar kevar nimna aleha rabban yochanan uvitlah mippene hattakkala

Amru lo talmidav rabbi kevar nimnu chaverecha alav vehittiruhu man chaverecha rabban yochanan ben zakkay

a: Vekaveh rabbeh bishmeh
Matni seder berachot omer avot ugvurot ukdushshat hashshem vecholel malchiyyot immahen veeno tokea
Kedushshat hayyom vetokea zichronot vetokea shofarot vetokea veomer avoda vehodaa uvirkat kohanim divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri

Gema amar lo rabbi akiva im eno tokea lemalchiyyot lama hu mazkir lama hu mazkir rachamana amar adkar ella lama eser lema tesha dehoil veishtanni ishtanni

Tanu rabbanan minnayin sheomrim avot shenneemar havu la bene elim uminnayin sheomrim gevurot shenneemar havu la kavod vaoz uminnayin sheomrim kedushshot shenneemar havu la kevod shemo hishtachau la behadrat kodesh
