Minnayin sheomrim malchiyyot tanya rabbi omer ani Adonai elohechem ubbachodesh hashshevii zo malchut

Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer eno tzarich hare hu omer vehau lachem lezikkaron lifne elohechem sheen talmud lomar ani Adonai elohechem uma talmud lomar ani Adonai elohechem ze bana av lechol makom shenneemar bo zichronot yihu malchiyyot immahen
Vehechan omrah likdushshat hayyom tanya rabbi omer im hammalchiyyot omrah ma matzinu bechol makom barviit af kan barviit
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im hazzichronot omrah ma matzinu bechol makom baemtza af kan baemtza

Uchshekkidshu bet din et hashshana beusha yarad rabbi yochanan ben beroka lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel veasa kerabbi yochanan ben nuri amar lo rabban shimon lo hau nohagin ken beyavne layyom hashsheni yarad rabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili veasa kerabbi akiva amar rabban shimon ben gamliel kach hau nohagin beyavne

Lememra derabban shimon ben gamliel kerabbi akiva sevira leh veha amar rabbi akiva malchiyyot im kedushshat hayyom amar lehu verabban shimon ben gamliel omer kedushshat hayyom im hazzichronot amar lehu amar rabbi zera lomar shettokin lemalchiyyot

Layyom hashsheni yarad rabbi chanina may sheni ilema yom tov sheni lememra deabberuh leelul vehaamar rabbi chanina bar kahana mimot ezra veelach lo matzinu elul meubbar amar rav chisda may sheni leom sheni lashshana habbaa
Matni en pochatin measara malchiyyot measara zichronot measara shofarot rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer im amar shalosh shalosh mikkullan yatza
Gema hane asara malchiyyot keneged mi amar rabbi keneged asara hillulim sheamar david besefer tehillim hillulim tuva hau hanach dichtiv behu halluhu beteka shofar
Rav yosef amar keneged aseret haddibberot shenneemru lo lemoshe besinay rabbi yochanan amar keneged asara maamarot shebbahen nivra haolam he ninhu vayyomer
Vayyomer divreshit tisha hau bereshit name maamar hu dichtiv bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu

Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer im amar shalosh shalosh mikkullan yatza ibaya lehu hechi katane shalosh min hattora shalosh min hanneviim veshalosh min hakketuvim dehau tesha veika benayehu chada o dilma echad min hattora veechad min hanneviim veechad min hakketuvim dehaveyan lehu shalosh veika benayehu tuva
Ta shema detanya en pochatin measara malchiyyot measara zichronot measara shofarot veim amar sheva mikkullan yatza keneged shiva rekiim

Rabbi yochanan ben nuri amar happochet lo yifchot mishsheva veim amar shalosh mikkullan yatza keneged tora neviim uchtuvim veamri lah keneged kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim amar rav huna amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri
Matni en mazkirin zikkaron malchut veshofar shel puranut matchil battora umashlim bannavi rabbi yose omer im hishlim battora yatza
b: Gema malchiyyot kegon chay ani neum elohim im lo beyad chazaka uvizroa netuya uvchema shefucha emloch alechem veaf al gav deamar rav nachman kol ki hay ritcha lirtach kudsha berich hu alan velifrokinan kevan divritcha amur adkore ritcha beresh shatta la madkerinan
Zikkaron kegon vayyizkor ki vasar hemma vego shofar kegon tiku shofar baggiva vego

Aval im ba lomar malchut zikkaron veshofar shel puranut shel nochrim omer malchut kegon Adonai malach yirgezu ammim uchgon Adonai melech olam vaed avdu goyim meartzo zikkaron kegon zechor Adonai livne edom vego shofar kegon va elohim bashshofar yitka vehalach besaarot teman uchtiv Adonai tzevaot yagen alehem
En mazkirin zikkaron shel yachid vaafilu letova kegon zochreni Adonai birtzon ammecha uchgon zochra li elohay letova
Pikdonot hare hen kezichronot kegon va pakad et sara uchgon pakod pakadti etchem divre rabbi yose rabbi yehuda omer enan kezichronot
Ulrabbi yose nehi name defikdonot hare hen kezichronot va pakad et sara pikkadon deyachid hu kevan deatu rabbim minah kerabbim damya

Seu shearim rashechem vehinnasu pitche olam veyavo melech hakkavod mi ze melech hakkavod Adonai izzuz vegibbor Adonai gibbor milchama seu shearim rashechem usu pitche olam veyavo melech hakkavod mi hu ze melech hakkavod Adonai tzevaot hu melech hakkavod sela rishona shettayim sheniyya shalosh divre rabbi yose
Rabbi yehuda omer rishona achat sheniyya shettayim

Zammeru elohim zammeru zammeru lemalkenu zammeru ki melech kol haaretz elohim shettayim divre rabbi yose rabbi yehuda omer achat veshavin bemalach elohim al goyim elohim yashav al kisse kodsho shehi achat
Zichron sheyyesh bo terua kegon shabbaton zichron terua mikra kodesh omrah im hazzichronot veomrah im hashshofarot divre rabbi yose rabbi yehuda omer eno omrah ella im hazzichronot bilvad
Malchut sheyyesh immo terua kegon Adonai elohav immo utruat melech bo omrah im hammalchiyyot veomrah im hashshofarot divre rabbi yose rabbi yehuda omer eno omrah ella im hammalchiyyot bilvad
Terua sheen immah lo kelum kegon yom terua yihye lachem omrah im hashshofarot divre rabbi yose rabbi yehuda omer eno omrah kol ikar
Matchil battora umashlim benavi rabbi yose omer im hishlim battora yatza im hishlim diavad in lechattechila la vehatanya rabbi yose omer hammashlim battora hare ze meshubbach ema mashlim

Veha im hishlim katane diavad in lechattechila la hachi kaamar matchil battora umashlim benavi rabbi yose omer mashlim battora veim hishlim benavi yatza tanya name hachi amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose votikin hau mashlimin otah battora
Bishlama zichronot veshofarot ika tuva ella malchiyyot telat hu dehaveyan Adonai elohav immo utruat melech bo vayehi bishurun melech Adonai yimloch leolam vaed vaanan baenan eser veleka
Amar rav huna ta shema shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad malchut divre rabbi yose rabbi yehuda omer enah malchut

Veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha ki Adonai hu haelohim en od malchut divre rabbi yose rabbi yehuda omer enah malchut atta horeta ladaat ki Adonai hu haelohim en od milvaddo malchut divre rabbi yose rabbi yehuda omer enah malchut
Matni haover lifne hatteva beom tov shel rosh hashshana hashsheni matkia uvishat hahallel harishon makre et hahallel

Ella may shena hallel devarishon mishshum dizrizin makdimin lemitzot tekia name naaved barishon mishshum dizrizin makdimin lemitzot
Amar rabbi yochanan bishat hashshemad shanu

Middekaamar bishat hallel mikkelal divrosh hashshana leka hallel may tama amar rabbi avahu amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam mippene ma en yisrael omrim shira lefanecha berosh hashshana uvom hakkippurim amar lahem efshar melech yoshev al kisse din vesifre chayyim vesifre metim petuchin lefanav veyisrael omrim shira

Lo olin bailan velo rochvin al gabbe behema vechu hashta derabbanan amratte la deorayeta mibaya zo veen tzarich lomar zo katane

Detanya dabber el bene yisrael bene yisrael somchin veen benot yisrael somchot divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim nashim somchot reshut

Ha gufa kashya amratte mitassekin bahen ad sheyyilmedu vaafilu beshabbat alma lechattechilla amrinan tiku vahadar tana en meakkevin ikkuva hu dela meakkevin ha lechattechilla la amrinan tiku
La kashya kan
b: Bekatan shehiggia lechinuch kan bekatan shello higgia lechinuch
Vehammitassek lo yatza ha tokea lashir yatza lema mesayya leh lerava deamar rava hattokea lashir yatza dilma tokea lashir name mitassek kare leh
Vehashshomea min hammitassek lo yatza aval hashshomea min hammashmia leatzmo may yatza lema tehve teuvteh derabbi zera deamar leh rabbi zera leshammaeh ikavan utka li
Dilma ayede ditna resha mitassek tena sefa name mitassek
Matni seder tekiot shalosh shel shalosh shalosh shiur tekia keshalosh teruot shiur terua keshalosh yevavot taka barishona umashach bashsheniyya kishtayim en beyado ella achat
Mi shebberach veachar kach nitmanna lo shofar tokea umeria vetokea shalosh peamim
Keshem sheshsheliach tzibbur chayyav kach kol yachid veyachid chayyav rabban gamliel omer sheliach tzibbur motzi et harabbim yede chovatan
Gema vehatanya shiur tekia kitrua amar abbaye tanna didan ka chashev tekia dechullehu bave utruot dechullehu bave tanna bara ka chashev chad bava vetu la
Shiur terua kishlosh yevavot vehatanya shiur terua kishlosha shevarim

Amar abbaye beha vadday peligi dichtiv yom terua yihye lachem umtargeminan yom yabbava yehe lechon uchtiv beimeh desisra bead hachallon nishkefa vatteyabbev em sisra mar savar gannoche gannach umar savar yallole yallel
Tanu rabbanan minnayin shebbeshofar talmud lomar vehaavarta shofar terua

En li ella bayyovel berosh hashshana minnayin talmud lomar bachodesh hashshevii sheen talmud lomar bachodesh hashshevii uma talmud lomar bachodesh hashshevii sheyyihu kol teruot shel chodesh shevii ze kaze
Uminnayin sheppeshuta lefaneha talmud lomar vehaavarta shofar terua uminnayin sheppeshuta leachareha talmud lomar taaviru shofar
Veen li ella bayyovel berosh hashshana minnayin talmud lomar bachodesh hashshevii

a: Sheen talmud lomar bachodesh hashshevii uma talmud lomar bachodesh hashshevii sheyehu kol teruot hachodesh hashshevii ze kaze
Uminnayin leshalosh shel shalosh shalosh talmud lomar vehaavarta shofar terua shabbaton zichron terua yom terua yihye lachem
Uminnayin liten et haamur shel ze baze veshel ze baze talmud lomar shevii shevii ligzera shava
Ha ketzad shalosh shehen tesha shiur tekia kitrua shiur terua kishlosha shevarim
Hay tanna meikara mayete lah behekesha vehashta mayete lah bigzera shava hachi kaamar i lav gezera shava hava mayetina lah behekesha hashta deatya bigzera shava hekesha la tzerich

Vehay tanna mayete lah bigzera shava mimmidbar detanya utkatem terua tekia bifne atzmah utrua bifne atzmah atta omer tekia bifne atzmah utrua bifne atzmah o eno ella tekia utrua achat hi keshehu omer uvhakhil et hakkahal titkeu velo tariu heve omer tekia bifne atzmah utrua bifne atzmah
Uminnayin sheppeshuta lefaneha talmud lomar utkatem terua uminnayin sheppeshuta leachareha talmud lomar terua yitkeu

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer eno tzarich hare hu omer utkatem terua shenit sheen talmud lomar shenit uma talmud lomar shenit ze bana av shekkol makom shenneemar terua tehe tekia sheniyya lah en li ella bammidbar berosh hashshana minnayin talmud lomar terua terua ligzera shava
Veshalosh teruot neemru berosh hashshana shabbaton zichron terua yom terua vehaavarta shofar terua ushte tekiot lechol achat veachat

Matzinu lemedin shalosh teruot veshesh tekiot neemru berosh hashshana shettayim middivre tora veachat middivre sofrim shabbaton zichron terua vehaavarta shofar terua middivre tora yom terua yihye lachem letalmudo hu ba
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan achat middivre tora ushtayim middivre sofrim vehaavarta shofar terua middivre tora shabbaton zichron terua veom terua yihye lachem letalmudo hu ba
May letalmudo hu ba mibe bayyom velo ballayela
Veidach bayyom velo ballayela mena leh nafka leh mibbeom hakkippurim
I beom hakkippurim yalef nigmor name mineh lifshuta lefaneha ufshuta leachareha vehaavarta taaviru la mashma lehu
Ella may darshi behu vehaavarta kidrav matna deamar rav matna vehaavarta derech haavarato taaviru dekaamar rachamana neabbereh beyad
Veidach derav matna middeshanni bedibureh
Taaviru beyad la matzet amratte degamar avara avara mimmoshe ketiv hacha vehaavarta shofar terua uchtiv hatam vayetzav moshe vayyaaviru kol bammachane ma lehallan bekol af kan bekol
Ulhay tanna demayete lah mimmidbar i ma lehallan chatzotzrot af kan chatzotzrot
Talmud lomar tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leom chaggenu e zehu chag shehachodesh mitkasse bo heve omer ze rosh hashshana vekaamar rachamana shofar
Atken rabbi avahu bekesari tekia shelosha shevarim terua tekia ma nafshach i yallole yallel lebed tekia terua utkia vei gannoche gannach lebed tekia shelosha shevarim utkia

Mesappeka leh i gannoche gannach i yallole yallel matkef lah rav avira vedilma yallole hava veka mafsek shelosha shevarim ben terua litkia dahadar aved tekia terua utkia matkef lah ravina vedilma gannoche hava veka mafseka terua ben shevarim litkia dahadar aved tekia shevarim tekia
Ella rabbi avahu may atken i gannoche gannach ha avdeh i yallole yallel ha avdeh mesappeka leh dilma gannach veyallel
I hachi lebad name ipcha tekia terua shelosha shevarim utkia dilma yallel vegannach setama demilta ki mittera beinish milta beresha ganach vahadar yalel
Taka barishona umashach bashsheniyya kishtayim amar rabbi yochanan shama
b: Tesha tekiot betesha shaot bayyom yatza
Tanya name hachi shama tesha tekiot betesha shaot bayyom yatza mittisha bene adam keechad lo yatza tekia mizze utrua mizze yatza vaafilu beserugin vaafilu kol hayyom kullo
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak behallel uvimgila im shaha kede ligmor et kullah chozer larosh la kashya ha dideh ha derabbeh

Vedideh la veha rabbi avahu hava shakel veazel batreh derabbi yochanan vahava kare keriat shema ki meta limvoot metunnafot ishtik batar dachalef amar leh mahu ligmor amar lo im shahita kede ligmor et kullah chazor larosh
Hachi kaamar leh ledidi la sevira li ledidach disvira lach im shahita kede ligmor et kullah chazor larosh
Tanu rabbanan tekiot en meakkevot zo et zo berachot en meakkevot zo et zo tekiot uvrachot shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim meakkevot

May tama amar rabba amar hakkadosh baruch hu imru lefanay berosh hashshana malchiyyot zichronot veshofarot malchiyyot kede shettamlichuni alechem zichronot kede sheyyavo lefanay zichronechem letova uvamme beshofar
Mi shebberach veachar kach nitmanna lo shofar tokea umeria vetokea tama dela hava leh shofar meikara ha hava leh shofar meikara ki shama lehu asseder berachot shama lehu
Rav pappa bar shemuel kam letzalloye amar leh leshammaeh ki naharna lach teka li amar leh rava lo amru ella bechever ir

Tanya name hachi keshehu shoman shoman al hasseder veal seder berachot bamme devarim amurim bechever ir aval shello bechever ir shoman al hasseder veshello al seder berachot veyachid shello taka chavero tokea lo veyachid shello berach en chavero mevarech alav
Umitzva betokin yoter min hamvarchin ketzad shette ayarot beachat tokin uvachat mevarchin holchin limkom shettokin veen holchin limkom shemmevarchin
Peshita ha deorayeta ha derabbanan la tzericha deaf al gav deha vadday veha safek
Keshem sheshsheliach tzibbur chayyav kach kol yachid veyachid vechu tanya amru lo lerabban gamliel lidvarecha lamma tzibbur mitpallelin amar lahem kede lehasdir sheliach tzibbur tefillato
Amar lahem rabban gamliel ledivrechem lamma sheliach tzibbur yored lifne hatteva amru lo kede lehotzi et sheeno baki amar lahem keshem shemmotzi et sheeno baki kach motzi et habbaki

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan modim chachamim lerabban gamliel verav amar adayin hi machloket shamah rabbi chiyya bereh derabba bar nachmani azal amrah lishmata kammeh derav dimi bar chinana amar leh hachi amar rav adayin hi machloket amar leh rabba bar bar chana name hachi kaamar ki amar rabbi yochanan leha shemata ippelig aleh resh lakish vaamar adayin hi machloket
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi chana tziporaa amar rabbi yochanan hilcheta kerabban gamliel hilcheta mikkelal difligi

a: Ki selek rabbi abba miyyamme pershah modim chachamim lerabban gamliel bivrachot shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim vahalacha mikkelal difligi bivrachot dechol hashshana
Ini vehaamar rabbi chana tziporaa amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabban gamliel bivrachot shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak man modim rabbi meir vahalacha mikkelal difligi rabbanan

Detanya berachot shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim sheliach tzibbur motzi harabbim yede chovatan divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim keshem sheshsheliach tzibbur chayyav kach kal yachid veyachid chayyav
May shena hane ilema mishshum dinfishi kerae vehaamar rav chananel amar rav kevan sheamar uvtoratcha katuv lemor shuv eno tzarich ella mishshum deaveshi berachot

Gufa amar rav chananel amar rav kevan sheamar uvtoratcha katuv lemor shuv eno tzarich sevur minah hane mile beyachid aval betzibbur la ittemar amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi echad yachid echad tzibbur kevan sheamar uvtoratcha katuv lemor shuv eno tzarich

Amar rabbi elazar leolam yasdir adam tefillato veachar kach yitpallel amar rabbi abba mistabbera milteh derabbi elazar bivrachot shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim veshel perakim aval dechol hashshana la
Ini veha rav yehuda mesaddar tzeloteh umtzalle shane rav yehuda kevan demittelatin yomin litlatin yomin hava metzalle kifrakim dame
Amar rav acha bar avira amar rabbi shimon chasida poter haya rabban gamliel afilu am shebbassadot vela mibaya hane dekayemi hacha
Adderabba hane anisi hane la anisi
Detane abba bereh derav binyamin bar chiyya am sheachore kohanim enan bichlal beracha
Ella ki ata ravin amar rabbi yaakov bar ide amar rabbi shimon chasida lo patar rabban gamliel ella am shebbassadot may tama mishshum daanisi bimlacha aval bair lo
Hadran alach yom tov uslika lah massechet rosh hashshana
Meematay mazkirin gevurot geshamim rabbi eliezer omer miyyom tov harishon shel chag rabbi yehoshua omer miyyom tov haacharon shel chag

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua hoil veen haggeshamim ella siman kelala bechag lama hu mazkir amar lo rabbi eliezer af ani lo amarti lishol ella lehazkir mashshiv haruach umorid haggeshem beonato amar lo im ken leolam yehe mazkir

En shoalim et haggeshamim ella samuch laggeshamim rabbi yehuda omer haover lifne hatteva beom tov haacharon shel chag haacharon mazkir harishon eno mazkir beom tov rishon shel pesach harishon mazkir haacharon eno mazkir
Gema tanna hecha kae dekatane meematay tanna hatam kae
Dekatane mazkirim gevurot geshamim bitchiyyat hammetim veshoalin bevirkat hashshanim vehavdala bechonen haddaat vekatane meematay mazkirim gevurot geshamim
Velitne hatam may shena deshavkeh ad hacha
Ella tanna merosh hashshana salek ditnan uvechag nidonin al hammayim veayede ditna uvechag nidonim al hammayim tana meematay mazkirin gevurot geshamim

Velitne meematay mazkirim al haggeshamim may gevurot geshamim amar rabbi yochanan mippene sheyyordin bigvura shenneemar ose gedolot ad en cheker veniflaot ad en mispar uchtiv hannoten matar al pene haaretz vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot
May mashma amar rabba bar shela atya cheker cheker mibberiyyato shel olam
Ketiv hacha ose gedolot ad en cheker uchtiv hatam halo yadata im lo shamata elohe olam Adonai bore ketzot haaretz lo yiaf velo yiga en cheker litvunato uchtiv mechin harim bechocho nezar bigvura
Umna lan devitfilla detanya leahava et Adonai elohechem ulovdo bechol levavchem ezo hi avoda shehi ballev heve omer zo tefilla uchtiv batreh venatatti metar artzechem beitto yore umalkosh
Amar rabbi yochanan shelosha maftechot beyado shel hakkadosh baruch hu shello nimseru beyad shaliach veellu hen mafteach shel geshamim mafteach shel chayya umafteach shel techiyyat hammetim
Mafteach shel geshamim dichtiv yiftach Adonai lecha et otzaro hattov et hashshamayim latet metar artzecha beitto mafteach shel chayya minnayin dichtiv vayyizkor elohim et rachel vayyishma
b: Eleha elohim vayyiftach et rachmah mafteach shel techiyyat hammetim minnayin dichtiv vidatem ki ani Adonai befitchi et kivrotechem
Bemareva amri af mafteach shel parnasa dichtiv poteach et yadecha vego verabbi yochanan may tama la ka chashev leha amar lach geshamim hayenu parnasa
Rabbi eliezer omer miyyom tov harishon shel chag ku ibaya lehu rabbi eliezer mehecha gamar lah millulav gamar lah o minnisuch hammayim gamar lah
Millulav gamar lah ma lulav bayyom af hazkara bayyom o dilma minnisuch hammayim gamar lah ma nisuch hammayim meurta deamar mar uminchatam veniskehem afilu ballayela af hazkara meurta
Ta shema deamar rabbi avahu lo lemadah rabbi eliezer ella millulav ika deamri rabbi avahu gemara gemir lah veika deamri matnita shemia leh
May hi detanya meematay mazkirin al haggeshamim rabbi eliezer omer mishsheat netilat lulav rabbi yehoshua omer mishsheat hannachato
Amar rabbi eliezer hoil vearbaat minin hallalu enan bain ella leratztzot al hammayim uchshem shearba minin hallalu i efshar bahem belo mayim kach i efshar laolam belo mayim

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua vahalo geshamim bechag eno ella siman kelala amar lo rabbi eliezer af ani lo amarti lishol ella lehazkir uchshem shettechiyyat hammetim mazkir kol hashshana kullah veenah ella bizmannah kach mazkirin gevurot geshamim kol hashshana veenan ella bizmannan lefichach im ba lehazkir kol hashshana kullah mazkir rabbi omer omer ani mishshaa shemmafsik lishela kach mafsik lehazkara

Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer bashsheni bechag hu mazkir rabbi akiva omer bashshishshi bechag hu mazkir rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi yehoshua omer haover lifne hatteva beom tov haacharon shel chag haacharon mazkir harishon eno mazkir beom tov rishon shel pesach harishon mazkir haacharon eno mazkir
Shappir kaamar leh rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua amar lecha rabbi yehoshua bishlama techiyyat hammetim mazkir dechulle yoma zimneh hu
Ella geshamim kol emat deatayin zimnayehu hi vehatnan yatza nisan veyardu geshamim siman kelala hem shenneemar halo ketzir chittim hayyom vego
Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer bashsheni bechag hu mazkir may tama derabbi yehuda ben betira detanya rabbi yehuda ben betira omer
Neemar bashsheni veniskehem veneemar bashshishshi unsacheha veneemar bashshevii kemishpatam
Hare mem yod mem hare kan mayim mikkan remez lenisuch hammayim min hattora
Umay shena besheni denaket dechi remizi lehu bikra besheni hu dirmizi hilkach besheni madkerinan
Rabbi akiva omer bashshishshi bechag hu mazkir shenneemar bashshishshi unsacheha bishne nisuchin hakkatuv medabber echad nisuch hammayim veechad nisuch hayyayin
Ema tarvayehu dechamra savar lah kerabbi yehuda ben betira deamar remizi mayya

a: I savar lah kerabbi yehuda ben betira nema keoteh kasavar rabbi akiva ki ketiv nisuch yattira beshishshi hu dichtiv

Tanya rabbi natan omer bakkodesh hassech nesech shechar la bishne nisuchin hakkatuv medabber echad nisuch hammayim veechad nisuch hayyayin ema tarvayehu dechamra im ken lichtov kera o hassech hesech o nassech nesech may hassech nesech shamatte minah chad demayya vechad dechamra
Ella ha ditnan nisuch hammayim kol shiva manni i rabbi yehoshua nema chad yoma i rabbi akiva tere yome i rabbi yehuda ben betira shita yome
Leolam rabbi yehuda ben betira hi usvira leh kerabbi yehuda dematnitin ditnan rabbi yehuda omer ballog haya menassech kol shemona umappek rishon umayyel shemini
Umay shena rishon dela dechi remizi mayim besheni hu dirmizi shemini name ki remizi mayim bishvii hu dirmizi
Ella rabbi yehoshua hi venisuch hammayim kol shiva hilcheta gemiri lah
Deamar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi nechunya ish bikat bet chortan eser netiot arava venisuch hammayim halacha lemoshe missinay
Rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua haover lifne hatteva beom tov haacharon shel chag haacharon mazkir harishon eno mazkir beom tov harishon shel pesach harishon mazkir haacharon eno mazkir
He rabbi yehoshua ilema rabbi yehoshua dematnitin ha amar beom tov haacharon shel chag hu mazkir
Ella rabbi yehoshua devarayeta haamar mishsheat hannachato
Vetu ha detanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum ben betira haover lifne hatteva beom tov haacharon shel chag haacharon mazkir he ben betira ilema rabbi yehuda ben betira ha amar bashsheni bechag hu mazkir
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak tehe berabbi yehoshua ben betira zimnin dekare leh bishmeh vezimnin dekare leh bishmeh deabba veha mikkamme delismechuhu veha levatar delismechuhu
Tena battal uvaruchot lo chiyevu chachamim lehazkir veim ba lehazkir mazkir may tama amar rabbi chanina lefi sheen neetzarin

Vetal menalan dela miatzar dichtiv vayyomer eliyyahu hattishbi mittoshave gilad el achav chay Adonai elohe yisrael asher amadti lefanav im yihye hashshanim haelle tal umatar ki im lefi devari uchtiv lech herae el achav veettena matar al pene haadama veilu tal la kaamar leh may tama mishshum
b: Dela miatzar vechi meachar dela miatzar eliyyahu ishtevoe lema leh hachi kaamar leh afilu tal beracha name la ate velahdereh letal divracha mishshum dela minachra milta

Ella ruchot mena lan dela miatzri amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar kera ki kearba ruchot hashshamayim perasti etchem neum Adonai may kaamar lehu ilema hachi kaamar lehu hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael devaddartinchu bearba ruche dealma i hachi kearba bearba mibe leh ella hachi kaamar keshem shei efshar laolam belo ruchot kach i efshar laolam belo yisrael
Amar rabbi chanina hilkach bimot hachamma amar mashshiv haruach en machazirin oto amar morid haggeshem machazirin oto
Bimot haggeshamim lo amar mashshiv haruach en machazirin oto lo amar morid haggeshem machazirin oto velo od ella afilu amar maavir haruach umafriach hattal en machazirin oto
Tana beavim uvaruchot lo chiyevu chachamim lehazkir veim ba lehazkir mazkir may tama mishshum dela miatzri

Vela miatzri vehatane rav yosef veatzar et hashshamayim min heavim umin haruchot atta omer min heavim umin haruchot o eno ella min hammatar keshehu omer velo yihye matar hare matar amur ha ma ani mekayyem veatzar et hashshamayim min heavim umin haruchot
Kashya ruchot aruchot kashya avim aavim avim aavim la kashya ha becharfe ha beafle
Ruchot aruchot la kashya ha beruach metzuya ha beruach sheenah metzuya ruach sheenah metzuya chazya leve dare efshar benafota

Tana heavim veharuchot sheniyyot lammatar hechi dame amar ulla veitema rav yehuda devatar mitra lememra dimalleuta hi vehachtiv yitten Adonai et metar artzecha avak veafar veamar ulla veitema rav yehuda zika devatar mitra
La kashya ha daata nicha ha daata razya vei baet ema ha demaale avak ha dela maale avak
Veamar rav yehuda zika devatar mitra kemitra eva devatar mitra kemitra shimsha devatar mitra kitre mitre lemaote may lemaote gilhe delelya veshimsha devene karche
Amar rava mealle talga leture kechamsha mitre leara shenneemar ki lashsheleg yomar heve aretz vegeshem matar vegeshem mitrot uzzo
Veamar rava talga leture mitra razya leilane mitra nicha lefere

a: Urpila afilu lefartzida detute kala mahneya leh may urpila uru pile veamar rava hay tzurba merabbanan dame lefartzida detute kala dechevan dinvat nevat

Veamar rava hay tzurba merabbanan deratach orayeta hu deka martecha leh shenneemar halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai veamar rav ashe kol talmid chacham sheeno kashe kabbarzel eno talmid chacham shenneemar uchfattish yefotzetz sala

Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe attun mehatam matnitu lah anan mehacha matnenan lah dichtiv eretz asher avaneha varzel al tikre avaneha ella boneha amar ravina afilu hachi mibe leh leinish lemelaf nafsheh benichuta shenneemar vehaser kaas millibbecha vego

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan shelosha shaalu shello kahogen lishnayim heshivuhu kahogen leechad heshivuhu shello kahogen veellu hen eliezer eved avraham veshaul ben kish veyiftach haggiladi
Eliezer eved avraham dichtiv vehaya hannaara asher omar eleha hatti na chaddech vego yachol afilu chigeret afilu soma heshivu kahogen venizdammena lo rivka
Shaul ben kish dichtiv vehaya haish asher yakkennu yasherennu hammelech osher gadol veet bitto yitten lo yachol afilu eved afilu mamzer heshivu kahogen venizdammen lo david
Yiftach haggiladi dichtiv vehaya hayyotze asher yetze middalte veti vego yachol afilu davar tame heshivu shello kahogen nizdammena lo bitto
Vehayenu dekaamar lehu navi leyisrael hatzori en begilad im rofe en sham
Uchtiv asher lo tziviti velo dibbarti velo alta al libbi
Asher lo tziveti ze beno shel mesha melech moav shenneemar vayyikkach et beno habbechor asher yimloch tachtav vayyaalehu ola velo dibbarti ze yiftach velo alta al libbi ze yitzchak ben avraham
Amar rabbi berechya af keneset yisrael shaala shello kahogen vehakkadosh baruch hu heshivah kahogen shenneemar veneda nirdefa ladaat et Adonai keshachar nachon motzao veyavo chaggeshem lanu
Amar lah hakkadosh baruch hu bitti atte shoelet davar sheppeamim mitbakkesh ufamim eno mitbakkesh aval ani ehye lach davar hammitbakkesh leolam shenneemar ehye chattal leyisrael

Veod shaala shello kahogen amra lefanav ribbono shel olam simeni chachotam al libbecha kachotam al zeroecha amar lah hakkadosh baruch hu bitti atte shoelet davar sheppeamim nire ufamim eno nire aval ani eese lach davar shennire leolam shenneemar hen al kappayim chakkotich
En shoalin et haggeshamim ku savruha sheela vehazkara chada milta hi man tanna amar rava rabbi yehoshua hi deamar mishsheat hannachato
Amar leh abbaye afilu tema rabbi eliezer sheela lechud vehazkara lechud
Veika deamri lema
b: Rabbi yehoshua hi deamar mishsheat hannachato amar rava afilu tema rabbi eliezer sheela lechud vehazkara lechud
Rabbi yehuda omer haover lifne hatteva ku
Urminhu ad matay shoalin et haggeshamim rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyaavor happesach rabbi meir omer ad sheyyaavor nisan
Amar rav chisda la kashya kan lishol kan lehazkir mishal shael veazel lehazkir beom tov harishon pasek
Amar ulla ha derav chisda kashya kachometz lashshinnayim vecheashan laenayim uma bimkom sheeno shoel mazkir bimkom sheshshoel eno din sheyehe mazkir
Ella amar ulla tere tannae alliba derabbi yehuda
Rav yosef amar may ad sheyyaavor happesach ad sheyyaavor sheliach tzibbur rishon hayyored beom tov rishon shel pesach
Amar leh abbaye sheela beom tov mi ika
Amar leh in shoel meturgeman vechi meturgeman shoel davar sheeno tzarich latztzibbur ella mechavarta kidulla
Rabba amar may ad sheyyaavor happesach ad sheyyaavor zeman shechitat happesach vechitchilato ken sofo ma techilato mazkir af al pi sheeno shoel af sofo mazkir af al pi sheeno shoel
Amar leh abbaye bishlama techilato mazkir hazkara name ritzuy sheela hi ella sofo may ritzuy sheela ika ella mechavarta kidulla

Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yehuda amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehatnan bishlosha bemarcheshon shoalin et haggeshamim rabban gamliel omer beshiva bo veamar rabbi elazar halacha kerabban gamliel
Amar leh gavra aggavra ka ramet ibaet ema la kashya kan lishol kan lehazkir
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan bimkom sheshshoel mazkir hahu lehafsaka itmar vehaamar rabbi yochanan hitchil lehazkir matchil lishol pasak millishol posek millehazkir
Ella la kashya ha lan ha lehu may shena ledidan deit lan pere bedavra ledidhu name it lehu ole regalim
Ki kaamar rabbi yochanan bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyam hashta deatet lehachi ha veha ledidhu vela kashya kan bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam kan bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyam
Vaanan deit lan tere yome hechi avdinan amar rav matchil bemusafin ufosek bemincha arvit veshacharit vechozer bemusafin
Amar lehu shemuel puku veemaru leh leabba achar sheasito kodesh taasehu chol ella amar shemuel matchil bemusafin uvmincha ufosek arvit veshacharit vechozer umatchil bemusafin

a: Rava amar kevan shehitchil shuv eno posek vechen amar rav sheshet kevan shehitchil shuv eno posek

Veaf rav hadar beh deamar rav chananel amar rav mone esrim veechad yom kederech shemmone asara yamim merosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim umatchil vechevan shehitchil shuv eno posek vehilcheta kevan shehitchil shuv eno posek
Matni ad matay shoalin et haggeshamim rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyaavor happesach rabbi meir omer ad sheyyetze nisan shenneemar vayyored lachem geshem more umalkosh barishon

Gema amar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak yore benisan yore bimrachshevan hu ditnan yore bimrachshevan umalkosh benisan amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan bime yoel ben petuel nitkayyem mikra ze dichtiv beh yeter haggazam achal haarbe vego otah shana yatza adar velo yardu geshamim yarda lahem revia rishona beechad benisan

Amar lahem navi leyisrael tzeu veziru amru lo mi sheyyesh lo kav chittim o kabbayyim seorin yochlennu veyichye o yizraennu veyamut amar lahem af al pi chen tzeu veziru naasa lahem nes venitgalla lahem ma shebbakketalin uma shebbechore nemalim

Yatzu vezaru sheni ushlishi urvii veyarda lahem revia sheniyya bachamishsha benisan hikrivu omer beshishsha asar benisan nimtzet tevua haggedela beshishsha chodashim gedela beachad asar yom nimtza omer hakkarev mittevua shel shishsha chodashim karev mittevua shel achad asar yom

Veal oto haddor hu omer hazzorim bedima berinna yiktzoru haloch yelech uvacho nose meshech hazzara vego may haloch yelech uvacho nose meshech vego amar rabbi yehuda shor keshehu choresh holech uvoche uvachazirato ochel chaziz min hattelem vezehu bo yavo berinna
May nose alummotav amar rav chisda veamri lah bematnita tana kane zeret shibolet zirtayim
Amar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak may dichtiv ki kara Adonai laraav vegam ba el haaretz sheva shanim behanach sheva shanim may achul

Amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan shana rishona achlu ma shebbabbattim sheniyya achlu ma shebbassadot shelishit besar behema tehora reviit besar behema temea chamishit besar shekatzim urmasim shishshit besar benehem uvnotehem sheviit besar zerootehem lekayyem ma shenneemar ish besar zeroo yochelu

Vaamar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak may dichtiv bekirbecha kadosh velo avo beir mishshum divkirbecha kadosh lo avo beir amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan amar hakkadosh baruch hu lo avo birushalayim shel mala ad sheavo lirushalayim shel matta
Umi ika yerushalayim lemala in dichtiv yerushalam habbenuya keir shechubbera lah yachdav

Vaamar leh rabbi nachman lerabbi yitzchak may dichtiv uvachat yivaru veyichsalu musar havalim etz hu amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan achat hi shemmevaeret reshaim begehinnam may hi avoda zara ketiv hacha musar havalim etz hu uchtiv hatam hevel hemma maase tatuim
Vaamar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak may dichtiv ki shettayim raot asa ammi tarten hu dahao esrin vearba shevika lehu amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan achat shehi
b: Shekula kishtayim umay nihu avoda zara dichtiv ki shettayim raot asa ammi oti azvu mekor mayim chayyim lachtzov lahem borot borot nishbarim uchtiv behu ki ivru iyye chittiyyim uru vekedar shilchu vehitbonnu meod vego hahemir goy elohim vehemma lo elohim veammi hemir kevodo belo yoil
Tana kutiyyim ovdim laesh vekedariyyim ovdin lammayim veaf al pi sheyyodim shehammayim mechabbin et haesh lo hemiru elohehem veammi hemir kevodo belo yoil

Vaamar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak may dichtiv vayehi kaasher zaken shemuel umi siv shemuel kulle hay veha bar chamishim ushtayim hava deamar mar met bachamishim ushtayim shana zehu mitato shel shemuel haramati

Amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan zikna kaftza alav dichtiv nichamti ki himlachti et shaul amar lefanav ribbono shel olam shekaltani kemoshe veaharon dichtiv moshe veaharon bechohanav ushmuel bekore shemo ma moshe veaharon lo batlu maase yedehem bechayyehem af ani lo yitbattel maase yaday bechayyay

Amar hakkadosh baruch hu hechi eeved lemut shaul la ka shavek shemuel lemut shemuel addezutar meranneni abbatreh la lemut shaul vela lemut shemuel kevar higgia malchut david veen malchut nogaat bachavertah afilu kimlo nima

Amar hakkadosh baruch hu akpitz alav zikna hayenu dichtiv veshaul yoshev baggiva tachat haeshel barama vechi ma inyan giva etzel rama ella lomar lecha mi garam leshaul sheyyashav baggiva shette shanim umechetza tefillato shel shemuel haramati

Umi midche gavra mikkamme gavra in deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv al ken chatzavti banneviim haragtim beimre fi bemaasehem lo neemar ella beimre fi alma midche gavra mikkamme gavra

Rav nachman verabbi yitzchak hao yatvi bisudta amar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak lema mar milta amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan en mesichin bisuda shemma yakdim kane leveshet veyavo lide sakkana

Batar disud amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan yaakov avinu lo met amar leh vechi bichdi sefadu safdanayya vachanatu chantayya ukvaru kabbarayya amar leh mikra ani doresh shenneemar veatta al tira avdi yaakov neum Adonai veal techat yisrael ki hinni moshiacha merachok veet zaracha meeretz shivyam makkish hu lezaro ma zaro bachayyim af hu bachayyim
Amar rabbi yitzchak kol haomer rachav rachav miyyad nikre amar leh rav nachman ana amena vela ichpat li amar leh ki kaamena beodah uvmakkirah

Ki hao mipatri mehadade amar leh livarchan mar amar leh emshol lecha mashal lema haddavar dome leadam shehaya holech bammidbar vehaya raev veayef vetzame umatza ilan shepperotav metukin vetzillo nae veammat hammayim overet tachtav achal mipperotav veshata mimmemav veyashav betzilo

Uchshebbikesh lelech amar ilan ilan bamma avarechcha im omar lecha sheyehu perotecha metukin hare perotecha metukin sheyehe tzilcha nae hare tzilcha nae shettehe ammat hammayim overet tachtecha hare ammat hammayim overet tachtecha ella yehi ratzon shekkol netiot shennotin mimmecha

a: Yihu kemotcha af atta bamma avarechcha im betora hare tora im beosher hare osher im bevanim hare banim ella yehi ratzon sheyyihu tzeetzae meecha kemotcha

Tanu rabbanan yore shemmore et habberiyyot lehatiach gaggotehen ulhachnis et perotehen velaasot kol tzorchehen davar acher shemmarve et haaretz umashkah ad tehom shenneemar telameha rave nachet gedudeha birvivim temoggenna tzimchah tevarech davar acher yore sheyyored benachat veeno yored bezaaf

O eno yore ella shemmashshir et happerot umashtif et hazzeraim umashtif et hailanot talmud lomar malkosh ma malkosh livracha af yore livracha o eno malkosh ella shemmappil et habbattim umshabber et hailanot umaale et hassakkain talmud lomar yore ma yore livracha af malkosh livracha
Veore gufeh menalan dichtiv uvne tziyyon gilu vesimchu ba elohechem ki natan lachem et hammore litzdaka vayyored lachem geshem more umalkosh barishon
Tanu rabbanan yore bimrachshevan umalkosh benisan atta omer yore bimrachshevan umalkosh benisan o eno ella yore betishri umalkosh beiyyar talmud lomar beitto

Malkosh amar rav nehilay bar ide amar shemuel davar shemmal kashutehen shel yisrael deve rabbi yishmael tana davar shemmemalle tevua bekashsheha bematnita tana davar sheyyored al hammelilot veal hakkashshin

Tanu rabbanan yore bimrachshevan umalkosh benisan atta omer yore bimrachshevan o eno ella bechodesh kislev talmud lomar beitto yore umalkosh ma malkosh beitto af yore beitto kevan sheyyatza nisan veyardu geshamim eno siman beracha
Tanya idach yore bimrachshevan umalkosh benisan divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim yore bechislev

Man chachamim amar rav chisda rabbi yose hi detanya ezo hi revia rishona habbechira bishlosha bimrachshevan benonit beshiva bo afila beshiva asar bo divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer beshiva uvshiva asar uvesrim ushlosha
Rabbi yose omer beshiva asar uvesrim ushlosha uvrosh chodesh kislev vechen haya rabbi yose omer en hayechidim mitannin ad sheyyaggia rosh chodesh kislev

Amar rav chisda halacha kerabbi yose ammemar matne leha derav chisda beha lishana bishlosha bimrachshevan shoalin et haggeshamim rabban gamliel omer beshiva bo amar rav chisda halacha kerabban gamliel

Keman azla ha detanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer geshamim sheyyardu shiva yamim ze achar ze atta mone bahen revia rishona ushniyya ushlishit keman kerabbi yose amar rav chisda halacha kerabbi yose
Bishlama revia rishona lishol shelishit lehitannot sheniyya lemay amar rabbi zera lindarim ditnan
b: Hannoder ad haggeshamim mishsheyyerdu geshamim ad shettered revia sheniyya

Rav zevid amar lezetim ditnan meematay kol adam muttarin beleket beshichcha uvfea mishsheyyelchu hannamoshot beferet uvolelot mishsheyyelchu aniyyim bakkerem veyavou bezetim mishshettered revia sheniyya
May namoshot amar rabbi yochanan save deazli attigra resh lakish amar lakote batar lakote
Rav pappa amar kede lehallech bishvile harshut deamar mar mehallechin kol adam bishvile harshut ad shettered revia sheniyya
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar levaer perot sheviit ditnan ad matay nehenin vesorfin beteven uvkash shel sheviit ad shettered revia sheniyya
May tama dichtiv velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha kol zeman shechayya ochelet bassade haachel livhemtecha babbayit kala lachayya min hassade kalle livhemtecha min habbayit

Amar rabbi avahu may leshon revia davar sherovea et hakkarka kidrav yehuda deamar rav yehuda mitra balah deara hu shenneemar ki kaasher yered haggeshem vehashsheleg min hashshamayim veshamma lo yashuv ki im hirva et haaretz veholidah vehitzmichah
Veamar rabbi avahu revia rishona kede shettered bakkarka tefach sheniyya kede laguf bah pi chavit amar rav chisda geshamim sheyyardu kede laguf bahen pi chavit en bahen mishshum veatzar
Veamar rav chisda geshamim sheyyardu kodem veatzar en bahen mishshum veatzar

Amar abbaye la amaran ella kodem veatzar deurta aval kodem veatzar detzafra yesh bahen mishshum veatzar deamar rav yehuda bar yitzchak hane anane detzafra let behu meshasha dichtiv ma eese lecha efrayim ma eese lecha yehuda vechasdechem kaanan boker vego
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veha amri inashe bemiftach bave mitra bar chammara much sakkach ugni la kashya ha diktir beeva ha diktir baanane

Amar rav yehuda tava leshatta detevet armalta ika deamri dela bayeri tarbitze veika deamri dela shekil shudfana ini vehaamar rav chisda tava leshatta detevet menavalta la kashya ha daata mitra meikara ha dela ata mitra meikara

Veamar rav chisda geshamim sheyyardu al miktzat medina veal miktzat medina lo yardu en bahen mishshum veatzar ini vehachtiv vegam anochi manati mikkem et haggeshem beod shelosha chodashim lakkatzir vehimtarti al ir echat veal ir achat lo amtir chelka achat timmater vego veamar rav yehuda amar rav shettehen liklala
La kashya ha daata tuva ha daata kidmibbee leh amar rav ashe dayeka name dichtiv timmater tehe mekom matar shema minah
Amar rabbi avahu meematay mevarchin al haggeshamim mishsheyyetze chatan likrat kalla

May mevarech amar rav yehuda amar rav modim anachnu lach Adonai elohenu al kol tippa vetippa shehoradta lanu verabbi yochanan mesayyem bah hachi ilu finu male shira kayyam ulshonenu rinna kahamon gallav ku ad al yazevunu rachamecha Adonai elohenu velo azavunu baruch rov hahodaot
Rov hahodaot velo kol hahodaot amar rava ema el hahodaot amar rav pappa hilkach

a: Nemrinhu letarvayehu el hahodaot verov hahodaot

Amar rabbi avahu gadol yom haggeshamim mittechiyyat hammetim deilu techiyyat hammetim latztzaddikim veilu geshamim ben latztzaddikim ben larshaim ufliga derav yosef deamar rav yosef mittoch shehi shekula kitchiyyat hammetim kevauha bitchiyyat hammetim

Amar rav yehuda gadol yom haggeshamim keom shennitna bo tora shenneemar yaarof kammatar likchi veen lekach ella tora shenneemar ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu rava amar yoter miyyom shennitna bo tora shenneemar yaarof kammatar likchi mi nitle bemi heve omer katan nitle baggadol
Rava rame ketiv yaarof kammatar likchi uchtiv tizzal kattal imrati im talmid chacham hagun hu kattal veim lav orfehu kammatar

Tanya haya rabbi benaa omer kol haosek betora lishmah torato naaset lo sam chayyim shenneemar etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah veomer rifut tehi lesharrecha veomer ki motzi matza chayyim vechol haosek battora shello lishmah naaset lo sam hammavet shenneemar yaarof kammatar likchi veen arifa ella hariga shenneemar vearfu sham et haegla bannachal

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera lete mar litne amar leh chalash libbay vela yachelna lema mar milta deaggadta amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv ki haadam etz hassade vechi adam etz sade hu
Ella mishshum dichtiv ki mimmennu tochel veoto lo tichrot uchtiv oto tashchit vecharatta ha ketzad im talmid chacham hagun hu mimmennu tochel veoto lo tichrot veim lav oto tashchit vecharatta
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina may dichtiv barzel bevarzel yachad lomar lach ma barzel ze echad mechadded et chavero af shene talmide chachamim mechaddedin ze et ze bahalacha
Amar rabba bar bar chana lamma nimshelu divre tora kaesh shenneemar halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai lomar lach ma esh eno dolek yechidi af divre tora en mitkayemin bichidi
Vehayenu deamar rabbi yose bar chanina may dichtiv cherev el habbaddim venoalu cherev al sonehen shel talmide chachamim sheoskin bad bevad battora velo od ella shemmittappeshin shenneemar venoalu
Velo od ella shechotin ketiv hacha venoalu uchtiv hatam asher noalnu vaasher chatanu veibaet ema mehacha noalu sare tzoan vego hitu et mitzrayim

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lamma nimshelu divre tora keetz shenneemar etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah lomar lach ma etz katan madlik et haggadol af talmide chachamim ketannim mechaddedim et haggedolim vehayenu deamar rabbi chanina harbe lamadti merabbotay umechaveray yoter merabbotay umittalmiday yoter mikkullan
Rabbi chanina bar pappa rame ketiv likrat tzame hetau mayim uchtiv hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim im talmid hagun hu likrat tzame hetau mayim vei la hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim
Rabbi chanina bar chama rame ketiv yafutzu mayenotecha chutza uchtiv yihu lecha levaddecha im talmid hagun hu yafutzu mayenotecha chutza veim lav yihu lecha levaddecha

Veamar rabbi chanina bar idi lamma nimshelu divre tora lemayim dichtiv hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim lomar lach ma mayim mannichin makom gavoha veholchin lemakom namuch af divre tora en mitkayemin ella bemi sheddato shefala

Veamar rabbi oshaya lamma nimshelu divre tora lishlosha mashkin hallalu bemayim uvyayin uvchalav dichtiv hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim uchtiv lechu shivru veecholu ulchu shivru belo chesef uvlo mechir yayin vechalav lomar lach ma shelosha mashkin hallalu en mitkayemin ella bappachut shebbakkelim af divre tora en mitkayemin ella bemi sheddato shefala

Kedaamara leh beratte dekesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya i chochma mefoara bichli mechoar amar lah avicha rame chamra bemane defachra amara leh ella bemay nirme amar lah attun dachashivitu remo bemane dahava vechaspa

Azala vaamara leh laavuh ramyeh lechamra bemane dahava vechaspa utkef ato vaamaru leh amar lah livratteh man amar lach hachi amara leh rabbi yehoshua ben chananya karuhu amar leh ammay amarte lah hachi amar leh ki hechi daamara li amari lah veha ika shappire digmiri
b: I hao senu tefe hao gemiri davar acher ma shelosha mashkin hallalu en nifsalin ella behesach haddaat af divre tora en mishtachchin ella behesach haddaat

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina gadol yom haggeshamim keom shennivreu shamayim vaaretz shenneemar harifu shamayim mimmaal ushchakim yizzelu tzedek tiftach eretz veyifru yesha utzdaka tatzmiach yachad ani Adonai berativ beratim lo neemar ella berativ

Amar rav oshaya gadol yom haggeshamim sheafilu yeshua para verava bo shenneemar tiftach eretz veyifru yesha amar rabbi tanchum bar chanilay en haggeshamim yordim ella im ken nimchalu aonotehen shel yisrael shenneemar ratzita Adonai artzecha shavta shevit yaakov nasata aon ammecha kissita chol chattatam sela
Amar leh zeeri middihavat leravina attun mehacha matnitu lah anan mehacha matnenan lah veatta tishma hashshamayim vesalachta lechattat vego

Amar rabbi tanchum bereh derabbi chiyya ish kefar akko en haggeshamim neetzarin ella im ken nitchayevu sonehen shel yisrael kelaya shenneemar tziyya gam chom yigzelu meme sheleg sheol chatau amar leh zeeri middihavat leravina attun mehacha matnitu lah anan mehacha matnenan lah veatzar et hashshamayim vaavadtem mehera

Amar rav chisda en haggeshamim neetzarin ella bishvil bitul terumot umaasrot shenneemar tziyya gam chom yigzelu meme sheleg may mashma tana deve rabbi yishmael bishvil devarim shetztziviti etchem bimot hachamma velo asitem yiggazlu mikkem meme sheleg bimot haggeshamim
Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi en haggeshamim neetzarin ella bishvil mesappere lashon hara shenneemar ruach tzafon techolel gashem ufanim nizamim leshon sater

Amar rav salla amar rav hamnuna en haggeshamim neetzarin ella bishvil azze fanim shenneemar vayyimmanu revivim umalkosh lo haya umetzach ishsha zona haya lach vego veamar rav salla amar rav hamnuna kol adam sheyyesh lo azzut panim sof nichshal baavera shenneemar umetzach ishsha zona haya lach rav nachman amar beyadua shennichshal baavera shenneemar haya lach velo neemar yihye lach

Amar rabba bar rav huna kol adam sheyyesh lo azzut panim muttar likroto rasha shenneemar heez ish rasha befanav rav nachman bar yitzchak amar muttar lisnooto shenneemar veoz panav yeshunne al tikre yeshunne ella yissane

Amar rav kattina en haggeshamim neetzarin ella bishvil bitul tora shenneemar baatzaltayim yimmach hammekare bishvil atzlut shehaya beyisrael shello asku battora naase sono shel hakkadosh baruch hu mach veen mach ella ani shenneemar veim mach hu meerkecha veen mekare ella hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar hamkare vammayim aliyyotav

Rav yosef amar mehacha veatta lo rau or bahir hu bashshechakim veruach avra vattetaharem veen or ella tora shenneemar ki ner mitzva vetora or bahir hu bashshechakim tana deve rabbi yishmael afilu beshaa sherakia naase behorin behorin lehorid tal umatar ruach avra vattetaharem

Amar rabbi amme en haggeshamim neetzarin ella baaon gazel shenneemar al kappayim kissa or baaon kappayim kissa or veen kappayim ella chamas shenneemar umin hechamas asher bechappehem veen or ella matar shenneemar yafitz anan oro
May takkanteh yarbe bitfilla shenneemar vayetzav aleha bemafgia veen pegia ella tefilla shenneemar veatta al titpallel bead haam hazze vego veal tifga bi
Veamar rabbi amme may dichtiv im keha habbarzel vehu lo fanim kilkal im raita rakia shekkeha kabbarzel millehorid tal umatar bishvil maase haddor shehen mekulkalin shenneemar vehu lo fanim kilkal
Ma takkanatan yitgabberu berachamim shenneemar vachayalim yegabber veyitron hachsher chochma kol shekken im huchsheru maasehen meikara
Resh lakish amar im raita talmid

a: Shettalmudo kashe alav kabbarzel bishvil mishnato sheenah sedura alav shenneemar vehu lo fanim kilkal
May takkanteh yarbe bishiva shenneemar vachayalim yegabber veyitron hachsher chochma kol shekken im mishnato sedura lo meikara

Ki ha deresh lakish hava mesaddar matniteh arbein zimnin keneged arbaim yom shennitna tora veayel lekammeh derabbi yochanan rav adda bar ahava mesaddar matniteh esrin vearba zimnin keneged tora neviim uchtuvim veayel lekammeh derava
Rava amar im raita talmid shettalmudo kashe alav kabbarzel bishvil rabbo sheeno masbir lo panim shenneemar vehu lo fanim kilkal
May takkanteh yarbe alav reim shenneemar vachayalim yegabber veyitron hachsher chochma kol shekken im huchsheru maasav bifne rabbo meikara

Veamar rabbi amme may dichtiv im yishshoch hannachash belo lachash veen yitron levaal hallashon im raita dor shehashshamayim mishtakkin kinchoshet millehorid tal umatar bishvil lochashe lechishot sheen baddor
May takkanatan yelchu etzel mi sheyyodea lilchosh dichtiv yaggid alav reo veen ytron levaal hallashon umi sheefshar lo lilchosh veeno lochesh ma hanaa yesh lo

Veim lachash velo naana may takkanteh yelech etzel chasid shebbaddor veyarbe alav bitfilla shenneemar vayetzav aleha bemafgia veen pegia ella tefila shenneemar veatta al titpallel bead haam hazze veal tissa vaadam rinna utfilla veal tifga bi
Veim lachash vealta beyado umegis dato alav mevi af laolam shenneemar mikne af al ole
Rava amar shene talmide chachamim sheyyoshvin beir achat veen nochin ze laze bahalacha mitkannein baaf umaalin oto shenneemar mikne af al ole

Amar resh lakish may dichtiv im yishshoch hannachash belo lachash veen yitron levaal hallashon leatid lavo mitkabbetzot uvaot kol hachayyot etzel hannachash veomrim lo ari dores veochel zeev toref veochel atta ma hanaa yesh lecha omer lahem veen yitron levaal hallashon

Amar rabbi amme en tefillato shel adam nishmaat ella im ken mesim nafsho bechappo shenneemar nissa levavenu el kappayim ini veha okem shemuel amora aleh udrash vayefattuhu befihem uvilshonam yechazzevu lo velibbam lo nachon immo velo neemnu bivrito veaf al pi chen vehu rachum yechapper aon vego
La kashya kan beyachid kan betzibbur
Amar rabbi amme en geshamim yordin ella bishvil baale amana shenneemar emet meeretz titzmach vetzedek mishshamayim nishkaf
Veamar rabbi amme bo ure kamma gedolim baale amana minnayin mechulda uvor uma hammaamin bechulda uvor kach hammaamin behakkadosh baruch hu al achat kamma vechamma

Amar rabbi yochanan kol hammatzdik et atzmo millematta matzdikin alav haddin millemala shenneemar emet meeretz titzmach vetzedek mishshamayim nishkaf rabbi chiyya bar avin amar rav huna mehacha uchyiratcha evratecha

Resh lakish amar mehacha pagata et sas veose tzedek bidrachecha yizkerucha hen atta katzafta vannecheta bahem olam venivashea amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol hassameach beyissurin shebbain alav mevi yeshua laolam shenneemar bahem olam venivashea

Amar resh lakish may dichtiv veatzar et hashshamayim beshaa shehashshamayim neetzarin millehorid tal umatar dome leishsha shemmechabbelet veenah yoledet vehayenu deamar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara neemra atzira bigshamim veneemra atzira beishsha
b: Neemra atzira beishsha shenneemar ki atzor atzar Adonai bead kol rechem veneemra atzira bigshamim dichtiv veatzar et hashshamayim
Neemar leda beishsha veneemar leda bigshamim neemar leda beishsha dichtiv vattahar vatteled ben veneemar leda bigshamim dichtiv veholidah vehitzmichah

Neemar pekida beishsha veneemar pekida bigshamim neemar pekida beishsha dichtiv va pakad et sara veneemar pekida bigshamim dichtiv pakadta haaretz vatteshokkeha rabbat tasherenna peleg elohim male mayim
May peleg elohim male mayim tana kemin kubba yesh barakia shemmimmenna geshamim yotzin
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani may dichtiv im leshevet im leartzo im lechesed yamtziehu im leshevet beharim uvigvaot im lechesed yamtziehu leartzo besadot uvichramim
Im leshevet leilanot im leartzo lizraim im lechesed yamtziehu borot shichin umarot

Bime rabbi shemuel bar nachmani hava kafna umotana amri hechi naaved nive rachame attarte la efshar ella live rachame ammotana vechafna nisbol amar lehu rabbi shemuel bar nachmani nive rachame akkafna dechi yahev rachamana suva lechayye hu deyahev dichtiv poteach et yadecha umasbia lechol chay ratzon

Umnalan dela metzallinan attarte dichtiv vannatzuma vannevaksha meelohenu al zot mikkelal deika achariti bemareva amri mishshemeh derabbi chaggay mehacha verachamin lemive min kodam elah shemayya al raza dena mikkelal deika achariti
Bime rabbi zera gezur shemada ugzur dela lemetav betaanita amar lehu rabbi zera nekabbeleh ilavan ulchi batel shemada letveh
Amri leh mena lach ha amar lehu dichtiv vayyomer elay al tira daniyyel ki min hayyom harishon asher natatta et libbecha lehavin ulhitannot lifne elohecha nishmeu devarecha

Amar rabbi yitzchak afilu shanim kishne eliyyahu veyardu geshamim bearve shabbatot enan ella siman kelala hayenu deamar rabba bar shela kashe yoma demitra keoma dedina amar ammemar i la ditzrich livriyyata baenan rachame umvattelinan leh

Veamar rabbi yitzchak shemesh beshabbat tzedaka laaniyyim shenneemar vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe veamar rabbi yitzchak gadol yom haggeshamim sheafilu peruta shebbakkis mitbarechet bo shenneemar latet metar artzecha beitto ulvarech et kol maase yadecha

Veamar rabbi yitzchak en habberacha metzuya ella bedavar hassamuy min haayin shenneemar yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha tana deve rabbi yishmael en habberacha metzuya ella bedavar sheen haayin sholetet bo shenneemar yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha

Tanu rabbanan hannichnas lamod et gorno omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettishlach beracha bemaase yadenu hitchil lamod omer baruch hashsholeach beracha bakkeri hazze madad veachar kach berach hare zo tefillat shave lefi sheen habberacha metzuya lo bedavar hashshakul velo bedavar hammadud velo bedavar hammanuy ella bedavar hassamuy min haayin

Kibbutz geyasot tzedaka maaser parnas siman amar rabbi yochanan gadol yom haggeshamim keom kibbutz galiyyot shenneemar shuva Adonai et shevitenu kaafikim bannegev veen afikim ella matar shenneemar vayyerau afike yam

Veamar rabbi yochanan gadol yom haggeshamim sheafilu geyasot poskot bo shenneemar telameha rave nachet gedudeha veamar rabbi yochanan en haggeshamim neetzarin ella bishvil poske tzedaka barabbim veen notnin shenneemar nesiim veruach vegeshem ayin ish mithallel bemattat shaker
Veamar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv

a: Asser teasser asser bishvil shettitashsher
Ashkecheh rabbi yochanan leyanoka deresh lakish amar leh ima li pesukach amar leh asser teasser amar leh umay asser teasser amar leh asser bishvil shettitashsher amar leh mena lach amar leh zil nassi

Amar leh umi shere lenassoyeh lehakkadosh baruch hu vehachtiv lo tenassu et Adonai amar leh hachi amar rabbi hoshaya chutz mizzo shenneemar haviu et kol hammaaser el bet haotzar vihi teref beveti uvchanuni na bazot amar Adonai tzevaot im lo eftach lachem et arubbot hashshamayim vaharikoti lachem beracha ad beli day
May ad beli day amar rame bar chama amar rav ad sheyyivlu siftotechem millomar day amar leh i havat mate hatam lehay pesuka la havet tzerichna lach ulhoshaya rabbach
Vetu ashkecheh rabbi yochanan leyanokeh deresh lakish deyatev veamar ivelet adam tesallef darko veal Adonai yizaf libbo
Yetev rabbi yochanan veka matmah amar mi ika mide dichtivi bichtuve dela remizi beorayeta amar leh attu ha mi la remizi vehachtiv vayyetze libbam vayyecherdu ish el achiv lemor ma zot asa elohim lanu
Dal eneh vachaza beh atya imeh appekteh amara leh ta mikkammeh dela lebad lach kedaavad laavuch

Amar rabbi yochanan matar bishvil yachid parnasa bishvil rabbim matar bishvil yachid dichtiv yiftach Adonai lecha et otzaro hattov latet metar artzecha parnasa bishvil rabbim dichtiv hinni mamtir lachem lechem

Metivi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer shelosha parnasim tovim amdu leyisrael ellu hen moshe veaharon umiryam veshalosh mattanot tovot nitnu al yadam veellu hen beer veanan uman beer bizchut miryam ammud anan bizchut aharon man bizchut moshe meta miryam nistallek habbeer shenneemar vattamot sham miryam uchtiv batreh velo haya mayim laeda vechazra bizchut shenehen

Met aharon nistalleku anne kavod shenneemar vayyishma hakkenaani melech arad ma shemua shama shama shemmet aharon venistalleku anne kavod uchsavur nitna lo reshut lehillachem beyisrael vehayenu dichtiv vayyiru kol haeda ki gava aharon
Amar rabbi avahu al tikre vayyiru ella vayyirau kiddaresh resh lakish deamar resh lakish ki meshammesh bearba leshonot i dilma ella deha

Chazru shenehem bizchut moshe met moshe nistalleku kullan shenneemar vaachchid et sheloshet haroim beyerach echad vechi beyerach echad metu vahalo miryam meta benisan veaharon beav umoshe baadar ella melammed shennitbattelu shalosh mattanot tovot shennittenu al yadan venistalleku kullan beyerach echad
Alma ashkechan parnasa bishvil yachid shane moshe kevan dilrabbim hu bae kerabbim dame

Rav huna bar manoach verav shemuel bar idi verav chiyya miuostanya hao shechichi kammeh derava ki nach nafsheh derava ato lekammeh derav pappa kol emat dahava amar lehu shemata vela hava mistabbera lehu hao merammezi ahadade chalash dateh
b: Akreuh bechelmeh vaachchid et sheloshet haroim limchar ki hao mipatri mineh amar lehu lezlu rabbanan bishlama
Rav shimi bar ashe hava shechiach kammeh derav pappa hava makshe leh tuva yoma chad chazyeh dinfal al appeh shameh deamar rachamana litzlan mikkisufa deshimi kabbel aleh shetikuta vetu la akshi leh
Veaf resh lakish savar matar bishvil yachid deamar resh lakish minnayin lammatar bishvil yachid dichtiv shaalu me matar beet malkosh Adonai ose chazizim umtar geshem yitten lahem leish esev bassade
Yachol lakkol talmud lomar leish vetanya i leish yachol lechol sedotav talmud lomar sade i sade yachol lechol hassade talmud lomar esev
Ki ha derav daniel bar kattina hava leh hahi ginta kol yoma hava azel vesayar lah amar ha meshra baaya mayya veha meshra la baaya mayya vaata mitra vekamashke kol hecha demibe leh mayya

May Adonai ose chazizim amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina melammed shekkol tzaddik hakkadosh baruch hu ose lo chaziz bifne atzmo may chazizim amar rav yehuda porchot amar rabbi yochanan siman lammatar porchot may porchot amar rav pappa eva kelisha tute eva semichta
Amar rav yehuda nehila mikkamme mitra ate mitra batar mitra pasek mitra mikkamme mitra ate mitra vesimanach maholta devatar mitra pasek mitra vesimanach charya deize
Ulla ikla levavel chaza porchot amar lehu pannu mane dehashta ate mitra lesof la ate mitra amar ki hechi dimshakkeri bavlae hachi meshakkeri mitrayehu
Ulla ikla levavel chaze mela tzanna detamre bezuza amar mela tzanna deduvsha bezuza uvavlae la aski beorayeta belelya tzaaruhu amar mela tzanna desakkine bezuza uvavlae aski beorayeta

Tanya rabbi eliezer omer kol haolam kullo mimmeme okyanos hu shote shenneemar veed yaale min haaretz vehishka et kol pene haadama amar lo rabbi yehoshua vahalo meme okyanos meluchin hen amar lo mitmattekin beavim

Rabbi yehoshua omer kol haolam kullo mimmayim haelonim hu shote shenneemar limtar hashshamayim tishte mayim ella ma ani mekayyem veed yaale min haaretz melammed shehaananim mitgabberim veolim larakia ufotchin pihen kenod umkabbelin me matar shenneemar yazokku matar leedo

Umnukkavot hen kichvara uvaot umchashsherot mayim al gabbe karka shenneemar chashrat mayim ave shechakim veen ben tipa letipa ella kimlo nima lelammedcha sheggadol yom haggeshamim keom shennivreu bo shamayim vaaretz
Shenneemar ose gedolot veen cheker uchtiv hannoten matar al pene aretz uchtiv lehallan halo yadata im lo shamata elohe olam Adonai en cheker litvunato uchtiv mechin harim bechocho vego
Keman azla ha dichtiv mashke harim mealiyyotav veamar rabbi yochanan mealiyyotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu keman kerabbi yehoshua

Verabbi eliezer kevan desalki lehatam mashke mealiyyotav kare lehu dei la tema hachi avak veafar min hashshamayim hechi mashkachatte lah ella kevan demiddele lehatam min hashshamayim kare leh hachi name desalki lehatam mealiyyotav kare leh
Keman azla ha deamar rabbi chanina kones kanned me hayyam noten beotzarot tehomot mi garam laotzarot sheyyitmalleu bar tehomot kerabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua hahu

a: Bivriyyato shel olam

Tanu rabbanan eretz yisrael nivret techila vechol haolam kullo nivra levassof shenneemar ad lo asa eretz vechutzot eretz yisrael mashke otah hakkadosh baruch hu beatzmo vechol haolam kullo al yede shaliach shenneemar hannoten matar al pene aretz vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot

Eretz yisrael shota me geshamim vechol haolam kullo mittamtzit shenneemar hannoten matar al pene aretz vego eretz yisrael shota techila vechol haolam kullo levassof shenneemar hannoten matar al pene aretz vego mashal leadam shemmegabbel et haggevina notel et haochel umanniach et happesolet
Amar mar mimmattekin hen beavim menaleh deamar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan ketiv cheshchat mayim ave shechakim uchtiv chashrat mayim ave shechakim
Shekol kaf ushdi aresh ukri beh chachsharat
Verabbi yehoshua behane kerae may daresh behu savar lah ki ha dechi ata rav dimi amar amri bemareva nehur anane zeerin mohi chashuch anane saggiyyin mohi

Keman azla ha detanya mayim haelonim bemaamar hem teluyim uferotehen me geshamim shenneemar mipperi maasecha tisba haaretz keman kerabbi yehoshua verabbi eliezer hahu bemaase yadav shel hakkadosh baruch hu hu dichtiv
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol haolam kullo mittamtzit gan eden hu shote shenneemar venahar yotze meeden vego tana mittamtzit bet kor shote tarkav

Tanu rabbanan eretz mitzrayim haveya arba meot parsa al arba meot parsa vehu echad mishshishshim bechush vechush echad mishshishshim baolam veolam echad mishshishshim baggan vegan echad mishshishshim leeden veeden echad mishshishshim legehinnam nimtza kol haolam kullo kechisuy kedera legehinnam veyesh omrim gehinnam en lah shiur veyesh omrim eden en lah shiur

Amar rabbi oshaya may dichtiv shochante al mayim rabbim rabbat otzarot mi garam levavel sheyehu otzroteha meleot bar heve omer mippene sheshshochenet al mayim rabbim amar rav attira bavel dechatzda bela mitra amar abbaye nekitinan tovani velo yovshani
Matni bishlosha bimrachshevan shoalin et haggeshamim rabban gamliel omer beshiva bo chamishsha asar yom achar hechag kede sheyyaggia acharon shebbeyisrael linhar perat
Gema amar rabbi elazar halacha kerabban gamliel tanya chananya omer uvaggola ad shishshim battekufa amar rav huna bar chiyya amar shemuel halacha kachananya
Ini veha beo mineh mishshemuel meemat madkerinan veten tal umatar amar lehu mikki meayeli tzive leve tavut rishba dilma ide veide chad shiura hu
Ibaya lehu yom shishshim kelifne shishshim o kilachar shishshim ta shema rav amar yom shishshim kilachar shishshim ushmuel amar yom shishshim kelifne shishshim
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vesimanach illae bau mayya tattae la bau mayya amar rav pappa hilcheta yom shishshim kilachar shishshim

Matni higgia shiva asar bemarcheshvan velo yardu geshamim hitchilu hayechidim mitannin shalosh taaniyyot ochlin veshotin mishshechashecha umuttarin bimlacha uvirchitza uvsicha uvinilat hassandal uvtashmish hammitta higgia rosh chodesh kislev velo yardu geshamim bet din gozrin shalosh taaniyyot al hatztzibbur ochlin veshotin mishshechashecha umuttarin bimlacha uvirchitza uvsicha uvinilat hassandal uvtashmish hammitta
Gema man yechidim amar rav huna rabbanan vaamar rav huna yechidim mitannin shalosh taaniyyot sheni vachamishi vesheni
May kamashma lan tenena en gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur battechila bachamishi shello lehafkia et hashshearim ella shalosh taaniyyot harishonot sheni vachamishi vesheni
Mahu detema hane mile tzibbur aval yachid la kamashma lan tanya name hachi keshehitchilu hayechidim lehitannot mitannin sheni vachamishi vesheni umafsikin berashe chodashim
b: Uvyamim tovim hakketuvin bimgilat taanit

Tanu rabbanan al yomar adam talmid ani eni rauy lihot yachid ella kol talmide chachamim yechidim ezehu yachid veezehu talmid yachid kol sherauy lemannoto parnas al hatztzibbur talmid kol sheshshoalin oto davar halacha betalmudo veomer vaafilu bemassechta dechalla
Tanu rabbanan lo kol harotze laasot atzmo yachid ose talmid ose divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer ose vezachur lattov lefi sheen shevach hu lo ella tzaar hu lo

Tanya idach lo kol harotze laasot atzmo yachid ose talmid ose divre rabbi shimon ben elazar rabban shimon ben gamliel omer bamme devarim amurim bedavar shel shevach aval bedavar shel tzaar ose vezachur lattov sheen shevach hu lo ella tzaar hu lo

Tanu rabbanan mi shehaya mitanne al hatztzara veavra al hachole venitrappe hare ze mitanne umashlim haholech mimmekom sheen mitannin limkom shemmitannin hare ze mitanne immahen mimmekom shemmitannin limkom sheen mitannin hare ze mitanne umashlim

Shachach veachal veshata al yitrae bifne hatztzibbur veal yanhig idunin beatzmo shenneemar vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau amar lahem yaakov levanav al taru atzmechem kesheattem sevein lo bifne esav velo bifne yishmael kede shello yitkanneu bachem
Al tirgezu baddarech amar rabbi elazar amar lahem yosef leechav al titasseku bidvar halacha shemma teraggezu alechem hadderech

Ini vehaamar rabbi ilay bar berechya shene talmide chachamim shemmehallechim badderech veen benehen divre tora reuyin lisaref shenneemar vayehi hemma holchim haloch vedabber vehinne rechev esh vesuse esh vayyafridu ben shenehem tama deika dibur ha leka dibur reuyin lisaref
La kashya ha lemigras ha leayyone
Bematnita tana al tafsiu pesia gassa vehachnisu chamma lair al tafsiu pesia gassa deamar mar pesia gassa notelet echad mechamesh meot mimmeor enav shel adam
Vehachnisu chamma lair kidrav yehuda amar rav deamar rav yehuda amar rav leolam yetze adam bechi tov veyikkanes bechi tov shenneemar habboker or vehaanashim shullechu
Amar rav yehuda amar rabbi chiyya hamhallech badderech al yochal yoter mishshene reavon may tama hacha targimu mishshum mayana bemareva amri mishshum mezone may benayehu ika benayehu

a: Deyatev bearba i name dekaazel meauona leauona
Rav pappa kol parsa ufarsa achel chada rifta kasavar mishshum mayana

Amar rav yehuda amar rav kol hammariv atzmo bishne reavon nitzal mimmita meshunna shenneemar baraav padcha mimmavet meraav mibe leh ella hachi kaamar bischar shemmariv atzmo bishne reavon nitzol mimmita meshunna
Amar resh lakish asur leadam leshammesh mittato bishne reavon shenneemar ulosef yullad shene vanim beterem tavo shenat haraav tana chasuche banim meshammeshin mittotehen bishne reavon

Tanu rabbanan bizman sheyyisrael sheruyin betzaar uferash echad mehen bain shene malache hashsharet shemmelavin lo laadam umannichin lo yedehen al rosho veomrim peloni ze shepperash min hatztzibbur al yire benechamat tzibbur

Tanya idach bizman shehatztzibbur sharuy betzaar al yomar adam elech leveti veochal veeshte veshalom alayich nafshi veim ose ken alav hakkatuv omer vehinne sason vesimcha harog bakar veshachot tzon achol basar veshatot yayin achol veshato ki machar namut ma ketiv batreh venigla veoznay Adonai tzevaot im yechuppar heaon hazze lachem ad temutun
Ad kan midat benonim aval bemiddat reshaim ma ketiv etau ekcha yayin venisbea shechar vehaya chaze yom machar ma ketiv batreh hatztzaddik avad veen ish sam al lev ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik

Ella yetzaer adam im hatztzibbur shekken matzinu bemoshe rabbenu shetztzier atzmo im hatztzibbur shenneemar vide moshe kevedim vayyikchu even vayyasimu tachtav vayyeshev aleha vechi lo haya lo lemoshe kar echad o keset achat leshev aleha ella kach amar moshe hoil veyisrael sheruyin betzaar af ani ehye immahem betzaar vechol hamtzaer atzmo im hatztzibbur zoche veroe benechamat tzibbur

Veshemma yomar adam mi meid bi avne veto shel adam vekorot beto shel adam meidim bo shenneemar ki even mikkir tizak vechafis meetz yaanenna deve rabbi shela amri shene malache hashsharet hamlavin lo laadam hen meidin alav shenneemar ki malachav yetzave lach
Rabbi chidka omer nishmato shel adam hi meida alav shenneemar mishshochevet chekecha shemor pitche ficha veyesh omrim evarav shel adam meidim bo shenneemar attem eday neum Adonai
El emuna veen avel el emuna keshem shennifrain min harshaim laolam habba afilu al avera kalla sheosin kach nifrain min hatztzaddikim baolam hazze al avera kalla sheosin
Veen avel keshem shemmeshallemin sachar latztzaddikim laolam habba afilu al mitzva kalla sheosin kach meshallemin sachar larshaim baolam hazze afilu al mitzva kalla sheosin

Tzaddik veyashar hu amru bishat petirato shel adam levet olamo kol maasav nifratin lefanav veomrim lo kach vechach asita bemakom peloni beom peloni vehu omer hen veomrim lo chatom vechotem shenneemar beyad kol adam yachtom velo od ella shemmatzdik alav et haddin veomer lahem yafe dantuni lekayyem ma shenneemar lemaan titzdak bedovrecha

Amar shemuel kol hayyoshev betaanit nikra chote savar ki hay tanna detanya rabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi omer ma talmud lomar vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh vechi beeze nefesh chata ze ella shetztzier atzmo min hayyayin
Vahalo devarim kal vechomer uma ze shello tzier atzmo ella min hayyayin nikra chote hamtzaer atzmo mikkol davar vedavar al achat kamma vechamma
Rabbi elazar omer nikra kadosh shenneemar kadosh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho uma ze shello tzier atzmo ella middavar echad nikra kadosh hamtzaer atzmo mikkol davar al achat kamma vechamma
Velishmuel ha ikri kadosh hahu aggidul pera kae ulrabbi elazar ha nikra chote hahu desaev nafsheh
Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi vehaamar rabbi elazar leolam yamod adam atzmo
b: Keilu kadosh sharuy betoch meav shenneemar bekirbecha kadosh velo avo beir la kashya ha dematze letzaore nafsheh ha dela matze letzaore nafsheh
Resh lakish amar nikra chasid shenneemar gomel nafsho ish chased veocher sheero vego amar rav sheshet hay bar be rav deyatev betaanita lechol kalba lesheruteh
Amar rav yirmeya bar abba en taanit tzibur bevavel ella tisha beav bilvad amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar resh lakish en talmid chacham rashshay leshev betaanit mippene shemmemaet bimlechet shamayim

Ochlin veshotin mishshechashecha ku amar rabbi zeera amar rav huna yachid shekkibel alav taanit afilu achal veshata kol hallayela lemachar hu mitpallel tefilat taanit lan betaanito eno mitpallel shel taanit
Amar rav yosef may kasavar rav huna sevira leh en mitannin leshaot o dilma mitannin leshaot vehammitanne leshaot eno mitpallel tefillat taanit
Amar leh abbaye leolam kasavar rav huna mitannin leshaot vehammitanne leshaot mitpallel tefillat taanit veshane hacha deika shaot delelya dela kabbel aleh meikara

Mar ukva ikla leginzak beo mineh mitannin leshaot o en mitannin leshaot la hava bideh kankannin shel nochrim asurin o muttarin la hava bideh bamme shimesh moshe kol shivat yeme hammilluim la hava bideh

Azal ushel be midresha amaru leh hilcheta mitannin leshaot umitpallelin tefillat taanit vehilcheta kankannin shel nochrim leachar shenem asar chodesh muttarin bamme shimesh moshe kol shivat yeme hammilluim bechaluk lavan rav kahana matne bechaluk lavan sheen lo imra
Amar rav chisda

a: Ha deamratte mitannin leshaot vehu shello taam kelum ad haerev amar leh abbaye ha taanit meallayeta hi la tzericha deimlach imloche
Veamar rav chisda kol taanit shello shaka alav chamma la shemeh taanit metivi anshe mishmar mitannin velo mashlimin hatam letzaore nafsheh bealma hu

Ta shema deamar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok ani mibbene vanav shel senaa ben binyamin ufaam achat chal tisha beav lihot beshabbat udchinuhu leachar hashshabbat vehitanninu bo velo hishlamnuhu mippene sheyyom tov shellanu hu hatam name letzaore nafsheh bealma hu
Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan ehe betaanit ad sheavo leveti hatam leshammote nafsheh mibbe nesia hu daavad
Amar shemuel kol taanit shello kibel alav mibbeod yom lav shemeh taanit vei yatev may amar rabba bar shela dame lemappucha demalya zika
Emat mekabbel leh rav amar bemincha ushmuel amar bitfillat hammincha amar rav yosef keoteh dishmuel mistabbera dichtiv bimgilat taanit lahen kol inish deyete alohi mikkadmat dena yesar
May lav yesar atzmo bitzlo la yesar atzmo
Peligi bah rabbi chiyya verabbi shimon berabbi chad amar yesar vechad amar yeaser man deamar yesar kidamrinan leman deamar yeaser may hi

Detanya bimgilat taanit kol inish deyete alohi mikkadmat dena yeaser ketzad yachid shekkibel alav sheni vachamishi vesheni shel kol hashshana kullah veeru bam yamim tovim hakketuvin bimgilat taanit im nidro kodem ligzeratenu yevattel nidro et gezeratenu veim gezeratenu kodemet lenidro tevattel gezeratenu et nidro

Tanu rabbanan ad matay ochel veshote ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar divre rabbi rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer ad kerot haggever amar abbaye lo shanu ella shello gamar seudato aval gamar seudato eno ochel
Etiveh rava gamar veamad hare ze ochel hatam keshello silek ika deamri amar rava lo shanu ella keshello yashan aval yashan eno ochel etiveh abbaye yashan veamad hare ze ochel hatam bemitnamnem
Hechi dame mitnamnem amar rav ashe
b: Nim vela nim tir vela tir dekaru leh veane vela yada ahdore sevara vechi madkeri leh middechar

Amar rav kahana amar rav yachid shekkibel alav taanit asur binilat hassandal chayeshinan shemma taanit tzibbur kibel alav hechi lebad amar rabba bar rav shela lema hachi lemachar ehe lefanecha betaanit yachid
Amaru leh rabbanan lerav sheshet ha ka chazenan rabbanan dimsayemi mesanayehu veatu leve taanita ikfad vaamar lehu dilma mechal name achul

Abbaye verava meayeli ki mesayemi afanta marimar umar zutra mechallefi deyammina lismala vedismala leyammina rabbanan deve rav ashe nafki ki orchayehu savri ki ha deamar shemuel en taanit tzibbur bevavel ella tisha beav bilvad

Amar rav yehuda amar rav love adam taanito uforea ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li vechi neder kabbel aleh dela saggi dela meshallem letzaore nafsheh kabbel aleh i matze metzaar nafsheh i la matze la metzaar nafsheh
Ika deamri amar rav yehuda amar rav love adam taanito uforea ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li peshita lo yehe ella neder neder mi la matze bae leshallome umezal limchar uloma acharina

Rav yehoshua bereh derav ide ikla leve rav assi avadu leh igla tilta amaru leh litom mar mide amar lehu betaanita yatevna amaru leh velozef mar velifra la savar mar leha deamar rav yehuda amar rav love adam taanito uforea amar lehu taanit chalom hu
Veamar rabba bar machseya amar rav chama bar gurya amar rav yafa taanit lachalom keesh linoret amar rav chisda uvo bayyom veamar rav yosef vaafilu beshabbat may takkanteh litev taanita letaanita

Matni avru ellu velo naanu bet din gozrin shalosh taaniyyot acherot al hatztzibbur ochlin veshotin mibbeod yom vaasurin bimlacha uvirchitza uvsicha uvinilat hassandal uvtashmish hammitta venoalin et hammerchatzaot

Avru ellu velo naanu bet din gozrin alehen od sheva shehen shelosh esre taaniyyot al hatztzibbur hare ellu yeterot al harishonot shebbeellu matriin venoalin et hachanuot bashsheni mattin im chashecha uvachamishi muttarin mippene kevod hashshabbat

Avru ellu velo naanu memaatin bemassa umattan bevinyan uvintia beerusin uvnisuin uvishelat shalom ben adam lachavero kivne adam hannezufin lammakom hayechidim chozrin umitannin ad sheyyetze nisan yatza nisan veyardu geshamim siman kelala shenneemar halo ketzir chittim hayyom vego

Gema bishlama kullehu it behu taanug rechitza vesicha vetashmish hammitta aval melacha tzaar hu amar rav chisda amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar kera kaddeshu tzom kiru atzara isfu zekenim kaatzeret ma atzeret asur baasiyyat melacha af taanit asur baasiyyat melacha

I ma atzeret meurta af taanit name meurta amar rabbi zera ledidi miparsha li mineh derabbi yirmeya bar abba amar kera isfu zekenim dumya daasifat zekenim ma asifat zekenim bayyom af tzom name bayyom veema mittihara amar rav shisha bereh derav idi mesayya leh lerav huna deamar mitztzafra kinufya

Hechi avdi amar abbaye mitztzafra ad palga deoma meayeninan bemile demata mikkan veelach riva deoma karenan besifra veaftarta mikkan veelach baenan rachame shenneemar vayyakumu al omdam vayyikreu besefer torat Adonai elohehem reviit hayyom urviit mitvaddim umishtachavim la elohehem

a: Efoch ana la salka datach dichtiv veelay yeasfu kol chared bedivre elohe yisrael al maal haggola vego uchtiv uvminchat haerev kamti mittaaniti vaefresa chappay el Adonai
Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda kol shehu mishshum evel kegon tisha beav veavel asur ben bechammin ben betzonen kol shehu mishshum taanug kegon taanit tzibbur bechammin asur betzonen muttar
Amar rav idi bar avin af anan name tenena venoalin et hammerchatzaot amar leh abbaye vei betzonen asur sochrin et hanneharot mibbee leh lemitne
Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi abba hachi kashya leh mikkedi tenan asur birchitza noalin et hammerchatzaot lema li ella lav shema minah bechammin asur betzonen muttar
Lema mesayya leh kol chayyave tevilot tovlin kedarkan ben betisha beav ben beom hakkippurim bemay ilema bechammin tevila bechammin mi ika sheuvin ninhu
Ella lav betzonen vechayyave tevilot in inish acharina la amar rav chana bar kattina lo nitzrecha ella lechamme teverya

I hachi ema sefa amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim keday hu bet elohenu leabbed alav tevila paam achat bashshana vei amratte betzonen muttar yirchatz betzonen amar rav pappa beatra dela shechiach tzonen

Ta shema kesheamru asur bimlacha lo amru ella bayyom aval ballayela muttar uchsheamru asur binilat hassandal lo amru ella bair aval badderech muttar ha ketzad yotze ladderech noel nichnas lair choletz uchsheamru asur birchitza lo amru ella kol gufo aval panav yadav veraglav muttar vechen atta motze bamnudde uvaavel
May lav akkullehu uvmay askinan ilema bechammin panav yadav veraglav mi sheru vehaamar rav sheshet avel asur lehoshit etzbao bechammin ella lav betzonen
La leolam bechammin udka kashya lach vechen atta motze bamnudde uvaavel ashsheara kae

Ta shema deamar rabbi abba hakkohen mishshum rabbi yose hakkohen maase umetu banav shel rabbi yose ben rabbi chanina verachatz betzonen kol shiva hatam keshettechafuhu avalav hava detanya techafuhu avalav ze achar ze hichbid searo mekel betaar umchabbes kesuto bemayim
Amar rav chisda betaar aval lo bemisparayim bemayim velo beneter velo bechol
Amar rava avel muttar lirchotz betzonen kol shiva mide dehave abbisra vechamra metivi
b: En habbogeret rashshaa lenavel et atzmah bime evel aviha ha naara rashshaa
May lav birchitza uvmay ilema bechammin en habbogeret rashshaa vehaamar rav chisda avel asur lehoshit etzbao bechammin ella lav betzonen la akkichul ufirkus
Lema mesayya leh deamar rabbi abba hakkohen mishshum rabbi yose hakkohen maase umetu banav shel rabbi yose bar chanina verachatz betzonen kol shiva

Amri hatam beshettechafuhu avalav ze achar ze detanya techafuhu avalav ze achar ze hichbid searo mekel betaar umchabbes kesuto bemayim amar rav chisda betaar aval lo bemisparayim bemayim velo beneter velo bechol velo beahal
