Ika deamri amar rava avel asur betzonen kol shiva may shena mibbasar veyayin hatam lefakkoche pachdeh hu deaved

Lema mesayya leh en habbogeret rashshaa lenavel atzmah ha naara rashshaa bemay ilema bechammin en habbogeret rashshaa vehaamar rav chisda avel asur lehoshit etzbao bechammin ella lav betzonen la akkichul ufirkus

Amar rav chisda zot omeret avel asur betichboset kol shiva vehilcheta avel asur lirchotz kol gufo ben bechammin uven betzonen kol shiva aval panav yadav veraglav bechammin asur betzonen muttar aval lasuch afilu kal shehu asur veim leabber et hazzuhama muttar
Tzelota detaanita hechi madkerinan adbereh rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh udrash yachid shekkibel alav taanit mitpallel shel taanit vehechan omrah ben goel lerofe
Matkef lah rav yitzchak vechi yachid kovea beracha leatzmo ella amar rav yitzchak beshomea tefilla vechen amar rav sheshet beshomea tefilla
Metivi en ben yachid letzibbur ella shezze mitpallel shemone esre veze mitpallel tesha esre may yachid umay tzibbur ilema yachid mammash vetzibbur sheliach tzibbur hane tesha esre esrin vearba hau

Ella lav hachi kaamar en ben yachid dekibbel alav taanit yachid leyachid shekkibbel alav taanit tzibbur ella shezze mitpallel shemone esre veze mitpallel tesha esre shema minah yachid kovea beracha leatzmo
La leolam ema lach sheliach tzibbur udka kashya lach sheliach tzibbur esrin vearba metzalle beshalosh taaniyyot rishonot deleka esrim vearba
Vela veha en ben katane en ben shalosh rishonot leshalosh emtzaiyyot ella shebbeellu muttarin baasiyyat melacha uvellu asurin baasiyyat melacha ha leesrim vearba ze vaze shavin
Tena veshayyar may shayyar dehay shayyar vetu veha en ben katane ella tanna beisure ka mayere bitfillot la mayere vei baet ema beemtzaayata name la metzalle esrim vearba
Vela vehatanya en ben shalosh sheniyyot lesheva acharonot ella shebbeillu matriin venoalin et hachanuot ha lechol divrehen ze vaze shavin vechi tema hacha name tena veshayyar veha en ben katane
Vetisbera en ben daveka

a: Veha shayyar teva i mishshum teva lav shiyyura hu mile detzina katane mile divfarhesya la katane

Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane ma ellu yeterot al harishonot ella shebbeellu matriin venoalin et hachanuot aval bechol divrehen ze vaze shavin vechi tema hacha name tena veshayyar veha ma ellu katane

Vetisbera ma ellu daveka hu veha shayyar lah teva i mishshum teva lav shiyyura hu mishshum deka chashev lah beidach pirka hashta deatet lehachi esrim vearbaa name lav shiyyura hu dekatane lah beidach pirka

May have alah amar rabbi shemuel bar sisratay vechen amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav ben goel lerofe verav ashe amar mishshemeh derabbi yannay bereh derabbi yishmael beshomea tefila vehilcheta beshomea tefila
Tane chada ubbarot umenikot mitannot barishonot veen mitannot baacharonot vetanya idach mitannot baacharonot veen mitannot barishonot vetanya idach en mitannot lo barishonot velo baacharonot
Amar rav ashe nekot emtzaayata bidach demitartzan kullehu
Ma ellu yeterot al harishonot ella shebbeellu matriin venoalin et hachanuot bemay matriin rav yehuda amar beshofarot verav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav amar baanenu

Ka salka datan man deamar baanenu la amar beshofarot uman deamar beshofarot la amar baanenu vehatanya en pochatin mishsheva taaniyyot al hatztzibbur shebbahen shemone esre hatraot vesiman laddavar yericho viricho shofarot hava utuvta leman deamar baanenu
Ella beshofarot dechulle alma la peligi dekare lah hatraa ki peligi baanenu mar savar kare lah hatraa umar savar la kare lah hatraa
Leman deamar baanenu kol shekken beshofarot ulman deamar beshofarot aval baanenu la
Vehatanya ushar kol mine puranuot hammitraggeshot kegon chikuch chagav zevuv vetzira veyattushin veshiluach nechashim veakrabbim lo hau matriin ella tzoakin midditzaka bappe hatraa beshofarot
Tannae hi ditnan al ellu matriin beshabbat al ir shehikkifuha gayis o nahar veal sefina hamtorefet bayyam rabbi yose omer leezra aval lo litzaka
Bemay ilema beshofarot shofarot beshabbat mi shere ella lav baanenu vekare lah hatraa shema minah
Bishne derabbi yehuda nesia hava tzaara
b: Gezar telat asre taaniyyot vela iani sevar lemigzar tefe amar leh rabbi amme hare amru en matrichin et hatztzibbur yoter midday

Amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba rabbi amme daavad legarmeh hu daavad ella hachi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella ligshamim aval lishar mine furanuot mitannin veholchin ad sheyyeanu min hashshamayim tanya name hachi kesheamru shalosh uchsheamru sheva lo amru ella ligshamim aval lishar mine furanuot mitannin veholchin ad sheyyeanu

Lema tehve teuvteh derabbi amme amar lach rabbi amme tannae hi detanya en gozrin yoter mishshelosh esre taaniyyot al hatztzibbur lefi sheen matrichin et hatztzibbur yoter midday divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo min hashshem hu ze ella mippene sheyyatza zemannah shel revia

Shelachu leh bene ninve lerabbi kegon anan daafilu bitkufat tammuz baenan mitra hechi naaved kichidim damenan o kerabbim damenan kichidim damenan uvshomea tefilla o kerabbim damenan uvvirkat hashshanim shelach lehu kichidim dametu uvshomea tefilla

Metivi amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shehashshanim ketiknan veyisrael sheruyin al admatan aval bizman hazze hakkol lefi hashshanim hakkol lefi hammekomot hakkol lefi hazzeman amar leh matnita ramet aleh derabbi rabbi tanna hu ufaleg
May have alah rav nachman amar bevirkat hashshanim rav sheshet amar beshomea tefilla vehilcheta beshomea tefilla

Bashsheni mattin im chashecha uvachamishi kol hayyom mippene kevod hashshabbat ibaya lehu hechi katane bashsheni mattin im chashecha uvachamishi kol hayyom mippene kevod hashshabbat o dilma bashsheni mattin uvachamishi potchin kol hayyom kullo

Ta shema detanya bashsheni mattin ad haerev uvachamishi potchin kol hayyom kullo mippene kevod hashshabbat hau lo shene fetachim poteach echad venoel echad haya lo itzteva keneged pitcho poteach kedarko veeno choshesh

Avru ellu velo naanu memaatin bemassa umattan bevinyan uvintia tana bevinyan binyan shel simcha netia netia shel simcha e zehu binyan shel simcha ze habbone bet chatnut livno i zo hi netia shel simcha ze hannotea abbeoranke shel melachim

Uvishelat shalom tanu rabbanan chaverim en sheelat shalom benehen amme haaretz sheshshoalin machzirin lahem besafa rafa uvchoved rosh vehen mitattefin veoshvin kaavelim vechimnuddin kivne adam hannezufin lammakom ad sheyerachamu alehem min hashshamayim
Amar rabbi elazar en adam chashuv rashshay lipol al panav ella im ken naane kihoshua bin nun shenneemar vayyomer Adonai el yehoshua kum lach lamma ze atta nofel al panecha

Veamar rabbi elazar en adam chashuv rashshay lachagor sak ella im ken naane kihoram ben achav shenneemar vayehi chishmoa hammelech et divre haishsha vayyikra et begadav vehu over al hachoma vayyar haam vehinne hassak al besaro vego

Veamar rabbi elazar lo hakkol bikria velo hakkol binfila moshe veaharon binfila yehoshua vechalev bikria moshe veaharon binfila dichtiv vayyippol moshe veaharon al penehem yehoshua vechalev bikria dichtiv vihoshua bin nun vechalev ben yefunne karu bigdehem
Matkef lah rabbi zera veitema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani i hava ketiv yehoshua kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv vihoshua ha veha aved
Veamar rabbi elazar lo hakkol bekima velo hakkol behishtachavaya melachim bekima vesarim behishtachavaya melachim bekima dichtiv ko amar Adonai goel yisrael kedosho

a: Livzo nefesh limtaev goy leeved moshlim melachim yiru vakamu vesarim behishtachavaya dichtiv sarim veyishtachau matkef lah rabbi zera veitema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani i hava ketiv vesarim yishtachau kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv sarim veyishtachau ha veha avud

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak af ani omer lo hakkol leora velo hakkol lesimcha tzaddikim leora visharim lesimcha tzaddikim leora dichtiv or zarua latztzaddik velisharim simcha dichtiv ulyishre lev simcha
Hadaran alach meematay
Seder taaniyyot ketzad motziin et hatteva lirchovah shel ir venotnin efer mikle al gabbe hatteva uvrosh hannasi uvrosh av bet din vechol echad veechad noten berosho

Hazzaken shebbahen omer lifnehen divre chibbushin achenu lo neemar beanshe ninve vayyar elohim et sakkam veet taanitam ella vayyar haelohim et maasehem ki shavu middarkam haraa uvakkabbala hu omer vekiru levavchem veal bigdechem
Amdu bitfilla moridin lifne hatteva zaken veragil veyesh lo banim uveto rekam kede sheyehe libbo shalem bitfilla

Veomer lifnehen esrim vearba berachot shemone esre shebbechal yom umosif alehen od shesh veellu hen zichronot veshofarot el Adonai batztzarata li karati vayyaaneni essa enay el heharim vego mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai tefilla leani chi yaatof
Rabbi yehuda omer lo haya tzarich lomar zichronot veshofarot ella omer tachtehen raav ki yihye vaaretz dever ki yihye asher haya devar Adonai el yirmeyahu al divre habbatztzarot

Veomer chotmehen al harishona hu omer mi sheana et avraham behar hammoriyya hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze baruch atta Adonai goel yisrael al hashsheniyya hu omer mi sheana et avotenu al yam suf hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze baruch atta Adonai zocher hannishkachot

Al hashshelishit hu omer mi sheana et yehoshua baggilgal hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze baruch atta Adonai shomea terua al harviit hu omer mi sheana et shemuel bammitzpa hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze baruch atta Adonai shomea tzeaka al hachamishit hu omer mi sheana et eliyyahu behar hakkarmel hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla

Al hashshishshit hu omer mi sheana et yona mimmee haddaga hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze baruch atta Adonai haone beet tzara al hashsheviit hu omer mi sheana et david veet shelomo beno birushalayim hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze baruch atta Adonai hamrachem al haaretz
Maase

a: Beittam belele reviiyyot uvlele shabbatot

Shekken matzinu bime shimon ben shatach sheyyardu lahem geshamim belele reviiyyot uvlele shabbatot ad shennaasu chittim kichlaot usorim kegarine zetim vaadashim kedinre zahav vetzarru mehem dugma laddorot lehodia kamma hachet gorem shenneemar aonotechem hittu elle vechattotechem manu hattov mikkem

Maase sheshshalchu lechoni hamaggel vechu tanu rabbanan paam achat yatza rov adar velo yardu geshamim shalchu lechoni hamaggel hitpallel veyerdu geshamim hitpallel velo yardu geshamim ag uga veamad betochah kederech sheasa chavakkuk hannavi shenneemar al mishmarti eemoda veetyatztzeva al matzor vego

Amar lefanav ribbono shel olam banecha samu penehem alay sheani keven bayit lefanecha nishba ani beshimcha haggadol sheeni zaz mikkan ad shetterachem al banecha hitchilu geshamim menattefin amru lo talmidav rabbi reinuch velo namut kimdummin anu sheen geshamim yordin ella lehattir shevuatcha

Amar lo kach shaalti ella gishme borot shichin umarot yardu bezaaf ad shekkol tippa vetippa kimlo pi chavit veshiaru chachamim sheen tippa pechuta millog amru lo talmidav rabbi reinuch velo namut kimdummin anu sheen geshamim yordin ella leabbed haolam

Amar lefanav lo kach shaalti ella gishme ratzon beracha undava yardu ketiknan ad shealu kol haam lehar habbayit mippene haggeshamim amru lo rabbi keshem shehitpallalta sheyyerdu kach hitpallel veyelchu lahem amar lahem kach mekubbelani sheen mitpallelin al rov hattova

Af al pi chen haviu li par hodaa heviu lo par hodaa samach shette yadav alav veamar lefanav ribbono shel olam ammecha yisrael shehotzeta mimmitzrayim enan yecholin lo berov tova velo berov puranut kaasta alehem enan yecholin laamod hishpata alehem tova enan yecholin laamod yehi ratzon millefanecha sheyyippasku haggeshamim vihe revach baolam miyyad nashva haruach venitpazzeru heavim vezarcha hachamma veyatzu haam lassade veheviu lahem kemehin ufitriyyot

Amar rabbi yochanan kol yamav shel oto tzaddik haya mitztaer al mikra ze shir hammaalot beshuv Adonai et shivat tziyyon hayinu kecholmim amar mi ika denayem shivin shenin bechelma

Yoma chad hava azel beorcha chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava nata charuva amar leh hay ad kamma shenin taen amar leh ad shivin shenin amar leh peshita lach dechayet shivin shenin amar leh ana charuva bealma ashkecheh ki hechi dishtalu li avahati shetali name livrai

Megila nikret beachad asar bishnem asar bishlosha asar bearbaa asar bachamishsha asar lo pachot velo yoter kerakkin hammukkafin choma mimot yehoshua bin nun korin bachamishsha asar kefarim vaayarot gedolot korin bearbaa asar ella shehakkefarim makdimin leom hakkenisa

Ketzad chal lihot arbaa asar bashsheni kefarim vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom umukkafot choma lemachar chal lihot bashshelishi o barvii kefarim makdimin leom hakkenisa vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom umukkafot choma lemachar
Chal lihot bachamishi kefarim vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom umukkafot choma lemachar chal lihot erev shabbat kefarim makdimin leom hakkenisa vaayarot gedolot umukkafot choma korin bo vayyom

Chal lihot bashshabbat kefarim vaayarot gedolot makdimin vekorin leom hakkenisa umukkafot choma lemachar chal lihot achar hashshabbat kefarim makdimin leom hakkenisa vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom umukkafot choma lemachar
Gema megila nikret beachad asar menalan menalan kidvaenan lememar lekamman chachamim hekelu al hakkefarim lihot makdimin leom hakkenisa kede sheyesappeku mayim umazon laachehem shebbakkerakkim

Anan hachi kaamrinan mikkedi kullehu anshe keneset haggedola takkeninhu dei salka datach anshe keneset haggedola arbaa asar vachamishsha asar takkun atu rabbanan veakri takkanta detakkinu anshe keneset haggedola vehatnan en bet din yachol levattel divre bet din chavero ella im ken gadol mimmennu bechachma uvminyan
Ella peshita kullehu anshe keneset haggedola takkinu hecha remiza
Amar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan amar kera lekayyem et yeme happurim haelle bizmannehem zemannim harbe tikkenu lahem
Hay mibaya leh legufeh im ken lema kera zeman may zemannehem zemannim tuva
Veakkatti mibe leh zemanno shel ze lo kizmanno shel ze im ken lema kera zemannam may zemannehem shamatte minah kullehu
Ema zemannim tuva zemannehem dumya dizmannam ma zemannam tere af zemannehem tere
Veema teresar utlesar kidamar rav shemuel bar yitzchak shelosha asar zeman kehila lakkol hi vela tzerich lerabboye hacha name shelosha asar zeman kehila lakkol hi vela tzerich lerabboye
Veema shitsar veshivsar velo yaavor ketiv
Verabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar amar kera kayyamim asher nachu vahem hayehudim yamim kayyamim lerabbot achad asar ushnem asar
Veema teresar utlesar amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak shelosha asar zeman kehila lakkol hi vela tzerich lerabboye veema shitsar veshivsar velo yaavor ketiv
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani may tama la amar mibbizmannehem zeman zemannam zemannehem la mashma leh
Verav shemen bar abba may tama la amar mikkayyamim amar lach hahu ledorot hu dichtiv
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi akiva setimtaa dedaresh zeman zemannam zemannehem aval chachamim omrim en korin otah ella bizmannah
Metivi amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shehashshanim ketiknan veyisrael sheruyin al admatan aval bizman hazze hoil umistakkelin bah en korin otah ella bizmannah
Rabbi yehuda alliba deman ilema alliba derabbi akiva afilu bizman hazze ita lehay takkanta
Ella lav alliba derabbanan uvizman shehashshanim ketiknan veyisrael sheruyin al admatan miha karenan teuvta derabbi yochanan teuvta
Ika deamri amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi akiva setimtaa aval chachamim amru bizman hazze hoil umistakkelin bah en korin otah ella bizmannah
Tanya name hachi amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shehashshanim ketiknan veyisrael sheruyin al admatan aval bizman hazze hoil umistakkelin bah en korin otah ella bizmannah
Rav ashe kashya leh derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda
b: Umokem lah levarayeta kerabbi yose bar yehuda

Umi amar rabbi yehuda bizman hazze hoil umistakkelin bah en korin otah ella bizmannah urminhi amar rabbi yehuda ematay makom shennichnasin bashsheni uvachamishi aval makom sheen nichnasin bashsheni uvachamishi en korin otah ella bizmannah
Mekom shennichnasin bashsheni uvachamishi miha karenan vaafilu bizman hazze umokem lah levarayeta kerabbi yose bar yehuda
Umishshum dekashya leh derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda mokem lah levarayeta kerabbi yose bar yehuda

Rav ashe shemia leh deika detane lah kerabbi yehuda veika detane lah kerabbi yose bar yehuda umiddekashya leh derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda amar man detane lah kerabbi yehuda lav daveka man detane lah kerabbi yose bar yehuda daveka

Kerakkim hammukkafim choma mimot yehoshua bin nun korin bachamishsha asar vechu menahane mile amar rava deamar kera al ken hayehudim happerazim hayyoshvim beare happerazot vego middifrazim bearbaa asar mukkafin bachamishsha asar
Veema perazim bearbaa asar mukkafin kelal kelal la velav yisrael ninhu veod mehoddu vead kush ketiv
Veema perazim bearbesar mukkafin bearbesar uvachamesar kedichtiv lihot osim et yom arbaa asar lechodesh adar veet yom chamishsha asar bo bechol shana
I hava ketiv et yom arbaa asar vachamishsha asar kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv et yom arbaa asar veet yom chamishsha asar ata et ufasek hane bearbaa asar vehane bachamishsha asar
Veema perazim bearbesar mukkafin i bau bearbesar i bau bachamesar amar kera bizmannehem zemanno shel ze lo zemanno shel ze
Veema bitlesar keshushan
Ashkechan asiyya zechira menalan amar kera vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim itakkash zechira laasiyya
Matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer kerakkin hammukkafin choma mimot achashverosh korin bachamishsha asar
May tama derabbi yehoshua ben korcha ki shushan ma shushan mukkefet choma mimot achashverosh vekorin bachamishsha asar af kol shemmukkefet choma mimot achashverosh korin bachamishsha asar

Vetanna didan may tama yalef perazi perazi ketiv hacha al ken hayehudim happerazim uchtiv hatam levad meare happerazi harbe meod ma lehallan mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun af kan mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun
Bishlama rabbi yehoshua ben korcha la amar ketanna didan delet leh perazi perazi ella tanna didan may tama la amar kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha
May tama deha it leh perazi perazi hachi kaamar ella shushan deavda keman la kifrazim vela kemukkafin
Amar rava veamri lah kedi shane shushan hoil venaasa bah nes
Bishlama letanna didan hayenu dichtiv medina umdina veir vair medina umdina lechallek ben mukkafin choma mimot yehoshua bin nun lemukkefet choma mimot achashverosh
Ir veir name lechallek ben shushan lishar ayarot ella lerabbi yehoshua ben korcha bishlama medina umdina lechallek ben shushan lishar ayarot ella ir veir lemay ata

Amar lecha rabbi yehoshua ben korcha ultanna didan mi nicha kevan deit leh perazi perazi medina umdina lema li ella kera lidrasha hu daata vechidrabbi yehoshua ben levi hu daata deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kerach vechol hassamuch lo vechol hannire immo nidon kichrach
Ad kamma amar rabbi yirmeya veitema rabbi chiyya bar abba kemechammatan litverya mil velema mil ha ka mashma lan deshiura demil kamma have kemechammatan litverya
Veamar rabbi yirmeya veitema rabbi chiyya bar abba mantzefach tzofim amarum
Vetisbera vehachtiv elle hammitzot sheen navi rashshay lechaddesh davar meatta veod haamar rav chisda mem vesamech shebballuchot

a: Benes hau omdin
In mihva hao vela hao yadi he beemtza teva vehe besof teva vaato tzofim vetakkinu petuchin beemtza teva ustumin besof teva
Sof sof elle hammitzot sheen navi atid lechaddesh davar meatta ella shechachum vechazru veyissedum

Veamar rabbi yirmeya veitema rabbi chiyya bar abba targum shel tora unkelos hagger amaro mippi rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua targum shel neviim yonatan ben uzziel amaro mippi chaggay zecharya umalachi venizdazea eretz yisrael arba meot parsa al arba meot parsa yatzta bat kol veamra mi hu ze sheggila setaray livne adam

Amad yonatan ben uzziel al raglav veamar ani hu sheggilliti setarecha livne adam galuy veyadua lefanecha shello lichvodi asiti velo lichvod bet abba ella lichvodcha asiti shello yirbu machalokot beyisrael
Veod bikesh legallot targum shel ketuvim yatzta bat kol veamra lo dayyeka may tama mishshum deit beh ketz mashiach

Vetargum shel tora unkelos hagger amaro veha amar rav ika bar avin amar rav chananel amar rav may dichtiv vayyikreu besefer torat haelohim meforash vesom sechel vayyavinu bammikra vayyikreu besefer torat haelohim ze mikra meforash ze targum
Vesom sechel ellu happesukin vayyavinu bammikra ellu piske teamim veamri lah ellu hammasorot shechachum vechazru veyissedum

May shena deorayeta dela izdazea veaddinvie izdazea deorayeta miparsha milleta dinvie ika mile demiparshan veika mile dimsatteman dichtiv bayyom hahu yigdal hammisped birushalam kemispad hadadrimon bevikat megidon

Veamar rav yosef ilmale targuma dehay kera la yadana may kaamar beoma hahu yisge mispeda birushlem kemispeda deachav bar amri diktal yateh hadadrimon ben tavrimon beramot gilad uchmispeda deyoshiyya bar amon diktal yateh paro chagira bevikat megido

Veraiti ani daniyyel levaddi et hammara vehaanashim asher hau immi lo rau et hammara aval charada gedola nafla alehem vayyivrechu behechave man ninhu anashim amar rabbi yirmeya veitema rabbi chiyya bar abba ze chaggay zecharya umalachi
Inhu adifi mineh veihu adif minayehu inhu adifi mineh deinhu nevie veihu lav navi ihu adif minayehu deihu chaza veinhu la chazo
Vechi meachar dela chazo may tama ibitu af al gav deinhu la chazo mazzalayehu chazo

Amar ravina shema minah hay man demibit af al gav deihu la chaze mazzaleh chaze may takkanteh likre keriat shema vei kaem bimkom hattinnofet linshof midduchteh arba garmide vei la lema hachi iza deve tabbache shammina minay
Vehashta deamratte medina umdina veir vair lidrasha mishpacha umishpacha lemay ata amar rabbi yose bar chanina lehavi mishpechot kehunna ulviyya shemmevattelin avodatan uvain lishmoa mikra megila
Deamar rav yehuda amar rav kohanim baavodatan ulviyyim beduchanan veyisrael bemaamadan kullan mevattelin avodatan uvain lishmoa mikra megila

Tanya name hachi kohanim baavodatan ulviyyim beduchanan veyisrael bemaamadan kullan mevattelin avodatan uvain lishmoa mikra megila mikkan samchu shel bet rabbi shemmevattelin talmud tora uvain lishmoa mikra megila kal vachomer meavoda uma avoda shehi chamura mevattelinan talmud tora lo kol shekken
Vaavoda chamura mittalmud tora vehachtiv vayehi bihot yehoshua biricho vayyissa enav vayyar vehinne ish omed lenegdo vego vayyishtachu leappav
Vehechi aved hachi vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi asur leadam sheyyitten shalom lachavero ballayela chayeshinan shemma shed hu shane hatam deamar leh ki ani sar tzeva Adonai
Vedilma meshakkeri gemiri dela mappeki shem shamayim levattala
Amar lo emesh bittaltem tamid shel ben haarbayim veachshav bittaltem talmud tora amar lo al eze mehen bata amar lo atta vati miyyad vayyalen yehoshua ballayela hahu betoch haemek amar rabbi yochanan
b: Melammed shellan beumkah shel halacha veamar rav shemuel bar unya gadol talmud tora yoter mehakravat temidin shenneemar atta vati
La kashya ha derabbim veha deyachid

Udyachid kal vehatnan nashim bammoed meannot aval lo metappechot rabbi yishmael omer im hau semuchot lammitta metappechot berashe chodashim bachanukka uvfurim meannot umtappechot baze uvaze aval lo mekonnot
Veamar rabba bar huna en moed bifne talmid chacham kol shekken chanukka ufurim
Kevod tora kaamratte kevod tora deyachid chamur talmud tora deyachid kal
Amar rava peshita li avoda umikra megila mikra megila adif midderabbi yose bar chanina talmud tora umikra megila mikra megila adif middesamchu shel bet rabbi
Talmud tora umet mitzva met mitzva adif middetanya mevattelin talmud tora lehotzaat met ulhachnasat kalla avoda umet mitzva met mitzva adif miulachoto
Detanya ulachoto ma talmud lomar hare shehaya holech lishchot et pischo velamul et beno veshama shemmet lo met yachol yittamma
Amarta lo yittamma yachol keshem sheeno mitamme laachoto kach eno mitamme lemet mitzva talmud lomar ulachoto laachoto hu deeno mitamme aval mitamme lemet mitzva

Bae rava mikra megila umet mitzva he minayehu adif mikra megila adif mishshum parsome nisa o dilma met mitzva adif mishshum kevod habberiyyot batar devaya hadar pashtah met mitzva adif deamar mar gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora
Gufa amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kerach vechol hassamuch lo vechol hannire immo niddon kichrach tana samuch af al pi sheeno nire nire af al pi sheeno samuch
Bishlama nire af al pi sheeno samuch mashkachatte lah kegon deyatva berosh hahar ella samuch af al pi sheeno nire hechi mashkachatte lah amar rabbi yirmeya sheyyoshevet bannachal
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kerach sheyyashav ulvassof hukkaf niddon kichfar may tama dichtiv veish ki yimkor bet moshav ir choma shehukkaf ulvassof yashav velo sheyyashav ulvassof hukkaf

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kerach sheen bo asara batlanin niddon kichfar may ka mashma lan tenena ezo hi ir gedola kol sheyyesh bah asara batlanin pachot mikkan hare ze kefar kerach itzterich leh af al gav demikali leh mealma

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kerach shecharav ulvassof yashav niddon kichrach may charav ilema charvu chomotav yashav in lo yashav la veha tanya rabbi eliezer bar yose omer asher lo choma af al pi sheen lo achshav vehaya lo kodem lachen
Ella may charav shecharav measara batlanin
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi

a: Lod veono vege hacharashim mukkafot choma mimot yehoshua bin nun hao
Vehane yehoshua benanhi veha elpaal benanhi dichtiv uvne elpaal ever umisham vashamer hu bana et ono veet lod uvnoteha ultamach asa benanhi dichtiv vayyiven asa et are habbetzurot asher lihuda
Amar rabbi elazar hane mukkafot choma mimot yehoshua bin nun hao charuv bime pilegesh begiva vaata elpaal benanhi hadur inful ata asa shappetzinhu
Dayeka name dichtiv vayyomer lihuda nivne et hearim haelle mikkelal dearim hao meikara shema minah
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi nashim chayyavot bemikra megila sheaf hen hau beoto hannes veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi purim shechal lihot beshabbat shoalin vedorshin beinyano shel yom
May irya purim afilu yom tov name detanya moshe tiken lahem leyisrael sheyehu shoalin vedorshin beinyano shel yom hilchot pesach bappesach hilchot atzeret baatzeret vehilchot chag bechag
Purim itztericha leh mahu detema nigzor mishshum derabba ka mashma lan
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi chayyav adam likrot et hammegila ballayela velishnotah bayyom shenneemar elohay ekra yomam velo taane velayela velo dumiyya li
Sevur mina lemikreyah belelya ulmitne matnitin didah bimama amar lehu rabbi yirmeya ledidi miparsha li mineh derabbi chiyya bar abba kegon deamri inashe eevor parashta da veetneyah
Itmar name amar rabbi chelbo amar ulla biraa chayyav adam likrot et hammegila ballayela velishnotah bayyom shenneemar lemaan yezammercha chavod velo yiddom Adonai elohay leolam odekka
Ella shehakkefarim makdimin leom hakkenisa amar rabbi chanina chachamim hekelu al hakkefarim lihot makdimin leom hakkenisa kede sheyesappeku mayim umazon laachehem shebbakkerakkin
b: Lememra detakkanta dichrakkin have vehatnan chal lihot bashsheni kefarim vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom veim ita lakdemu leom hakkenisa hau lehu asara vaasara la takkinu rabbanan
Ta shema chal lihot bachamishi kefarim vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom veim ita lakdemu leom hakkenisa deachad asar hu miyyom hakkenisa leom hakkenisa la dachenan

Ta shema amar rabbi yehuda ematay bimkom shennichnasim bashsheni uvachamishi aval mekom sheen nichnasim bashsheni uvachamishi en korin otah ella bizmannah vei salka datach takkanta dichrakkin hi mishshum deen nichnasim bashsheni uvachamishi mafsedi lehu lichrakkin
La tema kede sheyesappeku mayim umazon ella ema mippene shemmesappekim mayim umazon laachehem shebbakkerakkin
Ketzad chal lihot bashsheni bashshabbat kefarim vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom vechu may shena resha denaket sidura deyarcha umay shena sefa denaket sidura deome
Ayede demithafchi leh naket sidura deome
Chal lihot beerev shabbat vechu matnitin manni i rabbi i rabbi yose

May rabbi detanya chal lihot beerev shabbat kefarim vaayarot gedolot makdimin leom hakkenisa umukkafin choma korin bo vayyom rabbi omer omer ani lo yiddachu ayarot mimmekoman ella ellu vaellu korin bo vayyom
May tama detanna kamma dichtiv bechol shana veshana ma kol shana veshana ayarot kodmot lammukkafin af kan ayarot kodmot lammukkafin
Veema bechol shana veshana ma kol shana veshana en nidchin ayarot mimmekoman af kan lo yiddachu ayarot mimmekoman shane hacha dela efshar
Verabbi may tameh bechol shana veshana ma kol shana veshana en ayarot nidchin mimmekoman af kan lo yiddachu ayarot mimmekoman
Veema bechol shana veshana ma kol shana veshana ayarot kodmot lammukkafin af kan name ayarot kodmot lammukkafin shane hacha dela efshar

May rabbi yose detanya chal lihot beerev shabbat mukkafin uchfarim makdimin leom hakkenisa vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom rabbi yose omer en mukkafin kodmin laayarot ella ellu vaellu korin bo vayyom
May tama detanna kamma dichtiv bechol shana veshana ma kol shana veshana ayarot bearbaa asar uzmanno shel ze lo zemanno shel ze af kan ayarot bearbaa asar uzmanno shel ze lo zemanno shel ze
Veema bechol shana veshana ma kol shana veshana en mukkafin kodmin laayarot af kan en mukkafin kodmin laayarot shane hacha dela efshar
May tameh derabbi yose bechol shana veshana ma kol shana veshana en mukkafin kodmin laayarot af kan en mukkafin kodmin laayarot
Veema bechol shana veshana ma kol shana veshana zemanno shel ze lo zemanno shel ze af kan zemanno shel ze lo zemanno shel ze shane hacha dela efshar

Vesavar rabbi ayarot la dachinan leom hakkenisa vehatanya chal lihot beshabbat kefarim makdimin leom hakkenisa vaayarot gedolot korin baerev shabbat umukkafot choma lemachar rabbi omer omer ani hoil venidchu ayarot mimmekoman yiddachu leom hakkenisa
Hachi hashta hatam zemannam shabbat hi vehoil denidchu yiddachu vehacha zemannam erev shabbat

Keman azla ha deamar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna purim shechal lihot beshabbat hakkol nidchin leom hakkenisa hakkol nidchin salka datach veha ika mukkafin deavdi limchar ella kol hannidche yiddache leom hakkenisa keman kerabbi

Dechulle alma miha megila beshabbat la karinan may tama amar rabba hakkol chayyavin bikriat megila uvitkiat shofar veen hakkol bekiin bemikra megila gezera shemma yittelenna beyado veyelech etzel baki lilmod veyaavirenna arba ammot birshut harabbim
Vehayenu tama deshofar vehayenu tama delulav
Rav yosef amar mippene sheenehen shel aniyyim nesuot bemikra megila tanya name hachi af al pi sheamru kefarim makdimin leom hakkenisa govin bo vayyom umchallekin bo vayyom
Af al pi sheamru adderabba mishshum deamru hu ella hoil veamru shekkefarim makdimin leom hakkenisa govin bo vayyom umchallekin bo vayyom mippene sheenehem shel aniyyim nesuot bemikra megila aval

a: Simcha enah noheget ella bizmannah
Amar rav megila bizmannah korin otah afilu beyachid shello bizmannah baasara rav assi amar ben bizmannah ben shello bizmannah baasara hava ovada vechash leh rav leha derav assi

Umi amar rav hachi vehaamar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav purim shechal lihot beshabbat erev shabbat zemannam erev shabbat zemannam veha shabbat zemannam hu ella lav hachi kaamar shello bizmannam kizmannam ma zemannam afilu beyachid af shello bizmannam afilu beyachid
La leinyan mikra megila baasara ella may erev shabbat zemannam leappoke midderabbi deamar hoil venidchu ayarot mimmekoman yiddachu leom hakkenisa ha ka mashma lan deerev shabbat zemannam hu
Matni i zo hi ir gedola kol sheyyesh bah asara batlanin pachot mikkan hare ze kefar
Beellu amru makdimin velo meacharin aval zeman atze kohanim vetisha beav chagiga vehakhel meacharin velo makdimin

Af al pi sheamru makdimin velo meacharin muttarin behesped uvtaanit umattanot laevonim amar rabbi yehuda ematay mekom shennichnasin besheni uvachamishi aval mekom sheen nichnasin lo bashsheni velo bachamishi en korin otah ella bizmannah
Gema tana asara batlanin shebbevet hakkeneset
Beellu amru makdimin velo meacharin may tama amar rabbi abba amar shemuel amar kera velo yaavor
Veamar rabbi abba amar shemuel minnayin sheen monin yamim lashshanim shenneemar lechodshe hashshana chodashim atta mone lashshanim vei atta mone yamim lashshanim
Verabbanan dekesari mishshum rabbi abba amru minnayin sheen mechashshevin shaot lechodashim shenneemar ad chodesh yamim yamim atta mechashshev lechodashim vei atta mechashshev shaot lechodashim
Aval zeman atze chohanim vetisha beav vachagiga vehakhel meacharin velo makdimin tisha beav akdome puranut la makdemi chagiga vehakhel mishshum deakkatti la meta zeman chiyyuvayehu
Tana chagiga vechol zeman chagiga meacharin bishlama chagiga dei mikla beshabbeta meacharinan lah levatar shabbeta ella zeman chagiga may hi
Amar rav oshaya hachi kaamar chagiga beshabbat veolat reiyya afilu beom tov dizman chagiga meacharin
Manni bet shammay hi ditnan bet shammay omrim meviin shelamim beom tov veen somchin alehen
Aval lo olot uvet hillel omrim meviin shelamim veolot vesomchin alehen

Rava amar chagiga kol zeman chagiga meacharin tefe la ditnan mi shello chag beom tov harishon shel chag chogeg veholech et kal haregel kullo veom tov haacharon shel chag avar haregel velo chag eno chayyav beachrauto
Rav ashe amar chagiga vechol zeman chagiga meacharin vaafilu atzeret dechad yoma meacharin ditnan modim sheim chal atzeret lihot beshabbat sheyyom tevoach achar hashshabbat
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina rabbi nata netia befurim
b: Verachatz bikronah shel tzippori beshiva asar betammuz uvikkesh laakor tisha beav velo hodu lo

Amar lefanav rabbi abba bar zavda rabbi lo kach haya maase ella tisha beav shechal lihot beshabbat hava udchinuhu leachar hashshabbat veamar rabbi hoil venidcha yiddache velo hodu chachamim kare aleh tovim hashshenayim min haechad

Verabbi hechi nata netia befurim vehatane rav yosef simcha umishte veom tov simcha melammed sheasurim behesped mishte melammed sheasur betaanit veom tov melammed sheasur baasiyyat melacha ella rabbi bar arbesar hava vechi neta bachamesar neta
Ini veha rabbi bitverya hava utverya mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun havay ella rabbi bar chamesar hava vechi neta bearbesar hava

Umi peshita leh ditverya mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun veha chizkiyya kare bitverya bearbesar uvachamesar mesappeka leh i mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun hi i la lechizkiyya mesappeka leh lerabbi peshita leh
Vechi peshita leh mi shere vehachtiv bimgilat taanit et yom arbaa asar veet yom chamishsha asar yome purayya inun dela lemispad behon
Veamar rava lo nitzrecha ella leesor et shel ze baze veet shel ze baze hane mile behesped uvtaanit aval melacha yom echad vetu la
Ini veha rav chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava ka shade kitana befurayya velatyeh vela tzemach kitaneh hatam bar yoma hava
Rabba bereh derava amar afilu tema beomeh hesped vetaanit kabbilu alayehu melacha la kabbilu alayehu
Demeikara ketiv simcha umishte veom tov ulvassof ketiv laasot otam yeme mishte vesimcha veilu yom tov la ketiv
Veella rav may tama latyeh lehahu gavra devarim hammuttarin vaacherim nahagu bahen isur hava uvatreh derabbi la nehug
Veibaet ema leolam nehug verabbi netia shel simcha nata keditnan avru ellu velo naanu memaatin bemassa umattan bevinyan uvintia beerusin uvnisuin
Vetana alah binyan binyan shel simcha netia netia shel simcha ezehu binyan shel simcha ze habbone bet chatnut livno ezo hi netia shel simcha ze hannotea avvaranke shel melachim

Gufa chizkiyya kare bitverya bearbesar uvachamesar mesappeka leh i mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun hi i la umi mesappeka leh milleta ditverya vehachtiv veare mivtzar hatztziddim tzer vechammat rakkat vechinnaret vekayema lan rakkat zo teverya hayenu tama dimsappeka leh mishshum dechad gisa shura deyamma havat
I hachi ammay mesappeka leh vadday lav choma hi detanya asher lo choma velo shur igar saviv perat litverya sheyyammah chomatah

Leinyan batte are choma la mesappeka leh ki ka mesappeka leh leinyan mikra megila may perazim umay mukkafin dichtivi gabbe mikra megila mishshum dehane migallu vehane la migallu veha name migalleya o dilma mishshum dehane mignu vehane la mignu veha name miganya mishshum hachi mesappeka leh
Rav assi kare megila behutzal bearbesar uvachamesar mesappeka leh i mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun hi i la ika deamar amar rav assi hay hutzal devet binyamin mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua hi
Amar rabbi yochanan ki havena talya amena milleta dishelna lesavayya

a: Veishtechach keoti chammat zo teverya velamma nikra shemah chammat al shum chamme teverya rakkat zo tzipori velamma nikra shemah rakkat mishshum demidalya kerakta denahra kineret zo ginosar velamma nikra shemah kineret dimtiki pera kekala dechinare

Amar rava mi ika leman deamar rakkat lav teverya hi veha ki shachev inish hacha hatam safdi leh hachi gadol hu besheshach veshem lo berakkat vechi masseki arona lehatam safdi leh hachi ohave seridim yoshve rakkat tzeu vekabbelu haruge omek
Ki nach nafsheh derabbi zera petach aleh hahu safdana eretz shinar hara veyalda eretz tzevi gidla shaashueha oy na lah amra rakkat ki ibbeda keli chemdatah

Ella amar rabba chammat zo chamme gerar rakkat zo teverya kineret zo ginosar velamma nikra shemah rakkat sheafilu rekanin shebbah melein mitzot kerimmon rabbi yirmeya amar rakkat shemah velamma nikra shemah teverya sheyyoshevet betabburah shel eretz yisrael rava amar rakkat shemah velamma nikra shemah teverya shettova reiyyatah
Amar zeera kitron zo tzipori velamma nikra shemah tzipori sheyyoshevet berosh hahar ketzippor

Vekitron tzipori hi veha kitron bechelko shel zevulun havay dichtiv zevulun lo horish et yoshve kitron veet yoshve nahalol uzvulun mitraem al middotav hava shenneemar zevulun am cheref nafsho lamut ma taam mishshum denaftali al merome sade

Amar zevulun lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam leachay natatta lahem sadot uchramim veli natatta harim vegivot leachay natatta lahem aratzot veli natatta yammim unharot amar lo kullan tzerichin lach al yede chillazon shenneemar ammim har yikrau usfune temune chol

Tane rav yosef sefune ze chillazon temune zo tarit chol zo zechuchit levana amar lefanav ribbono shel olam mi modieni amar lo sham yizbechu zivche tzedek siman ze yehe lecha kol hannotel mimmecha belo damim eno moil bifrakmatya shello kelum

Vei salka datach kitron zo tzipori ammay mitraem al middotav veha haveya tzipori milta daadifa tuva vechi tema delet bah zavat chalav udvash vehaamar resh lakish ledidi chaze li zavat chalav udvash detzipori vehaveya shishsha asar mil al shishsha asar mil

Vechi tema dela nefisha dideh kedaachuh vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan ledidi chaze li zavat chalav udvash dechol ara deyisrael vehaveya kemibbe chubbe ad akra detulbakne esrin vetarten parse urka ufutya shita parse
Afilu hachi sadot uchramim adifa leh dayeka name dichtiv venaftali al merome sade shema minah

Amar rabbi avahu veekron teaker zo kesari bat edom shehi yoshevet ben hacholot vehi hayeta yated tekua leyisrael bime yeonim uchsheggavra malchut bet chashmonay venitztzechum hau korin otah achidat migdal shir

Amar rabbi yose bar chanina may dichtiv vahasiroti damav mippiv veshikkutzav mibben shinav venishar gam hu lelohenu vahasiroti damav mippiv ze bet bamayya shellahen veshikkutzav mibben shinav ze bet galya shellahen

Venishar gam hu lelohenu ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot shebbeedom vehaya kealluf bihuda veekron kivusi ellu teratraot vekirkesaot shebbeedom sheatidin sare yehuda lelammed bahen tora barabbim
Amar rabbi yitzchak leshem zo pamyas ekron teaker zo kesari bat edom shehi hayeta metroppolin shel melachim ika deamri dimrabbi bah malche veika deamri demokmi mina malche

Kesari virushalayim im yomar lecha adam charvu shettehen al taamen yashvu shettehen al taamen charva kesari veyashva yerushalayim charva yerushalayim veyashva kesari taamen shenneemar immala hachorava im melea zo chareva zo im melea zo chareva zo
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha ulom milom yeematz

Veamar rabbi yitzchak may dichtiv yuchan rasha bal lamad tzedek amar yitzchak lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam yuchan esav amar lo rasha hu amar lo bal lamad tzedek amar lo beeretz nechochot yeavel amar lo im ken bal yire geut Adonai

Veamar rabbi yitzchak may dichtiv al titten Adonai maavayye rasha zemamo al tafek yarumu sela amar yaakov lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam al titten leesav harasha taavat libbo zemamo al tafek zo
b: Germamya shel edom sheilmale hen yotzin macharivin kal haolam kullo

Veamar rabbi chama bar chanina telat mea ketire taga ika begermamya shel edom utlat mea veshitin vechamsha marzebbane ika beromi uvchol yoma nafki hane leappe hane umikketil chad minayehu umitardi leokome malka
Veamar rabbi yitzchak im yomar lecha adam yagati velo matzati al taamen lo yagati umatzati al taamen yagati umatzati taamen
Hane mile bedivre tora aval bemassa umattan siyyata hu min shemayya uldivre tora la amaran ella lechaddode aval leokome girsa siyyata min shemayya hi

Veamar rabbi yitzchak im raita rasha shehashshaa mesacheket lo al titgare bo shenneemar al titchar bammereim velo od ella shedderachav matzlichin shenneemar yachilu derachav bechol et velo od ella shezzoche baddin shenneemar marom mishpatecha minnegdo velo od ella sheroe besonav shenneemar kol tzorrav yafiach bahem

Ini vehaamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay muttar lehitgarot barshaim baolam hazze shenneemar ozve tora yehallu rasha veshomre tora yitgaru vam vetanya rabbi dostay bar matun amar muttar lehitgarot barshaim baolam hazze veim lechashcha adam lomar al titchar bammereim veal tekanne beose avela mi shellibbo nokfo omer ken
Ella al titchar bammereim lihot kammereim veal tekanne beose avela lihot keose avela veomer al yekanne libbecha bachattaim vego
La kashya ha bemile dideh ha bemile dishmayya

Veibaet ema ha veha bemile dideh vela kashya ha betzaddik gamur ha betzaddik sheeno gamur deamar rav huna may dichtiv lamma tabbit bogdim tacharish bevalla rasha tzaddik mimmennu tzaddik mimmennu bolea tzaddik gamur eno bolea
Vei baet ema shaa mesacheket lo shane

Amar ulla italya shel yavan ze kerach gadol shel romi vehaveya telat mea parsa al telat mea parsa veyesh bah shelosh meot shishshim vachamishsha sheokim keminyan yemot hachamma vekatan shebbechullam shel mochre ofot vehaveya shishsha asar mil al shishsha asar mil umelech soed bechol yom beechad mehen

Vehaddar bah af al pi sheeno nolad bah notel peras mibbet hammelech vehannolad bah af al pi sheeno dar bah notel peras mibbet hammelech ushloshet alafim be vane yesh bo vachamesh meot challonot maalin ashan chutz lachoma tziddo echad yam vetziddo echad harim ugvaot tziddo echad mechitza shel barzel vetziddo echad cholsit umtzula
Matni karu et hammegila baadar harishon venitabbera hashshana korin otah baadar sheni en ben adar harishon laadar hashsheni ella keriat hammegila umattanot laevonim
Gema ha leinyan seder parashiyyot ze vaze shavin

Manni matnitin la tanna kamma vela rabbi eliezer berabbi yose vela rabban shimon ben gamliel detanya karu et hammegila baadar harishon venitabbera hashshana korin otah baadar hashsheni shekkol mitzot shennohagot bashsheni nohagot barishon chutz mimmikra megila
Rabbi eliezer berabbi yose omer en korin otah baadar hashsheni shekkol mitzot shennohagot bashsheni nohagot barishon
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi yose af korin otah baadar hashsheni shekkol mitzot shennohagot bashsheni en nohagot barishon veshavin behesped uvtaanit sheasurin baze uvaze

Rabban shimon ben gamliel hayenu tanna kamma amar rav pappa seder parashiyyot ika benayehu detanna kamma savar lechattechila bashsheni vei avud barishon avud bar mimmikra megila deaf al gav dekaru barishon karu bashsheni
Verabbi eliezer berabbi yose savar afilu mikra megila lechattechila barishon verabban shimon ben gamliel savar afilu seder parashiyyot i karu barishon karu bashsheni
Manni i tanna kamma kashya mattanot i rabbi eliezer berabbi yose kashya name mikra megila i rabban shimon ben gamliel kashya seder parashiyyot
Leolam tanna kamma utna mikra megila vehu haddin mattanot laevonim deha beha talya

Veibaet ema leolam rabban shimon ben gamliel hi umatnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane en ben arbaa asar shebbaadar harishon learbaa asar shebbaadar hashsheni ella mikra megila umattanot ha leinyan hesped vetaanit ze vaze shavin veilu seder parashiyyot la mayere
Amar rabbi chiyya bar avin amar rabbi yochanan hilcheta kerabban shimon ben gamliel sheamar mishshum rabbi yose
Amar rabbi yochanan ushnehem mikra echad darshu bechol shana veshana rabbi eliezer berabbi yose savar bechol shana veshana ma kol shana veshana adar hassamuch lishvat af kan adar hassamuch lishvat
Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar bechol shana veshana ma kal shana veshana adar hassamuch lenisan af kan adar hassamuch lenisan
Bishlama rabbi eliezer berabbi yose mistabber tama deen maavirin al hammitzot ella rabban shimon ben gamliel may tama
Amar rabbi tavi tama derabbi shimon ben gamliel mismach geulla ligulla adif
Rabbi elazar amar tama derabban shimon ben gamliel mehacha dichtiv lekayyem et iggeret happurim hazzot hashshenit
Veitzterich lemichtav

a: Hashshenit veitzterich lemichtav bechol shana veshana dei mibbechol shana veshana hava amena ki kushyan ka mashma lan hashshenit vei ashmoinan hashshenit hava amena battechila barishon uvashsheni ka mashma lan bechol shana veshana
Verabbi eliezer berabbi yose hay hashshenit may aved leh mibe leh lechidrav shemuel bar yehuda deamar rav shemuel bar yehuda battechila kevauha beshushan ulvassof bechol haolam kullo
Amar rav shemuel bar yehuda shalcha lahem ester lachachamim kivuni ledorot shalchu lah kina atte meoreret alenu leven haummot shalcha lahem kevar ketuva ani al divre hayyamim lemalche maday ufaras

Rav verav chanina verabbi yochanan verav chaviva matnu bechulleh seder moed kal ki hay zuga challofe rabbi yochanan umayyel rabbi yonatan shalcha lahem ester lachachamim kitvuni ledorot shalchu lah halo chatavti lecha shalishim shilleshim velo ribbeim
Ad shemmatzu lo mikra katuv battora ketov zot zikkaron bassefer ketov zot ma shekkatuv kan uvmishne tora zikkaron ma shekkatuv banneviim bassefer ma shekkatuv bammegilla

Ketannae ketov zot ma shekkatuv kan zikkaron ma shekkatuv bemishne tora bassefer ma shekkatuv banneviim divre rabbi yehoshua rabbi elazar hammodai omer ketov zot ma shekkatuv kan uvmishne tora zikkaron ma shekkatuv banneviim besefer ma shekkatuv bimgila
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel ester enah metammea et hayyadayim
Lememra desavar shemuel ester lav beruach hakkodesh neemra vehaamar shemuel ester beruach hakkodesh neemra neemra likrot velo neemra lichtov

Metivi rabbi meir omer kohelet eno metamme et hayyadayim umachloket beshir hashshirim rabbi yose omer shir hashshirim metamme et hayyadayim umachloket bekohelet rabbi shimon omer kohelet mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel aval rut veshir hashshirim veester metammein et hayyadayim hu deamar kerabbi yehoshua

Tanya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer kohelet eno metamme et hayyadayim mippene shechochmato shel shelomo hi amru lo vechi zo bilvad amar vahalo kevar neemar vayedabber sheloshet alafim mashal veomer al tospe al devarav
May veomer vechi tema memar tuva amar dei bae iktiv udi bae la iktiv ta shema al tospe al devarav
Tanya rabbi eliezer omer ester beruach hakkodesh neemra shenneemar vayyomer haman belibbo rabbi akiva omer ester beruach hakkodesh neemra shenneemar vattehi ester noset chen beene kol roeha
Rabbi meir omer ester beruach hakkodesh neemra shenneemar vayyivada haddavar lemordochay rabbi yose ben dormaskit omer ester beruach hakkodesh neemra shenneemar uvabbizza lo shalchu et yadam
Amar shemuel i havay hatam hava amena milleta daadifa mikkullehu shenneemar kiyemu vekibbelu kiyemu lemala ma shekkiblu lematta
Amar rava lechullehu it lehu pircha levar middishmuel delet leh pircha derabbi eliezer sevara hu dela hava inish dachashiv lemalka keoteh vehay ki ka mappesh tuva veamar addateh denafsheh kaamar
Derabbi akiva dilma kerabbi elazar deamar melammed shekkol echad veechad nidmeta lo keummato
Veha derabbi meir dilma kerabbi chiyya bar abba deamar bigtan vateresh shene tarsiyyim hau
Veha derabbi yose ben dormaskit dilma peristake shaddur dishmuel vadday let leh pircha amar ravina hayenu deamri inashe tava chada pilpalta charifta mimmele tzanne kare
Rav yosef amar mehacha vime happurim haelle lo yaavru mittoch hayehudim rav nachman bar yitzchak omer mehacha vezichram lo yasuf mizzaram
Umattanot laevonim tane rav yosef umishloach manot ish lereehu shette manot leish echad umattanot laevonim shette mattanot lishne bene adam
Rabbi yehuda nesia shaddar leh lerabbi oshaya atma deigla tilta vegarba dechamra shelach leh
b: Kiyyamta banu rabbenu umishloach manot ish lereehu umattanot laevonim
Rabba shaddar leh lemare bar mar beyad abbaye mele taska dekashba umle kasa kimcha daavishuna amar leh abbaye hashta amar mari i chaklaa malka leheve dikula mitztzavvereh la nachet
Hadar shaddar leh ihu mele taska dezangevila umle kasa defilpelata arichata amar abbaye hashta amar mar ana shaddari leh chulya veihu shaddar li churpa

Amar abbaye ki nefaki mibbe mar hava savana ki metay lehatam karivu li shitin tzae deshitin mine kedera vaachali behu shitin peluge uvishula batrayeta hao karu leh tzeli kedar uvay lemikas tzaa abbatreh
Amar abbaye hayenu deamri inashe kafen anya vela yada i name ravecha livsima shechiach
Abbaye bar avin verabbi chanina bar avin mechallefi seodtayehu lahadade
Amar rava michayyav inish levassome befurayya ad dela yada ben arur haman levaruch mardochay

Rabba verabbi zera avadu seudat purim bahade hadade ibassum kam rabba shachteh lerabbi zera lemachar bae rachame veachayeh leshana amar leh nete mar venaaved seudat purim bahade hadade amar leh la bechol shata veshata mitrechish nisa

Amar rava seudat purim sheachalah ballayela lo yatza yede chovato may tama yeme mishte vesimcha ketiv rav ashe hava yatev kammeh derav kahana negah vela ato rabbanan amar leh may tama la ato rabbanan dilma teridi bisudat purim amar leh vela hava efshar lemechlah beurta amar leh la shemia leh lemar ha deamar rava seudat purim sheachalah ballayela lo yatza yede chovato amar leh amar rava hachi amar leh in tena mineh arbein zimnin vedame leh keman demannach bechiseh
Matni en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad
Gema ha leinyan machshire ochel nefesh ze vaze shavin
Matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda detanya en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh rabbi yehuda mattir af machshire ochel nefesh
May tama detanna kamma amar kera hu velo machshirav verabbi yehuda amar lachem lachem lechol tzorchechem
Veidach name hachtiv lachem lachem velo legoyim lachem velo lichlavim
Veidach name ha ketiv hu ketiv hu uchtiv lachem kan bemachshirin sheefshar laasotan meerev yom tov kan bemachshirin shei efshar laasotan meerev yom tov
Matni en ben shabbat leom hakkippurim ella shezze zedono bide adam veze zedono becharet
Gema ha leinyan tashlumin ze vaze shavin

Manni matnitin rabbi nechunya ben hakkana hi detanya rabbi nechunya ben hakkana haya ose et yom hakkippurim kashshabbat letashlumin ma shabbat mitchayyev benafsho ufatur min hattashlumin af yom hakkippurim mitchayyev benafsho ufatur min hattashlumin

Tenan hatam kol chayyave charetot shellaku nifteru mide keritatan shenneemar venikla achicha leenecha kevan shellaka hare hu keachicha divre rabbi chananya ben gamliel amar rabbi yochanan chalukin alav chaverav al rabbi chananya ben gamliel
Amar rava amri be rav tenena en ben yom hakkippurim lashshabbat ella shezze zedono bide adam veze zedono behikaret veim ita ide veide bide adam hi

Amar rav nachman ha manni rabbi yitzchak hi deamar malkot bechayyave charetot leka detanya rabbi yitzchak omer chayyave charetot bakkelal hau velamma yatzat karet baachoto ledunah becharet velo bemalkot
Rav ashe amar afilu tema rabbanan ze ikar zedono bide adam veze ikar zedono behikaret

a: Matni en ben hammuddar hanaa mechavero lammuddar mimmennu maachal ella derisat haregel vechelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh
Gema ha leinyan kelim sheosin bahen ochel nefesh ze vaze shavin
Derisat haregel ha la kafdi inashe amar rava ha manni rabbi eliezer deamar vitur asur bemuddar hanaa
Matni en ben nedarim lindavot ella shehannedarim chayyav beachrautan undavot eno chayyav beachrautan
Gema ha leinyan bal teacher ze vaze shavin

Tenan hatam e zehu neder haomer hare alay ola ezo hi nedava haomer hare zo ola uma ben nedarim lindavot nedarim metu o nignevu o avdu chayyav beachrautan nedavot metu o nignevu o avdu eno chayyav beachrautan
Menahane mile detanu rabbanan venirtza lo lechapper alav rabbi shimon omer et shealav chayyav beachrauto veet sheeno alav eno chayyav beachrauto
May mashma amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi kevan deamar alay keman ditin akkatpeh dame
Matni en ben zav haroe shette reiyyot laroe shalosh ella korban
Gema ha leinyan mishkav umoshav usfirat shiva ze vaze shavin
Menahane mile detanu rabbanan rabbi simay omer mana hakkatuv shettayim ukrao tame shalosh ukrao tame ha ketzad shettayim lattuma veshalosh lakkorban
Veemar shettayim letuma velo lekorban shalosh lekorban velo letuma amratte ad shello raa shalosh raa shettayim

Veemar shettayim lekorban velo letuma shalosh af letuma la salka datach detanya vechipper alav hakkohen lifne Adonai mizzovo miktzat zavin meviin korban umiktzat zavin en meviin korban ha ketzad raa shalosh mevi shettayim eno mevi
O eno ella raa shettayim mevi raa shalosh eno mevi amratte ad shello raa shalosh raa shettayim
Veitzterich derabbi simay veitzterich mizzovo dei midderabbi simay hava amena ki kushyan kamashma lan mizzovo vei mizzovo la yadana kamma reiyyot kamashma lan derabbi simay
Vehashta deamratte mizzovo lidrasha vechi yithar hazzav mizzovo may darshatte beh
Hahu mibe leh lechidtanya vechi yithar hazzav lichsheyyifsok mizzovo mizzovo velo mizzovo venigo mizzovo vesafar limed al zav baal shette reiyyot shettaun sefirat shiva
Vahalo din hu im metamme mishkav umoshav lo yehe taun sefirat shiva
b: Shomeret yom keneged yom tochiach shemmetammea mishkav umoshav veenah teuna sefirat shiva
Veaf atta al titmah al ze sheaf al pi shemmetamme mishkav umoshav lo yehe taun sefirat shiva talmud lomar mizzovo vesafar miktzat zovo vesafar limed al zav baal shette reiyyot shettaun sefirat shiva
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye may shena hay mizzovo dimrabbe beh zav baal shette reiyyot umay shena hay mizzovo dimmaet beh zav baal shette reiyyot
Amar leh i salka datach hay lemaote hu daata lishtok kera mineh vechi tema atya middina shomeret yom keneged yom tochiach
Vechi tema hay mibe leh mizzovo velo minnigo im ken lichtov kera vechi yithar hazzav velishtok mizzovo lema li limed al zav baal shette reiyyot shettaun sefirat shiva
Matni en ben metzora musgar limtzora muchlat ella peria ufrima
En ben tahor mittoch hesger letahor mittoch hechlet ella tiglachat vetzipporim
Gema ha leinyan shiluach vetuma ze vaze shavin
Menahane mile detane rav shemuel bar yitzchak kammeh derav huna vetiharo hakkohen mispachat hi vechibbes begadav vetaher tahor mipperia ufrima demeikara
Amar leh rava ella meatta gabbe zav dichtiv vechibbes begadav vetaher hatam may vetaher meikara ika
Ella tahor hashta milletamme keli cheres beheset af al gav dahadar chaze la metamme lemafrea
Hacha name tahor hashta milletamme bevia lemafrea
Ella amar rava mehacha vehatztzarua asher bo hannega mi shetztzarato teluya begufo yatza ze sheen tzarato teluya begufo ella beyamim
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta kal yeme asher hannega bo yitma mi shetztzarato teluya begufo hu detaun shiluach vesheen tzarato teluya begufo en taun shiluach
Vechi tema hachi name veha katane en ben metzora musgar limtzora muchlat ella peria ufrima ha leinyan shiluach ultammoye bevia ze vaze shavin
Amar leh yeme kol yeme lerabbot metzora musgar leshiluach
I hachi tiglachat vetzipporim may tama la dekatane en ben tahor mittoch hesger lattahor mittoch hechlet ella tiglachat vetzipporim
Amar abbaye amar kera veyatza hakkohen el michutz lammachane vehinne nirpa nega hatztzaraat mi shetztzarato teluya birfuot yatza ze sheen tzarato teluya birfuot ella beyamim
Matni en ben sefarim litfillin umzuzot ella shehassefarim nichtavin bechol lashon utfillin umzuzot enan nichtavot ella ashshurit
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af bisfarim lo hittiru sheyyikkatvu ella yeonit
Gema ha letofran begidin ultamme et hayyadayim ze vaze shavin
Usfarim nichtavin bechol lashon vechu urminhu mikra shekketavo targum vetargum shekketavo mikra uchtav ivri eno metamme et hayyadayim ad sheyyichtevennu bichtav ashshurit al hassefer uvido
Amar rava la kashya

a: Kan beggofan shellanu kan beggofan shellahen

Amar leh abbaye bemay okemta lehahi beggofan shellahen may irya mikra shekketavo targum vetargum shekketavo mikra afilu mikra shekketavo mikra vetargum shekketavo targum name deha katane ad sheyyichtevennu ashshurit al hassefer bido
Ella la kashya ha rabbanan ha rabban shimon ben gamliel
I rabban shimon ben gamliel ha ika yevanit ella la kashya kan bisfarim kan bitfillin umzuzot
Tefillin umzuzot may tama mishshum dichtiv behu vehau bahavayatan yehu may targum shekketavo mikra ika bishlama tora ika yegar sahaduta ella hacha may targum ika
Ella la kashya kan bimgila kan bisfarim megila may tama dichtiv bah kichtavam vechilshonam may targum shekketavo mikra ika
Amar rav pappa venishma pitgam hammelech rav nachman bar yitzchak amar vechol hannashim yittenu yekar levalehen
Rav ashe amar ki tanya hahi bishar sefarim verabbi yehuda hi detanya tefillin umzuzot en nichtavin ella ashshurit verabbotenu hittiru yevanit
Vehachtiv vehau ella ema sefarim nichtavim bechol lashon verabbotenu hittiru yevanit hittiru mikkelal detanna kamma asar
Ella ema rabbotenu lo hittiru sheyyikkatvu ella yevanit vetanya amar rabbi yehuda af keshehittiru rabbotenu yevanit lo hittiru ella besefer tora

Umishshum maase detalmay hammelech detanya maase betalmay hammelech shekkines shivim ushnayim zekenim vehichnisan beshivim ushnayim battim velo gila lahem al ma kinsan venichnas etzel kol echad veechad veamar lahem kitvu li torat moshe rabbechem natan hakkadosh baruch hu belev kol echad veechad etza vehiskimu kullan ledaat achat
Vechatvu lo elohim bara bereshit eese adam betzelem uvidmut
Vayechal beom hashshishshi vayyishbot beom hashshevii zachar unkeva berao velo katvu beraam
Hava erda veavla sham sefatam vattitzchak sara bikroveha
Ki veappam hargu shor uvirtzonam ikkeru evus vayyikkach moshe et ishto veet banav vayyarkivem al nose bene adam
Umoshav bene yisrael asher yashvu bemitzrayim uvishar aratzot arba meot shana vayyishlach et zaatute bene yisrael veel zaatute bene yisrael lo shalach yado
b: Lo chemed echad mehem nasati asher chalak Adonai elohecha otam lehair lechol haammim
Vayyelech vayyaavod elohim acherim asher lo tziviti leovdam
Vechatvu lo et tzeirat haraglayim velo katvu lo et haarnevet mippene sheishto shel talmay arnevet shemah shello yomar sachaku bi hayehudim vehetilu shem ishti battora

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af bassefarim lo hittiru sheyyikkatvu ella yevanit amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel veamar rabbi yochanan may tama derabban shimon ben gamliel amar kera yafte elohim leyefet veyishkon beohole shem devarav shel yefet yihu beohole shem
Veema gomer umagog amar rabbi chiyya bar abba hayenu tama dichtiv yafte elohim leyefet yafuto shel yefet yehe beohole shem
Matni en ben kohen mashuach beshemen hammishcha limrubbe vegadim ella par habba al kol hammitzot
En ben kohen meshammesh lechohen sheavar ella par yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa
Gema ha leinyan par yom kippurim vaasirit haefa ze vaze shavin
Matnitin dela kerabbi meir dei rabbi meir ha tanya merubbe vegadim mevi par habba al kol hammitzot divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim eno mevi
May tameh derabbi meir detanya mashiach en li ella mashuach beshemen hammishcha merubbe vegadim minnayin talmud lomar hammashiach

Bemay okemna dela kerabbi meir ema sefa en ben kohen meshammesh lechohen sheavar ella par yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa ha lechol divrehen ze vaze shavin atan lerabbi meir detanya era bo pesul uminu kohen acher tachtav rishon chozer laavodato sheni kol mitzot kehunna gedola alav divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer rishon chozer laavodato sheni eno rauy lo lechohen gadol velo lechohen hedot

Veamar rabbi yose maase berabbi yosef ben illem mitztzipori sheera bo pesul bechohen gadol uminuhu tachtav uva maase lifne chachamim veamru rishon chozer laavodato sheni eno rauy lo lechohen gadol velo lechohen hedot
Kohen gadol mishshum eva kohen hedot mishshum maalin bakkodesh velo moridin resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir
Amar rav chisda in resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir rav yosef amar rabbi hi venasev lah alliba detannae
Matni en ben bama gedola labbama ketanna ella pesachim ze hakkelal kol shehu nidar venidav karev bevama vechol sheeno lo nidar velo nidav eno karev bevama
Gema pesachim vetu la ema keen pesachim
Manni rabbi shimon hi detanya rabbi shimon omer af tzibbur lo hikrivu ella pesachim vechovot shekkavua lahem zeman aval chovot sheen kavua lahem zeman hacha vehacha la keruv
Matni en ben shilo lirushalayim ella shebbeshilo ochlin kadashim kallim umaaser sheni bechol haroe uvirushalayim lifnim min hachoma
Vechan vechan kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim kedushshat shilo

a: Yesh achareha heter ukdushshat yerushalayim en achareha heter
Gema amar rabbi yitzchak shamati shemmakrivin bevet chono bizman hazze kasavar bet chono lav bet avoda zara hi veka savar kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah velo kidsha leatid lavo
Dichtiv ki lo batem ad atta el hammenucha veel hannachala menucha zo shilo nachala zo yerushalayim makkish nachala limnucha ma menucha yesh achareha heter af nachala yesh achareha heter
Amaru leh amarta amar lehu la amar rava haelohim amrah ugmirna lah mineh

Umay tama ka hadar beh mishshum kushya derav mari demotev rav mari kedushshat shilo yesh achareha heter kedushshat yerushalayim en achareha heter veod tenan mishshebbau lirushalayim neesru habbamot velo haya lahem od heter vehi hayeta nachala
Tannae hi detanya amar rabbi eliezer shamati keshehau bonin bahechal osin kelaim lahechal uklaim laazara ella shebbahechal bonin mibbachutz uvaazara bonin mibbifnim

Veamar rabbi yehoshua shamati shemmakrivin af al pi sheen bayit ochlin kodshe kadashim af al pi sheen kelaim kadashim kallim umaaser sheni af al pi sheen choma mippene shekkedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah vekidsha leatid lavo mikkelal derabbi eliezer savar lo kidsha leatid lavo

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe mimmay dilma dechulle alma kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah vekidsha leatid lavo umar may dishmia leh kaamar umar may dishmia leh kaamar vechi tema kelaim lerabbi eliezer lema li litzniuta bealma

Ella ki hane tannae detanya amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose lamma manu chachamim et ellu shekkeshealu bene haggola matzu et ellu vekidshum aval harishonot batlu mishshebbatla haaretz alma kasavar kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah velo kidsha leatid lavo

Urminhu amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose vechi ellu bilvad hau vahalo kevar neemar shishshim ir kol chevel argov uchtiv kal elle arim betzurot choma gevoha ella lamma manu chachamim et ellu shekkeshealu bene haggola matzu ellu vekidshum
Kidshum
b: Hashta ha amri la tzericha lekaddoshe ella matzu et ellu umnaum

Velo ellu bilvad ella kol shettaale lecha masoret beyadcha meavotecha shemmukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun kol hammitzot hallalu nohagin bah mippene shekkedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah vekidsha leatid lavo kashya derabbi yishmael adderabbi yishmael
Tere tannae alliba derabbi yishmael berabbi yose veibaet ema ha rabbi elazar bar yose amrah detanya rabbi elazar berabbi yose amar asher lo choma af al pi sheen lo achshav vehaya lo kodem lachen
Vayehi bime achashverosh amar rabbi levi veitema rabbi yonatan davar ze masoret beyadenu meanshe keneset haggedola kol makom shenneemar vayehi eno ella leshon tzaar
Vayehi bime achashverosh hava haman vayehi bime shefot hashshoftim hava raav vayehi ki hechel haadam larov vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam

Vayehi benosam mikkedem hava nivne lanu ir vayehi bime amrafel asu milchama vayehi bihot yehoshua biricho vecharbo shelufa beyado vayehi Adonai et yehoshua vayyimalu bene yisrael vayehi ish echad min haramatayim ki et channa ahev va sagar rachmah
Vayehi ki zaken shemuel velo halchu vanav bidrachav vayehi david lechol derachav maskil va immo vayehi shaul oyen et david vayehi ki yashav hammelech beveto rak atta lo tivne habbayit

Vehachtiv vayehi bayyom hashshemini vetanya oto hayyom hayeta simcha lifne hakkadosh baruch hu keom shennivreu bo shamayim vaaretz ketiv hacha vayehi beom hashshemini uchtiv hatam vayehi voker yom echad
Ha shechev nadav vaavihu
Vehachtiv vayehi vishmonim shana vearba meot shana vehachtiv vayehi kaasher raa yaakov et rachel vehachtiv vayehi erev vayehi voker yom echad vehaika sheni vehaika shelishi vehaika tuva
Amar rav ashe kol vayehi ika hachi veika hachi vayehi bime eno ella leshon tzaar
Chamsha vayehi bime hau vayehi bime achashverosh vayehi bime shefot hashshoftim vayehi bime amrafel vayehi bime achaz vayehi bime yehoyakim
Veamar rabbi levi davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu amotz vaamatzya ache hau may ka mashma lan

Ki ha deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol kalla shehi tzenua bevet chamiha zocha veotzin mimmenna melachim unviim menalan mittamar dichtiv vayyireha yehuda vayyachsheveha lezona ki chisseta paneha mishshum dechisseta paneha vayyachsheveha lezona

Ella mishshum dechisseta paneha bevet chamiha vela hava yada lah zachta veyatzu mimmenna melachim unviim melachim middavid neviim deamar rabbi levi masoret beyadenu meavotenu amotz vaamatzya achim hau uchtiv chazon yeshayahu ven amotz
Veamar rabbi levi davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu mekom aron eno min hammidda

Tanya name hachi aron sheasa moshe yesh lo eser ammot lechol ruach uchtiv velifne haddevir esrim amma orech uchtiv kenaf hakkeruv haechad eser ammot uchnaf hakkeruv haechad eser ammot aron gufeh hecha hava kae ella lav shema minah benes haya omed
Rabbi yonatan patach lah pitcha lehay parashta mehacha vekamti alehem vego vehichratti levavel shem ushar venin vaneched neum Adonai shem ze hakketav shear ze leshon nin ze malchut vaneched zo vashti
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani patach lah pitcha lehay parashta mehacha tachat hannaatzutz yaale verosh vetachat hassirpad yaale hadas
Tachat hannaatzutz tachat haman harasha sheasa atzmo avoda zara dichtiv uvchol hannaatzutzim uvchol hannahalolim
Yaale berosh ze mardochay shennikra rosh lechol habbesamim shenneemar veatta kach lecha besamim rosh mor deror umtargeminan mor deche
Tachat hassirpad tachat vashti harshaa bat beno shel nevuchadnetztzar harasha shessaraf refidat bet Adonai dichtiv refidato zahav
Yaale hadas zo ester hatztzaddeket shennikret hadassa shenneemar vayehi omen et hadassa vehaya la leshem zo mikra megila leot olam lo yikkaret ellu yeme furim
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi patach lah pitcha lehay parashta mehacha vehaya kaasher sas Adonai alechem lehetiv etchem ken yasis lehara etchem

Umi chade hakkadosh baruch hu bemappaltan shel reshaim veha ketiv betzet lifne hechalutz veomrim hodu la ki leolam chasdo veamar rabbi yochanan mippene ma lo neemar ki tov behodaa zo lefi sheen hakkadosh baruch hu sameach bemappaltan shel reshaim
Veamar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv velo karav ze el ze kol hallayela bikkeshu malache hashsharet lomar shira amar hakkadosh baruch hu maase yaday tovin bayyam veattem omrim shira
Amar rabbi elazar hu eno sas aval acherim mesis vedayeka name dichtiv ken yasis vela ketiv yasus shema minah

Rabbi abba bar kahana patach lah pitcha lehay parashta mehacha leadam shettov lefanav natan chochma vedaat vesimcha ze mardochay hatztzaddik velachote natan inyan leesof velichnos ze haman latet letov lifne haelohim ze mardechay veester dichtiv vattasem ester et mordochay al bet haman
Rabba bar ofran patach lah pitcha lehay parashta mehacha vesamti chisi beelam vehaavadti mishsham melech vesarim melech zo vashti vesarim ze haman vaaseret banav
Rav dimi bar yitzchak patach lah pitcha lehay parashta mehacha

a: Ki avadim anachnu uvavdutenu lo azavanu elohenu vayyat alenu chesed lifne malche faras ematay bizman haman
Rabbi chanina bar pappa patach lah pitcha leha parashta mehacha hirkavta enosh leroshenu banu vaesh uvammayim baesh bime nevuchadnetztzar harasha uvammayim bime faro vattotzienu larvaya bime haman

Rabbi yochanan patach leh pitcha leha parashta mehacha zachar chasdo veemunato levet yisrael rau chol afse aretz et yeshuat elohenu ematay rau chol afse aretz et yeshuat elohenu bime mordochay veester

Resh lakish patach lah pitcha leha parashta mehacha ari nohem vedov shokek moshel rasha al am dal ari nohem ze nevuchadnetztzar harasha dichtiv beh ala arye missubbecho dov shokek ze achashverosh dichtiv beh vaaru cheva ochori tinyana damya ledov vetane rav yosef ellu parsiyyim sheochlin veshotin kedov umsurbalin basar kedov umgaddelin sear kedov veen lahem menucha kedov
Moshel rasha ze haman al am dal ellu yisrael shehem dallim min hammitzot

Rabbi elazar patach leh pitcha leha parashta mehacha baatzaltayim yimmach hammekare uvshiflut yadayim yidlof habbayit bishvil atzlut shehaya lahem leyisrael shello asku battora naasa sono shel hakkadosh baruch hu mach veen mach ella ani shenneemar veim mach hu meerkecha veen mekare ella hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar hamkare vammayim aliyyotav
Rav nachman bar yitzchak patach lah pitcha leha parashta mehacha shir hammaalot lule Adonai shehaya lanu yomar na yisrael lule Adonai shehaya lanu bekum alenu adam adam velo melech

Rava patach lah pitcha leha parashta mehacha birvot tzaddikim yismach haam uvimshol rasha yeanach am birvot tzaddikim yismach haam ze mordochay veester dichtiv vehair shushan tzahala vesamecha uvimshol rasha yeanach am ze haman dichtiv vehair shushan navocha
Rav matna amar mehacha ki mi goy gadol asher lo elohim kerovim elav rav ashe amar mehacha o hanissa elohim vego
Vayehi bime achashverosh amar rav vay vehe hada dichtiv vehitmakkartem sham leoyevecha laavadim velishfachot vego

Ushmuel amar lo meastim velo gealtim lechallotam lo meastim bime yeonim velo gealtim bime nevuchadnetztzar lechallotam bime haman lehafer beriti ittam bime farsiyyim ki ani Adonai elohehem bime gog umagog

Bematnita tana lo meastim bime kasdim sheheemadti lahem daniyyel chananya mishael vaazarya velo gealtim bime yeonim sheheemadti lahem shimon hatztzaddik vechashmonay uvanav umattitya kohen gadol lechallotam bime haman sheheemadti lahem mordochay veester lehafer beriti ittam bime romiyyim sheheemadti lahem shel bet rabbi vechachme dorot ki ani Adonai elohehem leatid lavo sheen kol umma velashon yechola lishlot bahem
Rabbi levi amar mehacha veim lo torishu et yoshve haaretz
Rabbi chiyya amar mehacha vehaya kaasher dimmiti laasot lahem eese lachem

Achashverosh amar rav achiv shel rosh uven gilo shel rosh achiv shel rosh achiv shel nevuchadnetztzar harasha shennikra rosh shenneemar ante hu resha di dahava ben gilo shel rosh hu harag hu bikesh laharog hu hechriv hu bikesh lehachriv shenneemar uvmalchut achashverosh bitchillat malchuto katvu sitna al yoshve yehuda virushalam

Ushmuel amar shehushcharu penehem shel yisrael beyamav keshule kedera verabbi yochanan amar kol shezzochro omer ach lerosho verabbi chanina amar shehakkol naasu rashin beyamav shenneemar vayyasem hammelech achashverosh mas

Hu achashverosh hu berisho mittechilato vead sofo hu esav hu berisho mittechilato vead sofo hu datan vaaviram hen berishan mittechilatan vead sofan hu hammelech achaz hu berisho mittechilato vead sofo

Avram hu avraham hu betzidko mittechilato vead sofo hu aharon umoshe hen betzidkan mittechilatan vead sofan vedavid hu hakkatan hu bekatnuto mittechilato ad sofo keshem shebbekatnuto hiktin atzmo etzel mi sheggadol mimmennu battora kach bemalchuto hiktin atzmo etzel mi sheggadol mimmennu bechachma

Hammolech amar rav shemmalach meatzmo amri lah leshevach veamri lah lignay amri lah leshevach dela hava inish dachashiv lemalka keoteh veamri lah lignay dela hava chaze lemalchuta umamona yattira hu dihav vekam

Mehoddu vead kush rav ushmuel chad amar hoddu besof haolam vechush besof haolam vechad amar hoddu vechush gabbe hadade hao kayemi keshem shemmalach al hoddu vechush kach malach missof haolam vead sofo

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer ki hu rode bechol ever hannahar mittifsach vead azza rav ushmuel chad amar tifsach besof haolam veazza besof haolam vechad amar tifsach veazza bahade hadade hao kayemi keshem shemmalach al tifsach veal azza kach malach al kol haolam kullo

Sheva veesrim umea medina amar rav chisda battechila malach al sheva ulvassof malach al esrim ulvassof malach al mea ella meatta ushne chayye amram sheva ushloshim umat shana may darshatte beh shane hacha dikra yattira hu mikkede ketiv mehoddu vead kush sheva veesrim umea medina lema li shema minah lidrasha

Tanu rabbanan shelosha malchu bakkipa veellu hen achav vaachashverosh unvuchadnetztzar achav dichtiv chay Adonai elohecha im yesh goy umamlacha asher lo shalach adoni sham levakkeshcha vego vei la dahava malech alayehu hechi matze mashba lehu
Nevuchadnetztzar dichtiv vehaya haggoy vehammamlacha asher lo yitten et tzavaro beol melech bavel achashverosh ha daamaran
b: Siman vetu leka veha ika shelomo la selik malchuteh

Hanicha leman deamar melech vehedot ella leman deamar melech vehedot umelech may ika lememar shelomo milta achariti hava beh shemmalach al haelonim veal hattachtonim shenneemar vayyeshev shelomo al kisse Adonai
Veha hava sancheriv dichtiv mi bechol elohe haaratzot haelle asher hitztzilu et artzam miyyadi ha ika yerushalayim dela kavshah

Veha ika daryavesh dichtiv daryavesh malka ketav lechol ammayya umayya velishshanayya di dayerin bechol ara shelamchon yisge ha ika sheva dela melach alayehu dichtiv shefar kodam daryavesh vahakim al malchuta laachashdarpenayya mea veesrin
Veha ika koresh dichtiv ko amar koresh melech paras kol mamlechot haaretz natan li Adonai hatam ishtabboche hu deka mishtabbach benafsheh
Bayyamim hahem keshevet hammelech uchtiv batreh bishnat shalosh lemolcho amar rava may keshevet leachar shennityashva dato amar belshatztzar chashshev uta ana chashevna vela taena

May hi dichtiv ki lefi melot levavel shivim shana efkod etchem uchtiv lemallot lechorvot yerushalam shivim shana chashshev arbein vachamesh dinvuchadnetztzar veesrim utlat deevil merodach vetarte dideh ha shivim appek mane deve makdesha veishtammash behu
Unvuchadnetztzar menalan dearbein vachamesh shenin melach deamar mar galu besheva galu bishmone galu bishmone esre galu bitsha esre

Galu besheva lechibush yehoyakim galut yehoyachin shehi shemone linvuchadnetztzar galu bishmone esre lechibush yehoyakim galut tzidkiyyahu shehi tesha esre linvuchadnetztzar deamar mar shana rishona kibesh ninve sheniyya kibesh yehoyakim uchtiv vayehi vishloshim vasheva shana legalut yehoyachin melech yehuda bishnem asar chodesh beesrim vachamishsha lachodesh nasa evil merodach melech bavel bishnat malchuto et rosh yehoyachin melech yehuda vayyotze oto mibbet hakkele
Tamne utlatin ushva hare arbein vachamesh dinvuchadnetztzar veesrin utlat deevil merodach gemara vetarte dideh ha shivin amar hashta vadday tu la miparki appek mane deve makdesha veishtammash behu

Hayenu dekaamar leh daniel veal mare shemayya hitromamta ulmanayya di vayeteh hayetiv kodamach uchtiv beh belelya ketil belshatzar malka kasdaa uchtiv vedaryavesh madaa kabbel malchuta kevar shenin shittin vetarten

Amar ihu mita tae ana chashevna vela taena mi ketiv lemalchut bavel levavel ketiv may levavel legalut bavel kamma betziran tamne chashshev veayyel chilufayehu chada develshatztzar vachamesh dedaryavesh vechoresh vetarte dideh ha shivin kevan dechaze dimlo shivin vela ipruk amar hashta vadday tu la miparki appek mane deve makdesha veishtammash behu ba satan veriked benehen veharag et vashti

Sof sof kamma betziran chadesar ihu kamma melach arbesar bearbesar dideh ibi leh lemivne bet hammikdash allema ketiv bedayin betelat avidat bet elaha di birushlem amar rava shanim mekuttaot hao

Uman afresh nashim goot ezra dichtiv vayyaan shechanya ven yechiel mibbene elam vayyomer leezra anachnu maalnu velohenu vannoshev nashim nochriyyot
Tanu rabbanan arba nashim yefefiyyot hau baolam sara vaavigayil rachav veester ulman deamar ester yerakroket hayeta mappek ester umayyel vashti

Tanu rabbanan rachav bishmah zinta yael bekolah avigayil bizchiratah michal bat shaul biriyyatah amar rabbi yitzchak kol haomer rachav rachav miyyad nikre amar leh rav nachman ana amena rachav rachav vela ichpat li amar leh ki kaamena beodah uvmakkirah
Umordochay yada et kol asher naasa may amar rav amar gavah haman meachashverosh ushmuel amar gevar malka ilaa mimmalka tattaa
Vattitchalchal hammalka may vattitchalchal amar rav sheppersa nidda verabbi yirmeya amar shehutzrecha linkaveha
Vattikra ester lahatach amar rav hatach ze daniel velamma nikra shemo hatach shechatachuhu miggedullato ushmuel amar shekkol divre malchut nechtachin al piv
Ladaat ma ze veal ma ze amar rabbi yitzchak shalcha lo shemma avru yisrael al chamishsha chumshe tora dichtiv bahen mizze umizze hem ketuvim
Vayyaggidu lemordochay et divre ester veilu ihu la azal legabbeh mikkan sheen meshivin al hakkalkala

Vayyaavor mardochay amar rav sheheevir yom rishon shel pesach betaanit ushmuel amar daavar arkuma demayya

Veamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina el tehi killat hedot kalla beenecha shehare avimelech killel et sara hinne hu lach kesut enayim venitkayyem bezarah vayehi ki zaken yitzchak vattichhena enav

Veamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina tzaddik avad ledoro avad mashal leadam sheavda lo margalit kol makom shehi margalit shemah lo avda ella levalah

Amar leh gam elle bayyayin shagu uvashshechar tau paku peliliyya en paku ella gehinnam shenneemar velo tihye zot lecha lefuka veen peliliyya ella dayyanin shenneemar venatan biflilim

O shemma al shekkerativ kelev shenneemar hatztzila mecherev nafshi miyyad kelev yechidati chazra ukraattu arye shenneemar hoshieni mippi arye

Vayehi chirot hammelech et ester hammalka amar rabbi yochanan shelosha malache hashsharet nizdammenu lah beotah shaa echad shehigbiha et tzavarah veechad shemmashach chut shel chesed aleha veechad shemmatach et hashsharvit

Vechamma amar rabbi yirmeya shette ammot haya veheemido al shettem esre veamri lah al shesh esre veamri lah al esrim vearba bematnita tana al shishshim vechen atta motze beammatah shel bat paro vechen atta motze beshine reshaim dichtiv shine reshaim shibbarta veamar resh lakish al tikre shibbarta ella shirbavta rabba bar ofran amar mishshum rabbi elazar sheshshama merabbo verabbo merabbo matayim
Vayyomer lah hammelech leester hammalka ma bakkashatech ad chatzi hammalchut veteas chatzi hammalchut velo kol hammalchut velo davar shechotzetz lammalchut umay nihu binyan bet hammikdash
Yavo hammelech vehaman el hammishte tanu rabbanan ma raata ester shezzimna et haman rabbi elazar omer pachim tamna lo shenneemar yehi shulchanam lifnehem lefach
Rabbi yehoshua omer mibbet aviha lamda shenneemar im raev sonaacha haachilehu lechem vego rabbi meir omer kede shello yittol etza veyimrod

Rabbi yehuda omer kede shello yakkiru bah shehi yehudit rabbi nechemya omer kede shello yomru yisrael achot yesh lanu bevet hammelech veyassichu datan min harachamim rabbi yose omer kede sheyehe matzuy lah bechol et rabbi shimon ben menasya omer ulay yargish hammakom veyaase lanu nes

Rabba amar lifne shever gaon abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu bechummam ashit et mishtehem vego ashkecheh rabba bar avuh leeliyyahu amar leh keman chazya ester vaavada hachi amar leh kechullehu tannae uchchullehu amorae
Vayesapper lahem haman et kevod oshro verov banav vechamma rov banav amar rav sheloshim asara metu vaasara nitlu vaasara mechazzerin al happetachim
Verabbanan amri otan shemmechazzerin al happetachim shivim hau dichtiv seveim ballechem niskaru al tikre seveim ella shivim
