Taala may betziruteh meachooha ella i itmar hachi itmar vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar taala beidaneh seged leh

Vayyomer hammelech leester hammalka beshushan habbira hargu hayehudim amar rabbi avahu melammed shebba malach ustaro al piv

Divre shalom veemet amar rabbi tanchum veamri lah amar rabbi assi melammed shetztzericha sirtut kaamita shel tora

Ki mordochay hayehudi mishne lammelech achashverosh vegadol layehudim veratzuy lerov echav lerov echav velo lechol echav melammed sheppershu mimmennu miktzat sanhedrin

Amar rabba amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta gadol talmud tora yoter mikkibbud av vaem shekkol otan shanim shehaya yaakov avinu bevet ever lo neenash deamar mar

a: Lamma nimnu shenotav shel yishmael kede leyaches bahen shenotav shel yaakov dichtiv veelle shene chayye yishmael meat shana ushloshim shana vesheva shanim kamma kashshish yishmael miyyitzchak arbesar shenin dichtiv veavram ben shemonim shana veshesh shanim beledet hagar et yishmael leavram uchtiv veavraham ben meat shana behivaled lo et yitzchak beno uchtiv veyitzchak ben shishshim shana beledet otam bar kamma hava yishmael kidityelid yaakov bar shivim vearbea kamma payeshan mishsheneh shittin utlat

Vetanya haya yaakov avinu beshaa shennitbarech meaviv ben shishshim veshalosh shana uvo bapperek met yishmael dichtiv vayyar esav ki verach vego vayyelech esav el yishmael vayyikkach et machalat bat yishmael achot nevaot mimmashma shenneemar bat yishmael eni yodea shehi achot nevaot melammed shekkidshah yishmael vamet vehissiah nevaot achiha
Shittin utlat vearbesar ad demityelid yosef ha shivin veshiva uchtiv veosef ben sheloshim shana beomdo lifne paro ha mea ushva shav desiva vetarte dechafna ha mea veshitsar
Uchtiv vayyomer paro el yaakov kamma yeme shene chayyecha vayyomer yaakov el paro yeme shene meguray sheloshim umat shana mea veshitsar haveyan

Ella shema minah arba esre shenin dahava bevet ever la chashev lehu detanya haya yaakov bevet ever mutman arba esre shana ever met leachar sheyyarad yaakov avinu laaram naharayim shette shanim yatza mishsham uva lo laaram naharayim nimtza kesheamad al habbeer ben shivim vasheva shana
Umnalan dela ianash detanya nimtza yosef shepperash meaviv esrim ushtayim shana keshem shepperash yaakov avinu meaviv deyaakov telatin veshita haveyan ella arbesar dahava bevet ever la chashev lehu

Sof sof devet lavan esrin shenin haveyan ella mishshum deishtahi beorcha tarten shenin detanya yatza mearam naharayim uva lo lesukkot veasa sham shemona asar chodesh shenneemar veyaakov nasa sukkota vayyiven lo bayit ulmiknehu asa sukkot uvvet el asa shishsha chodashim vehikriv zevachim

Keraah serugin umitnamnem yatza haya kotvah dorshah umaggihah im kiven libbo yatza veim lav lo yatza
Hayeta ketuva besam uvsikra uvkomos uvkankantom al hanneyar veal haddiftera lo yatza ad shettehe ketuva ashshurit al hassefer uvido
Gema mena hane mile amar rava deamar kera kichtavam vechizmannam ma zemannam lemafrea la af ketavam lemafrea la

Mide keria ketiva hacha asiyya ketiva dichtiv lihot osim et shene hayyamim ella mehacha dichtiv vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim itakkash zechira laasiyya ma asiyya lemafrea la af zechira lemafrea la
Tana vechen behallel vechen bikriat shema uvitfilla
Hallel menalan rabba amar dichtiv mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo rav yosef amar ze hayyom asa Adonai
Rav aveya amar yehi shem Adonai mevorach verav nachman bar yitzchak veitema rav acha bar yaakov amar mehacha meatta vead olam
Keriat shema detanya keriat shema kichtavah divre rabbi vachachamim omrim bechol lashon may tama derabbi amar kera
b: Vehau bahavayatan yehu verabbanan may tama amar kera shema bechol lashon sheatta shomea
Verabbi name ha ketiv shema hahu mibe leh hashma leaznecha ma sheatta motzi mippicha verabbanan savri keman deamar hakkore et shema velo hishmia leozno yatza
Verabbanan name hachtiv vehau hahu mibe leh shello yikra lemafrea verabbi shello yikra lemafrea mena leh middevarim haddevarim verabbanan devarim haddevarim la mashma lehu
Lema kasavar rabbi kol hattora kullah bechol lashon neemra dei salka datach bilshon hakkodesh neemra lema li lemichtav vehau
Itzterich salka datach shema kerabbanan ketav rachamana vehau
Lema kasavri rabbanan kol hattora bilshon hakkodesh neemra dei salka datach bechol lashon neemra lema li lemichtav shema
Itzterich salka datach amena vehau kerabbi ketav rachamana shema

Tefilla mena lan detanya shimon happakoli hisdir shemone esre berachot lifne rabban gamliel al hasseder beyavne amar rabbi yochanan veamri lah bematnita tana mea veesrim zekenim uvahem kamma neviim tiknu shemone esre berachot al hasseder

Tanu rabbanan minnayin sheomrim avot shenneemar havu la bene elim uminnayin sheomrim gevurot shenneemar havu la kavod vaoz uminnayin sheomrim kedushshot shenneemar havu la kevod shemo hishtachau la behadrat kodesh

Uma rau lomar bina achar kedushsha shenneemar vehikdishu et kedosh yaakov veet elohe yisrael yaaritzu usmich leh veyadu toe ruach bina uma rau lomar teshuva achar bina dichtiv ulvavo yavin vashav verafa lo
I hachi lema refua batrah ditshuva la salka datach dichtiv veyashov el Adonai virachamehu veel elohenu ki yarbe lisloach

Umay chazet desamchatte aha semoch aha ketav kera acharina hassoleach lechol aonechi harofe lechol tachaluayechi haggoel mishshachat chayyayechi lememra digulla urfua batar selicha hi vehachtiv vashav verafa lo hahu lav refua detachluim hi ella refua dislicha hi

Uma rau lomar geulla bishviit amar rava mittoch sheatidin ligael bishviit lefichach kevauha bishviit vehaamar mar beshishshit kolot bishviit milchamot bemotzae sheviit ben david ba milchama name atchalta digulla hi
Uma rau lomar refua bishminit amar rabbi acha mittoch shennittena mila bishminit shetztzericha refua lefichach kevauha bishminit
Uma rau lomar birkat hashshanim bitshiit amar rabbi alekkesanderi keneged mafkie shearim dichtiv shevor zeroa rasha vedavid ki amrah bitshiit amrah

Uma rau lomar kibutz galiyyot leachar birkat hashshanim dichtiv veattem hare yisrael anpechem tittenu uferyechem tisu leammi yisrael ki kervu lavo vechevan shennitkabbetzu galiyyot naase din barshaim shenneemar veashiva yadi alayich veetzrof kabbor sigayich uchtiv veashiva shoftayich kevarishona
Vechevan shennaasa din min harshaim kalu happoshim vecholel zedim immahem shenneemar veshever poshim vechattaim yachdav yichlu

Vechevan shekkalu happoshim mitromemet keren tzaddikim dichtiv vechol karne reshaim agaddea teromamna karnot tzaddik vecholel gere hatztzedek im hatztzaddikim shenneemar mippene seva takum vehadarta pene zaken usmich leh vechi yagur ittechem ger
Vehechan mitromemet karnam birushalayim shenneemar shaalu shelom yerushalam yishlau ohavayich
Vechevan shennivnet yerushalayim ba david shenneemar

a: Achar yashuvu bene yisrael uvikshu et Adonai elohehem veet david malkam vechevan shebba david bata tefilla shenneemar vahaviotim el har kodshi vesimmachtim bevet tefillati
Vechevan shebbat tefilla bat avoda shenneemar olotehem vezivchehem leratzon al mizbechi vechevan shebbat avoda bata toda shenneemar zoveach toda yechabbedanni
Uma rau lomar birkat kohanim achar hodaa dichtiv vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayevarchem vayyered measot hachattat vehaola vehashshelamim
Ema kodem avoda la salka datach dichtiv vayyered measot hachattat vego mi ketiv laasot measot ketiv
Velemrah achar haavoda la salka datach dichtiv zoveach toda
May chazet desamchatte ahay semoch ahay mistabbera avoda vehodaa chada milta hi
Uma rau lomar sim shalom achar birkat kohanim dichtiv vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarchem beracha dehakkadosh baruch hu shalom shenneemar Adonai yevarech et ammo vashshalom
Vechi meachar demea veesrim zekenim umehem kamma neviim tikkenu tefilla al hasseder shimon happakoli may hisdir shechachum vechazar vesidderom

Mikkan veelach asur lesapper beshivcho shel hakkadosh baruch hu deamar rabbi elazar may dichtiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato lemi nae lemallel gevurot Adonai lemi sheyyachol lehashmia kol tehillato
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan hamsapper beshivcho shel hakkadosh baruch hu yoter midday neekar min haolam shenneemar hayesuppar lo ki adabber im amar ish ki yevulla
Daresh rabbi yehuda ish kefar gibborayya veamri lah ish kefar gibbor chayil may dichtiv lecha dumiyya tehilla samma decholla mashtuka ki ata rav dimi amar amri bemareva milla besela mashtuka bitren
Keraah al pe lo yatza vechu menalan amar rava atya zechira zechira ketiv hacha vehayyamim haelle nizkarim uchtiv hatam ketov zot zikkaron bassefer ma lehallan besefer af kan besefer
Umimmay dehay zechira keria hi dilma iyyun bealma la salka datach dichtiv zachor yachol ballev keshehu omer lo tishkach hare shichchat hallev amur ha ma ani mekayyem zachor bappe
Keraah targum lo yatza vechu hechi dame ilema dichtiva mikra vekare lah targum hayenu al pe la tzericha dichtiva targum vekare lah targum
Aval korin otah lalloazot belaaz vechu veha amratte keraah bechol lashon lo yatza rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu belaaz yeoni
Hechi dame ilema dichtiva ashshurit vekare lah yeonit hayenu al pe amar rabbi acha amar rabbi elazar shekketuva belaaz yeonit

Veamar rabbi acha amar rabbi elazar minnayin shekkerao hakkadosh baruch hu leyaakov el shenneemar vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael dei salka datach lemizbeach kera leh yaakov el vayyikra lo yaakov mibe leh ella vayyikra lo leyaakov el umi kerao el elohe yisrael
Metivi keraah giptit ivrit elamit madit yeonit lo yatza
Ha la damya ella leha giptit legiptim ivrit leivrim elamit leelamim yeonit lionim yatza
I hachi rav ushmuel ammay mokmi lah lematnitin belaaz yeonit lokmuha bechol laaz ella matnitin kevarayeta vechi itmar derav ushmuel bealma itmar rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu laaz yeoni lakkol kasher
Veha katane yeonit lionim lionim in lechulle alma la inhu daamur kerabban shimon ben gamliel ditnan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af sefarim lo hittiru sheyyikkatvu ella yeonit
Velemru halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel i amri halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel hava amena hane mile shear sefarim aval megila dichtiv bah kichtavam ema la ka mashma lan
Vehalloez sheshshama ashshurit yatza vechu veha la yada may kaamri mide dehave annashim veamme haaretz
Matkef lah ravina attu anan haachashteranim bene harammachim mi yadinan ella mitzvat keria ufarsome nisa hacha name mitzvat keria ufarsome nisa
Keraah serugin yatza vechu la hao yadi rabbanan may serugin shamuha leammeta deve rabbi dekaamra lehu lerabbanan dahao ayeli piske piske leve rabbi ad matay attem nichnasin serugin serugin
La hao yadi rabbanan may chaloglogot shamuha leammeta deve rabbi daamara leh lehahu gavra dahava ka mevaddar parpechine ad matay atta mefazzer chaloglogcha
La hao yadi rabbanan may salseleha utrommekka shamuha leammeta deve rabbi dahaot amra lehahu gavra dahava mehappech bemazyeh amara leh ad matay atta mesalsel bisarcha
La hao yadi rabbanan may hashlech al Adonai yehavcha amar rabba bar bar chana zimna chada hava azelna bahade hahu tayyaa veka darena tuna vaamar li shekol yahbach ushdi aggamlay
La hao yadi rabbanan may vetetetiha bematate hashmed shamuha leammeta deve rabbi dahaot amra lachavertah shekuli tatita vetati beta
Tanu rabbanan keraah serugin yatza
b: Serusin lo yatza rabbi muna omer mishshum rabbi yehuda af beserugin im shaha kede ligmor et kullah chozer larosh amar rav yosef halacha kerabbi muna sheamar mishshum rabbi yehuda
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef kede ligmor et kullah mehecha dekae lesefa o dilma meresha lesefa amar leh meresha lesefa deim ken natatta devarecha leshiurin

Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav halacha kerabbi muna ushmuel amar en halacha kerabbi muna besura matnu hachi befumbedita matnu hachi amar rav kahana amar rav halacha kerabbi muna ushmuel amar en halacha kerabbi muna rav bivi matni ipcha rav amar en halacha kerabbi muna ushmuel amar halacha kerabbi muna

Amar rav yosef nekot derav bivi bidach dishmuel hu dechayesh lichidaa ditnan shomeret yavam shekkidesh achiv et achotah mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betira amru omrim lo hamten ad sheyyaase achicha haggadol maase
Amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira
Tanu rabbanan hishmit bah sofer otiyyot o pesukin ukraan hakkore kimturgeman hamtargem yatza
Metivi hau bah otiyyot metushtashot o mekoraot im rishshuman nikar keshera veim lav pesula la kashya ha bechullah ha bemiktzatah

Tanu rabbanan hishmit bah hakkore pasuk echad lo yomar ekra et kullah veachar kach ekra oto pasuk ella kore meoto pasuk veelach nichnas levet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur shekkaru chetzyah lo yomar ekra chetzyah im hatztzibbur veachar kach ekra chetzyah ella kore otah mittechilatah vead sofah
Mitnamnem yatza vechu hechi dame mitnamnem amar rav ashe nim vela nim tir vela tir dekaru leh veane vela yada leahdore sevara vechi madkeru leh midchar
Haya kotvah dorshah umaggihah im kiven libbo yatza vechu hechi dame i deka mesaddar pesuka pesuka vechatev lah ki kiven libbo may have al pe hu ella dechatev pesuka pesuka vekare leh
Umi yatza vehaamar rabbi chelbo amar rav chama bar gurya amar rav halacha kedivre haomer kullah vaafilu leman deamar meish yehudi tzericha shettehe ketuva kullah

Ella demannecha megila kammeh vekare lah minah pesuka pesuka vechatav lah lema mesayya leh lerabba bar bar chana deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan asur lichtov ot achat shello min hakketav dilma deitremi leh itremoye

Gufa amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan asur lichtov ot achat shello min hakketav metivi amar rabbi shimon ben elazar maase berabbi meir shehalach leabber shana beasya velo haya sham megila uchtavah millibbo ukraah

Amar rabbi avahu shane rabbi meir demikayyam beh veafappecha yayeshiru negdecha amar leh rame bar chama lerabbi yirmeya middifti may veafappecha yayeshiru negdecha amar lo ellu divre tora dichtiv behu hataif enecha bo veenennu vaafilu hachi meushsharin hen etzel rabbi meir

Rav chisda ashkecheh lerav chananel dahava katev sefarim shello min hakketav amar leh reuya kol hattora kullah likatev al pich ella kach amru chachamim asur lichtov ot achat shello min hakketav middekaamar kol hattora kullah reuya shettikatev al pich mikkelal dimushsharin hen etzlo veha rabbi meir katav sheat haddechak shane

Abbaye shera lidve bar chavu lemichtav tefillin umzuzot shello min hakketav keman ki hay tanna detanya rabbi yirmeya omer mishshum rabbenu tefillin umzuzot nichtavot shello min hakketav veen tzerichot sirtut
Vehilcheta tefillin en tzerichin sirtut mezuzot tzerichin sirtut ide veide nichtavot shello min hakketav may tama migras gerisin
Hayeta ketuva besam ku sam samma sikra amar rabba bar bar chana sekarta shemah komos koma

a: Kankantom charta deushkafe diftera dimliach ukmiach vela afitz neyar mechaka
Ad shettehe ketuva ashshurit dichtiv kichtavam vechizmannam
Al hassefer uvido vechu menalan atya ketiva ketiva ketiv hacha vattichtov ester hammalka uchtiv hatam vayyomer lahem baruch mippiv yikra elay et kol haddevarim haelle vaani kotev al hassefer baddeo
Matni ben ir shehalach lichrach uven kerach shehalach leir im atid lachzor limkomo kore kimkomo veim lav kore immahen
Umehechan kore adam et hammegila veotze bah yede chova rabbi meir omer kullah rabbi yehuda omer meish yehudi rabbi yose omer meachar haddevarim haelle

Gema amar rava lo shanu ella sheatid lachzor belele arbaa asar aval en atid lachzor belele arbaa asar kore immahen amar rava mena amena lah dichtiv al ken hayehudim happerazim hayyoshvim beare happerazot mikkede ketiv hayehudim happerazim lema li lemichtav hayyoshvim beare happerazot ha ka mashma lan defaruz ben yomo nikra paruz
Ashkechan paruz mukkaf mena lan sevara hu middefaruz ben yomo karuy paruz mukkaf ben yomo karuy mukkaf

Veamar rava ben kefar shehalach leir ben kach uven kach kore immahen may tama hay kivne hair bae lemikre verabbanan hu daakilu al hakkefarim kede sheyesappeku mayim umazon laachehem shebbakkerakkin hane mile ki iteh beduchteh aval ki iteh beir kivne ir bae lemikre
Etiveh abbaye ben kerach shehalach leir ben kach uven kach kore kimkomo ben kerach salka datach beim atid lachzor talya milta ella lav ben kefar
Velav tarotze metartzatte teni kore immahen
Mehechan kore adam et hammegila vechu tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer mibballayela hahu
Amar rabbi yochanan vechullan mikra echad darshu vattichtov ester hammalka umordochay hayehudi et kol tokef man deamar kullah tokpo shel achashverosh
Uman deamar meish yehudi tokpo shel mardochay uman deamar meachar haddevarim haelle tokpo shel haman uman deamar mibballayela hahu tokpo shel nes
Rav huna amar mehacha uma rau al kacha uma higgia alehem
Man deamar kullah ma raa achashverosh shennishtammesh bechelim shel bet hammikdash al kacha mishshum dechashshev shivim shenin vela ipruk uma higgia alehem diktal vashti
Uman deamar meish yehudi ma raa mardechay deikanni behaman al kacha deshavi nafsheh avoda zara uma higgia alehem deitrechish nisa
Uman deamar meachar haddevarim haelle ma raa haman shennitkanne bechol hayehudim al kacha mishshum demardechay lo yichra velo yishtachave uma higgia alehem vetalu oto veet banav al haetz
Uman deamar mibballayela hahu ma raa achashverosh lehavi et sefer hazzichronot al kacha dezammenteh ester lehaman bahadeh uma higgia alehem deitrechish nisa
Amar rabbi chelbo amar rav chama bar gurya amar rav halacha kedivre haomer kullah vaafilu leman deamar meish yehudi tzericha shettehe ketuva kullah

Veamar rabbi chelbo amar rav chama bar gurya amar rav megila nikret sefer venikret iggeret nikret sefer sheim tefarah bechute fishtan pesula venikret iggeret sheim hetil bah shelosha chute gidin keshera amar rav nachman uvilvad sheyehu meshullashin
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hakkore bimgila hakketuva ben hakketuvim lo yatza amar rava la amaran ella dela mechassera umyatra purta aval mechassera umyatra purta let lan bah
Levi bar shemuel hava ka kare kammeh derav yehuda bimgila
b: Hakketuva ben hakketuvim amar leh hare amru hakkore bimgila hakketuva ben hakketuvim lo yatza
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hakkore bimgila hakketuva ben hakketuvim lo yatza umachu lah ammocha betzibbur shanu
Veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan shiyyur hattefer halacha lemoshe missinay umachu lah ammocha velo amru ella kede shello yikkara

Veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan ilmale nishtayyer bimara sheamad bah moshe veeliyyahu kimlo nekev machat sidkit lo hau yecholin laamod mippene haora shenneemar ki lo yirani haadam vachay

Veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv vaalehem kechol haddevarim asher dibber Adonai immachem bahar melammed sheherahu hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe dikduke tora vedikidduke sofrim uma shehassofrim atidin lechaddesh umay nihu mikra megila
Matni hakkol kesherin likrot et hammegila chutz mecheresh shote vekatan rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan
Gema man tena cheresh diavad name la amar rav matna rabbi yose hi ditnan hakkore et shema velo hishmia leozno yatza rabbi yose omer lo yatza
Umimmay derabbi yose hi vediavad name la dilma rabbi yehuda hi ulchattechilla hu dela ha diavad shappir dame
La salka datach dekatane cheresh dumya deshote vekatan ma shote vekatan diavad name la af cheresh diavad name la
Vedilma ha kidita veha kidita middekatane sefa rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan mikkelal deresha lav rabbi yehuda hi
Vedilma kullah rabbi yehuda hi mi dame resha lifsula vesefa lichshera

Vedilma kullah rabbi yehuda hi utre gavene katan katane lah vechassore michassera vehachi katane hakkol kesherin likrot et hammegila chutz mecheresh shote vekatan bamme devarim amurim bekatan shello higgia lechinuch aval bekatan shehiggia lechinuch afilu lechattechilla sherabbi yehuda machshir bekatan
Bemay okemta kerabbi yehuda vediavad
Ella ha detane rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi cheresh hamdabber veeno shomea torem lechattechilla manni i rabbi yehuda diavad in lechattechilla la i rabbi yose diavad name la

Veella may rabbi yehuda vaafilu lechattechilla ella ha detanya lo yevarech adam birkat hammazon belibbo veim berach yatza manni la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yose i rabbi yehuda afilu lechattechilla i rabbi yose afilu diavad name la

a: Leolam rabbi yehuda vaafilu lechattechila vela kashya ha dideh ha derabbeh

Detanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya hakkore et shema tzarich sheyyashmia leozno shenneemar shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad hashma leaznecha ma sheatta motzi mippicha rabbi meir omer asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom al levavecha achar kauonat hallev hen hen haddevarim
Hashta deatet lehachi afilu tema rabbi yehuda kerabbeh sevira leh veha detane yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi rabbi meir hi
Rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan detanya amar rabbi yehuda katan hayiti ukritiha lemala merabbi tarfon uzkenim belod amru lo en meviin reaya min hakkatan
Tanya amar rabbi katan hayiti ukritiha lemala merabbi yehuda amru lo en meviin reaya min hammattir
Velemru leh en meviin reaya min hakkatan chada veod kaamru leh chada dekatan hayita veod afilu gadol hayita en meviin reaya min hammattir
Matni en korin et hammegila velo malin velo tovlin velo mazzin vechen shomeret yom keneged yom lo titbol ad shettanetz hachamma vechullan sheasu mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher

Gema menalan deamar kera vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim bayyom in ballayela la lema tehve teuvta derabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi chayyav adam likrot et hammegila ballayela velishnotah bayyom ki katane addeom
Velo malin vechu dichtiv uvayyom hashshemini yimmol
Velo tovlin velo mazzin vechu dichtiv vehizza hattahor al hattame vego bayyom hashshevii veitakkash tevila lehazzaya
Vechen shomeret yom keneged yom lo titbol ad shettanetz hachamma vechu peshita may shena shomeret yom keneged yom mikkol chayyave tevilot

Itzterich salka datach amena tehve kiriyya rishona shel zav uriyya rishona shel zav itakkash levaal keri dichtiv zot torat hazzav vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara ma baal keri tovel bayyom hay name litbol beomeh
Veha bimama la matzya tavla dichtiv kol yeme zovah kemishkav niddatah yihye lah belelya mihat lebed miktzat shimur vetitbol ka mashma lan kevan devaaya sefira
b: Sefira bimama hi
Vechullan sheasu mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher menahane mile amar rava deamar kera vayyikra elohim laor yom lammeir uva kerao yom
Ella meatta velachoshech kara layela lammachshich uva kara layela ha kayema lan dead tzet hakkochavim lav layela hu
Ella amar rabbi zera mehacha vaanachnu osim bammelacha vechetzyam machazikim barmachim mealot hashshachar ad tzet hakkochavim veomer vehaya lanu hallayela lemishmar
May veomer vechi tema mishsheala ammud hashshachar lav yemama umikki arva shimsha lelya veinhu mekaddemi umchashshechi ta shema vehaya lanu hallayela mishmar vehayyom melacha
Matni kol hayyom kasher likriat hammegila velikriat hahallel velitkiat shofar velintilat lulav velitfillat hammusafin ulmusafin
Ulviduy happarim ulviduy maaser ulviduy yom hakkippurim
Lismicha lishchita litnufa lehaggasha likmitza ulhaktara limlika ulkabbala ulhazzaya
Ulhashkayat sota velaarifat haegla ultohorat hammetzora
Kol hallayela kasher liktzirat haomer ulhekter chalavim veevarim ze hakkelal davar shemmitzvato bayyom kasher kol hayyom davar shemmitzvato ballayela kasher kol hallayela
Gema menalan deamar kera vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim likriat hahallel dichtiv mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo rabbi yose omer ze hayyom asa Adonai
Velintilat lulav dichtiv ulkachtem lachem bayyom harishon velitkiat shofar dichtiv yom terua yihye lachem ulmusafin dichtiv devar yom beomo velitfillat hammusafin kemusafin shavveuha rabbanan

Ulviduy parim deyalef kappara kappara miyyom hakkippurim detanya gabbe yom hakkippurim vechipper baado uvad beto bechapparat devarim hakkatuv medabber vechappara bimama hu dichtiv bayyom hazze yechapper alechem
Ulviduy maaser vechu dichtiv veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha biarti hakkodesh min habbayit usmich leh hayyom hazze Adonai elohecha metzavvecha
Lismicha velishchita dichtiv vesamach veshachat uchtiv bah bishchita bayyom zivchachem velitnufa dichtiv beom hanifchem et haomer
Ulhaggasha deitakkash litnufa dichtiv velakach hakkohen miyyad haishsha et minchat hakkenaot vehenif vehikriv velimlika velikmitza ulhaktara ulhazzaya dichtiv bayyom tzauoto et bene yisrael
Ulhashkayat sota atya tora tora ketiv hacha veasa lah hakkohen et kol hattora hazzot uchtiv hatam al pi hattora asher yorucha veal hammishpat

a: Ma mishpat bayyom af kan bayyom
Velaarifat haegla amri deve rabbi yannay kappara ketiv bah kekadashim ultohorat metzora dichtiv zot tihye torat hammetzora beom tohorato
Kol hallayela kasher liktzirat haomer vechu deamar mar ketzira usfira ballayela vahavaa bayyom ulhekter chalavim veevarim dichtiv kol hallayela ad habboker
Ze hakkelal davar shemmitzvato beom kasher kol hayyom ze hakkelal leetoye may leetoye sidur bazichin vesilluk bazichin
Uchrabbi yose detanya rabbi yose omer silek et hayeshana shacharit vesider et hachadasha arvit en bechach kelum
Uma ani mekayyem lifne Adonai tamid shello yehe shulchan belo lechem
Davar shemmitzvato ballayela kasher kol hallayela leetoye may

Leetoye achilat pesachim udla kerabbi elazar ben azarya detanya veachlu et habbasar ballayela hazze amar rabbi elazar ben azarya neemar kan ballayela hazze veneemar lehallan veavarti veeretz mitzrayim ballayela hazze ma lehallan ad chatzot af kan ad chatzot
Hadaran alach hakkore lemafrea
Hakkore et hammegila omed veoshev keraah echad kerauha shenayim yatzu makom shennahagu levarech yevarech veshello levarech lo yevarech
Besheni vachamishi bashshabbat bammincha korin shelosha en pochatin mehen veen mosifin alehen veen maftirin bannavi happoteach vehachotem battora mevarech lefaneha ulachareha
Berashe chodashim uvchullo shel moed korin arbaa en pochatin mehen veen mosifin alehen veen maftirin bannavi happoteach vehachotem battora mevarech lefaneha ulachareha

Ze hakkelal kol sheyyesh bo musaf veeno yom tov korin arbaa beom tov chamishsha beom hakkippurim shishsha beshabbat shiva en pochatin mehen aval mosifin alehen umaftirin bannavi happoteach vehachotem battora mevarech lefaneha ulachareha
Gema tana ma sheen ken battora menahane mile amar rabbi avahu deamar kera veatta po amod immadi veamar rabbi avahu ilmale mikra katuv i efshar leomro kivyachol af hakkadosh baruch hu baamida
Veamar rabbi avahu minnayin larav shello yeshev al gabbe mitta veyishne letalmido al gabbe karka shenneemar veatta po amod immadi

Tanu rabbanan mimot moshe vead rabban gamliel lo hau lemedin tora ella meummad mishshemmet rabban gamliel yarad choli laolam vehau lemedin tora meushshav vehayenu ditnan mishshemmet rabban gamliel batal kevod tora

Katuv echad omer vaeshev bahar vechatuv echad omer veanochi amadti bahar amar rav omed velomed yoshev veshone rabbi chanina amar lo omed velo yoshev ella shoche rabbi yochanan amar en yeshiva ella leshon akkava shenneemar vatteshvu vekadesh yamim rabbim rava amar rakkot meummad vekashot meushshav
Keraah echad kerauha shenayim yatzu vechu
b: Tana ma sheen ken battora tanu rabbanan battora echad kore veechad metargem uvilvad shello yehe echad kore ushnayim metargemin uvannavi echad kore ushnayim metargemin uvilvad shello yehu shenayim korin ushnayim metargemin uvahallel uvammegila afilu asara korin vaasara metargemin
May tama kevan dachaviva yahavi datayehu veshami
Makom shennahagu levarech yevarech amar abbaye lo shanu ella leachareha aval lefaneha mitzva levarech deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol hammitzot kullan mevarech alehen over laasiyyatan

May mashma dehay over lishana deakdome hu amar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar kera vayyarotz achimaatz derech hakkikkar vayyaavor et hakkushi abbaye amar mehacha vehu avar lifnehem veibaet ema mehacha vayyaavor malkam lifnehem va berosham
Lefaneha may mevarech rav sheshet mikkatrazya ikla lekammeh derav ashe uvarech

Leachareha may mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hael harav et rivenu vehaddan et dinenu vehannokem et nikmatenu vehannifra lanu mitztzarenu vehamshallem gemul lechol oyeve nafshenu baruch atta Adonai hannifra leyisrael mikkol tzarehem rava amar hael hammoshia amar rav pappa hilkach nemrinhu letarvayehu baruch atta Adonai hannifra leyisrael mikkol tzarehem hael hammoshia
Besheni uvachamishi bashshabbat bammincha korin shelosha vechu hane shelosha keneged mi amar rav assi keneged tora neviim uchtuvim rava amar keneged kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim
Ella ha detane rav shimi en pochatin measara pesukin bevet hakkeneset vayedabber ole min hamminyan hane asara keneged mi

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi keneged asara batlanin shebbevet hakkeneset rav yosef amar keneged aseret haddibberot shenneemru lemoshe besinay rabbi levi amar keneged asara hilulin sheamar david besefer tehillim verabbi yochanan amar keneged asara maamarot shebbahen nivra haolam
He ninhu vayyomer divreshit hane tisha hau bereshit name maamar hu dichtiv bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu uvruach piv kol tzevaam
Amar rava rishon shekkara arbaa meshubbach sheni shekkara arbaa meshubbach shelishi shekkara arbaa meshubbach
Rishon shekkara arbaa meshubbach ditnan beshalosh kuppot shel shalosh sein shebbahen tormin et hallishka vehaya katuv alehen leda ezo mehen nitrema rishon lehakriv mimmenna rishon shemmitzva barishon

Emtzai shekkara arbaa meshubbach detanya el mul pene hammenora yairu melammed shemmetzadded penehem kelappe ner maaravi vener maaravi kelappe shechina veamar rabbi yochanan mikkan sheemtzai meshubbach
Veacharon shekkara arbaa meshubbach mishshum maalin bakkodesh velo moridin rav pappa ikla leve kenishta daavi govar vekara rishon arbaa veshabbecheh rav pappa
En pochatin mehen veen mosifin tana happoteach mevarech lefaneha vehachotem mevarech leachareha
Vehaidana dechullehu mevarchi lefaneha ulachareha hayenu tama detakkinu rabbanan gezera mishshum hannichnasin umishshum hayyotzin

Berashe chodashim uvchullo shel moed korin arbaa vechu bea mineh ulla bar rav merava parashat rosh chodesh ketzad korin otah tzav et bene yisrael veamarta alehem et korbani lachmi dehaveyan temanya pesuke hechi nebed

Nikre tere telata telata pesukin pashu lehu tere veen meshayerin bapparasha pachot mishshelosha pesukin nikre arbaa arbea pashu lehu shiva uvom hashshabbat havayin tere uvrashe chodshechem havayin chamishsha hechi naaved nikre tere meha vechad mehanach

a: En matchilin bapparasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim likre tere meha utlata mehach pashu lehu tere
Amar lo zo lo shamati kayyotze bah shamati ditnan bayyom harishon bereshit viyehi rakia vetane alah bereshit bishnayim yehi rakia beechad
Vehavenan bah bishlama yehi rakia beechad ditlata pesuke hau ella bereshit bishnayim chamsha pesuke hau vetanya hakkore battora lo yifchot mishshelosha pesukim
Veitmar alah rav amar doleg ushmuel amar posek
Rav amar doleg may tama la amar posek kasavar kol pesuka dela paskeh moshe anan la paskinan leh
Ushmuel amar paskinan leh veha amar rabbi chananya kara tzaar gadol haya li etzel rabbi chanina haggadol velo hittir li lifsok ella letinokot shel bet rabban hoil ulhitlammed asuyin
Hatam tama may mishshum dela efshar hacha name la efshar
Ushmuel amar posek may tama la amar doleg gezera mishshum hannichnasin umishshum hayyotzin

Metivi parasha shel shishsha pesukim korin otah bishnayim veshel chamishsha pesukim beyachid kara rishon shelosha hashsheni kore shenayim mipparasha zo veechad mipparasha acheret veyesh omrim shelosha lefi sheen matchilin bapparasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim
Veim ita leman deamar doleg nidlog ulman deamar posek nifsok
Shane hatam deefshar behachi

Amar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha keyesh omrim veamar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi keshem sheen matchilin bapparasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim kach en meshayerin bapparasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim
Peshita hashta uma atchalta deka makkel tanna kamma machmeri yesh omrim shiyyur demachmir tanna kamma lo kol shekken demachmeri yesh omrim
Mahu detema nichnasin shechichi yotzin la shechichi demannechi sefer tora venafki ka mashma lan
Vetanna kamma may shena shayyore dela mishshum yotzin atchole name gezera mishshum hannichnasin amri man deayel shayyole meshayyel
Shelach leh rabba bereh derava lerav yosef hilcheta may shelach leh hilcheta doleg veemtzai dolgan
Ze hakkelal kol sheyyesh bo musaf vechu ibaya lehu taanit tzibbur bechamma rosh chodesh umoed deika korban musaf arbaa aval hacha deleka korban musaf la o dilma hacha name ika musaf tefilla

Ta shema berashe chodashim uvchullo shel moed korin arbaa ha betaanit tzibbur shelosha ema resha besheni uvachamishi uvashshabbat bammincha korin shelosha ha taanit tzibbur arbaa ella meha leka lemishma minah
Ta shema derav ikla levavel betaanit tzibbur kam kera besifra petach barech chatam vela barech neful kulle alma aanpayehu verav la nefal al appeh
Mikkede rav beyisrael kera may tama chatam vela barech lav mishshum devae lemikre acharina batreh
La rav bechahane kera deha rav huna kare bechahane
Bishlama rav huna kare bechahane deha afilu rav amme verav assi dechahane chashivi deara yisrael mikaf kayefi leh lerav huna ella rav ha ika shemuel dechahana hava vedavar aleh
Shemuel name mikaf hava kayif leh lerav verav hu daavad leh kavod vechi aved leh befanav shello befanav la aved leh
Hachi name mistabbera derav bechahane kera dei salka datach beyisrael kera lefaneha may tama barech leachar takkana
I hachi leachareha name levarech shane hecha deyatev rav demeal ayeli
b: Mipak la nafki
Ta shema ze hakkelal kol sheyyesh bo bitul melacha laam kegon taanit tzibbur vetisha beav korin shelosha
Vesheen bo bitul melacha laam kegon rashe chodashim vechullo shel moed korin arbaa shema minah
Amar rav ashe veha anan la tenan hachi ze hakkelal kol yom sheyyesh bo musaf veeno yom tov korin arbaa leetoye may lav leetoye taanit tzibur vetisha beav

Ulrav ashe matnitin manni la tanna kamma vela rabbi yose detanya chal lihot besheni uvachamishi korin shelosha umaftir echad bishlishi uvirvii kore echad umaftir echad rabbi yose omer leolam korin shelosha umaftir echad
Veella kashya ze hakkelal la leetoye rosh chodesh umoed
Ha behedya katane lah berashe chodashim umoed korin arbaa
Simana bealma yahev dela tema yom tov vechullo shel moed ki hadade ninhu ella nekot hay kelala bidach kol detafe leh milta mechavreh tafe leh gavra yattira
Hilkach berosh chodesh umoed deika korban musaf korin arbaa beom tov deasur baasiyyat melacha chamishsha beom hakkippurim deanush karet shishsha shabbat deika isur sekila shiva
Gufah rav ikla levavel betaanit tzibbur kam kera besifra petach barech chatam vela barech neful kulle alma aanpayehu verav la nefal al anpeh may tama rav la nefal al appeh

Ritzpa shel avanim hayeta vetanya veeven maskit lo tittenu beartzechem lehishtachaot aleha aleha i atta mishtachave beartzechem aval atta mishtachave al avanim shel bet hammikdash kidulla deamar ulla lo asra tora ella ritzpa shel avanim bilvad
I hachi may irya rav afilu kullehu name kammeh derav havay
Velezil legabbe tzibura velinpol al appeh la bae lmatrach tzibura veibaet ema rav pishut yadayim veraglayim hava aved vechidulla deamar ulla la asra tora ella pishut yadayim veraglayim bilvad
Velipol al appeh vela lebed pishut yadayim veraglayim la meshanne mimminhageh
Veibaet ema adam chashuv shane kidrabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar en adam chashuv rashshay lipol al panav ella im ken naane kihoshua bin nun dichtiv vayyomer Adonai el yehoshua kum lach vego

Tanu rabbanan kida al appayim shenneemar vattikkod bat sheva appayim eretz keria al birkayim vechen hu omer mikkeroa al birkav hishtachavaa zo pishut yadayim veraglayim shenneemar havo navo ani veimmecha veachecha lehishtachaot lecha artza
Levi achvi kida kammeh derabbi veitla
Veha ka gerama leh vehaamar rabbi elazar leolam al yatiach adam devarim kelappe mala shehare adam gadol hetiach devarim kelappe mala veitla umannu levi ha veha gerama leh
Amar rav chiyya bar avin chazena lehu leabbaye

a: Verava dimtzalle atzloye

Beom tov chamishsha beom hakkippurim shishsha ku matnitin manni lo rabbi yishmael vela rabbi akiva detanya beom tov chamishsha uvom hakkippurim shishsha uvshabbat shiva en pochatin mehen veen mosifin alehen divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer beom tov chamishsha uvom hakkippurim shiva uvshabbat shishsha en pochatin mehen aval mosifin alehen
Manni i rabbi yishmael kashya tosefet i rabbi akiva kashya shishsha veshiva
Amar rava tena deve rabbi yishmael hi detana deve rabbi yishmael beom tov chamishsha beom hakkippurim shishsha beshabbat shiva en pochatin mehen aval mosifin alehen divre rabbi yishmael
Kashya derabbi yishmael adderabbi yishmael tere tannae alliba derabbi yishmael

Man tena leha detanya beom tov meacharin lavo umimmuhrin latzet beom hakkippurim mimmuhrin lavo umacharin latzet uvshabbat mimmuhrin lavo umimmuhrin latzet lema rabbi akiva deit leh gavra yattira afilu tema rabbi yishmael dinfish sidura deoma

Hane shelosha chamishsha veshiva keneged mi peligi bah rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani vechad deamya umannu rabbi shimon ben pazzi veamri lah rabbi shimon ben pazzi vechad deammeh umannu rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani veamri lah rabbi shemuel bar nachmani chad amar keneged birkat kohanim vechad amar keneged shelosha shomre hassaf chamishsha meroe pene hammelech shiva roay pene hammelech

Tane rav yosef shelosha chamishsha veshiva shelosha shomre hassaf chamishsha meroe pene hammelech shiva roi pene hammelech amar leh abbaye ad haidana may tama la parish lan mar amar leh la hava yadana ditzrichitu leh umi beetu minay milta vela amari lechu

Amar leh yaakov minaa lerav yehuda hane shishsha deom hakkippurim keneged mi amar leh keneged shishsha sheamdu mimino shel ezra veshishsha missemolo shenneemar vayyaamod ezra hassofer al migdal etz asher asu laddavar vayyaamod etzlo mattitya veshema vaanaya veuriyya vechilkiyya umaaseya al yemino umissemolo pedaya umishael umalkiyya vechashum vechashbaddana zecharya meshullam
Hane shiva hau hayenu zecharya hayenu meshullam veammay kerao meshullam demishlam beovadeh
Tanu rabbanan hakkol olin lamminyan shiva vaafilu katan vaafilu ishsha aval amru chachamim ishsha lo tikra betora mippene kevod tzibbur
Ibaya lehu maftir mahu sheyyaale lamminyan shiva rav huna verabbi yirmeya bar abba chad amar ole vechad amar eno ole man deamar ola deha kare
Uman deamar eno ole kidulla deamar ulla mippene ma hammaftir benavi tzarich shikra betora techilla mippene kevod tora vechevan demishshum kevod tora hu leminyana la salek
Metivi hammaftir benavi lo yifchot meesrim veechad pesukin keneged shiva shekkerao betora veim ita esrim vearbaa haveyin kevan demishshum kevod tora hu
b: Kenegdo name la bae
Matkef lah rava vahare olotechem sefo dela haveyin esrin vechad vekarenan shane hatam dislek inyana

Vehecha dela salek inyana la vehaamar rav shemuel bar abba zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derabbi yochanan vechi hava karenan asara pesuke amar lan appesiko makom sheyyesh turgeman shane detane rav tachlifa bar shemuel lo shanu ella bimkom sheen turgeman aval makom sheyyesh turgeman posek
Matni en porsin al shema veen ovrin lifne hatteva veen nosin et kappehem veen korin betora veen maftirin bannavi
Veen osin maamad umoshav veen omrim birkat avelim vetanchume avelim uvirkat chatanim veen mezammenin beshem pachot measara uvkarkaot tisha vechohen veadam kayyotze bahen
Gema mena hane mile amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera venikdashti betoch bene yisrael kol davar shebbikdushsha lo yehe pachot measara
May mashma detane rabbi chiyya atya toch toch ketiv hacha venikdashti betoch bene yisrael uchtiv hatam hibbadlu mittoch haeda
Veatya eda eda dichtiv hatam ad matay laeda haraa hazzot ma lehallan asara af kan asara
Veen osin maamad umoshav pachot measara kevan devae lememar imdu yekarim amodu shevu yekarim shevu betzir measara lav orach ara

Veen omrim birkat avelim uvirkat chatanim vechu may birkat avelim birkat rechava deamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan birkat avelim baasara veen avelim min hamminyan birkat chatanim baasara vachatanim min hamminyan
Veen mezammenin al hammazon bashshem pachot measara vechu kevan devae lememar nevarech lelohenu betzir measara lav orach ara
Vehakkarkaot tisha vechohen veadam kayyotze bahen vechu mena hane mile
Amar shemuel asara kohanim ketuvim bapparasha chad legufeh vechad lemaote veidach have miut achar miut veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot tisha yisreelim vechad kohen
Veema chamishsha kohanim vachamishsha yisreelim kashya
Veadam kayyotze bahen adam mi kadosh
Amar rabbi avahu beomer deme alay detanya haomer deme alay shamin oto keeved veeved itakkash lekarkaot dichtiv vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem lareshet achuzza
Matni hakkore betora lo yifchot mishshelosha pesukim velo yikra limturgeman yoter mippasuk echad

a: Uvannavi shelosha hau shelashtan shalosh parashiyyot korin echad echad
Medallegin bannavi veen medallegin battora vead kamma hu medalleg ad kede shello yifsok hamturgeman
Gema hane shelosha pesukin keneged mi amar rav assi keneged tora neviim uchtuvim

Velo yikra lammeturgeman yoter mippasuk echad uvannavi shelosha pesukim veim hau shelashtan shalosh parashiyyot kore echad echad kegon ki cho amar Adonai chinnam nimkartem ki ko amar Adonai elohim mitzrayim yarad ammi varishona veatta ma li fo neum Adonai
Medallegin bannavi veen medallegin battora urminhi kore achare mot veach beasor veha ka medalleg
Amar abbaye la kashya kan bichde sheyyifsok hatturgeman vechan bichde shello yifsok hatturgeman
Veha alah katane medallegin bannavi veen medallegin battora vead kamma hu medalleg ad kede shello yifsok hatturgeman michlal devattora kelal kelal la
Ella amar abbaye la kashya kan beinyan echad kan bishte inyanot vehatanya medallegin battora beinyan echad uvannavi bishne inyanin kan vechan bichde shello yifsok hatturgeman
Tanya idach en medallegin minnavi lenavi uvannavi shel shenem asar medalleg uvilvad shello yedalleg missof hassefer litchilato
Matni hammaftir bannavi hu pores al shema vehu over lifne hatteva vehu nose et kappav veim haya katan aviv o rabbo ovrin al yado
Katan kore battora umtargem aval eno pores al shema veeno over lifne hatteva veeno nose et kappav
Pocheach pores et shema umtargem aval eno kore battora veeno over lifne hatteva veeno nose et kappav
Some pores et shema umtargem rabbi yehuda omer kol shello raa meorot miyyamav eno pores al shema
Gema may tama rav pappa amar mishshum kavod rabba bar shimi amar mishshum deate leintzoye
May benayehu ika benayehu deaved bechinnam
Tenan veim haya katan aviv o rabbo ovrin al yado i amratte mishshum intzoye katan bar intzoye hu
Ella may mishshum kavod katan bar kavod hu ella ika kevod aviv uchvod rabbo
b: Hacha name ika nitztzuye aviv venitztzuye rabbo
Pocheach pores al shema vechu bea mineh ulla bar rav meabbaye katan pocheach mahu sheyyikra battora
Amar leh vetibe lach arom arom may tama la mishshum kevod tzibbur hacha name mishshum kevod tzibbur
Some pores al shema vechu tanya amru lo lerabbi yehuda harbe tzafu lidrosh bammerkava velo rau otah mimehem
Verabbi yehuda hatam beovanta deliba talya milta veha ka mikaven veyada hacha mishshum hanaa hu veha let leh hanaa

Verabbanan it leh hanaa kerabbi yose detanya amar rabbi yose kol yamay hayiti mitztaer al mikra ze vehayita memashshesh batztzohorayim kaasher yemashshesh haiver baafela vechi ma ichpat leh leiver ben afela leora

Ad shebba maase leyadi paam achat hayiti mehallech beishon layela vaafela veraiti some shehaya mehallech badderech vaavuka beyado amarti lo beni avuka zo lamma lach amar li kol zeman sheavuka beyadi bene adam roin oti umatztzilin oti min happechatin umin hakkotzin umin habbarkanin
Matni kohen sheyyesh beyadav mumin lo yissa et kappav rabbi yehuda omer af mi shehau yadav tzevuot setes lo yissa et kappav mippene shehaam mistakkelin bo

Gema tana mumin sheamru befanav yadav veraglav amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi yadav bohakaniyyot lo yissa et kappav tanya name hachi yadav bohakaniyyot lo yissa et kappav akummot akushot lo yissa et kappav

Amar rav assi chefani uveshani lo yissa et kappav tanya name hachi en moridin lifne hatteva lo anshe bet shean velo anshe bet chefa velo anshe tivonin mippene shekkorin laalfin ayenin velaayenin alfin

Amar leh rabbi chiyya lerabbi shimon bar rabbi ilmale atta levi pasul atta min hadduchan mishshum daave kalach ata amar leh laavuh amar leh zil ema leh kesheatta maggia etzel vechikkiti la lo nimtzet mecharef umgaddef
Amar rav huna zavlegan lo yissa et kappav veha hahu dahava beshivavuteh derav huna vahava pares yedeh hahu dash beiro hava tanya name hachi zavlegan lo yissa et kappav veim haya dash beiro muttar

Amar rabbi yochanan some beachat meenav lo yissa et kappav veha hahu dahava beshivavuteh derabbi yochanan dahava pares yedeh hahu dash beiro hava tanya name hachi some beachat meenav lo yissa et kappav veim haya dash beiro muttar
Rabbi yehuda omer mi shehau yadav tzevuot lo yissa et kappav tana im rov anshe hair melachtan bechach muttar
Matni haomer eni over lifne hatteva bitzvuin af bilvanim lo yaavor besandal eni over af yachef lo yaavor
Haose tefillato agulla sakkana veen bah mitzva netanah al mitzcho o al pas yado hare zo derech hamminut tzipan tzipah zahav untanah al bet unkeli shello hare zo derech hachitzonim
Gema may tama chayeshinan shemma minut nizreka bo
Haose tefillato agulla sakkana veen bah mitzva lema tenena leha detanu rabbanan tefillin merubbaot halacha lemoshe missinay veamar rava betifran uvaalachsonan
Amar rav pappa matnitin daavida ki amguza
Matni haomer

a: Yevarchucha tovim hare zo derech hamminut al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha veal tov yizzacher shemecha modim modim meshattekin oto
Hamchanne baaraot meshattekin oto haomer umizzaracha lo titten lehaavir lammolech lo titten leabara bearmauta meshattekin oto binzifa

Gema bishlama modim modim demichaze kishte rashuot veal tov yizzacher shemecha name demashma al tov in veal ra la utnan chayyav adam levarech al haraa keshem shehu mevarech al hattova ella al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha may tama

Peligi bah tere amorae bemareva rabbi yose bar avin verabbi yose bar zevida chad amar mippene shemmetil kina bemaase vereshit vechad amar mippene sheose middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu rachamim veenan ella gezerot

Hahu dinchet kammeh derabba amar atta chasta al kan tzippor atta chus verachem alenu atta chasta al oto veet beno atta chus verachem alenu amar rabba kamma yada hay merabbanan leratztzoye lemareh amar leh abbaye veha meshattekin oto tenan
Verabba lechaddode leabbaye hu diva
Hahu dinchet kammeh derabbi chanina amar hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora haaddir vehechazak vehaammitz

Amar leh sayyemtinhu lishvacheh demarach hashta hane telata i lav dechatvinhu moshe beorayeta vaato keneset haggedola vetakkeninhu anan la amrinan lehu veatte amratte kulle hay mashal leadam shehau lo elef alfe alafim dinre zahav vehau mekallesin oto beelef dinre chesef lo genay hu lo
Amar rabbi chanina hakkol bide shamayim chutz miyyirat shamayim shenneemar veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach ki im leyira
Mikkelal deyira milta zutarti hi in legabbe moshe rabbenu milta zutarti hi mashal leadam shemmevakkeshin hemennu keli gadol veyesh lo dome alav kichli katan katan veen lo dome alav kichli gadol
Amar rabbi zera haomer shema shema keomer modim modim dame
Metivi hakkore et shema vechoflah hare ze megunne megunne hu dehave shattoke la meshattekinan leh la kashya ha deamar milta milta vetane lah ha deamar pesuka pesuka vetane leh
Amar leh rav pappa lerava vedilma meikara la kaven dateh vehashta kaven dateh amar leh chavruta kelappe shemayya i la mechaven dateh machena leh bearzafta denappacha ad dimchaven dateh
Hamchanne baaraot meshattekin oto tane rav yosef kelon aviv uklon immo
Haomer umizzaracha lo titten lehaavir vechu tana deve rabbi yishmael beyisrael habba al haggoya veholid mimmenna ben laavoda zara hakkatuv medabber
Matni maase reuven nikra velo mittargem maase tamar nikra umittargem maase egel harishon nikra umittargem vehashsheni nikra velo mittargem birkat kohanim maase david veamnon nikrain velo mittargemin
En maftirin bammerkava verabbi yehuda mattir rabbi eliezer omer en maftirin behoda et yerushalami
Gema tanu rabbanan yesh nikrin umittargemin veyesh nikrin velo mittargemin veyesh lo nikrin velo mittargemin ellu nikrin umittargemin balat akan nishpe siman
Maase vereshit nikra umittargem peshita mahu detema atu leshayyole ma lemala ma lematta
b: Uma lifnim uma leachor ka mashma lan
Maase lot ushte venotav nikra umittargem peshita mahu detema nechush lichvodo deavraham ka mashma lan
Maase tamar vihuda nikra umittargem peshita mahu detema lechush lichvodo dihuda ka mashma lan shevacheh hu deodi
Maase egel harishon nikra umittargem peshita mahu detema lechush lichvodan shel yisrael ka mashma lan kol shekken denicha lehu dehaveya lehu kappara
Kelalot uvrachot nikrin umittargemin peshita mahu detema nechush dilma payega datayehu detzibbura ka mashma lan
Azharot vaonashin nikrin umittargemin peshita mahu detema nechush dilma atu lemebad miyyira ka mashma lan
Maase amnon vetamar nikra umittargem maase avshalom nikra umittargem peshita mahu detema lechush likareh dedavid ka mashma lan
Maase pilegesh baggiva nikra umittargem peshita mahu detema lechush lichvodo devinyamin ka mashma lan

Hoda et yerushalam et toavoteha nikra umittargem peshita leappoke midderabbi eliezer detanya maase beadam echad shehaya kore lemala merabbi eliezer hoda et yerushalam et toavoteha amar lo ad sheatta bodek betoavot yerushalayim tze uvdok betoavot immecha badku acharav umatzu bo shemetz pesul

Veellu nikrin velo mittargemin siman maase reuven nikra velo mittargem umaase berabbi chanina ben gamliel shehalach lechavul vehaya kore chazzan hakkeneset vayehi bishkon yisrael veamar lo lammeturgeman hafsek al tetargem ella acharon veshibchuhu chachamim
Maase egel hashsheni nikra velo mittargem eze maase egel hashsheni min vayyomer moshe ad vayyar moshe
Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer leolam yehe adam zahir bitshuvotav shemmittoch teshuva sheheshivo aharon lemoshe pakru hamminin shenneemar vaashlichehu vaesh vayyetze haegel hazze
Birkat kohanim nikrin velo mittargemin may tama mishshum dichtiv yissa
Maase david veamnon lo nikrin velo mittargemin veha amratte maase amnon vetamar nikra umittargem la kashya ha dichtiv amnon ben david ha dichtiv amnon setama

Tanu rabbanan kol hammikraot hakketuvin battora lignay korin otan leshevach kegon yishgalenna yishkavenna baafolim battechorim chironim divonim leechol et chorehem velishtot et meme shinehem leechol et tzoatam velishtot et meme raglehem
Lemacharaot lemotzaot rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer lemacharaot kishman mippene shehu genay laavoda zara

Amar rav nachman kol letzanuta asira bar milletzanuta daavoda zara desharya dichtiv kara bel kores nevo uchtiv karsu charu yachdav lo yachlu mallet massa vego rabbi yannay amar mehacha leeglot bet aven yaguru shechan shomron ki aval alav ammo uchmarav alav yagilu al kevodo ki gala mimmennu al tikre kevodo ella kevedo

Amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika shere leh levar yisrael lememar leh legoy shikleh laavoda zara veannecheh beshin tav shello amar rav ashe hay man disne shumaneh shere leh levazzoyeh begimel veshin hay man deshappir shumaneh shere leshabbocheh uman deshabbecheh yanuchu lo berachot al rosho
Hadaran alach hakkore et hammegila omed
Bene hair shemmachru rechovah shel ir lokchin bedamav bet hakkeneset bet hakkeneset lokchin teva teva lokchin mitpachot mitpachot

a: Yikchu sefarim sefarim lokchin tora
Aval im machru tora lo yikchu sefarim sefarim lo yikchu mitpachot mitpachot lo yikchu teva teva lo yikchu bet hakkeneset bet hakkeneset lo yikchu et harchov
Vechen bemotrehen
Gema bene hair shemmachru rechovah shel ir amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi menachem bar yose setimtaa aval chachamim omrim harchov en bo mishshum kedushsha
Verabbi menachem bar yose may tameh hoil vehaam mitpallelin bo betaaniyyot uvmaamadot verabbanan hahu akray bealma

Bet hakkeneset lokchin teva amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan lo shanu ella bet hakkeneset shel kefarim aval bet hakkeneset shel kerakkin kevan demealma atu leh la matzu mezabbeni leh dehave leh derabbim
Amar rav ashe hay be chenishta demata machseya af al gav demealma atu lah kevan deaddata didi kaatu i baena mezabbenna lah

Metivi amar rabbi yehuda maase bevet hakkeneset shel tursiyyim shehaya birushalayim shemmecharuha lerabbi eliezer veasa bah kol tzerachav veha hatam dichrakkim hava hahi be chenishta zute hava veinhu avduh
Metivi bevet eretz achuzzatchem achuzzatchem mitamma bingaim veen yerushalayim mitamma bingaim amar rabbi yehuda ani lo shamati ella mekom mikdash bilvad
Ha batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot mitammein ammay ha dichrakkin hau ema amar rabbi yehuda ani lo shamati ella mekom mekuddash bilvad
Bemay kamipalgi tanna kamma savar lo nitchalleka yerushalayim lishvatim verabbi yehuda savar nitchalleka yerushalayim lishvatim
Uviflugta dehane tannae
Detanya ma haya bechelko shel yehuda har habbayit halleshachot vehaazarot uma haya bechelko shel binyamin ulam vehechal uvet kodshe hakkodashim

Urtzua hayeta yotzet mechelko shel yehuda venichneset bechelko shel binyamin uvah mizbeach banuy vehaya binyamin hatztzaddik mitztaer aleha bechol yom levolah shenneemar chofef alav kol hayyom lefichach zacha binyamin venaasa ushpizchan lashshechina

Vehay tanna savar lo nitchalleka yerushalayim lishvatim detanya en maskirim battim birushalayim mippene sheenan shellahen rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer af lo mittot lefichach orot kadashim baale ushpizin notlin otan bizroa
Amar abbaye shema minah orach ara lemishbak inash gulpa umashka beushpizeh
Amar rava lo shanu ella shello machru shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair aval machru shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair afilu
b: Lemishte beh shichra shappir dame
Ravina hava leh hahu tila deve chenishta ata lekammeh derav ashe amar leh mahu lemizreeh amar leh zil zavneh mishshiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair vezareh

Rame bar abba hava ka vane be chenishta hava hahi kenishta attika hava bae lemisterah uletoye livne uchshure minah veayyole lehatam yatev veka mibaya leh ha derav chisda deamar rav chisda la listor be chenishta ad devane be chenishta achariti hatam mishshum peshiuta ki hay gavena may ata lekammeh derav pappa vaasar leh lekammeh derav huna vaasar leh
Amar rava hay be chenishta challofah vezabbonah shere ogorah umashkonah asir may tama bikdushtah kae
Livne name challofinhu vezabboninhu shere ozofinhu asir hane mile beattikata aval bechadtata let lan bah
Vaafilu leman deamar hazmana milta hi hane mile kegon haoreg beged lammet aval hacha ketauy learig dame veleka leman deamar
Mattana peligi bah rav acha veravina chad asar vechad share man deasar bemay tifka kedushtah uman deshare i lav dahava leh hanaa mineh la hava yahev leh hadar have lah mattana kizvine

Tanu rabbanan tashmishe mitzva nizrakin tashmishe kedushsha nignazin veellu hen tashmishe mitzva sukka lulav shofar tzitzit veellu hen tashmishe kedushsha deloskeme sefarim tefilin umzuzot vetik shel sefer tora venartik shel tefilin urtzuotehen
Amar rava meresh hava amena hay kurseya tashmish detashmish hu ushre kevan dachazena demotvi illaveh sefer tora amena tashmish kedushsha hu vaasir
Veamar rava meresh hava amena hay perisa tashmish detashmish hu kevan dachazena deayefi leh umannechi sifra illaveh amena tashmish kedushsha hu vaasir
Veamar rava hay tevuta deirfat mibedah teva zutarti shere kurseya asir veamar rava hay perisa divla lemibedeh perisa lesifre shere lechumshin asir
Veamar rava hane zevile dechummashe vekamtere desifre tashmish kedushsha ninhu venignazin peshita mahu detema hane lav lechavod avidan lenattore bealma avidi ka mashma lan

Hahu be chenishta dihudae deromae dahava petiach lehahu idrona dahava machet beh met vahao bau kahane lemeal letzalloye hatam ato amaru leh lerava amar lehu dallo tevuta otvuha dehave leh keli etz heasuy lenachat uchli etz heasuy lenachat eno mekabbel tuma vechotzetz bifne hattuma
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava veha zimnin dimtalteli leh ki mannach sefer tora illaveh vehave leh mitaltel male verekam i hachi la efshar
Amar mar zutra mitpechot sefarim shebbalu osin otan tachrichin lemet mitzva vezo hi genizatan
Veamar rava sefer tora shebbala gonzin oto etzel talmid chacham vaafilu shone halachot amar rav acha bar yaakov uvichli cheres shenneemar untattam bichli chares lemaan yaamdu yamim rabbim
Veamar rav pappi mishshemeh derava mibbe chenishta leve rabbanan shere mibbe rabbanan leve chenishta asir verav pappa mishshemeh derava matni ipcha amar rav acha

a: Keoteh derav pappe mistabbera deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi bet hakkeneset muttar laasoto bet hammidrash shema minah

Darash bar kappara may dichtiv vayyisrof et bet Adonai veet bet hammelech veet kol batte yerushalam veet kol bet gadol saraf baesh bet Adonai ze bet hammikdash bet hammelech ellu palterin shel melech veet kol batte yerushalam kemashmaan veet kol bet gadol saraf baesh rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi chad amar makom shemmegaddelin bo tora vechad amar makom shemmegaddelin bo tefilla
Man deamar tora dichtiv Adonai chafetz lemaan tzidko yagdil tora veyadir uman deamar tefilla dichtiv sappera na haggedolot asher asa elisha veelisha daavad berachame hu daavad
Tistayyem derabbi yehoshua ben levi hu deamar makom shemmegaddelin bo tora deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi bet hakkeneset muttar laasoto bet hammidrash shema minah
Aval machru tora lo yikchu sefarim vechu ibaya lehu mahu limkor sefer tora yashan likach bo chadash kevan dela mealle leh asur o dilma kevan deleka lealloye iluya acharina shappir dame
Ta shema aval machru tora lo yikchu sefarim sefarim hu dela ha tora betora shappir dame matnitin diavad ki ka mibaya lan lechattechilla
Ta shema gollin sefer tora bemitpechot chummashin vechummashin bemitpechot neviim uchtuvim aval lo neviim uchtuvim bemitpechot chummashin velo chummashin bemitpechot sefer tora
Katane mihat gollim sefer tora bemitpechot chummashin mitpechot chummashin in mitpechot sefer tora la
Ema sefa velo chummashin bemitpechot sefer tora ha tora betora shappir dame ella meha leka lemishma minah
Ta shema mannichin sefer tora al gabbe tora vetora al gabbe chummashin vechummashin al gabbe neviim uchtuvim aval lo neviim uchtuvim al gabbe chummashin velo chummashin al gabbe tora
Hannacha kaamratte shane hannacha dela efshar dei la tema hachi michrach hechi karchinan veha ka yatev dappa achavreh ella kevan dela efshar shere hacha name kevan dela efshar shere
Ta shema deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel lo yimkor adam sefer tora yashan likach bo chadash
Hatam mishshum peshiuta ki kaamrinan kegon dichtiv umannach leiproke may
Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir en mochrin sefer tora ella lilmod tora velisa ishsha
Shema minah tora betora shappir dame dilma shane talmud shehattalmud mevi lide maase ishsha name la tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah aval tora betora la
Tanu rabbanan lo yimkor adam sefer tora af al pi sheeno tzarich lo yater al ken amar rabban shimon ben gamliel afilu en lo ma yochal umachar sefer tora o bitto eno roe siman beracha leolam
Vechen bemotrehen amar rava lo shanu ella shemmachru vehotiru aval gavu vehotiru muttar
Etiveh abbaye bamma devarim amurim shello hitnu aval hitnu afilu leduchsusya muttar
Hechi dame ilema shemmachru vehotiru ki hitnu may have ella sheggavu vehotiru tama dehitnu ha lo hitnu la
Leolam shemmachru vehotiru vehachi kaamar bamma devarim amurim shello hitnu shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair aval hitnu shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair afilu leduchsusya name muttar
Amar leh abbaye lehahu merabbanan dahava mesaddar matneyata kammeh derav sheshet mi shemia lach merav sheshet may duchsusya amar leh hachi amar rav sheshet parasha demata
Amar abbaye hilkach hay tzurba merabbanan dishmia leh milta vela yada perusha lishayelah kammeh leman dishchiach kamme rabbanan dela efshar dela shemia leh min gavra rabba
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir bene hair shehalchu leir acheret ufasku alehen tzedaka notnin uchshehen bain meviin otah immahen umfarnesin bah aniyye iran
Tanya name hachi bene hair shehalchu leir acheret ufasku alehen tzedaka notnin uchshehen bain meviin otah immahen veyachid shehalach leir acheret ufasku alav tzedaka tinnaten laaniyye otah hair
Rav huna gezar taanita al legabbeh rav chana bar chanilay vechol bene mateh remo alayehu tzedaka vihavu ki bau lemete amaru leh nitvah lan mar venezil unfarnes bah anye matin
Amar lehu tenena bamma devarim amurim besheen sham
b: Chaver ir aval yesh sham chaver ir tinaten lachaver ir vechol shekken deanye didi vedidchu alay semichi
Matni en mochrin et shel rabbim leyachid mippene shemmoridin oto mikkedushshato divre rabbi meir amru lo im ken af lo meir gedola leir ketanna
Gema shappir kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi meir verabbi meir meir gedola leir ketanna meikara kaddisha hashta name kaddisha merabbim leyachid leka kedushsha
Verabbanan i ika lemechash ki hay gavena name ika lemechash mishshum berov am hadrat melech

Matni en mochrin bet hakkeneset ella al tenay sheim yirtzu yachziruhu divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim mochrin oto mimkar olam chutz mearbaa devarim lemerchatz ulvurseki litvila ulvet hammayim rabbi yehuda omer mochrin otah leshem chatzer vehallokeach ma sheyyirtze yaase
Gema ulrabbi meir hechi dayeri bah ha haveya lah ribbit
Amar rabbi yochanan rabbi meir beshitat rabbi yehuda amarah deamar tzad echad beribbit muttar
Detanya hare shehaya noshe bachavero mane veasa lo sadehu mecher bizman shemmocher ochel perot muttar lokeach ochel perot asur

Rabbi yehuda omer afilu lokeach ochel perot muttar veamar rabbi yehuda maase bevayetos ben zonin sheasa sadehu mecher al pi rabbi elazar ben azarya velokeach ochel perot haya amru lo mishsham reaya mocher ochel perot haya velo lokeach
May benayehu tzad echad beribbit ika benayehu mar savar tzad echad beribbit muttar umar savar tzad echad beribbit asur
Rava amar dechulle alma tzad echad beribbit asur vehacha ribbit al menat lehachazir ika benayehu mar savar ribbit al menat lehachazir muttar umar savar asur
Vachachamim omrim mochrin oto mimkar olam vechu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel muttar laadam lehashtin mayim betoch arba ammot shel tefilla

Amar rav yosef may ka mashma lan tenena rabbi yehuda omer mochrin otah leshum chatzer velokeach ma sheyyirtze yaase vaafilu rabbanan la kaamri ella bet hakkeneset dikvia kedushteh aval arba ammot dela kevia kedushtayehu la
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman hammitpallel marchik arba ammot umashtin vehammashtin marchik arba ammot umitpallel
Amar leh bishlama hammashtin marchik arba ammot umitpallel tenena kamma yarchik mehen umin hatztzoa arba ammot
Ella hammitpallel marchik arba ammot umashtin lema li i hachi kaddeshtinhu lechullehu shevile dinhardea teni yishhe

Bishlama mashtin yishhe kede hiluch arba ammot mishshum nitzotzot ella mitpallel yishhe kede hiluch arba ammot lema li amar rav ashe shekkol arba ammot tefillato sedura befiv verachoshe merachashan sifoteh
Zalfan siman

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi zakkay bamma heerachta yamim amar lahem miyyamay lo hishtanti mayim betoch arba ammot shel tefilla velo kinniti shem lachaveri velo bitalti kidush hayyom imma zekena hayeta li paam achat machra kippa shebberoshah vehevia li kidush hayyom
Tana keshemmeta hannicha lo shelosh meot garve yayin keshemmet hu hinniach levanav sheloshet alafim garve yayin
Rav huna hava asar rita vekae kammeh derav amar leh may hay amar leh la hava li kidusha umashkanteh lehemyanay veetay beh kidusha amar leh yehe raava detitum beshirae

Ki ikallal rabba bereh rav huna inish gutza hava gena appurya atyan benateh vechallateh shalchan veshadyan manayehu aleh ad deitum beshirae shema rav veikfad amar may tama la amarte li ki barechtach vechen lemar
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi elazar ben shammua bamma heerachta yamim amar lahem miyyamay lo asiti kappendarya levet hakkeneset velo pasati al rashe am kadosh velo nasati kappay belo beracha
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi perida bamma heerachta yamim amar lahem miyyamay lo kedamani adam levet hammidrash

a: Velo berachti lifne chohen velo achalti mibbehema shello hurmu mattenoteha

Deamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan asur leechol mibbehema shello hurmu mattenoteha veamar rabbi yitzchak kol haochel mibbehema shello hurmu mattenoteha keilu ochel tevalim velet hilcheta keoteh
Velo berachti lifne chohen

Lememra dimalleuta hi veha amar rabbi yochanan kol talmid chacham shemmevarech lefanav afilu kohen gadol am haaretz oto talmid chacham chayyav mita shenneemar kol mesanay ahavu mavet al tikre mesanay ella masniay
Ki kaamar ihu beshavin
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi nechunya ben hakkana bamme heerachta yamim amar lahem miyyamay lo nitkabbadti biklon chaveri velo alta al mittati killat chaveri uvatteran bemamoni hayiti
Lo nitkabbadti biklon chaveri ki ha derav huna dare mara akkatpeh ata rav chana bar chanilay veka dare mineh amar leh i regilatte dedaret bematach deri vei la ityakore ana beziluta didach la nicha li
Velo alta al mittati killat chaveri ki ha demar zutra ki hava salek lefuryeh amar shere leh lechol man detzaaran
Uvatteran bemamoni hayiti deamar mar iyyov vatran bemamoneh hava shehaya manniach peruta lachenvani mimmamoneh

Shaal rabbi akiva et rabbi nechunya haggadol amar lo bamme heerachta yamim ato gauoze veka machu leh selek yetev aresha dedikla amar leh rabbi im neemar keves lamma neemar echad amar lehu tzurba midderabbanan hu shivkuhu
Amar leh echad meuchad shebbeedro
Amar leh miyyamay lo kibbalti mattanot velo amadti al middotay uvatteran bemamoni hayiti

Lo kibbalti mattanot ki ha derabbi elazar ki hao meshadderi leh mattanot mibbe nesia la hava shakel ki hava mezammeni leh la hava azel amar lehu la nicha lechu deechye dichtiv sone mattanot yichye rabbi zera ki hao meshadderi leh mibbe nesia la hava shakel ki hava mezammeni leh azel amar ityakore demityakri bi
Velo amadti al middotay deamar rava kol hammaavir al middotav maavirin mimmennu kol peshaav shenneemar nose aon veover al pesha lemi nose aon lemi sheover al pesha

Shaal rabbi et rabbi yehoshua ben korcha bamma heerachta yamim amar lo katzta bechayyay amar lo rabbi tora hi velilmod ani tzarich amar lo miyyamay lo nistakkalti bidmut adam rasha deamar rabbi yochanan asur leadam lehistakkel betzelem demut adam rasha shenneemar lule pene yehoshafat melech yehuda ani nose im abbit elecha veim erekka
Rabbi elazar amar enav kehot shenneemar vayehi ki zaken yitzchak vattichhena enav merot mishshum deistakkal beesav harasha

Veha gerama leh vehaamar rabbi yitzchak leolam al tehi killat hedot kalla beenecha shehare avimelech killel et sara venitkayyem bezarah shenneemar hinne hu lach kesut enayim al tikre kesut ella kesiyyat enayim
Ha veha gerama leh rava amar mehacha seet pene rasha lo tov
Bishat petirato amar lo rabbi barcheni amar lo yehi ratzon shettaggia lachatzi yamay ulchullehu la amar lo habbaim acharecha behema yiru
Avuh bar ihi uminyamin bar ihi chad amar tete li dela istakkali begoy vechad amar tete li dela avadi shuttafut bahade goy

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi zera bamma heerachta yamim amar lahem miyyamay lo hikpadti betoch beti velo tzaadti bifne mi sheggadol mimmenni velo hirharti bimvoot hamtunnafot velo halachti arba ammot belo tora uvlo tefilin velo yashanti bevet hammidrash lo shenat keva velo shenat aray velo sasti betakkalat chaveri velo karati lachaveri bachanichato veamri lah bachachinato
Matni veod amar rabbi yehuda bet hakkeneset shecharav en maspidin betocho veen mafshilin betocho chavalim veen porsin letocho metzudot veen shotchin al gaggo perot veen osin oto kappendarya
Shenneemar vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem kedushshatan af keshehen shommin
Alu bo asavim lo yitlosh mippene ogmat nefesh
Gema tanu rabbanan batte chenesiyyot en nohagin bahen kallut rosh en ochlin bahen veen shotin bahen
b: Veen neotin bahem veen metayelin bahem veen nichnasin bahen bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim veen maspidin bahen hesped shel yachid aval korin bahen veshonin bahen umaspidin bahen hesped shel rabbim
Amar rabbi yehuda ematay beyishshuvan aval bechurbanan mannichin otan veolin bahen asavim velo yitlosh mippene ogmat nefesh

Asavim man dechar shemayehu chassore michassera vehachi katane umchabbedin otan umarbitzin otan kede shello yaalu bahen asavim amar rabbi yehuda ematay beyishshuvan aval bechurbanan mannichin otan laalot alu bahen asavim lo yitlosh mippene ogmat nefesh
Amar rav assi batte chenesiyyot shebbevavel al tenay hen asuyin veaf al pi chen en nohagin bahen kallut rosh umay nihu cheshbonot
Amar rav assi bet hakkeneset shemmechashshevin bo cheshbonot melinin bo et hammet melinin salka datach la saggi delav hachi ella lesof sheyyalinu bo met mitzva
Veen neotin bahen amar rava chachamim vetalmidehem muttarin deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may be rabbanan beta derabbanan

Veen nichnasin bahen bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim ki ha deravina verav adda bar matna hao kayemi veshaali sheelta merava ata zilcha demitra ayeli leve chenishta amri hay deayelinan leve chenishta lav mishshum mitra ella mishshum dishmata baaya tziluta keoma deistana

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe i itzterich leh leinish lemikre gavra mibbe chenishta may amar leh i tzurba merabbanan hu lema hilcheta vei tanna hu lema matnitin vei kara hu lema pesuka vei la lema leh leyanoka ema li pesukach i name nishhe purta venekum
Umaspidin bahen hesped shel rabbim hechi dame hespeda derabbim machve rav chisda kegon hespeda dekae beh rav sheshet machve rav sheshet kegon hespeda dekae beh rav chisda

Rafram aspedah lechalleteh beve chenishta amar mishshum yekara didi udmita atu kulleh alma rabbi zera safdeh lehahu merabbanan beve chenishta amar i mishshum yekara didi i mishshum yekara dideh demita atu kulle alma
Resh lakish safdeh lehahu tzurba merabbanan dishchiach beara deyisrael dahava tane hilchata beesrim vearba shurata amar vay chasra ara deyisrael gavra rabba
Hahu dahava tane hilcheta sifra vesifre vetosefta ushchev ato vaamaru leh lerav nachman lispedeh mar amar hechi nispedeh he tzanna dimle sifre dachasar
Ta chazi ma ben takkife deara deyisrael lachaside devavel
Tenan hatam udishtammash betaga chalef tane resh lakish ze hammishtammesh bemi sheshshone halachot kitrah shel tora

Veamar ulla lishtammash inish beman detane arbea vela lishtammash beman dematne arbea ki ha deresh lakish hava azel beorcha meta urkema demayya ata hahu gavra arkeveh akkatpeh veka meabbar leh amar leh keret amar leh karena tenet tanena arbaa sidre mishna amar leh pesalte lach arbea ture vetaanatte bar lakish akkatpach shedi bar lakisha bemayya
Amar leh nicha li daashammeeh lemar i hachi gemor mini ha milleta deamar rabbi zera benot yisrael hen hechemiru al atzman sheafilu root tipat dam kechardal yoshvot alav shiva nekiyyim
Tana deve eliyyahu kol hashshone halachot muvtach lo shehu ben olam habba shenneemar halichot olam lo al tikre halichot ella halachot
Tanu rabbanan

a: Mevattelin talmud tora lehotzaat hammet ulhachnasat hakkalla amru alav al rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay shehaya mevattel talmud tora lehotzaat hammet ulhachnasat hakkalla bamme devarim amurim besheen sham kol tzorko aval yesh sham kol tzorko en mevattelin

Vechamma kol tzorko amar rav shemuel bar inya mishshemeh derav teresar alfe gavre veshita alfe shipure veamri lah teresar alfe gavre uminayehu shita alfe shipure ulla amar kegon dechayetzi gavre meavulla ad sichra
Rav sheshet amar kintinatah kach netilatah ma netinatah beshishshim ribo af netilatah beshishshim ribo hane mile leman dekare vetane aval leman dematne let leh shiura

Tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer bo ure kamma chavivin yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu shebbechal makom sheggalu shechina immahen galu lemitzrayim shechina immahen shenneemar hanniglo nigleti levet avicha bihotam bemitzrayim vego galu levavel shechina immahen shenneemar lemaanchem shullachti vavela veaf keshehen atidin ligael shechina immahen shenneemar veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutcha veheshiv lo neemar ella veshav melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu shav immahen mibben haggaliyyot

Bevavel hecha amar abbaye beve kenishta dehutzal uvve kenishta deshaf vitev binhardea vela tema hacha vehacha ella zimnin hacha vezimnin hacha amar abbaye tete li dechi merachakna parsa ayelna umtzallena hatam avuh dishmuel velevi hao yatvi bichnishta deshaf vitev binhardea atay shechina shemau kol rigsha kamu unfaku

Rav sheshet hava yatev beve kenishta deshaf vitev binhardea atay shechina vela nefak ato malache hashsharet veka mevaatu leh amar lefanav ribbono shel olam aluv vesheeno aluv mi nidche mippene mi amar lehu shivkuhu
Vaehi lahem lemikdash meat amar rabbi yitzchak ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot shebbevavel verabbi elazar amar ze bet rabbenu shebbevavel

Daresh rava may dichtiv Adonai maon atta hayita lanu ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot amar abbaye meresh havay garesna beveta umtzallena beve chenishta kevan dishmait leha dekaamar david Adonai ahavti meon betecha havay garesna beve chenishta

Tanya rabbi elazar hakkappar omer atidin batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot shebbevavel sheyyikkavu beeretz yisrael shenneemar ki ketavor beharim uchcharmel bayyam yavo vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma tavor vecharmel shello bau ella lefi shaa lilmod tora nikbaim beeretz yisrael batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot shekkorin umarbitzin bahen tora al achat kamma vechamma

Daresh bar kappara may dichtiv lamma teratztzedun harim gavnunnim yatzta bat kol veamra lahem lamma tirtzu din im sinay kullechem baale mumim attem etzel sinay ketiv hacha gavnunim uchtiv hatam o gibben o dak amar rav ashe shema minah hay man dihir baal mum hu
En osin oto kappendarya may kappendarya amar rava kappendarya kishmah may kishmah keman deamar addemakkefna addare eul beha
Amar rabbi avahu im haya shevil meikara muttar

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hannichnas al menat shello laasot kappendarya muttar laasoto kappendarya veamar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna hannichnas levet hakkeneset lehitpallel muttar laasoto kappendarya shenneemar uvvo am haaretz lifne Adonai bammoadim habba derech shaar tzafon lehishtachaot yetze derech shaar negev
Alu bo asavim lo yitlosh mippene ogmat nefesh vehatanya eno tolesh umaachil aval tolesh umanniach ki tenan name matnitin tolesh umaachil tenan
Tanu rabbanan bet hakkevarot en nohagin bahen kallut rosh en marin bahen behema veen molichin bahen ammat hammayim veen melakketin bahen asavim veim liket sorfan bimkoman mippene kevod metim
Aheya ilema assefa kevan shessorfan bimkoman may kevod metim ika ella aresha
Matni rosh chodesh adar shechal lihot bashshabbat korin befarashat shekalim chal lihot betoch hashshabbat makdimin lesheavar umafsikin leshabbat acheret
Bashsheniyya zachor bashshelishit para adumma barviit hachodesh hazze lachem bachamishit chozrin lichsidran
Lakkol mafsikin berashe chodashim bachanukka uvfurim betaaniyyot uvmaamadot uvom hakkippurim
Gema tenan hatam beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim
b: Veal hakkilayim
Bishlama al hakkilayim dizman zeria hi ella al hashshekalim menalan
Amar rabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya deamar kera zot olat chodesh bechodsho amra tora chaddesh vehave korban mitteruma chadasha
Vechevan divnisan bae akrove mitteruma chadasha kadminan vekarenan beechad baadar ki hechi delayeto shekalim lammikdash

Keman dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel dei rabban shimon ben gamliel haamar shette shabbatot detanya shoalin behilchot happesach kodem lefesach sheloshim yom rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shette shabbatot
Afilu tema rabban shimon ben gamliel kevan deamar mar bachamishsha asar bo shulchanot yoshvin bammedina uvesrim vachamishsha yoshvin bammikdash mishshum shulchanot kadminan vekarenan
May parashat shekalim rav amar tzav et bene yisrael veamarta alehem et korbani lachmi ushmuel amar ki tissa
Bishlama leman deamar ki tissa hayenu dekare lah parashat shekalim dichtiv bah shekalim ella leman deamar et korbani lachmi hacha mide shekalim ketivi hatam in tama may kidrabbi tavi
Bishlama leman deamar tzav et bene yisrael mishshum dichtivi korbanot hatam kidrabbi tavi ella leman deamar ki tissa korbanot mi ketivi shekalim laadanim ketivi
Kidtane rav yosef shalosh terumot hen shel mizbeach lammizbeach veshel adanim laadanim veshel bedek habbayit levedek habbayit
Bishlama leman deamar ki tissa hayenu deshane hay rosh chodesh mishshear rashe chodashim
Ella leman deamar tzav et korbani may shane shane deilu rashe chodashim karu shita beinyana deoma vechad bidrosh chodesh veilu haidana kullehu bidrosh chodesh
Hanicha leman deamar leseder parashiyyot hu chozer
Ella leman deamar leseder haftarot hu chozer ufarashta deoma karenan may shane
Shane deilu rashe chodashim karu shita beinyana deoma vechad kare bidrosh chodesh veilu haidana karu telata beinyana deoma vearbea karu bidrosh chodesh

Metivi rosh chodesh adar shechal lihot bashshabbat korin befarashat shekalim umaftirin bihoyada hakkohen bishlama leman deamar ki tissa hayenu demaftirin bihoyada hakkohen dedame leh dichtiv kesef nafshot erko
Ella leman deamar et korbani lachmi mi dame dame kidrabbi tavi
Metivi chal lihot bapparasha hassemucha lah ben millefaneha uven milleachareha korin otah vechoflin otah
Bishlama leman deamar ki tissa hayenu demitreme behahu zimna
Ella leman deamar tzav et korbani mi mitreme behahu zimna in livne mareva demasseki lidorayeta bitlat shenin
Tanya keoteh dishmuel rosh chodesh adar shechal lihot beshabbat korin ki tissa umaftirin bihoyada hakkohen

Amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha rosh chodesh adar shechal lihot bashshabbat motziin shalosh torot vekorin bahen echad beinyano shel yom veechad beshel rosh chodesh veechad bechi tissa veamar rabbi yitzchak nappacha rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihot bashshabbat meviin shalosh torot vekorin bahen echad beinyano shel yom veechad bidrosh chodesh veechad bachanukka
Utzricha dei itmar beha beha kaamar rabbi yitzchak aval behach kerav sevira leh deamar parashat shekalim et korbani lachmi uvishte torot saggi ka mashma lan
Velema ha vela baaya hach chada mikkelal chavertah itmar
Itmar rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihot bachol amar rabbi yitzchak karu telata berosh chodesh vechad bachanukka verav dimi demin chefa amar karu telata bachanukka vechad berosh chodesh
Amar rabbi mani keoteh derabbi yitzchak nappacha mistabbera detadir vesheeno tadir tadir kodem
Amar rabbi avin keoteh derav dimi mistabbera mi garam larvii sheyyavo rosh chodesh hilkach revii berosh chodesh bae mikre
May have alah rav yosef amar en mashgichin berosh chodesh verabba amar en mashgichin bachanukka vehilcheta en mashgichin bachanukka verosh chodesh ikar
Itmar chal lihot biveatta tetzave amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha karu shita mivveatta tetzave ad ki tissa vechad mikki tissa ad veasita amar abbaye

a: Amri okome hu deka mokmi hatam
Ella amar abbaye karu shita mivveatta tetzave ad veasita vechad tane vekare mikki tissa ad veasita
Metivi chal lihot bapparasha hassemucha lah ben millefaneha ben milleachareha korin otah vechoflin otah
Bishlama leabbaye nicha ella lerabbi yitzchak nappacha kashya
Amar lach rabbi yitzchak nappacha ulabbaye mi nicha tinach lefaneha leachareha hechi mashkachatte lah
Ella may it lach lememar koflah beshabbatot hacha name koflah beshabbatot
Chal lihot bechi tissa atzmah amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha karu shita min veasita ad vayyakhel vechad kare mikki tissa ad veasita
Matkef lah abbaye hashta amri lemafrea hu dekare ella amar abbaye karu shita ad vayyakhel vechad tane vekare mikki tissa ad veasita
Tanya keoteh deabbaye chal lihot bechi tissa atzmah korin otah vechoflin otah
Chal lihot betoch hashshabbat makdimin lashshabbat sheavra itmar rosh chodesh adar shechal lihot beerev shabbat rav amar makdimin ushmuel amar meacharin
Rav amar makdimin deim ken batzri lehu yome shulchanot ushmuel amar meacharin amar lach sof sof chamesar bemaale shabbeta mikla veshulchanot la nafki ad chad beshabba hilkach meacharin
Tenan chal lihot betoch hashshabbat makdimin lesheavar umafsikin leshabbat acheret may lav afilu beerev shabbat lo betoch hashshabbat daveka
