Ta shema ezo hi shabbat rishona kol shechal rosh chodesh adar lihot betochah vaafilu beerev shabbat may lav afilu beerev shabbat dumya detochah ma tochah makdimin af erev shabbat makdimin
Amar shemuel bah vechen tana deve shemuel bah

Ketannae mesargin leshabbatot divre rabbi yehuda hannasi rabbi shimon ben elazar omer en mesargin amar rabbi shimon ben elazar ematay ani omer en mesargin bizman shechal lihot beerev shabbat aval bizman shechal lihot betoch hashshabbat makdim vekore mishshabbat sheavra af al pi shehu shevat
Bishniyya zachor vechu itmar purim shechal lihot beerev shabbat rav amar makdimin parashat zachor ushmuel amar meacharin
Rav amar makdimin ki hechi dela tikdom asiyya lizchira ushmuel amar meacharin amar lach kevan deika mukkafin deavdi bachamesar asiyya uzchira bahade hadade ka atyan
Tenan bashsheniyya zachor veha ki mikla resh yarcha beshabbat mikla purim beerev shabbat vekatane bashsheniyya zachor amar rav pappa may sheniyya sheniyya lehafsaka
Ta shema ezo shabbat sheniyya kol shechal purim lihot betochah vaafilu beerev shabbat may lav erev shabbat dumya detochah ma tochah makdimin af erev shabbat makdimin
Amar shemuel bah vechen tana deve shemuel bah

Chal lihot beshabbat atzmah amar rav huna ledivre hakkol en makdimin verav nachman amar adayin hi machloket itmar name amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi abba amar rav purim shechal lihot beshabbat makdim vekore bashshabbat sheavra zachor
Bashshelishit para adumma vechu tanu rabbanan ezo hi shabbat shelishit kol shessemucha lefurim meachareha itmar rabbi chama berabbi chanina amar shabbat hassemucha lerosh chodesh nisan
Vela peligi ha deikla rosh chodesh nisan beshabbat ha deikla beemtza shabbat

Barviit hachodesh hazze lachem tanu rabbanan rosh chodesh adar shechal lihot bashshabbat korin ki tissa umaftirin bihoyada vei zo hi shabbat rishona kol shechal rosh chodesh adar lihot betochah vaafilu beerev shabbat bashsheniyya zachor umaftirin pakadti vei zo hi shabbat sheniyya kol shechal purim lihot betochah vaafilu beerev shabbat
Bashshelishit para adumma umaftirin vezarakti alechem vee zo hi shabbat shelishit kol shessemucha lefurim meachareha barviit hachodesh hazze umaftirin ko amar elohim barishon beechad lachodesh
b: Veezo hi shabbat reviit kol shechal rosh chodesh nisan lihot betochah vaafilu beerev shabbat
Bachamishit chozrin lichsidran vechu leseder may rabbi amme amar leseder parashiyyot hu chozer rabbi yirmeya amar leseder haftarot hu chozer
Amar abbaye keoteh derabbi amme mistabbera ditnan lakkol mafsikin lerashe chodashim lachanukka ulfurim letaaniyyot ulmaamadot ulom hakkippurim
Bishlama leman deamar leseder parashiyyot hu chozer hayenu deika parasha bechol ella leman deamar leseder haftarot hu chozer haftara bechol mi ika
Veidach ha kidita veha kidita
Uvtaaniyyot lema li hafsaka likre mitztzafra beinyana deoma uvmincha betaanita mesayya leh lerav huna deamar rav huna mitztzafra kinufya

Hechi avdinan amar abbaye mitztzafra lefalgeh deoma meayeninan bemile demata mippalgeh deoma lefanya riva deoma karu umafteri veriva deoma bau rachame shenneemar vayyikreu besefer torat Adonai elohehem reviit hayyom urviit hayyom mitvadim umishtachavim
Veefoch ana la salka datach dichtiv veelay yeasfu kol chared bedivre elohe yisrael al maal haggola vaani yoshev meshomem ad leminchat haarev uchtiv uvminchat haerev kamti mittaaniti

Matni bappesach korin befarashat moadot shel torat kohanim baatzeret shiva shavuot berosh hashshana bachodesh hashshevii beechad lachodesh beom hakkippurim achare mot beom tov harishon shel chag korin befarashat moadot shebbetorat kohanim uvishar kol yemot hachag bekorbenot hachag
Bachanukka bannesiim bappurim vayyavo amalek berashe chodashim uvrashe chodshechem bemaamadot bemaase vereshit betaaniyyot

a: Berachot uklalot en mafsikin biklalot ella echad kore et kullan
Besheni uvachamishi bashshabbat bammincha korin kesidran veen olim lahem min hacheshbon
Shenneemar vayedabber moshe et moade Adonai el bene yisrael mitzvatan sheyehu korin kol echad veechad bizmanno
Gema tanu rabbanan befesach korin befarashat moadot umaftirin befesach gilgal vehaidana deika tere yome yoma kamma befesach gilgal ulmachar befesach yoshiyyahu
Ushar yemot happesach melakket vekore meinyano shel pesach may hi amar rav pappa meappo siman
Yom tov haacharon shel pesach korin vayehi beshallach umaftirin vayedabber david ulmachar kol habbechor umaftirin od hayyom
Amar abbaye vehaidana nehug alma lemikre meshach tora kaddesh bechaspa pesal bemadbera shallach buchra
Baatzeret shiva shavuot umaftirin bachavakkuk acherim omrim bachodesh hashshelishi umaftirin bammerkava vehaidana deika tere yome avdinan ketarvayehu veifka
Berosh hashshana bachodesh hashshevii umaftirin haven yakkir li efrayim veyesh omrim va pakad et sara umaftirin bechanna
Vehaidana deika tere yome yoma kamma keyesh omrim limchar vehaelohim nissa et avraham umaftirin haven yakkir
Beom hakkippurim korin achare mot umaftirin ki cho amar ram venissa uvammincha korin baaraot umaftirin beona
Amar rabbi yochanan kol makom sheatta motze gevurato shel hakkadosh baruch hu atta motze invetanuto davar ze katuv battora veshanuy banneviim umshullash bakketuvim

Katuv battora ki Adonai elohechem hu elohe haelohim vaadone haadonim uchtiv batreh ose mishpat yatom vealmana shanuy banneviim cho amar ram venissa shochen ad vekadosh vego uchtiv batreh veet dakka ushfal ruach meshullash bakketuvim dichtiv sollu larochev baaravot beyah shemo uchtiv batreh avi yetomim vedayyan almanot

Yom tov harishon shel chag korin befarashat moadot shebbetorat kohanim umaftirin hinne yom ba la vehaidana deika tere yome limchar mikra hachi name karenan aftore may maftirin vayyikkahalu el hammelech shelomo

Ushar kol yemot hachag korin bekorbenot hechag yom tov haacharon korin kol habbechor mitzot vechukkim uvchor umaftirin vayehi kechallot shelomo lemachar korin vezot habberacha umaftirin vayyaamod shelomo
Amar rav huna amar rav shabbat shechal lihot bechullo shel moed ben bappesach ben bassukkot mikra karenan ree atta aftore bappesach haatzamot hayeveshot uvassukkot beom bo gog
Bachanukka bannesiim umaftirin benerot dizcharya vei mikali shette shabbatot kammayeta benerot dizcharya batrayeta benerot shelomo

Bappurim vayyavo amalek berashe chodashim uvrashe chodshechem rosh chodesh shechal lihot beshabbat maftirin vehaya midde chodesh bechodsho chal lihot beechad bashshabbat meetmol maftirin vayyomer lo yehonatan machar chodesh
Amar rav huna
b: Rosh chodesh av shechal lihot beshabbat maftirin chodshechem umoadechem sana nafshi hau alay latorach may hau alay latorach amar hakkadosh baruch hu lo dayyan lahem leyisrael shechotin lefanay ella shemmatrichin oti leda ezo gezera kasha avi alehem

Veella may besheyyachid tzarich lahem dichotah gabbe rabbim besherabbim tzerichin lahem chafira mi asir vehatanya borot shichin umarot shel yachid konsin mayim letochan vechottin otan aval lo shafin et sidkehen velo chottin letochan velo sadin otan besid veshel rabbim chofrin otan vesadin otan besid
Ella kashya hach kammayeta taretz hachi chottin borot shel yachid besheyyachid tzarich lahem veen tzarich lomar beshel rabbim kesherabbim tzerichin lahem daafilu chafira muttar
Veen chofrin borot shichin umarot shel rabbim besheen rabbim tzerichin lahem veen tzarich lomar shel yachid dechi en yachid tzarich lahem afilu chatita name asur
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane osin kol tzorche rabbim kol leetoye may lav leetoye chafira
La leetoye ha detanya yotzin lekavetz et hadderachim ultakken et harchovot veet haisterataot velamod et hammikvaot vechol mikve sheen bo arbaim sea margilin letocho arbaim sea
Uminnayin sheim lo yatzu veasu kol ellu shekkol damim shennishpechu sham maale alehem hakkatuv keilu hem shefachum talmud lomar vehaya alecha damim
Ha behedya katane lah umtakkenin et hadderachim veet harchovot veet hammikvaot veosin kol tzorche rabbim leetoye may lav leetoye chafira shema minah
Metzayenin et hakkevarot amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi remez letziyyun kevarot min hattora minnayin talmud lomar veraa etzem adam uvana etzlo tziyyun

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ha mikkamme delete yechezkel man amar velitamach ha deamar rav chisda davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu middivre yechezkel ben buzi lamadnu kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi lesharteni
Mikkamme delete yechezkel man amar ella gemara gemiri lah vaata yechezkel veasmechah akkera hacha name gemara gemiri lah vaata yechezkel veasmechah akkera
Rabbi avahu amar mehacha vetame tame yikra tuma kora lo veomeret lo perosh vechen amar rabbi uzziel bar bereh derabbi uzziel rabba tuma korah lo veomeret lo perosh
Vehay lehachi hu daata hahu mibe leh lechidtanya vetame tame yikra tzarich lehodia tzaaro lerabbim verabbim mevakkeshin alav rachamim
Im ken lichtov vetame yikra may vetame tame shamatte minah tarte
Abbaye amar mehacha velifne iver lo titten michshol rav pappa amar veamar sollu sollu pannu darech
Rav chinana amar harimu michshol midderech ammi rabbi yehoshua bereh derav idi amar vehodata lahem et hadderech asher yelchu vah
Mar zutra amar vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumatam rav ashe amar ushmartem et mishmarti asu mishmeret lemishmarti
Ravina amar vesam derech arennu beyesha elohim
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol hashsham orchotav zoche veroe bishuato shel hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar vesam derech al tikre vesam ella vesham derech arennu beyesha elohim
Rabbi yannay hava leh hahu talmida dechol yoma hava makshe leh beshabbeta derigla la hava makshe leh
b: Kare aleh vesam derech arennu beyesha elohim
Tanu rabbanan en metzayenin lo al kazzayit min hammet velo al etzem kisora velo al davar sheeno metamme beohel aval metzayenin al hashshidra veal haggulgolet al rov binyan veal rov minyan hammet

Veen metzayenin al havadaot aval metzayenin al hassefekot veellu hen hassefekot sechachot ufraot uvet happeras veen maamidin tziyyun bimkom tuma shello lehafsid et hatteharot veen marchikin tziyyun mimmekom tuma shello lehafsid et eretz yisrael
Uchzayit min hammet eno metamme beohel veha tenan ellu shemmetammein beohel kezayit min hammet
Amar rav pappa hacha bichzayit metzumtzam askinan desof sof michsar chasar mutav yissarfu alav teruma vekodashim lefi shaa veal yissarfu alav leolam
Veellu hen hassefekot sechachot ufraot
Sechachot ilan hammesech al haaretz
Peraot avanim peruot hayyotzot min haggader
Bet happeras keditnan hachoresh et hakkever hare hu ose bet happeras vechamma hu ose melo maane mea amma
Uvet happeras mi metamme beohel vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel menappeach adam bet happeras veholech
Verav yehuda bar amme mishshemeh deulla amar bet happeras shennidash tahor
Amar rav pappa la kashya kan besade sheavad bah kever kan besade shennechrash bah kever
Vesade shennechrash bah kever bet happeras kare leh in vehatnan shelosha bet happeras hen sade shenneevad bah kever vesade shennechrash bah kever usde vochin
May sede vochin rav yehoshua bar abba mishshemeh deulla amar sade shemmaftirin bah metim
Vetama may amar avimi mishshum yeush bealim nagu bah
Usde shennechrash bah kever la bae tziyyun veha tanya matza sade metzuyyenet veen yadua ma tivah yesh bah ilanot beyadua shennechrash bah kever en bah ilanot beyadua sheavad bah kever
Rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyehe sham zaken o talmid lefi sheen hakkol bekiin baddavar
Amar rav pappa ki tanya hahi besade sheavad bah kever detzayenuha yesh bah ilanot beyadua shennechrash bah kever en bah ilanot beyadua sheavad bah kever
Velechush dilma ilanot miggavay vekever mibbaray
Kidamar ulla beomdin al haggevulin hacha name beomdin al haggevulin

a: Vedilma tuma miggavay veilanot mibbaray
Bimsubbachin veibaet ema ha amaran en marchikin tziyyun mimmekom tuma shello lehafsid et eretz yisrael
Rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyehe sham zaken o talmid lefi sheen hakkol bekiin baddavar amar abbaye shema minah tzurba merabbanan deika bemata kol mile demata aleh ramya
Amar rav yehuda matza even metzuyyenet tachteha tame shettayim im yesh sid benehen benehen tame veim en sid benehen benehen tahor
Veaf al gav deleka choresh vehatanya matza even achat metzuyyenet tachteha tame shettayim im yesh choresh benehen benehen tahor veim lav benehen tame
Amar rav pappa hacha keshehassid shafuch al rashehen umrudde lechan ulchan i ika choresh benehen benehen tahor deemor mechamat choresh hu deikfal vei la sid devene bene hu vetame

Amar rabbi assi metzer echad metzuyyan hu tame vechol hassade kullah tehora shenayim hem temein vechol hassade kullah tehora shelosha hem temein vechol hassade kullah tehora arbaa hen tehorin vechol hassade kullah temea
Deamar mar en marchikin tziyyun mimmekom tuma shello lehafsid et eretz yisrael
Veotzin af al hakkilayim
Veakkilayim bechullo shel moed nafkinan urminhu beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim veal hakkilayim
Bachamishsha asar bo korin et hammegila bakkerakkim veotzin lekavetz et hadderachim ultakken harchovot velamod hammikvaot veosin kol tzorche rabbim umtzayenin et hakkevarot veotzin al hakkilayim
Rabbi elazar verabbi yose bar chanina chad amar kan bevakkir kan beafil vechad amar kan bizraim kan birakot
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella sheen nitzan nikar aval nitzan nikar yotzin alehen
May shena bechullo shel moed denafkinan amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan mishshum sechar peula demozli gabban

Amar rav zevid veitema rav mesharsheya shema minah ki yahavinan lehu sachar mitterumat hallishka yahavinan lehu dei salka datach middidhu yahavinan lehu may nafka lan minayehu kol kamma devau liten lehu
Vead kamma amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak keotah sheshshaninu kol sea sheyyesh bah
b: Rova zera mimmin acher yemaet
Vehatanya hitkinu sheyehu mafkirin kol hassade kullah la kashya kan kodem takkana kan leachar takkana
Detanya barishona hau okrin umashlichin lifne behemtan vehau baale battim semechin shette semachot achat shemmenakkeshin lahem sedotehen veachat shemmashlichin lifne behemtam
Hitkinu sheyehu okrin umashlichin al hadderachim vaadayin hau semechin simcha gedola shemmenakkeshin sedotehen hitkinu sheyehu mafkirin kol hassade kullah
Matni rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer moshchin et hammayim meilan leilan uvilvad shello yashke et kol hassade zeraim shello shatu lifne hammoed la yashkem bammoed vachachamim mattirin baze uvaze

Gema amar rav yehuda im hayeta sade metunnenet muttar tanya name hachi kesheamru asur lehashkotan bammoed lo amru ella bizraim shello shatu millifne hammoed aval zeraim sheshshatu lifne hammoed muttar lehashkotan bammoed
Veim hayeta sade metunnenet muttar veen mashkin sede garid bammoed vachachamim mattirin baze uvaze
Amar ravina shema minah hay tarbitza shere letarbotze bechulla demoada sede garid may tama deafla meshave lah charfa hacha name afla meshave lah charfa
Tanu rabbanan marbitzin sede lavan bashsheviit aval lo bammoed
Veha tanya marbitzin ben bammoed ben bashsheviit amar rav huna la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ben yaakov ha rabbanan
Tanya idach marbitzin sede lavan erev sheviit kede sheyyetzu yerakot bashsheviit velo od ella shemmarbitzin sede lavan bashsheviit kede sheyyetzu yerakot lemotzae sheviit
Matni tzadin et haishut veet haachbarim missede hailan umissede hallavan kedarko bammoed uvishviit vachachamim omrim missede hailan kedarko umissede hallavan shello kedarko
Umkarin et happirtza bammoed uvashsheviit bone kedarko
Gema may ishut amar rav yehuda beriyya sheen lah enayim amar rava bar yishmael veitema rav yemar bar shelemya may kera kemo shabbelul temes yahaloch nefel eshet bal chazu shamesh

Tanu rabbanan tzadin et haishut veet haachbarim missede hallavan umissede hailan kedarko umachrivin chore nemalim ketzad machrivin rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mevi afar mechor ze venoten letoch chor ze vehen chonkin ze et ze
Amar rav yemar bar shelemya mishshemeh deabbaye vehu dekae bitre evre nahara vehu deleka gishra vehu deleka gamla vehu deleka mitzra

a: Ad kamma ad parsa

Rabbi yehuda omer missede hailan kedarko umissede hallavan shello kedarko tanu rabbanan ketzad kedarko chofer gumma vetole bah metzuda ketzad shello kedarko noetz shappud umakke bekurdom umradde haadama mittachteha

Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer kesheamru missede lavan shello kedarko lo amru ella bisde lavan hassemucha lair aval bisde lavan hassemucha lisde hailan afilu kedarko shemma yetzu missede hallavan veyachrivu et hailanot
Umkarin et happirtza bammoed ketzad mekarin rav yosef amar behutza vedafna
Bematnita tana tzar bitzror veeno tach betit amar rav chisda lo shanu ella kotel haggina aval kotel hechatzer bone kedarko
Lema mesayya leh kotel haggoche lirshut harabbim soter uvone kedarko mippene hassakkana hatam kidkatane tama mippene hassakkana
Veika deamri ta shema kotel haggoche lirshut harabbim soter uvone kedarko mippene hassakkana mippene hassakkana in shello mippene hassakkana la lema tehve teuvteh derav chisda
Amar lecha rav chisda hatam soter uvone hacha bone velo soter
Hatam name listor vela livne im ken mimna vela sotar
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane uvashsheviit bone kedarko
Dehecha ilema dechatzer tzericha lememar ella lav degina veaf al gav demichaze keman deaved netiruta lefere shema minah
Matni rabbi meir omer roin et hannegaim battechila lehakel aval lo lehachmir vachachamim omrim lo lehakel velo lehachmir
Gema tanya rabbi meir omer roin et hannegaim lehakel aval lo lehachmir rabbi yose omer lo lehakel velo lehachmir sheim atta nizkak lo lehakel atta nizkak lo af lehachmir
Amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi meir bemusgar vedivre rabbi yose bemuchlat
Amar rava betahor kulle alma la peligi dela chazu leh behesger rishon dechulle alma la peligi dechaze leh ki peligi
b: Behesger sheni mar savar bechohen talya milta i tahor amar leh tahor vei tame shatek umar savar letaharo o letammeo ketiv
Amar mar amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yose bemuchlat vedivre rabbi meir bemusgar vehatanya ipcha
Tannae hi alliba derabbi mar savar tzaveta dealma adif leh
Umar savar tzaveta deishto adifa leh

Lememra demuchlat muttar betashmish hammitta in vehatanya veyashav michutz leoholo shivat yamim sheyehe asur betashmish hammitta veen oholo ella ishto shenneemar lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem rabbi yehuda omer shivat yamim yisperu lo yeme sefiro velo yeme chilluto
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer shiva yeme sefiro kal vachomer lime chilluto
Veamar rabbi chiyya danti lifne rabbi limadtanu rabbenu yotam lo haya lo leuzziyyahu ella bime chilluto amar lo af ani kach amarti
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar galli rachamana bime sefiro vechol shekken bime chilluto umar savar may degalli galli umay dela galli la galli
Lememra divchohen talya milta in vehatanya uvom heraot bo yesh yom sheatta roe bo veyesh yom shei atta roe bo
Mikkan amru chatan shennolad bo nega notnin lo shiva yeme hammishte lo ulveto velichsuto vechen baregel notnin lo shivat yeme haregel divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi omer eno tzarich hare hu omer vetziva hakkohen ufinnu et habbayit im mamtinim lo lidvar harshut kol shekken lidvar mitzva
May benayehu amar abbaye mashmaut dorshin ika benayehu verava amar devar harshut ika benayehu
Verabbi yehuda mehatam la gamrinan dechidush hu

a: Deha etzim vaavanim bealma la mittammeu vehacha mittammeu
Verabbi amar itzterich dei ketav rachamana uvom heraot bo have amena lidvar mitzva in lidvar harshut la ketav rachamana vetziva hakkohen
Vei ketav rachamana vetziva hakkohen hava amena hane in delav tuma degufeh aval tuma degufeh ema michza chazya leh tzericha
Amar mar yesh yom sheatta roe bo veyesh yom shei atta roe bo
May mashma amar abbaye im ken lichtov rachamana beom may uvom shema minah yesh yom sheatta roe bo veyesh yom shei atta roe bo
Rava amar kullah kera yattira hu deim ken lichtov rachamana uvheraot may uvom shema minah yesh yom sheatta roe bo veyesh yom shei atta roe bo
Veabbaye hahu mibe leh bayyom velo ballayela
Verava bayyom velo ballayela mena leh nafka leh millechol mare ene hakkohen veabbaye hahu mibe leh lemaote some beachat meenav
Verava name mibe leh lehachi in hachi name
Veella bayyom velo ballayela mena leh nafka leh mikkenega nira li babbayit li velo leori
Veabbaye i mehatam hava amena hane mile tuma delav degufeh aval tuma degufeh afilu leoro name ka mashma lan
Matni veod amar rabbi meir melakket adam atzmot aviv veimmo mippene shessimcha hi lo
Rabbi yose omer evel hu lo
Lo yeorer adam al meto velo yaspidennu kodem laregel sheloshim yom
Gema urminhu hamlakket atzmot aviv veimmo hare ze mitabbel alehem kol hayyom velaerev en mitabbel alehen veamar rav chisda afilu tzerurin lo bisdino
Amar abbaye ema mippene shessimchat haregel alav
Velo yearer al meto may lo yearer al meto amar rav kad hadar safdana bemareva amri yivkon immeh kal merire liba
Kodem haregel sheloshim yom may shena sheloshim yom

Amar rav kahana amar rav yehuda amar rav maase beadam echad shekkines maot laalot laregel uva safdan veamad al petach beto untalatan ishto untanatan lo venimna velo ala beotah shaa amru lo yeorer al meto velo yaspidennu kodem laregel sheloshim yom
Ushmuel amar
b: Lefi sheen hammet mishtakkeach min hallev sheloshim yom may benayehu ika benayehu dekaaved bechinnam
Matni en chofrin kuchin ukvarot bammoed aval mechannechin et hakkuchin bammoed veosin nivrechet bammoed vearon im hammet bechatzer rabbi yehuda oser ella im ken yesh immo nesarim
Gema may kuchin umay kevarot amar rav yehuda kuchin bachafira ukvarot bevinyan tanya name hachi ellu hen kuchin veellu hen kevarot kuchin bachafira ukvarot bevinyan
Aval mechannechin et hakkuchin ketzad mechannechin amar rav yehuda sheim haya aroch mekatztzero bematnita tana maarich bo umarchiv bo
Veosin nivrechet ku may nivrechet amar rav yehuda zo bakia vehatanya hannivrechet vehabbakia amar abbaye veitema rav kahana giha uvar giha

Vearon im hammet bechatzer tenena leha detanu rabbanan osin kol tzorche hammet gozzin lo searo umchabbesin lo kesuto veosin lo aron minnesarin hamnussarin meerev yom tov rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af meviin etzim umnasseran betzina betoch beto
Matni en nosin nashim bammoed lo betulot velo almanot velo meyabmin mippene shessimcha hi lo aval machzir hu et gerushato
Veosa ishsha tachshiteha bammoed rabbi yehuda omer lo tasud mippene shenniuul hu lah hahedot tofer kedarko vehaumman machliv umsargin et hammittot rabbi yose omer memattechin

Gema vechi simcha hi lo may have amar rav yehuda amar shemuel vechen amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya veamri lah amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina lefi sheen mearvin simcha besimcha rabba bar rav huna amar mippene shemmanniach simchat haregel veosek besimchat ishto
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef ha derabba bar rav huna derav hu deamar rav daniel bar kattina amar rav minnayin sheen nosin nashim bammoed shenneemar vesamachta bechaggecha bechaggecha velo beishtecha
Ulla amar mippene hattorach rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar mippene bitul periyya urviyya
Metivi kol ellu sheamru asurin lisa bammoed

a: Muttarin lisa erev haregel kashya lechullehu
La kashya leman deamar mishshum simcha ikar simcha chad yoma hu
Leman deamar mishshum tircha ikar tircha chad yoma hu leman deamar mishshum bitul periyya urviyya lechad yoma la mashhe inish nafsheh

Uden mearvin simcha besimcha menalan dichtiv vayyaas shelomo vaet hahi et hechag vechol yisrael immo kahal gadol millevo chamat ad nachal mitzrayim lifne Adonai elohenu shivat yamim veshivat yamim arbaa asar yom veim ita dimarvin simcha besimcha ibi leh lemintar ad hechag umibad shiva lehacha ulhacha
Vedilma mintar la natrinan vehecha deitremi avdinan ibi leh leshayyore purta
Shayyore binyan bet hammikdash la meshayerinan ibi leh leshayyore beamma kalya orev
Amma kalya orev tzorech binyan habbayit hu ella middimyatar kera mikkede ketiv arbea asar yom shivat yamim veshivat yamim lema li shema minah hane lechod vehane lechod

Amar rabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan otah shana lo asu yisrael et yom hakkippurim vehau doagim veomrim shemma nitchayevu sonehen shel yisrael kelaya yatzta bat kol veamra lahem kullechem mezummanin lechayye haolam habba

May derush amru kal vachomer uma mishkan sheen kedushshato kedushshat olam vekorban yachid doche shabbat deisur sekila mikdash dikdushshato kedushshat olam vekorban tzibbur veom hakkippurim deanush karet lo kol shekken
Ella ammay hau doagim hatam tzorech gavoha hacha tzorech hedot hacha name mebad libedu mechal la nechlu vela lishto en simcha belo achila ushtiyya

Umishkan dedache shabbat menalan ilema middichtiv bayyom harishon uvayyom hashshevii dilma shevii lekorbanot amar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar kera beom ashte asar yom ma yom kullo ratzuf af ashte asar kullan retzufin
Vedilma yamim haruyin ketiv kera acharina beom shenem asar yom ma yom kullo ratzuf af shenem asar yom kullan retzufin
Vedilma hacha name yamim haruyin im ken tere kerae lema li
Umikdash dedoche yom hakkippurim menalan ilema middichtiv arbaa asar yom vedilma yamim haruyin gamar yom yom mehatam

Yatzta bat kol veamra lahem kullechem mezummanin lechayye haolam habba umnalan deachel lehu detane tachlifa bayyom hashshemini shillach et haam vayevarchu et hammelech vayyelchu leoholehem semechim vetove lev al kol hattova asher asa Adonai ledavid avdo ulyisrael ammo

Leoholehem shehalchu umatzu nashehem betahora semechim shennehenu mizziv hashshechina vetove lev shekkol echad veechad nitabbera ishto beven zachar al kol hattova sheyyatzta bat kol veamra lahem kullechem mezummanin lechayye haolam habba
Ledavid avdo ulyisrael ammo bishlama leyisrael ammo deachel lehu aon yom hakkippurim ella ledavid avdo may hi
Amar rav yehuda amar rav beshaa shebbikesh shelomo lehachnis aron lammikdash davku shearim ze laze amar shelomo esrim vearba renanot velo naana patach veamar seu shearim rashechem vego velo naana

Kevan sheamar Adonai elohim al tashev pene meshichecha zochra lechasde david avdecha miyyad naana beotah shaa nehpechu pene sone david keshule kedera veyadu hakkol shemmachal lo hakkadosh baruch hu al oto aon
Rabbi yonatan ben asmay verabbi yehuda ben gerim tanu parashat nedarim be rabbi shimon ben yochay iptur mineh beurta letzafra hadur veka mippatri mineh amar lehu velav ipatritu minay beurta

Amaru leh limmadtanu rabbenu talmid shenniftar merabbo velan beotah hair tzarich lipater mimmennu paam acheret shenneemar bayyom hashshemini shillach et haam vayevarachu et hammelech uchtiv uvom esrim ushlosha lachodesh hashshevii shillach et haam
Ella mikkan letalmid hanniftar merabbo velan beotah hair tzarich lipater mimmennu paam acheret

Amar leh livreh bene adam hallalu anashim shel tzura hem zil gabbehon delivarchuch azal ashkechinhu deka ramu kerae ahadade ketiv palles magal raglecha vechol derachecha yikkonu uchtiv orach chayyim pen tefalles
La kashya kan bemitzva sheefshar laasotah al yede acherim
b: Kan bemitzva shei efshar laasotah al yede acherim
Hadar yatvi veka mibbee lehu ketiv yekara hi mippeninim vechol chafatzecha lo yishu vah ha cheftze shamayim yishu vah uchtiv kol chafatzim lo yishu vah daafilu cheftze shamayim lo yishu vah
Kan bemitzva sheefshar laasotah al yede acherim kan bemitzva shei efshar laasotah al yede acherim

Amaru leh may baet hacha amar lehu daamar li abba zil gabbayehu delivarchuch amaru leh yehe raava detizra vela techtzad teayyel vela tapek tapek vela teayyel lichrov betach velitov ushpizach libbalbal paturach vela tichze shatta chadta

Ki ata legabbe avuh amar leh la mibbaya devaroche la barchun aval tzaore tzaarun amar leh may amaru lach hachi vehachi amaru li amar leh hanach kullehu birchata ninhu tizra vela techtzad tolid banim vela yemutu teayyel vela tapek teayyel kalleta vela lemutu benach delipkun tapek vela teayyel tolid benata vela yemutu guvrayehu velihderu levatach
Lichrov betach velitov ushpizach dehay alma ushpizach vehahu alma beta dichtiv kirbam battemo leolam al tikre kirbam ella kivram
Libbalbal paturach bivne uvnata vela tichze shatta chadta dela temut ittetach vela tinsav inteta achariti

Rabbi shimon ben chalafta ippetar mineh derav amar leh avuh zil legabbeh delivarchach amar leh yehe raava dela tevayyesh vela titbayyash ata gabbe avuh amar leh may amar lach amar leh milin bealma hu deamar li

Amar leh barchach birketa deverchan kudsha berich hu leyisrael utna bah dichtiv vaachaltem achol vesavoa vehillaltem vego velo yevoshu ammi leolam vidatem ki vekerev yisrael ani vego velo yevoshu ammi leolam
Veosa ishsha tachshiteha tanu rabbanan ellu hen tachshite nashim kochelet ufokeset umaavira serak al paneha veika deamri maaveret serak al paneha shel matta
Devethu derav chisda mikkashsheta beanpe kalletah yatev rav huna bar chinana kammeh derav chisda veyatev vekaamar lo shanu ella yalda aval zekena lo
Amar leh haelohim afilu immacha vaafilu ima deimach vaafilu omedet al kivrah deamri inashe bat shitin kevat shet lekal tavla rahata

Rabbi yehuda omer lo tasud tanya rabbi yehuda omer ishsha lo tasud mippene shenniuul hu lah umode rabbi yehuda besid sheyechola lekappelo bammoed shettofalto bammoed sheaf al pi shemmetzera hi achshav semecha hi leachar zeman
Umi it leh lerabbi yehuda hay sevara vehatnan
Rabbi yehuda omer nifrain mehen mippene shemmetzer amru lo af al pi shemmetzer achshav sameach hu leachar zeman
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hannach lehilchot moed dechullehu metzer achshav vesameach leachar zeman ninhu
Ravina amar goy leinyan peraon leolam metzer

Amar rav yehuda benot yisrael shehiggiu lefirkan velo higgiu leshanim aniyyot toflot otan besid ashirot toflot otan besolet benot melachim beshemen hammor shenneemar shishsha chodashim beshemen hammor
May shemen hammor rav huna bar chiyya amar setachat rav yirmeya bar amme amar shemen zayit shello hevi shelish
Tanya rabbi yehuda omer anpikinun shemen zayit shello hevi shelish velamma sachin oto shemmashshir et hassear umadden et habbasar

Rav bivi hava leh beratta taflah ever ever shekal bah arba mea zuze hava hahu goy beshivavuteh dahava leh beratta taflah bechad zimna umita amar katlah bivi livratti amar rav nachman rav bivi deshate shichra baayan benateh tifla anan dela shatenan shichra la baayan benatin tifla

a: Hahedot tofer kedarko hechi dame hedot amri deve rabbi yannay kol sheeno yachol lehotzi melo machat bevat achat rabbi yose bar chanina amar kol sheeno yachol lechaven imra bechefet chaluko
Vehaumman machliv may machliv rabbi yochanan amar mafsia rabba bar shemuel amar shine chalbeta

Mesargin et hammittot may mesargin umay memattechin ki ata rav dimi amar peligi bah rabbi chiyya bar abba verabbi assi vetarvayehu mishshemeh dechizkiyya verabbi yochanan chad amar mesargin sheti vaerev ummattechin sheti belo erev vechad amar mesargin sheti belo erev ummattechin sheim haya rafuy memattecho

Ini veha tane rav tachlifa bar shaul veshavin sheen mafshilin chavalim lechattechilla bishlama leman deamar mesargin sheti vaerev ummattechin sheti belo erev hayenu dekatane rav tachlifa bar shaul veshavin sheen mafshilin chavalim lechattechilla
Ella leman deamar mesargin sheti belo erev memattechin sheim haya rafuy haya memattecho hashta sheti vaerev amratte la chavalim lechattechilla mibaya kashya
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerabbi chiyya bar avin mi ika leman deamar mesargin sheti belo erev vehatnan rabbi meir omer hammitta mishsheyesareg bah shelosha battim
Ella ki ata ravin amar bimsargin kulle alma la peligi dishti vaerev ella ki peligi bimmattechin mar savar memattechin sheti belo erev umar savar sheim haya rafuy memattecho
Metivi mesargin et hammitta veen tzarich lomar shemmemattechin divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer memattechin aval lo mesargin veyesh omrim en memattechin kol ikar
Bishlama leman deamar memattechin sheti belo erev hayenu deatu yesh omrim leiploge ella leman deamar sheim haya rafuy memattecho leyesh omrim memattecho name la
In kevan deefshar lemimleyeh bemane la tarchinan
Matni maamidin tannur vechirayim verechayim bammoed rabbi yehuda omer en mechabbeshin et harechayim battechila
Gema may mechabbeshin rav yehuda amar menakkar richya rav yechiel amar bat ena

Metivi maamidin tannur vechirayim bammoed uvilvad shello yigmor melachtan divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim af yigmor rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo maamidin et hachadasha umchabbeshin et hayeshana veyesh omrim en mechabbeshin kol ikar
Bishlama leman deamar mechabbeshin menakkar richya hayenu demashkachatte lah bishana ella leman deamar bat ena yeshana bat ena lema lah kegon deka bae learoche tefe purta
Rav huna shameh lehahu gavra deka menakkar richya bechulla demoada amar man hay itachil gufeh deka machel chulla demoada savar lah keyesh omrim
Daresh rav chama nokrin rechayim bammoed mishshum rabbi meir amar afilu sus sherochev alav vachamor sherochev alav muttar litol tzippornayim bechullo shel moed
b: Aval chamara derichya la
Rav yehuda shere lemishkal tufreh lachamara derichya ulokome richya ulmivne richya ulmivne ammat richya ulmivne urya rava shera lesaroke susya ulmivne akrafita ulmivne itzteva
Rava shera lemishkal dema livhema bechulla demoada amar leh abbaye tanya dimsayya lach makkizin dam labbehema veen monin refua labbehema bechullo shel moed
Rava shera lechaskose kirme may tama maase hedot hu amar rav yitzchak bar amme amar rav chisda kiture vere asir may tama maase umman hu
Amar rava man dimtakkel ara addata deve dare shere addata deara asir
Hechi dame mulya bemulya venatztza benatztza addata deve dare shekal mulya ushda benatztza addata deara
Veamar rava hay man dezache ziche addata detzive shere addata deara asir hechi dame shakel ravreve veshavek zutre addata detzive shekal ravreve vezutre addata deara
Veamar rava hay man defatach mayya leareh addata dichore shere addata deara asir
Hechi dame patach tere vave chad meilay vechad mittattay addata dichore petach chad bava addata deara
Veamar rava hay man defashach dikla addata dechevata shere addata dedikla asir hechi dame shakel kulleh mechad gisa addata dechevata mehay gisa umehay gisa addata dedikla vaasir
Veamar rava hane tamre tuchlani migzerinhu shere mayetzinhu asir rav pappa amar kevan dematlei kifrakmatya haaved dame veshare

Veamar rava perakmatya kal shehu asur amar rabbi yose bar avin uvaddavar haaved muttar ravina hava leh hahu iska dahava mizdabban beshita alfe shahayeh lezabboneh batar chulla demoada vezabbeneh bitresar alfe

Ravina hava massek zuze bivne akra deshanvata ata lekammeh derav ashe amar leh mahu lemezal haidana alayehu amar leh kevan dehaidana hu demashkachatte lehu beome acharine la mashkachatte lehu kifrakmatya haaved dame veshare
Tanya name gabbe avoda zara ki hay gavena holchin

a: Leyarid shel goyim velokchim behema avadim ushfachot battim sadot uchramim vechotev umaale baarkaot shellahen mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadan
Rav shera lechiyya bar ashe lemigdal uhari bechulla demoada may tama maase hedot hu aval izle asur may tama maase umman hu

Rav yehuda shera leamme tannuraa lemigdal tannure ulrabba bar isbi lemigdal maholata ini veha tane rabba bar shemuel veshavin sheen godlin tannur lechattechila la kashya kan bimot hachamma kan bimot haggeshamim
Matni osin maake laggag velammirpeset maase hedot aval lo maase umman shafin et hassedakin umaagilin otan bammaagila bayyad uvaregel aval lo bemachlatzayim
Hatztzir vehatztzinor vehakkora vehammanul vehammafteach shennishberu metakkenan bammoed uvilvad shello yitkaven laasot melachto bammoed
Vechol kevashin shehu yachol leechol mehen bammoed kovshan
Gema hechi dame maase hedot rav yosef amar behutza vedafna bematnita tana tzar bitzror veeno tach betit

Shafin et hassedakin umaagilin otan bammaagila hashta bemaagila amratte shere bayyad uvaregel mibaya hachi kaamar shafin et hassedakin umaagilin otan keen maagila bayyad uvaregel aval lo bemachlatzayim
Hatztzir vehatztzinor vehakkora vehammanul vehammafteach shennishberu metakkenan bammoed urminhi ad yamav haya pattish makke birushalayim ku ad yamav in mikkan veelach la
La kashya kan bidnappache kan bidnaggare
Matkef lah rav chisda yomru kala rabba asir kala zutra shere ella amar rav chisda la kashya ha bemaggale ha bachatzine rav pappa amar kan kodem gezera kan leachar gezera
Rav ashe amar ha rabbi yehuda ha rabbi yose deamar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi man tanna shinuy bammoed bedavar haaved dela kerabbi yose
Amar ravina keman medallinan haidana kibbevata dedashsha bechulla demoada keman kerabbi yose
Kevashin shehu yachol leechol bammoed kovshan bedita levay keore azul kulle alma tzud ayeto keore shera lehu rava lemimlach minayehu
Amar leh abbaye veha tenan kevashin shehu yachol leechol mehen bammoed kovshan amar leh kevan demeikara addata daachila ayetinhu vei shavek lehu pasdi kifrakmatya haaved dame ushre
Veika deamri shera lehu rava metzad mezal ayetoye umimlach amar leh abbaye veha anan kevashin shehu yachol leechol mehen kovshan tenan
Amar leh hane name mitachli aggav itzatza ki ha dishmuel avadu leh shitin itzatze vaachal rava ikla leve resh galuta avdi leh shitin itzatze vaachal
Rav ikla leve rav shappir ayeto lekammayehu hahu keora tilta bishula tilta milcha vetilta taveya
Amar rav amar li adda tzayyada keora samuch lemisrecheh mealle veamar rav amar li adda tzayyada keora taveya baachuh assokeh baavuh mechleh bivreh mishte aleh avuh
Veamar rav amar li adda tzayyada keora tachle vachalava liton gufa vela liton purya veamar rav amar li adda tzayyada keora tachle vachalava mayya vela shichra shichra vela chamra
Hadaran alach mashkin bet hashshelachin
b: Mi shehafach et zetav veero evel o ones o shehituhu poalim toen kora rishona umannichah leachar hammoed divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi yose omer zolef vegomer vegaf kedarko
Gema patach beevel vesiyyem bammoed amar rav shisha bereh derav idi zot omeret devarim hammuttarin bammoed asurim bime evlo
Rav ashe amar la mibaya kaamar la mibaya bime evlo demidderabbanan hu ushre ella afilu bammoed deisur melacha middeorayeta bimkom peseda sharu rabbanan

Tanya keoteh derav shisha bereh derav idi ellu devarim haosin laavel bime evlo zetav hafuchin toanin lo vechaddo laguf ufishtano lehaalot min hammishra vetzamro lehaalot min hayyora umarbitzim sadehu mishshettaggia onat hammayim shello
Rabbi yehuda omer af zorin lo sede nir vesade haomedet lefishtan amru lo im lo tizzara bevakkir tizzara beafil im lo tizzara pishtan tizzara mimmin acher

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer zetav hafuchin veen sham umman ella hu kaddo laguf veen sham umman ella hu pishtano lehaalot min hammishra vetzamro lehaalot min hayyora veen sham umman ella hu hare ze yaase betzina
Yater al ken amar rabban shimon ben gamliel im haya umman larabbim vesappar uvallan larabbim vehiggia et haregel veen sham umman ella hu hare ze yaase

Haarisin vehachachirin vehakkabbelanin hare ellu yaasu acherim bishvilan hachammarin haggammalin vehassappanin hare ellu lo yaasu veim hau muchkarin o muskarin etzel acherim hare ellu yaasu sechir yom afilu beir acheret lo yaase hayeta melechet acherim beyado af al pi shebbekibolet lo yaase
Af al pi shebbekibolet vela mibaya sheenah kibolet adderabba kibolet kedideh dame ella ema ben kibolet ben sheenah kibolet lo yaase
Hayeta melachto beyad acherim beveto lo yaasu bevayit acher yaasu

Mariyyon bereh deravin umar bereh derav acha bereh derava hava lehu hahu gamla detora bahade hadade itraa beh milta bemar bereh derav acha bereh derava ufaskeh legamleh amar rav ashe gavra rabba kemar bereh derav acha aved hachi nehi delifseda dideh la chayesh addaacherim la chayesh veha tanya im hau muskarin o muchkarin etzel acherim hare ellu yaasu
Vehu savar adam chashuv shane

a: Amar shemuel mekabbele kibolet betoch hattechum asur chutz lattechum muttar
Amar rav pappa vaafilu chutz lattechum lo amaran ella deleka mata dimkarva lehatam aval ika mata dimkarva lehatam asur

Amar rav mesharsheya vechi leka mata dimkarva lehatam name la amaran ella beshabbatot uvyamim tovim dela shechichi inashe deazli lehatam aval bechullo shel moed dishchichi inashe deazli veatu lehatam asur
Mar zutra bereh derav nachman benu leh appadna mekabbele kibolet chutz lattechum ikla rav safra verav huna bar chinana vela allu legabbeh veika deamri hu name la al begaveyh
Vehaamar shemuel mekabbele kibolet betoch hattechum asur chutz lattechum muttar adam chashuv shane veika deamri sayyoe sayya betivna bahadayehu
Rav chama shera lehu leavvangare deve resh galuta lemebad lehu avidta bechulla demoada amar kevan daagar la ka shakli sharshoye hu deka mesharshu leh velet lan bah

Tanu rabbanan mekabbelin kibolet bammoed laasotah leachar hammoed uvammoed asur kelalo shel davar kol shehu ose omer legoy veose vechol sheeno ose eno omer legoy veose tanya idach mekabbelin kibolet bammoed laasotah leachar hammoed uvilvad shello yimdod veshello yishkol veshello yimne kederech shehu ose bachol
Tanu rabbanan en marbiin behema bechullo shel moed kayyotze bo en marbiin bivchor velo bifsule hammukdashin
Tanya idach en marbiin behema bechullo shel moed rabbi yehuda omer chamora shettava marbiin aleha zachar bishvil shello titztannen ushar kol habbehemot machnisin otan levakrut
Tanu rabbanan en medayerin lo beshabbatot velo beyamim tovim velo bechullo shel moed veim bau mealehen muttar

Veen mesayein otan veen mosrin lahem shomer lenaer et tzonam haya sechir shabbat sechir chodesh sechir shana sechir shavua mesayein otan umosrin lahem shomer lenaer et tzonam rabbi omer bashshabbat betova beom tov bimzonot bammoed besachar amar rav yosef hilcheta kerabbi
Matni vechen mi shehaya yeno betoch habbor veero evel o ones o shehituhu zolef vegomer vegaf kedarko divre rabbi yose rabbi yehuda omer ose lo limudim bishvil shello yachmitz

Gema utzricha dei ashmeinan kammayeta behahi kaamar rabbi yose mishshum demishcha nefish pesedeh aval chamra dela nefish pesedeh ema mode leh lerabbi yehuda vei ashmeinan batrayeta behahi kaamar rabbi yehuda aval behach ema mode lerabbi yose tzericha
Amar rav yitzchak bar abba man tanna shinuy bammoed bedavar haaved dela kerabbi yose amar rav yosef halacha kerabbi yose
Beo mineh merav nachman bar yitzchak mahu lemesha chavita deshichra bechulla demoada amar lehu sinay amar halacha kerabbi yose emor deamar rabbi yose bechamra beshichra mi amar
Chamra tama may mishshum dinfish pesedeh shichra name it beh peseda deamar abbaye amara li em bar shet save ushyia mibbar tamne vela sheyia
Amar rav chama bar gurya amar rav hilchot moed kehilchot kutim bahalacha lemay hilcheta amar rav daniel bar kattina amar rav lomar shehen akurot veen lemedot zo mizzo
Deamar shemuel zoftin kuzta veen zoftin chavita rav dimi minnehardea amar zoftin chavita veen zoftin kuzta mar chayesh lifseda umar chayesh letircha
Amar abbaye naktinan hilchot moed kehilchot shabbat
b: Yesh mehen patur aval asur veyesh mehen muttar lechattechilla

Rav huna chatzadu leh chatzada bemoada etiveh rabba bar rav huna lerav huna tochanin kemach bammoed letzorech hammoed veshello letzorech hammoed asur davar sheavud bammoed muttar laasoto bammoed davar sheeno avud bammoed asur
Bamma devarim amurim bitlushin min hakkarka aval mechubbar lakkarka afilu kullo avud asur veim en lo ma yochal kotzer umammer vedash vezore uvorer vetochen uvilvad shello yadush befarot

Amar leh yechidaa hi vela sevira lan keoteh detanya kelal amar rabban shimon ben gamliel mishshum rabbi yose davar hattalush min hakkarka afilu miktzato avud muttar vehamchubbar lakkarka afilu kullo avud asur
Vei rabbi yose yadush name befarot ha amar rav yitzchak bar abba man tanna shinuy bammoed bedavar haaved dela kerabbi yose
Amar lach hacha name kevan dechol yoma lav befarot dayeshi haidana name lav shinuy hu

Tanu rabbanan tochanin bammoed letzorech hammoed veshello letzorech hammoed asur veim tachan vehotir hare ze muttar kotztzin etzim bammoed letzorech hammoed veshello letzorech hammoed asur veim katzatz vehotir hare ze muttar
Metilin shechar bammoed letzorech hammoed veshello letzorech hammoed asur veim hetil vehotir hare ze muttar uvilvad shello yaarim

Urminhu metilin shechar bammoed letzorech hammoed veshello letzorech hammoed asur echad shechar temarim veechad shechar seorim veaf al pi sheyyesh lo yashan maarim veshote min hechadash tannae hi detanya en maarimin bechach rabbi yose bar yehuda omer maarimin
Rav chatzadu leh chatzada bechulla demoada shema shemuel ikfad lema shemuel kichidaa sevira leh la chatzada dechite hava dela hava pased
Verav may tama aved hachi en lo ma yochal hava ushmuel la sayemuha kammeh i name adam chashuv shane

Rabbi yehuda nesia nefak bechumarta dimdusha veishti mayya deachem kappila arammaa shema rabbi amme ikfad amar rav yosef may tama ikfad i mishshum chumarta dimdusha ha tanya hashshirin hannezamim vehattabbaot hare hen kechol hakkelim hannitalin bechatzer
I mishshum deishti mayya deachem kappila arammaa ha amar shemuel bar yitzchak amar rav kol shenneechal kemot shehu chay en bo mishshum bishule goyim adam chashuv shane
Amar rav chananel amar rav kotzetz adam dekel bammoed af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lannesoret shello layet alah abbaye

Rav ashe hava leh ibba bishlanya azal lemiktzeyeh bechulla demoada amar leh rav shela mishshelanya lerav ashe may datach dekaamar rav chananel amar rav kotzetz adam dekel bammoed af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lannesoret shello ha layet alah abbaye amar leh la shemia li kelomar la sevira li ishtemit narga bae lemifsekeh leshakeh shavkeh vahadar ata

Rav yehuda shera lemikar kitana ulmiktal keshuta ulmikar shumsheme amar leh abbaye lerav yosef bishlama kitana chaze lachafifa keshuta chaze leshichra ella shumsheme lemay chaze chaze lenazye deit behu
Rabbi yannay hava leh hahu pardesa dimta zimneh bechulla demoada katfeh leshana shahiyyu kulle alma lefardesayehu lechulla demoada afkereh rabbi yannay lefardeseh hahi shatta
Matni machnis adam perotav mippene haggannavim veshole pishtano min hammishra bishvil shello tovad uvilvad shello yechaven et melachto bammoed vechullan im kivvenu melachtan bammoed yovedu
Gema tana uvilvad sheyyachnisem betzina letoch beto
Rav yosef hava leh keshure ayelinhu bimama
Amar leh abbaye vehatanya uvilvad sheyyachnisem betzina betoch beto amar leh tzina dehane yemama hu kevan divlelya bau gavre yattire uvau madbure denura avesha milta
Veshole pishtano min hammishra ku bae mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera kiven melachto bammoed vamet mahu sheyyiknesu banav acharav
Im timtze lomar

a: Tzaram ozen bechor kansu beno acharav mishshum deisura deorayeta
Veim timtze lomar machar avdo legoy vamet kansu beno acharav mishshum dechol yoma mafka leh mimmitzot
Hacha may gavra kanes rabbanan veha leteh o dilma mamona kanes rabbanan veha iteh

Amar leh tenetuha sade shennitkavvetza bashsheviit tizzara lemotzae sheviit nittayeva o niddayera lo tizzara lemotzae sheviit veamar rabbi yose bar chanina naktinan hetivah vamet beno zorah alma ledideh kenasu rabbanan livreh la kenasu rabbanan hacha name ledideh kenasu rabbanan livreh la kenasu rabbanan
Amar abbaye naktinan time taharotav vamet lo kansu beno acharav may tama hezek sheeno nikar la shemeh hezek ledideh kenasu rabbanan livreh la kenasu rabbanan
Matni en lokchin battim avadim uvhema ella letzorech hammoed o letzorech hammocher sheen lo ma yochal
Gema bea mineh rava merav nachman sechar peulla sheen lo ma yochal mahu amar leh tenena o letzorech hammocher sheen lo ma yochal leetoye may lav leetoye sechar peulla amar leh la paroshe ka mefaresh
Etiveh abbaye en kotvin shetare chov bammoed veim eno maamino o sheen lo ma yochal hare ze yichtov sheen lo ma yochal leetoye may lav leetoye sechar peulla shema minah

Motev rav sheshet vachachamim omrim shalosh ummaniyyot osin melacha bearve fesachim ad chatzot hachayyatin vehassapparin vehakkovsin hachayyatin shekken hedot tofer kedarko bechullo shel moed hassapparin vehakkovsin shekken habbain mimmedinat hayyam vehayyotze mibbet haasurin muttarin lesapper ulchabbes bechullo shel moed
Vei salka datach sechar peulla sheen lo ma yochal shere kol melachot name lishtero deha ika sechar peulla sheen lo ma yochal
Matkef lah rav pappa ella meatta binyan lishtere shekken kotel haggohe lirshut harabbim soter uvone kedarko mippene hassakkana
Matkef lah ravina ella meatta lavlar lishtere shekken kotvin kidushe nashim gitin veshovarin

Ella amar rav ashe moed aarbaa asar ka ramet moed mishshum tircha hu uvimkom peseda sharu rabbanan arbaa asar mishshum tzorech yom tov hu mide detzorech yom tov sharu rabbanan mide delav tzorech yom tov la sharu rabbanan
Matni en mefannin mibbayit levayit aval mefanne hu lachatzero en meviin kelim mibbet haumman im choshesh lahem mefannan lechatzer acheret
Gema vehaamratte resha en mefannin kelal amar abbaye sefa atan levayit shebbechatzer
Veen meviin kelim mibbet haumman amar rav pappa badek lan rava tenan en meviin kelim mibbet haumman urminhu molichin umviin kelim mibbet haumman veaf al pi sheenan letzorech hammoed
Veshannenan leh kan bearbaa asar kan bechullo shel moed ibaet ema ha veha bechullo shel moed kan bemaamino kan besheeno maamino

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan may dichtiv neum david ben yishay unum haggever hukam al neum david ben yishay shehekim ullah shel teshuva

b: Veachateh be kivre ukri beh alpa shippure bearbein yomin azel aved hachi peka kadda umit allama may shippure shennifrain mimmennu

Vehannazir vehammetzora mittumato letohorato bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera beshello haya lahem penay o dilma af beshehaya lahem penay
Amar leh tenena kol ellu sheamru muttarin legalleach bammoed beshello haya lahem penay aval haya lahem penay asurim
Nazir umtzora af al pi shehaya lahem penay muttarim shello yeshahu korbenotehen
Tana hakkohen vehaavel muttarin begiluach hay avel hechi dame ilema shechal shemini shello beerev haregel ibi leh legalloche baerev haregel ella shechal shemini shello lihot beshabbat erev haregel

Ibi leh legalloche erev shabbat deamar rav chisda amar ravina bar shela halacha keabba shaul umodim chachamim leabba shaul beshechal shemini shello lihot beshabbat erev haregel shemmuttar legalleach beerev shabbat
La tzericha shechal shevii shello lihot beshabbat erev haregel
Tanna bara savar lah keabba shaul deamar miktzat hayyom kechullo veom shevii ole lo lechan ulchan vechevan deshabbat have anus hu
Tanna didan savar lah kerabbanan deamri la amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo veakkatti la shelim avelut deshiva
Hay kohen hechi dame ilema dishlim mishmarto erev haregel ibi leh legalloche erev haregel

La tzericha dishlim mishmarto baregel tanna didan savar kevan ditnan bishlosha perakim bashshana hau kol hammishmarot shaot beemure hargalim uvchiluk lechem happanim keman dela shelim mishmarto baregel dame vetanna bara savar af al gav deshayech behanach mishmarot mishmarteh miha shelima leh
Tanu rabbanan kol ellu sheamru muttarin legalleach bammoed muttarin legalleach bime evlan
Vehatanya asurim amar rav chisda amar rav shela ki tanya hacha muttarin beshettechafuhu avalav
I beshettechafuhu avalav may irya kol ellu sheamru afilu kulle alma name detanya techafuhu avalav ze achar ze hichbid searo mekel betaar umchabbes kesuto bemayim
Ha ittemar alah amar rav chisda betaar velo bemisparayim bemayim velo beneter velo beahal amar rav chisda zot omeret avel asur betichboset
Tanu rabbanan keshem sheamru asur legalleach bammoed kach asur litol tzippornayim bammoed divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose mattir
Uchshem sheamru avel asur legalleach bime evlo kach asur litol tzippornayim bime evlo divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose mattir
Amar ulla halacha kerabbi yehuda beevel vahalacha kerabbi yose bammoed shemuel amar

Pinchas achuh demar shemuel itra beh milta al shemuel lemishal tama mineh chazanhu letufreh dahao nefishan amar leh ammay la shaklatte lehu amar leh i bedideh hava mi mezalzelatte beh kulle hay
Havay kishgaga sheyyotza millifne hashshallit veitra beh milta bishmuel al pinchas achuh lemishal tama mineh shaklinhu letufreh chavtinhu leappeh amar leh let lacha berit keruta lassefatayim

Deamar rabbi yochanan minnayin shebberit keruta lassefatayim shenneemar vayyomer avraham el nearav shevu lachem po im hachamor vaani vehannaar nelcha ad ko venishtachave venashuva alechem veistayea milleta dahadur tarvayehu
Sevur mineh deyad in deregel la amar rav anan bar tachlifa ledidi mipparsha li mineh dishmuel la shena deyad vela shena deregel
Amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav uvignustera asur amar rav shemen bar abba hava kaemna kammeh derabbi yochanan be midresha bechullo shel moed veshaklinhu letufreh beshineh vezarkinhu
Shema minah telat shema minah muttar litol tzippornayim bechullo shel moed ushma minah en bahen mishshum mius ushma minah muttar lezorkan
Ini vehatanya shelosha devarim neemru batztzippornayim hakkovran tzaddik sorfan chasid zorkan rasha tama may shemma taavor alehen ishsha ubbarah vetappil
Ishsha be midresha la shechicha vechi tema zimnin dimchanneshi lehu veshade lehu abbaray kevan deishtanni ishtanni

Vaamar avitul safra mishshemeh derav pappa paro shehaya bime moshe amgushi haya shenneemar hinne yotze hammayema vego
Veellu mechabbesin bammoed habba mimmedinat hayyam amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan mi sheen lo ella chaluk echad muttar lechabbeso bechullo shel moed
Metiv rabbi yirmeya ellu mechabbesin bammoed habba mimmedinat hayyam ku hane in mi sheen lo ella chaluk echad la
Amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya asberah lach matnitin af al gav deit leh tere umittannefi
Shelach rav yitzchak bar yaakov bar giyyore mishshemeh derabbi yochanan kele fishtan muttar lechabbesan bechullo shel moed metiv rava mitpechot hayyadayim mitpechot

Deamar rav gidel amar rav kamma atta noten levincha kach vechach kamma atta noten levittecha kach vechach amdu vekiddeshu kanu hen hen haddevarim hanniknin baamira
Lema mesayya leh en nosin nashim bammoed lo betulot velo almanot velo meyabbemin mippene shessimcha hi lo ha leares share
La mibaya kaamar la mibaya leares dela kaaved mitzva ella afilu lisa name deka aved mitzva asur
Ta shema detana deve shemuel mearsin aval lo konsin veen osin seudat erusin velo meyabbemin mippene shessimcha hi lo shema minah
Umi amar shemuel shemma yikdemennu acher vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel bechol yom veom bat kol yotzet veomeret bat peloni lifloni sede feloni lifloni

En kotvin sefarim tefilin umzuzot bammoed veen maggihin ot achat afilu besefer ezra rabbi yehuda omer kotev adam tefilin umzuzot leatzmo

Ori leh rav lerav chananel veamri lah rabba bar bar chana lerav chananel halacha kotev umocher kedarko kede farnasato

Vetove al yerecho techelet tanu rabbanan tove adam al yerecho techelet letzitzito aval lo beeven divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim af beeven rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo beeven aval lo befelech vachachamim omrim ben beeven ben befelech
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel vechen amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan halacha ben beeven ben befelech vahalacha kotev kedarko umocher kede farnasato
Matni hakkover et meto shelosha yamim kodem laregel batla hemennu gezerat shiva shemona batlu hemennu gezerat sheloshim
Mippene sheamru shabbat ola veenah mafseket regalim mafsikin veenan olin
Rabbi eliezer omer mishshecharav bet hammikdash atzeret kashshabbat
Rabban gamliel omer rosh hashshana veom hakkippurim kargalim vachachamim omrim lo kedivre ze velo kedivre ze ella atzeret kargalim rosh hashshana veom hakkippurim kashshabbat

May tama yamim lo batlu sheim lo gilach erev haregel asur legalleach achar haregel
b: Vehatanya hakkover et meto shelosha yamim kodem laregel batla hemennu gezerat shiva shemona yamim kodem laregel batla hemennu gezerat sheloshim umgalleach erev haregel im lo gilach erev haregel asur legalleach achar haregel
Abba shaul omer muttar legalleach achar haregel shekkeshem shemmitzvat shelosha mevattelet gezerat shiva kach mitzvat shiva mevattelet gezerat sheloshim
Shiva vehaanan shemona tenan kasavar abba shaul miktzat hayyom kechullo veom shevii ole lo lechan ulchan amar rav chisda amar ravina bar shela halacha keabba shaul
Umodim chachamim leabba shaul keshechal shemini shello lihot beshabbat erev haregel shemmuttar legalleach beerev shabbat
Keman azla ha deamar rav amram amar rav avel kevan sheamdu menachamin meetzlo muttar birchitza keman keabba shaul
Amar abbaye halacha keabba shaul beom shiva umodim chachamim leabba shaul beom sheloshim deamrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo
Rava amar halacha keabba shaul beom sheloshim veen halacha keabba shaul beom shiva unhardae amri halacha keabba shaul bazo uvazo deamar shemuel halacha kedivre hammekel beevel
Sheloshim yom menalan yalef pera pera minnazir ketiv hacha rashechem al tifrau uchtiv hatam gaddel pera sear rosho ma lehallan sheloshim af kan sheloshim
Vehatam menalan amar rav matna setam nezirut sheloshim yom may tama amar kera kadosh yihye yihye begimatriyya telatin hau
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hakkol modin keshechal shelishi shello lihot erev haregel sheasur birchitza ad haerev

Amar rav nechemya bereh derav yehoshua ashkachtinhu lerav pappe ulrav pappa deyatvi vekaamri halacha kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua ika deamri amar rav nechemya bereh derav yosef ashkachtinhu lerav pappe ulrav pappa ulrav huna bereh derav yehoshua deyatvi vekaamri hakkol modim sheim chal shelishi shello lihot erev haregel sheasur birchitza ad haerev

Amar leh eno ole etiveh hakkover et meto shene yamim kodem haregel mone chamishsha yamim achar haregel umlachto naaset al yede acherim vaavadav veshifchotav osim betzina betoch beto veen rabbim mitassekin immo

Amar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hen hen divre bet shammay hen hen divre bet hillel shebbet shammay omrim shelosha yamim uvet hillel omrim afilu yom echad

Ravina ikla lesura difrat amar leh rav chaviva leravina hilcheta may amar leh afilu yom echad vaafilu shaa achat
