Tanu rabbanan shemua kerova noheget shiva ushloshim shemua rechoka enah noheget ella yom echad ezo hi kerova veezo hi rechoka kerova betoch sheloshim rechoka leachar sheloshim divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim achat shemua kerova veachat shemua rechoka noheget shiva ushloshim

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol makom sheatta motze yachid mekel verabbim machmirin halacha karabbim chutz mizzo sheaf al pi sherabbi akiva mekel vachachamim machmirin halacha kerabbi akiva deamar shemuel halacha kedivre hammekel beevel

Rav chanina atya leh shemua daavuh mibbe chozae ata lekammeh derav chisda amar leh shemua rechoka enah noheget ella yom echad rav natan bar amme ata leh shemua deimeh mibbe chozae ata lekammeh derava amar leh hare amru shemua rechoka enah noheget ella yom echad bilvad
Etiveh bamma devarim amurim bachamishsha mete mitzva aval al aviv veal immo shiva ushloshim

Amar leh yechidaa hi vela sevira lan keoteh detanya maase umet aviv shel rabbi tzadok beginzak vehodiuhu leachar shalosh shanim uva veshaal et elisha ben avuya uzkenim sheimmo veamru nehog shiva ushloshim uchshemmet beno shel rabbi achiyya baggola yashav alav shiva ushloshim
Ini veha rav bar achuh derabbi chiyya dehu bar achateh derabbi chiyya ki selek lehatam amar leh abba kayyam
b: Amar leh ima kayyemet amar leh ima kayyemet amar leh abba kayyam amar leh leshammaeh chalotz li minalay veholech acharay kelay levet hammerchatz
Shema minah telat shema minah avel asur binilat hassandal ushma minah shemua rechoka enah noheget ella yom echad ushma minah miktzat hayyom kechullo
Rabbi chiyya lechud rabbi achiyya lechud

Amar rabbi yose bar avin shama shemua kerova baregel ulmotzae haregel naaset rechoka ola lo veeno noheg ella yom echad tane rabbi adda demin kesari kammeh derabbi yochanan shama shemua kerova beshabbat ulmotzae shabbat naaset rechoka eno noheg ella yom echad

Korea o eno korea rabbi mani amar eno korea rabbi chanina amar korea amar leh rabbi mani lerabbi chanina bishlama ledidi deamena eno korea hayenu dela ika avelut shiva ella ledidach deamratte korea keria belo shiva mi ika
Vela vehatanya isi avuh derabbi zera veamri lah achuh derabbi zera kammeh derabbi zera mi sheen lo chaluk likroa venizdammen lo betoch shiva korea leachar shiva eno korea
Ani rabbi zera batreh bamme devarim amurim bachamishsha mete mitzva aval al aviv veal immo korea veholech
Ki tanya hahi lichvod aviv veimmo

Tanu rabbanan kol haamur befarashat kohanim shekkohen mitamme lahen avel mitabbel alehen veellu hen ishto aviv veimmo achiv vaachoto beno uvitto hosifu alehen achiv vaachoto habbetula meimmo vaachoto nesua ben meaviv ben meimmo

Uchshem shemmitabbel alehem kach mitabbel al sheniyyim shellahem divre rabbi akiva rabbi shimon ben elazar omer eno mitabbel ella al ben beno veal avi aviv vachachamim omrim kol shemmitabbel alav mitabbel immo
Chachamim hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu immo babbayit ki ha deamar leh rav lechiyya bereh vechen amar leh rav huna lerabba bereh beappah nehog aviluta bela appah la tinhog aviluta
Mar ukva shechev leh bar chamuh sevar lemetav aleh shiva ushloshim al rav huna legabbeh ashkecheh amar leh tzudanyata baet lemechal lo amru lichvod ishto ella chamiv vachamoto

Detanya mi shemmet chamiv o chamoto eno rashshay lachof et ishto lihot kochelet velihot pokeset ella kofe mittato venoheg immah avelut vechen hi shemmet chamiha o chamotah enah rashshaa lihot kochelet velihot pokeset ella kofa mittatah venoheget immo avelut
Vetanya idach af al pi sheamru eno rashshay lachof et ishto lihot kochelet velihot pokeset beemet amru mozeget lo et hakkos umatztzaat lo mitta umarchetzet lo panav yadav veraglav kashyan ahadade
Ella lav shema minah kan bechamiv vachamoto kan bishar kerovim shema minah tanya name hachi lo amru lichvod ishto ella chamiv vachamoto bilvad
Ammemar shachev leh bar bereh kera ilaveh ata bereh kera beappeh idchar dimushshav kera kam kera meummad
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar keria dimummad menalan dichtiv vayyakom iyyov vayyikra et meilo

a: Ella meatta veamad veamar lo chafatzti lekachtah hacha name veha tanya ben yoshev ben omed ben mutte
Amar leh hatam la ketiv veyaamod veyomar hacha ketiv vayyakom vayyikra
Amar rame bar chama minnayin likria shehi meummad shenneemar vayyakom iyyov vayyikra dilma milta yattirta hu daavad dei la tema hachi vayyagoz et rosho hachi name
Ella mehacha vayyakam hammelech vayyikra et begadav vedilma milta yattirta aved dei la tema hachi vayyishkav artza hachi name
Vehatanya yashav al gabbe mitta al gabbe kisse al gabbe udyani gedola al gabbe karka mikkullan lo yatza yede chovato veamar rabbi yochanan shello kiyyem kefiyyat hammitta
Amar leh keen artza

Tanu rabbanan veellu devarim sheavel asur bahen asur bimlacha uvirchitza uvsicha uvtashmish hammitta uvinilat hassandal veasur likrot betora uvanneviim uvakketuvim velishnot bammishna bammidrash uvahalachot uvattalmud uvaaggadot veim hau rabbim tzerichin lo eno nimna umaase umet beno shel rabbi yose betzipori venichnas levet hammidrash vedarash kol hayyom kullo
Rabba bar bar chana itraa beh milta savar dela lemipak lefirka amar leh rabbi chanina im hau rabbim tzerichin lo eno nimna sevar leokome amora aleh amar leh rav tanya uvilvad shello yaamid turgeman

Veella hechi aved ki ha detanya maase umet beno shel rabbi yehuda bar ilay venichnas levet hammidrash venichnas rabbi chananya ben akavya veyashav betziddo velachash hu lerabbi chananya ben akavya verabbi chananya ben akavya leturgeman veturgeman hishmia larabbim

Tanu rabbanan avel shelosha yamim harishonim asur lehanniach tefilin mishshelishi veelach ushlishi bakkelal muttar lehanniach tefilin veim bau panim chadashot eno choletz divre rabbi eliezer rabbi yehoshua omer avel shene yamim harishonim asur lehanniach tefilin mishsheni vesheni bakkelal muttar lehanniach tefilin veim bau panim chadashot choletz
Amar rav matna may tama derabbi eliezer dichtiv vayyittemu yeme vechi evel moshe amar rav ena may tama derabbi yehoshua dichtiv veacharitah keom mar
Verabbi yehoshua name ha ketiv vayyittemu yeme vego amar lach shane moshe detakkif evleh verabbi eliezer name ha ketiv veacharitah keom mar ikar merira chad yoma hu
Amar ulla halacha kerabbi eliezer bachalitza vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua behannacha
Ibaya lehu bashsheni leulla choletz o eno choletz
Ta shema amar ulla choletz umanniach afilu mea peamim tanya name hachi yehuda ben tema omer choletz umanniach afilu mea peamim
Rava amar kevan shehinniach shuv eno choletz veha rava hu deamar halacha ketanna didan deamar shelosha
b: Mitzva shane
Tanu rabbanan avel shelosha yamim harishonim asur bimlacha vaafilu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka mikkan veelach ose betzina betoch beto vehaishsha tova bappelech betoch betah
Tanu rabbanan avel shelosha yamim harishonim eno holech levet haevel mikkan veelach holech veeno yoshev bimkom hamnachamin ella bimkom hammitnachamin
Tanu rabbanan avel shelosha yamim harishonim asur bishelat shalom mishshelosha vead shiva meshiv veeno shoel mikkan veelach shoel umeshiv kedarko
Shelosha yamim harishonim asur bishelat shalom vehatanya maase umetu banav shel rabbi akiva nichnesu kol yisrael vehispidum hesped gadol

Bishat petiratan amad rabbi akiva al safsal gadol veamar achenu bet yisrael shimu afilu shene vanim chatanim menucham hu bishvil kavod sheasitem veim bishvil akiva batem hare kamma akiva bashshuk ella kach amartem torat elohav belibbo vechol shekken shessecharchem kaful lechu levattechem leshalom
Kevod rabbim shane
Mishshelosha vead shiva meshiv veeno shoel mikkan veelach shoel umeshiv kedarko
Urminhu hammotze et chavero avel betoch sheloshim yom medabber immo tanchumin veeno shoel bishlomo leachar sheloshim yom shoel bishlomo veeno medabber immo tanchumin
Meta ishto venasa ishsha acheret eno rashshay likanes leveto ledabber immo tanchumin metzao bashshuk omer lo besafa rafa uvchoved rosh
Amar rav idi bar avin hu shoel bishlom acherim sheacherim sheruyin beshalom acherim en shoalin bishlomo shehu eno sharuy beshalom
Veha middekatane meshiv mikkelal deshayelinan leh dela yadi
I hachi hatam name hatam moda lehu vela mahdar lehu hacha la tzarich leodoinhu

Urminhu hammotze et chavero avel betoch shenem asar chodesh medabber immo tanchumin veeno shoel bishlomo leachar shenem asar chodesh shoel bishlomo veeno medabber immo tanchumin aval medabber immo min hatztzad

Amar rabbi meir hammotze et chavero avel leachar shenem asar chodesh umdabber immo tanchumin lema hu dome leadam shennishbera raglo vechayeta metzao rofe veamar lo kelach etzli sheani shovrah vaarappeenna kede shetteda shessammanin shelli yafin
La kashya ha beaviv veimmo ha bishar kerovim
Hatam name yedabber immo tanchumin min hatztzad in hachi name umay eno medabber immo tanchumin kedarko aval medabber immo min hatztzad

Tanu rabbanan avel shelosha yamim harishonim ba mimmakom karov mone immahen ba mimmakom rachok mone leatzmo mikkan veelach afilu ba mimmakom karov mone leatzmo rabbi shimon omer afilu ba beom hashshevii mimmakom karov mone immahen
Amar mar shelosha yamim harishonim ba mimmakom karov mone immahen amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan vehu sheyyesh gedol habbayit babbayit
Ibaya lehu

a: Halach gedol habbayit levet hakkevarot mahu
Ta shema deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan afilu halach gedol habbayit levet hakkevarot mone immahen mone immahen vehatanya mone leatzmo
La kashya ha daata bego telata veha dela ata bego telata ki ha daamar lehu rav livne hatztzalboni deatu bego telata limno bahadayechu dela atu bego telata limno lenafshayehu
Amar lehu rava livne machoza attun dela azlitu batar arsa mikki mehadderitu appayechu mibbava daavulla atchilu meno
Rabbi shimon omer afilu ba bayyom hashshevii mimmakom karov mone immahen amar rabbi chiyya bar gammada amar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rabbi vehu shebba umatza menachamin etzlo
Bae rav anan ninaru laamod velo amdu mahu teku

Gemiri chavreh derabbi abba bar chiyya merabbi abba umannu rabbi zera veamri lah chavreh derabbi zera merabbi zera umannu rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefot vahalacha kerabbi shimon beevel
Kerabbi shimon beevel ha daamaran kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefot ditnan bene meayim shennikvu velecha sotamtan keshera divre rabban shimon ben gamliel
May lecha amar rav kahana shirka dimayya denafek aggav duchka amar man dehu izke veesak veegmerah lishmata mippummeh demarah
Ki selek ashkecheh lerabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba amar leh amar mar halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefot amar leh ana en halacha amari
Kerabbi shimon beevel may amar leh pelugta ninhu deitmar rav chisda amar halacha vechen amar rabbi yochanan halacha rav nachman amar en halacha
Veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefot vahalacha kerabbi shimon beevel deamar shemuel halacha kedivre hammekel beevel
Al kol hammetim kullan medache mittato hare ze meshubbach al aviv veal immo hare ze megunne haya erev shabbat o erev yom tov hare ze meshubbach sheeno ose ella lichvod aviv veimmo
Al kol hammetim kullan ratza memaet beisko ratza eno
b: Memaet al aviv veal immo memaet
Al kol hammetim kullan ratza choletz ratza eno choletz al aviv veal immo choletz
Umaase bigdol haddor echad shemmet aviv uvikesh lachlotz uvikesh gedol haddor acher sheimmo lachlotz venimna velo chalatz
Amar abbaye gedol haddor rabbi gedol haddor sheimmo rabbi yaakov bar acha veika deamri gedol haddor rabbi yaakov bar acha gedol haddor sheimmo rabbi
Bishlama leman deamar gedol haddor sheimmo rabbi hayenu denimna velo chalatz
Ella leman deamar rabbi yaakov bar acha ammay nimna velo chalatz rabban shimon ben gamliel nasi hava vechulle alma michayevi lemichlatz kashya

Al kol hammetim kullan mistapper leachar sheloshim yom al aviv veal immo ad sheyyigaru bo chaverav al kol hammetim kullan nichnas levet hassimcha leachar sheloshim yom al aviv veal immo leachar shenem asar chodesh
Amar rabba bar bar chana ulsimchat mereut metivi ulsimcha velimreut sheloshim yom kashya
Ammemar matne hachi amar rabba bar bar chana ulsimchat mereut muttar likanes lealtar veha tanya lesimcha sheloshim velimreut sheloshim
La kashya ha baarisuta ha befuranuta
Al kol hammetim kullan korea tefach al aviv veal immo ad sheyegalle et libbo amar rabbi avahu may kera vayyachazek david bivgadav vayyikraem veen achiza pachot mittefach
Al kol hammetim kullan afilu lavush asara chalukin eno korea ella elon al aviv veal immo korea et kullan veappikarsuto enah meakkevet
Echad haish veechad ishsha rabbi shimon ben elazar omer haishsha koraat et hattachton umachzirato laachoreha vechozeret vekoraat et haelon
Al kol hammetim kullan ratza mavdil kamme safa shello ratza eno mavdil al aviv veal immo mavdil

Rabbi yehuda omer kol keria sheeno mavdil kamme safa shello eno ella kera shel tiflut amar rabbi avahu may tama derabbi yehuda dichtiv vayyachazek bivgadav vayyikraem lishnayim keraim mimmashma shenneemar vayyikraem eni yodea shehen lishnayim ella shennirin keruim kishnayim
Al kol hammetim kullan sholel leachar shiva umache leachar sheloshim al aviv veal immo sholel leachar sheloshim veeno meache leolam vehaishsha sholalto lealtar mippene kevodah
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan al kol hammetim ratza korea bayyad ratza korea bichli al aviv veal immo bayyad
Veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan al kol hammetim kullan mibbifnim al aviv veal immo korea mibbachutz amar rav chisda vechen lannasi
Metivi lo hushu leaviv ulimmo ella leichuy bilvad
May lav afilu lenasi la levar minnasi
Nesia shechev amar leh rav chisda lerav chanan bar rava kefi asita vekum alah veachvi keria lealma
Al chacham choletz miyyamin al av bet din missemol al nasi mikkan umikkan

Tanu rabbanan chacham shemmet bet midrasho batel av bet din shemmet kol batte midrashot shebbeiro betelin venichnasin levet hakkeneset umshannin et mekoman hayyoshvin batztzafon yoshvin baddarom hayyoshvin baddarom yoshvin batztzafon nasi shemmet batte midrashot kullan betelin uvne hakkeneset nichnasin levet hakkeneset

a: Vekorin shiva veotzin rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer lo sheyyelchu vitayelu bashshuk ella yoshvin vedaviyn
Veen omrim shemua veaggada bevet haevel amru alav al rabbi chananya ben gamliel shehaya omer shemua veaggada bevet haevel
Tanu rabbanan avel shabbat rishona eno yotze mippetach beto sheniyya yotze veeno yoshev bimkomo shelishit yoshev bimkomo veeno medabber reviit hare hu kechol adam

Rabbi yehuda omer lo hutzrechu lomar shabbat rishona lo yetze mippetach beto shehare hakkol nichnasin leveto lenachamo ella sheniyya eno yotze mippetach beto shelishit yotze veeno yoshev bimkomo reviit yoshev bimkomo veeno medabber chamishit hare hu kechol adam
Tanu rabbanan kol sheloshim yom lannisuin meta ishto asur lisa ishsha acheret ad sheyyaavru alav shelosha regalim rabbi yehuda omer regel rishon vesheni asur shelishi muttar
Veim en lo banim muttar lisa lealtar mishshum bitul periyya urviyya hinnicha lo banim ketannim muttar lisa lealtar mippene farnasatan

Maase shemmeta ishto shel yosef hakkohen veamar laachotah bevet hakkevarot lechi ufarnesi et bene achotech veaf al pi chen lo ba aleha ella lizman merubbe may lizman merubbe amar rav pappa leachar sheloshim yom

Tanu rabbanan kol sheloshim yom legihutz echad kelim chadashim veechad kelim yeshanim yotzin mittoch hammachbesh rabbi omer lo asru ella kelim chadashim bilvad rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer lo asru ella kelim chadashim levanim bilvad
Abbaye nafek bigrada desarbala kerabbi rava nafek bechimutzta romita summakta chadti kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon
Mippene sheamru shabbat ola veenah mafseket bene yehuda uvne galila hane amri
b: Yesh avelut beshabbat vehane amri en avelut beshabbat
Man deamar yesh avelut beshabbat dekatane ola man deamar en avelut beshabbat dekatane enah mafseket
I salka datach yesh avelut beshabbat hashta avelut nahaga afsoke mibaya
Veella ha katane ola ayede dekavae lemitne sefa enan olim tena resha ola
Ulman deamar yesh avelut beshabbat ha katane enah mafseket mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa mafsikin tena resha enah mafseket
Lema ketannae mi shemmeto muttal lefanav ochel bevayit acher en lo bayit acher ochel bevet chavero en lo bayit chavero ose lo mechitza asara tefachim en lo davar laasot mechitza machzir panav veochel

Veeno mesev veochel veeno ochel basar veeno shote yayin veen mevarech veen mezammen veen mevarchin alav veen mezammenin alav ufatur mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umin hattefilin umikkol mitzot haamurot battora

Uvshabbat mesev veochel veochel basar veshote yayin umvarech umzammen umvarchin umzammenin alav vechayyav bikriat shema uvitfila uvitfilin uvchol mitzot haamurot battora rabban gamliel omer mittoch shennitchayyev beellu nitchayyev bechullan
Veamar rabbi yochanan tashmish hammitta ika benayehu
May lav beha ka mipalgi demar savar yesh avelut beshabbat umar savar en avelut beshabbat
Mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamar tanna kamma hatam ella mishshum demeto muttal lefanav aval hacha deen meto muttal lefanav la
Vead kan la kaamar rabban gamliel hatam deakkatti la chal avelut aleh aval hacha dechal avelut aleh hachi name

a: Bea mineh rabbi yochanan mishshemuel yesh avelut beshabbat o en avelut beshabbat amar leh en avelut beshabbat
Yatvi rabbanan kammeh derav pappa vekaamri mishshemeh dishmuel avel sheshshimesh mittato bime evlo chayyav mita amar leh rav pappa asur ittemar umishshemeh derabbi yochanan ittemar

Vei shemia lechu mishshemeh dishmuel hachi shemia lechu amar rav tachlifa bar avimi amar shemuel avel shello pera veshello peram chayyav mita shenneemar rashechem al tifrau uvigdechem lo tifromu velo tamutu vego ha acher shello pera veshello peram chayyav mita
Amar rafram bar pappa tana beevel rabbati avel asur leshammesh mittato bime evlo umaase beechad sheshshimesh mittato bime evlo veshamtu chazirim et geviyyato
Amar shemuel pachaz chova neter reshut
Periat harosh chazarat kera laachorav zekifat hammitta chova neilat hassandal tashmish hammitta rechitzat yadayim veraglayim bechammin arvit reshut verav amar af periat harosh reshut
Ushmuel may shena neilat hassandal dirshut delav kulle alma avidi desayemi mesanayehu periat harosh name lav kulle alma avidi dimgallu reshayehu
Shemuel letameh deamar shemuel kol kera sheeno bishat chimum eno kera vechol atifa sheenah kaatifat yishmeelim enah atifa machve rav nachman ad gubbe dedikna
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella sheen lo minalim beraglav aval yesh lo minalim beraglav minalav mochichin alav

Kol kera sheeno bishat chimum eno kera veha amaru leh lishmuel nach nafsheh derav kera aleh teresar mane amar azal gavra dahava mistefena mineh amar leh lerabbi yochanan nach nafsheh derabbi chanina kera aleh telesar itztele melata amar azal gavra dahava mistefena mineh
Shane rabbanan dechevan dechol shata madkeri shematayehu kishat chimum dame
Amar leh ravin bar adda lerava amar talmidcha rav amram tanya avel kol shiva koro lefanav veim ba lehachalif machlif vekorea beshabbat koro laachorav veim ba lehachalif machlif veeno korea
Ki tanya hahi bichvod aviv veimmo
Otan kerain mitachin o en mitachin peligi bah avuh derav oshaya uvar kappara chad amar en mitachin vechad amar mitachin
Tistayyem daavuh derav oshaya deamar en mitachin deamar rav oshaya en mitachin mimman shemia leh lav meavuh la mibbar kappara rabbeh shemia leh

Amar rava avel metayyel beunkeli betoch beto abbaye ashkecheh lerav yosef difris leh sudara aresheh veazel veate beveteh amar leh lav savar lah mar en avelut beshabbat amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan devarim shebbetzina noheg
Rabbi eliezer omer mishshecharav bet hammikdash atzeret kashshabbat vechu amar rav gidel bar menashsheya amar shemuel halacha kerabban gamliel
Veika dematne leha derav gidel bar menashsheya aha kol sheloshim yom tinok yotze bachek venikbar beishsha achat ushne anashim aval lo beish echad ushte nashim
b: Abba shaul omer af beish echad ushte nashim veen omdin alav beshura veen omrim alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim
Ben sheloshim yotze bidloskama rabbi yehuda omer lo deloskama hannitelet bakkatef ella hannitelet baagappayim veomdin alav beshura veomrim alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim
Ben shenem asar chodesh yotze bemitta rabbi akiva omer hu ben shana veevarav keven shettayim hu ben shettayim veevarav keven shana yotze bemitta

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer hayyotze bemitta rabbim matzhivin alav eno yotze bemitta en rabbim matzhivin alav rabbi elazar ben azarya omer nikar larabbim rabbim mitassekim immo eno nikar larabbim en rabbim mitassekim immo
Uma hen behesped rabbi meir beshem rabbi yishmael omer aniyyim bene shalosh ashirim bene chamesh rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo aniyyim bene chamesh ashirim bene shesh uvne zekenim kivne aniyyim
Amar rav gidel bar menashsheya amar rav halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi yishmael
Daresh rabbi anani bar sason appitcha deve nesia yom echad lifne atzeret vaatzeret hare kan arbaa asar shema rabbi amme veikfad amar attu dideh hi derabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya hi
Derash rabbi yitzchak nappacha akkila deresh galuta yom echad lifne atzeret vaatzeret hare kan arbaa asar shema rav sheshet ikfad amar attu dideh hi derabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya hi

Deamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya minnayin laatzeret sheyyesh lah tashlumin kol shiva shenneemar bechag hammatztzot uvchag hashshavuot ma chag hammatztzot yesh lah tashlumin kol shiva af chag hashshavuot yesh lah tashlumin kol shiva

Adbereh rav pappa lerav aveya sava udrash yom echad lifne rosh hashshana verosh hashshana hare kan arbaa asar amar ravina hilkach yom echad lifne hechag vechag ushmini shello hare kan esrim veechad yom
Ravina ikla lesura difrat amar leh rav chaviva missura difrat leravina amar mar yom echad lifne rosh hashshana verosh hashshana hare kan arbaa asar amar leh ana mistabbera kerabban gamliel hu deamena
Matni en korin velo choltzin veen mavrin ella kerovav shel met veen mavrin ella al mitta zekufa

a: Gema vaafilu chacham vehatanya chacham shemmet hakkol kerovav
Hakkol kerovav salka datach ella hakkol kikrovav hakkol korin alav vehakkol choltzin alav vehakkol mavrin alav barchava la tzericha delav chacham hu
Vei adam kasher hu chayyove michayyav lemikra detanya mippene ma banav uvnotav shel adam metim keshehen ketannim kede sheyyivke veyitabbel al adam kasher

Yivke veyitabbel ervona ka shakel mineh ella mippene shello bacha vehitabbel al adam kasher shekkol habboche umitabbel al adam kasher mochalin lo al kol aonotav bishvil kavod sheasa lo delav adam kasher hu

I dekae hatam bishat yetziat neshama chayyove michayyav detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer haomed al hammet bishat yetziat neshama chayyav likroa lema ze dome lesefer tora shennisraf shechayyav likroa
Dela kae hatam bishat yetziat neshama
Ki nach nafsheh derav safra la kerau rabbanan aleh amri la gamrinan mineh amar lehu abbaye mi tanya harav shemmet chacham shemmet tanya veod kol yoma shematateh befummin beve midresha
Sevur ma dahava hava amar lehu abbaye tenena chacham kol zeman sheoskin behesped chayyavin likroa sevur lemikra lealtar amar lehu abbaye tanya chacham kevodo behespedo

Ki nach nafsheh derav huna sevur leotove sefer tora appuryeh amar lehu rav chisda milta divchayyeh la sevira leh hashta lekum leh lebad leh deamar rav tachlifa ana chazeteh lerav huna devae lemetav appuryeh vahava mannach sefer tora aleh vechaf kadda aara veotev sefer tora ilaveh alma kasavar asur leshev al gabbe mitta shessefer tora munnach aleha
La hava nafek purya mibbava sevur leshalshole derech gaggin amar lehu rav chisda ha gemirna mineh chacham kevodo derech petach

Sevur leashnoye mippurya lefurya amar lehu rav chisda hachi gemirna mineh chacham kevodo bemitta rishona deamar rav yehuda amar rav minnayin lechacham shekkevodo bemitta rishona shenneemar vayyarkivu et aron haelohim el agala chadasha perus bava veappekuh
Petach aleh rabbi abba rauy haya rabbenu shettishre alav shechina ella shebbavel garma lo
Metiv rav nachman bar chisda veamri lah rav chanan bar chisda hayo haya devar Adonai el yechezkel ben buzi hakkohen beeretz kasdim
Tefach leh avuh besandaleh amar leh lav amena lach la titrod alma may haya shehaya kevar
Ki assekuh lehatam amaru leh lerabbi amme ulrabbi assi rav huna ate amaru ki havenan hatam la hava lan ledalloye reshin mineh hashta atenan hacha ata batrin
Amaru leh arono ba rabbi amme verabbi assi nefuk rabbi ila verabbi chanina la nefuk ika deamri rabbi ila nefak rabbi chanina la nefak

Dinfak may tameh detanya aron haover mimmakom lemakom omdim alav beshura veomrim alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim dela nefak may tama detanya aron haover mimmakom lemakom en omdin alav beshura veen omrim alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim
Kashyan ahadade la kashya kan sheshshildo kayyemet kan besheen shildo kayyemet verav huna shildo kayyemet hava dela nefak la sayemuha kammeh
Amri hecha nancheh rav huna ribetz tora beyisrael verabbi chiyya ribetz tora beyisrael hava

Man meayyel leh amar lehu rav chagga ana meayyelna leh deokemteh letalmuday ki havena bar tamne sere shenin vela chaze li keri umshamma li kammeh vidai beovadeh deoma chad ithaficha leh retzua ditfilin vitev alah arbein taaniyyata

Ayeleh hava gane yehuda miyyammineh daavuh vechizkiyya missemaleh amar leh yehuda lechizkiyya kum midduchtich delav orach ara dekaem rav huna bahade dekaem kam bahadeh ammuda denura chazyeh rav chagga ibit zakfeh laaroneh unfak ata vehay dela ianash mishshum dezakfeh laaroneh derav huna
Ki nach nafsheh derav chisda sevur leotove sefer tora appuryeh amar lehu rabbi yitzchak milta dilrabbeh la sevira leh anan nekum naaved leh
Sevur dela lemishlal kirayehu amar lehu rabbi yitzchak bar amme chacham kevan shehechziru penehem meachore hammitta shollin
Ki nach nafsheh derabba bar huna verav hamnuna assekunhu lehatam
b: Ki meto aggishra kamu gamle amar lehu hahu tayyaa may hay amaru leh rabbanan deka avdi yekara ahadade mar amar mar neul beresha umar amar mar neul beresha amar dina hu derabba bar huna leul beresha chalef gamleh derabba bar huna netur kakkeh veshinneh dehahu tayyaa

Petach aleh hahu yanoka geza yeshishim ala mibbavel veimmo sefer milchamot kaat vekippod huchpelu lirot beshod vashever habba mishshinar katzaf al olamo vechamas mimmennu nefashot vesamach bahem kechalla chadasha rochev aravot sas vesamach bevo elav nefesh naki vetzaddik
Ki nach nafsheh deravina petach aleh hahu safdana temarim haniu rosh al tzaddik kattamar nasim lelot keyamim al mesim lelot keyamim

Amar leh rav ashe levar kipok hahu yoma may amratte amar leh amena im baarazim nafla shalhevet ma yaasu ezove kir liveyatan bechakka hoala ma yaasu dege rekak benachal shotef nafla chakka ma yaasu me gevim
Amar leh bar avin chas veshalom dechakka veshalhevet betzaddike amena umay amratte amena bechu laavelim velo laaveda shehi limnucha veanu laanacha
Chalash dateh alayehu veithafuch karayehu hahu yoma la ato leaspodeh vehayenu deamar rav ashe la bar kipok chaletz vela bar avin chaletz
Rava ki hava ata lediglat amar leh levar avin kum ema milta kae veamar bau rov shelishit bemayim zechor verachem tainu meacharecha keishsha mibbalah al taznichenu keot me mara
Chanin yochanan zera abba yaakov yose shemuel chiyya menachem siman

Rabbi chanin chatneh deve nesia hava la ka hao leh bene bea rachame vahao leh hahu yoma dahava leh nach nafsheh petach aleh hahu safdana simcha letuga nehpacha sason veyagon nidbaku beet simchato neenach beet chaninato avad chanino assiku leh chanin al shemeh

Ki nach nafsheh derabbi yochanan petach aleh rabbi yitzchak ben elazar kashe hayyom leyisrael keom bo hashshemesh batztzohorayim dichtiv vehaya bayyom hahu veheveti hashshemesh batztzohorayim veamar rabbi yochanan ze yomo shel yoshiyyahu

Ki nach nafsheh derabbi yochanan yatev rabbi amme shiva ushloshim amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba rabbi amme daavad legarmeh hu daavad dehachi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan afilu rabbo shellimdo chochma eno yoshev alav ella yom echad
Ki nach nafsheh derabbi zera petach aleh hahu safdana eretz shinar hara veyalda eretz tzevi gidla shaashueha oy na lah amra rakkat ki ibbeda keli chemdatah

Ki nach nafsheh derabbi avahu achitu ammude dekesari mayya derabbi yose shefau marzeve detzipori dema derabbi yaakov itchamiu kochve bimama derabbi assi iakaru kol ilanayya derabbi chiyya nechitu kefe denura merkia derabbi menachem berabbi yose ishtao tzalmanayya vahao lemachletzayya

Derabbi tanchum bar chiyya itkatztzatzu kol anderatayya derabbi elyashiv ichataru shivin machtarta binhardea derav hamnuna nechitu kefe devarda merkia derabba verav yosef neshuk kefe difrat ahadade deabbaye verava neshuk kefe dediglat ahadade ki nach nafsheh derabbi mesharsheya teun dikle shitze
Tanu rabbanan

a: Veellu kerain sheen mitachin hakkorea al aviv veal immo veal rabbo shellimdo tora veal nasi veal av bet din veal shemuot haraot veal birkat hashshem veal sefer tora shennisraf veal are yehuda veal hammikdash veal yerushalayim vekorea al mikdash umosif al yerushalayim
Aviv veimmo verabbo shellimdo tora menalan dichtiv veelisha roe vehu metzaek avi avi rechev yisrael ufarashav avi avi ze aviv veimmo rechev yisrael ufarashav ze rabbo shellimdo tora
May mashma kedimtargem rav yosef rabbi rabbi detav lehon leyisrael bitzloteh mertikin ufarashin
Velo mitachin menalan dichtiv vayyachazek bivgadav vayyikraem lishnayim keraim mimmashma shenneemar vayyikraem eni yodea shellishnayim ella melammed shekkeruim veomdim lishnayim leolam
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan eliyyahu chay hu amar leh kevan dichtiv velo raahu od legabbe dideh kemet dame

Nasi veav bet din ushmuot haraot menalan dichtiv vayyachazek david bivgadav vayyikraem vegam kol haanashim asher itto vayyispedu vayyivku vayyatzumu ad haarev al shaul veal yehonatan beno veal am Adonai veal bet yisrael ki naflu becharev
Shaul ze nasi yehonatan ze av bet din al am Adonai veal bet yisrael ellu shemuot haraot
Amar leh rav bar shabba lerav kahana veema ad dehau kullehu amar leh al al hifsik hainyan
Umi karinan ashshemuot haraot veha amaru leh lishmuel ketal shabbur malka teresar alfe yehudae bimzigat kesari vela kera lo amru ella berov tzibbur uchmaase shehaya

Umi ketal shabbur malka yehudae veha amar leh shabbur malka lishmuel tete li dela ketali yehudi meolam hatam inhu garmi lenafshayehu deamar rabbi amme lekal yetere dimzigat kesari peka shura deludkiyya
Al birkat hashshem menalan dichtiv vayyavo elyakim ben chilkiyya asher al habbayit veshevna hassofer veoach ben asaf hammazkir el chizkiyyahu kerue vegadim
Tanu rabbanan echad hashshomea veechad hashshomea mippi hashshomea chayyav likroa vehaedim enan chayyavin likroa shekkevar karu beshaa sheshshamu
Beshaa sheshshamu may have ha ka shami hashta la salka datach dichtiv vayehi kishmoa hammelech chizkiyyahu vayyikra et begadav hammelech kara vehem lo karu
Velo mitachin menalan atya keria keria
Sefer tora shennisraf menalan dichtiv vayehi kikro yehudi shalosh delatot vearbaa veyikraeha betaar hassofer vehashlech el haesh asher el haach vego may shalosh delatot vearbaa

Amaru leh lihoyakim katav yirmeya sefer kinot amar lehu ma ketiv beh echa yashva badad amar lehu ana malka amar leh bacho tivke ballayela ana malka galta yehuda meoni ana malka darche tziyyon avelot ana malka
Hau tzareha lerosh amar lehu man amrah ki Adonai hogah al rov peshaeha miyyad kadar kol azkarot shebbah usrafan baesh vehayenu dichtiv velo fachadu velo karu et bigdehem mikkelal divo lemikra
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye emar mishshum shemuot haraot amar leh shemuot raot behahi shata mi hao
Amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna haroe sefer tora shennikra chayyav likroa shette keriot echad al haggevil veechad al hakketav shenneemar achare serof hammelech et hammegilla veet haddevarim
Rabbi abba verav huna bar chiyya hau yatvi kammeh derabbi abba bea leippannoye shakleh letotefteh achateh abbe sadya atay bat naamita bea lemivleeh

Amar hashta ki chayevan li shette keriot amar leh mena lach ha veha bedidi hava ovada vaatay lekammeh derav matna vela hava bideh atay lekammeh derav yehuda vaamar li hachi amar shemuel lo amru ella bizroa uchmaase shehaya
Are yehuda menalan dichtiv vayyavou anashim mishshechem mishshilo umishshomron shemonim ish megulleche zakan ukrue vegadim umitgoddim umincha ulvona beyadam lehavi bet Adonai vego

Amar rabbi chelbo amar ulla biraa amar rabbi elazar haroe are yehuda bechurbanan omer are kodshecha hau midbar vekorea yerushalayim bechurbanah omer tziyyon midbar hayata yerushalam shemama vekorea bet hammikdash bechurbano omer bet kodshenu vetifartenu asher hillucha avotenu haya lisrefat esh vechol machamaddenu haya lechorba vekorea
Korea al mikdash umosif al yerushalayim urminhu echad hashshomea veechad haroe kevan shehiggia letzofim korea vekorea al mikdash bifne atzmo veal yerushalayim bifne atzmah
La kashya ha defaga bammikdash beresha ha defaga birushalayim beresha
Tanu rabbanan vechullan rashshain leshollan ulmollan ulloktan velaasotan kemin sullamot aval lo leachotan
Amar rav chisda
b: Uvichuy alekkesanderi
Tanu rabbanan hakkorea mittoch hashshelal mittoch hammelal mittoch halleket mittoch hassullamot lo yatza mittoch haichuy yatza amar rav chisda uvichuy alekkesanderi
Tanu rabbanan rashshay lehofcho lematta ulachoto rabbi shimon ben elazar oser leachoto uchshem shehammocher asur leachoto kach hallokeach asur leachoto ulfichach mocher tzarich lehodio lallokeach
Tanu rabbanan techilat keria tefach vetosefet shalosh etzbaot divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer techilat keria shalosh etzbaot vetosefet kol shehu
Amar ulla halacha kerabbi meir bikria vahalacha kerabbi yehuda betosefet tanya name hachi rabbi yose omer techilat keria tefach vetosefet kol shehu
Tanu rabbanan amru lo met aviv vekara met beno vehosif tachton mitache elon eno mitache
Met beno vekara met aviv vehosif elon mitache tachton eno mitache
Met aviv met immo met achiv meta achoto korea kera echad lechullan rabbi yehuda ben betira omer al kullan kera echad al aviv veimmo kera echad lefi sheen mosifin al kera aviv veimmo
May tama amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lefi sheenan betosefet
Amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira umi amar shemuel hachi vehaamar shemuel halacha kedivre hammekel beevel avelut lechud keria lechud
Ad hechan korea ad tiburo veyesh omrim ad libbo af al pi sheen reaya ledavar zecher laddavar shenneemar vekiru levavchem veal bigdechem

Higgia letiburo marchik shalosh etzbaot vekorea nitmalle millefanav machziro laachorav nitmalle millemala hofcho millematta vehakkorea millematta umin hatztzedadin lo yatza ella shekkohen gadol porem millematta
Peligu bah rav matna umar ukva vetarvayehu mishshemeh daavuh dishmuel velevi chad amar kol shiva korea leachar shiva mosif vechad amar kol sheloshim korea leachar sheloshim mosif
Matkef lah rabbi zera man deamar kol shiva korea ammay delo nitan leshollo ella ha deamar mar haishsha sholalto lealtar hacha name
Hatam mishshum kevod ishsha hu
Man deamar kol sheloshim korea ammay delo nitan leachoto ella leaviv ulimmo delo nitan leachoto leolam hachi name
Hatam mishshum kevod aviv veimmo hu
Tanu rabbanan hayyotze beveged karua lifne hammet hare ze gozel et hammetim veet hachayyim

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer haomer lachavero hashileni chalukcha veelech vaavakker et abba shehu chole vehalach umtzao shemmet korea umacho uchsheyyavo leveto machazir lo chaluko venoten lo deme kiro veim lo hodio hare ze lo yigga bo
Tanu rabbanan chole shemmet lo met en modiin oto shemmet shemma tittaref dato alav veen mekarin befanav umshattekin et hannashim mippanav
Umkarin lakkatan mippene ogmat nefesh vekorin al chamiv veal chamoto mippene kevod ishto
Veamar rav pappa tana beevel rabbati avel lo yanniach tinok betoch cheko mippene shemmevio lide sechok venimtza mitganne al habberiyyot
Veen mavrin al mittot zekufot tanu rabbanan haholech levet haevel im haya libbo gas bo yavruhu al mittot kefuot veim lav yavruhu al mittot zekufot
Rava itra beh milta al legabbeh abba bar marta dehu abba bar minome rava zakef abba bar marta kafe amar kamma let beh data lehay tzurba merabbanan
Tanu rabbanan haholech mimmakom lemakom

a: Im yachol lemaet beisko yemaet veim lav yegalgel immahen
Tanu rabbanan meematay kofin et hammittot mishsheyyetze mippetach beto divre rabbi eliezer rabbi yehoshua omer mishsheyyissatem haggolel

Maase shemmet rabban gamliel hazzaken kevan sheyyatza mippetach beto amar lahem rabbi eliezer kefu mittotechem vechevan shennistam haggolel amar lahem rabbi yehoshua kefu mittotechem amru lo kevar kafinu al pi zaken

Tanu rabbanan meematay zokfin et hammittot beerev shabbat min hammincha ulmala amar rabba bar huna af al pi chen eno yoshev aleha ad shettechshach ulmotzae shabbat af al pi sheen lo leshev ella yom echad chozer vechofe

Tanu rabbanan hakkofe mittato lo mittato bilvad hu kofe ella kol mittot sheyyesh lo betoch beto hu kofe vaafilu yesh lo eser mittot baasara mekomot kofe et kullan vaafilu chamishsha achin umet echad kullan kofin
Veim hayeta mitta hamuchedet lechelim en tzarich lichpotah dargesh en tzarich lichpoto ella zokfo rabban shimon ben gamliel omer dargesh mattir et karbitav vehu nofel meelav
May dargesh amar ulla arsa degadda
Amar leh rabba ella meatta gabbe melech ditnan kol haam mesubbim al haaretz vehu mesev al haddargesh mi ika mide dead haidana la otvineh vehashta motvinan leh
Matkef lah rav ashe may kushya mide dehave aachila ushtiyya dead haidana la ochlineh vela ashkineh hashta ochlineh veashkineh

Ella i kashya ha kashya ditnan dargesh eno tzarich lichpoto ella zokfo vei arsa degadda ammay eno tzarich lichpoto ha tenan hakkofe mittato lo mittato bilvad hu kofe ella kol mittot sheyyesh lo betoch beto kofe
Umay kashya mide dehave ammitta hamuchedet lechelim detanya im hayeta mitta hamuchedet lechelim eno tzarich lichpotah
Ella i kashya ha kashya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer dargesh mattir karbitav vehu nofel meelav vei salka datach arsa degadda may karbitin it leh
Ki ata ravin amar leh hahu merabbanan verav tachlifa bar mareva shemeh dahava shechiach beshuka degildae may dargesh arsa detzalla
Itmar name amar rabbi yirmeya dargesh serugo mittocho mitta serugah al gabbah
Amar rabbi yaakov bar acha amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel itmar name amar rabbi yaakov bar acha amar rabbi assi mitta shennakliteha yotzin zokfah vedayyo
Tanu rabbanan yashen al gabbe kisse al gabbe udyani gedola al gabbe karka lo yatza yede chovato amar rabbi yochanan shello kiyyem kefiyyat hammitta
Tanu rabbanan mechabbedin umarbitzin bevet haevel umdichin kearot vechosot utzlochiyyot vekitoniyyot bevet haevel veen meviin et hammugmar veet habbesamim levet haevel
Ini veha tane bar kappara en mevarchin lo al hammugmar velo al habbesamim bevet haevel baroche hu dela mevarchin ha etoye mayetinan
La kashya ha bevet haevel ha bevet hamnachamin
Matni en molichin levet haevel lo betavla velo beiskutla velo bekanon ella besallim veen omrim birkat avelim bammoed aval omdin beshura umnachamin ufotrin et harabbim
En mannichin et hammitta barchov shello lehargil et hahesped velo shel nashim leolam mippene hakkavod

Gema tanu rabbanan barishona hau molichin bevet haevel ashirim biklatot shel kesef veshel zahav vaaniyyim besalle netzarim shel arava kelufa vehau aniyyim mitbayeshim hitkinu sheyehu hakkol meviin besalle netzarim shel arava kelufa mippene kevodan shel aniyyim

Tanu rabbanan barishona hau mashkin bevet haevel ashirim bizchuchit levana vaaniyyim bizchuchit tzevua vehau aniyyim mitbayeshin hitkinu sheyehu hakkol mashkin bizchuchit tzevua mippene kevodan shel aniyyim

Barishona hau megallin pene ashirim umchassin pene aniyyim mippene shehau mushcharin penehen mippene vatztzoret vehau aniyyim mitbayeshin hitkinu sheyehu mechassin pene hakkol mippene kevodan shel aniyyim
Barishona hau motziin ashirim bedargesh vaaniyyim
b: Bichlicha vehau aniyyim mitbayeshin hitkinu sheyehu hakkol motziin bichlicha mippene kevodan shel aniyyim
Barishona hau mannichin et hammugmar tachat chole meayim metim vehau chole meayim chayyim mitbayeshin hitkinu sheyehu mannichin tachat hakkol mippene kevodan shel chole meayim chayyim

Barishona hau matbilin et hakkelim al gabbe niddot metot vehau niddot chayyot mitbayeshot hitkinu sheyehu matbilin al gabbe kol hannashim mippene kevodan shel niddot chayyot barishona matbilin al gabbe zavin metim vehau zavin chayyim mitbayeshin hitkinu sheyehu matbilin al gav hakkol mippene kevodan shel zavin chayyim

Barishona hayeta hotzaat hammet kasha likrovav yoter mimmitato ad shehau kerovav mannichin oto uvorchin ad shebba rabban gamliel venahag kallut rosh beatzmo veyatza bichle fishtan venahagu haam acharav latzet bichle fishtan amar rav pappa vehaidana nehug alma afilu betzarda bar zuza
En mannichin et hammitta barchov amar rav pappa en moed bifne talmid chacham vechol shekken chanukka ufurim
Vehane mile befanav aval shello befanav la ini veha rav kahana safdeh lerav zevid minnehardea befum nahara amar rav pappe yom shemua hava vechivfanav dame
Amar ulla hesped al lev dichtiv al shadayim sofdim tipuach bayyad kilus baregel
Tanu rabbanan hamkalles lo yekalles besandal ella beminal mippene hassakkana
Amar rabbi yochanan avel kevan shennina rosho shuv en menachamin rashshain leshev etzlo
Veamar rabbi yochanan hakkol chayyavin laamod mippene nasi chutz meavel vechole veamar rabbi yochanan lakkol omrim lahem shevu chutz meavel vechole
Amar rav yehuda amar rav avel yom rishon asur leechol lechem mishshello middaamar leh rachamana lichezkel velechem anashim lo tochel rabba verav yosef mechallefi seodatayehu lahadade
