Veella kera lemay ata lichdaacherim ditnan acherim omrim hamkammetz vehamtzaref nechoshet vehabbursi peturin min hariyya mishshum shenneemar kol zechurcha mi sheyyachol laalot im kol zechurcha yatzu ellu sheenan reuyin laalot im kol zechurcha
Nashim vaavadim sheenan meshuchrarim vechu bishlama nashim kedaamaran ella avadim menalan amar rav huna amar kera el pene haadon Adonai mi sheen lo ella adon echad yatza ze sheyyesh lo adon acher
Ha lema li kera mikkede kol mitzva shehaishsha chayyevet bah eved chayyav bah kol mitzva sheen haishsha chayyevet bah en haeved chayyav bah degamar lah lah meishsha

Amar ravina lo nitzrecha ella lemi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin dayeka name dekatane nashim vaavadim sheenan meshuchrarin may sheenan meshuchrarin ilema sheenan meshuchrarin kelal litne avadim setama ella lav sheenan meshuchrarin ligmare umay ninhu mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin shema minah

Vehachiger vehassome vechole vehazzaken tanu rabbanan regalim perat levaale kabbin davar acher regalim perat lechiger ulchole ulsome ulzaken ulsheeno yachol laalot beraglav vesheeno yachol laalot beraglav leetoye may amar rava leetoye
b: Mefanneki dichtiv ki tavou leraot panay mi vikkesh zot miyyedchem remos chatzeray
Tana hearel vehattame peturin min hariyya bishlama tame dichtiv uvata shamma vahavetem shamma kol sheyyeshno bevia yeshno bahavaa vechol sheeno bevia eno bahavaa
Ella arel menalan ha manni rabbi akiva hi dimrabbe learel ketame detanya rabbi akiva omer ish ish lerabbot et hearel
Tanu rabbanan tame patur min hariyya dichtiv uvata shamma vahavetem shamma kol sheyyeshno bevia yeshno bahavaa vechol sheeno bevia eno bahavaa
Rabbi yochanan ben dahavay omer mishshum rabbi yehuda some beachat meenav patur min hariyya shenneemar yire yerae kederech shebba lirot kach ba leraot ma ba lirot bishte enav af leraot bishte enav
Rav huna ki mate lehay kera yire yerae bache amar eved sherabbo metzappe lo liroto yitrachek mimmennu dichtiv ki tavou leraot panay mi vikkesh zot miyyedchem remos chatzeray
Rav huna ki mate lehay kera bache vezavachta shelamim veachalta sham eved sherabbo metzappe leechol al shulchano yitrachek mimmennu dichtiv lamma li rov zivchechem yomar Adonai

Rabbi elazar ki mate lehay kera bache velo yachlu echav laanot oto ki nivhalu mippanav uma tochecha shel basar vadam kach tochecha shel hakkadosh baruch hu al achat kamma vechamma rabbi elazar ki mate lehay kera bache vayyomer shemuel el shaul lamma hirgaztani lehaalot oti uma shemuel hatztzaddik haya mityare min haddin anu al achat kamma vechamma

Shemuel may hi dichtiv vattomer haishsha el shaul elohim raiti olim olim tere mashma chad shemuel veidach daazal shemuel veatyeh lemoshe bahadeh amar leh dilma chas veshalom ledina mitbeena kum bahaday deleka milta dichtavte beorayeta dela kayyemtah

Rabbi amme ki mate lehay kera bache yitten beafar pihu ulay yesh tikva amar kulle hay veulay rabbi amme ki mate lehay kera bache bakkeshu tzedek bakkeshu anava ulay tissatru beom af Adonai amar kulle hay veulay rabbi assi ki mate lehay kera bache sinu ra veehevu tov vehatztzigu vashshaar mishpat ulay yechenan elohe tzevaot kulle hay veulay

Rav yosef ki mate lehay kera bache veyesh nispe belo mishpat amar mi ika deazel bela zimneh in ki ha derav bivi bar abbaye hava shechiach gabbeh malach hammavet amar leh lishlucheh zil ayeti li miryam megaddela sear nashya azal ayeti leh miryam megaddela dardeke
Amar leh ana miryam megaddela sear neshayya amari lach amar leh i hachi ahderah amar leh hoil veayetitah leheve leminyana ella hechi yechelte lah havat nekita metara bidah vahavat ka shagra

a: Umcharya tannura shekalta veannachta aggabbeh decharah kedacha veitra mazzalah veayetitah
Amar leh rav bivi bar abbaye it lechu reshuta lemibad hachi amar leh vela ketiv veyesh nispe belo mishpat amar leh vehachtiv dor holech vedor ba
Amar deraena lehu ana ad demalu lehu ledara vahadar mashlemna leh leduma amar leh sof sof sheneh may avdatte amar i ika tzurba merabbanan demaber bemileh mosefna lehu leh vehaveya chillufeh

Rabbi yochanan ki mate lehay kera bache vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam eved sherabbo mesitin lo venisat takkana yesh lo rabbi yochanan ki mate lehay kera bache hen bikdoshav lo yaamin i bikdoshav lo yaamin beman yaamin

Yoma chad hava ka azel beorcha chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava menakket tene shavek hanach dimto veshakel hanach dela meto amar leh lav hane meallan tefe amar leh hane leorcha baenan lehu hane natran vehane la natran amar hayenu dichtiv hen bikdoshav lo yaamin
Ini veha hahu talmida dahava beshivavuteh derabbi alekkesanderi ushchev addezutar vaamar i bae hay merabbanan hava chaye veim ita dilma mehen bikdoshav lo yaamin hava hahu mevaet berabbotav hava

Rabbi yochanan ki mate lehay kera bache vekaravti alechem lammishpat vehayiti ed memaher bamchashshefim uvamnaafim uvannishbaim lashshaker uvoshke sechar sachir eved sherabbo mekarvo leduno ummaher lahaido takkana yesh lo
Amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay oy lanu sheshshakal alenu hakkatuv kallot kachamurot

Amar resh lakish kol hammatte dino shel ger keilu matte dino shel mala shenneemar umatte ger umatti ketiv amar rabbi chanina bar pappa kol haose davar umitcharet bo mochalin lo miyyad shenneemar velo yereuni ha yereuni mochalin lahem miyyad
Rabbi yochanan ki mate lehay kera bache ki et kol maase haelohim yavi vemishpat al kol nelam eved sherabbo shokel lo shegagot kizdonot takkana yesh lo
May al kol nelam amar rav ze hahoreg kina bifne chavero venimas bah ushmuel amar ze harak bifne chavero venimas

May im tov veim ra amri deve rabbi yannay ze hannoten tzedaka leani befarhesya ki ha derabbi yannay chazyeh lehahu gavra deka yahev zuza leani befarhesya amar leh mutav dela yehavte leh mehashta dihavte leh vechassefteh
Deve rabbi shela amri ze hannoten tzedaka leishsha basseter deka mayete lah lide chashada rava amar ze hamshagger leishto basar sheeno mechuttach bearve shabbatot
Veha rava meshaggar shane bat rav chisda dekim leh begavah divkia
Rabbi yochanan ki mate lehay kera bache vehaya ki timtzena oto raot rabbot vetzarot eved sherabbo mamtzi lo raot vetzarot takkana yesh lo
May raot vetzarot amar rav raot shennaasot tzarot zo lazo kegon zibura veakrabba
Ushmuel amar ze hammamtzi lo maot leani bishat dochko amar rava hayenu deamri inashe zuza lealla la shechicha litlita shechiach
Vechara appi vo vayyom hahu vaazavtim vehistarti fanay mehem amar rav bardela bar tavome amar rav kol sheeno behester panim eno mehem kol sheeno bivehaya leechol
b: Eno mehem amaru leh rabbanan lerava mar la behester panim iteh vela bivehaya leechol iteh amar lehu mi yaditu kamma meshaddarna betzina be shabbur malka afilu hachi yehavu beh rabbanan enayehu addehachi shaddur deve shabbur malka vegarvuhu amar hayenu detanya amar rabban shimon ben gamliel kol makom shennatnu chachamim enehem o mita o oni
Veanochi haster astir panay bayyom hahu amar rava amar hakkadosh baruch hu af al pi shehistarti panay mehem bachalom adabber bo rav yosef amar yado netuya alenu shenneemar uvtzel yadi kissiticha

Rabbi yehoshua ben chananya hava kae be kesar achvi leh hahu mina amma deahderinhu mareh leappeh mineh achvi leh yado netuya alenu amar leh kesar lerabbi yehoshua may achvi lach amma deahderinhu mareh leappeh mineh vaana machvena leh yado netuya alenu
Amaru leh lehahu mina may achviyt leh amma deahderinhu mareh mineh umay achvi lach la yadana amaru gavra dela yada may machu leh bemachog yachve kamme malka appekuhu vekatluhu

Ki ka nicha nafsheh derabbi yehoshua ben chananya amaru leh rabbanan may tehve alan mimminae amar lahem avda etza mibbanim nisrecha chochmatam kevan sheavda etza mibbanim nisrecha chochmatan shel ummot haolam
Vei baet ema mehacha vayyomer nisa venelecha veelcha lenegdecha

Rabbi ila hava salek bedarga deve rabba bar shela shameh leyanoka dahava ka kare ki hinne yotzer harim uvore ruach umaggid leadam ma sicho amar eved sherabbo maggid lo ma sicho takkana yesh lo may ma sicho amar rav afilu sicha yetera shebben ish leishto maggidim lo leadam bishat mita
Ini veha rav kahana hava gane tute puryeh derav veshameh desach vetzachak veasa tzerachav amar dame pummeh derav keman dela teim leh tavshila amar leh kahana pok lav orach ara
La kashya kan ditzrich leratztzoyah ha dela tzerich leratztzoyah

Veim lo tishmauha bemistarim tivke nafshi mippene geva amar rav shemuel bar inya mishshemeh derav makom yesh lo lehakkadosh baruch hu umistarim shemo may mippene geva amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak mippene gaaotan shel yisrael shennitla mehem venittena laggoyim rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar mippene gaaotah shel malchut shamayim
Umi ika bechiyya kammeh hakkadosh baruch hu vehaamar rav pappa en atzivut lifne hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar hod vehadar lefanav oz vechedva bimkomo la kashya ha bevatte gavae ha bevatte varae

Uvvatte varae la veha ketiv vayyikra adonay Adonai tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulmisped ulkorcha velachagor sak shane churban bet hammikdash daafilu malache shalom becho shenneemar hen erellam tzaaku chutza malache shalom mar yivkaun

Vedamoa tidma veterad eni dima ki nishba eder Adonai amar rabbi elazar shalosh demaot hallalu lamma achat al mikdash rishon veachat al mikdash sheni veachat al yisrael sheggalu mimmekoman veika deamri achat al bitul tora

Bishlama leman deamar al yisrael sheggalu hayenu dichtiv ki nishba eder Adonai ella leman deamar al bitul tora may ki nishba eder Adonai kevan sheggalu yisrael mimmekoman en lecha bitul tora gadol mizze
Tanu rabbanan shelosha hakkadosh baruch hu boche alehen bechol yom al sheefshar laasok battora veeno osek veal shei efshar laasok betora veosek veal parnas hammitgae al hatztzibbur
Rabbi hava naket sefer kinot veka kare begaveh ki meta lehay pesuka hishlich mishshamayim eretz nefal min yedeh amar meigara ram levera ammikta

Rabbi verabbi chiyya hao shakli veazli beorcha ki meto lehahu mata amri ika tzurba merabbanan hacha nezil venakbel appeh amri ika tzurba merabbanan hacha umor enayim hu amar leh rabbi chiyya lerabbi tiv atte la tezalzel binsiutach ezil ana veakbel appeh
Takfeh vaazal bahadeh ki hao mipatri mineh amar lehu attem hikbaltem panim hannirim veenan roin tizku lehakbil panim haroim veenan nirin amar leh ichu hashta menatan mehay birketa
Amaru leh mimman shemia lach mippirkeh derabbi yaakov shemia li derabbi yaakov ish kefar chitayya hava mekabbel appeh derabbeh kol yoma ki kash amar leh la nitztaar mar dela yachel mar
Amar leh mi zutar may dichtiv behu berabbanan vichi od lanetzach lo yire hashshachat ki yire chachamim yamutu uma haroe chachamim bemitatan yichye bechayyehen al achat kamma vechamma

Rav idi avuh derabbi yaakov bar idi hava regil dahava azel telata yarche beorcha vechad yoma beve rav vahao karu leh rabbanan bar be rav dechad yoma chalash dateh kare annafsheh sechok lereehu ehye vego amar leh rabbi yochanan bematuta minach la tanesh lehu rabbanan

Nefak rabbi yochanan leve midresha udrash veoti yom yom yidroshun vedaat derachay yechpatzun vechi bayyom dorshin oto uvallayela en dorshin oto ella lomar lach kol haosek battora afilu yom echad bashshana maale alav hakkatuv keilu asak kol hashshana kullah

Vechen bemiddat puranut dichtiv bemispar hayyamim asher tartem et haaretz vechi arbaim shana chatu vahalo arbaim yom chatu ella lomar lach kol haover avera afilu yom echad bashshana maale alav hakkatuv keilu avar kol hashshana kullah
E zehu katan kol sheeno yachol lirkov al ketefo shel aviv matkef lah rabbi zera

a: Ad hacha man atyeh
Amar leh abbaye ad hacha demichayeva imeh besimcha ayetiteh imeh mikkan veelach im yachol laalot veleechoz beyado shel aviv mirushalayim lehar habbayit chayyav vei la patur
Heshiv rabbi tachat bet hillel ledivre bet shammay vechanna lo alata ki amra leishah ad yiggamel hannaar vahaviotiv veha shemuel deyachol lirkov al ketefo shel aviv hava
Amar leh avuh ultamach tikshe lach channa gufah mi la michayeva besimcha ella channa mefannekuta yattirta chazya beh bishmuel vechashsha beh bishmuel lechulsha deorcha
Bae rabbi shimon katan chiger ledivre bet shammay vesome ledivre shenehem mahu

Hechi dame ilema bechiger sheeno yachol lehitpashshet vesome sheeno yachol lehitpatteach hashta gadol patur katan mibaya la tzericha bechiger sheyyachol lehitpashshet vesome sheyyachol lehitpatteach may
Amar abbaye kol hecha degadol michayyav middeorayeta katan name mechannechinan leh midderabbanan kol hecha degadol patur middeorayeta midderabbanan katan name patur
Bet shammay omrim hariyya shette kesef ku

Tanu rabbanan bet shammay omrim hariyya shette kesef vehachagiga maa kesef shehariyya ola kullah laggavoha ma sheen ken bachagiga veod matzinu baatzeret sheriba bahen hakkatuv beolot yoter mibbishlamim
Uvet hillel omrim hariyya maa kesef vachagiga shette chesef shechagiga yeshnah lifne haddibur ma sheen ken biriyya veod matzinu bannesiim sheriba bahen hakkatuv bishlamim yoter mibbeolot

Uvet hillel may tama la amri kevet shammay deka amratte reiyya adifa deola kullah laggavoha adderabba chagiga adifa deit bah shette achilot udka amratte nelaf meatzeret danin korban yachid mikkorban yachid veen danin korban yachid mikkorban tzibbur
Uvet shammay may tama la amri kevet hillel dekaamratte chagiga adifa deyeshnah lifne haddibur reiyya name yeshnah lifne haddibur
Udkaamratte nelaf minnesiim danin davar hannoheg ledorot middavar hannoheg ledorot veen danin davar hannoheg ledorot middavar sheeno noheg ledorot
Uvet hillel may shena chagiga deyeshnah lifne haddibur dichtiv vayyizbechu zevachim shelamim reiyya name hachtiv vayyaalu olot
Kasavri bet hillel ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar olat tamid havay uvet shammay savri ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar olat reiyya havay

Amar abbaye bet shammay verabbi elazar verabbi yishmael kullehu sevira lehu ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar olat reiyya havay uvet hillel verabbi akiva verabbi yose haggelili kullehu sevira lehu ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar olat tamid havay
Bet shammay ha daamaran rabbi yishmael detanya rabbi yishmael omer kelalot neemru besinay
b: Ufratot beohel moed verabbi akiva omer kelalot ufratot neemru besinay venishnu beohel moed venishtalleshu bearvot moav vei salka datach ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar olat tamid havay
Mi ika mide demeikara la bae hefshet venituach ulvassof bae hefshet venituach
Rabbi elazar detanya olat tamid haasuya behar sinay rabbi elazar omer maaseha neemru besinay vehi atzmah lo karva
Rabbi akiva omer karva veshuv lo paska ella ma ani mekayyem hazzevachim umincha higgashtem li vammidbar arbaim shana bet yisrael
Shivto shel levi shello avdu avoda zara hen hikrivu otah
Bet hillel ha daamaran rabbi akiva ha name daamaran rabbi yose haggelili detanya rabbi yose haggelili omer shalosh mitzot nitztauu yisrael baalotam laregel reiyya vachagiga vesimcha
Yesh bariyya sheen bishtehen veyesh bachagiga sheen bishtehen yesh bassimcha sheen bishtehen yesh bariyya sheen bishtehen shehariyya ola kullah laggavoha ma sheen ken bishtehen
Yesh bachagiga ma sheen bishtehen shechagiga yeshnah lifne haddibur ma sheen bishtehen yesh bassimcha ma sheen bishtehen shehassimcha noheget baanashim uvnashim ma sheen bishtehen
Verabbi yishmael may tama ka mokmatte leh kevet shammay i salka datach ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar olat tamid havay mi ika mide demeikara la bae hefshet venituach ulvassof bae hefshet venituach
Veha rabbi yose haggelili deamar ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar olat tamid havay meikara la bae hefshet venituach ulvassof bae hefshet venituach
Detanya rabbi yose haggelili omer ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar enah teuna hefshet venituach lefi sheen hefshet venituach ella meohel moed veelach semi mikkan rabbi yishmael
Bae rav chisda hay kera hechi ketiv vayyishlach et naare bene yisrael vayyaalu olot kevasim vayyizbechu zevachim shelamim la parim o dilma ide veide parim hao
Lemay nafka minah mar zutra amar lefisuk teamim
Rav acha bereh derava amar laomer hare alay ola kaola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar may parim hao o kevasim hao teku
Tenan hatam ellu devarim sheen lahem shiur

a: Happea vehabbikkurim vehareaon ugmilut chasadim vetalmud tora

Amar rabbi yochanan kisvurin anu lomar hareaon en lo shiur lemala aval yesh lo shiur lematta ad shebba rabbi oshaya berabbi velimed hareaon en lo shiur lo lemala velo lematta aval chachamim omrim hariyya maa kesef vehachagiga shette chesef
May hareaon rabbi yochanan amar reiyyat panim baazara veresh lakish amar reiyyat panim bekorban
Baikar haregel kulle alma la peligi diriyyat panim bekorban ki peligi bishar yemot haregel kol hecha daata veayeti kulle alma la peligi dimkabbelinan mineh ki peligi daata vela ayeti
Derabbi yochanan savar reiyyat panim baazara dechol emat deate la tzarich leetoye resh lakish amar reiyyat panim bekorban dechol emat deate tzarich leetoye
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan velo yerau fanay rekam amar leh beikar haregel

Etiveh velo yerau fanay rekam bizvachim atta omer bizvachim o eno ella beofot umnachot vedin hu neemra chagiga lahedot veneemra reiyya laggavoha ma chagiga haamura lahedot zevachim af reiyya haamura laggavoha zevachim
Uma hen zevachim olot atta omer olot o eno ella shelamim vedin hu neemra chagiga lahedot veneemra reiyya laggavoha ma chagiga haamura lahedot berauy lo af reiyya haamura laggavoha berauy lo
Vechen bedin shello yehe shulchancha male veshulchan rabbecha rekam amar leh beikar haregel

Etiveh rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer shalosh regalim bashshana nitztauu yisrael laalot baregel bechag hammatztzot uvchag hashshavuot uvchag hassukkot veen nirin chatzain mishshum shenneemar kol zechurcha veen nirin rekanim mishshum shenneemar velo yerau fanay rekam amar leh beikar haregel
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish yerae yire ma ani bechinnam af attem bechinnam
Ella kol hecha daata vela ayeti dechulle alma la peligi deayel umitchaze venafek ki peligi daata veayeti
Rabbi yochanan deamar reiyyat panim baazara reiyyat panim hu deen lah shiur ha lekorban yesh lah shiur veresh lakish amar reiyyat panim bekorban daafilu korban name en lo shiur
Etiveh hokar raglecha mibbet reecha hatam bechattaot vaashamot
Kidrabbi levi derabbi levi rame ketiv hokar raglecha mibbet reecha uchtiv avo vetcha veolot la kashya kan bechattaot vaashamot kan beolot ushlamim

Tanya name hachi hokar raglecha mibbet reecha bechattaot vaashamot hakkatuv medabber atta omer bechattaot vaashamot o eno ella beolot ushlamim keshehu omer avo vetcha veolot ashallem lecha nedaray hare olot ushlamim amur ha ma ani mekayyem hokar raglecha mibbet reecha bechattaot vaashamot hakkatuv medabber
Veen nirin chatzain ku savar rav yosef lememar man deit leh asara banim la lisku haidana chamsha ulmachar chamsha
b: Amar leh abbaye peshita he minayehu meshavet lehu poshim vehe minayehu meshavet lehu zerizin

Ella kera lemay ata lichdaacherim detanya acherim omrim hamkammetz vehamtzaref nechoshet vehabbursi peturin min hariyya shenneemar kol zechurcha mi sheyyachol laalot im kol zechurcha yatzu ellu sheen yecholin laalot im kol zechurcha
Matni olot bammoed baot min hachullin vehashshelamim min hammaaser yom tov harishon shel pesach bet shammay omrim min hachullin uvet hillel omrim min hammaaser
Yisrael yotzin yede chovatan bindarim undavot uvmasar behema vehakkohanim bechattaot vaashamot uvivchor uvchaze vashok aval lo beofot velo bimnachot
Gema ella olot bammoed hu devaot min hachullin ha beom tov min hammaaser ammay davar shebbechova hi vechol davar shebbechova eno ba ella min hachullin
Vechi tema ha ka mashma lan deolot bammoed baot beom tov enan baot keman kevet shammay
Ditnan bet shammay omrim meviin shelamim veen somchin alehen aval lo olot uvet hillel omrim meviin shelamim veolot vesomchin alehen

Chassore michassera vehachi katane olot nedarim undavot bammoed baot beom tov enan baot veolat reiyya baa afilu beom tov uchshehi baa enah baa ella min hachullin veshalme simcha bain af min hammaaser vachagigat yom tov harishon shel pesach bet shammay omrim min hachullin uvet hillel omrim min hammaaser

Tanya name hachi olot nedarim undavot bammoed baot beom tov enan baot veolat reiyya baa afilu beom tov uchshehi baa enah baa ella min hachullin veshalme simcha bain af min hammaaser vachagigat yom tov harishon shel pesach bet shammay omrim min hachullin uvet hillel omrim min hammaaser
May shena chagigat yom tov harishon shel pesach amar rav ashe ha ka mashma lan chagigat chamishsha asar in chagigat arbaa asar la

a: Alma kasavar chagigat arbaa asar lav deorayeta
Amar mar bet hillel omrim min hammaaser ammay davar shebbechova hu vechol davar shebbechova eno ba ella min hachullin amar ulla betofel
Chizkiyya amar toflin behema livhema veen toflin maot lemaot verabbi yochanan amar toflin maot lemaot veen toflin behema livhema

Tanya keoteh dechizkiyya tanya keoteh derabbi yochanan tanya keoteh derabbi yochanan missat melammed sheadam mevi chovato min hachullin uminnayin sheim ratza learev mearev talmud lomar kaasher yevarechcha Adonai elohecha

Tanya keoteh dechizkiyya missat melammed sheadam mevi chovato min hachullin bet shammay omrim yom rishon min hachullin mikkan veelach min hammaaser uvet hillel omrim achila rishona min hachullin mikkan veelach min hammaaser
Ushar kol yemot happesach adam yotze yede chovato bemaaser behema beom tov may tama la
Amar rav ashe dilma ate leassore beom tov vei efshar leasser beom tov mishshum sekarta
May mashma dehay missat lishana dechullin hu dichtiv vayyasem hammelech achashverosh mas al haaretz

Yisrael yotzin yede chovatan bindarim undavot tanu rabbanan vesamachta bechaggecha lerabbot kol mine semachot lesimcha mikkan amru chachamim yisrael yotzin yede chovatan bindarim undavot uvmasar behema
Vehakkohanim bechattat veasham uvivchor uvchaze vashok yachol af baofot uvimnachot talmud lomar vesamachta bechaggecha
b: Mi shechagiga baa mehem yatzu ellu sheen chagiga baa mehem
Rav ashe amar mivvesamachta nafka yatzu ellu sheen bahen simcha
Verav ashe hay bechaggecha may aved leh hahu lechidrav daniel bar kattina deamar rav daniel bar kattina amar rav minnayin sheen nosin nashim bammoed shenneemar vesamachta bechaggecha velo beishtecha
Matni mi sheyyesh lo ochlim merubbim unchasim muatim mevi shelamim merubbim veolot muatot nechasim merubbim veochlin muatin mevi olot merubbot ushlamim muatin
Ze vaze muat al ze neemar maa kesef shette kesef ze vaze merubbim al ze neemar ish kemattenat yado kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach
Gema shelamim merubbim mehecha mayete ha let leh amar rav chisda tofel umevi par gadol amar leh rav sheshet hare amru toflin behema livhema
May kaamar leh ilema hachi kaamar leh hare amru toflin behema livhema aval lo maot lemaot velema leh en toflin maot lemaot ella hachi amar leh hare amru af toflin behema livhema
Keman dela kechizkiyya udla kerabbi yochanan
Vechi tema amorae hu difligi matneyata la peligi veha katane achila rishona min hachullin
May achila rishona shiur deme achila rishona min hachullin
Amar ulla amar resh lakish hifrish eser behemot lachagigato hikriv chamesh beom tov rishon chozer umakriv chamesh beom tov sheni rabbi yochanan amar kevan sheppasak shuv eno makriv
Amar rabbi abba vela peligi kan bistam kan bimfaresh
Hay setam hechi dame ilema deleka shehut bayyom likrav hay dela akrevinhu deleka shehut bayyom
Veella delet leh ochlin hay dela akrevinhu delet leh ochlin
La tzericha deika shehut bayyom veit leh ochlin middivkamma la akrevinhu shema minah shayyore shayerinhu
Vehachi name mistabbera dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan hifrish eser behemot lachagigato hikriv chamesh beom tov rishon chozer umakriv chamesh beom tov sheni kashyan ahadade
Ella lav shema minah kan bistam kan bimfaresh shema minah
Itmar name amar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan

a: Lo shanu ella shello gamar aval gamar chozer umakriv
May gamar ilema gamar korbenotav may makriv ella shello gamar hayyom aval gamar hayyom chozer umakriv
Matni mi shello chag beom tov harishon shel chag chogeg et kal haregel veom tov haacharon shel chag
Avar haregel velo chag eno chayyav beachrauto al ze neemar meuvat lo yuchal litkon vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot
Rabbi shimon ben menasseya omer ezehu meuvat sheeno yachol lehittaken ze habba al haerva veholid mimmenna mamzer im tomar begonev vegozel yachol hu lehachziro vitakken
Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer en korin meuvat ella lemi shehaya metukkan battechila venitavet vee ze ze talmid chacham happoresh min hattora
Gema menahane mile amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael neemar atzeret bishvii shel pesach veneemar atzeret bishmini shel chag ma lehallan letashlumin af kan letashlumin
Mufne dei lav mufne ika lemifrach ma lishvii shel pesach shekken eno chaluk mishshellefanav tomar bishmini shel chag shechaluk mishshellefanav
Laye ippenoye mufne mikkede may atzeret atzur baasiyyat melacha hachtiv lo taase melacha atzeret dichtav rachamana lema li ella shema minah leafnoye

Vetanna mayete lah mehacha detanya vechaggotem oto chag la shivat yamim yachol yehe chogeg veholech kal shiva talmud lomar oto oto atta chogeg vei atta chogeg kol shiva im ken lamma neemar shiva letashlumin

Uminnayin sheim lo chag yom tov harishon shel chag shechogeg veholech et kal haregel veom tov haacharon talmud lomar bachodesh hashshevii tachoggu oto i bachodesh hashshevii yachol yehe chogeg veholech hachodesh kullo talmud lomar oto oto atta chogeg vei atta chogeg chutza lo
Umay tashlumin rabbi yochanan amar tashlumin larishon verabbi oshaya amar tashlumin ze laze

May benayehu amar rabbi zera chiger beom rishon venitpashshet beom sheni ika benayehu rabbi yochanan amar tashlumin larishon kevan dela chaze barishon la chaze bashsheni verabbi oshaya amar tashlumin ze laze af al gav dela chaze barishon chaze bishne
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi
Vehaamar chizkiyya nitma bayyom mevi ballayela eno mevi
Verabbi yochanan amar af ballayela name mevi
Amar rabbi yirmeya shane tuma deyesh lah tashlumin befesach sheni
Matkef lah rav pappa hanicha leman deamar pesach
b: Sheni tashlumin derishon hu ella leman deamar sheni regel bifne atzmo hu may ika lememar
Ella amar rav pappa kasavar rabbi yochanan layela eno mechussar zeman umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan raa achat ballayela ushtayim bayyom mevi
Shettayim ballayela veachat bayyom eno mevi vei salka datach kasavar rabbi yochanan layela eno mechussar zeman afilu shettayim ballayela veachat bayyom mevi
Ki kaamar rabbi yochanan ledivre haomer layela mechussar zeman ledivre haomer peshita shettayim bayyom veachat ballayela itztericha leh
Salka datach amena keatkafta derav shisha bereh derav idi ka mashma lan kidrav yosef
Avar haregel velo chag eno chayyav beachrauto veal ze neemar meuvat lo yuchal litkon vechesron lo yuchal lehimanot
Amar leh bar he he lehillel hay lehimanot lehimmaloot mibe leh ella ze shemminnuhu shennimnu chaverav lidvar mitzva vehu lo nimna immahen

Tanya name hachi meuvat lo yuchal litkon ze shebbitel keriat shema shel shacharit o keriat shema shel arvit o shebbitel tefilla shel shacharit o tefilla shel arvit vechesron lo yuchal lehimanot ze shennimnu chaverav lidvar mitzva vehu lo nimna immahen

Amar leh bar he he lehillel may dichtiv veshavtem uritem ben tzaddik lerasha ben oved elohim laasher lo avado hayenu tzaddik hayenu oved elohim hayenu rasha hayenu asher lo avado amar leh avado velo avado tarvayehu tzaddike gemure ninhu veeno dome shone pirko mea peamim leshone pirko mea veechad
Amar leh umishshum chad zimna kare leh lo avado amar leh in tze ulmad mishshuk shel chamarin asra parse bezuza chad asar parse bitre zuze

Amar leh eliyyahu levar he he veamri lah lerabbi elazar may dichtiv hinne tzerafticha velo vechasef becharticha bechur oni melammed shechazar hakkadosh baruch hu al kol middot tovot liten leyisrael velo matza ella aniyyut amar shemuel veitema rav yosef hayenu deamri inashe yaa anuta lihudae ki barza summaka lesusya chivara
Rabbi shimon ben menasya omer e ze hu meuvat lo yuchal litkon ze habba al haerva veholid mimmenna mamzer vechu holid in lo holid la

Veha tanya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer gonev adam efshar sheyyachazir genevo vitakken gozel adam efshar sheyyachazir gezelo vitakken aval habba al eshet ish vaasarah levalah nitrad min haolam vehalach lo
Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer en omer bakkeru gamal bakkeru chazir ella bakkeru tale vee ze ze talmid chacham shepperash min hattora
Rabbi yehuda ben lakish amar kol talmid chacham shepperash min hattora alav hakkatuv omer ketzippor nodedet min kinnah ken ish noded mimmekomo veomer ma matzu avotechem bi avel ki rachaku mealay
La kashya kan baachoto penuya kan beeshet ish vei baet ema ha veha beeshet ish vela kashya kan

a: Beones kan beratzon veibaet ema ha veha beones vela kashya kan beeshet kohen kan beeshet yisrael
Velayyotze velabba en shalom amar rav kevan sheyyotze adam middevar halacha lidvar mikra shuv en lo shalom
Ushmuel amar ze happoresh mittalmud lemishna verabbi yochanan amar afilu mittalmud letalmud
Matni heter nedarim porchin baavir veen lahem al ma sheyyissamechu

Hilchot shabbat chagigot vehammeilot hare hem kahararim hatteluyin bisarah shehen mikra muat vahalachot merubbot haddinin vehaavodot hatteharot vehattemaot vaaraot yesh lahen al ma sheyyissamechu vehen hen gufe tora
Gema tanya rabbi eliezer omer yesh lahem al ma sheyyissamechu shenneemar ki yafli ki yafli shette peamim achat haflaa leisur veachat haflaa leheter
Rabbi yehoshua omer yesh lahem al ma sheyyissamechu shenneemar asher nishbati veappi beappi nishbati vechazarti bi

Rabbi yitzchak omer yesh lahem al ma sheyyissamechu shenneemar kol nediv libbo chananya ben achi rabbi yehoshua omer yesh lahem al ma sheyyissamechu shenneemar nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel i havay hatam amri lehu didi adifa middidchu shenneemar lo yachel devaro hu eno mochel aval acherim mochalin lo amar rava lechullehu it lehu pircha levar middishmuel delet leh pircha
Dei midderabbi eliezer dilma kidrabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi tarfon detanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon leolam en echad mehem nazir shello nitna nezirut ella lehaflaa

I midderabbi yehoshua dilma hachi kaamar beappi nishbati vela hadarna bi i midderabbi yitzchak dilma leappoke middishmuel deamar shemuel gamar belibbo tzarich sheyyotzi bisfatav veha ka mashma lan deaf al gav delo hotzi bisfatav
I middachananya ben achi rabbi yehoshua dilma kerav gidel amar rav deamar rav gidel amar rav minnayin shennishbain lekayyem et hammitzva shenneemar nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha
Ella dishmuel let leh pircha amar rava veitema rav nachman bar yitzchak hayenu deamri inashe tava chada pilpalta charifta mimmele tzanna dekare
Hilchot shabbat michtav ketivan la tzericha lechidrabbi abba deamar rabbi abba hachofer gumma beshabbat veen tzarich ella laafarah patur aleha
Keman kerabbi shimon deamar melacha sheenah tzericha legufah patur aleha
Afilu tema lerabbi yehuda hatam metakken hacha mekalkel hu
May kahararin hatteluyin bisara
b: Melechet machshevet asra tora umlechet machshevet la ketiva
Chagigot michtav ketivan la tzericha lichdaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye mimmay dehay vechaggotem oto chag la zevicha dilma choggu chagga kaamar rachamana
Ella meatta dichtiv veyachoggu li bammidbar hachi name dechoggu chagga hu vechi tema hachi name vehachtiv vayyomar moshe gam atta titten beyadenu zevachim veolot
Dilma hachi kaamar rachamana ichlu ushtu vechoggu chagga kammay la salka datach dichtiv velo yalin chelev chaggi ad boker vei salka datach dechogga hu tarba lechagga it leh
Vedilma hachi kaamar rachamana chelev habba bizman chag lo yalin
Ella meatta habba bizman chag hu delo yalin ha dechol hashshana kullah yalin kol hallayela ad habboker ketiv
Dilma i mehahu hava amena hahu laase ketav rachamana hay lelav
Lelav ketav kera acharina velo yalin min habbasar asher tizbach baerev bayyom harishon labboker vedilma laavor alav bishne lavin vaase
Ella atya midbar midbar ketiv hacha veyachoggu li bammidbar uchtiv hatam hazzevachim umincha higgashtem li bammidbar ma lehallan zevachim af kan zevachim
Umay kahararin hatteluyin bisara divre tora middivre kabbala la yalfinan
Meilot michtav ketivan amar rame bar chama lo nitzrecha ella lichditnan hashshaliach sheasa shelichuto baal habbayit maal lo asa shelichuto shaliach maal
Vechi asa shelichuto ammay maal vechi ze chote veze mitchayyev hayenu kahararin hatteluyin bisara
Amar rava umay kushya dilma shane meila deyalfa chet chet mitteruma ma hatam shelucho shel adam kemoto af kan shelucho shel adam kemoto
Ella amar rava lo nitzrecha ella lechidtanya nizkar baal habbayit velo nizkar shaliach shaliach maal shaliach anya may ka aved hayenu kahararin hatteluyin bisara
Amar rav ashe may kushya dilma mide dehave ammotzi meot hekdesh lechullin

Ella amar rav ashe lo nitzrecha ella lichditnan natal even o kora shel hekdesh hare ze lo maal netanah lachavero hu maal vachavero lo maal mikkede mishkal shaklah ma li hu uma li chavero hayenu kahararin hatteluyin bisara
Umay kushya dilma kedishmuel deamar shemuel hacha

a: Begizbar hammesurot lo avne vinyan askinan dechol hecha demannecha birshuta dideh mannecha
Ella missefa benaah betoch beto hare ze lo maal ad sheyyadur tachteha beshave peruta mikkede shannoye shanneyah ma li dar uma li la dar hayenu kahararin hatteluyin bisara
Umay kushya dilma lechidrav deamar rav kegon shehinnichah al pi arubba i dar beh in la dar beh la
Ella leolam kidrava udka kashya lach mide dehave ammotzi meot hekdesh lechullin hatam mida yada deika zuze dehekdesh ibaya leh leayyone hacha mi yada hayenu kahararin hatteluyin bisara

Mikra muat vahalachot merubbot tana negaim veohalot mikra muat vahalachot merubbot negaim mikra muat negaim mikra merubbe hu amar rav pappa hachi kaamar negaim mikra merubbe vahalachot muatot ohalot mikra muat vahalachot merubbot
Umay nafka minah i mistappeka lach milta bingaim ayyen bikrae vei mistappeka lach milta beohalot ayyen bematnitin
Dinin michtav ketivan lo nitzrecha ella lechidrabbi
Detanya rabbi omer nefesh tachat nafesh mamon atta omer mamon o eno ella nefesh mammash neemra netina lematta veneemra netina lemala ma lehallan mamon af kan mamon
Avodot michtav ketivan lo nitzrecha ella leholachat haddam detanya vehikrivu zo kabbalat haddam
Veappekah rachamana bilshon holacha dichtiv vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol vehiktir hammizbecha veamar mar zo holachat evarim lakkevesh
Lememra deholacha la tappekah mikkelal kabbala

Teharot michtav ketivan lo nitzrecha ella leshiur mikve dela ketiva detanya verachatz et besaro bemayim beme mikve et kol besaro mayim shekkol gufo ole bahen vechamma hen amma al amma berum shalosh ammot veshiaru chachamim me mikve arbaim sea
Temaot michtav ketivan lo nitzrecha ella lechaadasha min hashsheretz dela ketiva detanya bahem
Yachol bechullan talmud lomar mehem yachol bemiktzatan talmud lomar bahem
Ha ketzad ad sheyyaggia bemiktzato shehu kechullo shiaru chachamim bechaadasha shekken chomet techillato bechaadasha rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer kiznav halletaa
Araot michtav ketivan lo nitzrecha
b: Levitto meanusato dela ketiva
Deamar rava amar li rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi atya henna henna
Atya zima zima
Hen hen gufe tora hane in hanach la ella ema hen vehen gufe tora
Hadaran alach hakkol chayyavin
En dorshin baaraot bishlosha velo bemaase vereshit bishnayim velo bammerkava beyachid ella im ken haya chacham umevin middato
Kol hammistakkel bearbaa devarim ratuy lo keilu lo ba laolam ma lemala ma lematta ma lefanim uma leachor vechol shello chas al kevod kono ratuy lo shello ba laolam
Gema amratte beresha velo bammerkava beyachid vahadar amratte ella im ken haya chacham umevin middato
Hachi kaamar en dorshin baaraot lishlosha velo bemaase vereshit lishnayim velo bammerkava layyachid ella im ken haya chacham umevin middato
En dorshin baaraot bishlosha may tama ilema mishshum dichtiv ish ish el kol sheer besaro ish ish tere sheer besaro chad veamar rachamana lo tikrevu legallot erva
Ella meatta dichtiv ish ish ki yekallel elohav ish ish asher yitten mizzaro lammolech hachi name
Ella hanhu mibe leh lerabbot et haggoyim shemmuzharin al birkat hashshem veal avoda zara keyisrael
Hay name mibe leh lerabbot et haggoyim shemmuzharin al haaraot keyisrael
Ella middichtiv ushmartem et mishmarti ushmartem tere mishmarti chad veamar rachamana levilti asot mechukkot hattoevot
Ella meatta dichtiv ushmartem et hashshabbat ushmartem et hammatztzot ushmartem et mishmeret hakkodesh hachi name
Ella amar rav ashe may en dorshin baaraot bishlosha en dorshin besitre araot bishlosha

May tama sevara hu be tere ki yatvi kamme rabbayehu chad shakel vetare bahade rabbeh veidach matzle udneh ligmara telata chad shakel vetare bahade rabbeh vehanach tere shaklu vetaru bahade hadade vela yadi may kaamar rabbayehu veatu lemishre isura baaraot
I hachi kol hattora name
Araot shane deamar mar gazel vaaraot nafsho shel adam mechammedatan umitava lahem
I hachi gazel name araot ben befanav ben shello befanav nefish yitzreh gazel befanav nefish yitzreh shello befanav la nefish yitzreh
Velo bemaase vereshit bishnayim mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ki sheal na leyamim rishonim yachid shoel veen shenayim shoalin
Yachol yishal adam kodem shennivra haolam talmud lomar lemin hayyom asher bara elohim adam al haaretz
Yachol lo yishal adam mishsheshet yeme vereshit talmud lomar leyamim rishonim asher hau lefanecha

Yachol yishal adam ma lemala uma lematta ma lefanim uma leachor talmud lomar ulmiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim millemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim atta shoel veen atta shoel ma lemala ma lematta ma lefanim ma leachor

a: Hashta denafka leh millemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim lemin hayyom asher bara elohim adam al haaretz lema li

Kidrabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar adam harishon min haaretz ad larakia shenneemar lemin hayyom asher bara elohim adam al haaretz vechevan shessarach hinniach hakkadosh baruch hu yadav alav umiato shenneemar achor vakedem tzartani vattashet alay kappecha

Amar rav yehuda amar rav adam harishon missof haolam vead sofo haya shenneemar lemin hayyom asher bara elohim adam al haaretz ulmiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim kevan shessarach hinniach hakkadosh baruch hu yado alav umiato shenneemar vattashet alay kappecha
I hachi kashu kerae ahadade ide veide chad shiura hu
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav asara devarim nivreu beom rishon veellu hen shamayim vaaretz tohu vavohu or vachoshech ruach umayim middat yom umiddat layela

Shamayim vaaretz dichtiv bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz tohu vavohu dichtiv vehaaretz hayeta tohu vavohu or vachoshech choshech dichtiv vechoshech al pene tehom or dichtiv vayyomer elohim yehi or ruach umayim dichtiv veruach elohim merachefet al pene hammayim middat yom umiddat layela dichtiv vayehi erev vayehi voker yom echad

Tana tohu kav yarok shemmakkif et kal haolam kullo shemmimmennu yatza choshech shenneemar yashet choshech sitro sevivotav vohu ellu avanim hamfullamot hamshukkaot battehom shemmehen yotzin mayim shenneemar venata aleha kav tohu veavne vohu
Veor beom rishon ibri vehachtiv vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim uchtiv vayehi erev vayehi voker yom revii

Kidrabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar or shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beom rishon adam tzofe bo missof haolam vead sofo kevan shennistakkel hakkadosh baruch hu bedor hammabbul uvdor happelagga veraa shemmaasehem mekulkalim amad ugnazo mehen shenneemar veyimmana mershaim oram
Ulmi genazo latztzaddikim leatid lavo shenneemar vayyar elohim et haor ki tov veen tov ella tzaddik shenneemar imru tzaddik ki tov
Kevan sheraa or sheggenazo latztzaddikim samach shenneemar or tzaddikim yismach
Ketannae or shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beom rishon adam tzofe umabbit bo missof haolam vead sofo divre rabbi yaakov vachachamim omrim hen hen meorot shennivreu beom rishon velo nitlu ad yom revii
Amar rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav baasara devarim nivra haolam bechochma uvitvuna uvdaat uvchoach uvigara uvigvura betzedek uvmishpat bechesed uvrachamim

Bechochma uvitvuna dichtiv Adonai bechochma yasad aretz konen shamayim bitvuna bedaat dichtiv bedato tehomot nivkau bechoach ugvura dichtiv mechin harim bechocho nezar bigvura bigara dichtiv ammude shamayim yerofafu veyitmehu miggaarato betzedek umishpat dichtiv tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha bechesed verachamim dichtiv zechor rachamecha Adonai vachasadecha ki meolam hemma

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav beshaa shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu et haolam haya marchiv veholech kishte fakiyyot shel sheti ad sheggaar bo hakkadosh baruch hu veheemido shenneemar ammude shamayim yerofafu veyitmehu miggaarato vehayenu deamar resh lakish may dichtiv ani el shadday ani hu sheamarti laolam day amar resh lakish beshaa shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu et hayyam haya marchiv veholech ad sheggaar bo hakkadosh baruch hu veyibbesho shenneemar goer bayyam vayyabbeshehu vechol hanneharot hecheriv

Tanu rabbanan bet shammay omrim shamayim nivreu techilla veachar kach nivret haaretz shenneemar bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz uvet hillel omrim eretz nivret techilla veachar kach shamayim shenneemar beom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim

Amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay ledivrechem adam bone aliyya veachar kach bone bayit shenneemar habbone vashshamayim maalotav vaaguddato al eretz yesadah amru lahem bet shammay levet hillel ledivrechem adam ose sherafraf veachar kach ose kisse shenneemar ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay vachachamim omrim ze vaze keachat nivreu shenneemar af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim kore ani alehem yaamdu yachdav

Matkef lah rav shimi bar ashe ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi meir ella baachila demaaser aval bingia demaaser uvaachila dechullin la peligi ella ide veide baachila vela kashya kan baachila denahama kan baachila defere deamar rav nachman kol hannotel yadav leferot hare ze miggasse haruach

Tanu rabbanan hannotel yadav nitkaven yadav tehorot lo nitkaven yadav temeot vechen hammatbil yadav nitkaven yadav tehorot lo nitkaven yadav temeot vehatanya ben nitkaven ben lo nitkaven yadav tehorot amar rav nachman la kashya kan lechullin

a: Kan lemaaser umna temra dechullin la bau kauona ditnan gal shennitlash uvo arbaim sea venafal al haadam veal hakkelim tehorin katane adam dumya dechelim ma kelim dela mechavveni af adam dela mechaven
Umimmay dilma beoshev umtzappe ematay yittalesh haggal askinan vechelim dumya deadam ma adam devar kauona af kelim dimchaven lehu
Vechi tema beoshev umtzappe may lememra
Salka datach amena ligzor dilma ate lemitbal bechardalit shel geshamim i name nigzor rashin attu kipin ka mashma lan dela gazrinan
Umna temra dela matbilin bechipin detanya matbilin berashin veen matbilin bechipin lefi sheen matbilin baavir
Ella meha ditnan perot shennaflu letoch ammat hammayim ufashat mi sheyyadav temeot untalan yadav tehorot uferot enan bechi yuttan
Veim bishvil sheyyudchu yadav yadav tehorot vehapperot hare hen bechi yuttan
Etiveh rabba lerav nachman hattovel lechullin vehuchzak lechullin asur lemaaser huchzak in lo huchzak la
Hachi kaamar af al pi shehuchzak lechullin asur lemaaser
Etiveh taval velo huchzak keilu lo taval may lav keilu lo taval kelal
Lo keilu lo taval lemaaser aval taval lechullin hu savar dachoye ka medache leh nefak dak veashkach detanya taval velo huchzak asur lammaaser umuttar lachullin
Amar rabbi elazar taval veala machzik atzmo lechol ma sheyyirtze
Metivi odehu raglo achat bammayim huchzak ledavar kal machzik atzmo ledavar chamur ala shuv eno machzik
May lav eno machzik kelal
Lo odehu af al pi shehuchzak machzik ala im lo huchzak machzik veim huchzak eno machzik

Man tanna odehu raglo achat bammayim amar rabbi pedat rabbi yehuda hi ditnan mikve shennimdad veyesh bo arbaim sea mechuuonot veyardu shenayim vetavlu ze achar ze harishon tahor vehashsheni tame amar rabbi yehuda im hau raglav shel rishon nogot bammayim af hashsheni tahor
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh machloket bemaalot derabbanan aval mittuma letohora divre hakkol af hashsheni tame vehayenu derabbi pedat
Ika deamri amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh machloket mittuma letohora aval bemaalot derabbanan divre hakkol af hashsheni tahor ufliga derabbi pedat
Amar ulla bae mineh merabbi yochanan lerabbi yehuda mahu lehatbil mechatin vetzinoriyyot berosho shel rishon
Gud achet it leh lerabbi yehuda gud assek let leh o dilma gud assek name it leh

Amar leh tenetuha shalosh gemamiyyot bannachal haelona hattachtona vehaemtzait haelona vehattachtona shel esrim esrim sea vehaemtzait shel arbaim sea vechardalit shel geshamim overet benehen rabbi yehuda omer meir haya omer matbil baelona
Vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer
b: Meir haya omer matbil baelona vaani omer battachtona velo baelona amar leh i tanya tanya
Hattovel lachullin vehuchzak lachullin ku manni matnitin rabbanan hi deshane lehu ben chullin lemaaser
Ema sefa bigde am haaretz midras lifrushin bigde ferushin midras leochle teruma
Atan lerabbi meir deamar chullin umaaser kahadade ninhu resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir in resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir
Rav acha bar adda matne lah besefa chamesh maalot umoke lah kullah kerabbanan
Amar rav mari shema minah chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh kekodesh damu mimmay

a: Middela katane behu maala

Vedilma hay dela katane behu maala dei damu litruma ha tane teruma vei damu lechullin ha tane lechullin ditnan chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh hare hen kechullin rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer hare hen kitruma
Ella missefa yose ben yoezer haya chasid shebbakkehunna vehayeta mitpachto midras lakkodesh yochanan ben gudgeda haya ochel al tohorat hakkodesh kol yamav vehayeta mitpachto midras lachattat
Lachattat in lakkodesh la alma kasavar chullin shennaasu al tohorat kodesh kekodesh damu
Amar rabbi yonatan ben elazar nafla maporto hemennu amar lachavero tenah li untanah lo temea amar rabbi yonatan ben amram nitchallefu lo kelim shel shabbat bechelim shel chol ulvashan nitmeu
Amar rabbi elazar bar tzadok maase bishte nashim chaverot shennitchallefu lahen kelehen bevet hammerchatz uva maase lifne rabbi akiva vetiman
Matkef lah rabbi oshaya ella meatta hoshit yado lassal litol pat chittin vealta beyado pat seorim hachi name denitmet
Vechi tema hachi name vehatanya hamshammer et hechavit bechezkat shel yayin venimtzet shel shemen tehora milletamme ultamach ema sefa vaasura milleechol ammay
Amar rabbi yirmeya beomer shemartiha middavar hamtammeah velo middavar happoslah
Umi ika netiruta lefalga in vehatanya hoshit yado besal vehassal al ketefo vehammagrefa betoch hassal vehaya belibbo al hassal velo haya belibbo al hammagrefa hassal tahor vehammagrefa temea
Hassal tahor tetamme hammagrefa lassal en keli metamme keli velitame ma shebbassal amar ravina beomer shemartiv middavar shemmetammeo velo middavar happoslo
Mikkol makom kashya

Veod motev rabba bar avuh maase beishsha achat shebbat lifne rabbi yishmael veamra lo rabbi beged ze aragtiv betohora velo haya belibbi leshomro betohora umittoch bedikot shehaya rabbi yishmael bodkah amra lo rabbi nidda mashcha immi bachevel amar rabbi yishmael kamma gedolim divre chachamim shehau omrim belibbo leshomro tahor en belibbo leshomro tame

Shuv maase beishsha achat shebbat lifne rabbi yishmael amra lo rabbi mappa zo aragtiha betahora velo haya belibbi leshomrah umittoch bedikot shehaya rabbi yishmael bodkah amra lo rabbi nima nifseka li ukshartiha bappe
Amar rabbi yishmael kamma gedolim divre chachamim shehau omrim belibbo leshomro tahor en belibbo leshomro tame
Bishlama lerabbi elazar bar tzadok kol achat veachat omeret chaverti eshet am haaretz umassecha datah minah
Lerabbi yonatan ben amram name kevan dechelim deshabbat aved lehu shimur tefe massach dateh minayehu ella lerabbi yonatan ben elazar naaved lehu shimur bideh dechavreh
Amar rabbi yochanan chazaka en adam meshammer ma shebbeyad chavero velo
b: Vehatanya hare shehau chamarav ufoalav teunin teharot af al pi shehiflig mehen yoter mimmil taharotav tehorot veim amar lahem lechu vaani avo acharechem kevan shennitallemu enav mehen taharotav temeot
May shena resha umay shena sefa amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha resha bimtaher chamarav ufoalav lechach
I hachi sefa name en am haaretz makpid al magga chavero
I hachi resha name beva lahem derech akallaton
I hachi sefa name kevan daamar lehu lechu vaani avo acharechem mismach samcha datayehu
Hadaran alach en dorshin
Chomer bakkodesh mibbitruma shemmatbilin kelim betoch kelim litruma aval lo lakkodesh achorayim vatoch uvet hatztzevita bitruma aval lo bakkodesh
Hannose et hammidras nose et hatteruma aval lo et hakkodesh bigde ochle teruma midras lakkodesh
Lo kemiddat hakkodesh middat hatteruma shebbakkodesh mattir umnaggev umatbil veachar kach kosher uvitruma kosher veachar kach matbil
Kelim hannigmarim betahora tzerichin tevila lakkodesh aval lo litruma hakkeli metzaref ma shebbetocho lakkodesh aval lo litruma

Harvii bakkodesh pasul vehashshelishi vitruma uvitruma im nitmet achat miyyadav chavertah tehora uvakkodesh matbil shettehen shehayyad metamme et chavertah bakkodesh aval lo vitruma ochlin ochalim neguvin beyadayim mesoavot vitruma aval lo bakkodesh

a: Haonen umchussar kippurim tzerichin tevila lakkodesh aval lo litruma
Gema bakkodesh may tama la amar rabbi ila mippene shekkevedo shel keli chotzetz

Veha middesefa mishshum chatzitza resha lav mishshum chatzitza dekatane sefa velo kemiddat hakkodesh middat hatteruma shebbakkodesh mattir umnaggev umatbil veachar kach kosher uvatteruma kosher veachar kach matbil

Resha vesefa mishshum chatzitza utzricha dei ashmeinan resha hava amena hayenu tama dilkodesh la mishshum kevedo shel keli deika aval sefa deleka kevedo shel keli ema lekodesh name la have chatzitza vei ashmeinan sefa hava amena hayenu tama dilkodesh la mishshum
b: Dekitra bemayya ihaddoke mihaddak aval resha demayya akpoye makpu leh lemana la haveya chatzitza tzericha

Rabbi ila letameh deamar rabbi ila amar rabbi chanina bar pappa eser maalot shanu kan chamesh rishonot ben lakkodesh ben lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh acharonot lakkodesh aval lo lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh

May tama chamesh kammayata deit lehu derara detuma middeorayeta gezaru behu rabbanan ben lekodesh ben lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh batrayata delet lehu derara detuma middeorayeta gezaru behu rabbanan lekodesh lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh la gezaru behu rabbanan

Rava amar middesefa have mishshum chatzitza resha lav mishshum chatzitza veresha hayenu tama gezera shello yatbil mechatin vetzinorot bichli sheen befiv kishfoferet hannod keditnan eruv mikoot kishfoferet hannod keovyah

a: Vechachalalah bishte etzbaot chozrot limkoman

Savar lah keha deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh achat esre maalot shanu kan shesh rishonot ben lakkodesh ben lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh acharonot lakkodesh aval lo lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh
May ika ben derava lidrabbi ila

Ika benayehu sal vegargutni shemmilan kelim vehitbilan leman deamar mishshum chatzitza ika leman deamar mishshum gezera shemma yatbil mechatin vetzinoriyyot bichli sheen befiv kishfoferet hannod sal vegargutni sheen befihen kishfoferet hannod leka
Veazda rava letameh deamar rava sal vegargutni shemmilan kelim vehitbilan tehorin
Umikve shechalako besal vegargutni hattovel sham lo alta lo tevila deha ara kullah chalchole mechalchala uvaenan deika arbaim sea bemakom echad
Vehane mile bichli tahor aval bichli tame migo desalka tevila lechulleh gufeh demana salka lehu name lechelim deit beh

Ditnan kelim shemmilan kelim vehitbilan hare ellu tehorin veim lo taval mayim hamoravim ad sheyyihu meoravin kishfoferet hannod may kaamar veim lo taval hachi kaamar veim eno tzarich lehatbilo umayim hamoravin ad sheyehu meoravin kishfoferet hannod
Veha derava udrabbi ila tannae hi detanya sal vegargutni shemmilan kelim vehitbilan ben lakkodesh ben latteruma tehorin abba shaul omer latteruma aval lo lakkodesh
I hachi teruma name leman kaamrinan chaverim chaverim mida yadi
I hachi kodesh name chaze leh am haaretz veazel matbil
Teruma name chaze leh am haaretz veazel matbil la mekabbelinan minayehu
Kodesh name la nekabbel minayehu haveya leh eva
Teruma name haveya leh eva la ichpat leh deazel yahev leh lechohen am haaretz chavreh

Uman tanna dechayesh leeva rabbi yose hi detanya amar rabbi yose mippene ma hakkol neemanin al tohorat yayin vashemen kol yemot hashshana kede shello yehe kol echad veechad holech uvone bama leatzmo vesoref para adumma leatzmo
Amar rav pappa keman mekabbelinan haidana sahaduta meam haaretz keman kerabbi yose
Venechush lishela
Ditnan keli cheres matztzil al hakkol divre bet hillel bet shammay omrim eno matztzil ella al ochalim veal hammashkim veal kele cheres

Amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay mippene ma amru bet shammay mippene shehu tame al gabbe am haaretz veen keli tame chotzetz amru lahem bet hillel vahalo tihartem ochalin umashkin shebbetocho amru lahem bet shammay keshettiharnu ochalin umashkin shebbetocho
b: Leatzmo tiharnu
Aval netaher et hakkeli shettohorato lecha valo
Tanya amar rabbi yehoshua boshani middivrechem bet shammay efshar ishsha lasha baareva ishsha vaareva temein shiva uvatzek tahor login male mashkin login tame tumat shiva umashkin tehorin

Nitpal lo talmid echad mittalmide bet shammay amar lo omar lecha taman shel bet shammay amar lo emor amar lo keli tame chotzetz o eno chotzetz amar lo eno chotzetz keli shel am haaretz tame o tahor amar lo tame veim atta omer lo tame kelum mashgiach alecha velo od ella sheim atta omer lo tame omer lecha shelli tahor veshellecha tame
Vezehu taman shel bet shammay

Miyyad halach rabbi yehoshua venishtattach al kivre bet shammay amar naaneti lachem atzmot bet shammay uma setumot shellachem kach meforashot al achat kamma vechamma amru kol yamav hushcharu shinav mippene taaniyyotav
Katane mihat lecha valo alma shaalinan minayehu ki shayelinan minayehu matbelinan lehu
I hachi nahderu lehu bet hillel levet shammay ki shaalinan minayehu matbelinan lehu teme met bae hazzaa shelishi ushvii umana leshiva yome la moshli inashe
Veattevila la mehemni vehatanya neemanin amme haaretz al tohorat tevilat teme met

Amar abbaye la kashya ha begufo ha bechelav rava amar ide veide bechelav vela kashya ha deamar meolam lo hitbalti keli betoch keli veha deamar hitbalti aval lo hitbalti bichli sheen befiv kishfoferet hannod
Vehatanya neeman am haaretz lomar perot lo huchsheru aval eno neeman lomar perot huchsheru aval lo nitmeu
Veaggufo mi meheman vehatanya chaver shebba lehazzot mazzin alav miyyad am haaretz shebba lehazzot en mazzin alav ad sheyyaase befanenu shelishi ushvii
Ella amar abbaye mittoch chomer shehechmarta alav bitchilato hekalta alav besofo
Achorayim vatoch may achorayim vatoch
Keditnan keli shennitma achorav bemashkin achorav temein tocho ogno ozno veyadav tehorin nitma tocho kullo tame
Uvet hatztzevita vechu may bet hatztzevita amar rav yehuda amar shemuel makom shetztzovto vechen hu omer vayyitzbot lah kali rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan makom shennekiyye haddaat tzovin

Tane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman kol hakkelim en lahem achorayim vatoch echad kodshe hammikdash veechad kodshe haggevul amar leh kodshe haggevul may ninhu teruma vehatnan achorayim vatoch uvet hatztzevita litruma
Dilma lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh kaamratte

Adkartan milta deamar rabba bar avuh achat esre maalot shanu kan shesh rishonot ben lakkodesh ben lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh acharonot lakkodesh aval lo lechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh

Hannose et hammidras nose et hatteruma aval lo et hakkodesh kodesh may tama la mishshum maase shehaya deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel maase beechad shehaya maavir chavit shel yen kodesh mimmakom lemakom

a: Venifseka retzua shel sandalo untalah vehinnichah al pi chavit venafla laavir hechavit venitmet beotah shaa amru hannose et hammidras nose et hatteruma aval lo et hakkodesh
I hachi teruma name ha manni rabbi chananya ben akavya hi deamar lo asru ella bayyarden uvisfina uchmaase shehaya

May hi detanya lo yissa adam me chattat veefer chattat veyaavirem bayyarden uvisfina velo yaamod betzad ze veyizrekem letzad acher velo yeshitem al pene hammayim velo yirkav al gabbe behema velo al gabbe chavero ella im ken hau raglav nogot bakkarka aval maaviran al gabbe haggesher veeno choshesh echad hayyarden veechad shear hanneharot rabbi chananya ben akavya omer lo asru ella bayyarden uvisfina uchmaase shehaya

May maase shehaya deamar rav yehuda amar rav maase beadam echad shehaya maavir me chattat veefer chattat bayyarden uvisfina venimtza kezayit met tachuv bekarkaitah shel sefina beotah shaa amru lo yissa adam me chattat veefer chattat veyaavirem bayyarden bisfina
Ibaya lehu sandal tame sandal tahor mahu chavit petucha chavit setuma mahu avar venasa mahu
Rabbi ila amar im avar venasa tame rabbi zera amar avar venasa tahor
Kelim hannigmarim betahora ku degamrinhu man ilema degamrinhu chaver lema lehu tevila
Ella degamrinhu am haaretz nigmarin betohora kare lehu amar rabba bar shela amar rav matna amar shemuel leolam degamrinhu chaver umishshum tzinora deam haaretz
Dinfal emat ilema mikkamme deligmereh ha lav mana hu ella batar degamreh mizhar zehir behv leolam mikkammeh degamreh vedilma beidana degamreh adayin lacha hi
Tevila in heerev shemesh la

Matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer ditnan shefoferet shechatachah lechattat rabbi eliezer omer yitbol miyyad rabbi yehoshua omer yetamme veachar kach yitbol vehavenan bah dechatchah man ilema dechatchah chaver lema li tevila veella dechatchah am haaretz beha lema rabbi yehoshua yetamme veyitbol ha tame vekae

Veamar rabba bar shela amar rav matna amar shemuel leolam dechatchah chaver umishshum tzinora deam haaretz dinfal emat ilema mikkamme delichtechah ha lav mana hu veella batar dechatchah mizhar zehir bah leolam mikkamme delichtechah dilma beidana dechatchah adayin lacha hi
Bishlama lerabbi yehoshua hayenu deika hekera letzaddukin
Ditnan metammein hau et hakkohen hassoref et happara lehotzi millibban shel tzaddukin shehau omrim bimorve shemesh hayeta naaset
Ella lerabbi eliezer i amratte bishlama bealma baenan heerev shemesh hayenu deika hekera letzaddukin ella i amratte bealma la baenan heerev shemesh may hekera letzaddukin ika
Amar rav
b: Asauha kitme sheretz
Ella meatta lo tetamme adam allema tanya chotchah umatbilah taun tevila veella asauha kitme met i hachi tive hazzaat shelishi ushvii
Allema tanya chotchah umatbilah taun tevila tevila in hazzaat shelishi ushvii la ella asauha kitme met bishvii shello
Vehatanya meolam lo chidshu davar bappara
Amar abbaye shello amru kurdom metamme moshav kidtanya vehayyoshev al hakkeli yachol kafa sea veyashav aleha tarkav veyashav aleha yehe tame
Talmud lomar vehayyoshev al hakkeli asher yeshev alav yitma mi shemuchad lishiva yatza ze sheomrim lo amod venaase melachtenu
Hakkeli metzaref ma shebbetocho lakkodesh aval lo latteruma mena hane mile amar rabbi chanin deamar kera kaf achat asara zahav melea ketoret hakkatuv asao lechol ma shebbakkaf achat
Metiv rav kahana hosif rabbi akiva hassolet vehakketoret vehallevona vehaggechalim sheim naga tevul yom bemiktzato pasal et kullo
Veha derabbanan hi mimmay middekatane resha heid rabbi shimon ben betera al efer chattat shennaga hattame bemiktzato shettime et kullo vekatane hosif rabbi akiva
Amar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara

a: Lo nitzrecha ella lishyare mincha deorayeta tzarich lichli hakkeli metzarfo sheen tzarich lichli en keli metzarfo
Vaato rabbanan ugzaru deaf al gav deeno tzarich lichli keli metzarfo

Tinach solet ketoret ulvona may ika lememar amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh kegon shetztzevaran al gabbe kartevula deorayeta yesh lo toch metzaref en lo toch eno metzaref vaato rabbanan vetakkinu deaf al gav deen lo toch metzaref
Ufliga derabbi chanin adderabbi chiyya bar abba deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan meeduto shel rabbi akiva nishnet mishna zo

Harvii bakkodesh pasul tanya amar rabbi yose minnayin larvii bakkodesh shehu pasul vedin hu uma mechussar kippurim shemmuttar batteruma pasul bakkodesh shelishi sheppasul batteruma eno din sheyyaase revii lakkodesh velamadnu shelishi lakkodesh min hattora urvii bekal vachomer
Shelishi lakkodesh min hattora minnayin dichtiv vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel mi la askinan dinga besheni vekaamar rachamana lo yeachel revii mikkal vachomer ha daamaran
Uvatteruma im nitmet ku amar rav shezvi bechiburin shanu aval shello bechiburin lo
Etiveh abbaye yad neguva metamma chavertah letamme lakkodesh aval lo latteruma divre rabbi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer lifsol aval lo letamme
I amratte bishlama shello bechiburin hayenu revutah dinguva ella i amratte bechiburin in shello bechiburin la may revuta dinguva
Itmar name amar resh lakish lo shanu ella yado
b: Aval yad chavero lo verabbi yochanan amar echad yado veechad yad chavero beotah hayyad lifsol aval lo letamme
Mimmay middekatane sefa shehayyad metammea chavertah lakkodesh aval lo latteruma ha tu lema li ha tena leh resha ella lav shema minah leetoye yad chavero
Veaf resh lakish hadar beh deamar rabbi yona amar rabbi amme amar resh lakish echad yado veechad yad chavero beotah hayyad lifsol aval lo letamme

Velifsol aval lo letamme tannae hi ditnan kol happosel bitruma metamme yadayim lihot sheniyyot veyad metamme chavertah divre rabbi yehoshua vachachamim omrim yadayim sheniyyot hen veen sheni ose sheni bachullin
May lav sheni hu dela aved ha shelishi aved
Dilma la sheni aved vela shelishi
Ella ki hane tannae detanya yad neguva metamma et chavertah letamme bakkodesh aval lo latteruma divre rabbi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer otah yad lifsol aval lo letamme
Ochlin ochalim neguvin beyadayim mesoavot ku tanya amar rabbi chanina ben antignos vechi yesh neguva lakkodesh vahalo chibat hakkodesh machshartan
La tzericha kegon shettachav lo chavero letoch piv o shettachav hu leatzmo bechush uvcharker uvikesh leechol tzenon uvatzal shel chullin immahen
Lekodesh gezaru behu rabbanan litruma la gezaru behu rabbanan
Haonen umchussar kippurim ku may tama kevan dead haidana hao asiri atzrechinhu rabbanan tevila
Matni chomer batteruma shebbihuda neemanin al tohorat yayin vashemen kol yemot hashshana uvishat haggitot vehabbaddim af al hatteruma
Avru haggitot vehabbaddim veheviu lo chavit shel yayin shel teruma lo yekabbelenna mimmennu aval mannichah laggat habbaa veim amar lo hifrashti letochah reviit kodesh neeman
Kadde yayin vechadde shemen

a: Hamdummaot neemanin alehem bishat haggitot vehabbaddim vekodem laggitot shivim yom
Gema bihuda in uvaggalil la may tama
Amar resh lakish mippene shertzua shel kutim mafseket benehen
Venetev beshida teva umigdal ha manni rabbi hi deamar ohel zaruk lav shemeh ohel detanya hannichnas leeretz haammim beshida teva umigdal rabbi metamme verabbi yose berabbi yehuda metaher
Velayetuh bichli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil amar rabbi eliezer shonin en hakkodesh nitzol betzamid patil
Vehatanya en chattat nitzolet betzamid patil may lav ha kodesh nitzol la ha mayim sheenan mekuddashim nitzolin betzamid patil
Vehaamar ulla chavrayya medakkan begalila mannichin lichsheyyavo eliyyahu vitaharenna
Uvishat haggitot neemanin af al hatteruma urminhi haggomer zetav yeshayyer kuppa achat veyittenenna leani kohen
Amar rav nachman la kashya ha becharfe ha beafle amar leh rav adda bar ahava kegon may keotan shel bet avicha

Rav yosef amar begalila shanu etiveh abbaye ever hayyarden vehaggalil hare hen kihuda neemanin al hayyayin bishat hayyayin veal hashshemen bishat hashshemen aval lo al hayyayin bishat hashshemen velo al hashshemen bishat hayyayin
Ella mechavarta kidshannin meikara
Avru haggitot vehabbaddim veheviu lo chavit shel yayin lo yekabbelenna hemennu aval mannichah laggat habbaa beo mineh merav sheshet avar vekiblah mahu sheyyannichenna laggat habbaa amar lehu tenetuha
b: Chaver veam haaretz sheyyarshu et avihem am haaretz yachol lomar lo tol atta chittin shebbemakom peloni vaani chittin shebbemakom peloni
Tol atta yayin shebbemakom peloni vaani yayin shebbemakom peloni
Aval lo yomar lo tol atta lach vaani yavesh tol atta chittin vaani seorim
Vetane alah oto chaver soref hallach umanniach et hayyavesh
Ammay yannichenna laggat habbaa baddavar sheen lo gat veyannichennu laregel bedavar sheeno mishtammer laregel
Veim amar hifrashti letochah reviit kodesh neeman tenan hatam modin bet shammay uvet hillel shebbodkin leose fesach veen bodkin leochle teruma
May bodkin amar rav yehuda amar shemuel menappeach adam bet happeras veholech
Verabbi chiyya bar abba mishshemeh deulla amar bet happeras shenniddash tahor leose fesach lo heemidu divrehen bimkom karet
Leochle teruma heemidu divrehen bimkom mita
Ibaya lehu badak lefischo mahu sheyyochal bitrumato ulla amar badak lefischo muttar leechol bitrumato rabba bar ulla amar badak lefischo asur leechol bitrumato

Amar leh hahu sava la tiflog aleh deulla ditnan keoteh veim amar hifrashti letochah reviit kodesh neeman alma middimheman akkodesh meheman name atteruma hacha name middimheman appesach meheman name atteruma

Kadde yayin vechadde shemen ku tana en neemanin lo al hakkankannim velo al hatteruma kankannim demay i kankannim dekodesh migo dimheman akkodesh meheman name akkankannim ella kankannim ditruma peshita hashta atteruma la meheman akkankannim meheman
Ella berekanim dekodesh uvishar yemot hashshana uvimlein ditruma uvishat haggitot
Tenan kadde yayin vechadde shemen hamdummaot may lav medummaot ditruma amri deve rabbi chiyya medummaot dekodesh
Umi ika dimua lekodesh amri deve rabbi ilay bimtaher et tivlo litol mimmennu nesachim
Kodem laggitot shivim yom amar abbaye shema minah dina hu deilave arisa lemitrach aggulfe shivim yomin mikkamme matzarta

Matni min hammodiim velifnim neemanin al kele cheres min hammodiim velachutz en neemanin ketzad hakkaddar shehu mocher hakkederot nichnas lifnim min hammodiim hu hakkaddar vehen hakkederot vehen hallokchin neeman yatza eno neeman
Gema tana modiim peamim kelifnim peamim kelachutz ketzad kaddar yotze vechaver nichnas kelifnim shenehen nichnasin

a: O shenehen yotzin kelachutz

Amar abbaye af anan name tenena hakkaddar shemmachar et hakkederot venichnas lifnim min hammodiim tama delifnim min hammodiim ha modiim gufah la meheman ema sefa yatza eno neeman ha modiim gufah neeman ella lav shema minah kan bekaddar yotze vechaver nichnas kan besheshshenehen yotzin o shenehen nichnasin shema minah
Tana neemanin bichle cheres haddakkin lakkodesh amar resh lakish vehu shennitalin beyado achat verabbi yochanan amar afilu sheen nitalin beyado achat

Amar resh lakish lo shanu ella rekanin aval melein lo verabbi yochanan amar afilu meleim vaafilu appikarsuto letocho veamar rava umode rabbi yochanan bemashkin atzman shehen temein veal titmah shehare lagin male mashkin lagin temein tumat shiva umashkin tehorin
Matni haggabbain shennichnesu letoch habbayit vechen haggannavim shehechziru et hakkelim neemanin lomar lo naganu uvirushalayim neemanin al hakkodesh uvishat haregel af al hatteruma

Gema urminhi haggabbain shennichnesu letoch habbayit habbayit kullo tame la kashya ha deika goy bahadayehu ha deleka goy bahadayehu ditnan im yesh goy immahen neemanin lomar lo nichnasnu aval en neemanim lomar nichnasnu aval lo naganu
Vechi ika goy bahadayehu may have rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar chad amar emat goy alehen vechad amar emat malchut alehen may benayehu ika benayehu goy sheeno chashuv

Vechen haggannavim shehechziru et hakkelim urminhi haggannavim shennichnesu letoch habbayit eno tame ella mekom derisat ragle haggannavim amar rav pinchas mishshemeh derav kesheasu teshuva dayeka name dekatane shehechziru et hakkelim shema minah
Uvirushalayim neemanin al hakkodesh tana neemanin al kele cheres gassin lakkodesh vechol kach lamma sheen osin kivshonot birushalayim
Uvishat haregel af al hatteruma menahane mile amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar kera vayyeasef kol ish yisrael el hair keish echad chaverim hakkatuv asaan kullan chaverim
Matni happoteach et chavito vehammatchil beisato al gav haregel rabbi yehuda omer yigmor vachachamim omrim lo yigmor
Gema yatev rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha akkila derabbi yitzchak nappacha petach chad vaamar mahu sheyyannichenna leregel acher

Amar leh idach yad hakkol memashmeshin bah veatte amratte yannichenna leregel acher amar leh attu ad haidana lav yad hakkol memashmeshin bah amar leh hachi hashta bishlama ad haidana tumat am haaretz baregel rachamana taharah ella hashta temea hi
Nema ketannae detane chada yannichenna leregel acher vetanya idach lo yannichenna leregel acher may lav tannae hi

La ha dekatane yannichenna rabbi yehuda veha dekatane lo yannichenna rabbanan vetisbera ha rabbi yehuda yigmor kaamar ella ha dekatane lo yannichenna rabbi yehuda veha dekatane yannichenna rabbanan umay lo yannichenna sheen tzarich lehannichah
Matni mishsheavar haregel maavirin al tohorat haazara avar haregel leom shishshi lo hau maavirin mippene kevod hashshabbat rabbi yehuda omer af lo beom chamishi sheen hakkohanim penuyin
Gema tana sheen hakkohanim penuyin millehotzi baddeshen
Matni ketzad maavirin al tohorat azara matbilin et hakkelim shehau bammikdash veomrin lahem hizzaharu
b: Shello tiggeu bashshulchan

Kol hakkelim shehau bammikdash yesh lahem sheniyyim ushlishim sheim nitmeu harishonim yaviu sheniyyim tachtehen kol hakkelim shehau bammikdash teunin tevila chutz mimmizbach hazzahav umizbach hannechoshet mippene shehen kakkarka divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim mippene shehen metzuppin
Gema tana hizzaharu shemma tiggeu bashshulchan uvammenora vetanna didan may tama la tane menora shulchan ketiv beh tamid menora la ketiv bah tamid
Veidach kevan dichtiv veet hammenora nochach hashshulchan keman dichtiv bah tamid dame veidach hahu likboa lah makom hu daata
Vetipok li dichli etz heasuy lenachat hu vechol keli etz heasuy lenachat la metamme may tama dumya desak baenan ma sak mitaltel male verekam af kol mitaltel male verekam
Hay name mitaltel male verekam hu kidresh lakish deamar resh lakish may dichtiv al hashshulchan hattahor mikkelal shehu tame

Veammay keli etz heasuy lenachat hu veeno mekabbel tuma ella melammed shemmagbihin oto umarin bo leole regalim lechem happanim veomrim lahem reu chibatchem lifne hammakom siluko kesiduro deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi nes gadol naasa belechem happanim kesiduro kach siluko shenneemar lasum lechem chom beom hillakcho
Vetipok li mishshum tzipuy dehatnan hashshulchan vehaddulpeke shennifchatu o shechipan beshayish veshiyyer bahem mekom hannachat kosot tame rabbi yehuda omer makom hannachat hachatichot

Vechi tema shane atze shittim dachashivi vela batli hanicha leresh lakish deamar lo shanu ella bichle ekkeselagem habbain mimmedinat hayyam aval bichle mesimem la batli shappir ella lerabbi yochanan deamar afilu bichle mesimem name batli may ika lememar
Vechi tema kan betzipuy omed kan betzipuy sheeno omed ha bea mineh resh lakish merabbi yochanan betzipuy omed o betzipuy sheeno omed bechofe et levizbezav o besheeno chofe et levizbezav
Vaamar leh la shena betzipuy omed vela shena betzipuy sheeno omed la shena bechofe et levizbezav vela shena besheeno chofe et levizbezav ella shane shulchan

a: Derachamana karyeh etz dichtiv hammizbeach etz shalosh ammot gavoha veorko shettayim ammot umiktzootav lo veorko vekirotav etz vayedabber elay ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai
Patach bemizbeach vesiyyem beshulchan rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam mizbeach mechapper al adam achshav shulchano shel adam mechapper alav
Kol hakkelim shebbammikdash yesh lahem sheniyyim ku mizbach hannechoshet dichtiv mizbach adama taase li mizbach hazzahav dichtiv hammenora vehammizbechot itakkush mizbechot ze laze
Vachachamim omrim mippene shehen metzuppin adderabba kevan dimtzuppin ninhu mitammeu ema vachachamim metammein mippene shehen metzuppin
Veibaet ema rabbanan lerabbi eliezer kaamri may datach mishshum dimtzuppin
Mivtal batel tzippuyan gabbayehu

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar talmide chachamim en ur shel gehinnam sholetet bahen kal vachomer missalamandera uma salamandera shettoledet esh hi hassach middamah en ur sholetet bo talmide chachamim shekkol gufan esh dichtiv halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai al achat kamma vechamma

Amar resh lakish en ur shel gehinnam sholetet befoshe yisrael kal vachomer mimmizbach hazzahav ma mizbach hazzahav sheen alav ella keovi dinar zahav kamma shanim en haur sholetet bo poshe yisrael shemmelein mitzot kerimmon dichtiv kefelach harimmon rakkatech al tikre rakkatech ella rekanin shebbach al achat kamma vechamma
Hadaran alach chomer bakkodesh uslika lah massechet chagiga
Chamesh esre nashim potrot tzarotehen vetzarot tzarotehen min hachalitza umin hayyibum ad sof haolam
Veellu hen bitto uvat bitto uvat beno bat ishto
Uvat benah uvat bittah chamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv
Achoto meimmo vaachot immo vaachot ishto veeshet achiv meimmo
b: Veeshet achiv shello haya beolamo vechallato hare ellu potrot tzarotehen vetzarot tzarotehen min hachalitza umin hayyibum ad sof haolam
Vechullan im metu o meanu
O nitgarshu o shennimtzeu ayelonit tzarotehen muttarot
Vei atta yachol lomar bachamoto uvem chamoto uvem chamiv shennimtzeu ayelonit o shemmeanu

Ketzad potrot tzarotehen hayeta bitto o achat mikkol haaraot haellu nesuot leachiv velo ishsha acheret vamet keshem shebbitto petura kach tzaratah petura halcha tzarat bitto venisset leachiv hashsheni velo ishsha acheret vamet keshem shetztzarat bitto petura kach tzarat tzaratah petura
Afilu hen mea
Ketzad im metu tzarotehen muttarot hayeta bitto o achat mikkol haaraot haellu nesuot leachiv velo ishsha acheret meta bitto o nitgarsha veachar kach met achiv tzaratah mutteret
Vechol hayechola lemaen velo meana tzaratah choletzet velo mityabemet
Gema mikkedi kullehu meachot ishsha yalfinan litne achot ishsha beresha
Vechi tema tanna chumre chumre naket verabbi shimon hi deamar serefa chamura
I hachi litne chamoto beresha deikar serefa bachamoto ketiva veod batar chamoto litne kallato devatar serefa sekila chamura
Ella bitto kevan deatya midderasha chabbiva leh

a: Kullehu name midderasha atu nehi dilinyan yibum atyan midderasha ikar isurayehu behedya ketiv behu bitto ikar isura midderasha
Deamar rava amar li rav yitzchak bar avdimi atya henna henna
Atya zimma zimma
Hashta deamratte kol milleta deatya midderasha chabbiva leh litne laachot ishsha levassof ayede deayeri beisur achota tena achot ishto
Velitneyeh lehay bava levassof ella tanna kurve kurve naket tena bitto uvat bitto uvat beno dikrove atzmo
Veayede ditna shelosha dorot lematta dideh tena name shelosha dorot lematta didah veayede ditna shelosha dorot lematta didah tena shelosha dorot lemala didah

Utna achoto vaachot immo dikrove atzmo veayede deayeri beisur achva tena achot ishto uvdin hu delakdemah lechallato mikkamme eshet achiv shello haya beolamo dela mishshum kurba hu daasira ella ayede deayeri beisur achva tena eshet achiv shello haya beolamo vahadar tena kallato
Umay irya ditna potrot litne osrot i tena osrot hava amena asur leyabem aval michlatz chaltza ka mashma lan
Velitne asura lachlotz may kaaved allema lo im atta omer choletzet mityabemet
Kevan devimkom mitzva hu daasira tzara veshello bimkom mitzva sharya mishshum hachi tane potrot

Umay irya detane min hachalitza umin hayyibum litne min hayyibum lechodeh i tena min hayyibum hava amena michlatz chaltza yabbome la meyabma ka mashma lan kol haole leyibum ole lachalitza vechol sheeno ole layyibum eno ole lachalitza
Velitne min hayyibum umin hachalitza i name min hachalitza lechodah abba shaul hi deamar mitzot chalitza kodemet lemitzot yabum
Minyana deresha lemaote may uminyana desefa lemaote may
b: Lemaote derav udrav assi lerav ulrav assi lemaote may
I sevira lehu dahadade chada lemaote tzarat memaenet vachada lemaote tzarat machazir gerushato
Vei la sevira lehu dahadade chada lemaote dechavreh vachada lemaote o tzarat memaenet o tzarat machazir gerushato
Lerav ulrav assi litninhu
Lefi sheenah betzarat tzara
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror legallot ervatah aleha bechayyeha aleha ma talmud lomar
Lefi shenneemar yevamah yavo aleha shomea ani afilu beachat mikkol araot haamurot battora hakkatuv medabber neemar kan aleha veneemar lehallan aleha
Ma lehallan bimkom mitzva af kan bimkom mitzva veamar rachamana lo tikkach
Veen li ella hi tzaratah minnayin talmud lomar litzror veen li ella tzaratah tzarat tzaratah minnayin talmud lomar litzror velo latzor

Veen li ella achot ishsha shear araot minnayin amarta ma achot ishsha meuchedet shehi erva vechayyavin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat vaasura layyavam af kol shehi erva vechayyavin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat asura layyavam

Veen li ella hen tzarotehen minnayin amarta ma achot ishsha meuchedet shehi erva vechayyavin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat vaasura layyavam vetzaratah asura af kol shehi erva vechayyavin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat vaasura layyavam tzaratah asura mikkan amru chachamim chamesh esre nashim potrot tzarotehen vetzarot tzarotehen min hachalitza umin hayyibum ad sof haolam
Yachol sheani merabbe af shesh araot chamurot meellu sheyehu tzarotehem asurot

Amarta ma achot ishto meuchedet shehi erva vechayyavin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat veefshar linase laachim vaasura layyavam vetzaratah asura af kol shehi erva vechayyavin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat veefshar linase laachim vaasura layyavam tzaratah asura
Yatzu shesh araot chamurot meellu hoil dei efshar linase laachim tzarotehen muttarot sheen tzara ella meach
Azhara shamanu onesh minnayin amar kera ki kol ish asher yaase mikkol hattoevot vego
Tama dichtav rachamana aleha ha lav hachi hava amena achot ishsha miyyabma may tama deamrinan ate ase vedache lo taase
Emar deamrinan ate ase vedache lo taase lo taase gereda lo taase sheyyesh bo karet mi dache vetu lo taase gereda menalan dedache

a: Dichtiv lo tilbash shaatnez gedilim taase lach
Veamar rabbi elazar semuchim min hattora minnayin shenneemar semuchim laad leolam asuyim beemet veyashar

Veamar rav sheshet amar rabbi elazar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya minnayin livama shennafla lifne mukke shechin sheen chosmin otah shenneemar lo tachsom shor bedisho usmich leh ki yeshvu achim yachdav
Veamar rav yosef afilu leman dela daresh semuchim bealma bemishne tora daresh deha rabbi yehuda bealma la daresh uvmishne tora daresh
Uvalma menalan dela daresh detanya ben azzay omer neemar mechashshefa lo techayye veneemar kol shochev im behema mot yumat semacho inyan lo ma shochev im behema biskila af mechashshefa biskila
Amar lo rabbi yehuda vechi mippene shessemacho inyan lo notzi ze liskila
Ella ov veyiddeoni bichlal mechashshefim hau velamma yatzu lehakkish lahem velomar lach ma ov veyiddeoni biskila af mechashshefa biskila
Uvmishne tora menalan dedaresh ditnan nose adam anusat aviv umfuttat aviv anusat beno umfuttat beno rabbi yehuda oser baanusat aviv umfuttat aviv
Veamar rav gidel amar rav may tama derabbi yehuda dichtiv lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv velo yegalle kenaf aviv kanaf sheraa aviv lo yegalle
Umimmay devaanusa ketiv meilaveh dikra dichtiv venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kasef usmich leh lo yikkach ish vego
Verabbanan i hava semich leh kidkaamratte hashta dela semich leh dichtiv lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv bentayim
Beshomeret yavam hakkatuv medabber velaavor alav bishne lavin
Uvmishne tora may tama dedaresh ibaet ema mishshum demochach veibaet ema mishshum demufne
Ibaet ema mishshum demochach deim ken lichteveh rachamana gabbe araot veibaet ema mishshum demufne deim ken lichtov rachamana lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv lo yegalle kenaf aviv lema li
b: Shema minah leafnoye vegabbe tzitzit name ibaet ema mishshum demochach veibaet ema mishshum demufne

Ibaet ema mishshum demochach deim ken lichteveh rachamana gabbe parashat tzitzit lemay hilcheta katveh hacha veibaet ema mishshum demufne mikkedi ketav uveged kilayim shaatnez lo yaale alecha lo tilbash shaatnez lema li shema minah leafnoye
Hane mitzrach tzerichi dei ketav rachamana lo yaale alecha have amena kol derech haalaa asar rachamana vaafilu mochre chesut ketav rachamana lo tilbash shaatnez dumya dilvisha deit beh hanaa
