Vei ketav rachamana lo tilbash hava amena daveka levisha dinfish hanayatah aval haalaa la ketav rachamana lo yaale alecha
Im ken lichtov rachamana lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim lema li

Mikkedi ketav uveged kilayim shaatnez lo yaale alecha vetana deve rabbi yishmael hoil veneemru battora setam begadim ufarat lecha hakkatuv beechad mehen tzemer ufishtim af kol tzemer ufishtim tzemer ufishtim dichtav rachamana lema li shema minah leafnoye
Veakkatti itzterich salka datach amena haalaa hi dela nefish hanaatah aval levisha dinfish hanayatah kol tere mine asar rachamana ketav rachamana tzemer ufishtim
Im ken lishtok kera mineh vetete shaatnez shaatnez mehaalaa
Vetanna deve rabbi yishmael tama dichtav rachamana tzemer ufishtim ha lav hachi kilayim betzitzit hava amena daasar rachamana vehachtiv veasu lahem tzitzit al kanfe vigdehem
Vetanna deve rabbi yishmael kal begadim tzemer ufishtim hem veamar rachamana aved leh techelet utchelet amra hu umimmay ditchelet amra hu middeshesh kitana techelet amra hu
Itzterich salka datach amena kidrava derava rame ketiv hakkanaf min kanaf uchtiv tzemer ufishtim
Ha ketzad tzemer ufishtim potrin ben beminan ben shello beminan shear minin beminan potrin shello beminan en potrin
Veha tanna deve rabbi yishmael let leh derava

Itzterich salka datach amena ki diyyuka derava hakkanaf min kanaf vehachi kaamar rachamana aved leh tzemer letzemer ufishtim lefishtim vechi avdatte tzemer letzemer tziveh aval tzemer lefishtim ufishtim letzemer la ketav rachamana tzemer ufishtim daafilu tzemer lefishtim ufishtim letzemer

a: Tinach letanna deve rabbi yishmael lerabbanan mena lehu
Nafka lehu merosho detanya rosho ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar lo takkifu et peat roshchem shomea ani af metzora ken
Talmud lomar rosho veka savar hay tanna hakkafat kol harosh shemah hakkafa
Ika lemifrach ma lelav dehakkafa shekken lav sheen shave bakkol
Ella atya mizzekano detanya zekano ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar ufat zekanam lo yegallechu shomea ani af kohen metzora ken talmud lomar zekano
Veim eno inyan lelav sheen shave bakkol tenehu inyan lelav hashshave bakkol
Veakkatti itzterich salka datach amena shane kohanim hoil veriba bahen hakkatuv mitzot yeterot afilu lav sheen shave bakkol la dache ka mashma lan dedache
Ella atya merosho dehach tanna detanya rosho ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar taar lo yaavor al rosho shomea ani af metzora venazir ken talmud lomar rosho
Ika lemifrach ma lenazir metzora shekken yeshno bishela dei la tema hachi ha dekayema lan deen ase doche lo taase vaase
Ligmar minnazir ella minnazir may tama la gamrinan deika lemifrach shekken yeshno bishela hachi name ika lemifrach shekken yeshno bishela
Ella leolam
b: Mikkera kamma im ken lema kera tzitzit taase lach gedilim lema li shema minah leafnoye
Hay leshiura hu daata gedil shenayim gedilim arbaa ase gedil ufotlehu mittocho
Im ken lema kera lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav lema li shema minah leafnoye
Veakkatti mibe leh letochef shette techifot chibur utchifa achat eno chibur im ken lichtov rachamana lo tilbash tzemer ufishtim yachdav shaatnez lema li shema minah leafnoye
Veakkatti mibe leh ad sheyehe shua tauy venuz ella kullah mishshaatnez nafka
Ashkechan deate ase vedache lo taase gereda lo taase sheyyesh bo karet hecha ashkechan dedache deitzterich aleha lemesrah
Vechi tema nelaf mimmila ma lemila shekken nichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot
Mippesach ma lefesach shekken karet
Mittamid ma letamid shekken tadir
Mechada la atya tete mittarte mehe tete mimmila ufesach shekken karet mippesach vetamid shekken tzorech gavoha
Mimmila vetamid shekken yeshno lifne haddibbur vealliba deman deamar ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar olat tamid hava umikkullehu name shekken yeshnan lifne haddibbur
Ella itzterich salka datach amena tete mikkibbud av vaem
Detanya yachol yehe kibbud av vaem doche shabbat talmud lomar ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru kullechem chayyavin bichvodi
May lav daamar leh shechot li bashshel li vetama dichtav rachamana et shabbetotay tishmoru ha lav hachi dache la

a: Lav dimchammer vaafilu hachi la dache
Ella dekayema lan deate ase vedache lo taase ligmar mehacha dela lidche
Vechi tema shane lave deshabbat dachamiri veha tanna bealma kae vela kafarech
Detanya yachol amar lo aviv hitamme o sheamar lo al tachzir yachol yishma lo talmud lomar ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru kullechem chayyavin bichvodi
Ella mishshum deika lemifrach
Ma lehanach shekken hechsher mitzva
Ella salka datach amena tete mibbinyan bet hammikdash detanya yachol yehe binyan bet hammikdash doche shabbat talmud lomar et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau kullechem chayyavin bichvodi
May lav bevone vesoter vetama dichtav rachamana et shabbetotay tishmoru ha lav hachi dache
La lav dimchammer vaafilu hachi la dache veella dekayema lan deate ase vedache lo taase ligmar mehacha dela dache

Vechi tema shane lave deshabbat dachamiri veha tanna bealma kae vela ka farech detanya yachol amar lo aviv hitamme o sheamar lo al tachzir yachol yishma lo talmud lomar ish immo veaviv tirau vego kullechem chayyavim bichvodi
Ella mishshum deika lemifrach ma lehanach shekken hechsher mitzva hechsher mitzva tipok li mehatam

In hachi name veet shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau lema li mibe leh lechidtanya yachol yityare adam mimmikdash talmud lomar et shabbetotay tishmoru veet mikdashi tirau neemra shemira bashshabbat veneemra mora bammikdash ma shemira haamura bashshabbat
b: Lo mishshabbat atta mityare ella mimmi shehizhir al hashshabbat af mora haamura bammikdash lo mimmikdash atta mityare ella mimmi shehizhir al hammikdash
Vee zo hi mora mikdash lo yikkanes adam behar habbayit bemaklo beminalo befundato uvavak sheal gabbe raglav velo yaasennu kappandarya urkika mikkal vachomer

Veen li ella bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyam minnayin talmud lomar et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau ma shemira haamura beshabbat leolam af mora haamura bammikdash leolam
Ella salka datach amena tete mehavara detana deve rabbi yishmael lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem ma talmud lomar
Ma talmud lomar i lerabbi yose lelav i lerabbi natan lechallek
Detanya havara lelav yatzata divre rabbi yose rabbi natan omer lechallek
Veamar rava tanna moshavot ka kashya leh moshavot ma talmud lomar
Mikkede shabbat chovat hagguf hi vechovat hagguf noheget ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz moshavot dichtav rachamana beshabbat lema li

Mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad lefi shenneemar vechi yihye veish chet mishpat mavet vehumat shomea ani ben bachol ben bashshabbat uma ani mekayyem mechalleleha mot yumat bishar melachot chutz mimmitat bet din o eno ella afilu mitat bet din uma ani mekayyem vehumat bachol velo bashshabbat
O eno ella afilu bashshabbat talmud lomar lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem ulhallan hu omer vehau elle lachem lechukkat mishpat ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem
Ma moshavot haamurim lehallan bevet din af moshavot haamurim kan bevet din veamar rachamana lo tevaaru
May lav rabbi natan hi deamar lechallek yatzata vetama dichtav rachamana lo tevaaru ha lav hachi dache
La rabbi yose vetihve name rabbi yose emar deamar rabbi yose havara lelav yatzata havara geredta
Havara devet din bishul petila hu
Veamar rav sheshet ma li bishul petila ma li bishul sammanin

Amar rav shimi bar ashe hay tanna la mishshum deate ase vedache lo taase ella mishshum demayete mikkal vachomer vehachi kaamar ma ani mekayyem mechalleleha mot yumat bishar melachot chutz mimmitat bet din aval mitat bet din dachaya shabbat mikkal vachomer

a: Uma avoda shehi chamura vedocha shabbat retzicha docha otah shenneemar meim mizbechi tikkachennu lamut shabbat shennidchet mippene avoda eno din shettehe retzicha docha otah

Umay o eno dekaamar hachi kaamar kevurat met mitzva tochiach sheddocha et haavoda veen docha et hashshabbat hadar amar kevurat met mitzva tidche shabbat mikkal vachomer uma avoda shehi docha shabbat kevurat met mitzva docha otah
Miulachoto shabbat shennidchet mippene avoda eno din shettehe kevurat met mitzva docha otah talmud lomar lo tevaaru
Ulmay dislek addateh meikara deate ase vedache lo taase may o eno dekaamar
Hachi kaamar ma ani mekayyem mechalleleha mot yumat bishar melachot chutz mimmitat bet din aval mitat bet din dache shabbat deate ase vedache lo taase

Hadar amar emar deamrinan deate ase vedache lo taase lo taase gereda lo taase sheyyesh bo karet mi shamatte leh dedache hadar amar attu ase doche et lo taase lav lo taase chamur mineh vekaate ase vedache leh
Ma li chumra zuta uma li chumra rabba talmud lomar lo tevaaru
Ella itzterich salka datach amena tihve hay eshet ach davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza min hakkelal lelammed lo lelammed al atzmo yatza ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza
Detanya davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza min hakkelal vechu ketzad

Vehannefesh asher tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim vetumato alav vahalo shelamim bichlal kodashim hau velamma yatzu lehakkish alehen velomar lach ma shelamim meuchadim kodshe mizbeach af kol kodshe mizbeach yatzu kodshe bedek habbayit
Hacha name ha eshet ach bichlal kol haaraot hayeta velamma yatzta lehakkish eleha velomar lach ma eshet ach sharya af kol araot name sharyan
Mi dame hatam kelal beisur ufrat beisur hacha kelal beisur ufrat beheter

Ha la dame ella ledavar shehaya bakkelal veyatza lidon bedavar hechadash shei atta yachol lehachaziro lichlalo ad sheyyachzirennu lecha hakkatuv beferush detanya davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza lidon bedavar hechadash i atta rashshay lehachziro lichlalo ad sheyyachzirennu lecha hakkatuv beferush
Ketzad veshachat et hakkeves bimkom asher yishchat et hachattat veet haola bimkom hakkodesh ki kachattat haasham hu lakkohen sheen talmud lomar kachattat haasham uma talmud lomar kachattat haasham
Lefi sheyyatza asham metzora lidon bedavar hechadash bevohen yad uvohen regel hayemanit yachol lo yehe taun mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach
b: Talmud lomar ki kachattat haasham hu ma chattat teuna mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach af asham taun mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach
Vei la ahdereh kera hava amena lemay dinfak nefak ulmay dela nefak la nefak hacha name hava amena eshet ach deishteray ishteray shear araot la
Ella salka datach amena tete bema matzinu meeshet ach ma eshet ach miyyabma af achot ishsha tityabem
Mi dame hatam chad isura hacha tere isure mahu detema hoil veishteri ishteri
Umna temra deamrinan hoil veishteri ishteri detanya metzora shechal shemini shello baerev happesach veraa keri bo bayyom vetaval amru chachamim af al pi sheen tevul yom acher nichnas ze nichnas
Mutav sheyyavo ase sheyyesh bo karet veyidche ase sheen bo karet veamar rabbi yochanan devar tora afilu ase let beh
Shenneemar vayyaamod yehoshafat bikhal yehuda lifne hechatzer hachadasha may chatzer hachadasha amar rabbi yochanan shechiddeshu bah devarim veamru tevul yom lo yikkanes lemachane leviyya
Veamar ulla ma taam hoil vehuttar letzarato huttar lekiryo mi dame lidulla

a: Tinach hecha denasa met veachar kach nasa chay demiggo deishteri isur eshet ach ishteri name isur achot ishsha
Ella nasa chay veachar kach nasa met isur achot ishsha kadem
Vaafilu nasa met name tinach hecha denasa met umet veachar kach nasa chay dechazya leh devene bene ella nasa met velo met veachar kach nasa chay la ichazya leh kelal
Mi la mode ulla sheim raa keri belel shemini sheen machnis yadav labbehonot shello yatza beshaa shehi reuya lehavi bah korban
Ella ki itzterich aleha hecha denasa met umet veachar kach nasa chay

Vei baet ema atya behekesha midderabbi yona deamar rabbi yona veitema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar kera ki kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot haelle venichretu hukshu kol haaraot kullan leeshet ach ma eshet ach sharya af kol araot name sharyan ketav rachamana aleha
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina mikkedi kol araot ika leakkoshinhu leeshet ach veika leakkoshinhu laachot ishsha may chazet deakkeshte laachot ishsha akkeshinhu leeshet ach
Ibaet ema lekulla vechumra lechumra makkeshinan ibaet ema hacha tere isure vehacha tere isure utre mittere yalfinan aval hacha chada isura utre mechada la yalfinan
Rava amar erva la tzericha kera deen ase doche lo taase sheyyesh bo karet ki itzterich kera lemesar tzara
Veerva la tzericha kera veha tanya en li ella hi
Mishshum tzaratah
Veha katane en li ella hen mishshum tzarotehen
Ta shema rabbi omer velakach ulkachah veyibbem veyibbemah leesor tzarot vaaraot
Ema leesor tzarot shel araot veha tere kerae kanasev leh may lav chad leerva vechad letzara
La idi veidi letzara chad lemesar tzara bimkom mitzva vechad lemishre tzara shello bimkom mitzva
May tama veyibbem veyibbemah bimkom yibum hu daasira tzara shello bimkom yibum sharya tzara
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane chamesh esre nashim potrot tzarotehen veilu peturot ufotrot la katane shema minah
Umay shena erva dela tzericha kera deen ase doche lo taase sheyyesh bo karet tzara name la tibe kera mishshum deen ase doche lo taase sheyyesh bo karet
Amar leh rav acha bar bivi mar leravina hachi kaamrinan mishshemeh derava tzara name la itzterich kera ki itzterich kera
b: Lemishre tzara shello bimkom mitzva may tama amar kara aleha bimkom aleha hu daasira shello bimkom aleha sharya
Amar leh rame bar chama lerava ema erva gufeh shello bimkom mitzva tishtere velav kal vachomer hu bimkom mitzva asira shello bimkom mitzva sharya
Amar leh tzara tochiach devimkom mitzva asira veshello bimkom mitzva sharya amar leh alecha amar kera bechayyeha kol shebbechayyeha
Hay bechayyeha mibe leh lemaote leachar mita hahi miveishsha el achotah nafka
I miveishsha el achotah hava amena nitgarsha sharya talmud lomar bechayyeha kol shebbechayyeha deaf al gav denitgarsha lo

Ella amar rav huna bar tachlifa mishshemeh derava tere kerae ketivi ketiv ishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror uchtiv legallot ervatah dachada mashma ha ketzad bimkom mitzva shettehen asurot shello bimkom mitzva hi asura vetzaratah mutteret
Efoch ana bimkom mitzva hi asura vetzaratah mutteret veshello bimkom mitzva shettehen asurot im ken lo yeamer aleha

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana mimmay dehay aleha leisura dilma lehettera vehachi kaamar rachamana ishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror lo hi velo tzaratah shello bimkom aleha aval bimkom aleha shettehen muttarot
Im ken legallot erva dachada hechi mashkachatte lah i bimkom mitzva shettehen muttarot i shello bimkom mitzva shettehen asurot
Gufa rabbi omer velakach ulkachah veyibbem veyibbemah leesor tzarot vaaraot mide tzarot ketiva hacha veod tzarot millitzror nafka
Litzror mappek leh rabbi lechidrabbi shimon
Tzara hacha ketiv hachi kaamar im ken lema kera velakach may ulkachah kol hecha deika tere likkuchin dei bae nasev hay vei bae nasev hay sharya vei la tarvayehu asirin
Veyibbemah bimkom yibum hu daasira tzara shello bimkom yibum sharya tzara verabbanan hay ulkachah may avdi leh
Mibe lehu lechidrabbi yose bar chanina deamar rabbi yose bar chanina ulkachah melammed shemmegarsha beget umachzirah veyibbemah al korchah
Verabbi derabbi yose bar chanina milleishsha nafka al korchah miyevama yavo aleha nafka
Verabbi hay aleha may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya en chayyavin bet din ella al davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat vechen hammashiach

a: Velo baavoda zara ella al davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veshiggato chattat utnan name kol mitzva shebbattora shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat yachid mevi kisba o seira nasi mevi sair mashiach uvet din meviin par
Uvaavoda zara yachid nasi umashiach meviin seira tzibbur meviim par vesair par leola vesair lechattat mena hane mile

Detanu rabbanan venoda hachattat asher chatu aleha rabbi omer neemar kan aleha veneemar lehallan aleha ma lehallan davar shechayyavim al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat af kan davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat
Ashkechan tzibbur mashiach menalan dichtiv bemashiach leashmat haam hare mashiach ketzibbur
Yachid venasi atya mitzot mitzot
Velo baavoda zara ella al davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat tzibbur baavoda zara yalef meene meene
Yachid nasi umashiach mivveim nefesh achat echad yachid veechad nasi veechad mashiach bammashma vav mosif al inyan rishon
Veyilmad tachton min haelon
Verabbanan hay sevara mena lehu nafka lehu middemakre leh rabbi yehoshua livreh tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama
Hukkesha kal hattora kullah laavoda zara ma avoda zara davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat af kol davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat
Ashkechan yachid venasi umashiach ben baavoda zara uven bishar mitzot tzibbur baavoda zara minnayin amar kera veim nefesh veyilmad elon mittachton
Ella tzibbur bishar mitzot menalan yalef meene meene verabbi hay tora achat may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben yechidim limrubbim
Yechidim biskila lefichach mamonan palet merubbin besayif lefichach mamonan aved
Yachol nachlok bekorbenotehen talmud lomar tora achat yihye lachem
Matkef lah rav chilkiyya mehagronya tama dichtav rachamana tora achat yihye lachem ha lav hachi hava amena nachlok may layeto layeto par tzibbur bishar mitzot hu demayetu
Kisba yachid bishar mitzot hu demayete seir nasi bishar mitzot hu demayete par leola vesair lechattat tzibbur baavoda zara hu demayetu veella may seira yachid name hayenu korbano
Itzterich salka datach amena hoil vetzibbur behoraa mayetu par leola vesair lechattat inhu name nayeto ipcha
I name tzarich veen lo takkana ka mashma lan
Amar leh levi lerabbi may irya detane chamesh esre litne shesh esre amar leh kimdumme li sheen lo moach bekodkodo
May datach immo anusat aviv
Immo anusat aviv pelugta derabbi yehuda verabbanan hi uviflugta la ka mayere
Vela vahare isur mitzva veisur kedushsha
Difligi rabbi akiva verabbanan vekatane
Befirkin ka amrinan veha bet shammay mattirin et hatztzarot laachin uvet hillel osrin
Bet shammay bimkom bet hillel enah mishna vahare eshet achiv shello haya beolamo
b: Difligi rabbi shimon verabbanan vekatane
Benolad ulvassof yibem la pelig rabbi shimon
Vehaamar rabbi oshaya chaluk haya rabbi shimon af barishona
Ha itotav rabbi oshaya
Vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav vechen tane rabbi chiyya bechullan ani kore bahen haasura laze mutteret laze vehaasura laze mutteret laze vaachotah shehi yevimtah choletzet o mityabemet
Verav yehuda metargem mechamoto veelach aval shita bave deresha la may tama
Kevan devitto
Beunsin mashkachatte benissuin la mashkachatte lah benissuin kamayere beunsin la ka mayere
Veabbaye metargem af bitto meanusato kevan deashkoche mashkachatte lah i baaya min haunsin tihve i baaya min hannissuin tihve aval eshet achiv shello haya beolamo la may tama
Kevan dilrabbi shimon hu demashkachatte lah lerabbanan la mashkachatte lah biflugta la ka mayere
Verav safra metargem af eshet achiv shello haya beolamo umashkachatte lah beshita achim vealliba derabbi shimon

a: Vesimanach met nolad veyibbem met nolad veyibbem

Ella lerabbi hane kelale let leh rav adda karchina kammeh derav kahana amar mishshemeh derava leolam it leh lerabbi hane kelale vehachi kaamar leh immo anusat aviv bachada mashkachatte lah betarte la kamashkachatte lah
I yaakov shette achaot anas achotah shehi yevimtah mashkachatte lah haasura laze mutteret laze la mashkachatte
Vei shette nochriyyot anas haasura laze mutteret laze mashkachatte lah achotah shehi yevimtah la mashkachatte lah
Rav ashe amar leolam let leh lerabbi hane kelale uviflugta kamayere umay kimdumme ani sheen lo moach bekodkodo dekaamar leh
Hachi kaamar leh may tama la dayekatte matnitin dematnitin rabbi yehuda hi deasar baanusat aviv
Dekatane shesh araot chamurot meellu mippene shehen nesuot laacherim tzarotehen muttarot immo veeshet aviv vaachot aviv may immo ilema nesuat aviv hayenu eshet aviv
Ella lav anusat aviv vekatane mippene shehen nesuot laacherim laacherim in laachin la man shamatte leh deit leh hay sevara rabbi yehuda deasar baanusat aviv mishshum hachi la tane leh
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe lerabbi yehuda name mashkachatte lah dei avar unsev dei la katane
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana bela dei name mashkachatte lah yaakov anas kallato veholid mimmenna ben umet reuven belo banim unfala lah kamme berah umigo deihi asira tzaratah name asira
Amar leh beachvata dehettera kamayere beachvata deisura la kamayere veaf al pi chen badkah levi bematniteh
Detane levi immo peamim poteret tzaratah ufamim enah poteret tzaratah ketzad hayeta immo nesuat aviv venisset leachiv meaviv umet zo hi immo sheen poteret tzaratah
b: Hayeta immo anusat aviv venisset leachiv meaviv umet zo hi immo sheppoteret tzaratah

Veaf al pi sheshshanu chachamim bemishnatenu chamesh esre yesh lanu lehosif shesh esre kegon zo amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan lelevi daamar dei name katane litne hacholetz livimto vechazar vekiddeshah umet belo banim demiggo deihi asura tzaratah name asira
Amar leh lefi sheenah betzarat tzara
Velema leh chayyave lavin hi vechayyave lavin bene chalitza veyibbum ninhu
Lidvarav kaamar leh ledidi chayyave lavin hem vechayyave lavin bene chalitza veyibbum ninhu ella ledidach chayyave karetot ninhu lefi sheenan betzarat tzara
Itmar hacholetz livimto vechazar vekiddeshah amar resh lakish hu en chayyav al hachalutza karet
Vehaachin chayyavin al hachalutza karet al hatztzara ben hu uven haachim chayyavin al hatztzara karet
Verabbi yochanan amar ben hu uven haachin enan chayyavin lo al hachalutza karet velo al hatztzara karet may tama deresh lakish amar kera asher lo yivne kevan shello bana shuv lo yivne
Ihu hu dekae belo yivne aval echav kidkayemi kayemi
Vaaleh didah hu dekae belo yivne ha tzara kidkayema kayema
Verabbi yochanan mi ika mide demeikara i bae hay chaletz vei bae hay chaletz vei bae lehay chaletz vei bae lehay chaletz vehashta kae alah becharet
Ella ihu shelichuta deachim kaaved ihi shelichuta detzara kaavda
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish hacholetz livimto vechazar vekiddeshah umet tzericha chalitza min haachin bishlama ledidi deamena chayyave lavin ninhu hayenu ditzricha chalitza min haachin
Ella ledidach ammay tzericha chalitza
Ultamach ema sefa amad echad min haachin vekiddeshah en lah alav kelum vei chayyave lavin ninhu ammay en lah alav kelum
Amar rav sheshet sefa atan lerabbi akiva deamar en kidushin tofsin bechayyave lavin velitne ledivre rabbi akiva en lo alav kelum

a: Kashya rav ashe savar lah keresh lakish umtaretz lah kerabbi shimon ravina savar lah kerabbi yochanan umtaretz kerabbanan
Rav ashe savar lah keresh lakish umtaretz lah kerabbi shimon hacholetz livimto vechazar vekiddeshah tzericha chalitza min haachin man achin
Achin hayyillodim keman kerabbi shimon
Amad echad min hannoladim vekiddeshah en lah alav kelum keman keresh lakish
Ravina savar lah kerabbi yochanan umtaretz lah alliba derabbanan hacholetz livimto vechazar vekiddeshah tzericha chalitza min haachin man achin achin hannoladim keman kerabbi yochanan
Amad echad min hayyillodim vekiddeshah en lah alav kelum keman kerabbanan
Itmar habba al yevama uva echad min haachin al tzaratah peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar becharet vechad amar baase
Man deamar becharet keresh lakish uman deamar baase kerabbi yochanan
Amar rav yehuda amar rav tzarat sota asura
Tuma ketiv bah kaaraot
Metiv rav chisda rabbi shimon omer biatah o chalitzatah meachiv shel rishon poteret tzaratah
Amar lecha rav amena lach ana sota deorayeta veatte amratte li sota derabbanan
Udkaare lah may kaare lah kasavar kol detakkun rabbanan keen deorayeta takkun
Metiv rav ashe nichnesa immo leseter veshahata immo kede tuma asura levetah vaasura leechol bitruma veim met choletzet
b: Velo mityabemet amar lecha rav amena lach ana sota vadday veamratte li atte sota safek umay shena sota vadday may tama mishshum dichtiv bah tuma
Sota safek name tuma ketiva bah detanya rabbi yose ben kipar omer mishshum rabbi elazar hammachzir gerushato min hannisuin asura min haerusin mutteret mishshum shenneemar achare asher huttammaa
Vachachamim omrim achat zo veachat zo asura ella ma ani mekayyem achare asher huttammaa lerabbot sota shennistera
Umay nistera nivala veammay kare leh nistera lishana mealleya naket nivala tuma behedya ketiv bah venistera vehi nitmaa
Lemekam alah belav verabbi yose ben kipar lav besota let leh vaafilu zannay name
May tama havaya veishut ketiv bah

Bea mineh rav yehuda merav sheshet hammachzir gerushato mishshenniset umet tzaratah mahu alliba derabbi yose ben kipar la tibe lach kevan deamar rabbi yose ben kipar tuma bemachazir gerushato hu dichtiva tzaratah kemotah
Vei mishshum dichtiv bah toeva hi hi toeva veen baneha toavin ha tzaratah toeva
Ki tibe lach alliba derabbanan af al gav daamur rabbanan tuma besota hu dichtiv en mikra yotze mide peshuto
O dilma kevan deiakar iakar ika deamri alliba derabbanan la tibe lach kevan deitakar iakar

Ki tibe lach alliba derabbi yose ben kipar may af al gav deamar rabbi yose ben kipar tuma bemachazir gerushato hu dichtiva miet rachamana hi toeva veen tzaratah toeva o dilma hi toeva veen baneha toavin ha tzaratah toeva
Amar leh tenetuha hayeta achat keshera veachat pesula im haya choletz choletz lappesula veim haya meyabem meyabem lakkeshera
May keshera umay pesula ilema keshera keshera lealma pesula pesula lealma kevan dildideh chazya may nafka leh minah
Ella lav keshera keshera leh pesula pesula leh umay nihu machazir gerushato vekatane veim haya meyabem meyabem lakkeshera
La leolam keshera keshera lealma pesula pesula lealma udkaamratte kevan dildideh chazya may nafka leh minah mishshum derav yosef
Deamar rav yosef kan shana rabbi lo yishpoch adam me voro vaacherim tzerichim lahem
Ta shema hammachzir gerushato mishshennisset hi vetzaratah choletzet hi vetzaratah salka datach ella ema o hi o tzaratah
Velav tarotze kamtartzatte lah taretz hachi hi choletzet tzaratah o choletzet o mityabemet
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba rabbi yochanan bae hammachzir gerushato mishshenniset tzaratah mahu amar leh rabbi amme vetibe lach hi gufah hi gufah la kamibaya li
Deamrinan kal vachomer bammuttar lah asura baasur lah lo kol shekken ki ka mibaya li tzaratah may mi allim kal vachomer lemidche tzara o la

Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne hachi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba bae rabbi yochanan hammachzir gerushato mishshenniset mahu amar leh rabbi amme vetibe lach tzaratah tzaratah la kamibaya li dela allim kal vachomer lemidche tzara ella ki kamibaya li hi gufah may mi allim kal vachomer bimkom mitzva o la

a: Amar leh tenetuha hayeta achat keshera veachat pesula im haya choletz choletz lappesula veim haya meyabem meyabem lakkeshera may keshera umay pesula ilema keshera keshera lealma pesula pesula lealma kevan dildideh chazya may nafka leh minah
Ella lav keshera keshera leh pesula pesula leh umay nihu machazir gerushato vekatane im haya meyabem meyabem lakkeshera
La keshera lealma pesula lealma udkaamratte kevan dildideh chazya may nafka leh minah mishshum derav yosef deamar rav yosef kan shana rabbi lo yishpoch adam me voro vaacherim tzerichim lahem

Ta shema hammachzir gerushato mishshenniset hi vetzaratah choletzet hi vetzaratah salka datach ella ema o hi o tzaratah velav tarotze ka metartzatte lah taretz hachi hi choletzet tzaratah o choletzet o mityabemet
Amar rav lele bar memel amar mar ukva amar shemuel tzarat memaenet asura leman ilema laachim hashta hi gufah sharya deamar shemuel meana baze mutteret baze tzaratah mibaya
Ella ledideh umay shena memaenet desharya leachin dela avda behu maase tzara name la avda behu maase
Gezera mishshum tzarat bitto memaenet vetzarat bitto memaenet mi asira vehatnan vechullan im metu o meanu tzarotehen muttarot
Demeana beman ilema demeana bevaal hayenu gerusha ella lav beyavam
La leolam bevaal utre gavene gerushin umay shena ki meana bevaal daakartinhu lenissuin
Ki meana beyavam name nissuin kammae ka akra
Mishshum detane rame bar yechezkel detane rame bar yechezkel meana babbaal mutteret leaviv bayyavam asura leaviv
Alma mishsheat nefila niret kechallato
Hacha name mishsheat nefila niret ketzarat bitto
Amar rav assi tzarat ayelonit asura shenneemar vehaya habbechor asher teled perat laayelonit sheenah yoledet
Metiv rav sheshet shelosha achin nesuin shalosh nashim nochriyyot umet echad mehem veasa bah sheni maamar
Umet hare ellu choltzot velo mityabmot shenneemar umet echad mehem yevamah yavo aleha mi shealeha zikat yavam echad velo zikat shene yevamin
Vekatane alah amar rav yosef zo hi tzarat eshet ach meav sheisur nefila garam lah shello matzinu bechol hattora kullah kegon zot
Zo hi lemaote may lav lemaote tzarat ayelonit desharya
La lemaote tzarat ayelonit daasira umay zo hi zo hi deisur nefila garam lah tzaratah baaya chalitza ayelonit afilu chalitza la baaya may tama ha deorayeta ha derabbanan
Tenan vechullan im metu o meanu o nitgarshu o shennimtzeu ayelonit tzarotehen muttarot la kashya kan shehikkir bah
Kan shello hikkir bah
Dayeka name dekatane shennimtzeu vela katane shehau shema minah amar rava
b: Hilcheta tzarat ayelonit mutteret vaafilu hikkir bah vaafilu tzarat bitto ayelonit
Veella ha dekatane shennimtzeu teni shehau ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan achat tzarat memaenet veachat tzarat ayelonit veachat tzarat machazir gerushato kullan muttarot

Tane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman shalosh nashim meshammeshot bemoch ketanna meubberet umnika ketanna shemma titabber veshemma tamut meubberet shemma taase ubbarah sandal menika shemma tigmol benah veyamut

Veezo hi ketanna mibbat achat esre shana veom echad ad shettem esre shana veom echad pachot mikken veyater al ken meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim achat zo veachat zo meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet umin hashshamayim yerachamu mishshum shenneemar shomer petaim Adonai
Middekaamar shemma titabber veshemma tamut mikkelal deika ketanna demiabbera vela meta im ken matzinu chamoto memaenet
Utnan i atta yachol lomar bachamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv shennimtzeu ayelonit o shemmeanu ema shemma titabber vetamut
Deamar rabba bar levay gevul yesh lah kodem hazzeman hazze enah mitabberet kol ikar toch hazzeman hazze hi meta veubbarah met leachar zeman hazze hi chayya veubbarah chay
Ini veha tane rabba bar shemuel i atta yachol lomar bachamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv shennimtzeu ayelonit o shemmeanu shekkevar yaldu ella leolam shemma titabber veshemma tamut veella kashya hach
Amar rav safra banim hare hem kesimanim veit deamri banim adifi missimanim lemay nafka minah daafilu lerabbi yehuda deamar ad sheyyirbe hashshachor bevanim mode

a: Verav zevid amar en banim belo simanim venivdok chayeshinan shemma nashru hanicha leman deamar choshshin
Ella leman deamar en choshshin may ika lememar afilu leman deamar en choshshin mishshum tzaar leda chayeshinan
Ketzad potrot tzarotehen vechu menahane mile amar rav yehuda deamar kera litzror hattora ribta tzarot harbe
Rav ashe amar sevara hi tzara may tama asira devimkom erva kayema tzarat tzara name bimkom erva kayema
Ketzad im metu hen ku vaafilu kanas ulvassof gerash

Urminhu shelosha achim shenayim mehen nesuim shette achaot veechad nasuy nochrit gerash echad mibbaale achaot ishto umet hannasuy nochrit uchnasah hamgaresh vamet zo hi sheamru sheim metu o nitgarshu tzarotehen muttarot
Tama degerash veachar kach kanas aval kanas veachar kach gerash la
Amar rabbi yirmeya tavra mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo hay tanna savar mita mappelet
Vehay tanna savar nissuin harishonim mappilim
Rava amar leolam chad tanna hu vezo veen tzarich lomar zo katane
Vechol sheyechola lemaen utmaen hashta vetityabem lema mesayea leh lerabbi oshaya
Deamar rabbi oshaya memaenet lemaamaro veenah memaenet lezikato
La tzarat erva shane detane rame bar yechezkel meana babbaal mutteret leaviv meana beyavam asura leaviv
Alma mishsheat nefila niret kechallato hacha name mishsheat nefila niret ketzarat bitto
Matni shesh araot chamurot meellu mippene shennesuot laacherim tzarotehen muttarot
Immo veeshet aviv vaachot aviv achoto meaviv veeshet achi aviv veeshet achiv meaviv
Bet shammay mattirin hatztzarot laachim uvet hillel osrim
b: Chaltzu bet shammay poslin min hakkehunna uvet hillel machshirin nityabmu bet shammay machshirin uvet hillel poslin

Af al pi sheellu osrim veellu mattirin ellu poslin veellu machshirin lo nimneu bet shammay millisa nashim mibbet hillel vela bet hillel mibbet shammay kal hatteharot vehattemaot shehau ellu metaharim veellu metammein lo nimneu osin teharot ellu al gabbe ellu
Gema amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi may tama devet shammay dichtiv lo tihye eshet hammet hachutza leish zar chutza mikkelal deika penimit veamar rachamana lo tihye
Uvet hillel mibe lehu lechidrav yehuda amar rav deamar rav yehuda amar rav minnayin sheen kidushin tofsin bivama shenneemar lo tihye eshet hammet hachutza leish zar lo tihye bah havaya lezar
Uvet shammay mi ketiv lachutz chutza ketiv uvet hillel kevan dichtiv chutza keman dichtiv lachutz dame

Detanya rabbi nechemya omer kol teva shetztzericha lamed bitchillatah hetil lah hakkatuv he besofah vetana deve rabbi yishmael kegon elim elima machanayim machanayema mitzrayim mitzrayema divlatayema yerushalayema midbara
Uvet shammay derav yehuda amar rav mena lehu milleish zar nafka
Uvet hillel name tipok lehu milleish zar in hachi name chutza lema li lerabbot haarusa
Veidach mechutza hachutza veidach chutza hachutza la mashma lehu
Rava amar tamayehu devet shammay deen isur chal al isur
Tinach hecha denasa met veachar kach nasa chay la ate isur achot ishsha vechayel aisur eshet ach ella nasa chay veachar kach nasa met achot ishsha kadem
Kevan dela ate isur eshet ach vechayel aisur achot ishsha haveya lah tzarat erva shello bimkom mitzva vesharya
Chaltzu bet shammay poslim vechu peshita
Leappoke derabbi yochanan ben nuri deamar bou untakken lahem latztzarot sheyehu choltzot velo mityabmot ka mashma lan devet hillel machshirim
Nityabmu bet hillel poslin ku ha tu lema li ayede ditna chaltzu tena name nityabmu
Tenan hatam megila nikret beachad asar uvishnem asar uvishlosha asar uvarbaa asar uvachamishsha asar lo pachot velo yoter
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan ikri kan lo titgoddu lo teasu aguddot aguddot hay lo titgoddu mibe leh legufeh deamar rachamana lo taasu chabbura al met
Im ken lema kera lo tegoddu may titgoddu shema minah lehachi hu daata veema kulleh lehachi hu daata im ken lema kera lo tagoddu may lo titgoddu shema minah tarte
Amar leh ad kan lo shanita makom shennahagu laasot melacha bearve pesachim ad chatzot osin makom shennahagu shello laasot en osin
Amar leh amena lach ana isura deamar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lekayyem et yeme happurim bizmannehem zemannim harbe tiknu lahem chachamim veatte amratte li minhaga
Vehatam lav isura hu vehatnan ballayela bet shammay osrin uvet hillel mattirin
Amar leh hatam haroe omer melacha hu delet leh veha bet shammay mattirin hatztzarot laachim uvet hillel osrim

a: Mi savratte asu bet shammay kedivrehem lo asu bet shammay kedivrehem verabbi yochanan amar asu veasu uviflugta derav ushmuel derav omer lo asu bet shammay kedivrehem ushmuel omer asu veasu
Emat ilema kodem bat kol may tama deman deamar lo asu veella leachar bat kol may tama deman deamar asu
I baet ema kodem bat kol vei baet ema leachar bat kol i baet ema kodem bat kol uchgon devet hillel rubba leman deamar lo asu deha bet hillel rubba
Uman deamar asu ki azlinan batar rubba hecha dechi hadade ninhu hacha bet shammay mechaddedi tefe
Vei baet ema leachar bat kol man deamar lo asu deha nefaka bat kol uman daamar asu rabbi yehoshua hi deamar en mashgichin bevat kol

Uman daamar asu karenan kan lo titgoddu lo teasu aguddot aguddot amar abbaye ki amrinan lo titgoddu kegon shette batte dinim beir achat hallalu morim kedivre bet shammay vehallalu morim kedivre bet hillel aval shette batte dinim bishte ayarot let lan bah

Amar leh rava veha bet shammay uvet hillel kishte batte dinim beir achat dame ella amar rava ki amrinan lo titgoddu kegon bet din beir achat pelag morin kedivre bet shammay uflag morin kedivre bet hillel aval shette batte dinin beir achat let lan bah
Ta shema bimkomo shel rabbi eliezer hau kortim etzim laasot pechamim beshabbat laasot barzel bimkomo shel rabbi yose haggelili hau ochlim besar of bechalav
Bimkomo shel rabbi eliezer in bimkomo shel rabbi akiva la detanya kelal amar rabbi akiva kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat en docha et hashshabbat
Vehay may teuvta mekomot mekomot shane udkaare lah may kaare lah
Salka datach amena mishshum chumra deshabbat kemakom echad dame ka mashma lan
Ta shema derabbi avahu ki ikla leatreh derabbi yehoshua ben levi hava metaltel sheraga vechi ikla leatreh derabbi yochanan la hava metaltel sheraga
Vehay may kushya vela amrinan mekomot shane anan hachi kaamrinan rabbi avahu hechi aved hacha hachi vehechi aved hacha hachi
Rabbi avahu kerabbi yehoshua ben levi sevira leh vechi mikkela leatreh derabbi yochanan la hava metaltel mishshum kevodo derabbi yochanan vehaika shammaa demoda leh leshammaa

Ta shema af al pi sheellu osrim veellu mattirim lo nimneu bet shammay millisa nashim mibbet hillel velo bet hillel mibbet shammay i amratte bishlama lo asu mishshum hachi lo nimneu ella i amratte asu ammay lo nimneu
Bishlama bet shammay mibbet hillel lo nimneu divne chayyave lavin ninhu
Ella bet hillel mibbet shammay ammay lo nimneu bene chayyave karetot mamzerim ninhu

Vechi tema kasavri bet hillel deen mamzer mechayyave karetot vehaamar rabbi elazar af al pi shennechleku bet shammay uvet hillel betzarot modim sheen mamzer ella mimmi sheisuro isur erva veanush karet ella lav shema minah lo asu
La leolam asu demodi lehu ufarshi
Vehachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa kal hatteharot vechol hattemaot shehau ellu metaharin veellu metammein lo nimneu osim teharot ellu al gabbe ellu
b: I amratte bishlama demodi lehu mishshum hachi lo nimneu ella i amratte dela modi lehu bishlama bet shammay mibbet hillel lo nimneu ditmaot devet hillel levet shammay teharot ninhu
Ella bet hillel mibbet shammay lamma lo nimneu teharot devet shammay levet hillel temaot ninhu ella lav demodi lehu shema minah
Umay ulmeh dehach mehach mahu detema tzara kala it lah ka mashma lan

Gufa amar rabbi elazar af al pi shennechleku bet shammay uvet hillel betzarot modim sheen mamzer ella mimmi sheisuro isur erva veanush karet man modim ilema bet shammay levet hillel peshita bene chayyave lavin kesherim ninhu
Ella bet hillel levet shammay hi gufah chayyave karetot hi
Leolam bet shammay levet hillel ulappoke midderabbi akiva deamar yesh mamzer mechayyave lavin ka mashma lan deen mamzer mechayyave lavin
Ta shema af al pi shennechleku bet shammay uvet hillel betzarot uvaachaot
Beget yashan uvisfek eshet ish uvimgaresh et ishto velana immo befundak
Bechesef uvshave kesef bifruta uvshave peruta

Lo nimneu bet shammay millisa nashim mibbet hillel velo bet hillel mibbet shammay lelammedcha shechiba vereut nohagim ze baze lekayyem ma shenneemar haemet vehashshalom ehavu rabbi shimon omer nimneu hen min havadday velo nimneu min hassafek
I amratte bishlama asu mishshum hachi nimneu ella i amratte lo asu ammay nimneu vetisbera nehi name deasu bishlama bet hillel nimneu mibbet shammay dechayyave karetot ninhu umamzerim hem levet hillel
Ella bet shammay ammay nimneu mibbet hillel bene chayyave lavin ninhu uchsherim ninhu kidamar rav nachman bar yitzchak lo nitzrecha ella latztzara atzmah hacha name la nitzrecha ella latztzara atzmah
Umay shena min havadday deisura hu safek name isura hu
La tema min hassafek ella ema min hassetam demodi lehu ufarshi
Umay ka mashma lan deahava vereut nohagim ze baze hayenu resha ha ka mashma lan dechullah rabbi shimon hi

Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan ben nuri heach halacha zo rovachat beyisrael naase kedivre bet shammay havalad mamzer ledivre bet hillel naase kedivre bet hillel havalad pagum ledivre bet shammay bou untakken lahen latztzarot

a: Sheyehu choltzot velo mityabmot lo hispiku ligmor et haddavar ad shennitrefa hashshaa
Amar leh rabban shimon ben gamliel ma naase lahem latztzarot harishonot meatta
I amratte bishlama asu hayenu dekaamar ma naase ella i amratte lo asu may ma naase
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lo nitzrecha ella letzara atzmah uma naase hachi kaamar hanach tzarot devet hillel levet shammay hechi naaved lehu
Lichletzu mimaasi aggavrayehu vechi tema limaasan deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom
Ta shema deamar rabbi tarfon teevani matay tavo tzarat habbat leyadi veessaenna ema veassienna
Veha teevani kaamar leappoke midderabbi yochanan ben nuri
Ta shema maase bevitto shel rabban gamliel shehayeta nesua leabba achiv umet belo banim veyibem rabban gamliel et tzaratah vetisbera rabban gamliel mittalmide bet shammay hu
Ella shane bitto shel rabban gamliel deayelonit havay ha middekatane sefa acherim omrim bitto shel rabban gamliel ayelonit hayeta mikkelal detanna kamma savar lav ayelonit hayeta
Hikkir bah velo hikkir bah ika benayehu
Veibaet ema kanas ulvassof gerash ika benayehu
Ibaet ema yesh tenay bevia ika benayehu
Metiv rav mesharsheya maase berabbi akiva shelliket etrog beechad bishvat venahag bo shene issurin
Echad kedivre bet shammay veechad kedivre bet hillel shema minah asu
Rabbi akiva gemareh istappak leh vela yeda i bet hillel beechad bishvat amur o bachamishsha asar bishvat amur
Metiv mar zutra maase veyalda kallato shel shammay hazzaken ufichet et hammaaziva vesikech al gabbe mitta bishvil katan shema minah asu hatam haroe omer leapposhe avir kaaved

Metiv mar zutra maase beshoket yehu shehayeta birushalayim vehayeta nekuva lammikve vechol teharot shehau birushalayim naasim al gabbah veshalchu bet shammay vehirchivuha shebbet shammay omrim ad shettipachet berubbah
Utnan eruv mikvaot kishfoferet hannod beovyah uvachalalah kishte etzbaot chozrot limkoman shema minah asu hatam
b: Haroe omer leapposhe mayya hu deka aved

Ta shema deamar rabbi elazar bar tzadok keshehayiti lomed tora etzel rabbi yochanan hachorani raiti shehaya ochel pat chareva bemelach bishne vatztzoret bati vehodati et abba amar li holech lo zetim veholachti lo raa otan shehen lachin amar li en ani ochel zetim
Bati vehodati et abba amar li lech veemor lo chavit nekuva hayeta ella shessetamuha shemarim utnan chavit shel zetim megulgalim bet shammay omrim en tzericha linnakev
Uvet hillel omrim tzericha linnakev umodim sheim nikva ustamuha shemarim shehi tehora
Veaf al pi shettalmid shammay haya kol maasav lo asa ella kedivre bet hillel i amratte bishlama asu hayenu revuteh ella i amratte lo asu may revuteh

Ta shema shaalu et rabbi yehoshua tzarat habbat mahu amar lahem machloket bet shammay uvet hillel vahalacha kedivre mi amar lahem mippene ma attem machnisin roshi ben shene harim gedolim ben shette machlokot gedolot ben bet shammay uven bet hillel mityare ani shemma yarotztzu gulgolti

Aval ani meid lachem al shette mishpachot gedolot shehau birushalayim mishpachat bet tzevoim mibben achmay umishpachat bet kofay mibben mekoshesh shehem bene tzarot umehem kohanim gedolim veshimmeshu al gabbe hammizbeach
I amratte bishlama asu hayenu dekaamar mityare ani ella i amratte lo asu ammay kaamar mityare ani unhi name deasu may mityare ani
Ha amar rabbi yehoshua en mamzer ella mechayyave mitot bet din nehi name demamzer la have pagum miha have
Mikkal vachomer mealmana ma almana sheen isurah noheg bakkol benah pagum zo sheisurah shave bakkol ku
Kavu mineh tzarot vekafashet leh bene tzarot tarte ka bae mineh tzarot may veim timtze lomar tzarot kevet hillel bene tzarot devet hillel levet shammay mahu
Lemay nafka minah lemifshat velad machazir gerushato levet hillel
Mi kaamrinan kal vachomer uma almana lechohen gadol sheen isurah shave bakkol benah pagum zo sheisurah shave bakkol eno din shebbenah pagum
O dilma ika lemifrach ma lealmana shehi atzmah mitchallelet vaamar lehu tzarot mityare ani

a: Bene tzarot ani meid lachem
Ta shema bime rabbi dosa ben harkinas huttera tzarat habbat laachin shema minah asu shema minah
Gufa bime rabbi dosa ben harkinas hittiru tzarat habbat laachin vehaya haddavar kashe lachachamim mippene shechacham gadol haya veenav kamu millavo levet hammidrash

Amru umi yelech veodio amar lahen rabbi yehoshua ani elech veacharav mi rabbi elazar ben azarya veacharav mi rabbi akiva halchu veamdu al petach beto nichnesa shifchato amra lo rabbi chachme yisrael bain etzlecha amar lah yikkansu venichnesu
Tefaso lerabbi yehoshua vehoshivahu al mitta shel zahav amar lo rabbi emor letalmidcha acher veyeshev amar lo mi hu rabbi elazar ben azarya amar veyesh lo ben laazarya chaverenu

Kara alav hammikra hazze naar hayiti gam zakanti velo raiti tzaddik neezav vezaro mevakkesh lachem tefaso vehoshivo al mitta shel zahav amar lo rabbi emor letalmidcha acher veyeshev amar lo umi hu akiva ben yosef amar lo atta hu akiva ben yosef sheshshimcha holech missof haolam vead sofo shev beni shev kemotcha yirbu beyisrael

Hitchilu mesabbevim oto bahalachot ad shehiggiu letzarat habbat amaru lo tzarat habbat mahu amar lahen machloket bet shammay uvet hillel halacha kedivre mi amar lahen halacha kevet hillel amru lo vahalo mishshimcha amru halacha kevet shammay
Amar lahem dosa shematem o ben harkinas shematem amaru lo chayye rabbi setam shamanu amar lahem ach katan yesh li bechor satan hu veonatan shemo vehu mittalmide shammay

Vehizzaharu shello yekappeach etchem bahalachot lefi sheyyesh immo shelosh meot teshuvot betzarat habbat shehi mutteret aval meid ani alay shamayim vaaretz sheal medocha zo yashav chaggay hannavi veamar shelosha devarim tzarat habbat asura
Ammon umoav measserin masar ani bashsheviit umkabbelim gerim min hakkardoyin umin hattarmodim
Tanna keshennichnesu nichnesu befetach echad kesheyyatzu yatzu bishlosha petachim paga bo berabbi akiva akshi leh veokmeh
Amar lo atta hu akiva sheshshimcha holech missof haolam vead sofo ashrecha shezzachita leshem vaadayin lo higgata leroe vakar amar lo rabbi akiva vaafilu leroe tzon
Ammon umoav measserin masar ani bashsheviit deamar mar harbe kerakkim kavshu ole mitzrayim velo kavshu ole vavel ukdushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo
Vehinnichum kede sheyyismechu alehen aniyyim bashsheviit
Umkabbelim gerim min hakkardoyim vehattarmodim ini veha tane rame bar yechezkel en mekabbelim gerim min hakkardoyim amar rav ashe kartoyim ittemar kidamri inashe kartoyim pesulim
Veika deamri tane rame bar yechezkel en mekabbelim gerim min hakkartoyim may lav hayenu kartoyim hayenu kardoyim amar rav ashe la kartoye lechod vekardoye lechod kidamri inashe kartoye pesili
Rabbi yochanan vesavayya deamri tarvayehu en mekabbelim gerim min hattarmodim umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehatnan kol hakketamim habbaim min harkam tehorim
Verabbi yehuda metamme mippene shehem gerim vetoim mibben haggoyim tehorim vehavenan bah
b: Kafasek vetane mibben haggoyim vaafilu min tarmod veamar rabbi yochanan zot omeret mekabbelin gerim mittarmod
Vechi tema zot vela sevira leh veha amar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna amorae ninhu vealliba derabbi yochanan
Mittarmod may tama la peligi bah rabbi yochanan vesavayya chad amar mishshum avde shelomo vechad amar mishshum benot yerushalayim

Bishlama leman deamar mishshum avde shelomo kasavar goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer ella leman deamar mishshum benot yerushalayim may hi peligi bah rav yosef verabbanan vetarvayehu mishshemeh derabba bar bar chana

Chad amar teresar alfe gavre veshita alfe kashtoye vechad amar teresar alfe gavre uminnayehu shita alfe kashtoye beshaa shennichnesu goyim lahechal hakkol nifnu al kesef vezahav vehem nifnu al benot yerushalayim shenneemar nashim betziyyon innu betulot beare yehuda

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan pasuk ze sar haolam amaro naar hayiti gam zakanti man amreh ilema kudsha berich hu mi ika zikna kammeh veella david amreh mi kashshish kulle hay ella shema minah sar haolam amaro

Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan may dichtiv yado paras tzar al kol machamaddeha ze ammon umoav beshaa shennichnesu goyim lahechal hakkol nifnu al kesef vezahav vehem nifnu al sifre tora amru ze shekkatuv bo lo yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal Adonai yissaref baesh
Tziva Adonai leyaakov sevivav tzarav amar rav kegon humanya lefum nahara
Amar rav yehuda amar rav assi goy shekkidesh bizman hazze choshshin lekiddushin shemma measeret hashshevatim hu veha kol defaresh merubba paresh
Beduchta dikvii deamar rabbi abba bar kahana vayyanchem bachlach uvchavor nehar gozan veare maday chalach ze chillazon vechavor

a: Zo chadyav nehar gozan zo ginzak veare maday zo chamdan vechavroteha veamri lah zo nihar vechavroteha chavroteha man amar shemuel kerach mushke chidke vedumke amar rabbi yochanan vechullan lifsul
Ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li bincha habba min yisreelit karuy bincha veen bincha habba min haggoya karuy bincha ella benah
Vehaika banot veamar ravina shema minah ben bittecha habba min haggoy karuy bincha gemiri divnata dehahu dara itzteroye itztero
Ika deamri ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li lo zazu mishsham ad sheasaum goyim gemurim shenneemar ba bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu

Yatev rav yosef achoreh derav kahana veyatev rav kahana kammeh derav yehuda veyatev vekaamar atidin yisrael deavdi yoma tava ki charva tarmod veha chariv hahi tamod havay rav ashe amar hayenu tarmod hayenu tamod ikkefole hu demikkafla chariv mehay gisa itiv mehay gisa vei chariv mehay gisa itiv mehay gisa

Yatev rav hamnuna kammeh deulla veka have bishmata amar ma gavra uma gavra i lav deharpanya mateh ikkesif amar leh kesaf gulgulta lehecha yahavatte amar leh lefum nahara amar leh im ken mippum nahara atte

May harpanya amar rabbi zera har shehakkol ponin bo bematnita tana kol sheen makkir mishpachto veshivto nifne lesham amar rava vehi amukka mishsheol shenneemar miyyad sheol efdem mimmavet egalem veilu pesul didhu let lehu takkanta
Pesule deharpanya mishshum pesule demeshon ufsule demeshon mishshum pesule detarmod pesule detarmod mishshum avde shelomo
Vehayenu deamri inashe kabba rabba vekabba zuta migandar veazel lishol umishsheol letarmod umittarmod lemeshan umimmeshan leharpanya
Hadaran alach chamesh esre nashim

Ketzad eshet achiv shello haya beolamo shene achim umet echad mehen venolad lahen ach veachar kach yibem hashsheni et eshet achiv umet harishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo vehashsheniyya mishshum tzaratah
Asa bah maamar umet sheniyya choletzet velo mityabemet
Gema amar rav nachman man detane rishona la mishtabbash man detane sheniyya la mishtabbash man detane
b: Rishona la mishtabbash may rishona rishona linfila uman detane sheniyya la mishtabbash may sheniyya sheniyya lenissuin mi la askinan deyibbem veachar kach kanas ella may sheniyya sheniyya benissuin

Eshet achiv shello haya beolamo hecha ketiva amar rav yehuda amar rav amar kera ki yeshvu achim yachdav shehayeta lahem yeshiva achat baolam perat leeshet achiv shello haya beolamo yachdav meuchadim bannachala perat leachiv min haem
Rabba amar achin min haav yalef achva achva mibbene yaakov ma lehallan min haav velo min haem af kan min haav velo min haem
Velelaf achva achva mearaot danin achim meachim veen danin achim meachicha
May nafka minah ha tana deve rabbi yishmael veshav hakkohen uva hakkohen zo hi shiva zo hi bia hane mile hecha deleka mide dedame leh aval hecha deika mide dedame leh middedame leh yalfinan

Velelaf achva achva millot dichtiv ki anashim achim anachnu mistabbera mibbene yaakov hava leh lemelaf mishshum demafne middahava leh lemichtav shenem asar avadecha bene avinu uchtiv achim shema minah leafnoye

Veitzterich lemichtav achim veitzterich lemichtav yachdav dei ketav rachamana achim hava amena lelaf achva achva millot vechi tema la mafne laye afnoye mafne middahava leh lemichtav reim uchtiv achim shema minah leafnoye ketav rachamana yachdav hamuchadim bannachala
Vei ketav rachamana yachdav hava amena dimyachadi beabba uvimma tzericha
Veha mehecha tete yibbum bannachala tela rachmana venachala min haav velo min haem hi itzterich salka datach amena hoil vechidush hu dekamishtere erva gabbeh ema ad dimyachadi beabba uvimma tzericha
Amar rav huna amar rav shomeret yavam shemmeta muttar beimmah alma kasavar en zika velema halacha kedivre haomer en zika
I hava amar hachi hava amena hane mile bitre aval bechad yesh zika
Velema halacha kedivre haomer en zika afilu bechad i amar hachi hava amena afilu mechayyim kamashma lan leachar mita in mechayyim la mishshum deasur levattel mitzvat yevamin
Tenan yevimto shemmeta muttar baachotah baachotah in beimmah la
Hu haddin daafilu beimmah veayede ditna resha ishto shemmeta muttar baachotah baachotah in aval beimmah la dehaveya lah isura deorayeta tena name sefa muttar baachotah
Verav yehuda amar shomeret yavam shemmeta asur beimmah alma kasavar yesh zika velema halacha kedivre haomer yesh zika
I hava amar hachi hava amena hane mile bechad aval bitre en zika veha ki peligi bitre peligi ella i amar hachi

a: Hava amena mechayyim aval leachar mita paka lah zika ka mashma lan dezika bichdi la paka lema mesayya leh yevimto shemmeta muttar baachotah baachotah in beimmah la
Hu haddin daafilu beimmah veayede ditna resha ishto shemmeta muttar baachotah daveka baachotah aval beimmah la dehaveya lah isura deorayeta tena name sefa muttar baachotah

Metiv rav huna bar chiyya asa bah maamar umet sheniyya choletzet velo mityabemet tama daavad bah maamar ha la avad bah maamar sheniyya name yabbome meyabma vei amratte yesh zika haveya lah tzarat eshet achiv shello haya beolamo bezika
Amar rabba hu haddin deaf al gav dela avad bah maamar sheniyya michlatz chaltza yabbome la miyyabma
Veha dekatane maamar leappoke mibbet shammay deamri maamar kone kinyan gamur ka mashma lan

Etiveh abbaye shene achin beolam echad vamet echad mehen belo valad veamad hashsheni hazze laasot maamar bivimto velo hispik laasot bah maamar ad shennolad lo ach umet harishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo ushniyya o choletzet o mityabemet vei amratte yesh zika haveya lah tzarat eshet achiv shello haya beolamo bezika
Ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar en zika umi sevira leh lerabbi meir en zika vehatnan arbaa achim shenayim mehen nesuim shette achaot umetu hannesuin haachaot hare ellu choltzot velo mityabmot
Vei salka datach savar rabbi meir en zika hane mittere batte kaatyan hay leyabem chada vehay leyabem chada
Leolam en zika mishshum dekasavar asur levattel mitzvat yevamin dedilma addimyabem chad mayet idach veka batlat mitzvat yevamin
Vei en zika tivtal deha rabban gamliel amar en zika umuttar levattel mitzvat yevamin
Ditnan rabban gamliel omer im meana meana veim lo meana tamtin ad shettagdil vetetze hallezu mishshum achot ishsha

Amar leh derabban gamliel adderabbi meir karamet la hachi kaamrinan rabbi meir chayesh afilu lisfeka rabban gamliel afilu levadday la chayesh dilma man dela chayesh afilu levadday la chayesh uman dechayesh afilu lisfeka chayesh
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef ha derav yehuda dishmuel hi ditnan
b: Shomeret yavam shekkiddesh achiv et achotah mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betira amru omrim lo hamten ad sheyyaase achicha maase veamar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira

Amar leh dei derav may amar leh kashya derav adderav dilma amorae ninhu vealliba derav kevan deitmar mishshemeh dishmuel behedya umishshemeh derav keamorae la shavkinan mishshemeh dishmuel behedya umokminan keamorae vealliba derav

Amar rav kahana amritah lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea amar attun hachi matnitu lah anan behedya matnenan amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shomeret yavam shemmeta asur beimmah alma kasavar yesh zika veazda shemuel letameh deamar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira

Utzrichi dei ashmeinan yesh zika hava amena hane mile bechad aval bitre la ka mashma lan vei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira hava amena hane mile mechayyim aval leachar mita paka lah zika ka mashma lan dezika bichdi la paka

Matni shene achim umet echad mehen veyibbem hashsheni et eshet achiv veachar kach nolad lahen ach umet harishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo vehashsheniyya mishshum tzaratah asa bah maamar umet hashsheniyya choletzet velo mityabemet
Rabbi shimon omer meyabem leezo mehen sheyyirtze o choletz leezo mehen sheyyirtze
Gema amar rav oshaya chaluk haya rabbi shimon af barishona mimmay middekatane mishna yattira
Bava deresha leman katane lah ilema lerabbanan hashta yibbem ulvassof nolad dechi ashkechah behettera ashkechah asri rabbanan nolad veachar kach yibbem mibaya ella lav lerabbi shimon itzterich
Utna resha lehodiacha kocho derabbi shimon utna sefa lehodiacha kochan derabbanan uvdin hu deniflog rabbi shimon beresha ella natar lehu lerabbanan ad dimsayemi lemiltayehu vahadar pelig alayehu
Ella eshet achiv shello haya beolamo lerabbi shimon hechi mashkachatte lah bechad acha umit venolad lo ach i name bitre vela yibbem vela mit
Bishlama yibbem veachar kach nolad ki ashkechah behettera ashkechah ella nolad veachar kach yibbem may tama kasavar yesh zika vezika kichnusa damya
Matkef lah rav yosef hashta zika umaamar mesappeka leh lerabbi shimon i kichnusa damya i lav kichnusa damya zika lechodah mibaya
May hi ditnan shelosha achin nesuin shalosh nashim nochriyyot umet echad mehem veasa bah sheni maamar umet hare ellu choltzot velo mityabmot
Shenneemar umet echad mehem yevamah yavo aleha mi shealeha zikat yavam echad velo shealeha zikat shene yevamin
Rabbi shimon omer meyabem leezehu mehen sheyyirtze vecholetz lashsheniyya yabbome tarvayehu la dedilma yesh zika vehau shette yevamot habbaot

a: Mibbayit echad yabbome chada veiptore idach la dedilma en zika kichnusa vehau lehu shette yevamot habbaot mishshene vattim alma mesappeka leh

Vechi tema middeorayeta hachi name demiyyabma chada umippatra chada umidderabbanan hu deasur gezera mishshum shemma yomru shette yevamot habbaot mishshene vattim chada miyyabma veidach mipatra bivvelo kelum
Veha tama derabbi shimon mishshum maamar velav maamar hu detanya amar lahem rabbi shimon lachachamim im maamaro shel sheni maamar eshet sheni hu boel
Veim maamaro shel sheni eno maamar eshet rishon hu boel
Amar leh abbaye vela shane lach ben zikat yavam echad lezikat shene yevamim dilma ki amar rabbi shimon zika kichnusa damya beyavam echad aval bishne yevamin la
Umi shane leh lerabbi shimon vehatanya kelal amar rabbi shimon kol shehalleda kodemet lannissuin lo choletzet velo mityabemet nissuin kodmin lalleda o choletzet o mityabemet
May lav beyavam echad vekatane lo choletzet velo mityabemet la bishne yevamim

Aval beyavam echad may hachi name o choletzet o mityabemet i hachi addetane nissuin kodmin lalleda o choletzet o mityabemet liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim bishne yevamim aval beyavam echad o choletzet o mityabemet
Kullah bishne yevamin kamayere veella may kelala
Veod metiv rav oshaya shelosha achin shenayim mehen nesuin shette achaot o ishsha uvittah o ishsha uvat bittah o ishsha uvat benah hare ellu choltzot velo mityabmot verabbi shimon poter
Vei salka datach kasavar rabbi shimon zika kichnusa damya leyabem lekammayeta vetiptar idach
Amar rav amram may poter name poter bashsheniyya vehatanya rabbi shimon poter bishtehen
Amar rava sheniyya shebbezug ze vehashsheniyya shebbezug ze
Ka tae rava bearbea zuge chada deo o katane veod rabbi shimon poter bearbatan mibe leh
Veod tanya rabbi shimon poter bishtehen min hachalitza umin hayyibum shenneemar veishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror beshaa shennaasu tzarot zo lazo lo yehe lecha likuchin afilu beachat mehen
Ella amar rav ashe i dinful beze achar ze hachi name hacha bemay askinan dinful bevat achat verabbi shimon savar lah kerabbi yose haggelili deamar efshar letzamtzem
Rav pappa amar beyibem veachar kach nolad pelig rabbi shimon benolad veachar kach yibem la pelig
Vetarvayehu lerabbanan itzterich velo zo af zo katane

Tanya keoteh derav pappa utuvta derabbi oshaya shene achim beolam echad umet echad mehem belo valad veamad hashsheni hazze laasot maamar bivimto velo hispik laasot bah maamar ad shennolad lo ach umet harishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo ushniyya o choletzet o mityabemet
Asa bah maamar veachar kach nolad ach o shennolad lo ach veachar kach asa bah maamar umet harishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo ushniyya choletzet velo mityabemet
b: Rabbi shimon omer biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehem poteret tzaratah chalatz levaalat maamar lo niftera tzara kenasah vamet veachar kach nolad lo ach o shennolad lo ach veachar kach kenasah vamet shettehen peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibum

Kenasah venolad lo ach veachar kach met shettehen peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibum divre rabbi meir verabbi shimon omer hoil uva umtzaah beheter velo amda alav shaa achat beisur meyabem leezo mehen sheyyirtze o choletz leezo mehen sheyyirtze
Ha bava desefa leman katane lah ilema lerabbi meir katane lah mikkedi la shane leh lerabbi meir ben yibem veachar kach nolad ben nolad veachar kach yibem learvinhu velitninhu
Ella lav rabbi shimon uvyibem veachar kach nolad pelig benolad veachar kach yibem la pelig shema minah

Amar mar amad hashsheni laasot maamar bivimto velo hispik laasot maamar bivimto ad shennolad lo ach vamet rishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo ushniyya o choletzet o mityabemet may amad umay lo hispik i avad avad vei la avad la avad
Ella amad middatah velo hispik middatah ella beal korchah udla kerabbi detanya haose maamar bivimto shello middatah rabbi omer kana vachachamim omrim lo kana
May tama derabbi gamar mibbia divama ma bia divama beal korchah af kiddushin divama beal korchah verabbanan gamri mikkiddushin dealma ma kiddushin dealma middatah af kiddushin divama middatah
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar mile divama mimmile divama hava leh lemelaf umar savar mile dekiddushin mimmile dekiddushin hava leh lemelaf

Asa bah maamar veachar kach nolad lo ach o shennolad lo ach veachar kach asa bah maamar vamet rishona yotza mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo ushniyya choletzet velo mityabemet rabbi shimon omer biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehen poteret tzaratah
Rabbi shimon aheya kae ilema annolad lo ach veachar kach asa bah maamar ha amratte benolad ulvassof yibem la pelig rabbi shimon ella aasa bah maamar veachar kach nolad lo ach
Chalatz levaalat maamar lo niftera tzara may tama mishshum dahavay tzara vadday uvaalat maamar safek veen safek motzi mide vadday
Yatev rav menashshe bar zevid kammeh derav huna veyatev vekaamar may tama derabbi shimon may tama derabbi shimon kidamar tama hoil uva umtzaah beheter velo amda alav shaa achat beisur
Ella may tama derabbanan amar kera ulkachah lo leishsha veyibbemah adayin yibbumim harishonim aleha ella ha ditnan kenasah hare hi keishto lechol davar veamar rabbi yose bar chanina melammed

a: Shemmegarsha beget umachzirah hatam name lema veyibbemah adayin yibbumin harishonim aleha vetive chalitza
Shane hatam deamar kera ulkachah lo leishsha kevan shellekachah naaset keishto lechol davar i hachi hacha name ha ketav rachamana veyibbemah
Uma raita mistabbera shedi hetera ahetera ushdi isura aisura
Ulrabbi shimon deamar hoil uva umtzaah beheter velo amda alav shaa achat beisur ella meatta achoto meimmo shennesaah achiv meaviv veachar kach nolad ach vamet tityabem hoil uva umtzaah beheter
Isur achoto lehechan azal hacha name isur achiv shello haya baolam lehechan azal hay isura delet leh hetera hay isura deit leh hetera
Matni kelal amru bivama kol shehi isur erva lo choletzet velo mityabemet isur mitzva veisur kedushsha choletzet velo mityabemet
Achotah shehi yevimtah choletzet o mityabemet
Isur mitzva sheniyyot middivre sofrim isur kedushsha almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot mamzeret untina leyisrael uvat yisrael lenatin umamzer
Gema kelal leetoye may amar rafram bar pappa leetoye tzarat ayelonit vechidrav assi
Veika deamri kol sheisurah isur erva hu daasira tzaratah ha la isurah isur erva tzaratah la asira lemaote may amar rafram lemaote tzarat ayelonit udla kerav assi
Achotah shehi yevimtah achotah deman ilema deisur mitzva kevan demiddeorayeta ramya kammeh paga baachot zekukato ella achotah deisur erva
Isur mitzva sheniyyot ammay kare leh isur mitzva amar abbaye mitzva lishmoa divre chachamim
Isur kedushsha almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot veammay kare lehu isur kedushsha dichtiv kedoshim yihu lelohehem
Tanya rabbi yehuda machlif isur mitzva almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot veammay kare leh isur mitzva dichtiv elle hammitzot

Isur kedushsha sheniyyot middivre sofrim veammay kare leh isur kedushsha amar abbaye kol hamkayyem divre chachamim nikra kadosh amar leh rava vechol sheeno mekayyem divre chachamim kadosh hu dela mikre rasha name la mikre ella amar rava kaddesh atzmecha bammuttar lach
Almana lechohen gadol kafasek vetane la shena min hannissuin vela shena min haerusin
Bishlama min hannissuin ase velo taase veen ase doche lo taase vaase ella min haerusin lo taase gereda hu yavo ase veyidche lo taase
Amar rav gidel amar rav amar kera vealta yevimto hashshara sheen talmud lomar yevimto ma talmud lomar yevimto yesh lecha yevama achat sheola lachalitza veenah ola leyibum veezo zo chayyave lavin
Veema chayyave karetot amar kera veim lo yachpotz haish lakachat ha chafetz meyabem kol haole leyibum ole lachalitza vechol sheen ole leyibum eno ole lachalitza
I hachi chayyave lavin name ha rabbi rachamana yevimto uma raita
b: Mistabbera chayyave lavin tafsi behu kiddushin chayyave karetot la tafsi behu kiddushin
Metiv rava isur mitzva veisur kedushsha ba aleha o chalatz lah niftera tzaratah vei salka datach chayyave lavin middeorayeta lachalitza ramya leyibum la ramya ki ba aleha ammay niftera tzaratah
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah litzdadin katane ba aleha aisur mitzva chalatz lah aisur kedushsha

Metiv rava petzua dakka uchrut shofcha seris adam vehazzaken o choltzin o meyabmin ketzad metu velahem achim velahem nashim veamdu achin veasu maamar binshotehen venatnu get vechaltzu ma sheasu asu veim baalu kanu

Metu achim veamdu hem veasu maamar binshotehen venatnu get o shechaltzu ma sheasu asu veim baalu kanu veasur lekayeman mishshum shenneemar lo yavo fetzua dakka vei salka datach chayyave lavin middeorayeta lachalitza ramya leyibum la ramya im baalu ammay kanu
Ella amar rava almana min haerusin name ase velo taase hu dichtiv kedoshim yihu lelohehem
Mamzeret untina may ika lememar ketiv vehitkaddishtem
I hachi kol hattora kullah name ase velo taase hu dichtiv vehitkaddishtem ella amar rava gezera almana min haerusin attu almana min hannissuin
Mamzeret untina may ika lememar gezera bimkom mitzva attu shello bimkom mitzva
Ella meatta eshet achiv meaviv lo tityabem gezera mishshum eshet achiv meimmo yibum benachala tela rachmana mida yedia
Ishsha sheen lah banim lo tityabem gezera mishshum ishsha sheyyesh lah banim bevanim tela rachmana mida yedia
Eshet achiv shehaya beolamo lo tityabem gezera mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo bishiva tela rachmana mida yedia
Kol hannashim lo tityabemna gezera mishshum ayelonit la shechicha mamzeret untina name la shechicha
Ella amar rava gezera bia rishona attu bia sheniyya
Tanya name hachi im baalu kanu bevia rishona veasur lekayeman bevia sheniyya

Hadar amar rava veitema rav ashe lav milta hi daamari deamar resh lakish kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase im atta yachol lekayyem shenehem mutav veim lav yavo ase veyidche et lo taase hacha name efshar bachalitza dimkayyem ase velo taase
Metivi veim baalu kanu teuvta
Itmar biat kohen gadol bealmana rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar chad amar enah poteret tzaratah vechad amar poteret tzaratah

a: Bealmana min hannissuin kulle alma la peligi dela patra deen ase doche lo taase vaase ki peligi bealmana min haerusin man deamar poteret ate ase vedache et lo taase uman deamar enah poteret la ate ase vedache et lo taase kevan deefshar bachalitza
Metivi veim baalu kanu teuvta
Lema tihve name teuvta deresh lakish amar lach resh lakish ki amena ana hecha dimkayemi mitzva aval hacha chalitza bimkom yibum lav mitzva hi
Amar rava remez lishniyyot min hattora minnayin shenneemar ki et kol hattoevot hael asu anshe haaretz hael kashot mikkelal deika rakkot umay ninhu sheniyyot
Umay mashma dehael lishana dekashe hu dichtiv veet ele haaretz lakach
Lema peliga derabbi levi deamar rabbi levi kashe onshan shel middot yoter meonshan shel araot shezze neemar bahen el veze neemar bahen elle el kashe veelle kashe meel
Gabbe araot name ha ketiv elle hahu lemaote middot mikkaret
Ella may chumrayehu hane efshar bitshuva hane la efshar bitshuva
Rav yehuda amar mehacha veizzen vechikker tikken meshalim harbe veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar kodem shebba shelomo hayeta tora doma lichfifa sheen lah oznayim ad shebba shelomo veasa lah oznayim
Rabbi oshaya amar mehacha peraehu al taavor bo sete mealav vaavor

Amar rav ashe mashal derabbi oshaya lema haddavar dome leadam meshammer pardes meshammero mibbachutz kullo mishtammer meshammero mibbifnim shellefanav mishtammer shelleacharav eno mishtammer veha derav ashe beduta hi hatam shellefanav miha mishtammer hacha i lav sheniyyot paga beerva gufah
Rav kahana amar mehacha ushmartem et mishmarti asu mishmeret lemishmarti
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef ha deorayeta hi deorayeta ufershu rabbanan kol hattora name pershu rabbanan ella midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma

Tanu rabbanan ma hem sheniyyot em immo veem aviv veeshet avi aviv veeshet avi immo veeshet achi haav min haem veeshet achi haem min haav vechallat beno vechallat bitto umuttar adam beeshet chamiv uveshet chorgo veasur bevat chorgo vechorgo muttar beishto uvitto
Veeshet chorgo omeret lo ani mutteret lecha uvitti asura lach

Bat chorgo deorayeta hi dichtiv et bat benah veet bat bittah mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa eshet chorgo omeret lo ani mutteret lecha uvitti asura lecha veaf al gav devitti asura lecha middeorayeta bedidi la gezur bi rabbanan tena resha name bat chorgo
I hachi eshet chamiv name tema ani mutteret lecha uvitti asura lach dehaveya achot ishto ha pesika leh ha la pesika leh

Amar rav arba nashim yesh lahen hefsek naket rav bideh telat eshet achi haem min haav veeshet achi haav min haem vechallato uzeri mosif af eshet avi immo amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vesimanach deilay derav
Verav may tama la chashev leh michallefa leh beeshet avi aviv
Uzeri lehatam shechiach veazel lehacha la shechiach veazel
Kallato
b: Deorayeta hi dichtiv ervat kallatcha lo tegalle ema kallat beno vechallat beno yesh lah hefsek veha tanya kallato erva kallat beno sheniyya vechen atta omer bivno uven beno ad sof kol haddorot ella ema kallat bitto
Deamar rav chisda ha milta miggavra rabba shemia li umannu rabbi amme lo asru kalla ella mippene kalla vaamaru li kaldae mallefana havet
Amena i gavra rabba havena esbera middatay i makre dardeke havena eshayelah merabbanan deatu leve chenishta hashta sevartah middatay lo asru kallat bitto ella mishshum kallat beno
Amar leh abbaye lerava asberah lach kegon kallateh deve bar tzetay rav pappa amar kegon kallateh deve rav pappa bar abba rav ashe amar kegon kallateh deve mari bar isak
Ibaya lehu eshet achi haem min haem mahu eshet achi haav min haem veeshet achi haem min haav deika tzad av hu digzaru rabbanan aval hecha deleka tzad av la gezaru behu rabbanan o dilma la shena

Amar rav safra hi gufah gezera vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera amar rava attu kullehu lav gezera ligzera ninhu immo erva em immo sheniyya ugzaru al em aviv mishshum em immo vetama may kullehu deve ima rabbati karu lah
Eshet aviv erva eshet avi aviv sheniyya ugzaru al eshet avi immo mishshum eshet avi aviv vetama may kullehu deve abba rabba karu leh
Eshet achi haav min haav erva eshet achi haav min haem sheniyya vegazru al eshet achi haem min haav mishshum eshet achi haav min haem vetama may mishshum dechullehu deve dode kare lehu
May ta shema dechi ata rav yehuda bar shela amar amri bemareva kol shebbinkeva erva bezachar gazru al ishto mishshum sheniyya

Veamar rava uchlala hu chamoto erva eshet chamiv mutteret bat chamoto erva eshet ben chamoto mutteret bat chamiv erva eshet ben chamiv mutteret choragto erva eshet chorgo mutteret bat choragto erva eshet ben chorgo mutteret
Veha derav yehuda bar shela leetoye may lav leetoye eshet achi haem min haem dechol shebbinkeva erva bezachar gazru ishto mishshum sheniyya
May shena hane umay shena ha ha bechad kidushin mekarev lah hane ad deika tere kidushin la mekarev lehu
Shelach leh rav mesharsheya mittosanya lerav pappe yelammedenu rabbenu eshet achi avi haav vaachot avi haav mahu middilmatta erva lemala name gezaru beh o dilma ha itpelig darata
Ta shema ma hen sheniyyot vela kachashev lehu bahadayehu
Tena veshayyar may shayyer dehay shayyar shayyar sheniyyot deve rabbi chiyya

Ammemar achshar beeshet achi avi aviv uvaachot avi aviv amar leh rav hillel lerav ashe ledidi chazya li sheniyyot mar bereh deravna uchtivan shitasre leisura may lav tamne dematnita veshet deve rabbi chiyya vehanach tarte ha shitasre
Ultamach shivsere haveyan deha ika eshet achi haem min haem defashtinan leisura ha la kashya

a: Hanach tarte dedamyan lahadade kachada chashev lehu veha shitasre veha mikkol makom ledidi chazyan lan dichtivan leisura amar leh velitamach i hava ketiv lehetera mi havet samchatte alayehu demar bereh deravna mi chatim alayehu hashta name dichtiv leisura lav mar bereh deravna chatim alayehu
Tane deve rabbi chiyya shelishi shebbivno veshebbevitto veshebbeven ishto veshebbevat ishto sheniyya revii shebbechamiv veshebbachamoto sheniyya

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe may shena lemala dekachashev lah leishto umay shena lematta dela kachashev lah leishto lemala deisura mikkoach ishto ka ate chashev lah lematta deisura lav mikkoach ishto kaate la kachashev lah
Veha ben ishto uvat ishto deisura mikkoach ishto kaate vela chashev lah ayede ditna shelosha dorot lematta dideh vela chashshevah tena name shelosha dorot lematta didah vela chashshevah
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana sheniyyot deve rabbi chiyya yesh lahen hefsek o en lahem hefsek
Ta shema deamar rav arba nashim yesh lahem hefsek vetu la dilma ki kaamar rav lehahi matnita ta shema shelishi urvii shelishi urvii in tefe la dilma mishshelishi veelach mervii veelach
Amar leh rava lerav nachman chazi mar hay merabbanan daata mimmareva veamar beo bemareva gazru sheniyyot begerim o lo gazru sheniyyot begerim
Amar leh hashta uma erva gufah i lav shello yomru bain mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla la gezaru behu rabbanan sheniyyot mibaya

Amar rav nachman gerim hoil vaato leyadan nema behu milleta achin min haem lo yaidu veim heidu edutan edut achin min haav meidin lechattechilla ammemar amar afilu achin min haem name meidin lechattechilla
Umay shena mearaot erva lakkol mesura edut levet din mesura veger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame

Matni mi sheyyesh lo ach mikkol makom zokek et eshet achiv leyibbum veachiv hu lechol davar chutz mimmi sheyyesh lo ach min hashshifcha umin haggoya mi sheyyesh lo ben mikkol makom poter eshet aviv min hayyibbum vechayyav al makkato veal killato uvno lechol davar chutz mimmi sheyyesh lo ben min hashshifcha umin haggoya
Gema mikkol makom leetoye may amar rav yehuda leetoye mamzer peshita achiv hu mahu detema lelaf achva achva mibbene yaakov ma lehallan kesherin velo pesulin af kan kesherin velo pesulin ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name kevan dilinyan yibbum miftar niftar
b: Mizkak name zakek
Veachiv hu lechol davar lemay hilcheta leorsho velitame lo

Peshita achiv hu salka datach amena hoil uchtiv ki im lishero hakkarov elav veamar mar sheero zo ishto uchtiv lo yittamma baal beammav lehechallo yesh baal shemmittamme veyesh baal sheen mittamme ha ketzad mittamme hu leishto keshera veen mittamme leishto pesula
Hachi name mittamme hu leach kasher veen mittamme leach pesul ka mashma lan veema hachi name hatam leappoke kayema hacha achiv hu
Chutz mimmi sheyyesh lo ach min hashshifcha umin haggoya may tama amar kera haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha
Mi sheyyesh lo ben mikkol makom poter vechu mikkol makom leetoye may amar rav yehuda leetoye mamzer may tama deamar kera uven en lo ayyen alav
Vechayyav al makkato ammay keri kan venasi veammecha lo taor beose maase ammecha
Kidamar rav pinchas mishshemeh derav pappa beose teshuva hacha name kesheasa teshuva
Vehay bar teshuva hu vehatnan shimon ben menasya omer ezehu meuvat lo yuchal litkon ze habba al haerva veholid mimmenna mamzer hashta miha ose maase ammecha hu
Tanu rabbanan habba al achoto vehi bat eshet aviv chayyav mishshum achoto umishshum bat eshet aviv rabbi yose ben yehuda omer eno chayyav ella mishshum achoto bilvad velo mippene bat eshet aviv

May tamayehu derabbanan amri mikkede ketiv ervat achotcha vat avicha o vat immecha ervat bat eshet avicha moledet avicha achotcha hi lema li shema minah lechayevo mishshum achoto umishshum bat eshet aviv
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda amar kera achotcha hi mishshum achoto atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum bat eshet aviv
Verabbanan hay achotcha hi may avdi leh mibe lehu lechayevo al achoto bat aviv uvat immo lomar sheen mazhirin min haddin
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda im ken lichtov rachamana achotcha hi lema li mishshum achotcha atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum bat eshet aviv
Verabbanan af al gav dichtiv achotcha itzterich lemichtav hi shello tomar bealma mazhirin min haddin
Vechi tema achotcha dichtav rachamana lema li milta deatya bekal vechomer tarach vechatav lah kera ketav rachamana hi
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda im ken lichteveh rachamana laachotcha hi beidach kera
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda hay bat eshet avicha may aved leh mibe leh mi sheyyesh lo ishut leavicha bah perat laachoto mishshifcha vegoya sheen ishut leavicha bah
Veema perat laachoto meanusa hahi la matzet amratte midderava
Derava rame ketiv ervat bat bincha o vat bittecha lo tegalle ha bat benah didah uvat bittah didah shere uchtiv ervat ishsha uvittah lo tegalle et bat benah veet bat bittah ha ketzad
Kan baonasin kan benissuin

a: Veema perat lechayyave lavin amar rav pappa chayyave lavin tafsi behu kiddushin

Dichtiv ki tihyena leish shette nashim haachat ahuva vehaachat senua vechi yesh ahuva lifne hammakom veyesh senua lifne hammakom ella ahuva ahuva benisueha senua senua benisueha veamar rachamana ki tihyena

Veema perat lechayyave karetot amar rava amar kera ervat achotcha vat avicha o vat immecha moledet bayit o moledet chutz ben sheomrim lo leavicha kayyem ben sheomrim lo leavicha hotze veamar rachamana achotcha hi

Ema ben sheomer lo avicha kayyem ben sheomer lo avicha hotze veamar rachamana achotcha hi lerabbot achoto mishshifcha vegoya amar kera bat eshet avicha mi sheyyesh lo ishut leavicha bah perat laachoto mishshifcha vegoya
Uma raita mistabbera chayyave karetot hava leh lerabbot shekken tafsi bahen kiddushin lealma
Adderabba shifcha vegoya hava leh lerabbot dei miggayera ledideh name tafsi bah kiddushin lechi miggayera gufa acharina hi
Verabbanan lemaote shifcha vegoya mena lehu nafka lehu mehaishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda chad beshifcha vechad begoya utzrichi dei ashmeinan shifcha mishshum deen lah chayis aval goya deit lah chayis ema la
Vei ashmeinan goya mishshum dela shayecha bemitzot aval shifcha deshayecha bemitzot ema la tzericha
Verabbanan ashkechan shifcha goya mena lehu vechi tema nelaf mishshifcha hanhu mitzrach tzerichi
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay amar kera ki yasir et bincha meacharay bincha miyyisreelit karuy bincha veen bincha habba min haggoya karuy bincha ella benah
Amar ravina shema minah ben bittecha habba min haggoy karuy bincha lema kasavar ravina goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad kasher nehi demamzer la have kasher name la have yisrael pasul mikre
Hay beshiva goyim ketiv ki yasir lerabbot kol hammesirim
Hanicha lerabbi shimon dedaresh tama dikra ella lerabbanan mena lehu man tanna diflig aleh derabbi yose berabbi yehuda rabbi shimon hi
b: Matni mi shekkidesh achat mishte achaot veen yodea e zo mehen kidesh noten get lazo veget lazo met velo ach echad choletz lishtehen
Hau lo shenayim echad choletz veechad meyabem kadmu vechansu en motziin miyyadam
Shenayim shekkiddeshu shette achaot ze eno yodea e zo kidesh veze eno yodea ezo kidesh ze noten shene gitin veze noten shene gitin metu laze ach velaze ach ze choletz lishtehen veze choletz lishtehen
