Laze echad velaze shenayim hayyachid choletz lishtehen vehashshenayim echad choletz veechad meyabem kadmu vechansu en motziin miyyadam laze shenayim velaze shenayim achiv shel ze choletz leachat veachiv shel ze choletz leachat achiv shel ze meyabem chalutzato shel ze veachiv shel ze meyabem chalutzato shel ze
Kadmu shenayim vechaltzu lo yeyabbemu hashshenayim ella echad choletz veechad meyabem kadmu vechansu en motziin miyyadam
Gema shema minah kiddushin sheen mesurin levia hau kiddushin
Hacha bemay askinan keshehukkeru ulvassof nitarvu dayeka name dekatane veeno yodea vela katane veeno yadua shema minah

May ka mashma lan sefa itztericha leh met velo ach echad choletz lishtehen hau lo shenayim echad choletz veechad meyabem daveka michlatz vahadar yabbome aval yabbome beresha la deka paga baachot zekukato

Shenayim shekkiddeshu shette achaot vechu shema minah kiddushin sheen mesurin levia hau kiddushin hacha name keshehukkeru ulvassof nitarvu dayeka name dekatane veen yodea vela katane veen yadua shema minah
Umay ka mashma lan sefa itztericha leh metu laze echad velaze shenayim hayyachid choletz lishtehen vehashshenayim echad choletz veechad meyabem
Peshita hayenu resha mahu detema ligzor tere attu chad ka mashma lan
Vedaveka michlatz vahadar yabbome aval yabbome beresha la deka paga bivama lashshuk
Laze shenayim velaze shenayim vechu ha tu lema li hayenu hach mahu detema ligzor dilma meyabem belo chalitza ka mashma lan
May shena meha ditnan arbaa achin shenayim mehen nesuin shette achaot umetu hannesuin et haachaot hare ellu choltzot velo mityabmot
Hachi hashta

a: Hatam i leman deamar yesh zika yesh zika vei leman deamar asur levattel mitzvat yevamin asur levattel mitzvat yevamin hacha kol chad vechad emor dideh ka mitramya leh
Kadmu vechansu en motziin ku tane shela vaafilu shenehem kohanim may tama chalutza derabbanan hi vesafek chalutza la gezaru behu rabbanan
Vachalutza derabbanan hi vehatanya gerusha en li ella gerusha chalutza minnayin talmud lomar veishsha midderabbanan hu ukra asmachta bealma hu
Matni mitzva baggadol leyabem veim kadam hakkatan zacha
Gema tanu rabbanan vehaya habbechor mikan shemmitzva baggadol leyabem asher teled perat leayelonit sheen yoledet yakum al shem achiv lenachala

Atta omer lenachala o eno ella leshem yosef korin oto yosef yochanan korin oto yochanan neemar kan yakum al shem achiv veneemar lehallan al shem achehem yikkaru benachalatam ma shem haamur lehallan nachala af shem haamur kan lenachala
Velo yimmache shemo perat lesaris sheshshemo machuy
Amar rava af al gav divchol hattora kullah en mikra yotze mide feshuto hacha atay gezera shava appekteh mippeshateh ligmare
Vei lav gezera shava hava amena shem shem mammash leman kamazhar rachamana leyavam yakum al shem achicha mibe leh i leve dina yakum al shem achi aviv mibe leh
Vedilma hachi kaamar lehu rachamana levet din emaru leh leyavam yakum al shem achiv ella atay gezera shava appekteh ligmare
Hashta deamratte kera begadol ketiv ema bechor leyabem pashut la leyabem
Im ken eshet achiv shello haya beolamo demiet rachamana lema li
Parech rav acha veema lemaote buchra deimma hahu la matzet amratte deyibbum benachala tela rachamana venachala min haav velo min haem
Veema ki ika bechor titkayyem mitzvat yibbum ki leka bechor lo titkayyem mitzvat yibbum amar kera umet achad mehem mi la askinan demit bechor veamar rachamana leyabem katan
Veema demit katan veamar rachamana leyabem bechor ha miet rachamana eshet achiv shello haya beolamo
Veema ki leka bechor kedam katan zecha vei ika bechor kedam katan la zecha amar kera ki yeshvu achim yachdav hukkesha yeshivat achim ze laze
Veema ki ika bechor lehdar aggadol ki leka bechor en chozrin etzel gadol allema tane abbaye kashshisha mitzva baggadol leyabem lo ratza holchim etzel achiv hakkatan lo ratza chozrin etzel gadol
Kivchor ma bechor bechorato garma lo af gadol gedullato garma lo
Veema ki meyabem bechor lishkol nachala ki meyabem pashut la lishkol nachala amar kera yakum al shem achiv vahare kam
Veella bechor dekaryeh rachamana
b: Lemay hilcheta ligriuta ma bechor eno notel barauy kivmuchzak af hay eno notel barauy kivmuchzak
Matni hannitan al hashshifcha venishtachrera o al haggoya venitgayera hare ze lo yichnos veim kanas en motziin miyyado hannitan al eshet ish vehotziuha mittachat yado af al pi shekkanas yotzi

Gema ha giyyoret miha haveya urminhi echad ish shennitgayyer leshum ishsha veechad ishsha shennitgayera leshum ish vechen mi shennitgayyer leshum shulchan melachim leshum avde shelomo enan gerim divre rabbi nechemya
Shehaya rabbi nechemya omer echad gere araot veechad gere chalomot veechad gere mordochay veester enan gerim ad sheyyitgayeru bazzeman hazze
Bazzeman hazze salka datach ella ema kevazzeman hazze
Ha itmar alah amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav halacha kedivre haomer kullam gerim hem
I hachi lechattechilla name mishshum derav assi deamar rav assi haser mimmecha ikkeshut pe ulzut sefatayim vego

Tanu rabbanan en mekabbelin gerim limot hammashiach kayyotze bo lo kibbelu gerim lo bime david velo bime shelomo amar rabbi eliezer may kera hen gor yagur efes meoti mi gar ittach alayich yippol aval idach la
Hannitan al eshet ish vechu amar rav uvedim
Amar rav sheshet amena ki nayem veshachev rav amar lehay shematata detanya hannitan al eshet ish vehotziuha al yado venitgarsha mittachat yede acher im kanas lo yotzi
Hechi dame i deika edim ki ata acher veafsekeh lekala may have ella lav deleka edim vetama daata acher veafsekeh lekala ha lav hachi mappekinan
Amar lecha rav hu haddin deaf al gav dela ata acher veafsekeh lekala i ika edim mappekinan i leka edim la mappekinan vehachi kaamar deaf al gav daata acher veafsekeh lekala lechattechilla lo yichnos
Metivi bamme devarim amurim kesheen lah banim aval yesh lah banim lo tetze veim bau ede tuma afilu yesh lah kamma banim tetze

Rav moke lah lematnitin beyesh lah banim veyesh lah edim umay duchkeh derav leokome lematnitin beyesh lah banim veyesh lah edim vetama deika edim mappekinan vei leka edim la mappekinan lokmah besheen lah banim af al gav deleka edim
Amar rava matnitin keshiteh may irya detane hotziuha litne hotziah ella kol hotziuha bevet din uvet din beedim hu demappeki

Neshe legabbe neshe shechichan deazlan gavre legabbe gavre la shechichan

b: Chamsha name lemita ditre la chayeshinan

Gufa amar shemuel chalatz laachaot lo nifteru tzarot letzarot nifteru achaot chalatz levaalat hagget lo niftera tzara letzara niftera baalat hagget
Chalatz levaalat hammaamar lo niftera tzara letzara niftera baalat maamar
May shena laachaot delo nifteru tzarot dehaveya lo lah achot ishsha bezika chalatz letzarot name la lipatru achaot dehaveya lehu tzarot achot ishsha bezika kasavar shemuel en zika
Veha amar shemuel yesh zika ledivre haomer en zika kaamar

I hachi chalatz letzarot nifteru achaot veatztzarat rachel mi mipatra veha tenan asur adam betzarat kerovat chalutzato

Rav ashe amar leolam kidkaamratte umishshum dela allima zika leshauoye letzara keerva
Tanya keoteh derav ashe chalatz laachaot lo nifteru tzarot ha letzarot nifteru achaot may tama lav mishshum dekasavar yesh zika vela allima zika leshauoyah letzara keerva

Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav kol yevama sheen ani kore bah bishat nefila yevamah yavo aleha hare hi keeshet ach sheyyesh lah banim vaasura may ka mashma lan tenena hare zo asura alav olamit hoil veneesra alav shaa achat
Mahu detema hane mile hecha dela ichazya lah binfila rishona aval hecha deichazya lah binfila rishona ema tishtere ka mashma lan
Ha name tenena shene achin nesuin shette achaot met echad mehem veachar kach meta ishto shel sheni hare zo asura alav olamit hoil veneesra alav shaa achat
Mahu detema hatam hu deidchay lah mehay beta ligmare aval hacha dela idchay lah mehay beta ligmare ema migo dechazya lehay nesuy nochrit chazya name lehay ka mashma lan

Matni shelosha achim shenayim mehem nesuin shette achaot veechad nasuy nochrit gerash echad mibbaale achaot et ishto umet nesuy nochrit uchnasah hamgaresh vamet zo hi sheamru vechullan shemmetu o nitgarshu tzarotehen muttarot
Gema tama degerash veachar kach met aval met veachar kach gerash asura amar rav ashe zot omeret yesh zika afilu bitre ache
Ulrav ashe kashya derav nachman amar lach rav ashe hu haddin deaf al gav dela avad bah maamar nochrit michlatz chaltza yabbome la miyyabma veha dekatane maamar leappoke bet shammay deamri maamar kone
b: Kinyan gamur ka mashma lan dela kevet shammay
Ulrav nachman kashya derav ashe vechi tema hu haddin daafilu met veachar kach gerash tzaratah mutteret ella zo hi lemaote may lemaote kanas veachar kach gerash
Hanicha i savar lah kerabbi yirmeya deamar tavra mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo
Vehay tanna savar mita mappelet vehay tanna savar nisuin harishonim mappilim
Zo hi lemaote kanas ulvassof gerash ella i savar lah kerava deamar leolam chad tanna hu vezo veen tzarich lomar zo katane zo hi lemaote may al korchach kerabbi yirmeya sevira leh
Ulrava hanicha i savar lah kerav ashe zo hi lemaote met belo geresh ella i savar lah kerav nachman zo hi lemaote may al korchach kerav ashe sevira leh
Matni vechullan shehau bahen kiddushin o gerushin besafek hare ellu hatztzarot choltzot velo mityabmot ketzad sefek kiddushin zarak lah kiddushin safek karov lo safek karov lah zehu sefek kiddushin
Sefek gerushin katav bichtav yado veen alav edim yesh alav edim veen bo zeman yesh bo zeman veen bo ella ed echad zehu sefek gerushin
Gema veilu begerushin safek karov lo safek karov lah la katane
May tama amar rabba ishsha zo bechezkat heter lashshuk omedet umissafek atta ba leosrah al taasrenna missafek
Amar leh abbaye i hachi bekiddushin name nema ishsha zo bechezkat heter layyavam omedet umissafek atta ba leosrah al taasrenna missafek
Hatam lechumra
Hay chumra deate lide kulla hu zimnin deazel hu umkaddesh lah laachotah kiddushe vadday
Vei name zimnin deate acher umkaddesh lah ledidah kiddushe vadday vechevan deasar lah mar letzara leyabome amri dekamma kiddushin udvatra lav kiddushin

a: Kevan deka matzrechatte chalitza mida yadi dechumra bealma hu i hachi gerushin name litne velatzrechah chalitza umida yadi dechumra bealma hu
Im atta omer choletzet mityabemet hacha name im atta omer choletzet mityabemet vetityabem veen bechach kelum achazaka ka kayema
Etiveh abbaye nafal habbayit alav veal bat achiv veen yadua eze mehem met rishon tzaratah choletzet velo mityabemet
Ammay hacha name nema ishsha zo bechezkat heter lashshuk omedet umissafek atta ba leosrah al taasrenna missafek
Vechi tema hacha name lechumra chumra deate lide kulla hu sheim atta omer choletzet mityabemet gerushin dishchichi gezaru behu rabbanan mappolot dela shechichi la gezaru behu rabbanan
I name gerushin dekayema erva deka mochcha vetzaratah kamatzrechatte lah chalitza amri kamu beh rabbanan begita degita mealleya hu veatu leyabome letzara mappolet mi kamu behu rabbanan bemappolet
Vegabbe gerushin mi la tenan vehatnan hayeta omedet birshut harabbim uzrako lah karov lah megoreshet karov lo enah megoreshet mechetza al mechetza megoreshet veenah megoreshet
Veamrinan lemay hilcheta dei kohen hu asira leh vei erva hi tzaratah baaya chalitza vela amrinan sheim atta omer choletzet mityabemet

Ha itmar alah rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu hacha bishte kite edim askinan achat omeret karov lah veachat omeret karov lo dehave leh sefeka deorayeta umatnitin dehacha bechat achat dehave leh sefeka derabbanan

Umimmay dematnitin dehacha bechat achat dumya dekiddushin ma kiddushin bechat achat af gerushin bechat achat vekiddushin gufayehu mimmay divchat achat dilma bishte kite edim i bishte kite edim tityabem veen bechach kelum
Kayemi edim vekaamri karov lah veatte amratte tityabem veen bechach kelum vetu bishte kite edim name sefeka derabbanan hi deamrinan oke tere levahade tere veishsha okmah achazaka
Mide dehave annichse devar shatya devar shatya zabben nichse ato be tere veamri keshehu chalim zabben veatu be tere vaamaru keshehu shote zabben veamar rav ashe oke tere lahade tere
b: Veara okmah bechezkat bar shatya
Ella amar abbaye yaggid alav reo tena bekidushin vehu haddin legerushin tena begerushin vehu haddin lekidushin
Amar leh rava i yaggid alav reo may zehu dekatane

Ella amar rava kol sheyyesh bekidushin yesh begerushin veyesh begerushin ma sheen bekidushin vezehu degerushin lav daveka ella mishshum ditna zehu bekidushin tena name zehu begerushin vezehu dekidushin lemaote may lemaote zeman deleka bekidushin
Umippene ma lo tikkenu zeman bekidushin hanicha leman deamar mishshum pere arusa let lah pere
Ella leman deamar mishshum bat achoto litakken zeman
Mishshum deika dimkaddesh bechaspa veika dimkaddesh bishtara la takkun rabbanan zeman
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe veha avda deika dekane bechaspa veika bishtara vetakkun rabbanan zeman hatam rubba bishtara hacha rubba bechaspa
Ibaet ema mishshum dela efshar hechi lebed lancheh gabbe didah machaka leh lancheh gabbe dideh zimnin devat achoto hi umchappe alah
Lancheh gabbe edim i dizchiyiri layeto lashud vei la zimnin dechazu mikketava veatu mashadi verachamana amar mippihem velo mippi chetavam
I hachi begerushin name nema hachi hatam lehatztzala didah kaate hacha lechova didah kaate
Matni shelosha achin nesuin shalosh nochriyyot umet echad mehen veasa bah hashsheni maamar umet hare ellu choltzot velo mityabmot
Shenneemar umet echad mehen yevamah yavo aleha shealeha zikat yavam echad velo shealeha zikat shene yevamin rabbi shimon omer meyabem leezo sheyyirtze vecholetz lashsheniyya
Gema vei zikat shene yevamin deorayeta chalitza name la tive ella midderabbanan ugzera shemma yomru shette yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad mityabmot
Unyabem lachada venichlotz lachada gezera shemma yomru bayit echad miktzato banuy

a: Umiktzato chalutz
Veyomru i dimyabem vahadar chaletz hachi name
Ella gezera dilma chaletz beresha vahadar meyabem vekam leh baasher lo yivne verachamana amar kevan shello bana shuv lo yivne
Amar rava natan get lemaamaro huttera tzaratah aval hi asura demichallefa bevaalat get
Ika deamri amar rava natan get lemaamaro huttera afilu hi may tama may daavad bah shakleh
Matni shene achin nesuin shette achaot umet echad mehen veachar kach meta ishto shel sheni hare zo asura alav olamit hoil veneesra alav shaa achat

Gema peshita hashta uma hatam dela midachya mehay beta ligmare amratte la hacha deka midachya mehay beta ligmare la kol shekken tanna ha tena beresha vehach chazya lehetera vesharya vahadar chazya leisura veayede dechabbiva leh akdemah umishna lo zaza mimmekomah

Tanu rabbanan ba aleha chayyav aleha mishshum eshet ach umishshum achot ishsha divre rabbi yose rabbi shimon omer eno chayyav ella mishshum eshet ach bilvad veha tanya rabbi shimon omer eno chayyav ella mishshum achot ishsha bilvad
La kashya kan shennasa chay veachar kach nasa met kan shennasa met veachar kach nasa chay
Verabbi shimon hecha denasa met veachar kach nasa chay kevan deisur achot ishsha la chayel tityabem yabbome
Amar rav ashe isur achot ishsha mitla tele vekae i paka isur eshet ach ate isur achot ishsha vechayel vehilkach la paka
Vesavar rabbi yose isur chal al isur veha tanya avar avera sheyyesh bah shette mitot nidon bachamura rabbi yose omer nidon bazzika harishona habbaa alav
Vetanya ketzad amar rabbi yose nidon bazzika harishona habbaa alav chamoto venaaset eshet ish nidon bachamoto eshet ish venaaset chamoto nidon beeshet ish
b: Amar rabbi avahu mode rabbi yose beisur mosif
Tinach hecha denasa chay veachar kach nasa met miggo deittosaf isur legabbe achim ittosaf isur legabbe dideh
Ella hecha denasa met veachar kach nasa chay may isur mosif ika
Vechi tema miggo deitsar bechullehu achota hay isur kolel hu

Ella amar rava maale ani alav keilu asa shettayim veeno chayyav ella achat vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan maale ani alav keilu asa shettayim veeno chayyav ella achat may nafka minah lekovro ben reshaim gemurim

Uviflugta deitmar zar sheshshimesh beshabbat rabbi chiyya omer chayyav shettayim bar kappara omer en chayyav ella achat kafatz rabbi chiyya venishba haavoda kach shamati merabbi shettayim kafatz bar kappara venishba haavoda kach shamati merabbi achat

Hitchil rabbi chiyya ladun shabbat lakkol neesra keshehuttera bammikdash etzel kohanim huttera lechohanim huttera velo lezarim yesh kan mishshum zarut veyesh kan mishshum shabbat hitchil bar kappara ladun shabbat lakkol neesra keshehuttera bammikdash huttera en kan ella zarut

Baal mum sheshshimesh betuma rabbi chiyya omer chayyav shettayim bar kappara omer en chayyav ella achat kafatz rabbi chiyya venishba haavoda kach shamati merabbi shettayim kafatz bar kappara venishba haavoda kach shamati merabbi achat

Hitchil rabbi chiyya ladun tuma lakkol neesra keshehuttera bammikdash etzel kohanim temimim huttera lechohanim temimim huttera velo levaale mumin yesh kan mishshum baale mumin veyesh kan mishshum tuma hitchil bar kappara ladun tuma lakkol neesra keshehuttera bammikdash huttera en kan ella mishshum baal mum

Zar sheachal melika rabbi chiyya omer chayyav shettayim bar kappara omer en chayyav ella achat kafatz rabbi chiyya venishba haavoda kach shamati merabbi shettayim kafatz bar kappara venishba haavoda kach shamati merabbi achat

Hitchil rabbi chiyya ladun nevela lakkol neesra keshehuttera bammikdash etzel kohanim huttera lechohanim huttera velo lezarim yesh kan mishshum zarut veyesh kan mishshum melika hitchil bar kappara ladun nevela lakkol neesra keshehuttera bammikdash huttera en kan ella mishshum zarut

a: Bemay kamipalgi beisur kolel vealliba derabbi yose rabbi chiyya savar rabbi yose beisur kolel michayyav tarte bar kappara savar la michayyav ella chada
Umay isur kolel ika hacha bishlama zar meikara shere bimlacha veasur baavoda atya lah shabbat miggo deka mitsar bimlacha mitsar name baavoda
Baal mum meikara shere baachila veasur baavoda itammi leh miggo deka mitsar baachila mitsar name baavoda ella melika bevat achat hi demashkachatte lah beisur kolel la mashkachatte lah
Ella kamipalgi beisur bevat achat vealliba derabbi yose rabbi chiyya savar rabbi yose beisur bat achat michayyav tarte uvar kappara savar la michayyav ella chada
Vehacha may isur bat achat ika hacha zar sheshshimesh beshabbat kegon deayeti shette searot beshabbat dehaveya lehu zarut veshabbat bahade hadade
Baal mum name kegon deayeti shette searot veitammi leh dehaveya leh baal mum vetuma bahade hadade i name shechatach etzbao besakkin temea
Bishlama lerabbi chiyya ki atneyeh ledideh alliba derabbi yose ki atneyeh levar kappara alliba derabbi shimon ella levar kappara rabbi chiyya shakkore ka meshakker
Ella kamipalgi beisur bat achat vealliba derabbi shimon bishlama lerabbi chiyya ka mishteva leappoke lerabbi shimon mechezkeh ella levar kappara lema leh leishtevoe kashya
Bishlama levar kappara ki atneyeh rabbi ledideh alliba derabbi shimon ki atneyeh lerabbi chiyya alliba derabbi yose ella lerabbi chiyya bar kappara shakkore ka meshakker
Amar lach rabbi chiyya ki atneyeh rabbi ledideh tarte liftur atneyeh
b: Veisur kolel atneyeh vealliba derabbi shimon vechazya lebbar kappara lezar sheachal melika veayede dedamya lah arvah bahadayehu veayyen bah vela ashkach ella bevat achat
Vesavar middeha bevat achat ha name bevat achat umiddehanach liftur hanach name liftur

Metivi zar sheshshimesh beshabbat uvaal mum sheshshimesh betuma yesh kan mishshum zarut umishshum shabbat umishshum baal mum umishshum tuma divre rabbi yose rabbi shimon omer en kan ella mishshum zarut uvaal mum bilvad veilu melika shayerah

Leman shayerah ilema lerabbi yose hashta rabbi yose beisur kolel michayyav shettayim beisur bat achat mibaya ella lav lerabbi shimon uvisur kolel hu defatar aval beisur bevat achat michayyav teuvta davar kappara teuvta
Zar sheshshimesh beshabbat bemay i bishchita shechita bezar keshera vei bekabbala veholacha tiltul bealma hu
I behaktara vehaamar rabbi yose havara lelav yatzata
Amar rav acha bar yaakov bishchitat paro shel kohen gadol uchdivre haomer shechitat paro shel kohen gadol bezar pesula i hachi may irya zar afilu kohen hedot name shezzar etzlo kaamar
Matkef lah rav ashe mide chattaot katane o lave katane ella isure bealma ka chashev lemay nafka minah lekovro ben reshaim gemurim

Matni shenayim shekkidshu shette nashim uvishat kenisatan lachuppa hechlifu et shel ze laze veet shel ze laze hare ellu chayyavin mishshum eshet ish veim hau achin mishshum eshet ach veim hau achaot mishshum ishsha el achotah veim hau niddot mishshum nidda
Umafrishin otan shelosha chodashim shemma meubbarot hen veim hau ketannot sheenan reuot leled machazirim otan miyyad veim hau kohanot nifselu min hatteruma
Gema hechlifu mide berashshie askinan vetu ha detane rabbi chiyya hare kan shesh esre chattaot i bemezid mi ika korban amar rav yehuda teni huchlefu
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa im hau ketannot sheenan reuot leled machazirin otan miyyad vei bemezid mi sharya ha la kashya pituy ketanna ones ninhu veones beyisrael mishra shere
Ella dekatane mafrishin otan shelosha chodashim shemma meubbarot hen ha lav meubbarot sharyan vei bemezid mi shere ella lav shema minah huchlefu shema minah

a: Uman hay tanna deit leh isur kolel veisur mosif veisur bat achat
Amar rav yehuda amar rav rabbi meir hi detanya yesh ochel achila achat vechayyav aleha arba chattaot veasham echad
Tame sheachal chelev vehu notar min mukdashin beom hakkippurim
Rabbi meir omer im hayeta shabbat vehotzio befiv chayyav amru lo eno min hashshem
Verabbi meir alliba deman i alliba derabbi yehoshua haamar taa bidvar mitzva patur ella alliba derabbi eliezer
Ibaet ema leolam alliba derabbi yehoshua ki kaamar rabbi yehoshua taa bidvar mitzva patur hane mile gabbe tinokot dizmanno bahul aval hay kevan deen zemanno bahul la
Vahare teruma deen zemanno bahul vekafatar ditnan haya ochel bitruma venoda shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vachomesh verabbi yehoshua poter
Ha itmar alah amar rav bivi bar abbaye hacha bitruma beerev happesach askinan dizmannah bahul
Vei baet ema beisur bat achat vealliba derabbi shimon
Bishlama kullehu mashkachatte lehu deshavinhu shaliach veshauo inhu shaliach ufga shaliach beshaliach ella niddut hechi mashkachatte lah
Amar rav amram amar rav beshofot mittoch shelosha asar leachar shelosha asar leichayyove inhu mittoch shenem asar leachar shenem asar lechayyove inhi
Mafrishim otan veha en ishsha mitabberet bevia rishona amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh shebbaalu veshanu veella ha detane rabbi chiyya hare kan shesh esre chattaot telatin vetarten haveyan
Velitamach lerabbi eliezer dimchayyev al kol koach vachoach tuva haveyan ella divchoach rishon kachashev hachi name devia rishona kachashev
Amar leh rava lerav nachman
b: Veha tamar bevia rishona iabbara amar leh tamar beetzba miacha deamar rabbi yitzchak kol moochot shel bet rabbi tamar sheman velamma nikra sheman tamar al shem tamar shemmiacha beetzbaah veha hao er veonan er veonan shimmeshu shello kedarkan
Metivi kol esrim vearbaa chodesh dash mibbifnim vezore mibbachutz divre rabbi eliezer amru lo hallalu eno ella kemaase er veonan
Kemaase er veonan velo kemaase er veonan kemaase er veonan dichtiv vehaya im ba el eshet achiv veshichet artza velo kemaase er veonan deilu hatam shello kedarkah vehacha kedarkah

Bishlama onan dichtiv beh veshichet artza ella er menalan amar rav nachman bar yitzchak dichtiv vayyamet gam oto af hu beotah mita met bishlama onan mishshum lo lo yihye hazzara ella er may tama avad hachi kede shello titabber veyachchish yafyah

Tanu rabbanan otah perat lechalla divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim perat leshello kedarkah amar leh hun bereh derav nachman lerav nachman lema ka savar rabbi yehuda hattora chasa al tachshite challa amar leh lefi sheen ishsha mitabberet mibbia rishona
Bemay kamipalgi rabbanan savri shichvat zara perat lehaaraa otah perat leshello kedarkah verabbi yehuda savar shello kedarkah vehaaraa mishshichvat zara nafka otah perat lechalla

Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan kol sheshshahata achar baalah eser shanim venisset shuv enah yoledet amar rav nachman lo shanu ella sheen datah lehinnase aval datah lehinnase mitabberet amar leh rava levat rav chisda ka meranneni rabbanan abbatricha amara leh ana datay alach havay
Hahi daatay lekammeh derav yosef amra lo rabbi ana ani shahiti achar bali eser shanim veyaladti amar lah bitti al totzii laaz al divre chachamim amara leh legoy nivalti
Amar shemuel vechullan tzerichot lehamtin shelosha chodashim chutz miggiyyoret umshuchreret ketanna aval ketanna bat yisrael tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim

Uvmay i bemeun vehaamar shemuel dela baaya vei beget haamrah shemuel chada zimna deamar shemuel meana bo enah tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim natan lah get tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim ella biznut

a: Ugzaru rabbanan ketanna mishshum gedola

Umi gazrinan ketanna mishshum gedola vehatnan im hau ketannot sheenan reuot leled machzirin otan miyyad amar rav gidel amar rav horaat shaa hayeta mikkelal dahavay ella kehoraat shaa hayeta vechiluf la shechiach

Lishana acharina amri lah amar shemuel kullan tzerichot lehamtin shelosha chodashim chutz miggiyyoret umshuchreret gedola aval ketanna bat yisrael enah tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim bemay i bemeun haamrah shemuel chada zimna i beget ha kaamar shemuel devaaya deamar shemuel meana bo enah tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim natan lah get tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim ella biznut uznut biktanna la shechiach

Giyyoret umshuchreret dishchiach behu zenut ligzor hu deamar kerabbi yose detanya haggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayeru veshennishtachreru tzerichot lehamtin shelosha chodashim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose mattir leares velinase miyyad amar rabba may tama derabbi yose kasavar ishsha mezanna meshammeshet bemoch kede shello titabber

Amar leh abbaye bishlama giyyoret kevan dedatah leigayyore menattera nafshah kede lehavchin ben zera shennizra bikdushsha uven zera shennizra shello bikdushsha shevuya veshifcha name deshami mimmarayehu umnatteri nafshayehu ella yotzet beshen vaayin hechi mashkachatte lah
Vechi tema kol demimmela mode rabbi yose vehatnan anusa umfutta tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose mattir leares velinase miyyad
Ella amar abbaye ishsha mezanna mithappechet shello titabber veidach chayeshinan shemma lo nithappecha yafe yafe
Veim hau kohanot ku kohanot in yisreeliyyot la ema im hau neshe chohanim neshe chohanim in neshe yisreelim la
Vehaamar rav amram ha milta amar lan rav sheshet veanharinhu leayenin mimmatnitin eshet yisrael shenneensa af al pi shemmutteret levalah pesula lakkehunna
Amar rava hachi kaamar im hau kohanot nesuot leyisrael nifselu min hatteruma deve nashayehu
Hadaran alach arbaa achin
b: Hacholetz livimto venimtzet meubberet veyalda bizman shehavalad shel kayyama hu muttar bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav velo pesalah min hakkehunna
En havalad shel kayyama hu asur bikrovoteha vehi asura bikrovav ufsalah min hakkehunna
Hakkones et yevimto venimtzet meubberet veyalda bizman shehavalad shel kayyama yotzi vechayyavin bekorban
Veim en valad shel kayyama yekayyem
Safek ben tisha larishon safek ben shiva laacharon yotzi vehavalad kasher vechayyavin beasham taluy
Gema itmar hacholetz limubberet vehippila rabbi yochanan amar enah tzericha chalitza min haachin resh lakish amar tzericha chalitza min haachin

Rabbi yochanan amar enah tzericha chalitza min haachin chalitzat meubberet shemah chalitza uviat meubberet shemah bia veresh lakish amar tzericha chalitza min haachin chalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza uviat meubberet lo shemah bia
Bemay kamippalgi ibaet ema kera veibaet ema sevara
Ibaet ema sevara rabbi yochanan savar im yavo eliyyahu veyomar deha deiabbara appole mappela mi lav bat chalitza veyibbum hi hashta name tiggalle milta lemafrea
Veresh lakish amar tiggalle milta lemafrea la amrinan
Veibaet ema kera rabbi yochanan savar uven en lo amar rachamana veha let leh veresh lakish savar uven en lo ayyen alav

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish en havalad shel kayyama hu asur bikrovoteha vehi asura bikrovav ufsalah min hakkehunna bishlama ledidi deamena chalitzat meubberet shemah chalitza mishshum hachi pasla ella ledidach deamratte chalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza ammay pasla min hakkehunna
Amar leh midderabbanan ulchumra bealma

Ika deamri etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan en havalad shel kayyama hu asur bikrovoteha vehi asura bikrovav ufsalah min hakkehunna bishlama ledidi deamena chalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza hayenu dekatane pesalah min hakkehunna lechumra vela katane enah tzericha chalitza min haachin
Ella ledidach enah tzericha chalitza min haachin mibe leh amar leh in hachi name veayede ditna resha lo pesalah tena name sefa pesalah
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish en havalad shel kayyama yekayyem bishlama ledidi deamena chalitzat meubberet shemah chalitza uviat meubberet shemah bia mishshum hachi katane yekayyem
Ella ledidach deamratte chalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza uviat meubberet lo shemah bia yachzor veyivol vikayyem mibe leh may yekayyem yachzor veyivol vikayyem dela saggi

Ika deamri etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan en havalad shel kayyama yekayyem bishlama ledidi deamena chalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza uviat meubberet lo shemah bia hayenu dekatane yekayyem yachzor veyivol vikayyem dela saggi belav hachi
Ella ledidach ratza yotzi ratza yekayyem mibe leh in hachi name ayede ditna resha yotzi tena name sefa yekayyem

Metivi hakkones et yevimto venimtzet meubberet hare zo lo tinnase tzaratah shemma yehe velad ben kayyama adderabba ki have havalad ben kayyama mipatra tzaratah ella ema shemma lo yehe havalad ben kayyama
Vei salka datach biat meubberet shemah bia ammay lo tinnase tzaratah tiptar bevia shel chavertah
Amar abbaye bevia kulle alma la peligi dela patra ki peligi bachalitza
Rabbi yochanan savar chalitzat meubberet shemah chalitza biat meubberet lo shemah bia resh lakish savar biat meubberet lo shemah bia vachalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza
Amar leh rava ma nafshach i biat meubberet shemah bia chalitzat meubberet shemah chalitza vei biat meubberet lo shemah bia chalitzat meubberet name lo shemah chalitza deha kayema lan

a: Dechol haole leyibbum ole lachalitza vechol sheen ole leyibbum eno ole lachalitza

Ella amar rava hachi kaamar hakkones yevimto venimtzet meubberet hare zo lo tinnase tzaratah shemma yehe valad ben kayyama uviat meubberet lo shemah bia vachalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza vehavalad eno poter ad sheyyetze laavir haolam

Tanya keoteh derava hakkones yevimto venimtzet meubberet hare zo lo tinnase tzaratah shemma yehe valad ben kayyama veen bia vachalitza poteret ella valad poter vehavalad en potrah ad sheyyetze laavir haolam
Tama deshemma yehe valad ben kayyama hu ha la have valad ben kayyama mipatra tzaratah lema tehve teuvta deresh lakish

Amar lach resh lakish hachi katane hakkones yevimto venimtzet meubberet hare zo lo tinnase tzaratah shemma lo yehe havalad ben kayyama vachalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza uviat meubberet lo shemah bia
Veim tomar hallech achar rov nashim verov nashim valad mealleya yaldan valad en poter ad sheyyetze laavir haolam

Amar rabbi elazar efshar ita leha deresh lakish vela tenan lah bematnitin nefak dak veashkach ditnan haishsha shehalach balah vetzaratah limdinat hayyam uvau veamru lah met balich hare zo lo tinnase velo tityabem ad shetteda shemma meubberet hi tzaratah
Bishlama yabbome la shemma yehe valad ben kayyama veyifga beisur eshet ach deorayeta ella lo tachlotz ammay bishlama tachlotz betoch tisha vetinnase betoch tisha la hayenu safek
Ella tachlotz betoch tisha vetinnase leachar tisha
Ultamach tachlotz vetinnase leachar tisha
Ella bar minah dehahi deabbaye bar abba verav chinana bar abbaye deamri tarvayehu shemma yehe valad ben kayyama venimtza atta matzrichah karoz lakkehunna
Velatzrechah dilma ika inish dehave bachalitza vela have behachraza veate lememar kashare chalutza lechohen
Amar leh abbaye mide lo tachlotz velo tityabem katane lo tinnase velo tityabem katane belo chalitza aval i chaletz lah hachi name desharya
Tanya keoteh deresh lakish hacholetz limubberet vehippila tzericha chalitza min haachin
Amar rava hilcheta keoteh deresh lakish behane telat chada ha daamaran idach ditnan hamchallek nechasav al piv riba leechad umiet leechad vehishva lahem et habbechor devarav kayyamin
Veim amar mishshum yerushsha lo amar kelum katav ben battechilla ben bassof ben baemtza mishshum mattana devarav kayyamin
b: Veamar resh lakish leolam lo kana ad sheyyomar peloni ufloni yirshu sade pelonit uflonit shennetattim lahem bemattana veyirashum

Veidach ditnan hakkotev kol nechasav livno leachar moto haav eno yachol limkor mippene shennetanan labben vehabben eno yachol limkor mippene shehen birshut haav machar haav mechurin ad sheyyamut hu machar habben en lallokeach kelum ad sheyyamut haav
Veitmar machar habben bechayye haav umet habben bechayye haav rabbi yochanan amar lo kana lokeach veresh lakish amar kana lokeach
Rabbi yochanan amar lo kana lokeach kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame
Veresh lakish amar kana lokeach kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame
En havalad shel kayyama ku tana mishshum rabbi eliezer amru yotzi beget
Amar rava rabbi meir verabbi eliezer amru davar echad rabbi eliezer ha daamaran
Rabbi meir detanya lo yissa adam meubberet chavero umeneket chavero veim nasa yotzi velo yachzir olamit divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim yotzi velichsheyyaggia zemanno lichnos yichnos
Amar leh abbaye mimmay dilma la hi ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hacha ella mishshum dekafage beisur eshet ach deorayeta aval hatam derabbanan kerabbanan sevira leh
I name ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella mishshum derabbanan vachachamim asu chizuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora aval hacha middeorayeta mifrash parshi minah
Amar rava uldivre chachamim yotziah beget amar mar zutra dayeka name dekatane yotzi vela katane yafrish shema minah
Amar leh rav ashe lerav hoshaya bereh derav idi hatam tenan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol sheshshaha beadam sheloshim yom eno nefel ha la sheha sefeka have
Veitmar met betoch sheloshim yom veamda venitkaddesha
Ravina mishshemeh derava amar im eshet yisrael hi choletzet veim eshet kohen hi enah choletzet
Rav mesharsheya mishshemeh derava amar achat zo veachat zo choletzet
Amar leh ravina lerav mesharsheya

a: Beurta amar rava hachi uvtzafra hadar beh amar leh sherituha yehe raava detishtero af tarba
Hacha gabbe meubberet chavero umeneket chavero hannesua lechohen may mi avud rabbanan takkanta lechohen o la

Amar leh hachi hashta bishlama hatam kevan deika rabbanan difligi aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel deamri af al gav dela sheha valad mealleya have gabbe eshet kohen kevan dela efshar avdinan kerabbanan
Aval hacha keman naaved i kerabbi meir ha amar yotzi velo yachzir olamit vei kerabbanan haamri beget
Itmar kiddeshah betoch shelosha uvarach peligi bah rav acha verafram chad amar meshammetinan leh vechad amar erukeh missatyeh hava ovada vaamar lehu rafram erukeh missatyeh
Safek ben tesha vechu amar leh rava lerav nachman lema hallech achar rov nashim verov nashim letisha yaldan
Amar leh neshe didan leshiva yaldan amar leh neshe didchu hau rubba dealma
Amar leh hachi kaamena rov nashim yaldan letisha umiut leshiva vechol hayyoledet letisha ubbarah nikar lishlish yameha vezo hoil velo hukkar ubbarah lishlish yameha itra leh rubba

I kol hayyoledet letisha ubbarah nikar lishlish yameha ha middelo hukkar lishlish yameha ubbarah vadday bar shiva levatraa hu ella ema rov hayyoledet letisha ubbarah nikar lishlish yameha vehay middelo hukkar lishlish yameha itra leh rubba
Tanu rabbanan rishon rauy lihot kohen gadol vesheni mamzer missafek rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer en mamzer missafek
May kaamar amar abbaye hachi kaamar rishon rauy lihot kohen gadol vesheni sefek mamzer veasur bemamzeret rabbi eliezer omer eno sefek mamzer ella vadday mamzer umuttar bemamzeret
Rava amar hachi kaamar rishon rauy lihot kohen gadol vesheni mamzer vadday missafek umuttar bemamzeret verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer en vadday mamzer missafek ella sefek mamzer veasur bemamzeret
Vekamipalgi bidrabbi elazar ditnan rabbi elazar omer vaddaan bevaddaan muttar vaddaan bisfekan usfekan bevaddaan usfekan bisfekan asur
Veellu hen sefekan shetuki vaasufi vechuti

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav halacha kerabbi elazar ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li hillel shana asara yuchasin alu mibbavel kahane leviyye veyisreele chalale gere charore mamzere netine shetuke vaasufe vechullan muttarin lavo ze baze
Veatte amratte halacha kerabbi elazar
Abbaye savar lah kishmuel deamar halacha kehillel umoke lah rabbi eliezer ben yaakov alliba dehilcheta ki hechi dela tikshe hilcheta ahilcheta
Rava savar lah kerav deamar halacha kerabbi elazar umoke lah lidrabbi eliezer ben yaakov alliba dehilcheta ki hechi dela tikshe
b: Hilcheta ahilcheta
Amar abbaye mena amena lah dechol sefeka lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov kevadday meshave leh

Detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer hare shebba al nashim harbe veen yodea al ezo mehen ba vechen hi shebbau aleha anashim harbe veenah yodaat meeze mehen kibbela nimtza av nose et bitto veach nose et achoto venitmalle kal haolam kullo mamzerin veal ze neemar umala haaretz zimma
Verava amar lach hachi kaamar zo ma hi
Yater al ken amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov lo yissa adam ishsha bimdina zo veyelech veyissa ishsha bimdina acheret shemma yizdavvegu ze laze venimtza ach nose et achoto
Ini veha rav ki ikla ledardeshir machrez veamar man haveya leoma verav nachman ki ikla leshachnetziv machrez veamar man haveya leoma
Shane rabbanan difkia shemayehu
Vehaamar rava tevauha linase venitpayesa tzericha leshev shiva nekiyyim
Rabbanan sheluchayehu hao meshadderi umodi lehu veibaet ema lerabbanan yachode bealma hu dimyachadi lehu deamar mar eno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo lemi sheen lo pat besallo
Tana rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer lo yissa adam ishto vedato legarshah mishshum shenneemar al tacharosh al reacha raa vehu yoshev lavetach ittach
Safek veyavam shebbau lachalok benichse mitana
Safek amar ana bar mitana hu venichse didi hu ninhu veyavam amar atte beray didi atte velet lach vela mide benichse have mamon hammuttal besafek umamon hammuttal besafek cholkin
Safek uvne yavam shebbau lachalok benichse mitana safek amar hahu gavra bar mitana hu venichse didi hu ninhu bene yavam amri atte achenu achuna atte umnata hu deit lach bahadan
Sevur rabbanan kammeh derav mesharsheya lememar matnitin hi ditnan hu eno yoresh otam vehem yorshin oto
Vehacha ipcha hatam amri leh ayeti reaya ushkol
Hacha amar lehu ayeto reaya ushkulu
Amar lehu rav mesharsheya mi dame hatam inhu vadday veihu safek hacha ide veide safek
Ella i damya lematnitin leha damya lesafek uvne yavam shebbau lachlok benichse yavam gufeh dehatam amri leh ayeti reaya daachuna atte ushkol
Safek uvne yavam shebbau lachlok benichse yavam levatar diflag yavam benichse mitana
Bene yavam amri ayeti reaya daachuna atte ushkol amar lehu safek ma nafshayechu i achuchon ana havu li menata bahadayechu vei bar mitana ana havu li palga diflag avuchon bahaday
Rabbi abba amar rav kam dina rabbi yirmeya amar hadar dina
Lema biflugta deadmon verabbanan kamipalgi ditnan mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veavda lo derech sadehu admon amar yelech biktzara vachachamim omrim yikkach lo derech bemea mane o yifrach baavir
Vehavenan bah lerabbanan shappir kaamar admon veamar rav yehuda amar rav hacha bemay askinan kegon shehikkifuha arbaa bene adam mearba ruchot
I hachi may tama deadmon veamar rava bearbea deatu mikkoach arbea vearbea deatu mikkoach chad kulle alma la peligi dematzu medache leh

Ki peligi bechad deate mikkoach arbea admon savar matze amar leh mikkol makom darkay gabbach hu verabbanan savri daamar leh i shatkatte shatkatte vei la mahdarna shetara lemarayehu vela matzet leishtaoye dina bahadayehu
Lema rabbi abba deamar kerabbanan
Verabbi yirmeya deamar keadmon
Amar lach rabbi abba ana daamari afilu keadmon ad kan la kaamar admon hatam ella mishshum deamar leh mimma nafshach

a: Darkay chad gabbach gabbe chad hu aval hacha mi ika lememar hachi

Verabbi yirmeya amar lach ana daamari afilu lerabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella mishshum deamar leh i shatkatte shatkatte vei la mahdarna shetara lemarayehu vela matzet leishtaoye dina bahadayehu aval hacha mi ika lememar hachi
Safek veyavam shebbau lachalok benichse sava safek amar hay gavra bar mitana hu ufalga didi hu yavam amar atte beray didi atte velet lach vela mide
Have yavam vadday vesafek safek veen safek motzi mide vadday
Safek uvne yavam shebbau lachalok benichse sava safek amar hahu gavra bar mitana hu ufalga didi hu uvne yavam amri achuna atte umnata it lach bahadan
Palga dekamode lehu shakli tilta deka modu leh shakel pash lehu danka have mamon hammuttal besafek vecholkin
Sava veyavam benichse safek o sava vesafek benichse yavam
Have mamon hammuttal besafek vecholkin
Matni shomeret yavam shennaflu lah nechasim modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret venotenet vekayyam

Meta ma yaase bichtubbatah uvinchasim hannichnasim veotzin immah bet shammay omrim yachloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav uvet hillel omrim nechasim bechezkatan ketubba bechezkat yorshe habbaal nechasim hannichnasim veotzin immah bechezkat yorshe haav
Kenasah hare hi keishto lechol davar uvilvad shettehe ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon
Gema may shena resha dela peligi umay shena sefa difligi
Amar ulla resha denafla keshehi arusa vesefa denafla keshehi nesua
Vekasavar ulla zikat arusa osa sefek arusa
b: Zikat nesua osa sefek nesua
Zikat arusa osa sefek arusa dei salka datach vadday arusa modim bet hillel shemmocheret venotenet vekayyam
Vehatnan naflu lah nechasim mishshennitarsa bet shammay omrim timkor uvet hillel omrim lo timkor ellu veellu modim sheim machra venatna kayyam ella shema minah zikat arusa osa sefek arusa
Zikat nesua osa sefek nesua dei salka datach vadday nesua bet shammay omrim yachloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav
Vehatnan naflu lah nechasim mishshenniset ellu vaellu modim sheim machra venatna shehabbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot ella shema minah zikat nesua osa sefek nesua
Amar leh rabba addemippalgi begufah ulachar mita lippalgu bechayyeha ulferot
Ella amar rabba ide veide denafla keshehi nesua vezikat nesua osa sefek nesua resha deihi kayema haveya lah ihi vadday veinhu safek veen safek motzi mide vadday
Sefa demeta hallalu bain lirash vehallalu bain lirash veyachloku
Etiveh abbaye ulvet shammay en safek motzi mide vadday vehatnan nafal habbayit alav veal aviv alav veal morishav vehau alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov
Yorshe haav omrim habben met rishon veachar kach met haav uvaal chov omer haav met rishon veachar kach met habben
Bet shammay omrim yachloku uvet hillel omrim nechasim bechezkatan
Veha hacha yorshe haav vadday uvaal chov safek vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday
Kasavri bet shammay shetar haomed ligbot kegavuy dame
Umna temra ditnan metu baalehen ad shello shatu bet shammay omrim notlot ketubbatan veenan shotot uvet hillel omrim o shotot o lo notlot ketubbatan
O shotot vehevi haish et ishto amar rachamana veleka ella mittoch shello shotot lo notlot ketubbatan
Veha hacha desafek hu safek zannay safek la zannay vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday ella shema minah shetar haomed ligbot kegavuy dame
Veabbaye lotveh meha dilma ketubbat ishsha shane mishshum china
Velotveh ketubba dematnitin
La peligi vela veha katane meta ma yaase bichtubbatah uvinchasim hannichnasim veotzin immah bet shammay omrim yachloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav uvet hillel omrim nechasim bechezkatan
Hachi kaamar meta ma yaase bichtubbatah veshavkah nechasim hannichnasim vehayyotzim immah bet shammay omrim yachloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav uvet hillel omrim nechasim bechezkatan
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane yachloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav vela katane yorshe haav im yorshe habbaal shema minah
Abbaye amar resha denaflu lah keshehi shomeret yavam sefa denaflu lah keshehi tachtav devaal

a: Vekasavar abbaye yado keyadah
Amar leh rava i denafli lah keshehi tachtav devaal dechulle alma la peligi deyado adifa miyyadah
Ella ide veide denaflu lah keshehi shomeret yavam resha dela avad bah maamar sefa daavad bah maamar
Vekasavar rava maamar levet shammay ose vadday arusa usfek nesua vadday arusa lidchot batztzara usfek nesua lachlok bannechasim
Itmar mishshemeh derabbi elazar keoteh derava veitmar mishshemeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina keoteh deabbaye
Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi veha amar rabbi elazar maamar levet shammay eno kone ella lidchot batztzara bilvad
Efoch vei baet ema leolam la tefoch amar lach rabbi elazar ki amari ana dela saggi lah beget ella devae name chalitza lachlok bannechasim dela kane mi amari
Amar rav pappa diyyuka dematnitin keoteh deabbaye veaf al gav dekashya meta
Dekatane nechasim hannichnasim veotzim immah may nichnasin umay yotzin lav nichnasin lirshut habbaal veotzim mershut habbaal lirshut haav
Veaf al gav dekashya meta addemippalgi begufah ulachar mita lippalgu bechayyeha ulferot
Vetu la mide
Kenasah hare hi ku lemay hilcheta amar rabbi yose bar chanina lomar shemmegarsha beget umachzirah
Megarsha beget peshita salka datach amena hoil uchtiv ulkachah lo leishsha veyibbemah amar rachamana vaadayin yibbume harishon aleha bachalitza in beget la ka mashma lan
Machzirah peshita salka datach amena mitzva deramya rachamana aleh avdah hashta tekum aleh beisur eshet ach ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name amar kera ulkachah lo leishsha kevan shellekachah hare hi keishto lechol davar
Uvilvad shettehe ketubbatah ku may tama ishsha hiknu lo min hashshamayim
Vei let lah min harishon takkinu lah mishsheni kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah
Matni mitzva begadol leyabem lo ratza mehallechin al kol haachin lo ratzu chozrin etzel gadol veomrim lo alecha mitzva o chalotz o yabem
Tala bekatan ad sheyyagdil o baggadol ad sheyyavo mimmedinat hayyam o cheresh o shote en shomin lo ella omrim lo alecha mitzva o chalotz o yabem
Gema itmar biat katan vachalitzat gadol peligi bah rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi chad amar biat katan adifa vechad amar chalitzat gadol adifa
Man deamar biat katan adifa deha mitzva beyibum uman deamar chalitzat gadol adifa bimkom gadol biat katan lav kelum hi
Tenan lo ratza machzirin al kol haachin may lav lo ratza leyabem ella lachlotz vekatane mehallechin etzel haachin shema minah biat katan adifa

La lo ratza lachlotz velo leyabem dichotah gabbe haachin lo ratzu lo lachlotz velo leyabem ammay chozrim etzel haggadol lemichpeyeh lichpeyeh lichpinhu ledidhu kevan demitzva aleh dideh ramya ledideh kayefinan
Tenan tala bekatan ad sheyyagdil en shomin lo vei biat katan adifa ammay en shomin lo nintar dilma gadel umyabem
Velitamach uvgadol ad sheyyavo mimmedinat hayyam en shomin lo ammay nintar dilma ate vechaletz ella kol shahoye mitzva la meshahenan
b: It deamri bevia kulle alma la peligi deviat katan adifa ki peligi bachalitzat katan
Vehachi itmar chalitzat katan vachalitzat gadol peligi bah rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi chad amar chalitzat gadol adifa vechad amar ki hadade ninhu
Man deamar chalitzat gadol adifa deha mitzva baggadol veidach ki amrinan mitzva baggadol leinyan yibbum aval leinyan chalitza kahadade ninhu
Tenan lo ratzu chozrin etzel gadol may lav lo ratzu leyabem ella lachlotz vekatane chozrin etzel gadol ushma minah chalitzat gadol adifa

La lo ratzu lo lachlotz vela leyabem dichoteh gabbe gadol lo ratza lo lachlotz velo leyabem ella ammay chozrin etzel gadol lemichpeyeh lichpeyuhu nichpinhu ledidhu kevan demitzva aleh dideh ramya ledideh kayefinan
Ta shema tala baggadol ad sheyyavo mimmedinat hayyam en shomin lo vei salka datach chalitzat gadol adifa ammay en shomin lo nintar dilma ate vechaletz
Ultamach bekatan ad sheyyagdil en shomin lo ammay nintar dilma gadel umyabem i name ate ihu umyabmah ella kol shahoye mitzva la meshahenan
Tenan hatam mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza barishona shehau mitkavvenin leshem mitzva achshav sheen mitkavvenin leshem mitzva amru mitzvat chalitza kodemet lemitzvat yibbum
Amar rav en kofin ki ato lekammeh derav amar lehu i baet chalotz i baet yabem bedidach tela rachamana veim lo yachpotz haish ha im chafetz i bae chaletz i bae yeyabbem

Veaf rav yehuda savar en kofin middeatken rav yehuda begita dachalitza ech pelonit bat peloni akrivat yat peloni yevamah kodamana leve dina veishtemodinhu daachuh demitana meabba nihu veamri leh i tzavet leyabbem yabbem vei la atla lah riglach deyammina
Veatla lah rigla deyammina ushrat seneh maal raglohi virakat beanpohi rukka demitchazya leve dina al ara
Verabbi chiyya bar aveya mesayyem bah mishshemeh derav yehuda veakrinhu ma dichtiv bisfar orayeta demoshe
Ishtemodinhu peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar beedim vechad amar afilu karov afilu ishsha vehilcheta galloye milta vealma hu vaafilu karov vaafilu ishsha
Barishona shehau mitkavvenin leshem mitzva mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza veachshav sheen mitkavvenin leshem mitzva amru mitzvat chalitza kodemet lemitzvat yibbum
Amar rame bar chama amar rabbi yitzchak chazru lomar mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak ikkashshur dare
Meikara savri lah keabba shaul ulvassof savri lah kerabbanan
Detanya abba shaul omer hakkones et yevimto leshem noy ulshum ishut ulshum davar acher keilu pogea beerva vekarov ani beenay lihot havalad mamzer vachachamim omrim yevamah yavo aleha mikkol makom
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan yevamah yavo aleha mitzva shebbattechilla hayeta alav bichlal heter neesra vechazra vehuttera yachol tachzor lehetterah harishon talmud lomar yevamah yavo aleha mitzva
Man tanna amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi abba shaul hi vehachi kaamar yevamah yavo aleha mitzva shebbattechilla hayeta alav bichlal heter ratza leshem noy konsah ratza leshum ishut konsah
Neesra chazra vehuttera yachol tachzor lehetterah harishon talmud lomar yevamah yavo aleha lemitzva
Rava amar afilu tema rabbanan vehachi kaamar yevamah yavo aleha mitzva shebbattechilla hayeta bichlal heter ratza konsah ratza eno konsah
Neesra chazra vehuttera yachol tachzor lehetterah harishon ratza konsah ratza eno konsah ratza eno konsah
Ha agida beh bichdi tipok ella ema ratza konsah ratza choletz lah talmud lomar yevamah yavo aleha mitzva
Ema resha matztzot teachel bemakom kadosh mitzva

a: Shebbattechilla hayeta alav bichlal heter neesra vechazra vehuttera yachol tachzor leheterah harishon talmud lomar matztzot teachel bemakom kadosh mitzva

Bishlama lerava deamar ha manni rabbanan hi hacha hachi kaamar matztzot teachel bemakom kadosh mitzva shebbattechilla hayeta alav bichlal heter ratza ochlah ratza eno ochlah neesra chazra vehuttera yachol tachzor leheterah harishon ratza ochlah ratza eno ochlah
Ratza eno ochlah vehachtiv veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem melammed shehakkohanim ochlim uvalim mitkapperin
Ella ratza hu ochlah ratza kohen acher ochlah talmud lomar matztzot teachel bemakom kadosh mitzva
Ella lerav yitzchak bar avdimi deamar abba shaul hi hacha may tere gavene ika
Vechi tema ratza leteavon ochlah ratza achila gassa ochlah achila gassa mi shemah achila vehaamar resh lakish haochel achila gassa beom hakkippurim patur millo teunne
Ella ratza matztza ochlah ratza chametz ochlah
Vehachtiv lo teafe chametz chelkam veamar resh lakish vaafilu chelkam lo teafe chametz ella ratza matztza ochlah ratza chalut ochlah
Hay chalut hechi dame i matztza hi ha matztza hi vei la matztza hi matztzot amar rachamana
La leolam ema lach matztza hi ulhachi tena beh kera leakkev

Ella chalut matztza hi dekaamrinan lemay hilcheta lomar sheadam yotze bah yede chovato befesach af al pi dechalteh meikara kevan dahadar afyeh betannur lechem oni karena beh veadam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach

Matni hacholetz livimto hare hu keechad min haachin lannachala veim yesh sham av nechasim shel av hakkones et yevimto zacha binchasim shel achiv rabbi yehuda omer ben kach uven kach im yesh sham av nechasim shel av
Gema peshita salka datach amena chalitza bimkom yibbum kayema venishkol kullehu nichse ka mashma lan
I hachi hare hu keechad min haachim eno ella keechad min haachim mibe leh
Ella salka datach amena hoil veafsedah miyyibbum likneseh ka mashma lan
Im yesh sham av deamar mar av kodem lechol yotze yerecho
Hakkones et yevimto vechu may tama yakum al shem achiv amar rachamana vahare kam
Rabbi yehuda omer vechu amar ulla halacha kerabbi yehuda vechen amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha halacha kerabbi yehuda
Veamar ulla veitema rabbi yitzchak nappacha may tama derabbi yehuda dichtiv vehaya habbechor asher teled kivchor ma bechor en lo bechayye haav af hay name en lo bechayye haav
I ma bechor notel pi shenayim leachar mitat haav af hay notel pi shenayim leachar mitat haav
Mide yakum al shem aviv ketiv yakum al shem achiv ketiv velo al shem aviv
Ema hecha deleka av delishkol nachala titkayyem mitzvat yibbum hecha deika av dela shakel nachala lo titkayyem mitzvat yibbum
Mide yibbum benachala tela rachamana yabbome meyabbemi vei ika nachala shakel vei la la shakel
Yetev rabbi chanina kara kammeh derabbi yannay veyatev vekaamar halacha kerabbi yehuda amar leh pok keri kerayach levara en halacha kerabbi yehuda
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman en halacha kerabbi yehuda amar leh ella keman kerabbanan peshita yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim
Amar leh esmeyah amar leh la atte halacha atneyuch umiksha hu deikkeshi lach vaafachte ulmay daafachte shappir afachte
Matni hacholetz livimto hu asur bikrovoteha vehi asura bikrovav
b: Hu asur beimmah uvem immah uvem aviha uvvittah uvvat bittah uvvat benah uvaachotah bizman shehi kayyemet vehaachin muttarin
Vehi asura beaviv uvaavi aviv uvivno uvven beno beachiv uvven achiv
Muttar adam bikrovat tzarat chalutzato veasur betzarat kerovat chalutzato
Gema ibaya lehu gazru sheniyyot bachalutza o lo
Beerva deorayeta gezaru behu rabbanan sheniyyot bachalutza la gezaru rabbanan sheniyyot o dilma la shena
Ta shema hu asur beimmah uvem immah veilu em em immah la katane
Dilma hayenu tama dela tane mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa vehaachin muttarin vei tana em em immah hava amena haachin muttarin daveka beem em immah aval beem immah uvimmah lo
Velitne em em immah velitne haachin muttarin bechullan kashya
Ta shema hi asura beaviv uvaavi aviv katane miha avi aviv may lav mishshum choletz dehaveya lah kallat beno
La mishshum mitana dehaveya lah kallat beno
Ta shema uvven beno may lav mishshum choletz dehaveya lah mishshum eshet avi aviv
La mishshum mitana vehaveya lah eshet achi avi aviv
Ha ammemar machshar beeshet achi avi aviv
Ammemar moke lah bevar bera desava
I hachi hayenu achiv uven achiv tena achiv min haav vekatane achiv min haem
Ta shema detane rabbi chiyya arba middivre tora vearba middivre sofrim av uvno achiv uven achiv middivre tora avi aviv vaavi immo ben beno uven bitto middivre sofrim
Katane miha avi aviv may lav mishshum choletz vehaveya lah kallat beno
La mishshum mitana dehaveya lah kallat beno
Ta shema avi immo may lav mishshum choletz dehaveya lah kallat bitto
La mishshum mitana dehaveya lah kallat bitto
Ta shema uven beno may lav mishshum choletz dehaveya lah eshet avi aviv
La mishshum mitana vehaveya lah eshet achi avi aviv
Veha ammemar machshir beeshet achi avi aviv ammemar mokem lah mishshum choletz vekasavar gazru sheniyyot bachalutza
Ta shema uvven bitto may lav mishshum choletz dehaveya lah eshet avi immo
La mishshum mitana dehaveya lah eshet achi avi immo veha gabbe sheniyyot deerva lo gazru
Ella lav mishshum choletz ushma minah gazru sheniyyot bachalutza shema minah
Muttar adam vechu amar rav tovi bar kisna amar shemuel habba al tzarat chalutza havalad mamzer may tama beisurah kayema
Amar rav yosef af anan name tenena muttar adam bikrovat tzarat chalutzato i amratte bishlama tzara abbaray mishshum hachi muttar baachotah
Ella i amratte tzara kachalutza damya ammay muttar
Lema tehve teuvta derabbi yochanan deamar ben hu ben achin en chayyavin lo al hachalutza karet velo al tzaratah karet
Amar lach rabbi yochanan vetisbera achot chalutza deorayeta vehaamar resh lakish kan shana rabbi achot gerusha middivre tora achot chalutza middivre sofrim
May shena hay umay shena hay

a: Hach deazla bahadah leve dina gezaru behu rabbanan hay dela azla bahadah leve dina la gezaru behu rabbanan
Matni hacholetz livimto venasa achiv et achotah vamet choletzet velo mityabbemet vechen hamgaresh et ishto venasa achiv et achotah vamet hare zo petura
Shomeret yavam shekkidesh achiv et achotah mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betira amru omrim lo hamten ad sheyyaase achicha maase
Chalatz lah achiv o kenasah yichnos et ishto meta hayevama yichnos et ishto met yavam yotzi et ishto beget veeshet achiv bachalitza
Gema may vechen ema aval hamgaresh
Amar resh lakish kan shana rabbi achot gerusha middivre tora achot chalutza middivre sofrim
Shomeret yavam shekkidesh vechu amar shemuel halacha kedivre rabbi yehuda ben betera
Ibaya lehu meta ishto mahu bivimto rav verabbi chanina deamri tarvayehu meta ishto muttar bivimto shemuel verav assi deamri tarvayehu meta ishto asur bivimto
Amar rava may tama derav mishshum dahavay yevama shehuttera veneesra vechazra vehuttera tachzor leheterah harishon
Metiv rav hamnuna shelosha achin shenayim nesuin shette achaot veechad mufne met echad mibbaale achaot veasa bah mufne maamar veachar kach met achiv hashsheni
Veachar kach meta ishto acharav otah yevama choletzet velo mityabbemet
Veammay tehve kivama shehuttera veneesra vechazra vehuttera tachzor leheterah harishon
Ishtik levatar dinfak amar ammay la amarte leh rabbi elazar hi deamar kevan sheamda alav shaa achat beissur neesra alav olamit
Hadar amar emor deamar rabbi elazar hecha dela chazya bishat nefila aval hecha dechazya bishat nefila mi amar
Hadar amar in vehatanya rabbi elazar omer meta yevimto muttar beishto meta ishto otah yevama choletzet velo mityabbemet
Lema shemuel verav assi deamri kerabbi elazar
Afilu tema kerabbanan ad kan la kamipalgi rabbanan aleh derabbi elazar ella mishshum deminnefila veelach la mitsar alayehu aval hacha deitsar afilu rabbanan modu

Matni hayevama lo tachalotz velo tityabem ad sheyyesh lah shelosha chodashim vechen kol shear hannashim lo yitarsu velo yinnasu ad sheyehu lahen shelosha chodashim echad betulot veechad beulot echad gerushot veechad almanot echad nesuot veechad arusot
Rabbi yehuda omer hannesuot yitarsu vehaarusot yinnasu chutz min haarusot shebbihuda mippene shellibbo gas bah
Rabbi yose omer kol hannashim yitarsu chutz min haalmana
b: Mippene haibul
Gema bishlama lo tityabem shemma yihye havalad ben kayyama veka faga beisur eshet ach deorayeta ella lo tachlotz ammay
Lema tehve teuvta derabbi yochanan deamar chalitzat meubberet shemah chalitza velav mi otvineh lerabbi yochanan chada zimna lema meha name tehve teuvta
La hacha hayenu tama shemma yehe valad ben kayyama venimtzeta atta matzrichah karoz lakkehunna
Venatzrechah dilma ika dehavey bachalitza vela have behachraza umafseluha min hakkehunna
Tinach almana gerusha may ika lememar mishshum demafsed lah mezonot
Tinach nesua arusa gerusha may ika lememar
Ella mishshum derabbi yose detanya maase beadam echad shebba lifne rabbi yose amar lo mahu lachlotz betoch shelosha amar lo lo tachlotz vetachlotz uma bechach
Kara alav mikra ze veim lo yachpotz ha im chafetz yibbem kol haole leyibbum ole lachalitza ku
Metiv rav chinana hassefekot choltzot velo mityabbemot
May sefekot ilema sefek kiddushin ammay la mityabbemot tityabem veen bechach kelum
Ella lav safek shekkidesh achat mishte achaot veeno yodea ezo mehen kidesh vekatane choletzet
Hachi hashta hatam im yavo eliyyahu veyomar deha kidesh bat chalitza veyibum hi
Hacha im yavo eliyyahu veyomar deha la iabbara mi mashgechinan beh umyabbeminan lah ha ketanna delav bat iabbore hi vaafilu hachi tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim
Tanu rabbanan yevama shelosha chodashim harishonim nizzonet mishshel baal mikkan veelach enah nizzonet lo mishshel baal velo mishshel yavam
Amad baddin uvarach nizzonet mashal yavam
Nafla lifne yavam katan may miyyavam let lah mibbaal may
Peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar it lah vechad amar let lah vehilcheta let lah mishshemayya kansuh
Tanu rabbanan yevama shechaltzu lah achim betoch shelosha tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim

a: Leachar shelosha en tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim
Heve hashlosha chodashim sheamru mishsheat mitat habbaal velo mishsheat chalitzat hayyavam
May shena migget derav amar mishsheat netina ushmuel amar mishsheat ketiva
Amar rava kal vachomer isur karet hittarta isur lav lo kol shekken
Vechen shear kol hannashim bishlama yevama kedaamaran ella shear kol hannashim ammay
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel mishshum deamar kera lihot lecha lelohim ulzaracha acharecha lehavchin ben zaro shel rishon lezaro shel sheni
Metiv rava lefichach ger vegiyyoret tzerichin lehamtin shelosha chodashim hacha may lehavchin ika
Hacha name ika lehavchin ben zera shennizra bikdushsha lezera shello nizra bikdushsha
Rava amar gezera shemma yissa et achoto meaviv viyabbem eshet achiv meimmo
Veotzi et immo lashshuk veyiftor et yevimto lashshuk
Metiv rav chananya bechullan ani kore bahen mishshum takkanat erva vechan mishshum takkanat valad veim ita kullehu mishshum takkanat erva
Hay mishshum takkanat valad dela lifga behu erva
Bishlama tamtin shene chodashim vetinnase la dehayenu sefeka i bar tisha lekamma i bar shiva levatra
Ella tamtin chodesh echad vetinnase vei leshiva yalda hay bar shiva levatra hu vei litmanya yalda hay bar tisha lekamma hu
I name litmanya yalda ika lememar devatra hu dilma ishtahoye ishtahay chodesh echad veiabbar
Vetamtin shene chodashim umechetza vetinnase dei leshiva yalda hay bar shiva levatra hu vei leshita ufalga yalda hay bar tisha lekamma hu dei bar batra hu bar shita ufalga la chaye
I name leshita ufalga yalda ika lememar devatra hu deamar mar zutra afilu leman deamar yoledet letisha enah yoledet limkuttain yalda leshiva yoledet limkuttain
Shenneemar vayehi litkufot hayyamim miut tekufot shettayim miut yamim shenayim
Vetamtin mashshehu vetinnase vechi malu shelosha chodashim livdekah
Amar rav safra en bodkin et hannesuot shello yitgannu al baalehen venivdekah behilluchah
Amar rame bar chama ishsha mechappa atzmah kede sheyyirash benah benichse vaalah
Hecha dekim lan dimubberet hi tinnase allema tanya lo yissa adam meubberet chavero umeneket chavero veim nasa yotzi velo yachzir olamit
Gezera shemma taase ubbarah sandal i hachi dideh name
I leman deamar bemoch bemoch vei leman deamar min hashshamayim yerachamu min hashshamayim yerachamu
Hacha name i leman deamar bemoch bemoch i leman deamar min hashshamayim yerachamu min hashshamayim yerachamu
Ella mishshum dachsa i hachi dideh name dideh chayes ilaveh hacha name chayes ilaveh
Ella setam meubberet lemenika kayema
b: Dilma iabbara umiachar chalvah vekatla leh i hachi dideh name dideh memasmesa leh bevetzim vechalav didah name memasmesa leh bevetzim vechalav la yahev lah baal velitbeineh vetitbeinhu leorshim amar abbaye ishsha bosha lavo levet din vehoreget et benah
Achat betulot veachat beulot he nihu betulot vehe nihu arusot he nihu beulot vehe nihu nesuot
Amar rabbi yehuda hachi kaamar achat betulot veachat beulot shennitarmelu o shennitgarshu ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin
Rabbi elazar la al leve midresha ashkecheh lerabbi assi amar leh may amur rabbanan beve midresha amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yose

Mikkelal dichidaa pelig aleh in vehatanya hare shehayeta redufa lelech levet aviha o shehaya lah kaas bevet balah o shehaya balah chavush bevet haasurin o shehaya balah zaken o chole o shehayeta hi chola
O shehippila achar mitat balah o shehayeta akara o zekena o ketanna o ayelonit o sheenah reuya leled tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda mattir leares velinase miyyad

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba chazar bo rabbi yochanan amar rav yosef i hadar beh mimmatnitin decharma hadar beh detanya amar rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka shamati mippi chachamim bakkerem beyavne kullan tzerichot lehamtin shelosha chodashim

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zerika ki ayelatte lekammeh derabbi avahu remi leh mi amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yose vehaamar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna utnan kol hannashim lo yinnasu velo yitarsu ad sheyehu lahem shelosha chodashim achat betulot veachat beulot

Amar leh dirma lach ha la chash lekimcheh setam veachar kach machloket hi veen halacha kistam deamar rav pappa veitema rabbi yochanan machloket veachar kach setam halacha kistam setam veachar kach machloket en halacha kistam

Mistemich veazel rabbi avahu akkatpeh derabbi nachum shammaeh menakket veazel hilchata mineh bea mineh machloket veachar kach setam may amar leh halacha kistam setam veachar kach machloket may amar leh en halacha kistam
Setama dematnitin umachloket bevarayeta may amar leh halacha kistam machloket bematnitin ustama bevarayeta may amar leh

a: Vechi rabbi lo shenaah rabbi chiyya minnayin lo
Amar leh veha tenan masrek shel pishtan shennitlu shinav venishtayeru bo shettayim temeot veachat tehora vechullan shennitlu achat achat bifne atzman temeot

Shel tzemer shennitlu shinav achat mibbentayim tahor nishtayeru bo shelosh bemakom echad tame hayeta hachitzona achat mehen tahor nitlu shenayim vaasaan lemalket temeot achat vehitkinah lener o lemituach temea
Vekayema lan deen halacha keotah mishna amar leh bar minah dehahi derabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu zo enah mishna

May tama amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav idi bereh derav ika mishshum dekashya resha lesefa dekatane shel tzemer shennitlu shinav achat mibbentayim tahor ha nishtayeru bo shettayim bemakom echad tame vahadar tane nishtayeru bo shelosh tame shalosh in shettayim la
Umay kushya dilma ha begauoyata ha bevarayeta
Ella mehacha dekatane vechullan shennitlu achat achat bifne atzman temeot veaf al gav delo hitkinah ema sefa achat vehitkinah lener o lemituach temea hitkinah in lo hitkinah la
Amar abbaye umay kushya dilma ha bekattayehu ha bela kattayehu
Amar rav pappa umay kushya vedilma ha bekattinata ha beallimata
Ella mishshum dimsayemi bah davekane zo rabbi shimon
Shalach rabbi chiyya bar avin mearsin toch shelosha vechen osim maase
Vechen haya rabbi elazar melammedenu mishshum rabbi chanina haggadol rubbo shel rishon verubbo shel shelishi veemtzai shalem

Ammemar shera leares beom tishim amar leh rav ashe leammemar veha rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim chutz miyyom shemmet bo vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo hahu leinyan meneket itmar derav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu tzericha lehamtin esrim vearbaa chodesh chutz miyyom shennolad bo vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo
Veha hahu daavad seudat erusin beom tishim veafsedeh rava lisodteh hahi seudat nissuin havay
Vehilcheta tzericha lehamtin esrim vearbaa chodesh chutz miyyom shennolad bo vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo utzricha lehamtin shelosha chodashim chutz miyyom shemmet bo vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo
Chutz min haalmana vechu amar rav chisda kal vachomer uma bimkom sheasur lechabbes muttar leares mekom shemmuttar lechabbes eno din shemmuttar leares

May hi ditnan shabbat shechal tisha beav betochah asur lesapper ulchabbes uvachamishi muttar mippene kevod hashshabbat vetanya kodem hazzeman hazze haam memaatin beiskehem millisa umilliten millivnot velintoa umarsin aval lo konsin veen osin seudat erusin
Ki tanya hahi kodem dekodem tanya
Amar rava vekodem dekodem name kal vachomer uma bimkom sheasur lisa veliten muttar leares mekom shemmuttar lisa veliten eno din shemmuttar leares
La tema derabbi yose omer kol hannashim yitarsu ella ema kal hannashim yinnasu
b: Velet leh lerabbi yose lehavchin
Let leh veibaet ema leolam it leh veema rabbi yose omer kol arusot gerushot yinnasu
I hachi hayenu rabbi yehuda ika benayehu nesua leares rabbi yehuda savar nesua mutteret leares verabbi yose savar nesua asura leares

Vesavar rabbi yose nesua asura leares vehatanya rabbi yose omer kol hannashim yitarsu chutz min haalmana mippene haibul vechamma ibul shellah sheloshim yom vechullan lo yinnasu ad sheyehu lahen shelosha chodashim
Hay may kushya ilema dekatane rabbi yose omer kol hannashim yitarsu mi allima mimmatnitin deokemna baarusot gerushot yinnasu hacha name kol arusot gerushot yinnasu
Ella missefa dekatane vechullan lo yinnasu ad sheyehu lahen shelosha chodashim insove hu dela ha itrose shappir dame
Amar rava taretz veema hachi rabbi yose omer kol arusot gerushot yinnasu chutz min haalmana mippene haibul vechamma ibul shellah sheloshim yom unsuot lo yitarsu ad sheyehe lahen shelosha chodashim
Vealmana min haerusin mi it lah ibul vehatane rabbi chiyya bar amme ishto arusa lo onen velo mitamme lah vechen hi lo onenet velo mitammea lo meta eno yorshah met hu gova ketubbatah

Ella tannae hi detanya merosh chodesh vead hattaanit haam memaatin meiskehen millisa umilliten millivnot velintoa umilleares umillisa shabbat shechal tisha beav betochah asur lesapper ulchabbes veasur leares veyesh omrim kol hachodesh asur
Matkef lah rav ashe mimmay deleares leares mammash dilma lemibad seudat erusin hu deasur ha leares shappir dame
I hachi millisa linase name lemebad seudat nissuin hu deasur ha lisa shappir dame hachi hashta bishlama nissuin belo seuda ika simcha ella erusin belo seuda mi ika simcha
Ella amar rav ashe shane avelut chadasha meavelut yeshana veshane avelut derabbim meavelut deyachid
Matni arbaa achin nesuin arba nashim vametu im ratza haggadol shebbahem leyabem et kullan harshut beyado
Mi shehaya nasuy lishte nashim umet biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehen poteret tzaratah

a: Hayeta achat keshera veachat pesula im haya choletz choletz lappesula veim haya meyabem meyabem lakkeshera
Gema arbaa achin salka datach ella ema arbaa meachin
Harshut beyado veshavki leh vehatanya vekaru lo zikne iro hen velo sheluchan vedibberu elav melammed shemmassiin lo etza hogenet lo
Sheim haya hu yeled vehi zekena hu zaken vehi yalda omrin lo ma lecha etzel yalda ma lecha etzel zekena kelach etzel shekkemotcha veal tasim ketata bevetecha
La tzericha deefshar leh i hachi afilu tuva name etza tova ka mashma lan arba in tefe la ki hechi denimteyeh ona bechodesh
Mi shehaya nasuy vechu unyabem letarvayehu amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan amar kera asher lo yivne et bet achiv bayit echad hu bone veen bone shene vattim
Venachlotz letarvayehu amar mar zutra bar toviyya amar kera bet chalutz hannaal bayit echad hu choletz veen choletz shene vattim
Unyabem lachada venachlotz lachada amar kera im lo yachpotz ha chafetz yeyabbem kol haole leyibbum ole lachalitza kol sheen ole leyibum en ole lachalitza
Veod shello yomru bayit miktzato banuy umiktzato chalutz veyomru i dimyabem vahadar chaletz hachi name ella dilma chaletz vahadar meyabem vekam leh belo yivne
Veema ki ika chada titkayyem mitzvat yibbum ki ika tarte lo titkayyem mitzvat yibbum
Im ken tzarat erva deasar rachamana lema li hashta tarte bealma amratte lav bene chalitza veyibbum ninhu tzarat erva mibaya
Allema la itzterich salka datach amena erva abbaray kayema vetityabem tzaratah ka mashma lan daasira
Ella yevimto yevimto riba
Hayeta achat keshera amar rav yosef kan shana rabbi lo yishpoch adam me voro vaacherim tzerichim lahem
Matni hammachzir gerushato vehannose chalutzato vehannose kerovat chalutzato yotzi vehavalad mamzer divre rabbi akiva
Vachachamim omrim en havalad mamzer umodim benose kerovat gerushato shehavalad mamzer
Gema vesavar rabbi akiva hannose kerovat chalutzato havalad mamzer vehaamar resh lakish kan shana rabbi achot gerusha middivre tora achot chalutza middivre sofrim teni kerovat gerushato
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa umodim benose kerovat gerushato shehavalad mamzer i amratte bishlama ayeri bah hayenu dekatane umodim ella i amratte la ayeri bah may umodim

Vedilma ha ka mashma lan deyesh mamzer mechayyave karetot ha katane lah lekamman ezehu mamzer kol sheer basar shehu belo yavo divre rabbi akiva rabbi shimon hattimni omer kol shechayyavin alav karet bide shamayim vahalacha kidvarav
Vedilma kasatem lan tanna kerabbi shimon hattimni im ken litne shear chayyave karetot kerovat gerushato lema li ella shema minah ayeri bah
Vedilma leolam la ayeri bah veayede ditna machazir gerushato venose chalutzato ukrovat chalutzato tane name kerovat gerushato
Ella kerovat chalutzato lerabbi akiva have mamzer amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hayenu tama derabbi akiva deamar kera bet chalutz hannaal hakkatuv kerao beto
Amar rav yosef amar rabbi shimon bar rabbi hakkol modim bemachazir gerushato
b: Shehavalad pagum lakkehunna man hakkol modim shimon hattimni deaf al gav deamar shimon hattimni en mamzer mechayyave lavin nehi demamzer la have pagum miha have
Mikkal vachomer mealmana uma almana lechohen gadol sheen isurah shave bakkol benah pagum zo sheisurah shave bakkol eno din shebbenah pagum
Ika lemifrach ma lealmana shekken hi atzmah mitchallelet
Veod hi toeva ketiv veen baneha toavin

Veod tanya hammachazir gerushato vehannose chalutzato vehannose kerovat chalutzato rabbi akiva omer en lo bah kiddushin veenah tzericha hemennu get vehi pesula uveladah pasul vechofin oto lehotzi vachachamim omrim yesh lo bah kiddushin utzricha hemennu get vehi keshera uveladah kasher
Leman lav lichhunna la lakkahal i hachi hi keshera leman ilema lakkahal peshita mishshum dezanneya ippasla lakkahal ella lav lichhunna
Umiddehi lichhunna veladah name lichhunna mide irya ha kidita veha kidita
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane resha hi pesula uveladah pasul hi pesula leman ilema lakkahal mishshum dezanneya ippasla leh lakkahal ella lav lichhunna
Uveladah pasul leman ilema lichhunna ha lakkahal kasher haamar rabbi akiva havalad mamzer ella peshita lakkahal
Umidderesha ha kidita veha kidita sefa name ha kidita veha kidita
Vehi toeva name hi toeva veen tzaratah toeva aval baneha toavin
Ella almana kashya ma lealmana shekken hi atzmah mitchallelet

Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar amar rav yosef amar rabbi shimon berabbi hakkol modim beva al chayyave karetot shehavalad pagum man hakkol modim rabbi yehoshua deaf al gav deamar rabbi yehoshua en mamzer mechayyave karetot nehi demamzer la have pagum miha have
Mikkal vachomer mealmana uma almana lechohen gadol sheen isurah shave bakkol benah pagum zo sheisurah shave bakkol eno din shebbenah pagum
Vechi tema ma lealmana shekken hi atzmah mitchallelet hacha name kevan shebbealah asaah zona
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim beeved vegoy habba al bat yisrael shehavalad mamzer
Man hakkol modim shimon hattimni deaf al gav deamar shimon hattimni en mamzer mechayyave lavin hane mile

a: Mechayyave lavin detafsi behu kiddushin aval hacha goy veeved kevan dela tafsi behu kiddushin kechayyave karetot deme
Metivi goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer en mamzer ella mimmi sheisuro isur erva veanush karet

Ella amar rav yosef man hakkol modim rabbi af al gav derabbi omer en haddevarim hallalu amurim ella ledivre rabbi akiva shehaya ose chalutza keerva veleh la sevira leh begoy veeved mode dechi ata rav dimi amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi mishshum rabbenu goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer

Rabbi acha sar habbira verabbi tanchum bereh derabbi chiyya ish kefar akko peruk hanhu shevuyata daato mearmon litverya hava chada deiabbara miggoy vaato lekammeh derabbi amme amar lehu rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar verabbi chanina deamri goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer

Amar rav yosef revuta lemichshav gavre ha rav ushmuel bevavel verabbi yehoshua ben levi uvar kappara beeretz yisrael veamri lah challofe bar kappara veayyole zikne darom deamri goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad kasher
Ella amar rav yosef rabbi hi dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yitzchak bar avudimi mishshum rabbenu amru goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi omer havalad mekulkal leman ilema lakkahal ha amar rabbi yehoshua havalad kasher ella lichhunna dechullehu amorae demachsheri modu shehavalad pagum lichhunna
Mikkal vechomer mealmana ma almana lechohen gadol sheen isurah shave bakkol benah pagum zo sheisurah shave bakkol eno din shebbenah pagum
Ma lealmana lechohen gadol shekken hi atzmah mitchallelet hacha name kevan shennivala pesalah

Deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon minnayin legoy veeved habba al hakkohenet veal halleviyya veal hayyisreelit sheppesaluha shenneemar uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugrusha mi sheyyesh lo almenut vegerushin bah yatzu goy veeved sheen lahem almenut vegerushin bah
Amar leh abbaye may chazet desamchatte adderav dimi semoch adderavin dechi ata ravin amar rabbi natan verabbi yehuda hannasi moru bah lehetera uman rabbi yehuda hannasi rabbi
Veaf rav more bah lehetera dehahu daata lekammeh derav amar leh goy veeved habba al bat yisrael mahu
Amar leh havalad kasher amar leh hav li berattach la yahevna lach
Amar shimi bar chiyya lerav amri inashe gamla bemaday akkabba rakda ha kabba veha gamla veha maday vela rakda
Amar leh i nihve kihoshua bin nun la yahevna leh beratti amar leh i hava kihoshua bin nun i mar la yahev leh acharine yahavi leh hay i mar la yahev leh acharine la yahavi leh
La hava kaazel mikkammeh yehev beh eneh ushchev
Veaf rav matna more bah lehetera veaf rav yehuda more bah lehetera dechi ata lekammeh derav yehuda amar leh zil itammar o nesev bat minach vechi ata lekammeh derava amar leh o geli o nesev bat minach
Shelachu leh bene be michse lerabba mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin habba al bat yisrael mahu amar lehu hashta eved kullo amrinan kasher chetzo mibaya
Amar rav yosef mara dishmata
b: Mannu rav yehuda veha amar rav yehuda mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin habba al bat yisrael oto valad en lo takkana
Ki itmar derav yehuda kegon dekaddesh bat yisrael denimtza tzad avdut shebbo mishtammesh beeshet ish
Vehaamri nehardae mishshemeh derabbi yaakov ledivre happosel posel afilu bifnuya ledivre hammachshir machshir afilu beeshet ish
Ushnehem lo lemaduha ella meeshet av man defasel savar ma eshet av dela tafsi bah kiddushin havalad mamzer af kol dela tafsi bah kiddushin havalad mamzer
Uman demachshar savar ma eshet av dildideh la tafsi bah kiddushin leacharine tafsi bah kiddushin leappoke goy veeved dela tafsi behu kiddushin kelal
Ella ki itmar derav yehuda kegon shebba al eshet ish venimtza tzad cherut shebbo mishtammesh beeshet ish

Amar ravina amar li rav gazza ikla rabbi yose bar avin leatrin vahava ovada bifnuya veachshar beeshet ish ufsal amar rav sheshet ledidi amar li rav gazza la rabbi yose bar avin hava ella rabbi yose berabbi zevida hava veachshar ben bifnuya ben beeshet ish amar leh rav acha bereh derabba leravina ikla ammemar leatrin veachshar ben bifnuya ben beeshet ish
Vehilcheta goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad kasher ben bifnuya ben beeshet ish

Rava achshereh lerav mari bar rachel umanneyeh befurse devavel veaf al gav deamar mar som tasim alecha melech kol mesimot sheatta mesim al yehu ella mikkerev achecha hay kevan deimmo miyyisrael mikkerev achecha karenan beh
Avdeh derabbi chiyya bar amme atbelah lehahi goya leshem inteta amar rav yosef yachelna leachshore bah uvivrattah
Bah kidrav assi deamar rav assi mi la tevala leniddutah
Bivrattah goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad kasher
Hahu dahao karu leh bar armayeta amar rav assi mi la tevala leniddutah hahu dahao karu leh bar armaa amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mi la teval lekiro
Amar rav chama bar gurya amar rav hallokeach eved min haggoy vekadam vetaval leshem ben chorin kana atzmo ben chorin may tama

a: Goy gufa la kane leh may dekane leh hu demakne leh leyisrael vechevan dikdam utval leshem ben chorin afkeeh leshibudeh
Kidrava deamar rava hekdesh chametz veshichrur mafkiin mide shibud
Metiv rav chisda maase bivlorya haggiyyoret shekkadmu avadeha vetavlu lefaneha uva maase lifne chachamim veamru kanu atzman bene chorin lefaneha in leachareha la
Amar rava lefaneha ben bistam ben bimforesh leachareha bimforesh in bistam la
Amar rav aveya lo shanu ella belokeach min haggoy aval goy gufeh kane
Dichtiv vegam mibbene hattoshavim haggarim immachem mehem tiknu attem konim mehem velo hem konim mikkem velo hem konim ze mizze
