Velo hem konim mikkem lemay ilema lemaase yadav attu goy la kane leh leyisrael lemaase yadav vehachtiv o leeker mishpachat ger veamar mar mishpachat ger ze haggoy ella lav legufeh vekaamar rachamana attem konin mehem afilu gufeh
Parech rav acha ema bechaspa uvitvila kashya
Amar shemuel vetzarich letokpo bammayim
Ki hay deminyamin avdeh derav ashe bea leatboleh masreh nihalayehu leravina ulrav acha bereh derava amar lehu chazo deminayechu kavaena leh remo leh arvisa betzavvereh arpo leh vetzamtzimu leh

Arpo leh ki hechi dela leheve chatzitza tzamtzimu leh ki hechi dela lakdem velema lehu leshem ben chorin ani tovel bahade dedalli resheh mimmayya annechu leh zulta detina aresheh vaamaru leh zil amti leve marach
Amar leh rav pappa lerava chazi mar hane deve pappa bar abba deyahavi zuzi leinashe lichragayehu umshabedi behu ki nafki tzerichi gita decheruta o la
Amar leh iko shechevi la amari lechu ha milta hachi amar rav sheshet muhrekayehu dehane betufsa demalka mannach umalka amar man dela yahev keraga mishtabed leman deyahev keraga

Rabbi chiyya bar abba ikla legavla chaza benot yisrael dimabberan miggerim shemmalu velo tavlu vachaza chamra deyisrael demazgi goyim veshatu yisrael vachaza tormosin deshalki goyim veachli yisrael vela amar lehu vela mide
Ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh tze vehachrez al benehem shehem mamzerim veal yenam mishshum yen nesech veal tormosan mishshum bishule goyim lefi sheenan bene tora

Al benehen shehem mamzerim rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan leolam en ger ad sheyyamul veyitbol vechevan dela tavel goy hu veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer
Veal yenam mishshum yen nesech mishshum lach lach amrin nezira sechor sechor lecharma la tikrav

Veal tormosan mishshum bishshule goyim lefi sheenan bene tora ha bene tora shere vehaamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak mishshemeh derav kal hanneechal kemot shehu chay en bo mishshum bishshule goyim veha tormos eno neechal kemot shehu chay veyesh bo mishshum bishshule goyim

Rabbi yochanan keidach lishana sevira leh deamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak mishshemeh derav kol sheen ole al shulchan melachim leechol bo et happat en bo mishshum bishshule goyim vetama deenan bene tora ha bene tora shere

Tanu rabbanan ger shemmal velo taval rabbi eliezer omer hare ze ger shekken matzinu baavotenu shemmalu velo tavlu taval velo mal rabbi yehoshua omer hare ze ger shekken matzinu baimmahot shettavlu velo malu vachachamim omrim taval velo mal mal velo taval en ger ad sheyyamul veyitbol
Verabbi yehoshua name nelaf meavot verabbi eliezer name nelaf meimmahot vechi tema en danin efshar mishshei efshar

Vehatanya rabbi eliezer omer minnayin lefesach dorot sheen ba ella min hachullin neemar pesach bemitzrayim veneemar pesach bedorot ma pesach haamur bemitzrayim en ba ella min hachullin af pesach haamur ledorot en ba ella min hachullin
Amar lo rabbi akiva vechi danin efshar mishshei efshar amar lo af al pi shei efshar reaya gedola hi venilmad hemenna
Ella
b: Betaval velo mal kulle alma la peligi demahne ki peligi bemal velo taval rabbi eliezer yalef meavot verabbi yehoshua beavot name tevila hava
Mena leh ilema middichtiv lech el haam vekiddashtam hayyom umachar vechibbesu simlotam uma bimkom sheen taun kibbus taun tevila mekom shettaun kibbus eno din shettaun tevila
Vedilma nekiyyut bealma
Ella mehacha vayyikkach moshe et haddam vayyizrok al haam ugmiri deen hazzaa belo tevila
Verabbi yehoshua tevila baimmahot menalan sevara hu deim ken bamme nichnesu tachat kanfe hashshechina
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan leolam eno ger ad sheyimmol veyitbol peshita yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim
Man chachamim rabbi yose
Detanya hare shebba veamar malti velo tavalti matbilin oto uma bechach divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer en matbilin
Lefichach matbilin ger beshabbat divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose omer en matbilin
Amar mar lefichach matbilin ger beshabbat peshita kevan deamar rabbi yehuda bachada saggi hecha demal lefanenu matbilin may lefichach
Mahu detema lerabbi yehuda tevila ikar utvila beshabbat la deka metakken gavra ka mashma lan derabbi yehuda o ha o ha bae
Rabbi yose omer en matbilin peshita dechevan deamar rabbi yose tarte baenan takkone gavra beshabbat la metakkeninan
Mahu detema lerabbi yose mila ikar vehatam hu dela havay mila befanenu aval hecha dahavay mila befanenu ema litbol ze latbeleh beshabbeta ka mashma lan derabbi yose tarte bae

Amar rabba ovada hava be rabbi chiyya bar rabbi verav yosef matni rabbi oshaya bar rabbi verav safra matne rabbi oshaya berabbi chiyya daata lekammeh ger shemmal velo taval amar leh shehi kan ad limchar venatbelinach
Shema minah telat shema minah ger tzarich shelosha ushma minah eno ger ad sheyimmol veyitbol ushma minah en matbilin ger ballayela venema shema minah name baenan mumchin dilma deiklau
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan ger tzarich shelosha mishpat ketiv beh
Tanu rabbanan mi shebba veamar ger ani yachol nekabbelennu talmud lomar ittecha bemuchzak lecha ba veedav immo minnayin talmud lomar vechi yagur ittecha ger beartzechem

a: En li ella baaretz bechutz laaretz minnayin talmud lomar ittecha bechol makom sheittecha im ken ma talmud lomar baaretz baaretz tzarich lehavi reaya bechutz laaretz en tzarich lehavi reaya divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz tzarich lehavi reaya
Ba hu veedav immo kera lema li amar rav sheshet deamri shamanu shennitgayyer bevet din shel peloni salka datach amena la lehemniyhu ka mashma lan
Baaretz en li ella baaretz bechutza laaretz minnayin talmud lomar ittecha bechol makom sheittecha veha appekteh chada meittecha vachada meimmach
Vachachamim omrim ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz tzarich lehavi reaya veella ha ketiv baaretz
Hahu mibe leh daafilu baaretz mekabbelim gerim desalka datach amena mishshum tevuta deeretz yisrael kamiggayeri vehashta name deleka tevuta ika leket shichcha ufea umasar ani ka mashma lan

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan halacha ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz tzarich lehavi reaya peshita yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim mahu detema mistabbar tama derabbi yehuda dekamsayei leh kerae ka mashma lan
Tanu rabbanan ushfattem tzedek ben ish uven achiv uven gero mikkan amar rabbi yehuda ger shennitgayyer bevet din hare ze ger beno leven atzmo eno ger

Maase beechad shebba lifne rabbi yehuda veamar lo nitgayyarti beni leven atzmi amar lo rabbi yehuda yesh lecha edim amar lo lav yesh lecha banim amar lo hen amar lo neeman atta lifsol et atzmecha vei atta neeman lifsol et banecha

Umi amar rabbi yehuda abbanim la meheman vehatanya yakkir yakkirennu laacherim mikkan amar rabbi yehuda neeman adam lomar ze beni bechor uchshem shenneeman lomar ze beni bechor kach neeman lomar beni ze ben gerusha hu o ben chalutza hu vachachamim omrim eno neeman

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hachi kaamar leh lidvarecha goy atta veen edut legoy ravina amar hachi kaamar leh yesh lecha banim hen yesh lecha bene vanim hen amar lo neeman atta lifsol banecha vei atta neeman lifsol bene vanecha

Tanya name hachi rabbi yehuda omer neeman adam lomar al beno katan veen neeman al beno gadol veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lo katan katan mammash velo gadol gadol mammash ella katan veyesh lo banim zehu gadol gadol veen lo banim zehu katan
Vehilcheta keoteh derav nachman bar yitzchak vehatanya keoteh deravina hahu leinyan yakkir itmar

Tanu rabbanan ger shebba lehitgayyer bizman hazze omrim lo ma raita shebbata lehitgayyer i atta yodea sheyyisrael bizman hazze deuyim dechufim sechufim umtorafin veyissurin bain alehem im omer yodea ani veeni keday mekabbelin oto miyyad

Umodiin oto miktzat mitzot kallot umiktzat mitzot chamurot umodiin oto aon leket shichcha ufea umasar ani umodiin oto onshan shel mitzot omrim lo heve yodea shead shello bata lemidda zo achalta chelev i atta anush karet chillalta shabbat i atta anush sekila veachshav achalta chelev anush karet chillalta shabbat anush sekila
Uchshem shemmodiin oto onshan shel mitzot kach modiin oto mattan secharan omrim lo heve yodea shehaolam habba eno asuy ella letzaddikim veyisrael bizman hazze enam yecholim lekabbel
b: Lo rov tova velo rov puranut veen marbin alav veen medakdekin alav

Kibel malin oto miyyad nishtayeru bo tzitzin hamakkevin et hammila chozrim umalin oto sheniyya nitrappe matbilin oto miyyad ushne talmide chachamim omdim al gabbav umodiin oto miktzat mitzot kallot umiktzat mitzot chamurot taval veala hare hu keyisrael lechol devarav
Ishsha nashim moshivot otah bemayim ad tzavarah ushne talmide chachamim omdim lah mibbachutz umodiin otah miktzat mitzot kallot umiktzat mitzot chamurot
Echad ger veechad eved meshuchrar uvimkom shennidda tovelet sham ger veeved meshuchrar tovlin vechol davar shechotzetz bitvila chotzetz beger uveved meshuchrar uvnidda

Amar mar ger shebba lehitgayyer omrim lo ma raita shebbata lehitgayyer umodiim oto miktzat mitzot kallot umiktzat mitzot chamurot may tama dei paresh nifrosh deamar rabbi chelbo kashim gerim leyisrael kesappachat dichtiv venilva hagger alehem venispechu al bet yaakov
Umodiim oto aon leket shichcha ufea umasar ani may tama amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan ben noach neherag al pachot mishshave peruta velo nitan lehishshavon
Umodiim oto aon shichcha ufea veen marbim alav veen medakdekim alav amar rabbi elazar may keraa dichtiv vattere ki mitammetzet hi lalechet ittah vattechdal ledabber eleha
Amara lah asir lan techum shabbat baasher telchi elech asir lan yichud baasher talini alin
Mippakdinan shesh meot ushlosh esre mitzot ammech ammi asir lan avoda zara velohayich elohay arba mitot nimseru levet din baasher tamuti amut shene kevarim nimseru levet din vesham ekkaver

Kibel malin oto miyyad may tama shahoye mitzva la meshahenan

Nishtayeru bo tzitzin hamakkevin hammila vechu keditnan ellu hen tzitzin hamakkevin hammila basar hachofe et rov haatara veeno ochel bitruma veamar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav basar hachofe rov govhah shel atara
Nitrappe matbilin oto miyyad nitrappe in lo nitrappe la may tama mishshum demayya marzu makka
Ushne talmide chachamim omdim al gabbav veha amar rabbi chiyya amar rabbi yochanan ger tzarich shelosha ha amar rabbi yochanan letanna teni shelosha
Taval veala hare hu keyisrael lechol devarav lemay hilcheta dei hadar beh umkaddesh bat yisrael yisrael meshummad karena beh vekidushav kidushin
Echad ger veechad eved meshuchrar kasalka datach lekabbel alav ol mitzot urminhu bamme devarim amurim beger aval beeved meshuchrar en tzarich lekabbel
Amar rav sheshet la kashya ha rabbi shimon ben elazar ha rabbanan
Detanya uvachta et aviha veet immah vego bamme devarim amurim shello kibbela aleha aval kibbela aleha matbilah umuttar bah miyyad
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af al pi shello kibbela aleha kofah umatbilah leshem shifchut vechozer umatbilah leshem shichrur umshachrerah

a: Umuttar bah miyyad
Amar rava may tama derabbi shimon ben elazar dichtiv kol eved ish miknat kasef eved ish velo eved ishsha ella eved ish atta mal beal korcho vei atta mal ben ish beal korcho
Verabbanan amar ulla keshem shei atta mal ben ish beal korcho kach i atta mal eved ish beal korcho veella hachtiv kol eved ish hahu mibe leh lichdishmuel

Deamar shemuel hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut veen tzarich get shichrur shenneemar kol eved ish miknat kasef eved ish velo eved ishsha ella eved sheyyesh lo reshut lerabbo alav karuy eved vesheen reshut lerabbo alav en karuy eved
Matkef lah rav pappa emor deshamatte lehu lerabbanan bifat toar dela shayecha bemitzot aval eved deshayech bemitzot hachi name daafilu rabbanan modu
Detanya echad ger veechad lokeach eved min haggoy tzarich lekabbel ha lokeach miyyisrael en tzarich lekabbel
Manni i rabbi shimon ben elazar haamar lokeach min haggoy name en tzarich lekabbel ella lav rabbanan ushma minah delokeach min haggoy tzarich lekabbel aval lokeach miyyisrael en tzarich lekabbel
Veella kashya echad ger veechad eved meshuchrar ki tanya hahi leinyan tevila tanya
Tanu rabbanan vegillecha et roshah veasta et tzipporneha rabbi eliezer omer takotz rabbi akiva omer tegaddel

Amar rabbi eliezer neemra asiyya barosh veneemra asiyya batztzippornayim ma lehallan haavara af kan haavara rabbi akiva omer neemra asiyya barosh veneemra asiyya batztzippornayim ma lehallan niuul af kan niuul
Uraya ledivre rabbi eliezer umfivoshet ben shaul yarad likrat hammelech lo asa raglav velo asa sefamo may asiyya haavara
Tanu rabbanan uvachta et aviha veet immah
b: Rabbi eliezer omer aviha aviha mammash immah immah mammash rabbi akiva omer aviha veimmah zo avoda zara vechen hu omer omrim laetz avi atta vego
Yerach yamim yerach sheloshim yom rabbi shimon ben elazar omer tishim yom yerach sheloshim yamim sheloshim veachar ken sheloshim
Matkef lah ravina ema yerach sheloshim yamim sheloshim veachar ken ki hane kashya

Tanu rabbanan mekayemin avadim sheenam malin divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer en mekayemin amar lo rabbi yishmael hare hu omer veyinnafesh ben amatcha amar lo belokeach eved ben hashshemashot velo hispik lemulo hakkatuv medabber

Dechulle alma mihat veyinnafesh ben amatcha beeved arel ketiv may mashma detanya veyinnafesh ben amatcha beeved arel hakkatuv medabber atta omer beeved arel o eno ella beeved mahul keshehu omer lemaan yanuach avdecha vaamatcha kamocha hare eved mahul amur ha ma ani mekayyem veyinnafesh ben amatcha beeved arel
Vehagger ze ger toshav atta omer ze ger toshav o eno ella ger tzedek keshehu omer vegercha asher bisharecha hare ger tzedek amur ha ma ani mekayyem vehagger ze ger toshav
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hallokeach eved min haggoy velo ratza lamul megalgel immo ad shenem asar chodesh lo mal chozer umochro legoyim

Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa keman dela kerabbi akiva dei rabbi akiva haamar en mekayemin amar lehu rav pappa afilu tema rabbi akiva hane mile hecha dela paskah lemilteh aval hecha defaskah lemilteh paskah
Amar rav kahana amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea amar li i hachi ki amar leh rabbi akiva belokeach eved ben hashshemashot lishanne leh ha chada mittere tame kaamar

Shelach ravin mishshemeh derabbi ilay vechol rabbotay amru li mishshemo ezehu eved arel shemmuttar lekayemo ze shellekacho rabbo al menat shello lemulo amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa keman dela kerabbi akiva dei rabbi akiva haamar en mekayemin amar lehu rav pappa afilu tema rabbi akiva hane mile hecha dela atni bahadeh aval hecha deatni atni
Amar rav kahana amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea vaamar li i hachi ki kaamar leh rabbi akiva belokeach eved ben hashshemashot velo hispik lemulo lishanne leh ha
Velitamach lishanne leh hach ella chad mittere utlat tame kaamar

Yetev rabbi chanina bar pappi verabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha akkila derabbi yitzchak nappacha veyatvi vekaamri ir achat hayeta beeretz yisrael velo ratzu avadeha lamul vegilgelu immahem ad shenem asar chodesh vechazru umcharum legoyim keman

Ki hay tanna detanya hallokeach eved min haggoy velo ratza lamul megalgel immo ad shenem asar chodesh lo mal chozer umochro legoyim rabbi shimon ben elazar omer en meshahin oto beeretz yisrael mippene hefsed teharot uvair hassemucha lassefar en meshahin oto kol ikar shemma yishma davar veyelech veyomar lachavero goy

Tanya rabbi chananya beno shel rabban gamliel omer mippene ma gerim bizman hazze meunnin veyissurin bain alehen mippene shello kiyemu sheva mitzot bene noach rabbi yose omer ger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame ella mippene ma meunnin lefi sheen bekiin bedikduke mitzot keyisrael abba chanan omer mishshum rabbi elazar lefi sheen osin meahava ella miyyira

Acherim omrim mippene sheshshihu atzmam lehikkanes tachat kanfe hashshechina amar rabbi avahu veitema rabbi chanina may keraa yeshallem Adonai poolech uthi maskurtech shelema meim Adonai elohe yisrael asher bat lachasot vegomer

a: Matni ezehu mamzer kol sheer basar shehu belo yavo divre rabbi akiva shimon hattimni omer kol shechayyavim alav karet bide shamayim vahalacha kidvarav verabbi yehoshua omer kol shechayyavin alav mitat bet din
Amar rabbi shimon ben azzay matzati megillat yuchasin birushalayim vechatuv bah ish peloni mamzer meeshet ish lekayyem divre rabbi yehoshua

Ishto shemmeta muttar baachotah gershah umeta muttar baachotah nisset leacher umeta muttar baachotah yevimto shemmeta muttar baachotah chalatz lah umeta muttar baachotah nisset leacher umeta muttar baachotah
Gema may tama derabbi akiva dichtiv lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv velo yegalle kenaf aviv kanaf sheraa aviv lo yegalle
Vesavar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar baanusat aviv hakkatuv medabber dehaveya lah chayyave lavin
Usmich leh lo yavo mamzer bikhal Adonai alma mehane have mamzer
Ulrabbi simay dimrabbe shear chayyave lavin delav disher ulrabbi yeshevav dimrabbe afilu chayyave ase
Nafka lehu mivvelo
Veshimon hattimni savar lah kerabbanan deamri beshomeret yavam shel aviv hakkatuv medabber dehaveya lah chayyave karetot usmich leh lo yavo mamzer alma mechayyave karetot have mamzer
Verabbi yehoshua lichtov rachamana lo yegalle lo yikkach velo yegalle lema li ella lav hachi kaamar millo yikkach ad lo yegalle have mamzer tefe la have mamzer
Amar abbaye hakkol modim beva al hannidda
b: Veal hassota sheen havalad mamzer
Nidda deha tafsi bah kidushin shenneemar uthi niddatah alav afilu bishat niddatah tafsi bah kidushin
Sota name deha tafsi bah kidushin
Tanya name hachi hakkol modim beva al hannidda veal hassota veal shomeret yavam sheen havalad mamzer
Veabbaye shomeret yavam mesappeka leh i kerav i kishmuel

Amar rabbi shimon ben azzay ku tane shimon ben azzay omer matzati megillat yuchasin birushalayim vechatuv bah ish peloni mamzer meeshet ish vechatuv bah mishnat rabbi eliezer ben yaakov kav venaki vechatuv bah menashshe harag et yeshaya

Amar rava medan dayeneh vekatleh amar leh moshe rabbecha amar ki lo yirani haadam vachay veatte amratte vaere et Adonai yoshev al kisse ram venissa moshe rabbecha amar mi ka elohenu bechol korenu elav veatte amratte dirshu Adonai behimmatzo moshe rabbecha amar et mispar yamecha amalle veatte amratte vehosafti al yamecha chamesh esre shana

Amar yeshaya yadana beh dela mekabbel ma deema leh vei ema leh eshavveyeh mezid amar shem ibla bearza atuh learza venasseruh ki meta lahade pumma nach nafsheh mishshum daamar uvtoch am teme sefatayim anochi yoshev
Mikkol makom kashu kerae ahadade
Vaere et Adonai kidtanya kol hanneviim nistakkelu beaspaklarya sheenah meira moshe rabbenu nistakkel beaspaklarya hammeira
Dirshu Adonai behimmatzo ha beyachid ha betzibbur veyachid emat amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh ellu asara yamim shebben rosh hashshana leom hakkippurim
Et mispar yamecha amalle tannae hi detanya et mispar yamecha amalle

a: Ellu shene dorot zacha mashlimin lo lo zacha pochatin lo divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim zacha mosifim lo lo zacha pochatin lo

Amru lo lerabbi akiva hare hu omer vehosafti al yamecha chamesh esre shana amar lahem mishshello hosifu lo teda shehare navi omed umitnabbe hinne ven nolad levet david yoshiyyahu shemo vaadayin lo nolad menashshe

Ishto shemmeta vechu yevimto shemmeta vechu amar rav yosef kan shana rabbi mishna sheenah tzericha
Hadaran alach hacholetz

Rabban gamliel omer en get achar get velo maamar achar maamar velo beila achar beila velo chalitza achar chalitza vachachamim omrim yesh get achar get veyesh maamar achar maamar aval lo achar beila velo achar chalitza kelum
Ketzad asa maamar bivimto venatan lah get tzericha hemennu chalitza asa maamar vachalitza tzericha hemennu get asa maamar uvaal hare zo kemitzvatah
Natan get veasa maamar tzericha get vachalitza natan get uvaal tzericha get vachalitza natan get vechalatz en achar chalitza kelum
Chalatz veasa maamar natan get uvaal o baal veasa maamar natan get vechalatz en achar chalitza kelum
b: Echad yevama achat leyavam echad veechad shette yevamot leyavam echad ketzad asa maamar bazo umaamar bazo tzerichot shene gitin vachalitza maamar bazo veget lazo tzericha get vachalitza maamar bazo uvaal et zo tzerichot shene gitin vachalitza maamar bazo vechalatz lazo harishona tzericha get
Get lazo veget lazo tzerichot hemennu chalitza get lazo uvaal et zo tzericha get vachalitza get lazo umaamar bazo tzericha get vachalitza get lazo vechalatz lezo en achar chalitza kelum
Chalatz vechalatz o chalatz veasa maamar natan get uvaal o baal uvaal o baal veasa maamar natan get vechalatz en achar chalitza kelum ben yavam echad lishte yevamot ben shene yevamin livama achat
Chalatz veasa maamar natan get uvaal o baal veasa maamar venatan get vechalatz en achar chalitza kelum ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof
Vehabbeila bizman shehi battechilla en achareha kelum baemtza uvassof yesh achareha kelum rabbi nechemya omer achat beila veachat chalitza ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof en achareha kelum
Gema ad kan la peligi ella beget achar get umaamar achar maamar aval get echad bivama umaamar echad bivama mahane

May tama amur rabbanan get bivama mahane mishshum demahane bealma dei amratte la mahane amri get lehotziah vachalitza lehotziah umiddeget la mahane chalitza name la mahane veate lemival achar chalitza
Umay tama amur rabbanan maamar bivama mahane mishshum demahane bealma dei amratte la mahane amri maamar liknot uvia liknot umiddemaamar la mahane bia name la mahneya veate lemival achar bia
Umay tama amur rabbanan bia pesula yesh achareha kelum
Amri i bia achar hagget hi gezera bia achar hagget mishshum bia achar chalitza vei bia achar maamar hi gezera bia achar maamar mishshum bia achar bia
Umay tama amur rabbanan hay chalitza pesula en achareha kelum amri may ligzor nigzor chalitza achar hagget mishshum chalitza achar chalitza kol ki hane tichlotz vetezil
Ligzor chalitza achar maamar mishshum chalitza achar bia attu chalitza achar maamar mi la baaya get lemaamaro chalitza achar bia name baaya get leviato
Amar rava

a: May tama derabban gamliel dimsappeka leh get i dache i la dache maamar i kane i la kane get i dache i la dache i kamma dache batra may kaaved i kamma la dache batra name la dache
Maamar i kane i la kane i kamma kane batra may kaaved vei kamma la kane batra name la kane
Etiveh abbaye umode rabban gamliel sheyyesh get achar maamar umaamar achar hagget veget achar bia umaamar umaamar achar bia veget
Vei mesappeka leh lerabban gamliel tihve kevia dilchattechilla vetikne deha tenan habbeila bizman shehi battechilla en achareha kelum

Ella amar abbaye leolam peshita leh lerabban gamliel beget dedache umaamar dekane mihu amur rabbanan ha yevama bechad tzad mahane bah get uvchad tzad mahane bah maamar get achar get la dache deha decha leh kamma umaamar achar maamar la kane deha kena leh kamma get achar maamar umaamar achar hagget hay milta ka dache vehay milta ka kane
Verabbanan kol chad vechad takkinu le rabbanan get umaamar bivama

Vehay bia pesula adifa mimmaamar ugria mimmaamar adifa mimmaamar deilu maamar achar maamar la mahane veilu bia achar maamar mahane ugria mimmaamar deilu maamar achar hagget kane lechulleh shiyyura deget veilu bia achar hagget la kanya leh lechulleh shiyyura deget

Tanu rabbanan ketzad amar rabban gamliel en get achar get shette yevamot shennaflu lifne yavam echad venatan get lazo veget lazo rabban gamliel omer choletz larishona veasur bikrovoteha umuttar bikrovot sheniyya
Vachachamim omrim natan get lazo veget lazo asur bikrovot shettehen vachalitza leachat mehen vechen atta omer bishne yevamim vivama achat

Ketzad amar rabban gamliel en maamar achar maamar shette yevamot shennaflu lifne yavam echad veasa maamar bazo umaamar bazo rabban gamliel omer noten get larishona vecholetz lah veasur bikrovoteha umuttar bikrovot sheniyya vachachamim omrim noten get lishtehen veasur bikrovot shettehen vachalitza leachat mehen vechen atta omer bishne yevamim vivama achat

Amar mar noten get lazo veget lazo rabban gamliel omer choletz lerishona veasur bikrovoteha umuttar bikrovot sheniyya lema tehve teuvta dishmuel deamar shemuel chalatz levaalat hagget lo niftera tzara
Amar lecha shemuel ki amari ana alliba deman deamar yesh zika verabban gamliel savar en zika
Umidderabban gamliel savar en zika
b: Rabbanan savri yesh zika vekatane sefa vechen atta omer bishne yevamin vivama achat lema tehve teuvta derabba bar rav huna amar rav deamar rabba bar rav huna amar rav chalitza pesula tzericha lachazor al kol haachin
Amar lach rabba bar rav huna ben lerabban gamliel ben lerabbanan savri en zika vehacha beget achar get umaamar achar maamar kamipalgi

Amar mar asa maamar bazo umaamar bazo rabban gamliel omer noten get larishona vecholetz lah veasur bikrovoteha umuttar bikrovot sheniyya mikkede kasavar rabban gamliel en maamar achar maamar rishona name tityabem gezera dilma ate leyabome lishniyya
Amar rabbi yochanan rabban gamliel uvet shammay verabbi shimon uven azzay verabbi nechemya kullehu sevira lehu maamar kone kinyan gamur rabban gamliel ha daamaran

Bet shammay ditnan shelosha achin shenayim mehem nesuin lishte achaot veechad mufne met echad mibbaale achaot veasa bah mufne maamar veachar kach met achiv hashsheni bet shammay omrim ishto immo vehallezu tetze mishshum achot ishsha

Rabbi shimon detanya amar lehu rabbi shimon lachachamim im biat rishon bia biat sheni enah bia im biat rishon enah bia biat sheni name enah bia veha biat ben tesha dichmaamar shavveuha rabbanan vekaamar rabbi shimon enah bia

Ben azzay detanya ben azzay omer yesh maamar achar maamar bishne yevamin vivama achat veen maamar achar maamar bishte yevamot veyavam echad rabbi nechemya ditnan rabbi nechemya omer achat beila veachat chalitza ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof en achareha kelum veha bia pesula dichmaamar shavveuha rabbanan vekatane en achareha kelum
Ketzad asa maamar ku

a: Hay get achar get hu amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar get achar hagget umaamar achar maamar kedaamaran yavam echad vivama achat ketzad hattaratan asa maamar bivimto venatan lah get tzericha hemennu chalitza
Asa maamar uvaal hare zo kemitzvatah lema mesayya leh lerav huna deamar rav huna mitzvat yevama mekaddesh veachar kach boel ema af ze kemitzvatah
Peshita salka datach amena kevan deamar mar haose maamar bivimto parcha hemennu zikat yevamin vechala alav zikat erusin venissuin ema lav mitzva kaaved ka mashma lan
Gufa amar rav huna mitzvat yevamin mekaddesh veachar kach boel veim baal veasa maamar kana im baal veasa maamar peshita deha kanyah bevia ella ema im baal belo maamar kana
Vehatanya loke makkat mardut midderabbanan
Derav menagged man dimkaddesh bevia uman dimkaddesh beshuka uman dimkaddesh bela shidduche
Uman dimvattel gita uman demasar modaa aggita
Demitpakkar bishlucha derabbanan uman dimshahe shamta derabbanan aleh telatin yomin vela ate leve dina vetava leshamteh
Veal chatna dedaer beve chamuhi dedaer in dechalef la veha hahu dachalef abbava deve chamuhi venaggedeh rav sheshet hahu medam hava dayim mechamateh
Nehardae amri bechullehu la menagged rav ella limkaddesh bevia uvla shidduche veika deamri afilu beshidduche name mishshum peritzuta

Tanu rabbanan ketzad maamar natan lah kesef o shave kesef uvishtar ketzad bishtar ketzad kedaamaran katav lah al hanneyar o al hacheres af al pi sheen bo shave peruta hare atte mekuddeshet li amar abbaye hachi kaamar shetar ketubbat yevamin ketzad

Katav lah ana peloni bar peloni kabbelit yat pelonit yevimti alay lazun ulfarnesah karauy uvilvad shettehe ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon vei let lah merishon takkinu lah rabbanan mishsheni kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah

Bea mineh abbaye merabba natan lah get veamar hare atte megoreshet hemenni vei atte mutteret lechol adam mahu get yevama derabbanan hu get demahane beeshet ish mahane bivama get dela mahane beeshet ish la mahane bivama o dilma ate leichallofe begita
Amar leh chayeshinan dilma ate leichallofe begita matkef lah rabba bar chanan ella meatta yahev lah neyara bealma hachi name defaslah amar leh hatam la pasel bichhunna hacha kafasel bichhunna
Detanya veishsha gerusha meishah lo yikkachu afilu lo nitgarsha ella meishah lo yikkachu vehayenu reach hagget shepposel bichhunna
Amar rame bar chama hare amru amar echad lelavlar ketov get laarusati lichsheechnesenna agarshenna hare ze get mippene shebbeyado legarshah
b: Ulishsha bealma en get mippene sheen beyado legarshah bae rame bar chama livimto mahu kevan daagida beh kaarusato damya o dilma kevan dela avad bah maamar la teku

Bae rav chananya katav get lezikato velo lemaamaro lemaamaro velo lezikato mahu maamar ilave zika ka reme vehave leh kimgaresh chatzi ishsha vehamgaresh chatzi ishsha lo asa velo chelum o dilma hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae
Vetifshot leh midderava deamar rava natan get lemaamaro huttera tzaratah lerava peshita leh lerav chananya mibaya leh may teku
Chalatz veasa maamar amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi akiva deamar en kiddushin tofsin bechayyave lavin aval chachamim omrim yesh achar chalitza kelum
Umi matzet mokmatte lah kerabbi akiva veha katane resha natan get veasa maamar tzericha get vachalitza vei rabbi akiva kevan dihav lah get mi mahane bah maamar
Vehatanya rabbi akiva omer minnayin lenoten get livimto shenneesra alav olamit shenneemar lo yuchal balah harishon asher shillechah achar shiluach
Amar rav ashe get yevamin midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma

Tanya name hachi amar rabbi en haddevarim hallalu amurim ella ledivre rabbi akiva shehaya ose chalutza keerva aval chachamim omrim yesh achar chalitza kelum vaani omer ematay bizman shekkiddeshah leshum ishut aval kiddeshah leshum yavmut en achar chalitza kelum

Tanya idach hacholetz livimto vechazar vekiddeshah rabbi omer im kiddeshah leshum ishut tzericha hemennu get leshum yavmut en tzericha hemennu get vachachamim omrim ben shekkiddeshah leshum ishut bin shekkiddeshah leshum yavmut tzericha hemennu get
Amar rav yosef may tama derabbi asauha keoder benichse hagger uchsavur shello hen dela kane
Amar leh abbaye mi dame hatam la ka mechaven lemikne hacha ka mechaven lemikne ha la damya ella leoder benichse ger ze uchsavur shel ger acher hu dekane

Ella amar abbaye hacha bemay askinan kegon daamar lah hitkaddeshi li bemaamar yevamin rabbi savar maamar ilave zika ka rame vaatay chalitza afkatah lezikah verabbanan savri hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae meikara ilu amar lah hitkaddeshi li bemaamar yevamin mi la mahane hashta name mahane
Rava amar i deamar lah bemaamar yevamin kulle alma la peligi demahneya vehacha bemay askinan kegon deamar lah hitkaddeshi li bezikat yevamin rabbi savar

a: Yesh zika vaatay chalitza afkatah lezika verabbanan savri en zika meikara ilu amar lah hitkaddeshi li bezikat yevamin mi la mahane hashta name mahane

Rav sherevya amar bachalitza keshera i deamar lah hitkaddeshi li bezikat yevamin kulle alma la peligi dela mahane vehacha bachalitza pesula kamipalgi mar savar chalitza pesula poteret umar savar chalitza pesula enah poteret
Rav ashe amar dechulle alma chalitza pesula enah poteret vehacha beyesh tenay bachalitza kamipalgi mar savar yesh tenay bachalitza umar savar en tenay bachalitza
Ravina amar dechulle alma yesh tenay bachalitza vehacha bitnay kaful kamipalgi mar savar baenan tenay kaful umar savar la baenan tenay kaful
Chaletz veasa maamar venatan get uvaal vechu venitne name en achar bia kelum abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu tane en achar bia kelum vetanna didan hattarat yevama lashshuk adifa leh
Echad yevama achat echad shette yevamot matnitin dela keven azzay detanya ben azzay omer yesh maamar achar maamar bishne yevamin vivama achat veen maamar achar maamar bishte yevamot veyavam echad
Ketzad maamar lazo vechu lema mesayya leh lishmuel deamar shemuel chalatz levaalat maamar lo niftera tzaratah
Utuvta derav yosef mi katane choletz chalatz katane diavad
Get lazo veget lazo ku lema mesayya leh lerabba bar rav huna deamar rabba bar rav huna chalitza pesula tzericha lechazzer al kol haachin may tzerichot tzerichot dealma
Get lazo vechalatz lezo lema mesayya leh lishmuel vetihve teuvta derav yosef mi katane choletz chalatz katane diavad
Chalatz vechalatz o chalatz vechu velitne name en achar bia kelum abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu tane en achar bia kelum vetanna didan hattarat yevama lashshuk adifa leh
Ben yavam echad lishte yevamot ku bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar kulleh beta belav kae itzterich leashmoinan deen kiddushin tofsin bechayyave lavin
Ella leresh lakish deamar kulleh beta becharet kae itzterich leashmoinan deen kiddushin tofsin bechayyave karetot
Amar lach resh lakish velitamach sefa dekatane baal veasa maamar itzterich leashmoinan deen kiddushin tofsin beeshet ish
Ella ayede ditna hattarat yavam echad vivama achat tena name shette yevamot veyavam echad veayede ditna shette yevamot veyavam echad tena name shette yevamin vivama achat
b: Chalatz veasa maamar venatan vechu bishlama chalatz veasa maamar itzterich salka datach amena nigzor maamar devatar chalitza attu maamar dekamme chalitza ka mashma lan dela gazrinan ella chalatz venatan get lema li

Ultamach ema sefa baal veasa maamar baal venatan get bishlama baal venatan get itzterich salka datach amena nigzor get devatar beila attu get dekamme beila ka mashma lan dela gazrinan aval baal veasa maamar lema li
Ella ayede ditna chalatz veasa maamar tena name baal veasa maamar veayede devae lemitne baal venatan get tena name chalatz venatan get

Bizman shehi vechu matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya abba yose ben yochanan ish yerushalayim omer mishshum rabbi meir achat beila veachat chalitza battechilla en achareha kelum baemtza uvassof yesh achareha kelum
Veshalosh machlokot baddavar tanna kamma savar bia deika lemigzar gazrinan chalitza deleka lemigzar la gazrinan

Verabbi nechemya savar bia name leka lemigzar udkaamratte ligzor bia achar hagget mishshum bia achar chalitza kevan dachalitza deorayeta mida yadi udkaamratte ligzor bia achar maamar mishshum bia achar bia kevan devia deorayeta ha mida yedii veabba yose ben chanan savar lah kerabbanan degazri bevia vegazar chalitza mishshum bia
Hadaran alach rabban gamliel

Habba al yevimto ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon afilu hu shogeg vehi mezida hu mezid vehi shogeget hu anus vehi lo anusa hi anusa vehu lo anus echad hamare veechad haggomer kana velo chilek ben bia levia

Vechen habba al achat mikkol haaraot shebbattora o pesulot kegon almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot mamzeret untina leyisrael bat yisrael lemamzer ulnatin pesalah velo chilek ben bia levia
Gema may afilu

La mibaya kaamar la mibaya hu shogeg vehi kamikkavvena lemitzva i name hu mezid vehi kamikkavvena lemitzva ella afilu hu shogeg vehi mezida detarvayehu la kamikkavveni leshem mitzva afilu hachi kana tane rabbi chiyya afilu shenehem shoggim shenehem mezidim shenehem anusim
Anus dematnitin hechi dame ilema kesheanasuhu goyim uva aleha vehaamar rava en ones leerva lefi sheen kishuy ella ledaat
Ella beyashen vehaamar rav yehuda

a: Yashen lo kana bivimto ella benitka veha amar rabba nafal min haggag venitka chayyav bearbaa devarim uvivimto lo kana
Ella kegon shennitkaven leishto utkafattu yevimto uva aleha shenehem anusim deve rabbi chiyya hechi dame kegon shennitkaven leishto utkafuhu goyim vedibbekum ze baze uva aleha
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan yevamah yavo aleha mitzva davar acher yevamah yavo aleha ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon
Veha appekteh lemitzva lemitzva mivveim lo yachpotz haish nafka ha chafetz yibbem vechi ata kera ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon
Tanya idach yevamah yavo aleha kedarkah ulkachah shello kedarkah veyibbem bia gomeret bah veen kesef ushtar gomrin bah veyibbemah beal korchah davar acher yevamah yavo aleha ben beshogeg ku
Veha appekteh lichdarkah hahu millehakim leachiv shem nafka bemakom shemmekim shem vechi ata kera ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon
Gufa amar rav yehuda yashen lo kana bivimto deamar kera yevamah yavo aleha ad dimchaven lah leshem bia vehatanya ben er ben yashen ema ben era ben yeshena

Vehatanya ben er hu ben yashen hu ben era hi ben yeshena hi hacha bemay askinan bemitnamnem hechi dame mitnamnem amar rav ashe nim vela nim tir vela tir kegon dekaru leh veane vela yada leahdore sevara vechi madkeru leh middechar
Gufa amar rabba nafal min haggag venitka chayyav bearbaa devarim uvivimto lo kana benezek betzaar beshevet berippuy aval boshet la michayyav deamar mar en chayyav al habboshet ad sheyyitkaven
Amar rava nitkaven lehatiach bakkotel vehetiach bivimto lo kana lehatiach bivhema vehetiach bivama kana deha kamchaven leshem bia beolam
Echad hamare amar ulla minnayin lehaaraa min hattora shenneemar veish asher yishkav et ishsha dava vegilla et ervatah et mekorah heera mikkan lehaaraa min hattora
Ashkechan nidda shear araot minnayin vechi tema nelaf minnidda ma lenidda shekken metammea et boalah
Ella atya meeshet ach dichtiv veish asher yikkach et eshet achiv nidda hi vechi eshet achiv leolam nidda hi ella kenidda ma nidda behaaraa af eshet ach behaaraa
Ma leeshet ach shekken beyado lerabbot dei bae mekaddesh veazel ki alpa
Ella atya meachot av vaachot em dichtiv veervat achot immecha vaachot avicha lo tegalle ki et sheero heera ika lemifrach ma laachot av vaachot em shekken isur habba meelav
Mechada la atya tete chada mittarte mehe tete tete meeshet ach vaachot av vaachot em ma lehanach shekken asurin mishshum sheer
Ella tete minnidda vaachot av vaachot em ma lehanach shekken isur habba meelav ella tete minnidda veeshet ach demay parchatte
Matkef lah rav acha bereh derav ika ma lenidda veeshet ach shekken en lahem heter bechayye osran tomar beeshet ish shekken yesh lah heter bechayye osrah
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina attu nidda veeshet ach bechayye osran hu deen lahem heter aval leachar mikkan yesh lahem heter nidda
b: Beome talya milta eshet ach bevanim tela rachamana
Ella parech hachi ma lenidda veeshet ach shekken en osran mattiran tomar beeshet ish sheosrah mattirah

Ella amar rabbi yona veitema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar kera ki kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot haelle venichretu hannefashot haosot hukkeshu kol haaraot kullan lenidda ma nidda behaaraa af kol behaaraa
Veella nidda dichtiva gabbe eshet ach lema li lechidrav huna deamar rav huna remez livama min hattora minnayin minnayin ha ketiv yevamah yavo aleha ella remez livama sheasura bechayye balah minnayin
Hay sevara hi middeamar rachamana leachar mitat balah sharya mikkelal divchayye balah asura
Vedilma leachar mitat balah mitzva bechayye balah reshut i name leachar mitat balah in bechayye balah la velav habba mikkelal ase ase

Amar kera veish asher yikkach et eshet achiv nidda hi vechi eshet achiv nidda hi ella kenidda ma nidda af al pi sheyyesh lah heter leachar mikkan bishat isurah becharet af eshet ach name af al pi sheyyesh lah heter leachar mikkan bechayye balah becharet
Ella haaraa dichtiva gabbe achot av vaachot em lema li
Lichdiva mineh ravina merava hamare bizchur mahu bizchur mishkeve ishsha ketiva
Ella hamare bivhema mahu amar leh im eno inyan lehaaraa dichtiva gabbe achot av vaachot em deatya behekkesha midderabbi yona tenehu inyan lehaaraa divhema
Mikkede behema chayyave mitot bet din hi may tama ketiv lehaaraa didah gabbe chayyave karetot lichtov gabbe mitat bet din venelaf mitat bet din mimmitat bet din
Ayede dechulleh kera lidrasha ate ketiv beh name ha milta lidrasha
May derasha detanya ervat achot avicha lo tegalle ben min haav ben min haem atta omer ben min haav ben min haem o eno ella min haav velo min haem
Vedin hu chayyav kan vechayyav baachoto ma achoto ben min haav ben min haem af kan ben min haav ben min haem
O kelach lederech zo chayyav kan vechayyav bedodato ma dodato min haav velo min haem af kan min haav velo min haem
Nire lemi dome danin isur habba meelav meisur habba meelav veal tochiach dodato sheen isur habba meelav
O kelach lederech ze danin kerove haav mikkerove haav veal tochiach achoto shekkerove atzmo
Talmud lomar ervat achot avicha lo tegalle ben min haav ben min haem ervat achot immecha lo tegalle ben min haav ben min haem
Lema li lemichtav baachot av lema li lemichtav baachot em amar rabbi avahu tzerichi dei ketav rachamana baachot av shekken yesh lah chayis aval achot em ema la
Vei ketav rachamana baachot em shekken vaddait aval achot av ema la tzericha
Vedodato difshita leh letanna demin haav velo min haem mena leh
Amar rava atya dodo dodo ketiv hacha ervat dodo gilla uchtiv hatam o dodo o ven dodo yigalennu ma lehallan min haav velo min haem af kan min haav velo min haem
Vehatam menalan amar kera mimmishpachto yigalennu mishpachat av keruya mishpacha mishpachat em enah keruya mishpacha
Vehaditnan amru lo meta ishtecha venasa achotah meaviha meta venasa achotah meimmah meta venasa achotah meaviha meta venasa achotah meimmah
Muttar barishona uvashshelishit uvachamishit ufotrot tzarotehen veasur bashsheniyya uvarviit veen biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah
Veim ba al hashsheniyya leachar mitat harishona muttar bashsheniyya uvarviit ufotrot tzarotehen veasur bashshelishit uvachamishit

a: Alma achot ishto ben min haav ben min haem asurot menalan yalef meachoto ma achoto ben min haav ben min haem af kan ben min haav ben min haem
Velelaf middodato ma dodato min haav velo min haem af kan min haav velo min haem mistabbera meachoto hava leh lemelaf shekken kerove atzmo mikkerove atzmo
Adderabba middodato hava leh lemelaf shekken davar al yede kiddushin middavar sheal yede kiddushin ella meeshet ach yalfinan deshekken davar al yede kiddushin ukrove atzmo
Veeshet ach gufah mena lan detanya ervat eshet achicha lo tegalle ben min haav ben min haem
Atta omer ben min haav ben min haem o eno ella min haav velo min haem vedin hu chayyav kan vechayyav baachoto ma achoto ben min haav ben min haem af kan ben min haav ben min haem
O kelach lederech zo chayyav kan vechayyav bedodato ma dodato min haav velo min haem af kan min haav velo min haem

Nire lemi dome danin kerove atzmo mikkerove atzmo veal tochiach dodato shekkerove haav o kelach lederech zo danin davar sheal yede kiddushin middavar sheal yede kiddushin veal tochiach achoto sheisur habba meelav
Talmud lomar ervat achicha hi ben min haav ben min haem
Veema ide veide beeshet ach min haav chada deyesh lah banim bechayye balah vachada deen lah banim bechayye balah en lah banim bechayye balah midderav huna nafka
Veema ide veide beeshet ach min haav chada deyesh lah banim bechayye balah vachada deyesh lah banim leachar mitat balah
Yesh lah banim leachar mitat balah la tzericha kera middeamar rachamana sheen lah banim mutteret ha yesh lah banim asura
Vedilma en lah banim asura lealma vesharya leyavam yesh lah banim sharya lealma vesharya leyavam i name en lah banim mitzva yesh lah banim reshut
I name en lah banim in yesh lah banim la velav habba mikkelal ase ase
Ketav kera acharina ervat achiv gilla
Veema eshet ach min haem keeshet ach min haav ma eshet ach min haav leachar mitat balah sharya af eshet ach min haem leachar mitat balah sharya amar kera hi bahavayatah tehe
Achoto dichtav bah karet lema li
Lechidrabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan sheim asaan kullam behelem achat chayyav al kol achat veachat
Ulrabbi yitzchak deamar kol chayyave karetot bakkelal hau velamma yatzta karet baachoto leduno becharet velo bemalkot lechallek menalan
Nafka leh mivveel ishsha beniddat tumatah lechayyev al kol ishsha veishsha
Dodato dichtav bah rachamana aririm yihu lema li lechidrabba derabba rame ketiv aririm yihu uchtiv aririm yamutu ha ketzad yesh lo banim kovran en lo banim holech ariri

Veitzterich lemichtav aririm yihu veitzterich lemichtav aririm yamutu dei ketav rachamana aririm yihu hava amena ad chiteh aval mechiteh veelach la ketav rachamana aririm yamutu vei ketav rachamana aririm yamutu hava amena mechiteh veelach aval meikara la tzericha
Haaraa dechayyave lavin menalan
Middegalli rachamana shichvat zera gabbe shifcha charufa mikkelal dechayyave lavin behaaraa
Adderabba middegalli rachamana haaraa bechayyave karetot mikkelal dechayyave lavin bigmar bia amar rav ashe im ken lishtok kera mishshifcha charufa
Haaraa dechayyave lavin dichhunna menalan atya kicha kicha
Dechayyave ase menalan
b: Atya bia bia
Yevama lashshuk menalan i leman deamar lav lav i leman deamar ase ase
Ella yevama leyavam menalan atya bia bia
Ishsha levalah menalan atya kicha kicha
Amar rava lema li dichtav rachamana shichvat zera beshifcha charufa shichvat zera beeshet ish shichvat zera besota
Deshifcha charufa kedaamaran deeshet ish perat limshammesh met

Hanicha leman deamar meshammesh met baaraot patur ella leman deamar chayyav may ika lememar ella perat limshammesh meta desalka datach amena hoil leachar mita name ikray sheero ema lichayyav alah beeshet ish ka mashma lan
Desota lema li lechidtanya shichvat zara perat ledavar acher may davar acher amar rav sheshet perat leshekkine lah shello kedarkah amar leh rava mishkeve ishsha ketiv
Ella amar rava perat leshekkine lah derech evarim amar leh abbaye peritzuta asar rachamana
Ella amar abbaye perat leshekkine lah binshika hanicha leman deamar haaraa zo hachnasat atara ella leman deamar zo neshika may ika lememar
Ella leolam leshekkine lah derech evarim veitzterich salka datach amena bikfeda devaal tela rachamana veha ka kafed ka mashma lan
Amar shemuel haaraa zo neshika mashal leadam shemmanniach etzbao al piv i efshar shello yidchok habbasar
Ki ata rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan gemar bia beshifcha charufa zo hachnasat atara metiv rav sheshet shichvat zera eno chayyav ella al biat hammeruk may lav meruk gid la meruk atara
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan haaraa zo hachnasat atara amaru leh veha rabba bar bar chana la amar hachi amar lehu o ihu shakray o ana shakray
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan haaraa zo hachnasat atara adderabba bar bar chana vadday pelig addishmuel mi lema pelig
Lo minneshika vead hachnasat atara haaraa kare lah
Ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan haaraa zo hachnasat atara gemar bia gemar bia mammash

a: Mikkan veelach eno ella neshika ufatur aleha uflig addishmuel
Echad hamare veechad haggomer kana may kana rav amar kana lakkol ushmuel amar lo kana ella lidvarim haamurim bapparasha lirash benichse echav ulfotrah min hayyibum
Min hannissuin ledivre hakkol achla deha havat kaachla meikara ki peligi min haerusin rav amar ochelet deha rabbi rachamana biat shogeg kemezid
Ushmuel amar ki rabbi rachamana leokmeh bimkom baal leallome mibbaal la
Veazda shemuel letameh deamar rav nachman amar shemuel kol shehabbaal maachil yavam maachil vechol sheen habbaal maachil yavam eno maachil
Metivi bat yisrael pikkachat shennitarsa lechohen pikkeach velo hispik lechonsah ad shennitcharesh enah ochelet met venafla lifne yavam cheresh ochelet uvazo yafe koach hayyavam mikkoach habbaal
Bishlama lerav nicha ella lishmuel kashya
Amar lecha shemuel ema hachi velo hispik lechonsah ad shennitcharesh enah ochelet bitruma kanas veachar kach nitcharesh ochelet met venafla lifne yavam cheresh ochelet
Umay bazo deilu baal cheresh meikara lo ochelet veilu yavam cheresh meikara achla
Veika deamri min haerusin divre hakkol la achla deha la achla bechayye vaal
Ki peligi min hannissuin rav amar ochelet deha havat achla meikara ushmuel amar enah ochelet ki rabbi rachamana biat shogeg kemezid lidvarim haamurim bapparasha aval lechol mile la
Vehaamar rav nachman amar shemuel kol shehabbaal maachil yavam maachil ema kol bia shehabbaal maachil bah yavam maachil bah vechol bia sheen habbaal maachil bah en hayyavam maachil bah

Metivi bat yisrael pikkachat shennitarsa lechohen pikkeach velo hispik lechonsah ad shennitcharesh enah ochelet met venafla lifne yavam cheresh ochelet uvazo yafe koach yavam mikkoach baal bishlama lerav metaretz kidtaretz meikara ella lishmuel kashya kashya

Tanu rabbanan bat yisrael pikkachat shennitarsa lechohen pikkeach velo hispik lechonsah ad shennitcharesh enah ochelet nolad lah ben ochelet met habben rabbi natan omer ochelet vachachamim omrim enah ochelet

May tama derabbi natan amar rabba hoil shekkevar achla amar leh abbaye ella meatta bat yisrael shenniset lechohen umit leh techol shekkevar achla ella kevan demit leh pekaa leh kedushteh minah hacha name kevan demit leh pekaa kedushteh minah
Ella amar rav yosef kasavar rabbi natan nissue cheresh maachilin bitruma vela gazrinan nissue cheresh attu kiddushe cheresh amar leh abbaye i hachi nolad lah ben lema li mishshum rabbanan
Veliflog rabbi natan alayehu beresha shavek lehu lerabbanan ad dimsayemi miltayehu vahadar pelig alayehu i hachi litne met habben enah ochelet rabbi natan omer ochelet kashya
Vechen habba al achat mikkol haaraot amar rav amram ha milleta amar lan rav sheshet
b: Veanharinhu leayenin mimmatnitin eshet yisrael shenneensa af al pi shemmutteret levalah pesula lichhunna vetanna tuna vechen habba al achat mikkol haaraot haamurot betora o pesulot
May vechen may lav la shena beshogeg vela shena bemezid vela shena beones vela shena beratzon vekatane pesalah
La may vechen ahaaraa haaraa deman ilema daaraot lememra daaraot yalfinan miyevama adderabba yevama yalfinan mearaot deikar haaraa baaraot ketiv
Ella may vechen ashshello kedarkah daaraot adderabba ikar mishkeve ishsha baaraot ketiv
Ella may vechen ashshello kedarkah dechayyave lavin
Amar rava eshet kohen shenneensa balah loke aleha mishshum zona mishshum zona in mishshum tuma la ema af mishshum zona
Metiv rabbi zera vehi lo nitpasa asura ha nitpasa mutteret veyesh lecha acheret sheaf al pi shennitpasa asura vee zo zo eshet kohen
Velav habba mikkelal ase ase
Amar rabba hakkol hau bichlal zona keshepparat lecha hakkatuv gabbe eshet yisrael vehi lo nitpasa asura ha nitpasa mutteret mikkelal deeshet kohen kidkayema kayema
Veika deamri amar rabba eshet kohen shenneensa balah loke aleha mishshum tuma mishshum tuma in mishshum zona la alma beones la karena bah zona
Metiv rabbi zera vehi lo nitpasa asura ha nitpasa mutteret veyesh lecha acheret sheaf al pi shennitpasa asura veezo zo eshet kohen velav habba mikkelal ase ase
Amar rava hakkol hau bichlal achare asher huttammaa keshepparat lecha hakkatuv gabbe eshet yisrael vehi lo nitpasa asura ha nitpasa mutteret mikkelal deeshet kohen kidkayema kayema
Matni almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot min haerusin lo yochlu bitruma rabbi elazar verabbi shimon machshirin
Nitarmelu o nitgarshu min hannissuin pesulot min haerusin kesherot
Gema tanya amar rabbi meir kal vachomer uma kiddushe reshut en maachilin kiddushe avera lo kol shekken
Amru lo lo im amarta bekidushe reshut shekken en lo lehaachil bemakom acher tomar bekiddushe avera shekken yesh lo lehaachil bemakom acher
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya petzua dakka kohen shekkiddesh bat yisrael banu lemachloket rabbi meir verabbi elazar verabbi shimon
Lerabbi meir deamar mishtammeret levia pesula deorayeta la achla ha name la achla lerabbi elazar verabbi shimon deamri mishtammeret levia pesula deorayeta achla

a: Ha name achla mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamri rabbi elazar verabbi shimon hatam ella deyesh lo lehaachil bemakom acher aval hacha deen lo lehaachil bemakom acher la
Vechi tema hacha name yesh lo lehaachil bevat gerim veha mibaya bea lah rabbi yochanan merabbi oshaya vela peshat leh
Itmar abbaye amar hoil umaachilah belo yedaah
Rava amar hoil umaachilah baavadav veshifchotav hakkenaanim
Abbaye la amar kerava kinyan deishut mikkinyan deishut yalfinan vela yalfinan kinyan deishut mikkinyan daavadim

Verava la amar keabbayye shane hatam shekkevar achla veabbaye shekkevar achla la amrinan dei la tema hachi bat yisrael shenniset lechohen umit techol shekkevar achla verava hatam paka kinyaneh hacha la paka kinyaneh

Gufa bea mineh rabbi yochanan merabbi oshaya petzua dakka kohen shennasa bat gerim mahu sheyyaachilenna bitruma ishtik vela amar leh vela mide lesof ata gavra rabba acharina uva mineh milta achrita ufshat leh umannu resh lakish amar leh rabbi yehuda nesia lerabbi oshaya attu rabbi yochanan lav gavra rabba hu amar leh dekavae minay milta delet lah patri
Leman i lerabbi yehuda ben bikdushteh kae ben lav bikdushteh kae la achla i bikdushteh kae la achla deha amar mar bat ger zachar kevat chalal zachar
I lav bikdushteh kae la achla deha amrinan kehal gerim ikri kahal

Vei lerabbi yose ben bikdushteh kae ben lav bikdushteh kae achla bikdushteh kae achla deha amar af ger shennasa giyyoret bitto keshera lichhunna i lav bikdushteh kae achla deha amar kehal gerim la ikri kahal
Ella alliba dehay tanna ditnan rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer ishsha bat gerim lo tinnase lichhunna ad shettehe immah miyyisrael
Vehachi kamibaya leh kashrut mitosfa bah veachla o dilma kedushsha mitosfa bah vela achla

Ta shema ki ata rabbi acha bar chinana middaroma ata veayeti matnita bideh minnayin liftzua dakka kohen shennasa bat gerim shemmaachilah bitruma shenneemar vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo vego yochal bo

Leman ilema lerabbi yehuda haamar ben bikdushteh kae ben lav bikdushteh kae la achla vei lerabbi yose lema li kera haamar ben bikdushteh kae ben lav bikdushteh kae achla ella lav lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov ushma minah kashrut itosafa bah veachla shema minah
Itmar rav amar
b: Yesh chuppa lifsulot ushmuel amar en chuppa lifsulot
Amar shemuel umode li abba betinoket pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad hoil veen lah bia en lah chuppa
Amar rava af anan name tenena bat shalosh shanim veom echad mitkaddeshet bevia veim ba aleha yavam kenaah vechayyavin aleha mishshum eshet ish umtammea et boalah letamme mishkav tachton keelon
Nisset lechohen ochelet bitruma ba aleha echad mikkol happesulin pesalah
Bat shalosh shanim veom echad hu demippasla bevia mippasla bechuppa ha pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad dela mippasla bevia la mippasla name bechuppa shema minah
Amar rame bar chama yesh chuppa lifsulot banu lemachloket rabbi meir verabbi elazar verabbi shimon

a: Lerabbi meir deamar kiddushin pasli chuppa name pasla lerabbi elazar verabbi shimon deamri kiddushin la pasli chuppa name la pasla
Umimmay dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella bekiddushin dekane lah aval chuppa dela kane lah la
I name ad kan la kaamri rabbi elazar verabbi shimon hatam ella bekiddushin dela kerivi levia aval chuppa dikriva levia hachi name defasla
Ella i ika lememar biflugta dehane tannae detanya nisu zo vazo kesherot ufsulot o shennichnesu lechuppa velo nivalu ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma
Nichnesu mikkelal denisu nisu mammash
Ella lav kegon shennichnesu lechuppa velo nivalu vekatane ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma
Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer kol shebbiatah maachilatah chuppatah maachilatah vechol sheen biatah maachilatah en chuppatah maachilatah
Mimmay dilma rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka kerabbi meir sevira leh deamar kiddushin la achla
Hay kol sheen biatah maachilatah en chuppatah maachilatah kol sheen biatah maachilatah en kaspah maachilatah mibe leh dilma ayede deamar tanna kamma chuppa amar ihu name chuppa
Amar rav amram ha milta amar lan rav sheshet veanharinhu leayenin mimmatnitin yesh chuppa lifsulot vetanna tuna amen shello satiti arusa unsua shomeret yavam uchnusa
Hay arusa hechi dame ilema dekanni lah keshehi arusa veka mashke lah keshehi arusa arusa bat mishteya hi veha tenan arusa veshomeret yavam lo shotot velo notlot ketuva

Ella dekanni lah keshehi arusa veistetar vekamashke lah keshehi nesua mi badki lah mayya vehatanya venikka haish meaon bizman shehaish menukke meaon hammayim bodkin et ishto en haish menukke meaon en hammayim bodkin et ishto
Ella dekanni lah keshehi arusa veistetar venichnesa lechuppa velo nivala ushma minah yesh chuppa lifsulot

Amar rava vetisbera deha metaratzta hi veha ki ata rabbi acha bar chanina middaroma ata veayeti matnita bideh mibbalade ishech mi shekkadma shechivat baal labboel velo shekkadma shechivat boel labbaal
Amar rame bar chama mashkachatte lah kegon shebba aleha arusah bevet aviha
Dichotah gabbe shomeret yavam shebba aleha yavam bevet chamiha
b: Shomeret yavam karet lah ishto mealleya hi deha amar rav kana lakkol kishmuel deamar lo kana ella lidvarim haamurim bapparasha
Mide hu tama ella lerav ha amar rav kana lakkol hacha bemay askinan kegon daavad bah maamar uvet shammay hi deamri maamar kone kinyan gamur
I hachi hayenu arusa ultamach nesua uchnusa lav chada milta hi ella nesua dideh uchnusa dechavreh hacha name arusa dideh veshomeret yavam dechavreh
Rav pappa amar hay tanna hu detanya en mekannin lah laarusa lehashkotah keshehi arusa aval mekannin otah lehashkotah keshehi nesua
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar al yede gilgul
Shelach rav chanina mishshemeh derabbi yochanan haose maamar bivimto veyesh lo ach afilu hu kohen vehi kohenet pesalah min hatteruma

Leman ilema lerabbi meir emar deamar rabbi meir mishtammeret levia pesula la achla middeorayeta derabbanan mi amar veella lerabbi elazar verabbi shimon hashta mishtammeret levia pesula deorayeta achla derabbanan mibaya

Ella ki ata ravin amar asa bah maamar bivimto divre hakkol achla yesh lo ach chalal divre hakkol enah ochelet lo nechleku ella shennatan lah get rabbi yochanan amar ochelet resh lakish amar enah ochelet
Rabbi yochanan amar ochelet afilu lerabbi meir deamar enah ochelet hane mile mishtammeret levia pesula deorayeta aval derabbanan achla
Veresh lakish amar enah ochelet afilu lerabbi elazar verabbi shimon deamri ochelet hane mile deyesh lo lehaachil bemakom acher aval hacha kevan deen lo lehaachil bemakom acher la
Vechi tema hacha name yesh lo lehaachilah bechozeret chozeret paska mineh ukrova leve nasha aval ha agida beh
Nitarmelu o nitgarshu vechu bea mineh rabbi chiyya bar yosef mishshemuel kohen gadol shekkiddesh et hakketanna uvagra tachtav

a: Mahu batar nisuin azlinan o batar erusin azlinan
Amar leh tenetuha nitarmelu o nitgarshu min hannissuin pesulot min haerusin kesherot
Amar leh leshauoyeh chalala la kamibaya li devia hi dimshavveya chalala ki kamibaya li vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach may kicha dekiddushin baenan o kicha denisuin baenan
Amar leh ha name tenetuha eras et haalmana venitmanna lihot kohen gadol yichnos shane hatam dichtiv yikkach ishsha
Hacha name ketiv ishsha achat velo shettayim
Uma raita ha ishtanni gufah veha la ishtanni gufah
Matni kohen gadol lo yissa almana ben almana min haerusin ben almana min hannisuin velo yissa et habbogeret rabbi elazar verabbi shimon machshirin bevogeret velo yissa et mukkat etz
Gema tanu rabbanan almana lo yikkach ben almana min haerusin ben almana min hannisuin peshita mahu detema lelaf almana almana mittamar ma lehallan min hannisuin af kan min hannisuin ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name dumya digrusha ma gerusha ben min hannisuin ben min haerusin af almana ben min haerusin ben min hannisuin
Velo yissa et habbogeret tanu rabbanan vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach perat labbogeret shekkalu lah betuleha divre rabbi meir rabbi elazar verabbi shimon machshirin bevogeret
Bemay ka mipalgi rabbi meir savar betula afilu miktzat betulim mashma betuleha ad deika kol habbetulim bivtuleha bichdarkah in shello kedarkah la
Verabbi elazar verabbi shimon savri betula betula shelema mashma betuleha vaafilu miktzat betulim bivtuleha ad sheyyihu kol betuleha kayyamin ben bichdarkah ben shello kedarkah
Amar rav yehuda amar rav nivala shello kedarkah pesula lakkehunna metiv rava velo tihye leishsha beishsha haruya lo perat lealmana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot
Hechi dame illema bichdarkah may irya mishshum almana tipok leh mishshum dehaveya lah beula ella lav shello kedarkah umishshum almana in mishshum beula la
b: Ha manni rabbi meir hi verav deamar kerabbi elazar
I kerabbi elazar may irya mishshum beula tipok leh dehaveya lah zona deha amar rabbi elazar panuy habba al happenuya shello leshem ishut asaah zona
Amar rav yosef kegon shennivala livhema dehatam mishshum beula ika mishshum zona leka

Amar leh abbaye mimma nafshach i beula haveya zona name haveya vei zona la haveya beula name la haveya vechi tema mide dehave amukkat etz shello kedarkah im ken en lecha ishsha shekkeshera lakkehunna shello naaset mukkat etz al yede tzeror
Ella amar rabbi zera bimmaenet
Amar rav shimi bar chiyya nivala livhema keshera lakkehunna tanya name hachi nivala lemi sheeno ish af al pi shebbiskila keshera lakkehunna

Ki ata rav dimi amar maase beriva achat behayetalo shehayeta mechabbedet et habbayit urvaah kelev kufri meachareha vehichshirah rabbi lakkehunna amar shemuel ulchohen gadol bime rabbi kohen gadol mi hava ella reuya lechohen gadol
Amar leh rava mipparzakya lerav ashe mena ha milta daamur rabbanan en zenut livhema dichtiv lo tavi etnan zona umchir kelev
Utnan etnan kelev umchir zona muttarin mishshum shenneemar gam shenehem shenayim velo arbaa
Tanu rabbanan anusat atzmo umfuttat atzmo lo yissa veim nasa nasuy anusat chavero umfuttat chavero lo yissa veim nasa rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer havalad chalal vachachamim omrim havalad kasher
Im nasa nasuy amar rav huna amar rav umotzi beget veella ha dekatane im nasa nasuy amar rav acha bar yaakov lomar

a: Sheen meshallem kenas bimfutta
Azal rav geviha mibbe chatil amrah lishmata kammeh derav ashe amar leh veha rav verabbi yochanan deamri tarvayehu bogeret umukkat etz lo yissa veim nasa nasuy
Alma sofah lihot bogeret tachtav sofah lihot mukkat etz tachtav hacha name sofah lihot beula tachtav kashya

Anusat chavero umfuttat chavero lo yissa veim nasa rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer havalad chalal vachachamim omrim havalad kasher amar rav huna amar rav halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov vechen amar rav gidel amar rav halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov
Ika deamri amar rav huna amar rav may tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar lah kerabbi elazar
Umi savar lah kevateh veha kayema lan mishnat rabbi eliezer ben yaakov kav venaki veilu beha amar rav amram amar rav en halacha kerabbi elazar kashya
Rav ashe amar beyesh chalal mechayyave ase kamipalgi rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar yesh chalal mechayyave ase verabbanan savri en chalal mechayyave ase
May tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov dichtiv almana ugrusha vachalala zona et elle lo yikkach ki im betula vego uchtiv velo yechallel zaro beammav akkullehu
Verabbanan elle hifsik hainyan verabbi eliezer ben yaakov amar elle lemaote nidda
Keman azla ha detanya meelle atta ose chalal vei atta ose chalal minnidda keman kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbi eliezer ben yaakov nichteveh leelle levassof kashya

Tanu rabbanan achoto arusa rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim mittamme lah rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim en mittamme lah anusa umfutta divre hakkol en mittamme lah umukkat etz en mittamme lah divre rabbi shimon shehaya rabbi shimon omer reuya lechohen gadol mittamme lah sheen reuya lechohen gadol en mittamme lah
Uvogeret mittamme lah divre kol adam
May tama derabbi meir verabbi yehuda dedarshi hachi velaachoto habbetula perat laanusa umfutta
Yachol sheani motzi af mukkat etz talmud lomar asher lo hayeta leish mi shehavayatah al yede ish yatza zo sheen havayatah al yede ish hakkerova lerabbot haarusa elav lerabbot habbogeret
Ha lema li kera vehaamar rabbi meir betula afilu miktzat betula mashma itzterich salka datach amena nelaf betula betula mehatam ma lehallan naara af kan name naara ka mashma lan

Verabbi yose verabbi shimon may tamayehu darshi hachi velaachoto habbetula perat laanusa umfutta umukkat etz asher lo hayeta perat laarusa hakkerova lerabbot arusa shennitgarsha elav lerabbot et habbogeret hakkerova lerabbot arusa shennitgarsha
b: Veha amar rabbi shimon reuya lechohen gadol mittamme lah sheen reuya lechohen gadol en mittamme lah shane hatam derabbi rachamana kerova
I hachi mukkat etz name rabbi kerova achat velo shettayim uma raita ha itavid bah maase ha la itavid bah maase
Verabbi yose middeshavkeh levar zugeh mikkelal divmukkat etz kerabbi meir sevira leh mena leh millo hayeta leish
Veha appekteh chad millo hayeta vechad milleish
Elav lerabbot habbogeret veha amar rabbi shimon betula betula shelema mashma tama dideh name hatam mehacha dedaresh hachi middeelav lerabbot habbogeret michlal divtula betula shelema mashma

Tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer giyyoret pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad keshera lakkehunna shenneemar vechol hattaf bannashim asher lo yadu mishkav zachar hachau lachem vahare pinchas immahem
Verabbanan laavadim velishfachot i hachi bat shalosh shanim veom echad name

Kidrav huna derav huna rame ketiv kol ishsha yodaat ish lemishkav zachar harogu ha enah yodaat kayyemu mikkelal dehattaf ben yadu ben lo yadu kayyemu uchtiv vechol hattaf bannashim asher lo yadu mishkav zachar hachau lachem ha yadi harogu
Heve omer biruya libael hakkatuv medabber

Tanya name hachi vechol ishsha yodaat ish biruya libael hakkatuv medabber atta omer biruya libael o eno ella nivala mammash keshehu omer vechol hattaf bannashim asher lo yadu mishkav zachar heve omer biruya libael hakkatuv medabber

Mena yadi amar rav huna bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida heevirum lifne hatztzitz kol sheppaneha morikot beyadua shehi reuya libael kol sheen paneha morikot beyadua sheenah reuya libael amar rav nachman siman laavera hidrokan

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer vayyimtzeu miyyoshve yavesh gilad arba meot naara vetula asher lo yadu ish lemishkav zachar mena yadi amar rav kahana hoshivum al pi chavit shel yayin beula rechah nodef betula en rechah nodef

Unabberinhu lifne tzitz amar rav kahana bereh derav natan leratzon lahem ketiv leratzon velo lefuranut i hachi bemidyan name amar rav ashe lahem ketiv lahem leratzon velo lefuranut ulgoyim afilu lefuranut
Amar rabbi yaakov bar idi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha kerabbi shimon ben yochay amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi yaakov bar idi beferush shemia lach o mikkelala shemia lach

May kelala deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi ir achat hayeta beeretz yisrael shekkara aleha arar veshigger rabbi et rabbi romanus uvdakah umatza bah bat giyyoret pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad vehichshirah rabbi lakkehunna amar leh beferush shemia li
Vei mikkelala may dilma shane hatam hoil veinnesiv innesiv deha rav verabbi yochanan deamri tarvayehu bogeret umukkat etz lo yissa veim nasa nasuy
Hachi hashta bishlama hatam sofah lihot bogeret tachtav sofah lihot beula tachtav hacha sofah lihot zona tachtav
Rav safra matne lah mikkelala vekashya leh umshanne leh hachi

Hahu kahana deinnesiv giyyoret pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak may hay amar leh deamar rabbi yaakov bar idi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha kerabbi shimon ben yochay amar leh zil appek vei la mappekna lach rabbi yaakov bar idi meunnach
Tanya vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer

a: Kivre goyim enan metammein beohel shenneemar veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem attem keruyin adam veen haggoyim keruyin adam
Metivi venefesh adam shishsha asar alef mishshum behema
Asher yesh bah harbe mishtem esre ribbo adam asher lo yada ben yemino lismolo uvhema rabba mishshum behema
Kol horeg nefesh vechol nogea bechalal titchatteu dilma iktil chad miyyisrael verabbanan lo nifkad mimmennu ish verabbi shimon ben yochay lo nifkad mimmennu ish laavera
Ravina amar nehi demaatinhu kera meittammoye beohel dichtiv adam ki yamut beohel mimmagga umassa mi maatinhu kera

Matni eras et haalmana venitmanna lihot kohen gadol yichnos umaase bihoshua ben gamla shekkiddesh et marta bat bayettos uminnahu hammelech lihot kohen gadol uchnasah shomeret yavam shennafla lifne kohen hedot venitmanna lihot kohen gadol af al pi sheasa bah maamar hare ze lo yichnos
Gema tanu rabbanan minnayin sheim eras et haalmana venitmanna lihot kohen gadol sheyyichnos talmud lomar yikkach ishsha i hachi shomeret yavam name ishsha velo yevama

Maase bihoshua vechu minnahu in nitmanna la amar rav yosef ketir kachazena hacha deamar rav assi tarkabba dedinare ayyilah leh marta bat bayettos leyannay malka ad demoke leh lihoshua ben gamla bechahane ravreve
Matni kohen gadol shemmet achiv choletz velo meyabem
Gema ka pasek vetane la shena min haerusin vela shena min hannissuin bishlama min hannissuin ase velo taase hu veen ase doche lo taase vaase ella min haerusin yavo ase veyidche et lo taase
Gezera bia rishona attu bia sheniyya

Matni kohen hedot lo yissa ayelonit ella im ken yesh lo ishsha uvanim rabbi yehuda omer af al pi sheyyesh lo ishsha uvanim lo yissa ayelonit shehi zona haamura battora vachachamim omrim en zona ella giyyoret umshuchreret veshennivala beilat zenut

Gema amar leh resh galuta lerav huna may tama mishshum periyya urviyya apperiyya urviyya kohanim hu demippakkedi veyisrael la mippakkedi amar leh mishshum deka bae lemitne sefa rabbi yehuda omer af al pi sheyyesh lo ishsha
b: Veyesh lo banim lo yissa ayelonit shehi zona haamura battora deazzona kohanim hu demippakdi veyisrael la mippakkedi mishshum hachi katane kohen
Amar rav huna may tama derabbi yehuda dichtiv achlu velo yisbau hiznu velo yifrotzu kol bia sheen bah pirtza enah ella beilat zenut

Tanya rabbi eliezer omer kohen lo yissa et hakketanna amar leh rav chisda lerabba pok ayyen bah dilurta bae lah rav huna minach nefak ayyen bah rabbi eliezer savar lah kerabbi meir vesavar lah kerabbi yehuda
Savar lah kerabbi meir dechayesh lemiuta vesavar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar ayelonit zona haveya

Uchrabbi meir mi savar lah vehatanya katan uktanna lo choltzin velo meyabbemin divre rabbi meir amru lo lerabbi meir yafe amarta sheen choltzin ish ketiv bapparasha umakkeshinan ishsha leish ella may tama en meyabbemin
Amar lahem katan shemma yimmatze saris ketanna shemma timmatze ayelonit venimtzeu pogin beerva vetanya ketanna mityabemet veenah choletzet divre rabbi eliezer

Uchrabbi yehuda mi savar lah vehatanya zona zona kishmah divre rabbi eliezer rabbi akiva omer zona zo mufkeret rabbi matya ben charash omer afilu halach balah lehashkotah uva aleha badderech asaah zona
Rabbi yehuda omer zona zo ayelonit vachachamim omrim en zona ella giyyoret umshuchreret veshennivala beilat zenut rabbi elazar omer panuy habba al happenuya shello leshem ishut asaah zona
Ella amar rav adda bar ahava hacha bechohen gadol askinan leemat kane la lechi gadla lechi gadla beula hi
Amar rava mechalle lev i dekaddeshah avuh mehahi shata hu dekane lah vei dekaddisha nafshah ha rabbi eliezer hi vela rabbanan
Ella amar rava leolam bechohen hedot vechayeshinan shemma titpatte alav i hachi yisrael name pittuy ketanna ones hu veones beyisrael mishra shere
Rav pappa amar bechohen gadol vehay tanna hu detanya betula yachol ketanna talmud lomar ishsha i ishsha yachol bogeret talmud lomar betula ha ketzad yatzta mikkelal katnut velichlal bagrut lo bata
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar hay tanna hu detanya betula en betula ella naara vechen hu omer vehannaara tovat mare meod betula
Rabbi elazar omer panuy habba al happenuya shello leshem ishut asaah zona amar rav amram en halacha kerabbi elazar
Matni lo yibbatel adam mipperiyya urviyya ella im ken yesh lo banim bet shammay omrim shene zecharim uvet hillel omrim zachar unkeva shenneemar zachar unkeva beraam

Gema ha yesh lo banim mipperiyya urviyya batel meishsha la batel mesayea leh lerav nachman amar shemuel deamar af al pi sheyyesh lo leadam kamma banim asur laamod belo ishsha shenneemar lo tov heot haadam levaddo

Veika deamri ha yesh lo banim batel mipperiyya urviyya uvatel name meishsha nema tehve teuvta derav nachman amar shemuel la en lo banim nose ishsha bat banim yesh lo banim nose ishsha delav bat banim nafka minah limkor sefer tora bishvil banim

Bet shammay omrim shene zecharim may tamayehu devet shammay yalfinan mimmoshe dichtiv bene moshe gershom veeliezer uvet hillel yalfinan mibberiyyato shel olam uvet shammay lelfe mibberiyyato shel olam en danin efshar

a: Mishshei efshar uvet hillel name lelfu mimmoshe amri lach moshe middateh hu daavad detanya shelosha devarim asa moshe middato vehiskima dato ledaat hammakom perash min haishsha veshiber halluchot vehosif yom echad

Perash min haishsha may derash amar uma yisrael shello dibbera immahem shechina ella lefi shaa vekava lahem zeman amra tora al tiggeshu el ishsha ani shemmeuchad ledibbur bechol shaa veshaa velo kava li zeman al achat kamma vechamma vehiskima dato ledaat hammakom shenneemar lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem veatta po amod immadi
Shiber et halluchot may derash amar uma pesach shehu echad mishshesh meot ushlosh esre mitzot amra tora kol ben nechar lo yochal bo hattora kullah veyisrael meshummadim al achat kamma vechamma
Vehiskima dato ledaat hammakom dichtiv asher shibbarta veamar resh lakish amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe yishar kochacha sheshshibbarta
