Matni haish metzuve al periyya urviyya aval lo haishsha rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer al shenehem hu omer vayevarech otam elohim vayyomer lahem elohim peru urvu
Gema mena hane mile amar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon amar kera umilu et haaretz vechivshuha ish darko lechabbesh veen ishsha darkah lechabbesh
Adderabba vechivshuha tarte mashma amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vechovsheha ketiv rav yosef amar mehacha ani el shadday pere urve vela kaamar peru urvu

Veamar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon keshem shemmitzva al adam lomar davar hannishma kach mitzva al adam shello lomar davar sheeno nishma rabbi abba omer chova shenneemar al tochach letz pen yisnaekka hochach lechacham veyeehavekka
Veamar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon muttar lo laadam leshannot bidvar hashshalom shenneemar avich tziva vego ko tomru leosef anna sa na vego
Rabbi natan omer mitzva shenneemar vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani vego
Deve rabbi yishmael tana gadol hashshalom sheaf hakkadosh baruch hu shina bo demeikara ketiv vaadoni zaken ulvassof ketiv vaani zakanti
Rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer ittemar rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi chad amar halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka vechad amar en halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka
Tistayyam derabbi yochanan hu deamar en halacha ditev rabbi avahu vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi yochanan halacha veahderinhu rabbi amme verabbi assi leappayehu

Veika deamri rabbi chiyya bar abba amar veahderinhu rabbi amme verabbi assi leappayehu amar rav pappa bishlama leman deamar rabbi avahu amrah mishshum kevod be kesar la amru leh vela mide ella leman deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amrah lemru leh la amar rabbi yochanan hachi

May hava alah ta shema deamar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi assi ovada hava kammeh derabbi yochanan bichnishta dekesari vaamar yotzi veyitten ketubba vei salka datach la mefakkeda ketubba may avidtah
Dilma bevaa mechamat taana
Ki hahi daatay lekammeh derabbi amme amara leh hav li ketubba amar lah zil la mipakkedatte amara leh missevu dilah may tehve alah dehach itteta amar ki ha vadday kafenan
Hahi daatay lekammeh derav nachman amar lah la mipakkedatte amara leh la baaya hach itteta chutra lida umara likvura amar ki ha vadday kafenan

Yehuda vechizkiyya teomim hau echad nigmera tzurato lesof tisha veechad nigmera tzurato litchillat shiva yehudit devethu derabbi chiyya hava lah tzaar leda shannay manah vaatay lekammeh derabbi chiyya amara itteta mefakkeda apperiyya urviyya amar lah la azala ishteya samma daakarta
Lesof igallay milta amar lah iko yeladte li chada karsa achrita deamar mar yehuda vechizkiyya ache pazzi vetavi

a: Achota

Vela mipakdi vehaamar rav acha bar rav kattina amar rabbi yitzchak maase beishsha achat shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin vechafu et rabbah vaasaah bat chorin amar rav nachman bar yitzchak minhag hefker nahagu bah
Hadaran alach habba al yevimto
Almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot hichnisa lo avde melog veavde tzon barzel avde melog lo yochlu bitruma avde tzon barzel yochelu

Veellu hen avde melog im metu metu lah veim hotiru hotiru lah af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotan hare ellu lo yochlu bitruma veellu hen avde tzon barzel im metu metu lo veim hotiru hotiru lo hoil vehu chayyav beachrautan hare ellu yochlu bitruma

Bat yisrael shenniset lechohen vehichnisa lo avadim ben avde melog ben avde tzon barzel hare ellu yochlu bitruma uvat kohen shenniset leyisrael vehichnisa lo avadim ben avde melog ben avde tzon barzel hare ellu lo yochlu bitruma

Gema veavde melog lo yochlu bitruma ammay leheve kekinyano shekkana kinyan detanya minnayin lechohen shennasa ishsha vekana avadim sheyyochlu bitruma shenneemar vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo hu yochal bo
Uminnayin leishsha shekkanta avadim vaavadav shekkanu avadim sheyyochlu bitruma shenneemar vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo hu yochal bo kinyano shekkana kinyan ochel
Kol haochel maachil kol sheen ochel eno maachil
Vela vahare arel vechol hattemeim sheenan ochlin umaachilin hatam pummayehu kaev lehu
Vahare mamzer sheen ochel umaachil
Amar ravina kinyan ochel kaamar kinyan ochel maachil sheeno ochel eno maachil
Verava amar middeorayeta mechal achli verabbanan hu degazri behu kede shettomar ani eni ochelet avaday enan ochlin zona hi etzlo hilkach ate leappokah
Rav ashe amar gezera shemma taachil leachar mita
Ella meatta bat yisrael shennisset lechohen lo taachil gezera shemma taachil leachar mita

Ella amar rav ashe bealmana kohenet deatya leoroye meikara achali bitruma deve nasha insevi leh lehay achali bitruma degavray vehashta hadari li lemiltay kammayeta vela yada demeikara la shavetah lenafshah chalala hashta shavetah lenafshah chalala
Tinach almana kohenet almana bat yisrael may ika lememar bealmenutah la peligi rabbanan
Itmar hammachneset shum levalah hi omeret kelay ani notelet vehu omer damim ani noten haddin im mi rav yehuda amar
b: Haddin immah verav amme amar haddin immo

Rav yehuda amar haddin immah mishshum shevach bet aviha didah have rabbi amme amar haddin immo kevan deamar mar im metu metu lo veim hotiru hotiru lo hoil vechayyav beachrautan yochelu amar rav safra mi katane vehen shello hoil vechayyav beachrautan katane ulolam lav dideh ninhu

Vechol hecha dechayyav beachrautan achli bitruma vehatnan yisrael shessachar para mikkohen hare ze yaachilenna karshine teruma kohen shessachar para miyyisrael af al pi shemmezonoteha alav la yaachilenna karshine teruma

Vetisbera nehi name dimchayyev bigneva vaaveda beonseha bechachshah uvnifchat dameha mi michayyav ha la damya ella lesefa yisrael sheshsham para mikkohen la yaachilenna karshine teruma aval kohen sheshsham para miyyisrael yaachilenna karshine teruma

Yatev rabba verav yosef beshilhe pirkeh derav nachman veyatvi vekaamri tanya kevateh derav yehuda vetanya kevateh derabbi amme tanya kevateh derabbi amme avde tzon barzel yotzin beshen vaayin laish aval lo laishsha

Tanya kevateh derav yehuda hammachneset shum levalah im ratza habbaal limkor lo yimkor velo od ella afilu hichnis lah shum mishshello im ratza habbaal limkor lo yimkor machru shenehem lefarnasa ze haya maase lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel veamar habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot

Amar rava amar rav nachman halacha kerav yehuda amar leh rava lerav nachman vehatanya kevateh derabbi amme af al gav detanya kevateh derabbi amme mistabbera tama derav yehuda mishshum shevach bet aviha
Hahi itta deayyila leh legavra itztela demelata bichtubbetah shechev shakluha yatme ufarsuha ammitana

Amar rava kanyah mitana amar leh nanay bereh derav yosef bereh derava lerav kahana vehaamar rava amar rav nachman halacha kerav yehuda amar leh mi la mode rav yehuda dimchussar guvyana vechevan dimchussar guvyana birshuteh kae
Rava letameh deamar rava hekdesh chametz

a: Veshichrur mafkiin mide shibud
Amar rav yehuda hichnisa lo shene chelim beelef zuz veshavchu veamdu al shene alafim echad notalto bichtubbatah veechad notenet damim venotalto mippene shevach bet aviha
May ka mashma lan shevach bet aviha didah have ha amrah rav yehuda chada zimna mahu detema hane mile hecha dematya lemishkal bichtubbetah aval mitan deme umishkal la ka mashma lan
Matni bat yisrael shenniset lechohen umet vehinnichah meubberet lo yochlu avadeha bitruma mippene chelko shel ubbar shehaubbar posel veeno maachil divre rabbi yose
Amru lo meachar sheheadta lanu al bat yisrael lechohen af bat kohen lechohen umet vehinnicha meubberet lo yochlu avadeha bitruma mippene chelko shel ubbar
Gema ibaya lehu tama derabbi yose mishshum dekasavar ubbar bime zara zar hu o dilma yalud maachil sheeno yalud eno maachil
Lemay nafka minah leubbar bime chohenet may amar rabba hayenu tama derabbi yose dekasavar ubbar bime zara zar hu rav yosef amar yalud maachil sheen yalud eno maachil
Metivi amru lo lerabbi yose meachar sheheadta lanu al bat yisrael lechohen bat kohen lechohen mahu amar lahem zo shamati vezo lo shamati
I amratte bishlama ubbar bime zara zar hu hayenu dekaamar lehu zo shamati vezo lo shamati ella i amratte yalud maachil sheen yalud en maachil may zo shamati vezo lo shamati ihi hi kashya
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel zo divre rabbi yose aval chachamim omrim yesh lo banim ochlim mishshum banim en lo banim ochlim mishshum achim en lo achim ochlim mishshum mishpacha kullah
Zo vela sevira leh ha amar leh shemuel lerav chana bagdataa pok ayeti li be asra deema lach beanpayehu hamzakke leubbar kana ella zo usvira leh may ka mashma lan difligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yose
Umi peligi metiv rabbi zakkay zo edut heid rabbi yose mippi shemaya veavtalon vehodu lo amar rav ashe mi katane vekibbelu vehodu lo katane demistabbar tameh

Tanu rabbanan hinniach banim ellu vaellu ochlim hinnichah meubberet ellu vaellu en ochlim hinniach banim vehinnichah meubberet avde melog ochlim kederech shehi ochelet avde tzon barzel lo yochlu mippene chelko shel ubbar shehaubbar posel veeno maachil divre rabbi yose

Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv habbat maachelet habben eno maachil rabbi shimon ben yochay omer zecharim yochlu kullan nekevot lo yochelu shemma yimmatze ubbar zachar veen labbanot bimkom habben kelum
May irya shemma yimmatze ubbar zachar tipok leh dinkeva name pasla chada veod kaamar chada dinkeva name pasla veod shemma yimmatze ubbar zachar veen labbanot bimkom habben kelum
Zecharim yochelu vehaika ubbar kasavar
b: En choshshin lemiuta veibaet ema leolam kasavar choshshin lemiuta deavdinan leh takkanta kerav nachman amar shemuel

Deamar rav nachman amar shemuel yetomim shebbau lachalok benichse avihem bet din maamidin lahem appotroppos uvorer lahem chelek yafe higdilu yecholin lemachot verav nachman dideh amar higdilu en yecholin lemachot deim ken ma koach bet din yafe
Lema derav nachman tannae hi la dechulle alma it lehu derav nachman vehacha bechoshshin lemiuta kamipalgi
Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv habbat maachelet habben eno maachil may shena ben delo maachil mishshum chelko shel ubbar bat name lo taachil mippene chelko shel ubbar
Amar abbaye hacha binchasim muatim askinan uchgon deika ben bahade bat
Ma nafshach i hay dimabbera ben hu la adif mehay dekae i bat hi ammay achla betakkanta derabbanan kamma dela nefak laavir haolam la takkinu rabbanan
Bemay okemta binchasim muatim ema sefa shemma yimmatze haubbar zachar veen labbanot bimkom ben kelum adderabba nechasim muatim devanot ninhu sefa atan linchasim merubbin
Unchasim muatim devanot ninhu vehaamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan yetomin shekkadmu umachru binchasim muatim ma shemmachru machru
Veella may bat dekatane em i hachi hayenu rabbi yose kullah rabbi yishmael berabbi yose katane lah
Matni haubbar vehayyavam vehaerusin vehacheresh uven tesha shanim veom echad poslin velo maachilin
Safek shehu ben tesha shanim veom echad safek sheeno safek hevi shette searot vesafek shello hevi
Nafal habbayit alav veal bat achiv veen yadua e ze met rishon tzaratah choletzet velo mityabemet
Gema haubbar i bat kohen leyisrael hi pasel lah kinureha perat limubberet i bat yisrael lechohen hi lo maachil lah yalud maachil sheeno yalud eno maachil
Hayyavam i bat kohen leyisrael hi pasel lah veshava el bet aviha perat leshomeret yavam i bat yisrael lechohen hi la maachel lah kinyan kaspo amar rachamana veha kinyan deachiv hu
Vehaerusin i bat kohen leyisrael hi pasel lah

a: Deha kanyah bahavaya vei bat yisrael lechohen hi lo maachil lah mishshum deulla
Vehacheresh i bat kohen leyisrael hi pasel lah deha kanyah betakkanta derabbanan vei bat yisrael lechohen hi la maachel kinyan kaspo amar rachamana vehay lav bar kinyan hu
Uven tesha shanim vechu ka salka datin beshomeret yavam leven tesha veom echad lemay i lemifsal katan name mifsal pasel i leochole gadol name lo maachil

Amar abbaye hacha beyavam ben tesha shanim veom echad habba al yevimto askinan demiddeorayeta kanya leh salka datach amena hoil umiddeorayeta kanya leh uviato bia ema lochel ka mashma lan asu biat ben tesha shanim veom echad kemaamar begadol
Amar leh rava i hachi sefa dekatane safek ben tesha shanim veom echad safek sheeno hashta vadday ben tesha lo maachil safek mibaya

Ella amar rava beven tesha shanim veom echad dehanach pesulim katane defasli beviatan vechidtanya ben tesha shanim veom echad ger ammoni umoavi mitzri vaadomi kuti natin chalal umamzer shebbau al kohenet leviyya veyisreelit pesaluha
Veha middekatane sefa im enan reuyin lavo beyisrael hare ellu poslim mikkelal deresha lav bifsulim askinan resha pesule kahal sefa pesule chehunna
Gufa ben tesha shanim veom echad ger ammoni umoavi mitzri vaadomi kuti natin chalal umamzer shebbau al kohenet leviyya veyisreelit pesaluha
Rabbi yose omer kol shezzaro pasul posel kol sheen zaro pasul eno posel rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol sheatta nose bitto atta nose almenato vechol sheen atta nose bitto i atta nose almenato
Mena hane mile amar rav yehuda amar rav amar kera uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar kevan shennivala lefasul lah pesalah
Hay mibe leh dekaamar rachamana bat kohen deminasva lezar la techul
Hahi mivveshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel nafka middekaamar rachamana veshava el bet aviha tochel mikkelal demeikara la achla
I mehahi hava amena lav habba mikkelal ase ase ketav rachamana hay lelav lav mivechal zar lo yochal kodesh nafka
b: Hahu mibe leh legufeh tere vechol zar ketivi
Veakkatti mibe leh lechidrabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina vechol zar zarut amarti lecha velo aninut derabbi yose berabbi chanina min zar vechol zar nafka

Veakkatti mibe leh lechidtanya keshehi chozeret chozeret litruma veenah chozeret lechaze vashok veamar rav chisda amar ravina bar rav shela may kera dichtiv uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel lo tochal bammuram min hakkodashim
Im ken lichtov kera hi bakkodashim lo tochal may bitrumat hakkodashim shamatte minah tarte
Ashkechan kohenet leviyya veyisreelit menalan kidamar rabbi abba amar rav bat uvat hacha name bat uvat
Keman kerabbi akiva dedaresh vavin afilu tema rabbanan kulleh uvat kera yattira hu
Ashkechan litruma lichhunna menalan attu leviyya veyisreelit la lichhunna merabbenan lehu dei litruma benot mechal teruma ninhu
Allema la mashkachatte lah dekaachla bishvil benah
Bishvil benah kal vachomer uma kohenet devikdushsha denafshah achla pasel lah leviyya veyisreelit dela achla ella bishvil benah lo kol shekken

Vehi hannotenet kohenet dekaddish gufah pasel lah ha dela kaddish gufah la pasel lah ella lichhunna kal vachomer miggerusha uma gerusha shemmutteret bitruma asura lakkehunna zo sheasura bitruma eno din sheppesula lakkehunna
Vechi mazhirin min haddin gilluy milta bealma hu
Veema nivala lefasul lah chayyave karetot ki tihye amar rachamana hanach deit behu havaya chayyave karetot lav bene havaya

I hachi goy veeved la lifselu hanach pasli midderabbi yishmael deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael minnayin legoy veeved shebba al bat yisrael veal kohenet ulviyya sheppesaluha shenneemar uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugrusha vego

a: Mi sheyyesh lo almenut vegerushin bah yatzu goy veeved sheen lo almenut vegerushin
Ashkechan kohenet leviyya veyisreelit mena lan kidamar rabbi abba amar rav bat uvat hacha name bat uvat
Keman kerabbi akiva dedaresh vave afilu tema rabbanan kulleh uvat kera yattira hu
Veema mi sheyyesh lo almenut vegerushin bah ki let leh zera kaachla ki it leh zera la achla mi sheen lo almenut vegerushin bah af al gav deit leh zera name techol
Im ken rabboye leviyya veyisreelit lema li
Ulrabbi akiva deamar en kiddushin tofsin bechayyave lavin umay ki tihye leish zar ki tibael almana ugrusha lema li

Almana lehachmir aleha ugrusha lehakel aleha utzricha dei ashmeinan almana almana hu dechi let lah zera achla mishshum dechazya lichhunna aval gerusha dela chazya lichhunna ema af al gav delet lah zera la achla vei ashmeinan gerusha gerusha hu dechi it lah zera la achla mishshum dela chazya lichhunna aval almana dechazya lichhunna ema af al gav deit lah zera name techol tzericha
Veema nivala lefasul lah af machzir gerushato leish zar amar rachamana mi shezzar etzlah meikara leappoke hay delo zar etzlah meikara hu
I hachi chalal delav zar hu meikara la lifsol amar kera lo yechallel zaro beammav makkish zaro lo ma hu posel af zaro name posel
Veema mishsheat havaya dumya dechohen gadol bealmana ma kohen gadol bealmana bevia af hay name bevia
Veema ad deika havaya uvia dumya dechohen gadol bealmana ma kohen gadol bealmana bevia lechuddah af hay name bevia lechuddah
Verabbi yose omer kol shezzaro pasul posel vechol sheen zaro pasul eno posel may ika ben tanna kamma lerabbi yose
Amar rabbi yochanan mitzri sheni vaadomi sheni ika benayehu
Ushnehem lo lemaduha ella mikkohen gadol bealmana tanna kamma savar ma kohen gadol bealmana shebbiato baavera ufosel af hay name posel

Verabbi yose savar kechohen gadol ma kohen gadol shezzaro pasul ufosel af kol shezzaro pasul posel leappoke mitzri sheni deen zaro pasul dichtiv banim asher yivaldu lahem dor shelishi yavo lahem bikhal Adonai
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol sheatta nose bitto atta nose almenato vechu may ika ben rabbi yose lerabban shimon ben gamliel
Amar ulla ger ammoni umoavi ika benayehu ushnehem lo lemaduha ella mikkohen gadol bealmana rabbi yose savar ma kohen gadol bealmana shezzaro pasul ufosel af kol shezzaro pasul posel

Rabban shimon ben gamliel savar ma kohen gadol bealmana shekkol zaro pasul ufosel af shekkol zaro pasul ufosel leappoke ammoni umoavi deen kal zaro pasul deamar mar ammoni velo ammonit moavi velo moavit
Matni haones vehamfatte vehashshote lo poslin velo maachilin veim enan reuyin lavo beyisrael hare ellu poslin ketzad haya yisrael shebba al bat kohen tochal bitruma
b: Ibra lo tochal bitruma nechtach haubbar bemeeha tochal haya kohen shebba al bat yisrael lo tochal bitruma ibra lo tochal yalda tochal nimtza kocho shel ben gadol mishshel av

Haeved posel mishshum bia veeno posel mishshum zera ketzad bat yisrael lechohen bat kohen leyisrael veyalda hemennu ben vehalach habben venichbash al hashshifcha veyalda hemennu ben hare ze eved hayeta em aviv bat yisrael lechohen lo tochal bitruma bat kohen leyisrael tochal bitruma

Mamzer posel umaachil ketzad bat yisrael lechohen uvat kohen leyisrael veyalda hemennu bat vehalcha habbat veniset leeved o legoy veyalda hemennu ben hare ze mamzer hayeta em immo bat yisrael lechohen tochal bitruma bat kohen leyisrael lo tochal bitruma

Kohen gadol peamim shehu posel ketzad bat kohen leyisrael veyalda hemennu bat vehalcha habbat veniset lakkohen veyalda hemennu ben hare ze rauy lihot kohen gadol omed umshammesh al gabbe hammizbeach maachil et immo ufosel em immo zot omeret lo kivni kohen gadol shehu posleni min hatteruma
Gema tenena leha detanu rabbanan shote vekatan shennasu nashim umetu neshotehen peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibum
Ketzad haya yisrael shebba al bat kohen tochal bitruma ibra lo tochal kevan deibra lo tochal lechush shemma ibra mi la tenan mafrishin otan shelosha chodashim shemma meubbarot hen
Amar rabba bar rav huna leuchasin chashshu litruma lo chashshu velitruma lo chashshu vehatanya hare ze gitech shaa achat kodem lemitati asura leechol bitruma miyyad
Ella amar rabba bar rav huna benisuin chashshu biznut lo chashshu
Uvnisuin mi chashshu vehatanya bat kohen shenniset leyisrael vamet tovelet veochelet bitruma learev
Amar rav chisda tovelet veochelet ad arbaim dei la miabbera ha la miabbera vei miabbera ad arbaim mayya bealma hi
Amar leh abbaye i hachi ema sefa hukkar ubbarah bemeeha tehe mekulkelet lemafrea may mekulkelet ad arbaim
Itmar habba al arusato bevet chamiv rav amar havalad mamzer ushmuel amar havalad shetuki amar rava mistabbera milteh derav dedayema mealma aval la dayema mealma batreh dideh shadenan leh
Amar rava mena amena lah dekatane yalda tochal hechi dame ilema dedayema mealma yalda ammay tochal ella lav mineh dayema vela dayema mealma
Uma hatam dilhay isura ulhay isura batra dideh shadenan leh hacha dilhay isura ulhay hetera lo kol shekken

Amar leh abbaye leolam ema lach kol hecha dedayema mineh af al gav dela dayema mealma amar rav havalad mamzer may tama deamrinan middeafkara nafshah legabbe arus afkara nafshah lealma umatnitin shehau shenehem chavushim bevet haasurin

Ika deamri beva aleha kulle alma la peligi devatreh dideh shadenan leh vehachi itmar arusa sheibra rav amar havalad mamzer ushmuel amar havalad shetuki amar rava mistabbera milteh derav dela dayema mineh vedayema mealma

a: Aval dayema minneh af al gav dedayema mealma batreh dideh shadenan leh
Amar rava mena amena lah dekatane yalda tochal hechi dame ilema dedayema minneh vela dayema mealma tzericha lememar detechol ella lav dedayema name mealma
Uma hatam dilhay isura ulhay isura batreh dideh shadenan leh hacha dilhay isura ulhay hetera lo kol shekken
Amar leh abbaye leolam ema lach kol hecha dedayema mealma af al gav dedayema minneh amar rav havalad mamzer umatnitin bidla dayema kelal
Haeved posel mishshum bia ku may tama amar kera haishsha viladeha tihye vego
Mamzer posel umaachil tanu rabbanan vezera en lah en li ella zarah zera zarah minnayin talmud lomar vezera en lah mikkol makom
En li ella zera kasher zera pasul minnayin talmud lomar vezera en lah ayyen aleha
Veha appekteh lezera zarah zera zarah la itzterich kera bene vanim hare hen kevanim ki itzterich kera lezera pasul

Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan keman kerabbi akiva deamar yesh mamzer mechayyave lavin afilu tema rabbanan begoy veeved modu dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi mishshum rabbenu goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer
Kohen gadol peamim shepposel tanu rabbanan hareni kapparat ben bitti kuza shemmaachileni batteruma veeni kapparat ben bitti kadda shepposleni min hatteruma
Hadaran alach almana
Hearel vechol hattemeim lo yochlu bitruma neshehen veavdehen yochlu bitruma
Petzua dakka uchrut shofcha hen veavdehen yochelu unshehen lo yochelu veim lo yada mishshennaasa petzua dakka uchrut shofcha hare ellu yochelu
Vee zehu petzua dakka kol shenniftzeu habbetzim shello vaafilu achat mehen uchrut shofcha kol shennichrat haggid veim nishtayyer meatara afilu kechut hassaara kasher

Gema tanya amar rabbi elazar minnayin learel sheen ochel bitruma neemar toshav vesachir bappesach veneemar toshav vesachir batteruma ma toshav vesachir haamur bappesach arel asur bo af toshav vesachir haamur batteruma arel asur bo
Rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich hare hu omer ish ish lerabbot hearel
Amar mar rabbi eliezer omer neemar toshav vesachir bappesach veneemar toshav vesachir batteruma ma toshav vesachir haamur bappesach arel asur bo af toshav vesachir haamur batteruma arel asur bo
Mufne dei lav mufne ika lemifrach ma lefesach shekken chayyavin alav mishshum pigul venotar vetame laye afnoye mufne
He mufne i ditruma mitzrach tzerichi detanya toshav ze kanuy kinyan olam sachir ze kanuy kinyan shanim
Veyeamer toshav veal yeamer sachir vaani omer kanuy kinyan olam eno ochel kanuy kinyan shanim lo kol shekken
Ilu ken hayiti omer toshav ze kanuy kinyan shanim aval kanuy kinyan olam ochel ba sachir velimed al toshav sheaf al pi shekkanuy kinyan olam en ochel

Ella defesach mufne hay toshav vesachir dichtav rachamana befesach may nihu i nema toshav vesachir mammash mishshum dehave leh toshav vesachir iptar leh mippesach veha kayema lan gabbe teruma dela achel
b: Alma la kane leh rabbeh hacha name la kane leh rabbeh ella leafnoye
Veakkatti mufne mitztzad echad hu veshaminan leh lerabbi elazar deamar mufne mitztzad echad lemedin umshivin
Kevan dilgufeh la tzerich shedi chad allamed ushdi chad ammelammed vehave leh gezera shava mufna mishshene tzedadin
I ma pesach onen asur bo af teruma onen asur bah
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina amar kera zar vechol zar zarut amarti lecha velo aninut ema velo arelut ha ketiv toshav vesachir
Uma raita mistabbera arelut hava leh lerabboye shekken maasim kerutim bidvar haeved mechussar maase umaase begufo veanush karet veyeshno lifne haddibbur umilat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet
Adderabba aninut hava leh lerabboye shekken yeshnah bechol shaa venoheget baanashim venashim veen beyado letakken et atzmo hanach nefishan
Rava amar bela hanach nefishan name la matzet amratte shavkinan arelut dichtiv begufeh defesach veyalfinan aninut mippesach defesach gufeh mimmaaser gamrinan
I ma pesach milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet af teruma milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet
Amar kera umalta oto az yochal bo milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet bo milleechol befesach veen milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet bitruma
I hachi ema kol arel lo yochal bo bo eno ochel aval ochel hu bitruma ha ketiv toshav vesachir
Uma raita mistabbera arelut degufeh hava leh lerabboye shekken maase begufo veanush karet adderabba milat zecharav vaavadav hava leh lerabboye shekken yeshnah bechol shaa
Hanach nefishan veibaet ema bela hanach nefishan name la matzet amratte mi ika mide daarelut degufeh la meakkeva beh arelut deacharine meakkeva beh
Hashta deamratte bo lidrasha hu daata kol ben nechar lo yochal bo lema li bo

a: Meshummadut poselet veen meshummadut poselet bemaaser
Kol arel lo yochal bo lema li bo eno ochel aval ochel hu bematztza umaror

Veitzterich lemichtav arel veitzterich lemichtav kol ben nechar dei ketav rachamana arel mishshum dimis aval ben nechar dela meis ema la vei ketav rachamana kol ben nechar mishshum deen libbo lashshamayim aval arel delibbo lashshamayim ema la tzericha
Mimmennu mimmennu lema li lechidrabba amar rabbi yitzchak
Amar mar rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich hare hu omer ish ish lerabbot et hearel veema lerabbot et haonen amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar kera vechol zar zarut amarti lecha velo aninut
Ema velo arelut ha ketiv ish ish
Uma raita mistabbera arelut hava leh lerabboye shekken maasim kerutim bidvar haeved mechussar maase umaase begufo veanush karet veyeshno lifne haddibbur umilat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet
Adderabba aninut hava leh lerabboye shekken yeshnah bechol shaa venoheget baanashim venashim veen beyado letakken atzmo
Hanach nefishan rava amar bela hanach nefishan name la matzet amratte amar kera ish ish ezehu davar sheyyeshno baish veeno baishsha have omer ze arelut
Verabbi akiva hay toshav vesachir may aved leh amar rav shemaya leetoye arvi mahul vegivoni mahul
Vehane mulin ninhu veha tenan kunam sheani nehene laarelim muttar bearle yisrael veasur bemule ummot haolam kunam sheani nehene lemulin muttar bemule ummot haolam veasur bearle yisrael
Ella leetoye ger shemmal velo taval vekatan shennolad keshehu mahul vekasavar tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit
Verabbi eliezer letameh deamar ger shemmal velo taval ger mealleya hu vekasavar katan keshennolad mahul en tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit
Verabbi eliezer hay ish ish may aved leh dibbera tora kilshon bene adam
Bae rav chama bar ukva katan arel mahu lesucho beshemen shel teruma arelut shello bizmannah meakkeva o la meakkeva
Amar rabbi zera ta shema en li ella milat zecharav bishat asiyya vaavadav bishat achila minnayin liten et haamur shel ze baze veet haamur shel ze baze talmud lomar az az ligzera shava
Bishlama avadav mashkachatte lah deitanhu bishat achila veletanhu bishat asiyya kegon dezavninhu bene bene
Ella zecharav deitanhu bishat achila veletanhu bishat asiyya hechi mashkachatte lah lav deityelud ben asiyya laachila shema minah arelut shello bizmannah haveya arelut
Amar rava vetisbera himmol lo chol zachar amar rachamana veaz yikrav laasoto vehay lav bar mehila hu ella hacha bemay askinan kegon shechalatzattu chamma
Venitev leh kol shiva deamar shemuel chalatzattu chamma notnin lo kol shiva deyahavinan leh kol shiva venimhaleh mitztzafra baenan
b: Meet leet
Vehatane ludaa yom havraato keom hivaldo may lav ma yom hivaldo la baenan meet leet af yom havraato la baenan meet leet
La adif yom havraato miyyom hivaldo deilu yom hivaldo la baenan meet leet veilu yom havraato baenan meet leet
Rav pappa amar kegon dechaev leh eneh leyanoka veitfach bene uvene
Rava amar kegon shehau aviv veimmo chavushin bevet haasurin
Rav kahana bereh derav nechemya amar kegon tumtum shennikra venimtza zachar bene uvene
Rav sherevya amar kegon shehotzi rosho chutz lapperozdor
Umi chaye vehatanya kevan sheyyatza laavir haolam niftach hassatum venistam happatuach sheilmale ken en yachol lichot afilu shaa achat
Hacha bemay askinan kegon dezanteh ishata ishata deman ilema ishata dideh i hachi kol shiva bae ella dezanteh ishata deimeh veibaet ema hane mile hecha dela meave aval hecha dimave michya chaye
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi benaa arel mekabbel hazzaa shekken matzinu baavotenu shekkibbelu hazzaa keshehen arelim shenneemar vehaam alu min hayyarden beasor lachodesh harishon
Baasara la mehili mishshum chulsha deorcha hazzaa emat aved lehu lav keshehen arelim
Vedilma la avud pesach kelal la salka datach dichtiv vayyaasu et happesach
Matkef lah mar zutra vedilma pesach habba betuma haya amar leh rav ashe tanya behedya malu vetavlu veasu pischehen betohora
Amar rabba bar yitzchak amar rav lo nitna periat mila leavraham avinu shenneemar baet hahi amar Adonai el yehoshua ase lecha charvot tzurim vego
Vedilma hanach dela mehul dichtiv ki mulim hau kol haam hayyotzim vechol haam hayyillodim vego
Im ken may shuv ella lav lifria umay shenit
Leakkoshe sof mila litchillat mila ma techillat mila meakkevet af sof mila meakkevin bo ditnan ellu hen tzitzin hamakkevin et hammila basar hachofe et rov haatara veen ochel bitruma
Amar ravina veitema rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav basar hachofe et rov govhah shel atara
Uvammidbar may tama la mehul ibaet ema mishshum chulsha deorcha

a: Veibaet ema mishshum dela neshiv lehu ruach tzefonit detanya kol otan arbaim shana shehau yisrael bammidbar lo nashva lahem ruach tzefonit
May tama ibaet ema mishshum dinzufim hau vei baet ema dela nibbaddur anne chavod
Amar rav pappa hilkach yoma deeva veoma deshuta la mahalinan beh vela mesochrinan beh vehaidana dedashu bah rabbim shomer petaim Adonai

Tanu rabbanan kol otan arbaim shana shehau yisrael bammidbar lo haya yom shello nashva bo ruach tzefonit bachatzi hallayela shenneemar vayehi bachatzi hallayela va hikka chol bechor vego may talmuda ha ka mashma lan deet retzon milta hi
Amar rav huna devar tora mashuch ochel bitruma umiddivrehem gazru alav mippene shennire kearel
Metivi mashuch tzarich sheyyamul midderabbanan udkaare lah may kaare lah ha tzarich katane

Katae besefa rabbi yehuda omer lo yimmol mippene shessakkana hi lo amru lo vahalo harbe malu bime ben kozeva veholidu banim uvanot shenneemar himmol yimmol afilu mea peamim veomer et beriti hefar lerabbot et hammashuch
May veomer vechi tema hay himmol yimmol lerabbot tzitzin hamakkevim et hammila ta shema et beriti hefar lerabbot et hammashuch
Hu savar middeka nasev lah talmuda kera deorayeta hi vela hi midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma
Metivi tumtum en ochel bitruma nashav vaavadav ochlin mashuch venolad keshehu mahul hare ellu ochlim anderoginos ochel bitruma veen ochel bekadashim tumtum eno ochel lo bitruma velo bekadashim
Katane mihat mashuch venolad keshehu mahul hare ellu ochlin teuvta derav huna teuvta
Amar mar tumtum eno ochel bitruma nashav vaavadav ochlim nashav letumtum mena leh ilema dekaddesh detanya tumtum shekkidesh kiddushav kiddushin nitkaddesh kiddushav kiddushin
Emar deamar lechumra lekulla mi amrinan sefek ishsha hu veen ishsha mekaddeshet ishsha
Amar abbaye keshebbetzav nikarot mibbachutz
Rava amar may nashav immo immo peshita mahu detema molid maachil sheen molid eno maachil ka mashma lan
Ta shema tumtum eno ochel lo bitruma velo bekadashim bishlama leabbaye tena resha arel vadday vekatane sefa sefek arel
Ella lerava tumtum desefa lema li may tumtum arel
Hashta sefek arel la achel vadday arel achel ma taam kaamar ma taam tumtum eno ochel bitruma mippene shessefek arel hu vearel eno ochel lo bitruma velo bekadashim

Lema ketannae mashuch venolad keshehu mahul veger shennitgayyer keshehu mahul vekatan sheavar zemanno ushar kol hannimolim leetoye mi sheyyesh lo shette aralot enan nimolin ella bayyom rabbi elazar bar shimon omer bizmanno
b: En nimolin ella beom shello bizmanno nimolin beom uvallayela may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar mashuch deorayeta umar savar mashuch derabbanan
Vetisbera katan sheavar zemanno mi ika leman deamar derabbanan
Ella dechulle alma mashuch derabbanan vekatan sheavar zemanno deorayeta vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar darshinan uvayyom umar savar la darshinan uvayyom
Ki ha deyatev rabbi yochanan vekadaresh notar bizmanno eno nisraf ella bayyom shello bizmanno nisraf ben bayyom ben ballayela
Veetiveh rabbi elazar lerabbi yochanan en li ella nimol lishmini sheen nimol ella bayyom minnayin lerabbot letisha laasara leachad asar lishnem asar minnayin talmud lomar uvayyom
Vaafilu leman dela daresh vav vav vehe daresh ishtik

Batar dinfak amar leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish raiti leven pedat sheyyoshev vedoresh kemoshe mippi haggevura amar leh resh lakish dideh hi matnita hi hecha tena leh betorat kohanim nefak tanyah bitlata yome vesavrah bitlata yarche
Amar rabbi elazar arel shehizza hazzaato keshera mide dehave attevul yom sheaf al pi sheasur bitruma kasher bappara
Ma litvul yom shekken muttar bemaaser attu anan laachila kaamrinan anan lingia kaamrinan uma tevul yom sheasur bingia ditruma muttar bappara arel shemmuttar bingia eno din shemmuttar bappara
Tanya name hachi arel shehizza hazzaato keshera umaase haya vehichshiru chachamim hazzaato

Metivi tumtum shekkidesh kidusho pasul mippene shehu sefek arel vearel pasul lekaddesh veanderoginos shekkidesh kidusho kasher rabbi yehuda omer af anderoginos shekkidesh kiddushav pesulim mippene shessefek ishsha hu veishsha pesula millekaddesh katane miha arel usfek arel pasul millekaddesh
Amar rav yosef hay tanna tanna deve rabbi akiva hu dimrabbe leh learel ketame detanya rabbi akiva omer ish ish lerabbot hearel
Amar rava hava yatevna kammeh derav yosef vekashya li la lishtemit tanna velitne hearel vehattame velema rabbi akiva hi
Vela veha katane hearel vehattame peturim min hariyya hatam mishshum dimis
Veazdu letamayehu detanya hakkol kesherim lekaddesh chutz mecheresh shote vekatan rabbi yehuda machshir bakkatan ufosel beishsha uvanderoginos
May tama derabbanan dichtiv velakchu lattame meafar serefat hachattat hanach defasli baasifa pesulin bekidush hanach dichsherin baasifa kesherim bekidush
Verabbi yehuda amar lach im ken nema kera velakach may velakchu daafilu hanach difsulin hatam kesherim hacha
I hachi ishsha name venatan velo venatna verabbanan i ketiv velakach venatan hava amena shakel chad veyahev chad ketav rachamana velakchu
Vei ketav rachamana velakchu venatnu hava amena deshakli tere veyahavi tere ketav rachamana velakchu venatan daafilu shakli tere veyahev chad

a: Vehizza hattahor al hattame tahor mikkelal shehu tame limed al tevul yom shekkasher bappara
Beo mineh merav sheshet arel mahu bammaaser ki hechi deyalef pesach mimmaaser leinyan aninut yalef name maaser mippesach leinyan arelut
O dilma chamur mikkal yalef kal mechamur la yalef
Amar lehu tenetuha hatteruma vehabbikkurim chayyavim alehen mita vachomesh vaasurin lezarim
Vehen nichse chohen veolin beechad umea utunin rechitzat yadayim veheerev shemesh hare ellu batteruma uvabbikkurim ma sheen ken bammaaser
Veim ita nitne arel asur bahen ma sheen ken bammaaser
Tena veshayyar umay shayyar dehay shayyar

Shayyar deka tane sefa yesh bammaaser uvabbikkurim ma sheen ken batteruma shehammaaser vehabbikkurim teunin havaat makom utunin viduy vaasurin leonen verabbi shimon mattir vechayyavin beviur verabbi shimon poter
Veilu asur levaer mehen betuma
b: Veochlan betumat atzman loke ma sheen ken batteruma la katane alma tane veshayyar

Vaasurin leonen verabbi shimon mattir mena lehu dichtiv lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha vego utrumat yadecha veamar mar terumat yadecha ellu bikkurim veitakkash bikkurim lemaaser ma maaser asur leonen af bikkurim asur leonen
Verabbi shimon teruma kerinhu rachamana ma teruma mutteret leonen af bikkurim muttarim leonen
Vechayyavin beviur verabbi shimon poter mar makkesh umar la makkesh
Veasur levaer mehen betuma veochlan betumat atzman loke menalan detanya rabbi shimon omer lo viarti mimmennu betame ben sheani tame vehu tahor ben sheani tahor vehu tame
Vehecha muzhar al achilato eni yodea tumat hagguf behedya ketiv beh nefesh asher tigga bo vetama ad haarev velo yochal min hakkodashim ki im rachatz besaro bammayim

Hachi kamibaya leh tumat atzmo minnayin talmud lomar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha ulhallan hu omer bisharecha tochlennu hattame vehattahor yachdav katztzevi vechaayyal vetana deve rabbi yishmael afilu tame vetahor ochlin al shulchan echad bikara achat veenan choshshin vekaamar rachamana hahu daamari lach hatam bisharecha tochlennu hacha la techol
Ma sheen ken batteruma mena lan amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera lo viarti mimmennu betame mimmennu i atta mavir aval atta mavir shemen shel teruma shennitma
Veema mimmennu i atta mavir aval atta mavir shemen shel kodesh shennitma lav kal vachomer hu uma maaser hakkal amra tora lo viarti mimmennu betame kodesh chamur lo kol shekken
I hachi teruma name kal vachomer hu ha ketiv mimmennu
Uma raita mistabbera kodesh la memaetna shekken
Piggul notar korban meila karet veasur leonen
Adderabba teruma la memaetna shekken mita vachomesh veen lah pidon vaasura lezarim
Hanach nefishan veibaet ema karet adifa
Veochlan betumat atzman loke ma sheen ken batteruma milka hu dela lake ha isura ika menalan amar kera bisharecha tochlennu laze velo leacher velav habba mikkelal ase ase
Amar rav ashe meresha name shamatte minah ditna veshayyar middela katane

a: Venohagin bishar shene shavua veen lahem pidon ma sheen ken bammaaser shema minah
Ta shema nishtayeru bo tzitzin hamakkevin et hammila hare ze eno ochel lo batteruma velo bappesach velo bakkodashim velo bammaaser may lav masar dagan la masar behema
Masar behema hayenu kadashim velitamach mi la tenan pesach vekatane kadashim
Bishlama pesach vekadashim tzerichi dei tena pesach mishshum daarelut befesach ketiva aval kadashim ema la vei tena kadashim hava amena may kadashim pesach ella masar behema lema li
Ella maaser rishon verabbi meir hi deamar maaser rishon asur lezarim
Ta shema middetane rabbi chiyya bar rav middifti arel asur bishte maasrot may lav echad masar dagan veechad masar behema hacha name maaser rishon verabbi meir

Ta shema onen asur bammaaser umuttar batteruma uvappara tevul yom asur bitruma umuttar bappara uvammaaser mechussar kippurim asur bappara umuttar batteruma uvammaaser veim ita nitne arel asur batteruma umuttar bappara uvammaaser
Hay tanna deve rabbi akiva hi dimrabbe leh learel ketame detanya rabbi akiva omer ish ish lerabbot et hearel
Uman tanna diflig aleh derabbi akiva tanna derabbi yosef habbavli hi detanya serefat onen umchussar kippurim keshera rabbi yosef habbavli omer onen keshera mechussar kippurim pesula

Veaf rabbi yitzchak savar arel asur bemaaser deamar rabbi yitzchak minnayin learel sheasur bammaaser neemar mimmennu bammaaser veneemar mimmennu bappesach ma mimmennu haamur bappesach arel asur bo af mimmennu haamur bammaaser arel asur bo
Mufne dei la mufne ika lemifrach ma lefesach shekken chayyavin alav mishshum pigul venotar vetame laye afnoye mufne
May mufne amar rava amar rabbi yitzchak telata mimmennu ketivi befesach chad legufeh vechad ligzera shava vechad
Leman deamar ba hakkatuv liten lecha ase achar lo taase ayede dichtiv notar ketiv name mimmennu ulman deamar liten lo boker sheni lisrefato ayede dichtiv ad boker ketiv name mimmennu
Telata mimmennu ketivi bemaaser chad legufeh vechad lidrabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan vechad lidresh lakish

Deamar resh lakish amar rabbi simay minnayin lemaaser sheni shennitma shemmuttar lesucho shenneemar velo natatti mimmennu lemet lemet hu delo natatti ha lechay dumya demet natatti ezehu davar sheshshave bachayyim uvammetim heve omer zo sicha
Matkef lah mar zutra veema likach lo aron vetachrichim amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua mimmennu miggufo rav ashe amar la natatti dumya delo achalti ma lehallan miggufo af kan miggufo
Veakkatti mufne mitztzad echad hu hanicha leman deamar lemedin veen meshivin ella leman deamar lemedin umshivin may ika lememar

Hach derabbi avahu midderav nachman amar rabba bar avuh nafka deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh may dichtiv vaani hinne natatti lecha et mishmeret terumotay bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber achat teruma tehora veachat teruma temea veamar rachamana lecha shellecha tehe lehassaka tachat tavshilcha
Vechol hattemeim ku mena hane mile amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael amar kera ish ish mizzera aharon vehu tzarua o zav vego e zehu davar sheshshave
b: Bezaro shel aharon heve omer zo teruma veema bechaze vashok enah bechozeret
Teruma name enah bachalala chalala lav zaro deaharon hi
Umimmay dehay ad asher yithar ad deika heerev shemesh ema ad demayete kappara
La salka datach detana deve rabbi yishmael bezav baal shette reiyyot uvimtzora musgar hakkatuv medabber dumya ditme nefesh ma teme nefesh delav bar kappara hu hane name delav bene kappara ninhu
Veema hane mile delav bar kappara aval devar kappara ad demayete kappara
Vetu ha ditnan taval veala ochel bammaaser heeriv shimsho ochel batteruma hevi kappara ochel bakkodashim mena lan

Amar rava amar rav chisda telata kerae ketivi ketiv velo yochal min hakkodashim ki im rachatz besaro bammayim ha rachatz tahor uchtiv uva hashshemesh vetaher veachar yochal min hakkodashim uchtiv vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera ha ketzad kan lemaaser kan litruma kan lekadashim
Veefoch ana mistabbera teruma adifa shekken
Adderabba meeser adifa shekken hadas tav
Afilu hachi mita adifa
Rava amar bela mita adifa name la matzet amratte amar kera nefesh ezehu davar sheshshave bechol nefesh heve omer ze maaser
Veakkatti hane mile hecha delav bar kappara aval hecha devar kappara ad demayete kappara
