Veellu muttarot leyivmehen vaasurot levalehen kohen gadol shekkidesh et haalmana veyesh lo ach kohen hedot kasher shennasa chalala veyesh lo ach chalal yisrael shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach mamzer mamzer shennasa bat yisrael veyesh lo ach yisrael muttarot leyivmehen vaasurot levalehen

Veellu asurot laellu velaellu kohen gadol shennasa et haalmana veyesh lo ach kohen gadol o kohen hedot kasher shennasa chalala veyesh lo ach kasher yisrael shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach yisrael mamzer shennasa bat yisrael veyesh lo ach mamzer asurot laellu velaellu ushar kol hannashim muttarot levalehen ulyivmehen

Sheniyyot middivre sofrim sheniyya labbaal velo sheniyya layyavam asura labbaal umutteret layyavam sheniyya layyavam velo sheniyya labbaal asura layyavam umutteret labbaal sheniyya laze velaze asura laze velaze
En lah lo ketuva velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot vehavalad kasher vechofin oto lehotzi
Almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot mamzeret untina leyisrael bat yisrael lenatin ulmamzer yesh lahen ketubba
Gema may irya detane nasa litne kidesh
Vechi tema tama denasa dehave leh ase velo taase aval kidesh ate ase vedoche lo taase veha kulleh pirkin ase velo taase hu vela ate ase vedache lo taase
Mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa kohen gadol shennasa et haalmana daveka nasa deshavveyah chalalah aval kidesh sharya leh tanna name resha nasa

Veaddetane mishshum sefa litne mishshum metziata kohen gadol shekkidesh et haalmana veyesh lo ach kohen hedot ella mishshum bat bukta dekavae lemitne chalal shennasa keshera tama denasa deshavveyah chalala aval kidesh sharya leh mishshum hachi katane nasa
Umay irya dekatane almana litne betula
b: Vechi tema kasavar hay tanna nisuin harishonim mappilin hare chalal shennasa keshera vela amrinan nisuin harishonim mappilin
Ha vadday mishshum sefa mishshum dekavae lemitna sefa kohen gadol shennasa et haalmana veyesh lo ach kohen gadol o kohen hedot daveka almana aval betula chazya leh mishshum hachi katane almana
Matkef lah rav pappa im ita leha dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan mitzri sheni shennasa mitzrit rishona benah sheni have litne name
Mitzri sheni shennasa shette mitzriyyot achat rishona veachat sheniyya vehau lo banim merishona ushniyya i nesuv ki orchayehu muttarot levalehen vaasurot leyivmehen
Vei efuch unsuv muttarot leyivmehen vaasurot levalehen muttarot laellu velaellu giyyorot asurot laellu velaellu ayeloniyyot
Tena veshayyar may shayyar dehay shayyar shayyar petzua dakka
I mishshum petzua dakka lav shiyyura deha tena leh chayyave lavin
Attu chayyave lavin mi la katane vahadar tane veha katane kohen hedot shennasa almana vechalal shennasa keshera
Hahu itztericha leh leashmoinan kidrav yehuda amar rav deamar rav yehuda amar rav lo huzharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin
Veha katane chalal shennasa keshera veyisrael shennasa bat yisrael veyesh lo ach mamzer ha name la mihdar mitna hi deishmuinan lav sheen shave bakkol vekamashma lan lav hashshave bakkol
Ha katane yisrael shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach yisrael umamzer shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach yisrael ella lav shema minah tena veshayyar shema minah
Gufa amar rav yehuda amar rav lo huzharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin lema mesayya leh chalal shennasa keshera may lav kohenet haruya lo umay keshera keshera lichhunna
La yisreelit umay keshera keshera lakkahal
I hachi yesh lo ach kasher name kasher lakkahal mikkelal dehu pasul lakkahal ella lav kohen umiddehu kohen hi kohenet mide irya ha kidita veha kidita
Metiv ravin bar nachman lo yikkachu lo yikkachu melammed shehaishsha muzheret al yede haish
Amar rava kol hecha dehu muzhar hi muzheret vechol hecha dehu lo muzhar hi lo muzheret

Veha mehacha nafka midderav yehuda amar rav nafka deamar rav yehuda amar rav vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashin shebbattora
I mehahi hava amena lav hashshave bakkol aval lav sheeno shave bakkol la

a: Vahare tuma delav sheen shave bakkol vetama dichtav rachamana bene aharon velo benot aharon ha lav hachi hava amena nashim chayyavot may tama lav mishshum derav yehuda amar rav
La degamrinan millo yikkachu
Ika deamri kicha itztericha leh salka datach amena ligmar mittuma kamashma lan
Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua iklau lehintzevu leatreh derav idi bar avin beo minayehu huzharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin o la

Amar lehu rav pappa tenetuha asara yuchasin alu mibbavel kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim chalalim gerim vacharurim umamzerim netinim shetuke vaasufe kohanim leviyyim yisreelim muttarin lavo ze baze leviyyim yisreelim chalalim gerim charurim muttarin lavo ze baze gere charore umamzere netine shetuke vaasufe muttarim lavo ze baze veilu kohenet lechalal la katane

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua kol hecha dehane nasvi mehane vehane nasvi mehane katane kohen kevan deilu bae leminsav chalala asira leh la katane ato lekammeh derav idi bar avin amar lehu dardeke hachi amar rav yehuda amar rav lo huzharu kesherot linase lifsulim
Sheniyyot middivre sofrim vechu beo mineh bene vere merav sheshet sheniyya labbaal velo sheniyya layyavam yesh lah ketubba miyyavam o la kevan deamar mar ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon let lah
O dilma kevan deilu let lah merishon takkinu lah rabbanan mishsheni it lah
Amar lehu rav sheshet tenetuha ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon veim hayeta sheniyya labbaal afilu miyyavam en lah
Mikkelal deika deit lah miyyavam chassore michassera vehachi katane ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon vei let lah merishon takkinu lah mishsheni veim hayeta sheniyya labbaal afilu miyyavam en lah

Bea mineh rabbi elazar merabbi yochanan almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot yesh lahen mezonot o en lahen mezonot hechi dame ilema deyatva tuteh baamod vehotze kae mezonot it lah la tzericha shehalach hu limdinat hayyam velaveta veachla may
Mezone tenay ketuva ninhu middeit lah ketuva it lah mezone o dilma ketubba dilmishkal umipak it lah mezone dilma tiakkav gabbeh let lah amar leh let lah
Vehatanya yesh lah ki tanya hahi leachar mita
It deamar amar leh tanya yesh lah ha baamod vehotze kae veella hatanya yesh lah ki tanya hahi leachar mita

Tanu rabbanan almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot yesh lah ketubba perot mezonot belaot vehi pesula uveladah pasul vechofin oto lehotzi sheniyyot middivre sofrim en lah ketubba lo perot lo mezonot velo belaot vehi keshera uveladah kasher vechofin oto lehotzi
Amar rabbi shimon ben elazar mippene ma amru almana lechohen gadol yesh lah ketubba mippene shehu pasul vehi pesula vechol makom shehu pasul vehi pesula
b: Kansu oto ketubba umippene ma amru sheniyyot middivre sofrim en lahen ketubba mippene shehu kasher vehi keshera vechol makom shehu kasher vehi keshera kansu otah ketubba
Rabbi omer hallalu divre tora vedivre tora en tzerichin chizuk vehallalu divre sofrim vedivre sofrim tzerichin chizuk davar acher ze hu margilah vezo hi margilato

Davar acher man katane lah ika deamar rabbi shimon ben elazar katane lah uma taam kaamar ma taam amru hu pasul vehi pesula kansu oto ketubba mippene shehu margilah uma taam hu kasher vehi keshera kansu otah ketubba mippene shehi margilato
Ika deamar rabbi katane lah vachalutza ka kashya leh veha chalutza derabbanan veit lah ketubba hadar amar kevan defasel lah midderabbanan ze hu margilah vezo hi margilato
May ika ben rabbi lerabbi shimon ben elazar amar rav chisda mamzeret untina leyisrael ika benayehu
Man deamar deorayeta ha name deorayeta man deamar mippene shehu margilah ha hi margela leh

Ulrabbi eliezer deamar hare ze eved umamzer ha la margela leh vela mide ella amar rav yosef machazir gerusha mishshenniset ika benayehu man deamar deorayeta ha name deorayeta uman deamar mippene shehu margilah ha hi margela leh

Ulrabbi akiva deamar yesh mamzer mechayyave lavin ha la margela leh vela mide ella amar rav pappa beula lechohen gadol ika benayehu man deamar deorayeta ha name deorayeta uman deamar mippene shehu margilah ha hi margela leh
Ulrabbi eliezer ben yaakov deamar yesh chalal mechayyave ase ha la margela leh vela mide ella amar rav ashe machazir safek sotato ika benayehu

Man deamar deorayeta ha name deorayeta uman deamar mippene shehu margilah ha hi margela leh ulrabbi matya ben charash deamar afilu halach balah lehashkotah uva aleha badderech asaah zona ha la margela leh vela mide ella amar mar bar rav ashe sota vadday ika benayehu

Matni bat yisrael meoreset lechohen meubberet mikkohen shomeret yavam lechohen vechen bat kohen leyisrael lo tochal bitruma bat yisrael meoreset lelevi meubberet millevi shomeret yavam lelevi vechen bat levi leyisrael lo tochal bemaaser
Bat levi meoreset lechohen meubberet mikkohen shomeret yavam lechohen vechen bat kohen lelevi lo tochal lo bitruma velo bemaaser
Gema uthe zara zara mi la achla bemaaser amar rav nachman amar shemuel ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar maaser rishon asur lezarim detanya

a: Teruma lechohen umaaser rishon lelevi divre rabbi meir rabbi elazar ben azarya mattiro lechohen mattiro mikkelal deika man deasar ella ema notno af lechohen

May tama derabbi meir amar rav acha bereh derabba mishshemeh digmara ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu la teruma ma teruma asura lezarim af maaser rishon asur lezarim i ma teruma chayyavin alav mita vachomesh af maaser chayyavin alav mita vachomesh
Amar kera umetu vo ki yechalleluhu veyasaf chamishito alav bo velo bemaaser alav velo al maaser verabbanan ma teruma tovelet af maaser rishon name tovel

Vechidtanya rabbi yose omer yachol lo yehe chayyav ella al tevel shello huram mimmennu kol ikar huram mimmennu teruma gedola velo huram mimmennu maaser rishon maaser rishon velo maaser sheni vaafilu masar ani minnayin
Talmud lomar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha ulhallan hu omer veachlu visharecha vesaveu ma shearecha haamur lehallan masar ani af shearecha haamur kan masar ani veamar rachamana lo tuchal
Vei mehatam hava amena lelav aval mita la ka mashma lan
Lishana acharina maaser rishon detavel midderabbi yose nafka i mehahi hava amena lelav aval mita la ka mashma lan

Bemay okemtah kerabbi meir ema sefa bat levi meoreset lechohen uvat kohen lelevi lo tochal lo bitruma velo bemaaser hacha may zarut ika amar rav sheshet may enah ochelet dekatane enah notenet reshut litrom
Michlal dinsua notenet reshut in vehatanya vaachaltem oto bechol makom attem uvetchem limed al nesua bat yisrael shennotenet reshut litrom
Atta omer reshut litrom o eno ella leechol amratte teruma chamura ochelet maaser hakkal lo kol shekken ella limed al nesua bat yisrael shennotenet reshut litrom
Mar bereh deravna amar lomar sheen cholkin lah maaser bevet haggeranot hanicha leman deamar mishshum yichud ella leman deamar mishshum gerusha gerusha bat levi mi la achla bemaaser
Velitamach gerusha bat kohen mi la achla bitruma ella gezera mishshum gerusha bat yisrael
I hachi may irya meoreset afilu nesua name ayede ditna resha meoreset tena name sefa meoreset
Tanu rabbanan teruma lechohen umaaser rishon lelevi divre rabbi akiva rabbi elazar ben azarya omer
b: Lechohen lechohen velo lelevi ema af lechohen may tama derabbi akiva dichtiv veel halviyyim tedabber veamarta alehem bilviyyim ka mishtae kera veidach kidrabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi beesrim vearbaa mekomot nikreu kohanim leviyyim veze echad mehem vehakkohanim halviyyim bene tzadok

Verabbi akiva hacha la matzet amratte dichtiv vaachaltem oto bechol makom mi sheyyachol leochlo bechol makom yatza kohen sheen yachol leochlo bevet hakkevarot veidach kol hecha devae dela bae choma vei achel leh betumat hagguf la lake
Hahi ginta dahava shakel rabbi elazar ben azarya maaser rishon minah azal rabbi akiva ahdereh lefitcha leve kivre amar akiva betarmilo vaana chaye
Itmar mippene ma kansu leviyyim bemaaser peligi bah rabbi yonatan vesavayya chad amar shello alu bime ezra vechad amar kede sheyyismechu kohanim alav bime tumatan

Bishlama leman deamar shello alu mishshum hachi kansinhu ella leman deamar kede sheyyismechu alav kohanim bime tumatan mishshum kohanim kansinhu lalviyyim ella kulle alma kenasa shello alu bime ezra vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar kenasa laaniyyim umar savar kohanim bime tumatan aniyyim ninhu

Bishlama leman deamar kenasa laaniyyim mishshum hachi ahdereh rabbi akiva lefitcha leve kivre ella leman deamar lechohanim ammay ahdereh lefitcha leve kivre hachi kaamar leh i deka atet betorat kenasa it lach vei ka atet betorat chalukka let lach

Umna lan dela seliku bime ezra dichtiv vaekbetzem el hannahar habba al ahava vannachane sham yamim shelosha vaavina vaam uvakkohanim umibbene levi lo matzati sham amar rav chisda battechilla lo hau meamidim shotrim ella min halviyyim shenneemar veshotrim halviyyim lifnechem achshav en maamidin shotrim ella miyyisrael shenneemar veshotrim harabbim berashechem

Matni bat yisrael shenniset lechohen tochal bitruma met velah hemennu ben tochal bitruma niset lelevi tochal bemaaser met velah hemennu ben tochal bemaaser niset leyisrael lo tochal lo bitruma velo bemaaser met velah hemennu ben lo tochal lo bitruma velo bemaaser
Met benah miyyisrael tochal bemaaser met benah millevi tochal bitruma met benah mikkohen lo tochal lo bitruma velo bemaaser

a: Bat kohen shenniset leyisrael lo tochal bitruma met velah hemennu ben lo tochal bitruma niset lelevi tochal bemaaser met velah hemennu ben tochal bemaaser niset lechohen tochal bitruma met velah hemennu ben tochal bitruma
Met benah mikkohen lo tochal bitruma met benah millevi lo tochal bemaaser met benah miyyisrael chozeret levet aviha veal zo neemar veshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel
Gema met benah millevi tochal bitruma dehadra achla mishshum benah menalan amar rabbi abba amar rav bat uvat
Keman kerabbi akiva dedaresh vave afilu tema rabbanan kulleh uvat kera yattira hu

Tanu rabbanan keshehi chozeret chozeret litruma veenah chozeret lechaze vashok amar rav chisda amar ravina bar shela may kera hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel bammuram min hakkodashim lo tochel rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh millechem velo kol lechem perat lechaze vashok

Matkef lah rame bar chama ema perat lahafarat nedarim amar rava kevar paskah tanna deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael veneder almana ugrusha yakum aleha ma talmud lomar vahalo mutzaa mikkelal av umutzaa mikkelal baal

Ella hare shemmasar haav lishluche habbaal o shemmasru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal venitarmela o nitgarsha badderech heach ani kore bah bet aviha shel zo o bet balah shel zo ella lomar lecha kevan sheyyatza shaa achat mershut haav shuv eno yachol lehafer
Rav safra amar millechem aviha tochel lechem velo basar rav pappa amar millechem aviha tochel lechem hakkanuy leaviha perat lechaze vashok demishshulchan gavoha ka zachu
Verava amar veet chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma tochlu atta uvanecha uvnotecha ittach bizman sheittecha
Amar rav adda bar ahava tana keshehi chozeret levet aviha chozeret litruma veenah chozeret lechaze vashok bishvil benah chozeret af lechaze vashok
Azal rav mardochay amrah lishmata kammeh derav ashe amar mehecha ka mitrabbeya miuvat mi adifa lah minah hatam ketivi miute hacha la ketivi miute
Bat kohen shenniset leyisrael vechu tanu rabbanan veshava el bet aviha perat leshomeret yavam kinureha perat limubberet
Vahalo din hu uma bimkom shello asa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefotrah min hayyibum asa ubbar keyalud
Makom sheasa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefoslah min hatteruma eno din shennaase ubbar keyalud
La ma li asa ubbar keyalud leinyan yibum shehare asa metim kechayyim naase ubbar keyalud leinyan teruma shello asa metim kechayyim talmud lomar kinureha perat limubberet

Veitzterich lemichtav meubberet veitzterich lemichtav vezera en lah dei ketav rachamana vezera en lah meikara chad gufa vehashta tere gufe aval meubberet demeikara chad gufa vehashta chad gufa ema techol tzericha vei ketav rachamana meubberet demeikara gufa
b: Serika vehashta gufa malya aval zera en lah demeikara gufa serika vehashta gufa serika ema la tzericha
Siman amar leh lo naase maaseha bemita naase velo naase bevalad yibbum utruma yibbum utruma siman

Amar leh rav yehuda middiskarta lerava lo naase metim kechayyim leinyan yibbum mikkal vechomer uma bemakom sheasa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefoslah min hatteruma lo asa metim kechayyim makom shello asa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefotrah min hayyibum eno din shello naase metim kechayyim
Talmud lomar deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom

Venaasa metim kechayyim leinyan teruma mikkal vechomer uma bemakom shello asa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefotrah min hayyibum asa metim kechayyim makom sheasa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefoslah min hatteruma eno din shennaase metim kechayyim talmud lomar vezera en lah veha en lah

Venaase valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni leinyan yibbum mikkal vechomer uma bemakom shello asa metim kechayyim leinyan teruma asa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni makom sheasa metim kechayyim leinyan yibbum eno din shennaase valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni talmud lomar uven en lo veha en lo

Velo naase valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni litruma mikkal vechomer ma bimkom sheasa metim kechayyim lefotrah min hayyibum lo asa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni makom shello asa metim kechayyim leinyan teruma eno din shello naase valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni talmud lomar en lah veha yesh lah
Hadaran alach yesh muttarot
Haishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam uvau veamru lah met balich veniset veachar kach ba balah tetze mizze umizze utzricha get mizze umizze
Veen lah ketubba velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot lo al ze velo al ze veim natla mizze umizze tachzir
Vehavalad mamzer mizze umizze velo ze vaze mittamme lah velo ze vaze zakkaim lo bimtziatah velo bemaase yadeha velo bahafarat nedareha

Hayeta bat yisrael nifsela min hakkehunna uvat levi min hammaaser uvat kohen min hatteruma veen yorshin shel ze veorshin shel ze yorshin et ketubbatah veim metu achiv shel ze veachiv shel ze choltzin velo meyabmin

Rabbi yose omer ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon rabbi elazar omer harishon zakkay bimtziatah uvmaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha rabbi shimon omer biatah o chalitzatah meachiv shel rishon poteret tzaratah veen havalad mimmennu mamzer
Veim nisat shello birshut mutteret lachzor lo niset al pi bet din tetze uftura min hakkorban
Lo niset al pi bet din tetze vechayyevet bekorban yippa koach bet din sheppotrah min hakkorban horuha bet din linase vehalcha vekilkela chayyevet bekorban shello hittiruha ella linase
Gema middekatane sefa nisset shello birshut mutteret lachzor lo shello birshut bet din ella beedim mikkelal deresha birshut bet din uved echad alma ed echad neeman
Utnan name huchzeku lihot massiin ed mippi ed veishsha mippi ishsha veishsha mippi eved umippi shifcha alma ed echad meheman
Utnan name ed echad omer achalta chelev vehu omer lo achalti patur tama deamar lo achalti ha ishtik meheman alma ed echad meheman middeorayeta
Mena lan detanya o hoda elav chattato velo sheyyodiuhu acherim yachol af al pi sheeno machchisho yehe patur talmud lomar o hoda elav mikkol makom

Hechi dame ilema daato tere vela ka machchish lehu kera lema li ella lav chad vechi la ka machchish leh meheman shema minah ed echad neeman umimmay demishshum dimheman dilma mishshum deka shatek ushtika kehodaa damya
Teda dekatane sefa amru shenayim achalta chelev vehu omer lo achalti patur rabbi meir mechayyev amar rabbi meir kal vachomer im heviuhu shenayim lide mita chamura lo yeviuhu lide korban hakkal
Amru lo ma im yirtze lomar mezid hayiti resha

a: May tama ka mechayevi rabbanan ilema mishshum dimheman veha tere bealma deaf al gav deka machchish lehu inhu mehemni veka patri rabbanan ella lav mishshum deishtik ushtika kehodaa damya
Ella sevara hi mide dehave achaticha safek shel chelev safek shel shumman vaata ed echad veamar bari li deshumman hu dimheman
Mi dame hatam la itachzak isura hacha itachzak isura deeshet ish veen davar shebbeerva pachot mishshenayim

Ha la damya ella lachaticha devadday chelev vaata ed echad veamar bari li deshumman hava dela meheman mi dame hatam afilu atu be mea la mehemni hacha kevan dechi atu be tere mehemni chad name lehemneh mide dehave attevel hekdesh vekunamot
Hay tevel hechi dame i dideh mishshum divyado letakkeno ella deacher may kasavar
I ka savar torem mishshello al shel chavero eno tzarich daat bealim mishshum divyado letakkeno vei kasavar tzarich daat bealim veamar ana yadana beh dimtakkan hi gufah menalan
Hekdesh name i kedushshat damim mishshum divyado lifdoto i kedushshat hagguf i dideh mishshum divyado leitshole aleh ella deacher veamar yadana beh deitshil mareh aleh hi gufah menalan

Kunamot name i kasavar yesh meila bekunamot ukdushshat damim nachata lehu mishshum divyado lifdoto vei kasavar en meila bekunamot veisur bealma hu derachev lehu akkatpeh i dideh mishshum divyado leitshole aleh
Ella deacher veamar ana yadana deitshil mareh aleh hi gufah menalan
Amar rabbi zera mittoch chomer shehechmarta aleha besofah hekalta aleha battechilla la lachmar vela lakel
Mishshum iguna akkilu bah rabbanan
Tetze mizze umizze vechu amar rav lo shanu ella shenniset beed echad aval niset al pi shene edim lo tetze machachu aleh bemareva ata gavra vekae veatte amratte lo tetze la tzericha dela yadinan leh

I dela yadinan leh beed echad ammay tetze la tzericha daato be tere veamri anan havenan bahadeh mikki nefak vead hashta veattun hu dela yaditu leh dichtiv vayyakker yosef et echav vehem lo hikkiruhu veamar rav chisda melammed sheyyatza belo chatimat zakan uva bachatimat zakan
Sof sof tere utre ninhu
b: Vehabba aleha beasham taluy kae amar rav sheshet kegon shenniset leechad meedeha
Hi gufah beasham taluy kayema beomeret bari li i hachi may lememra afilu rabbi menachem berabbi yose la kaamar ella keshebbau edim veachar kach niset aval niset veachar kach bau edim la amar

Detanya shenayim omrim met ushnayim omrim la met shenayim omrim nitgarsha ushnayim omrim lo nitgarsha hare zo lo tinnase veim niset lo tetze rabbi menachem berabbi yose amar tetze amar rabbi menachem berabbi yose emat ani omer tetze bizman shebbau edim veachar kach niset aval niset veachar kach bau edim hare zo lo tetze

Ki kaamar rav name bizman shebbau edim veachar kach niset leappoke midderabbi menachem berabbi yose veika deamar tama deniset veachar kach bau edim aval bau edim veachar kach niset tetze keman kerabbi menachem berabbi yose
Metiv rava minnayin sheim lo ratza dofno talmud lomar vekiddashto beal korcho
Hechi dame ilema dela niset leechad meedeha velo kaamra bari li tzericha lememar dedofno ella lav deniset leechad meedeha vekaamra bari li vekatane dofno alma mappekinan lah mineh
Isur kehunna shane veibaet ema may dofno dofno beedim veibbaet ema keshebbau edim veachar kach niset verabbi menachem berabbi yose hi
Rav ashe omer may lo tetze dekaamar rav lo tetze meheterah harishon
Ha amrah rav chada zimna ditnan niset shello birshut mutteret lachzor lo veamar rav huna amar rav hachi hilcheta chada mikkelala dachavertah itmar
Amar shemuel lo shanu ella shello machchashto aval machchashto lo tetze bemay askinan ilema beve tere ki machchasha leh may have ella bechad tama demachchashto ha shatka tetze
Vehaamar ulla kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad hare kan shenayim veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim hacha bemay askinan bifsule edut vechidrabbi nechemya
Detanya rabbi nechemya omer kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad hallech achar rov deot veasu shette nashim beish echad kishne anashim beish echad
Veibaet ema kol hecha daata ed echad kasher meikara afilu mea nashim keed echad damyan hacha bemay askinan kegon deatya ishsha meikara

Vetartzah lidrabbi nechemya hachi rabbi nechemya omer kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad hallech achar rov deot veasu shette nashim beishsha achat kishne anashim beish echad aval shette nashim beish echad kefalga ufalga dame
Tzericha get mizze umizze bishlama merishon tive get ella mishsheni ammay zenut bealma hu

Amar rav huna gezera shemma yomru gerash ze venasa ze venimtzet eshet ish yotza bela get i hachi sefa dekatane amru lah met balich venitkaddesha veachar kach ba balah mutteret lachzor lo hatam name nema gerash ze vekiddesh ze venimtzet eshet ish yotza shello bagget
Leolam baaya get i hachi nimtza ze machazir gerushato mishshennitarsa kerabbi yose ben kipar deamar min hannissuin asura min haerusin mutteret
Ha middekatane sefa af al pi

a: Shennatan lah acharon get lo pesalah min hakkehunna mikkelal dela baaya get dei baaya get ammay lo pesalah min hakkehunna ella sefa amri kidushe taut hao
Resha name amri nisue taut hao kansuha rabbanan sefa name liknesuha resha daavada isura kansuha sefa dela avada isura la kansuha rabbanan
En lah ketubba may tama takkinu lah rabbanan ketubba kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah ha tehe kalla beenav lehotziah
En lah perot velo mezonot velo belaot tenay ketubba kichtubba dame
Natla mizze umizze peshita mahu detema kevan detafsa la mappekinan minah ka mashma lan

Havalad mamzer tenan hatam en tormin min hattame al hattahor veim taram beshogeg terumato teruma bemezid lo asa velo kelum may lo asa velo kelum amar rav chisda lo asa velo kelum kol ikar daafilu hahu geriva hadar letivleh
Rav natan berabbi oshaya amar lo asa velo chelum letakken et hashshirayim aval teruma have rav chisda la amar kerav natan berabbi oshaya dei amratte have teruma zimnin defasha vela mafresh
May shena meha ditnan hattorem kishut venimtzet mara avattiach venimtzet saruach teruma veyachazor veyitrom shogeg ammezid karamet shogeg la avad isura mezid kaaved isura
Urmi shogeg ashshogeg hacha katane beshogeg terumato teruma hatam katane teruma veyachzor veyitrom
Hatam shogeg karov lemezid deibi leh lemitameh
Urmi mezid ammezid hacha katane bemezid lo asa kelum hatam tenan hattorem mishsheen nakuv al nakuv teruma veyachzor veyitrom
Bitre mane tzayet bechad mana la tzayet
Ulrav natan berabbi oshaya deamar lo asa velo chelum letakken shirayim aval teruma have
b: May shena meha ditnan min hannakuv al sheen nakuv terumato teruma velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma umaaser mimmakom acher
Shane hacha demiddeorayeta teruma meallayeta hi kidrabbi ilay deamar rabbi ilay minnayin lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma dichtiv velo tisu alav chet baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu
Veim en kadosh nesiut chet lamma mikan lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma

Amar leh rabba lerav chisda ledidach deamratte lo asa velo kelum kol ikar daafilu hahu geriva hadar letivleh may tama gezera dilma pasha vela mafresh mi ika mide demiddeorayeta have teruma umishshum dilma pasha appekuh rabbanan lechullin vechi bet din matnin laakor davar min hattora
Amar leh veatte la tisbera vehatnan havalad mamzer mizze umizze bishlama mishsheni mamzer ella merishon ammay ishto hi veyisrael mealleya hu veka sharenan leh bemamzeret
Amar leh hachi amar shemuel asur bemamzeret vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan asur bemamzeret veammay kare leh mamzer leosro bevat yisrael

Shelach leh rav chisda lerabba beyad rav acha bar rav huna veen bet din matnin laakor davar min hattora vehatanya meematay adam yoresh et ishto ketanna bet shammay omrim mishshettaamod bekomatah uvet hillel omrim mishshettikkanes lachuppa rabbi eliezer omer mishshettibbael veorshah umitamme lah veochelet begino teruma

Bet shammay omrim mishshettaamod bekomatah af al gav delo nichnesa lachuppa ema mishshettaamod bekomatah vetikkanes lachuppa vehachi kaamru leh bet shammay levet hillel dekaamritu mishshettikkanes lachuppa i amda bekomatah mahneya lah chuppa vei la la mahneya lah chuppa
Rabbi eliezer omer mishshettibbael vehaamar rabbi eliezer en maase ketanna kelum ema mishshettagdil vetibbael
Katane mihat yorshah veha hacha demiddeorayeta avuha yaret lah umidderabbanan yaret lah baal hefker bet din hefker
Deamar rabbi yitzchak minnayin shehefker bet din hefker shenneemar kol asher lo yavo lishloshet hayyamim baatzat hassarim vehazzekenim yochoram kol rechusho vehu yibbadel mikkehal haggola

Rabbi elazar amar mehacha elle hannechalot asher nichalu elazar hakkohen vihoshua bin nun verashe haavot lemattot bene yisrael vechi ma inyan rashim etzel avot ella lomar lach ma avot manchilin benehem kol ma sheyyirtzu af rashim manchilin et haam kol ma sheyyirtzu
Umitamme lah veha hacha demiddeorayeta aviha mitamme lah umidderabbanan mitamme lah baal mishshum dehaveya lah met mitzva
Umi haveya met mitzva vehatanya e zehu met mitzva kol sheen lo kovrin kore vaacherim onin oto en ze met mitzva hacha name kevan dela yarti lah karya vela anu lah

a: Veochelet begino teruma bitruma derabbanan ta shema achal teruma temea meshallem chullin tehorim shilem chullin temeim somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir beshogeg tashlumav tashlumin bemezid en tashlumav tashlumin vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze tashlumav tashlumin vechozer umshallem chullin tehorin
Vehavenan bah bemezid en tashlumav tashlumin tavo alav beracha daachal mineh mide dela kachaze leh bime tumato veka meshallem mide dekachaze leh bime tumato

Veamar rava veamri lah kedi chassore michassera vehachi katane achal teruma temea meshallem kal dehu achal teruma tehora meshallem chullin tehorin shilem chullin temeim somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir beshogeg tashlumav tashlumin bemezid en tashlumav tashlumin vachachamim omrim ben beshogeg ben bemezid tashlumav tashlumin vechozer umshallem chullin tehorin
Veha hacha demiddeorayeta tashlume mealleya have dei mekaddesh behu kohen ishsha tafsu lah kidushe vaamur rabbanan en tashlumav tashlumin vekasharenan eshet ish lealma
May en tashlumav tashlumin dekaamar rabbi meir devae lemehdar shallome chullin tehorin i hachi somchos hayenu rabbanan
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika kansu shogeg attu mezid ika benayehu
Ta shema dam shennitma uzrako beshogeg hurtza bemezid lo hurtza

Veha hacha demiddeorayeta artzoye meratztze detanya al ma hatztzitz meratztze al haddam veal habbasar veal hachelev shennitma ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon ben beyachid ben betzibbur veamri rabbanan lo hurtza veka hadar meayyel chullin laazara
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina may lo hurtza dekaamar lehattir basar baachila aval bealim nitkapperu bo
Sof sof kamitakkera achilat basar uchtiv veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem melammed shehakkohanim ochlim uvalim mitkapperim amar leh shev veal taase shane
b: Amar leh beay leotovach arel hazzaa
Veizmel sadin betzitzit
Vechivse atzeret veshofar
Velulav hashta deshannit lan shev veal taase la miakar hu kullehu name shev veal taase ninhu
Ta shema elav tishmaun afilu omer lecha avor al achat mikkol mitzot shebbattora kegon eliyyahu behar hakkarmel hakkol lefi shaa shema lo
Shane hatam dichtiv elav tishmaun veligmar mineh migdar milta shane
Ta shema bittelo mevuttal divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer eno yachol lo levattelo velo lehosif al tenao im ken ma koach bet din yafe
Veha hacha demiddeorayeta batel get umishshum ma koach bet din ka sharenan eshet ish lealma man dimkaddesh addata derabbanan mekaddesh veafkeinhu rabbanan lekidushin
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe hatinach dekaddesh bechaspa kaddesh bevia may ika lememar shavveuh rabbanan livilato beilat zenut

Ta shema amar rabbi elazar ben yaakov shamati shebbet din makkin veonshin shello min hattora velo laavor al divre tora ella laasot seyag lattora umaase beadam echad sherachav al sus bashshabbat bime yevanim veheviuhu levet din uskaluhu lo mippene sherauy lechach ella shehashshaa tzericha lechach
Veshuv maase beadam echad shehetiach beishto tachat hatteena veheviuhu levet din vehilkuhu lo mippene sherauy lechach ella shehashshaa tzericha lechach migdar milta shane
Velo ze vaze metammein lah menalan dichtiv ki im lishero hakkarov elav veamar mar sheero zo ishto
Uchtiv lo yittamma baal beammav lehechallo yesh baal shemmitamme veyesh baal sheen mitamme ha ketzad mitamme hu leishto keshera veeno mitamme leishto pesula
Velo ze vaze zakkain bimtziatah vechu tama may amur rabbanan metziat ishsha levalah ki hechi dela tihve leh eva hacha tihve leh eva veeva
Uvmaase yadeha tama may amri rabbanan maase yadeha levalah mishshum dekaachla mezone hacha kevan dimzone let lah maase yadeha lav dideh
Velo mefer nedareha tama may amar rachamana baal mefer kede shello titganne hacha titganne vetitganne
Hayeta bat yisrael nifsela min hakkehunna vechu

a: Peshita bat levi min hammaaser itztericha leh
Uvat levi min hammaaser mi mipasla biznut vehatanya leviyya shennishbet o shennivala beilat zenut notnin lah maaser veochelet amar rav sheshet kenasa
Bat kohen min hatteruma afilu bitruma derabbanan
Veen yorshav shel ze veorshav shel ze yorshin ketubbatah vechu ketubba may avidtah amar rav pappa ketubbat benin dichrin
Peshita mahu detema ledidah daavada isura kansuha rabbanan lezarah la kenasu rabbanan ka mashma lan

Achiv shel ze veachiv shel ze choltzin velo meyabmin achiv shel rishon choletz middeorayeta vela meyabem midderabbanan achiv shel sheni choletz midderabbanan vela meyabem la middeorayeta vela midderabbanan
Rabbi yose omer ketubbatah al nichse balah vechu amar rav huna batrae modu lekammae kammae la modu levatrae

Rabbi shimon mode leh lerabbi elazar dema bia deikar isura la kanes vechol shekken metziatah umaase yadeha demamona hu verabbi elazar la mode leh lerabbi shimon metziatah umaase yadeha demamona hu la kanes aval bia deisura hu kanes

Vetarvayehu modu leh lerabbi yose hane deyatva tuteh la kanes vechol shekken ketubba dilmishkal umipak kae verabbi yose la mode lehu ketubba dilmishkal umipak hu dela kanes aval hane deyatva tuteh kanes
Rabbi yochanan amar kammae modu levatrae batrae la modu lekammae rabbi yose mode leh lerabbi elazar ketubba demiddideh ledidah la kanes vechol shekken metziatah umaase yadeha demiddidah ledideh
Verabbi elazar la mode leh metziatah umaase yadeha hu demiddidah ledideh la kanes aval ketuva demiddideh ledidah kanes
Vetarvayehu modu leh lerabbi shimon uma hane demechayyim la kansi bia dilachar mita lo kol shekken verabbi shimon la mode lehu bia hu dilachar mita la kanes aval hane demechayyim kanes

Nisset shello birshut vechu amar rav huna amar rav hachi hilcheta amar leh rav nachman gannava gannove lema lach i sevira lach kerabbi shimon ema halacha kerabbi shimon dishmatach kerabbi shimon kaazla
Vechi tema i amena halacha kerabbi shimon mashma afilu bekammayeta ema halacha kerabbi shimon baacharona kashya
Amar rav sheshet amena ki nayem veshachev rav amrah leha shemateta halacha mikkelal difligi may hava lah lemibad menas anisa
Veod tanya kol araot shebbattora en tzerichot hemennu get chutz meeshet ish shenniset al pi bet din al pi bet din hu devaaya gita al pi edim la baaya gita
Manni ilema rabbi shimon al pi bet din mi baaya get vehatanya rabbi shimon omer asu bet din behoraatan kizdon ish beishsha al pi edim keshiggat ish beishsha ide veidi la baaya get
Ella lav rabbanan hi
Leolam rabbi shimon hi vetaretz hachi rabbi shimon omer asu bet din behoraatan kechauonat ish beishsha uvaaya get al pi edim keshello bechauonat ish beishsha velo baaya get
Rav ashe amar leinyan isura katane vehachi kaamar asu bet din behoraatan kizdon ish beishsha umitasra al balah al pi edim keshiggat ish beishsha vela mitasra al balah
b: Ravina amar leinyan korban katane asu bet din behoraatan kizdon ish baishsha vela matya korban al pi edim keshiggat ish beishsha umatya korban
Veibaet ema ha kammayeta rabbanan hi vetaretz hachi chutz meeshet ish veshenniset al pi bet din

Metiv ulla mi amrinan may hava lah lemibad vehatnan katav leshem malchut sheenah hogenet leshem malchut maday leshem malchut yavan levinyan habbayit lechurban habbayit haya bammizrach vechatav bammaarav bammaarav vechatav bammizrach
Tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu bah veammay lema may hava lah lemibad ibi lah leakroye legita

Amar rav shimi bar ashe ta shema hakkones et yevimto vehalcha tzaratah venisset venimtzet zo ayelonit tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu bah veammay nema may hava lah lemibad ibi lah leamtone

Amar abbaye ta shema kol araot sheamru potrot tzarotehen halchu tzarot venisu venimtzeu ellu ayeloniyyot tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu bah veammay nema may hava lah lemibad ibi lah leamtone
Amar rava ta shema katav sofer get laish veshovar laishsha vetaa venatan get laishsha veshovar laish venatnu ze laze veze laze
Ulachar zeman hare hagget yotze mittachat yede haish veshovar mittachat yede haishsha tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu bah veammay nema may hava lah lemebad ibi lah leakroye legita
Amar rav ashe ta shema shina shemo ushmah shem iro veshem irah tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu bah veammay nema may hava lah lemibad ibi lah leakroye legita
Amar ravina ta shema kenasah beget kereach tetze mizze umizze ku ibi lah leakroye legita
Rav pappa savar lemibad ovada bemay hava lah lemibad amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa vehatanya kol hane matneyata
Amar leh velav shanninhu amar leh veashshinuye leku velismoch ufsak
Amar rav ashe ulkala la chayeshinan he kala ilema kala devatar nissuin ha amrah rav ashe chada zimna deamar rav ashe

a: Kol kala devatar nissuin la chayeshinan mahu detema hoil vaatay leve dina ushrenan kekala dekamme nissuin dame vetitsar ka mashma lan
Niset al pi bet din tetze vechu amar zeeri letah lematnitin midditnan be midresha detane be midresha horu bet din sheshshaka chamma ulvassof zarcha en zo horaa ella taut
Verav nachman amar horaa hi

Amar rav nachman teda dehoraa hi divchol hattora kullah ed echad la meheman vehacha meheman may tama lav mishshum dehoraa hi amar rava teda detaut hu deilu horu bet din bechelev uvdam lehetera vahadar chazo tama leisura ki hadri veamri lehetera la mashgechinan behu
Veilu hecha daata ed echad sherena ato tere asarna ki hadar ata ed acharina sharenan lah may tama lav mishshum detaut hu

Veaf rabbi eliezer savar detaut hu detanya rabbi eliezer omer yikkov haddin et hahar vetavi chattat shemena i amratte bishlama detaut hu mishshum hachi matya korban ella i amratte dehoraa hi ammay matya korban
Vedilma kasavar rabbi eliezer yachid sheasa behoraat bet din chayyav im ken ma yikkov haddin et hahar
Horuha bet din lehinnase ku may kilkela rabbi elazar omer zinta rabbi yochanan amar almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot
Man deamar zinta kol shekken almana lechohen gadol man deamar almana lechohen gadol aval zinta la may tama deamra attun hu deshavitun penuya
Tanya keoteh derabbi yochanan horuha bet din lehinnase vehalcha vekilkela kegon almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot chayyevet bekorban al kol bia uvia divre rabbi elazar
Vachachamim omrim korban echad al hakkol umodim chachamim lerabbi elazar sheim nisset lachamishsha bene adam shechayyevet bekorban al kol echad veechad hoil vegufin muchlakin
Matni haishsha shehalach balah uvnah limdinat hayyam uvau veamru lah met balich veachar kach met benech venisset veachar kach amru lah chiluf hau haddevarim tetze vehavalad rishon veacharon mamzer

Amru lah met benech veachar kach met balich venityabma veachar kach amru lah chiluf hau haddevarim tetze vehavalad rishon veacharon mamzer amru lah met balich veniset veachar kach amru lah kayyam haya vamet tetze vehavalad rishon mamzer vehaacharon eno mamzer

Amru lah met balich venitkaddesha veachar kach ba balah mutteret lachzor lo af al pi shennatan lah acharon get lo pesalah min hakkehunna et zo darash rabbi elazar ben matya veishsha gerusha meishah velo meish sheeno ishah
Gema may rishon umay acharon ilema rishon lifne shemua veacharon leachar shemua litne havalad mamzer
Mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa amru lah met balich venisset veachar kach amru lah kayyam haya umet harishon mamzer vehaacharon eno mamzer tena name resha rishon veacharon mamzer
Tanu rabbanan zo divre rabbi akiva shehaya omer en kiddushin tofsin bechayyave lavin aval chachamim omrim en mamzer miyevama velema en mamzer mechayyave lavin
Hay tanna hach tanna derabbi akiva hu deamar mechayyave lavin disher have mamzer mechayyave lavin geridi la have mamzer amar rav yehuda
b: Amar rav minnayin sheen kiddushin tofsin bivama shenneemar lo tihye eshet hammet hachutza leish zar lo tehe bah havaya lezar
Ushmuel amar baaniyyutenu tzericha get mesappeka leh lishmuel hay la tihye eshet hammet i lelav hu daata i dela tafsi bah kiddushin hu daata
Amar leh rav mari bar rachel lerav ashe hachi amar ammemar halacha keoteh dishmuel amar rav ashe hashta deamar ammemar hilcheta keoteh dishmuel im haya yevamah kohen choletz lah vesharya leh
Itgore itgar im ken matzinu chote niskar ella im haya yevamah yisrael noten lah sheni get vehuttera lo
Amar rav gidel amar rav chiyya bar yosef amar rav yevama kiddushin en bah nissuin yesh bah i kiddushin en bah nissuin name en bah ema kiddushin venissuin en bah
Veibaet ema may nissuin yesh bah biznut kidrav hamnuna deamar rav hamnuna shomeret yavam shezzinta asura livamah
Vei baet ema leolam kedaamaran meikara kiddushin en bah nissuin yesh bah demichallefa beishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam

Amar rabbi yannay bachavura nimnu vegamru en kiddushin tofsin bivama amar leh rabbi yochanan rabbi lo mishnatenu hi zo ditnan haomer laishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li leachar sheetgayyer leachar shettitgayeri leachar sheeshtachrer leachar shettishtachreri leachar sheyyamut balich leachar shettamut achotich o leachar sheyyachlotz lich yevamich enah mekuddeshet amar leh i lav dedallay lach chaspa mi mashkachatte marganita tuteh
Amar leh resh lakish i lav dekallesach gavra rabba hava amena lach ana matnitin rabbi akiva hi deamar en kidushin tofsin bechayyave lavin
Vei rabbi akiva ki amar lah leachar sheyyachalotz lich yevamich litpesu bah kidushe deha shaminan leh lerabbi akiva deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam ditnan

a: Kunam sheani osa leficha en tzarich lehafer
Rabbi akiva omer yafer shemma taadif alav yoter min harauy lo
Ha itmar alah amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua beomeret yikdeshu yaday leosehem deyadayim itanhu bealma

Ufliga derav nachman bar yitzchak deamar rav nachman bar yitzchak rav huna kerav verav kerabbi yannay verabbi yannay kerabbi chiyya verabbi chiyya kerabbi verabbi kerabbi meir verabbi meir kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbi eliezer ben yaakov kerabbi akiva deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam
Rav huna may hi deitmar hammocher perot dekel lachavero amar rav huna ad shello bau laolam yachol lachzor bo mishshebbau laolam en yachol lachzor bo
