Dallae dedalu davela lipol bechu setar petar dehay dedarena hu bar vaana berat achuh mashkachatte lah begoy habba al bat beno

Biyya biyya meach vehu av vehu beel vehu bar beel vehu balah deem vaana berattah deitteh vela yahev pita laachuh yatme bene veratte mashkachatte lah begoy habba al immo veholid mimmenna bat vechazar uva al otah bat vechazar zaken uva aleha veholid mimmenna banim

Ana veatte ache ana vaavuch ache ana veimmach ache mashkachatte lah begoy habba al immo veholid mimmenna shette vanot vechazar uva al achat mehen veholid mimmenna ben vekarya leh achateh deima vekaamra leh hachi

Ana veatte bene ache ana vaavuch bene ache ana veimmach bene ache ha behetera name mashkachatte lah kegon reuven sheyyesh lo shette vanot vaata shimon unsav chada minayehu vaata bar levi unsav chad minayehu vekaamar leh bereh deshimon levar bereh delevi

Matni haggiyyoret shennitgayeru baneha immah lo choltzin velo meyabmin afillu horato shel rishon shello bikdushsha veledato bikdushsha vehashsheni horato veledato bikdushsha vechen shifcha shennishtachreru baneha immah
Gema bene yudan amta ishtachrur shera lehu rav acha bar yaakov leminsav neshe dahadade amar leh rava veha rav sheshet asar amar leh hu asar vaana sharena
Min haav velo min haem kulle alma la peligi dishre min haem velo min haav kulle alma la peligi daasir
Ki peligi min haav umin haem man deshare batar abba shadenan deha bene felanya karu lehu verav sheshet karu lehu name bene felonit
Veika deamar pelig rav acha bar yaakov afilu beachin min haem umay tama ger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame
Tenan haggiyyoret shennitgayeru baneha immah lo choltzin velo meyabmin may tama lav mishshum daasiri la deenah betorat chalitza veyibum vesharya lealma veinhu name sheru

Veha katane afilu i amratte bishlama asiri hayenu dekatane afilu deaf al gav derishon horato shello bikdushsha veledato bikdushsha vehashsheni horato veledato bikdushsha vechishte immahot damu afilu hachi asiri ella i amratte sharu may afilu
Deaf al gav detarvayehu ledatan bikdushsha veate leichallofe beyisrael afilu hachi shere

Ika deamri hachi name mistabbera dishru dekatane afilu i amratte bishlama sheru hayenu dekatane afilu deaf al gav detarvayehu ledatan bikdushsha deate leichallofe beyisrael afilu hachi sheru ella i amratte asiri may afilu
Deaf al gav derishon horato shello bikdushsha veledato bikdushsha vehashsheni horato veledato bikdushsha dechishte immahot dame afilu hachi asiri

Ta shema shene achim teomim gerim vechen meshuchrarim lo choltzin velo meyabmin veen chayyavin mishshum eshet ach hayeta horatan shello bikdushsha veledatan bikdushsha lo choltzin velo meyabmin aval chayyavin mishshum eshet ach hayeta horatan veledatan bikdushsha hare hen keyisreelim lechol divrehen katane mihat en chayyavin mishshum eshet ach chiyyuva leka

a: Ha isura ika hu haddin daafilu isura name leka veayede devae lemitne sefa aval chayyavin tanna name resha en chayyavin
Amar rava ha daamur rabbanan en av legoy la tema mishshum dishtifi bezimma dela yedia aval yedia chayeshinan ella afilu didia name la chayeshinan

Deha shene achin teomim detippa achat hi venechleka lishtayim vekatane sefa lo choltzin velo meyabmin shema minah afkore afkereh rachamana lezareh dichtiv besar chamorim besaram vezirmat susim zirmatam

Ta shema deamar rabbi yose maase beniftayim hagger shennasa eshet achiv meimmo uva maase lifne chachamim veamru en ishut lagger veella ger dekaddesh hachi name la tafsi bah kidushin ella ema en issur eshet ach lagger may lav denasvah ach keshehu ger
La denasvah keshehu goy keshehu goy may lememra mahu detema ligzor keshehu goy attu keshehu ger ka mashma lan

Ta shema deamar ben yasyan keshehalachti lichrakke hayyam matzati ger echad shennasa eshet achiv meimmo amarti lo beni mi hirshecha amar li hare ishsha veshiva baneha al safsal ze yashav rabbi akiva veamar shene devarim ger nose eshet achiv meimmo veamar vayehi devar Adonai el yona shenit lemor shenit dibbera immo shechina shelishit lo dibbera immo shechina katane mihat ger nose eshet achiv meimmo may lav denasvah achiv keshehu ger
La denasvah keshehu goy may lememra mahu detema nigzor keshehu goy attu keshehu ger ka mashma lan
Umi meheman vehaamar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav kol talmid chacham shemmore halacha uva im kodem maase amarah shomin lo veim lav en shomin lo
Ibaet ema more uva haya veibaet ema mishshum dekaamar hare ishsha veshiva baneha veibaet ema shane hacha dekaamar maase acharina bahadeh

Amar mar vayehi devar Adonai el yona shenit lemor shenit dibbera immo shechina shelishit lo dibbera immo veha ketiv hu heshiv et gevul yisrael millevo chamat ad yam haarava kidvar Adonai asher dibber beyad avdo yona ven amittay hannavi

Amar ravina al iske ninve kaamar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar hachi kaamar kidvar Adonai asher dibber beyad avdo hannavi keshem shennehpach leninve meraa letova kach bime yarovam ben yoash nehefach lahem leyisrael meraa letova
Ta shema ger shehaya ledato bikdushsha vehorato shello bikdushsha yesh lo sheer haem veen lo sheer haav ketzad nasa achoto min haem yotzi min haav yekayyem achot haav min haem yotzi
b: Min haav yekayyem achot haem min haem yotzi min haav rabbi meir omer yotzi vachachamim omrim yekayyem shehaya rabbi meir omer kol erva shehi mishshum sheer haem yotzi mishshum haav yekayyem
Umuttar beeshet achiv meimmo uveshet achi aviv ushar kol haaraot muttarot lo leetoye eshet haav
Nasa ishsha uvittah kones achat umotzi achat lechattechilla lo yichnos meta ishto muttar bachamoto veika detane asur bachamoto
Katane mihat muttar beeshet achiv may lav denasvah achiv keshehu ger la denasvah keshehu goy may lememra mahu detema ligzor keshehu goy attu keshehu ger ka mashma lan

Amar mar nasa ishsha uvittah kones achat umotzi achat lechattechilla lo yichnos hashta appoke mappek lechattechilla mibaya hatam kae vehachi kaamar hach daamur rabbanan yekayyem lechattechilla lo yichnos
Meta ishto muttar bachamoto veika detane asur bachamoto chada kerabbi yishmael vachada kerabbi akiva

Man deasar kerabbi yishmael deamar chamoto leachar mita beisura kayema vegabbe ger gezaru beh rabbanan uman deshare kerabbi akiva deamar chamoto leachar mita kelash leh isura vegabbe ger la gezaru beh rabbanan
Matni chamesh nashim shennitarvu valdotehen higdilu hattaarovot venasu nashim umetu arbaa choltzin leachat veechad meyabem otah
Hu ushlosha choltzin leachat veechad meyabem nimtzeu arba chalitzot veyibum lechol achat veachat
Gema vedaveka michlatz vahadar yabbome aval yabbome beresha la dekafaga bivama lashshuk
May hu ushlosha choltzin leachat dela tema leyabbeminhu chad lechullehu ella kol chad vechad meyabem chada dilma mitramya leh dideh

Miktzatan achin umiktzatan sheen achin haachin choltzin vesheen achin meyabmin may kaamar amar rav safra hachi kaamar miktzatan achin min haav umiktzatan achin min haem achin min haem choltzin veachin min haav meyabmin
Miktzatan kohanim umiktzatan sheenan kohanim kohanim choltzin sheenan kohanim meyabmin miktzatan kohanim umiktzatan achin min haem ellu vaellu choltzin velo meyabmin

a: Tanu rabbanan yesh choletz leimmo missafek laachoto missafek levitto missafek

Ketzad immo veishsha acheret velahen shene zecharim vechazru veyaldu shene zecharim bemachave uva benah shel zo venasa immo shel ze uvnah shel zo nasa immo shel ze umetu belo banim ze choletz lishtehen veze choletz lishtehen nimtza kol echad veechad choletz leimmo missafek
Laachoto missafek ketzad immo veishsha acheret sheyyaldu shette nekevot bemachave uvau achehen shello meotah haem unsaum umetu belo banim choletz lishtehen nimtza choletz laachoto missafek
Levitto missafek ketzad ishto veishsha acheret sheyyaldu shette nekevot bemachave uvau achehen unsaum umetu belo banim ze choletz levitto missafek veze choletz levitto missafek
Tanya haya rabbi meir omer ish veishsha peamim shemmolidin chamesh ummot

Ketzad yisrael shellakach eved veshifcha min hashshuk velahen shene vanim venitgayyer echad mehen nimtza echad ger veechad goy hitbilan leshem avdut venizkeku ze laze hare kan ger vegoy veeved shichrer et hashshifcha uva aleha haeved hare kan ger vegoy veeved umamzer shichrer shenehem vehissian ze laze hare kan ger vegoy veeved umamzer veyisrael
May ka mashma lan goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer

Tanu rabbanan yesh mocher et aviv lehagbot immo ketubbatah ketzad yisrael lakach eved veshifcha min hashshuk velahem ben veshichrer et hashshifcha unsaah veamad vechatav kol nechasav livnah nimtza ze mocher et aviv lehagbot leimmo ketubbatah
May ka mashma lan kullah rabbi meir hi veavda mittaltele umittaltele mishtabedi lichtuva veibaet ema ha kamashma lan avda kimkarka dame
Matni haishsha shennitarev veladah bivelad kallatah higdilu hattaarovot venasu nashim umetu bene hakkalla choltzin velo meyabmin shehu safek eshet achiv safek eshet achi aviv
Bene hazzekena o choltzin o meyabmin shehu safek eshet achiv veeshet ben achiv
Metu hakkesherim hattaarovot livne hazzekena choltzin velo meyabmin shehu safek eshet achiv veeshet achi aviv livne hakkalla echad choletz veechad meyabem
Kohenet shennitarev veladah bivelad shifchatah hare ellu ochlim bitruma vecholkin chelek echad baggoren
b: Veenan mittammein lemetim veenan nosin nashim ben kesherot ben pesulot higdilu hattaarovot veshichreru ze et ze nosin nashim reuot lakkehunna
Veenan metammein lemetim veim nitmeu enan sofgin haarbaim veenan ochlin bitruma veim achlu enan meshallemin keren vachomesh veenan cholkin al haggoren umochrin et hatteruma vehaddamim shellahen
Veenan cholkin bekodshe hammikdash veen notnim lahem kadashim veen motziin shellahem midehem
Ufturin min hazzeroa umin hallechayayim umin hakkeva uvchoro yehe roe ad sheyyistaev venotnin alav chumre chohanim vechumre yisreelim
Gema metu hakkesherim vechu ella hanach mishshum deiaruv lehu hau lehu pesulin amar rav pappa ema umetu havaddain
Livne hakkalla echad choletz vechu daveka michlatz vahadar yabbome aval yabbome beresha la dekafaga bivama lashshuk
Kohenet shennitarev vechu chelek echad peshita ema chelek keechad

Tenan keman deamar en cholkin teruma leeved ella im ken rabbo immo detanya en cholkin teruma leeved ella im ken rabbo immo divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer yachol sheyyomar im kohen ani tenu li bishvil atzmi veim eved kohen ani tenu li bishvil rabbi
Bimkomo shel rabbi yehuda hau maalin mitteruma leuchasin bimkomo shel rabbi yose lo hau maalin mitteruma leuchasin
Tanya amar rabbi elazar bar tzadok miyyamay lo headti ella edut echad veheelu eved lakkehunna al pi
Heelu salka datach hashta behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadan tzaddikim atzman lo kol shekken
Ella ema bikkeshu lehaalot eved lakkehunna al pi chaza beatreh derabbi yose vaazal veashed beatreh derabbi yehuda

Tanu rabbanan asara en cholkin lahem teruma bevet haggoranot veellu hen cheresh shote vekatan tumtum veanderoginos vehaeved vehaishsha vehearel vehattame venose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo vechullan meshaggerin lahem levattehem chutz mittame venose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo
Bishlama cheresh shote vekatan lav bene dea ninhu tumtum veanderoginos name

a: Beriyya bifne atzmah ninhu eved name dilma ate leassoke mitteruma leuchasin arel vetame mishshum dimisi nose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo mishshum kenasa ella ishsha may tama la
Peligi bah rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua chad amar mishshum gerusha vechad amar mishshum yichud
May benayehu ika benayehu be dare dimkarav lemata vela shechichi behu inashe i name dimrachak ushchichi beh inashe
Vechullan meshaggerin lahem levattehen chutz mittame venose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo aval arel meshaggerinan leh may tama
Mishshum daanis tame name ha anis hay nefish unseh vehay la nefish unseh
Tanu rabbanan haeved vehaishsha en cholkin lahem teruma bevet haggoranot uvmakom shecholkin notnin laishsha techilla ufotrin otah miyyad may kaamar
Hachi kaamar bemakom shecholkin masar ani notnin leishsha techilla may tama mishshum ziluta
Amar rava meresha ki hao atu gavra veitteta ledina kammay hava sharena tigra degavra beresha amena demichayyav bemitzot kevan dishmana leha sharena tigra deitteta beresha may tama mishshum ziluta
Higdilu hattaarovot vechu shichreru i bae in i la bae la veammay lisa shifcha eno yachol bat chorin eno yachol amar rava ema kofin otan umshachrerin ze et ze
Notnin alehem chumre vechu lemay hilcheta amar rav pappa leminchatam nikmetzet keminchat yisrael veenah neechelet keminchat kohanim ha ketzad hakkometz karev beatzmo vehashshirayim kerevin beatzman
Ikri kan kol shemmimmennu laishim hare hu beval taktiru
Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi demassek lehu leshum etzim kerabbi elazar detanya rabbi elazar omer lereach nichoach i atta maale aval atta maale leshum etzim

Hanicha lerabbi elazar ella lerabbanan may ika lememar deaved lah kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon detanya rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer hakkometz karev leatzmo vehashshirayim mitpazzerin al bet haddeshen vaafilu rabbanan la peligi aleh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon ella beminchat chote shel kohanim devat hakrava hi aval hacha afilu rabbanan modu

Matni mi shello shahata achar baalah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda veen yadua im ben tisha larishon im bin shiva laacharon hau lah banim min harishon uvanim min hashsheni choltzin velo meyabmin vechen hu lahem choletz velo meyabem
b: Hau lo achim min harishon veachim min hashsheni shello meotah haem hu choletz umyabem vehem echad choletz veechad meyabem

Haya echad yisrael veechad kohen nose ishsha reuya lechohen veen mittamme lemetim veim nitma eno sofeg et haarbaim eno ochel bitruma veim achal eno meshallem keren vachomesh veeno cholek al haggoren umocher hatteruma vehaddamim shello

Veeno cholek bekodshe hakkodashim veen notnin lo et hakkodashim veen motziin et shello miyyado ufatur min hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva uvchoro yehe roe ad sheyyistaev venotnin alav chumre kohanim vechumre yisreelim
Hau shenehem kohanim hu onen alehem vehem onnim alav hu eno mittamme lahem vehem enan metammeim lo hu eno yoresh otan aval hem yorshin oto
Ufatur al makkato veal killato shel ze veshel ze ole bemishmaro shel ze veshel ze veeno cholek im hau shenehem bemishmar echad notel chelek echad
Gema daveka michlatz vahadar yabbome aval yabbome beresha la deka faga bivama lashshuk
Amar shemuel asara kohanim omdim uferash echad mehem uvaal havalad shetuki may shetuki ilema shemmeshattekin oto minnichse aviv peshita mi yadinan avuh mannu ella shemmeshattekin oto middin kehunna
May tama amar kera vehayeta lo ulzaro acharav baenan zaro meuchas acharav veleka
Matkef lah rav pappa ella meatta gabbe avraham dichtiv lihot lecha lelohim ulzaracha acharecha hatam may ka mazhar leh rachamana hachi kaamar leh la tinsav goya veshifcha dela lezil zarach batrah
Metivi rishon rauy lihot kohen gadol veha baenan zaro meuchas acharav veleka zaro meuchas acharav derabbanan ukra asmachta bealma vechi gezur rabbanan biznut benissuin la gezur rabbanan
Uviznut mi gezur rabbanan vehatnan mi shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda

May achar balah ilema achar mitat balah ema sefa hu onen alehem vehem onnim alav bishlama hu onen alehem mashkachatte lah benissuin desheni velikut atzamot dekamma ella hem onnim alav hechi mashkachatte lah kamma ha mit leh

Veella bigrusha umay achar balah achar get balah ema sefa hu en mittamme lahem vehem enan mittammein lo bishlama hen en mittammein lo lechumra dechol chad vechad dilma lav bereh hu ella hu en mittamme lahem ammay
Bishlama lesheni la litamme leh ella lerishon litamme leh mimma nafshach i bereh hu shappir ka mittamme leh vei bar batra hu shappir ka mittamme leh dechalal hu
Ella lav biznut umay achar balah achar boalah vekatane sefa ole bemishmar shel ze veshel ze utuvta dishmuel
Amar rav shemaya bimmaenet

Memaenet mi ka yalda vehatane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman shalosh nashim meshammeshot bemoch ketanna meubberet umnika ketanna shemma titabber vetamut meubberet shemma taase ubbarah sandal menika shemma tigmol et benah veyamut veezo hi ketanna mibbat achat esre shana veom echad ad bat shettem esre shana veom echad pachot miken o yater al ken meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim achat zo veachat zo meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet umin hashshamayim yerachamu shenneemar shomer petaim Adonai
Mashkachatte lah bekidushe taut vechidrav yehuda amar shemuel deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi yishmael vehi lo nitpasa asura ha nitpasa mutteret
Veyesh lecha acheret sheaf al pi shello nitpasa mutteret vee zo zo shekkiddusheha kidushe taut sheafilu benah murkav lah al ketefah memaenet veholechet lah

a: Hau shenehem kohanim vechu tanu rabbanan hikka ze vechazar vehikka ze killel ze vechazar vekillel ze killel shenehem bevat achat hikka shenehem bevat achat chayyav rabbi yehuda omer bevat achat chayyav baze achar ze patur
Vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer patur bevat achat tere tannae alliba derabbi yehuda
May tama deman defatar amar rabbi chanina neemra beracha lematta veneemra beracha lemala ma lemala sheen bah shuttafut af lematta sheen bah shuttafut veitakkash hakkaa liklala
Veole bemishmaro vechu vechi meachar deeno cholek lamma ole lamma ole haamar baena denebed mitzva ella ala la katane ella ole beal korcho
Amar rav acha bar chanina amar abbaye amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum pegam mishpacha
Veim hau shenehem bemishmar ku may shena shene mishmarot dela deazel leha mishmara umdachu leh veazel leha mishmara umdachu leh mishmar echad name azel lehay bet av umdachu leh
Amar rav pappa hachi kaamar im hau shenehem mishmar echad uvet av echad notel chelek echad
Hadaran alach nosin al haanusa
Mitzvat chalitza bishlosha dayyanin vaafilu shelashtan hedotot chaltza beminal chalitzatah keshera beanpilya chalitzatah pesula besandal sheyyesh lo akev kasher vesheen lo akev pesul

Min haarkubba ulmatta chalitza keshera min haarkubba ulmala chalitza pesula chaltza besandal sheen shello o besandal shel etz o beshel semol beyamin chalitza keshera chaltza begadol shehu yachol lahaloch bo o bekatan shehu chofe et rov raglo chalitzatah keshera

Gema umeachar daafilu shelosha hedotot dayyanin lema li ha ka mashma lan devaenan bishlosha sheyyodim lehakrot keen dayyanim tenena leha detanu rabbanan mitzvat chalitza bishlosha sheyyodin lehakrot keen dayyanim rabbi yehuda omer bachamishsha

May tama detanna kamma detanya zekenim shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehen od echad hare kan shelosha verabbi yehuda zikne shenayim zekenim shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehen od echad hare kan chamishsha
Vetanna kamma hay zikne may aved leh mibe leh lerabboye afilu shelosha hedotot
Verabbi yehuda hedotot mena leh nafka leh milleene deamar mar leene perat lesomim

Umiddeitzterich leene lemaote somim shema minah daafilu hedotot dei salka datach sanhedrin baenan lema li lemaote somin middetane rav yosef nafka detane rav yosef keshem shebbet din menukkim betzedek kach bet din menukkim mikkol mum
b: Shenneemar kullach yafa rayati umum en bach veidach hahu leene may aved leh hahu lechidrava hu daata deamar rava tzerichi dayyane lemichze rukka deka nafek mippumma divama dichtiv leene hazzekenim veyarka
Veidach name mibe leh lechidrava in hachi name veella hedotot mena leh nafka mibbeyisrael yisrael kol dehu
Veidach hay yisrael may aved leh mibe leh lechidtane rav shemuel bar yehuda beyisrael bevet din shel yisrael velo bevet din shel gerim
Veidach beyisrael acharina ketiv veidach mibe leh lechidtanya amar rabbi yehuda paam achat hayinu yoshvin lifne rabbi tarfon uvaa yevama lachlotz veamar lanu anu kullechem chalutz hannaal
Veidach mivvenikra nafka
Ella meatta vekaru shenayim vedibberu shenayim hachi name lerabbi yehuda hare kan tisha lerabbanan hare kan shiva

Hahu mibe leh lechidtanya vekaru lo velo shelucham vedibberu elav melammed shemmassiin lo etza hahogenet lo sheim haya hu yeled vehi zekena hu zaken vehi yalda omrim lo ma lecha etzel yalda ma lecha etzel zekena kelach etzel shekkemotcha veal tachnis ketata letoch betcha
Amar rava amar rav nachman halacha chalitza bishlosha hoil ustam lan tena keoteh amar leh rava lerav nachman i hachi meun name ditnan hammeun vehachalitza bishlosha

Vechi tema hachi name vehatanya meun bet shammay omrim bet din mumchin uvet hillel omrim bevet din veshello bevet din ellu veellu modim shetztzarich shelosha rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi yose machshirin bishnayim veamar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman halacha keoto hazzug
Hatam chad setama vehacha tere setame hatam name tere setame ninhu ditnan meana o shechaltza befanav yissaenna mippene shehu bevet din
Ella hatam tere setame hacha telata setame
Mikkede ha setama veha setama ma li chad setam ma li tere setam ma li telata ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hoil ustam bimkom machloket

Ditnan semichat zekenim veegla arufa bishlosha divre rabbi yose rabbi yehuda omer bachamishsha hachalitza vehammeunin bishlosha vela kafaleg rabbi yehuda shema minah hadar beh rabbi yehuda shema minah

Amar rava tzerichi dayyane lemikba duchta dichtiv vealta yevimto hashshara el hazzekenim rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua avdi ovada bechamsha keman kerabbi yehuda veha hadar beh lefirsome milta

Rav ashe ikla leve rav kahana amar leh selek mar legabban lemalloye be chamsha amar rav kahana hava kaemna kammeh derav yehuda vaamar li ta sak lezirza dikne leitzterofe be chamsha amru lo lema li chamsha amar lehu ki hechi deliparsam milta

Rav shemuel bar yehuda hava kae kammeh derav yehuda amar leh sak ta lezirza dikne leitzterofe be chamsha lefarsome milta amar leh tenena beyisrael bevet din yisrael velo bevet din shel gerim vaana ger ana
Amar rav yehuda kegon rav shemuel bar yehuda mappekna mamona appummeh mappekna salka datach veha al pi shenayim edim amar rachamana ella marana shetara appummeh
Amar rava

a: Ger dan et chavero devar tora shenneemar som tasim alecha melech asher yivchar Adonai elohecha bo mikkerev achecha tasim alecha melech alecha hu devaenan mikkerev achecha aval ger dan et chavero ger
Veim hayeta immo miyyisrael dan afilu yisrael ulinyan chalitza ad sheyehe aviv veimmo miyyisrael shenneemar venikra shemo beyisrael
Amar rabba amar rav kahana amar rav im yavo eliyyahu veyomar choltzin beminal shomin lo en choltzin besandal en shomin lo shekkevar nahagu haam besandal
Verav yosef amar rav kahana amar rav im yavo eliyyahu veyomar en choltzin beminal shomin lo en choltzin besandal en shomin lo shekkevar nahagu haam besandal
May benayehu ika benayehu minal lechattechilla
Ulman deamar afilu lechattechilla vehatnan chaltza beminal chalitzatah keshera diavad in lechattechilla la
Hu haddin daafilu lechattechilla veayede devae lemitne sefa beanpilya chalitzatah pesula daafilu diavad tena name resha diavad

Uminal lechattechilla tannae hi detanya amar rabbi yose paam achat halachti lintzivin matzati zaken echad amarti lo kelum atta baki berabbi yehuda ben betera amar li hen veal shulchani hu tadir kelum raita shechalatz bivama
Amar li raiti shechalatz harbe peamim beminal o besandal amar li vechi choltzin beminal vehattora amra naalo velo minalo amarti lo im ken ma raa rabbi meir lomar chaltza beminal chalitzatah keshera
Rabbi yaakov omer mishshemo choltzin beminal lechattechilla uman deamar lechattechilla la may tama
Ilema mishshum dehaveya panta meal vearketa meal demeal vehattora amra meal velo meal demeal i hachi afilu diavad name la
Gezera mishshum minal meruppat
I name mishshum chatzi minal

Amar rav i lav dachameteh lechabbivi dachalatz besandal deit leh shintzin ana la havay chaletzna ella besandala detayyaa demihaddak tefe vehay didan af al gav deit beh chumarta katrinan beh mitna ki hechi detehve chalitzatah meallayeta
Siman hattarat yevama sandal amar rav yehuda amar rav hattarat yevama lashshuk bishmitat rov heakev
Metivi hutteru retzuot minal vesandal o sheshshamat rov haregel chalitzatah pesula
Tama deshamat hu ha shamta hi chalitzatah keshera rov haregel in rov heakev la
Lo hayenu rov haregel hayenu rov heakev veammay karu leh rov haregel dechulla cheyla dechara aleh dechis

Mesayya leh lerabbi yannay deamar rabbi yannay ben shehittir hu veshamta hi ben shehittira hi veshamat hu chalitzatah pesula ad shettattir hi vetashmit hi bae rabbi yannay keraathu mahu serafathu mahu galloye kara baenan vehaika o dilma chalitza baenan veleka teku

Bea mineh rabbi nechemya merabba shene minalim ze al gav ze mahu hechi dame ilema dishlafteh leilay vekae tattay meal amar rachamana velo meal demeal la tzericha dikrateh leilay ushlafteh letattay vekae ilay may chalitza baenan veha ika o dilma galloye kara baenan veleka
b: Umi ika ki hay gavena in dechazuh rabbanan lerav yehuda dinfak bechamsha zuze moke leshuka
Amar rav yehuda amar rav yevama shehigdila ben haachin mutteret linase leechad min haachin veen choshshin shemma chaltza sandal leechad mehen tama dela chazenan ha chazenan chayeshinan

Veha tanya ben shennitkaven hu velo nitkavvena hi ben shennitkavvena hi velo nitkaven hu chalitzatah pesula ad sheyyitkavvenu shenehem keechad hachi kaamar af al gav dachazenan en choshshin shemma kivvenu
Veika deamri tama dela chazenan ha chazenan choshshin udka tane bae kauona hane mile leishteroye lealma aval leachin mipasla
Amar rav yehuda amar rav sandal hattafur befishtan en choltzin bo shenneemar vaenalech tachash veema tachash in mide acharina la naal naal riba
I naal naal riba afilu kol mile name im ken tachash may ahani leh
Bea mineh rabbi elazar merav hu shel or utresiyyotav shel sear mahu amar leh mi la karenan beh vaenalech tachash i hachi kullo shel sear name hahu kurka mikkere
Amar leh rav kahana lishmuel mimmay dehay vechaltza naalo meal raglo mishlaf hu dichtiv vechilletzu et haavanim asher bahen hannaga
Veema zaroze hu dichtiv hechaltzu meittechem anashim latztzava hatam name shallofe mibbeta likrava
Vehachtiv yechalletz ani veono bischar ono yechalletzo middinah shel gehinnam
Ella ha dichtiv chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vayechalletzem bischar yereav yechalletzem middinah shel gehinnam

Ella ha dichtiv veatzmotecha yachalitz veamar rabbi elazar zo meulla shebbabberachot veamar rava zaroze garme in mashma hachi umashma hachi dehacha i salka datach zaroze hu im ken lichtov rachamana vechaltza naalo beraglo
I ketav rachamana beraglo hava amena beraglo in beshoko la ketav rachamana meal raglo daafilu beshoko im ken lichtov rachamana bemeal raglo may meal raglo shema minah mishlaf hu
Amar leh hahu mina lerabban gamliel amma dachalatz leh mareh mineh dichtiv betzonam uvivkaram yelchu levakkesh et Adonai velo yimtzau chalatz mehem
Amar leh shote mi ketiv chalatz lahem chalatz mehem ketiv veilu yevama dechaltzu lah achin mide meshasha it beh
Beanpilya chalitzatah pesula ku lememra deanpilya lav minal hu
Utnan name en hattorem nichnas lo befargod chafut velo beanpilya veen tzarich lomar beminal vesandal lefi sheen nichnasin beminal vesandal laazara
Urminhu echad minal vesandal veanpilya lo yetayyel bahen lo mibbayit levayit velo mimmitta lemitta

Amar abbaye deit beh ketite umishshum taanug amar leh rava umishshum taanug belo minal beom hakkippurim mi asiri veha rabba bar rav huna karech sudara akkareh venafek ella amar rava la kashya kan beanpilya shel or kan beanpilya shel beged

Hachi name mistabbera dei la tema hachi kashya yom hakkippurim ayyom hakkippurim detanya lo yetayyel adam bekordakesin betoch beto aval metayyel hu beanpilin betoch beto ella lav shema minah kan beanpilya shel or kan beanpilya shel beged shema minah

Tanya keoteh derava chaltza beminal hannifram shechofe et rov haregel besandal hannifchat shemmekabbel et rov haregel besandal shel shaam veshel siv bekav hakkitea bemuk bismichat haraglayim beanpilya shel or vehacholetzet min haggadol

a: Ben omed ben yoshev ben mutte vehacholetzet min hassome chalitzatah keshera aval beminal hannifram sheen chofe et rov haregel besandal hannifchat sheeno mekabbel et rov haregel uvismichat hayyadayim uvanpilya shel beged vecholetzet min hakkatan chalitzatah pesula
Kav hakkitea manni rabbi meir hi ditnan hakkitea yotze bekav shello divre rabbi meir rabbi yose oser
Beanpilya shel beged atan lerabbanan
Amar abbaye middesefa rabbanan resha name rabbanan veresha bimchuppe or
Amar leh rava aval en mechuppe or may pasul i hachi addetane sefa beanpilya shel beged liflog bedidah bamme devarim amurim bimchuppe or aval en mechuppe or pasul
Ella amar rava midderesha rabbi meir sefa name rabbi meir hay maggen vehay la maggen
Amar ammemar hay man dechaletz tzarich lemidchaseh lechareh
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar vehatanya ben omed ben yoshev ben mutte ema ulolam dedaches lechareh
Veamar ammemar hay man dimsagge al lichata dechareh la chaletz amar leh rav ashe leammemar vehatanya semichut haraglayim lav dechaletz bah ihu la deyahev leh leacher vechaletz
Amar rav ashe lemay dekaamar ammemar lav bar ova chaletz velav bar kifof chaletz
Min haarkubba ulmatta ku urminhi regalim perat levaale kabbin
Shane hacha dichtiv meal raglo i hachi lemala min haarkubba name meal vela meal demeal
Amar rav pappa shema minah hay istavira ad ara nachet dei salka datach mifsak pasek have leh ihu meal veshoka meal demeal amar rav ashe afilu tema mifsak pasek kol devahade kara kechara dame
Min haarkubba ulmala metiv rav kahana uvshilyatah hayyotzet mibben ragleha amar abbaye beshaa shekkoraat leled noetzet akeveha beyarchoteha veoledet
Ta shema lo asa raglav velo asa sefamo lishana mealleya ta shema vayyavo shaul lehasech et raglav lishana mealleya
Ta shema ach mesich hu raglav bachadar hammekera lishana mealleya ben ragleha ku lishana mealleya

Amar rabbi yochanan sheva beilot baal oto rasha beoto hayyom shenneemar ben ragleha kara nafal shachav ben ragleha kara nafal baasher kara sham nafal shadud veha ka mithanya meavera amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay kol tovatan shel reshaim
b: Raa hi etzel tzaddikim shenneemar hishshamer lecha pen tedabber im yaakov mittov ad ra bishlama ra lechayye ella tov ammay la ella shema minah tovatan shel reshaim raa hi etzel tzaddikim
Bishlama hatam dilma madkar leh shema daavoda zara ella hacha may raa ika
Deka shade bah zuhama deamar rabbi yochanan beshaa shebba nachash al chava hetil bah zuhama yisrael sheamdu al har sinay paska zuhamatan goyim shello amdu behar sinay lo paska zuhamatan
Chaltza beminal sheeno shello vechu tanu rabbanan naalo en li ella naalo naal shel kol adam minnayin talmud lomar naal naal mikkol makom
Im ken ma talmud lomar naalo naalo harauy lo perat legadol sheen yachol lahaloch bo ufrat lekatan sheeno chofe rov raglo ufrat lesandal hamsulyam sheen lo akev
Abbaye hava kae kammeh derav yosef atay yevama lachlotz amar leh hav leh sandalach yehav leh sandala dismala amar leh emar daamur rabbanan diavad lechattechilla mi amur
Amar leh i hachi sandal sheen shello name emar daamur rabbanan diavad lechattechilla mi amur amar leh hachi kaamena lach hav leh veakni leh
Sandal shel etz man tanna amar shemuel rabbi meir hi ditnan hakkitea yotze bekav shello divre rabbi meir rabbi yose oser avuh dishmuel omer bimchuppe or vedivre hakkol
Amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava sandal hammusgar lo tachalotz bo veim chaltza chalitzatah keshera sandal hammuchlat lo tachalotz bo veim chaltza chalitzatah pesula
Rav pappa mishshemeh derava amar echad sandal hammusgar veechad sandal hammuchlat lo tachalotz bo veim chaltza chalitzatah keshera
Metivi bayit hammusgar metamme mittocho muchlat mittocho umeachorav veze vaze metammein bevia
Vei salka datach kedimchattat dame veha baenan vehabba el habbayit veleka
Shane hatam deamar kera venatatz et habbayit afilu bishat netitza karuy bayit
Ta shema matlet sheyyesh bo shalosh al shalosh af al pi sheen bo kezayit kevan shennichnas rubbah levayit tahor timmeathu may lav muchletet la musgeret
I hachi ema sefa hau bah kamma zetim kevan shennichnas mimmenna kezayit levayit tahor timmeathu
I amratte bishlama muchletet hayenu deitakkash lemet ella i amratte musgeret ammay itakkash lemet
Shane hatam deamar kera vesaraf et habbeged afilu bishat serefa karuy beged
Veligmar mineh isur mittuma la gamrinan
Amar rava hilcheta echad sandal hammusgar veechad sandal hammuchlat veechad sandal shel avoda zara lo tachlotz veim chaltza chalitzatah keshera shel tikrovet avoda zara

a: Veshel ir hanniddachat veshel zaken heasuy lichvodo lo tachlotz veim chaltza chalitzatah pesula
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe may shena zaken heasuy lichvodo delav lehilucha avid deve dina name lav lehilucha avid
Amar leh ilu mesagge beh shelucha deve dina mi kafed aleh dayyana
Matni chaltza ballayela chalitzatah keshera verabbi elazar posel bismol chalitzatah pesula verabbi elazar machshir
Gema lema beha kamipalgi demar savar makkeshinan rivim lingaim umar savar la makkeshinan rivim lingaim
La dechulle alma la makkeshinan rivim lingaim dei makkeshinan afilu gemar din ballayela name la vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar chalitza kitchillat din damya umar savar chalitza kigmar din damya
Rabba bar chiyya ketosfaa avad ovada bemuk uvichidi uvallayela amar shemuel kamma rav guvreh deaved kichidaa
May kashya i muk setama tanya i layela setama tanya

Ella yechidi ka kashya leh hechi aved bichidi dichidaa katane lah ditnan chaltza bishnayim o bishlosha venimtza echad mehen karov o pasul chalitzatah pesula verabbi shimon verabbi yochanan hassandelar machshirim umaase beechad shechalatz beno levenah bevet haasurim uva maase lifne rabbi akiva vehichshir

Veamar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman en halacha keoto hazzug veibaet ema kullehu name yechidaa katane lehu detanya amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose ani raiti et rabbi yishmael ben elisha shechalatz bemuk bichidi uvallayela
Bismol chalitzatah ku may tama derabbanan amar ulla yalfinan regel regel mimmetzora ma lehallan deyamin af kan deyamin
Verabbi elazar la yalef regel regel mimmetzora vehatanya rabbi elazar omer minnayin lirtzia shehi beozen hayemanit neemar kan ozen veneemar lehallan ozen ma lehallan yamin af kan yamin
Amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan muchlefet hashshita
Rava amar leolam la tefoch ozen ozen mufne regel regel la mufne
Vechi la mufne may pircha ika ika lemifrach ma limtzora shekken taun etz erez veezov ushni tolaat

Matni chaltza verakka aval lo kara chalitzatah keshera kara verakka aval lo chaltza chalitzatah pesula chaltza vekara aval lo rakka rabbi eliezer omer chalitzatah pesula rabbi akiva omer chalitzatah keshera
b: Amar rabbi eliezer kacha yease kol davar shehu maase meakkev amar leh rabbi akiva mishsham reaya kacha yease laish kol davar shehu maase baish

Hacheresh shennechlatz vehachereshet shechaltza vecholetzet lekatan chalitzatah pesula ketanna shechaltza tachlotz mishshettagdil veim lo chaltza chalitzatah pesula chaltza bishnayim o bishlosha venimtza echad mehen karov o pasul chalitzatah pesula rabbi shimon verabbi yochanan hassandelar machshirin umaase beechad shechalatz beno levenah bevet haasurim uva maase lifne rabbi akiva vehichshir
Gema amar rava hashta deamratte keria la meakkeva lefichach illem veillemet shechaltzu chalitzatan keshera
Tenan cheresh shennechlatz vehachereshet shechaltza vehacholetzet min hakkatan chalitzatah pesula may tama lav mishshum dela bene keriyya ninhu la mishshum delav bene dea ninhu
I hachi illem veillemet name amar rava illem veillemet bene dea ninhu ufummayehu hu dechaev lehu
Veha amri deve rabbi yannay lefi sheeno beamar veamra ella ki ittemar derava assefa ittemar cheresh shennechlatz vehachereshet shechaltza vehacholetzet min hakkatan chalitzatah pesula
Amar rava hashta deamratte keriyya meakkeva lefichach illem veillemet shechaltzu chalitzatan pesula umatnitin kerabbi zera
Deamar rabbi zera kol harauy levila en bila meakkevet bo vechol sheen rauy levila bila meakkevet
Shelachu leh laavuh dishmuel yevama sherakka tachlotz mikkelal deipasla lah meachin
Manni ilema rabbi akiva hashta uma bimkom mitzva deika lememar mide dehave aemurim dechi letanhu la meakkevi
Vechi itanhu meakkevi
Amar rabbi akiva la meakkeva meachin ipasla
Veella lerabbi elazar
Veha shene devarim hammattirin ninhu ushne devarim hammattirin en maalin ze belo ze
Ella kerabbi detanya kivse atzeret en mekaddeshin hallechem ella bishchita

Ketzad shechatan lishman vezarak daman lishman kadash hallechem shachat shello lishman vezarak lishman lo kadash hallechem shechatan lishman vezarak daman shello lishman kadosh veeno kadosh divre rabbi
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer leolam eno kadosh ad sheyyishchot lishman veyizrok daman lishman
Umi amar rabbi akiva rekika la pasla vehatanya chaltza velo

a: Rakka velo kara chalitzatah keshera rakka velo chaltza velo kara chalitzatah pesula kara velo rakka velo chaltza en kan bet mechosh

Manni ilema rabbi eliezer chaltza velo rakka velo kara chalitzatah keshera veha amar rabbi eliezer kacha yease davar shehu maase meakkev ella peshita rabbi akiva vekatane rakka velo chaltza velo kara chalitzatah pesula leman
Ilema lealma peshita mi haveya chalitza deishtarya lealma ella lav laachin shema minah
Ulrabbi akiva may shena rekika umay shena keriyya
Keriyya deitah ben battechilla ben bassof la michallefa leh rekika devitchilla letah velivsof itah michallefa leh veatu lemishre chalutza laachin

Veika deamri hachi shelachu leh yevamah sherakka tachlotz veenah tzericha larok paam acheret ki hahi daatay lekammeh derabbi amme hava yatev rabbi abba bar memel kammeh rekaka mikkamme detachlotz amar leh rabbi amme chalotz lah ushre lah tigra
Amar leh rabbi abba veha baenan merak ha rekaka lah veterok uma bechach nafek mineh churba dei amratte tihdar veterok amri rekika kammayeta let bah meshasha veate lemishre chalutza laachin
Veha baenan kesidran kesidran la meakkeva hu savar dachoye ka medache leh nefak dak veashkach detanya ben shehikdim chalitza lirkika ben shehikdim rekika lachalitza ma sheasa asuy
Levi nefak lekiryata beo mineh gidemet mahu shettachlotz yevama sherakka dam mahu aval aggid lecha et harashum bichtav emet mikkelal deika ketav sheeno emet
La hava bideh ata shael be midresha amaru leh mi ketiv vechaltza bayyad umi ketiv veyarka rok
Aval aggid lach harashum bichtav emet vechi yesh ketav sheeno emet
La kashya kan bigzar din sheyyesh immo shevua kan bigzar din sheen immo shevua

Kidrav shemuel bar amme deamar rav shemuel bar amme amar rabbi yonatan minnayin ligzar din sheyyesh immo shevua sheeno mitkarea shenneemar lachen nishbati levet eli im yitkapper aon bet eli bezevach uvmincha ad olam

Amar rabba bezevach uvmincha eno mitkapper aval mitkapper hu bedivre tora abbaye amar bezevach uvmincha eno mitkapper aval mitkapper bigmilut chasadim rabba veabbaye middevet eli kaatu rabba daasak battora chaya arbein shenin abbaye daasak betora uvigmilut chasadim chaya shitin shenin

Tanu rabbanan mishpacha achat hayeta birushalayim shehau metim keven shemone esre shana bau vehodiu et rabban yochanan ben zakkay amar lahem shemma mimmishpachat eli attem shenneemar vechol marbit betcha yamutu anashim lechu veisku battora vetichu halchu veasku battora vechau vehau korin otan mishpachat yochanan al shemo
Amar rav shemuel bar unya amar rav minnayin ligzar din shel tzibbur sheeno nechtam eno nechtam veha ketiv ki im techabbesi banneter vetarbi lach borit nichtam aonech lefanay
Ella minnayin sheafilu nechtam mitkarea shenneemar mi ka elohenu bechol korenu elav vehachtiv dirshu Adonai behimmatzo la kashya ha beyachid ha betzibur
Yachid emat amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh ellu asara yamim shebben rosh hashshana leom hakkippurim
Shelachu leh laavuh dishmuel yevama sherakka dam tachlotz lefi shei efshar laddam belo tzichtzuach rok
Metivi yachol yehe dam hayyotze mippiv umippi haamma tame talmud lomar zovo tame veen dam hayyotze mippiv umippi haamma tame ella tahor
La kashya kan bemotzetzet kan beshotet
Cheresh shennechlatz vechu
b: Amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi meir aval chachamim omrim en chalitzat katan kelum
Ketanna shechaltza vechu amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi meir deamar ish katuv bapparasha umakkeshinan ishsha leish
Aval chachamim omrim ish ketiv bapparasha ishsha ben gedola ben ketanna
Man chachamim rabbi yose hi derabbi chiyya verabbi shimon bar rabbi hao yatvi petach chad minayehu vaamar hammitpallel tzarich sheyyitten enav lematta shenneemar vehau enay velibbi sham kol hayyamim

Vechad amar enav lemala shenneemar nissa levavenu el kappayim addehachi ata rabbi yishmael berabbi yose legabbayehu amar lehu bemay askitu amaru leh bitfilla amar lehu kach amar abba hammitpallel tzarich sheyyitten enav lematta velibbo lemala kede sheyyitkayemu shene mikraot hallalu
Addehachi ata rabbi limtivta inhu dahao kallile yetivu beduchtayehu rabbi yishmael berabbi yose aggav yukreh hava mefassa veazel
Amar leh abbadan mi hu ze shemmefassea al rashe am kadosh amar leh ani yishmael berabbi yose shebbati lilmod tora merabbi amar leh vechi atta hagun lilmod tora merabbi
Amar leh vechi moshe haya hagun lilmod tora mippi haggevura amar leh vechi moshe atta amar leh vechi rabbecha elohim hu amar rav yosef shakleh rabbi lematrafseh dekaamar leh rabbecha vela rabbi
Addehachi atya yevama lekammeh derabbi amar leh rabbi leabbadan pok bidkah levatar dinfak amar leh rabbi yishmael kach amar abba ish katuv bapparasha aval ishsha ben gedola ben ketanna

Amar leh ta la tzerichatte kevar hora zaken kamfassa abbadan veate amar leh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose mi shetztzarich lo am kadosh yefassea al rashe am kadosh mi sheen tzarich lo am kadosh heach yefassea al rashe am kadosh
Amar leh rabbi leabbadan kum beduchtich tana beotah shaa nitztara abbadan vetavu shene vanav umeanu shette challotav amar rav nachman bar yitzchak berich rachamana dechassefeh leabbadan behay alma
Amar rabbi amme middevarav shel berabbi nilmod ketanna choletzet bifutut rava amar ad shettaggia leonat nedarim vehilcheta ad shettavi shette searot
Chaltza bishnayim vechu amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman en halacha keoto hazzug veha amar rav nachman chada zimna deamar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman chalitza bishlosha

Tzerichi dei itmar hach kammayeta hava amena hane mile lechattechila aval diavad afilu tere ka mashma lan en halacha keoto hazzug vei ashmoinan en halacha keoto hazzug ella ketanna kamma hava amena diavad aval lechattechila live chamishsha tzericha
Maase shechaltzu ku beno levenah mi yadana amar rav yehuda amar shemuel veedim roin oto mibbachutz

a: Tanu rabbanan chalitza mutet keshera e zo hi chalitza mutet amar resh lakish kol sheomrim lo chalotz uvchach atta konsah

Amar leh rabbi yochanan ani shone ben shennitkaven hu velo nitkavvena hi ben shennitkavvena hi velo nitkaven hu chalitzatah pesula ad sheyyitkavvenu shenehem keechad veatte amratte chalitzatah keshera
Ella kol sheomrim lo chalotz lah al menat shettitten lecha matayim zuz tanya name hachi chalitza mutet keshera e zo hi chalitza mutet kol sheomrim chalotz lah al menat shettitten lecha matayim zuz
Umaase beishsha achat shennafla lifne yavam sheen hagun lah veamru lo chalotz lah al menat shettitten lecha matayim zuz uva maase lifne rabbi chiyya vehichshirah
Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi chiyya bar abba amar lah bitti amodi amara leh ema yeshivatah zo hi amidatah amar lah yadatte leh amara leh in mamona hu dachaza lah vekave lemechleh minah
Amar lah la nicha lach amara leh la amar leh chalotz lah uvchach atta konsah levatar dachalatz lah amar leh hashta minach ippasla lah chalotz lah chalitza meallayeta ki hechi detishtere lealma

Bat chamuh derav pappa nafla lifne yavam sheen hagun lah ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh chalotz lah uvchach atta konsah amar leh rav pappa la savar lah mar leha deamar rabbi yochanan veella hechi ema leh
Amar leh chalotz lah al menat shettitten lecha matayim zuz levatar dachalatz lah amar lah zil hav leh amar leh meshatta ani bach avada leh
Mi la tanya hare shehaya boreach mibbet haasurin vehayeta maboret lefanav vaamar leh tol dinar vehaavireni en lo ella secharo
Alma amar leh meshatte ani bach hacha name meshatta ani bach
Amar leh avuch hecha amar leh bemata imach hecha amar leh bemata yehav behu eneh ushchivan
Tanu rabbanan chalitza mutet keshera get mute pasul chalitza meusset pesula get meusse kasher hechi dame i deamar rotze ani afilu chalitza name vei la amar rotze ani get name la
Hachi kaamar chalitza mutet leolam kasher veget mute leolam pasul chalitza meusset veget meusse zimnin kasher vezimnin pasul ha deamar rotze ani ha dela amar rotze ani
Detanya yakriv oto melammed shekkofin oto yachol beal korcho talmud lomar lirtzono ha ketzad kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani vechen atta motze begite nashim kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani
Amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna choltzin af al pi sheen makkirin memaanin af al pi sheen makkirin
Lefichach en kotvin get chalitza ella im ken makkirin veen kotvin get meun ella im ken makkirin dechayeshinan levet din toin

Verava dideh omer en choltzin ella im ken makkirin veen memaanin ella im ken makkirin lefichach kotvin get chalitza af al pi sheen makkirin vechotvin get meun af al pi sheen makkirin vela chayeshinan levet din toin
b: Matni mitzvat chalitza ba hu vivimto levet din vehen massiin lo etza hahogenet lo shenneemar vekaru lo zikne iro vedibberu elav

Vehi omeret meen yevami lehakim leachiv shem beyisrael lo ava yabbemi vehu omer lo chafatzti lekachtah uvilshon hakkodesh hau omrim veniggesha yevimto elav leene hazzekenim vechaltza naalo meal raglo veyarka befanav rok hannire laddayyanim veanta veamra kacha yease laish asher lo yivne et bet achiv ad kan hau makrin

Uchshehikra rabbi hurkanos tachat haela bichfar etam vegamar et kol happarasha huchzeku lihot gomrin kol happarasha venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal mitzva baddayyanin velo mitzva battalmidim rabbi yehuda omer mitzva al kol haomdim sham lomar chalutz hannaal
Gema amar rav yehuda mitzvat chalitza kora vekore vecholetzet verokeket vekora may kamashma lan matnitin hi ha kamashma lan mitzva hachi vei afech let lan bah
Tanya name hachi ben shehikdim chalitza lirkika uven shehikdim rekika lachalitza ma sheasa asuy
Amar abbaye hay man demakre get chalitza la lakre ledidah lo lechodeh veava yabbemi lechodeh demashma ava yabbemi ella lo ava yabbemi
Vela lakre ledideh lo lechodeh chafatzti lechodeh demashma chafatzti lekachtah ella lo chafatzti lekachtah rava amar afsoke milta hi veafsoke milta let lan bah
Rav ashe ashkecheh lerav kahana dekamitztaar umakre lah lo ava yabbemi amar leh la savar leh mar leha derava

Amar leh mode rava belo ava yabbemi amar abbaye hay man dechatev gita dachalitzta lichtov hachi akrenuha ledidah min meen yevami ad ava yabbemi veakrenohi ledideh min lo ad lekachtah veakrenuha ledidah min kacha vead chalutz hannaal
Mar zutra mesartet vechatev lechullah parasha matkef lah mar bar idi veha lo nitan likatev vehilcheta keoteh demar zutra

Amar abbaye rakka uklatattu haruach lo asta velo kelum may tama veyarka befanav baenan hilkach hu aroch vehi gutza kelatathu haruach ika befanav hi arukka vehu gutz baenan ad demate lahade appeh vahadar azel

Amar rava achala tuma verakat achala gargishta verakato lo asta velo kelum may tama veyarka meatzmah baenan veleka veamar rava tzerichi dayyane lemichze rukka ki nafek mippummah divama dichtiv leene hazzekenim veyarka

Venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal mitzva baddayyanin velo battalmidim tanya amar rabbi yehuda paam achat hayinu yoshvim lifne rabbi tarfon uvata yevama lachlotz veamar lanu anu kullechem chalutz hannaal chalutz hannaal chalutz hannaal

a: Bet shammay omrim en memaanin ella arusot uvet hillel omrim arusot unsuot

Bet shammay omrim befanav uvet hillel omrim befanav veshello befanav bet shammay omrim bevet din uvet hillel omrim bevet din veshello bevet din
Amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay memaenet vehi ketanna afilu arba vechamesh peamim amru lahem bet shammay en benot yisrael hefker ella memaenet umamtenet ad shettagdil utmaen vetinnase
Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel may tama devet shammay lefi sheen tenay benissuin vei nesua temaen ate lememar yesh tenay benissuin
Nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala may ika lememar lefi sheen tenay bechuppa
Masar haav lishluche habbaal may ika lememar la pelug rabbanan
Uvet hillel mida yadi denisue ketanna derabbanan ninhu rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu tama devet shammay lefi sheen adam ose beilato beilat zenut

Nichnesa lachuppa velo nivala may ika lememar la nicha leh detihve chuppa deisura masar haav lishluche habbaal may ika lememar la pelug rabbanan uvet hillel kevan deika kiddushin uchtubba la atu lememar divilato beilat zenut

Rav pappa amar tama devet shammay mishshum pere tama devet hillel mishshum pere tama devet shammay mishshum pere dei amratte nesua temaen shamet veachel lehu minah desof sof lemipak kayema uvet hillel adderabba kevan deamratte temaen ashboche mashbach lehu savar dei la ayetzi lah keroveh umappeki lah mineh
Rava amar hayenu tama devet shammay sheen adam toreach bisuda umafsidah uvet hillel tarvayehu nicha lehu kede delipok alayehu kala deishut
Bet shammay omrim babbaal vechu amar rabbi oshaya memaenet lemaamaro veenah memaenet lezikato amar rav chisda may tama derabbi oshaya maamar demiddatah matzya akra zika dival kurchah la matzya akra
Vahare bia dival kurchah
b: Umatzya akra ella bia umaamar dehu kaaved matzya akra zika derachamana rema alah la matzya akra ulla amar memaenet af lezikato may tama nisue kammae ka akra

Etiveh rava leulla kol sheyechola lemaen velo meana tzaratah choletzet velo mityabemet veammay temaen hashta vetikerinhu lenisue kammae vetityabem tzaratah tzarat erva shane detane rame bar yechezkel meana babbaal mutteret leaviv bayyavam asura leaviv
Alma bishat nefila niret kechallato hacha name bishat nefila niret ketzarat bitto
Amar rav meana baze asura laze mide dehave abbaalat hagget baalat hagget lav kevan deitasra lah lechad itasra lehu lechullehu hacha name la shena
Ushmuel amar meana baze mutteret laze vela damya levaalat hagget baalat hagget hu deka aved bah hacha hi kaavda beh deamra la raena bach vela tzavena bach bach hu dela raena ha bechavrach raena
Rav assi amar meana baze mutteret afilu lo lema kerabbi oshaya sevira leh deamar enah memaenet lezikato bechad yavam hachi name dematzya akra hacha bishne yevamin asikinan deen meun lachatzi zika
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan meana baze mutteret laachin velo hodu lo man lo hodu lo amar abbaye rav rava amar rabbi oshaya veamri lah rav assi

Bet shammay omrim befanav vechu tanya amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay vahalo pishon haggammal meana ishto shello befanav amru lahen bet shammay levet hillel pishon haggammal bemidda kefusha madad lefichach maddu lo bemidda kefusha
Middeka achel pere peshita nesua hi vehaamri bet shammay nesua la memaana tere kitre avadu beh

Bet shammay omrim bifne bet din vechu tenan hatam hachalitza vehammeunin bishlosha man tanna amar rabba bet shammay hi abbaye amar afilu tema bet hillel ad kan la kaamri bet hillel ella dela baenan mumchin aval shelosha baenan

Kidtanya bet shammay omrim bifne bet din uvet hillel omrim bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din veellu veellu modim shetztzarich shelosha rabbi yose bar yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon machshirin bishnayim amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman halacha keoto hazzug
Bet shammay omrim temaen vechu veha meana chada zimna amar shemuel ad shettagdil vetomar rotza ani bammeunim harishonim
Ulla amar tarte katane o shettemaen vetagdil veteares o shettemaen vetinnase lealtar
Bishlama ulla hayenu dekatane ad shettagdil vetinnase ella lishmuel ad shettagdil vetomar mibe leh kashya

Matni e zo hi ketanna shetztzericha lemaen kol shehissiuha immah veacheha ledatah hissiuha shello ledatah enah tzericha lemaen rabbi chanina ben antignos omer kol tinoket sheenah yechola lishmor kidusheha enah tzericha lemaen
Rabbi elazar omer en maase ketanna kelum ella kimfutta bat yisrael lechohen lo tochal bitruma bat kohen leyisrael tochal bitruma
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer kol akkava shehi min haish keilu hi ishto kol akkava sheenah min haish keilu enah ishto
Gema amar rav yehuda veamri lah bematnita tana barishona hau kotvin get meun la raena beh vela tzavena beh velet ana baaya lehitnasva leh kevan dachazo dinfish dibura amri

a: Ate leichallofe begita takkinu hachi beom peloni meana pelonit bat peloni beanpana

Tanu rabbanan e zehu meun amra i efshi bifloni bali i efshi bekidushin shekkidshuni immi veachay yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda afilu yoshevet beappiron veholechet mibbet aviha levet balah veamra i efshi bifloni bali zehu meun

Yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda afilu hau orchin mesubbin bevet balah vehi omedet umashka alehem veamra lahem i efshi bifloni bali hare hu meun yater al ken amar rabbi yose bar yehuda afilu shigrah balah etzel chenvani lehavi lo chefetz mishshello veamra i efshi bifloni bali en lecha meun gadol mizze

Rabbi chanina ben antignos omer kol tinoket vechu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi chanina ben antignos tana ketanna shello meana veamda venisset mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betira amru nisueha hen hen meuneha
Ibaya lehu nitkaddesha mahu ta shema ketanna shello meana veamda venitkaddesha mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betira amru kidusheha hen hen meuneha

Ibaya lehu peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yehuda ben betira o la im timtze lomar peligi bekidushin o afilu benisuin veim timtze lomar peligi afilu benisuin halacha kemoto o en halacha kemoto veim timtze lomar halacha kemoto benisuin o afilu bekidushin
Ta shema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira halacha mikkelal difligi

Veakkatti tibe lach dahava nesiva meikara o dilma mikaddesha ta shema dechallateh deabbadan imrud shaddar rabbi zuge derabbanan lemivdekinhu amri lehu neshe chazu gavrayechu dekaatu amri lehu niho gavrayechu didchu
Amar rabbi en lecha meun gadol mizze may lav dahava nesiva la dahava mikaddesha kidushe vahalacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira vaafilu benisuin dekamma

Rabbi elazar omer vechu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel chozrani al kol tzidde chachamim velo matzati adam shehishva middotav biktanna kerabbi elazar sheasaah rabbi elazar kimtayyelet immo bechatzer veomedet mecheko vetovelet veochelet bitruma laerev

Tanya rabbi eliezer omer en maase ketanna kelum veen balah zakkay lo bimtziatah velo bemaase yadeha velo bahafarat nedareha veeno yorshah veen mitamme lah kelalo shel davar enah keishto lechol davar ella shetztzericha meun
Rabbi yehoshua omer balah zakkay bimtziatah uvmaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha veorshah umitamme lah kelalo shel davar hare hi keishto lechol davar ella sheyyotza bemeun
Amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi eliezer middivre rabbi yehoshua sherabbi eliezer hishva middotav biktanna verabbi yehoshua chalak may chalak i ishto hi tive get
Lerabbi eliezer name i lav ishto hi meun name la tive ella bichdi tipok

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer vechu hechi dame akkava shehi min haish veakkava sheenah min haish amar rav yehuda amar shemuel tevauha linase veamra mechamat peloni bali zo hi akkava shehi min haish mechamat bene adam sheenam mehugganin li zo hi akkava sheenah min haish

Abbaye bar avin verav chanina bar avin deamri tarvayehu natan lah get zo hi akkava shehi min haish vehu asur bikrovoteha vehi asura bikrovav ufsalah min hakkehunna meana bo zo hi akkava sheenah min haish vehu muttar bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav velo pesalah min hakkehunna

Ha katane lekamman hammaenet baish hu muttar bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav velo pesalah min hakkehunna natan lah get hu asur bikrovoteha vehi asura bikrovav ufsalah min hakkehunna paroshe kamfaresh
Matni hammaenet baish hu muttar bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav velo pesalah min hakkehunna natan lah get hu asur bikrovoteha vehi asura bikrovav ufsalah min hakkehunna

Gema alma ate meun umvattel get

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel tavrah mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo

Ha kevar shabbeshah vela ishtabbasha

Amar rabbi elazar tivrah mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo ulla amar kegon sheshshillesha begitin demichazzeya kigdola

Amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose lezo lo hutzrachnu leisur karet hittarta leisur lav lo kol shekken

a: Verabbi elazar oser vechen hamgaresh et hayetoma vehechzirah mutteret layyavam verabbi elazar oser ketanna shehissiah aviha venitgarsha kitoma bechayye haav vehechzirah divre hakkol asura layyavam
Gema amar efa may tama derabbi elazar hoil veamda alav shaa achat beisura amaru leh rabbanan leefa i hachi chalitza name la tive
Vechi tema hachi name vehatanya mishshum rabbi elazar amru choletzet ella amar efa rabbi elazar la yadana may tama
Amar abbaye hayenu tama derabbi elazar mesappeka leh i mita mappelet i nissuin harishonim mappilim i mita mappelet ha ramya kammeh leyibum i nissuin harishonim mappilim ha amda alav shaa achat beisur
Rava amar leolam peshita lerabbi elazar demita mappelet umihu hakkol bekiin begerushin veen hakkol bekiin bachazara
Adderabba chazara kevan deyatva tuteh it leh kala mi la askinan deahderah beurta ushchev betzafra

Rav ashe amar hayenu tama derabbi elazar degazar hane mishshum yetoma bechayye haav vehechzirah hachi name mistabbera middekatane sefa ketanna shehissiah aviha venitgarsha kitoma bechayye haav vehechzirah divre hakkol sheasura layyavam
Hay may lememra peshita ella lav ha ka mashma lan tama derabbi elazar degazar hanach mishshum hay shema minah

Tanya keoteh derav ashe modim chachamim lerabbi elazar biktanna shehissiah aviha venitgarsha hare hi kitoma bechayye haav vehechzirah sheasura layyavam mippene sheggerusheha gerushin gemurin veen chazaratah chazara gemura

Bamme devarim amurim sheggershah keshehi ketanna vehechzirah keshehi ketanna aval gershah keshehi ketanna vehechzirah keshehi gedola i name hechzirah keshehi ketanna vegadla etzlo vamet o choletzet o mityabemet mishshum rabbi elazar amru choletzet velo mityabemet
Bea mineh rava merav nachman tzaratah mahu amar leh hi gufah gezera vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera

Veha tanya mishshum rabbi elazar amru hi vetzaratah choletzet hi vetzaratah salka datach ella lav o hi o tzaratah choletzet lav tarotze kamtartzatte taretz hachi hi choletzet tzaratah o choletzet o mityabemet

Rabban gamliel omer im meana meana veim lav tamtin ad shettagdil vetetze hallezu mishshum achot ishsha
Rabbi yehoshua omer i lo al ishto i lo al eshet achiv motzi et ishto beget veeshet achiv bachalitza

Gema umi shere vehatane bar kappara leolam yidbak adam bishlosha devarim veyitrachek mishshelosha devarim yidbak bishlosha devarim bachalitza uvahavaat shalom uvahafarat nedarim veyitrachek mishshelosha devarim min hammeun umin happikdonot umin haervonot meun demitzva shane

Gufa tane bar kappara leolam yidbak adam bishlosha devarim bachalitza keabba shaul detanya abba shaul omer hakkones et yevimto leshem noy leshem ishut leshem davar acher keilu pogea beerva vekarov beenay lihot havalad mamzer
Bahavaat shalom dichtiv bakkesh shalom verodfehu
b: Veamar rabbi avahu atya redifa redifa ketiv hacha bakkesh shalom verodfehu uchtiv hatam rodef tzedaka vachased yimtza chayyim tzedaka vechavod bahafarat nedarim kerabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer hannoder keilu bana bama vehamkayemo keilu hikriv aleha korban
Veyitrachek mishshelosha devarim min hammeunin dilma gadla umicharta bah min happikdonot bevar mata devayeteh ki vayeteh dame min haeravon baarave shaltziyyon

Deamar rabbi yitzchak may dichtiv ra yeroa ki arav zar raa achar raa tavo limkabbele gerim velaarave shaltziyyon ultokea atzmo lidvar halacha mekabbele gerim kerabbi chelbo deamar rabbi chelbo kashim gerim leyisrael kesappachat baor
Arave shaltziyyon deavdi shelof dotz tokea atzmo lidvar halacha detanya rabbi yose omer kol haomer en lo tora en lo tora peshita ella kol haomer en lo ella tora en lo ella tora
Ha name peshita ella daafilu tora en lo may tama amar rav pappa amar kera velimmadtem vaasitem kol sheyyeshno baasiyya yeshno bilmida kol sheeno baasiyya eno bilmida
Veibaet ema leolam kidamritu meikara kol haomer en lo ella tora en lo ella tora la tzericha deka magmar leacharine veazli veavdi mahu detema it leh agra ledideh ka mashma lan
Veibaet ema tokea atzmo lidvar halacha bedayyana deate dina lekammeh vegamar halacha umdamme milta lemilta veit leh rabba vela azel meshael

Deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan leolam yire dayyan atzmo keilu cherev munnachat lo ben yerechotav vegehinnam petucha lo mittachtav shenneemar hinne mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah miggibbore yisrael vego mippachad ballelot mippachad shel gehinnam sheddome lelayela
Rabban gamliel omer im meana vechu bea mineh rabbi elazar merav may tama derabban gamliel mishshum dekasavar kidushe ketanna mitla telu vechi gadla gadli bahadah af al gav dela beal
O dilma mishshum dekasavar hamkaddesh achot yevama niftera yevama vehalcha lah i beal in i la beal la
Amar leh hayenu tama derabban gamliel mishshum dekasavar hamkaddesh achot yevama niftera yevama vehalcha lah i beal in i la beal la
Amar rav sheshet amena ki nayem veshachev rav amar leha shemata detanya hamkaddesh et hakketanna kidusheha teluyin may teluyin lav ki gadla gadli bahadah veaf al gav dela baal
Amar leh ravin bereh derav nachman ha milta diktanna mitla talya vekayema i beal in i la beal la deamra hu adif minay vaana adifna mineh
Vesavar rav i beal in i la beal la veha itmar ketanna shello meana vehigdila veamda venisset rav amar enah tzericha get mishsheni ushmuel amar tzericha get mishsheni

a: May lav dela beal la dival i dival may tama dishmuel kasavar kol habboel al daat kiddushin harishonim hu boel
Veha peligi bah chada zimna deitmar kiddeshah al tenay uchnasah setam rav amar tzericha hemennu get ushmuel amar enah tzericha hemennu get
Rav amar tzericha hemennu get kevan denasvah achole achaleh litnaeh ushmuel amar enah tzericha hemennu get kol habboel al daat kiddushin harishonim hu boel

Tzericha dei itmar hahi behahi kaamar rav mishshum deika tenaa vechevan dival achaleh litnaeh aval beha ema mode leh lishmuel vei itmar beha behach kaamar shemuel aval behach ema mode leh lerav tzericha

Umi amar rav ki beal in i la beal la ha hahi ovada dahava benaresh veikaddisha keshehi ketanna vegadla veotvah abbe churseya vaata acharina vechatfah mineh verav berona verav chananel talmide derav hao hatam vela atzrechuha gita mibbatra
Amar rav pappa benaresh minsav nasvi vahadar motvi abbe churseya rav ashe amar hu asa shello kahogen lefichach asu bo shello kahogen veafkeinhu rabbanan lekidushe mineh

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe tinach dekaddesh bechaspa kaddesh bevia may shavveuha rabbanan livilato beilat zenut amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi eliezer vechen amar rabbi elazar halacha kerabbi eliezer
Matni mi shehaya nasuy lishte yetomot ketannot umet biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehem poteret tzaratah vechen shette chershot ketanna vechereshet en biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah
Pikkachat vechereshet biat happikkachat poteret hachereshet veen biat hachereshet poteret et happikkachat gedola uktanna biat haggedola poteret hakketanna veen biat hakketanna poteret haggedola
Gema vechereshet bat chalitza hi vehatnan cheresh shennechlatz vechereshet shechaltza vecholetzet min hakkatan chalitzatah pesula
Amar rav gidel amar rav abbia rava amar afilu tema achalitza kan bechereshet meikara kan befikkachat veachar kach nitcharsha
Chereshet meikara ki hechi deal hachi nafek pikkachat veachar kach nitcharsha la dimakkeva bah keriyya

Etiveh abbaye vechereshet meikara bat chalitza hi vehatnan shene achin echad pikkeach veechad cheresh nesuin lishte nochriyyot achat pikkachat veachat chereshet met cheresh baal chereshet ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat kones veim ratza lehotzi yotzi
Met pikkeach baal pikkachat ma yaase cheresh baal chereshet kones veeno motzi leolam may lav bechereshet meikara vekatane kones in
b: Choletz la la befikkachat veachar kach nitcharsha

Ta shema shene achin pikchin nesuin shette nochriyyot achat pikkachat veachat chereshet met pikkeach baal hachereshet ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat kones veim rotze lehotzi yotzi met pikkeach baal pikkachat ma yaase pikkeach baal chereshet o choletz o meyabem
May lav middehu pikkeach meikara hi name chereshet meikara vekatane kones in choletz la mide irya ha kidita veha kidita
Etiveh shene achin echad pikkeach veechad cheresh nesuin shette achaot achat pikkachat veachat chereshet met cheresh baal chereshet ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat tetze mishshum achot ishsha
Met pikkeach baal pikkachat ma yaase cheresh baal chereshet motzi et ishto beget veeshet achiv asura leolam
Vechi tema hacha name befikkeach veachar kach nitcharesh mi matze mappek vehatnan nitcharsha yotzi nishtattet lo yotzi nitcharesh hu o nishtatta lo yotzi olamit
Ella lav becheresh meikara umiddehu cheresh meikara hi name chereshet meikara umiddaachaot chershot meikara nochriyyot name chershot meikara utnan gabbe nochriyyot kones in choletz la ishtik
Ki ata lekammeh derav yosef amar leh may tama totveh meha deyachel leshannoye lach achaot chershot meikara nochriyyot pikkechot veachar kach nitcharshu

Ella ibi lach leotoveh meha shene achin chershin nesuin shette achaot pikkechot o shette achaot chershot o shette achaot achat pikkachat veachat chereshet vechen shette achaot chershot nesuot lishne achin pikchin o lishne achin chershin o lishne achin echad pikkeach veechad cheresh hare ellu peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibum veim hau nochriyyot yichnosu veim ratzu lehotzi yotziu
Hechi dame ilema befikchim ulvassof nitcharshu mi matze mappeki vehatnan nishtattet lo yotzi nitcharesh hu o nishtatta lo yotzi olamit
Ella lav achershin meikara umiddehen chershin meikara inhu name chershot meikara vekatane im hau nochriyyot yichnosu yichnosu in yachlotzu la teuvta derabba teuvta

Ketanna vechereshet vechu amar rav nachman ashkachteh lerav adda bar ahava ulrav chana chatneh deyatvi vekamaku akota beshuka defumbedita veamri ha ditnan ketanna vechereshet en biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah hane mile dinfala leh meachiv pikkeach dela yadinan i biktanna nicha leh i bechereshet nicha leh
I biktanna nicha leh deatya lichlal dea i bechereshet nicha digdola hi uvat bia hi aval nafla meachiv cheresh vadday bechereshet nicha leh devat bia hi uvat mineh hi
Veamena lehu ana afilu nefala leh meachiv cheresh name mesappeka leh
Ketzad takkanatan amar rav chisda amar rav kones hachereshet umotziah beget uktanna tamtin ad shettagdil vetachlotz

Amar rav chisda shema minah kasavar rav chereshet kenuya umshuyyeret ketanna kenuya veenah kenuya dei salka datach chereshet kenuya veenah kenuya ketanna kenuya umshuyyeret chereshet ammay kones umotziah beget

a: Titev gabbeh mimma nafshach i kenuya hi ha kenuya hi vei lav kenuya hi ha nochrit bealma hi
Vechi tema ketanna ammay tamtin ad shettagdil vetachlotz titev gabbeh i kenuya hi ha kenuya hi i lav kenuya hi nuchrita bealma hi im ken chereshet bema tipok
Amar rav sheshet hachi name mistabbera kidka metaretz rav chisda alliba derav
Detanya shene achin nesuin shette achaot yetomot ketanna vechereshet met balah shel ketanna chereshet yotza beget uktanna tamtin ad shettagdil vetachlotz
Met balah shel chereshet ketanna yotza beget vechereshet asura leolam veim ba al hachereshet noten lah get vehuttera

I amratte bishlama chereshet kenuya umshuyyeret ketanna kenuya veenah kenuya mishshum hachi dechi ba al hachereshet noten lah get vehuttera deamratte mimma nafshach i ketanna kenuya hi ha nafka mishshum achot ishsha i lav kenuya shappir meyabbem
Ella i amratte chereshet kenuya veenah kenuya ketanna kenuya umshuyyeret ki va al chereshet ammay noten get vehuttera haveya leh bia pesula uvia pesula la patra
Ha manni rabbi nechemya hi deamar bia pesula poteret mechalitza

Ella i amratte rabbi nechemya ha amar bia pesula patra
Ella shema minah rabbanan hi shema minah
Amar rav ashe meresha name shema minah derabbanan hi dekatane im ba al hachereshet noten lah get vehuttera vela katane im ba al hakketanna noten lah get vehuttera
I mishshum ha la irya chereshet delet lah takkanta dehetera katane takkanta deisura ketanna deit lah takkanta dehetera la tane takkanta deisura
Matni mi shehaya nasuy lishte yetomot ketannot umet uva yavam al harishona vechazar uva al hashsheniyya o shebba achiv al hashsheniyya

Afilu tema rabbi meir ki amar rabbi meir gedola lekatan uktanna legadol dechad minayehu bia deisura hu aval katan habba al hakketanna detarvayehu ki hadade ninhu la amar
Veha katane ba al yevama gedola tegaddelennu amar rabbi chanina chozaa ba shane veha tegaddelennu kaamar dechol bia uvia deisura hu ella mechavarta matnitin dela kerabbi meir
Keri kan lehakim leachiv shem vehay lav bar hachi hu amar abbaye amar kera yevamah yavo aleha kal dehu

Ibaya lehu netula ani min hayehudim layyavam mahu mi masseka addatah demayet baalah venafla kamme yavam o la
Rav amar yavam eno kevaal ushmuel amar yavam hare hu kevaal amar abbaye keoteh derav mistabbera ditnan hannoderet hanaa miyevamah bechayye valah kofin oto sheyyachlotz veim ita demasseka addatah

a: Mimani vela nasvi lah

Umay shena ketanna deachla bitruma umay shena chereshet dela achla bitruma ditnan heid rabbi yochanan ben gudgeda al hachereshet shehissiah aviha sheyyotza beget veal ketanna bat yisrael shennisset lechohen sheochelet bitruma veilu chereshet la achla
Gezera shemma yaachil cheresh bechereshet velechol katan ochel nevelot hu
Gezera shemma yaachil cheresh befikkachat vecheresh befikkachat name lechol bitruma derabbanan gezera dilma ate leocholah bitruma deorayeta
Umay shena ketanna deit lah ketubba umay shena chereshet delet lah ketubba deim ken mimani vela nasvi lah
Uktanna menalan deit lah ketubba ditnan hammaenet vehashsheniyya veayelonit en lahen ketubba aval yotza beget uktanna yesh lah ketubba
Vechereshet menalan delet lah ketubba detanya cheresh veshote shennasu pikkechot af al pi shennitpakkeach hacheresh venishtappa hashshote en lahem alehem kelum ratzu lekayeman yesh lahem ketubba
Ufikkeach shennasa chereshet o shota afilu katav lah mea mane ketubbatah kayyemet mippene sheratza lizzok binchasav tama deratza ha lo ratza en lah deim ken mimani vela nasvi lah

Amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar shemuel eshet cheresh en chayyavin aleha asham taluy

Baenan chaticha mishte chatichot
Umi bae rabbi elazar chaticha mishte chatichot vehatanya rabbi elazar omer koy chayyavin al chelbo asham taluy

Veika deamri amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar shemuel eshet cheresh chayyavin aleha asham taluy metivi chamishsha lo yitromu savar lah kerabbi elazar

Nishtattet vechu amar rabbi yitzchak devar tora shota mitgareshet mide dehave appikkachat beal korchah uma taam amru enah megoreshet shello yinhagu bah minhag hefker
Hechi dame ilema deodaat lishmor gitah veodaat lishmor atzmah mi nahagi bah minhag hefker ella deen yodaat lishmor lo gitah velo atzmah
Devar tora shota mitgareshet veha amar deve rabbi yannay venatan beyadah mi sheyyesh lah yad legaresh atzmah yatzta zo sheen lah yad legaresh atzmah
Vetana deve rabbi yishmael veshillechah mibbeto mi shemmeshallechah veenah chozeret yatzta zo shemmeshallechah vechozeret
La tzericha deodaat lishmor gitah veenah yodaat lishmor atzmah devar tora shota mitgareshet deha yodaat lishmor gitah vaamur rabbanan la lapkah shello yinhagu bah minhag hefker
