Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri vechu ibaya lehu rabbi yochanan ben nuri ish peshita leh veishsha kamibaya leh o dilma ishsha peshita leh veish kamibaya leh

Ta shema middekaamru leh eno dome haish hamgaresh laishsha hammitgareshet shehaishsha yotzet lirtzonah veshello lirtzonah vehaish eno motzi ella lirtzono shema minah ish kamibaya leh adderabba middekaamru leh af zo kayyotze bah shema minah ishsha kamibaya leh

Ella rabbi yochanan ben nuri ledivrehem kaamar lehu ledidi ki hechi deish la matze megaresh ishsha name la migarsha ella ledidchu may shena ishsha umay shena ish amaru leh eno dome haish hamgaresh laishsha hammitgareshet
Heid rabbi yochanan vechu amar rava meeduto shel rabbi yochanan ben gudgeda amar leedim reu get ze sheani noten veamar lah kinsi shetar chov ze hare zo megoreshet
Mi la amar rabbi yochanan ben gudgeda la baenan datah hacha name la baenan datah peshita

Mahu detema middaamar lah kinsi shetar chov ze battole batteleh ka mashma lan i ita devatteleh leedim hava kaamar lehu umiddela amar leedim la batteleh vela mide vehay dekaamar hachi mechamat kisufa hu dekaamar lehu
Rav yitzchak bar bisna irchasu leh mafteche deve midresha birshut harabbim beshabbeta ata lekammeh derabbi pedat amar leh zil

a: Devar tele vetalya velitayelu hatam dei mashkechi lehu mayete lehu alma kasavar katan ochel nevelot en bet din metzuviyn lehafrisho lema mesayya leh lo yomar adam letinok have li mafteach have li chotam ella mannicho tolesh mannicho zorek
Amar abbaye tolesh beatzitz sheeno nakuv zorek becharmelit derabbanan
Ta shema goy shebba lechabbot en omrim lo kabbe veal techabbe mippene sheen shevitato alehem katan habba lechabbot omrim lo al techabbe sheshshevitato alehem
Amar rabbi yochanan beose al daat aviv dichoteh gabbe goy deose al daat yisrael mi shere goy addata denafsheh aved
Ta shema ben chaver sheragil lelech etzel avi immo am haaretz en choshshin shemma yaachilennu devarim sheenam metukkanim matza beyado perot en zakuk lo amar rabbi yochanan bidmay hekelu
Ella tama didmay ha vadday bea leassore vehaamar rabbi yochanan beose al daat aviv ella rabbi yochanan sappoke mesappeka leh kae hacha medache kae hacha medache
Ta shema ben chaver kohen sheragil lelech etzel avi immo kohen am haaretz en choshshin shemma yaachilennu teruma temea matza beyado perot en zakuk lo bitruma derabbanan

Ta shema yonek tinok veholech miggoya umibbehema temea veen choshshin beonek sheketz velo yaachilennu nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim umikkullan yonek mehem vaafilu bashshabbat uvgadol asur abba shaul omer nohagin hayinu sheyyonkim mibbehema tehora beom tov
Katane miha en choshshin beonek sheketz hatam mishshum sakkana i hachi gadol name
Gadol bae umdana katan name live umdana amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua setam tinok mesukkan etzel chalav
Abba shaul omer nohagin hayinu sheyyonkim mibbehema tehora beom tov hechi dame i deika sakkana afilu beshabbat name vei deleka sakkana afilu beom tov asur la tzericha deika tzaara
Vekasavar mefarek kilachar yad hu shabbat deisur sekila gezaru rabbanan yom tov deisur lav la gezaru beh rabbanan
Ta shema lo tochlum ki sheketz hem lo taachilum lehazhir haggedolim al hakketannim may lav deamar lehu lo techlu la dela lispo leh beyadayim
Ta shema kol nefesh mikkem lo tochal dam lehazhir haggedolim al hakketannim may lav deamri lehu lo techlu la dela lispo lehu beyadayim
Ta shema emor veamarta lehazhir gedolim al hakketannim may lav deamar lehu la titammo la dela litammo lehu beyadayim
Utzrichi dei ashmeinan shekatzim
b: Mishshum deisuran bemashshehu aval dam dead deika reviit ema la vei ashmeinan dam mishshum deika karet aval sheratzim ema la
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte mishshum deisuran shave bakkol aval tuma ema la vei ashmeinan tuma kohanim shane mishshum deriba bahen mitzot yeterot aval hane ema la tzericha
Ta shema shene achin echad pikkeach veechad cheresh nesuin shette achaot pikkechot met cheresh baal pikkachat ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat tetze mishshum achot ishsha
Met pikkeach baal pikkachat ma yaase cheresh baal pikkachat motzi et ishto beget veeshet achiv asura leolam
Ammay motzi et ishto beget titiv gabbeh katan ochel nevelot hu mishshum isura didah

Ta shema shene achin pikchin nesuin shette achaot achat pikkachat veachat chereshet met pikkeach baal chereshet ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat tetze mishshum achot ishsha met pikkeach baal pikkachat ma yaase pikkeach baal chereshet motzi et ishto bagget veeshet achiv bachalitza
Veammay motzi et ishto beget titev gabbeh katan ochel nevelot hu mishshum isura dideh

Amar rava ta shema shene achin echad cheresh veechad pikkeach nesuin lishte achaot achat pikkachat veachat chereshet met cheresh baal chereshet ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat tetze mishshum achot ishto met pikkeach baal pikkachat ma yaase cheresh baal chereshet motzi et ishto beget veeshet achiv asura leolam
Veha hacha delav isura didah ika velav isura dideh ika vekatane motzi et ishto beget amar rav shemaya gezera mishshum hattarat yevama lashshuk
Hadaran alach cheresh
Haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam shalom beno levenah veshalom baolam uvaa veamra met bali tinnase met bali tityabem

Shalom beno levenah umilchama baolam ketata beno levenah veshalom baolam uvata veamra met bali enah neemenet rabbi yehuda omer leolam enah neemenet ella im ken bata bocha uvgadeha keruin amru lo achat zo veachat zo tinnase
Gema tena shalom beno levenah mishshum dekavae lemitne ketata beno levenah tena shalom baolam mishshum dekavae lemitne milchama beolam

Amar rava may tama demilchama mishshum deamra biddame salka data bechol hane deiktul hu palet im timtza lomar kevan deshalom beno levenah natra ad dechazya zimnin demachu leh begira o berumcha vesavra vadday met veika deaved samtari vechaye

Savar rava lememar reavon eno kemilchama dela amra biddame hadar amar rava reavon hare hu kemilchama dehahi daatat lekammeh derava amara leh bali met baraav amar lah shappir avadte deshezivte nafshich salka datach divhahu purta dinfafita dishvakte leh hava chaye amara leh mar name yada dechi hay gavena la chaye
Hadar amar rava reavon geria mimmilchama deilu milchama ki amra met bali bammilchama hu dela mehemna ha met al mittato mehemna veilu gabbe reavon ad deamra met ukvartiv
Mappolet hare hu kemilchama deamra biddame shiluach nechashim veakrabbim hare hen kemilchama deamra biddame

Dever amri lah hare hu kemilchama veamri lah eno kemilchama amri lah hare hu kemilchama deamri biddame veamri lah eno kemilchama desamchi addeamri inashe shav shenin have motana veinash bela shene la azel
Ibaya lehu hechzika hi milchama baolam mahu mi amrinan ma lah leshakker

a: Dei baaya amra shalom baolam o dilma kevan deichazka amra biddame vela ate ma li leshakker umara chezkateh
Ta shema ishnu alenu bayit ishnu alenu meara hu met vaani nitztzalti enah neemenet shane hatam deamar lah ki hechi dildidach itrechish nisa ledideh name itrechish nisa
Ta shema naflu alenu goyim naflu alenu listim hu met venitztzalti neemenet hatam kidrav idi deamar rav idi ishsha kele zayenah aleha
Hahu gavra divshilhe hilluleh itlay nura be genaneh amara lehu devethu chazo gavray chazo gavray ato chazo gavra charocha dishde ufisseta dida deshadya
Savar rav chiyya bar avin lememar hayenu ishnu alenu bayit ishnu alenu meara amar rava mi dame hatam la kaamra chazo gavray chazo gavray veod gavra charocha dishde ufisseta dida deshadya
Verav chiyya bar avin gavra charocha dishde ema inish acharina ata leatztzole vaachalteh nura ufisseta dida deshadya nura itla veityelid beh muma umechamat kisufa azal vaarak lealma

Ibaya lehu ed echad bammilchama mahu tama deed echad meheman mishshum demilta daavida leigalloye hu la meshakkar hacha name la meshakkar o dilma tama deed echad mishshum dehi gufa dayeka uminasva vehacha kevan dezimnin desanya leh la dayeka uminasva

Amar rame bar chama ta shema amar rabbi akiva kesheyyaradti linhardea leabber hashshana metzaani nechemya ish bet deli veamar li shamati sheen massiin et haishsha beeretz yisrael al pi ed echad ella rabbi yehuda ben bava venamti lo ken haddevarim amar li emor lahem mishshemi attem yodim hammedina hazzo meshubbeshet bigyasot kach mekubbelani merabban gamliel hazzaken shemmassiin haishsha al pi ed echad
May medina meshubbeshet bigyasot lav af al gav dimdina zo meshubbeshet kach mekubbelani shemmassiin al pi ed echad alma ed echad meheman

Amar rava i hachi may shena medina zo kol makom sheyyesh geyasot mibe leh ella amar rava hachi kaamar attem yodim shemmedina zo meshubbeshet bigyasot vela efshar li lemishbak inashe veti umeyte kamme rabbanan kach mekubbelani merabban gamliel shemmassiin haishsha al pi ed echad

Ta shema maase bishne talmide chachamim shehau bain im abba yose ben simay bisfina vetava vehissi rabbi neshotehen al pi nashim veha mayim kemilchama damu venashim afilu mea keed echad damu vekatane hissi
Vetisbera mayim sheen lahem sof ninhu umayim sheen lahem sof ishto asura ella hechi dame deamri assekinhu kamman
b: Vachazenhu lealtar vekaamri simanin delav alayehu samchinan ella assimanim
Hahu gavra deafked shumsheme gabbe chavreh amar leh hav li shumshemay amar leh shekaltinhu veha ken vechen havayin uvchavita ramyin amar leh didach shekaltinhu vehane acharine ninhu
Sevar rav chisda lememar hayenu shene talmide chachamim vela amrinan hanach azalu lealma vehane acharine ninhu
Amar leh rava mi dame hatam kaamri simanim hacha shumsheme may simana it lehu udkaamar ken vechen havayin emar chushbana itremi

Amar leh mar kashshisha bar rav chisda lerav ashe umi chayeshinan shemma pinan vehatnan matza cheli vechatuv alav kof korban mem maaser dalet dimmua tet tevel tav teruma shebbishat hassakkana hau kotvin tav tachat teruma
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe vela chayeshinan shemma pinan ema sefa rabbi yose omer afilu matza chavit vechatuv aleha teruma hare ellu chullin sheani omer eshtakad hava male teruma ufinah
Ella dechulle alma chayeshinan shemma pinan vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar im ita definahu michpar hava kafar veidach emar ishteloye ishteli i name lefanchayya shavkeh

Yitzchak resh galuta bar achateh derav bivi hava kaazel mikkurtava leaspamya ushchev shelachu mehatam yitzchak resh galuta bar achateh derav bivi hava kaazel mikkurtava leaspamya ushchev mi chayeshinan litre yitzchak o la abbaye amar chayeshinan rava amar la chayeshinan

Amar abbaye mena amena lah dehahu gita deishtechach binhardea uchtiv betzad kelonya mata ana anderolinay nehardaa petarit vetarechit yat pelonit inteti veshalchah avuh dishmuel lekammeh derabbi yehuda nesia ushlach leh tibadek nehardea kullah
Verava amar im ita yibbadek kol haolam mibe leh ella mishshum kevodo daavuh dishmuel hu dishlach hachi

Amar rava mena amena lah dehanhu tere shetare denafki bemachoza uchtiv behu chave bar nannay venannay bar chave veagbi behu rava bar avuh zuze veha chave bar nannay venannay bar chave bemachoza shechichi tuva veabbaye

a: Lemay nechush lah i linfila mizhar zehir beh i lefikkadon kevan dishmeh kishmeh la mafked gabbeh
May amratte dilma mesar leh otiyyot niknot bimsira

Hahu gita deishtechach besura uchtiv beh hachi besura mata ana anan bar chiyya nehardaa petarit vetarechit pelonit inteti uvdaku rabbanan missura vead nehardea vela hava anan bar chiyya acharina levar meanan bar chiyya mechaggera dahava binhardea vaato sahadi veemor dehahu yoma ki iktav hahu gita anan bar chiyya mechaggera gabban hava
Amar abbaye af ledidi deamena chayeshinan hacha la chayeshinan deha kaamri sahadi devinhardea hava may bea besura
Amar rava af ledidi dela chayeshinan hacha chayeshinan dilma begamla parcha azal i name bikfitza i name mile mesar
Kedaamar lehu rav lesafre vechen amar lehu rav huna lesafre ki itanchu beshile ketuvu beshile af al gav demimasran mile behine vechi itanchu behine ketuvu behine af al gav demimasran mile beshile
May hava alayehu deshumsheme rav yemar amar la chayeshinan ravina amar chayeshinan vehilcheta chayeshinan
Ketata beno levenah vechu hechi dame ketata beno levenah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel beomeret levalah garsheni kullehu name amru hachi ella beomeret levalah gerashtani
Velihemnah midderav hamnuna deamar rav hamnuna ishsha sheamra levalah gerashtani neemenet chazaka en ishsha meiza paneha bifne balah
Beomeret gerashtani bifne peloni ufloni veshaelna veamru lo hau devarim meolam
May tama diktata rav chanina amar mishshum dimshakkera rav shimi bar ashe amar mishshum deamra biddame may benayehu
b: Ika benayehu deargel hu ketata

Ibaya lehu ed echad biktata mahu may tama deed echad meheman mishshum demilta daavida leigalloye la meshakkar hacha name la meshakkar o dilma tama deed echad meheman mishshum dehi dayeka uminasva vehacha kevan deit leh ketata la dayeka uminasva teku
Rabbi yehuda omer leolam enah vechu tanya amru lo lerabbi yehuda lidvarecha pikkachat tinnase shota lo tinnase ella achat zo veachat zo tinnase
Hahi daatay leve dina derabbi yehuda amri lah sifdi balich kerai manich sitri mazyich allefuha shikra inhu kerabbanan sevira lehu amri taaved hachi ki hechi delishreyuha
Matni bet hillel omrim lo shamanu ella bevaa min hakkatzir uvotah medina uchmaase shehaya

Amru lahem bet shammay achat habbaa min hakkatzir veachat habbaa min hazzetim veachat habbaa min habbatzir veachat habbaa mimmedina limdina lo dibberu chachamim bakkatzir ella bahove chazru bet hillel lehorot kevet shammay
Gema tanya amru lahem bet shammay levet hillel ledivrechem en li ella ketzir chittim ketzir seorim minnayin veen li ella kotzer botzer mosek goder oder minnayin
Ella maase shehaya bakkatzir vehu haddin lechullehu hacha name maase shehaya beotah medina vehu haddin lechullehu
Uvet hillel beotah medina dishchichi inashe mirtat mimmedina limdina acheret dela shechichi inashe la mirtat uvet shammay hacha name shechichi shayyarata

May maase shehaya deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel shilfe katzir chittin hau vehalchu asara bene adam liktzor chittin neshacho nachash leechad mehen umet uvat ishto vehodia levet din veshalchu umatzu kidvareha beotah shaa amru haishsha sheamra met bali tinnase met bali tityabem
Nema rabbi chananya ben akiva verabbanan biflugta devet shammay uvet hillel kamipalgi detanya lo yissa adam me chattat veefer chattat veyaavirem bayyarden uvisfina

Velo yaamod betzad ze veyizrok letzad acher velo yeshitem al pene hammayim velo yarkivem lo al gabbe behema velo al gabbe chavero ella im ken hau raglav nogot bakkarka aval maaviram al haggesher echad yarden veechad shear neharot rabbi chananya ben akiva omer lo amru ella yarden uvisfina uchmaase shehaya
Lema rabbanan deamri kevet shammay verabbi chananya ben akiva deamar kevet hillel
Amri lach rabbanan anan deamrinan af kevet hillel ad kan la kaamar bet hillel hatam ella mishshum demiratta bemakom karov miratta bemakom rachok la miratta hacha ma li yarden ma li shear neharot

Rabbi chananya ben akiva amar lach ana daamari af levet shammay ad kan la kaamri bet shammay hatam ella mishshum deihi dayeka uminasva ma li makom karov ma li makom rachok hacha mishshum maase shehaya bayyarden uvisfina dahava maase gezur rabbanan bishar neharot dela hava maase la gezur rabbanan

May maase shehaya deamar rav yehuda amar rav maase beadam shehaya maavir me chattat veefer chattat bayyarden uvisfina venimtza kezayit min hammet tachuv bekarkait shel sefina beotah shaa amru lo yissa adam me chattat veefer chattat veyaavirem bayyarden uvisfina

Matni bet shammay omrim tinnase vetittol ketubbatah bet hillel omrim tinnase velo tittol ketubbatah amru lahem bet shammay hittartem erva chamura velo nattir mamon hakkal amru lahem bet hillel matzinu

a: Sheen haachin nichnasin lannachala al piha
Amru lahem bet shammay vahalo missefer ketubba nilmod shehu kotev lah sheim tinnasi leacher titteli ma shekkatuv lichi vechazru bet hillel lehorot kedivre bet shammay
Gema amar rav chisda nityabma yevamah nichnas lannachala al piha hem darshu midrash ketubba anu lo nidrosh midrash tora
Yakum al shem achiv amar rachamana vahare kam
Amar rav nachman bat levet din veamra met bali hattiruni lehinnase mattirin otah lehinnase venotnin lah ketubbatah tenu li ketubbati af lehinnase en mattirin otah may tama addata dichtubba atay

Ibaya lehu hattiruni lehinnase utnu li ketubbati mahu kevan deamra ketubbetah addata dichtubba atay o dilma kol mile deit leh leinish amar lehu leve dina veim timtze lomar kol mile deit leh leinish amar lehu leve dina tenu li ketubbati vehattiruni lehinnase mahu
Hacha vadday addata dichtubba atay o dilma hoil dela yada bemay mishtarya teku
Matni hakkol neemanin lehaidah chutz mechamotah uvat chamotah vetzaratah vivimtah uvat baalah
Ma ben get lemita shehakketav mochiach
Gema ibaya lehu bat chamiha mahu tama devat chamotah mishshum deika ima desanya lah hi name sanya lah vehacha leka ima desanya lah
O dilma tama devat chamotah deamra kaachla legirsana deima hacha name kaamra achla legirsana deve nashay
Ta shema hakkol neemanin lehaidah chutz mechamesh nashim veim ita shet haveyan dilma tama devat chamotah deamra kaachla legirsana deve nashay la shena bat chamotah vela shena bat chamiha
Vehaanan tenan chutz mishsheva nashim hahi rabbi yehuda hi ditnan rabbi yehuda mosif af eshet av vehakkalla
Amru lo eshet av hare hi bichlal bat habbaal kalla hare bichlal chamotah

Verabbi yehuda bishlama chamotah sanya lah lechalla deamra kaachla legirsanay ella kalla may tama sanya lachamotah bishlama bat habbaal desanya leeshet haav deamra kaachla legirsane deem ella eshet haav may tama sanya levat habbaal
Ella may mosif tarte ella kalla may tama sanya lachamotah dimgalla livnah kol deavda eshet av name sanya levat habbaal dimgalla leaviha kol deavda
Verabbanan kammayim happanim lappanim ken lev haadam laadam verabbi yehuda hahi bedivre tora ketiv
Amar rav acha bar aveya bau bemareva chamotah habbaa leachar miken mahu mi masseka addatah demayet baal venafla kamme yavam vesanya lah o la
b: Ta shema amra met bali veachar kach met chami tinnase vetittol ketubba vachamotah asura may tama chamotah asura lav mishshum deamrinan la balah miyt vela chamuha miyt veha dekaamra hachi lekalkola lachamotah hu dekamikavvena
Savra levatar shata la tete titztaaran
Dilma shane hatam dirgish lah tzaara
Matni ed omer met venisset uva echad veamar lo met hare zo lo tetze ed omer met ushnayim omrim lo met af al pi shennisset tetze shenayim omrim met veed omer lo met af al pi shello nisset tinnase
Gema tama denisset ha lo nisset lo tinnase vehaamar ulla kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad hare kan shenayim veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim
Hachi kaamar ed echad omer met vehittiruha lehinnase uva echad veamar lo met lo tetze meheterah harishon
Ed omer met peshita deen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim la tzericha bifsule edut vechidrabbi nechemya
Detanya rabbi nechemya omer kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad hallech achar rov deot veasu shette nashim beish echad kishne anashim beish echad
Veibaet ema kol hecha daata ed echad kasher meikara afilu mea nashim keed echad damyan ella kegon daatay ishsha meikara

Vetartzah lidrabbi nechemya hachi rabbi nechemya omer kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad hallech achar rov deot veasu shette nashim beishsha achat kishne anashim beish echad aval shette nashim beish echad kefalga ufalga dame
Shenayim omrim met vechu may kamashma lan bifsule edut vechidrabbi nechemya deazel batar rov deot hayenu hach
Mahu detema ki azlinan batar rov deot lechumra aval lekulla la ka mashma lan
Matni achat omeret met veachat omeret lo met zo sheomeret met tinnase vetittol ketubbatah vezo sheomeret lo met lo tinnase velo tittol ketubbatah

Achat omeret met veachat omeret neherag rabbi meir omer hoil umachchishot zo et zo hare ellu lo yinnasu rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim hoil vezo vazo modot sheen kayyam yinnasu ed omer met veed omer lo met

a: Ishsha omeret met veishsha omeret lo met hare zo lo tinnase
Gema tama deamra lo met ha ishtika tinnase ha en tzara meida lachavertah
Lo met itztericha leh salka datach amena ha mayet veha dekaamra lo met lekalkolah letzara hi dekamikavvena vetamot nafshah im pelishtim kaamra kamashma lan

Achat omeret met ku veliflog rabbi meir beresha amar rabbi elazar bemachloket shenuya verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hi verabbi yochanan amar afilu tema rabbi meir beha afilu rabbi meir mode dechol lo met beedut ishsha lav hachchasha hi
Tenan ed omer met veed omer lo met ishsha omeret met veishsha omeret lo met hare zo lo tinnase bishlama lerabbi elazar setama kerabbi meir ella lerabbi yochanan kashya kashya
Matni haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam uvaa veamra met bali tinnase vetittol ketubbatah vetzaratah asura hayeta bat yisrael lechohen tochal bitruma divre rabbi tarfon
Rabbi akiva omer en zo derech motziato mide avera ad shettehe asura linase vaasura milleechol bitruma

Amra met li bali veachar kach met chami tinnase vetittol ketubbatah vachamotah asura hayeta bat yisrael lechohen tochal bitruma divre rabbi tarfon rabbi akiva omer en zo derech motziatah mide avera ad shettehe asura linase vaasura milleechol bitruma
Gema utzricha dei itmar hach kammayeta beha kaamar rabbi tarfon mishshum detzara degufah aval chamot detzara mile dealma ema mode leh lerabbi akiva
Vei itmar beha beha kaamar rabbi akiva aval behach ema mode leh lerabbi tarfon tzericha
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi tarfon amar abbaye af anan name tenena nitan li ben bimdinat hayyam met beni veachar kach bali neemenet bali veachar kach beni enah neemenet
Vechoshshin lidvareha vecholetzet velo mityabemet lidvareha hu dechoshshin ha ledivre tzara en choshshin shema minah
b: Matni kidesh achat mechamesh nashim veen yodea e zo kidesh kol achat omeret oti kidesh noten get lechol achat veachat umanniach ketubba benehen umistallek divre rabbi tarfon

Rabbi akiva omer en zo derech motzi mide avera ad sheyyitten get uchtubba lechol achat veachat gazal echad mechamishsha veen yodea meeze gazal kol echad omer oti gazal manniach gezela benehen umistallek divre rabbi tarfon rabbi akiva omer en zo derech motzi mide avera ad sheyeshallem lechol echad veechad
Gema kidesh katane baal la katane gazal katane lakach la katane manni matnitin la tanna kamma vela rabbi shimon ben elazar

Detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer lo nechleku rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva al shekkidesh achat mechamesh nashim veeno yodea ezo kidesh shemmanniach ketubba benehen umistallek al ma nechleku al shebbaal rabbi tarfon omer manniach ketubba benehen umistallek rabbi akiva omer ad sheyeshallem lechol achat veachat

Lo nechleku rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva al shellakach mikkach mechamishsha bene adam veen yodea meeze mehen lakach shemmanniach deme mikkach benehen umistallek lo nechleku ella sheggazal mechamishsha sheamar rabbi tarfon manniach gezela benehem umistallek verabbi akiva omer ad sheyeshallem gezela lechol echad veechad
Middekaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar bekidesh velakach la peligi mikkelal detanna kamma savar peligi manni
I tanna kamma litne kidesh velakach i rabbi shimon ben elazar litne baal vegazal
Leolam rabbi shimon ben elazar umay kidesh kidesh bevia tena kidesh lehodiacha kocho derabbi akiva
Deaf al gav deisura derabbanan avad kanes tena gazal lehodiacha kocho derabbi tarfon deaf al gav deisura deorayeta avad la kanes

Matni haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam uvnah immahem uvat veamra met bali veachar kach met beni neemenet met beni veachar kach met bali enah neemenet vechoshshin lidvareha vecholetzet velo mityabemet
Nitan li ben bimdinat hayyam veamra met beni veachar kach met bali neemenet met bali veachar kach met beni enah neemenet vechoshshin lidvareha vecholetzet velo mityabemet
Nitan li yavam bimdinat hayyam amra met bali veachar kach met yevami yevami veachar kach bali neemenet

Halcha hi uvalah vivamah limdinat hayyam amra met bali veachar kach yevami yevami veachar kach bali enah neemenet sheen haishsha neemenet lomar met yevami shettinnase velo meta achotah shettikkanes leveto veen haish neeman lomar met achi sheyeyabbem ishto velo meta ishto sheyyissa achotah

Gema bea mineh rava merav nachman hamzakke get leishto bimkom yavam mahu kevan desanya leh zechut hu lah vezachin leadam shello befanav o dilma kevan dezimnin derachama leh chov hu lah veen chavin laadam shello befanav
Amar leh tenena vechoshshin lidvareha vecholetzet velo mityabemet

Amar leh ravina lerava hamzakke get leishto bimkom ketata mahu kevan deit lah ketata bahadeh zechut hu lah o dilma neyacha degufa adif lah ta shema deamar resh lakish tav lemetav tan du millemetav armelu
Abbaye amar deshumshemana gavra kurseyah be charata ramu lah rav pappa amar denappatza gavra tikre besipe vava vetitiv
Rav ashe omer dekolsa gavra la baaya telafche lekidra tana vechullan mezannot vetolot bevalehen
Hadaran alach haishsha shalom

a: Haishsha shehalach balah vetzaratah limdinat hayyam uvau veamru lah met balich lo tinnase velo tityabem ad shetteda shemma meubberet hi tzaratah
Hayeta lah chamot enah chosheshet yatzta melea chosheshet rabbi yehoshua omer enah chosheshet
Gema may hi tzaratah ha ka mashma lan leha tzara hu dechayeshinan aval letzara achariti la chayeshinan
Lo tinnase velo tityabem vechu bishlama yabbome la dedilma miabbera vekafaga beeshet ach deorayeta ella lo tinnase ammay hallech achar rov nashim verov nashim mitabberot veoldot
Lema rabbi meir hi dechayesh lemiuta
Afilu tema rabbanan ki azli rabbanan batar rubba rubba deiteh kamman kegon tesha chanuot vesanhedri aval rubba deleteh kamman la azli rabbanan batar rubba

Vahare katan uktanna derubba deleta kamman hi veazli rabbanan batar rubba detanya katan uktanna lo choltzin velo meyabmin divre rabbi meir amru lo lerabbi meir yafe amarta sheen choltzin ish ketiv bapparasha umakkeshinan ishsha leish ella ma taam en meyabmin

Amar lahem katan shemma yimmatze saris ketanna shemma timmatze ayelonit venimtzeu pogim beerva verabbanan savri zil batar rubba diktannim verov ketannim lav sarise ninhu zil batar rov ketannot verov ketannot lav ayelonit ninhu ella mechavarta matnitin rabbi meir hi

Bemay okemta kerabbi meir ema sefa hayeta lah chamot enah chosheshet ammay hallech achar rov nashim verov nashim mitabberot veoldot miut mappilot vechol hayyoldot mechetza zecharim umechetza nekevot semoch miuta demappilot lemechetza nekevot vehau leh zecharim miuta velechush
Dilma kevan deichzeka lashshuk la chayesh resha deichzak leyibum tiyyabam
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh resha deisur karet chashshu sefa deisur lav lo chashshu
Amar rava mikkede ha deorayeta veha deorayeta ma li isur karet ma li isur lav ella amar rava
b: Resha chazaka leyibum verubba lashshuk vachazaka la adif ki rubba veayeti miuta demappilot semoch lachazaka vehave leh palga ufalga lo tinnase velo tityabem
Sefa chazaka lashshuk verubba lashshuk vehave leh zecharim miuta demiuta umiuta demiuta la chayesh rabbi meir
Lo tinnase velo tityabem vechu ulolam
Amar zeeri leatzmah shelosha chodashim lachavertah tisha vecholetzet mimma nafshach
Rabbi chanina amar leatzmah shelosha lachavertah leolam vetachlotz mimma nafshach
Abbaye bar avin verabbi chanina bar avin amri tarvayehu gezera shemma yehe valad ben kayyama venimtza atta matzrichah karoz lakkehunna
Velatzrechah dilma ika dehave bachalitza vela have behachraza veamri kasharu chalutza lechohen
Tenan nitan li ben bimdinat hayyam veamra met beni veachar kach bali neemenet met bali veachar kach beni enah neemenet vechoshshin lidvareha vecholetzet velo mityabemet
Velechush dilma atu edim veamri kidkaamra venimtza atta matzrichah karoz lakkehunna amar rav pappa bigrusha rav chiyya bereh derav huna amar beamra ani vahu nechbenu bimara
Matni shette yevamot zo omeret met bali vezo omeret met bali zo asura mippene balah shel zo vezo asura mippene balah shel zo
Lazo edim velazo en edim et sheyyesh lah edim asura veet sheen lah edim mutteret lazo banim velazo en banim et sheyyesh lah banim mutteret veet sheen lah banim asura
Nityabmu umetu hayevamin asurot lehinnase rabbi elazar omer hoil vehutteru layevamin hutteru lechol adam
Gema tana lazo edim uvanim velazo lo edim velo banim shettehen muttarot
Nityabmu umetu hayevamin asurin lehinnase rabbi elazar omer hoil vehutteru layevamin hutteru lechol adam
Bae rava may tama derabbi elazar mishshum dekasavar tzara meida lachavertah o dilma mishshum dehi la mekalkela nafshah
Lemay nafka minah

a: Leansove letzara mikkamme didah i amratte tzara meida lachavertah af al gav dela insiv mansevinan lah letzara i amratte mishshum dehi la mekalkela nafshah insiv mansevinan lah letzara i la insiv la mansevinan lah
May ta shema rabbi elazar omer hoil vehutteru layevamin hutteru lechol adam i amratte bishlama dehi la mekalkela nafshah hayenu dechi insiv mansevinan lah
Ella i amratte mishshum detzara meida lachavertah af al gav dela insiv name ella shema minah tama derabbi elazar mishshum deinsiv hu vela mekalkela nafshah

Rabbi elazar ledivrehem kaamar lehu ledidi tzara meida lachavertah veaf al gav dela insiv mansevinan lah ella ledidchu odo li mihat dehecha deinsiv mansevinan lah mishshum dehi la mekalkela nafshah verabbanan tamot nafshi im pelishtim hu dekaavda

Ta shema haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam uvaa veamra met bali tinnase vetittol ketubbatah vetzaratah asura rabbi elazar omer hoil vehuttera hi huttera name tzaratah ema hoil vehuttera venisset
Velechush dilma begita atay vehay dekaamra hachi lekalkolah letzara hi mikavvena
I deinsiv leyisrael hachi name hacha bemay askinan deinsiv lechohen

Matni en meidin ella al partzuf panim im hachotem af al pi sheyyesh simanin begufo uvchelav en meidin ella ad shettetze nafsho vaafilu rauhu meguyyad vetzaluv vehachayya ochelet bo en meidin ella ad shelosha yamim
Rabbi yehuda ben bava omer lo kol haadam velo kol hammakom velo kol hashshaot shavin
Gema tanu rabbanan paddachat velo partzuf panim partzuf panim velo paddachat en meidin ad sheyehu shenehem im hachotem amar abbaye veitema rav kahana may kera hakkarat penehem anta bam
Abba bar marta dehu abba bar minome hava masseki beh deve resha galuta zuze ayeti kira dabbek bivliyta dabbek beapputeh chalaf kammayehu vela bashkeruh
Af al pi sheyyesh simanin vechu lememra desimanin lav deorayeta
Urminhi metzao kashur bechis uvarnaki uvtabbaat o shennimtza ben kelav afilu lizman merubbe kasher

Amar abbaye la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ben mahavay ha rabbanan detanya en meidin al hashshuma rabbi eliezer ben mahavay omer meidin may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar simanin deorayeta umar savar simanin derabbanan
Amar rava dechulle alma simanin deorayeta hacha beshuma metzuya beven gilo kamipalgi mar savar shuma metzuya beven gilo umar savar enah metzuya beven gilo
Veika deamri hacha beshuma haasuya lehishtannot leachar mita kamipalgi mar savar asuya lehishtannot leachar mita umar savar enah asuya lehishtannot leachar mita
Veika deamri amar rava dechulle alma simanin derabbanan vehacha beshuma
b: Siman muvhak ka mipalgi mar savar siman muvhak umar savar lav siman muvhak
Ulhach lishana deamar rava simanin deorayeta ha katane af al pi sheyyesh simanin begufo uvchelav
Gufo dearoch vegutz kelav dechayeshinan lishela vei chayeshinan lishela chamor besimane ukkaf hechi mahderinan
La shayeli inashe ukkafa dimsakkev leh lachamara metzao kashur bechis uvarnaki uvtabbaat hechi mahderinan
Tabbaat chayeshi lezayyofe kis vearnaki menachashi inashe vela moshli veibaet ema kelav bechivare vesummake
Vaafilu rauhu meguyyad vechu lememra dimguyyad chaye urminhi adam eno metamme ad shettetze nafsho afilu meguyyad vaafilu goses tammoye la metamme ha michya la chaye

Amar abbaye la kashya ha rabbi shimon ben elazar ha rabbanan detanya meidin al hamguyyad veen meidin al hatztzaluv rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af al hamguyyad en meidin mippene sheyyachol likkaot velichot

Umi matzet leokome kerabbi shimon ben elazar veha katane sefa maase beasya beechad sheshshilsheluhu layyam velo alta beyadam ella raglo veamru chachamim min haarkubba ulmala tinnase min haarkubba ulmatta lo tinnase
Shane mayya demarzu makka
Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana ledidi chaze li hahu tayyaa deshakel safsira vegayedeh legamleh vela afsektah lenaaruteh amar abbaye hahi kechisha haveya
Rava amar besakkin melubbenet vedivre hakkol
Vehachayya ochelet vechu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella mimmakom sheen nafsho yotza aval mimmakom shennafsho yotza meidin
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel shachat bo shenayim o rov shenayim uvarach meidin
Ini vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel shachat bo shenayim o rov shenayim veramaz veamar kitvu get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu chay hu vesofo lamut
Ella meatta yehe gole al yado allema tanya shachat shenayim o rov shenayim hare ze eno gole ha itmar alah amar rav hoshaya chayeshinan shemma haruach bilbelattu i name shemma ihu

a: Kerav mitato may benayehu
Deshachteh beveta deshesha ufarkes i name deshachteh bevara vela parkes
Rabbi yehuda omer lo kal vechu ibaya lehu rabbi yehuda ben bava lekulla pelig o lechumra pelig

Ta shema dehahu gavra detava becharme veassekuhu abbe hadaya levatar telata yomin veansevah rav dimi minnehardea lidvethu vetu hahu gavra ditva bediglat veassekuhu aggishra deshabbistana veansevah rava lidvethu appumma deshoshvine levatar chamsha yome
I amratte bishlama lekulla pelig inhu daavud kerabbi yehuda ben bava ella i amratte lechumra pelig inhu daavud keman shane mayya detzamti
Vehaamratte mayya marzu makka hane mile hecha deika makka aval hecha deleka makka mitzmat tzamet vehane mile dechi assekeh chazyeh beshateh aval ishtahi mitpach tafach
Matni nafal lemayim ben sheyyesh lahen sof ben sheen lahen sof ishto asura amar rabbi meir maase beechad shennafal levor haggadol veala leachar shelosha yamim

Amar rabbi yose maase besome sheyyarad litbol bimara veyarad moshcho acharav veshahu kede shettetze nafsham vehissiu et neshotehem veshuv maase beasya beechad sheshshilsheluhu layyam velo alta beyadam ella raglo amru chachamim min haarkubba ulmala tinnase min haarkubba ulmatta lo tinnase
Gema tanu rabbanan nafal lammayim ben sheyyesh lahem sof ben sheen lahem sof ishto asura divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim mayim sheyyesh lahem sof ishto mutteret vesheen lahem sof ishto asura
Hechi dame mayim sheyyesh lahem sof amar abbaye kol sheomed veroe mearba ruchotav
Hahu gavra ditva beagma desamke ansevah rav shela lidvethu amar leh rav lishmuel ta neshammeteh amar leh nishlach leh beresha

Shelachu leh mayim sheen lahem sof ishto asura o mutteret shelach lehu ishto asura veagma desamke mayim sheyyesh lahem sof o mayim sheen lahem sof shelach lehu mayim sheen lahem sof hu umar may tama avad hachi
Mita teena ana sevari kevan diku vekayemi kemayim sheyyesh lahem sof dame vela hi kevan deika galle emor galle ashpeluh
Kare shemuel aleh derav lo yeunne latztzaddik kol aven kare rav aleh dishmuel utshua berov yoetz

Tanya amar rabbi maase bishne bene adam mechammerin michmorin bayyarden venichnas echad mehem limchila shel dagim veshaka chamma velo raa pitchah shel mechila veshaha chavero kede shettetze nafsho uva vehodia betoch beto lemachar zarcha chamma vehikkir pitchah shel mechila uva umatza hesped gadol betoch beto amar rabbi kamma gedolim divre chachamim sheamru mayim sheyyesh lahem sof ishto mutteret sheen lahem sof ishto asura
I hachi mayim sheyyesh lahem sof name lechush limchila shel dagim bemayim sheyyesh lahem sof mechila shel dagim la shechicha

Amar rav ashe ha daamaru rabbanan mayim sheen lahem sof ishto asura hane mile beinish dealma aval tzurba merabbanan la i dislek kala it leh vela hi la shena inish dealma vela shena tzurba merabbanan diavad in lechattechilla la

Tanya amar rabban gamliel paam achat hayiti mehallech bisfina veraiti sefina achat shennishbera vehayiti mitztaer al talmid chacham shebbah umannu rabbi akiva uchshealiti bayyabbasha ba veyashav vedan lefanay bahalacha amarti lo beni mi heelcha amar li daf shel sefina nizdammen li vechol gal vegal shebba alay ninati lo roshi
Mikkan amru chachamim im yavou reshaim al adam yenanea lo rosho amarti beotah shaa kamma gedolim divre chachamim sheamru mayim sheyyesh lahem sof mutteret mayim sheen lahem sof asura

Tanya amar rabbi akiva paam achat hayiti mehallech bisfina veraiti sefina achat shemmittarefet bayyam vehayiti mitztaer al talmid chacham shebbah umannu rabbi meir keshealiti limdinat kappotkeya ba veyashav vedan lefanay bahalacha amarti lo beni mi heelcha amar li gal teradani lachavero vachavero lachavero ad shehekiani layyabbasha amarti beotah shaa kamma gedolim divre chachamim sheamru mayim sheyyesh lahem sof ishto mutteret mayim sheen lahem sof ishto asura
Tanu rabbanan nafal legov araot en meidin alav lachafura melea nechashim veakrabbim meidin alav rabbi yehuda ben betera omer af lachafura melea nechashim veakrabbim en meidin alav chayeshinan
b: Shemma chabbar hu vetanna kamma aggav itztza mazzeki leh

Tanu rabbanan nafal letoch kivshan haesh meidin alav leora melea yayin vashemen meidin alav mishshum rabbi acha amru shel shemen meidin alav mippene shehu mavir shel yayin en meidin alav mippene shehu mechabbe amru lo techillato mechabbe vesofo mavir

Amar rabbi meir maase beechad shennafal labbor haggadol vechu tanya amru lo lerabbi meir en mazkirin maase nissim may maase nissim ilema dela achal vela ishti vehachtiv vetzumu alay veal tochlu veal tishtu
Ella dela nayem deamar rabbi yochanan shevua shello ishan shelosha yamim malkin oto veyishan lealtar
Verabbi meir may tama amar rav kahana kipin al gav kipin hao verabbanan deshesha hao verabbi meir i efshar dela mesarech venayem purta

Tanu rabbanan maase bevitto shel nechunya chofer shichin shennafla levor haggadol uvau vehodiu lerabbi chanina ben dosa shaa rishona amar lahem shalom sheniyya amar lahem shalom shelishit amar lahem alta

Amar lah bitti mi heelech amra lo zachar shel rechelim nizdammen li vezaken manhigo amru lo navi atta amar lahem lo navi anochi velo ben navi anochi ella davar shehatztzaddik mitassek bo yikkashel bo zaro

Amar rabbi abba af al pi chen met beno batztzama shenneemar usvivav nisara meod melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu medakdek im sevivav kechut hassaara rabbi chanina amar mehacha el naaratz besod kedoshim rabba venora al kol sevivav
Matni afilu shama min hannashim omrot met ish peloni dayyo rabbi yehuda omer afilu shama min hattinokot omrim hare anu holchin lispod velikbor et ish peloni ben shehu mitkaven uven sheeno mitkaven
Rabbi yehuda ben bava omer beyisrael af al pi shehu mitkaven uvgoy im haya mitkaven en eduto edut
Gema vedilma la azli amar rav yehuda amar shemuel dekaamri harenu bain millispod umillikbor et ish peloni
Vedilma kamtza bealma shechev leh veassiku leh al shemeh dekaamri ken vechen rabbanan hao hatam ken vechen safdane hao hatam

Uvgoy im haya mitkaven vechu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella shennitkaven lehattir aval nitkaven lehaid eduto edut hechi yadinan amar rav yosef ba levet din veamar ish peloni met hassiu et ishto zehu nitkaven lehattir met setam zehu nitkaven leedut

Itmar name amar resh lakish lo shanu ella shennitkaven lehattir aval nitkaven lehaid eduto edut amar leh rabbi yochanan lo kach haya maase beoshaya berabbi shehittiram im shemonim vachamishsha zekenim amar lahem lo shanu ella shennitkaven lehattir aval nitkaven lehaid eduto edut velo hodu lo chachamim

Ella matnitin dekatane uvgoy im haya mitkaven en eduto edut hechi mashkachatte lah bemesiach lefi tummo ki hahu dahava kaamar veazel man ika be chivay man ika be chivay shechev chivay veansevah rav yosef lidvethu hahu dahava kaamar veazel vay leh lefarasha zeriza dahava befumbedita dishchev veansevah rav yosef veitema rava lidvethu

Hahu dahava kaamar veazel man ika be chasa teva chasa amar rav nachman haelokim achalu keore lechasa middibureh derav nachman azala devethu dechasa veinasva vela amaru lah vela mide amar rav ashe shema minah ha daamur rabbanan mayim sheen lahem sof ishto asura hane mile lechattechilla aval i nasev la mappekinan lah mineh
Ika deamri ansevah rav nachman lidvethu amar chasa gavra rabba iteh im ita dislek kala it leh lemilta vela hi la shena gavra rabba la shena lav gavra rabba diavad in lechattechilla la

Hahu goy dahava kaamar leh leyisrael ketol aspasta ushdi lechevatay beshabbeta vei la katelna lach kediktelna lifloni bar yisrael daamari leh bashshel li kedera beshabbat vela bashshel li uktelteh shemaa devethu vaatay lekammeh deabbaye sheheta

a: Telata rigle amar lah rav adda bar ahava zil lekammeh derav yosef decharif sakkine
Azala kammeh peshat meha matnitin goy shehaya mocher perot bashshuk veamar perot hallalu shel orla hen shel azeka hen shel neta revai hen lo amar kelum lo nitkaven ella lehashbiach mikkacho
Abba yudan ish tzayedan amar maase beyisrael vegoy shehalchu badderech uva goy veamar chaval al yehudi shehaya immi badderech shemmet badderech ukvartiv vehissiu ishto

Veshuv maase bekolar shel bene adam shehau mehallechin leantochya uva goy echad veamar chaval al kolar shel bene adam shemmetu ukvartim vehissiu et neshotehem veshuv maase beshishshim bene adam shehau mehallechin lecharkom beter uva goy veamar chaval al shishshim bene adam shehau mehallechin bederech beter shemmetu ukvartim vehissiu et neshotehem
Matni meidin leor hanner ulor hallevana umassiin al pi bat kol maase beechad sheamad al rosh hahar veamar ish peloni ben peloni mimmakom peloni met halchu velo matzu sham adam vehissiu et ishto
Veshuv maase betzalmon beechad sheamar ani ish peloni ben ish peloni neshachani nachash vahare ani met vehalchu velo hikkiruhu vehalchu vehissiu et ishto

Gema amar rabba bar shemuel tana bet shammay omrim en massiin al pi bat kol uvet hillel omrim massiin al pi bat kol may ka mashma lan matnitin hi ha ka mashma lan dei mashkachatte setama deen massiin bet shammay hi
Vehalchu velo matzu vedilma shed hava amar rav yehuda amar rav sherau lo demut adam inhu name damu dachazo leh bavua
Veinhu name it lehu bavua dachazo leh bavua devavua vedilma ledidhu it lehu bavua devavua amar rabbi chanina amar li yonatan sheda bavua it lehu bavua devavua let lehu
Vedilma tzara havay tana deve rabbi yishmael bishat hassakkana kotvin venotnin af al pi sheen makkirin

Matni amar rabbi akiva kesheyyaradti linhardea leabber hashshana metzaani nechemya ish bet deli amar li shamati sheen massiin et haishsha beeretz yisrael al pi ed echad ella yehuda ben bava venummeti lo ken haddevarim amar li emor lahem mishshemi attem yodim shehammedina meshubbeshet bigyasot mekubbelani merabban gamliel hazzaken shemmassiin et haishsha al pi ed echad
Uchshebbati vehirtzeti haddevarim lifne rabban gamliel samach lidvaray veamar matzanu chaver lerabbi yehuda ben bava

Mittoch haddavar nizkar rabban gamliel shennehergu harugim betel arza vehissi rabban gamliel neshotehen al pi ed echad vehuchzeku lihot massiin ed mippi ed mippi eved mippi ishsha mippi shifcha rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua omrim en massiin et haishsha al pi ed echad rabbi akiva omer lo al pi ishsha velo al pi eved velo al pi shifcha velo al pi kerovim

Gema vesavar rabbi akiva al pi ishsha la vehatanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi akiva ishsha neemenet lehavi gitah mikkal vachomer uma nashim sheamru chachamim en neemanot lomar met balah neemanot lehavi gitehen zo shenneemenet lomar met balah eno din shenneemenet lehavi gitah
Nashim sheamru chachamim hu dela mehemni ishsha bealma mehemna la kashya kan kodem shehecheziku kan leachar shehecheziku

Matni amru lo maase bivne levi shehalchu letzoar ir hattemarim vechala echad mehem veheviuhu befundak uvachazaratam amru lappundakit ayye chaverenu nummet lahem met ukvartiv vehissiu et ishto velo tehe kohenet kefundakit
Amar lehu lichshettehe kefundakit neemenet happundakit hotzia lahem maklo vetarmilo vesefer tora shehaya beyado
b: Gema may geriuta defundakit amar rav kahana pundakit goya hayeta umsicha lefi tumma hayeta ze maklo veze tarmilo veze kever shekkevartiv bo vechen tane abba bereh derav minome bar chiyya pundakit goya hayeta umsicha lefi tumma hayeta ze maklo veze tarmilo veze kever shekkevartiv bo
Veha ayye chaverenu kaamri lah kevan dachazetinhu bachya amru lah ayye chaverenu amra lahem met ukvartiv

Tanu rabbanan maase beadam echad shebba lehaid al haishsha lifne rabbi tarfon amar lo beni heach atta yodea beedut ishsha zo amar ani vahu hayinu holchim badderech veradaf acharenu gayis venitla beyichur shel zayit ufshacho vehechzir et haggayis laachorav
Amarti lo arye yishar kochacha amar li minnayin atta yodea shearye shemi kach korin oti beiri yochanan berabbi yehonatan arye demikkefar shichya leyamim chala umet vehissi rabbi tarfon et ishto

Verabbi tarfon la bae derisha vachakira vehatanya maase beadam echad shebba lifne rabbi tarfon lehaid edut ishsha amar lo beni heach atta yodea edut zo amar lo ani vahu hayinu holchin badderech veradaf acharenu gayis venitla beyichur teena ufshacho vehechzir et haggayis laachorav amarti lo yishar kochacha arye amar li yafe kivanta lishmi shekkach korin oti beiri yochanan ben yonatan arye demikkefar shichya leyamim chala umet

Amar lo lo kach amratte li yochanan ben yonatan demikkefar shichya arye amar leh lo ella kach amarti lach yochanan ben yonatan arye demikkefar shichya vedikdek alav shenayim ushlosha peamim vechiven et devarav vehissi rabbi tarfon et ishto
Tannae hi detanya en bodkin ede nashim bidrisha vachakira divre rabbi akiva rabbi tarfon omer bodkin
Vekamipalgi bidrabbi chanina deamar rabbi chanina devar tora echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot bidrisha vachakira shenneemar mishpat echad yihye lachem
Uma taam amru dine mamonot en tzerichin derisha vachakira shello tinol delet bifne lovin
Uvmay kamipalgi mar savar kevan deika ketubba lemishkal kedine mamonot dame umar savar kevan deka sharenan eshet ish lealma kedine nefashot dame
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam shenneemar vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich
Hadaran alach haishsha batra uslika lah massechet yevamot

a: Betula nisset layyom harvii vealmana layyom hachamishi sheppaamayim beshabbat batte dinin yoshvin baayarot bayyom hashsheni uvayyom hachamishi sheim haya lo taanat betulim haya mashkim levet din
Gema amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mippene ma amru betula nisset layyom harvii lefi sheshshaninu higgia zeman velo nisu ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma
Yachol higgia zeman beechad beshabbat yehe maale lah mezonot lechach shaninu betula nisset layyom harvii
Amar rav yosef mareh deavraham tale tanya bidla tanya he tanya vehe la tanya ha tanya veha tanya ella tale tanya dimfaresh tama bidtanya dela mefaresh tama

Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mippene ma amru betula nisset layyom harvii sheim haya lo taanat betulim haya mashkim levet din vetinase beechad beshabbat sheim haya lo taanat betulim haya mashkim levet din shakdu chachamim al takkanat benot yisrael sheyehe toreach bisuda shelosha yamim echad beshabbat vesheni bashshabbat ushlishi bashshabbat uvarvii konsah
Veachshav sheshshaninu shakdu otah sheshshaninu higgia zeman velo nisu ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma higgia zeman beechad beshabbat mittoch sheeno yachol lichnos eno maale lah mezonot
Lefichach chala hu o shechalta hi o sheppersa nidda eno maale lah mezonot
Veika devae lah mibaya chala hu mahu hatam tama may mishshum daanis vehacha name ha anis o dilma hatam anis betakkanta detakkinu le rabbanan hacha la
Veim timtze lomar chala hu maale lah mezonot chalta hi mahu matze amar lah ana ha kaemna o dilma matzya amra leh nistachafa sadehu
Veim timtze lomar amra leh nistachafa sadehu persa nidda mahu
Bishat vistah la tibe lach
b: Dela matzya amra leh nistachafa sadehu ki tibe lach shello bishat vistah may kevan dela bishat vistah haveya matzya amra leh nistachafa sadehu o dilma kevan deika neshe deka meshanneya vistayehu kishat vistah dame
Pashet rav achay higgia zeman velo nisu ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma lo nasu la katane ella lo nisu
Hechi dame i deka meakkevan inhi ammay ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma ella lav deitnis ki hay gavena vekatane ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma
Amar rav ashe leolam ema lach kol unsa la achla udka meakkevi inhu uvdin hu deibi leh lemitne lo nasu veayede ditna resha bedidhi tena name sefa bedidhi
Amar rava ulinyan gitin eno ken alma kasavar rava en ones begitin
Mena leh lerava ha ilema meha ditnan hare ze gitech im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh umet betoch shenem asar chodesh eno get met hu deeno get ha chala hare ze get
Vedilma leolam ema lach chala name eno get vehi gufa ka mashma lan deen get leachar mita
En get leachar mita ha tena leh resha hare ze gitech im matti hare ze gitech mecholi ze hare ze gitech leachar mita lo amar kelum

Dilma leappoke midderabbotenu detanya verabbotenu hittiruha lehinnase veamrinan man rabbotenu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel be dina dishro mishcha savri lah kerabbi yose deamar zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav
Veella missefa meachshav im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh umet betoch shenem asar chodesh hare ze get met vehu haddin lechala
Dilma met daveka dela nicha leh detippol kamme yavam
Ella meha dehahu daamar lehu i la atena mikan vead telatin yomin leheve gita ata besof telatin yomin ufaskeh mabbara amar lehu chazo daatay chazo daatay amar shemuel lav shemeh matya
Vedilma unsa dishchiach shane dechevan deibi leh leatnoye vela atni ihu deafsed annafsheh
Ella rava sevara denafsheh kaamar mishshum tzenuot umishshum perutzot mishshum tzenuot dei amratte la leheve get

a: Zimnin dela anis vesavra daanis umiaggena veyatva umishshum perutzot dei amratte la leheve gita zimnin daanis veamra la anis veazla uminasva venimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerim
Umi ika mide demiddeorayeta la leheve get umishshum tzenuot umishshum perutzot sharinan eshet ish lealma
In kol dimkaddesh addata derabbanan mekaddesh veafkeinhu rabbanan lekidushe mineh
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe tinach kaddesh bechaspa kaddesh bevia may ika lememar shavveuh rabbanan livilato beilat zenut
Ika deamri amar rava vechen leinyan gitin alma kasavar rava yesh ones begitin
Metivi hare ze gitech im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh umet betoch shenem asar chodesh eno get met hu deeno get ha chala hare ze get
Leolam ema lach chala name eno get vehi gufah ka mashma lan deen get leachar mita
En get leachar mita ha tena leh resha dilma leappoke midderabbotenu
Ta shema meachshav im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh umet betoch shenem asar chodesh hare ze get may lav hu haddin lechala la met daveka dela nicha leh detippol kamme yavam
Ta shema mehahu daamar lehu i la atena mikkan vead sheloshim yom leheve gita ata besof telatin yomin ufaskeh mabbara vaamar lehu chazo daatay chazo daatay vaamar shemuel la shemeh matya
Unsa dishchiach shane dechevan deibi leh leatnoye vela atni ihu hu deafsed annafsheh

Amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak lo shanu ella mittakkanat ezra veelach sheen batte dinin kevuin ella besheni uvachamishi aval kodem takkanat ezra shebbatte dinin kevuin bechol yom ishsha nisset bechol yom
Kodem takkanat ezra may dahava hava hachi kaamar i ika batte dinin dikvuin haidana kekodem takkanat ezra ishsha nisset bechol yom
Ha bainan shakdu ditriach leh
b: May shakdu detanya mippene ma amru betula nisset layyom harvii sheim haya lo taanat betulim haya mashkim levet din vetinnase beechad beshabbat veim haya lo taanat betulim haya mashkim levet din shakdu chachamim al takkanat benot yisrael sheyehe adam toreach basseuda shelosha yamim echad bashshabbat vesheni beshabbat ushlishi bashshabbat uvarvii konsah

Umissakkana veelach nahagu haam lichnos bashshelishi velo michu beyadam chachamim uvashsheni lo yichnos veim mechamat haones muttar umafrishin et hechatan min hakkalla lele shabbat techilla mippene shehu ose chabbura
May sakkana ilema deamri betula hannisset layyom harvii tehareg nahagu ligmare nikereh
Amar rabba deamri betula hannisset beom harvii tibael lahegmon techilla hay sakkana ones hu mishshum deika tzenuot demasran nafshayehu liktala veatyan lide sakkana
Velidrosh lehu deones shere ika perutzot veika name kohanot
Velikereh shemada avida devatla vetakkanta derabbanan mikkamme shemada la akrinan i hachi bashshelishi name ate uvael missefeka la akar nafsheh
Uvashsheni lo yichnos veim mechamat haones muttar may ones ilema ha daamaran hatam kare leh sakkana vehacha ka kare leh ones vetu hatam nahagu hacha muttar
Amar rava deamri sar tzava ba lair hechi dame i deate vechalef liakkav la tzericha deate vekava bashshelishi miha lichnos isparo dideh bishlishi kaatu

Veibaet ema may mechamat haones kidtanya hare shehaya pitto afuy vetivcho tavuach veyeno mazug umet aviv shel chatan o immah shel kalla machnisin et hammet lacheder veet hechatan veet hakkalla lachuppa

a: Uvoel beilat mitzva uforesh venoheg shivat yeme hammishte veachar kach noheg shivat yeme avelut vechol otan hayyamim hu yashen ben haanashim vehi yeshena ben hannashim veen monin tachshitin min hakkalla kol sheloshim yom
Vedaveka aviv shel chatan o immah shel kalla deleka inish detarach lehu aval ipcha la
Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda lo shanu ella shennatan mayim al gabbe basar aval lo natan mayim al gabbe basar mizdabban

Amar rava uvichrach af al pi shennatan mayim al gabbe basar mizdabban amar rav pappa uvichfar af al pi shello natan mayim al gabbe basar la mizdabban veella derav chisda hechi mashkachatte lah amar rav ashe kegon mata machseya demappeka mikkerach umappeka mikkefar

Tanya keoteh derav chisda hare shehaya pitto afuya vetivcho tavuach veyeno mazug venatan mayim al gabbe basar umet aviv shel chatan o immah shel kalla machnisin et hammet lacheder veet hechatan veet hakkalla lachuppa uvoel beilat mitzva uforesh venoheg shivat yeme hammishte veachar kach noheg shivat yeme avelut vechol otan hayyamim hu yashen ben haanashim veishto yeshena ben hannashim

Vechen mi sheppersa ishto nidda hu yashen ben haanashim vehi yeshena ben hannashim veen monin tachshitin min hakkalla kal sheloshim yom ben kach uven kach lo yivol lo beerev shabbat velo bemotzae shabbat
Amar mar hu yashen ben haanashim vehi yeshena ben hannashim mesayya leh lerabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan af al pi sheamru en avelut bammoed aval devarim shel tzina noheg
Daresh rav yosef bereh derava mishshemeh derava lo shanu ella shello baal aval baal ishto yeshena immo
Veha hacha divvaal askinan vekatane hu yashen ben haanashim vehi yeshena ben hannashim ki kaamar appersa ishto nidda
Ha vechen katane
b: Hachi kaamar vechen mi sheppersa ishto nidda velo baal hu yashen ben haanashim veishto yeshena ben hannashim
Lememra daavelut kayela leh minnidda

Vehaamar rabbi yitzchak bar chanina amar rav huna kol melachot sheishsha osa levalah nidda osa levalah chutz mimmezigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta veharchatzat panav yadav veraglav veillu gabbe avelut tanya af al pi sheamru en adam rashshay lachof et ishto lihot kochelet velihot pokeset beemet amru mozeget lo hakkos umatztzaat lo hammitta umarchetzet lo panav yadav veraglav
La kashya kan baavelut dideh kan baavelut didah
Veha aviv shel chatan o immah shel kalla katane ki katane ashsheara

Umi shane ben avelut dideh laavelut didah vehatanya mi shemmet chamiv o chamoto eno yachol lachof et ishto lihot kochelet velihot pokeset ella kofe mittato venoheg immah avelut vechen hi shemmet chamiha o chamotah enah rashshaa lihot kochelet velihot pokeset ella kofa mittatah venoheget immo avelut

Teni baavelut dideh hu yashen ben haanashim veishto yeshena ben hannashim ha vechen katane ki katane akkichul veappirkus veha immo katane may lav immo bammitta lo immo babbayit uchdaamar leh rav lechiyya bereh beappah nehog aviluta dela beappah la tinhog aviluta
Rav ashe amar mi kamdammet aviluta dehacha laaviluta dealma aviluta dealma chamir vela ate lezalzole beh avelut dehacha kevan deakkilu rabbanan ate lezalzole beh
May kulla ilema dekatane boel beilat mitzva uforesh hatam mishshum delo chal alav aviluta i lerabbi eliezer ad sheyyetze mippetach habbayit i lerabbi yehoshua ad sheyyissatem haggolel
Ella dekatane noheg shivat yeme hammishte veachar kach noheg shivat yeme avelut
Amar mar ben kach uven kach lo yivol lo baerev shabbat velo bemotzae shabbat bishlama beerev shabbat mishshum chabbura ella bemotzae shabbat ammay la
Amar rabbi zera

a: Mishshum cheshbonot

Amar leh abbaye vecheshbonot shel mitzva mi asiri veha rav chisda verav hamnuna deamri tarvayehu cheshbonot shel mitzva muttar lechashshevan beshabbat veamar rabbi elazar poskin tzedaka laaniyyim beshabbat veamar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan holchin levatte chenesiyyot ulvatte midrashot lefakkeach al iske rabbim beshabbat veamar rabbi yaakov bar ide amar rabbi yochanan mefakkechin pikuach nefesh beshabbat

Veamar rav shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan holchin leteratyaot ulkirkeyaot lefakkeach al iske rabbim beshabbat vetana deve menashsheya meshaddechin al hattinoket leares beshabbat veal hattinok lelammedo sefer ullammedo ummanut

Ella amar rabbi zera gezera shemma yishchot ben of amar leh abbaye ella meatta yom hakkippurim shechal lihot besheni beshabbat yiddache gezera shemma yishchot ben of hatam dilnafsheh la terid hacha delaacherim terid i name hatam it leh ravecha hacha let leh ravecha
Hashta deatet lehachi erev shabbat name gezera shemma yishchot ben of
Ibaya lehu betula nisset barvii venivelet barvii vela chayeshinan leikarore data o dilma betula nisset barvii venivelet bachamishi dechayeshinan leikarore data

Ta shema detane bar kappara betula nisset barvii venivelet bachamishi hoil veneemra bo beracha laddagim almana nisset bachamishi venivelet bashshishshi hoil veneemra bo beracha laadam tama mishshum beracha aval mishshum ikarore data la chayeshinan
I hachi almana name tibael bachamishi hoil veneemra bo beracha laddagim beracha deadam adifa leh

Vei name mishshum shakdu detanya mippene ma amru almana nisset bachamishi venivelet bashshishshi sheim atta omer tibael bachamishi lemachar mashkim leummanuto veholech lo shakdu chachamim al takkanat benot yisrael sheyehe sameach immah shelosha yamim chamishi beshabbat veerev shabbat veshabbat
May ika ben beracha leshakdu ika benayehu adam batel i name yom tov shechal lihot beerev shabbat

Darash bar kappara gedolim maase tzaddikim yoter mimmaase shamayim vaaretz deilu bemaase shamayim vaaretz ketiv af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim veillu bemaase yedehem shel tzaddikim ketiv machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai mikkedash adonay konnu yadecha

Heshiv bavli echad verabbi chiyya shemo veyabbeshet yadav yatzaru yado ketiv vehachtiv yatzaru amar rav nachman bar yitzchak yatzru etzbeotav kedichtiv ki ere shamecha maase etzbeotecha yareach vechochavim asher konanta
Metivi hashshamayim mesapperim kevod el umaase yadav maggid harakia hachi kaamar maase yedehem shel tzaddikim mi maggid harakia umay nihu matar
Darash bar kappara may dichtiv veyated tihye lecha al azenecha al tikre azenecha ella al oznecha sheim yishma adam davar sheeno hagun
b: Yanniach etzbao beoznav vehayenu deamar rabbi elazar mippene ma etzbeotav shel adam domot litedot may tama ilema mishshum dimchallekan kol chada vachada lemiltah avida deamar mar zo zeret zo kemitza zo amma zo etzba ze gudal

Ella ma taam meshuppot kitedot sheim yishma adam davar sheeno hagun yanniach etzbeotav beoznav tana deve rabbi yishmael mippene ma ozen kullah kasha vehaalya rakka sheim yishma adam davar sheeno hagun yachof alya letochah tanu rabbanan al yashmia adam leoznav devarim betelim mippene shehen nichot techilla leevarim
Ibaya lehu mahu livol battechilla beshabbat dam mifkad pekid o chabbore michabbar
Veim timtze lomar dam mifkad pekid laddam hu tzarich ushre o dilma lappetach hu tzarich vaasir
Veim timtze lomar laddam hu tzarich ufetach mimmela kaate halacha kerabbi shimon deamar davar sheen mitkaven muttar o halacha kerabbi yehuda deamar davar sheen mitkaven asur
Veim timtze lomar halacha kerabbi yehuda mekalkel hu etzel happetach o metakken hu etzel happetach
Ika deamri veim timtze lomar dam chabbore michabbar laddam hu tzarich veasur o dilma lahanaat atzmo hu tzarich veshare
Veim timtze lomar lahanaat atzmo hu tzarich vedam mimmela kaate halacha kerabbi yehuda o halacha kerabbi shimon
Veim timtze lomar halacha kerabbi yehuda mekalkel bechabbura o metakken bechabbura hu
Veim timtze lomar mekalkel bechabbura hu bimkalkel halacha kerabbi yehuda

a: O halacha kerabbi shimon
Itmar beve rav amri rav share ushmuel asar binhardea amri rav asar ushmuel share amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vesimanach ellu mekilin leatzman veellu mekilin leatzman
Verav share vehaamar rav shimi bar chizkiyya mishshemeh derav hay mesocharya denazyata asur lehaddokah beoma tava
Behahu afilu rabbi shimon mode deabbaye verava deamri tarvayehu mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut

Veha amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav halacha kerabbi yehuda verav chanan bar amme amar shemuel halacha kerabbi shimon verav chiyya bar avin matne lah bela gavre rav amar halacha kerabbi yehuda ushmuel amar halacha kerabbi shimon
Leolam rav kerabbi yehuda sevira leh lehach lishana deamar dam mifkad pekid mekalkel hu etzel happetach lehach lishana deamar dam chabbore michabbar mekalkel bechabbura hu
Metiv rav chisda tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot venisset bet shammay omrim notnin lah arbaa lelot uvet hillel omrim ad shettichye hammakka
Higgia zemannah lirot venisset bet shammay omrim notnin lah layela harishon uvet hillel omrim ad motzae shabbat arbaa lelot
b: May lav dei lo baal matze bael afilu beshabbat amar rava la levar mishshabbat amar leh abbaye veha ad motzae shabbat arbaa lelot katane ella amar rava keshebbaal
I keshebbaal may ka mashma lan ka mashma lan dishre lemival beshabbat kedishmuel deamar shemuel pirtza dechuka muttar likanes bah beshabbat veaf al pi shemmashshir tzerorot
Metiv rav yosef chatan patur mikkeriyyat shema layela harishon ad motzae shabbat im lo asa maase may lav ditrid devae lemival amar leh abbaye la ditrid dela beel

Amar leh rava umishshum tirda patur ella meatta tava sefinato bayyam hachi name defatur vechi tema hachi name vehaamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav avel chayyav bechol hammitzot haamurot betorah chutz min hattefilin shenneemar bahen peer
Ella amar rava tannae hi detana chada im lo asa maase barishon patur af bashsheni bashsheni patur af bashshelishi
Vetanya idach rishon vesheni patur shelishi chayyav
Veabbaye hatam name betirda peligi

Man chachamim amar rabba rabbi shimon hi deamar davar sheen mitkaven muttar
Amar leh abbaye veha mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut amar leh lo kehallalu bavliyyim sheen bekiin behattaya ella yesh bekiin behattaya
Im ken tored lamma lesheeno baki yomru baki muttar sheeno baki asur rov bekiin hen

Metiv rabbi amme hammefis mursa beshabbat im laasot lah pe chayyav veim lehotzi mimmenna lecha

Amar rabbi yaakov bar idi hora rabbi yochanan betzayedan asur livol battechilla bashshabbat umi ika horaa leisur
In vehatnan horuha bet hillel shettehe nezira od sheva shanim acherot
Vei name ki ha detanya chut hashshidra shennifsak berubbo divre rabbi rabbi yaakov omer afilu nikav hora rabbi kerabbi yaakov amar rav huna en halacha kerabbi yaakov

Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne hachi amar rabbi avahu shaal rabbi yishmael ben yaakov demin tzur et rabbi yochanan betzayedan vaana shemai mahu livol battechilla bashshabbat vaamar leh asur vehilcheta muttar livol battechilla bashshabbat

Amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav achat betula veachat almana teuna beracha umi amar rav huna hachi vehaamar rav huna almana enah teuna beracha la kashya kan bevachur shennasa almana kan bealmon shennasa almana

Vealmon shennasa almana la vehaamar rav nachman amar li huna bar natan tana minnayin levirkat chatanim baasara shenneemar vayyikkach asara anashim mizzikne hair vayyomer shevu fo vayyeshevu uvoaz almon shennasa almana hava
May enah teuna beracha deamar rav huna enah teuna beracha kol shiva aval yom echad teuna beracha
Ella ha detanya shakdu chachamim al takkanat benot yisrael sheyehe sameach immah shelosha yamim bemay i bevachur haamratte shiva i bealmon haamratte yom echad
Ibaet ema bealmon yom echad livracha ushlosha lesimcha veibaet ema bevachur shiva livracha ushlosha lesimcha
b: Metivi mevarchin livtula shiva ulalmana yom echad may lav afilu almana shennisset levachur lo lealmon aval levachur may shiva i hachi litne mevarchin livtula shiva ulalmana shennisset levachur shiva ulalmana yom echad
Milta pesikta katane deleka betula devatzra mishshiva veleka almana devatzra miyyom echad

Veotzer haadam

Rav chaviva ikla leve mahola barech shehassimcha bimono velet hilcheta keoteh mishshum ditridi deit leh tzaara leyanoka

Amar rabbi elazar

a: Haomer petach patuach matzati neeman leosrah alav
Veammay sefek sefeka hu safek tachtav safek en tachtav veim timtza lomar tachtav safek beones safek beratzon
La tzericha beeshet kohen veibaet ema beeshet yisrael uchgon dekabbel bah avuh kidushin pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad
May ka mashma lan tenena haomer leishsha kiddashtich vehi omeret lo kiddashtani hi mutteret bikrovav vehu asur bikrovoteha
Mahu detema hatam devadday kim leh aval hacha mekam hu dela kim leh ka mashma lan
Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi vehaamar rabbi elazar en haishsha neeseret al balah ella al iske kinuy ustira uchmaase shehaya
Vetisbera maase shehaya bekinuy ustira hava veod mi asruha
Ha la kashya hachi kaamar en haishsha neeseret al balah ella al iske kinuy ustira mimmaase shehaya dela hava kinuy ustira vela itasra mikkol makom kashya kinuy ustira in petach patuach la
Ultamach kinuy ustira in edim la
Ella hachi kaamar en haishsha neeseret al balah beed echad ella bishne edim vekinuy ustira afilu beed echad name ufetach patuach kishne edim dame
Vechi tema maase shehaya mippene ma lo asaruha hatam ones hava veibaet ema ki ha deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan
b: Kol hayyotze lemilchemet bet david get keritut kotev leishto dichtiv veet achecha tifkod leshalom veet arubbatam tikkach may veet arubbatam tikkach tane rav yosef devarim hamoravin beno levenah
Amar abbaye af anan name tenena betula nisset layyom harvii leom revii in leom chamishi la may tama mishshum ikarore data
Ulmay i lemitav lah ketubba nitev lah ella leosrah alav udka taen taana
May lav dekataen taanat petach patuach la dekataen taanat damim

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel haomer petach patuach matzati neeman lehafsidah ketubbatah amar rav yosef may ka mashma lan tenena haochel etzel chamiv bihuda shello beedim eno yachol liton taanat betulim mippene shemmityached immah bihuda hu dela matze taen ha baggalil matze taen
Ulmay i leosrah alav bihuda ammay la ella lav lehafsidah ketubbatah udka taen taana may lav deka taen taanat petach patuach la deka taen taanat damim

a: Itmar amar rav nachman amar shemuel mishshum rabbi shimon ben elazar chachamim tikkenu lahem livnot yisrael livtula matayim ulalmana mane vehem heeminuhu sheim amar petach patuach matzati neeman im ken ma hoilu chachamim betakkanatam

Umi amar rabban shimon ben gamliel hachi vehatanya kesef yishkol kemohar habbetulot sheyehe ze kemohar habbetulot umohar habbetulot kaze mikkan samchu chachamim lichtubbat ishsha min hattora rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ketubbat ishsha enah middivre tora ella middivre sofrim
Efoch umay chazet deafchatte batrayeta efoch kammayeta
Ha shaminan leh lerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar ketubbat ishsha middeorayeta ditnan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer noten lah mimmeot kappotkeya

Vei baet ema kullah rabban shimon ben gamliel hi vechassore michassera vehachi katane mikkan samchu chachamim lichtubbat ishsha min hattora ketubbat almana enah middivre tora ella middivre sofrim sherabban shimon ben gamliel omer ketubbat almana enah middivre tora ella middivre sofrim
Hahu daata lekammeh derav nachman amar leh petach patuach matzati amar leh rav nachman assevuhu kufre mevarachta chavita leh
Veha rav nachman hu deamar meheman meheman umassevinan leh kufre rav achay meshanne kan bevachur kan benasuy

Hahu daata lekammeh derabban gamliel amar leh petach patuach matzati amar leh shemma hittetah emshol lecha mashal lema haddavar dome leadam shehaya mehallech beishon layela vaafela hita metzao patuach lo hita metzao naul

Ika deamri hachi amar leh shemma bemezid hittetah vaakarte ledashsha veavra emshol lecha mashal lema haddavar dome leadam shehu mehallech beishon layela vaafela hita bemezid metzao patuach lo hita bemezid metzao naul

Amar leh huna mar bereh derava mipparzikya lerav ashe anan name naaved hachi amar leh
b: Gihutz shellanu kechibbus shellahem vei amratte nebad gihutz meabbera leh chumarta

Venivdok meikara begavah gemara hava shemia leh maase la hava chaze vesavar dilma la kim leh begavah demilleta shappir velav orach ara lezalzole bivnot yisrael

Hahu daata lekammeh derabban gamliel hazzaken amar lo rabbi baalti velo matzati dam amra lo rabbi mimmishpachat dorketi ani sheen lahen lo dam nidda velo dam betulim badak rabban gamliel bikrovoteha umatza kidvareha amar lo lech zeche bemikkachecha ashrecha shezzachita lemishpachat dorketi

Matni betula ketubbatah matayim vealmana mane betula almana gerusha vachalutza min haerusin ketubbatan matayim veyesh lahen taanat betulim
Gema may almana amar rav chana bagdataa almana al shem mane almana min haerusin may ika lememar ayede deha kare lah almana ha name kare lah almana

Lechi gadla lechi gadla name memachaya venafka kevan shehigdila shaa achat velo michata shuv enah yechola lemachot

Lechi gadla lechi gadla name memachaya venafka kevan shehigdila shaa achat velo michata shuv enah yechola lemachot

b: Veen lahen taanat betulim

Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav katan habba al haggedola asaah mukkat etz ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar en mukkat etz bevasar
Ika dematne lah leha shemata beappe nafshah katan habba al haggedola rav amar asaah mukkat etz ushmuel amar en mukkat etz bevasar
Metiv rav oshaya gadol shebba al hakketanna vekatan habba al haggedola umukkat etz ketubbatan matayim divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim mukkat etz ketubbatah mane
Amar rava hachi kaamar gadol habba al hakketanna velo kelum defachot mikkan kenoten etzba baayin dame vekatan habba al haggedola asaah mukkat etz umukkat etz gufa pelugta derabbi meir verabbanan
