Verabbi meir ammay medamme lah levogeret nedammeyah livula beula itavid bah maase bide adam ha la itavid bah maase bide adam verabbanan addimdammu lah livula nedammeuha levogeret bogeret la itavid bah maase kelal ha itavid bah maase
Aval lo hikkir bah ledivre hakkol velo kelum metiv rav nachman hi omeret mukkat etz ani vehu omer lo ki ella derusat ish atte rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet
Ella amar rava ben hikkir bah uven lo hikkir bah lerabbi meir matayim lerabbanan hikkir bah mane lo hikkir bah velo kelum

Vahadar beh rava detanya ketzad hotzaat shem ra ba levet din veamar peloni lo matzati levittecha betulim im yesh edim shezzinta tachtav yesh lah ketubba mane im yesh edim shezzinta tachtav bat sekila hi hachi kaamar im yesh edim shezzinta tachtav biskila zinta meikara yesh lah ketubba mane

Veamar rav chiyya bar avin amar rav sheshet zot omeret kenasah bechezkat betula venimtzet beula yesh lah ketubba mane umetiv rav nachman hannose et haishsha velo matza lah betulim hi omeret mishsheerastani neenasti venistachafa sadehu vehu omer lo chi ella ad shello erastich vehaya mikkachi mikkach taut velet lah kelal

Vaamar lehu rav chiyya bar avin efshar rav amram vechol gedole haddor yatvi ki amar rav sheshet leha shemata vekashya lehu veshanni may mikkach taut name mimmatayim aval mane it lah veatt amratte let lah kelal

Veamar rava man deka motev shappir ka motev mikkach taut ligmare mashma veella kashya hach taretz veema hachi im yesh edim shezzinta tachtav biskila zinta meikara velo kelum nimtzet mukkat etz yesh lah ketubba mane
Veha rava hu deamar lerabbanan lo hikkir bah velo kelum ella shema minah hadar beh rava mehahi
Tanu rabbanan kenasah rishon leshum nisuin veyesh lah edim shello nistera i name nistera velo shahata kede via en hashsheni yachol liton taanat betulim shehare kenasah rishon

a: Amar rabba zot omeret kenasah bechezkat betula venimtzet beula yesh lah ketubba mane rav ashe amar bealma leolam ema lach let lah kelal veshane hacha shehare kenasah rishon
Venechush shemma tachtav zinta amar rav sherevya kegon shekkidesh uvaal lealtar
Veika dematne lah ammatnitin betula almana gerusha chalutza min hannisuin ketubbatan mane veen lahen taanat betulin betula min hannisuin hechi mashkachatte lah kegon shennichnesa lechuppa velo nivala
Amar rabba zot omeret kenasah bechezkat betula venimtzet beula ketubbatah mane rav ashe amar leolam ema lach bealma let lah kelal veshane hacha shehare nichnesa lechuppa
Venechush shemma tachtav zinta amar rav sherevya kegon shekkidesh uvaal lealtar
Man dematne lah abbarayeta kol shekken ammatnitin uman dematne lah ammatnitin aval abbarayeta la mishshum dematze amar lah ana aedim semachi
Matni haochel etzel chamiv bihuda shello beedim eno yachol liton taanat betulim mippene shemmityached immah

Gema middekatane haochel mikkelal deika duchta bihuda name dela achel amar abbaye shema minah bihuda name mekomot mekomot yesh kidtanya amar rabbi yehuda bihuda barishona hau meyachadin et hechatan veet hakkalla shaa achat kodem kenisatan lachuppa kede sheyehe libbo gas bah uvaggalil lo hau osin ken
Bihuda barishona hau maamidin lahem shene shoshvinin echad lo veechad lah kede lemashmesh et hechatan veet hakkalla bishat kenisatan lachuppa uvaggalil lo hau osin ken
Bihuda barishona hau shoshvinin yeshenim babbayit shechatan vechalla yeshenim bah uvaggalil lo hau osin ken
Vechol shello nahag kamminhag hazze eno yachol liton taanat betulim aheya ilema aresha kol shennahag mibe leh
Ella assefa kol shello mushmash mibe leh

Amar abbaye leolam aresha utni kol shennahag amar leh rava veha kol shello nahag katane ella amar rava hachi kaamar kol shello nahag minhag galil baggalil ella minhag yehuda baggalil eno yachol liton taanat betulim rav ashe amar leolam assefa utni kol shello mushmash
Matni achat almenat yisrael veachat almenat kohanim ketubbatah mane bet din shel kohanim hau govin livtula arba meot zuz velo michu beyadam chachamim
Gema tana vealmenat kohanim ketubbatah matayim vehaanan tenan achat almenat yisrael veachat almenat kohanim ketubbatan mane
Amar rav ashe shette takkanot hao meikara takkinu livtula arba meot zuz ulalmana mane
b: Kevan dachazo dimzalzeli behu takkinu lehu matan kevan dachazo deka parshin minayehu deamri ad denasvinan almenat kohanim nezil nisev betula bat yisrael ahderinhu lemilletayehu
Bet din shel kohanim ku amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo bet din shel kohanim bilvad amru ella afilu mishpachot hamuchasot beyisrael im ratzu laasot kederech shehakkohanim osin osin
Metivi harotze laasot kederech shehakkohanim osin kegon bat yisrael lechohen uvat kohen leyisrael osin bat yisrael lechohen uvat kohen leyisrael hu deika tzad kehunna aval bat yisrael leyisrael la
La mibbaya kaamar la mibbaya bat yisrael leyisrael dela matze amar lah alloye ka meallena lich aval bat yisrael lechohen dematze amar lah alloye ka meallena lich ema la ka mashma lan

Matni hannose et haishsha velo matza lah betulim hi omeret mishsheerastani neenasti venistachafa sadehu vehu omer lo ki ella ad shello erasticha vehaya mikkachi mikkach taut rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet rabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin ella hare zo bechezkat beula ad shello titares vehitattu ad shettavi reaya lidvareha

Gema ittemar mane li beyadcha vehalla omer eni yodea rav yehuda verav huna amri chayyav verav nachman verabbi yochanan amri patur rav huna verav yehuda amri chayyav bari veshemma bari adif rav nachman verabbi yochanan amri patur oki mamona bechezkat mareh

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef ha derav huna verav yehuda dishmuel hi ditnan hayeta meubberet veamru lah ma tivo shel ubbar ze meish peloni vechohen hu rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabban gamliel

Vaamar leh rav shemuel bar yehuda lerav yehuda shinana amarte lan mishshemeh dishmuel halacha kerabban gamliel af barishona may af barishona af al gav deika lememar oke mamona bechezkat mareh amar rabban gamliel bari adif
Lema rav yehuda verav huna deamri kerabban gamliel verav nachman verabbi yochanan deamri kerabbi yehoshua
Amar lecha rav nachman ana daamari afilu kerabban gamliel ad kan la kaamar rabban gamliel hatam ella deika miggo aval hacha may miggo ika
I name ad kan la kaamar rabban gamliel hatam ella deamrinan okmah achazaka aval hacha may chazaka it leh lehay
Hachi name mistabbera kidka meshannenan derav nachman hu deamar kerabban gamliel

a: Deim ken kashya hilcheta ahilcheta dekayema lan hilcheta kerav nachman bedine uvha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabban gamliel ella lav shema minah kidmishshenenan shema minah

Matni hi omeret mukkat etz ani vehu omer lo chi ella derusat ish atte rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet verabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin ella hare zo bechezkat derusat ish ad shettavi reaya lidvareha
Gema taanatayehu bemay rabbi yochanan amar bematayim umane rabbi elazar amar bemane velo kelum

Rabbi yochanan amar bematayim umane savar lah kerabbi meir deamar ben hikkir bah uven lo hikkir bah matayim verabbi elazar omer bemane velo kelum savar lah kerabbanan deamri ben hikkir bah ben lo hikkir bah mane
Bishlama rabbi elazar lo kaamar kerabbi yochanan deka moke lah kerabbanan ella rabbi yochanan may tama la amar kerabbi elazar
Kasavar kenasah bechezkat betula venimtzet beula yesh lah ketubba mane hacha hu kaamar mane vehi kaamra mane may ika ben taana dideh letaana didah
Bishlama lerabbi elazar hayenu dekatane tarte chada leappoke midderame bar chama
Vachada leappoke midderav chiyya bar avin amar rav sheshet ella lerabbi yochanan tarte lema li

Chada lehodiacha kocho derabban gamliel vachada lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehoshua kammayeta lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehoshua deaf al gav deika lememar migo la mehemna batrayeta lehodiacha kocho derabban gamliel deaf al gav deleka lememar migo mehemna

Matni rauha medabberet im echad veamru lah ma tivo shel ish ze ish peloni vechohen hu rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet verabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin ella hare zo bechezkat beula lenatin ulmamzer ad shettavi reaya lidvareha

Hayeta meubberet veamru lah ma tivo shel ubbar ze meish peloni vechohen hu rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet verabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin ella hare zo bechezkat meubberet lenatin ulmamzer ad shettavi reaya lidvareha

Gema may medabberet zeeri amar nistera rav assi amar nivala bishlama lizeri hayenu dekatane medabberet ella lerav assi may medabberet lishana mealleya kedichtiv achla umachata fiha veamra lo faalti aven
Bishlama lizeri hayenu dekatane tarte medabberet umubberet ella lerav assi tarte lema li
Chada lehachshir bah vachada lehachshir bevittah

Hanicha leman deamar ledivre hammachshir bah machshir bevittah ella leman deamar ledivre hammachshir bah posel bevittah may ika lememar rav assi savar keman deamar ledivre hammachshir bah machshir bevittah
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye lizeri deamar may medabberet nistera veamar rabbi yehoshua la mehemna haamar rav malkin al hayyichud veen osrin al hayyichud
Lema dela kerabbi yehoshua afilu tema rabbi yehoshua maala asu beuchasin
Metivi rauha shennichnesa im echad leseter
b: O lechurba veamru lah ma tivo shel ish ze kohen hu uven achi abba hu rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet rabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin ella hare zo bechezkat beula lenatin ulmamzer ad shettavi reaya lidvareha
Bishlama lizeri hayenu dekatane tarte leseter o lechurba ella lerav assi deamar nivala tarte lema li chada katane leseter dechurba

Veha leseter o lechurba katane chada lechurba demata vachada lechurba dedavra utzrichi dei ashmeinan churba demata beha kamachshar rabban gamliel mishshum derov kesherim etzlah aval lechurba dedavra derov pesulin etzlah ema mode leh lerabbi yehoshua
Vei ashmeinan behahi behahi kaamar rabbi yehoshua aval beha ema mode lerabban gamliel tzericha

Metivi zo edut shehaishsha keshera lah verabbi yehoshua omer enah neemenet amar lahem rabbi yehoshua i attem modim bishvuya shennishbet veyesh lah edim shennishbet vehi omeret tehora ani sheenah neemenet
Amru lo aval uma hefresh yesh ben zo lazo lazo yesh edim vlazo en lah edim
Amar lahem af lazo yesh edim shehare keresah ben shineha amru lo rov goyim perutzim baaraot hem amar lahen en appotroppos laaraot
Bamme devarim amurim beedut ishsha begufah aval edut ishsha bevittah divre hakkol havalad shetuki

May kaamar lehu umay kamahderi leh hachi kaamri leh hashavtanu al hamubberet ma teshivenu al hamdabberet amar lahem medabberet hayenu shevuya amru lo shane shevuya derov goyim perutzim baaraot hem amar lahem ha name kevan deistattar en appotroppos laaraot
Katane mihat tarte medabberet umubberet teuvta derav assi teuvta

Vetipok leh dehatam rov pesulin etzlah vehacha rov kesherin etzlah mesayya leh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi ledivre hammachshir machshir afilu berov pesulin ledivre happosel posel afilu berov kesherim
Amar rabbi yochanan ledivre hammachshir bah machshir bevittah ledivre happosel bah posel bevittah verabbi elazar omer ledivre hammachshir bah posel bevittah
Amar rabba may tama derabbi elazar bishlama ihi it lah chazaka dechashrut bittah let lah chazaka dechashrut
Etiveh rabbi elazar lerabbi yochanan bamme devarim amurim beedut ishsha begufah aval edut ishsha bevittah divre hakkol havalad shetuki may lav shetuki ufasul la shetuki vechasher
Umi ika shetuki kasher in kedishmuel deamar shemuel asara kohanim omdim uferash echad mehem uvaal havalad shetuki

May shetuki ilema shemmashtikin oto minnichse aviv peshita umi yadinan avuh mannu ella shemmashtikin oto middin kehunna dichtiv vehayeta lo ulzaro acharav berit kehunnat olam mi shezzaro meuchas acharav yatza ze sheen zaro meuchas acharav
Hahu arus vaarusato daato lekammeh derav yosef hi amra mineh vehu amar

a: In minay amar rav yosef lemay nechush lah chada deha ka mode veod ha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabban gamliel

Amar leh abbaye uvha ki la mode machshar rabban gamliel vehaamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana halacha kerabban gamliel veatte la taaved ovada ad deika rov kesherin etzlah vehacha rov pesulin etzlah
Velitamach tikshe lach hi gufah halacha veatte la taaved ovada ella may it lach lememar ha lechattechilla ha diavad veha name kediavad dame
Rame leh abbaye lerava umi amar rabbi yehoshua enah neemenet urminhu heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi yehuda ben betera al almenat isa shehi keshera lakkehunna
Amar leh hachi hashta hatam ishsha niset bodeket veniset hacha ishsha mezanna bodeket umzanna

Amar rava derabbi yehoshua adderabbi yehoshua kashya derabban gamliel adderabban gamliel la kashya veha katane sefa amar lahen rabban gamliel kibbalnu edutchem aval ma naase shehare gazar rabban yochanan ben zakkay shello lehoshiv bet din al kach shehakkohanim shomin lachem lerachek aval lo lekarev
Ella amar rava derabban gamliel adderabban gamliel la kashya hatam bari hacha shemma
Derabbi yehoshua adderabbi yehoshua name la kashya hatam chad sefeka hacha tere sefeke

Hilkach lerabban gamliel allim leh bari daafilu bechad sefeka name machshir vekil leh shemma daafilu bisfek sefeka name pasel lerabbi yehoshua allim leh chad sefeka daafilu bevari name pasel vekil leh sefek sefeka daafilu bishma name machshir
Tanu rabbanan ezohi almenat isa kol sheen bah lo mishshum mamzerut velo mishshum netinut velo mishshum avde melachim amar rabbi meir
b: Shamati kol sheen bah echad mikkol ellu massiin lakkehunna
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir vechen haya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer kidvarav ezohi almenat isa kol shennitma bah sefek chalal
Makkirin yisrael mamzerim shebbenehem veen makkirin chalalin shebbenehem
Amar mar ezohi almenat isa kol sheen bah lo mishshum mamzerut velo mishshum netinut velo mishshum avde melachim ha chalal kasher
May shena hanach deorayeta chalal name deorayeta vetu amar rabbi meir shamati kol sheen bah echad mikkol ellu massiin lakkehunna hayenu tanna kamma

Vetu rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir vechen haya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer kidvarav ezohi almenat isa kol shennitma bah sefek chalal makkirin yisrael mamzerim shebbenehen veen makkirin chalalin shebbenehen veha amratte resha chalal kasher

Amar rabbi yochanan mamzer tzoveach vechalal shotek ika benayehu tanna kamma savar kol pesul dekaru leh veshatek pasul vehachi kaamar tanna kamma ezohi almenat isa kol sheen bah lo shetuk mamzerut velo shetuk netinut velo shetuk avde melachim velo shetuk chalal
Vekaamar leh rabbi meir hanach hu deka pasel leh bekahal aval shetuk chalal kasher veha deshatek mishshum dela ichpat leh

Vekaamar leh rabbi shimon ben elazar letanna kamma derabbi meir i shemia lach demachshar rabbi meir bishtika la dekaru leh chalal veshatek ella dekaru leh mamzer veshatek vehay deshatek savar mamzer kala it leh aval mamzer vetzoveach chalal veshotek pasul vehay deishtik savar misatyeh dela mappeki leh mikkahal
Tane chada rabbi yose omer shetuk mamzer kasher shetuk chalal pasul vetanya idach shetuk chalal kasher shetuk mamzer pasul
La kashya ha tanna kamma alliba derabbi meir ha derabbi shimon ben elazar alliba derabbi meir
Matni amar rabbi yose maase betinoket sheyyarda lemalloot mayim min haayin veneenasa amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri im rov anshe hair massiin lichhunna hare zo tinase lichhunna

Gema amar leh rava lerav nachman rabbi yochanan ben nuri deamar keman i kerabban gamliel afilu berov pesulin name machshar i kerabbi yehoshua afilu berov kesherim name pasel amar leh hachi amar rav yehuda amar rav

a: Bikronot shel tzipori haya maase vechidrabbi amme deamar rabbi amme vehu shehayeta sia shel bene adam kesherin overet lesham vechidrabbi yannay deamar rabbi yannay nivelet bikronot keshera lakkehunna
Bikronot salka datach ella nivelet bishat keronot keshera lakkehunna aval perash echad mitztzipori uvaal havalad shetuki
Ki ha dechi ata rav dimi amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina veamri lah amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina holchin achar rov hair veen holchin achar rov sia
Kelappe leya hane nayedi vehane kevii vekayemi
Ella holchin achar rov hair vehu deika rov sia bahadah veen holchin achar rov hair geredta velo achar rov sia geredta may tama gezera rov sia attu rov hair
Verov hair name i deka azli inhu legabbah kol defaresh merubba paresh la tzericha deka azla ihi legabbayehu dehave leh kavua veamar rabbi zera kol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame

Umi baenan tere rubbe vehatanya tesha chanuot kullan mochrot besar shechuta veachat mocheret besar nevela velakach meachat mehen veeno yodea mee ze mehen lakach sefeko asur uvannimtza hallech achar harov
Vechi tema besheen daltot medina neulot deka ate lah rubba mealma veha amar rabbi zera af al pi sheddaltot medina neulot maala asu beuchasin
Gufa amar rabbi zera kol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame ben lekulla ben lechumra

Mena leh lerabbi zera ha ilema mittesha chanuot kullan mochrot besar shechuta veachat besar nevela velakach meachat mehen veeno yodea meeze mehen lakach sefeko asur uvannimtza hallech achar harov hatam lechumra
Ella mittisha tzefardeim vesheretz echad benehem venaga beechad mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen naga sefeko tame hatam name lechumra
Ella mittisha sheratzim utzfardea echad benehem venaga beechad mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen naga birshut hayyachid sefeko tame birshut harabbim sefeko tahor
Umiddeorayeta mena lan amar kera vearav lo vekam alav ad sheyyitkaven lo verabbanan amri deve rabbi yannay perat lezorek even legav
Hechi dame ilema deika tisha goyim veechad yisrael benehem tipok li derubba goyim ninhu i name palga ufalga sefek nefashot lehakel
La tzericha deika tisha yisreelim vegoy echad benehem dehave leh goy kavua vechol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame
Itmar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav halacha kerabbi yose verav chanan bar rava amar rav horaat shaa hayeta
Metiv rabbi yirmeya uluchasin la baenan tere rubbe vehatnan
b: Matza bah tinok mushlach im rov goyim goy im rov yisrael yisrael mechetza al mechetza yisrael
Veamar rav lo shanu ella lehachoto aval leuchasin lo ushmuel amar lefakkeach alav et haggal
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav bikronot shel tzippori hava maase
Ulrav chanan bar rava deamar horaat shaa hayeta kashya ha man dematne ha la matne ha
Gufah matza bah tinok mushlach im rov goyim goy im rov yisrael yisrael mechetza al mechetza yisrael amar rav lo shanu ella lehachoto aval leuchasin lo ushmuel amar lefakkeach alav et haggal

Umi amar shemuel hachi vehaamar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel en holchin befikuach nefesh achar harov ella ki itmar dishmuel aresha ittemar im rov goyim goy amar shemuel ulfakkeach alav et haggal eno ken
Im rov goyim goy lemay hilcheta amar rav pappa lehaachilo nevelot
Im rov yisrael yisrael lemay hilcheta amar rav pappa lehachzir lo aveda
Mechetza al mechetza yisrael lemay hilcheta amar resh lakish linzakin hechi dame i nema denagcheh tora didan letora dideh lema leh ayeti reaya deyisrael atte ushkol
La tzericha denagcheh tora dideh letora didan palga meshallem veidach palga amar lehu ayete reaya delav yisrael ana veetten lechon
Hadaran alach betula nisset

Haishsha shennitarmela o shennitgarsha hi omeret betula nesatani vehu omer lo ki ella almana nesatich im yesh edim sheyyatzat behinuma veroshah parua ketubbatah matayim rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer af chiluk kelaot reaya
Umode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero sade zo shel avicha hayeta ulkachtiha hemennu shehu neeman

a: Shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir veim yesh edim shehi shel aviv vehu omer lekachtiha hemennu eno neeman
Gema tama deika edim ha leka edim baal meheman lema tenan setama dela kerabban gamliel dei rabban gamliel ha amar ihi mehemna
Afilu tema rabban gamliel ad kan la kaamar rabban gamliel hatam ella bevari veshemma aval hacha bevari uvari la amar
Udkaare lah may kaare lah ha bari uvari hu kevan derov nashim betulot nisaot ki vari veshemma dame
Vehachi name mistabbera middekatane umode rabbi yehoshua i amratte bishlama ayeri rabban gamliel bemode shappir ella i amratte la ayeri rabban gamliel bemode rabbi yehoshua leman mode
Mi savratte rabbi yehoshua ahay pirkin kae ammiggo kae veappirkin kamma kae

Aheya ilema aha hayeta meubberet veamru lah ma tivo shel ubbar ze meish peloni vechohen hu rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet rabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin hatam may miggo ika hare keresah ben shineha

Ella aha rauha medabberet im echad veamru lah ma tivo shel ish ze ish peloni vechohen hu rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet rabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin hatam may miggo ika hanicha lizeri deamar may medabberet nistera miggo dei baaya amra lo nivalti vekaamra nivalti mehemna ella lerav assi deamar may medabberet nivelet may miggo ika
Veella aha hi omeret mukkat etz ani vehu omer lo chi ella derusat ish atte rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet verabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin hatam may miggo ika

Bishlama lerabbi elazar deamar bemane velo kelum miggo dei baaya amra mukkat etz ani tachtecha veit lah matayim vekaamra meikara delet lah ella mane mehemna ella lerabbi yochanan deamar bematayim umane may miggo ika
Ella aha hannose et haishsha velo matza lah betulim hi omeret mishsheerastani neenasti venistachafa sadehu vehu omer lo chi ella ad shello erastich

Rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet verabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin demiggo dei baaya amra mukkat etz ani tachtecha dela ka fasla nafshah mikkehunna vekaamra neenasti deka pasla nafshah mikkehunna mishshum hachi kaamar rabban gamliel dimhemna vekaamar rabbi yehoshua lerabban gamliel behay miggo dehacha modena lach behahu miggo dehatam peligna ilaoch
Mikkedi hay miggo vehay miggo may shena hay miggo mehay miggo hacha en shor shachut lefanecha hatam hare shor shachut lefanecha
Vechevan derov nashim betulot nisaot ki la atu edim may have amar ravina mishshum deika lememar rov nashim betulot nisaot umiut almanot vechol hannisset betula yesh lah kol
b: Vezo hoil veen lah kol itra leh rubba
I kol hannisset betula yesh lah kol ki ato edim may have hanach sahade shakkare ninhu ella amar ravina rov hannisset betula yesh lah kol vezo hoil veen lah kol itra leh rubba

Im yesh edim sheyyatzta behinuma vechu velechush dilma mappeka edim behay be dina vegavya vahadar mappeka lah lichtuva behay bet din vegavya bah amar rabbi avahu zot omeret kotvin shovar rav pappa amar bimkom sheen kotvin ketubba askinan

Veika dematne lah abbarayeta ibda ketubbatah hitmina ketubbatah nisrefa ketubbatah rakdu lefaneha sachaku lefaneha heeviru lefaneha kos shel besora o mappa shel betulim im yesh lah edim beechad mikkol ellu ketubbatah matayim
Velechush dilma mappeka edim behay bet din vegavya vahadar mappeka lichtubbatah behay bet din vegavya bah amar rabbi avahu zot omeret kotvin shovar rav pappa amar bimkom sheen kotvin ketubba askinan
Veha ibda ketubbatah katane dichtav lah ihu sof sof mappeka lah vegavya bah may ibda ibda baur
I hachi hayenu nisrefa veod hitmina may ika lememar vetu ibda lema li ella kol ibda ki hitmina befanenu dame vela yahavinan lah ad deamri edim nisrefa ketubbatah
Man dematne lah abbarayeta kol shekken ammatnitin uman dematne lah ammatnitin aval abbarayeta la ki kushya
Im yesh edim ku velechush dilma mappeka ede hinuma behay bet din vegavya vahadar mappeka ede hinuma beve dina acharina vegavya bemakom dela efshar vadday katvinan shovar

Heeviru lefaneha kos shel besora may kos shel besora amar rav adda bar ahava kos yayin shel teruma maavirin lefaneha kelomar reuya hayeta zo leechol bitruma matkef lah rav pappa attu almana mi la achla bitruma ella amar rav pappa zo reshit kitruma reshit

Tanya rabbi yehuda omer chavit shel yayin maavirin lefaneha amar rav adda bar ahava betula maavirin lefaneha setuma beula maavirin lefaneha petucha ammay niabbar kamme betula vekamme beula la niabbar kelal zimnin detafsa matayim veamra ana betula havay vehay dela abbaru kammay ittenose hu deittenisu
Tanu rabbanan ketzad merakkedin lifne hakkalla bet shammay omrim

a: Kalla kemot shehi uvet hillel omrim kalla naa vachasuda amru lahen bet shammay levet hillel hare shehayeta chigeret o soma omrim lah kalla naa vachasuda vehattora amra middevar sheker tirchak amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay ledivrechem mi shellakach mikkach ra min hashshuk yeshabbechennu beenav o yegannennu beenav heve omer yeshabbechennu beenav mikkan amru chachamim leolam tehe dato shel adam meorevet im habberiyyot
Ki ata rav dimi amar hachi mesharu kamme kalleta bemareva lo kachal velo sarak velo pirkus veyaalat chen ki samchu rabbanan lerabbi zera sharu leh hachi la kachal velo sarak velo pirkus veyaalat chen
Ki semachu rabbanan lerabbi amme ulrabbi assi sharu lehu hachi kol min den vechol min den semuchu lana la tismuchu lana la min sarmisin vela min sarmitin veamri lah la min chamisin vela min turmisin
Rabbi avahu ki hava ate mimmetivta leve kesar nafkan amhata deve kesar leappeh umsharyan leh hachi rabba deammeh umdabberana deummeteh butzina dinhora berich metyach lishlam

Amru alav al rabbi yehuda bar ilay shehaya notel bad shel hadas umrakked lifne hakkalla veomer kalla naa vachasuda rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak merakked attelat amar rabbi zera ka machsef lan sava ki nach nafsheh ipsik ammuda denura ben dideh lechulle alma ugmiri dela ippesik ammuda denura ella i lechad bedara i litre bedara
Amar rabbi zera ahanya leh shotiteh lesava veamri lah shetuteh lesava veamri lah shitteh lesava
Rav acha markev lah akkatpeh umrakked amri leh rabbanan anan mahu lemibad hachi amar lehu i damyan alayechu kichshura lechayye vei la la
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan muttar lehistakkel bifne challa kol shiva kede lechabbevah al balah velet hilcheta keoteh
Tanu rabbanan maavirin et hammet millifne challa veze vaze millifne melech yisrael amru alav al agripas hammelech sheavar millifne kalla veshibbechuhu chachamim

Shibbechuhu mikkelal deshappir avad veha amar rav ashe afilu leman deamar nasi shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul melech shemmachal al kevodo en kevodo machul deamar mar som tasim alecha melech shettehe emato alecha parashat derachim havay

Tanu rabbanan mevattelin talmud tora lehotzaat hammet ulhachnasat kalla amru alav al rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay shehaya mevattel talmud tora lehotzaat hammet ulhachnasat kalla bamme devarim amurim kesheen immo kol tzarko aval yesh immo kol tzarko en mevattelin

Vechamma kol tzarko amar rav shemuel bar ini mishshemeh derav teresar alfe gavre veshita alfe shipure veamri lah telesar alfe gavre uminayehu shita alfe shipure ulla amar kegon dechayetzi gavre meavulla vead sichra rav sheshet veitema rabbi yochanan amar netilatah kintinatah ma netinatah beshishshim ribbo af netilatah beshishshim ribbo vehane mile leman dekare vetane
b: Aval leman dematne let leh shiura
Veim yesh edim sheyyatzta behinuma vechu may hinuma surchav bar pappa mishshemeh dizeri amar tannura deassa rabbi yochanan amar karita dimnamnema bah kalleta

Rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer vechu tana bihuda reaya bevavel may amar rav dardoge demishcha aresha derabbanan amar leh rav pappa leabbaye mishcha dachafifuta kaamar mar amar leh yatma la avada lach immach dardoge mishcha aresha derabbanan bishat maase ki ha dehahu merabbanan deiasak leh livreh be rabba bar ulla veamri lah rabba bar ulla iasak leh livreh be hahu merabbanan vedardeg mishcha aresha derabbanan bishat maase
Armalta may tane rav yosef armalta let lah kisane
Umode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero ku velitne mode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero sade zo shellecha hayeta ulkachtiha mimmecha
Mishshum deka vae lemitne sefa im yesh edim shehi shello vehu omer lekachtiha mimmennu eno neeman hechi dame
I deachlah shene chazaka ammay la meheman vei dela achlah shene chazaka peshita dela meheman
I hachi gabbe aviv name i deachlah shene chazaka ammay la meheman vei dela achlah shene chazaka peshita dela meheman
Bishlama gabbe aviv mashkachatte lah kegon sheachalah shettayim bechayye haav veachat bechayye veno vechidrav huna deamar rav huna en machazikin benichse katan afilu higdil
Verav huna matnitin ata leashmoinan ibaet ema rav huna diyyuka dematnitin kaamar veibaet ema afilu higdil ka mashma lan
Velitneyah bedideh velokmah kegon sheachalah shettayim befanav veachat shello befanav uchgon shebbarach
Barach mechamat may i devarach mechamat nefashot peshita dela meheman dela matze memache vei devarach mechamat mamon ibi leh lemachoye dekayema lan mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa
Ditnan shalosh aratzot lachazaka yehuda veever hayyarden vehaggalil haya bihuda vehechezik baggalil baggalil vehechezik bihuda enah chazaka ad sheyehe immo bimdina
Vehavenan bah may kasavar i kasavar mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa afilu bihuda vegalil name vei kasavar mechaa shello befanav la haveya mechaa afilu yehuda vihuda name la
Amar rabbi abba bar memel leolam kasavar mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa umatnitin bishat cherum shanu
Umay shena yehuda vegalil denaket

a: Distam yehuda uglil kishat cherum damu

Velitne mode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero mane laviti mimmecha ufrativ lach shehu neeman mishshum deka bae lemitne sefa im yesh edim shehu lava mimmennu vehu omer perativ eno neeman veha kayema lan hammalve et chavero beedim eno tzarich leforo beedim
Velitne mode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero mane leavich beyadi veheechaltiv peras shehu neeman
Alliba deman i alliba derabbanan ha amri meshiv aveda have i alliba derabbi eliezer ben yaakov ha amar shevua bae

Detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer peamim sheadam nishba al taanat atzmo ketzad mane leavich beyadi veheechaltiv peras hare ze nishba vezehu shennishba al taanat atzmo vachachamim omrim eno ella kemeshiv aveda ufatur
Verabbi eliezer ben yaakov let leh meshiv aveda patur amar rav betoano katan vehaamar mar en nishbain al taanat cheresh shote vekatan
May katan gadol veammay kare leh katan dilgabbe mile deaviv katan hu i hachi taanat atzmo taanat acherim hi taanat acherim vehodaat atzmo
Kullehi taanata taanat acherim vehodaat atzmo ninhu

Ella hacha bidrabba kamipalgi deamar rabba mippene ma amra tora mode miktzat hattaana yishshava chazaka en adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo vehay bechullah bae delichpereh vehay dela kefar leh mishshum deen adam meiz panav hu
b: Uvchullah bae delode leh vehay dela odi leh ki hechi delishtemit leh vesavar ad dehave li zuze ufarana leh verachamana amar remi shevua aleh ki hechi delode leh bechulleh
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar la shena bo vela shena bivno eno meiz vehilkach lav meshiv aveda have verabbanan savri bo hu deeno meiz aval bivno meiz umiddelo heiz meshiv aveda have

Matni haedim sheamru ketav yadenu hu ze aval anusim hayinu ketannim hayinu pesule edut hayinu hare ellu neemanim veim yesh edim shehu ketav yadam o shehaya ketav yadam yotze mimmakom acher enan neemanin
Gema amar rame bar chama lo shanu ella sheamru anusim hayinu mechamat mamon aval anusim hayinu mechamat nefashot hare ellu neemanin

Amar leh rava kol kemineh kevan shehiggid shuv eno chozer umaggid vechi tema hane mile al pe aval bishtar la veha amar resh lakish edim hachatumim al hashshetar naasa kemi shennechkera edutan bevet din

Ella ki ittemar aresha ittemar hare ellu neemanin amar rame bar chama lo shanu ella sheamru anusin hayinu mechamat nefashot aval amru anusin hayinu mechamat mamon en neemanin may tama en adam mesim atzmo rasha

Tanu rabbanan en neemanim lefoslo divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim neemanim bishlama lerabbanan ki tamayehu shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir ella lerabbi meir may tama bishlama pesule edut malve gufeh meikara midak dayek umachtem ketannim name kidrabbi shimon ben lakish deamar resh lakish

a: Chazaka en haedim chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken naasa begadol ella anusin may tama
Amar rav chisda kasavar rabbi meir edim sheamru lahem chitmu sheker veal tehargu yehargu veal yachtemu sheker

Amar leh rava hashta ilu atu lekamman leimmeloche amrinan lehu zilu chatumu vela titkattelun deamar mar en lecha davar sheomed bifne pikuach nefesh ella avoda zara vegilluy araot ushfichut damim bilvad hashta dachatamu amrinan lehu ammay chatmitu
Ella tama derabbi meir kidrav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav mode bishtar shekketavo en tzarich lekayemo
Gufa amar rav huna amar rav mode bishtar shekketavo en tzarich lekayemo amar leh rav nachman gannova gannove lema lach i sevira lach kerabbi meir ema halacha kerabbi meir
Amar leh umar hechi sevira leh amar leh ki atu lekamman ledina amrinan lehu zilu kayyimu shetarayechu vechutu ledina
Amar rav yehuda amar rav haomer shetar amana hu ze eno neeman

Dekaamar man ilema dekaamar love peshita kal kemineh veella dekaamar malve tavo alav beracha ella dekaamri edim i dichtav yadam yotze mimmakom acher peshita dela mehemni vei deen ketav yadam yotze mimmakom acher ammay la mehemni
Siman baesh amar rava leolam dekaamar love vechidrav huna deamar rav huna amar rav mode bishtar shekketavo en tzarich lekayemo
Abbaye amar leolam deamar malve uchgon shechav laacherim vechidrabbi natan
Detanya rabbi natan omer minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane vachavero bachavero minnayin shemmotziin mizze venotnin laze talmud lomar venatan laasher asham lo

Rav ashe amar leolam dekaamri edim uden ketav yadam yotze mimmakom acher udkaamratte ammay la mehemni kidrav kahana deamar rav kahana asur lo laadam sheyeshahe shetar amana betoch beto mishshum shenneemar al tashken beohalecha avela
b: Veamar rav sheshet bereh derav idi shema minah midderav kahana edim sheamru amana hau devarenu en neemanin may tama kevan deavela hu aavela la chatmi

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi asur lo laadam sheyeshahe shetar parua betoch beto mishshum shenneemar al tashken beohalecha avela bemareva mishshemeh derav amri im aven beyadcha harchikehu ze shetar amana ushtar passim veal tashken beohalecha avela ze shetar parua
Man deamar shetar parua kol shekken shetar amana uman deamar shetar amana aval shetar parua la dezimnin dimshahe leh appeshite desafra
Ittemar sefer sheeno muggah amar rabbi amme ad sheloshim yom muttar leshahoto mikkan veelach asur leshahoto mishshum shenneemar al tashken beohalecha avela

Amar rav nachman edim sheamru amana hau devarenu en neemanin modaa hau devarenu en neemanin mar bar rav ashe amar amana hau devarenu en neemanin modaa hau devarenu neemanin may tama hay nitan likatev vehay lo nitan likatev

Bea mineh rava merav nachman tenay hau devarenu mahu modaa vaamana hayenu tama deka akri leh lishtara vehay name ka akar lishtara o dilma tenay milta achariti hi amar leh ki atu lekamman ledina amrinan lehu zilu kayyimu tenaayechu vechutu ledina
Ed omer tenay veed omer eno tenay amar rav pappa tarvayehu bishtara mealleya ka mashadi vehay dekaamar tenay have leh chad veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim
Matkef lah rav huna bereh derav yehoshua i hachi afilu tarvayehu name ella amrinan hane lemikar sahadutayehu kaatu hay name lemikar sahaduteh kaate vehilcheta kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua

Tanu rabbanan shenayim chatumin al hashshetar umetu uvau shenayim min hashshuk veamru yadanu shekketav yadam hu aval anusim hau ketannim hau pesule edut hau hare ellu neemanim veim yesh edim shekketav yadam hu ze o shehaya ketav yadam yotze mimmakom acher mishshetar shekkara alav arar vehuchzak bevet din en ellu neemanin
Umagbenan beh kevishtara mealleya veammay tere utre ninhu
Amar rav sheshet zot omeret hachchasha techillat hazama hi

a: Uchshem sheen mezimin et haedim ella bifnehem kach en machchishin et haedim ella bifnehem
Amar leh rav nachman ilu hao kamman umachchishin lehu hava hachchasha vela hava mashgichin behu dehaveya lah edut muchcheshet hashta deletanhu deilu hao lekamman dilma hao modu lehu mehemni

Ella amar rav nachman oke tere lahade tere veoke mamona bechezkat mareh mide dehave annichse devar shatya devar shatya zabben nichse ato be tere amri keshehu shote zabben vaato be tere veamri keshehu chalim zabben
Amar rav ashe oke tere lahade tere veoki mamona bechezkat bar shatya vela amaran ella deit leh chazaka daavahateh aval let leh chazaka daavahateh amrinan keshehu shote zevan uchshehu shote zabben
Amar rabbi avahu en mezimin et haedim ella bifnehen umachchishin et haedim shello bifnehen vahazama shello bifnehen nehi dahazama la haveya hachchasha miha haveya

Amar mar im yesh edim shekketav yadam hu ze o shehaya ketav yadam yotze mimmakom acher mishshetar shekkara alav arar vehuchzak bevet din en neemanin kara alav arar in lo kara alav arar la mesayya leh lerabbi assi deamar rabbi assi en mekayemin et hashshetar ella mishshetar shekkara alav arar vehuchzak bevet din
Amri nehardae en mekayemin et hashshetar ella mishte ketubbot o mishshette sadot vehu sheachalum baalehen shalosh shanim uvshofi

Amar rav shimi bar ashe uvotze mittachat yad acher aval miyyad atzmo la may shena tachat yad atzmo dela dilma zayyofe mezayyef mittachat yede acher name dilma azal vachaza ata vezayyef kulle hay la matze mechaven

Tanu rabbanan kotev adam eduto al hashshetar umeid aleha afilu leachar kamma shanim amar rav huna vehu shezzochrah meatzmo rabbi yochanan amar af al pi sheen zochrah meatzmo amar rabba shema minah midderabbi yochanan hane be tere deyadi sahaduta uminneshe chad minnayehu madkar chad lechavreh
Ibaya lehu atzmo may rav chaviva amar afilu atzmo mar bereh derav ashe amar atzmo lo vehilcheta atzmo lo
b: Vei tzurba merabbanan hu afilu atzmo ki ha derav ashe hava yedia leh besahaduta lerav kahana amar leh mi dechir mar hay sahaduta amar leh la velav hachi vehachi hava amar leh la yadana lesof idchar rav ashe ashed leh chazyeh lerav kahana dahava mechassem amar leh mi savratte alach ka semichna ana hu dirmay annafshay veiddachri

Tenan hatam hatteluliyyot hakkerovot ben lair uven ladderech echad chadashot veechad yeshanot temeot harchokot chadashot tehorot yeshanot temeot ezohi kerova chamishshim amma veezo hi yeshana shishshim shana divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer kerova sheen kerova hemenna yeshana sheen adam zochrah

May ir umay derech ilema ir ir mammash derech derech mammash missefeka mi machzekinan tuma vehaamar resh lakish ila matzu vetiharu eretz yisrael amar rabbi zera ir ir hassemucha levet hakkevarot vederech derech bet hakkevarot
Bishlama derech bet hakkevarot dezimnin demitreme ben hashshemashot umikkeru kavru betel ella ir hassemucha levet hakkevarot kullehi levet hakkevarot azli

Amar rabbi chanina mittoch shehannashim kovrot sham niflehen umukke shechin zerootehem ad chamishshim amma azla ihi lechuddah tefe davra inish bahadah ulvet hakkevarot azla hilkach tuma beeretz yisrael la machzekinan
Amar rav chisda shema minah merabbi meir hay sahaduta ad shitin shenin midchar tefe la midchar vela hi hatam hu dela ramya aleh aval hacha kevan derame aleh afilu tuva name

Matni ze omer ketav yadi veze ketav yado shel chaveri veze omer ze ketav yadi veze ketav yado shel chaveri hare ellu neemanin ze omer ze ketav yadi veze omer ze ketav yadi tzerichin letzaref immahem acher divre rabbi vachachamim omrim enam tzerichin letzaref immahen acher ella neeman adam lomar ze ketav yadi
Gema keshettimtze lomar ledivre rabbi

a: Al ketav yadan hem meidim ledivre chachamim al mane shebbashshetar hem meidim
Peshita mahu detema lerabbi sappoke mesappeka leh i al ketav yadam hem meidim o al mane shebbashshetar hem meidim
Venafka minah hecha demit chad minayehu live shenayim min hashshuk lehaid alav
Deim ken kanafek neche riva demamona appumma dechad sahada
Vehacha lechumra vehacha lechumra

Ka mashma lan derabbi mifshat peshita leh ben lekulla ben lechumra deamar rav yehuda amar rav shenayim hachatumin al hashshetar umet echad mehen tzerichin shenayim min hashshuk lehaid alav bezo rabbi lekulla verabbanan lechumra

Vei leka tere ella chad may amar abbaye lichtov chatimat yedeh achaspa veshade leh beve dina umachzeki leh be dina vechazu leh vela tzarich ihu leashode achatimat yedeh veazel ihu vehay umashadi aidach
Vedaveka achaspa aval ammegilleta la dilma mashkach lah inish dela mealle vechatev ilaveh may devae utnan hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyav lo gove minnechasim bene chorin
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kedivre chachamim peshita yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim mahu detema halacha kerabbi mechavero vaafilu mechaverav ka mashma lan
Siman nach nad chad amar leh rav chinnana bar chiyya lerav yehuda veamri lah rav huna bar yehuda lerav yehuda veamri lah rav chiyya bar yehuda lerav yehuda umi amar shemuel hachi

Veha hahu shetara dinfak mibbe dina demar shemuel vahava ketiv beh middaata rav anan bar chiyya veashed achatimut yedeh veaddechad deimmeh umannu rav chanan bar rabba umiddaata rav chanan bar rabba veashed achatimut yedeh veaddechad deimmeh umannu rav anan bar chiyya ashsharnohi vekayyemnohi kedachaze

Amar leh hahu shetara deyatme hava vechash shemuel levet din toin usvar shemuel dilma ika disvira leh halacha kerabbi mechavero velo mechaverav uvha afilu mechaverav sevar eeved ravecha ki hechi dela mafsedi yatme
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel ed vedayyan mitztarfin
Amar rame bar chama kamma mealleya ha shemata amar rava may mealleuta may deka mashed sahada la ka mashed dayyana umay deka mashed dayyana la ka mashed sahada
Ella ki ata rame bar yechezkel amar la tetzitinhu lehane kelale dechayel yehuda achi mishshemeh dishmuel
b: Ikla ravnay achuh derabbi chiyya bar abba lemizban shumsheme vaamar hachi amar shemuel ed vedayyan mitztarfin amar ammemar kamma mealleya ha shemata amar leh rav ashe leammemar mishshum dekallesah avuh deimmach atte name mekallesatte lah kevar parchah rava

Amar rav safra amar rabbi abba amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta amar rav huna veamri leh amar rav huna amar rav shelosha sheyyashvu lekayyem et hashshetar shenayim makkirin chatimut yede edim veechad eno makkir ad shello chatmu meidin befanav vechotem mishshechatmu en meidin befanav vechotem
Umi katvinan vehaamar rav pappi mishshemeh derava hay ashsharta dedayyane denichtav mikkammeh denacho sahadi achatimat yedayehu pesula demitchaze keshikra hacha name mitchaze keshikra

Ella hacha bemay askinan demuchzak lan baavuh dehay dechohen hu unfak aleh kala deven gerusha o ben chalutza hu veachatineh vaata ed echad veamar yadana beh dechohen hu
b: Veassekineh vaato be tere veamri ben gerusha uven chalutza hu veachatineh vaata ed echad veamar yadana beh dechohen hu udchulle alma mitztarfin leedut

Vehacha bemechash leziluta deve dina kamipalgi tanna kamma savar kevan deachatineh la massekinan leh chayeshinan leziluta deve dina verabban shimon ben gamliel savar anan achatinan leh vaanan massekinan leh ulziluta deve dina la chayeshinan
Matkef lah rav ashe i hachi afilu tere utre name

Ella amar rav ashe bemitztarfin leedut kamipalgi uviflugta dehane tannae detanya en edutan mitztarefet ad sheyyiru shenehem keechad rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer afilu baze achar ze veen edutan mitkayyemet bevet din ad sheyyaidu shenehem keechad
Rabbi natan omer shomin devarav shel ze hayyom uchsheyyavo chavero lemachar shomin devarav
Matni haishsha shennechbesha bide goyim al yede mamon mutteret levalah al yede nefashot asura levalah
Gema amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav lo shanu ella sheyyad yisrael takkifa al ummot haolam aval yad ummot haolam takkifa al atzman afilu al yede mamon asura levalah

Metiv rava heid rabbi yose hakkohen verabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav al bat yisrael shehurhana beashkelon verichakuha bene mishpachtah veedeha meidim otah shello nistera veshello nitmaa veamru lahem chachamim im attem maaminim shehurhana haaminu shello nistera veshello nitmaa veim i attem maaminim shello nistera veshello nitmaa al taaminu shehurhana
Veha ashkelon deyad ummot haolam takkifa al atzman vekatane

a: Hurhana in nechbesha la hu haddin afilu nechbesha umaase shehaya kach haya

Ika deamri amar rava af anan name tenena heid rabbi yose hakkohen verabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav al bat yisrael shehurhana beashkelon verichakuha bene mishpachtah veedeha meidim aleha shello nistera veshello nitmaa veamru chachamim im attem maaminim shehurhana haaminu shello nistera veshello nitmaa veim en attem maaminim shello nistera veshello nitmaa al taaminu shehurhana
Veha ashkelon deal yede mamon hava vetama deedim meidin otah ha en edim meidin otah la may lav la shena hurhana vela shena nechbesha la hurhana shane
Ika derame lah mirma tenan al yede mamon mutteret levalah urminhu heid rabbi yose ku veha ashkelon deal yede mamon vekatane tama deedim meidim otah ha en edim meidin otah la
Umshanne amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak la kashya kan sheyyad yisrael takkifa al ummot haolam kan sheyyad ummot haolam takkifa al atzman

Al yede nefashot asura vechu amar rav kegon neshe gannave velevi amar kegon ishto shel ben donay amar chizkiyya vehu shennigmar dinan lahariga verabbi yochanan amar af al pi shello nigmar dinan lahariga
Matni ir shekkevashuha karkom kol kohanot shennimtzeu betochah pesulot veim yesh lahen edim afilu eved afilu shifcha hare ellu neemanin veen neeman adam al yede atzmo
Gema urminhu balleshet shebbaa lair bishat shalom chaviyyot petuchot asurot setumot muttarot bishat milchama ellu veellu muttarot lefi sheen penay lenassech
Amar rav mari livol yesh penay lenassech en penay rabbi yitzchak bar elazar mishshemeh dechizkiyya amar kan becharkom shel otah malchut kan becharkom shel malchut acheret

Shel otah malchut name i efshar dela arak chad minayehu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel keshemmishmarot root zo et zo i efshar dela nayema purta amar rabbi levi kegon dimhaddar lah lemata shushilta vechalba ugoza vaaoza

Amar rabbi abba bar zavda peligi bah rabbi yehuda nesia verabbanan chad amar kan becharkom shel otah malchut kan becharkom shel malchut acheret vela kashya leh vela mide vechad kashya leh kol hane umshanne kegon dimhaddar leh lemata shushilta vechalba ugoza vaaoza
Amar rav idi bar avin amar rabbi yitzchak bar ashyan im yesh sham machboa achat matztzelet al hakkohanot kullan
Bae rabbi yirmeya enah machzeket ella achat mahu mi amrinan kol chada vachada hayenu ha o dilma la amrinan
Umay shena mishshene shevilin echad tame veechad tahor vehalach beechad mehen veasa teharot uva chavero vehalach bashsheni veasa teharot
Rabbi yehuda omer im nishal ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo tehorot shenehem keachat temeot rabbi yosi omer ben kach uven kach temein

Veamar rava veitema rabbi yochanan bevat achat divre hakkol temein beze achar ze divre hakkol tehorim lo nechleku ella beva lishael alav veal chavero mar medamme leh livvat achat umar medamme leh levaze achar ze vehacha name kevan deshare lehu lechullehu kevat achat dame
Hachi hashta hatam vadday ika tuma hacha mi yemar deitammay
Bae rav ashe amra lo nechbeti velo nitmeti mahu mi amrinan
b: Ma li leshakker o dilma la amrinan
Umay shena mehahu maase dehahu gavra deogar leh chamara lechavreh amar leh la tezil beorcha dinhar pekod deika mayya zil beorcha denaresh deleka mayya vaazal ihu beorcha dinhar pekod umit chamara
Ata lekammeh derava amar leh in beorcha dinhar pekod azali mihu la hao mayya amar rabba ma li leshakker i bae amar leh beorcha denaresh azali vaamar leh abbaye ma li leshakker bimkom edim la amrinan
Hachi hashta hatam vadday ika edim deika mayya hacha vadday itammay chashasha hu uvimkom chashasha amrinan
Im yesh edim afilu eved vaafilu shifcha neemanin vaafilu shifcha didah mehemna urminhi lo tityached immo ella al pi edim
Vaafilu al pi eved veal pi shifcha chutz mishshifchatah mippene shellibbah gas beshifchatah amar rav pappe bishvuya hekelu
Rav pappa amar ha beshifcha didah ha beshifcha dideh
Veshifcha didah la mehemna ha katane en adam meid al atzmo ha shifcha didah mehemna shifchatah name keatzmah dame
Rav ashe amar ha veha beshifcha didah veshifcha michza chazya veshatka hatam dishtikatah mattiratah la mehemna hacha dishtikatah osartah mehemna
Hashta name atya umshakkera tarte la avda

Ki ha demari bar isak veamri lah chana bar isak ata leh acha mibbe chozaa amar leh pelog li benichse deabba amar leh la yadana lach ata lekammeh derav chisda amar leh shappir kaamar lach dichtiv vayyakker yosef et echav vehem lo hikkiruhu melammed sheyyatza belo chatimat zakan uva bachatimat zakan

Amar leh zil ayeti sahade daachuh atte amar leh it li sahade umistefu mineh degavra allama hu amar leh ledideh zil ayetinhu atte delav achuch hu amar leh dina hachi hammotzi mechavero alav haraya amar leh hachi daenna lach ulchullehu allame chavrach hashta name atu umshakkeri tarte la avdi
Lema ketannae zo edut ish veishsha tinok vetinoket aviha veimmah veachiha vaachotah aval lo benah uvittah lo avdah veshifchatah vetanya idach hakkol neemanin lehaid chutz mehemenna uvalah
Derav pappe udrav ashe tannae hi derav pappa mi lema tannae hi
Amar lecha rav pappa ki tanya hahi bimsicha lefi tummah

Ki ha dechi ata rav dimi amar rav chanan kartignaa mishtae maase ba lifne rabbi yehoshua ben levi veamri lah rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishtae maase ba lifne rabbi beadam echad shehaya mesiach lefi tummo veamar ani veimmi nishbinu leven haggoyim yatzati lishov mayim dati al immi lelakket etzim dati al immi vehissiah rabbi lichhunna al piv
Matni amar rabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav hammaon hazze lo zaza yadah mittoch yadi mishshaa shennichnesu goyim lirushalayim vead sheyyatzu amru lo en adam meid al atzmo
Gema tana veaf al pi chen yiched lah bayit bachatzero uchshehi yotza yotza berosh baneha uchshehi nichneset nichneset besof baneha
Bae abbaye mahu laasot bigrusha ken hatam hu devishvuya hekelu aval hacha la o dilma la shena
Ta shema detanya hamgaresh et ishto lo tinnase bishchunato

a: Veim haya kohen lo tadur immo bemavoy im haya kefar katan ze haya maase veamru kefar katan nidon kishchuna
Mi nidche mippene mi ta shema detanya hi nidchet mippanav veen hu nidche mippaneha veim hayeta chatzer shellah hu nidche mippaneha

Ibaya lehu hayeta chatzer shel shenehem mahu ta shema hi nidchet mippanav bemay askinan ilema bechatzer shello peshita veella bechatzer shellah vehatanya im hayeta chatzer shellah hu nidche mippaneha ella lav ki hay gavena dilma daagir megar
May have alah ta shema hinne Adonai metaltelcha taltela gaver veamar rav tiltula degavra kashe middeitta

Tanu rabbanan lava hemenna benichse aviha enah nifraat ella al yede acher amar rav sheshet vei atu lekamman ledina la mizdakkinan lehu rav pappa amar shammote meshammetinan lehu rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar naggode name menaggedinan lehu amar rav nachman tana beevel rabbati bamme devarim amurim shennitgarsha min hannissuin aval keshennitgarsha min haerusin nifraat al yede atzmah sheen libbo gas bah

Hahu arus vaarusato daato lekammeh derava yetev rav adda bar matna kammeh oki rava shelucha bentayehu amar leh rav adda bar matna vehaamar rav nachman tana beevel rabbati ku amar leh ka chazena deka gayesi bahadade

Ika deamri la oki rava shaliach bentayehu amar leh rav adda bar matna nokem mar shelucha bentayehu amar leh veha amar rav nachman tana beevel rabbati ku amar leh hane mile hecha dela gayesi bahadade aval hane ka chazena lehu degayesi bahadade
Matni veellu neemanin lehaid begodlan ma sherau bekotnan neeman adam lomar ze ketav yado shel abba veze ketav yado shel rabbi veze ketav yado shel achi

Zachur hayiti biflonit sheyyatza behinuma veroshah parua veshehaya ish peloni yotze mibbet hassefer litbol leechol bitruma veshehaya cholek immanu al haggoren vehammakom hazze bet happeras vead kan hayinu bain bashshabbat
Aval en adam neeman lomar derech haya lifloni bammakom hazze maamad umisped haya lifloni bammakom hazze
Gema amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua vehu sheyyesh gadol immo
Utzricha dei ashmeinan aviv mishshum dishchiach gabbeh aval rabbo la vei ashmeinan rabbo mishshum deit leh emteh derabbeh aval aviv la
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte aviv dishchiach gabbeh verabbo deit leh emteh aval achiv delet leh la ha vela ha ema la ka mashma lan kevan dekiyyum shetarot midderabbanan hemnuhu rabbanan bidrabbanan
Zachur hayiti biflonit sheyyatza behinuma veroshah parua may tama kevan derov nashim betulot nisaot gilluy milleta bealma hu
Veshehaya ish peloni yotze mibbet hassefer litbol leechol bitruma vedilma eved kohen hu mesayya leh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi asur leadam sheyelammed et avdo tora
Vela vehatanya lava hemennu rabbo o sheasao rabbo
b: Appotroppos o shehinniach tefilin bifne rabbo o shekkara shelosha pesukim bevet hakkeneset hare ze lo yatza lecherut hatam deikri eved middato ki kaamrinan deka naheg beh minhag banim

Litbol leechol bitruma bitruma derabbanan veshehaya cholek immanu al haggoren vedilma eved kohen hu tenan keman deamar en cholkin teruma leeved ella im ken rabbo immo detanya en cholkin teruma leeved ella im ken rabbo immo divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer yachol hu sheyyomar im kohen ani tenu li bishvil atzmi veim eved kohen ani tenu li bishvil rabbi
Bimkomo shel rabbi yehuda hau maalin mitteruma leuchasin bimkomo shel rabbi yose lo hau maalin mitteruma leuchasin

Tanya amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose miyyamay lo headti paam achat headti veheelu eved lakkehunna al pi heelu salka datach hashta uma behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadam tzaddikim atzmam lo kol shekken
Ella bikkeshu lehaalot eved lakkehunna al pi chaza beatreh derabbi yose vaazal veashed beatreh derabbi yehuda

Veshehammakom hazze bet happeras hu may tama bet happeras derabbanan deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel menappeach adam bet happeras veholech verav yehuda bar amme mishshemeh derav yehuda amar bet happeras shennidash tahor may tama i efshar leetzem kisora shello nidash baregel
Vead kan hayinu bain bashshabbat kasavar techumin derabbanan
Veen neeman lomar derech haya lifloni bammakom hazze maamad umisped haya lifloni bammakom hazze may tama appoke mamona la mappekinan
Tanu rabbanan neeman hattinok lomar kach amar li abba mishpacha zo tehora mishpacha zo temea tehora utmea salka datach ella mishpacha zo keshera umishpacha zo pesula

Vesheachalnu biktzatza shel bat peloni lifloni veshehayinu molichim challa umattanot lifloni kohen al yede atzmo aval lo al yede acher vechullan im haya goy venitgayyer eved venishtachrer en neemanim veen neeman lomar derech haya lifloni bammakom hazze maamad umisped haya lifloni bammakom hazze rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer neemanim
Rabbi yochanan ben beroka aheya ilema assefa appoke mamona hu ella aresha vechullam im haya goy venitgayyer eved venishtachrer en neemanin rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer neemanin
Bemay kamipalgi tanna kamma savar kevan degoy hu la hava dayek verabbi yochanan ben beroka savar kevan dedateh leigayyore medak hava dayek

May ketzatza detanu rabbanan ketzad ketzatza echad min haachin shennasa ishsha sheenah hogenet lo bain bene mishpacha umviin chavit melea perot veshovrin otah beemtza rechava veomrim achenu bet yisrael shimu achinu peloni nasa ishsha sheenah hogenet lo umityarim anu shemma yitarev zaro bezarenu bou ukchu lachem dugma ledorot shello yitarev zaro bezarenu vezo hi ketzatza shehattinok neeman lehaid aleha
Hadaran alach haishsha shennitarmela

a: Ellu nearot sheyyesh lahen kenas habba al hammamzeret veal hannetina veal hakkutit habba al haggiyyoret veal hashshevuya veal hashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayeru veshennishtachreru pechutot mibbenot shalosh shanim veom echad
Habba al achoto veal achot aviv veal achot immo veal achot ishto veal eshet achiv veal eshet achi aviv veal hannidda yesh lahem kenas af al pi shehen behikkaret en bahen mitat bet din
Gema hane nearot pesulot it lehu kenas kesherot la hachi kaamar ellu nearot pesulot sheyyesh lahem kenas habba al hammamzeret veal hannetina veal hakkutit
Naara in ketanna la man tanna

Amar rav yehuda amar rav rabbi meir hi detanya ketanna mibbat yom echad vead shettavi shette searot yesh lah mecher veen lah kenas umishshettavi shette searot vead shettivgar yesh lah kenas veen lah mecher divre rabbi meir shehaya rabbi meir omer kol makom sheyyesh mecher en kenas vechol makom sheyyesh kenas en mecher
Vachachamim omrim ketanna mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad vead shettivgar yesh lah kenas kenas in mecher la ema
b: Af kenas bimkom mecher
Vehane bene kenasa ninhu veammay ikri kan velo tihye leishsha ishsha haruya lo amar resh lakish naara naara hannaara chad legufeh vechad leetoye chayyave lavin vechad leetoye chayyave charetot
Rav pappa amar betula betulot habbetulot chad legufeh vechad leetoye chayyave lavin vechad leetoye chayyave charetot
Verav pappa may tama la amar keresh lakish hahu mibe leh lechidabbaye deamar abbaye ba aleha umeta patur shenneemar venatan laavi hannaara laavi naara velo laavi meta

Veresh lakish may tama la amar kerav pappa hahu mibe leh ligzera shava detanya kesef yishkol kemohar habbetulot sheyehe ze kemohar habbetulot umohar habbetulot kaze veresh lakish name mibe leh lechidabbaye verav pappa name mibe leh ligzera shava

Ella shita kerae ketivi naara naara hannaara betula betulot habbetulot tere legufayehu chad lechidabbaye vechad ligzera shava iyyataru leh tere chad leetoye chayyave lavin vechad leetoye chayyave charetot
Ulappoke mehay tanna detanya velo tihye leishsha shimon hattimni omer ishsha sheyyesh bah havaya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer ishsha haruya lekayemah
May benayehu amar rabbi zera mamzeret untina ika benayehu leman deamar yesh bah havaya ha name yesh bah havaya leman deamar reuya lekayemah ha enah reuya lekayemah

Ulrabbi akiva deamar en kidushin tofsin bechayyave lavin may benayehu ika benayehu almana lechohen gadol kerabbi simay detanya rabbi simay omer min hakkol ose rabbi akiva mamzerin chutz mealmana lechohen gadol shehare amra tora lo yikkach velo yechallel chilulin hu ose veen ose mamzerin
Ulrabbi yeshevav deamar bou venitzvach al akiva ben yosef shehaya omer kol sheen lo bia beyisrael havalad mamzer may benayehu ika benayehu

a: Chayyave ase mitzri vaadomi
Hanicha lerabbi yeshevav i leappoke mittama derabbi simay kaate shappir ella i tama denafsheh kaamar kol sheen lo bia beyisrael havalad mamzer vaafilu chayyave ase may benayehu
Ika benayehu beula lechohen gadol umay shena dehave leh ase sheeno shave bakkol
Amar rav chisda hakkol modim beva al hannidda shemmeshallem kenas leman deamar yesh bah havaya ha name yesh bah havaya leman deamar reuya lekayemah ha name reuya lekayemah

Ulappoke midderabbi nechunya ben hakkana detanya rabbi nechunya ben hakkana haya ose et yom hakkippurim kashshabbat letashlumin ma shabbat mitchayyev benafsho ufatur min hattashlumin af yom hakkippurim mitchayyev benafsho ufatur min hattashlumin
May tama derabbi nechunya ben hakkana amar abbaye neemar ason bide adam veneemar ason bide shamayim ma ason haamur bide adam patur min hattashlumin af ason haamur bide shamayim patur min hattashlumin

Matkef lah rav adda bar ahava mimmay dechi ka mazhar lehu yaakov livneh al tzinim ufachim devide shamayim ninhu dilma al arya vegannave devide adam ninhu attu yaakov aha azhar aha la azhar yaakov al kol mile azhar

Vetzinim pachim bide shamayim ninhu vehatanya hakkol bide shamayim chutz mitztzinim pachim shenneemar tzinim pachim bederech ikesh shomer nafsho yirchak mehem vetu arya vegannave bide adam ninhu vehaamar rav yosef vechen tane rabbi chiyya miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash af al pi shebbatlu sanhedrin arba mitot lo batlu lo batlu ha batlu lehu ella
b: Din arba mitot lo batlu mi shennitchayyev sekila o nofel min haggag o chayya dorasto umi shennitchayyev serefa o nofel bidleka o nachash makkisho umi shennitchayyev hariga o nimsar lammalchut o listim bain alav umi shennitchayyev chenek o tovea bannahar o met bisronche ella efoch arya vegannave bide shamayim tzinim ufachim bide adam

Rava amar tama derabbi nechunya ben hakkana mehacha veim halem yalimu am haaretz et enehem min haish hahu betitto mizzaro lammolech vesamti ani et panay baish hahu uvmishpachto vehichratti oto amra tora karet shelli kemita shellachem ma mita shellachem patur min hattashlumin af karet shelli patur min hattashlumin
May ika ben rava leabbaye ika benayehu zar sheachal teruma leabbaye patur ulrava chayyav

Ulabbaye patur vehaamar rav chisda mode rabbi nechunya ben hakkana begonev chelbo shel chavero vaachalo shehu chayyav shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem shebba lide isur chelev alma demeidana deagbeheh kanyeh mitchayyev benafsho la hava ad deachel leh hacha name beidana deagbeheh kanyeh mitchayyev benafsho la have ad deachel leh hacha bemay askinan kegon shettachav lo chavero letoch piv

Sof sof kevan delaaseh kanyeh mitchayyev benafsho la have ad devalah kegon shettachav lo letoch bet habbelia hechi dame i dematze leahdorah nehdar i la matze leahdorah ammay chayyav la tzericha dematze leahdorah al yede haddechak
Rav pappa amar kegon shettachav lo chavero mashkin shel teruma letoch piv rav ashe amar bezar sheachal teruma mishshello

a: Vekara shirain shel chavero

Gufa amar rav chisda mode rabbi nechunya ben hakkana begonev chelbo shel chavero vaachalo shehu chayyav shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide isur chelev lema peliga derabbi avin deamar rabbi avin hazzorek chetz mittechilat arba lesof arba vekara shirain bahalichato patur sheakira tzorech hannacha hi hacha name hagbaha tzorech achila hi
Hachi hashta hatam i efshar lehannacha belo akira hacha efshar laachila belo hagbaha dei bae gachen veachel i name hatam i bae leahdorah la matze mahdar lah hacha matze mahdar lah

May ika ben hay lishana lehay lishana ika benayehu hammaavir sakkin birshut harabbim vekara shirain bahalichato lehach lishana deamratte i efshar lehannacha belo akira hacha name i efshar lehannacha belo akira lehach lishana deamratte la matze mahdar lah hacha matze mahdar lah

Gufa amar rabbi avin hazzorek chetz mittechillat arba lesof arba vekara shirain bahalichato patur sheakira tzorech hannacha hi metiv rav bivi bar abbaye haggonev kis beshabbat chayyav shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide isur sekila haya megarer veotze megarer veotze patur shehare isur shabbat ugneva bain keechad
Veammay hacha name lema hagbaha tzorech hotzaa hi hacha bemay askinan kegon shehigbiho al menat lehatznio venimlach alav vehotzio
Vechi hay gavena mi chayyav vehaamar rav simon amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan hamfanne chafatzim mizzavit lezavit venimlach alehem vehotzian patur shello hayeta akira mishshaa rishona lechach
La tema al menat lehatznio ella ema al menat lehotzio hacha bemay askinan kesheamad
Amad lemay i lechattef orcheh hu ella beomed lafush aval lechattef may
b: Patur addetane haya megarer veotze megarer veotze patur niflog venitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim beomed lafush aval lechattef patur
Ella ha manni ben azzay hi deamar mehallech keomed dame aval zorek may patur niflog venitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim bimhallech aval zorek patur
Megarer veotze itztericha leh salka datach amena en derech hotzaa bechach ka mashma lan
Uvmay i beravreve orcheh hu i bezutre lav orcheh hu ella bemitze
Udappekeh lehecha i deappekeh lirshut harabbim isur shabbat ika isur geneva leka i deappekeh lirshut hayyachid isur geneva ika isur shabbat leka la tzericha deappekeh letzide reshut harabbim

Uchman i kerabbi eliezer deamar tzide reshut harabbim kirshut harabbim damu isur shabbat ika isur geneva leka i kerabbanan deamri tzide reshut harabbim lav kirshut harabbim damu isur geneva ika isur shabbat leka

Leolam kerabbi eliezer vechi amar rabbi eliezer tzide reshut harabbim kirshut harabbim damu hane mile leinyan chiyyuva deshabbat dezimnin dedachaki rabbim veayeli lehatam aval leinyan mikne kane may tama deha la shechichi rabbim
Rav ashe amar kegon shetztzeraf yado lematta mishshelosha vekiblo kidrava deamar rava yado shel adam chashuva lo kearbaa al arbaa rav acha matni hachi

Ravina matne leolam deappekeh lirshut harabbim uvirshut harabbim name kana vetarvayehu bediyyuka deha matnitin kamipalgi ditnan haya moshcho veotze umet birshut bealim patur higbiho o shehotzio mershut bealim umet chayyav

Ravina dayek meresha rav acha dayek missefa ravina dayek meresha haya moshcho veotze umet birshut bealim patur tama demet birshut bealim ha hotzio mershut bealim vamet chayyav rav acha dayek missefa higbiho o shehotzio hotzaa dumya dehagbaha ma hagbaha deate lirshuteh af hotzaa name deate lirshuteh
Lerav acha kashya resha leravina kashya sefa resha lerav acha la kashya kamma dela ate lirshuteh reshut bealim karena beh sefa leravina la kashya hotzaa dumya dehagbaha la amrinan
Habba al achoto veal achot aviv ku urminhu ellu hen hallokin habba al achoto veal achot aviv veal achot immo veal achot ishto veal eshet achiv veal eshet achi aviv veal hannidda

a: Vekayema lan deeno loke umshallem amar ulla la kashya kan baachoto naara kan baachoto bogeret
Achoto bogeret name ha ika boshet ufgam beshota veha ika tzaara bimfutta
Hashta deatet lehachi afilu tema achoto naara bitoma umfutta

Alma kasavar ulla kal hecha deika mamon umalkot mamona meshallem milka la lake mena leh leulla ha gamar mechovel bachavero ma chovel bachavero deika mamon umalkot mamona meshallem milka la lake af kol hecha deika mamon umalkot mamona meshallem milka la lake
Ma lechovel bachavero shekken chayyav bachamishsha devarim vei mamona lekulla shekken huttar mikkelalo bevet din
Ella gamar meedim zommin ma edim zommin deika mamon umalkot mamona meshallem milka la lake af kol hecha deika mamon umalkot mamona meshallem milka la lake
Ma leedim zommin shekken enan tzerichim hatraa vei mamona lekulla hu shekken lo asu maase

Ella gamar mittarvayehu ma hatztzad hashshave shebbahen deika mamon umalkot mamona meshallem milka la lake af kol hecha deika mamon umalkot mamona meshallem milka la lake ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahen tzad chamur vei mamona lekulla hu shekken yesh bahen tzad hakkal
b: Ella ulla tachat tachat gamar ketiv hacha tachat asher innah uchtiv hatam ayin tachat ayin ma hatam mamona meshallem milka la lake af kol hecha deika mamona umalkot mamona meshallem milka la lake
Rabbi yochanan amar afilu tema achoto naara kan shehitru bo kan shello hitru bo

Alma kasavar rabbi yochanan kol hecha deika mamon umalkot veatro beh milka lake mamona la meshallem mena leh lerabbi yochanan ha amar kera kede rishato mishshum risha achat atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum shette rishaot usmich leh arbaim yakkennu

Vahare chovel bachavero deika mamon umalkot mamona meshallem milka la lake vechi tema hane mile hecha dela atro beh aval atro beh milka lake mamona la meshallem vehaamar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan hikkahu hakkaa sheen bah shave peruta loke hechi dame i dela atro beh ammay loke ella peshita deatro beh vetama delet beh shave peruta ha it beh shave peruta mamona meshallem milka la lake

Kidamar rabbi ila beferush ribta tora edim zommin letashlumin hacha name beferush ribta tora chovel bachavero letashlumin vehecha itmar derabbi ila aha meidin anu et ish peloni shechayyav lachavero matayim zuz venimtzeu zommin lokin umshallemin shello hashshem hammevian lide makkot mevian lide tashlumin divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim kol hamshallem eno loke

Venema kol halloke eno meshallem amar rabbi ila beferush ribta tora edim zommin letashlumin hechan ribta tora mikkede ketiv vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv yad beyad lema li davar hannitan miyyad leyad umay nihu mamon
Chovel bachavero name mikkede ketiv kaasher asa ken yease lo ken yinnaten bo lema li davar sheyyesh bo netina umay nihu mamon
Verabbi yochanan may tama la amar keulla im ken bittalta ervat achotcha lo tegalle

a: Chovel bachavero name im ken bittalta lo yosif pen yosif edim zommin name im ken bittalta vehaya im bin hakkot harasha ella edim zommin efshar lekayyomah beven gerusha uven chalutza chovel bachavero name ika lekayyomah kegon shehikkahu hakkaa sheen bah shave peruta

Achoto name ika lekayyomah baachoto bogeret amar lach rabbi yochanan hay tachat asher inah mibe leh lechidabbaye deamar abbaye amar kera tachat asher inah hay tachat asher inah mikkelal deika boshet ufgam
Veulla nafka leh midderava deamar rava amar kera venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kasef hanaat shechiva chamishshim mikkelal deika boshet ufgam

Rabbi eliezer omer edim zommin mamona meshallemi umilka la lake mishshum delav bene hatraa ninhu amar rava tidda natre behu emat natre behu meikara amri ishtelin natre behu bishat maase parshi vela mashadi natre behu levassof may dahava hava
Matkef lah abbaye venatre behu betoch kede dibbur matkef lah rav acha bereh derav ika venatre behu meikara unrammez behu rammoze

Hadar amar abbaye lav milta hi daamari i salka datach edim zommin tzerichin hatraa ki la matrinan behu la katlinan lehu mi ika mide deinhu bau katli bela hatraa veinhu bau hatraa ha baenan vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv veleka
Matkef lah rav samma bereh derav yirmeya ella meatta ben gerusha uven chalutza dela mikkaasher zamam ka mitrabbe live hatraa amar kera mishpat echad yihye lachem mishpat hashshave lechullechem

Rav shisha bereh derav idi amar chovel bachavero name mamona meshallem umilka la lake mehacha vechi yinnatzu anashim venagfu ishsha hara veyatzu yeladeha veamar rabbi elazar bematztzut shebbemita hakkatuv medabber dichtiv veim ason yihye venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh
Hechi dame i dela atro beh ammay miktil ella peshita deatro beh umutre ledavar chamur have mutre ledavar hakkal veamar rachamana velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh
Matkef lah rav ashe mimmay demutre ledavar chamur have mutre ledavar hakkal dilma la have im timtza lomar have mimmay demita chamura
b: Dilma malkot chamur deamar rav ilmale naggeduh lachananya mishael vaazarya pelachu letzalma amar leh rav samma bereh derav assi lerav ashe veamri lah rav samma bereh derav ashe lerav ashe vela shane lach ben hakkaa sheyyesh lah kitzva lehakkaa sheen lah kitzva
Matkef lah rav yaakov minnehar pekod hanicha lerabbanan deamri nefesh mammash ella lerabbi deamar mamon may ika lememar

Ella amar rav yaakov minnehar pekod mishshemeh derava mehacha im yakum vehithallech bachutz al mishanto venikka hammakke vechi taale al datecha shezze mehallech bashshuk veze neherag ella melammed shechovshin oto vei mayet katlinan leh vei la mayet shivto yitten verappo yerappe
Hechi dame i dela atro beh ammay miktil ella peshita deatro beh umutre ledavar chamur mutre ledavar hakkal veamar rachamana shivto yitten verappo yerappe

Matkef lah rav ashe mimmay demutre ledavar chamur have mutre ledavar hakkal dilma la have veim timtza lomar have mimmay demita chamura dilma malkot chamur deamar rav ilmale naggeduh lachananya mishael vaazarya pelachu letzalma
Amar leh rav samma bereh derav assi lerav ashe veamri lah rav samma bereh derav ashe lerav ashe vela shane lach ben hakkaa sheyyesh lah kitzva lehakkaa sheen lah kitzva
Matkef lah rav mari mimmay divmezid venikka mikketala dilma beshogeg venikka miggalut kashya
Resh lakish amar ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar loke umshallem i rabbi meir afilu bitto name

Vechi tema rabbi meir loke umshallem it leh met umshallem let leh vela vehatanya ganav vetavach beshabbat ganav vetavach laavoda zara ganav shor hanniskal utvacho meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha divre rabbi meir vachachamim potrin

Ha itmar alah amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan veamri lah amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi shimon ben lakish rabbi avin verabbi ila vechol chavurata mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amri betoveach al yede acher
Vechi ze chote veze mitchayyev amar rava amar rachamana utvacho o mecharo ma mechira al yede acher af tevicha al yede acher
Deve rabbi yishmael tana o lerabbot et hashshaliach deve chizkiyya tana tachat lerabbot et hashshaliach
Matkef lah mar zutra mi ika mide deilu avad ihu la michayyav veaved sheliach umichayyav ihu lav mishshum dela michayyav ella mishshum dekam leh bidrabba mineh
I betoveach al yede acher may tamayehu derabbanan defatri man chachamim

a: Rabbi shimon hi deamar shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita hatinach avoda zara veshor hanniskal ella shechitat shabbat shechita reuya hi ditnan hashshochet beshabbat uvom hakkippurim af al pi shemmitchayyev benafsho shechitato keshera

Savar lah kerabbi yochanan hassandelar detanya hamvashshel beshabbat beshogeg yochal bemezid lo yochal divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer beshogeg yochal lemotzae shabbat bemezid lo yochal olamit rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer beshogeg yeachel lemotzae shabbat laacherim velo lo bemezid lo yeachel olamit lo lo velo laacherim

May tama derabbi yochanan hassandelar kiddaresh rabbi chiyya appitcha deve nesia ushmartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi lachem ma kodesh asur baachila af maase shabbat asurin baachila i ma kodesh asur bahanaa af maase shabbat asur bahanaa talmud lomar lachem shellachem yehe
Yachol afilu beshogeg talmud lomar mechalleleha mot yumat bemezid amarti lecha velo beshogeg
Peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar maase shabbat deorayeta vechad amar derabbanan man deamar deorayeta kedaamaran man deamar derabbanan amar kera kodesh hi hi kodesh veen maaseha kodesh
Ulman deamar derabbanan may tamayehu derabbanan defatri ki ka patri rabbanan ashsheara
Toveach laavoda zara kevan dishchat beh purta itsar leh idach ki ka tavach lav demareh ka tavach amar rava beomer bigmar zevicha hu ovdah
Shor hanniskal lav dideh hu dekatavach amar rabba hacha bemay askinan kegon shemmesaro leshomer vehizzik bevet shomer venigmar dino bevet shomer ugnavo gannav mibbet shomer

Verabbi meir savar lah kerabbi yaakov vesavar lah kerabbi shimon savar lah kerabbi yaakov deamar af mishshennigmar dino hechziro shomer livalav muchzar vesavar lah kerabbi shimon deamar davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame
Rabba amar leolam betoveach al yede atzmo
b: Verabbi meir loke umshallem it leh met umshallem let leh veshane hane dechidush hu shechidsha tora biknas af al gav demiktil meshallem veazda rabba letameh deamar rabba haya gedi ganuv lo utvacho beshabbat chayyav shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide isur shabbat ganav vetavach beshabbat patur sheim en geneva en tevicha veen mechira
Veamar rabba haya gedi ganuv lo utvacho bammachteret chayyav shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide isur machteret ganav vetavach bammachteret patur sheim en geneva en tevicha veen mechira
Utzricha dei ashmeinan shabbat mishshum deisurah isur olam aval machteret deisur shaa hu ema la vei ashmeinan machteret mishshum demachtarto zo hi hatraato aval shabbat devaaya hatraa ema la tzericha

Amar rav pappa hayeta para genuva lo utvachah beshabbat chayyav shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide isur shabbat hayeta para sheula lo utvachah beshabbat patur amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe rav pappa para ata leashmoinan
Amar leh rav pappa sheula ata leashmoinan salka datach amena hoil veamar rav pappa mishsheat meshicha hu deitchayyav leh bimzonoteha hacha name mishsheat sheela itchayyav beunseha ka mashma lan

Amar rava hinniach lahen avihen para sheula mishtammeshin bah kol yeme sheelatah meta en chayyavin beonsah kisvurin shel avihem hi utvachuha vaachaluha meshallemin deme vasar bezol hinniach lahen avihen achraut nechasim chayyavin leshallem
Ika dematne lah aresha veika dematne lah assefa man dematne lah aresha kol shekken assefa ufliga derav pappa uman dematne lah assefa aval aresha la vehayenu derav pappa
Bishlama rabbi yochanan la amar keresh lakish deka mokem lah kerabbanan ella resh lakish may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan amar lach kevan deilu atro beh patur ki la atro beh name patur

Veazdu letamayehu dechi ata rav dimi amar chayyave mitot shoggin vechayyave malkiyyot shoggin vedavar acher rabbi yochanan amar chayyav veresh lakish amar patur rabbi yochanan amar chayyav deha la atro beh resh lakish amar patur kevan deilu atro beh patur ki la atro beh name patur
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh

a: May lav ason mammash la din ason ika deamri etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh may lav din ason lo ason mammash
Amar rava umi ika leman deamar chayyave mitot shoggin chayyavim veha tana deve chizkiyya makke adam umakke vehema

Ma makke vehema lo chilakta bo ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben mitkaven lesheen mitkaven ben derech yerida lederech aliyya lefotro mamon ella lechayevo mamon af makke adam lo tachlok bo ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben mitkaven lesheen mitkaven ben derech yerida lederech aliyya lechayevo mamon ella lefotro mamon

Ella ki ata ravin amar chayyave mitot shoggin kulle alma la peligi difturin ki peligi bechayyave malkot shoggin vedavar acher rabbi yochanan amar chayyav chayyave mitot itakkush chayyave malkiyyot la itakkush resh lakish amar patur beferush ribta tora chayyave malkiyyot kechayyave mitot

Hechan ribta tora amar abbaye atya rasha rasha rava amar atya makke makke amar leh rav pappa lerava he makke ilema umakke vehema yeshallemenna umakke adam yumat hay biktala ketiv ella hay makke makke nefesh behema yeshallemenna nefesh tachat nafesh usmich leh veish ki yitten mum baamito kaasher asa ken yease lo

Vehay lav makke hi anan hakkaa hakkaa kaamrinan veha ki ketiv bechovel bachavero hu dichtiv vechovel bachavero bar tashlumin hu im eno inyan lehakkaa sheyyesh bah shave peruta tenehu inyan lehakkaa sheen bah shave peruta
b: Sof sof lav bar tashlumin hu la tzericha devahade demachyeh kera shirain dileh
Amar leh rav chiyya lerava ultanna deve chizkiyya deamar makke adam umakke vehema mimmay divchol ketiv veleka leiploge dilma beshabbat ketiv devivhema gufah ika leiploge

La salka datach dichtiv umakke vehema yeshallemenna umakke adam yumat hechi dame i dela atro beh makke adam ammay yumat ella peshita deatro beh vei beshabbat makke behema yeshallemenna ella lav bechol

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye lerabba deamar chidush hu shechidsha tora biknas veaf al gav demiktil meshallem matnitin keman mokem lah i kerabbi meir kashya bitto i kerabbi nechunya ben hakkana kashya achoto i kerabbi yitzchak kashya mamzeret
Hanicha i savar lah kerabbi yochanan hu name metaretz lah kerabbi yochanan ella i savar keresh lakish hechi metaretz lah al korchach kerabbi yochanan sevira leh
Amar leh rav matna leabbaye leresh lakish deamar beferush ribta tora chayyave malkiyyot kechayyave mitot man tanna diflig aleh derabbi nechunya ben hakkana i rabbi meir i rabbi yitzchak
Tanu rabbanan araot ushniyyot laaraot en lahen lo kenas velo pituy hammaenet en lah lo kenas velo pituy ayelonit en lah lo kenas velo pituy vehayyotzet mishshum shem ra en lah lo kenas velo pituy
May araot umay sheniyyot laaraot ilema araot

a: Araot mammash sheniyyot middivre sofrim kevan demiddeorayeta chazya leh ammay en lahen kenas ella araot chayyave mitot bet din sheniyyot chayyave charetot aval chayyave lavin yesh lahen kenas umanni shimon hattimni hi
Ika deamri araot chayyave mitot bet din vechayyave charetot sheniyyot chayyave lavin manni rabbi shimon ben menasya hi

Hammaenet en lah lo kenas velo pituy ha ketanna bealma it lah manni rabbanan hi deamri ketanna yesh lah kenas ema sefa ayelonit en lah lo kenas velo pituy atan lerabbi meir deamar ketanna en lah kenas veha mikkatnutah yatzta leveger resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir

Vechi tema kullah rabbi meir hi uvimmaenet savar lah kerabbi yehuda umi savar lah vehatanya ad matay habbat memaenet ad shettavi shette searot divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyirbe shachor al hallavan

Ella rabbi yehuda hi uviktanna savar lah kerabbi meir umi savar lah vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi meir veim ita zo divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda mibe leh hay tanna savar lah kerabbi meir bachada uflig aleh bachada
Rafram amar may memaenet haruya lemaen velitne ketanna kashya
Ayelonit en lah lo kenas velo pituy urminhi hachereshet vehashshota vehaayelonit yesh lahen kenas veyesh lahen taanat betulim veha may rumya ha rabbi meir ha rabbanan udkaare lah may kaare lah

Mishshum deit leh lemirme achariti ilaveh hachereshet vehashshota vehabbogeret vmukkat etz en lahen taanat betulim hassoma veayelonit yesh lahen taanat betulim somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir soma en lah taanat betulim

Amar rav sheshet la kashya ha rabban gamliel veha rabbi yehoshua emar deshamatte leh lerabban gamliel hecha deka taana ihi hecha dela ka taana ihi mi shamatte leh in kevan deamar rabban gamliel mehemna kegon zo petach picha leillem hu
Vehabbogeret en lah taanat betulim vehaamar rav bogeret notnin lah layela harishon
b: I deka taen taanat damim hachi name hacha bemay askinan dekataen taanat petach patuach
