Somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir soma en lah taanat betulim may tama desomchos amar rabbi zera mippene shennechbetet al gabbe karka kullehu name chabbote michabbeti kullehu root umarot leimman zo enah roa veenah mara leimmah
Vehayyotzet mishshum shem ra en lah lo kenas velo pituy hayyotzet mishshum shem ra bat sekila hi amar rav sheshet hachi kaamar mi sheyyatza aleha shem ra beyaldutah en lah lo kenas velo pituy

Amar rav pappa shema minah hay shetara ria la magbenan beh hechi dame ilema dinfak kala aleh dishtara dezayefa hu dichotah hacha dinfak alah kala dezannay veha amar rava yatza lah shem mezanna bair en choshshin lah

Ella daato be tere veamri ledidhu tevatanhi beisura dichotah hacha daato be tere veamri ledidhu amar lehu zayyifu li bishlama hatam shechichi perutzin ella hacha im hu huchzak kol yisrael mi huchzeku hacha name kevan deka mehaddar azziyyufa emar zayyofe zayyef uchtav

Matni veellu sheen lahen kenas habba al haggiyyoret veal hashshevuya veal hashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayeru veshennishtachreru yeterot al benot shalosh shanim veom echad rabbi yehuda omer shevuya shennifdet hare hi bikdushshatah af al pi sheggedola

Habba al bitto al bat bitto al bat beno al bat ishto al bat benah al bat bittah en lahen kenas mippene shemmitchayyev benafsho shemmitatan bide bet din vechol hammitchayyev benafsho en meshallem mamon shenneemar veim lo yihye ason anosh yeanesh

Gema amar rabbi yochanan rabbi yehuda verabbi dosa amru davar echad rabbi yehuda ha daamaran rabbi dosa detanya shevuya ochelet bitruma divre rabbi dosa amar rabbi dosa vechi ma asa lah arvi hallaz vechi mippene shemmiech lah ben daddeha pesalah min hakkehunna

Amar rabba dilma la hi ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hacha ella shello yehe chote niskar aval hatam kerabbanan sevira leh i name ad kan la kaamar rabbi dosa hatam ella bitruma derabbanan aval kenas deorayeta kerabbanan sevira leh

Amar leh abbaye vetameh derabbi yehuda hacha shello yehe chote niskar hu veha tanya rabbi yehuda omer shevuya shennishbet hare hi bikdushshatah afilu bat eser shanim ketubbatah matayim vehatam may shello yehe chote niskar ika hatam name dilma mimani vela nasvi lah

Vesavar rabbi yehuda bikdushtah kayema vehatanya happode et hashshevuya yissaenna meid bah lo yissaenna rabbi yehuda omer ben kach uven kach lo yissaenna ha gufah kashya amratte happode et hashshevuya yissaenna vahadar tena meid bah lo yissaenna mishshum demeid bah lo yissaenna
Ha la kashya hachi kaamar happode et hashshevuya umeid bah yissaenna meid bah kedi lo yissaenna

Mikkol makom kashya lerabbi yehuda amar rav pappa ema rabbi yehuda omer ben kach uven kach yissaenna rav huna bereh derav yehoshua omer leolam kidkatane rabbi yehuda ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi ben kach uven kach yissaenna ella ledidchu ben kach uven kach lo yissaenna mibbee leh
Verabbanan happode et hashshevuya umeid bah yissaenna la shade inish zuze bichdi meid bah kedi lo yissaenna shemma enav natan bah
Rame leh rav pappa bar shemuel lerav yosef

a: Vesavar rabbi yehuda bikdushtah kayema vehatanya haggiyyoret shennitgayera veraata dam rabbi yehuda omer dayyah sheatah rabbi yose omer hare hi kechol hannashim umtammea meet leet umippekida lifkida
Utzricha lehamtin shelosha chodashim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose mattir leares velinase miyyad amar leh giyyoret ashshevuyah ka ramet giyyoret la menattera nafshah shevuya menattera nafshah

Urmi shevuya ashshevuyah detanya haggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayeru veshennishtachreru yeterot al benot shalosh shanim veom echad tzerichot lehamtin shelosha chodashim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose mattir leares velinase miyyad ishtik
Amar leh mide shemia lach beha amar leh hachi amar rav sheshet sherauha shennivala i hachi may tama derabbi yose amar rabba kasavar rabbi yose ishsha mezanna meshammeshet bemoch shello titabber
Bishlama giyyoret kevan dedatah leigayyore menattera nafshah shevuya name dela yada hecha mamtu lah shifcha name deshama mippi marah ella yotza beshen vaayin may ika lememar
Vechi tema kol mimmela la amar rabbi yose hare anusa umfutta demimmela vetanya anusa umfutta tzerichot lehamtin shelosha chodashim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose mattir leares velinase miyyad
Ella amar rabba kasavar rabbi yose ishsha mezanna mithappechet kede shello titabber veidach chayeshinan shemma lo nehefcha yafe yafe
Shenneemar velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh vechu veha mehacha nafka mehatam nafka kede rishato mishshum risha achat atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum shette rishaot
Chada bemita umamon vachada bemalkot umamon utzricha dei ashmeinan mita umamon mishshum deika ibud neshama aval malkot umamon deleka ibud neshama ema la
Vei ashmeinan malkot umamon mishshum dela chamir isureh aval mita umamon dachamir isureh ema la tzericha
Ulrabbi meir deamar loke umshallem tarte lema li chada bemita umamon
b: Vachada bemita umalkot utzricha dei ashmeinan mita umamon mishshum dachada begufeh vachada bemamoneh la avdinan aval bemita umalkot deide veide begufeh ema mita arichta hi venabed beh
Vei ashmeinan mita umalkot detarte begufeh la avdinan aval mita umamon dachada begufeh vachada bemamoneh ema naaved beh tzericha

Velo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach lema li deamar rachamana la tishkol mamona mineh vetiftereh mikketala lo tikchu chofer lanus el ir miklato lema li deamar rachamana la tishkol mamona mineh vetiftereh min galut

Utre kerae lema li chad beshogeg vechad bemezid utzrichi dei ashmeinan mezid mishshum dachamir isureh aval shogeg dela chamir isureh ema la vei ashmeinan shogeg mishshum deleka ibud neshama aval mezid deika ibud neshama ema la tzericha
Velaaretz lo yechuppar laddam asher shuppach bah ki im bedam shofcho lema li
Mibbee leh lechidtanya minnayin sheim nitarfa agala veachar kach nimtza hahoreg minnayin sheen potrin oto shenneemar velaaretz lo yechuppar laddam asher shuppach bah vego

Veatta tevaer haddam hannaki mikkirbecha lema li mibe leh lechidtanya minnayin lemumatim besayif shehu min hatztzavar talmud lomar veatta tevaer haddam hannaki mikkirbecha hukshu kol shofche damim leegla arufa ma lehallan min hatztzavar af shofche damim min hatztzavar
I ma lehallan bekofitz umimmul oref af kan bekofitz umimmul oref amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar kera veahavta lereacha kamocha beror lo mita yafa
Kol cherem asher yochoram min haadam lo yippade lema li mibe leh lechidtanya minnayin layyotze lehareg veamar echad erko alay minnayin shello amar kelum
Shenneemar kol cherem asher yochoram min haadam lo yippade yachol af kodem shennigmar dino ken talmud lomar min haadam velo kol haadam
Ulrabbi chananya ben akavya deamar neerach mippene sheddamav ketzuvin hay kol cherem may aved leh

Mibe leh lechidtanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer lefi shemmatzinu lemumatim bide shamayim shennotnin mamon umitkapper lahen shenneemar im kofer yushat alav yachol af bide adam ken talmud lomar cherem min haadam lo yippade
Veen li ella mitot chamurot shello nitna shiggatan lechappara mitot kallot shennitna shiggatan lechappara minnayin talmud lomar kol cherem
Vela mimmela millo tikchu kofer shamatte minah la tishkol mamona mineh vetiftereh kol cherem lema li amar rame bar chama itzterich salka datach amena

a: Hane mile hecha daharago derech aliyya shello nitna shiggato lechappara aval harago derech yerida denitna shiggato lechappara ema nishkol mamona mineh veniftereh ka mashma lan
Amar leh rava ha middetanna deve chizkiyya nafka detana deve chizkiyya makke adam umakke vehema

Ma makke vehema lo chillakta bo ben shogeg lemezid ben mitkaven lesheen mitkaven ben derech yerida lederech aliyya lefotro mamon ella lechayevo mamon af makke adam lo tachlok bo ben shogeg lemezid ben mitkaven lesheen mitkaven ben derech yerida lederech aliyya lechayevo mamon ella lefotro mamon

Ella amar rame bar chama itzterich salka datach amena hane mile hecha desime et eno vaharago bah aval hecha desime et eno vaharago bedavar acher ema nishkol mamona mineh amar leh rava ha name meidach tanna deve chizkiyya nafka detana deve chizkiyya ayin tachat ayin velo ayin venefesh tachat ayin

Ella amar rav ashe itzterich salka datach amena hoil vechidush hu shechidsha tora biknas af al gav demiktil meshallem ka mashma lan ulrabba deamar chidush hu shechidsha tora biknas af al gav demiktil meshallem hay kol cherem may aved leh savar lah ketanna kamma derabbi chananya ben akavya
Matni naara shennitarsa venitgarsha rabbi yose haggelili omer en lah kenas rabbi akiva omer yesh lah kenas uknasah leatzmah
Gema may tama derabbi yose haggelili amar kera asher lo orasa ha orasa en lah kenas verabbi akiva asher lo orasa leaviha ha orsa leatzmah
Ella meatta naara velo bogeret hachi name dilatzmah betula velo beula hachi name dilatzmah ella ligmare hacha name ligmare

Amar lach rabbi akiva hay la orasa mibe leh lechidtanya asher lo orasa perat lenaara shennitarsa venitgarsha sheen lah kenas divre rabbi yose haggelili rabbi akiva omer yesh lah kenas uknasah leaviha vehaddin noten hoil veaviha zakkay bechesef kidusheha veaviha zakkay bechesef kenasah ma kesef kidusheha af al pi shennitarsa venitgarsha leaviha af kesef kenasah af al pi shennitarsa venitgarsha leaviha

Im ken ma talmud lomar asher lo orasa mufne lehakkish lo veladun hemennu gezera shava neemar kan asher lo orasa veneemar lehallan asher lo orasa ma kan chamishshim af lehallan chamishshim uma lehallan shekalim af kan shekalim
Verabbi akiva may chazet daasher lo orasa ligzera shava uvtula lemaote beula
b: Ema betula ligzera shava vaasher lo orasa perat lenaara shennitarsa venitgarsha
Mistabbera asher lo orasa ligzera shava shehare ani kore bah naara betula adderabba betula ligzera shava shehare ani kore bah asher lo orasa mistabbera ha ishtanni gufah veha la ishtanni gufah
Verabbi yose haggelili hay sevara mena leh nafka leh middetanya kesef yishkol kemohar habbetulot sheyehe ze kemohar habbetulot umohar habbetulot kaze
Kashya derabbi akiva adderabbi akiva tere tannae vealliba derabbi akiva
Bishlama rabbi akiva dematnitin la atya gezera shava umappeka leh likra mippeshateh ligmare ella lerabbi akiva devarayeta atya gezera shava umappeka mippeshateh ligmare
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak keri beh asher lo arusa arusa bat sekila hi salka datach amena hoil vechidush hu shechidsha tora biknas af al gav demiktil meshallem
Ulrabba deamar chidush hu shechidsha tora biknas af al gav demiktil meshallem may ika lememar savar lah kerabbi akiva dematnitin

Tanu rabbanan kenasah lemi leaviha veyesh omrim leatzmah leatzmah ammay amar rav chisda hacha benaara shennitarsa venitgarsha askinan vekamipalgi biflugta derabbi akiva dematnitin verabbi akiva devarayeta
Amar abbaye ba aleha umeta patur shenneemar venatan laavi hannaara velo laavi meta milleta difshita leh leabbaye mibaya leh lerava
Devae rava yesh beger bakkever o en beger bakkever yesh beger bakkever vedivnah have o dilma en beger bakkever udaviha have

a: Umi miabbera vehatane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman shalosh nashim meshammeshot bemoch ellu hen ketanna umubberet umnika ketanna shemma titabber vetamut meubberet shemma taase ubbarah sandal menika shemma tigmol et benah

Veezohi ketanna mibbat achat esre shana veom echad ad shettem esre shana veom echad pachot miken veyater al ken meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim achat zo veachat zo meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet umin hashshamayim yerachemu mishshum shenneemar shomer petaim Adonai

Vechi tema deiabbara keshehi naara veolida keshehi naara uvshita yarche mi ka yalda vehaamar shemuel en ben naarut levagrut ella shishsha chodashim vechi tema betzir hu deleka ha tefe ika ha ella kaamar
Ella hachi kamibaya leh yesh beger bakkever ufaka av o dilma en beger bakkever vela paka av mar bar rav ashe bae lah hachi mita osa bagrut o en osa bagrut teku
Bea mineh rava meabbaye ba aleha venitarsa mahu amar leh mi ketiv venatan laavi hannaara asher lo arusa ultamach ha detanya ba aleha venisset leatzmah mi ketiv venatan laavi hannaara asher lo nesua

Hachi hashta hatam hoil uvagrut motzia mershut av venisuin motziin mershut av ma bagrut ba aleha uvagra leatzmah af nisuin ba aleha venisset leatzmah ella erusin mi ka mappeki mershuta deav ligmare ha tenan naara hamorasa aviha uvalah mefirin lah nedareha

Matni hamfatte noten shelosha devarim vehaones arbaa hamfatte noten boshet ufgam uknas mosif alav ones shennoten et hatztzaar ma ben ones limfatte haones noten et hatztzaar vehamfatte eno noten et hatztzaar haones noten miyyad vehamfatte lichsheyyotzi haones shote baatzitzo vehamfatte im ratza lehotzi motzi

Ketzad shote baatzitzo afilu hi chigeret afilu hi soma vaafilu hi mukkat shechin nimtza bah devar erva o sheenah reuya lavo beyisrael eno rashshay lekayemah shenneemar velo tihye leishsha ishsha haruya lo

Gema tzaar demay amar avuh dishmuel tzaar shechavatah al gabbe karka matkef lah rabbi zera ella meatta chavatah al gabbe shirain hachi name defatur vechi tema hachi name vehatanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon ones eno meshallem et hatztzaar mippene
b: Shessofah lehitztaer tachat baalah amru lo eno dome nivelet beones lenivelet beratzon ella amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh tzaar shel pisuk haraglayim vechen hu omer vattefasseki et raglayich lechol over

I hachi mefutta name amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh mashal dimfutta lema haddavar dome leadam sheamar lachavero kera shirain shelli vehippater shelli daavuh ninhu ella amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh pikkechot shebbahen omrot mefutta en lah tzaar

Veha ka chazenan deit lah amar abbaye amara li em kemayya chammime al resheh dekarcha rava amar amara li bat rav chisda ki rivda dechusilta rav pappa amar amara li bat abba suraa ki nahama akkusha bechinche

Haones noten miyyad hamfatte lichsheyyotzi vechu lichsheyyotzi ishto hi amar abbaye ema lichshello yichnos tanya name hachi af al pi sheamru hamfatte noten lichshello yichnos boshet ufgam noten miyyad veechad haones veechad hamfatte ben hi uven aviha yecholin leakkev
Bishlama mefutta ketiv im maen yemaen aviha en li ella aviha hi atzmah minnayin talmud lomar yemaen mikkol makom
Ella ones bishlama ihi ketiv velo tihye middatah ella aviha menalan

Amar abbaye shello yehe chote niskar rava amar kal vachomer uma mefatte shello avar ella al daat aviha bilvad ben hi uven aviha yecholin leakkev ones sheavar al daat aviha veal daat atzmah lo kol shekken

Rava la amar keabbayye kevan deka meshallem kenas lav chote niskar hu abbaye la amar kerava mefatte deihu matze meakkev aviha name matze meakkev ones deihu la matze meakkev aviha name la matze meakkev

Tanya idach af al pi sheamru ones noten miyyad kesheyyotzi hu en lah alav kelum kesheyyotzi mi matze mappek lah ema keshettetze hi en lah alav kelum met yatza kesef kenasah bichtubbatah rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer yesh lah ketubba mane

Bemay kamipalgi rabbanan savri tama may takkinu rabbanan ketubba kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah veha la matze mappek lah verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar ha name metzaar lah ad deamra hi la baena lach
Ones shote baatzitzo amar leh rava mipparzikya lerav ashe mikkede migmar gamri mehadade

a: Leha milta name ligmeru mehadade amar kera mahor yimharenna lo leishsha lo middato
Ketzad shote baatzitzo ku amar rav kahana amritah lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea nete ase venidche lo taase
Amar li hecha amrinan nete ase venidche lo taase kegon mila betzaraat dela efshar lekayyomeh laase aval hacha i amra dela baena mi iteh laase kelal
Matni yetoma shennitarsa venitgarsha rabbi elazar omer haones chayyav vehamfatte patur

Gema amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan rabbi elazar beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo amarah deamar yesh lah kenas uknasah leatzmah mimmay middekatane yetoma rabbi elazar omer haones chayyav vehamfatte patur
Yetoma peshita ella ha ka mashma lan denaara shennitarsa venitgarsha kitoma ma yetoma leatzmah af naara shennitarsa venitgarsha leatzmah
Amar rabbi zera amar rabba bar shela amar rav hamnuna sava amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav halacha kerabbi elazar kare rav aleh derabbi elazar tuvyana dechakkime

Matni ezehu boshet hakkol lefi hamvayyesh vehammitbayyesh pegam roin otah keilu hi shifcha nimkeret bashshuk kamma hayeta yafa vechamma hi yafa kenas shave bechol adam vechol sheyyesh lo kitzva min hattora shave bechol adam

Gema veema chamishshim selaim amar rachamana mikkol mile amar rabbi zera yomru baal bat melachim chamishshim baal bat hedotot chamishshim amar leh abbaye i hachi gabbe eved name yomru eved nokev margaliyyot sheloshim eved ose
b: Maase machat sheloshim

Ella amar rabbi zera ilu bau aleha shenayim echad kedarkah veechad shello kedarkah yomru baal shelema chamishshim baal peguma chamishshim amar leh abbaye i hachi gabbe eved name yomru eved bari sheloshim eved mukke shechin sheloshim

Ella amar abbaye amar kera tachat asher inah hane tachat asher inah mikkelal deika boshet ufgam rava amar amar kera venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kasef hanaat shechiva chamishshim mikkelal deika boshet ufgam
Veema ledidah amar kera binureha bet aviha kol shevach neureha leaviha

Veella ha deamar rav huna amar rav minnayin shemmaase habbat leaviha shenneemar vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama ma ama maase yadeha lerabbah af bat maase yadeha leaviha lema li tipok leh mibbinureha bet aviha ella hahi bahafarat nedarim hu dichtiv
Vechi tema nelaf mineh mamona meisura la yalfinan vechi tema nelaf mikkenasa mamona mikkenasa la yalfinan ella mistabbera deaviha have dei bae masar lah limnuuol umukke shechin
Pegam roin otah keilu hi shifcha nimkeret hechi shayeminan lah amar avuh dishmuel omdin kamma adam rotze liten ben shifcha betula leshifcha beula leshammesho
May nafka leh minah ella ben shifcha beula leshifcha sheenah beula lehassia leavdo ulavdo may nafka leh minah beeved sheyyesh lo lerabbo korat ruach hemennu
Matni kol makom sheyyesh mecher en kenas vechol makom sheyyesh kenas en mecher ketanna yesh lah mecher veen lah kenas naara yesh lah kenas veen lah mecher habbogeret en lah lo mecher velo kenas

Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi meir aval chachamim omrim yesh lah kenas bimkom mecher detanya ketanna mibbat yom echad vead shettavi shette searot yesh lah mecher veen lah kenas mishshettavi shette searot ad shettivgar yesh lah kenas veen lah mecher divre rabbi meir shehaya rabbi meir omer kol makom sheyyesh mecher en kenas vechol makom sheyyesh kenas en mecher vachachamim omrim ketanna mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad vead shettivgar yesh lah kenas

Kenas in mecher la ema af kenas bimkom mecher amar rav chisda may tama derabbi meir amar kera velo tihye leishsha bimhava atzmah hakkatuv medabber verabbanan amar resh lakish amar kera naara afilu ketanna bammashma

Shamah rav pappa bereh derav chanan mibbe chelochit azal amrah kammeh derav shimi bar ashe amar leh attun aha matnitu lah anan aha matnenan lah amar resh lakish hammotzi shem ra al hakketanna patur shenneemar venatnu laavi hannaara naara male diber hakkatuv

Matkef lah rav adda bar ahava tama dichtav rachamana naara ha lav hachi hava amena afilu ketanna veha ketiv veim emet haya haddavar hazze lo nimtzeu vetulim lannaara vehotziu et hannaara el petach bet aviha uskaluha uktanna lav bat onashin hi ella kan naara ha kol makom shenneemar naara afilu ketanna bammashma

a: Matni haomer pittiti et bitto shel peloni meshallem boshet ufgam al pi atzmo veen meshallem kenas haomer ganavti meshallem et hakkeren al pi atzmo veen meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha hemit shori et peloni o shoro shel peloni hare ze meshallem al pi atzmo hemit shori avdo shel peloni en meshallem al pi atzmo ze hakkelal kol hamshallem yater al ma shehizzik eno meshallem al pi atzmo
Gema velitne anasti la mibbaya kaamar la mibbaya anasti dela ka pagem lah dimshallem boshet ufgam al pi atzmo aval pittiti deka pagem lah ema la meshallem al pi atzmo ka mashma lan
Matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon af boshet ufgam eno meshallem al pi atzmo lo kol hemennu sheyyifgom bitto shel peloni

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye nicha lah ledidah may dilma la nicha leh leaviha nicha leh leaviha may dilma la nicha lehu livne mishpacha nicha lehu livne mishpacha may i efshar deleka chad bimdinat hayyam dela nicha leh
Haomer ganavti meshallem et hakkeren vechu itmar palga nizka rav pappa amar palga nizka mamona rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar palga nizka kenasa

Rav pappa amar palga nizka mamona kasavar setam shevarim lav bechezkat shimur kayemi uvdin hu dimshallem kulleh verachamana hu dechayes illaveh deakkatti la iyyaad tora rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar palga nizka kenasa kasavar setam shevarim bechezkat shimur kayemi uvdin hu dela lishallem kelal verachamana hu dekanseh ki hechi denintereh letoreh

Siman hizik ma vehemit kelal tenan hannizak vehammazzik betashlumin bishlama leman deamar palga nizka mamona hayenu deshayech nizak betashlumin ella leman deamar palga nizka kenasa hashta delav dideh ka shakel betashlumin iteh
Lo nitzrecha ella lifchat nevela pechat nevela tenena tashlume nezek melammed shehabbealim mittappelin bannevela
Chada betam vachada bemuad utzricha dei ashmoinan tam mishshum deakkatti la iyyaad aval muad deiyyaad ema la vei ashmoinan muad mishshum deka meshallem kulleh aval tam ema la tzericha
Ta shema ma ben tam lemuad shehattam meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo umuad meshallem nezek shalem min haaliyya vela katane shehattam eno meshallem al pi atzmo umuad meshallem al pi atzmo
Tena veshayyar may shayyer dehay shayyar shayyar chatzi chofer i mishshum chatzi chofer lav shiyyura hu
b: Ha manni rabbi yose haggelili hi deamar tam meshallem chatzi chofer
Ta shema hemit shori et peloni o shoro shel peloni hare ze meshallem al pi atzmo may lav betam la bemuad

Aval betam may eno meshallem al pi atzmo addetane sefa avdo shel peloni eno meshallem al pi atzmo niflog venitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim bemuad aval tam eno meshallem al pi atzmo kullah bemuad kamayere

Ta shema ze hakkelal kol hamshallem yater al ma shehizzik eno meshallem al pi atzmo ha pachot mimma shehizzik meshallem al pi atzmo la tema ha pachot mimma shehizzik ella ema ha kema shehizzik meshallem al pi atzmo
Aval pachot may eno meshallem al pi atzmo litne ze hakkelal kol sheeno meshallem kema shehizzik eno meshallem al pi atzmo demashma pachot umashma yater teuvta

Vehilcheta palga nizka kenasa teuvta vehilcheta in tama may itotav mishshum dela katane kema shehizzik la pesika leh kevan deika chatzi nezek tzerorot dehilcheta gemiri lah demamona hu mishshum hachi la katane
Vehashta deamratte palga nizka kenasa hay kalba deachel imre veshunnara deachel tarnegole ravreve meshunne hu vela magbenan bevavel aval zutre orcheh hu umagbenan
Vei tefas la mappekinan mineh vei amar akbeu li zimna leeretz yisrael makbeinan leh vei la azel meshammetinan leh

Ben kach uven kach meshammetinan leh deamrinan leh sallek hezzekach midderabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer minnayin shello yegaddel adam kelev ra betoch beto velo yaamid sullam raua betoch beto shenneemar velo tasim damim bevetecha
Hadaran alach ellu nearot
Naara shennitpatteta boshtah ufgamah uknasah shel aviha vehatztzaar bitfusa amda baddin ad shello met haav hare hen shel av met haav hare hen shel achin

Lo hispika laamod baddin ad shemmet haav hare hen shel atzmah amda baddin ad shello bagra hare hen shel av met haav hare hen shel achin lo hispika laamod baddin ad shebbagra hare hen shel atzmah rabbi shimon omer im lo hispika ligbot ad shemmet haav hare hen shel atzmah

a: Maase yadeha umtziatah af al pi shello gavta met haav hare hen shel achin

Gema may ka mashma lan tenena hamfatte noten shelosha devarim vehaones arbaa hamfatte noten boshet ufgam uknas mosif alav ones shennoten et hatztzaar leaviha itzterich leh leaviha name peshita middeka yahev mefatte dei leatzmah ammay yahev mefatte middatah avad
Amda baddin itztericha leh pelugta derabbi shimon verabbanan
Tenan hatam anasta ufitita et bitti vehu omer lo anasti velo pititi mashbiacha ani veamar amen veachar kach hoda chayyav
Rabbi shimon poter sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo amru lo af al pi sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo aval meshallem boshet ufgam al pi atzmo

Bea mineh abbaye merabba haomer lachavero anasta ufitita et bitti veheemadticha baddin venitchayyavta li mamon vehu omer lo anasti velo pititi velo heemadtani baddin velo nitchayyavti lecha mamon venishba vehoda lerabbi shimon may
Kevan deamad baddin mamona havey umichayyav aleh korban shevua o dilma af al gav deamad baddin kenas have amar leh mamona have umichayyav aleh korban shevua

Etiveh rabbi shimon omer yachol haomer lachavero anasta ufitita et bitti vehu omer lo anasti velo pititi hemit shorcha et avdi vehu omer lo hemit o sheamar lo avdo hippalta et shini vesimita et eni vehu omer lo hippalti velo simiti venishba vehoda yachol yehe chayyav

Talmud lomar vechichesh baamito befikkadon o vitsumet yad o vegazel o ashak et amito o matza aveda vechichesh bah venishba al shaker ma ellu meuchadin shehen mamon af kol shehen mamon yatzu ellu shehen kenas
b: May lav besheamad baddin la beshello amad baddin

Veha midderesha besheamad baddin sefa name besheamad baddin dekatane resha en li ella devarim shemmeshallemin alehem et hakkeren tashlume chefel tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vehaones vehamfatte umotzi shem ra minnayin talmud lomar umaala maal riba
Hechi dame i delo amad baddin kefela mi ika ella peshita besheamad baddin umidderesha besheamad baddin sefa name besheamad baddin

Amar leh yachelna leshannoye lach resha besheamad baddin vesefa beshello amad baddin vechullah rabbi shimon hi veshinuye dechike la meshannenan lach deim ken amratte li litne resha rabbi shimon omer o litne sefa divre rabbi shimon
Ella kullah besheamad baddin veresha rabbanan vesefa rabbi shimon
Umodena lach leinyan korban shevua derachamana patreh mivvechichesh
Vechi kaamena mamon have lehorisho levanav
Etiveh rabbi shimon omer im lo hispika ligbot ad shemmet haav hare hen shel atzmah vei amratte mamon have lehorisho levanav leatzmah ammay deachin bae mihve

Amar rava hay milta keshay bah rabba verav yosef esrin vetarten shenin vela iprak ad ditev rav yosef beresha ufarkah shane hatam deamar kera venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kesef lo zikta tora laav ella mishsheat netina
Vechi kaamar rabba mamona have lehorisho levanav bishar kenasot
Ella meatta gabbe eved dichtiv kesef sheloshim shekalim yitten ladonav hachi name lo zikta tora laadon ella mishsheat netina yitten lechud venatan lechud
I hachi talmud lomar vechichesh talmud lomar venatan mibe leh
Amar rava ki itzterich vechichesh kegon sheamda baddin uvagra umeta dehatam ki ka yaret aviha minah didah ka yaret
I hachi yatzu ellu shehen kenas mamon hu amar rav nachman bar yitzchak yatzu ellu sheikaran kenas
Etiveh rabbi shimon poter sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo tama delo amad baddin ha amad baddin dimshallem al pi atzmo korban shevua name michayyav
Rabbi shimon ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi af al gav deamad baddin rachamana patreh mivvechichesh ella ledidchu odo li mihat hecha delo amad baddin dechi ka tava kenasa ka tava

a: Umode biknas patur verabbanan savri ki ka tava boshet ufgam ka tava
Bemay ka mipalgi amar rav pappa rabbi shimon savar la shavek inish mide dekitz vetava mide dela kitz verabbanan savri la shavek inish mide dechi mode beh la miptar vetava mide dechi mode beh miptar
Bea mineh rabbi avina merav sheshet bat hannizonet min haachin maase yadeha lemi
Bimkom av kayemi ma hatam maase yadeha laav hacha name maase yadeha laachin o dilma la dame leav hatam middideh mitazna hacha lav middidhu mitazna
Amar leh tenetuha almana nizonet minnichse yetomim umaase yadeha shellahen
Mi dame almenato la nicha leh beharvacha bitto nicha leh beharocha
Lememra devitto adifa leh mealmenato vehaamar rabbi abba amar rabbi yose asu almana etzel habbat kabbat etzel achin binchasin muatin

Ma habbat etzel achin habbat nizonet vehaachin yishalu al happetachim af almana etzel habbat almana nizonet vehabbat tishal al happetachim leinyan ziluta almenato adifa leh leinyan harvacha bitto adifa leh
Metiv rav yosef maase yadeha umtziatah af al pi shello gavta met haav hare hen shel achin tama divchayye haav ha leachar mitat haav leatzmah may lav benizonet la besheenah nizonet
I besheenah nizonet may lememra afilu leman deamar yachol harav lomar laeved ase immi veeni zanach hane mile beeved kenaani dela ketiv beh immach
Aval eved ivri dichtiv beh immach lo kol shekken bitto
Amar rabba bar ulla lo nitzrecha ella lehaadafa amar rava gavra rabba kerav yosef la yada deika haadafa vekamotev teuvta
Ella amar rava rav yosef matnitin gufa kashya leh dekatane maase yadeha umtziatah af al pi shello gavta metziatah mimman gavya
Ella lav hachi kaamar maase yadeha kimtziatah ma metziatah bechayye haav laav leachar mitat haav leatzmah af maase yadeha name bechayye haav laav leachar mitat haav leatzmah shema minah

Itmar name amar rav yehuda amar rav bat hannizonet min haachin maase yadeha leatzmah amar rav kahana may tama dichtiv vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem otam livnechem velo benotechem livnechem maggid sheen adam morish zechut bitto livno
Matkef lah rabba veema befituy habbat uknasot vachavalot hakkatuv medabber vechen tana rav chanina befittuy habbat uknasot vachavalot hakkatuv medabber
Chavalot tzaara degufa ninhu amar rabbi yose bar chanina
b: Sheppetzaah befaneha amar rav zera amar rav matna amar rav veamri lah amar rabbi zera amar rav matna amar rav bat hannizonet min haachin maase yadeha leatzmah dichtiv vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem otam livnechem velo benotechem livnechem maggid sheen adam morish zechut bitto livno

Amar leh avimi bar pappe shakud amrah shakud mannu shemuel ha rav amrah ema af shakud amrah amar mar bar ammemar lerav ashe hachi amri nehardae hilcheta keoteh derav sheshet rav ashe amar hilcheta keoteh derav vehilcheta keoteh derav

Matni hamares et bitto vegershah ersah venitarmela ketubbatah shello hissiah vegershah hissiah venitarmela ketubbatah shellah rabbi yehuda omer harishona shel av amru lo im mishshehissiah en leaviha reshut bah
Gema tama dehissiah vegershah hissiah venitarmela aval nitarmela tere zimne tu la chazya leinsove veaggav orcheh ka satem lan tanna kerabbi deamar bitre zimne haveya chazaka
Rabbi yehuda omer harishona shel av may tama derabbi yehuda rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu hoil umishsheat erusin zacha bahen haav

Metiv rava rabbi yehuda omer harishona shel av umode rabbi yehuda bimares et bitto keshehi ketanna uvagra veachar kach nisset sheen leaviha reshut bah ammay hacha name lema hoil umishsheat erusin zacha bahen haav
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu hoil uvirshuto nichtavin
Umigba meemat gavya
Amar rav huna mane matayim min haerusin vetosefet min hannissuin verav assi amar echad ze veechad ze min hannissuin
Umi amar rav huna hachi vehaittemar hotzia alav shette ketubbot achat shel matayim veachat shel shelosh meot veamar rav huna bata ligbot matayim gova mizzeman rishon shelosh meot gova mizzeman sheni
Veim ita tigbe matayim mizzeman rishon umea mizzeman sheni
Ultamach tigbe chamesh meot kullam matayim mizzeman rishon telat mea mizzeman sheni
Ella chamesh meot may tama la gavya kevan dela katav lah tzeveti veosefit lach telat mea ammatayim hachi kaamar lah i mizzeman rishon gavyat gevay matayim i mizzeman sheni gavyat gevay telat mea

a: Hacha name hayenu tama dela gavya middela ketav lah osefit lich mea ammatayim achole achelteh leshibuda kamma
Amar mar i baaya behay gavya i baaya behay gavya lema peliga derav nachman deamar rav nachman shene shetarot hayyotzin beze achar ze bitel sheni et harishon
Lav mi itmar alah amar rav pappa umode rav nachman dei osef beh dikla letosefet katveh hacha name ha osef lah mide

Gufa amar rav nachman shene shetarot hayyotzin beze achar ze bitel sheni et harishon amar rav pappa umode rav nachman dei osef beh dikla letosefet katveh peshita rishon bemecher vesheni bemattana leyappot kocho hu dichtav leh mishshum dina devar mitzra
Vechol shekken rishon bemattana vesheni bemecher deamrinan mishshum dina devaal chov hu dichtav ken
Ella i shenehem bemecher shenehem bemattana bitel sheni et harishon may tama rafram amar emar odoye odi leh rav acha amar emar achole achleh leshibudeh
May benayehu ika benayehu oroe sahade
Ulshallome pere ultaska
May have alah dichtubba ta shema deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon mane matayim min haerusin vetosefet min hannisuin
Vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze min hannisuin vehilcheta echad ze veechad ze min hannisuin
Matni haggiyyoret shennitgayera bittah immah vezinta hare zo bechenek en lah lo petach bet haav velo mea sela
Hayeta horatah shello bikdushsha veledatah bikdushsha hare zo biskila veen lah lo petach bet haav velo mea sela hayeta horatah veledatah bikdushsha hare hi kevat yisrael lechol devareha
Yesh lah av veen lah petach bet haav yesh lah petach bet haav veen lah av hare zo biskila lo neemar petach bet av ella lemitzva
b: Gema mena hane mile amar resh lakish deamar kera vameta lerabbot horatah shello bikdushsha veledatah bikdushsha
I hachi milka name nilke umea sela name leshallem amar kera vameta lemita nitrabbeta velo liknas veema lerabbot horatah veledatah bikdushsha hahi yisreelit meallayeta hi
Veema lerabbot horatah veledatah shello bikdushsha im ken beyisrael may ahani leh
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina hammotzi shem ra al hayetoma patur shenneemar venatnu laavi hannaara perat lezo sheen lah av
Metiv rabbi yose bar avin veitema rabbi yose bar zevida veim maen yemaen aviha lerabbot yetoma liknas divre rabbi yose haggelili
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah bava aleha veachar kach nityattema
Rava amar chayyav mimmay middetane amme betulat yisrael velo betulat gerim
I amratte bishlama ki hay gavena beyisrael michayyav hayenu deitzterich kera lemaote gerim ella i amratte beyisrael kehay gavena patur hashta beyisrael patur begerim mibaya
Amar resh lakish hammotzi shem ra al hakketanna patur shenneemar venatnu laavi hannaara naara male dibber hakkatuv

Matkef lah rav acha bar abba tama dichtiv bah hannaara ha lav hachi hava amena afilu ketanna ha ketiv veim emet haya haddavar hazze lo nimtzeu vetulim lannaara vehotziu et hannaara el petach bet aviha uskaluha uktanna lav bat onashin hi
Ella kan naara ha kol makom shenneemar naara afilu ketanna bammashma
Tane shela shalosh middot bannaara bau lah edim bevet chamiha shezzinta bevet aviha

a: Soklin otah al petach bet aviha kelomar reu gidulim sheggidaltem bau lah edim bevet aviha shezzinta bevet aviha soklin otah al petach shaar hair sarcha ulvassof bagra tidon bechenek
Lememra dechol hecha deishtanni gufa ishtanni ketala urminhi naara hamorasa shezzinta umishshebbagra hotzi aleha shem ra hu eno loke veeno noten mea sela hi vezommeha makdimin levet hassekila
Hi vezommeha salka datach ella o hi o zommeha makdimin levet hassekila
Amar rava motzi shem ra kaamratte shane motzi shem ra dechidush hu deha nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala bealma vezinta bechenek veilu motzi shem ra biskila
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava dilma ki chaddet rachamana hecha dela ishtanni gufa aval hecha deishtanni gufa la chaddet rachamana
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ishtanni vela ishtanni tannae hi ditnan chatu ad shello nitmannu venitmannu hare hen kehedotot
Rabbi shimon omer im noda lahem ad shello nitmannu chayyavim mishshennitmannu peturim
b: Emor deshaminan leh lerabbi shimon deazel af batar yedia deazel batar yedia vela azel batar cheta mi shamatte leh im ken layete korban ki dehashta mashuach par venasi sair
Haamar leh rabbi yochanan letanna teni tidon biskila veammay naara hamorasa amar rachamana veha bogeret hi amar rabbi ila amar kera hannaara hannaara shehayeta kevar
Amar leh rabbi chananya lerabbi ila i hachi milka name lilke umea sela name lishallem amar leh rachamana natzlan mehay data adderabba rachamana natzlan middata didach

Vetama may amar rabbi yitzchak bar avin veitema rabbi yitzchak bar abba zo maaseha garmu lah veze akimat sefatav garmu lo zo maaseha garmu lah keshehi ki zannay keshehi naara zannay veze akimat sefatav garmu lo emat ka michayyav hahi shata vehahi shata bogeret havay

Tanu rabbanan naara hamorasa shezzinta soklin otah al petach bet aviha en lah petach bet haav soklin otah al petach shaar hair hahi uvir sherubbah goyim soklin otah al petach bet din kayyotze baddavar atta omer haoved avoda zara soklin oto al shaar sheavad bo uvir sherubbah goyim soklin oto al petach bet din
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan shearecha ze shaar sheavad bo atta omer shaar sheavad bo o eno ella shaar shennidon bo
Neemar shearecha lematta veneemar shearecha lemala ma shearecha haamur lemala shaar sheavad bo af shearecha haamur lematta shaar sheavad bo
Davar acher shearecha velo shaare goyim hay shearecha ha appekteh im ken lema kera shaar may shearecha shema minah tarte
Ashkechan avoda zara naara hamorasa mena lan
Amar rabbi avahu gamar petach mippetach ufetach mishshaar veshaar mishshearecha
Tanu rabbanan hammotzi shem ra loke venoten mea sela rabbi yehuda omer lilkot loke mikkol makom mea sela baal noten lo baal eno noten

Ka mipalgi biflugta derabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbanan vehachi kaamar hammotzi shem ra loke venoten mea sela ben baal ben shello baal kerabbanan rabbi yehuda omer lilkot loke mikkol makom mea sela baal noten lo baal eno noten kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov
Ika deamri kullah kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov vehachi kaamar hammotzi shem ra loke venoten mea sela vehu shebbaal rabbi yehuda omer lilkot loke mikkol makom
Vesavar rabbi yehuda lilkot loke mikkol makom vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer baal loke lo baal eno loke amar rav nachman bar yitzchak loke makkat mardut midderabbanan

a: Rav pappa amar may baal loke dekatane hatam mamon vekare leh lemamon malkot in veha tenan haomer chatzi erki alay noten chatzi erko rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer loke venoten erech shalem loke ammay amar rav pappa loke beerech shalem
May tama gezera chatzi erko attu erech chetzo veerech chetzo have leh ever shehanneshama teluya bo
Tanu rabbanan veanshu oto ze mamon veyisseru ze malkot
Bishlama veanshu ze mamon dichtiv veanshu oto mea chesef venatnu laavi hannaara ella veyisseru ze malkot menalan
Amar rabbi avahu lamadnu yisseru miyyisseru veyisseru mibben uven mibbin vehaya im bin hakkot harasha
Azhara lemotzi shem ra menalan rabbi elazar amar millo telech rachil rabbi natan omer mivvenishmarta mikkol davar ra
Verabbi elazar may tama la amar mehay hahu mibe leh lechidrabbi pinchas ben yair venishmarta mikkol davar ra mikkan amar rabbi pinchas ben yair al yeharher adam bayyom veyavo lide tuma ballayela
Verabbi natan may tama la amar mehay hahu azhara levet din shello yehe rach laze vekashe laze
Lo amar leedim bou vehaiduni vehen meidim oto mealehen hu eno loke veeno noten mea selaim hi vezommeha makdimin levet hassekila
Hi vezommeha salka datach ella o hi o zommeha makdimin levet hassekila
Tama dela amar lehu ha amar lehu af al gav dela agrinhu leappoke midderabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer eno chayyav ad sheyyiskor edim
May tama derabbi yehuda amar rabbi avahu atya sima sima ketiv hacha vesam lah alilot devarim uchtiv hatam lo tesimun alav neshech ma lehallan mamon af kan mamon
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vechen tane rav yosef tzidoni be rabbi shimon ben yochay atya sima sima
Bae rabbi yirmeya secharan bekarka mahu befachot mishshave peruta mahu shenehem bifruta mahu
Bae rav ashe hotzi shem ra al hannisuin harishonim mahu al nissue achiv mahu
Peshot miha chada detane rabbi yona et bitti natatti laish hazze leze velo layyavam
May rabbanan umay rabbi eliezer ben yaakov detanya ketzad hotzaat shem ra ba levet din veamar peloni lo matzati levittecha betulim im yesh edim shezzinta tachtav yesh lah ketubba mane
Im yesh edim shezzinta tachtav yesh lah ketubba mane bat sekila hi hachi kaamar im yesh edim shezzinta tachtav biskila zinta meikara yesh lah ketubba mane

Nimtza sheshshem ra sheeno shem ra hu loke venoten mea sela ben baal uven lo baal rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer lo neemru devarim hallalu ella keshebbaal bishlama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov hayenu dichtiv uva eleha vaekrav eleha
Ella lerabbanan may uva eleha vaekrav eleha uva eleha baalilot vaekrav eleha bidvarim
Bishlama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov hayenu dichtiv lo matzati levittecha betulim ella lerabbanan may lo matzati levittecha betulim lo matzati levittecha keshere vetulim
Bishlama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov hayenu dichtiv veelle betule vitti ella lerabbanan may veelle betule vitti veelle keshere betule vitti
Bishlama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov hayenu dichtiv ufarsu hassimla ella lerabbanan may ufarsu hassimla

Amar rabbi avahu parsu ma shessam lah kidtanya ufarsu hassimla melammed shebbain edim shel ze veedim shel ze uvorrin et haddavar kesimla chadasha rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer devarim kichtavan simla mammash

Shalach rabbi yitzchak bar rav yaakov bar giyyore mishshemeh derabbi yochanan af al gav shello matzinu bechol hattora kullah shechillek hakkatuv ben bia kedarkah levia shello kedarkah lemakkot velaonashin aval motzi shem ra chillek eno chayyav ad sheyyivol shello kedarkah veotzi shem ra kedarkah
Keman i kerabbanan af al gav dela baal i kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov
b: Ide veide kedarkah baenan ella shelach rav kahana mishshemeh derabbi yochanan eno chayyav ad sheyyivol kedarkah veotzi shem ra bichdarkah
Matni haav zakkay bevitto bekidusheha bechesef bishtar uvvia zakkay bimtziatah uvmaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha umkabbel et gitah veeno ochel perot bechayyeha
Nisset yater alav habbaal sheochel perot bechayyeha vechayyav bimzonoteha uvfirkonah ukvuratah rabbi yehuda omer afilu ani shebbeyisrael lo yifchot mishshene chalilin umkonenet
Gema bechesef menalan amar rav yehuda amar kera veyatza chinnam en kasef en kesef leadon ze veyesh kesef leadon acher umannu aviha
Veema ledidah hashta aviha mekabbel kidusheha dichtiv et bitti natatti laish hazze ihi shakla kaspa
Veema hane mile ketanna delet lah yad aval naara deit lah yad ihi tekaddesh nafshah veihi tishkol kaspa amar kera binureha bet aviha kol shevach neurim leaviha

Veella ha deamar rav huna amar rav minnayin shemmaase habbat leaviha shenneemar vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama ma ama maase yadeha lerabbah af bat maase yadeha leaviha lema li tipok leh mibbinureha bet aviha ella hahu bahafarat nedarim hu dichtiv
Vechi tema nelaf minah mamona meisura la yalfinan vechi tema nelaf mikkenasa mamona mikkenasa la yalfinan
Vechi tema nelaf mibboshet ufgam shane boshet ufgam deaviha name shayech beh
Ella mistabbera dechi memaet rachamana yetzia dichotah ka memaet
Veha la damya ha yetzia leha yetzia hatam gabbe adon nafka lah mershuteh ligmare yetzia deav akkatti mechassera mesira lechuppa
Mehafarat nedarim miha nafka lah mershuteh ditnan naara hamorasa aviha uvalah mefirin lah nedareha
Shetar uvia mena lan amar kera vehayeta leish acher itakkush haoot lahadade
Zakkay bimtziatah

a: Mishshum eva

Bemaase yadeha menalan deamar rav huna amar rav minnayin shemmaase habbat laav shenneemar vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama ma ama maase yadeha lerabbah af bat maase yadeha leaviha veema hane mile ketanna dematze mezabben lah aval naara dela matze mezabben lah maase yadeha didah hau
Mistabbera deaviha hau dei salka datach maase yadeha lav deaviha ella ha dezakki leh rachamana leav lemimserah lechuppa hechi matze masar lah ha kamvattel lah mimmaase yadeha
Parech rav achay ema deyahev lah sechar pekatah i name dimsar lah belelya i name dimsar lah beshabbatot veyamim tovim
Ella ketanna la tzericha kera hashta zabbone mezabben lah maase yadeha mibe ella ki itzterich kera lenaara
Bahafarat nedareha menalan dichtiv binureha bet aviha
Umkabbel et gitah menalan dichtiv veyatza vehayeta itakkush yetzia lahavayah

Veeno ochel perot bechayyeha tanu rabbanan haav eno ochel perot bechayye vitto rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer haav ochel perot bechayye vitto bemay kamipalgi tanna kamma savar bishlama baal takkinu le rabbanan pere deim ken mimna vela parek
Ella av may ika lememar demimna vela parek belav hachi parek lah verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar av name mimna vela parek savar kisa nekita ilavah tezil vetifrok nafshah

Niset yater alav habbaal shehu ochel ku tanu rabbanan katav lah perot kesut vechelim sheyyavou immah mibbet aviha levet balah meta lo zacha habbaal bidvarim hallalu mishshum rabbi natan amru zacha habbaal bidvarim hallalu

Lema biflugta derabbi elazar ben azarya verabbanan kamipalgi ditnan nitarmela o nitgarsha ben min hannissuin ben min haerusin gova et hakkol rabbi elazar ben azarya omer min hannissuin gova et hakkol umin haerusin betula gova matayim vealmana mane
b: Shello katav lah ella al menat lechonsah leman deamar lo zacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya uman deamar zacha kerabbanan

La dechulle alma kerabbi elazar ben azarya man deamar lo zacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya uman deamar zacha ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar ben azarya ella middideh ledidah shello katav lah ella al menat lechonsah
Aval middidah ledideh afilu rabbi elazar ben azarya mode demishshum ichattone hu veha ichattanuy lehu
Chayyav bimzonoteha vechu tanu rabbanan tiknu mezonoteha tachat maase yadeha ukvuratah tachat ketubbatah lefichach baal ochel perot
Perot man dechar shemayehu chassore mechassera vehachi katane tiknu mezonoteha tachat maase yadeha ufirkonah tachat perot ukvuratah tachat ketubbatah lefichach baal ochel perot
May lefichach
Mahu detema mechal la nechlinhu annoche nannechinhu deim ken mimna vela parek ka mashma lan deha adifa zimnin dela malu ufarek lah middideh
Veefoch ana
Amar abbaye tiknu matzuy lematzuy vesheeno matzuy lesheeno matzuy
Amar rava hay tanna savar mezonot middeorayeta detanya sheerah ellu mezonot vechen hu omer vaasher achlu sheer ammi kesutah kemashmao onatah zo ona haamura battora vechen hu omer im teanne et benotay
Rabbi elazar omer sheerah zo ona vechen hu omer ish ish el kol sheer besaro lo tikrevu legallot erva kesutah kemashmao onatah ellu mezonot vechen hu omer vayeannecha veyarivecha

a: Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer sheerah kesutah lefum sheerah ten kesutah shello yitten lah lo shel yalda lizkenah velo shel zekena leyalda kesutah veonatah lefum onatah ten kesutah shello yitten chadashim bimot hachamma velo shechakim bimot haggeshamim

Tane rav yosef sheerah zo keruv basar shello yinhag bah minhag parsiyyim shemmeshammeshin mittotehen bilvushehen mesayya leh lerav huna deamar rav huna haomer i efshi ella ani bevigdi vehi bevigdah yotzi venoten ketubba
Rabbi yehuda omer afilu ani shebbeyisrael vechu mikkelal detanna kamma savar hane la hechi dame i deorchah may tama detanna kamma deamar la vei delav orchah may tama derabbi yehuda
La tzericha kegon deorcheh dideh velav orchah didah tanna kamma savar ki amrinan ola immo veenah yoredet immo hane mile mechayyim aval leachar mita lo
Verabbi yehuda savar afilu leachar mita amar rav chisda amar mar ukva halacha kerabbi yehuda

Veamar rav chisda amar mar ukva mi shennishtatta bet din yordin linchasav vezanin umfarnesin et ishto uvanav uvnotav vedavar acher amar leh ravina lerav ashe may shena meha detanya mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot bet din yordin linchasav vezanin umfarnesin et ishto aval lo banav uvnotav velo davar acher
Amar leh vela shane lach ben yotze ledaat layyotze shello ledaat
May davar acher rav chisda amar ze tachshit rav yosef amar tzedaka man deamar tachshit kol shekken tzedaka man deamar tzedaka aval tachshit yahavinan lah dela nicha leh detinaval
Amar rav chiyya bar avin amar rav huna mi shehalach limdinat hayyam umeta ishto bet din yordin linchasav vekovrin otah lefi chevodo lefi chevodo velo lefi chevodah
Ema af lefi chevodo ha ka mashma lan ola immo veenah yoredet immo vaafilu leachar mita
Amar rav matna haomer im meta lo tikberuha minnechasav shomin lo may shena ki amar denafli nichse kamme yatme ki la amar name nichse kamme yatme remu
Ella haomer im met hu lo tikberuhu minnechasav en shomin lo lav kol hemennu sheyyaashir et banav veyappil atzmo al hatztzibur
Matni leolam hi birshut haav ad shettikkanes
b: Lirshut habbaal lenissuin masar haav lishluche habbaal hare hi birshut habbaal halach haav im sheluche habbaal o shehalchu sheluche haav im sheluche habbaal hare hi birshut haav masru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal hare hi birshut habbaal
Gema may leolam leappoke mimmishna rishona ditnan higgia zeman velo nisu ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma ka mashma lan leolam
Masar haav lishluche habbaal hare hi birshut habbaal vechu amar rav mesiratah lakkol chutz mitteruma verav assi amar af litruma

Etiveh rav huna lerav assi veamri lah chiyya bar rav lerav assi leolam hi birshut haav ad shettikkanes lachuppa amar lehu rav lav amena lechu la tezlu batar ipcha yachel leshannoye lechu mesiratah zo hi kenisatah lechuppa
Ushmuel amar lirushshatah
Resh lakish amar lichtubbatah ketubbatah may hi dei meta yaret lah hayenu dishmuel amar ravina lomar ketubbatah meacher mane
Rabbi yochanan verabbi chanina deamri tarvayehu mesiratah lakkol af litruma
Metivi halach haav im sheluche habbaal o shehalchu sheluche haav im sheluche habbaal o shehayeta lah chatzer badderech venichnesa immo lalin af al pi shekketubbatah bevet balah meta aviha yorshah
Masar haav lishluche habbaal o shemmasru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal o shehayeta lo chatzer badderech venichnesa immo leshum nisuin af al pi shekketubbatah bevet aviha meta balah yorshah
Bamme devarim amurim lirushshatah aval litruma en ishsha ochelet bitruma ad shettikkanes lachuppa teuvta dechullehu teuvta
Ha gufa kashya amratte nichnesa immo lalin tama delalin ha setama leshem nisuin ema sefa nichnesa immo leshem nisuin ha setama lalin
Amar rav ashe setame setame katane setam chatzer didah lalin setam chatzer dideh lenissuin
Tanna masar haav lishluche habbaal vezinta hare zo bechenek mena hane mile amar rabbi amme bar chama amar kera liznot bet aviha perat leshemmasar haav lishluche habbaal
Veema perat shennichnesa lachuppa velo nivala
Amar rava amar li amme chuppa behedya ketiva ki yihye naara vetula meorasa leish naara velo bogeret betula velo beula meorasa velo nesua
May nesua ilema nesua mammash hayenu betula velo beula ella lav shennichnesa lechuppa velo nivala

a: Veema hecha dehadra leve nasha hadra lemilta kammayeta amar rava hahu kevar paskah tanna deve rabbi yishmael
Detana deve rabbi yishmael veneder almana ugrusha kol asher asra al nafshah yakum aleha ma talmud lomar vahalo mutzet mikkelal av umutzet mikkelal baal

Ella hare shemmasar haav lishluche habbaal o shemmasru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal venitarmela badderech o nitgarsha heach ani kore bah bet aviha shel zo o bet balah shel zo ella lomar lecha kevan sheyyatza shaa achat mershut haav shuv eno yachol lehafer

Amar rav pappa af anan name tenena habba al naara hamorasa eno chayyav ad shettehe naara betula meorasa vehi bevet aviha bishlama naara velo bogeret betula velo beula meorasa velo nesua bevet aviha lemaote may lav lemaote masar haav lishluche habbaal

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak af anan name tenena habba al eshet ish kevan shennichnesa lirshut habbaal lenissuin af al pi shello nivala habba aleha hare ze bechenek nichnesa lirshut habbaal bealma shema minah

Matni haav eno chayyav bimzonot bitto ze midrash darash rabbi elazar ben azarya lifne chachamim bakkerem beyavne habbanim yirshu vehabbanot yizzonu ma habbanim enan yorshin ella leachar mitat haav af habbanot en nizonot ella leachar mitat avihen
Gema bimzonot bitto hu deeno chayyav ha bimzonot beno chayyav bitto name chova hu deleka ha mitzva ika manni matnitin la rabbi meir la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yochanan ben beroka

Detanya mitzva lazun et habbanot kal vechomer labbanim deaski battora divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer mitzva lazun et habbanim vekal vachomer labbanot mishshum ziluta rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer chova lazun et habbanot leachar mitat avihen aval bechayye avihen ellu vaellu enan nizonin
Manni matnitin i rabbi meir ha amar banim mitzva i rabbi yehuda ha amar banim name mitzva i rabbi yochanan ben beroka afilu mitzva name leka
Ibaet ema rabbi meir ibaet ema rabbi yehuda ibaet ema rabbi yochanan ben beroka
Ibaet ema rabbi meir vehachi kaamar haav eno chayyav bimzonot bitto vehu haddin livno ha mitzva bevitto ika kal vachomer labbanim vehay dekatane bitto ha ka mashma lan
b: Daafilu bitto chova hu deleka ha mitzva ika
Veibaet ema rabbi yehuda vehachi kaamar haav eno chayyav bimzonot bitto vechol shekken livno ha mitzva bivno ika vekal vachomer labbanot veha dekatane bitto ha ka mashma lan daafilu bitto chova leka
Veibaet ema rabbi yochanan ben beroka vehachi kaamar eno chayyav bimzonot bitto vehu haddin livno vehu haddin daafilu mitzva name leka veayede devanot leachar mitat avihen chova tena name eno chayyav

Amar rabbi ila amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda bar chanina beusha hitkinu sheyehe adam zan et banav veet benotav keshehen ketannim ibaya lehu hilcheta keoteh o en hilcheta keoteh ta shema ki hava atu lekammeh derav yehuda amar lehu yarud yalda veabbene mata shadya

Ki hava atu lekammeh derav chisda amar lehu kefo leh asita betzibbura velekum velema orva bae beneh vehahu gavra la bae beneh veorva bae beneh vehachtiv livne orev asher yikrau la kashya ha bechivare ha beukkame
Ki hava ate lekammeh derava amar leh nicha lach demitazni benach mitztzedaka
Vela amaran ella dela amid aval amid kafenan leh al kurcheh ki ha derava kafyeh lerav natan bar amme veappek mineh arba mea zuze litzdaka
Amar rabbi ila amar resh lakish beusha hitkinu hakkotev kol nechasav levanav hu veishto nizzonim mehem
Matkef lah rabbi zera veitema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani gedola mizzo amru almenato nizzonet minnechasav hu veishto mibaya
Dishlach ravin beigarteh mi shemmet vehinniach almana uvat almenato nizonet minnechasav niset habbat almenato nizonet minnechasav
Meta habbat amar rabbi yehuda ben achoto shel rabbi yose bar chanina al yadi haya maase veamru almenato nizonet minnechasav hu veishto mibaya
Mahu detema hatam hu deleka detarach aval hacha nitrach ledideh uldidah ka mashma lan

Ibaya lehu hilcheta keoteh o let hilcheta keoteh ta shema derabbi chanina verabbi yonatan hao kayemi ata hahu gavra gechen venashshekeh lerabbi yonatan akkareh amar leh rabbi chanina may hay amar leh kotev nechasav levanav hu

a: Veassitinhu lezuneh vezanuh i amratte bishlama lav dina mishshum hachi assiynhu ella i amratte dina assoyinhu bae

Amar rabbi ila beusha hitkinu hamvazbez al yevazbez yoter mechomesh tanya name hachi hamvazbez al yevazbez yoter mechomesh shemma yitztarech labberiyyot umaase beechad shebbikkesh levazbez yoter mechomesh velo hinniach lo chavero umannu rabbi yeshevav veamri lah rabbi yeshevav velo hinnicho chavero umannu rabbi akiva
Amar rav nachman veitema rav acha bar yaakov may kera vechol asher titten li asser aasserennu lach
Veha la dame isura batra leisura kamma amar rav ashe aasserennu levatra ki kamma
Amar rav shimi bar ashe ushmuot hallalu mitmaatot veholchot vesimanach ketannim katvu uvizbezu

Amar rav yitzchak beusha hitkinu sheyehe adam mitgalgel im beno ad shettem esre shana mikkan veelach yored immo lechayyav ini veha amar leh rav lerav shemuel bar shilat betzir mibbar shet la tekabbel bar shet kabbel usfi leh ketora
In safe leh ketora mihu eno yored immo lechayyav ad leachar shettem esre shana veibaet ema la kashya ha lemikra ha lemishna
Deamar abbaye amara li em bar shet lemikra bar eser lemishna bar telesar letaanita meet leet uvtinoket bat teresar

Amar abbaye amara li em hay bar shet detarka leh akrabba beoma demishlam shet la chaye may asuteh merarta dedayya chivarta beshichra nishpeyeh venashkeyeh hay bar shatta detarek leh zibura beoma demishlam shatta la chaye may asuteh atzvata dedikla bemayya nishpeyeh venashkeyeh

Amar rav kattina kol hammachnis et beno pachut mibben shesh ratz acharav veeno maggio ika deamri chaverav ratzin acharav veen maggiin oto vetarvayehu itanhu chalish ugmir ibaet ema ha dichchish ha devari

Amar rabbi yose bar chanina beusha hitkinu haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah umeta habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot ashkecheh rav yitzchak bar yosef lerabbi avahu dahava kae beuchlusa deusha amar leh man marah dishmata deusha amar leh rabbi yose bar chanina tena mineh arbein zimnin vedame leh keman demannecha leh bechisteh

Ashre shomre mishpat ose tzedaka vechol et vechi efshar laasot tzedaka bechol et darshu rabbotenu shebbeyavne veamri lah rabbi eliezer ze hazzan banav uvnotav keshehen ketannim rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar ze hamgaddel yatom vitoma betoch beto umassian
Hon vaosher beveto vetzidkato omedet laad rav huna verav chisda chad amar ze hallomed tora umlammedah vechad amar ze hakkotev tora neviim uchtuvim umashilan laacherim

Ure vanim levanecha shalom al yisrael amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kevan shevanim levanecha shalom al yisrael dela ate lide chalitza veyibbum rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar kevan shevanim levanecha shalom al dayyane yisrael dela ate leintzoye
Ze midrash darash rabbi elazar lifne chachamim ku
b: Yatev rav yosef kammeh derav hamnuna veyatev rav hamnuna vekaamar keshem sheen habbanim yorshin ella min hakkarka kach en habbanot nizonot ella min hakkarka avash aleh kulle alma deshavek ara hu deyarti leh beneh dela shavek ara la yarti leh beneh
Amar leh rav yosef vedilma ketubbat benin dichrin kaamar mar amar leh mar degavra rabba hu yada may kaamena
Amar rabbi chiyya bar yosef rav zan mechite daaliyya ibaya lehu parnasa hava umay aliyya meiluya deav uchdishmuel deamar shemuel lefarnasa shamin baav
O dilma mezone mammash hava umay aliyya middevarim tovim shenneemru baaliyya deamar rav yitzchak bar yosef baaliyya hitkinu sheyehu banot nizonot min hammittaltelin
Ta shema bideh derabbi bannay achuh derabbi chiyya bar abba hao mittaltelin deyatme ato lekammeh dishmuel amar leh zil zun
May lav limzone vechidrav yitzchak bar yosef sevira leh la hatam lefarnasa havay ushmuel letameh deamar shemuel lefarnasa shamin baav
Hava ovada binhardea vedun dayyane dinhardea befumbedita veagbi rav chana bar bizna amar lehu rav nachman zilu ahdaru vei la magbena lechu leappadnayechu minayechu
Rabbi amme verabbi assi sevur lemezan mimmittaltele amar lehu rabbi yaakov bar idi milta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish la avadu bah ovada attun avdin bah ovada

Rabbi elazar savar lemezan mimmittaltelin amar lefanav rabbi shimon ben elyakim rabbi yodea ani becha sheen middat haddin atta ose ella middat rachmanut ella shemma yiru hattalmidim veyikbeu halacha ledorot
Hahu daata lekammeh derav yosef amar lehu havu lah mittamre deal budya amar leh abbaye ilu baal chov hava ki hay gavena mi hava yahev leh mar
Amar leh dechazya levudya kaamena

a: Sof sof kol haomed ligzoz kegazuz dame ditzricha ledikla kaamena

Hahu yatom vitoma daato lekammeh derava amar lehu rava haalu layyatom bishvil yetoma amri leh rabbanan lerava veha mar hu deamar mimmekarkee vela mimmittalteli ben limzone ben lichtubba uven lefarnasa
Amar lehu ilu ratza shifcha leshammesho mi la yahavinan leh kol shekken hacha deika tarte

Tanu rabbanan echad nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut veechad nechasim sheen lahen achraut motziin limzon ishsha ulvanot divre rabbi rabbi shimon ben elazar omer nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut motziin labbanot min habbanim velabbanot min habbanot velabbanim min habbanim
Velabbanim min habbanot binchasim merubbin aval lo labbanim min habbanot binchasim muatin
Nechasim sheen lahen achraut motziin labbanim min habbanim velabbanot min habbanot velabbanim min habbanot aval lo labbanot min habbanim
Af al gav dekayema lan halacha kerabbi mechavero hacha halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar deamar rava hilcheta mimmekarkee vela mimmetalteli ben lichtubba ben limzone ben lefarnasa

Matni lo katav lah ketubba betula gova matayim vealmana mane mippene shehu tenay bet din katav lah sade shave mane tachat matayim zuz velo katav lah kol nechasim deit li achrain lichtubbetich chayyav shehu tenay bet din
Lo katav lah im tishtevay efrekinich veotvinich li leintu uvchohenet ahderinich limdinticha chayyav shehu tenay bet din
Nishbet chayyav lifdotah veim amar hare gitah uchtubbatah vetifde et atzmah eno rashshay lakta chayyav lerappeotah amar hare gitah uchtubbatah terappe et atzmah rashshay
Gema manni rabbi meir hi deamar kol happochet livtula mimmatayim ulalmana mimmane hare zo beilat zenut
Dei rabbi yehuda haamar ratza kotev livtula shetar shel matayim vehi kotevet hitkabbalti mimmecha mane ulalmana mane vehi kotevet hitkabbalti mimmecha chamishshim zuz
Ema sefa katav lah sade shave mane tachat matayim zuz velo katav lah kol nechasim deit li achrain lichtubbetich chayyav shehu tenay bet din atan lerabbi yehuda deamar achraut taut sofer hu
Dei rabbi meir haamar achraut lav taut sofer hu ditnan matza shitre chov im
b: Yesh bahen achraut nechasim lo yachazir shebbet din nifrain mehen
En bahen achraut nechasim yachazir sheen bet din nifrain mehen divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze lo yachazir shebbet din nifrain mehen
Resha rabbi meir vesefa rabbi yehuda vechi tema kullah rabbi meir hi veshane leh lerabbi meir ben ketubba lishtare umi shane leh
Vehatanya chamishsha govin min hamchorarin veellu hen perot ushvach perot vehamkabbel alav lazun et ben ishto uvat ishto veget chov sheen bo achraut uchtubbat ishsha sheen bah achraut
Man shamatte leh deamar achraut lav taut sofer hu rabbi meir vekatane ketubbat ishsha
Ibaet ema rabbi meir veibaet ema rabbi yehuda ibaet ema rabbi yehuda hatam katva leh hitkabbalti hacha la katva leh hitkabbalti
Ibaet ema rabbi meir may chayyav dekatane min hamchorarin
Lo katav lah vechu amar avuh dishmuel eshet yisrael shenneensa asura levalah chayeshinan shemma techillatah beones vesofah beratzon
Etiveh rav laavuh dishmuel im tishtevay efrekinich veotvinich li leintu ishtik
Kare rav aleh daavuh dishmuel sarim atzru vemillim vechaf yasimu lefihem may it leh lememar bishvuya hekelu
Velaavuh dishmuel ones desharyah rachamana hechi mashkachatte lah kegon dekaamri edim betzovachat mittechilla vead sof
Ufliga derava deamar rava kol shettechillatah beones vesof beratzon afilu hi omeret hannichu lo sheilmale lo nizkak lah hi socharto mutteret may tama yetzer albeshah
Tanya keoteh derava vehi lo nitpasa asura ha nitpasa mutteret veyesh lecha acheret sheaf al pi shello nitpasa mutteret veezo zo kol shettechillatah beones vesofah beratzon
Tanya idach vehi lo nitpasa asura ha nitpasa mutteret veyesh lecha acheret sheaf al pi shennitpasa asura veezo zo eshet kohen

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi yishmael vehi lo nitpasa asura ha nitpasa mutteret veyesh lah acheret sheaf al pi shello nitpasa mutteret veezo zo shekkidusheha kiddushe taut sheafilu benah murkav al ketefah memaenet veholechet lah

Amar rav yehuda hane neshe dignavu gannave sharyan leguvrayehu amri leh rabbanan lerav yehuda veha ka mamteyan lehu nahama mechamat yira veha ka meshallechan lehu gire mechamat yira vadday shavkinhu veazlan minnafshayehu asiran
Tanu rabbanan shevuye malchut hare hen kishvuyin genuve listut enan kishvuyin vehatanya ipcha
Malchut ammalchut la kashya ha bemalchut achashverosh ha bemalchut ben netztzar
Listut allistut la kashya ha beven netztzar ha belistim dealma uven netztzar hatam kare leh melech vehacha kare leh listim in gabbe achashverosh listim hu gabbe listim dealma melech hu
Uvchohenet ahderinich limdinticha vechu amar abbaye almana lechohen gadol chayyav lifdotah sheani kore bah uvchohenet ahderinich limdinticha

a: Mamzeret untina leyisrael eno chayyav lifdotah sheen ani kore bah veotvinich li leintu rava amar kol sheisur sheviyya gorem lah chayyav lifdotah isur davar acher gorem lah eno chayyav lifdotah
Lema ketannae hammaddir et ishto venishbet rabbi eliezer omer podah venoten lah ketubbatah rabbi yehoshua omer noten lah ketubbatah veeno podah
Amar rabbi natan shaalti et somchos kesheamar rabbi yehoshua noten lah ketubbatah veeno podah keshehiddirah ulvassof nishbet o benishbet ulvassof hiddirah
Veamar li lo shamati venirin devarim shehiddirah ulvassof nishbet dei amratte nishbet ulvassof hiddirah ate leiarome
May lav bemaddir eshet kohen kamipalgi veabbaye deamar kerabbi eliezer verava deamar kerabbi yehoshua
La hacha bemay askinan kegon shennadra ihi vekayyem lah hu rabbi eliezer savar hu noten etzba ben shineha verabbi yehoshua savar hi natna etzba ben shineha
I hi natna etzba ben shineha ketubba may avidtah
Vetu amar rabbi natan shaalti et somchos kesheamar rabbi yehoshua noten lah ketubbatah veeno podah keshehiddirah ulvassof nishbet o beshennishbet ulvassof hiddirah veamar lo shamati
Vei dindara ihi ma li hiddirah ulvassof nishbet ma li nishbet ulvassof hiddirah

Ella leolam deadderah ihu veabbaye metaretz letameh verava metaretz letameh abbaye metaretz letameh almana lechohen gadol kulle alma la peligi dechayyav lifdotah mamzeret untina leyisrael kulle alma la peligi deeno chayyav lifdotah maddir eshet kohen name kulle alma la peligi dechayyav lifdotah dehayenu almana lechohen gadol
Ki peligi bemaddir eshet yisrael rabbi eliezer azel batar meikara verabbi yehoshua azel batar bassof
Rava metaretz letameh almana lechohen gadol mamzeret untina leyisrael kulle alma la peligi deeno chayyav lifdotah ki peligi bemaddir ben eshet kohen uven eshet yisrael
Rabbi eliezer azel batar meikara verabbi yehoshua azel batar bassof
Nishbet chayyav lifdotah vechu tanu rabbanan nishbet bechayye balah veachar kach met balah hikkir bah baalah yorshin chayyavin lifdotah lo hikkir bah baalah en yorshin chayyavin lifdotah

Levi savar lemibad ovada ki ha matnita amar leh rav hachi amar chabbivi let hilcheta ki ha matnita ella ki ha detanya nishbet leachar mitat balah en hayetomin chayyavin lifdotah velo od ella afilu nishbet bechayye balah veachar kach met balah en hayetomin chayyavin lifdotah sheen ani kore bah veotvinich leintu
Tanu rabbanan nishbet vehau mevakkeshin mimmennu ad asara bedameha paam rishona podah mikkan veelach ratza podah ratza eno podah rabban shimon ben gamliel omer
b: En podin et hashshevuyin yoter al kede demehem mippene tikkun haolam ha bichde demehen podin af al gav defirkonah yoter al ketubbatah

Urminhi nishbet vehau mevakkeshin mimmennu ad asara bichtubbatah paam rishona podah mikkan veelach ratza podah ratza eno podah rabbi shimon ben gamliel omer im haya pirkonah keneged ketubbatah podah im lav eno podah
Rabban shimon ben gamliel tere kulle it leh

Lakta chayyav lerappeotah tanu rabbanan almana nizonet minnichse yetomin utzricha refua hare hi kimzonot rabban shimon ben gamliel omer refua sheyyesh lah kitzva nitrappet titrappe mikketubbatah sheen lah kitzva hare hi kimzonot

Amar rabbi yochanan asu hakkazat dam beeretz yisrael kirfua sheen lah kitzva kariveh derabbi yochanan hava lehu itat abba dahavat tzericha refua kol yoma ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar lehu ezilu kutzu leh mide lerofe
Amar rabbi yochanan asinu atzmenu keorche haddayyanin meikara may sevar ulvassof may sevar meikara sevar umibbesarcha lo titallam ulvassof sevar adam chashuv shane

Matni lo katav lah benin dichrin deyiho lichi minay inun yirtun kesef ketubbetich yater al chulakhon deim achuhon chayyav shehu tenay bet din benan nukvan deyihon lichi minay yeheveyan yatvan beveti umitaznan minnichsay ad detillakchan leguvrin chayyav shehu tenay bet din

Atte tehe yatva beveti umitazna minnichsay kol yeme megar almenutich beveti chayyav shehu tenay bet din kach hau anshe yerushalayim kotvin anshe galil hau kotvin keanshe yerushalayim anshe yehuda hau kotvin ad sheyyirtzu hayyorshin liten lich ketubbetich lefichach im ratzu yorshin notnin lah ketubbatah ufotrin otah
Gema amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay mippene ma hitkinu ketubbat benin dichrin kede sheyyikpotz adam veyichtov levitto kivno
Umi ika mide derachamana amar bera lerot beratta la terot vaato rabbanan umtakkeni deterot beratta
Ha name deorayeta hu dichtiv kechu nashim veholidu banim uvanot ukchu livnechem nashim veet benotechem tenu laanashim bishlama banim bideh kayemi ella benateh mi kayeman bideh
Ha ka mashma lan denalbeshah venichasseyah venitev lah mide ki hechi dekaftzi alah veatu nasvi lah vead kamma abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu ad leisur nichse
Veema deav lerot devaal la lerot im ken av name mimna vela katev
Veema hecha dichtav av lichtov baal hecha dela ketav av la lichtov baal la pelug rabbanan

Bat ben habbanot terot la pelug rabbanan vetigbe mimmittalteli kichtubba shavveuha rabbanan
Titrof mimmeshabedi yirtun tenan veema af al gav deleka motar dinar bemakom deka miakra nachala deorayeta la takkinu rabbanan

a: Chazyeh dela hava nicha leh amar leh may datach mishshum daamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana la tihve beabbore achsanta afilu mibbera bisha livra tava dela yedia may zara nafek mineh vechol shekken mibbera livratta

Hay name takkanta derabbanan hi deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay amar leh hane mile middateh leassoyeh name amar leh attu mi kaamena lach deul veasseyeh ul vela teasseyeh kaamena amar leh maalay didi hayenu issuyeh
Achpeyeh veol ishtik vitev sevar hahu mirtach ratach katveh lechol may dahava leh lesof amar leh hashta name la mishtae mar chayye demar la shevaki mide lenafshay
Amar leh i minay didi afilu hay name dichtavte la nicha li amar leh hashta name ehdar bi amar leh shauoye nafshach hadrana la kaamena
Bea mineh rav yemar sava merav nachman machra ketubbatah levalah yesh lah ketubbat benin dichrin o en lah ketubbat benin dichrin amar leh rava vetibbee lach mochelet
Amar leh hashta mocheret kamibaya li deaf al gav deika lememar zuze ansuha deamena keman deka machu lah mea uchle beuchla mochelet mibaya
Amar rava peshita li mocheret ketubbatah laacherim yesh lah ketubbat benin dichrin may tama zuze ansuha mochelet ketubbatah levalah en lah ketubbat benin dichrin may tama achole acheltah
Bae rava mocheret ketubbatah levalah kemocheret laacherim dame o kemochelet levalah dame batar devaya hadar pashtah mocheret ketubba levalah kemocheret laacherim dame
Metiv rav idi bar avin meta en yorshin shel ze veen yorshin shel ze yorshin ketubbatah vehavenan bah ketubbatah may avidtah
Veamar rav pappa ketubbat benin dichrin veammay hacha name lema yetzer ansah
Hatam kenasa hu dekansuha rabbanan

Yatev ravin bar chanina kammeh derav chisda veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi elazar mochelet ketubbatah levalah en lah mezonot amar leh i lav dekaamratte li mishshemeh degavra rabba hava amena lach meshiv raa tachat tova lo tamush raa mibbeto

Yatev rav nachman veulla vaavimi bar rav pappe veyatev rav chiyya bar amme gabbayehu ata hahu gavra dishchiva arusato amri leh zil kevar o hav lah ketubbetah amar lehu rav chiyya tenena ishto arusa lo onen velo mitamme lah vechen hi lo onenet velo mitammea lo meta eno yorshah met hu gova ketubbatah
Tama demet hu ha meta hi en lah ketubba may tama amar rav hoshaya sheen ani kore bah lichshettinnasi leacher titteli ma shekkatuv lichi
Ki ata ravin amar resh lakish arusa shemmeta en lah ketubba amar lehu abbaye zilu imru leh
b: Shekila tevutach shadya achizre kevar targemah rav hoshaya lishmateh bevavel
Benan nukvan deyihveyan lichi minay vechu rav tane ad detillakchan leguvrin velevi tane ad detivgeran lerav af al gav divgar velevi af al gav deinsiv

Ella begar vela insiv insiv vela begar dechulle alma la peligi ki peligi baarusa vela begar vechen tane levi bematniteh ad detivgeran veyimte zimnehon deinasvan tarte ella o tivgeran o yimte zimnehon leitnasva
Ketannae ad matay habbat nizzonet ad shetteares mishshum rabbi elazar amru ad shettivgar tane rav yosef ad diheveyan ibaya lehu havaya deerusin o havaya denisuin teku
Amar leh rav chisda lerav yosef mi shemia lach mineh derav yehuda arusa yesh lah mezonot o en lah mezonot amar leh mishma la shemia li ella missevara let lah kevan deersah la nicha leh detitzil
Amar leh im mishma la shemia lach missevara it lah kevan dela kim leh begavah la shade zuze bichdi
Veika deamri amar leh mishma la shemia li missevara it lah kevan dela kim leh begavah la shade zuze bichdi amar leh i mishma la shemia lach missevara let lah kevan deersah la nicha leh detitzil
Siman degavre shak zeraf meana vivama sheniyya arusa vaanusa
Beo mineh merav sheshet memaenet yesh lah mezonot o en lah mezonot
Amar lehu rav sheshet tenetuha almana bevet aviha ugrusha bevet aviha veshomeret yavam bevet aviha yesh lah mezonot rabbi yehuda omer odah bevet aviha yesh lah mezonot enah bevet aviha en lah mezonot
Rabbi yehuda hayenu tanna kamma ella lav memaenet ika benayehu detanna kamma savar it lah verabbi yehuda savar let lah
Bae resh lakish bat yevamah yesh lah mezonot o en lah mezonot
Kevan deamar mar ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon let lah o dilma kevan dei let lah merishon takkinu lah rabbanan mishsheni it lah teku
Bae rabbi elazar bat sheniyya yesh lah mezonot o en lah mezonot

a: Kevan delet lah ketubba let lah mezone o dilma immah daavada isura kansuha rabbanan ihi dela avada isura la kansuha rabbanan teku
Bae rava bat arusa yesh lah mezonot o en lah mezonot kevan deit lah ketubba it lah o dilma kevan dela takkinu rabbanan ketubba ad sheat nisuin let lah teku
Bae rav pappa bat anusa yesh lah mezonot o en lah mezonot alliba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda la tibe lach deamar yesh lah ketubba mane
Ki tibe lach alliba derabbanan deamri yatza kesef kenasah bichtubbatah may
Kevan delet lah ketubba let lah mezone o dilma ketubba tama may kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah veha la matze mappek lah teku
Atte tehe yatva beveti vechu tane rav yosef beveti vela bevikti aval mezone it lah mar bar rav ashe amar afilu mezone name let lah velet hilcheta kemar bar rav ashe

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel tevauha lehinnase venitpayesa en lah mezonot ha lo nitpayesa yesh lah mezonot amar rav anan ledidi mipparsha li mineh demar shemuel amra mechamat peloni bali yesh lah mezonot mechamat bene adam sheenan mehugganin lah en lah mezonot
Amar rav chisda zinta en lah mezonot amar rav yosef kichala ufirkesa en lah mezonot
Man deamar zinta kol shekken kichala ufirkesa man deamar kichala ufirkesa aval zinta it lah may tama yetzer ansah
Velet hilcheta kechol hane shematata ella ki ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel hattovaat ketubbatah bevet din en lah mezonot
Vela vehatanya machra ketubbatah umishkena ketubbatah asta ketubbatah appoteke leacher en lah mezonot hane in aval tovaat la
Hane ben bevet din ben shello bevet din tovaat bevet din in shello bevet din la
Vechach hau anshe yerushalayim vechu ittemar rav amar halacha keanshe yehuda ushmuel amar halacha keanshe galil
Bavel vechol parodeha nehug kerav nehardea vechol parodeha nehug kishmuel hahi bat machoza dahavat nesiva linhardea ato lekammeh derav nachman shamah lekalah devat machoza hi
Amar lehu bavel vechol parodeha nehug kerav amaru leh veha linhardea nesiva amar lehu i hachi nehardea vechol parodeha nehug kishmuel vead hecha nehardea ad hecha desage kabba dinhardea
Itmar almana rav amar shamin ma shealeha ushmuel amar en shamin ma shealeha amar rav chiyya bar avin vechilufah belakit
Rav kahana matne vechen belakit umannach bah simana yatma vearmalta shelach ufok

Amar rav nachman af al gav ditnan bematnitin keoteh dishmuel hilcheta keoteh derav ditnan echad hammakdish nechasav veechad hammaarich et atzmo en lo lo bichsut ishto velo bichsut banav velo betzeva shetztzava lishman velo besandalim chadashim shellakach lishman
Amar leh rava lerav nachman vechi meachar ditnan matnitin keoteh dishmuel ammay hilcheta keoteh derav amar leh lichora kishmuel rehita ki meayenatte bah hilcheta keoteh derav
May tama ki akni lah addata lemekam kammeh addata lemishkal ulmipak la akni lah

Hahu daamar lehu

Kariveh derabbi yochanan hava lehu itat abba dahava kamafseda mezone ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar lehu ezilu veemaru leh laavuchon dinyached lah ara limzonah

Amar rabbi avahu ledidi mipparsha li mineh derabbi yochanan amar limzonot riba lah mezonot amar bimzonot katzatz lah mezonot
Hadaran alach naara

Im ratza lehosif ku ratza lichtov lah la katane ella ratza lehosif mesayya leh lerabbi ayevu amar rabbi yannay deamar rabbi ayevu amar rabbi yannay tenay ketubba kichtubba dame
Nafka minah lemocheret ulmochelet lemoredet

a: Leshevach lishvua velishviit
Ulchotev kol nechasav levanav ligbot min hakkarka umin hazziburit vechol zeman shehi bevet aviha velichtubbat benin dichrin
Itmar ketubbat benin dichrin pumbedita amri la tarfa mimmeshabedi yirtun tenan
Bene mata machseya amri tarfa mimmeshabedi yissevun tenan vehilcheta la tarfa mimmeshabedi yirtun tenan

Letanhu beenayehu pumbedita amri belo shevua bene mata machseya amri bishvua vehilcheta belo shevua
Yached lah ara bearbea mitzraneha bela shevua bechad mitzra pumbedita amri bela shevua bene mata machseya amri bishvua vehilcheta bela shevua
Amar leedim kitvu vechitmu vehavu leh keno mineh la tzerich imloche beh la keno mineh pumbedita amri la tzerich imloche beh bene mata machseya amri tzerich imloche beh vehilcheta tzerich imloche beh
