Tistayyem derabbi natan hu deamar halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya deshaminan leh lerabbi natan deazel batar umdana deamar rabbi natan halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri bimsukkan
b: Uvitrumat maaser shel demay
Verav la azel batar umdana veha itmar mattenat shechiv mera shekkatuv bah kinyan beve rav mishshemeh derav amri arkeveh attere richshe ushmuel amar la yadana may edun bah
Beve rav mishshemeh derav amri arkeveh attere richshe hare hi kemattenat bari vahare hi kemattenat shechiv mera
Hare hi kemattenat bari deim amad eno yachol lachazor bo hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera sheim amar halvaati lifloni halvaato lifloni
Ushmuel amar la yadana may edun bah shemma lo gamar lehaknoto ella bishtar veen shetar leachar mita

a: Ella tarvayehu azli batar umdana
Man deamar halacha shappir man deamar en halacha hacha name umdan data hu mishshum ikarove data hu veha ikarava leh data
Yatev rav chanina kammeh derabbi yannay vekaamar halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya amar leh pok keri keraach levara en halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya
Amar rav yitzchak bar avdimi mishshum rabbenu halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya amar rav nachman amar shemuel halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya

Verav nachman dideh amar en halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya unhardae mishshemeh derav nachman amri halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya veaf al gav delat rav nachman veamar kol dayyana dedaen kerabbi elazar ben azarya hachi vehachi tehve afilu hachi halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya vahalacha lemaase kerabbi elazar ben azarya
Bae ravin nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala mahu chibat chuppa kona o chibat bia kona

Ta shema detane rav yosef shello katav lah ella al chibat layela harishon i amratte bishlama chibat chuppa kona hayenu deamar layela harishon ella i amratte chibat bia kona bia belayela harishon itah mikkan veelach letah
Veella may chuppa chuppa belelya itah bimama letah ultamach bia belelya itah bimama letah ha amar rava im haya bevayit afel muttar ha la kashya orach ara ka mashma lan devia ballayela
Ella chuppa kashya chuppa name la kashya kevan distam chuppa levia kayema orach ara ka mashma lan devallayela
Bae rav ashe nichnesa lechuppa ufersa nida mahu im timtze lomar chibat chuppa kona chuppa dechazya levia aval chuppa dela chazya levia la o dilma la shena teku
Rabbi yehuda omer ratza kotev livtula vechu vesavar rabbi yehuda dechotvin shovar vehatnan mi sheppara miktzat chovo rabbi yehuda omer yachlif rabbi yose omer yichtov lo shovar
Amar rabbi yirmeya kesheshshovartah mittochah

Abbaye amar afilu tema besheen shovartah mittochah bishlama hatam vadday pareh dilma mirchas tavarta umappek leh lishtara vahadar gave zimna acharina hacha vadday yehav lah milta bealma hi daamara leh i natreh natreh i la natreh ihu hu deafsed annafsheh
Bishlama abbaye la amar kerabbi yirmeya la katane shovartah mittochah ella rabbi yirmeya may tama la amar keabbayye gezera shovar dehacha attu shovar dealma
Tama dechatva leh aval al pe la ammay davar shebbemamon hu veshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda deamar davar shebbemamon tenao kayyam
Detanya haomer leishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li al menat sheen lich alay sheer kesut veona hare zo mekuddeshet utnao batel divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer bedavar shebbemamon tenao kayyam
Kasavar rabbi yehuda ketubba derabbanan vachachamim asu chizuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora
Hare perot derabbanan vela avadu lehu rabbanan chizuk ditnan rabbi yehuda omer leolam hu ochel pere ferot ad sheyyichtov lah din udvarim en li binchasayich uvferotehen uvferot perotehen ad olam
b: Vekayema lan may kotev omer

Hare chammarim dishchichi vela avadu lah rabbanan chizuk
Ditnan hachammarin shennichnesu lair veamar echad mehen shelli chadash veshel chaveri yashan shelli eno metukkan veshel chaveri metukkan en neemanim rabbi yehuda omer neemanim
Amar abbaye vadday dedivrehem avadu rabbanan chizuk safek dedivrehem la avadu rabbanan chizuk rava amar bidmay hekelu
Rabbi meir omer kol happochet vechu kol happochet afilu bitnaa alma kasavar tenao batel veit lah vechevan deamar lah let lich ella mane la samcha datah vehaveya lah beilato beilat zenut
Veha shaminan leh lerabbi meir deamar kol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel ha bidrabbanan tenao kayyam kasavar rabbi meir ketubba deorayeta

Tanya rabbi meir omer kol happochet livtula mimmatayim ulalmana mimmane hare zo beilat zenut rabbi yose omer rashshay rabbi yehuda omer ratza kotev livtula shetar shel matayim vehi kotevet lo hitkabbalti mimmecha mane ulalmana mane vehi kotevet lo hitkabbalti mimmecha chamishshim zuz
Vesavar rabbi yose rashshay urminhi en osin ketubbat ishsha mittaltelin mippene tikun haolam amar rabbi yose vechi ma tikun haolam yesh bezo vahalo en ketzuvin ufochatin

Hashta uma hatam dedilma pachati chayesh rabbi yose hacha devadday ka pachata lo kol shekken hachi hashta hatam la yada detachel hacha yada veka machala
Achateh derame bar chama havat nesiva lerav aveya

Aval chachamim omrim meshahe adam et ishto shettayim veshalosh shanim belo ketubba amar leh abbaye veha amar rav nachman amar shemuel halacha kerabbi meir bigzerotav i hachi zil ketov lah

Ta shema bogeret sheshshahata shenem asar chodesh rabbi eliezer omer hoil vechayyav balah bimzonoteha yafer ema bogeret vesheshshahata shenem asar chodesh rabbi eliezer omer hoil vvalah chayyav bimzonoteha yafer

Ta shema hamares et habbetula ben shettevaah habbaal vehi meakkevet uven shettava hi uvaal meakkev notnin lah shenem asar chodesh mishsheat tevia aval lo mishsheat erusin uvagra hare hi kitvua ketzad bagra yom echad venitkaddesha notnin lah shenem asar chodesh velaarusa sheloshim yom teuvta derav huna teuvta
May velaarusa sheloshim yom amar rav pappa hachi kaamar bogeret sheavru aleha shenem asar chodesh bevagrut venitkaddesha notnin lah sheloshim yom kealmana

Higgia zeman velo nisu amar ulla devar tora arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma shenneemar vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo vehay name kinyan kaspo hu ma taam amru enah ochelet shemma yimzegu lah kos bevet aviha vetashke leachiha velaachotah
I hachi higgia zeman velo nisu name hatam duchta meyached lah
Ella meatta lakit kohen leyisrael la lechol bitruma dilma atu lemechal bahadeh hashta middidhu safu leh middideh achli
Rav shemuel bar rav yehuda amar mishshum simpon
I hachi nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala name hatam mivdak badek lah vahadar meayyel

Ella meatta eved kohen shellekacho miyyisrael la lechol bitruma mishshum simpon simpon baavadim leka dei deabbaray ha kachaze leh vei degavay limlacha ka bae veshebbasseter la ichpat leh nimtza gannav o

a: Kuvustus higgio may ika listim mezuyyan o muchtav lammalchut hanhu kala it lehu
Mikkedi ben lemar uven lemar la achla may benayehu ika benayehu kibbel masar vehalach
Rabbi tarfon omer notnin lah hakkol teruma vechu amar abbaye machloket bevat kohen lechohen aval bevat yisrael lechohen divre hakkol mechetza chullin umechetza teruma
Veamar abbaye machloket baarusa aval binsua divre hakkol mechetza chullin umechetza teruma

Tanya name hachi rabbi tarfon omer notnin lah hakkol teruma rabbi akiva omer mechetza chullin umechetza teruma bamme devarim amurim bevat kohen lechohen aval bat yisrael lechohen divre hakkol mechetza chullin umechetza teruma bamme devarim amurim baarusa aval binsua divre hakkol mechetza chullin umechetza teruma

Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer notnin lah shette yadot shel teruma veachat shel chullin rabbi yehuda omer noten lah hakkol teruma vehi mocheret velokachat baddamim chullin rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol makom shehuzkera teruma notnin lah kiflayim bechullin
May benayehu ika benayehu tircha
Hayyavam eno maachil bitruma may tama kinyan kaspo amar rachamana vehay kinyan deachiv hu
Asta shishsha chodashim bifne habbaal hashta bifne habbaal amratte la bifne hayyavam mibaya zo veen tzarich lomar zo katane
Zo mishna rishona ku may tama amar ulla veitema rav shemuel bar yehuda mishshum simpon
Bishlama leulla kammayeta shemma yimzegu lah kos bevet aviha uvatrayeta mishshum simpon
b: Ella lerav shemuel bar yehuda kammayeta mishshum simpon uvatrayeta mishshum simpon may benayehu
Ika benayehu bedikat chutz mar savar bedikat chutz shemah bedika umar savar bedikat chutz lo shemah bedika
Matni hammakdish maase yede ishto hare zo osa veochelet hammotar rabbi meir omer hekdesh rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer chullin
Gema amar rav huna amar rav yechola ishsha lomar levalah eni nizonet veeni osa kasavar ki takkinu rabbanan mezone ikar umaase yadeha mishshum eva vechi amra eni nizonet veeni osa harshut beyadah
Metivi tikkenu mezonot tachat maase yadeha ema tikkenu maase yadeha tachat mezonot
Lema mesayya leh hammakdish maase yede ishto hare hi osa veochelet may lav benizonet la besheenah nizonet

I besheenah nizonet may lememra afilu leman deamar yachol harav lomar laeved ase immi veeni zanach hane mile beeved kenaani dela ketiv beh immach aval eved ivri dichtiv beh immach la vechol shekken ishto
Sefa itzterich leh motar rabbi meir omer hekdesh rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer chullin

Ufliga deresh lakish deamar resh lakish la tema tama derabbi meir mishshum dekasavar adam makdish davar shello ba laolam ella tama derabbi meir mittoch sheyyachol lechuppah lemaase yadeha naasa keomer lah yikdeshu yadayich leosehem
Veha la amar lah hachi kevan deshaminan leh lerabbi meir deamar en adam motzi devarav levattala naase keomer lah yikdeshu yadayich leosehem

Vesavar rabbi meir en adam makdish davar shello ba laolam vehatanya haomer leishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li leachar sheetgayyer o leachar shettitgayeri leachar sheeshtachrer leachar shettishtachreri leachar sheyyamut balich o shettamut achotich o leachar sheyyachlotz lich yevamich rabbi meir omer mekuddeshet
Mehahi in meha leka lemishma minah
Hammotar rabbi meir omer hekdesh emat kadosh rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu motar leachar mita kadosh rav adda bar ahava amar motar mechayyim kadosh
Have bah rav pappa bemay ilema bemaale lah mezonot umaale lah maa kesef litzracheha may tama deman deamar leachar mita kadosh
Veella kesheen maale lah mezonot velo maale lah maa kesef litzracheha may tama deman deamar mechayyim kadosh
Leolam bemaale lah mezonot veeno maale lah maa kesef litzracheha rav ushmuel savri tikkenu

a: Mezonot tachat maase yadeha umaa kesef tachat motar vechevan dela ka yahev lah maa kesef motar didah have rav adda bar ahava savar tikkenu mezonot tachat motar umaa kesef tachat maase yadeha vechevan deka yahev lah mezone motar dideh have
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar mide dishchiach mimmide dishchiach umar savar mide dekiytz mimmide dekiytz
Metivi tikkenu mezonot tachat maase yadeha ema tachat motar maase yadeha
Ta shema im eno noten lah maa kesef litzracheha maase yadeha shellah ema motar maase yadeha shellah veha alah katane ma hi osa lo mishkal chamesh selaim sheti bihuda
Hachi kaamar maase yadeha kamma have delida motar didah kamma mishkal chamesh selaim sheti bihuda shehen eser selaim baggalil
Amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yochanan hassandelar

Umi amar shemuel hachi vehatnan kunam sheani osa leficha eno tzarich lehafer rabbi akiva omer yafer shemma taadif alav yater min harauy lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri amar yafer shemma yegarshenna uthe asura lachazor
Veamar shemuel halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri ki amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri lehadafa
Velema halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri lehadafa i name en halacha ketanna kamma i name halacha kerabbi akiva
Ella amar rav yosef kunamot kaamratte shane kunamot mittoch sheadam oser perot chavero alav adam makdish davar shello ba laolam
Amar leh abbaye bishlama adam oser perot chavero alav shekken adam oser perotav al chavero yeesor davar shello ba leolam al chavero shekken en adam oser perot chavero al chavero
Ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua beomeret yikdeshu yaday leosehem deyadayim itanhu baolam
Vechi kaamra hachi mi makdesha ha meshabeda leh deamra lechi migarsha
Umi ika mide deilu hashta la kaddish ulkammeh kaddish amar rabbi ilay allema la ilu haomer lachavero sade zo sheani mocher lecha lichsheekkachenna mimmecha tikdash mi la kadsha

Matkef lah rabbi yirmeya mi dame hatam beyado lehakdishah hacha en beyadah legaresh et atzmah ha la damya ella laomer lachavero sade zo shemmacharti lecha lichsheekkachenna mimmecha tikdash dela kadsha
Matkef lah rav pappa mi dame hatam gufa uferot bida delokeach hacha gufah bidah hu ha la damya ella laomer lachavero
b: Sade zo shemmishkanti lecha lichsheefdenna mimmecha tikdash dekadsha

Matkef lah rav shisha bereh derav idi mi dame hatam beyado lifdotah hacha en beyadah legaresh atzmah ha la damya ella laomer lachavero sade zo shemmishkanti lecha leeser shanim lichsheefdenna mimmecha tikdash dekadsha
Matkef lah rav ashe mi dame hatam leeser shanim miha beyado lifdotah hacha en beyadah legaresh atzmah leolam
Ella amar rav ashe kunnamot ka amratte shane kunnamot dikdushshat hagguf ninhu vechidrava deamar rava hekdesh chametz veshichrur mafkiin mide shibud
Venikdeshu mehashta allemuha rabbanan leshibudeh devaal ki hechi dela tikdash mehashta

Matni veellu melachot shehaishsha osa levalah tochenet veofa umchabbeset mevashshelet umnika et benah matztzaat lo hammitta veosa batztzemer hichnisa lo shifcha achat lo tochenet velo ofa velo mechabbeset shettayim en mevashshelet veen menika et benah shalosh en matztzaat lo hammitta veen osa batztzemer arba yoshevet bekatedra

Rabbi eliezer omer afilu hichnisa lo mea shefachot kofah laasot batztzemer shehabbattala mevia lide zima rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af hammaddir et ishto millaasot melacha yotzi veyitten ketubba shehabbattala mevia lide shiamum
Gema tochenet salka datach ella ema matchenet veibaet ema berichya dida

Matnitin dela kerabbi chiyya detane rabbi chiyya en ishsha ella leofi en ishsha ella levanim vetane rabbi chiyya en ishsha ella letachshite ishsha vetane rabbi chiyya harotze sheyeadden et ishto yalbishenna kele fishtan harotze sheyyalbin et bitto yaachilenna efrochim veyashkenna chalav samuch lefirkah

Umnika et benah lema matnitin dela kevet shammay detanya nadra shello lehanik et benah bet shammay omrim shometet dad mippiv bet hillel omrim kofah umnikato nitgarsha eno kofah veim haya makkirah noten lah secharah vechofah umnikato mippene hassakkana
Afilu tema bet shammay hacha bemay askinan kegon shennadra hi vekiyyem lah hu vekasavri bet shammay hu noten etzba ben shineha uvet hillel savri hi natna etzba ben shineha
Veniflegu bichtubba bealma veod tanya bet shammay omrim enah menika ella mechavarta matnitin dela kevet shammay
Im haya makkirah

a: Ad kamma amar rava amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav shelosha chodashim ushmuel amar sheloshim yom verabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan chamishshim yom amar rav shimi bar abbaye halacha kerabbi yitzchak sheamar mishshum rabbi yochanan bishlama rav verabbi yochanan kol chad vechad ki churpeh ella lishmuel ki hay gavena mi mashkachatte lah
Ki ata rame bar yechezkel amar la tetzitinhu lehane kelale dechayel yehuda achi mishshemeh dishmuel hachi amar shemuel kol zeman shemmakkirah

Hahi daatay lekammeh dishmuel amar leh lerav dimi bar yosef zil bidkeh azal otvah bedare dinshe veshakleh livrah vekamhaddar leh alayehu ki meta legabbah havat ka mesave leappah kevashtinhi leenah mineh amar lah netof enich kum deray berich some mena yada amar rav ashe berecha uvtama

Tanu rabbanan yonek tinok veholech ad esrim vearbaa chodesh mikkan veelach keonek sheketz divre rabbi eliezer rabbi yehoshua omer afilu arba vechamesh shanim perash leachar esrim vearbaa chodesh vechazar keonek sheketz

Amar mar mikkan veelach keonek sheketz urminhi yachol yehe chalev mehalleche shettayim tame vedin hu uma behema shehekalta bemaggaah hechmarta bachalavah adam shehechmarta bemaggao eno din shettachmir bachalavo

Talmud lomar et haggamal ki maale gera hu hu tame veen chalev mehalleche shettayim tame ella tahor yachol otzi et hechalav sheeno shave bakkol velo otzi et haddam shehu shave bakkol talmud lomar hu hu tame veen dam mehalleche shettayim tame ella tahor
Veamar rav sheshet afilu mitzvat perisha en bo
La kashya ha defaresh ha dela paresh
Vechilufah bedam kidtanya dam sheal gabbe kikkar gorro veochlo shebben hashshinayim motztzo veeno choshesh
Amar mar rabbi yehoshua omer afilu arba vechamesh shanim vehatanya rabbi yehoshua omer afilu chavilato al ketefav ide veide chad shiura hu amar rav yosef halacha kerabbi yehoshua
Tanya rabbi marinus omer goneach yonek chalav beshabbat may tama yonek mefarek kilachar yad uvimkom tzaara la gezaru rabbanan amar rav yosef halacha kerabbi marinus

Tanya nachum ish galya omer tzinor shealu bo kashkashshin memaachan beraglo betzina beshabbat veeno choshesh may tama metakken kilachar yad hu uvimkom peseda la gezaru bah rabbanan amar rav yosef halacha kenachum ish galya
Perash leachar esrim vearbaa chodesh vechazar keonek sheketz vechamma amar rav yehuda bar chaviva amar shemuel shelosha yamim ika deamri tane rav yehuda bar chaviva kammeh dishmuel shelosha yamim
Tanu rabbanan meneket shemmet balah betoch esrim vearbaa chodesh hare zo lo titares velo tinase
b: Ad esrim vearbaa chodesh divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda mattir bishmona asar chodesh amar rabbi natan bar yosef hen hen divre bet shammay hen hen divre bet hillel shebbet shammay omrim esrim vearbaa chodesh uvet hillel omrim shemona asar chodesh

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel ani achria ledivre haomer esrim vearbaa chodesh mutteret linase beesrim veechad chodesh ledivre haomer bishmona asar chodesh mutteret lehinnase bachamishsha asar chodesh lefi sheen hechalav nekar ella leachar shelosha chodashim

Amar ulla halacha kerabbi yehuda veamar mar ukva li hittir rabbi chanina laset leachar chamishsha asar chodesh ariseh deabbaye ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh mahu leares bachamishsha asar chodesh amar leh chada derabbi meir verabbi yehuda halacha kerabbi yehuda veod bet shammay uvet hillel halacha kevet hillel veamar ulla halacha kerabbi yehuda veamar mar ukva li hittir rabbi chanina laset leachar chamishsha asar chodesh kol shekken deatte leares

Ki ata lekammeh derav yosef amar leh rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu tzericha lehamtin esrim vearbaa chodesh chutz miyyom shennolad bo vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo rehat batreh telata parse veamri lah parsa bechala vela adrecheh

Amar abbaye hay milta daamur rabbanan afilu beata bechuttacha la lishre inish bimkom rabbeh la mishshum demichaze keafkiruta ella mishshum dela mistayea milta lememra deha ana hava gemirna leh leha derav ushmuel afilu hachi la mistayea li milta lememar

Tanu rabbanan natna benah lemeneket o gemalattu o met mutteret linase miyyad rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua sevur lemibad ovada ki ha matnita amara lehu hahi savta bedidi hava ovada vaasar li rav nachman
Ini veha rav nachman shera lehu leve resh galuta shane be resh galuta dela hadri behu

Amar lehu rav pappe veattun la tisberuha meha detanya hare shehayeta redufa lelech levet aviha o shehaya lah kaas bevet balah o shehaya balah chavush bevet haasurin o shehalach balah limdinat hayyam o shehaya balah zaken o chole o shehayeta akara uzkena ayelonit uktanna vehammappelet achar mitat balah vesheenah reuya leled kullan tzerichot lehamtin shelosha chodashim divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yose mattir leares velinase miyyad veamar rav nachman amar shemuel halacha kerabbi meir bigzerotav

Amri leh lav addatin vehilcheta met muttar gemalattu asur mar bar rav ashe amar afilu met name asur dilma katla leh veazla uminasva hava ovada vachanakteh vela hi hahi shota havay dela avdi neshe dechankan benayehu
Tanu rabbanan hare shennatnu lah ben lehanik hare zo lo tanik immo lo benah velo ben chavertah paska kima ochelet harbe lo tochal immo devarim haraim lechalav
Hashta benah amratte la ben chavertah mibaya mahu detema benah hu dechayesa ilaveh mamtzeya leh tefe aval ben chavertah i lav dahava lah motar la hava mamtzeya leh ka mashma lan
Paska kima ochelet harbe mehecha amar rav sheshet mishshellah

Lo tochal immo devarim haraim may ninhu amar rav kahana kegon keshut vachaziz vedagim ketannim vaadama abbaye amar afilu kara vachavusha rav pappa amar afilu kora vechufra rav ashe amar afilu kamka veharsana minayehu paski chalava minayehu achri chalava

Dimshammesha be richya hau lah bene nichpe dimshammesha al ara hau lah bene shemute dedarcha al rema dema dachamara hau lah bene girdane deachla chardela hau lah bene zalzelane deachla tachle hau lah bene dulfane deachla monine hau lah bene metzitze ena deachla gargushta hau lah bene mechoare deshatya shichra hau lah bene ukkame deachla bisra veshatya chamra hau lah bene

a: Barye deachla bee hau lah bene enane deachla keore hau lah bene chinane deachla karpesa hau lah bene zivetane deachla kusbarta hau lah bene bisrane deachla etroga hau lah bene rechane beratte deshabbur malka achala bah amma etroga vahao masseki lah lekammeh avuh beresh rechane

Amar rav huna bedak lan rav huna bar chinana hi omeret lehanik vehu omer shello lehanik shomin lah tzaara didah hu hu omer lehanik vehi omeret shello lehanik mahu kol hecha delav orchah shomin lah hi orchah vehu lav orcheh may batar dideh azlinan o batar didah azlinan

Ufashetna leh meha ola immo veenah yoredet immo amar rav huna may keraa vehi beulat baal baaliyyato shel baal velo biridato shel baal rabbi elazar amar mehacha ki hi hayeta em kol chay lechayyim nitna velo letzaar nitna
Hichnisa lo shifcha vechu ha sheara avda vetema leh ayyelit lach itta bacharikay mishshum deamar lah ha tarcha ledidi uldidah kamme didach man tarach

Shettayim enah mevashshelet veenah menika vechu ha sheara avda vetema leh ayyelit lach itta achariti detarcha ledidi uldidah vachada ledidach uldidah mishshum deamar lah kamme orche ufarche man tarach
Shalosh enah matztzaat hammitta ha sheara avda vetema leh ayyelit lach achariti leorche ufarche mishshum deamar lah nefish bene veta nefish orche ufarche
I hachi afilu arba name arba kevan dinfishi lehu mesayean ahadade
Amar rav chana veitema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani lo hichnisa lo mammash ella kevan sheruya lehachnis af al pi shello hichnisa tana echad shehichnisa lo veechad shetztzimtzema lo mishshellah
Arba yoshevet bekatedra amar rav yitzchak bar chananya amar rav huna af al pi sheamru yoshevet bekatedra aval mozeget lo kos umatztzaat lo et hammitta vmarchetzet lo panav yadav veraglav
Amar rav yitzchak bar chananya amar rav huna kol melachot shehaishsha osa levalah nidda osa levalah chutz mimmezigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta veharchatzat panav yadav veraglav

Vehatztzaat hammitta amar rava la amaran ella befanav aval shello befanav let lan bah umzigat hakkos shemuel mechallefa leh devethu bida dismala abbaye mannecha leh appumma dechubba rava abbe sadya rav pappa ashsharshifa

Amar rav yitzchak bar chananya amar rav huna hakkol meshahin bifne hashshammash chutz mibbasar veyayin amar rav chisda basar shamen veyayin yashan amar rava basar shamen kol hashshana kullah yayin yashan bitkufat tammuz

Amar rav anan bar tachlifa hava kaemna kammeh demar shemuel veayeto leh tavshila dearde vei lav dihav li istakkani amar rav ashe hava kaemna kammeh derav kahana veayeto leh gargelide delifta bechalla vei lav dihav li istakkani rav pappa amar afilu temarta dahanunita kelala demilta kol deit leh recha veit leh kiyyuha
Avuh bar ihi uminyamin bar ihi chad safe mikkol mina umina vechad safe mechad mina mar mishtae eliyyahu bahadeh umar la mishtae eliyyahu bahadeh
Hanhu tarten chaside veamri lah rav mari verav pinchas bene rav chisda mar kadem safe umar meachar safe dekadem safe eliyyahu mishtae bahadeh dimachar safe la mishtae eliyyahu bahadeh
Ammemar umar zutra verav ashe hau ka yatvi appitcha deve izgur malka chalef veazel aturanga demalka chazyeh rav ashe lemar zutra
b: Dachavar appeh shekal beetzbateh annach leh befummeh amar leh afsadte lisodta demalka amaru leh ammay tibed hachi amar lehu man deaved hachi pesil lemaachal demalka amaru leh ammay amar lehu davar acher chazay beh bedaku vela ashkachu shekal etzbateh annach aleh amar lehu hacha mi badkitu bedaku ashkachu amaru leh rabbanan may tama samchatte annisa amar lehu chazay ruach tzaraat deka farcha ilaveh

Hahu romaa daamar lah lehahi itta minasvat li amara leh la azal ayeti rumane palli vaachal kammah kol mayya detzaari lah belateh vela hav lah ad dezag lah lesof amar lah i massena lach minasvat li amara leh in azal ayeti rumane palli vaachal kammah amar lah kol mayya detzaari lich tuf sheday tuf sheday ad denafka minah ki hutza yarka veittesiat

Veosa batztzemer betzemer in befishtim la matnitin manni rabbi yehuda hi detanya eno kofah lo laamod lifne aviv velo laamod lifne veno velo liten teven lifne vehemto aval kofah liten teven lifne vekaro rabbi yehuda omer af eno kofah laasot befishtan mippene sheppishtan masriach et happe umsharbet et hassefatayim vehane mile bechitana romaa
Rabbi eliezer omer afilu hichnisa lo mea shefachot amar rav malkiyyo amar rav adda bar ahava halacha kerabbi eliezer
Amar rabbi chanina bereh derav ika shappud shefachot vegumot rav malkiyyo
Belorit efer mikle ugvina rav malkiyya
Rav pappa amar matnitin umatnita rav malkiyya shematata rav malkiyyo vesimanach matnita malketa may benayehu ika benayehu shefachot
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechu hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu demitallela beguryata kitanyata venadreshir
Matni hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta bet shammay omrim shette shabbatot bet hillel omrim shabbat achat

Hattalmidim yotzin letalmud tora shello birshut sheloshim yom happoalim shabbat achat haona haamura battora hattayyalin bechol yom happoalim shettayim beshabbat hachammarim achat beshabbat haggammalim achat lishloshim yom hassappanim achat leshishsha chodashim divre rabbi eliezer
Gema may tama devet shammay gamri miyyoledet nekeva uvet hillel gamri miyyoledet zachar
Uvet hillel name nigmeru miyyoledet nekeva i miyyoledet gamri lah hachi name ella bet hillel minnidda gamri lah
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar mide dishchiach mimmide dishchiach umar savar mide dehu garem lah mimmide dehu garem lah

Hammaddir et ishto millehanot lo ad sheloshim yom yaamid parnas yater miken yotzi veyitten ketubba

Hammaddir et ishto shello titkashshet beechad mikkol hamminin yotzi veyitten ketubba rabbi yose omer baaniyyut shello natan kitzva uvaashirut sheloshim yom
Gema vechevan dimshubad lah hechi matze maddir lah kal kemineh demafka lah leshibudah
Vehatnan kunam sheeni osa leficha eno tzarich lehafer alma kevan dimshabeda leh lav kal keminah demafka leh leshibudeh hacha name kevan dimshubad lah lav kal kemineh demafka lah leshibudah

b: Naasa keomer lah tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich veim itah leha derav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav yechola ishsha shettomar levalah eni nizonet veeni osa kunnam sheani osa leficha ammay eno tzarich lehafer lema mittoch sheyechola lomar eni nizonet veeni osa naase kemi sheomeret lo eni nizonet veeni osa

Umay shena ad sheloshim yom ad sheloshim yom lo shami bah inashe vela zila bah milta tefe shami bah inashe vezila bah milta
Ibaet ema shehiddirah keshehi arusa arusa mi it lah mezone shehiggia zeman velo nisseu ditnan higgia zeman velo nisseu ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma
Umay shena ad sheloshim yom ad sheloshim yom aved shaliach shelichuteh tefe la aved shaliach shelichuteh
Veibaet ema shehiddirah keshehi arusa veniset niset ha sevara vekabbila deamra kisvura ani sheani yechola lekabbel achshav en ani yechola lekabbel
Emar deamrinan hachi gabbe mumin leinyan mezone mi amrinan hachi ella mechavarta kidshanninan meikara
Ad sheloshim yom yaamid parnas ufarnas lav shelichuteh ka aved amar rav huna beomer kol hazzan eno mafsid
Vechi amar hachi lav shelichuteh kaaved vehatnan mi shehaya mushlach bevor veamar kol hashshomea kolo yichtov get leishto hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu
Hachi hashta hatam kaamar yichtov hacha mi kaamar yazun kol hazzan kaamar
Veha amar rabbi amme bidleka hittiru lomar kol hamchabbe eno mafsid bidleka lemaote may lav lemaote ki hay gavena la lemaote shear isurim deshabbat

La mibaya kaamar la mibaya kol hazzan eno mafsid dilalma kaamar aval hay kevan deragil etzlo vekaazel kaamar leh keman deamar leh zil hav leh atte dame ka mashma lan

a: Maase devet choron
Rabbi yehuda omer beyisrael chodesh echad vechu hayenu tanna kamma amar abbaye kohenet ata leashmoinan rava amar chodesh male vechodesh chaser ika benayehu
Amar rav lo shanu ella bimfaresh aval bistam yotzi lealtar veyitten ketubba ushmuel amar afilu bistam lo yotzi shemma yimtza petach lenidro

Veha ipligu bah chada zimna ditnan hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta bet shammay omrim shette shabbatot uvet hillel omrim shabbat achat veamar rav machloket bimfaresh aval bistam yotzi lealtar veyitten ketubba ushmuel amar afilu bistam name lo yotzi shemma yimtza petach lenidro

Tenan hammaddir et ishto shello titom echad mikkol happerot yotzi veyitten ketubba bishlama lerav kan bistam kan bimfaresh ella lishmuel kashya
Hacha bemay askinan kegon shennadra hi vekiyyem lah ihu vekasavar rabbi meir hu noten etzba ben shineha

Vesavar rabbi meir hu noten etzba ben shineha vehatanya haishsha shennadra benazir veshama balah velo hefer lah rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim hi natna etzba ben shineha lefichach im ratza habbaal lehafer yafer veim amar i efshi beishsha nadranit tetze shello bichtubba

Rabbi yose verabbi elazar omrim hu noten etzba ben shineha lefichach im ratza habbaal lehafer yafer veim amar i efshi beishsha nadranit yotzi veyitten ketubba efoch rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim hu noten rabbi yose verabbi elazar omrim hi natna
Vesavar rabbi yose hi natna vehatnan rabbi yose omer baaniyyut shello natan kitzva
Ema rabbi meir verabbi yose omrim hu noten rabbi yehuda verabbi elazar omrim hi natna vesavar rabbi yehuda hi natna vehatnan rabbi yehuda omer beyisrael yom echad yekayyem

Ema rabbi meir verabbi yehuda verabbi yose omrim hu noten verabbi elazar omer hi natna veim timtza lomar zuge zuge katane ema rabbi meir verabbi elazar omrim hi natna rabbi yehuda verabbi yose omrim hu noten veha setama dela kerabbi meir

Vesavar rabbi yose baaniyyut shello natan kitzva alma baal matze mefar urminhu ellu devarim shehabbaal mefer devarim sheyyesh bahen inuy nefesh im erchatz im lo erchatz im etkashshet im lo etkashshet amar rabbi yose en ellu nidre inuy nefesh veellu hen nidre inuy nefesh shello ochal basar veshello eshte yayin veshello etkashshet
b: Bevigde tzivonin hacha bemay askinan bidvarim shebbeno levenah

Deamar rav kahana hanaat tashmishi alecha kofah umshammashto hanaat tashmishcha alay yafer lefi sheen maachilin laadam davar haasur lo

Hammaddir et ishto shello telech levet haevel o levet hammishte yotzi veyitten ketubba mippene shennoel befaneha veim haya toen mishshum davar acher rashshay
Amar lah al menat shettomri lifloni ma sheamarta li o ma sheamarti lach o shettehe memallea umara laashpa yotzi veyitten ketubba
Gema ha gufah kashya amratte regel echad yekayyem ha shenayim yotzi veyitten ketubba ema sefa shelosha yotzi veyitten ketubba ha shenayim yekayyem

a: Ika noel befaneha ella levet haevel may noel befaneha ika tana lemachar hi meta veen kol beriyya sofdah veika deamri en kol beriyya sofnah

Veim amar lah al menat shettomri vetema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel devarim shel kalon
O shettehe memallea umara leashpa vetibed amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shettemalle venofetzet bematnita tanna shettemalle asara kadde mayim utare leashpa
Bishlama lishmuel mishshum hachi yotzi veyitten ketubba ella lematnita may nafka lah minah tibed amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mippene shennirita keshote
Amar rav kahana hammaddir et ishto shello tishal veshello tashil nafa uchvara verechayim vetannur yotzi veyitten ketubba shemmassiah shem ra bishchenoteha

Matni veellu yotzot shello bichtubba haoveret al dat moshe vihudit veezo hi dat moshe maachilato sheeno meussar umshammashto nidda velo kotza lah challa venoderet veenah mekayyemet

Veezohi dat yehudit yotza veroshah parua vetove beshuk umdabberet im kal adam abba shaul omer af hamkallelet yoldav befanav rabbi tarfon omer af hakkolanit veezohi kolanit lichshehi medabberet betoch betah ushcheneha shomin kolah
Gema maachilato sheeno meussar hechi dame i deyada nifrosh i dela yada mena yada la tzericha deamra leh peloni kohen tiken li et hakkeri veazel shayeleh veishtechach shikra

La tzericha deamra leh peloni chacham tiher li et haddam vaazal shayeleh veishtechach shikra veibaet ema kidrav yehuda deamar rav yehuda huchzeka nidda bishchenoteha balah loke aleha mishshum nidda
Velo kotza lah challa hechi dame i deyada nifrosh i dela yada mena yada la tzericha deamra leh peloni gabbal tiken li et haisa veazel shayeleh veishtechach shikra

Veezohi dat yehudit yotza veroshah parua roshah parua deorayeta hi dichtiv ufara et rosh haishsha vetana deve rabbi yishmael azhara livnot yisrael shello yetzu bifrua rosh deorayeta

b: La kidsha setam uchnasah setam

Hachi name kaamar hamkaddesh et haishsha al menat sheen aleha nedarim uchnasah setam venimtzeu aleha nedarim enah mekuddeshet kidsha setam uchnasah setam tetze shello bichtubba
Ketubba hu dela baaya ha gita baaya umay shena ketubba dela baaya deamar i efshi beishsha nadranit i hachi get name la tibe
Amar rabba tzericha get middivrehem vechen amar rav chisda tzericha get middivrehem rava amar tanna sappoke mesappeka leh gabbe mamona lekulla gabbe isura lechumra
Amar rabba machloket betaut shette nashim aval betaut ishsha achat divre hakkol en tzericha hemennu get
Amar leh abbaye veha matnitin detaut ishsha achat hi vekamotvinan teuvta minah
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar amar rabba machloket betaut ishsha achat keen shette nashim aval betaut ishsha achat geredta divre hakkol enah tzericha hemennu get

Veha hacha detaut ishsha achat hi ufligi may lav taut nedarim

a: Velo hikkum bene yisrael ki nishbeu lahem nesie haeda vechamma rabbim rav nachman bar yitzchak amar shelosha yamim shenayim rabbim shelosha rabbi yitzchak amar asara eda ketiv behu

Ihi bechol dehu nicha lah kidresh lakish deamar resh lakish tav lemetav tan du millemetav armelu abbaye amar deshumshemana gavra kurseyah be charata rame lah
Rav pappa amar denappasa gavra tikreyeh besipe vava vetetiv rav ashe amar dekallasa gavra la baaya telafche lekidra tana vechullan mezannot vetolot bevalehen

Rav ashe amar zea ammezoham ka ramet hatam gabbe kohanim efshar leabborah bekiyyuha dechamra umereach happe name efshar denaket pilpela befummeh veaved avoda aval gabbe ishsha la efshar

Verav en adam dar im nachash bichfifa ki selek rabbi zera ashkecheh lerabbi binyamin bar yefet deyatev vekaamar lah mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amar leh al da akkesuh searin leelazar bevavel

a: Haishsha shennaflu lah nechasim ad shello titares modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret venotenet vekayyam naflu lah mishshennitarsa bet shammay omrim timkor uvet hillel omrim lo timkor ellu vaellu modim sheim machra venatna kayyam
Amar rabbi yehuda amru chachamim lifne rabban gamliel hoil vezacha baishsha lo yizke bannechasim amar lahem al hachadashim anu boshim ella sheattem megalgelin alenu et hayeshanim

Naflu lah mishshennisset ellu veellu modim sheim machra venatna shehabbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot ad shello nisset venisset rabban gamliel omer im machra venatna kayyam amar rabbi chanina ben akavya amru lifne rabban gamliel hoil vezacha baishsha lo yizke bannechasim amar lahem al hachadashim anu boshim ella sheattem megalgelin alenu hayeshanim
Rabbi shimon cholek ben nechasim linchasim nechasim hayeduin labbaal lo timkor veim machra venatna batel sheenan yeduin labbaal lo timkor veim machra venatna kayyam
Gema may shena resha dela peligi umay shena sefa difligi

Amar rabbi yehuda amru lifne rabban gamliel ibaya lehu rabbi yehuda allechattechilla o addiavad
b: Ta shema detanya amar rabbi yehuda amru lifne rabban gamliel hoil vezo ishto vezo ishto zo michrah batel af zo michrah batel amar lahen al hachadashim anu boshim ella sheattem megalgelim alenu et hayeshanim shema minah diavad kaamar shema minah

Tanya amar rabbi chanina ben akavya lo kach heshivan rabban gamliel lachachamim ella kach heshivan lo im amartem binsua shekken balah zakkay bimtziatah uvmaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha tomru baarusa sheen balah zakkay lo bimtziatah velo bemaase yadeha velo bahafarat nedareha

Mishshenniset ellu veellu modim lema tenena letakkanat usha deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina beusha hitkinu haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah umeta habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot
Matnitin bechayyeha ulferot takkanat usha begufah shel karka ulachar mita

Rabbi shimon cholek ben nechasim ellu hen yeduin veellu hen sheenan yeduin amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina yeduin mekarkee sheenan yeduin mittaltelin verabbi yochanan amar ellu vaellu yeduin hen veellu hen sheenan yeduin kol sheyyoshevet kan venaflu lah nechasim bimdinat hayyam
Tanya name hachi ellu hen sheenan yeduin kol sheyyoshevet kan venaflu lah nechasim bimdinat hayyam
Hahi itta devaaya detavrechinhu lenichsah miggavrah ketavtinhu livrattah insiva veigarasha

a: Atay lekammeh derav nachman kareh rav nachman lishtara azal rav anan lekammeh demar ukva amar leh chazi mar nachman chaklaa hechi mekara shetare deinashe amar leh ema li izi gufa deovada hechi hava
Amar leh hachi vehachi hava amar leh shetar mavrachat ka amratte hachi amar rav chanilay bar idi amar shemuel more horaa ani im yavo shetar mavrachat leyadi ekraennu
Amar leh rava lerav nachman tama may dela shavek inish nafsheh veyahev leacharine hane mile leacharine aval livrattah yahava afilu hachi bimkom berattah nafshah adifa lah
Metivi harotza shettavriach nechaseha mibbalah ketzad hi osa kotevet shetar passim laacherim divre rabban shimon ben gamliel
Vachachamim omrim ratza metzachek bah ad shettichtov lo mehayyom velichsheertze
Tama dechatva leh hachi ha la katva leh hachi kenanhi lokeach
Amar rabbi zera la kashya ha bechullah ha bemiktzatah
Vei la kenanhi lokeach nikninhu baal amar abbaye asaum kinchasim sheen yeduin labbaal vealliba derabbi shimon
Matni naflu lah kesafim yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot perot hattelushin min hakkarka yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot

Perot hamchubbarim bakkarka amar rabbi meir shamin otah kamma hi yafa beferot vechamma hi yafa belo perot umotar yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot vachachamim omrim hamchubbarim lakkarka shello vehattelushin min hakkarka shellah veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot

Rabbi shimon omer mekom sheyyippa kocho bichnisatah hora kocho bitziatah mekom shehora kocho bichnisatah yippa kocho bitziatah ketzad perot hamchubbarim lakkarka bichnisatah shello uvitziatah shellah vehattelushin min hakkarka bichnisatah shellah uvitziatah shello
Gema peshita ara uvatte ara batte vedikle batte dikle veilane dikle ilane vegufne ilane
Ibba zardeta ufira dechavere amri lah pera veamri lah karna kelala demilta gizo machlif pera en gizo machlif karna
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi oshaya amar rabbi yannay veamri lah amar rabbi abba amar rabbi oshaya amar rabbi yannay haggonev
b: Velad behemat melog meshallem tashlume chefel laishsha
Keman la kerabbanan vela kachananya detanya velad behemat melog levaal velad shifchat melog laishsha vachananya ben achi yoshiyya amar asu velad shifchat melog kivelad behemat melog
Afilu tema divre hakkol pera takkinu le rabbanan pera defera la takkinu le rabbanan
Bishlama lachananya hayenu dela chayeshinan lemita
Ella rabbanan i chayeshi lemita afilu velad behemat melog name la vei la chayeshi lemita afilu velad shifchat melog name
Leolam chayeshi lemita veshane behema deika orah

Amar rav huna bar chiyya amar shemuel halacha kachananya amar rava amar rav nachman af al gav deamar shemuel halacha kachananya mode chananya sheim nitgarsha notenet damim venotaltan mippene shevach bet aviha

Amar rava amar rav nachman hichnisa lo ez lachalavah verachel legizatah vetarnegolet levetzatah vedekel leferotav ochel veholech ad shettichle hakkeren amar rav nachman ayyila leh gelima pera have mikkasse beh veazel ad dechalya
Keman ki hay tanna detanya hammelach vehachol hare ze perot pir shel gofrit machporet shel tzarif rabbi meir omer keren vachachamim omrim perot
Rabbi shimon omer makom sheyyippa kocho rabbi shimon hayenu tanna kamma amar rava mechubbarin bishat yetzia ika benayehu

Matni naflu lah avadim ushfachot zekenim yimmachru veyillakach mehen karka vehu ochel perot rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo timkor mippene shehen shevach bet aviha naflu lah zetim ugfanim zekenim yimmachru veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot rabbi yehuda omer lo timkor mippene shehen shevach bet aviha
Gema amar rav kahana amar rav machloket shennaflu besade shellah aval besade sheenah shellah divre hakkol timkor mishshum deka chalya karna

Matkef lah rav yosef hare avadim ushfachot dechi sade sheenah shellah dame ufligi ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav kahana amar rav machaloket besade sheenah shellah aval besade shellah divre hakkol lo timkor mippene shevach bet aviha
Matni hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto hotzi harbe veachal kima kima veachal harbe ma shehotzi hotzi uma sheachal achal hotzi velo achal yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol
Gema vechamma kima amar rabbi assi afilu gerogeret achat vehu sheachalah derech kavod amar

a: Rabbi abba amri be rav afilu shigra detamre bae rav bivi chuvtza detamre may teku
La achla derech kavod may amar ulla peligi bah tere amorae bemareva chad amar bichisar vechad amar bichdinar
Amri dayyane defumbedita avad rav yehuda ovada bachavile zemorot rav yehuda letameh deamar rav yehuda achalah orla sheviit vechilayim hare zo chazaka
Amar rav yaakov amar rav chisda hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto ketanna kemotzi al nichse acher dame may tama avadu bah rabbanan takkanta ki hechi dela nifsedinhu

Hahi itta dinfalu lah arba mea zuze be chozae azal gavra appek shet mea ayetay arba mea bahade dekaate itzterich leh chad zuza ushkal minnayehu ata lekammeh derabbi amme amar leh ma shehotzi hotzi uma sheachal achal
Amaru leh rabbanan lerabbi amme hane mile hecha dekaachel pera ha karna kaachel vehotzaa hi im ken have leh hotzi velo achal yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol
Yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol amar rabbi assi vehu sheyyesh shevach keneged hotzaa lemay hilcheta amar abbaye sheim haya shevach yater al hotzaa notel et hahotzaa belo shevua
Amar leh rava im ken ate leiarome ella amar rava sheim hayeta hotzaa yetera al hashshevach en lo ella hotzaa shiur shevach uvishvua
Ibaya lehu baal shehorid arisin tachtav mahu addata devaal nachet istallak leh baal istallaku lehu o dilma addata deara nachet veara ki kayema laarise kayema
Matkef lah rava bar rav chanan may shena mehayyored letoch sede chavero untaah shello birshut shamin lo veyado al hattachtona
Hatam leka inish detarach hacha ika baal detarach
May have alah amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chazenan i baal aris hu istallak leh baal istallaku lehu i baal lav aris hu ara laarise kayema
Ibaya lehu baal shemmachar karka leferot mahu mi amrinan may dekane lah akni o dilma ki takkinu le rabbanan perot levaal
b: Mishshum revach beta aval lezabbone la yehuda mar bar marimar mishshemeh derava amar ma sheasa asuy rav pappa amar mishshemeh derava lo asa velo chelum
Amar rav pappa ha dihuda mar bar marimar lav beferush ittemar ella mikkelala ittemar dehahi itta deayyila leh legavra tarte amhata azal gavra nesev itta achariti ayyel lah chada minnayehu
Atay lekammeh derava tzevacha la ashgach bah man dachaza savar mishshum desavar ma sheasa asuy vela hi mishshum revach beta veha ka ravach
Vehilcheta baal shemmachar karka leferot lo asa velo kelum may tama abbaye amar chayeshinan shemma tachsif rava amar mishshum revach beta
May benayehu ika benayehu ara dimkarva lemata i name baal aris hu i name zuze veka aved behu iska
Matni shomeret yavam shennaflu lah nechasim modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret venotenet vekayyam

Meta ma yaasu bichtubbatah uvinchasim hannichnasin vehayyotzin immah bet shammay omrim yachleku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav uvet hillel omrim nechasim bechezkatan uchtubba bechezkat yorshe habbaal nechasim hannichnasim vehayyotzim immah bechezkat yorshe haav
Hinniach achiv maot yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot perot hattelushin min hakkarka yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot
Hamchubbarin bakkarka amar rabbi meir shamin otan kamma hen yafin beferot vechamma hen yafin belo perot vehammotar yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot
Vachachamim omrim perot hamchubbarin bakkarka shello hattelushin min hakkarka kol hakkodem zacha bahen kadam hu zacha kadma hi yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot
Kenasah hare hi keishto lechol davar bilvad shettehe ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon

Lo yomar lah hare ketubbatich munnachat al hashshulchan ella kol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah vechen lo yomar adam leishto hare ketubbatich munnachat al hashshulchan ella kol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah
Gershah en lah ella ketubba hechzira hare hi kechol hannashim veen lah ella ketubba bilvad

Gema ibaya lehu shomeret yavam shemmeta mi kovrah yorshe habbaal kavri lah deka yarti ketubba o dilma yorshe haav kavri lah deka yarti nechasim hannichnasin vehayyotzin immah amar rav amram ta shema detanya shomeret yavam shemmeta

a: Yorsheha yorshe ketubbatah chayyavin bikvuratah amar abbaye af anan name tenena almana nizonet minnichse yetomin umaase yadeha shellahen veen chayyavin bikvuratah yorsheha yorshe chetubbatah chayyavin bikvuratah veezohi almana sheyyesh lah shene yorshin heve omer zo shomeret yavam
Amar rava velema ach ani yoresh ishto en ani kover amar leh abbaye mishshum devain alav mishshene tzedadin im achiv yoresh yikbor et ishto im eno kover et ishto yitten ketubbatah
Amar leh hachi ka amena ach ani yoresh et ishto en ani kover vei mishshum ketubba lo nitna ketubba liggavot mechayyim
Man shamatte leh deit leh midrash ketubba bet shammay veshaminan lehu levet shammay deamri shetar haomed ligbot kegavuy dame
Ditnan metu baalehen ad shello shatu bet shammay omrim notlot ketuva velo shotot uvet hillel omrim o shotot o lo notlot ketuva
O shotot vehevi haish et ishto el hakkohen amar rachamana veleka ella mittoch shello shotot lo notlot ketuva
Bet shammay omrim notlot ketuva velo shotot veammay sefeka hu safek zannay safek la zannay vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday
Kasavri bet shammay shetar haomed ligbot kegavuy dame
Veha baenan keshettinnasi leacher titteli ma shekkatuv lichi veleka
Amar rav ashe yavam name keacher dame
Shelach leh rava leabbaye beyad rav shemaya bar zera umi nittena ketubba liggavot mechayyim
Vehatanya rabbi abba omer shaalti et somchos harotze sheyyimkor benichse achiv ketzad hu ose im kohen hu yaase seuda vifayyes im yisrael hu megaresh beget veyachzir
b: Vei salka datin nittena ketubba liggavot mechayyim neyached lah shiur ketubba vehashshear lizabben ultamach velotvah mimmatnitin lo yomar lah hare ketubbatich munnachat lich al hashshulchan ella kol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah

Hatam etza tova ka mashma lan dei la tema hachi sefa dekatane vechen lo yomar adam leishto hare ketubbatich munnachat lich al hashshulchan ella kol nechasav achrain lichtubbat ishto i bae leh lezabbone hacha name dela matze mezabben ella etza tova kamashma lan hacha name etza tova ka mashma lan
Ella derabbi abba kashya derabbi abba name la kashya mishshum eva
Hahu gavra dinfala leh yevama befumbedita bae achuh lemifselah lah begita mineh
Amar leh may datach mishshum nichse ana benichse palegna lach

Amar rav yosef kevan daamur rabbanan la lizabben af al gav dezabben la hava zevineh zevine detanya mi shemmet vehinniach shomeret yavam vehinniach nechasim bemea mane af al pi shekketubbatah enah ella mane lo yimkor shekkol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah

Amar leh abbaye vechol hecha daamur rabbanan la lizabben af al gav dezabben la hava zevineh zevine vehatnan bet shammay omrim timkor uvet hillel omrim lo timkor ellu veellu modim sheim machra venatna kayyam shalchuha lekammeh derabbi chanina bar pappe shalchah kidrav yosef
Amar abbaye attu rabbi chanina bar pappe kife tela lah shalchuha lekammeh derav minome bereh derav nechumi shalchah kidabbaye vei amar bah rav yosef tama acharina shilchu li
Nefak rav yosef dak veashkach detanya hare shehaya noshe beachiv umet vehinniach shomeret yavam lo yomar hoil vesheani yoresh hechzakti ella motziin miyyavam veyikkach bahen karka vehu ochel perot
Amar leh abbaye dilma detava leh avadu leh amar leh tanna tane motziin veatte amratte detava leh avadu leh
Hadur shalchuha kammeh derav minome bereh derav nechumi amar lehu hachi amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman zo enah mishna
May tama ilema mishshum dehau lehu mittalteli umittalteli lichtubba la meshabedi dilma rabbi meir hi deamar mittalteli meshabedi lichtubba
Veella mishshum deamar lah atte lav baalat devarim didi atte

a: Dilma rabbi natan hi detanya rabbi natan omer minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane vachavero bachavero minnayin shemmotziin mizze venotnin laze talmud lomar venatan laasher asham lo
Ella la ashkechan tanna demachmir tere chumre bichtubba ella i kerabbi meir i kerabbi natan
Amar rava im ken hayenu dishmana leh leabbaye deamar zo enah mishna vela yadana may hi

Hahu gavra dinfala leh yevama bemata machseya bea achuh lemifselah begita mineh amar leh may datach i mishshum nichse ana benichse palegna lach amar leh mistefena deavdatte li kedaavad pumbeditaa rammaa amar leh i baet pelog lach mehashta

Amar mar bar rav ashe af al gav dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan haomer lachavero lech umshoch para zo velo tihye kenuya lecha ella leachar sheloshim yom leachar sheloshim yom kana vaafilu omedet baagam
Hatam beyado hacha lav beyado
Veha ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan la kane la kashya ha daamar leh kene meachshav ha dela amar leh kene meachshav
Beo mineh meulla yibbem veachar kach chilek mahu lo asa velo chelum chilek veachar kach yibbem mahu lo asa velo chelum
Matkef lah rav sheshet hashta yibbem veachar kach chilek lo asa velo chelum chilek veachar kach yibbem mibbaya shene maasim hao
Ki ata ravin amar resh lakish ben yibbem veachar kach chilek ben chilek veachar kach yibbem lo asa velo chelum vehilcheta lo asa velo chelum
Vachachamim omrim perot hamchubbarim lakkarka shello ammay veha kol nechasav achrain vearvain lichtubbatah amar resh lakish teni shellah
Kenasah hare hi keishto lemay hilcheta amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina lomar shemmegarshah beget umachzirah megarshah beget peshita
Mahu detema veyibbemah amar rachamana vaadayin yibbumin harishonim aleha la tisge lah beget ella bachalitza ka mashma lan
Machzirah peshita
b: Mahu detema mitzva dirma rachamana aleh avdah vehashta tekum aleh beisur eshet ach ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name amar kera ulkachah lo leishsha kevan shellekachah naaset keishto
Bilvad shettehe ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon may tama ishsha hiknu lo min hashshamayim
Vei let lah merishon it lah mishsheni kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah
Lo yomar lah hare ketubbatich may vechen
Mahu detema hatam hu dela ketav lah diknay udkanena aval hacha dichtav lah diknay udkanena ema samcha datah ka mashma lan
Gershah en lah ella ketubbatah gershah in lo gershah la ka mashma lan kidrabbi abba
Hechzira hare hi kechol hannashim veen lah ella ketubbatah hechzira may ka mashma lan tenena hamgaresh et haishsha umachzira al menat ketubba rishona machzirah
Mahu detema ishto hu deihu ketav lah ketubba mineh aval yevimto dela ihu ketav lah hecha degarshah veahderah ema ketubbetah mineh ka mashma lan
Amar rav yehuda barishona hau kotvin livtula matayim ulalmana mane vehau mazkinin velo hau nosin nashim ad shebba shimon ben shatach vetiken kol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah

Tanya name hachi barishona hau kotvin livtula matayim ulalmana mane vehau mazkinin velo hau nosin nashim hitkinu sheyyihu mannichin otah bevet aviha vaadayin keshehu koes aleha omer lah lechi etzel ketubbatich
Hitkinu sheyyihu mannichin otah bevet chamiha ashirot osot otah kelatot shel kesef veshel zahav aniyyot hau osot otah avit shel meme raglayim
Vaadayin keshekkoes aleha omer lah teli ketubbatich vatzei ad shebba shimon ben shatach vetiken sheyehe kotev lah kol nechasay achrain lichtubbatah
Hadaran alach haishsha

a: Hakkotev leishto din udvarim en li binchasayich hare ze ochel perot bechayyeha veim meta yorshah im ken lamma katav lah din udvarim en li binchasayich sheim machra venatna kayyam

Katav lah din udvarim en li binchasayich uvferotehen hare ze eno ochel perot bechayyeha veim meta yorshah rabbi yehuda omer leolam ochel pere ferot ad sheyyichtov lah din udvarim en li binchasayich uvferotehen uvfere ferotehen ad olam

Katav lah din udvarim en li binchasayich uvferotehen uvfere ferotehen bechayyayich uvmotech eno ochel perot bechayyeha veim meta eno yorshah rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im meta yirashenna mippene shemmatne al ma shekkatuv battora vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel
Gema tane rabbi chiyya haomer leishto
Vechi ketav lah hachi may have vehatanya haomer lachavero din udvarim en li al sade zo veen li esek bah veyaday mesullakot hemenna lo amar kelum

Amri deve rabbi yannay bechotev lah veodah arusa kidrav kahana deamar rav kahana nachala habbaa leadam mimmakom acher adam matne aleha shello yirashenna vechidrava deamar rava haomer i efshi betakkanat chachamim kegon zo shomin lo
May kegon zo kidrav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav yechola ishsha shettomar levalah eni nizonet veeni osa
I hachi afilu nesua name
Amar abbaye nesua yado keyadah rava amar yado adifa miyyadah nafka minah leshomeret yavam
Ibaya lehu kanu miyyado mahu amar rav yosef middin udvarim kanu miyyado rav nachman amar miggufah shel karka kanu miyyado amar abbaye mistabbera milta derav yosef
b: Beorer aval beomed miggufah shel karka kanu miyyado
Amar ammemar hilcheta miggufah shel karka kanu miyyado amar leh rav ashe leammemar beorer o beomed lemay nafka minah lechidrav yosef amar leh la shemia li kelomar la sevira li
Im ken lamma katav lah vechu vetema leh mikkol mile sallekte nafshach amar abbaye yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona
Veema mippere amar abbaye butzina tav mikkara

Veema miyerushsha amar abbaye mita shechicha mechira la shechicha vechi mesallek inish nafsheh mimmilta dela shechicha mimmilta dishchicha la mesallek inish nafsheh rav ashe amar binchasayich velo beferotehen binchasayich velo leachar mita

Rabbi yehuda omer leolam hu ochel pere ferot tanu rabbanan ellu hen perot veellu hen pere ferot hichnisa lo karka veasta perot hare hen perot machar perot velakach mehen karka veasta perot hare hen pere ferot
Ibaya lehu lerabbi yehuda pere ferot daveka o dilma ad olam daveka o dilma tarvayehu daveka
Im timtze lomar pere ferot daveka ad olam lema li ha ka mashma lan kevan dichtav lah pere ferot keman dichtav lah ad olam dame
Veim timtze lomar ad olam daveka pere ferot lema li ha ka mashma lan af al gav dichtav lah pere ferot i ketav lah ad olam in i la la

Veim timtze lomar tarvayehu daveka tarte lema li tzericha dei ketav lah pere ferot velo ketav lah ad olam hava amena pere ferot hu dela achel aval pera defere ferot achel lehachi itzterich ad olam vei ketav lah ad olam vela ketav lah pere ferot hava amena leolam apperot kae lehachi itzterich pere ferot
Ibaya lehu katav lah din udvarim en li binchasayich uvfere ferot mahu sheyyochal perot mippere ferot sallek nafsheh mippere la sallek nafsheh o dilma mikkol mile sallek nafsheh
Peshita demikkol mile sallek nafsheh dei amratte mippere ferot sallek nafsheh mippere la sallek nafsheh kevan deachlinhu leferot pere ferot mehecha
Velitamach ha ditnan rabbi yehuda omer leolam hu ochel pere ferot ku kevan deachlinhu lefere pere ferot mehecha ella bidshayyara hacha name bidshayyar
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ku amar rav halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel vela mittameh

May halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel vela mittameh ilema halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar im meta yirashenna velav mittameh deilu rabban shimon ben gamliel savar matne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel verav savar tenao kayyam vekasavar yerushshat habbaal derabbanan vachachamim asu chizuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora

a: Vesavar rav tenao kayyam veha itmar haomer lachavero al menat sheen lecha alay onaa rav amar yesh lo alav onaa ushmuel amar en lo alav onaa
Ella halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel velav mittameh deilu rabban shimon ben gamliel savar meta yirashenna verav savar meta lo yirashenna
Hay mittameh vela kehilcheteh hu

Ella halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar im meta yirashenna velav mittameh deilu rabban shimon ben gamliel savar bidorayeta tenao batel ha bidrabbanan tenao kayyam verav savar afilu bidrabbanan tenao batel
Hay ketameh uchhilcheteh hu verav mosif hu

Ella halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar im meta yirashenna velav mittameh deilu rabban shimon ben gamliel savar yerushshat habbaal deorayeta vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel verav savar yerushshat habbaal derabbanan vachachamim asu chizuk ledivrehem keshel tora
Verav savar yerushshat habbaal derabbanan vehatnan rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer hayyoresh et ishto yachzir livne mishpacha vinakke lahen min haddamim
Vehavenan bah may kasavar i kasavar yerushshat habbaal deorayeta ammay yachzir vei derabbanan damim may avidtayehu
Veamar rav leolam kasavar yerushshat habbaal deorayeta uchgon shehorishattu ishto bet hakkevarot mishshum pegam mishpacha amur rabbanan lishkol deme velahdar
Umay yenakke lahen min haddamim deme kever ishto kidtanya hammocher kivro vederech kivro maamado umkom hespedo bain bene mishpacha vekovrin oto beal korcho mishshum pegam mishpacha
Rav letameh derabbi yochanan ben beroka kaamar veleh la sevira leh

Matni mi shemmet vehinniach ishsha uvaal chov veorshin vehaya lo pikkadon o milva beyad acherim rabbi tarfon omer yinnatnu lakkoshel shebbahen rabbi akiva omer en merachamin baddin ella yinnatnu layyorshin shekkullan tzerichin shevua veen hayyorshin tzerichin shevua

Hinniach perot telushin min hakkarka kol hakkodem bahen zacha bahen zachta ishsha yoter mikketubbatah uvaal chov yoter al chovo hammotar rabbi tarfon omer yinnatnu lakkoshel shebbahen rabbi akiva omer en merachamin baddin ella yinnatnu layyorshin shekkullam tzerichin shevua veen hayyorshin tzerichin shevua
Gema lema li lemitne milva lamma li lemitne pikkadon tzericha dei tena milva beha kaamar rabbi tarfon mishshum demilva lehotzaa nitna aval pikkadon deiteh beeneh ema mode leh lerabbi akiva
Vei tena ha beha kaamar rabbi akiva aval behach ema mode lerabbi tarfon tzericha
May lakkoshel rabbi yose berabbi chanina omer lakkoshel shebbiraya rabbi yochanan amar lichtubbat ishsha mishshum china
Ketannae rabbi binyamin omer lakkoshel shebbiraya vehu kasher rabbi elazar omer lichtubbat ishsha mishshum china
Hinniach perot hattelushin verabbi akiva may irya motar kullehu name deorshin hau in hachi name veayede deamar rabbi tarfon motar tena ihu name motar
b: Verabbi akiva tefisa la mahneya kelal amar rava amar rav nachman vehu shettafas mechayyim
Ulrabbi tarfon demannechi hecha rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu vehu shetztzevurin umunnachin birshut harabbim aval besimta lo verabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu afilu besimta
Dun dayyane kerabbi tarfon veahdereh resh lakish leovada minayehu amar leh rabbi yochanan asita keshel tora
Lema beha kamipalgi demar savar taa bidvar mishna chozer umar savar taa bidvar mishna eno chozer
La dechulle alma taa bidvar mishna chozer vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar halacha kerabbi akiva mechavero velo merabbo umar savar halacha afilu merabbo
Veibaet ema dechulle alma halacha kerabbi akiva mechavero velo merabbo vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar rabbi tarfon rabbo hava umar savar chavero hava
Veibaet ema dechulle alma chavero hava vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar halacha itmar umar savar mattin itmar

Kariveh derabbi yochanan tefus para deyatme missimta ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar lehu shappir tefastuha ato lekammeh derabbi shimon ben lakish amar lehu zilu ahdur ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar lehu ma eese shekkenegdi chaluk alay

Hahu bakkara deyatme detafsi tora mineh baal chov amar mechayyim tefesna leh uvakkara amar leachar mita tafseh ato lekammeh derav nachman amar leh it lecha sahade detafseh amar leh lav amar leh miggo deyachol lememar lakuach hu beyadi yachol name lememar mechayyim tefesna leh
Vehaamar resh lakish haggodrot en lahen chazaka shane tora dimsira leroe

Deve nesia tefus amta deyatme missimta yetev rabbi avahu verabbi chanina bar pappi verabbi yitzchak nappacha vitev rabbi abba gabbayehu amar lehu shappir tafsituha amar lehu rabbi abba mishshum deve nesia ninhu mechannefitu lehu veha dun dayyane kerabbi tarfon veahdereh resh lakish ovada minayehu

Yemar bar chashu hava massek beh zuze behahu gavra shechev ushvak arba amar leh lishlucheh zil tefasa nihali azal tafsah pegau beh rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua amaru leh atte tofes levaal chov bemakom shechav laacherim veamar rabbi yochanan hattofes levaal chov bemakom shechav laacherim

a: Lo kana tafsuha inhu rav pappa memallach malloche rav huna bereh derav yehoshua memattach lah beashla mar amar ana kanena lah lechullah umar amar ana kanena lah lechullah
Pega behu rav pinchas bar amme amar lehu rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu vehu shetztzevurin umunnachin birshut harabbim amar lehu anan name mecharifuta denahara tefesna
Ato lekammeh derava amar lehu kake chivare meshalleche gelime deinashe hachi amar rav nachman vehu shettefasah mechayyim
Avimi bereh derabbi avahu hao masseki beh zuze be chozae shadderinhu beyad chama bereh derabba bar avahu azal parinhu amar lehu havu li shetara amaru leh sitrae ninhu
Ata lekammeh derabbi avahu amar leh it lecha sahade difratinhu amar leh la amar leh migo dicholin lomar lo hau devarim meolam yecholin name lememar sitrae ninhu
Leinyan shallome shaliach may amar rav ashe chazenan i amar leh shekol shetara vehav zuze meshallem hav zuze ushkol shetara la meshallem
Vela hi ben kach uven kach meshallem deamar leh letakkone shaddartacha vela leauote

Hahi itta dahao mipakdi gabbah meluga dishtare ato yorshim ka tavi leh minah amara lehu mechayyim tefesna lehu atay lekammeh derav nachman amar lah it lich sahade detavuha minich mechayyim vela yehavt nihaleh amra leh la im ken have tefisa dilachar mita utfisa dilachar mita lo kelum hi
Hahi itta deichayyava shevua be dina derava amara leh bat rav chisda yadana bah dachashuda ashshevua afchah rava lishvua ashshekkenegdah

Zimnin hau yatvi kammeh rav pappa verav adda bar matna ayeto hahu shetara gabbeh amar leh rav pappa yadana beh dishtara peria hu amar leh ika inish acharina bahadeh demar amar leh la amar leh af al gav deika mar ed echad lav kelum hu
Amar leh rav adda bar matna velo yehe rav pappa kevat rav chisda bat rav chisda kim li begavah mar la kim li begaveyh
Amar rav pappa hashta deamar mar kim li begaveyh milta hi kegon abba mar beri dekim li begaveyh karana shetara appummeh
Karana salka datach ella marana shetara appummeh

Hahi itta deichayyava shevua be dina derav bivi bar abbaye amar lehu hahu baal din tete vetishteva bemata efshar demikasfa umodya amara lehu ketuvu li zachota dechi mishtevana yahavi li amar lehu rav bivi bar abbaye kitvu lah
Amar rav pappe mishshum deatetu mimmulae amritu mile mulyata
Ha amar rava hay ashsharta dedayyane demikatva mikkamme denacho sahade achatimut yedayehu pesula alma michze keshikra hachi name michze keshikra

Veletah midderav nachman deamar rav nachman omer haya rabbi meir afilu metzao beashpa vachatamo untano lah kasher vaafilu rabbanan la peligi aleh derabbi meir ella begite nashim devaenan ketiva lishmah aval bishar shetarot modu leh
Deamar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan shetar shellava bo ufrao eno chozer velove bo shekkevar nimchal shibudo tama denimchal shibudo aval lemichze
b: Keshikra la chayeshinan

Hahu gavra deafked shav marganyata detzayeri bisdina be rabbi meyasha bar bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi shechev rabbi meyasha vela pakked ato lekammeh derabbi amme amar lehu chada deyadana beh berabbi meyasha bar bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi dela amid veod ha ka yahev simana
Vela amaran ella dela regil deayel venafek lehatam aval ragil deayel venafek lehatam ema inish acharina afked veihu michza chaza

Hahu gavra deafked kasa dechaspa be chasa shachev chasa vela pakked ato lekammeh derav nachman amar lehu yadana beh bechasa dela amid veod ha ka yahev simana vela amaran ella dela regil deayel venafek lehatam aval regil deayel venafek lehatam emar inish acharina afked veihu michza chaza

Hahu deafked metachsa be rav dimi achuh derav safra shachev rav dimi vela pakked ata lekammeh derabbi abba amar lehu chada deyadana beh berav dimi dela amid veod ha ka yahev simana vela amaran ella dela regil deayel venafek lehatam aval regil deayel venafek lehatam ema inish acharina afked veihu michza chaza
Hahu daamar lehu nichsay letoviyya shachev ata toviyya amar rabbi yochanan hare ba toviyya

Amar toviyya vaata rav toviyya letoviyya amar lerav toviyya la amar vei inish degis beh ha gis beh ato shene toviyya shachen vetalmid chacham talmid chacham kodem karov vetalmid chacham talmid chacham kodem
Ibaya lehu shachen vekarov may ta shema tov shachen karov meach rachok shenehem kerovim ushnehem shechenim ushnehem chachamim shuda dedayyane

Amar leh rava livreh derav chiyya bar avin ta ema lach milta meallayeta dahava amar avuch ha deamar shemuel hammocher shetar chov lachavero vechazar umchalo machul vaafilu yoresh mochel mode shemuel bemachneset shetar chov levalah vechazra umchalatto sheeno machul mippene sheyyado keyadah
Karivteh derav nachman zabbentah lichtubbetah betovat hanaa igarasha ushchiva ato ka tavi lah livrattah amar lehu rav nachman leka delasvah lah etza

a: Tezil vetachalah lichtubbetah deimmah legabbe avuh vetertah mineh shemaa azala acheltah
Amar rav nachman asinu atzmenu keorche haddayyanin meikara may sevar ulvassof may sevar meikara sevar umibbesarcha lo titallam ulvassof savar adam chashuv shane
Gufa amar shemuel hammocher shetar chov lachavero vechazar umchalo machul vaafilu yoresh mochel amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua vei pikkeach hu mekarkesh leh zuze vechatev leh shetara bishmeh
Amar ammemar man dedaen dina digrame magbe beh deme shetara mealleya man dela daen dina degarme magbe beh deme neyara bealma
Hava ovada vechafyeh rafram lerav ashe veagbi beh ki cheshura letzalme

Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav chama hay man deika aleh ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov veit leh ara veit leh zuze levaal chov mesallekinan leh bezuze leishsha mesallekinan lah beara hay ki dineh vehay ki dineh
Vei la ika ella chad ara vela chazya ella lechad levaal chov yahavinan leh leishsha la yahavinan lah may tama yoter mimma shehaish rotze lisa ishsha rotza lehinnase

Amar leh rav pappa lerav chama vadday deamritu mishshemeh derava hay man demasseki beh zuze veit leh ara vaata baal chov veka tava mineh veamar leh zil shekol meara amrinan leh zil zabben atte veayeti hav leh amar leh la
Ema li gufa deovada hechi hava amar leh tole meotav begoy hava hu asa shello kahogen lefichach asu bo shello kahogen

Amar leh rav kahana lerav pappa ledidach deamratte periat baal chov mitzva amar la nicha li deebed mitzva may amar leh tenena bamme devarim amurim bemitzvat lo taase aval bemitzvat ase kegon sheomrin lo ase sukka veeno ose lulav veeno ose
b: Makkin oto ad shettetze nafsho
Bea mineh rame bar chama merav chisda hare ze gitech velo titgarshi bo ella leachar sheloshim yom vehalcha vehinnichattu betzide reshut harabbim mahu
Amar leh enah megoreshet midderav ushmuel derav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu vehu shetztzevurin umunnachin birshut harabbim vetzide reshut harabbim kirshut harabbim damu

Adderabba megoreshet midderav nachman deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh haomer lachavero meshoch para zo velo tihye kenuya lach ad leachar sheloshim yom kana vaafilu omedet baagam may lav hayenu agam vehayenu tzide reshut harabbim la agam lechud vetzide reshut harabbim lechud

Ika deamri amar leh megoreshet midderav nachman vetzide reshut harabbim kaagam dame adderabba enah megoreshet midderav ushmuel may lav hayenu reshut harabbim vehayenu tzide reshut harabbim la reshut harabbim lechod vetzide reshut harabbim lechod
Matni hammoshiv et ishto chenonit o shemminah appotroppeya hare ze mashbiah kol zeman sheyyirtze rabbi eliezer omer afilu al pilkah veal isatah
Gema ibaya lehu rabbi eliezer al yede gilgul kaamar o lechattechilla kaamar
Ta shema amru lo lerabbi eliezer en adam dar im nachash bichfifa i amratte bishlama lechattechilla shappir ella i amratte al yede gilgul may nafka lah minah
Deamra leh kevan dekadayekatte batray kulle hay la matzyana deedur bahadach

Ta shema hare shello patar et ishto min hanneder umin hashshevua vehoshivah chenonit o shemminah appotroppeya hare ze mashbiah kol zeman sheyyirtze lo hoshivah chenonit velo minah appotroppeya eno yachol lehashbiah

Rabbi eliezer omer af al pi shello hoshivah chenonit velo minah appotroppeya hare ze mashbiah kol zeman sheyyirtze sheen lecha ishsha shello naaset appotroppeya shaa achat bechayye balah al pilkah veal isatah amru lo en adam dar im nachash bichfifa shema minah lechattechilla shema minah
Matni katav lah neder ushvua en li alayich en yachol lehashbiah aval mashbia hu et yorsheha veet habbaim birshutah

Neder ushvua en li alayich veal yorshayich veal habbaim berishshutecha eno yachol lehashbiah lo hi velo yorsheha velo et habbaim birshutah aval yorshav mashbiin otah veet yorsheha veet habbaim birshutah

Neder ushvua en li velo leorshay velo labbaim birshuti alayich veal yorshayich veal habbaim birshutich eno yachol lehashbiah lo hu velo yorshav velo habbaim birshuto lo otah velo yorsheha velo habbaim birshutah

Halcha mikkever balah levet aviha o shechazra levet chamiha velo naaset appotroppeya en hayyorshin mashbiin otah veim naaset appotroppeya hayyorshin mashbiin otah al heatid lavo veen mashbiin otah al ma sheavar
Gema shevua may avidteh amar rav yehuda amar rav

a: Al appotroppeya shennaaset bechayye valah rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh al happogemet ketubbatah

Azal rav mardochay amrah lishmata kammeh derav ashe bishlama leman deamar al happogemet ketubbatah demasseka addatah dilma mitztarchi li zuze veshakelna mikketubbetay veamra leh ketov li dela mashbeatte li ella leman deamar al appotroppeya shennaaset bechayye valah ihi mi havat yada demotev lah appotroppeya deamra leh ketov li dela mashbeatte li

Amar leh attun aha matnitu lah anan aha matnenan lah halcha mikkever balah levet aviha o shechazra levet chamiha velo naaset appotroppeya en hayyorshin mashbiin otah veim naaset appotroppeya yorshin mashbiin otah al heatid lavo veen mashbiin otah al sheavar
Sheavar may avidteh amar rav yehuda amar rav al appotroppeya shennaaset bechayye habbaal
Aval ben mita likvura mashbeinan lah verav matna amar afilu ben mita likvura la mashbeinan lah deamri nehardae lichraga velimzone velikvura mezabbeninan bela achrazta

Amar rabba amar rabbi chiyya dela neder udla shevua hu eno yachol lehashbiah aval yorshin mashbiin otah neki neder neki shevua ben hu uven yorshin en mashbiin otah hachi kaamar lah menakkeyatte mishshevuata

Verav yosef amar rabbi chiyya dela neder udla shevua hu eno yachol lehashbiah aval yorshin mashbiin otah neki neder neki shevua ben hu uven yorshin mashbiin otah hachi kaamar lah nakkay nafshich bishvuata

Shelach rabbi zakkay lemar ukva ben dela shevua ben dinki shevua ben dela neder uven dinki neder benichsay hu eno yachol lehashbiah aval yorshin mashbiin otah minnichsayya ilen ben hu uven yorshav en mashbiin otah

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel mishshum abba shaul ben ima miryam ben dela shevua ben dinki shevua ben dela neder uven dinki neder ben minnichsay uven minnichsayya ilen ben hu uven yorshav en mashbiin otah aval ma eese shehare amru chachamim habba lipara minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella bishvua

Veika deamri lah matnita abba shaul ben ima miryam amar ben dela shevua ben dinki shevua ben dela neder uven neki neder ben minnichse uven minnichsayya ilen ben hu uven yorshav en mashbiin otah aval ma eese shehare amru chachamim habba lipara minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella bishvua amar rav nachman amar shemuel halacha keven ima miryam
Matni happogemet ketubbatah lo tippara ella bishvua ed echad meidah shehi perua lo tippara ella bishvua minnichse yetomim uminnechasim meshubadim veshello befanav lo tippara ella bishvua
Happogemet ketubbatah ketzad hayeta ketubbatah elef zuz veamar lah hitkabbalte ketubbatich vehi omeret lo hitkabbalti ella mane lo tippara ella bishvua
Ed echad meidah shehi perua ketzad hayeta ketubbatah elef zuz veamar lah hitkabbalte ketubbatich vehi omeret lo hitkabbalti veed echad meidah shehi perua lo tippara ella bishvua
Minnechasim meshubadim ketzad machar nechasav laacherim vehi nifraat min hallakochot lo tippara ella bishvua
Minnichse yetomim ketzad met vehinniach nechasav litomim vehi nifraat min hayetomim lo tippara ella bishvua
Veshello befanav ketzad halach lo limdinat hayyam vehi nifraat shello befanav enah nifraat ella bishvua
b: Rabbi shimon omer kol zeman shehi tovaat ketubbatah hayyorshin mashbiin otah veim enah tovaat ketubbatah en hayyorshin mashbiin otah
Gema savar rame bar chama lememar shevua deorayeta deka taen matayim veka mode leh bemea haveya leh hodaa bemiktzat hattaana vechol hammode bemiktzat hattaana yishshava
Amar rava shette teshuvot baddavar chada dechol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin vehi nishbaat venotelet veod en nishbain al kefirat shibud karkaot
Ella amar rava midderabbanan defara dayek demipra la dayek urmo rabbanan shevua alah ki hechi detidok
Ibaya lehu pogemet ketubbatah beedim mahu im ita defara beedim hava para lah o dilma itremoye itremi leh

Ta shema kol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin veellu nishbain venotlin hassachir vehannigzal vehannechbal veshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua vechenvani al pinkaso vehappogem shetaro shello beedim shello beedim in beedim la
La mibaya kaamar la mibaya beedim devadday tzericha shevua aval shello beedim ema tehve kemeshiv aveda vetishkol belo shevua ka mashma lan
Ibaya lehu happogemet ketubbatah pachot pachot mishshave peruta mahu mi amrinan kevan deka dayeka kulle hay kushta ka amrah o dilma iarome ka miarma teku
Ibaya lehu pochetet ketubbatah mahu mi amrinan hayenu pogemet o dilma pogemet modya bemiktzat ha la ka modya bemiktzat
Ta shema pochetet tippara shello bishvua ketzad hayeta ketubbatah elef zuz veamar lah hitkabbalte ketubbatich vehi omeret lo hitkabbalti veenah ella mane nifraat shello bishvua
Bemay gavya behay shetara hay shetara chaspa bealma hu amar rava bereh derabba beomeret amana hayeta li beni leveno

Ed echad meidah shehi perua sevar rame bar chama lememar shevua deorayeta dichtiv lo yakum ed echad beish lechol aon ulchol chattat lechol aon ulchol chattat hu deeno kam aval kam hu lishvua veamar mar kol makom shehashshenayim mechayevin oto mamon echad mechayevo shevua
Amar rava shette teshuvot baddavar chada dechol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin vehi nishbaat venotelet veod en nishbain al kefirat shibud karkaot

Amar rav pappa

a: I pikeach hu mayete lah lide shevua deorayeta yahev lah ketubbetah beappe chad sahada vesamech sahada kamma assahada batra umokem lehu lehanach kammae bemilva

Matkef lah rav shisha bereh derav idi heach samech sahada kamma assahada batra ella amar rav shisha bereh derav idi yahev lah ketubbetah beappe sahada kamma vesahada batra umokem lehu lehanach kammae behalvaa
Matkef lah rav ashe akkatti yechola lememar shette ketubbot havay ella amar rav ashe hu demoda lehu
Minnechasim meshubadim tenan hatam vechen hayetomim lo yipparu ella bishvua
Mimman ilema millove hashta avihen shakel bela shevua veinhu bishvua ella hachi kaamar vechen hayetomim min hayetomim lo yipparu ella bishvua
Amar rav zerika amar rav yehuda lo shanu ella sheamru yetomim amar lanu abba laviti ufarati aval amru amar lanu abba lo laviti af bishvua lo yipparu
Matkef lah rava adderabba kol haomer lo laviti keomer lo parati dame

Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar amar rav zerika amar rav yehuda lo shanu ella sheamru yetomim amar lanu abba laviti ufarati aval amru amar lanu abba lo laviti nifrain shello bishvua shekkol haomer lo laviti keomer lo parati dame
Venifraat shello befanav lo tippara ella bishvua amar rav acha sar habbira maase ba lifne rabbi yitzchak beantochya veamar lo shanu ella lichtubbat ishsha mishshum china aval baal chov la
Verava amar rav nachman afilu baal chov shello yehe kol echad veechad notel meotav shel chavero veholech veoshev bimdinat hayyam veatta noel delet bifne lovin

Rabbi shimon omer kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah vechu rabbi shimon aheya amar rabbi yirmeya aha venifraat shello befanav la tippara ella bishvua la shena limzone vela shena lichtubba vaata rabbi shimon lememar kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah yorsheha mashbiin otah
b: Enah tovaat ketubbatah en yorshin mashbiin otah vekamipalgi biflugta dechanan uvne kohanim gedolim ditnan mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot chanan omer tishshava bassof velo tishshava battechilla
Nechleku alav bene kohanim gedolim veamru tishshava battechilla uvassof rabbi shimon kechanan rabbanan kivne kohanim gedolim
Matkef lah rav sheshet hay yorshin mashbiin otah bet din mashbiin otah mibe leh

Ella amar rav sheshet aha halcha mikkever balah levet aviha o shechazra levet chamiha velo naaset appotroppeya en hayyorshim mashbiin otah veim naaset appotroppeya yorshin mashbiin otah al heatid lavo veen mashbiin otah al ma sheavar vaata rabbi shimon lememar kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah yorshin mashbiin otah enah tovaat ketubbatah en hayyorshin mashbiin otah

Vekamipalgi biflugta deabba shaul verabbanan ditnan appotroppos shemminahu avi yetomim yishshava minuhu bet din lo yishshava abba shaul omer chiluf haddevarim minuhu bet din yishshava minahu avi yetomim lo yishshava
Rabbi shimon keabba shaul verabbanan kerabbanan
Matkef lah abbaye hay kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah im tovaat mibe leh

Ella amar abbaye aha katav lah neder ushvua en li alayich eno yachol lehashbiah ku neder ushvua en li velo leorshay velo labbaim birshuti alayich veal yorshayich veal habbain birshutich en yachol lehashbiah lo hu velo yorshav velo habbain birshuto lo hi velo yorsheha velo habbain birshutah vaata rabbi shimon lememar kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah yorshin mashbiin otah
Vekamipalgi biflugta deabba shaul ben ima miryam verabbanan rabbi shimon keabba shaul verabbanan kerabbanan
Matkef lah rav pappa hatinach kol zeman shettovaat ketubbatah enah tovaat ketubbatah may ika lememar
Ella amar rav pappa leappoke midderabbi eliezer umachlukto
Matni hotzia get veen immo ketubba

a: Gova ketubbatah
Ketubba veen immah get hi omeret avad giti vehu omer avad shovari vechen baal chov shehotzi shetar chov veen immo perozbul hare ellu lo yipparu
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer min hassakkana veelach ishsha gova ketubbatah shello beget uvaal chov gove shello bifrozbul
Gema shema minah kotvin shovar dei en kotvin shovar lechush dilma mappeka lah lichtubbetah vegavya bah
Amar rav bimkom sheen kotvin ketubba askinan ushmuel amar af bemakom shekkotvin ketubba
Velishmuel kotvin shovar amar rav anan ledidi miparsha li mineh demar shemuel bimkom sheen kotvin veamar katavti alav lehavi reaya bimkom shekkotvin veamra lo katav li aleha lehavi reaya
Veaf rav hadar beh deamar rav ben bimkom shekkotvin ben bimkom sheen kotvin get gova ikar ketubba gova tosefet vechol harotze lehashiv yavo veyashiv
Tenan ketubba veen immah get hi omeret avad giti vehu omer avad shovari vechen baal chov shehotzi shetar chov veen immo perozbul hare ellu lo yipparu
Bishlama lishmuel moke lah bimkom sheen kotvin veamar katavti deamrinan leh ayeti reaya vei la mayete reaya amrinan leh zil pareh
Ella lerav nehi deikar la gavya tosefet miha tigbe
Amar rav yosef hacha bemay askinan kesheen sham ede gerushin migo deyachol lememar lo gerashtiha
b: Yachol lememar gerashtiha venatatti lah ketubbatah
Ha middekatane sefa rabban shimon ben gamliel omer min hassakkana veelach ishsha gova ketubbatah shello beget uvaal chov shello bifrozbul bidika ede gerushin askinan dei leka ede gerushin bemay gavya
