Ella kullah rabban shimon ben gamliel hi vechassore michassera vehachi katane hare ellu lo yipparu bamme devarim amurim kesheen sham ede gerushin aval yesh sham ede gerushin gavya tosefet veikar i mappeka gita gavya vei la mappeka gita la gavya
Umin hassakkana veelach af al gav dela mappeka gita gavya sherabban shimon ben gamliel omer missakkana veelach ishsha gova ketubbatah shello beget uvaal chov shello bifrozbul
Amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav ledidach deamratte get gova ikar almana min hannissuin bemay gavya beede mita velechush dilma gershah umappeka legita vegavya beh beoshevet tachat balah
Vedilma samuch lemita gershah ihu hu deafsed annafsheh
Almana min haerusin bemay gavya beede mita velechush dilma gershah umappeka gita vegavya

Ella bimkom dela efshar katvinan shovar dei la tema hachi ede mita gufayehu nechush dilma mappeka ede mita behay be dina vegavya vahadar mappeka beve dina acharina vegavya ella vadday bimkom dela efshar katvinan shovar

Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe almana min haerusin menalan deit lah ketubba ilema meha nitarmela o nitgarsha ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin gova et hakkol dilma dichtav lah
Vechi tema i ketav lah may lememra leappoke midderabbi elazar ben azarya deamar shello katav lah ella al menat shehu konsah
Dayeka name dekatane gova et hakkol i amratte bishlama dechatav lah mishshum hachi gova et hakkol ella i amratte dela ketav lah may gova et hakkol mane matayim hu deit lah
Veella middetane rav chiyya bar avin ishto arusa lo onen velo mitamme lah vechen hi lo onenet velo mitammea lo meta eno yorshah met hu gova ketubbatah
Dilma dichtav lah vechi tema i ketav lah may lememra meta eno yorshah itztericha leh

Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna lerav deamar get gova ikar lechush dilma mappeka gita behay be dina vegavya vehadra mappeka beve dina acharina vegavya vechi tema dekarinan leh amra baena leinnesove beh
Dekarinan leh vechatvinan aggabbeh gita denan keranohi lav mishshum degita pasul hu ella dela tihdar vetigbe beh zimna acharina
Matni shene gitin ushte chetubbot gova shette chetubbot
Shette chetubbot veget echad o ketubba ushne gittin o ketubba veget umita enah gova ella ketubba achat shehamgaresh et ishto vehechzirah al menat ketubba harishona machzirah
Gema i baaya behay gavya i baaya behay gavya
Lema tehve teuvta derav nachman amar shemuel deamar rav nachman amar shemuel shene shetarot hayyotzin baze achar ze bitel sheni et harishon
Lav ittemar alah amar rav pappa umode rav nachman dei osef beh dikla letosefet katveh hacha name bidosef lah
Tanu rabbanan hotzia get uchtubba umita

a: Im get kodem lakketubba gova shette ketubbot ketubba kodemet lagget enah gova ella ketubba achat shehammegaresh et ishto vehechzirah al menat ketubba harishona hechzirah
Matni katan shehissio aviv ketubbatah kayyemet sheal menat ken kiyemah ger shennitgayera ishto immo ketubbatah kayyemet sheal menat ken kiyemah
Gema amar rav huna lo shanu ella mane matayim aval tosefet en lah verav yehuda amar afilu tosefet yesh lah
Metivi chidshu notelet ma shechidshu chidshu in lo chidshu la
Ema af ma shechidshu veha la tane hachi chidshu notelet ma shechidshu lo chidshu betula gova matayim vealmana mane teuvta derav yehuda
Rav yehuda matnitin ateteh hu savar ketubbatah kayyemet akkullah milta kae vela hi aikar ketubba kae
Hadaran alach hakkotev leishto
Mi shehaya nasuy shette nashim vamet harishona kodemet lashsheniyya veorshe harishona kodmin leorshe sheniyya
Nasa et harishona vameta nasa sheniyya umet hu sheniyya veorsheha kodmin leorshe harishona
Gema middekatane harishona kodemet lashsheniyya vela katane harishona yesh lah vehashsheniyya en lah mikkelal dei kadma sheniyya vetafsa la mappekinan minah
Shema minah baal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava ma sheggava gava
Leolam ema lach ma sheggava lo gava umay kodemet ligmare katane keditnan ben kodem labbat
Ika deamri middela katane im kadma sheniyya vetafsa en motziin miyyadah mikkelal dei kadma sheniyya vetafsa mappekinan minah
Shema minah baal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava ma sheggava lo gava
Leolam ema lach ma sheggava gava ayede ditna sheniyya veorsheha kodmin leorshe harishona
b: Tena name harishona kodemet lashsheniyya
Nasa et harishona shema minah telat shema minah achat bechayyav veachat bemoto yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin vela chayeshinan leintzoye
Mimmay middekatane sheniyya veorsheha kodmim leorshe rishona mikdam hu dekadmi ha ika shakli
Ushma minah ketubba naaset motar lachavertah
Mimmay middela katane im yesh sham motar dinar
Ushma minah ketubbat benin dichrin la tarfa mimmeshabedi dei salka datin tarfa mimmeshabedi leto bene rishona velitrefinhu livne sheniyya
Matkef lah rav ashe mimmay dilma leolam ema lach achat bechayyav veachat bemoto en lahen ketubbat benin dichrin umay kodmin lenachala katane
Vechi tema yorshe harishona lema li ayede ditna sheniyya veorsheha tena name leorshe harishona
Udkaamratte ketubba naaset motar lachavertah dilma leolam ema lach en ketubba naaset motar lachavertah vehacha hu deika motar dinar

Veachat bechayyav veachat bemoto tannae hi detanya metu achat bechayyav veachat bemoto ben nannas omer yecholin bene harishona lomar livne hashsheniyya bene baalat chov attem telu ketubbat immechem utzu
Rabbi akiva omer kevar kaftza nachala millifne bene harishona venafla lifne bene hashsheniyya
May lav beha ka mipalgi demar savar achat bechayyav veachat bemoto yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin umar savar achat bechayyav veachat bemoto en lahen ketubbat benin dichrin

Amar rabba ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi vekaamri dechulle alma achat bechayyav veachat bemoto yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin vehacha bichtubba naaset motar lachavertah vehu haddin levaal chov kamipalgi
Mar savar ketubba naaset motar lachavertah vehu haddin levaal chov umar savar en ketubba naaset motar lachavertah vehu haddin levaal chov
Veamena lehu ana bevaal chov kulle alma la peligi dehave motar ki peligi bichtubba
Matkef lah rav yosef i hachi rabbi akiva omer kevar kaftza nachala im yesh motar dinar mibe leh
Ella amar rav yosef beachat bechayyav veachat bemoto ka mipalgi

Vehane tannae ki hane tannae detanya nasa et harishona vameta nasa et hashsheniyya umet hu bain baneha shel zo leachar mita venotlin ketubbat imman rabbi shimon omer im yesh motar dinar ellu notlin ketubbat imman veellu notlin ketubbat imman veim lav cholkin beshave
May lav beha ka mipalgi demar savar achat bechayyav veachat bemoto yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin umar savar achat bechayyav veachat bemoto en lahem ketubbat benin dichrin
La dechulle alma achat bechayyav veachat bemoto yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin

a: Vehacha bedinar mekarkee kamipalgi mar savar mekarkee in mittaltele la umar savar afilu mittalteli
Umi matzet amratte hachi vehatnan rabbi shimon omer afilu yesh sham nechasim sheen lahem achraut enan kelum ad sheyehe sham nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut yater al shette ketubbot dinar
Ella hacha bedinar meshabedi kamipalgi mar savar mibbene chorin in mimmeshabedi la umar savar afilu mimmeshabedi
I hachi rabbi shimon omer im yesh sham motar dinar kevan sheyyesh sham motar dinar mibe leh
Ella befachot middinar kamipalgi mar savar dinar in pachot middinar la umar savar afilu pachot middinar
Veha rabbi shimon dinar kaamar vechi tema efoch tanna kamma dematnitin name dinar kaamar
Ella ki hanach tere lishaney kammae veefoch
Amar mar zutra mishshemeh derav pappa hilcheta achat bechayyav veachat bemoto yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin uchtubba naaset motar lachavertah
Bishlama i ashmeinan achat bechayyav veachat bemoto yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin vela ashmeinan ketubba naaset motar lachavertah hava amena i ika motar dinar in i la la
Ella lashmeinan ketubba naaset motar lachavertah vaana yadana mishshum deachat bechayyav veachat bemoto yesh lahen ketubbat benin dichrin
I ashmeinan hachi hava amena kegon shennasa shalosh nashim vametu shettayim bechayyav veachat bemoto vehach demayet leachar mita yoledet nekeva hi velav bat yerushsha hi
Aval achat bechayyav veachat bemoto veha dilachar mita yoledet zachar hi ema lechush leintzoye ka mashma lan
Matni mi shehaya nasuy shette nashim vametu veachar kach met hu vitomim mevakkeshin ketubbat imman veen sham ella shette chetubbot cholkin beshave
Haya sham motar dinar ellu notlim ketubbat imman veellu notlim ketubbat imman
Im amru yetomim anachnu maalim al nichse avinu yafe dinar kede sheyyittelu ketubbat imman en shomin lahen ella shamin et hannechasim bevet din
Hau sham nechasim berauy enan kivmuchzak
Rabbi shimon omer afilu yesh sham nechasim sheen lahem achraut enan kelum ad sheyyihu sham nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut yoter al shette hakketubbot dinar
Gema tanu rabbanan lazo elef velazo chamesh meot im yesh sham motar dinar ellu notlin ketubbat imman veellu notlin ketubbat imman veim lav yachleku beshave
Peshita merubbin venitmaatu kevar zachu bahen yorshin muatin venitrabbu may
Ta shema denichse deve bar tzartzur muatin venitrabbu hao vaato lekammeh derav amram amar lehu zilu payesinhu la ashgachu
Amar lehu i la mefayesitu lehu machena lechu besilva dela mabba dema shadderinhu lekammeh derav nachman amar lahen keshem shemmerubbin venitmaatu
b: Zachu bahen yorshin kach muatin venitrabbu zachu bahen yorshin
Siman elef umea mitzva bichtubba yaakov zakaf sedotav bidvarim asikin
Hahu gavra dahao masseki beh alpa zuze hao leh tere appadne zabbeninhu chada bachamesh mea vachada bachamesh mea ata baal chov tarfa lachada minayehu hadar kataref leidach
Shekal alpa zuze veka azel legabbeh amar leh i shaveya lach alpa zuze lechayye vei la shekol alpa zuze veistallak
Sevar rame bar chama lememar hayenu matnitin im amru yetomim hare anu maalin al nichse avinu yafe dinar
Amar leh rava mi dame hatam it lehu peseda leyatme hacha mi it leh peseda alpa yahev vealpa shakel
Vetirfa bechamma katvinan
Ravina amar bealpa rav avira amar bachamesh mea vehilcheta bachamesh mea
Hahu gavra dahao masseki beh mea zuze hao leh tere kattine deara chad zabbenhu zabbeninhu lechad bechamshin vechad bechamshin ata baal chov tarfa lechad minayehu hadar ata vekataref leidach
Shekal mea zuze vekaazel legabbeh vaamar leh i shaveya lach mea zuze lechayye vei la shekol mea zuze veistallak
Savar rav yosef lememar hayenu matnitin im amru yetomim ku amar leh abbaye mi dame hatam it lehu peseda leyatme hacha may peseda it leh mea yahev mea shakel
Vetirpa bechamma katvinan ravina amar bima rav avira amar bechamshin vehilcheta bechamshin
Hahu gavra dahao masseki beh mea zuze shachev shevak kattina deara dahava shaveya chamshin zuze ata baal chov vekataref leh azul yatme yehavu leh chamshin zuze hadar kataref lah
Ato lekammeh deabbaye amar lahen mitzva al hayetomim lifroa chov avihen hane kammae mitzva avditu hashta ki taref bedin kataref
Vela amaran dela amaru leh hane chamshin zuze deme deara kattina aval amaru leh hane chamshin zuze deme ara kattina salloke sallekuh
Hahu gavra dezabbenah lichtubbetah deimeh betovat hanaa vaamar leh i atya em umarara la mefatztzena lach
Shechiva imeh vela iarara vaata ihu veka mearar sevar rame bar chama lememar ihu bimkom imeh kae amar leh rava nehi deachraut didah la kabbel aleh achraut dideh mi la kabbel
Amar rame bar chama reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beachraut vaata shimon umcharah liruven beachraut

a: Vaata baal chov diruven vekataref leh mineh dina hu deazel shimon umfatztze leh
Amar leh rava nehi deachraut dealma kabbel aleh achraut denafsheh mi kabbel aleh

Umode rava biruven sheyyarash sade miyyaakov umcharah leshimon shello beachraut vaata shimon umcharah liruven beachraut vaata baal chov deyaakov vekataref leh mineh dina hu deazel shimon umfatztze leh mineh
May tama baal chov deyaakov kevaal chov dealma dame
Amar rame bar chama reuven shemmachar sade leshimon beachraut vezakaf alav bemilva umet reuven vaata baal chov diruven vekataref lah mishshimon ufayeseh bezuze
Dina hu deamri leh bene reuven anan mittalteli shevak avun gabbach umittalteli deyatme levaal chov la mishtabedi

Amar rava i pikkeach idach magbe lehu nihalayehu ara vahadar gave lah minayehu kerav nachman deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh yetomim sheggavu karka bechovat avihen baal chov chozer vegove otah mehen
Amar rabba reuven shemmachar kol sedotav leshimon vechazar shimon umachar sade achat lelevi vaata baal chov diruven ratza mizze gove ratza mizze gove
Vela amaran ella dezabbeneh benonit aval zabbeneh idit vezibburit matze amar leh lehachi terachi uzvani ara dela chazya lach
Uvenonit name la amaran ella dela shevak benonit dichotah
b: Aval shevak benonit dichotah matze amar leh hinnachti lach makom ligbot hemennu

Amar abbaye reuven shemmachar sade leshimon beachraut vaata baal chov diruven vekataref lah mineh dina hu deazel reuven umfatztze leh vela matze amar leh lav baal devarim didi atte mishshum deamar leh demappekatte mineh alay hadar
Veika deamri afilu shello beachraut name deamar leh la nicha li detehve leh leshimon taromet alay
Amar abbaye reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beachraut veyatzu alav

a: Asikin ad shello hechzik bah yachol lachazor bo mishshehechzik bah eno yachol lachazor bo mishshum deamar leh chayeta dekitre sevarte vekabbelte umeemat machzek bah mikki dayesh ammitzre
Ika deamri afilu beachraut name deamar leh achvi tirfach vaashallem lach
Matni mi shehaya nasuy shalosh nashim vamet ketubbatah shel zo mane veshel zo matayim veshel zo shelosh meot veen sham ella mane cholkin beshave

Hau sham matayim shel mane notelet chamishshim shel matayim veshel shelosh meot shelosha shelosha shel zahav hau sham shelosh meot shel mane notelet chamishshim veshel matayim mane veshel shelosh meot shishsha shel zahav
Vechen shelosha shehittilu lakkis pichatu o hotiru kach hen cholkin
Gema shel mane notelet chamishshim telatin utlata vetilta hu deit lah
Amar shemuel bechotevet baalat matayim levaalat mane din udvarim en li immach bemane
I hachi ema sefa shel matayim veshel shelosh meot shalosh shalosh shel zahav tema lah ha sallekte nafshich minah
Mishshum deamra lah middin udvarim hu desalliki nafshay
Hau sham shelosh meot vechu
Shel matayim mane shivim vachamishsha hu deit lah
Amar shemuel bechotevet baalat shelosh meot levaalat matayim ulvaalat mane din udvarim en li immachem bemane
Rav yaakov minnehar pekod mishshemeh deravina amar resha bishte tefisot vesefa bishte tefisot
Resha bishte tefisot denaflu shivin vachamishsha bechad zimna umea veesrim vachamishsha bechad zimna
Sefa bishte tefisot denaflu shivim vachamishsha bechad zimna umatayim veesrim vachamishsha bechad zimna
Tanya zo mishnat rabbi natan rabbi omer en ani roe devarav shel rabbi natan beellu ella cholkot beshave
Vechen shelosha shehetilu amar shemuel shenayim shehittilu lechis ze mane veze matayim
b: Hassachar laemtza

Amar rabba mistabbera milteh dishmuel beshor lacharisha veomed lacharisha aval beshor lacharisha veomed litvicha ze notel lefi meotav veze notel lefi meotav verav hamnuna amar afilu shor lacharisha veomed litvicha hassachar laemtza
Metivi shenayim shehittilu lakkis ze mane veze matayim hassachar laemtza may lav beshor lacharisha veomed litvicha utuvta derabba la beshor lacharisha veomed lacharisha
Aval shor lacharisha veomed litvicha may ze notel lefi meotav veze notel lefi meotav addetane sefa lakach ze beshello veze beshello venitarvu ze notel lefi meotav veze notel lefi meotav
Liflog velitne bedideh bamme devarim amurim beshor lacharisha veomed lacharisha aval beshor lacharisha veomed litvicha ze notel lefi meotav veze notel lefi meotav

Hachi name kaamar bamme devarim amurim beshor lacharisha veomed lacharisha aval beshor lacharisha veomed litvicha naase kemi shellakach ze beshello veze beshello venitarvu ze notel lefi meotav veze notel lefi meotav
Tenan vechen shelosha shehittilu lakkis pichatu o hotiru kach hen cholkin
May lav pichatu pichatu mammash hotiru hotiru mammash
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh la hotiru zuze chadte pichatu istera detzonita

Matni mi shehaya nasuy arba nashim vamet harishona kodemet lashsheniyya ushniyya lashshelishit ushlishit larviit verishona nishbaat lashsheniyya ushniyya lashshelishit ushlishit larviit veharviit nifraat shello bishvua ben nannas omer vechi mippene shehi acharona niskeret af hi lo tippara ella bishvua
Hau yotzot kullan beom echad kol hakkodemet lachavertah afilu shaa achat zachta vechach hau kotvin birushalayim shaot hau kullan yotzot beshaa achat veen sham ella mane cholkot beshave
Gema bemay kamipalgi amar shemuel

a: Kegon shennimtzet achat mehen sade sheenah shello uvvaal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava kamipalgi
Tanna kamma savar ma sheggava lo gava
Uven nannas savar ma sheggava gava
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh dechulle alma ma sheggava lo gava vehacha bechayeshinan shemma tachsif kamipalgi
Mar savar chayeshinan shemma tachsif umar savar la chayeshinan shemma tachsif
Abbaye amar deabbaye kashshisha ika benayehu detane abbaye kashshisha yetomim sheamru gedolim veen tzarich lomar ketannim
Tanna kamma let leh deabbaye kashshisha uven nannas it leh deabbaye kashshisha
Amar rav huna hane tere ache utre shuttafe deit lehu dina bahade chad vaazal chad minayehu bahadeh ledina la matze idach lememar leh atte lav baal devarim didi atte ella shelichuteh avad
Ikkela rav nachman lesura shayeluhi ki hay gavena may
Amar lehu matnitin hi harishona nishbaat lashsheniyya ushniyya lashshelishit ushlishit larviit veilu rishona lashshelishit la katane may tama lav mishshum dishlichutah avda
Mi dame hatam shevua leechad ushvua lemea hacha amar ilu ana havay taenna tefe
Vela amaran ella dela iteh bemata aval iteh bemata ibi leh lemete
Ittemar shene shetarot hayyotzim beom echad rav amar cholkin ushmuel amar shuda dedayyane
Lema rav deamar kerabbi meir deamar ede chatima karti
b: Ushmuel deamar kerabbi elazar deamar ede mesira karti
La dechulle alma kerabbi elazar vehacha beha kamipalgi rav savar chalukka adifa ushmuel savar shuda dedayyane adifa

Umi matzet mokmatte leh lerav kerabbi elazar vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav halacha kerabbi elazar begitin ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar af bishtarot mikkelal derav savar bishtarot la ella mechavarta rav kerabbi meir ushmuel kerabbi elazar
Metivi shene shetarot hayyotzim beom echad cholkin teuvta dishmuel amar lach shemuel ha manni rabbi meir hi vaana daamari kerabbi elazar
I rabbi meir ema sefa katav leechad umasar leacher ze shemmasar lo kana vei rabbi meir ammay kana haamar ede chatima karti
Tannae hi detanya vachachamim omrim yachloku vechan amru ma sheyyirtze hashshalish yaase
Immeh derame bar chama ketavtinhu lenichsah lerami bar chama betzafra leurta ketavtinhu lemar ukva bar chama

Ata rame bar chama lekammeh derav sheshet okmeh benichse ata mar ukva lekammeh derav nachman okmeh benichse ata rav sheshet lekammeh derav nachman amar leh may tama avad mar hachi amar leh umay tama avad mar hachi
Amar leh dikdem amar leh attu birushalayim yatvinan dechatvinan shaot ella mar may tama avad hachi amar leh shuda dedayyane
Amar leh ana name shuda dedayyane amar leh chada daana dayyana umar lav dayyana veod meikara lav betorat hachi atet lah
Hanhu tere shetare daato lekammeh derav yosef chad hava katuv bechamsha benisan vechad hava katuv beh benisan setama okmeh rav yosef lehahu dechamsha benisan binchasim
Amar leh idach vaana afsed amar leh atte yadcha al hattachtona ema bar esrim vetisha benisan atte
Amar leh venichtov li mar

a: Tirfa meiyyar veelach amar leh yachli lememar lach atte bar chad benisan atte
May takkanteh nichtevu harshaa lahadade

Matni mi shehaya nasuy shette nashim umachar et sadehu vechatva rishona lallokeach din udvarim en li immach hashsheniyya motzia mehallokeach verishona min hashsheniyya vehallokeach min harishona vechozrot chalila ad sheyyaasu peshara benehem vechen baal chov vechen ishsha baalat chov
Gema vechi katva leh may have vehatanya haomer lachavero din udvarim en li al sade zo veen li esek bah veyaday mesullakot hemenna lo amar kelum hacha bemay askinan beshekkanu miyyadah
Vechi kanu miyyadah may have tema nachat ruach asiti levali mi la tenan lakach min haish vechazar velakach min haishsha mikkacho batel alma yechola hi shettomar nachat ruach asiti levali
Amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda la kashya ha rabbi meir ha rabbi yehuda
Detanya katav larishon velo chatma lo lashsheni vechatma lo ibda ketubbatah divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda omer yechola hi shettomar nachat ruach asiti levali attem ma lachem alay
Verabbi satem lah hacha kerabbi meir vesatem lah hatam kerabbi yehuda
Amar rav pappa bigrusha vedivre hakkol

Rav ashe amar kullah rabbi meir hi vead kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella bishne lakochot deamri lah i ita denachat ruach avadte lekamma ibi lach lemibad aval belokeach echad afilu rabbi meir mode umatnitin dichtav leh leacher
Tenan hatam en nifrain minnechasim meshubadim bimkom sheyyesh nechasim bene chorin vaafilu hen ziburit ibaya lehu ishteduf bene chare mahu delitrof mimmeshabedi
Ta shema katav larishon velo chatma lo lashsheni vechatma lo ibda ketubbatah divre rabbi meir
Vei salka datach ishteduf bene chare taref mimmeshabedi nehi deibda ketubbatah mishsheni merishon miha tigbe
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak may ibda ibda mishsheni

Amar rava shette teshuvot baddavar chada deibda ligmare mashma veod tanya lava min haechad umachar nechasav lishnayim vechatav baal chov lelokeach sheni din udvarim en li immach en lo al lokeach rishon kelum mippene sheyyachol lomar hinnachti lecha makom ligbot hemennu
Hatam ihu deafsed nafsheh beyadayim
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe
b: Veha maasim bechol yom dehahu gavra demashken leh pardesa lechavreh laasar shenin vekash lachamesh shenin vaata lekammayehu derabbanan uchtavu leh tirfa
Hatam name inhu hu deafsidu annafshayehu kevan dahao yadi defardesa aved dekish la ibi lehu lemizban
Vehilcheta ishteduf bene chare tarfa mimmeshabedi
Amar abbaye nechasay lich veacharayich lifloni veamda veniset baal lokeach have veen leacharayich bimkom baal kelum

Keman ki hay tanna detanya nechasay lich veacharayich lifloni yarad harishon umachar hashsheni motzi miyyad hallakochot divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer en lashsheni ella ma sheshshiyyer rishon
Umi amar abbaye hachi vehaamar abbaye ezehu rasha arum ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Mi kaamar tinase nisset kaamar
Veamar abbaye nechasay lich veacharayich lifloni umachra vameta habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot veacharayich miyyad baal velokeach miyyad acharayich umokminan lechullehu bida delokeach
May shena meha ditnan vechozrot chalila ad sheyyaasu peshara benehen hatam it lehu peseda lechullehu hacha lokeach hu deit leh peseda
Azal rafram amar lishmata kammeh derav ashe mi amar abbaye hachi vehaamar abbaye nechasay lich veacharayich lifloni amda veniset baal lokeach have veen leacharayich bimkom baal kelum
Amar leh hatam deamar lah keshehi penuya hacha deamar lah keshehi nesua may kaamar lah acharayich likne baal la likne
Vechen baal chov tana vechen baal chov ushne lakochot
Vechen ishsha baalat chov ushne lakochot
Hadaran alach mi shehaya nasuy
Almana nizonet minnichse yetomim maase yadeha shellahen veen chayyavin bikvuratah yorsheha yorshe chetubbatah chayyavin bikvuratah
Gema ibaya lehu nizonet tenan o hannizonet tenan nizonet tenan uchanshe galil vela saggi dela yahavi lah
O dilma hannizonet tenan uchanshe yehuda vei bau la yahavi lah

a: Ta shema amar rabbi zera amar shemuel metziat almana leatzmah i amratte bishlama hannizonet tenan shappir ella i amratte nizonet tenan niho kevaal ma baal metziat ishsha levalah hacha name metziat ishsha layyorshim
Leolam ema lach nizonet tenan tama may amur rabbanan metziat ishsha levalah dela tehve lah eva hane tehve lehu eva
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina kol melachot shehaishsha osa levalah almana osa layyorshim chutz mimmezigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta veharchatzat panav yadav veraglav
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol melachot shehaeved ose lerabbo talmid ose lerabbo chutz mehattarat lo minal

Amar rava la amaran ella bimkom sheen makkirin oto aval bimkom shemmakkirin oto let lan bah amar rav ashe uvimkom sheen makkirin oto name la amaran ella dela mannach tefillin aval mannach tefillin let lan bah

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan kol hammonea talmido milleshammesho keilu monea mimmennu chesed shenneemar lammas mereehu chased rav nachman bar yitzchak omer af porek mimmennu yirat shamayim shenneemar veyirat shadday yaazov
Amar rabbi elazar almana shettafsa mittaltelin bimzonoteha ma shettafsa tafsa tanya name hachi almana shettafsa mittaltelin bimzonoteha ma shettafsa tafsa
Vechen ki ata rav dimi amar maase bechallato shel rabbi shabbetay shettafsa disakkayya melea maot velo haya koach beyad chachamim lehotzi miyyadah
Amar ravina vela amaran ella limzone aval lichtubba mappekinan minah
Matkef lah mar bar rav ashe may shena lichtubba demimmekarkee vela mimmittalteli mezonot name mimmekarkee vela mimmittalteli ella limzone may detafsa tafsa hachi name lichtubba
Amar leh rav yitzchak bar naftali leravina hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava keotach
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshemeh derabbi yose ben zimra almana sheshshahata shettayim veshalosh shanim velo tava mezonot ibda mezonot
Hashta shettayim ibda shalosh mibaya la kashya kan baaniyya kan baashira
I name kan bifrutza kan bitznua
Amar rava la amaran ella lemafrea aval lehabba yesh lah
Bae rabbi yochanan yetomim omrim natannu vehi omeret lo natalti al mi lehavi reaya
b: Nichse bechezkat yatme kayemi veal almana lehavi reaya o dilma nichse bechezkat almana kayemi veal hayetomim lehavi reaya
Ta shema detane levi almana kol zeman shello niset al hayetomim lehavi reaya niset aleha lehavi reaya
Amar rav shimi bar ashe ketannae mocheret vechotevet ellu limzonot macharti veellu lichtubba macharti divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer mocheret vechotevet setam vechen kochah yafe

May lav beha kamipalgi lerabbi yehuda deamar bae lefaroshe savar nichse bechezkat yatme kayemi veal haalmana lehavi reaya verabbi yose savar la bae lefaroshe nichse bechezkat almana kayemi veal hayetomim lehavi reaya
Mimmay dilma dechulle alma nichse bechezkat almana kayemi veal hayetomim lehavi reaya verabbi yehuda etza tova ka mashma lan dela likro lah raavtanuta

Dei la tema hachi ha devae rabbi yochanan tifshot leh mimmatnitin mocheret limzonot shello bevet din vechotevet ellu limzonot macharti ella mimmatnitin leka lemishma minah deetza tova ka mashma lan hachi name etza tova ka mashma lan

I name dechulle alma nichse bechezkat yatme kayemi vehayenu tama derabbi yose kidabbaye kashshisha deamar abbaye kashshisha mashal derabbi yose lema haddavar dome lishchiv mera sheamar tenu matayim zuz lifloni baal chovi ratza bechovo notlan ratza bemattana notlan

a: Im bemattana notlan lo kach yafe kocho

Ketzad mocheret amar rabbi daniel bar rav kattina amar rav huna mocheret achat lishnem asar chodesh velokeach mefarnes achat lishloshim yom verav yehuda amar mocheret leshishsha chodashim velokeach mefarnes achat lishloshim yom
Tanya keoteh derav huna mocheret lishnem asar chodesh velokeach mefarnes achat lishloshim yom tanya keoteh derav yehuda mocheret leshishsha chodashim velokeach mefarnes achat lishloshim yom
Amar ammemar hilcheta mocheret leshishsha chodashim velokeach mefarnes achat lishloshim yom amar leh rav ashe leammemar derav huna may amar leh la shemia li kelomar la sevira li
Beo mineh merav sheshet mocheret limzonot mahu shettachazor vetitrof lichtubba
Kamibaya lehu bidrav yosef deamar rav yosef armalta dezabben achraut ayyatme uve dina dezabben achraut ayyatme may
Kevan deachraut ayyatme tarfa o dilma matze amri lah nehi deachraut dealma la kabbelte ilavach achraut denafshach mi la kabbole kabbelte
Amar leh tenetuha mocheret veholechet ad kede chetubbatah vesemech lah shettigbe ketubbatah min hashshear shema minah shayyara in la shayyara la
Vedilma etza tova ka mashma lan dela likro lah hadranita im ken litne gova ketubbatah min hashshear may semech lah shema minah shayyara in la shayyara la
Ibaya lehu zabben vela itzterichu leh zuze hadri zevine o la hadri zevine
Ta shema dehahu gavra dezabben ara lerav pappa deitzterichu leh zuze lemizban tore lesof la itzterichu leh veahderah nihaleh rav pappa leareh rav pappa lifnim mishshurat haddin hu daavad
Ta shema dehahu bitztzurta dahavat binhardea zabbeninhu kulle alma leappadnayehu lesof ato chite amar lehu rav nachman dina hu dehadri appadne lemarayehu
Hatam name zevine betaut hao deigallay milta dearba beikkule hava kayema
I hachi hayenu daamar leh rame bar shemuel lerav nachman im ken nimtzeta machshilan leatid lavo amar leh attu kol yoma bitztzurta shechicha amar leh in bitztzurta binhardea mishkach shechicha
Vehilcheta zabben vela itzterichu leh zuze hadri zevine
Matni almana ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin mocheret shello bevet din
Rabbi shimon omer min hannissuin mocheret shello bevet din min haerusin lo timkor ella bevet din mippene sheen lah mezonot vechol sheen lah mezonot lo timkor ella bevet din
Gema bishlama min hannissuin mishshum mezone
b: Ella min haerusin may tama amar ulla mishshum china rabbi yochanan amar lefi sheen adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din
May benayehu ika benayehu gerusha leman deamar mishshum china gerusha name baaya chen leman deamar lefi sheen adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din gerusha la ichpat leh
Tenan ugrusha lo timkor ella bevet din bishlama leman deamar lefi sheen adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din gerusha la ichpat leh ella leman deamar mishshum china gerusha name baaya chen
Ha manni rabbi shimon hi
I rabbi shimon ha tena leh resha min haerusin lo timkor ku
Mahu detema almana min haerusin hu dela nefish chen didah aval gerusha dinfish chen didah ema tibe chen
Ha name tenena kol sheen lah mezonot leetoye may lav leetoye gerusha
La leetoye megoreshet veenah megoreshet kidrabbi zera deamar rabbi zera kol makom sheamru megoreshet veenah megoreshet baal chayyav bimzonoteha

Ta shema keshem shemmocheret shello bevet din kach yorsheha yorshe chetubbatah mochrim shello bevet din bishlama leman deamar lefi sheen adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din ki hechi deihi la nicha leh detitbazze yorsheha name la nicha leh delibazzu ella leman deamar mishshum china yorsheha may chen ika targemah ulla kegon sheyerashatta bittah o achotah

Matni machra ketubbatah o miktzatah mishkena ketubbatah o miktzatah natna ketubbatah leacher o miktzatah lo timkor et hashshear ella bevet din vachachamim omrim mocheret hi afilu arbaa vachamishsha peamim umocheret limzonot shello bevet din vechotevet limzonot macharti ugrusha lo timkor ella bevet din

Gema matnitin manni rabbi shimon hi detanya machra ketubbatah mishkena ketubbatah asta ketubbatah appoteke leacher en lah mezonot divre rabbi meir rabbi shimon omer af al pi shello machra velo mishkena ketubbatah ella machatzitah ibbeda mezonoteha
Lememra derabbi shimon savar dela amrinan miktzat kesef kechol kesef verabbanan savri amrinan miktzat kesef kechol kesef
Ha ipcha shaminan lehu detanya vehu ishsha bivtuleha perat levogeret shekkalu betuleha divre rabbi meir rabbi elazar verabbi shimon machshirin bevogeret
Hatam bikrae peligi rabbi meir savar betula afilu miktzat betulim betuleha ad deika kullehu betulim bivtuleha bichdarkah in shello kedarkah la
Rabbi elazar verabbi shimon savri betula shelema mashma betuleha afilu miktzat betulim

a: Bivtuleha sheyehu kol betuleha kayemin ben bichdarkah ben shello kedarkah
Hahi itta ditfasa kasa dechaspa bichtubbetah katava mezone atay lekammeh derava amar lehu leyatme zilu havu lah mezonot let dechash leha derabbi shimon deamar la amrinan miktzat kesef kechol kesef
Shelach leh rabba bereh derava lerav yosef mocheret shello bevet din tzericha shevua o en tzericha shevua vetibbee lach hachraza
Amar leh hachraza la kamibaya li deamar rabbi zera amar rav nachman almana sheshshama leatzmah lo asta velo kelum
Hechi dame i deachruz ammay lo asta velo kelum ella lav dela achruz ulatzmah hu delo asta velo kelum ha leacher ma sheasta asta
Leolam deachruz udamri lah man sham lich
Ki hay dehahu gavra deafkidu gabbeh kista deyatme azal shamah lenafsheh bearba mea zuze iyyakar kam beshet mea
Ata lekammeh derabbi amme amar leh man sham lach
Vehilcheta tzericha shevua veenah tzericha hachraza
Matni almana shehayeta ketubbatah matayim umachra shave mane bematayim o shave matayim bemane nitkabbela ketubbatah
Hayeta ketubbatah mane umachra shave mane vedinar bemane michrah batel afilu hi omeret achzir dinar layyorshin machra batel
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer leolam michrah kayyam ad shettehe sham kede shetteshayyer besade bat tisha kabbin uvginna bat chatzi kav uchdivre rabbi akiva bet rova
Hayeta ketubbatah arba meot zuz umachra laze bemane velaze bemane velaacharon yafe mane vedinar bemane shel acharon batel veshel kullan michran kayyam
Gema may shena shave matayim bemane deamri lah atte afsedte shave mane bematayim name tema ana arvachna
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh
b: Kan shana rabbi hakkol levaal hammaot kidtanya hosifu lo achat yetera hakkol lashshaliach divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer cholkin
Vehatanya rabbi yose omer hakkol levaal hammaot amar rame bar chama la kashya kan bedavar sheyyesh lo kitzva kan bedavar sheen lo kitzva
Amar rav pappa hilcheta davar sheyyesh lo kitzva cholkin davar sheen lo kitzva hakkol levaal hammaot may ka mashma lan shinuya deshanninan shinuya hu
Ibaya lehu amar leh zabben li litka vaazal vezabben leh kora may mosif al devarav hu velitka miha kane o dilma maavir al devarav hu velitka name la kane
Amar rav yaakov minnehar pekod mishshemeh deravina ta shema amar baal habbayit lishlucho ten lahen chaticha laorchin vehu omer telu shettayim vehen natlu shalosh kullan maalu

I amratte bishlama mosif al devarav have mishshum hachi baal habbayit maal ella i amratte maavir al devarav have baal habbayit ammay maal vehatnan hashshaliach sheasa shelichuto baal habbayit maal lo asa shelichuto shaliach maal
Hacha bemay askinan deamar lehu telu achat middato shel baal habbayit veachat middati ushkalu inhu telat
Ta shema hayeta ketubbatah mane umachra shave mane vedinar bemane michrah batel
May lav dezabben shave mane vedinar bemane vedinar umay bemane mane shellah umay afilu afilu hi omeret achzir et haddinar layyorshim bedinar mekarkee vekatane michrah batel
Amar rav huna bereh derav natan la bidozel

a: Ha middesefa bidozel have resha bidla ozel dekatane sefa hayeta ketubbatah arba meot zuz machra laze bemane velaze bemane velaacharon yafe mane vedinar bemane shel acharon michrah batel veshel kullan michran kayyam
La resha vesefa bidozel vesefa ha ka mashma lan tama deozel bidyatme aval bedidah michrah kayyam
Ha midderesha shamatte minah hayeta ketubbatah matayim umachra shave mane bematayim o shave matayim bemane nitkabbela ketubbatah
Mahu detema hatam hu deistallaka lah mehay beta ligmare aval hacha nigzor mane rishon attu mane acharon ka mashma lan
Veika deamri ha la tibe lach hecha daamar leh zil zabben li litka vezabben leh kora devadday mosif al devarav have
Ki tibe lach daamar leh zil zabben li kora vaazal vezabben leh litka may mi amrinan amar leh detava lach avadi lach dei la mitztarchi lach zuze la matzet hadratte beh
O dilma amar leh la nicha li delipushu shetare ilavay
Amar rabbi chanina missura ta shema natan lo dinar shel zahav veamar lo have li chaluk vehalach vehevi lo beshalosh chaluk uvshalosh tallit shenehem maalu
I amratte bishlama sheliach ki hay gavena ose shelichuto umosif al devarav have mishshum hachi baal habbayit maal ella i amratte maavir al devarav have ammay maal
Hacha bemay askinan deayeti leh shave shesh beshalosh
I hachi shaliach ammay maal attallit
I hachi ema sefa rabbi yehuda omer af baze baal habbayit lo maal mippene sheyyachol lomar chaluk gadol hayiti mevakkesh veatta heveta li chaluk katan vara
May ra ra bedamim deamar leh i ayetet li beshet kol shekken dahava shave tarte sere
Dayeka name dekatane mode rabbi yehuda bekitnit sheshshenehem maalu
b: Shehakkitnit besela vekitnit bifruta shema minah
Hechi dame ilema beatra dimzabbeni beshuma hecha deyahev leh sela mozli gabbeh tefe
Amar rav pappa beatra dechayeli bechanne deamar leh kanna kanna bifruta
Ta shema hayeta ketubbatah arba meot zuz machra laze bemane velaze bemane velaacharon yafe mane vedinar bemane shel acharon batel veshel kullan michran kayyam
Kidamar rav shisha bereh derav idi bekattine hacha name bekattine
Peshita amar leechad velo lishnayim haamar leh leechad velo lishnayim amar leh leechad setama may
Rav huna amar leechad velo lishnayim rav chisda verabba bar rav huna deamri tarvayehu leechad vaafilu lishnayim leechad vaafilu lemea
Ikla rav nachman lesura ul legabbeh rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amaru leh ki hay gavena may amar lehu leechad vaafilu lishnayim leechad vaafilu lemea
Amaru leh af al gav dita shaliach amar lehu dita shaliach la kaamena amaru leh vehaamar mar en onaa lekarkaot
Hane mile hecha dita baal habbayit aval tea shaliach amar leh letakkone shaddartacha vela leauote
Umna temra deshane ben shaliach levaal habbayit
Ditnan haomer lishlucho tze utrom torem kedaat baal habbayit veim eno yodea dato shel baal habbayit torem bevenonit echad mechamishshim pichet asara o hosif asara terumato teruma
Veilu gabbe baal habbayit tanya taram veala beyado afilu echad meesrim terumato teruma
Ta shema hayeta ketubbatah arba meot zuz machra laze bemane velaze bemane velaacharon shave mane vedinar bemane shel acharon batel veshel kullan michran kayyam
Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi bekattine
Matni shum haddayyanin sheppichatu shetut o hosifu shetut michran batel
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer michran kayyam im ken ma koach bet din yafe aval im asu iggeret bikkoret benehen afilu machru shave mane bematayim o shave matayim bemane michran kayyam
Gema ibaya lehu shaliach keman

a: Rava amar rav nachman shaliach kedayyanin rav shemuel bar bisna amar rav nachman kealmana
Rava amar rav nachman shaliach kedayyanin ma dayyanin lav ledidhu af shaliach name lav ledideh leappoke almana dildidah
Rav shemuel bar bisna amar rav nachman kealmana ma almana yechida af shaliach yachid leappoke bet din derabbim ninhu vehilcheta shaliach kealmana
Umay shena meha ditnan haomer lishlucho tze utrom torem kedaat baal habbayit veim eno yodea dato shel baal habbayit torem bevenonit echad mechamishshim pichet asara o hosif asara terumato teruma
Hatam kevan deika detorem beayin raa veika detorem beayin yafa amar leh lehachi amadtach aval hacha tauta hu amar leh la ibi lach lemite

Amar rav huna bar chanina amar rav nachman halacha kedivre chachamim velet leh lerav nachman ma koach bet din yafe vehaamar rav nachman amar shemuel yetomim shebbau lachlok benichse avihen bet din maamidin lahen appotroppos uvorrin lahem chelek yafe higdilu yecholin lemachot verav nachman dideh amar higdilu en yecholin lemachot im ken ma koach bet din yafe
La kashya ha dito ha dela teo
I dela teo bemay yecholin lemachot beruchot

Ki ata rav dimi amar maase veasa rabbi kedivre chachamim amar lefanav parta beno shel rabbi elazar ben parta ben beno shel rabbi parta haggadol im ken ma koach bet din yafe vehechzir rabbi et hammaase

Rav dimi matne hachi rav safra matne hachi maase uvikesh rabbi laasot kedivre chachamim amar lefanav parta beno shel rabbi elazar ben parta ben beno shel rabbi parta haggadol im ken ma koach bet din yafe lo asa rabbi et hammaase
Lema beha kamipalgi mar savar taa bidvar mishna chozer umar savar eno chozer
La dechulle alma taa bidvar mishna chozer umar savar hachi hava maase umar savar hachi hava maase
Amar rav yosef armalta dezabbina achraut ayyatme uvet din dezabben achraut ayyatme
Peshita
Almana la itztericha leh ki itzterich leh be dina mahu detema
b: Kol dezaven mibbe dina addata lemipak leh kala hu dezaven ka mashma lan
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ku vead kamma amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet ad palga
Tanya name hachi amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bet din shemmachru shave matayim bemane o shave mane bematayim michran kayyam
Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav yosef bet din shemmachru belo hachraza naasu kemi shettau bidvar mishna vechozrin
Naasu vadday tau ditnan shum hayetomin sheloshim yom veshum hahekdesh shishshim yom umachrizin babboker uvaerev
I mehahi hava amena hane mile shaliach aval bet din la ka mashma lan
Etiveh rav ashe leammemar shum haddayyanin sheppichatu shetut o hotiru shetut michran batel ha shave beshave michran kayyam may lav dela achruz la bidachruz
Ha middesefa bidachruz have resha bidla achruz dekatane sefa im asu iggeret bikkoret afilu machru shave mane bematayim o shave matayim bemane michran kayyam
Ella leolam bidla achruz vela kashya kan bidvarim shemmachrizin alehen kan bidvarim sheen machrizin alehen
Veellu hen devarim sheen machrizin alehen haavadim vehammittaltelin vehashshetarot avadim tama may shemma yishmeu veyivrechu mittaltelin ushtarot shemma yigganvu
Veibaet ema kan beshaa shemmachrizin kan beshaa sheen machrizin
Deamri nehardae lichraga limzone velikvura mezabbeninan bela achrazta
Veibaet ema kan bimkom shemmachrizin kan bimkom sheen machrizin deamar rav nachman meolam lo asu iggeret bikkoret binhardea
Sevur minah mishshum divkie beshuma amar leh rav yosef bar minome ledidi miparsha li mineh derav nachman mishshum dekaru lehu bene achli nichse deachrazta
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mittaltelin shel yetomim shamin otan umochrin otan lealtar rav chisda amar avimi mochrin otan lishvakim
Vela peligi ha dimkarav shuka ha dimrachak shuka
Rav kahana hava bideh shichra derav mesharsheya bar chilkay yatma shahayeh ad rigla amar af al gav denafel beh itztzata mayete zuza charifa
Ravina hava bideh chamra deravina zute yatma bar achateh hava ledideh name chamra hava kamassek leh lesichra
Ata lekammeh derav ashe amar leh mahu leamtoye bahadan amar leh zil la adif middidach
Matni hammaenet hashsheniyya vehaayelonit en lahen ketubba velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot
Im mittechilla nesaah leshem ayelonit yesh lah ketubba
Almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot mamzeret untina leyisrael bat yisrael lenatin ulmamzer yesh lahem ketubba
Gema rav tane ketanna yotza beget en lah ketubba vechol shekken memaenet
Shemuel tane memaenet en lah ketubba aval yotza beget yesh lah ketubba
Veazda shemuel letameh deamar shemuel memaenet en lah ketubba yotza beget yesh lah ketubba
Memaenet lo pesalah min haachin velo pesalah min hakkehunna yotza beget pesalah min haachin ufsalah min hakkehunna
Memaenet enah tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim

a: Yotza beget tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim
May ka mashma lan tenena kullehu hammaenet beish hu muttar bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav velo pesalah min hakkehunna natan lah get hu asur bikrovoteha vehi asura bikrovav ufsalah min hakkehunna
Tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim itztericha leh dela tenan

Lema ketannae rabbi eliezer omer en maase ketanna kelum veen balah zakkay bimtziatah velo bemaase yadeha velo bahafarat nedareha veeno yorshah veeno mitamme lah kelalo shel davar enah keishto lechol davar ella shetztzericha meun
Rabbi yehoshua omer maase ketanna kelum uvalah zakkay bimtziatah uvmaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha veorshah umitamme lah kelalo shel davar hare hi keishto lechol davar ella sheyyotza bemeun
Lema rav deamar kerabbi eliezer ushmuel deamar kerabbi yehoshua
Alliba derabbi eliezer kulle alma la peligi
Ki peligi alliba derabbi yehoshua shemuel kerabbi yehoshua verav ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam ella middidah ledideh aval middideh ledidah la
Velo belaot amar leh rav huna bar chiyya lerav kahana amarte lan mishshemeh dishmuel lo shanu ella nichse melog aval nichse tzon barzel it lah
Have bah rav pappa aheya ilema ammemaenet i deitanhu ide veide shakla vei deletanhu ide veidi la shakla
Ella aayelonit i deitanhu ide veide shakla i deletanhu ipcha mibe leh nichse melog devirshutah kayemi it lah nichse tzon barzel delav birshutah kayemi let lah
Ella ashsheniyya uknasu rabbanan ledidah bedideh uldideh bedidah
Amar rav shimi bar ashe shema minah midderav kahana ayyila leh gelima karna have vela mikkasse lah veazel ad devale
Vehaamar rav nachman pera have derav nachman peliga
En lahen ketubba amar shemuel lo shanu ella mane matayim aval tosefet yesh lahen
Tanya name hachi nashim sheamru chachamim en lahen ketubba kegon hammaenet vechavroteha en lahen mane matayim aval tosefet yesh lahen
Nashim sheamru chachamim yotzot shello bichtubba kegon overet al dat vechavroteha en lahen tosefet vechol shekken mane matayim vehayyotzet mishshum shem ra notelet ma shellefaneha veotza
Mesayya leh lerav huna deamar rav huna zinta lo hifsida
b: Belaoteha kayyamin
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman zinta hifsida belaoteha kayyamin amar leh im hi zinta keleha mi zannay tane lo hifsida belaoteha kayyamin
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi menachem setimtaa aval chachamim omrim zinta lo hifsida belaoteha kayyamin
Im mittechilla nasa ku amar rav huna ayelonit ishsha veenah ishsha almana ishsha gemura
Ayelonit ishsha veenah ishsha hikkir bah yesh lah ketubba lo hikkir bah en lah ketubba almana ishsha gemura ben hikkir bah ben lo hikkir bah yesh lah ketubba
Verav yehuda omer achat zo veachat zo ishsha veenah ishsha hikkir bah yesh lah ketubba lo hikkir bah en lah ketubba
Metivi kenasah bechezkat shehi ken venimtzet shehi ken yesh lah ketubba ha setama en lah ketubba
La tema ha setama en lah ketubba ella ema kenasah bechezkat sheenah ken venimtzet shehi ken en lah ketubba
Aval setama may it lah addetane bechezkat shehi ken venimtzet shehi ken yesh lah ketubba lashmeinan setama vechol shekken ha
Veod tane kenasah beyadua venimtzet beyadua yesh lah ketubba kenasah setam en lah ketubba teuvta derav huna
Rav huna matnitin atiteh hu savar middeka mefalleg beayelonit vela kamfalleg bealmana mikkelal dealmana afilu bistama name it lah vela hi ki katane lah lealmana appelugta deayelonit kae
Hadaran alach almana nizonet
Hannose et haishsha ufaska immo kede sheyyazun et bittah chamesh shanim chayyav lezunah chamesh shanim
Niset leacher ufaska immo kede sheyyazun et bittah chamesh shanim chayyav lezunah chamesh shanim lo yomar harishon lichshettavo etzli ezunah ella molich lah mezonoteha lammakom sheimmah
Vechen lo yomru shenehem hare anu zanin otah keechad ella echad zana veechad noten lah deme mezonot
Niset habbaal noten lah mezonot vehen notnin lah deme mezonot metu benotehen nizonot minnechasim bene chorin vehi nizonet minnechasim meshubadim mippene shehi kevaalat chov
Happikkechim hau kotvim al menat sheazun et bittech chamesh shanim kol zeman sheatte immi
Gema ittemar haomer lachavero chayyav ani lecha mane rabbi yochanan amar chayyav veresh lakish amar patur
Hechi dame i deamar lehu attem eday may tama deresh lakish dekafatar i dela amar lehu attem eday may tama derabbi yochanan dekamchayyev

Leolam dela kaamar lehu attem eday vehacha bemay askinan deamar leh chayyav ani lecha mane bishtar rabbi yochanan amar chayyav allima milta dishtara keman deamar lehu attem edim dame resh lakish amar patur la allima milta dishtara
Tenan hannose et haishsha ufaska immo lazun et bittah chamesh shanim chayyav lezunah chamesh shanim may lav ki hay gavena

a: La bishtare fesikata vechidrav gidel
Deamar rav gidel amar rav kamma atta noten levincha kach vechach vechamma atta noten levittecha kach vechach amdu vekidshu kanu hen hen haddevarim hanniknin baamira
Ta shema katav lechohen sheani chayyav lecha chamesh selaim chayyav liten lo chamesh selaim uvno eno paduy
Shane hatam dimshubad leh middeorayeta i hachi ammay katav kede levarer lo kohen
I hachi beno ammay eno paduy kidulla deamar ulla devar tora paduy lichsheyyitten umay tama amru beno eno paduy gezera shemma yomru podin bishtarot
Amar rava ketannae arev hayyotze achar chitum shetarot gove minnechasim bene chorin
Maase ba lifne rabbi yishmael veamar gove minnechasim bene chorin amar lo ben nannas eno gove lo minnechasim bene chorin velo minnechasim meshubadim
Amar lo lamma amar lo hare shehaya chonek et chavero bashshuk umtzao chavero veamar lo hannach lo vaani etten lach patur shello al emunato hilvahu
Lema rabbi yochanan deamar kerabbi yishmael veresh lakish deamar keven nannas
Alliba deven nannas kulle alma la peligi
b: Ki peligi alliba derabbi yishmael rabbi yochanan kerabbi yishmael veresh lakish ad kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael hatam ella deshayech leh leshibuda deorayeta aval hacha la shayech shibuda deorayeta
Gufa amar rav gidel amar rav kamma atta noten levincha kach vechach vechamma atta noten levittecha kach vechach amdu vekidshu kanu hen hen haddevarim hanniknim baamira
Amar rava mistabbera milta derav bevitto naara deka mate hanaa lideh aval bogeret dela mate hanaa lideh la
Vehaelohim amar rav afilu bogeret dei la tema hachi avi habben may hanaa ata lideh ella behahi hanaa dekamichatteni ahadade gamri umakni lahadade
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe devarim hallalu nitnu likatev o lo nitnu likatev amar leh lo nitnu likatev
Etiveh happikchin hau kotvin al menat sheazun et bittech chamesh shanim kol zeman sheatte immi may kotvin omrim
Vekare leh laamira ketiva in vehatnan hakkotev leishto din udvarim en li binchasayich vetane rabbi chiyya haomer leishto
Ta shema en kotvin shetare erusin venissuin ella middaat shenehem ha middaat shenehem kotvin may lav shetare fesikata
La shetare erusin mammash kidrav pappa verav sherevya deitmar ketavo lishmah veshello middatah rabba veravina amri mekuddeshet rav pappa verav sherevya amri enah mekuddeshet
Ta shema metu benotehen nizonot minnechasim bene chorin vehi nizonet minnechasim meshubadim mippene shehi kevaalat chov
Hacha bemay askinan beshekkanu miyyado
I hachi banot name beshekkanu lazo velo kanu lazo
Umay paska ihi dahavay bishat kinyan mahane lah kinyan banot dela hao bishat kinyan la mahane lehu kinyan
Mi la askinan dahavay bishat kinyan vehechi dame kegon degarshah veahderah
Ella ihi deleta bitnay bet din mahane lah kinyan banot deitanhu bitnay bet din la mahane lehu kinyan
Migra gari ella benotav hayenu tama kevan deitanhu bitnay bet din emar tzerare etpesinhu
Lo yomar harishon amar rav chisda zot omeret bat etzel immah
Mimmay devigdola askinan dilma biktanna askinan umishshum maase shehaya

Detanya mi shemmet vehinniach ben katan leimmo yorshe haav omrim yehe gadel etzlenu veimmo omeret yehe beni gadel etzli mannichin oto etzel immo veen mannichin oto etzel rauy leorsho maase haya ushchatuhu erev happesach
Im ken litne lemakom shehi

a: May limkom sheimmah shamatte minah bat etzel haem la shena gedola vela shena ketanna
Lo yomru shenehem vechu
Hahu gavra deogar leh richya lechavreh litchina lesof iattar zeven richya vechamra
Amar leh ad haidana hava tachenna gabbach hashta hav li agra amar leh mitchan tachenna lach
Sevar ravina lememar hayenu matnitin lo yomru shenehem hare anu zanin otah keechad ella echad zanah veechad noten lah deme mezonot
Amar leh rav avira mi dame hatam chad keresa it lah tarte keresata let lah hacha matze amar leh techon vezabben techon veotev
Vela amaran ella delet leh techina lerichya aval it leh techina lerichya kegon zo kofin oto al middat sedom
Matni almana sheamra i efshi lazuz mibbet bali en hayyorshin yecholin lomar lah lechi levet avich veanu zanin otach ella zanin otah venotnin lah mador lefi kevodah
Amra i efshi lazuz mibbet abba yecholin hayyorshin lomar lah im atte etzlenu yesh lich mezonot veim en atte etzlenu en lich mezonot
Im hayeta toenet mippene shehi yalda vehen yeladim zanin otah vehi bevet aviha

Gema tanu rabbanan mishtammeshet bammador kederech shemmishtammeshet bechayye valah baavadim ushfachot kederech shemmishtammeshet bechayye valah becharim uchsatot kederech shemmishtammeshet bechayye valah bichle chesef uvichle zahav kederech shemmishtammeshet bechayye valah shekkach katav lah veatte tehe yatvatte beveti umitazna minnichsay kol yeme megar armelutich beveti
Tane rav yosef beveti velo bevikti
Amar rav nachman yetomim shemmachru medor almana lo asu velo kelum
Umay shena midderabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan yetomim shekkadmu umachru binchasim muatin ma shemmachru machru
Hatam la mishtabedi lah mechayyim hacha mishtabedi lah mechayyim
Amar abbaye nekitinan medor almana shennafal en hayyorshin chayyavin livnoto
Tanya name hachi medor almana shennafal en hayyorshin chayyavin livnoto velo od ella afilu hi omeret hannichuni veevnennu mishshelli en shomin lah
Bae abbaye shiptza may teku
Amra i efshi
Velitvu lah ki yatva hatam mesayya leh lerav huna deamar rav huna birkat habbayit berubba
Velitvu lah lefi birkat habbayit hachi name
Amar rav huna leshon chachamim beracha leshon chachamim osher leshon chachamim marpe beracha ha daamaran
Osher ditnan hammocher perot lachavero mashach velo madad kana madad velo mashach lo kana veim haya pikkeach socher et mekomo
Marpe ditnan lo yilos adam chittin veyanniach al gabbe makkato bappesach mippene shemmachmitzot

Tanu rabbanan bishat petirato shel rabbi amar levanay ani tzarich nichnesu banav etzlo amar lahem hizzaharu bichvod immechem ner yehe daluk bimkomo shulchan yehe aruch bimkomo mitta tehe mutztzaat bimkomah yosef chofni shimon efrati hem shimmeshuni bechayyay vehem yeshammeshuni bemoti
Hizzaharu bichvod immechem deorayeta hi dichtiv kabbed et avicha veet immecha eshet av havay
Eshet av name deorayeta hi detanya kabbed et avicha veet immecha et avicha zo eshet avicha veet immecha zo baal immecha vav yetera lerabbot et achicha haggadol
Hane mile mechayyim aval leachar mita la
Ner yehe daluk bimkomo shulchan yehe aruch bimkomo mitta tehe mutztzaat bimkomah may tama kol be shimshe hava ate leveteh
Hahu be shimsha atay shivavta ka karya abbava amara ammeteh shetiku derabbi yatev kevan dishma shuv la ata shello lehotzi laaz al tzaddikim harishonim
Yosef chofni shimon efrati hem shimmeshuni bechayyay vehem yeshammeshuni bemoti sevur mina behaden alma hu dekaamar kevan dachazo dekadem arsayehu learseh amri shema minah lehahu alma hu dekaamar
Vehay daamar hachi dela lemru milta havay lehu vead haidana name zechuto derabbi hu deahanya lehu
Amar lahen lechachme yisrael ani tzarich nichnesu etzlo chachme yisrael amar lahen al tispeduni baayarot
b: Vehoshivu yeshiva leachar sheloshim yom shimon beni chacham gamliel beni nasi chanina bar chama yeshev barosh
Al tispeduni baayarot sevur minah mishshum tircha hu dekaamar kevan dachazo dekasafdi bichrakkim vekaatu kulle alma amru shema minah mishshum yekara hu dekaamar

Hoshivu yeshiva leachar sheloshim yom dela adifna mimmoshe rabbenu dichtiv vayyivku vene yisrael et moshe bearvot moav sheloshim yom telatin yomin safdin bimama velelya mikkan veelach safdu bimama vegarsi belelya o safdu belelya vegarsi bimama ad desafdi teresar yarche shatta

Hahu yoma deashkavteh derabbi nefaka bat kala vaamara kol dahava beashkavteh derabbi mezumman hu lechayye haolam habba hahu koves kol yoma hava ate kammeh hahu yoma la ata kevan dishma hachi selek leigara unfal leara umit yatzta bat kol veamra af hahu koves mezumman hu lechayye haolam habba
Shimon beni chacham may kaamar hachi kaamar af al pi sheshshimon beni chacham gamliel beni nasi
Amar levi tzericha lememar amar rabbi shimon bar rabbi tzericha lach ulmatlatach may kashya leh ha kera kaamar veet hammamlacha natan lihoram ki hu habbechor
Hahu memalle mekom avotav hava verabban gamliel eno memalle mekom avotav hava
Verabbi may tama avad hachi nehi deeno memalle mekom avotav bechochma beyirat chet memalle mekom avotav hava
Chanina bar chama yeshev barosh lo kibel rabbi chanina shehaya rabbi appas gadol mimmennu shette shanim umechetza yetev rabbi appas beresha vitev rabbi chanina abbaray vaata levi vitev gabbeh

Nach nafsheh derabbi appas vitev rabbi chanina beresha vela hava leh lelevi inish lemetav gabbeh vekaate levavel vehayenu deamri leh lerav gavra rabba ikkela linhardea umatla vedaresh kelila shere amar shema minah nach nafsheh derabbi appas vitev rabbi chanina beresha vela hava leh lelevi inish lemetav gabbeh vekaate
Veema rabbi chanina nach nafsheh verabbi appas keditev yetev vela hava leh lelevi inish lemetav gabbeh vekaate ibaet ema levi lerabbi appas mikaf hava kayif leh
Vei baet ema kevan deamar rabbi chanina bar chama yeshev barosh la saggi dela malech dichtiv behu betzaddikim vetigzar omer veyakom lach
Veha hava rabbi chiyya nach nafsheh vehaamar rabbi chiyya ani raiti kivro shel rabbi vehoradti alav demaot efoch
Vehaamar rabbi chiyya oto hayyom shemmet rabbi batla kedushsha efoch

Vehatanya keshechala rabbi nichnas rabbi chiyya etzlo umtzao shehu boche amar lo rabbi mippene ma atta boche vehatanya met mittoch hassechok siman yafe lo mittoch habbechi siman ra lo panav lemala siman yafe lo panav lematta siman ra lo panav kelappe haam siman yafe lo kelappe hakkotel siman ra lo panav yerukkin siman ra lo panav tzehubbin vaadummim siman yafe lo met beerev shabbat siman yafe lo bemotzae shabbat siman ra lo met beerev yom hakkippurim siman ra lo bemotzae yom hakkippurim siman yafe lo met mecholi meayim siman yafe lo mippene sherubbam shel tzaddikim mitatan becholi meayim
Amar leh ana attora umitzot ka vachena
Ibaet ema efoch veibaet ema leolam la tefoch rabbi chiyya asuk bemitzot hava verabbi savar la afaggereh
Vehayenu dechi hao mintzu rabbi chanina verabbi chiyya amar leh rabbi chanina lerabbi chiyya bahade didi mintzet deim chas veshalom nishtakkecha tora miyyisrael mahdarna leh mippilpulay

Amar leh rabbi chiyya ana avadi dela mishtachcha tora miyyisrael deayetina kitana veshadeyna umgaddelna nishbe vetzayedna teve umaachelna bisra leyatme vearechna megilta mimmashche ditve vesalekna lemata delet bah makre dardeke vechatevna chamsha chumshe lechamsha yanoke umatnena shita sidre leshita yanoke lechol chad vechad amari leh atni sidrach lechavrach

Vehayenu deamar rabbi kamma gedolim maase chiyya amar leh rabbi shimon berabbi afilu mimmecha amar leh in amar leh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose afilu meabba amar leh chas veshalom lo tehe kazot beyisrael
Amar lahen livni katan ani tzarich nichnas rabbi shimon etzlo masar lo sidre chochma
Amar lahen livni gadol ani tzarich nichnas rabban gamliel etzlo umasar lo sidre nesiut amar lo beni nehog nesiutach beramim zerok mara battalmidim
Ini veha ketiv veet yire Adonai yechabbed veamar mar ze yehoshafat melech yehuda keshehaya roe talmid chacham haya omed mikkisseo umchabbeko umnashsheko vekore lo rabbi rabbi mari mari
La kashya ha betzina ha befarhesya
Tanya rabbi mutal betzipori umakom muchan lo bevet shearim vehatanya tzedek tzedek tirdof hallech achar rabbi levet shearim
Rabbi bevet shearim hava ella kevan dachalash amteuhi letzipori

a: Demiddalya uvsim avera
Hahu yoma denach nafsheh derabbi gezaru rabbanan taanita uvo rachame veamri kol man deamar nach nafsheh derabbi yiddaker bacherev

Selika ammeteh derabbi leigara amra elonim mevakkeshin et rabbi vehattachtonim mevakkeshin et rabbi yehi ratzon sheyyachofu tachtonim et haelonim kevan dachazay kamma zimne deayel levet hakkisse vechalatz tefilin umannach lehu vekamitztaar amara yehi ratzon sheyyachofu elonim et hattachtonim
Vela hao shatki rabbanan millemive rachame shakla kuza shadya meigara leara ishtiku merachame venach nafsheh derabbi

Amaru leh rabbanan levar kappara zil ayyen azal ashkecheh denach nafsheh kareh lilvusheh veahdereh lekireh laachoreh petach vaamar erellim umtzukim achazu baaron hakkodesh nitztzechu erellim et hammetzukim venishba aron hakkodesh amaru leh nach nafsheh amar lehu attun kaamritu vaana la kaamena

Bishat petirato shel rabbi zakaf eser etzbeotav kelappe mala amar ribbono shel olam galuy veyadua lefanecha sheyyagati beeser etzbeotay battora velo neheneti afilu beetzba ketanna yehi ratzon millefanecha sheyehe shalom bimnuchati yatzta bat kol veamra yavo shalom yanuchu al mishkevotam

Al mishkavcha mibe leh mesayyea leh lerabbi chiyya bar gammada deamar rabbi chiyya bar gammada amar rabbi yose ben shaul beshaa shehatztzaddik niftar min haolam omrim malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam tzaddik peloni ba omer lahem yavou tzaddikim veyetzu likrato veomrim lo yavo beshalom yanuchu al mishkevotam

Amar rabbi elazar beshaa shehatztzaddik niftar min haolam shalosh kitot shel malache hashsharet yotzot likrato achat omeret lo bo beshalom veachat omeret holech nichcho veachat omeret lo yavo shalom yanuchu al mishkevotam beshaa sheharasha neevad min haolam shalosh kitot shel malache chabbala yotzot likrato achat omeret en shalom amar Adonai larshaim veachat omeret lo lemaatzeva yishkav veachat omeret lo reda vehoshkeva et arelim

Matni kol zeman shehi bevet aviha gova ketubbatah leolam kol zeman shehi bevet balah gova ketubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim sheyyesh beesrim vechamesh shanim shettaase tova keneged ketubbatah divre rabbi meir sheamar mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel
Vachachamim omrim kol zeman shehi bevet balah gova ketubbatah leolam kol zeman shehi bevet aviha gova ketubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim
Meta yorsheha mazkirin ketubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim
Gema amar leh abbaye lerav yosef aniyya shebbeyisrael ad esrim vechamesh shanim umarta bat bayetos ad esrim vechamesh shanim
Amar leh lefum gamla shichna
Ibaya lehu lerabbi meir mahu shetteshallesh teku
Vachachamim omrim kol zeman amar leh abbaye lerav yosef atay kodem shekiat hachamma gova ketubbatah leachar shekiat hachamma la gavya behahi purta acheltah
Amar leh in kol middat chachamim ken hi bearbaim sea tovel bearbaim sea chaser kurtov eno yachol litbol bahen

Amar rav yehuda amar rav heid rabbi yishmael berabbi yose lifne rabbi sheamar mishshum aviv lo shanu ella sheen shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadeha aval shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadeha gova ketubbatah leolam verabbi elazar amar afilu shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadeha enah gova ella ad esrim vechamesh shanim
Metiv rav sheshet baal chov gove shello behazkara hechi dame i dela naket shetara bemay gave ella denaket shetara uvaal chov hu delav bar achole hu ha almana acheltah
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah leolam dela naket shetara vehacha bemay askinan keshechayyav mode
Vehaamar rabbi ila shonin gerusha hare hi kevaal chov hechi dame i dela nekita ketubba bemay gavya ella lav dinkita ketubba ugrusha hi delav bat achole hi ha almana acheltah
Hacha name keshechayyav mode
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak tane rav yehuda bar kaza bematnita deve bar kaza tava ketubbatah
b: Hare hi kevattechilla veim haya shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadeha gova ketubbatah leolam

Shelach leh rav nachman bar rav chisda lerav nachman bar yaakov yelammedenu rabbenu kesheshshetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah machloket o kesheen shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah vahalacha kedivre mi
Shelach leh besheen shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah machloket aval shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah gova ketubbatah leolam vahalacha kedivre chachamim
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara lo shanu ella mane matayim aval tosefet yesh lah
Verabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan afilu tosefet en lah deamar rabbi ayevu amar rabbi yannay tenay ketubba kichtubba dame
Ittemar name amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav lo shanu ella mane matayim aval tosefet yesh lah
Amar leh rabbi abba lerav huna amar rav hachi amar leh ishtikn kaamratte o ashkeyan kaamratte amar leh ishtikn kaamena
Chamateh derav chiyya aricha intat achuh havay vealmana bevet aviha havay vezanah esrim vachamesh shenin beve nasha
Lesof amara leh hav li mezone amar lah let lich mezone hav li ketubba amar lah la mezone it lich vela ketubba it
Tevateh ledina kammeh derabba bar shela amar leh ema li izi gufa deovada hechi hava amar leh zanitah esrim vachamesh shanim beve nasha bechayye demar divchatfay amtay lah
Amar leh tama may amur rabbanan kol zeman shehi bevet balah gova ketubbatah leolam deamrinan mishshum kisufa hu dela tava hacha name mishshum kisufa hu dela tava zil hav lah
La ashgach ketav lah adrachta annichse ata lekammeh derava amar leh chazi mar hechi danan amar leh shappir danach

Amara leh i hachi lezil lahdar li pere demin hahu yoma ad haidana amar lah achvi li adrachtich chazyah dela hava ketiv bah veishtemodana dinchasim ellu demitana inun amar lah adrachta lav shappir ketiva
Amara leh tezil adrachta eshkol miyyoma dishlimi yome achrazta ad hashta amar lah hane mile hecha dela ketiv tauta beadrachta aval hecha dichtiv tauta beadrachta let lan bah
Amara leh veha mar hu deamar achraut taut sofer hu
Amar lah rava beha leka lememar taut sofer hu divha afilu rabba bar shela tae meikara hu sevar hane vehane dideh ma li mehane ma li mehane
Vela hi zimnin deazla umashbecha lehu udvalah machsefi veamar lah shekul didach vehav li didi veate leappoke laaz al be dina
Hadaran alach hannose
Shene dayyane gezerot hau birushalayim admon vechanan ben avishalom chanan omer shene devarim admon omer shiva mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot chanan omer

a: Tishshava bassof velo tishshava battechilla nechleku alav bene kohanim gedolim veamru tishshava battechilla uvassof amar rabbi dosa ben harkinas kedivrehem amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay yafe amar chanan lo tishshava ella bassof
Gema urminhi shelosha dayyane gezelot hau birushalayim admon ben gadday vechanan hammitzri vechanan ben avishalom kashya telat atteren kashya gezerot aggezelot
Bishlama telat atteren la kashya dachashiv leh katane dela chashiv leh la katane ella gezerot aggezelot kashya
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak shehau gozrin gezerot al gezelot kidtanya kitma netia rabbi yose omer gozre gezerot shebbirushalayim omrim netia bat shenatah shette chesef bat shette shanim arba kesef

Urminhi shelosha dayyane gezerot hau birushalayim admon vechanan venachum amar rav pappa man tena nachum rabbi natan hi detanya rabbi natan omer af nachum hammadi miggozre gezerot shebbirushalayim haya velo hodu lo chachamim

Vetu leka vehaamar rabbi pinchas amar rabbi oshaya shelosh meot vetishim vearbaa batte dinin hau birushalayim kenegdan batte chenesiyyot uchnegdan batte midrashot uchnegdan batte sofrim dayyanin tuva hao vechi kaamrinan aggozre gezerot kaamrinan

Amar rav yehuda amar rav assi gozre gezerot shebbirushalayim hau notlin secharan tishim vatesha mane mitterumat hallishka lo ratzu mosifin lahem lo ratzu attu berashshie askinan ella lo safku af al pi shello ratzu mosifin alehen
Karna hava shakel istera mizzakkay veistera mechayyav vedaen lehu dina vehechi aved hachi vehachtiv veshochad lo tikkach
Vechi tema hane mile hecha dela shakel mittarvayehu dilma ate leatzloye dina karna kevan deshakel mittarvayehu la ate leatzloye dina vechi la ate leatzloye dina mi shere

Vehatanya veshochad lo tikkach ma talmud lomar im lelammed shello lezakkot et hachayyav veshello lechayyev et hazzakkay hare kevar neemar lo tatte mishpat ella afilu lezakkot et hazzakkay ulchayyev et hachayyav amra tora veshochad lo tikkach
Hane mile hecha deshakel betorat shochad karna betorat agra hava shakel uvtorat agra mi shere vehatnan hannotel sachar ladun dinav betelin hane mile agar dina karna agar betela hava shakel

Vaagar betela mi shere vehatanya mechoar haddayyan shennotel sachar ladun ella sheddino din hechi dame ilema agar dina dino din vehatanya hannotel sachar ladun dinav betelin ella agar betela vekatane mechoar haddayyan
Hane mile betela dela mochcha karna betela demochcha hava shakel dahava tahe beambara dechamra veyahavi leh zuza
Ki ha derav huna ki hava ate dina lekammeh amar lehu havu li gavra dedale li bacharikay veedun lechu dina

Amar rabbi avahu bo ure kamma semuot enehen shel mekabbele shochad adam chash beenav noten mamon larofe safek mitrappe safek eno mitrappe vehen notlin shave peruta umsammin enehen shenneemar ki hashshochad yeaver pikchim

Tanu rabbanan ki hashshochad yeaver ene chachamim kal vachomer lattippeshin visallef divre tzaddikim kal vachomer larshaim mide tippeshim urshaim bene dina ninhu ella hachi kaamar ki hashshochad yeaver ene chachamim afilu chacham gadol velokeach shochad eno niftar min haolam belo samut hallev visallef divre tzaddikim
b: Afilu tzaddik gamur velokeach shochad eno niftar min haolam belo teruf daat

Ki ata rav dimi amar daresh rav nachman bar kohen may dichtiv melech bemishpat yaamid aretz veish terumot yehersenna im dome dayyan lemelech sheeno tzarich lichlum yaamid aretz veim dome lechohen shemmechazzer al haggoranot yehersenna
Amar rabba bar rav shela hay dayyana deshael sheelta pasul lemedan dina vela amaran ella delet leh leoshole aval it leh leoshole let lan bah
Ini veha rava shael sheelta middeve bar mariyyon af al gav dela shayeli mineh hatam leachshovinhu hu devae

Amar rava may tama deshuchda kevan dekabbel leh shuchda mineh ikarva leh dateh legabbeh vehave kegufeh veen adam roe chova leatzmo may shochad shehu chad amar rav pappa la ledun inish dina leman derachem leh vela leman desane leh derachem leh la chaze leh chova desane leh la chaze leh zechuta
Amar abbaye hay tzurba merabbanan dimrachamin leh bene mata lav mishshum dimalle tefe ella mishshum dela mochach lehu bemile dishmayya

Amar rava meresh hava amena hane bene machoza kullehu rachamu li kevan dahavay dayyana amena minayehu sanu li uminayehu rachamu li kevan dachazay deman demichayyav leh haidana ka zache limchar amena im mircham kullehu rachamu li i misno kullehu sanu li
Tanu rabbanan veshochad lo tikkach eno tzarich lomar shochad mamon ella afilu shochad devarim name asur middela ketiv betza lo tikkach hechi dame shochad devarim
Ki ha dishmuel hava avar bemabbara ata hahu gavra yahev leh yedeh amar leh may avidtach amar leh dina it li amar leh pesilna lach ledina

Ammemar hava yatev veka daen dina perach gadpa aresheh ata hahu gavra shakleh amar leh may avidtach amar leh dina it li amar leh pesilna lach ledina mar ukva hava shede rukka kammeh ata hahu gavra kasseyeh amar leh may avidtach amar leh dina it li amar leh pesilna lach ledina

Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose hava regil ariseh dahava mayete leh kol maale shabbeta kanta defere yoma chad ayeti leh bechamsha beshabbeta amar leh may shena haidana amar leh dina it li veamena aggav orchi ayete leh lemar la kabbel mineh amar leh pesilna lach ledina

Otev zuza derabbanan vekadayenin leh bahade dekaazel veate amar i bae taen hachi vei bae taen hachi amar tipach nafsham shel mekabbele shochad uma ani shello natalti veim natalti shelli natalti kach mekabbele shochad al achat kamma vechamma

Rabbi yishmael bar elisha ayeti leh hahu gavra reshit haggez amar leh mehecha atte amar leh midduch pelan umehatam lehacha la hava kohen lemitva leh amar leh dina it li veamena aggav orchay ayete leh lemar amar leh pesilna lach ledina la kabbel mineh

Otev leh zuga derabbanan vekadayeni leh bahade dekaazel veate amar i bae taen hachi vei bae taen hachi amar tipach nafsham shel mekabbele shochad uma ani shello natalti veim natalti shelli natalti kach mekabbele shochad al achat kamma vechamma
Rav anan ayeti leh hahu gavra kanta degildane deve gile amar leh may avidtach amar leh dina it li la kabbel mineh amar leh pesilna lach ledina

Amar leh dina demar la baena kabbole lekabbel mar dela limnean mar meakrove bikkurim detanya veish ba mibbaal shalisha vayyave leish haelohim lechem bikkurim esrim lechem seorim vecharmel betziklono vechi elisha ochel bikkurim hava ella lomar lach kol hammevi doron letalmid chacham keilu makriv bikkurim

Amar leh kabbole la baenan deekabbel hashta deamratte li tama mekabbelna shaddereh lekammeh derav nachman shelach leh nidayeneh mar lehay gavra daana anan pesilna leh ledina amar middishlach li hachi shema minah kariveh hu hava kaem dina deyatme kammeh amar

a: Hay ase vehay ase ase dichvod tora adif sallekeh ledina deyatme veachateh ledineh kevan dachaza baal dineh yekara deka aved lah istattum tanateh
Rav anan hava regil eliyyahu deate gabbeh dahava matne leh seder deeliyyahu kevan daavad hachi istallak yetev betaanita uva rachame vaata ki ata hava mevaet leh baote
Vaavad tevuta vitev kammeh ad deappek leh sidreh vehayenu deamri seder deeliyyahu rabba seder eliyyahu zuta

Bishne derav yosef hava ritcha amri leh rabbanan lerav yosef live mar rachame amar lehu hashta uma elisha dechi hao rabbanan mipatri mikkammeh hao payeshi tere alfe umatan rabbanan beidan ritcha la hava bae rachame ana eve rachame
Umimmay defayeshi hachi dichtiv vayyomer mesharto ma etten ze lifne mea ish may lifne mea ish ilema dechullehu lifne mea ish bishne vatztzoret tuva hao ella dechol chad vechad kamme mea ish

Ki hao mipatri rabbanan mibbe rav hao payeshi alpa umatan rabbanan mibbe rav huna hao payeshi tamne mea rabbanan rav huna hava daresh bitlesar amorae ki hao kayemi rabbanan mimmetivta derav huna venaftzi gelimayehu hava salek avka vechase leh leoma veamri bemareva kamu leh mimmetivta derav huna bavlaa

Ki mipatri rabbanan mibbe rabba verav yosef hao payeshi arba mea rabbanan vekaru lenafshayehu yatme ki hao mipatri rabbanan mibbe abbaye veamri lah mibbe rav pappa veamri lah mibbe rav ashe hao payeshi matan rabbanan vekaru nafshayehu yatme deyatme

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar redifa amar rabbi amme mevakkere mumin shebbirushalayim hau notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka amar rav yehuda amar shemuel talmide chachamim hamlammedin hilchot shechita lechohanim hau notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka

Amar rav gidel amar rav talmide chachamim hamlammedim hilchot kemitza lakkohanim notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan maggihe sefarim shebbirushalayim hau notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka
Amar rav nachman amar rav nashim haorgot bapparochot notlot secharan mitterumat hallishka vaani omer mikkodshe bedek habbayit hoil ufarochot tachat binyan asuot
Metivi nashim haorgot bapparochot uvet garmu al maase lechem happanim uvet avtinas al maase hakketoret kullan hau notlot secharan mitterumat hallishka

Hatam bidvave deamar rabbi zera amar rav shelosh esre parochot hau bemikdash sheni sheva keneged shiva shearim achat lefitcho shel hechal veachat lefitcho shel ulam shettayim baddevir shettayim kenegdan baaliyya
Tanu rabbanan nashim hamgaddelot benehen lappara hau notlot secharan mitterumat hallishka abba shaul omer nashim yekarot shebbirushalayim hau zanot otan umfarnesot otan
Bea mineh rav huna merav
b: Kele sharet mahu sheyyeasu mikkodshe bedek habbayit tzorech mizbeach ninhu umikkodshe bedek habbayit atu o tzorech korban ninhu umitterumat hallishka hau osin otan amar leh en naasin ella mitterumat hallishka
Etiveh uchchallotam heviu lifne hammelech vihoyada hakkohen et shear hakkesef vayyaasehu chelim levet Adonai kele sharet vego
Amar leh deakreyach ketuve la akreyach nevie ach lo yease bet Adonai sippot vego ki leose hammelacha yittenuhu
I hachi kashu kerae ahadade la kashya kan sheggavu vehotiru kan sheggavu velo hotiru
Vechi gavu vehotiru may have amar rabbi avahu lev bet din matne alehen im hutzrechu hutzrechu veim lav yehu lichle sharet
Tana deve rabbi yishmael kele sharet bain mitterumat hallishka shenneemar et shear hakkesef ezehu kesef sheyyesh lo shirayim heve omer ze terumat hallishka
Veema shirayim gufayehu kidamar rava haola ola rishona hachi name hakkesef kesef rishon
Metivi hakketoret vechol korbenot tzibbur bain mitterumat hallishka mizbach hazzahav ulvona uchle sharet bain mimmotar nesachim

Mizbach haola halleshachot vehaazarot bain mikkodshe bedek habbayit chutz lechomat haazara bain mishsheyare halleshachot zo hi sheshshaninu chomat hair umigdeloteha vechol tzorche hair bain mishsheyare hallishka
Tannae hi ditnan motar teruma ma hau osin bah rikue zahav tzipuy levet kodshe hakkodashim rabbi yishmael omer motar perot leketz hammizbeach motar teruma lichle sharet

Rabbi akiva omer motar teruma leketz hammizbeach motar nesachim lichle sharet rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer motar nesachim leketz hammizbeach motar teruma lichle sharet veze vaze lo hau modim beferot
Perot may hi detanya motar teruma ma hau osin bah lokchin perot bezol umochrin otam beoker vehassachar mekayetzin bo et hammizbeach vezo hi sheshshaninu motar perot leketz hammizbeach

May ze vaze lo hau modin beferot ditnan motar sheyare lishka ma hau osin bahen lokchin bahen yenot shemanim uslatot vehassachar lahekdesh divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer en mistakkerin beshel hekdesh af lo beshel aniyyim
Beshel hekdesh may tama la en aniyyut bimkom ashirut beshel aniyyim may tama la dilma mitreme lehu anya veleka lemitva leh
Mi shehalach limdinat hayyam itmar rav amar

a: Poskin mezonot leeshet ish ushmuel amar en poskin mezonot leeshet ish amar shemuel mode li abba bishlosha chodashim harishonim lefi sheen adam manniach beto rekan
Besheshshamu bo shemmet kulle alma la peligi ki peligi beshello shamu bo shemmet rav amar poskin deha meshubad lah ushmuel amar en poskin
May tama rav zevid amar ema tzerare atpesah rav pappa amar chayeshinan shemma amar lah tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich
May benayehu ika benayehu gedola vela safka
I name ketanna vesafka

Tenan mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot chanan amar tishshava bassof velo tishshava battechilla nechleku alav bene kohanim gedolim veamru tishshava battechilla uvassof ad kan la peligi ella leinyan shevua aval mezone yahavinan lah targemah shemuel besheshshamu bo shemmet
Ta shema mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot bene kohanim gedolim omrim tishshava chanan omer lo tishshava veim ba veamar pasakti lah mezonot neeman
Hacha name besheshshamu bo shemmet veha im ba veamar kaamar im ba leachar shemua
Ta shema mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot veim ba veamar tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich rashshay kadmu bet din ufasku ma sheppasku pasku hacha name besheshshamu bo shemmet
Ta shema mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot bet din yordim linchasav vezanin umfarnesin leishto aval lo banav uvnotav velo davar acher
Amar rav sheshet bemashre et ishto al yede shalish i hachi banav uvnotav name keshehishra lazo velo hishra lazo may paska
Ella amar rav pappa kesheshshama bo shemmet beed echad hi dei baaya insove beed echad matzya minasva mezone name yahavinan lah
Banav uvnotav dei bau lemechat linchasav beed echad la matzu nachati mezone name la yahavinan lehu
May davar acher rav chisda amar tachshit rav yosef amar tzedaka man deamar tachshit kol shekken
b: Tzedaka man deamar tzedaka aval tachshit yahavinan lah dela nicha leh detinaval
Ta shema hayevama shelosha chodashim harishonim nizonet mishshel balah
Mikan veelach enah nizonet lo mishshel balah velo mishshel yavam amad baddin uvarach nizonet mishshel yavam
Amar lecha shemuel lemay nechush lah lehay i mishshum tzerare la mikarva dateh legabbah i mishshum maase yadeha la mishtabeda leh
Ta shema haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam uvat veamra met bali ratzta nizonet ratzta gova ketubbatah gershani baali mitparneset veholechet ad kede chetubbatah
Hacha name kesheshshamu bo shemmet umay shena ad kede chetubbatah deihi hi deafseda annafshah

Ta shema ketzad amru memaenet en lah mezonot i atta yachol lomar beoshevet tachat balah shehare balah chayyav bimzonot ella kegon shehalach balah limdinat hayyam laveta veachla amda umeana tama demeana ha lo meana yahavinan lah
Amar lach shemuel hacha lemay nechush lah i mishshum tzerare tzerare liktanna la matpes vei mishshum maase yadeha ketanna la safka

May hava alah ki ata rav dimi amar maase ba lifne rabbi bevet shearim ufasak lah mezonot lifne rabbi yishmael betzippori velo pasak lah mezonot tahe bah rabbi yochanan vechi ma raa rabbi yishmael shello pasak lah mezonot ha lo nechleku bene kohanim gedolim vechanan ella leinyan shevua aval mezone yahavinan lah
Amar leh rav shemen bar abba kevar targemah rabbenu shemuel bevavel kesheshshamu bo shemmet amar leh patritu bah kulle hay

Ki ata ravin amar maase ba lifne rabbi bevet shearim velo pasak lah mezonot lifne rabbi yishmael betzipori ufasak lah mezonot amar rabbi yochanan ma raa rabbi shello pasak lah deha lo nechleku chanan uvne kohanim gedolim ella leinyan shevua aval mezonot yahavinan lah amar leh rav shemen bar abba kevar targemah shemuel bevavel kesheshshamu bo shemmet amar leh patritu bah kulle hay
Vehilcheta kevateh derav ufoskin mezonot leeshet ish vehilcheta kevateh derav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav yechola ishsha shettomar levalah eni nizonet veeni osa
Vehilcheta kevateh derav zevid bekunya deamar rav zevid hane mane dekunya chivare veukkame sheru
