Yerukke asiri vela amaran ella delet behu kartufane aval it behu kartufane asiri
Matni mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veamad echad ufirnes et ishto chanan omer ibed et meotav
Nechleku alav bene kohanim gedolim veamru yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol amar rabbi dosa ben harkinas kedivrehem amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay yafe amar chanan hinniach meotav al keren hatztzevi
Gema tenan hatam hammuddar hanaa mechavero

a: Shokel lo et shiklo uforea et chovo umachazir lo avedato uvmakom shennotlin sachar tippol hanaa lahekdesh

Veamar rabbi chiyya bar yosef atida eretz yisrael shettotzi geluskaot uchle melat shenneemar yehi fissat bar baaretz

Tanu rabbanan yehi fissat bar baaretz berosh harim amru atida chitta shettittammer kedekel veola berosh harim veshemma tomar yesh tzaar lekotzrah talmud lomar yirash kallevanon piro hakkadosh baruch hu mevi ruach mibbet genazav umnashshevah aleha umashshira et soltah veadam yotze lassade umevi melo pisat yado umimmenna parnasato ufarnasat anshe veto
Im chelev kilot chitta amru atida chitta shettehe kishte chelaot shel shor haggadol veal titmah shehare shual kinen belefet ushkaluhu umatzu bo shishshim litrin belitra shel tzippori

Tanya amar rav yose maase beshichin beechad shehinniach lo aviv shelosha badde chardal venifshach echad mehen venimtzeu bo tisha kabbin chardal veetzav sikchu bo sukkat yotzrin amar rabbi shimon ben tachlifa kelach shel keruv hinniach lanu abba vehayinu olim veordim bo besullam

Vedam enav tishte chamer amru lo kaolam hazze haolam habba haolam hazze yesh bo tzaar livtzor velidroch haolam habba mevi anava achat bakkaron o bisfina umannichah bezavit beto umsappek hemenna kefitos gadol veetzav massikin tachat hattavshil veen lecha kol anava vaanava sheen bah sheloshim garve yayin shenneemar vedam enav tishte chamer al tikre chamer ella chomer

Ki ata rav dimi amar may dichtiv osri laggefen iro en lecha kol gefen vagefen shebbeeretz yisrael sheen tzarich ayir achat livtzor velassoreka beni atono en lach kol ilan serak shebbeeretz yisrael sheeno motzi massoy shette atonot veshemma tomar en bo yayin talmud lomar kibbes beyayin levusho veshemma tomar eno adom talmud lomar vedam enav tishte chamer

Veshemma tomar eno marve talmud lomar suto veshemma tomar en bo taam talmud lomar chachlili enayim miyyayin kol chech shettoamo omer li li veshemma tomar linarim yafe velizkenim eno yafe talmud lomar ulven shinnayim mechalav al tikre leven shinayim ella leven shanim
Peshateh dikra bemay ketiv ki ata rav dimi amar amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam remoz li beenach divsim mechamra veachvi li shinach divsim mechalava
Mesayya leh lerabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan tov hammalbin shinayim lachavero yoter mimmashkehu chalav shenneemar ulven shinnayim mechalav al tikre leven shinayim ella libbun shinayim
Rav chiyya bar adda makre dardeke deresh lakish hava ipaggar telata yome vela ata ki ata amar leh ammay ipaggarte

Amar leh dalit achat hinniach li abba uvatzarti mimmenna yom rishon shelosh meot eshkolot eshkol legarav yom sheni batzarti shelosh meot eshkolot shette eshkolot legarav yom shelishi batzarti mimmenna shelosh meot eshkolot shalosh eshkolot legarav vehifkarti yoter mechetzyah amar leh i lav deipaggarte hava avda tefe
Rame bar yechezkel ikla livne verak chazanhu lehanhu ize dekaachlan tute teene vekanatef duvsha mitteene vachalava tayef minnayehu umiarav bahade hadade amar hayenu zavat chalav udvash

Amar rabbi yaakov ben dostay millod leono shelosha milin paam achat kiddamti banneshef vehalachti ad karsullay bidvash shel teenim amar resh lakish ledidi chaze li zavat chalav udvash shel tzippori vehave shitsar milin ashshitsar milin amar rabba bar bar chana ledidi chaze li zavat chalav udvash shel kol eretz yisrael

a: Vehaveya kemibbe michse ad akra detulbanke esrin vetarten parse urka ufutya shita parse

Rabbi chelbo verabbi avira verabbi yose bar chanina iklau lehahu atra ayeto kammayehu afarseka dahava keilpas kefar hino veilpas kefar hino kamma have chamesh sein achlu shelish vehifkiru shelish venatnu lifne behemtan shelish
Leshana ikla rabbi elazar lehatam veayeto lekammeh nekatu nakteh bideh veamar eretz peri limlecha meraat yoshve vah

Rabbi yehoshua ben levi ikla legavla chazanhu lehanhu kittufe dahao kayemi ki igle amar agalim ben haggefanim amaru leh kittufe ninhu amar eretz eretz hachnisi perotayich lemi atte motzia perotayich legoyim hallalu sheamdu alenu bechattotenu
Leshana ikla rabbi chiyya lehatam chazanhu dahao kayemi keize amar izzim ben haggefanim amaru leh zil la taaved lan ki chavrach

Tanu rabbanan bevirchoteha shel eretz yisrael bet sea osa chameshet ribo korin bishivatah shel tzoan bet sea osa shivim korin detanya amar rabbi meir ani raiti bevikat bet shean bet sea osa shivim korin

Veen lecha meulla bechol aratzot yoter meeretz mitzrayim shenneemar kegan Adonai keeretz mitzrayim veen lecha meulla bechol eretz mitzrayim yoter mitztzoan dahao merabbu bah melachim dichtiv ki hau vetzoan sarav veen lecha terashim bechol eretz yisrael yoter mechevron dahao kavri bah shachve

Vaafilu hachi chevron mevunna al achat mishshiva betzoan dichtiv vechevron sheva shanim nivneta lifne tzoan mitzrayim may nivneta ilema nivneta mammash efshar adam bone bayit livno katan kodem sheyyivne livno gadol shenneemar uvne cham kush umitzrayim ufut uchnaan
Ella shemmevunna al achat mishshiva betzoen vehane mile bitrashim aval shello bitrashim chamesh mea
Vehane mile shello bevirchoteha aval bevirchoteha ketiv vayyizra yitzchak baaretz hahi vego

Tanya amar rabbi yose sea bihuda hayeta osa chamesh sein sea kemach sea solet sea subbin sea mursin usa kiborya amar leh hahu tzadduki lerabbi chanina yae meshabbechitu bah bearachon bet sea achat hinniach li abba mimmenna meshach mimmenna chamar mimmenna ivur mimmenna kitniyyot mimmenna root miknati

Amar leh hahu bar emoraa levar ara deyisrael hay talta dekayema aggudda deyardena kamma gadritu minah amar leh shitin kore amar leh akkatti la ayelitu bah achrevtuha anan mea veesrim kore hava gazrinan minah amar leh ana name mechad gisa kaamena lach

Amar rav chisda may dichtiv veetten lach eretz chemda nachalat tzevi lamma eretz yisrael nimshela litzvi lomar lecha ma tzevi ze en oro machazik besaro af eretz yisrael enah machzeket peroteha davar acher ma tzevi ze kal mikkol hachayyot af eretz yisrael kalla mikkol haaratzot levashshel et peroteha
I ma tzevi ze kal veen besaro shamen af eretz yisrael kalla levashshel veen peroteha shemenim talmud lomar zavat chalav udvash shemenim mechalav umtukim middevash
Rabbi elazar ki hava salek leeretz yisrael amar pelati li mechada ki samchuhu amar pelati li mittarte ki otvuhu besod haibur amar pelati li mittelat
Shenneemar vehayeta yadi el hanneviim hachozim shave vego besod ammi lo yihu ze sod ibur uvichtav bet yisrael lo yikkatevu ze semicha veel admat yisrael lo yavou kemashmao

Rabbi zera ki hava salek leeretz yisrael la ashkach mabbara lemebar nekat bemitzra vekaavar amar leh hahu tzadduki amma peziza dekaddemitu pummayechu leudnayechu akkatti bifzizutayechu kayemitu amar leh duchta demoshe veaharon la zecho lah ana mi yemar dezachena lah
Rabbi abba menashshek kefe deakko rabbi chanina metakken matkalayya rabbi amme verabbi assi
b: Kayemi mishshimsha letulla umittulla leshimsha rabbi chiyya bar gammada migandar beafrah shenneemar ki ratzu avadecha et avaneha veet afarah yechonenu

Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba dor shebben david ba kategorya betalmide chachamim ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar tzeruf achar tzeruf shenneemar veod bah asiriyya veshava vehayeta levaer tane rav yosef bazoze uvazoze devazozi
Amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav atidin kol ilane serak shebbeeretz yisrael sheyyitanu perot shenneemar ki etz nasa firo teena vagefen natnu chelam
Hadaran alach shene dayyane gezerot uslika lah massechet ketubbot

a: Kal kinuye nedarim kindarim
Vacharamim kacharamim ushvuot kishvuot unzirut kinzirut
Haomer lachavero mudderani mimmach mufreshani mimmach meruchakani mimmach sheani ochel lach sheani toem lach asur
Menudde ani lach rabbi akiva haya chochech baze lehachmir
b: Gema kal kinuye nedarim kindarim may shena gabbe nazir dela katane lehu lechullehu umay shena gabbe nedarim dekatane lechullehu
Mishshum deneder ushvua ketivi gabbe hadade tane tarten vechevan detane tarten tane lechullehu
Velitne kinuye shevuot batar nedarim ayede ditna nedarim demitsar cheftza aleh tena name charamim demitsar cheftza aleh leappoke shevua dekaasar nafsheh min cheftza
Petach bechinuyin kal kinnuyay nedarim umfaresh yadot haomer lachavero muddar ani mimmach vetu yadot inshi
Ayeri behon vechassore michassera vehachi katane kal kinuye nedarim kindarim vidot nedarim kindarim
Velifrosh kinuyin beresha
Hahu desalek mineh hahu mefaresh beresha keditnan bamme madlikin uvamma en madlikin en madlikin ku
Bamme tomnin uvamma en tomnin en tomnin ku bamma ishsha yotza uvamma enah yotza lo tetze ishsha
Vechol hecha defatach la mefaresh beresha vehatnan yesh nochalin umanchilin nochalin velo manchilin veellu nochalin umanchilin
Yesh muttarot levaalehen vaasurot leyivmehen muttarot leyivmehen vaasurot levaalehen veellu muttarot levaalehen vaasurot leyivmehen
Yesh teunot shemen ulvona shemen velo levona veellu teunot shemen ulvona yesh teunot haggasha veen teunot tenufa tenufa velo haggasha veellu teunot haggasha
Yesh bechor lenachala veen bechor lechohen bechor lechohen veen bechor lenachala veezehu bechor lenachala veen bechor lechohen
Halen mishshum deaveshu leh mefaresh hahu defatach beresha
Veha bamme behema yotza uvamma enah yotza dela avesha vekatane yotze gamal

a: Ella lav daveka zimnin mefaresh hahu diftach beresha zimnin hahu desalek mefaresh beresha veibaet ema yadot ayede deatyan midderasha mefaresh lehon beresha
Veliftach haden beresha miftach patach bechinuyin deorayeta beresha vahadar mefaresh yadot deatyan leh midderasha
Hanicha leman deamar kinuyin leshon nachrim hen ella leman deamar lashon shebbadu lahen chachamim lihot noder bo may ika lememar

Mi katane yadot velav chassore ka mechasseratte lah akdem name utni yadot kal yedot nedarim kindarim vechol kinuye nedarim kindarim veellu hen yadot haomer lachavero veellu hen kinuyin kunam kunnach kunnas
Veyadot hecha ketiv ish ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir la vetanya nazir lehazzir laasot kinuye nezirut kinzirut vidot nezirut kinzirut

En li ella binzirut bindarim minnayin talmud lomar ish ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir la makkish nezirut lindarim undarim linzirut ma nezirut asa bo yedot nezirut kinzirut af nedarim asa bahem yedot nedarim kindarim

Uma nedarim over beval yachel uvval teacher af nezirut over beval yachel uvval teacher uma nedarim haav mefer nidre vitto uvaal mefer nidre ishto af nezirut haav mefer nezirut bitto uvaal mefer nezirut ishto
May shena gabbe nezirut dichtiv nazir lehazzir nedarim name ha ketiv lindor neder vehekesha lema li
I ketav neder lindor kedichtav nazir lehazzir kidkaamratte la tzarich hekesha hashta dichtiv lindor neder dibbera tora chilshon bene adam

Hanicha leman deit leh dibbera tora kilshon bene adam ella leman delet leh dibbera tora kilshon bene adam hay lindor neder may aved leh daresh leh laasot yedot nedarim kindarim umakkish nezirut lindarim nazir lehazzir daresh leh melammed
b: Shehannezirut chal al hannezirut

Ulman deamar dibbera tora kilshon bene adam venazir lehazzir daresh laasot yedot nezirut kinzirut shehannezirut chal al hannezirut mena leh hanicha i sevira leh keman deamar en nezirut chal al nezirut ella i sevira leh keman deamar nezirut chal al nezirut mena leh
Nema kera lizor may lehazzir shamatte minah tarte
Bemareva amri it tanna demappek leh leyadot min lindor neder veit tanna demappek leh min kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase
Amar mar uma nedarim over beval yachel uval teacher bishlama bal yachel dindarim mashkachatte lah kegon deamar kikkar zo ochal velo achalah over mishshum bal yachel devaro
Ella bal yachel dinzirut hechi mashkachatte lah kevan deamar hareni nazir have leh nazir achal kam leh beval yochal sheta kam leh beval yishte amar rava laavor alav bishnayim
Bal teacher dinzirut hechi mashkachatte lah kevan deamar hareni nazir have leh nazir achal kam leh beval yochal beomer lichsheertze ehe nazir vei amar kesheertze leka bal teacher

Amar rava kegon deamar lo ipater min haolam ad sheehe nazir demin hahi shata have leh nazir mide dehave haomer leishto hare zo gitech shaa achat kodem mitati asura leechol bitruma miyyad alma amrinan kol shata veshata dilma mayet hacha name lealtar have nazir deamrinan dilma hashta mayet

a: Rav acha bar yaakov amar kegon dindar vehu bevet hakkevarot

Hanicha leman deamar la chayela aleh nezirut mealtar ella leman deamar mealtar chayela aleh mi ika bal teacher veod haamar mar bar rav ashe chayela nezirut aleh mealtar vechi peligi leinyan malkot peligi
Afilu hachi kam leh beval teacher mishshum deka meachar nezirut detahora amar rav ashe hoil vechen nazir shettime atzmo bemezid over mishshum bal teacher dinzirut tahora
Rav acha bereh derav ika amar over beval teacher tiglachto
Vela mibaya leman deamar tiglachat meakkevet ella afilu leman deamar tiglachat enah meakkevet mitzvat giluach miha la mekayyem
Mar zutra bereh derav mari amar over beval teacher karbenotav
Umin hacha nafka leh mehatam nafka leh ki darosh yidreshennu ellu chattaot vaashamot
Mahu detema chidush hu shechidsha tora benazir
May chidush ilema dela matpes lah lechattat nazir beneder hare chattat chelev sheen matpisah beneder veover beval teacher
Ella may chidusheh salka datach amena hoil veim amar hareni nazir afilu min chartzan have nazir lakkol ema la laavor aleh mishshum bal teacher ka mashma lan
Hanicha leman deamar ki nazir min chartzan have nazir lakkol ella lerabbi shimon deamar en nazir ad sheyyazzir mikkullan may ika lememar veod hay chidush lechumra hu
Ella may chidusheh desalka datach amena hoil
b: Veim gilach al achat mishsheloshtan yatza la laavor aleh beval teacher ka mashma lan
Veibaet ema may chiddusheh mishshum delo matpiso beneder veha deka kashya lach chattat chelev chattat chelev kaatya lechappara chattat nazir lemay atya
Vahare chattat yoledet dela atya lechappara veavar alah mishshum bal teacher hahi ka sharya lah lemechal bekadashim
Amar mar uma nedarim haav mefer nidre vitto uvaal mefer nidre ishto af nezirut haav mefer nezirut bitto uvaal mefer nezirut ishto lema li hekesha tete bema matzinu minnedarim
Dilma gabbe nedarim hu demefar mishshum dela it leh kitzuta aval gabbe nezirut deit leh kitzuta distam nezirut sheloshim yom ema la ka mashma lan
Haomer lachavero muddar ani vechu amar shemuel bechullan ad sheyyomar sheani ochel lach sheani toem lach

Metivi muddar ani mimmach mufreshani mimmach meruchakeni mimmach hare ze asur sheani ochel lach sheani toem lach hare ze asur hachi katane bamme devarim amurim beomer sheani ochel lach sheani toem lach
Vehatanya ipcha sheani ochel lach sheani toem lach asur mudderani mimmach umufreshani mimmach meruchakani mimmach hare ze asur tane hachi uchvar amar mudderani
I hachi hayenu resha veod asur asur lema leh lemitne
Ella amar shemuel tama deamar sheani ochel lach sheani toem lach hu deasur vachavero muttar

a: Aval amar mudderani hemach lechodeh shenehen asurin ki ha deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mudderani hemach shenehen asurin
Tenan hareni alecha cherem hammuddar asur aval maddir la kegon defaresh veatte alay la
Atte alay cherem hannoder asur aval muddar la kegon defaresh vaana alach la
Aval setama may shenehen asurim ha middekatane sefa hareni alecha veatte alay shenehen asurim haden hu dishnehem asurin ha setama hu asur vachavero muttar
Ella hachi ittemar derabbi yose berabbi chanina muddar ani lach shenehem asurin mudderani hemach hu asur vachavero muttar
Veha matnitin dekatane hemach veokimna lematnitin lishmuel bechullan ad sheyyomar sheani toem lach vesheani ochel lach hu deasur vachavero muttar aval bemudderani hemach shenehem asurin
Ella meikara dishmuel hachi itmar tama deamar sheani ochel lach vesheani toem lach hu deen hu asur ella baachila ha mudderani mimmecha asur afilu bahanaa
I hachi lema shemuel hachi veim la amar ella sheani ochel lach vesheani toem lach en asur ella baachila

Ella hachi itmar tama deamar sheani ochel lach vesheani toem lach hu deasur aval amar mudderani hemach la mashma deamar asur may tama muddar ani mimmach la mishtaena bahadach mashma mufreshani mimmach dela avedna immach massa umattan mashma meruchakani mimmach dela kaemna bearba ammot dilach mashma
b: Lema kasavar shemuel yadayim sheen mochichot la haveyan yadayim in shemuel mokem lah lematnitin kerabbi yehuda deamar yadayim sheen mochichot la haveyan yadayim
Ditnan gufo shel get hare atte mutteret lechol adam rabbi yehuda omer veden deyeheve lichi minay sefer teruchin veigeret shibbukin
Ammay dachek shemuel leokomah lematnitin kerabbi yehuda lokmah kerabbanan af al gav deen yadayim mochichot
Amar rava matnitin keshiteh ammay tane sheani ochel lach sheani toem lach litne sheani ochel sheani toem shema minah bainan yadayim mochichot

Itmar yadayim sheen mochichot abbaye amar haveyan yadayim verava amar la haveyan yadayim amar rava rabbi idi asbera li amar kera nazir lehazzir la makkish yedot nezirut linzirut ma nezirut behaflaa af yedot nezirut behaflaa

Lema biflugta derabbi yehuda verabbanan kamipalgi ditnan gufo shel get hare atte mutteret lechol adam rabbi yehuda omer veden deyeheve lichi minay sefer teruchin veget pitturin veigeret shibbukin abbaye deamar kerabbanan verava deamar kerabbi yehuda
Amar lach abbaye ana daamari afilu lerabbi yehuda ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda bainan yadayim mochichot ella gabbe get devainan keritut veleka aval bealma mi shamatte leh
Verava amar ana daamari afilu lerabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan dela bainan yadayim mochichot ella gabbe get

a: Deen adam megaresh et eshet chavero aval bealma mi shamatte lehu
Metivi hare hu alay hare ze alay asur mippene shehu yad lekorban tama deamar alay hu deasur aval la amar alay la teuvta deabbaye
Amar lach abbaye tama deamar alay hu deasur aval amar hare hu vela amar alay hare hu dehefker hare hu ditzdaka kaamar veha mippene shehu yad lekorban katane
Ella ema tama deamar alay hu asur vachavero muttar aval amar hare hu shenehen asurin dedilma hare hu hekdesh kaamar
Metivi hare zo chattat hare zo asham af al pi shehu chayyav chattat veasham lo amar kelum hare zo chattati hare zo ashami im haya mechuyyav devarav kayyamin teuvta deabbaye
Amar lach abbaye ha manni rabbi yehuda hi veha abbaye hu deamar ana daamari afilu lerabbi yehuda hadar beh
Ella lema rava deamar kerabbi yehuda
Amar lach rava ana daamari afilu lerabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan dela bainan yadayim mochichot ella gabbe get deen adam megaresh et eshet chavero aval bealma bainan yadayim mochichot
b: Bae rav pappa yesh yad lekidushin o la hechi dame ilema deamar lah leishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li veamar lachavertah veatte name peshita hayenu kidushin atzman ella kegon deamar lah leishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li veamar lah lachavertah veatte mi amrinan veatte name amar lah lachavertah vetafsi bah kidushin lachavertah o dilma veatte chazay amar lah lachavertah vela tafsi bah kidushin bachavertah

Umi mibe leh lerav pappa veha middaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye mi savar shemuel yadayim sheen mochichot haveyan yadayim mikkelal disvira leh lerav pappa deyesh yad lekidushin chada miggo may disvira leh lishmuel amar leh leabbaye
Bae rav pappa yesh yad lefea o en yad lefea hechi dame ilema deamar haden ugya leheve pea vehaden name hahi pea meallayeta hi ki ka mibaya leh kegon deamar vehaden vela amar name may
Mikkelal dechi amar sade kullah tehve pea haveya pea
In vehatanya minnayin sheim rotze laasot kol sadehu pea ose talmud lomar peat sadcha
Mi amrinan kevan deitakkash lekorbenot ma korbanot yesh lahem yad af pea yesh lah yad o dilma ki itakkash leval teacher hu deitakkash vehecha itakkash detanya

a: Meimmach ze leket shichcha ufea

Yesh yad litzdaka o en yad litzdaka hechi dame ilema deamar haden zuza litzdaka vehaden name hahu tzedaka atzmah hi ella kegon deamar haden vela amar name may haden name tzedaka kaamar o dilma may vehaden name lenafkuta bealma kaamar vedibbura hu dela assekeh
Mi amrinan kevan deitakkash lekorbanot dichtiv befich zo tzedaka ma korbanot yesh lahen yad af tzedaka yesh lah yad o dilma leval teacher hu deitakkash
Yesh yad lehefker o dilma en yad lehefker hayenu tzedaka

Im timtza lomar kaamar im timtza lomar yesh yad litzdaka deen hekesh lemechetza hefker mi amrinan hayenu tzedaka o dilma shane tzedaka ditzdaka la chazya ella laaniyyim aval hefker ben laaniyyim ben laashirim

Bae ravina yesh yad levet hakkisse o la hechi dame ilema daamar haden beta leheve bet hakkisse vehaden name hahu bet hakkisse name have ella kegon deamar vehaden vela amar name may haden deamar vehaden name bet hakkisse o dilma may vehaden letashmisha bealma kaamar
Mikkelal difshita leh leravina deyesh zimun levet hakkisse veha mibaya leh leravina hizmino levet hakkisse mahu hizmino levet hammerchatz mahu zimun moil o en zimun moil
Ravina chada miggo chada kamibaya leh zimun moil o en zimun moil im timtza lomar yesh zimun yesh yad o en yad tibe leh
Menudde ani lach vechu amar abbaye mode rabbi akiva leinyan malkot sheeno loke deim ken nitne rabbi akiva machmir
Amar rav pappa bindina minach dechulle alma la peligi deasur meshammatna minach lechulle alma shere bemay peligi
b: Bimnudde ani lach derabbi akiva savar lishana deniduya hu verabbanan savri lishana dimshammatna hu
Ufliga derav chisda dehahu gavra deamar meshammatna benichseh divreh derav yirmeya bar abba ata lekammeh derav chisda amar leh let dechash lah leha derabbi akiva kasavar bimshammatna peligi
Amar rabbi ila amar rav niddahu befanav en mattirin lo ella befanav niddahu shello befanav mattirin lo ben befanav ben shello befanav
Amar rav chanin amar rav hashshomea hazkarat hashshem mippi chavero tzarich lenaddoto veim lo nidahu hu atzmo yehe beniduy shekkol makom shehazkarat hashshem metzuya sham aniyyut metzuya
Vaaniyyut kemita shenneemar ki metu kol haanashim vetanya kol makom shennatnu chachamim enehem o mita o oni

Amar rabbi abba hava kaemna kammeh derav huna shamah lehach itta deappika hazkarat hashshem levattala shammetah ushra lah lealtar beappah shema minah telat shema minah hashshomea hazkarat hashshem mippi chavero tzarich lenaddoto ushma minah nidahu befanav en mattirin lo ella befanav ushma minah en ben niduy lahafara velo kelum
Amar rav gidel amar rav talmid chacham menadde leatzmo umefer leatzmo peshita mahu detema en chavush mattir atzmo mibbet haasurin ka mashma lan
Hechi dame ki ha demar zutra chasida ki michayyav bar be rav shamta meshammet nafsheh beresha vahadar meshammet bar be rav vechi ayel leveteh share lenafsheh vahadar share leh
Veamar rav gidel amar rav

a: Minnayin shennishbain lekayyem et hammitzva shenneemar nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha
Vahalo mushba veomed mehar sinay hu ella ha ka mashma lan deshare leh leinish lezaroze nafsheh

Veamar rav gidel amar rav haomer ashkim veeshne perek ze eshne massechta zo neder gadol nadar lelohe yisrael vahalo mushba veomed hu veen shevua chala al shevua may ka mashma lan daafilu zaroze bealma hayenu derav gidel kammayeta
Ha ka mashma lan kevan dei bae patar nafsheh bikriyyat shema shacharit vearvit mishshum hachi chayel shevua aleh

Amar rav gidel amar rav haomer lachavero nashkim venishne perek ze alav lehashkim shenneemar vayyomer elay ben adam kum tze el habbika vesham adabber otach vaetze el habbika vehinne sham kevod Adonai omed
Amar rav yosef niduhu bachalom tzarich asara bene adam lehattir lo vehu detanu hilcheta aval matnu vela tanu la vei leka detanu hilcheta afilu matnu vela tanu
Vei leka lezil velitev apparashat derachim veyahev shelama leve asra ad demikkali leh asra degamri hilcheta
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe yada man shamteh mahu delishre leh amar leh leshammoteh shavveuh shaliach lemishre leh la shavveuh shaliach
Amar leh rav acha lerav ashe shammetuh ushro leh bechelmeh may amar leh keshem shei efshar labbar belo teven
b: Kach i efshar lachalom belo devarim betelim
Ravina hava lah nidra lidvethu ata lekammeh derav ashe amar leh baal mahu sheyyease shaliach lacharatat ishto amar leh i mechannefin in i la la
Shema minah telat shema minah baal naase shaliach lacharatat ishto ushma minah la shere lemishre nidra beatra derabbeh ushma minah ki mechannefin shappir dame
Veshamta afilu beatra derabbeh veyachid mumche share shamta

Amar rabbi shimon bar zevid amar rabbi yitzchak bar tavla amar rabbi chiyya aricha deve rabbi acha amar rabbi zera amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina amar rabbi meyasha mishshemeh derabbi yehuda bar ilay may dichtiv vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka vego ellu bene adam shehen yerein lehotzi shem shamayim levattala shemesh tzedaka umarpe amar abbaye shema minah chirga deoma masse

Ufliga derabbi shimon ben lakish deamar en gehinnam laolam habba ella hakkadosh baruch hu motzi chamma minnartikah tzaddikim mitrappein bah urshaim nidonin bah shenneemar vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh vego velo od ella shemmitaddenin bah shenneemar vitzatem ufishtem keegle marbek
Veharshaim nidonin bah shenneemar hinne hayyom ba boer kattannur vego

a: Matni kenidre reshaim nadar benazir uvkorban uvishvua kenidre chesherim lo amar kelum kenidvotam nadar benazir uvkorban
Gema vedilma hachi kaamar kenidre reshaim la nadarna amar shemuel beomer kenidre reshaim hareni alay vehemennu hareni binzirut alay bekorban hemennu bishvua
Hareni nezirut dilma hareni betaanit kaamar amar shemuel keshehaya nazir over lefanav
Alay bekorban hemennu bishvua dilma hemennu deachelna kaamar amar rava deamar hemennu shello ochal
I hachi may lememra mahu detema ha la mappek shevua mippummeh ka mashma lan haden
Kenidre chesherim lo amar kelum kenidvotam nadar vechu man tanna deshane leh ben neder lindava lema la rabbi meir vela rabbi yehuda
Detanya tov asher lo tiddor vego tov mizze umizze sheeno noder kol ikar divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer tov mizze umizze noder umshallem
Afilu tema rabbi meir
b: Ki kaamar rabbi meir beneder bindava la kaamar veha katane kenidvotam nadar benazir uvkorban teni nadav benazir uvkorban
May shena noder dela dilma ate bah lide takkala nedava name la dilma ate bah lide takkala
Kehillel hazzaken detanya amru al hilel hazzaken shello maal adam beolato kol yamav meviah keshehi chullin laazara umakdishah vesomech aleha veshochatah
Hanicha nedava dekorbanot nedava dinzirut may ika lememar savar lah keshimon hatztzaddik

Detanya amar rabbi shimon hatztzaddik miyyamay lo achalti asham nazir tame ella echad paam achat ba adam echad nazir min haddarom uritiv shehu yefe enayim vetov roi ukutztzotav sedurot lo taltallim amarti lo beni ma raita lehashchit et searcha ze hannae

Amar li roe hayiti leabba beiri halachti lemalloot mayim min hammayan venistakkalti babbavua shelli ufachaz alay yitzri uvikkesh letordeni min haolam amarti lo rasha lama atta mitgae beolam sheeno shellecha bemi shehu atid lihot rimma vetolea haavoda sheagallechacha lashshamayim
Miyyad amadti unshaktiv al rosho amarti lo beni kamocha yirbu nozre nezirut beyisrael alecha hakkatuv omer ish ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir la
Matkef lah rabbi mani may shena asham nazir tame dela achal deate al chet kol ashamot name la lechol deal chet atu
Amar leh rabbi yona hayenu tama keshehen tohin nozrin uchshehen mittammein veravin alehen yeme nezirut mitchartin bahen venimtzeu meviin chullin laazara
I hachi afilu nazir tahor name nazir tahor la deamode amed nafsheh deyachol lindor
Veibaet ema

a: Afilu tema rabbi yehuda ki amar rabbi yehuda bindava beneder la amar
Vehakatane tov mizze umizze noder umkayyem teni nodev umkayyem
May shena noder dela dilma ate bah lide takkala nedava name dilma ate bah lide takkala
Rabbi yehuda letameh deamar adam mevi kivsato laazara umakdisha vesomech aleha veshochatah
Tinach nedava dekorbanot nedava dinzirut may ika lememar

Rabbi yehuda letameh detanya rabbi yehuda omer chasidim harishonim hau mitavin lehavi korban chattat lefi sheen hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yedehem ma hau osin omdim umitnaddevin nezirut lammakom kede sheyyitchayyev korban chattat lammakom

Rabbi shimon omer lo nadru benazir ella harotze lehavi ola mitnaddev umevi shelamim mitnaddev umevi toda vearbaa mine lachmah mitnaddev umevi aval binzirut lo hitnaddevu kede shello yikkaru chotin shenneemar vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh
Amar abbaye shimon hatztzaddik verabbi shimon verabbi elazar hakkappar kullan shita achat hen denazir chote have shimon hatztzaddik verabbi shimon ha daamaran

Verabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi detanya rabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi omer vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh vechi beezo nefesh chata ze ella shetztzier atzmo min hayyayin vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma ze shello tzier atzmo ella min hayyayin nikra chote hamtzaer atzmo mikkol davar al achat kamma vechamma mikkan kol hayyoshev betaanit nikra chote
Vehaden kera benazir tame ketiv mishshum deshana bechet hu

Matni haomer lachavero kunam kunnach kunnas hare ellu kinuyin lakkorban cherek cherech cheref hare ellu kinuyin lacherem nazik naziach paziach hare ellu kinuyin linzirut shevuta shekuka noder bemohi hare ellu kinuyin lashshevua
Gema itmar kinuyin rabbi yochanan amar leshon ummot hen rabbi shimon ben lakish amar lashon shebbadu lahem chachamim lihot noder bo vechen hu omer bachodesh asher bada millibbo
Vetama may takkinu rabbanan kinuyin dela lema korban velema korban dilma amar korban la velema korban la dilma amar la vela amar korban veka mappek shem shamayim levattala
Vetanya rabbi shimon omer
b: Minnayin shello yomar adam la ola la mincha la toda la shelamim talmud lomar korban la
Vekal vachomer uma ze shello nitkaven ella lehazkir shem shamayim al hakkorban amra tora korban la levattala al achat kamma vechamma
Lema ketannae bet shammay omrim kinuye chinuyin asurin uvet hillel omrim kinuye chinuyin muttarin
May lav man deamar kinuye chinuyin asurin kasavar kinuye chinuyin leshon ummot hen ulman deamar muttarim kasavar lashon shebbadu lahen chachamim
La dechulle alma kinuyin leshon ummot hen uvet shammay savri behane name mishtai ummot uvet hillel savri behane la mishtai ummot
Veibaet ema bet shammay savri gazrinan kinuye chinuyin mishshum kinuyin uvet hillel savri la gazrinan kinuye chinuyin mishshum kinuyin

Hechi dame kinuye chinuyin dindarim tane rav yosef maknemna maknachna maknesna hechi dame kinuye chinuyin decherem tane mafshaa charakim charachim charafim kinuye chinuyin dinzirut tane rav yosef machzekna manzachna mappichna
Ibaya lehu mipchazna may mitchazna may mitazna may amar leh ravina lerav ashe kinma may kunam kaamar o dilma kinneman besem kaamar
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav chiyya lerav ashe kina may kina shel tarnegolin kaamar o dilma lashon dekunam tibe

Kinuye chinuyin dishvua hechi dame shevuel shevutiel shekukael shevuel shevuel ben gershom mashma ella shevuvael shevutiel shekukael mahu amar shemuel amar ashshivta lo amar kelum ashkika lo amar kelum karinsa lo amar kelum
Nadar bemohi hare ellu chinuyin tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer haomer bemohi lo amar kelum bemomata daamar mohi hare ellu kinuyin lashshevua
Matni haomer lachullin sheochal lach la kashar vela deche tahor vetame notar ufigul asur

Keimra kedirim kaetzim kaishshim kammizbeach kahechal kirushalayim nadar beechad mikkol meshammeshe hammizbeach af al pi shello hizkir korban hare ze nadar bekorban rabbi yehuda omer haomer yerushalayim lo amar kelum

a: Gema savruha may lachullin la lechullin leheve ella korban
Manni matnitin i rabbi meir let leh mikkelal lav atta shomea hen ditnan rabbi meir omer kol tenay sheeno kitnay bene gad uvne reuven eno tenay
Ella rabbi yehuda hi ema sefa rabbi yehuda omer haomer yerushalayim lo amar kelum middesefa rabbi yehuda resha lav rabbi yehuda hi
Kulleh rabbi yehuda hi vehachi katane sherabbi yehuda omer haomer yerushalayim lo amar kelum
Vechi amar kirushalayim lerabbi yehuda mi mitsar vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer haomer kirushalayim lo amar kelum ad sheyyiddor bedavar hakkarev birushalayim
Kullah rabbi yehuda hi utre tannae alliba derabbi yehuda
b: Tanya chullin hachullin kechullin ben sheochal lach uven shello ochal lach muttar lachullin sheochal lach asur lachullin lo ochal lach muttar
Resha manni rabbi meir hi delet leh mikkelal lav atta shomea hen
Ema sefa lachullin lo ochal lach muttar vehatnan lakkorban lo ochal lach rabbi meir oser vekashya lan ha let leh mikkelal lav atta shomea hen
Veamar rabbi abba naasa keomer lekorban yehe lefichach lo ochal lach hacha name hachi kaamar leh la chullin leheve lefichach lo ochal lach
Hay tanna savar lah kerabbi meir bachada uflig aleh bachada savar lah kevateh bachada delet leh mikkelal lav atta shomea hen uflig aleh bachada bekorban
Rav ashe amar ha deamar lachullin veha deamar la lechullin demashma la leheve chullin ella kekorban
Tahor vetame notar ufigul asur bae rame bar chama hare alay kivsar zivche shelamim leachar zerikat damim mahu
I dekaamar behaden lishana behetera ka matpes ella kegon demachet besar zivche shelamim umachet dehetera gabbeh veamar ze kaze may beikaro ka matpes o behetera ka matpes
Amar rava ta shema notar ufigul

a: Veha notar ufigul leachar zerikat damim hu
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan benotar shel ola amar leh im ken litne bivsar ola
La mibaya kaamar la mibaya besar ola deasur deha bekorban ka matpes notar ufigul deola itztericha
Salka datach amena keisur notar keisur pigul vehave leh kematpes bedavar haasur vela mitsar ka mashma lan

Metivi ezehu isar haamur betora amar hareni shello ochal basar veshello eshte yayin kayyom shemmet bo aviv kayyom shemmet bo rabbo kayyom shenneherag bo gedalya ben achikam kayyom sheraiti yerushalayim bechurbanah veamar shemuel vehu shennadur beoto hayyom
Hechi dame lav kegon dekae bechad beshabba demit beh avuh veaf al gav deika tuva chad beshabba dehetera vekatane asur shema minah beikar hu matpes
Dishmuel hachi itmar amar shemuel vehu shennadur uva meoto hayyom veelach
Amar ravina ta shema kechallat aharon vechitrumato muttar ha kitrumat lachme toda asur
b: Veha terumat lachme toda leachar zerikat damim hi
Ema kitrumat hallishka asur
Aval terumat lachme toda may muttar litne lachme toda vechol shekken terumato ha ka mashma lan terumat lachme toda terumato hi
Vei baet ema terumat lachme toda name kodem zerikat damim hu kegon deafreshinhu belesha
Vechi ha deamar rav tovi bar kisna amar shemuel lachme toda sheafaan bearba challot yatza vehachtiv arbaim lemitzva

Veha bae lemishkal teruma vechi tema deshakel chada rifta al kullah vehatnan echad mikkol korban shello yittol mikkorban al chavero vechi tema deshakel perusa mikkol chad vechad vehatnan echad shello yittol perusa
Ella deafreshinhu belesha deshakel chada mechametz vachada min challot vachada min rekikim vachada min revucha
Lema ketannae hare alay kivchor rabbi yaakov oser verabbi yehuda mattir
Hechi dame i nema lifne zerikat damim may tama deman deshare vei leachar zerikat damim may tama deman deasar ella lav

a: Demachet besar bechor umachet basar dehayeche gabbeh veamar ze kaze vetannae hi
La dechulle alma lifne zerikat damim umay tama deman deshare amar kera ki yiddor ad sheyyiddor bedavar hannadur leappoke bechor dedavar haasur hu
Uman deasar amar kera la lerabbot davar haasur
Uman deshare la may aved leh mibe leh lematpis bechattat veasham
Uma raita lerabbot chattat veasham ulhotzi et habbechor merabbe ani chattat veasham shehu matpis beneder umotzi ani et habbechor shehu kadosh mimmee immo
Uman deasar bechor name matpiso beneder hu detanya mishshum rabbi amru minnayin lenolad bechor betoch beto shemmitzva lehakdisho shenneemar hazzachar takdish
Uman deshare ki la makdesh leh mi la mikaddesh
Keimra kaddirim

Tana imra leimra keimra dirim laddirim kaddirim etzim laetzim kaetzim ishim laishim kaishim mizbeach lammizbeach kammizbeach hechal lahechal kahechal yerushalayim lirushalayim kirushalayim kullan sheochal lach asur lo ochal lach muttar
Man shaminan leh dela shane leh imra leimra keimra rabbi meir hi
Ema sefa vechullan lo ochal lach muttar vehatnan lakkarban lo ochal lach rabbi meir oser veamar rabbi abba naasa keomer lekarban yehe lefichach lo ochal lach
La kashya ha deamar la leimra ha deamar leimra
Matni haomer korban ola mincha chattat toda shelamim sheani ochel lach asur rabbi yehuda mattir hakkorban kakkorban korban sheochal lach asur lakkorban lo ochal lach rabbi meir oser
Gema katane korban hakkorban kakkorban sheochal lach asur setama tena kerabbi meir dela shane leh ben imra leimra

I rabbi meir ha dekatane hakkorban sheochal lach asur vehatanya modim chachamim lerabbi yehuda beomer ha korban veha ola veha mincha veha chattat sheochal lach shemmuttar shello nadar ze ella bechayye korban
b: La kashya ha deamar ha korban veha deamar hakkorban may tama chayye korban kaamar
Katane lakkorban lo ochal lach rabbi meir oser veha let leh lerabbi meir mikkelal lav atta shomea hen amar rabbi abba naasa keomer lekorban yehe lefichach lo ochal lach
Matni haomer lachavero kunam pi medabber immach yadi osa immach ragli mehallechet immach asur

Gema urminhu chomer bashshevuot mibbannedarim uvannedarim mibbashshevuot chomer bannedarim shehannedarim chalim al hammitzva kevarshut ma sheen ken bashshevuot vechomer bashshevuot shehashshevuot chalot al davar sheyyesh bo mammash vesheen bo mammash ma sheen ken bannedarim
Amar rav yehuda beomer yeaser pi lediburi yaday lemaasehem raglay lehiluchan dayeka name dekatane pi medabber immach vela katane sheani medabber immach
Hadran alach kol kinnuye
Matni veellu muttarin chullin sheochal lach kivsar chazir kaavoda zara keorot levuvin kinvelot utrefot kishkatzim urmasim kechallat aharon vechitrumato muttar
Haomer leishto hare atte alay keima potchin lo petach mimmakom acher shello yakel rosho lechach
Gema tama deamar chullin sheochal lach ha amar lachullin sheochal lach mashma la lechullin leheve ella korban
Manni matnitin i rabbi meir ha let leh mikkelal

a: Lav atta shomea hen veella rabbi yehuda hayenu resha
Ayede dekatane kivsar chazir kaavoda zara lehachi katane chullin
Ravina amar hachi katane veellu muttarin kechullin kivsar chazir kaavoda zara vei la tena chullin hava amena bae sheela
Umi ika leassoke al data hachi ha middekatane sefa haomer leishto hare atte alay keima potchin lo petach mimmakom acher mikkelal deresha la baaya sheela ella mechavarta chullin mimmela nasvah
Menahane mile amar kera ish ki yiddor neder la ad sheyyiddor bedavar hannadur
I hachi afilu bedavar haasur name deha ketiv lesor issar al nafsho lesor issar mibbee leh lechidtanya ezehu isar haamur battora ku
Haomer leishto hare atte keima ku urminhu hare atte alay kivsar ima kivsar achoti keorla uchchile hakkerem lo amar kelum
Amar abbaye lo amar kelum middeorayeta vetzarich sheela midderabbanan rava amar ha betalmide chachamim ha beam haaretz
Vehatanya hannoder battora lo amar kelum veamar rabbi yochanan vetzarich sheela lechacham veamar rav nachman vetalmid chacham eno tzarich sheela
b: Tanya hannoder battora lo amar kelum bema shekkatuv bah devarav kayyamin bah uvma shekkatuv bah devarav kayyamin
Katane bema shekkatuv bah devarav kayyamin bah uvma shekkatuv bah tzerich lememar
Amar rav nachman la kashya ha demachata orayeta aara ha denaket lah bideh machata al ara dateh aggevile naket lah bideh dateh al haazkarot shebbah
Veibaet ema demachata al ara veha ka mashma lan deaf al gav demachata al ara kevan deamar bema shekkatuv bah mahane vezo veen tzarich lomar zo katane
Vei baet ema kullah metziata name denaket leh bideh veha ka mashma lan kevan denaket leh bideh af al gav dela amar ella bah keman deamar bema shekkatuv bah dame
Matni kunam sheani yashen sheani medabber sheani mehallech haomer leishsha kunam sheani meshammeshech hare ze belo yachel devaro

Gema itmar kunam enay beshena hayyom im ishan lemachar amar rav yehuda amar rav al yishan hayyom shemma yishan lemachar verav nachman amar yishan hayyom vela chayeshinan shemma yishan lemachar umode rav yehuda beomer kunam enay beshena lemachar im ishan hayyom sheyyishan hayyom

a: Ki la mizdehar bitnaa aval beisura mizdehar

Tenan kunam sheani yashen sheani mehallech sheani medabber vechu hechi dame ilema kidkatane sheani yashen mi have nidra vehatnan chomer bashshevuot shehashshevuot chalot al davar sheyyesh bo mammash veal davar sheen bo mammash ma sheen ken bannedarim veshena davar sheen bo mammash hu ella deamar kunam enay beshena
Vei dela yahev shiura mi shavkinan leh ad deavar isur bal yachel vehaamar rabbi yochanan shevua shello ishan shelosha yamim malkin oto veyashen lealtar
Ella daamar kunam enay beshena lemachar im ishan hayyom ha amratte kol beissureh mizdehar
Ella peshita deamar kunam enay beshena hayyom im ishan lemachar vei la nayem hayyom ki nayem lemachar may bal yachel devaro ika ella lav bidnayem alma iteh denayem utuvta derav yehuda
Ki katane dei nayem
Ravina amar leolam kidkatane umay bal yachel midderabbanan
Umi ika bal yachel midderabbanan in vehatanya devarim hammuttarin vaacherim nahagu bahen isur i atta rashshay lehattiran bifnehem shenneemar lo yachel devaro
Tenan sheatte nehenet li ad happesach im telchi levet avich ad hechag halcha lifne happesach asura bahanaato ad happesach
Halcha lifne happesach asura lo halcha la
Amar rabbi abba halcha lifne happesach asura veloka lo halcha asura bealma
Ema sefa achar happesach beval yachel devaro vei dela ithani lifne happesach mi ika bal yachel ella peshita deithani alma mithane
b: Utuvta derav yehuda
Ki katane dei ithani hare ze beval yachel devaro
Tenan sheatte nehenet li ad hechag im telchi levet avich ad happesach halcha lifne happesach asura bahanaato ad hechag umutteret lelech achar happesach
Halcha asura lo halcha la
Amar rava hu haddin daafilu lo halcha asura halcha asura veloka lo halcha asura bealma
Metivi kikkar zo alay hayyom im elech lemakom peloni lemachar achal hare ze beval yelech
Mi katane ochel achal katane dechi achal hare ze beval yelech
Halach hare ze beval yachel devaro mehallech la vekashya lerav yehuda
Amar lach rav yehuda hu haddin delitne mehallech ayede dekatane resha achal dela mitne leh ochel tane sefa halach
Haomer leishsha kunam sheani meshammeshech hare ze beval yachel devaro veha mishtabad lah middeorayeta dichtiv sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra
Beomer hanaat tashmishech alay veha la ka nicha leh betashmish
Deamar rav kahana tashmishi alecha kofin otah umshammashto deshabode meshubedet leh hanaat tashmishcha alay asur sheen maachilin lo leadam davar haasur lo
Matni shevua sheeni yashen sheeni medabber sheeni mehallech asur korban lo ochal lach ha korban sheochal lach lo korban lo ochal lach muttar

a: Gema manni matnitin rabbi meir hi dei rabbi yehuda la shane leh korban vela shane leh hakkorban
Ema sefa lakkorban lo ochal lach muttar vehatnan lakkorban lo ochal lach rabbi meir oser veamar rabbi abba naasa keomer lakkorban yehe lefichach lo ochal lach
La kashya ha deamar lakkorban ha deamar la lekorban dela have korban kaamar
Matni shevua lo ochal lach ha shevua sheochal lach la shevua lo ochal lach asur

Gema mikkelal deha shevua sheochal lach dela achelna mashma urminhu shevuot shettayim shehen arba sheochal veshello ochal sheachalti veshello achalti middekaamar shello ochal sheachalti veshello achalti mikkelal desheochal lach deachelna mashma

Amar abbaye sheochal shette leshonot mashma hau mesarvin bo leechol veamar achelna achelna vetu shevua sheochal deachelna mashma aval amar la achelna la achelna vetu amar shevua sheochal dela achelna kaamar
Rav ashe amar sheochal dishvua shei ochal kaamar im ken peshita may lememra mahu detema mekam lishana hi deitkil leh ka mashma lan
Abbaye la amar taam kerav ashe dela katane shei ochal

Verav ashe nade min taam deabbaye kasavar shello ochal name mashma shette leshonot hau mesarvin bo leechol veamar la achelna la achelna veamar name shevua ben sheochal ben shello ochal haden achelna mashma deamar
Veika letarotzah name lishana shevua shello ochal shevua dela achelna kaamar ella tanna paskah sheochal deachelna mashma veshello ochal lo ochal mashma

Matni ze chomer bashshevuot mibbannedarim vechomer bannedarim mibbashshevuot ketzad amar kunam sukka sheani ose lulav sheani notel tefilin sheani manniach bannedarim asur bashshevuot muttar sheen nishbain laavor al hammitzot
b: Gema chomer mikkelal deneder hu veha muttar katane
Assefa deidach bava katane shevua sheeni yashen sheeni medabber sheeni mehallech asur ze chomer bashshevuot mibbannedarim

Chomer bannedarim mibbashshevuot ketzad ku rav kahana matne amar rav gidel amar rav verav tavome matne amar rav gidel amar shemuel minnayin sheen nishbain laavor al hammitzot talmud lomar lo yachel devaro devaro lo yachel aval mechel hu lecheftze shamayim
May shena neder dichtiv ish ki yiddor neder la lo yachel devaro shevua name ha ketiv o hishshava shevua la lo yachel devaro
Amar abbaye ha deamar hanaat sukka alay ha deamar shevua shello ehene min hassukka
Amar rava vechi mitzot lehanot nitnu ella amar rava ha deamar yeshivat sukka alay veha deamar shevua shello eshev bassukka
Vesheen nishbain laavor al hammitzot mehacha nafka leh mehatam nafka leh detanya yachol nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bitel yachol yehe chayyav

a: Talmud lomar lehara o lehetiv ma hatava reshut af haraa reshut yatza nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bitel sheen harshut beyado
Chad kera lemiftereh mikkorban shevua vechad lemiftereh min lav dishvua

Matni yesh neder betoch neder veen shevua betoch shevua ketzad amar hareni nazir im ochal hareni nazir im ochal veachal chayyav al kol achat veachat shevua shello ochal shevua shello ochal veachal eno chayyav ella achat

Gema amar rav huna lo shanu ella deamar hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir lemachar demigo deka mitosaf yoma yattira chayela nezirut al nezirut aval amar hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir hayyom en chala nezirut al nezirut ushmuel amar afilu amar hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir hayyom chala nezirut aleh

Ulrav huna additna en shevua betoch shevua litne yesh neder betoch neder veen neder betoch neder hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir lemachar yesh neder betoch neder hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir hayyom
b: En neder betoch neder kashya

Tenan yesh neder betoch neder veen shevua betoch shevua hechi dame ilema deamar hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir lemachar dichotah gabbe shevua shello ochal teenim vechazar veamar shevua shello ochal anavim ammay la chala shevua al shevua

Ella hechi dame dela chala shevua al shevua kegon deamar shevua shello ochal teenim vechazar veamar shevua shello ochal teenim dichotah gabbe nezirut hechi dame deamar hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir hayyom vekatane yesh neder betoch neder kashya lerav huna
Amar lecha rav huna matnitin deamar hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir lemachar dichotah gabbe shevua deamar shello ochal teenim vechazar veamar shevua shello ochal teenim vaanavim dela chayela

Vehaamar rabba shevua shello ochal teenim vechazar veamar shevua shello ochal teenim vaanavim veachal teenim vehifrish korban vechazar veachal anavim haveya lehu anavim chatzi shiur veen meviim korban al chatzi shiur
Alma hecha deamar shevua shello ochal teenim vechazar veamar shevua shello ochal teenim vaanavim migo dechal shevua al anavim chayela name al teenim rav huna la sevira leh kerabba
Metivi mi shennazar shette nezirot mana et harishona vehifrish korban venishal aleha alta lo sheniyya barishona
Hechi dame ilema deamar hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir lemachar ammay alta lo sheniyya barishona ha ika yoma yattira ella peshita deamar hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir hayyom

a: Utuvta derav huna
La leolam hareni nazir hayyom hareni lemachar umay alta lo levar mehahu yoma yattira i name kegon shekkibel shette nezirut bevat achat

Metiv rav hamnuna nazir lehazzir mikkan shehannezirut chal al hannezirut sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma shevua chamura en shevua chala al shevua nezirut kalla lo kol shekken talmud lomar nazir lehazzir mikkan shehannezirut chala al hannezirut
Hechi dame ilema deamar hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir lemachar ha kera baaya ella lav deamar hareni nazir hayyom hareni nazir hayyom vekatane nezirut chal al nezirut
La hacha bemay askinan kegon shekkibel alav shette nezirut bevat achat
Umay chumra dishvua minneder ilema mishshum dechayela afilu al davar sheen bo mammash neder name chamur shekken chal al hammitzva kirshut ella mishshum dichtiv bah bishvua lo yenakke

Shevua shello ochal shevua shello ochal veachal eno chayyav ella achat amar rava im nishal al harishona sheniyya chala alav mimmay middela katane eno ella achat vekatane eno chayyav ella achat ravecha hu delet lah ki mitshil al chavertah chayela
Lishana acharina chiyyuva hu deleka ha shevua ika lemay hilcheta lechidrava deamar rava nishal al harishona alta lo sheniyya tachteha
Lema mesayya leh mi shennadar shette nezirot umana et harishona vehifrish korban venishal aleha alta lo sheniyya barishona
Kegon shekkibel alav shette nezirot bevat achat
b: Matni setam nedarim lehachamir uferusham lehakel ketzad amar hare alay kevasar maliach keyen nesech im beshel shelamim nadar asur
Im beshel avoda zara nadar muttar veim setam asur
Hare alay kecherem im kecherem shel shamayim asur veim kecherem shel kohanim muttar veim setam asur
Hare alay kemaaser im kemasar behema nadar asur veim shel goren muttar veim setam asur
Hare alay kitruma im kitrumat hallishka nadar asur veim shel goren muttar veim setam asur divre rabbi meir

Rabbi yehuda omer setam teruma bihuda asura baggalil mutteret sheen anshe galil makkirin et terumat hallishka setam charamim bihuda muttarin baggalil asurin sheen anshe galil makkirin et cherme hakkohanim
Gema vehatnan sefek nezirut lehakel
Amar rabbi zera la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ha rabbanan detanya hammakdish chayyato uvhemto hikdish et hakkoy rabbi eliezer omer lo hikdish et hakkoy
Man deamar mamono meayyel lisfeka gufeh name meayyel uman deamar mamono la meayyel lisfeka gufeh name

a: Kol shekken dela meayyel lisfeka
Amar leh abbaye bemay okemta lisfek nezirut lehakel kerabbi eliezer ema sefa sefek bechorot echad bechore adam veechad bechore vehema ben temea ben tehora hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Vetane alah vaasurim begiza vaavoda
Amar leh ammay ka medammet kedushsha habbaa meeleha likdushsha habbaa bide adam
Ella i kashya ha kashya sefek mashkin litame tame letamme acherim tahor divre rabbi meir vechen haya rabbi elazar omer kidvarav
Umi sevira leh lerabbi eliezer litame tame
Vehatanya rabbi eliezer omer en tuma lemashkin kol ikar teda shehare heid yose ben yoezer ish tzereda al ayyal kamtza dechan veal mashkin bet mitbechayya dechan
Hanicha lishmuel deamar dechan milletamme acherim aval tumat atzman yesh bahen shappir
Ella lerav deamar dechan mammash may ika lememar
Ella ha rabbi yehuda veha rabbi shimon
Detanya hareni nazir im yesh bichri hazze mea kor vehalach umtzao shennignav o sheavad rabbi yehuda mattir verabbi shimon oser

Verame derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda mi amar rabbi yehuda la meayyel inish nafsheh lisfeka urminhi rabbi yehuda omer setam teruma bihuda asura uvaggalil mutteret sheen anshe haggalil makkirin et terumat hallishka tama deen makkirin
b: Ha makkirin asurin
Amar rava gabbe keri kasavar kol shessefeko chamur mivadday la meayyel nafsheh lisfeka deilu gabbe nazir vadday megalleach umevi korban veneechal al sefeko la matze megallach
Amar leh rav huna bar yehuda lerava amar hareni nezir olam may
Amar leh nezir olam name sefeko chamur mivadday deilu vadday hichbid searo mekel betaar umevi shalosh behemot veilu sefeko lo
Amar hareni nezir shimshon may
Amar leh nezir shimshon la tanya amar leh vehaamar rav adda bar ahava tanya nezir shimshon amar leh i tanya tanya
Rav ashe amar hahi rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi tarfon hi detanya rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi tarfon omer en echad mehem nazir lefi shello nitna nezirut ella lehaflaa
I hachi may irya shennignav o sheavad ella lehodiacha kocho derabbi shimon deaf al gav denignav o sheavad kasavar meayyel inish nafsheh lisfeka
Rabbi yehuda omer setam teruma bihuda ku ha makkirin asurin alma sefeka lechumra
Ema sefa setam charamim bihuda muttarin uvaggalil asurin sheen anshe haggalil makkirin et cherme hakkohanim ha makkirin muttarin alma sefeka lekulla
Amar abbaye sefa rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok hi detanya rabbi yehuda omer setam teruma bihuda asura rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer setam charamim baggalil asurin

a: Matni nadar becherem veamar lo nadarti ella bechermo shel yam bekorban veamar lo nadarti ella bekorbanot shel melachim
Hare atzmi korban veamar lo nadarti ella beetzem shehinnachti li lihot noder bo kunam ishti nehenet li veamar lo nadarti ella beishti harishona sheggerashti
Al kullan en nishalin lahem veim nishalu onshin otan umachmirin alehen divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim potchin lahen petach mimmakom acher umlammedin otan kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim
Gema ha gufa kashya amratte en nishalin lahen vahadar tane im nishalu onshin otan umachmirin alehen
Amar rav yehuda hachi katane vechullan en tzerichin sheela bamme devarim amurim betalmid chacham aval beam haaretz shebba lishael onshin oto umachmirin alav
Bishlama machmirin dela patchinan leh bacharata ella onshin hechi dame

Kidtanya mi shennazar veavar al neziruto en nizkakin lo ad sheyyinhog bo isur kayyamim shennahag bahen heter divre rabbi yehuda amar rabbi yose bamme devarim amurim binzirut muetet aval binzirut merubba dayyo sheloshim yom
Amar rav yosef hoil veamri rabbanan en nizkakim lo be dina demizdakki la aved shappir rav acha bar yaakov omer meshammetinan leh

Vachachamim omrim potchin lo petach ku tana leolam al tehi ragil bannedarim shessofcha limol bishvuot veal tehi ragil etzel am haaretz shessofcha lehaachilcha tevalim al tehi ragil etzel kohen am haaretz shessofcha lehaachilcha teruma veal tarbe sicha im haishsha shessofcha lavo lide niuf

Rabbi acha berabbi yoshiyya omer kol hatztzofe benashim sofo ba lide avera vechol hammistakkel baakevah shel ishsha haveyin lo banim sheenan mehugganin amar rav yosef uvishto nidda amar rabbi shimon ben lakish akevah dekatane bimkom hattinnofet shehu mechuuon keneged heakev

Tanya baavur tihye yirato al penechem zo busha levilti techetau melammed shehabbusha mevia lide yirat chet mikan amru siman yafe beadam shehu bayeshan acherim omrim kol adam hammitbayyesh lo bimhera hu chote umi sheen lo boshet panim beyadua shello amdu avotav al har sinay

Amar rabbi yochanan ben dahavay arbaa devarim sachu li malache hashsharet chigrin mippene ma haveyin mippene shehofchim et shulchanam ilmim mippene ma haveyin mippene shemmenashshekim al oto makom chershim mippene ma haveyin mippene shemsapperim bishat tashmish somin mippene ma haveyin mippene shemmistakkelim beoto makom
Urminhu shaalu et ima shalom mippene ma
b: Banayich yefefin beoter amra lahen eno mesapper immi lo bitchillat hallayela velo besof hallayela ella bachatzot hallayela uchshehu mesapper megalle tefach umchasse tefach vedome alav kemi shekkefao shed
Veamarti lo ma taam veamar li kede shello etten et enay beishsha acheret venimtzeu banav bain lide mamzerut
La kashya ha bemile detashmish ha bemile achranyata

Amar rabbi yochanan zo divre yochanan ben dahavay aval amru chachamim en halacha keochanan ben dahavay ella kol ma sheadam rotze laasot beishto ose mashal levasar habba mibbet hattabbach ratza leochlo bemelach ochlo tzali ochlo mevushshal ochlo shaluk ochlo vechen dag habba mibbet hatztzayyad

Amar ammemar man malache hashsharet rabbanan dei tema malache hashsharet mammash ammay amar rabbi yochanan en halacha keochanan ben dahavay ha inhu bekii betzurat havalad tefe veammay karu lehu malache hashsharet dimtzayeni kemalache hashsharet

Hahi daatay lekammeh derabbi amra lo rabbi arachti lo shulchan vahafacho amar lah bitti tora hittiratech vaani ma eese lich hahi daatay lekammeh derav amra lo rabbi arachti lo shulchan vahafacho amar may shena min binita
Velo taturu achare levavchem mikkan amar rabbi al yishte adam bechos ze veyitten enav bechos acher amar ravina lo nitzrecha ella daafilu shette nashav
Uvaroti mikkem hammordim vehapposhim bi amar rabbi levi ellu bene tesha middot bene osnat
Bene ema bene anusa bene senua bene niduy bene temura bene meriva bene shichrut bene gerushat hallev bene irbuvya bene chatzufa

Ini vehaamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol adam sheishto tovato haveyin lo banim sheafilu bedoro shel moshe rabbenu lo hau kemotam shenneemar havu lachem anashim chachamim unvonim uchtiv vaekkach et rashe shivtechem vela ketiv nevonim
Uchtiv yissashchar chamor garem uchtiv mibbene yissashchar yode vina laittim
Hahi demartzeya artzoye
Hadaran alach veellu muttarin

Arbaa nedarim hittiru chachamim nidre zeruzin venidre havay venidre shegagot venidre onasin nidre zeruzin ketzad haya mocher chefetz veamar kunam sheeni pochet lecha min hassela vehalla omer kunam sheeni mosif lach al hashshekel

a: Shenehem rotzin bishlosha dinarin

Gema arbaa nedarim hittiru chachamim ku amar leh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi amme amarte lan mishshemeh derabbi yehuda nesia man tena arbaa nedarim rabbi yehuda hi deamar mishshum rabbi tarfon leolam en echad mehen nazir lefi shello nitna nezirut ella lehaflaa
Rava amar afilu tema rabbanan mi katane shenehen ratzu shenehen rotzin katane
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe amar lo tefe missela vehalla omer betzir mishshekel nidra have o zeruzin have

Amar leh tenena haya mesarev bachavero sheyyochal etzlo veamar lo kunam betcha sheani nichnas tipat tzonen sheani toem muttar likanes leveto velishtot hemennu tzonen shello nitkaven ze ella leshum achila ushtiyya
Veammay veha tipat tzonen kaamar ella mishtae inish hachi hacha name mishtae inish hachi
Amar leh
b: Mi dame gabbe tzonen tzaddikim omrim meat veosin harbe
Hacha sefeka hu dilma pachot missela veoter al shekel kaamar vezeruzin have o dilma daveka kaamar venidra have tibbee
Amar rav yehuda amar rav assi arbaa nedarim hallalu tzerichin sheela lechacham ki amrita kammeh dishmuel amar tanna tane arbaa nedarim hittiru chachamim veatte amratte tzerichin sheela lechacham
Rav yosef matni lah leha shemata behay lishana amar rav yehuda amar rav assi en chacham rashshay lehattir ella keen arbaa nedarim hallalu kasavar en potchin bacharata
Hahu daata lekammeh derav huna amar leh libbach alach amar leh la vesharyeh
Hahu daata lekammeh derabba bar rav huna amar leh ilu hau asara bene adam sheyefayesuch beotah shaa mi nadarta amar leh lo vehittiro

Tanya rabbi yehuda omer omrim lo laadam lev ze alecha im amar lav mattirin oto rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv omrim lo laadam ilu hau asara bene adam sheyefayesuch beotah shaa mi nadarta im amar lav mattirin oto
Siman assi veelazar yochanan veyannay

Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi assi amar leh kedu tahet amar leh la vesharyeh hahu daata lekammeh derabbi elazar amar leh baet nadur amar leh ilu la margezin li la baenan kelum amar leh tehe kevaet hahi itta deaddartah livrattah atay lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar lah ilu hava yadatte deamran megeratich alah divrattich

a: Ilu la chamat bah imah milin daaziva bichdi la addartah mi addartah amara leh la vesharyah
Bar beratte derabbi yannay sava ata lekammeh derabbi yannay sava amar leh ilu hava yadatte defatchin pinkesach ummashmeshin beovadach mi nedarte amar leh la vesharyeh
Amar rabbi abba may keraa veachar nedarim levakker veaf al gav diftach rabbi yannay leh anan la patchinan leh beha

Vela patchinan behada achraniyta deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan may petach leh rabban gamliel lehahu sava yesh bote kemadkerot charev ulshon chachamim marpe kol habbote rauy ledokro becherev ella leshon chachamim marpe
Vela patchinan bahada achraniyta detanya rabbi natan omer hannoder keilu bana bama vehamkayemo keilu makriv alav korban beresha patchinan besefa abbaye amar patchinan rava amar la patchinan
Rav kahana matne lah leha shemata behaden lishana rav tavome matne hachi besefa la patchinan beresha abbaye amar patchinan rava amar la patchinan vehilcheta la patchinan la beresha vela besefa

Vela patchinan beha name dishmuel deamar shemuel af al pi shemmekayemo nikra rasha amar rabbi avahu may kera vechi techdal lindor lo yihye vecha chet veyalef chadala chadala ketiv hacha vechi techdal lindor uchtiv hatam sham reshaim chadlu rogez
Amar rav yosef af anan name tenena kenidre chesherim lo amar kelum kenidre reshaim nadar benazir uvkorban uvishvua

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol hakkoes kol mine gehinnam sholtin bo shenneemar vehaser kaas millibbecha vehaaver raa mibbesarecha veen raa ella gehinnam shenneemar kol paal Adonai lammaanehu vegam rasha leom raa

Velo od ella shehattachtoniyyot sholtot bo shenneemar venatan Adonai lecha sham lev raggaz vechilon enayim vedaavon nafesh ezehu davar shemmechalle et haenayim umadiv et hannefesh heve omer ellu hattachtoniyyot

Ulla bemiskeh leara deyisrael itleo leh teren bene chozae bahadeh kam chad shachteh lechavreh amar leh leulla yaut avadi amar leh in ufra leh bet hashshechita ki ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh dilma chas veshalom achziki yede ovre avera amar leh nafshecha hitztzalta
Ka tamah rabbi yochanan mikkedi ketiv venatan Adonai lecha sham lev raggaz bevavel ketiv amar leh hahu shata
b: La avrinan yardena

Amar rabba bar rav huna kol hakkoes afilu shechina enah chashuva kenegdo shenneemar rasha kegovah appo bal yidrosh en elohim kol mezimmotav rabbi yirmeya middifti amar meshakkeach talmudo umosif tipshut shenneemar ki chaas bechek kesilim yanuach uchtiv uchsil yifros ivelet rav nachman bar yitzchak amar beyadua sheaonotav merubbin mizzechiyyotav shenneemar uvaal chema rav pasha
Amar rav adda berabbi chanina ilmale lo chatu yisrael lo nitan lahem ella chamishsha chumshe tora vesefer yehoshua bilvad sheerkah shel eretz yisrael hu may tama ki berov chochma rov kaas
Amar rabbi assi en nizkakin leelohe yisrael chutz mikkunnam ishti nehenet li shegganva et kisi veshehikketa et beni venoda shello ganva veshello hikkattu
Hahi daatay lekammeh derav assi amar lah bemay nedarte belohe yisrael amar lah i nedarte bemohi shehi kinuy bealma mizdekikna lich hashta dela nedarte bemohi ella belohe yisrael la mizdekikna lich

Rav kahana ikla leve rav yosef amar leh litom mar mide amar leh la mare kolla la taemna leh amar leh la mare kolla la taamatte leh hanicha lerav kahana deamar la mare kolla ella lerav yosef ammay amar la mare kolla hachi hu dekaamar leh la mare kolla hu dekaamratte hilkach la taamatte leh
Amar rava amar rav nachman hilcheta potchin bacharata venizkakin lelohe yisrael
Mishtabbach leh rava lerav nachman berav sechora deadam gadol hu amar lo kesheyyavo leyadcha haviehu leyadi hava leh nidra lemishre ata lekammeh derav nachman
Amar leh nedarte addata dehachi amar leh in addata dehachi in kamma zimnin ikfad rav nachman amar leh zil lekilach

Nefak rav sechora uftach pitcha lenafsheh rabbi omer eze hi derech yeshara sheyyavor lo haadam kol shehi tiferet leoseha vetiferet lo min haadam vehashta deikfad rav nachman addata dehachi la nedari ushra lenafsheh
Rabbi shimon berabbi hava leh nidra lemishre ata lekammayehu derabbanan amri leh nedarte addata dehachi amar in addata dehachi in kamma zimnin

a: Vahao mitztaari rabbanan mishshimsha letulla umittulla leshimsha
Lishana achara addata dehachi in kamma zimnin vahao mitztaari rabbanan mishshimsha letulla umittulla leshimsha
Amar leh batnit bereh deabba shaul ben batnit mi nedarte addata demitztaari rabbanan mittulla leshimsha umishshimsha letulla amar la vesharuh

Rabbi yishmael bar rabbi yose hava leh nidra lemishre ata lekammayehu derabbanan amru leh nedarte addata dehachi amar lehu in nedarta addata dehachi amar lehu in kamma zimnin kevan dachaza hahu katztzara demitztaari rabbanan machyeh beuchla dekatztzare amar addata demache li katztzara la nedari vesharyeh lenafsheh
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina hay nolad hu dela massek addata demache leh katztzara utnena en potchin lo bannolad amar leh hay lav nolad hu dishchichi appikore dimtzaari rabbanan

Devethu deabbaye hava lah hahi beratta hu amar lekarivay hi amra lekarivah amar lah titsar hanaati alach i avratte addatay umansevat lah lekarivach azalat vaavarat al dateh veinasva lekarivah ata lekammeh derav yosef amar leh ilu hava yadatte daavarat al datach umanseva lah lekarivah mi addartah amar la vesharyeh rav yosef

Umi shere ki hay gavena in vehatanya maase beadam echad shehiddir et ishto millaalot laregel veavra al dato vealta laregel uva lifne rabbi yose amar lo veilu hayita yodea sheoveret al datecha veola laregel kelum hiddartah amar lo lo vehittiro rabbi yose
Matni rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer af harotze lehaddir et chavero sheyyochal etzlo yomar lo kol neder sheani atid lidor hu batel uvilvad sheyehe zachur bishat hanneder
Gema vechevan deamar kol neder sheani atid lidor yehe batel la shama leh vela ate bahadeh
b: Chassore michassera vehachi katane harotze sheyyochal etzlo chavero umsarev bo umaddiro nidre zeruzin hu veharotze shello yitkayemu nedarav kol hashshana yaamod berosh hashshana veyomar kol neder sheani atid lidor yehe batel uvilvad sheyehe zachur bishat hanneder
I zachur akreh litnaeh vekayyem leh lenidreh amar abbaye tane uvilvad shello yehe zachur bishat hanneder

Rava amar leolam kidamrinan meikara hacha bemay askinan kegon shehitna berosh hashshana velo yada bamme hitna vehashta ka nadar i zachur bishat hanneder veamar al daat harishona ani noder nidreh let beh mammasha lo amar al daat harishona ani noder akreh litnaeh vekayyem lenidreh
Rav huna bar chinana savar lemidresheh befirka amar leh rava tanna ka mesattem lah sattome kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim veatte darshatte leh befirka
Ibaya lehu peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ben yaakov o la veim timtza lomar peligi hilcheta kevateh o la ta shema ditnan haomer lachavero

a: Kunam sheeni nehene lecha im i atta notel levincha kor shel chitin ushte chaviyyot shel yayin hare ze yachol lehattir et nidro shello al pi chacham sheyyachol lomar lo kelum amarta ella bishvil kevodi ze hu kevodi
Tama deamar ze hu kevodi ha lav hachi neder hu manni i rabbi eliezer ben yaakov nidre zeruzin have ella shema minah peligi rabbanan aleh
Leolam rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi umode rabbi eliezer ben yaakov behay denidra have deamar leh la kalba ana demithanena minach vela mithanet minay

Ta shema haomer lachavero kunam sheatta nehenet li im i atta noten livni kor shel chitin ushte chaviyyot shel yayin rabbi meir omer ad sheyyitten vachachamim omrim af ze yachol lehattir et nidro shello al pi chacham sheyyachol lomar hareni keilu hitkabbalti
Tama deamar hareni keilu hitkabbalti ha lav hachi neder hu manni i rabbi eliezer ben yaakov nidre zeruzin have ella lav rabbanan ufligi
La leolam rabbi eliezer ben yaakov umode rabbi eliezer behay denidra have mishshum deamar leh lav malka ana dimhannena lach veatte la mehannet li

Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe ta shema nidre onasin hiddiro chavero sheyyochal etzlo vechala hu o chala beno o sheikkevo nahar ha lav hachi neder hu manni i rabbi eliezer ben yaakov zeruzin have ella lav rabbanan ufligi

Leolam rabbi eliezer ben yaakov umi savratte deaddereh mezammena lizmina la dizmina addereh limzammena daamar leh mezammenatte li lisodtach amar leh in neder ze alecha venadar vechala hu o shechala beno o sheikkevo nahar hare ellu nidre onasin

Ta shema yater al ken amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov haomer lachavero kunam sheani nehene lach im i atta mitareach etzli vetochal immi pat chamma vetishte immi kos chammin vehalla hikpid kenegdo af ellu nidre zeruzin velo hodu lo chachamim may lo hodu lo chachamim lav
b: Daafilu bekammayeta ushma minah peligi rabbanan aleh shema minah
May have alah ta shema deamar rav huna halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov vechen amar rav adda bar ahava halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov
Matni nidre havay amar kunam im lo raiti badderech hazze keole mitzrayim im lo raiti nachash kekorat bet habbad
Gema tana nidre havay muttarin shavuot havay asurin
Hechi dame shavuot havay ilema deamar shevua im lo raiti badderech hazze midaam kaamar
Amar abbaye deamar shevua sheraiti amar leh rava im ken lema li lememar veod dumya deneder katane ella amar rava beomer yeasru perot haolam alay bishvua im lo raiti badderech hazze keole mitzrayim
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe vedilma hay gavra kina deshumshemane chaza veassek lehon shema ole mitzrayim veshappir mishteva

a: Amar leh ki mishteva addata didan mishteva vaanan la massekinan nafshin ashshumshemane

Veal data denafsheh la avid inish demishteva vehatanya keshehen mashbiin oto omrim lo heve yodea shello al tenay shebbelibbecha anu mashbiin otcha ella al datenu veal daat bet din leappoke may lav leappoke deassek lehu leiskundere veassek lehon shema zuze
Umiddekaamar al datenu mikkelal daavid inash demishteva addata denafsheh
La leappoke mikkanya derava dehahu gavra dahava massek bechavreh zuze ata lekammeh derava amar leh lelove zil pera li amar leh peraticha amar leh rava im ken zil ishteva leh difrateh
Azal veayeti kanya veyahev zuze begaveh vahava mistemich veazel veate aleh leve dina amar leh lemalve nekot hay kanya bidach nesav sefer tora veishteva defareh kol ma dahava leh bideh
Hahu malve regaz vetavreh lehahu kanya veishtefuch hanhu zuze leara veishtechach dekushta ishteva

Veakkatti la avid demishteva addata denafsheh vehatanya vechen matzinu bemoshe rabbenu keshehishbia et yisrael bearvot moav amar lahem heu yodim shello al datechem ani mashbia etchem ella al dati veal daat hammakom shenneemar velo ittechem levaddechem vego

La avoda zara ikri eloha dichtiv uvchal elohe mitzrayim vego

b: Matni nidre shegagot im achalti veim shatiti venizkar sheachal veshata sheani ochel vesheani shote veshachach veachal veshata amar kunam ishti nehenet li shegganva et kisi veshehikketa et beni venoda shello hikkattu venoda shello ganva
Raa otan ochlin teenim veamar hare alechem korban venimtzeu aviv veachiv vehau immahen acherim bet shammay omrim hen muttarim uma sheimmahem asurim uvet hillel omrim ellu vaellu muttarin

Gema tana keshem shennidre shegagot muttarin kach shevuot shegagot muttarot hechi dame shevuot shegagot kegon rav kahana verav assi haden amar shevuata dehachi amar rav vehaden amar shevuata dehachi amar rav dechol chad vechad addata denafsheh shappir kamishteva
Raa otan ochlin tenan hatam potchin beshabbatot uvyamim tovim barishona hau omrim otan hayyamim muttarim ushar kol hayyamim asurim ad shebba rabbi akiva velimed neder shehuttar miktzato huttar kullo

Amar rabba dechulle alma kol hecha deamar ilu hayiti yodea sheabba benechem hayiti omer kullechem asurin chutz meabba dechullehon asurin veaviv muttar lo nechleku ella beomer ilu hayiti yodea sheabba benechem hayiti omer peloni ufloni asurin veabba muttar

a: Verava amar dechulle alma kol hecha deamar ilu hayiti yodea sheabba benechem hayiti omer peloni ufloni asurin veabba muttar kullam muttarin lo nechleku ella beomer ilu hayiti yodea sheabba benechem hayiti omer kullechem asurin chutz meabba

Uvet hillel savri lah kerabbi yose deamar bigmar devarav adam nitpas

Vesefa deamar lechullechem

b: Ella sefa deamar laze velaze rabbi akiva hi ammay peligi rabbanan aleh vehaamratte divre hakkol muttar
Amar leh rava ulrabba lerabbi akiva mi nicha sefa bemay mokem leh deamar lechullechem he den hu rishon vehe den hu acharon
Ella resha deamar lechullechem vesefa kegon shettelaan ze baze veamar peloni kifloni ufloni kifloni
Dayeka name detanya huttar haemtzai hemennu ulmatta muttarin ulmala asurin

May lav deamar ilu hayiti yodea shehakkufri yafe lallev hayiti omer kol habbetzalim asurin vechufri muttar
Lo beomer ilu hayiti yodea shehakkufri yafe lallev hayiti omer batzal peloni ufloni asurin vechufri muttar verabbi meir alliba derabbi akiva vealliba derabbanan
Etiveh ravina lerava rabbi natan omer yesh neder shemmiktzato muttar umiktzato asur ketzad nadar min hakkalkalla

a: Vehau bah benot shuach veamar ilu hayiti yodea shebbenot shuach betochah lo hayiti noder hakkalkalla asura benot shuach muttarot ad shebba rabbi akiva velimed neder shehuttar miktzato huttar kullo may lav deamar ilu hayiti yodea shebbenot shuach betochah hayiti omer teenim shechorot ulvanot asurot benot shuach muttarot verabbi akiva hi ufligi rabbanan
La beomer ilu hayiti yodea shebbenot shuach betochah hayiti omer kol hakkalkalla asura uvnot shuach muttarot
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan nadar mechamishsha bene adam keechad huttar leechad mehem hutteru kullan chutz meechad mehen hu muttar vehen asurin
I lerabba resha rabbi akiva vesefa divre hakkol i lerava sefa rabbanan veresha divre hakkol
Matni nidre onasin hiddiro chavero sheyyochal etzlo vechala hu o shechala beno o sheikkevo nahar hare ellu nidre onasin
Gema hahu gavra deatpes zachota beve dina veamar i la atena ad telatin yomin libatlun hane zachotay itnis vela ata amar rav huna betil zachoteh
Amar leh rava anus hu veanus rachamana patreh dichtiv velannaara lo taase davar
Vechi tema ketala shane vehatnan nidre onasin hiddiro chavero sheyyochal etzlo vechala hu o shechala beno o sheikvo nahar hare ellu nidre onasin
Ulrava may shena meha ditnan hare ze gitech meachshav im lo bati mikkan ad shenem asar chodesh umet betoch shenem asar chodesh hare ze get ammay veha menas itnis amri dilma shane hatam
b: Dei hava yada demit min lealtar hava gamar veyahev gita

Dilma unsa demigalleya shane umabara migalle unseh

Vehecha demitafsin lav asmachta hi vehatnan mi sheppara miktzat chovo vehishlish et shetaro veamar im en ani noten lo mikkan ad sheloshim yom ten lo shetaro
Higgia zeman velo natan rabbi yose omer yitten verabbi yehuda omer lo yitten veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav en halacha kerabbi yose deamar asmachta kanya
Shane hacha deamar libbatlan zachvateh

Matni nodrin leharagin velecharamin velammochsin shehi teruma af al pi sheeno teruma shehen shel bet hammelech af al pi sheenan shel bet hammelech bet shammay omrim bakkol nodrin

a: Chutz mibbishvua uvet hillel omrim af bishvua
Bet shammay omrim lo yiftach lo beneder uvet hillel omrim af yiftach lo bet shammay omrim bamme shehu maddiro uvet hillel omrim af bamme sheeno maddiro
Ketzad amar lo emor kunam ishti nehenet li veamar kunam ishti uvanay nehenin li bet shammay omrim ishto mutteret uvanav asurin uvet hillel omrim ellu vaellu muttarin
Gema vehaamar shemuel dina demalchuta dina
Amar rav chinana amar rav kahana amar shemuel bemoches sheen lo kitzva deve rabbi yannay amar bemoches haomed meelav
Shehen shel bet hammelech veaf al pi sheenan shel bet hammelech hechi nadar amar rav amram amar rav beomer yeasru perot haolam alay im enan shel bet hammelech
Kevan deamar yeasru itsaru aleh kol pere alma beomer hayyom i deamar hayyom la mekabbel mineh moches
Beomer belibbo hayyom umotzi bisfatav setam veaf al gav disvira lan devarim shebballev enan devarim legabbe onasin shane

Bet shammay omrim bakkol ku bet shammay omrim bamme shehu maddiro uvet hillel omrim af besheeno maddiro ketzad amar lo kunam ishti nehenet li veamar kunam ishti uvanay nehenin li bet shammay omrim ishto mutteret uvanav asurin uvet hillel omrim ellu vaellu muttarin

Amar rav huna tana bet shammay omrim lo yiftach lo bishvua uvet hillel omrim af yiftach lo bishvua levet shammay bishvua hu delo yiftach lo ha beneder yiftach lo veha tenan bet shammay omrim lo yiftach lo banneder
Vetu miftach hu dela yiftach lo bishvua ha midar nadar bishvua vehatnan bet shammay omrim bakkol nodrin chutz mibbishvua
Tanna matnitin beneder lehodiacha kochan devet shammay tanna barayeta bishvua lehodiacha kochan devet hillel
Rav ashe amar hachi katane bet shammay omrim en sheela bishvua uvet hillel omrim yesh sheela bishvua
Matni hare netiot haellu korban im enan niktzatzot tallit zo korban im enah nisrefet yesh lahen pidon hare netiot haellu korban ad sheyyikkatztzu tallit zo korban ad shettissaref
b: En lahem pidon
Gema velitne kedoshot veen kedoshot ayede devae lemitna sefa en lahem pidon tena name resha yesh lahem pidon
Hechi nadar amar ammemar beomer im enan niktzatzot hayyom veavar hayyom velo niktzetzu im ken lema li lememar peshita la tzericha kegon deika zika nefisha
Veha katane lah gabbe tallit vetallit lisrefa kayema in kegon deika deleka hacha name deika zika nefisha vesalka datach demassek addateh dela mitnatzlan umishshum hachi ka nadar ka mashma lan
Hare netiot haellu korban ku ulolam amar bar peda pedaan chozrot vekodshot pedaan chozrot vekodshot ad sheyyikkatztzu niktzetzu podan paam achat vedayyo veulla amar kevan shenniktzetzu shuv en podan

a: Amar leh rav hamnuna kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha uma ilu amar leishsha hayyom atte ishti ulmachar i atte ishti mi nafka bela get

Hacha bemay askinan deamar lidme
I hachi ema sefa leachar sheloshim yom ola umeachshav shelamim i amratte bishlama chada bikdushshat hagguf vachada bikdushshat damim
b: Hayenu deitzterich leh letanna lemitne tarte desalka datach amena kedushshat hagguf la paka bichdi kedushshat damim paka bichdi ammetu lehachi tena tarte
Ella i amratte ide veide kedushshat damim lema li lemitne tarte hashta yesh lomar mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla paka mikkedushsha kalla likdushsha chamura tzericha lememar
Lema tehve teuvta devar peda deamar la paka kedushsha bichdi
Amar rav pappa amar lach bar peda hachi kaamar im lo amar meachshav shelamim leachar sheloshim yom ola have
Mide dehave haomer leishsha hitkaddeshi li leachar sheloshim yom dimkuddeshet veaf al pi shennitakkelu hammaot
Peshita la tzericha dahadar beh
Hanicha leman deamar enah chozeret ella leman deamar chozeret may ika lememar
Afilu leman deamar hatam chozeret hacha shane daamirato legavoha kimsirato lehedot
Yetev rabbi avin verav yitzchak berabbi kammeh derabbi yirmeya veka menamnem rabbi yirmeya yatvi vekaamri levar peda deamar pedaan chozrot vekodshot

a: Tifshot devae rav hoshaya hannoten shette ferutot leishsha veamar lah beachat hitkaddeshi li hayyom uvachat hitkaddeshi li leachar sheagarshech hachi name dehau kidushe
Itar behu rabbi yirmeya amar lehu may ka meddammetun pedaan hu lifdaum acherim hachi amar rabbi yochanan pedaan hu chozrot ukdoshot pedaum acherim en chozrot ukdoshot veishsha kifdauha acherim damya
Itmar name amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella sheppedaan hu aval pedaum acherim en chozrot ukdoshot

Matni hannoder miyyorde hayyam muttar beoshve hayyabbasha miyyoshve hayyabbasha asur miyyorde hayyam sheyyorde hayyam bichlal yoshve hayyabbasha lo keellu sheholchim meakko leyafo ella bemi sheddarko lefaresh
Gema rav pappa verav acha bereh derav ika chad matne aresha vechad matne assefa man detane aresha matne hachi hannoder miyyorde hayyam muttar beoshve yabbasha ha beorde hayyam asur velo keellu
b: Haholchim meakko leyafo dehalen yoshve hayyabbasha ninhu ella mimmi sheddarkan lefaresh
Uman dematne assefa matne hachi hannoder miyyoshve yabbasha asur beorde hayyam velo beellu haholchim meakko leyafo bilvad ella afilu bemi sheddarko lefaresh hoil vesofo leyabbasha salek
Matni hannoder meroe hachamma asur af bassomin shello nitkaven ze ella lemi shehachamma roa otan
Gema may tama middela kaamar min haroin leappoke dagim veubbarim
Matni hannoder mishshechore harosh asur bakkerchin uvaali sevot umuttar bannashim uvakketannim sheen nikrain shechore harosh ella anashim
Gema may tama middela kaamar mibbale sear
Umuttar benashim uviktannim sheen nikrain shechore harosh ella anashim may tama anashim zimnin demikassu reshayehu vezimnin demiggallu reshayehu aval nashim leolam mikassu uktannim leolam migallu
Matni hannoder min hayeludim muttar benoladim min hannoladim asur min hayeludim rabbi meir mattir af bayeludim vachachamim omrim lo nitkaven ze ella bemi sheddarko lehiuoled
Gema lerabbi meir vela mibaya noladim ella mimman asur

Chassore michassera vehachi katane hannoder min hayeludim muttar bannoladim min hannoladim asur bayeludim rabbi meir omer af hannoder min hannoladim muttar bayeludim ki hechi denoder min hayeludim muttar bannoladim
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye lememra denoladim demityaldan mashma ella meatta shene vanecha hannoladim lecha beeretz mitzrayim hachi name deityaldan hu
