Veella may diylidu mashma ella meatta dichtiv hinne ven nolad levet david yoshiyyahu shemo hachi name dahava veha adayin menashshe lo ba ella mashma hachi umashma hachi uvindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam
Vachachamim omrim lo nitkaven ze ella mimmi sheddarko lehiuoled leappoke may leappoke dagim veofot

a: Matni hannoder mishshovte shabbat asur beyisrael veasur bakkutim meochle shum asur beyisrael veasur bakkutim meole yerushalayim asur beyisrael umuttar bakkutim
Gema may shovte shabbat ilema mimmekayeme shabbat may irya bakkutim afilu goyim name ella mimmetzuviym al hashshabbat
I hachi ema sefa meole yerushalayim asur beyisrael umuttar bakkutim ammay veha metzuviym ninhu

Amar abbaye metzuve veose katane betarte bave kammayata yisrael vechutim metzuviyn veosin goyim hahu deavdi osin veenam metzuviyn beole yerushalayim yisrael metzuviyn veosin kutim metzuviyn veenam osin
Matni kunam sheeni nehene livne noach muttar beyisrael veasur beummot haolam
Gema veyisrael mi nafek mikkelal bene noach kevan deikaddash avraham itkero al shemeh
Matni sheeni nehene lezera avraham asur beyisrael umuttar beummot haolam
Gema vehaika yishmael ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara ketiv vehaika esav beyitzchak velo kol yitzchak
Matni sheeni nehene miyyisrael lokeach beoter umocher befachot sheyyisrael nehenin li lokeach befachot umocher beoter veen shomin lo sheeni nehene lahen vehen li yehane leummot haolam
Gema amar shemuel hallokeach keli min haumman levakkero veneenas beyado chayyav alma kasavar hanaat lokeach hi
Tenan sheeni nehene miyyisrael mocher befachot aval shave beshave la vei hanaat lokeach hi afilu shave beshave matnitin bizvina dirme al appeh
Im ken ema resha lokeach beoter veod ema sefa sheyyisrael nehenin li lokeach befachot umocher beoter vei bizvina dirme al appeh afilu shave beshave
Sefa bizvina charifa i hachi lokeach befachot afilu shave beshave ella
b: Matnitin bizvina mitza vedishmuel bizvina charifa

Tanya kevateh dishmuel hallokeach kelim min hattaggar leshaggeran levet chamiv veamar lo im mekabbelin otan mimmenni ani noten lecha demehem veim lav ani noten lecha lefi tovat hanaa shebbahen neensu bahalicha chayyav
Bachazara patur mippene shehu kenose sachar
Hahu safsira dishkal chamara lezabbone vela izabban bahade dahadar itnis chamra chayeveh rav nachman leshallome etiveh rava lerav nachman neensu bahalicha chayyav bachazara patur
Amar leh chazara desafsira holacha hi deilu mashkach lezabbone afilu abbava deveteh mi la mezabben leh
Matni kunam sheani nehene laarelim muttar bearle yisrael veasur bemule ummot haolam

Sheani nehene lammulim asur bearle yisrael umuttar bemule ummot haolam sheen haorla keruya ella leshem ummot haolam shenneemar ki chol haggoyim arelim vechol bet yisrael arle lev veomer vehaya happelishti hearel hazze veomer pen tismachna benot pelishtim pen taalozna benot haarelim
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer meusa hi haorla shennitgannu bah reshaim shenneemar ki chol haggoyim arelim rabbi yishmael omer gedola mila shennichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot
Rabbi yose omer gedola mila sheddocha et hashshabbat chamura
Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer gedola mila shello nitla lo lemoshe hatztzaddik aleha melo shaa
Rabbi nechemya omer gedola mila sheddocha et hannegaim rabbi omer gedola mila shekkol hammitzot sheasa avraham avinu lo nikra shalem ad shemmal shenneemar hithallech lefanay vehye tamim
Davar acher gedola mila sheilmale hi lo bara hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo shenneemar ko amar Adonai im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti
Gema tanya rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer gedola mila shekkol zechiyyot sheasa moshe rabbenu lo amdu lo keshennitrashshel min hammila shenneemar vayyifgeshehu Adonai vayevakkesh hamito

Amar rabbi chas veshalom shemmoshe rabbenu nitrashshel min hammila ella kach amar amul veetze sakkana hi shenneemar vayehi vayyom hashshelishi bihotam koavim vego amul veeshhe shelosha yamim hakkadosh baruch hu amar li lech shuv mitzrayim ella mippene ma neenash moshe

a: Mippene shennitassek bammalon techilla shenneemar vayehi badderech bammalon
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo lemoshe rabbenu bikkesh satan laharog ella leoto tinok shenneemar ki chatan damim atta li tze ure mi karuy chatan heve omer ze hattinok

Daresh rabbi yehuda bar bizna beshaa shennitrashshel moshe rabbenu min hammila bau af vechema uvlauhu velo shiyeru mimmennu ella raglav miyyad vattikkach tzippora tzor vattichrot et orlat benah miyyad vayyiref mimmennu

Beotah shaa bikesh moshe rabbenu lehorgan shenneemar heref meaf vaazov chema veyesh omrim lechema harago shenneemar chema en li vehachtiv ki yagorti mippene haaf vehachema tere chema hao veibaet ema gunda dechema
Tanya rabbi omer gedola mila sheen lach mi shennitassek bemitzot keavraham avinu velo nikra tamim ella al shem mila shenneemar hithallech lefanay vehye tamim uchtiv veettena veriti beni uvenecha

Davar acher gedola mila sheshshekula keneged kol hammitzot shebbattora shenneemar ki al pi haddevarim haelle vego davar acher gedola mila sheilmale mila lo nitkayemu shamayim vaaretz shenneemar im lo beriti yomam valayela vego
Ufliga derabbi eliezer deamar rabbi eliezer gedola tora sheilmale tora lo nitkayemu shamayim vaaretz shenneemar im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti vego

Amar rav yehuda amar rav beshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu leavraham avinu hithallech lefanay vehye tamim achazattu reada amar shemma yesh bi davar megunne kevan sheamar lo veettena veriti beni uvenecha nitkarra dato
Vayyotze oto hachutza amar lefanav ribbono shel olam histakkalti bammazzal shelli veen li ella ben echad amar lo tze meitztagninut shellecha en mazzal leyisrael
Amar rabbi yitzchak kol hamtammem atzmo hakkadosh baruch hu mittammem immo shenneemar im chasid titchassad im gibbor tamim tittammam
Amar rabbi hoshaya kol hamtammem atzmo shaa omedet lo shenneemar hithallech lefanay vehye tamim uchtiv vehayita leav hamon goyim
Amar rabbi kol hamnachesh lo nachash shenneemar ki lo nachash beyaakov veha belamed alef ketiv ella mishshum midda keneged midda
Tane ahava bereh derabbi zera kol adam sheeno menachesh machnisin oto bimchitza sheafilu malache hashsharet en yecholin likanes betochah shenneemar ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael vego

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar mippene ma neenash avraham avinu venishtabedu banav lemitzrayim matayim veeser shanim mippene sheasa angarya betalmide chachamim shenneemar vayyarek et chanichav yelide veto

Ushmuel amar mippene shehifriz al middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar bamma eda ki irashenna verabbi yochanan amar shehifrish bene adam millehikkanes tachat kanfe hashshechina shenneemar ten li hannefesh veharchush kach lach
Vayyarek et chanichav yelide veto rav amar shehorikan battora ushmuel amar shehorikan bezahav
Shemona asar ushlosh meot amar rabbi amme bar abba eliezer keneged kullam ika deamri eliezer hu dechushbaneh hachi have
Veamar rabbi amme bar abba ben shalosh shanim hikkir avraham et boro shenneemar ekev asher shama avraham bekoli chushbaneh mea veshivin utren
Veamar rame bar abba
b: Hassatan bechushbaneh telat mea veshitin vearbea veamar rame bar abba ketiv avram uchtiv avraham battechilla himlicho hakkadosh baruch hu al matayim vearbaim ushlosha evarim ulvassof himlicho al matayim vearbaim ushmone evarim
Ellu hen shette enayim ushte oznayim verosh haggeviyya

Veamar rame bar abba may dichtiv ir ketanna vaanashim vego ir ketanna ze hagguf vaanashim bah meat ellu evarim uva eleha melech gadol vesavav otah ze yetzer hara uvana aleha metzodim vacharamim ellu aonot
Umatza vah ish misken vechacham ze yetzer tov umillat hu et hair bechochmato zo teshuva umaasim tovim veadam lo zachar et haish hammisken hahu devishat yetzer hara let demiddechar leh leyetzer tov
Hachochma taoz lechacham measara shallitim hachochma taoz lechacham zo teshuva umaasim tovim measara shallitim shette enayim ushte oznayim ushte yadayim ushte raglayim verosh haggeviyya ufe
Amar rabbi zecharya mishshum rabbi yishmael bikesh hakkadosh baruch hu lehotzi kehunna mishshem shenneemar vehu chohen leel elon kevan shehikdim birkat avraham levirkat hammakom hotziah meavraham

Shenneemar vayevarchehu vayyomar baruch avram leel elon kone shamayim vaaretz uvaruch el elon amar lo avraham vechi makdimin birkat eved levirkat kono miyyad netanah leavraham shenneemar neum Adonai ladoni shev limini ad ashit oyevecha hadom leraglecha uvatreh ketiv nishba Adonai velo yinnachem atta chohen leolam al divrati malki tzedek al diburo shel malki tzedek
Vehayenu dichtiv vehu chohen leel elon hu kohen veen zaro kohen
Hadran alach arbaa nedarim
En ben hammuddar hanaa mechavero lammuddar hemennu maachal ella derisat haregel vechelim sheen osin bahem ochel nefesh
Hammuddar maachal mechavero lo yashilennu nafa uchvara verechayim vetannur aval mashil lo chaluk vetabbaat vetallit unzamim
Gema man tena amar rav adda bar ahava rabbi eliezer hi detanya rabbi eliezer omer afilu vitur asur bemuddar hanaa
Hammuddar maachal mechavero lo yashilennu vechu

a: Veha min maachal nadar amar rabbi shimon ben lakish beomer hanaat maachalcha alay
Ema shello yilos chitin veyitten al makkato amar rava beomer hanaa hammevia lide maachalcha alay
Amar rav pappa sak lehavi perot vachamor lehavi alav perot vaafilu tzanna bealma hanaa hammevia lide maachal hu bae rav pappa sus lirkov alav vetabbaat leraot bah mahu mifsak umezal beareh may
Ta shema aval mashil lo chaluk vetallit nezamim vetabbaot hechi dame ilema shello leraot bahen tzericha lememar ella lav afilu leraot bahen vekatane mashilo
La leolam shello leraot veayede dekatane resha lo yashilennu tena sefa mashilo
Matni vechol davar sheen osin bo ochel nefesh makom shemmaskirin keotze bahen asur
Gema mikkelal deresha af al pi sheen maskirin man tanna amar rav adda bar ahava rabbi eliezer hi
Matni hammuddar hanaa mechavero shokel lo et shiklo uforea et chovo umachazir lo et avedato makom shennotlin aleha sachar tippol hanaa lahekdesh
Gema alma avroche ari bealma hu ushre
Man tanna amar rav hoshaya zo
b: Divre chanan hi
Rava amar afilu tema divre hakkol gabbe muddar hanaa deyahev al menat shello lifroa
May chanan ditnan mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veamad echad ufirnes et ishto chanan amar ibed et meotav
Nechleku alav bene kohanim gedolim veamru yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol amar rabbi dosa ben harkinas kedivrehem amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay yafe amar chanan hinniach meotav al keren hatztzevi
Rava la amar kerav hoshaya deka mokem lah lematnitin kedivre hakkol rav hoshaya la amar kerava gezera shello lipara mishshum lipara

Machazir lo et avedato peligi bah rabbi amme verabbi assi chad amar lo shanu ella beshennichse machzir asurin al baal aveda dechi mahdar leh midaam denafsheh ka mahdar leh aval nichse baal aveda asurin al machzir la ka mahdar leh deka mehanne leh peruta derav yosef
Vechad amar afilu nichse baal aveda asurin al machzir mahdar leh umishshum peruta derav yosef la shechiach

a: Tenan makom shennotlin aleha sachar tippol hanaa lahekdesh bishlama leman deamar afilu beshennichse baal aveda asurim al machzir name mahdar hayenu dekatane makom shennotlin aleha sachar tippol hanaa lahekdesh
Ella leman deamar keshennichse baal aveda asurim al machzir la mahdar ammay tippol hanaa lahekdesh
Achada katane

Ika dematne lah behay lishana peligi bah rabbi amme verabbi assi chad amar lo shanu ella beshennichse baal aveda asurin al machzir umishshum peruta derav yosef la shechiach aval nichse machzir asurim al baal aveda la mahdar leh mishshum deka mehanne leh
Vechad amar afilu nichse machzir asurim al baal aveda muttar dechi mahdar leh mide denafsheh kamahdar leh
Tenan makom shennotlin aleha sachar tippol hanaa lahekdesh bishlama leman deamar afilu beshennichse machzir asurim al baal aveda mahdar hayenu dimtaretz makom
Ella leman deamar beshennichse machzir asurin vela mahdar hechi metaretz makom kashya
b: Amar rava hayeta lefanav kikkar shel hefker veamar kikkar zo hekdesh netalah leochlah maal lefi kullah lehorisha levanav maal lefi tovat hanaa shebbah
Bea mineh rav chiyya bar avin merava kikkari alecha untanah lo bemattana mahu kikkari amar lo ki iteh birshuteh hu deasur o dilma alecha amar leh ilaveh shaviteh hekdesh
Amar leh peshita deaf al gav deyahavah leh bemattana asur ella kikkari alecha leappoke may lav leappoke dei ganvah mineh mignav amar leh la leappoke dei azmeneh alah

a: Etiveh amar lo hashileni paratcha amar lo kunam para sheani kanuy lach nechasay alecha im yesh li para ella zo hashileni kardummecha amar lo kunam kardom sheyyesh li sheani kanuy nechasay alay im yesh li kardom ella ze venimtza sheyyesh lo bechayyav asur met o shennittena lo bemattana hare ze muttar
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika shennitna lo al yede acher
Amar rav ashe dayeka name dekatane shennitna lo vela katane shennetanah lo
Bea mineh rava merav nachman yesh meila bekunnamot o la
Amar leh tenetuha mekom shennotlin aleha sachar tipol hanaa lahekdesh lememra ki hekdesh ma hekdesh yesh bo meila af kunnamot yesh bahen meila
Ketannae kunam kikkar zo hekdesh vaachalah ben hu uven chavero maal lefichach yesh lah pidon kikkar zo alay lehekdesh vaachalah hu maal chavero lo maal lefichach en lah pidon divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach lo maal lefi sheen meila bekunnamot

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe kikkari alecha untanah lo bemattana mi maal limol noten ha la asira aleh limol mekabbel yachol deamar hetera beeti isura la beeti amar leh mekabbel maal lichsheyyotzi shekkol hammotzi meot hekdesh lechullin kesavur shel chullin hu moel af ze moel
b: Matni vetorem et terumato umaserotav ledato umakriv alav kine zavin kine zavot kine yoldot chattaot vaashamot umlammedo midrash halachot veaggadot aval lo yelammedennu mikra aval melammed hu et banav veet benotav mikra
Gema ibaya lehu hane kahane sheluche didan hau o sheluche dishmayya lemay nafka minah lemuddar hanaa i amratte dishluche didan hau ha mehanne leh veasur vei amratte sheluche dishmayya shere may
Ta shema ditnan makriv alav kine zavin ku i amratte sheluche didan ka mehanne leh

Velitamach litne makriv alav korbanot ella mechussere chappara shane deamar rabbi yochanan hakkol tzerichin daat chutz mimmechussere chappara shehare adam mevi korban al banav veal benotav hakketannim shenneemar zot torat hazzav ben gadol ben katan

Ella meatta lerabbi yochanan zot torat hayyoledet vego ben ketanna uven gedola ketanna bat leda hi veha tane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman shalosh nashim meshammeshot bemoch ketanna umubberet umnika ketanna shemma titabber vetamut
Hahi zot torat hayyoledet ben pikkachat ben shota shekken adam mevi korban al ishto shota
Kedivre rabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer adam mevi korban ashir al ishto vechol korbanot shechayyevet
Shekkach kotev lah veachraut deit lich alay min kadmat dena

a: Metiv rav shimi bar abba im haya kohen yizrok alav dam chattato vedam ashamo
Dam chattato shel metzora vedam ashamo shel metzora dichtiv zot tihye torat hammetzora ben gadol uven katan
Tenan hakkohanim sheppiglu bammikdash mezidin chayyavin ha shoggin peturin ella sheppigulan pigul
I amratte bishlama sheluche dishmayya hau hayenu sheppigulan pigul ella i amratte sheluche didan hau ammay pigulan pigul lema leh shelicha shavetach letakkone vela leauote
Amri shane gabbe pigul deamar kera lo yechashev lo mikkol makom

Gufa amar rabbi yochanan hakkol tzerichin daat chutz mimmechussar kappara shehare adam mevi korban al banav veal benotav hakketannim ella meatta yavi adam chattat chelev al chavero shekken adam mevi al ishto shota kerabbi yehuda allema amar rabbi elazar hifrish chattat chelev al chavero lo asa kelum
Ishto shota hechi dame i deachla keshehi shota lav bat korban hi
Vei deachla keshehi pikkachat venishtattet ha amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan achal chelev vehifrish korban venishtatta vechazar venishtappa pasul hoil venidcha yiddache
Ella meatta yavi adam pesach al chavero shekken adam mevi al banav veal benotav hakketannim allema amar rabbi elazar hifrish pesach al chavero lo asa kelum
Amar rabbi zera se levet avot lav deorayeta

Umimmay midditnan haomer levanav hareni shochet et happesach al mi sheyyaale mikkem rishon lirushalayim kevan shehichnis rishon rosho verubbo zacha bechelko umzakke et echav immo vei amratte se levet deorayeta al bisra kae umzakke lehu
Ella lema lehu deamar lehon avuhon kede lezarzan bemitzot tanya name hachi maase haya vekadmu banot labbanim venimtzeu banot zerizot uvanim shefalim
Vetorem et terumato ku
b: Ibaya lehu hattorem mishshello al shel chavero tzarich dato o la mi amrinan kevan dizchut hu lo lo tzarich daat o dilma mitzva dileh hi venicha leh lemibedeh
Ta shema torem et terumotav veet maserotav ledato bemay askinan ilema min baal hakkeri al shel baal hakkeri uldato deman ilema ledato dileh man shavveyeh shaliach

Ella ledato devaal hakkeri ha kamhanne leh dekaaved shelichuteh ella mishshello al shel hakkeri uldato deman ilema ledato devaal hakkeri ha kamhanne leh ella lav ledateh denafsheh umishshello torem al shel chavero vei amratte tzarich daat ha kamhanne leh ella lav en tzarich daat
Leolam mishshel baal hakkeri al baal hakkeri kidamar rava beomer kol harotze litrom yavo veyitrom hacha name beomer vechu

Bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera hattorem mishshello al shel chavero tovat hanaa shel mi mi amrinan i lav pere dehayeche mi mittakkena karya dehahu o dilma i lav karya dehahu la haveyan pere dehaden teruma
Amar leh amar kera et kol tevuat zarecha venatatta

Etiveh torem et terumotav veet maserotav ledato vei amratte tovat hanaa devaal hakkeri ha ka mehanne leh ella shema minah tovat hanaa dileh amri lo mishshel baal hakkeri al shel baal hakkeri uldato devaal hakkeri beomer kol harotze litrom yavo veyitrom
Ta shema deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan hammakdish mosif chomesh umitkapper ose temura vehattorem mishshello al sheeno shello tovat hanaa shello

Melammedo midrash halachot veaggadot aval lo yelammedennu mikra mikra may tama lo yelammedennu mishshum dekamhanne leh midrash name kamhanne leh amar shemuel bemakom shennotlin sachar al hammikra veen notlin sachar al hammidrash may paska

a: Ha ka mashma lan daafilu bimkom shennotlin sachar al hammikra shere lemishkal al hammidrash la shere lemishkal

May shena midrash dela dichtiv veoti tziva Adonai baet hahi lelammed etchem uchtiv ree limmadti etchem chukkim umishpatim kaasher tzivani Adonai ma ani bechinnam af attem name bechinnam mikra name bechinnam
Rav amar sechar shimur verabbi yochanan amar sechar pisuk teamim
Tenan lo yelammedennu mikra bishlama leman deamar sechar pisuk teamim hayenu dela yelammedennu ella leman deamar sechar shimur gadol bar shimur hu bekatan katane
I bekatan ema sefa aval melammed et banav mikra katan bar banim hu chassore mechassera vehachi katane lo yelammedennu mikra bekatan im haya gadol melammedo lo ulvanav mikra

Metivi tinokot lo korin battechila bashshabbat ella shonin barishon bishlama leman deamar sechar pisuk teamim hayenu deen korin battechila bashshabbat ella leman deamar sechar shimur ammay en korin battechila bashshabbat veammay shonin barishon ha ika sechar shimur deshabbat

Velitamach sechar pisuk beshabbat mi asur havlaa hi vehavlaa mishre shere detanya hassocher et happoel lishmor et hattinok lishmor et happara lishmor et hazzeraim en notnin lo sechar shabbat lefichach
b: Im avdu eno chayyav beachrautan veim haya sechir shabbat sechir chodesh sechir shana sechir shavua noten lo sechar shabbat lefichach im avdu chayyav beachrautan

Ella gabbe shabbat hayenu tama deen korin battechila mishshum deyifnu avahathon deyanoke lemitzveta deshabbeta veibaet ema mishshum divshabbeta achlin veshatin veyakkir alehon alma kidamar shemuel shinuy veset techilat choli meayim
Ulman deamar sechar pisuk teamim may tama la amar sechar shimur kasavar banot mi ka baayan shimur
Ulman deamar sechar shimur may tama la amar sechar pisuk teamim kasavar sechar pisuk teamim deorayeta hu

Deamar rav ika bar avin amar rav chananel amar rav may dichtiv vayyikreu vassefer betorat haelohim meforash vesom sechel vayyavinu bammikra vayyikreu vassefer betorat haelohim ze mikra meforash ze targum vesom sechel ellu happesukim vayyavinu bammikra ze pisuk teamim veamri lah ellu hammesorot
Amar rabbi yitzchak mikra sofrim veitur sofrim vekaryan vela ketivan uchtivan vela karyan halacha lemoshe missinay
Mikra sofrim aretz shamayim mitzrayim
Itur sofrim achar taavoru achar telech achar teasef kiddemu sharim achar nognim tzidkatcha keharre el
Karyan vela ketivan perat divlechto ish dechaasher yishal ish bidvar haelohim baim denivneta lah difleta et dehugged huggad elay dehaggoren elay dehasseorim halen karyan vela ketivan
Uchtivan vela karyan na deyislach

a: Zot dehammitzva yidroch dehaddorech chamesh difat negev im dechi goel halen ketivan vela karyan
Amar rav acha bar adda bemareva paskin lehaden pesuka litlata pesukin vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinne anochi ba elecha beav heanan
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina lo heeshir moshe ella mippesoltan shel luchot shenneemar pesol lecha shene luchot avanim karishonim pesoltan shellecha yehe

Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina lo nitna tora ella lemoshe ulzaro shenneemar ketov lecha pesol lecha ma pesoltan shellecha af ketavan shellecha moshe nahag bah tovat ayin untanah leyisrael vealav hakkatuv omer tov ayin hu yevorach vego
Metiv rav chisda veoti tziva Adonai baet hahi lelammed etchem veoti tziva vaani lachem ree limmadti etchem chukkim umishpatim kaasher tzivani Adonai elohay oti tziva vaani lachem
Veatta kitvu lachem et hashshira hazzot hashshira lechuddah lemaan tihye li hashshira hazzot leed bivne yisrael ella pilpula bealma

Amar rabbi yochanan en hakkadosh baruch hu mashre shechinato ella al gibbor veashir vechacham veanav vechullan mimmoshe gibbor dichtiv vayyifros et haohel al hammishkan veamar mar moshe rabbenu peraso uchtiv eser ammot orech hakkaresh vego ema daarich vekattin
Ella min haden kera dichtiv vaetpos bishne halluchot vaashlichem meal shette yaday vaashabberem vetanya halluchot orkan shishsha verochban shishsha veovyan shelosha

Ashir pesol lach pesoltan shellecha yehe chacham rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu chamishshim shaare vina nivreu baolam vechullam nittenu lemoshe chaser achat shenneemar vattechasserehu meat meelohim anav dichtiv vehaish moshe anav meod
Amar rabbi yochanan kol hanneviim ashirim hau menalan mimmoshe umishshemuel meamos umiyyona
Moshe dichtiv lo chamor echad mehem nasati i bela agra leappoke man deshakel bela agra ella daafilu beagra dilma mishshum deani hava ella min pesol lach pesoltan yehe shellecha

Shemuel dichtiv hinni anu vi neged Adonai veneged meshicho et shor mi lakachti vachamor mi lakachti i bechinnam leappoke man deshakel bechinnam ella daafilu besachar dilma deani hava ella mehacha utshuvato haramata ki sham beto veamar rava kol makom shehalach beto immo

Amar rava gadol ma shenneemar bishmuel yoter mishshenneemar bemoshe deilu bemoshe rabbenu ketiv lo chamor echad mehem nasati daafilu besachar veilu gabbe shemuel afilu beratzon lo secharo dichtiv vayyomru lo ashaktanu velo ratztzotanu vego
Amos dichtiv vayyaan amos vayyomer el amatzya lo navi anochi velo ven navi anochi ki voker anochi uvoles shikmim kedimtargem rav yosef ari mare gite ana veshikmin li beshafelta vego
Yona dichtiv vayyitten secharah vayyered bah veamar rabbi yochanan shennatan secharah shel sefina kullah amar rabbi romanus secharah shel sefina haveya arbaat alafim dinare dahava
Veamar rabbi yochanan battechilla haya moshe lamed tora umshakkecha ad shennitna lo bemattana shenneemar vayyitten el moshe kechalloto ledabber itto

Matni vezan et ishto veet banav af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotan velo yazun et behemto ben temea ben tehora rabbi eliezer omer zan et hattemea veeno zan et hattehora amru lo ma ben temea lithora amar lehu shehattehora nafshah lashshamayim vegufah shello utmea
b: Nafshah vegufah lashshamayim amru lo af hattemea nafshah lashshamayim vegufah shello sheim yirtze hare hu mochrah laggoyim o maachilah lakkelavim

Gema amar rav yitzchak bar chananya amar rav huna hammuddar hanaa mechavero muttar lehassi lo bitto have bah rabbi zera bemay askinan ilema beshennichse avi challa asurin al hechatan hare moser lo shifcha leshammesho
Ella benichse chatan asurin al avi challa gedola mizzo amru zan et ishto veet banav veaf al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotan veatte amratte muttar lehassi lo bitto
Leolam beshennichse avi challa asurin al hechatan uvvitto bogeret umiddatah
Tanya name hachi hammuddar hanaa mechavero asur lehassi lo bitto aval massio bitto bogeret umiddatah

Amar rabbi yaakov hammaddir beno letalmud tora muttar lemalloot lo chavit shel mayim ulhadlik lo et hanner rabbi yitzchak amar litzlot lo dag katan amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan hammuddar hanaa mechavero muttar lehashkoto kos shel shalom may nihu hacha targimu kos shel bet haevel bemareva amri kos shel bet hammerchatz

Velo yazun et behemto ben ku tanya yehoshua ish uzza omer zan avadav veshifchotav hakkenaanim velo yazun et behemto ben temea ben tehora may tama avadav veshifchotav hakkenaanim lemancharuta avidan behema lefittuma avida
Matni hammuddar hanaa mechavero venichnas levakkero omed aval lo yoshev umrappeo refuat nefesh aval lo refuat mamon

a: Gema bemay askinan i beshennichse mevakker asurin al chole afilu yoshev name i beshennichse chole asurin al hamvakker afilu omed name la amar shemuel leolam beshennichse mevakker asurin al hachole uvimkom shennotlin sachar al hayeshiva veen notlin sachar al haamida

May paska ha ka mashma lan deaf bimkom shennotlin sachar al hayeshiva bae lemishkal al haamida la bae lemishkal veibaet ema kidrabbi shimon ben elyakim gezera shemma yishhe baamida hacha name gezera shemma yishhe bishiva
Ulla amar leolam beshennichse chole asurin al hamvakker uchgon dela addereh min chayyuteh i hachi afilu yoshev name ha efshar baamida
Metivi chala hu nichnas levakkero chala beno shoalo bashshuk bishlama leulla deamar beshennichse chole asurin al hamvakker uchgon dela addereh min chayyuteh shappir
Ella lishmuel deamar beshennichse mevakker asurin al hachole may shena hu umay shena beno amar lach matnitin beshennichse mevakker asurin al hachole barayeta beshennichse chole asurin al hamvakker
May paska amar rava amar shemuel
b: Matnitin keshiteh may irya detane omed aval lo yoshev shema minah denichse mevakker asurin al hachole

Amar resh lakish remez levikur cholin min hattora minnayin shenneemar im kemot kol haadam yemutun elle ufkuddat kol haadam vego may mashma amar rava im kemot kol haadam yemutun elle shehen cholim umutalim baarisatan uvne adam mevakkerim otan ma habberiyyot omrim lo Adonai shelachani laze
Daresh rava im beria yivra Adonai im beria gehinnam mutav tihye im lav yivra Adonai
Ini veha tanya shiva devarim nivreu kodem shennivra haolam ellu hen tora utshuva gan eden vegehinnam kisse hakkavod uvet hammikdash ushmo shel mashiach
Tora dichtiv Adonai kanani reshit darko vego
Teshuva dichtiv beterem harim yulladu vattecholel vego tashev enosh ad dakka vego
Gan eden dichtiv vayyitta Adonai elohim gan beeden mikkedem vego
Gehinnam dichtiv ki aruch meetmul tofte
Kisse kavod dichtiv nachon kisacha meaz
Bet hammikdash dichtiv kisse chavod marom merishon
Shemo shel mashiach dichtiv yehi shemo leolam vego
Ella hachi kaamar i ibri leh pumma mutav veim la yivra Adonai vehachtiv en kol chadash tachat hashshamesh hachi kaamar i hacha la mekarav pumma lehacha likrav

Daresh rava veamri lah amar rabbi yitzchak may dichtiv shemesh yareach amad zevula shemesh veyareach bizvul may baayan veha berakia kevii melammed shealu shemesh veyareach merakia lizvul veamru lefanav ribbono shel olam im atta ose din leven amram anu meirim veim lav en anu meirin

Beotah shaa yara bahen chitzim vachanitot amar lahem bechol yom vaom mishtachavim lachem veattem meirim bichvodi lo mechitem bichvod basar vadam mechitem uvchol yom vaom yorin bahen chitzin vachanitot umirim shenneemar leor chitztzecha yehallechu vego

Tanya bikur cholim en lah shiur may en lah shiur savar rav yosef lememar en shiur lemattan secharah amar leh abbaye vechol mitzot mi yesh shiur lemattan secharan veha tenan heve zahir bemitzva kalla kevachamura sheen atta yodea mattan secharan shel mitzot ella amar abbaye afilu gadol etzel katan rava amar afilu mea peamim beom
Amar rabbi acha bar chanina kol hamvakker chole notel echad mishshishshim betzaaro amri leh im ken liallun shitin velokmuh amar leh keisuryata deve rabbi uvven gilo

Detanya rabbi omer bat hannizonet minnichse achin notelet isur nechasim amru lo lerabbi lidvarecha mi sheyyesh lo eser banot uven en lo labben bimkom banot kelum amar lahen rishona notelet isur nechasim sheniyya bamme sheshshiyera shelishit bamme sheshshiyera vechozrot vecholkot beshave
Rav chelbo chalash nefak achrez rav kahana

a: Rav chelbo beesh la ika deka ate amar lehu lo kach haya maase betalmid echad mittalmide rabbi akiva shechala lo nichnesu chachamim levakkero venichnas rabbi akiva levakkero uvishvil shekkibdu veribtzu lefanav chaya amar lo rabbi hecheyitani yatza rabbi akiva vedarash kol mi sheen mevakker cholim keilu shofech damim

Ki ata rav dimi amar kol hamvakker et hachole gorem lo sheyyichye vechol sheeno mevakker et hachole gorem lo sheyyamut may gerama ilema kol hamvakker et hachole mevakkesh alav rachamim sheyyichye vechol sheen mevakker et hachole mevakkesh alav rachamim sheyyamut sheyyamut salka datach ella kol sheen mevakker chole en mevakkesh alav rachamim lo sheyyichye velo sheyyamut

Rava yoma kadmaa dechalesh amar lehon la tigallo leinish dela littera mazzaleh mikkan veelach amar lehon puku veachrizu beshuka dechol desane li lichde li uchtiv binfol oyivcha al tismach vego udrachem li live alay rachame

Amar rav kol hamvakker et hachole nitzol middinah shel gehinnam shenneemar ashre maskil el dal beom raa yemalletehu Adonai en dal ella chole shenneemar middalla yevatztzeeni i name min haden kera maddua atta kacha dal ben hammelech babboker babboker vego en raa ella gehinnam shenneemar kol paal Adonai lammaanehu vegam rasha leom raa
Veim biker ma secharo ma secharo kidamar nitzol middinah shel gehinnam ella ma secharo baolam hazze

Adonai yishmerehu vichayyehu veushshar baaretz veal tittenehu benefesh oyevav Adonai yishmerehu miyyetzer hara vichayyehu min hayyissurin veushshar baaretz sheyehu hakkol mitkabbedin bo veal tittenehu benefesh oyevav sheyyizdammenu lo reim kenaaman sheripu et tzarato veal yizdammenu lo reim kirchavam shechilku et malchuto

Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer im yomru lach yeladim bene uzkenim setor shema lazzekenim veal tishma layeladim shebbinyan yeladim setira ustirat zekenim binyan vesiman laddavar rechavam ben shelomo

Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi la lisod inish ketzira la bitlat shae kadmayata vela bitlat shae batrayata deoma ki hechi dela lasach dateh min rachame telat shae kadmayata ravecha dateh batrayata takef chulsheh

Amar ravin amar rav minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu zan et hachole shenneemar Adonai yisadennu al eres devay vego veamar ravin amar rav minnayin shehashshechina sheruya lemala mimmittato shel hachole shenneemar Adonai yisadennu al eres devay

Tanya name hachi hannichnas levakker et hachole lo yeshev lo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe safsal velo al gabbe kisse ella mitattef veoshev al gabbe karka mippene shehashshechina sheruya lemala mimmittato shel chole shenneemar Adonai yisadennu al eres devay
Veamar ravin amar rav mitra bemareva sahada rabba perat ufliga dishmuel deamar shemuel nahra mikkefeh mitbarech ufliga dishmuel addishmuel deamar shemuel en hammayim metaharin bezochalin
b: Ella perat beome tishre bilvad
Avuh dishmuel avad lehon mikoot livnateh beome nisan umappatze beome tishre
Amar rabbi amme amar rav may dichtiv veatta ven adam ase lecha kele gola zo ner ukara

a: Veshatiach bechoser kol amar rabbi amme amar rav belo ner uvlo shulchan rav chisda amar belo ishsha rav sheshet amar belo shammash rav nachman amar belo dea tana belo melach uvlo revav
Amar abbaye naktinan en ani ella bedea bemareva amri deda beh kulla beh dela da beh ma beh da kane ma chasar da la kane ma kane

Amar rabbi alekkesanderi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba en hachole omed mecholo ad shemmochalin lo al kol aonotav shenneemar hassoleach lechol aonechi harofe lechol tachaluayechi rav hamnuna amar chozer lime alumav shenneemar rutfash besaro minnoar yashuv lime alumav kol mishkavo hafachta vecholo amar rav yosef lomar dimshakkeach talmudo
Rav yosef chalash iakkar leh talmudeh ahdereh abbaye kammeh hayenu divchal duchta amrinan amar rav yosef la shemia li hada shemata amar leh abbaye atte amritah nihalan umaha matnita amritah nihalan

Ki hava gemir rabbi telat esre appe hilchata agmereh lerabbi chiyya shiva minnehon lesof chalash rabbi ahdar rabbi chiyya kammeh hanhu shiva appe deagmereh shita azzeddu hava hahu katztzara hava shemia leh lerabbi kedahava gares lehu azal rabbi chiyya ugmar yathon kamme katztzara vaata veahdar yathon kamme rabbi kad hava chaze leh rabbi lehahu katztzara amar leh rabbi atta asita oti veet chiyya ika deamri hachi kaamar leh atta asita et chiyya vechiyya asa oti

Veamar rabbi alekkesanderi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba gadol nes shennaase lachole yoter min hannes shennaasa lachananya mishael vaazarya shel chananya mishael vaazarya esh shel hedot vehakkol yecholim lechabbotah vezo shel chole shel shamayim hi umi yachol lechabbotah

Veamar rabbi alekkesanderi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba veamri lah amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kevan shehiggia kitzo shel adam hakkol moshlim bo shenneemar vehaya chol motzi yahargeni rav amar min haden kera lemishpatecha amdu hayyom ki hakkol avadecha
Rabba bar shela amaru leh shechev gavra gavoha hava rechiv girdona zutra meta titura istevit shadyeh veka shachev kare al nafsheh lemishpatecha amdu hayyom
Shemuel chazyah lehahu kerukita deakrabba yetiva al akrukta veavra nahara tarka gavra umayet kare aleh lemishpatecha amdu hayyom

Amar shemuel en mevakkerin et hachole ella lemi shechalatzattu chamma leappoke may leappoke ha detanya rabbi yose ben perata omer mishshum rabbi eliezer en mevakkerin lo chole meayim velo chole haayin velo mechushe harosh bishlama chole meayim mishshum kisufa ella chole haayin umchushe harosh may tama
Mishshum derav yehuda deamar rav yehuda dibura kashya leena umalle leishata amar rava hay ishata i lav defaronka demalacha demota mealle
b: Kechizra ledikle chad litlatin yomin vechi tiryaki legufa rav nachman bar yitzchak amar la hi vela tiryaka

Amar rabba bar yonatan amar rav yechiel arsan yafe lachole lirfuato may arsan amar rabbi yonatan chushla disare attikata deresh nafya amar abbaye baayan bishula keen bisra detora rav yosef amar semide disare attikata deresh nafya amar abbaye baayan bishula kevisra detora
Amar rabbi yochanan bordam en mevakkerim veen mazkirin shemo may tama amar rabbi elazar mippene shehu kemayan hannovea veamar rabbi elazar lamma nikra shemo bordam shehu kemayan hannovea

Umrappeehu refuat hannefesh ku hechi katane ilema dirfuat nefesh bechinnam refuat mamon besachar litne hachi merappeehu bechinnam aval lo besachar ella refuat nefesh gufo refuat mamon behemto amar rabbi zutra bar toviyya amar rav aval omer lo sam peloni yafe lah sam peloni ra lah
Matni verochetz immo beambati gedola aval lo biktanna veyashen immo bammitta

Rabbi yehuda omer bimot hachamma aval lo bimot haggeshamim mippene shehu mahanehu umesev immo al hammitta veochel immo al hashshulchan aval lo min hattamchuy aval ochel hu immo min hattamchuy hachozer

Gema tanya lo yirchatz immo beambati velo yishan immo bammitta ben gedola ben ketanna divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer gedola bimot haggeshamim uktanna bimot hachamma muttar rochetz immo beambati gedola umazzia immo biktanna aval mesev immo al hammitta veochel immo al hashshulchan aval lo min hattamchuy aval ochel hu min hattamchuy hachozer amar rabbi yose bar chanina min hattamchuy hachozer levaal habbayit
Matni lo yochal immo min haevus shellifne happoalim velo yaase immo bauman divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim ose vehu barachok mimmennu
Gema bekarov la peligi daasir ki peligi berichuk rabbi meir savar gazrinan rachok mishshum karov deka merappe leh leara kammeh verabbanan savri la gazrinan

a: Matni hammuddar hanaa mechavero lifne sheviit eno yored letoch sadehu veeno ochel min hannotot uvashsheviit eno yored letoch sadehu aval ochel hu min hannetiot hannotot nadar hemennu maachal lifne sheviit yored letoch sadehu veeno ochel min happerot uvashsheviit yored veochel

Gema rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu nechasim ellu alecha lifne sheviit en yored letoch sadehu veeno ochel min hannotot af al pi shehiggia sheviit veim bashsheviit nadar en yored letoch sadehu aval ochel min hannotot
Verabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu nechasay alecha lifne sheviit en yored letoch sadehu veen ochel min hannotot higgia sheviit eno yored letoch sadehu aval ochel hu et hannotot
Lema beha kamipalgi derav ushmuel savri adam oser davar shebbirshuto afilu lichsheyyetze mershuto verabbi yochanan veresh lakish savri en adam oser davar shebbirshuto lichsheyyetze mershuto
Vetisbera mi ika leman deamar en adam oser davar shebbirshuto lichsheyyetze merashuto im ken niflege binchasim ellu vechol shekken binchasay
Vetu ha tenan deadam oser davar shebbirshuto lichsheyyetze mershuto ditnan haomer livno kunam sheatta nehene li met yirashennu bechayyav uvmoto
b: Im met lo yirashennu shane hacha deka amar leh bechayyav uvmoto
Mikkol makom kashya ella binchasim ellu kulle alma la peligi ki peligi binchasay
Rav ushmuel savri la shena nechasim ellu la shena nechasay adam oser verabbi yochanan veresh lakish savri nechasim adam oser nechasay en adam oser

Umi ika leman deamar la shena nechasim ellu vela shena nechasay veha tenan haomer lachavero kunam letoch betcha sheani nichnas sadcha sheani lokeach met o shemmecharo leacher muttar levayit ze sheani nichnas sade zo sheani lokeach met o shemmecharo leacher asur
Ella ki amri rabbi yochanan veresh lakish binchasay verav ushmuel binchasim ellu vela peligi
Uvashsheviit en yored letoch sadehu ku may shena deochel min hannotot defere dehefkera inun ara name afkerah
Amar ulla beomdin ilanot al haggevulim rabbi shimon ben elyakim amar gezera shemma yishhe baamida
Matni hammuddar hanaa mechavero lo yashilennu velo yishal mimmennu lo yalvennu velo yilve mimmennu velo yimkor lo velo yikkach mimmennu

a: Gema bishlama lo yalvennu deka mahane leh ella la yilve hemennu may ka mahane leh uvishlama lo yilve hemennu velo yikkach hemennu dekamithane mineh ella lo yishal hemennu may ka mithane mineh
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina kegon shennadru hanaa ze mizze abbaye amar gezera lishol mishshum lehashil vechen bechullehu gezera
Matni amar lo hashileni paratcha amar lo enah penuya amar kunam sadi sheani choresh bah leolam im haya darko lachrosh hu asur vechol adam muttarim veim en darko lachrosh hu vechol adam asurin
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero veen lo ma yochal holech etzel hachenvani veomer ish peloni noder mimmenni hanaa veeni yodea ma eese vehu noten lo uva venotel mizze
Haya beto livnot gedero ligdor sadehu liktzor holech etzel happoalim veomer ish peloni muddar mimmenni hanaa veeni yodea ma eese vehen osin immo uvain venotlin sachar mizze

Hau mehallechin badderech veen lo ma yochal noten leechad leshum mattana vehalla muttar bah im en immahem acher manniach al hassela o al haggader veomer hare hen mufkarim lechol mi sheyyachpotz vehalla notel veochel verabbi yose oser
Gema amar rabbi yochanan may tama derabbi yose kasavar hefker kemattana ma mattana ad deatya mershut noten lirshut mekabbel af hefker ad deatya lirshut zoche
Metiv rabbi abba vehalla notel veochel verabbi yose oser amar rabbi yose ematay bizman shennidro kodem lehefkero
b: Aval im haya hefkero kodem lenidro hare ze muttar vei amratte ad deate lirshut zoche ma li nidro kodem lehefkero ma li hefkero kodem lenidro
Hu motev lah vehu meshanne lah kol hannoder en dato al ma shehifkir
Metiv rava miktzatan larishon vechullan lashsheni rishon kana
Sheni lo kana
Ella amar rava hayenu tama derabbi yose gezera mishshum mattenat bet choron
Tanya hammafkir et sadehu kol shelosha yamim yachol lachazor bo mikkan veelach en yachol lachazor bo

a: Amar tehe sade zo mufkeret leom echad leshabbat achat lechodesh echad leshana achat leshavua echat ad shello zacha bah ben hu ben acher yachol lachazor bo mishshezzacha bah ben hu ben acher en yachol lachazor bo resha rabbanan sefa rabbi yose
Amar ulla sefa name rabbanan hi i hachi ammay ad shello zacha bah ben hu ben acher yachol lachazor bo shane shana veshavua dela shechichi
Resh lakish amar middesefa rabbi yose resha name rabbi yose veresha hayenu tama dela lishtakkach torat hefker
I hachi afilu miyyom harishon name leheve hefker amar rabba mippene harammain demafkirin vehadrin behon
Aval deorayeta la have hefker
b: Vedilma ate leassore min hachiyyuv al happetur umin happetur al hachiyyuv
Deamrinan leh ki measseratte assar mineh uveh
Metivi hammafkir et karmo velashshachar amad uvtzaro chayyav beferet uvolelot uvshichcha uvfea ufatur min hammaaser
Bishlama leulla derabbanan katane lah udorayeta katane lah ella leresh lakish ammay patur min hammaaser
Amar lecha ki amari ana lerabbi yose ha rabbanan hi

a: Ibaet ema ha deafkereh beanpe teren veha deafkereh beappe telata deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak kol hammafkir bifne shelosha have hefker bifne shenayim la have hefker
Verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar devar tora afilu beechad have hefker uma taam amru bishlosha kede sheyehe echad zoche ushnayim meidin
Hadran alach en ben hammuddar
b: Hashshuttafin shennadru hanaa ze mizze asurin likanes lechatzer rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer ze nichnas letoch shello veze nichnas letoch shello

a: Ushnehem asurim lehaamid rechayim vetannur ulgaddel tarnegolim

Haya echad mehem muddar hanaa mechavero lo yikkanes lechatzer rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer yachol hu lomar lo letoch shelli ani nichnas veeni nichnas letoch shellecha vechofin et hannoder limkor et chelko
Haya echad min hashshuk muddar beechad mehem hanaa lo yikkanes lechatzer rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer yachol lomar lo letoch shel chavercha ani nichnas veeni nichnas letoch shellecha
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero veyesh lo merchatz uvet habbad muskarin bair im yesh lo bahen tefisat yad asur en lo bahen tefisat yad muttar
Haomer lachavero kunam levetcha sheani nichnas vesadcha sheani lokeach met o shemmecharo leacher muttar kunam bayit ze sheani nichnas sade zo sheani lokeach met o shemmecharo leacher asur

Gema ibaya lehu benadru peligi hiddiru ze et ze may mi amrinan benadru hu difligi aval behiddiru ze et ze modu leh rabbanan lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov dechi anusin damu o dilma afilu behiddiru ze et ze peligi rabbanan
Ta shema haya echad mehen muddar hanaa mechavero ufligi rabbanan tane nadur mechavero hanaa
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa vechofin et hannoder limkor et chelko i amratte bishlama dindar hu hayenu dekatane kofin ella i amratte deaddereh ammay kofin oto ha menas anis
Amar rabba amar zeeri
b: Machloket sheyyesh bah kede chalukka aval en bah kede chalukka divre hakkol muttar
Amar leh rav yosef hare bet hakkeneset dichmi sheen bo kede chalukka dame utnan shenehen asurin bedavar shel otah hair
Ella amar rav yosef amar zeeri machloket sheen bah kede chalukka aval yesh bah kede chalukka divre hakkol asur
Amar rav huna halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov vechen amar rabbi elazar halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov

Hammuddar hanaa mechavero veyesh lo sham merchatz vechu vechamma tefisat yad amar rav nachman lemechetza lishlish velirvia aval bivtzir la abbaye amar afilu bivtzir asur hechi dame dishre dimkabbel betaska

a: Haomer lachavero vechu bae avimi kunam levayit ze sheatta nichnas met o shemmecharo leacher mahu adam oser davar shebbirshuto lichsheyyetze mershuto o la
Amar rava ta shema haomer livno kunam shei atta nehene li umet yirashennu bechayyav uvmoto umet lo yirashennu shema minah adam oser davar shebbirshuto lichsheyyetze mershuto shema minah
Tenan hatam kunam perot haellu alay kunam hen al pi kunam hen lefi asur bechilufehen uvgidulehen

Bae rame bar chama amar kunam perot haellu al peloni mahu bechilufehen mi amrinan gabbe dileh hoil veadam oser perot chavero al atzmo adam oser davar shello va leolam al atzmo gabbe chavero hoil veen adam oser perot chavero al chavero en adam oser davar shello va leolam al chavero
b: O dilma mishshum dechilufin kegidulin dame la shena hu vela shena chavero
Amar rav acha bar minome ta shema haomer leishto kunam sheani nehene lich lova uvale chovin bain venifrain may tama bale chovin nifrain lav mishshum dechilufin lav kegidulin dame
Amar rava dilma lechattechila hu dela vei avad avad
Ella ta shema hamkaddesh beorla enah mekuddeshet mecharan vekidesh bidmehen hare zo mekuddeshet hacha name lechattechila hu dela vei avad avad
Matni hareni alecha cherem hammuddar asur hare atte alay cherem hannoder asur hareni alecha veatte alay shenehem asurin ushnehem muttarin bedavar shel ole bavel

a: Vaasurim bedavar shel otah hair veezehu davar shel ole bavel kegon har habbayit vehaazarot vehabbor shebbeemtza hadderech veezehu davar shel otah hair kegon harchava vehammerchatz uvet hakkeneset vehatteva vehassefarim vehakkotev chelko lannasi

Rabbi yehuda omer echad kotev lannasi veechad kotev lahedot ma ben kotev lannasi lakkotev lahedot shehakkotev lannasi en tzarich lezakkot lahedot tzarich lezakkot vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze tzerichin lezakkot lo dibberu benasi ella bahove rabbi yehuda omer en anshe galil tzerichin lichtov shekkevar katvu avotehen al yedehen
Gema ammay mitsar amar rav sheshet hachi katane uma takkanatan yichtevu chelkan lannasi

Rabbi yehuda omer echad kotev lannasi veechad kotev lahedot uma ben kotev lannasi lechotev lahedot hakkotev lannasi en tzarich lezakkot vehakkotev lahedot tzarich lezakkot vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze tzerichim lezakkot lo dibberu benasi ella bahove

Rabbi yehuda omer en anshe galil tzerichin lezakkot shekkevar katvu avotehen al yedehen tanya rabbi yehuda omer anshe galil kanteranin hau vehau nodrin hanaa ze mizze amdu avotehem vechatvu chelkehen lannasi

Matni hammuddar hanaa mechavero veen lo ma yochal notno leacher leshum mattana vehalla muttar bah maase beechad bevet choron shehaya aviv noder hemennu hanaa vehaya massi et beno veamar lachavero chatzer usuda netunim hinan lefanecha ella kede sheyyavo abba veyochal immanu bisuda

Amar im shelli hem hare hem mukdashin lashshamayim amar lo natatti lecha et shelli shettakdishem lashshamayim amar lo natatta li et shellecha ella shettehe atta veavich ochlin veshotin umitratztzin ze laze vihe aon taluy berosho amru chachamim kol mattana sheenah sheim hikdishah tehe mekuddeshet enah mattana
Gema maase listor chassore michassera vehachi katane veim hochiach sofo al techilato asur umaase name bevet choron beechad dahava sofo mochiach al techilato
Amar rava lo shanu ella deamar leh vehinan lefanecha ella kede sheyyavo abba aval amar leh sheyehu lefanecha sheyyavo abba middatecha hu deamar leh

Lishana acharina amrin lah amar rava la tema tama deamar leh vehinan lefanecha hu deasur aval amar leh hen lefanecha sheyyavo abba veyochal muttar ella afilu amar leh hen lefanecha yavo abba veyochal asur may tama seudato mochachat alav
b: Hahu gavra dahava leh bera dahava shamet kipe dechitana asrinhu lenichseh aleh amru leh vei havay bar berach tzurba merabbanan may amar lehon likne haden vei havay bar beri tzurba merabbanan likneyeh may
Amri pumbeditae keni al menat lehaknot hu vechol keni al menat lehaknot la kane
Verav nachman amar kane deha sudara kane al menat lehaknot hu

Amar rav ashe uman lema lan desudara i tafes leh la mitfis veod sudara kane al menat lehaknot vekane min hashta halen nichsin dehaden leimatti kane lechi have bar bereh tzurba merabbanan lechi hava hadar sudara lemareh
Amar leh rava lerav nachman veha mattenat bet choron dikni al menat lehaknot hu vela ka kane
Zimnin amar leh mishshum disudato mochachat alav vezimnin amar leh rabbi eliezer hi deamar afilu vitur asur bemuddar hanaa
Tenan amru chachamim kol mattana sheenah sheim hikdishah tehe mekuddeshet enah mattana kol leetoye may lav leetoye ha milta deshadya bechipe la leetoye lishana batraa dishmateh derava
Hadran alach hashshuttafin

a: Hannoder min hamvushshal muttar betzali uvshaluk amar kunam tavshil sheeni toem asur bemaase kedera rach umuttar beave umuttar bevetza tormota uvaddallaat harmutza hannoder mimmaase kedera en asur ella mimmaase retachta amar kunam hayyored likdera sheeni toem asur bechol hammitbashshelin bikdera
Gema tanya rabbi yoshiyya oser veaf al pi sheen reaya ledavar zecher laddavar shenneemar vayevashshelu et happesach baesh kammishpat
Lema beha kamipalgi derabbi yoshiyya savar hallech achar leshon tora vetanna dilan savar bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam

La dechulle alma bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam mar ki atreh umar ki atreh beatra detanna dilan letzali karu leh tzali velimvushshal karu leh mevushshal beatra derabbi yoshiyya afilu tzali karu mevushshal
Veha kera nasev lah asmachta bealma
Kunam tavshil ku veha mittavshil nedar

Amar abbaye hay tanna kol mide demitachel beh rifta tavshil karu leh vehatanya hannoder min hattavshil asur bechol mine tavshil veasur betzali uvshaluk uvimvushshal veasur behitriyyot rakkot shehacholin ochlin bahen pitan
Ini veha rabbi yirmeya chalash al legabbeh hahu asya leassoyeh chaza kara demachet beveteh shavkeh unfak amar malach mota it leh leden beveteh vaana eul leassaa yateh

La kashya ha berakkiche ha beashshune rava bar ulla amar ha bekara gufeh veha begaveyh dikra deamar rav yehuda luliba dekara besilka luliba dechitana bechuttacha vedavar ze asur leomro bifne am haaretz
Rava amar man cholin rabbanan rava letameh deamar rava
b: Keman metzallinan al ketzire veal merie keman kerabbi yose middeamar ketzire umrie shema minah ketzire ketzire mammash merie rabbanan
Umuttar beava matnitin dela kevavlae deamar rabbi zera bavlae tafshae deachli lachma belachma
Amar rav chisda dimshael lehon lehalen nakdane dehutzal haden dayesa hechen mealle lemechlah dechite belachma dechite vedisare belachma disare o dilma dechite bedisare vedisare bidchite

Rava achleh bachasise rabba bar rav huna ashkecheh lerav huna dekaachel dayesa beetzbeateh amar leh ammay kaachel mar bideh amar leh hachi amar rav dayesa beetzbeata besim vechol dechen betarten vechol dechen bitlat

Amar leh rav lechiyya bereh vechen amar leh rav huna lerabba bereh mezammenim lach lemechal dayesa ad parsa lemechal bisra detora ad telata parsin amar leh rav lechiyya bereh vechen amar leh rav huna lerabba bereh kol midaam la tiflot kammeh rabbach levar min kara vedayesa shehen domin liftilta shel avar vaafilu kamme shabbur malka pelot

Rabbi yose verabbi yehuda chad achel dayesa beetzbeateh vechad achel behutza amar leh deachel behutza lidachel beetzbeateh ad matay atta maachileni tzoatcha amar leh deachel beetzbeateh lidachel behutza ad matay atta maachileni rukkecha

Rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon ayeto lekammayehu belusfiyn rabbi yehuda achal rabbi shimon la achal amar leh rabbi yehuda may tama la achel mar amar leh rabbi shimon ellu en yotzin mibbene meayim kol ikar amar leh rabbi yehuda kol shekken shennismoch alehen lemachar

Rabbi yehuda hava yatev kammeh derabbi tarfon amar leh rabbi tarfon hayyom panecha tzehubbin amar leh emesh yatzu avadecha lassade veheviu lanu teradin vaachalnum belo melach veim achalnum bemelach kol shekken shehau panenu tzehubbin

Amara hahi matronita lerabbi yehuda more verave amar lah hemanuta bida dehahi itta i taemna ella kidusha veavdalta vearbea kase defischa vechograni tziday min happesach ad haatzeret ella chochmat adam tair panav

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi yehuda panecha domin i kemalve ribbit i kimgaddele chazirin amar leh bihudae tarvayehu asiran ella esrim vearbaa bet hakkisse it li min beta ad be midresha vechol shaa veshaa ani nichnas lechol echad veechad
Rabbi yehuda kad azel leve midresha shakel gulpa al katpeh amar gedola melacha shemmechabbedet et bealeha rabbi shimon shakel tzanna al katpeh amar gedola melacha shemmechabbedet et bealeha

Devethu derabbi yehuda nefakat nekatat amra avada gelima dehutve kad nefakat leshuka mikasseya beh vechad nafek rabbi yehuda letzalloye hava mikkasse umtzalle vechad mikasse beh hava mevarach baruch sheatani meil
Zimna chada gezar rabban shimon ben gamliel taanita rabbi yehuda la ata leve taanita amrin leh la it leh kissuya shaddar leh gelima vela kabbel

a: Dalli tzipta vaamar leh lishlucha chazi may ika mihu la nicha li deithane behaden alma
Rabbi akiva itkaddashat leh beratte devar dechalba savua shema bar kalba savua adderah hanaa mikkol nichseh azala veitnesiva leh

Besitva hava ganu be tivna hava ka menakket lah tivna min mazzeyah amar lah i havay li ramena lich yerushalayim dedahava ata eliyyahu idmi lehon keenasha veka kare abbava amar lehu havu li purta detivna diledat itteti velet li midaam leagnoyah amar lah rabbi akiva leinteteh chazi gavra daafilu tivna la it leh

Amara leh zil heve be rav azal tarte sere shenin kamme derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua lemishlam tarte sere shenin ka ata leveteh shema min achore beteh dekaamar lah chad rasha lidvethu shappir aved lich avuch chada dela dame lich veod shavkich armelut chayyut kullehon shenin amara leh i tzaet ledili leheve tarte sere shenin achranyata amar hoil vihavat li reshuta ehdar laachoray hadar azal hava tarte sere shene achranyata

Ata beesrin vearbea alfin zuge talmide nefuk kulle alma leappeh veaf hi kamat lemipak leappeh amar lah hahu rashshia veatte lehecha amara leh yodea tzaddik nefesh behemto atat leitchazoye leh ka medachin lah rabbanan amar lehon hannichu lah shelli veshellachem shellah hu shema bar kalba savua ata veitshil al nidreh veishteray veishteri
Min shet mile iattar rabbi akiva min kalba savua min ayyala disfinta dechol sefinata avdin leh min ana zimna chada ansheuh al kef yamma ata hu ashkecheh

Umin geoza dezimna chada yehev arbaa zuze lesafonae amar lehu ayete li middaam vela ashkachu ella geoza al kef yamma atuh leh amaru leh aved marana aleh ishtechach dahava mele dinare dezimna chada tevaat sefinta vechulle iska hava machet behahu geoza veishtechach behahu zimna
Demin disrukita umin matronita
b: Umin ishto shel toranusrufus umin ketia bar shalom
Rav gammada yehev arbaa zuzi lesafonae leetoye behon midaam la ashkachu atuh leh behon kofa ishtemit al lecharta chafaru batreh ashkechuh dirvia al margalyata ayetinun leh kullehon

Amara leh bat kesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya tora mefoara bichli mechoar amar lah limdi mibbet avuch bamme mannichin yayin amara leh bemane defachra amar lah kulle alma befachra veattun bemane defachra attun achitun bemane dechaspa vedahava
Azalat urmat chamra bemane dechaspa vedahava usri amar lah af orayeta ken vehaika shappirin ugmirin amar lah i hao senu hao gemirin tefe

Hahi deatya lekammeh derav yehuda minnehardea ledina veitchayyavat min dina amara leh shemuel rabbach hachi danan amar lah yadatte leh amara leh in gutztza verabba kereseh ukkam verabba shineh amar lah levazzoyeh kaatet tehve hahi itteta beshamta pekaa umita

Umuttar bevetza tormita may betza tormita amar shemuel avda deaved lah shave alpa dinare umayyel lah alpa zimne bemayya chammime vealpa zimne bemayya karire ad demitzutra ki hechi devala yatah veim it keva sarech alah vechad nafka veatya yada asya may samma mitbee leh uvmay mittassi
Shemuel hava badek nafsheh bekulcha ad dimsatterin inashe beteh aleh sarehon
Tenan hatam haya ose bichlufsin lo yochal bivnot sheva bivnot sheva lo yochal bichlufsin may kelufsin mina ditene deavdin minnehon lafde
Hahu gavra dihav avda lechavreh leagmoreh alpa mine lafde agmereh tamne mea azmeneh ledina lekammeh derabbi amar rabbi avotenu amru nashinu tova anu afilu beenenu lo rainu

Rabbi avad leh hillula lerabbi shimon berabbi ketav al bet genana esrin vearbea alfin riboin dinarin nefaku al bet genana den vela azmeneh levar kappara amar leh im leovre retzono kach leose retzono al achat kamma vechamma azmeneh amar leose retzono baolam hazze kach laolam habba al achat kamma vechamma
Yoma dimchayyech beh rabbi atya puranuta lealma amar leh levar kappara la tevaddechan veyahevna lach arbein gerive chite amar leh lichze mar

a: Dechol geriva devaena shakelna shekal dikula rabba chafyeh kufra vesachfeh al resheh vaazal vaamar leh lechil li mar arbein gerive chite derashena bach achuch rabbi amar leh lav azhartacha dela tevaddechan amar leh chite derashena ka nasevna
Amar lah bar kappara levarteh derabbi limchar shatena chamra berikuda daavuch uvkirkane deimmich ben elasa chatneh derabbi hava veashir gadol hava azmeneh leve hilula derabbi shimon berabbi

Amar leh bar kappara lerabbi may toeva kol daamar leh rabbi dehachen hu toeva parchah bar kappara amar leh parsheh atte amar leh tete devetchi tirme li natla atat ramya leh amar leh lerabbi kum rekod li deemar lach hachi amar rachamana toeva toe atta bah
Lechasa acharina amar leh may tevel amar leh ki inyana kadmaa amar leh ived li deomar lach avad amar leh tevel hu tavlin yesh bah mi shanya hada bia min kullehon biot
Amar leh umay zima amar leh ived ki inyana kadmaa avad vaamar leh zo ma hi la yechel ben elasa lemisbal kam unfak hu veinteteh mittamman
May ben elasa detanya lo lechinnam pizer ben elasa et meotav ella leharot bahen tisporet shel kohen gadol
Dichtiv kasom yichsemu et rashehem tana keen lulyanit may lulyanit amar rav yehuda tispurta yechidta hechi dame amar rava rosho shel ze betzad ikaro shel ze vehayenu tisporet shel kohen gadol
Uvaddallaat harmutza may dallaat harmutza amar shemuel karra karkuzay rav ashe amar dallaat hattemuna beremetz
Etiveh ravina lerav ashe rabbi nechemya omer dallaat arammit hi dallaat hammitzrit kilayim im hayevanit kilayim im harmutza teuvta
Matni hannoder mimmaase kedera en asur ella mimmaase retachta amar kunam hayyored likdera sheani toem asur bechol hannaase bikdera

Gema tanya hannoder min hayyored likdera asur bayyored leilpas shekkevar yarad likdera kodem sheyyorad leilpas min hayyored leilpas muttar beored likdera min hannaase bikdera muttar benaase beilpas min hannaase beilpas muttar benaase bikdera
Hannoder min hayyored letannur en asur ella befat veim amar kol maase tannur alay asur bechol hannaasim betannur
b: Matni min hakkavush en asur ella min hakkavush shel yarak kavush sheani toem asur bechol hakkevushim min hashshaluk eno asur ella min hashshaluk shel basar shaluk sheani toem asur bechol hashshelukim
Gema amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe amar dichvish may dishlik may ditzli may dimliach may hechen mashma tibe

Matni min hatztzali en asur ella min hatztzali shel basar divre rabbi yehuda tzali sheani toem asur bechol hatztzeluyim min hammaliach en asur ella min hammaliach shel dag maliach sheani toem asur bechol hammeluchim

Dag dagim sheani toem asur bahen ben gedolim ben ketannim ben meluchim ben tefelim ben chayyim ben mevushshalim umuttar betarit terufa uvtzir hannoder min hatztzachana asur betarit terufa umuttar betzir uvmuryas hannoder mittarit terufa asur betzir uvmuryas
Gema tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer dag sheani toem asur bigdolim umuttar biktannim daga sheani toem asur biktannim umuttar bigdolim dag daga sheani toem asur ben bigdolim ben biktannim
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye mimmay dedag sheani toem gadol hu dichtiv vayeman Adonai dag gadol livloa et yona vehachtiv vayyitpallel yona el Adonai elohav mimmee haddaga
Ha la kashya dilma palteh dag gadol uvaleh dag katan ella vehaddaga asher bayeor meta ketannim metu gedolim lo metu ella daga mashma gedolim umashma ketannim uvindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam
Hannoder min hatztzachana ku amar leh ravina lerav ashe amar hare alay tzichin may tibe
Matni hannoder min hechalav muttar bakkom verabbi yose oser min hakkom muttar bechalav abba shaul omer hannoder min haggevina asur bah ben melucha utfela hannoder min habbasar

a: Muttar barotev uvakkefe verabbi yehuda oser

Amar rabbi yehuda maase veasar alenu rabbi tarfon bevetzim shennitbashshelu immo amru lo ken haddavar ematay bizman sheyyomar basar ze alay shehannoder min haddavar venitarev beacher im yesh bo benoten taam asur
Hannoder min hayyayin muttar betavshil sheyyesh bo taam yayin amar kunam yayin ze sheani toem venafal letavshil im yesh bo benoten taam hare ze asur
b: Gema urminhu min haadashim asur baashishim verabbi yose mattir
La kashya mar ki atreh umar ki atreh beatra derabbanan karu lachalava chalava ulkoma koma beatreh derabbi yose lekoma name karu leh koma dachalava

Tanya hannoder min hechalav muttar bakkom min hakkom muttar bechalav min hechalav muttar bigvina min haggevina muttar bechalav min harotev muttar bekefe min hakkefe muttar berotev im amar basar ze alay asur bo uvrotbo uvkefo
Hannoder min hayyayin muttar betavshil sheyyesh bo taam yayin amar kunam yayin ze sheeni toem venafal letoch hattavshil im yesh bo taam yayin hare ze asur
Matni hannoder min haanavim muttar beyayin min hazzetim muttar beshemen amar kunam zetim vaanavim ellu sheeni toem asur bahen uvotze mehen
Gema bae rame bar chama ellu daveka o sheeni toem daveka
I salka datach ellu daveka sheeni toem lema li ha ka mashma lan deaf al gav deamar sheeni toem i deamar ellu mitsar vei la la
Amar rava ta shema kunam perot haellu alay kunam hen lefi asur bechilufehen uvgidulehen ha bayyotze mehen muttar
Hu haddin daafilu beotze mehen asur veha adifa leh leashmoinan dechilufehen kegidulehen dame
Ta shema sheeni ochel vesheeni toem muttar bechilufehen uvgidulehen ha hayyotze mehen asur ayede dela nasev beresha yotze mehen la nasev name besefa yotze mehen

Ta shema amar rabbi yehuda maase veasar rabbi tarfon alay betzim shennitbashshelu immo amru lo ematay bizman sheamar basar ze alay shehannoder min haddavar venitarev beacher veyesh bo benoten taam hare ze asur
Beellu la ka mibaya lan dedaveka hu ki mibaya lan besheeni toem daveka o lav daveka
Ta shema dag dagim sheeni toem asur bahen ben gedolim ben ketannim ben chayyim ben mevushshalim umuttar betarit terufa uvtzir
Amar rava uchvar yatza mehen

a: Matni hannoder min hattemarim muttar bidvash temarim missitvaniyyot muttar bechometz sitvaniyyot rabbi yehuda ben betera omer kol sheshshem toladto keruya alav venoder hemennu asur bayyotze hemennu vachachamim mattirim
Gema chachamim hayenu tanna kamma

Ika benayehu hada detanya kelal ze amar rabbi shimon ben elazar kol sheddarko leechol vederech hayyotze mimmennu leechol kegon temarim udvash temarim nadar bo asur bayyotze mimmennu noder miyyotze mimmennu asur bo
Kol sheen darko leechol vederech hayyotze mimmennu leechol noder bo en asur ella bayyotze mimmennu shello nitkaven ze ella layyotze mimmennu
Matni hannoder min hayyayin muttar beyen tappuchim min hashshemen muttar beshemen shumshemin min haddevash muttar bidvash temarim
Min hachometz muttar bechometz sitvaniyyot min hakkereshin muttar bekaflotot min hayyarak muttar beyarkot hassade shehu shem lauy

Gema tanya hannoder min hashshemen beeretz yisrael muttar beshemen shumshemin veasur beshemen zayit uvvavel asur beshemen shumshemin umuttar beshemen zayit makom shemmistappekin mizze umizze asur baze uvaze
Peshita la tzericha derubba min chad mistappekin mahu detema ezil batar rubba ka mashma lan safek isura lechumra

Hannoder min hayyarak bishar shene shavua asur beyarkot haggina umuttar beyarkot hassade uvashsheviit asur beyarkot hassade umuttar beyarkot haggina amar rabbi avahu mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel
b: Lo shanu ella bimkom sheen meviin yarak mechutza laaretz laaretz aval bemakom shemmeviin yarak mechutza laaretz laaretz asur
Ketannae en meviin yarak min chutza laaretz laaretz rabbi chananya ben gamliel omer meviin yarak mechutza laaretz laaretz may tameh deman deamar en meviin amar rabbi yirmeya mishshum gush
Matni min hakkeruv asur beispargos min haispargos muttar bichruv
Min haggerisin asur bemikpa verabbi yose mattir min hammikpa muttar bigrisin min hammikpa asur bishshum verabbi yose mattir min hashshum muttar bemikpa
Min haadashim asur baashishim rabbi yose mattir min haashishim muttar baadashim
Chitta chittin sheani toem asur bahen ben kemach ben happat geris gerisin sheani toem asur bahen ben chayyin ben mevushshalin rabbi yehuda omer kunam geris o chitta sheani toem muttar lachos chayyim
Gema tanya rabbi shimon ben gamliel omer chitta sheani toem asur leefot umuttar lachos chittim sheani toem asur lachos umuttar leefot chitta chittin sheani toem asur ben lachos ben leefot
Geris sheani toem asur levashshel umuttar lachos gerisin sheani toem asur lachos umuttar levashshel geris gerisin sheani toem asur ben levashshel ben lachos
Hadaran alach hannoder min hamvushshal

a: Hannoder min hayyarak muttar baddilluin verabbi akiva oser amru lo lerabbi akiva vahalo omer adam lishlucho kach li yarak vehu omer lo matzati ella dilluin
Amar lahem ken haddavar o shemma omer hu lo matzati ella kitnit ella shehaddilluin bichlal yarak vekitnit eno bichlal yarak veasur befol hammitzri lach umuttar bayyavesh
Gema hannoder min hayyarak ku veha min yarak nedar amar ulla beomer yarke kedera alay vedilma yarak hanneechal bikdera kaamar beomer yarak hammitbashshel bikdera alay

Bemay ka mipalgi rabbanan savri kol milta ditzrich shelicha leimmeloche alah lav mineh hu verabbi akiva savar kol milta demimlich shelicha alah mineh hu amar abbaye mode rabbi akiva leinyan malkot sheeno loke
Tenan hatam hashshaliach sheasa shelichuto baal habbayit maal lo asa shelichuto shaliach maal

Man tanna amar rav chisda matnitin dela kerabbi akiva ditnan ketzad amar lo ten basar laorchim venatan lahem kaved ten kaved venatan lahem basar hashshaliach maal vei rabbi akiva ha amar rabbi akiva kol milta demimlich alah shaliach mineh hu limol baal habbayit vela limol shaliach
Amar abbaye afilu tema rabbi akiva
b: Mi la mode rabbi akiva ditzrich imloche itmar shemata kammeh derava amar lehon shappir amar nachmani

Man tanna diflig aleh derabbi akiva rabban shimon ben gamliel hi detanya hannoder min habbasar asur bechol mine vasar veasur barosh uvaraglayim uvakkane uvakkaved uvallev uvofot umuttar bivsar dagim vachagavim

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hannoder min habbasar asur bechol mine vasar umuttar barosh uvaraglayim uvakkane uvakkaved uvallev uvofot veen tzarich lomar besar dagim vachagavim vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer keravayim lav basar veochlehen lav bar inash ochlehen kevasar leinyan zevine lav bar inash
May shena besar of letanna kamma daasir daavid shelicha demimlich aleh besar dagim name aved shelicha dei la mashkach bisra mimlich aleh deamar i la mashkachna bisra ayete dagim velitasru

Amar abbaye kegon shehikkiz dam dela achel dagim i hachi afilu ofot name la achel deamar shemuel dimsochar veachel bisra detzippera parach libbeh ketzippera vetanya en makkizin lo al dagim velo al ofot velo al basar maliach vetanya hikkiz dam lo yochal lo chalav velo gevina velo betzim velo shachalayim velo ofot velo basar maliach shane ofot deefshar al yede shelika
Abbaye amar kegon dechayevin leh eneh dedagim kashin laenayim i hachi achel dagim deha amar shemuel nun samech ayin nuna samma leenayim hahu sof uchla

a: Matni hannoder min haddagan asur befol hammitzri yavesh divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim eno asur ella bachameshet hamminin rabbi meir omer hannoder min hattevua eno asur ella mechameshet hamminin aval hannoder min haddagan asur bakkol umuttar beferot hailan uvayyarak

Gema lememra dedagan kol demidgan mashma metiv rav yosef vechifrotz haddavar hirbu vene yisrael reshit dagan tirosh veyitzhar vechol tevuat sade larov vego vei amratte dagan kol demidgan mashma may kifrotz haddavar hirbu amar abbaye leetoye perot hailan veyarak

Rabbi meir omer hannoder min hattevua vechu amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim benoder min hattevua sheen asur ella mechameshet hamminin tanya name hachi shavin bannoder min hattevua sheen asur ella mechameshet hamminin peshita mahu detema tevua kol mille mashma kamashma lan dela mashma kol milli
Metiv rav yosef vechifrotz haddavar hirbu vene yisrael ku amar rava tevua lechud tevuat sade lechud

Bar mar shemuel pakked delitnun telesar alfe zuzi lerava min alalta dinhar panya shalchah rava lekammeh derav yosef alalta hechi mikarya amar rav yosef matnitin hi veshavin bannoder min hattevua sheen asur ella mechameshet hamminin amar leh abbaye mi dame tevua la mashma ella mechameshet hamminin alalta kol mile mashma

Ahderuhu lekammeh derava amar ha la ka mibaya li daalalta kol mile mashma hada hu deibaya li sechar battim uschar sefinot may mi amrinan kevan defachatan lav alalta hi o dilma kevan dela yedia pechatayehu alalta hi amruha rabbanan kammeh derav yosef amar vechi meachar dela tzerich lan ammay shelach lan ikfad rav yosef

Shema rava vaata lekammeh bemaale yoma dechippure ashkecheh leshammaeh dahava ka mazeg kammeh kasa dechamra amar leh hav li deemzig leh ana yehav leh veka mazeg ihu kasa dechamra ki ka shate amar haden mizga dame lemizga derava bereh derav yosef bar chama amar leh hu nihu
Amar leh la titev akkarach ad deamratte li perusha dehaden milta may dichtiv umimmidbar mattana umimmattana nachaliel uminnachaliel bamot

Amar leh kevan sheose adam et atzmo kammidbar shehu mufkar lakkol tora nitna lo bemattana shenneemar umimmidbar mattana vechevan shennitna lo bemattana nechalo el shenneemar umimmattana nachaliel vechevan shennechalo el ole ligdulla shenneemar uminnachaliel bamot veim higbiha atzmo hakkadosh baruch hu mashpilo shenneemar umibbamot haggaye velo od ella sheshshokin oto bakkarka shenneemar venishkafa al pene hayeshimon veim chozer bo hakkadosh baruch hu magbiho
b: Shenneemar kol ge yinnase

Tanya hannoder min haddagan asur af befol hammitzri yavesh umuttar ballach umuttar beorez bechilka betargis uvtisne hannoder min perot hashshana asur bechol perot hashshana umuttar bigdayim uvitlaim uvchalav uvvetzim uvgozalot veim amar gidule shana alay asur bechullan
Hannoder min perot haaretz asur bechol perot haaretz umuttar bichmehin ufitriyyot veim amar gidule karka alay asur bechullan

Urminhi al davar sheen gidulo min haaretz omer shehakkol nihye bidvaro vetanya al hammelach veal hazzamit veal kemehin ufitriyyot omer shehakkol nihye bidvaro amar abbaye mirba ravu meara menak meavera yanki vela meara veha katane al davar sheen gidulo min haaretz teni al davar sheen yonek min haaretz
Matni hannoder min hakkesut muttar besak uviria uvachamila amar kunnam tzemer ole alay muttar lehitkassot begize tzemer happishtan ole alay muttar lehitkassot baanitze pishtan
Rabbi yehuda omer hakkol lefi hannoder taan vehizzia vehaya recho kashe amar kunnam tzemer ufishtim ole alay muttar lehitkassot veasur lehafshil laachorav

Gema tanya hannoder min hakkesut muttar besak uviria uvachamila veasur befunda uvifsikya uviskurteya uvkatavulya veanpilya uflinya umichnasayim vechova may iskurte amar rabba bar chana kituna detzalla

Tanya yotzin besak ave uvsagos ave uviria uvachamila mippene haggeshamim aval lo beteva velo bekuppa velo bemachtzelet mippene haggeshamim haroim yotzin besakkim velo roim bilvad amru ella kol adam ella sheddibberu chachamim bahove

Rabbi yehuda omer hakkol lefi hannoder ku tanya ketzad amar rabbi yehuda hakkol lefi hannoder haya lavush tzemer vehetzar veamar kunnam tzemer ole alay asur lilbosh umuttar liton haya taun pishtan vehizzia veamar kunnam pishtan ole alay muttar lilbosh veasur liton

a: Matni hannoder min habbayit muttar baaliyya divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim aliyya bichlal habbayit hannoder min aliyya muttar bevayit
Gema man tena bevet lerabbot et hayyatzia bevet lerabbot et haaliyya amar rav chisda rabbi meir hi dei rabbanan haamri rabbanan aliyya bichlal habbayit lema li kera bevet leribuya
Abbaye amar afilu tema rabbanan baaya kera desalka datach amena bevet eretz achuzzatchem ketiv dimchabbar beara shemeh bayit aliyya ha la mechabbar beara

Keman azla ha deamar rav huna bar chiyya mishshemeh deulla bayit beveti ani mocher lach marehu aliyya tama daamar leh bayit shebbeveti ani mocher lach aval bayit setam eno marehu aliyya lema rabbi meir hi afilu tema rabbanan may aliyya meulla shebbabbattim
Matni hannoder min hammitta muttar baddargesh divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim dargesh bichlal mitta hannoder min haddargesh muttar bammitta

Gema may dargesh amar ulla arsa degadda amaru leh rabbanan leulla ha ditnan keshehen mavrin oto kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al haddargesh kullah shatta la yatev aleh hahu yoma yatev aleh matkef lah ravina mide dehave abbasar veyayin dechullah shatta i bae achel vei bae la achel hahu yoma anan yahavinan leh

Ella ha kashya detanya dargesh lo haya kofehu ella zokfo vei amratte arsa degadda hu vehatanya hakkofe et mittato lo mittato bilvad hu kofe ella kol mittot sheyyesh lo betoch habbayit hu kofe ha la kashya
b: Mide dehave ammitta hamuchedet lechelim detanya im hayeta mitta hamuchedet lechelim en tzarich lichpotah

Ella i kashya ha kashya detanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer dargesh mattir karbitav vehu nofel meelav vei dargesh arsa degadda hu karbitin mi it leh ki ata ravin amar sheelteh lehahu merabbanan verav tachlifa bar mareva shemeh dahava shechiach beshuka detzallae veamar li may dargesh arsa detzalla

Itmar ezehu mitta veezehu dargesh amar rabbi yirmeya mitta mesargin otah al gabbah dargesh mesargin oto miggufo metivi kele etz meematay mekabbelin tuma hammitta vehaarisa mishsheyeshufem beor haddag vei mitta mistareget al gabbah lema li shifat or haddag
Ella ha veha miggufan mitta aole veappoke bevizyane dargesh aole veappoke baavakta
Amar rabbi yaakov bar acha amar rabbi mitta shennakliteha yotzin zokfah vedayyo amar rabbi yaakov bar ide amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Matni hannoder min hair muttar likanes litchumah shel ir veasur likanes leiburah aval hannoder min habbayit asur min haagaf velifnim

Gema menalan deibura demata kemata dame amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera vayehi bihot yehoshua biricho vego may biricho ilema biricho mammash vehachtiv viricho sogeret umsuggeret ella shema minah beiburah
Ema afilu bitchumah ha ketiv bitchumah umaddotem michutz lair

Hannoder min habbayit eno asur ella min haagaf velifnim aval min haagaf velachutz lo metiv rav mari veyatza hakkohen min habbayit yachol yelech leveto veyasgir talmud lomar el petach habbayit i el petach habbayit yachol yaamod tachat hammashkof veyasgir talmud lomar min habbayit ad sheyyetze min habbayit kullo

Ha ketzad omed betzad hammashkof veyasgir uminnayin sheim halach leveto vehisgir o sheamad tachat hashshakof vehisgir shehesgero musgar talmud lomar vehisgir et habbayit mikkol makom shane gabbe bayit dichtiv min habbayit ad sheyyetze min habbayit kullo

a: Matni kunam perot haellu alay kunam hen al pi kunam hen lefi asur bechilufehen uvgidulehen sheani ochel vesheani toem muttar bechilufehen uvgidulehen bedavar shezzaro kale aval bedavar sheen zaro kale afilu gidule gidulin asurin

Haomer leishto kunam maase yadayich alay kunam hen al pi kunam hen lefi asur bechilufehen uvgidulehen sheani ochel sheani toem muttar bechilufehen uvgidulehen bedavar shezzaro kale aval davar sheen zaro kale afilu gidule gidulin asurin

Sheatte osa eni ochel ad happesach sheatte osa eni mitkasse ad happesach asta lifne happesach muttar leechol ulhitkassot achar happesach sheatte osa ad happesach eni ochel vesheatte osa ad happesach eni mitkasse asta lifne happesach asur leechol ulhitkassot achar happesach sheatte nehenet li ad happesach im holechet atte levet avich ad hechag halcha lifne happesach asura bahanaato ad happesach
b: Leachar happesach beval yachel sheatte nehenet li ad hechag im holechet atte levet avicha ad happesach halcha lifne happesach asura bahanaato ad hechag umutteret lelech achar happesach

Gema haomer leishto kunam maase yadayich alay kunam hen al pi kunam hen lefi vechu yishmael ish kefar yamma veamri lah ish kefar deyamma heela beyado batzal sheakaro bashsheviit untao bashsheminit verabbu gidulav al ikaro vehachi ka mibaya leh gidulav heter veikaro asur kevan deravu gidulav meikaro otan gidule heter maalin et haisur o la ata lekammeh derabbi amme la hava bideh

Ata lekammeh derabbi yitzchak nappacha peshat leh min hada deamar rabbi chanina teritaa amar rabbi yannay batzal shel teruma shennetao verabbu gidulav al ikaro muttar amar leh rabbi yirmeya veitema rabbi zerika shavek mar teren veaved kechad
Man ninhu teren deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan yalda shessibchah bizkenah uvah perot af al pi shehosifa matayim asur
Veamar rabbi shemuel bar rabbi nachmani amar rabbi yonatan batzal shennetao bakkerem veneekar hakkerem asur
Hadar ata lekammeh derabbi amme ufshat leh min hada deamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan litra betzalim shettikna uzraah mitasseret lefi chullah alma otan gidulin mevattelin ikar
Dilma lechumra shane
Ella min hada detanya rabbi shimon omer

a: Kol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin kegon tevel umaaser sheni vehekdesh vechadash lo natnu bahen chachamim shiur vechol davar sheen lo mattirin kegon teruma utrumat maaser vechalla veorla vechile hakkerem natnu bahem chachamim shiur
Amru lo vahalo sheviit en lah mattirin velo natnu bah chachamim shiur ditnan hashsheviit oseret kol shehu beminah amar lahen af ani lo amarti ella leviur
Aval laachila benoten taam vedilma ha name lechumra shane
Ella min hada pashtah ditnan betzalim sheyyardu alehem geshamim vetzamchu im hau alin shellahen shechorin asurin horiku muttarin
Rabbi chananya ben antignos omer im yecholin litalesh bealin shellahen asurin uchnegdan lemotzae sheviit muttarin lememra degidule heter maalin et haisur vedilma bimdukkanin
Ella min hada detanya
b: Hamnakkesh im hakkuti bachasiyyot ochel mehen achilat aray umasseran vadday

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer im yisrael chashud al hashsheviit lemotzae sheviit muttar lememra degidule heter maalin et haisur vedilma bedavar shezzaro kale ha tanya ellu hen chasiyyot kegon halluf hashshum vehabbetzalim
Vedilma bimdukkanin chashud al hashsheviit katane vedilma betaarovet hamnakkesh katane
Lema tehve teuvteh derabbi yochanan udrabbi yonatan amar rabbi yitzchak shanya sheviit hoil veisurah al yede karka betilatah name al yede karka

Hare maaser deisuro al yede karka veen betilato al yede karka detanya litra maaser tevel shezzeraah bakkarka vehishbicha vahare hi keeser litrin chayyevet bemaaser uvishviit veotah litra measser aleha mimmakom acher lefi cheshbon

a: Amri maaser digun hu deka garem leh

Metiv rame bar chama kunam perot haellu alay kunam hen al pi kunam hen lefi asur bechilufehen uvgidulehen sheani ochel vesheani toem muttar bechilufehen uvgidulehen bedavar shezzaro kale aval bedavar sheen zaro kale afilu gidule gidulin asurin
Amar rabbi abba shane konamot hoil vei bae mitteshil alayehu hau lehu kedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin veen batel barov
Vahare teruma dei bae mitshil alah uvatli berov ditnan sea teruma temea shennafla lefachot mimmea chullin terakev ha lemea taale amri bitruma beyad kohen askinan dela matze mitshil alah
I hachi ema sefa im hayeta tehora timmacher lechohen ella beyisrael shennaflu lo mibbet avi immo kohen askinan
Veha katane sefa timacher lechohen chutz middeme otah sea
Ella ema bishlama kunnamot mitzva leitshole alehen mishshum derabbi natan deamar rabbi natan kol hannoder keilu bana bama vehamkayemo keilu maktir aleha teruma may mitzva leitshole alah

Gufa amar rabbi yochanan litra betzalim shettiknah uzraah mitasseret lefi chullah yatev rabba vekaamar leha shemata amar leh rav chisda man tzaet lach ulrabbi yochanan rabbach heter shebbahen lehechan halach amar leh mi la tenan dichotah betzalim sheyyardu alehem geshamim vetzimchu
b: Im hau alin shellahen shechorin asurin horiku muttarin vechi shechorin ammay asurin lema heter shebbahen lehechan halach amar leh mi savratte al ikar katane attosefet katane asurin i hachi may ata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar detanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer haggadel bechiyyuv chayyav haggadel biftur patur tanna kamma name hachi amar
Kullah matnitin rabban shimon ben gamliel katane lah vead kan la shamatte leh lerabban shimon ben gamliel dela ka tarach aval hecha deka tarach batel berubba
