Vechol hecha deka tarach batel berubba vahare litra maaser tevel dekatarach vekatane veotah litra measser alav mimmakom acher lefi cheshbon shane gabbe maaser deamar kera asser teasser vego vehetera zari inashe isura la zari inashe
Gufa amar rabbi chanina tirtaa amar rabbi yannay batzal shel teruma shennetao verabbu gidulav al ikaro muttar lememra degidule

a: Heter maalin et haisur vehatnan gidule teruma teruma begidule gidulin kaamrinan ha name tenena gidule gidulin chullin ha ka mashma lan afilu bedavar sheen zaro kale
Vehatnan hattevel gidulav muttarin bedavar shezzaro kale aval davar sheen zaro kale gidule gidulin asurin ribbuya derabbu gidulin al ikaro muttar ka mashma lan
Hadran alach hannoder min hayyarak
Kunnam yayin sheani toem hayyom eno asur ella ad shettechshach shabbat zo asur bechol hashshabbat veshabbat sheavra chodesh ze asur bechol hachodesh verosh chodesh lehabba
Shana zo asur bechol hashshana verosh hashshana leatid lavo shavua ze asur bechol hashshavua ushviit sheavra
Veim amar yom echad shabbat achat chodesh echad shana achat shavua echad asur miyyom leom
Ad happesach asur ad sheyyaggia ad sheyehe asur ad sheyyetze ad lifne happesach rabbi meir omer asur ad sheyyaggia rabbi yose omer asur ad sheyyetze
Gema kunnam yayin sheani toem ku amar rabbi yirmeya lichshettecheshach tzarich sheela lechacham
May tama amar rav yosef gezera hayyom mishshum yom echad
b: Amar leh i hachi ligzor beom echad mishshum hayyom
Amar leh hayyom beom echad michallaf yom echad behayyom la michallaf

Amar ravina amar li marimar hachi amar avuch mishshemeh derav yosef keman azla shemateh derav yirmeya bar abba kerabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer kol hannoder keilu bana bama vehamkayemo keilu maktir aleha
Shabbat zo asur bechol hashshabbat kullah peshita mahu detema yome deshabbeta kaamar ka mashma lan
Chodesh ze asur bechol hachodesh verosh chodesh lehabba peshita ki itztericha lechodesh chaser
Mahu detema rosh chodesh lesheavar have vela litsar ka mashma lan karu inashe resh yarcha
Shana zo asur bechol hashshana kullah
Ibaya lehu amar kunam yayin sheani toem yom may dineh kehayyom o keom echad
Ta shema mimmatnitin kunam yayin sheani toem hayyom en asur ella ad shettechshach ha yom keom echad dame
Ema sefa amar yom echad asur miyyom leom ha yom kehayyom dame ella meha leka lemishma minah
Amar rav ashe ta shema kunam yayin sheani toem hashshana nitabbera hashshana asur bah uviburah hechi dame

a: Ilema kidkatane lema li lememra ella lav daamar shana alma shana kehashshana dame veom name kehayyom dineh
La leolam deamar hashshana umahu detema hallech achar rov hashshanim vela it behu ibur ka mashma lan
Ibaya lehu amar yayin sheani toem yovel may shenat chamishshim kelifne chamishshim o kilachar chamishshim

Ta shema detanya pelugta derabbi yehuda verabbanan vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana shenat hachamishshim atta mone vei atta mone shenat chamishshim veachat mikkan amru yovel eno ole leminyan shavua rabbi yehuda omer yovel ole leminyan shavua
Amru lo lerabbi yehuda hare hu omer shesh shanim tizra sadecha veen kan ella chamesh
Amar lahem ledivrechem hare hu omer veasat et hattevua lishlosh hashshanim hare kan arba
Ella ika leokomah bishar shene shavua dili name ika leokomah bishar shene shavua
Ad happesach asur ku lememra derabbi meir savar la meayyel inish nafsheh
b: Lisfeka verabbi yose savar meayyel inish nafsheh lisfeka

Urminhi mi sheyyesh lo shette kite vanot mishte nashim veamar kiddashti et bitti haggedola veeni yodea im gedola shebbaggedolot im gedola shebbakketannot veim ketanna shebbaggedolot shehi gedola min haggedola shebbakketannot kullan asurot divre rabbi meir chutz min hakketanna shebbakketannot
Rabbi yose omer kullan muttarot chutz min haggedola shebbaggedolot
Amar rabbi chanina bar avdimi amar rav muchlefet hashshita vehatanya ze hakkelal kol shezzemanno kavua veamar ad lifne rabbi meir omer ad sheyyetze verabbi yose omer ad sheyyaggia

Matni ad hakkatzir ad habbatzir ad hammasik eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia ze hakkelal kol shezzemanno kavua veamar ad sheyyaggia asur ad sheyyaggia amar ad sheyehe asur ad sheyyetze vechol sheen zemanno kavua ben amar ad sheyehe ben amar ad sheyyaggia eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia
Ad hakkayitz ad sheyehe hakkayitz ad sheyyatchilu haam lehachnis bechalkallot ed sheyyaavor hakkayitz ad sheyyakpilu hammiktzoot
Gema tana kalkalla sheamru kalkalla shel teenim velo kalkalla shel anavim tanya hannoder mipperot hakkayitz en asur ella bitenim rabban shimon ben gamliel omer anavim bichlal teenim
May tama detanna kamma kasavar teenim mikatztzan bida anavim la mikatztzan bida rabban shimon ben gamliel savar anavim name ki miraddedan mikatztzan bida
Ad sheyyaavor hakkayitz ad sheyyikkaflu hammaktzuot tana ad sheyyachpilu rov hammaktzuot

a: Tana hukpelu rov hammaktzuot muttarot mishshum gezel ufturot min hammaasrot

Rabbi verabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda iklau lehahu atra bizman shehukpelu rov hammaktzuot rabbi hava ka achel rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda la achel ata marhon amar lehu ammay la achli rabbanan hukpelu rov hammaktzuot hu veaf al pi chen la achel rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda kasavar mishshum sanut milta hu dekaamar haden gavra

Rabbi chama bar rabbi chanina ikla lehahu atra bizman shehukpelu rov hammaktzuot hava kaachel yahev leshammaeh la achel amar leh echol kach amar li rabbi yishmael bar rabbi yose mishshum aviv hukpelu rov hammaktzuot muttarot mishshum gezel ufturot min hammaaser

Rabbi tarfon ashkecheh hahu gavra bizman shehukpelu hammaktzuot dekaachel achateh besakka veshakleh veamteyeh lemishdeh benahara amar lo oy lo letarfon shezze horgo shema hahu gavra shavkeh vaarak amar rabbi avahu mishshum rabbi chananya ben gamliel kol yamav shel oto tzaddik haya mitztaer al davar ze amar oy li shennishtammashti bechitrah shel tora

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol hammishtammesh bechitrah shel tora nekar min haolam kal vachomer uma belshatztzar shennishtammesh bichle kodesh shennaasu kele chol shenneemar uvau vah paritzim vechilluha kevan shepperatzum naasu chol nekar min haolam dichtiv beh belelya ketil belshatztzar hammishtammesh bechitrah shel tora shehu chay vekayyam leolam al achat kamma vechamma

Verabbi tarfon kevan dechi achel dehukpelu rov hammaktzuot hava ammay tzaareh hahu gavra mishshum dehahu hao ganvi leh inve kullah shatta vechevan deashkecheh lerabbi tarfon savar hayenu deganvan i hachi ammay tzaar nafsheh mishshum derabbi tarfon ashir gadol hava vahava leh lefayeso bedamim
Tanya leahava et Adonai elohecha lishmoa bekolo uldovka vo shello yomar adam ekra sheyyikrauni chacham eshne sheyyikrauni rabbi ashannen sheehye zaken veeshev bishiva
Ella lemad meahava vesof hakkavod lavo shenneemar koshrem al etzbeotecha kotvem al luach libbecha veomer deracheha darche noam veomer etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah vetomcheha meushshar

Rabbi eliezer bar rabbi tzadok omer ase devarim leshem poolam vedabber bahem lishmam al taasem atara lehitgaddel bahem veal taasem kurdom lihot oder bo vekal vachomer uma belshatztzar shello nishtammesh ella bichle kodesh shennaasu kele chol nekar min haolam hammishtammesh bechitrah shel tora al achat kamma vechamma
Amar rava shere leh leinish leodoe nafsheh beatra dela yadi leh dichtiv veavdecha yare et Adonai minneurav ella kashya derabbi tarfon ashir gadol haya vahava leh lefayyoseh bedamim
Rava rame ketiv veavdecha yare et Adonai minneurav uchtiv yehallelcha zar velo ficha ha beatra deyadi leh ha beatra dela yadi leh

Amar rava shere leh letzurba merabbanan lememar tzurba merabbanan ana shero li tigray beresha dichtiv uvne david kohanim hau ma kohen notel barosh af talmid chacham notel barosh vechohen mena lan dichtiv vekiddashto ki et lechem Adonai elohecha hu makriv vetana deve rabbi yishmael vekiddashto lechol davar shebbikdushsha
b: Liftoach rishon ulvarech rishon velitol mana yafa rishon

Amar rava shere leh letzurba merabbanan lememar la yahevna akkeraga dichtiv minda velo vahalach la shallit lemirme alehon veamar rabbi yehuda minda zo menat hammelech belo zo kesef gulgalta vahalach zo arnona
Veamar rava shere leh letzurba merabbanan lememar avda denura ana la yahevna akkeraga may tama leavroche arya mineh kaamar
Rav ashe hava leh hahu ibba zabbeneh leve nura amar leh ravina lerav ashe haika lifne iver lo titten michshol amar leh rov etzim lehassaka nitnu
Matni ad hakkatzir ad sheyyatchil heam liktzor ketzir chittin aval lo ketzir seorin hakkol lefi mekom nidro im haya bahar bahar veim haya babbika babbika

Ad haggeshamim ad sheyehu haggeshamim ad shettered revia sheniyya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ad sheyyaggia zemannah shel revia ad sheyyifseku geshamim ad sheyyetze nisan kullo divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyaavor happesach
Gema tanya hannoder ad hakkayitz baggalil veyarad laamakim af al pi shehiggia hakkayitz baamakim asur ad sheyyaggia hakkayitz baggalil
Ad haggeshamim ad sheyehu geshamim ad shettered revia sheniyya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechu amar rabbi zera machaloket deamar ad haggeshamim aval amar ad haggeshem ad zeman geshamim kaamar

a: Metivi ezohi zemannah shel revia habbechira bishlosha benonit beshiva afila beesrim ushlosha divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer beshiva uvshiva asar uvesrim ushlosha
Rabbi yose omer beshiva asar uvesrim ushlosha uvchodesh kislev vechen haya rabbi yose omer en hayechidim mitannin ad sheyyaggia rosh chodesh kislev
Veamrinan alah bishlama revia rishona lishael shelishit lehitannot ella sheniyya lemay veamar rabbi zera lenoder
Veamrinan alah keman azla ha detanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer geshamim sheyyardu shiva yamim ze achar ze atta mone bahen revia rishona ushniyya keman kerabbi yose
Hahu deamar ad haggeshamim
Matni kunam yayin sheeni toem leshana nitabbera hashshana asur bah uviburah ad rosh adar ad rosh adar harishon ad sof adar ad sof adar harishon
Gema alma setama daadar dekaamar rishon hu
Lema matnitin rabbi yehuda hi detanya adar harishon kotev adar harishon adar sheni kotev adar setam divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer adar harishon kotev setam adar sheni kotev tinyan
Amar abbaye afilu tema rabbi meir ha deyada dimabbera shatta ha dela yada
b: Vehatanya ad rosh chodesh adar ad rosh chodesh adar harishon im hayeta shana meubberet ad rosh chodesh adar hashsheni
Mikkelal deresha lav bimubberet askinan shema minah ha difshita leh dimabbera shatta ha dela yada
Matni rabbi yehuda omer kunam yayin sheeni toem ad sheyehe happesach lo nitkaven ze ella ad lel happesach ad shaa shedderech bene adam lishtot yayin

Amar kunam basar sheeni toem ad sheyehe hatztzom eno asur ella ad lele tzom shello nitkaven ze ella ad shaa shedderech bene adam leechol basar rabbi yose beno omer kunam shum sheani toem ad shettehe shabbat eno asur ella ad lele shabbat shello nitkaven ze ella ad shaa shedderech bene adam leechol beshum

Haomer lachavero kunam sheani nehene lecha im en atte ba venotel levanecha kor echad shel chittin ushte chaviyyot shel yayin hare ze yachol lehafer et nidro shello al pi chacham veyomar lo kelum amarta ella mippene chevodi zehu kevodi

Vechen haomer lachavero kunam sheatte nehenet li im en atte ba venoten livni kor shel chittin ushte chaviyyot shel yayin rabbi meir omer asur ad sheyyitten vachachamim omrim af ze yachol lehafer et nidro shello al pi chacham veyomar lo hare ani keilu nitkabbalti
Haya mesarev bo laset bat achoto veamar kunam shehi nehenet li leolam vechen hamgaresh et ishto omer kunam ishti nehenet li leolam hare ellu muttarot lehanot lo shello nitkaven ze ella leshum ishut
Haya mesarev bachavero sheyyochal etzlo amar kunam levetcha sheani nichnas tipat tzonen sheani toem lach muttar likanes leveto velishtot mimmennu tzonen shello nitkaven ze ella leshum achila ushtiyya
Hadaran alach kunam yayin

a: Rabbi eliezer omer potchin leadam bichvod aviv veimmo vachachamim osrin

Amar rabbi tzadok ad sheppotchin lo bichvod aviv veimmo yiftechu lo bichvod hammakom im ken en nedarim modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bedavar shebbeno leven aviv veimmo sheppotchin lo bichvod aviv veimmo

Veod amar rabbi eliezer potchin bannolad vachachamim osrin ketzad amar kunam sheani nehene leish peloni venaasa sofer o shehaya massi et beno veamar ilu hayiti yodea shehu naase sofer o shehaya massi et beno bekarov lo hayiti noder
Kunam levayit ze sheani nichnas venaasa bet hakkeneset amar ilu hayiti yodea shehu naasa bet hakkeneset lo hayiti noder rabbi eliezer mattir vachachamim osrin
Gema may en nedarim amar abbaye im ken en nedarim nitarin yafe
b: Verava amar im ken en nedarim nishalin lechacham

Tenan umodin chachamim lerabbi eliezer bedavar shebbeno leven aviv veimmo sheppotchim lo bichvod aviv veimmo bishlama leabbaye deamar im ken en nedarim nitarin hacha kevan deichatzaf leh ha ichatzaf leh
Ella lerava deamar im ken en nedarim nishalin lechacham hacha ammay potchin amri kevan dechol nidre la saggi lehon delav chacham hacha name potchin
Veod amar rabbi eliezer potchin bannolad ku may tama derabbi eliezer amar rav chisda deamar kera ki metu kol haanashim veha mita denolad hu mikkan sheppotchin bannolad

Verabbanan may tamayehu kasavri hanhu mi mayeti veha amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay kol makom shenneemar nitztzim venitztzavim enan ella datan vaaviram ella amar resh lakish sheyyardu minnichsehen

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol adam sheen lo banim chashuv kemet shenneemar hava li vanim veim ayin meta anochi vetanya arbaa chashuvin met ani umtzora vesome umi sheen lo banim ani dichtiv ki metu kol haanashim metzora dichtiv al na tehi kammet vesome dichtiv bemachashakkim hoshivani kemete olam umi sheen lo banim dichtiv hava li vanim veim ayin meta anochi

a: Tanya hammuddar hanaa mechavero en mattirin lo ella befanav mena hane mile amar rav nachman dichtiv vayyomer Adonai el moshe bemidyan lech shuv mitzrayim ki metu kol haanashim amar lo bemidyan nadarta lech vehatter nidrecha bemidyan dichtiv vayyoel moshe en ala ella shevua dichtiv vayyave oto beala

Vegam bammelech nevuchadnetzar marad asher hishbio belohim chayyim may marduteh ashkecheh tzidkiyya linvuchadnetztzar dahava kaachel arneva chayya amar leh ishteva li dela megallet ilavay vela tipok milta ishteva

Lesof hava ka mitztaar tzidkiyyahu begufeh itshil ashshevuateh vaamar shema nevuchadnetztzar deka mevazzin leh shelach veayeti sanhedrin vetzidkiyyahu amar lehon chazetun may ka aved tzidkiyyahu lav hachi ishteva bishma dishmayya dela megallena amar leh itshali ashshevuata

Amar lehu mittashlin ashshevuata amri leh in amar lehu befanav o afilu shello befanav amri leh befanav amar lehon veattun may avditun may tama la amritun letzidkiyyahu miyyad yeshvu laaretz yiddemu zikne vat tziyyon amar rabbi yitzchak sheshshamtu karim mittachtehem

Matni rabbi meir omer yesh devarim shehen kannolad veenan kannolad veen chachamim modim lo ketzad amar kunam sheani nose et pelonit sheaviha ra amru lo met o sheasa teshuva kunam levayit ze sheani nichnas shehakkelev ra betocho o shehannachash betocho amru lo met hakkelev o shenneherag hannachash hare hen kannolad veeno kannolad veen chachamim modim lo
Gema kunam sheani nichnas levayit ze shehakkelev vechu met nolad hu amar rav huna naasa ketole nidro bedavar verabbi yochanan amar kevar met uchvar asa teshuva kaamri leh
b: Metiv rabbi abba kunam sheeni nose liflonit keura vahare hi naa shechora vahare hi levana ketzara vahare hi arukka muttar bah lo mippene shekkeura venaaset nae shechora venaaset levana ketzara venaaset arukka ella shehanneder taut bishlama lerav huna deamar naasa ketole nidro bedavar tena tole nidro bedavar utna neder taut ella lerabbi yochanan deamar kevar met uchvar asa teshuva lema li lemitne tere zimne neder taut kashya

Matni veod amar rabbi meir potchin lo min hakkatuv shebbattora veomrin lo ilu hayita yodea sheatta over al lo tikkom veal lo tittor veal lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha veahavta lereacha kamocha veche achicha immach shehu ani veen atta yachol lefarnaso amar ilu hayiti yodea shehu ken lo hayiti noder hare ze muttar

Gema amar lehu rav huna bar rav kattina lerabbanan nema kol demiane lav alay nafel may demate li lefarneso bahade kulle alma mefarnasna leh amri leh ani omer kol hannofel eno nofel lide gabbay techilla
Matni potchin laadam bichtubbat ishto

Umaase beechad shennadar meishto hanaa vehayeta ketubbatah arba meot dinarim uva lifne rabbi akiva vechiyevo liten lah ketubbatah amar lo rabbi shemone meot dinarin hinniach abba natal achi arba meot vaani arba meot lo dayya shettittol hi matayim vaani matayim amar lo rabbi akiva afilu atta mocher sear roshcha atta noten lah ketubbatah amar lo ilu hayiti yodea shehu ken lo hayiti noder vehittirah rabbi akiva
Gema mittaltele mi mishtabedi lichtuva amar abbaye karka shava shemone meot dinar vehakatane sear rosho usar rosho mittaltele hu hachi kaamar afilu atta mocher sear roshcha veochel
Shamatte minah en mesadderin levaal chov amar rav nachman berabbi yitzchak

a: Lomar sheen mekarin shetar ketubba
Matni potchin beyamim tovim uvshabbatot barishona hau omrim otan hayyamim muttarin ushar kol hayyamim asurin ad shebba rabbi akiva velimed shehanneder shehuttar mikkelalo huttar kullo
Ketzad amar kunam sheeni nehene lechullechem huttar echad mehen hutteru kullan
Sheeni nehene laze velaze huttar harishon hutteru kullan huttar haacharon haacharon muttar vechullan asurin huttar haemtzai hemennu ulmatta muttar hemennu ulmala asur
Sheani nehene laze korban velaze korban tzerichin petach lechol echad veechad

Kunam yayin sheani toem shehayyayin ra lammeayim amru lo vahalo hamushshan yafe lammeayim huttar bimushshan velo bimushshan bilvad huttar ella bechol hayyayin kunam batzal sheeni toem shehabbatzal ra lallev amru lo halo hakkufri yafe lallev huttar bakkufri velo bakkufri bilvad huttar ella bechol habbetzalim maase haya vehittiro rabbi meir bechol habbetzalim
Gema huttar haacharon haacharon muttar vechullan asurin man tanna
Amar rava rabbi shimon hi deamar ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad
Kunam yayin sheani toem vechu vetipok leh deen ra amar rabbi abba veod yafe katane
Kunam batzal sheani toem shehabbatzal vechu vetipok leh deen ra amar rabbi abba veod yafe katane

Matni potchin laadam bichvod atzmo uvichvod banav omrim lo ilu hayita yodea shellemachar omrin alecha kach hi visto shel peloni megaresh et nashav veal benotecha yehu omrin benot gerushot hen ma raata imman shel ellu lehitgaresh veamar ilu hayiti yodea shekken lo hayiti noder hare ze muttar

Kunam sheani nose et pelonit keura vahare hi naa shechora vahare hi levana ketzara vahare hi arukka muttar bah lo mippene shehi keura venaaset naa shechora venaaset levana ketzara venaaset arukka ella shehanneder taut
Umaase beechad shennadar mibbat achoto hanaya vehichnisuha levet rabbi yishmael veyipuha amar lo rabbi yishmael beni mizzo nadarta amar lo lav vehittirah rabbi yishmael

Beotah shaa bacha rabbi yishmael veamar benot yisrael naot hen ella shehaaniyyut menavaltan uchshemmet rabbi yishmael hau benot yisrael nosot kina veomrot benot yisrael al rabbi yishmael bechena vechen hu omer beshaul benot yisrael al shaul bechena

Gema maase listor chassore mechassera vehachi katane rabbi yishmael omer afilu keura venaaset naa shechora venaaset levana ketzara venaaset arukka maase beechad shennadar mibbat achoto vehichnisuha levet rabbi yishmael veyipuha vechu
b: Tana shen totevet hayeta lah veasa lah rabbi yishmael shen shel zahav mishshello ki shechev rabbi yishmael petach aleh hahu safdana hachi benot yisrael al rabbi yishmael bechena hammalbishchen vechu

Hahu daamar lah lidvethu kunam shei atte nehenet li ad shettatimi tavshilech lerabbi yehuda ulrabbi shimon rabbi yehuda teem amar kal vachomer uma laasot shalom ben ish leishto amra tora shemi shennichtav bikdushsha yimmache al hammayim hamarrim besafek vaani al achat kamma vechamma
Rabbi shimon la teem amar yamutu kol bene almana veal yazuz shimon mimmekomo veod ki hechi dela litraggeli lemindar

Hahu deamar lidvethu kunam shei atte nehenet li ad shettarokki bo berabban shimon ben gamliel atat urkak allevusheh amar leh rav acha middifti leravina veha hay leziluta ka mikaven amar leh mirak al mane derabban shimon ben gamliel ziluta rabbeta hi
Hahu daamar lidvethu kunam shei atte nehenet li ad shettari mum yafe shebbich lerabbi yishmael berabbi yose

Amar lahem shemma roshah nae amru lo segalgal shemma searah nae dome laanitze pishtan shemma eneha naot terutot hen shemma ozneha naot kefulot hen shemma chotmah nae balum hu shemma siftoteha naot avot hen shemma tzavarah nae shakut hu shemma keresah nae tzave hu shemma ragleha naot rechavot keshel aoza shemma shemah nae lichluchit shemah amar lahen yafe korin otah lichluchit shehi meluchlechet bemumin vesharyah

Hahu bar bavel dislek leara deyisrael nesev itta amar lah bashshili li tere talfe bashshila leh tere talfe retach alah limchar amar lah bashshili li geriva bashshila leh geriva amar lah zili ayeti li tere vutzine azalat veayetay leh tere sherage

Hadran alach rabbi eliezer
Naara hamorasa aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha

a: Hefer haav velo hefer habbaal hefer habbaal velo hefer haav eno mufar veen tzarich lomar shekkiyyem echad mehen
Gema hayenu resha aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha mahu detema o aviha o valah katane ka mashma lan
Veen tzarich lomar shekkiyyem echad mehen lema li lemitna hashta yesh lomar hefer ze belo ze velo kelum kiyyem echad mehen lema li tzericha lemitne
Ki itzterich leh kegon dehefer echad mehen vekiyyem echad vechazar hamkayyem venishal al hakamato mahu detema may deoki ha akreh ka mashma lan dimfirin shenehem bevat achat
Venaara hamorasa aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha menalan amar rabba amar kera veim hao tihye leish undareha aleha mikkan lenaara hamorasa sheaviha uvalah mefirin nedareha ema hay kera binsua ketiv
I mishshum nesua kera acharina ketiv veim bet ishah nadara ema tarvayehu binsua vechi tema tere kerae binsua lema li lememar sheen habbaal mefer bekodmin
b: Velav mimmela shamatte minah
Ibaet ema dahavaya kiddushin mashma
Ema av lechodeh mefer im ken veasra issar bet aviha yani otah lema li hashta yesh lomar bimkom arus mefer av lechodeh shello bimkom arus mibaya
Ema av live arus vearus lechodeh mefer vechi tema av dichtav rachamana lema li mibe leh dei hekim hekim
Im ken bet ishah nadara lemay ketiv kal vachomer uma bimkom av arus mefer lechodeh shello bimkom av mibaya
Ema im bet ishah nadara lomar sheen habbaal mefer bekodmin
Umineh arus mefer bekodmin
Ella lav mishshum shuttafuteh deav

a: Deve rabbi yishmael tana ben ish leishto ben av levitto mikkan lenaara hamorasa sheaviha uvalah mefirin nedareha ultana deve rabbi yishmael im hao tihye leish may aved leh
Mokem leidach derava verava hay detane deve rabbi yishmael may aved leh mibe leh lomar shehabbaal mefer nedarim shebbeno levenah
Ibaya lehu baal migaz gayez o miklash kalesh hecha ka mibaya lan kegon dindara mitteren zetin ushma arus vehefer lah vaachaltinnun
I amrinan migaz gayez lakya i amrinan miklash kalesh isura bealma hu may

Ta shema ematay amru met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav bizman shello shama habbaal kodem sheyyamut o sheshshama veshatak o sheshshama vehefer umet bo bayyom zo hi sheshshaninu met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav
b: Aval im shama vekiyyem o sheshshama veshatak umet bayyom shelleacharav en yachol lehafer

Shama aviha vehefer lah velo hispik baal lishmoa ad shemmet haav zo hi sheshshaninu met haav lo nitrokna reshut labbaal shama balah vehefer lah velo hispik haav lishmoa ad shemmet habbaal zo hi sheshshaninu met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav
Shama balah vehefer lah velo hispik haav lishmoa ad shemmet en habbaal yachol lehafer sheen habbaal mefer ella beshuttafut

a: Shama aviha vehefer lah velo hispik habbaal lishmoa ad shemmet chozer haav umefer chelko shel baal amar rabbi natan hen hen divre bet shammay bet hillel omrim en yachol lehafer
Shema minah levet shammay migaz gayez levet hillel miklash kalesh shema minah
Bae rava yesh sheela behakem o en sheela behakem im timtza lomar yesh sheela behakem yesh sheela behafer o en sheela behafer
Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan nishalin al hehakem veen nishalin al hehafer
Bae rabba kayyam lichi kayyam lichi venishal al hakama rishona mahu
Ta shema deamar rava im nishal al harishona sheniyya chala alav bae rabba kayyam lichi umufar lichi vela techul hakama ella im ken chala hafara mahu
b: Ta shema mippelugta derabbi meir verabbi yose ditnan hare zo temurat ola temurat shelamim hare zo temurat ola divre rabbi meir verabbi yose omer im lechach nitkaven mittechilla hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keechad devarav kayyamin
Vaafilu rabbi meir la kaamar dela amar la techul zo ella im ken chala zo aval hacha deamar lo techul hakama ella im ken chala hafara rabbi meir name mode dahafara chala
Bae rabba kayyam umufar lichi bevat achat mahu ta shema deamar rabba kol davar sheeno beze achar ze afilu bevat achat eno
Bae rabba kayyam lichi hayyom mahu mi amrinan keman daamar lah mufar lichi lemachar o dilma ha la amar lah

a: Im timtza lomar ha la amar lah amar lah mufar lichi lemachar mahu mi amrinan limchar la matze mefar deha kayemeh lenidrah hayyom o dilma kevan dela amar lah kayyam lichi hayyom ki kaamar lah mufar lichi lemachar mehayyom kaamar
Veim timtza lomar afilu hachi kevan dekiyemo hayyom limchar keman deiteh dame amar lah kayyam lichi shaa mahu mi amrinan keman daamar lah mufar lichi leachar shaa dame o dilma ha la amar lah
Im timtza lomar ha la amar lah mihu amar lah may mi amrinan kevan dekiyemo kiyemo o dilma kevan dechulleh yoma bar hakama uvar hafara hu ki amar mufar lichi leachar shaa mahne

Ta shema hareni nezira veshama balah veamar vaani en yachol lehafer veammay nema vaani deamar hu al nafsheh dehave nazir aval hareni nezira dilah deshaa achat kayema leachar shaa i bae lefar ammay en yachol lehafer lav mishshum dechevan shekkiyemo kiyemo la kasavar kol vaani keman deamar kayyam lichi leolam dame
Matni met haav lo nitrokna reshut labbaal met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav baze yippa koach haav mikkoach habbaal
Bedavar acher yippa koach habbaal mikkoach haav shehabbaal mefer bivgar vehaav eno mefer bivgar
Gema may tama deamar kera binureha bet aviha
Met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav menalan amar rabba deamar kera veim hao tihye leish undareha aleha
b: Makkish kodme havaya sheniyya lekodme havaya rishona ma kodme havaya rishona av mefar lechodeh af kodme havaya sheniyya av mefar lechodeh
Ema hane mile bindarim shello niru laarus aval bindarim shenniru laarus la matze mefar av
I bindarim shello niru laarus mibbinureha bet aviha nafka
Baze yippa koach haav mikkoach habbaal ku hechi dame
Ilema shekkidshah keshehi naara uvagra mikkede mita motzia uvagrut motzia mershut av ma mita lo nitrokna reshut labbaal af bagrut lo nitrokna reshut labbaal
Ella shekkidshah keshehi bogeret ha tenena chada zimna habbogeret sheshshahata shenem asar chodesh
Ha gufa kashya amratte habbogeret sheshshahata shenem asar chodesh bevogeret lema li shenem asar chodesh bogeret bishloshim yom saggi lah tane bogeret vesheshshahata shenem asar chodesh
Mikkol makom kashya ibaet ema hacha daveka uvogeret katane hatam mishshum devae iploge rabbi eliezer verabbanan
Ibaet ema bogeret daveka veayede denasev resha baze nasev sefa name baze

a: Matni nadra vehi arusa nitgarsha bo bayyom nitarsa bo bayyom afilu lemea aviha uvalah haacharon mefirin nedareha ze hakkelal kol shello yatza lirshut atzmah shaa achat aviha uvalah haacharon mefirin nedareha

Gema menalan dearus acharon mefer nedarim shenniru learus rishon amar shemuel amar kera veim hao tihye leish undareha aleha nedarim shehau aleha kevar dilma hane mile shello niru learus rishon aval nedarim shenniru learus rishon la matze mefar arus acharon
Aleha kera yattira hu

Tanya keoteh dishmuel naara hamorasa aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha ketzad shama aviha vehefer lah velo hispik habbaal lishmoa ad shemmet venitarsa bo bayyom vaafilu mea peamim aviha uvalah haacharon mefirin nedareha shama balah vehefer lah velo hispik haav lishmoa ad shemmet habbaal chozer haav umefer chelko shel baal
Amar rabbi natan hen hen divre bet shammay aval bet hillel omrim en yachol lehafer bemay peligi
b: Bet shammay savri nedarim name sherauy laarus nitrokna reshut laav umigaz gayez bet hillel savri aviha uvalah acharon mefirin nedareha vela migaz gayez
Ibaya lehu gerushin kishtika damya o kahakama damya
Lemay nafka minah kegon shennadra veshama balah vegershah veahderah beomeh i amar mar kishtika dame matze mefar lah vei amar mar kahakama dame la matze mefar lah

a: Ta shema ematay amru met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav bizman shello shama habbaal o shama vehefer o shama veshatak umet bo bayyom vei amratte gerushin kishtika damu litne name o shama vegerash middela tane hachi shema minah gerushin kahakama damu

Ema sefa aval im shama vekayyam o shama veshatak umet beom shel acharav en yachol lehafer vei amratte gerushin kahakama damu litne veim shama vegeresh ella middela katane hachi shema minah gerushin kishtika damu
Ella meha leka lemishma mineh i resha daveka nasev sefa mishshum resha i sefa daveka nasev resha mishshum sefa

Ta shema nadra vehi arusa venitgarsha venitarsa bo bayyom afilu lemea aviha uvalah haacharon mefirin nedareha shema minah gerushin kishtika damu dei kahakama damu mi matze mefar arus acharon nidre deokem arus rishon
Hacha bemay askinan beshello shama arus rishon i hachi may irya bo bayyom afilu leachar mea yamim name
Keshello shama arus veshama haav devo bayyom hu dematze mefar aval mikkan veelach lo matze mefar
Ta shema nadra bo bayyom gershah vehechzirah bo bayyom en yachol lehafer shema minah gerushin kahakama damu
Amri hacha binsua askinan vehayenu tama deen yachol lehafer mishshum deen habbaal mefer bekodmin
b: Matni derech talmide chachamim ad shello hayeta bitto yotza meetzlo omer lah kol nedarim shennadarte betoch beti hare hen mufarin vechen habbaal ad shello tikkanes lirshuto omer lah kol nedarim shennadarte ad shello tikkansi lirshuti hare hen mufarin shemmishshettikkanes lirshuto eno yachol lehafer
Gema bae rame bar chama baal mahu sheyyafer belo shemia veshama ishah daveka hu o lav daveka hu
Amar rava ta shema derech talmide chachamim ad shello yatzat bitto meetzlo omer lah kol nedarim shennadarte betoch beti hare hen mufarin veha la shema
Lechi shama hu demefar im ken ki la shema lema leh lememar ha kamashma lan orcheh detzurba merabbanan lehaddore
Ta shema missefa vechen habbaal ad shello tikkanes lirshuto omer lah hacha name deamar lah lechi shamana
Ta shema haomer leishto kol nedarim shettiddori ad sheavo mimmakom peloni hare hen kayyamin lo amar kelum hare hen mufarin rabbi eliezer omer mufar veha la shema
Hacha name deamar lechi shamana ulma li min hashta lechi shama lefar lah kasavar dilma mitteridna hahi shata

Ta shema haomer leappotroppos kol nedarim shennoderet ishti mikkan vead sheavo mimmakom peloni hafer vehefer leh yachol yehu mufarin talmud lomar ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu divre rabbi yoshiyya
Amar lo rabbi yonatan matzinu bechol hattora kullah shelucho shel adam kemoto
Vaafilu rabbi yoshiyya la kaamar ella mishshum digzerat hakkatuv hu ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu aval dechulle alma shelucho shel adam kemoto veha la shemia leh

a: Hacha name deamar leh lechi shamana mefar lah lechi shama lefar lah hu savar dilma mitteridna
Bae rame bar chama cheresh mahu sheyyafer leishto im timtza lomar baal mefer belo shemia mishshum devar mishma hu aval cheresh delav bar mishma hu hayenu derabbi zera
Deamar rabbi zera kol harauy levila en bila meakkevet bo vechol sheen rauy levila bila meakkevet bo
O dilma veshama ishah la meakkev amar rava ta shema veshama ishah perat leeshet cheresh shema minah
Ibaya lehu baal mahu sheyyafer lishte nashav bevat achat otah daveka o lav daveka
Amar ravina ta shema en mashkin shette sotot keachat mippene shellibbah gas bachavertah
Rabbi yehuda omer lo min hashshem hu ze ella mishshum shenneemar vehishkah otah levaddah
b: Matni bogeret sheshshahata shenem asar chodesh vealmana sheloshim yom rabbi eliezer omer hoil uvalah chayyav bimzonoteha yafer vachachamim omrim en habbaal mefer ad shettikkanes lirshuto

Gema amar rabba rabbi eliezer umishna rishona amru davar echad ditnan notnin labbetula shenem asar chodesh lefarnes atzmah higgia shenem asar chodesh ochelet mishshello veochelet bitruma aval hayyavam eno maachil bitruma

Asta shishsha chodashim bifne habbaal veshishsha chodashim bifne hayyavam vaafilu kullan bifne habbaal chaser yom echad o kullan bifne hayyavam chaser yom echad enah ochelet bitruma zo mishna rishona bet din shel acharehem amru en haishsha ochelet bitruma ad shettikkanes lachuppa
Amar leh abbaye dilma la hi ad kan la ka ashmeinan mishna rishona ella lemechal bitruma derabbanan aval nedarim deorayeta ema la
Vead kan la shamatte leh lerabbi eliezer ella gabbe nedarim kidrav pinchas mishshemeh derava deamar kol hannoderet al daat balah hi noderet aval teruma afilu midderabbanan name la achla

a: Matni shomeret yavam ben leyavam echad ben lishne yevamin rabbi eliezer omer yafer rabbi yehoshua omer leechad aval lo lishnayim rabbi akiva omer lo leechad velo lishnayim
Amar rabbi eliezer ma im ishsha shekkana hu leatzmo hare hu mefer nedareha ishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim eno din sheyyafer nedareha
Amar lo rabbi akiva lo im amarta beishsha shekkana hu leatzmo sheen laacherim bah reshut tomar beishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim sheyyesh laacherim bah reshut
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua akiva devarecha bishne yevamin ma atta meshiv al yavam echad amar lo en hayevama gemura layyavam keshem shehaarusa gemura leishah
Gema bishlama rabbi akiva savar en zika verabbi yehoshua savar yesh zika ella rabbi eliezer may tameh i yesh zika en berera
Amar rabbi amme kegon sheasa bah maamar verabbi eliezer savar lah kevet shammay deamri maamar kone kinyan gamur
Verabbi yehoshua omer lecha hane mile bechad yavam aval bishne yevamin la mi ika mide dechi ate achuhi asar aleh bevia o begita umefer verabbi akiva savar en zika
Ulrabbi eliezer elazar deamar maamar levet shammay en kone ella lidchot batztzara may ika lememar
Hacha bemay askinan kegon sheamad baddin veitchayyev lah mezonot vechidrav pinchas mishshemeh derava deamar kol hannoderet al daat balah hi noderet
b: Tenan amar rabbi eliezer uma im ishsha shekkana leatzmo hare hu mefer nedareha ishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim eno din shemmefer nedareha vei besheasa bah maamar kana leatzmo hu shekkana leatzmo al yede shamayim
Tifshot devae rabba maamar levet shammay erusin ose o nissuin ose tifshot denissuin ose dei erusin ose ha tenan naara hamorasa aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak may yafer yafer beshuttafut
Tanya name hachi kerabbi amme shomeret yavam ben yavam echad ben shene yevamin rabbi eliezer omer yafer verabbi yehoshua omer leechad velo lishnayim rabbi akiva omer lo leechad velo lishnayim

Amar rabbi eliezer uma im ishsha sheen lo chelek bah ad shello tavo lirshuto mishshebbat lirshuto nigmera lo ishsha sheyyesh lo chelek ad shello tavo lirshuto mishshebbat lirshuto eno din shettigmor lo

Amar lo rabbi akiva lo im amarta beishsha shekkana hu leatzmo shekkeshem sheen lo chelek bah kach en laacherim chelek bah tomar beishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim shekkeshem sheyyesh lo immah chelek kach yesh laacherim chelek bah

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua akiva devarecha bishne yevamin ma atta meshiv al yavam echad amar lo kelum chillaknu al yavam echad veal shene yevamin ben sheasa bah maamar ben shello asa bah maamar vechishar devarim ken nedarim
Ballashon hazze amar ben azzay chaval alecha ben azzay shello shimashta et rabbi akiva
May

a: Tanya keoteh derabbi amme dekatane ben sheasa bah maamar uven shello asa bah maamar
I name meresha dekatane mishshennichnesa lirshuto nigmera lo vei dela kaddesh may nigmera lo tifshot mineh kesheasa bah maamar
May vechishar devarim ken nedarim dekatane amar rava hachi katane i atta mode sheen chayyavin sekila kenaara hamorasa
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka en yevama gemura leishah keshem shearusa gemura leishah

Matni haomer leishto kol hannedarim shettiddori mikkan ad sheavo mimmakom peloni hare hen kayyamin lo amar kelum hare hen mufarin rabbi eliezer omer mufar vachachamim omrim eno mufar amar rabbi eliezer im hefer nedarim shebbau lichlal isur lo yafer nedarim shello bau lichlal isur
Amru lo hare hu omer ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu et shebba lichlal hakem ba lichlal hafer lo ba lichlal hakem lo ba lichlal hafer
Gema ibaya lehu lerabbi eliezer mechal chalin uvatlin o dilma la chalin kelal lemay nafka minah
b: Kegon deatpes acharina behaden nidra i amratte chalin haveya tefisuta i amratte la chalin la ika meshasha
May ta shema amar rabbi eliezer im hefer nedarim shebbau lichlal isur lo yafer nedarim shello bau lichlal isur shema minah la chalin
Mi katane sheenan bain shello bau katane adayin lo bau

Ta shema amar lahen rabbi eliezer uma bimkom sheen mefer nidre atzmo mishshennadar mefer nidre atzmo ad shello yadur mekom shemmefer nidre ishto mishshettiddor eno din sheyyafer nidre ishto ad shello tiddor
May lav deishto dumya dileh ma hu dela chayelin af ishto name dela chayelin la ha kidita veha kidita

Ta shema amru lo lerabbi eliezer uma mikve shemmaale et hattemein mittumatan en matztzil al hattehorim millitame adam sheen maale et hattemein mittumatan eno din hu shello yatztzil al hattehorin millitame
Shema minah la chayelin

a: Ema sefa amru lo lerabbi eliezer im matbilin keli tame litaher yatbilu keli lichsheyyitma litaher shema minah chayelin
Amri rabbanan la kayemi lehon betameh derabbi eliezer vehachi kaamri leh may sevira lach i sevira lach dechayelin uvatlin tihve keli teuvtach i la sevira lach dechayelin tihve mikve teuvtach
Ta shema amar lahem rabbi eliezer uma zeraim temeim kevan shezzeraan bekarka tehorin zeruin veomdim lo kol shekken shema minah la chayelin
Verabbanan la darshi kal vachomer veha tanya yachol yimkor adam et bitto keshehi naara amratte kal vachomer mechura kevar yotza enah mechura eno din shello timacher
b: In bealma darshi kal vachomer veshane hacha deamar kera ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu et shebba lichlal hakem ba lichlal hafer et shello ba lichlal hakem lo ba lichlal hafer
Matni hafarat nedarim kol hayyom yesh baddavar lehakel ulhachamir
Ketzad nadra belele shabbat yafer belele shabbat uvom hashshabbat ad shettechshach nadra im chashecha mefer ad shello techshach sheim chashcha velo hefer eno yachol lehafer
Gema tanya hafarat nedarim kol hayyom rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon amru meet leet may tama detanna kamma amar kera beom shomo
Verabbanan may tamayehu dichtiv miyyom el yom
Ultanna kamma ha ketiv miyyom el yom itzterich dei beom shomo hava amena bimama in belelya la ketiv miyyom el yom
Ulman deamar miyyom el yom ha ketiv beom shomo itzterich dei ketiv miyyom el yom hava amena mechad beshabba lechad beshabba lefar lah ketiv beom shomo
Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi en halacha keoto hazzug levi savar lemibad kehane tannae amar leh rav hachi amar chavivi en halacha keoto hazzug
Chiyya bar rav shade gira uvadek rabba bar rav huna yatev vekaem

a: Tenan hatam mefirin nedarim beshabbat venishalin lindarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat ibaya lehu mefirin nedarim beshabbat letzorech hashshabbat o dilma afilu shello letzorech

Ta shema detane rav zute deve rav pappe en mefirin nedarim ella letzorech hashshabbat amar rav ashe ha la tenan hachi nadra im chashecha mefer lah ad shello techshach vei amratte letzorech hashshabbat in shello letzorech hashshabbat la may irya chashcha afilu betoch hayyom eno yachol lehafer deshello letzorech
Tannae hi hafarat nedarim kol hayyom rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon amru meet leet
Leman deamar kol hayyom in tefe la afilu shello letzorech hashshabbat mefer leman deamar meet leet letzorech hashshabbat in shello letzorech hashshabbat la

Venishalin lindarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat ibaya lehu keshello haya lahem penay o dilma keshehaya lahem penay ta shema deizdekiku leh rabbanan livreh derav zutra bereh derav zeera afilu bindarim shehaya lahem penay mibbeod yom
Savar rav yosef lememar nishalin nedarim beshabbat beyachid mumche in bishlosha hedotot la mishshum demitchaze kedina
Amar leh abbaye kevan disvira lan afilu meummad afilu bikrovim vaafilu ballayela la mitchaze kedina
Amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav halacha mefirin nedarim ballayela veha matnitin hi nadra belele shabbat ella ema halacha nishalin ballayela
Amar leh rabbi abba lerav huna amar rav hachi amar leh ishtik amar leh ishtik ka amratte o shate kaamratte
Amar rav ika bar avin izdekik leh rav lerabba
b: Bekitona deve rav omed yechidi uvallayela
Amar rabba amar rav nachman halacha nishalin nedarim omed yechidi uvallayela uvashshabbat uvikrovim vaafilu haya lahen penay mibbeod yom

Omed vehatanya yarad rabban gamliel min hachamor venitattef veyashav vehittir lo nidro rabban gamliel savar potchin bacharata mikar nidra bainan uvae ayyone ahachi yashav verav nachman savar en potchin bacharata vaafilu meummad

Amar leh rava lerav nachman chazi mar hay merabbanan daata mimmareva veamar izdekiku leh rabbanan livreh derav huna bar avin ushro leh nidreh vaamaru leh zil uvi rachame al nafshach dachatat detane rav dimi achuh derav safra kol hannoder af al pi shehu mekayemo nikra chote amar rav zevid may kera vechi techdal lindor lo yihye vecha chet ha lo chadalta ika chet
Tanya haomer leishto kol nedarim shettiddori i efshi shettiddori en ze neder lo amar kelum yafe asit veen kemotech veim lo nadarte maddirech ani devarav kayyamin
Lo yomar adam leishto beshabbat mufar lichi batel lichi kederech sheomer lah bachol ella omer lah teli veichli teli ushti vehanneder batel meelav amar rabbi yochanan vetzarich sheyevattel belibbo
Tanya bet shammay omrim bashshabbat mevattel belibbo bachol motzi bisfatav uvet hillel omrim echad ze veechad ze mevattel belibbo veen tzarich lehotzi bisfatav
Amar rabbi yochanan chacham sheamar bilshon baal uvaal sheamar bilshon chacham la amar kelum
Detanya ze haddavar hechacham mattir veen baal mattir sheyyachol uma chacham sheen mefer mattir baal shemmefer eno din shemmattir talmud lomar

a: Ze haddavar chacham mattir veen baal mattir tanya idach ze haddavar baal mefer veen chacham mefer sheyyachol uma baal sheen mattir mefer chacham shemmattir eno din shemmefer talmud lomar ze haddavar baal mefer veen chacham mefer

Neemar kan ze haddavar veneemar lehallan ze haddavar bishchute chutz ma bishchute chutz aharon uvanav vechol yisrael af parashat nedarim aharon uvanav vechol yisrael uma kan rashe hammattot af lehallan rashe hammattot
Befarashat nedarim lemay hilcheta amar rav acha bar yaakov lehachshir shelosha hedotot veha rashe hammattot ketiv amar rav chisda veitema rabbi yochanan beyachid mumche
Rashe hammattot bishchute chutz lemay hilcheta amar rav sheshet lomar sheyyesh sheela behekdesh
Levet shammay deamar en sheela behekdesh rashe hammattot dichtiv bishchute chutz lemay hilcheta bet shammay let lehu gezera shava
Ze haddavar befarashat nedarim lemay ketiv lomar chacham mattir veen baal mattir baal mefer veen chacham mefer
Ze haddavar bishchute chutz lemay ketiv lomar al hashshechita chayyav veen chayyav al hammelika
Ella levet shammay lehachshir shelosha hedotot menalan nafka lehu midderav assi bar natan

Dichtiv vayedabber moshe et moade Adonai el bene yisrael vehatanya rabbi yose haggelili omer moade neemru velo neemra shabbat bereshit immahen ben azzay omer moade neemru velo neemar parashat nedarim immahen
Rav assi bar natan kashya leh ha matnita ata linhardea lekammeh derav sheshet vela ashkecheh ata abbatreh lemachoza amar leh moade Adonai neemru velo neemra shabbat bereshit immahen
Veha ketiv shabbat immahen vetu moade Adonai neemru velo neemra parashat nedarim immahen veha missitra ketiva amar leh hachi katane
b: Moade Adonai tzerichin kidush bet din shabbat bereshit en tzericha kidush bet din
Moade Adonai tzerichin mumche veen parashat nedarim tzerichin mumche afilu bet din hedotot
Veha befarashat nedarim rashe hammattot ketiv amar rav chisda veitema rabbi yochanan beyachid mumche

Amar rabbi chanina hashshotek al menat lemekat mefer afilu mikkan vead asara yamim metiv rava ematay amru met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav bizman shello shama habbaal o sheshshama veshatak o sheshshama vehefer umet bo bayyom aval shama vekiyyem o sheshshama veshatak umet bayyom shel acharav en yachol lehafer
May lav beshotek al menat lemekat lo beshotek al menat lekayyem i hachi hayenu o shama vekiyyem ella beshotek setam
Metiv rav chisda chomer behakem mibbehafer uvhafer mibbehakem chomer behakem

a: Shehashshetika mekayyemet veen shetika mevattelet kiyyem belibbo kayyam hefer belibbo eno mufar kiyyem en yachol lehafer hefer en yachol lekayyem katane shehashshetika mekayyemet may lav beshotek al menat lemekat
Lo beshotek al menat lekayyem hayenu kiyyem belibbo kayyam ella beshotek setam
Ashkechan chomer behakem mibbehafer behafer mibbehakem mena lan amar rabbi yochanan nishalin al hehakem veen nishalin al hehafer
Metiv rav kahana veim hacharesh yacharish lah ishah vego beshotek al menat lemekat hakkatuv medabbar atta omer beshotek al menat lemekat o eno ella beshotek al menat lekayyem
Keshehu omer ki hecherish lah hare beshotek al menat lekayyem hakkatuv medabber ha ma ani mekayyem im hacharesh yacharish lah ishah beshotek al menat lemekat hakkatuv medabber teuvta
Velokem ha beshotek al menat lekayyem ha beshotek setam kerae yattiri ketivi
Metiv rava nadra im chashecha mefer lah ad shello chashcha sheim lo hefer vechashcha eno yachol lehafer ammay leheve keshotek al menat lemekat teuvta
Metiv rav ashe yodea ani sheyyesh nedarim aval eni yodea sheyyesh mefirin yafer yodea ani sheyyesh mefirin aval eni yodea shezze neder rabbi meir omer lo yafer vachachamim omrim yafer
Veammay leheve keshotek al menat lemekat teuvta
Hadran alach naara hamorasa
Veellu nedarim shehu mefer devarim sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh im erchatz veim lo erchatz im etkashshet veim lo etkashshet
b: Amar rabbi yose en ellu nidre innuy nefesh veellu hen nidre innuy nefesh amra kunam perot haolam alay hare ze yachol lehafer perot medina zo alay yavi lah mimmedina acheret perot chenoni ze alay eno yachol lehafer veim lo hayeta parnasato ella mimmennu hare ze yafer divre rabbi yose
Gema nidre innuy nefesh hu demefer sheen bahen innuy nefesh eno mefer veha tanya ben ish leishto ben av levitto melammed shehabbaal mefer nedarim shebbeno levenah

Amri halen vehalen mefer mihu innuy nefesh mefer leolam aval en bahen innuy nefesh kiditah techoteh haveya hafara mikki megaresh lah chayel alah nidrah bidvarim shebbeno levenah sheen bahen innuy nefesh aval yesh bahen innuy nefesh la chayel alah nidrah
Udvarim sheen bahen innuy nefesh ki megaresh lah chayela alah veha tenan rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer yafer shemma yegarshenna uthe asura lo alma ki megaresh lah umefar lah meikara haveya hafara

Amri halen vehalen haveya hafara ella nidre innuy nefesh mefer ben leatzmo uven laacherim en bahen innuy nefesh leatzmo mefer laacherim eno mefer vehachi katane ellu nedarim shehu mefer ben leatzmo uven laacherim nedarim sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh
Im erchatz hechi kaamar ilema deamra kunam perot olam alay im erchatz lema leh hafara la tirchatz vela litasran perot olam ellu alah
Veod beha lema rabbi yose en ellu nidre innuy nefesh dilma rachatza veitasru perot olam alah

a: Veella deamra kunam hanaat rechitza alay leolam im erchatz mishshum hachi mefer lah dehechi taaved tirchatz mittasra hanaat rechitza alah la tirchatz it lah niuula verabbi yose savar efshar dela rachatza ulniuul la chayeshinan
I hachi litne hachi rabbi yose omer tenay ze en bo innuy nefesh
Ella deamra hanaat rechitza alay leolam im erchatz hayyom verabbi yose savar niuul dechad yoma la shemeh niuul
b: Shannet im erchatz im lo erchatz hechi dame illema deamra titsar hanaat rechitza leolam alay im lo erchatz hayyom lema lah hafara titseche amar rav yehuda deamra hanaat rechitza alay leolam im lo erchatz beme mishra
Dichoteh dekatane im lo etkashshet im lo etkashshet benefte lichluch hu
Amar rav yehuda deamra hanaat rechitza leolam alay im erchatz hayyom ushvua shello erchatz hanaat kishut alay leolam im etkashshet hayyom ushvua shello etkashshet
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe hay ellu nedarim ushvuot mibe leh lemitne amar leh teni ellu nedarim ushvuot veibaet ema shevuot name hayenu nedarim ditnan kenidre reshaim nadar benazir uvkorban uvishvua

Vaamaru rabbanan rechitza it bah innuy nefesh ki la rachatza urminhi af al pi sheasur bechullan en anush karet ella beochel veshote veose melacha bilvad vei amratte ki la rachatza ika innuy beom hakkipurim ki rachatz lichayyav karet

Amar rava meinyana dikra gabbe yom hakkipurim dichtiv teannu et nafshotechem milta deyada inuya hashta rechitza la yada inuya hashta gabbe nedarim dichtiv kol neder vechol shevuat issar leannot nafesh milta deatya leh lide innuy vechi la rachatza atya lide innuy

Verame derabbi yose adderabbi yose mayan shel bene hair chayyehen vechayye acherim chayyehen kodmin lechayye acherim behemtam uvehemat acherim behemtam kodemet levehemat acherim kevisatan uchvisat acherim kevisatan kodemet lichvisat acherim chayye acherim uchvisatan chayye acherim kodmin lichvisatan
Rabbi yose omer kevisatan kodemet lechayye acherim hashta kevisa amar rabbi yose yesh bah tzaar

a: Guf kullo lo kol shekken amri in kevisa allima lerabbi yose deamar shemuel hay arbuvita deresha matya lide avira arbuvita demane matya lide shamumita arbuvita degufa matya lide shichne vechive
Shelachu mittam hizzaharu bearbuvita hizzaharu bachavura hizzaharu bivne aniyyim shemmehen tetze tora shenneemar yizzal mayim middallav shemmehen tetze tora

Umippene ma en metzuyin talmide chachamim latzet talmide chachamim mibbenehen amar rav yosef shello yomru tora yerushsha hi lahem rav sheshet bereh derav idi omer kede shello yitgadderu al hatztzibbur mar zutra omer mippene shehen mitgabberin al hatztzibbur rav ashe omer mishshum dekaru leinashe chamare
Ravina omer sheen mevarchin battora techilla deamar rav yehuda amar rav may dichtiv mi haish hechacham veyaven et zot davar ze nishal lachachamim velanneviim velo pershuhu
Ad sheppersho hakkadosh baruch hu beatzmo dichtiv vayyomer Adonai al ozvam et torati vego hayenu lo shamu bekoli hayenu lo halchu bah amar rav yehuda amar rav sheen mevarchin battora techilla

Isi bar yehuda la ata limtivta derabbi yose telata yome ashkecheh vardimos berabbi yose amar leh may tama la ate mar leve midresha deabba ha telata yomin amar leh ki tameh daavuch la yadana hecha etay amar leh lema mar may kaamar leh dilma yadana tameh amar leh ha detanya rabbi yose omer kevisatan kodmin lechayye acherim kera menalan
Amar leh dichtiv umigreshehem yihu livhemtam vego may chayyatam ilema chayya vahalo chayya bichlal behema hi ella may chayyatam chayyuta mammash peshita ella lav kevisa deha ika tzara dearbuvita

Amar rabbi yose en ellu nidre inuy nefesh ibaya lehu lerabbi yose mahu sheyyafer mishshum devarim shebbeno levenah ta shema amar rabbi yose en ellu nidre inuy nefesh aval devarim shebbeno levenah havayin
Dilma ledidhu kaamar lehu ledidi afilu devarim shebbeno levenah la havayin ledidchu deamritu havayin nidre inuy nefesh odo li deen ellu nidre inuy nefesh
May rav adda bar ahava omer mefer rav huna omer en mefer
b: Shello matzinu shual shemmet baafar pir

Tanya keoteh derav adda bar ahava devarim sheyyesh bahen inuy nefesh mefer ben beno levenah ben benah leven acherim sheen bahen inuy nefesh beno levenah mefer benah leven acherim eno mefer ketzad amra kunam perot alay hare ze yafer kunam sheeni osa lefi abba lefi achicha lefi avicha lefi achi veshello etten teven lifne behemtecha umayim lifne bekarecha en yachol lehafer
Shello echchol shello efkos veshello ashammesh mittati yafer mishshum devarim shebbeno levenah
Shello atztzia lach mittatecha veshello emzog lecha et hakkos veshello erchatz lach panecha yadecha veraglecha en tzarich lehafer
Rabban gamliel omer yafer shenneemar lo yachel devaro davar acher lo yachel devaro mikkan lechacham sheen mattir nidre atzmo
Man shaminan deamar shello echchol veshello efkos devarim shebbeno levenah havayin rabbi yose vekatane demefar mishshum devarim shebbeno levenah

Amar mar veshello ashammesh mittati yafer mishshum devarim shebbeno levenah hechi dame ilema deamra hanaat tashmishi alecha lema li hafara ha meshubedet leh ella beomeret hanaat tashmishcha alay vechidrav kahana
Deamar rav kahana hanaat tashmishi alecha kofah umshammashto hanaat tashmishcha alay yafer sheen maachilin et haadam davar haasur lo

Man tena ha detanya devarim hammuttarim vaacherim nahagu bahen isur i atta rashshay linhog bahem heter kede levattelan mishshum shenneemar lo yachel devaro davar acher lo yachel devaro mikkan letalmid chacham sheen mefer nidre atzmo manni rabban gamliel hi
Bea mineh rava merav nachman tashmish hammitta lerabbanan inuy nefesh hu o devarim shebbeno levenah amar leh tenetuha untula ani min hayehudim

a: Yafer chelko umshammashto uthe netula min hayehudim vei amratte neder innuy nefesh have ammay tehe netula min hayehudim shema minah devarim shebbeno levenah havayin

Lerabbanan tibbee lach mishshum dintula ani min hayehudim rabbi yose katane lah deamar rav huna kulleh pirkin rabbi yose hi mimmay kevan dekatane rabbi yose omer en ellu nidre inuy nefesh lema leh tu lemitne hare ze yafer divre rabbi yose shema minah mikkan veelach rabbi yose hi
Amar shemuel mishshemeh delevi kol nedarim baal mefer leishto chutz min hanaati al peloni sheeno mefer aval hanaat peloni alay mefer
Tenan perot medina zo alay yavi lah mimmedina acheret amar rav yosef dekaamra shettavi
Ta shema perot chenvani ze alay en yachol lehafer hacha name deka amra shettavi atta
Lo hayeta parnasato ella mimmennu hare ze yafer vei amratte deka amra shettavi atta ammay yafer ella middesefa dela mayete baal have resha deka mayeta hi
Ella resha en yachol lehafer udka mayeta hi
b: Umatnitin rabbi yose hi deamar rav huna kulleh pirkin rabbi yose hi umay en yachol lehafer mishshum inuy nefesh aval mefer nedarim shebbeno levenah

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel nadra mishte chikkarot beachat mitanna uvachat en mitanna mittoch shehu mefer lammitanna mefer lesheeno mitanna verav assi amar rabbi yochanan mefer lammitanna veen mefer lesheen mitanna
Veika deamri bea mineh rav assi merabbi yochanan nadra mishte chikkarot beachat mitanna uvachat en mitanna mahu amar leh mefer lammitanna veen mefer lesheen mitanna
Etiveh haishsha shennadra benazir vehayeta shote yayin umittammea lemetim

a: Hare zo sofeget et haarbaim hefer lah balah vehi lo yada shehefer lah vehayeta shota yayin umitammeah lemetim enah sofeget et haarbaim
Vei amratte mefer lammitanna veen mefer lesheen mitanna dilma min yayin deit lah tzaara hefer lah min chartzan umin zag lo hefer lah deha la it lah tzaara vetispog et haarbaim
Amar rav yosef en nezirut lachatzain
Amar leh abbaye ha korban lachatzi nezirut ika ella amar abbaye en nezirut lachatzain veen korban lachatzain
Metivi haishsha shennadra benazir vehifrisha behemtah veachar kach hefer lah balah mevia chattat haof veenah mevia olat haof vei amratte en korban lachatzi nezirut ammay mevia chattat haof
Veella may yesh korban lachatzi nezirut shalosh behemot bae leetoye chattat ola ushlamim ella leolam en korban lachatzi nezirut vechattat haof dematya mishshum dechattat al hassafek
Etiveh haishsha shennadra benazir venitmet veachar kach hefer lah balah mevia chattat haof veen mevia olat haof vei amratte mefer lammitanna veen mefer lesheen mitanna
b: Dilma miyyayin deit lah tzaara hefer lah mittumat met delet lah tzaara lo hefer lah
Amri mittumat met name it lah tzaara dichtiv vehachay yitten el libbo vetanya haya rabbi meir omer may dichtiv vehachay yitten el libbo deyispod yispedun leh deyivkun yivkun leh deyikbar yikberuneh
Matni kunam sheani nehene labberiyyot eno yachol lehafer vichola hi lehanot beleket shichcha uvfea
Kunam kohanim leviyyim nehenim li yittelu al korcho kohanim ellu ulviyyim ellu nehenim li yittelu acherim
Gema alma efshar demittazna middileh mikkelal devaal lav bichlal beriyyot hu ema sefa yechola lehanot beleket shichcha ufea aval middevaal la achla alma baal bichlal beriyyot hu
Amar ulla leolam lav bichlal beriyyot hu veod en yachol lehafer mippene sheyechola lehanot beleket shichcha ufea
Rava amar leolam baal bichlal beriyyot hu uma taam kaamar ma taam en yachol lehafer mippene sheyechola lehanot beleket shichcha ufea
Rav nachman amar leolam baal lav bichlal beriyyot hu vehachi katane nitgarsha yechola lehanot beleket shichcha ufea

a: Etiveh rava lerav nachman uvaal lav bichlal beriyyot hu vehatnan netula ani min hayehudim yafer chelko uthe meshammashto uthe netula min hayehudim
Vei amratte baal lav bichlal beriyyot hu nidre inuy nefesh hen veyafer lah leolam
Ema lach shane hacha demochcha milleta deal hetera kaasra nafshah
Yechola lehanot beleket shichcha ufea vela katane uvmasar ani vehatanya bevarayeta uvmasar ani
Amar rav yosef la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ha rabbanan ditnan rabbi eliezer omer en adam tzarich likrot shem al masar ani shel demay
b: Vachachamim omrim kore shem veen tzarich lehafrish may lav leman deamar sefeko tovel kasavar it leh tovat hanaa vechevan deit leh tovat hanaa la mahneya
Ulman deamar eno kore shem kasavar sefeko eno tovel vechol shessefeko eno tovel let leh tovat hanaa ushre leh leithanoye

Amar leh abbaye dechulle alma sefeko tovel verabbi eliezer verabbanan beha kamipalgi rabbi eliezer savar lo nechshedu amme haaretz al masar ani kevan deilu mafkar nichseh vehave ani veshakel leh hu let leh peseda
Verabbanan savri nichseh la mafkar inish demirtat dilma zache behu inish acharina hilkach nechshedu
Rava omer kan bemasar ani hammitchallek betoch habbayit dichtiva beh netina venatatta lallevi lagger vego mishshum hachi asur leh leithanoye
Kan bemasar ani hammitchallek betoch haggoranot kevan dichtiv beh vehinnachta bisharecha shere leh leithanoye
Kohanim ulviyyim nehenin li yittelu ku alma tovat hanaa enah mamon
Ema sefa kohanim ellu ulviyyim ellu nehenin li yittelu acherim aval lehane la alma tovat hanaa mamon

Amar rav hoshaya la kashya ha rabbi veha rabbi yose berabbi yehuda detanya haggonev tivlo shel chavero vaachalo meshallem lo deme tivlo divre rabbi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer eno meshallem ella deme chullin shebbo may lav beha kamipalgi

a: Derabbi savar tovat hanaa mamon verabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda savar tovat hanaa enah mamon
La dechulle alma tovat hanaa enah mamon ella hacha bemattanot shello hurmu ka mipalgi
Vei tovat hanaa enah mamon ma li hurmu ma li lo hurmu
Ella hayenu tama derabbi kansuh rabbanan legannav ki hechi dela lignov verabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda savar kansuh rabbanan levaal habbayit ki hechi dela lishahe letivleh
Rava amar shane teruma dehayenu tama deyittelu al korcho mishshum ditruma la chazya ella lechohanim vechevan deka ate lemesra alayehu shavveya afra bealma
Matni kunam sheeni osa al pi abba veal pi avicha veal pi achi veal pi achicha eno yachol lehafer sheeni osa al picha eno tzarich lehafer
Rabbi akiva omer yafer shemma taadif alav yoter min harauy lo
Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer yafer shemma yegarshenna uthi asura alav
Gema amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri lememra dekasavar shemuel adam makdish davar shello ba leolam urminhi hammakdish maase yede ishto
b: Hare zo osa veochelet vehammotar rabbi meir omer hekdesh rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer chullin veamar shemuel halacha kerabbi yochanan hassandelar alma en adam makdish davar shello ba leolam
Vechi tema ki kaamar halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri al haadafa hu dekaamar
Lema halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri behaadafa i name halacha ketanna kamma i name en halacha kerabbi akiva
Ella amar rav yosef shane kunnamot hoil veadam oser perot chavero alav oser name davar shello ba leolam alav
Amar leh abbaye bishlama adam oser perot chavero alav shehare adam oser perotav al chavero ella yeesor davar shello ba leolam al chavero shehare en adam oser perot chavero al chavero
Ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua beomeret yikdeshu yaday leosehen deyadayim ha itanhu baolam
Vechi amra hachi kadsha veha meshabedan yedah levaal deamra lechi miggarsha hashta mihat la miggarsha umimmay dechi amrah hachi mahneya

a: Amar rabbi ila uma ilu omer lachavero sade zo sheani mocher lecha lichsheekkachenna mimmecha tikkadesh mi la kadsha

Matkef lah rabbi yirmeya mi dame sade zo sheani mocher lecha hashta bideh hi ishsha beyadah lehakdish maase yadeha ha la dame ella laomer lachavero sade zo shemmacharti lecha lichsheekkachenna mimmecha tikkadesh mi kadsha
Matkef lah rav pappa mi dame gabbe zevina pesika miltayehu gabbe ishsha mi pesika milta ha la dame ella laomer lachavero sade zo shemmishkanti lecha lichsheefdenna mimmecha tikkadesh mi la kadsha

Matkef lah rav shisha bereh derav idi mi dame sade beyado lifdoto ishsha beyadah lehitgaresh ha la damya ella laomer lachavero sade zo shemmishkanti lecha leeser shanim lichsheefdenna mimmecha tikkadesh mi la kadsha
Matkef lah rav ashe mi dame hatam kitz ishsha mi it lah kitzuta
b: Ella amar rav ashe shane kunnamot dechi kedushshat hagguf dame vechidrava
Deamar rava hekdesh chametz veshichrur mafkiin mide shibud
I hachi lema li shemma yegarshenna teni veod shemma yegarshenna

Matni nadra ishto vesavur shennadra bitto nadra bitto vesavur shennadra ishto nadra benazir vesavur shennadra bekorban nadra bekorban vesavur shennadra benazir nadra mitteenim vesavur shennadra min haanavim nadra min haanavim vesavur shennadra min hatteenim hare ze yachzor veyafer
Gema lememra deyani otah daveka hu

a: Veha gabbe keraim dichtiv al al dichtiv al shaul veal yehonatan beno
Vetanya amru lo met aviv vekara veachar kach nimtza beno yatza yede keria
Amri la kashya ha bistam veha bimfaresh
Vehatanya amru lo met aviv vekara veachar kach nimtza beno lo yatza yede keria amru lo met lo met uchsavur aviv hu vekara veachar kach nimtza beno yatza yede keria
Rav ashe amar kan betoch kede dibbur kan leachar kede dibbur
Ha dekaamratte yatza yede keria shennimtza beno betoch kede dibbur ha deamratte lo yatza yede keria leachar kede dibbur

Vehatanya mi sheyyesh lo chole betoch beto venitallef vechimdumme shemmet vekara veachar kach met lo yatza yede keria amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara lo shanu ella shemmet leachar kede dibur aval betoch kede dibur kedibbur dame
Vehilcheta toch kede dibbur kedibbur dame chutz mimmegaddef veoved avoda zara umkaddesh umgaresh

Matni amra kunam teenim vaanavim ellu sheani toemet kiyyem litenim kullo kayyam hefer litenim eno mufar ad sheyyafer af laanavim amra kunam teena sheani toemet vaanava sheani toemet hare ellu shene nedarim
Gema manni matnitin rabbi yishmael detanya ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu amra kunam teenim vaanavim ellu sheani toemet kiyyem litenim kullo kayyam
b: Hefer litenim eno mufar ad sheyyafer af laanavim divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer hare hu omer ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu ma yekimennu mimmennu af yeferennu mimmennu verabbi yishmael mi ketiv yafer mimmennu verabbi akiva makkish hafara lahakama ma hakama mimmennu af hafara mimmennu
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva aval chachamim omrim makkish hakama lahafara ma hafara ma shehefer hefer af hakama ma shekkiyyem kiyyem
Amra kunam teena amar rava matnitin rabbi shimon hi deamar ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad
Matni yodea ani sheyyesh nedarim aval eni yodea sheyyesh mefirin yafer yodea ani sheyyesh mefirin aval eni yodea shezze neder rabbi meir omer lo yafer vachachamim omrim yafer
Gema urminhu belo reot perat lassome divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer lerabbot et hassome

a: Amar rava hacha meinyaneh dikra vehacha meinyaneh dikra rabbi yehuda savar gabbe rotzeach ketiv vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar kol devar meal leyaar vessome name bar meal leyaar hu vei amratte belo reot lerabbot et hassome miyyaar nafka leh ella shema minah belo reot perat lessome
Rabbi meir savar ketiv bivli daat kol devar mida vessome lav bar mida hu vei amratte belo reot perat lassome mibbeli daat nafka leh ella shema minah belo reot lerabbot et hassome
Matni hammaddir hanaa mechatano vehu rotze latet levitto maot omer lah hare hammaot haellu netunin lach bemattana uvilvad shello yehe levalich reshut bahen ella ma sheatte noset venotenet befich

Gema amar rav lo shanu ella deamar lah ma sheatte noset venotenet befich aval amar ma shettirtzi asi kena yathon baal ushmuel omer afilu amar ma shettirtzi asi la kena yathon baal matkef lah rabbi zera
b: Keman azla ha shemata derav kerabbi meir deamar yad ishsha keyad balah
Urminhu ketzad mishtattefin bemavoy manniach et hechavit veomer hare ze lechol bene mavoy umzakke lahen al yede avdo veshifchato haivrim veal yede beno uvitto haggedolim veal yede ishto
Vei amratte kena yathon balah eruv la nafek mershuteh devaal
Amar rava af al gav deamar rabbi meir yad ishsha keyad balah mode rabbi meir leinyan shituf dechevan dilzakkot laacherim hu miyyad balah zachya

Etiveh ravina lerav ashe ellu shezzachin lahen al yede beno uvitto haggedolim veavdo veshifchato haivrim veellu sheen zachin lahen al yede beno uvitto hakketannim veavdo veshifchato hakkenaanim veishto
Ella amar rav ashe matnitin besheyyesh lah chatzer beoto mavoy askinan demiggo dezachya lenafshah zachya leacharine
Matni veneder almana ugrushah yakum aleha ketzad amra hareni nezira leachar sheloshim yom af al pi shennisset betoch sheloshim yom eno yachol lehafer

a: Nadra vehi birshut habbaal mefer lah ketzad amra hareni nezira leachar sheloshim af al pi shennitalmena o nitgarsha betoch sheloshim hare ze mufar nadra bo bayyom venitgarsha bo bayyom hechzira bo beom eno yachol lehafer ze hakkelal kol sheyyatza lirshut atzmah shaa achat eno yachol lehafer

Gema tanya almana ugrusha sheamra hareni nezira lichsheinnase venisset rabbi yishmael omer yafer verabbi akiva omer lo yafer vesimana yeleli eshet ish sheamra hareni nezira lichsheetgaresh venitgarsha rabbi yishmael omer lo yafer verabbi akiva omer yafer

Amar rabbi yishmael hare hu omer veneder almana ugrusha vego ad sheyehe neder bishat almanut vegerushin rabbi akiva savar hare hu omer kol asher asra al nafshah ad sheyehe isure neder bishat almanut vegerushin
Amar rav chisda matnitin rabbi akiva hi abbaye amar afilu tema rabbi yishmael matnitin talya nafshah beome barayeta talya nafshah benisuin
Shalmu yome vela nitgarsha shalmu yome vela mitnasva
Ze hakkelal dekatane gabbe naara hamorasa leetoye halach haav im sheluche habbaal o shehalchu sheluche haav im sheluche habbaal benaara hamorasa deaviha uvalah mefirin nedareha
Ze hakkelal dekatane gabbe veellu nedarim leetoye masar haav lishluche habbaal o shemmasru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal sheen habbaal mefer bakkodmin
Matni tesha nearot nidrehen kayyamin bogeret vehi yetoma naara uvagra vehi yetoma
b: Naara shello bagra vehi yetoma bogeret umet aviha naara bogeret umet aviha naara shello bagra umet aviha naara shemmet aviha umishshemmet aviha bagra bogeret veaviha kayyam naara bogeret veaviha kayyam rabbi yehuda omer af hammassi bitto hakketanna venitalmena o nitgarsha vechazra etzlo adayin hi naara
Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi yehuda aval chachamim omrim shalosh nearot nidrehen kayyamin bogeret vitoma vitoma bechayye haav
Matni kunam sheeni nehene leabba ulavicha im osa ani al picha sheeni nehenet lecha im osa ani al pi abba veal pi avicha hare ze yafer
Gema tanya sheeni nehenet leabba ulavich im ani osa leficha rabbi natan omer lo yafer vachachamim omrim yafer
Netula ani min hayehudim im meshammashtecha rabbi natan omer lo yafer vachachamim omrim yafer
Hahu gavra deitsar hanayata dealma aleh i nasev itta ki la tanena hilcheta rahet begappa vetuvalya vela immetzi lemitne ata rav acha bar rav huna veshabbesheh veinsiv itta

a: Vesharkeh tina veatyeh lekammeh derav chisda amar rava man chakkim lemibad ki ha milta i lav derav acha bar rav huna degavra rabba hu dekasavar dechi hechi difligi rabbanan verabbi natan bahafara hachi name peligi bishela

Verav pappi amar machaloket bahafara derabbi natan savar en habbaal mefer ella im ken chal neder dichtiv vechafra hallevana verabbanan savri baal mefer af al pi shello chal neder dichtiv mefer machshevot arumim
Aval bishela divre hakkol en chacham mattir kelum ella im ken chal neder dichtiv lo yachel devaro

Lema mesayya leh kunam sheeni nehene lifloni ulmi sheeshshael alav nishal al harishon veachar kach nishal al hashsheni vei amratte nishal af al pi shello chal neder i bae al hay nitshil beresha i bae al hay nitshil beresha
Umi yada i hay kamma i hay batra
Ella lema mesayya leh kunam sheeni nehene lifloni hareni nazir lichsheeshshael alav nishal al nidro veachar kach nishal al nizro
Vei amratte nishal af al pi shello chal neder i bae al nidro itshil beresha i bae al nizro itshil beresha rabbi natan hi
Amar ravina amar li marimar hachi amar avuch mishshemeh derav pappi machaloket bahafara aval bishela divre hakkol mefer veaf al pi shello chal neder dichtiv lo yachel devaro
b: Lememra dela hava beh maase
Metivi kunam sheeni nehene lifloni ulmi shennishal alav nishal al harishon veachar kach nishal al hashsheni ammay i bae al hay nitshil beresha vei bae al hay nitshil beresha
Mi yodea he rishon vehe sheni
Metivi kunam sheeni nehene vahareni nazir lichsheeshshael alav nishal al nidro veachar kach nishal al nizro veammay i bae al nidro nitshil beresha vei bae al nizro nitshil beresha teuvta
Matni barishona hau omrim shalosh nashim yotzot venotlot ketuva haomeret temea ani lach shamayim beni levenach untula ani min hayehudim

Chazru lomar shello tehe ishsha notenet eneha beacher umkalkelet al balah haomeret temea ani lach tavi reaya lidvareha hashshamayim beni levenach yaasu derech bakkasha untula ani min hayehudim yafer lechelko uthe meshammashto uthe netula min hayehudim
Gema ibaya lehu amra levalah temea ani mahu shettochal bitruma rav sheshet amar ochelet shello totzi laaz al baneha rava amar enah ochelet efshar deachla chullin
Amar rava umode rav sheshet sheim nitarmela sheenah ochelet mide hu tama ella mishshum totzi laaz al baneha nitarmela venitgarsha amri hashta deitnisa
Amar rav pappa badek lan rava eshet kohen shenneensa yesh lah ketubba o en lah ketubba kevan deones legabbe kohen keratzon legabbe yisrael dame en lah ketubba o dilma matze amra leh ana ha chazena

a: Vegavra hu denistachafa sadehu veamrinan leh matnitin hi haomeret temea ani lach yesh lah ketubba

Bemay askinan ilema beeshet yisrael i beratzon kelum yesh lah ketubba vei beones mi ka mitasra al gavra veella beeshet kohen i beratzon kelum yesh lah ketubba mi gara meeshet yisrael beratzon ella lav beones vekatane yesh lah ketubba

Ibaya lehu amra levalah gerashtani mahu amar rav hamnuna ta shema haomeret temea ani lach daafilu lemishna acharona dekatane la mehemna hatam hu dimshakkera deyada devalah la yada bah aval gabbe gerashtani deyada bah mehemna dachazaka en ishsha meiza paneha bifne balah
Amar leh rava adrabba afilu lemishna rishona dekatane mehemna hatam mishshum dela avida levazzoye nafshah aval hacha dezimnin ditkif lah min gavra meiza umiza

Metiv rav mesharsheya hashshamayim beni levenach demishna rishona teuvta derava hacha delet lah kisufa vekatane dimhemna kasavar rava hatam kevan dela saggi lah dela amra en yore kechetz i la ita kidkaamra la amra leh
Hashshamayim beni levenach demishna acharona tihve teuvta derav hamnuna veha hacha deyada hi uvalah yada bah vekatane dela mehemna
Kasavar rav hamnuna hacha name hi gufa amra nehi divvia yada beore kechetz mi yada umishshum hachi meshakkera
Hahi itta dechol yoma detashmish mikaddema mashya yedeh legavra yoma chad atya leh mayya lemimshe amar lah hada milta la havat haidana amara leh im ken chad min nochrim
b: Ahaloye dahao hacha haidana i ante la dilma minnehon amar rav nachman eneha natna beacher velet bah meshasha bemillah

Hahi itta dela hava bedicha datah bahade gavra amar lah haidana may shena amara leh meolam la tzaartan bederech eretz ki haidana amar lah la hava hada milta haidana amara leh im ken halen nochrim naftoye dahao hacha haidana i ante la dilma chad minnehon amar lehu rav nachman la tashgichun bah notenet eneha beacher havay
Hahu gavra dahava miharzik beveta hu veinteta al ata mareh deveta parteh noef lehutza vaarak amar rava itta sharya im ita daavad isura irchose hava mirchas

Hahu noef deal legabbe dehahi inteta ata gavra selek noef itiv bichlae bava hava machatan tachle tamman vetaminun chiveya bea mare deveta lemechal min hanhu tachle bela data deinteta amar leh hahu noef la techul minnehon detaminun chiveya
Amar rava inteteh sharya im iteh daavad isura nicha leh delechol velemut dichtiv ki niefu vedam bidehen
Peshita mahu detema isura avad vehay daamar leh denicha leh dela lemut baal detehve inteteh illaveh mayim genuvim yimtaku velechem setarim yinam ka mashma lan
Hadran alach veellu nedarim uslika lah massechet nedarim

a: Kol kinuye nezirut kinzirut
Haomer ehe hare ze nazir o ehe nae nazir nazik naziach paziach hare ze nazir hareni kaze hareni mesalsel hareni mechalkel hare alay leshalleach pera hare ze nazir
Hare alay tziporim rabbi meir omer nazir vachachamim omrim eno nazir
Gema mikkede tanna beseder nashim kae may tama tane nazir
Tanna akkera kae vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav ki matza vah ervat davar vehachi kaamar mi garam lah laavera yayin vekaamar kol haroe sota bekilkulah yazzir atzmo min hayyayin
Patach bechinuyin umfaresh yadot
Amar rava veitema kedi chassore michassera vehachi katane kol kinuye nezirut kinzirut vidot nezirut kinzirut veellu hen yadot haomer ehe hare ze nazir
Velifrosh kinuye beresha tanna mehahu desalek hahu mefaresh beresha keditnan bamme madlikin uvamma en madlikin umfaresh en madlikin beresha
Bamme tomnin uvamma en tomnin umfaresh en tomnin beresha
Bamma ishsha yotza uvamma enah yotza umfaresh lo tetze ishsha beresha
Vehatnan bamme behema yotza uvamma enah yotza umfaresh yotze gamal beresha
Yesh nochalin umanchilin nochalin velo manchilin manchilin velo nochalin lo nochalin velo manchilin umfaresh ellu nochalin umanchilin beresha
Ella leolam tane hachi vetane hachi
Ella hatam deisura denafsheh hu mefaresh isura denafsheh beresha gabbe behema deisura ayede behema hu deate mefaresh hetera beresha
b: Gabbe yesh nochalin name mefaresh ikar nachala beresha
Ella hacha lifrosh kinuye beresha ella hayenu taam yadot hoil veatyan leh midderasha chavivin leh
Veliftach behon beresha tanna ki matchil matchil beikar korban ulinyan parushe mefaresh yadot beresha
Haomer ehe hare ze nazir dilma ehe betaanit kaamar amar shemuel kegon shehaya nazir over lefanav

Lema kasavar shemuel yadayim sheenan mochichot la haveyan yadayim amri bizman shennazir over lefanav leka lesappoke bemilta acharina aval vadday en hannazir over lefanav amrinan dilma ehe betaanit kaamar
Vedilma lefotro min korbenotav kaamar dekaamar belibbo
I hachi may lememra mahu detema bainan piv velibbo shavin ka mashma lan
Ehe nae nazir vedilma ennae lefanav bemitzot kidtanya ze eli veanvehu ennae lefanav bemitzot eese lefanav sukka naa lulav nae tzitzit naa echtov lefanav sefer tora nae veechrechennu beshirain naim
Amar shemuel shettafus bisaro veamar ennae
Nezira milta daavera veamrinan leh nae

a: In daafilu lerabbi elazar hakkappar deamar nazir chote hane mile gabbe nazir tame deayede devae mistar deamar rachamana vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ki tame nizro hatam hu dilma ate lemibar al neziruteh aval nazir tahor lav chote kare beh
Hareni kaze nehi name detafus bisaro hareni kaze la amar amar shemuel kegon shehaya nazir over lefanav
Hareni mesalsel mimmay dehaden silsul sara kedaamara leh hahi ammeta deve rabbi lehahu gavra ad matay atta mesalsel bisarcha
Ema tora dichtiv salseleha utrommekka amar shemuel hacha name shettafus bisaro
Hareni mechalkel mimmay dehaden kilkul searo hu keditnan sid rabbi yehuda omer kede lasud kilkul veamar rav bat tzida
Ema mezan anye kedichtiv vayechalkel yosef et aviv veet echav amar shemuel hacha name shettafus bisaro
Hare alay leshalleach pera hare ze nazir mimmay dehaden shilluach ribuya hu dichtiv shelachayich pardes rimmonim
Ema mide deabbore kedichtiv vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot
Tanna pera pera yalef ketiv hacha kadosh yihye gaddel pera uchtiv hatam gabbe kohen hedot ufera lo yeshallechu
Veibaet ema hay sholeach mayim name ribuy hu kedimtargem rav yosef dechad mashkin leh mayya lefera verave
Hare alay tziporin rabbi meir omer nazir may tama derabbi meir amar resh lakish tziporin semuchin lesear kibel alav dichtiv ad di sareh kenishrin reva vetifrohi chetzipperin
Rabbi meir savar matpes inish bemide dismich leh
b: Verabbanan savri la matpes inish bemide dismich leh
Rabbi yochanan amar dechulle alma la matpes ella hayenu tama derabbi meir dechayeshinan shemma tzippore nazir tame kibel alav
Mikkede chayeshinan kaamar dilma tzippore nedava kibel alav im ken hare alay ken mibbee leh
Vedilma hare alay tzippore metzora kaamar kegon shehaya nazir over lefanav vedilma nazir tame ulfotro min korbenotav kaamar kegon shehaya nazir tahor over lefanav
May benayehu
Ika benayehu kegon deamar tziporin hassemuchin lesear alay lerabbi yochanan af al gav deamar hachi i nazir over lefanav in i la la lerabbi shimon ben lakish af al gav deen nazir over lefanav
Mi ika leman deamar la matpes inish bemilta dismich leh vehatanya haomer yamin hare zo shevua may tama lav mishshum dichtiv vayyarem yemino usmolo el hashshamayim vayyishshava beche haolam
Amri la mishshum deyamin gufeh ikri shevua detanya minnayin laomer yamin shehi shevua shenneemar nishba Adonai bimino uminnayin laomer semol shehi shevua shenneemar uvizroa uzzo
Matni hareni nazir min hachartzannim umin hazzaggim umin hattiglachat umin hattuma hare ze nazir vechol dikduke nezirut alav
Gema matnitin dela kerabbi shimon detanya rabbi shimon omer eno chayyav ad sheyyiddor mikkullam verabbanan amri afilu la nezar ella bechad minnehon have nazir
May tama derabbi shimon amar kera mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin mechartzannim vead zag verabbanan may tama amar kera miyyayin veshechar yazzir
Verabbi shimon name hachtiv miyyayin veshechar yazzir hahu mibe leh leesor yen mitzva keyen harshut
May hi kiddushta veavdalta

a: Hare mushba veomed alav mehar sinay
Ella ki ha deamar rava shevua sheeshte vechazar veamar hareni nazir atya nezirut chayela al shevua
Verabbanan name ha mibe leh leesor yen mitzva keyen reshut im ken lema kera miyyayin may veshechar shamatte minah tarte

Verabbi shimon hayenu tama dichtav shechar leallofe shechar shechar lemikdash dichtiv yayin veshechar al teshte atta uvanecha ittach ma gabbe nazir yayin hu delitsar aval shear mashkin la af gabbe mikdash name yayin hu delitsar aval shear mashkin hammishtakkerin la
Ulappoke midderabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer achal devela keilit veshata devash vechalav venichnas lammikdash chayyav
Ibaet ema rabbi shimon let leh isur chal al isur
Detanya rabbi shimon omer haochel nevela beom hakkippurim patur
Ulrabbanan name hachtiv mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin amri lach rabbanan hatam limed al isure nazir shemmitztarfim ze im ze
Verabbi shimon let leh tzeruf detanya rabbi shimon omer kol shehu lemakkot lo amru kezayit ella leinyan korban
Matni hareni keshimshon keven manoach kevaal delila kemi sheakar daltot azza kemi shennikkeru pelishtim et enav hare ze nezir shimshon
Gema lema li lemitna kol halen tzerichi dei amar hareni keshimshon hava amena shimshon acharina ka mashma lan keven manoach
Vei tena keven manoach hava amena ika demitkere hachi ka mashma lan kevaal delila uchmi shennikkeru pelishtim et enav
Matni ma ben nezir olam lenazir shimshon nezir olam hichbid searo mekel betaar umevi shalosh behemot veim nitma mevi korban tuma
Nezir shimshon hichbid searo eno mekel veim nitma eno mevi korban tuma

Gema nezir olam man dechar shemeh chassore michassera vehachi katane haomer hareni nezir olam hare ze nazir ma ben nezir olam linzir shimshon nezir olam hichbid searo mekel betaar umevi shalosh behemot veim nitma mevi korban tuma nezir shimshon hichbid searo eno mekel betaar
b: Veeno mevi korban tuma
Korban hu dela mayete aval nezirut chayela aleh
