Manni matnitin la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi shimon detanya rabbi yehuda omer nezir shimshon muttar litamme lemetim shekken matzinu beshimshon shennitma rabbi shimon omer haomer nezir shimshon lo amar kelum shello matzinu beshimshon sheyyatzat nezirut mippiv
Manni i rabbi yehuda haamar afilu lechattechila umatnitin katane im nitma i rabbi shimon haamar la chayela aleh nezirut kelal
Leolam rabbi yehuda hi veayede dekatane gabbe nezir olam im nitma tena name gabbe nezir shimshon im nitma
Lema biflugta dehane tannae kamipalgi ditnan hare alay kivchor rabbi yaakov oser verabbi yose mattir
May lav rabbi yehuda savar lah kerabbi yaakov deamar la bainan davar hannidar verabbi shimon savar lah kerabbi yose deamar bainan davar hannidar
La dechulle alma bainan davar hannidar veshane gabbe bechor dichtiv beh la lerabbot et habbechor
Verabbi yose amar lach hahu la mibe leh lerabbot chattat veasham
Uma raita lerabbot chattat veasham ulhotzi et habbechor merabbe ani chattat veasham shekken matpisan beneder umotzi ani et habbechor sheen matpiso beneder
Verabbi yaakov amar lach bechor name matpiso beneder hu detanya shel bet rabbenu amru minnayin lenolad lo bechor betoch edro shemmitzva alav lehakdisho shenneemar hazzachar takdish
Verabbi yose amar lach nehi demitzva lehakdisho i la makdesh leh mi la kadosh
Gabbe nazir name hachtiv la

Hahu mibe leh lechidtanya amar shimon hatztzaddik miyyamay lo achalti asham nazir tame chutz meadam echad shebba elay min haddarom yefe enayim vetov roi ukutztzotav sedurot lo taltallim amarti lo beni ma raita leshachet sear nae ze

Amar li roe hayiti leavi beiri vehalachti lishov mayim min hammayan venistakkalti babbavua shelli ufachaz yitzri alay uvikesh letordeni min haolam amarti lo reka mippene ma atta mitgae beolam sheeno shellecha shessofcha lihot rimma vetolea haavoda sheagallechacha lashshamayim
Amadti unshaktiv al rosho amarti lo kemotcha yirbu nezirim beyisrael alecha hakkatuv omer ish ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir la
Veshimshon lav nazir hava vehachtiv ki nezir elohim yihye hannaar min habbeten hatam malach hu dekaamar
Umnalan deitammi lemetim ilema middichtiv bilchi hachamor hikketi elef ish dilma garoye gari behu vela nega behu
Ella mehacha vayyach mehem sheloshim ish vayyikkach et chalitzotam dilma ashlechinun beresha vahadar katlinun vayyach vayyikkach ketiv
Vedilma gossin shavinun ella gemara gemiri lah

Unzir olam hecha ketiv detanya rabbi omer avshalom nezir olam haya shenneemar vayehi mikketz arbaim shana vayyomer avshalom el hammelech elcha na vaashallem et nidri asher nadarti la bechevron umgalleach echad lishnem asar chodesh shenneemar vayehi mikketz yamim layyamim

a: Veyalef yamim yamim mibbatte are choma ma hatam shenem asar chodesh af kan shenem asar chodesh
Rabbi nehoray omer megalleach achat lishloshim yom rabbi yose omer megalleach meerev shabbat leerev shabbat shekken matzinu bivne melachim shemmegallechim meerev shabbat leerev shabbat
May tama derabbi yalef mibbatte are choma veha rabbi hu deamar en yamim pechutin mishshenayim
Hay gezera shava mishshum koved gemir uvishne yamim leka koved
Veema shette shanim dichtiv vayehi mikketz shenatayim yamim danin yamim sheen immahen shanim miyyamim sheen immahen shanim veal yochiach ze sheyyesh immo shanim
Veema sheloshim yom dichtiv ad chodesh yamim danin yamim sheen immahem chodashim miyyamim sheen immahem chodashim veal yochiach ze sheyyesh immo chodashim
Veema mehacha miyyamim yamima vego danin yamim miyyamim veen danin yamim miyyamima
Umay nafka minah veha tana deve rabbi yishmael veshav hakkohen uva hakkohen zo hi shiva zo hi bia
Hane mile hecha deleka dedame leh aval hecha deika dedame leh middedame leh yalfinan
Ika deamri mena yadinan dechol telata yarchin chad zimna dilma arbea zimne beshatta i name arbea yarchin chad zimna teren yarchin bechad zimna
Rabbi nehoray omer megalleach achat lishloshim yom may tama gabbe chohanim mishshum deika koved hacha name ika koved
Rabbi yose omer megalleach meerev shabbat leerev shabbat may ika beneh lishar achohi
Yom tov shechal lihot beemtza shabbat daachohi megallechin hu la megallach i name legalloche min tzafra demaale shabbeta achohi megallechin ihu la megallach ad panya
Hane arbaim shana may avidtayehu rabbi nehoray omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua leketz arbaim shana sheshshaalu lahen melech tana otah shana sheshshaalu lahen melech hi shenat eser lishmuel haramati
Matni setam nezirut sheloshim yom
Gema menahane mile amar rav matna amar kera kadosh yihye yihye begimatriyya telatin hau
Bar peda amar keneged nazir nizro haamurim battora sheloshim chaser achat
Verav matna name nelaf minnazir nizro
Amar lach hahu lidrasha miyyayin veshechar yazzir leesor yen mitzva keyen reshut ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir melammed shehannezirut chala al nezirut
b: Uvar peda amar lach leka chad minhon delav lidrasha ella middehahu leminyana kullehu name leminyana
Tenan setam nezirut sheloshim yom bishlama lerav matna nicha ella levar peda kashya
Amar lach bar peda ayede deika yom telatin dimgalleach umevi korbenotav mishshum hachi tena sheloshim
Tenan mi sheamar hareni nazir megalleach yom sheloshim veechad bishlama lerav matna nicha ella levar peda kashya
Amar lach bar peda ema sefa im gilach leom sheloshim yatza ella sefa mesayea leh resha naasa keomer shelemin
Ulrav matna kashya sefa kasavar miktzat hayyom kechullo
Tenan hareni nazir sheloshim yom im gilach yom sheloshim lo yatza beomer shelemin
Tenan mi shennazar shette nezirut megalleach et harishona yom sheloshim veechad vehashsheniyya leom shishshim veechad bishlama lerav matna nicha

a: Ella levar peda kashya
Amar lach bar peda ema sefa veim gilach et harishona leom sheloshim megalleach et hashsheniyya leom shishshim ella sefa mesayea leh resha beomer shelemim
Ulrav matna kashya sefa amar lecha rav matna kidkatane sefa yom sheloshim ole lechan ulchan
May hi miktzat hayyom kechullo ha amrah chada zimna mahu detema hane mile leinyan chada nezirut aval lishte nezirut la ka mashma lan
Tenan im gilach yom shishshim chaser echad yatza sheyyom sheloshim ole lo min hamminyan bishlama lerav matna nicha ella levar peda lema li ha amar sheloshim chaser echad
Amar lach ana name aha semachi
Tenan mi sheamar hareni nazir nitma yom sheloshim soter et hakkol bishlama lerav matna nicha ella levar peda kashya
b: Amar lach bar peda ema sefa rabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella shiva i salka datach sheloshim bainan nistor kullehu
Kasavar rabbi eliezer miktzat hayyom kechullo

Tenan hareni nazir mea yom nitma yom mea soter et hakkol rabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella sheloshim yom vei salka datach savar rabbi eliezer miktzat hayyom kechullo nistor shiva vei la savar miktzat hayyom kechullo listor kullehu

Leolam la amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo i hachi listor kullehu amar resh lakish hayenu tama derabbi eliezer amar kera zot torat hannazir beom melot yeme nizro hattora amra nitma beom melot ten lo torat nazir
Lema ketannae ad melot hayyamim
Shomani miut yamim shenayim talmud lomar kadosh yihye gaddel pera en gidul sear pachot mishsheloshim divre rabbi yoshiyya
Rabbi yonatan omer eno tzarich hare hu omer ad melot hayyamim i ellu hen yamim shetztzerichin lemalloot heve omer sheloshim
May lav rav matna deamar kerabbi yoshiyya uvar peda deamar kerabbi yonatan
Amar lecha rav matna kulle alma sheloshim bainan vehacha bead vead bakkelal peligi rabbi yoshiyya savar ad velo ad bakkelal verabbi yonatan savar ad vead bakkelal
Amar mar i ellu hen yamim shetztzerichin lemalloot heve omer sheloshim veema shabbat shabbat mi ika chassiruta

a: Veema shana mi manenan leome veha rabbanan dekesari amri minnayin sheen monin yamim leshanim shenneemar lechodshe hashshana chodashim mechashshevin leshanim velo yamim leshanim
Matni amar hareni nazir achat gedola hareni nazir achat ketanna afilu mikkan vead sof haolam nazir sheloshim yom
Gema ammay veha mikkan vead sof haolam kaamar hachi kaamar aricha li hada milta kemikkan vead sof haolam

Tenan hareni nazir mikkan ad makom peloni omdim kamma yamim mikkan vead makom peloni pachot mishsheloshim yom nazir sheloshim yom veim lav nazir keminyan hayyamim veema hacha name aricha li ha milta kemikkan vead makom peloni
Amar rava shehechzik badderech velihve kol parsa ufarsa amar rav pappa beatra dela mane parse
Velihve kol auona veauona mi la tenan hareni nazir kaafar haaretz vechisar roshi uchchol hayyam hare ze nezir olam umgalleach echad lishloshim yom
Kol milta deit bah kitzuta la katane
Vehatanya hareni nazir kol yeme chayyay hareni nezir olam hare ze nezir olam afilu mea shana afilu elef shanim en ze nezir olam ella nazir leolam
Rabba amar shane searot hoil umuvdalot zo mizzo
Gabbe yome name ha ketiv vayehi erev vayehi voker yom echad
Hatam lav demippaski mehadade hu may kaamar yemama velelya chad yoma hu ulolam la mippaski mehadade
Rava amar lema lach akshoye kulle hay shane hatam deha katane hareni nazir achat
Matni hareni nazir veom echad hareni nazir veshaa achat hareni nazir achat umechetza hare ze nazir shettayim

Gema lema li lemitna kol hane tzerichi dei tena hareni nazir veom echad hacha hu deamrinan en nezirut leom echad ammetu lehachi kamane tarten aval hareni nazir veshaa achat limne sheloshim veechad yom ka mashma lan
b: Vei tena shaa achat mishshum dela nachet ledaveka aval achat umechetza denachet ledaveka ema la limne tarte kamashma lan kullehu nazir shettayim
Matni hareni nazir sheloshim yom veshaa achat nazir sheloshim veechad yom sheen nezirut leshaot
Gema amar rav lo shanu ella deamar sheloshim veechad yom aval amar sheloshim yom veom echad nazir shettayim
Rav savar lah kerabbi akiva dedaresh lishana yattira
Ditnan lo et habbor velo et haddut af al pi shekkatav lo umka veruma vetzarich likach lo derech divre rabbi akiva
Vachachamim omrim eno tzarich likach lo derech umode rabbi akiva bizman sheamar lo chutz meellu sheeno tzarich likach lo derech

a: Matni hareni nazir kisar roshi vechaafar haaretz uchchol hayyam hare ze nezir olam umgalleach achat lishloshim yom
Rabbi omer en ze megalleach achat lishloshim yom veezehu megalleach achat lishloshim haomer hare alay nezirut kisar roshi vechaafar haaretz uchchol hayyam
Hareni nazir melo habbayit o melo hakkuppa bodkin oto im amar achat gedola nazarti nazir sheloshim yom veim amar setam nazarti roin et hakkuppa keilu hi melea chardal venazir kol yamav
Hareni nazir mikkan ad makom peloni omdin kamma yamim mikkan ad makom peloni im pachot mishsheloshim yom nazir sheloshim yom veim lav nazir keminyan hayyamim
Hareni nazir keminyan yemot hachamma mone nezirot keminyan yemot hachamma amar rabbi yehuda maase haya kevan shehishlim met
Gema roin et hakkuppa keilu melea chardal venazir kol yamav veammay velichzeyah keilu melea kishuin vedilluin vetihve leh takkanta
Amar chizkiyya bemachaloket shenuya verabbi shimon hi deamar adam machnis et atzmo ledavar shessefeko chamur mivadday
Detanya hareni nazir al menat sheyehe bichri ze mea kor vehalach umtzao shennignav o sheavad rabbi shimon oser shessefek nezirut lehachmir
Rabbi yehuda mattir shessefek nezirut lehakel
Rabbi yochanan amar afilu tema rabbi yehuda hatam la nachet leh linzirut hacha nachet leh linzirut bemay lesallokeh mineh
Ammay la lichzeyah lekuppa keilu melea kishuin vedilluin vetihve leh takkanta ha salka datin nezirut hu dekabbel ilaveh
b: Derabbi yehuda savar lah kerabbi ditnan rabbi omer en ze megalleach achat lishloshim yom veezehu shemmegallech achat lishloshim yom haomer hare alay nezirot kisar roshi vechaafar haaretz uchchol hayyam
Verabbi yehuda mi savar lah kerabbi vehatnan hareni nazir keminyan yemot hachamma vechu amar rabbi yehuda maase haya vechevan shehishlim met
I amratte bishlama nezirot ka mekabbel aleh hayenu tama dechevan dehishlim met ella i amratte chada nezirut kabbel ilaveh mi have hashlama kelal
Veod mi savar lah kerabbi veha tanya rabbi yehuda omer hareni nazir minyan hilkete kayitz uminyan shevile shemita mone nezirot keminyan hilkete kayitz uchminyan shevile shemita
Minyan shane

Umi shane leh lerabbi minyan vehatanya hareni nazir keminyan yemot hachamma mone nezirot keminyan yemot hachamma kime hallevana mone kime hallevana rabbi omer ad sheyyomar nezirot alay keminyan yemot hachamma uchminyan yemot hallevana
Rabbi yehuda savar lah kevateh bachada uflig aleh bachada savar lah kevateh bachada nezirut kabbel ilaveh uflig aleh bachada deilu rabbi yehuda shane leh mone verabbi la shane leh mone
Tanu rabbanan hareni nazir kol yeme chayyay hareni nezir olam hare ze nezir olam afilu mea shana afilu elef shanim en ze nezir olam ella nazir leolam
Tanu rabbanan hareni nazir veachat mone shettayim veod mone shalosh veshuv mone arba peshita mahu detema veshuv ki kullehu vehaveya leh shet ka mashma lan dela
Tanu rabbanan hareni nazir somchos omer hen achat digon shettayim terigon shalosh tetragon arba pontigon chamesh
Tanu rabbanan bet iggul digon terigon pontigon eno mittamme bingaim tetragon mittamme bingaim may tama lematta hu omer kir kirot lemala hu omer kir kirot hare kan arba
Hadran alach kol kinuye

a: Hareni nazir min haggerogrot umin haddevela bet shammay omrim nazir uvet hillel omrim eno nazir amar rabbi yehuda af kesheamru bet shammay lo amru ella beomer hare hen alay korban

Gema hareni nazir min haggerogrot umin haddevela bet shammay omrim nazir veammay mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin amar rachamana bet shammay savri lah kerabbi meir deamar en adam motzi devarav levattala
Uvet hillel savri lah kerabbi yose deamar bigmar devarav adam nitpas vehay neder ufitcho immo hu
Uvet shammay name neder ufitcho immo hu

Ella bet shammay savri lah kerabbi meir deamar en adam motzi devarav levattala vechevan deamar hareni nazir hava leh nazir ki kaamar min haggerogrot umin haddevela leitshole hu dekaate uvet shammay letamayehu deamri en sheela behekdesh vechevan deen sheela behekdesh en sheela binzirut
Uvet hillel savri kerabbi shimon ditnan verabbi shimon poter shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevim
b: Matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya rabbi natan omer bet shammay omrim nadur venazir uvet hillel omrim nadur veen nazir bet shammay savri lah kerabbi meir uchrabbi yehuda uvet hillel savri lah kerabbi yose
Lishana acharina amri lah rabbi natan omer bet shammay omrim nadur veeno nazir uvet hillel omrim lo nadur velo nazir bet shammay kerabbi yehuda uvet hillel kerabbi shimon

Tenan hatam haomer hare alay mincha lehavi min hasseorim yavi min hachitim kemach yavi solet shello beshemen ulvona yevienna beshemen ulvona chatzi issaron yavi issaron shalem issaron umechetza yavi shenayim rabbi shimon poter shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevim

Man tanna dechi amar hare alay mincha min hasseorim mevi min hachitim amar chizkiyya bemachaloket shenuya uvet shammay hi lav amri bet shammay ki amar min haggerogrot umin haddevela have nazir hachi name ki amar min hasseorin mevi min hachitim
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu tema divre hakkol beomer ilu hayiti yodea sheen nodrin kach lo nadarti kach ella kach
Amar chizkiyya lo shanu ella sheamar min hasseorim aval amar min haadashim la mayete velo kelum
Mikkedi chizkiyya keman mokem lah lematnitin kevet shammay veha adashim legabbe mincha kigrogrot legabbe nazir damu vekaamri bet shammay have nazir hadar beh chizkiyya
Veammay hadar beh amar rava matnitin keshiteh may irya detane min hasseorim litne min haadashim ella savar chizkiyya ki kaamri bet shammay hatam kerabbi yehuda
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu min haadashim veha rabbi yochanan hu deamar beomer ilu hayiti yodea sheen nodrin kach lo nadarti kach ella kach lidvarav dechizkiyya hu dekaamar

Atte may tama ka hadratte bach mishshum dela katane min haadashim dilma la mibaya kaamar la mibaya ki amar meadashim demayete mincha meallayeta deika lememar mihdar hu dahadar beh utfos lashon rishon ella ki amar min hasseorin vadday dehachi kaamar i kadsha kamminchat haomer

a: O keminchat sota tikdosh i la la ka mashma lan demayete min hachitim

Matni amar amra para zo hareni nezira im omedet ani omer haddelet hazze hareni nezira im niftach ani bet shammay omrim nazir uvet hillel omrim eno nazir amar rabbi yehuda af kesheamru bet shammay lo omrim ella beomer hare para zo alay korban im omedet hi

Gema para mi ka mishtaya amar rame bar chama hacha bemay askinan kegon shehayeta para revutza lefanav veamar kisvura para zo enah omedet hareni nazir mibbesarah im amda meeleha veamda meeleha vehalchu bet shammay leshitatan uvet hillel leshitatan
Bet shammay deamri min haggerogrot umin haddevela have nazir hacha name ki amar mibbesarah have nazir uvet hillel omrim la have nazir
Veha amruha bet shammay chada zimna amar rava tarte telat vechen tane rabbi chiyya tarte telat vechen amar rabbi oshaya tarte telat

Utzrichi dei itmar beha gerogrot udvela hatam hu deamri bet shammay have nazir mishshum demichallefan baanavim aval basar baanavim la michallaf vei itmar basar hacha hu deamri bet shammay have nazir bevisra vechamra aval gerogrot udvela la ka mashma lan
Vei itmar hane tarte hane hu dekaamri bet shammay aval delet ema modu lehu levet hillel vei tanna delet beha kaamri bet hillel aval behach tarte ema modu lehu levet shammay kamashma lan dela

Amar rava mi katane im amda meeleha ella amar rava kegon shehayeta para revutza lefanav veamar hare alay korban bishlama para bat korban hi ella delet bat korban hi ella amar rava kegon shehayeta para revutza lefanav
b: Veamar hareni nazir miyyayin im lo amda veamda meeleha bet shammay savri turpeh dehay gavra mishshum okomah bideh hu veha la okmah uvet hillel savri mishshum dirvia hu veha kamat
I hachi ema sefa amar rabbi yehuda af kesheamru bet shammay lo amru ella beomer hare hen alay korban para mi ka matpes bah mide

Ella kegon deamar hareni nazir mibbesarah im lo amda veamda meeleha bet shammay savri turpeh dehahu gavra mishshum okomah bideh hu veha la okmah uvet hillel savri turpeh dehay gavra mishshum dirvia veha kamat
Uvet hillel savri i la kamat have nazir vehaamri mibbesarah la have nazir

Letamayehu devet shammay kaamri ledidan afilu la kamat name la have nazir ledidchu deamritu have nazir odo lan mihat deturpeh dehaden gavra mishshum dirvia veha kamat uvet shammay lav turpeh dehay gavra mishshum okomah bideh hu veha la okmah

a: Matni mazgu lo et hakkos veamar hareni nazir mimmennu hare ze nazir maase beishsha achat shehayeta shikora umazgu lah et hakkos veamra hareni nezira mimmennu amru chachamim lo nitkavvena zo ella lomar hare hu alay korban
Gema maase listor amratte resha hare ze nazir vahadar tane maase beishsha achat alma behay hu deasur ha yena acharina shere

Chassore michassera vehachi katane mazgu lo et hakkos veamar hareni nazir mimmennu hare ze nazir veim shikor hu veamar hareni nazir mimmennu eno nazir may tama keman deamar hare alay korban hu vechi tema lema hachi savar mayetin li acharina umtzaarin li ema lehu ha milta difsika lehu umaase name beishsha achat
Matni hareni nazir al menat sheehe shote yayin umitamme lemetim hare ze nazir veasur bechullan

Yodea ani sheyyesh nezirut aval eni yodea shehannazir asur beyayin hare ze asur verabbi shimon mattir yodea ani shehannazir asur beyayin aval savur hayiti shechachamim mattirin li mippene sheen ani yachol lichot ella beyayin o mippene sheani kover et hammetim hare ze muttar verabbi shimon oser
Gema veliflog name rabbi shimon beresha amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi chaluk haya rabbi shimon af beresha

Ravina amar beresha la pelig rabbi shimon may tama mishshum dehave leh matne al ma shekkatuv battora vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar lach hay al menat kechutz dame

Tanya keoteh deravina amar hareni nazir al menat sheehe shote yayin umitamme lemetim hare ze nazir veasur bechullan mippene shehu matne al ma shekkatuv betora vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel
Yodea ani shehannazir asur beyayin vehaamratte resha asur verabbi shimon mattir ema name hare ze asur verabbi shimon mattir veibaet ema leolam la tefoch hatam
b: Resha kegon dinzar mechada lerabbanan deamri daafilu lo nazar ella meachat mehen have nazir veasur lerabbi shimon deamar ad sheyyazzir mikkullam muttar
Sefa dindar mikkullehu veitshil mechada

Lerabbanan deamri afilu lo nazar ella meachat mehen have nazir ki mitteshil mechada minayehu ishteri lerabbi shimon deamar ad sheyyazzir mikkullam ki mitteshil name mehahu ad demitteshil mikkullehu mishshum hachi katane verabbi shimon oser
Veibaet ema benidre onasin ka mipalgi uviflugta dishmuel verav assi ditnan arbaa nedarim hittiru chachamim nidre zeruzin nidre havay nidre shegagot nidre onasin
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav assi arbaa nedarim hallalu tzerichin sheela lachachamim ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li tanna katane hittiru chachamim veatte amratte tzerichin sheela lachachamim
Rabbanan savri kishmuel verabbi shimon kerav assi
Matni hareni nazir vealay legalleach nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani vealay legalleach nazir im hau pikchim megallechin ze et ze veim lav megallechin nezirim acherim
Gema ibaya lehu shama chavero veamar vaani mahu vaani akkulleh dibura mashma o dilma appalgeh dedibura mashma im timtze lomar appalgeh dedibura mashma aresha o assefa

Ta shema vaani vealay legalleach nazir im hau pikchim megallechin ze et ze middekaamar vaani vealay shema minah vaani appalgeh dedibura amri in appalgeh dedibura mashma mihu aresha o assefa mina middekaamar vealay legalleach shema minah vaani al techilat dibura mashma

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava mimmay dehachi leolam ema lach vaani akkulleh dedibura vei mishshum vealay may kaamar vealay beha milta dei la tema hachi dekatane sefa hare alay legalleach chatzi nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani alay legalleach chatzi nazir hatam mi ika tarten mile ella may kaamar alay beha milta hacha name ki kaamar alay beha milta

Amar leh rava hachi hashta i amratte bishlama resha tzericha sefa la tzericha tane sefa dela tzericha mishshum resha ditzricha ella i amratte resha la tzericha sefa la tzericha tane resha dela tzericha vetane sefa dela tzericha
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan haomer lishlucho

a: Tze vekaddesh li ishsha setam asur bechol hannashim shebbaolam chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto vechevan dela paresh leh ha la yada he nihu kaddesh leh
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan ken setuma shepparcha gozal echad mehen laavir haolam o shepparcha leven chattaot hammetot o shemmet echad mehen yikkach zug lashsheni
Veilu ken meforeshet en lo takkana
Veilu shear kinin bealma mitakkenan veammay lema kol chada vachada dilma hay nihu
Amar leh kaamena ana ishsha dela nayeda veamratte li atte isura denayed
Vechi tema hacha name nayed emor beshuka ashkach vekaddesh hatam hadra lenichuta gabbe ken mi hadra
Amar rava umode rabbi yochanan beishsha sheen lah lo bat velo bat bat velo bat ben velo em velo em em velo achot veaf al pi shehayeta lah achot venitgarsha leachar mikkan dehahi sharya
May tama divhahi shata deka amar leh hava nesivan legavre ki meshave shaliach bemilta dekayema kammeh bemilta dela kayema kammeh la meshave shaliach

Tenan hareni nazir vealay legalleach nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani vealay legalleach nazir im hau pikchin megallechin ze et ze veim lav megallechin nezirim acherim bishlama batraa ika kadmaa kammeh ella kadmaa mi ika batraa kammeh
b: Ella hachi kaamar i mashkachna dehave nazir agallecheh hacha name hachi kaamar leh i mashkachatte demigarsha kaddesh li
Amri la meshave inish shaliach ella bemilta dematze aved hashta bemilta dela matze aved leh hashta la meshave

Vela ta shema haomer leappotroppos shello kol nedarim shettiddor ishti mikkan ad sheavo mimmakom peloni hafer lah vehefer lah yachol yehu mufarin talmud lomar ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu divre rabbi yoshiyya verabbi yonatan omer matzinu bechol makom sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto

Tama deamar rachamana ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu ha lav hachi appotroppos mefer veilu gabbe dideh tanya haomer leishto kol nedarim shettiddori mikkan vead sheavo mimmakom peloni yehu kayyamin lo amar kelum hare hen mufarin rabbi eliezer omer mufar vachachamim omrim eno mufar
Ka salka datin ki amar rabbi yoshiyya alliba derabbanan deamri la matze mefer vei lav deamar rachamana ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu appotroppos hava mefar
Vedilma alliba derabbi eliezer deamar matze mefar i hachi lema li leshauoye shaliach lefar lah ihu kasavar dilma mishtelena o ratachna o mitridna

Matni hare alay legalleach chatzi nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani alay legalleach chatzi nazir ze megalleach nazir shalem veze megalleach nazir shalem divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim ze megalleach chatzi nazir veze megalleach chatzi nazir
Gema amar rava hakkol modim kol hecha deamar chatzi korbanot nazir alay chatzi korban mayete korbenot chatzi nazir alay kulleh korban bae etoye may tama deha la ashkechan nezirut lefalga
Vechi peligi belishana dematnitin peligi rabbi meir savar kevan deamar hare alay ichayyav akkulleh korban nezirut vechi kaamar chatzi nezirut lav kol kemineh verabbanan savri neder ufetach immo hu
Matni hareni nazir lichsheyyihye li ben venolad lo ben hare ze nazir nolad lo bat tumtum veanderoginos eno nazir im amar kesheyyihye li valad afilu nolad lo bat tumtum veanderoginos hare ze nazir

a: Hippila ishto eno nazir rabbi shimon omer yomar im haya ben kayyama hare ani nezir chova veim lav hare ani nezir nedava
Chazra veyalda hare ze nazir rabbi shimon omer yomar im harishon ben kayyama harishon chova vezo nedava veim lav harishon nedava vezo chova
Gema hay may lememra mishshum sefa bat tumtum veanderoginos eno nazir peshita mahu detema lichsheebbane hu dekaamar ka mashma lan dela
Veim amar kesheyyihye li valad ku peshita mahu detema valad demichashav bene inashe bainan ka mashma lan
Hippila ishto eno nazir man katane lah rabbi yehuda dichri hu

Rabbi shimon omer yomar im haya ben kayyama hareni nezir chova veim lav hareni nezir nedava bea mineh rabbi abba merav huna hareni nazir lichsheyyihye li ben vehippila ishto vehifrish korban vechazra veyalda mahu
Alliba deman i alliba derabbi shimon may tibe leh ha amar rabbi shimon sefek nezirut lehachamir veella alliba derabbi yehuda deamar sefek nezirut lehakel may kadosh o la kadosh
May nafka minah legizato velaavod bo teku
Bea mineh ben rechumi meabbaye hareni nazir lichsheyehe li ben veshama chavero veamar vealay mahu addibureh mashma o aggufeh mashma
Im timtze lomar aggufeh mashma amar hareni nazir lichsheyehe li ben veshama chavero veamar vaani mahu annafsheh kaamar o dilma hachi kaamar rachemna lach keotach im timtze lomar kol beanpeh
b: Kesifa leh milta amar hareni nazir lichsheyehe lifloni ben veshama chavero veamar vaani mahu mi amrinan shello befanav annafsheh kaamar o dilma hachi kaamar leh rachemna leh keotach tibe

Matni hareni nazir venazir kesheyyihye li ben hitchil mone et shello veachar kach nolad lo ben mashlim et shello veachar kach mone et shel beno hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben venazir hitchil mone et shello veachar kach nolad lo ben manniach et shello umone et shel beno veachar kach mashlim et shello
Gema bae rava amar hareni nazir leachar esrim yom umeachshav mea yom mahu kevan dehalen mea beesrin la shalmin la chayelin o dilma kevan deit leh gidul sear levassof chayelin
Vetibe leh nezirut muetet chada miggo chada ka mibaya leh

a: Im timtze lomar nezirut muetet kevan deasra yomin hu deyattirin la salek leh halen asara vadday nezir mea yom kevan deit leh temanin yomin levassof salkin leh o la
Veim timtze lomar chayeli amar hareni nazir leachar esrim yom umeachshav nezir olam mahu mi chayela aleh o la

Im timtze lomar hacha kevan deefshar leitshole chayela amar hareni nezir shimshon leachar esrim yom umeachshav nazir setam mahu hacha la efshar leitshole mi chayela o la amar kemoshe beshiva baadar may
Peshot minayehu kadmayeta hareni nazir leachar esrim yom umeachshav mea yom mone esrim veachar kach mone sheloshim veachar kach mone shemonim kede lehashlim nezirut rishona
Nitma bime beno rabbi yochanan amar soter resh lakish amar eno soter
Rabbi yochanan amar soter chada nezirut arichta hi resh lakish amar eno soter nezirut dideh lechud vedivreh lechud
b: Nitma bime tzarato rabbi yochanan amar soter resh lakish amar eno soter
Rabbi yochanan amar soter deha binzirut kae resh lakish amar eno soter tzaraat lechud unzirut lechud
Utzricha dei itmar behach kammayeta behahi amar rabbi yochanan soter shem nezirut achat hi aval beha ema mode leh leresh lakish denazir lechud vetzaraat lechud
Vei itmar beha beha kaamar resh lakish aval behach ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan tzericha
Nitma beom gidul sear rav amar eno soter afilu lerabbi yochanan deamar soter hane mile hecha dekae binzirut gidul sear mishlam nezirut hu
Ushmuel amar soter afilu leresh lakish deamar en soter hatam shette nezirut hacha chada neziruta
Amar rav chisda hakkol modim sheim kiddesh sear baddam en lo takkana

Alliba deman i alliba derabbi eliezer kevan deamar tiglachat meakkevet toch melot hi velistor ella alliba derabbanan haamri tiglachat lo meakkevet leolam alliba derabbanan umay en lo takkana en lo takkana lemitzvat giluach

Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina nazir shekkalu lo yamav loke al hattuma veeno loke al hattiglachat velo al hayyayin may shena tuma delake deamar kera kol yeme hazziro la lerabbot yamim shelleachar melot keyamim shellifne melot

I hachi attiglachat name lichayyav deha amar rachamana kol yeme neder nizro taar lo yaavor al rosho laasot yamim shelleachar melot kayyamim shellifne melot vetu kol yeme nizro mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin laasot yamim shelleachar melot keyamim shellifne melot

a: Shane hacha deamar rachamana vetimme rosh nizro mi shennizro taluy lo berosho metivi nazir shekkalu lo yamav asur legalleach velishtot yayin velittame lemetim veim gilach veshata yayin venitma lemetim hare ze sofeg et haarbaim teuvta
Matni hareni nazir lichsheyehe li ben venazir mea yom nolad lo ben ad shivim lo hifsid kelum leachar shivim soter shivim sheen tiglachat pachot mishsheloshim yom

Gema amar rav yom shivim ole lechan ulchan tenan nolad lo ad shivim lo hifsid kelum vei salka datach ola lechan ulchan itgore mitgar ella bedin hu dela litne ad shivim umishshum dekatane sefa achar shivim soter shivim katane resha shivim
Ta shema missefa nolad achar shivim soter shivim may achar achar achar

Aval achar mammash may hachi name dela satar i hachi may irya detane nolad ad shivim lo hifsid kelum afilu achar shivim name ha amratte la satar ella shema minah achar mammash vechen matnitin lerav shema minah
Verav keman amrah lishmateh ilema keabba shaul ditnan hakkover et meto shelosha yamim kodem laregel batla mimmennu gezerat shiva
Shemona yamim kodem laregel batla mimmennu gezerat sheloshim umuttar lesapper erev haregel veim lo siper erev haregel asur lesapper achar haregel
b: Abba shaul omer afilu lo siper kodem haregel muttar lesapper achar haregel shekkeshem shemmitzvat shelosha mevattelet gezerat shiva kach mitzvat shiva mevattelet gezerat sheloshim
May tama deabba shaul lav mishshum dekasavar shevii ole lechan ulchan dilma ad kan la kaamar abba shaul ella baavelut shiva derabbanan aval benazir deorayeta la
Ella rav deamar kerabbi yose detanya rabbi yose omer shomeret yom keneged yom sheshshachatu vezarku aleha bashsheni shellah
Veachar kach raata hare zo enah ochelet uftura millaasot pesach sheni
May tama derabbi yose lav mishshum dekasavar miktzat hayyom kechullo mimmay vedilma mishshum dekasavar mikkan ulhabba hu metamme
Umi savar rabbi yose hachi

Vehatanya rabbi yose omer zav baal shette reiyyot sheshshachatu vezarku alav bashshevii vechen shomeret yom keneged yom sheshshachatu vezarku aleha veachar kach rau af al pi shemmetammein mishkav umoshav lemafrea peturin millaasot pesach sheni
May lemafrea midderabbanan hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach middeorayeta ammay peturin millaasot pesach sheni
Leolam ema lach tuma deorayeta tehom deziva hittiru
Veaf rabbi oshaya savar lemafrea midderabbanan detanya rabbi oshaya amar aval haroe zav bashshevii shello soter et shellefanav vaamar leh rabbi yochanan la nistor ella yomo
Ma nafshach i satar kullehu satar i la satar la nistor velo yomo ella ema la nistor vela yomo

a: Vaamar leh rabbi yose kae kevatach deamar mikkan ulhabba metamme veha rabbi yose lemafrea hu deamar may lemafrea midderabbanan

Verabbi yose mikkedi savar miktzat hayyom kechullo zava gemura demayeta korban hechi mashkachatte lah kevan dechazya befalgeh deoma idach palgeh deoma salek lah leshimur ibaet ema deka shafa telata telata yome bahade hadade veibaet ema dechazya telata yome samuch lishkiat hachamma dela havay shehut desalek leh leminyana
Hadran alach hareni nazir
Mi sheamar hareni nazir megalleach yom sheloshim veechad veim gilach leom sheloshim yatza hareni nazir sheloshim yom im gilach leom sheloshim lo yatza

Mi shennazar shette nezirot megalleach et harishona yom sheloshim veechad veet hashsheniyya yom shishshim veechad veim gilach et harishona yom sheloshim megalleach et hashsheniyya yom shishshim veim gilach yom shishshim chaser echad yatza

Vezo edut heid rabbi pappeyas al mi shennazar shette nezirot sheim gilach et harishona yom sheloshim megalleach et hashsheniyya leom shishshim veim gilach leom shishshim chaser echad yatza sheyyom shel sheloshim ole lo min hamminyan

Mi sheamar hareni nazir nitma yom sheloshim soter et hakkol rabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella shiva hareni nazir sheloshim yom nitma yom sheloshim soter et hakkol hareni nazir mea yom nitma yom mea soter et hakkol rabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella sheloshim nitma yom mea veechad soter sheloshim yom rabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella shiva
Gema mi sheamar hareni nazir venitma yom sheloshim soter et hakkol rabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella shiva
b: Kasavar rabbi eliezer kol achar melot shiva soter hareni nazir sheloshim yom venitma yom sheloshim soter et hakkol la pelig rabbi eliezer deamar shelemin
Hareni nazir mea yom venitma yom mea soter et hakkol rabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella sheloshim vechullah kedahavenan bah alliba devar padda verav matna
Matni mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot afilu haya sham sheloshim yom en olin lo min hamminyan veeno mevi korban tuma yatza venichnas olin lo min hamminyan umevi korban tuma
Rabbi eliezer omer lo bo vayyom shenneemar vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ad sheyehu lo yamim rishonim

Gema itmar mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot rabbi yochanan amar nezirut chala alav veresh lakish amar en nezirut chala alav rabbi yochanan amar nezirut chala alav savar mitla talya vekayema kevan demashkecha tohora chayela veresh lakish amar en nezirut chala alav i hadar veamar chayela aleh vei la la

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot afilu haya sham sheloshim yom en olin min hamminyan veeno mevi korban tuma korban tuma hu dela mayete ha mechal chayela aleh amar leh eno betorat tuma veeno betorat korban

Etiveh mi shehaya tame venazar asur legalleach velishtot yayin velitame lemetim veim gilach veshata yayin venitma lemetim hare ze sofeg et haarbaim i amratte bishlama chayela hayenu tama desofeg et haarbaim ella i amratte la chayela ammay sofeg et haarbaim

a: Hacha bemay askinan beotze venichnas

Etiveh en ben tame shennazar lenazir tahor shennitma ella tame shennazar shevii shello ole lo lamminyan venazir tahor shennitma en shevii shello ole lo lamminyan vei salka datach la chayela ammay ole lo min hamminyan
Amar mar bar rav ashe mechal kulle alma la peligi dechayela ella ki peligi lemilke rabbi yochanan savar kevan dechayela lake veresh lakish savar la lake vechayela
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot afilu haya sham sheloshim yom en olin lo min hamminyan veeno mevi korban tuma korban tuma hu dela mayete ha milke lake aleh
Bedin hu delitne eno loke ella mishshum deka bae lemitne sefa yatza venichnas ole lo min hamminyan umevi korban tuma tena resha eno mevi korban tuma

Ta shema en ben tame shennazar lenazir tahor shennitma ella shettame shennazar shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan venazir tahor shennitma en shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan ha lemalkut ze vaze shavin amar leh la letiglachat ze vaze shavin
Aval leinyan malkot may ze loke veze eno loke litneyeh betakkanteh ka mayere bekilkuleh la ka mayere
Ta shema mi shehaya tame venazar asur legalleach velishtot yayin veim gilach veshata yayin venitma lemetim hare ze sofeg et haarbaim teuvta
Bae rava nazir vehu bevet hakkevarot mahu bae shehiyya lemalkut o la
Hechi dame ilema deamri leh la tinzor lema li shehiyya nazir may tama la bae shehiyya deka matri beh hacha name ka matri beh
b: Ella kegon shennichnas beshida teva umigdal uva chavero ufara mealav maaziva
Ki gemirin shehiyya bevet hammikdash aval abbaray la o dilma la shena teku
Bae rav ashe nazar vehu bevet hakkevarot taun giluach o la ki bae tiglachat tahor shennitma deka metamme linziruteh aval tame shennazar la o dilma la shena

Ta shema mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot afilu haya sham sheloshim yom eno ole lo min hamminyan veeno mevi korban tuma korban tuma hu dela mayete aval galloche bae ma taam kaamar ma taam eno mevi korban tuma mishshum dela bae galloche

Ta shema en ben tame shennazar lenazir tahor shennitma ella tame shennazar shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan venazir tahor shennitma en shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan may lav ha letiglachat ze vaze shavin la ha lemalkut ze vaze shavin
Aval tiglachat may ze megalleach veze eno megalleach litneyeh tena shevii shello vechol mile

Ta shema en li ella yeme tumato sheen olin lo min hamminyan yeme chilluto minnayin vedin hu ma yeme tumato megalleach umevi korban af yeme chilluto megalleach umevi korban uma yeme tumato en olin lo min hamminyan af yeme chilluto en olin lo min hamminyan
Lo im amarta bime tumato shekken mevattel bahen et hakkodmin lefichach en olin lo min hamminyan tomar bime chilluto sheeno mevattel et hakkodmin lefichach olin lo min hamminyan
Amarta uma nazir bekever shessearo rauy letiglachat en olin lo min hamminyan yeme chilluto sheen rauy letiglachat lo kol shekken sheen olin lo min hamminyan
May lav tiglachat tuma la tiglachat tohora hachi name mistabbera

a: Dei salka datach tiglachat tuma yeme chilluto mi la bae tiglachat la tiglachat dinzirut katane
Ta shema vetimme rosh nizro betahor shennitma hakkatuv medabber shehu taun haavarat sear vahavaat tziporin veliftor et hannazir bekever sheen taun haavarat sear vahavaat tziporin
Vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma tahor shennitma taun haavarat sear vahavaat tziporin mi shehaya tame mittechilla eno din sheyehe taun haavarat sear vahavaat tziporin
Talmud lomar vetimme rosh nizro bemi shehaya tahor venitma hakkatuv medabber sheyehe taun haavarat sear vahavaat tziporin veliftor et hannazir bekever shema minah
Man tena ha detanu rabbanan en ben tame shennazar lenazir tahor shennitma ella shettame shennazar shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan venazir tahor shennitma en shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan
Amar rav chisda rabbi hi deamar rabbi en nezirut tohora chala ella ad shemini dei tema rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi haamar nezirut detohora mishshevii hu dechayela
May rabbi umay rabbi yose berabbi yehuda detanya vekiddash et rosho bayyom hahu beom havaat korbenotav divre rabbi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer beom tiglachto

Veha ditnan nazir shennitma tumot harbe eno mevi ella korban echad man tanna amar rav chisda rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi deamar nezirut tohora mishshevii chayela umashkachatte lah kegon shennitma bashshevii vechazar venitma bashshevii umanni rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi kevan delo yatza shaa haruya lehavi korban eno chayyav ella korban echad

Dei tema rabbi hi i denitma bashshevii vechazar venitma bashshevii vechazar venitma bashshevii kullehu tuma arichta hi vei denitma bashshemini vechazar venitma bashshemini hare yatzta shaa sheruya lehavi korban
May tama derabbi amar kera vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh vahadar vekiddash et rosho verabbi yose berabbi yehuda im ken lema kera vekiddash et rosho
b: Beom hahu lema li im eno inyan lishmini tenehu inyan lishvii verabbi name hachtiv bayyom hahu amar lecha rabbi hahu lehachi hu daata lomar lach af al pi shello hevi korbenotav
Verav chisda may duchkeh leokomah kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda lokmah kegon denitma dechazya belel shemini verabbi hi
Middela mokem lah kerabbi lema kasavar lelya lav mechussar zeman hu

Amar rav adda bar ahava ha beha talya i amratte lelya mechussar zeman emat michze lekorban letzafra nezirut name la chayela ad tzafra vei amratte lelya eno mechussar zeman nezirut tohora chayela meurta
Gufa nitma bashshevii vechazar venitma bashshevii eno mevi ella korban echad nitma bashshemini vechazar venitma bashshemini mevi korban al kol echad veechad matchil umone miyyad divre rabbi eliezer
Vachachamim omrim korban echad al hakkol ad sheyyavi chattato hevi chattato venitma vehevi chattato venitma mevi korban al kol echad veechad hevi chattato velo hevi ashamo mone
Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer keshem shechattato ikvattu ken ashamo meakkevo
Bishlama lerabbi eliezer amar kera vekiddash et rosho bayyom hahu af al pi shello hevi korbenotav verabbanan hahu af al pi shello hevi ashamo
Ella rabbi yishmael hahu lema li amar lach hahu af al pi shello hevi olato verabbanan ola la bae miuta doron bealma hu
May tamayehu derabbanan detanya vehizzir la et yeme nizro vehevi keves ben shenato leasham ma talmud lomar lefi shemmatzinu shekkol ashamot shebbattora shehen meakkevin yachol af ze meakkevo

a: Talmud lomar vehizzir vehevi af al pi shello hevi hizzir rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer vehizzir vehevi ematay hizzir bizman shehevi
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan ishsha shennadra benazir venitmea veachar kach hefer lah baalah mevia chattat haof veenah mevia olat haof
Amar rav chisda rabbi yishmael hi
May kasavar i kasavar baal mikar akar chattat haof name la layete i kasavar baal migaz gayez olat haof name layete leolam kasavar baal mikar akar verabbi yishmael savar lah kerabbi elazar hakkappar

Detanya rabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi omer ma talmud lomar vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh vechi beezo nefesh chata ze ella shetztzier atzmo min hayyayin vekal vachomer uma ze shello tzier atzmo ella min hayyayin nikra chote hamtzaer atzmo mikkol davar al achat kamma vechamma
Veha benazir tame ketiv vaanan afilu nazir tahor kaamrinan kasavar rabbi elazar hakkappar nazir tahor name chote hu vehayenu tama dichtiv benazir tame hoil veshana bachet
Yatza venichnas olin lo min hamminyan katane olin lo min hamminyan mishshum deyatza chal aleh nezirut amar shemuel kegon sheyyatza vehizza veshana vetaval
Ella nichnas hu deolin lo min hamminyan lo nichnas en olin lo min hamminyan la mibaya kaamar la mibaya yatza ella afilu nichnas olin lo min hamminyan
Amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav may tama la mefarshatte lan kehalen mile amar lehon amena dilma la tzerichitu

Rabbi eliezer omer lo bo beom shenneemar vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ad sheyyihu yamim rishonim amar ulla la amar rabbi eliezer ella betame shennazar aval bannazir tahor shennitma afilu yom echad soter
b: Amar rava may tama derabbi eliezer amar kera ki tame nizro mishshum divtuma nezar
Etiveh abbaye hareni nazir mea yom venitma bitchillat mea yachol yehe soter talmud lomar vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ad sheyehu lo yamim rishonim veze en lo rishonim

Nitma besof mea yachol yehe soter talmud lomar vehayyamim harishonim yippelu mikkelal deika acharonim veze en lo acharonim nitma beom mea chaser achat yachol lo yehe soter talmud lomar vehayyamim harishonim yippelu mikkelal deika acharonim veze yesh lo rishonim veacharonim
Veha betame shennazar la matzet amratte middekatane hareni nazir mea venitma bitchillat mea vekatane ad sheyehu lo yamim rishonim teuvta
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye halen yamim dekaamrinan denafek chad umatchilin teren o dilma denafkin teren umatchilin telata la hava bideh ata shayeleh lerava amar leh yippelu ketiv

Veitzterich lemichtav yamim veitzterich lemichtav yippelu dei ketav rachamana yamim vela ketav yippelu hava amena ad denafkin teren veayelin telata ketav rachamana yippelu vei ketav yippelu vela ketav yamim hava amena afilu chad ketav rachamana yamim
Matni mi shennazar nezirut harbe vehishlim et neziruto veachar kach ba laaretz bet shammay omrim nazir sheloshim yom uvet hilel omrim nazir battechilla

Maase beheleni hammalka shehalach benah lemilchama veamra im yavo beni min hammilchama beshalom ehe nezira sheva shanim uva benah min hammilchama vehayeta nezira sheva shanim uvsof sheva shanim alta laaretz vehoruha bet hillel shettehe nezira od sheva shanim acherot uvsof sheva shanim nitmet venimtzet nezira esrim veachat shana amar rabbi yehuda lo hayeta nezira ella arba esre shana
Gema katane resha bet shammay omrim nazir sheloshim yom uvet hillel omrim nazir battechilla lema beha kamipalgi devet shammay savri eretz haammim mishshum gushah gazru aleha

a: Uvet hillel savri mishshum avera gazru aleha la dechulle alma mishshum gushah gazru aleha uvet shammay savri bistam nezirut kanesna uvet hillel savri ki kanesna bitchilat nezirut
Maase beheleni hammalka vechu ibaya lehu beshennitmet vealliba devet shammay o dilma beshello nitmet vealliba devet hillel

Ta shema alta laaretz vehoruha bet hillel shettehe nezira od sheva shanim acherot vechu vei salka datach beshennitmet vealliba devet shammay i hachi rabbi yehuda omer lo hayeta nezira ella arba esre shana arba esre shana ushloshim yom mibe leh
Tanya name hachi rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer deamar kera zot torat hannazir hattora amra ki nitma beom melot ten lo torat nazir

Matni mi shehau shette kite edim meidot oto ellu meidim shennazar shettayim veellu meidim shennazar chamesh bet shammay omrim nechleka haedut veen kan nezirut uvet hillel omrim yesh bichlal chamesh shettayim sheyehe nazir shettayim

Gema matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al shette kite edim achat omeret shettayim veachat omeret chamesh sheyyesh bichlal chamesh shettayim al ma nechleku al kat achat echad omer shettayim veechad omer chamesh shebbet shammay omrim nechleka edutan uvet hillel omrim yesh bichlal chamesh shettayim

Amar rav hakkol modim bemone amar leh rav chama lerav chisda may kaamar ilema echad omer chamesh velo shettayim veechad omer shettayim velo chamesh ha ka machchashi ahadade ella echad omer achat ushtayim veechad omer shalosh arba chamesh
b: Ha lema li hashta yesh lomar chamirta amar rav kilta la amar amri bemareva en hachchasha bemone
Hadran alach mi sheamar

Mi sheamar hareni nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani vaani kullam nezirim huttar harishon hutteru kullan huttar haacharon haacharon muttar vechullam asurin amar hareni nazir veshama chavero veamar pi kefiv usari kisaro hare ze nazir

Hareni nazir veshama ishto veamra vaani mefer et shellah veshello kayyam hareni nezira veshama baalah veamar vaani eno yachol lehafer hareni nazir veatte veamra amen mefer et shellah veshello kayyam hareni nezira veatta veamar amen eno yachol lehafer

Gema yatev resh lakish kammeh derabbi yehuda nesia veyatev vekaamar vehu shehitpisu kullan betoch kede dibur vechamma toch kede dibur kede sheelat shalom vechamma kede sheelat shalom kede sheomer shalom talmid larav
Amar leh tuv la shavkatte ravecha letalmida

a: Tanya name hachi mi sheamar hareni nazir veshama chavero veshaha kede dibbur veamar vaani hu asur vachavero muttar vechamma kede dibbur kede sheelat shalom talmid larav
Lema mesayea leh mi sheamar hareni nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani vaani vetu la tanna ki rochla lichshov velezil

Velitne chad velashmeinan hane hacha name umishshum dekatane sefa huttar harishon hutteru kullan huttar haacharon haacharon muttar vechullan asurin mikkelal deika emtzai umishshum hachi katane vaani vaani

Ibaya lehu chad bechavreh mitfis o dilma bekamma mitafsi lemay nafka minah leittefose umezal i amratte chad bechavreh mittefis mittafsin veazlin leolam vei amratte bekamma mittafsi tefe mikkede dibbur la mittafsin may
Ta shema hareni nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani vaani vetu la mide shema minah bekamma hu demittafsi dei salka datach chad bechavreh mitfis litne tuva vaani tanna ki rochla lichshov velezil
Velitne chad velashmeinan kullehon ayede dekatane huttar harishon hutteru kullan huttar haacharon haacharon muttar vechullan asurin mikkelal deika emtzai mishshum hachi katane vaani vaani
Ta shema huttar harishon hutteru kullan rishon hu dishru ha emtzai la shema minah bekamma mittafsin
Ema lach leolam chad bechavreh mittefis veayede devae mitne hutteru kullan dei tena emtzai ika rishon dela mishtere mishshum hachi katane rishon
Ta shema huttar haacharon haacharon muttar vechullan asurin dela ika acharina batreh aval emtzai deika acharina batreh mishtere shema minah chad bechavreh mittefis
Leolam ema lach bekamma mitafsin umay acharon dekatane emtzai veayede ditna rishon tena acharon

Ta shema detanya behedya huttar harishon hutteru kullan huttar haacharon haacharon muttar vechullan asurin huttar emtzai hemennu ulmatta muttar hemennu ulmala asur shema minah chad bechavreh mittefis shema minah
Hareni nazir veshama chavero veamar pi kefiv usari kisaro vechu mishshum deamar pi kefiv usari kisaro hare nazir
b: Urminhu yadi nezira veragli nezira lo amar kelum roshi nezira kevedi nezira hare ze nazir ze hakkelal davar shehanneshama teluya bo hare ze nazir
Amar rav yehuda deamar hachi yease pi kefiv miyyayin usari kisaro millagoz
Hareni nezira veshama balah vaamar vaani eno yachol lehafer ibaya lehu baal mikar akar o dilma migaz gayez lemay nafka minah
Leishsha shennadra benazir veshama chavertah veamra vaani veshama balah shel rishona vehefer lah i amratte mikar akar hahi name ishteray vei amratte migaz gayez ihi ishteray chavertah asira may
Ta shema hareni nezira veshama balah veamar vaani eno yachol lehafer vei salka datach baal migaz gayez lefar leishto vehu litsar ella lav shema minah baal mikar akar
La leolam migaz gayez uvdin hu delefar lah vehayenu tama dela matze mefar kevan deamar lah vaani keman deamar kayyam lichi dame i mitteshil ahakamato matze mefar vei la la matze mefar
Ta shema haishsha shennadra benazir vehifrisha et behemtah veachar kach hefer lah balah im shello hayeta habbehema tetze vetire baeder veim shellah hayeta habbehema hachattat tamut
Vei salka datach baal mikar akar tipok lechullin ella lav shema minah baal migaz gayez
Leolam ema lach baal mikar akar vehayenu tama kevan delo tzericha kappara havat kechattat shemmetu bealeha ugmiri dechattat shemmetu bealeha tamut
Ta shema haishsha shennadra benazir vehayeta shota yayin umittammea lemetim hare zo sofeget et haarbaim hechi dame ilema dela hefar lah baal tzericha lememar
Ella peshita dehefar lah baal vei salka datach baal mikar akar ammay sofeget arbaim ella lav shema minah baal migaz gayez
Leolam ema lach baal mikar akar umishshum dekatane sefa hefer lah balah vehi lo yada vehayeta shota yayin umittammea lemetim enah sofeget et haarbaim

a: Tena name resha sofeget
Ta shema haishsha shennadra benazir venitmet veachar kach hefer lah baalah mevia chattat haof veenah mevia olat haof vei salka datach baal migaz gayez tayete name olat haof
Veella may mikar akar chattat haof name la tayete hachi name veha manni rabbi elazar hakkappar hi

Detanya rabbi elazar hakkappar bar rabbi omer ma talmud lomar measher chata al hannafesh vechi beezo nefesh chata ze ella mippene shetztzier atzmo min hayyayin nikra chote vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma ze shello tzier atzmo ella min hayyayin nikra chote hamtzaer atzmo mikkol davar al achat kamma vechamma
Ta shema detanya behedya haishsha shennadra benazir veshama chavertah veamra vaani uva balah shel rishona vehefer lah hi mutteret vachavertah asura shema minah baal migaz gayez
Rabbi shimon omer im amra lah hareni kemotech shettehen muttarot
b: Mar zutra bereh derav mari amar hay hayenu derami bar chama devae rame bar chama hare alay kivsar zevach shelamim mahu
Ki matpes inish beikara matpes o dilma bitznana matpes

Mi dame hatam kevan deamar hare alay kivsar zevach shelamim af al gav dilachar shennizrak damo matze achel leh bachutz mikdash kadesh aval hacha i salka datach bitznana ka matpes ha hefer lah balah ika deamri hayenu derame bar chama vadday
Amra lah hareni nezira beikvech mahu hareni beikvech becholla milta vesharya o dilma kemikamme delefar lah balah vaasira
Ta shema haishsha shennadra benazir veshama balah veamar vaani eno yachol lehafer vei salka datach ki amar lah hareni beikvech beikara ka matpes lefar lah ledidah velokem dideh
Ella lav shema minah becholla demilta matpes vehilkach hu dela matze mefar ha ishsha deamra hareni beikvech hi name mutteret
La leolam beikara matpes vehacha kevan deamar lah vaani keomer kayyam lichi dame vei mitteshil ahakamato matze mefar vei la la
Hareni nazir veatte veamra amen mefer et shellah veshello kayyam urminhu hareni nazir veatte veamra amen shenehem asurin veim lav shenehem muttarin mippene shettala nidro benidrah
Amar rav yehuda teni mefer et shellah veshello kayyam abbaye amar afilu tema kidkatane barayeta kegon dekaamar lah hareni nazir veatte deka tale nidro benidrah

a: Umatnitin kegon daamar lah hareni nazir veatte may mishshum hachi mefer et shellah veshello kayyam

Matni haishsha shennadra benazir vehayeta shote beyayin umittammea lemetim hare ze sofeget et haarbaim hefer lah balah vehi lo yada shehefer lah balah vehayeta shota beyayin umittammea lemetim enah sofeget et haarbaim rabbi yehuda omer im enah sofeget et haarbaim tispog makkat mardut
Gema tanu rabbanan ishah haferam va yislach lah beishsha shehefer lah balah vehi lo yada hakkatuv medabber shehi tzericha kappara uslicha

Uchshehaya maggia rabbi akiva etzel pasuk ze haya boche uma mi shennitkaven laalot beyado besar chazir veala beyado besar tale taun kappara uslicha hammitkaven laalot beyado besar chazir veala beyado besar chazir al achat kamma vechamma
Kayyotze baddavar atta omer velo yada veashem venasa aono

Uma mi shennitkaven laalot beyado besar tale veala beyado besar chazir kegon chaticha safek shel shumman safek shel chelev amar kera venasa aono mi shennitkaven laalot beyado besar chazir veala beyado besar chazir al achat kamma vechamma

Isi ben yehuda omer velo yada veashem venasa aono uma mi shennitkaven laalot beyado besar tale veala beyado besar chazir kegon shette chatichot achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman venasa aono hammitkaven laalot beyado besar chazir veala beyado besar chazir al achat kamma vechamma
Al davar ze yidu haddovim

Vechol hane lema li tzerichin dei tena gabbe ishsha hatam hu devaaya kappara uslicha mishshum demeikara leisura ikaven aval chaticha safek shel chelev safek shel shumman dilhetera ikaven la bae kappara uslicha
Vei itmar hada deika isura aval ishsha dehefer lah balah dehettera la tive kappara uslicha

Vei itmar hane tarte hava amena hane tarte hu desaggi lehon bechappara uslicha dela ikva isura aval shette chatichot achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman deikva isura la saggi leh bechappara uslicha ka mashma lan dela shena

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam ufoshim yikkashlu vam mashal lishne bene adam shetztzalu et pischehen echad achalo leshum mitzva veechad achalo leshum achila gassa ze sheachalo leshum mitzva vetzaddikim yelchu vam veze sheachalo leshum achila gassa ufoshim yikkashlu vam

Amar leh resh lakish hay rasha karet leh nehi dela ka aved mitzva min hammuvchar pesach miha ka aved ella mashal lishne bene adam ze ishto vaachoto immo veze ishto vaachoto immo leze nizdammena lo ishto ulze nizdammena lo achoto ze shennizdammena lo ishto tzaddikim yelchu vam veze shennizdammena lo achoto ufoshim yikkashlu vam

Mi dame anan kaamrinan chada derech hacha shene derachim ella mashal lelot ushte venotav immo hen shennitkavvenu leshem mitzva vetzaddikim yelchu vam hu shennitkaven leshem avera ufoshim yikkashlu vam
Vedilma hu name leshum mitzva ikaveyn amar rabbi yochanan kol happasuk hazze al shem avera neemar
Vayyissa lot vattissa eshet adonav et eneha et enav ki hi yashra veenay
Vayyar vayyar otah shechem ben chamor et kol kikkar hayyarden ki vead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem ki chullah mashke elcha achare meahavay notne lachmi umemay tzamri ufishti shamni veshikuyay
Veha menas anis tana mishshum rabbi yose bar rav choni lamma nakud al vav uvkumah shel bechira lomar shebbeshichvah la yada aval bekumah yada
Umay hava leh lemibad may dahava hava nafka minah dilfanya acharina la ibi lemishte chamra
Daresh rava may dichtiv ach nifsha mikkiryat oz
b: Umidyanim kivriach armon ach nifsha mikkiryat oz ze lot shepperash meavraham umidyanim kivriach armon shehetil midyanim kivrichin vearmon lo yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal Adonai

Daresh rava veitema rabbi yitzchak may dichtiv letaava yevakkesh nifrad uvchol tushiyya yitgalla letaava yevakkesh nifrad ze lot uvchal tushiyya yitgalla shennitgalla kelono bevatte chenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot ditnan ammoni umoavi asurin veisuran isur olam
Amar ulla tamar zinta zimri zina
Tamar zinta yatzu mimmenna melachim unviim zimri zina naflu alav kamma revavot miyyisrael
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak gedola avera lishmah mimmitzva shello lishmah vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav leolam yaasok adam betora uvmitzot afilu shello lishman shemmittoch shello lishman ba lishman
Ella ema kemitzva shello lishmah dichtiv tevorach minnashim yael eshet chever hakkeni minnashim baohel tevorach man nashim shebbaohel sara rivka rachel velea
Amar rabbi yochanan sheva beilot baal oto rasha beotah shaa shenneemar ben ragleha kara nafal shachav vego
Veha ka mithanya mibbeila dileh amar rabbi yochanan kol tovatan shel reshaim enah ella raa etzel tzaddikim
Shenneemar hishshamer lecha middabber im yaakov mittov vead ra bishlama ra shappir ella tov ammay la ella lav shema minah tovato raa hi shema minah

Gufa amar rav yehuda amar rav leolam yaasok adam betora uvmitzot afilu shello lishman shemmittoch shello lishman ba lishman shebbischar arbaim ushnayim korbanot shehikriv balak harasha zacha veyatza mimmennu rut veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina rut bat beno shel eglon melech moav hayeta

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan minnayin sheen hakkadosh baruch hu mekappeach afilu sechar sicha naa deilu bechira dikrateh moav amar leh rachamana al tatzar et moav veal titgar vam milchama milchama hu dela aval tzaore tzaarinun
Veilu tzeira dikrateh ben ammi amar leh al tetzurem veal titgar vam afilu tzaore la tetzaarinun kelal
Amar rabbi chiyya bar avin amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha leolam yakdim adam lidvar mitzva shebbischar layela achat shekkedamatta bechira litzira

a: Zachta vekadma arbaa dorot beyisrael lammalchut
Matni haishsha shennadra benazir vehifrisha et behemtah veachar kach hefer lah baalah im shello hayeta habbehema tetze vetire baeder
Veim shellah hayeta habbehema hachattat tamut veola tikrav ola shelamim tikrav shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lechem
Hau lah maot setumin yippelu lindava maot meforashin deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach lo nehenin velo moalin bahen
Deme ola yaviu ola umoalin bahen deme shelamim yaviu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veen teunin lechem
Gema man tena devaal la mishtabad lah amar rav chisda rabbanan hi dei salka datach rabbi yehuda hi ammay tetze vetire baeder ha mishtabad lah
Detanya rabbi yehuda omer adam mevi korban ashir al ishto
Vechen kol korbenoteha shehi chayyevet shekkach katav lah kol achraut deit lich alay min kadmat dena
Rava amar afilu tema rabbi yehuda ki meshabad lah bemilta ditzricha lah bemilta dela tzericha lah la
Ika deamri man tanna amar rav chisda rabbi yehuda hi vechi meshabad lah bemilta ditzricha lah bemilta dela tzericha lah la dei rabbanan la meshabad lah kelal
Ella hechi dame dimshabad lah kegon deakneyah lah vechevan deakne lah have denafshah
b: Rava amar afilu tema rabbanan ki makne lah name bemilleta ditzricha lah bemilta dela tzericha lah la makne lah

Im shellah hayeta behemtah chattat tamut veola tikrav hi mena lah haamratte ma shekkanta ishsha kana balah amar rav pappa shekkimmetzatta meisatah ibaet ema deakni lah acher vaamar lah al menat sheen levalech reshut bahen

Haola tikrav ola vehashshelamim tikrav ku amar leh shemuel laavuh bar ihi la titev al karach ad deamratte li hada milta veellu hen arbaa elim sheenan teunin lechem shello veshellah veshelleachar hammita veshelleachar kappara
Shellah ha daamaran shello ditnan haish maddir et beno benazir veen haishsha madderet et benah benazir gilach o sheggilchuhu kerovim micha o shemmichuhu kerovim
Hau lo maot setumin yippelu lindava maot meforashin deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach deme ola yaviu ola umoalin bahen deme shelamim yaviu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lechem
Shelleachar mita menalan detanya hammafrish maot linziruto lo nehenin velo moalin bahen mippene shehen reuyin lehavi bechullan shelamim

Met vehau lo maot setumim yippelu lindava maot meforashin deme chattat yolich leyam hammelach lo nehenin velo moalin deme ola yaviu ola umoalin bahen deme shelamim yaviu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lechem
Shelleachar kappara sevara hu shelleachar hammita may taam dela chazya lechappara shelleachar kappara name ha la chazya lechappara
Vetu leka vehaika ushar kol shalme nazir sheshshechatan shello kemitzvatan kesherim velo olin labbealim leshum chova veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lo lechem velo zeroa
Kemitzvatan ka chashev shello kemitzvatan la ka chashev
Hau lo maot setumim yippelu lindava

a: Vahalo deme chattat meoravin bahen amar rabbi yochanan halacha hi benazir resh lakish amar lechol nidrehem ulchol nidvotam hattora amra motar neder yehe lindava
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar halacha hi benazir ammetu lehachi setumin in meforashin la ella leresh lakish lechol nidrehem ulchol nidvotam may irya setumin afilu meforashin
Amar rava meforashin la matzet amratte kevar paskah tanna deve rabbi yishmael rak kodashecha asher yihu lecha undarecha bevalde kadashim uvitmuratam hakkatuv medabber
Ma takkanatan tissa uvata el hammakom asher yivchar Adonai yachol yaalem levet habbechira veyimna mehem mayim umazon bishvil sheyyamutu talmud lomar veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam
Lomar lach kederech sheatta noheg baola nehog bitmuratah kederech sheatta noheg bashshelamim nehog bevaldehem yachol af velad chattat utmurat asham ken talmud lomar rak divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich hare hu omer asham hu bahavayato yehe

Katane yachol yaalem levet habbechira veyimna mehem mayim umazon bishvil sheyyamutu talmud lomar veasita olotecha ammay ha velad chattat hu digmirin bah mita i lav kera hava amena velad chattat bechol makom
b: Uvalde kadashim bevet habbechira ka mashma lan dela
Katane yachol af velad chattat utmurat asham ken talmud lomar rak lema li kera hilcheta gemiri lah velad chattat lemita azel hachi name ukra leasham hu daata
Asham name hilcheta gemiri lah kol sheilu bechattat meta beasham roe
Ella i mehilcheta hava amena hilcheta vei akreveh la lichayyav aleh velo kelum ka mashma lan kera dei makrev leh kaem aleh baase
Rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich hare hu omer asham hu bahavayato yehe lema li kera gemara gemirin lah kol shebbechattat meta beasham roe
Hachi name vechi ata kera lidrav deamar rav huna amar rav asham shennitak liriyya ushchato leshem ola kasher
Tama denitak ha lo nitak la deamar kera hu bahavayato yehe
Amar mar halacha hi benazir vetu leka vehatanya ushar chayyave kinin shebbattora

a: Shehifrishu maot lekinehem ratza lehavi bahen chattat behema yavi olat behema yavi met vehau lo maot setumin yippelu lindava
Tanna nazir vechayyave kinin dedamu leh ulappoke meha detanya mi shehaya mechuyyav chattat veamar hare alay ola vehifrish maot veamar hare ellu lechovati
Ratza lehavi bahen chattat behema lo yavi olat behema lo yavi met vehau lo maot setumim yelchu leyam hammelach
Amar rav ashe ha deamratte meforashin la la tema deamar ellu lechattati veellu leolati veellu lishlamay ella afilu amar ellu lechattati ulolati velishlamay meforashin hen
Veika deamri amar rav ashe la tema ad deamar ellu lechattati ulolati velishlamay ella afilu amar ellu lechovati hare hen kimforashin
Amar rava ha daamaran maot setumin yippelu lindava im nafla deme chattat mibbenehen hare hen kimforashin
b: Tanya keoteh derava ellu lechattati vehashshear lishar neziruti deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach vehashshear yavi chetzo leola vechetzo lishlamim umoalin bechullan veen moalin bemiktzatan
Ellu leolati vehashshear lishar neziruti deme ola yaviu ola umoalin bahen vehashshear yippelu lindava umoalin bechullan veen moalin bemiktzatan
Amar rav huna amar rav lo shanu ella maot aval behema hare hi kimforeshet
Amar rav nachman ha deamri behema hare hi kimforeshet lo shanu ella temima aval baalat mum hare hi kistuma aval nesacha la

Verav nachman bar yitzchak amar afilu nesacha aval sevar shel korot la amar leh rav shimi bar ashe lerav pappa may tamayehu derabbanan deamri maot velo behema vela nesacha maot vela seora ella meatta maot velo ofot
Vechi tema hachi name ella ha deamar rav chisda en hakkinin mitparshot ella i bilkichat bealim i baasiyyat kohen
Ammay ha maot gemirin lah

a: Amar leh velitamach ha ditnan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hevi shalosh behemot velo peresh haruya lechattat tikrav chattat leola tikrav ola lishlamim tikrav shelamim ammay ha amratte behema lav kimforeshet damya
Amar leh hatam velakach veasa
Amar rachamana i bilkichat bealim i baasiyyat kohen hacha name
b: Mi matzet amratte haden dechattat tikrav ola hacha nekeva hacha zachar

Metiv rav hamnuna umi amrinan behema baalat mum kistuma damya ta shema ketzad amru haish megalleach al nezirut aviv bizman shehaya hu veaviv nezirim vehifrish aviv maot linziruto vamet veamar hareni nazir al menat sheagalleach al meot abba
Hau lo maot setumot yippelu lindava hayeta lo behema mufreshet chattat tamut ola tikrav ola ushlamim yekarvu shelamim may lav afilu baalat mum
Lo temima aval baalat mum kistuma damya may irya maot lema hayeta lo behema baalat mum yippelu lindava
Hachi name baalat mum lemay kaddisha lidme deme hayenu maot
Metiv rava korbano bekorbano hu yotze veeno yotze bekorban aviv yachol lo yetze bekorbano shel aviv shehifrish min hakkalla al hachamura o min hachamura al hakkalla
Aval yotze bekorban shehifrish aviv min hakkalla al hakkalla o min hachamura al hachamura talmud lomar korbano korbano bekorbano hu yotze veeno yotze bekorbano shel aviv

Yachol lo yetze bekorban aviv bivhema shehifrish afilu min hakkalla al hakkalla min hachamura al hachamura shehare en adam megalleach al behemat aviv binzirut aval yotze bemaot shehifrish aviv afilu min hachamura al hakkalla o min hakkalla al hachamura shehare adam megalleach al meot aviv binzirut

a: Bizman shehen setumin velo bizman shehen meforashin talmud lomar korbano bekorbano hu yotze veeno yotze bekorban aviv

Yachol lo yetze bemaot shehifrish afilu min hakkalla al hakkalla min hachamura al hachamura aval yotze bekorban shehifrish leatzmo min hakkalla al hachamura min hachamura al hakkalla talmud lomar korbano al chattato ad sheyehe korbano leshum cheto
Yachol lo yetze bivhema shehifrish leatzmo min hakkalla al hakkalla o min hachamura al hachamura afilu min hakkalla al hachamura o min hachamura al hakkalla
Shekken im hifrish behema al hachelev vehevi al haddam o al haddam vehevi al hachelev shehare lo maal velo kiper
Aval yotze bemaot shehifrish leatzmo min hakkalla lakkalla umin hachamura lachamura min hachamura lakkalla umin hakkalla lachamura
Shekken im hifrish leatzmo maot min hachelev vehevi al haddam al haddam vehevi al hachelev shehare maal vechiper
Talmud lomar al chattato ad sheyehe korbano leshem cheto
Katane mihat behema may lav afilu baalat mum la temima
Aval baalat mum may kistuma damya may irya dekatane maot shehifrish aviv litne baalat mum hachi name dilmay chazya lidme deme hayenu maot
Matni nizrak aleha echad min haddamim eno yachol lehafer rabbi akiva omer afilu nishchata aleha achat mikkol habbehemot eno yachol lehafer

Bamme devarim amurim betiglachat hattohora aval betiglachat hattuma yafer shehu yachol lomar i efshi beishsha menuvelet rabbi meir omer af betiglachat hattohora yafer shehu yachol lomar i efshi beishsha megallachat
Gema matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer dei rabbi eliezer haamar tiglachat meakkevet vechevan dela gilcha asira bechamra vechevan deit lah niuul matze mefar uvha peligi
b: Tanna didan savar kevan deizderik alah dam lealtar sharya bechamra veha let lah niuul verabbi akiva savar afilu ishtechitat behema eno yachol lehafer mishshum hefsed kadashim

Matkef lah rabbi zera veammay lizrok daman shello lishman veyattir basar baachila mi la tanya kivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello lishman o sheshshechatan lifne zemannan o leachar zemannan haddam yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel
Veim hayeta shabbat lo yizzarek veim zarak hurtza lehaktir emurin laerev
Amri i dishchat ola o shelamim hachi name ella hacha bemay askinan kegon sheshshachat chattat beresha
Keditnan im gilach al achat mishsheloshtan yatza

Bamme devarim amurim betiglachat tohora aval betiglachat tuma yafer mippene sheyyachol lomar i efshi beishsha menuvelet verabbi meir omer afilu betiglachat tohora yafer mippene sheyyachol lomar i efshi beishsha megallachat
Vetanna kamma amar lach efshar befea nochrit verabbi meir savar befea nochrit ayede dezuhama la nicha leh
Matni haish maddir et beno benazir veen haishsha madderet et benah benazir ketzad gilach o sheggilchuhu kerovav micha o shemmichu kerovav
Hayeta lo behema mufreshet hachattat tamut vehaola tikrav ola ushlamim yikrevu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lechem

Hau lo maot setumin yippelu lindava maot meforashim deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach lo nehenin velo moalin deme ola yaviu ola umoalin bahen deme shelamim yaviu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lechem
Gema ish in aval ishsha la may tama rabbi yochanan amar halacha hi benazir verabbi yose berabbi chanina

a: Amar resh lakish kede lechannecho bemitzot i hachi afilu ishsha name savar ish chayyav lechannech beno bemitzot veen haishsha chayyevet lechannech et benah
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar halacha hi benazir ammetu lehachi beno in bitto la ella leresh lakish afilu bitto kasavar beno chayyav lechannecho bitto eno chayyav lechannechah
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar halacha hi benazir ahachi binzirut in bindarim la ella leresh lakish afilu nedarim name
La mibaya kaamar la mibaya bindarim delet leh niuul ella afilu binzirut deit leh niuul afilu hachi chayyav lechannecho
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar halacha hi benazir hayenu dekatane micha o shemmichuhu kerovav
Ella lerabbi yose berabbi chanina amar resh lakish kol keminehon kerovim deamrin leh la tagmereh mitzot kasavar kol chinuch dela chashiv la nicha leh
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar halacha hi benazir mishshum hachi megalleach veaved hakkafa
Ella lerabbi yose berabbi chanina amar resh lakish kede lechannecho bemitzot ha kaaved hakkafa
Kasavar hakkafat kol harosh midderabbanan vechinuch midderabbanan veate chinuch derabbanan vedache hakkafa derabbanan
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar halacha hi benazir ahachi megalleach mayete korban
Ella lerabbi yose berabbi chanina amar resh lakish kede lechannecho bemitzot ha ka mayete chullin laazara kasavar chullin baazara lav deorayeta
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar halacha hi benazir ahachi ki mitamme mayete korban tziporin veachel kohen melika
Ella lerabbi yose berabbi chanina amar resh lakish ha kaachel nevela
Kasavar kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda deen shechita laof min hattora vechullin baazara lav deorayeta

Vesavar rabbi yose hachi vehatanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer minnayin lechattat haof shehi baa al hassafek sheenah neechelet talmud lomar vehazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva makkish nekeva lezachar ma zachar mevi korban al havadday af nekeva mevia korban al havadday uma zachar mevi al hassafek af nekeva mevia al hassafek
Uma zachar mimmin shehu mevi al havadday mevi al hassafek af nekeva mimmin shehi mevia al havadday mevia al hassafek i ma zachar mevi korban veneechal af nekeva mevia korban veneechal amarta
b: Lo im amarta bezachar shekken isur echad tomar binkeva sheshshene isurin
May shene isurin lav isur nevela vechullin baazara matkef lah rav acha bereh derav ika vedilma michayyav aleh mishshum demitchaze kitren isurin midderabbanan
Lema ketannae ad matay maddir et beno benazir ad sheyyavi shette searot divre rabbi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyaggia leonat nedarim

May lav tannae hi derabbi savar halacha hi benazir veaf al gav dehiggia leonat nedarim maddir leh veazel ad demayete shette searot verabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar ad sheyyaggia leonat nedarim savar kede lechannecho bemitzot vechevan denafek mershuteh tu la michayyav
Amri la dechulle alma halacha hi benazir vehacha bemufla hassamuch leish kamipalgi
Rabbi savar mufla hassamuch leish derabbanan veatya deorayeta dachaya derabbanan verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar mufla hassamuch leish deorayeta
Veibaet ema dechulle alma kede lechannecho bemitzot umufla hassamuch leish derabbanan hi rabbi savar ate chinuch derabbanan vedache mufla hassamuch leish derabbanan
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar ad sheyyaggia leonat nedarim kasavar la ate chinuch derabbanan vedache mufla hassamuch leish
Lema hane tannae ki hane tannae detanya maase berabbi chanina shehiddiro aviv benazir vehevio lifne rabban gamliel vehaya rabban gamliel bodko leda im hevi shette searot im lo hevi

Rabbi yose omer leda im higgia leonat nedarim im lav amar lo rabbi al titztaer levodkeni im katan ani ehye bishvil abba im gadol ani ehye bishvil atzmi amad rabban gamliel unshako al rosho amar muvtach ani baze shemmore halacha beyisrael amru lo hau yamim muatim ad shehora horaa beyisrael
Bishlama lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar ad sheyyaggia leonat nedarim hayenu dekaamar im katan ani ehye bishvil abba ella lerabbi deamar ad sheyyavi shette searot veim gadol ani ehye bishvil atzmi

a: Ha birshuteh daavuh kaem ella deamar ehe bishvil abba ehe bishvil atzmi
I ayeti shette searot meikara kaem binzirut dileh ulvassof kaem binzirut daavuh vei ayeti bemitze may
Hanicha lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar ad sheyyaggia leonat nedarim
Ella lerabbi deamar ad sheyyavi shette searot may ika lememar amri lerabbi leka takkanta ad deyatev dileh veyatev daavuhi

Matni haish megalleach al nezirut aviv veen haishsha megallachat al nezirut aviha ketzad mi shehaya aviv nazir vehifrish maot setumim al neziruto vamet veamar hareni nazir al menat sheagalleach al meot abba

Amar rabbi yose hare ellu yippelu lindava en ze megalleach al nezirut aviv ezehu shemmegallech al nezirut aviv mi shehaya hu veaviv nezirim vehifrish aviv maot setumim linziruto vamet ze hu shemmegalleach al nezirut aviv
Gema may tama amar rabbi yochanan halacha hi benazir peshita may lememra deven yoresh et aviv bat la
La tzericha delet leh ella bat mahu detema yorshin gemirin lah
b: Ka mashma lan halacha
Ibaya lehu peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yose o la peligi veim timtze lomar peligi aresha o assefa ta shema ketzad amru haish megalleach al nezirut aviv

Mi shehaya aviv nazir vehifrish aviv maot linziruto vamet veamar hareni nazir al menat sheagalleach al meot abba zehu shemmegalleach al meot aviv aval mi shehaya hu veaviv nezirim vehifrish aviv maot linziruto vamet hare ellu yippelu lindava divre rabbi yose
Rabbi eliezer verabbi meir verabbi yehuda amru ze hu shemmegalleach al meot aviv
Bae rabba yesh lo shene vanim nezirim mahu hilcheta gemirin lah kol dikdem gallach gallach o dilma yerushsha gemirin lah ufalga have
Bae rava bechor ufashut may hilcheta gemirin lah vehilkach la bae galloche lefum may deshakel o dilma yerushsha hi vechi hechi deshakel pi shenayim hachi megallach
Veim timtze lomar yerushsha hi ulfum deshakel megallach uvchullin hu deit leh pi shenayim aval behekdesh la o dilma kevan dekane leh legilluach la shena
Aviv nezir olam vehu nazir setam aviv nazir setam vehu nezir olam may ki gemirin hilcheta bistam nezirut o dilma la shena
Veim timtze lomar hacha ide veide nezirut tohora bae rav ashe aviv nazir tame vehu nazir tahor aviv nazir tahor vehu nazir tame may teku
Hadran alach mi sheamar
Bet shammay omrim hekdesh taut hekdesh

a: Uvet hillel omrim en hekdesh ketzad amar shor shachor sheyyetze mibbeti rishon hare hu hekdesh veyatza lavan bet shammay omrim hekdesh uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh dinar zahav sheyyaale beyadi rishon hare hu hekdesh veala shel kesef bet shammay omrim hekdesh uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh chavit shel yayin shettaale beyadi rishona hare hi hekdesh vealta shel shemen bet shammay omrim hekdesh uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh
Gema bet shammay omrim hekdesh ku may tamayehu devet shammay deyalfinan techillat hekdesh missof hekdesh ma temura afilu betaut af hekdesh afilu betaut
Uvet hillel omrim hane mile temura aval achote hekdesh betaut la machatinan
Ulvet shammay ma ilu amar hare ze tachat ze lachatzi hayyom mi haveya temura mehahi shata ella ad demate chatzi hayyom hu dehaveya temura hachi name lechi migalleya milta
Amar rav pappa lechach neemar rishon lichsheyyetze rishon
Veha shor shachor kaamar mi la askinan delet leh ella hay la tzericha deit leh teren telata uvet hillel omrim im ken sheyyetze barishon mibe leh
Amar leh rava mibbarnish lerav ashe hay hekdesh betaut hu hekdesh bechavana hu mishshum deatayeh ledibureh kamma
Vesavri bet shammay hekdesh betaut la have hekdesh vehatnan mi shennadar benazir venishal lachachamim vehittiru vehayeta lo behema mufreshet tetze vetire baeder
Amru bet hillel levet shammay i attem modim shehekdesh betaut hu vetetze vetire baeder michlal desavri bet shammay hekdesh betaut have hekdesh
Ella bet hillel hu deka tau savri tamayehu devet shammay mishshum dehekdesh betaut have hekdesh veamri lehon bet shammay lav mishshum hekdesh betaut hu ella mishshum deatayeh ledibureh kamma
Vesavri bet shammay hekdesh betaut la have hekdesh ta shema hau mehallechin badderech
b: Veechad ba kenegdan veamar echad hareni nazir shezze peloni veechad amar hareni nazir sheen ze peloni hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir sheen echad mikkem nazir sheshshenechem nezirim shekkullechem nezirim bet shammay omrim kullam nezirim
Veha hacha hekdesh betaut hu vekatane kullam nezirim amri savri bet shammay hekdesh betaut have hekdesh hacha la

Abbaye amar la ka salka datach dekaem betzafra ella hacha bemay askinan dekaem betihara veamar shor shachor sheyyatza mibbeti rishon leheve hekdesh vaamaru leh lavan nefak vaamar lehon i hava yadana delavan nefak la amari shachor
Umi matzet amratte dekaem betihara asek vehakatane dinar shel zahav sheyyaale teni sheala chavit shel yayin shettaale teni shealta
Amar rav chisda ukkama bechivara lakya chivara beukkama lakya tenan shachor sheyyetze mibbeti rishon hekdesh ka salka datin ki makdish beayin raa makdish veamri bet shammay have hekdesh
Veella may beayin yafa makdish dinar shel zahav sheyyaale beyadi rishon veala kesef bet shammay omrim hekdesh

Veella may beayin raa makdish chavit shel yayin shettaale beyadi rishon veala shel shemen bet shammay omrim hekdesh veha shemen adif miyyayin i mishshum ha la kashya begalila shanu dechamra adif mimmishcha
Resha kashya lerav chisda amar lecha rav chisda ki amari betora dekarmenae
Veamar rav chisda ukkama lemashkeh summaka levisreh chivara leridya vehaamar rav chisda ukkama bechivara lakya ki amari betora dekarmonae
Matni mi shennadar benazir venishal lechacham vaasaro mone mishshaa shennadar nishal lechacham vehittiro hayeta lo behema mufreshet tetze vetire baeder

Amru bet hillel levet shammay i attem modim baze shehu hekdesh taut shettetze vetire baeder amar lahen bet shammay i attem modim bemi shettaa vekara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri shehu mekuddash
Amru lahem bet hillel lo hashshevet kidsho uma ilu taa vehinniach et hashshevet al shemini veal shenem asar shemma asa kelum ella katuv shekkidesh haasiri hu kidesh hatteshii

a: Veet achad asar
Gema manni matnitin la rabbi yose vela rabbanan
Detanya mi shennadar veavar al neziruto en nizkakin lo ella im ken mone bahen isur kayyamim shennahag bahem heter rabbi yose omer dayyo sheloshim yom
I rabbanan kashya nezirut muetet i rabbi yose kashya nezirut merubba
