Ibaet tema rabbi yose veibaet tema rabbanan ibaet tema rabbi yose kan binzirut merubba kan binzirut muetet
Veibaet tema rabbanan la tema mishshaa shennazar ella ema kemishshaa shennazar

Nishal lachachamim vehittiruhu vechu amar rabbi yirmeya middevet shammay nishma lidvet hillel lav amri bet shammay hekdesh betaut have hekdesh kevan deigallay milta delav shappir nazar tetze vetire baeder
Levet hillel name af al gav deamri temura betaut haveya temura hane mile hecha deiteh leikar hekdesh aval hecha demitakar ikar hekdesh itakar name temura
Amar mar i attem modim sheilu kara latteshii asiri ku itmar maaser rav nachman amar tauto velo kauonato rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri tauto vechol shekken kauonato

Amar leh rava lerav nachman ledidach deamratte tauto velo kauonato dekaamri bet shammay levet hillel i attem modim sheilu kara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri sheshshelashtan mekuddashin veishtiku bet hillel
Lemru lehon ma lemaaser shekken eno kadosh bechauona
Amar rav shimi bar ashe hayenu tama dela amri lehon dekal vachomer hu ma maaser sheeno kadosh bechauona kadosh betaut hekdesh shekkadosh bechauona lo kol shekken
Vela hi dehekdesh bedata demareh tele
Matni mi shennadar benazir vehalach lehavi et behemto umtzaah shennigneva im ad shello nigneva behemto nazar hare ze nazir
b: Veim mishshennigneva behemto nazar eno nazir vezo taut taa nachum hammadi keshealu nezirim min haggola umatzu bet hammikdash charev amar lahem nachum hammadi ilu heyitem yodin shebbet hammikdash charev heyitem nozrim amru lo lo vehittiran nachum hammadi
Uchshebba haddavar etzel chachamim amru kol shennazar ad shello charav bet hammikdash nazir umishshecharav bet hammikdash eno nazir
Gema amar rabba shatfuhu rabbanan lerabbi eliezer veokmuh beshittayehu ditnan potchin benolad divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim osrin
Veamar rava af al gav daamur rabbanan en potchin benolad aval potchin bitnay nolad hechi dame amri lehon ilu ata inish vaamar lechon decharav bet hammikdash mi hava nadritun
Amar rav yosef i havay hatam hava amena lehon hachtiv hechal Adonai hechal Adonai hechal Adonai hemma ze mikdash rishon umikdash sheni
Nehi deyadin lehon deyichruv mi yodin leimatti amar abbaye vela yadin leimat vehachtiv shavuim shivim nechtach al ammecha veal ir kodshecha veakkatti mi yadinan behe yoma

Matni hau mehallechin badderech veechad ba kenegdan amar echad mehen hareni nazir shezze peloni veechad amar hareni nazir sheen ze peloni hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir sheen echad mikkem nazir sheshshenechem nezirim shekkullechem nezirim
Bet shammay omrim kullan nezirin uvet hillel omrim eno nazir ella mi shello nitkayemu devarav verabbi tarfon omer en echad mehem nazir
Hirtia laachorav eno nazir rabbi shimon omer yomar im haya chidvaray hareni nezir chova veim lav hareni nezir nedava
Gema mi shello nitkayemu devarav ammay have nazir amar rav yehuda ema mi shennitkayemu devarav

a: Abbaye amar kegon deamar i name lav peloni hu i have nazir umay lo nitkayemu devarav lo nitkayemu devarav harishonim ella devarav acharonim
Hirtia laachorav eno nazir ku tama mishshum dehirtia laachorav ha ate lekamman have nazir manni

Ilema rabbi tarfon mi have nazir kevan divshata deka nazar la yada i peloni hu vei la mi chala aleh nezirut vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon en echad mehen nazir lefi shello nittena nezirut ella lehaflaa
Ella rabbi yehuda dichri hu detanya hareni nazir al menat sheyehe bakkeri hazze mea kor vehalach umtzao shennignav o sheavad rabbi shimon oser verabbi yehuda mattir
Rabbi shimon savar kevan deilu lo nignav dilma hao beh mea kor vehave nazir hashta name have nazir vehacha name kevan dei ata lekamman veyadinan difloni havay have nazir hashta name have nazir
Matni raa et hakkoy veamar hareni nazir shezze chayya hareni nazir shezze eno chayya hareni nazir shezze behema hareni nazir sheen ze behema

Hareni nazir shezze chayya uvhema hareni nazir sheen ze lo chayya velo behema hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir hareni nazir sheen echad mikkem nazir hareni nazir shekkullechem nezirin hare kullan nezirin
Gema tane chada tisha nezirim vetanya idach tesha neziriyyot bishlama tisha nezirin kegon dehave gavre tefe deitfis veazel beh
Ella tesha neziriyyot lechad gavra hechi mashkachatte lah bishlama shet mashkachatte lah keditnan
Aval telat hechi mashkachatte lah amar rav sheshet kegon deamar hareni nazir unzirut hakkol alay
Hadran alach bet shammay
Shelosha minin asurin bannazir hattuma vehattiglachat vehayyotze min haggefen vechol hayyotze min haggefen mitztarfin ze im ze veen chayyav ad sheyyochal min haanavim kazzayit
b: Mishna rishona omeret ad sheyyishte reviit yayin rabbi akiva omer afilu shara pito beyayin veyesh bah kede letzaref kezayit chayyav vechayyav al hayyayin bifne atzmo veal haanavim bifne atzman veal hachartzannim bifne atzman veal hazzaggim bifne atzman rabbi elazar ben azarya omer en chayyav ad sheyyochal shene chartzannim vezag
Ellu hen chartzannim veellu hen zaggim hachartzannim ellu hachitzonim hazzaggim ellu happenimim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer shello tite kezog shel behema hachitzon zog vehappenimi inbal
Gema shelosha minin asurin bannazir hattuma ku hayyotze min haggefen in gefen atzmo la matnitin dela kerabbi elazar detanya rabbi elazar omer afilu alin velulavin bammashma
Ika deamri lah assefa eno chayyav ella ad sheyyochal min haanavim kezayit min haanavim in mehaggefen atzmo la matnitin dela kerabbi elazar detanya rabbi elazar omer afilu alin velulavin bammashma
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi elazar daresh ribuye umiute rabbanan darshi kelale ufrate rabbi elazar daresh ribbuye umiute miyyayin veshechar yazzir miet mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin riba
Miet veriba riba hakkol may riba riba kol mile may miet miet shevishata

Verabbanan darshi kelale ufrate miyyayin veshechar yazzir parat mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin kalal mechartzannim vead zag chazar ufarat perat uchlal ufrat i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash peri ufsolet peri af kol peri ufsolet peri

I ma happerat meforash peri gamur af kol peri gamur amarta im ken ma hinniach lecha hakkatuv bemashmao shello amaro anavim lachim viveshim ha ketivi yayin vachometz ha ketivi ha en alecha ladun kelashon acharon ella kelashon rishon
Umeachar shessofenu lerabbot kol davar ma talmud lomar mechartzannim vead zag lomar lach kol makom sheatta motze perat uchlal i atta rashshay lemoshcho ulduno keen happerat
Ella naase kelal musaf al happerat ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv kederech shepparat lecha bannazir
Amar mar ma happerat meforash peri ufsolet peri af kol peri ufsolet peri peri inve pesolet peri may hi chometz
Af kol peri may hi guharke af kol difsolet peri may hi amar rav kahana leetoye inve dichrin vead zag amar ravina leetoye deven habbenayim

Amar mar i ma happerat meforash peri gamur af kol peri gamur amarta im ken ma hinniach hakkatuv bemashmao shello amaro anavim lachim viveshim ha ketivi yayin vachometz ha ketivi ha en alecha ladun kelashon acharon ella kelashon rishon umeachar shessofenu lerabbot kol davar ma talmud lomar mechartzannim vead zag lomar lach kol makom sheatta motze perat uchlal i atta rashshay lemoshcho ulduno keen happerat ella naase kelal musaf al happerat ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv

a: Kederech shepparat lecha benazir mechartzannim vead zag ulrabbi elazar ben azarya deka mokem lehay mechartzannim vead zag lomar sheeno chayyav ad sheyyochal shene chartzannim vezag perata mena leh savar lah kerabbi elazar dedaresh miet veriba

Vei baet ema kerabbanan dei salka datach kidamar rabbi elazar ben azarya lichteveh rachamana lehay mechartzannim vead zag gabbe perate lemay hilcheta katveh batar kelal shema minah lemedayeneh bichlal ufrat

Veema kulleh lehachi hu daata im ken lichtov o shene chartzannim o shene zaggim o chartzan vezag lemay hilcheta ketav rachamana mechartzannim vead zag shema minah lemidrash beh kelal ufrat veika name lemidrash beh ad sheyyochal shene chartzannim vezag
Verabbi elazar dedaresh miet veriba perat uchlal ufrat mena leh
Amar rabbi avahu nafka leh mehay kera vechi yitten ish el reehu chamor o shor o se parat vechol behema kalal lishmor chazar ufarat perat uchlal ufrat i atta dan ella cheen happerat
Rava amar nafka leh mehay kera veim min parat hatztzon kalal kevashim veizzim chazar ufarat
Perat uchlal ufarat i atta dan ella cheen happerat
Amar leh rav yehuda middiskarta lerava velelaf min haden kera min parat habbehema kalal bakar vatzon chazar ufarat perat uchlal ufrat i atta dan ella cheen happerat
Amar leh min hay leka lemishma minah dei mehatam hava amena habbehema
b: Chayya bichlal behema
Amar leh chayya bichlal behema ha ketiv bakar vatzon vehave leh perat uchlal vei atta dan ella cheen happerat
Umnalan dehachi hu detanya
Venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teave nafshecha kalal babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar parat uvchol asher tishalcha nafshecha chazar vechalal
Kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash peri mipperi vegidule karka af kol peri mipperi vegidule karka
Mikkedi kelal ufrat uchlal keen perata dayeninan kelala batra may ahani ahani leosofe kol dedame leh
Vetu perat uchlal ufrat keen happerat dayeninan perata batraa may ahani i lav perata batraa hava amena naase kelal musaf al happerat
Umikkede teren kelale ufrata utren perate uchlala kelala keen perata dayeninan may ika bene uvene
Ika deilu tarten kelale ufrata i ika perata dedame leh afilu bechad tzad merabbinan tere perate uchlala i ika perata dedame mishshene tzedadin merabbinan bechad tzad la merabbinan
Mikkedi perat uchlal naase kelal musaf al happerat veitrabbi kol mile umiet veriba name riba hakkol veitrabbi kol mile may ika ben miet veriba lifrat uchlal
Ika deilu perat uchlal merabbinan afilu alin velulavin umiet veriba lulavin in alin la
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan kol isurin shebbattora en heter mitztaref leisur chutz meisure nazir shehare amra tora mishrat

a: Zeeri amar af seor beval taktiru keman kerabbi elazar dedaresh kol
I hachi leinyan chametz name in hachi name ella leappoke meabbaye deamar yesh haktara befachot mikkezayit ka mashma lan en haktara befachot mikkezayit

Yatev rav dimi vekaamar lah leha shemata etiveh abbaye hammikpa shel teruma vehashshum vehashshemen shel chullin venaga tevul yom bemiktzatan pasal et kullan mikpa shel chullin vehashshum vehashshemen shel teruma venaga tevul yom bemiktzatan lo pasal ella mekom maggao
Vehavenan bah mekom maggao ammay pasul veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan ma taam hoil vezar loke aleha bichzayit
May tameh
b: Lav mishshum deheter mitztaref leisur amar leh la may kezayit deika kezayit bichde achilat peras
Vaachilat peras deorayeta hi amar leh in i hachi ammay peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi elazar bechuttach habbavli
Amar leh hannach lechuttach habbavli deleka kezayit bichde achilat peras i deka saref leh misraf batla dato etzel kol adam i mishtar ka shatar la mashkachatte kezayit bichde achilat peras

Etiveh shette medochot achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin ulfanav shette kederot achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin venaflu ellu letoch ellu shettehen muttarot sheani omer chullin letoch chullin naflu utruma letoch teruma nafla
Vei salka datach kezayit bichde achilat peras deorayeta ammay amrinan sheani omer
Ella may heter mitztaref leisur ammay amrinan sheani omer ella hannach litrumat tavlin derabbanan hi

Etiveh shette kuppot achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin ulfanehen shette sein achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma venaflu ellu letoch ellu shenehen muttarin sheani omer chullin letoch chullin naflu teruma letoch teruma nafla
Vei salka datach kezayit bichde achilat peras asur ammay amrinan sheani omer

a: Bishlama ledidi deamena mishshum deheter mitztaref leisur kegon dinfishi chullin ella ledidach deamratte mishshum deika kezayit bichde achilat peras ki nefishi chullin may have
Amar leh hannach litruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan
Amar leh abbaye mimmay dehay mishrat leheter mitztaref leisur hu daata dilma liten taam keikar hu daata
Ulabbaye meikara ka kashya leh may dekaamar rav dimi veka motev leh kol halen teuvata hadar amar leh liten taam keikar
Batar deshanni leh amar leh dilma liten taam kaikar hu daata
Lechidtanya mishrat liten taam keikar sheim shara anavim bemayim veyesh bahen taam yayin chayyav umikkan atta dan kol isurin shebbattora

Uma nazir sheen isuro isur olam veen isuro isur hanaa veyesh heter leisuro asa bo taam keikar kile hakkerem sheisuran isur olam veisuran isur hanaya veen heter leisuran eno din sheyyaase bo taam keikar
Vehu haddin leorla bishtayim

Amar leh hahu merabbanan rabbi avahu ki kaamar lerabbi akiva he rabbi akiva ilema rabbi akiva dehacha ditnan rabbi akiva omer afilu shara pito beyayin veyesh bo kede letzaref kezayit chayyav umimmay dilma hu deika kezayit baena
Vechi tema may lememra leappoke mittanna kamma deamar ad sheyyishte reviit yayin
Ella rabbi akiva devarayeta detanya rabbi akiva omer nazir sheshshara pitto beyayin veachal kezayit mippat umiyyayin chayyav

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe lerabbi akiva deka mokem leh lehay vechol mishrat leheter mitztaref leisur liten taam keikar mena leh yalef mibbasar bechalav lav taam bealma hu veasur hacha name la shena
Verabbanan mibbasar bechalav la gamrinan dechidush hu
May chidusheh ilema dehay lechodeh vehay lechodeh shere uvahade hadade asur kilayim name hay lechodeh shere vehay lechodeh shere uvahade hadade asur
Ella dei taru leh kulle yoma bachalava shere umvashshel leh bashshole asur
Verabbi akiva name basar bechalav chidush hu ella
b: Yalef miggiule goyim deamar rachamana kol davar asher yavo vaesh lememra daasiri giule goyim lav tama bealma hu veasur hacha name la shena
Ulrabbanan name tipok lehu miggiule goyim amar leh hatam chidush hu deha bechol hattora kullah noten taam lifgam muttar
Vegabbe giule goyim asur
Ulrabbi akiva name ha chidush hu amar rav huna bar chiyya lo asra tora ella likdera bat yoma delav noten taam lifgam hu
Verabbanan kedera bat yoma name i efshar dela pagma purta

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe midderabbanan nishma lerabbi akiva lav amri rabbanan hay mishrat liten taam keikar umikkan atta dan lechol isurin shebbattora lerabbi akiva name deka mokem leh lehay mishrat leheter mitztaref leisur lema mikkan atta dan lechol isurin shebbattora
Amar leh mishshum dehave nazir vechattat shene chetuvin habbain keechad vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin nazir ha daamaran chattat may hi
Detanya kol asher yigga bivsarah yikdash yachol afilu shello bala talmud lomar bivsarah ad sheyyibbala bivsarah
Yikdash lihot kamoha sheim pesula hi yippasel veim keshera teachel kechamur shebbah
Verabbanan tzerichi dei ketav rachamana gabbe chattat hava amena nazir la ate minah mishshum denazir mikkodashim la yalfinan
Vei ketav rachamana gabbe nazir hava amena minnazir la yalfinan mishshum dachamir isureh daafilu chartzan asir leh hilkach la atya mineh

Verabbi akiva amar lach lemay tzerichi bishlama i ketav rachamana chattat la gamar nazir minah dechullin mikkodashim la gamrinan ella lichtov rachamana benazir vetete chattat mineh deha kol isurin shebbattora ka gamri minnazir
Verabbanan amri lach chattat leheter mitztaref leisur vechullin mikkodashim la gamrinan
Umishrat liten taam keikar mikkan atta dan lechol isurin shebbattora
Verabbi akiva tarvayehu leheter mitztaref leisur vehau lehu shene chetuvin habbain keechad vechol shene chetuvin habbaim keechad en melammedin

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana ella ha detanya mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin limed al isure nazir shehen mitztarfin ze im ze lerabbi akiva hashta yesh lomar heter mitztaref leisur isur leisur mibbaya
Amar leh heter leisur bevat achat isur leisur afilu beze achar ze
Verabbi shimon

a: Delet leh tzeruf mikkol asher yease may daresh beh amar lach hahu mibe leh leolam eno nazir ad sheyyazzir mikkullan
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar kol reviiyyot shebbattora en heter mitztaref leisur chutz merviit shebbannazir shehare amra tora mishrat may ika ben rabbi yochanan lerabbi elazar
Ika benayehu derabbi yochanan merabbi afilu ochalin verabbi elazar mashkin in mide acharina la
Amar rabbi elazar eser reviiyyot hen venaket rav kahana bideh chamesh summakata vachamesh chiuorata chamesh summakata nazir veose fesach shehoru bammikdash vametu

Nazir reviit yayin lenazir ose fesach deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel arba kosot hallalu tzarich sheyehe bahen kede reviit shehoru shata reviit yayin al yore bammikdash shata reviit yayin venichnas lammikdash chayyav mita
Umetu detanya minnayin lirviit dam sheyyotza mishshene metim shehi metammea beohel shenneemar veal kol nafshot met lo yavo

Vachamesh chiuorata challat nazir umtzora shennifselu beshabbat challat reviit shemen lechalla nazir reviit shemen lenazir metzora reviit mayim limtzora shennifselu ditnan ushar kol hammashkin temein poslin et haggeviyya birviit
Beshabbat ditnan ushar kol hammashkin birviit ushar kol hashshofchim birviit
Vetu leka vehaika merviit notlin layyadayim leechad vaafilu lishnayim biflugta la ka mayere
Veha ika haya mevi peyale shel cheres venoten letochah chatzi log mayim min hakkiyyor verabbi yehuda omer reviit biflugta la ka mayere
Vehaika kamma mayim noten letochah kol shehu rabbi zakkay omer reviit biflugta la ka mayere vehaika mikve bar mehahi devatteluha rabbanan
b: Veeno chayyav ella ad sheyyochal min haanavim kezayit vechu tanna kamma la medamme lehon lechol isure nazir lishtiyya verabbi akiva kevan dichtiv vaanavim lachim viveshim lo yochel ma achila kezayit af kol isurin kezayit

Vechayyav al hayyayin bifne atzmo ku tanu rabbanan vaanavim lachim viveshim lo yochel lechayyev al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo mikkan atta dan lechol isurin shebbattora ma kan shehu min echad vehen shene shemot vechayyav al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo af kol shehu min echad vehen shene shemot chayyav al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo
Leetoye chamra chadta veinve
Amar abbaye achal chartzan loke shettayim achal zag loke shettayim achal chartzan vezag loke shalosh rava amar eno loke ella achat sheeno loke allav shebbichlalot

Metiv rav pappa rabbi eliezer omer nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom eno chayyav ella achat amru lo al tishte al tishte vehu shote chayyav al kol achat veachat achal anavim lachim viveshim chartzannim vezaggim vesachat eshkol shel anavim veshata loke chamesh i hachi lilke shesh achat al mikkol asher yaase
Tena veshayyar may shayyer dehay shayyar shayyar lo yachel devaro
I mishshum hay lav shiyyura hu ki katane mide dela iteh beduchta achariti lo yachel devaro iteh bindarim
Amar leh ravina mipparzikya lerav ashe veha shayyar deven habbenayim ella amar rav pappa la tanya mide chamesh veha

a: Otveh chamesh umeachar dela tanya chamesh may tama otveh amar rav pappa ana sevari lav gemara hi bideh vehadar beh vela yadana digmara hi bideh vela hadar beh
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer ku amar rav yosef keman metargeminan mippurtzenin vead itzurin kerabbi yose
Matni setam nezirut sheloshim yom gilach o sheggilchuhu listim soter sheloshim yom nazir sheggilach ben bezug ben betaar o shessifsef kol shehu chayyav
Gema ibaya lehu hay mazya milletachat rave o milleel lemay nafka minah lenazir sheggilchuhu listim veshiyeru bo kede lachof rosho leikaro
I amratte milletachat rave nezirut ha shakleh ella i amratte milleel rave may deakdesh ha kaem
Ta shema meha inba chayya dekaem beikba devinta vei salka datach milletachat rave beresha devinta bae lemekam leolam milletachat rave veaggav chayyuta nachet veazel inba
Ta shema inba meta beresha devinta vei salka datach milleel rave beikba devinta bae lemekam hatam name mishshum delet bah chela saroge sarega veazel
Ta shema mibbelorit dechushiyyim devatar dimgaddelin lah rafya milletachat hatam name ayede dekamta hi mishshichva derafya
Ta shema missekarta derafe amra milletachat vetanya vetu kad tzavi savayya diknehon chaveran
b: Ikve nimhon shema minah milletachat rave shema minah

Veella ha detanya nazir sheggilchuhu listim veshiyeru bo kede lachof rosho leikaro eno soter vei salka datach milletachat rave listor kegon sheggilchuhu achar melot umanni rabbi eliezer hi deamar kol achar melot shiva soter
May tama derabbi eliezer yalef tiglachat tohora mittiglachat tuma ma tiglachat tuma shiva af tiglachat tohora shiva
Vekim lehu lerabbanan kol shiva yomin atya mazya kede lachof rosho leikaro

Nazir sheggilach ben betaar ben bezug o shessifsef kol shehu chayyav tanu rabbanan taar en li ella taar talash merat sifsef kol shehu minnayin talmud lomar kadosh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho divre rabbi yoshiyya
Rabbi yonatan omer taar en li ella taar merat talash sifsef kol shehu patur vehachtiv kadosh yihye memra deim gilach leh betaar kaem aleh baase velo taase
Tanya idach taar en li ella taar talash merat sifsef kol shehu minnayin talmud lomar lo yaavor al rosho umeachar shessofenu lerabbot kol davar ma talmud lomar taar lo yaavor al rosho
Lefi shello lamadnu letiglachat haacharona sheyyihye betaar lelammedo mimmetzora i efshar

a: Sheen danin kal mechamur lehachmir alav
Rabbi omer eno tzarich hare hu omer taar lo yaavor al rosho ad melot hattora amra achar melot lo tehe tiglachat ella betaar
Vehachtiv taar lo yaavor al rosho
Laavor alav bishne lavin
Amar rav chisda lilkot beachat leakkev bishtayim listor eno soter ella berov rosho uvtaar
Betaar in bemide acharina la vehakatane minnayin lerabbot et kol hammaavirin ella ema keen taar

Tanya name hachi nazir shettalash merat sifsef kol shehu eno soter ella berov rosho uvtaar rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon keshem sheshte searot meakkevot bo kach shette searot sotrot bo
Tenan hatam shelosha megallechin vetiglachtan mitzva nazir umtzora ulviyyim vechullan sheggilchu shello betaar o sheshshiyeru shette searot lo asu velo kelum
Amar mar shelosha megallechin vetiglachtan mitzva peshita mahu detema mishshum abbore sear hu vaafilu sach nasha ka mashma lan dela
Katane vechullan sheggilchu shello betaar bishlama gabbe nazir ketiv taar lo yaavor al rosho vegabbe leviyyim ketiv veheeviru taar al kol besaram ella metzora betaar menalan

Vechi tema tete milleviyyim ma leviyyim shekken teunin tiglachat veen tiglachtan ella betaar af ani avi et hamtzora shehu taun tiglachat veen tiglachto ella betaar ika lemifrach ma lilviyyim shekken teunin tenufa begufam tomar bimtzora dela
Ella tete minnazir ma lenazir shekken korbano taun lechem tomar bimtzora dela ella mechada la atya tete mittarvehon
Mehe tete tete milleviyyim ma lilviyyim shekken teunin tenufa begufan nazir yochiach ma lenazir shekken korbano taun lechem leviyyim yochichu
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahem shehen teunin tiglachat vetiglachtan betaar af ani avi et hamtzora shehu taun tiglachat vetiglachto betaar
Amar leh rava mibbarnish lerav ashe velifroch ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken
b: En korbano bedallut tomar bimtzora shekkorbano bedallut
Amar leh rava bar mesharsheya lerava hay tanna meikara amar lelomdo mimmetzora i efshar sheen danin kal mechamur lehachmir alav vahadar amar nelaf middina umiddina name la yalef
Amar leh hahu alliba derabbanan ha alliba derabbi eliezer ditnan veeno chayyav ad sheyelakketennu betaar rabbi eliezer omer afilu likto bemalket uvrahitne chayyav
May tamayehu derabbanan detanya zekano ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar ufat zekanam lo yegallechu yachol afilu metzora ken talmud lomar zekano
Umnalan divtaar detanya ufat zekanam lo yegallechu yachol afilu gilcho bemisparayim yehe chayyav talmud lomar velo tashchit
Yachol likto bemalket uvrahitne yehe chayyav talmud lomar ufat zekanam lo yegallechu ha ketzad ezehu giluach sheyyesh bo hashchata heve omer ze taar
Mimmay dilma leolam afilu likto bemalket uvrahitne name mitzva kaaved veha kaate leashmoinan daafilu betaar la michayyav aleh
Amri i salka datach ki aved name bemalket uvrahitne shappir dame lishtok kera mineh vaana amena uma gabbe nazir deisura ka aved afilu hachi michayyav hacha demitzva lo kol shekken

a: Vetu i salka datach ki aved bemalket uvrahitne mitzva ka aved middela ketiv taar keresh lakish deamar
Kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase im atta yachol lekayyem et shenehem mutav veim lav yavo ase veyidche et lo taase
Verabbi eliezer may tama yalef merosho detanya rosho ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar gabbe nazir taar lo yaavor al rosho yachol af nazir metzora ken talmud lomar rosho

Mimmay dilma leolam afilu likto bemalket uvrahitne mitzva kaaved vechi tema taar lema li lememra daafilu betaar salka datach amena hoil vegabbe nazir ki aved betaar michayyav gabbe metzora name lichayyav ka mashma lan dela
I salka datach ki aved bemalket uvrahitne mitzva kaaved middela ketav taar keresh lakish
Verabbanan hay rosho may darshi beh mibe lehu lemidche lav dehakkafa detanya lo takkifu peat roshchem yachol af metzora ken talmud lomar rosho
Lema li lemichtav rosho vetipok leh mizzekano detanya zekano ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar ufat zekanam lo yegallechu yachol af metzora ken talmud lomar zekano
Lema li lemichtav rosho ulma li lemichtav zekano tzerichi dei ketav rachamana zekano vela ketav rosho hava amena hakkafat kol harosh lo shemah hakkafa lehachi ketav rachamana rosho
b: Vei ketav rosho vela ketav zekano hava amena mashma tarte deate ase vedache et lo taase umashma dehakkafat kol harosh shemah hakkafa veakkatti betaar menalan lehachi ketav rachamana zekano
Verabbi eliezer deate ase vedache et lo taase menaleh yalef miggedilim detanya lo tilbash shaatnez

a: Ha gedilim taase lach mehem
Amar mar vechullam sheggilchu shello betaar o sheshshiyeru shette searot lo asu velo chelum amar rav acha bereh derav ika zot omeret rubbo kechullo middeorayeta
Mimmay middegalli rachamana gabbe nazir beom hashshevii yegallechennu hacha hu dead deika kullo ha bealma rubbo kechullo

Matkef lah rabbi yose berabbi chanina hay benazir tame ketiv machachu alah bemareva mikkede nazir tame divtaar menalan minnazir tahor yalef layete nazir tahor velelaf minnazir tame ma tame ki shayyar shette searot vela kelum avad hacha name ki shayyar shette searot vela kelum avad
Bae abbaye nazir sheggilach veshiyyer shette searot tzamach rosho vechazar vegilchan mahu mi meakkevi o la
Bae rava nazir sheggilach vehinniach shette searot vegilach achat venashra achat mahu amar leh rav acha middifti leravina gilach saara saara ka mibe leh lerava
Ella ema nashra achat vegilach achat mahu amar leh giluach en kan sear en kan i sear en kan giluach yesh kan hachi kaamar af al pi shessear en kan mitzvat giluach en kan
Matni nazir chofef umfaspes aval lo sorek
Gema chofef umfaspes manni rabbi shimon hi deamar davar sheen mitkaven muttar aval lo sorek atan lerabbanan
Resha rabbi shimon vesefa rabbanan amar rabba kullah rabbi shimon hi kol hassorek lehasir nimin meduldalot mitkaven
Matni rabbi yishmael omer lo yachof baadama mippene shemmashsheret et hassear
Gema ibaya lehu mippene shehi mashsheret et hassear tenan o dilma mippene hammashsheret tenan lemay nafka minah
Kegon deika adama dela mattera i amratte mippene shehi mashsheret tenan hecha deyadinan dela mattera shappir ella i amratte mippene hammashsheret kelal kelal la teku

Matni nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom eno chayyav ella achat amru lo al tishte al tishte vehu shote chayyav al kol achat veachat haya megalleach kol hayyom eno chayyav ella achat amru lo al tegalleach al tegalleach vehu megalleach chayyav al kol achat veachat haya mittamme lemetim kol hayyom eno chayyav ella achat amru lo al tittamme al tittamme vehu mittamme chayyav al kol achat veachat
b: Gema itmar amar rabba amar rav huna mikra male dibber hakkatuv lo yittamma keshehu omer lo yavo lehazhiro al hattuma lehazhiro al habbia aval tuma vetuma lo

Verav yosef amar haelohim amar rav huna afilu tuma vetuma deamar rav huna nazir shehaya omed bevet hakkevarot vehoshitu lo meto umet acher venaga bo chayyav ammay ha mitamme vekaem ella lav shema minah amar rav huna afilu tuma vetuma
Etiveh abbaye kohen shehaya lo met munnach al ketefo vehoshitu lo meto umet acher venaga bo yachol yehe chayyav talmud lomar velo yechallel bemi sheeno mechullal yatza ze shehu mechullal veomed
Amar leh vetikshe lach matnitin ditnan haya mitamme lemetim kol hayyom eno chayyav ella achat amru lo al tittamme al tittamme chayyav al kol achat veachat veammay ha mitamme vekaem
Ella kashya ahadade la kashya kan bechiburin kan shello bechiburin
Vetuma bechiburin deorayeta ha amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yannay lo amru tuma bechiburin ella litruma vekadashim aval lenazir veose fesach la vei amratte deorayeta may shena
Kan bechibure adam beadam kan bechibure adam bemet
Aval tuma vetuma la deha mitamme vekaem
Tuma uvia name ha mitamme vekae amar rabbi yochanan kan bevayit
Kan besade

a: Bevayit name kevan deael yedeh istaav ki ayel kulle hay tame hu
Ella amar rabbi elazar tzeraf yado mishshum tuma ika mishshum bia leka vetzeraf gufo tuma uvia bahade hadade kaatu ha i efshar dela ayel chotmo beresha venachet leh tuma
Ella amar rava hichnis yado mishshum tuma ika mishshum bia leka hichnis gufo tuma uvia bahade hadade ka atyan veha i efshar dela ayel etzbeata dechareh beresha venachet lehu tuma

Ella amar rav pappa kegon shennichnas beshida teva umigdal uva chavero ufara alav et hammaaziva detuma uvia bahade hadade kaatyan mar bar rav ashe amar kegon deayel keshehu goses unfak nishmeteh addeyatev detuma uvia bahade hadade kaatyan
Tanu rabbanan lehechallo ad shaa sheyyamut rabbi omer bemotam yittamma ad sheyyamut
May benayehu amar rabbi yochanan mashmaut dorshin ika benayehu resh lakish amar goses ika benayehu leman deamar millehechallo afilu goses leman deamar bemotam ad sheyyamut in goses la
Ulman deamar millehechallo hachtiv bemotam mibe leh lechidrabbi detanya rabbi omer bemotam eno mittamme aval mittamme benigatam uvzivatam
Ulman deamar bemotam ha mibe leh lehay sevara im ken lema kera bemot may bemotam shamatte minah tarte
Ulman deamar bemotam hachtiv lehechallo lehechallo lehachi hu daata bemi sheeno mechullal yatza ze shemmechullal veomed
Ulman deamar millehechallo ha mibe leh lehay sevara im ken lema kera lehechel may lehechallo shamatte minah tarte
Metivi adam eno metamme ella ad shettetze nafsho vaafilu meguyyad vaafilu goses ulman deamar millehechallo ha katane deeno metamme leinyan tammoye ad denafka nafsheh leinyan ittachole ha itachil
b: Amar rav chisda amar rav nikta rosho shel aviv eno mittamme lo may tama amar kera leaviv bizman shehu shalem velo bizman shehu chaser amar leh rav hamnuna ella meatta kaazel befakta daaravot ufaskuh gannave leresheh hachi name dela litamme leh
Amar leh met mitzva kaamratte hashta yesh lomar beachrine michayyav beaviv lo kol shekken
Vehay met mitzva hu vehatanya ezehu met mitzva kol sheen lo kovrin kore vaacherim onin oto en ze met mitzva veha it leh bera kevan dekaazel beorcha kemi sheen lo kovrim dame
Metivi lah yittamma lah hu mittamme veeno mittamme leevareha lefi sheeno mittamme leever min hachay shel aviv aval mechazzer hu al etzem kisora
May mechazzer hu al etzem kisora lav lememra dei michassar purta
La hahi rabbi yehuda hi detanya rabbi yehuda omer lah mitamme veeno mitamme leevareha sheeno mitamme al ever min hachay shel aviv aval mitamme hu leever min hammet shel aviv
Vehatanya rav kahana berabbi eliezer ben yaakov lah mitamme veeno mitamme leevarim perat lichzayit min hammet uchzayit netzel umlo tarod rakav
Yachol lo yittamme lashshidra velaggulgolet ulrov binyanah ulrov minyanah ketiv veamarta alehem hosif lecha hakkatuv tuma acheret

a: Yachol lo yittamme lashshidra velaggulgolet ulrov binyano ulrov minyano shel acherim amarta ma achoto meuchedet sheggufa taluy bo umitamme lashshidra velaggulgolet ulrov binyanah ulrov minyanah af kol sheggufo taluy bo mitamme lashshidra velaggulgolet ulrov binyano ulrov minyano

Hahi name rabbi yehuda hi verav deamar ki hay tanna detanya maase shemmet aviv shel rabbi yitzchak beginzak uvau vehodiuhu leachar shalosh shanim uva veshaal et rabbi yehoshua ben elisha vearbaa zekenim sheimmo
Veamru leaviv bizman shehu shalem velo bizman shehu chaser

Matni shelosha minin asurin bannazir hattuma vehattiglachat vehayyotze min haggefen chomer battuma uvattiglachat mibbayyotze min haggefen shehattuma vehattiglachat sotrin vehayyotze min haggefen eno soter
Chomer bayyotze min haggefen mibbattuma uvattiglachat shehayyotze min haggefen lo huttar mikkelalo vetuma vetiglachat hutteru mikkelalan betiglachat mitzva uvmet mitzva
Vechomer battuma mibbattiglachat shehattuma soteret et hakkol vechayyavin aleha korban vetiglachat enah soteret ella sheloshim veen chayyavin aleha korban
Gema vetuma lo tuttar mikkelalah kal vachomer miyyayin uma yayin sheeno soter lo huttar mikkelalo tuma shessoteret eno din shello tuttar mikkelalah
Talmud lomar leaviv ulimmo lo yittamma leaviv ulimmo lo yittamma aval mitamme hu lemet mitzva

Veyayin yuttar mikkelalo kal vachomer mittuma ma tuma shehi soteret huttera mikkelalah yayin sheeno soter eno din sheyyuttar mikkelalo amar kera miyyayin veshechar yazzir leesor yen mitzva keyen reshut
Veyayin yistor et hakkol kal vachomer mittuma ma tuma shehuttera mikkelalah soteret et hakkol yayin shello huttar mikkelalo lo kol shekken sheyyistor
Amar kera vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ki tame nizro tuma soteret veen hayyayin soter
Vehattiglachat tistor et hakkol kal vachomer mittuma uma tuma shello asu bah metamme kammitamme soteret et hakkol tiglachat sheasu bah megalleach kammitgalleach eno din shettistor et hakkol
Amar kera vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ki tame nizro tuma soteret et hakkol veen tiglachat soteret et hakkol

Vetuma naase bah metamme kammitamme kal vachomer mittiglachat uma tiglachat sheenah soteret ella sheloshim asa bah megalleach kammitgalleach tuma shehi soteret et hakkol eno din shennaase bah metamme kammitamme
Amar kera vetimme rosh nizro limtamme rosh nizro

Vetiglachat lo naase bah megalleach kammitgalleach kal vachomer mittuma uma tuma shehi soteret et hakkol lo asu bah metamme kammitamme tiglachat sheenah soteret ella sheloshim yom lo kol shekken shello naase megalleach kammitgalleach
Amar kera taar lo yaavor al rosho keri beh lo yaavor hu velo yaavor leacher
Vetiglachat lo tuttar mikkelalah kal vachomer miyyayin uma yayin sheeno soter lo huttar mikkelalo tiglachat shessoteret eno din shello tuttar mikkelalah amar rachamana rosho veamar rachamana zekano
Vetiglachat lo tistor kelal kal vachomer miyyayin uma yayin shello huttar mikkelalo eno soter tiglachat shehuttera mikkelalah eno din shello tistor bainan gidul sear veha leka

Veyayin yistor sheloshim yom kal vachomer mittiglachat uma tiglachat shehuttera mikkelalah soteret yayin shello huttar mikkelalo eno din sheyyistor mide hu tama ella mishshum gidul sear gabbe yayin ha kaem searo
b: Matni tiglachat tuma ketzad haya mazze bashshelishi uvashshevii umgalleach bashshevii umevi korbenotav bashshemini veim gilach bashshemini mevi korbenotav bo bayyom divre rabbi akiva amar lo rabbi tarfon ma ben ze limtzora
Amar lo ze tohorato teluya beyamav umtzora tohorato teluya betiglachto veeno mevi korban ella im ken haya meorav shemesh
Gema kablah mineh o la ta shema detane hillel gilach bashshemini mevi korbenotav batteshii vei salka datach kablah mineh layete korbenotav bashshemini
Amar rava la kashya ha detaval bashshevii ha delo taval bashshevii

Amar abbaye ashkachtinhu lechavreh derav natan bar hoshaya deyatvin vekaamrin uva lifne Adonai el petach ohel moed untanam el hakkohen ematay hu ba bizman shehu taval veasa heerev shemesh in lo taval veasa heerev shemesh la
Alma kasavar tevul yom shel zav kezav dame
Amena lehon ana ella meatta gabbe nazir tame name dichtiv vehevi otam el hakkohen el petach ohel moed ematay hu ba bizman shettaval veasa heerev shemesh

a: Mikkede shaare nikanor hecha kayemin beshaare leviyya
Vehatanya teme met muttar likanes bemachane leviyya velo teme met bilvad ella afilu met atzmo shenneemar vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo may immo immo bimchitzato immo bemachane leviyya
Ella amar abbaye tevul yom shel zav kezav dame vaafilu hachi kevan dimchussar kappara la ayel
Vei bemachane leviyya kae ammay ka kare leh ohel moed lememra ma hatam mechussar kappara la ayel af lemachane leviyya name mechussar kappara la ayel
Vehatam menalan detanya tame yihye lerabbot tevul yom od tumato bo lerabbot mechussar kappara

Matni tiglachat hattohora ketzad haya mevi shalosh behemot chattat ola ushlamim veshochet et hashshelamim umgalleach alehem divre rabbi yehuda rabbi elazar omer lo haya megalleach ella al hachattat shehachattat kodemet bechol makom veim gillach al achat mishsheloshtan yatza
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hevi shalosh behemot velo peresh haruya lechattat tikrav chattat leola tikrav ola lishlamim tikrav shelamim
Gema tanu rabbanan vegillach hannazir petach ohel moed vego bishlamim hakkatuv medabber shenneemar ushchato petach ohel moed
Atta omer bishlamim hakkatuv medabber o eno ella petach ohel moed mammash amarta im ken derech bizzaon hu
Rabbi yoshiyya omer eno tzarich hare amra tora lo taale vemaalot al mizbechi kal vachomer lederech bizzaon

Bammidrash befarasha naso daf vegillach hannazir rabbi yoshiyya omer bishlamim hakkatuv medabber o eno vechu im kach amra tora lo taale vechu kal vachomer laddavar shello yegalleach petach ohel moed ella bishlamim hakkatuv medabber
Rabbi yitzchak omer eno tzarich hare hu omer velakach et sear rosh nizro venatan al haesh vego mi sheeno mechussar ella lekicha untina yatza ze shehu mechussar lekicha havaa untina

Ika deamri rabbi yitzchak omer bishlamim hakkatuv medabber atta omer bishlamim hakkatuv medabber o eno ella petach ohel moed mammash talmud lomar velakach et sear rosh nizro mekom shehaya mevashshel sham haya megalleach
Abba chanan omer mishshum rabbi eliezer vegillach hannazir petach ohel moed kol zeman sheen petach ohel moed patuach eno megalleach
Rabbi shimon shezuri omer vegillach hannazir petach ohel moed velo nezira
b: Shemma yitgaru bah pirche chehunna amar lo lidvarecha sota tochiach dichtiv bah veheemidah lifne Adonai vela chayeshinan shemma yitgaru bah pirche chehunna
Amar lahen zo kochelet ufokeset zo enah kochelet ufokeset

Matni haya notel sear rosh nizro umshalleach tachat haddud veim gilach bammedina lo haya meshalleach tachat haddud bamme devarim amurim betiglachat hattohora aval betiglachat hattuma lo haya meshalleach tachat haddud
Rabbi meir omer hakkol meshallechin tachat haddud chutz min hattame shebbammedina bilvad

Gema notel sear rosh nizro tanu rabbanan veachar kach notel et harotev venoten al sear rosh nizro umshalleach tachat haddud shel shelamim veim shilach tachat haddud shel chattat veasham yatza asham benazir tahor mi ika amar rava hachi kaamar veim nazir tame meshalleach tachat haddud shel asham yatza
Mena hane mile amar rava amar kera asher tachat zevach hashshelamim mizzivcho yehe tachtav

Veim shilach tachat haddud shel chattat yatza may tama amar kera zevach lerabbot et hachattat veasham veha appekteh lehay zevach merotev im ken lema kera merotev hashshelamim may zevach shema minah lerabbot chattat veasham
Veema kullah lechattat veasham hu daata im ken lema shelamim vezevach may zevach hashshelamim shema minah tarte

Tanu rabbanan hakkol hau meshallechin tachat haddud chutz mittame sheggilach bimdina mippene shessearo nikbar divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer tehorim kan vechan hau meshallechin temeim kan vechan lo hau meshallechin vachachamim omrim hakkol lo hau meshallechin tachat haddud chutz min tahor shebbammikdash mippene shennaasa kemitzvato

Matni haya mevashshel et hashshelamim o sholkan hakkohen notel et hazzeroa beshela min haayil vechalla matztza achat min hassal urkik matztza achat venoten al kappe hannazir umnifan veachar kach huttar hannazir lishtot yayin ulhittamme lammetim

a: Rabbi shimon omer kevan shennizrak alav echad min haddamim huttar hannazir lishtot beyayin ulhitamme lemetim
Gema tanu rabbanan veachar yishte hannazir yayin achar hammaasim kullan divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim achar maase yechidi
May tamayehu derabbanan ketiv hacha veachar yishte hannazir yayin uchtiv hatam achar hitgallecho et nizro ma hatam achar maase yechidi af kan achar maase yechidi
Ema ad deika tarvayehu i hachi gezera shava lema li
Amar rav tenufa benazir meakkevet alliba deman ilema alliba derabbanan tiglachat amri rabbanan la meakkeva tenufa mibaya
Ella alliba derabbi eliezer peshita haamar rabbi eliezer achar maasim kullam mahu detema kevan dilinyan kappara sheyare mitzva hi hacha name la teakkev ka mashma lan
b: Ume meakkeva vehatanya zot torat hannazir ben sheyyesh lo kappayim ben sheen lo kappayim

Veella ha detanya zot torat hannazir ben sheyyesh lo sear ben sheen lo sear hachi name dela meakkeva vehatanya nazir memorat bet shammay omrim eno tzarich lehaavir taar al rosho uvet hillel omrim tzarich lehaavir taar al rosho
Veamar ravina may eno tzarich levet shammay eno tzarich en lo takkana ha levet hillel yesh lo takkana
Vehayenu derabbi pedat deamar rabbi pedat bet shammay verabbi eliezer amru davar echad
May rabbi eliezer detanya en lo bohen yad varegel en lo tohora olamit divre rabbi eliezer rabbi shimon omer yannichennu al mekomo veyetze vachachamim omrim yanniach al shel semol veyetze

Lishana acharina amri lah amar rav tenufa benazir meakkevet alliba deman ilema alliba derabbi eliezer peshita haamar rabbi eliezer achar maasim kullam ella alliba derabbanan hashta yesh lomar tiglachat amri rabbanan la meakkeva tenufa mibaya
Umi la meakkeva vehatanya zot torat hannazir ben sheyyesh lo kappayim uven sheen lo kappayim veella ha detanya zot torat hannazir ben sheyyesh lo sear uven sheen lo sear hachi name dimakkeva
Vehatanya nazir memorat bet shammay omrim eno tzarich lehaavir taar al rosho uvet hillel omrim tzarich amar rabbi avina may tzarich levet hillel tzarich veen lo takkana
Levet shammay yesh lo takkana ufliga derabbi pedat

Matni gilach al hazzevach venimtza pasul tiglachto pesula uzvachav lo alu lo gilach al hachattat shello lishmah veachar kach hevi korbenotav lishman tiglachto pesula uzvachav lo alu lo gilach al haola o al hashshelamim shello lishman veachar kach hevi korbenotav lishman tiglachto pesula uzvachav lo alu lo
Rabbi shimon omer oto hazzevach lo ala lo aval shear zevachim alu veim gilach al shelashtan venimtza echad mehen kasher tiglachto keshera veyavi shear zevachim
Gema amar rav adda bar ahava zot omeret kasavar rabbi shimon nazir sheggilach al shalme nedava yatza may tama deamar kera venatan al haesh asher tachat zevach hashshelamim velo katav al shelamav

a: Matni mi shennizrak alav echad min haddamim venitma rabbi eliezer omer soter et hakkol vachachamim omrim yavi shear korbenotav veyithar amru lo maase bemiryam hattarmodit shennizrak aleha echad min haddamim uvau veamru lah al bittah shehayeta mesukkenet vehalcha umatza shemmeta veamru chachamim tavi shear korbenoteha vetithar
Gema katane rabbi eliezer omer soter et hakkol vehaamar rabbi eliezer kol achar melot shiva soter amar rav may soter name dekaamar rabbi eliezer soter korbenotav
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane vachachamim omrim tavi shear korbenoteha vetithar shema minah

Umaase name bemiryam hattarmodit shennezarek aleha echad min haddamim uvau vehodiuha al bittah shehayeta mesukkenet vehalcha umatza shemmeta veamru chachamim tavi shear korbenoteha vetithar shema minah
Hadran alach shelosha minin

Kohen gadol venazir en mitammein likrovehen aval mitammein lemet mitzva hau mehallechin badderech umatzu met mitzva rabbi eliezer omer yittamme kohen gadol veal yittamme nazir vachachamim omrim yittamme nazir veal yittamme kohen hedot

Amar lahem rabbi eliezer yittamme kohen sheeno mevi korban al tumato veal yittamme nazir shehu mevi korban al tumato amru lo yittamme nazir sheen kedushshato kedushshat olam veal yittamme kohen shekkedushshato kedushshat olam
Gema bishlama kohen gadol venazir hay savar kohen gadol adif vehay savar nazir adif
Mashuach beshemen hammishcha
b: Umrubbe vegadim mashuach beshemen hammishcha adif deilu mashuach beshemen hammishcha mevi par habba al kol hammitzot veilu merubbe vegadim en mevi
Mashuach sheavar umrubbe vegadim merubbe vegadim adif dimrubbe vegadim aved avoda veilu mashuach sheavar lav bar avoda hu
Avar mechamat keruo veavar mechamat mumo avar mechamat keruo adif deilu hay chazi laavoda lemachar veilu avar mechamat mumo lo chazi laavoda
Ibaya lehu meshuach milchama usgan he minayehu adif meshuach milchama adif dachaze lemilchama o dilma segan adif dachaze laavoda
Ta shema detanya en ben meshuach milchama lisgan ella sheim hau mehallechin bederech umatzu met mitzva yittamme meshuach milchama veal yittamme hassegan
Vehatanya meshuach milchama kodem lisgan amar mar zutra leinyan hachaoto meshuach milchama adif may tama ditlu beh rabbim
Ulinyan tuma segan adif detanya rabbi chanina ben antignos omer lamma tikkenu segan lechohen gadol sheim era bo pesul hare nichnas umshammesh tachtav
Ad kan la peligi ella bechohen gadol venazir ki ka azli bahade hadade aval chad chad lechodeh bar itammoye inun mena hane mile

Detanu rabbanan al kol nafshot met lo yavo bamma hakkatuv medabber i birchokim kal vachomer hu uma kohen hedot shehu mitamme likrovim eno mitamme lirchokim kohen gadol sheeno mitamme likrovim eno din sheeno mitamme lirchokim ella bikrovim hakkatuv medabber
Ulaviv hu deeno mitamme ha mitamme hu lemet mitzva

a: Ulimmo ligzera shava lechidrabbi detanya rabbi omer gabbe nazir bemotam eno mitamme aval mitamme hu lenigam ulzivatam veen li ella benazir bechohen gadol minnayin

Amarta lo yeamer immo bechohen gadol sheen talmud lomar shehare kal vachomer hu uma im bemakom shekkohen hedot mitamme leachiv meaviv en kohen gadol mitamme leaviv makom sheen kohen hedot mitamme leachiv meimmo eno din sheen kohen gadol mitamme leimmo
Im zachita mehaddin ma talmud lomar immo bechohen gadol mufne lehakkish veladun hemennu gezera shava neemar immo benazir veneemar immo bechohen gadol
Ma immo haamur benazir bemotam eno mitamme aval mitamme hu lenigam ulzivatam af immo haamur bechohen gadol bemotam eno mitamme aval mitamme lenigam ulzivatam
Ashkechan kohen gadol nazir menalan detanya kol yeme hazziro la al nefesh met lo yavo

Shomea ani afilu nefesh behema bammashma keinyan shenneemar makke nefesh behema talmud lomar al nefesh met lo yavo benefesh adam hakkatuv medabber rabbi yishmael omer eno tzarich hare hu omer lo yavo binfashot hamtammeot bevia hakkatuv medabber
Leaviv ulimmo eno mitamme aval mitamme hu lemet mitzva
Ad shello yeamer yesh li baddin uma kohen gadol shekkedushshato kedushshat olam mitamme lemet mitzva nazir sheen kedushshato kedushshat olam eno din shemmitamme lemet mitzva

Lo im amarta bechohen gadol shekken eno mevi korban al tumato tomar benazir shemmevi korban al tumato hoil umevi korban al tumato lo yittamme lemet mitzva talmud lomar leaviv ulimmo lo yittamma aval mitamme lemet mitzva

O eno mitamme leaviv ulimmo aval yittamme lishar metim amarta kal vachomer uma kohen hedot shemmitamme likrovin eno mitamme lishar metim nazir sheeno mitamme likrovin eno din shello yittamme lishar metim
b: Ha ma talmud lomar leaviv ulimmo leaviv ulimmo hu delo mitamme aval mitamme hu lemet mitzva

Ad shello yeamer yesh li baddin neemru kelalot bechohen gadol veneemru kelalot benazir ma kelalot haamurot bechohen gadol leaviv eno mitamme aval mitamme lemet mitzva af kelalot haamurot benazir leaviv eno mitamme aval mitamme lemet mitzva
O kelach lederech zo neemru kelalot bechohen hedot veneemru kelalot benazir ma kelalot haamurot bechohen hedot mitamme leaviv af kelalot haamurot benazir mitamme leaviv
Talmud lomar leaviv ulimmo lo yittamma ha lemet mitzva mitamme ha mibe leh lomar sheen mitamme leaviv
Ella leaviv lomar sheen mitamme leaviv leachiv eno mitamme ha lemet mitzva mitamme ulimmo ligzera shava lechidrabbi
Ulachoto lechidtanya detanya leachoto ma talmud lomar
Hare shehalach lishchot et pischo velamul et beno veshama shemmet lo met yachol yittamme amarta lo yittamme
Yachol lo yittamme lemet mitzva talmud lomar leachoto laachoto hu deeno mitamme ha lemet mitzva mitamme
Rabbi akiva omer nefashot ellu harchokin met ellu hakkerovin leaviv ulimmo eno mitamme aval mitamme hu lemet mitzva
Leachiv sheim haya kohen gadol vehu nazir leachiv eno mitamme aval mitamme hu lemet mitzva leachoto kidtanya hare shehaya holech lishchot et pischo velamul et beno ku
Ulrabbi akiva gezera shava derabbi menaleh
Amar lach kevan deamar mar im haya kohen gadol venazir leachiv eno mitamme aval mitamme hu lemet mitzva ma li kohen gadol lechodeh ma li nazir vechohen gadol
Ulrabbi yishmael kohen gadol vehu nazir menaleh kevan dishra rachamana chad lav gabbe met mitzva ma li chad lav ma li teren lavin
Achoto lema li salka datach amena ki shera rachamana lemet mitzva nazir vechohen deisur lave hu aval mila ufesach decharet lo yittamme lemet mitzva ka mashma lan

a: Ulrabbi akiva mikkede la shena kohen gadol lechodeh vela shena kohen gadol vehu nazir nafka milleachiv leaviv ulimmo lema li
Tzerichi dei ketav aviv hava amena hayenu tama dela mitamme leh mishshum dachazaka bealma hu aval immo deyadin diledteh litamme lah
Vei ketav rachamana immo hava amena immo la litamme lah delav azel zarah batrah aval aviv kevan deamar mar lemishpechotam levet avotam ema litamme leh ka mashma lan
Veal kol nafshot met lo yavo lema li
b: Al kol leappoke rechokim met leappoke kerovim nafshot leappoke reviit dam sheyyatza mishshene metim shemmetamme beohel shenneemar al kol nafshot met lo yavo

Matni al ellu tumot hannazir megalleach al hammet veal kezayit min hammet veal kezayit netzel veal melo tarod rakav al hashshidra veal haggulgolet veal ever min hammet veal ever min hachay sheyyesh alav basar karauy veal chatzi kav atzamot veal chatzi log dam
Veal maggaan veal massaan veal ahilan veal etzem kisora al maggao veal massao
Al ellu hannazir megalleach umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii vesoter et hakkodmin veeno matchil limnot ella ad sheyyithar umevi et korbenotav

Gema tanu rabbanan achar petirato shel rabbi meir amar lahen rabbi yehuda letalmidav al yikkansu talmide rabbi meir lechan mippene shekkanteranin hen velo lilmod tora hen bain ella lekappecheni bahalachot hen bain dachak somchos venichnas

Amar lahem kach shana li rabbi meir al ellu tumot hannazir megalleach al hammet veal kazzayit min hammet kaas rabbi yehuda veamar lahen lo kach amarti lachem al yikkansu talmide rabbi meir lechan mippene shekkanteranin hen al kazzayit min hammet megalleach al hammet lo kol shekken

a: Amar rabbi yose yomru meir shachav yehuda kaas yose shatak tora ma tehe aleha amar rabbi yose lo nitzrecha ella lemet sheen alav kezayit basar vaadayin yomar al ever mimmennu megalleach al kullo lo kol shekken
Ella kidamar rabbi yochanan lo nitzrecha ella lenefel shello nitkashsheru evarav begidin hacha name benefel shello nitkashsheru evarav begidin
Rava amar lo nitzrecha ella lerov binyano ulrov minyano sheen bahen rova atzamot
Al kezayit met veal kezayit netzel veezehu netzel besar hammet shekkarash umohal shehirtiach
Hechi dame ilema dela yadinan dedideh hu ki karash may have ella deyadinan dedideh hu af al gav delo karash
Amar rabbi yirmeya bistam i karash mohel hu lo karash dilma kicho venio hu
Bea mineh abbaye merabba yesh netzel livhema o en netzel livhema mi amrinan gemiri netzel deate meadam aval deate mibbehema la o dilma la shena
Hanicha leman deamar tuma chamura ad leger vetuma kalla ad lechelev shappir
Ella leman deamar tuma chamura ad lechelev may ika lememar
Ta shema himchuhu baur tame bachamma tahor vei salka datach ad lechelev afilu bachamma name
Emat mamche leh batar deasrach bechamma kevan deasrach have leh afar
Tenan kol hannitztzok tahor
Chutz middevash hazzifim vehatztzappichit
b: Bet shammay omrim af hammikpa shel gerisin veshel pol mippene shehi soledet laachoreha
Bae rame bar chama yesh nitztzok laochalin o en nitztzok laochalin mi amrinan mishshum deit behu rire vehane let behu rire o dilma mishshum dismichin hu vehacha ha semichin
Amar rava ta shema chelev hammet shehu shalem vehitticho tame haya meforad vehitticho tahor vei salka datach en nitztzok laochalin shalem vehitticho name lithar
Amar rabbi zera ana umar bereh deravina targemna hacha bemay askinan kegon devahade demartach leh salek ammuda denura lefummeh demana vekaresh deiteh kulle gabbe hadade
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ta shema bet shammay omrim af hammikpa shel gerisin veshel pol mippene shehen soldin laachorehen mide irya hatam mishshum dismichin hacha mishshum rire

Veal melo tarod rakav vechamma shiuro chizkiyya amar melo pisat hayyad rabbi yochanan amar melo chofnav tenan melo tarod rakav sheamru yeshnan meikar etzbaot ulmala divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim melo chofnav
Bishlama rabbi yochanan hu deamar kerabbanan ella chizkiyya keman la kerabbi meir vela kerabbanan amri melo pisat hayyad umlo kishre etzbeotav lemala chad shiura hu
Amar leh rav shimi bar adda lerav pappa mimmay dehay mikkishre etzbeotav ulmala lerosh dilma lematta middideh dehave leh melo pisat hayyad teku

a: Tanu rabbanan ezehu met sheyyesh lo rakav met shennikbar arom bearon shel shayish o al gabbe ritzpa shel avanim zehu met sheyyesh lo rakav nikbar bichsuto bearon shel etz o al gabbe ritzpa shel levenim zehu met sheen lo rakav

Amar ulla en rakav ella habba min habbasar umin haggidim umin haatzamot etiveh rava leulla rakav habba min habbasar tahor ha min haetzem tame veaf al gav deleka basar ema hachi rakav habba min habbasar tahor ad sheyyesh etzem babbasar
Ha leka gidim i efshar levasar velaatzamot belo gidim
Amar rav shemuel bar abba amar rabbi yochanan shene metim shekkevaran ze im ze naasu galgallin ze laze metiv rav natan rakav habba mishshene metim tame
Amar rava shekkavru ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo vehirkivu veamdu al melo tarod rakav
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan gazaz searo ukvaro immo naasa lo galgallin tenan hatam kol shebbammet tame chutz min hashshinayim vehassear vehatztzipporen uvishat chiburan kullan temein
Bae chizkiyya searo haomed legalleach tzipporen haomed ligazez may mi amrinan kol haomed ligazez kegazuz dame o dilma hashta miha ha mechubbarin
Venifshot leh midderabba bar bar chana tama mishshum degazaz ha lo gazaz la hachi kaamar gazaz hare ze galgallim lo gazaz mibe leh
Bae rabbi yirmeya rakav habba min heakev mahu ki gamrinan rakav habba mikkulleh met aval deate min akev la o dilma la shena
Ta shema detane rabbi natan berabbi oshaya rakav habba mishshene metim tame vei salka datach habba min heakev la zil hacha dilma derech akev kaate vehacha dilma derech akev kaate
I deirkiv kulleh met vekaate derech akev hachi name ella hacha kegon deirkiv chad ever vekaate derech akev may teku

Bae rabbi yirmeya ubbar bime ishsha have galgallim o la kevan deamar mar ubbar yerech immo hilkach gufah hu vela have galgallin o dilma kevan desofo latzet mifrash paresh minah veim timtze lomar ubbar desofo latzet mifrash paresh minah
b: Shichvat zera bime ishsha mahu mi amrinan kevan dela ittzar ki gufah dame o dilma kevan demealma kaate la
Bae rav pappa pirshah mahu kevan dela mikkayema bidla achla chayyuta hu o dilma ha name mealma ate bae rav acha bereh derav ika oro mahu bae rav huna bar manoach kicho venio mahu
Amar leh rav shemuel bar acha lerav pappa vei salka datach kol hane dekaamar have galgallin rakav dimtamme hechi mashkachatte lah deashkeyeh me dekalim vesachye nasha ushlako beme teverya
Amar abbaye naktinan met shettechano en lo rakav ibaya lehu techano vechazar vehirkiv mahu mide hu tama ella deika basar vegidim vaatzamot vehaika o dilma kivriyyato bainan veleka teku
Tane ulla bar chanina met shechasar en lo rakav velo tefusa velo shechunat kevarot
Metivi lo im amarta bemet sheyyesh lo rov verova o melo tarod rakav tomar bechay sheen lo lo rov velo rova velo melo tarod rakav
Hechi dame dearkiv chad ever dichoteh gabbe met afilu chad ever ika rakav mi katane ha met ha ka mashma lan shum met yesh lo rakav shum chay en lo rakav
Bae rava hirkiv keshehu chay vechazar umet mahu ki gemiri rakav deirkiv keshehu met o dilma hashta miha ha mayet
Ta shema lo im amarta bemet sheyyesh lo rov verova umlo tarod rakav tomar bechay ku
Tama mishshum chay ha met yesh lo rakav mi katane ha met ha ka mashma lan deshum met yesh lo rakav shum chay en lo rakav
Bae rava nemala shechasra mahu shiura gemirin lah veha chasar o beriyya gemiri lah vehaika

a: Amar rav yehuda middiskarta ta shema bahem yachol bechullan talmud lomar mehem i mehem yachol miktzatan talmud lomar bahem
Ha ketzad ad sheyyigga bemiktzatan shehu kechullan veshiaru chachamim bechaadasha shekken hachomet techillat beriyyato bechaadasha shema minah shiura gemiri lah
Amar rav shemaya ki bainan shiura devidla haveya kaadasha la metamma dela nafla bah neshama aval nafla bah neshama la tibe lach

Hashshidra vehaggulgolet ibaya lehu shidra vegulgolet tenan o dilma o shidra o gulgolet amar rava ta shema shidra sheggerad rov ilin shebbah tehora uvkever afilu meshubberet o meforeket temea mippene hakkever
Tama mishshum degerad ha la gerad tame shema minah o shidra o gulgolet katane ha la katane ha ka mashma lan dechi gerad tehora idach tibe lach

Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer shishsha devarim rabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin vechazar bo rabbi akiva umaase sheheviu kuppa melea atzamot levet hakkeneset shel tarsiyyim vehinnichuha baavir venichnas todos harofe vechol harofim immo veamru en kan shidra mimmet echad

Tama deleka shidra demechada haika o shidra o gulgolet demechada nazir megalleach aleha shema minah o shidra o gulgolet tenan la mibaya kaamar la mibaya shidra vegulgolet demimmet echad leka ella afilu o shidra mimmet echad o gulgolet mimmet echad leka

Ta shema mimminyana uma hen shishsha devarim sherabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin al ever min hammet shebba mishshene metim veal ever min hachay shebba mishshene bene adam veal chatzi kav atzamot shebba mishshene metim veal reviit dam habba mishshenayim veal etzem kisora shennechlak lishnayim vehashshidra vehaggulgolet
b: Vei salka datach o shidra o gulgolet hane shiva haveyan ki katane siman yachid shehu gilach veechad
Kol hecha difligi aleh rabbim leappoke etzem kisora deyachid hu diflig aleh detanya etzem kisora shennechlak lishnayim rabbi akiva metamme verabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher
Vei baet ema ki katane ever min hammet ever min hachay la katane
Veibaet ema ki katane kol hecha denazir megalleach al ahilo leappoke etzem kisora dela
Veibaet ema ki katane kol hecha dahadar beh leappoke reviit dam dela hadar beh daamar leh rabbi levar kappara lo tishne reviit dam bachazara shehare limmudo shel rabbi akiva beyado
Veod hammikra mesayeo veal kol nafshot met lo yavo rabbi shimon omer ad yamav haya metamme im mishshemmet chazar bo eni yodea tana hushcharu shinav mippene taaniyyotav

Ta shema detanya bet shammay omrim rova atzamot min haatzamim o mishshenayim o mishshelosha uvet hillel omrim rova min haggeviyya merov habbinyan o merov hamminyan amar rabbi yehoshua yacholni laasot divre bet shammay vedivre bet hillel keechad

Shebbet shammay omrim mishshenayim o mishshelosha o mishshene shokayim veyarech echad o mishshene yerechayim veshok echad hoil verov govho shel adam miggovah uvet hillel omrim min haggeviyya o merov binyan o merov minyan hoil veyeshnan bemifreke yadayim veraglayim shammay omer afilu etzem min hashshidra o min haggulgolet

Shane shammay demachmir lifshot minah tama devet shammay demachmir ha rabbanan ad deika shidra vegulgolet la ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh deshammay ella beetzem echad deate min hashshidra umin haggulgolet aval hecha deiteh beeneh afilu chada minhon
Beay rame bar chama rova atzamot min shidra vegulgolet may ki katane chatzi kav atzamot hecha deika mishshear evarav aval min shidra vegulgolet dachamiri afilu rova atzamot o dilma la shena
Amar rava ta shema hashshidra vehaggulgolet vei salka datach rova atzamot deate min shidra vegulgolet chamir litne al rova atzamot habba min hashshidra ku

a: Veha rava hu deamar lo nitzrecha ella leshidra vegulgolet sheen bahen rova atzamot batar deshamah merabbi akiva
Ta shema shammay omer etzem echad min shidra o min gulgolet shane shammay demachmir tefe
Lifshot minah tama deshammay demachmir ha lerabbanan ad deika chatzi kav atzamot
Dilma ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh deshammay ella beetzem echad aval berova atzamot afilu rabbanan modu
Amar rabbi eliezer zekenim harishonim miktzatan hau omrim chatzi kav atzamot vachatzi log dam lakkol rova atzamot urviit dam lo lakkol umiktzatan hau omrim af rova atzamot urviit dam lakkol
Bet din shelleacharehem amru chatzi kav atzamot vachatzi log dam lakkol rova atzamot urviit dam litruma vekadashim aval lo lenazir veose fesach
Mikkedi en hachraat shelishit machraat amar rabbi yaakov bar idi mippi shemua amru mippi chaggay zecharya umalachi
Al ellu hannazir megalleach al ellu deresha lemaote etzem kisora deal maggao veal massao in veal ahilo la veal ellu desefa lemaote even hassachochit
Vachatzi kav atzamot
b: Chatzi kav atzamot in rova atzamot la hechi dame ilema deit behon atzamot kisora tipok leh mishshum etzem kisora ella deakmach akmoche
Al ever min hammet veal ever min hachay sheyyesh alehen basar karauy en alehen basar karauy may rabbi yochanan amar en hannazir megalleach alehen resh lakish amar hannazir megalleach alehen
Rabbi yochanan amar en hannazir megalleach alehen deha katane beresha al ever min hammet veal ever min hachay vechu sheyyesh alehen kezayit basar in aval en alehem la
Verabbi shimon ben lakish omer megalleach middela katane besefa
Verabbi yochanan amar lach kol hecha demashma mikkelala la katane besefa
Veha chatzi kav atzamot demashma chatzi kav atzamot in rova atzamot la vekatane besefa rova atzamot
Hatam i lav rova atzamot hava amena afilu al maggao veal massao la lehachi itzterich lemitne rova atzamot deal ahilan hu deen hannazir megalleach
Veha chatzi log dam deshamatte minah chatzi log dam in reviit dam la vekatane besefa reviit dam hatam leappoke midderabbi akiva deamar rabbi akiva reviit dam habba mishshene metim metamme beohel

Hay ever min hammet hechi dame i deit beh etzem kisora may tama derabbi yochanan vei delet beh etzem kisora may tama deresh lakish amar lach resh lakish leolam delet beh etzem kisora vaafilu hachi rachamana rabbeyeh
Detanya vechol asher yigga al pene hassade bachalal cherev o vemet al pene hassade ze hammaahil al pene hammet bachalal ze ever min hachay veyesh lo lehaalot arucha
Cherev hare ze kechalal o bemet ze ever hanechlal min hammet o beetzem adam ze rova atzamot o bekever ze kever satum

a: Deamar mar tuma bokaat veola bokaat veoredet veilu gabbe negia amar rav yehuda tanya vechol hannogea baetzem o vechalal baetzem ze etzem kisora o vechalal ze ever hanechlal min hachay veen bo lehaalot arucha
O bemet ze ever hanechlal min hammet o vekaver amar resh lakish ze kever shellifne haddibur
Hay ever min hammet hechi dame i deit beh etzem kisora hayenu hannogea baetzem ella delet beh etzem kisora vaafilu hachi rachamana rabbeyeh
Amar lach rabbi yochanan leolam deit beh veim eno inyan lemaggao tenehu inyan lemassao
Umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii vesoter vechu
Ibaya lehu ha dekatane ad sheyyithar bashshevii kae ad deaved heerev shemesh umanni rabbi eliezer hi o dilma bashshemini kae umay ad sheyyithar ad sheyyavi korbenotav umanni rabbanan hi
Ta shema middekatane sefa matchil umone miyyad ha resha may ad sheyyithar ad sheyyavi korbenotav umanni rabbanan hi deamri nezirut detohora ad shemini la chayela
Matni aval hassechachot vehapperaot uvet happeras
Veeretz haammim vehaggolel vehaddofek urviit dam veohel verova atzamot vechelim hannogim bemet uvime sefaro uvime gemaro al ellu en hannazir megalleach
Umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii
b: Veeno soter et hakkodmim umatchil umone miyyad vekorban en lo beemet amru yeme hazzav vehazzava vime hesgero shel metzora hare ellu olin lo
Gema veellu hen hassechachot ilan hammesech al haaretz ufraot hayyotzot min haggader
Veeretz haammim ibaya lehu eretz haammim mishshum avera gazru aleha o dilma mishshum gushsha gazru aleha
Ta shema umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii vei amratte mishshum avera hazzaa lema li
Ella lav mishshum gushsha la leolam ema lach mishshum avera vechi katane ashsheara
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane vechelim hannogim bemet hane kelim bene hazzaa inun ella shema minah ashsheara

a: Lema ketannae hannichnas leeretz haammim beshida teva umigdal rabbi metamme verabbi yose berabbi yehuda metaher may lav rabbi savar mishshum avera verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar mishshum gushsha
La dechulle alma mishshum gushsha mar savar ohel zaruk shemeh ohel umar savar la shemeh ohel
Vehatanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer teva shehi melea kelim uzrakah al pene hammet beohel temea veim hayeta munnachat tehora
Ella dechulle alma mishshum avera umar savar kevan dela shechicha la gezaru beh rabbanan umar savar af al gav dela shechicha gezaru beh rabbanan
Vehattanya hannichnas leeretz haammim beshida teva umigdal tahor bekaron uvisfina uviskarya tame
Veibaet ema hacha shemma yotzi rosho verubbo lesham peligi
Vehatanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer hannichnas leeretz haammim beshida teva umigdal tahor ad sheyyotzi lesham rosho o rubbo
Umatchil umone amar rav chisda lo shanu ella binzirut muetet aval binzirut merubba mislak name salkin leh
Metiv rav sherevya matchil umone miyyad veen mevattel bahen et hakkodmin bemay ilema binzirut muetet kavae gidul sear
b: Ella lav binzirut merubba vekatane matchil umone miyyad hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah binzirut bat chamishshim yom deyatev esrin veityelida beh tzaraat megallach tzarato vahadar yatev telatin yomin denazir deha it leh gidul sear
Metiv rame bar chama nazir shehaya tame besafek umuchlat besafek

a: Ochel bekadashim leachar shishshim yom
Veshote yayin umitamme lemetim leachar mea veesrim yom
Vetane alah bamme devarim amurim binzirut muetet aval binzirut bat shana ochel bekadashim leachar shette shanim
Veshote yayin umitamme lemetim leachar arba shanim
Vei salka datach salkin leh yome tisge leh beshalosh shanim ushloshim yom

Veod metiv rav ashe en li ella yeme tuma sheen olin lo min hamminyan yeme chilluto minnayin vedin hu yeme tuma megalleach umevi korban vime chilluto megalleach umevi korban ma yeme tumato en olin lo min hamminyan af yeme chilluto en olin lo min hamminyan
Lo im amarta bime tumato shekken mevattel bahen et hakkodmim tomar bime chilluto sheen mevattel bahen et hakkodmin
Amarta kal vachomer hu uma nazir bekever shessearo rauy letiglachat nezirut en olin lo min hamminyan yeme chilluto sheen searo rauy letiglachat nezirut lo kol shekken
Veen li ella yeme chilluto yeme sefaro minnayin vedin hu
b: Ma yeme chilluto taun tiglachat af yeme sefaro uma yeme chilluto en olin lo min hamminyan af yeme sefaro

Yachol af yeme hesgero ken vehaddin noten chalut metamme mishkav umoshav vime hesgero metamme mishkav umoshav im lamadta lime chilluto sheen olin lo min hamminyan af yeme hesgero en olin lo min hamminyan
Amarta lo im amarta bime chilluto shekken chilluto taun tiglachat umevi korban lefichach en olin tomar bime hesgero sheen taun tiglachat veeno mevi korban lefichach yaalu lamminyan
Mikkan amru yeme sefaro vime gemaro en olin lo min hamminyan aval yeme hazzav vehazzava vehesgero shel metzora hare ellu olin lo
Katane mihat la im amarta bime tuma shekken mevattel bahen et hakkodmin tomar bime chilluto bemay ilema binzirut muetet ha bainan gidul sear
Ella lav binzirut merubba vekatane sheen olin lo min hamminyan alma la salkin leh shema minah

Matni amar rabbi eliezer mishshum rabbi yehoshua kol tuma min hammet shennazir megalleach aleha chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash vechol tuma min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach aleha en chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash
Amar rabbi meir lo tehe zo kalla min hashsheretz

Gema verabbi eliezer mishshum rabbi yehoshua gemar lah veha mishshum rabbi yehoshua bar memel gemar lah detanya amar rabbi eliezer keshehalachti leardaskiyya matzati et rabbi yehoshua ben peter rosh shehaya yoshev vedan lifne rabbi meir bahalacha kol tuma min hammet shehannazir megalleach aleha chayyavin aleha mishshum biat mikdash vechol tuma min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach aleha en chayyavin aleha mishshum biat mikdash amar lo al tehe zo kalla mishsheretz

Amarti lo kelum atta baki berabbi yehoshua bar memel amar li hen kach amar li rabbi yehoshua bar memel mishshum rabbi yehoshua kol tuma min hammet shehannazir megalleach aleha chayyav aleha mishshum biat mikdash vechol tuma min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach aleha en chayyavin aleha mishshum biat mikdash heve mishshum rabbi yehoshua bar memel gemir lah
Amru shema minah kol shemateta demitamra beve telata kadmae uvatrae amrinan metziae la amrinan

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak af anan name tenena amar nachum hallavlar kach mekkubbelani merabbi meyasha shekkibel meabba shekkibbel min hazzugot shekkibbelu min hanneviim halacha lemoshe missinay bezorea shevet vechardal bishnayim ushlosha mekomot shennoten pea mikkol echad veechad
Veilu yehoshua vechalev la kachashev shema minah

Matni amar rabbi akiva danti lifne rabbi eliezer ma im etzem kisora sheeno metamme adam beohel hannazir megalleach al maggao veal massao reviit dam shehu metamme adam beohel eno din sheyehe hannazir megalleach al maggaah veal massaah
Amar li ma ze akiva en danin kan mikkal vachomer uchshebbati vehirtzeti devarim lifne rabbi yehoshua amar li yafe amarta ella ken amru halacha

a: Gema ibaya lehu etzem kisora halacha urviit dam kal vachomer veen danin kal vachomer mehalacha
O dilma reviit dam halacha veetzem kisora kal vachomer veen danin kal vachomer mehalacha ta shema etzem kisora halacha urviit dam kal vachomer veen danin kal vachomer mehalacha
Hadaran alach kohen gadol

Shene nezirim sheamar lahen echad raiti echad mikkem shennitma veeni yodea eze mikkem megallechin umviin korban tuma vekorban tohora veomer im ani hu tame korban tuma shelli vekorban tohora shellecha veim ani hu hattahor korban tohora shelli vekorban tuma shellecha

Vesofrin sheloshim yom umviin korban tohora veomer im ani hu hattame korban tuma shelli vekorban tohora shellecha veze korban tohorati veim ani hu hattahor korban tohora shelli vekorban tuma shellecha veze korban tohoratcha
Gema katane shene nezirim sheamar lahem raiti echad mikkem shennitma veeni yodea eze mikkem veammay kol sefek tuma birshut hayyachid mehecha yalfinan leh missota

Ma sota boel venivelet af kol sefek tuma birshut hayyachid kegon deika be tere aval hacha shene nezirim vehay dekae gabbehon ha telata have leh sefek tuma birshut harabbim vechol sefek tuma birshut harabbim sefeko tahor
Amar rabba bar rav huna beomer raiti tuma shennizreka benechem amar rav ashe dayeka name
b: Dekatane veeni yodea eze mikkem shema minah
Megallechin umviin veammay dilma lav temein inun vekaaved hakkafa amar shemuel beishsha vekatan
Velokma begadol vehakkafat kol harosh lo shemah hakkafa middela mokem lah hachi shema minah kasavar shemuel hakkafat kol harosh shemah hakkafa

Mar zutra matne lah leha shemata dishmuel assefa nazir shehaya tame besafek umuchlat besafek ochel bekadashim leachar shishshim yom umgalleach arba tiglachot veha kaaved hakkafa amar shemuel beishsha vekatan

Amar rav huna hammakkif et hakkatan hare hu chayyav amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerav huna vedidach man megallach lehon amar leh chova tikberinun chova livnah kullehu shene derav adda bar ahava la ikkayyam leh zara lerav huna

Mikkedi tarvayehu sevira hakkafat kol harosh shemah hakkafa bemay kamipalgi rav huna savar lo takkifu peat roshchem velo tashchit et peat zekanecha kol sheyyesh lo hashchata yesh lo hakkafa vehane neshe hoil veletanhu behashchata letanhu name behakkafa

Verav adda bar ahava savar echad hammakkif veechad hannikaf bammashma veitakkash makkif lenikaf kol hecha denikaf michayyav makkif name michayyav vehay katan hoil vehu gufeh lav bar unshin hu demichayyav makkif name la michayyav
Lema hakkafat kol harosh tannae hi detanu rabbanan rosho ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar lo takkifu peat roshchem

a: Yachol af metzora ken talmud lomar rosho vetanya idach rosho ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar gabbe nazir taar lo yaavor al rosho yachol af nazir metzora ken talmud lomar rosho

May lav tannae hi leman deamar minnazir kasavar hakkafat kol harosh lo shemah hakkafa vechi ata kera lemidche et lo taase vaase veidach savar hakkafat kol harosh shemah hakkafa vechi ata kera lemidche lav gereda

Amar rava dechulle alma hakkafat kol harosh lo shemah hakkafa vechi ata kera kegon shehikkif ulvassof gilach kevan deilu gallecheh bechad zimna la michayyav ki hikkif ulvassof gilach name la michayyav
Umi ketav kera hachi vehaamar resh lakish kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase im atta yachol lekayyem et shenehem mutav veim lav yavo ase veyidche et lo taase
Ella dechulle alma hakkafat kol harosh shemah hakkafa uman demokem likra lemidche lo taase vaase lav gereda menaleh
Yalef miggedilim deamar kera lo tilbash shaatnez vetanya lo tilbash shaatnez ha gedilim taase lach mehem
Uman denafka leh merosho may tama la nafka leh miggedilim amar lach lechidrava hu daata
Derava rame ketiv venatnu al tzitzit hakkanaf min kanaf petil techelet uchtiv tzemer ufishtim yachdav
Ha chetzad tzemer ufishtim potrim ben beminan ben shello beminan shear minin beminan potrin shello beminan en potrin
Vehay tanna demappek lerosho lelav gereda deate ase vedache et lo taase vaase menalan nafka leh mizzekano
Detanya zekano ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar ufat zekanam lo yegallechu yachol af kohen metzora ken talmud lomar zekano
Uman demappek leh lerosho laase velo taase lelaf mizzekano velitamach dekayema lan bealma
b: Dela ate ase vedache et lo taase vaase lelaf mikkohen dedache
Ella mikkohen la yalfinan ma lechohen shekken lav sheeno shave bakkol nazir mikkohen name la yalef shekken lav sheeno shave bakkol
Uman demokem lehay rosho benazir lema li zekano
Mibe leh lechidtanya zekano ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar ufat zekanam lo yegallechu yachol af kohen metzora ken talmud lomar zekano
Umnalan divtaar detanya ufat zekanam lo yegallechu yachol af gilcho bemisparayim yehe chayyav talmud lomar velo tashchit i lo tashchit yachol liktan bemalket uvrahitne chayyav
Talmud lomar ufat zekanam lo yegallechu ezo giluach sheyyesh bo hashchata heve omer ze taar
Uman demappek leh lehay rosho lelav gereda lema li lemichtav rosho ulma li lemichtav zekano
Mashma lemidche lav gereda umashma lemidche lo taase vaase hilkach shakul hu veyavou shenehen
Kohen minnazir la yalef shekken yeshno bishela nazir mikkohen la yalef shekken lav sheeno shave bakkol uvalma la yalfinan minayehu mishshum deika lemifrach kedaamaran
Amar rav mekel adam kol gufo betaar metivi hammaavir bet hashshechi uvet haerva hare ze loke
Ha betaar ha bammisparayim veha rav name betaar kaamar keen taar
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hammaavir bet hashshechi uvet haerva loke metivi haavarat sear enah middivre tora ella middivre sofrim may loke name dekaamar midderabbanan

a: Ika deamri amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hammaavir bet hashshechi uvet haerva loke mishshum lo yilbash gever simlat ishsha metivi haavarat sear enah middivre tora ella middivre sofrim hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya hammaavir bet hashshechi uvet haerva hare ze over mishshum lo yilbash gever simlat ishsha

Vetanna kamma hay lo yilbash gever may daresh beh mibe leh lechidtanya lo yihye cheli gever al ishsha may talmud lomar im shello yilbash ish simlat ishsha veishsha simlat ish hare kevar neemar toeva hi veen kan toeva

Ella shello yilbash ish simlat ishsha veyeshev ben hannashim veishsha simlat ish veteshev ben haanashim rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer minnayin shello tetze ishsha bichle zayin lemilchama talmud lomar lo yihye cheli gever al ishsha velo yilbash gever simlat ishsha shello yittakken ish betikune ishsha
Amar rav nachman benazir muttar velet hilcheta keoteh amaru leh rabbanan lerabbi shimon bar abba chazena leh lerabbi yochanan delet leh amar lehon mechamat zikna nashru
Hahu deitchayyav negida kammeh derabbi amme igallay bet hashshechi chazyeh dela megallach amar lehon rabbi amme shivkuh den min chavrayya hu
Bea mineh rav merabbi chiyya mahu legalleach amar leh asur amar leh veha ka gadel amar leh bar pachate zeman yesh lo kol zeman shehu gadel nosher
Bea mineh rav merabbi chiyya mahu lachoch amar leh asur bevigdo mahu amar leh muttar ika deamri bea mineh bitfilla bevigdo may amar leh asur velet hilcheta keoteh
b: Matni met echad mehen amar rabbi yehoshua yevakkesh echad min hashshuk sheyyiddor kenegdo benazir

Veomer im tame hayiti hare atta nazir miyyad veim tahor hayiti hare atta nazir achar sheloshim yom vesofrin sheloshim umviin korban tuma vekorban tohora veomer im ani hu hattame korban tuma shelli vekorban tohora shellecha veim ani hu hattahor korban tohora shelli vekorban tuma besafek

Vesofrim sheloshim yom umviin korban tohora veomer im ani hattame korban tuma shelli vekorban tohora shellecha vaze korban tohorati veim ani hu hattahor korban tohora shelli vekorban tuma besafek vezehu korban tohoratcha

Amar lo ben zoma umi shomea lo sheyyiddor kenegdo benazir ella mevi chattat haof veolat behema veomer im tame hayiti hachattat mechovati vehaola nedava veim tahor hayiti haola mechovati vehachattat missafek
Vesofer sheloshim yom umevi korban tohora veomer im tame hayiti haola harishona nedava vezo chova veim tahor hayiti haola harishona chova vezo nedava vezo shear korbani
Amar rabbi yehoshua nimtza ze mevi korbenotav lachatzaim aval hodu lo chachamim leven zoma
Gema velayete amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo amar rabbi yehoshua ella lechadded bah et hattalmidim
Amar rav nachman may lebed leh rabbi yehoshua ledakkayya dela lesru
Matni nazir shehaya tame besafek umuchlat besafek ochel bekadashim achar shishshim yom
Veshote yayin umittamme lammetim achar mea veesrim yom
Shettiglachat hannega doche tiglachat hannazir bizman shehu vadday aval bizman shehu safek eno doche

a: Gema tana bamme devarim amurim binzirut muetet aval binzirut bat shana ochel bekadashim leachar shette shanim
Veshote yayin umitamme lemetim leachar arba shanim
Vetane alah umgalleach arba tiglachiyyot tiglachat rishona mevi tzipporim
Vechattat haof veolat behema sheniyya mevi chattat haof veolat behema shelishit mevi chattat haof veolat behema reviit mevi korban tohora
Amarta tiglachat rishon mevi vechu mimma nafshach shappir kamayete dei vadday metzora hu velav tame hu tziporin chovato vechattat haof safek azla likvura veola haveya nedava
Ulgallecho toch shiva i efshar dedilma lav muchlat hu verachamana amar taar lo yaavor al rosho ad melot
Vei lav metzora vadday have vehu tame chattat haof chovato vetziporin abbaray ka mitavdin vela have chullin baazara veolat behema haveya nedava
Vei lav metzora hu velav tame hu tziporin abbaray ka mitavdin chattat haof likvura olat behema haveya chovato veha bae asham rabbi shimon hi deamar mayete umatne
Tiglachat sheniyya ushlishit tziporin la tzerich deha avad may ika dilma vadday muchlat hu chada lisfek sefaro
Vachada lisfek tumato tiglachat reviit mevi korban tohora umatne
b: Vei vadday nazir hu ola harishona chova vezo nedava veim tame umuchlat hu ola harishona nedava vezo chova veze shear korbano
Tame safek umuchlat vadday ochel bekadashim leachar shemona yamim veshote yayin umitamme lemetim leachar shishshim veshiva yamim
Muchlat safek vetame vadday ochel bekadashim leachar sheloshim veshiva yamim veshote yayin umitamme lemetim leachar shivim vearbaa yamim
Tame vadday umuchlat vadday ochel bekadashim leachar shemona yamim veshote yayin umitamme lemetim leachar arbaim vearbaa yamim
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi shimon ben yochay nazir tahor umtzora mahu sheyegalleach tiglachat achat veola lo lechan ulchan amar lahen eno megalleach
Amru lo lamma amar lahen ilu ze legaddel veze legaddel veze lehaavir veze lehaavir yafe attem omrim achshav nazir lehaavir umtzora legaddel
Velo taale lo lime chilluto vetaale lo lime sefaro veamar lahen ilu ze lifne zerikat damim veze lifne zerikat damim yafe attem omrim ella metzora lifne zerikat damim venazir leachar zerikat damim
