Velo taale lo lime tzarato unziruto vetaale lo lime tzarato vetumato amar lahen ilu ze lifne biat mayim veze lifne biat mayim yafe attem omrim ella tame leachar biat mayim metzora lifne biat mayim
Amru lo yafe amarta shello taale lo lime sefaro velinziruto vetaale lo lime chilluto vetumato deze legaddel veze legaddel hu
Amar lahen nazir tahor vehu metzora ze legaddel veze lehaavir veim nazir tame vehu metzora ze lifne biat mayim veze leachar biat mayim

a: Tane rabbi chiyya ze lifne biat mayim chayyim veze leachar biat mayim ze lifne zerikat damim veze leachar zerikat damim
Shettiglachat hannega vechu bae rame bar chama hane arba tiglachiyyot dekaamar mishshum mitzva o mishshum abore sear tuma
Lemay nafka minah leabbore benasha i amratte mishshum mitzva leabbore benasha la vei amratte mishshum abore sear tuma afilu sachyeh nasha name
May amar rava ta shema umgalleach arba tiglachiyyot i salka datach mishshum abbore sear tuma afilu beshalosh name sagya leh shema minah mishshum mitzva shema minah
Hadran alach shene nezirim
Haggoyim en lahem nezirut nashim vaavadim yesh lahen nezirut chomer bannashim mibbaavadim shehu kofe et avdo veeno kofe et ishto

Gema katane haggoyim en lahem nezirut mena hane mile detanu rabbanan dabber el bene yisrael velo laggoyim veamarta alehem lerabbot et haavadim lema li kera haamratte kol mitzva shehaishsha chayyevet bah eved chayyav bah
Amar rava shane hacha deamar kera lesor issar al nafsho bemi shennafsho kenuya lo yatza eved sheen nafsho kenuya lo hoil veen nafsho kenuya lo ema gabbe nazir name la kamashma lan
Amar mar dabber el bene yisrael velo laggoyim vechol hecha dichtiv yisrael goyim la veha gabbe arachin dichtiv dabber el bene yisrael vetanya bene yisrael maarichin veen haggoyim maarichin
Yachol lo yehu neerachin talmud lomar ish

Shane hacha deamar kera leaviv ulimmo lo yittamma bemi sheyyesh lo av yatza goy sheen lo av lemay ilema leinyan yerushsha vehaamar rabbi chiyya bar avin amar rabbi yochanan goy yoresh et aviv devar tora shenneemar ki yerushsha leesav natatti et har seir
Ella bemi shemmuzhar al kibud aviv mi ketiv kabbed avicha gabbe nazir ella amar kera leaviv ulimmo lo yittamma bemi sheyyesh lo tuma
b: Yatza goy sheen lo tuma menalan delet lehu tuma deamar kera veish asher yitma velo yitchatta venichreta hannefesh hahi mittoch hakkahal bemi sheyyesh lo kahal yatza ze sheen lo kahal
Mimmay dilma karet hu dela michayyav aval itammoye mitammu amar kera vehizza hattahor al hattame kol sheyyesh lo tohora yesh lo tuma vechol sheen lo tohora en lo tuma
Veema tohora hu dela haveya leh tuma haveya leh amar kera veish asher yitma velo yitchatta
Rav acha bar yaakov amar shane hacha deamar kera vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem
Kol sheyyesh lo nachala yesh lo tuma vechol sheen lo nachala en lo tuma i hachi avadim name la
Ella amar rava bishlama gabbe arachin shenneemar bene yisrael bene yisrael maarichin veen haggoyim maarichin yachol lo yehu neerachin talmud lomar ish
Hacha bene yisrael nozrin umviin korban veen haggoyim nozrin umviin korban yachol af lo yehu nezirin kelal talmud lomar ish
Amri i mishshum korban lav mehacha nafka leh ella mehatam leola perat linzirut divre rabbi yose haggelili
Ema bene yisrael nozrin nezirut olam veen haggoyim nozrim nezirut olam yachol lo yehu nezirim talmud lomar ish amar rabbi yochanan mi ketiv nezir olam
Ema bene yisrael maddirin benehem benazir veen haggoyim maddirin benehem benazir yachol lo yehu nezirim talmud lomar ish haamar rabbi yochanan halacha hi benazir
Ema bene yisrael megallechin al nezirut avihen veen haggoyim megallechin al nezirut avihen

a: Yachol lo yehu nezirin talmud lomar ish haitmar amar rabbi yochanan halacha hi benazir

I hachi ish ki yafli neder beerkecha baarachin lema li mikkede haitakkash arachin lindarim deamar kera ish ki yafli neder beerkecha vehatanya gabbe nedarim ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot et haggoyim shehen nodrim nedarim undavot keyisrael
Ish ki yafli baarachin lema li ella hay ish mibe leh leetoye mufla samuch leish
Hanicha leman deamar mufla samuch leish deorayeta ella leman deamar derabbanan ish ki yafli lema li leetoye mufla samuch leish degoy
Hanicha leman deamar bene yisrael neerachin veen haggoyim neerachin yachol lo yehu maarichin talmud lomar ish shappir
Ella leman deamar bene yisrael maarichim veen haggoyim maarichim yachol lo yehu neerachin talmud lomar ish afilu tinok ben chodesh bar aruchi hu ki yafli lema li
Amar rav adda bar ahava leetoye goy gadol deaf al gav degadol hu eno yodea lehaflot
Ella ki yafli dichtav rachamana gabbe nezirut lema li mikkede haitakkash nezirut lindarim ki yafli lema li
Leetoye yadayim sheenan mochichot deitmar yadayim sheenan mochichot abbaye amar haveyan yadayim rava amar la haveyan yadayim leabbaye nicha ella lerava may ika lememar

Ella ki yafli mibe leh lechidrabbi tarfon detanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon en echad mehen nazir lefi shello nitna nezirut ella lehaflaa hanicha lerabbi tarfon ella lerabbanan may ika lememar
Ella mibe leh lechidtanya heter nedarim porchin baavir veen lahen al ma sheyyismochu
Rabbi eliezer omer yesh lahem al ma sheyyismochu shenneemar ish ki yafli ki yafli shette feamim echad haflaa leisur veechad haflaa leheter
b: Matni chomer baavadim mibbannashim shehu mefer nidre ishto veeno mefer nidre avdo hefer leishto hefer olamit hefer leavdo yatza lecherut umashlim neziruto
Gema tanu rabbanan lema rabbo kofo linzirut aval lo lindarim velaarachin
May shena gabbe nazir deamar rachamana lesor issar al nafsho bemi shennafsho kenuya lo yatza eved sheen nafsho kenuya lo i hachi afilu gabbe nedarim name
Amar rav sheshet hacha bemay askinan kegon shehaya eshkol shel anavim munnach lefanav gabbe nedarim dechi mitsar behay la mitsar beacharine la matze kafe leh
Gabbe nezirut dechi mitsar behay itsar bechullehu matze kafe leh vegabbe nedarim mi la askinan deleka ella hay eshkol dei la achel leh chalesh
Ella amar rava kegon shehaya chartzan munnach lefanav gabbe nedarim behay hu demitsar la matze kafe leh gabbe nazir deitsar name beachareni matze kafe leh
Vegabbe nedarim mi la askinan deleka ella hay chartzan dei la achel leh chalesh
Ella amar abbaye lema rabbo tzarich lichpoto linzirut veen tzarich lichpoto lindarim veeno tzarich lichpoto lishvua
May tama deamar kera lehara o lehetiv ma hatava reshut af haraa reshut yatza lehara laacherim sheen harshut beyado
Matni avar mikkeneged panav rabbi meir omer lo yishte verabbi yose omer yishte
Gema lema bedishmuel kamipalgi deamar shemuel hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut veen tzarich get shichrur
Rabbi meir it leh dishmuel rabbi yose let leh dishmuel

La dechulle alma it lehu dishmuel ella man deamar yishte savar sof sof mihdar hadar veate gabbeh lishte chamra ki hechi dela lichchosh ulman deamar lo yishte savar leheve leh tzara ki hechi delihdar gabbeh

a: Matni nazir sheggilach venoda lo shehu tame im tuma yedua soter veim tumat tehom eno soter im ad shello gilach ben kach uven kach soter
Ketzad yarad litbol bimara venimtza met tzaf al pi hamara tame nimtza meshukka bekarka hammeara
Yarad lehaker tahor litaher mittumat met tame shechezkat tame tame vechezkat tahor tahor sheraglayim laddavar
Gema mena hane mile amar rabbi eliezer deamar kera vechi yamut met alav befeta pitom alav bimchuveret lo
Resh lakish amar amar kera ki yihye tame lanefesh o vederech rechoka ki derech ma derech begilluy af kol begilluy
Veella haditnan ezohi tumat hattehom kol sheeno makkirah echad besof haolam aval makkirah echad besof haolam en zo tumat hattehom
Bishlama leman deamar ki derech shappir ella leman deamar bimchuveret lo ki makkirah echad besof haolam may have
Vetu ha detanya hammotze met mushkav lerochbah shel derech bitruma tame benazir uvaasiyyat pesach tahor may shena ella tumat hattehom gemara gemiri lah
Im ad shello gilach vechu man tanna amar rabbi yochanan rabbi eliezer hi deamar tiglachat meakkevet
Bae rame bar chama nitma betoch melot venoda lo leachar melot mahu batar yedia azlinan vidia achar melot hi o la ulmay lemistar
b: Amar rava ta shema im ad shello gilach ben kach uven kach soter hechi dame i deityeda leh betoch melot tzericha lememar ella lav leachar melot shema minah
Vaadayin tibe lach kullo soter o shiva soter leman ilema lerabbanan peshita dechullo soter vei lerabbi eliezer kol achar melot shiva soter
Amar lecha hane mile ki nitma achar melot vehay lifne melot hu o dilma shane hacha didia achar melot hi
Uminah katane ben kach uven kach soter vela kamipalgi
Tanu rabbanan hammotze met mutal lerochbah shel derech litruma tame uvnazir uvose fesach tahor bamme devarim amurim sheen lo makom laavor
Aval yesh lo makom laavor af litruma tahor
Bamme devarim amurim shemmetzao shalem aval meshubbar o meforak afilu en makom laavor chayeshinan shemma ben pirkin avar uvkever afilu meshubbar umforak tame mippene shekkever metzarfo

Bamme devarim amurim bimhallech beraglav aval taun o rachuv tame lefi shemmehallech beraglav efshar lo shello yigga veshello yasit veshello yaahil taun o rachuv i efshar shello yigga veshello yasit veshello yaahil
Bamme devarim amurim betumat hattehom aval tuma yedua sheloshtan temeim
Veezo hi tumat hattehom kol sheen makkirah echad besof haolam makkirah echad besof haolam en zo tumat hattehom
Haya tamun beteven o bitzrorot hare zo tumat hattehom bayyammim uvaafela uvinkike hasselaim en zo tumat hattehom
Velo amru tumat hattehom ella lemet bilvad
Ketzad yarad tzafa enah metammea leinyan sheretz detanya sefek tuma tzafa ben bechelim ben bekarka tehora rabbi shimon omer bechelim temea bekarka tehora

a: May tama detanna kamma amar rabbi yitzchak bar avudimi ketiv bechol hashsheretz hashshoretz kol makom shehu shoretz uchtiv al haaretz ha ketzad vadday maggao tame sefek maggao tahor
Verabbi shimon may tama amar ulla ketiv ach mayan uchtiv yitma ad haarev ha ketzad tzafa bechelim tame bekarka tahor
Tanu rabbanan kol hannitalin vehannigrarin sefekan tame mippene shehen kemunnachin vehannizrakin sefekan tahor
Chutz min kezayit hammet vehammaahil al pene tuma vechol davar shemmetamme millemala kilmatta leetoye zav vezava
Bae rame bar chama met bichli uchli tzaf al pene hammayim mahu batar keli azlinan o batar mita azlinan
Im timtze lomar batar keli azlinan met al gabbe sheretz mahu kevan dehay tumat erev vehay tumat shiva keman demachata tuma bichli damya o dilma tuma semichta hi
Veim timtze lomar keman demachata tuma bichli damya vetame vadday sheretz al gabbe nevela unvela tzafa mahu kevan detarvayehu tumat erev inun tuma semichta hi o dilma hay kezayit vehay kaadasha
Sheretz al gabbe sheretz mahu hane vadday chad shiura ninhu o dilma kevan demippaski mehadade la
Veim timtze lomar sheretz al gabbe sheretz kevan demippaski mehadade keman demannecha bichli dame sheretz al gabbe nevela shennimocha mahu kevan denimocha haveya lah mashke o dilma hay uchla hu

Veim timtze lomar deuchla hu sheretz al gabbe shichvat zera mahu veim timtze lomar kevan demitakkera haveya lah ki uchla sheretz al gabbe me chattat ume chattat tzafin al gabbe hammayim mahu la yadinan teku
b: Amar rav hamnuna nazir veose fesach shehalchu bekever hattehom bashshevii shellahen tehorim may tama dela allima tumat hattehom lemistar
Metiv rava yarad litaher mittumat hammet tame shechezkat tame tame shechezkat tahor tahor
Amar leh modena lach benazir shemchussar tiglachat
Amar leh rava af ana modena lach beose fesach dela mechussar vela chelum amar leh abbaye veha mechussar heerev shemesh amar leh shimsha mimmela arva
Veaf abbaye hadar beh detanya
Yom melot tavi toch melot lo tavi
Yachol lo tavi al leda shellifne melot aval tavi al leda shelleachar melot vetipater mishshettehen
Talmud lomar uvimlot yeme tohora beom melot tavi toch melot lo tavi
Amar rav kahana shane hacha dimchassera korban hatam name mechassera heerev shemesh
Amar leh abbaye shimsha mimmela arva
Matni hammotze met battechila mushkav kedarko notlo veet tefusato
Shenayim notlan veet tefusatan matza shelosha im yesh ben ze laze mearba ammot vead shemone hare zo shechunat kevarot

a: Bodek hemennu ulhallan esrim amma matza echad besof esrim amma bodek hemennu ulhallan esrim amma sheraglayim laddavar sheilu techila metzao notlo veet tefusato
Gema amar rav yehuda matza perat lematzuy met perat leharug mushkav perat leoshev kedarko perat lesherosho munnach ben yarchotav
Tane ulla bar chanina met shechasar en lo tefusa velo shechunat kevarot vechol hane may tama la amrinan dilma goy hu

Matza shenayim rosho shel ze betzad margelotav shel ze verosho shel ze betzad margelotav shel ze en lahen tefusa velo shechunat kevarot matza shelosha haechad yadua ushnayim techila o shenayim techila ushnayim yeduim en lahem tefusa veen lahem shechunat kevarot

Maase berabbi yeshevav shebbadak umatza shenayim yeduin veechad techila uvikesh laasotan shechunat kevarot amar lo rabbi akiva kol sheyyagata larik yagata lo amru shechunat kevarot ella lishlosha yeduin o lishlosha techila
Notlan veet tefusatan hechi dame tefusa amar rav yehuda amar kera unsatani mimmitzrayim tol immi
Vechamma shiur tefusa peresh rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok notel afar tichuach vechofer babbetula shalosh etzbaot
Metivi vechamma shiur tefusa peresh rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok notel et hakkesamin veet hakkesasot
Vezorek et havadain umanniach et hassefekot vehashshear mitztaref lerov binyano shel met ulrova atzamot limlo tarod rakav
Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya vechamma shiur tefusa amar rabbi yochanan mishshum ben azzay notel afar tichuach vechofer babbetula shalosh etzbaot
Bodek hemennu
b: Amar rava badak ufinna badak ufinna bedak veashkach la hay mefanne leh gabbe hanach tere vela hane tere legabbay hay chad
Ika deamri amar rava kevan shennittena reshut lifnot mefanne lehon velishavinhu shechunat kevarot amar resh lakish ila matzu vetiharu eretz yisrael
Badak meesrim amma velo matza may amar rav menashsheya bar yirmeya amar rav shechunat kevarot may tama amar resh lakish ila matzu vetiharu et eretz yisrael
Matni kol sefek negaim battechila tahor ad shello nizkak letuma mishshennizkak letuma sefeko tame
Gema mena hane mile amar rav yehuda amar rav amar kera letaharo o letammeo hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv betohora techila i hachi afilu mishshennizkak letuma name sefeko tahor
Ella ki itmar derav yehuda amar rav aha itmar im baheret kadma lesear lavan tame veim sear lavan kodem labbaheret tahor safek tame verabbi yehoshua amar kiha
May kiha amar rav yehuda kiha vetahor vedilma kiha vetame amar rav yehuda amar rav amar kera letaharo o letammeo hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv betohora techila
Matni beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav ad shello nizkak leziva bemaachal uvmishte bemassa uvikfitza uvcholi uvmare uvhirhur
Mishshennizkak leziva en bodkin oto onso usfeko veshichvat zaro temeim sheraglayim laddavar
Hammakke et chavero vaamaduhu lemita vehekel mimma shehaya leachar mikkan hichbid vamet chayyav rabbi nechemya omer patur sheraglayim laddavar
Gema mena hane mile amar rabbi natan amar kera vehazzav et zovo liriyya shelishit itakkash linkeva
Vehatanya rabbi eliezer omer bashshelishit bodkin oto barviit en bodkin oto ella beettim kamipalgi rabbi eliezer daresh ettim verabbanan la darshi ettim
Onso usfeko

a: Amar rava la tema safek chaza safek la chaza ella vadday chaza safek mechamat shichvat zera safek mechamat reiyya kevan shennizkak letuma sefeko tame
Shichvat zaro temea lemay ilema lemagga mi gara mishshichvat zera detahor ella zaro shel zav metamme bemassa

Man shamatte leha deamar shichvat zera shel zav metamme bemassa ilema hay tanna detanya rabbi eliezer omer shichvat zaro shel zav eno metamme bemassa verabbi yehoshua omer metamme bemassa lefi shei efshar lah belo tzichtzuche ziva afilu rabbi yehoshua la amar ella mishshum tzichtzuche ziva aval beeneh la amar
Ella amar rav adda bar ahava lomar sheen tolin bah
Sevar rav pappa kammeh derava lememar ayede chulsha hu dechaze amar leh rava vehatnan ger shennitgayyer metamme miyyad beziva amar leh en lecha choli gadol mizze
Ella tannae hi detanya shichvat zera shel zav metamme bemassa kol meet leet verabbi yose omer yomo
Bemay kamipalgi bedishmuel dishmuel rame ketiv ki yihye vecha ish asher lo yihye tahor mikkere layela uchtiv lifnot erev yirchatz bammayim
Man deamar meet leet dayek millifnot erev veidach dayek mikkere layela
Uman deamar millifnot erev hachtiv mikkere layela amar lach orcha dekeri lemete belelya
Matni nazir haya shemuel kedivre rabbi nehoray shenneemar umora lo yaale al rosho neemar beshimshon umora veneemar bishmuel umora ma mora haamura beshimshon nazir af mora haamura bishmuel nazir
Amar rabbi yose vahalo en mora ella shel basar vadam amar leh rabbi nehoray vahalo kevar neemar vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani shekkevar haya alav mora shel basar vadam
Gema amar leh rav lechiyya bereh
b: Chatof uvarech vechen amar leh rav huna lerabba bereh chatof uvarech
Lememra dimvarech adif vehatanya rabbi yose omer gadol haone amen yoter min hamvarech veamar lo rabbi nehoray hashshamayim kach hu teda shehare gulyarim mitgarin bammilchama vegibborim notzchin
Tannae hi detanya echad hamvarech veechad haone amen bammashma ella shemmemaharin lamvarech techila
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam shenneemar vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich
Hadran alach haggoyim en lahem nezirut uslika lah massechet nazir

a: Hamkanne leishto rabbi eliezer omer mekanne lah al pi shenayim umashkah al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo rabbi yehoshua omer mekanne lah al pi shenayim umashkah al pi shenayim
Ketzad mekanne lah omer lah bifne shenayim al tedabberi im ish peloni vedibbera immo adayin hi mutteret levetah umutteret leechol bitruma
Nichnesa immo levet hasseter veshahata immo kede tuma asura levetah vaasura leechol bitruma veim met choletzet velo mityabemet
Gema mikkede tanna minnazir salek may tena deka tane sota
Kidrabbi detanya rabbi omer lamma nismecha parashat nazir lefarashat sota lomar lach shekkol haroe sota bekilkulah yazzir atzmo min hayyayin
Velitne sota vahadar litne nazir ayede ditna ketubbot utna hammaddir tena nedarim veayede ditna nedarim tena nazir dedame lindarim vekatane sota kidrabbi
Hamkanne diavad in lechattechila la kasavar tanna didan asur lekannoot

Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak ki hava patach resh lakish besota amar hachi en mezavvegin lo leadam ishsha ella lefi maasav shenneemar ki lo yanuach shevet haresha al goral hatztzaddikim amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan vekashin lezavvegan kikriat yam suf shenneemar elohim moshiv yechidim bayeta motzi asirim bakkosharot
Ini veha amar rav yehuda amar rav arbaim yom kodem yetzirat havalad bat kol yotzet veomeret bat peloni lifloni bet peloni lifloni sede feloni lifloni la kashya ha bezug rishon ha bezug sheni
Rabbi eliezer omer mekanne lah al pi shenayim vechu ad kan la peligi ella bekinuy ustira aval betuma ed echad meheman
Utnan name ed echad omer ani raiti shennitmet lo hayeta shota
Middeorayeta menalan dimheman ed echad detanu rabbanan veed en bah bishnayim hakkatuv medabber
O eno ella afilu beechad talmud lomar lo yakum ed echad beish
b: Mimmashma shenneemar lo yakum ed beish eni yodea shehu echad ma talmud lomar echad ze bana av kol makom shenneemar ed hare kan shenayim ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv echad
Veamar rachamana tere let bah ella chad vehi lo nitpasa asura
Ella tama dichtiv lo yakum ed echad beish ha lav hachi hava amena ed desota chad hu vei afilu chad leka ella bemay mitasra
Itzterich salka datach amena ed en bah en neeman bah
En neeman bah veella may bae
Ad deika tere lishtok kera mineh deatya davar davar mimmamon vaana yadana mide dehave akkol eduot shebbattora
Itzterich salka datach amena sota shane deraglayim ledavar shehare kine lah venistera litheman bah ed echad
Umi matzet amratte deen neeman bah vesharya veha middichtiv vehi lo nitpasa mikkelal daasura
Itzterich salka datach amena en neeman bah ad deika tere uvitre name hi delo nitpasa ka mashma lan
Rabbi yehoshua omer mekanne lah al pi shenayim vechu may tama derabbi yehoshua amar kera bah bah velo bekinuy bah velo bistira
Verabbi eliezer omer bah velo bekinuy
Veema bah velo bistira setira itakkash letuma dichtiv venistera vehi nitmaa
Kinuy name itakkash letuma dichtiv vekinne et ishto vehi nitmaa ha miet rachamana bah
Uma raita mistabbera setira adifa shekken osartah ketuma
Adderabba kinuy adif shekken ikar garam lah
I lav setira kinuy mi ika vei lav kinuy setira may ahani
Afilu hachi setira adifa deatchalta detuma hi

Matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer hamkanne leishto mekanne al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo umashke lah al pi shenayim heshivu chachamim ledivre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda en laddavar sof
May tama derabbi yose berabbi yehuda amar kera bah bah velo bistira
Veema bah velo bekinuy kinuy itakkash letuma dichtiv vekinne et ishto vehi nitmaa
Setira name itakkash letuma dichtiv venistera vehi nitmaa hahu lechamma shiur setira kede tuma hu daata
Heshivu chachamim ledivre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda en laddavar sof may nihu dezimnin dela kanni veamar kannay
Ha lemishnatenu yesh laddavar sof zimnin dela istattar veamar istattar
Amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan af ledivre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda en laddavar sof
Af ledivre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda velo mibaya lemishnatenu adderabba lemishnatenu ika ikar hatam leka ikar
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan ledivre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda af lemishnatenu en laddavar sof

Amar rav chanina missura la lema inish leitteh bazzeman hazze lo tisatri bahade feloni dilma kayema lan kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar kinuy al pi atzmo umistattera veleka haidana me sota lemivdekah vekaasar lah ilaveh isura dilolam
Amar resh lakish ma leshon kinuy davar hammetil kina benah leven acherim alma kasavar kinuy al pi atzmo vechulle alma la yadi dekanni lah veamri may dekamma deka badla veatu lemibad kina bahadah
Verav yemar bar rabbi shelemya mishshemeh deabbaye amar davar hammetil kina beno levenah alma kasavar kinuy al pi shenayim edim vechulle alma yadi dekanni lah veihu hu deate lemibad kina bahadah

a: Alma kasavri deasur lekannoot
Uman deamar muttar lekannoot mahu leshon kinuy amar rav nachman bar yitzchak en kinuy ella leshon hatraa vechen hu omer vayekanne Adonai leartzo

Tanya haya rabbi meir omer adam over avera basseter vehakkadosh baruch hu machriz alav begaluy shenneemar veavar alav ruach kina veen avera ella leshon hachraza shenneemar vayetzav moshe vayyaaviru kol bammachane
Resh lakish amar en adam over avera ella im ken nichnas bo ruach shetut shenneemar ish ish ki tiste ishto tishte ketiv
Tana deve rabbi yishmael mippene ma heemina tora ed echad besota sheraglayim laddavar shehare kine lah venistera veed echad meidah shehi temea
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veha ki ketiva kinuy batar setira vetuma hu dichtiva
Amar leh veavar uchvar avar
Ella meatta veavar lachem kol chalutz hachi name
Hatam middichtiv venichbesha haaretz lifne Adonai veachar tashuvu mashma dilhabba ella hacha i salka datach kedichtivi veavar batar tuma ustira kinuy lema li
Tana deve rabbi yishmael en adam mekanne leishto ella im ken nichnesa bo ruach shenneemar veavar alav ruach kina vekinne et ishto may ruach
Rabbanan amri ruach tuma rav ashe amar ruach tohora

Umistabbera keman deamar ruach tohora detanya vekinne et ishto reshut divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer chova i amratte bishlama ruach tohora shappir ella i amratte ruach tuma reshut vechova leayyole leinish ruach tuma benafsheh
Gufa vekinne et ishto reshut divre rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva omer chova lah yittamma reshut divre rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva omer chova
Leolam bahem taavodu reshut divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer chova
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veamri lah rav mesharsheya lerava lema rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva bechol hattora kullah hachi peligi demar amar reshut umar amar chova amar leh hacha bikrae peligi
Vekinne et ishto reshut divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer chova

May tama derabbi yishmael savar lah ki hay tanna detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer kelappe sheamra tora lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha yachol kegon zo talmud lomar veavar alav ruach kina vekinne et ishto
Verabbi akiva kinuy acharina ketiv
Verabbi yishmael ayede devae lemichtav vehi nitmaa vehi lo nitmaa ketiv name vekinne et ishto
Lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael kal parasha shenneemra venishnet lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah
Lah yittamma reshut divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer chova
May tama derabbi yishmael ayede dichtiv emor el hakkohanim bene aharon veamarta alehem lenefesh lo yittamma beammav itztericha lemichtav lah yittamma
Verabbi akiva mikki im lishero nafka lah yittamma lema li lechova
Verabbi yishmael lah mitamme veen mitamme leevareha
b: Verabbi akiva im ken lichtov rachamana lah velishtok yittamma lema li shema minah
Verabbi yishmael ayede dichtav lah ketav name yittamma lechidtane deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael kal parasha shenneemra venishnet lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah
Leolam bahem taavodu reshut divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer chova

May tama derabbi yishmael ayede dichtiv lo techayye kol neshama itzterich name lemichtav leolam bahem taavodu lemishre echad mikkol haummot shebba al hakkenaanit veholid mimmenna ben sheatta rashshay liknoto
Detanya minnayin leechad min haummot shebba al hakkenaanit veholid mimmenna ben sheatta rashshay liknoto beeved talmud lomar vegam mibbene hattoshavim haggarim immachem mehem tiknu
Yachol af hakkenaani shebba al achat min haummot veholid mimmenna ben sheatta rashshay liknoto beeved talmud lomar asher holidu beartzechem min hannoladim beartzechem velo min haggarim beartzechem
Verabbi akiva mimmehem tiknu nafka leolam bahem taavodu lema li lechova
Verabbi yishmael bahem velo beachechem
Verabbi akiva beachechem missefa dikra nafka uvachechem bene yisrael ish beachiv lo tirde vo befarech
Verabbi yishmael ayede dichtiv uvachechem ketiv name bahem lechidtane deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael kal parasha shenneemra venishnet lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah
Amar rav chisda zenuta beveta ki karya leshumshema veamar rav chisda tukpa beveta ki karya leshumshema ide veide beitta aval begavra let lan bah

Veamar rav chisda battechila kodem shechatu yisrael hayeta shechina shora im kol echad veechad shenneemar ki Adonai elohecha mithallech bekerev machanecha kevan shechatu nistalleka shechina mehem shenneemar velo yire vecha ervat davar veshav meacharecha

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol haose mitzva achat baolam hazze mekaddamto veholechet lefanav laolam habba shenneemar vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha vechol haover avera achat baolam hazze melappafto veholechet lefanav leom haddin shenneemar yillaftu orchot darkam yaalu vattohu veyovedu
Rabbi elazar omer keshura bo kechelev shenneemar velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihot immah lishkav etzlah baolam hazze lihot immah laolam habba
Tenan hatam shehaya baddin
Uma edut harishona sheen osartah isur olam enah mitkayyemet befachot mishshenayim edut haacharona sheosartah isur olam eno din shello titkayyem befachot mishshenayim
Talmud lomar veed en bah kol sheyyesh bah
Vekal vachomer leedut harishona meatta uma edut haacharona sheosartah isur olam mitkayyemet beed echad edut harishona sheen osartah isur olam eno din shettitkayyem beed echad
Talmud lomar ki matza vah ervat davar ulhallan hu omer al pi shene edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar ma davar haamur lehallan al pi shenayim edim af kan al pi shenayim
Hay mikki matza vah ervat davar nafka mibbah nafka bah velo bekinuy bah velo bistira mibe leh
Hachi name kaamar talmud lomar bah bah velo bekinuy bah velo bistira

Vetuma bealma belo kinuy uvlo setira dela meheman ed echad menalan neemar kan ki matza vah ervat davar veneemar lehallan al pi shene edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar ma davar haamur lehallan edim shenayim af kan edim shenayim
Tanu rabbanan e zo hi edut harishona zo edut setira edut acharona zo edut tuma

a: Vechamma shiur setira kede tuma kede via kede haaraa
Kede hakkafat dekel divre rabbi yishmael rabbi eliezer omer kede mezigat hakkos rabbi yehoshua omer kede lishtoto
Ben azzay omer kede litzlot betza rabbi akiva omer kede legomah rabbi yehuda ben betera omer kede ligmoa shalosh betzim zo achar zo rabbi elazar ben yirmeya omer kede likshor gardi nima

Chanin ben pinchas omer kede shettoshit yadah letoch piha litol kesam pelemo omer kede shettoshit yadah lassal litol kikkar af al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar ki vead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem
Vechol hane lema li
Tzerichi dei tena kede tuma hava amena kede tumatah veartzutah ka mashma lan kede via
Vei tena kede via hava amena kede gemar bia ka mashma lan kede haaraa
Vei ashmeinan kede haaraa hava amena kede haaraa veartzutah ka mashma lan kede tuma vechamma kede haaraa kede hakkafat dekel
Urminhi venistera vechamma shiur setira lo shamanu keshehu omer vehi nitmaa heve omer kede tuma kede via kede haaraa kede chazarat dekel divre rabbi eliezer
Rabbi yehoshua omer kede mezigat hakkos ben azzay omer kede lishtoto rabbi akiva omer kede litzlot betza rabbi yehuda ben betera omer kede legomah
Ka salka datin hayenu hakkafat dekel hayenu chazarat dekel hatam amar rabbi yishmael kede hakkafat dekel uflig rabbi eliezer aleh hacha amar rabbi eliezer kede chazarat dekel
Amar abbaye hakkafa baregel chazara baruach
Bae rav ashe chazara baruach ki hechi deazel vahadar ate o dilma ki hechi deazel veate vahadar kae beduchteh teku
Hatam amar rabbi eliezer kede mezigat hakkos hacha kede chazarat dekel ide veide chad shiura hu
Hatam amar rabbi yehoshua kede lishtoto hacha amar kede mezigat hakkos ema kede limzog velishtot velema ide veide chad shiura hu im ken hayenu rabbi eliezer
Hatam amar ben azzay kede litzlot betza hacha amar kede lishtoto ide veide chad shiura hu
Hatam amar rabbi akiva kede legomah hacha amar kede litzlot betza ema kede litzlot betza ulgomah velema ide veide chad shiura hu im ken hayenu ben azzay

Hatam amar rabbi yehuda ben betera kede ligmoa shalosh betzim zo achar zo hacha amar kede legomah lidvarav derabbi akiva kaamar dekaamar meshaarin bitzlia uvigmia ema shiur gemia lechodah kede ligmoa shalosh betzim zo achar zo dehayenu tzelia ugmia
Rabbi elazar ben yirmeya omer kede sheyyikshor gardi nima bae rav ashe dimrachak o dimkarav teku
Chanin ben pinchas omer kede shettoshit yadah letoch piha litol kesam bae rav ashe dimhaddak o dela mehaddak teku
Pelemo omer kede shettoshit yadah lassal litol kikkar bae rav ashe dimhaddak o dela mehaddak bechadta o beattika bechammima o bekarira
b: Bidchitte o bedisare berakkicha o baakosha teku
Amar rav yitzchak bar rav yosef amar rabbi yochanan kol echad veechad beatzmo shier vehaika ben azzay dela nesev
Ibaet ema nesev uferash hava veibaet ema merabbeh shemia leh veibaet ema sod Adonai lireav

Daresh rav avira zimnin amar lah mishshemeh derabbi amme vezimnin amar lah mishshemeh derabbi assi kol haochel lechem belo netilat yadayim keilu ba al ishsha zona shenneemar ki vead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem
Amar rava hay bead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem bead kikkar lechem ad ishsha zona mibe leh ella amar rava kol habba al ishsha zona lesof mevakkesh kikkar lechem

Amar rabbi zerika amar rabbi elazar kol hammezalzel bintilat yadayim neekar min haolam amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav mayim rishonim tzarich sheyyagbiha yadav lemala mayim acharonim tzarich sheyyashpil yadav lematta tanya name hachi hannotel yadav tzarich sheyyagbiha yadav lemala shemma yetzu hammayim chutz lapperek veyachzeru vitammeu et hayyadayim
Amar rabbi avahu kol haochel pat belo niguv yadayim keilu ochel lechem tame shenneemar vayyomer Adonai kacha yochlu vene yisrael et lachmam tame vego
Umay veeshet ish nefesh yekara tatzud amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach levassof nichshal beeshet ish shenneemar veeshet ish nefesh yekara tatzud

Amar rava hay nefesh yekara nefesh gevoha mibe leh veod hi tatzud mibe leh ella amar rava kol habba al eshet ish afilu lamad tora dichtiv bah yekara hi mippeninim mikkohen gadol shennichnas lifnay velifnim hi tetzudennu ledinah shel gehinnam
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach keilu oved avoda zara ketiv hacha toavat Adonai kol gevah lev uchtiv hatam vela tavi toeva el betecha
Verabbi yochanan dideh amar keilu kafar baikar shenneemar veram levavecha veshachachta et Adonai elohecha vego
Rabbi chama bar chanina amar keilu ba al kol haaraot ketiv hacha toavat Adonai kol gevah lev uchtiv hatam ki et kol hattoevot hael vego
Ulla amar keilu bana bama shenneemar chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo ki bamme nechshav hu al tikre bamme ella bama

May yad leyad lo yinnake amar rav kol habba al eshet ish afilu hiknahu lehakkadosh baruch hu shamayim vaaretz keavraham avinu dichtiv beh harimoti yadi el Adonai el elon kone shamayim vaaretz lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam
Kashya lehu lidve rabbi shela hay yad leyad lo yinnake yadi mibe leh
Ella amri deve rabbi shela afilu kibel tora kemoshe rabbenu dichtiv beh mimino esh dat lamo lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam
Kashya leh lerabbi yochanan hay yad leyad yad miyyad mibaya leh
Ella amar rabbi yochanan

a: Afilu ose tzedaka basseter dichtiv mattan basseter yichpe af vego lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam

Azhara legasse haruach minnayin amar rava amar zeeri shimu vehaazinu al tigbahu rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha veram levavecha veshachachta uchtiv hishshamer lecha pen tishkach et Adonai elohecha
Vechidrabbi avin amar rabbi ila deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila kol makom shenneemar hishshamer pen veal eno ella belo taase

Daresh rav avira zimnin amar lah mishshemeh derav assi vezimnin amar lah mishshemeh derav amme kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach lesof mitmaet shenneemar rommu meat veshemma tomar yeshno baolam talmud lomar veenennu
Veim chozer bo neesaf bizmanno keavraham avinu shenneemar vehummechu kakkol yikkaftzun keavraham yitzchak veyaakov dichtiv behu bakkol mikkol kol veim lav uchrosh shibbolet yimmalu

May uchrosh shibbolet rav huna verav chisda chad amar ki sasa deshibalta vechad amar keshibolet atzmah bishlama leman deamar ki sasa deshibalta hayenu dichtiv uchrosh shibbolet ella leman deamar ki shubbalta atzmah may uchrosh shibbolet amar rav assi vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael mashal leadam shennichnas letoch sadehu gevoha gevoha hu melakket
Veet dakka ushfal ruach rav huna verav chisda chad amar itti dakka vechad amar ani et dakka
Umistabbera keman deamar ani et dakka shehare hakkadosh baruch hu hinniach kol harim ugvaot vehishra shechinato al har sinay velo gavah har sinay lemala
Amar rav yosef leolam yilmad adam middaat kono shehare hakkadosh baruch hu hinniach kol harim ugvaot vehishra shechinato al har sinay vehinniach kol ilanot tovot vehishra shechinato bassene
Amar rabbi elazar kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach rauy legaddeo kaashera ketiv hacha verame hakkoma geduim uchtiv hatam vaasherehem tegaddeun
Veamar rabbi elazar kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach en afaro ninar shenneemar hakitzu verannenu shochne afar shochve beafar lo neemar ella shochne afar mi shennaasa shachen leafar bechayyav
Veamar rabbi elazar kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach shechina meyallelet alav shenneemar vegavoha mimmerchak yeyeda

Daresh rav avira veitema rabbi elazar bo ure shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam middat basar vadam gavoha roe et haggavoha veen gavoha roe et hashshafel aval middat hakkadosh baruch hu eno ken hu gavoha veroe et hashshafel shenneemar ki ram Adonai veshafal yire

Amar rav chisda veitema mar ukva kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach amar hakkadosh baruch hu en ani vahu yecholin ladur baolam shenneemar meloshni vasseter reehu oto atzmit gevah enayim urchav levav oto lo uchal al tikre oto ella itto lo uchal ika dematne lah ammesappere lashon hara shenneemar meloshni vasseter reehu oto atzmit

Amar rabbi alekkesanderi kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach afilu ruach kima ocharto shenneemar veharshaim kayyam nigrash uma yam sheyyesh bo kamma reviiyyot ruach kima ocharto adam sheen bo ella reviit achat al achat kamma vechamma

Amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav talmid chacham tzarich sheyehe bo echad mishshemona bishminit amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua umattera leh ki sasa leshubbalta amar rava beshamta deit beh uvshamta delet beh
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak la minah vela miktzatah mi zutar dichtiv beh toavat Adonai kol gevah lev
Amar chizkiyya en tefillato shel adam nishmaat ella im ken mesim libbo kevasar shenneemar vehaya midde chodesh bechodsho vego yavo kol basar lehishtachaot vego
Amar rabbi zera basar ketiv beh venirpa adam la ketiv beh venirpa
Amar rabbi yochanan adam efer dam mara basar busha serucha rimma ika deamri sheol dichtiv beshin
Amar rav ashe kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach lesof nifchat shenneemar
b: Velaset velassappachat veen seet ella leshon gavoha shenneemar veal kol heharim haramim veal kol haggevaot hannissaot veen sappachat ella tefela shenneemar sefacheni na el achat hakkehunnot leechol pat lachem
