Moshe zacha beatzmot yosef veen beyisrael gadol mimmennu shenneemar vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo mi gadol mimmoshe shello nitassek bo ella hammakom shenneemar vayyikbor oto baggay lo al moshe bilvad amru ella al kol hatztzaddikim shenneemar vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha kevod Adonai yaasfecha

Gema tanu rabbanan shimshon beenav marad shenneemar vayyomer shimshon el aviv otah kach li ki hi yashra veenay lefichach nikkeru pelishtim et enav shenneemar vayyochazuhu felishtim vayenakkeru et enav
Ini vehachtiv veaviv veimmo lo yadu ki me hi ki azal miha batar yashruteh azal

Tanya rabbi omer techilat kilkulo beazza lefichach laka beazza techilat kilkulo beazza dichtiv vayyelech shimshon azzata vayyar sham ishsha zona vego lefichach laka beazza dichtiv vayyoridu oto azzatah
Vehachtiv vayyered shimshon timnata techillat kilkulo miha beazza hava
Vayehi achare chen vayyeehav ishsha benachal sorek ushmah delila tanya rabbi omer ilmale lo nikra shemah delila reuya hayeta shettikkare delila dildela et kocho dildela et libbo dildela et maasav
Dildela et kocho dichtiv vayyasar kocho mealav dildela et libbo dichtiv vattere delila ki higgid lah et kol libbo dildela et maasav deistallak shechina mineh dichtiv vehu lo yada ki Adonai sar mealav

Vattere delila ki higgid lah et kol libbo mena yada amar rabbi chanin amar rav nikarin divre emet abbaye amar yada bo beoto tzaddik dela mappek shem shamayim levattala kevan daamar nezir elohim ani amara hashta vadday kushta kaamar
Vayehi ki hetzika lo vidvareha kol hayyamim vattealtzehu may vattealtzehu amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme bishat gemar bia nishmeta mittachtav
Veatta hishshamri na veal tishti yayin veshechar veal tochli kol tame may kol tame vetu ad hashta devarim temeim kaachla amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme devarim haasurim benazir
Vayyivka elohim et hammachtesh asher ballechi amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme hu iva ledavar tame lefichach nitlu chayyav bedavar tame
Vattachel ruach Adonai vego amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina chalta nevuato shel yaakov avinu dichtiv yehi dan nachash ale derech
Lefaamo bemachane dan amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme melammed shehayeta shechina mekashkeshet lefanav kezog ketiv hacha lefaamo bemachane dan uchtiv hatam paamon verimmon
Ben tzora uven eshtaol amar rabbi assi tzora veeshtaol shene harim gedolim hau vaakaran shimshon utchanan ze baze
Vehu yachel lehoshia et yisrael amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina

a: Huchal shevuato shel avimelech dichtiv im tishkor li ulnini ulnechdi
Vayyigdal hannaar vayevarchehu Adonai bamme bercho amar rav yehuda amar rav shebbercho beammato ammato kivne adam vezaro kenachal shotef

Vayyikra shimshon el Adonai vayyomer Adonai elohim zochreni na vechazzekeni na ach happaam hazze veinnakma nekam achat mishshete enay mippelishtim amar rav amar shimshon lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam zechor li esrim ushtayim shana sheshshafatti et yisrael velo amarti leechad mehem haaver li makkel mimmakom lemakom

Vayyelech shimshon vayyilkod shelosh meot shualim may shena shualim amar rabbi ayevu bar nagdi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar shimshon yavo mi shechozer laachorav veyippara mippelishtim shechazru bishvuatan

Tanya amar rabbi shimon hechasid ben ketefav shel shimshon shishshim amma haya shenneemar vayyishkav shimshon ad chatzi hallayela vayyakom bachatzi hallayela vayyeechoz bedaltot shaar hair uvishte hammezuzot vayyissaem im habberiach vayyasem al ketefav ugmiri deen daltot azza pechutot mishshishshim amma

Vayehi tochen bevet haasurim amar rabbi yochanan en techina ella leshon avera vechen hu omer titchan leacher ishti melammed shekkol echad veechad hevi lo et ishto levet haasurim kede shettitabber hemennu amar rav pappa hayenu deamri inashe kamme deshate chamra chamra kamme rafoka geridya duvla

Veamar rabbi yochanan kol hamzanne ishto mezannenet mezanna alav shenneemar im nifta libbi al ishsha veal petach rei aravti uchtiv titchan leacher ishti vealeha yichreun acherin vehayenu deamri inashe ihu be kare veitteh be vutzine

Veamar rabbi yochanan shimshon dan et yisrael kaavihem shebbashshamayim shenneemar dan yadin ammo keachad vego veamar rabbi yochanan shimshon al shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu nikra shenneemar ki shemesh umagen Adonai elohim vego ella meatta lo yimmache ella meen shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu ma hakkadosh baruch hu megen al kol haolam kullo af shimshon megen bedoro al yisrael
Veamar rabbi yochanan bilam chiger beraglo achat haya shenneemar vayyelech shefi shimshon chiger bishte raglav haya shenneemar shefifon ale orach
Tanu rabbanan chamishsha nivreu meen dugma shel mala vechullan laku bahen shimshon bechocho shaul betzavaro avshalom bisaro tzidkiyya beenav asa beraglav
Shimshon bechocho dichtiv vayyasar kocho mealav
Shaul betzavaro dichtiv vayyikkach shaul et hacherev vayyippol aleha
Avshalom bisaro kidvaenan lememar kamman tzidkiyya beenav dichtiv veet ene tzidkiyyahu iver

Asa beraglav dichtiv rak leet ziknato chala et raglav veamar rav yehuda amar rav sheachazattu padagra amar leh mar zutra bereh derav nachman lerav nachman hechi dame padagra amar leh kemachat bivsar hachay mena yada ika deamri mechash hava chash beh veika deamri merabbeh shema leh veika deamri sod Adonai lireav uvrito lehodiam

Daresh rava mippene ma neenash asa mippene sheasa angarya betalmide chachamim shenneemar vehammelech asa hishmia et kol yehuda en naki may en naki amar rav yehuda amar rav afilu chatan mechedro vechalla mechuppatah
Ketiv vayyered shimshon timnata uchtiv hinne chamich ole timnata amar rabbi elazar shimshon shennitganna bah ketiv beh yerida yehuda shennitalla bah ketiv beh aliyya
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar shette timnaot hau chada birida vachada baaliyya
Rav pappa amar chada timna havay deate mehay gisa yerida udate mehay gisa aliyya kegon vardonya uve vare veshuka denaresh

Vatteshev befetach enayim amar rabbi alekkesanderi melammed shehalcha veyashva lah befitcho shel avraham avinu makom shekkol enayim tzofot liroto rabbi chanin amar rav makom hu sheshshemo enayim vechen hu omer tappuach vehaenam

Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar shennatna enayim lidvareha keshettevaah amar lah shemma nochrit atte amra leh giyyoret ani shemma eshet ish atte amra leh penuya ani shemma kibel bich avicha kidushin amra leh yetoma ani shemma temea atte amra leh tehora ani
Vayyitta eshel biver shava amar resh lakish melammed sheasa pardes venata bo kol mine megadim
Rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya chad amar pardes vechad amar pundak bishlama leman deamar pardes hayenu dichtiv vayyitta ella leman deamar pundak may vayyitta kedichtiv vayyitta ohole appadno vego
Vayyikra sham beshem Adonai el olam amar resh lakish al tikre vayyikra
b: Ella vayyakri melammed shehikri avraham avinu lishmo shel hakkadosh baruch hu befe kol over vashav ketzad leachar sheachlu veshatu amdu levarcho amar lahem vechi mishshelli achaltem mishshel elohe olam achaltem hodu veshabbechu uvarchu lemi sheamar vehaya haolam
Vayyireha yehuda vayyachsheveha lezona ki chisseta paneha mishshum dechisseta paneha chashshevah lezona

Amar rabbi elazar shekkisseta paneha bevet chamiha deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol kalla shehi tzenua bevet chamiha zocha veotzin mimmenna melachim unviim menalan mittamar neviim dichtiv chazon yeshayahu ven amotz melachim middavid veamar rabbi levi davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu amotz vaamatzya achim hao
Hi mutzet hi mitotzet mibe leh amar rabbi elazar leachar shennimtzeu simaneha ba sammael verichakan ba gavriel vekervan

Hayenu dichtiv limnatztzeach al yonat elem rechokim ledavid michtam amar rabbi yochanan mishshaa shennitrachaku simaneha naaset keona ilemet ledavid michtam sheyyatza mimmenna david shehaya mach vetam lakkol davar acher michtam shehayeta makkato tamma shennolad keshehu mahul davar acher michtam keshem shebbekatnuto hiktin atzmo etzel mi sheggadol mimmennu lilmod tora kach bigdullato

Vehi shalcha el chamiha lemor leish asher elle lo anochi hara vetema leh memar amar rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav veamri lah amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida veamri lah amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay noach lo laadam sheyyappil atzmo letoch kivshan haesh veal yalbin pene chavero barabbim menalan mittamar
Hakker na amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina behakker biser leaviv behakker bisruhu behakker biser hakker na hakketonet bincha hi behakker bisruhu hakker na lemi
Na en na ella leshon bakkasha amra leh bevakkasha mimmecha hakker pene boraacha veal taalim enecha mimmenni

Vayyakker yehuda vayyomer tzadka mimmenni hayenu deamar rav chanin bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida yosef shekkiddesh shem shamayim basseter zacha vehosifu lo ot achat mishshemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu dichtiv edut bihosef samo

Yehuda shekkiddesh shem shamayim befarhesya zacha venikra kullo al shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu kevan shehoda veamar tzadka mimmenni yatzta bat kol veamra atta hitztzalta tamar ushne baneha min haur chayyecha sheani matztzil bizchutcha shelosha mibbanecha min haur man ninhu chananya mishael vaazarya
Tzadka mimmenni mena yada yatzta bat kol veamra mimmenni yatzu kevushim

Velo yasaf od ledata amar shemuel sava chamuh derav shemuel bar amme mishshemeh derav shemuel bar amme kevan sheyedaah shuv lo pasak mimmenna ketiv hacha velo yasaf od ledata uchtiv hatam kol gadol velo yasaf

Avshalom nitgaa bisaro vechu tanu rabbanan avshalom bisaro marad shenneemar uchavshalom lo haya ish yafe vego uvgallecho et rosho vehaya mikketz yamim layyamim asher yegalleach ki chaved alav vegillecho veshakal et sear rosho matayim shekalim beeven hammelech tana even sheanshe teverya veanshe tzipori shoklim bah

Lefichach nitla bisaro shenneemar vayyikra avshalom lifne avde david veavshalom rochev al happered vayyavo happered tachat sovech haela haggedola vayyechezak rosho vaela vayyuttan ben hashshamayim uven haaretz vehappered asher tachtav avar shekal safsira bea lemifsekeh tana deve rabbi yishmael beotah shaa nivka sheol mittachtav

Vayyirgaz hammelech vayyaal al aliyyat hashshaar vayyevke vecho amar belechto beni avshalom beni veni avshalom mi yitten muti ani tachtecha avshalom beni veni vehammelech laat et panav vayyizak hammelech kol gadol beni avshalom avshalom beni veni hane temanya beni lema shiva deassekeh mishshiva medore gehinnam veidach ika deamri dekarev resheh legabbe gufeh veika deamri deayeteh lealma deate

Veavshalom lakach vayyatztzev lo vechayyav may lakach amar resh lakish shellakach mikkach ra leatzmo et matztzevet asher beemek hammelech vego amar rabbi chanina bar pappa beetza amukka shel malko shel olam

a: Dichtiv hinni mekim alecha raa mibbetecha kayyotze baddavar atta omer vayyishlachehu meemek chevron amar rabbi chanina bar pappa beetza amukka shel oto tzaddik shekkavur bechevron dichtiv yadoa teda ki ger yihye zaracha

Ki amar en li ven vela hao leh bene vehachtiv vayyivaldu leavshalom shelosha banim uvat achat amar rav yitzchak bar avdimi shello haya lo ben hagun lammalchut rav chisda amar gemiri kol hassoref tevuato shel chavero eno manniach ben leorsho veihu kalyah lidoav dichtiv vayyomer el avadav reu chelkat yoav el yadi velo sham seorim lechu vehatztzituha vaesh vayyatztzitu avde avshalom et hachelka baesh
Vechen leinyan hattova miryam vechu mi dame hatam chada shata hacha shiva yome amar abbaye ema ulinyan hattova eno ken
Amar leh rava ha vechen leinyan hattova katane ella amar rava hachi katane vechen leinyan hattova divotah midda ulolam midda tova merubba mimmiddat puranut

Vattetatztzav achoto merachok amar rabbi yitzchak pasuk ze kullo al shem shechina neemar vattetatztzav dichtiv vayyavo Adonai vayyityatztzav vego achoto dichtiv emor lachochma achoti atte merachok dichtiv merachok Adonai nira li ladaat dichtiv ki el deot Adonai ma dichtiv ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach yease dichtiv ki lo yaase Adonai elohim davar lo dichtiv vayyomer lo Adonai shalom

Vayyakom melech chadash vego rav ushmuel chad amar chadash mammash vechad amar shennitchaddeshu gezerotav man deamar chadash mammash dichtiv chadash uman deamar shennitchaddeshu gezerotav dela ketiv vayyamot vayyimloch asher lo yada et yosef dahava dame keman dela yada leh kelal

Vayyomer el ammo hinne am bene yisrael tana hu hitchil beetza techila lefichach laka techila hu hitchil beetza techila dichtiv vayyomer el ammo lefichach laka techila kedichtiv uvcha uvammecha uvchol avadecha
Hava nitchakkema lo lahem mibe leh amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina bou venechkam lemoshian shel yisrael
Bamme nedunem nedunem baesh ketiv ki hinne Adonai baesh yavo uchtiv ki vaesh Adonai nishpat vego becherev ketiv uvcharbo et kol basar
Ella bou undunem bammayim shekkevar nishba hakkadosh baruch hu sheeno mevi mabbul laolam shenneemar ki me noach zot li vego vehen enan yodin sheal kol haolam kullo eno mevi aval al umma achat hu mevi

I name hu eno mevi aval hen bain venoflin betocho vechen hu omer umitzrayim nasim likrato vehayenu deamar rabbi elazar may dichtiv ki vaddavar asher zadu alehem bikdera shebbishlu bah nitbashshelu may mashma dehay zadu lishana dikdera hu dichtiv vayyazed yaakov nazid
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi simay shelosha hau beotah etza bilam veiyyov veyitro

Bilam sheyyaatz neherag iyyov sheshshatak nidon beyissurin yitro shebbarach zachu mibbene vanav sheyyashvu belishkat haggazit shenneemar umishpechot sofrim yoshve yabetz tiratim shimatim suchatim hemma hakkinim habbaim mechammat avi vet rechav uchtiv uvne keni choten moshe vego
Venilcham banu veala min haaretz vealinu mibe leh amar rabbi abba bar kahana keadam shemmekallel et atzmo vetole killato bachavero

Vayyasimu alav sare missim alehem mibe leh tana deve rabbi elazar berabbi shimon melammed sheheviu malben vetalu lo lefaro betzavaro vechol echad veechad miyyisrael sheamar lahem istenis ani amru lo kelum istenis atta yoter mipparo
Sare missim davar shemmesim levenim
Lemaan annoto besivlotam annotam mibe leh lemaan annoto lefaro besivlotam deyisrael
Vayyiven are miskenot lefaro rav ushmuel chad amar shemmesakkenot et balehen vechad amar shemmemaskenot et balehen deamar mar kol haosek bevinyan mitmasken
Et pitom veet raamses rav ushmuel chad amar pitom shemah velamma nikra shemah raamses sherishon rishon mitroses vechad amar raamses shemah velamma nikra shemah pitom sherishon rishon pi tehom bolo

Vechaasher yeannu oto ken yirbe vechen yifrotz ken rabbu vechen partzu mibe leh amar resh lakish ruach hakkodesh mevassartan ken yirbe vechen yifrotz vayyakutzu mippene bene yisrael melammed shehau domin beenehem kekotzim
Vayyaavidu mitzrayim et bene yisrael
b: Befarech rabbi elazar amar befe rach rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar bifricha
Vayemarru et chayyehem baavoda kasha bechomer uvilvenim vego amar rava battechila bechomer uvilvenim ulvassof uvchol avoda bassade

Et kol avodatam asher avdu vahem befarech amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan shehau machlifin melechet anashim lenashim umlechet nashim laanashim ulman deamar name hatam befe rach hacha vadday bifricha

Daresh rav avira bischar nashim tzidkaniyyot shehau beoto haddor nigalu yisrael mimmitzrayim beshaa sheholchot lishov mayim hakkadosh baruch hu mezammen lahem dagim ketannim bechaddehen veshoavot mechetza mayim umechetza dagim uvaot veshoftot shette kederot achat shel chammin veachat shel dagim

Umolichot etzel balehen lassade umarchitzot otan vesachot otan umaachilot otan umashkot otan venizkakot lahen ben shefattayim shenneemar im tishkevun ben shefattayim vego bischar tishkevun ben shefattayim zachu yisrael levizat mitzrayim shenneemar kanfe yona nechpa vakkesef veevroteha birakrak charutz
Vechevan shemmitabberot baot levattehem vechevan shemmaggia zeman moldehen holchot veoldot bassade tachat hattappuach shenneemar tachat hattappuach orarticha vego

Vehakkadosh baruch hu sholeach mishsheme marom mi shemmenakker umshapper otan kechayya zo shemmeshapperet et havalad shenneemar umoldotayich beom hulledet otach lo chorrat shorrech uvmayim lo ruchatzte lemishi vego umlakket lahen shene iggulin echad shel shemen veechad shel devash shenneemar vayyenikehu devash missela veshemen vego

Vechevan shemmakkirin bahen mitzrim bain lehorgan venaasa lahem nes venivlain bakkarka umviin shevarim vechorshin al gabban shenneemar al gabbi charshu chorshim vego leachar sheholchin hau mevatzbetzin veotzin keesev hassade shenneemar revava ketzemach hassade netattich
Vechevan shemmitgaddelin bain adarim adarim levattehen shenneemar vattirbi vattigdeli vattavoi baadi adayim al tikre baadi adayim ella beedre adarim
Uchshennigla hakkadosh baruch hu al hayyam hem hikkiruhu techilla shenneemar ze eli veanvehu

Vayyomer melech mitzrayim lamyalledot haivriyyot vego rav ushmuel chad amar ishsha uvittah vechad amar kalla vachamotah man deamar ishsha uvittah yocheved umiryam uman deamar kalla vachamotah yocheved veelisheva
Tanya keman deamar ishsha uvittah detanya shifra zo yocheved velamma nikra shemah shifra shemmeshapperet et havalad davar acher shifra shepparu veravu yisrael beyameha
Pua zo miryam velamma nikra shemah pua shehayeta poa umotzia et havalad davar acher pua shehayeta poa beruach hakkodesh veomeret atida immi shetteled ben shemmoshia et yisrael
Vayyomer beyalledchen et haivriyyot vego may ovnayim amar rabbi chanan siman gadol masar lahen amar lahen beshaa shekkoraat leled yarchoteha mitztannenot kaavanim
Veit deamar kedichtiv vaered bet hayyotzer vehinne hu ose melacha al haovnayim ma yotzer ze yarech mikkan veyarech mikkan vesaddan baemtza af ishsha yarech mikkan veyarech mikkan vehavalad baemtza
Im ben hu vahamitten oto amar rabbi chanina siman gadol masar lahen ben panav lematta bat paneha lemala
Vattirena hamyalledot et haelohim velo asu kaasher dibber alehen vego lahen mibe leh amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina melammed shettevaan lidvar avera velo nitbeu
Vattechayyena et hayeladim tana lo dayyan shello hemitu otan ella shehau maspikot lahem mayim umazon
Vattomarna hamyalledot el paro ki lo channashim vego may chaot ilema chayyot mammash attu chayya mi la tzericha chayya achariti leolodah
Ella amru lo umma zo kechayya nimshela yehuda gur arye dan yehi dan nachash naftali ayyala shelucha yissashchar chamor garem yosef bechor shor binyamin zeev yitraf
Dichtiv beh ketiv beh udla ketiv beh ketiv beh ma immecha leviyya ben araot ravatza vego

Vayehi ki yaru hamyalledot et haelohim vayyaas lahem battim rav ushmuel chad amar batte chehunna ulviyya vechad amar batte malchut man deamar batte chehunna ulviyya aharon umoshe uman deamar batte malchut david name mimmiryam kaate dichtiv vattamot azuva eshet kalev vayyikkach lo chalev et efrat vatteled lo et chur uchtiv vedavid ben ish efrati vego
Vechalev ben chetzron holid et azuva ishsha veet yeriot veelle vaneha yesher veshovav veardon ben chetzron ben yefunne hu ben sheppana meatzat meraggelim
Veakkatti ben kenaz hu dichtiv vayyilkedah otniel ben kenaz achi chalev amar rava chorgo diknaz hava

a: Dayeka name dichtiv hakkenizzi shema minah
Azuva zo miryam velamma nikra shemah azuva shehakkol azavuha mittechilatah holid vahalo minsav hava nasev lah amar rabbi yochanan kol hannose ishsha leshem shamayim maale alav hakkatuv keilu yeladah
Yeriot shehau paneha domin liriot
Veelle baneha al tikre baneha ella boneha yesher sheyyishsher et atzmo shovav sheshshibev et yitzro veardon sherada et yitzro veika deamri al shehau paneha domin levered
Ulashchur avi tekoa hau shette nashim chela venaara ashchur ze kalev velamma nikra shemo ashchur shehushcharu panav betaaniyyot avi shennaasa lah keav tekoa shettaka et libbo leaviv shebbashshamayim
Hau shette nashim naasa miryam kishte nashim chela venaara la chela venaara havay ella battechila chela ulvassof naara
Uvne chela tzeret vetzohar veetnan tzeret shennaaset tzara lechavroteha tzohar shehau paneha domin katztzohorayim etnan shekkol haroe otah molich etnan leishto

Vayetzav paro lechol ammo amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina af al ammo gazar veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina shalosh gezerot gazar battechila im ben hu vahamitten oto ulvassof kol habben hayyillod hayeora tashlichuhu ulvassof af al ammo gazar
Vayyelech ish mibbet levi lehechan halach amar rav yehuda bar zevina shehalach baatzat bitto
Tana amram gedol haddor haya kevan sheraa sheamar paro harasha kol habben hayyillod hayeora tashlichuhu amar lashshave anu amelin amad vegerash et ishto amdu kullan vegershu et neshotehen

Amra lo bitto abba kasha gezeratcha yoter mishshel paro shepparo lo gazar ella al hazzecharim veatta gazarta al hazzecharim veal hannekevot paro la gazar ella baolam hazze veatta baolam hazze ulolam habba

Paro harasha safek mitkayyemet gezerato safek enah mitkayyemet atta tzaddik bevadday sheggezeratcha mitkayyemet shenneemar vetigzar omer veyakom lach amad vehechzir et ishto amdu kullan vehechziru et neshotehen
Vayyikkach vayyachzir mibe leh amar rav yehuda bar zevina sheasa lo maase likuchin hoshivah beappiron veaharon umiryam merakkedin lefaneha umalache hashsharet amru em habbanim semecha

Et bat levi efshar bat mea ushloshim shana haveya vekare lah bat deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina zo yocheved shehoratah badderech veledatah ben hachomot shenneemar asher yalda otah lelevi bemitzrayim
Ledatah bemitzrayim veen horata bemitzrayim amar rabbi yehuda shennoldu bah simane naarut

Vattahar haishsha vatteled ben veha havat miabbera beh telata yarche meikara amar rav yehuda bar zevina makkish ledatah lehoratah ma horatah shello betzaar af ledatah shello betzaar mikkan lenashim tzidkaniyyot shello hau befitkah shel chava

Vattere oto ki tov hu tanya rabbi meir omer tov shemo rabbi yehuda omer toviyya shemo rabbi nechemya omer hagun linviut acherim omrim nolad keshehu mahul vachachamim omrim beshaa shennolad moshe nitmalle habbayit kullo or ketiv hacha vattere oto ki tov hu uchtiv hatam vayyar elohim et haor ki tov
Vattitzpenehu shelosha yerachim dela meno mitzriyyim ella mishshaa deahderah vehi havat miabbera beh telata yarche meikara

Velo yachla od hatztzefino ammay titzpeneh vetezil ella kol hecha dahao shami mitzrae demityelid yanoka mamtu yanoke hatam ki hechi delishmeinhu umave bahadayehu dichtiv echezu lanu shualim shualim ketannim vego
Vattikkach lo tevat gome may shena gome amar rabbi elazar mikan letzaddikim shemmamonam chaviv alehen yoter miggufan vechol kach lamma lefi sheen poshtin yedehen begazel
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar davar rach sheyyachol laamod bifne davar rach uvifne davar kashe
Vattachmera vachemar uvazzafet tana chemar mibbifnim vezefet mibbachutz kede shello yariach oto tzaddik reach ra
Vattasem bah et hayyeled vattasem bassuf rabbi elazar omer yam suf rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar
b: Agam kedichtiv kane vasuf kamelu
Vattered bat paro lirchotz al hayeor amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay melammed sheyyarda lirchotz miggillule bet aviha vechen hu omer im rachatz Adonai et tzoat benot tziyyon vego
Venaaroteha holchot vego amar rabbi yochanan en halicha zo ella leshon mita vechen hu omer hinne anochi holech lamut

Vattere et hatteva betoch hassuf kevan dachazo deka vau leatztzole lemoshe amru lah gevirtenu minhago shel olam melech basar vadam gozer gezera im kol haolam kullo en mekayemin otah banav uvne veto mekayemin otah veatte overet al gezerat avich ba gavriel vachavatan bakkarka
Vattishlach et amatah vattikkacheha rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya chad amar yadah vechad amar shifchatah man deamar yadah dichtiv ammatah uman deamar shifchatah middela ketiv yadah
Ulman deamar shifchatah ha amratte ba gavriel vachavatan bakkarka deshayyar lah chada delav orchah devat malka lemekam lechodah

Ulman deamar yadah lichtov yadah ha ka mashma lan deishtarbav ishtarbove deamar mar vechen atta motze beammatah shel bat paro vechen atta motze beshine reshaim dichtiv shinne reshaim shibbarta veamar resh lakish al tikre shibbarta ella sheribavta
Vattiftach vattirehu et hayyeled vattere mibe leh amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina sheraata shechina immo

Vehinne naar boche kare leh yeled vekare leh naar tana hu yeled vekolo kenaar divre rabbi yehuda amar lo rabbi nechemya im ken asito lemoshe rabbenu baal mum ella melammed sheasta lo immo chuppat neurim batteva amra shemma lo ezke lechuppato
Vattachmol alav vattomer miyyalde haivrim ze mena yada amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina sheraata oto mahul
Ze amar rabbi yochanan melammed shennitnabbea shello middatah ze nofel veen acher nofel
Vehayenu deamar rabbi elazar may dichtiv vechi yomru alechem dirshu el haovot veel hayyiddeonim hamtzaftzefim vehammahgim tzofin veenam yodin ma tzofin mehaggim veenan yodim ma mehaggim

Rau shemmoshian shel yisrael bammayim hu loke amdu vegazru kol habben hayyillod hayeora tashlichuhu kevan deshaduh lemoshe amru tu la chazenan ki hahu simana battilu ligzertayehu vehem enan yodin sheal me meriva hu loke

Vehayenu deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina may dichtiv hemma me meriva asher ravu hemma sherau itztagnine paro vetau vehayenu dekaamar moshe shesh meot elef ragli vego amar lahen moshe leyisrael bishvili nitztzaltem kullechem
Rabbi chanina bar pappa amar oto hayyom esrim veechad benisan haya amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam mi sheatid lomar shira al hayyam beom ze yilke beom ze
Rabbi acha bar chanina amar oto hayyom shishsha besivan haya amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam mi sheatid lekabbel tora mehar sinay beom ze yilke beom ze

Bishlama leman deamar beshishsha besivan mashkachatte lah telata yarche deamar mar beshiva baadar met uvshiva baadar nolad moshe umishshiva baadar vead shishsha besivan telata yarche ella leman deamar beesrim veechad benisan hechi mashkachatte lah
Otah shana meubberet hayeta rubbo shel rishon verubbo shel acharon veemtzai shalem
Vattomer achoto el bat paro haelech vekarati lach ishsha meneket min haivriyyot umay shena meivriyyot

Melammed shehechziruhu lemoshe al kol hammitzriyyot kullan velo yanak amar pe sheatid ledabber im hashshechina yinak davar tame vehayenu dichtiv et mi yore dea vego lemi yore dea ulmi yavin shemua ligmule mechalav ulattike mishshadayim
Vattomer lah bat paro lechi vego amar rabbi elazar melammed shehalcha bizrizut kealma rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar haalma sheheelima et devareha

Vattomer lah bat paro helichi et hayyeled hazze amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina mitnabbea veenah yodaat ma mitnabbea helichi ha shellichi vaani etten et secharech amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina lo dayyan latztzaddikim shemmachzirin lahen avedatan ella shennotnin lahen secharan
Vattikkach miryam hannevia achot aharon vego achot aharon velo achot moshe amar rav amram amar rav veamri lah amar rav nachman amar rav melammed shehayeta mitnabbea keshehi achot aharon

a: Veomeret atida immi shetteled ben shemmoshia et yisrael vechevan shennolad moshe nitmalle kal habbayit kullo or amad aviha unshakah al roshah amar lah bitti nitkayema nevuatich vechevan shehittiluhu layeor amad aviha utfachah al roshah amar lah bitti hechan nevuatich vehayenu dichtiv vattetatztzav achoto merachok ledea ma yease lo leda ma yehe besof nevuatah

Yosef zacha vechu may shena meikara dichtiv vayyaal yosef likbor et aviv vayyaalu itto kol avde paro vego vahadar vechol bet yosef veechav uvet aviv umay shena levassof dichtiv vayyashov yosef mitzrayema hu veechav vahadar vechol haolim itto likbor et aviv
Amar rabbi yochanan battechila ad shello rau bichvodan shel yisrael lo nahagu bahen kavod ulvassof sherau bichvodan nahagu bahen kavod

Dichtiv vayyavou ad goren haatad vechi goren yesh lo laatad amar rabbi avahu melammed shehikkifuhu ketarim laarono shel yaakov kegoren ze shemmakkifim lo atad shebbau bene esav uvne yishmael uvne ketura
Tana kullam lammilchama bau kevan sherau kitro shel yosef taluy baarono shel yaakov natlu kullan kitrehen utlaum baarono shel yaakov tana sheloshim veshishsha ketarim nitlu baarono shel yaakov
Vayyispedu sham misped gadol vechaved meod tana afilu susim vaafilu chamorim

Meelu meelu kevan shehiggiu limarat hammachpela ata esav ka meakkev amar lahen mamre kiryat haarba hi chevron veamar rabbi yitzchak kiryat arba arba zugot hau adam vechava avraham vesara yitzchak verivka yaakov velea ihu kavrah lelea bedideh vehay defayesh didi hu

Amaru leh zabbenteh amar lehu nehi dezabbeni becheruta peshituta mi zabbeni amaru leh in dichtiv bekivri asher kariti li veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak en kira ella leshon mechira shekken bichrakke hayyam korin limchira kira

Amar lehu havu li igarta amaru leh igarta beara demitzrayim hi uman nezil nezil naftali dekallil ki ayyalta dichtiv naftali ayyala shelucha hannoten imre shafer amar rabbi avahu al tikre imre shafer ella imre sefer

Chushim bereh dedan tamman hava veyakkiran leh udneh amar lehu may hay veamru leh ka meakkev hay ad deate naftali meara demitzrayim amar lehu vead deate naftali meara demitzrayim yehe avi abba mutal bevizzaon shekal kulfa machyeh aresheh natran eneh unfalu akkara deyaakov patchinhu yaakov leeneh veachech vehayenu dichtiv yismach tzaddik ki chaza nakam peamav yirchatz bedam harasha
Beotah shaa nitkayema nevuatah shel rivka dichtiv lamma eshkal gam shenechem yom echad veaf al gav demitatan lo beom echad havay kevuratan miha beom echad havay
Vei la iasak beh yosef echav la hao miasseki beh vehachtiv vayyisu oto vanav artza kenaan amru hannichu lo kevodo bimlachim yoter mibbehedotot
Mi lanu gadol miyyosef ku tanu rabbanan bo ure kamma chavivot mitzot al moshe rabbenu shekkol yisrael kullan nitasseku babbiza vehu nitassek bemitzot shenneemar chacham lev yikkach mitzot vego

Uminnayin haya yodea moshe rabbenu hechan yosef kavur amru serach bat asher nishtayera meoto haddor halach moshe etzlah amar lah kelum atte yodaat hechan yosef kavur amra lo aron shel mattechet asu lo mitzrim ukvauhu benilus hannahar kede sheyyitbarchu memav halach moshe veamad al sefat nilus amar lo yosef yosef higgia haet shennishba hakkadosh baruch hu sheani goel etchem vehiggia hashshevua shehishbata et yisrael im atta mare atzmecha mutav im lav hare anu menukkin mishshevuatecha miyyad tzaf arono shel yosef

Veal titmah heach barzel tzaf shehare ketiv vayehi haechad mappil hakkora veet habbarzel nafal el hammayim vego ahah adoni vehu shaul vayyomer ish haelohim ana nafal vayyarehu et hammakom vayyiktzov etz vayyashlech shamma vayyatzef habbarzel vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma elisha talmido shel eliyyahu veeliyyahu talmido shel moshe tzaf barzel mippanav mippene moshe rabbenu al achat kamma vechamma

Rabbi natan omer bekabbarnit shel melachim haya kavur halach moshe veamad al kabbarnit shel melachim amar yosef higgia et shennishba hakkadosh baruch hu sheani goel etchem vehiggia shevua shehishbata et yisrael im atta mare atzmecha mutav veim lav hare anu menukkin mishshevuatecha beotah shaa nizdaza arono shel yosef netalo moshe vehevio etzlo

Vechol otan shanim shehau yisrael bammidbar hau shene aronot hallalu echad shel met veechad shel shechina mehallechin ze im ze vehau ovrin veshavin omrim ma tivan shel shene aronot hallalu amru echad shel met veechad shel shechina vechi ma darko shel met lehallech im shechina amru
b: Kiyyem ze kol ma shekkatuv baze

Vei la asik beh moshe yisrael la hao miaski beh vehachtiv veet atzmot yosef asher heelu vene yisrael mimmitzrayim kavru vishchem vetu i la iasaku beh yisrael banav la hao miaski beh vehachtiv vayyihu livne yosef lenachala
Amru hannichu lo kevodo bimrubbim yoter mibbemuatin vetu amru hannichu lo kevodo bigdolim yoter mibbiktannim
Kavru bishchem may shena bishchem amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina mishshechem genavuhu velishchem nachzir avedato
Kashu kerae ahadade ketiv vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo uchtiv veet atzmot yosef asher heelu vene yisrael vego
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina kal haose davar velo gemaro uva acher ugmaro maale alav hakkatuv al sheggemaro keilu asao
Rabbi elazar omer af moridin oto miggedullato dichtiv vayehi baet hahi vayyered yehuda
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar af kover ishto uvanav dichtiv vattamot bat shua eshet yehuda vego uchtiv vayyamot er veonan
Amar rav yehuda amar rav mippene ma nikra yosef atzamot bechayyav mippene shello micha bichvod aviv dekaamri leh avdecha avinu vela amar lehu vela mide
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav veitema rabbi chama berabbi chanina mippene ma met yosef kodem leechav mippene shehinhig atzmo berabbanut
Veosef hurad mitzrayema amar rabbi elazar al tikre hurad ella horid shehorid itztagnine paro miggedullatan
Vayyiknehu potifar seris paro amar rav shekkenao leatzmo ba gavriel michael veserso ba gavriel ufero meikara ketiv potifar ulvassof potifera
Mi lanu gadol mimmoshe vechu vayyomer Adonai elay rav lach amar rabbi levi berav biser berav bisruhu berav biser rav lachem berav bisruhu rav lach
Davar acher rav lach rav yesh lecha umannu yehoshua
Davar acher rav lach shello yomru harav kamma kashe vetalmid kamma sarvan vechol kach lamma tana deve rabbi yishmael lefum gamla shichna

Vayyomer alehem ben mea veesrim shana anochi hayyom sheen talmud lomar hayyom hayyom malu yamay ushnotay lelammedcha shehakkadosh baruch hu mashlim shenotehem shel tzaddikim miyyom leom umechodesh lechodesh dichtiv et mispar yamecha amalle

Lo uchal od latzet velavo may latzet velavo ilema latzet velavo mammash vehachtiv umoshe ben mea veesrim shana bemoto lo nas lecho uchtiv vayyaal moshe mearvot moav el har nevo vetanya shettem esre maalot hau sham ufsaan moshe bifsia achat
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan latzet velavo bedivre tora melammed shennistattemu mimmennu shaare chochma
Vayyelech moshe vihoshua vayyityatztzevu beohel moed tana otah shabbat shel deo zuge hayeta nitla reshut mizze venitna laze

Vetanya amar rabbi yehuda ilmale mikra katuv i efshar leomro hechan moshe met bechelko shel reuven dichtiv vayyaal moshe mearvot moav el har nevo unvo bechelko shel reuven kayema dichtiv uvne reuven banu vego veet nevo vego
Nevo sheshsham metu shelosha neviim moshe veaharon umiryam
Vehechan moshe kavur bechelko shel gad dichtiv vayyar reshit lo vego umechelko shel reuven ad chelko shel gad kamma have arbaa milin otan arbaa milin mi holicho
Melammed shehaya moshe muttal bechanfe shechina umalache hashsharet omrim tzidkat Adonai asa umishpatav im yisrael vehakkadosh baruch hu omer mi yakum li im mereim mi yityatztzev li im poale aven
Ushmuel amar mi kehechacham umi yodea pesher davar verabbi yochanan amar hachochma meayin timmatze verav nachman amar vayyamot sham moshe vego semalon amar vayyamot sham moshe safra rabba deyisrael

Tanya rabbi eliezer haggadol omer shenem asar mil al shenem asar mil keneged machane yisrael bat kol mashmia veomer vayyamot moshe safra rabba deyisrael veyesh omrim lo met moshe ketiv hacha vayyamot sham uchtiv hatam vayehi sham im Adonai ma lehallan omed umshammesh af kan omed umshammesh
Vayyikbor oto vaggaye beeretz moav mul bet peor amar rabbi berechya siman betoch siman vaafilu hachi velo yada ish et kevurato
Uchvar shalcha malchut harshaa etzel

a: Gastera shel bet peor harenu hechan moshe kavur amdu lemala nidma lahem lematta lematta nidma lahem lemala nechleku lishte chitot otan sheomdim lemala nidma lahen lematta lematta nidma lahen lemala lekayyem ma shenneemar velo yada ish et kevurato

Rabbi chama berabbi chanina amar af moshe rabbenu eno yodea hechan kavur ketiv hacha velo yada ish et kevurato uchtiv hatam vezot habberacha asher berach moshe ish haelohim veamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina mippene ma nikbar moshe etzel bet peor kede lechapper al maase feor
Veamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina may dichtiv achare Adonai elohechem telechu vechi efshar lo leadam lehallech achar shechina vahalo kevar neemar ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu

Ella lehallech achar middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu ma hu malbish arummim dichtiv vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam ulishto kotnot or vayyalbishem af atta halbesh arummim hakkadosh baruch hu biker cholim dichtiv vayyera elav Adonai beelone mamre af atta bakker cholim hakkadosh baruch hu nichem avelim dichtiv vayehi achare mot avraham vayevarech elohim et yitzchak beno af atta nachem avelim hakkadosh baruch hu kavar metim dichtiv vayyikbor oto baggay af atta kevor metim
Kotnot or rav ushmuel chad amar davar habba min haor vechad amar davar shehaor nehene mimmennu

Darash rabbi simlay tora techillatah gemilut chasadim vesofah gemilut chasadim techilatah gemilut chasadim dichtiv vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam ulishto kotnot or vayyalbishem vesofah gemilut chasadim dichtiv vayyikbor oto baggay

Darash rabbi simlay mippene ma nitava moshe rabbenu likanes leeretz yisrael vechi leechol mippiryah hu tzarich o lisboa mittuvah hu tzarich ella kach amar moshe harbe mitzot nitztauu yisrael veen mitkayemin ella beeretz yisrael ekkanes ani laaretz kede sheyyitkayemu kullan al yadi

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu kelum atta mevakkesh ella lekabbel sachar maale ani alecha keilu asitam shenneemar lachen achallek lo varabbim veet atzumim yechallek shalal tachat asher heera lammavet nafsho veet poshim nimna vehu chet rabbim nasa velapposhim yafgia

Lachen achallek lo barabbim yachol kaacharonim velo karishonim talmud lomar veet atzumim yechallek shalal keavraham yitzchak veyaakov shehen atzumim battora uvmitzot tachat asher heera lammavet nafsho shemmasar atzmo lemita shenneemar veim ayin mecheni na vego

Veet poshim nimna shennimna im mete midbar vehu chet rabbim nasa shekkiper al maase haegel velapposhim yafgia shebbikesh rachamim al poshe yisrael sheyyachzeru bitshuva veen pegia ella tefilla shenneemar veatta al titpallel bead haam hazze veal tissa vaadam rinna utfilla veal tifga bi
Hadaran alach hamkanne leishto
Haya mevi et minchatah betoch kefifa mitzrit venotnah al yadeha kede leyaggeah
Kol hammenachot techilatan vesofan bichli sharet vezo techillatah bichfifa mitzrit vesofah bichli sharet

Kol hammenachot teunot shemen ulvona vezo enah teuna lo shemen velo levona kol hammenachot baot min hachittin vezo baa min hasseorin minchat haomer af al pi shebbaa min hasseorin hi hayeta baa geres vezo baa kemach rabban gamliel omer keshem shemmaaseha maase behema kach korbanah maachal behema
Gema tanya abba chanin omer mishshum rabbi eliezer vechol kach lamma kede leyaggeah kede shettachazor bah im kacha chasa tora al ovre retzono kal vachomer al ose retzono
Umimmay mishshum dechasa hu dilma ki hechi delo timachek megila kasavar
b: Mashkah veachar kach makriv et minchatah dei mishshum megila ha imchika lah

Kol hammenachot vechu urminhu seder menachot ketzad adam mevi mincha mittoch beto biklatot shel kesef veshel zahav venotnah letoch keli sharet umkaddeshah bichli sharet venoten aleha shamnah ulvonatah umolichah etzel kohen vechohen molichah etzel mizbeach umaggishah bekeren deromit maaravit keneged chuddah shel keren vedayyo

Umsallek et hallevona letzad echad vekometz mimmakom shennitrabba shamnah venotno letoch keli sharet umkaddesho bichli sharet umlakket et levonatah venotnah al gabbav umaale oto legabbe mizbeach umaalehu umaktiro bichli sharet umolcho venotno al gabbe haishim
Karav hakkometz sheyareha neechalin verashshain hakkohanim liten letochah yayin veshemen udvash veen asurin ella millechammetz
Katane miha biklatot shel kesef uviklatot shel zahav amar rav pappa ema bechelim haruyin lichle sharet
Mikkelal dichfifa mitzrit la chazya keman dela kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda detanya kele sharet sheasaan shel etz rabbi posel verabbi yose berabbi yehuda machshir
Afilu tema rabbi yose berabbi yehuda emar deamar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda bachashuvin bifchutin mi amar let leh lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda hakrivehu na lefechatecha
Venotnah lichle sharet umkaddeshah bichli sharet shamatte minah keli sharet en mekaddeshin ella middaat ema notnah bichli sharet lekaddeshah bichli sharet
Venoten aleha shamnah ulvonatah shenneemar veyatzak aleha shemen venatan aleha levona
Umolichah etzel kohen dichtiv veheviah el bene aharon vego
Vechohen molichah etzel mizbeach dichtiv vehiggishah etzel hammizbeach
Maggishah bekeren deromit maaravit keneged chuddah shel keren vedayyo menalan

Dichtiv vezot torat hammincha hakrev otah bene aharon lifne Adonai el pene hammizbeach vetanya lifne Adonai yachol bammaarav talmud lomar el pene hammizbeach i el pene hammizbeach yachol baddarom talmud lomar lifne Adonai ha ketzad maggishah bekeren deromit maaravit keneged chuddah shel keren vedayyo

Rabbi elazar omer yachol yaggishenna bemaaravah shel keren o lidromah shel keren amarta kol makom sheatta motze shene mikraot echad mekayyem atzmo umkayyem divre chavero veechad mekayyem atzmo umvattel divre chavero mannichin et shemmekayyem atzmo umvattel chavero vetofsin et shemmekayyem atzmo umkayyem chavero kesheatta omer lifne Adonai bammaarav bittalta el pene hammizbeach baddarom uchsheatta omer el pene hammizbeach baddarom kiyyamta lifne Adonai bammaarav ha ketzad maggishah lidromah shel keren
Vehechan kiyyamta amar rav ashe kasavar hay tanna kulleh mizbeach betzafon kae
May vedayyo amar rav ashe itzterich salka datach amena tibe haggashat mincha gufah kamashma lan
Veema hachi name amar kera vehikrivah el hakkohen vego vehiggishah el hammizbeach ma hakrava etzel kohen bichli af haggasha etzel mizbeach bichli
Umsallek et levonatah letzad echad ki hechi dela tikkemotz bahade mincha keditnan kamatz veala beyado tzeror o garger melach o koret levona pasul
Vekometz mimmakom shennitrabba shamnah menalan dichtiv missoltah umishshamnah miggirsah umishshamnah

Venotno letoch keli sharet umkaddesho bichli sharet lema li ha kaddeshah chada zimna mide dehave addam dam af al gav dekaddeshteh sakkin betzavar behema hadar mekaddesh leh bichli sharet hacha name la shena
Umlakket et levonatah venotnah al gabbav dichtiv veet kol hallevona asher al hammincha
Umaalehu

a: Umaktiro bichli sharet bichli sharet makter leh ella ema maalehu bichli sharet lehaktiro
Umolcho venotno al gabbe haishim dichtiv vechol korban minchatcha bammelach timlach vego
Karav hakkometz sheyareha neechalin menalan dichtiv vehiktir hakkohen et azkaratah vego uchtiv vehannoteret min hammincha leaharon ulvanav
Karav hakkometz lemar kidit leh ulmar kidit leh deitmar hakkometz meematay mattir shirayim baachila rabbi chanina amar mishshettishlot bo haur rabbi yochanan amar mishshettitzat haur berubbo
Verashshain hakkohanim liten letocho yayin veshemen udvash may tama amar kera lemoshcha ligdulla kederech shehammelachim ochlin
Veen asurin ella millechammetz dichtiv lo teafe chametz chelkam amar rabbi shimon ben lakish afilu chelkam lo teafe chametz
Kol hammenachot ku vechol hammenachot teunot shemen ulvona vehaika minchat chote derachamana amar lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona

Hachi kaamar kol hammenachot teunot shemen ulvona uvaot min hachitin uvaot solet minchat chote af al pi sheenah teuna shemen ulvona baa min hachittin uvaa solet minchat haomer af al pi shehi baa min hasseorin teuna shemen ulvona uvaa geres vezo enah teuna lo shemen velo levona uvaa min hasseorin uvaa kemach
Tanya amar rabbi shimon bedin hu shettehe minchat chote teuna shemen ulvona shello yehe chote niskar umippene ma enah teuna shello yehe korbano mehuddar
Uvdin hu shettehe chattat chelev teuna nesachim shello yehe chote niskar umippene ma enah teuna shello yehe korbano mehuddar

Aval chattato shel metzora vaashamo teunin nesachim lefi sheen bain al chet ini vehaamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan al shiva devarim negaim bain vechu hatam minnigeh hu deikappar leh ki mayete korban leishteroye bekadashim hu deka mayete
Ella meatta chattat nazir tehe teuna nesachim lefi sheenah baa al chet savar lah kerabbi elazar hakkappar deamar nazir name chote hu
Rabban gamliel omer keshem ku tanya amar lahen rabban gamliel lachachamim sofrim hannichu li veedreshenna kemin chomer
b: Deshameh lerabbi meir dekaamar hi heechilattu maadanne olam lefichach korbanah maachal behema amar lo hatinach ashira aniyya may ika lememar ella keshem shemmaaseha maase vehema kach korbanah maachal behema
Matni haya mevi peyali shel cheres venoten letochah chatzi log mayim min hakkiyyor rabbi yehuda omer reviit keshem shemmemaet bakketav kach memaet bammayim

Nichnas lahechal ufana limino umakom haya sham amma al amma vetavla shel shayish vetabbaat hayeta kevua bah keshehu magbiha venotel afar mittachteha venoten kede sheyyerae al hammayim shenneemar umin heafar asher yihye bekarka hammishkan yikkach hakkohen venatan el hammayim
Gema tana peyali shel cheres chadasha divre rabbi yishmael may tama derabbi yishmael gamar keli keli mimmetzora ma lehallan cheres chadasha af kan cheres chadasha
Vehatam menalan dichtiv veshachat et hatztzippor haechat el keli cheres al mayim chayyim ma mayim chayyim shello neesta bahen melacha af keli shello neesta bo melacha
I ma lehallan mayim chayyim af kan mayim chayyim
Lerabbi yishmael hachi name deamar rabbi yochanan me chiyyor rabbi yishmael omer me mayan hen vachachamim omrim mishshear memot hen
Ika lemifrach ma limtzora shekken taun etz erez veezov ushni tolaat
Amar rabba amar kera bichli cheres keli sheamarti lecha kevar
Amar rava lo shanu ella shello nitakkemu panav aval nitakkemu panav pesulin may tama dumya demayim ma mayim shello nishtannu af keli shello nishtanna
Bae rava nitakkemu vehechziran letoch kivshan haesh venitlabbenu mahu mi amrinan kevan deidcho idcho o dilma kevan dahadur hadur
Ta shema rabbi elazar omer etz erez veezov ushni tolaat shehifshil bahen kuppato laachorav pesulin veha hatam hadri umippashti
Hatam deikluf iklofe
Nichnas lahechal ufana limino vechu may tama deamar mar kol pinot sheatta pone lo yehu ella derech yamin
Makom haya sham amma ku tanu rabbanan umin heafar asher yihye yachol yetakken mibbachutz veyachnis
Talmud lomar bekarka hammishkan i bekarka hammishkan yachol yachpor bekardummot talmud lomar asher yihye ha ketzad yesh sham have en sham ten sham
Tanya idach umin heafar asher yihye vego melammed shehaya metakken mibbachutz umachnis bekarka hammishkan isi ben yehuda omer lehavi karka

a: Shilo nov vegivon uvet olamim
Isi ben menachem omer eno tzarich uma betuma kalla lo chalak hakkatuv betumat eshet ish chamura lo kol shekken im ken ma talmud lomar bekarka hammishkan shello yavi mittoch kuppato
Ibaya lehu en sham afar mahu sheyyitten efer alliba devet shammay la tibe lach deamri lo matzinu efer shekkaruy afar

Ki tibe lach alliba devet hillel deamri matzinu efer shekkaruy afar may af al gav deikri afar hacha bekarka hammishkan ketiv o dilma hay bekarka hammishkan lechidisi ben yehuda ulchidisi ben menachem hu deate
Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael bishlosha mekomot halacha okevet mikra
Hattora amra beafar vahalacha bechol davar hattora amra betaar vahalacha bechol davar hattora amra sefer vahalacha bechol davar
Veim ita lichshov name hay

Tena veshayyar umay shayyar dehay shayyar shayyar metzora detanya vehaya bayyom hashshevii yegallach et kol searo kelal et rosho veet zekano veet gabbot enav perat veet kal searo yegalleach chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella cheen happerat ma perat meforash mekom kinus sear venire af kol makom kinus sear venire
Ma rabbi rabbi sear haraglayim may miet miet devet hashshechi udchulleh gufeh
Vehilcheta megalleach kedallaat ditnan ba lo lehakkif et hamtzora maavir taar al kol besaro vekatane sefa uvayyom hashshevii megallecho tiglachat sheniyya ketiglachat rishona
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ki ka chashev halacha okevet mikra ha okevet midderabbanan hi
Rav pappa amar ki ka chashev halacha okevet veokeret ha okevet umosefet hi
Rav ashe amar ha matnita manni rabbi yishmael hi dedaresh kelale ufrate
b: Kedallaat manni rabbi akiva hi dedaresh ribuye umiute detanya vehaya bayyom hashshevii yegallach et kol searo riba et rosho veet zekano veet gabbot enav miet veet kal searo yegalleach chazar veriba riba umiet veriba riba hakkol
May riba riba dechulleh gufeh umay miet miet sear shebbetoch hachotem
May have alah ta shema deamar rav huna bar ashe amar rav en sham afar mevi rakbuvit yarak umkaddesh
Vela hi rakbuvit yarak hu dahavay afar efer la havay afar
Kede sheyyerae al hammayim tanu rabbanan shelosha tzerichin sheyyerau afar sota veefer para verok yevama mishshum rabbi yishmael amru af dam tzippor

May tama derabbi yishmael dichtiv vetaval otam bedam hatztzippor vego vetanya bedam yachol baddam velo bammayim talmud lomar bammayim i mayim yachol bammayim velo baddam talmud lomar baddam ha ketzad mevi mayim sheddam tzipor nikar bahen vechamma reviit
Verabbanan hahu legufeh dehachi kaamar rachamana atbel bedam uvmayim
Verabbi yishmael im ken lichtov rachamana vetaval bahem bedam uvammayim lema li lenikar
Verabbanan i ketav rachamana vetaval bahem hava amena hay lechodeh vehay lechodeh ketav rachamana bedam uvammayim learvan
Verabbi yishmael learvan kera acharina ketiv veshachat et hatztzippor haechat vego
Verabbanan i mehahu hava amena lishchateh samuch lemana veninketinhu liveridin ulkabbeleh ledam bemana acharina ka mashma lan
Bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera gedola umadchet et hammayim ketanna venidchet mippene hammayim mahu
Amar leh lav amena lach la tappek nafshach levar mehilcheta betzippor deror shiaru rabbanan en lecha gedola shemmadchet et hammayim veen lecha ketanna shennidchet mippene hammayim
Tanu rabbanan hikdim afar lammayim pasul verabbi shimon machshir may tama derabbi shimon

Dichtiv velakchu lattame meafar serefat hachattat vetanya amar rabbi shimon vechi afar hu vahalo efer hu shina hakkatuv bemashmao ladun hemennu gezera shava neemar kan afar veneemar lehallan afar ma lehallan afar al gabbe mayim af kan afar al gabbe mayim
Uma kan hikdim afar lammayim kasher af lehallan hikdim afar lammayim kasher
Vehatam menalan tere kerae ketivi ketiv alav alma efer beresha uchtiv mayim chayyim el keli alma mayim beresha ha ketzad ratza ze noten ratza ze noten
Verabbanan el keli daveka alav learvan
Veema alav daveka el keli shettehe chiyyutan bichli
Ma matzinu bechol makom machshir lemala af kan machshir lemala

a: Matni ba lo lichtov et hammegila meeze makom hu kotev
Miveim lo shachav ish vego veatte ki satit tachat ishech
Veeno kotev vehishbia hakkohen et haishsha vechotev yitten Adonai otach leala velishvua uvau hammayim hamarrim haelle bemeayich latzbot beten velanpil yarech veeno kotev veamra haishsha amen amen
Rabbi yose omer lo haya mafsik
Rabbi yehuda omer kol atzmo eno kotev ella yitten Adonai otach leala velishvua vego uvau hammayim hamarrim haelle bemeayich vego veeno kotev veamra haishsha amen amen
Gema bemay ka mipalgi behay kera kamipalgi vechatav et haalot haelle hakkohen bassefer
Rabbi meir savar alot alot mammash haalot lerabbot kelalot habbaot mechamat berachot elle lemaote kelalot shebbemishne tora haelle lemaote tzauoot vekabbalot amen
Verabbi yose kullehu kidkaamratte et lerabbot tzauoot vekabbalot
Verabbi meir ettim la daresh
Verabbi yehuda kullehu bemiute daresh lehu alot alot mammash haalot lemaote kelalot habbaot mechamat berachot elle lemaote kelalot shebbemishne tora haelle lemaote tzauoot vekabbalot
Verabbi meir may shena hay he dimrabbe beh umay shena hay he demaet beh
He degabbe dribuya ribuya hi he degabbe dmiuta miuta
Veha let leh lerabbi meir mikkelal lav atta shomea hen
Amar rabbi tanchum hinnaki ketiv
Daresh rabbi akiva ish veishsha zachu shechina benehen lo zachu esh ochaltan
Amar rava udishsha adifa middeish may tama hay metzaref vehay la metzaref
Amar rava mippene ma amra tora have afar lesota zachta yotze mimmenna ben keavraham avinu dichtiv beh afar vaefer lo zachta tachzor laafarah
Deresh rava bischar sheamar avraham avinu veanochi afar vaefer zachu banav lishte mitzot efer para vaafar sota
Vehaika name afar kisuy haddam
Hatam hechsher mitzva ika hanaa leka
Daresh rava bischar sheamar avraham avinu im michut vead seroch naal zachu banav lishte mitzot chut shel techelet urtzua shel tefillin
Bishlama retzua shel tefillin dichtiv verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha vetanya rabbi eliezer haggadol omer ellu tefillin shebbarosh
Ella chut shel techelet may hi detanya haya rabbi meir omer ma nishtanna techelet mikkol mine tzivonin

Mippene shehattechelet dome layyam veyam dome larakia verakia dome lechisse hakkavod shenneemar vayyiru et elohe yisrael vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir uchetzem hashshamayim latohar uchtiv kemare even sappir demut kisse
Matni eno kotev lo al halluach velo al hanneyar velo al
b: Haddiftera ella al hammegila shenneemar bassefer
Veeno kotev lo bekomos velo bekankantom velo bechol davar sheroshem ella bido shenneemar umacha ketav sheyyachol limmachot

Gema amar rava megilat sota shekketavah ballayela pesula may tama atya tora tora ketiv hacha veasa lah hakkohen et kol hattora hazzot uchtiv hatam al pi hattora asher yorucha veal hammishpat ma mishpat bayyom af megilat sota bayyom
Ketavah lemafrea pesula dichtiv vechatav et haalot haelle ki dichtiva
Ketavah kodem shettekabbel aleha shevua pesula shenneemar vehishbia veachar kach vechatav
Ketavah igeret pesula bassefer amar rachamana

a: Ketavah al shene dappin pesula sefer echad amar rachamana velo shenayim ushlosha sefarim
Katav ot achat umachak ot achat vechatav ot achat umachak ot achat pesula dichtiv veasa lah hakkohen et kol hattora hazzot
Bae rava katav shette megilot lishte sotot umchakan letoch kos echad mahu ketiva lishmah baenan vehaika o dilma baenan name mechika lishmah
Veim timtza lomar baenan name mechika lishmah mechakan bishte chosot vechazar veervan mahu mechika lishmah baenan vehaika o dilma ha lav didah ka shatya veha lav didah ka shatya
Veim timtza lomar ha lav didah ka shatya veha lav didah ka shatya chazar vechillekan mahu yesh berera o en berera teku
Bae rava hishkah besiv mahu bishfoferet mahu derech shetiyya bechach o en derech shetiyya bechach teku
Bae rav ashe nishpechu mehen venishtayeru mehen mahu teku
Amar rabbi zera amar rav shette shevuot haamurot bassota lamma achat kodem shennimchaka megila veachat leachar shennimchaka
Matkef lah rava tarvayehu kodem shennimchaka megila ketivan ella amar rava achat shevua sheyyesh immah ala veachat shevua sheen immah ala
Hechi dame shevua sheyyesh immah ala amar rav amram amar rav mashbiani alayich shello nitmet sheim nitmet yavou bich
Amar rava ala lechodah kayema ushvua lechodah kayema ella amar rava mashbiani alayich sheim nitmet yavou bich
Amar rav ashe ala ika shevua leka ella amar rav ashe mashbiani alayich shello nitmet veim nitmet yavou bich
Matni al ma hi omeret amen amen amen al haala amen al hashshevua amen meish ze amen meish acher amen shello satiti arusa unsua
b: Veshomeret yavam uchnusa amen shello nitmeti veim nitmeti yavou bi
Rabbi meir omer amen shello nitmeti amen shello ettame
Hakkol shavin sheen matne immah lo al kodem shettitares velo al achar shettitgaresh
Nistera leechad venitmet veachar kach hechzira lo haya matne immah
Ze hakkelal kol shettibbael velo hayeta asura lo lo haya matne immah
Gema amar rav hamnuna shomeret yavam shezzinta asura livamah mimmay middekatane shomeret yavam uchnusa
I amratte bishlama asira mishshum hachi matne bahadah ella i amratte la asira hechi matne bahadah vehatnan ze hakkelal kol sheilu tibael velo tehe asura lo lo haya matne immah
Amri bemareva let hilcheta kerav hamnuna
Ella ha dekatane shomeret yavam uchnusa ha manni rabbi akiva hi deamar en kidushin tofsin bechayyave lavin umshave lah ki erva
Bae rabbi yirmeya mahu sheyyatne adam al nisuin harishonim al nisue achiv mahu
Ta shema ze hakkelal kol shettibael velo tehe asura lo lo haya matne immah ha asira hachi name dematne shema minah
Rabbi meir omer amen shello nitmeti vechu tanya lo kesheamar rabbi meir amen shello ettame sheim tittame mayim bodkin otah meachshav ella lichshettittame mayim meararin otah uvodkin otah
Bae rav ashe mahu sheyyatne adam al nisuin haacharonim hashta miha la asira leh o dilma zimnin dimgaresh lah vahadar mahdar lah

Ta shema hakkol shavin shello haya matne immah lo al kodem shettitares velo al achar shettitgaresh nistera leechad venitmet veachar kach yachzirenna lo haya matne ha yachzirenna vetitame hachi name dematne shema minah
Tanu rabbanan zot torat hakkenaot melammed shehaishsha shota veshona
Rabbi yehuda omer zot sheen haishsha shota veshona amar rabbi yehuda maase veheid lefanenu nechunya chofer shichin shehaishsha shota veshona vekibalnu eduto bishne anashim aval lo beish echad
Vachachamim omrim en haishsha shota veshona ben beish echad ben bishne anashim
Vetanna kamma name hachtiv zot verabbanan batrae name ha chetiv torat
Amar rava beish echad uvoel echad dechulle alma la peligi deen haishsha shota veshona

a: Dichtiv zot bishne anashim ushne boalin dechulle alma la peligi dehaishsha shota veshona dichtiv torat
Ki peligi beish echad ushne boalin bishne anashim uvoel echad
Tanna kamma savar torat lerabboye kullehi zot lemaote ish echad uvoel echad
Verabbanan batrae savri zot lemaote kullehi torat lerabboye shene anashim ushne boalin
Verabbi yehuda zot lemaote tarte torat lerabbot tarte zot lemaote tarte ish echad uvoel echad ish echad ushne boalin torat lerabboye tarte shene anashim uvoel echad shene anashim ushne boalin
Hadaran alach haya mevi
Haya notel et minchatah mittoch kefifa mitzrit venotnah letoch keli sharet venotnah al yadah vechohen manniach yado mittachteha umnifah henif vehiggish kamatz vehiktir vehashshear neechal lakkohanim

Haya mashkah veachar kach makriv et minchatah rabbi shimon omer makriv et minchatah veachar kach haya mashkah shenneemar veachar yashke et haishsha et hammayim im hishkah veachar kach hikriv et minchatah keshera
Gema amar leh rabbi elazar lerabbi yoshiyya dedareh la tetev akkarach ad dimfarshatte lah leha milta minnayin leminchat sota shetteuna tenufa mena lan vehenif ketiv bah bivalim menalan
Atya yad yad mishshelamim ketiv hacha velakach hakkohen miyyad haishsha uchtiv hatam yadav teviena
Ma kan kohen af lehallan kohen uma lehallan bealim af kan bealim ha ketzad manniach yado tachat yede habbealim umenif
Henif vehiggish kamatz vechu haya mashkah veachar kach makriv et minchatah ha akrevah
Hachi kaamar seder menachot ketzad henif vehiggish kamatz vehiktir vehashshear neechal lakkohanim
Uvhashkaa gufah peligi rabbi shimon verabbanan derabbanan savri mashkah veachar kach makriv et minchatah verabbi shimon savar makriv et minchatah veachar kach mashkah shenneemar veachar yashke
Veim hishkah veachar kach hikriv et minchatah keshera
b: Tanu rabbanan vehishka ma talmud lomar vahalo kevar neemar vehishkah sheim nimchaka megila veomeret eni shota meararin otah umashkin otah beal korchah divre rabbi akiva

Rabbi shimon omer veachar yashke ma talmud lomar vahalo kevar neemar vehishkah ella leachar kol maasim kullan haamurin lemala maggid shelosha devarim meakkevin bah ad shello karav hakkometz vead shello nimchaka megila vead shello tekabbel aleha shevua
Ad shello karav hakkometz rabbi shimon letameh deamar makriv et minchatah veachar kach mashkah
Ad shello nimchaka megila ella may mashke lah amar rav ashe lo nitzrecha lesherishumo nikar
Ad shello tekabbel aleha shevua mishta hu dela shatya ha michtav katvi lah vehaamar rava megilat sota shekketavah kodem shettekabbel aleha shevua lo asa velo chelum kedi nasvah
Bemay kamipalgi telata kerae ketivi vehishka kamma veachar yashke vehishkah batra

Rabbanan savri vehishka kamma legufo shemmashke veachar kach makriv et minchatah veachar yashke mibe leh lesherishumo nikar vehishkah batra sheim nimchaka megila veomeret eni shota meararin otah umashke otah beal korchah

Verabbi shimon savar veachar yashke legufo shemmakriv et minchatah veachar kach mashkah vehishka kamma sheim hishkah veachar kach hikriv et minchatah keshera vehishkah batra sheim nimchaka megila veamra eni shota meararin otah umashkin otah beal korchah
Verabbanan bediavad la patach kera

Vesavar rabbi akiva mashkin otah beal korchah vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer kalbos shel barzel metilin letoch piha sheim nimchaka megila veamra eni shota meararin otah umashkin otah beal korchah amar rabbi akiva kelum anu tzerichin ella levodkah vahalo beduka veomedet ella ad shello karav hakkometz yechola lachazor bah mishshekkarav hakkometz enah yechola lachazor bah
Velitamach tikshe lach hi gufah mishshekkarav hakkometz enah yechola lachazor bah vahalo beduka veomedet

Enah maspeket lishtot ad sheppaneha morikot veeneha boltot vehi mitmallet gidin vehem omrim hotziuha hotziuha shello tetamme haazara

Rabbi yehoshua omer rotza ishsha bekav vetiflut mittisha kabbin ufrishut hu haya omer chasid shote verasha arum veishsha perusha umakkot perushin hare ellu mevalle olam

Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi meir keshehayiti lamed tora etzel rabbi akiva hayiti metil kankantom letoch haddeo velo amar li davar keshebbati etzel rabbi yishmael amar li beni ma melachtecha amarti lo lavlar ani amar li beni heve zahir shemmelachtecha melechet shamayim hi shemma tachsir ot achat o totir ot achat nimtzeta atta machriv et kal haolam kullo

May kaamar leh umay ka mahdar leh

Ini veha tanya amar rabbi meir keshehayiti lamed tora etzel rabbi yishmael hayiti metil kankantom letoch haddeo velo amar li davar keshebbati etzel rabbi akiva asarah alay

Vehane tannae chi hane tannae detanya en megilatah keshera lehashkot bah sota acheret rabbi achay bar yoshiyya omer megilatah keshera lehashkot bah sota acheret

Verabbi achay bar yoshiyya let leh katav legaresh et ishto venimlach metzao ben iro veamar lo shemi keshimcha veshem ishti keshem ishtecha pasul legaresh bo
Amri hatam vechatav lah amar rachamana bainan ketiva lishmah hacha name veasa lah may asiyya mechika
Enah maspeket lishtot ad sheppaneha ku manni rabbi shimon hi deamar makriv et minchatah veachar kach mashkah dechamma dela karva minchatah la badki lah mayya dichtiv minchat zikkaron mazkeret aon
Ema sefa yesh lah zechut hayeta tola lah atan lerabbanan dei rabbi shimon haamar en zechut tola bammayim hammarim
Amar rav chisda ha manni rabbi akiva hi deamar makriv et minchatah veachar kach mashkah uvizchut savar lah kerabbanan
Vehem omrim hotziuha vechu may tama dedilma meta lememra demet asur bemachane leviyya
Vehatanya teme met muttar likanes lemachane leviyya velo teme met bilvad amru ella afilu met atzmo shenneemar vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo immo bimchitzato
Amar abbaye shemma tifros nidda lememra deviatuta merappeya in dichtiv vattitchalchal hammalka meod veamar rav sheppersa nidda veha anan tenan charada mesalleket damim pachda tzamet biatuta merappeya
Yesh lah zechut hayeta vechu manni matnitin la abba yose ben chanan vela rabbi elazar ben yitzchak ish kefar darom velo rabbi yishmael

Detanya im yesh lah zechut tola lah shelosha chodashim kede hakkarat haubbar divre abba yose ben chanan rabbi elazar ben yitzchak ish kefar darom omer tisha chodashim shenneemar venikketa venizrea zara ulhallan hu omer zera yaavdennu yesuppar zera harauy lesapper
Rabbi yishmael omer shenem asar chodesh veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar dichtiv lahen malka milki yishpar alach vachatayach betzidka feruk vaavayatach bemichan anayin

a: Hen teheve archa lishlevetach uchtiv kolla meta al nevuchadnetztzar malka uchtiv liktzat yarchin tere asar

Zechut demitzva mi maggena kulle hay vehatanya et zo darash rabbi menachem bar yose ki ner mitzva vetora or tala hakkatuv et hammitzva bener veet hattora beor et hammitzva bener lomar lach ma ner enah megina ella lefi shaa af mitzva enah megina ella lefi shaa

Nizdammena lo avuka shel ur nitzal min hakkotzim umin happechatim umin habbarkanim vaadayin mityare mechayya raa umin hallistin veeno yodea beeze derech mehallech kevan sheala ammud hashshachar nitzal mechayya raa umin hallistin vaadayin eno yodea beeze derech mehallech higgia lefarashat derachim nitzal mikkullam
Davar acher avera mechabba mitzva veen avera mechabba tora shenneemar mayim rabbim lo yuchlu lechabbot et haahava
Amar rav yosef mitzva beidana deasek bah maggena umatztzela beidana dela asek bah aggone maggena atztzole la matztzela tora ben beidana deasek bah uven beidana dela asek bah maggena umatztzela

Matkef lah rabba ella meatta doeg vaachitofel mi la aski betora ammay la hegena alayehu ella amar rava tora beidana deasek bah maggena umatztzela beidana dela asek bah aggone maggena atztzole la matztzela mitzva ben beidana deasek bah ben beidana dela asek bah aggone maggena atztzole la matztzela

Davar acher avera mechabba mitzva veen avera mechabba tora amar rav yosef darsheh rabbi menachem bar yose lehay kera ki sinay veilmale darshuh doeg vaachitofel hachi la redafu batar david dichtiv lemor elohim azavo vego
May derush velo yire vecha ervat davar vego vehen enan yodin sheavera mechabba mitzva veen avera mechabba tora
May boz yavuzu lo amar ulla la keshimon achi azarya vela kerabbi yochanan deve nesia
Ella kehillel veshevna dechi ata rav dimi amar hillel veshevna ache hao hillel asak battora shevna avad iska lesof amar leh ta naarov veliflog yatzta bat kol veamra im yitten ish et kol hon beto vego
b: Omer ben azzay chayyav adam lelammed et vechu rabbi eliezer omer kol hamlammed et bitto tora melammedah tiflut tiflut salka datach ella ema keilu limmedah tiflut
Amar rabbi avahu may tama derabbi eliezer dichtiv ani chochma shachanti orma kevan shennichnesa chochma beadam nichnesa immo armumit

Verabbanan hay ani chochma may avdi leh mibe leh lechidrabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina en divre tora mitkayemin ella bemi shemmaamid atzmo arom alehen shenneemar ani chochma shachanti orma amar rabbi yochanan en divre tora mitkayemin ella bemi shemmesim atzmo kemi sheeno shenneemar vehachochma meayin timmatze
Rabbi yehoshua omer rotza ishsha vechu may kaamar hachi kaamar rotza ishsha bekav vetiflut immo mittishat kabbin ufrishut
Hu haya omer chasid shote ku hechi dame chasid shote kegon deka tava itta benahara veamar lav orach ara leistakkole bah veatztzolah

Hechi dame rasha arum amar rabbi yochanan ze hammatim devarav laddayyan kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero rabbi avahu omer ze hannoten dinar leani lehashlim lo matayim zuz ditnan mi sheyyesh lo matayim zuz lo yittol leket shichcha ufea umasar ani haya lo matayim chaser dinar afilu elef notnin lo keachat hare ze yittol
Rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim muatin deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan yetomim shekkadmu umachru binchasim muatin ma shemmachru machru

Abbaye amar ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim kerabban shimon ben gamliel detanya nechasay lecha veacharecha lifloni veyarad harishon umachar veachal hashsheni motzi miyyad hallakochot divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer en lashsheni ella ma sheshshiyyer rishon
Rav yosef bar chama amar rav sheshet ze hammachria acherim beorchotav rabbi zerika amar rav huna ze hammekel leatzmo umachmir laacherim ulla amar ze

a: Shekkara veshana velo shimesh talmide chachamim
Ittemar kara veshana velo shimesh talmide chachamim rabbi elazar omer hare ze am haaretz rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar hare ze bur rabbi yannay omer hare ze kuti
Rav acha bar yaakov omer hare ze magosh amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mistabbera kerav acha bar yaakov deamri inashe raten magosha vela yada may amar tane tanna vela yada may amar

Tanu rabbanan ezehu am haaretz kol sheeno kore keriat shema shacharit vearvit bevirchoteha divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim kol sheeno manniach tefilin ben azzay omer kol sheen lo tzitzit bevigdo rabbi yonatan ben yosef amar kol sheyyesh lo banim veeno megaddelan lilmod tora acherim omrim afilu kore veshone velo shimesh talmide chachamim zehu am haaretz
Kara velo shana hare ze bur lo kara velo shana alav hakkatuv omer vezarati et bet yisrael veet bet yehuda zera adam vezera behema

Yera et Adonai beni vamelech im shonim al titarav amar rabbi yitzchak ellu sheshshonim halachot peshita mahu detema shonin bechet vechidrav huna deamar rav huna kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah huttera lo ka mashma lan

Tana hattannaim mevalle olam mevalle olam salka datach amar ravina shemmorin halacha mittoch mishnatan tanya name hachi amar rabbi yehoshua vechi mevalle olam hen vahalo meyashve olam hen shenneemar halichot olam lo ella shemmorin halacha mittoch mishnatan
Ishsha perusha vechu tanu rabbanan betula tzalyanit vealmana shovavit vekatan shello kalu lo chodashav hare ellu mevalle olam

Ini vehaamar rabbi yochanan lamadnu yirat chet mibbetula vekibul sachar mealmana yirat chet mibbetula derabbi yochanan shamah lehahi betula denafla aappah vekaamra ribbono shel olam barata gan eden uvarata gehinnam barata tzaddikim uvarata reshaim yehi ratzon millefanecha shello yikkashlu bi bene adam

May katan shello kalu lo chodashav hacha targimu ze talmid chacham hamvaet berabbotav

Parush ma chovati veeesenna ha mealleuta hi ella deamar ma chovati tu veeesenna

Parush meahava parush miyyira amaru leh abbaye verava letanna la titne parush meahava parush miyyira deamar rav yehuda amar rav leolam yaasok adam battora uvmitzot afilu shello lishmah shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak demittammera mittammera udmiggalleya miggalleya be dina rabba litpera mehane dechafu gunde amar lah yannay malka lidveteh al tityari min happerushin velo mimmi sheenan perushin ella min hatztzevuin sheddomin lifrushin shemmaasehen kemaase zimri umvakkeshin sachar kefinchas

Matni rabbi shimon omer en zechut tola bemayim hammarim veim atta omer hazzechut tola bammayim hamarrin madhe atta et hammayim bifne kol hannashim hashshotot umotzi atta shem ra al hattehorot sheshshatu sheomrim temeot hen ella shettalta lahen zechut rabbi omer hazzechut tola bemayim hamarrim veenah yoledet veenah mashbachat ella mitnavvena veholechet lesof hi meta beotah mita
Nitmet minchatah ad shello kadsha bichli hare hi kechol hammenachot vetippade veim mishshekkadsha bichli hare hi kechol hammenachot vetissaref veellu shemminchotehen nisrafot

a: Haomeret temea ani lach veshebbau lah edim shehi temea vehaomeret eni shota veshebbalah eno rotze lehashkotah veshebbalah ba aleha badderech
Vechol hannesuot lechohanim minchotehen nisrafot bat yisrael shennisset lechohen minchatah nisrefet vechohenet shennisset leyisrael minchatah neechelet
Ma ben kohen lechohenet minchat kohenet neechelet uminchat kohen enah neechelet kohenet mitchallelet vechohen en mitchallel
Kohenet mittammea lemetim veen kohen mittamme lemetim kohen ochel bekodshe kadashim veen kohenet ochelet bekodshe kodashim

Ma ben ish leishsha haish porea uforem veen haishsha poraat uforemet haish maddir et beno benazir veen haishsha madderet benah benazir haish megalleach al nezirut aviv veen haishsha megallachat al nezirut aviha

Haish mekaddesh et bitto veen haishsha mekaddeshet et bittah haish mocher et bitto veen haishsha mocheret et bittah haish niskal arom veen haishsha niskelet arumma haish nitle veen haishsha nitlet haish nimkar bignevato veen haishsha nimkeret bignevatah

Gema tanu rabbanan kol hannesuot lakkehunna minchotehen nisrafot ketzad kohenet leviyya veyisreelit shennisset lechohen en minchatah neechelet mippene sheyyesh lo chelek bah veenah ola kalil mippene sheyyesh lah chelek bah ella hakkometz karev beatzmo vehashshirayim kerevin beatzman

Ikri kan kol shehu mimmennu laishim hare hu beval taktiru amar yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi demassek lehu leshum etzim kerabbi eliezer detanya rabbi eliezer omer lereach nichoach i atta maale aval atta maalehu leshum etzim

Bat yisrael hannesua vechu may tama deamar kera vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel kohen velo kohenet
Kohenet mitchallelet kohen en mitchallel menalan deamar kera velo yechallel zaro beammav zaro mitchallel vehu eno mitchallel
Kohenet mittammea ku may tama amar kera emor el hakkohanim bene aharon bene aharon velo benot aharon
Kohen ochel bekodshe kodashim dichtiv kol zachar bivne aharon yochalenna
Uma ben ish ku tanu rabbanan ish en li ella ish ishsha minnayin keshehu omer vehatztzarua asher bo hare kan shenayim
Im ken ma talmud lomar ish lainyan shellematta ish porea vechu

Arusa veshomeret yavam lo shotot velo notlot ketuva shenneemar asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah perat laarusa veshomeret yavam
Almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot mamzeret

a: Untina leyisrael uvat yisrael lemamzer ulnatin lo shotot velo notlot ketuva
Veellu lo shotot velo notlot ketuva haomeret temea ani veshebbau lah edim shehi temea vehaomeret eni shota
Amar balah eni mashkah veshebbalah ba aleha badderech notlot ketubba velo shotot
Metu balehen ad shello shatu bet shammay omrim notlot ketubba velo shotot uvet hillel omrim o shotot o lo notlot ketubbatan
Meubberet chavero umnikat chavero lo shotot velo notlot ketubba divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim yachol hu lehafrishah ulhachzirah leachar zeman
Ayelonit uzkena vesheenah reuya leled lo notlot ketubba velo shotot rabbi elazar omer yachol hu lisa ishsha acheret velifrot velirbot hemenna
Ushar kol hannashim o shotot o lo notlot ketubba eshet kohen shota umutteret levalah eshet saris shota
Al yede kol araot mekannin chutz min hakkatan umimmi sheeno ish

Veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen mi shennitcharesh balah o nishtatta o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin lo lehashkotah amru ella lefoslah mikketubbatah rabbi yose omer af lehashkotah lichsheyyetze balah mibbet haasurin yashkenna
Gema mishta hu dela shatya ha kannoye mekanne lah mena hane mile detanu rabbanan dabber el bene yisrael veamarta lerabbot arusa veshomeret yavam lekinuy
Umatnitin manni rabbi yonatan hi detanya tachat ishech perat laarusa yachol sheani motzi af shomeret yavam talmud lomar ish ish divre rabbi yoshiyya
Rabbi yonatan omer tachat ishech perat leshomeret yavam otzi shomeret yavam velo otzi et arusa talmud lomar asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah perat laarusa
Mar allima leh arusa dekidushe dideh vesoklin al yado
Umar allima leh shomeret yavam dela mechassera mesira lechuppa
Verabbi yonatan hay ish ish may aved leh mibe leh lerabbot eshet cheresh veeshet shote veeshet
b: Shaamum verabbi yoshiyya hay tachat ishah may aved leh mibe leh lehakkish ish leishsha veishsha leish

Ella tama dichtivi hane kerae ha lav hachi hava amena arusa shatya veha ki ata rabbi acha bar chanina middaroma ata veayeti matnita bideh mibbalade ishech mishshekkadma shechivat baal labboel velo shekkadma shechivat boel labbaal
Amar rame bar chama mashkachatte lah kegon shebba aleha arus bevet aviha
Dichotah gabbe shomeret yavam kegon shebba aleha yavam bevet chamiha ha shomeret yavam karet lah ishto meallayeta hi dehaamar rav kana lakkol
Kishmuel deamar lo kana ella lidvarim haamurim bapparasha
I hachi lema rav deamar kerabbi yoshiyya ushmuel deamar kerabbi yonatan amar lach rav ana daamari afilu lerabbi yonatan middeitzterich kera lemaotah mikkelal deishto meallayeta hi

a: Ushmuel amar ana daamari afilu lerabbi yoshiyya middeitzterich kera lerabboyah mikkelal delav ishto hi kelal
Ibaya lehu overet al dat tzericha hatraa lehafsidah ketubbatah o enah tzericha mi amrinan kevan deoveret al dat hi la baaya hatraa o dilma tive hatraa dei hadra bah tihdar bah
Ta shema arusa veshomeret yavam lo shotot velo notlot ketuva mishta hu dela shatya ha kannoye mekanne lah lemay lav lehafsidah ketubbatah
Amar abbaye la leosrah alav rav pappa amar lehashkotah keshehi nesua kidtanya en mekannin laarusa lehashkotah keshehi arusa aval mekannin laarusa lehashkotah keshehi nesua
Amar rava ta shema almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot mamzeret untina leyisrael bat yisrael lemamzer ulnatin lo shotot velo notlot ketuva
Mishta hu dela shatya ha kannoye mekanne lehu ulmay i leosran alav ha asiran vekayeman ella lav lehafsidan ketubbatan
Amar rav yehuda middiskarta la leosrah labboel kabbaal ditnan keshem sheasura labbaal kach asura labboel

Amar rav chanina missura ta shema veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen mi shennitcharesh balah o nishtatta o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin velo lehashkotah amru ella lefoslah mikketubbatah shema minah bae hatraa shema minah
Vechullehu may tama la amri meha dilma shane hatam delet lah emta devaal kelal
Ibaya lehu overet al dat veratza baal lekayemah mekayemah o eno mekayemah mi amrinan bikfida devaal tela rachamana veha la kafed o dilma kevan dekafed kafed

Ta shema veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen mi shennitcharesh balah o nishtatta o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin vei amratte ratza baal lekayemah mekayemah avdi bet din mide dedilma la nicha leh levaal setama demilta kevan deoveret al dat hi menach nicha leh
Ibaya lehu baal shemmachal al kinuo kinuo machul o eno machul mi amrinan bekinuy devaal tela rachamana uvaal ha machel leh lekinuo o dilma kevan dekanni lah meikara la matze machel leh

Ta shema veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen mi shennitcharesh balah o nishtatta o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin vei amratte baal shemmachal al kinuo kinuo machul avdinan mide deate baal machel leh setama demilleta adam maskim al daat bet din
Ta shema umosrin lo shene talmide chachamim shemma yavo aleha badderech vei amratte baal shemmachal al kinuo kinuo machul lachleh lekinuyeh velivol
May shena talmide chachamim digmiri dei bae lemival amri leh achaleh lekinuyach uvalah

Ta shema deamar rabbi yoshiyya shelosha devarim sach li zeera meanshe yerushalayim baal shemmachal al kinuo kinuo machul vezaken mamre sheratzu bet din limchol lo mochalin lo uven sorer umore sheratzu aviv veimmo limchol lo mochalin lo
Uchshebbati etzel chaveray shebbaddarom al shenayim hodu li veal zaken mamre lo hodu li shello yirbu machalokot beyisrael shema minah baal shemmachal al kinuo kinuo machul shema minah
Peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar kodem setira machul leachar setira eno machul vechad amar leachar setira name machul umistabbera keman deamar eno machul
Mimmay middeka mehadderi rabbanan lerabbi yose detanya rabbi yose omer balah neeman aleha mikkal vachomer uma nidda shehi becharet balah neeman aleha sota shehi belav lo kol shekken
Amru lo lo im amarta benidda shekken yesh lah heter tomar besota sheen lah heter
Vei amratte leachar setira machul lah mashkachatte lah deyesh lah heter dei bae machel leh lekinuyeh uvael ella shema minah leachar setira eno machul shema minah
Metu balehen ad shello shatu bet shammay ku bemay kamipalgi bet shammay savri shetar haomed ligbot kegavuy dame
