Meubberet chavero ku amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh machloket baakara uzkena
Aval ayelonit divre hakkol lo shota velo notelet ketubbatah shenneemar venikketa venizrea zara mi sheddarkah lehazria yatza zo sheen darkah lehazria
Metivi hamkanne laarusato ulshomeret yavam shello im ad shello kenasah nistera lo shota velo notelet ketubbatah

a: Meubberet chavero umeneket chavero lo shotot velo notlot ketuva divre rabbi meir
Shehaya rabbi meir omer lo yissa adam meubberet chavero umeneket chavero veim nasa yotzi velo yachzir olamit vachachamim omrim yotzi uchsheyyaggia zemanno lichnos yichnos
Veharove shennasa akara uzkena veen lo ishsha uvanim meikara lo shota velo notelet ketubba rabbi elazar omer yachol hu lisa acheret velifrot velirbot hemenna

Aval hamkanne laarusato ulshomeret yavam shello umishshekkenasah nistera o shota o lo notelet ketubba meubberet umeneket atzmo o shota o lo notelet ketubbatah harove shennasa akara uzkena veyesh lo ishsha uvanim o shota o lo notelet ketubba
Eshet mamzer lemamzer veeshet natin lenatin veeshet ger veeved meshuchrar veayelonit o shota o lo notelet ketubba katane miha ayelonit teuvteh derav nachman

Amar lecha rav nachman tannae hi vaana daamari ki hay tanna detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer ayelonit lo shota velo notelet ketubba shenneemar venikketa venizrea zara mi sheddarkah lehazria yatzata zo sheen darkah lehazria

Verabbanan hay venikketa venizrea zara may avdi leh mibe lehu lechidtanya venikketa venizrea zara sheim hayeta akara nifkedet divre rabbi akiva amar lo rabbi yishmael im ken yissatru kol haakarot veyippakdu vezo hoil velo nistera hifsida
Im ken ma talmud lomar venikketa venizrea zara sheim hayeta yoledet betzaar yoledet berevach nekevot yoledet zecharim ketzarim yoledet arukkim shechorim yoledet levanim
Eshet mamzer lemamzer peshita mahu detema apposhe pesulin la lapesh ka mashma lan
Eshet ger veeved meshuchrar veayelonit peshita
Mahu detema dabber el bene yisrael velo gerim ka mashma lan veema hachi name veamarta ribbuya hu
Eshet kohen shota ku eshet kohen shota peshita mahu detema vehi lo nitpasa asura ha nitpasa mutteret vezo hoil venitpasa asura ema la tishte ka mashma lan
Umutteret levalah peshita amar rav huna bemitnavvena mitnavvena ha badkuha mayya
Bemitnavvena derech evarim mahu detema ha zannoye zannay veha dela badkuha mayya ki orchayehu mishshum divones zannay ulgabbe kohen asira ka mashma lan
Eshet saris shota peshita mahu detema mibbalade ishech amar rachamana vehay lav bar hachi hu ka mashma lan
Al yede kol araot mekannin peshita
b: Mahu detema nitmaa nitmaa shene peamim echad labbaal veechad labboel hecha deka mitasra beha zenut aval ha hoil vaasura vekayema ema la ka mashma lan
Chutz min hakkatan vechu ish amar rachamana velo katan vesheeno ish lemaote may ilema lemaote shachuf vehaamar shemuel shachuf mekannin al yado ufosel bitruma
Mekannin al yado peshita mahu detema veshachav ish otah shichvat zera amar rachamana veha lav bar hachi hu ka mashma lan
Ufosel bitruma peshita mahu detema lo yechallel zaro amar rachamana deit leh zera lichallel delet leh zera la lichallel ka mashma lan
Veella lemaote nochri vehaamar rav hamnuna nochri mekannin al yado ufosel bitruma
Mekannin al yado peshita mahu detema nitmaa nitmaa shette peamim echad labbaal veechad labboel hecha dekamitasra beha zenut aval ha hoil vaasira vekayema ema la kamashma lan
Ufosel bitruma peshita mahu detema uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar amar rachamana devar havaya in delav bar havaya la kamashma lan defasel midderabbi yochanan

Deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael minnayin lenochri veeved shebbau al hakkohenet veal halleviyya veal bat yisrael sheppesaluha shenneemar uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugrusha mi sheyyesh lo almenut vegerushin bah yatzu nochri veeved sheen lo almenut vegerushin bah
Veella lemaote may amar rav pappa lemaote behema deen zenut bivhema
Amar leh rava mipparzikya lerav ashe mena ha milta daamur rabbanan en zenut bivhema dichtiv lo tavi etnan zona umchir kelev vego
Vetanya etnan kelev umchir zona muttarin shenneemar gam shenehem shenayim velo arbaa
Veella shichvat zera lema li mibe leh lechidtanya shichvat zera perat ledavar acher
May davar acher amar rav sheshet perat leshekkine lah shello kedarkah amar leh rava shello kedarkah mishkeve ishsha ketiv
Ella amar rava perat leshekkine lah derech evarim amar leh abbaye peritzuta bealma hi ufritzuta mi asar rachamana

Ella amar abbaye perat leshekkine lah binshika hanicha leman deamar haaraa zo hachnasat atara aval neshika velo kelum hi hayenu deate kera lemaote neshika ella leman deamar haaraa zo neshika may ika lememar
Leolam leshekkine lah derech evarim umahu detema bikfida devaal talya rachamana uvaal ha ka kafed kamashma lan
Amar shemuel yissa adam

a: Duma veal yissa bat duma shezzo baa mittipa keshera vezo baa mittipa pesula
Verabbi yochanan amar yissa adam bat duma veal yissa duma shezzo omedet bechezkat kashrut vezo enah omedet bechezkat kashrut
Metivi nose adam duma amar rava vetisbera nose lechattechilla ella im nasa teni name bat duma
Vehilcheta yissa adam bat duma veal yissa duma detane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu ishsha mezanna baneha kesherin rov beilot achar habbaal
Bae rav amram hayeta perutza beoter mahu alliba deman deamar en ishsha mitabberet ella samuch levistah la tibe lach dela yada bah vela menattar lah
Ki tibe lach alliba deman deamar en ishsha mitabberet ella samuch litvilatah may kevan deyada bah nattore menattar lah o dilma kevan difrutza beoter la teku

Veellu shebbet din ku tanu rabbanan ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot eshet cheresh veeshet shote veeshet shaamum veshehalach balah limdinat hayyam veshehaya chavush bevet haasurin shebbet din mekannin lahen lefoslan mikketubbatan
Yachol af lehashkotan talmud lomar vehevi haish et ishto rabbi yose omer af lehashkotah velichsheyyetze balah mibbet haasurin yashkenna
Bemay ka mipalgi rabbanan savri baenan vekinne vehevi verabbi yose savar la baenan vekinne vehevi

Tanu rabbanan asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah lehakkish ish leishsha veishsha leish lemay hilcheta amar rav sheshet keshem sheim hu some lo haya mashkah dichtiv venelam meene ishah kach hi im hayeta soma lo hayeta shota rav ashe amar keshem shechigeret vegidemet lo hayeta shota dichtiv
b: Veheemid hakkohen et haishsha lifne Adonai venatan al kappeha kach hu im haya chiger o gidem lo haya mashkah mar bar rav ashe amar keshem sheilemet lo hayeta shota dichtiv veamra haishsha amen amen kach hu im haya ilem lo haya mashkah
Hadaran alach arusa
Keshem shehammayim bodkin otah kach hammayim bodkin oto shenneemar uvau uvau
Keshem sheasura labbaal kach asura labboel shenneemar nitmaa venitmaa divre rabbi akiva
Amar rabbi yehoshua kach haya doresh zecharya ben hakkatztzav rabbi omer shene peamim haamurim bapparasha nitmaa venitmaa echad labbaal veechad labboel
Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva uchli cheres asher yippol mehem el tocho kol asher betocho yitma eno omer tame ella yitma letamme acherim limmed al kikkar sheni shemmetamme et hashshelishi

Amar rabbi yehoshua mi yegalle afar meenecha rabban yochanan ben zakkay shehayita omer atid dor acher letaher kikkar shelishi sheen lo mikra min hattora shehu tame vahalo rabbi akiva talmidcha mevi lo mikra min hattora shehu tame shenneemar kol asher betocho yitma
Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva umaddotem michutz lair et peat kedma alpayim baamma vego umikra acher omer mikkir hair vachutza elef amma saviv
I efshar lomar elef amma shekkevar neemar alpayim amma vei efshar lomar alpayim amma shekkevar neemar elef amma ha ketzad elef amma migrash vealpayim amma techum hashshabbat
Rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer elef amma migrash vealpayim amma sadot uchramim

Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva az yashir moshe uvne yisrael et hashshira hazzot la vayyomru lemor sheen talmud lomar lemor uma talmud lomar lemor melammed shehau yisrael onin shira acharav shel moshe al kol davar vedavar kekorin et hahallel ashira la ki gao gaa lechach neemar lemor
Rabbi nechemya omer kekorin et shema velo kekorin et hahallel

Bo bayyom darash rabbi yehoshua ben hurkanos lo avad iyyov et hakkadosh baruch hu ella meahava shenneemar hen yikteleni lo ayachel vaadayin haddavar shakul lo ani metzappe o eni metzappe talmud lomar ad egva lo asir tummati mimmenni melammed shemmeahava asa

Amar rabbi yehoshua mi yegalle afar meenecha rabban yochanan ben zakkay shehayita doresh kol yamecha shello avad iyyov et hammakom ella miyyira shenneemar ish tam veyashar yere elohim vesar mera vahalo yehoshua talmid talmidcha limmed shemmeahava asa
Gema oto leman ilema levaal baal may aved vechi tema

a: Dei it beh aon badki leh mayya ki it beh aon bedideh mi badki lah mayya ledidah veha tanya venikka haish meaon vehaishsha hahi tissa et aonah bizman shehaish menukke meaon hammayim bodkin et ishto en haish menukke meaon en hammayim bodkin et ishto
Veella levoel litne kidkatane sefa keshem sheasura labbaal kach asura labboel
Leolam labboel veresha ayede ditna otah tane oto sefa ayede ditna baal tena boel
Shenneemar uvau uvau ibaya lehu bau uvau kaamar o uvau uvau kaamar
Ta shema keshem sheasura labbaal kach asura labboel shenneemar nitmaa venitmaa
Vaadayin tibe nitmaa nitmaa kaamar o nitmaa venitmaa kaamar
Ta shema middekatane sefa rabbi omer shene peamim haamurin bapparasha venitmaa venitmaa echad labbaal veechad labboel mikkelal derabbi akiva vave kadaresh
Hilkach lerabbi akiva shita kerae ketivi
Chad letzavaa didah vechad letzavaa dideh
Chad laasiyya didah vechad laasiyya dideh
Chad lidia didah vechad lidia dideh
Verabbi telata kerae ketivi chad letzavaa vechad laasiyya vechad lidia
Verabbi keshem shehammayim bodkin otah kach bodkin oto mena leh

Nafka leh middetanya latzbot beten velanpil yarech bitno virecho shel boel atta omer bitno virecho shel boel o eno ella bitnah virechah shel nivelet keshehu omer vetzavta vitnah venafla yerechah hare bitnah virechah shel nivelet amur uma ani mekayyem latzbot beten velanpil yarech bitno virecho shel boel
Veidach hahu demoda lah kohen deveten beresha vahadar yarech shello lehotzi laaz al hammayim hammarim
Veidach im ken lichtov kera bitnah virechah may beten veyarech shema minah levoel
Veema kulleh lehachi hu daata im ken lichtov bitno virecho may beten veyarech shema minah tarte
Amar rabbi yehoshua kach haya doresh zecharya ku
Tanu rabbanan shalosh peamim haamurin bapparasha im nitmea nitmaa venitmaa lamma echad labbaal veechad labboel veechad litruma divre rabbi akiva
Amar rabbi yishmael kal vachomer uma gerusha shemmutteret litruma asura lichhunna zo sheasura bitruma eno din sheasura lichhunna
Ma talmud lomar vehi nitmaa vehi lo nitmaa im nitmea lamma shota im lo nitmea lamma mashkah maggid lecha hakkatuv shehassafek asura
Mikkan atta dan lesheretz uma sota shello asa bah shogeg kemezid veones keratzon asa bah safek kevadday sheretz sheasa bo shogeg kemezid veones keratzon eno din sheyyaase bo safek
b: Kevadday
Umimmakom shebbata ma sota reshut hayyachid af sheretz reshut hayyachid
Uma sota davar sheyyesh bo daat lishael af sheretz davar sheyyesh bo daat lishael
Umikkan amru davar sheyyesh bo daat lishael birshut hayyachid sefeko tame birshut harabbim sefeko tahor vesheen bo daat lishael ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim sefeko tahor
Verabbi yishmael amar rabbi akiva teruma umahdar leh ihu kehunna
Vetu lerabbi akiva kehunna mena leh vechi tema kehunna la tzericha kera

a: Shehare asa bah sefek zona kezona teruma name la tibe kera shehare asa bah sefek zona kezona
Ella lerabbi akiva arbea kerae ketivi chad levaal vechad levoel vechad lichhunna vechad litruma
Verabbi yishmael telata kerae ketivi chad levaal vechad levoel vechad litruma uchhunna atya bekal vachomer
Verabbi yishmael mimmay deitzterich kera litruma uchhunna atya bekal vachomer dilma ki itzterich lichhunna utruma sharya
Amar lach mistabbera dumya devaal uvoel ma baal uvoel mechayyim af teruma name mechayyim leappoke kehunna dilachar mita
Verabbi akiva dumya devaal uvoel let leh
Vei name it leh milta deatya bekal vechomer tarach vechatev lah kera

Amar rav gidel amar rav davar sheyyesh bo daat lishael veen bo daat lishael mehay kera nafka vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel vadday tame hu delo yeachel ha safek tame vesafek tahor yeachel
Ema sefa vehabbasar kol tahor yochal basar vadday tahor hu deyochal basar ha safek tame vesafek tahor lo yochal
Ella lav shema minah kan sheyyesh bo daat lishael kan sheen bo daat lishael
Veitzterich derav gidel amar rav veitzterich lemigmar missota dei midderav hava amena ben birshut hayyachid uven birshut harabbim itzterich lemigmar missota
Vei missota hava amena ad deika daat nogea umaggia tzericha
Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva vechol keli cheres ku
Umeachar deen lo lamma tame
Amar rav yehuda amar rav min hattora en lo middin kal vachomer yesh lo uma tevul yom shemmuttar bechullin posel bitruma kikkar sheni sheppasul bechullin eno din sheyyaase shelishi bitruma
Ika lemifrach ma litvul yom shekken av hattuma
Tete
b: Mittevul yom desheretz
Ma litvul yom desheretz shekken bemino av hattuma
Keli cheres yochiach
Ma lichli cheres shekken metamme meaviro
Tevul yom yochiach
Vechozer haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shemmuttarin bechullin ufoslin bitruma kol shekken kikkar sheni shepposel bechullin defosel bitruma
Vedor acher parech ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahen tzad chamur
Verabban yochanan ben zakkay tzad chamur la parech
Tanya amar rabbi yose minnayin lirvii bakkodesh sheppasul
Vedin hu ma mechussar kipurim shemmuttar batteruma pasul bakkodesh shelishi sheppasul batteruma eno din hu sheyyaase revii bakkodesh
Velamadnu shelishi lakkodesh min hattora urvii mikkal vachomer
Shelishi lakkodesh min hattora menalan dichtiv vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel mi la askinan dinga besheni veamar rachamana lo yeachel revii mikkal vachomer kedaamaran
Amar rabbi yochanan taam beribi eni yodea ma hu shehare teshuvato betziddo ochel habba mechamat tevul yom yochiach sheppasul bitruma veeno ose revii bakkodesh
Detanya abba shaul omer tevul yom techila lakkodesh letamme shenayim velifsol echad
Rabbi meir omer metamme echad ufosel echad vachachamim omrim keshem shepposel ochle teruma umashke teruma kach posel ochle kodesh umashke kodesh
Matkef lah rav pappa mimmay derabbi yose kerabbanan sevira leh dilma keabba shaul sevira leh deamar letamme shenayim velifsol echad
I salka datach keabba shaul sevira leh layeteh lirvii bakkodesh meochel shebba mechamat tevul yom
Uma ochel habba mechamat tevul yom ditvul yom gufeh muttar bechullin amratte ose revii bakkodesh ochel

a: Shelishi habba mechamat sheni desheni gufeh asur bechullin eno din sheose revii bakkodesh
Vechi tema mishshum deika lemifrach ma litvul yom shekken av hattuma ha ayetineh mimmechussar kipurim vela parcheh
Amar rav assi amar rav veamri lah amar rabba ben isi amar rav rabbi meir verabbi yose verabbi yehoshua verabbi elazar verabbi eliezer kullehu sevira lehu deen sheni ose shelishi bechullin
Rabbi meir ditnan kol hattaun biat mayim middivre sofrim metamme et hakkodesh ufosel et hatteruma umuttar bachullin uvammaaser divre rabbi meir vachachamim osrin bammaaser
Rabbi yose ha daamaran deim iteh layeteh lirvii batteruma vachamishi bakkodesh

Rabbi yehoshua ditnan rabbi eliezer omer haochel ochel rishon rishon sheni sheni shelishi shelishi rabbi yehoshua omer haochel ochel rishon veochel sheni sheni shelishi sheni bakkodesh veen sheni batteruma
Bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma
Al tohorat hatteruma in al tohorat hakkodesh la
Alma kasavar en sheni ose shelishi bechullin
Rabbi elazar detanya rabbi elazar omer shelashtan shavin harishon shebbakkodesh veshebbachullin veshebbatteruma
Metamme shenayim ufosel echad bakkodesh
Metamme echad ufosel echad batteruma
Ufosel echad bachullin

Rabbi eliezer ditnan rabbi eliezer omer challa nitelet min hattehora al hattemea ketzad shette isot achat tehora veachat temea notel kede challa meisa shello hurma challatah venoten pachot mikkevetza baemtza kede litol min hammukkaf
b: Vachachamim osrin
Vetanya kevetza
Savruha ide veide beisa rishona vechullin hattevulin lechalla la kechalla damu
May lav beha kamipalgi demar savar en sheni ose shelishi bechullin
Umar savar sheni ose shelishi bechullin
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana dechulle alma en sheni ose shelishi bechullin vehacha bechullin hattevulin lechalla kamipalgi mar savar kechalla damu umar savar la kechalla damu
Veibaet ema dechulle alma chullin hattevulin lechalla la kechalla damu veen sheni ose shelishi bechullin vehacha bemuttar ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael kamipalgi
Mar savar muttar ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael umar savar asur ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael
Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva vechu
Bemay ka mipalgi mar savar techumin deorayeta umar savar derabbanan

Tanu rabbanan bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva beshaa shealu yisrael min hayyam natnu enehem lomar shira vechetzad amru shira kegadol hammakre et hallel vehen onin acharav rashe ferakim moshe amar ashira la vehen omrim ashira la moshe amar ki gao gaa vehen omrim ashira la

Rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer kekatan hammakre et hallel vehen onin acharav kol ma shehu omer moshe amar ashira la vehen omrim ashira la moshe amar ki gao gaa vehen omrim ki gao gaa
Rabbi nechemya omer kesofer happores al shema bevet hakkeneset shehu poteach techila vehen onin acharav
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi akiva savar lemor ammilta kammayeta
Verabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili savar lemor akkol milta umilta verabbi nechemya savar vayyomru daamur kullehu bahade hadade lemor diftach moshe beresha

Tanu rabbanan darash rabbi yose haggelili beshaa shealu yisrael min hayyam natnu enehem lomar shira vechetzad amru shira olal muttal al birke immo vetinok yonek mishshede immo kevan sherau et hashshechina olal higbiha tzavaro vetinok shamat dad mippiv veamru ze eli veanvehu shenneemar mippi ollim veyonkim yissadta oz
Haya rabbi meir omer minnayin sheafilu ubbarim shebbime imman amru shira shenneemar

a: Bemakhelot barchu elohim Adonai mimmekor yisrael
Veha la chazo amar rabbi tanchum kares naasa lahen keaspaklarya hammeira verau
Bo bayyom darash rabbi yehoshua ben hurkanos shello avad iyyov ku velichze hay lo i belamed alef ketiv lo hu i belamed vav ketiv lo hu
Vechol hecha dichtiv belamed alef lo hu ella meatta bechol tzaratam lo tzar dichtiv belamed alef hachi name delo hu
Vechi tema hachi name vehachtiv umalach panav hoshiam ella lav mashma hachi umashma hachi
Tanya rabbi meir omer neemar yere elohim beiyyov veneemar yere elohim beavraham ma yere elohim haamur beavraham meahava af yere elohim haamur beiyyov meahava
Veavraham gufeh menalan dichtiv zera avraham ohavi
May ika ben ose meahava leose miyyira ika ha detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer gadol haose meahava yoter min haose miyyira shezze taluy leelef dor veze taluy lealpayim dor
Hacha ketiv laalafim leohavay ulshomre mitzotay vehatam ketiv ulshomre mitzotav leelef dor
Hatam name ketiv leohavav ulshomre mitzotav leelef dor
Hay ledismich leh vehay ledismich leh

Hanhu tere talmide dahao yatvi kammeh derava chad amar leh akreun bechelmay ma rav tuvcha asher tzafanta lireecha vechad amar leh akreun bechelmay veyismechu chol chose vach leolam yerannenu veyaletzu vecha ohave shemecha amar lehu tarvayechu rabbanan tzaddike gemure attun mar meahava umar miyyira
Hadaran alach keshem shehammayim
Mi shekkine leishto venistera afilu shama meof happoreach yotzi veyitten ketubba divre rabbi eliezer
Rabbi yehoshua omer ad sheyyisu veyittenu bah mozrot ballevana
Amar ed echad ani reitiha shennitmet lo hayeta shota velo od ella afilu eved afilu shifcha hare ellu neemanin af lefoslah mikketubbatah
Chamotah uvat chamotah vetzaratah vivimtah uvat balah hare ellu neemanot velo lefoslah mikketubbatah ella shello tishte
Shehaya baddin uma im edut rishona sheen osartah isur olam enah mitkayyemet befachot mishshenayim edut acharona sheosartah isur olam eno din shello titkayyem befachot mishshenayim
Talmud lomar veed en bah kol edut sheyyesh bah
Vekal vachomer leedut harishona meatta uma im
b: Edut acharona sheosartah isur olam hare hi mitkayyemet beed echad edut harishona sheen osartah isur olam eno din shettitkayyem beed echad
Talmud lomar ki matza vah ervat davar ulhallan hu omer al pi shene edim yakum davar ma lehallan al pi shenayim af kan pi shenayim
Ed omer nitmet veed omer lo nitmet ishsha omeret nitmet veishsha omeret lo nitmet hayeta shota
Echad omer nitmet ushnayim omrim lo nitmet hayeta shota shenayim omrim nitmet veechad omer lo nitmet lo hayeta shota
Gema hay talmud lomar ki matza vah ervat davar
Talmud lomar bah bah velo bekinuy bah velo bistira mibe leh
Hachi name kaamar talmud lomar bah bah velo bekinuy bah velo bistira
Vetuma bealma belo kinuy uvlo setira dela meheman ed echad menalan neemar kan davar veneemar lehallan davar ma lehallan bishne edim af kan bishne edim
Ed omer nitmet tama deka machchesh leh ha la ka machchesh leh ed echad meheman
Menahane mile detanu rabbanan veed en bah bishnayim hakkatuv medabber
Atta omer bishnayim o eno ella beechad talmud lomar lo yakum ed echad beish vego
Mimmashma shenneemar lo yakum ed eni yodea shehu echad ma talmud lomar echad ze bana av kol makom shenneemar ed hare kan shenayim ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv echad
Veamar rachamana tere let bah ella chad vehi lo nitpasa asura
Vechevan demiddeorayeta ed echad meheman idach hechi matze machchesh leh veha amar ulla kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad hare kan shenayim veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim
Ella amar ulla teni lo hayeta shota vechen amar rabbi yitzchak lo hayeta shota verabbi chiyya amar hayeta shota
Lerabbi chiyya kashya deulla la kashya kan bevat achat kan beze achar ze
Tenan ed omer nitmet ushnayim omrim lo nitmet hayeta shota ha chad vechad lo hayeta shota teuvta derabbi chiyya
Amar lach rabbi chiyya velitamach ema sefa shenayim omrim nitmet veechad omer lo nitmet lo hayeta shota ha chad vechad hayeta shota
Ella kullah bifsule edut verabbi nechemya hi detanya rabbi nechemya omer kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad hallech achar rov deot veasu shette nashim beish echad kishne anashim beish echad
Veika deamri kol hecha daata ed echad kasher meikara afilu mea nashim name keed echad damyan

Vetarte bifsule edut lema li mahu detema ki azlinan batar rov deot lechumra aval lekulla la azlinan ka mashma lan
Hadaran alach mi shekkine
Ellu neemarin bechol lashon parashat sota uviduy maaser keriyyat shema utfilla uvirkat hammazon ushvuat haedut ushvuat happikadon
Veellu neemarin bilshon hakkodesh mikra bikurim vachalitza berachot uklalot birkat kohanim uvirkat kohen gadol ufarashat hammelech ufarashat egla arufa umshuach milchama beshaa shemmedabber el haam
Mikra bikurim ketzad veanita veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha ulhallan hu omer veanu halviyyim veamru ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh af kan bilshon hakkodesh
Chalitza ketzad veanta veamra ulhallan hu omer veanu halviyyim veamru ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh af kan bilshon hakkodesh
Rabbi yehuda omer veanta veamra kacha ad shettomar ballashon hazze

Berachot uklalot ketzad kevan sheavru yisrael et hayyarden uvau el har gerizim veel har eval shebbeshomron shebbetzad shechem shebbeetzel elone more shenneemar halo hemma beever hayyarden vego ulhallan hu omer vayyaavor avram baaretz ad mekom shechem ad elon more ma elon more haamur lehallan shechem af elon more haamur kan shechem

Shishsha shevatim alu lerosh har gerizim veshishsha shevatim alu lerosh har eval vehakkohanim vehalviyyim vehaaron omdim lematta baemtza hakkohanim makkifin et haaron vehalviyyim et hakkohanim vechol yisrael mikkan umikkan shenneemar vechol yisrael uzkenav veshotrim veshoftav omdim mizze umizze laaron vego

Hafchu penehem kelappe har gerizim ufatchu bivracha baruch haish asher lo yaase fesel umassecha veellu vaellu onin amen hafchu penehem kelappe har eval ufatchu biklala arur haish asher yaase fesel umassecha veellu vaellu onin amen ad sheggomrin berachot uklalot
Veachar kach heviu et haavanim uvanu et hammizbeach vesaduhu besid vechatvu alav et kol divre hattora beshivim lashon shenneemar baer hetev venatlu et haavanim uvau
b: Velanu bimkoman
Gema parashat sota menalan dichtiv veamar hakkohen laishsha bechol lashon shehu omer
Tanu rabbanan mashmiin otah bechol lashon shehi shomaat al ma hi shota uvamma hi shota al ma nitmet uvamma hi nitmet
Al ma hi shota al iske kinuy ustira uvamma hi shota bimkida shel cheres
Al ma nitmet al iske sechok veyaldut uvamma hi nitmet beshogeg o bemezid beones o beratzon vechol kach lamma shello lehotzi laaz al mayim hammarim
Viduy maaser menalan dichtiv veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha biarti hakkodesh min habbayit veyalef amira missota bechol lashon shehu omer
Amar leh rav zevid leabbaye velelaf amira milleviyyim ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh af kan bilshon hakkodesh
Danin amira geredta meamira geredta veen danin amira geredta meaniyya vaamira
Tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer adam omer shivcho bekol namuch ugnuto bekol ram
Shivcho bekol namuch min viduy hammaaser genuto bekol ram mimmikra bikurim
Ugnuto bekol ram vehaamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay mippene ma tikkenu tefilla belachash kede shello levayyesh et ovre avera shehare lo chalak hakkatuv makom ben chattat leola

La tema genuto ella ema tzaaro kidtanya vetame tame yikra tzarich lehodia tzaaro larabbim verabbim mevakkeshim alav rachamim vechol mi sheera bo davar tzarich lehodia larabbim verabbim mevakkeshim alav rachamim
Gufa amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay mippene ma tiknu tefilla belachash shello levayyesh et ovre avera shehare lo chalak hakkatuv makom ben chattat leola
Vela veha ika damim dam chattat lemala vedam ola lematta hatam kohen hu deyada
Vehaika chattat nekeva ola zachar hatam mikasseya bealya
Tinach kivsa seira may ika lememar hatam ihu deka machsef nafsheh deibi leh leetoye kivsa veka mayete seira
Chattat daavoda zara dela saggi delav seira may ika lememar hatam niksif venezil ki hechi denikkappar leh
Keriyyat shema menalan dichtiv shema yisrael bechol lashon sheatta shomea
Tanu rabbanan keriyyat shema kichtavah divre rabbi vachachamim omrim bechol lashon
May tama derabbi amar kera vehau bahaoyatan yehu
Verabbanan amar kera shema bechol lashon sheatta shomea
Verabbanan name ha ketiv vehau hahu shello yikraenna lemafrea
Verabbi shello yikraenna lemafrea menaleh nafka lah middevarim haddevarim verabbanan devarim haddevarim la mashma lehu
Verabbi name hachtiv shema hahu mibe leh lehashmia leaznecha ma sheatta motzi mippicha verabbanan savri lah keman deamar hakkore et shema velo hishmia leozno yatza
Lema kasavar rabbi

a: Kol hattora bechol lashon neemra dei salka datach bilshon hakkodesh neemra vehau dichtav rachamana lema li
Itzterich mishshum dichtiv shema
Lema kasavri rabbanan kol hattora kullah bilshon kodesh neemra dei salka datach bechol lashon shema dichtav rachamana lema li
Itzterich mishshum dichtiv vehau
Tefilla rachame hi kol hechi devae metzalle

Utfilla bechol lashon vehaamar rav yehuda leolam al yishal adam tzerachav bilshon aramit deamar rabbi yochanan kol hashshoel tzerachav bilshon arammi en malache hashsharet nizkakin lo lefi sheen malache hashsharet makkirin bilshon arammi
La kashya ha beyachid ha betzibbur

Veen malache hashsharet makkirin bilshon arammi vehatanya yochanan kohen gadol shama bat kol mibbet kodesh hakkodashim shehu omer netzachu talayya daazalu laagacha kerava leantochya veshuv maase beshimon hatztzaddik sheshshama bat kol mibbet kodesh hakkodashim shehu omer betelat avidta daamar sana leayetaa al hechla veneherag gaskalgas uvatlu gezerotav vechatvu otah shaa vechivnu uvlashon arammi haya omer
I baet ema bat kol shane dilashmoe avida vei baet ema gavriel hava deamar mar ba gavriel velimdo shivim lashon
Birkat hammazon dichtiv veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha bechol lashon sheatta mevarech
Shevuat haedut dichtiv venefesh ki techeta veshama kol ala bechol lashon shehi shomaat
Shevuat happikkadon atya techta techta mishshevuat haedut

Veellu neemarin bilshon hakkodesh mikra bikurim vachalitza ku ad mikra bikurim ketzad veanita veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha ulhallan hu omer veanu halviyyim veamru el kol ish yisrael ma aniyya haamura lehallan bilshon hakkodesh af kan bilshon hakkodesh
Ulviyyim gufayehu menalan atya kol kol mimmoshe ketiv hacha kol ram uchtiv hatam moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh af kan bilshon hakkodesh
Chalitza ketzad vechu verabbanan hay kacha may avdi leh mibe lehu ledavar shehu maase meakkev
Verabbi yehuda mikko kacha verabbanan ko kacha la mashma lehu
b: Verabbi yehuda hay veanta veamra may aved leh mibe leh leagmore lilviyyim devilshon hakkodesh
Velelaf kol mimmoshe aniyya aniyya gemir kol kol la gemir
Tanya name hachi rabbi yehuda omer kol makom shenneemar ko kacha aniyya vaamira eno ella leshon hakkodesh ko ko tevarchu kacha dachalitza aniyya vaamira dilviyyim

Berachot uklalot ketzad kevan sheavru yisrael et hayyarden ku tanu rabbanan halo hemma beever hayyarden meever layyarden veelach divre rabbi yehuda achare derech mevo hashshemesh mekom shechamma zorachat

Beeretz hakkenaani hayyoshev baarava ellu har gerizim vehar eval sheyyoshvin bahem kutiyyim mul haggilgal samuch laggilgal etzel elone more shechem ulhallan hu omer vayyaavor avram baaretz ad mekom shechem ad elon more ma elon more haamur lehallan shechem af kan shechem

Tanya amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose bedavar ze ziyyafti sifre chutiyyim amarti lahem ziyyaftem toratchem velo heelitem beyedchem kelum sheattem omrim elone more shechem af anu modim sheelone more shechem anu lemadnuha bigzera shava attem bamme lemadtem
Rabbi elazar amar halo hemma beever hayyarden samuch layyarden dei meever hayyarden veelach halo ketiv vehaya beovrechem et hayyarden
Achare derech mevo hashshemesh makom shehachamma shokaat beeretz hakkenaani eretz chivi hi
Hayyoshev baarava vahalo ben harim ugvaot hen yoshvin mul haggilgal vahalo lo rau et haggilgal

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer lo ba hakkatuv ella leharot lahen derech bashsheniyya kederech shehera lahen barishona derech badderech lechu velo besadot uchramim hayyoshev bayyishshuv lechu velo bemidbarot baarava baarava lechu velo beharim ugvaot

Tanu rabbanan ketzad avru yisrael et hayyarden bechol yom aron nosea achar shene degalim vehayyom nasa techila shenneemar hinne aron habberit adon kol haaretz over lifnechem bechol yom vaom leviyyim nosin et haaron vehayyom nesauhu kohanim shenneemar vehaya kenoach kappot ragle hakkohanim nose aron Adonai vego
Tanya rabbi yose omer bishlosha mekomot nasu kohanim et haaron kesheavru et hayyarden uchshehesebu et yericho uchshehechziruhu limkomo

a: Vechevan shennitbelu ragle chohanim bammayim chazru hammayim laachorehem shenneemar uchvo nose haaron ad hayyarden vego vayyaamdu hammayim hayyordim milmala kamu ned echad vechamma govhan shel mayim shenem asar mil al shenem asar mil keneged machane yisrael divre rabbi yehuda
Amar lo rabbi elazar berabbi shimon lidvarecha adam kal o mayim kallim heve omer mayim kallim im ken bain mayim veshotfin otan

Ella melammed shehau mayim nigdashin veolin kipin al gabbe kipin yater mishshelosh meot mil ad sherau otan kol malche mizrach umaarav shenneemar vayehi chishmoa kol malche haemori asher beever hayyarden yamma vechol malche hakkenaani asher al hayyam et asher hovish Adonai et me hayyarden mippene vene yisrael ad ovram vayyimmas levavam velo haya vam od ruach mippene bene yisrael
Veaf rachav hazzona amra lishluche yehoshua ki shamanu et asher hovish Adonai et me yam suf vego uchtiv vannishma vayyimmas levavenu velo kama od vego

Odam bayyarden amar lahem yehoshua deu al ma attem ovrim et hayyarden al menat shettorishu et yoshve haaretz mippenechem shenneemar vehorashtem et kol yoshve haaretz mippenechem vego im attem osin ken mutav veim lav bain mayim veshotfin otichem may otichem oti veetchem

Odam bayyarden amar lahen yehoshua harimu lachem ish even achat al shichmo lemispar shivte yisrael vego uchtiv lemaan tihye zot ot bekirbechem ki yishalun benechem machar lemor ma haavanim haelle lachem vego siman labbanim sheavru avot et hayyarden

Odam bayyarden amar lahen yehoshua seu lachem mizze mittoch hayyarden mimmatztzav ragle hakkohanim hachin shettem esre avanim vehaavartem otam immachem vehinnachtem otam bammalon asher talinu vo hallayela vego yachol bechol malon umalon talmud lomar asher talinu vo hallayela

Amar rabbi yehuda abba chalafta verabbi eliezer ben matya vachananya ben chachinay amdu al otan avanim veshiarum kol achat veachat shekula kearbaim sea ugmiri dituna demadle inish lechatpeh tilta dituneh have
Mikkan atta mechashshev laeshkol shenneemar vayyissauhu vammot bishnayim mimmashma shenneemar bammot eni yodea shebbishnayim ma talmud lomar bishnayim bishne motot

Amar rabbi yitzchak turtane veturtane deturtane ha ketzad shemona nasu eshkol echad nasa rimon veechad nasa teena yehoshua vechalev lo nasu kelum i baet ema mishshum dachashivi vei baet ema shello hau beotah etza
Peligi bah rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha chad amar ledivre rabbi yehuda
b: Kachaniyyatan avru ledivre rabbi elazar berabbi shimon beze achar ze avru
Vechad amar ben mar uven mar kachaniyyatan avru mar savar adam kal umar savar mayim kallim
Shelach lecha anashim amar resh lakish shelach lecha middatecha vechi adam ze borer chelek ra leatzmo vehayenu dichtiv vayyitav beenay haddavar amar resh lakish beenay velo beenav shel makom

Veyachperu lanu et haaretz amar rabbi chiyya bar abba meraggelim lo nitkavvenu ella levoshtah shel eretz yisrael ketiv hacha veyachperu lanu et haaretz uchtiv hatam vechafra hallevana uvosha hachamma vego

Veelle shemotam lematte reuven shammua ben zakkur amar rabbi yitzchak davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu meraggelim al shem maasehem nikreu veanu lo alta beyadenu ella echad setur ben michael setur shessatar maasav shel hakkadosh baruch hu michael sheasa atzmo mach
Amar rabbi yochanan af anu nomar nachbi ben vofsi nachbi shehechbi devarav shel hakkadosh baruch hu vofsi sheppisa al middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu

Vayyaalu vannegev vayyavo ad chevron vayyavou mibbee leh amar rava melammed shepperash kalev meatzat meraggelim vehalach venishtattach al kivre avot amar lahen avotay bikkeshu alay rachamim sheennatzel meatzat meraggelim
Yehoshua kevar bikkesh moshe alav rachamim shenneemar vayyikra moshe lehoshea bin nun yehoshua yah yoshiacha meatzat meraggelim vehayenu dichtiv veavdi chalev ekev hayeta ruach acheret immo vego
Vesham achiman sheshay vetalmay vego achiman meumman shebbeechav sheshay shemmesim et haaretz kishchitot talmay shemmesim et haaretz telamim telamim
Davar acher achiman bana anat sheshay bana alush talmay bana talbush yelide haanak shemmaanikin chamma bekomatan
Vechevron sheva shanim nivneta may nivneta ilema nivneta mammash efshar adam bone bayit livno katan kodem livno gadol dichtiv uvne cham kush umitzrayim vego

Ella shehayeta mevunna al echad mishshiva betzoan veen lecha terashim bechol eretz yisrael yater mechevron mishshum dekavri bah shachve veen lecha meulla bechol haaratzot yater meeretz mitzrayim shenneemar kegan Adonai keeretz mitzrayim veen lecha meulla bechol eretz mitzrayim yater mitztzoan dichtiv ki hau vetzoan sarav vaafilu hachi chevron mevunna echad mishshiva betzoan

Vechevron terashim havay veha ketiv vayehi mikketz arbaim shana vayyomer avshalom el hammelech elcha na vego veamar rav aveya veitema rabba bar bar chanan shehalach lehavi kevasim mechevron vetanya elim mimmoav kevasim mechevron minah ayede diklisha ara avda riya veshammin kinyana
Vayyashuvu mittur haaretz

a: Vayyelchu vayyavou amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay makkesh halicha levia ma bia beetza raa af halicha beetza raa
Vayesapperu lo vayyomru banu vego uchtiv efes ki az haam amar rabbi yochanan siman emet levaddo leviyya mishshum rabbi meir kal lashon hara sheen bo devar emet bitchilato en mitkayyem besofo
Vayyahas kalev et haam el moshe amar rabba shehissitan bidvarim
Patach yehoshua deka mishtae amri leh den resh ketia yemallel
Amar i mishtaena amri bi milta vechasmin li amar lahen vechi zo bilvad asa lanu ben amram savri bignuteh ka mishtae ishtiku
Amar lehu hotzianu mimmitzrayim vekara lanu et hayyam veheechilanu et hamman im yomar asu sullamot vaalu larakia lo nishma lo alo naale veyarashnu otah vego

Vehaanashim asher alu immo amru lo nuchal vego amar rabbi chanina bar pappa davar gadol dibberu meraggelim beotah shaa ki chazak hu mimmennu al tikre mimmennu ella mimmeno kivyachol afilu baal habbayit eno yachol lehotzi kelav mishsham

Eretz ochelet yoshveha hi daresh rava amar hakkadosh baruch hu ani chashavtiha letova vehem chashvu leraa ani chashavtiha letova dechol hecha dimto mit chashiva didhu ki hechi denitardu vela leshaalu abbatrayehu veika deamri iyyov nach nafsheh veitteridu kulle alma behespeda hem chashvu leraa eretz ochelet yoshveha hi
Vannehi veenenu kachagavim vechen hayinu vego amar rav mesharsheya meraggelim shakkare hao bishlama vannehi beenenu kachagavim lechayye ella vechen hayinu beenehem mena hao yadi
Vela hi ki hao mavri avele tute arze hao mavri vechi chazinhu seliku yatvi beilane shami dekaamri kachazenan inashe dedamu lekamtze beilane

Vattissa kol haeda vayyittenu et kolam vayyivku amar rabba amar rabbi yochanan oto hayyom erev tisha beav haya amar hakkadosh baruch hu hen bachu bechiyya shel chinnam vaani ekba lahem bechiyya ledorot
Vayyomru kol haeda lirgom otam baavanim uchtiv vechavod Adonai nira beohel moed amar rabbi chiyya bar abba melammed shennatlu avanim uzrakum kelappe mala

Vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat haaretz raa bammaggefa amar rabbi shimon ben lakish shemmetu mita meshunna amar rabbi chanina bar pappa daresh rabbi shela ish kefar temarta melammed shennishtarbev leshonam venafal al tiburam vehau tolaim yotzot milleshonam venichnasot betiburam umittiburam venichnasot bilshonam verav nachman bar yitzchak amar beaskara metu

Vechevan sheala haacharon shebbeyisrael min hayyarden chazru mayim limkoman shenneemar vayehi baalot hakkohanim nose aron berit Adonai mittoch hayyarden nitteku kappot ragle hakkohanim el hecharava vayyashuvu me hayyarden limkomam vayyelchu chitmol shilshom al kol gedotav
Nimtza aron venosav vechohanim mitztzad echad veyisrael mitztzad echad nasa aron et nosav veavar shenneemar vayehi kaasher tam kol haam laavor vayyaavor aron Adonai vehakkohanim lifne haam
Veal davar ze neenash uzza shenneemar vayyavou ad goren kidon vayyishlach uzza et yado leechoz et haaron amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu uzza nosav nasa atzmo lo kol shekken
Vayyichar af Adonai beuzza vayyakkehu sham al hashshal vego rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar chad amar al iske shalu vechad amar sheasa tzerachav befanav
Vayyamot sham im aron haelohim amar rabbi yochanan uzza ba laolam habba shenneemar im aron haelohim ma aron leolam kayyam af uzza ba laolam habba
Vayyichar ledavid al asher paratz Adonai peretz beuzza amar rabbi elazar shennishtannu panav kacharara
Ella meatta kol hecha dichtiv vayyichar hachi name hatam ketiv af hacha la ketiv af
Daresh rava mippene ma neenash david mippene shekkara ledivre tora zemirot shenneemar zemirot hau li chukkecha bevet meguray

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu divre tora shekkatuv bahen hataif enecha bo veenennu atta kore otan zemirot hareni machshilcha bedavar sheafilu tinokot shel bet rabban yodin oto dichtiv velivne kehat lo natan ki avodat hakkodesh vego veihu atyeh baagalta
Vayyach beanshe vet shemesh ki rau baaron mishshum derau vayyach elohim rabbi avahu verabbi elazar chad amar kotzrin umishtachavim hau vechad amar mile name amur
b: Man amreyach leha deimarayet uman ata alach deipayyaste

Vayyach baam shivim ish chamishshim elef ish rabbi avahu verabbi elazar chad amar shivim ish hau vechol echad veechad shakul kachamishshim elef vechad amar chamishshim elef hau vechol echad veechad shakul keshivim sanhedrin

Vayehi ki tzaadu nose aron Adonai shishsha tzeadim vayyizbach shor umri uchtiv shiva farim veshiva elim amar rav pappa bar shemuel al kol pesia ufsia shor umri al kol shesh veshesh pesiot shiva farim veshiva elim
Amar leh rav chisda im ken mileta et kol eretz yisrael bamot ella amar rav chisda al kol shesh veshesh pesiot shor umri al kol shishsha sedarim shel shesh pesiot shiva farim veshiva elim
Ketiv kidon uchtiv nachon amar rabbi yochanan battechilla kidon ulvassof nachon

Nimtzeta atta omer shelosha mine avanim hau echad shehekim moshe beeretz moav shenneemar beever hayyarden beeretz moav hoil moshe beer vego ulhallan hu omer vechatavta alehen et kol divre hattora hazzot vego veatya beer beer
Veechad shehekim yehoshua betoch hayyarden shenneemar ushtem esre avanim hekim yehoshua betoch hayyarden veechad shehekim baggilgal shenneemar veet shettem esre haavanim haelle asher lakchu vego
Tanu rabbanan ketzad katvu yisrael et hattora rabbi yehuda omer al gabbe avanim ketavuha shenneemar vechatavta al haavanim et kol divre hattora hazzot vego veachar kach sadu otan besid

Amar lo rabbi shimon lidvarecha heach lamdu ummot haolam tora amar lo bina yetera natan bahem hakkadosh baruch hu veshigru noterin shellahen vekilfu et hassid vehissiuha veal davar ze nitchattem gezar dinam liver shachat shehaya lahen lilmod velo lamdu
Rabbi shimon omer al gabbe sid ketavuha vechatvu lahen lematta yelammedu etchem laasot kechol vego ha lamadta sheim hau chozrin bitshuva hau mekabbelin otan
Amar rava bar shela may tama derabbi shimon dichtiv vehau ammim misrefot sid al iske sid
Verabbi yehuda ki sid ma sid en lo takkana ella serefa af ummot haolam en lahem takkana ella serefa
Keman azla ha detanya veshavita shivo lerabbot kenaanim shebbechutza laaretz sheim chozrin bitshuva mekabbelin otan

a: Keman kerabbi shimon

Bo ure kamma nissim naasu beoto hayyom avru yisrael et hayyarden uvau lehar gerizim ulhar eval yater mishshishshim mil veen kol beriyya yechola laamod bifnehem vechol haomed bifnehem miyyad nitraz shenneemar et emati ashallach lefanecha vehammoti et kol haam asher tavo bahem vego
Veomer tippol alehem emata vafachad ad yaavor ammecha Adonai zo bia rishona ad yaavor am zu kanita zo bia sheniyya
Emor meatta reuyin hau yisrael laasot lahem nes bevia sheniyya kevia rishona ella sheggaram hachet
Veachar kach heviu et haavanim uvanu et hammizbeach vesaduhu besid vechatvu alehem et kol divre hattora beshivim lashon shenneemar baer hetev
Veheelu olot ushlamim veachlu veshatu vesamchu uverchu vekillelu vekiplu et haavanim uvau velanu baggilgal shenneemar vehaavartem otam immachem vehinnachtem otam bammalon
Yachol bechol malon umalon talmud lomar asher talinu vo hallayela uchtiv veet shettem esre haavanim haelle asher lakchu vego
Tana tzira lo avra immahem vela veha ketiv veshalachti et hatztzira lefanecha

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish al sefat yarden amda vezarka bahen mara vesimta enehen millemala vesersatan millematta shenneemar veanochi hishmadti et haemori mippenehem asher kegovah arazim govho vechason hu kaallonim vaashmid piro mimmaal veshorashav mittachat vego
Rav pappa amar shette tzeraot havay chada demoshe vachada dihoshua demoshe la avar dihoshua avar
Shishsha shevatim alu lerosh har gerizim ku may vehachetzo amar rav kahana kederech shechalukin kan kach chalukin beavne efod

Metivi shette avanim tovot hau lo lechohen gadol al ketefav achat mikkan veachat mikkan ushmot shenem asar shevatim katuv alehem shishsha al even zo veshishsha al even zo shenneemar shishsha mishshemotam al haeven haechat vego
Sheniyya ketoldotam velo rishona ketoldotam mippene sheyehuda mukdam vachamishshim otiyyot hau esrim vechamesh al even zo veesrim vechamesh al even zo
Rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer
b: Lo kederech shechalukin bechomesh happekudim chalukin beavne efod ella kederech shechalukin bechomesh sheni
Ketzad bene lea kesidran bene rachel echad mikkan veechad mikkan uvne shefachot baemtza

Veella may ani mekayyem ketoldotam kishmotan shekkara lahen avihen velo keshemot shekkara lahen moshe reuven velo reuveni shimon velo shimoni dan velo haddani gad velo haggadi teuvta derav kahana teuvta
Veella may vehachetzo tana chetzo shel mul har gerizim merubbe mechetzo shel har eval mippene shellevi lematta

Adderabba mippene shellevi lematta batzri lehu hachi kaamar af al pi shellevi lematta bene yosef immahem shenneemar vayedabberu bene yosef et yehoshua lemor maddua natatta li nachala goral echad vechevel echad vaani am rav vayyomer alehem yehoshua im am rav atta ale lecha hayyara

Amar lahen lechu vehachbiu atzmechem bayearim shello tishlot bachem ayin hara amaru leh zareh deosef la shalta beh ena bisha dichtiv ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin veamar rabbi avahu al tehi kore ale ayin ella ole ayin
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar mehacha veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz ma dagim shebbayyam mayim mechassin alehen veen haayin sholetet bahen af zaro shel yosef en haayin sholetet bahen
Hane chamishshim otiyyot chamishshim neche chada haveyan amar rabbi yitzchak yosef hosifu lo ot achat shenneemar edut bihosef samo betzeto al eretz mitzrayim
Matkef lah rav nachman bar yitzchak ketoldotam baenan ella kol hattora kullah binyamin ketiv vehacha binyamin shalem kedichtiv veaviv kara lo vinyamin

Amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida yosef shekkidesh shem shamayim basseter hosifu alav ot achat mishshemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu yehuda shekkidesh shem shamayim befarhesya nikra kullo al shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu

Yosef may hi dichtiv vayehi kehayyom hazze vayyavo habbayeta laasot melachto amar rabbi yochanan melammed sheshshenehem lidvar avera nitkavvenu vayyavo habbayeta laasot melachto rav ushmuel chad amar laasot melachto mammash vechad amar laasot tzerachav nichnas

Veen ish meanshe habbayit vego efshar bayit gadol keveto shel oto rasha lo haya bo ish tana deve rabbi yishmael oto hayyom yom chaggam haya vehalchu kullan levet avoda zara shellahem vehi amra lahen chola hi amra en li yom shennizkak li yosef kayyom hazze

Vattitpesehu bevigdo lemor vego beotah shaa bata deokno shel aviv venirata lo bachallon amar lo yosef atidin achecha sheyyikkatvu al avne efod veatta benehem retzoncha sheyyimmache shimcha mibbenehem vetikkare roe zonot dichtiv veroe zonot yeabbed hon
Miyyad vatteshev beetan kashto amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir sheshshava kashto leetanah vayyafozzu zeroe yadav naatz yadav bakkarka veyatza shichvat zaro mibben tziporne yadav
Mide avir yaakov mi garam lo sheyyechakek al avne efod ella avir yaakov mishsham roe even yisrael mishsham zacha venaasa roe shenneemar roe yisrael haazina noheg katztzon yosef

Tanya haya rauy yosef latzet mimmennu shenem asar shevatim kederech sheyyatzu miyyaakov aviv shenneemar elle toldot yaakov yosef ella sheyyatza shichvat zaro mibben tziporne yadav veaf al pi chen yatzu mibbinyamin achiv vechullan nikreu al shemo shenneemar uvne vinyamin bela vavecher veashbel vego
Bela shennivla ben haummot uvecher bechor leimmo haya veashbel sheshshevao el gera sheggar beachsanot
Venaaman shennaim beoter echi varosh achi hu veroshi hu muppim vechuppim hu lo raa bechuppati vaani lo raiti bechuppato vaarde sheyyarad leven ummot haolam ika deamri vaarde sheppanav domin levered

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan beshaa sheamar lo paro leosef uviladecha lo yarim ish et yado vego amru itztagnine faro eved shellekacho rabbo beesrim kesef tamshilehu alenu amar lahen ginnune malchut ani roe bo

Amru lo im ken yehe yodea beshivim lashon ba gavriel velimdo shivim lashon la hava kagamar hosif lo ot achat mishshemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu velamad shenneemar edut bihosef samo betzeto al eretz mitzrayim sefat lo yadati eshma ulmachar kol lishana deishtai paro bahadeh ahdar leh
Ishtai ihu bilshon hakkodesh la hava ka yada may hava amar amar leh agmari agmereh vela gemar amar leh ishteva li dela megallet ishteva lo
Ki amar leh avi hishbiani lemor amar leh zil itshil ashshevuatach amar leh veitshil name addidach veaf al gav dela nicha leh amar leh ale ukvor et avicha kaasher hishbiecha
Yehuda may hi detanya haya rabbi meir omer kesheamdu yisrael al hayyam hau shevatim menatztzechim ze im ze ze omer ani yored techilla layyam veze omer ani yored techilla layyam kafatz

a: Shivto shel binyamin veyarad layyam techila shenneemar sham binyamin tzair rodem al tikre rodem ella rad yam vehau sare yehuda rogmim otam shenneemar sare yehuda rigmatam
Lefichach zacha binyamin hatztzaddik venaasa ushpizchan laggevura shenneemar uven ketefav shachen

Amar lo rabbi yehuda lo kach haya maase ella ze omer en ani yored techila layyam veze omer en ani yored techila layyam kafatz nachshon ben amminadav veyarad layyam techila shenneemar sevavuni vechachash efrayim uvmirma bet yisrael vihuda od rad im el
Vealav meforash bakkabbala hoshieni elohim ki vau mayim ad nafesh tavati biven metzula veen moomad vego al tishtefeni shibbolet mayim veal tivlaeni metzula vego

Beotah shaa haya moshe maarich bitfilla amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu yediday tovim bayyam veatta maarich bitfilla lefanay amar lefanav ribbono shel olam uma beyadi laasot amar lo dabber el bene yisrael veyissau veatta harem et mattecha unte et yadcha vego
Lefichach zacha yehuda laasot memshala beyisrael shenneemar hayeta yehuda lekodsho yisrael mamshelotav ma taam hayeta yehuda lekodsho veyisrael mamshelotav mishshum dehayyam raa vayyanos
Tanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer i efshar lomar levi lematta shekkevar neemar lemala vei efshar lomar lemala shekkevar neemar lematta
Ha ketzad zikne kehunna ulviyya lematta vehashshear lemala rabbi yoshiyya omer kol harauy lesharet lematta vehashshear lemala
Rabbi omer ellu veellu lematta hen omdim hafchu penehem kelappe har gerizim ufatchu bivracha kelappe har eval ufatchu biklala may al al besamuch
Kidtanya venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka rabbi omer al besamuch atta omer al besamuch o eno ella al mammash keshehu omer vesakkota al haaron heve omer al besamuch
Hafchu penehem kelappe har gerizim ufatchu bivracha ku tanu rabbanan baruch bichlal baruch bifrat arur bichlal arur bifrat lilmod ullammed lishmor velaasot hare
b: Arba arba vearba hare shemone shemone ushmone hare shesh esre vechen besinay vechen bearvot moav shenneemar elle divre habberit asher tziva Adonai et moshe vego uchtiv ushmartem et divre habberit hazzot vego nimtza arbaim ushmone beritot al kol mitzva umitzva
Rabbi shimon motzi har gerizim vehar eval umachnis ohel moed shebbammidbar
Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya rabbi yishmael omer kelalot neemru besinay ufratot beohel moed rabbi akiva omer kelalot ufratot neemru besinay venishnu beohel moed venishtalleshu bearvot moav
Veen lach kol devar mitzva umitzva shekketuva battora shello nichretu aleha arbaim ushmone beritot

Rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar akko amar mishshum rabbi shimon en lecha mitzva umitzva shekketuva battora shello nichretu aleha arbaim ushmone beritot shel shesh meot elef ushloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim

Amar rabbi ledivre rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar akko sheamar mishshum rabbi shimon en lecha kol mitzva umitzva shebbattora shello nichretu aleha arbaim ushmone beritot shel shesh meot elef ushloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim nimtza lechol echad veechad miyyisrael shesh meot elef ushloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim
May benayehu amar rav mesharsheya arva vearva dearva ika benayehu
Daresh rabbi yehuda ben nachmani meturgemaneh derabbi shimon ben lakish kol happarasha kullah lo neemra ella benoef venoefet
Arur haish asher yaase fesel umassecha vego bearur saggi leh ella ze habba al haerva veholid ben vehalach leven ummot haolam veavad avoda zara arurin aviv veimmo shel ze shekkach garmu lo

Tanu rabbanan venatatta et habberacha al har gerizim veet hakkelala vego ma talmud lomar im lelammed shettehe beracha al har gerizim uklala al har eval hare kevar neemar elle yaamdu levarech et haam al har gerizim uchtiv veelle yaamdu al hakkelala behar eval ella lehakdim beracha liklala
Yachol yihu kol habberachot kodmot lakkelalot talmud lomar beracha uklala beracha achat kodemet liklala veen kol habberachot kodmot lakkelalot

Ulhakkish beracha liklala lomar lach ma kelala bilviyyim af beracha bilviyyim uma kelala bekol ram af beracha bekol ram uma kelala bilshon hakkodesh af beracha bilshon hakkodesh uma kelala bichlal ufrat af beracha bichlal ufrat uma kelala ellu vaellu onin veomrim amen af beracha ellu vaellu onin veomrim amen
Matni birkat kohanim ketzad bammedina omer otah shalosh berachot uvammikdash beracha achat bammikdash omer et hashshem

a: Kichtavo uvammedina bechinuo bammedina kohanim nosim et yedehen keneged kitfehen uvammikdash al gabbe rashehen chutz mikkohen gadol sheeno magbiha et yadav lemala min hatztzitz rabbi yehuda omer af kohen gadol magbiha yadav lemala min hatztzitz shenneemar vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayevarchem

Gema tanu rabbanan ko tevarchu bilshon hakkodesh atta omer bilshon hakkodesh o eno ella bechol lashon neemar kan ko tevarchu veneemar lehallan elle yaamdu levarech et haam ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh af kan bilshon hakkodesh
Rabbi yehuda omer eno tzarich hare hu omer ko ad sheyyomru ballashon hazze
Tanya idach ko tevarchu baamida atta omer baamida o eno ella afilu bishiva neemar kan ko tevarchu veneemar lehallan elle yaamdu levarech ma lehallan baamida af kan baamida
Rabbi natan omer eno tzarich hare hu omer lesharto ulvarech bishmo ma mesharet baamida af mevarech baamida umsharet gufeh menalan dichtiv laamod lesharet

Tanya idach ko tevarchu binsiut kappayim atta omer binsiut kappayim o eno ella shello binsiut kappayim neemar kan ko tevarchu veneemar lehallan vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayevarchem ma lehallan binsiut kappayim af kan binsiut kappayim
Kashya leh lerabbi yonatan i ma lehallan kohen gadol verosh chodesh vaavodat tzibbur af kan kohen gadol verosh chodesh vaavodat tzibur
Rabbi natan omer eno tzarich hare hu omer hu uvanav kol hayyamim makkish banav lo ma hu binsiut kappayim af banav binsiut kappayim uchtiv kol hayyamim veitakkash beracha lesherut
Vetanya idach ko tevarchu et bene yisrael bashshem hamforash atta omer bashshem hamforash o eno ella bechinuy talmud lomar vesamu et shemi shemi hamuchad li
Yachol af baggevulin ken neemar kan vesamu et shemi veneemar lehallan lasum et shemo sham ma lehallan bet habbechira af kan bevet habbechira

Rabbi yoshiyya omer eno tzarich hare hu omer bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi avo elecha bechol makom salka datach ella mikra ze mesoras hu bechol makom asher avo elecha uverachticha sham azkir et shemi vehechan avo elecha uverachticha bevet habbechira sham azkir et shemi bevet habbechira
Tanya idach ko tevarchu et bene yisrael en li ella bene yisrael gerim nashim vaavadim meshuchrarim minnayin talmud lomar amor lahem lechullehu
Tanya idach ko tevarchu panim keneged panim atta omer panim keneged panim o eno ella panim keneged oref talmud lomar amor lahem keadam haomer lachavero
Tanya idach ko tevarchu bekol ram o eno ella belachash talmud lomar amor lahem keadam sheomer lachavero
Amar abbaye naktinan lishnayim kore kohanim ulechad eno kore kohen shenneemar amor lahem lishnayim veamar rav chisda naktinan kohen kore kohanim veen yisrael kore kohanim shenneemar amor lahem amira
b: Mishshellahem tehe vehilcheta keoteh deabbaye velet hilcheta keoteh derav chisda
Siman mitave livracha duchan baavoda kos makkir nehene beegla

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu mitave levirkat kohanim shenneemar vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarchem veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol kohen shemmevarech mitbarech vesheeno mevarech en mitbarech shenneemar vaavarcha mevarchecha
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol kohen sheeno ole ladduchan over bishlosha ase ko tevarchu amor lahem vesamu et shemi
Rav amar choshshin shemma ben gerusha o ben chalutza hu
Vela peligi ha desalek lifrakim ha dela salek lifrakim

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol kohen sheeno ole baavoda shuv eno ole shenneemar vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayevarchem vayyered measot hachattat vehaola vehashshelamim ma lehallan baavoda af kan baavoda
Ini veha rabbi amme verabbi assi salki rabbi amme verabbi assi meikara hao akri karayehu mimta la hava matu hatam vechidtane rabbi oshaya lo shanu ella shello akar et raglav aval akar et raglav ole
Utnan name im havtachato shennose et kappav vechozer litfillato rashshay vehavenan bah ha la akar ella denad purta hacha name deakar purta
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi en notnin kos shel beracha levarech ella letov ayin shenneemar tov ayin hu yevorach ki natan millachmo laddal al tikre yevorach ella yevarech
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi minnayin sheafilu ofot makkirin betzare haayin shenneemar ki chinnam mezora harashet beene kol baal kanaf

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol hannehene mitztzare haayin over belav shenneemar al tilcham et lechem ra ayin vego ki kemo shaar benafsho ken hu echol ushte yomar lach vego rav nachman bar yitzchak amar over bishne lavin al tilcham veal titav
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi en egla arufa baa ella bishvil tzare haayin

Shenneemar veanu veamru yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze vechi al libbenu alta shezzikne bet din shofche damim hem ella lo ba leyadenu uftarnuhu velo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu lo ba leyadenu uftarnuhu belo mezonot lo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu belo levaya
Amar adda amar rabbi simlay bet hakkeneset shekkullah kohanim kullan olin ladduchan lemi mevarchin amar rabbi zera laachehem shebbassadot
Ini vehatane abba bereh derav minyamin bar chiyya am sheachore kohanim enan bichlal beracha la kashya ha daanisi ha dela anisi
Vehatane rav shimi mibbirta deshichori bet hakkeneset shekkullah kohanim miktzatan olin umiktzatan onin amen
La kashya ha deishteyur be asara ha dela ishteyur be asra
Gufa tana abba bereh derav minyamin bar chiyya am sheachore kohanim enan bichlal beracha
Peshita ariche beappe gutze la mafseki teva la mafseka mechitza may ta shema deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi afilu mechitza shel barzel enah mafseket ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim
Ibaya lehu tzedadin mahu amar abba mar bar rav ashe ta shema ditnan nitkaven lehazzot lefanav

Amar rava bar rav huna kevan shenniftach sefer tora asur lesapper afilu bidvar halacha shenneemar uvfitcho amdu kol haam veen amida ella shetika shenneemar vehochalti ki lo yedabberu ki amdu lo anu od rabbi zera amar rav chisda mehacha veozne chol haam el sefer hattora
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol kohen shello natal yadav lo yissa et kappav shenneemar seu yedechem kodesh uvarchu et Adonai
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi elazar ben shammua bamma heerachta yamim amar lahen miyyamay lo asiti bet hakkeneset kappendarya velo pasati al rashe am kodesh velo nasati kappay belo beracha
May mevarech amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda asher kiddeshanu bikdushshato shel aharon vetzivanu levarech et ammo yisrael beahava

Ki akar kareh may amar yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettehe beracha zo shetztzivitanu levarech et ammecha yisrael lo yehe bah michshol veaon vechi mahdar appeh mitztzibura may amar adbereh rav chisda lerav ukva udrash ribbono shel olam asinu ma sheggazarta alenu ase immanu
b: Ma shehivtachtanu hashkifa mimmeon kodshecha min hashshamayim vego

Amar rav chisda en hakkohanim rashshaim lachof kishre etzbeotehen ad sheyyachziru penehem min hatztzibbur amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda en hakkore rashshay likrot kohanim ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur

Veen hakkohanim rashshain lehatchil bivracha ad sheyyichle dibur mippi hakkore veen hatztzibbur rashshain laanot amen ad shettichle beracha mippi hakkohanim veen hakkohanim rashshain lehatchil bivracha acheret ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur

Veamar rabbi zera amar rav chisda en hakkohanim rashshain lehachzir penehem min hatztzibbur ad sheyyatchil sheliach tzibbur besim shalom veenan rashshain laakor raglehem velelech ad sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur sim shalom

Veamar rabbi zera amar rav chisda en hatztzibbur rashshain laanot amen ad shettichle beracha mippi hakkore veen hakkore rashshay likrot battora ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur veen hamtargem rashshay lehatchil battargum ad sheyyichle pasuk mippi hakkore veen hakkore rashshay lehatchil befasuk acher ad sheyyichle targum mippi hamtargem

Amar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hammaftir benavi tzarich sheyyikra battora techila veamar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi en hammaftir rashshay lehaftir bannavi ad sheyyiggalel sefer tora
Veamar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi en sheliach tzibbur rashshay lehafshit et hatteva batztzibbur mippene kevod tzibbur
Veamar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi en hatztzibbur rashshain latzet ad sheyyinnatel sefer tora veyanuach bimkomo ushmuel amar ad sheyyetze
Vela peligi ha deika pitcha acharina ha deleka pitcha acharina amar rava bar ahina asberah li achare Adonai elohechem telechu

Bizman shehakkohanim mevarchim et haam ma hen omrim amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach vego barchu Adonai kol tzevaav meshartav ose retzono barchu Adonai kol maasav bechol mekomot memshalto barchi nafshi et Adonai
Bemusfe deshabbeta ma hen omrim amar rabbi assi shir hammaalot hinne barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai vego seu yedechem kodesh uvarchu et Adonai baruch Adonai mitztziyyon shochen yerushalam halluyah

Velema name yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon dichtiv behahu inyana amar yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi mittoch shehitchil bevirchotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu mesayyem bevirchotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu

Beminchata detaanita may amri amar rav acha bar yaakov im aonenu anu vanu Adonai ase lemaan shemecha mikve yisrael moshio beet tzara lamma tihye keger baaretz vego lamma tihye keish nidham kegibbor lo yuchal lehoshia vego
