Velokmah becherem shel shene shuttafin dehay hadar addideh vehay hadar addideh amar rav pappa zot omeret kerem shel shene shuttafin en chozrin alav meerche hammilchama
Umay shena mechamishsha achin umet echad mehen bammilchama dechullan chozrin hatam kol chad vechad karena beh ishto hacha kol chad vechad la karena bah karmo
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar bemavrich ilan beyarak vehay tanna hu detanya hammavrich ilan beyarak rabban shimon ben gamliel mattir mishshum rabbi yehuda ben gamda ish kefar akko vachachamim osrin
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan ha manni rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi la amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hatam kerem kemashmao hacha name nata kemashmao notea in mavrich umarkiv la

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov yalda pechuta mittefach chayyevet beorla kol shenoteha demitchazya kevat shatta vehane mile shettayim keneged shettayim veachat yotza zanav aval kulleh kerem kala it leh
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov met tofes arba ammot likriat shema dichtiv loeg larash cheref osehu
Amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov churgeta haggedela ben haachin asura linase laachin demitchazya ki achatayehu vela hi kala it lah lemilta
Veamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov leket shichcha ufea sheasaan begoren hukbeu lemaaser amar ulla la amaran ella bassade aval bair kala it leh lemilleta

Veamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov yalda happechuta mittefach enah mekaddeshet et hazzeraim vehane mile shettayim keneged shettayim veachat yotza zanav aval kulleh kerem mekaddesh
Veamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov

a: Met tofes arba ammot letuma vetanna tuna chatzar hakkever haomed betochah tahor vehu sheyehu bah arba ammot divre bet shammay bet hillel omrim arbaa tefachim bamme devarim amurim sheppitchah millemala aval pitchah min hatztzad divre hakkol arba ammot

Kelappe leya adderabba min hatztzad midrid venafek millemala i efshar dela maahil ella bamme devarim amurim sheppitchah min hatztzad aval pitchah millemala arba ammot vehane mile chatzar hakkever dimsayema mechitzatah aval met bealma tafes

Mi haish asher eras ishsha ku tanu rabbanan asher eras echad hamares et habbetula veechad hamares et haalmana veechad shomeret yavam vaafilu chamishsha achin umet echad mehem bammilchama kullan chozrin lo lakach velo lekachah perat lealmana lakkohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot mamzeret untina leyisrael bat yisrael lemamzer ulnatin
Lema dela kerabbi yose haggelili dei rabbi yose haggelili ha amar hayyare verach hallevav ze hammityare meaverot shebbeyado
Afilu tema rabbi yose haggelili kidrabba deamar rabba leolam eno chayyav ad sheyyivol ma taam lo yikkach mishshum lo yechallel mishshum hachi eno loke ad sheyyivol

Tanu rabbanan asher bana asher nata asher eras limda tora derech eretz sheyyivne adam bayit veyitta kerem veachar kach yissa ishsha veaf shelomo amar bechochmato hachen bachutz melachtecha veattedah bassade lach achar uvanita vetecha hachen bachutz melachtecha ze bayit veattedah bassade lach ze kerem achar uvanita vetecha zo ishsha

Davar acher hachen bachutz melachtecha ze mikra veattedah bassade lach ze mishna achar uvanita vetecha ze gemara davar acher hachen bachutz melachtecha ze mikra umishna veattedah bassade lach ze gemara achar uvanit vetecha ellu maasim tovim rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer hachen bachutz melachtecha ze mikra umishna ugmara veattedah bassade lach ellu maasim tovim achar uvanita vetecha derosh vekabbel sachar
Veellu sheenan chozrin habbone bet shaar ku tana im hosif bo dimos echad chozer rabbi eliezer omer af habbone bet levenim bashsharon lo haya chozer tana mippene shemmechaddeshin oto paamayim beshavua

Veellu sheen zazin mimmekoman bana bayit chadash vachanacho vechu tanu rabbanan ishsha chadasha en li ella ishsha chadasha almana ugrusha minnayin talmud lomar ishsha mikkol makom im ken ma talmud lomar ishsha chadasha mi shechadasha lo yatza machazir gerushato sheen chadasha lo

Tanu rabbanan lo yetze batztzava yachol batztzava hu delo yetze aval yaspik mayim umazon vitakken hadderachim talmud lomar velo yaavor alav lechol davar yachol sheani merabbe af habbone bayit velo chanacho nata kerem velo chillelo eras ishsha velo lekachah talmud lomar alav alav i atta maavir aval atta maavir al acherim umeachar dichtav lo yaavor lo yetze batztzava lema li laavor alav bishne lavin

Matni veyasfu hashshotrim ledabber el haam vego rabbi akiva omer hayyare verach hallevav kemashmao sheeno yachol laamod bekishre hammilchama velirot cherev shelufa rabbi yose haggelili omer hayyare verach hallevav zehu hammityare min haaverot shebbeyado lefichach talta lo hattora et kol ellu sheyyachzor biglalan
Rabbi yose omer almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot mamzeret untina leyisrael bat yisrael lemamzer ulnatin hare hu hayyare verach hallevav

Vehaya kechallot hashshotrim ledabber el haam ufakdu sare tzevaot berosh haam uvaakevo shel am maamidin zekifin lifnehem vaacherim meachorehem vechashshilin shel barzel bidehen vechol hamvakkesh lachzor harshut beyado lekappeach et shokav
b: Shettechilat nisa nefila shenneemar nas yisrael lifne felishtim vegam maggefa gedola hayeta vaam ulhallan hu omer vayyanusu anshe yisrael mippene felishtim vayyippelu chalalim vego

Bamme devarim amurim bemilchamot harshut aval bemilchamot mitzva hakkol yotzin afilu chatan mechedro vechalla mechuppatah amar rabbi yehuda bamme devarim amurim bemilchamot mitzva aval bemilchamot chova hakkol yotzin afilu chatan mechedro vechalla mechuppatah
Gema may ika ben rabbi yose lerabbi yose haggelili ika benayehu avera derabbanan
Keman azla ha detanya sach ben tefila litfila avera hi beyado vechozer aleha meorche hammilchama keman kerabbi yose haggelili

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan shama kol keranot vehirtia haggafat terisin vehirtia tzichtzuach charavot umayim shottin lo al birkav chozer keman lema rabbi akiva hi vela rabbi yose haggelili beha afilu rabbi yose haggelili mode mishshum dichtiv velo yimmas et levav echav kilvavo
Vehaya kechallot hashshotrim ku hay mippene shettechilat nisa nefila mippene shettechilat nefila nisa mibbee leh ema mippene shettechilat nefila nisa
Bamme devarim amurim bemilchamot harshut ku amar rabbi yochanan reshut derabbanan zo hi mitzva derabbi yehuda mitzva derabbanan zo hi chova derabbi yehuda

Amar rava milchamot yehoshua lechabbesh divre hakkol chova milchamot bet david lirvacha divre hakkol reshut ki peligi lemaote nochrim dela layete alayehu mar kare lah mitzva umar kare reshut nafka minah leosek bemitzva sheppatur min hammitzva
Hadaran alach meshuach milchama

Egla arufa bilshon hakkodesh shenneemar ki yimmatze chalal baadama veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha shelosha mibbet din haggadol shebbirushalayim hau yotzin rabbi yehuda omer chamishsha shenneemar zekenecha shenayim veshoftecha shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehen od echad
Nimtza tamun baggal o taluy bailan o tzaf al pene hammayim lo hau orfin shenneemar baadama velo tamun baggal nofel velo taluy bailan bassade velo tzaf al pene hammayim
Nimtza samuch lassefar o leir sherubbah nochrim o leir sheen bah bet din lo hau orfin en moddin ella leir sheyyesh bah bet din
Gema may kaamar amar rabbi avahu hachi kaamar shenneemar veanu veamru ulhallan hu omer veanu halviyyim veamru vego ma aniyya haamura lehallan bilshon hakkodesh af kan bilshon hakkodesh
Veseder egla arufa ketzad ki yimmatze chalal baadama veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha shelosha mibbet din haggadol shebbirushalayim hau yotzin rabbi yehuda omer chamishsha vechu

Tanu rabbanan veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha zekenecha shenayim veshoftecha shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehen od echad hare kan chamishsha divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer zekenecha shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehen od echad hare kan shelosha
Verabbi shimon name ha ketiv veshoftecha hahu mibe leh limuchadin shebbeshoftecha verabbi yehuda mizzikne zekenecha nafka

Verabbi shimon i ketav rachamana zikne hava amena afilu zikne hashshuk ketav rachamana zekenecha vei ketav rachamana zekenecha hava amena afilu sanhedri ketanna ketav rachamana veshoftecha limuchadin shebbeshoftecha
Verabbi yehuda gemar zikne zikne mizzikne haeda ma lehallan meuchadin shebbaeda af kan meuchadin shebbaeda
I gamar ligmerah lechullah milta mehatam zekenecha veshoftecha lema li ella vav veshoftecha leminyana verabbi shimon

a: Vav la mashma leh may kaamar rachamana hamuchadin shebbeshoftecha ella meatta veyatzu shenayim umaddu shenayim lerabbi yehuda hare kan tisha lerabbi shimon hare kan shiva
Hahu mibe leh lechidtanya veyatzu hen velo sheluchehen umaddu sheafilu nimtza baalil lair hau moddin shemmitzva laasok bimdida

Matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer zekenecha zo sanhedrin shoftecha ze melech vechohen gadol melech dichtiv melech bemishpat yaamid aretz kohen gadol dichtiv uvata el hakkohanim halviyyim veel hashshofet asher yihye vego
Ibaya lehu rabbi eliezer ben yaakov bemelech vechohen gadol hu diflig aval besanhedri i kerabbi yehuda i kerabbi shimon sevira leh o dilma besanhedri name pelig ad deika kullah sanhedri
Amar rav yosef ta shema metzaan zaken mamre abbe fagge vehimra alehen yachol tehe hamraato hamraa talmud lomar vekamta vealita el hammakom melammed shehammakom gorem
Dinfuk kamma ilema dinfuk miktzatan dilma hanach deika gavae keoteh sevira lehu ella peshita dinfuk kullehu

Ulmay i lidvar harshut mi matzu nafki vehachtiv shorrech aggan hassahar al yechsar hammazeg sheim nitzrach echad mehem latzet im yesh sham esrim ushlosha keneged sanhedri ketanna yotze veim lav eno yotze

Ella peshita lidvar mitzva lemay lav limdidat egla verabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi amar leh abbaye la dilma lehosif al hair veal haazarot keditnan en mosifin al hair veal haazarot ella bevet din shel shivim veechad

Tanya keoteh derav yosef metzaan abbet pagge vehimra alehen kegon sheyyatzu limdidat egla o lehosif al hair veal haazarot yachol tehe hamraato hamraa talmud lomar vekamta vealita melammed shehammakom gorem
Nimtza tamun baggal o taluy bailan lema matnitin rabbi yehuda hi vela rabbanan detanya veshachachta omer bassade perat letamun divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim bassade lerabbot et hattamun
Amar rav afilu tema rabbanan hacha meinyaneh dikra hatam meinyaneh dikra

Dichtiv ki yimmatze chalal hecha demishtechach baadama perat letamun vehatam meinyaneh dikra dichtiv ki tiktzor ketzircha vesadecha veshachachta omer shichcha dumya dekatzir ma katzir begaluy af shichcha begaluy ketav rachamana bassade lerabbot et hattamun
Lerabbi yehuda name tipok leh mishshichcha dumya dekatzir in hachi name
Veella bassade lema li mibe leh lerabbot shichchat kama verabbanan shichchat kama mena lehu nafka lehu mikki tiktzor ketzircha besadcha

Verabbi yehuda mibe leh lechidrabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar perat leshetztzafu omarin letoch sede chavero verabbanan mibbassade besadecha verabbi yehuda bassade besadecha la mashma leh
Bae rabbi yirmeya tzafu omarin letoch sadehu mahu avir sade kesade dame o lav kesade dame
Amar leh rav kahana lerav pappe veamri lah rav kahana lerav zevid tifshot leh midderabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar deamar perat leshetztzafu omarin letoch sede chavero dachavero in letoch sadehu la
Velitamach letoch sede chavero tzafu in munnachin la veha baenan besadecha veleka
Ella letoch sede chavero vaafilu munnachin vehay dekaamar tzafu dela mashkachatte lah ella betzafu

Ta shema omer shehechzik bo leholicho lair vehinnicho al gabbe chavero ushchacho hattachton shichcha vehaelon eno shichcha rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon shenehem enan shichcha hattachton mippene shehu tamun vehaelon mippene shehu tzaf ad kan la peligi ella betachton aval beelon divre hakkol la havey shichcha
Shane hatam kevan deachzek beh zecha beh i hachi may irya al gabbe chavero afilu bassade name in hachi name vehay dekatane al gabbe chavero mishshum tachton
Veha mippene shehu tzaf kaamar ema mippene shehu ketzaf
Amar abbaye hareni keven azzay beshuke teverya amar leh hahu midderabbanan leabbaye shene chalalim ze al gabbe ze mehechan hu moded
Min bemino have tamun umin bemino la have tzaf umeelon moded o dilma min bemino have tzaf umin bemino la have tamun umittachton moded
O dilma min bemino have tamun umin bemino have tzaf velo mittachton moded velo meelon moded
Amar leh
b: Tenetuha omer shehechzik bo leholicho lair vehinnicho al gabbe chavero ushchacho hattachton shichcha vehaelon eno shichcha rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon shenehen enan shichcha hattachton mippene shehu tamun vehaelon mippene shehu tzaf savruha dehane tannae kerabbi yehuda sevira lehu deamar bassade perat letamun
May lav beha ka mipalgi demar savar min bemino have tamun umar savar la have tamun
La i kerabbi yehuda sevira lehu dechulle alma min bemino have tamun vehacha biflugta derabbi yehuda verabbanan kamipalgi derabbanan kerabbanan verabbi shimon ben yehuda kerabbi yehuda
I hachi may irya al gabbe chavero afilu beafar uvitzror name in hachi name ulhodiacha kocho derabbi yehuda deamar afilu min bemino have tamun
Tanu rabbanan chalal velo chanuk chalal velo mefarper baadama velo tamun baggal nofel velo taluy bailan bassade velo tzaf al pene hammayim rabbi elazar omer bechullan im haya chalal orfin

Tanya amar rabbi yose bar yehuda amru lo lerabbi elazar i atta mode sheim haya chanuk umutal baashpa sheen orfin alma chalal velo chanuk hacha name baadama velo tamun baggal nofel velo taluy bailan bassade velo tzaf al gabbe mayim verabbi elazar chalal yattira ketiv
Nimtza samuch lassefar o leir sherubbah nochrim ku dichtiv ki yimmatze perat lematzuy
O leir sheen bah bet din devaena zikne hair veleka en moddin ella leir ku peshita kevan ditna leir sheen bah bet din ana yadana deen moddin ella leir sheyyesh bah bet din
Ha ka mashma lan kidtanya minnayin sheim nimtza samuch leir sheen bah bet din shemmannichin otah umoddin leir sheyyesh bah bet din talmud lomar velakchu zikne hair hahi mikkol makom

Matni nimtza mechuuon ben shette ayarot shettehen meviot shette agalot divre rabbi eliezer veen yerushalayim mevia egla arufa nimtza rosho bemakom echad vegufo bemakom acher molichin harosh etzel hagguf divre rabbi eliezer rabbi akiva omer hagguf etzel harosh meayin hau moddin rabbi eliezer omer mittiburo rabbi akiva omer mechotmo rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer mimmakom shennaase chalal mitztzavaro
Gema may tama derabbi eliezer kasavar efshar letzamtzem ukrova vaafilu kerovot
Veen yerushalayim mevia egla arufa deamar kera lerishtah vekasavar yerushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim
Nimtza rosho bemakom ku bemay kamipalgi ilema leinyan medida kamipalgi ha middekatane sefa meayin hau moddin mikkelal deresha la bimdida askinan amar rabbi yitzchak bemet mitzva kana mekomo kamipalgi

Vehachi kaamar lekovro kana mekomo vehecha denimtza rosho bemakom echad vegufo bemakom acher molichin harosh etzel hagguf divre rabbi eliezer rabbi akiva omer hagguf etzel harosh bemay kamipalgi mar savar gufeh beduchteh nafel resha denade venafel umar savar resha hecha denafel nafel gufa hu derahet azel
Meayin hau moddin bemay kamipalgi mar savar ikar chiyyuta beappeh umar savar ikar chiyyuta betibureh
Lema ki hane tannae mehechan havalad notzar merosho vechen hu omer mimmee immi atta gozi veomer gozzi nizrech vehashlichi vego abba shaul omer mittiburo umshalleach shorsho elach

Afilu tema abba shaul ad kan la kaamar abba shaul ella leinyan yetzira dechi mittzar velad mimmetziateh mittzar aval leinyan chiyyuta dechulle alma beappeh hu dichtiv kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav vego
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer mimmakom shennaase chalal mitztzavaro may tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov kedichtiv latet otach el tzavvere challe reshaim

Matni nifteru zikne yerushalayim vehalchu lahen zikne otah hair meviin eglat bakar asher lo mashcha beol veen hammum posel bah umoridin otah lenachal etan etan kemashmao kashe af al pi sheeno etan kasher veorfin otah bekofitz meachoreha umkomah asur millizroa umillaavod umuttar lisrok sham pishtan ulnakker sham avanim

Zikne otah hair rochatzin et yedehen bammayim bimkom arifa shel egla veomrim yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze veenenu lo rau vechi al datenu alta shezzikne bet din shofche damim hen ella shello ba al yadenu uftarnuhu belo mazon velo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu belo levaya

a: Vehakkohanim omrim kapper leammecha yisrael asher padita Adonai veal titten dam naki bekerev ammecha yisrael lo hau tzerichin lomar venikkapper lahem haddam ella ruach hakkodesh mevassartan ematay shettaasu kacha haddam mitkapper lahem

Gema vihe mum posel beegla mikkal vachomer uma para sheen hashshanim poslot bah mum posel bah egla sheshshanim poslot bah eno din sheyehe mum posel bah shane hatam deamar kera asher en bah mum bah mum posel veen mum posel beegla
Ella meatta lo yehu shear avodot poslot bah
Allema amar rav yehuda amar rav hinniach aleha udda shel sakkin pesula uvegla ad shettimshoch shane para deyalfinan ol ol meegla
Egla name tete ol ol mippara ha maet rachamana bah

Beegla name ketiv bah hahu mibe leh lemaote kodashim dela pasla behu avoda salka datach amena lete bekal vachomer meegla uma egla sheen mum posel bah avoda poselet bah kodashim shemmum poselt bahen eno din sheavoda poselet bahen
Ika lemifrach ma leegla shekken shanim poslot bah attu kodashim mi leka defasli behu shanim ki itzterich kera lehanach kodashim defasli behu shanim

Vekadashim dela pasla behu avoda mehacha nafka mehatam nafka averet o shavur o charutz o yabbelet o garav o yallefet lo takrivu elle la elle i atta makriv aval atta makriv kodashim shenneevda bahen avoda itzterich salka datach amena hane mile hecha deavad bahen avodat heter aval avodat isur ema litasru tzericha
Veha name mehacha nafka umiyyad ben nechar lo takrivu et lechem elohechem mikkol elle elle i atta makriv aval atta makriv kodashim shenneevda bahen avoda
Itzterich salka datach amena hane mile hecha deavad bahen keshehen chullin aval avad bahen keshehen kodashim ema litasru tzericha

Gufa amar rav yehuda amar rav hinniach aleha udda shel sakkin pesula uvegla ad shettimshoch metivi ol en li ella ol shear avodot minnayin amarta kal vachomer uma egla sheen mum posel bah shear avodot poslot bah para shemmum posel bah eno din sheshshear avodot poslin bah
Veim nafshecha lomar neemar kan ol veneemar lehallan ol ma lehallan shear avodot poslot bah af kan shear avodot poslot
May im nafshecha lomar vechi tema ika lemifrach ma leegla shekken shanim poslot bah i name kodashim yochichu shemmum posel bahen veen avoda poselet bahen
Neemar kan ol veneemar lehallan ol ma lehallan shear avodot af kan shear avodot umimmakom shebbata ma lehallan ad shettimshoch af kan ad shettimshoch
Tannae hi deika demayete lah meegla ika demayete lah miggufah defara

Detanya ol en li ella ol shear avodot minnayin talmud lomar asher lo ala aleha ol mikkol makom im ken ma talmud lomar ol ol posel ben bishat avoda ben shello bishat avoda shear avodot en poslot ella bishat avoda
Veema asher lo ala aleha kalal ol parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat ol in mide acharina la asher ribbuya hu

Vetanya name gabbe egla ki hay gavena ol en li ella ol shear avodot minnayin talmud lomar asher lo ubbad bah mikkol makom im ken ma talmud lomar ol ol posel ben bishat avoda ben shello bishat avoda shear avodot en poslot ella bishat avoda
Veema asher lo ubbad bah kalal ol parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat ol in mide acharina la asher ribbuya hu

Amar rabbi avahu beay mineh merabbi yochanan meshichat ol bechamma amar li kimlo ol ibaya lehu leorko o lerochbo amar lehu hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh ledidi mipparsha li mineh derabbi yochanan meshichat ol lerochbo tefach
Velema tefach ha ka mashma lan shiura deol tefach have lemay nafka minah lemikkach umimkar

Amar rabbi yochanan ben shaul mippene ma amra tora have egla benachal amar hakkadosh baruch hu yavo davar shello asa perot veyearef bimkom sheen ose perot vichapper al mi shello hinnichuhu laasot perot may perot ilema periyya urviyya ella meatta azzaken veassaris hachi name dela arfinan ella mitzot
Umoridin otah el nachal etan etan kemashmao kashe tanu rabbanan minnayin leetan shehu kashe shenneemar
b: Etan moshavecha vesim bassela kinnecha veomer shimu harim et riv Adonai vehaetanim mosde aretz acherim omrim minnayin leetan shehu yashan shenneemar goy etan hu goy meolam hu
Veorfin otah bekofitz meachoreha may tama gamar arifa arifa mechattat haof
Umkomah asur millizroa umilleaved tanu rabbanan asher lo yeaved bo velo yizzarea lesheavar divre rabbi yoshiyya rabbi yonatan omer lehabba

Rava amar lehabba dechulle alma la peligi dichtiv velo yizzarea ki peligi lesheavar rabbi yoshiyya savar mi ketiv velo yeubbad verabbi yonatan mi ketiv asher lo neevad verabbi yoshiyya asher lesheavar mashma verabbi yonatan asher ribbuya hu

Vetisbera ha midderabbi yehoshua ben levi amar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah rabbi yochanan amar lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayemo vehacha hechi kaamar rabbi yochanan bifne shenayim
Veod ha rabba it leh derava

Ella dechulle alma baenan edim metzuyin lekayemo vehacha beshaliach naase ed veed naase dayyan kamipalgi man deamar bifne shenayim kasavar shaliach naase ed veed naase dayyan uman deamar bifne shelosha kasavar shaliach naase ed veen ed naase dayyan
Veha kayema lan bidrabbanan deed naase dayyan
Ella hacha beha kamipalgi demar savar kevan deishsha keshera lehavi et hagget zimnin demayeta leh itta vesamchi alah
Veidach ishsha mida yadi vela samchi alah
Tanya keoteh derabbi yochanan hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam untano lah velo amar lah befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam yotzi vehavalad mamzer divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim en havalad mamzer ketzad yaase yittelennu hemenna veyachazor veyittenennu lah bifne shenayim veyomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam
Verabbi meir mishshum delo amar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam yotzi vehavalad mamzer
In rabbi meir letameh deamar rav hamnuna mishshemeh deulla omer haya rabbi meir kal hamshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim begitin yotzi vehavalad mamzer
Bar hedya bae leetoye gita ata lekammeh derabbi achay dahava memunne aggite amar leh tzarich atta laamod al kal ot vaot ata lekammeh derabbi amme verabbi assi amri leh la tzerichatte
Vechi tema eeved lechumra nimtza atta motzi laaz al gitin harishonim
Rabba bar bar chana ayeti gita palga iktav kammeh ufalga la iktav kammeh ata lekammeh derabbi elazar amar leh afilu lo katav bo ella shita achat lishmah shuv eno tzarich rav ashe amar

a: Afilu kan kulmosa vekan megilta
Tanya keoteh derav ashe hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam afilu hu babbayit vesofer baaliyya hu baaliyya vesofer babbayit afilu nichnas veotze kal hayyom kullo kasher
Hu babbayit vesofer baaliyya ha la ka chaze leh ella lav kegon dishma kan kulmosa vekan megilta

Amar mar afilu nichnas veotze kal hayyom kullo kasher man ilema shaliach hashta hu babbayit vesofer baaliyya dela chaze leh amratte kasher nichnas veotze mibaya ella sofer peshita mishshum denichnas veotze nifselineh
La tzericha dinfak leshuka vaata mahu detema inish acharina ashkecheh vaamar leh ka mashma lan
Itmar bavel rav amar keeretz yisrael legitin ushmuel amar kechutza laaretz
Lema beha ka mipalgi demar savar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah vehane gemiri umar savar lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayemo vehane name la shechichi
Vetisbera ha rabba it leh derava
Ella dechulle alma baenan lekayemo rav savar kevan deika metivata mishkach shechichi ushmuel savar metivata begirsayehu teridi
Itmar name amar rabbi abba amar rav huna asinu atzmenu bevavel keeretz yisrael legitin mikki ata rav levavel

Metiv rabbi yirmeya rabbi yehuda omer merkam lemizrach urkam kammizrach meashkelon laddarom veashkelon kaddarom meakko latztzafon veakko katztzafon veha bavel litzfonah deeretz yisrael kayema dichtiv vayyomer Adonai elay mitztzafon tippatach haraa
Utnan rabbi meir omer akko keeretz yisrael legitin vaafilu rabbi meir la kaamar ella beakko dimkarva aval bavel dimrachaka la hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah levar mibbavel
Ad hechan hi bavel amar rav pappa kemachaloket leuchasin kach machaloket legitin verav yosef amar machaloket leuchasin aval legitin divre hakkol ad arba tinyana degishra
Rav chisda matzrech meaktesfon leve ardashir umibbe ardashir leaktesfon la matzrech lema kasavar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah vehane gemiri
Vetisbera veha rabba it leh derava ella dechulle alma baenan lekayemo vehane kevan deazli leshuka lehatam hanach yadi bachatimot yeda dehane
Vehane bidhanach la yadi may tama beshukayehu teridi
Rabba bar avuh matzrech mearsa learsa rav sheshet matzrech mishshechuna lishchuna verava matzrech beotah shechuna
Veha rava hu deamar lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayemo shane bene machoza denayedi

Rav chanin mishtae rav kahana ayeti gita vela yadana i missura linhardea i minnehardea lesura ata lekammeh derav amar leh tzerichna lememar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam o la tzerichna amar leh la tzerichatte
b: Vei avadte ahnet may i avadte ahnet dei ate baal mearar la mashgechinan beh

Kidtanya maase beadam echad shehevi get lifne rabbi yishmael amar lo tzarich ani lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam o eni tzarich amar lo beni mehechan atta amar lo rabbi mikkefar sisay ani amar lo tzarich atta lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam shello tizakek leedim

Leachar sheyyatza nichnas lefanav rabbi ilay amar lo rabbi vahalo kefar sisay muvlaat bitchum eretz yisrael ukrova letzipori yoter meakko utnan rabbi meir omer akko keeretz yisrael legitin vaafilu rabbanan la peligi aleh derabbi meir ella beakko dimrachaka aval kefar sisay dimkarva la
Amar lo shetok beni shetok hoil veyatza haddavar beheter yatza
Ha ihu name shello tizakek leedim kaamar leh la sayemuha kammeh
Shelach leh rabbi evyatar lerav chisda gitin habbaim mishsham lechan en tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam lema kasavar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah vehane gemiri
Vetisbera veha rabba it leh derava ella dechulle alma baenan lekayemo vechevan deika rabbim desalki venachati mishkach shechichi

Amar rav yosef man lema lan derabbi evyatar bar samcha hu veod ha ihu dishlach leh lerav yehuda bene adam haolin mishsham lechan hen kiyemu beatzman vayyittenu et hayyeled bazzona vehayyalda machru vayyayin vayyishtu uchtav leh bela sirtut
Veamar rabbi yitzchak shettayim kotvin shalosh en kotvin bematnita tana shalosh kotvin arba en kotvin
Amar leh abbaye attu kol dela yada ha derabbi yitzchak lav gavra rabba hu bishlama milta detalya bisvara lechayye ha gemara hi ugmara la shemia leh
Veod ha rabbi evyatar hu deaskem mareh al yedeh dichtiv vattizne alav pilagsho rabbi evyatar amar zevuv matza lah rabbi yonatan amar nima matza lah
Veashkecheh rabbi evyatar leeliyyahu amar leh may ka aved hakkadosh baruch hu amar leh asek befilegesh baggiva umay kaamar amar leh evyatar beni kach hu omer yonatan beni kach hu omer
Amar leh chas veshalom umi ika sefeka kamme shemayya amar leh ellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim hen zevuv matza velo hikpid nima matza vehikpid
Amar rav yehuda zevuv bakkeara venima beoto makom zevuv meisuta venima sakkanta ika deamri ide veide bakkeara zevuv unsa venima peshiuta
Amar rav chisda leolam al yatil adam ema yetera betoch beto shehare pilegesh baggiva hetil aleha baalah ema yetera vehippila kamma revavot miyyisrael
Amar rav yehuda amar rav kol hammetil ema yetera betoch beto sof hu ba lide shalosh averot giluy araot ushfichut damim vechilul shabbat
Amar rabba bar bar chana ha deamri rabbanan shelosha devarim tzarich adam lomar betoch beto erev shabbat im chashecha issartem eravtem hadliku et hanner tzarich

a: Lememrinhu benichuta ki hechi delikabbelu mineh amar rav ashe ana la shemia li ha derabba bar bar chana vekiyyamtiha missevara
Amar rabbi avahu leolam al yatil adam ema yetera betoch beto shehare adam gadol hetil ema yetera betoch beto veheechiluhu davar gadol
Umannu rabbi chanina ben gamliel heechiluhu salka datach hashta behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadam tzaddikim atzman lo kol shekken
Ella bikkeshu lehaachilo davar gadol umay nihu ever min hachay
Shelach leh mar ukva lerabbi elazar bene adam haomdim alay uvyadi lemosram lammalchut mahu
Sirtet uchtav leh amarti eshmera derachay mechato vilshoni eshmera lefi machsom beod rasha lenegdi af al pi sherasha lenegdi eshmera lefi machsom

Shelach leh ka metzaari li tuva vela matzena deekum behu shelach leh dom la vehitcholel lo dom la vehu yappilem lecha chalalim chalalim hashkem vehaarev alehen levet hammidrash vehen kalin meelehen haddavar yatza mippi rabbi elazar untanuhu ligniva bekolar
Shelachu leh lemar ukva zimra mena lan daasir sirtet uchtav lehu al tismach yisrael el gil beammim
Velishlach lehu mehacha bashshir lo yishtu yayin yemar shechar leshotav i mehahu hava amena hane mile zimra demana aval defumma shere ka mashma lan
Amar leh rav huna bar natan lerav ashe may dichtiv kina vedimona veadada amar leh matvata deeretz yisrael kachashev
Amar leh attu ana la yadana dematvata deeretz yisrael ka chashev ella rav geviha mearaggiza amar bah tama kol sheyyesh lo kina al chavero vedomem shochen ade ad ose lo din

Amar leh ella meatta tziklag umadmena vesansannah hachi name amar leh i hava rav geviha mibbe araggiza hacha hava amar bah tama rav acha mibbe chozaa amar bah hachi kal mi sheyyesh lo tzaakat legima al chavero vedomem shochen bassene ose lo din
Amar leh resh galuta lerav huna kelila mena lan deasur amar leh midderabbanan ditnan bappulmus shel aspasyanus gazru al atrot chatanim veal hairus
Addehachi kam rav huna leippenoye amar leh rav chisda kera ketiv ko amar Adonai elohim hasir hammitznefet veharim haatara zot lo zot hashshafala hagbeha vehaggavoha hashpil
Vechi ma inyan mitznefet etzel atara ella lomar lach bizman shemmitznefet berosh kohen gadol atara berosh kol adam nistalleka mitznefet merosh kohen gadol nistalleka atara merosh kol adam
Addehachi ata rav huna ashkechinhu dahave yatvi amar leh haelohim midderabbanan ella chisda shemach vechisdain milach
Ravina ashkecheh lemar bar rav ashe dahava gadel kelila livratteh amar leh la savar lah mar hasir hammitznefet veharim haatara amar leh dumya dechohen gadol begavre aval binshe la

May zot lo zot daresh rabbi avira zimnin amar lah mishshemeh derav amme vezimnin amar lah mishshemeh derav assi beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael hasir hammitznefet veharim haatara amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam zot lahen leyisrael shehikdimu lefanecha besinay naase lenishma
Amar lahen lo zot lahen leyisrael shehishpilu et haggavoha vehigbihu et hashshafel veheemidu tzelem bahechal

Daresh rav avira zimnin amar lah mishshemeh derav amme vezimnin amar lah mishshemeh derav assi may dichtiv ko amar Adonai im shelemim vechen rabbim vechen nagozzu veavar vego im roe adam shemmezonotav metzumtzamin yaase mehen tzedaka vechol shekken keshehen merubbin

May vechen nagozzu veavar tana deve rabbi yishmael kal haggozez minnechasav veose mehen tzedaka nitzal middinah shel gehinnam mashal lishte rechelot shehau ovrot bemayim achat gezuza veachat enah gezuza gezuza avra vesheenah gezuza lo avra
b: Veinnitich amar mar zutra afilu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka yaase tzedaka lo aannech od tane rav yosef shuv en marin lo simane aniyyut

Rabbi yehuda omer mirkam lammizrach ku lememra deakko litzfonah deeretz yisrael kayema urminhu haya mehallech meakko lichziv mimino lemizrach hadderech temea mishshum eretz haammim uftura min hammaaser umin hashsheviit ad sheyyivada lach shehi chayyevet
Missemolo lemaarav hadderech tehora mishshum eretz haammim vechayyevet bemaaser uvishviit ad sheyyivada lach shehi petura ad hechan ad keziv rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv ad lavlavo

Amar abbaye retzua nafka veyahev tanna simana hachi in kera name yahev simana dichtiv vayyomru hinne chag Adonai beshilo miyyamim yamima asher mitztzefona levet el mizrecha hashshemesh limsilla haola mibbet el shechema uminnegev lilvona veamar rav pappa lemizrachah shel mesilla
Tana chada hammevi get bisfina kemevi beeretz yisrael vetanya idach kemevi bechutza laaretz
Amar rabbi yirmeya la kashya ha rabbi yehuda ha rabbanan ditnan afar chutza laaretz habba bisfina laaretz chayyav bemaaser uvishviit
Amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shehassefina gosheshet aval en hassefina gosheshet patur
Abbaye amar ha veha rabbi yehuda hi vela kashya kan bizman sheen hassefina gosheshet kan bizman shehassefina gosheshet
Amar rabbi zera atzitz nakuv hammunnach al gabbe yetedot banu lemachloket rabbi yehuda verabbanan
Amar rava dilma la hi ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam ella bisfina

a: Haasuya livroach aval atzitz sheeno asuy livroach lo
I name ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella bisfina dela mafsek avera demayya ki ara semichta damya aval atzitz demafsek avera la
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar binharot deeretz yisrael dechulle alma la peligi ella ki peligi bayyam haggadol

Detanya ezehu eretz veezehu chutza laaretz kol sheshshofea veored mitture amnon velifnim eretz yisrael mitture amnon velachutz chutza laaretz hannissin shebbayyam roin otan keilu chut matuach alehem mitture amnon ad nachal mitzrayim min hachut velifnim eretz yisrael min hachut velachutz chutza laaretz
Rabbi yehuda omer kol shekkeneged eretz yisrael hare hu keeretz yisrael shenneemar ugvul yam vehaya lachem hayyam haggadol ugvul ze yihye lachem gevul yam

Vehannissin shebbatztzedadin roin otan keilu chut matuach alehen mikkaflurya vead yam okyanos uminnachal mitzrayim vead yam okyanos min hachut velifnim eretz yisrael min hachut velachutz chutza laaretz
Verabbanan hay ugvul may avdi leh mibe leh lenissin verabbi yehuda nissin la tzerichi kera
Rabbi meir omer akko keeretz yisrael vechu beo mineh merabbi chiyya bar abba hammocher avdo lesurya kemocher bechutza laaretz dame o la
Amar lehu tenetuha rabbi meir omer akko keeretz yisrael legitin legitin in laavadim la vechol shekken surya dimrachaka tuva

Tanu rabbanan bishlosha derachim shaveta surya leeretz yisrael uvishlosha lechutza laaretz siman av bar rak afarah tame kechutza laaretz vehammocher avdo lesurya kemocher bechutza laaretz vehammevi get missurya kemevi mechutza laaretz
Uvishlosha leeretz yisrael chayyevet bemaaser uvishviit keeretz yisrael veharotze likanes lah betohora nichnas vehakkone sade besurya
b: Kekonah befarvare yerushalayim chayyevet bemaaser uvishviit keeretz yisrael kasavar kibush yachid shemeh kibush
Veharotze likanes lah betohora nichnas vehaamratte afarah tame beshida teva umigdal

Detanya hannichnas leeretz haammim beshida teva umigdal rabbi metamme rabbi yose berabbi yehuda metaher vaafilu rabbi la ka metamme ella beeretz haammim degazru al gushah veal avirah aval surya al gushah gazru al avirah lo gazru
Vehakkone sade besurya kekonah befarvare yerushalayim lemay hilcheta amar rav sheshet lomar shekkotvin alav ono vaafilu beshabbat
Beshabbat salka datach kidamar rava omer legoy veose hacha name omer legoy veose veaf al gav daamira legoy shevut mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael la gezur rabbanan
Tanu rabbanan eved shehevi gito vechatuv bo atzmecha unchasay kenuyin lach atzmo kana nechasim lo kana
Ibaya lehu kol nechasay kenuyin lach mahu amar abbaye mittoch shekkana atzmo kana nechasim
Amar leh rava bishlama atzmo likne mide dehave agget ishsha ella nechasim la likne mide dehave akkiyyum shetarot dealma
Hadar amar abbaye mittoch shello kana nechasim lo kana atzmo amar leh rava bishlama nechasim la likne mide dehave akkiyyum shetarot dealma ella atzmo likne mide dehave agget ishsha
Ella amar rava echad ze veechad ze atzmo kana nechasim lo kana amar leh rav adda bar matna lerava keman kerabbi shimon deamar palginan dibura
Ditnan hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo yatza ben chorin shiyyer karka kal shehu lo yatza ben chorin rabbi shimon omer

a: Leolam hu ben chorin ad sheyyomar kol nechasay netunin lifloni avdi chutz meechad meribo shebbahen

Vehaamar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman af al pi shekkiles rabbi yose et rabbi shimon halacha kerabbi meir detanya keshennemeru devarim lifne rabbi yose kara alav hammikra hazze sefatayim yishshak meshiv devarim nechochim
Umi amar rav nachman hachi vehaamar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav leavdo veamad chozer bannechasim veeno chozer baeved
Chozer bannechasim mattenat shechiv mera hu veeno chozer baeved shehare yatza alav shem ben chorin
Ella amar rav ashe hatam hayenu tama mishshum delav kerut gita hu
Im yesh alav orrin yitkayyem bechotmav arar kamma ilema arar chad vehaamar rabbi yochanan divre hakkol en arar pachot mishshenayim
Veella arar tere tere utre ninhu may chazet desamchatte ahane semoch ahane ella arar devaal
Matni hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam veeno yachol lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam im yesh alav edim yitkayyem bechotmav
Echad gite nashim veechad shichrure avadim shau lammolich velammevi vezo achat min hadderachim sheshshau gite nashim leshichrure avadim
Gema may eno yachol lomar ilema cheresh cheresh bar etoye gita hu vehatnan hakkol kesherin lehavi et hagget chutz mecheresh shote vekatan
Amar rav yosef hacha bemay askinan kegon shennetano lah keshehu pikeach velo hispik lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam ad shennitcharesh

Echad gite nashim veechad shichrure avadim tanu rabbanan bishlosha derachim shau gite nashim leshichrure avadim shau lammolich velammevi vechol get sheyyesh alav ed kuti pasul chutz miggite nashim veshichrure avadim vechol hashshetarot
b: Haolim bearkaot shel goyim af al pi shechotmehen goyim kesherin chutz miggite nashim veshichrure avadim uchdivre rabbi meir bearbaa haomer ten get ze leishti ushtar shichrur ze leavdi ratza lachazor bishnehem yachzor divre rabbi meir
Bishlama lerabbanan minyana lemaote ha derabbi meir ella lerabbi meir minyana lemaote may
Lemaote ha detanya edim sheen yodim lachtom mekarin lahem neyar chalak ummalleim et hakkeraim deo
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim begite nashim aval shichrure avadim ushar kol hashshetarot im yodin likrot velachtom chotmin veim lav en chotmin
Keriyya man dechar shemah chassore mechassera vehachi katane edim sheen yodin likrot korin lifnehem vechotmin vesheen yodin lachtom mekarin lahem
Vetu leka vehaika haomer tenu get ze leishti ushtar shichrur ze leavdi umet lo yittenu leachar mita tenu mane lifloni umet yittenu leachar mita
Ki katane milta deletah bishtarot milta deitah bishtarot la katane
Dishlach ravin mishshemeh derabbi avahu heu yodin sheshshalach rabbi elazar laggola mishshum rabbenu shechiv mera sheamar kitvu utnu mane lifloni umet en kotvin venotnin
Shemma lo gamar lehaknoto ella bishtar veen shetar leachar mita
Vehaika lishmah
Bishlama lerabba hayenu molich umevi ella lerava kashya
Vetu ben lerabba ben lerava haika mechubbar ki katane pesula derabbanan deorayeta la katane
Veha arkaot shel goyim difsula deorayeta hu vekatane beede mesira uchrabbi elazar deamar ede mesira karti
Veha middekatane sefa rabbi shimon omer af ellu kesherin veamar rabbi zera yarad rabbi shimon leshitato shel rabbi elazar deamar ede mesira karti mikkelal detanna kamma savar la

a: Ika benayehu shemot muvhakin
Veha chazara deorayeta vekatane
Ella ki katane milta deletah bekidushin milta deitah bekidushin la katane
Veha chazara gufah ita bekidushin bishlichut beal korchah divgerushin itah uvkidushin letah
Matni kol get sheyyesh alav ed kuti pasul chutz miggite nashim veshichrure avadim maase sheheviu lifne rabban gamliel lichfar otnay get ishsha vehau edav ede chutim vehichshir
Gema manni matnitin la tanna kamma vela rabbi elazar vela rabban shimon ben gamliel

Detanya matztzat kuti mutteret veadam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach rabbi elazar oser lefi sheen bekiin bedikduke mitzot rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim harbe medakdekin bah yoter miyyisrael
Manni i tanna kamma afilu shear shetarot name i rabbi elazar afilu get ishsha name la
Vei rabban shimon ben gamliel i deachzuk afilu shear shetarot name i dela achzuk afilu get ishsha name la
Vechi tema rabban shimon ben gamliel hi udachzuk beha vela achzuk beha i hachi may irya chad afilu tere name allema amar rabbi elazar lo hichshiru bo ella ed echad kuti bilvad
Leolam rabbi elazar uchgon dechatem yisrael levassof
b: Dei lav dechuti chaver hava la machtem leh mikkammeh i hachi afilu shear shetarot name
Ella amrinan ravecha shevak leman dekashshish mineh hacha name ravecha shevak leman dekashshish mineh
Amar rav pappa zot omeret ede hagget en chotmin ze belo ze
May tama amar rav ashe gezera mishshum kullechem
Gufa amar rabbi elazar lo hichshiru bo ella ed echad kuti bilvad may ka mashma lan tenena kol get sheyyesh alav ed kuti pasul ku
I mimmatnitin hava amena afilu tere name vehay dekatane chad mishshum devishtarot afilu chad name la ka mashma lan
Utre la veha katane maase veheviu lifne rabban gamliel lichfar otnay get ishsha vehau edav ede chutim vehichshir amar abbaye teni edo

Rava amar leolam tere verabban gamliel miflag pelig vechassore michassera vehachi katane verabban gamliel machshir bishnayim umaase name sheheviu lifne rabban gamliel lichfar otnay get ishsha vehau edav ede chutim vehichshir

Matni kol hashshetarot haolim bearkaot shel goyim af al pi shechotmehem goyim kesherim chutz miggite nashim veshichrure avadim rabbi shimon omer af ellu kesherin lo huzkeru ella bizman shennaasu behedot
Gema ka pasek vetane la shena mecher la shena mattana
Bishlama mecher mikki yahev zuze kammayehu hu dikna ushtara reaya bealma hu dei la yahev zuze kammayehu la hao mari nafshayehu vechatvin leh shetara
Ella mattana bemay ka kane lav behay shetara vehay shetara chaspa bealma hu amar shemuel dina demalchuta dina
Veibaet ema tane chutz mikkegite nashim
Rabbi shimon omer af ellu kesherin vechu veha lav bene cheritut ninhu
Amar rabbi zera yarad rabbi shimon leshitato shel rabbi elazar deamar ede mesira karti
Vehaamar rabbi abba mode rabbi elazar bimzuyyaf mittocho sheppasul hacha bemay askinan

a: Beshemot muvhakin
Hechi dame shemot muvhakin amar rav pappa kegon hormiz vaavudayyana bar shivtay uvar kidre uvati unkim unna
Aval shemot sheen muvhakim may la i hachi addetane sefa lo huzkeru ella bizman shennaasu behedot liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim beshemot muvhakin aval shemot sheen muvhakin la
Hachi name kaamar bamme devarim amurim beshemot muvhakin aval beshemot sheen muvhakin naasa kemi shennaasu behedot ufsulin
Veibaet ema sefa atan legite mamon vehachi kaamar lo huzkeru gite mamon difsulim ella bizman shennaasu behedot

Tanya amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose kach amar rabbi shimon lachachamim betzayeddan lo nechleku rabbi akiva vachachamim al kol hashshetarot haolin bearkaot shel goyim sheaf al pi shechotmehen goyim kesherim vaafilu gite nashim veshichrure avadim lo nechleku ella bizman shennaasu behedot sherabbi akiva machshir vachachamim poslim chutz miggite nashim veshichrure avadim
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af ellu kesherin bimkom sheen yisrael chotmin aval bimkom sheyyisrael chotmin la
Mekom sheen yisrael chotmin name ligzor attu mekom sheyyisrael chotmin shemma bishma michallaf atra beatra la michallaf
Ravina savar leachshore bichnufyata dearmae amar leh rafram arkaot tenan
Amar rava hay shetara parsaa demasreh nihaleh beappe sahade yisrael magbinan beh mibbene chare
Veha la yadi lemikre bidyadi
Veha baena ketav sheeno yachol lezayyef veleka bedaafitzan veha baena tzarich sheyyachazir meinyano shel shetar beshita acharona veleka bidmahdar
I hachi mimmeshabedi name let leh kala
Bea mineh resh lakish merabbi yochanan
b: Edim hachatumin al hagget ushmotan keshemot goyim mahu amar leh la ba leyadenu ella lokus velus vehichsharnu
Vedaveka lokus velus dela shechichi yisrael demasseki bishmahatayehu aval shemahata acharine dishchichi yisrael demasseki bishmahatayehu la
Etiveh gitin habbaim mimmedinat hayyam veedim chatumim alehem af al pi sheshshemotehen kishmot goyim kesherin mippene sherov yisrael shebbechutza laaretz shemotehen kishmot goyim
Hatam kidkatane tama mippene sherov yisrael shebbechutza laaretz shemotehen kishmot goyim
Veika deamri ki matnita bea mineh ufshat leh mimmatnita
Matni haomer ten get ze leishti ushtar shichrur ze leavdi im ratza lachazor bishnehen yachzor divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim begite nashim aval lo beshichrure avadim lefi shezzachin laadam shello befanav veen chavin lo ella befanav
Sheim yirtze shello lazun et avdo rashshay veshello lazun et ishto eno rashshay
Amar lahem vahare hu posel et avdo min hatteruma keshem shehu posel et ishto amru lo mippene shehu kinyano
Gema yatev rav huna verav yitzchak bar yosef kammeh derabbi yirmeya veyatev rabbi yirmeya veka menamnem veyatev rav huna vekaamar shema minah midderabbanan hattofes levaal chov kana
Amar leh rav yitzchak bar yosef vaafilu bimkom shechav laacherim amar leh in
Addehachi itar behu rabbi yirmeya amar lehu dardeke hachi amar rabbi yochanan hattofes levaal chov bimkom shechav laacherim lo kana veim tomar mishnatenu
Kol haomer tenu keomer zechu dame

Amar rav chisda hattofes levaal chov bimkom shechav laacherim banu lemachloket rabbi eliezer verabbanan ditnan mi shelliket et happea veamar hare zo lifloni ani rabbi eliezer amar zacha lo vachachamim omrim yittenennu leani hannimtza rishon
Amar ammemar veitema rav pappa

a: Dilma la hi ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam ella demigo dei bae mafkar lehu lenichseh vehave ani vachaze leh umigo dezache leh lenafsheh zache lechavreh aval hacha la
Vead kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella dichtiv lo telakket leani lo telakket lo leani aval hacha la
Verabbi eliezer hay lo telakket may aved leh mibe leh lehazhir leani al shello
Sheim yirtze shello lazun ku shamatte minah yachol harav lomar laeved ase immi veeni zanach
Hacha bemay askinan daamar leh tze maase yadecha limzonotecha
Dichotah gabbe ishsha daamar lah tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich ishsha ammay la ishsha bidla safka
Eved name bidla safek avda dinhom kereseh la shave lemareh ulmarteh lemay mitbee

Ta shema eved sheggala leare miklat en rabbo chayyav lezuno velo od ella shemmaase yadav lerabbo shema minah yachol harav lomar laeved ase immi veeni zanach hacha bemay askinan deamar lo tze maase yadecha limzonotecha
I hachi maase yadav ammay lerabbo lehadafa
Haadafa peshita mahu detema kevan dechi let leh la yahev leh ki it leh name la lishkol mineh ka mashma lan
Umay shena leare miklat salka datach amena vachay aved leh chiyyuta tefe ka mashma lan
Veha middekatane sefa aval ishsha sheggalta leare miklat balah chayyav bimzonoteha mikkelal dela amar lah dei amar lah balah ammay chayyav
Umiddesefa dela amar lah resha name dela amar leh
Leolam daamar leh veishsha bidla safka
Veha middekatane sefa veim amar lah tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich rashshay mikkelal deresha dela amar lah hachi kaamar veim maspeket veamar lah tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich rashshay
Maspeket may lememra mahu detema kol kevudda vat melech penima ka mashma lan
Lema ketannae rabban shimon ben gamliel omer yachol haeved lomar lerabbo bishne vatztzoret o parneseni o hotzieni lecherut vachachamim omrim harshut beyad rabbo
May lav beha kamipalgi demar savar yachol umar savar eno yachol
Vetisbera hay o parneseni o hotzieni lecherut o parneseni o ten li maase yaday befarnasati mibe leh veod may shena bishne vatztzoret
Ella hacha bemay askinan deamar lo tze maase yadecha limzonotecha uvishne vatztzoret la safek
Rabban shimon ben gamliel savar o parneseni o hotzieni lecherut ki hechi dechazu li inashe umrachamin alay verabbanan savri man dimrachem abbene chare aeved name rachome merachem
Ta shema deamar rav hammakdish yede avdo oto haeved love veochel veose uforea shema minah yachol harav lomar laeved ase immi veeni zanach
Hacha bemay askinan bemaale lo mezonot i hachi lemay
b: Love veochel lehadafa
Velema leh hekdesh ad hashta saggi lach bela haadafa vehashta name tisge lach bela haadafa hekdesh gufeh nicha leh ki hechi delashbach avdeh
Ose uforea kamma kamma kadesh leh befachot pachot mishshave peruta
Hachi name mistabbera deamar rav hammakdish yede avdo oto haeved ose veochel dei la avda man palach leh
I amratte bishlama hach bemaale veeno yachol veha besheeno maale shappir
Ella i amratte hach besheeno maale veyachol dei la avda man palach leh man devae niflecheh
Ella lav shema minah eno yachol shema minah
Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan hakkotea yad avdo shel chavero noten shivto urfuato lerabbo veoto haeved nizon min hatztzedaka shema minah yachol harav lomar laeved ase immi veeni zanach
Hacha bemay askinan bemaale lo mezonot i hachi ammay nizon min hatztzedaka lehadafa
I hachi nizon mitparnes mibe leh ella lav shema minah yachol shema minah
Amar mar noten shivto urfuato lerabbo shivto peshita refuato itztericha leh
Refuato dideh hi devae itassoye beh la tzericha deamduh lechamsha yome vaavadu leh samma charifa veittassi bitlata yome mahu detema tzaara dideh hu ka mashma lan

Tanya amar rabbi elazar amarnu lo lemeir vahalo zechut hu laeved sheyyotze mittachat yede rabbo lecherut amar lanu chov hu lo sheim haya eved kohen poslo min hatteruma amarnu lo vahalo ma im yirtze shello lezuno veshello lefarneso rashshay
Amar lanu uma ilu eved kohen shebbarach veeshet kohen shemmarda al balah halo ochlin bitruma veze eno ochel aval ishsha chov hu lah shekken poslah min hatteruma umafsidah min hammezonot
May kaamru leh umay ka mahdar lehu hachi kaamar lehu hashavtuni al hammezonot ma teshivuni al hatteruma
Vechi temru i bae zarek leh gita ufasel leh shavek leh vearek veazel lealma

a: Uma ilu eved kohen shebbarach veeshet kohen shemmarda al balah halo ochlim bitruma veze eno ochel
Shappir kaamar lehu amar rava hayenu deka mahderi leh bematnitin mippene shehu kinyano dei bae shakel arbaa zuze miyyisrael ufasel leh kol hecha deiteh
Ulrabbi meir tinach eved kohen eved yisrael may ika lememar amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak mippene shemmafsido mishshifcha kenaanit
Adderabba hare hu mattiro bevat chorin avda behefkera nicha leh zila leh shechicha leh peritza leh
Matni haomer tenu get ze leishti shetar shichrur ze leavdi umet lo yittenu leachar mita tenu mane leish peloni umet yittenu leachar mita
Gema amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav vehu shetztzevurin umunnachin bekeren zavit
Bemay askinan ilema bevari ki tzevurin may have ha la meshach veella bishchiv mera may irya tzevurin ki en tzevurin name deha kayema lan dedivre shechiv mera kichtuvim vechimsurin damu
Amar rav zevid leolam bevari vechidrav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav mane li beyadcha tenehu lo lifloni bemaamad shelashtan kana
Rav pappa amar leolam bishchiv mera uchidach derav deamar rav shechiv mera sheamar tenu mane lifloni minnechasay mane ze notnin mane setam en notnin
Chayeshinan shemma mane kavur kaamar
Vehilcheta likvura la chayeshinan rav pappa may tama la amar kerav zevid
b: Kasavar rav pappa ki amar rav la shena bemilve vela shena befikkadon
Rav zevid may tama la amar kerav pappa la mitokma matnitin bishchiv mera mimmay middekatane haomer tenu get ze leishti ushtar shichrur ze leavdi umet lo yittenu leachar mita
Tama demet ha mechayyim notnin tama deamar tenu ha lo amar tenu en notnin ushchiv mera af al gav dela amar tenu notnin
Ditnan barishona hau omrim hayyotze bekolar veamar kitvu get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu chazru lomar af hamfaresh vehayyotze bishyara
Rabbi shimon shezuri omer af hamsukkan
Matkef lah rav ashe uman nema lan dematnitin rabbi shimon shezuri hi dilma rabbanan hi
Gufa amar rav huna amar rav mane li beyadcha tenehu lo lifloni bemaamad shelashtan kana amar rava mistabbera milteh derav befikkadon aval bemilva lo
Vehaelohim amar rav afilu bemilva ittemar name amar shemuel mishshemeh delevi milva li beyadcha tenehu lo lifloni bemaamad shelashtan kana
Vetama may amar ammemar naasa keomer lo bishat mattan maot shabadna lach ledidach ulchol deatu mechamatach
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar ella meatta hikna lannoladim dela hao bishat mattan maot hachi name dela kanu
Daafilu lerabbi meir deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam hane mile ledavar sheyyeshno beolam aval ledavar sheeno baolam la
Ella amar rav ashe

a: Behahi hanaa deka mishtanneya leh ben milva yeshana lemilva chadasha gamar umshabed nafsheh
Amar leh huna mar bereh derav nechemya lerav ashe ella meatta kegon hane deve bar elyashiv dechafti veshakli lealtar hachi name dela kanu
Vechi tema hachi name im ken natatta devarecha leshiurin

Ella amar mar zutra hane telat mile shavinhu rabbanan kehilcheta bela tama chada ha veidach deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel hakkotev kol nechasav leishto lo asaah ella appitroppeya veidach deamar rav chananya hammassi ishsha livno gadol babbayit kenao
Amar leh rav lerav acha bardela kabba demorika it li gabbach yahaveh lifloni beappeh kaamena lach dela hadarna bi
Mikkelal dei bae hadar beh matze hadar beh hachi kaamar devarim hallalu lo nitnu lachazara
Ha amar rav chada zimna deamar rav huna amar rav mane li beyadcha tenehu lo lifloni bemaamad shelashtan kana
I mehahi hava amena hane mile mattana merubba aval mattana muetet la live befanav ka mashma lan
Hanhu ginae daavud chushbana bahade hadade pash chamesh istere zuze gabbe chad minnayehu amri leh yahavinhu nihaleh lemare ara beappe mare ara ukno mineh
Lesof azal avad chushbana ben dileh lenafsheh la pash gabbeh vela mide ata lekammeh derav nachman amar leh may ebed lach chada deamar rav huna amar rav veod ha keno minach
Amar leh rava attu hay mi kaamar la yahavina deleka gabbay kaamar amar leh im ken kinyan betaut hu vechol kinyan betaut chozer
Itmar holech mane lifloni sheani chayyav lo amar rav chayyav beachrauto veim ba lachzor eno chozer ushmuel amar mittoch shechayyav beachrauto im ba lachzor chozer
Lema beha kamipalgi demar savar holech kizchi dame umar savar holech lav kizchi dame
La dechulle alma holech kizchi dame vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar la amrinan migo umar savar amrinan migo

Tanya keoteh derav holech mane lifloni sheani chayyav lo ten mane lifloni sheani chayyav lo holech mane lifloni pikkadon sheyyesh lo beyadi ten mane lifloni pikkadon sheyyesh lo beyadi chayyav beachrauto veim ba lachzor eno chozer
Pikkadon lema leh en retzono sheyehe pikdono beyad acher amar rabbi zera keshehuchzak kafran
Rav sheshet hava leh asharta desarbale bemachoza amar leh lerav yosef bar chama bahade deatet ayetinhu nihali azal yahavinhu leh amri leh nikne minach amar lehu in
Lesof ishtemit lehu ki ata legabbeh amar leh shappir avadte dela shavit nafshach eved love leish malve lishana acharina shappir avadte eved love leish malve
Rabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya hava leh ispeka dechaspa binhardea
b: Amar lehu lerabbi dostay bar rabbi yannay ulrabbi yose bar kefar bahade deatetu atuh nihali azul yahaveh nihaleh amri lehu nikne minayechu amri lehu la amri lehu ahdereh nihalan
Rabbi dostay berabbi yannay amar lehu in rabbi yose bar kefar amar lehu la hao ka metzaaru leh amar leh chazi mar hechi ka aved amar lehu tav remo leh
Ki ato legabbeh amar leh chazi mar la misatyeh dela sayean ella amar lehu name tav remo leh amar leh ammay tebed hachi

Amar leh otan bene adam hen amma vechovaan ammah umdabberin mechetzyehen ushmotehen mevohalin arda vearta ufile beresh omrin kefotu koftin omrin harogu horgin ilu hargu et dostay mi natan leyannay abba bar kemoti
Amar leh bene adam hallalu kerovim lammalchut hen amar leh hen yesh lahen susim ufradim sheratzim acharehen amar leh hen amar leh i hachi shappir avadte
Holech mane lifloni vehalach uvikkesho velo metzao tane chada yachzeru lamshalleach vetanya idach leorshe mi shennishtalchu lo
Lema beha kamipalgi demar savar holech kizchi umar savar holech lav kizchi
Amar rabbi abba bar memel dechulle alma holech lav kizchi vela kashya ha bevari ha bishchiv mera
Rav zevid amar ha veha bishchiv mera ha deiteh limkabbel bishat mattan maot ha deleteh limkabbel bishat mattan maot
Rav pappa amar ha veha bevari ha demit mekabbel bechayye noten ha demit noten bechayye mekabbel

Lema holech kizchi tannae hi detanya holech mane lifloni vehalach uvikkesho velo metzao yachzeru lamshalleach met meshalleach rabbi natan verabbi yaakov amru yachzeru leorshe meshalleach veyesh omrim leorshe mi shennishtalchu lo

Rabbi yehuda hannasi amar mishshum rabbi yaakov sheamar mishshum rabbi meir mitzva lekayyem divre hammet vachachamim omrim yachloku vechan amru kol ma sheyyirtze shaliach yaase amar rabbi shimon hannasi al yadi haya maase veamru yachzeru leorshe meshalleach
May lav beha kamipalgi detanna kamma savar holech lav kizchi verabbi natan verabbi yaakov name holech lav kizchi veaf al gav demit la amrinan mitzva lekayyem divre hammet veyesh omrim holech kizchi
Rabbi yehuda hannasi amar mishshum rabbi yaakov sheamar mishshum rabbi meir holech lav kizchi mihu hecha demit amrinan mitzva lekayyem divre hammet
Vachachamim omrim yachloku mesappeka lehu vechan amru shuda adif verabbi shimon hannasi maase ata leashmoinan
La bevari dechulle alma la peligi vehacha bemay askinan bishchiv mera uviflugta derabbi elazar verabbanan kamipalgi

Ditnan hamchallek nechasav al piv rabbi elazar omer echad bari veechad mesukkan nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka vesheen lahen achraut en niknin ella bimshicha vachachamim omrim ellu vaellu niknin baamira
Amru lo maase beimman shel bene rochel shehayeta chola veamra tinaten

a: Kevinti levitti vehi bishnem asar mane umeta vekiyemu chachamim et devareha amar lahem bene rochel tikberem immam
Tanna kamma kerabbi elazar verabbi natan verabbi yaakov name kerabbi elazar af al gav demit la amrinan mitzva lekayyem divre hammet veyesh omrim kerabbanan

Verabbi yehuda hannasi sheamar mishshum rabbi meir kerabbi elazar mihu hecha demit amrinan mitzva lekayyem divre hammet vachachamim omrim yachloku mesappeka lehu vechan amru shuda adif verabbi shimon hannasi maase ata leashmoinan
Ibbaya lehu rabbi shimon hannasi nasi hu o mishshemeh denasi kaamar ta shema deamar rav yosef halacha kerabbi shimon hannasi vaadayin tibe lach nasi hu o dekaamar mishshemeh denasi teku
Gufa amar rav yosef halacha kerabbi shimon hannasi veha kayema lan divre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin damu
Rav yosef moke lah bevari veha leorshe meshalleach kaamar vekayema lan mitzva lekayyem divre hammet teni yachzeru limshalleach
Hadaran alach hammevi kamma

Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam veamar befanay nichtav aval lo befanay nechtam befanay nechtam aval lo befanay nichtav befanay nichtav kullo uvfanay nechtam chetzo befanay nichtav chetzo uvfanay nechtam kullo pasul

Echad omer befanay nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam pasul shenayim omrim befanenu nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam pasul verabbi yehuda machshir echad omer befanay nichtav ushnayim omrim befanenu nechtam kasher
Gema ha tu lema li ha tena leh chada zimna hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam i mehahi hava amena tzarich vei la amar kasher ka mashma lan
Befanay nichtav chetzo uvfanay nechtam kullo pasul he chetzo illema chetzo rishon vehaamar rabbi elazar afilu lo katav bo ella shita achat lishmah shuv eno tzarich ella amar rav ashe chetzo acharon
Befanay nichtav kullo uvfanay nechtam chetzo pasul amar rav chisda vaafilu shenayim meidim al chatimat yad sheni pasul may tama
O kullo bekiyyum hagget o kullo betakkanat chachamim
Matkef lah rava mi ika mide deilu amar chad kasher hashta deika tere pasul ella amar rava afilu
b: Hu veacher meidin al chatimat yad sheni pasul may tama atu leichallofe bekiyyum shetarot dealma veka nafek neche riva demamona appumma dechad sahada
Matkef lah rav ashe mi ika mide deilu massek leh ihu lechulleh dibura kasher hashta deika chad bahadeh pasul
Ella amar rav ashe afilu omer ani hu ed sheni pasul may tama o kullo bekiyyum hagget o kullo betakkanat chachamim

Tenan befanay nichtav kullo befanay nechtam chetzo pasul idach chetzo hechi dame ilema deleka deka mashed aleh kelal hashta echad omer befanay nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam dehay kamashed akkullah ketiva vehay kamashed akkullah chatima pasul chetzo mibaya
Ella o kidrava o kidrav ashe
Ulappoke midderav chisda
Amar lecha rav chisda ultamach befanay nichtav aval lo befanay nechtam lamma li ella lo zo af zo katane
Hacha name la zo af zo katane
Amar rav chisda gidud chamishsha umchitza chamishsha en mitztarfin ad sheyehe o kullo bimchitza o kullo begidud
Daresh marimar gidud chamishsha umchitza chamishsha mitztarfin vehilcheta mitztarfin
Bae ilfa yadayim tehorot lachatzain o en tehorot lachatzain hechi dame ilema deka mashu be tere merviit veha tenan merviit notlin layyadayim leechad vaafilu lishnayim
Veella deka mashe chada chada yedeh vehatnan hannotel yado achat bintila veachat bishtifa yadav tehorot
Veella deka mashe palga palga deyadeh vehaamri deve rabbi yannay yadayim en tehorot lachatzain la tzericha deika mashke tofeach
Vechi ika mashke tofeach may have vehatnan

a: Hannitztzok vehakkatafres umashke tofeach eno chibur lo letuma velo letohora
La tzericha deika tofeach lehatpiach ha name tenena tofeach lehatpiach chibur
Dilma leinyan mikvaot verabbi yehuda hi ditnan mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mechuvanot veyardu shenayim vetavlu shenehem bevat achat tehorim
Beze achar ze rishon tahor vehashsheni tame
Rabbi yehuda omer im hau raglav shel rishon nogot bammayim af hashsheni tahor
Amar rabbi yirmeya hare amru habba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin vetahor shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin tame bae rabbi yirmeya chetzo bevia vechetzo binfila may teku
Amar rav pappa hare amru baal keri chole shennatnu alav tisha kabbin mayim tahor bae rav pappa chetzo bitvila vechetzo bintina may teku
Echad omer befanay nichtav veechad omer ku amar rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella sheen hagget yotze mittachat yede shenehem aval get yotze mittachat yede shenehem
b: Kasher alma kasavar shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam en tzerichin sheyyomru befanenu nichtav uvfanenu nechtam
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta sefa dekatane shenayim omrim befanenu nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam pasul verabbi yehuda machshir
Tama deen hagget yotze mittachat yede shenehem ha get yotze mittachat yede shenehem machsheri rabbanan amar leh in
Vechi en get yotze mittachat yede shenehem bemay peligi mar savar gazrinan dilma atya leichallofe bekiyyum shetarot dealma beed echad umar savar la gazrinan

Lishana acharina amri lah amar rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan afilu get yotze mittachat yede shenehem pasul alma kasavar shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam tzerichin sheyyomru befanenu nichtav uvfanenu nechtam
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta sefa dekatane shenayim omrim befanenu nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam pasul verabbi yehuda machshir afilu get yotze mittachat yede shenehem pasli rabbanan amar leh in
Bemay ka mipalgi mar savar lefi sheen bekiin lishmah umar savar lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayemo
Lema derabba verava tannae hi la rava metaretz kelishana kamma
Verabba amar lach dechulle alma baenan lishmah vehacha bemay askinan leachar shellamdu
Uvigzera shemma yachzor haddavar lekilkulo kamipalgi demar savar gazrinan umar savar la gazrinan
Veliflog name rabbi yehuda beresha ha ittemar alah amar ulla chaluk haya rabbi yehuda af barishona
Metiv rav oshaya leulla rabbi yehuda machshir bezo velo beacheret may lav lemaote echad omer befanay nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam

La lemaote befanay nechtam aval lo befanay nichtav salka datach amena hoil vela gazar rabbi yehuda gezera shemma yachzor davar lekilkulo dilma ate leichallofe bekiyyum shetarot dealma beed echad name la gazar ka mashma lan
Ittemar name amar rav yehuda shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam banu lemachloket rabbi yehuda verabbanan

Rabba bar bar chana chalash ul legabbeh rav yehuda verabba leshayyole beh beo mineh shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam tzerichin sheyyomru befanenu nichtav uvfanenu nechtam o en tzerichin amar lahem en tzerichin ma ilu yomru befanenu gershah mi la mehemni addehachi ata hahu

a: Chavra shekala lishraga mikkammayehu amar rachamana o betullach o betulla devar esav

Lememra deromae meallu mipparsae vehatane rabbi chiyya may dichtiv elohim hevin darkah vehu yada et mekomah yodea hakkadosh baruch hu beyisrael sheen yecholin lekabbel gezerat romiyyim amad vehigla otam levavel
La kashya ha mikkamme deneto chabbare levavel ha levatar daato chabbare levavel

Echad omer befanay nichtav ushnayim omrim befanenu nechtam kasher amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shehagget yotze mittachat yad ed ketiva denaasu kishnayim al ze vechishnayim al ze aval mittachat yede ede chatima pasul

Alma kasavar shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam tzerichin sheyyomru befanenu nichtav uvfanenu nechtam amar leh rabbi assi ella meatta resha dekatane shenayim omrim befanenu nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam pasul verabbi yehuda machshir vaafilu get yotze mittachat yede shenehem pasli rabbanan amar leh in
Zimnin ashkecheh deyatev vekaamar daafilu get yotze mittachat yede ede chatima kasher alma kasavar shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam en tzerichin sheyyomru befanenu nichtav uvfanenu nechtam

Amar leh rabbi assi ella meatta resha dekatane shenayim omrim befanenu nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam pasul verabbi yehuda machshir tama deen hagget yotze mittachat yede shenehem ha get yotze mittachat yede shenehem machsheri rabbanan
Amar leh in veha zimnin la amarte lan hachi amar leh yated hi shello tamut
Matni nichtav bayyom venechtam bayyom ballayela venechtam ballayela ballayela venechtam bayyom kasher bayyom venechtam ballayela pasul rabbi shimon machshir
Shehaya rabbi shimon omer kol haggitin shennichtevu bayyom venechtemu ballayela pesulin chutz miggite nashim
Gema itmar mippene ma tiknu zeman begitin rabbi yochanan amar mishshum bat achoto
Resh lakish amar mishshum perot
Resh lakish may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan amar lach
b: Zenut la shechicha
Verabbi yochanan may tama la amar keresh lakish kasavar yesh levaal perot ad sheat netina
Bishlama leresh lakish mishshum hachi ka machshar rabbi shimon ella lerabbi yochanan may tama derabbi shimon demachshar
Amar lach rabbi yochanan alliba derabbi shimon la kaamena ki kaamena alliba derabbanan
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan hayenu deika ben rabbi shimon lerabbanan ella leresh lakish may ika ben rabbi shimon lerabbanan
Pere demishsheat ketiva vead sheat chatima ika benayehu
Veha ipcha shaminan lehu deittemar meematay motziin leferot rabbi yochanan amar mishsheat ketiva veresh lakish amar mishsheat netina
Efoch
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef shelosha gitin pesulim veim nisat havalad kasher ma hoilu chachamim betakkanatan ahano dilchattechila la tinase
Gazyeh lizman dideh veyahaveh nihalah may amar leh lerammay la chayeshinan
Katuv bo shavua shana chodesh shabbat may amar leh kasher uma hoilu chachamim betakkanatan
Ahno leshavua dekammeh ulshavua devatreh dei la tema hachi yoma gufeh mi yadinan i mitztzafra i mippanya ella leoma dekammeh uloma devatreh hacha name ahni leshavua dekammeh ulshavua devatreh
Amar leh ravina lerava katveh

a: Veotveh bechisteh dei mippayesah tipayyas may
Amar leh la makdem inash puranuta lenafsheh
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe gitin habbaim mimmedinat hayyam demikatvi benisan vela matu ad tishre ma hoilu chachamim betakkanatam amar leh hanhu kala it lehu
Itmar meematay monin lagget rav amar mishsheat netina ushmuel amar mishsheat ketiva
Matkef lah rav natan bar hoshaya lishmuel yomru shette nashim bechatzer achat zo asura vezo mutteret amar leh abbaye zo zeman gitah mochiach aleha vezo zeman gitah mochiach aleha

Tanya keoteh derav tanya keoteh dishmuel tanya keoteh derav hashsholeach get leishto venishtaha shaliach badderech shelosha chodashim keshehiggia get leyadah tzericha lehamtin shelosha chodashim ulget yashan en choshshin shehare lo nityached immah
Tanya keoteh dishmuel hammashlish get leishto veamar lo al tittenehu lah ella leachar shelosha chodashim mishshennetano lah mutteret linase miyyad ulget yashan en choshshin shehare lo nityached immah
Rav kahana verav pappe verav ashe avdi mishsheat ketiva rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua avdi mishsheat netina vehilcheta mishsheat ketiva
Itmar meematay ketubba meshammetet
Rav amar mishshettifgom vetizkof ushmuel amar pagma af al pi shello zakfa zakfa af al pi shello pagma
Tanya keoteh derav tanya keoteh dishmuel tanya keoteh derav meematay ketubba meshammetet mishshettifgom vetizkof pagma velo zakfa zakfa velo pagma enah meshammetet ad shettifgom vetizkof
Tanya keoteh dishmuel ones uknas ufituy uchtubbat ishsha shezzekafan bemilva meshammetin veim lav en meshammetin meematay nizkafim bemilva mishsheat haamada baddin

Amar shemuel ketubba kemaase bet din damya ma maase bet din nichtavin bayyom venechtamin ballayela af ketubba nichtevet bayyom venechtemet ballayela ketubbeteh derabbi chiyya bar rav iktuv bayyom veichatum ballayela hava rav hatam vela amar lehu vela mide
Lema kishmuel sevira leh asukin beoto inyan hao detanya amar rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok lo shanu ella kesheen asukin beoto inyan aval asukin beoto inyan kasher
Rabbi shimon machshir amar rava may tama derabbi shimon kasavar kevan shennatan enav legarshah shuv en lo perot
Amar resh lakish lo hichshir rabbi shimon ella lealtar aval mikkan vead asara yamim lo
b: Chayeshinan shemma piyyes verabbi yochanan amar afilu mikkan vead asara yamim im ita defayyes kala it lah lemilta
Itmar amar laasara kitvu get leishti amar rabbi yochanan shenayim mishshum edim vechullam mishshum tenay veresh lakish amar kullam mishshum edim
Hechi dame ilema dela amar lehu kullechem veha tenan amar laasara kitvu get leishti echad kotev ushnayim chotmin ella daamar lehu kullechem
May benayehu ika benayehu dachatum be tere minayehu beomeh veinach mikkan vead asara yamim man deamar mishshum tenay kasher uman deamar mishshum edim pasul
I name kegon shennimtza echad mehem karov o pasul leman deamar mishshum tenay kasher leman deamar mishshum edim pasul
I chatim bitchila karov o pasul amri lah kasher veamri lah pasul amri lah kasher tenay hu amri lah pasul ate leichallofe bishtarot dealma
Hahu daamar lehu laasara kitvu get leishti chatum be tere minayehu beomeh veinach mikkan vead asara yamim ata lekammeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi amar leh

a: Keday hu rabbi shimon lismoch alav bishat haddechak
Vehaamar resh lakish lo hichshir rabbi shimon ella lealtar aval mikkan vead asara yamim la behahi kerabbi yochanan sevira leh
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan shenayim mishshum edim vechullan mishshum tenay behahi keresh lakish sevira leh
Matni bakkol kotvim bido besam besikra uvkomos uvkankantom uvchol davar shehu shel kayyama en kotvin lo bemashkin velo beme ferot velo bechol davar sheeno mitkayyem

Al hakkol kotvin al heale shel zayit veal hakkeren shel para venoten lah et happara al yad shel eved venoten lah et haeved rabbi yose haggelili omer en kotvin lo al davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim velo al haochalim
Gema deo deota sam samma sikra amar rabba bar bar chana sekarta shemah komos koma kankantom amar rabba bar bar chana amar shemuel charta deushkafe
Uvchol davar shehu mitkayyem vechu leetoye may leetoye ha detane rabbi chanina ketavo beme tarya veaftza kasher tane rabbi chiyya ketavo baavar bishchor uvshichor kasher

Itmar hammaavir deo al gabbe sikra bashshabbat rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu chayyav shettayim achat mishshum kotev veachat mishshum mochek deo al gabbe deo sikra al gabbe sikra patur sikra al gabbe deo amri lah chayyav veamri lah patur
Amri lah chayyav mochek hu amri lah patur mekalkel hu
Bea mineh resh lakish merabbi yochanan edim sheen yodim lachtom mahu sheyyichtevu lahem besikra veyachtemu ketav elon ketav o eno ketav amar leh eno ketav
Amar leh vahalo limadtanu rabbenu ketav elon ketav leinyan shabbat amar leh vechi mippene sheanu medammin naase maase
Itmar edim sheen yodim lachtom rav amar mekarin lahem neyar chalak ummalleim et hakkeraim deo ushmuel amar baavar
Baavar salka datach vehatane rabbi chiyya ketavo baavar bishchor uvshichor kasher la kashya ha baavara ha bemayya daavara
Rabbi avahu amar beme melin vehatane rabbi chanina ketavo beme tarya veaftza kasher
La kashya ha daafitz ha dela afitz sheen me melin al gabbe me melin
Rav pappa amar berok vechen ori leh rav pappa lefappa toraa berok vehane mile begitin aval bishtarot la
Dehahu daavad ovada bishar shetarot venaggedeh rav kahana
b: Tanya keoteh derav edim sheen yodin lachtom mekarin lahen neyar chalak ummalleim et hakkeraim deo
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim begite nashim aval beshichrure avadim ushar kol hashshetarot im yodin likrot velachtom chotmin veim lav en chotmin

Keriyya man dechar shemah chassore michassera vehachi katane edim sheen yodin likrot korin lifnehem vechotmim vesheen yodin lachtom ku amar rabbi shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim begite nashim aval shichrure avadim ushar kol hashshetarot im yodin likrot velachtom chotmin veim lav en chotmin
Amar rabbi elazar may tama derabban shimon ben gamliel shello yehu benot yisrael agunot
Amar rava halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel verav gammada mishshemeh derava amar en halacha veella keman kerabbanan
Veha hahu daavad ovada bishar shetarot venaggedeh rav kahana targemah akkeria

Rav yehuda mitztaar kare vechatem amar leh ulla la tzerichatte deha rabbi elazar mara deeretz yisrael karu kammeh vechatem verav nachman karu kammeh safre dayyane vechatem vedaveka rav nachman vesafre dayyane deit lehu emta aval rav nachman vesafre acharine safre dayyane veinish acharina la
Rav pappa ki hava ate lekammeh shetara parsaa daavid bearkaot shel goyim makre lehu lishne goyim ze shello bifne ze bemesiach lefi tummo umagbe beh mimmeshabedi
Amar rav ashe amar li rav huna bar natan hachi amar ammemar hay shetara parsaa dachatimi aleh sahadi yisrael magbenan beh mimmeshabedi
Veha la yadi lemikre bidyadi veha baenan ketav sheeno yachol lehizdayyef veleka bedaafitzan veha baenan tzarich lachazor meinyano shel shetar beshita acharona veleka bidmahdar
Veella may ka mashma lan dechol lashon kasher tenena get shekketavo ivrit veedav yevanit yevanit veedav ivrit kasher
I mehahi hava amena hane mile begitin aval bishar shetarot la ka mashma lan
Amar shemuel natan lah neyar chalak veamar lah hare ze gitech megoreshet chayeshinan shemma beme melin ketavo
Metivi hare ze gitech untalattu uzrakattu layyam o laur o lechol davar haaved vechazar veamar shetar passim hu shetar amana hu megoreshet velo kol hemennu leosrah
Tama deika ketav ha leka ketav la ki kaamar shemuel devadkinan leh bemayya denara i palet palet vei la palet lav kelum hu
Vechi palet may have hashta hu defalet shemuel name chayeshinan kaamar

Amar ravina amar li ammemar hachi amar marimar mishshemeh derav dimi hane be tere deyahev gita kammayehu tzerichi lemikreyeh metivi hare ze gitech untalattu uzrakattu layyam o laur o lechol davar haaved vechazar veamar shetar passim hu shetar amana hu megoreshet velo chol hemennu leosrah vei amratte tzerichi lemikreyeh batar dekaruh mi matze amar lah hachi
La tzericha devatar dekaruh ayeleh leve yedeh veappekeh mahu detema challofe challefeh ka mashma lan
Hahu gavra dizrak lah gita lidvethu levene danne ishtechach mezuzta amar rav nachman mezuzta bene danne la shechicha
Vehane mile deishtechach chada aval shenayim shelosha middeha havay ha name havay vegita emor achbarim shakluh
Hahu gavra deal leve chenishta shekal sefer tora yehav lah lidvethu vaamar lah he gitich amar rav yosef lemay lechush lah i mishshum me melin en me melin al gabbe me melin

a: I mishshum keritut deit bah ha baena vechatav lah lishmah veleka
Vechi tema lechush dilma akdem vihav leh zuza lesafra meikara ha baenan shina shemo ushmah shem iro veshem irah veleka
Verav yosef may ka mashma lan sheen me melin al gabbe me melin
Amar rav chisda get shekketavo shello lishmah veheevir alav kulmos lishmah banu lemachloket rabbi yehuda verabbanan
Detanya hare shehaya tzarich lichtov et hashshem venitkaven lichtov yehuda vetaa velo hetil bo dalet maavir alav kulmos umkaddesho divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim en hashshem min hammuvchar
Amar rav acha bar yaakov dilma la hi ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam devaena ze eli veanvehu veleka aval hacha la
Amar rav chisda yachelna lemifselinhu lechulle lechullehu gite dealma amar leh rava may tama ilema mishshum dichtiv vechatav vehacha ihi ka katva leh vedilma aknoye akno leh rabbanan
Veella mishshum dichtiv venatan vehacha la yahev lah mide dilma netinat get hi teda dishlachu mittam ketavo al isure hanaa kasher
Gufa shelachu mittam ketavo al isure hanaa kasher amar rav ashe af anan name tenena al heale shel zayit dilma shane ale shel zayit dachaze leitzterofe
Tanya rabbi omer ketavo al isure hanaa kasher nefak levi darshah mishshemeh derabbi vela kallesuh mishshemeh derabbim vekallesuh alma hilcheta kevateh
Tanu rabbanan vechatav velo chakak lememra dachakika lav ketiva hi urminhu eved sheyyatza bichtav sheal gabbe tavla ufinkas yatza lecherut aval lo bichtav sheal gabbe kipa veanduchtari
Amar ulla amar rabbi elazar la kashya ha dechak tochot ha dechak yerechot
Vetochot la urminhu lo haya ketavo shokea ella bolet kedinre zahav veha dinre zahav tochot hen
Kedinre zahav velo kedinre zahav kedinre zahav devolet velo kedinre zahav deilu hatam tochot hacha yerechot
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe rushma michratz charitz o kannofe mechannef amar leh michratz charitz
Etiveh lo haya ketavo shokea ella bolet kedinre zahav vei salka datach michratz charitz
b: Ha baena michtav veleka kedinre zahav velo kedinre zahav kedinre zahav devolet velo kedinre zahav deilu hatam miggavay vehacha meabbaray
Bea mineh rava merav nachman katav lah get al tas shel zahav veamar lah hitkabbeli gitich vehitkabbeli ketubbatich mahu amar leh nitkabbela gitah venitkabbela ketubbatah
Etiveh hitkabbeli gitich vehashshear lichtubbaticha nitkabbela gitah vehashshear lichtubbatah
Tama deika shear ha leka shear lo
Hu haddin af al gav deleka shear veha ka mashma lan deaf al gav deika shear i amar lah in i la la
May tama avera dimgilta hu
Tanu rabbanan hare ze gitich vehanneyar shelli enah megoreshet al menat shettachziri li et hanneyar hare zo megoreshet
Bae rav pappa ben shita leshita uven teva leteva may teku
Vetipok leh desefer echad amar rachamana velo shenayim ushlosha sefarim la tzericha dimore
Bae rame bar chama hau muchzakim beeved shehu shello veget katuv al yado vahare hu yotze mittachat yadah mahu
Mi amrinan aknoye akni lah o dilma hu minnafsheh ayel
Amar rava vetipok leh dichtav sheyyachol lehizdayyef hu ulrava kashya matnitin al hayyad shel eved
Bishlama matnitin lerava la kashya beede mesira verabbi elazar hi ella lerame bar chama kashya
Lerame bar chama name la kashya bichtovet kaaka hashta deatet lehachi matnitin lerava name la tikshe bichtovet kaaka
May have alah ta shema deamar resh lakish haggodrot en lahen chazaka
Bae rame bar chama hau muchzakin betavla shehi shellah veget katuv aleha vahare hi yotza mittachat yado mahu mi amrinan aknoye aknitah leh o dilma ishsha la yada leaknoye

Amar abbaye ta shema af hu heid al kefar katan shehaya betzad yerushalayim vehaya bo zaken echad vehaya malve lechol bene hakkefar vechotev bichtav yado vaacherim chotmim uva maase lifne chachamim vehichshiruhu veammay ha baena sefer mikna veleka
Ella lav mishshum deamrinan aknoye makne lehu
Amar rava umay kushya dilma

a: Zaken shane deyada leaknoye
Ella amar rava mehacha arev hayyotze leachar chitum shetarot gove minnechasim bene chorin
Amar rav ashe may kushya dilma gavra shane deyada leaknoye ella amar rav ashe mehacha ishsha kotevet et gitah vehaish kotev et shovaro sheen kiyyum hagget ella bechotmav
Amar rava katav lah get untano beyad avdo vechatav lah shetar mattana alav kenaathu umitgareshet bo
Veammay chatzer mehallechet hi vechatzer mehallechet lo kana vechi tema beomed vehaamar rava kol sheilu mehallech lo kana omed veoshev lo kana vehilcheta bechafut
Veamar rava katav lah get untano bachatzero vechatav lah shetar mattana alav kenaathu umitgareshet bo
Utzricha dei ashmeinan eved hava amena daveka eved aval chatzer ligzar mishshum chatzerah habbaa leachar mikkan
Vei ashmeinan chatzer hava amena daveka chatzer aval eved ligzar kafut attu sheeno kafut ka mashma lan
