Amar abbaye mikkede chatzer mehecha itrabbay miyyadah
Ma yadah deitah ben middatah uven beal kurchah af chatzerah deitah ben middatah uven beal kurchah veha mattana middatah itah beal kurchah letah
Matkef lah rav shimi bar ashe veha shelichut lekabbala demiddatah itah beal kurchah letah veka have shaliach likabbala
Veabbaye attu shelichut miyyadah itrabbay mivveshillach veshillechah itrabbay
Veibaet ema shelichut lekabbala name ashkechan beal kurchah shekken av mekabbel get levitto ketanna beal korchah
Al heale shel zayit vechu bishlama yad deeved
b: La efshar lemiktzeyah ella keren shel para liktzeyah velitvah lah
Amar kera vechatav venatan lah mi sheeno mechussar ella ketiva untina yatza ze shemchussar ketiva ketzitza untina

Rabbi yose haggelili omer vechu may tama derabbi yose haggelili detanya sefer en li ella sefer minnayin lerabbot kol davar talmud lomar vechatav lah mikkol makom im ken ma talmud lomar sefer ma sefer davar sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel af kol davar sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel
Verabbanan i ketiv besefer kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv sefer lisfirat devarim hu daata
Verabbanan hay vechatav may avdi leh mibe lehu bichtiva mitgareshet veenah mitgareshet bechesef salka datach amena akkesh yetzia lahavayah ma havaya bechesef af yetzia name bechesef ka mashma lan
Veidach nafka leh missefer keritut sefer kortah veen davar acher kortah
Veidach mibe leh davar hakkoret beno levenah kidtanya hare ze gitich al menat shello tishti yayin al menat shello telchi levet avich leolam en ze keritut ad sheloshim yom hare ze keritut
Veidach mikkaretkritut
Veidach karetkritut la darshi
Matni en kotvin bimchubbar lakkarka ketavo bimchubbar telasho vachatamo untano lah kasher rabbi yehuda posel ad shettehe ketivato vachatimato betalush
Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer en kotvin lo al hanneyar hammachuk velo al haddiftera mippene shehu yachol lehizdayyef vachachamim machshirin
Gema ketavo al hamchubbar vehaamratte resha en kotvin amar rav yehuda amar shemuel vehu sheshshiyyer mekom hattoref

Vechen amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya vehu sheshshiyyer mekom hattoref vechen amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan vehu sheshshiyyer mekom hattoref verabbi elazar hi deamar ede mesira karti
Vehachi kaamar en kotvin tofes shemma yichtov toref ketavo lattofes utlasho ketavo lattoref untano lah kasher
Veresh lakish amar chatmu shaninu verabbi meir hi deamar ede chatima karti
Vehachi kaamar en kotvin toref gezera shemma yachtom ketavo lattoref telasho chatamo untano lah kasher
Ketavo al cheres shel atzitz nakuv kasher deshakel leh veyahev leh nihalah al ale shel atzitz nakuv abbaye amar kasher verava amar pasul abbaye amar kasher

a: Deshakel leh veyahev leh nihalah rava amar pasul gezera shemma yiktom
Atzitz shel echad uzraim shel acher machar baal atzitz levaal zeraim kevan shemmashach kana machar baal zeraim levaal atzitz lo kana ad sheyyachzik bizraim
Atzitz uzraim shel echad umcharan leacher hechzik bizraim kana atzitz vezo hi sheshshaninu nechasim sheen lahem achraut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka
Hechzik beatzitz af atzitz lo kana ad sheyyachzik bizraim
Nikbo baaretz venofo bechutza laaretz abbaye amar batar nikbo azlinan rava amar batar nofo azlinan
Bidashrush kulle alma la feligi ki peligi bidla ashrush
Uvidashrush la peligi vehatnan shette ginot zo al gav zo veyarak bentayim rabbi meir omer shel elon rabbi yehuda omer shel tachton
Hatam kidkatane tama amar rabbi meir ma im yirtze elon litol et afaro en kan yarak
Amar rabbi yehuda ma im yirtze hattachton lemalloot et ginnato afar en kan yarak

Veakkatti bidashrush la peligi veha tanya ilan miktzato baaretz umiktzato bechutza laaretz tevel vechullin meoravin ze baze divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer haggadel bechiyyuv chayyav vehaggadel biftur patur
May lav miktzat nofo baaretz umiktzat nofo bechutza laaretz
Lo miktzat shorashin baaretz umiktzat shorashin bechutza laaretz umay tama derabban shimon ben gamliel demafsik tzunma
May tama derabbi dehadri orvi
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar avera mevalbel umar savar hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae
Rabbi yehuda ben betera omer ku amar rabbi chiyya bar assi mishshemeh deulla shelosha orot hen matztza chipa vediftera

Matztza kemashmao dela meliach udla kemiach udla afitz lemay hilcheta lehotzaat shabbat vechamma shiuro kidkatane rav shemuel bar yehuda kede latzur mishkal ketanna vechamma amar abbaye ki riva deriva defumbedita
Chipa dimliach vela kemiach vela afitz lemay hilcheta lehotzaat shabbat vechamma shiuro keditnan or kede laasot kamea
Diftera dimliach ukmiach vela afitz lemay hilcheta lehotzaat shabbat vechamma shiuro kede lichtov alav et hagget
Vachachamim machshirin man chachamim amar rabbi elazar
b: Rabbi elazar hi deamar ede mesira karti
Veamar rabbi elazar lo hichshir rabbi elazar ella lealtar aval mikkan ad asara yamim la chayeshinan dilma hava beh tenaa vezayyefteh
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu mikkan ad asara yamim deim ita dahava beh tenay midkar dechiri
Veamar rabbi elazar lo hichshir rabbi elazar ella begitin aval bishar shetarot la dichtiv untattam bichli chares lemaan yaamdu yamim rabbim
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu bishtarot vehachtiv lemaan yaamdu yamim rabbim hatam etza tova ka mashma lan
Matni hakkol kesherin lichtov et hagget afilu cheresh shote vekatan haishsha kotevet et gitah vehaish kotev et shovaro sheen kiyyum hagget ella bechotmav
Gema veha lav bene dea ninhu amar rav huna

a: Vehu shehaya gadol omed al gabbav
Amar leh rav nachman ella meatta goy veyisrael omed al gabbav hachi name dechasher vechi tema hachi name vehatanya goy pasul goy ledateh denafsheh aved
Hadar amar rav nachman lav milta hi daamari demiddeka pasel leh legoy leinyan havaa mikkelal dilinyan ketiva kasher
Vehatanya goy pasul hahi rabbi elazar hi deamar ede mesira karti uvaenan ketiva lishmah veha vadday goy addateh denafsheh kaaved
Amar rav nachman omer haya rabbi meir afilu metzao beashpa chatamo untano lah kasher
Etiveh rava lerav nachman vechatav lah lishmah may lav ketivat hagget lo chatimat edim
Etiveh rava kol get shennichtav shello leshum ishsha pasul ema shennechtam shello leshum ishsha pasul
Etiveh keshehu kotvo keilu kotvo lishmah may lav keshehu kotvo lattoref lishmah keilu kotvo lattofes lishmah
Lo keshehu chotmo lishmah keilu kotvo lishmah veibaet ema hane matnitin manni rabbi elazar hi deamar ede mesira karti
Verav yehuda amar shemuel vehu sheshshiyyer mekom hattoref vechen amar rabbi chagga mishshemeh deulla vehu sheshshiyyer mekom hattoref verabbi elazar hi
Verabbi zerika amar rabbi yochanan enah tora may enah tora amar rabbi abba kan hodiacha sheen koach lishmah verabbi meir hi deamar ede chatima karti
Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan rabbi elazar hi amorae ninhu vealliba derabbi yochanan
Matni hakkol kesherin lehavi et hagget chutz mecheresh shote vekatan vesome vegoy
Kibel hakkatan vehigdil cheresh venitpakkeach some venitpatteach shote venishtappa goy venitgayyer pasul
Aval pikkeach venitcharesh vechazar venitpakkeach patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa kasher ze hakkelal kol shettechilato vesofo bedaat kasher
Gema bishlama cheresh shote vekatan delav bene dea ninhu goy name delav bar hetera hu ella some ammay la amar rav sheshet lefi sheeno yodea mimmi notlo ulmi notno
Matkef lah rav yosef heach some muttar beishto heach bene adam muttarim binshotehem ballayela ella bitviut ena dekala hacha name bitviut ena dekala
Ella amar rav yosef hacha bechutza laaretz askinan devae lememar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam vela matze lememar
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta patuach venistamme dematze amar hachi name dechasher veha katane patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach kasher chazar venitpatteach in lo chazar venitpatteach lo

Hu haddin deaf al gav delo chazar venitpatteach veayede dekatane shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa tama dechazar venishtappa ha lo chazar venishtappa la tena name patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach
Amar rav ashe dayeka name dekatane ze hakkelal kol shettechilato vesofo bedaat kasher vela katane kol shettechilato vesofo bechashrut kasher shema minah
Beo mineh merabbi amme eved mahu sheyyease shaliach lekabbel get ishsha miyyad balah amar lehu middeka pasel leh legoy
b: Mikkelal deeved kasher amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan en haeved naase shaliach lekabbel get leishsha miyyad balah lefi sheeno betorat gitin vekiddushin
Matkef lah rabbi elazar tama bemilta deleteh ha bemilta deiteh kasher
Veha goy veha kuti deitanhu betorat teruma denafshayehu ditnan haggoy vehakkuti shettarmu mishshellahem terumatam teruma utnan goy shettaram shel yisrael afilu birshut en terumato teruma
May tama lav mishshum dichtiv attem gam attem ma attem yisrael af sheluchachem yisrael
Amri deve rabbi yannay lo ma attem bene berit af sheluchachem bene berit

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan en haeved naase shaliach lekabbel get ishsha miyyad balah lefi sheeno betorat gitin vekidushin veaf al pi sheshshaninu hare atte shifcha uveladech ben chorin im hayeta ubbara zachta lo
May im hayeta ubbara zachta lo ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan tarte amar nirim devarim shehaeved mekabbel get lachavero miyyad rabbo shel chavero aval lo miyyad rabbo shello
Veim lechashcha adam lomar zo halacha shenuya im hayeta ubbara zachta lo emor lo shene gedole haddor pershu et haddavar rabbi zera verabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak
Chad amar ha manni rabbi hi deamar hamshachrer chatzi avdo kana vechad amar may tama derabbi beha kasavar ubbar yerech immo hu venaasa kemi shehikna lah echad meevareha
Matni af hannashim sheenan neemanot lomar met balah neemanot lehavi et gitah chamotah uvat chamotah vetzaratah vivimtah uvat balah
Ma ben get lemita shehakketav mochiach haishsha atzmah mevia et gitah uvilvad shehi tzericha lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam
Gema vehatanya keshem sheen neemanot lomar met balah kach en neemanot lehavi gitah amar rav yosef la kashya kan baaretz kan bechutza laaretz
Baaretz delav addiburah didah ka samchinan mehemna bechutza laaretz deaddiburah didah ka samchinan la mehemna

Amar leh abbaye adderabba ipcha mistabbera baaretz dei ate baal mearar mashgechinan beh deika lememar lekilkula ka mikavvena la mehemna bechutza laaretz dei ate baal mearar la mashgechinan beh mehemna

Tanya keoteh deabbaye rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi akiva ishsha neemenet lehavi gitah mikkal vachomer uma nashim sheamru chachamim en neemanot lomar met balah neemanot lehavi gitah hi shenneemenet lomar met balah eno din shenneemenet lehavi gitah

a: Umimmakom shebbata ma lehallan tzerichot sheyyomru befanenu nichtav uvfanenu nechtam af hi tzericha shettomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane haishsha atzmah mevia gitah uvilvad shettehe tzericha lomar ku shema minah
Verav yosef resha vesefa bechutza laaretz metziata baaretz in resha vesefa bechutza laaretz metziata baaretz
Mimmay middekatane ma ben get lemita shehakketav mochiach vela katane shehakketav ufe mochiach
Haishsha atzmah mevia vechu ishsha mikki mate gitah leyadah igarasha lah amar rav huna beomer lo titgarshi bo ella bifne bet din peloni sof sof ki matya hatam igarasha
Ella amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika deamar lah ki matet hatam atnecheh aara veshikleh
I hachi hava leh teli gitich meal gabbe karka veamar rava teli gitich meal gabbe karka lo amar kelum
Ella deamar lah hevay shaliach leholacha ad dematyat hatam vechi matyat hatam hevay shaliach likabbala vekabbili atte gitich
Veha lo chazra shelichut etzel habbaal deamar lah hevay shaliach leholacha ad dematyat hatam vechi matyat hatam shavay shaliach likabbala
Hanicha leman deamar ishsha osa shaliach lekabbel gitah miyyad sheliach balah ella leman deamar en haishsha osa shaliach lekabbel gitah miyyad sheliach baalah may ika lememar
Tama may mishshum deika bizzaon devaal vehacha baal la kafed
Hanicha leman deamar mishshum bizzaon devaal ella leman deamar mishshum chatzerah habbaa leachar mikan may ika lememar
Deamar lah hevay shaliach leholacha ad dematyat hatam vechi matyat hatam shavay shaliach leholacha vekabbili atte gitich mineh
Veibaet ema deamar lah hevay shaliach leholacha ad dematyat hatam vechi matyat hatam emar kamme be dina befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam umshave be dina shaliach velitvuh nihalich
Hadaran alach hammevi get
Kol get shennichtav shello leshum ishsha pasul ketzad haya over bashshuk veshama kol sofrim makrin ish peloni megaresh et pelonit mimmakom peloni veamar ze shemi veze shem ishti pasul legaresh bo
Yater miken katav legaresh et ishto venimlach metzao ben iro veamar lo shemi keshimcha veshem ishti keshem ishtecha pasul legaresh bo
b: Yater miken hau lo shette nashim ushmotehen shaot katav legaresh et haggedola lo yegaresh bo et hakketanna
Yater miken amar lelavlar ketov leezo sheertze agaresh pasul legaresh bo
Gema katav legaresh et ishto venimlach vechu veella resha bemay
Amar rav pappa besofrin haasuyin lehitlammed askinan amar rav ashe dayeka name dekatane sofrin makrin vela katane sofrin korin shema minah
May yater miken tana deve rabbi yishmael lo ze shennichtav shello leshum gerushin ella af ze shennichtav leshum gerushin pasul
Velo ze shennichtav shello leshum gerushin dideh ella af ze shennichtav leshum gerushin dideh pasul velo ze shello nichtav leshum gerushin ha ella af ze shennichtav leshum gerushin ha pasul

May tama i ketav venatan sefer keritut beyadah hava amena lemaote hayeche kamma dela avid leshum keritut aval katav legaresh et ishto venimlach daavid leshum keritut ema kasher ketav rachamana vechatav
I ketav rachamana vechatav hava amena lemaote hay dela ihu ka chatev lah aval yesh lo shette nashim deihu ka chatev lah ema kasher ketav rachamana lah lishmah
Vesefa lema li ha ka mashma lan deen berera
Katav legaresh et haggedola lo yegaresh bo et hakketanna ketanna hu dela matze megaresh beh ha gedola matze megaresh beh
Amar rava zot omeret shene yosef ben shimon haddarin beir achat motziin shetar chov al acherim
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta resha dekatane shemi keshimcha pasul legaresh bo sheni hu dela matze megaresh beh ha rishon matze megaresh beh veha amrinan velo acher yachol lehotzi alehen shetar chov
Ella may it lach lememar beede mesira verabbi elazar hi
Hacha name beede mesira verabbi elazar hi
Amar rav kullan poslin bichhunna chutz min harishon ushmuel amar af rishon name posel
Veazda shemuel letameh deamar shemuel kol makom sheshshanu chachamim get pasul pasul ufosel chalitza pesula pesula ufosaltah min haachin
Bemareva amri mishshemeh derabbi elazar semol velayela pesulot ufoslot

a: Katan veanpilya pesulot veen poslot
Zeeri amar kullan en poslin chutz min haacharon
Vechen amar rav assi kullan en poslin chutz min haacharon verabbi yochanan amar af acharon name eno posel
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan haachin shechalku lakochot hen umachzirin ze laze bayyovel
Utzricha dei itmar beha beha kaamar rabbi yochanan deen berera mishshum devaenan lah lishmah aval hatam mecher hu deamar rachamana lihdar beovel aval yerushsha umattana la
Vei ashmeinan sade mishshum dilchumra i name kattechila aval hacha ema la tzericha
Bea mineh rav hoshaya merav yehuda amar lelavlar ketov leezo shettetze bappetach techila mahu amar leh tenetuha yater miken amar lelavlar ketov leezo sheertze agaresh pasul legaresh bo alma en berera
Etiveh haomer levanav hareni shochet et happesach al mi sheyyaale mikkem rishon lirushalayim kevan shennichnas rishon rosho verubbo zacha bechelko umzakke et echav immo
Amar leh hoshaya beri ma inyan pesachim etzel gitin ha ittemar alah amar rabbi yochanan kede lezarzan bemitzot

Dayeka name dekatane kevan shennichnas rishon rosho verubbo zacha bechelko umzakke et echav immo i amratte bishlama deamninhu meikara shappir ella i amratte dela amninhu leachar shechita mi kamitmenu vehatnan nimnin umoshchin yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet
Tanya name hachi maase vekadmu banot labbanim venimtzeu banot zerizot uvanim shefalim
Amar abbaye ka bae mineh tole bedaat acherim veka fashet leh tole bedaat atzmo vahadar motev leh tole bedaat acherim

Amar rava may kushya dilma deman deit leh berera la shena tole bedaat atzmo vela shena tole bedaat acherim it leh berera uman delet leh berera la shena tole bedaat atzmo vela shena tole bedaat acherim let leh berera
Amar leh rav mesharsheya lerava veha rabbi yehuda detole bedaat atzmo let leh berera vetole bedaat acherim it leh berera
Tole bedaat atzmo let leh berera detanya hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim omer shene luggin sheani atid lehafrish hare hen teruma asara maaser rishon tisha maaser sheni
b: Umechel veshote miyyad divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin
Tole bedaat acherim it leh berera ditnan ma hi beotan hayyamim
Rabbi yehuda omer hare hi keeshet ish lechol devareha ulchi mayet have gita
Amar leh rav mesharsheya lerava ha rabbi shimon detole bedaat atzmo let leh berera vetole bedaat acherim it leh berera

Tole bedaat atzmo let leh berera ha daamaran tole bedaat acherim it leh berera detanya hareni boalich al menat sheyyirtze abba af al pi shello ratza haav mekuddeshet rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon ratza haav mekuddeshet

a: Lo ratza haav enah mekuddeshet
Amar leh ben lerabbi yehuda ben lerabbi shimon la shena tole bedaat atzmo vela shena tole bedaat acherim it lehu berera
Vehatam kidkatane tama amru lo lerabbi meir i atta mode shemma yibbaka hannod venimtza ze shote tevalim lemafrea amar lahem lichsheyyibbaka
Matni hakkotev tofse gitin tzarich sheyyanniach mekom haish umkom haishsha umkom hazzeman
Shetare milva tzarich sheyyanniach mekom hammilva mekom hallove mekom hammaot mekom hazzeman
Shetare mikkach tzarich sheyyanniach mekom hallokeach umkom hammocher makom hammaot mekom hassade umkom hazzeman mippene hattakkana
Rabbi yehuda posel bechullan rabbi elazar machshir bechullan chutz miggite nashim shenneemar vechatav lah lishmah
Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel tzarich sheyyanniach af mekom hare atte mutteret lechol adam verabbi elazar hi deamar ede mesira karti uvaenan ketiva lishmah
Utzricha
Dei ashmeinan hach kammayeta behahi hu deika leokomah kerabbi elazar dekatane en kotvin vekatane kitvu
Aval sefa dekatane sheen kiyyum hagget ella bechotmav ema rabbi meir hi deamar ede chatima karti
Vei ashmeinan behahi hahi name ika leokomah kerabbi elazar aval ha ema middesefa rabbi elazar have resha lav rabbi elazar tzericha
Mippene hattakkana may takkana amar rabbi yonatan mippene takkanat sofer verabbi elazar hi deamar ede mesira karti uvdin hu daafilu tofes name la lichtov umishshum takkanat sofrim sharu rabbanan
Rabbi yehuda posel bechullan gazar tofes attu toref gazar shetarot attu gitin
Verabbi elazar machshir bechullan chutz miggite nashim tofes attu toref gazar shetarot attu gitin la gazar
Shenneemar vechatav lah veha ki ketiv lah attoref hu dichtiv
Ella ema mishshum shenneemar vechatav lah lishmah
b: Kashya derabbi elazar adderabbi elazar tere tannae vealliba derabbi elazar
Rabbi shabbetay amar chizkiyya mishshum ketata verabbi meir hi deamar ede chatima karti
Uvdin hu daafilu toref name lichtov vezimnin deshama leh lesofer deka chatev vesavra ihu kaamar leh vehave lah ketata bahadeh
Rav chisda amar avimi mishshum takkanat agunot amri lah rabbi meir veamri lah rabbi elazar
Amri lah rabbi meir deamar ede chatima karti uvdin hu daafilu toref name lichtov vezimnin dehave leh ketata bahadah veratach alah vezarek leh nihalah umaggen umotev lah
Amri lah rabbi elazar deamar ede mesira karti uvdin hu daafilu tofes name la lichtov vezimnin devae lemezal limdinat hayyam vela ashkach safra veshavek lah veazel umaggen umotev lah
Umkom hazzeman kafasek vetane la shena min hannisuin vela shena min haerusin
Bishlama min hannisuin ben leman deamar mishshum bat achoto ika ben leman deamar mishshum pere ika
Ella min haerusin bishlama leman deamar mishshum bat achoto ika ella leman deamar mishshum pere arusa mi it lah pere

Amar rav amram ha milta shemait mineh deulla deamar mishshum takkanat valad vela yadana may nihu kevan deshamitah leha detanya haomer kitvu get laarusati lichsheechnesenna agarshenna eno get veamar ulla ma taam gezera shemma yomru gitah kodem livnah hacha name gezera shemma yomru gitah kodem livnah
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi abba bar shela amar rav hamnuna sava amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav halacha kerabbi elazar kare rav aleh derabbi elazar tuvyana dechakkime

Vaafilu bishar shetarot name vehaamar rav pappi mishshemeh derava hay ashsharta dedayyane demikatva mikkamme delisahade sahadi achatimat yedayehu pesula alma michze keshikra hacha name michze keshikra

Veletah midderav nachman deamar rav nachman omer haya rabbi meir afilu metzao beashpa chatamo untano lah kasher vaafilu rabbanan la peligi aleh derabbi meir ella begite nashim devaenan ketiva lishmah aval bishar shetarot la
Deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan shetar shellava bo ufrao eno chozer velove bo shekkevar nimchal shibudo tama denimchal shibudo aval mishshum shikra la chayeshinan

a: Matni hammevi get veavad hemennu metzao lealtar kasher veim lav pasul metzao bachafisa o bidloskama im makkiro kasher
Gema urminhu matza gite nashim veshichrure avadim deyateke mattanot veshovarin hare ze lo yachazir sheani omer ketuvin hau venimlach alehen shello litnan ha amar tenu notnin vaafilu lizman merubbe
Amar rabba la kashya kan bimkom shehashshayyarot metzuot kan bimkom sheen hashshayyarot metzuot
Vaafilu bimkom shehashshayyarot metzuot vehu shehuchzeku shene yosef ben shimon beir achat
Dei la tema hachi kashya derabba adderabba dehahu gita deishtechach be dina derav huna vahava ketiv beh bishvire mata deal rachis nahara veamar rav huna choshshin lishne shevire
Vaamar leh rav chisda lerabba pok veayyen bah dilurta bae lah minach rav huna nefak dak veashkach ditnan kol maase bet din hare ze yachzir
Veha be dina derav huna dechimkom shehashshayyarot metzuot dame veka pashet yachzir alma i huchzeku shene yosef ben shimon beir achat in vei la la

Avad rabba ovada behahu gita deishtechach be chitana befumbedita kishmateh ika deamri beduchta hecha detaru kitana veaf al gav dehuchzeku dela shechichan sheyarata veika deamri beduchta dimzabbeni kitana vehu shello huchzeku ushchichan shayyarot

Rabbi zera rame matnitin abbarayeta umshanne tenan hammevi get veavad hemennu im metzao lealtar kasher veim lav pasul urminhu matza get ishsha bashshuk bizman shehabbaal mode yachzir leishsha en habbaal mode lo yachzir lo laze velo laze ha
b: Bizman shehabbaal mode mihat yachzir laishsha vaafilu lizman merubbe umshanne kan bimkom shehashshayyarot metzuot kan bimkom sheen hashshayyarot metzuot
Ika deamri vehu shehuchzeku hu dela lahdar vehayenu derabba veika deamri af al gav dela huchzeku la lahdar ufliga derabba
Bishlama derabba la amar kerabbi zera matnitin allima leh leakshoye ella rabbi zera may tama la amar kerabba
Amar lach mi katane im amar tenu notnin vaafilu lizman merubbe dilma im amar tenu notnin kidkayema lan lealtar
Rabbi yirmeya amar kegon dekaamri edim meolam lo chatamnu ella al get echad shel yosef ben shimon
I hachi may lememra mahu detema lechush dilma itremi shema kishma veedim keedim ka mashma lan
Rav ashe amar kegon dekaamar nekev yesh bo betzad ot pelonit dehave leh siman muvhak vedaveka betzad ot pelonit dehave leh siman muvhak aval nekev bealma la
Mesappeka leh simanin i deorayeta i derabbanan

Rabba bar bar chana irchas leh gita be midresha amar i simana it li begaveh i teviut ena it li begaveh ahderuh nihaleh amar la yadana i mishshum simana ahderuh vekasavri simanim deorayeta i mishshum teviut ena vedaveka tzurba midderabbanan aval inash bealma la

Veim lav pasul tanu rabbanan ezehu shello lealtar rabbi natan omer sheshshaha kede shettaavor sheyara vetishre rabbi shimon ben elazar omer kede sheyehe adam omed veroe shello avar sham adam veyesh omrim shello shaha adam sham rabbi omer kede lichtov et hagget rabbi yitzchak omer kede likroto acherim omrim kede lechotvo velikroto
Vaafilu shaha veyesh bo simanin meidim alav deamri nekev yesh bo betzad ot pelonit veen meidin al simane hagguf deamri aroch vegutz
Metzao kashur bechis bearnaki uvtabbaat

a: O shemmetzao ben kelav afilu lizman merubbe kasher
Itmar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha shello shaha adam sham rabba bar bar chana amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel halacha shello avar adam sham
Lema mar halacha kemar umar halacha kemar mishshum deafchi lehu
Metzao bachafisa o bidloskama may chafisa amar rabba bar bar chana chemet ketanna may deloskama telika desave
Matni hammevi get vehinnicho zaken o chole noten lah bechezkat shehu kayyam
Bat yisrael hannesua lechohen vehalach balah limdinat hayyam ochelet bitruma bechezkat shehu kayyam hashsholeach chattato mimmedinat hayyam makrivin otah bechezkat shehu kayyam
Gema amar rava lo shanu ella zaken shello higgia ligvurot vechole sherov cholim lechayyim aval zaken shehiggia ligvurot vegoses sherov gossin lemita la
Etiveh abbaye hammevi get vehinnicho zaken afilu ben mea shana noten lah bechezkat shehu kayyam teuvta
Vei baet ema kevan deiplig iplig
Rame leh abbaye lerabba tenan hammevi get vehinnicho zaken o chole noten lah bechezkat shehu kayyam urminhu hare ze gitich shaa achat kodem lemitato asura leechol bitruma miyyad
Amar leh teruma aggitin ka ramet teruma efshar get la efshar
Verame teruma atteruma tenan bat yisrael hannesua lechohen vehalach balah limdinat hayyam ochelet bitruma bechezkat shehu kayyam
Urminhu hare ze gitich shaa achat kodem mitato asura leechol bitruma miyyad
Amar rav adda bereh derav yitzchak shane hatam shehare asarah alav shaa achat kodem mitato matkef lah rav pappa mimmay deihu mayet beresha dilma ihi mayeta beresha
Ella amar abbaye la kashya ha rabbi meir dela chayesh lemita ha rabbi yehuda dechayesh lemita
Ditnan hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim omer shene luggin sheani atid lehafrish hare hen teruma asara maaser rishon tisha maaser sheni umechel veshote miyyad divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin
Rava amar
b: Shemma met la chayeshinan shemma yamut chayeshinan
Amar leh rav adda bar matna lerava veha nod dichshemma yamut hu ufligi amar rav yehuda middiskarta shane nod deefshar demasar leh leshomer
Matkef lah rav mesharsheya arvach arva tzerich ella amar rava shemma met la chayeshinan shemma yamut tannae hi
Hashsholeach chattato mimmedinat hayyam vechu veha baena semicha amar rav yosef bekorban nashim rav pappa amar bechattat haof
Utzricha dei ashmeinan get mishshum dela efshar aval teruma deefshar ema la
Vei ashmeinan teruma dezimnin dela efshar aval chattat haof missefeka la leul chullin laazara tzericha
Matni shelosha devarim amar rabbi elazar ben parta lifne chachamim vekiyemu et devarav al ir shehikkifah karkom veal hassefina hammutrefet bayyam veal hayyotze lidon shehen bechezkat kayyamin
Aval ir shekkevashah karkom usfina sheavda bayyam vehayyotze lehareg notnin alehen chumre chayyim vechumre metim bat yisrael lechohen uvat kohen leyisrael lo tochal bitruma
Gema amar rav yosef lo shanu ella bevet din shel yisrael aval bevet din shel ummot haolam kevan digmir leh dina liktala miktal katli leh
Amar leh abbaye bet din shel ummot haolam name dimkabbeli shuchda amar leh ki shakli mikkamme delachtom pursi shenamag levatar demichtam pursi shenamag la shakli
Metivi kol makom sheyyaamdu shenayim veyomru meidin anu et ish peloni shennigmar dino bevet dino shel peloni ufloni ufloni edav hare ze yehareg dilma boreach shane
Ta shema shema mibbet din shel yisrael shehau omrim ish peloni met ish peloni neherag yassiu et ishto mekomentarisin shel goyim ish peloni met ish peloni neherag al yassiu et ishto
May met umay neherag ilema met met mammash veneherag neherag mammash dichoteh gabbe goyim ammay al yassiu et ishto ha kayema lan dechol mesiach lefi tummo hemone mehemni leh
Ella lav met yotze lamut neherag yotze lehareg vekatane bevet din yisrael yassiu et ishto

Leolam met mammash veneherag mammash udkaamratte dichoteh gabbe goyim ammay la veha kayema lan dechol mesiach lefi tummo hemone mehemni hane mile bemilta dela shayechi bah aval bemilta deshayechi bah avdi leachzoke shikrayehu
Ika deamri amar rav yosef lo shanu ella bevet din shel ummot haolam

a: Aval bevet din shel yisrael kevan dinfak leh dina liktala katli leh
Amar leh abbaye bet din shel yisrael name efshar dechazu leh zechuta ki chazu leh zechuta mikkamme deligmar dina batar gemar dina tu la chazu leh zechuta
Lema mesayea leh kol makom sheyyaamdu shenayim veyomru meidim anu et ish peloni shennigmar dino bevet dino shel peloni ufloni ufloni edav hare ze yehareg dilma boreach shane
Ta shema shema mibbet din shel yisrael shehau omrim ish peloni met ish peloni neherag yassiu et ishto mikkomentarisim shel goyim ish peloni met ish peloni neherag al yassiu et ishto
May met umay neherag ilema met mammash veneherag mammash dichoteh gabbe goyim ammay al yassiu et ishto ha kayema lan kol mesiach lefi tummo hemone mehemni leh
Ella lav met yotze lamut veneherag yotze lehareg vekatane bevet din shel yisrael yassiu et ishto

Leolam met mammash veneherag mammash dichoteh gabbe goyim ammay la veha kayema lan dechol mesiach lefi tummo hemone mehemni hane mile bemilta dela shayechi bah aval bemilta deshayechi bah avdi leachzoke shikrayehu
Matni hammevi get beeretz yisrael vechala hare ze meshallecho beyad acher veim amar lo tol li hemenna chefetz peloni lo yeshallechennu beyad acher sheen retzono sheyehe pikdono beyad acher
Gema amar rav kahana chala tenan peshita chala katane mahu detema hu haddin af al gav dela chala vehay dekatane chala orcha demilta katane ka mashma lan
Hechi dame i daamar leh holech af al gav dela chala name vei daamar leh atte holech afilu chala name la vei rabban shimon ben gamliel afilu chala name la

Detanya holech get ze leishti hare ze meshallecho beyad acher atte holech get ze leishti hare ze lo yeshallechennu beyad acher rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ben kach uven kach en hashshaliach ose shaliach
Ibaet ema holech vehu dechala vei baet ema atte holech vechala shane vei baet ema rabban shimon ben gamliel hi vechala shane

Tenan hammevi get beeretz yisrael vechala hare ze meshallecho beyad acher urminhu amar lishnayim tenu get leishti o lishlosha kitvu get utnu leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu inhu in aval shaliach la
Amar abbaye hatam tama may mishshum bizzaon devaal hacha baal la kafed
Rava amar mishshum demile ninhu umile la mimasran leshaliach
May benayehu ika benayehu sheliach mattana uviflugta derav ushmuel rav amar mattana enah keget ushmuel amar mattana hare hi keget
Veim amar lo tol li hemenna chefetz peloni amar resh lakish kan shana rabbi en hashshoel rashshay lehashil veen hassocher rashshay lehaskir

Amar lo rabbi yochanan zo afilu tinokot shel bet rabban yodim otah ella zimnin degita name la have denaasa kemi sheamar lo al tegarshah ella babbayit vegershah baaliyya al tegarshah ella beyamin vegershah bismol
Dechulle alma hecha denafka leappeh veyahava leh chefetz vahadar shakla mineh gita kulle alma la peligi degita gita mealleya have ki peligi hecha daamar leh
b: Shekol minah chefetz vahadar hav lah gita vaazal ihu vihav lah gita vahadar shekal minah chefetz rabbi yochanan posel bo vechol shekken bishlucho veresh lakish machshir bishlucho vechol shekken bo

Matni hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam vechala ose shaliach bevet din umshallecho veomer lifnehem befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam veen shaliach acharon tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam ella omer sheliach bet din ani

Gema amaru leh rabbanan laavimi bereh derabbi avahu bae mineh merabbi avahu shaliach deshaliach meshave shaliach o la amar lehu ha la tibe lechu middekatane en hashshaliach haacharon michlal dimshave shaliach
Ella ki tibe lechu ki meshave shaliach bevet din o afilu shello bevet din amaru leh ha la mibbaya lan middekatane ella omer sheliach bet din ani
Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne hachi amaru leh rabbanan laavimi bereh derabbi avahu bei mineh merabbi avahu shaliach deshaliach ki meshave shaliach bevet din o shello bevet din

Amar lehu vetibe lechu i meshave shaliach bealma amaru leh ha la ka mibaya lan ditnan en hashshaliach haacharon mikkelal deshaliach meshave shaliach ella ki ka mibaya lan bevet din o shello bevet din amar lehu ha name la tibe lechu dekatane ella omer sheliach bet din ani
Amar rabba shaliach beeretz yisrael ose kamma sheluchin amar rav ashe im met rishon batlu kullan
Amar mar bar rav ashe ha deabba dekatnuta hi ilu met baal mide meshasha it behu kullehu mikkoach man kaatu mikkoach devaal kaatu iteh levaal itanhu lechullehu leteh levaal letanhu lechullehu

Hahu gavra deshaddar lah gita lidvethu amar shaliach la yadana lah amar leh zil yahaveh leabba bar minome deihu yada lah velezil velitveh nihalah ata vela ashkach leabba bar minome ashkecheh lerabbi avahu verabbi chanina bar pappa verabbi yitzchak nappacha veyatev rav safra gabbayehu amaru leh mesor milach kamme didan dechi yete abba bar minome nitvineh leh velezil velitvineh lah
Amar lehu rav safra veha sheliach shello nitan legerushin hu iksufu
Amar rava kappechinhu rav safra litlata rabbanan semiche amar rav ashe bemay kappechinhu mi kaamar leh abba bar minome vela atte
Ika deamri amar rava kappechinhu rav safra litlata rabbanan semiche betauta amar rav ashe may tauta may ka amar leh abba bar minome vela atte
Hahu gavra deshaddar lah gita lidvethu amar leh leshaliach la titveh nihalah ad telatin yomin ittenis bego telatin yomin

Ata lekammeh derava amar rava chala tama may mishshum daanis hay name ha anis anus hu amar leh mesor milach kamme didan dilvatar telatin yomin meshavenan shaliach veyahev leh nihalah amaru leh rabbanan lerava veha shaliach shello nitan legerushin hu amar lehu kevan dilvatar telatin yomin matze megaresh keshaliach shennitan legerushin hu
Velechush shemma piyyes mi la tenan meachshav im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh umet betoch shenem asar chodesh hare ze get
Vehavenan bah venechush shemma piyyes veamar rabba bar rav huna hachi amar abba mari mishshemeh derav beomer neemenet alay lomar shello bati
Iksif lesof igallay milta daarusa havay amar rava im amru binsua yomru baarusa
Amar rava ha vadday ka mibaya lan

a: Ki meshauu bet din shaliach befanav o shello befanav hadar pashtah ben befanav ben shello befanav shelachu mittam ben befanav ben shello befanav
Hahu daamar i la atena ad telatin yomin leheve gita ata ufaskeh mabbara amar lehu chazo daatay chazo daatay amar shemuel la shemeh matya
Hahu daamar lehu i la mefayyesna lah ad telatin yomin leheve gita azal payesah vela ipayyasa amar rav yosef mi yehav lah tarkabba dedinare vela ipayyasa
Ika deamri amar rav yosef mide tarkabba dedinare bae lemitav lah ha payesah vela ipayyasa
Ha keman deamar yesh ones begitin ha keman deamar en ones begitin
Matni hammalve maot et hakkohen veet hallevi veet heani lihot mafrish alehen mechelkan mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyamin veeno choshesh shemma met hakkohen o hallevi o heeshir heani
Metu tzarich litol reshut min hayyorshim im hilon bifne bet din eno tzarich litol reshut min hayyorshin
Gema veaf al gav dela atu lideh
Amar rav bemakkare kehunna ulviyya ushmuel amar bimzakke lahem al yede acherim ulla amar ha manni rabbi yose hi deamar asu et sheeno zoche kezoche
Kullehu kerav la amri bemakkare la katane kishmuel la kaamri bimzakke la katane keulla name la amri kichidaa la mokminan
Tanu rabbanan hammalve maot et hakkohen veet hallevi veet heani lihot mafrish alehen mechelkan mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyamin
Ufosek immahen keshaar hazzol veen bo mishshum ribbit veen sheviit meshammatto
Veim ba lachazor eno chozer nityaashu habbealim en mafrish alehem lefi sheen mafrishin al haavud
Amar mar posek immahem keshaar hazzol peshita ha ka mashma lan af al pi shello pasak kemi sheppasak dame
Veen bo mishshum ribbit may tama kevan dechi let leh la yahev leh ki it leh name en bo mishshum ribbit
Veen sheviit meshammatto dela karena beh lo yiggos
Veim ba lachzor eno chozer amar rav pappa lo shanu ella baal habbayit bechohen aval kohen bevaal habbayit im ba lachzor chozer ditnan natan lo maot velo mashach hemennu perot yachol lachzor bo
Nityaashu habbealim en mafrish alehen lefi sheen mafrishin al haavud peshita la tzericha daakun mahu detema akanta milta hi ka mashma lan

Tanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer hammalve maot et hakkohen veet hallevi bevet din vametu mafrish alehen bechezkat oto hashshevet veet heani bevet din vamet mafrish alav bechezkat aniyye yisrael rabbi achay omer bechezkat aniyye olam
May benayehu
b: Ika benayehu aniyye chutiyyim
Heeshir heani en mafrish alav vezacha halla bema shebbeyado
Verabbanan may shena lemita daavud takkanta umay shena laashirut dela avud takkanta mita shechicha ashirut la shechicha amar rav pappa hayenu deamri inashe chavrach mit ashshar itashshar la teashshar
Met tzarich litol reshut vechu tanya rabbi omer yorshin sheyyarshu umi ika yorshin dela yarti ella amar rabbi yochanan sheyyarshu karka velo sheyyarshu kesafim
Amar rabbi yonatan hinniach melo machat gove melo machat melo kardom gove melo kardom verabbi yochanan amar afilu hinniach melo machat gove melo kardom
Uchmaase dekattina deabbaye
Tanu rabbanan yisrael sheamar lelevi maaser yesh lecha beyadi en choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo kor maaser yesh lecha beyadi choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo

May kaamar amar abbaye hachi kaamar yisrael sheamar lelevi maaser yesh lecha beyadi vehelach damav en choshshin shemma asao terumat maaser al makom acher kor maaser yesh lecha beyadi vehelach damav choshshin shemma asao terumat maaser al makom acher
Attu berashshie askinan deshakli deme umshauu leh terumat maaser

Ella amar rav mesharsheya bereh derav idi hachi kaamar yisrael sheamar leven levi maaser leavich beyadi helach damav en choshshin shemma asao aviv terumat maaser al makom acher kor maaser leavich beyadi vehelach damav choshshin shemma asao aviv terumat maaser al makom acher
Vechi nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf

Ella amar rav ashe hachi kaamar ben yisrael sheamar lelevi kach amar li abba maaser lecha beyadi o maaser leavich beyadi choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo kevan dela kitz la hava metakken leh baal habbayit kor maaser lecha beyadi o kor maaser leavich beyadi en choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo kevan dekitz takkone takkeneh baal habbayit
Vechi yesh lo reshut levaal habbayit litrom terumat maaser in abba elazar ben gamla hi detanya abba elazar ben gamla omer venechshav lachem terumatchem

a: Bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber achat teruma gedola veachat terumat maaser keshem shetteruma gedola nitelet beomed uvmachshava kach terumat maaser nitelet beomed uvmachshava uchshem sheyyesh lo reshut levaal habbayit litrom teruma gedola kach yesh lo reshut levaal habbayit litrom terumat maaser
Matni hammanniach perot lihot mafrish alehen teruma umaasrot maot lihot mafrish alehen maaser sheni mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyamin im avdu hare ze choshesh meet leet divre rabbi elazar
Rabbi yehuda omer bishlosha perakim bodkin et hayyayin bekidum shel motzae hachag uvhotzaat semadar uvishat kenisat mayim bevoser
Gema may meet leet rabbi yochanan amar meet leet shel bedika rabbi elazar ben antignos omer mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi yannay
b: Meet leet shel hannacha
Tenan im avdu hare ze choshesh meet leet bishlama leman deamar meet leet shel bedika shappir
Ella leman deamar meet leet shel hannacha hay meet leet ad meet leet mibe leh kashya

Divre rabbi elazar amar rabbi elazar chalukin alav chaverav al rabbi elazar ditnan mikve shennimdad venimtza chaser kol teharot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim temeot
Peshita dachalukin mahu detema may lemafrea meet leet ka mashma lan
Rabbi yehuda omer bishlosha perakim ku tana bekidum shel motzae hachag shel tekufa

Tanya rabbi yehuda omer bishlosha perakim mochrin et hattevua lifne hazzera uvishat hazzera uvifros happesach uvishlosha perakim mochrin et hayyayin bifros happesach uvifros atzeret uvifros hachag veshemen meatzeret veelach lemay hilcheta amar rava veitema rav pappa leshuttafin mikkan veelach may amar rava kol yoma pirkeh hu
Vayehi kizroach hashshemesh vayeman elohim ruach kadim charishit may charishit amar rav yehuda beshaa shemmenashshevet ose telamim telamim bayyam

Amar leh rabba i hachi hayenu dichtiv vattach hashshemesh al rosh yona vayyitallaf ella amar rabba beshaa shemmenashshevet meshatteket kol haruchot mippaneha vehayenu dichtiv asher begadecha chammim behashkit eretz middarom amar rabbi tachlifa bar rav chisda amar rav chisda ematay begadecha chammim beshaa shehishkit eretz middarom shebbeshaa shemmenashshevet meshatteket kol haruchot mippaneha

Rav huna verav chisda hao yatvi chalef veazel geniva alayehu amar chad lechavreh nekum mikkammeh devar oryan hu amar leh idach mikkamme palgaa nekum addehachi ata ihu legabbayehu amar lehu bemay askitu amaru leh beruchot

Amar lehu hachi amar rav chanan bar rava amar rav arba ruchot menashshevot bechol yom veruach tzefonit menashshevet im kullan sheilmale ken en haolam mitkayyem afilu shaa achat veruach deromit kasha mikkullan veilmale ben netz maamidah machrevet kal haolam kullo mippaneha shenneemar hamibbinatcha yaaver netz yifros kenafav leteman

Rava verav nachman bar yitzchak hao yatvi hava chalef veazel rav nachman bar yaakov deyatev beguharka dedahava ufris aleh sarbala decharrate rava azal legabbeh rav nachman bar yitzchak la azal legabbeh amar dilma meinashe deve resh galuta ninhu rava tzarich lehu ana la tzerichna lehu

Kedachaza derav nachman bar yaakov hava azel legabbeh galli lidraeh amar shadya nashev amar rava hachi amar rav ishsha mappelet bo ushmuel amar afilu margalit shebbayyam markevet bo rabbi yochanan amar afilu shichvat zera shebbime ishsha masrachat bo

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ushloshtan mikra echad darshu ki hu ben achim yafri yavo kadim ruach Adonai mimmidbar ole veyevosh mekoro vego yevosh mekoro zo mekorah shel ishsha veyecherav mayano ze shichvat zera shebbime ishsha hu yishse otzar kol keli chemda zo margalit shebbayyam
Amar rava ade suraa hu dedayeki kerae may ki hu ben achim yafri amar rava afilu

a: Shufta bekofina demara rafya rav yosef amar afilu sikta bedafna rafya rav acha bar yaakov amar afilu kanya bechufta rafya
Hadaran alach kol get

Hashsholeach get leishto vehiggia bashshaliach o sheshshalach acharav shaliach veamar lo get shennatatti lecha batel hu hare ze batel kidem etzel ishto o sheshshalach etzlah shaliach veamar lah get sheshshalachti lich batel hu hare ze batel im mishshehiggia get leyadah shuv eno yachol levattelo
Barishona haya ose bet din mimmakom acher umvattelo hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken shello yehu osin ken mippene tikun haolam
Gema higgio la katane ella higgia vaafilu mimmela vela amrinan letzaorah hu deka mikaven
O sheshshalach acharav shaliach lema li mahu detema la allima shelichuteh devatra mishshelichuteh dekamma dilvatteleh ka mashma lan
Kadam hu etzel ishto lema li mahu detema ki la amrinan letzaorah ka mikaven hane mile leshaliach aval ledidah vadday letzaorah ka mikaven ka mashma lan
O sheshshalach etzlah shaliach lema li mahu detema ihu hu dela tarach addata letzaorah aval shaliach dela ichpat leh ki tarach vadday letzaorah ka mikaven ka mashma lan
Im mishshehiggia get leyadah eno yachol levattelo peshita la tzericha demahdar aleh meikara levattole mahu detema igallay milleta lemafrea devattole batteleh ka mashma lan
Tanu rabbanan batel hu i efshi bo devarav kayyamin pasul hu eno get lo amar kelum

Lememra devatel lishana delibbetil mashma vehaamar rabba bar ayevu amar rav sheshet veamri lah amar rabba bar avuh mekabbel mattana sheamar leachar shebbata mattana leyado mattana zo mevuttelet tibattel i efshi bah lo amar kelum betela hi enah mattana devarav kayyamin alma batel meikara mashma
Amar abbaye batel
b: Shette leshonot mashma mashma devatel umashma delibtil gabbe get lishana demahane beh kaamar gabbe mattana lishana demahane bah kaamar
Amar abbaye nekitinan sheliach mattana hare hu kishliach hagget nafka minah leholech lav kizchi dame
Ravina ashkecheh lerav nachman bar yitzchak ditle vekae beivra dedashsha veka mibaya leh batel mahu teku
Amar rav sheshet veamri lah bematnita tana get ze lo yoil lo yattir lo yaaziv lo yeshallach lo yegaresh yehe cheres yehe kecheres devarav kayyamin
Eno moil eno mattir eno maaziv eno meshalleach eno megaresh cheres hu kecheres hu lo amar kelum
Ibaya lehu hare hu cheres mahu amar leh ravina lerav acha bereh derava veamri lah rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe may shena mehare hu hekdesh hare hu hefker
Chozer umgaresh bo o eno chozer umgaresh bo rav nachman amar chozer umgaresh bo verav sheshet amar eno chozer umgaresh bo vehilcheta keoteh derav nachman
Ini veha kayema lan hilcheta keoteh derabbi yochanan deamar chozeret
Hachi hashta hatam dibur vedibur hu ate dibur umvattel dibur vehacha nehi devatteleh lishlichuta deshaliach gita gufeh mi ka vatel
Barishona haya ose itmar bifne kamma hu mevattelo rav nachman amar bifne shenayim rav sheshet amar bifne shelosha
Rav sheshet amar bifne shelosha bet din katane verav nachman amar bifne shenayim leve tere name bet din kare lehu amar rav nachman mena amena lah ditnan mosrani lifnechem

a: Peloni ufloni haddayyanin shebbemakom peloni
Verav sheshet attu tanna ki rochla lichshov velezil
Amar rav nachman mena amena lah ditnan haddayyanim chotmin lematta o haedim may lav dayyanim dumya deedim ma edim shenayim af dayyanim name shenayim verav sheshet mide irya ha kidita veha kidita
Lema li lemitne dayyanim lema li lemitne edim ha ka mashma lan dela shena katuv bilshon dayyanim vechatmi edim vela shena katuv bilshon edim vechatmi dayyanim
Mippene tikun haolam may mippene tikun haolam rabbi yochanan amar mippene takkanat mamzerim resh lakish amar mippene takkanat agunot
Rabbi yochanan amar mippene takkanat mamzerim savar lah kerav nachman deamar bifne shenayim uve tere let lehu kala vehi la shama vela yada veazla uminasva veika mamzerim
Veresh lakish amar mippene takkanat agunot savar lah kerav sheshet deamar bifne shelosha uve telata it lehu kala veshama veyada vela minasva vetakkanat agunot hu deika
Tanu rabbanan bittelo mevuttal divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer eno yachol lo levattelo velo lehosif al tenao sheim ken ma koach bet din yafe
Umi ika mide demiddeorayeta batel gita umishshum ma koach bet din yafe sharenan eshet ish lealma in kol dimkaddesh addata derabbanan mekaddesh veafkeinhu rabbanan lekidushin mineh
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe tinach dekaddesh bechaspa kaddesh bevia may ika lememar shavveuha rabbanan livilato beilat zenut
Tanu rabbanan amar laasara kitvu get leishti yachol levattel ze shello bifne ze divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer eno yachol levattel ella ze bifne ze
Bemay kamipalgi beedut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah kamipalgi rabbi savar edut shebbatla miktzatah
b: Lo batla kullah vei azli hanach katvi veyahavi lichtevu velitvu
Rabban shimon ben gamliel savar edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah vehanach la yadi veazli vechatvi veyahavi vesharu eshet ish lealma
Veibaet ema dechulle alma edut shebbatla miktzatah lo batla kullah vehacha hayenu tama derabban shimon ben gamliel kasavar milleta demitavda beappe asra tzericha be asra lemishlefah
Ibaya lehu kullechem mahu tama derabban shimon ben gamliel mishshum dekasavar edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah vehane kevan daamar lehu kullechem la matzu katvi veyahavi
O dilma tama derabban shimon ben gamliel mishshum dekasavar kol milleta demitavda beappe be asra tzericha be asra lemishlefah vehilkach afilu kullechem name
Ta shema amar lishnayim tenu get leishti yachol levattel ze shello bifne ze divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer eno yachol levattel ella ze bifne ze veha shenayim dechi chullechem damu ufligi
Amar rav ashe i beede chetiva hachi name hacha bemay askinan beede holacha

Hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa amar laze bifne atzmo velaze bifne atzmo yachol levattel ze shello bifne ze i amratte bishlama beede holacha shappir ella i amratte beede chetiva mi mitztarfi ha amar mar en edutan mitztarefet ad sheyyiru shenehem keechad dilma kerabbi yehoshua ben karcha sevira leh
Amar rav shemuel bar yehuda shemait mineh derabbi abba tarte chada kerabbi vachada kerabban shimon ben gamliel vela yadana he kerabbi vehe kerabban shimon ben gamliel

Amar rav yosef nichze anan dechi ata rav dimi amar maase veasa rabbi kedivre chachamim amar lefanav rabbi parta beno shel rabbi elazar ben parta ben beno shel rabbi parta haggadol im ken ma koach bet din yafe vechazar rabbi veasa kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Umiddeha kerabban shimon ben gamliel hach kerabbi

Veaf rabbi yoshiyya demin usha savar chada kerabbi vachada kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar rabba bar bar chana chamsha save havenan kammeh derabbi yoshiyya demin usha ata hahu gavra kammeh veashkeleh gita al kurcheh amar lan zilu ittammuru uchtuvu lah
Vei salka datach kerabbi ki mitammeri may have ella shema minah kerabban shimon ben gamliel sevira leh
Vei salka datach idach name kerabban shimon ben gamliel lema lehu ittammore libadderu ibaddore ella shema minah chada kerabbi vachada kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Verava amar rav nachman halacha kerabbi bishtehen velet leh lerav nachman ma koach bet din yafe vehaamar rav nachman amar shemuel

a: Yetomin shebbau lachalok benichse avihen bet din maamidin lahen appotroppos uvorrim lahen chelek yafe higdilu yecholin lemachot verav nachman dideh amar higdilu en yecholin lemachot deim ken ma koach bet din yafe
Hatam mamona hacha isura

Gidul bar reilay shaddar lah gita lidvethu azal shelicha ashkechah dahava yatva venavela amar lah he gitich amara leh zil hashta miha veta limchar azal legabbeh vaamar leh petach vaamar baruch hattov vehammetiv
Abbaye amar baruch hattov vehammetiv vela batel gita rava amar baruch hattov vehammetiv uvatel gita
Bemay kamipalgi begilluy data begita kamipalgi deabbaye savar gilluy data begita lav milleta hi verava savar gilluy data begita milta hi
Amar rava mena amena lah derav sheshet ashkeleh gita lehahu gavra beal kurcheh vaamar lehu lesahadi hachi amar lechu rav sheshet levattel gita veatzrecheh rav sheshet gita acharina
Veabbaye attu rav sheshet mevattel gita deinashe hava ihu battelah vehay dekaamar lehu hachi mishshum dafnoye

Veamar abbaye mena amena lah derav yehuda ashkeleh gita lechatneh derabbi yirmeya biraa uvatteleh tena ashkeleh uvatteleh hadar tena veashkeleh al kurcheh vaamar lehu lesahadi otivu kare beunnayechu uchtuvu leh vei salka datach gilluy data begita milta hi ha chazu leh deka rahet batrayehu
Verava hay deka rahet batrayehu deamar lehu ashshur havu lah hayya ki hecha demishlam tzaara dehahu gavra
Veamar abbaye mena amena lah dehahu daamar lehu i la atena ad telatin yomin leheve gita ata ufaskeh mabbara amar lehu chazo daatay chazo daatay vaamar shemuel la shemeh matya
Verava attu hatam levattole gita bae hatam lekayyome tenaeh ka vae veha la ikayyam tenaeh
Hahu daamar lehu i la nasevna ad telatin yomin leheve gita ki meto telatin yomin amar lehu ha tarachna
Lemay nechush lah i mishshum unsa en ones begitin i mishshum galloye data begita pelugta deabbaye verava hu

Hahu daamar lehu i la nasevna leresh yarcha daadar leheve gita ki meta resh yarcha daadar amar lehu ana leresh yarcha denisan amari lemay nechush lah i mishshum ones en ones begitin i mishshum galloye data pelugta deabbaye verava
Vehilcheta kenachman vehilcheta kenachman
b: Vehilcheta kenachmani

Matni barishona haya meshanne shemo ushmah shem iro veshem irah hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken sheyehe kotev ish peloni vechol shum sheyyesh lo ishsha pelonit vechol shum sheyyesh lah mippene tikun haolam

Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shelachu leh bene medinat hayyam lerabban gamliel bene adam habbaim mishsham lechan shemo yosef vekorin lo yochanan yochanan vekorin lo yosef heach megarshin neshotehen amad rabban gamliel vehitkin sheyehu kotvin ish peloni vechol shum sheyyesh lo ishsha pelonit vechol shum sheyyesh lah mippene tikun haolam amar rav ashe vehu deittachzak bitre sheme amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe rabbi mari verabbi elazar kayemi keotach

Tanya keoteh derav ashe hau lo shette nashim achat bihuda veachat baggalil velo shene shemot echad bihuda veechad baggalil vegerash et ishto shebbihuda bishmo shebbihuda veet ishto shebbaggalil bishmo shebbaggalil enah megoreshet ad sheyegaresh et ishto shebbihuda bishmo shebbihuda veshem degalil immo veet ishto shebbaggalil bishmo shebbaggalil veshem dihuda immo yatza lemakom acher vegerash beechad mehen megoreshet
Vehaamratte shem degalil immo ella shema minah ha deittachzak ha dela ettachzak shema minah
Hahi dahao karu lah miryam ufurta sara amri nehardae miryam vechol shum sheyyesh lah vela sara vechol shum sheyyesh lah
Matni en almana nifraat minnichse yetomim ella bishvua nimneu millehashbiah hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken shettehe noderet layetomim kol ma sheyyirtzu vegova ketubbatah
Haedim chotmin al hagget mippene tikun haolam vehillel hitkin perozbul mippene tikun haolam
Gema may irya almana afilu kulle alma name deha kayema lan habba lipara minnichse yetomin lo yippara ella bishvua almana itztericha leh salka datach amena

a: Mishshum china akkilu rabbanan gabbah ka mashma lan

Nimneu millehashbiah may tama ilema mishshum derav kahana deamar rav kahana veamri lah amar rav yehuda amar rav maase beadam echad bishne vatztzoret shehifkid dinar zahav etzel almana vehinnichattu bechad shel kemach vaafaattu befat untanattu leani

Leyamim ba baal haddinar vaamar lah havi li dinari amra leh yehanne sam hammavet beechad mibbaneha shel otah ishsha im neheneti middinarcha kelum amru lo hau yamim muatin ad shemmet echad mibbaneha uchsheshshamu chachamim baddavar amru ma mi shennishba beemet kach hannishba al sheker al achat kamma vechamma
May tama ianasha deishtarash lah mekom dinar
Umay mi shennishba beemet kemi shennishba beemet
I mishshum ha may irya almana afilu gerusha name allema amar rabbi zera amar shemuel lo shanu ella almana aval gerusha mashbiin otah
Almana shane divhahi hanaa deka tarcha kamme deyatme atya leoroye hetera
Amar rav yehuda amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu lo shanu ella bevet din aval chutz levet din mashbiin otah ini veha rav la magbe ketubba learmalta kashya
Besura matnu hachi binhardea matnu hachi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella bevet din aval chutz levet din mashbiin otah verav amar afilu chutz levet din name en mashbiin otah
Rav letameh derav la magbe ketubba learmalta veliadderah velagbeyah bishne derav kili nidre

Hahi daatay lekammeh derav huna amar lah ma eeved lich derav la magbe ketubba learmalta amara leh mide hu tama ella dilma naketna mide mikketubbati chay Adonai tzevaot im neheneti mikketubbati kelum amar rav huna mode rav bekofetzet
Hahi daatay lekammeh derabba bar rav huna amar lah may eeved lich derav la magbe ketubba learmalta veabba mari la magbe ketubba learmalta
Amara leh hav li mezone amar lah mezone name let lich deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel hattovaat ketubbatah bevet din en lah mezonot
Amara leh afchuh lechurseyeh keve tere avdatte li hafchuh lechurseyeh vetartzuh vaafilu hachi la iprak mechulsha
Amar leh rav yehuda lerav yirmeya biraa adderah bevet din veashbeah chutz levet din velete kala velipol beudni devaena ki hechi deeeved bah maase
Gufa amar rabbi zera amar shemuel lo shanu ella almana aval gerusha mashbiin otah

Ugrusha deadderah la veha shelachu mittam ech pelonita bat peloni kabbilat gita min yeda deacha bar hidya demitkere ayya mari undarat vaasarat perot shebbaolam alah dela kabbilat mikketubbetah ella gelufkera echad vesefer tehillim echad vesefer iyyov umimshalot beloim
b: Veshamnum bachamishsha mane lichshettavo leyedchem hagbuha et hashshear amar rav ashe hahu get yevamin hava
Hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken shettehe noderet ku amar rav huna lo shanu ella beshello niset aval niset en maddirin otah
Niset may tama demefar lah baal ki lo niset name lechi minnasva mefar lah baal en habbaal mefer bekodmin
Venechush dilma azla legabbe chacham veshare lah kasavar tzarich lefaret et hanneder
Rav nachman amar afilu niset niset vadday mefar lah baal demadderinan lah barabbim
Metivi niset gova ketubbatah im nadra may lav nadra hashta la dindara meikara
Vehatanya niset noderet vegova ketubbatah tannae hi deika leman deamar neder shehuddar barabbim yesh lo hafara veika leman deamar en lo hafara
Ibaya lehu tzarich lefaret et hanneder o eno tzarich rav nachman amar eno tzarich rav pappa amar tzarich
Rav nachman amar eno tzarich dei amratte tzarich zimnin degayez leh ledibureh vechacham may deshama mefar
Rav pappa amar tzarich mishshum milta deisura
Tenan hannose nashim baavera pasul ad sheyyiddor hanaa vetane alah noder veoved yored umgaresh vei amratte eno tzarich lefaret et hanneder lechush dilma azel legabbe chacham veshare leh

a: Demadderinan leh berabbim hanicha leman deamar neder shehuddar berabbim en lo hafara ella leman deamar yesh lo hafara may ika lememar
Demadderinan leh al daat rabbim deamar ammemar hilcheta afilu leman deamar neder shehuddar berabbim yesh lo hafara al daat rabbim en lo hafara
Vehane mile lidvar harshut aval lidvar mitzva yesh lo hafara ki hahu makre dardeke deaddereh rav acha al daat rabbim dahava pasha beyanoke veahdereh ravina dela ishtechach dedayek keoteh
Vehaedim chotmin al hagget mippene tikun haolam mippene tikun haolam deorayeta hu dichtiv vechatov bassefer vechatom
Amar rabba la tzericha lerabbi elazar deamar ede mesira karti takkinu rabbanan ede chatima mippene tikun haolam dezimnin demayeti sahadi i name zimnin deazli limdinat hayyam
Rav yosef amar afilu tema lerabbi meir hitkinu sheyehe edim mefarshin shemotehen begitin mippene tikun haolam
Kidtanya barishona haya kotev ani peloni chatamti ed im ketav yado yotze mimmakom acher kasher veim lav pasul
Amar rabban gamliel takkana gedola hitkinu sheyyihu mefarshin shemotehen begitin mippene tikun haolam
Uvsimana la veha rav tzayer kevara verabbi chanina tzayer charuta rav chisda samech verav hoshaya ayin rabba bar rav huna tzayer machuta shane rabbanan divkiin simanayehu
Meikara bemay afkeinhu bediske

Hillel hitkin perosbul vechu tenan hatam perosbul eno meshammet ze echad min haddevarim shehitkin hillel hazzaken sheraa et haam shennimneu millehalot ze et ze veavru al ma shekkatuv battora hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha veliyyaal vego amad vehitkin perosbul
Veze hu gufo shel perosbul mosrani lachem peloni ufloni dayyanin shebbemakom peloni shekkol chov sheyyesh li etzel peloni sheegbennu kol zeman sheertze vehaddayyanim chotmim lematta o haedim
Umi ika mide demiddeorayeta meshammeta sheviit vehitkin hillel dela meshammeta amar abbaye bashsheviit bizman hazze verabbi hi

Detanya rabbi omer veze devar hashshemita shamot bishte shemitot hakkatuv medabber achat shemitat karka veachat shemitat kesafim bizman sheatta meshammet karka atta meshammet kesafim bizman shei atta meshammet karka i atta meshammet kesafim
b: Vetakkinu rabbanan ditshammet zecher lashsheviit raa hillel shennimneu haam millehalot ze et ze amad vehitkin perosbul
Umi ika mide demiddeorayeta la meshammeta sheviit vetakkinu rabbanan ditshammet

Amar abbaye shev veal taase hu rava amar hefker bet din hefker deamar rabbi yitzchak minnayin shehefker bet din hefker shenneemar vechol asher lo yavo lishloshet hayyamim kaatzat hassarim vehazzekenim yochoram kol rechusho vehu yibbadel mikkehal haggola

Rabbi eliezer amar mehacha elle hannechalot asher nichalu elazar hakkohen vihoshua bin nun verashe haavot vego vechi ma inyan rashim etzel avot lomar lach ma avot manchilin et benehem kol ma sheyyirtzu af rashim manchilin haam kol ma sheyyirtzu
Ibaya lehu ki hitkin hillel perosbul ledareh hu detakken o dilma ledare alma name takken

Lemay nafka minah levattoleh i amratte ledareh hu detakken mevattelinan leh ella i amratte ledare alma name takken ha en bet din yachol levattel divre bet din chavero ella im ken gadol hemennu bechochma uvminyan may
Ta shema deamar shemuel la katvinan perosbul ella i beve dina desura i beve dina dinhardea vei salka datach ledare alma name takken bishar be dina name lichtevu
Dilma ki takken hillel ledare alma kegon be dina dideh uchrav amme verav assi deallime leafkoe mamona aval lechulle alma la

Ta shema deamar shemuel ha perosbula ulbana dedayyane hu i ayashar chayil avattelineh avattelineh veha en bet din yachol levattel divre bet din chavero ella im ken gadol hemennu bechachma uvminyan hachi kaamar im ayasher chayil yoter mehillel avattelineh
Verav nachman amar akayeminneh akayeminneh ha mikayyam vekae hachi kaamar ema beh milta deaf al gav delo katuv kechatuv dame
Ibaya lehu hay ulbana lishana dechutzpa hu o lishana denichuta hu ta shema deamar ulla aluva kalla shezzinta bekerev chuppatah
Amar rav mari berah devat shemuel may kera ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi natan recho amar rava adayin chabbivuta hu gabban dichtiv natan vela ketiv hisriach
Tanu rabbanan hanneelavin veenan olvim shomin cherpatan veen meshivin osin meahava usmechin beyissurin alehen hakkatuv omer veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato
May perosbul amar rav chisda peros bule uvute

a: Bule ellu ashirim dichtiv veshavarti et geon uzzechem vetane rav yosef ellu bulaot shebbihuda bute ellu haaniyyim dichtiv haavet taavitennu amar leh rava lelaoza may perosbul amar leh pursa demilta
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel yetomin en tzerichin perosbul vechen tane rame bar chama yetomin en tzerichin perosbul derabban gamliel uvet dino avihen shel yetomin

Tenan hatam en kotvin perosbul ella al hakkarka im en lo mezakkehu betoch sadehu kol shehu vechamma kol shehu amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav afilu kelach shel keruv amar rav yehuda afilu hishilo makom letannur ulchirayim kotvin alav perosbul
Ini vehatane hillel en kotvin perosbul ella al atzitz nakuv bilvad nakuv in sheeno nakuv la
Ammay veha ika mekomo la tzericha demannach assike

Rav ashe makne leh gidma dedikla uchtav aleh perosbul rabbanan deve rav ashe masri milayehu lahadade rabbi yonatan mesar mile lerabbi chiyya bar abba amar leh tzerichna mide acharina amar leh la tzerichatte
Tanu rabbanan en lo karka velearev yesh lo karka kotvin alav perosbul lo velearev en lahen karka velachayyav lo yesh lo karka kotvin alav perosbul midderabbi natan
Detanya rabbi natan omer minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane vachavero bachavero minnayin shemmotziin mizze venotnin laze talmud lomar venatan laasher asham lo

Tenan hatam hashsheviit meshammetet et hammilva ben bishtar ben shello bishtar rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu bishtar shetar sheyyesh bo achraut nechasim shello bishtar sheen bo achraut nechasim kol shekken milve al pe
Rabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish deamri tarvayehu bishtar shetar sheen bo achraut nechasim shello bishtar milve al pe aval shetar sheyyesh bo achraut nechasim eno meshammet

Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish shetar chov meshammet veim yesh bo achraut nechasim eno meshammet tanya idach siyyem lo sade achat behaloato eno meshammet velo od ella afilu katav kol nechasay achrain vearvain lach eno meshammet

Kariveh derabbi assi hava leh hahu shetara dahava ketiv beh achraut nechasim ata lekammeh derabbi assi amar leh meshammet o eno meshammet amar leh eno meshammet shavkeh vaata lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh meshammet

Ata rabbi assi lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh meshammet o eno meshammet amar leh meshammet veha mar hu deamar eno meshammet amar leh vechi mippene sheanu medammin naase maase amar leh vehatanya keoteh demar amar leh dilma hahi bet shammay hi deamri shetar haomed ligbot kegavuy dame
Tenan hatam hammalve et chavero maot al hammashkon vehammoser shetarotav levet din en meshammetin bishlama moser shetarotav levet din detafsi lehu be dina ella malve al hammashkon may tama
Amar rava mishshum detafes leh amar leh abbaye ella meatta hilvahu vedar bachatzero detafes leh hachi name dela meshammet

Amar leh shane mashkon dekane leh midderabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak minnayin levaal chov shekkone mashkon shenneemar ulcha tihye tzedaka im eno kone tzedaka minnayin mikkan levaal chov shekkone mashkon
Tenan hatam
b: Hammachazir chov lachavero bashsheviit tzarich sheyyomar lo meshammet ani veim amar lo af al pi chen yekabbel hemennu shenneemar veze devar hashshemitta
Amar rabba vetale leh ad deamar hachi etiveh abbaye keshehu noten lo al yomar lo bechovi ani noten lach ella yomar lo shelli hen uvmattana ani noten lach amar leh tale leh name ad deamar hachi

Abba bar marta dehu abba bar minome hava massek beh rabba zuze ayetinhu nihaleh bishviit amar leh meshammet ani shaklinhu vaazal ata abbaye ashkecheh dahava atziv amar leh ammay atziv mar amar leh hachi hava maase

Azal legabbeh amar leh amtet leh zuze lemar amar leh in amar leh umay amar lach amar leh meshammet ani amar leh vaamarte leh af al pi chen amar leh la amar leh vei amarte leh af al pi chen hava shaklinhu minach hashta mihat amtinhu nihaleh veema leh af al pi chen azal amtinhu nihaleh vaamar leh af al pi chen shaklinhu mineh amar la hava beh data behay tzurba merabbanan meikara
Amar rav yehuda amar rav nachman neeman adam lomar perosbul haya beyadi veavad mimmenni may tama kevan detakkinu rabbanan perosbul la shavek hetera veachel isura
Ki ato lekammeh derav amar leh mide perosbul haya lecha veavad kegon ze petach picha laillem hu
Tenan vechen baal chov shemmotzi shetar chov veen immo perosbul hare ellu lo yipparu
Tannae hi detanya hammotzi shetar chov tzarich sheyehe immo perosbul vachachamim omrim eno tzarich
Matni eved shennishba ufdauhu im leshum eved yishtabed im leshum ben chorin lo yishtabed rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ben kach uven kach yishtabed
Gema bemay askinan ilema lifne yeush leshum ben chorin ammay la yishtabed ella leachar yeush leshum eved ammay yishtabed

Amar abbaye leolam lifne yeush ulshum eved yishtabed lerabbo rishon leshum ben chorin lo yishtabed lo lerabbo rishon velo lerabbo sheni lerabbo sheni la deha leshum ben chorin parkeh lerabbo rishon name la dilma mimmani vela parki
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ben kach uven kach yishtabed kasavar keshem shemmitzva lifdot et bene chorin kach mitzva lifdot et haavadim

Rava amar leolam leachar yeush ulshum eved yishtabed lerabbo sheni leshum ben chorin lo yishtabed lo lerabbo rishon velo lerabbo sheni lerabbo sheni la deha leshum ben chorin parkeh lerabbo rishon name la deha leachar yeush hava

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ben kach uven kach yishtabed kidchizkiyya deamar chizkiyya mippene ma amru ben kach uven kach yishtabed shello yehe kol echad veechad holech umappil atzmo ligyasot umafkia atzmo miyyad rabbo
Metivi amar lahen rabban shimon ben gamliel keshem shemmitzva lifdot et bene chorin kach mitzva lifdot et haavadim bishlama leabbaye deamar lifne yeush hayenu dekaamar keshem
Ella lerava deamar leachar yeush hay keshem mishshum dechizkiyya hu
Amar lach rava rabban shimon ben gamliel la have yada may kaamri rabbanan vehachi kaamar lehu i lifne yeush kaamritu hayenu keshem i leachar yeush kaamritu kidchizkiyya
Ulrava deamar leachar yeush ulrabbo sheni rabbo sheni mimman kane leh mishshabbay shabbay gufeh mi kane leh
In kane leh lemaase yadav deamar resh lakish minnayin legoy shekkana et haggoy lemaase yadav shenneemar vegam mibbene hattoshavim haggarim immachem mehem tiknu attem konim mehem

a: Velo hem konim mikkem velo hem konim ze mizze yachol lo yiknu ze et ze yachol lo yiknu ze et ze haamratte lo hem konim ze mizze hachi kaamar velo hem konim ze mizze legufo
Yachol lo yiknu ze et ze lemaase yadav amarta kal vachomer goy yisrael kone goy goy lo kol shekken
Veema hane mile bechaspa aval bachazaka la amar rav pappa ammon umoav taharu besichon
Ashkechan goy goy goy yisrael menalan dichtiv vayyishbe mimmennu shevi
Amar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan eved shebbarach mibbet haasurim yatza lecherut velo od ella shekkofin et rabbo vechotev lo get shichrur

Tenan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ben kach uven kach yishtabed veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu halacha kemoto chutz mearev vetzayedan uraya acharona
Bishlama leabbaye moke lah lehay lifne yeush vehay leachar yeush
Ella lerava deamar leachar yeush kashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan
Amar lach rava tama may mishshum dechizkiyya boreach shane hashta liktala mesar nafsheh appole appel nafsheh ligyasot
Amteh demar shemuel ishtevay parkuha leshum amhuta veshadderuha leh shelachu leh anan kerabban shimon ben gamliel sevira lan atte i name kerabbanan sevira lach anan leshum amhuta parkinan lah nihalah
Veinhu sevur lifne yeush hava vela hi leachar yeush hava ushmuel la mibaya deishtabode la mishtabad bah ella gita decheruta name la atzrecha

Shemuel letameh deamar shemuel hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut veeno tzarich get shichrur shenneemar vechol eved ish miknat kasef eved ish velo eved ishsha ella eved sheyyesh lo reshut lerabbo alav karuy eved sheen lo reshut lerabbo alav en karuy eved
Amteh derabbi abba bar zutra ishtevay parkah hahu tarmodaa leshum itta shelachu leh ledideh i yaut avdatte shaddar lah gita decheruta
Hechi dame i dematzu parki lah lema li gita decheruta i dela matzu parki lah ki shaddar lah gita decheruta may have

Leolam dematzu parki lah vechevan dimshaddar lah gita decheruta chabbore michabberi ahadade ufarki lah veibaet ema leolam dela matzu parki lah vechevan dimshaddar lah gita decheruta mitazla beappeh umfarek lah
Vehaamar mar chaviva lahen behemtan shel yisrael yoter minneshotehen hane mile betzina aval befarhesya zila behu milta

Hahi amta dahavat befumbedita dahao ka meabbedi bah inashe isura amar abbaye i lav deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol hamshachrer avdo over baase hava kayefna leh lemarah vechatev lah gita decheruta ravina amar ki ha mode rav yehuda mishshum milta deisura
Veabbaye mishshum isura la haamar rav chanina bar rav kattina amar rabbi yitzchak maase beishsha achat shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin
b: Vechafu et rabbah vaasaah bat chorin veamar rav nachman bar yitzchak minhag hefker nahagu bah
Hachi hashta hatam la leeved chazya vela leven chorin chazya hacha efshar dimyached lah leavdeh umnattar lah
Gufa amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol hamshachrer avdo over baase shenneemar leolam bahem taavodu
Metivi maase berabbi eliezer shennichnas bevet hakkeneset velo matza asara veshichrer avdo vehishlimo laasara mitzva shane
Tanu rabbanan leolam bahem taavodu reshut divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer chova vedilma rabbi eliezer savar lah keman deamar reshut
La salka datach detanya behedya rabbi eliezer omer chova

Amar rabba behane telat mile nachati baale vattim minnichsehon demappeki avdayehu lecheruta udsayeri nichsayehu beshabbeta udkavi seudtayehu beshabbeta beidan be midresha deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan shette mishpachot hau birushalayim achat kava seuddatah beshabbat veachat kava seuddatah beerev shabbat ushtehen nekeru
Amar rabba amar rav hammakdish avdo yatza lecherut may tama gufeh la kaddish lidme la kaamar delehve am kadosh kaamar
Verav yosef amar rav hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut man deamar makdish kol shekken mafkir man deamar mafkir aval makdish la dilma lidme kaamar
Ibaya lehu tzarich get shichrur o lo tzarich ta shema deamar rav chiyya bar avin amar rav echad ze veechad ze yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur

Amar rabba umotvinan ashshematin hammakdish nechasav vehau bahen avadim en haggizbarin rashshain lehotzian lecherut aval mochrin otan laacherim vaacherim motziin otan lecherut rabbi omer omer ani af hu noten deme atzmo veotze mippene shehu kemochro lo matnita ka ramet aleh derav rav tanna hu ufaleg
Ta shema ach kol cherem vego meadam ellu avadav veshifchotav hakkenaanim hacha bemay askinan deamar lidme
I hachi idach name deamar lidme
I hachi en haggizbarim rashshain lehotzian lecherut gizbarim may avidtayehu

Vetu aval mochrin otan laacherim vaacherim motziin otan lecherut acherim may avidtayehu vetu rabbi omer omer ani af hu noten deme atzmo veotze mippene shehu kemochro lo vei lidme may mippene shehu kemochro lo
Ta shema hammakdish avdo ose veochel shello hikdish ella damav

a: Ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar en adam motzi devarav levattala
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa vechen hu shehikdish atzmo ose veochel shello hikdish ella damav i amratte bishlama rabbi meir hi shappir
Ella i amratte rabbanan hi bishlama avdo lidme kae ella ihu lidme kae
Lema ketannae hammakdish avdo en moalin bo rabban shimon ben gamliel omer moalin bisaro may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar kadosh umar savar la kadosh
Vetisbera hay moalin bo veen moalin bo hay kadosh veeno kadosh mibe leh
Ella dechulle alma kadosh vehacha beha kamipalgi demar savar avda kimkarkee dame umar savar kemittalteli dame
I hachi addemipalgi bisaro lipalgu begufo
Ella dechulle alma avda kimkarkee dame vehacha bisaro haomed ligazez kamipalgi mar savar kegazuz dame umar savar lav kegazuz dame

Lema hane tannae kehane tannae ditnan rabbi meir omer yesh devarim shehem kakkarka veenan kakkarka veen chachamim modim lo ketzad eser gefanim teunot masarti lach vehalla omer enan ella chamesh rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim omrim kol hamchubbar lakkarka hare hu kakkarka
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina anavim haomdot libatzer ika benayehu derabbi meir savar kivtzurot damyan verabbanan savri lav kivtzurot damyan
Afilu tema rabbi meir ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella baanavim dechamma dekayeman michchash kechishi aval hacha kamma dekae ashboche mashbach

Ki selek rabbi chiyya bar yosef amar lehay shemata derav kammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh amar rav hachi vehu la amar hachi vehaamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur

Hachi kaamar leh amar rav keoti veika deamri la sayemuha kammeh amar leh vela amar rav tzarich get shichrur verabbi yochanan letameh deamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur
Gufa amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur

Etiveh rabbi abba leulla ger shemmet uvizbezu yisrael nechasav vehau bahen avadim ben gedolim uven ketannim kanu atzman bene chorin abba shaul omer gedolim kanu atzman bene chorin ketannim kol hammachzik bahen zacha bahen
Vechi mi katav get shichrur leellu
Amar dame hay midderabbanan kidla gamri inashe shemata vetama may amar rav nachman kasavar ulla avdo deger ki ishto ma ishto mishtallachat belo get af avadav mishtallechim belo get
I hachi afilu yisrael name amar kera vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem lareshet achuzza
I hachi hammafkir avdo vamet name allema amar ammemar hammafkir avdo vamet oto haeved en lo takkana deammemar kashya
Amar rabbi yaakov bar ide amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha keabba shaul amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi yaakov bar idi
b: Beferush shemia lach o mikkelala shemia lach may kelala deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amru lifne rabbi amar nityaashti mippeloni avdi mahu amar lahem omer ani en lo takkana ella bishtar
Veamar rabbi yochanan may tama derabbi gamar lahlah meishsha ma ishsha bishtar af eved name bishtar
Veka dayekatte minah keishsha ma ishsha isura vela mamona af eved name isura vela mamona
Vei mikkelala may amar leh adderabba dok minah leidach gisa ma ishsha ben gedola ben ketanna af eved name ben gadol ben katan amar leh beferush shemia li

Verabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan en halacha keabba shaul amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi chiyya bar abba beferush shemia lach o mikkelala shemia lach may kelala deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amru lifne rabbi nityaashti mippeloni avdi mahu amar lahem omer ani en lo takkana ella bishtar
Veamar rabbi yochanan may tama derabbi gamar lahlah meishsha ma ishsha bishtar af eved name bishtar
Veka dayekatte minah keishsha ma ishsha ben gedola ben ketanna af eved name ben gadol ben katan
Vei mikkelala may adderabba dok minah lehach gisa ma ishsha isura vela mamona af eved name isura vela mamona amar leh beferush shemia li
Amar mar amar lahem omer ani en lo takkana ella bishtar vehatanya rabbi omer omer ani af hu noten deme atzmo veotze mippene shehu kemochro lo
Hachi kaamar o bechesef o bishtar vehay peka leh kaspeh ulappoke mehay tanna
Detanya rabbi shimon omer mishshum rabbi akiva yachol yehe kesef gomer bah kederech sheshshetar gomer bah talmud lomar vehofde lo nifdata
Ora kal happarasha kulah lelo chuppasha lomar lach shetar gomer bah veen hakkesef gomer bah
Amar rame bar chama amar rav nachman halacha kerabbi shimon verav yosef bar chama amar rabbi yochanan en halacha kerabbi shimon

Ashkecheh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava bar sheelta dahava kae appitcha deve tefilla amar leh halacha o en halacha amar leh ani omer en halacha verabbanan daato mimmachoza amri amar rabbi zera mishshemeh derav nachman halacha

Vechi atay lesura ashkachteh lerabbi chiyya bar avin amri leh ema li izi gufa deovada hechi hava amar li dehahi amta dahava marah shechiv mera atya bachya kammeh amra leh ad emat tishtabed vetezil hahi itta shekal kumteh sheda bah amar lah zil keni ha ukni nafshich ato lekammeh derav nachman amar lehu lo asa velo chelum
Man dachaza savar mishshum dahalacha kerabbi shimon vela hi ella mishshum dehave leh kelav shel makne
Amar rav shemuel bar achitay amar rav hamnuna sava amar rabbi yitzchak bar ashyan amar rav huna amar rav hamnuna halacha kerabbi shimon vela hi en halacha kerabbi shimon
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi chanina amar rav ashe amar rabbi eved shennasa et bat chorin bifne rabbo

a: Yatza lecherut amar lo rabbi yochanan kal kach yesh beyadcha vaani shone hakkotev shetar erusin leshifchato rabbi meir omer mekuddeshet vachachamim omrim enah mekuddeshet
Kidamar rabba bar rav shela kesherabbo hinniach lo tefilin hacha name kesherabbo hissio ishsha
Umi ika mide dilavdeh la miavad leh isura veihu aved isura
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hacha bemay askinan deamar lah tzei bo vehitkaddeshi bo rabbi meir savar yesh ballashon hazze leshon shichrur verabbanan savri en ballashon hazze leshon shichrur

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi eved shehinniach tefilin bifne rabbo yatza lecherut metivi lava hemennu rabbo o sheasao rabbo appotroppos o shehinniach tefilin bifne rabbo o shekkara shelosha pesukim bevet hakkeneset bifne rabbo hare ze lo yatza lecherut
Amar rabba bar rav shela kesherabbo hinniach lo tefilin

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan mi sheamar bishat mitato pelonit shifchati al yishtabedu bah leachar moti kofin et hayyorshim vechotvin lah get shichrur amru lefanav rabbi amme verabbi assi rabbi i atta mode shebbaneha avadim

Ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan mi sheamar bishat mitato pelonit shifchati korat ruach asta li yease lah korat ruach kofin et hayyorshin veosin lah korat ruach may tama mitzva lekayyem divre hammet
Amar ammemar hammafkir avdo oto eved en lo takkana may tama gufeh la kane leh isura hu deika gabbeh veisura la matze makne leh
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar vehaamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan verav chiyya bar avin amar rav echad ze veechad ze yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur amar leh tzarich veen lo takkana

Ika deamri amar ammemar hammafkir avdo vamet oto haeved en lo takkana may tama gufeh la kane leh isura hu deika gabbeh veisura livreh la moret amar leh rav ashe leammemar veha ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan
Derav dimi tauta hi amar leh may tauta dela amrah bilshon shichrur ha amrah bilshon shichrur hachi name amar leh ana kidrav shemuel bar yehuda sevira li

Hahu diskarta deavde deizdabban legoy kelo marota batrae ato lekammeh deravina amar lehu zilu ahdaru abbene marota kammae veyichtevu lechu gita decheruta amaru leh rabbanan leravina vehaamar ammemar hammafkir avdo vamet oto haeved en lo takkana
Amar lehu ana kerav dimi sevira li amaru leh derav dimi tauta hi amar lehu may tauta dela amrah bilshon shichrur ha amrah bilshon shichrur hachi name vehilcheta keravina
Hahu avda deve tere kam chad minayehu veshachrereh lefalgeh amar idach hashta shami bi rabbanan umafsedu leh minay azal akneyeh livno katan
Shalchah rav yosef bereh derava lekammeh derav pappa shelach leh kaasher asa ken yease lo gemulo yashiv lo berosho anan kim lan beyanoka dimkarva dateh legabbe zuze mokminan leh appotroppos
