b: Umkarkesh leh zuze vechatev leh gita decheruta al shemeh
Tanu rabbanan haomer asiti peloni avdi ben chorin asuy ben chorin hare hu ben chorin hare hu ben chorin
Eesennu ben chorin rabbi omer kana vachachamim omrim lo kana amar rabbi yochanan vechullan bishtar
Tanu rabbanan haomer natatti sade pelonit lifloni netuna lifloni hare hi shello hare hi shello ettenenna lifloni rabbi meir omer kana vachachamim omrim lo kana amar rabbi yochanan vechullan bishtar
Tanu rabbanan haomer asiti peloni avdi ben chorin vehu omer lo asaani chayeshinan shemma zika lo al yede acher katavti venatatti lo vehu omer lo katav li velo natan li hodaat baal din kemea edim dame
Haomer natatti sade pelonit lifloni vehu omer lo natan li chayeshinan shemma zika lo al yede acher katavti venatatti lo vehu omer lo katav velo natan li hodaat baal din kemea edim dame
Mi ochel perot rav chisda amar noten ochel perot verabba amar meshalleshin et happerot
Vela peligi ha beabba ha bivra

Matni eved sheasao rabbo appoteke laacherim veshichrero shurat haddin en haeved chayyav kelum ella mippene tikun haolam kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin vechotev shetar al damav rabban shimon ben gamliel omer eno kotev ella meshachrer
Gema eved sheasao rabbo appoteke veshichrero mi shichrero amar rav rabbo rishon shurat haddin en haeved chayyav kelum lerabbo sheni
Kidrava deamar rava hekdesh chametz veshichrur mafkiin mide shibud ella mippene tikun haolam shemma yimtzaennu bashshuk

a: Veyomar lo avdi atta kofin et rabbo sheni veose oto ben chorin vechotev eved shetar al damav rabban shimon ben gamliel omer en haeved kotev ella meshachrer kotev
Bemay ka mipalgi bemazzik shibudo shel chavero ka mipalgi demar savar chayyav umar savar patur
Itmar name hammazzik shibudo shel chavero banu lemachloket rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan

Ulla amar mi shichrero rabbo sheni shurat haddin en haeved chayyav kelum bemitzot ella mippene tikun haolam shehare yatza alav shem ben chorin kofin et rabbo rishon veose oto ben chorin vechotev shetar al damav rabban shimon ben gamliel omer eno kotev ella meshachrer kotev
Bemay kamipalgi behezek sheeno nikar kamipalgi mar savar shemeh hezek umar savar la shemeh hezek
Ulla may tama la amar kerav amar lach sheni rabbo karet leh
Verav may tama la amar keulla amar lach sheni meshachrer karet leh
Itmar haosa sadehu appoteke laacherim ushtafah nahar amme shappir nae amar rabbi yochanan eno gove mishshear nechasim vaavuh dishmuel amar gove mishshear nechasim
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mishshum deamme shappir nae hu omer shemata dela shappiran tetargam shemateh daamar leh lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizzo
Tanya name hachi haosa sadehu appoteke leacher ushtafah nahar gove mishshear nechasim veim amar lo lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizzo eno gove mishshear nechasim

Tanya idach haose sadehu appoteke levaal chov velichtubbat ishsha govin mishshear nechasim rabban shimon ben gamliel omer baal chov gove mishshear nechasim ishsha enah gova mishshear nechasim sheen darkah shel ishsha lechazzer al batte dinin

Matni mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin oved et rabbo yom echad veet atzmo yom echad divre bet hillel bet shammay omrim tikkantem et rabbo veet atzmo lo tikkantem lisa shifcha i efshar shekkevar chetzo ben chorin
b: Bat chorin i efshar shekkevar chetzo eved yibbatel vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya urviyya shenneemar lo tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah ella mippene tikun haolam kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin vechotev shetar al chatzi damav vechazru bet hillel lehorot kedivre bet shammay
Gema tanu rabbanan hamshachrer chatzi avdo rabbi omer kana vachachamim omrim lo kana
Amar rabba machloket bishtar derabbi savar vehofde lo nifdata o chufsha lo nittan lah
Makkish shetar lechesef ma kesef ben kullo ben chetzo af shetar name ben kullo ben chetzo
Verabbanan gamri lahlah meishsha ma ishsha chetzyah lo af eved name chetzo lo aval bechesef divre hakkol kana peduya veenah peduya
Lema beha kamipalgi demar savar hekkesha adif umar savar gezera shava adifa
La dechulle alma gezera shava adifa veshane hacha deika lemifrach ma leishsha shekken enah yotza bechesef tomar beeved sheyyotze bechesef
Verav yosef amar machloket bechesef derabbi savar vehofde lo nifdata peduya veenah peduya verabbanan savri dibbera tora kilshon bene adam aval bishtar divre hakkol lo kana
Metivi hamshachrer chatzi avdo bishtar rabbi omer kana vachachamim omrim lo kana teuvta derav yosef teuvta
Nema bishtar hu difligi aval bechesef la peligi lema tehve teuvta derav yosef betarte
Amar lecha rav yosef peligi bishtar vehu haddin bechesef veha deka mipalgi bishtar lehodiacha kocho derabbi
Velifleguy bechesef ulhodiacha kochan derabbanan koach dehetera adif leh
Ta shema vehofde yachol lakkol talmud lomar lo nifdata i lo nifdata yachol lakkol talmud lomar vehofde ha ketzad peduya veenah peduya bechesef uvshave kesef
Veen li ella bechesef bishtar minnayin talmud lomar vehofde lo nifdata o chufsha lo nittan lah ulhallan hu omer vechatav lah sefer keritut ma lehallan bishtar af kan bishtar

En li ella chetzo bechesef o kullo bishtar chetzo bishtar minnayin talmud lomar vehofde lo nifdata o chufsha lo nittan lah makkish shetar lechesef ma kesef ben kullo ben chetzo af shetar name ben kullo ben chetzo
Bishlama lerav yosef batar deitotav ha manni rabbi hi ella lerabba resha divre hakkol vesefa rabbi
Amar lach rabba in resha divre hakkol vesefa rabbi rav ashe amar rabbi hi
Ella matnitin dekatane mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin bishlama lerabba mokem lah bechesef vedivre hakkol ella lerav yosef lema rabbi hi vela rabbanan amar ravina

a: Beeved shel shene shuttafin vedivre hakkol
Amar rabba machaloket besheshshichrer chetzo vehinniach chetzo aval shichrer chetzo umachar chetzo o natan bemattana chetzo kevan dekanafek mineh kulleh divre hakkol kana
Amar leh abbaye uvchullo la peligi vehatane chada hakkotev nechasav lishne avadav kanu umshachrerin ze et ze vetanya idach haomer kol nechasay netunin lifloni ufloni avaday af atzmam lo kanu
May lav ha rabbi veha rabbanan
La idi veidi rabbanan ha deamar kullo ha deamar chatzi chatzi
Veha middekatane sefa veim amar chatzi chatzi lo kanu mikkelal deresha deamar kullo paroshe ka mefaresh af atzman lo kanu ketzad kegon deamar chatzi chatzi
Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach resha deamar kullo hashta amar kullo lo kanu amar chatzi chatzi mibaya
I mishshum ha la irya tena sefa legalloye resha shello tomar resha deamar chatzi chatzi aval amar kullo kanu tena sefa deamar chatzi chatzi mikkelal deresha deamar kullo vaafilu hachi lo kanu
Veibaet ema la kashya kan bishtar echad kan bishne shetarot

Bishtar echad may irya chatzi chatzi afilu amar kullo name lo kanu hachi name kaamar af atzman lo kanu bamme devarim amurim bishtar echad aval bishne shetarot kanu veim amar chatzi chatzi af bishne shetarot name la kanu
Veibaet ema la kashya kan bevat achat kan beze achar ze
Bishlama batra la kane deha kane leh kamma ella kamma likne nafsheh velikneyeh lechavreh ella mechavarta kidshanninan meikara
Rav ashe amar shane hatam deka kare lehu avaday amar leh rafram lerav ashe vedilma avaday shehau kevar

Mi la tenan hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo yatza lecherut shiyyer karka kal shehu lo yatza lecherut rabbi shimon omer leolam hu ben chorin ad sheyyomar kol nechasay netunin lifloni avdi chutz meechad meribbo shebbahen
Tama deamar chutz meechad meribbo shebbahen ha la amar hachi kane ammay veha eved ka kare leh ella avdi shehaya kevar hacha name avaday shehau kevar
Negacho shor yom shel rabbo lerabbo yom shel atzmo leatzmo ella meatta yom shel rabbo yissa shifcha yom shel atzmo yissa bat chorin isura la kaamrinan
Ta shema hemit mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin noten chatzi kenas lerabbo
b: Vachatzi chofer leorshav ammay hachi name lema yom shel rabbo lerabbo yom shel atzmo leatzmo shane hacha deka chalya karna
Veella hechi dame dela ka chalya karna kegon shehikkahu al yado vetzamta yado vesofah lachazor
Hanicha leabbaye deamar noten lo shevet gedola veshevet ketanna shappir
Ella lerava deamar eno noten lo ella shivto shebbechol yom vaom hay shor hu veshor eno meshallem ella nezek
Ibaet ema keshehikkahu adam vei baet ema memra hi umemra lerava la sevira leh
Ibaya lehu meukkav get shichrur yesh lo kenas o en lo kenas
Kesef sheloshim shekalim yitten ladonav amar rachamana vehay lav adon hu o dilma kevan dimchussar get shichrur adon karena beh
Ta shema hemit mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin noten chatzi kenas lerabbo vachatzi chofer leorshav may lav kemishna acharona
Lo kemishna rishona
Ta shema hippil et shino vesima et eno yotze beshino venoten deme eno vei amratte yesh lo kenas uknas lerabbo hashta chavli beh acharine yahavi leh lerabbeh chavel beh rabbeh gufeh yahev leh ledideh

Dilma keman deamar eno tzarich detanya bechullan eved yotze bahen lecherut vetzarich get shichrur merabbo divre rabbi yishmael rabbi meir omer eno tzarich rabbi eliezer omer tzarich rabbi tarfon omer eno tzarich rabbi akiva omer tzarich
Hammachriin lifne chachamim omrim nirim divre rabbi tarfon beshen vaayin hoil vetora zikketa lo vedivre rabbi akiva bishar evarim hoil uknas chachamim hu
Kenas ha kerae ka darshinan ella ema hoil umidrash chachamim hu
Ibaya lehu meukkav get shichrur ochel bitruma o eno ochel kinyan kaspo amar rachamana vehay lav kinyan kaspo hu o dilma kevan dimchussar get shichrur kinyan kaspo karena beh
Ta shema deamar rav mesharsheya kohenet shennitarev veladah bivelad shifchatah hare ellu ochlin bitruma vecholkin chelek echad al haggoren higdilu hattaarovot meshachrerin ze et ze
Hachi hashta hatam im yavo eliyyahu veyomar bechad minayehu deeved hu kinyan kaspo karena beh hacha lav kinyan kaspo hu kelal
Ibaya lehu eved shemmecharo rabbo liknas machur o eno machur

Tibe lerabbi meir tibe lerabbanan tibe lerabbi meir ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir adam makne davar shello ba laolam ella kegon perot dekel daavidi deatu aval hacha mi yemar demingach veim timtza lomar demingach mimmay dimshallem

a: Dilma mode umiptar
Vetibbee lerabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan en adam makne davar shello ba laolam ella kegon perot dekel dehashta miha letanhu aval hacha ha kae shor veha kae eved may
Amar rabbi abba ta shema vilid bayit ma talmud lomar im kinyan kesef ochel yelid bayit lo kol shekken
Ilu ken hayiti omer ma kinyan kesef sheyyesh bo shave kesef ochel af yelid bayit sheyyesh bo shave kesef ochel uminnayin sheaf al pi sheeno shave kelum talmud lomar yelid bayit mikkol makom

Vaadayin ani omer yelid bayit ben sheyyesh bo shave kesef ben sheen bo shave kesef ochel kinyan kesef yesh bo shave kesef ochel en bo shave kesef eno ochel talmud lomar kinyan kaspo vilid beto ma yelid bayit af al pi sheeno shave kelum ochel af kinyan kaspo af al pi sheeno shave kelum ochel
Vei salka datach eved shemmecharo rabbo liknas machur mi ika avda dela mizdabban liknasa in ika eved terefa
Veha chaze lemekam kammeh bimnuuol umukke shechin

Ibaya lehu mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin shekkidesh bat chorin mahu im timtza lomar ben yisrael sheamar levat yisrael hitkaddeshi lechetzyi mekuddeshet dechazya lechulleh ha la chazya lechulleh
Veim timtza lomar ben yisrael hamkaddesh chatzi ishsha enah mekuddeshet deshiyyer bekinyano veha eved lo shiyyer bekinyano may
Ta shema hemit mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin noten chatzi kenas lerabbo vachatzi chofer leorshav vei amratte kidushav lav kidushin yorshin mena leh
Amar rav adda bar ahava kesheasao terefa umay yorshav nafsheh
Amar rava shette teshuvot baddavar chada deorshav katane veod kofer hu veamar resh lakish kofer en mishtallem ella leachar mita ella amar rava rauy litol veen lo
Amar rava keshem shehamkaddesh chatzi ishsha enah mekuddeshet kach chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha en kiddusheha kiddushin

Daresh rabba bar rav huna keshem shehamkaddesh chatzi ishsha enah mekuddeshet kach chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha enah mekuddeshet amar leh rav chisda mi dame hatam shiyyer bekinyano hacha lo shiyyer bekinyano

Hadar okem rabba bar rav huna amora aleh udrash vehammachshela hazzot tachat yadecha en adam omed al divre tora ella im ken nichshal bahen af al pi sheamru hamkaddesh chatzi ishsha enah mekuddeshet aval chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha kiddusheha kiddushin may tama hatam shiyyer bekinyano hacha lo shiyyer bekinyano

Amar rav sheshet keshem shehamkaddesh chatzi ishsha enah mekuddeshet kach chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha en kidusheha kidushin veim lechashcha adam lomar ezo hi shifcha charufa zo shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin hamoreset leeved ivri alma bat itrose hi emor lo kelach etzel rabbi yishmael shehu omer beshifcha kenaanit hamoreset leeved ivri
Veshifcha kenaanit bat itrose hi ella may it lach lememar may meoreset meuchedet hacha name may meoreset meuchedet
Amar rav chisda chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha liruven venishtachrera vechazra venitkaddesha leshimon umetu shenehem mityabemet lelevi
b: Veen ani kore bah eshet shene metim ma nafshach i kiddushe diruven kiddushin kiddushe deshimon lav kiddushin vei kiddushe deshimon kiddushin kiddushe diruven lav kiddushin

Itmar chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha liruven venishtachrera vechazra venitkaddesha leshimon rav yosef bar chama amar rav nachman paku kiddushe rishon rabbi zera amar rav nachman gamru kiddushe rishon
Amar rabbi zera keoteh didi mistabbera dichtiv lo yumtu ki lo chuppasha ha chuppasha yumtu

Amar leh abbaye ultana deve rabbi yishmael deamar beshifcha kenaanit hamoreset leeved ivri hachi name dechi chuppasha yumtu ella may it lach lememar shechuppesha vechazra venitkaddesha hacha name shechuppesha vechazra venitkaddesha

Amar rav huna bar kattina amar rabbi yitzchak maase beishsha achat shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin vechafu et rabbah vaasaah bat chorin keman kerabbi yochanan ben beroka deamar al shenehem hu omer vayevarech otam elohim vayyomer vego peru urvu umilu vego
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lo minhag hefker nahagu bah
Matni hammocher avdo laggoyim o lechutza laaretz yatza ben chorin

Gema tanu rabbanan hammocher avdo laggoyim yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur merabbo rishon amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim shello katav alav ono aval katav alav ono zehu shichruro
May ono amar rav sheshet dichtav leh hachi lichshettivrach mimmennu en li esek bach
Tanu rabbanan lava alav min haggoy kevan sheasa lo goy nimuso yatza lecherut may nimuso amar rav huna bar yehuda nashki
Metiv rav sheshet haarisin vehachachirot vaarise batte avot vegoy shemmishken sadehu leyisrael af al pi sheasa lo nimuso petura min hammaaser
Vei salka datach nashki sade bat nashki hi ella amar rav sheshet zeman
Kashya zeman azzeman la kashya ha dimta zimneh ha dela meta zimneh
Ella gabbe eved dimta zimneh tzericha lememar ella ide veide dela meta zimneh vela kashya ha legufa veha lefera

a: Vei baet ema beshellava al menat lemashkeno velo mishkeno
Tanu rabbanan gevao bechovo o shellekacho sikarikon lo yatza lecherut uvchovo lo
Urminhi hare sheansu bet hammelech gorno im bechovo chayyav leasser im baanparot patur milleasser
Shane hatam deka mishtarshi leh
Ta shema deamar rav hammocher avdo lefarhange goy yatza lecherut hatam hava leh lefayyes velo piyyes
Gufa amar rav hammocher avdo lefarhange goy yatza lecherut may hava leh lemebad hava leh lefayyes velo piyyes
Bae rabbi yirmeya mecharo lishloshim yom mahu ta shema deamar rav hammocher avdo lefarhange goy yatza lecherut hatam befarhange goy sheenah chozeret

Mecharo chutz mimmelachto mahu chutz min hammitzot mahu chutz mishshabbatot veyamim tovim mahu leger toshav leyisrael meshummad mahu lechuti mahu peshot miha chada ger toshav hare hu kegoy kuti veyisrael meshummad amri lah kegoy veamri lah keyisrael
Beo mineh merabbi amme eved shehippil atzmo ligyasot veen rabbo yachol lehotzio lo bedine yisrael velo bedine ummot haolam mahu sheyyittol et damav

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zerika pok ayyen bimchilatach nefak dak veashkach detanya hammocher beto legoy damav asurin vegoy sheanas beto shel yisrael veen bealav yachol lehotzio lo bedine yisrael velo bedine ummot haolam muttar litol et damav vechotev umaale bearkaot shellahen mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam
Vedilma hane mile bayit dechevan dela saggi leh belo bayit la ate lezabboneh aval avda desaggi leh bela avda ate lezabboneh o la

Shelach lehu rabbi amme minay amme bar natan tora yotza lechol yisrael eved shehippil atzmo ligyasot veen rabbo yachol lehotzio lo bedine yisrael velo bedine ummot haolam muttar litol et damav vechotev umaale bearkaot shel goyim mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hammocher avdo legoy konsim oto ad mea bedamav
Daveka o lav daveka ta shema deamar resh lakish hammocher behema gassa legoy konsim oto ad asara bedameha
Vedilma shane eved dechol yoma veoma mafka leh mimmitzot
Veika deamri amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hammocher avdo legoy konsin oto ad asara bedamav daveka o lav daveka ta shema deamar resh lakish hammocher behema gassa legoy konsin oto ad mea bedameha
Shane eved dela hadar leh
Ella behema tama may mishshum dehadra leh likneseh tefe chad ella eved milta dela shechicha umilleta dela shechicha la gazri bah rabbanan

Bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi assi machar avdo vamet mahu sheyyiknesu et beno acharav im timtze lomar tzaram ozen bechor vamet kansu beno acharav mishshum deisura deorayeta hi aval hacha isura derabbanan
b: Veim timtze lomar kiven melachto bammoed vamet lo kansu beno acharav mishshum dela avad isura hacha may ledideh kenasu rabbanan veha leteh o dilma lemamoneh kenasu rabbanan veha iteh
Amar leh tenetuha sade shennitkavvetza bashsheviit tizzara lemotzae sheviit nittayeva o niddayera lo tizzara lemotzae sheviit
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina naktinan hetivah vamet beno zorah alma ledideh kenasu rabbanan livreh la kenasu rabbanan

Amar abbaye naktinan time teharot shel chavero vamet la kenasu rabbanan beno acharav may tama hezek sheeno nikar la shemeh hezek uknasa derabbanan hi ledideh kansuhu rabbanan livreh la ka kenasu rabbanan

O lechutza laaretz tanu rabbanan hammocher avdo lechutza laaretz yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur merabbo sheni rabban shimon ben gamliel omer peamim yatza ufamim lo yatza ketzad amar peloni avdi mechartihu lifloni antochi lo yatza leantochi shebbeantochya yatza
Veha tanya mechartihu leantochi yatza leantochi hashsharuy belod lo yatza
La kashya ha deit leh beta beeretz yisrael ha deit leh ushpiza beeretz yisrael
Bae rabbi yirmeya ben bavel shennasa ishsha beeretz yisrael vehichnisa lo avadim ushfachot vedato lachazor mahu
Tibe leman deamar haddin immah tibe leman deamar haddin immo
Tibe leman deamar haddin immah kevan dehaddin immah kedideh damu o dilma kevan dimshabedi leh lefera kedideh damu
Vetibe leman deamar haddin immo kevan dehaddin immo kedideh damu o dilma kevan dela kane leh legufeh kedideh damu teku
Amar rabbi avahu shana li rabbi yochanan eved sheyyatza achar rabbo lesurya umcharo sham rabbo yatza lecherut vehatane rabbi chiyya ibed et zechuto
La kashya kan sheddaat rabbo lachzor kan sheen daat rabbo lachzor
Vehatanya yotze haeved achar rabbo lesurya yotze la saggi dela nafek vehatnan veen hakkol motziin
Ella yatza haeved achar rabbo lesurya umcharo rabbo sham im daat rabbo lachzor kofin oto veim en daat rabbo lachzor en kofin oto
Amar rav anan shemait mineh demar shemuel tarte chada hach veidach deitmar hammocher sadehu bishnat hayyovel atzmah rav amar mechura veotza ushmuel amar enah mechura kol ikar
Bachada hadri zevine uvachada la hadri zevine vela yadana he minayehu

Amar rav yosef nichze anan middetane bevarayeta hammocher avdo lechutza laaretz yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur merabbo sheni shema minah kanyeh rabbo sheni vela hadri zevine vechi amar shemuel hatam enah mechura umaot chozrin

a: Verav anan barayeta la shemia leh

Vei middishmuel mimmay deenah mechura umaot chozrin dilma enah mechura umaot mattana ninhu mide dehave ammekaddesh et achoto deitmar hamkaddesh et achoto rav amar maot chozrin ushmuel amar maot mattana
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef may chazet dekansinan lelokeach nikneseh lemocher amar leh lav achbera gannav ella chora gannav amar leh i lav achbera chora mena leh
Mistabbera hecha deika isura hatam kansinan

Hahu avda daarak mechutza laaretz laaretz azal mareh abbatreh ata lekammeh derabbi amme amar leh nichtov lach shetara addemeh uchtov leh gita decheruta vei la mafkana leh minach midderabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya

Detanya lo yeshvu beartzecha pen yachatiu otcha li yachol begoy shekkibel alav shello laavod avoda zara hakkatuv medabber talmud lomar lo tasgir eved el adonav asher yinnatzel elecha meim adonav may takkanato immecha yeshev bekirbecha vego
Vekashya leh lerabbi yoshiyya hay meim adonav meim aviv mibe leh ella amar rabbi yoshiyya bemocher avdo lechutza laaretz hakkatuv medabber

Vekashya leh lerabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya hay asher yinnatzel elecha asher yinnatzel meimmecha mibe leh ella amar rabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya beeved shebbarach mechutza laaretz laaretz hakkatuv medabber

Tanya idach lo tasgir eved el adonav rabbi omer belokeach eved al menat leshachrero hakkatuv medabber hechi dame amar rav nachman bar yitzchak dichtav leh hachi lichsheekkachacha hare atzmecha kanuy lecha meachshav

Rav chisda arak leh avda leve chutae shelach lehu ahderuh nihali shelachu leh lo tasgir eved el adonav shelach lehu vechen taase lachamoro vechen taase lesimlato vechen taase lechol avedat achicha shelachu leh vehachtiv lo tasgir eved el adonav shelach lehu hahu beeved shebbarach mechutza laaretz laaretz vechidrabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya
Umay shena dishlach lehu kidrabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya mishshum demashma lehu kerae

Abbaye irchas leh chamara be chutae shelach lehu shadderuh li shelachu leh shelach simana shelach lehu dechiuora kereseh shelachu leh i lav denachmani atte la hava meshaddarna leh nihalach attu kulle chamare lav keresayehu chivare ninhu
Matni en podin et hashshevuyin yater al kede demehen mippene tikun haolam veen mavrichin et hashshevuyin mippene tikun haolam rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mippene takkanat hashshevuyin
Gema ibaya lehu hay mippene tikun haolam mishshum duchka detzibbura hu o dilma mishshum dela ligrevu velayeto tefe
Ta shema delevi bar darga parkah livratteh bitlesar alfe dinre zahav
Amar abbaye uman lema lan devirtzon chachamim avad dilma shello birtzon chachamim avad
Veen mavrichin et hashshevuyin mippene tikun haolam rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mippene takkanat shevuyin may benayehu ika benayehu deleka ella chad

Benateh derav nachman bachashan kidra bidayehu kashya leh lerav ilish ketiv adam echad meelef matzati veishsha vechol elle lo matzati ha ika benateh derav nachman gerama lehu milta veishtavyan veishteviy ihu name bahadayehu
Yoma chad hava yatev gabbeh hahu gavra dahava yada belishana detzipore ata orva veka kare leh amar leh may kaamar amar leh ilish berach ilish berach amar orva shakkara hu vela samechna aleh

Addehachi ata yona veka karya amar leh may kaamra amar leh ilish berach ilish berach amar keneset yisrael keona metila shema minah mitrechish li nisa amar ezil echze benateh derav nachman i kayeman behemanutayehu ahderinhu
Amar neshe kol mile deit lehu sadran lahadade bevet hakkisse shaminhu dekaamran ade guvrin unhardae guvrin lema lehu leshavoyayehu delirachakinhu mehacha dela leto inashin velishmei velifrekinan
Kam arak ata ihu vehahu gavra ledideh itrechish leh nisa avar bemabbara vehahu gavra ashkechuh vekatluh ki hadran veatan amar hao ka vachashan kidra bichshafim
Matni veen lokchin sefarim tefilin umzuzot min haggoyim yoter al kede demehen
b: Mippene tikun haolam
Gema amar leh rav budya lerav ashe yater al kede demehen hu deen lokchin ha bichde demehen lokchin shema minah sefer tora shennimtza beyad goy korin bo dilma lignoz
Amar rav nachman naktinan sefer tora shekketavo min yissaref ketavo goy yigganez nimtza beyad min yigganez nimtza beyad goy amri lah yigganez veamri lah korin bo
Sefer tora shekketavo goy tane chada yissaref vetanya idach yigganez vetanya idach korin bo
La kashya ha detanya yissaref rabbi eliezer hi deamar setam machshevet goy laavoda zara

Veha detanya yigganez hay tanna hu detane rav hamnuna bereh derava mippashrunya sefer tora tefillin umzuzot shekketavan min umasor goy veeved ishsha vekatan vechuti veyisrael meshummad pesulin shenneemar ukshartamuchtavtam kol sheyyeshno bikshira yeshno bichtiva vechol sheeno bikshira eno bichtiva

Veha detanya korin bo hay tanna hu detanya lokchin sefarim min haggoyim bechol makom uvilvad sheyyihu ketuvin kehilchatan umaase begoy echad betzayeddan shehaya kotev sefarim vehittir rabban shimon ben gamliel likach mimmennu
Verabban shimon ben gamliel ibud lishman bae ketiva lishman la bae

Detanya tzipan zahav o shettala alehen or behema temea pesulot or behema tehora kesherot veaf al pi shello ibdan lishman rabbi shimon ben gamliel omer afilu or behema tehora pesulot ad sheyeabbeden lishman
Amar rabba bar shemuel beger shechazar lesoro lesoro kol shekken dehave leh min amar rav ashe shechozer lesoro mishshum yira
Tanu rabbanan maalin bidmehen ad kede tarpaik may tarpaik amar rav sheshet istera
Hahi tayyata deayetay chayeta ditfile lekammeh deabbaye amar lah yahavatte li resh resh betamre imalya zihara shekala shedatinhu benahara amar la ibbeay li lezalzolinhu beappah kulle hay
Matni hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra lo yachzir mishshum neder lo yachzir rabbi yehuda omer kol neder sheyyadu bo rabbim lo yachzir veshello yadu bo rabbim yachzir
Rabbi meir omer kol neder shetztzarich chakirat chacham lo yachzir vesheeno tzarich chakirat chacham yachzir amar rabbi elazar lo asru ze ella mippene ze
Amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda maase betzayeddan beechad sheamar leishto kunam im eni megarshich vegershah vehittiru lo chachamim sheyyachzirenna mippene tikun haolam
Gema amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman vehu sheamar lah mishshum shem ra ani motziech

a: Mishshum neder ani motziech kasavar tama may mishshum kilkula i amar lah hachi matze mekalkel lah vei la la matze mekalkel lah

Ika deamri amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman tzarich sheyyomar lah hevi yodaat shemmishshum shem ra ani motziech umishshum neder ani motziech kasavar tama may kede shello yehu benot yisrael perutzot baaraot uvindarim hilkach tzarich lememar lah hachi
Tanya kelishana kamma vetanya kelishana batra

Tanya kelishana kamma amar rabbi meir mippene ma amru hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra lo yachzir umishshum neder lo yachzir shemma telech vetinnase leacher venimtzeu devarim baddain veyomar ilu hayiti yodea shekken hu afilu im hau notnim li mea mane lo hayiti megarshah venimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerin lefichach omrim lo heve yodea shehammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra lo yachzir umishshum neder lo yachzir

Tanya kelishana batra amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose mippene ma amru hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra lo yachzir umishshum neder lo yachzir shello yehu benot yisrael perutzot baaraot uvindarim lefichach omrim lo emor lah have yodaat shemmishshum shem ra ani motziech umishshum neder ani motziech

Rabbi yehuda omer kol neder sheyyedu bo rabbim lo yachzir veshello yadu bo rabbim yachzir amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may tama derabbi yehuda dichtiv velo hikkum bene yisrael ki nishbeu lahem nesie haeda
Verabbanan hatam mi chala shevua ilavayehu kelal kevan daamaru lehu meeretz rechoka banu velo bau la chayela shevua ilavayehu kelal vehay dela katlinhu mishshum kedushshat hashshem
Vechamma rabbim rav nachman amar shelosha rabbi yitzchak amar asara
Rav nachman amar shelosha yamim shenayim rabbim shelosha rabbi yitzchak amar asara dichtiv eda
Rabbi meir omer kol neder shetztzarich vechu tanya rabbi elazar omer lo asru tzarich ella mippene sheeno tzarich
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi meir savar adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din
Verabbi elazar savar en adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din
Amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda maase betzayeddan vechu may tanna dekatane maase

Chassore michassera vehachi katane bamme devarim amurim keshennadra hi aval nadar ihu yachzir veamar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda maase name betzayeddan beechad sheamar leishto kunnam im eni megarshich vegershah vehittiru lo chachamim sheyyachzirenna mippene tikun haolam
b: May kunam amar rav huna beomer yeasru kol perot shebbaolam alay im eni megarshah
Vehittiru lo sheyyachzirenna peshita mahu detema ligzor mishshum derabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer hannoder keilu bana bama vehamkayemo keilu hikriv aleha korban ka mashma lan
Mippene tikun haolam may tikun haolam ika amar rav sheshet aresha
Ravina amar leolam assefa vehachi katane en bazo mippene tikun haolam
Matni hammotzi et ishto mishshum ayelonit rabbi yehuda omer lo yachzir vachachamim omrim yachzir
Niset leacher vehau lah banim hemennu vehi tovaat ketubbatah amar rabbi yehuda omer lah shetikutich yafa middiburich
Gema lememra derabbi yehuda chayesh lekilkula verabbanan la chayeshi lekilkula veha ipcha shaminan lehu

Ditnan hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra lo yachzir umishshum neder lo yachzir rabbi yehuda omer kol neder sheyyadu bo rabbim lo yachzir veshello yadu bo rabbim yachzir alma rabbanan chayeshi lekilkula verabbi yehuda la chayesh lekilkula
Amar shemuel efoch
Veha middekatane sefa niset leacher vehau lah banim hemennu vehi tovaat ketubbatah amar rabbi yehuda omer lah shetikutich yafa middiburich mikkelal derabbi yehuda chayesh lekilkula ha name efoch
Abbaye amar leolam la tefoch verabbi yehuda behahi savar lah kerabbi meir vesavar lah kerabbi elazar betzarich savar lah kerabbi elazar besheeno tzarich savar lah kerabbi meir
Amar rava derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda kashya derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya
Ella amar rava derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya kidshanninan derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya man chachamim rabbi meir deamar baenan tenay kaful vehacha bemay askinan bidla kafleh litnaeh
Matni hammocher et atzmo veet banav laggoyim en podin oto aval podin et habbanim leachar mitat avihen
Gema amar rav assi vehu shemmachar veshana veshilesh
Hanhu bene be michse deyazfi zuze miggoyim vela hava lehu lemifreinhu atu veka garvi lehu ato lekammeh derav huna amar lehu may ebed lechu ditnan hammocher et atzmo veet banav laggoyim en podin oto
Amar leh rabbi abba limadtani rabbenu vehu shemmachar veshana veshilesh amar leh hane mirgal regili deavdi hachi
Hahu gavra dezabben nafsheh leludae ata lekammeh derabbi amme amar leh

a: Pirkan amar leh tenan hammocher atzmo veet banav laggoyim en podin oto aval podin et habbanim mishshum kilkula vechol shekken hacha deika ketala
Amaru leh rabbanan lerabbi amme hay yisrael mumar hu deka chazu leh dekaachel nevelot utrefot amar lehu ema leteavon hu dekaachel
Amaru leh veha zimnin deika hetera veisura kammeh veshavek hetera veachel isura amar leh zil la ka shavki li deefrekinach
Resh lakish zabben nafsheh leludae shekal bahadeh chayeta vegulgulta amar gemiri deoma batra kol devae minayehu avdi leh ki hechi delechul addemeh

Yoma batra amaru leh may nicha lach amar lehu baena ekmetinchu veotvinchu vechol chad minayechu emcheyeh chayeta ufalga kamtinhu veotvinhu kol chad minayehu kad machyeh chad chayeta nefak nishmeteh charkineh leshineh amar leh achoche ka mechayechatte bi akkatti pash lach gabbay palga dechayeta katlinhu kullehu
Nefak vaata yatev kaachel veshate amara leh beratte la baet mide lemizge aleh amar lah bitti keresi kari ki nach nafsheh shevak kabba demorika kera annafsheh veazvu laacherim chelam
Matni hammocher et sadehu legoy lokeach umevi mimmennu bikkurim mippene tikun haolam

Gema amar rabba af al pi sheen kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lehafkia mide maaser shenneemar ki li haaretz li kedushshat haaretz aval yesh kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lachpor bah borot shichin umarot shenneemar hashshamayim shamayim la vehaaretz natan livne adam

Verabbi elazar omer af al pi sheyyesh kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lehafkia mide maaser shenneemar degancha velo degan goy aval en kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lachpor bah borot shichin umarot shenneemar la haaretz
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar degancha velo degan goy umar savar diguncha velo digun goy
Amar rabba mena amena lah ditnan halleket vehashshichcha vehappea shel goy chayyavin bemaaser ella im ken hifkir
Hechi dame ilema deyisrael velaktinhu goy ella im ken hifkir ha mafkeri vekayemi ella lav degoy velakketinhu yisrael
Tama dehifkir ha lo hifkir chayyav
La leolam deyisrael velakketinhu goy udka amratte ha mafkeri vekayemi nehi demafkeri addata deyisrael addata degoy mi mafkeri
Ta shema yisrael shellakach sade miggoy ad shello hevia shelish vechazar umcharah lo mishshehevia shelish chayyevet bemaaser shekkevar nitchayeva nitchayeva in lo nitchayeva la
Hacha bemay askinan besurya vekasavar kibush yachid la shemeh kibush
Ta shema yisrael vegoy shellakchu sade beshuttafut
b: Tevel vechullin meoravin ze baze divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shel goy patur veshel yisrael chayyav
Ad kan la peligi ella demar savar yesh berera umar savar en berera aval dechulle alma yesh kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lehafkia miyyad maaser
Hacha name besurya vekasavar kibush yachid la shemeh kibush
Amar rav chiyya bar avin ta shema hammocher sadehu legoy lokeach umevi bikurim mippene tikun haolam mippene tikun haolam in middeorayeta la
Amar rav ashe shette takkanot hao meikara hao mayeti middeorayeta kevan dachazo deka mikkeri umzabbeni desavri bikdushtayehu kayeman takkinu lehu dela layeto
Kevan dachazo deman dela saggi leh mezabben veka mishtakkean beyad goyim hadar takkinu lehu delayeto
Itmar hammocher sadehu leferot rabbi yochanan amar mevi vekore resh lakish amar mevi veeno kore
Rabbi yochanan amar mevi vekore kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame resh lakish amar mevi veeno kore kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish ulvetcha melammed sheadam mevi bikure ishto vekore
Amar leh shane hatam dichtiv ulvetecha
Veika deamri etiveh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan ulvetecha melammed sheadam mevi bikure ishto vekore hatam hu dichtiv ulvetecha aval bealma la amar leh tama didi name mehacha kaamena
Etiveh haya ba badderech uvikure ishto beyado veshama shemmeta ishto mevi vekore meta in lo meta la
Hu haddin deaf al gav delo meta umeta itztericha leh salka datach amena ligzor mishshum derabbi yose bar chanina
Deamar rabbi yose bar chanina betzaran veshiggeran beyad shaliach umet shaliach badderech mevi veeno kore shenneemar velakachtaveheveta ad shettehe lekicha vahavaa beechad ka mashma lan
Veazdu letamayehu deitmar hammocher sadehu

a: Bizman shehayyovel noheg rabbi yochanan amar mevi vekore resh lakish amar mevi veeno kore
Rabbi yochanan amar mevi vekore kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame resh lakish amar mevi veeno kore kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame
Utzricha dei itmar behahi behahi kaamar resh lakish dechi ka nachet addata defera ka nachet aval behach deaddata degufeh ka nachet ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan
Vei itmar beha beha kaamar rabbi yochanan aval behach ema mode leh leresh lakish tzericha
Ta shema hakkone ilan vekarkao mevi vekore hacha bemay askinan bizman sheen hayyovel noheg
Ta shema hakkone shene ilanot betoch sadehu shel chavero mevi veeno kore ha shelosha mevi vekore hacha name bizman sheen hayyovel noheg
Vehashta deamar rav chisda machloket beyyovel sheni aval beyyovel rishon divre hakkol mevi vekore deakkatti la semach datayehu la kashya ha beovel rishon ha beovel sheni
Lema ketannae minnayin lallokeach sade meaviv vehikdishah veachar kach met aviv minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza
Talmud lomar im et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato sade sheenah reuya lihot sede achuzza yatzta zo sheruya lihot sede achuzza divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon

Rabbi meir omer minnayin lallokeach sade meaviv umet aviv veachar kach hikdishah minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza talmud lomar im et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato sade sheenah sede achuzza yatzta zo shehi sede achuzza veilu lerabbi yehuda verabbi shimon met aviv veachar kach hikdishah la tzericha kera
May lav beha kamipalgi derabbi meir savar kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame uvha bemitat aviv hu dela yaret vela mide vehilkach met aviv veachar kach hikdishah tzerich kera

Rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon savri kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame uvha bemitat aviv hashta hu deka yaret vehilkach met aviv veachar kach hikdishah la tzericha kera vechi itzterich kera lehikdishah veachar kach met aviv hu deitzterich

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak leolam ema lach bealma kasavri rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame vehacha rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon kera ashkachu udrush lichtov rachamana im et sede miknato asher lo achuzzato may missede achuzzato sade sheenah reuya lihot sede achuzza yatzta zo sheruya lihot sede achuzza

Amar rav yosef i lav deamar rabbi yochanan kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame lo matza yadav veraglav bevet hammidrash deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan haachin shechalku lakochot hen umachzirin ze laze beovel
Vei salka datach lav kekinyan hagguf dame la mashkachatte demayete bikurim ella chad bar chad ad yehoshua bin nun
Amar rava kera umatnita mesayei leh leresh lakish kera
b: Bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach
Matnita detanya bechor notel pi shenayim besade hachozeret leaviv beovel
Amar abbaye naktinan baal benichse ishto tzarich harshaa
Vela amaran ella dela nachet appere aval nachet appere migo demishtae dina appere mishtae dina aggufa
Hadaran alach hashsholeach
Hannizakin shamin lahen beidit uvaal chov bevenonit uchtubbat ishsha beziburit rabbi meir omer af ketubbat ishsha bevenonit
En nifrain minnechasim meshubadim bimkom sheyyesh nechasim bene chorin vaafilu hen ziburit
En nifrain minnichse yetomin ella min hazziburit
En motziin laachilat perot velishvach karkaot
Velimzon haishsha vehabbanot minnechasim meshubadin mippene tikun haolam
Vehammotze metzia lo yishshava mippene tikun haolam
Gema mippene tikun haolam deorayeta hi dichtiv metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem
Amar abbaye la tzericha ella lerabbi yishmael deamar middeorayeta bidnizak shayeminan ka mashma lan mippene tikun haolam shayeminan bidmazzik

May rabbi yishmael detanya metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem metav sadehu shel nizak umetav karmo shel nizak divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer lo ba hakkatuv ella lagbot lannizakin min haidit vekal vachomer lahekdesh

Ulrabbi yishmael achal shemena meshallem shemena achal kechusha meshallem shemena amar rav idi bar avin hacha bemay askinan kegon sheachla aruga ben haarugot vela yadinan i kechusha achal i shemena achal dimshallem leh mimmetav
Amar rava ilu yadinan dichchusha achal meshallem kechusha hashta dela yadinan meshallem shemena hammotzi mechavero alav haraya ella amar rav acha bar yaakov

a: Hacha bemay askinan kegon shehayeta idit denizak keziburit demazzik rabbi yishmael savar bidnizak shayeminan verabbi akiva savar bidmazzik shayeminan
May tama derabbi yishmael neemra sade lematta veneemra sade lemala ma sade haamura lemala denizak af sade haamura lematta denizak
Verabbi akiva savar metav sadehu yeshallem dehayeche deka meshallem
Verabbi yishmael ahanay gezera shava veahani kera ahanay gezera shava lichdaamaran ahani kera dei it leh lemazzik idit veziburit veziburit dideh la shaveya keidit denizak dimshallem leh mimmetav
Rabbi akiva omer lo ba hakkatuv ella lagbot lannizakin min haidit vekal vachomer lahekdesh
May kal vachomer lahekdesh ilema denagcheh tora didan letora dehekdesh shor reehu amar rachamana velo shor shel hekdesh
Ella laomer hare alay mane levedek habbayit deate gizbar veshakel meidit

Lo yehe ella baal chov uvaal chov dino bevenonit vechi tema kasavar rabbi akiva baal chov shakel beidit kenizakin ika lemifrach ma levaal chov shekken yippa kocho benizakin tomar behekdesh shekken hora kocho benizakin

Leolam denagcheh tora didan letora dehekdesh verabbi akiva savar lah kerabbi shimon ben menasya detanya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer shor shel hekdesh shennagach leshor shel hedot patur veshel hedot shennagach leshor shel hekdesh ben tam uven muad meshallem nezek shalem
I hachi mimmay dividit denizak keziburit demazzik peligi dilma dechulle alma bidnizak shayeminan vehacha biflugta derabbi shimon ben menasya verabbanan kamipalgi
Derabbi akiva savar lah kerabbi shimon ben menasya verabbi yishmael savar lah kerabbanan
Im ken may lo ba hakkatuv veod may kal vachomer lahekdesh veod ha amar rav ashe
b: Tanya behedya metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem metav sadehu shel nizak umetav karmo shel nizak divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer metav sadehu shel mazzik umetav karmo shel mazzik
Ravina amar leolam matnitin rabbi akiva hi deamar middeorayeta bidmazzik shayeminan verabbi shimon hi dedaresh tama dikra uma taam kaamar ma taam hannizakin shamin lahen beidit mippene tikun haolam

Detanya amar rabbi shimon mippene ma amru hannizakin shamin lahen beidit mippene haggazlanim umippene hachamsanin kede sheyyomar adam lama ani gozel velama ani chomes lemachar bet din yordin linchasay venotlin sade naa shelli vesomchim al ma shekkatuv battora metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem lefichach amru hannizakin shamin lahen beidit
Mippene ma amru baal chov bevenonit kede shello yire adam lachavero sade naa vedira naa veyomar ekpotz vealvennu kede sheegbennu bechovi lefichach amru baal chov bevenonit
Ella meatta yehe beziburit im ken atta noel delet bifne lovin
Ketubbat ishsha beziburit divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer bevenonit amar rabbi shimon mippene ma amru ketubbat ishsha beziburit sheyyoter mimma shehaish rotze lisa haishsha rotza linase
Davar acher ishsha yotza lirtzonah veshello lirtzonah vehaish eno motziah ella lirtzono

May davar acher vechi tema ki hechi dechi mappek lah ihu takkinu lah rabbanan ketubba mineh ki nafka ihi name litakkeni leh rabbanan ketubba minah ta shema ishsha yotza lirtzonah veshello lirtzonah vehaish eno motzi ella lirtzono efshar dimshahe lah begita
Ketubbat ishsha beziburit amar mar zutra bereh derav nachman la amaran ella miyyatme aval mineh dideh bevenonit
Miyyatme may irya ketubbat ishsha afilu kol mile name deha tenan en nifraim minnichse yetomim ella min hazziburit ella lav mineh
Leolam miyyatme uchtubbat ishsha itztericha leh salka datach amena mishshum china akkilu rabbanan gabbah ka mashma lan

Amar rava ta shema rabbi meir omer ketubbat ishsha bevenonit mimman ilema miyyatme let leh lerabbi meir ha ditnan en nifraim minnichse yetomim ella min hazziburit ella lav mineh mikkelal derabbanan savri beziburit
La leolam miyyatme veshane ketubbat ishsha mishshum china
Amar abbaye ta shema hannizakin shamin lahen beidit uvaal chov bevenonit uchtubbat ishsha beziburit mimman ilema miyyatme may irya ketubbat ishsha afilu kol hane name ella lav mineh
Amar rav acha bar yaakov hacha bemay askinan kegon shennaasa arev lenizke veno levaal chov beno velichtubbat kallato

Vehay ki dineh vehay ki dineh nizakin uvaal chov demechayyim gavu ihu name ki magbe kemechayyim magbe ketubbat ishsha dilachar mita gavya ulachar mita mimman gavya miyyatme ihu name ki magbe kilachar mita magbe
Vetipok leh dearev dichtubba lo mishtabed bekabbelan
Hanicha leman deamar kabbelan af al gav delet leh nichse lelove mishtabad shappir ella leman deamar i it leh mishtabad i let leh la mishtabad may ika lememar
Ibaet ema bedahao leh veishteduf
Veibaet ema kol legabbe bereh shabode meshabad nafsheh
Itmar arev dichtubba divre hakkol la mishtabad

a: Kabbelan devaal chov divre hakkol mishtabad arev devaal chov vekabbelan dichtubba peligi ika leman deamar af al gav delet leh nichse lelove mishtabad veika leman deamar i it leh mishtabad i let leh la mishtabad
Vehilcheta bechullehu af al gav delet leh mishtabad bar mearev dichtubba deaf al gav deit leh la mishtabad
May tama mitzva hu daavad vela mide chasserah
Amar ravina ta shema meikara detakkantin yoter mimma shehaish rotze lisa ishsha rotza linase vei salka datach miyyatme hay mishshum deyatme hu teuvta demar zutra teuvta
Amar mar zutra bereh derav nachman mishshemeh derav nachman shetar chov hayyotze al hayetomin af al pi shekkatuv bo shevach eno gove ella min hazziburit
Amar abbaye tidda devaal chov dineh bevenonit umiyyatme beziburit

Amar leh rava hachi hashta baal chov dineh middeorayeta beziburit kidulla deamar ulla devar tora baal chov beziburit shenneemar bachutz taamod vehaish vego ma darko shel ish lehotzi pachut shebbakkelim uma taam amru baal chov bevenonit kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin vegabbe yatme okmuh rabbanan addeorayeta
Ella hacha kevan dedineh middeorayeta beidit afilu miyyatme name beidit
Ulrava vehatane avram chozaa en nifrain minnichse yetomin ella min hazziburit vaafilu hen nizakin veha nizakin dinan middeorayeta beidit
Hacha bemay askinan kegon shehayeta idit denizak keziburit demazzik
Verabbi yishmael hi deamar middeorayeta bidnizak shayeminan umippene tikun haolam takkinu rabbanan bidmazzik vegabbe yatme okmuh rabbanan addeorayeta
Ini vehatane rabbi eliezer naotaa en nifrain minnichse yetomim ella min hazziburit vaafilu hen idit may afilu hen idit lav af al gav dichtiv idit bishtara
La may idit shefay idit kidrava
Deamar rava hizzik ziburit gove min haidit shefay idit gove min habbenonit vegabbe yatme okmuh rabbanan addeorayeta

En nifrain minnichse yetomin ella min hazziburit bae rav achadvuy bar amme yetomim sheamru ketannim o afilu gedolim takkanta hi daavud rabbanan gabbe yatme liktannim avud rabbanan ligdolim la avud rabbanan
O dilma mishshum dela massek addata demalve demit love venafli nichse kamme yatme dehave leh noel delet hilkach afilu gedolim name
Ta shema detane abbaye kashshisha yetomin sheamru gedolim veen tzarich lomar ketannim
Vedilma hane mile leinyan shevua degadol bemile daavuh kekatan dame aval leinyan ziburit la
Vehilcheta
b: Yetomin sheamru gedolim veen tzarich lomar ketannim ben lishvua ben leziburit
En nifrain minnechasim meshubadim bimkom sheyyesh bene chorin bae rav achadvuy bar amme bemattana heach

Takkanta hu daavud rabbanan mishshum peseda delakochot aval mattana deleka peseda delakochot la o dilma mattana name i lav deit leh hanaa mineh la yahev leh mattana vehilkach ki peseda delakochot dame

Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe ta shema shechiv mera sheamar tenu matayim zuz lifloni vshlosh meot lifloni vearba meot lifloni en omrim kol hakkodem bishtar zacha lefichach yatza alav shetar chov gove mikkullan

Aval im amar tenu matayim zuz lifloni veacharav lifloni veacharav lifloni omrim kol hakkodem bishtar zacha lefichach yatza alav shetar chov gove min haacharon en lo gove mishshellefanav en lo gove mishshellifne fanav
Veaf al gav dekamma benonit uvatra ziburit mizziburit gave mibbenonit la gave shema minah bemattana name avud rabbanan takkanta
Hacha bemay askinan bevaal chov veha tenu kaamar tenu bechovi
Velichze shetara deman kadem deleka shetara veha kol hakkodem bishtar kaamar bishtar pekadta
Veibaet ema afilu mattana name vela kashya may gove min haacharon en nifsad ella acharon
Veibaet ema deshau kullehu lahadade
En motziin laachilat perot may tama amar ulla amar resh lakish lefi sheen ketuvin
Amar leh rabbi abba leulla veha mezon haishsha vehabbanot dichman dichtivi damu vekatane en motziin
Amar leh hatam meikara hachi ittakkun ketuvin hen etzel bene chorin veen ketuvin hen etzel meshubadin

Vechen amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan lefi sheen ketuvin amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi veha mezon haishsha vehabbanot dichman dichtivi damu vekatane en motziin amar leh meikara hachi ittakkun ketuvin hen etzel bene chorin veen ketuvin hen etzel meshubadin
Rabbi chanina amar lefi sheen ketzuvin
Ibaya lehu lerabbi chanina ketzuvin uchtuvin bae

a: O dilma ketzuvin veaf al pi sheenan ketuvim
Ta shema deitmar mi shemmet vehinniach shette banot uven vekadma harishona venatla isur nechasim velo hispika sheniyya ligbot ad shemmet habben
Amar rabbi yochanan sheniyya vitra veamar lo rabbi chanina gedola mizzo amru motziin lefarnasa veen motziin limzonot veatte amratte sheniyya vitra
Veha parnasa demikatz kayetza michtav la ketiva veka motzia
Shane parnasa kevan deit lah kala keman dichtiva dame
Metiv rav huna bar manoach metu benotehen nizzonot minnechasim bene chorin
Vehi nizzonet minnechasim meshubadim mippene shehi kevaalat chov
Hacha bemay askinan beshekkanu miyyado
I hachi banot name beshekkanu lazo velo kanu lazo
May paska bat ishto dahavay bishat kinyan mahane lah kinyan bitto dela havay bishat kinyan la mahane lah kinyan
Mi la askinan dahao tarvayehu bishat kinyan vehechi dame degarshah veahderah
Ella bitto devitnay bet din kaachla la mahane lah kinyan bat ishto delav bitnay bet din kaachla mahane lah kinyan
Vechi migra gara ella bitto kevan devitnay bet din kaachla emar tzerare atpesah
Ta shema amar rabbi natan ematay bizman shekkadam mikkacho shel sheni leshivcho shel rishon
Aval kadam shivcho shel rishon lemikkacho shel sheni gove minnechasim meshubadim alma mishshum dela kadem hu
Tannae hi detanya en motziin laachilat perot velishvach karkaot velimzon ishsha vehabbanot minnechasim meshubadim mippene tikun haolam lefi sheen ketuvin
Amar rabbi yose vechi ma tikun haolam yesh bazo vahalo en ketzuvin

Vehammotze metzia lo yishshava amar rabbi yitzchak shene kisin keshurin matzata li vehalla omer lo matzati ella echad nishba shene shevarim keshurin matzata li vehalla omer lo haya ella echad eno nishba
May tama sheorin minnatchi mehadade kisin la minnatchi mehadade
Shene sheorin keshurin matzata vehalla omer matzati vehechzarti lach echad mehen hare ze nishba
Verabbi yitzchak let leh hammotze metzia la yishshava mippene tikun haolam
b: Hu deamar kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer peamim sheadam nishba al taanat atzmo ketzad mane leavich beyadi veheechaltiv peras hare ze nishba veze hu shennishba al taanat atzmo
Vachachamim omrim eno ella kemeshiv aveda ufatur
Verabbi eliezer ben yaakov let leh meshiv aveda patur amar rav betoano katan
Katan mide meshasha it beh vehatnan en nishbain al taanat cheresh shote vekatan
May katan gadol veammay kare leh katan dilgabbe mile deaviv katan hu
I hachi taanat atzmo taanat acherim hu taanat acherim vehodaat atzmo
Kullehu taanata name taanat acherim vehodaat atzmo ninhu ella bidrabba kamipalgi deamar rabba mippene ma amra tora mode miktzat hattaana yishshava chazaka en adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo

Vehay bechulleh bae lemichpereh leh vehay dela kafreh mishshum deen adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo uvchulleh bae delode leh vehay dela odi leh ishtemote hu deka mishtemit leh savar ad dehau li zuze ufarana leh veamar rachamana remi shevua ilaveh ki hechi delode leh bechulleh
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar la shena bo vela shena bivno eno meez vehilkach lav meshiv aveda hu verabbanan savri bo hu deeno meez aval bivno meez umiddelo meez meshiv aveda hu

a: Matni yetomin shessamchu etzel baal habbayit o shemmina lahen avihen appotroppos chayyav leasser perotehem
Appotroppos shemminahu avi yetomim yishshava minuhu bet din lo yishshava abba shaul omer chiluf haddevarim
Gema urminhu attem velo shuttafin attem velo arisin attem velo appotroppin velo hattorem et sheeno shello
Amar rav chisda la kashya kan lehaachil kan lehanniach

Vehatanya haappotroppin tormin umasserin lehaachil velo lehanniach umochrin lahen behema avadim ushfachot battim sadot uchramim lehaachil aval lo lehanniach umochrin lahen perot yenot shemanim uslatot lehaachil aval lo lehanniach
Veosin lahen lulav vaarava vesukka vetzitzit vechol davar sheyyesh lo kitzva leetoye shofar velokchin lahem sefer tora tefilin umzuzot vechol davar sheyyesh lo kitzva leetoye megila
Veen poskin alehem tzedaka veen podin alehen et hashshevuyin velo kol davar sheen lo kitzva leetoye tanchume avelim
Veen appotroppin rashshain ladun lachuv velizkot benichse yetomim lizkot ammay la ella lachuv al menat lizkot benichse yetomim
Veen appotroppin rashshain limkor berachok veligol bekarov beraa veligol beyafa may tama dedilma mishtaddefin
Veen appotroppin rashshain limkor sadot velikach avadim aval mochrin avadim velokchin bahen sadot rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af lo limkor avadim velikach sadot may tama dilma la meshappeyan
Veen appotroppin rashshain lehotzi avadim lecherut aval mochrin otan laacherim vaacherim motziin otan lecherut rabbi omer omer ani af hu noten deme atzmo veotze mippene shehu kemochro lo
Vetzarich lechashshev immahen baacharona rabban shimon ben gamliel omer eno tzarich en osin appotroppin nashim vaavadim uktannim veim minan avi yetomin harshut beyado

Hahu appotroppos dahava beshivavuteh derabbi meir dahava ka mezabben arata vezaven avde vela shavkeh rabbi meir acho leh bechelmeh ani laharos veatta livnot afilu hachi la ashgach amar divre chalomot lo maalin velo moridin

Hanhu be tere deigari behu satan dechol be shimshe hao ka mintzu bahade hadade ikla rabbi meir lehatam akkevinhu telata be shimshe ad daavad lehu shelama shameh dekaamar vay deappekeh rabbi meir lehahu gavra mibbeteh

Hahu appotroppos dahava beshivavuteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi dahava ka mezabben ara vezaven tore vela amar leh vela mide savar lah kerabbi yose detanya amar rabbi yose miyyamay lo kariti leishti ishti ulshori shori ella leishti beti ulshori sadi

Hanhu yatme dahao semichi gabbe hahi savta hava lehu torta shekala vezabbentah nihalayehu ato kerovim lekammeh derav nachman amaru leh may avidtah dimzabbena amar lehu yetomim shessamchu etzel baal habbayit tenan
Veha iyyakar birshuta delokeach iyyakar veha la nekiti deme
Amar lehu im ken hayenu derav chanilay bar ide amar shemuel deamar rav chanilay bar ide amar shemuel nichse yetomin hare hen kehekdesh vela mikkene ella bechaspa

Chamreh deravna ukva yatma mashchuh bearbea arbea veiyyakar vekam beshita shita ato lekammeh derav nachman amar lehu hayenu derav chanilay bar idi deamar rav chanilay bar idi amar shemuel nichse yetomin hare hen kehekdesh vela mikkene ella bechaspa
Meshuch pere miyyatme iyyakur hayenu derav chanilay bar idi zul lo yehe koach hedot chamur mehekdesh
Immeshichu lehu pere leyatme iyyakar lo yehe koach hedot chamur mehekdesh zul sevur mina hayenu derav chanilay bar idi
Amar lehu rav shisha bereh derav idi ha raa hi ledidhu dezimnin demitztarchi lefere veleka deyahev lehu ad deyahavi zuze
Yahavi yatme zuze appere zul lo yehe koach hedot chamur min hekdesh iyyakar sevur minah hayenu derav chanilay bar idi
Amar lehu rav shisha bereh derav idi ha raa hi ledidhu
b: Deatu lememar lehu nisrefu chitechem baaliyya
Yahavi lehu zuze leyatme appere iyyakar lo yehe koach hedot chamur mehekdesh zul sevur mina hayenu derav chanilay bar idi
Amar lehu rav shisha bereh derav idi ha raa hu ledidhu dezimnin demitztarchi lezuze veleka deyahev lehu ad deyahavi lehu pere
Amar rav ashe ana verav kahana chatminan ashshetara deimeh dizera yatma dimzabbena ara lichraga bela achrazta deamri nehardae lichraga velimzone velikvura mezabbeninan bela achrazta
Amram tzabbaa appotroppa deyatme hava ato kerovim lekammeh derav nachman amri leh ka lavesh umikkasse miyyatme amar lehu ki hechi delishtaman mileh

Kaachel veshate middidhu vela amid emor metzia ashkach veha ka mafsed amar lehu ayeto li sahadi demafsed veesallekineh deamar rav huna chavrin mishshemeh derav appotroppos demafsed mesallekinan leh deitmar appotroppa demafsed rav huna amar rav mesallekinan leh deve rabbi shela amri la mesallekinan leh vehilcheta mesallekinan leh
Appotroppos shemminahu avi yetomim yishshava may tama i lav deit leh hanaa mineh la hava leh appotroppos umishshum shevua la ate leimmenoe
Minuhu bet din lo yishshava milleta bealma hu deaved leve dina vei ramet aleh shevua ate leimmenoe
Abba shaul omer chiluf haddevarim may tama minuhu bet din yishshava behahi hanaa deka nafek aleh kala deinish mehemna hu deha samech aleh be dina mishshum shevua la ate leimmenoe
Minahu avi yetomim lo yishshava milta bealma hu deavdi lahadade vei ramet aleh shevua ate leimmenoe amar rav chanan bar amme amar shemuel hilcheta keabba shaul
Tanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer ze vaze yishshava vahalacha kidvarav

Tane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu appotroppos shemminahu avi yetomim yishshava mippene shehu nose sachar amar leh atte ayetet kabba vechayelatte leh ella ema mippene shehu kenose sachar
Matni hamtamme vehamdammea vehamnassech beshogeg patur bemezid chayyav
Gema itmar menassech rav amar menassech mammash ushmuel amar mearev
Man deamar mearev may tama la amar menassech amar lach menassech kam leh bidrabba mineh
Veidach kidrabbi yirmeya deamar rabbi yirmeya mishsheat hagbaha hu dikna mitchayyev benafsho la have ad sheat nisuch
Ulman deamar menassech may tama la amar mearev amar lach mearev

a: Hayenu medammea
Veidach kenasa hu umikkenasa la yalfinan
Ulman deyalef kenasa mikkenasa kol hane lema li
Tzericha dei tena metamme i teruma hava amena mishshum deka mafsed lah ligmare vei metamme chullin mishshum deasur ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael aval medammea ema la
Vei ashmeinan medammea mishshum dishchiach aval metamme dela shechiach ema la
Vei ashmeinan metamme umdammea mishshum dela kim leh bidrabba mineh
Aval menassech dekim leh bidrabba mineh ema la ka mashma lan kidrabbi yirmeya
Ulha detane avuh derabbi avin barishona hau omrim hamtamme vehamnassech chazru lomar af hamdammea kol hane lema li
Tzericha dei ashmeinan metamme mishshum dela kim leh bidrabba mineh aval menassech dekim leh bidrabba mineh ema la
Vei ashmeinan menassech mishshum deka mafsed leh ligmare aval metamme dela mafsed leh ligmare ema la
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte mishshum dehefsed merubbe aval medammea dehefsed muat ema la tzericha
Amar chizkiyya devar tora echad shogeg veechad mezid chayyav may tama hezek sheeno nikar shemeh hezek
Uma taam amru beshogeg patur kede sheyyodio
I hachi afilu bemezid name hashta leozoke ka mechaven odoe la moda leh

Verabbi yochanan amar devar tora echad shogeg veechad mezid patur may tama hezek sheeno nikar la shemeh hezek uma taam amru bemezid chayyav shello yehe kol echad veechad holech umtamme tohorotav shel chavero veomer patur ani
Tenan hakkohanim sheppiggelu bammikdash mezidim chayyavin vetane alah mippene tikun haolam
Vei amratte hezek sheeno nikar shemeh hezek hay shoggin peturin mippene tikun haolam mibe leh
Hachi name kaamar mezidin chayyavin ha shoggin peturin mippene tikun haolam
Metiv rabbi elazar haose melacha beme chattat uvfarat chattat patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim vei amratte hezek sheeno nikar shemeh hezek bedine adam name lechayyev
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah para shehichnisah lerivka al menat shettinak vetadush me chattat sheshshakal bahen mishkalot
Vehaamar rava me chattat
b: Sheshshakal bahen mishkalot keshera la kashya ha begufan ha bichnegdan
Begufan maase ka aved behu vei hezek sheeno nikar shemeh hezek bedine adam name lechayyev ella ide veide bichnegdan vela kashya ha deassach dateh ha dela assach dateh
Metiv rav pappa gazal matbea venifsal teruma venitmet chametz veavar alav happesach omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha
Vei amratte hezek sheeno nikar shemeh hezek hay gazlan hu mamona mealleya bae shallome teuvta
Lema ketannae hamtamme vehamdammea vehamnassech echad shogeg veechad mezid chayyav divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer beshogeg patur bemezid chayyav
May lav beha kamipalgi demar savar hezek sheeno nikar shemeh hezek umar savar la shemeh hezek
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak dechulle alma hezek sheeno nikar la shemeh hezek vehacha bekansu shogeg attu mezid ka mipalgi demar savar kansu shogeg attu mezid umar savar lo kansu shogeg attu mezid

Verame derabbi meir adderabbi meir verame derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda detanya hamvashshel beshabbat beshogeg yeachel bemezid lo yeachel divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer beshogeg yeachel lemotzae shabbat bemezid lo yeachel olamit

Rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer beshogeg yeachel lemotzae shabbat laacherim velo lo bemezid lo yeachel olamit lo lo velo laacherim kashya derabbi meir adderabbi meir kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda
Derabbi meir adderabbi meir la kashya ki kanes bidrabbanan bidorayeta la kanes
Veha menassech deorayeta hu veka kanes mishshum chumra daavoda zara kanes leh
Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya ki la kanes bidrabbanan bidorayeta kanes veha menassech deorayeta vela kanes mishshum chumra daavoda zara mivdal bedili mineh
Verame derabbi meir adderabbi meir bidorayeta detanya hannotea bashshabbat beshogeg yekayyem bemezid yaakor uvashsheviit ben beshogeg ben bemezid yaakor divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda omer bashsheviit beshogeg yekayyem bemezid yaakor uvashshabbat ben beshogeg ben bemezid yaakor
Ultamach tikkashe lach hi gufah mikkede ha deorayeta veha deorayeta may shena shabbat umay shena sheviit
Ella hatam kidkatane tama amar rabbi meir mippene ma ani omer bashshabbat beshogeg yekayyem bemezid yaakor uvashsheviit ben beshogeg ben bemezid yaakor mippene sheyyisrael monin lashsheviit

a: Veen monin leshabbatot
Davar acher nechshedu yisrael al hashsheviit velo nechshedu al hashshabbatot
May davar acher hachi kaamar vechi tema shabbat name zimnin demikla yom sheloshim beshabbat dei nata hahu yoma hu desalka leh shatta vei la la salka leh shatta
Ta shema davar acher nechshedu yisrael al hashsheviit velo nechshedu al hashshabbatot
Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya beatreh derabbi yehuda chamira lehu sheviit
Dehahu daamar leh lachavero dayyar bar dayyarta amar leh ana la achli pere dishviit keotach

Ta shema achal teruma temea meshallem chullin tehorin shilem chullin temeim mahu amar somchos mishshum rabbi meir beshogeg tashlumav tashlumin bemezid en tashlumav tashlumin vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze tashlumav tashlumin vechozer umshallem chullin tehorim
Vehavenan bah bemezid ammay en tashlumav tashlumin tavo alav beracha deachel mineh mide dela chaze leh bime tumato veka meshallem leh mide dachaze leh bime tumato

Veamar rava veamri lah kedi chassore mechassera vehachi katane achal teruma temea meshallem kal dehu achal teruma tehora meshallem chullin tehorim shilem chullin temein mahu somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir beshogeg tashlumav tashlumin bemezid en tashlumav tashlumin vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze tashlumav tashlumin vechozer umshallem chullin tehorin
Veamar rav acha bereh derav ika hacha bekansu shogeg attu mezid ika benayehu derabbi meir savar lo kansu shogeg attu mezid vachachamim omrim kansu
Hachi hashta hatam gavra leshallome ka mikaven anan nekum velikneseh
Ta shema dam shennitma uzrako beshogeg hurtza bemezid lo hurtza
Amar lach rabbi meir hachi hashta hatam gavra lechappore ka mechaven anan nekum venikneseh
Ta shema hamasser bashshabbat beshogeg yochal bemezid lo yochal hachi hashta hatam gavra letakkone ka mikaven anan lekum velikneseh
Ta shema hammatbil kelim bashshabbat beshogeg yishtammesh bahen bemezid lo yishtammesh bahen hachi hashta hatam gavra letahore mane ka mikaven anan lekum velikneseh
Verame derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda bidrabbanan detanya
b: Naflu venitpatztzeu echad shogeg veechad mezid lo yaalu divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim beshogeg yaalu bemezid lo yaalu
Veha hacha demiddeorayeta chad bitre batel verabbanan hu digzur veka kanes rabbi yehuda hatam hayenu tama derabbi yehuda mishshum deate leiarome
Verame derabbi yose adderabbi yose ditnan netia shel orla veshel kile hakkerem shennitarvu bintiot acherot hare ze lo yelakket veim liket yaalu beechad umatayim uvilvad shello yitkaven lelakket
Rabbi yose omer af hammitkaven lelakket yaalu beechad umatayim
Ha ittemar alah amar rava chazaka en adam oser et karmo bintia achat vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan chazaka en adam oser et karmo bintia achat
Matni hakkohanim sheppiggelu bammikdash mezidin chayyavin

Gema tanu rabbanan haya ose immo bitharot veamar lo teharot sheasiti immecha nitmeu haya ose immo bizvachim veamar lo zevachim sheasiti immecha nitpaggelu neeman aval amar lo teharot sheasiti immecha beom peloni nitmeu uzvachim sheasiti immecha beom peloni nitpaggelu eno neeman
May shena resha umay shena sefa amar abbaye kol shebbeyado neeman
Rava amar kegon deashkecheh vela amar leh vela mide ulvatar hachi ashkecheh vaamar leh

Hahu daamar leh lechavreh teharot sheasiti immecha beom peloni nitmeu ata lekammeh derabbi amme amar leh shurat haddin eno neeman amar lefanav rabbi assi rabbi atta omer ken hachi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ma eese shehattora heeminattu
Hechan heeminattu amar rabbi yitzchak bar bisna kohen gadol beom hakkippurim yochiach dechi amar piggul meheman umna yadinan vehachtiv vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed ella lav mishshum dimheman
Vedilma dishmaneh defaggel i lav dimheman af al gav dishmaneh name la meheman dedilma levatar hachi kaamar
Vedilma dachazeneh befishpash kashya

Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi amme amar leh sefer tora shekkatavti lifloni azkarot shello lo ketavtim lishman amar leh sefer tora beyad mi amar leh beyad lokeach amar leh neeman atta lehafsid secharcha vei atta neeman lehafsid sefer tora
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya nehi dehifsid sechar azkarot sechar desefer tora kulleh mi hifsid amar leh in shekkol sefer tora sheen azkarot shello ketuvot lishman eno shave kelum
Veliabbar alayehu kulmos velikaddesheh keman nema dela kerabbi yehuda
Ditnan hare shehaya tzarich lichtov et hashshem venitkaven lichtov yehuda vetaa velo hetil bo dalet maavir alav kulmos umkaddesho divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim en hashshem min hammuvchar
Afilu tema rabbi yehuda ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda ella bachada azkara aval dechulle sefer tora la mishshum demichaze kimnummar

Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi avahu amar leh sefer tora shekkatavti lifloni gevilin shello lo ibadtim lishman amar leh sefer tora beyad mi amar leh beyad lokeach amar lo mittoch sheatta neeman lehafsid secharcha atta neeman lehafsid sefer tora

a: Umay shena midderabbi amme hatam ika lememar tae bidrabbi yirmeya hacha kevan deka mafsed kulleh agreh vaata vaamar emor kushta kaamar
Matni heid rabbi yochanan ben gudgeda al hachereshet shehissiah aviha shehi yotza beget
Veal ketanna bat yisrael shennisset lechohen sheochelet bitruma veim meta balah yorshah
Veal hammarish haggazul shebbenao bevira sheyyittol et damav mippene takkanat hashshavim
Veal chattat haggezula shello noda lerabbim shehi mechapperet mippene tikun hammizbeach

Gema amar rava meeduto shel rabbi yochanan ben gudgeda amar leedim rau get ze sheani noten lah vechazar veamar lah kinsi shetar chov ze hare zo megoreshet mi la amar rabbi yochanan ben gudgeda la baenan datah hacha name la baenan datah
Peshita mahu detema kevan deamar kinsi shetar chov ze battole batteleh ka mashma lan im ita devatteleh leedim hava amar lehu vehay dekaamar hachi mishshum kisufa
Veal ketanna bat yisrael veilu chereshet la achla may tama gezera shemma yaachil cheresh bechereshet
Velochel katan ochel nevelot hu
Gezera shemma yaachil cheresh befikachat
Velochel bitruma derabbanan gezera shemma ate leochole bitruma deorayeta

Veal hammarish haggazul shebbenao tanu rabbanan gazal marish uvnao bevira bet shammay omrim mekakea kol habbira kullah umachzir marish livalav uvet hillel omrim en lo ella deme marish bilvad mishshum takkanat hashshavin
Veal chattat haggezula ku amar ulla devar tora ben noda uven lo noda enah mechapperet
May tama yeush kedi la kane uma taam amru lo noda mechapperet shello yehu kohanim atzevin
Amri leh rabbanan leulla vehaanan mippene tikun hammizbeach tenan amar lahem kevan dechohanim atzevin nimtza mizbeach batel
Verav yehuda amar devar tora ben noda ben lo noda mechapperet may tama yeush kedi kane
b: Uma taam amru noda enah mechapperet shello yomru mizbeach ochel gezelot
Bishlama leulla hayenu dekatane chattat ella lerav yehuda may irya chattat afilu ola name
La mibaya kaamar la mibaya ola dechalil hi ella afilu chattat name dechelev vadam hu desalek legabbe mizbeach veidach kohanim achli leh afilu hachi gezur shello yomru mizbeach ochel gezelot
Tenan al chattat haggezula shello noda lerabbim shehi mechapperet mippene tikun hammizbeach bishlama leulla nicha ella lerav yehuda ipcha mibe leh
Hachi name kaamar la noda mechapperet noda enah mechapperet mippene tikun hammizbeach

Metiv rava ganav vehikdish veachar kach tavach umachar meshallem tashlume chefel veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vetane alah bachutz ki hay gavena anush karet vei amratte yeush kedi la kane karet may avidteh

Amar rav shezvi karet middivrehem achichu aleh karet middivrehem mi ika amar lehu rava gavra rabba amar milta la techuchu alah karet sheal yede divrehen bata lo okmuha rabbanan birshuteh ki hechi delichayyav alah

Amar rava ha vaday ka mibaya li ki okmuha rabbanan birshuteh mishsheat geneva o mishsheat hekdeshah lemay nafka minah legizoteha uvaldoteha may hadar amar rava mistabbera mishsheat hekdeshah shello yehe chote niskar

Matni lo haya sikarikon bihuda baharuge milchama meharuge hammilchama veelach yesh bah sikarikon ketzad lakach missikarikon vechazar velakach mibbaal habbayit mikkacho batel mibbaal habbayit vechazar velakach missikarikon mikkacho kayyam
Lakach min haish vechazar velakach min haishsha mikkacho batel min haishsha vechazar velakach min haish mikkacho kayyam zo mishna rishona
Bet din shel acharehem amru hallokeach missikarikon noten labbealim revia ematay bizman sheen beyadan likach aval yesh beyadan likach hen kodmin lechol adam
Rabbi hoshiv bet din venimnu sheim shahata bifne sikarikon shenem asar chodesh kol hakkodem likach zacha aval noten labbealim revia
Gema hashta baharuge hammilchama lo haya bah sikarikon meharuge milchama veelach yesh bah sikarikon

Amar rav yehuda lo danu bah din sikarikon kaamar deamar rabbi assi shalosh gezerot gazru gezerta kammayeta kol dela katel likteluh metziata kol dekatel layete arba zuze batrayeta kol dekatel likteluh hilkach kammayeta umtziata kevan dekatli aggav unseh gamar umakne
Batrayeta amri haidana lishkol limchar tavana leh bedina
Amar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv ashre adam mefached tamid umakshe libbo yippol beraa akkamtza uvar kamtza charuv yerushalayim attarnegola vetarnegolta charuv tur malka ashshaka derispak charuv beter
Akkamtza uvar kamtza charuv yerushalayim dehahu gavra derachameh kamtza uvel devaveh bar kamtza avad seodta amar leh leshammaeh zil ayeti li kamtza azal ayeti leh bar kamtza
