Amar rav yehuda amar rav maase bivno uvvitto shel rabbi yishmael ben elisha shennishbu lishne adonim leyamim nizdavvegu shenehem bimkom echad ze omer yesh li eved sheen keofo bechol haolam veze omer yesh li shifcha sheen bechol haolam kullo keofyah

Amru bo venassiem ze laze unchallek bavveladot hichnisum lecheder ze yashav bekeren zavit ze vezo yashva bekeren zavit ze ze omer ani kohen ben kohanim gedolim essa shifcha vezot omeret ani kohenet bat kohanim gedolim ennase leeved uvachu kol hallayela
Kevan sheala ammud hashshachar hikkiru ze et ze venaflu ze al ze vegau bivchiyya ad sheyyatza nishmatan vaalehen konen yirmeya al elle ani vochiyya eni eni yorda mayim
Amar resh lakish maase beishsha achat vetzafnat bat peniel shemah tzafnat shehakkol tzofin beofyah bat peniel bitto shel kohen gadol sheshshimesh lifnay velifnim

Shennitallel bah shabbay kol hallayela lemachar hilbishah shiva chalukim vehotziah lemochrah ba adam echad shehaya mechoar beoter amar lo hareni et yofyah amar lo reka im atta rotze likach kach sheen keofyah bechol haolam kullo
Amar lo af al pi chen hifshitah shishsha chalukim ushvii keraattu venitpallesha baefer amra lefanav ribbono shel olam im alenu lo chasta al kedushshat shimcha haggibbor haggadol lamma lo tachus
Vealeha konen yirmeya bat ammi chigri sak vehitpalleshi vaefer evel yachid asi lach mispad tamrurim ki fitom yavo hashshoded alenu alayich lo neemar ella alenu kivyachol alay vealayich ba shoded
Amar rav yehuda amar rav may dichtiv veashku gever uveto veish venachalato maase beadam echad shennatan enav beeshet rabbo ushvalya denaggare hava

Paam achat hutzrach rabbo lilot amar lo shagger ishtecha etzli vealvenna shiger ishto etzlo shaha immah shelosha yamim kadam uva etzlo amar lo ishti sheshshigarti lecha hechan hi amar lo ani petartiha lealtar veshamati shehattinokot nitallelu bah badderech
Amar lo ma eese amar lo im atta shomea laatzati garshah amar lo ketubbatah merubba amar lo ani alvecha veten lah ketubbatah amad ze vegershah halach hu unsaah

Kevan shehiggia zemanno velo haya lo leforo amar lo bo vaase immi bechovcha vehau hem yoshvim veochlim veshotin vehu haya omed umashke alehen vehau demaot noshrot meenav venoflot bechosehen veal otah shaa nitchattem gezar din veamri lah al shette fetilot bener echad
Lakach min hassikarikon vechu amar rav lo shanu ella deamar lo lech chazek ukni aval bishtar kana ushmuel amar af bishtar name lo kana ad sheyyichtov lo achraut
b: Tanya keoteh dishmuel rabbi shimon ben elazar omer lakach min haishsha vechazar velakach min haish mikkacho kayyam min haish vechazar velakach min haishsha mikkacho batel ad shettichtov lo achraut
Nema tehve teuvta derav amar lecha rav may achraut name shetar
Tanu rabbanan lakach min hassikarikon vaachalah shalosh shanim bifne bealim vechazar umcharah leacher en labbealim al lokeach sheni kelum
Hechi dame i deka taen veamar minach zavnah afilu rishon name i dela ka taen veamar minach zavnah afilu sheni name la
Amar rav sheshet leolam dela ka taen leh uchgon ze toanin leoresh vetoanin lelokeach
Veidach i taen in vei la taen la
Tanu rabbanan habba mechamat chov umechamat anparut en bo mishshum sikarikon veanparut atzmah tzericha shettishhe shenem asar chodesh
Vehaamratte en bah mishshum sikarikon hachi kaamar sikarikon atzmah tzericha shettishhe shenem asar chodesh
Amar rav yosef naktinan en anparut bevavel veha kachazenan deika ella ema en din anparut bevavel may tama kevan deika be dauor vela azel kavel ema achole achel
Gidul bar reilay kabbel ara betaska mibbene vaga akdem veyahev zuze ditlat shenin lesof ata marota kammae amaru leh shatta kammayeta dihavte achalte hashta anan yahavinan anan achlinan

Ato lekammeh derav pappa savar michtav leh tirfa abbene vaga amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa im ken asita sikarikon ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hinniach meotav al keren hatztzevi
Zo mishna rishona bet din shel acharehen amru hallokeach min hassikarikon noten labbealim revia amar rav revia bekarka o revia bemaot ushmuel amar revia bekarka shehen shelish bemaot
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar neche revia zaven umar savar neche chumsha zaven

Metivi zo mishna rishona bet din shel acharehen amru hallokeach min hassikarikon noten labbealim revia veyad bealim al haelona ratzu bekarka notlin ratzu bemaot notlin ematay bizman sheen beyadan likach aval yesh beyadan likach hen kodmin lechol adam
Rabbi hoshiv bet din venimnu sheim shahata bifne sikarikon shenem asar chodesh kol hakkodem likach zacha aval noten labbealim revia bekarka o revia bemaot
Amar rav ashe ki tanya hahi leachar shebbau maot leyado amar rav

a: Ana havay beminyana deve rabbi uminay didi meno beresha
Vehaanan tenan dine mamonot vehatteharot vehattemaot matchilin min haggadol vedine nefashot matchilin min hatztzad
Amar rabba bereh derava veitema rabbi hilel bereh derabbi valas shane minyana deve rabbi dechullehu minyanayehu min hatztzad hao matchilin
Veamar rabba bereh derava veitema rabbi hilel bereh derabbi voles mimot moshe vead rabbi lo matzinu tora ugdulla bemakom echad
Vela ha hava yehoshua hava elazar ha hava elazar hava pinchas veha hava pinchas hao zekenim
Ha hava shaul hava shemuel veha nach nafsheh kullehu shene kaamrinan veha hava david hava ira hayyairi
Veha nach nafsheh kullehu shene baenan ha hava shelomo hava shimi ben gera veha katleh kullehu shene kaamrinan
Ha hava chizkiyya hava shevna ha iktil kullehu shene kaamrinan veha hava ezra hava nechemya ben chachalya
Amar rav acha bereh derava af ani omer mimot rabbi vead rav ashe lo matzinu tora ugdulla bemakom echad vela veha hava huna bar natan shane huna bar natan demechaf hava kayif leh lerav ashe
Matni cheresh romez venirmaz uven betira omer kofetz venikpatz bemittaltelin happaotot mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar bemittaltelin
Gema amar rav nachman machaloket bemittaltelin aval begitin divre hakkol birmiza
Peshita bemittaltelin tenan mahu detema af bemittaltelin ka mashma lan
Ika deamri amar rav nachman kemachloket bemittaltelin kach machloket begitin vehaanan bemittaltelin tenan ema af bemittaltelin

Happaotot mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar bemittaltelin vead kamma machve rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh kevar shet kevar shav rav kahana amar kevar shav kevar tamne bematnita tana kevar tesha kevar eser
Vela peligi kol chad vechad lefi churpeh vetama may amar rabbi abba bar yaakov amar rabbi yochanan mishshum kede chayyav
Vayyomer laasher al hammeltacha hotze levush lechol ovde habbaal may meltacha amar rabbi abba bar yaakov amar rabbi yochanan devar hannimlal venimtach

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan shiger lo bunyam ben nunyam lerabbi sivni vechomes salsala umalmala sivni vechomes keamguza ufalgeh deamguza salsala umalmala kefisteka ufalgu defisteka may malmala davar hannimlal venimtach
Vetautan ad kamma amar rabbi yona amar rabbi zera ad shetut kegadol
Bae abbaye mattenato may rav yemar amar en mattenato mattana mar bar rav ashe amar mattenato mattana

Afchuha veshadderuha lekammeh derav mordochay amar leh zilu emaru levar mar lav hachi hava ovada ki hava kae mar chad kareh aara vechad kareh addarga vaamarna leh mattenato may vaamar lan mattenato mattana achat mattenat shechiv mera veachat mattenat bari achat mattana merubba veachat mattana muetet
Matni ellu devarim amru mippene darche shalom kohen kore rishon veacharav levi veacharav yisrael mippene darche shalom mearvin bevayit yashan mippene darche shalom
b: Bor shehu karov laamma mitmalle rishon mippene darche shalom
Metzudot chayya veofot vedagim yesh bahen mishshum gazel mippene darche shalom rabbi yose omer gazel gamur
Metziat cheresh shote vekatan yesh bahen mishshum gazel mippene darche shalom rabbi yose omer gazel gamur
Ani hamnakkef berosh hazzayit ma shettachtav gazel mippene darche shalom rabbi yose omer gazel gamur
En memachin beyad aniyye goyim beleket shichcha ufea mippene darche shalom
Gema mena hane mile amar rav matna deamar kera vayyichtov moshe et hattora hazzot vayyittenah el hakkohanim bene levi attu ana la yadana dechohanim bene levi ninhu ella kohen beresha vahadar levi
Rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar mehacha veniggeshu hakkohanim bene levi attu anan la yadinan dechohanim bene levi ninhu ella kohen beresha vahadar levi
Rav ashe amar mehacha bene amram aharon umoshe vayyibbadel aharon lehakdisho kodesh kodashim
Rabbi chiyya bar abba amar mehacha vekiddashto lechol davar shebbikdushsha tana deve rabbi yishmael vekiddashto lechol davar shebbikdushsha liftoach rishon ulvarech rishon velitol mana yafa rishon
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef mippene darche shalom deorayeta hi amar leh deorayeta umippene darche shalom
Kol hattora kullah name mippene darche shalom hi dichtiv deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom
Ella amar abbaye lechidmar detanya shenayim mamtinin ze laze bakkeara shelosha en mamtinin habbotzea hu poshet yado techilla veim ba lachlok kavod lerabbo o lemi sheggadol mimmennu harshut beyado
Veamar mar alah lo shanu ella bisuda aval bevet hakkeneset lo deatu leintzoye
Amar rav matna ha deamratte bevet hakkeneset lo la amaran ella beshabbatot veyamim tovim dishchichi rabbim aval besheni uvachamishi la
Ini veha rav huna kare bechahane beshabbatot veom tov shane rav huna daafilu rabbi amme verabbi assi kahane chashivi deeretz yisrael mechaf hao kayefi leh
Amar abbaye naktinan en sham kohen nitparda chavila veamar abbaye naktinan en sham levi kore kohen
Ini vehaamar rabbi yochanan kohen achar kohen lo yikra mishshum pegamo shel rishon levi achar levi lo yikra mishshum pegam shenehem ki kaamrinan beoto kohen
May shena levi achar levi deika pegam shenehem deamri chad minayehu lav levi hu kohen acher kohen name amri chad minayehu lav kohen hu kegon demuchzak lan baavuh dehay sheni dechohen hu
Hacha name demuchzak lan baavuh dehay sheni delevi hu ella amri mamzeret o netina nesev ufasleh lezareh hacha name amri gerusha o chalutza nesev veachaleh lezareh
Sof sof levi mi ka have
Ulman i leoshvin ha ka chazu leh ella leotzin
Shelachu leh bene galila lerabbi chelbo acharehen

a: Mi korin la hava bideh ata veshayeleh lerabbi yitzchak nappacha amar leh acharehen korin talmide chachamim hammunnin parnasim al hatztzibbur veacharehen talmide chachamim haruyin lemannotam parnasim al hatztzibur veacharehen bene talmide chachamim sheavotehen memunnim parnasim al hatztzibbur veacharehen rashe chenesiyyot vechol adam

Shelachu leh bene galil lerabbi chelbo mahu likrot bechummashim bevet hakkeneset betzibur la hava bideh ata shayeleh lerabbi yitzchak nappacha la hava bideh ata sheel be midresha ufashtuha meha deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan sefer tora shechasar yeria achat en korin bo
Vela hi hatam mechassar bemilteh hacha la mechassar bemilteh rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu en korin bechummashin bevet hakkeneset mishshum kevod tzibbur
Verabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu hay sefer aftarata asur lemikre beh beshabbat may tama delo nitan likatev
Mar bar rav ashe amar letaltole name asur may tama deha la chaze lemikre beh vela hi shere letaltole ushre lemikre beh

Derabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish meayeni besifra deaggadta beshabbeta veha lo nitan likatev ella kevan dela efshar et laasot la heferu toratecha hacha name kevan dela efshar et laasot la heferu toratecha
Bea mineh abbaye merabba mahu lichtov megila letinok lehitlammed bah tibe leman deamar tora megila megila nitna tibe leman deamar tora chatuma nitna
Tibe leman deamar tora megila megila nitna kevan dimgila megila nitna kotvin o dilma kevan deidvak idvak
Tibe leman deamar tora chatuma nitna kevan dachatuma nitna en kotvin o dilma kevan dela efshar katvinan amar leh en kotvin uma taam lefi sheen kotvin
Etiveh af hi asta tavla shel zahav shepparashat sota ketuva aleha amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi yannay bealef bet
Etiveh keshehu kotev roe vechotev ma shekkatuv battavla ema kema shekkatuv battavla
Etiveh keshehu kotev roe battavla vechotev ma shekkatuv battavla ma hu katuv battavla im shachav im lo shachav hacha bemay askinan beserugin
Ketannae en kotvin megila letinok lehitlammed bah veim dato lehashlim muttar rabbi yehuda omer bivreshit ad dor hammabbul betorat kohanim ad vayehi bayyom hashshemini

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi benaa tora megila megila nitna shenneemar az amarti hinne vati bimgilat sefer katuv alay rabbi shimon ben lakish omer tora chatuma nitna shenneemar lakoach et sefer hattora hazzot
Veidach name hachtiv lakoach hahu levatar deidvak
Veidach name hachtiv bimgilat sefer katuv alay hahu dechol hattora kullah ikri megila dichtiv vayyomer elay ma atta roe vaomar ani roe megila afa

I name lechidrabbi levi deamar rabbi levi shemone parashiyyot neemru bayyom shehukam bo hammishkan ellu hen parashat kohanim ufarashat leviyyim ufarashat temeim ufarashat shiluach temeim ufarashat achare mot
b: Ufarashat shetuye yayin ufarashat nerot ufarashat para adumma
Amar rabbi elazar tora rov bichtav umiut al pe shenneemar echtov lo rubbe torati kemo zar nechshavu verabbi yochanan amar rov al pe umiut bichtav shenneemar ki al pi haddevarim haelle
Veidach name hachtiv echtov lo rubbe torati hahu atmohe ka matmah echtov lo rubbe torati halo kemo zar nechshavu
Veidach name hachtiv ki al pi haddevarim haelle hahu mishshum detakkifi lemigmerinhu

Daresh rabbi yehuda bar nachmani meturgemaneh derabbi shimon ben lakish ketiv ketov lecha et haddevarim haelle uchtiv ki al pi haddevarim haelle ha ketzad devarim shebbichtav i atta rashshay leomran al pe devarim shebbeal pe i atta rashshay leomran bichtav deve rabbi yishmael tana elle elle atta kotev vei atta kotev halachot
Amar rabbi yochanan lo karat hakkadosh baruch hu berit im yisrael ella bishvil devarim shebbeal pe shenneemar ki al pi haddevarim haelle karatti ittecha berit veet yisrael
Mearvin bevayit yashan mippene darche shalom may tama ilema mishshum kavod veha hahu shipura dahava meikara be rav yehuda ulvassof be rabba ulvassof be rav yosef ulvassof be abbaye ulvassof be rava
Ella mishshum chashada
Bor shehu karov laamma vechu itmar bene nahara rav amar tattae shatu mayya beresha ushmuel amar ilae shatu mayya beresha
Bidmezal kulle alma la feligi ki feligi bemiskar veashkoye shemuel amar ilae shatu mayya beresha deamri anan mekarvinan tefe verav amar tattae shatu mayya beresha deamri nahara kifshateh lezil
Tenan bor hakkarov laamma mitmalle rishon mippene darche shalom targemah shemuel alliba derav beamma hammithallechet al pi voro
I hachi may lememra mahu detema matze amri leh sechar miskar veashki behindaza ka mashma lan
Amar rav huna bar tachlifa hashta dela itmar hilcheta la kemar vela kemar kol deallim gavar

Rav shimi bar ashe ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh lotvan mar beidana amar leh it li idana ledidi velotvan mar belelya amar leh it li mayya leashkoye amar leh ana mashkena leh lemar mayya bimama velotvan mar belelya amar leh lechayye

Azal leilae amar lehu tattae shatu mayya beresha azal letattae amar lehu ilae shatu mayya beresha addehachi sechar miskar veashki ki ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh keve tere avadte li vela taminhu abbaye lefere dehahi shatta

Hanhu bene be charmach daazul kero beresha deshanota veahderuh veshaduh beshilhe nahara ato ilae lekammeh deabbaye amaru leh ka matkel lenaharin amar lehu kero bahadayehu tefe purta amaru leh ka yavshi perin amar lehu zilu salliku nafshayechu mehatam

a: Kulle alma la peligi ki peligi belechi vekukre

Ani hamnakkef berosh hazzayit ma shettachtav vechu tana im liket venatan bayyad hare ze gazel gamur

Rav kahana hava kaazel lehutzal chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava shade ufye veka natran tamre azal ka menakket veachel amar leh chazi mar deviday shedetinhu amar leh meatreh derabbi yoshiyya atta kare aleh vetzaddik yesod olam

En memachin beyad aniyye goyim beleket beshichcha uvfea mippene darche shalom tanu rabbanan mefarnesim aniyye goyim im aniyye yisrael umvakkerin chole goyim im chole yisrael vekovrin mete goyim im mete yisrael mippene darche shalom
Matni mashelet ishsha lachavertah hachashuda al hashsheviit nafa uchvara verechayim vetannur aval lo tavor velo titchan immah

Eshet chaver mashelet leeshet am haaretz nafa uchvara uvoreret vetochenet umrakkedet immah aval mishshettatil et hammayim lo tigga immah lefi sheen machzikin yede ovre avera vechullan lo amru ella mippene darche shalom
Umachzikin yede goyim bashsheviit aval lo yede yisrael veshoalin bishloman mippene darche shalom
Gema may shena resha umay shena sefa amar abbaye rov amme haaretz measserin hen
Rava amar hacha beam haaretz derabbi meir vetuma vetohora derabbanan detanya ezehu am haaretz kol sheeno ochel chullav betahora divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim kol sheeno measser perotav
Veha middekatane sefa mishshettatil et hammayim lo tigga immah mikkelal deresha lav betuma vetohora askinan
Resha vesefa betuma vetohora veresha betumat chullin vesefa betumat challa
Urminhu
b: Tochanin umafkidin etzel ochle sheviit veetzel ochle ferotehen betuma aval lo leochle sheviit velo leochle ferotehen betuma
Amar abbaye hatam bechohen hechashud leechol teruma betuma askinan dahava leh tuma deorayeta
I hachi mafkidin urminhu mafkidin teruma etzel yisrael am haaretz velo etzel kohen am haaretz mippene shellibbo gas bah
Amar rabbi ila hacha bemay askinan bichli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil
Velechush shemma tesitennu ishto nidda
Ella amar rabbi yirmeya la kashya kan beferot shehuchsheru kan beferot shello huchsheru
Urminhu hammolich chittin letachon kuti o letachon am haaretz hare ellu bechezkatan lemaaser velishviit aval lo letuma
Hay may rumya lav okemna beferot shello huchsheru
Udkaare lah may kaare lah mishshum deka bae lemirme achariti alah hare ellu bechezkatan lemaaser velishviit ulchallofe la chayeshinan
Urminhu hannoten lachamoto measser et shehu noten lah veet shehu notel hemenna mippene shechashuda machlefet hammitkalkel
Hatam kidkatane tama amar rabbi yehuda rotze hi betakkanat bittah uvosha mechatanah
Ulalma la chayeshinan vehatnan hannoten lappundakit measser et shehu noten lah veet shehu notel hemenna mippene shemmachlefet hatam morya veamra bar be rav lechol chammima vaana echol karira

Veakkatti lealma la chayeshinan vehatanya eshet chaver tochenet im eshet am haaretz bizman shehi temea aval lo bizman shehi tehora rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af bizman shehi temea lo titchon mippene shechavertah

Amar rav yosef hatam name morya veamra tora middisheh kaachel

Heid rabbi yose ben hamshullam mishshum rabbi yochanan achiv sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben chassama en osin challat am haaretz betohora aval osin isat chullav betahora venotel hemenna kede challa umannichah bichfisha o beanchuta uchshebba am haaretz litol notel et shettehen veeno choshesh
Veen osin terumat zetav betohora aval osin zete chullav betahora venotel hemenna kede teruma umannichah bechilo shel chaver uchshebba am haaretz litol notel et shettehen veeno choshesh
Vetama may amar rabbi yochanan mishshum kede chayyav degabbal umishshum kede chayyav devaddad
Utzricha dei ashmoinan gabbal mishshum dela nefish agreh aval baddad dinfish agreh ema la vei ashmoinan baddad mishshum dela shechiach leh aval gabbal dishchiach leh ema la tzericha

Amar mar notel hemenna kede challa umannichah bichfisha o beanchuta uchshebba am haaretz litol notel et shettehen veeno choshesh velechush dilma naga bah deamrinan leh chazi i nagatte bah hadra letivla
Velechush dilma la ichpat leh hashta letakkone ka mikaven michpat la ichpat leh

Amar mar notel hemenna kede teruma umannichah bechilo shel chaver uchshebba am haaretz litol notel et shettehen veeno choshesh velechush dilma naga bah bishlama hatam it leh hekera hacha may hekera it leh demannach leh bichle gelalim bichle avanim bichle adama
I hachi may irya dechaver afilu deam haaretz name hachi name kaamar bechelim shel am haaretz haruyin lehishtammesh bahen chaver

Machzikin yede goyim bashsheviit machzikin vehaamar rav dimi bar shishna mishshemeh derav en odrin im haggoy bashsheviit veen koflin shalom legoy la tzericha lememra lehu achzuku bealma ki ha derav yehuda amar lehu achzuku rav sheshet amar lehu ashsharta
Veen koflin shalom legoy rav chisda makdem veyahev lehu shelama rav kahana amar lehu shelama lemar

Veshoalin bishloman hashta achzoke machzekinan shoalin bishloman mibaya amar rav yeva lo nitzrecha ella leom edam detanya lo yikkanes adam leveto shel goy beom edo veyitten lo shalom metzao bashshuk noten lo besafa rafa uvchoved rosh

Hadaran alach hannizakin
b: Haomer hitkabbel get ze leishti o holech get ze leishti im ratza lachzor yachzor haishsha sheamra hitkabbel li giti im ratza lachzor lo yachzor

Gema amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe tama dela shaveteh ihi shaliach likabbala ha shaveteh ihi shaliach likabbala ratza lachzor lo yachzor shema minah holech kizchi dame
La leolam ema lach holech lav kizchi dame vehitkabbel get leishti itztericha leh
Desalka datach amena hoil uvaal lav bar shauoye shaliach likabbala hu af al gav dimta gita lideh la leheve gita ka mashma lan dehitkabbel veholech kaamar
Tenan haishsha sheamra hitkabbel li giti im ratza lachzor lo yachzor may lav la shena akkabbala la shena aholacha
La akkabbala

Ta shema lefichach im amar lo habbaal i efshi shettekabbel lah ella holech veten lah im ratza lachzor yachzor tama deamar i efshi ha la amar i efshi im ratza lachzor lo yachzor shema minah holech kizchi dame
Dilma behelach
Peshita ish have shaliach leholacha shekken baal molich get ishto veishsha haveya shaliach likabbala shekken ishsha mekabbelet gitah miyyad balah ish lekabbala vehaishsha leholacha may

Ta shema haomer hitkabbel get ze leishti o holech get ze leishti im ratza lachzor yachzor haishsha sheamra hitkabbel li giti im ratza lachzor lo yachzor may lav bechad shaliach ushma minah kasher lekabbala kasher leholacha la bishne sheluchin
Ta shema lefichach im amar lo habbaal i efshi shettekabbel lah ella holech veten lah im ratza lachzor yachzor veha hacha dechad shaliach hu ushma minah kasher lekabbala kasher leholacha

Peshot minah ish have shaliach lekabbala shekken av mekabbel get levitto ketanna ishsha leholacha tibe lach may amar rav mari ta shema af hannashim sheen neemanot lomar met balah neemanot lehavi et gitah vehatam holacha hi
Amar rav ashe missefa name shema minah dekatane sefa haishsha atzmah mevia et gitah uvilvad shehi tzericha lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam veokemna beholacha shema minah
Itmar have li giti veishtecha amra hitkabbel li giti vehu amar helach kema sheamra
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav afilu higgia get leyadah enah megoreshet shema minah addibura dideh ka samech dei addibura didah ka samech mikki mate gita lidah miha tigarash
Amar rav ashe hachi hashta

a: Bishlama i itmar ipcha hitkabbel li giti veishtecha amra have li giti vehu omer helach kema sheamra veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav kevan shehiggia get leyado megoreshet alma addibura didah hu deka samech
I name leyadah addibura dideh ka samech ella hacha mishshum deakrah shaliach lishlichuteh ligmare hu deamar shaliach likabbala havena leholacha la havena
Amar rav huna bar chiyya ta shema haomer hitkabbel get ze leishti o holech get ze leishti ratza lachzor yachzor tama deratza ha lo ratza have get

Veammay ha baal lav bar shauoye shaliach likabbala hu ella amrinan kevan shennatan enav legarshah memar amar tigarash kol hechi demiggarsha hacha name kevan shennatan enav legarshah memar amar tigarash kol hechi demiggarsha
Hachi hashta hatam adam yodea sheen shelichut lekabbala vegamar venatan leshem holacha hacha tae

Amar rava ta shema ketanna sheamra hitkabbel li giti eno get ad sheyyaggia get leyadah ki mate gita lidah miha miggarsha veammay veha lav shaliach leholacha shavveyeh ella amrinan kevan shennatan enav legarshah memar amar tigarash kol hechi demiggarsha hacha name kevan shennatan enav legarshah memar amar tigarash kol hechi demiggarsha
Hachi hashta hatam adam yodea sheen shelichut lekatan vegamar venatan lah leshum holacha dideh hacha tae

Ta shema have li giti veishtecha amra hitkabbel li giti hitkabbel li giti veishtecha amra have li giti vehu omer holech veten lah zeche lah vehitkabbel lah ratza lachzor yachzor mishshehiggia get leyadah megoreshet
May lav kabbala akkabbala veholacha aholacha
La kabbala aholacha veholacha akkabbala
I kabbala aholacha mikki mate gita lideh lealtar leheve gita shamatte minah deaddibura dideh ka samech
Hachi hashta hatam kaamar leh helach kema sheamra hacha mi kaamar leh helach kema sheamra

Tanu rabbanan hitkabbel li giti veishtecha amra hitkabbel li giti vehu omer holech veten lah zeche lah vehitkabbel lah ratza lachzor lo yachzor rabbi natan omer holech veten lah ratza lachzor yachzor zeche lah vehitkabbel lah ratza lachzor lo yachzor
Rabbi omer bechullan im ratza lachzor lo yachzor aval im amar lo i efshi shettekabbel lah ella holech veten lah ratza lachzor yachzor
Rabbi hayenu tanna kamma ibaet ema i efshi ata leashmoinan veibaet ema ha ka mashma lan man tanna kamma rabbi
Ibaya lehu helach lerabbi natan kizche dame o lav kizche dame
Ta shema haomer hitkabbel get ze leishti o holech get ze leishti ratza lachzor yachzor haishsha sheamra hitkabbel li giti ratza lachzor lo yachzor
b: May lav behelach verabbi natan la beholech verabbi
Ta shema lefichach im amar lo habbaal i efshi shettekabbel lah ella holech veten lah ratza lachzor yachzor tama deamar i efshi ha la amar i efshi ratza lachzor lo yachzor
May lav behelach verabbi natan la beholech verabbi

Ta shema holech get ze leishti ratza lachzor yachzor helach get ze leishti ratza lachzor lo yachzor man shamatte leh deamar beholech ratza lachzor yachzor rabbi natan vekaamar behelach ratza lachzor lo yachzor shema minah helach kizche dame shema minah
Ittemar hitkabbel li giti veishtecha amra hitkabbel li giti vehu omer holech veten lah amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav naasa shelucho ushluchah vecholetzet
Lememra dimsappeka leh lerav i holech kizche dame i lav kizche dame veha ittemar holech mane lifloni sheani chayyav lo amar rav chayyav beachrauto veim ba lachzor eno chozer
Hatam sefek mamona lekulla hacha sefek isura lechumra
Amar rav en haishsha osa shaliach lekabbel lah gitah miyyad sheliach balah verabbi chanina amar ishsha osa shaliach lekabbel lah gitah miyyad sheliach balah
May tama derav ibaet ema mishshum bizzaon devaal
Ibaet ema mishshum chatzerah habba leachar mikan
May benayehu ika benayehu dikdama ihi veshaviyya shaliach meikara
Hahu gavra deshaddar lah gita lidvethu azal shelicha ashkechah ki yatva veka layesha amar lah helach gitach amara leh leheve bidach amar rav nachman im ita lidrabbi chanina avadi bah ovada
Amar leh rava veim ita lidrabbi chanina avadte bah ovada ha lo chazra shelichut etzel habbaal
Shalchuha lekammeh derabbi amme shelach lehu lo chazra shelichut etzel habbaal verabbi chiyya bar abba amar nityashev baddavar
Hadur shalchuha kammeh derabbi chiyya bar abba amar kol hane shalchu lah veazli ki hechi dimsappeka lehu ledidhu hachi name mesappeka lan ledidan
Have davar shebbaerva vedavar shebbaerva choletzet
Hava ovada veatzrechah rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta get vachalitza tarte get mechayyim vachalitza leachar mita
Hahi dahao karu lah nafata azul sahade ketuv tafata amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav asu edim shelichutan
Matkef lah rabba mi kaamar lehu ketuvu chaspa vehavu lah ella amar rabba vadday i ketuv sahade gita mealleya vaavad asu edim shelichutan
Matkef lah rav nachman mi kaamar lehu ketuvu veannechuh bechisayechu ella amar rav nachman kotvin venotnin afilu mea peamim
Bea mineh rava merav nachman kitvu utnu leshaliach mahu salloke sallek lehu o dilma letircha didhu chayesh
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe veolich lah mahu teku
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af haomeret tol li giti im ratza lachzor lo yachzor tanu rabbanan tol li vesa li vihe li beyadecha kullan leshon kabbala hen
Matni haishsha sheamra hitkabbel li giti tzericha shette kite edim shenayim sheomrim befanenu amra ushnayim sheomrim befanenu kibbel vekara afilu hen harishonim vehen haacharonim

a: O echad min harishonim veechad min haacharonim veechad mitztaref immahen
Gema itmar baal omer lefikkadon veshalish omer legerushin mi neeman rav huna amar baal neeman verav chisda amar shalish neeman
Rav huna amar baal neeman deim ita dilgerushin yahaveh nihaleh ledidah hava yahev lah nihalah verav chisda amar shalish neeman deha hemneh
Metiv rabbi abba hodaat baal din kemea edim dame veshalish neeman mishshenehem ketzad ze omer kach veze omer kach shalish neeman
Shane mamon deityehiv limchila
Veha tanya vechen legitin gite mamon vehatanya vechen lishtarot
Mide gabbe hadade tanya
Tenan haishsha sheamra hitkabbel li giti tzericha shette kite edim shenayim sheyyomru befanenu amra ushnayim sheyyomru befanenu kibbel vekara veammay lihemneh leshalish
Mi ka nafek gita mittute yedeh delihemneh
Tinach amra kibel lema li amar rabba ha manni rabbi elazar hi deamar ede mesira karti
Kara lema li amar rav yehuda amar rav bishat hashshemad shanu
Amar rabba umode rav huna dei amara ihi ledidi amar li shalish dilgerushin yahaveh nihaleh mehemna mi ika mide deshalish gufeh la meheman veihi mehemna
Ella i amara kammay didi legerushin yahaveh nihaleh mehemna migo dei baaya amra ledidah yahaveh nihalah baal
Baal omer legerushin veshalish omer legerushin vehi omeret natan li veavad amar rabbi yochanan have davar shebbaerva veen davar shebbeerva pachot mishshenayim
Veammay velihemneh leshalish mi ka nafek gita mittute yedeh delihemneh
Velihemneh levaal deamar rav chiyya bar avin amar rabbi yochanan baal sheamar gerashti et ishti neeman mi kaamar gerashti
Velema chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto deamar rabbi yitzchak haomer lishlucho tze vekaddesh li ishsha setam umet shelucho asur bechol hannashim shebbaolam chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto
b: Hane mile lechumra aval lekulla la
Velihemnah ledidah midderav hamnuna deamar rav hamnuna haishsha sheamra levalah gerashtani neemenet chazaka en haishsha meiza paneha bifne balah
Hane mile hecha deleka deka mesayya lah aval hecha dimsayya lah meiza umiza

Matni naara hamorasa hi veaviha mekabbelin et gitah amar rabbi yehuda en shette yadayim zochot keachat ella aviha mekabbel et gitah bilvad vechol sheenah yechola lishmor et gitah enah yechola lehitgaresh
Gema bemay kamipalgi rabbanan savri yeda yattirta zakki lah rachamana verabbi yehuda savar bimkom aviha yad dilah lav kelum hi

Vechol sheenah yechola lishmor et gitah tanu rabbanan ketanna hayyodaat lishmor et gitah mitgareshet vesheenah yodaat lishmor et gitah enah mitgareshet veezo hi ketanna yodaat lishmor et gitah kol shemmeshammeret gitah vedavar acher
May kaamar amar rabbi yochanan hachi kaamar kol shemmeshammeret davar acher mechamat gitah
Matkef lah rav huna bar manoach ha shota bealma hi ella amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika kol shemmavchenet ben gitah ledavar acher
Amar rav yehuda amar rabbi assi tzeror vezorko egoz venotlo zoche leatzmo veen zoche laacherim chefetz umachziro leachar shaa zoche ben leatzmo uven laacherim
Ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li da veda achat hi may da veda achat hi amar rav chisda echad ze veechad ze zoche leatzmo veen zoche laacherim
Metiv rav chinana vardan ketzad mishtattefin bemavoy manniach et hechavit veomer hare zo lechol bene hammavoy umzakke lahem al yede beno uvitto haggedolim veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim
Hay shifcha hechi dame i deatya shette searot may baaya gabbeh ella lav dela atya shette searot vekatane zocha laacherim
Shane shitufe mevoot derabbanan
Amar rav chisda ishtik vardan may hava leh lememar kol detakkun rabbanan

a: Keen deorayeta takkun
Veidach ki amrinan kal detakkun rabbanan keen deorayeta takkun bemilta deit lah ikar min hattora aval milta delet lah ikar min hattora la
Metiv rav aveya maarimin al maaser sheni ketzad omer adam livno uvitto haggedolim leavdo veshifchato haivrim he lachem maot hallalu ufdu bahen maaser sheni ze veochlo belo chomesh
Hay shifcha hechi dame i deatya shette searot may baaya gabbeh ella lav dela atya shette searot hacha bemay askinan bemaaser bizman hazze derabbanan
Veama haivriyya bizman hazze mi ika vehatanya en eved ivri noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg ella beatzitz sheeno nakuv derabbanan
Amar rava shalosh middot bekatan tzeror vezorko egoz venotlo zoche leatzmo veen zoche laacherim uchnegdan biktanna mitkaddeshet lemeun
Happaotot mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar bemittaltelin uchnegdan biktanna mitgareshet bekidushe aviha
Higgiu leonat nedarim nidrehen neder vehekdeshan hekdesh uchnegdan biktanna choletzet velimkor benichse aviv ad sheyehe ben esrim
Matni ketanna sheamra hitkabbel li giti eno get ad sheyyaggia get leyadah lefichach im ratza habbaal lachazor yachzor sheen katan ose shaliach
Veim amar lo aviha tze vehitkabbel levitti gitah im ratza lachazor lo yachzor
Haomer ten get ze leishti bemakom peloni untano lah bemakom acher pasul hare hi bemakom peloni untano lah bemakom acher kasher
Haishsha sheamra hitkabbel li giti bemakom peloni vekiblo lah bemakom acher pasul rabbi elazar machshir have li giti mimmakom peloni vehevio lah mimmakom acher kasher
Gema verabbi elazar may shena resha dela pelig umay shena sefa diflig
Ihu demiddateh megaresh kafed ihi dival kurchah mitgareshet mara makom hi lo

Matni have li giti ochelet bitruma ad sheyyaggia get leyadah hitkabbel li giti asura leechol bitruma miyyad hitkabbel li giti bemakom peloni ochelet bitruma ad sheyyaggia get leoto makom rabbi elazar oser miyyad
Gema vegita miha have vehaamratte resha la have gita
La tzericha deamra leh hitkabbel li gita bemata machseya vezimnin demashkachatte leh bevavel vehachi kaamra leh mishkal kol hecha demashkachatte leh shikleh mineh
b: Gita la have ad dematet lemata machseya
Verabbi elazar oser miyyad peshita deha mara makom hi lo
La tzericha daamara leh zil lemizrach deiteh bemizrach veka azel lemaarav mahu detema bemaarav ha leteh ka mashma lan dilma bahade dekaazel megas gaes beh vihav leh gita
Haomer lishlucho arev li bitmarim veerav lo bigrogrot bigrogrot veerav lo bitmarim tane chada eruvo eruv vetanya idach en eruvo eruv
Amar rabba la kashya ha rabbanan ha rabbi elazar ha rabbanan deamri kefida ha rabbi elazar deamar mara makom hi lo
Verav yosef amar ha veha rabbanan kan beshello kan beshel chavero

Amar leh abbaye veella ha detanya haomer lishlucho arev li bemigdal veerav lo beshovach beshovach veerav lo bemigdal detanya chada eruvo eruv vetanya idach en eruvo eruv hatam may shello veshel chavero ika
Hatam name ika pere demigdal ufere deshovach
Matni haomer kitvu get utnu leishti garshuha kitvu igeret utnu lah hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu
Patteruha parnesuha asu lah kenimus asu lah karauy lo amar kelum
Gema tanu rabbanan shallechuha shivkuha tarchuha hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu patteruha parnesuha asu lah kenimos asu lah karauy lo amar kelum
Tanya rabbi natan omer patteruha devarav kayyamin pitruha lo amar kelum amar rava rabbi natan devavlaa hu vedayek ben pitruha lefatteruha tanna didan devar eretz yisrael hu la dayek
Ibaya lehu hotziuha mahu izvuha mahu hattiruha mahu hannichuha mahu hoilu lah mahu asu lah kaddat mahu
Peshot miha chada detanya asu lah kaddat asu lah kenimos asu lah karauy lo amar kelum
Matni barishona hau omrim hayyotze bekolar veamar kitvu get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu chazru lomar af hamfaresh vehayyotze bishyara rabbi shimon shezuri omer af hamsukkan
Gema geniva yotze bekolar hava ki hava ka nafek amar havu arba mea zuze lerabbi avina mechamra dinhar panya amar rabbi zera

a: Dera rabbi avina lesilteh vaazal legabbe derav huna rabbeh deamar rav huna gito kemattenato ma mattenato im amad chozer af gito im amad chozer
Uma gito af al gav dela paresh kevan deamar kitvu af al gav dela amar tenu af mattenato kevan deamar tenu af al gav dela keno mineh
Matkef lah rabbi abba i ma mattana yeshnah leachar mita af get yeshno leachar mita hachi hashta bishlama mattana itah leachar mita ella get leachar mita mi ika

Ella rabbi abba hachi ka kashya leh mattenat shechiv mera bemiktzat hi umattenat shechiv mera bemiktzat baaya kinyan mikkelal derav huna savar la baaya kinyan veha kayema lan devaaya kinyan shane hacha demetzave mechamat mita hu
Mikkelal derabbi abba savar metzave mechamat mita baaya kinyan veha kayema lan dela bae kinyan
Ella rabbi abba hachi ka kashya leh chamra la kaamar deme chamra la kaamar mechamra kaamar veidach mechamra kede leyapot et kocho shelachu mittam mechamra kede leyapot et kocho
Matni mi shehaya mushlach levor veamar kol hashshomea et kolo yichtov get leishto hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu
Gema velechush shemma shed hu amar rav yehuda kesherau lo demut adam
Inhu name idmoye idmo dachazo leh bavua inhu name it lehu bavua dachazo leh bavua devavua vedilma inhu name it lehu amar rabbi chanina limdani yonatan beni bavua it lehu bavua devavua let lehu
Vedilma tzara hi tana deve rabbi yishmael bishat hassakkana kotvin venotnin af al pi sheen makkirin
Matni habbari sheamar kitvu get leishti ratza lesachek bah
Maase bevari echad sheamar kitvu get leishti veala lerosh haggag venafal vamet amar rabban shimon ben gamliel im meatzmo nafal hare ze get im haruach dachattu eno get
Gema maase listor

Chassore michassera vehachi katane im hochiach sofo al techilato hare ze get umaase name bevari sheamar kitvu get leishti veala lerosh haggag venafal vamet veamar rabban shimon ben gamliel im meatzmo nafal hare ze get im haruach dachattu eno get

Hahu gavra deal leve chenishta ashkach makre yanoka uvreh deyatvi veyatev inish acharina gabbayehu amar lehu be tere minayechu nichtevu gita lidvethu lesof shechev makre yanoka mi meshauu inashe bera shelicha bimkom abba o la
Rav nachman amar la meshauu inashe bera shelicha bimkom abba verav pappe amar meshauu inashe bera shelicha bimkom abba amar rava hilcheta meshauu inashe bera shelicha bimkom abba
Matni amar lishnayim tenu get leishti
b: O lishlosha kitvu get utnu leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu amar lishlosha tenu get leishti hare ellu yomru laacherim veyichtevu mippene sheasaan bet din divre rabbi meir
Vezo halacha heela rabbi chanina ish ono mibbet haasurin mekubbal ani beomer lishlosha tenu get leishti sheyyomru laacherim veyichtevu mippene sheasaan bet din
Amar rabbi yose numenu lashshaliach af anu mekubbalin sheafilu amar levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim tenu get leishti sheyyilmedu veyichtevu veyittenu
Amar laasara kitvu utnu get leishti echad kotev ushnayim chotmin kullechem ketovu echad kotev vechullam chotmin lefichach im met echad mehen hare ze get batel

Gema amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba shelachu leh mibbe rav lishmuel yelammedenu rabbenu amar lishnayim kitvu utnu get leishti veamru lesofer vechatav vechatmu hen mahu shelach lehu tetze vehaddavar tzarich talmud
May haddavar tzarich talmud ilema mishshum dehau lehu mile umsappeka leh mile i mimasran leshaliach i la mimasran leshaliach
Vehaamar shemuel amar rabbi halacha kerabbi yose deamar mile la mimasran leshaliach
Ella lishmuel ha ka mibaya leh hay ketovu i ketav yadan i ketav hagget
Vetifshot leh mimmatnitin amar lishnayim tenu get leishti o lishlosha kitvu get utnu leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu

Hi gufa ka mibaya leh ketovu ketav yadan hu o ketav hagget hu peshita dichtav hagget hu dekatane sefa amar rabbi yose numenu lashshaliach af anu mekubbalin sheafilu amar levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim tenu get leishti sheyyilmedu veyichtevu veyittenu lah
I amratte bishlama ketav hagget hu shappir ella i amratte ketav yadan hu mi ika be dina dela yadi michtam chatimat yedayehu in ika be dina chadta
Vei sevira lan dehay ketovu ketav yadan hu ha ketav hagget kasher vehaamar shemuel amar rabbi halacha kerabbi yose deamar mile la mimasran leshaliach

Amri i seviri lan dichtovu ketav yadan hu ketav hagget naasa keomer imru umode rabbi yose beomer imru umi mode rabbi yose beomer imru vehatnan katav sofer veed kasher veamar rabbi yirmeya chatam sofer shaninu
Veamar rav chisda matnitin manni rabbi yose hi deamar mile la mimasran leshaliach
Vei salka datach mode rabbi yose beomer imru nafek minah churba dezimnin deamar lehu lishnayim

a: Imru lesofer veyichtov velifloni ufloni veyachtomu umishshum kisufa desofer chayeshi umachtemi chad mehanach sahadi vesofer bahadayehu uvaal la amar hachi
Kevan deamar mar kasher velo tease ken beyisrael la shechiach

Velechush dilma amar lehu leve tere imru lesofer veyichtov veattem chatomu veazli hanach mishshum kisufa desofer umachtemi leh lesofer bahade chad minayehu uvaal la amar hachi amri ha name kasher velo tease hu
Hanicha leman deamar kasher velo tease ella leman deamar kasher vetaase may ika lememar
Ella rabbi yose tarte amar ushmuel savar lah keoteh bachada uflig aleh bachada

Gufa amar shemuel amar rabbi halacha kerabbi yose deamar mile la mimasran leshaliach amar lefanav rabbi shimon berabbi meachar sherabbi meir vachanina ish ono cholkin al rabbi yose ma raa rabbi lomar halacha kerabbi yose
Amar lo shetok beni shetok lo raita et rabbi yose ilmale reito nimmuko immo

Detanya isi ben yehuda haya mone shivchan shel chachamim rabbi meir chacham vesofer rabbi yehuda chacham lichsheyyirtze rabbi tarfon gal shel egozin rabbi yishmael chanut meuzzenet rabbi akiva otzar balum rabbi yochanan ben nuri kuppat harochlim rabbi elazar ben azarya kuppa shel besamim mishnat rabbi eliezer ben yaakov kav venaki rabbi yose nimmuko immo rabbi shimon tochen harbe umotzi kima
Tana meshakkeach kima uma shemmotzi eno motzi ella subbin vechen amar rabbi shimon letalmidav banay shenu middotay shemmiddotay terumot mitterumot midotav shel rabbi akiva
Gufa amar lishnayim imru lesofer veyichtov velifloni ufloni veyachtomu amar rav huna amar rav kasher velo tease zot beyisrael
Amar leh ulla lerav nachman veamri lah rav nachman leulla meachar dechasher ammay lo tease zot beyisrael amar leh chayeshinan shemma tiskor edim
Umi chayeshinan vehatanya edim hachatumin al sede mikkach veal get ishsha lo chashu chachamim ledavar ze maase la avdi dibbura kaamri
Amar lishnayim imru lesofer veyichtov veattem chatomu rav chisda amar kasher velo tease rabba bar bar chana amar kasher vetease
Rav nachman amar kasher velo tease rav sheshet amar kasher vetease rabba amar kasher velo tease rav yosef amar kasher vetease
b: Veika deafech lehu

Amar laasara kitvu get tanu rabbanan amar laasara kitvu get utnu leishti echad kotev al yede kullam kullechem ketovu echad kotev bemaamad kullam holichu get leishti echad molich al yede kullam kullechem holichu echad molich bemaamad kullam
Ibaya lehu mana otan mahu rav huna amar mana eno kechullechem rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi elazar demin roma amar mana hare hu kechullechem
Amar rav pappa vela peligi ha demana kullehu veha demana miktzatayehu amri lah lehay gisa veamri lah lehay gisa
Atken rav yehuda begita dechullechem ketovu o kullechon o kol chad vechad minchon chatomu o kullechon o kol tere minchon ovilu o kullechon o kol chad vechad minchon
Amar rava zimnin degaez leh ledibureh veamar kullechon vela amar kol chad minchon veate leipsole
Ella amar rava ketovu kol chad minchon chatomu kol tere minchon ovilu kol chad minchon
Hadaran alach haomer
Mi sheachazo kurdeyakos veamar kitvu get leishti lo amar kelum amar kitvu get leishti vaachazo kurdeyakos vechazar veamar lo tichtevennu en devarav haacharonim kelum
Nishtattek veamru lo nichtov get leishtecha vehirkin berosho bodkin oto shelosha peamim im amar al lav lav veal hen hen hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu
Gema may kurdeyakos amar shemuel denachteh chamra chadta dematzarta velitne mi shenneshacho yayin chadash ha ka mashma lan deha rucha kurdeyakos shemah
Lemay nafka minah likmia may asuteh bisra summaka aggumre vechamra marka

Amar abbaye amara li em leshimsha bat yoma kuza demayya bat tere yome sikure bat telata yome bisra summaka aggumre vechamra marka leshimsha attikta layete tarnegolta ukkamti velikreah sheti vaerev veligallecheh limtziata deresheh velotveh ilaveh venannecheh ilaveh ad demisrach
Velinchot velekum bemayya ad tzavvereh ad dechalesh alma ilaveh velemod velislak velitev vei la lechol karrate velinchot velekum bemayya ad tzavvereh ad dechalesh alma ilaveh velemod velislak velitev
Leshimsha bisra summaka aggumre vechamra marka letalga bisra shammina aggumre vechamra chayya

Rav amram chasida ki hava metzaarin leh be resh galuta hao magnu leh attalga limchar amaru leh may nicha leh lemar delayeto leh amar hane kol deamena lehu mefach afchi amar lehu bisra summaka aggumre vechamra marka ayeto leh inhu bisra shammina aggumre vechamra chayya
Shama yalta umayela leh leve massuta umokmi leh bemayya deve massuta ad dimhafchi mayya deve massuta vehau dema vekae bisreh peshite peshite
Rav yosef iasek berichya rav sheshet iasek bichshure amar gedola melacha shemmechammemet et bealeha

Amar leh resh galuta lerav sheshet may tama la saed mar gabban amar leh dela meallu avde dachashidi aever min hachay amar leh mi yemar amar leh hashta machvena lach amar leh leshammaeh zil genov ayeti li chada kara mecheveta

Ayeti leh amar lehu ahdemu li hadme decheveta ayeto telat kare otivu kammeh amar lehu ha baalat shalosh raglayim havay pesuk ayeto chada mealma otivu kammeh amar leh leshammaeh otvah name lehach didach otvah amar lehu hay bat chamesh raglayim havay
Amar leh i hachi libedu kammeh shammaeh demar velechol amar leh lechayye karivu takka kammayehu veayeto kammeh bisra veotivu kammeh ristana dechanka chamta gashshesheh veshaklah karchah besudareh
Levatar deachel amri leh

a: Igniv lan kasa dechaspa bahade deka meayeni veatu ashkechuha dichricha besudareh

Amri leh chazi mar dela mechal ka bae ella letzaoran amar lehu ana mechal achali utami beh tama dechivara amri leh chivara la avid lan haidana amar lehu bedaku beduchteh deamar rav chisda ukkama bechivara vechivara beukkamta lakuta hi beduk ashkechuh

Ki ka nafek kero leh bera ushdo leh tzipta ilaveh veamri leh lete mar lenach nechar leh rav chisda meachoreh amar leh leyanoka pesok li pesukach amar leh nete lecha al yemincha o al semolecha amar le leshammaeh may ka chazet amar leh tzipta deshadya amar leh hadar minah
Levatar dinfak amar leh rav chisda mena hava yada mar amar leh chada dinchar li mar veod difsak li yanoka pesuka veod dachashidi avde dela meallu

Asiti li sharim vesharot vetaanugot bene haadam shidda veshiddot sharim vesharot ellu mine zemer vetaanugot bene haadam ellu berechot umerchatzaot shidda veshiddot hacha targimu sheda veshedtin bemareva amri shidta
Amar rabbi yochanan shelosh meot mine shedim hau beshichin vesheda atzmah eni yodea ma hi

Amar mar hacha targimu sheda veshedtin sheda veshedtin lemay ibi leh dichtiv vehabbayit behibbanoto even shelema massa nivna vego amar lehu lerabbanan hechi eeved amaru leh ika shamira deayeti moshe leavne efod
Amar lehu hecha ishtechach amaru leh ayeti sheda veshedtin kavshinhu ahadade efshar deyadi umgallu lach ayeti sheda veshedtin kavshinhu ahadade amri anan la yadinan dilma ashmeday malka deshede yada

Amar lehu hecha iteh amri leh iteh betura pelan karya leh bera umalya leh mayya umikasseya betinara vachatima begushpankeh vechol yoma salek lirkia vegamar metivta dirkia venachet leara vegamar metivta deara veate sayer leh legushpankeh umgalle leh veshate umchasse leh vechatem leh veazel

Shaddereh livnayahu ben yehoyada yehav leh shushilta dachakik alah shem veizketa dachakik alah shem ugvave deamra vezike dechamra azal kera bera mittattay ushfinhu lemayya vesatminhu bigvave deamra uchra bera meilay veshafchinhu veshafcheh lechamra vetamminhu selek yetev beilana

Ki ata sayereh legushpanka galleyeh ashkecheh chamra amar ketiv letz hayyayin home shechar vechol shoge bo lo yechkam uchtiv zenut veyayin vetirosh yikkach lev la ishti ki tzache la saggi leh ishti reva ugna
Nechet ata sheda beh shushilta setameh ki ittear hava ka miparzal amar leh shema demarach alach shema demarach alach
Ki naket leh veate meta dikla chaf beh shadyeh meta leveta shadyeh meta gabbe kubba dehahi armalta nefaka
b: Ichannana leh kefa lekomteh mineh itvar beh garma amar hayenu dichtiv velashon rakka tishbor garem

Chaza samya dahava ka tae beorcha assekeh leorcheh chaza raveya dahava ka tae beorcha assekeh leorcheh chaza chedveta dahao kamchaddi lah becha shameh lehahu gavra dahava kaamar leushkafa aved li mesane leshav shene achech chaza hahu kassama dahava kasem achech

Ki meta lehatam la ayeluh legabbeh dishlomo ad telata yome yoma kamma amar lehu ammay la ka vae li malka legabbeh amaru leh anseh mishteya shekal leventa otev achavirtah ato amaru leh lishlomo amar lehu hachi amar lechu hadur ashkeuh
Limchar amar lehu veammay la ka bae li malka legabbeh amaru leh anseh mechla shekal leventa mechavirtah otvah aara ato amaru leh lishlomo amar lehu hachi amar lechu negidu mineh mechleh

Lesof telata yome ayal lekammeh shekal kanya umshach arbea garmide ushda kammeh amar leh mikkedi ki mayet hahu gavra let leh behaden alma ella arbaa garmide hashta kevashteh lechulle alma vela sevate ad dichvashte name ledidi

Amar leh la ka vaena minach mide baena deevneyeh levet hammikdash veka mibe li shamira amar leh ledidi la mesir li lesara deyamma maser leh vela yahev leh ella letarnegola bara dimheman leh ashshevuateh
Umay aved beh mamte leh leture delet behu yishshuv umannach leh ashshina detura ufaka tura umnakket mayeti bizrane meilane veshade hatam vehave yishshuv vehayenu dimtargeminan naggar tura

Bedaku kina detarnegola bara deit leh bene vechappeuh lekineh zuggita chivarti ki ata bae lemeal vela matze azal ayeti shamira veotveh illaveh rema beh kala shadyeh shakleh azal chanak nafsheh ashshevuateh
Amar leh benayahu may tama ki chaziteh lehahu samya dahava ka tae beorcha assekteh leorcheh amar leh machrezi aleh birkia detzaddik gamur hu uman daavad leh nicha nafsheh zache lealma deate
Umay tama ki chazeteh lehahu raveya dekatae beorcha assekteh leorcheh amar leh machrezi aleh birkia derasha gamur hu veavdi leh nicha nafsheh ki hechi delechleh lealma
May tama ki chazeteh lehahu chedveta bechet amar leh bae memat gavra bego telatin yomin uvaaya mintar leyavam katan telesre shenin
May tama ki shemateh lehahu gavra daamar leh leushkafa aved li mesane leshav shenin achechte amar leh hahu shiva yome let leh mesane leshav shenin bae
May tama ki chazeteh lehahu kassama dahava kasem achechte amar leh dahava yetev abbe gazza demalka liksom may deika tuteh
Tarcheh gabbeh ad devanyeh levet hammikdash yoma chad hava kae lechodeh amar leh ketiv ketoafot reem lo veamrinan ketoafot ellu malache hashsharet reem ellu hashshedim may revutayechu minan

Amar leh shekol shushilta minay vehav li izketach veachvi lach revutay shakleh leshushilta mineh veyahev leh izketeh baleh otveh lechad gappeh birkia ulchad gappeh beara patkeh arba mea parse al hahi shata amar shelomo ma yitron laadam bechol amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh

Veze haya chelki mikkol amali may veze rav ushmuel chad amar maklo vechad amar gundo haya mechazzer al happetachim kol hecha dimta amar ani kohelet hayiti melech al yisrael birushalam ki meta gabbe sanhedrin amaru rabbanan mikkedi shote bachada milta la serich may hay
Amaru leh livnayahu ka vae lach malka legabbeh amar lehu la shelachu lehu lemalkeota kaate malka legabbayechu shelachu lehu in kaate shelachu lehu bidku bechareh shelachu lehu bemuke kaate
Veka tava lehu benidutayehu veka tava lah name levat sheva imeh atuh lishlomo vehavu leh izketa veshushilta dachakik aleha shem ki ayel chazyeh perach

Vaafilu hachi hava leh biatuta mineh vehayenu dichtiv hinne mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah miggibbore yisrael kullam achuze cherev melummede milchama ish charbo al yerecho mippachad ballelot
Rav ushmuel chad amar melech vehedot vechad amar melech vehedot umelech
Lidma deresha layete shurbina uvina veasa dara vezeta vechilfa vechilfe deyamma veyavla velishlokinhu bahade hadade velintol telat mea kase ahay gisa deresha utlat mea kase ahay gisa deresha
Vei la layete varda chivara dekae bechad dara velishlekeh velintol shitin kase ahay gisa deresha veshitin kase ahay gisa deresha
Litzlichta layete tarnegola bara velishchateh bezuza chivara ahahu gisa dechayev leh venizdehar middemeh dela lesamminhu leeneh velitleyeh besefa devava dechi ayel chayef beh vechi nafek chayef beh

a: Livrukti layete akrabba deshav chumre unyabsheh betulla venishchok tarte menata kuchla vachada menata mineh velimle talta machchale behay ena utlata machchale behay ena tefe la limalle dei la paka eneh

Leshavrire delelya nete shudra barka venesar chada kara mineh vachada kara mikkalba venitrefu yanoke chaspa abbatreh velemru leh assa kalba achsa tarnegola veligbe shav umtze mishshiva batte velitvinhu nihaleh betzinora dedashsha venechlinhu bekilkele demata batar hachi lifshot shudra barka venemru hachi shavrire difloni bar pelonita shavkinhu lishbekuh lifloni bar pelonita velicharu lechalba bevavita deeneh

Leshavrire dimama layete shiva summake miggauo decheveta venitvinhu achaspa deummana velitev ihu miggavay veinish acharina meabbaray venema leh avira hav li deechol venema leh hayeche peticha sav echol uvatar deachel litbereh lechaspa dei la hadri ilaveh
Lidma deate minnechira lete gavra kohen dishmeh levi velichtov leh levi lemafrea vei la layete inish mealma venichtov leh ana pappe shela bar summake lemafrea

Vei la nichtov leh hachi taam deli beme chesef taam deli beme fegam vei la layete ikara deaspasta veashla defurya attika vekurtesa umorike vesummaka deluliba veniklinhu bahade hadade velayete gevava deamra venigdol tarte petilata velitmish bechalla venigadbel bekitma haden venitev binchireh

Vei la lichze ammat hammayim deazla mimmizrach kelappe maarav venifsa venekum chad kara lehay gisa vechad kara lehay gisa venishkol tina bideh deyammina mittute kara dismaleh uvideh dismala mittute kara deyammineh venigdol tarte petilata deamra venitmish betina venitev binchireh
Vei la letev tute marzava venayeto mayya velishdo aleh velemru ki hechi defaski hane mayya lifsok demeh diflanya bar pelanita
Lidma deate mippumma badkinan leh begila dechitta i sarech merea kaate veit leh takkanta vei la mikkavda kaate velet leh takkanta
Amar leh rav amme lerav ashe vehaanan ipcha tenan nital hakkaved velo nishtayyer hemenna kelum harea shennikva o shechasra amar leh kevan demippummeh kaate emar itmoche itmach

Amar mar i merea kaate it leh takkanta may takkanteh layete shiva kune mippirma desilka veshiva kune pirma decharrate vechamsha kune perida utlata kune ditlafche vechuna dechammona vechuna dechavle detavle uchnegdan kanta petirta velivashshel velechol velishte abbatreh shichra charifa detevet

Lechakka amar rabba bar rav huna layete tuma yechidaa venimreseh bemishcha umilcha venitteveh attufra deilona dehahu gisa dechayev leh venahdar leh gedanfa delesha venizdehar levisreh dekashe lechivara

Lechinche amar rabbi yochanan chumti ki mamru veikara dechumti adif mimmamru veninkot befummeh hane leokome levashshole layete pare deresh nafya utlafche beafrayehu veshuvlilta vechumarta dichshuta veninkot keamguza befummeh
Leiptoche linpach leh chavreh tachle chivarta begila dechitta leassoke layete afra mittulla devet hakkisse venigbol beduvsha venechol dimalle leh

Levarsam layete ki fisteka denishadur vechi amguza dechelbenita duvshanita umle taroda duvsha chivara umle natla bat machoza chamra nekida venishlokinhu bahade hadade vechi beshil nishadur beshil leh kulleh vei la layete revieta dachalava deiza chivarti
b: Venitayefeh attelat kilche kerava venivchasheh bigoza demarmehin vechi beshil geoza demarmahin beshil leh kulleh vei la layete nifka dechalba chivara venigbol benitfa vechamma deefshar nifka la nechol dimfarek
Legira layete gira delilita venefcheh venishde mayya illaveh venishte vei la layete mimmayya deishti minayehu kalba belelya venizdehar miggiluya legiluya anpaka dechamra chayya
Lemursa anpaka dechamra beahala tolana

Lefircha deliba layete telat beroshiyyata disare venishterinhu bechamka dela avar ilaveh arbein yomin venechol venishte abbatrayehu chamra marka amar leh rav acha middifti leravina vechol shekken defarach libeh amar leh ana leukra deliba amari
Lefircha deliba layete telat beroshiyyata dechite venishterinhu beduvsha venechol venishte abbatrayehu chamra chayya
Letzircha deliba layete telat bee ninya uveata dechammona uveata deshumsheme velechol
Lichev mee layete telat mea pilpele arichata vechol yome nishte mea minayehu bechamra ravin demin naresh avad lah levarteh derav ashe mea vechamshin mehane didan veittesiat
Lechirtza anpaka dechamra baatarpa dearaa lechirtza chivara layete bizra galgila venitzyereh beshistag venityereh bemayya venishteyeh venizdehar mibbinta dei la menakkeva lah lemayaneh
Lemesar sisin rattiva bemayya lemishre yabbishta bemayya vesimanach itza rattivta desachar nahara

Litchala layete shav bine demayya unyabshinhu betulla vechol yoma nishte tarte vetilta bechamra vei la layete techala ditzfirta dela iptach venitchayeh betannura venoke lahadeh venema ki hechi deyabbish hay techala niyyabash techaleh difloni bar pelonita

Vei la nitchayeh bene urve deveta chadta venema hachi vei la livke shachva dishchev beshabbeta venishkeleh lideh venotvah attechaleh venema ki hechi deyabbish ha yeda niyyabash techaleh difloni bar pelonita
Vei la nayete binita venitveyeh be nappacha venechleh bemayya deve nappacha venishte mimmayya deve nappacha hahi iza dahavat shatya mayya deve nappacha ishtechit vela ishtechach lah techala
Vei la liftach chavita dechamra lishmeh amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe i it leh chavita dechamra la ate lekammeh demar ella margal befat shacharit dimalleya lechulle gufeh
Lerushchata layete akkika veilo veaspircha umartecha vechumarta defilon ushyafa dachamimta veninkot beshachake dechitana bekayeta vedaamar gufna besitva vei la lishte shichra marka
Leshigrona layete patya demonine venigandereh shitin zimne aha metachteh veshitin zimne aha metachteh
Litzmirta nete telat nitufyata mishcha dechufra utlat nitufyata itzra decharrate utlat nitufyata dechamra nekida velishde leh leish baamma ulishsha beoto makom
Vei la layete unna dezika velitle leh leish baamma ulishsha baddaddin vei la layete chote dizhorita disdoteha duma bat duma velitle leh leish baamma ulishsha baddaddin

Vei la layete kina dezachar unkeva velitle leh leish baamma ulishsha beoto makom vechi mashtin nashtin assisana yabbishta betzinora dedashsha unayyen bechumarta denafka mineh dimalleya lechullehu tzimri

Letzimra bara layete telata gerive sufle utlata gerive atraf addara venishlokinhu kol chad lechodeh velitev benayehu velotvinhu betarte meshichle venayete patura venannach ilaveh venekum meilave hay veletev ilave hay umeilave hay veletev ilave hay ad denisak beh havla velische minayehu vechi shate mimmayya deaddara lishte mimmayya desufle la lishte mishshum dimakkeri
Letzimra gavena layete shiva bune desilka mishshav meshare venishlokinhu beafrayehu venechol venishte atraf addara beshichra o

a: Inve taala bemayim
Lachazazita layete shav chite arzanyata veniklinhu ammara chadta venafek mishcha minayehu veneshuf rav shimi bar ashe avad leh lehahu goy ledavar acher veitassi
Amar shemuel hay man dimcho leh baalonke defarsae michya la chaye addehachi vehachi nispo leh bisra shammina aggumre vechamra chayya efshar dechaye purta umfakked abbeteh
Amar rav idi bar avin hay man divla zibura michya la chaye addehachi vehachi nashkeyeh revieta dechalla shamgaz efshar dechaye purta umfakked leveteh
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi achal besar shor belefet velan ballevana belele arbaa asar o chamishsha asar bitkufat tammuz ochazto achilu

Tana vehammalle kereso mikkol davar ochazto achilu amar rav pappa afilu mittamre peshita salka datach amena hoil veamar mar tamre masbean umshachanan umshalshelan umashsheran vela mefannekan ema la ka mashma lan
May achilu amar rabbi elazar esh shel atzamot may esh shel atzamot amar abbaye esh garme
May asuteh amar abbaye amara li em kullehu shakyane telata veshiva utresar vehay ad demittasse

Kullehu shakyane alliba rekana vehay batar deachel veshate veayel levet hakkisse venafek umashe yedeh umayetu leh buna dishtita ditlafche uvuna dechamra attika venigbelinhu bahade hadade venechol venichroch bisdineh venagneyeh veleka denokmeh ad dekae minnafsheh vechi kae lishkeleh lisdineh mineh vei la hadar ilaveh
Amar leh eliyyahu lerabbi natan echol shelish ushte shelish vehannach shelish lichshettichos taamod al miluecha

Tane rabbi chiyya harotze shello yavo lide choli meayim yehe ragil betibul kayitz vachoref seudatcha shehanaatcha mimmenna meshoch yadcha hemenna veal teshahe atzmecha beshaa sheatta tzarich linkavecha
Amar mar ukva hay man deshate tilya chivara ochazto vitek amar rav chisda shitin mine chamra hao mealleya dechullehu summaka rechatana geria dechullehu tilya chivara
Amar rav yehuda hay man deyatev betzafrane nisan gabbe nura veshayef mishcha venafek veyatev beshimsha ochazto vitak
Tanu rabbanan hikkiz dam veshimesh mittato hoviyn lo banim vitkin hikkizu shenehem veshimshu hoviyn lahen banim baale ratan amar rav pappa la amaran ella dela taem mide aval taem mide let lan bah

Amar rabba bar rav huna ba min hadderech veshimesh mittato hoviyn lo banim vitkin tanu rabbanan habba mibbet hakkisse al yeshammesh mittato ad sheyyishhe shiur chatzi mil mippene sheshshed bet hakkisse melave immo veim shimesh hoviyn lo banim nichpim
Tanu rabbanan hamshammesh mittato meummad ochazto avit meushshav ochazto dalarya hi millemala vehu millematta ochazto dalarya
May dalarya amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi sam dalarya dardara may dardara amar abbaye morika dechoche rav pappa ales uvala leh rav pappe ales veshade leh
Amar abbaye mi sheeno baki bederech eretz lete shelosha kefize kurteme dechoche venedukinhu venishlekinhu bechamra venishte amar rabbi yochanan hen hen hechziruni lenaaruti
Shelosha devarim machchishim kocho shel adam veellu hen pachad derech veaon pachad dichtiv libbi secharchar azavani chochi derech dichtiv inna vadderech kochi aon dichtiv kashal baaoni chochi
Shelosha devarim mattizin gufo shel adam veellu hen achal meummad veshata meummad veshimesh mittato meummad
Chamishsha kerovin lemita yoter min hachayyim veellu hen achal veamad shata veamad hikkiz dam veamad yashen veamad shimesh mittato veamad

Shishsha haose otan miyyad met veellu hen habba badderech venityaga hikkiz dam venichnas levet hammerchatz veshata venishtakker veyashan al gabbe karka veshimesh mittato amar rabbi yochanan vehu sheasaan kesidran
Amar abbaye kesidran met shello kesidran chalesh ini veha meurat avada leh leavdah telat minayehu umit hahu kachush hava

Shemona memaatim et hazzera veellu hen hammelach veharaav vehannetek bechiyya veshena al gabbe karka vegudgedaniyyot uchshut shello bizmannah vehakkazat dam lematta kiflayim

Bemay kamipalgi resh lakish medamme leh leyashen verabbi yochanan medamme leh leshote

Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel shachat bo shenayim o rov shenayim veramaz veamar kitvu get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu
Vetanya rauhu meguyyad o tzaluv al hatztzeliva veramaz veamar kitvu get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu
Hachi hashta hatam data tziluta hi uchchishuta hu deatchila beh hacha data shegishta hi
Umi amar shemuel hachi vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel shachat bo shenayim o rov shenayim uvarach meidin alav vei salka datach chay hu ammay meidin alav
Amri chay hu vesofo lamut
Ella meatta yehe gole al yado allema tanya shachat bo shenayim o rov shenayim hare ze eno gole
Ha itmar alah amar rabbi hoshaya chayeshinan shemma haruach bilbelattu i name hu kerav et mitato
May benayehu ika benayehu deshachteh beveta deshesha ufarkes i name deshachteh bevara vela parkes

a: Ella befere

Amar rav kahana amar rav cheresh sheyyachol ledabber mittoch hakketav kotvin venotnin get leishto amar rav yosef may ka mashma lan tenena nishtattek veamru lo nichtov get leishtecha vehirkin berosho bodkin oto shelosha peamim im amar al lav lav veal hen hen hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu
Amar leh rabbi zera illem kaamratte shane illem detanya medabber veeno shomea zehu cheresh shomea veeno medabber zehu illem veze vaze hare hen kefikchin lechol divrehem
Umimmay dimdabber veeno shomea zehu cheresh shomea veeno medabber zehu illem dichtiv vaani checheresh lo eshma uchillem lo yiftach piv vei baet ema kidamri inashe ishtekil miluleh
Amar rabbi zera i kashya li ha kashya li detanya im lo yaggid perat leillem sheeno yachol lehaggid ammay ha yachol lehaggid mittoch hakketav
Amar leh abbaye edut kaamratte shane edut derachamana amar mippihem velo mippi chetavam
Metivi keshem shebbodkin oto legitin kach bodkin oto lemassaot ulmattanot ulediyyot velirushshot katane mihat ediyyot
Amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav sheshet beedut ishsha daakilu bah rabbanan
Veha katane yerushshot amar rabbi avahu yerushshat beno habbechor
Katane mihat lemassaot ulmattanot may lav lealma la ledideh
Metivi cheresh lo halchu bo achar remizotav veachar kefitzotav veachar ketav yado ella bemittaltelin aval lo legitin
Tannae hi detanya amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim becheresh meikaro aval pikeach venitcharesh hu kotev vehen chotmin
Vecheresh meikaro lo keshem shekkonsah birmiza kach motziah birmiza
I beishto hachi name hacha bemay askinan bivimto

Veibaet ema leolam dinfala leh meachiv cheresh ugzera achiv cheresh attu achiv pikeach
I hachi ishto name yevimto bivimto michallefa ishto bivimto la michallefa
Umi gazrinan cheresh attu pikeach
b: Vehatnan shene achin chershin nesuin shette achaot pikchot o shette achaot chershot o shette achaot achat pikachat veachat chereshet vechen shette achaot chershot nesuot lishne achin pikchin o lishne achin chershin o lishne achin echad pikeach veechad cheresh hare ellu peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum

Ella mechavarta kidshannin meikara

Amar abbaye af anan name tenena nishattet lo yotzi nitcharesh hu o nishtatta lo yotzi olamit may olamit lav af al gav deyachol ledabber mittoch hakketav

Uma taam amru enah mitgareshet shello yinhagu bah minhag hefker

Matni amru lo nichtov get leishtecha veamar lahen ketovu amru lassofer vechatav velaedim vechatmu af al pi shekketavuhu vachatamuhu untanuhu lo vechazar untano lah hare hagget batel ad sheyyomar lassofer ketov velaedim chatomu
Gema tama delo amar tenu ha amar tenu notnin manni rabbi meir hi deamar mile mimasran leshaliach
Ema sefa ad sheyyomar lassofer ketov velaedim chatomu atan lerabbi yose deamar mile la mimasran leshaliach
Resha rabbi meir vesefa rabbi yose in resha rabbi meir vesefa rabbi yose
Abbaye amar kullah rabbi meir hi vehacha bemay askinan dela amar tenu i hachi ad sheyyomar tenu mibe leh
Ella hacha bemay askinan dela amar leve telata i hachi ad sheyyomar lishlosha mibe leh
Ella kullah rabbi yose hi vehacha bemay askinan dela amar imru
I hachi ad sheyyomar imru mibe leh
Veod mi mode rabbi yose beomer imru vehatnan katav sofer veed kasher veamar rabbi yirmeya chatam sofer shaninu veamar rav chisda matnitin manni

Matni ze gitich im matti ze gitich mecholi ze ze gitich leachar mita lo amar kelum mehayyom im matti meachshav im matti hare ze get
Mehayyom ulachar mita get veeno get veim met choletzet velo mityabemet
Ze gitich mehayyom im matti mecholi ze veamad vehalach bashshuk vechala vamet omdin oto im mechamat choli harishon met hare ze get veim lav eno get
Gema alma im matti kilachar mita dame vahadar tane mehayyom im matti meachshav im matti alma im matti lav kilachar mita dame
Amar abbaye im matti shette leshonot mashma mashma kemeachshav umashma kilachar mita
Amar lah mehayyom keman deamar lah meachshav dame lo amar lah mehayyom keman deamar lah leachar mita dame
Ze gitech im matti lo amar kelum amar rav huna vecholetzet
Veha lo amar kelum katane lo amar kelum daasira lealma ulyavam name asira
Veha middesefa choletzet mikkelal deresha yabbome name miyyabbema matnitin kerabbanan
Verav huna deamar kerabbi yose deamar zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav
I rabbi yose chalitza name la tive vechi tema mesappeka leh lerav huna i hilcheta kerabbi yose o en halacha kerabbi yose umi mesappeka leh

Veha rabba bar avuh chalash ul legabbeh rav huna verav nachman amar leh rav huna lerav nachman bei mineh merabba bar avuh halacha kerabbi yose o en halacha amar leh tama derabbi yose la yadana halacha eve mineh amar leh atte bei mineh halacha vetameh derabbi yose ana amena lach
Bea mineh amar leh hachi amar rav halacha kerabbi yose levatar dinfak amar leh hayenu tama derabbi yose dekasavar zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav ella mesappeka leh
b: I amar rabbi yose beal pe i la amar
Umi mesappeka leh vehatnan hare ze gitich im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh umet betoch shenem asar chodesh eno get vetane alah rabbotenu hittiruha lehinashe
Veamrinan man rabbotenu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel be dina dishro mishcha vesavri lah kerabbi yose deamar zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav
Ella mesappeka leh i halacha kerabbi yose beal pe o en halacha
Umi mesappeka leh vehaamar rava hare ze gitich im matti vesheani met hare ze get kesheamut ulachar mita en ze get
Hechi dame ilema deamar lah mehayyom verabbanan tzericha lememar vehatnan mehayyom im matti hare ze get veella lav dela amar lah mehayyom verabbi yose shema minah halacha kerabbi yose
Lerava peshita leh lerav huna mesappeka leh
Veibaet ema leolam daamar lah mehayyom verabbanan vehane lishane itzterichi leh sheani met keim matti dame kesheamut kilachar mita dame
Veika dematne lah assefa ze gitich leachar mita lo amar kelum amar rav huna uldivre rabbi yose choletzet
Peshita middesefa lerabbanan choletzet resha name lerabbi yose choletzet
Mahu detema rabbi yose beha kerabbi sevira leh deamar gita mealleya have vachalitza name la tive ka mashma lan dela rabbi savar lah kerabbi yose vela rabbi yose savar lah kerabbi
Rabbi la savar lah kerabbi yose dekatane kaze get lemaote derabbi yose verabbi yose la savar lah kerabbi dekatane kaze get lemaote derabbi
Rabbi may hi detanya mehayyom ulachar mita get veeno get divre chachamim rabbi omer kaze get
Rabbi yose may hi ditnan kitvu utnu get leishti im lo bati mikan vead shenem asar chodesh ketavuhu betoch shenem asar chodesh untanuhu leachar shenem asar chodesh eno get rabbi yose omer kaze get
Ze gitich mehayyom im matti mecholi ze veamad vehalach bashshuk ku
Amar rav huna gito kemattenato ma mattenato im amad chozer af gito im amad chozer
Uma gito af al gav dela paresh kevan deamar ketovu af al gav dela amar tenu af mattenato kevan deamar tenu af al gav dela keno mineh
