Hacha bemay askinan daamar leh zerok li chovi vetipater i hachi may lememra la tzericha daamar leh zerok li chovi betorat gitin
Veakkatti may lememra mahu detema matze amar leh meshatte ani bach ka mashma lan
Amar rav chisda get beyadah umshicha beyado im yachol lenatteko velahavio etzlo enah megoreshet veim lav megoreshet
May tama baenan keritut veleka
Amar rav yehuda hayeta yadah asuya kekatafres uzrako lah af al pi shehiggia get leyadah enah megoreshet
Ammay ha ki nafel bearba ammot didah ka nafel bidla nach
Vetigarash meavera dearba ammot tifshot devae rabbi elazar arba ammot sheamru yesh lahen avir o en lahen avir tifshot deen lahen avir
Hacha bemay askinan beomedet al gav hannahar demeikara leibud kae

a: Matni hayeta omedet al rosh haggag uzrako lah kevan shehiggia laavir haggag hare zo megoreshet hu millemala vehi millematta uzrako lah kevan sheyyatza mershut haggag nimchak o nisraf hare zo megoreshet
Gema veha la mintar amar rav yehuda amar shemuel begag sheyyesh lo maake askinan
Ulla bar menashsheya mishshemeh daavimi amar hacha befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag askinan dechol pachot mishshelosha samuch laggag kegag dame
Hu millemala veha la mintar amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kegon shehau mechitzot hattachtonot odfot al haelonot
Vechen amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya kegon shehau mechitzot hattachtonot odfot al haelonot vechen amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan kegon shehau mechitzot hattachtonot odfot al haelonot
Amar leh rabbi abba leulla keman kerabbi deamar keluta kemi shehunnecha damya
Amar leh afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi ella leinyan shabbat aval hacha mishshum intore hu veha ka mintar
Vechen amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan kegon shehau mechitzot hattachtonot odfot al haelonot amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi keman kerabbi deamar keluta kemi shehunnecha damya
Amar leh afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi ella leinyan shabbat aval hacha mishshum intore hu veha ka mintar
Nimchak amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lo shanu ella shennimchak derech yerida aval nimchak derech aliyya la may tama meikara la lemenach kae
Nisraf amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lo shanu ella shekkadam get lidleka aval kadma deleka leget la may tama meikara lisrefa kaazel
Amar rav chisda reshuot chalukot begitin
Amar leh rame bar chama lerava mena leh lesava ha amar leh matnitin hi hayeta omedet al rosh haggag uzrako lah kevan shehiggia get laavir haggag hare zo megoreshet
Bemay askinan ilema begag didah vechatzer didah lema li avir haggag
Ella begag dideh vechatzer dideh ki higgia laavir haggag may have

Ella peshita begag didah vechatzer dideh ema sefa hu millemala vehi millematta uzrako lah kevan sheyyatza mershut haggag nimchak o nisraf hare zo megoreshet vei begag didah vechatzer dideh ammay megoreshet ella begag dideh vechatzer didah
Resha begag didah vechatzer dideh sefa begag dideh vechatzer didah
Ella lav deoshlah makom dechad makom moshli inashe tere mekomot la moshli inashe
Amar leh mide irya dilma ha kiditah veha kiditah resha begag didah vechatzer dideh sefa begag dideh vechatzer didah
Amar rava shalosh middot begitin ha deamar rabbi keluta kemi shehunnecha ufligi rabbanan aleha hane mile leinyan shabbat aval hacha mishshum intore hu veha mintar

Veha deamar rav chisda naatz kane birshut hayyachid uvrosho teraskal vezarak venach al gabbav afilu gavoha mea amma chayyav lefi shershut hayyachid ola ad larakia hane mile leinyan shabbat aval hacha mishshum intore hu veha la mintar
b: Veha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo yaamod adam begag ze veyiklot me geshamim miggaggo shel chavero shekkeshem sheddiyyurin chalukin millematta kach diyyurin chalukin millemala
Hane mile leinyan shabbat aval leinyan get mishshum kefida hu vechulle hay la kafdi inashe
Amar abbaye shette chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo penimit shellah vechitzona shello umchitzot hachitzonot odfot al happenimiyyot uzrako lah kevan shehiggia laavir mechitzot hachitzona hare zo megoreshet
May tama penimit gufah bimchitzot hachitzona ka minatra
Ma sheen ken bekuppot shette kuppot zo betoch zo penimit shellah vechitzona shello uzrako lah afilu higgia laavir penimit enah megoreshet
May tama deha la nach
Vechi nach may have kilo shel lokeach birshut mocher hu
Hacha bemay askinan bekuppa sheen lah shulayim
Matni bet shammay omrim poter adam ishto beget yashan uvet hillel osrin veezehu get yashan kol shennityached immah meachar shekketavo lah
Gema bemay kamipalgi bet shammay savri la amrinan gezera shemma yomru gitah kodem livnah
Uvet hillel savri amrinan gezera shemma yomru gitah kodem livnah
Amar rabbi abba amar shemuel im niset lo tetze
Veika deamri amar rabbi abba amar shemuel im nitgarsha tinase lechattechilla
Matni katav leshum malchut sheenah hogenet leshum malchut maday leshum malchut yavan levinyan habbayit lechurban habbayit
Haya bammizrach vechatav bammaarav bammaarav vechatav bammizrach tetze mizze umizze utzricha get mizze umizze
Veen lah lo ketubba velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot lo al ze velo al ze
Im natla mizze umizze tachzir vehavalad mamzer mizze umizze velo ze vaze metammein lah velo ze vaze zakkain lo bimtziatah velo bemaase yadeha velo bahafarat nedareha
Hayeta bat yisrael nifselet min hakkehunna

a: Bat levi min hammaaser bat kohen min hatteruma
Veen yorshin shel ze veorshin shel ze yorshim ketubbatah veim metu achiv shel ze veachiv shel ze choltzin velo meyabmin
Shina shemo ushmah shem iro veshem irah tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu bah
Kol araot sheamru tzarotehen muttarot
Halchu hatztzarot haellu venisu venimtzeu ellu ayeloniyyot tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu bah
Hakkones et yevimto vehalcha tzaratah veniset leacher venimtzet zo shehayeta ayelonit tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu bah
Katav sofer get laish veshovar laishsha vetaa venatan get laishsha veshovar laish venatnu ze laze
Ulachar zeman hare hagget yotze miyyad haish veshovar miyyad haishsha tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu bah
Rabbi elazar omer im lealtar yatza en ze get im leachar zeman yatza hare ze get lo kal hemennu min harishon leabbed zechuto shel sheni
Gema may malchut sheenah hogenet romi veammay kare lah malchut sheenah hogenet mishshum deen lahem lo ketav velo lashon
Amar ulla mippene ma tiknu malchut begitin mishshum shelom malchut
Umishshum shelom malchut tetze vehavalad mamzer
In rabbi meir letameh deamar rav hamnuna mishshemeh deulla omer haya rabbi meir kal hamshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim begitin havalad mamzer
Leshum malchut yavan utzricha dei ashmoinan malchut sheenah hogenet mishshum dimlicha aval malchut maday umalchut yavan may dahava hava
Vei ashmeinan malchut maday umalchut yavan mishshum demalchevata hau aval binyan habbayit may dahava hava
Vei ashmeinan binyan habbayit deamri kamadkeri shevachayehu aval churban habbayit detzaara hu ema la tzericha
Haya bammizrach vechatav bammaarav man ilema baal hayenu shina shemo ushmah shem iro veshem irah

Ella lav sofer kedaamar lehu rav lesafreh vechen amar lehu rav huna lesafreh ki yatvitu beshile ketuvu beshile veaf al gav demimasran lechu mile behine vechi yatvitu behine ketuvu behine veaf al gav demimasran lechu mile beshile
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel
b: Zo divre rabbi meir aval chachamim omrim afilu lo katav ella leshem santar shebbair hare zo megoreshet
Hahu gita dahava ketiv beh leshem istandera devashkar shalcheh rav nachman bar rav chisda lekammeh derabba ki hay gavena may
Shelach leh beha afilu rabbi meir mode may tama meotah malchut hu
Umay shena missantar shebbair hatam zila lehu milta hacha shevicha lehu milta
Amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav zo divre rabbi meir aval chachamim omrim havalad kasher umodim chachamim lerabbi meir sheim shina shemo ushmah shem iro veshem irah shehavalad mamzer
Amar rav ashe af anan name tenena shina shemo ushmah shem iro veshem irah tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu bah
Ha man katane lah ilema rabbi meir liarvinhu velitninhu ella shema minah rabbanan shema minah
Kol araot sheamru ku nisu en zinu la
Lema tehve teuvta derav hamnuna deamar rav hamnuna shomeret yavam shezzinta asura livamah
La nisu vehu haddin lezinu vehay dekatane nisu lishana mealleya naket
Veika deamri nisu vehu haddin lezinu
Lema mesayya leh lerav hamnuna deamar rav hamnuna shomeret yavam shezzinta asura livamah
La nisu daveka mishshum demichallefa beishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam
Hakkones et yevimto ku utzricha dei ashmeinan behach kammayeta mishshum dela ikayyam mitzvat yibbum
Aval hacha deikayyam mitzvat yibbum ema la
Vei ashmeinan hacha mishshum deka ramya kammeh aval hatam dela ramya kammeh ema la tzericha
Katav hassofer vetaa venatan get laishsha veshovar vechu rabbi eliezer omer im lealtar yatza vechu
Hechi dame lealtar vehechi dame leachar zeman amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol zeman sheyyoshvin vaasukin beoto inyan zehu lealtar amdu zehu leachar zeman
Verav adda bar ahava amar lo niset zehu lealtar niset zehu leachar zeman
Tenan lo kol hemennu min harishon leabbed zechuto shel sheni bishlama lerav adda bar ahava hayenu dekatane sheni ella lishmuel may sheni

a: Zechut haruya lashsheni
Matni katav legaresh et ishto venimlach bet shammay omrim pesalah min hakkehunna uvet hillel omrim af al pi shennetano lah al tenay velo naasa hattenay lo pesalah min hakkehunna
Gema shelach leh rav yosef bereh derav menashshe middevil lishmuel yelammedenu rabbenu yatza alav kol ish peloni kohen katav get leishto veoshevet tachtav umshammashto mahu
Shelach leh tetze vehaddavar tzarich bedika may hi ilema dei mevattelinan kala o la mevattelinan veha nehardea atreh dishmuel hi uvinhardea la mevatteli kala ella dei karu lintina ketiva
Vechi karu lintina ketiva lichtiva gufah mi la karu lah ketiva
In dei migalleya milta dekaru lintina ketiva dilma natan kaamri
Tetze vehaamar rav ashe kol kala devatar nisuin la chayeshinan leh
May tetze name tetze mishsheni
Im ken atta motzi laaz al banav shel rishon kevan demishsheni hu demappekinan lah umerishon la mappekinan lah ate lememar samuch lemita gershah
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda bar ilay bo ure shello kedorot harishonim dorot haacharonim
Dorot harishonim bet shammay dorot haacharonim rabbi dosa detanya shevuya ochelet bitruma divre rabbi dosa
Amar rabbi dosa vechi ma asa lah arvi ze mippene shemmiech lah ben daddeha pesalah min hakkehunna

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda bar ilay bo ure shello kedorot harishonim dorot haacharonim dorot harishonim machnisin perotehen derech teraksemon kede lechayevan bemaaser dorot haacharonim machnisin perotehen derech gaggot vederech karpefot kede lefotran min hammaaser
Deamar rabbi yannay en hattevel mitchayyev bemaaser ad sheyyire pene habbayit shenneemar biarti hakkodesh min habbayit
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu chatzer kovaat shenneemar veachlu visharecha vesaveu
Matni hamgaresh et ishto velana immo befundeki bet shammay omrim enah tzericha hemennu get sheni uvet hillel omrim tzericha hemennu get sheni
Ematay bizman shennitgarsha min hannissuin umodim benitgarsha min haerusin sheenah tzericha hemennu get sheni mippene sheen libbo gas bah
Gema amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan machloket besherauha shennivala
b: Devet shammay savri adam ose beilato beilat zenut
Uvet hillel savri en adam ose beilato beilat zenut aval lo rauha shennivala divre hakkol enah tzericha hemennu get sheni
Tenan umodim benitgarsha min haerusin sheenah tzericha hemennu get sheni sheen libbo gas bah vei besherauha shennivala ma li min haerusin uma li min hannissuin

Ella matnitin beshello rauha shennivala verabbi yochanan deamar ki hay tanna detanya amar rabbi shimon ben elazar lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al shello rauha shennivala sheenah tzericha hemennu get sheni
Al ma nechleku al sherauha shennivala shebbet shammay omrim adam ose beilato beilat zenut uvet hillel omrim en adam ose beilato beilat zenut
Umatnitin deokemna belo rauha shennivala bemay peligi deika ede yichud veleka ede via
Bet shammay savri la amrinan hen hen ede yichud vehen hen ede via uvet hillel savri amrinan hen hen ede yichud vehen hen ede via
Umodim benitgarsha min haerusin sheenah tzericha hemennu get sheni dechevan deen libbo gas bah la amrinan hen hen ede via
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna veokimna lematnitin beshello rauha shennivala amorae ninhu vealliba derabbi yochanan
Matni kenasah beget kereach tetze mizze umizze vechol hadderachim haellu bah
Get kereach hakkol mashlimin alav divre ben nannas rabbi akiva omer en mashlimin alav ella kerovim haruyin lehaid bemakom acher
Veezehu get kereach kol shekkesharav merubbin meedav
Gema may tama deget kereach gezera mishshum kullechem
Get kereach hakkol mashlimin alav
Verabbi akiva eved may tama la deatu lememar kasher leedut karov name atu lememar kasher leedut
Ella eved hayenu tama dedilma atu leassokeh leuchasin
Gazlan devar yuchasin hu litachshar allema tenan rabbi akiva omer en mashlimin alav ella kerovim haruyin lehaid bemakom acher karov in gazlan la
Ella eved hayenu tama deatu lememar shachrore shachrereh gazlan name atu lememar teshuva avad karov may ika lememar karov kulle alma yadi dekarov hu

Amar rabbi zera amar rabba bar sheelta amar rav hamnuna sava amar rav adda bar ahava get kereach kesharav shiva veedav shishsha shishsha veedav chamishsha chamishsha veedav arbaa arbaa veedav shelosha ad kan machloket ben nannas verabbi akiva aval kesharav shelosha veedav shenayim divre hakkol en mashlimin alav ella karov
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabba bar sheelta mikkede kol shelosha bimkushshar kishnayim befashut dame ma hatam karov la af hacha name karov la
Amar leh af ledidi kashya li ushelteh lerav hamnuna verav hamnuna lerav adda bar ahava vaamar leh hannach lishlosha bimkushshar delav deorayeta
Tanya name hachi get kereach kesharav shiva veedav shishsha shishsha veedav chamishsha chamishsha veedav arbaa arbaa veedav shelosha ad kan machloket ben nannas verabbi akiva
Hishlim alav eved ben nannas omer havalad kasher verabbi akiva omer havalad mamzer aval kesharav shelosha veedav shenayim divre hakkol en mashlimin alav ella karov
Rav yosef matni kasher vehatanya karov amar rav pappa teni kasher
Amar rabbi yochanan lo huchsheru bo ella ed echad karov bilvad aval tere la dilma ate lekayyome bitre kerovim vechad kasher
Amar rav ashe matnita name dayeka

a: Deka medalleg vetane chad chad shema minah
Amar abbaye shema minah hay karov chatem i bae ben battechila ben baemtza ben bassof
Mimmay middela keva leh makom ushma minah mikkol telata mekayeminan vela baenan retzufin
Dei salka datach baenan retzufin likba leh makom lehay karov battechila o baemtza o bassof velachshar beh tuva
Ki atu lekammeh derabbi amme amar leh tze vehashlem alav eved min hashshuk
Hadaran alach hazzorek

Hamgaresh et ishto veamar lah hare atte mutteret lechol adam ella lifloni rabbi eliezer mattir vachachamim osrim ketzad yaase yittelennu hemenna veyachazor veyittenennu lah veyomar lah hare atte mutteret lechol adam ketavo betocho af al pi shechazar umchako pasul
Gema ibaya lehu hay ella chutz hu o al menat hu
Chutz hu uvchutz hu difligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer deha shayyar lah beget aval beal menat modu leh mide dehave akkol tenae dealma
O dilma al menat hu uval menat hu diflig rabbi eliezer adderabbanan aval bechutz mode deha shayyar lah beget

Amar ravina ta shema kol habbattim mittammein bingaim ella shel goyim i amratte bishlama chutz hu shappir ella i amratte al menat hu al menat dela mitammu batte goyim hu demitammu batte yisrael ha mitammu batte goyim la mittammei batte yisrael
Veod batte goyim mi mittammei vehatanya venatatti nega tzaraat bevet eretz achuzzatchem eretz achuzzatchem mittammea bingaim veen batte goyim mittammein bingaim ella shema minah chutz hu shema minah

Matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda lo nechleku rabbi eliezer vachachamim al hamgaresh et ishto veamar lah hare atte mutteret lechol adam chutz mippeloni sheenah megoreshet al ma nechleku al hamgaresh ishto veamar lah hare atte mutteret lechol adam al menat shello tinnasi lifloni
b: Sherabbi eliezer mattir lechol adam chutz meoto haish vachachamim osrim
May tama derabbi eliezer mide dehave akkol tenae dealma verabbanan kol tenae dealma la shayyar leh beget hacha shayyar lah beget
Umatnitin deokemna bechutz may tama derabbi eliezer

Amar rabbi yannay mishshum zaken echad amar kera veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayeta leish acher afilu lo hittirah ella leish acher hare zo megoreshet verabbanan amri tama derabbi eliezer hay ish lechol ish vaish
Verabbi yochanan amar tama derabbi eliezer mehacha veishsha gerusha meishah lo yikkachu afilu lo nitgarsha ella meishah nifsela min hakkehunna alma have gita
Verabbanan isur kehunna shane
Bae rabbi abba bekidushin heach tibe lerabbi eliezer tibe lerabbanan
Tibe lerabbi eliezer ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hacha ella mishshum dichtivi kerae aval hatam kinyan mealleya baenan o dilma veyatzahvehayeta
Tibe lerabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hacha ella devaenan keritut veleka aval hatam kinyan kol dehu o dilma veyatzahvehayeta
Levatar deibaya leh hadar pashtah ben lerabbi eliezer ben lerabbanan baenan veyatzahvehayeta
Amar abbaye im timtza lomar ita lidrabbi abba
Ba reuven vekidshah chutz mishshimon uva shimon vekidshah chutz meruven umetu shenehem mityabbemet lelevi veen ani kore bah eshet shene metim
May tama kidushe diruven ahano kidushe deshimon la ahano

Veella eshet shene metim hechi mashkachatte lah kegon shebba reuven vekidshah chutz mishshimon uva shimon vekidshah setam dekidushe reuven ahano lemesrah aalma vekidushe deshimon ahano lemesrah aruven
Bae abbaye amar lah hare atte mutteret lechol adam chutz meruven veshimon vechazar veamar lah liruven veshimon mahu
Mi amrinan may daasar shera o dilma may daasar shera umay dishra asar im timtza lomar

a: May daasar shera liruven mahu liruven vehu haddin leshimon vehay dekaamar liruven mishshum diftach beh o dilma liruven daveka
Veim timtza lomar liruven daveka leshimon mahu leshimon vehu haddin liruven vehay dekaamar shimon mishshum dislek mineh o dilma leshimon daveka
Bae rav ashe af leshimon mahu af aruven kae o dilma af aalma kae teku
Tanu rabbanan leachar petirato shel rabbi eliezer nichnesu arbaa zekenim lehashiv al devarav ellu hen rabbi yose haggelili verabbi tarfon verabbi elazar ben azarya verabbi akiva
Naana rabbi tarfon veamar hare shehalcha zo veniset leachiv shel ze shenneesra alav umet belo banim lo nimtza ze oker davar min hattora ha lamadta sheen ze keritut
Naana rabbi yose haggelili veamar hechan matzinu asur laze umuttar laze haasur asur lakkol vehammuttar muttar lakkol ha lamadta sheen ze keritut
Naana rabbi elazar ben azarya veamar keritut davar hakkoret beno levenah ha lamadta sheen ze keritut

Naana rabbi akiva veamar hare shehalcha zo venisset leechad min hashshuk vehau lah banim venitarmela o nitgarsha veavra veniset laze shenneesra alav lo nimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerim ha lamadta sheen ze keritut
Davar acher hare shehaya ze shenneesra alav kohen umet hamgaresh lo nimtzet almana etzlo ugrusha etzel kol adam
Vekal vachomer ma gerusha shehi kalla asura bishvil tzad gerushin shebbah eshet ish shehi chamura lo kol shekken ha lamadta sheen ze keritut
Amar lahen rabbi yehoshua en meshivin et haari leachar mita
Amar rava kullehu it lehu pircha levar midderabbi elazar ben azarya delet leh pircha tanya name hachi amar rabbi yose roe ani et divre rabbi elazar ben azarya middivre kullan
Amar mar naana rabbi tarfon veamar hare shehalcha zo venisset leachiv shel ze shenneesra alav umet belo banim lo nimtza ze oker davar min hattora oker ihu akar ella matne laakor davar min hattora
Matne mi kaamar lah la saggi lah dela minasva leh laachuh dehahu gavra ella gorem laakor davar min hattora
Gorem ella meatta bat achiv lo yissa shemma yamut belo banim venimtza gorem laakor davar min hattora hayenu pircha
Uvmay ilema bechutz mishra share rabbi eliezer
Detanya mode rabbi eliezer bimgaresh et ishto veamar lah hare atte mutteret lechol adam chutz mippeloni vehalcha veniset leechad min hashshuk venitarmela o nitgarsha shemmutteret laze shenneesra alav
Ella beal menat

Naana rabbi yose haggelili veamar hechan matzinu asur laze umuttar laze haasur asur lakkol vehammuttar muttar lakkol vela vahare teruma vekadashim sheasura laze umutteret laze beisur ishsha ka amrinan
Vahare araot beishut kaamrinan
Hare eshet ish hayenu pircha
Uvmay ilema beal menat hare huttera etzlo biznut ella bechutz
Naana rabbi akiva veamar hare shehalcha zo veniset leechad min hashshuk vehau lah banim venitarmela o nitgarsha veamda venisset laze shenneesra alav lo nimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerin
I hachi bechullehu tenae dealma name la tinnesiv dilma la mekayema leh litnaeh venimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerin hayenu pircha
Uvmay ilema bechutz mishra share rabbi eliezer

Detanya mode haya rabbi eliezer bimgaresh et ishto veamar lah hare atte mutteret lechol adam chutz mippeloni vehalcha venisset leechad min hashshuk venitarmela o nitgarsha shemmutteret laze shenneesra alav ella beal menat

Davar acher hare shehaya ze shenneesra alav kohen umet hamgaresh lo nimtzet almana etzlo ugrusha etzel kol adam vekal vachomer uma gerusha shehi kalla asura mishshum tzad gerushin shebbah eshet ish chamura lo kol shekken
Uvmay ilema beal menat
b: Hare gerusha etzlo biznut ella bechutz

Velitachshar hay bishne edim ivrim velitachshar hay bishne edim yevanim ditnan get shekketavo ivrit veedav yevanit yevanit veedav ivrit kasher
Vechi tema kevan demuflag bishne shitin la vehaamar chizkiyya milleahu bikrovim kasher
Ha tane zeeri shenehen kesherin vetanna didan dilma gundalit chatum vechullehu achad hu dachatimi
Ed echad ivri veed echad yevani velitachshar hay beed echad ivri veed echad yevani vehay beed echad ivri veed echad yevani deha tenan ed echad ivri veed echad yevani kasher
Ha tane zeeri shenehem kesherim vetanna didan dilma gundalit chatum utlata achad vechad achad
Matni shiyyer miktzat hagget uchtavo bedaf hashsheni vehaedim millematta kasher chatmu edim berosh haddaf min hatztzad o meacharav beget pashut pasul

Hikkif rosho shel ze betzad rosho shel ze vehaedim baemtza shenehem pesulin sofo shel ze betzad sofo shel ze vehaedim baemtza et shehaedim nikrin immo kasher rosho shel ze betzad sofo shel ze vehaedim baemtza et shehaedim nikrin besofo kasher
Get shekketavo ivrit veedav yeonit yeonit veedav ivrit ed echad ivri veed echad yeoni katav sofer veed kasher
Ish peloni ed kasher ben ish peloni ed kasher ish peloni ben ish peloni velo katav ed kasher vechach hau nekiyye haddaat shebbirushalayim osin katav chanichato vachanichatah kasher
Gema velechush dilma hane tere gite hao veitremi leh zeman dekamma veedim devatra vegazyeh lizman devatra veedim dekamma
Amar rabbi abba amar rav kesheyyesh revach millematta vedilma zeman devatra migaz gazyeh kidamar rabbi abba amar rav kesheyyesh revach millematta

a: Hacha name kesheyyesh revach millemala
Vedilma imloche imlich uchtav
Dichtiv hare atte millematta umutteret millemala vedilma itremi leh kulle hay la chayeshinan
Rav ashe amar didia beh metachta dimgilta
Chatmu edim berosh haddaf vechu ini veha rav chatem min hatztzad hatam besheggaggo kelappe chetav
Ella ha dekatane hikkif rosho shel ze betzad rosho shel ze vehaedim baemtza shenehem pesulin velichze he minayehu kelappe chetav velitachshar
Hatam dirme leh keivra
I hachi sefa dekatane rosho shel ze betzad sofo shel ze vehaedim baemtza et shehaedim nikrin besofo kasher vei dirme keivra lav bahade hay mikre velav bahade hay mikre
Ella rav bediske hava chatem
Get shekketavo ivrit vechu katav sofer veed kasher amar rabbi yirmeya chatam sofer shaninu
Amar rav chisda ha manni rabbi yose hi
Hahi ketubbat chatanim daatay lekammeh derabbi avahu dahao yadi leh letufsa velachatimat yeda dechad sahada sevar leachshorah amar leh rabbi yirmeya chatam sofer shaninu
Katav chanichato vachanichatah kasher tanu rabbanan chanichat avot begitin ad asara dorot rabbi shimon ben elazar omer shelosha dorot kasher mikkan veelach pasul
Keman azla ha deamar rabbi chanina katav chanichat avot begitin ad shelosha dorot keman kerabbi shimon ben elazar
Amar rav huna may keraa ki tolid banim uvne vanim venoshantem

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi lo charva eretz yisrael ad sheavdu bah shiva batte dinim avoda zara veellu hen yarovam ben nevat uvasha ben achiyya veachav ben amri veyehu ben nimshi ufekach ben remalyahu umnachem ben gadi vehoshea ben ela shenneemar umlela yoledet hashshiva nafcha nafshah baa shimshah beod yomam bosha vechafera
Amar rav amme may keraa ki tolid banim uvne vanim
Amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav ketiv beh behoshea ben ela vayyaas hara beene Adonai rak lo kemalche yisrael uchtiv alav ala shalmaneser vego

Amar lehu otan pardesiot shehoshiv yarovam al hadderachim kede shello yaalu yisrael laregel ba hoshea uvitlan veaf al pi chen lo alu yisrael laregel amar hakkadosh baruch hu otan shanim shello alu yisrael laregel yelchu bashshevi

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukva veamri lah amar rav chisda amar rabbi yirmeya daresh marimar may dichtiv vayyishkod Adonai al haraa vayevieha alenu ki tzaddik Adonai elohenu mishshum detzaddik Adonai elohenu vayyishkod Adonai al haraa vayevieha alenu
Ella tzedaka asa hakkadosh baruch hu im yisrael shehigla galut tzidkiyyahu vaadayin galut yechanya kayyemet dichtiv beh begalut yechanya hecharash vehammasger elef
Charash shebbeshaa sheppotchin naasu hakkol kechershin masger kevan shessogrin shuv enan potchin vechamma elef
Ulla amar shehikdim shette shanim livenoshantem
b: Amar rav acha bar yaakov shema minah mehera demare alma tamne mea vechamshin vetarte hu
Matni get meusse beyisrael kasher uvgoyim pasul uvgoyim chovtin oto veomrim lo ase ma sheyyisrael omrim lach vechasher
Gema amar rav nachman amar shemuel get hamusse beyisrael kaddin kasher shello kaddin pasul ufosel
Uvgoyim kaddin pasul ufosel shello kaddin afilu reach hagget en bo
Ma nafshach i goyim bene assoye ninhu itachshore name litachshar i lav bene assoye ninhu mifsal la lifsol
Amar rav mesharsheya devar tora get meusse baggoyim kasher uma taam amru pasul shello tehe kol achat veachat holechet vetola atzmah begoy vmafkaat atzmah miyyad balah
I hachi shello kaddin afilu reach hagget en bo veneheve shello kaddin keyisrael umifsal name lifsol
Ella ha derav mesharsheya beduta hi
Vetama may kaddin bechaddin deyisrael michallaf shello kaddin bechaddin deyisrael la michallaf

Abbaye ashkecheh lerav yosef deyatev veka measse aggite amar leh veha anan hedotot anan vetanya haya rabbi tarfon omer kol makom sheatta motze agoriot shel goyim af al pi sheddinehem kedine yisrael i atta rashshay lehizakek lahem shenneemar veelle hammishpatim asher tasim lifnehem lifnehem velo lifne goyim davar acher lifnehem velo lifne hedotot
Amar leh anan shelichutayehu ka avdinan mide dehave ahodaot vehalvaot
I hachi gezelot vechabbalot name ki avdinan shelichutayehu bemilta dishchicha bemilta dela shechicha la avdinan shelichutayehu
Matni yatza shemah bair mekuddeshet hare zo mekuddeshet megoreshet hare zo megoreshet uvilvad shello yehe sham amatla
Ezo hi amatla gerash ish peloni et ishto al tenay zarak lah kidusheha safek karov lah safek karov lo zo hi amatla
Gema veasrinan lah aggavra veha amar rav ashe kol kala devatar nisuin la chayeshinan leh
Hachi kaamar yatza shemah bair mekuddeshet hare zo mekuddeshet mekuddeshet umgoreshet

a: Hare zo megoreshet may tama kol veshovro immo
Amar rava yatza lah shem mezanna bair en choshshin lah may tama peritzuta bealma hu dachazo lah
Ketannae achla bashshuk girgera bashshuk henika bashshuk bechullan rabbi meir omer tetze rabbi akiva omer mishsheyyisseu veyittenu bah mozrot ballevana

Amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri im ken lo hinnachta bat leavraham avinu sheyyoshevet tachat baalah vehattora amra ki matza vah ervat davar ulhallan hu omer al pi shenayim edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar ma lehallan davar barur af kan davar barur
Tanu rabbanan beula en choshshin lah nesua en choshshin lah arusa en choshshin lah shello lifloni en choshshin lah beir acheret en choshshin lah
Mamzeret en choshshin lah shifcha en choshshin lah
Hikdish peloni nechasav hifkir peloni nechasav en choshshin lahen
Amar ulla lo sheshshamu kol havara ella kede sheyehu nerot dolkot umittot mutztzaot uvne adam nichnasin veotzin veomrim pelonit mitkaddeshet hayyom
Mitkaddeshet vedilma la ikkaddasha ema pelonit nitkaddesha hayyom

Vechen tane levi lo sheyyishmeu kol havara ella kede sheyehu nerot dolkot umittot mutztzaot venashim toot leor hanner usmechot lah veomrot pelonit mitkaddeshet hayyom mitkaddeshet vedilma la ikkaddasha amar rav pappa ema pelonit nitkaddesha hayyom
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo sheshshamu kol havara ella kede sheyehu nerot dolkot umittot mutztzaot uvne adam nichnasin veotzin amru davar ze hu kol lo amru davar zehu amatla
Lo amru veha lo amru velo kelum leappoke midderabba bar rav huna deamar amatla sheamru afilu mikkan vead asara yamim ka mashma lan la amru hu dehaveya amatla ha amru la haveya amatla
Amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav lo sheshshamu kol havara ella kede sheyyomru peloni mehechan shama mippeloni ufloni mippeloni uvodkin veholchin ad shemmaggiin ledavar habbarur

Davar habbarur edut meallayeta hu ella ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav lo sheshshamu kol havara ella kede sheyyomru peloni mehechan shama mippeloni ufloni mippeloni vehalchu lahem limdinat hayyam
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef mevattelinan kala o la mevattelinan amar leh middeamar rav chisda ad sheyyishmeu mippi hakkesherim shema minah mevattelinan kala
Amar leh adderabba middeamar rav sheshet afilu mippi nashim have kol shema minah la mevattelinan kala
Amar leh atraota ninhu besura mevatteli kala binhardea la mevatteli kala

Hahi dinfak alah kala deikaddasha levar be rav atyeh rav chama laavuh amar leh ema li hechi hava ovada amar leh al tenay kaddesh addata dela azel leve chozay vaazal amar leh kevan dividana dahavay kala la havay amatla lav kol keminach demachzekatte amatla

Hahi dinfak alah kala deikaddasha baatzipa detuchla beena deve shife shalchah rav idi bar avin lekammeh deabbaye ki hay gavena may amar leh afilu leman deamar la mevattelinan kala beha mevattelinan kala memar amri ayyinu behu rabbanan bekidushe vela hava behu shave peruta
Hahi dinfak alah kala deikaddasha
b: Lechad mibbene pelanya amar rava afilu leman deamar la mevattelinan kala beha mevattelinan kala memar amri ayyinu behu rabbanan bekidushe vekidushe katan hao
Hahi dinfak alah kala deikaddasha lekatan hannire kegadol amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hava ovada veamru adayin lo higgia liflaggot reuven shenneemar liflaggot reuven gedolim chikre lev
Uvilvad shello tehe sham amatla amar rabba bar rav huna amatla sheamru afilu mikkan vead asara yamim rav zevid amar bimkom amatla choshshin laamatla
Etiveh rav pappa lerav zevid uvilvad shello tehe sham amatla amar leh bimkom amatla kaamar
Amar leh rav kahana lerav pappa veatte la tisbera vehatnan nitkaddesha veachar kach ba balah mutteret lachzor lav mishshum deamrinan al tenay kaddesh
Shane hatam deate baal veka mearer
I hachi niset name niset daavada isura kansuha rabbanan nitkaddesha dela avada isura la kansuha rabbanan

Amar rav ashe kol kala dela itachzak beve dina lav kala hu veamar rav ashe kol kala devatar nisuin la chayeshinan leh ha devatar erusin chayeshinan leh rav chaviva amar afilu devatar erusin name la chayeshinan leh vehilcheta la chayeshinan leh
Amar rav yirmeya bar abba shelachu leh mibbe rav lishmuel yelammedenu rabbenu yatza aleha kol merishon uva acher vekiddeshah kidushe tora mahu shelach lehu tetze vehaamidu haddavar al buro vehodiuni

May vehaamidu haddavar al buro ilema dei miggalleya milta dekidushe dekamma lav kidushe mealleya ninhu mevattelinan kala veha nehardea atreh dishmuel hu vela mevatteli kala ella dei migalleya milta dekidushe kamma kidushe mealleya ninhu lo tzericha get mishsheni
Ufliga derav huna deamar rav huna eshet ish sheppashta yadah vekibla kidushin meacher mekuddeshet
Midderav hamnuna deamar rav hamnuna haishsha sheamra levalah gerashtani neemenet chazaka en ishsha meiza paneha bifne balah
Veidach ki ittemar derav hamnuna befanav shello befanav meiza umiza
Lo matzu davar al buro mahu
Amar rav huna megaresh rishon venose sheni aval megaresh sheni venose rishon la may tama ate lememar machzir gerushato min haerusin
Rav shinana bereh derav idi amar af megaresh sheni venose rishon memar amri ayyinu rabbanan bekidushe vekidushe taut hava
Yatza aleha kol mizze umizze mahu amar rav pappa af zo megaresh rishon venose sheni ammemar amar mutteret lishnehem

a: Vehilcheta mutteret lishnehem
Matni bet shammay omrim lo yegaresh adam et ishto ella im ken matza bah devar erva shenneemar ki matza vah ervat davar
Uvet hillel omrim afilu hikdicha tavshilo shenneemar ki matza vah ervat davar
Rabbi akiva omer afilu matza acheret naa hemenna shenneemar vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav
Gema tanya amru bet hillel levet shammay vahalo kevar neemar davar amru lahem bet shammay vahalo kevar neemar ervat

Amru lahem bet hillel im neemar ervat velo neemar davar hayiti omer mishshum erva tetze mishshum davar lo tetze lechach neemar davar veilu neemar davar velo neemar ervat hayiti omer mishshum davar tinnase leacher umishshum erva lo tinnase leacher lechach neemar ervat
Uvet shammay hay davar may avdi leh neemar kan davar veneemar lehallan davar al pi shene edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar ma lehallan bishne edim af kan bishne edim
Uvet hillel mi ketiv erva bedavar uvet shammay mi ketiv o erva o davar
Uvet hillel lehachi ketiv ervat davar demashma hachi umashma hachi
Rabbi akiva omer afilu matza acheret bemay ka mipalgi bidresh lakish deamar resh lakish ki meshammesh bearbaa leshonot i dilma ella deha
Bet shammay savri vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav ki matza vah ervat davar deha matza vah ervat davar verabbi akiva savar ki matza vah ervat davar i name matza vah ervat davar
Amar leh rav pappa lerava lo matza bah lo erva velo davar mahu
Amar leh middegalli rachamana gabbe ones lo yuchal leshallechah kol yamav kol yamav baamod vehachzer kae hatam hu degalli rachamana aval hacha may daavad avad
Amar leh rav mesharsheya lerava im libbo legarshah vehi yoshevet tachtav umshammashto mahu kare aleh al tacharosh al reacha raa vehu yoshev lavetach ittach

Tanya haya rabbi meir omer keshem shehaddeot bemaachal kach deot benashim yesh lecha adam shezzevuv nofel letoch koso vezorko veeno shotehu vezo hi middat pappus ben yehuda shehaya noel bifne ishto veotze
Veyesh lecha adam shezzevuv nofel letoch koso vezorko veshotehu vezo hi middat kol adam shemmedabberet im acheha ukroveha umannichah
Veyesh lecha adam shezzevuv nofel letoch tamchuy motztzo veochlo zo hi middat adam ra sheroe et ishto yotza veroshah parua vetova bashshuk
b: Ufruma mishshene tzedadeha verochetzet im bene adam
Im bene adam salka datach ella bimkom shebbene adam rochatzin

Zo mitzva min hattora legarshah shenneemar ki matza vah ervat vego veshillechah mibbeto vehalcha vehayeta leish acher hakkatuv kerao acher lomar sheen ze ben zugo larishon ze hotzi reshaa mibbeto veze hichnis reshaa letoch beto
Zacha sheni shillechah shenneemar usneah haish haacharon veim lav kovarto shenneemar o chi yamut haish haacharon keday hu bemita shezze hotzi reshaa mibbeto veze hichnis reshaa letoch beto
Ki sane shallach rabbi yehuda omer im senetah shallach rabbi yochanan omer sanouy hamshalleach
Vela peligi ha bezug rishon ha bezug sheni

Deamar rabbi elazar kol hamgaresh ishto rishona afilu mizbeach morid alav demaot shenneemar vezot shenit taasu kassot dima et mizbach Adonai bechi vaanaka meen od penot el hammincha velakachat ratzon miyyedchem vaamartem al ma al ki Adonai heid bencha uven eshet neurecha asher atta bagadta bah vehi chavertecha veeshet beritecha
Hadaran alach hamgaresh uslika lah massechet gitin

a: Haishsha niknet beshalosh derachim vekona et atzmah bishte derachim niknet bechesef bishtar uvvia bechesef bet shammay omrim bedinar uvshave dinar uvet hillel omrim bifruta uvshave peruta vechamma hi peruta echad mishshemona baisar haitalki
Vekona et atzmah beget uvmitat habbaal hayevama niknet bevia vekona et atzmah bachalitza uvmitat hayyavam
Gema haishsha niknet may shena hacha detane haishsha niknet umay shena hatam detane haish mekaddesh mishshum deka bae lemitne kesef
Vechesef mena lan gamar kicha kicha missede efron ketiv hacha ki yikkach ish ishsha uchtiv hatam natatti kesef hassade kach mimmenni
Vekicha ikri kinyan dichtiv hassade asher kana avraham
b: I name sadot bakkesef yiknu tane haishsha niknet
Venitne hatam haish kone meikara tane lishana deorayeta ulvassof tane lishana derabbanan umay lishana derabbanan deasar lah akkulle alma kehekdesh
Venitne hacha haish kone mishshum deka bae lemitna sefa vekona et atzmah bedidah tena name resha bedidah
Venitne haish kone umakne mishshum deika mitat habbaal delav ihu ka makne min shemayya hu demakni lah
Vei baet ema i tena kone hava amena afilu beal korchah tena haishsha niknet demiddatah in shello middatah la
Umay irya detane shalosh litne shelosha mishshum deka bae lemitne derech vederech leshon nekeva hu dichtiv vehodata lahem et hadderech yelchu vah

Veella ha detanya beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav nitne sheva mishshum deka bae lemitne derech veashkechan derech deikri leshon zachar dichtiv bederech echad yetzu elecha uvshiva derachim yanusu lefanecha i hachi kashu kerae ahadade vekashya name matnitin ahadade

Kerae ahadade la kashyan hacha divtora kae vetora ikri leshon nekeva dichtiv torat Adonai temima meshivat nafesh katav lah bilshon nekeva hatam divmilchama kae dedarko shel ish laasot milchama veen darkah shel ishsha laasot milchama katav lah bilshon zachar

Matnitin ahadade la kashyan hacha dilgabbe ishsha kae katane lah bilshon nekeva hatam dilgabbe ish kae dedarko shel ish libadek veen darkah shel ishsha libadek deha ishsha name beones mitammeah tane leshon zachar
May tama tane shalosh mishshum derachim nitne devarim venitne shelosha mishshum dekavae lemitne bia uvia ikri derech dichtiv vederech gever bealma ken derech ishsha menaafet
Ha tinach bia kesef ushtar may ika lememar mishshum bia
Vetane tarte attu chada hanach name tzorech bia ninhu

Vei baet ema ha manni rabbi shimon hi detanya rabbi shimon omer mippene ma amra tora ki yikkach ish ishsha velo katav ki tillakach ishsha leish mippene sheddarko shel ish lechazzer al ishsha veen darkah shel ishsha lechazzer al ish mashal leadam sheavda lo aveda mi chozer al mi baal aveda mechazzer al avedato
Veha ditnan beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav litne devarim hatam ha ka mashma lan dedarka demechla yattira leetoye lide ziva vedarka demishteya yattira leetoye lide ziva
Veha ditnan etrog shave lailan bishlosha derachim litne devarim mishshum devaenan mitne sefa velayyarak bederech echad sefa name nitne davar

a: Hatam ha kamashma lan dedarkeh deetrog keyarak ma yarak darko ligdal al kol mayim uvishat lekitato isuro af etrog darko ligdal al kol mayim uvishat lekitato isuro

Veha ditnan koy yesh bo derachim shave lachayya veyesh bo derachim shave labbehema veyesh bo derachim shave lachayya velabbehema veyesh bo derachim sheeno shave lo lachayya velo labbehema nitne devarim vetu ha ditnan zo achat min hadderachim sheshshau gite nashim leshichrure avadim nitne devarim
Ella kol hecha deika pelugta tane derachim vechol hecha deleka pelugta tane devarim dayeka name dekatane sefa rabbi eliezer omer etrog shave lailan lechol davar shema minah
Minyana deresha lemaote may minyana desefa lemaote may
Minyana deresha lemaote chuppa ulrav huna deamar chuppa kona mikkal vachomer lemaote may
Lemaote chalifin salka datach amena hoil vegamar kicha kicha missede efron ma sade mikkanya bachalifin af ishsha name mikkanya bachalifin kamashma lan
Veema hachi name chalifin itanhu befachot mishshave peruta veishsha befachot mishshave peruta
b: La makneya nafshah
Minyana desefa lemaote may lemaote chalitza salka datach amena tete bekal vachomer miyevama ma yevama sheenah yotza beget yotza bachalitza zo sheyyotza beget eno din sheyyotza bachalitza kamashma lan
Veema hachi name amar kera sefer keritut sefer kortah veen davar acher kortah
Bechesef mena lan vetu ha ditnan haav zakkay bevitto bekiddusheha bechesef bishtar uvvia menalan demikanya bechesef vechesef daavuh hu
Amar rav yehuda amar rav deamar kera veyatza chinnam en kasef en kesef leadon ze aval yesh kesef leadon acher uman nihu av
Veema ledidah hachi hashta aviha mekabbel kidusheha dichtiv et bitti natatti laish hazze veihi shakla kaspa
Veema hane mile ketanna delet lah yad lekabbel kidushin aval naara deit lah yad lekabbel kidushin tekaddesh ihi nafshah vetishkol kaspa amar kera binureha bet aviha kol shevach neurim leaviha

Veella ha deamar rav huna amar rav minnayin shemmaase habbat laav shenneemar vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama ma ama maase yadeha lerabbah af bat name maase yadeha leaviha tipok leh mibbinureha bet aviha
Ella bahafarat nedarim hu dichtiv hachi name bahafarat nedarim hu dichtiv vechi tema nelaf mineh mamona meisura la yalfinan
Vechi tema nelaf mikkenasa mamona mikkenasa la yalfinan
Vechi tema nelaf mibboshet ufgam shane boshet ufgam daavuh shayech begavayehu
Ella mistabbera dechi ka memaet

a: Yetzia dichotah ka memaet

Veha la damya hay yetzia lehay yetzia hatam nafka lah mershut adon ligmare vehacha akkatti michassera mesira lechuppa bahafarat nedarim miha nafka lah mershuteh ditnan naara hamorasa aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha
Vehay veyatza chinnam lehachi hu daata ha mibbee leh lechidtanya detanya veyatza chinnam ellu yeme bagrut en kasef ellu yeme naarut
Amar ravina im ken lema kera en kasef may en kasef en kesef leadon ze aval yesh kesef leadon acher uman nihu av
Umimmay dedarshinan hachi detanya vezera en lah
En li ella zarah zera zarah minnayin talmud lomar zera en lah ayyen lah veen li ella zera kasher zera pasul minnayin talmud lomar zera en lah ayyen lah
Veha appekteh lezera zarah zera zarah la itzterich kera divne vanim hare hen kevanim ki itzterich kera lezera pasul
Vetanna gufeh menaleh dedaresh hachi amri ketiv meen bilam umeen yevami dela ketiv behu yod vehacha ketiv beh yod shema minah lidrasha hu daata

Veitzterich lemichtav kidusheha leaviha veitzterich lemichtav maase yadeha leaviha dei ketav rachamana kidusheha leaviha hava amena mishshum dela tarcha behu aval maase yadeha deka tarcha behu ema didah hau
Vei ashmeinan maase yadeha deka mittazna mineh aval kidusheha demealma kaate lah ema didah hau tzericha
Gufa veyatza chinnam ellu yeme bagrut en kesef ellu yeme naarut velichtov rachamana naarut vela bae bagrut
Amar rabba ba ze velimmed al ze
Mide dehave attoshav vesachir detanya toshav ze kanuy kinyan olam sachir ze kanuy kinyan shanim
Yeamer toshav velo yeamer sachir vaani omer kanuy kinyan olam eno ochel kanuy kinyan shanim lo kol shekken
Ilu ken hayiti omer toshav ze kanuy kinyan shanim aval kenuy kinyan olam ochel ba sachir velimed al toshav sheaf al pi shekkanuy kinyan olam eno ochel

Amar leh abbaye mi dame hatam tere gufe ninhu dechi name ketav rachamana toshav nirtza lo yochal vahadar ketav idach hava sachir milta deatya bekal vachomer umilta deatya bekal vachomer tarach vechatav lah kera
Ella hacha chad gufa hi ki nafka lah benaarut bagrut may baaya gabbeh
Ella amar abbaye lo nitzrecha ella leveger deayelonit
Salka datach amena benaarut tipok bevagrut la tipok ka mashma lan
Matkef lah mar bar rav ashe velav kal vachomer hu uma simanin sheen motziin mershut av motziin mershut adon bagrut shemmotzia mershut av eno din shemmotzia mershut adon
Ella amar mar bar rav ashe lo nitzrecha ella leikar zevina deayelonit salka datach amena deatya simane naarut have zevina dela atya simane naarut la have zevinah zevina
b: Ka mashma lan veyatza chinnam ku
Ulmar bar rav ashe deamar velav kal vachomer hu ha amrinan milta deatya bekal vachomer tarach vechatav lah kera hane mile hecha deleka leshannoye aval hecha deika leshannoye meshanninan
Vetanna mayete lah mehacha detanya ki yikkach ish ishsha uvalah vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav ki matza vah vego en kicha ella bechesef vechen hu omer natatti kesef hassade kach mimmenni
Vahalo din hu uma ama haivriyya sheenah niknet bevia niknet bechesef zo shenniknet bevia eno din shettikkane bechesef
Yevama tochiach shenniknet bevia veenah niknet bechesef ma livama shekken en niknet bishtar tomar bezo shenniknet bishtar
Talmud lomar ki yikkach ish ha lema li kera ha atya lah amar rav ashe mishshum deika lememar meikara dedina pircha
Mehecha ka mayetet lah meama haivriyya ma leama haivriyya shekken yotza bechesef tomar bezo sheenah yotza bechesef talmud lomar ki yikkach ish
Veitzterich lemichtav veyatza chinnam veitzterich lemichtav ki yikkach ish dei ketav rachamana ki yikkach hava amena kidushin dihav lah baal didah hau ketav rachamana veyatza chinnam
Vei ketav rachamana veyatza chinnam hava amena hecha deyahava leh ihi ledideh vekidshattu hau kidushe ketav rachamana ki yikkach vela ki tikkach
Uvalah melammed shenniknet bevia vahalo din hu uma yevama sheen niknet bechesef niknet bevia zo shenniknet bechesef eno din shenniknet bevia
Ama haivriyya tochiach shenniknet bechesef veen niknet bevia ma leama haivriyya sheen kinyanah leshum ishut tomar bezo shekkinyanah leshum ishut
Talmud lomar uvalah ulma li kera ha atya lah amar rav ashe mishshum deika lememar meikara dedina pircha mehecha ka mayetet lah miyevama
Ma livama shekken zekuka veomedet tomar bazo sheen zekuka veomedet talmud lomar uvalah

a: Uminnayin sheaf bishtar vedin hu uma kesef sheen motzi machnis shetar shemmotzi eno din shemmachnis
Ma lechesef shekken podin bo hekdesh umaaser sheni tomar shetar sheen podin bo hekdesh umaaser sheni dichtiv venatan hakkesef vekam lo
Amar kera veyatza vehayeta makkish havaya litzia ma yetzia bishtar af havaya name bishtar veakkesh name yetzia lahavaya ma havaya bakkesef af yetzia bechesef
Amar abbaye yomru kesef machnis kesef motzi sanegor yease kategor i hachi shetar name yomru shetar motzi shetar machnis kategor yease sanegor
Mile dehay shetara lechod umile dehay shetara lechod hacha name hay kaspa lechod vehay kaspa lechod tiva miha chad hu
Rava amar amar kera vechatav lah bichtiva mitgareshet veenah mitgareshet bechesef veema bichtiva mitgareshet veenah mitkaddeshet bichtiva ha ketiv veyatza vehayeta makkish vechu
Uma raita mistabbera kae begerushin memaet gerushin kae begerushin ummaet kidushin
Ulrabbi yose haggelili deappek leh lehay kera lidrasha acharina sheenah mitgareshet bechesef mena leh amar kera sefer keritut sefer kortah veen davar acher kortah
Verabbanan hay keritut may avdi leh mibe leh ledavar hakkoret beno levenah
Kidtanya hare ze gitech al menat shello tishti yayin al menat shello telchi levet avich leolam en ze keritut kal sheloshim yom hare ze keritut
Verabbi yose haggelili mikkaret keritut ka nafka leh verabbanan karet keritut la mashma lehu
Chada mechada la atya tete chada mittarte he tete la lichtov rachamana bishtar vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken hanaatan merubba
La nichtov rachamana bevia vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken kinyanan merubbe
La nichtov rachamana bechesef vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken yeshnan beal korchah
Vechi tema kesef name beal korchah beama haivriyya beishut miha la ashkechan
Amar rav huna chuppa kona mikkal vachomer uma kesef sheeno maachil bitruma kone chuppa shemmaachelet bitruma eno din shettikne
Vechesef eno maachil vehaamar ulla devar tora arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma shenneemar vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo vehay kinyan kaspo hu
Uma taam amru enah ochelet gezera shemma yimzegu lah kos bevet aviha vetashkennu leachiha velaachotah
Ella perech hachi uma kesef sheeno gomer kone
b: Chuppa sheggomeret eno din shettikne ma lechesef shekken podin bo hekdeshot umaaser sheni bia tochiach

Ma levia shekken kona bivama kesef yochiach vechazar haddin lo rei ze chiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekkonin bealma vekonin kan af ani avi chuppa shekkona bealma vekona kan
Ma letzad hashshave shebbahen shekken hanaatan merubba shetar yochiach ma lishtar shekken motzi bevat yisrael kesef uvia yochichu
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekkonin bealma vekonin kan af ani avi chuppa shekkona bealma vekona kan
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yeshnan beal korchah verav huna kesef miha beishut la ashkechan beal korchah
Amar rava shette teshuvot baddavar chada deshalosh tenan vearba la tenan
Veod kelum chuppa gomeret ella al yede kidushin vechi gamrinan chuppa shello al yede kidushin mechuppa sheal yede kidushin
Amar leh abbaye ha dekaamratte shalosh tenan vearba la tenan tanna milta dichtiva behedya katane milta dela ketiva behedya la katane
Udkaamratte kelum chuppa gomeret ella al yede kidushin rav huna name hachi kaamar uma kesef sheeno gomer achar kesef kone chuppa sheggomeret achar kesef eno din shettikne

Tanu rabbanan ketzad bechesef natan lah kesef o shave kesef veamar lah hare atte mekuddeshet li hare atte meoreset li hare atte li leintu hare zo mekuddeshet aval hi shennatna veamra hi hareni mekuddeshet lecha hareni meoreset lecha hareni lecha leintu enah mekuddeshet

Matkef lah rav pappa tama denatan hu veamar hu ha natan hu veamra hi enah mekuddeshet ema sefa aval hi shennatna lo veamra hi la hau kidushin tama denatna hi veamra hi ha natan hu veamra hi hau kidushin
Resha daveka sefa kedi nasvah vetane sefa milta desatra lah leresha

Ella hachi kaamar natan hu veamar hu peshita dehau kidushin natan hu veamra hi naasa kemi shennatna hi veamra hi vela hau kidushin vei baet ema natan hu veamar hu mekuddeshet natna hi veamra hi enah mekuddeshet natan hu veamra hi sefeka hi vechayeshinan midderabbanan

Amar shemuel bekidushin natan lah kesef veshave kesef veamar lah hare atte mekuddeshet hare atte meoreset hare atte li leintu hare zo mekuddeshet hareni ishech hareni balech hareni arusech en kan bet mechosh
Vechen begerushin natan lah veamar lah hare atte meshullachat hare atte megoreshet hare atte mutteret lechol adam hare zo megoreshet eni ishech eni balech eni arusech en kan bet mechosh
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye lememra desavar shemuel yadayim sheen mochichot haveyan yadayim
Vehatnan haomer ehe hare ze nazir vehavenan bah vedilma ehe betaanit kaamar veamar shemuel vehu shehaya nazir over lefanav tama dinzir over lefanav ha lav hachi la
Hacha bemay askinan deamar li i hachi may kamashma lan hane

a: Lishane batrae ka mashma lan hacha ketiv ki yikkach velo sheyyakkach et atzmo vehacha ketiv veshillechah velo sheyeshallach et atzmo

Tanu rabbanan hare atte ishti hare atte arusati hare atte kenuya li mekuddeshet hare atte shelli hare atte birshuti hare atte zekuka li mekuddeshet velitninhu kullehu kachada tanna telat telat shaminhu vegarsinhu
Ibaya lehu meuchedet li mahu meoedet li mahu ezrati mahu negdati mahu atzurati mahu tzalati mahu segurati mahu tachtay mahu tefusati mahu lekuchati mahu
Peshot miha chada detanya haomer lekuchati hare zo mekuddeshet mishshum shenneemar ki yikkach ish ishsha
Ibaya lehu charufati mahu ta shema detanya haomer charufati mekuddeshet shekken bihuda korin laarusa charufa vihuda haveya rubba dealma

Hachi kaamar haomer charufati mekuddeshet shenneemar vehi shifcha necherefet leish veod bihuda korin laarusa charufa vihuda veod likra ella hachi kaamar haomer charufa bihuda mekuddeshet shekken bihuda korin laarusa charufa
Bemay askinan ilema besheen medabber immah al iske gitah vekidusheha mena yada may kaamar lah veella bimdabber immah al iske gitah vekidusheha af al gav dela amar lah name

Ditnan haya medabber im ishsha al iske gitah vekidusheha venatan lah gitah vekidusheha velo peresh rabbi yose omer dayyo rabbi yehuda omer tzarich lefaresh veamar rav huna amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose
Amri leolam bimdabber immah al iske gitah vekidusheha vei deyahev lah veshatek hachi name hacha bemay askinan dihav lah vaamar lah behane lishane
Vehachi ka mibe leh hane lishane lekidushe kaamar lah o dilma limlacha kaamar lah teku

Gufa haya medabber im haishsha al iske gitah vekidusheha venatan lah gitah vekidusheha velo peresh rabbi yose omer dayyo rabbi yehuda omer tzarich lefaresh amar rav yehuda amar shemuel vehu sheasukin beoto inyan
Vechen amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya vehu sheasukin beoto inyan ketannae rabbi omer vehu sheasukin beoto inyan rabbi elazar bar rabbi shimon omer af al pi sheen asukin beoto inyan
Vei lav daasukin beoto inyan mena yada may kaamar lah amar abbaye meinyan leinyan beoto inyan

Amar rav huna amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe veella ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol sheeno yodea betiv gitin vekidushin lo yehe lo esek immahem afilu la shemia leh ha derav huna amar shemuel amar leh in hachi name

Vechen begerushin natan lah gitah veamar lah hare atte meshullachat hare atte megoreshet hare atte mutteret lechol adam hare hi megoreshet peshita natan lah gitah veamar lah leishto hare atte bat chorin
b: Lo amar velo kelum amar lah leshifchato hare atte mutteret lechol adam lo amar velo kelum
Amar lah leishto hare atte leatzmecha mahu mi amrinan limlacha kaamar lah o dilma ligmare kaamar lah

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ta shema detanya gufo shel get shichrur hare atta ben chorin hare atta leatzmecha hashta uma eved kenaani dikne leh gufeh ki amar leh hare atta leatzmecha ligmare kaamar leh ishsha dela kene leh gufah lo kol shekken
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe amar leavdo en li esek becha may mi amrinan en li esek becha ligmare kaamar leh o dilma limlacha kaamar leh
Amar leh rav nachman lerav ashe veamri lah rav chanin machozaa lerav ashe ta shema hammocher avdo lenochri yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur merabbo rishon
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim shello katav alav ono aval katav alav ono zehu shichruro hechi dame ono amar rav sheshet dichtav leh keshettivrach mimmennu en li esek becha
Amar abbaye hamkaddesh bemilve enah mekuddeshet bahanaat milve mekuddeshet veasur laasot ken mippene haaramat ribbit
Hay hanaat milve hechi dame ilema deazkefah daamar lah arba bechamsha ha ribbit meallayeta hu veod hayenu milve
La tzericha dearvach lah zimna
Amar rava helach mane al menat shettachazirehu li bemecher lo kana beishsha enah mekuddeshet befidon habben en beno paduy
Bitruma yatza yede netina veasur laasot ken mippene shennire kechohen hamsayyea bevet haggeranot
May kasavar rava i kasavar mattana al menat lehachazir shemah mattana afilu kullehu name vei kasavar lo shemah mattana afilu teruma name la
Veod ha rava hu deamar mattana al menat lehachazir shemah mattana deamar rava helach etrog ze al menat shettachzirehu li netalo vehechziro yatza veim lav lo yatza
Ella amar rav ashe bechullehu kane levar meishsha lefi sheen ishsha niknet bachalifin amar leh rav huna mar bereh derav nechemya lerav ashe hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava keotach
Amar rava ten mane lifloni

a: Veekkaddesh lach mekuddeshet middin arev arev lav af al gav dela mate hanaa lideh ka meshabed nafsheh hay itta name af al gav dela mate hanaa lidah ka meshabeda umakneya nafshah

Helach mane vehitkaddeshi lifloni mekuddeshet middin eved kenaani eved kenaani lav af al gav dela ka chaser vela mide ka kane nafsheh hay gavra name af al gav dela ka chaser vela mide ka kane lah lehay itta
Ten mane lifloni veekkaddesh ani lo mekuddeshet middin shenehem arev lav af al gav dela ka mate hanaa lideh ka meshabed nafsheh hay itta name af al gav dela ka mate hanaa lidah ka makneya nafshah
Mi dame arev hay deka kane leh ka chasar mamona hay gavra ka kane lah lehay itta vela ka chasar vela mide eved kenaani yochiach dela ka chasar mamona veka kane nafsheh
Mi dame hatam hach deka makne ka kane hacha hay itta ka makneya nafshah vela ka kanya vela mide arev yochiach af al gav dela ka mate hanaa lideh meshabed nafsheh

Bae rava helach mane veekkaddesh ani lach mahu amar mar zutra mishshemeh derav pappa mekuddeshet amar leh rav ashe lemar zutra im ken have leh nechasim sheyyesh lahem achraut niknin im nechasim sheen lahem achraut

Vaanan ipcha tenan nechasim sheen lahem achraut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahem achraut bechesef bishtar uvachazaka amar leh mi savratte deamra leh aggav hacha beadam chashuv askinan divhahi hanaa deka mekabbel mattana minah gamra umakneya leh nafshah
Itmar name mishshemeh derava vechen leinyan mamona utzricha
Dei ashmoinan kidushin mishshum deha itta nicha lah bechol dehu kidresh lakish deamar resh lakish tav lemetav tan du millemetav armelu aval mamona ema la
Vei ashmoinan mamona mishshum deityehiv limchila aval kidushin ema la tzericha

Amar rava hitkaddeshi li lechetzyi mekuddeshet chetzyech mekuddeshet li enah mekuddeshet amar leh abbaye lerava may shena chetzyech mekuddeshet li deenah mekuddeshet ishsha amar rachamana velo chatzi ishsha hachi name ish amar rachamana velo chatzi ish
Amar leh hachi hashta hatam itta leve tere la chazya ella gavra mi la chaze leve tere vehachi kaamar lah dei baena leminsav achariti nasevna
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina venifshetu lah kidushe bechullah mi la tanya haomer raglah shel zo ola tehe kullah ola
Vaafilu leman deamar en kullah ola hane mile hecha demakdish davar sheen hanneshama teluya bo aval makdish davar shehanneshama teluya bo haveya kullah ola
Mi dame hatam behema hacha daat acheret
Ha la damya ella leha deamar rabbi yochanan behema shel shene shuttafin hikdish chetzyah vechazar ulkachah vehikdishah kedosha veenah kereva
Veosa temura utmuratah kayyotze bah
Shema minah telat
b: Shema minah baale chayyim nidchim
Ushma minah dachuy meikara have dachuy ushma minah yesh dichuy bedamim
Bae rava chetzyech bachatzi feruta vechetzyech bachatzi feruta mahu kevan deamar lah chatzi feruta paskah o dilma mone veholech hu
Im timtze lomar mone veholech hu chetzyech bifruta vechetzyech bifruta mahu kevan deamar lah bifruta ufruta paskah lemilteh o dilma kol beomeh mone veholech hu

Im timtze lomar kol beomeh mone veholech hu chetzyech bifruta hayyom vechetzyech bifruta lemachar mahu kevan deamar lah lemachar paskah o dilma hachi kaamar lah kiddushin matchalu mehaidana umigmar la nigmeru ad limchar
Shene chatzayayich bifruta mahu hacha vadday bechad zimna kaamar lah o dilma en ishsha mitkaddeshet lachatzain kelal teku
Bae rava shette venotecha lishne vanay bifruta mahu batar noten umkabbel azlinan vehaika mamona o dilma batar didhu azlinan veha leka teku
Bae rav pappa bittecha ufaratcha bifruta mahu mi amrinan bittecha bachatzi feruta ufaratcha bachatzi feruta o dilma bittecha bifruta ufaratcha bimshicha teku
Bae rav ashe bittecha vekarkaacha bifruta mahu bittecha bachatzi feruta vekarkaacha bachatzi feruta o dilma bittecha bifruta vekarkaacha bachazaka teku
Hahu gavra dekaddesh beshirae rabba amar la tzerichi shuma rav yosef amar tzerichi shuma i deamar lah bechol dehu kulle alma la peligi dela tzerichi shuma

I deamar lah chamshin vela shau chamshin ha la shau ki peligi deamar chamshin veshau chamshin rabba amar la tzerichi shuma deha shau chamshin rav yosef amar tzerichi shuma kevan deitta la bekia beshuma la samcha datah
Ika deamri bechol dehu name peligi rav yosef amar shave kesef hare hu kechesef ma kesef dekitz

a: Af shave kesef name dekitz
Amar rav yosef mena amena lah detanya mikkesef miknato bechesef hu nikne veeno nikne bitvua vechelim
Hay tevua vechelim hechi dame ilema dela maknu behu kelal yashiv geullato amar rachamana lerabbot shave kesef kechesef
Vei delet behu shave peruta may irya tevua vechelim afilu kesef name ella lav deit behu shave peruta vechevan dela kayetzi la
Veidach hachi kaamar betorat kesef hu nikne veen nikne betorat tevua vechelim umay ninhu chalifin
Ulrav nachman deamar perot la avdi chalifin may ika lememar ella leolam delet behu shave peruta udkaamratte may irya tevua vechelim afilu kesef name la mibaya kaamar
La mibaya kesef dei it beh shave peruta in i la la aval tevua vechelim ema middimkarva hanaatayehu gamar umakne nafsheh ka mashma lan
Amar rav yosef mena amena lah detanya egel ze lefidon beni tallit zo lefidon beni lo amar kelum egel ze bechamesh selaim lefidon beni tallit zo bechamesh selaim lefidon beni beno paduy
Hay pidon hechi dame ilema dela shave kol kemineh ella lav af al gav deshave vechevan dela kayetzi la
La leolam dela shave uchgon dekabbel kohen ilaveh ki ha derav kahana shakel sudara mibbe pidon habben amar leh ledidi chaze li chamesh selaim
Amar rav ashe la amaran ella kegon rav kahana degavra rabba hu umibbee leh sudara aresheh aval kulle alma la ki ha demar bar rav ashe zevan sudara meimeh derava mikkubbe shave asra bitlesar
Amar rabbi elazar hitkaddeshi li bemane venatan lah dinar hare zo mekuddeshet veyashlim may tama kevan deamar lah mane veyahev lah dinar keman deamar lah al menat dame
Veamar rav huna amar rav kol haomer al menat keomer meachshav dame
Metivi hitkaddeshi li bemane vehaya mone veholech veratza echad mehen lachazor afilu baddinar haacharon harshut beyado
Hacha bemay askinan deamar bemane ze ha middesefa bemane ze resha bemane setam
Deka tane sefa amar lah hitkaddeshi li bemane ze venimtza mane chaser dinar o dinar shel nechoshet enah mekuddeshet dinar ra hare zo mekuddeshet veyachlif
La resha vesefa deamar bemane ze ufaroshe ka mefaresh ratza echad mehen lachazor afilu bedinar haacharon harshut beyado ketzad kegon deamar lah bemane zo
Vehachi name mistabbera dei salka datach resha bemane setam hashta bemane setam la hau kidushe bemane ze mibaya
I mishshum ha la irya tena sefa legalloye resha shello tomar resha bemane ze aval bemane setam hau kidushin tena sefa bemane ze mikkelal deresha bemane setam vaafilu hachi la hau kidushin
Rav ashe amar mone veholech shane dedatah akkulleh
Hay dinar shel nechoshet hechi dame i deyada beh ha sevara vekabbila la tzericha deyahaveh nihalah belelya i name deishtechach lah bene zuze
Hay dinar ra hechi dame i dela nafek hayenu dinar shel nechoshet amar rav pappa kegon denafek al yede haddechak
Amar rava amar rav nachman amar lah hitkaddeshi li bemane vehinniach lah mashkon alehem enah mekuddeshet
b: Mane en kan mashkon en kan etiveh rava lerav nachman kidsha bemashkon mekuddeshet hatam bemashkon daacherim vechidrabbi yitzchak
Deamar rabbi yitzchak minnayin levaal chov shekkone mashkon shenneemar ulcha tihye tzedaka im eno kone tzedaka minnayin mikkan levaal chov shekkone mashkon
Bene rav huna bar avin zevun hahi amta bifrite la hao bahadayehu otivu nesacha aleh lesof iyyakar amta ato lekammeh derabbi amme amar lehu perite en kan nesacha en kan
Tanu rabbanan hitkaddeshi li bemane netalattu uzrakattu layyam o laur o lechol davar haaved enah mekuddeshet ha shedetinhu kammeh hau kidushin ha kaamra leh shekel la baena

La mibaya ka amar la mibaya shedetinhu kammeh dela hau kidushin aval zerakattu layyam o laur ema kevan demichayeva behu kaddoshe kaddish nafshah veha deka avda hachi savra evdekeh lehay gavra i ratchana hu o la ka mashma lan
Tanu rabbanan hitkaddeshi li bemane tenem leabba ulavicha enah mekuddeshet al menat sheyekabbelum li mekuddeshet
Tena abba lehodiacha koach deresha tena avicha lehodiacha koach desefa
Hitkaddeshi li bemane tenem lifloni enah mekuddeshet al menat sheyekabbelem li mekuddeshet utzricha
Dei ashmeinan abba veavich hatam hu dechi amra al menat sheyekabbelum li hau kidushin desamcha datah ilavayehu savra avdin li shelichutay aval peloni la

Vei ashmeinan peloni hacha hu dechi amrah tenem lifloni la hau kidushe dela mekarva datah legabbeh lemitveh leh bemattana aval abba veavich dimkarva datah legabbayehu ema bemattana yahaviteh nihalayehu tzericha
Tanu rabbanan hitkaddeshi li bemane tenem al gabbe sela enah mekuddeshet veim haya sela shellah mekuddeshet bae rav bivi sela shel shenehem mahu teku
Hitkaddeshi li bechikkar tenehu lechelev enah mekuddeshet veim haya kelev shellah mekuddeshet bae rav mari kelev ratz achareha mahu
Behahu hanaa deka matztzela nafshah mineh gamra umakneya leh nafshah o dilma matze amra leh middeorayeta chayyove mechayevatte laatzulan teku
Hitkaddeshi li bechikkar tenehu leani enah mekuddeshet afilu ani hassamuch aleha may tama amra leh ki hechi dimchayyavna beh ana hachi mechayevatte beh atte
Hahu gavra dahava ka mezabben

a: Chumre petachyata atay hahi itta amara leh hav li chad socha amar lah i yahavina lich mikaddeshatte li amara leh hava mehava amar rav chama kol hava mehava lav kelum hu

Hahu gavra dahava ka shate chamra bechanuta atay hahi itta amara leh hav li chad kasa amar lah i yahevna lich mikaddeshatte li amara leh ashkoye ashkeyan amar rav chama kol ashkoye ashkeyan lav kelum hu
Hahu gavra dahava ka shade tamre middikla atay hahi itta amara leh shedi li tarte amar lah i shadena lich mikaddeshatte li amara leh shedi mishda amar rav zevid kol shedi mishda lav kelum hu
Ibaya lehu hav ashki ushdi mahu amar ravina mekuddeshet rav samma bar rakta amar taga demalka enah mekuddeshet vehilcheta enah mekuddeshet
Vehilcheta shirae la tzerichi shuma vehilcheta kerabbi elazar vehilcheta kerava amar rav nachman
Tanu rabbanan bishtar ketzad katav lo al hanneyar o al hacheres af al pi sheen bo shave feruta bittecha mekuddeshet li bittecha meoreset li bittecha li leintu hare zo mekuddeshet
Matkef lah rabbi zera bar memel ha la dame hay shetara lishtar zevine hatam mocher kotev lo sadi mechura lach hacha baal kotev bittecha mekuddeshet li
Amar rava hatam meinyana dikra vehacha meinyana dikra hatam ketiv umachar meachuzzato bemocher tela rachamana hacha ketiv ki yikkach bevaal tela rachamana
Hatam name ketiv sadot bakkesef yiknu keri beh yaknu may tama karet beh yaknu mishshum dichtiv umachar hachi name keri beh ki yakkach dichtiv et bitti natatti laish hazze
Ella amar rava hilcheta ninhu veasmechinhu rabbanan akkerae veibaet ema hatam name ketiv vaekkach et sefer hammikna

Veamar rava amar rav nachman katav lo al hanneyar o al hacheres af al pi sheen bo shave feruta bittecha mekuddeshet li bittecha meoreset li bittecha li leintu ben al yede aviha ben al yede atzmah mekuddeshet middato vehu shello bagra

Katav lah al hanneyar o al hacheres af al pi sheen bo shave feruta hare atte mekuddeshet li hare atte li leintu hare atte meoreset li mekuddeshet ben al yede aviha ben al yede atzmah middatah vehu shebbagra
Bae rabbi shimon ben lakish shetar erusin shekketavo shello lishmah mahu havaot litziot makkeshinan ma
b: Yetzia baenan lishmah af havaya baenan lishmah o dilma havaot lahadade makkeshinan ma havaya dechesef la baenan lishmah af havaya dishtar la baenan lishmah
Batar devaya hadar pashtah havaya litzia makkeshinan deamar kera veyatza vehayeta

Itmar ketavo lishmah veshello middatah rava veravina amri mekuddeshet rav pappa verav sherevya amri enah mekuddeshet amar rav pappa ema tama didhu veema tama didi ema tama didhu dichtiv veyatza vehayeta makkish havaya litzia ma yetzia lishmah veshello middatah af havaya name lishmah veshello middatah
Veema tama didi veyatza vehayeta makkish havaya litzia ma yetzia baenan daat makne af havaya baenan daat makne
Metivi en kotvin shetare erusin venissuin ella middaat shenehen may lav shetare erusin venissuin mammash la shetare pesikata vechidrav gidel amar rav
Deamar rav gidel amar rav kamma atta noten levincha kach vechach levittecha kach vechach amdu vekiddeshu kanu hen hen haddevarim hanniknim baamira

Uvvia mena lan amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera beulat baal melammed shennaase lah baal al yede veila amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi avahu veamri lah resh lakish lerabbi yochanan keura zo sheshshana rabbi uvalah melammed shenniknet bevia
I mehatam hava amena ad dimkaddesh vahadar bael ka mashma lan
Matkef lah rabbi abba bar memel im ken naara hamorasa deamar rachamana biskila hechi mashkachatte lah
I dekaddesh vahadar beel beula hi i dekaddesh vela beel lav kelum hu amruha rabbanan kammeh deabbaye mashkachatte lah kegon shebba aleha arus shello kedarkah
Amar lehu abbaye ad kan la peligi rabbi verabbanan ella beacher aval baal divre hakkol im ba aleha shello kedarkah asaah beula
May hi detanya bau aleha asara anashim vaadayin hi betula kullan biskila rabbi omer omer ani harishon biskila vechullan bechenek
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mashkachatte lah kegon shekkiddeshah bishtar hoil vegomer umotzi gomer umachnis
Verabbi yochanan hay uvalah may aved leh hahu mibe leh zo niknet bevia veen ama haivriyya niknet bevia
Salka datach amena tete bekal vachomer mivama uma yevamah sheen niknet bechesef niknet bevia zo shenniknet bechesef eno din shenniknet bevia
Ma livama shekken zekuka veomedet salka datach amena hoil uchtiv im acheret yikkach lo hikkishah hakkatuv leacheret ma acheret mikanya bevia af ama haivriyya mikanya bevia ka mashma lan
Verabbi hay sevara mena leh im ken lichtov rachamana uvaal may uvalah shema minah tarte
Ulrava deamar bar ahina asberah li ki yikkach ish ishsha uvalah kidushin hamsurin levia hau kidushin kidushin sheen mesurin levia la hau kidushin may ika lememar
Im ken nichtov kera o vealah may uvalah shema minah kullehu
Verabbi hay beulat baal may aved leh hay mibe leh baal ose otah beula shello kedarkah veen acher ose otah beula shello kedarkah
Umi it leh lerabbi hay sevara vehatanya bau aleha asara anashim vaadayin hi betula kullam biskila rabbi omer omer ani harishon biskila vechullam bechenek

a: Amar rabbi zera mode rabbi leinyan kenas dechullehu meshallemi may shena mikketala shane hatam deamar kera umet haish asher shachav immah levaddo
Verabbanan hay levaddo may avdi leh mibe lehu lechidtanya umetu gam shenehem ad sheyyihu shavin keechad divre rabbi oshaya rabbi yonatan omer umet haish asher shachav immah levaddo
Verabbi yochanan hay sevara mena leh im ken nichtov kera beulat ish may beulat baal shema minah tarte
Ibaya lehu techilat bia kona o sof bia kona nafka minah kegon sheheera bah ufashta yadah vekibbela kiddushin meacher
I name lechohen gadol deka kane betula bevia may amar ammemar mishshemeh derava kol habboel dato al gemar bia
Ibaya lehu bia nissuin osa o erusin osa nafka minah leorshah
Velitamme lah ulhafer nedareha i amratte nissuin osa yorshah umitamme lah umefer nedareha vei amratte erusin osa eno yorshah veeno mitamme lah veeno mefer nedareha may

Amar abbaye ta shema haav zakkay bevitto bekiddusheha bechesef bishtar uvvia vezakkay bimtziatah uvmaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha umkabbel et gitah veeno ochel perot bechayyeha niset yater alav habbaal sheochel perot bechayyeha
Katane bia vekatane niset ki katane niset ashsheara
Amar rava ta shema bat shalosh shanim veom echad mitkaddeshet bevia veim ba aleha yavam kenaah vechayyavin aleha mishshum eshet ish umtammea et boalah
b: Letamme mishkav tachton keelon
Veim niset lechohen ochelet bitruma veim ba aleha echad mikkol araot shebbattora mumatin al yadah vehi petura veim ba aleha echad min happesulin pesalah min hakkehunna
Katane bia vekatane niset hachi kaamar i hane nissuin dechohen ninhu ochelet bitruma

Ta shema uchvar shalach yochanan ben bag bag etzel rabbi yehuda ben betira lintzivin shamati alecha sheatta omer arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma shalach lo veatta i atta omer ken muchzekani becha sheatta baki bechadre tora lidrosh bekal vachomer i atta yodea

Uma shifcha kenaanit sheen biatah maachilatah bitruma kaspah maachilatah bitruma zo shebbiatah maachilatah bitruma eno din shekkaspah maachilatah bitruma aval ma eese shehare amru chachamim en arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma ad shettikkanes lachuppa
Hechi dame i bevia sheal yede chuppa vechesef sheal yede chuppa betarvayehu mechal achla
Veella bevia sheal yede chuppa vechesef shello al yede chuppa hacha tarte vehacha chada ella lav bevia shello al yede chuppa vechesef shello al yede chuppa
I amratte bishlama nissuin osa mishshum hachi peshita leh daalima lah bia mikkesef ella i amratte kiddushin osa may shena hacha difshita leh umay shena hacha dimsappeka leh
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak leolam ema lach bevia sheal yede chuppa vechesef shello al yede chuppa udkaamratte hacha tarte vehacha chada kal vachomer miha iteh

Vehachi shelach leh uma shifcha kenaanit sheen biatah maachilatah bitruma afilu al yede chuppa kaspah maachilatah belo chuppa zo shebbiatah maachilatah bitruma al yede chuppa eno din shekkaspah maachilatah bitruma belo chuppa
Aval ma eese shehare amru chachamim en arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma ad shettikkanes lachuppa mishshum deulla
Uven bag bag gabbe shifcha kenaanit la shayyar bekinyanah hacha shayyer bekinyanah
Ravina amar middeorayeta mifshat peshita leh deachla umidderabbanan hu dishlach leh

Vehachi shelach leh shamati alecha sheatta omer arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma vela chayeshatte lesimpon shelach leh veatta i atta omer ken muchzekani becha sheatta baki bechadre tora lidrosh bekal vachomer i atta yodea

Uma shifcha kenaanit sheen biatah maachilatah bitruma kaspah maachilatah bitruma vela chayeshinan lesimpon zo shebbiatah maachilatah bitruma eno din shekkaspah maachilatah bitruma velo nechush lesimpon aval ma eese shehare amru chachamim arusa bat yisrael enah ochelet bitruma

a: Ad shettikkanes lachuppa mishshum deulla
Uven bag bag simpon baavadim let leh i mumin shebbaggaluy hu ha ka chaze leh i mishshum mumin shebbasseter may nafka leh mineh limlacha ka vae leh la ichpat leh
Nimtza gannav o kuvustus higgio may amratte listim mezuyyan o nichtav muchtav lammalchut hanhu kala it lehu
Mikkedi ben lemar uven lemar la achla may benayehu
Ika benayehu kibel masar vehalach
Bechesef bet shammay omrim bedinar vechv may tamayehu devet shammay amar rabbi zera shekken ishsha makpedet al atzmah veen mitkaddeshet befachot middinar

Amar leh abbaye ella meatta kegon benateh derabbi yannay dekafdan annafshayehu vela mikkaddeshan befachot mittarkeva dedinare hachi name dei pashta yadah vekibbela chad zuza meacher hachi name dela hau kiddushin
Amar leh pashta yadah vekibbelah la kaamena ki kaamena dekaddeshah belelya i name deshaviya shaliach
Rav yosef amar tamayehu devet shammay kidrav yehuda amar rav assi deamar rav yehuda amar rav assi kol kesef haamur battora kesef tzori veshel divrehem kesef medina
Gufa amar rav yehuda amar rav assi kol kesef haamur battora kesef tzori veshel divrehem kesef medina uchlala hu
b: Vahare taana dichtiv ki yitten ish el reehu kesef o chelim lishmor utnan shevuat haddayyanin hattaana shette kesef vehahodaa shave feruta
Hatam dumya dechelim ma kelim shenayim af kesef shenayim uma kesef davar chashuv af kelim davar chashuv
Vahare maaser dichtiv vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha utnan happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni kesef hakkesef riba
Vahare hekdesh dichtiv venatan hakkesef vekam lo veamar shemuel hekdesh shave mane shechillo al shave feruta mechullal hatam name kesef kesef yalef mimmaaser
Vahare kidushe ishsha dichtiv ki yikkach ish ishsha uvalah vegamar kicha kicha missede efron utnan bet hillel omrim bifruta uvshave feruta nema rav assi deamar kevet shammay
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav yehuda amar rav assi kol kesef katzuv haamur battora kesef tzori veshel divrehem kesef medina
May ka mashma lan tenena chamesh selaim shel ben sheloshim shel eved chamishshim shel ones veshel mefatte mea shel motzi shem ra kullam beshekel hakkodesh bemane tzori
Veshel divrehem kesef medina itztericha leh dela tenan detanya hattokea lachavero noten lo sela vela tema may sela arbea zuze ella may sela palga dezuza daavidi inashe dekaru lefalga dezuza istera
Rabbi shimon ben lakish omer tamayehu devet shammay kidchizkiyya deamar chizkiyya amar kera vehefdah melammed shemmegaraat mippidonah veotza

I amratte bishlama dihav lah dinar hayenu dimgara veazla ad peruta ella i amratte dihav lah peruta mipperuta mi megara vedilma hachi kaamar rachamana hecha dihav lah dinar tegara ad peruta hecha dihav lah peruta la tegara kelal

a: La salka datach dumya deyiud ma yiud af al gav dei bae meyaed vei bae la meyaed kol hecha dela matze meyaed la hau zevina zevine hachi name kol hecha dela matzya megara la hau zevina zevine
Vekidushe ishsha levet shammay nafka lehu meama haivriyya ma ama haivriyya bifruta la mikkanya af ishsha bifruta la mikaddesha
Veema palga dedinar veema shette perutot kevan deappikteh mipperuta okmah addinar
Rava amar hayenu tama devet shammay shello yehu benot yisrael kehefker
Uvet hillel omrim bifruta savar rav yosef lememar peruta kal dehu amar leh abbaye veha alah katane kamma hi peruta echad mishshemona baisar haitalki

Vechi tema hane mile bedoro shel moshe aval hacha kedachashiva lehu leinashe veha ki ata rav dimi amar shier rabbi simay bedoro kamma hi peruta echad mishshemona baisar haitalki vechi ata ravin amar rabbi dostay verabbi yannay verabbi oshaya shiaru kamma have peruta echad mishshishsha beisar haitalki

Amar leh rav yosef i hachi hayenu detanena tze vachashov kamma perutot bishne selaim yoter mealpayim hashta alpayim la haveyan yater mealpayim kare lehu amar lehu hahu sava ana tenena lah karov lealpayim sof sof alpa vachamesh mea utlatin veshita hu dehaveyan kevan denafka lehu mippalga karov lealpayim kare leh

Gufa ki ata rav dimi amar shier rabbi simay bedoro kamma hi peruta echad mishshemona baisar haitalki vechi ata ravin amar shiaru rabbi dostay verabbi yannay verabbi oshaya kamma hi peruta echad mishshishsha baisar haitalki amar leh abbaye lerav dimi nema atte veravin biflugta dehane tannae ka mipalgitu

Detanya peruta sheamru chachamim echad mishshemona baisar haitalki shesh maa kesef dinar maa shene pundeonin pundeon shene isarin isar shene mismesim mismes shene kunteronkin kunteronk shette ferutot nimtza peruta echad mishshemona baisar haitalki

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shelosha hadresin lemaa shene hantzin lehadres shene shemenin lahanetz shette ferutot leshamen nimtza peruta echad mishshishsha beisar haitalki lema demar amar ketanna kamma veravin deamar kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Amar leh ben didi uven ravin alliba detanna kamma vela kashya ha deiyyakkur isure ha dezul isure ha deiyyakkur isure kum esrim vearba bezuza ha dezul kum telatin utren bezuza
Amar shemuel kidshah bitmara afilu omed kor temarim bedinar mekuddeshet chayeshinan shemma shave peruta bemaday
Veha anan tenan bet hillel omrim bifruta uvshave peruta la kashya ha bekidushe vadday ha bekidushe safek

Hahu gavra dekaddesh bizoda deudre yatev rav shimi bar chiyya kammeh derav veka meayyen bah i it bah shave peruta in i la la vei let bah shave peruta la vehaamar shemuel chayeshinan la kashya ha bekidushe vadday ha bekidushe safek
Hahu gavra dekaddesh beavna dechuchla yatev rav chisda veka meshaer lah i it bah shave peruta in vei la la vei let bah shave peruta la veha amar shemuel chayeshinan rav chisda la savar leh dishmuel
Amara leh imeh veha hahu yoma dekaddeshah hava bah shave peruta amar lah lav kal keminach deasratte lah abbatra
b: Lav hayenu dihudit devethu derabbi chiyya dahavet dahava lah tzaar leda amara leh amara li em kabbel bich avuch kidushe ki zutratte amar lah lav kal keminah deimach deasra lich ilavay
Amri leh rabbanan lerav chisda ammay ha ika sahadi beidit deyadi divhahu yoma hava bah shave peruta hashta miha la letanhu kamman
Lav hayenu derabbi chanina deamar rabbi chanina edeha betzad astan veteaser
Abbaye verava la sevira lehu leha derav chisda im hekelu bishvuya dimnavvela nafshah gabbe shabbay nakel beeshet ish
Ishtear mehahi mishpacha besura ufrashu rabbanan minah velav mishshum disvira lehu dishmuel ella mishshum disvira lehu keabbaye verava
Hahu gavra dekaddesh beshutita deasa beshuka shalchah rav acha bar huna lekammeh derav yosef kehay gavena may shelach leh naggedeh kerav veatzrech gita kishmuel
Derav menagged al dimkaddesh beshuka veal dimkaddesh bevia veal dimkaddesh bela shiduche
Veal dimvattel gita veal demasar modaa aggita veal dimtzaar shelucha derabbanan veal dechala shamta ilaveh telatin yomin
Veal chatna dedayar be chamuh dedayar in chalef la veha hahu chatna dachalef abbava deve chamuh venaggedeh rav sheshet hahu medam havat dayema chamateh mineh
Nehardae amri bechullehu la menagged rav ella al dimkaddesh bevia bela shiduche veika deamri vaafilu beshiduche name mishshum peritzuta
