Hahu gavra dekaddesh betzipta deasa amaru leh veha let bah shave peruta amar lehu tikdosh bearba zuze deit bah shekaltah veishtika amar rava have shetikuta dilachar mattan maot vechol shetikuta dilachar mattan maot lav kelum hi

Amar rava mena amena lah detanya amar lah kinsi sela zo befikkadon vechazar veamar lah hitkaddeshi li bo bishat mattan maot mekuddeshet leachar mattan maot ratzta mekuddeshet lo ratzta enah mekuddeshet
May ratzta umay lo ratzta ilema ratzta deamra in lo ratzta deamra la mikkelal deresha

a: Ki amra la name hau kidushin ammay veha kaamra la ella lav ratzta deamra in lo ratzta deishtika mishtako ushma minah shetika dilachar mattan maot velo kelum hi

Kashu bah befum nahara mishshemeh derav huna bereh derav yehoshua mi dame hatam betorat pikkadon yahavinhu nihalah savra i shadena lehu umitavri mechayyavna behu hacha betorat kiddushin yahavinhu nihalah vei ita dela nicha lah lishdinhu

Parech rav achay attu kullehu neshe dina gemiri hachi name savrah i shadena lehu umitavri mitchayyavna beachrautayehu shelacha rav acha bar rav lekammeh deravina kehay gavena may shelach leh anan la shemia lan ha derav huna bereh derav yehoshua attun dishmia lechu chushu lah

Hahi itta dahava ka mezabbena varsheche ata hahu gavra chataf varshecha minah amara leh haveh nihali amar lah i yahevna lich mikaddeshatte li shekalteh veishtika veamar rav nachman yechela lememar in shekali vedidi shekali
Etiveh rava lerav nachman kidsha begazel uvchamas uvigneva o shechataf sela miyyadah vekiddeshah mekuddeshet hatam bidshaddech

Umna temra deshane lan ben shaddech udla shaddech detanya amar lah kinsi sela zo sheani chayyav lichi vechazar veamar lah hitkaddeshi li bo bishat mattan maot ratzta mekuddeshet lo ratzta enah mekuddeshet leachar mattan maot afilu ratzta enah mekuddeshet
May ratzta umay lo ratzta ilema ratzta deamra in lo ratzta deamra la ha ishtika hau kidushin venitne mekuddeshet setam ki hatam
Ella ratzta deamra in lo ratzta deishtika veka tane deenah mekuddeshet may tama yechela lememar in shekali vedidi shekali
Veella kashya hach dekiddeshah begazel uvchamas uvigneva o shechataf sela miyyadah vekiddeshah mekuddeshet ella lav shema minah ha deshaddech ha dela shaddech

Ki nach nafsheh derabbi assi ayalu rabbanan lenakkotinhu lishmatateh amar lehu hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh hachi amar rabbi assi amar rabbi mani keshem sheen ishsha niknet befachot mishshave peruta kach en karka niknet befachot mishshave peruta amaru leh vehatanya af al pi sheen ishsha niknet befachot mishshave peruta karka niknet befachot mishshave peruta
Amar lehu ki tanya hahi bachalifin detanya konin bichli veaf al pi sheen bo shave peruta

Hadar yatvi vekaamri ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol sheeno yodea betiv gitin vekiddushin lo yehe lo esek immahen amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan vekashin leolam yoter middor hammabbul shenneemar alo vechachesh veratzoach veganov venaof paratzu vedamim bedamim nagau
May mashma kedimtargem rav yosef moldin benin minneshe chavrehon chovin al chovin mosifin

Uchtiv al ken teeval haaretz veumlal kol yoshev bah bechayyat hassade uvof hashshamayim vegam dege hayyam yeasefu vego veilu bedor hammabbul lo nigzera gezera al dagim shebbayyam shenneemar mikkol asher becharava metu velo dagim shebbayyam veilu hacha afilu dagim shebbayyam
Veema ad deaved lechullehu la salka datach dichtiv ki mippene ala avla haaretz
Veema ala lechud vehanach lechudehon
b: Mi ketiv ufaratzu paratzu ketiv
Hadur yatvi vekaamri ha ditnan haishsha shehevia chattatah umeta yaviu yorshin olatah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel vehu shehifrishatta mechayyim aval lo hifrishatta mechayyim la
Alma kasavar shibuda lav deorayeta amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan af al gav shello hifrishatta mechayyim alma kasavar shibuda have deorayeta

Veha peligi bah chada zimna derav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu milva al pe enah gova min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot verabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu milva al pe gova ben min hayyorshin ben min hallakochot
Tzericha dei itmar beha behach kaamar shemuel mishshum dela milva ketuva battora hi aval behach ema mode lehu lerabbi yochanan ulresh lakish
Vei ashmeinan beha beha kaamar rabbi yochanan demilva ketuva battora kichtuva bishtar damya aval behach ema mode leh lishmuel tzericha
Amar rav pappa hilcheta milva al pe gove min hayyorshin veeno gove min hallakochot gove min hayyorshin shibuda deorayeta veeno gove min hallakochot delet leh kala
Vekona et atzmah beget uvmitat habbaal bishlama get dichtiv vechatav lah sefer keritut
Ella mitat habbaal menalan sevara hu hu asrah vehu shartah
Veha araot deasar lehu vela share lehu ella middeamar rachamana yevama sheen lah banim asura ha yesh lah banim mutteret
Vedilma en lah banim asura lealma vesharya leyavam veyesh lah banim lechulle alma name asura ella middeamar rachamana almana lechohen gadol asura ha lechohen hedot sharya
Vedilma lechohen gadol belav lechulle alma baase hay ase may avidteh i deahanya mitat habbaal tishtere ligmare i dela ahanya mitat habbaal tokmah bemilta kammayeta
Allema la appiktah mimmita veokemtah al ase mide dehave appesule hammukdashim
Demeikara it behu meila vaasiri begiza vaavoda parkinhu meila let behu begiza vaavoda asiri
Ella middeamar kera pen yamut bammilchama veish acher yikkachenna matkef lah rav shisha bereh derav idi ema man acher yavam

Amar rav ashe shette teshuvot baddavar chada deyavam la ikri acher veod ketiv usneah haish haacharon vechatav lah sefer keritut o chi yamut haish haacharon veitakkash mita legerushin ma gerushin sharya vegomeret af mita sharya vegomeret
Vehayevama niknet bevia ku bevia menalan amar kera

a: Yevamah yavo aleha ulkachah lo leishsha veema lechullah milta keishsha la salka datach detanya yachol yehu kesef ushtar gomrim bah kederech shehabbia gomeret bah talmud lomar veyibbemah bia gomeret bah veen kesef ushtar gomrim bah
Veema may veyibbemah dival kurchah meyabbem im ken lema kera veyibbem may veyibbemah shamatte minah tarte
Bachalitza menalan dichtiv venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal kevan shechalatz bah naal huttera lechol yisrael
Hay yisrael lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidtane rav shemuel bar yehuda beyisrael bevet din shel yisrael velo bevet din shel nochrim tere beyisrael ketivi

Veakkatti mibe leh lechidtanya amar rabbi yehuda paam achat hayinu yoshvim lifne rabbi tarfon uvata yevama lachlotz veamar lanu anu kullechem veimru chalutz hannaal chalutz hannaal hahu mivvenikra shemo nafka
Uvmitat hayyavam menalan kal vachomer uma eshet ish shehi bechenek mitat habbaal mattiratah yevamah shehi belav lo kol shekken
Ma leeshet ish shekken yotza beget tomar bezo sheenah yotza beget ha name yotza bachalitza
Ella ma leeshet ish shekken osrah mattirah amar rav ashe ha name osrah mattirah yavam osrah yavam share lah

Uthe eshet ish yotza bachalitza mikkal vachomer uma yevama sheenah yotza beget yotza bachalitza zo sheyyotza beget eno din sheyyotza bachalitza amar kera sefer keritut sefer kortah veen davar acher kortah
Uthe yevama yotzet beget mikkal vachomer uma eshet ish sheen yotza bachalitza yotza beget zo sheyyotza bachalitza en din sheyyotza beget amar kera kacha vechacha ikuva
Vechol hecha deika ikuva la darshi kal vachomer veha yom hakkippurim dichtiv goral vechukka
Vetanya veasahu chattat haggoral ose chattat veen hashshem ose chattat
Sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma bimkom shello kidesh haggoral kidesh hashshem mekom shekkidesh haggoral eno din sheyekaddesh hashshem
Talmud lomar veasahu chattat haggoral ose chattat veen hashshem ose chattat vetama demaateh kera ha lav hachi darshinan kal vachomer af al gav dichtiv beh chukka
Amar kera lah lah velo livamah veema lah lishmah
Tere lah ketivi veakkatti mibe leh chad lah lishmah veidach lah velo lah velachavertah
Ella amar kera naal naal in mide acharina la
Vehay naal lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidtanya naalo en li ella naalo naal shel kol adam mena leh
Talmud lomar naal naal riba im ken ma talmud lomar naalo naalo harauy lo perat legadol sheen yachol lehallech bo perat lekatan sheen chofe et rov raglo perat
b: Limsulyam sheen lo akev im ken nichtov kera naal may hannaal shamatte minah tarte

Matni eved ivri nikne bechesef uvishtar vekone atzmo beshanim uvayyovel uvgiron kesef yetera alav ama haivriyya shekkona et atzmah besimanin hannirtza nikne birtzia vekone et atzmo bayyovel uvmitat haadon
Gema eved ivri nikne bechesef menalan amar kera mikkesef miknato melammed shennikne bechesef ashkechan eved ivri hannimkar lenochri hoil vechol kinyano bechesef
Nimkar leyisrael menalan amar kera vehofde melammed shemmegaraat pidonah veotza
Ashkechan ama haivriyya hoil umikaddesha bechesef mikanya bechesef eved ivri menalan amar kera ki yimmacher lecha achicha haivri o haivriyya vaavadcha shesh shanim makkish ivri leivriyya
Ashkechan mecharuhu bet din hoil venimkar beal korcho mocher atzmo menalan
Yalef sachir sachir hanicha leman deyalef sachir sachir ella leman dela yalef sachir sachir may ika lememar
Amar kera vechi tassig musaf al inyan rishon veyilmad elon mittachton
Uman tanna dela yalef sachir sachir hay tanna hu detanya hammocher atzmo nimkar leshesh veyater al shesh mecharuhu bet din eno nimkar ella leshesh

Hammocher atzmo eno nirtza mecharuhu bet din nirtza mocher atzmo en maanikim lo mecharuhu bet din maanikim lo hammocher atzmo en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit mecharuhu bet din rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit

Rabbi elazar omer ze vaze eno nimkar ella leshesh ze vaze nirtza vaze vaze maanikim lo veze vaze rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit may lav beha kamipalgi detanna kamma la yalef sachir sachir verabbi elazar yalef sachir sachir

Amar rav tavome mishshemeh deabbaye dechulle alma yalef sechir sachir vehacha behay kera kamipalgi may tama detanna kamma deamar mocher atzmo nimkar leshesh veyater al shesh miet rachamana gabbe mecharuhu bet din vaavadcha shesh shanim ze velo mocher atzmo
Veidach vaavadcha lecha velo leoresh
Veidach vaavadcha acharina ketiv veidach hahu lehartzaat adon hu daata
May tama detanna kamma deamar mocher atzmo eno nirtza middemaet rachamana gabbe mecharuhu bet din veratza adonav et ozno bammartzea ozno shello velo ozno shel mocher atzmo

a: Veidach hahi ligzera shava hu daata detanya rabbi eliezer omer minnayin lirtzia shehi beozen yamanit neemar kan ozen veneemar lehallan ozen ma lehallan yamin af kan yamin
Veidach im ken lema kera ozen may ozno
Veidach hahu mibe leh ozno velo oznah veidach nafka lah mivveim yomar haeved haeved velo ama
Veidach mibe leh ad sheyyomar keshehu eved
Veidach meeved haeved nafka veidach eved haeved la daresh
May tama detanna kamma deamar mocher atzmo en maanikin lo miet rachamana gabbe mecharuhu bet din haanek taanik lo lo velo lemocher atzmo
Veidach hahu mibe leh lo velo leorshav yorshav ammay la sachir karyeh rachamana ma sachir peullato leorshav af hay peullato leorshav ella lo velo levaal chovo
Middisvira lan bealma kerabbi natan detanya amar rabbi natan minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane vachavero bachavero minnayin shemmotziin mizze venotnin laze talmud lomar venatan laasher asham lo
Ata lo leappoke veidach bealma name la sevira lan kerabbi natan
May tama detanna kamma deamar mocher atzmo en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit maet rachamana gabbe mecharuhu bet din im adonav yitten lo ishsha lo velo lemocher atzmo veidach lo beal korcho
Veidach mikki mishne sechar sachir nafka detanya ki mishne sechar sachir avadcha sachir eno oved ella bayyom eved ivri oved ben bayyom uven ballayela

Vechi taale al datecha sheeved ivri oved ben bayyom uven ballayela vahalo kevar neemar ki tov lo immach immecha bammaachal immecha bammishte veamar rabbi yitzchak mikkan sherabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit
Veidach i mehatam hava amena hane mile middateh aval beal kurcheh ema la ka mashma lan
Ella man tanna dela yalef sachir sachir hay tanna hu detanya veshav el mishpachto vego amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov bamma hakkatuv medabber i bemocher atzmo hare kevar amur

I benirtza hare kevar amur ha en hakkatuv medabber ella bimcharuhu bet din shettayim veshalosh shanim lifne hayyovel shehayyovel motzio vei salka datach yalef sachir sachir lema li nelaf sachir sachir
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak leolam yalef sachir sachir veitzterich salka datach amena mocher atzmo hu dela avad isura aval mecharuhu bet din daavad isura ema nikneseh ka mashma lan
Amar mar i benirtza hare kevar amur may hi detanya veshavtem ish el achuzzato veish el mishpachto vego bamma hakkatuv medabber i bemocher atzmo hare kevar amur

I bimcharuhu bet din hare kevar amur ha en hakkatuv medabber ella benirtza shettayim veshalosh shanim lifne hayyovel shehayyovel motzio may mashma amar rava bar shela amar kera ish ezehu davar shennoheg baish veen noheg baishsha heve omer zo retzia
Veitzterich lemichtav mecharuhu bet din veitzterich lemichtav nirtza dei ashmeinan mecharuhu bet din mishshum dela metay zimneh aval nirtza dimtay zimneh ema nikneseh
Vei ashmeinan nirtza mishshum daavad leh shesh aval mecharuhu bet din dela avad leh shesh ema la tzericha
Veitzterich lemichtav veshavtem veitzterich lemichtav leolam dei ketav rachamana leolam hava amena leolam mammash ketav rachamana veshavtem

Vei ketav rachamana veshavtem hava amena hane mile hecha dela avad shesh aval hecha daavad shesh lo yehe sofo chamur mittechillato ma techillato shesh af sofo name shesh kamashma lan leolam leolamo shel yovel
Ella man tanna dela yalef sachir sachir rabbi hi detanya
b: Veim lo yiggael beelle rabbi omer beelle hu nigal veen nigal beshesh
Sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma mi sheeno nigal beelle nigal beshesh ze shennigal beelle eno din shennigal beshesh talmud lomar beelle beelle hu nigal veen nigal beshesh
Vei salka datach yalef sachir sachir ammay kaamar uma mi sheeno nigal beelle nelaf sachir sachir
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak leolam yalef sachir sachir veshane hacha deamar kera yigalennu laze velo leacher

Uman tanna diflig aleh derabbi rabbi yose haggelili verabbi akiva detanya lo yiggael beelle rabbi yose haggelili omer beelle leshichrur bishar kol adam leshibud rabbi akiva omer beelle leshibud bishar kol adam leshichrur

May tama derabbi yose haggelili amar kera im lo yiggael beelle ella beacher veyatza bishnat hayyovel verabbi akiva omer im lo yiggael ella beelle veyatza bishnat hayyovel verabbi yose haggelili mide ella beelle ketiv
Ella behay kera kamipalgi o dodo o ven dodo yigalennu zo geullat kerovim o hissiga yado zo geullat atzmo venigal zo geullat acherim

Rabbi yose haggelili savar mikra nidrash lefanav shedi geullat kerovim aggeullat atzmo ma geullat atzmo leshichrur af geullat kerovim leshichrur verabbi akiva savar mikra nidrash leacharav shedi geullat acherim aggeullat atzmo ma geullat atzmo leshichrur af geullat acherim leshichrur
I hachi beelle lema li i lav beelle hava amena mikra nidrash ben lefanav ben leacharav vehakkol leshichrur
I hachi hadar kushya leduchteh ella bisvara kamipalgi

Rabbi yose haggelili savar mistabbera geullat acherim leshibud dei amratte leshichrur hao mimani vela parki leh verabbi akiva savar mistabbera geullat kerovim leshibud dei amratte leshichrur kol yoma veoma azal umzabben nafsheh
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi yose haggelili verabbi akiva aval chachamim omrim hakkol leshichrur
Man chachamim rabbi hi demappek leh lehay beelle lidrasha acharina umikra nidrash ben lefanav uven leacharav
Verabbi hay veyatza bishnat hayyovel may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya veyatza bishnat hayyovel

a: Benochri sheyyeshno tachat yadecha o eno ella benochri sheeno tachat yadecha amarta vechi ma efshar laasot lo ha en hakkatuv medabber ella benochri sheyyeshno tachat yadecha
Uvishtar menalan amar ulla amar kera im acheret yikkach lo hikkishah hakkatuv leacheret ma acheret mikkanya bishtar af ama haivriyya mikkanya bishtar

Hanicha leman deamar shetar ama haivriyya adon kotvo ella leman deamar av kotvo may ika lememar deitmar shetar ama haivriyya mi kotvo rav huna amar adon kotvo rav chisda amar av kotvo hanicha lerav huna ella lerav chisda may ika lememar
Amar rav acha bar yaakov amar kera lo tetze ketzet haavadim aval niknet hi kekinyan avadim umay nihu shetar
Veema aval niknet hi kekinyan avadim umay nihu chazaka amar kera vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem otam bachazaka velo acher bachazaka
Veema otam bishtar velo acher bishtar hachtiv lo tetze ketzet haavadim uma raita
Mistabbera shetar hava leh lerabboye shekken motzi bevat yisrael adderabba chazaka hava leh lerabboye shekken kona benichse hagger beishut mihat la ashkechan i baet ema lehachi ahani im acheret
Verav huna hay lo tetze ketzet haavadim may daresh beh hahu mibe leh sheenah yotza berashe evarim keeved verav chisda im ken lichtov kera lo tetze kaavadim may ketzet haavadim shema minah tarte
Vekone et atzmo beshanim dichtiv shesh shanim yaavod uvashsheviit vego
Bayyovel dichtiv ad shenat hayyovel yaavod immach
Begiron kesef amar chizkiyya deamar kera vehofde melammed shemmegaraat pidonah veotza tana vekone et atzmo bechesef uvshave kesef uvishtar
Bishlama kesef dichtiv mikkesef miknato shave kesef name yashiv geullato amar rachamana lerabbot shave kesef kechesef ella hay shetar hechi dame ilema dichtav leh shetara addemeh hayenu kesef
Ella shichrur shetar lema li lema leh beappe tere zil i name beappe be dina zil amar rava zot omeret eved ivri gufo kanuy veharav shemmachal al girono en girono machul

Yetera alav ama haivriyya amar resh lakish ama haivriyya kona et atzmah bemitat haav mershut adon mikkal vachomer uma simanin sheen motziin mershut av motziin mershut adon mita shemmotzia mershut av eno din shemmotzia mershut adon
Metivi rav hoshaya yetera alav ama haivriyya shekkona et atzmah besimanin veim ita nitne name mitat haav tena veshayyar
May shayyar dehay shayyar shayyar mitat haadon i mishshum mitat haadon lav shiyyura hu dechevan deika name beish la katane
Veella nitne tanna davar sheyyesh lo kitzva katane davar sheen lo kitzva la katane
Veha simanin deen lahem kitzva vekatane amar rav safra en lahem kitzva lemala aval yesh lahem kitzva
b: Lematta

Detanya ben tesha shanim shehevi shette searot shuma mibben tesha shanim veom echad ad ben shettem esre shana veom echad veodan bo shuma rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer siman ben shelosh esre shana veom echad divre hakkol siman
Metiv rav sheshet rabbi shimon omer arbaa maanikim lahem shelosha baish ushlosha baishsha vei atta yachol lomar arbaa beechad lefi sheen simanim baish veen retzia baishsha

Veim ita nitne name mitat av vechi tema hacha name tanna veshayyar veha arbaa katane vechi tema tanna davar sheyyesh lo kitzva katane vedavar sheen lo kitzva la katane veha simanin deen lahem kitzva vekatane
Vechi tema hacha name kidrav safra vehaika mitat adon deen lahm kitzva vekatane mitat adon name la katane
Veella arbaa may nihu shanim veovel veovel shel retzia veama haivriyya besimanim
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa i atta yachol lomar arbaa beechad mehem lefi sheen simanim baish veen retzia baishsha veim ita beishsha miha mashkachatte lah arbaa shema minah
Metiv rav amram veellu maanikim lahem hayyotze beshanim uvayyovel uvmitat haadon veama haivriyya besimanim veim ita nitne name mitat av vechi tema tena veshayyar veha ellu katane
Vechi tema davar sheyyesh lo kitzva katane davar sheen lo kitzva la katane veha simanin deen lahem kitzva vekatane vechi tema hacha name kidrav safra haika mitat adon teuvta deresh lakish teuvta
Veha resh lakish kal vachomer amar kal vachomer pericha hu mishshum deika lemifrach ma lesimanin shennishtanna hagguf tomar bemitat av shekken lo nishtanna hagguf
Tane chada enek eved ivri leatzmo veenek ama haivriyya leatzmah vetanya idach enek ama haivriyya umtziatah leaviha veen lerabba ella sechar battala bilvad
May lav ha denafka besimanim veha denafka lah bemitat av
La idi veidi denafka lah besimanin vela kashya ha deiteh leav ha deleteh leav
Bishlama enek ama haivriyya leatzmah lemaote achin detanya vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem otam livnechem velo benotechem livnechem mikkan sheen adam morish zechut bitto livno
Ella enek eved ivri leatzmo peshita ella leman amar rav yosef yod keret ka chazena hacha
Abbaye amar hachi amar rav sheshet ha manni tutay hu detanya tutay omer lo velo levaal chovo

Gufa ellu maanikim lahem hayyotze beshanim uvayyovel uvmitat adon veama haivriyya besimanin aval boreach veotze begiron kesef en maanikim lo rabbi meir omer boreach en maanikin lo veotze begiron kesef maanikim lo
Rabbi shimon omer arbaa maanikim lahem shelosha baish ushlosha baishsha vei atta yachol lomar arbaa beechad mehen lefi sheen simanin baish urtzia baishsha
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan yachol lo yehu maanikim ella layyotze beshesh minnayin lerabbot yotze bayyovel uvmitat haadon veama haivriyya besimanin talmud lomar teshallechennu vechi teshallechennu

Yachol sheani merabbe boreach veotze begiron kesef talmud lomar vechi teshallechennu chofshi meimmach mi sheshshilucho meimmach yatza boreach veotze begiron kesef sheen shilucho meimmach rabbi meir omer boreach en maanikin lo deen shilucho meimmach aval yotze begiron kesef sheshshilucho meimmach
Boreach hashlama bae detanya minnayin levoreach shechayyav lehashlim talmud lomar shesh shanim yaavod

a: Yachol afilu chala talmud lomar uvashsheviit yetze
Amar rav sheshet hacha bemay askinan kegon shebbarach ufaga bo yovel mahu detema hoil veappek leh yovel shilucho meimmach karenan beh vela nikneseh venaanek leh ka mashma lan

Amar mar yachol afilu chala talmud lomar uvashsheviit yetze afilu chala kol shesh vehatanya chala shalosh veavad shalosh eno chayyav lehashlim chala kol shesh chayyav lehashlim amar rav sheshet beose maase machat

Ha gufa kashya amratte chala shalosh veavad shalosh en chayyav lehashlim ha arba chayyav lehashlim ema sefa chala kol shesh chayyav lehashlim ha arba en chayyav lehashlim hachi kaamar chala arba naasa kemi shechala kol shesh vechayyav lehashlim

Tanu rabbanan kamma maanikim lo chamesh selaim mikkol min vamin shehen chamesh esre selaim divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer sheloshim kishloshim shel eved rabbi shimon omer chamishshim kachamishshim shebbaarachin

Amar mar chamesh selaim mikkol min vamin shehem chamesh esre selaim divre rabbi meir verabbi meir minyana ata leashmoinan ha ka mashma lan mivtzar hu dela mevatztzar livtzar leh mehay minyana vei batzar leh mechad mina vetafe leh mechad mina let lan bah
May tama derabbi meir yalef rekam rekam mibbechor ma lehallan chamesh selaim af kan chamesh selaim
Veema chamesh selaim mikkullehu i ketiv rekam levassof kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv rekam beresha shedi rekam atztzon rekam aggoren rekam ayyekev
Venelaf rekam rekam meolat reiyya amar kera asher berachcha Adonai elohecha
Rabbi yehuda omer sheloshim kishloshim shel eved may tama derabbi yehuda yalef netina netina meeved ma lehallan sheloshim af kan sheloshim
Venelaf netina netina mearachin ma lehallan chamishshim af kan chamishshim
Chada detafasta merubbe lo tafasta tafasta muat tafasta veod eved meeved hava leh lemelaf

Rabbi shimon omer chamishshim kachamishshim shebbaarachin may tameh derabbi shimon gamar netina netina mearachin ma lehallan chamishshim af kan chamishshim veema kappachut shebbaarachin asher berachcha Adonai elohecha ketiv
Venelaf netina netina meeved ma lehallan sheloshim af kan sheloshim chada detafasta merubbe lo tafasta veod eved meeved hava leh lemelaf rabbi shimon micha micha gamar
Bishlama lerabbi meir hayenu dichtiv tzon goren vayekev ella lerabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hay tzon goren vayekev lema li

Hay mibe leh lechidtanya yachol lo yehu maanikin ella mitztzon goren vayekev minnayin lerabbot kol davar talmud lomar asher berachcha Adonai elohecha im ken ma talmud lomar tzon goren vayekev lomar lach ma tzon goren vayekev meuchadim sheyyeshnan bichlal beracha af kol sheyyeshnan bichlal beracha yatzu kesafim divre rabbi shimon rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer yatzu peradot
Verabbi shimon peradot mashbechan begufayehu verabbi eliezer ben yaakov kesafim aved behu iska
Utzricha dei ketav rachamana tzon hava amena baale chayyim in gidule karka la ketav rachamana goren vei ketav goren hava amena gidule karka in baale chayyim la ketav rachamana tzon yekev lema li
b: Lemar lemaote kesafim lemar lemaote peradot

Tanu rabbanan asher berachcha Adonai elohecha yachol nitbarech bayit biglalo maanikim lo lo nitbarech bayit biglalo en maanikim lo talmud lomar haanek taanik mikkol makom im ken ma talmud lomar asher berachcha hakkol lefi beracha ten lo
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer devarim kichtavan nitbarech bayit biglalo maanikim lo lo nitbarech bayit biglalo en maanikim lo im ken ma talmud lomar haanek taanik dibbera tora chilshon bene adam

Tanu rabbanan eved ivri oved et habben veeno oved et habbat ama ivriyya enah ovedet lo et habben velo et habbat hannirtza vehannimkar lenochri eno oved lo et habben velo et habbat amar mar eved ivri oved et habben veeno oved et habbat menahane mile

Detanu rabbanan vaavadcha shesh shanim lecha velo layyoresh atta omer lecha velo layyoresh o eno ella lecha velo labben keshehu omer shesh shanim yaavod hare labben amur ha ma ani mekayyem vaavadcha shesh shanim lecha velo layyoresh
Ma raita lerabbot et habben ulhotzi et haach merabbe ani et habben shekken kam tachat aviv liida velisde achuzza
Adderabba merabbe ani et haach shekken kam tachat achiv leyibbum kelum yesh yibbum ella bemakom sheen ben ha yesh ben en yibbum
Ella tama deika ha pircha ha lav hachi ach adif vetipok li dehacha tarte vehacha chada
Sede achuzza name mehay pircha hu deka nafka leh letanna kelum yesh yibbum ella bemakom sheen ben

Ama haivriyya enah ovedet lo et habben velo et habbat menahane mile amar rabbi peda deamar kera veaf laamatcha taase ken hikkishah hakkatuv lannirtza ma nirtza eno oved lo et habben velo et habbat af ama haivriyya enah ovedet lo et habben velo et habbat vehay laamatcha taase ken lehachi hu daata ha mibe leh lechidtanya veaf laamatcha taase ken leheenek
Atta omer leheenek o eno ella lirtzia keshehu omer veim amor yomar haeved haeved velo ama haivriyya hare retzia amur
Ha ma ani mekayyem veaf laamatcha taase ken leheenek im ken nichtov kera laamatcha ken may taase shamatte minah tarte

Hannirtza vehannimkar lenochri eno oved lo et habben velo et habbat nirtza dichtiv veratza adonav et ozno bammartzea vaavado leolam velo et habben veet habbat nimkar lenochri minnayin amar chizkiyya amar kera vechishshav im konehu velo im yorshe konehu
Amar rava devar tora nochri yoresh et aviv shenneemar vechishshav im konehu velo im yorshe konehu mikkelal deit leh yorshim ger et hannochri eno middivre tora ella middivre sofrim
Ditnan ger venochri sheyyarshu et avihem nochri ger yachol lomar lenochri tol atta avoda zara vaani maot tol atta yayin nesech vaani perot mishshebbau lirshut ger asur
Vei salka datach deorayeta ki lo vau lirshuto name ki shakel chilufe avoda zara hu deka shakel
Ella midderabbanan gezera hu daavud rabbanan shemma yachzor lesoro tanya name hachi bamme devarim amurim kesheyyarshu aval keshennishtattefu asur
Nochri et hagger veger et hagger eno lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim ditnan lava maot min hagger shennitgayeru banav immo lo yachazir levanav veim hechezir en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu
Vehatanya ruach chachamim nocha hemennu la kashya kan shehorato veledato shello bikdushsha

a: Vechan shehorato shello bikdushsha veledato bikdushsha

Rav chiyya bar avin amar rabbi yochanan nochri yoresh et aviv devar tora dichtiv ki yerushsha leesav natatti et har seir vedilma yisrael meshummad shane ella mehacha ki livne lot natatti et ar yerushsha
Verav chiyya bar avin may tama la amar kerava mi ketiv vechishshav im konehu velo im yorshe konehu
Verava may tama la amar kerav chiyya bar avin mishshum kevodo deavraham shane

Tanu rabbanan yesh baivri sheen baivriyya veyesh baivriyya sheen baivri yesh baivri shehu yotze beshanim uvayyovel uvmitat haadon ma sheen ken baivriyya veyesh baivriyya shehare ivriyya yotza besimanin veenah nimkeret venishnet umafdin otah beal korcho ma sheen ken baivri
Amar mar yesh baivri sheen baivriyya urminhi yetera alav ama haivriyya shekkona atzmah besimanin amar rav sheshet kegon sheyeada
Yeada peshita gita baaya mahu detema la livtela livtelan hilchata minah ka mashma lan i hachi ammay yotza besimanin hachi kaamar im lo yeada yotza af besimanin
Veenah nimkeret venishnet mikkelal deeved ivri nimkar venishne vehatanya bignevato velo bichfelo bignevato velo bizmamo bignevato kevan shennimkar paam achat shuv i atta rashshay lemochro
Amar rava la kashya kan bigneva achat kan bishte genevot
Amar leh abbaye bignevato tuva mashma ella amar abbaye la kashya kan beadam echad kan bishne bene adam
Tanu rabbanan genevo elef veshave chamesh meot nimkar vechozer venimkar genevo chamesh meot veshave elef eno nimkar kelal rabbi eliezer omer im haya genevo keneged mimkaro nimkar veim lav eno nimkar

Amar rava beha zechanhu rabbi eliezer lerabbanan demay shena genevo chamesh meot veshave elef deen nimkar denimkar kullo amar rachamana velo chetzo hachi name nimkar bignevato amar rachamana velo nimkar bachatzi genevato
Umafdin otah beal korcho sevar rava lememar beal kurcheh deadon amar leh abbaye may nihu dechatevna leh shetara addemeha ammay naket marganita bideh yahevna leh chaspa
Ella amar abbaye beal kurcheh deav mishshum pegam mishpacha i hachi eved ivri name nichpinhu livne mishpacha mishshum pegam mishpacha hadar azel umzabben nafsheh

Hacha name hadar azel umzabben lah ha katane enah nimkeret venishnet umanni rabbi shimon hi detanya mocher adam et bitto leishut veshone leshifchut veshone leishut achar shifchut aval lo leshifchut achar ishut rabbi shimon omer keshem sheen adam mocher et bitto leshifchut achar ishut kach en adam mocher et bitto leshifchut achar shifchut
Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya bevigdo bah
b: Kevan shepperas tallito aleha shuv en rashshay lemochrah divre rabbi akiva rabbi eliezer omer bevigdo bah kevan shebbagad bah shuv en rashshay lemochrah
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi eliezer savar yesh em lammasoret verabbi akiva savar yesh em lammikra verabbi shimon savar yesh em lammikra velammasoret
Bae rabba bar avuh yiud nisuin ose o erusin ose nafka minah leorshah velitamme lah ulhafer nedareha may

Ta shema bevigdo bah kevan shepperas tallito aleha shuv eno rashshay lemochrah zabbone hu dela mezabben lah ha yaode meyaed lah vei amratte nisuin ose kevan deniset shuv en leaviha reshut bah ella lav shema minah erusin ose
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hacha bekidushin dealma kae vehachi kaamar kevan shemmesarah aviha lemi shennitchayyev bisherah kesutah veonatah shuv en yachol lemochrah
Ta shema en mochrah likrovim mishshum rabbi eliezer amru mochrah likrovim veshavin shemmochrah almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot
Hay almana hechi dame ilema dekaddish nafshah almana kare lah veella dekaddeshah aviha mi matze mezabben lah veha en adam mocher et bitto leshifchut achar ishut

Veamar rav amram amar rabbi yitzchak hacha bekiddushe yiud vealliba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar maot harishonot lav lekidushin nitnu vei amratte nisuin ose kevan shenniset shuv en leaviha reshut bah

Veella may erusin ose veshavin shemmochrah ha en adam mocher et bitto leshifchut achar ishut ella may it lach lememar shane erusin didah meerusin deaviha afilu tema nisuin ose shane nisuin didah minnisuin deaviha
Hay may bishlama erusin meerusin shane ella nisuin minnisuin

a: Mi shane

Ulrav nachman bar yitzchak deamar afilu lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda maot harishonot lekidushin nitnu bemay mokem lah mokem lah kerabbi eliezer deamar leshifchut achar shifchut hu dela matze mezabben lah aval leshifchut achar ishut matze mezabben lah
Bae resh lakish mahu shemmeyaed adam livno katan beno amar rachamana beno kal dehu o dilma beno dumya dideh ma hu gadol af beno gadol
Amar rabbi zera ta shema ish perat lekatan asher yinaf et eshet ish perat leeshet katan vei amratte meyaed im ken matzinu ishut lekatan
Veella may eno meyaed ammay ka memaet leh kera tifshot minah dimyaed amar rav ashe hacha beyavam ben tesha shanim veom echad habba al yevimto askinan
Demiddeorayeta chazya leh mahu detema kevan demiddeorayeta chazya leh uviato bia habba aleha mitchayyev beeshet ish ka mashma lan
May have alah ta shema amar rabbi ayevu amar rabbi yannay en yiud ella begadol en yiud ella middaat tarte ma taam kaamar ma taam en yiud ella begadol lefi sheen yiud ella middaat
Veibaet ema may middaat middaat didah detane abbaye bereh derabbi avahu asher lo yeadah melammed shetztzarich leyaadah

Hu tane lah vehu amar lah bekidushe yiud vealliba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar maot harishonot lav lekidushin nitnu rav nachman bar yitzchak amar afilu tema lekidushin nitnu shane hacha deamar rachamana yeadah
May rabbi yose berabbi yehuda detanya yeadah vehefdah tzarich sheyehe shehut bayyom kede fediyya
Mikkan amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda im yesh shehut bayyom kede laasot immo shave peruta mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet alma kasavar maot harishonot lav lekidushin nitnu
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar afilu tema lekidushin nitnu shane hacha deamar rachamana vehefdah
Amar rava amar rav nachman omer adam levitto ketanna tzei vekabbeli kidushayich midderabbi yose berabbi yehuda
Lav amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda maot harishonot lav lekidushin nitnu vechi meshayyar bah shave peruta hau kidushe hacha name la shena

Veamar rava amar rav nachman hamkaddesh bemilva sheyyesh aleha mashkon mekuddeshet midderabbi yose berabbi yehuda lav amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda maot harishonot lav lekidushin nitnu hay halvaa hi vehi gufah mashkon hi
b: Vechi meshayyar bah shave peruta umyaed hau kidushin hacha name la shena

Tanu rabbanan ketzad mitzvat yiud omer lah bifne shenayim hare atte mekuddeshet li hare atte meoreset li afilu besof shesh vaafilu samuch lishkiat hachamma venoheg bah minhag ishut veeno noheg bah minhag shifchut rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer im yesh shehut beom kede laasot immo shave peruta mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet
Mashal leomer leishsha hitkaddeshi li meachshav leachar sheloshim yom uva acher vekidshah betoch sheloshim yom shemmekuddeshet larishon mashal leman
Ilema mashal lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda ha im yesh shehut beom kede laasot immo shave peruta mekuddeshet veim lav lo
Amar rav acha bereh derava mashal lerabbanan peshita
Mahu detema ha la amar leh meachshav ka mashma lan
Tanya idach hammocher et bitto vehalach vekidshah leacher sichek baadon umkuddeshet lashsheni divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim im ratza leyaed meyaed
Mashal laomer leishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li leachar sheloshim yom uva acher vekidshah betoch sheloshim yom shemmekuddeshet lashsheni mashal leman
Ilema lerabbanan haamri rabbanan im ratza leyaed meyaed
Ella amar rav acha bereh derava mashal lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda peshita
Mahu detema ha la amar lah leachar sheloshim yom ka mashma lan

Tanya idach hammocher et bitto ufasak al menat shello leyaed nitkayyem hattenay divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim im ratza leyaed meyaed mippene shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel

Ulrabbi meir tenao kayyam vehatanya haomer leishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li al menat sheen lecha alay sheer kesut veona hare zo mekuddeshet utnao batel divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer bedavar shebbemamon tenao kayyam
Amar chizkiyya shane hacha deamar kera leama peamim sheeno mochrah ella leama bilvad
Verabbanan hay leama may avdi leh hay mibe lehu lechidtanya leama melammed shemmochrah lifsulim

Vahalo din hu im mekaddeshah lifsulim lo yimkerenna lifsulim ma limkaddeshah lifsulim shekken adam mekaddesh et bitto keshehi naara yimkerenna lifsulim sheen adam mocher et bitto keshehi naara talmud lomar leama melammed shemmochrah lifsulin
Rabbi eliezer omer im lelammed shemmochrah lifsulin hare kevar neemar im raa beene adoneha sheraa benisueha ma talmud lomar leama melammed shemmochrah

a: Likrovim

Vahalo din hu im mochrah lifsulin lo yimkerenna likrovim ma lemochrah lifsulin sheim ratza leyaed meyaed yimkerenna likrovim sheim ratza leyaed eno meyaed amar kera leama melammed shemmochrah likrovim
Verabbi meir lifsulin nafka leh mehecha denafka leh lerabbi eliezer bikrovim savar lah kerabbanan deamri en mochrah likrovim
Tane chada mochrah leaviv veen mochrah livno vetanya idach en mochrah lo leaviv velo livno bishlama eno mochrah lo leaviv velo livno kerabbanan ella mochrah leaviv veen mochrah livno keman
La kerabbanan vela kerabbi eliezer leolam kerabbanan modu rabbanan hecha deika tzad yiud

Tanu rabbanan im begappo yavo begappo yetze begufo nichnas begufo yetze rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer yechidi nichnas yechidi yetze may begufo nichnas begufo yetze amar rava lomar sheeno yotze berashe evarim keeved amar leh abbaye hahu millo tetze ketzet haavadim nafka
I mehatam hava amena nitev leh deme eneh venipok ka mashma lan

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer yechidi nichnas yechidi yetze may yechidi yetze amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hachi kaamar yesh lo ishsha uvanim rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit en lo ishsha uvanim en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit
Tanu rabbanan nimkar bemane vehishbiach veamad al matayim minnayin sheen mechashshevin lo ella mane shenneemar mikkesef miknato
Nimkar bematayim vehichsif veamad al mane minnayin sheen mechashshevin lo ella mane talmud lomar kefi shanav
En li ella eved hannimkar lenochri hoil venigal bikrovim yado al hattachtona
Nimkar leyisrael menalan talmud lomar sachir sachir ligzera shava

Amar abbaye hareni keven azzay beshuke teverya amar leh hahu merabbanan leabbaye mikkedi hane kerae ika lemidreshinhu lekulla veika lemidreshinhu lechumra may chazet dedarshinhu lemidreshinhu lekulla nidreshinhu lechumra
La salka datach middeakkel rachamana legabbeh detanya ki tov lo immach immecha bammaachal veimmecha bammishte

Shello tehe atta ochel pat nekiyya vehu ochel pat kibar atta shote yayin yashan vehu shote yayin chadash atta yashen al gabbe mochim vehu yashen al gabbe hatteven mikkan amru kol hakkone eved ivri kekone adon leatzmo

Veema hane mile leinyan achila ushtiyya ki hechi dela litztaar leh ha leinyan pidon nachmir aleh midderabbi yose berabbi chanina detanya rabbi yose berabbi chanina omer bo ure kamma kashe avakah shel sheviit

Adam nose venoten beferot sheviit lesof mocher et mittaltelav shenneemar bishnat hayyovel tashuvu ish el achuzzato usmich leh vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha davar hannikne miyyad leyad
Lo hirgish lesof mocher et sedotav shenneemar ki yamuch achicha umachar meachuzzato lo bat leyado ad shemmocher et beto shenneemar ki yimkor bet moshav ir choma
May shena hatam deamar lo hirgish umay shena hacha deamar lo bat leyado kidrav huna deamar rav huna kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah huttera lo huttera lo salka datach ella naaset lo keheter

Lo bat leyado ad shemmocher et bitto shenneemar vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama veaf al gav devitto la ketiva behay inyana ha ka mashma lan nizabben inash beratte vela nezif beribita may tama beratte megara venafka veha mosfa veazla

Lo bat leyado ad shellove beribbit shenneemar vechi yamuch achicha umata yado immach usmich leh al tikkach meitto vego lo bat leyado ad shemmocher et atzmo shenneemar vechi yamuch achicha venimkar lach
Lo lecha ella leger shenneemar leger velo leger tzedek ella leger toshav shenneemar ger toshav mishpachat ger ze nochri keshehu omer leeker
b: Ze hannimkar laavoda zara atzmah
Amar leh hatam ha ahdereh kera detane deve rabbi yishmael hoil vehalach ze venaasa komer laavoda zara ema lidche even achar hannofel talmud lomar achare nimkar geulla tihye lo echad meechav yigalennu
Veema geulla tihye lo ki hechi dela litamma ben hannochrim ha leinyan pidon nachmir aleh midderabbi yose berabbi chanina

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak tere kerae ketivi ketiv im od rabbot bashshanim uchtiv veim meat nishar bashshanim vechi yesh shanim merubbot veyesh shanim muatot ella nitrabba kaspo mikkesef miknato nitmaet kaspo kefi shanav
Veema hachi kaamar hecha daavad tere ufush leh arba nitev leh arba mikkesef miknato avad arba ufushov leh tarte nitev tarte kefi shanav

Im ken nichtov kera im od rabbot shanim im meat nishar shanim may bashshanim nitrabba kaspo bashshanim mikkesef miknato nitmaet kaspo bashshanim kefi shanav amar rav yosef darshinhu rav nachman bar yitzchak lehane kerae kesinay
Siman eved bayit chatzain bayit eved kerovim bea mineh rav huna bar chinana merav sheshet eved ivri hannimkar lenochri nigal lachatzain o eno nigal lachatzain
Geullato geullato missede achuzza gamar ma sede achuzza eno nigal lachatzain af hay name eno nigal lachatzain o dilma lekulla amrinan lechumra la amrinan
Amar leh lav amratte hatam nimkar kullo velo chetzo hachi name nigal kullo velo chetzo

Amar abbaye im timtze lomar nigal lachatzain mashkachatte lah lekulla ulchumra lekulla zavneh bima yehav leh chamshin palga dedame veashbach vekam al matan i amratte nigal lachatzain yahev leh mea venafek vei amratte en nigal lachatzain yahev leh mea vechamshin venafek
Vehaamratte nitrabba kaspo mikkesef miknato kegon deokir vezal veokir

Mashkachatte lah lechumra zavneh bematan yehav mea palge didme veiksif vekam al mea i amratte nigal lachatzain yahev leh chamshin venafek vei amratte en nigal lachatzain hanach mea pikkadon ninhu gabbeh yahev lehu nihaleh venafek

Bea mineh rav huna bar chinana merav sheshet hammocher bayit bevatte are choma nigal lachatzain o eno nigal lachatzain geullato geullato missede achuzza gamar ma sede achuzza enah nigelet lachatzain af hay name eno nigal lachatzain
O dilma hecha degalli galli hecha dela galli la galli
Amar leh mimmidrasho shel rabbi shimon nishma shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain detanya im gaol yigal melammed shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain
Amar rabbi shimon ma taam lefi shemmatzinu bemocher sede achuzza sheyyippa kocho sheim higgia yovel velo nigala chozeret livaleha bayyovel hora kocho sheeno love vegoel vegoel lachatzain
Makdish shehora kocho sheim higgia yovel velo nigala yotza lechohanim bayyovel yippa kocho shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain
Hay mocher bayit bevatte are choma name hoil vehora kocho sheim mala lo shana temima velo nigala nechlat yippa kocho shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain
Etiveh im gaol yigal melammed shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain

Sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma mocher sede achuzza sheyyippa kocho sheim higgia yovel velo nigala chozeret livaleha bayyovel hora kocho sheen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain makdish shehora kocho sheim higgia yovel velo nigala yotza lechohanim bayyovel eno din shehora kocho sheen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain
Ma lemocher sede achuzza shekken hora kocho ligael miyyad tomar bemakdish sheyyippa kocho ligael miyyad
Mocher bayit bevatte are choma yochiach sheyyippa kocho ligael miyyad veen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain la kashya

a: Ha rabbanan ha rabbi shimon
Tane chada love vegoel vegoel lachatzain vetanya idach en love vegoel vegoel lachatzain la kashya ha rabbanan ha rabbi shimon
Siman charash chavash zeman
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe ika lemifrach ma lemocher bayit bevatte are choma shekken hora kocho ligael leolam tomar bemakdish sheyyippa kocho ligael leolam

Amar leh rav acha sava lerav ashe mishshum deika lememar nehdar dina tete bema hatztzad mocher sede achuzza yochiach sheyyippa kocho ligael leolam veen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain ma lemocher sede achuzza shekken hora kocho ligael miyyad mocher bayit bevatte are choma yochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shennigalin veen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain af ani avi makdish shennigal veen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina ika lemifrach ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken hora kocham ligael beshana sheniyya tomar bemakdish sheyyippa kocho ligael beshana sheniyya
Amar leh ravina mishshum deika lememar eved ivri hannimkar lenochri yochiach sheyyippa kocho ligael beshana sheniyya veen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain

Bea mineh rav huna bar chinana merav sheshet hammocher bayit bevatte are choma nigal likrovim o en nigal likrovim geullato geullato missede achuzza gamar ma sede achuzza enah nigelet lachatzain venigelet likrovim af hay name en nigal lachatzain venigal likrovim
O dilma ki ketiva geulla bachatzain hu dichtiva bikrovim la ketiva amar leh eno nigal
Etiveh bechol geulla tittenu lerabbot battim veeved ivri may lav batte are choma la batte chatzerim
Batte chatzerim behedya ketiv behu al sede haaretz yechashev hahu lekovo chova vealliba derabbi eliezer

Detanya vegaal et mimkar achiv reshut atta omer reshut o eno ella chova talmud lomar veish ki lo yihye lo goel vechi yesh adam beyisrael sheen lo goalim ella ze sheyyesh lo veeno rotze likach sheharshut beyado divre rabbi yehoshua
Rabbi eliezer omer vegaal et mimkar achiv chova atta omer chova o eno ella reshut talmud lomar bechol geulla tittenu hakkatuv kevao chova
Amri leh rabbanan lerav ashe veamri lah ravina lerav ashe bishlama leman deamar lerabbot batte are choma hayenu dichtiv bechol ella leman deamar lerabbot batte chatzerim may bechol kashya
Etiveh abbaye ma talmud lomar yigalennu yigalennu yigalennu shalosh peamim lerabbot kol haggeullot shennigalot kasseder hazze may lav batte are choma veeved ivri la batte chatzerim usde achuzza
Batte chatzerim usde achuzza behedya ketiv al sede haaretz yechashev kidamar rav nachman bar yitzchak lekarov karov kodem hachi name lekarov karov kodem

Hecha itmar derav nachman bar yitzchak aha deibaya lehu eved ivri hannimkar leyisrael nigal likrovim o eno nigal likrovim alliba derabbi la tibbee lach deamar mi sheeno nigal beelle nigal beshesh alma la miprek
Ki tibe lach alliba derabbanan may yalfinan sachir sachir vela darshi yigalennu o dilma yigalennu laze velo leacher
Ta shema bechol geulla tittenu lerabbot battim veeved ivri may lav batte are choma veeved ivri hannimkar leyisrael la eved ivri hannimkar lenochri
Eved ivri hannimkar lenochri behedya ketiv beh o dodo o ven dodo yigalennu
b: Hahu lekovo chova vaafilu lerabbi yehoshua

Ta shema ma talmud lomar yigalennu yigalennu yigalennu shalosh peamim lerabbot kol haggeullot shennigalot kasseder hazze may lav batte are choma veeved ivri hannimkar leyisrael la batte chatzerim usde achuzza batte chatzerim behedya ketiv behu al sede haaretz yechashev amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lekarov karov kodem
Vehannirtza nikne birtzia dichtiv veratza adonav et ozno bammartzea vego
Vekone et atzmo bayyovel uvmitat haadon dichtiv vaavado velo et habben velo et habbat leolam leolamo shel yovel

Tanu rabbanan martzea en li ella martzea minnayin lerabbot hassol vehassira vehammachat vehammakdeach vehammachtev talmud lomar velakachta lerabbot kol davar shennikkach bayyad divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda
Rabbi omer ma martzea meuchad shel mattechet af kol shel mattechet davar acher hammartzea lehavi hammartzea haggadol

Amar rabbi elazar yudan beribi haya doresh keshehen rotzim en rotzim ella bammilta vachachamim omrim en eved ivri kohen nirtza mippene shennaase baal mum veim tomar bemilta hem rotzim heach eved ivri kohen yease baal mum ha en nirtza ella begovah shel ozen bemay kamipalgi
Derabbi daresh kelale ufrate velakachta kalal martzea parat beozno uvaddelet chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash shel mattechet af kol shel mattechet
Rabbi yose daresh ribuye umiute velakachta riba martzea miet beozno uvaddelet chazar veriba riba umiet veriba riba hakkol
May rabbi rabbi kol mile may maet maet sam
Amar mar hammartzea lehavi martzea haggadol may mashma kidamar rava hayyarech hamummenet shebbayyarech hacha name hammartzea meuchad shebbammartzein

Amar rabbi elazar yudan beribi haya doresh keshehen rotzin en rotzin ella bemilta vachachamim omrim en eved ivri kohen nirtza mippene shennaase baal mum veyease baal mum amar rabba bar rav shela amar kera veshav el mishpachto lemuchzak shebbemishpachto
Ibaya lehu eved ivri kohen mahu sheyyimsor lo rabbo shifcha kenaanit chidush hu la shena kohanim vela shena yisrael
O dilma shane kohanim hoil veriba bahen hakkatuv mitzot yeterot rav amar muttar ushmuel amar asur
Amar leh rav nachman lerav anan ki havetu be mar shemuel beiskumdere itallelitu may tama la temru leh meha vachachamim omrim en eved ivri kohen nirtza mippene shennaase baal mum
Veim tomar en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit tipok li devaena ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay veleka tu la midi
Ibaya lehu kohen mahu bifat toar chidush hu la shena kohen vela shena yisrael o dilma shane kohanim hoil veriba bahen mitzot yeterot rav amar muttar ushmuel amar asur
Bevia rishona dechulle alma la peligi dishre delo dibbera tora ella keneged yetzer hara
Ki peligi bevia sheniyya rav amar muttar ushmuel amar asur rav amar muttar hoil veishtera ishteray ushmuel amar asur deha haveya lah giyyoret vegiyyoret lechohen la chazya

Ika deamri bevia sheniyya kulle alma la peligi daasira dehaveya lah giyyoret ki peligi bevia rishona rav amar muttar deha lo dibbera tora ella keneged yetzer hara ushmuel amar asur kol hecha dekarena bah vahavetah el toch betecha karena bah veraita bashshivya kol hecha dela karena bah vahavetah el toch betecha la karena bah veraita bashshivya
Tanu rabbanan veraita bashshivya bishat shivyah eshet vaafilu eshet ish yefat toar lo dibbera tora ella keneged yetzer hara mutav sheyyochlu yisrael besar

a: Temutot shechutot veal yochlu besar temutot nevelot vechashakta af al pi sheenah naa bah velo bah uvachavertah
Velakachta likuchin yesh lecha bah lecha leishsha shello yikkach shette nashim achat lo veachat leaviv achat lo veachat livno vahavetah melammed shello yilchatzenna bammilchama
Tanu rabbanan im amor yomar ad sheyyomar veyishne amar bitchilat shesh velo amar besof shesh eno nirtza shenneemar lo etze chofshi ad sheyyomar bishat yetzia
Amar besof shesh velo amar bitchilat shesh eno nirtza shenneemar im amor yomar haeved ad sheyyomar keshehu eved
Amar mar amar bitchilat shesh velo amar besof shesh eno nirtza shenneemar lo etze chofshi may irya millo etze chofshi tipok leh devaenan ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay veleka
Vetu amar besof shesh velo amar bitchilat shesh eno nirtza shenneemar haeved attu sof shesh lav eved hu amar rava may bitchilat shesh bitchilat peruta acharona umay besof shesh besof peruta acharona

Tanu rabbanan lo ishsha uvanim ulrabbo en ishsha uvanim eno nirtza shenneemar ki ahevcha veet betecha lerabbo ishsha uvanim velo en ishsha uvanim eno nirtza shenneemar ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay

Hu ohev et rabbo verabbo eno ohavo eno nirtza shenneemar ki tov lo immach rabbo ohavo vehu eno ohev et rabbo eno nirtza shenneemar ki ahevcha hu chole verabbo eno chole eno nirtza shenneemar ki tov lo immach rabbo chole vehu eno chole eno nirtza shenneemar immach
Bae rav bivi bar abbaye shenehem cholin may immach baenan veha ika o dilma ki tov lo immach baenan veha leka teku

Tanu rabbanan ki tov lo immach immecha bammaachal immecha bammishte shello tehe atta ochel pat nekiyya vehu ochel pat kibar atta shote yayin yashan vehu shote yayin chadash atta yashen al gabbe mochin vehu yashen al gabbe teven mikkan amru kol hakkone eved ivri kekone adon leatzmo

Tanu rabbanan veyatza meimmach hu uvanav immo amar rabbi shimon im hu nimkar banav uvnotav mi nimkarim mikkan sherabbo chayyav bimzonot banav kayyotze baddavar atta omer im baal ishsha hu veyatza ishto immo amar rabbi shimon im hu nimkar ishto mi nimkera mikkan sherabbo chayyav bimzonot ishto
Utzricha dei ashmoinan banav mishshum dela bene mebad umechal ninhu aval ishto devat mechal umebad hi ema taaved vetechol
Vei ashmeinan ishto delav dirkah lehaddore aval banav dedirkayehu lehaddore ema la tzericha
Tanu rabbanan
b: Ilu neemar ozno baddelet hayiti omer yidkor keneged ozno baddelet delet in ozno la veozen la vehachtiv veratza adonav et ozno bammartzea
Ella hayiti omer yirtzaenna laozen meabbaray veyannichenna al haddelet veyidkor keneged ozno baddelet talmud lomar beozno uvaddelet ha ketzad doker veholech ad shemmaggia etzel delet
Delet shomea ani ben akura ben sheenah akura talmud lomar mezuza ma mezuza meummad af delet name meummad

Rabban yochanan ben zakkay haya doresh et hammikra hazze kemin chomer ma nishtanna ozen mikkol evarim shebbagguf amar hakkadosh baruch hu ozen sheshshama koli al har sinay beshaa sheamarti ki li vene yisrael avadim velo avadim laavadim vehalach ze vekana adon leatzmo yeratza

Verabbi shimon bar rabbi haya doresh et hammikra hazze kemin chomer ma nishtanna delet umzuza mikkol kelim shebbabbayit amar hakkadosh baruch hu delet umzuza shehau edim bemitzrayim beshaa sheppasachti al hammashkof veal shette hammezuzot veamarti ki li vene yisrael avadim velo avadim laavadim vehotzetim meavdut lecherut vehalach ze vekana adon leatzmo yeratza bifnehem

Matni eved kenaani nikne bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka vekone et atzmo bechesef al yede acherim uvishtar al yede atzmo divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim bechesef al yede atzmo uvishtar al yede acherim uvilvad sheyehe hakkesef mishshel acherim

Gema menalan dichtiv vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem lareshet achuzza hikkishan hakkatuv lisde achuzza ma sede achuzza nikne bechesef bishtar uvachazaka af eved kenaani nikne bechesef bishtar uvachazaka
I ma sede achuzza chozeret labbealim bayyovel af eved kenaani chozer labbealim bayyovel talmud lomar leolam bahem taavodu
Tana af bachalifin vetanna didan milta deletah bemittaltelin katane milta deitah bimtaltelin la katane
Amar shemuel eved kenaani nikne bimshicha ketzad tekafo uva etzlo kenao kerao uva etzlo lo kenao

Bishlama letanna didan milta deitah bemittaltele la katane deletah bemittaltele katane ella letanna bara nitne meshicha ki katane milta deitah ben bimkarkee ben bemittalteli meshicha divmittalteli ita bimkarkei letah la katane
Ketzad tekafo uva etzlo kenao kerao uva etzlo lo kenao ukrao la vehatanya ketzad bimsira achazah betalpah bisarah baukkaf shealeha bishlif shealeha bifrumbeya shebbefiha uvzog shebbetzavarah kenaah
Ketzad bimshicha kore lah vehi baa o shehikkishah bemakkel veratzta lefanav kevan sheakra yad varegel kenaah rabbi assi veamri lah rabbi acha omer ad shettehallech lefanav melo komatah
Amri behema addata demarah azla eved addateh denafsheh kaazel amar rav ashe eved katan kivhema dame

Tanu rabbanan ketzad bachazaka hittir lo minalo o holich kelav acharav levet hammerchatz hifshito hirchitzo sacho gerdo hilbisho hinilo higbiho kenao amar rabbi shimon lo tehe chazaka gedola mehagbaha shehagbaha kona bechol makom may kaamar
Amar rav ashe higbiho hu lerabbo kenao higbiho rabbo lo lo kenao amar rabbi shimon lo tehe chazaka gedola mehagbaha shehagbaha kona bechol makom
Hashta deamratte higbiho hu lerabbo kenao ella meatta shifcha kenaanit tikkane bevia ki kaamrinan ze nehene veze mitztaer hacha ze nehene veze nehene hu
Shello kedarkah may ika lememar amar rav achay bar adda demin acha man lema lan delav hanaa it lehu letarvayehu veod mishkeve ishsha ketiv hikkisho hakkatuv kedarkah leshello kedarkah
Rabbi yehuda hindua ger sheen lo yorshin hava chalash al mar zutra leshayyole beh chazyeh detakef leh alma tuva amar leh leavdeh shelof li mesanay veamtinhu leveta ika deamri gadol hava

a: Ze perash lemita veze perash lechayyim

Veika deamri katan hava udla keabba shaul detanya ger shemmet uvizbezu yisrael nechasav vehau bahen avadim ben gedolim ben ketannim kanu atzman bene chorin abba shaul omer gedolim kanu atzman bene chorin ketannim kol hammachzik bahen zacha bahen

Vekone atzmo bechesef ku bechesef al yede acherim in aval lo al yede atzmo bemay askinan ilema shello middato mikkede shemana leh lerabbi meir deamar chov hu leeved sheyyetze miyyad rabbo lecherut utnena zachin laadam shello befanav veen chavin lo ella befanav
Ella peshita middato veha kamashma lan al yede acherim in al yede atzmo la alma en kinyan leeved belo rabbo
I hachi ema sefa bishtar al yede atzmo al yede atzmo in al yede acherim la vei middato al yede acherim ammay la
Vechi tema may al yede atzmo af al yede atzmo veha ka mashma lan degito veyado baim keechad veha la tane hachi detanya bishtar al yede atzmo velo al yede acherim divre rabbi meir
Amar abbaye leolam shello middato veshane kesef hoil vekane leh beal kurcheh makne leh beal kurcheh
I hachi shetar name hay shetara lechod vehay shetara lechod
Hacha name hay kaspa lechod vehay kaspa lechod tiva miha chad hu
Rava amar kesef kabbalat rabbo garma lo shetar kabbalat acherim garma lo

Vachachamim omrim bechesef al yede atzmo bechesef al yede atzmo in al yede acherim la ammay nehi name deshello middato mikkede shemana lehu lerabbanan deamri zechut hu sheyyetze mittachat yad rabbo lecherut utnena zachin leadam shello befanav veen chavin lo ella befanav
Vechi tema may al yede atzmo af al yede atzmo veka mashma lan deyesh kinyan leeved belo rabbo i hachi ema sefa bishtar al yede acherim velo al yede atzmo veha kayema lan degito veyado bain keechad

Vechi tema may al yede acherim af al yede acherim veha ka mashma lan dizchut hu leeved sheyyetze miyyad rabbo lecherut i hachi nearvinhu venitninhu bechesef uvishtar ben al yede acherim ben al yede atzmo

Ella bechesef ben al yede acherim ben al yede atzmo bishtar al yede acherim velo al yede atzmo verabbi shimon ben elazar hu detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af bishtar al yede acherim velo al yede atzmo veshalosh machlokot baddavar
Amar rabba may tama derabbi shimon ben elazar gamar lah lah meishsha ma ishsha ad sheyyotzi get lirshut sheenah shello af eved name ad sheyyotzi get lirshut sheenah shello
Bae rabba
b: Lerabbi shimon ben elazar eved kenaani mahu sheyyaase shaliach lekabbel gito miyyad rabbo kevan degamar lah lah meishsha keishsha
O dilma ishsha deihi matze mekabbelet gitah shaliach name matze meshavveya eved deihu la mekabbel giteh shaliach name la matze meshave batar devaya hadar pashtah lah lah meishsha keishsha
Veella ha deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hane kahane sheluche derachamana ninhu dei salka datach sheluche didan ninhu mi ika mide daanan la matzenan avdinan veinhu matze avdi
Vela veha avda deihu la matze mekabbel giteh ushliach matze meshave
Vela hi yisrael la shayechi betorat korbanot kelal eved shayech begitin detanya nirin haddevarim shehaeved mekabbel gito shel chavero miyyad rabbo shel chavero aval lo miyyad rabbo shello

Uvilvad sheyehe hakkesef mishshel acherim nema beha kamipalgi derabbi meir savar en kinyan leeved belo rabbo veen kinyan leishsha belo balah verabbanan savri yesh kinyan leeved belo rabbo veyesh kinyan leishsha belo balah
Amar rabba amar rav sheshet dechulle alma en kinyan leeved belo rabbo veen kinyan leishsha belo balah vehacha bemay askinan deakni leh acher mane vaamar leh al menat sheen lerabbach reshut bo
Rabbi meir savar ki amar leh keni kane eved vekane rabbeh vechi amar leh al menat lo kelum kaamar leh verabbanan savri kevan deamar leh al menat ahani leh tenaeh
Verabbi elazar amar kol ki hay gavena dechulle alma la peligi dekane eved vekane rabbeh vehacha bemay askinan kegon deakni leh acher mane vaamar leh al menat shettetze bo lecherut

Rabbi meir savar ki amar leh keni kane eved vekane rabbeh vechi amar leh al menat lo kelum kaamar leh verabbanan savri ledideh name ha la ka makne leh deha la amar leh ella al menat shettetze bo lecherut
Urmi derabbi meir adderabbi meir urmi derabbanan adderabbanan detanya

a: En ishsha poda maaser sheni belo chomesh rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir ishsha poda maaser sheni belo chomesh hechi dame ilema bezuze devaal umaaser devaal shelichuteh devaal ka avda
Veella bezuze didah umaaser dideh ish amar rachamana velo ishsha
Ella lav ki hay gavena deakni lah acher mane vaamar lah al menat shettifdi bo et hammaaser veipcha shemana lehu
Amar abbaye efoch rava amar leolam la tefoch vehacha bemaaser daata mibbe nasha askinan verabbi meir letameh deamar maaser mamon hekdesh hu vela kane leh baal
Verabbanan letamayehu deamri mamon hedot hu vekane leh baal hilkach shelichuta devaal kaavda

Tana yotze beshen vaayin verashe evarim sheenan chozrim bishlama shen vaayin ketivi ella rashe evarim menalan dumya deshen vaayin ma shen vaayin mumin shebbaggaluy veenan chozrin af kol mumin shebbaggaluy veenan chozrin
Veema niho shen vaayin kishne chetuvim habbaim keechad vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin tzericha dei ketav rachamana shen hava amena afilu
b: Shen dechalav ketav rachamana ayin vei ketav rachamana ayin hava amena ma ayin shennivra immo af kol shennivra immo aval shen la tzericha
Veema ki yakke kalal shen vaayin parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat shen vaayin in mide acharina la
Lachofshi yeshallechennu chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash mum shebbaggaluy veenan chozrim af kol mumin shebbaggaluy veenan chozrin

I ma happerat meforash mumin shebbaggaluy uvatel mimmelachto veeno chozer af kol mumin shebbaggaluy veeno chozer uvatel mimmelachto allema tanya talash bizkano vedildel bo etzem eved yotze bahem lecherut lachofshi yeshallechennu ribuya hu
Vei ribuya hu afilu hikkahu al yado vetzamta vesofah lachzor name allema tanya hikkahu al yado vetzamta vesofah lachzor en eved yotze bah lecherut im ken shen vaayin may ahani leh

Tanu rabbanan bechullam eved yotze bahem lecherut vetzarich get shichrur divre rabbi shimon rabbi meir omer eno tzarich rabbi eliezer omer tzarich rabbi tarfon omer eno tzarich rabbi akiva omer tzarich

Hammachriim lifne chachamim omrim nirin divre rabbi tarfon beshen vaayin shehattora zikketa lo vedivre rabbi akiva bishar evarim hoil uknas chachamim hu kenas hu kerae ka darshinan ella hoil umidrash chachamim hu

May tama derabbi shimon yalef shiluach shiluach meishsha ma ishsha bishtar af eved name bishtar verabbi meir i ketav chofshi levassof kidkaamratte hashta dichtav lachofshi yeshallechennu hava leh chofshi meikara

Tanu rabbanan hikkahu al eno vesimmeah al ozno vechershah eved yotze bahen lecherut neged eno veeno roe keneged ozno veeno shomea en eved yotze bahen lecherut amar rav shemen lerav ashe lememra dekala lav kelum hu

Vehatane rame bar yechezkel tarnegol shehoshit rosho laavir keli zechuchit vetaka bo ushvaro meshallem nezek shalem veamar rav yosef amri be rav sus shetztzanaf vachamor shennaar veshavru kelim betoch habbayit meshallemim chatzi nezek

Amar leh shane adam dechevan devar daat hu ihu mevaet nafsheh kidtanya hammavit et chavero patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim ketzad taka beozno vechersho patur achazahu vetaka beozno vechersho chayyav

Tanu rabbanan hikkahu al eno vechahata al shino venadda im yachol lehishtammesh bahen achshav en eved yotze bahen lecherut veim lav eved yotze bahen lecherut tanya idach hare shehayeta eno kehuya vesimmeah shino neduda vehippilah im yachol lehishtammesh bahen kevar eved yotze bahen lecherut veim lav en eved yotze bahen lecherut
Utzricha dei ashmoinan hach kammayeta mishshum demeikara nehora beriyya vehashta nehora kechisha aval hacha demeikara name nehora kechisha ema la
Vei ashmoinan ha mishshum desammeyah ligmare aval hatam dela sammeyah ligmare ema la tzericha

Tanu rabbanan hare shehaya rabbo rofe veamar lo lichchol lo eno vesimmeah lachtor lo shino vehippilah sichek baadon veyatza lecherut rabban shimon ben gamliel omer veshichatah ad sheyyitkaven leshachatah

Verabbanan hay veshichatah may avdi leh mibe lehu lechidtanya rabbi elazar omer hare shehoshit yado lime shifchato vesime ubbar shebbemeeha patur may tama deamar kera veshichatah ad sheyechaven leshachatah
Veidach miveshichet shichatah nafka veidach shichet shichatah la daresh
Amar rav sheshet hare shehayeta eno semuya vachatatah eved yotze bahen lecherut may tama mechussar ever hu
Vetanna tuna tammut vezachrut bivhema veen tammut vezachrut beofot
Yachol yavsha gappah niktea raglah nechteta enah talmud lomar min haof velo kol haof
Amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav hayeta lo

a: Yeteret vachatachah eved yotze bahen lecherut amar rav huna vehu shennisperet al gav hayyad

Save denazonya la ato lefirkeh derav chisda amar leh lerav hamnuna zil tzanneinhu azal amar lehu may tama la ato rabbanan lefirka amaru leh ammay nete divenan mineh milta vela peshat lan amar lehu mi beetu minay mide vela pashetna lechu
Beo mineh eved shesserso rabbo babbetzim mahu kemum shebbaggaluy dame o la la hava bideh amru lo ma shemach amar lehu hamnuna amaru leh lav hamnuna ella karnuna
Ata lekammeh derav chisda amar leh matnita beo minach ditnan esrim vearbaa rashe evarim shebbaadam kullam en metammein mishshum michya

Veellu hem rashe etzbaot yadayim veraglayim verashe oznayim verosh hachotem verosh haggeviyya verashe daddim shebbaishsha rabbi yehuda omer af shebbaish vetane alah bechullam eved yotze bahem lecherut rabbi omer af hasserus ben azzay omer af hallashon
Amar mar rabbi omer af hasserus serus demay ilema serus degid hayenu geviyya ella lav serus devetzim
Rabbi omer af hasserus verabbi lashon la urminhu hare mi shehaya mazze venitteza hazzaa al piv rabbi omer hiza vachachamim omrim lo hiza
May lav al leshono lo al sefatav al sefatav peshita mahu detema zimna dechalem sifvateh ka mashma lan
Vehatanya al leshono veod tanya veshennital rov hallashon rabbi omer rov hamdabber shebbilshono
Ella rabbi omer serus vela mibaya lashon ben azzay amar lashon aval serus la umay af akkammayeta i hachi nakdemah deven azzay beresha
Tanna shamah lidrabbi vekavah veshamah lidven azzay vetanyah umishna lo zaza mimmekomah
Amar ulla hakkol modim belashon leinyan tuma degaluy hu etzel hashsheretz may tama asher yigga bo amar rachamana vehay name bar negia hu
Leinyan tevila ketamun dame may tama verachatz besaro bemayim amar rachamana ma besaro meabbaray af kol meabbaray
Lo nechleku ella leinyan hazzaa rabbi medamme lah letuma verabbanan medammu lah litvila
Vetarvayehu behay kera kamipalgi vehizza hattahor al hattame vego rabbi savar vehizza hattahor al hattame bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii vechitteo
Rabbanan savri vechitteo bayyom hashshevii vechibbes begadav verachatz bammayim
Verabbanan name nedammeyah letuma tohora mittohorah hava leh lemelaf verabbi nedammeyah litvila vechibbes begadav hifsik hainyan
Vesavar rabbi leinyan tevila ketamun dame vehaamar ravin amar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak maase beshifcha shel bet rabbi shettavla vealta venimtza etzem ben shineha vehitzrichah rabbi tevila acheret
Nehi deviat mayim la baenan mekom harauy lavo bo mayim baenan
Kidrabbi zera deamar rabbi zera kol harauy levila en bila meakkevet bo vesheeno rauy levila bila meakkevet bo
b: Ketannae umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut kullan babbetzim divre rabbi yehuda
Babbetzim velo baggid ella kullan af babbetzim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer kullam baggid rabbi yose omer mauch vechatut af babbetzim natuk vecharut begid in bevetzim la
Matni behema gassa niknet bimsira vehaddakka behagbaha divre rabbi meir verabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim behema dakka niknet bimshicha

Gema daresh rav bekimchonya behema gassa niknet bimshicha ashkechinhu shemuel letalmide derav amar lehu mi amar rav behema gassa niknet bimshicha vehaanan bimsira tenan verav name bimsira amar hadar beh mehahi hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya vachachamim omrim zo vezo niknet bimshicha rabbi shimon omer zo vezo behagbaha
Matkef lah rav yosef ella meatta pil lerabbi shimon bamme yikkane amar leh abbaye bachalifin i name besocher et mekomo
Rabbi zera amar mevi arbaa kelim umannichan tachat raglav shamatte minah kilo shel lokeach birshut mocher kana lokeach hacha bemay askinan besimta

a: I name bachavile zemorot

Matni nechasim sheyyesh lahem achraut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka sheen lahem achraut en niknin ella bimshicha nechasim sheen lahem achraut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahem achraut bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka
Vezokkin et hannechasim sheyyesh lahem achraut lishava alehen

Gema bechesef menalan amar chizkiyya amar kera sadot bakkesef yiknu veema ad deika shetar dichtiv vechatov bassefer vechatom i ketiv yiknu levassof kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv yiknu meikara kesef kane shetar reaya bealma hu
Amar rav lo shanu ella bimkom sheen kotvin et hashshetar aval bimkom shekkotvin et hashshetar lo kana vei paresh paresh

Ki ha derav idi bar avin ki zaven ara amar i baena bechaspa ikne i baena bishtara ikne i baena bechaspa ikne dei baetu lemihdar la matzitu hadritu vei baena bishtara ikne dei baena lemihdar hadarna bi

Uvishtar menalan ilema mishshum dichtiv vechatov bassefer vechatom vehaed edim vehaamratte shetar reaya bealma hu ella mehacha vaekkach et sefer hammikna amar shemuel lo shanu ella bishtar mattana aval bemecher lo kana ad sheyyitten lo damim

Metiv rav hamnuna bishtar ketzad katav lo al hanneyar o al hacheres af al pi sheen bahem shave peruta sadi mechura lach sadi netuna lecha hare zo mechura untuna hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah bemocher sadehu mippene raatah
Rav ashe amar bemattana bikesh litnah lo velamma katav lo leshon mecher kede leyappot et kocho
Uvachazaka menalan amar chizkiyya amar kera ushvu bearechem asher tefastem bamme tefastem bishiva deve rabbi yishmael tana virishtem otah vishavtem bah bamme yerashtem bishiva
Vesheen lahem achraut en niknin ella bimshicha menalan dichtiv vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha davar hannikne miyyad leyad
Ulrabbi yochanan deamar devar tora maot konot may ika lememar tanna takkanta derabbanan katane
Nechasim sheen lahem achraut menahane mile amar chizkiyya deamar kera vayyitten lahem avihem mattanot vego im are metzurot bihuda
Ibaya lehu baenan tzevurim o la amar rav yosef ta shema rabbi akiva omer karka kol shehu chayyevet bappea uvabbikkurim
b: Velichtov aleha perosbul veliknot immah nechasim sheen lahem achraut vei amratte baenan tzevurim kol shehu lemay chaze

Targema rav shemuel bar bisna kammeh derav yosef kegon shennaatz bah machat amar leh rav yosef kevastan ikfal tanna leashmoinan machat amar rav ashe man lema lan dela tela bah marganita deshaveya alpa zuze

Ta shema amar rabbi elazar maase bemadoni echad shehaya birushalayim shehau lo mittaltelin harbe uvikesh litnam bemattana amru lo en lo takkana ad sheyyaknem al gabbe karka ma asa halach velakach bet sela samuch lirushalayim veamar tzefoni ze lifloni veimmo mea tzon umea chaviyyot vamet vekiyemu et devarav
Vei amratte baenan tzevurim bah bet sela lemay chaze mi savratte bet sela sela mammash may sela dinfish tuva veammay karu leh sela dikshe kesela
Ta shema deamar rav yehuda amar rav maase beadam echad shechala birushalayim kerabbi eliezer veamri lah bari haya kerabbanan

Shehau lo mittaltelin harbe uvikesh litnam bemattana amru lo en lo takkana ad sheyyaknem al gabbe karka ma asa halach velakach bet rova samuch lirushalayim veamar tefach al tefach lifloni veimmo mea tzon umea chaviyyot vamet vekiyemu chachamim et devarav vei amratte baenan tzevurim tefach al tefach lemay chaze
Hacha bemay askinan lidme hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach mea tzon umea chaviyyot mammash nakninhu nihaleh bachalifin
Veella may lidme nakninhu nihaleh bimshicha ella deleteh limkabbel mattana hachi name deleteh limkabbel mattana
Venizkinhu nihaleh aggav acher la samcha dateh savar shamet veachel lehu
Veella may en lo takkana hachi kaamar lemay dela samcha dateh en lo takkana ad sheyyaknem al gabbe karka
Ta shema maase berabban gamliel uzkenim shehau baim bisfina amar lahem rabban gamliel lazzekenim isur sheani atid lamod

a: Natun lo lihoshua umkomo muskar lo veisur acher sheani atid lamod natun lo laakiva ben yosef kede sheyyizke bo laaniyyim umkomo muskar lo shema minah baenan tzevurim bah shane hatam ki hechi dela latrechinhu

Ta shema deamar rava bar yitzchak amar rav shene shetarot hen zechu besade zo lifloni vechitvu lo et hashshetar chozer bashshetar veeno chozer bassade al menat shettichtevu lo et hashshetar chozer ben bashshetar ben bassade

Verav chiyya bar avin amar rav huna shelosha shetarot hen tere ha daamaran idach im kadam mocher vechatav lo et hashshetar keotah sheshshaninu kotvim shetar lammocher af al pi sheen lokeach immo kevan shehechzik immo bakkarka nikna shetar bechol makom shehu
Shema minah la baenan tzevurim bah shane shetar deafsera deara hu
Veha alah katane zo hi sheshshaninu nechasim sheen lahem achraut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahem achraut bechesef bishtar uvachazaka shema minah la baenan tzevurim bah shema minah
Ibaya lehu mi baenan aggav o la ta shema dekatane kol hane vela katane aggav ultamach keni mi katane
Ella ad deamar keni hacha name ad daamar aggav vehilcheta tzevurim la baenan aggav ukni baenan
Ibaya lehu sade bemecher umtaltelin bemattana mahu ta shema isur sheani atid lamod natun lihoshua umkomo muskar lo shema minah
Ibaya lehu sade leechad umtaltelin leacher mahu ta shema isur sheani atid lamod natun laakiva ben yosef kede sheyyizke bo laaniyyim umkomo muskar lo
May muskar muskar lemaaser vei baet ema shane rabbi akiva deyad aniyyim hava
Amar rava lo shanu ella shennatan deme chullan aval lo natan deme chullan lo kana ella keneged meotav

Tanya keoteh derava yafe koach hakkesef mikkoach hashshetar vechoach hashshetar mikkoach hakkesef yafe koach hakkesef shehakkesef podin bo hekdeshot umaaser sheni ma sheen ken bishtar veyafe koach hashshetar shehashshetar motzi bevat yisrael ma sheen ken bechesef

Veyafe koach shenehem mikkoach chazaka vechoach chazaka mikkoach shenehem yafe koach shenehem sheshshenehem konim beeved ivri ma sheen ken bachazaka yafe koach chazaka shechazaka machar lo eser sadot beeser medinot kevan shehechzik beachat mehem kenaam kullam
b: Bamme devarim amurim shennatan lo deme chullan aval lo natan lo deme chullan lo kana ella keneged meotav mesayya leh lishmuel deamar shemuel machar lo eser sadot beeser medinot kevan shehechzik beachat mehen kana et kullan
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika teda sheilu masar lo eser behemot beafsar echad vaamar leh kene mi la kane amar leh mi dame hatam igudo beyado hacha en igudo beyado
Ika deamri amar rav acha bereh derav ika teda dela kane ilu masar lo eser behemot beafsar echad veamar lo zo kene mi kane
Mi dame hatam gufim muchlakim hacha saddana deara chad hu
Vezokkim et hannechasim vechu amar ulla minnayin legilgul shevua min hattora
Shenneemar veamra haishsha amen amen utnan al ma hi omeret amen amen amen al haala amen al hashshevua amen im meish ze amen im meish acher amen shello satiti arusa unsua veshomeret yavam uchnusa
Hay arusa hechi dame ilema dekanni lah keshehi arusa veka mashke lah keshehi arusa vehatnan arusa veshomeret yavam lo shotot velo notlot ketubba may tama tachat ishech amar rachamana veleka
Ella dekanni lah keshehi arusa venistera keshehi arusa veka mashke lah keshehi nesua
Mi badki lah mayya venikka haish meaon amar rachamana bizman shehaish menukke meaon mayim bodkim et ishto en ish menukke meaon en hammayim bodkim et ishto
Ella al yede gilgul
Ashkechan sota deisura mamona menalan tana deve rabbi yishmael kal vachomer uma sota

a: Shello nitna lehittava beed echad megalgelin mamon shennitan lehittava beed echad eno din shemgalgelin
Ashkechan bevadday safek menalan
Tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer neemra shevua bachutz veneemra shevua bifnim ma shevua haamura bifnim asa bah safek kevadday af shevua haamura bachutz asa bah safek kevadday
Ad hechan gilgul shevua amar rav yehuda amar rav deamar leh hishava li sheen avdi atta
Hahu shammote meshammetinan leh detanya hakkore lachavero eved yehe beniduy mamzer sofeg et haarbaim rasha yored immo lechayyav
Ella amar rava hishava li shello nimkarta li beeved ivri hay taanta meallayeta hi mamona it leh gabbeh rava letameh deamar rava eved ivri gufo kanuy
I hachi hayenu karka mahu detema karka hu deavdi inashe dimzabbeni betzina im ita dezabben let leh kala
Hay im ita dezabben kala it leh ka mashma lan
Matni kol hannaase damim beacher kevan shezzacha ze nitchayyev ze bachalifav ketzad hechlif shor befara o chamor beshor kevan shezzacha ze nitchayyev ze bachalifav
Gema chalifin may nihu matbea shema minah matbea naase chalifin amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar kol hannishom damim beacher
b: Kevan shezzacha ze nitchayyev bachalifin dayeka name dekatane ketzad hechlif shor befara o chamor beshor shema minah
Ulmay dislek addatin meikara dematbea naase chalifin may ketzad hachi kaamar perot name avdi chalifin ketzad hechlif besar shor befara o besar chamor beshor kevan shezzacha ze nitchayyev bachalifin
Hanicha lerav sheshet deamar perot avdi chalifin ella lerav nachman deamar perot la avdi chalifin may ika lememar
Hachi kaamar yesh damim shehen kachalifin ketzad hechlif deme shor befara o deme chamor beshor
May tama savar lah kerabbi yochanan deamar devar tora maot konot uma taam amru meshicha kona gezera shemma yomar lo nisrefu chitecha baaliyya
Milta dishchicha gezaru bah rabbanan milta dela shechicha la gezaru bah rabbanan
Ulresh lakish deamar meshicha meforeshet min hattora hanicha i savar lah kerav sheshet deamar perot avdi chalifin metaretz kerav sheshet
Ella i savar lah kerav nachman deamar perot la avdi chalifin umatbea la kane bemay moke lah al kurchach kerav sheshet sevira leh
Matni reshut haggavoha bechesef urshut hahedot bachazaka amirato legavoha kimsirato lehedot
Gema tanu rabbanan ketzad reshut haggavoha bechesef gizbar shennatan maot bivhema afilu behema besof haolam kana uvahedot lo kana ad sheyyimshoch
Ketzad amirato laggavoha kimsirato lahedot haomer shor ze ola bayit ze hekdesh afilu besof haolam kana bahedot lo kana

a: Ad sheyyimshoch veyachzik meshacho bemane velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad bematayim noten matayim may tama venatan hakkesef vekam lo
Meshacho bematayim velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad bemane noten matayim may tama lo yehe koach hedot chamur mehekdesh
Pedao bematayim velo hispik lemoshcho ad sheamad bemane noten matayim may tama venatan hakkesef vekam lo pedao bemane velo hispik lemoshcho ad sheamad bematayim ma sheppada paduy veen noten ella mane
Ammay hachi name nema lo yehe koach hedot chamur mehekdesh
Attu hedot lav bemi sheppara kae

Matni kol mitzot habben al haav anashim chayyavin venashim peturot vechol mitzot haav al habben echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavin vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah anashim chayyavin venashim peturot vechol mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah echad haanashim veechad hannashim chayyavin
Vechol mitzot lo taase ben shehazzeman geramah ben shello hazzeman geramah echad haanashim veechad hannashim chayyavin chutz mibbal takkif uval tashchit uval tittamme lemetim
Gema may kol mitzot habben al haav ilema kol mitzot demichayyav bera lemibad leabba nashim peturot vehatanya ish en li ella ish ishsha minnayin keshehu omer ish immo veaviv tirau hare kan shenayim
Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar kol mitzot habben hammuttalot al haav laasot livno anashim chayyavin venashim peturot

Tenena leha detanu rabbanan haav chayyav bivno lemulo velifdoto ullammedo tora ulhassio ishsha ullammedo ummanut veyesh omrim af lahashito bammayim rabbi yehuda omer kol sheeno melammed et beno ummanut melammedo listut listut salka datach ella keilu melammedo listut

Lemulo menalan dichtiv vayyamol avraham et yitzchak beno vehecha dela mahleh avuh michayevi be dina lemimhaleh dichtiv himmol lachem kol zachar vehecha dela mahluh be dina michayyav ihu lemimhal nafsheh dichtiv vearel zachar asher lo yimmol et besar orlato venichreta
Ihi menalan dela michayeva dichtiv kaasher tziva oto elohim oto velo otah
Ashkechan miyyad ledorot menalan tana deve rabbi yishmael kal makom shenneemar tzav eno ella zeruz miyyad uldorot
Zeruz dichtiv vetzav et yehoshua vechazzekehu veammetzehu miyyad uldorot dichtiv min hayyom asher tziva Adonai vahala ledorotechem
Lifdoto menalan dichtiv kol bechor banecha tifde vehecha dela parkeh avuh michayyav ihu lemifrekeh dichtiv pado tippade
Veihi menalan dela mipakda dichtiv tipade tifde kol shemmetzuve lifdot et atzmo metzuve lifdot et acherim vechol sheeno metzuve lifdot et atzmo eno metzuve lifdot acherim

Veihi menalan dela michayeva lemifrak nafshah dichtiv tifde tipade kol sheacherim metzuviym lifdoto metzuve lifdot et atzmo vechol sheen acherim metzuviym lifdoto en metzuve lifdot et atzmo uminnayin sheen acherim metzuviyn lifdotah deamar kera kol bechor banecha tifde banecha velo benotecha
Tanu rabbanan hu lifdot uvno lifdot hu kodem livno rabbi yehuda omer beno kodmo shezze mitzvato al aviv veze mitzvat beno alav
