Amar rabbi yirmeya hakkol modin
b: Kol hecha deleka ella chamesh selaim hu kodem livno may tama mitzva degufeh adifa ki peligi hecha deika chamesh meshubadim vechamesh bene chorin
Rabbi yehuda savar milva dichtiv hakketuva battora kichtuva bishtar damya behane chamesh parek livreh veazel kohen vetaref leh lechamesh meshubadim ledideh
Verabbanan savri milva dichtiv beorayeta lav kichtuva bishtar damya vehilkach mitzva degufeh adif
Tanu rabbanan lifdot et beno velaalot laregel pode et beno veachar kach ole laregel rabbi yehuda omer ole laregel veachar kach pode et beno shezzo mitzva overet vezo mitzva sheenah overet
Bishlama lerabbi yehuda kidkaamar tama ella rabbanan may tamayehu deamar kera kol bechor banecha tifde vahadar lo yerau fanay rekam
Tanu rabbanan minnayin sheim hau lo chamishsha banim mechamesh nashim shechayyav lifdot kullan talmud lomar kol bechor banecha tifde peshita befeter rechem tela rachamana
Mahu detema nelaf bechor bechor minnachala ma lehallan reshit ono af kan reshit ono ka mashma lan
Lelammedo tora menalan dichtiv velimmadtem otam et benechem vehecha dela agmereh avuh michayyav ihu lemigmar nafsheh dichtiv ulmadtem
Ihi menalan dela michayeva dichtiv velimadtem ulmadtem kol shemmetzuve lilmod metzuve lelammed vechol sheeno metzuve lilmod eno metzuve lelammed

Veihi menalan dela michayeva lemelaf nafshah dichtiv velimadtem ulmadtem kol sheacherim metzuviyn lelammedo metzuve lelammed et atzmo vechol sheen acherim metzuviyn lelammedo en metzuve lelammed et atzmo uminnayin sheen acherim metzuviyn lelammedah deamar kera velimmadtem otam et benechem et benechem velo benotechem

Tanu rabbanan hu lilmod uvno lilmod hu kodem livno rabbi yehuda omer im beno zariz ummullach vetalmudo mitkayyem beyado beno kodmo ki ha derav yaakov bereh derav acha bar yaakov shaddereh avuh lekammeh deabbaye ki ata chazyeh dela hava michaddedan shemateh amar leh ana adifa minach tuv atte deezil ana
Shema abbaye deka hava ate hava hahu mazzik be rabbanan deabbaye dechi hao ayeli bitren afilu bimama hao mitazzeki amar lehu la litev leh inash ushpiza efshar demitrechish nisa
Al bat behahu be rabbanan idmi leh ketannina deshiva reshoteh kol keria dichra netar chad resheh amar lehu limchar i la itrechish nisa sakkentin

Tanu rabbanan lilmod tora velisa ishsha yilmod tora veachar kach yissa ishsha veim i efshar lo belo ishsha yissa ishsha veachar kach yilmod tora amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha nose ishsha veachar kach yilmod tora
Rabbi yochanan amar rechayim betzavaro veyaasok battora vela peligi ha lan veha lehu

Mishtabbach leh rav chisda lerav huna bidrav hamnuna deadam gadol hu amar leh kesheyyavo leyadcha haviehu leyadi ki ata chazyeh dela pares sudara amar leh may tama la paresatte sudara amar leh dela nesevna ahderinhu leappeh mineh amar leh chazi dela chazet lehu leappay ad denasvatte
Rav huna letameh deamar ben esrim shana velo nasa ishsha kol yamav baavera baavera salka datach ella ema kal yamav behirhur avera
Amar rava vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael ad esrim shana yoshev hakkadosh baruch hu umtzappe laadam matay yissa ishsha kevan shehiggia esrim velo nasa omer tipach atzmotav
Amar rav chisda hay daadifna mechavray dinsevna beshitsar vei hava nasevna bearbesar

a: Hava amena lesatan gira beenach amar leh rava lerabbi natan bar amme addidach al tzavvere divrach mishshitsar vead esrim vetarte veamri lah mittamne sere ad esrim vearbaa
Ketannae chanoch lannaar al pi darko rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya chad amar mishshitsar vead esrim vetarten vechad amar mittamne sere vead esrim vearbea

Ad hechan chayyav adam lelammed et beno tora amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kegon zevulun ben dan shellimdo avi aviv mikra umishna vetalmud halachot veaggadot metivi limmedo mikra en melammedo mishna veamar rava mikra zo tora
Kizvulun ben dan velo kizvulun ben dan kizvulun ben dan shellimmedo avi aviv velo kizvulun ben dan deilu hatam mikra mishna vetalmud halachot veaggadot veilu hacha mikra levad

Vaavi aviv mi michayyav vehatanya velimmadtem otam et benechem velo bene venechem uma ani mekayyem vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha lomar lach shekkol hamlammed et beno tora maale alav hakkatuv keilu limmedo lo velivno ulven beno ad sof kol haddorot

Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya velimmadtem otam et benechem en li ella benechem bene venechem minnayin talmud lomar vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha im ken ma talmud lomar benechem benechem velo benotechem

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol hamlammed et ben beno tora maale alav hakkatuv keilu kibbelah mehar sinay shenneemar vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha usmich leh yom asher amadta lifne Adonai elokecha bechorev

Rabbi chiyya bar abba ashkecheh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi deshade disna aresheh veka mamte leh leyanoka leve chenishta amar leh may kulle hay amar leh mi zutar may dichtiv vehodatam levanecha usmich leh yom asher amadta lifne Adonai elokecha bechorev mikkan veelach rabbi chiyya bar abba la taem umtza ad demakre leyanoka umosfeh rabba bar rav huna la taem umtza ad demayete leyanoka levet midresha
Amar rav safra mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben chananya may dichtiv veshinnantam levanecha al tikre veshinnantam ella veshillashtam
Leolam yeshallesh adam shenotav shelish bammikra shelish bammishna shelish battalmud mi yodea kamma chaye la tzericha leome

Lefichach nikreu rishonim sofrim shehau sofrim kol haotiyyot shebbattora shehau omrim vav degachon chetzyan shel otiyyot shel sefer tora darosh darash chetzyan shel tevot vehitgallach shel pesukim yecharsemenna chazir miyyaar ayin deyaar chetzyan shel tehillim vehu rachum yechapper aon chetzo difsukim

Bae rav yosef vav degachon mehay gisa o mehay gisa amaru leh nete sefer tora venimninhu mi la amar rabba bar bar chana lo zazu mishsham ad sheheviu sefer tora umnaum amar lehu inhu bekii bachaserot viterot anan la bekiinan

Bae rav yosef vehitgallach mehay gisa o mehay gisa amar leh abbaye pesuke miha layeto limninhu bifsuke name la bekiinan dechi ata rav acha bar adda amar bemareva paski leh lehay kera litlata pesuke vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinne anochi ba elecha beav heanan
Tanu rabbanan chameshet alafim ushmone meot ushmonim ushmona pesukim hau pesuke sefer tora yater alav tehillim shemona chaser mimmennu divre hayyamim shemona
Tanu rabbanan veshinnantam sheyehu divre tora mechuddadim befich sheim yishal lecha adam davar al tegamgem vetomar lo ella emor lo miyyad shenneemar
b: Emor lachochma achoti atte vego veomer koshrem al etzbeotecha kotvem al luach libbecha veomer kechitztzim beyad gibbor ken bene hanneurim veomer chitztze gibbor shenunim veomer chitztzecha shenunim ammim tachtecha yippelu veomer ashre haggever asher mille et ashpato mehem lo yevoshu ki yedabberu et oyevim bashshaar

May et oyevim bashshaar amar rabbi chiyya bar abba afilu haav uvno harav vetalmido sheoskin battora bashshaar echad naasim oyevim ze et ze veenam zazim mishsham ad shennaasim ohavim ze et ze shenneemar et vahev besufa al tikre besufa ella besofah

Tanu rabbanan vesamtem sam tam nimshela tora kesam chayyim mashal leadam shehikka et beno makka gedola vehinniach lo retiyya al makkato veamar lo beni kol zeman shehartiyya zo al makkatcha echol ma shehanaatecha ushte ma shehanaatecha urchotz ben bechammin ben betzonen veen atta mityare veim atta maavirah hare hi maala nome
Kach hakkadosh baruch hu amar lahem leyisrael banay barati yetzer hara uvarati lo tora tavlin veim attem oskim battora en attem nimsarim beyado shenneemar halo im tetiv seet

Veim en attem oskin battora attem nimsarim beyado shenneemar lappetach chattat rovetz velo od ella shekkol massao umattano becha shenneemar veelecha teshukato veim atta rotze atta moshel bo shenneemar veatta timshol bo
Tanu rabbanan kashe yetzer hara sheafilu yotzro kerao ra shenneemar ki yetzer lev haadam ra minneurav amar rav yitzchak yitzro shel adam mitchaddesh alav bechol yom shenneemar rak ra kol hayyom

Veamar rabbi shimon ben levi yitzro shel adam mitgabber alav bechol yom umvakkesh hamito shenneemar tzofe rasha latztzaddik umvakkesh lahamito veilmale hakkadosh baruch hu ozro en yachol lo shenneemar elohim lo yaazvennu veyado

Tana deve rabbi yishmael beni im paga becha menuuol ze moshchehu levet hammidrash im even hu nimoach veim barzel hu mitpotzetz shenneemar halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai uchfattish yefotzetz sala im even hu nimoach shenneemar hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim veomer avanim shachaku mayim
Lehassio ishsha menalan dichtiv kechu nashim veholidu banim uvanot ukchu livnechem nashim veet benotechem tenu laanashim
Bishlama beno beyado ella bitto beyado hi hachi kaamar lehu niten lah mide venalbeshah unchasseyah ki hechi dilkiftzu alah inashe

Lelammedo ummanut menalan amar chizkiyya deamar kera ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta im ishsha mammash hi keshem shechayyav lehassio ishsha kach chayyav lelammedo ummanut im tora hi keshem shechayyav lelammedo tora kach chayyav lelammedo ummanut
Veyesh omrim af lahashito bannahar may tama chayyuteh hu
Rabbi yehuda omer kol sheeno melammedo ummanut melammedo listut listut salka datach ella keilu melammedo listut
May benayehu ika benayehu deagmereh iska
Kol mitzot haav al habben vechu may kol mitzot haav al habben ilema kol mitzvata demichayyav abba lemibad livreh nashim chayyavot vehatanya haav chayyav bivno lemulo velifdoto aviv en immo lo

Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar kol mitzot haav hammuttalot al habben laasot leaviv echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavin tenena leha detanu rabbanan ish en li ella ish ishsha minnayin keshehu omer tirau hare kan shenayim
Im ken ma talmud lomar ish ish sipek beyado laasot ishsha en sipek beyadah laasot mippene shershut acherim aleha amar rav idi bar avin amar rav nitgarsha shenehem shavim
Tanu rabbanan neemar kabbed et avicha veet immecha veneemar kabbed et Adonai mehonecha hishva hakkatuv kibbud av vaem lichvod hammakom
Neemar ish immo veaviv tirau veneemar et Adonai elohecha tira veoto taavod hishva hakkatuv moraat av vaem lemoraat hammakom
Neemar mekallel aviv veimmo mot yumat veneemar ish ish ki yekallel elohav venasa cheto hishva hakkatuv birkat av vaem levirkat hammakom aval behakkaa vadday i efshar

Vechen bedin sheshshelashtan shuttafin bo tanu rabbanan shelosha shuttafin hen baadam hakkadosh baruch hu veaviv veimmo bizman sheadam mechabbed et aviv veet immo amar hakkadosh baruch hu maale ani alehem keilu darti benehem vechibbeduni
Tanya rabbi omer galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam shebben mechabbed et immo yoter meaviv mippene

a: Shemmeshaddalto bidvarim lefichach hikdim hakkadosh baruch hu kibud av lechibud em vegaluy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam shehabben mityare meaviv yoter meimmo mippene shemmelammedo tora lefichach hikdim hakkadosh baruch hu mora haem lemora haav

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman bizman sheadam metzaer et aviv veet immo amar hakkadosh baruch hu yafe asiti shello darti benehem sheilmale darti benehem tziaruni amar rabbi yitzchak kol haover avera basseter keilu dochek ragle shechina shenneemar ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi asur leadam sheyehallech arba ammot bekoma zekufa shenneemar melo chol haaretz kevodo rav huna bereh derav yehoshua la mesagge arba ammot begiluy harosh amar shechina lemala meroshi

Shaal ben almana achat et rabbi eliezer abba omer hashkeni mayim veima omeret hashkeni mayim eze mehem kodem amar leh hannach kevod immecha vaase kevod avicha sheatta veimmecha chayyavim bichvod avicha ba lifne rabbi yehoshua amar lo kach
Amar lo rabbi nitgarsha mahu amar leh mibben rise enecha nikar shebben almana atta hattel lahen mayim besefel vekakea lahen ketarnegolin

Daresh ulla rabba appitcha deve nesia may dichtiv yoducha Adonai kol malche aretz ki shamu imre ficha maamar picha lo neemar ella imre ficha beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu anochi velo yihye lecha amaru ummot haolam lichvod atzmo hu doresh
Kevan sheamar kabbed et avicha veet immecha chazru vehodu lemaamarot harishonot rava amar mehacha rosh devarcha emet rosh devarcha velo sof devarcha ella missof devarcha nikar sherosh devarcha emet

Beo mineh merav ulla ad hechan kibud av vaem amar lahem tzeu uru ma asa nochri echad beashkelon vedama ben netina shemo paam achat bikkeshu chachamim perakmatya beshishshim ribo sachar vehaya mafteach munnach tachat meraashotav shel aviv velo tziaro

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shaalu et rabbi eliezer ad hechan kibud av vaem amar lahem tzeu uru ma asa nochri echad leaviv beashkelon vedama ben netina shemo bikkeshu mimmennu chachamim avanim laefod beshishshim ribo sachar verav kahana matne bishmonim ribo vehaya mafteach munnach tachat meraashotav shel aviv velo tziaro

Leshana haacheret natan hakkadosh baruch hu secharo shennolda lo para adumma beedro nichnesu chachme yisrael etzlo amar lahem yodea ani bachem sheim ani mevakkesh mikkem kol mamon shebbaolam attem notnin li ella en ani mevakkesh mikkem ella oto mamon shehifsadti bishvil kevod abba
Veamar rabbi chanina uma mi sheeno metzuve veose kach metzuve veose al achat kamma vechamma deamar rabbi chanina gadol metzuve veose mimmi sheeno metzuve veose

Amar rav yosef meresh hava amena man dahava amar li halacha kerabbi yehuda deamar some patur min hammitzot avedna yoma tava lerabbanan deha la mipkidna veha avedna hashta deshamitah leha deamar rabbi chanina gadol metzuve veose yoter mimmi sheeno metzuve veose adderabba man deamar li deen halacha kerabbi yehuda avedna yoma tava lerabbanan
Ki ata rav dimi amar paam achat haya lavush sirkon shel zahav vehaya yoshev ben gedole romi uvata immo ukraattu mimmennu vetafcha lo al rosho veyarka lo befanav velo hichlimah
Tane avimi bereh derabbi avahu yesh maachil leaviv pasone vetordo min haolam veyesh matchino barechayim
b: Umvio lechayye haolam habba

Amar rabbi avahu kegon avimi beri kiyyem mitzvat kibud chamsha bene semichi hava leh laavimi bechayye aviv vechi hava ata rabbi avahu kare abbava rahet veazel ufatach leh veamar in in ad dematey hatam
Yoma chad amar leh ashkeyan mayya addeayeti leh namnem gachen kae aleh ad deitar istayyaa milteh udrash avimi mizmor leasaf

Amar leh rav yaakov bar avuh leabbaye kegon ana dead deatena mibbe rav abba medalle li kasa veimma mazga li hechi eeved amar leh meimmach kabbel umeavuch la tekabbel dechevan devar tora hu chalsha dateh

Rabbi tarfon hava leh hahi imma dechol emat dahavat baaya lemesek lefurya gachin uslik lah vechol emat dehvat nachit nechtat aluya ata veka mishtabbach be midresha amre leh adayin lo higgata lachatzi kibud kelum zarka arnaki befanecha layyam velo hichlamtah

Rav yosef ki hava shama kal kara deimmeh amar ekum mikkamme shechina deatya amar rabbi yochanan ashre mi shello chamaan rabbi yochanan ki ibberattu immo met aviv yeladattu meta immo vechen abbaye ini vehaamar abbaye amara li em hahi merabbeyanteh havay
Rav assi hava leh hahi imma zekena amara leh baayana tachshitin avad lah baayana gavra neayyen lach baayana gavra deshappir kevatach shavkah vaazal leara deyisrael

Shema deka azla abbatreh ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh mahu latzet meeretz lechutza laaretz amar leh asur likrat imma mahu amar leh eni yodea ittarach purta hadar ata amar leh assi nitratztzeta latzet hammakom yachazircha leshalom

Ata lekammeh derabbi elazar amar leh chas veshalom dilma mirtach ratach amar leh may amar lach amar leh hammakom yachazircha leshalom amar leh veim ita deratach la hava mevarech lech addehachi vehachi shema laarona dekaate amar i yedai la nefaki

Tanu rabbanan mechabbedo bechayyav umchabbedo bemoto bechayyav ketzad hannishma bidvar aviv lemakom lo yomar shallechuni bishvil atzmi maharuni bishvil atzmi pitruni bishvil atzmi ella kullehu bishvil abba

Bemoto ketzad haya omer davar shemua mippiv lo yomar kach amar abba ella kach amar abba mari hareni kapparat mishkavo vehane mile toch shenem asar chodesh mikkan veelach omer zichrono livracha lechayye haolam habba
Tanu rabbanan chacham meshanne shem aviv veshem rabbo turgeman eno meshanne lo shem aviv velo shem rabbo avuh deman ilema avuh dimturgeman attu turgeman lav bar chiyyuva hu
Ella amar rava shem aviv shel chacham veshem rabbo shel chacham ki ha demar bar rav ashe ki hava daresh befirka ihu amar abba mari veamoreh amar hachi amar rav ashe
Tanu rabbanan ezehu mora veezehu kibud mora lo omed bimkomo velo yoshev bimkomo velo soter et devarav velo machrio kibud maachil umashke malbish umchasse machnis umotzi
Ibaya lehu

a: Mishshel mi rav yehuda amar mishshel ben rav natan bar oshaya amar mishshel av oro leh rabbanan lerav yirmeya veamri lah livreh derav yirmeya keman deamar mishshel av
Metivi neemar kabbed et avicha veet immecha veneemar kabbed et Adonai mehonecha ma lehallan bechesron kis af kan bechesron kis vei amratte mishshel av may nafka leh mineh levitul melacha
Ta shema shene achim shene shuttafin haav uvno harav vetalmido podin ze laze maaser sheni umaachilin ze laze masar ani
Vei amratte mishshel ben nimtza ze porea chovo mishshel aniyyim la tzericha lehadafa
I hachi hayenu dekatane alah amar rabbi yehuda tavo meera lemi shemmaachil et aviv masar ani vei lehadafa may nafka minah afilu hachi zila beh milta
Ta shema shaalu et rabbi eliezer ad hechan kibud av vaem amar lahem kede sheyyittol arnaki veyizrekennu layyam befanav veeno machlimo vei amratte mishshel av may nafka leh mineh berauy leorsho
Vechi ha derabba bar rav huna derav huna kera shirae beanpe rabba bereh amar ezil ichze i ratach i la ratach vedilma ratach vekaavar allifne iver lo titten michshol demachel leh likareh
Veha kaavar mishshum bal tashchit daavad leh befumbeyane vedilma mishshum hachi la ratach deaved leh bishat ritcheh
Matne leh rav yechezkel lerami bereh hannisrafim banniskalim rabbi shimon omer yiddonu biskila shehasserefa chamura
Amar leh rav yehuda bereh abba la tatneyeh hachi may irya serefa chamura tipok li derubba niskalim ninhu ella hachi atneyeh hanniskalim bannisrafim
Amar leh i hachi ema sefa vachachamim omrim yiddonu bisrefa shehassekila chamura may irya diskila chamura tipok li derubba nisrafim ninhu
Amar leh hatam rabbanan hu dekaamru leh lerabbi shimon dekaamratte serefa chamura la sekila chamura

Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana la tema leh laavuch hachi detanya hare shehaya aviv over al divre tora al yomar lo abba avarta al divre tora ella omer lo abba kach katuv battora kach katuv battora tzaore ka metzaar leh ella omer lo abba mikra katuv battora kach

Elazar ben matya omer abba omer hashkeni mayim umitzva laasot manniach ani kevod abba veose et hammitzva sheani veabba chayyavim bammitzva isi ben yehuda omer im efshar lammitzva leasot al yede acherim tease al yede acherim veyelech hu bichvod aviv amar rav matna halacha keisi ben yehuda
Amar rav yitzchak bar shela amar rav matna amar rav chisda haav shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul harav shemmachal al kevodo en kevodo machul
Verav yosef amar afilu harav shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul shenneemar va holech lifnehem yomam amar rava hachi hashta hatam hakkadosh baruch hu alma dileh hu vetora dileh hi machel leh likareh
b: Hacha tora dileh hi hadar amar rava in tora dileh hi dichtiv uvtorato yehge yomam valayela

Ini veha rava mashke be hillula divreh vedal leh kasa lerav pappa ulrav huna bereh derav yehoshua vekamu mikkammeh lerav mari ulrav pinchas bereh derav chisda vela kamu mikkammeh ikfad vaamar hanu rabbanan rabbanan vehanu rabbanan lav rabbanan
Vetu rav pappa hava mashke be hillula deabba mar bereh vedalli leh kasa lerabbi yitzchak bereh derav yehuda vela kam mikkammeh veikfad afilu hachi hidur mebad leh bau

Amar rav ashe afilu leman deamar harav shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul nasi shemmachal al kevodo en kevodo machul metivi maase berabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua verabbi tzadok shehau mesubbin bevet hammishte beno shel rabban gamliel vehaya rabban gamliel omed umashke alehem natan hakkos lerabbi eliezer velo netalo netano lerabbi yehoshua vekiblo amar lo rabbi eliezer ma ze yehoshua anu yoshvin verabban gamliel beribi omed umashke alenu

Amar leh matzinu gadol mimmennu sheshshimmesh avraham gadol mimmennu veshimmesh avraham gedol haddor haya vechatuv bo vehu omed alehem veshemma tomru kemalache hashsharet nidmu lo lo nidmu lo ella learviyyim veanu lo yehe rabban gamliel beribi omed umashke alenu

Amar lahem rabbi tzadok ad matay attem mannichim kevodo shel makom veattem oskim bichvod habberiyyot hakkadosh baruch hu meshiv ruchot umaale nesiim umorid matar umatzmiach adama veorech shulchan lifne kol echad veechad veanu lo yehe rabban gamliel beribi omed umashke alenu
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav ashe afilu leman deamar nasi shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul melech shemmachal al kevodo en kevodo machul shenneemar som tasim alecha melech shettehe emato alecha

Tanu rabbanan mippene seva takum yachol afilu mippene zaken ashmay talmud lomar zaken veen zaken ella chacham shenneemar esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael rabbi yose haggelili omer en zaken ella mi shekkana chochma shenneemar Adonai kanani reshit darko
Yachol yaamod mippanav mimmakom rachok talmud lomar takum vehadarta lo amarti kima ella bimkom sheyyesh hidur

Yachol yehadderennu bemamon talmud lomar takum vehadarta ma kima sheen bah chesron kis af hidur sheen bo chesron kis yachol yaamod mippanav mibbet hakkisse umibbet hammerchatz talmud lomar takum vehadarta lo amarti kima ella bimkom sheyyesh hidur
Yachol yaatzim enav kemi shello raahu talmud lomar takum veyareta davar hammasur lallev neemar bo veyareta meelohecha
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer minnayin lezaken shello yatriach talmud lomar zaken veyareta isi ben yehuda omer mippene seva takum afilu kol seva bammashma
Rabbi yose haggelili hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu yannik vechakkim tanna kamma savar yannik vechakkim la rabbi yose haggelili savar afilu yannik vechakkim

May tama derabbi yose haggelili amar lach i salka datach kidkaamar tanna kamma im ken nichtov rachamana mippene seva zaken takum vehadarta may shena defalginhu rachamana lememar dehay lav hay vehay lav hay shema minah afilu yannik vechakkim
Vetanna kamma mishshum devae lemismach zaken veyareta vetanna kamma may tama i salka datach kidkaamar rabbi yose haggelili im ken nichtov rachamana

a: Mippene seva takum vehadarta takum vehadarta pene zaken umiddela ketav hachi shema minah chad hu

Amar mar yachol yehadderennu bemamon talmud lomar takum vehadarta ma kima sheen bah chesron kis af hidur sheen bo chesron kis vekima let bah chesron kis mi la askinan deka nakev marganita addehachi vehachi kaem mikkammeh uvatel mimmelachto

Ella akkesh kima lehidur ma hidur sheen bo bitul af kima sheen bah bitul veakkesh name hidur lekima ma kima sheen bah chesron kis af hidur sheen bo chesron kis mikkan amru en baale ummaniyyot rashshain laamod mippene talmide chachamim beshaa sheoskin bimlachtam

Vela vehatnan kol baale ummaniyyot omdim mippenehem veshoalim bishlomam veomrim lahem achenu anshe makom peloni boachem leshalom amar rabbi yochanan mippenehem omdim mippene talmide chachamim en omdim
Amar rabbi yose bar avin bo ure kamma chaviva mitzva bishatah shehare mippenehem omdim mippene talmide chachamim en omdim vedilma shane hatam deim ken atta machshilan leatid lavo

Amar mar yachol yaamod mippanav mibbet hakkisse umibbet hammerchatz vela veha rabbi chiyya hava yatev be maschuta vechalef veazel rabbi shimon bar rabbi vela kam mikkammeh veikfad vaata amar leh laavuh shene chummashim shaniti lo besefer tehillim velo amad mippanay

Vetu bar kappara veamri lah rabbi shemuel bar rabbi yose hava yatev be maschuta al veazel rabbi shimon bar rabbi vela kam mikkammeh veikfad vaata amar leh laavuh shene shelishe shelish shaniti lo betorat kohanim velo amad mippanay veamar lo shemma bahen yoshev umharher
Tama devahen yoshev umharher ha lav hachi la
La kashya ha bevatte gavae ha bevatte barae
Hachi name mistabbera deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan bechol makom muttar leharher chutz mibbet hammerchatz umibbet hakkisse dilma leunseh shane
Yachol yaatzim enav kemi shello raahu attu berashshie askinan
Ella yachol yaatzim enav mikkamme delimteyeh zeman chiyyuva dechi meta zeman chiyyuva ha la chaze leh dekaem mikkammeh talmud lomar takum veyareta
Tana ezohi kima sheyyesh bah hidur heve omer ze arba ammot amar abbaye la amaran ella berabbo sheeno muvhak aval berabbo hammuvhak melo enav

Abbaye mikki hava chaze leh leudneh dechamra derav yosef deate hava kaem abbaye hava rechiv chamara veka mesagge aggudda dinhar sagya yatev rav mesharsheya verabbanan beidach gisa vela kamu mikkammeh amar lehu velav rav muvhak ana amaru leh lav addatin
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer minnayin lezaken shello yatriach talmud lomar zaken veyareta amar abbaye naktinan dei makkef chaye abbaye makkef rabbi zera makkef
Ravina hava yatev kammeh derabbi yirmeya middifti chalaf hahu gavra kammeh vela mikasse resha amar kamma chatzif ha gavra amar leh dilma mimmata machseya nihu degisi bah rabbanan

Isi ben yehuda omer mippene seva takum vaafilu kol seva bammashma amar rabbi yochanan halacha keisi ben yehuda rabbi yochanan hava kae mikkamme save dearmae amar kamma harpatke ado alayehu dehane rava mekam la kae hidur aved lehu
Abbaye yahev yeda lesave rava meshaddar shelucheh rav nachman meshaddar gozae amar i lav tora kamma nachman bar abba ika beshuka
Amar rabbi ayevu amar rabbi yannay
b: En talmid chacham rashshay laamod mippene rabbo ella shacharit vearvit kede shello yihye kevodo merubbe mikkevod shamayim metivi rabbi shimon ben elazar omer minnayin lezaken shello yatriach talmud lomar zaken veyareta
Vei amratte shacharit vearvit bilvad ammay la nitrach chiyyuva hu ella lav kulle yoma la leolam shacharit vearvit bilvad vaafilu hachi kamma deefshar leh la nitrach

Amar rabbi elazar kol talmid chacham sheen omed mippene rabbo nikra rasha veeno maarich yamim vetalmudo mishtakkeach shenneemar vetov lo yihye larasha velo yaarich yamim katztzel asher enennu yare millifne haelohim mora zo eni yodea mahu keshehu omer veyareta meelohecha hare mora zo kima
Veema moraat ribbit umoraat mishkalot rabbi elazar pene pene gamar
Ibaya lehu beno vehu rabbo mahu laamod mippene aviv ta shema daamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana kum mikkamme avuch shane rav yechezkel devaal maasim hava daafilu mar shemuel name kaem mikkammeh
Ella may kaamar leh hachi kaamar leh zimnin deate meachoray kum atte mikkammeh vela techush likara didi
Ibaya lehu beno vehu rabbo mahu sheyyaamod aviv mippanav ta shema deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi ani eni keday laamod mippene veni ella mishshum kevod bet nasi
Tama daana rabbeh ha ihu rabbay kaemna mikkammeh hachi kaamar ani eni keday laamod mippene veni vaafilu hu rabbay deha ana avuh ella mishshum kevod bet nasi
Ibaya lehu rachuv kimhallech dame o la amar abbaye ta shema tame yoshev tachat hailan vetahor omed tame
Tame omed tachat hailan vetahor yoshev tahor veim yashav hattame hattahor tame
Vechen beeven hamnuggaat veamar rav nachman bar kohen zot omeret rachuv kimhallech dame shema minah
Ibaya lehu mahu laamod mippene sefer tora rabbi chilkiyya verabbi simon verabbi elazar amri kal vachomer mippene lomdeha omdim mippaneha lo kol shekken
Rabbi ilay verabbi yaakov bar zavdi hao yatvi chalef veazel rabbi shimon bar abba vekamu mikkammeh amar lehu chada deattun chakkime vaana chaver veod kelum tora omedet mippene lomdeha
Savar lah kerabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar en talmid chacham rashshay laamod mippene rabbo beshaa sheosek battora layet alah abbaye
Vehibbitu achare moshe ad boo haohela rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha chad amar lignay vechad amar leshevach man deamar lignay kidita man deamar leshevach amar chizkiyya

Amar li rabbi chanina bereh derabbi avahu amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi avdimi demin chefa chacham over omed millefanav arba ammot vechevan sheavar arba ammot yoshev av bet din over omed millefanav melo enav vechevan sheavar arba ammot yoshev nasi over omed millefanav melo enav veeno yoshev ad sheyyeshev bimkomo shenneemar vehibbitu achare moshe ad boo haohela
Kol mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah vechu tanu rabbanan ezohi mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah sukka velulav shofar vetzitzit

a: Utfilin
Veezohi mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah mezuza maake aveda veshiluach hakken

Uchlala hu hare matztza simcha hakhel demitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama venashim chayyavot vetu vahare talmud tora periyya urviyya ufidon habben delav mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah hu venashim peturot
Amar rabbi yochanan en lemedin min hakkelalot vaafilu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz
Ditnan bakkol mearvin umishtattefin chutz min hammayim umelach vetu leka vehaika kemehin ufitriyyot ella en lemedin min hakkelalot vaafilu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz

Umitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot menalan gamar mittefilin ma tefilin nashim peturot af kol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot utfilin gamar lah mittalmud tora ma talmud tora nashim peturot af tefilin nashim peturot
Venakkesh tefilin limzuza tefilin letalmud tora itakkush ben befarasha rishona ben befarasha sheniyya tefilin limzuza befarasha sheniyya la itakkush
Venakkesh mezuza letalmud tora la salka datach dichtiv lemaan yirbu yemechem gavre bau chayye neshe la bau chayye
Vahare sukka demitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah dichtiv bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim tama dichtav rachamana haezrach lehotzi et hannashim ha lav hachi nashim chayyavot
Amar abbaye itzterich salka datach amena hoil dichtiv bassukkot teshvu teshvu keen taduru ma dira ish veishto af sukka ish veishto
Verava amar
b: Itzterich salka datach amena nelaf chamishsha asar chamishsha asar mechag hammatztzot ma lehallan nashim chayyavot af kan nashim chayyavot tzericha
Vahare reiyya demitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah vetama dichtav rachamana zechurcha lehotzi hannashim ha lav hachi nashim chayyavot
Itzterich salka datach amena nelaf reiyya reiyya mehakhel
Veaddeyalfinan mittefilin liftura nelaf missimcha lechiyyuva amar abbaye ishsha baalah mesammechah
Almana may ika lememar bishruya etzlo
Venelaf mehakhel mishshum dehave matztza vehakhel shene chetuvim habbaim keechad vechol shene chetuvim habbain keechad en melammedim
I hachi tefilin uriyya name shene chetuvim habbaim keechad veen melammedim tzerichi dei ketav rachamana tefilin vela ketav reiyya hava amena nelaf reiyya reiyya mehakhel
Vei ketav rachamana reiyya vela ketav tefilin hava amena akkesh tefilin limzuza tzericha
I hachi matztza vehakhel name tzerichi lemay tzerichi bishlama i ketav rachamana hakhel vela ketav matztza hava amena nelaf chamishsha asar chamishsha asar mechag hassukkot
Ella nichtov rachamana matztza vela bae hakhel vaana amena tefalim chayyavim nashim lo kol shekken hilkach have lehu shene chetuvim habbaim keechad veen melammedim
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar
Vetu mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah nashim chayyavot menalan deyalef mimmora ma mora nashim chayyavot af kol mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama nashim chayyavot
Venelaf mittalmud tora mishshum dehave leh talmud tora ufriyya urviyya shene chetuvim habbaim keechad vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedim

a: Ulrabbi yochanan ben beroka deamar al shenehem hu omer vayevarech otam elohim peru urvu may ika lememar mishshum dehave talmud tora ufidon habben shene chetuvim habbaim keechad vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin

Ulrabbi yochanan ben beroka name niho periyya urviyya umora shene chetuvim habbaim keechad veen melammedin tzerichi dei ketav rachamana mora vela ketav periyya urviyya hava amena vechivshuha amar rachamana ish dedarko lechabbesh in ishsha deen darkah lechabbesh la
Vei ketav periyya urviyya velo ketav mora hava amena ish desipek beyado laasot in ishsha deen sipek beyadah laasot la vechevan deen sipek beyadah laasot lo titchayyev kelal tzericha
Hanicha leman deamar shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar amar rava pappunae yadi lah letama deha milta

Umannu rav acha bar yaakov amar kera vehaya lecha leot al yadcha ulzikkaron ben enecha lemaan tihye torat Adonai beficha hukkesha kal hattora kullah litfilin ma tefilin mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah venashim peturot af kol mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah nashim peturot umiddemitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah nashim peturot mikkelal demitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah nashim chayyavot

Hanicha leman deamar tefilin mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah ella leman deamar tefilin mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah may ika lememar man shamatte leh deamar tefilin mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah rabbi meir vesavar lah shene chetuvim habbaim keechad vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin

Ulrabbi yehuda deamar shene chetuvim habbaim keechad melammedin utfilin mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah may ika lememar mishshum dehavey matztza simcha vehakhel shelosha chetuvim habbaim keechad ushlosha chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin

Vechol mitzvat lo taase vechu menahane mile amar rav yehuda amar rav vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael amar kera ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashim shebbattora

Deve rabbi eliezer tana amar kera asher tasim lifnehem hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol dinim shebbattora deve chizkiyya tana amar kera vehemit ish o ishsha hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol mitot shebbattora
Utzricha dei ashmeinan hach kammayeta mishshum kappara chas rachamana alah aval dinin ema ish devar massa umattan in ishsha la
Vei ashmeinan ha mishshum dechayyutah hi aval kofer ema
b: Ish devar mitzot in ishsha la vei ashmeinan ha mishshum deika ibud neshama chas rachamana alah aval hanach tarte ema la tzericha
Chutz mibbal takkif uval tashchit ku bishlama bal tittamme lemetim dichtiv emor el hakkohanim bene aharon bene aharon velo benot aharon ella bal takkif uval tashchit menalan
Dichtiv lo takkifu peat roshchem velo tashchit et peat zekanecha kol sheyyeshno behashchata yeshno behakkafa vehane neshe hoil vela itanhu behashchata letanhu behakkafa
Umnalan dela itanhu behashchata ibaet ema sevara deha la it lehu zakan veibaet ema kera deamar kera lo takkifu peat roshchem velo tashchit et peat zekanecha
Middeshanni kera bedibureh deim ken nichtov rachamana peat zekanchem may zekanecha zekanecha velo zekan ishtecha
Vela vehatanya zekan ishsha vehassaris sheheelu sear hare hen kezakan lechol divrehem may lav lehashchata
Amar abbaye lehashchata la matzet amratte deyalef peat peat mibbene aharon ma lehallan nashim peturot af kan nashim peturot

Vei sevira lan dechi ketiv bene aharon akkulleh inyana ketiv nishtok kera mineh vetete bekal vachomer vaana amena uma kohanim sheriba bahem hakkatuv mitzot yeterot bene aharon velo benot aharon yisrael lo kol shekken
I lav gezera shava hava amena hifsik hainyan
Hashta name nema hifsik hainyan vei mishshum gezera shava mibe leh lechidtanya lo yegallechu yachol gilcho bemisparayim yihye chayyav talmud lomar lo tashchit
Yachol likketo bemalket uvrahitne yehe chayyav talmud lomar lo yegallechu ha ketzad giluach sheyyesh bo hashchata heve omer ze taar
Im ken nichtov kera et shebbizkanecha may peat zekanecha shema minah tarte
Veella ha detanya zekan haishsha vehassaris sheheelu sear hare hen kezakan lechol divrehem lemay hilcheta amar mar zutra letumat negaim
Tumat negaim behedya ketiva veish o ishsha ki yihye vo naga berosh o vezakan ella amar mar zutra letohorat negaim
Tohorat negaim name peshita kevan devat tuma hi bat tohora hi itzterich salka datach amena litzdadim ketiv ish o ishsha ki yihye vo naga berosh o vezakan hadar atan leish ka mashma lan
Isi tane af bal yikrechu nashim peturot may tama deisi dedaresh hachi banim attem la elohechem lo titgoddu velo tasimu korcha ben enechem lamet ki am kadosh atta la elohecha banim velo banot lekorcha
Atta omer lekorcha o eno ella ligdida keshehu omer ki am kadosh atta la elohecha hare gedida amur ha ma ani mekayyem banim velo banot lekorcha
Uma raita lerabbot et haggedida ulhotzi et hakkorcha merabbe ani et haggedida sheyyeshnah bimkom hassear veshello bimkom sear umotzi ani et hakkorcha sheenah ella bimkom sear
Veema banim velo banot ben lekorcha ben ligdida vechi ketiv ki am kadosh atta la elohecha bisrita hu dichtiv kasavar isi serita ugdida

a: Achat hi
Abbaye amar hayenu tama deisi degamar korcha korcha mibbene aharon ma lehallan nashim peturot af kan nashim peturot

Vei sevira lan dechi ketiv kera bechulle inyana hu dichtiv nishtok kera mineh vetete bekal vachomer vaana amena uma kohanim sheriba bahem hakkatuv mitzot yeterot bene aharon velo benot aharon yisrael lo kol shekken
I lav gezera shava hava amena hifsik hainyan

Hashta name nema hifsik hainyan vei mishshum gezera shava mibe leh lechidtanya lo yikrechu yachol afilu karach arba vechamesh kerachot lo yehe chayyav ella achat talmud lomar korcha lechayyev al kol achat veachat

Berosham ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar lo titgoddu velo tasimu korcha ben enechem lamet yachol lo yehe chayyav ella al ben haenayim minnayin lerabbot kal harosh talmud lomar berosham lechayyev al harosh keven haenayim

Veen li ella kohanim sheriba bahem hakkatuv mitzot yeterot yisrael menalan neemar kan korcha veneemar lehallan korcha ma kan chayyav al kol korcha vekorcha vechayyav al harosh keven haenayim af lehallan chayyav al kol korcha vekorcha vechayyav al harosh keven haenayim
Uma lehallan al met af kan al met im ken nichtov kera korach may korcha shamatte minah tarte
Rava amar hayenu tama deisi deyalef ben enechem mittefilin ma lehallan nashim peturot af kan nashim peturot verava may tama la amar keabbayye korach korcha la mashma leh
Veabbaye may tama la amar kerava amar lach tefilin gufayehu mehacha gamar lah ma lehallan mekom sheosim korcha begovah shel rosh af kan mekom hannacha begovah harosh

Uven leabbaye uven lerava hay banim attem may darshi beh hay mibe lechidtanya banim attem la elohechem bizman sheattem nohagim minhag banim attem keruyim banim en attem nohagim minhag banim en attem keruyim banim divre rabbi yehuda

Rabbi meir omer ben kach uven kach attem keruyim banim shenneemar banim sechalim hemma veomer banim lo emun bam veomer zera mereim banim mashchitim veomer vehaya bimkom asher yeamer lahem lo ammi attem yeamer lahem bene el chay
May veomer vechi tema sechale hu demikkeru bene ki let behu hemanutayehu la mikru bene ta shema veomer banim lo emun bam

Vechi tema ki let behu hemanuta hu demikru banim ki palchu laavoda zara la mikru banim ta shema veomer zera mereim banim mashchitim vechi tema banim mashchitim hu demikru bene mealleya la mikru ta shema veomer vehaya bimkom asher yeamer lahem lo ammi attem yeamer lahem bene el chay
Matni hassemichot vehattenufot vehahaggashot vehakkemitzot vehahaktarot vehammelikot vehakkabbalot vehazzaot nohagim baanashim velo benashim chutz mimminchat sota unzira shehen menifot
Gema semichot dichtiv dabber el bene yisrael vesamach bene yisrael somchim veen benot yisrael somchot
Tenufot dabber el bene yisrael vehenif bene yisrael menifin veen benot yisrael menifot
Haggashot dichtiv vezot torat hammincha hakrev otah bene aharon bene aharon velo benot aharon
Kemitzot dichtiv veheviah el bene aharon vekamatz bene aharon velo benot aharon
Haktarot dichtiv vehiktiru oto bene aharon bene aharon velo benot aharon
Hammelikot dichtiv umalak vehiktir itakkash melika lehaktara
Hakkabbalot dichtiv vehikrivu bene aharon veamar mar
b: Vehikrivu zo kabbalat haddam
Vehazzaot hazzaa dehecha i defara elazar ketiv bah i defanim hakkohen hammashiach ketiv bah ella hazzaa deven of
Deatya bekal vachomer mibben tzon uma ben tzon shello kava lo kohen lishchitato kava lo kohen lehazzaato ben of shekkava lo kohen limlikato eno din sheyyikba lo lehazzaato

Chutz mimminchat sota unzira amar leh rabbi elazar lerabbi yoshiyya dedareh la tetev akkarach ad deamratte li leha shemateta minnayin leminchat sota shetteuna tenufa menalan begufah ketiv vehenif et hammincha ella tenufa bivalim menalan
Atya yad yad mishshelamim ketiv hacha velakach hakkohen miyyad haishsha uchtiv hatam yadav tevienna
Ma kan kohen af lehallan kohen ma lehallan bealim af kan bealim ha ketzad kohen machnis yado tachat yad bealim umenif
Ashkechan sota nezira menalan atya kaf kaf missota
Matni kol mitzva shehi teluya baaretz enah noheget ella baaretz vesheenah teluya baaretz noheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz

a: Chutz min haorla vechilayim rabbi eliezer omer af hechadash
Gema may teluya umay sheenah teluya ilema teluya dichtiv bah bia vesheenah teluya dela ketiv bah bia vahare tefilin ufeter chamor dichtiv bahen bia venohagin ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz
Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar kol mitzva shehi chovat hagguf noheget ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz chovat karka enah noheget ella baaretz
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan elle hachukkim ellu hammidrashot vehammishpatim ellu haddinim asher tishmerun zo mishna laasot zo maase

Baaretz yachol kol hammitzot kullan lo yehu nohagim ella baaretz talmud lomar kol hayyamim asher attem chayyim al haadama i kol hayyamim yachol yehu nohagim ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz talmud lomar baaretz

Achar sheriba hakkatuv umiet tze ulmad mimma sheamur bainyan abbed teabbedun et kol hammekomot asher avdu sham vego ma avoda zara meuchedet shehi chovat hagguf venoheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz af kol shehi chovat hagguf noheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz
Chutz min haorla vehakkilayim ibaya lehu rabbi eliezer lekulla pelig o lechumra pelig
Lechumra pelig vehachi kaamar tanna kamma chutz min haorla umin hakkilayim dehilcheta gemiri lah af al gav deika lememar chovat karka hi aval chadash baaretz in bechutza laaretz la
May tama moshav leachar yerushsha vishiva mashma
Vaata rabbi eliezer lememar af chadash noheg ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz may tama moshav bechol makom sheattem yoshvim
O dilma lekulla pelig vehachi kaamar tanna kamma chutz min haorla vehakkilayim dehilcheta gemiri lah vechol shekken chadash demoshav kol makom sheattem yoshvim mashma
Vaata rabbi eliezer lememar chadash eno noheg ella baaretz demoshav leachar yerushsha vishiva mashma umay af akkammayeta
Ta shema deamar abbaye man tanna diflig aleh derabbi eliezer rabbi yishmael hi detanya lelammedcha shekkol makom shenneemar bo moshav eno ella leachar yerushsha vishiva divre rabbi yishmael

Amar lo rabbi akiva hare shabbat shenneemar bo moshavot venoheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz amar lo shabbat kal vachomer atya ma mitzot kallot nohagot ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz shabbat chamira lo kol shekken
Middeamar abbaye man tanna diflig aleh derabbi eliezer rabbi yishmael shema minah rabbi eliezer lechumra pelig shema minah
Mikkede rabbi yishmael ahecha kae annesachim binsachim
b: Bia umoshav ketiv behu hachi kaamar lelammed shekkol makom shenneemar bia umoshav eno ella leachar yerushsha vishiva divre rabbi yishmael

I hachi amar lo rabbi akiva hare shabbat shenneemar bo moshavot veamar lo shabbat kal vachomer hi nema leh ana bia umoshav kaamena chada veod kaamar leh chada daana bia umoshav kaamena veod deka amratte hare shabbat shenneemar bo moshavot shabbat kal vachomer hi
Bemay kamipalgi bekervu nesachim bammidbar ka mipalgi rabbi yishmael savar la kervu nesachim bammidbar verabbi akiva savar kervu nesachim bammidbar
Amar abbaye hay tana deve rabbi yishmael mappek meidach tana deve rabbi yishmael
Detana deve rabbi yishmael hoil veneemru biot battora setam ufarat lecha hakkatuv beechad mehen leachar yerushsha vishiva af kol leachar yerushsha vishiva
Veidach mishshum dehave melech uvikurim shene chetuvim habbaim keechad vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin
Veidach tzerichi dei ketav rachamana melech vela ketav bikurim hava amena bikurim deka mithane lealtar vei ketav bikurim vela ketav melech hava amena melech dedarko lechabbesh lealtar
Veidach nichtov rachamana melech vela bae bikurim vaana amena uma melech dilchabbesh leachar yerushsha vishiva bikurim lo kol shekken
Veidach i ketav hachi hava amena mide dehave achalla ka mashma lan

Vehashta deamratte chovat hagguf noheget ben beeretz yisrael ben bechutza laaretz moshav dichtav rachamana gabbe shabbat lema li itzterich salka datach amena hoil uvinyana demoadot ketiva tibe kidush ki moadot ka mashma lan
Moshav dichtav rachamana gabbe chelev vadam lema li itzterich salka datach amena hoil uvinyana dekorbanot ketivi bizman deika korban nitsar chelev vadam bizman deleka korban la ka mashma lan
Moshav dichtav rachamana gabbe matztza umaror lema li itzterich salka datach amena hoil uchtiv al matztzot umrorim yochluhu bizman deika pesach in bizman deleka pesach la ka mashma lan
Bia dichtav rachamana gabbe tefilin ufeter chamor lema li hahu mibe leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael ase mitzva zo shebbishvilah tikanes laaretz
Bishlama leman deamar moshav kol makom sheattem yoshvim mashma hayenu dichtiv vayyochlu meavur haaretz mimmochorat happesach mimmachorat happesach achul meikara la achul alma

a: Akruv omer vahadar achul
Ella leman deamar leachar yerushsha vishiva nechol lealtar la hao tzerichi

Dichtiv uvne yisrael achlu et hamman arbaim shana ad boam el eretz noshavet et hamman achlu ad boam el ketze eretz kenaan i efshar lomar ad boam el eretz noshavet shekkevar neemar el ketze eretz kenaan vei efshar lomar el ketze eretz kenaan shehare kevar neemar ad boam el eretz noshavet ha ketzad beshiva baadar met moshe ufasak man millered vehau mistappekin mimman shebbichlehem ad shishsha asar benisan
Tanya idach uvne yisrael achlu et hamman arbaim shana vechi arbaim shana achlu vahalo arbaim shana chaser sheloshim yom achlu ella lomar lecha ugot shehotziu mimmitzrayim taamu bahem taam man

Tanya idach beshiva baadar met moshe uvshiva baadar nolad minnayin shebbeshiva baadar met shenneemar vayyamot sham moshe eved Adonai uchtiv vayyivku vene yisrael et moshe bearvot moav sheloshim yom uchtiv vayehi achare mot moshe eved Adonai uchtiv moshe avdi met veatta kum avor

Uchtiv ivru bekerev hammachane vetzauu et haam lemor hachinu lachem tzeda ki beod sheloshet yamim taavru et hayyarden uchtiv vehaam alu min hayyarden beasor lachodesh harishon tze mehen sheloshim ushlosha yamim lemafrea ha lamadta shebbeshiva baadar met moshe

Uminnayin shebbeshiva baadar nolad moshe shenneemar vayyomer alehem ben mea veesrim shana anochi hayyom lo uchal od latzet velavo sheen talmud lomar hayyom ma talmud lomar hayyom melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev ummalle shenotehem shel tzaddikim miyyom leom umechodesh lechodesh shenneemar et mispar yamecha amalle
Tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer shalosh mitzot nitztauu yisrael bichnisatan laaretz venohagot ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz
Vehu haddin sheyyinhagu uma chadash sheen isuro isur olam veen isuro isur hanaa veyesh heter leisuro noheg ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz
Kilayim sheisuran isur olam veisuran isur hanaa veen heter leisuran eno din sheyyinhagu ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz vehu haddin leorla bishtayim
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer
b: Kol mitzva shennitztauu yisrael kodem kenisatan laaretz noheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz leachar kenisatan laaretz enah noheget ella baaretz chutz min hashmatat kesafim veshiluach avadim sheaf al pi shennitztauu alehem leachar kenisatan laaretz noheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz
Hashmatat kesafim chovat hagguf hi

Lo nitzrecha ella lechidtanya detanya rabbi omer veze devar hashshemitta shamot bishte shemitot hakkatuv medabber achat shemitat karka veachat shemitat kesafim bizman sheatta meshammet karka atta meshammet kesafim bizman shei atta meshammet karka i atta meshammet kesafim
Veema bimkom sheatta meshammet karka atta meshammet kesafim uvimkom sheen atta meshammet karka en atta meshammet kesafim talmud lomar ki kara shemitta la mikkol makom
Shiluach avadim chovat hagguf hi salka datach amena hoil uchtiv ukratem deror baaretz baaretz in bechutza laaretz la talmud lomar yovel hi mikkol makom
Im ken ma talmud lomar baaretz bizman shehadderor noheg baaretz noheg bechutza laaretz en deror noheg baaretz eno noheg bechutza laaretz

Tenan hatam hechadash asur min hattora bechol makom orla halacha vehakkilayim middivre sofrim may halacha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hilcheta medina ulla amar rabbi yochanan halacha lemoshe missinay
Amar leh ulla lerav yehuda bishlama ledidi deamena halacha lemoshe missinay hayenu deshane lan ben sefek orla lisfek kilayim
Ditnan sefek orla baaretz asur besurya muttar bechutza laaretz yored velokeach uvilvad shello yirennu loket
Veilu gabbe chilayim tenan kerem hannatua yarak veyarak nimkar chutza lo baaretz asur besurya muttar

Deve rabbi yishmael tana o lerabbot et hashshaliach deve chizkiyya tana tachat lerabbot et hashshaliach
Hanicha leman deamar shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar galli rachamana bishchute chutz dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach hu velo shelucho
Ashkechan gabbe shechute chutz bechol hattora menalan deyalef mishshechute chutz
Addeyalef mishshechute chutz nelaf mehanach hadar ketav rachamana venichrat haish hahu im eno inyan legufo tenehu inyan lechol hattora kullah
Ulman deamar shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedim hane hahu hahu may daresh behu chad lemaote shenayim sheochazim besakkin veshochatim vechad hu velo anus hu velo shogeg hu velo mute
Veidach mehu hahu veidach hu hahu la daresh
Veha detane haomer lishlucho tze harog et hannefesh hu chayyav vesholchav patur shammay hazzaken omer mishshum chaggay hannavi sholchav chayyav shenneemar oto haragta becherev bene ammon
May tameh deshammay hazzaken kasavar shene chetuvim habbaim keechad melammedin vehu hahu la daresh veibaet ema leolam daresh umay chayyav chayyav bedine shamayim
Mikkelal detanna kamma savar afilu middine shamayim name patur ella dina rabba vedina zuta ika benayehu
Veibaet ema shane hatam degalli rachamana oto haragta becherev bene ammon

Veidach hare lecha kecherev bene ammon ma cherev bene ammon en atta neenash alav af uriyya hachitti i atta neenash alav may tama mored bammalchut hava dekaamar leh vadoni yoav veavde adoni al pene hassade chonim

Amar rava im timtze lomar savar shammay shene chetuvim habbaim keechad melammedin vehu hahu la daresh mode beomer lishlucho tze beol et haerva veechol et hachelev shehu chayyav vesholchav patur shello matzinu bechol hattora kullah ze nehene veze mitchayyev

Itmar rav amar shaliach naase ed deve rabbi shela amri en shaliach naase ed may tama deve rabbi shela ilema mishshum dela amar leh heve li ed ella meatta kidesh ishsha bifne shenayim vela amar lahem attem eday hachi name dela hau kidushe
Ella rav amar shaliach naase ed allome ka meallemna lemilteh deve rabbi shela amri en shaliach naase ed kevan deamar mar shelucho shel adam kemoto have leh kegufeh

Metivi amar lishlosha tzeu vekaddeshu li haishsha echad shaliach ushnayim edim divre bet shammay uvet hillel omrim kullam sheluchin hen veen shaliach naase ed ad kan la peligi ella bishlosha aval bishnayim divre hakkol la

Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya rabbi natan omer bet shammay omrim shaliach veed echad uvet hillel omrim shaliach ushne edim verav kevet shammay efoch verav acha bereh derava matni ipcha rav amar en shaliach naase ed deve rabbi shela amri shaliach naase ed vehilcheta shaliach naase ed
Amar rava amar rav nachman amar lishnayim tzeu vekaddeshu li et haishsha hen hen sheluchav hen hen edav vechen begerushin
b: Vechen bedine mamonot
Utzricha dei ashmeinan bekidushin mishshum dilmesrah kaate aval gerushin nechush shemma enav natan bah
Vei ashmeinan gerushin mishshum deitta leve tere la chazya aval mamona ema hane miflag palgi tzerichi
May kasavar i kasavar hammalve chavero beedim tzarich leforo beedim hane nogim beedut ninhu dei amri la peraneh amar lehu perauni
Ella leolam kasavar hammalve et chavero beedim en tzarich leforo beedim umiggo deyachli lememar ahderinhu lelove yecholin lememar peraneh lemalve
Vehashta detakkun rabbanan shevuat heset mishtavi hane edim deyahevna leh umishteva malve dela shakel leh ufara leh love lemalve

Haish mekaddesh et bitto tenan hatam naara hamorasa hi veaviha mekabbelin et gitah amar rabbi yehuda en shette yadayim zochot keechad ella aviha mekabbel et gitah vechol sheen yechola lishmor et gitah en yechola lehitgaresh
Amar resh lakish kemachloket legerushin kach machloket lekidushin verabbi yochanan amar machloket legerushin aval lekidushin divre hakkol aviha velo hi
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina may tameh derabbi yochanan alliba derabbanan gerushin demachneset atzmah lirshut aviha ben hi uven aviha kidushin demafkaat atzmah mershut aviha aviha velo hi
Vahare maamar demafkaat atzmah mershut aviha utnan

a: Ketanna min haerusin en osim bah maamar ella middaat aviha vehannaara ben middaat atzmah ben middaat aviha ma sheen ken bekidushin
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina may tameh derabbi yochanan alliba derabbanan kidushin demiddatah aviha vela hi gerushin dival kurchah ben hi ben aviha
Hare maamar demiddatah vekatane ben hi uven aviha hatam bemaamar dival kurchah verabbi hi detanya haose maamar bivimto shello middatah rabbi omer kana vachachamim omrim lo kana
May tameh derabbi gamar mibbia divama ma bia divama beal kurchah af hacha name beal kurchah verabbanan savri yalfinan mikkidushin ma kidushin demiddatah af hacha name demiddatah
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi savar mile divama mivama hava leh lemelaf verabbanan savri kidushin mikkidushin hava leh lemelaf

Hachi name mistabbera kidka metaretz rabbi yochanan middekatane sefa ma sheen ken bekidushin ella nema tehve teuvta deresh lakish amar lach resh lakish ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar en shette yadayim zochot keachat
I rabbi yehuda ma sheen ken bekidushin ma sheen ken begerushin mibe leh in hachi name ayede ditna maamar dedame lekidushin tena name ma sheen ken bekidushin
Verabbi yehuda may shena maamar hoil uzkuka veomedet hashta deatet lehachi rabbi yochanan name la tikshe lach meikara shane maamar hoil uzkuka veomedet
Tenan haish mekaddesh et bitto keshehi naara bo uvishlucho bo uvishlucho in bah uvishluchah la teuvta deresh lakish amar lach resh lakish ha name rabbi yehuda hi
Umi matzet mokmatte lah kerabbi yehuda vehakatane sefa haomer leishsha hitkaddeshi li bitmara zo hitkaddeshi li bazo veamrinan man tanna hitkaddeshi hitkaddeshi
Veamar rabba rabbi shimon hi deamar ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad
Vechi tema kullah rabbi yehuda uvifrate savar lah kerabbi shimon umi savar lah

Vehatanya ze hakkelal kalal eno chayyav ella achat parat chayyav al kol achat veachat divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer shevua lo lach lo lach lo lach chayyav al kol achat veachat rabbi eliezer omer lo lach lo lach lo lach velo lach shevua chayyav al kol achat veachat rabbi shimon omer leolam eno chayyav ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad
Ella kullah rabbi shimon hi uvishlichut savar lah kerabbi yehuda

Rabbi assi la al leve midresha ashkecheh lerabbi zera amar leh may amur haidana be midresha amar leh af ana la ayali rabbi avin hu deayel vaamar chavruta kullah kerabbi yochanan utzvach resh lakish ki cheruchya veyatza vehayeta veleka deashgach beh amar leh rabbi avin bar samcha hu amar leh in kemin yamma letigne hu
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ana la rabbi avin berabbi chiyya vela rabbi avin bar kahana ella rabbi avin setam lemay nafka minah lemirme dideh addideh
Bea mineh rava merav nachman
b: Naara mahu shettaase shaliach lekabbel gitah miyyad balah keyad aviha damya o kachatzar aviha damya keyad aviha damya ma aviyya meshave shaliach af hi name meshavveya shaliach o dilma kachatzar aviha damya vead demate gita lidah la migarsha

Umi mesappeka leh lerava ha vehaamar rava katav get untano beyad avdah yashen umshammarto hare ze get neor eno get neor ammay eno get dehaveya lah chatzer mishtammeret shello ledatah vei salka datach kachatzar aviha damya ki meta gitah lidah name la tigarash dehaveya lah chatzer hammishtammeret shello ledaat aviha
Ella leolam peshita leh dechi yad aviha damya vehachi kamibaya leh mi allima keyad aviha leshauoye ihi shaliach o la amar leh en osa shaliach
Etiveh ketanna sheamra hitkabbel li giti eno get ad sheyyaggia get leyadah ha naara hare ze get hacha bemay askinan besheen lah av

Ha middekatane sefa im amar aviha tze vekabbel get levitti im ratza baal lachazor bo lo yachzor mikkelal deresha bidyesh lah av askinan chassore michassera vehachi katane ketanna sheamra hitkabbel li giti eno get ad sheyyaggia get leyadah ha naara hare ze get bamme devarim amurim kesheen lah av aval yesh lah av veamar aviha tze vekabbel levitti gitah verotze baal lachzor lo yachzor
Itmar ketanna shennitkaddesha shello ledaat aviha amar shemuel tzericha get utzricha meun amar karna devarim bego im get lamma meun im meun lamma get
Amaru leh ha mar ukva uve dineh bechafri afchuha shadderuha lekammeh derav amar lehu haelohim tzericha get utzricha meun vechas leh lezareh deabba bar abba denema hachi
Vetama may amar rav acha bereh derav ika tzericha get shemma nitratztza haav bekidushin tzericha meun shemma lo nitratztza haav bekidushin veyomru en kidushin tofsin baachotah
Amar rav nachman vehu sheshshiddechu
Ulla amar afilu meun enah tzericha af al gav deshidchu man dematne ha la matne ha ika deamri amar ulla ketanna shennitkaddesha shello ledaat aviha afilu meun enah tzericha
Metiv rav kahana vechullan im metu o meanu o nitgarshu o shennimtzeu ayeloniyyot tzarotehen muttarot
Dekaddeshah man ilema dekaddeshah aviha bemeun saggi lah get mealleya baaya ella lav dekaddisha ihi nafshah vekatane devaaya meun
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah kegon shennaasa lah maase yetoma bechayye haav
Metiv rav hamnuna en mochrah likrovim mishshum rabbi elazar amru mochrah likrovim

a: Veshavin shemmochrah almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot hay almana hechi dame ilema dekaddeshah aviha mi matze mezabben lah ha en adam mocher et bitto leshifchut achar ishut ella lav dekaddish ihi nafshah veka kare lah almana
Amar rav amram amar rabbi yitzchak hacha bekidushe yiud vealliba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar maot harishonot lav lekidushin nitnu
Itmar met venafla lifne achiv leyibbum amar rav huna amar rav memaenet lemaamaro veenah memaenet lezikato ketzad asa bah maamar tzericha get utzricha chalitza utzricha meun

Tzericha get shemma nitratztza haav bekidushe sheni tzericha chalitza shemma nitratztza haav bekidushe rishon tzericha meun shemma lo nitratztza haav lo bekidushe rishon velo bekidushe sheni veyomru en kidushin tofsin baachotah

Lo asa bah maamar enah tzericha ella chalitza bilvad may amratte tibe name meun shemma yomru en kidushin tofsin baachotah hakkol yodim achot chalutza derabbanan deamar resh lakish kan shana rabbi achot gerusha middeorayeta achot chalutza middivre sofrim

Hanhu be tere dahao ka shatu chamra tute tzipe bevavel shekal chad minayehu kasa dechamra yehav leh lechavreh amar mikaddesha li berattach livri amar ravina afilu leman deamar chayeshinan shemma nitratztza haav
b: Shemma nitratztza habben la amrinan amri leh rabbanan leravina vedilma shaliach shavveyeh la chatzif inish leshauoye laavuh shaliach vedilma artzoye artzeyah kammeh amar leh rabba bar shimi beferush amar mar dela savar leha derav ushmuel
Hahu gavra dekaddesh bechisha deyarka beshuka amar ravina afilu leman deamar choshshin shemma nitratztza haav hane mile derech kavod aval derech bizzaon la
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina bizzaon demay i bizzaon deyarka i bizzaon deshuka nafka minah dekaddesh bechaspa beshuka o bechisha deyarka beveta may amar leh ide veide derech bizzaon hu
Hahu deamar lekarivay vehi amra lekarivah kefatteh ad daamar lah tehve lekarivah addeachli veshatu ata kariveh beigara vekaddeshah
Amar abbaye ketiv sheerit yisrael lo yaasu avela velo yedabberu chazav rava amar chazaka en adam toreach bisuda umafsidah
May benayehu ika benayehu dela terach

Nitkaddesha ledaat aviha vehalach aviha limdinat hayyam veamda veniset amar rav ochelet bitruma ad sheyyavo aviha vimache rav assi amar enah ochelet shemma yavo aviha vimache venimtzet zara ochelet bitruma lemafrea hava ovada vechash lah rav leha derav assi
Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak umode rav sheim meta eno yorshah oki mamona bechezkat mareh
Nitkaddesha ledaat veniset shello ledaat veaviha kan rav huna amar enah ochelet rav yirmeya bar abba amar ochelet

Rav huna amar enah ochelet vaafilu lerav deamar ochelet hatam hu dela iteh leav aval hacha deiteh leav hay deishtik mirtach ratach rav yirmeya bar abba amar ochelet vaafilu lerav assi deamar enah ochelet hatam hu deshemma yavo aviha vimache aval hacha middishtek itnoche itnecha leh

Nitkaddesha shello ledaat aviha veniset shello ledaat veaviha kan rav huna amar ochelet rav yirmeya bar abba amar enah ochelet amar ulla ha derav huna kachometz lashshinnayim vecheashan laenayim hashta uma hatam dekidushe deorayeta amratte la achla hacha lo kol shekken
