Itmar ketanna shennitkaddesha shello ledaat aviha amar rav ben hi uven aviha yecholin leakkev verav assi amar aviha velo hi etiveh rav huna lerav assi veamri lah chiyya bar rav lerav assi im maen yemaen aviha en li ella aviha hi atzmah minnayin talmud lomar im maen yemaen mikkol makom
Amar lehu rav la tezlu batar ipcha yachel leshannoye lechu kegon sheppitah shello leshum ishut pitah shello leshum ishut kera bae amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lomar shemmeshallem kenas kimfutta
Amar leh rav yosef i hachi hayenu ditnena mahor yimharenna lo leishsha shetztzericha hemennu kidushin veim pitah leshum ishut kidushin lema li amar leh abbaye tzericha kidushin ledaat aviha

Matni haomer leishsha hitkaddeshi li bitmara zo hitkaddeshi li bazo im yesh beachat mehen shave peruta mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet bazo uvazo uvazo im yesh shave peruta bechullan mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet hayeta ochelet rishona rishona enah mekuddeshet ad sheyehe beachat mehen shave peruta
Gema man tena hitkaddeshi hitkaddeshi amar rabba rabbi shimon hi deamar ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad
Bazo uvazo uvazo im yesh bechullan shave peruta ku aheya ilema aresha may irya ochelet afilu minchat name deha hitkaddeshi li bazo kaamar ella assefa
Vaafilu bekammayeta veha milva hi amar rabbi yochanan hare shulchan vahare basar vahare sakkin veen lanu pe leechol
Rav ushmuel amri tarvayehu leolam aresha vela mibaya kaamar la mibaya mannachat dei ika shave peruta in i la la aval ochelet hoil umikarva hanayatah ema gamra umakneya nafshah ka mashma lan
Rabbi amme amar leolam assefa umay ad sheyehe beachat mehen shave peruta ad sheyehe baacharona shave peruta
Amar rava shema minah midderabbi amme telat shema minah hamkaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet ushma minah hamkaddesh bemilva ufruta datah apperuta
b: Ushma minah maot bealma chozrim

Itmar hamkaddesh achoto rav amar maot chozrim ushmuel amar maot mattana rav amar maot chozrim adam yodea sheen kidushin tofsin baachoto vegamar venatan leshum pikkadon velema lah leshum pikkadon savar la mekabbela
Ushmuel savar maot mattana adam yodea sheen kidushin tofsin baachoto vegamar venatan leshum mattana venema lah leshum mattana savar kesifa lah milta
Metiv ravina hammafrish challato kemach enah challa vegazel beyad kohen veammay gazel beyad kohen nema adam yodea sheen mafrishim challa kemach venatan leshem mattana
Shane hatam denafek churba minah zimnin deit leh lechohen pachot mechamesh revaim kemach vehay alesh leh bahade hadade vekasavar nittakkena isato veate lemechlah betivlah
Vehaamratte adam yodea sheen mafrishim challa kemach yodea veeno yodea yodea sheen mafrish challa kemach veeno yodea desavar tamayehu may mishshum tircha dechohen vetircha dechohen achelteh
Vetihve teruma velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha challa mimmakom acher mi la tenan min hannakuv al sheeno nakuv teruma velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma umaaser mimmakom acher
Bitre mane tzaet bechad mana la tzaet
Veibaet ema leolam kohen metzat tzayet vekasavar baal habbayit nittakkena isato veate lemechal betivla
Vehaamratte adam yodea sheen mafrishin challa kemach yodea veeno yodea yodea sheen mafrishin challa kemach veeno yodea desavar tama may mishshum tircha dechohen tircha dechohen kabbelah aleh
Vetihve teruma veyachzor veyitrom mi la tenan mishsheeno nakuv al hannakuv teruma veyachzor veyitrom ha okemna bitre mane tzaet bechad mana la tzaet
Vela tzaet vehatnan hattorem kishut venimtza mara avattiach venimtzet saruach teruma veyachazor veyitrom shane hatam demiddeorayeta teruma mealleya hi

Midderabbi ilay deamar rabbi ilay minnayin lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma shenneemar velo tisu alav chet baharimchem et chelbo im eno kadosh nesiut chet lamma mikkan lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma
Amar rava

a: Lo shanu ella deamar lah bazo uvazo uvazo aval amar lah beellu afilu ochelet name mekuddeshet ki ka achla middenafshah kaachla

Tanya kevateh derava hitkaddeshi li beallon berimmon uveegoz o sheamar lah hitkaddeshi li beellu im yesh bechullan shave peruta mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet bazo uvazo uvazo im yesh bechullam shave peruta mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet bazo netalattu vaachalattu bazo netalattu vaachalattu veod bazo veod bazo enah mekuddeshet ad sheyehe beachat mehen shave peruta

Hay beallon berimmon beegoz hechi dame ilema deamar lah o beallon o berimmon o beegoz im yesh bechullan shave peruta mekuddeshet veha o kaamar veella beallon uvrimmon uveegoz hayenu bazo uvazo uvazo ella lav daamar lah beellu ha middekatane sefa o sheamar lah hitkaddeshi li beellu mikkelal deresha lav beellu askinan
Parushe ka mefaresh hitkaddeshi li beallon berimmon beegoz ketzad kegon deamar lah hitkaddeshi li beellu
Vekatane sefa bazo netalattu vaachalattu im yesh beachat mehem shave peruta mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet
Veilu resha la ka mefalleg ben ochelet lemannachat shema minah kol hecha daamar lah beellu ki ka achla minnafshah ka achla shema minah
Hanicha leman deamar assefa kae umay ad sheyehe beachat mehen shave peruta ad sheyehe baacharona shave peruta hachi name ad sheyehe baacharona shave peruta
Ella lerav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu aresha kae veochelet itztericha leh hacha kelale kachashev perate la ka chashev
Ha manni rabbi hi daamar la shena kezayit kezayit vela shena kezayit uchzayit perata have

Amar rav hamkaddesh bemilve enah mekuddeshet milva lehotzaa nitna nema ketannae hamkaddesh bemilve enah mekuddeshet veyesh omrim mekuddeshet may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar milva lehotzaa nitna umar savar milva lav lehotzaa nitna
Vetisbera ema sefa veshavim bemecher shezze kana i amratte milva lehotzaa nitna bemay kane

Amar rav nachman huna chavrin mokem lah bemile uchre vehacha bemay askinan kegon sheamar lah hitkaddeshi li bemane venimtza mane chaser dinar mar savar kesifa lah milta lemitbeeh umar savar la kesifa lah milta lemitbeeh

Veella ha deamar rabbi elazar hitkaddeshi li bemane venatan lah dinar hare zo mekuddeshet veyashlim lema ketannae amrah lishmateh amri mane chaser dinar kesifa lah milta lemitbeeh mane chaser tishim vatesha la kesifa lah milta lemitbeeh

Metivi haomer leishsha hitkaddeshi li befikkadon sheyyesh li beyadech vehalcha umtzaattu shennignav o sheavad im nishtayyer hemennu shave peruta mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet uvmilva af al pi shello nishtayyer hemennu shave peruta mekuddeshet rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir milva
b: Hare hi kefikkadon ad kan la peligi ella demar savar milva af al gav delo nishtayyer hemenna shave peruta umar savar nishtayyer hemenna shave peruta in vei la nishtayyer hemenna shave peruta la aval dechulle alma mekaddesh bemilva mekuddeshet
Amar leh rava vetisbera ha metaratzta ha meshabbashta hi

Hay pikkadon hechi dame i dekabbil alah achraut hayenu milva i dela kabbil alah achraut i hachi addetane sefa uvmilva af al pi shello nishtayyer hemenna shave peruta mekuddeshet niflog venitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim shello kibbela aleha achraut aval kibbela aleha achraut af al gav delo nishtayyer hemenna shave peruta mekuddeshet
Ella taretz hachi uvmilva af al pi shennishtayyer hemenna shave peruta enah mekuddeshet

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir milva hare hi kefikkadon bemay kamipalgi amar rabba ashkachtinhu lerabbanan beve rav deyatvi vekaamri bemilva birshut bealim lachazara vehu haddin leunsin kamipalgi
Demar savar milva birshut love kayema vehu haddin laonasim umar savar milva birshut bealim kayema vehu haddin laonasim

Veamena lehu laonasim kulle alma la peligi devirshut love kayemi may tama la gara mishsheela ma sheela dehadra beenah chayyav baonasim milva lo kol shekken ella hacha milva birshut bealim lachazara ika benayehu
Veella ha deamar rav huna hashshoel kurdom mechavero bika bo kenao lo bika bo lo kenao lema ketannae amrah lishmateh
La ad kan la peligi ella bemilva dela hadra beenah aval bishela dehadra beenah divre hakkol bika bo in lo bika bo lo kenao

Nema ketannae hitkaddeshi li bishtar chov o shehaya lo milva beyad acherim vehirshah alehem rabbi meir omer mekuddeshet vachachamim omrim enah mekuddeshet hay shetar chov hechi dame ilema shetar chov daacherim hayenu milva beyad acherim ella lav shetar chov didah uvimkaddesh bemilva kamipalgi
Leolam shetar chov daacherim vehacha bemilva bishtar uvmilva al pe ka mipalgi

Bemilva bishtar bemay peligi biflugta derabbi verabbanan kamipalgi detanya otiyyot niknot bimsira divre rabbi vachachamim omrim ben shekkatav velo masar ben shemmasar vela katav lo kana ad sheyyichtov veyimsor
Mar it leh derabbi umar let leh derabbi

Veibaet ema dechulle alma let lehu derabbi vehacha bidrav pappa kamipalgi deamar rav pappa hay man dezaven shetara lechavreh tzarich lemichtav leh keni lach hu vechol shibudeh mar it leh derav pappa umar let leh derav pappa
Veibaet ema dechulle alma it lehu derav pappa vehacha bedishmuel kamipalgi deamar shemuel

a: Hammocher shetar chov lachavero vechazar umchalo machul vaafilu yoresh mochel demar it leh dishmuel umar let leh dishmuel
Veibaet ema dechulle alma it lehu dishmuel vehacha beishsha kamipalgi mar savar ishsha samcha datah memar amra la shavek leh ledidi umachel leh leacharine umar savar ishsha name la samcha datah
Bemilva al pe bemay peligi bidrav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav mane li beyadcha tenehu lifloni bemaamad shelashtan kana
Mar savar ki kaamar rav hane mile befikkadon aval milva la umar savar la shena milva vela shena pikkadon

Nema ketannae hitkaddeshi li bishtar rabbi meir omer enah mekuddeshet verabbi elazar omer mekuddeshet vachachamim omrim shamin et hanneyar im yesh bo shave peruta mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet
Hay shetar hechi dame ilema shetar chov daacherim kashya derabbi meir adderabbi meir ella bishtar chov didah uvimkaddesh bemilva ka mipalgi
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hacha bemay askinan kegon shekkiddeshah bishtar sheen alav edim

Verabbi meir letameh deamar ede chatima karti verabbi elazar letameh deamar ede mesira karti verabbanan mesappeka lehu i kerabbi meir i kerabbi elazar hilkach shamin et hanneyar im yesh bo shave peruta mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet

Veibaet ema kegon shekketavo shello lishmah uvidresh lakish kamipalgi devae resh lakish shetar erusin shekketavo shello lishmah mahu havaya litzia makkeshinan ma yetzia baenan lishmah af havaya name baenan lishmah o dilma havaot lahadade makkeshinan ma havaya dechesef la baenan lishmah af havaya dishtar la baenan lishmah
Batar devayah hadar pashtah veyatza vehayeta makkish havaya litzia mar it leh deresh lakish umar let leh deresh lakish

Vei baet ema dechulle alma it lehu deresh lakish vehacha bemay askinan shekketavo lishmah veshello middatah uviflugta derava veravina verav pappa verav sherevya kamipalgi deitmar ketavo lishmah veshello middatah rava veravina amri mekuddeshet rav pappa verav sherevya amri enah mekuddeshet
Nema kehane tannae detanya ase li shirim nezamim vetabbaot veekkaddesh ani lach kevan sheasaan mekuddeshet divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim enah mekuddeshet ad sheyyaggia mamon leyadah
Hay mamon hechi dame ilema oto mamon mikkelal detanna kamma savar afilu oto mamon name la ella bemay ku mikkaddesha ella lav bemamon acher ushma minah bimkaddesh bemilva kamipalgi
Vesavri dechulle alma yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof vehave milva may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar hamkaddesh bemilva mekuddeshet umar savar hamkaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet
La dechulle alma mekaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet vehacha beyeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof kamipalgi mar savar
b: Enah lischirut ella bassof umar savar yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof

Veibaet ema dechulle alma yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof umkaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet vehacha beumman kona bishvach keli kamipalgi mar savar umman kona bishvach keli umar savar en umman kone bishvach keli

Vei baet ema dechulle alma en umman kona bishvach keli veyeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof umkaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet vehacha bemay askinan kegon shehosif lah nofech mishshello demar savar milva ufruta dateh apperuta umar savar dateh ammilva

Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya bischar sheasiti immach enah mekuddeshet bischar sheeese immach mekuddeshet rabbi natan omer bischar sheeese immach enah mekuddeshet vechol shekken bischar sheasiti immach
Rabbi yehuda hannasi omer beemet amru ben bischar sheasiti ben bischar sheeese immach enah mekuddeshet veim hosif lah nofech mishshello mekuddeshet
Ben tanna kamma lerabbi natan ika benayehu sechirut ben rabbi natan lerabbi yehuda hannasi ika benayehu milva ufruta mar savar milva ufruta dateh ammilva umar savar dateh apperuta

Matni hitkaddeshi li bechos ze shel yayin venimtza shel devash shel devash venimtza shel yayin bedinar ze shel kesef venimtza shel zahav shel zahav venimtza shel kesef al menat sheani ashir venimtza ani ani venimtza ashir enah mekuddeshet rabbi shimon omer im hitah leshevach mekuddeshet

Gema tanu rabbanan hitkaddeshi li bechos ze tane chada bo uvamme shebbetocho vetanya idach bo velo bamme shebbetocho vetanya idach bamme shebbetocho velo bo vela kashya ha bemayya ha bechamra ha betzihara

Im hitah leshevach hare zo mekuddeshet velet leh lerabbi shimon yayin venimtza chometz chometz venimtza yayin shenehem yecholin lachazor bahem alma ika denicha leh bechalla veika denicha leh bechamra hacha name ika nicha leh bechaspa vela nicha leh bedahava

Amar rav shimi bar ashe ashkachteh leabbaye deyatev vekamasbar leh livreh hacha bemay askinan kegon sheamar lishlucho halveni dinar shel kesef velech vekaddesh li ishsha pelonit vehalach vehilva shel zahav mar savar kefeda umar savar mare makom hu lo
I hachi hitkaddeshi li hitkaddeshi lo mibe leh hitah leshevach hitahu leshevach mibe leh nimtza meikara name dezahav hava

Ella amar rava ani vaari shebbachavura targemna targemnuha umannu rabbi chiyya bar avin hacha bemay askinan kegon sheamra hi lishluchah tze vekabbel li kiddushay mippeloni sheamar li hitkaddeshi li bedinar shel kesef vehalach venatan lo dinar shel zahav mar savar kefeda umar savar mare makom hi lo umay nimtza deka tzayir bivlita
Amar abbaye rabbi shimon verabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi elazar kullehu sevira lehu mare makom hu lo rabbi shimon ha daamaran rabban shimon ben gamliel ditnan

a: Get pashut edav mittocho mekushshar edav meachorav pashut shekkatvu edav meachorav umkushshar shekkatvu edav mittocho shenehem pesulim rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer mekushshar shekkatvu edav mittocho kasher sheyyachol laasoto pashut rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hakkol keminhag hammedina

Vehavenan bah vetanna kamma let leh minhag hammedina veamar rav ashe beatra dinhigi befashut vaavad leh mekushshar i name beatra dinhigi bimkushshar vaavad leh pashut kulle alma la peligi devadday kefida
Ki peligi beatra dinhigi ben befashut ben bimkushshar vaamar leh aved li pashut vaazal vaavad leh mekushshar mar savar kefeda umar savar mare makom hu lo
Rabbi elazar ditnan haishsha sheamra hitkabbel li giti mimmakom peloni vekibbel lah gitah mimmakom acher pasul verabbi elazar machshir alma kasavar mara makom hi lo

Amar ulla machaloket beshevach mamon aval beshevach yuchasin divre hakkol enah mekuddeshet may tama mesana derav mikkaray la baena tanya name hachi mode rabbi shimon im hitah lishvach yuchasim enah mekuddeshet
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane al menat sheani kohen venimtza levi levi venimtza kohen natin venimtza mamzer mamzer venimtza natin vela pelig rabbi shimon
Matkef lah mar bar rav ashe ella dekatane al menat sheyyesh li bat o shifcha meguddelet veen lo al menat sheen lo veyesh lo dishvach mamon hu hachi name dela pelig
Ella pelig beresha vehu haddin lesefa hacha name pelig beresha vehu haddin lesefa
Hachi hashta hatam ide veide dishvach mamon pelig beresha vehu haddin besefa hacha dishvach yuchasim hu im ita diflig nitne
Ibaet ema hacha name shevach yuchasim mi savratte may meguddelet gedola mammash may meguddelet gaddelet deamra hi la nicha li deshakla mile minay veazla nadya kamme shivavotay

Tanu rabbanan al menat sheani karyana kevan shekkara shelosha pesukim bevet hakkeneset hare zo mekuddeshet rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyikra vitargem yetargem middateh vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer hamtargem pasuk ketzurato hare ze badday vehammosif alav hare ze mecharef umgaddef ella may targum targum didan
Vehane mile daamar lah karyana aval amar lah kara ana ad dekare orayeta nevie uchtuve bediyyuka
Al menat sheani shone chizkiyya amar halachot verabbi yochanan amar tora
Metivi ezo hi mishna rabbi meir omer halachot rabbi yehuda omer midrash
b: May tora midrash tora vehane mile daamar lah tanena aval amar lah tanna ana ad detane hilcheta sifra vesifre vetosefta

Al menat sheani talmid en omrim keshimon ben azzay uchshimon ben zoma ella kol sheshshoalin oto bechol makom davar echad betalmudo veomro vaafilu bemassechta dechalla al menat sheani chacham en omrim kechachme yavne kerabbi akiva vachaverav ella kol sheshshoalim oto devar chochma bechol makom veomrah

Al menat sheani gibbor en omrim keavner ben ner uchoav ben tzeruya ella kol shechaverav mityarim mimmennu mippene gevurato al menat sheani ashir en omrim kerabbi elazar ben charsom uchrabbi elazar ben azarya ella kol shebbene iro mechabbedim oto mippene oshro
Al menat sheani tzaddik afilu rasha gamur mekuddeshet shemma hirher teshuva bedato al menat sheani rasha afilu tzaddik gamur mekuddeshet shemma hirher devar avoda zara bedato

Asara kabbim chochma yardu laolam tisha natla eretz yisrael veechad kol haolam kullo asara kabbim yofi yardu laolam tisha natla yerushalayim veechad kol haolam kullo asara kabbim ashirut yardu laolam tisha natla romi veechad kol haolam kullo asara kabbim aniyyut yardu laolam tisha natla bavel veechad kol haolam kullo asara kabbim gassut yardu laolam tisha natla elam veechad kol haolam kullo

Vegassut levavel la nechit vehachtiv vaessa enay vaere vehinne shettayim nashim yotzot veruach bechanfehem velahenna chenafayim kechanfe hachasida vetishne et haefa ben haaretz uven hashshamayim vaomar el hammalach haddover bi ana hemma molichot et haefa vayyomer elay livnot la vayit beeretz shinar veamar rabbi yochanan zo chanuppa vegassut haruach sheyyardu levavel
In lehacha nechit veishtarbove hu deishtarbuv lehatam dayeka name dekatane livnot lah bayit shema minah

Ini vehaamar mar siman legassut aniyyut vaaniyyut bevavel hu deika may aniyyut aniyyut detora dichtiv achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah veamar rabbi yochanan zo elam shezzachta lilmod velo zachta lelammed

Asara kabbim gevura yardu laolam tisha natlu parsiyyim vechu asara kabbim kinnim yardu laolam tisha natla maday ku asara kabbim keshafim yardu laolam tisha natla mitzrayim ku asara kabbim negaim yardu laolam tisha natlu chazirim ku asara kabbim zenut yardu laolam tisha natla arviyya ku

Asara kabbim azzut yardu laolam tisha natla meshan ku asara kabbim sicha yardu laolam tisha natlu nashim ku asara kabbim shichrut yardu laolam tisha natlu kushim ku asara kabbim shena yardu laolam tisha natlu avadim veechad natlu kal haolam kullo

Matni al menat sheani kohen venimtza levi levi venimtza kohen natin venimtza mamzer mamzer venimtza natin ben ir venimtza ben kerach ben kerach venimtza ben ir al menat shebbeti karov lammerchatz venimtza rachok rachok venimtza karov

Al menat sheyyesh lo bat o shifcha meguddelet veen lo o al menat sheen lo veyesh lo al menat sheen lo banim veyesh lo o al menat sheyyesh lo veen lo uvchullam af al pi sheamra belibbi haya lehitkaddesh lo af al pi chen enah mekuddeshet vechen hi shehitattu

Gema hahu gavra dezabben lenichseh addata lemisak leeretz yisrael uvidana dezabben la amar vela mide amar rava have devarim shebballev udvarim shebballev enam devarim mena leh lerava ha ilema meha ditnan

a: Yakriv oto melammed shekkofin oto yachol beal korcho talmud lomar lirtzono
Ha ketzad kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani veammay ha belibbeh la nicha leh ella lav mishshum deamrinan devarim shebballev enan devarim vedilma shane hatam daanan sahadi denicha leh bechappara

Ella missefa vechen atta motze begite nashim veshichrure avadim kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani veammay ha belibbeh la nicha leh ella lav mishshum deamrinan devarim shebballev enan devarim vedilma shane hatam mishshum demitzva lishmoa divre chachamim

Ella amar rav yosef mehacha hamkaddesh et haishsha veamar kesavur hayiti shehi kohenet vahare hi leviyya leviyya venimtzet kohenet aniyya vahare hi ashira ashira vahare hi aniyya mekuddeshet mippene shello hitattu veammay ha kaamar kesavur hayiti ella mishshum deamrinan devarim shebballev enan devarim amar leh abbaye dilma shane hatam dilchumra

Ella amar abbaye mehacha bechullam af al pi sheamra belibbi haya lehitkaddesh lo af al pi chen enah mekuddeshet veammay ha kaamra belibbi haya vedilma shane hatam dechevan deatni lav kol keminah deakra leh litnaeh

Ella amar rav chiyya bar avin ovada hava be rav chisda verav chisda be rav huna ufashtuha meha haomer lishlucho have li min hachallon o min haddeloskama vehevi lo af al pi sheamar baal habbayit lo haya li belibbi ella al ze kevan shehevi lo mizze baal habbayit maal veammay ha kaamar belibbi ella lav mishshum deamrinan devarim shebballev enan devarim
Vedilma shane hatam dilmiftar nafsheh mikkorban kaate
Hava leh lememar mezid hava la avid inish dimshave nafsheh rashshia
Hava leh lomar nizkarti ditnan nizkar baal habbayit velo nizkar shaliach shaliach maal
Hahu gavra dezabbeninhu lenichseh addata lemisak leara deyisrael selek vela itdar leh amar rava kol desalek addata lemedar hu veha la itdar leh ika deamri addata lemisak veha selek leh
Hahu gavra dezabbeninhu lenichseh addata lemisak leeretz yisrael lesof la selek amar rav ashe i bae salek ika deamri i bae la salek may benayehu ika benayehu deityelid unsa beorcha
Matni haomer lishlucho tze vekaddesh li ishsha pelonit bemakom peloni vehalach vekiddeshah bemakom acher enah mekuddeshet hare hi bemakom peloni vekiddeshah bemakom acher hare zo mekuddeshet
Gema utnan name gabbe gitin haomer tenu get ze leishti bemakom peloni untano lah bemakom acher pasul hare hi bemakom peloni untano lah bemakom acher kasher

Utzricha dei ashmeinan gabbe kidushin mishshum dilkarovah kaate behay atra rachamu li vela memalleli mile illavay behay atra sanu li memalleli mile illavay aval gabbe gitin dilrachokah kaate emar la ichpat leh
Vei ashmoinan gabbe gerushin behay atra nicha leh denibazze behay atra la nicha leh aval gabbe kidushin ema la ichpat leh tzericha
Matni hamkaddesh et haishsha al menat sheen aleha nedarim venimtzeu aleha nedarim enah mekuddeshet kenasah setam venimtzeu aleha nedarim tetze shello bichtubba
Al menat sheen aleha mumin venimtzeu bah mumin enah mekuddeshet kenasah setam venimtzeu bah mumin tetze shello bichtubba shekkol hammumin happoslin bakkohanim poslin bannashim
Gema utnan name gabbe chetubbot ki hay gavena hacha kidushin itztericha leh tena ketubbot attu kidushin hatam ketubbot itztericha leh tena kidushin attu ketubbot
Matni hamkaddesh shette nashim beshave peruta o ishsha achat befachot mishshave peruta af al pi sheshshalach sivlonot leachar mikkan
b: Enah mekuddeshet shemmechamat kidushin harishonim shalach vechen katan shekkidesh

Gema utzricha dei ashmeinan shave peruta ayede deka nafek mamona mineh tae aval pachot mishshave peruta ema yodea sheen kidushin tofsin befachot mishshave peruta vechi ka meshaddar sivlonot addata dekidushin ka meshaddar

Vei ashmeinan hane tarte mishshum deven peruta lefachot mishshave peruta la kim lehu leinashe aval katan shekkidesh hakkol yodin sheen kidushe katan kelum ema ki ka meshaddar sivlonot addata dekidushe ka meshaddar ka mashma lan

Itmar rav huna amar choshshin lesivlonot vechen amar rabba choshshin lesivlonot amar rabba umotvinan ashshematin af al pi sheshshalach sivlonot leachar mikkan enah mekuddeshet amar leh abbaye hatam kidkatane tama shemmechamat kidushin harishonim shalach
Ika deamri amar rabba mena amena lah kidkatane tama shemmechamat kidushin harishonim shalach hacha hu detae ha bealma hau kidushin
Veabbaye la mibaya kaamar la mibaya bealma dela nechet letorat kidushin kelal ella afilu hacha dinchet letorat kidushin ema hau kidushin ka mashma lan
May have alah amar rav pappa beatra dimkaddeshi vahadar mesabbeli chayeshinan mesabbeli vahadar mekaddeshi la chayeshinan
Mikkodshe vahadar mesabbeli peshita la tzericha derubba mekaddeshi vahadar mesabbeli umiuta mesabbeli vahadar mekaddeshi mahu detema nechush lemiuta ka mashma lan

Bea mineh rav acha bar rav huna merava huchzak shetar ketubba bashshuk mahu amar leh vechi mippene shemmachzik shehuchzak shetar ketubba bashshuk nachzik bah keeshet ish may have alah amar rav ashe beatra dimkaddeshi vahadar katvi ketubba chayeshinan katvi vahadar mekaddeshi la chayeshinan
Mekaddeshi vahadar katvi peshita la tzericha dela shechiach safra mahu detema safra hu deitremi ka mashma lan

Matni hamkaddesh ishsha uvittah o ishsha vaachotah keachat enan mekuddashot umaase bechamesh nashim uvahen shette achaot veliket adam echad kalkalla shel teenim veshellahen hayeta veshel sheviit hayeta veamar hare kullechem mekuddashot li bechalkalla zo vekibla achat mehen al yede kullan veamru chachamim en achaot mekuddashot

Gema menahane mile amar rame bar chama deamar kera ishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror hattora amra beshaa shennaasu tzarot zo lazo lo yehe lo likuchim afilu beachat mehem amar leh rava i hachi hayenu dichtiv venichretu hannefashot haosot mikkerev ammam i kidushin la tafsi bah karet mi michayyav
Ella amar rava kera beze achar ze umatnitin kidrabba deamar rabba kol sheeno beze achar ze afilu bevat achat eno
Gufa amar rabba kol sheeno beze achar ze afilu bevat achat eno etiveh abbaye

a: Hammarbe bammaaser perotav metukkanim umaserotav mekulkalin veammay nema kol sheeno beze achar ze afilu bevat achat eno
Amar leh shane maaser deiteh lachatzaim dei amar tikdosh palga dechitta kadsha
Vahare masar behema deleka lachatzain veleka beze achar ze veamar rava yatzu shenayim baasiri ukraan asiri asiri veachad asar meoravim ze baze
Shane masar behema deiteh betaut ditnan kara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri shelashtan mekuddashin

Hare toda deletah betaut veletah name beze achar ze veitmar toda shennishchata al shemonim challot chizkiyya amar kadshi lah arbaim mittoch shemonim verabbi yochanan amar la kadshi lah arbaim mittoch shemonim
Lav itmar alah amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hakkol modim kol hecha deamar kadshi lah arbaim mittoch shemonim kadshi lo yikdeshu arbaim ella im ken kadshi shemonim la kadshi
Lo nechleku ella bistam mar savar leachraut ka mikavan umar savar lekorban gadol ka mikavan
Verava lema leh leshannoye kerabba tipok leh kidushin sheen mesurin levia ninhu
Lidvarav derame bar chama kaamar

Itmar kidushin sheen mesurin levia abbaye amar hau kidushin rava amar la hau kidushin amar rava bar ahina asberah li ki yikkach ish ishsha uvalah kidushin hamsurin levia hau kidushin kidushin sheen mesurin levia la hau kidushin
Tenan hamkaddesh ishsha uvittah o ishsha vaachotah keachat enan mekuddashot ha achat meishsha uvittah o meishsha vaachotah mekuddeshet veammay kidushin sheen mesurin levia ninhu teuvta derava

Amar lach rava ultamach ema sefa maase bechamesh nashim uvahen shette achaot veliket echad kalkalla shel teenim veshellahen hayeta veshel sheviit hayeta veamar hare kullechem mekuddashot li bechalkalla zo veamru chachamim en achaot mekuddashot achaot hu deenan mekuddashot ha nachriyyot mekuddashot
Hechi dame ilema deamar kullechem keni atte vachamor hu veatte vachamor lo kana
b: Ella lav daamar lehu achat mikkem vekatane en achaot mekuddashot lerava kashya resha leabbaye kashya sefa abbaye metaretz letameh rava metaretz letameh
Abbaye metaretz letameh hamkaddesh ishsha uvittah o ishsha vaachotah keachat enan mekuddashot ha achat meishsha uvittah meishsha vaachotah mekuddeshet

Veim amar haruya levia titkaddesh li enah mekuddeshet umaase name bechamesh nashim uvahen shette achaot veliket echad kalkalla shel teenim veamar haruya li mikkem titkaddesh li veamru chachamim en achaot mekuddashot

Verava metaretz letameh hamkaddesh achat meishsha uvittah o achat meishsha vaachotah naasa kemi shekkidesh ishsha uvittah o ishsha vaachotah keachat veenan mekuddashot umaase name bechamesh nashim uvahem shette achaot veliket echad kalkalla shel teenim veamar hare kullechem veachat mishte achaot mekuddashot li bechalkalla zo veamru chachamim en achaot mekuddashot
Ta shema hamkaddesh et bitto setam en habbogrot bakkelal ha ketannot bakkelal veammay kidushin sheen mesurin levia ninhu utuvta derava
Amar lach rava hacha bemay askinan kesheen sham ella gedola uktanna
Ha bogrot katane may bogrot bogrot dealma i hachi may lememra
Hacha bemay askinan deshaviteh shaliach mahu detema ki mekabbel kidushe addatah didah ka mekabbel ka mashma lan dela shavek inish mide deit leh hanaa mineh
Mi la askinan deamra leh kidushay ledidach afilu hachi la shavek inish mitzva deramya aleh veaved mitzva dela ramya aleh

Ta shema mi sheyyesh lo shette kitte vanot mishte nashim veamar kidashti et bitti haggedola veeni yodea im gedola shebbaggedolot veim gedola shebbakketannot im ketanna shebbaggedolot shehi gedola min haggedola shebbakketannot kullan asurot chutz mikketanna shebbakketannot divre rabbi meir
Hacha bemay askinan keshehukkeru ulvassof nitarvu dayeka name dekatane eni yodea vela katane en yadua shema minah
I hachi may lememra leappoke midderabbi yose deamar la machet inish nafsheh lisfeka ka mashma lan demachet inish nafsheh lisfeka
Ta shema mi shekkidesh achat mishte achaot veeno yodea ezo kidesh noten get lazo veget lazo hacha bemay askinan keshehukkeru ulvassof nitarvu dayeka name dekatane eno yodea vela katane eno yadua
I hachi may lememra sefa itztericha leh met velo ach echad choletz lishtehen hau lo shenayim echad choletz veechad meyabem im kadmu vechansu en motziin otam miyyadam
Daveka michlatz vahadar yabbome aval yabbome vahadar michlatz la deka paga baachot zekukato

Ta shema shenayim shekkiddeshu shette achaot ze eno yodea ezo kidesh veze eno yodea ezo kidesh ze noten shene gittin veze noten shene gittin hacha name shehukkeru ulvassof nitarvu dayeka name dekatane eno yodea vela katane en yadua shema minah
I hachi may lememra sefa itztericha leh met velaze ach velaze ach ze choletz lishtehen veze choletz lishtehen laze echad velaze shenayim

a: Haechad choletz lishtehen vehashshenayim echad choletz veechad meyabbem im kadmu vechansu en motziin otan miyyadam
Daveka michlatz vahadar yabbome aval yabbome vahadar michlatz la deka paga bivama lashshuk

Ta shema detane tavome leze chamishsha banim ulze chamishsha banot veamar achat mibbenotecha mekuddeshet leechad mibbanay kol achat veachat tzericha chamishsha gitin met echad mehem kol achat veachat tzericha arbaa gitin vachalitza meechad mehen
Vechi tema hachi name keshehukkeru ulvassof nitarvu ha achat mibbenotecha leechad mibbanay katane teuvta derava teuvta vehilcheta keoteh deabbaye beyaal kagam
Maase bechamesh nashim amar rav shema minah mimmatnitin arba venaket rav bideh telat

Shema minah hamkaddesh beferot sheviit mekuddeshet ushma minah kidshah begazel enah mekuddeshet afilu begazel didah mimmay middekatane shellahem hayeta veshel sheviit hayeta tama dishviit dehefker hu ha dishar shene shavua la
Ushma minah ishsha naaset shaliach lachavertah vaafilu bimkom shennaaset lah tzara
Veidach may hi kidushin sheen mesurim levia venichshevah mishshum dimsappeka leh i keabbaye i kerava

Ki selek rabbi zera amrah leha shemata kammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh mi amar rav hachi vehu la amar vehaamar rabbi yochanan gazal velo nityaashu habbealim shenehem enam yecholim lehakdish ze lefi sheeno shello veze lefi sheeno birshuto hachi kaamar leh mi amar rav keoti
Metivi kidshah begazel bechamas uvigneva o shechataf sela miyyadah vekiddeshah mekuddeshet hatam begazel didah
Ha middekatane sefa o shechataf sela mishshellah mikkelal deresha begazel dealma askinan parushe ka mefaresh kidshah begazel bechamas uvigneva ketzad kegon shechataf sela miyyadah vekiddeshah bo
b: Veha matnitin degazel didah vekaamar rav enah mekuddeshet la kashya ha deshaddech ha dela shaddech

Hahi itta dahava ka mashya kara bimshichla demayya ata hahu gavra chataf zuze mechavreh ushda lah amar lah mikaddeshatte li ata hahu gavra lekammeh derava amar let dechash leha derabbi shimon deamar setam gezela yeush bealim have
Hahu arisa dekaddesh bemoza deshamche ata lekammeh derava amar leh man achalach vehane mile bemoza aval kisha matze amar leh ana shekali kisha shekel atte kisha kisha ki chisha
Hahu serasya dekaddesh bifruma deshichra ata mareh deshichra ashkecheh amar leh ammay la titev mehay charifa ata lekammeh derava amar lo amru kelach etzel yafot ella leinyan teruma bilvad
Detanya ketzad amru torem shello middaat terumato teruma hare sheyyarad letoch sede chavero veliket vetaram shello birshut im choshesh mishshum gazel en terumato teruma veim lav terumato teruma

Uminnayin haya yodea im choshesh mishshum gazel im lav hare shebba baal habbayit umtzao veamar lo kelach etzel yafot im nimtzeu yafot mehem terumato teruma veim lav en terumato teruma hau habbealim melakketim umosifim ben kach uven kach terumato teruma
Aval hacha mishshum kisufa hu daavad veenah mekuddeshet
Matni hamkaddesh bechelko ben kodshe kodashim ben kodashim kallim enah mekuddeshet bemaaser sheni ben shogeg ben mezid lo kidesh divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer beshogeg lo kidesh bemezid kidesh
Uvahekdesh bemezid kidesh uvshogeg lo kidesh divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer beshogeg kidesh bemezid lo kidesh
Gema nema matnitin dela kerabbi yose haggelili detanya umaala maal ba lerabbot kodashim kallim shehen mamono divre rabbi yose haggelili
Afilu tema rabbi yose haggelili ki kaamar rabbi yose haggelili mechayyim aval leachar shechita la may tama ki ka zachu mishshulchan gavoha ka zachu
Dayeka name dekatane hamkaddesh bechelko ben kodshe kodashim uven kodashim kallim lo kidesh shema minah

Tanu rabbanan leachar petirato shel rabbi meir amar lahem rabbi yehuda letalmidav al yikkansu talmide rabbi meir lechan mippene shekkanteranim hem velo lilmod tora hem baim ella lekappecheni bahalachot hem baim dachak somchos venichnas amar lahem kach shana li rabbi meir hamkaddesh bechelko ben kodshe kodashim uven kodashim kallim lo kidesh

Kaas rabbi yehuda alehem amar lahem lo kach amarti lachem al yikkansu mittalmide rabbi meir lechan mippene shekkanteranim hem velo lilmod tora hem baim ella lekappecheni bahalachot hem baim vechi ishsha baazara minnayin

Amar rabbi yose yomru meir shachav yehuda kaas yose shatak divre tora ma tehe aleha vechi en adam asuy lekabbel kidushin levitto baazara veen ishsha asuya laasot lah shaliach lekabbel kidusheha baazara veod dachaka venichnesa may

Tanya rabbi yehuda omer mekuddeshet rabbi yose omer enah mekuddeshet amar rabbi yochanan shenehem mikra echad darshu ze yihye lecha mikkodesh hakkodashim min haesh rabbi yehuda savar lecha ulchol tzerachecha verabbi yose savar keesh ma esh laachila af hu name laachila
Amar rabbi yochanan

a: Nimnu vegamru hamkaddesh bechelko ben kodshe kodashim uven kodashim kallim lo kidesh verav amar adayin hi machloket amar abbaye keoteh derabbi yochanan mistabbera
Detanya minnayin sheen cholkim menachot keneged zevachim talmud lomar vechol mincha asher teafe battannur lechol bene aharon tihye

Yachol lo yachleku menachot keneged zevachim shello kamu tachtehem bedallut aval yachleku menachot keneged ofot shehare kamu tachtehen bedallut talmud lomar vechol naasa vammarcheshet lechol bene aharon tihye
Yachol lo yachleku menachot keneged ofot shehallalu mine damim vehallalu mine kemachim aval yachleku ofot keneged zevachim shehallalu vehallalu mine damim talmud lomar veal machavat

Yachol lo yachleku ofot keneged zevachim shehallalu maasehem bayyad vehallalu maasehem bichli aval yachleku menachot keneged menachot shehallalu vehallalu maasehem bayyad talmud lomar vechol mincha velula vashshemen lechol bene aharon

Yachol lo yachleku machavat keneged marcheshet umarcheshet keneged machavat shezzo maaseha rakkim vezo maaseha kashim aval yachleku machavat keneged machavat umarcheshet keneged marcheshet shehallalu vehallalu maasehem kashim i name maasehem rakkim talmud lomar vachareva lechol bene aharon tihye
Yachol lo yachleku bekodshe kadashim aval yachleku bekadashim kallim talmud lomar ish keachiv usmich leh im al toda keshem sheen cholkin bekodshe kodashim kach en cholkim bekadashim kallim
Ish ish cholek afilu baal mum veen hakkatan cholek vaafilu tam setam sifra manni rabbi yehuda vehu kaamar delet bah din chalukah kelal shema minah

Amar rava uchrav mi la tanya vehatanya hatztzenuim moshchin et yedehem vehaggargeranim cholkim may cholkim chotfim kidkatane sefa maase beechad shechataf chelko vechelek chavero vehau korin oto ben chamtzan ad yom moto
Amar rabba bar rav shela may keraa elohay palleteni miyyad rasha mikkaf meavel vechometz rabba amar mehacha limdu hetev dirshu mishpat ashsheru chamotz

Maaser sheni ben beshogeg ben bemezid lo kidesh divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer shogeg lo kidesh mezid kidesh vechu mena hane mile amar rav acha bereh derava mishshemeh digmara vechol masar haaretz mizzera haaretz mipperi haetz la hu kodesh la la hu velo lekaddesh bo ishsha
Hare terumat maaser dichtiv ken tarimu gam attem terumat Adonai utnan hamkaddesh bitruma mekuddeshet dela ketiv beh la
Vahare challa dichtiv bah tittenu la utnan hamkaddesh bitrumot mekuddeshet dela ketiv bah kodesh
Vahare sheviit dichtiv bah yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem utnan hamkaddesh beferot sheviit mekuddeshet dela ketiv bah la
Vahare teruma dichtiv kodesh yisrael la reshit tevuato utnan hamkaddesh bitruma mekuddeshet hahu beyisrael ketiv
b: Velav mimmela shamatte minah targemah ravin sava kammeh derav amar kera hu bahavayato yehe

Uvahekdesh bemezid kidesh beshogeg lo kidesh divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer beshogeg kidesh bemezid lo kidesh amar rabbi yaakov shemait mineh derabbi yochanan tarte shiggat maaser derabbi yehuda shiggat hekdesh derabbi meir shenehem en ishsha mitkaddeshet bahem

Chada lefi sheen ishsha rotza vachada lefi sheen shenehem rotzim vela yadana he minayehu amar rabbi yirmeya nichze anan maaser ihi la nicha lah mishshum tircha deorcha ihu nicha leh denikne itta mimmela ella hekdesh tarvayehu la nicha lehu denittachil hekdesh al yedayehu

Verabbi yaakov amar ipcha mistabbera mi la ika lememar maaser ihi la nicha lah mishshum tircha deorcha ihu la nicha leh mishshum unsa deorcha ella hekdesh bishlama ihi la nicha lah denittachil hekdesh al yedah ella ihu mi la nicha leh denikne itta mimmela
Bea mineh rava merav chisda ishsha en mitkaddeshet maot mahu sheyyetzu lechullin amar leh ishsha en mitkaddeshet maot heach yetzu lechullin
Bea mineh rav chiyya bar avin merav chisda bemecher may amar leh af bemecher lo kana
Etiveh chenvani kevaal habbayit divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer chenvani keshulchani

Ad kan la ka mipalgi ella demar savar chenvani keshulchani umar savar chenvani kevaal habbayit aval dechulle alma im hotzi maal rabbi meir lidvarav derabbi yehuda kaamar ledidi im hotzi name lo maal ella ledidach odi li miha dechenvani kevaal habbayit vaamar leh la keshulchani
Amar rav

a: Chazarnu al kol tzedadim shel rabbi meir velo matzinu hekdesh beshogeg en mitchallel bemezid mitchallel
Umishnatenu bechotnot kehunna shello balu hoil venitnu lehanot bahen lefi shello nitna tora lemalache hashsharet
Ta shema kotnot kehunna shebbalu moalin bahem divre rabbi meir may lav afilu lo balu la balu daveka
Ta shema moalim bechadtin veen moalim beattikim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer moalin af beattikim shehaya rabbi meir omer moalin bishyare hallishka

Veammay nema hoil venitnu lehanot lefi shello nitna tora lemalache hashsharet deha chomat hair umigdeloteha mishsheyare hallishka atu ditnan chomat hair umigdeloteha vechol tzorche hair bain mishsheyare hallishka la tema rabbi meir ella ema rabbi yehuda
Ta shema detanya amar rabbi yishmael bar rabbi yitzchak avne yerushalayim shennashru moalim bahem divre rabbi meir la tema rabbi meir ella ema rabbi yehuda
I rabbi yehuda yerushalayim mi mikaddesha vehatnan keimra kaddirim kaetzim kaishim kahechal kammizbeach kirushalayim rabbi yehuda omer kol haomer yerushalayim lo amar kelum
Vechi tema mishshum delo amar kirushalayim vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer kol haomer kirushalayim lo amar kelum ad sheyyiddor bedavar hakkarev birushalayim
b: Tere tannae ninhu vealliba derabbi yehuda

Amar ulla mishshemeh devar peda omer haya rabbi meir hekdesh bemezid mitchallel beshogeg en mitchallel velo amru beshogeg mitchallel ella leinyan korban bilvad vechi meachar deen mitchallel korban bemay michayyav
Ella ki ata ravin paresh mishshemeh devar peda omer haya rabbi meir hekdesh bemezid mitchallel beshogeg en mitchallel velo amru beshogeg mitchallel ella leinyan achila bilvad
Amar rav nachman amar rav adda bar ahava halacha kerabbi meir bemaaser hoil ustam lan tena kevateh vahalacha kerabbi yehuda behekdesh hoil ustam lan tena kevateh
Kerabbi meir bemaaser may hi ditnan kerem revai bet shammay omrim en lo chomesh veen lo biur uvet hillel omrim yesh lo
Bet shammay omrim yesh lo peret veyesh lo olelot uvet hillel omrim kullo laggat
May tama devet hillel gamri kodesh kodesh mimmaaser ma maaser yesh lo chomesh veyesh lo biur af kerem revai yesh lo chomesh veyesh lo biur uvet shammay la gamri kodesh kodesh mimmaaser
Uvet hillel omrim kemaaser keman sevira lehu i kerabbi yehuda ammay kullo laggat haamar maaser mamon hedot hu ella lav kerabbi meir
Kerabbi yehuda behekdesh may hi ditnan shilach beyad pikeach venizkar ad shello higgia etzel chenoni chenoni maal lichsheyyotzi

Uchrabbi yehuda bemaaser mi la tenan vehatnan happode maaser sheni shello mosif alav chamishito ben mishshello ben shennitan lo bemattana manni ilema rabbi meir hi mi matze yahev leh bemattana vehaamar maaser mamon gavoha hu ella lav rabbi yehuda
La leolam rabbi meir vehacha bemay askinan kegon deyahev nihaleh betivleh vekasavar mattanot shello hurmu kemi shello hurmu damyan
Ta shema happode neta revai shello mosif alav chamishito ben mishshello ben shennitan lo bemattana manni ilema rabbi meir mi matze yahev leh veha gamri kodesh kodesh mimmaaser ella lav rabbi yehuda
Leolam rabbi meir vehacha bemay askinan kegon deyahev keshehu semadar udla kerabbi yose deamar semadar asur mippene shehu peri

Ta shema mashach hemennu maaser besela velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad bishtayim noten sela umistakker besela umaaser sheni shello manni ilema rabbi meir ammay mistakker besela venatan et hakkesef vekam lo amar rachamana ella lav rabbi yehuda
Leolam rabbi yehuda vehacha chad setama vehacha tere setame
Vei setama daveka ma li chad setama ma li tere setame amar rav nachman bar yitzchak halacha kerabbi meir hoil utnan bivchirata keoteh

a: Tenan hatam behema shennimtzet mirushalayim lemigdal eder uchmiddatah lechol ruach zecharim olot nekevot zivche shelamim
Ella zecharim olot hu dehau zivche shelamim la hau amar rabbi oshaya hacha bava lachuv bidmehen askinan vehachi kaamar chayeshinan shemma olot verabbi meir hi deamar hekdesh bemezid mitchallel
Ukdushshat hagguf mi mitchallel vehatnan en moel achar moel bemukdashin ella bivhema uvichli sharet bilvad

Ketzad haya rochev al gabbe behema ba chavero verachav ba chavero verachav kullam maalu haya shote bechos shel zahav ba chavero veshata ba chavero veshata kullam maalu hahi rabbi yehuda hi ha rabbi meir

Midderabbi yehuda nishma lerabbi meir lav amar rabbi yehuda hekdesh beshogeg mitchallel ukdushshat hagguf la mittachala lerabbi meir name af al gav dehekdesh bemezid mitchallel kedushshat hagguf la mittachala hatam la ka mechaven leappokinhu lechullin hacha ka mechaven leappokinhu lechullin

Emar deshamatte leh lerabbi meir bekodshe kodashim bekadashim kallim mi shamatte leh amar leh hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh kal vachomer kodshe kodashim mitchallelim kodashim kallim lo kol shekken

Itmar name amar rabbi chama berabbi akiva amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina omer haya rabbi meir hekdesh bemezid mitchallel beshogeg en mitchallel echad kodshe kodashim veechad kodashim kallim kal vachomer kodshe kodashim mitchallelim kodashim kallim lo kol shekken
b: Tahe bah rabbi yochanan vechi omrim lo laadam amod vachata bishvil shettizke ella amar rabbi yochanan mamtin lah ad shettumam umayete shette behemot umatne
Amar mar zecharim olot dilma toda hi demayete name toda veha baaya lechem demayete name lechem
Vedilma asham hu asham ben shette shanim veishtechach ben shana vedilma asham metzora hu asham nazir hu la shechichi
Vedilma pesach hu pesach bizmanno mizhar zehiri beh veshello bizmanno shelamim hu
Vedilma bechor umaaser ninhu lemay hilcheta lemechlinhu bemuman hachi name bemuman mitachli
Amar mar nekevot zivche shelamim dilma toda hi demayete toda veha baaya lechem demayete name lechem
Vedilma chattat hi chattat bat shenatah veishtechach bat shette shanim vedilma chattat sheavra shenatah la shechiach
Ishtechach bat shenatah may tanya chananya ben chachinay omer ez bat shenatah lechattat lechattat salka datach ella amar abbaye kechattat konsah lechipa vehi meta meeleha
Tanu rabbanan en lokchim behema bimot maaser sheni

a: Veim lakach beshogeg yachzeru damim limkomam bemezid taale veteachel bammakom amar rabbi yehuda bamme devarim amurim bemitkaven velakach techila leshem shelamim aval bemitkaven lehotzi meot maaser sheni lechullin ben shogeg ben mezid yachzeru damim limkomam
Vehaanan tenan rabbi yehuda omer bemezid kidesh amar rabbi elazar ishsha yodaat sheen meot maaser sheni mitchallelin al yadah veola veochalto birushalayim

Matkef lah rabbi yirmeya vahare behema temea avadim vekarkaot deadam yodea sheen meot maaser sheni mitchallelin alehen utnan en lokchim behema temea avadim vekarkaot bimot maaser sheni afilu birushalayim veim lakach yochal kenegdan
Ella hacha beishsha chavera askinan deyada
Amar mar im lakach yochal kenegdan veammay yachzeru damav limkomam ki hatam
Amar shemuel
b: Keshebbarach vetama devarach ha lo barach kansinan lemocher venikneseh lelokeach lav achbera gannav ella chora gannav
Vei la achbera chora may kaaved mistabbera kol hecha deika isura hatam kansinan

Matni hamkaddesh beorla bechile hakkerem beshor hanniskal uvegla arufa betzippore metzora uvisar nazir ufeter chamor uvasar bechalav vechullin shennishchatu baazara enah mekuddeshet mecharan vekidesh bidmehen mekuddeshet
Gema beorla menalan detanya arelim lo yeachel en li ella isur achila hanaa minnayin shello yehane mimmennu velo yitzba bo velo yadlik bo et hanner talmud lomar vaaraltem et orlato lerabbot et kullam
Bechile hakkerem menalan amar chizkiyya amar kera pen tikdash pen tukad esh
Rav ashe amar pen yihye kodesh i ma kodesh tofes et damav veotze lechullin af kile hakkerem tofes et damav veotze lechullin ella mechavarta kidchizkiyya

Shor hanniskal minnayin detanya mimmashma shenneemar sakol yissakel hashshor eni yodea shennevela hi unvela asura baachila ma talmud lomar lo yeachel et besaro maggid lach sheim shechato leachar shennigmar dino asur baachila
Bahanaa minnayin talmud lomar uvaal hashshor naki may mashma shimon ben zoma omer keadam sheomer lachavero yatza peloni naki minnechasav veen lo bahem hanaa shel kelum

Mimmay dehay lo yeachel et besaro lehecha deshachet leachar shennigmar dino hu daata dilma hecha deshachet leachar shennigmar dino shere veha lo yeachel hecha desakleh miskal hu daata vechidrabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar
Deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar kol makom shenneemar lo yochal lo tochal velo tochlu echad isur achila veechad isur hanaa ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv kederech shepparat lecha binvela
Hane mile hecha denafka lan isur achila millo yochal hacha isur achila missakol yissakel nafka dei salka datach leisur hanaa hu dichtiv nichtov kera lo yehane
I name lo yeachel et besaro lema li af al gav deshachteh keen basar asur

Matkef lah mar zutra veema hane mile hecha devadak tzur veshachat bah demichaze kiskila aval shachteh besakkin la mide sakkin beorayeta ketiv veod tanya bakkol shochatin ben betzor ben bizchuchit ben bikrumit shel kane
Vehashta denafka lan isur achila veisur hanaa tarvayehu millo yeachel hay baal hashshor naki lemay ata lahanaat oro salka datach amena lo yeachel et besaro ketiv besaro asur veoro muttar
Ulhanach tannae demappeki leh hay baal hashshor naki lachatzi kofer velidme valdot hanaat oro mena lehu
Meet besaro et hattafel livsaro veidach

a: Et la daresh kidtanya shimon haamsoni veamri lah nechemya haamsoni haya doresh kol ettin shebbattora kevan shehiggia leet Adonai elohecha tira perash

Amru lo talmidav rabbi kol ettin sheddarashta ma tehe alehem amar lahem keshem shekkibbalti sachar al hadderisha kach kibbalti al happerisha ad shebba rabbi akiva velimed et Adonai elohecha tira lerabbot talmide chachamim
Beegla arufa menalan amri deve rabbi yannay kappara ketiv bah kekadashim
Tzipore metzora menalan detana deve rabbi yishmael neemar machshir umchapper mibbifnim veneemar machshir umchapper mibbachutz
Ma machshir umchapper haamur bifnim asa bo machshir kimchapper af machshir umchapper haamur bachutz asa bo machshir kimchapper

Itmar tzipore metzora meematay asurim rabbi yochanan amar mishsheat shechita veresh lakish amar mishsheat lekicha rabbi yochanan amar mishsheat shechita shechita hu deasra lah resh lakish amar mishsheat lekicha meegla arufa nafka ma egla arufa mechayyim af tzipore metzora mechayyim

Veegla arufa gufah meematay amar rabbi yannay gevul shamati bah veshachachti venasvin chavrayya lomar yeridatah lenachal etan hi osartah i ma egla arufa mishsheat lekicha la mitasra af tzipore metzora name mishsheat lekicha la mitasri hachi hashta hatam it leh gevul acharina hacha mi it leh gevul acharina

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish kol tzippor tehora tochelu lerabbot et hamshullachat veze asher lo tochlu mehem lerabbot et hashshechuta vei salka datach mechayyim asura leachar shechita mibaya mahu detema mide dehave akkodashim demechayyim asiri veatya shechita umachshera lehu ka mashma lan

Etiveh shechatah venimtzet terefa yikkach zug lashsheniyya veharishona mutteret bahanaa vei salka datach mechayyim asura harishona ammay mutteret bahanaa amar leh hacha bemay askinan kegon shennimtzet terefa bivne meeha dela chal alah kedushsha kelal
Etiveh shechatah shello beezov veshello beetz erez veshello bishni tolaat rabbi yaakov omer hoil vehuktza lemitzvatah asura rabbi shimon omer hoil venishchata shello kemitzvatah mutteret
Ad kan la peligi ella mar savar shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita umar savar shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita dechulle alma miha mechayyim la mitasra
Tannae hi detana deve rabbi yishmael neemar machshir umchapper mibbifnim veneemar machshir umchapper bachutz
Ma machshir umchapper haamur bifnim asa bo machshir kimchapper af machshir umchapper haamur bachutz asa bo machshir kimchapper
Gufa kal tzippor tehora tochelu lerabbot et hamshullachat veze asher lo tochlu mehem lerabbot et hashshechuta
Veefoch ana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay lo matzinu baale chayyim sheasurim matkef lah rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak vela hare
b: Muktze veneevad devaale chayyim ninhu vaasiri ki asiri legavoha lehedot mishre shere
Matkef lah rabbi yirmeya hare rovea venirba beedim devaale chayyim ninhu vaasiri ella amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay lo matzinu rov baale chayyim sheasurim

Deve rabbi yishmael tana deamar kera veshillach al pene hassade kesade ma sade mutteret af hay name mutteret hay sade lehachi hu daata hahu mibe leh lechidtanya sade shello yaamod beyafo veyizrekenna layyam bigvat veyizrekenna lammidbar veshello yaamod chutz lair veyizrekenna betoch hair ella kol sheomed bair veyizrekenna chutz lachoma
Veidach im ken nichtov kera sade may hassade shema minah tarte
Rava amar lo amra tora shallach letakkala
Bisar nazir menalan deamar kera kadosh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho gidulo yihye kadosh
I ma kodesh tofes et damav veotze lechullin af sear nazir tofes et damav veotze lechullin mi karenan kodesh kadosh karenan
Befeter chamor nema matnitin dela kerabbi shimon detanya peter chamor asur bahanaa divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon mattir amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh leachar arifa vedivre hakkol
Basar bechalav menalan detana deve rabbi yishmael lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo shalosh peamim echad isur achila veechad isur hanaa veechad isur bishul

Matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer basar bechalav asur baachila umuttar bahanaa shenneemar ki am kadosh atta la elohecha lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo ulhallan hu omer veanshe kodesh tihun li ma lehallan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa af kan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa
Vechullin shennishchatu baazara mena hane mile amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir amra tora shechot li beshelli veshellach beshellach ma shelli beshellach asur af shellach beshelli asur

I ma shelli beshellach anush karet af shellach beshelli anush karet amar kera veel petach ohel moed lo hevio lehakriv korban la venichrat al korban anush karet al chullin shennishchatu baazara en anush karet
Ika lemifrach ma leshelli beshellach shekken anush karet
Ella amar abbaye mehacha ushchato veshachat oto veshachat oto telata kerae yattire ma talmud lomar
Lefi shenneemar ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom vezavachta berichuk makom atta zoveach vei atta zoveach bemakom karov perat lechullin shello yishshachatu baazara

Veen li ella temimim haruyim likarev minnayin lerabbot baale mumin merabbe ani et baale mumim shekken min hammachshir minnayin lerabbot et hachayya merabbe ani et hachayya shehi bishchita kivhema minnayin lerabbot et haofot talmud lomar ushchato veshachat oto veshachat oto

Yachol lo yishchot veim shachat yehe muttar talmud lomar ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom vezavachta veachalta ma sheatta zoveach berichuk makom atta ochel vei atta ochel ma sheatta zoveach bemakom karov perat lechullin shennishchatu baazara
Veen li ella temimim

a: Haruyim likrav minnayin lerabbot baale mumin merabbe ani baale mumin shekken min hammachshir uminnayin lerabbot et hachayya merabbe ani et hachayya shehi bishchita kivhema minnayin lerabbot et haofot talmud lomar ushchato veshachat oto veshachat oto
Yachol lo yishchot veim shachat yashlichennu lifne chelavim talmud lomar lakkelev tashlichun oto oto atta mashlich lakkelev vei atta mashlich chullin shennishchatu baazara

Ashkechinhu mar yehuda lerav yosef ulrav shemuel bereh derabba bar bar chana dahao kayemi appitcha deve rabba amar lehu tanya hamkaddesh befeter chamor bevasar bechalav uvchullin shennishchatu baazara rabbi shimon omer mekuddeshet vachachamim omrim enah mekuddeshet alma chullin shennishchatu baazara lerabbi shimon lav deorayeta
Urminhu rabbi shimon omer chullin shennishchatu baazara yissarfu vechen chayya shennishchata baazara ishtiku
Ato lekammeh derabba amar lehu palgaa okminchu hacha bemay askinan kegon shennishchata venimtzet terefa verabbi shimon letameh
Detanya hashshochet et hatterefa vechen hashshochet venimtzet terefa ze vaze chullin baazara rabbi shimon mattir bahanaa vachachamim osrim
Mecharan vekidesh bidmehen mekuddeshet menalan middegalli rachamana baavoda zara vehayita cherem kamohu kol sheatta mehayye hemenna hare hu kamohu mikkelal dechol isurim shebbattora sheru
Venelaf minah mishshum dehave avoda zara ushviit shene chetuvim habbaim keechad vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin
Avoda zara ha daamaran sheviit may hi yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem ma kodesh tofes et damav af sheviit tofeset dameha
I ma kodesh tofes et damav veotze lechullin af sheviit tofeset dameha veotza lechullin talmud lomar tihye bahavayatah tehe

Ketzad lakach beferot sheviit basar ellu vaellu mitbaarim bashsheviit babbasar dagim yatza basar nichnesu dagim bedagim yayin yatzu dagim nichnas yayin beyayin shemen yatza yayin nichnas shemen ha ketzad acharon acharon nitpas bashsheviit ufri atzmo asur
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar tere miute ketivi ketiv hacha ki cherem hu uchtiv hatam yovel hi hi in mide acharina la
Matni hamkaddesh bitrumot uvammaasrot uvammattanot uvme chattat uvefer chattat hare zo mekuddeshet vaafilu yisrael
Gema amar ulla tovat hanaa enah mamon etiveh rabbi abba leulla hamkaddesh bitrumot uvmaasrot uvammattanot beme chattat uvefer para hare zo mekuddeshet vaafilu yisrael
Amar leh hacha beyisrael shennaflu lo tevalim mibbet avi immo kohen veka savar mattanot shello hurmu kemi shehurmu damyan

Bea mineh rabbi chiyya bar avin merav huna tovat hanaa mamon o enah mamon amar leh tenetuha hamkaddesh bitrumot uvmaasrot uvmattanot beme chattat uvefer para hare zo mekuddeshet vaafilu yisrael amar leh velav okemna beyisrael shennaflu lo tevalim mibbet avi immo kohen
b: Amar leh hutzaa atte iksif hu savar mishshemata kaamar leh amar leh hachi kaamena rav assi dehutzal kae kevatach

Nema ketannae haggonev tivlo shel chavero meshallem lo deme tivlo shel chavero divre rabbi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer eno meshallem ella deme chullin shebbo may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar tovat hanaa mamon umar savar tovat hanaa enah mamon

La dechulle alma tovat hanaa enah mamon vehacha bitvalim shennaflu lo mibbet avi immo kohen uvmattanot shello hurmu kemi shehurmu damyan kamipalgi mar savar kemi shehurmu damyan umar savar lav kemi shehurmu damyan
Veibaet ema dechulle alma kemi shehurmu damyan vetovat hanaa enah mamon vehacha bedishmuel kamipalgi deamar shemuel chita achat poteret et hakkeri
Demar it leh dishmuel umar let leh dishmuel
Veibaet ema dechulle alma let lehu dishmuel vehacha hayenu tama derabbi dekansuhu rabbanan legannav
Veibaet ema dechulle alma it lehu dishmuel vehacha hayenu tama derabbi yose berabbi yehuda dekansuhu rabbanan levaal habbayit dela ibi leh leshahoyeh letivleh

Tenan hamkaddesh bitrumot uvammaasrot uvammattanot beme chattat uvefer para hare zo mekuddeshet veaf al pi yisrael urminhu hannotel sachar ladun dinav betelim lehaid eduto betela lehazzot ulkaddesh memav me meara veefro efer mikle
Amar abbaye la kashya kan besachar havaa umiluy kan bischar hazzaa vekidush
Dayeka name dekatane hacha beme chattat uvefer para vekatane hatam lehazzot ulkaddesh shema minah
Hadaran alach haish mekaddesh

Haomer lachavero tze vekaddesh li ishsha pelonit vehalach vekiddeshah leatzmo mekuddeshet lashsheni vechen haomer leishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li leachar sheloshim yom uva acher vekidsha betoch sheloshim yom mekuddeshet lishne bat yisrael lechohen tochal bitruma
Meachshav ulachar sheloshim yom uva acher vekidsha betoch sheloshim yom mekuddeshet veenah mekuddeshet bat yisrael lechohen o vat kohen leyisrael lo tochal bitruma
Gema haomer lachavero tze vekaddesh tana ma sheasa asuy ella shennahag bo minhag rammaut vetanna didan halach name dekatane halach berammaut
May shena hacha dekatane haomer lachavero

a: Umay shena hatam dekatane haomer lishlucho

Hacha revuta ka mashma lan vehatam revuta ka mashma lan hacha revuta ka mashma lan dei tena shelucho hava amena shelucho hu dehave rammay desamcha dateh savar aved li shelichutay aval chavero dela samcha dateh ema la leheve rammay
Hatam revuta ka mashma lan dei tena haomer lachavero hava amena chavero hu dechi kiddeshah bemakom acher enah mekuddeshet desavar la tarach aval shelucho detarach ema mare makom hu lo ka mashma lan

Ravin chasida azal lekaddoshe leh itta livreh kadshah lenafsheh vehatanya ma sheasa asuy ella shennahag bo minhag rammaut la yahavuh nihaleh ibi leh leodoe savar addehachi vehachi ata inish acharina mekaddesh lah

Rabba bar bar chana yehav leh zuze lerav amar zivnah nihali lehay ara azal zavnah lenafsheh vehatanya ma sheasa asuy ella shennahag bo minhag rammaut baga deallime hava leh lerav nahagi beh kavod lerabba bar bar chana la nahagi beh kavod ibi leh leodoe sevar addehachi vehachi ata inish acharina zabben lah

Rav gidel hava mehappech behahi ara azal rabbi abba zavnah azal rav gidel kavleh lerabbi zera azal rabbi zera vekavleh lerav yitzchak nappacha amar leh hamten ad sheyyaale etzlenu laregel ki selek ashkecheh amar leh ani mehappech bacharara uva acher untalah hemennu may

Amar leh nikra rasha veella mar may tama avad hachi amar leh la hava yadana hashta name nitvah nihaleh mar amar leh zabbone la mezabbenna lah deara kammayeta hi vela mesammena milta i bae bemattana nishkeleh
Rav gidel la nachet lah dichtiv vesone mattanot yichye rabbi abba la nachet lah mishshum dehappech bah rav gidel la mar nachet lah vela mar nachet lah umitkarya ara derabbanan
Vechen haomer leishsha hitkaddeshi li ku lo ba acher vekidsha betoch sheloshim mahu rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu mekuddeshet veaf al pi shennitakkelu hammaot
May tama hane zuze la lemilva damu vela lefikkadon damu
Lefikkadon la damu pikkadon birshuta demareh ka mitakkeli vehane birshuta didah ka mitakkeli lemalve name la damu milva lehotzaa nitna hane betorat kidushin yahavinhu nihalah
Lo ba acher vekidshah vechazra bah mahu rabbi yochanan amar chozeret ate dibur umvattel dibur resh lakish amar enah chozeret la ate dibur umvattel dibur

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish bitel im ad shello taram bitel en terumato teruma veha hacha dedibur vedibur hu vekaate dibur umvattel dibur shane netinat maot leyad ishsha dechi maase damu vela ate dibur umvattel maase

Hatam name kol kamma dela meta gita lidah dibur vedibur hu ate dibur umvattel dibur
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan kol hakkelim yordin lide tumatan bemachshava veen olim mide tumatan ella beshinuy maase
b: Maase motzi miyyad maase umiyyad machshava machshava en motzia lo miyyad maase velo miyyad machshava bishlama miyyad maase la mappeka dela ate dibur umvattel maase ella miyyad machshava miha tappek
Shane machshava detuma dechi maase dame vechidrav pappa derav pappa rame ketiv ki yitten vekarenan ki yuttan ha ketzad
Ki yuttan dumya dechi yitten ma yitten denicha leh af yuttan denicha leh

Rav zevid matne leha shemateta aha vechen hi shennatna reshut lishluchah lekaddeshah vehalcha hi vekiddeshah et atzmah im shellah kadmu kidusheha kidushin veim shel sheluchah kadmu en kidusheha kidushin

Lo kiddeshah et atzmah vechazra bah mahu rabbi yochanan amar chozeret veresh lakish amar enah chozeret rabbi yochanan amar chozeret ate dibur umvattel dibur resh lakish amar enah chozeret la ate dibur umvattel dibur
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish bitel im ad shello taram bitel en terumato teruma amar rava hacha bemay askinan kegon shekkadam baal habbayit vetaram et kiro dehave leh maase

Amar leh shane machshava detuma dechi maase dame vechidrav pappa derav pappa rame ketiv ki yitten vekarenan ki yuttan ha ketzad ki yuttan dumya dayitten ma yitten denicha leh af yuttan name denicha leh
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish hashsholeach get leishto vehiggia bashshaliach o sheshshalach acharav shaliach veamar lo get shennatatti lecha batel hu hare ze batel teuvta deresh lakish teuvta
Vehilcheta keoteh derabbi yochanan vaafilu bekammayeta veaf al gav deika lememar shane netinat maot leyad ishsha dichmaase dame afilu hachi ate dibur umvattel dibur
Kashya hilcheta ahilcheta amratte hilcheta kerabbi yochanan vekayema lan hilcheta kerav nachman deibaya lehu mahu sheyyachazor vigaresh bo
Rav nachman amar chozer umgaresh bo rav sheshet amar eno chozer umgaresh bo vekayema lan hilcheta kevateh derav nachman nehi devatteleh mittorat sheliach mittorat get la batteleh
Mekuddeshet lashsheni amar rav mekuddeshet lashsheni leolam ushmuel amar mekuddeshet lashsheni ad sheloshim yom leachar sheloshim yom paki kidushe sheni vegamri kidushe rishon
Yatev rav chisda veka kashya leh kidushe sheni bemay paki amar leh rav yosef mar aresha matne lah vekashya leh rav yehuda assefa matne lah vela kashya leh

Meachshav ulachar sheloshim yom vechu amar rav mekuddeshet veenah mekuddeshet leolam ushmuel amar mekuddeshet veenah mekuddeshet ella ad sheloshim yom leachar sheloshim paki kidushe sheni vegamri kidushe rishon
Lerav mesappeka leh i tenaa havay i chazara havay lishmuel peshita leh ditnaa havay
Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya mehayyom ulachar mita get veeno get divre chachamim rabbi omer kaze get

Venema rav halacha kerabbanan venema shemuel halacha kerabbi tzericha deilu amar rav halacha kerabbanan hava amena hatam dilrachokah kaate aval hacha dilkarovah kaate ema mode leh lishmuel ditnaah havay
Vei amar shemuel halacha kerabbi hava amena hatam hu deen get leachar mita aval hacha deyesh kidushin leachar sheloshim ema mode leh lerav tzericha
Amar abbaye ultameh derav ba echad veamar lah hare atte mekuddeshet li meachshav ulachar sheloshim yom uva acher veamar lah hare atte mekuddeshet li meachshav ulachar esrim yom

a: Uva acher veamar lah hare atte mekuddeshet li meachshav ulachar asara yamim merishon umeacharon tzericha get meemtzai enah tzericha get
Ma nafshach i tenaa havay dekamma kidushe dehanach lav kidushe i chazara havay devatra kidushe dehanach lav kidushe
Peshita mahu detema hay lishana mashma tenaa umashma chazara vetive gita mikkol chad vechad ka mashma lan

Ulla amar rabbi yochanan afilu mea tofsin bah vechen amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan afilu mea tofsin bah amar leh rav mesharsheya bereh derav amme lerabbi assi asberah lach tama derabbi yochanan shauo nafshayehu ki shirga delivne dechol chad vechad revacha lechavreh shevak
Metiv rav chanina mehayyom ulachar mita get veeno get veim met choletzet velo mityabemet
Bishlama lerav mesayea leh lishmuel name ha manni rabbanan hi vaanan deamri kerabbi
Ella lerabbi yochanan deamar shiyyura have kol gita dimshayyar bah vela kelum hu yabbome meyabem
Amar rava get lehotzi umita lehotzi ma sheshshiyyer get gemarattu mita amar leh abbaye mi dame get motzi mershut yavam mita machneset lirshut yavam
Ella amar abbaye hatam tama may gezera mishshum mehayyom im matti hare ze get
Venigzor mehayyom im matti detachlotz attu mehayyom ulachar mita im atta omer choletzet mityabemet
Hacha name im atta omer choletzet mityabemet tityabem veen bechach kelum chashasha derabbanan hu

Matni haomer leishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li al menat sheetten lich matayim zuz hare zo mekuddeshet vehu yitten al menat sheetten lich mikkan vead sheloshim yom natan lah betoch sheloshim mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet
Al menat sheyyesh li matayim zuz hare zo mekuddeshet veyesh lo al menat shearech matayim zuz hare zo mekuddeshet veyare lah veim hera al hashshulchan enah mekuddeshet

Gema itmar rav huna amar vehu yitten rav yehuda amar lichsheyyitten rav huna amar vehu yitten tenaa have mekayyem tenaa veazel rav yehuda amar lichsheyyitten lechi yahev hau kidushe hashta miha la hau kidushe
May benayehu ika benayehu sheppashta yadah vekibbela kidushin meacher lerav huna la hau kidushe lerav yehuda hau kidushe

Utnan name gabbe gitin ki hay gavena haomer leishsha hare ze gitich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz hare zo megoreshet vehi titten itmar rav huna amar vehi titten rav yehuda amar lichshettitten rav huna amar vehi titten tenaa have mekayema tenaa veazla rav yehuda amar lichshettitten lechi yahava leh hu dehave get hashta miha la have get
b: May benayehu ika benayehu shennitkara hagget o sheavad lerav huna have get lerav yehuda la have get
Utzricha dei ashmeinan gabbe kidushin beha kaamar rav huna mishshum dilkarovah kaate aval gerushin dilrachokah kaate ema mode leh lerav yehuda
Vei itmar behach behach kaamar rav huna mishshum deihu la kesif leh lemitbeah aval hacha deihi kesifa lah lemitbeeh ema mode leh lerav yehuda tzericha
Metivi hare ze gitich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz af al pi shennitkara hagget o sheavad hare zo megoreshet leacher lo tinnase ad shettitten

Veod tanya amar lah hare ze gitich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz vamet natna en zekuka layyavam lo natna zekuka leyavam rabban shimon ben gamliel omer notenet leachiv o leaviv o leechad min hakkerovim
Ad kan la peligi ella demar savar li velo leorshay umar savar afilu leorshay dechulle alma miha tenaa have teuvta derav yehuda
Amar lach rav yehuda ha manni rabbi hi deamar rav huna amar rabbi kol haomer al menat keomer meachshav dame ufligi rabbanan aleh vaana daamari kerabbanan

Gufa amar rav huna amar rabbi kol haomer al menat keomer meachshav dame amar rabbi zera ki havenan bevavel hava amrinan ha deamar rav huna amar rabbi kol haomer al menat keomer meachshav dame peligi rabbanan aleh
Ki salki lehatam ashkecheh lerabbi assi deyatev vekaamar lah mishshemeh derabbi yochanan hakkol modim beomer al menat keomer meachshav dame lo nechleku ella mehayyom ulachar mita
Vehatanya mehayyom ulachar mita get veeno get divre chachamim rabbi omer kaze get
Ulrav yehuda deamar beal menat name peligi addemipalgi bemehayyom ulachar mita niflege beal menat
Lehodiacha koach derabbi demehayyom ulachar mita name hare ze get veniflegi beal menat lehodiacha koach derabbanan koach dehetera adif
Al menat sheetten lecha mikkan vechu peshita mahu detema lav tenaa hu ulzarozeh kaamra ka mashma lan

Lema li lemitne gabbe ara ulma li lemitne gabbe zuze tzericha dei ashmeinan gabbe zuze mishshum daavidi inashe dematznei aval ara ema i deit leh ara kala it leh ka mashma lan

Gabbe hekdesh tenan

a: Hammakdish sadehu bishat hayyovel noten bezera chomer seorim chamishshim shekel kasef hau nekaim amukkim asara tefachim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim en nimdadin immah pachot mikkan nimdadin immah

Amar mar ukva bar chama hacha binkaim meleim mayim askinan mishshum delav bene zeria ninhu dayeka name dekatane dumya dislaim gevohim shema minah
I hachi afilu pachot miken name hanhu negane deara mikru shidra deara mikkeru
