May have alah rav kahana amar en choshshin lekidushav rav pappa amar choshshin lekiddushav amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana may datach deyalfatte davar davar mimmamon
I ma lehallan hodaat baal din kemea edim dame af kan hodaat baal din kemea edim dame amar leh hatam la ka chayev leacharine hacha ka chayev leacharine

Mar zutra verav adda sava bene derav mari bar isur pelug nichsayehu bahade hadade ato lekammeh derav ashe amaru leh al pi shene edim amar rachamana dei bae lemihdar la matzu hadri behu vaanan la hadri
O dilma la mikkayema milleta ella besahade amar lehu la ibro sahade ella leshakkare
Amar abbaye amar lo ed echad achalta chelev vehalla shotek neeman vetanna tuna amar lo ed echad achalta chelev vehalla omer lo achalti patur tama deamar lo ha ishtik meheman
Veamar abbaye amar lo ed echad nitmeu tohorotecha vehalla shotek neeman vetanna tuna ed echad omer nitmeu vehalla omer lo nitmeu patur tama deamar lo ha ishtik meheman
Veamar abbaye amar lo ed echad

a: Shorcha nirba vehalla shotek neeman vetanna tuna veshenneevda bo avera veshehemit al pi ed echad o al pi habbealim neeman hay al pi ed echad hechi dame i deka modu bealim hayenu al pi habbealim ella lav deshatek
Utzricha dei ashmeinan hach kammayeta i lav dekim leh benafsheh daavad chullin baazara la hava mayete
Aval nitmeu tohorotecha memar amrinan hay deshatek desavar chaze leh bime tumato
Vei ashmeinan ha mishshum deka mafsed leh bime tohorato aval shoro nirba memar amar kol hshorim lav legabbe mizbeach kayemi tzericha
Ibaya lehu ishto zinta bead echad veshotek mahu amar abbaye neeman rava amar eno neeman have davar shebbeerva veen davar shebbeerva pachot mishshenayim

Amar abbaye mena amena lah dehahu samya dahava mesaddar matneyata kammeh demar shemuel yoma chad negah leh vela hava kaate shaddar shelicha abbatreh addeazel sheliach bachada orcha ata ihu bachada ki ata shaliach amar ishto zinta ata lekammeh demar shemuel amar leh i meheman lach zil appekah vei la la tappek
May lav i meheman alach delav gazlana hu verava i meheman lach keve tere zil appekah vei la la tappekah

Veamar abbaye mena amena lah detanya maase binay hammelech shehalach lechuchlit shebbammidbar vechibesh sham shishshim kerakkim uvachazarato haya sameach simcha gedola vekara lechol chachme yisrael amar lahem avotenu hau ochlim meluchim bizman shehau asukim bevinyan bet hammikdash af anu nochal meluchim zecher laavotenu veheelu meluchim al shulchanot shel zahav veachlu

Vehaya sham echad ish letz lev ra uvliyyaal veelazar ben poera shemo vayyomer elazar ben poera leyannay hammelech yannay hammelech libbam shel perushim alecha uma eese hakem lahem batztzitz shebben enecha hekim lahem batztzitz shebben enav

Haya sham zaken echad vihuda ben gedidya shemo vayyomer yehuda ben gedidya leyannay hammelech yannay hammelech rav lecha keter malchut hannach keter kehunna lezaro shel aharon shehau omrim immo nishbet bemodiim vayevukkash haddavar velo nimtza vayyibbadlu chachme yisrael bezaam

Vayyomer elazar ben poera leyannay hammelech yannay hammelech hedot shebbeyisrael kach hu dino veatta melech vechohen gadol kach hu dinach uma eese im atta shomea laatzati romsem vetora ma tehe aleha hare kerucha umunnachat bekeren zavit kal harotze lilmod yavo veyilmod

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak miyyad nizreka bo minut dahava leh lememar tinach tora shebbichtav tora shebbeal pe may miyyad vattutzatz haraa al yede elazar ben poera vayyehargu kol chachme yisrael vehaya haolam mishtomem ad shebba shimon ben shatach vehechzir et hattora leoshnah
Hechi dame ilema deve tere amri ishtevay uve tere amri la ishtevay may chazet desamchatte ahane semoch ahane
Ella beed echad vetama deka machchashi leh be tere ha lav hachi meheman
Verava leolam tere utre vechidamar rav acha bar rav minome beede hazama hacha name beede hazama
Veibaet ema kidrabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak shifcha hichnisu tachteha
Amar rava
b: Mena amena lah ditnan amar rabbi shimon maase bimgora shel diskim beyavne shehayeta omedet bechezkat shelema umaddu venimtzet chasera

Kol teharot shennaasu al gabbah haya rabbi tarfon metaher verabbi akiva metamme amar rabbi tarfon mikve ze bechezkat shalem hu omed missafek atta ba lechassero al techasserennu missafek amar rabbi akiva adam ze bechezkat tame hu omed missafek atta ba letaharo al tetaharennu missafek

Amar rabbi tarfon mashal leomed umakriv al gabbe hammizbeach venoda shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza sheavodato keshera amar rabbi akiva mashal leomed umakriv al gabbe hammizbeach venoda shehu baal mum sheavodato pesula

Amar rabbi tarfon atta dimito levaal mum vaani dimmitiv leven gerusha o leven chalutza nire lemi dome i dome leven gerusha ulven chalutza nedunennu keven gerusha o keven chalutza im dome levaal mum nedunennu kevaal mum
Hitchil rabbi akiva ladun mikve pesulo beyachid uvaal mum pesulo beyachid veal yochiach ben gerusha uven chalutza sheppesulo bishnayim
Davar acher mikve pesulo begufo baal mum pesulo begufo veal yochiach ben gerusha uven chalutza sheppesulo meacherim amar leh rabbi tarfon akiva kol happoresh mimmecha keforesh min hachayyim
Hay baal mum sheppesulo beyachid hechi dame i deka machchesh leh mi meheman ella deshatek
Vedichvateh gabbe ben gerusha uven chalutza deshatek vekatane mikve pesulo beyachid uvaal mum pesulo beyachid veal yochiach ben gerusha uven chalutza sheppesulo bishnayim

Veabbaye amar leolam deka machchesh leh udkaamratte ammay meheman deamar leh shelach achvi vehayenu dekatane mikve pesulo begufo uvaal mum pesulo begufo veal yochiach ben gerusha uven chalutza sheppesulo meacherim
Uven gerusha uven chalutza daavodato keshera menalan amar rav yehuda amar shemuel deamar kera vehayeta lo ulzaro acharav ben zera kasher uven zera pasul
Avuh dishmuel amar mehacha barech Adonai chelo ufoal yadav tirtze afilu chullin shebbo tirtze
Rabbi yannay amar mehacha uvata el hakkohen asher yihye bayyamim hahem vechi taale al datecha sheadam holech etzel kohen shello haya beyamav ella ze kasher venitchallel

Baal mum daavodato pesula menalan amar rav yehuda amar shemuel deamar kera lachen emor hinni noten lo et beriti shalom keshehu shalem velo keshehu chaser veha shalom ketiv amar rav nachman vav deshalom ketia hi
Matni kol makom sheyyesh kidushin veen avera havalad holech achar hazzachar veeze zo zo kohenet leviyya veyisreelit shennisseu lechohen levi veyisrael
Vechol makom sheyyesh kidushin veyesh avera havalad holech achar happagum veeze zo zo almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot mamzeret untina leyisrael bat yisrael lemamzer ulnatin

Vechol mi sheen lah alav kidushin aval yesh lah al acherim kidushin havalad mamzer veeze ze ze habba al achat mikkol haaraot shebbattora vechol mi sheen lah lo alav velo al acherim kidushin havalad kemotah veeze ze ze velad shifcha venochrit
Gema kol makom sheyyesh kidushin amar leh rabbi shimon lerabbi yochanan kelala hu dechol makom sheyyesh kidushin veen avera havalad holech achar hazzachar hare

a: Ger shennasa mamzeret deyesh kidushin veen avera havalad holech achar happagum detanya ger shennasa mamzeret havalad mamzer divre rabbi yose amar leh mi savratte matnitin rabbi yose hi matnitin rabbi yehuda hi deamar ger lo yissa mamzeret veyesh kidushin veyesh avera havalad holech achar happagum
Venitneyah tena kol makom desefa leetoye
Veibaet ema leolam rabbi yose hi utna ezo zo lemaote
Veezo zo vetu la vahare chalal shennasa bat yisrael deyesh kidushin veen avera havalad holech achar hazzachar ha la kashya kerabbi dostay ben rabbi yehuda sevira leh
Vahare yisrael shennasa chalala deyesh kidushin veen avera havalad holech achar hazzachar tena kol makom deresha leetoye
Venitneyah behedya mishshum dela mittene leh hechi nitne kohenet ulviyya veyisreelit vachalala shennisset lechohen levi veyisrael vachalala lechohen mi chazya
Vehaika derabba bar bar chana deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mitzri sheni shennasa mitzrit rishona benah shelishi have
Tena kol makom deresha leetoye ulrav dimi deamar sheni have tena ezo zo lemaote
Vehaika dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan baummot hallech achar hazzachar
Nitgayeru hallech achar happagum shebbishnehem tena ezo zo lemaote
Hay may i amratte bishlama matnitin rabbi yehuda hi kol makom deresha leetoye yisrael shennasa chalala udrabba bar bar chana ezo zo lemaote derav dimi veravin
b: Kol makom desefa leetoye ger shennasa mamzeret ella i amratte rabbi yose hi kol makom deresha kedaamaran ezo zo kedaamaran ella kol makom desefa leetoye may
Ultamach lerabbi yehuda ezo zo desefa lema li ella ayede ditna resha ezo zo tena sefa ezo zo hachi name ayede ditna resha kol makom tena name sefa kol makom
Gufa ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan baummot hallech achar hazzachar nitgayeru hallech achar happagum shebbishnehem
May baummot hallech achar hazzachar kidtanya minnayin leechad min haummot shebba al hakkenaanit veholid ben sheatta rashshay liknoto beeved

Talmud lomar vegam mibbene hattoshavim haggarim immachem mehem tiknu yachol af eved shebba al shifcha min haummot veholid ben sheatta rashshay liknoto beeved talmud lomar asher holidu beartzechem min hannoladin beartzechem velo min haggarim beartzechem
Nitgayeru hallech achar happagum shebbishnehem bemay ilema bemitzri shennasa ammonit may pagum ika ammoni velo ammonit
Ella beammoni shennasa mitzrit vei zachar have hay shidyeh abbatreh dideh veim nekeva haveya shidyah abbatrah didah

Kol sheen lah alav kidushin mena hane mile deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan umatu bah mishshum derabbi yannay verav acha bereh derava umatu bah mishshum rabbi yose haggelili amar kera veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayeta leish acher laacherim velo likrovim
Matkef lah rabbi abba veema leacher velo leven ben behedya ketiv beh lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv acher lema li shema minah laacherim velo likrovim
Veema ide veide leven ha lechattechila veha diavad
Lechattechila meachot ishsha nafka uma achot ishsha becharet la tafsi bah kidushin chayyave mitot bet din lo kol shekken
Veema ide veide baachot ishsha ha lechattechila ha diavad in hachi name

Ashkechan achot ishsha shear araot menalan yalfinan meachot ishsha ma achot ishsha meuchedet shehi erva vechayyavin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat vela tafsi bah kidushin af kol shehi erva vechayyavin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat la tafsi bah kidushin
Bishlama kullehu atyan ella eshet ish veeshet ach ika lemifrach ma laachot ishsha shekken en lah heter bimkom mitzva tomar beeshet ach sheyyesh lah heter bimkom mitzva
Eshet ish name ika lemifrach ma lehanach shekken en lah heter bechayye osran tomar beeshet ish sheyyesh lah heter bechayye osran

Ella amar rabbi yona veitema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar kera kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot haelle venichretu hukshu kol haaraot kullam laachot ishsha ma achot ishsha lo tafsi bah kidushin af kol araot kullam lo tafsi bah kidushin
I hachi

a: Afilu nidda name allema amar abbaye hakkol modim beva al hannidda veal hassota sheen havalad mamzer amar chizkiyya amar kera uthi niddatah alav afilu bishat niddatah tehe bah havaya
Mikkede ika leakkoshah lenidda veika leakkoshah laachot ishsha may chazet demakkeshatte lehu laachot ishsha akkeshah lenidda kulla vechumra lechumra makkeshinan
Rav acha bar yaakov amar atya bekal vachomer mivama uma yevama shehi belav la tafsi bah kidushin chayyave mitot vechayyave charetot lo kol shekken i hachi shear chayyave lavin name

Amar rav pappa chayyave lavin behedya ketiv behu ki tihyena leish shette nashim haachat ahuva vehaachat senua vechi yesh senua lifne hammakom vaahuva lifne hammakom ella ahuva ahuva benisueha senua senua benisueha vekaamar rachamana ki tihyena
Ulrabbi akiva deamar en kidushin tofsin bechayyave lavin ki tihyena bemay mokem bealmana lechohen gadol uchrabbi simay
Detanya rabbi simay omer min hakkol haya rabbi akiva ose mamzer chutz mealmana lechohen gadol shehare amra tora lo yechallel chilulim ose veen ose mamzerut
Ulrabbi yeshevav deamar bou venitzvach al akiva ben yosef shehaya omer kol sheen lo bia beyisrael havalad mamzer hanicha lerabbi yeshevav i leappoke midderabbi simay kaate shappir
Ella i tama denafsheh kaamar vaafilu chayyave ase bemay mokem lah
Bivula lechohen gadol umay shena mishshum dehave leh ase sheen shave bakkol
Verabbanan addemoke lah bechayyave lavin nokmah bechayyave ase
Hane chayyave ase bemay ninhu i shettehen mitzriyyot shettehen senuot i achat mitzrit veachat yisreelit shette nashim meam echad baenan i beula lechohen gadol mi ketiv tihyena lechohen
Verabbi akiva beal kurchech shivkeh likra dehave dachek umoke annafsheh
Vechol mi sheen lah alav vechu shifcha kenaanit menalan amar rav huna amar kera shevu lachem po im hachamor am haddome lachamor ashkechan dela tafsi bah kiddushe
b: Veladah kemotah menalan deamar kera haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha
Nochrit menalan amar kera lo titchatten bam ashkachna dela tafsi bah kidushe veladah kemotah menalan
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay deamar kera ki yasir et bincha meacharay bincha habba miyyisreelit karuy bincha veen bincha habba min hannochrit karuy bincha ella benah
Amar ravina shema minah ben bittecha habba min hannochri karuy bincha nema kasavar ravina nochri veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer
Nehi dechasher la have mamzer la have pasul mikre
Hahu beshiva goyim ketiv shear ummot menalan amar kera ki yasir et bincha lerabbot kol hammesirim
Hanicha lerabbi shimon dedaresh tama dikra ella lerabbanan may tama
Amar kera veachar ken tavo eleha uvaltah vego mikkelal demeikara la tafsi bah kidushin

Ashkechan dela tafsi bah kidushin veladah kemotah menalan amar kera ki tihyena leish veyaldu lo kol hecha dekarenan beh ki tihyena karenan beh veyaldu lo vechol hecha dela karenan beh ki tihyena la karenan beh veyaldu lo
I hachi shifcha name in hachi name ella haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha lema li lechidtanya

a: Haomer leshifchato hare atte bat chorin uveladich eved havalad kemotah divre rabbi yose haggelili vachachamim omrim devarav kayyamim mishshum shenneemar haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha
May talmuda amar rava adderabbi yose haggelili
Matni rabbi tarfon omer yecholin mamzerin litaher ketzad mamzer shennasa shifcha havalad eved shichrero nimtza habben ben chorin rabbi eliezer omer hare ze eved mamzer
Gema ibaya lehu rabbi tarfon lechattechila kaamar o diavad kaamar ta shema amru lo lerabbi tarfon tiharta et hazzecharim velo tiharta et hannekevot
Vei amratte lechattechila kaamar mamzeret name tinsiv leavda eved en lo chayis
Ta shema deushpizkaneh derabbi simlay mamzer hava vaamar leh i akdemtach tahartinhu livnach i amratte bishlama lechattechila shappir ella i amratte diavad may nihu

Demansev leh etza veamar leh zil genov veizdabban beeved ivri uvishne derabbi simlay eved ivri mi hava vehaamar mar in eved ivri noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg ella lav shema minah rabbi tarfon lechattechila kaamar shema minah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi tarfon
Rabbi eliezer omer hare ze eved mamzer amar rabbi elazar may tameh derabbi eliezer deamar kera lo hallech achar pesulo
Verabbanan hahu beyisrael shennasa mamzeret salka datach amena lemishpechotam levet avotam ketiv ata lo appekeh

Verabbi eliezer lav af al gav dichtav lemishpechotam levet avotam ata lo appekeh hacha name af al gav dichtiv haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha ata lo appekeh verabbanan kol valad bime shifcha kenaanit kevalad bime behema dame
Hadaran alach haomer
Asara yuchasim alu mibbavel kahane leviyye yisreele chalale gere vacharore mamzere netine shetuke vaasufe
Kahane leviyye veyisreele muttarin lavo ze baze leviyye yisreele chalale gere vacharori muttarin lavo ze baze

Gire vacharore mamzere untine shetuke vaasufe kullam muttarin lavo ze baze veellu hem shetuki kol shehu makkir et immo veeno makkir et aviv asufi kol shenneesaf min hashshuk veeno makkir lo et aviv velo immo abba shaul haya kore lashshetuki beduki

Gema asara yuchasin alu mibbavel may irya detane alu mibbavel nitne halchu leeretz yisrael milta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan kidtanya vekamta vealita el hammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha melammed shebbet hammikdash gavoha mikkol eretz yisrael veeretz yisrael gevoha mikkol haaratzot
Bishlama bet hammikdash gavoha mikkol eretz yisrael hayenu dichtiv
b: Divre rivot bisharecha vekamta vealita ella eretz yisrael gevoha mikkol aratzot menalan dichtiv lachen hinne yamim baim neum Adonai velo yomru od chay Adonai asher heela et bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim ki im chay Adonai asher heela vaasher hevi et zera bet yisrael meeretz tzafona umikkol haaratzot asher hiddachtim sham
May irya detane alu mibbavel nitne alu leeretz yisrael mesayya leh lerabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar lo ala ezra mibbavel ad sheasaah kesolet nekiyya veala
Itmar abbaye amar alu meelehem tenan verava amar heelum tenan vekamipalgi bidrabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar lo ala ezra mibbavel ad sheasaah kesolet nekiyya veala

Abbaye let leh derabbi elazar rava it leh derabbi elazar ibaet ema dechulle alma it lehu derabbi elazar vehacha beha ka mipalgi mar savar afroshe afroshinhu uminnafshayehu seliku umar savar beal kurchayehu assokinhu

Bishlama leman deamar alu hayenu deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol aratzot isa leeretz yisrael veeretz yisrael isa levavel ella leman deamar heelum mida yadinhu nehi deyadi lehahu dara ledara acharine la yadi
Bishlama leman deamar alu hayenu dichtiv vaekbetzem el hannahar habba al achava vannachane sham yamim shelosha vaavina vaam uvakkohanim umibbene levi lo matzati sham
Ella leman deamar heelum ha mizhar zehiri nehi deizhur bifsulim bichsherim la izdehur
Kahane leviyye veyisreele menalan disliku dichtiv vayyeshvu hakkohanim vehalviyyim umin haam vehamshorrim vehashshoarim vehannetinim bearehem vechol yisrael bearehem

Chalale gere vacharore chalale menalan detanya rabbi yose omer gedola chazaka shenneemar umibbene hakkohanim bene chovayya bene hakkotz bene varzillay asher lakach mibbenot barzillay haggiladi ishsha vayyikkare al shemam elle bikshu chetavam hammityachsim velo nimtzau vayegoalu min hakkehunna vayyomer hattirshata lahem asher lo yochlu mikkodesh hakkodashim ad amod kohen leurim ultummim
Veamar lahem hare attem bechezkatchem bamme heyitem ochlim baggola bekodshe haggevul af kan name bekodshe haggevul
Ulman deamar maalim mitteruma leuchasin hane daachul bitruma atu leassokinhu shane hatam deria chezkatayehu
Veella may gedola chazaka demeikara achul bitruma derabbanan ulvassof achul bitruma deorayeta
Veibaet ema leolam hashta name bidrabbanan achul bidorayeta la achul vechi massekinan mitteruma leuchasin middeorayeta midderabbanan la massekinan
I hachi may gedola chazaka demeikara leka lemigzar mishshum teruma deorayeta levassof af al gav deika lemigzar mishshum teruma deorayeta bidrabbanan achul bidorayeta la achul
Vehachtiv vayyomer hattirshata lahem asher lo yochlu mikkodesh hakkodashim bekodesh hakkadashim hu delo yochlu ha kol mide nechol

Hachi kaamar la mide demikre kodesh vela mide demikre kadashim la mide demikre kodesh dichtiv vechol zar lo yochal kodesh vela mide demikre kadashim deamar kera uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel veamar mar bammuram min hakkodashim

a: Lo tochel
Gere vacharore menalan amar rav chisda deamar kera vechol hannivdal mittumat goye haaretz alehem

Mamzere menalan dichtiv vayyishma sanvallat hachoroni vetoviyya haeved haammoni uchtiv ki rabbim bihuda baale shevua lo ki chatan hu lishchanya ven arach vihochanan beno lakach et bat meshullam ben berechya kasavar nochri veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer
Hanicha leman deamar havalad mamzer ella leman deamar havalad kasher may ika lememar vetu mimmay dahao leh bene dilma la hao leh bene vetu mimmay dehacha hao lehu usliku dilma hatam hao

Ella mehacha veelle haolim mittel melach tel charsha keruv addon veimmer velo yachlu lehaggid bet avotam vezaram im miyyisrael hem tel melach ellu bene adam sheddomim maasehem lemaase sedom shennehefcha letel melach tel charsha ze shekkore abba veimmo meshattakto

Velo yachlu lehaggid bet avotam vezaram im miyyisrael hem ze hu asufi shenneesaf min hashshuk keruv addon veimmer amar rabbi avahu amar adon ani amarti yihu yisrael lefanay chashuvim kichruv vehem samu atzmam kenamer ika deamri amar rabbi avahu amar adon af al pi shessamu atzmam kenamer hen chashuvim lefanay kichruv
Amar rabba bar bar chana kol hannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo maale alav hakkatuv keilu charasho lechol haolam kullo uzrao melach shenneemar veelle haolim mittel melach tel charsha
Amar rabba bar rav adda amar rav kol hannose ishsha leshum mamon havayin lo banim sheenan mehugganim shenneemar ba bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu

Veshemma tomar mamon palet talmud lomar atta yochlem chodesh et chelkehem veshemma tomar chelko velo chelkah talmud lomar chelkehem veshemma tomar lizman merubbe talmud lomar chodesh may mashma amar rav nachman bar yitzchak chodesh nichnas vechodesh yatza umamonam avad

Veamar rabba bar rav adda veamri lah amar rabbi salla amar rav hamnuna kol hannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo eliyyahu kofto vehakkadosh baruch hu rotzo vetana al kullam eliyyahu kotev vehakkadosh baruch hu chotem oy lo lapposel et zaro velappogem et mishpachto velannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo eliyyahu kofto vehakkadosh baruch hu rotzo
Vechol happosel pasul veeno medabber bishvacha leolam veamar shemuel bemumo posel

Amar rava bar rav huna metzao mahul
b: En bo mishshum asufi meshalleti haddameh en bo mishshum asufi shayif mishcha umle kuchla reme chumre tele pitka utle kemia en bo mishshum asufi
Tele bedikle i matya leh chayya yesh bo mishshum asufi im lav en bo mishshum asufi
Zardeta semicha lemata yesh bo mishshum asufi veim lav en bo mishshum asufi be chenishta semichta lemata ushchichi beh rabbim en bo mishshum asufi veim lav yesh bo mishshum asufi

Amar ammemar hay pera desufle yesh bo mishshum asufi charifta denahara en bo mishshum asufi pishre yesh bo mishshum asufi tzide reshut harabbim en bo mishshum asufi reshut harabbim yesh bo mishshum asufi
Amar rava uvishne reavon en bo mishshum asufi ha derava aheya ilema arshut harabbim ayede dishne reavon katla leh veella atztzide reshut harabbim may irya shene reavon afilu bela shene reavon
Ella ki ittemar derava aha deamar rav yehuda amar rabbi abba amar rabbi yehuda bar zavdi amar rav kol zeman shebbashshuk aviv veimmo neemanim alav neesaf min hashshuk en neemanim alav
May tama amar rava hoil veyatza alav shem asufi veamar rava uvishne reavon af al pi shenneesaf min hashshuk aviv veimmo neemanim alav
Amar rav chisda shelosha neemanim lealtar ellu hen asufi chayya ufoteret chavroteha
Asufi ha daamaran

Chayya detanya chayya neemenet lomar ze yatza rishon veze yatza sheni bamme devarim amurim shello yatzta vechazra aval yatzta vechazra enah neemenet rabbi eliezer omer huchzeka al omdah neemenet veim lav enah neemenet may benayehu ika benayehu deahdar appah

Poteret chavroteha may hi ditnan shalosh nashim shehau yeshenot bemitta achat venimtza dam tachat achat mehen kullan temeot badka achat mehen venimtzet temea hi temea vechullan tehorot amar rav chisda shebbadka atzmah keshiur veset
Tanu rabbanan neemenet chayya lomar ze kohen veze levi ze natin veze mamzer bamme devarim amurim shello kara aleha shem arar aval kara aleha arar enah neemenet
Arar demay ilema arar chad vehaamar rabbi yochanan en arar pachot mishshenayim ella arar tere
Veibaet ema leolam ema lach arar chad vechi amar rabbi yochanan en arar pachot mishshenayim hane mile hecha deita chazaka dechashrut aval hecha deleka chazaka dechashrut chad name meheman
Neeman baal mikkach lomar laze macharti velaze en macharti bamme devarim amurim bizman shemmikkacho beyado aval en mikkacho beyado eno neeman

a: Venichze zuze mimman naket la tzericha denaket mittarvayehu veamar chad middatay vechad beal kurchay vela yedia he middato vehe lo middato
Neeman dayyan lomar laze zikkiti velaze chiyyavti bamme devarim amurim shebbaale dinim omdim lefanav aval en baale dinim omdim lefanav eno neeman venichze zechuta man naket
La tzericha dikria zechutayehu venihdar venidayeninhu beshuda dedayyane
Amar rav nachman shelosha neemanin al habbechor ellu hen chayya aviv veimmo chayya lealtar immo kol shiva aviv leolam kidtanya yakkir yakkirennu laacherim
Mikkan amar rabbi yehuda neeman adam lomar ze beni bechor uchshem shenneeman lomar ze beni bechor kach neeman lomar ze ben gerusha veze ben chalutza vachachamim omrim eno neeman

Abba shaul haya kore lashshetuki beduki may beduki ilema shebbodkin et immo veomeret lechasher nivalti neemenet keman kerabban gamliel tenena chada zimna ditnan hayeta meubberet veamru lah ma tivo shel ubbar ze amra lahem meish peloni vechohen hu rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet verabbi yehoshua omer lo mippiha anu chayyin veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabban gamliel
Chada lehachshir bah vachada lehachshir bevittah hanicha leman deamar ledivre hammachshir bah posel bevittah
Ella leman deamar ledivre hammachshir bah machshir bevittah abba shaul may ata leashmoinan
Deabba shaul adifa midderabban gamliel dei mehatam hava amena hatam derov kesherin etzlah aval hecha derov pesulin etzlah ema la tzericha amar rava halacha keabba shaul
Matni kol haasurin lavo bakkahal muttarim lavo ze baze rabbi yehuda oser
Rabbi eliezer omer vaddaan bevaddaan muttar vaddaan bisfekan usfekan bevaddaan usfekan bisfekan asur veellu hen hassefekot shetuki asufi vechuti
Gema may kol haasurin lavo bakkahal ilema mamzere untine shetuke vaasufe ha tena leh resha mamzere untine shetuke vaasufe muttarim lavo ze baze
Vetu rabbi yehuda oser aheya ilema avaddaan bisfekan ha middekatane sefa rabbi eliezer omer vaddaan bevaddaan muttar vaddaan bisfekan usfekan bisfekan asur mikkelal derabbi yehuda la sevira leh
Vechi tema rabbi yehuda oser agger bemamzeret mide ger bemamzeret katane kol haasurin lavo bakkahal katane
Amar rav yehuda
b: Hachi kaamar kol haasurim lavo bikhal kehunna may ninhu giyyoret pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad udla kerabbi shimon ben yochay muttarin lavo ze baze
Venokmah bevat shalosh shanim veom echad vaafilu lerabbi shimon ben yochay im ken mitztzidah tavrah

Ella tama devat shalosh shanim veom echad ha pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad demutteret lavo bikhal kehunna asura lavo ze baze hare pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad lerabbi shimon ben yochay demutteret lavo bikhal kehunna umuteret lavo ze baze

Uchlala hu dechol haasurim lavo bikhal kehunna muttarin lavo ze baze vahare almana ugrusha vachalala vezona daasurim lavo bikhal kehunna vaasurim lavo ze baze vetu ha muttar asur vahare ger shemmuttar bechohenet umuttar bemamzeret
Ella amar rav natan bar hoshaya hachi kaamar kol shekkohen asur lisa et bitto umay nihu ger shennasa giyyoret uchrabbi eliezer ben yaakov muttarin lavo ze baze
Uchlala hu dechol shekkohen asur lisa et bitto muttarim lavo ze baze hare chalal shennasa bat yisrael dechohen asur lisa bitto vaasurin name lavo ze baze la kashya kerabbi dostay ben yehuda
Vahare chalal shennasa chalala vechohen asur lisa bitto veasur name lavo ze baze vetu ha muttar asur vahare ger shennasa bat yisrael vechohen muttar lisa bitto umuttarin lavo ze baze
Ella amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh hacha mamzer meachoto umamzer meeshet ish ika benayehu
Tanna kamma savar afilu mamzer meachoto name have mamzer verabbi yehuda savar meeshet ish have mamzer meachoto la have mamzer
May ka mashma lan tenena ezehu mamzer kol shehu belo yavo divre rabbi akiva
Shimon hattimni omer kol shechayyavin alav karet bide shamayim vahalacha kidvarav rabbi yehoshua omer kol shechayyavin alav mitat bet din
Ella amar rava ger ammoni umoavi ika benayehu vehachi kaamar kol haasurim lavo bakkahal umay nihu ger ammoni umoavi muttarin lavo ze baze
I hachi may rabbi yehuda oser hachi kaamar af al pi sherabbi yehuda oser ger bemamzeret hane mile ger derauy lavo bakkahal aval ger ammoni umoavi deen reuyin lavo bakkahal la

Tanu rabbanan ben tesha shanim veom echad ger ammoni umoavi mitzri vaadomi kuti venatin chalal umamzer shebbau al hakkohenet veal halviyya veal bat yisrael pesaluha rabbi yose omer kol shezzaro pasul posel vechol sheen zaro pasul eno posel rabban shimon ben gamliel omer

a: Kol sheatta nose bitto atta nose almenato vechol shei atta nose bitto i atta nose almenato
May ika ben tanna kamma uven rabbi yose amar rabbi yochanan mitzri sheni ika benayehu ushnehem lo lemaduha ella mikkohen gadol bealmana
Detanna kamma savar ki kohen gadol bealmana ma kohen gadol bealmana shebbiato baavera ufosel bah af kol shebbiato baavera posel

Verabbi yose savar ki chohen gadol bealmana ma kohen gadol bealmana shezzaro pasul ufosel af kol shezzaro pasul posel leappoke mitzri sheni sheen zaro pasul deamar kera banim asher yivaldu lahem dor shelishi yavo lahem bikhal Adonai

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol sheatta nose bitto atta nose almenato vechol shei atta nose et bitto i atta nose almenato may ika ben rabbi yose lerabban shimon ben gamliel amar ulla ger ammoni umoavi ika benayehu ushnehem lo lemaduha ella mikkohen gadol bealmana
Derabbi yose savar ki kohen gadol bealmana ma kohen gadol bealmana shezzaro pasul ufosel af kol shezzaro pasul posel

Verabban shimon ben gamliel kechohen gadol bealmana ma kohen gadol bealmana shekkol zaro pasul af kol shekkol zaro pasul afilu nekevot leappoke ger ammoni umoavi dinkevot hau kesherot lavo bakkahal deamar mar ammoni velo ammonit moavi velo moavit

Amar rav chisda hakkol modim bealmenat isa sheppesula lakkehunna man mekel behane tannae rabban shimon ben gamliel vekaamar kol sheatta nose bitto atta nose almenato vechol shei atta nose bitto i atta nose almenato lemaote may lemaote almenat isa sheppesula lakkehunna
Leappoke middehane tannae ditnan heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi yehuda ben betera al almenat isa shekkeshera lakkehunna may tama have sefek sefeka usfek sefeka lekulla

Vaddaan bevaddaan muttar amar rav yehuda amar rav halacha kerabbi eliezer ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li hillel shone asara yuchasim alu mibbavel vechullam muttarim lavo ze baze veatte amratte halacha kerabbi eliezer
Urmi derav adderav urmi dishmuel addishmuel deitmar arusa sheibra rav amar havalad mamzer ushmuel amar havalad shetuki
Rav amar havalad mamzer umuttar bemamzeret ushmuel amar havalad shetuki veasur bemamzeret efoch rav amar havalad shetuki ushmuel amar havalad mamzer
Tarte lema li tzericha dei itmar beha beha kaamar rav mishshum derov kesherim etzlah aval hatam derov pesulim etzlah ema mode lishmuel
Vei itmar behach beha kaamar rav mishshum deika lemitleyah bearus aval beha ema mode lishmuel tzericha

Vei baet ema leolam la tefoch umay mamzer dekaamar rav lav muttar bemamzeret ella deasur bevat yisrael ushmuel amar havalad shetuki deasur bevat yisrael i hachi hayenu derav ella may shetuki shemmeshattekin oto middin kehunna
Peshita hashta middin yisrael meshattekinan leh middin kehunna mibe ella may shetuki shemmeshattekin oto minnichse aviv peshita mi yadinan avuh mannu la tzericha ditfas

Vei baet ema may shetuki beduki shebbodkim et immo veomeret lechasher nivalti neemenet keman kerabban gamliel haamar shemuel chada zimna ditnan hayeta meubberet veamru lah ma tivo shel ubbar ze meish peloni vechohen hu rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim neemenet rabbi yehoshua omer enah neemenet veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabban gamliel
Tzericha dei mehatam hava amena hatam rov kesherim etzlah aval hacha derov pesulim etzlah ema la tzericha
Tanya vechen rabbi elazar omer kuti lo yissa kutit may tama amar rav yosef asauhu keger leachar asara dorot detanya ger ad asara dorot muttar bemamzeret mikkan veelach asur bemamzeret
Veyesh omrim ad sheyyishtakkea shem avoda zara mimmennu
Amar leh abbaye mi dame hatam ger yashan umamzeret chadasha amri bar yisrael hu deka nasev mamzeret hacha ide veide ki hadade ninhu ella ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi elazar savar lah kerabbi yishmael
b: Verabbi yishmael savar lah kerabbi akiva rabbi elazar savar lah kerabbi yishmael deamar kutim gere araot hem verabbi yishmael savar lah kerabbi akiva deamar nochri veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer

Umi savar lah rabbi yishmael kerabbi akiva vehaamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael minnayin lenochri veeved shebbau al hakkohenet veal halviyya veal bat yisrael sheppesaluha shenneemar uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugrusha vezera en lah
Mi sheyyesh lo almenut vegerushin yatza nochri veeved sheen lo almenut vegerushin
Vei salka datach savar lah kerabbi akiva hashta mamzer have mifsal beviato mibaya
Ella rabbi elazar savar lah kerabbi yishmael deamar kutim gere araot vesavar lah kerabbi akiva deamar nochri veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad mamzer
Umi savar lah rabbi elazar kerabbi akiva vehaamar rabbi elazar af al pi shennechleku bet shammay uvet hilel betzarot modim sheen mamzer ella mimmi sheisuro isur erva veanush karet

Ella ki ata ravin amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan veamri lah amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rabbi chanina veamri lah amar rabbi yaakov bar ide amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi shalosh machlokot baddavar

Rabbi yishmael savar kutim gere araot hen vechohanim shennitmeu bahem kohanim pesulim hau shenneemar veyaasu lahem miktzotam kohane vamot veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan min hakkotzim shebbaam umishshum hachi paslinhu

Verabbi akiva savar kutim gere emet hen vechohanim shennitmeu bahen kohanim kesherim hau shenneemar veyaasu lahem miktzotam kohane vamot veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan min habbechirim shebbaam veella mippene ma asarum mippene shehau meyabmim et haarusot

a: Ufotrim et hannesuot may darshi lo tihye eshet hammet hachutza leish zar hach deyatva chutza hi lo tihye leish zar aval hach dela yatva chutza tihye leish zar
Verabbi akiva letameh deamar yesh mamzer mechayyave lavin

Veyesh omrim lefi sheen bekiin bedikduke mitzot man yesh omrim amar rav idi bar avin rabbi eliezer hi detanya matztzat kuti mutteret veadam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach verabbi eliezer oser lefi sheen bekiim bedikduke mitzot rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim harbe medakdekim bah yoter miyyisrael
Veella hachi may en bekiin lefi sheen bekiin betorat kidushin vegerushin
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh mamzer meachoto umamzer meeshet ach nitarvu bahen may ka mashma lan yesh mamzer mechayyave charetot nitne chada maase shehaya kach haya
Verava amar eved veshifcha nitarvu bahen isura mishshum may mishshum shifcha nitne chada maase shehaya kach haya

Matni hannose ishsha kohenet tzarich livdok achareha arba immahot shehen shemone immah veem immah veem avi immah veimmah veem aviha veimmah veem avi aviha veimmah leviyya veyisreelit mosifin alehen od achat

En bodkin lo min hammizbeach ulmala velo min hadduchan ulmala velo min hassanhedrin ulmala vechol shehuchzeku avotav mishshotre harabbim vegabbae tzedaka massiin lakkehunna veen tzarich livdok acharehen
Rabbi yose omer af mi shehaya chatum ed bearche hayeshana shel tzipori rabbi chanina ben antignos omer af mi shehaya muchtav beisteratya shel melech

Gema may shena binshe badkinan umay shena begavre dela badkinan neshe dechi mintzu bahade hadade baaraot hu demintzu veim ita deika milta la it lah kala gavre dechi mintzu bahade hadade beuchasin hu demintze im ita deika milta it lah kala
Veihi name tivdok beh bedideh mesayya leh lerav deamar rav yehuda amar rav lo huzharu kesherot linase lifsulim
Rav adda bar ahava tane arba immahot shehem shettem esre bematnita tana arba immahot shehem shesh esre bishlama lerav adda bar ahava
b: Mokem lah bilviyya uvat yisrael ella matnita nema peliga la may od achat zug achat

Amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi meir aval chachamim omrim kol mishpachot bechezkat kesherot hen omdot ini vehaamar rav chama bar gurya amar rav mishnatenu keshekkore alav arar man dematne ha la matne ha
Ika deamri amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi meir aval chachamim omrim kol mishpechot bechezkat kesherot hen omdot amar rav chama bar gurya amar rav im kore alav arar tzarich livdok achareha
En bodkin min hammizbeach ulmala may tama i lav devadkuh la hao masseki leh velo min hadduchan ulmala may tama deamar mar sheshsham hau yoshvim meyachase kehunna umyachase leviyya
Velo missanhedrin ulmala may tama detane rav yosef keshem shebbet din menukkin betzedek kach menukkin mikkol mum amar marimar may keraa kullach yafa rayati umum en bach
Ema muma mammash amar rav acha bar yaakov amar kera vehityatztzevu sham immach immach bedomim lach
Vedilma mishshum shechina amar rav nachman amar kera vehakel mealecha venasu ittach bedomim lach

Kol mi shehuchzeku avotav mishshotre harabbim lememra dela mokminan mippesulim urminhu hakkol kesherim ladun dine mamonot veen hakkol kesherim ladun dine nefashot vehavenan bah hakkol leetoye may veamar rav yehuda leetoye mamzer amar abbaye birushalayim vechen tane rav shimon bar zera bekidushe deve levi birushalayim
Vegabbae tzedaka massiim may tama kevan deminnetzu bahade inashe deamar mar memashkenim al hatztzedaka vaafilu beerev shabbat veim ita deika it leh kala

Ushpizkaneh derav adda bar ahava giyyora hava vahava ka minnetze ihu verav bivi mar amar ana avedna seraruta demata umar amar ana avedna seraruta demata ato lekammeh derav yosef amar lehu tenena som tasim alecha melech mikkerev achecha kol mesimot sheatta mesim lo yihye ella mikkerev achecha

Amar leh rav adda bar ahava vaafilu immo miyyisrael amar leh immo miyyisrael mikkerev achecha karena beh hilkach rav bivi degavra rabba hu liayyen bemile dishmayya umar liayyen bemile demata amar abbaye hilkach man demashre tzurba midderabbanan beushpizkaneh lashre kerav adda bar ahava deyada limhappech dimhappech leh bizchuteh
Rabbi zera mittappal behu rabba bar avuh mittappal behu bemareva afilu resh kore la mokmi minayehu binhardea afilu resh garguta la mokmi minayehu
Rabbi yose omer af mi shehaya vechu may tama dayeki umachtemi

Rabbi chanina ben antignos vechu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel bachayalot shel bet david amar rav yosef may kera vehityachsam batztzava bammilchama vetama may amar rav yehuda amar rav kede shettehe zechutan uzchut avotam mesayyatan
Vehaika tzelek haammoni may lav deate meammon la deyatev beammon vehaika uriyya hachitti may lav deate mechet la deyatev bechet
Vehaika ittay haggitti vechi tema hachi name deyatev begat veha amar rav nachman ittay haggiti ba uvittelah

Veod amar rav yehuda amar rav arba meot yeladim hau lo ledavid vechullam bene yefat toar hau vechullam mistapperim kome umgaddelim belorit hau vechullam yoshvim bikroniyyot shel zahav vehau mehallechim berashe geyasot vehen hen baale egrofim shel bet david deazli levaote alma

a: Matni bat chalal zachar pesula min hakkehunna leolam yisrael shennasa chalala bitto keshera lakkehunna chalal shennasa bat yisrael bitto pesula lakkehunna rabbi yehuda omer bat ger zachar kevat chalal zachar

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer yisrael shennasa giyyoret bitto keshera lakkehunna veger shennasa bat yisrael bitto keshera lakkehunna aval ger shennasa giyyoret bitto pesula lakkehunna echad ger veechad avadim meshuchrarim afilu ad asara dorot ad shettehe immo miyyisrael rabbi yose omer af ger shennasa giyyoret bitto keshera lakkehunna
Gema may leolam mahu detema mide dahava ammitzri vaadomi ma lehallan leachar shelosha dorot af kan name leachar shelosha dorot ka mashma lan

Yisrael shennasa chalala mena hane mile amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon neemar kan velo yechallel zaro beammav veneemar lehallan lo yittamma baal beammav ma lehallan zecharim velo nekevot af kan zecharim velo nekevot
Ella meatta bitto shel kohen gadol tishtere mi ketiv beno zaro ketiv lo yechallel zaro beammav
Bat beno tishtere ketiv lo yechallel zaro makkish zaro lo ma hu bitto pesula af beno bitto pesula bat bitto titsar im ken gezera shava may ahani leh
Chalal shennasa bat yisrael bitto pesula ha tena leh resha bat chalal zachar pesula min hakkehunna leolam ayede ditna resha yisrael shennasa chalala tena name sefa chalal shennasa bat yisrael

Matnitin dela kerabbi dostay ben yehuda detanya rabbi dostay ben yehuda omer keshem shebbene yisrael mikve tohora lachalalot kach benot yisrael mikve tohora lachalalim may tameh derabbi dostay berabbi yehuda amar kera lo yechallel zaro beammav beim echad hu demechel bishne amamim eno mechel
Tanu rabbanan lo yechallel zaro en li ella zaro hi atzmah minnayin amarta kal vachomer ma zaro shello avar avera mitchallel hi sheavra avera eno din shemmitchallelet
Hu atzmo yochiach sheavar avera veen mitchallel ma lehu shekken en mitchallel bechol makom tomar behi shemmitchallelet bechol makom
Veim nafshecha lomar amar kera lo yechallel zaro lo yechullal ze shehaya kasher venitchallel
May im nafshecha lomar vechi tema ika lemifrach ma lezaro shekken yetzirato baavera amar kera lo yechallel lo yecholel ze shehaya kasher venitchallel
Tanu rabbanan ezo hi chalala kol shennolda min happesulim may pesulim ilema pesulim lo hare machazir gerushato difsula lo uvaneha kesherim dichtiv toeva hi hi toeva veen baneha toavim
Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar ezo hi chalala kol shennolda min pesul kehunna nolda in lo nolda la hare almana ugrusha zona delo nolda veka haveya chalala

Amar rabba hachi kaamar ezo chalala muzkeret shello haya lah sheat hakkosher kelal kol shennolda min pesul kehunna may muzkeret amar rav yitzchak bar avin hachi kaamar ezo hi chalala sheikarah middivre tora veen tzerichin lefaresh middivre sofrim kol shennolda min pesule kehunna
Tanu rabbanan almana almana almana eno chayyav ella achat gerusha gerusha gerusha eno chayyav ella achat
Almana ugrusha vachalala zona bizman shehem kasseder chayyav al kol achat veachat zinta venitchallela venitgarsha venitarmela eno chayyav ella achat
Amar mar almana almana almana eno chayyav ella achat hay almana hechi dame ilema shebba al almenat reuven veal almenat shimon veal almenat levi ammay eno chayyav ella achat
b: Hare gufin muchlakim hare shemot muchlakim
Ella shebba al almana achat shalosh biot hechi dame i dela atro beh peshita deeno chayyav ella achat

Ella deatro beh akkol chada vachada ammay eno chayyav ella achat vehatnan nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom kullo eno chayyav ella achat amru lo al tishte al tishte vehu shote chayyav al kol achat veachat
La tzericha shebba al almenat reuven shehayeta almenat shimon shehayeta almenat levi mahu detema hare shemot muchlakim ka mashma lan gufim muchlakim baenan veleka
Almana ugrusha vachalala zona hay tanna may kasavar i kasavar isur chal al isur ipcha name vei kasavar en isur chal al isur afilu kasseder hazze name la
Amar rava hay tanna isur chal al isur let leh isur mosif it leh

Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet kol shehu beyikkach hare hu belo yikkach kol sheeno beyikkach eno belo yikkach perat lechohen gadol shebba al achoto almana
Amar leh daamar lach manni rabbi shimon hi deamar en isur chal al isur detanya rabbi shimon omer haochel nevela beom hakkippurim patur dei rabbanan ha amri isur chal al isur
Afilu tema rabbanan ki amri rabbanan isur chal al isur hane mile isur chamur al isur kal aval isur kal al isur chamur la chayel

Vachalutza derabbanan vehatanya gerusha en li ella gerusha chalutza minnayin talmud lomar veishsha midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma

Ma lechalal shekken yetzirato baavera kohen gadol bealmana yochiach sheen yetzirato baavera bitto pesula
Ma lechohen gadol bealmana shekken biato baavera chalal yochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheenan berov hakkahal af ani avi et hagger sheeno berov hakkahal uvitto pesula
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahem tzad avera
La tema kohen gadol bealmana yochiach ella ema mitzri rishon yochiach
Ma lemitzri rishon shekken eno rauy lavo bakkahal chalal yochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheenan berov kahal uvitto pesula af ani avi et hagger sheeno berov kahal uvitto pesula
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken poslim beviatam verabbi yehuda ger name posel beviato umayete lah bamma hatztzad mehay dina

Vehaalmana asher tihye almana mikkohen yikkachu mikkohen in miyyisrael la hachi kaamar mikkohen yikkachu mishshear kohanim yikkachu tanya name hachi mikkohen yikkachu mishshear kohanim yikkachu

Rabbi yose omer af ger shennasa giyyoret amar rav hamnuna mishshemeh deulla halacha kerabbi yose vechen amar rabba bar bar chana halacha kerabbi yose umiyyom shecharav bet hammikdash nahagu kohanim silsul beatzman kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov
Amar rav nachman amar li huna ba limalech morim lo kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov nasa en motziim otah mimmennu kerabbi yose
Matni haomer beni ze mamzer eno neeman vaafilu shenehem modim al haubbar shebbemeeha mamzer hu enam neemanim rabbi yehuda omer neemanim

Gema may vaafilu shenehem la mibaya kaamar la mibaya ihu dela kim leh ella afilu ihi dekim lah la mehemna vela mibaya hecha deit leh chazaka dechashrut dela mehemni ella afilu ubbar name delet leh chazaka dechashrut la mehemni

Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava bishlama lerabbi yehuda hayenu dichtiv yakkir ella lerabbanan yakkir lema li
Bitzrich hekkera lemay hilcheta latet lo pi shenayim peshita lema li kera migo dei bae mitvah leh mattana mi la yahavi leh
Binchasim shennaflu leachar miken
Ulrabbi meir deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam yakkir lema li shennaflu lo keshehu goses
Matni mi shennatan reshut lishlucho lekaddesh et bitto vehalach hu vekiddeshah im shello kadmu kidushav kidushin veim shel shelucho kadmu kidushav kidushin veim eno yadua

a: Shenehem notnim get veim ratzu echad noten get veechad kones

Vechen haishsha shennatna reshut lishluchah lekaddeshah vehalcha vekiddeshah et atzmah im shellah kadmu kiddusheha kidushin veim shel sheluchah kadmu kidushav kidushin veim enan yodin shenehem notnim lah get veim ratzu echad noten lah get veechad kones
Gema utzricha dei ashmeinan gabbe dideh mishshum degavra kim leh beuchasin aval itta dela kim lah beuchasin ema la niho kidusheha kidushin
Vei ashmeinan gabbe didah mishshum deitta dayeka uminasva aval ihu ema la ichpat leh tzericha
Itmar kidshah aviha badderech vekidsha atzmah bair vahare hi bogeret rav amar hare hi bogeret lefanenu ushmuel amar chayeshinan lekidushe shenehem

Emat ilema betoch shishsha beha nema rav hare hi bogeret lefanenu hashta hu devagra ella leachar shishsha beha nema shemuel chayeshinan lekidushe shenehem veha amar shemuel en ben nearot levagrut ella shishsha chodashim bilvad
La tzericha dekaddesh behahu yoma demashlem shishsha rav amar hare hi bogeret lefanenu middehashta bogeret betzafra name bogeret ushmuel amar hashta hu deayetay simanim
Ushmuel may shena mimmikve ditnan mikve shennimdad venimtza chaser kol teharot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim temeot
Shane hatam deika lememar haamed tame al chezkato veemar lo taval
Adderabba haamed mikve al chezkato veemar lo chasar hare chaser lefanecha hacha name hare bogeret lefanecha hashta hu divgara hatam name hashta hu dachasar
Hatam tarte lereuta hacha chada lereuta
Ushmuel may shena mechavit detanya haya bodek et hechavit lehafrish aleha teruma veholech veachar kach nimtzet chometz kol shelosha yamim vadday mikan veelach safek
Veramenan chavit ammikve may shena dehacha vadday umay shena dehacha safek
Veamar rav chanina missurya man tena chavit rabbi shimon hi degabbe mikve name sefeka meshave
Detanya kol teharot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim temeot verabbi shimon omer birshut harabbim tehorot birshut hayyachid tolin
Aval lerabbanan tevel lemafrea shane hatam deika lememar haamed tevel al chezkato veemar lo nitkan
Adderabba haamed yayin al chezkato veemar lo hechmitz hare hechmitz lefanecha hacha name hare hi bogeret lefanenu hashta hu divgara hacha name hashta hu deachmetz
Hatam tarte lereuta hacha chada lereuta hu deika

Ishsha nasati bimdinat hayyam hare hi zo veellu baneha mevi reaya al haishsha veen tzarich lehavi reaya al habbanim meta veellu baneha tzarich lehavi reaya al haishsha veal habbanim

a: Lo shanu ella bekodshe haggevul aval beuchasin lo verabbi yochanan amar afilu beuchasin
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan malkin al hachazakot soklin vesorfin al hachazakot veen sorfin teruma al hachazakot
Malkin al hachazakot kerav yehuda deamar rav yehuda huchzeka nidda bishchenoteha balah loke aleha mishshum nidda
Soklin vesorfin al hachazakot kidrabba bar rav huna deamar rabba bar rav huna ish veishsha tinok vetinoket shehigdilu betoch habbayit niskalin ze al ze venisrafin ze al ze

Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara maase beishsha shebbat lirushalayim vetinok murkav lah al ketefah vehigdilattu uva aleha vehevium levet din uskalum lo mippene shebbenah vadday ella mippene shekkaruch achareha

Veen sorfin teruma al hachazakot deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish sorfin al hachazakot verabbi yochanan omer en sorfin veazdu letamayehu ditnan tinok shennimtza betzad haisa uvatzek beyado rabbi meir metaher vachachamim metammein mippene sheddarko shel tinok letappeach

Ella ezo chazaka lerabbi yochanan shessorfin aleha et hatteruma keditnan isa betoch habbayit ushratzim utzfardeim mittappelin sham venimtzeu chatichot baisa im rov sheratzim temea im rov tzefardeim tehora
Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan shene devarim en bahem daat lishael vaasaum chachamim kema sheyyesh bahem daat lishael tinok veod acheret

Mityached adam im immo amar rav yehuda amar rav assi mityached adam im achoto vedar im immo veim bitto ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar asur lehityached im kol araot shebbattora vaafilu im behema

Tenan mityached adam im immo veim bitto veyashen immahem bekeruv basar utuvta dishmuel amar lach shemuel velitamach ha detanya achoto vachamoto ushar kol araot shebbattora en mityached immahem ella beedim beedim in shello beedim la

Ella tannae hi detanya amar rabbi meir hizzaharu bi mippene bitti amar rabbi tarfon hizzaharu bi mippene kallati ligleg alav oto talmid amar rabbi avahu mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel lo hau yamim muatim ad shennichshal oto talmid bachamoto

Afilu im behema abbaye mechalle leh mikkulleh davra rav sheshet meabbar leh mitzra rav chanan minnehardea ikla lerav kahana lefum nahara chazyeh deyatev veka gares vekayema behema kammeh amar leh la savar lah mar afilu im behema amar leh lav addatay
Amar rava mityached adam im shette yevamot veim shette tzarot im ishsha vachamotah im ishsha uvat balah im ishsha vetinoket sheyyodaat taam bia veen moseret atzmah levia

Higdilu ze yashen bichsuto vechu vechamma amar rav adda bar rav uzza ava amar rav assi tinoket bat tesha shanim veom echad tinok ben shettem esre shana veom echad ika deamri tinoket bat shettem esre shana veom echad tinok ben shelosh esre veom echad veze veze kede sheyyihu shadayim nachonu usarech tzimmeach
Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda lo shanu ella sheenah bosha laamod lefanav arumma aval bosha laamod lefanav arumma asur may tama yetzer albeshah

Rav acha bar abba ikla leve rav chisda chatneh shakleh levat beratte otvah bechanfeh amar leh la savar lah mar demikkaddesha amar leh avarte lach adderav deamar rav yehuda amar rav veitema rabbi elazar asur leadam sheyekaddesh et bitto keshehi ketanna ad shettagdil vetomar bifloni ani rotza mar name avar leh addishmuel deamar shemuel en mishtammeshim beishsha amar leh ana keidach dishmuel sevira li deamar shemuel

a: Hakkol leshem shamayim

Matni lo yelammed adam rauok sofrim velo telammed ishsha sofrim rabbi elazar omer af mi sheen lo ishsha lo yelammed sofrim rabbi yehuda omer lo yire rauok behema velo yishnu shene rauokin betallit achat vachachamim mattirim
Gema may tama ilema mishshum yanoke vehatanya amru lo lerabbi yehuda lo nechshedu yisrael al mishkav zechur velo al habbehema ella rauok mishshum immahata deyanoke ishsha mishshum avahata deyanoke
Rabbi elazar omer af mi sheen ku ibaya lehu mi sheen lo ishsha kelal o dilma besheenah sheruya etzlo ta shema af mi sheyyesh lo veenah sheruya etzlo lo yelammed sofrim
Rabbi yehuda omer lo yire ku tanya amru lo lerabbi yehuda lo nechshedu yisrael al mishkav zechur velo al habbehema

Matni kol sheasakav im hannashim lo yityached im hannashim velo yelammed adam et beno ummanut hannashim rabbi meir omer leolam yelammed adam et beno ummanut nekiyya vekalla veyitpallel lemi shehaosher vehannechasim shello sheen ummanut sheen bah aniyyut vaashirut shello aniyyut min haummanut velo ashirut min haummanut ella hakkol lefi zechuto

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer raita miyyamecha chayya vaof sheyyesh lahem ummanut vehen mitparnesin shello betzaar vahalo lo nivreu ella leshammesheni vaani nivreti leshammesh et koni eno din sheetparnes shello betzaar ella shehorati maasay vekippachti et parnasati

Abba guryan ish tzayedan omer mishshum abba gurya lo yelammed adam et beno chammar gammal kaddar sappan roe vechenvani sheummanutan ummanut listim rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo hachammarin rubban reshaim vehaggammalin rubban kesherin hassappanin rubban chasidim tov shebbarofim legehinnam vehakkasher shebbattabbachim shuttafo shel amalek

Rabbi nehoray omer manniach ani kol ummanut shebbaolam veeni melammed et beni ella tora sheadam ochel missecharah baolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba ushar kol ummaniyyot enan ken kesheadam ba lide choli o lide zikna o lide yissurin veeno yachol laasok bimlachto hare hu met baraav aval hattora enah ken ella meshammarto mikkol ra benaaruto venotenet lo acharit vetikva beziknuto

Benaaruto mahu omer vekoye Adonai yachalifu choach beziknuto mahu omer od yenuvun beseva vechen hu omer beavraham avinu veavraham zaken va berach et avraham bakkol matzinu sheasa avraham avinu et kal hattora kullah ad shello nitna shenneemar ekev asher shama avraham bekoli vayyishmor mishmarti mitzotay chukkotay vetorotay

Gema tanu rabbanan kol sheasakav im hannashim soro ra kegon hatztzorfim vehassarekim vehannakorot veharochlin vehaggardiyyim vehassapparim vehakkovsim vehaggara vehabballan vehabburseki en maamidim mehem lo melech velo kohen gadol may tama la mishshum difsili ella mishshum dezil ummanutayehu
Tanu rabbanan asara devarim neemru begara mehallech al tzido verucho gassa venitle veoshev veeno tzara veeno raa ochel harbe umotzi kima vechashud al haaraot veal haggazel veal shefichut damim
Darash bar kappara leolam yelammed adam et beno ummanut nekiyya vekalla may hi amar rav yehuda
b: Machta detalmiyyuta

Tanya rabbi omer en lecha ummanut sheoveret min haolam ashre mi sheroe et horav beummanut meulla oy lo lemi sheroe et horav beummanut peguma i efshar laolam belo bassam uvlo burseki ashre mi sheummanuto bassam veoy lo lemi sheummanuto burseki i efshar leolam belo zecharim uvlo nekevot ashre mi shebbanav zecharim veoy lo lemi shebbanav nekevot

Rabbi meir omer leolam yelammed adam livno ummanut nekiyya vekalla vivakkesh rachamim lemi shehaosher vehannechasim shello sheen aniyyut min haummanut veen ashirut min haummanut ella lemi shehaosher shello shenneemar li hakkesef veli hazzahav neum Adonai tzevaot

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer im raita miyyamecha tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer miyyamay lo raiti tzevi kayyatz vaari sabbal veshual chenvani vehem mitparnesim shello betzaar vehem lo nivreu ella leshammesheni vaani nivreti leshammesh et koni ma ellu shello nivreu ella leshammesheni mitparnesim shello betzaar vaani shennivreti leshammesh et koni eno din sheetparnes shello betzaar ella shehareoti et maasay vekipachti et parnasati shenneemar aonotechem hittu

Rabbi nehoray omer manniach ani kol ummanut vechu tanya rabbi nehoray omer manniach ani kol ummanut shebbaolam veeni melammed et beni ella tora shekkol ummanut shebbaolam en omedet lo ella bime yalduto aval bime ziknuto hare hu muttal baraav aval tora enah ken omedet lo laadam beet yalduto venotenet lo acharit vetikva beet ziknuto beet yalduto mahu omer vekoye Adonai yachalifu choach yaalu ever kannesharim beziknuto mahu omer od yenuvun beseva deshenim veraanannim yihu
Hadaran alach asara yuchasin uslika lah massechet kidushin

a: Matni arbaa avot nezikin hashshor vehabbor vehammave vehahever
Lo hare hashshor kahare hammave velo hare hammave kahare hashshor velo ze vaze sheyyesh bahen ruach chayyim kahare haesh sheen bo ruach chayyim
Velo ze vaze sheddarkan lelech ulhazzik kahare habbor sheen darko lelech ulhazzik
Hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheddarkan lehazzik ushmiratan alecha uchshehizzik chav hammazzik leshallem tashlume nezek bemetav haaretz
Gema middekatane avot mikkelal deika toldot toldotehen kayyotze bahen o lav kayyotze bahen
Gabbe shabbat tenan avot melachot arbaim chaser achat avot mikkelal deika toladot
Toldotehen kayyotze bahen la shena av chattat vela shena tolada chattat la shena av sekila vela shena tolada sekila
Umay ika ben av letolada nafka minah deilu aved shette avot bahade hadade i name shette toladot bahade hadade michayyav akkol chada vachada veilu aved av vetolada dideh la michayyav ella chada
Ulrabbi eliezer dimchayyev attolada bimkom av ammay kare leh av veammay kare lah tolada hach dahava bemishkan chashiva kare leh av hach dela have bemishkan chashiva kare lah tolada
Gabbay tumot tenan avot hattumot hashsheretz vehashichvat zera
b: Utme met toldotehen lav kayyotze bahen deilu av metamme adam vechelim veilu toladot ochalin umashkin metamme adam vechelim lo metamme
Hacha may amar rav pappa yesh mehen kayyotze bahen veyesh mehen lav kayyotze bahen
Tanu rabbanan shelosha avot neemru beshor hakkeren vehashshen veharegel

Keren menalan detanu rabbanan ki yiggach en negicha ella keren shenneemar vayyaas lo tzidkiyya ven kenaana karne varzel vayyomer ko amar Adonai beelle tenaggach et aram vego veomer bechor shoro hadar lo vekarne reem karnav bahem ammim yenaggach
May veomer vechi tema divre tora middivre kabbala la yalfinan ta shema bechor shoro hadar lo
Vehay melaf hu giluy milta bealma hu dingicha bekeren hu
Ella mahu detema ki palleg rachamana ben tam lemuad hane mile bitlusha aval bimchubberet ema kullah muedet hi
Ta shema bechor shoro hadar lo vego
Tolada dekeren may hi negifa neshicha revitza uvita
May shena negicha dekare lah av dichtiv ki yiggach negifa name ketiv ki yiggof hay negifa negicha hi detanya patach bingifa vesiyyem bingicha lomar lach zo hi negifa zo hi negicha
May shena gabbe adam dichtiv ki yiggach umay shena gabbe behema dichtiv ki yiggof
Adam deit leh mazzala ketiv ki yiggach behema delet lah mazzala ketiv ki yiggof
Umilleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan demuad leadam have muad livhema umuad livhema la have muad leadam
Neshicha tolada deshen hi la shen yesh hanaa lehezzekah ha en hanaa lehezzekah
Revitza uvita tolada deregel hi la regel hezzekah matzuy hane en hezzekan matzuy
Ella toldotehen lav kayyotze bahen deamar rav pappa aheya
Ilema ahane may shena keren dechauonato lehazzik umamoncha ushmirato alecha hane name kauonatan lehazzik umamoncha ushmiratan alecha
Ella tolada dekeren kekeren vechi kaamar rav pappa ashshen varegel
Shen varegel hecha ketivi detanya veshillach ze haregel vechen hu omer meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor
Uvier zo hashshen vechen hu omer kaasher yevaer

a: Haggalal ad tummo
Amar mar veshillach zo haregel vechen hu omer meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor tama dichtav rachamana meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor ha lav hachi bemay mokmatte lah
I keren ketiv i shen ketiv
Itzterich salka datach amena ide veide ashshen veha demikkalya karna ha dela mikkalya karna ka mashma lan
Vehashta deokemna aregel shen dela mikkalya karna menalan
Dumya deregel ma regel la shena mikkalya karna vela shena la mikkalya karna af shen la shena mikkalya karna vela shena la mikkalya karna
Amar mar uvier zo hashshen vechen hu omer kaasher yevaer haggalal ad tummo tama dichtav rachamana kaasher yevaer haggalal ad tummo ha lav hachi bemay okemna lah
I keren ketiv i regel ketiv itzterich salka datach amena ide veide aregel ha deazel mimmela ha deshallach shalloche ka mashma lan
Vehashta deoke ashshen regel deazla mimmela menalan
Dumya deshen ma shen la shena shallechah shalloche la shena deazel mimmela af regel la shena shallechah shalloche la shena azla mimmela
Velichtov rachamana veshillach vela bae uvier demashma regel umashma shen mashma regel dichtiv meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor umashma shen dichtiv veshen behemot ashallach bam
I lav kera yattira hava amena o ha o ha o regel dehezzeko matzuy o shen deyesh hanaa lehezzeko
Mikkede shekulin hen vayyavou shenehem dehe minnayehu mappekatte itzterich salka datach amena hane mile hechi deshallach shalloche aval azla mimmela la ka mashma lan
Tolada deshen may hi nitchakkecha bechotel lahanaatah vetinfa perot lahanaatah
May shena shen deyesh hanaa lehezzeko umamoncha ushmirato alecha hane name yesh hanaa lehezzekan umamoncha ushmiratan alecha ella tolada deshen keshen vechi kaamar rav pappa attolada deregel
Tolada deregel may hi hizzika begufah derech hiluchah bisarah derech hiluchah bishlif shealeha bifrumbeya shebbefiha bezog shebbetzavarah
May shena regel dehezzeko matzuy umamoncha ushmirato alecha hane name hezzekan matzuy umamoncha ushmiratan alecha ella tolada deregel keregel vechi kaamar rav pappa attolada devor
Tolada devor may nihu ilema av asara vetolada tisha la tisha ketivi vela asara ketivi
Ha la kashya vehammet yihye lo amar rachamana vekim lehu lerabbanan asara avdan mita tisha nezikin avdi mita la avdi
Sof sof ze av lemita veze av linzakin
Ella aavno sakkino umassao shehinnichan birshut harabbim vehizziku
Hechi dame i deafkerinhu ben lerav uven lishmuel hayenu bor
b: Vei dela afkerinhu i lishmuel deamar kullam mibboro lamadnu hayenu bor vei lerav deamar kullam mishshoro lamadnu hayenu shor

May shena bor shekken techillat asiyyato lenezek umamoncha ushmirato alecha hane name techillat asiyyatan lenezek umamoncha ushmiratan alecha ella tolada devor kevor vechi kaamar rav pappa attolada demave
May nihu i lishmuel deamar mave zo shen ha okemna tolada deshen keshen i lerav deamar mave ze adam may avot umay toladot it beh
Vechi tema av neor tolada yashen vehatnan adam muad leolam ben er ben yashen
Ella akkicho venio hechi dame i bahade deazli kamazzeki kocho have i batar denayach ben lerav ben lishmuel hayenu bor ella tolada demave kemave vechi kaamar rav pappa attolada deesh
Tolada deesh may nihu ilema avno sakkino umassao shehinnichan berosh gaggo venaflu beruach metzuya vehizziku hechi dame i bahade deazlu ka mazzeki hayenu esh
May shena esh dechoach acher meorav bahen umamoncha ushmirato alecha hane name koach acher meorav bahen umamoncha ushmiratan alecha ella tolada deesh keesh vechi kaamar rav pappa attolada deregel
Regel ha okemna tolada deregel keregel bachatzi nezek tzerorot dehilcheta gemiri lah
Veammay kare lah tolada deregel leshallem min haaliyya
Veha mibbaya bae rava devae rava chatzi nezek tzerorot miggufo meshallem o min haaliyya meshallem
Lerava mibbaya leh lerav pappa peshita leh
Lerava demibbaya leh ammay kare lah tolada deregel lefotrah birshut harabbim
Hammave vehahever ku may mave rav amar mave ze adam ushmuel amar mave ze hashshen
Rav amar mave ze adam dichtiv amar shomer ata voker vegam layela im tivaun beau
Ushmuel amar mave ze hashshen dichtiv ech nechpesu esav nivu matzpunav may mashma kedimtargem rav yosef echden itbelesh esav itgallin matmorohi
Verav may tama la amar kishmuel amar lach mi katane nive
Ushmuel may tama la amar kerav amar lecha mi katane boe
Mikkede kerae la kemar dayeki vela kemar dayeki rav may tama la amar kishmuel tena shor vechol mile deshor
Ushmuel name ha tena leh shor amar rav yehuda tena shor lekarno umave leshino vehachi kaamar lo rei hakkeren sheen hanaa lehezzeko kiri hashshen sheyyesh hanaa lehezzekah

a: Velo rei hashshen sheen kauonato lehazzik kiri hakkeren shekkauonato lehazzik

Velav kal vachomer hu uma shen sheen kauonato lehazzik chayyav keren shekkauonato lehazzik lo kol shekken itzterich salka datach amena mide dehave aeved veama eved veama lav af al gav dechauonatan lehazzik afilu hachi petiri hachi name la shena
Amar rav ashe attu eved veama lav tama rabba it behu shemma yaknitennu rabbo veyelech veyadlik gedisho shel chavero venimtza ze mechayyev et rabbo mea mane bechol yom
Ella parech hachi lo rei hakkeren shekkauonato lehazzik kiri hashshen sheen kauonato lehazzik velo rei hashshen sheyyesh hanaa lehezzeko kiri hakkeren sheen hanaa lehezzeko
Veregel may shayereh keshehizzik chav hammazzik leetoye regel
Velitneyeh behedya

Ella amar rava tena shor leraglo umave leshino vehachi kaamar lo rei haregel shehezzekah matzuy kiri hashshen sheen hezzekah matzuy velo rei hashshen sheyyesh hanaa lehezzeko kiri haregel sheen hanaa lehezzeko
Vekeren may shayereh keshehizzik chav hammazzik leetoye keren
Velitneyeh behedya bemuadin mittechilatan kamayere betammin ulvassof muadin la kamayere
Ushmuel may tama la amar kerav amar lach i salka datach adam ha katane sefa shor hammuad veshor hammazzik birshut hannizak vehaadam
Velitne beresha benizke mamon kamayere benizke gufo la kamayere
Verav name ha katane adam besefa amar lecha rav hahu lemechsheveh bahade muadin hu daata
Umay lo hare
Hachi kaamar lo rei hashshor shemmeshallem et hakkofer kiri haadam sheen meshallem et hakkofer velo rei haadam shechayyav bearbaa devarim kiri hashshor sheen bo arbaa devarim
Hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheddarkan lehazzik vechi shor darko lehazzik bemuad umuad darko lehazzik kevan deiyyaad orcheh hu
Adam darko lehazzik beyashen yashen darko lehazzik kevan dechayef ufashet orcheh hu
Ushmiratan alecha adam shemirat gufo alav hu
Ultamach ha detane karna arbaa avot nezikin veadam echad mehen adam shemirat gufo alav hu ella kedaamar leh rabbi avahu letanna teni adam shemirat gufo alav
b: Hacha name teni adam shemirat gufo alav
Matkef lah rav mari veema mave ze hammayim kedichtiv kikdoach esh hamasim mayim tive esh mi ketiv mayim nivu tive esh ketiv
Matkef lah rav zevid veema mave ze haesh dechi ketiv tive beesh hu dichtiv i hachi may hammave vehahever vechi tema paroshe kamfaresh i hachi arbaa shelosha hau
Vechi tema tena shor deit beh tarte i hachi la ze veze sheyyesh bahen ruach chayyim esh may ruach chayyim it beh vetu may kahare haesh
Tane rabbi oshaya shelosha asar avot nezikin shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher nezek tzaar veripuy shevet uvoshet vearbaa dematnitin ha telesar
Vetanna didan may tama la tane hane bishlama lishmuel benizke mamon kamayere benizke gufo la kamayere ella lerav litne tanna adam vechol mile deadam
Ulrabbi oshaya name ha tane leh adam tere gavene adam tena adam deazzek adam vetanna adam deazzek shor
I hachi shor name litne tere gavene shor litne shor deazzek shor velitne shor deazzek adam
Hay may bishlama adam deazzek shor nezek hu dimshallem adam deazzek adam meshallem arbaa devarim ella shor ma li shor deazzek shor ma li shor deazzek adam ide veide nezek hu dimshallem
Veha shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher deadam deazzek shor hu vekatane
Tane hezzeka divyadayim vekatane hezzeka demimmela
Tane rabbi chiyya esrim vearbaa avot nezikin tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha vegannav vegazlan veedim zommin
Vehaones vehamfatte umotzi shem ra vehamtamme vehamdammea vehamnassech vehane telesar ha esrim vearbea
Verabbi oshaya may tama la tane hane bemamona kamayere biknasa la kamayere
Gannav vegazlan demamona hu litne ha katane leh shomer chinnam vehashshoel
Verabbi chiyya name ha tena leh shomer chinnam vehashshoel tane mamona daata lideh behetera vekatane mamona daata lideh beisura

a: Edim zommin demamona hu litne savar lah kerabbi akiva deamar en meshallemin al pi atzman
I savar leh kerabbi akiva litne tere gavene shor litne shor deazzek shor velitne shor deazzek adam
Ditnan rabbi akiva omer af tam shechaval beadam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem
Ha tavreh rabbi akiva ligzizeh detanya rabbi akiva omer yachol af tam shechaval beadam yeshallem min haaliyya talmud lomar yease lo miggufo meshallem veeno meshallem min haaliyya
Haones vehamfatte vehammotzi shem ra demamona hu litne
Ma nafshach i nezek tena leh i tzaar tena leh i boshet tena leh i pegam hayenu nezek ma it lach lememar kenasa biknasa la kamayere
Hamtamme vehamdammea vehamnassech demamona hu litne
Ma nafshach i hezek sheeno nikar shemeh hezek ha tena leh nezek i hezek sheeno nikar la shemeh hezek have leh kenasa uviknasa la kamayere
Lema kasavar rabbi chiyya hezek sheeno nikar la shemeh hezek dei shemeh hezek ha tena leh nezek tena hezeka deminachra utna hezeka dela minachra
Bishlama letanna didan tena minyana lemaote derabbi oshaya verabbi oshaya tena minyana lemaote derabbi chiyya ella minyana derabbi chiyya lemaote may
Lemaote moser umfaggel
Velitne bishlama mefaggel bekadashim la kamayere ella moser may tama la tane shane moser dedibura uvdibura la kamayere
Veha motzi shem ra dedibura hu vekatane dibura deit beh maase hu
Veha edim zommin dibura delet beh maase hu vekatane hatam af al gav delet beh maase rachamana karyeh maase dichtiv vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv
Bishlama letanna didan tanna avot mikkelal deika toldot ella lerabbi chiyya verabbi oshaya avot mikkelal deika toldot toldotehen may nihu
Amar rabbi avahu kullan keavot leshallem mimmetav
May tama atya tachat netina yeshallem kesef
Lo hare hashshor kahare hammave may kaamar amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava hachi kaamar lichtov rachamana chada vetete idach mineh hadar amar chada mechada la atya
Velo ze vaze sheyyesh bahen ruach chayyim may kaamar amar rav mesharsheya mishshemeh derava hachi kaamar
b: Lichtov rachamana tarte vetete idach minayehu hadar amar chada mittarte la ate
Amar rava vechullehu ki shadet bor benayehu atya kullehu bamme hatztzad levar mikkeren mishshum deika lemifrach ma lechullehu shekken muadin mittechilatan
Ulman deamar adderabba keren adifa shekkauonato lehazzik afilu keren name atya
Ella lemay hilcheta katvinhu rachamana lehilchotehen
Keren lechallek ben tamma lemuedet
Shen varegel lefotran birshut harabbim
Bor liftor bo et hakkelim ulrabbi yehuda dimchayyev al nizke chelim bevor liftor bo et haadam
Adam lechayevo bearbaa devarim
Esh liftor bo et hattamun ulrabbi yehuda dimchayyev al nizke tamun baesh leetoye may

a: Leetoye lichacha niro vesichsecha avanav
Hatztzad hashshave shebbahen leetoye may amar abbaye leetoye avno sakkino umassao shehinnichan berosh gaggo venaflu beruach metzuya vehizziku
Hechi dame i bahade deka azli ka mazzeki hayenu esh
May shena esh dechoach acher meorav bo umamoncha ushmirato alecha hane name koach acher meorav bahen umamoncha ushmirato alecha
Veella batar denayechi i deafkerinhu ben lerav ben lishmuel hayenu bor
May shena bor shekken techilat asiyyato lenezek umamoncha ushmiratan alecha hane name techilat asiyyatan lenezek umamoncha ushmiratan alecha
Ella dela afkerinhu lishmuel deamar kullam mibboro lamadnu hayenu bor
Leolam deafkerinhu vela damu levor ma levor shekken en koach acher meorav bo tomar behane shekkoach acher meorav bahen
Esh tochiach
Ma leesh shekken darko lelech ulhazzik
Bor tochiach vechazar haddin
Rava amar leetoye bor hammitgalgel beragle adam uvragle behema
Hechi dame i deafkerinhu ben lerav ben lishmuel hayenu bor
May shena bor shekken techilat asiyyato lenezek ushmirato alecha hane name techilat asiyyatan lenezek ushmiratan alecha
Ella dela afkerinhu lishmuel deamar kullam mibboro lamadnu hayenu bor
Leolam deafkerinhu vela dame levor ma levor shekken maasav garmu lo tomar behane sheen maasav garmu lo
Shor yochiach
Ma leshor shekken darko lelech ulhazzik bor tochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze chiri ze

Rav adda bar ahava amar leetoye ha detanya kol ellu sheamru potkin bivotehen vegorfin mearotehen bimot hachamma en lahem reshut bimot haggeshamim yesh lahem reshut af al pi shebbirshut im hizziku chayyavim leshallem
Hechi dame i bahade dekaazli mazzeki kocho hu

Ella batar denayach hechi dame i deafkerinhu ben lerav ben lishmuel hayenu bor may shena bor ditchilat asiyyato lenezek umamoncha ushmirato alecha hane name techilat asiyyatan lenezek umamoncha ushmiratan alecha
Ella dela afkerinhu lishmuel deamar kullam mibboro lamadnu hayenu bor
Leolam deafkerinhu vela dame levor ma levor shekken shello birshut tomar behane devirshut
b: Shor yochiach
Ma leshor shekken darko lelech ulhazzik
Bor tochiach vechazar haddin

Ravina amar leetoye ha ditnan hakkotel vehailan shennaflu lirshut harabbim vehizziku patur milleshallem natnu lo zeman lakotz et hailan velistor et hakkotel venaflu betoch hazzeman vehizziku patur leachar hazzeman chayyav
Hechi dame i deafkereh ben lerav ben lishmuel hayenu bor may shena bor dehezzeko matzuy ushmirato alecha hane name hezzekan matzuy ushmiratan alecha
I dela afkerinhu lishmuel deamar kullam mibboro lamadnu hayenu bor
Leolam deafkerinhu vela dame levor ma levor shekken techilat asiyyato lenezek tomar behane sheen techilat asiyyatan lenezek
Shor yochiach
Ma leshor shekken darko lelech ulhazzik
Bor tochiach vechazar haddin
Keshehizzik chav hammazzik chav hammazzik chayyav hammazzik mibe leh amar rav yehuda amar rav hay tanna yerushalmi hu detane lishana kallila
Leshallem tashlume nezek tanu rabbanan metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem metav sadehu shel nizak umetav karmo shel nizak divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer lo ba hakkatuv ella ligbot lannizzakin min haidit vekal vachomer lahekdesh
Verabbi yishmael achal shemena meshallem shemena achal kechusha meshallem shemena
Amar rav idi bar avin hacha bemay askinan kegon sheachal aruga ben haarugot vela yadinan i kechusha achal i shemena achal dimshallem shemena
Amar rava uma ilu yadinan dichchusha achal la meshallem ella kechusha hashta dela yadinan i kechusha achal i shemena achal meshallem shemena hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov hacha bemay askinan kegon shehayeta idit denizak keziburit demazzik
Uvha peligi rabbi yishmael savar bidnizak shayeminan verabbi akiva savar bidmazzik shayeminan
May tama derabbi yishmael neemar sade lematta veneemar sade lemala ma sade haamur lemala denizak af sade haamur lematta denizak
Verabbi akiva metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem dehayeche deka meshallem
Verabbi yishmael ahani gezera shava veahni kera ahani gezera shava kidkaamena
Ahani kera kegon deit leh lemazzik idit veziburit veidit lenizak veziburit demazzik la shaveya keidit denizak dimshallem leh mimmetav dideh
Dela matze amar leh ta atte gevi mizziburit ella gevi mimmetav
Rabbi akiva omer lo ba hakkatuv ella ligbot lannizakin min haidit vekal vachomer lahekdesh may kal vachomer lahekdesh
Ilema dingach tora didan letora dehekdesh shor reehu amar rachamana velo shor shel hekdesh
Ella laomer hare alay mane levedek habbayit deate gizbar veshakel meidit
Lo yehe ella baal chov

a: Uvaal chov bevenonit
Vechi tema savar rabbi akiva baal chov name beidit ika lemifrach ma levaal chov shekken yippa kocho benizzakin tomar behekdesh shehora kocho benizzakin
Leolam dingach tora didan letora dehekdesh udka kashya lach shor reehu amar rachamana velo shor shel hekdesh rabbi akiva savar lah kerabbi shimon ben menasya
Detanya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer shor shel hekdesh shennagach shor shel hedot patur shor shel hedot shennagach shor shel hekdesh ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem
I hachi rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva mimmay dividit denizak veziburit demazzik peligi dilma dechulle alma bidnizak shayeminan vehacha biflugta derabbi shimon ben menasya verabbanan kamippalgi
Rabbi akiva savar kerabbi shimon ben menasya verabbi yishmael savar kerabbanan
Im ken may lo ba hakkatuv
Veod may kal vachomer lahekdesh

Veod ha amar rav ashe tanya behedya metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem metav sadehu shel nizak umetav karmo shel nizak divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer metav sadehu shel mazzik umetav karmo shel mazzik
Rame leh abbaye lerava ketiv metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem metav in mide acharina la
Vehatanya yashiv lerabbot shave kesef vaafilu subbin
La kashya kan middato kan beal korcho
Amar ulla bereh derav ilay dayeka name dichtiv yeshallem beal korcho
Amar leh abbaye mi ketiv yeshullam yeshallem ketiv middato mashma
Ella amar abbaye kidmar detanya hare shehau lo battim sadot uchramim veeno motze lemochran maachilin oto masar ani ad mechetza
Vehave bah mar hechi dame i huzal dezul arata dechulle alma vedideh name zal bahadayehu afilu tuva name lispe leh deha zul dechulle alma name
Ella deokir arata dechulle alma vedideh ayede deayel venafek azzuze zal areh
b: Afilu purta name la lispo leh
Veamar mar alah la tzericha divome nisan yakra arata uvome tishre zal arata
Dechulle alma natri ad nisan umzabbeni vehay hoil veitztericha leh zuze zaven kidhashta ad palga orcheh lemezal tefe lav orcheh lemezal
Vehacha name gabbe nizzakin dineh beidit
Vei amar leh ihu hav li benonit tefe purta amar leh i shaklatte kedinach shekol kidhashta vei la shekol ki yukra dilkammeh
Matkef lah rav acha bar yaakov im ken horata kochan shel nizzakin etzel benonit veziburit derachamana amar mimmetav veatte amratte mibbenonit veziburit name la

Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov i ika ledammoye levaal chov medammenan leh baal chov dineh bevenonit vei amar leh hav li ziburit tefe purta amar leh i shaklatte kedinach shekol kidhashta vei la shekol ki yukra dilkammeh
Matkef lah rav acha bereh derav ika im ken naalta delet bifne lovin deamar leh ilu hao li zuze hava shekali kidhashta hashta dezuze gabbach eshkol keukra dilkammeh

Ella amar rav acha bereh derav ika i ika ledammoye lichtubbat ishsha medammenan deha ketubbat ishsha dina beziburit vei amra leh ihi hav li benonit betzir purta amar lah i shaklatte kedinich shekuli kidhashta vei la shekuli keukra dilkammeh
Mikkol makom kashya
Amar rava kol deyahev leh mimmetav litev leh
Veha metav sadehu ketiv

Ella ki ata rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua mibbe rav parshuha kol mile metav hu dei la mizdabban hacha mizdabban bemata achariti levar meara delitev leh mimmetav ki hechi delikpotz alah zavona
Bea mineh rav shemuel bar abba meakronya merabbi abba keshehen shamin beshello hen shamin o beshel olam hen shamin
Alliba derabbi yishmael la tibbee lach deamar bidnizak shayeminan
Ki tibbee lach alliba derabbi akiva deamar bidmazzik shayeminan
May metav sadehu amar rachamana lemaote denizak o dilma lemaote dealma name
Amar leh rachamana amar metav sadehu veatte amratte beshel olam hen shamin
Etiveh en lo ella idit kullam govin min haidit benonit kullam govin benonit ziburit kullam govin ziburit

Hau lo idit uvenonit veziburit nizzakin beidit uvaal chov bevenonit uchtubbat ishsha beziburit idit uvenonit nizzakin beidit baal chov uchtubbat ishsha bevenonit benonit veziburit nizzakin uvaal chov bevenonit uchtubbat ishsha beziburit

a: Idit veziburit nizzakin beidit uvaal chov uchtubbat ishsha beziburit
Katane miha metzia benonit veziburit nizzakin uvaal chov bevenonit uchtubbat ishsha beziburit vei amratte beshello hen shamin tease benonit shello keidit veyidche baal chov etzel ziburit
Hacha bemay askinan kegon shehayeta lo idit umcharah
Vechen amar rav chisda kegon shehayeta lo idit umcharah
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane achariti benonit veziburit nizzakin bevenonit baal chov uchtubbat ishsha beziburit kashyan ahadade
Ella lav shema minah kan shehayeta lo idit umcharah kan shello hayeta lo idit umcharah
Vei baet ema ide veide shello hayeta lo idit umcharah vela kashya ha deshaveya benonit shello keidit dealma vechan dela shaveya benonit shello keidit dealma
Veibaet ema ide veide kegon shehayeta benonit shello kevenonit dealma vehacha beha peligi mar savar beshello hen shamin umar savar beshel olam hen shamin

Ravina amar bidulla peligi deamar ulla devar tora baal chov beziburit shenneemar bachutz taamod vehaish asher atta noshe vo yotzi elecha et haavot hachutza ma darko shel adam lehotzi lachutz pachut shebbakkelim uma taam amru baal chov bevenonit kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin
Mar it leh takkanta deulla umar let leh takkanta deulla
Tanu rabbanan machar leechad o lishlosha bene adam keechad kullan nichnesu tachat habbealim
Beze achar ze kullan govin min haacharon en lo gove mishshellefanav en lo gove mishshellifne fanav
Mecharan leechad hechi dame
Ilema bevat achat hashta lishlosha deika lememar chad minayehu kadem amratte kullan nichnesu tachat habbealim mecharan leechad mibaya
Ella peshita beze achar ze
Umay shena shelosha dechol chad vechad amar leh hinnachti lecha makom ligbot mimmennu
