Hay name akkol chad vechad lema leh hinnachti lecha makom ligbot mimmennu
Hacha bemay askinan kegon shellakach idit baacharona vechen amar rav sheshet kegon shellakach idit baacharona
I hachi leto kullehu veligbo meidit
Mishshum deamar lehu i shatkitu veshaklitu kedinayechu shaklitu vei la mahdarna shetara deziburit lemareh veshaklitu kullechu mizziburit
I hachi
b: Benizzakin name nema hachi
Ella hacha bemay askinan beyatme delav bene feraon ninhu veshibuda dileh aleh dideh ramya
Hilkach leka lememar hachi
Ella mishshum deamar lehu tama may amur rabbanan en nifrain minnechasin meshubadim bemakom sheyyesh bene chorin mishshum takkanta didi ana beha takkanta la nicha li
Kidrava deamar rava kol haomer i efshi betakkanat chachamim kegon zo shomin lo
May kegon zo
Kidrav huna deamar rav huna yechola ishsha shettomar levalah eni nizonet veeni osa
Peshita machar lokeach benonit veziburit veshiyyer idit lefanav leto kullehu veligbo meidit
Deha acharona hi uvenonit veziburit letanhu gabbeh dematze lememar lehu gevo mibbenonit veziburit dela nicha li betakkanta derabbanan
Aval machar idit veshiyyer benonit veziburit may
Sevar abbaye lememar atu kullehu gavu meidit

Amar leh rava ma machar rishon lashsheni kol zechut shettavo leyado vechevan deilu atu gabbe lokeach rishon matze agbe lehu leagboyinhu mibbenonit veziburit veaf al pi dechi zavninhu levenonit veziburit akkatti idit bene bat chorin havay veen nifrain minnechasim meshubadim kol zeman deika bene chorin matze amar lehu la nicha li behay takkana
Lokeach sheni name matze amar lehu geve benonit veziburit dechi zaven lokeach sheni addata dechol zechuta dahava leh lerishon begavah zaven
Amar rava reuven shemmachar kol sedotav leshimon vehalach shimon umachar sade achat lelevi uva baal chov diruven ratza mizze gove ratza mizze gove vela amaran ella dizvan benonit
Aval zevan idit veziburit la daamar leh lehachi deyaki uzvani idit veziburit ara dela chazya lach

Vaafilu zevan benonit name la amaran ella dela shayyar benonit dichotah dela matze amar leh hinnachti lecha makom legabbe shimon aval shayyar benonit dichotah gabbe shimon la gave mineh dematze amar leh hinnachti lecha makom ligbot mimmennu

Amar abbaye reuven shemmachar sade leshimon beachraut vaata baal chov diruven utraf mishshimon dina hu deazel reuven umishtae dina bahadeh vela matze amar leh lav baal devarim didi atte deamar leh i mappekatte mineh alay hadar
Veika deamri afilu shello beachraut name deamar leh la nicha li detehve leshimon taromet alay
Veamar abbaye reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beachraut

a: Veyatzu aleha asikin ad shello hechzik bah yachol lachazor bo mishshehechzik bah en yachol lachazor bo
May tama deamar leh chayeta dekitre sevarte vekabbelte
Meemat havay chazaka mikki dayesh ammitzre
Vedaveka shello beachraut aval beachraut la
Veika deamri afilu beachraut name daamar leh achvi tirfach vaashallem lach
Rav huna amar o kesef o metav
Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna yashiv lerabbot shave kesef afilu subbin
Hacha bemay askinan bidlet leh i delet leh peshita mahu detema amrinan leh zil terach zabben veayeti leh kesaf ka mashma lan
Amar rav assi kesafim hare hen kekarka lemay hilcheta ilema leinyan metav hayenu derav huna
Ella lishne achim shechalku venatal echad karka veechad kesafim uva baal chov venatal karka deazel hay veshakel palga bichsafim bahadeh
Peshita hay bera vehay lav bera
Ika deamri adderabba leidach gisa daamar leh lehachi shekali kesafim dei migganvi la mishtallamna minach ulhachi shaklatte ara dei mittarfa la mishtallema lach mide minay
Ella lishne achim shechalku uva baal chov venatal chelko shel echad mehen
Veha amrah rav assi chada zimna deitmar haachim shechalku uva baal chov venatal chelko shel echad mehen rav amar batla machloket ushmuel amar viter verav assi amar notel revia bekarka urvia bemaot
Rav amar batla machloket kasavar haachim shechalku keorshim hau
Ushmuel amar viter kasavar haachim shechalku lakochot uchlokeach shello beachraut dame
Verav assi amar notel revia bekarka urvia bemaot mesappeka leh i keorshin damu i kelakochot damu hilkach notel revia bekarka urvia bemaot
Ella may hare hen kekarka leinyan metav
I hachi hayenu derav huna ema vechen amar rav assi
Amar rabbi zera amar rav huna bemitzva ad shelish
May shelish
b: Ilema shelish beto ella meatta i itremi leh telata mitzvata litev lechulleh beteh
Ella amar rabbi zera behidur mitzva ad shelish bemitzva
Bae rav ashe shelish millegav o shelish millevar teku
Bemareva amri mishshemeh derabbi zera ad shelish mishshello mikkan veelach mishshel hakkadosh baruch hu
Matni kol shechavti bishmirato hichsharti et nizko hichsharti bemiktzat nizko chavti betashlume nizko kehechsher kol nizko
Nechasim sheen bahen meila nechasim shehen shel bene berit nechasim hamuchadim
Uvchol makom chutz mershut hamuchedet lammazzik
Urshut hannizak vehammazzik
Keshehizzik chav hammazzik leshallem tashlume nezek bemetav haaretz
Gema tanu rabbanan kol shechavti bishmirato hichsharti et nizko ketzad shor uvor shemmesaran lecheresh shote vekatan vehizziku chayyav leshallem ma sheen ken beesh
Bemay askinan ilema beshor kashur uvor mechusse dichotah gabbe esh gachelet may shena hacha umay shena hacha

Ella beshor muttar uvor megulle dichotah gabbe esh shalhevet ma sheen ken beesh defatur veha amar resh lakish mishshemeh dechizkiyya lo shanu ella shemmasar lo gachelet velibah aval shalhevet chayyav may tama deha bari hezzeka
Leolam beshor kashur uvor mechusse vedichotah gabbe esh gachelet udka amratte may shena hacha umay shena hacha
Shor darkeh lenattoke bor darkeh lenattore gachelet kamma deshavek lah mima amya veazla
Ulrabbi yochanan deamar afilu masar lo shalhevet name patur dichotah hacha beshor muttar uvor megulle may shena hacha umay shena hacha
Hatam tzevata decheresh ka garem hacha la tzevata decheresh ka garem
Tanu rabbanan chomer beshor mibbevor chomer bevor mibbeshor

Chomer beshor mibbevor shehashshor meshallem et hakkofer vechayyav bishloshim shel eved nigmar dino asur bahanaa vedarko lelech ulhazzik ma sheen ken bevor chomer bevor mibbeshor shehabbor techilat asiyyato lenezek umuad mittechilato ma sheen ken beshor

a: Chomer beshor mibbeesh chomer beesh mibbeshor

Chomer beshor mibbeesh shehashshor meshallem kofer vechayyav bishloshim shel eved nigmar dino asur bahanaa mesaro lecheresh shote vekatan chayyav ma sheen ken beesh chomer beesh mibbeshor shehaesh muedet mittechilatah ma sheen ken beshor
Chomer beesh mibbevor vechomer bevor mibbeesh

Chomer bevor mibbeesh shettechilat asiyyato lenezek mesaro lecheresh shote vekatan chayyav ma sheen ken beesh chomer beesh mibbevor shehaesh darkah lelech ulhazzik umuedet leechol ben davar harauy lah uven davar sheeno rauy lah ma sheen ken bevor
Velitne chomer beshor mibbevor shehashshor chiyyev bo et hakkelim ma sheen ken bevor
Ha manni rabbi yehuda hi dimchayyev al nizke chelim bevor

I rabbi yehuda ema sefa chomer beesh mibbevor shehaesh darkah lelech ulhazzik umuedet leechol ben davar harauy lah uven davar sheeno rauy lah ma sheen ken bevor davar harauy lah may ninhu etzim davar sheen rauy lah may ninhu kelim ma sheen ken bevor i rabbi yehuda ha amratte mechayyev haya rabbi yehuda al nizke chelim bevor
Ella leolam rabbanan hi utna veshayyar may shayyar dehay shayyar shayyar tamun
Ibaet ema leolam rabbi yehuda vedavar sheen rauy lah lav leetoye kelim ella leetoye lichacha niro vesichsecha avanav
Matkef lah rav ashe litne chomer beshor mibbevor shehashshor chiyyev bo shor pesule hammukdashin ma sheen ken bevor
I amratte bishlama rabbanan hi ayede deshayyar hach shayyar name hach ella i amratte rabbi yehuda may shayyar dehay shayyar
Shayyar dash beniro i mishshum dash beniro lav shiyyura hu dehakatane shekken darko lelech ulhazzik
Hichsharti bemiktzat nizko
Tanu rabbanan hichsharti miktzat nizko chavti betashlume nizko kehechsher kol nizko ketzad hachofer bor tisha uva acher vehishlimo laasara haacharon chayyav
Udla kerabbi detanya hachofer bor tisha uva acher vehishlimo laasara acharon chayyav rabbi omer achar acharon lemita achar shenehem linzakin
Rav pappa amar lemita vedivre hakkol
Ika deamri lema dela kerabbi amar rav pappa lemita vedivre hakkol
Matkef lah rabbi zera vetu leka veha ika masar shoro lachamishsha bene adam ufasha bo echad mehen vehizzik chayyav
Hechi dame ilema divlav ihu la hava mintar peshita deihu kaaved ella divlav ihu name mintar may kaaved
Matkef lah rav sheshet veha ika marbe bachavila
Hechi dame
b: I divlav ihu la azla peshita ella divlav ihu azla may ka aved
Matkef lah rav pappa veha ika ha detanya chamishsha sheyyashvu al safsal echad velo shevaruhu uva echad veyashav alav ushvaro haacharon chayyav veamar rav pappa kegon pappa bar abba
Hechi dame ilema divlav ihu la itvar peshita ella divlav ihu name itvar may kaaved
Sof sof matnita hecha mittartza
La tzericha divlav ihu have mitvar bitre shae vehashta itvar bachada shaa deamri leh i lav atte have yatvinan tefe purta vekayemin
Velema lehu i lav attun bedidi la hava mitvar
La tzericha devahade desamech behu tevar
Peshita
Mahu detema kocho lav kegufo dame ka mashma lan dechocho kegufo dame dechol hecha degufo tavar kocho name tavar

Vetu leka veha ika ha detanya hikkuhu asara bene adam beeser maklot ben bevat achat ben baze achar ze vamet kullan peturin rabbi yehuda ben betera omer beze achar ze haacharon chayyav mippene shekkerav et mitato
Biktala la kamayere
Veibaet ema biflugta la kamayere vela veha okemnan dela kerabbi dela kerabbi uchrabbanan mokminan kerabbi yehuda ben betera vela kerabbanan la mokminan
Chavti betashlume nizko chavti benizko la katane ella betashlume nizko
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan tashlume nezek melammed shehabbealim mittappelin bannevela
Mena hane mile amar rabbi amme deamar kera makke nefesh behema yeshallemenna al tikre yeshallemenna ella yashlimenna
Rav kahana amar mehacha im tarof yittaref yeviehu ed hatterefa lo yeshallem ad terefa yeshallem terefa atzmah lo yeshallem
Chizkiyya amar mehacha vehammet yihye lo lannizak
Vechen tana deve chizkiyya vehammet yihye lo lannizak atta omer lannizak o eno ella lammazzik amarta lo kach haya
May lo kach haya
Amar abbaye i salka datach nevela demazzik haveya lichtov rachamana shor tachat hashshor velishtok vehammet yihye lo lema li shema minah lannizak
Utzricha dei ketav rachamana makke behema yeshallemenna mishshum dela shechicha aval terefa dishchicha ema la tzericha
Vei ashmoinan terefa mishshum demimmela aval makke behema divyadayim ema la
Vei ashmoinan hane tarte ha mishshum dela shechicha veha mishshum demimmela aval vehammet yihye lo dishchicha uvyadayim ema la
Vei ashmoinan hammet yihye lo mishshum demamona ka mazzek aval hacha divgufa mazzek ema la tzericha
Amar leh rav kahana lerav ella tama dichtav rachamana vehammet yihye lo ha lav hachi hava amena nevela demazzik haveya
Hashta i it leh ledideh kamma terefot yahev leh deamar mar yashiv lerabbot shave kesef vaafilu subbin dideh mibbaya
Lo nitzrecha ella lifchat nevela
Lema pechat nevela tannae hi detanya im tarof yittaref yeviehu ed

a: Yavi edim shennitrefa beones ufatur abba shaul omer yavi aduda levet din
May lav beha kamipalgi demar savar pechat nevela denizak have umar savar demazzik have
La dechulle alma denizak vehacha betorach nevela kamipalgi
Vehatanya acherim omrim minnayin sheal baal habbor lehaalot shor mibboro talmud lomar kesef yashiv livalav vehammet
Amar leh abbaye lerava hay torach nevela hechi dame
Ilema divvera shaveya zuza veaggudda shaveya arba ki tarach bidnafsheh tarach
Amar leh la tzericha divvera shaveya zuza veaggudda name shaveya zuza
Umi ika kehay gavena in deha amri inashe keshura bemata bezuza keshura bedavra bezuza
Amar shemuel en shamin lo legannav velo legazlan ella lenizzakin vaani omer af leshoel veabba mode li
Ibaya lehu hachi kaamar af leshoel shamin veabba mode li o dilma hachi kaamar vaani omer af leshoel en shamin veabba mode li
Ta shema dehahu gavra dishel narga mechavreh tavreh ata lekammeh derav amar leh zil shallem leh narga mealleya shema minah en shamin
Adderabba middeamri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav dina hachi ushtek shema minah shamin
Itmar amar ulla amar rabbi elazar shamin legannav ulgazlan rav pappe amar en shamin vehilcheta en shamin lo legannav velo legazlan aval leshoel shamin kidrav kahana verav assi
Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar shilya sheyyatzta miktzatah beom rishon umiktzatah beom sheni monin lah min harishon
Amar leh rava ma datach lechumra
Chumra deate lide kulla hu deka metaharatte lah merishon
Ella amar rava lachosh chosheshet mimna la mmanya ella lesheni
May ka mashma lan deen miktzat shilya belo valad tenena shilya sheyyatzta miktzatah asura baachila siman valad beishsha siman valad bivhema
I mimmatnita hava amena
b: Deyesh miktzat shilya belo valad ugzera miktzatah attu kullah ka mashma lan
Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar bechor shennitraf betoch sheloshim yom en podin oto
Vechen tane rame bar chama mittoch shenneemar pado tifde yachol afilu nitraf betoch sheloshim yom talmud lomar ach chillek
Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar behema gassa niknet bimshicha
Veha anan tenan bimsira hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya vachachamim omrim zo vazo bimshicha rabbi shimon omer zo vazo behagbaha
Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar haachin shechalku ma shealehen shamin uma sheal benehen uvnotehen en shamin
Amar rav pappa peamim af ma shealehen en shamin mashkachatte lah bigdol ache denicha lehu delishtamun mileh

Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar shomer shemmasar leshomer patur vela mibaya shomer chinnam shemmasar leshomer sachar dealloye alleyah lishmirato ella afilu shomer sachar shemmasar leshomer chinnam dehashta garoe garah lishmirato name patur shehare masar leven daat
Rava amar shomer shemmasar leshomer chayyav vela mibaya shomer sachar shemmasar leshomer chinnam degaroe garah lishmirato ella afilu shomer chinnam shemmasar leshomer sachar chayyav
Deamar leh atte mehemnatte li bishvua hay la meheman li bishvua
Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar hilcheta govin min haavadim
Amar leh rav nachman leulla amar rabbi elazar afilu miyyatme la mineh mineh afilu miggelima deal katpeh
Hacha bemay askinan sheasao appoteke kidrava deamar rava asa avdo appoteke umcharo baal chov gove hemennu shoro appoteke umcharo en baal chov gove hemennu
May tama ha it leh kala veha let leh kala

a: Levatar dinfak amar lehu ulla hachi amar rabbi elazar afilu miyyatme amar rav nachman ishtemitan ulla
Hava ovada binhardea veagbo dayyane dinhardea hava ovada befumbedita veagbeyeh rav chana bar bizna amar lehu rav nachman zilu ahaduru vei la magbinan lechu leappadnayechu
Amar leh rava lerav nachman ha ulla ha rabbi elazar ha dayyane dinhardea veha rav chana bar bizna mar keman sevira leh
Amar leh ana matnita yadana detane avimi perozbul chal al hakkarka veeno chal al haavadim mittaltelin niknin im hakkarka veenan niknin im haavadim
Lema ketannae

Machar lo avadim vekarkaot hechzik baavadim lo kana karkaot bekarkaot lo kana avadim karkaot umittaltelin hechzik bekarka kana mittaltelin bemittaltelin lo kana karka avadim umittaltelin hechzik baavadim lo kana mittaltelin bemittaltelin lo kana avadim
Vehatanya hechzik baavadim kana mittaltelin
May lav beha kamippalgi demar savar avadim kimkarkee dame umar savar avadim kemittaltelin dame
Amar rav ika bereh derav amme dechulle alma avadim kimkarkee dame vehadtanya kana shappir vehadtanya lo kana baenan karka dumya dearim metzurot bihuda dela nayedi

Ditnan nechasim sheen lahem achraut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahem achraut bechesef bishtar uvachazaka menahane mile amar chizkiyya deamar kera vayyitten lahem avihem mattanot rabbot lechesef ulzahav ulmigdanot im are metzurot bihuda
Ika deamri amar rav ika bereh derav amme dechulle alma avde kemittaltelin dame vehadtanya lo kana shappir ha detanya kana beodan alav
Vechi odan alav may have chatzer mehallechet hi vechatzer mehallechet lo kana vechi tema beomed veha amar rava kol sheilu mehallech lo kana omed veoshev lo kana
Vehilcheta bechafut
Vehatanya hechzik bekarka kana avadim
Hatam beomdin betochah
Mikkelal dehay lo kana kesheen omdin betochah
Hanicha lehach lishana deamar rav ika bereh derav amme avda kemittalteli dame hayenu dei omdin betochah in i la la
Ella lehach lishana deamar avda kimkarkee dame lema li omdin betochah ha amar shemuel machar lo eser sadot beeser medinot kevan shehechzik beachat mehen kana kullan
Velitamach lehach lishana deamar avda kemittaltelin dame lema li omed betochah
b: Ha kayema lan dela baenan tzevurin
Ella may it lach lememar shane mittalteli denayedi mimmittalteli dela nayedi
Hacha name shane mekarkee denayedi mimmekarkee dela nayedi avda mekarkee denayedi hu hatam saddana deara chad hu
Nechasim sheen bahen meila vechu
Meila hu delet behu ha mikdash kadshi
Man tanna amar rabbi yochanan bekadashim kallim vealliba derabbi yose haggelili deamar mamon bealim hu
Detanya umaala maal ba lerabbot kodashim kallim shehen mamono divre rabbi yose haggelili
Vehatnan hamkaddesh bechelko ben bekodshe kodashim ben bekadashim kallim enah mekuddeshet lema dela kerabbi yose haggelili
Afilu tema rabbi yose haggelili ki amar rabbi yose haggelili mechayyim aval leachar shechita afilu rabbi yose haggelili mode dechi ka zachu mishshulchan gavoha ka zachu
Umechayyim mi amar vehatnan bechor mochrin oto tam chay velo shachut uvaal mum chay veshachut umkaddeshin bo et haishsha

Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lo shanu ella bechor bazzeman hazze dechevan dela chaze lehakrava it lehu lechohanim zechiyya begaveyhv aval bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam dachaze lehakrava la
Veetiveh rava lerav nachman umaala maal ba lerabbot kodashim kallim shehen mamono divre rabbi yose haggelili
Umshanne ravina bivchor bechutza laaretz vealliba derabbi shimon deamar im bau temimim yikrevu im bau in lechattechilla la
Veim ita dechi amar rabbi yose haggelili mamono hu mechayyim

a: Lishanne ha rabbi yose haggelili ha rabbanan
Amar leh mattenot kehunna kaamratte shane mattenot kehunna dechi ka zachu mishshulchan gavoha ka zachu
Gufa umaala maal ba lerabbot kodashim kallim shehem mamono divre rabbi yose haggelili ben azzay omer lerabbot et hashshelamim abba yose ben dostay omer lo amar ben azzay ella bivchor bilvad
Amar mar ben azzay omer lerabbot et hashshelamim lemaote may
Ilema lemaote bechor hashta uma shelamim shetteunim semicha unsachim utnufat chaze vashok amratte mamon bealim hu bechor mibbaya
Ella amar rabbi yochanan lemaote maaser
Kidtanya bivchor neemar lo tifde venimkar tam chay uvaal mum chay veshachut bemaaser neemar lo yiggael veeno nimkar lo chay velo shachut lo tam velo baal mum
Ravina matne lah assefa abba yose ben dostay omer lo amar ben azzay ella bivchor bilvad lemaote may
Ilema lemaote shelamim hashta uma bechor shekkadosh merechem mamono hu shelamim mibbaya
Amar rabbi yochanan lemaote maaser
Kidtanya bivchor neemar lo tifde venimkar tam chay uvaal mum chay veshachut bemaaser neemar lo yiggael veeno nimkar lo chay velo shachut lo tam velo baal mum
Ha bivchor bilvad kaamar kashya
Rava amar may nechasim sheen bahen meila nechasim sheen bahen din meila umay ninhu dehedot
Velitne dehedot kashya
Amar rabbi abba shelamim shehizziku gove mibbesaran veeno gove meemurehen
Peshita emurin legavoha salki
La tzericha legove mibbesaran keneged emurim
Alliba deman
I alliba derabbanan peshita ha amri ki leka leishtallome mehay la mishtallam mehay
Vei alliba derabbi natan ha amar ki leka leishtallome mehay mishtallam mehay
I baet ema rabbi natan ibaet ema rabbanan
Ibaet ema rabbanan hane mile bitre gufe aval bechad gufa matze amar leh mikkol hecha devaena mishtallamna
Ibaet ema rabbi natan hatam hu daamar leh baal shor levaal habbor ana toray beverach ashkachteh may delet li leishtallome mehayech mishtallamna minach
b: Aval hacha mi matze amar basar azzek emurin la azzik
Amar rava toda shehizzika gove mibbesarah veeno gove millachmah
Lechem peshita
Sefa itzterich leh nizak ochel basar umitkapper mevi lechem
Ha name peshita mahu detema kevan delechem hechshera dezevach hu lema leh atte achlatte besar vaana ayete lechem ka mashma lan delechem chiyyuva divalim hu
Nechasim shehen shel bene verit
Lemaote may i lemaote degoy ha katane lah lekamman shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel goy patur tane vahadar mefaresh
Nechasim hamuchadin lemaote may amar rav yehuda lemaote ze omer shorcha hizzik veze omer shorcha hizzik
Ha tane lekamman hau shenayim rodfin achar echad ze omer shorcha hizzik veze omer shorcha hizzik shenehem peturin tane vahadar mefaresh
Bematnita tana perat lenichse hefker hechi dame ilema dingach tora didan letora dehefker man tava leh ella dingach tora dehefker letora didan
Lezil velayeteh beshekkadam vezacha bo acher
Ravina amar lemaote nagach veachar kach hikdish nagach veachar kach hifkir

Tanya name hachi yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda afilu nagach veachar kach hikdish nagach veachar kach hifkir patur shenneemar vehuad bivalav vehemit ish vego ad shettehe mita vehaamada baddin shavin keechad
Ugmar haddin la baenan ha hashshor yissakel bigmar din hu dichtiv
Ella ema ad shettehe mita vehaamada bedin ugmar din shavin keechad
Chutz mershut hamuchedet lammazzik deamar leh torach birshuti may bae
Urshut hannizak vehammazzik
Amar rav chisda amar avimi chatzar hashshuttafin chayyav bah al hashshen veal haregel vehachi kaamar chutz mershut hamuchedet lammazzik defatur urshut hannizak vehammazzik keshehizzik chav hammazzik
Verabbi elazar amar patur al hashshen veal haregel vehachi kaamar chutz mershut hamuchedet lammazzik urshut hannizak vehammazzik name patur uchshehizzik chav hammazzik leetoye keren
Hanicha lishmuel ella lerav deamar tena shor vechol mile deshor chav hammazzik leetoye may

Leetoye ha detanu rabbanan keshehizzik chav hammazzik lehavi shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher shehizzika behema birshutan tam meshallem chatzi nezek umuad meshallem nezek shalem nifretza ballayela o shepperatzuha listin veyatzta vehizzika patur
Amar mar keshehizzik chav hammazzik lehavi shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher hechi dame
Ilema deazzekeh tora demashil letora deshoel lema leh ilu azzek bealma baet leshallome atte hashta deazzekeh letora didach baena leshallome
Ella deazzekeh tora deshoel letora demashil lema leh ilu itazzak mealma baet leshallome kulleh tora hashta deazzekeh tora didach palga nizka hu dimshallematte li
Leolam deazzekeh tora demashil letora deshoel vehacha bemay askinan shekkibbel alav shemirat gufo

a: Velo kibbel alav shemirat nezakav
I hachi ema sefa nifretza ballayela o shepperatzuha listim veyatzta vehizzika patur ha bayyom chayyav ha lo kibbel alav shemirat nezakav
Hachi kaamar im kibbel alav shemirat nezakav chayyav nifretza ballayela o shepperatzuha listim veyatzta vehizzika patur
Ini veha tane rav yosef chatzar hashshuttafim vehappundak chayyav bahen al hashshen veal haregel teuvta derabbi elazar

Amar lach rabbi elazar vetisbera matneyata mi la peligi vehatanya arbaa kelalot haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer benizzakin kol shehu reshut lannizak velo lammazzik chayyav bakkol demazzik velo lannizak patur mikkol

Laze velaze kegon chatzar hashshuttafim vehabbika patur bah al hashshen veal haregel al hannegicha veal hannegifa veal hanneshicha veal harvitza veal habbeita tam meshallem chatzi nezek muad meshallem nezek shalem

Lo laze velo laze kegon chatzer sheeno shel shenehem chayyav bo al hashshen veal haregel al hannegicha veal hanneshicha veal hannegifa veal harvitza veal habbeita tam meshallem chatzi nezek muad meshallem nezek shalem
Katane mihat chatzar hashshuttafin vehabbika patur bah al hashshen veal haregel
Kashya ahadade
Ki tanya hahi bechatzer meuchedet laze velaze ben leferot ben lishorim hahi derav yosef bechatzer meuchedet leferot veenah meuchedet lishorim dilgabbe shen haveya lah chatzar hannizak
Dayeka name dekatane hacha dumya defundak vekatane hatam dumya devika shema minah
Matkef lah rabbi zera kevan dimuchedet leferot ha baenan uvier bisde acher veleka
Amar leh abbaye kevan deenah meuchedet lishorim sede acher karena beh
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina lema middematneyata la peligi amorae name la peligi
Amar leh in veim timtza lomar peligi bekushya derabbi zera uvferuka deabbaye peligi
Gufa arbaa kelalot haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer benizzakin kol shehu reshut lannizak velo lammazzik chayyav bakkol
Al hakkol la katane ella chayyav bakkol bechulleh nezek
Manni rabbi tarfon hi deamar meshunne keren bachatzar hannizak nezek shalem meshallem
Ema sefa lo laze velo laze kegon chatzer sheeno shel shenehem chayyav bah al hashshen veal haregel
May lo laze velo laze ilema lo laze velo laze kelal ella deacher veha baena uvier bisde acher veleka
Ella peshita lo laze velo laze ella dechad vekatane sefa tam meshallem chatzi nezek umuad meshallem nezek shalem
Atan lerabbanan deamri meshunne keren bachatzar hannizak chatzi nezek hu dimshallem
Resha rabbi tarfon vesefa rabbanan
In deha amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana shevok matnitin veta abbatray resha rabbi tarfon vesefa rabbanan
Ravina mishshemeh derava amar kullah rabbi tarfon hi umay lo laze velo laze lo laze velo laze leferot ella dechad laze velaze lishorim
Dilgabbe shen haveya lah chatzar hannizak legabbe keren haveya lah reshut harabbim
I hachi arbaa shelosha hau
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak
b: Shelosha kelalot bearbaa mekomot
Matni shum kesef shave kesef bifne bet din veal pi edim bene chorin bene verit vehannashim bichlal hannezek vehannizak vehammazzik betashlumin
Gema may shum kesef
Amar rav yehuda shum ze lo yehe ella bechesef
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan para shehizzika tallit vetallit shehizzika para en omrim tetze para betallit vetallit befara ella shamin otah bedamim
Shave kesef
Detanu rabbanan shave kesef melammed sheen bet din nizkakin ella linchasim sheyyesh lahen achraut aval im kadam nizak vetafas mittaltelin bet din govin lo mehen
Amar mar shave kesef melammed sheen bet din nizkakin ella linchasim sheyyesh lahen achraut may mashma
Amar rabba bar ulla davar hashshave kol kesef may nihu davar sheen lo onaa avadim ushtarot name en lahen onaa
Ella amar rabba bar ulla davar hannikne bechesef avadim ushtarot name niknin bechesef
Ella amar rav ashe shave kesef velo kesef vehane kullehu kesef ninhu

Rame leh rav yehuda bar chinana lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua tana shave kesef melammed sheen bet din nizkakin ella linchasim sheyyesh lahen achraut vehatanya yashiv lerabbot shave kesef vaafilu subbin
Hacha bemay askinan beyatme
I beyatme ema sefa im kadam nizak vetafas mittaltelin bet din govin lo mehen i beyatme ammay bet din govin lo mehen
Kidamar rava amar rav nachman shettafas mechayyim hacha name shettafas mechayyim
Bifne bet din
Perat lemocher nechasav veachar kach holech levet din
Shema minah lava umachar nechasav veachar kach ba levet din en bet din govin lo mehen
Ella perat levet din hedotot
Al pi edim
Perat lemode biknas veachar kach bau edim shehu patur
Hanicha leman deamar mode biknas veachar kach bau edim patur ella leman deamar mode biknas veachar kach bau edim chayyav may ika lememar
Sefa itzterich leh

a: Bene chorin uvne verit bene chorin lemaote avadim bene verit lemaote goyim
Utzricha dei ashmeinan eved mishshum deen lo chayis aval goy deyesh lo chayis ema la vei ashmeinan goy mishshum dela shayech bemitzot aval eved deshayech bemitzot ema la tzericha
Vehannashim bichlal hannezek menahane mile
Amar rav yehuda amar rav vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael amar kera ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashin shebbattora
Deve rabbi elazar tana veelle hammishpatim asher tasim lifnehem hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol dinin shebbattora
Deve chizkiyya verabbi yose haggelili tana amar kera vehemit ish o ishsha hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol mitot shebbattora
Utzrichi dei ashmeinan kammayeta hatam hu dechas rachamana alah ki hechi detehve lah kappara aval dinin ish devar massa umattan in ishsha la
Vei ashmeinan dinin ki hechi detihve lah chayyuta aval kappara ish devar mitzva in ishsha delav bat mitzva la
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte hacha mishshum kappara vehacha mishshum chayyuta aval leinyan ketala ish devar mitzva leshallem kofer ishsha la
Vei ashmeinan kofer mishshum deika ibud neshama aval hane tarte deleka ibud neshama ema la tzericha
Hannizak vehammazzik betashlumin
Ittemar palga nizka rav pappa amar mamona rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar kenasa
Rav pappa amar mamona kasavar setam sheorim lav bechezkat shimur kayemi uvdin hu devae leshallome kulleh verachamana hu dechas aleh deakkatti la iyyaad toreh
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar kenasa kasavar setam sheorim bechezkat shimur kayemi uvdin hu dela leshallem kelal verachamana hu dekanseh ki hechi delintereh letoreh
Tenan hannizak vehammazzik betashlumin bishlama leman deamar palga nizka mamona hayenu deshayech nizak betashlumin ella leman deamar palga nizka kenasa hashta delav dideh shakel betashlumin iteh
Lo nitzrecha ella lifchat nevela
Pechat nevela ha tena leh resha tashlume nezek melammed shehabbealim mittappelin binvela
Chada betam vachada bemuad
Utzricha dei ashmeinan tam mishshum deakkatti la iyyaad aval muad ema la vei ashmeinan muad mishshum deka meshallem kulleh aval tam ema la tzericha
Ta shema ma ben tam lemuad shehattam meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo umuad meshallem nezek shalem min haaliyya
Veim ita litne name ha tam eno meshallem al pi atzmo muad meshallem al pi atzmo
Tena veshayyar may shayyar dehay shayyar
Shayyar chatzi chofer
I mishshum chatzi chofer lav shiyyura hu ha manni rabbi yose haggelili hi deamar tam meshallem chatzi chofer
Ta shema
b: Hemit shori et peloni o shoro shel peloni hare ze meshallem al pi atzmo
May lav betam
La bemuad aval tam may hachi name deen meshallem al pi atzmo i hachi addetane sefa hemit shori et avdo shel peloni en meshallem al pi atzmo liflog velitne bedideh
Bamme devarim amurim bemuad aval betam eno meshallem al pi atzmo
Kullah bemuad kamayere
Ta shema ze hakkelal kol hamshallem yoter al ma shehizzik eno meshallem al pi atzmo may lav ha pachot mimma shehizzik meshallem
La ha kema shehizzik meshallem

Aval pachot may hachi name dela meshallem i hachi addetane ze hakkelal kol hamshallem yoter al ma shehizzik eno meshallem al pi atzmo litne ze hakkelal kol sheeno meshallem kema shehizzik demashma pachot umashma yoter teuvta
Vehilcheta palga nizka kenasa
Teuvta vehilcheta
In tama may haveya teuvta mishshum dela katane kemo shehizzik
La pesika leh kevan deika chatzi nezek tzerorot dehilcheta gemiri lah demamona hu mishshum hachi la katane
Vehashta deamratte palga nizka kenasa hay kalba daachal imre veshunnara daachalo tarnegola meshunne hu vela magbenan bevavel
Vehane mile beravreve aval bezutre orcheh hu
Vei tefas la mappekinan mineh
Vei amar kivu li zimna deazelna leara deyisrael kavinan leh vei la azel meshammetinan leh
Uven kach uven kach meshammetinan leh ad dimsallek hezzeka
Midderabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer minnayin shello yegaddel adam kelev ra betoch beto veal yaamid sullam raua betoch beto talmud lomar lo tasim damim bevetecha
Matni chamishsha tammin vachamishsha muadin
Habbehema enah muedet lo ligach velo ligof velo lishshoch velo lirbotz velo livot
Hashshen muedet leechol et harauy lah haregel muedet lishbor bederech hiluchah veshor hammuad veshor hammazzik birshut hannizak vehaadam
Hazzeev vehaari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash hare ellu muadin rabbi elazar omer bizman shehen bene tarbut enan muadin vehannachash muad leolam
Gema middekatane hashshen muedet leechol mikkelal devachatzar hannizak askinan vekatane behema enah muedet leshallem kulleh aval chatzi nezek meshallemet
Manni rabbanan hi deamri meshunne keren bachatzar hannizak chatzi nezek hu dimshallem
Ema sefa shor hammuad veshor hammazzik birshut hannizak vehaadam atan lerabbi tarfon deamar meshunne keren bachatzar hannizak nezek shalem hu dimshallem
Resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi tarfon
In dehaamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana shevok matnitin veta abbatray resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi tarfon
Rabbi elazar mishshemeh derav amar

a: Kullah rabbi tarfon hi resha bechatzer hamuchedet leferot leechad mehen velaze velaze lishvarim dilgabbe shen haveya lah chatzar hannizak ulgabbe keren haveya reshut harabbim
Amar rav kahana amritah lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea vaamar li mi matzet mokmatte lah kullah kerabbi tarfon hakatane hashshen muedet leechol et harauy lah rauy lah in sheen rauy lah la
Vei rabbi tarfon haamar meshunne keren bachatzar hannizak nezek shalem meshallem
Ella leolam rabbanan hi vechassore mechassera vehachi katane chamishsha tammim hen veim huadu chamishtan muadin
Veshen varegel muadin mittechilatan vehechan headatan bachatzar hannizak
Matkef lah ravina ha katane lekamman shor hammazzik birshut hannizak ketzad i amratte bishlama ayeri bah mishshum hachi katane ketzad ella i amratte la ayeri bah may ketzad
Ella amar ravina chassore mechassera vehachi katane chamishsha tammim hen veim huadu chamishtan muadin

Veshen varegel muadin mittechilatan vezehu shor hammuad veshor hammazzik birshut hannizak machloket rabbi tarfon verabbanan veyesh muadim acherim kayyotze beellu hazzeev vehaari vehaddov vehabbardelas vehannamer vehannachash

Tanya name hachi chamishsha tammim hen veim huadu chamishtan muadin veshen varegel muadin mittechilatan vezehu shor hammuad veshor hammazzik birshut hannizak machloket rabbi tarfon verabbanan veyesh muadin acherim kayyotze beellu hazzeev vehaari haddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash
Ika deramu lah mirma tenan chamishsha tammim vachamishsha muadim vetu leka vehaika hazzeev haari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash

Umshanne amar ravina chassore mechassera vehachi katane chamishsha tammim hen veim huadu chamishtan muadin veshen varegel muadin mittechilatan vezehu shor hammuad veshor hammazzik birshut hannizak machloket rabbi tarfon verabbanan veyesh muadin acherim kayyotze beellu hazzeev vehaari haddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash
Velo lirbotz amar rabbi elazar lo shanu ella pakkin gedolim aval pakkin ketannim orcheh hu
Lema mesayya leh habbehema muedet lehallech kedarkah ulshabber ulmaech et haadam veet habbehema veet hakkelim
Dilma min hatztzad
Ika deamri amar rabbi elazar la tema pakkin gedolim hu delav orcheh aval pakkin ketannim orcheh hu ella afilu pakkin ketannim name lav orcheh hu
Metivi ulmaech et haadam veet habbehema veet hakkelim
Amar rabbi elazar dilma min hatztzad
Ika derame lah mirma tenan velo lirbotz vehatanya ulmaech et haadam veet habbehema veet hakkelim amar rabbi elazar la kashya kan befakkin gedolim kan befakkin ketannim
Hazzeev vehaari vechu may bardelas amar rav yehuda nafreza may nafreza amar rav yosef appa
Metivi rabbi meir omer af hatztzavoa rabbi elazar omer af hannachash veamar rav yosef tzavoa zo appa
La kashya kan betzavoa zachar kan betzavoa nekiva

Detanya tzavoa zachar leachar sheva shanim naase atallef atallef leachar sheva shanim naase arpad arpad leachar sheva shanim naase kimos kimos leachar sheva shanim naase choach choach leachar sheva shanim naase shed shidro shel adam leachar sheva shanim naase nachash vehane mile dela kara bemodim
Amar mar rabbi meir omer af hatztzavoa
b: Rabbi elazar omer af hannachash veha anan tenan rabbi elazar omer bizman shehen bene tarbut enan muadim vehannachash muad leolam
Teni nachash
Amar shemuel ari birshut harabbim daras veachal patur taraf veachal chayyav
Daras veachal patur kevan deorcheh lemidras have leh kemo sheachla perot virakot dehave leh shen birshut harabbim ufatur taraf lav orcheh hu
Lememra ditrefa lav orcheh hu vehachtiv arye toref bede gorotav bishvil gorotav umchannek lelivotav bishvil livotav vayemalle teref chorav bishvil chorav umonotav terefa bishvil meonotav
Vehatanya vechen chayya shennichnesa lachatzar hannizak tarfa behema veachla basar meshallem nezek shalem
Hacha bemay askinan shettarfa lehanniach ha achla katane beshennimlecha veachla
Mena yadinan veod dishmuel name dilma hachi hu
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak litzdadin katane shettarfa lehanniach o darsa veachla meshallemet nezek shalem
Ravina amar ki kaamar shemuel baari tarbut vealliba derabbi elazar deamar lav orcheh
I hachi afilu darsa name lichayyav
Ella deravina lav ashshemuel ittemar ella ammatnita ki tane matnita baari tarbut vealliba derabbi elazar deamar lav orcheh
I hachi chatzi nezek bae leshallome deiyyaad
I hachi may hay dekatane lah gabbe tolada deshen gabbe tolada dekeren bae lemitneyah kashya
Matni ma ben tam lemuad
Ella shehattam meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo umuad meshallem nezek shalem min haaliyya
Gema may aliyya amar rabbi elazar bimulle shebbinchasav
Vechen hu omer vayyishkav chizkiyyahu im avotav vayyikberuhu bemaale kivre vene david veamar rabbi elazar bemaale etzel meullim shebbammishpacha uman ninhu david ushlomo

Vayyikberuhu vekivrotav asher kara lo beir david vayyashkivuhu bammishkav asher mille besamim uznim may besamim uznim rabbi elazar amar zene zene rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar besamim shekkol hammeriach bahen ba lide zima
Ki charu shucha lelochdeni ufachim tamnu leraglay rabbi elazar amar shechashaduhu mizzona rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar shechashaduhu meeshet ish
Bishlama leman deamar shechashaduhu mizzona hayenu dichtiv ki shucha amukka zona ella leman deamar shechashaduhu meeshet ish may shucha attu eshet ish mi nafka mikkelal zona
Bishlama leman deamar shechashaduhu meeshet ish hayenu dichtiv veatta Adonai yadata et kol atzatam alay lammavet ella leman deamar shechashaduhu mizzona may lammavet shehishlichuhu liver tit

Daresh rava may dichtiv yihu muchshalim lefanecha beet appecha ase bahem amar yirmeya lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam afilu beshaa sheosin tzedaka hachshilem bivne adam sheenan mehugganim kede shello yekabbelu alehen sachar
Vechavod asu lo vemoto melammed shehoshivu yeshiva al kivro
Peligi bah rabbi natan verabbanan chad amar shelosha

a: Vechad amar shiva veamri lah sheloshim
Tanu rabbanan vechavod asu lo vemoto ze chizkiyya melech yehuda sheyyatzu lefanav sheloshim veshishsha elef chalutze chatef divre rabbi yehuda
Amar lo rabbi nechemya vahalo lifne achav asu ken
Ella shehinnichu sefer tora al mittato veamru kiyyem ze ma shekkatuv baze
Vehaidana name avdinan hachi appoke mappekinan annoche la mannechinan veibaet ema annoche name mannechinan kiyyem la amrinan

Amar rabba bar bar chana hava azelna bahadeh derabbi yochanan lemishal shemata ki hava ayel levet hakkisse vahava baena mineh milleta la pashet lan ad demashe yedeh umannach tefilin umvarech vahadar amar lan afilu kiyyem amrinan limed la amrinan
Vehaamar mar gadol talmud tora shehattalmud mevi lide maase la kashya ha lemigmar ha leagmore
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay may dichtiv ashrechem zore al kol mayim meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor kol haosek betora uvigmilut chasadim zoche lenachalat shene shevatim
Shenneemar ashrechem zore veen zeria ella tzedaka shenneemar ziru lachem litzdaka vekitzru lefi chesed veen mayim ella tora shenneemar hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim
Vezoche lenachalat shene shevatim zoche lechila keosef dichtiv ben porat yosef banot tzaada ale shur vezoche lenachalat yissashchar dichtiv yissashchar chamor garem
It deamri oyevav noflim lefanav keosef dichtiv bahem ammim yenaggach yachdav afse aretz vezoche levina keyissashochar dichtiv umibbene yissashchar yode vina laittim ladaat ma yaase yisrael
Hadaran alach arbaa avot
Matni ketzad haregel muedet lishbor bederech hilluchah habbehema muedet lehallech kedarkah ulshabber

Hayeta mevaetet o shehau tzerorot menattezin mittachat ragleha veshavra et hakkelim meshallem chatzi nezek darsa al hakkeli ushvarattu venafal al keli ushvaro al harishon meshallem nezek shalem veal haacharon meshallem chatzi nezek
Hattarnegolin muadin lehallech kedarkan ulshabber haya delil kashur beraglav o shehaya mehaddes umshabber et hakkelim meshallem chatzi nezek
b: Gema amar leh ravina lerava hayenu regel hayenu behema amar leh tena avot vekatane toladot
Ella meatta sefa dekatane hashshen muedet habbehema muedet may avot umay toladot ika hava kamahdar leh bivdichuta vaamar leh ana shannay chada veatte shanni chada
Vetama may amar rav ashe tanna shen dechayya vekatane shen divhema salka datach amena veshillach et beiro ketiv behema in chayya la ka mashma lan dechayya bichlal behema
I hachi ha mibbee leh lemitne beresha hay deatya leh midderasha chaviva leh
I hachi resha name litne hahi dela ketiva beresha hachi hashta hatam ide veide avot ninhu hach deatya leh midderasha chaviva leh hacha shavek av vetane tolada
Ibaet ema ayede desalek meregel patach baregel

Tanu rabbanan behema muedet lehallech kedarkah ulshabber ketzad behema shennichnesa lachatzar hannizak vehizzika begufah derech hilluchah uvisarah derech hilluchah baukkaf shealeha uvishlif shealeha uvifrumbeya shebbefiha uvzog shebbetzavarah vachamor bemassao meshallem nezek shalem somchos omer tzerorot vachazir shehaya nover baashpa vehizzik meshallem nezek shalem
Hizzik peshita ella ema hittiz vehizzik meshallem nezek shalem

Tzerorot man dechar shemayehu chassore mechassera vehachi katane tzerorot ki orchayehu chatzi nezek vachazir shehaya nover baashpa vehittiz vehizzik meshallem chatzi nezek somchos omer tzerorot vachazir shehaya nover baashpa vehittiz vehizzik meshallem nezek shalem

Tanu rabbanan tarnegolin shehau mafrichin mimmakom lemakom veshavru kelim bechanfehen meshallem nezek shalem beruach shebbechanfehen meshallemin chatzi nezek somchos omer nezek shalem tanya idach tarnegolin shehau mehaddesin al gabbe isa veal gabbe perot vetinfu o nikru meshallem nezek shalem heelu afar o tzerorot meshallemin chatzi nezek somchos omer nezek shalem
Tanya idach tarnegol shehaya mafriach mimmakom lemakom veyatzta ruach mittachat kenafav veshibra et hakkelim meshallem chatzi nezek setama kerabbanan
Amar rava bishlama somchos kasavar kocho kegufo dame ella rabbanan i kegufo dame kulleh nezek bae leshallem vei lav kegufo dame chatzi nezek name la leshallem
Hadar amar rava leolam kegufo dame vachatzi nezek tzerorot hilcheta gemiri lah
Amar rava kol shebbazzav tame benizzakin meshallem nezek shalem kol shebbazzav tahor benizzakin meshallem chatzi nezek
Verava tzerorot ata leashmoinan lo rava egla moshechet bakkaron ka mashma lan

Tanya kevateh derava behema muedet leshabber bederech hilluchah ketzad behema shennichnesa lachatzar hannizak vehizzika begufah derech hilluchah uvisarah derech hilluchah baukkaf shealeha uvishlif shealeha uvifrumbeya shebbefiha uvzog shebbetzavarah vachamor bemassao veegla moshechet bekaron meshallem nezek shalem
Tanu rabbanan tarnegolim shehau mechattetin bechevel deli venifsak hachevel venishbar haddeli meshallemin nezek shalem
Bae rava darsa al keli velo shevarattu venitgalgel lemakom acher venishbar mahu batar meikara azlinan vegufeh hu o dilma batar tevar mana azlina utzrorot ninhu
Tifshot leh midderabba deamar rabba zarak keli merosh haggag uva acher ushvaro bemakkel patur deamrinan leh mana tevira tevar lerabba peshita leh lerava mibbaya leh
Ta shema hidus eno muad veyesh omrim hare ze muad
Hidus salka datach ella lav hidus vehittiz uvha kamippalgi demar savar batar meikara azlinan umar savar batar tevar mena azlinan
La

a: Behittiz tzerorot uviflugta desomchos verabbanan kamipalgi
Ta shema tarnegolin shehau mechattetin bechevel deli venifsak hachevel venishbar haddeli meshallemin nezek shalem shema minah batar meikara azlinan targemah achevel
Veha chevel meshunne hu demaus belisha veha nishbar deli katane ella somchos hi deamar tzerorot nezek shalem meshallem
I somchos ema sefa nitaz mimmennu shever venafal al keli acher ushvarah al harishon meshallem nezek shalem veal haacharon meshallem chatzi nezek vei somchos mi it leh chatzi nezek
Vechi tema shane leh lesomchos ben nezek kocho lechoach kocho veella ha devae rav ashe koach kocho lesomchos kechocho dame o lav kechocho dame
Tifshot leh delav kechocho dame
Ella lav rabbanan hi shema minah batar meikara azlinan
Amar rav bivi bar abbaye dekaazel mineh mineh

Bae rava chatzi nezek tzerorot miggufo meshallem o mealiyya meshallem miggufo meshallem dela ashkechan chatzi nezek dimshallem mealiyya o dilma mealiyya meshallem dela ashkechan keorcheh dimshallem miggufeh
Ta shema hidus eno muad veyesh omrim hare ze muad hidus salka datach ella lav hidus vehittiz
Uvha kamipalgi man deamar eno muad kasavar miggufo meshallem uman deamar muad kasavar mealiyya meshallem
La biflugta desomchos verabbanan kamipalgi
Ta shema hakkelev shennatal charara vehalach legadish veachal hacharara vehidlik et haggadish al hacharara meshallem nezek shalem veal haggadish meshallem chatzi nezek
May tama lav mishshum dehaveya lehu tzerorot vetane alah meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo
Vetisbera lerabbi elazar nezek shalem miggufeh mi ashkechan
Ella kegon deshanni beha gachelet verabbi elazar savar lah kerabbi tarfon deamar meshunne keren bachatzar hannizak nezek shalem meshallem
Vela hi may tama mokmatte lah kerabbi tarfon mishshum nezek shalem
Rabbi elazar savar kesomchos deamar tzerorot nezek shalem meshallem vesavar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar tzad tammut bimkomah omedet vechi katane miggufo atztzad tammut
Amar leh rav samma bereh derav ashe leravina emor deshamatte leh lerabbi yehuda betam venaasa muad bemuad mittechilato
b: Mi shamatte leh
Ella ki kaamar rabbi elazar nezek shalem kegon deiyyaad uvha kamipalgi mar savar yesh haadaa litzrorot umar savar en haadaa litzrorot
Ella ha devae rava yesh haadaa litzrorot o en haadaa litzrorot i lerabbanan en haadaa litzrorot i lerabbi elazar yesh haadaa litzrorot
Amar lach rava ki mibaya li ledidi alliba derabbanan difligi aleh desomchos aval hacha ben lerabbanan ben lerabbi elazar kesomchos sevira lehu deamar tzerorot nezek shalem meshallem
Vetama may amur rabbanan chatzi nezek deshanni vela iyyaad uviflugta derabbi tarfon verabbanan kamipalgi
Emor deshamatte leh lerabbi tarfon nezek shalem miggufo mi shamatte leh
In mehecha mayete lah mikkeren mershut harabbim
Dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon
Veha rabbi tarfon let leh dayyo
Ki let leh dayyo hecha demipperich kal vachomer hecha dela mipperich kal vachomer it leh dayyo
Gufa bae rava yesh haadaa litzrorot o en haadaa litzrorot lekeren medammenan leh o dilma tolada deregel hu
Ta shema hidus eno muad veyesh omrim hare ze muad hidus salka datach ella hidus vehittiz
May lav kegon daavad telata zimne uvha kamipalgi mar savar yesh haadaa umar savar en haadaa la bechad zimna uviflugta desomchos verabbanan kamipalgi

Ta shema behema shehetila gelalim leisa rav yehuda omer meshallem nezek shalem verabbi elazar omer chatzi nezek may lav kegon daavad telata zimne uvha kamipalgi mar savar yesh haadaa umar savar en haadaa
La bechad zimna uviflugta desomchos verabbanan kamipalgi veha meshunne hu didchik leh alma
Velema rav yehuda halacha kesomchos velema rabbi elazar halacha kerabbanan gelalim itztericha leh salka datach amena hoil uvatar gufeh geririn kegufeh dame ka mashma lan

Ta shema detane rame bar yechezkel tarnegol shehoshit rosho laavir keli zechuchit vetaka bo ushvaro meshallem nezek shalem veamar rav yosef amri be rav sus shetztzanaf vachamor shennaar veshiber et hakkelim meshallem chatzi nezek
May lav kegon daavad telata zimne

a: Uvha kamipalgi mar savar yesh haadaa umar savar en haadaa
La bechad zimna uviflugta desomchos verabbanan kamipalgi veha meshunne hu deit beh bizrane
Bae rav ashe yesh shinnuy litzrorot lirvia nezek o en shinnuy litzrorot lirvia nezek
Tifshot leh midderava devae rava yesh haadaa litzrorot o en haadaa litzrorot mikkelal deen shinnuy
Dilma rava im timtze lomar kaamar im timtze lomar en shinnuy yesh haadaa o en haadaa teku
Bae rav ashe koach kocho lesomchos kechocho dame o la
Mi gemir halacha umoke lah bechoach kocho o dilma la gemir halacha kelal teku
Hayeta mevaetet o shehau tzerorot menattezin mittachat ragleha veshavra et hakkelim meshallem chatzi nezek ibaya lehu hechi kaamar

Hayeta mevaetet vehizzika beviutah o tzerorot keorchayehu meshallem chatzi nezek verabbanan hi o dilma hayeta mevaetet vehizzika beviutah o tzerorot mechamat biut meshallem chatzi nezek ha ki orcheh meshallem nezek shalem umanni somchos hi
Ta shema missefa darsa al hakkeli ushvarattu venafal hashshever al keli acher ushvaro al harishon meshallem nezek shalem veal haacharon chatzi nezek vei somchos mi it leh chatzi nezek
Vechi tema rishon rishon lehattaza vesheni sheni lehattaza veshane leh lesomchos ben kocho lechoach kocho
Ella ha devae rav ashe koach kocho lesomchos kechocho dame o lav kechocho dame tifshot leh delav kechocho dame
Rav ashe kerabbanan moke lah uvae lah hachi hayeta mevaetet vehizzika beviutah o tzerorot keorchayehu chatzi nezek ha mechamat biut revia nezek veyesh shinnuy
O dilma hayeta mevaetet vehizzika beviutah o tzerorot mechamat biut chatzi nezek veen shinnuy teku

Bae mineh rabbi abba bar memel merabbi amme veamri lah merabbi chiyya bar abba hayeta mehallechet bemakom shei efshar lah ella im ken menattezet uviata vehittiza vehizzika mahu kevan dei efshar lah orchah hu o dilma hashta miha mechamat biut kamnatteza tzerorot teku

Bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera hayeta mehallechet birshut harabbim uviata vehittiza vehizzika mahu lekeren medammenan leh vechayyevet o dilma tolada deregel hu uftura amar leh mistabbera tolada deregel hu
Hittiza birshut harabbim vehizzika birshut hayyachid mahu amar leh akira en kan hannacha yesh kan

Etiveh hayeta mehallechet badderech vehittiza ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim chayyav may lav hittiza birshut harabbim vehizzika birshut harabbim la hittiza birshut harabbim vehizzika birshut hayyachid vehaamratte akira en kan hannacha yesh kan amar leh hadari bi

Etiveh darsa al hakkeli ushvarattu venafal hashshever al keli acher ushvaro al harishon meshallem nezek shalem veal haacharon meshallem chatzi nezek vetane alah bamme devarim amurim birshut hannizak aval birshut harabbim al harishon petura veal haacharon chayyevet may lav hittiza birshut harabbim vehizzika birshut harabbim
Lo hittiza birshut harabbim vehizzika birshut hayyachid vehaamratte akira en kan hannacha yesh kan amar leh hadari bi
Ini
b: Vehaamar rabbi yochanan en chatzi nezek chaluk lo lirshut hayyachid velo lirshut harabbim may lav hittiza birshut harabbim vehizzika birshut harabbim la hittiza birshut harabbim vehizzika birshut hayyachid
Vehaamratte akira en kan hannacha yesh kan amar leh hadari bi ibaet ema ki amar rabbi yochanan akaran

Yatev rabbi yehuda nesia verabbi oshaya akkila derabbi yehuda nefak milta mibbenayehu kishkesha biznavah mahu amar leh idach vechi yochazenna biznavah veyelech i hachi keren name nema vechi yochazenna bekeren veyelech
Hachi hashta keren lav orcheh ha orchah
Vechi meachar deorchah may mibbaya leh kishkush yattira mibbaya leh
Bae rav ena kishkesha beammatah mahu mi amrinan mide dehave akkeren keren lav yitzra katakef leh hacha name la shena o dilma keren kauonato lehazzik ha en kauonatah lehazzik teku
Hattarnegolin muadin lehallech kedarkan ulshabber vechu amar rav huna lo shanu ella shennikshar meelav aval kesharo adam chayyav
Nikshar meelav man chayyav ilema baal haddelil hechi dame i deatzneeh anus hu vei la atzneeh poshea hu
Ella chayyav baal tarnegol may shena kulleh nezek dela dichtiv ki yiftach ish bor velo shor bor chatzi nezek name ish bor velo shor bor
Ella matnitin bidaddeyeh addoye vechi ittemar derav huna bealma ittemar delil hefker amar rav huna nikshar meelav patur kesharo adam chayyav
Mishshum may chayyav amar rav huna bar manoach mishshum boro hammitgalgel beragle adam uvragle vehema
Matni ketzad hashshen muedet leechol et harauy lah habbehema muedet leechol perot virakot achla kesut o chelim meshallem chatzi nezek bamme devarim amurim birshut hannizak aval birshut harabbim patur
Veim nehenet meshallemet ma shennehenet

Ketzad meshallemet ma shennehenet achla mittoch harchava meshallemet ma shennehenet mitztzidde harchava meshallemet ma shehizzika mippetach hachanut meshallemet ma shennehenet mittoch hachanut meshallemet ma shehizzika

Gema tanu rabbanan hashshen muedet leechol et harauy lah ketzad behema shennichnesa lachatzar hannizak veachla ochalin haruyin lah veshatta mashkin haruyin lah meshallem nezek shalem vechen chayya shennichnesa lachatzar hannizak vetarfa behema veachla basar meshallem nezek shalem

Ufara sheachla seorin vachamor sheachal karshinin vechelev shellikek et hashshemen vachazir sheachal chaticha shel basar meshallemin nezek shalem amar rav pappa hashta deamratte kol mide delav orcheh veachla leh al yede haddechak shemeh achila hay shunnara daachal tamre vachamara daachal binita meshallem nezek shalem

Hahu chamra daachal nahama ufalleseh lesalla chayeveh rav yehuda leshallem nezek shalem annahama veassalla chatzi nezek veammay kevan deorcheh lemechal nahama orcheh name lefallose salla daachal vahadar palles
Ufat orcheh hu urminhu achla pat uvasar vetavshil meshallem chatzi nezek may lav bivhema lo bechayya
Chayya basar orcheh hu demitteve veibaet ema betavya veibaet ema leolam bivhema uvfatura

a: Hahu barcha dachaza lifta appumma dedanna sarech selek achlah lelifta vetavreh ledanna chayeveh rava allifta veaddanna nezek shalem may tama kevan deorcheh lemechal lifta orcheh name lesaroche ulmislak
Amar ilfa behema birshut harabbim ufashta tzavarah veachla meal gabbe chavertah chayyevet may tama gabbe chavertah kachatzar hannizak dame
Lema mesayya leh hayeta kuppato mufshelet laachorav ufashta tzavarah veachla mimmennu chayyevet kidamar rava bekofetzet hacha name bekofetzet
Vehecha itmar derava aha deamar rabbi oshaya behema birshut harabbim halcha veachla petura amda veachla chayyevet may shena halcha deorcheh hu amda name orcheh hu amar rava bekofetzet
Bae rabbi zera mitgalgel mahu hechi dame kegon dekayema amir birshut hayyachid veka mitgalgal veate mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim may

Ta shema detane rabbi chiyya massoy miktzato bifnim umiktzato bachutz achla bifnim chayyevet achla bachutz petura may lav mitgalgal veate la ema achla al ma shebbifnim chayyevet al ma shebbachutz petura
Ibaet ema ki kaamar rabbi chiyya biftila deaspasta
Achla kesut vechu
Aheya amar rav akkullehu may tama kol hamshanne uva acher veshina bo patur
Ushmuel amar lo shanu ella perot virakot aval kesut vechelim chayyevet

Vechen amar resh lakish akkullehu veazda resh lakish letameh deamar resh lakish shette farot birshut harabbim achat revutza veachat mehallechet baata mehallechet barvutza petura revutza bammehallechet chayyevet
Verabbi yochanan amar lo shanu ella perot virakot aval kesut vechelim chayyevet
Lema rabbi yochanan let leh deresh lakish afilu bishte farot la leolam it leh kesut avdi inashe demannechi gelime umittafchi aval behema lav orchah
Veim nehenet meshallemet vechu vechamma rabba amar deme amir rava amar deme seorim bezol
Tanya keoteh derabba tanya keoteh derava tanya keoteh derabba rabbi shimon ben yochay amar en meshallemet ella deme amir bilvad

Tanya keoteh derava im nehenet meshallemet ma shennehenet ketzad achla kav o kabbayim en omrim teshallem demehen ella omdin kamma adam rotze lehaachil livhemto davar harauy lah af al pi sheeno ragil lefichach achla chittin o davar hara lah petura

Amar leh rav chisda lerame bar chama la havet gabban beurta bitchuma deibaya lan mile mealleyata amar may mile mealleyata amar leh haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato tzarich lehaalot lo sachar o en tzarich
Hechi dame ilema bechatzer dela kayema leagra vegavra dela avid lemegar ze lo nehene veze lo chaser ella bechatzer dekayema leagra vegavra daavid lemegar ze nehene veze chaser
La tzericha bechatzer dela kayema leagra vegavra daavid lemegar may matze amar leh may chassartach o dilma matze amar
b: Ha ithanit
Amar leh matnitin hi he matnitin amar leh lechi teshammesh li shekal sudareh kerach leh amar leh im nehenet meshallemet ma shennehenet
Amar rava kamma la chale vela margesh gavra demareh sayeeh deaf al gav dela dame lematnitin kabbelah mineh hay ze nehene veze chaser vehay ze nehene veze lo chaser hu
Verame bar chama setam perot birshut harabbim afkore mafkar lehu
Tenan hammakkif chavero mishshalosh ruchotav vegadar et harishona veet hashsheniyya veet hashshelishit en mechayevin oto ha reviit mechayevin oto
Shema minah ze nehene veze lo chaser chayyav shane hatam daamar leh atte geramte li hekkefa yattira
Ta shema amar rabbi yose im amad nikaf vegadar et harviit megalgelin alav et hakkol tama degadar nikaf ha makkif patur
Shema minah ze nehene veze lo chaser patur shane hatam deamar leh ledidi saggi li bintira bar zuza
Ta shema habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim shennaflu amar baal haaliyya levaal habbayit livnot vehu eno rotze hare baal haaliyya bone bayit veoshev bah ad sheyyitten lo yetziotav
Yetziotav hu dimchayyev leh baal habbayit ha secharo la shema minah ze nehene veze lo chaser patur shane hatam deveta laaliyya mishtabad
Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer af ze haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato tzarich lehaalot lo sachar shema minah ze nehene veze lo chaser chayyav shane hatam mishshum shachrurita deashyata

Shallechuha be rabbi amme amar vechi ma asa lo uma chissero uma hizziko rabbi chiyya bar abba amar nityashev baddavar hadar shallechuha kammeh derabbi chiyya bar abba amar kulleh hay shalchu li veazli ilu ashkachi bah tama la shalachna lehu
Ittemar rav kahana amar rabbi yochanan eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan tzarich lehaalot lo sachar
Amar rav pappa ha derabbi avahu lav beferush ittemar ella mikkelala ittemar ditnan natal even o kora shel hekdesh hare ze lo maal
Netanah lachavero hu maal vachavero lo maal benaah letoch beto hare ze lo maal ad sheyyadur tachteha shave peruta
Veamar shemuel vehu shehinnichah al pi arubba
Veyatev rabbi avahu kammeh derabbi yochanan vekaamar mishshemeh dishmuel zot omeret haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato tzarich lehaalot lo sachar ushtek leh
Ihu savar middishtek mode leh vela hi ashgoche la ashgach beh
Kidrabba deamar rabba hekdesh shello middaat

a: Kehedot middaat dame
Shelach leh rabbi abba bar zavda lemare bar mar bei mineh merav huna haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato tzarich lehaalot lo sachar o la addehachi nach nafsheh derav huna

Amar leh rabba bar rav huna hachi amar abba mari mishshemeh derav eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar vehassocher bayit meruven maale sachar leshimon shimon may avidteh hachi kaamar nimtza habbayit shel shimon maale lo sachar
Tarte ha dekayema leagra ha dela kayema leagra

Ittemar name amar rabbi chiyya bar avin amar rav veamri lah amar rabbi chiyya bar avin amar rav huna haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar vehassocher bayit mibbene hair maale sachar labbealim bealim may avidtayehu hachi kaamar nimtzeu lo bealim maalin lahen sachar
Tarte ha dekayema leagra ha dela kayema leagra

Amar rav sechora amar rav huna amar rav haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato en tzarich lehaalot lo sachar mishshum shenneemar ushiyya yukkat shaar amar mar bar rav ashe ledidi chaze leh umnaggach ki tora rav yosef amar beta meyatteva yatev
May benayehu ika benayehu deka mishtammash beh betzive vetivna

Hahu gavra divna appadna akkilkalta deyatme agbeyeh rav nachman leappadneh mineh lema kasavar rav nachman haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato tzarich lehaalot lo sachar hahu meikara karmenae hao dayeri beh veyahavi lehu leyatme davar muat amar leh zil payesinhu leyatme vela ashgach agbeyeh rav nachman leappadneh mineh
Ketzad meshallemet ma shennehenet vechu amar rav uvmachzeret ushmuel amar afilu machzeret name patur
Velishmuel hechi mashkachatte lah dimchayyev kegon dishvaktah lirchava vaazala vekama betzide rechava

Veika dematne leha shemata beappe nafshah machzeret rav amar chayyevet ushmuel amar petura velishmuel meshallemet ma shehizzika hechi mashkachatte lah dimchayeva kegon dishvaka lirchava vaazala vekama betzide rechava
Metiv rav nachman bar yitzchak mippetach hachanut meshallemet ma shennehenet hechi mashkachatte lah peshita bemachzeret vekaamar mar ma shennehenet ma shennehenet in ma shehizzika la
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah dekayema bekeren zavit
Ika deamri machzeret kulle alma la peligi dechayyevet ki peligi bemaktze makom mershuto lirshut harabbim
Vehachi ittemar amar rav lo shanu ella machzeret aval maktze makom mershuto lirshut harabbim petura ushmuel amar afilu maktze makom mershuto lirshut harabbim chayyevet
Lema bevor birshuto kamippalgi rav deamar patur kasavar bor birshuto chayyav
Ushmuel deamar chayyav kasavar bor birshuto patur
Amar lecha rav leolam ema lach
b: Bealma bor birshuto patur veshane hacha deamar lav kol keminach dimkarvatte lehu leferotach lirshut harabbim umchayevatte lehu letoray
Ushmuel amar bealma bor birshuto chayyav devishlama bor ika lememar lav addateh ella perot mi ika lememar lav addateh ha chaze lehu

Lema machzeret tannae hi detanya achla mittoch harchava meshallemet ma shennehenet mitztzide harchava meshallemet ma shehizzika divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda rabbi yose verabbi elazar omrim en darkah leechol ella lehallech
Rabbi yose hayenu tanna kamma ella machzeret ika benayehu tanna kamma savar machzeret name meshallem ma shennehenet verabbi yose savar meshallemet ma shehizzika
La dechulle alma machzeret i kerav i kishmuel vehacha bevier bisde acher ka mipalgi mar savar uvier bisde acher velo birshut harabbim umar savar uvier bisde acher velo birshut hammazzik
Birshut hammazzik lema perach birshuti may bae ella deilfa verabbi oshaya ika benayehu

Matni hakkelev vehaggedi shekkaftzu merosh haggag veshavru et hakkelim meshallem nezek shalem mippene shehen muadin hakkelev shennatal charara vehalach legadish achal hacharara vehidlik haggadish al hacharara meshallem nezek shalem veal haggadish meshallem chatzi nezek
Gema tama dekaftzu ha naflu patur alma kasavar techillato bifshia vesofo beones patur

Tanya name hachi hakkelev vehaggedi shekkaftzu merosh haggag veshavru et hakkelim meshallem nezek shalem naflu peturin hanicha leman deamar techillato bifshia vesofo beones patur ella leman deamar chayyav may ika lememar
Kegon dimkarvi kelim legabbe chotel dechi kaftzi bikfitza la nafli alayehu vaafilu techillato bifshia leka

Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava peamim sheafilu naflu name chayyav mashkachatte lah bechotel raua may nihu deibbei leh leassoke data denafli arche sof sof la neful arche unful inhu techillato bifshia vesofo beones hu la tzericha bechotel tzar
Tanu rabbanan hakkelev vehaggedi sheddillegu mimmatta lemala peturin millemala lematta chayyavin adam vetarnegol sheddillegu ben millemala lematta ben millematta lemala chayyavin

a: Vehatanya hakkelev vehaggedi sheddilgu ben millemala lematta ben millematta lemala peturin targema rav pappa deafech mefach kalba bizkira vegadya bisricha i hachi ammay peturim patur minnezek shalem vechayyavin bachatzi nezek
Hakkelev shennatal
Ittemar rabbi yochanan amar ishsho mishshum chitztzav veresh lakish amar ishsho mishshum mamono

Veresh lakish may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan amar lach chitztzav mikkocho kaazli hay la mikkocho kaazel verabbi yochanan may tama la amar keresh lakish amar lach mamona it beh mammasha ha let beh mammasha
Tenan hakkelev shennatal charara ku bishlama leman deamar ishsho mishshum chitztzav chitztzav dechelev hu
Ella leman deamar ishsho mishshum mamono hay esh lav mamono devaal kelev hu
Amar lach resh lakish hacha bemay askinan deaddeyeh addoye deal charara meshallem nezek shalem veal makom gachelet meshallem chatzi nezek veal gadish kulleh patur
Verabbi yochanan deannechah annoche al charara veal mekom gachelet meshallem nezek shalem veal haggadish meshallem chatzi nezek

Ta shema gamal taun pishtan veavar birshut harabbim nichnesa pishtano letoch hachanut vedalku vedalka benero shel chenoni vehidlik et habbira baal gamal chayyav hinniach chenoni nero mibbachutz chenoni chayyav rabbi yehuda omer bener chanukka patur

Bishlama leman deamar ishsho mishshum chitztzav chitztzav degamal hu ella leman deamar mishshum mamono hay esh lav mamona devaal gamal hu amar lach resh lakish hacha bemay askinan bimsachsechet kol habbira kullah
I hachi ema sefa im hinniach chenoni nero mibbachutz chenoni chayyav vei bimsachsechet ammay chayyav besheamda
Amda vesichsecha kol shekken dechenoni patur uvaal gamal chayyav amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav ika hacha bemay askinan kegon sheamda lehattil memeha
b: Resha baal gamal chayyav dela ibi leh leapposhe bitina sefa chenoni chayyav dela ibi leh leannoche nero meabbaray
Ta shema hammadlik et haggadish vehaya gedi kafut lo veeved samuch lo venisraf immo chayyav eved kafut lo ugdi samuch lo venisraf immo patur
Bishlama leman deamar ishsho mishshum chitztzav mishshum hachi patur ella leman deamar ishsho mishshum mamono ammay patur ilu ketal toreh avda hachi name dela michayyav
Amar lecha rabbi shimon ben lakish hacha bemay askinan keshehitztzit begufo shel eved dekam leh bidrabba mineh
I hachi may lememra la tzericha bigdi dechad veeved dechad
Ta shema hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh shote vekatan patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim
Bishlama leman deamar ishsho mishshum chitztzav chitztzav decheresh hu ella leman deamar ishsho mishshum mamono ilu masar shoro lecheresh shote vekatan hachi name dela michayyav
Ha ittemar alah amar resh lakish mishshemeh dechizkiyya lo shanu ella keshemmasar lo gachelet velibah aval masar lo shalhevet chayyav may tama bari hezeka
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu shalhevet patur kasavar tzevata decheresh ka garem la michayyav ad demasar leh geoza silta ushraga
Amar rava kera umatnita mesayya leh lerabbi yochanan kera dichtiv ki tetze esh tetze meatzmah yeshallem hammavir et habbeera shema minah ishsho mishshum chitztzav
Matnita detanya patach hakkatuv

a: Benizke mamono vesiyyem benizke gufo lomar lecha ishsho mishshum chitztzav
Amar rava kashya leh leabbaye leman deamar ishsho mishshum chitztzav tamun baesh diftar rachamana hechi mashkachatte lah
Venicha leh kegon shennafla deleka leoto chatzer venafla gader shello mechamat deleka vehalcha vehidlika vehizzika bechatzer acheret dehatam kelu leh chitztzav
I hachi leinyan galuy name kelu leh chitztzav
Ella leman deit leh mishshum chitztzav it leh name mishshum mamono uchgon shehaya lo legodrah velo gedarah dehatam shoro hu vela tefach beappeh
Vechi meachar deman deit leh mishshum chitztzav it leh name mishshum mamono may benayehu
Ika benayehu lechayevo bearbaa devarim
Al hacharara meshallem ku man chayyav baal kelev velichayyav name baal gachelet besheshshimer gachalto
I kesheshshimer gachalto may bae kelev hatam beshechatar amar rav mari bereh derav kahana zot omeret setam delatot chaturot hen etzel kelev
Deachlah hecha ilema deachlah begadish dealma ha baenan uvier bisde acher veleka la tzericha deachlah begadish devaal charara
Tifshot defi fara
b: Kachatzar hannizak dame dei kachatzar hammazzik dame lema leh may bae riftach befumma dechalbay
Deibaya lehu pi fara kachatzar hannizak dame o kachatzar hammazzik dame
Vei amratte kachatzar hammazzik dame shen dechayyev rachamana hechi mashkachatte lah
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana kegon shennitchakkecha bechotel lahanaatah vetinnefa perot lahanaatah
Matkef lah mar zutra veha baena kaasher yevaer haggalal ad tummo veleka ravina amar deshaf tzalme rav ashe amar defassaoy passoe
Ta shema shisa bo et hakkelev shisa bo et hannachash patur man patur meshasse patur vechayyav baal kelev vei amratte kachatzar hammazzik dame lema leh may bae yedach befummeh dechalbay
Ema patur af meshasse veibaet ema deappekeh leniveh vesarteh
Ta shema hishshich bo et hannachash rabbi yehuda mechayyev vachachamim potrim

Veamar rav acha bar yaakov keshettimtze lomar ledivre rabbi yehuda eres nachash ben shinav hu omed lefichach makkish besayif venachash patur ledivre chachamim eres nachash meatzmo mikki lefichach nachash biskila umakkish patur
Vei amratte pi fara kachatzar hammazzik dame lema leh may bae yedach befumma dechivay leinyan ketala la amrinan
Umna temra detanya hannichnas lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut ungacho shoro shel baal habbayit umet hashshor biskila uvalim peturim min hakkofer
Bealim peturin min hakkofer may tama deamar leh birshuti may baet shoro name lema leh may baet birshuti ella leinyan ketala la amrinan
Hanhu ize deve tarbu dahao mafsedi leh lerav yosef amar leh leabbaye zil ema lehu lemarayehu delatzneinhu amar leh ammay ezil dei azelna amri li ligdor mar gedera beareh
Vei gadar shen dechayyev rachamana hechi mashkachatte lah keshechatra i name denafel gudda belelya
Machrez rav yosef veitema rabba desalkin leela udnachatin letachta hane ize deshuka demafsedi matrenan bemarayehu tere utlata zimnin i tzayet tzayet vei la amrinan leh tiv ammesachta vekabbel zuzach

Matni ezehu tam veezehu muad muad kol sheheidu bo shelosha yamim vetam mishsheyyachzor bo shelosha yamim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer muad sheheidu bo shelosha peamim vetam kol sheyehu hattinokot memashmeshin bo veeno nogeach
Gema may tama derabbi yehuda amar abbaye temol chad mittemol tere shilshom telata velo yishmerennu bealav atan lingicha reviit
Rava amar temolmittemol chad shilshom tere vela yishmerennu haidana chayyav
Verabbi meir may tama detanya amar rabbi meir

a: Richek negichotav chayyav kerav negichotav lo kol shekken amaru leh zava tochiach sherichaka reiyyoteha temea kerva reiyyoteha tehora
Amar lahen hare hu omer vezot tihye tumato bezovo tala hakkatuv et hazzav biriyyot veet hazzava beyamim
Mimmay dehay vezot lemaote zava meriyyot ema lemaote zav miyyamim amar kera vehazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva makkish zachar linkeva ma nekeva beyamim af zachar beyamim
Velakkesh nekeva lezachar ma zachar biriyyot af nekeva biriyyot ha maet rachamana vezot
Uma raita mistabbera kae biriyyot memaet reiyyot kae biriyyot memaet yamim

Tanu rabbanan ezehu muad kol sheheidu bo shelosha yamim vetam sheyehu hattinokot memashmeshin bo veeno nogeach divre rabbi yose rabbi shimon omer muad kol sheheidu bo shalosh peamim velo amru shelosha yamim ella lachazara bilvad
Amar rav nachman amar rav adda bar ahava halacha kerabbi yehuda bemuad shehare rabbi yose mode lo vahalacha kerabbi meir betam shehare rabbi yose mode lo

Amar leh rava lerav nachman velema mar halacha kerabbi meir bemuad shehare rabbi shimon mode lo vahalacha kerabbi yehuda betam shehare rabbi shimon mode lo amar leh ana kerabbi yose sevira li derabbi yose nimuko immo
Ibbaya lehu shelosha yamim dekatane leyaode tora o leyaode gavra
Lemay nafka minah deatu telata kite sahadi bechad yoma i amratte leyaode tora miyyaad vei amratte leyaode gavra la miyyaad memar amar hashta hu dekamashadu bi may

Ta shema en hashshor naase muad ad sheyyaidu bo bifne vealim uvifne vet din heidu bo bifne vet din veshello bifne vealim bifne vealim veshello bifne vet din eno naase muad ad sheyyaidu bo bifne vet din uvifne vealim
Heiduhu shenayim barishona ushnayim bashsheniyya ushnayim bashshelishit hare kan shalosh ediyyot vehen edut achat lahazama
Nimtzet kat rishona zomemet hare kan shette ediyyot vehu patur vehen peturim nimtzet kat sheniyya zomemet hare kan edut achat vehu patur vehen peturim
Nimtzet kat shelishit zomemet kullan chayyavin veal ze neemar vaasitem lo kaasher zamam vego
I amratte leyaode tora shappir
b: Ella i amratte leyaode gavra lemru hanach kammae anan mi hava yadinan devatar telata yome atu hane umyaadi leh

Amar rav ashe amritah lishmata kammeh derav kahana vaamar li ulyaode tora mi nicha velemru hanach batrae anan mena yadinan dechol dekae be dina leashode betora kaatu anan lechayyove gavra palga nizka atenan
Dekamrammezi rammoze rav ashe amar keshebbau retzufim
Ravina amar bemakkirin baal hashshor veen makkirin et hashshor
Ella hechi meyaadi leh deamri tora naggechana it lach bevakrach ibbei lach lenattore lechulleh bakra

Ibbaya lehu hamshasse kalbo shel chavero bachavero mahu meshasse vadday patur baal kelev may mi amrinan matze amar leh ana may avedna leh o dilma amrinan leh kevan deyadatte bechalbach dimshasse leh umishtasse la ibbei lach leashhoyeh
Amar rabbi zera ta shema vetam sheyehu hattinokot memashmeshin bo veeno nogeach ha nogeach chayyav amar abbaye mi katane nagach chayyav dilma ha nagach la have tam uvhahi negicha la michayyav
Ta shema shisa bo et hakkelev shisa bo nachash patur may lav patur meshasse vechayyav baal kelev la ema patur af meshasse
Amar rava im timtze lomar hamshasse kalbo shel chavero bachavero chayyav shisahu hu beatzmo patur may tama kol hamshanne uva acher veshina bo patur

Amar leh rav pappa lerava itmar mishshemeh deresh lakish keotach deamar resh lakish shette parot birshut harabbim achat revutza veachat mehallechet uviata mehallechet birvutza petura revutza bimhallechet chayyevet
Amar leh ana behahi chayyove mechayyevna deamrinan leh ki it lach reshuta lesaggoye alay levaote bi let lach reshuta
Matni shor hammazzik birshut hannizak ketzad nagach nagaf nashach ravatz baat birshut harabbim meshallem chatzi nezek birshut hannizak rabbi tarfon omer nezek shalem vachachamim omrim chatzi nezek

Amar lahem rabbi tarfon uma bemakom shehekel al hashshen veal haregel birshut harabbim shehu patur hechmir alehen birshut hannizak leshallem nezek shalem mekom shehechmir al hakkeren birshut harabbim leshallem chatzi nezek eno din shennachmir alav birshut hannizak leshallem nezek shalem
Amru lo dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon ma birshut harabbim chatzi nezek af birshut hannizak chatzi nezek
Amar lahem af ani

a: Lo adun keren mikkeren ani adun keren meregel uma bemakom shehekel al hashshen veal haregel birshut harabbim hechmir bakkeren makom shehechmir al hashshen veal haregel birshut hannizak eno din shennachmir bakkeren
Amru lo dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon ma birshut harabbim chatzi nezek af birshut hannizak chatzi nezek

Gema verabbi tarfon let leh dayyo veha dayyo deorayeta hu detanya middin kal vechomer ketzad vayyomer Adonai el moshe veaviha yarok yarak befaneha halo tikkalem shivat yamim kal vechomer lashshechina arbaa asar yom ella dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon
Ki let leh dayyo hecha demipperich kal vachomer hecha dela mipperich kal vachomer it leh dayyo hatam shiva dishchina la ketivi ata kal vachomer ayeti arbesar ata dayyo appek shiva veoke shiva
Aval hacha chatzi nezek ketiv vaata kal vachomer veayeti chatzi nezek acharina venaasa nezek shalem i darshatte dayyo ipperich leh kal vachomer
Verabbanan shiva dishchina ketivi tissager shivat yamim
Verabbi tarfon hahu tissager dedarshinan dayyo hu
Verabbanan ketiv kera acharina vattissager miryam verabbi tarfon hahu daafilu bealma darshinan dayyo velo tomar hacha mishshum kevodo shel moshe aval bealma la ka mashma lan

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veha hay tanna dela daresh dayyo veaf al gav dela mipperich kal vachomer detanya keri bezav minnayin vedin hu ma tahor betahor tame betame tame betahor eno din sheyehe tame betame
Veka mayete lah ben lemagga ben lemassa veammay nema ahani kal vachomer lemagga ahani dayyo leappoke massa

Vechi tema lemagga la itzterich kal vachomer dela gara miggavra tahor itzterich salka datach amena mikkere layela ketiv mi shekkiro gorem lo yatza ze sheen kiro gorem lo ella davar acher garam lo ka mashma lan
Mide velo davar acher ketiv

Uman tanna deshamatte leh deamar shichvat zera shel zav metammea bemassa la rabbi eliezer vela rabbi yehoshua ditnan shichvat zera shel zav metammea bemagga veen metammea bemassa divre rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua omer af metammea bemassa lefi shei efshar belo tzichtzuche ziva
Ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam ella shei efshar belo tzichtzuche ziva ha lav hachi la ella hay tanna hu ditnan lemala mehen
b: Zovo shel zav verukko veshichvat zaro umeme raglav vedam hannidda metammein ben bemagga ben bemassa
Vedilma hachi name lefi shei efshar belo tzichtzuche ziva im ken litneyah gabbe zovo may shena dekatane lah gabbe rukko ella mishshum deate merukko

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina veha hay tanna la daresh dayyo veaf al gav dela mipperich kal vachomer detanya mappatz bemet minnayin vedin hu uma pakkin ketannim shettehorim bezav metamme bemet mappatz shemmetamme bezav eno din sheyetamme bemet
Vekamayete lah ben letumat erev ben letumat shiva veammay ema ahani kal vachomer letumat erev veahani dayyo leappoke tumat shiva

Amar leh kevar rema nihaleh rav nachman bar zecharya leabbaye vaamar leh abbaye tanna mimmappatz besheretz mayete lah vehachi kaamar mappatz besheretz minnayin vedin hu uma pakkin ketannim shettehorim bezav temein besheretz mappatz shettame bezav eno din sheyehe tame besheretz
Ella mappatz bemet minnayin neemar beged vaor besheretz veneemar beged vaor bemet ma beged vaor haamur besheretz mappatz tame bo af beged vaor haamur bemet mappatz tame bo
Mufne dei la mufne ika lemifrach ma lesheretz shekken metamme bechaadasha tomar bemet sheen metamme bechaadasha ella bichzayit

Laye ippenoye mufne mikkede sheretz ittakkash leshichvat zera dichtiv o ish asher tetze vego usmich leh o ish asher yigga bechol sheretz uchtiv beh beshichvat zera vechol beged vechol or asher yihye alav shichvat zara
Beged vaor dichtav rachamana besheretz lema li shema minah leafnoye
Veakkatti mufne mitztzad echad hu hanicha leman deamar mufne mitztzad echad lemedin veen meshivin shappir ella leman deamar lemedin umshivin may ika lememar

Demet name ippenoye mufne mikkede met ittakkash leshichvat zera dichtiv vehannogea bechol teme nefesh o ish asher tetze mimmennu vego uchtiv beh beshichvat zera vechol beged vechol or asher yihye alav shichvat zara beged vaor dichtav rachamana bemet lema li shema minah leafnoye vehave mufne mishshene tzedadin
Hanicha leman deamar dun minah veoke beatra ella leman deamar dun minah uminah may ika lememar
Amar rava amar kera vechibbastem bigdechem bayyom hashshevii kol temaot sheattem mittammein bemet lo yehu pechutin mishshiva

Uthe shen varegel chayyav birshut harabbim mikkal vachomer uma keren shebbirshut hannizak eno meshallem ella chatzi nezek birshut harabbim chayyevet shen varegel shebbirshut hannizak meshallem nezek shalem eno din shebbirshut harabbim chayyav
Amar kera uvier bisde acher velo birshut harabbim

a: Mide kulleh kaamrinan palga kaamrinan
Amar kera vechatzu et kaspo kaspo shel ze velo kaspo shel acher

Velo tehe shen varegel chayyevet birshut hannizak ella chatzi nezek mikkal vachomer mikkeren uma keren shebbirshut harabbim chayyevet birshut hannizak enah meshallemet ella chatzi nezek shen varegel shebbirshut harabbim petura eno din shebbirshut hannizak meshallem chatzi nezek
Amar kera yeshallem tashlumin mealleya

Velo tehe keren birshut harabbim chayyav mikkal vachomer uma shen varegel shebbirshut hannizak nezek shalem birshut harabbim petura keren shebbirshut hannizak chatzi nezek eno din shebbirshut harabbim petura
Amar rabbi yochanan amar kera yechetzun en chatzi nezek chaluk lo birshut harabbim velo birshut hayyachid
Vihe adam chayyav bechofer mikkal vachomer uma shor sheeno chayyav bearbaa devarim chayyav bechofer adam shechayyav bearbaa devarim eno din sheyehe chayyav bechofer
Amar kera kechol asher yushat alav alav velo al adam
Vihe shor chayyav bearbaa devarim mikkal vechomer uma adam sheeno chayyav bechofer chayyav bearbaa devarim shor shechayyav bechofer eno din sheyehe chayyav bearbaa devarim
Amar kera ish baamito velo shor baamito
Ibaya lehu regel sheddarsa al gabbe tinok bachatzar hannizak mahu shetteshallem kofer mi amrinan mide dehave akkeren keren kevan daavad tere utlata zimne orcheh hu umshallem kofer hacha name la shena
O dilma keren kauonato lehazzik hay en kauonato lehazzik
Ta shema hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut ungacho levaal habbayit vamet hashshor biskila uvalav ben tam ben muad meshallem kofer shalem divre rabbi tarfon

Kofer shalem betam lerabbi tarfon mena leh lav mishshum desavar leh kerabbi yose haggelili deamar tam meshallem chatzi chofer birshut harabbim umayete lah mikkal vachomer meregel alma ika kofer beregel
Amar rav shimi minnehardea tanna minnezakin deregel mayete lah
Velifroch ma linzakin deregel shekken yeshnan beesh mittamun
Ma letamun shekken yeshno bevor mikkelim
Ma lechelim sheyyeshnan beesh mikkelim temunim ma lechelim temunim sheyyeshnan beadam
Ella lav shema minah mikkofer deregel mayete lah alma ika kofer beregel shema minah
