Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina hachi name mistabbera deika kofer beregel dei salka datach leka kofer beregel vetanna minnezakin deregel mayete lah lifroch ma linzakin deregel shekken yeshnan beregel
Ella lav shema minah mikkofer deregel mayete lah alma ika kofer beregel shema minah
Matni adam muad leolam ben shogeg ben mezid ben er ben yashen sime et en chavero veshiber et hakkelim meshallem nezek shalem
Gema katane sime et en chavero dumya deshiber et hakkelim ma hatam nezek in arbaa devarim la af sime et en chavero nezek in arbaa devarim la
b: Mena hane mile amar chizkiyya vechen tana deve chizkiyya amar kera petza tachat patza lechayevo al hashshogeg kemezid veal haones keratzon
Hay mibbee leh liten tzaar bimkom nezek im ken lichtov kera petza befatza may tachat patza shema minah tarte
Amar rabba hayeta even munnachat lo becheko velo hikkir bah veamad venafla leinyan nezakin chayyav leinyan arbaa devarim patur leinyan shabbat melechet machshevet asra tora leinyan galut patur
Leinyan eved pelugta derabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan detanya hare shehaya rabbo rofe veamar lo kechol eni vesimah chator li shini vehippilah sichek baadon veyatza lecherut
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer veshichatah ad sheyyitkaven leshachatah

Hikkir bah ushchechah veamad venafla leinyan nezakin chayyav leinyan arbaa devarim patur leinyan galut chayyav deamar kera bishgaga mikkelal dahava leh yedia veha haveya leh yedia leinyan shabbat patur leinyan eved pelugta derabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan

Nitkaven lizrok shettayim vezarak arba leinyan nezakin chayyav leinyan arbaa devarim patur leinyan shabbat melechet machshevet baenan leinyan galut asher lo tzada amar rachamana perat lenitkaven lizrok shettayim vezarak arba leinyan eved pelugta derabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan

Nitkaven lizrok arba vezarak shemone leinyan nezakin chayyav leinyan arbaa devarim patur leinyan shabbat beomer kol makom shettirtze tanuach in i la la leinyan galut asher lo tzada perat lenitkaven lizrok arba vezarak shemone leinyan eved pelugta derabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan
Veamar rabba zarak keli merosh haggag uva acher ushvaro bemakkel patur may tama mana tevira tavar
Veamar rabba zarak keli merosh haggag vehau tachtav karim o chesatot ba acher vesillekan o kadam hu vesillekan patur may tama beidana deshadyeh passoke mefasseki gireh
Veamar rabba zarak tinok merosh haggag uva acher vekibbelo besayif pelugta derabbi yehuda ben betera verabbanan detanya hikkuhu asara bene adam baasara maklot ben bevat achat ben baze achar ze kullan

a: Peturin rabbi yehuda ben betera omer beze achar ze haacharon chayyav mippene shekkerav mitato

Ba shor vekibbelo bekarnav pelugta derabbi yishmael beno shel yochanan ben beroka verabbanan detanya venatan pidyon nafsho deme nizak rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer deme mazzik
Veamar rabba nafal merosh haggag venitka beishsha chayyav bearbaa devarim uvivimto lo kana
Chayyav benezek betzaar beripuy beshevet aval boshet la ditnan eno chayyav al habboshet ad sheyehe mitkaven

Veamar rabba nafal merosh haggag beruach sheenah metzuya vehizzik uviyyesh chayyav al hannezek ufatur bearbaa devarim beruach metzuya vehizzik uviyyesh chayyav bearbaa devarim ufatur al habboshet veim nithappech chayyav af al habboshet
Detanya mimmashma shenneemar veshalcha yadah eni yodea shehechezika ma talmud lomar vehechezika lomar lecha kevan shennitkaven lehazzik af al pi shello nitkaven levayyesh
Veamar rabba hinniach lo gachelet al libbo vamet patur al bigdo venisraf chayyav

Amar rava tarvayehu tenanhi al libbo ditnan kavash alav letoch haur o letoch hammayim veeno yachol laalot mishsham vamet chayyav dechafo letoch haur o letoch hammayim veyachol laalot mishsham vamet patur
Bigdo ditnan kera et kesuti shabber et kaddi chayyav al menat liftor patur
Bae rabba hinniach gachelet al lev avdo mahu kegufo dame o kemamono dame im timtza lomar kegufo dame shoro mahu
Hadar pashtah avdo kegufo shoro kemamono
Hadaran alach ketzad haregel
Matni hammanniach et hakkad birshut harabbim uva acher venitkal bah ushvarah patur veim huzzak bah baal hechavit chayyav benizko
Gema patach bechad vesiyyem bechavit
Utnan name ze ba bechavito veze ba bekorato nishbera kaddo shel ze bekorato shel ze patur patach bechavit vesiyyem bechad
Utnan name ze ba bechavito shel yayin veze ba bechaddo shel devash nisdeka chavit shel devash veshafach ze yeno vehitztzil et haddevash letocho en lo ella secharo patach bechad vesiyyem bechavit
Amar rav pappa hayenu kad hayenu chavit lemay nafka minah lemikkach umimkar
Hechi dame ilema beatra dechadda la karu chavit vechavit la karu kadda ha la karu lah
La tzericha derubba karu lah lechadda kadda ulchavita chavita veika name dekaru lechavita kadda ulchadda chavita mahu detema zil batar rubba
b: Ka mashma lan deen holchin bemamon achar harov
Uva acher venitkal bah ushvarah patur ammay patur ibi leh leayyone umezal
Amri deve rav mishshemeh derav bimmalle reshut harabbim kullah chaviyyot shemuel amar baafela shanu rabbi yochanan amar bekeren zavit
Amar rav pappa la dayeka matnitin ella o kishmuel o kerabbi yochanan dei kerav may irya nitkal afilu shavar name

Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava hu haddin daafilu shavar vehay dekatane nitkal ayede devae lemitne sefa veim huzzak bah baal chavit chayyav benizko dedaveka nitkal aval shavar la may tama hu deazzek annafsheh katane resha nitkal
Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe hachi amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi ulla lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lehitbonen badderachim
Hava ovada binhardea vechayyev shemuel befumbedita vechayyev rava
Bishlama shemuel kishmateh ella rava lema kishmuel sevira leh
Amar rav pappa karna deatzra have dechevan devirshut kaavdi ibi leh leayyone umezal
Shelach leh rav chisda lerav nachman hare amru lirchubba shalosh velivita chamesh velisnokeret shelosh esre lefanda demara ulkofina demara may
Shelach leh chisda chisda kenasa ka magbet bevavel ema li gufa deovada hechi hava
Shelach leh dehahu garguta deve tere dechol yoma hava dale chad minnayehu ata chad ka dale beoma dela dileh amar leh yoma didi hu la ashgach beh shekal panda demara machyeh
Amar leh mea pande befanda limchayeh afilu leman deamar la aved inish dina lenafsheh bimkom peseda aved inish dina lenafsheh
Deittemar rav yehuda amar la aved inish dina lenafsheh rav nachman amar aved inish dina lenafsheh

Hecha deika peseda kulle alma la peligi deaved inish dina lenafsheh ki peligi hecha deleka peseda rav yehuda amar la aved inish dina lenafsheh dechevan deleka peseda lezil kammeh dayyana rav nachman amar aved inish dina lenafsheh dechevan divdin aved la tarach
Metiv rav kahana ben bag bag omer al tikanes lachatzar chavercha litol et shellecha shello birshut shemma terae alav kegannav ella shevor et shinav veemor lo shelli ani notel
Amar leh

a: Immach ben bag bag yechidaa hu ufligi rabbanan aleh
Rabbi yannay amar may shevor et shinav baddin
I hachi veemor lo veomrim lo mibe leh shelli ani notel shello hu notel mibe leh kashya
Ta shema shor sheala al gabbe chavero lehorgo uva baal hattachton veshamat et shello venafal elon vamet patur may lav bemuad deleka peseda
La betam deika peseda
I hachi ema sefa dechafo laelon vamet chayyav vei betam ammay chayyav
Shehaya lo leshomto velo shemato
Ta shema hammalle chatzar chavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen baal hechatzer meshabber veotze meshabber venichnas
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak meshabber veotze levet din meshabber venichnas lehavi zechiyyotav
Ta shema minnayin lenirtza shekkalu lo yamav verabbo mesarhev bo latzet vechaval veasa bo chabbura shehu patur
Talmud lomar lo tikkechu chofer lashuv lo tikchu kofer lashshav
Hacha bemay askinan beavda gannava
Ad haidana la genav vehashta ganev ad haidana hava emteh derabbeh aleh hashta let leh emta derabbeh aleh
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar beeved shemmasar lo rabbo shifcha kenaanit ad haidana hetera vehashta isura
Ta shema hammanniach et hakkad birshut harabbim uva acher venitkal bah ushvarah patur tama denitkal bah ha shevarah chayyav

Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava hu haddin afilu shevarah vehay dekatane nitkal ayede dekavae lemitne sefa im huzzak baal chavit chayyav benizko dedaveka nitkal aval shavar la dehu azzek nafsheh katane resha nitkal
Ta shema vekatztzota et kappah mamon may lav besheenah yechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher lo sheyechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher

Aval enah yechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher petura i hachi addetane sefa veshalcha yadah perat lishliach bet din liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim besheyechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher aval enah yechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher petura
Hachi name kaamar bamme devarim amurim besheyechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher aval enah yechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher naasa yadah kishliach bet din uftura
Ta shema hare shehayeta derech harabbim overet betoch sadehu netalah venatan lahem min hatztzad ma shennatan natan veshello lo higgio
Vei amratte aved inish dina lenafsheh linkot pazra velitev
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava gezera shemma yitten lahem derech akallaton
Rav mesharsheya amar benoten lahem derech akallaton
Rav ashe amar kol min hatztzad derech akallaton hu kerova laze urchoka laze
I hachi ammay shello lo higgio lema lehu shekulu didchu vehavu li didi
Mishshum derav yehuda deamar rav yehuda metzar shehecheziku bo rabbim asur lekalkelo
Ta shema baal habbayit shehinniach pea mitztzad echad uvau aniyyim venatlu mitztzad acher ze vaze pea vei amratte aved inish dina lenafsheh ammay ze vaze pea linkot pazra velitev
Amar rava may ze vaze pea lefotran min hammaaser
Kidtanya hammafkir et karmo vehishkim babboker uvtzaro chayyav beferet uvolelot uvshichcha uvfea ufatur min hammaaser
Matni nishbera kaddo birshut harabbim vehuchlak echad bammayim o shellaka becharsit chayyav rabbi yehuda omer bemitkaven chayyav beeno mitkaven patur
Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav lo shanu ella shettinfu kelav bammayim
b: Aval hu atzmo patur karka olam hizzikattu
Ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li mikkede avno vesakkino umassao mibboro lamadnu vechullan ani kore bahen shor velo adam chamor velo kelim
Vehane mile leinyan ketala aval leinyan nezakin adam chayyav vechelim peturin
Verav hane mile hecha deafkerinhu aval hecha dela afkerinhu mamono hu

Metiv rav oshaya venafal shamma shor o chamor shor velo adam chamor velo kelim mikkan amru nafal letocho shor vechelav venishtabberu chamor vechelav venitkaru chayyav al habbehema ufatur al hakkelim ha lema ze dome leavno vesakkino umassao shehinnichan birshut harabbim vehizziku
Adderabba ma dome laze mibbee leh ella may dome laze avno vesakkino umassao shehinnichan birshut harabbim vehizziku
Lefichach im hetiach tzelochito beeven chayyav
Resha kashya lerav vesefa kashya lishmuel
Ultamach tikshe lach hi gufa kashya resha patur vesefa chayyav
Ella rav metaretz letameh ushmuel metaretz letameh
Rav metaretz letameh bamme devarim amurim keshehifkiran aval lo hifkiran chayyav lefichach hetiach tzelochito beeven chayyav
Ushmuel metaretz letameh hashta deamratte avno sakkino umassao kevoro dame lerabbi yehuda dimchayyev al nizke chelim bevor lefichach hetiach tzelochito beeven chayyav
Amar rabbi elazar lo shanu ella shennitkal baeven venishshof baeven aval nitkal bakkarka venishshof baeven patur
Keman dela kerabbi natan

Ika deamri amar rabbi elazar la tema benitkal baeven venishshof baeven hu demichayyav aval nitkal bakkarka venishshof baeven patur ella afilu nitkal bakkarka venishshof baeven chayyav keman kerabbi natan
Rabbi yehuda omer bemitkaven chayyav vechu hechi dame mitkaven
Amar rabba bemitkaven lehoridah lematta mikketefo amar leh abbaye mikkelal dimchayyev rabbi meir afilu nifshera amar leh in mechayyev haya rabbi meir afilu oznah beyado
Ammay anus hu veones rachamana patreh dichtiv velannaara lo taase davar
Vechi tema hane mile leinyan ketala aval leinyan nezakin chayyav vehatanya nishbera kaddo velo sillekah nafla gemallo velo heemida rabbi meir mechayyev behezzekan vachachamim omrim

a: Patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim

Umodim chachamim lerabbi meir beavno sakkino umassao shehinnichan berosh gaggo venaflu beruach metzuya vehizziku shehu chayyav umode rabbi meir lerabbanan bemaale kankannin al haggag al menat lenaggevan venaflu beruach sheenah metzuya vehizziku shehu patur
Ella amar abbaye betarte peligi peligi bishat nefila ufligi leachar nefila
Peligi bishat nefila benitkal poshea mar savar nitkal poshea hu umar savar nitkal lav poshea hu
Peligi leachar nefila bemafkir nezakav mar savar mafkir nezakav chayyav umar savar patur
Umimmay middekatane tarte huchlak echad bammayim o shellaka bacharsit hayenu hach ella lav hachi kaamar huchlak echad bammayim bishat nefila o shellaka bacharsit leachar nefila
Umiddematnitin betarte barayeta name betarte
Bishlama kaddo mashkachatte lah o bishat nefila o leachar nefila ella gemallo bishlama leachar nefila mashkachatte lah bemafkir nivlato ella bishat nefila hechi mashkachatte lah
Amar rav acha kegon deabberah bemayya derech serata denahara
Hechi dame i deika darka acharina poshea hu vei deleka darka acharina anus hu
Ella mashkachatte lah deittekil veittekila beh gamla
Mafkir nezakav may mitkaven ika
Amar rav yosef bemitkaven lizkot bacharaseha vechen amar rav ashe bemitkaven lizkot bacharaseha
Rabbi elazar amar bishat nefila machloket
Aval leachar nefila may divre hakkol patur veha ika rabbi meir dimchayyev ella may divre hakkol chayyav veha ika rabbanan defatri
Ella may bishat nefila af bishat nefila vekamashma lan kidabbaye
b: Verabbi yochanan amar leachar nefila machloket
Aval bishat nefila may divre hakkol patur veha middekaamar rabbi yochanan lekamman la tema matnitin rabbi meir hi deamar nitkal poshea hu mikkelal derabbi meir mechayyev
Ella may divre hakkol chayyav veha middekaamar rabbi yochanan lekamman la tema matnitin rabbi meir hi deamar nitkal poshea hu mikkelal defatri rabbanan
Ella ha ka mashma lan demafkir nezakav dehacha hu defatri rabbanan deanus hu aval mafkir nezakav dealma mechayevi
Itmar mafkir nezakav rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar chad amar chayyav vechad amar patur
Lema man dimchayyev kerabbi meir uman defatar kerabbanan

Alliba derabbi meir kulle alma la peligi ki peligi alliba derabbanan man defatar kerabbanan uman dimchayyev amar lach ana daamari afilu lerabbanan ad kan la patri rabbanan ella bemafkir nezakav dehacha mishshum deanus hu aval mafkir nezakav dealma mechayevi

Tistayyem derabbi elazar hu deamar chayyav deamar rabbi elazar mishshum rabbi yishmael shene devarim enan birshuto shel adam vaasaan hakkatuv keilu hen birshuto veellu hen bor birshut harabbim vechametz mishshesh shaot ulmala tistayyem

Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi veha amar rabbi elazar ipcha ditnan hahofech et haggalal birshut harabbim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav benizko veamar rabbi elazar lo shanu ella shennitkaven lizkot bahen aval lo nitkaven lizkot bahen patur alma mafkir nezakav patur
Amar rav adda bar ahava shehechzirah limkomah amar ravina mashal derav adda bar ahava lamma haddavar dome lemotze bor megulle vechissahu vechazar vegilahu
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina mi dame hatam la istalluk lehu maase rishon hacha istalluk lehu maase rishon
Ha la dame ella lemotze bor megulla utmamah vechazar vachafarah deistalliku lehu maase rishon vekayema lah birshuto
Ella amar rav ashe keshehafachah lefachot mishshelosha

Umay duchkeh derabbi elazar leokomah kegon shehafachah lefachot mishshelosha vetama dechi nitkaven lizkot bah ha en mitkaven lizkot bah la lokmah lemala mishshelosha veaf al gav dela nitkaven lizkot bah chayyav
Amar rava matnitin keshiteh may irya hafach litne higbiha ella shema minah kol hafach lematta mishshelosha hu
Umidderabbi elazar amar chayyav rabbi yochanan amar patur
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehatnan hammatznia et hakkotz veet hazzechuchit vehaggoder gedero bekotzim vegader shennafal lirshut harabbim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav benizko

Veamar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella bemafriach aval bimtzamtzem patur metzamtzem may tama patur lav mishshum dehaveya leh bor birshuto mikkelal dechiyyuva devor birshut harabbim hu alma mafkir nezakav chayyav
La leolam ema lach mafkir nezakav patur umtzamtzem may tama patur mishshum deittemar alah amar rav acha bereh derav ika lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lehitchakkech bakketalim
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi veha amar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna utnan hachofer bor birshut harabbim venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet chayyav
Ella leolam rabbi yochanan amar chayyav
Umidderabbi yochanan amar chayyav rabbi elazar amar patur vehaamar rabbi elazar

a: Mishshum rabbi yishmael ku
La kashya ha dideh ha derabbeh

Matni hashshofech mayim birshut harabbim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav benizko hammatznia et hakkotz veet hazzechuchit vehaggoder et gedero bekotzim vegader shennafal lirshut harabbim vehuzzeku bahen acherim chayyav benizkan
Gema amar rav lo shanu ella denitnefu kelav bemayim aval hu atzmo patur karka olam hizzikattu
Amar leh rav huna lerav lo yehe ella kerifsho
Mi savratte dela tammu mayya bidtammu mayya
Vetarte lema li
Chada bimot hachamma vachada bimot haggeshamim
Detanya kol ellu sheamru potkin bivotehen vegorfin mearotehen bimot hachamma en lahen reshut uvimot haggeshamim yesh lahem reshut veaf al pi shebbirshut im hizziku chayyavin leshallem
Hammatznia et hakkotz vechu amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella mafriach aval metzamtzem la may tama patur amar rav acha bereh derav ika lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lehitchakkech bakketalim
Tanu rabbanan hammatznia kotzotav uzchuchiyyotav letoch kotel shel chavero uva baal kotel vesatar kotlo venafal lirshut harabbim vehizziku chayyav hammatznia
Amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella bechotel raua aval bechotel bari hammatznia patur vechayyav baal hakkotel
Amar ravina zot omeret hamchassa boro bedolo shel chavero uva baal deli venatal dolo chayyav baal habbor
Peshita
Mahu detema hatam hu dela havi yada leh delodeh aval hacha deyada leh hava leh leodoeh ka mashma lan
Tanu rabbanan chasidim harishonim hau matzniim kotzotehem uzchuchiyyotehem betoch sedotehen umaamikim lahen shelosha tefachim kede shello yeakkev hammacharesha
Rav sheshet shade lehu benura rava shade lehu bediglat
Amar rav yehuda hay man devae lemeheve chasida lekayyem mile dinzikin rava amar mile deavot veamri lah mile divrachot

Matni hammotzi et tivno vekashsho lirshut harabbim lizvalim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav benizko vechol hakkodem bahen zacha rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol hamkalkelin birshut harabbim vehizziku chayyavin leshallem vechol hakkodem bahen zacha
Hahofech et haggalal birshut harabbim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav benizko
Gema lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda

Detanya rabbi yehuda omer bishat hotzaat zevalim adam motzi zivlo lirshut harabbim vetzovro kol sheloshim yom kede sheyehe nishof beragle adam uvragle behema sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua et haaretz
Afilu tema rabbi yehuda mode rabbi yehuda sheim hizzik meshallem ma shehizzik
Vehatnan rabbi yehuda omer bener chanukka patur mippene shehu birshut may lav mishshum reshut bet din
La mishshum reshut mitzva detanya rabbi yehuda omer bener chanukka patur mippene shehu reshut mitzva
Ta shema kol ellu sheamru muttarin lekalkel birshut harabbim im hizziku chayyavin leshallem verabbi yehuda poter
Amar rav nachman matnitin shello bishat hotzaat zevalim verabbi yehuda hi
Rav ashe amar
b: Tivno vekashsho tenan mishshum demashreki
Kol hakkodem bahen zacha amar rav ben begufan ben beshivchan uzeri amar beshivchan aval lo begufan
Bemay kamipalgi rav savar kansu gufan mishshum shivchan uzeri savar lo kansu gufan mishshum shivchan
Tenan hahofech et haggalal birshut harabbim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav benizko veilu kol hakkodem zacha la katane
Tena leresha vehu haddin lesefa
Veha tane alah asurin mishshum gazel
Ki katane asurin mishshum gazel akkullah matnitin kae leoto shekkadam vezacha

Veha la katane hachi ditnan hammotzi tivno vekashsho lirshut harabbim lizvalim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav benizko vechol hakkodem bahen zacha umuttar mishshum gazel vehahofech et haggalal lirshut harabbim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav veasur mishshum gazel
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak galal karamet davar sheyyesh bo shevach kansu gufo mishshum shivcho davar sheen bo shevach lo kansu
Ibaya lehu ledivre haomer kansu gufan mishshum shivchan lealtar kansinan o lechi mayeti shevacha kansinan
Ta shema middekaayerinan galal
Vetisbera ki ayerinan galal mikamme dilshanne rav nachman levatar deshanni rav nachman mi ika lemirme galal kelal

Lema ketannae shetar shekkatuv bo ribbit konsin oto veeno gove lo et hakkeren velo et haribbit divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim gove et hakkeren aval lo et haribbit lema rav deamar kerabbi meir uzeri deamar kerabbanan
Amar lecha rav ana daamari afilu lerabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella keren divhettera aval hacha keren gufa kamazzek
Uzeri amar lach ana daamari afilu lerabbi meir ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella demishsheat ketiva daavad leh suma aval hacha mi yemar demazzek

Lema kehane tannae hammotzi tivno vekashsho lirshut harabbim lizvalim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav benizko vechol hakkodem bahen zacha vaasurin mishshum gazel rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol hamkalkelin birshut harabbim vehizziku chayyavin leshallem vechol hakkodem bahen zacha umuttarin mishshum gazel

Ha gufa kashya amratte kol hakkodem bahen zacha vahadar kaamar asurin mishshum gazel ella lav hachi kaamar vechol hakkodem bahen zacha beshivchan vaasurin mishshum gazel aggufan vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar afilu gufan name kol hakkodem bahen zacha
Lizeri vadday tannae hi lerav mi lema tannae hi
Amar lecha rav dechulle alma kansu gufan mishshum shivchan vehacha bahalacha veen morin ken ka mipalgi deittemar rav huna amar rav halacha veen morin ken rav adda bar ahava amar halacha umorin ken
Ini veha rav huna afkar chushle rav adda bar ahava afkar

a: Selikusta
Bishlama rav adda bar ahava kishmateh ella rav huna lema hadar beh
Hanhu mutrin hao
Matni shene kaddarin shehau mehallechin ze achar ze venitkal harishon venafal venitkal hashsheni barishon harishon chayyav benizke sheni
Gema amar rabbi yochanan la tema matnitin rabbi meir hi deamar nitkal poshea hu vechayyav ella afilu lerabbanan deamri anus hu ufatur hacha chayyav shehaya lo laamod velo amad
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar afilu tema lo haya lo laamod haya lo lehazhir velo hizhir
Verabbi yochanan amar kevan delo haya lo laamod lo haya lo lehazhir ditrid
Tenan haya baal kora rishon uvaal chavit acharon nishbera chavit bakkora patur veim amad baal kora chayyav
May lav sheamad lechattef deorcheh hu vekatane chayyav dahava leh lehazhir
Lo kesheamad lafush
Aval amad lechattef may patur addetane sefa veim amar lo levaal chavit amod patur liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim kesheamad lafush aval amad lechattef patur
Ha ka mashma lan deaf al gav deamad lafush ki kaamar lo levaal chavit amod patur

Ta shema hakkaddarin vehazzaggagin shehau mehallechin ze achar ze nitkal harishon venafal venitkal hashsheni barishon vehashshelishi bashsheni rishon chayyav benizke sheni vesheni chayyav benizke shelishi veim mechamat rishon naflu rishon chayyav benizke kullam veim hizhiru ze et ze peturin may lav shello haya lahen laamod
Lo shehaya lahen laamod
Aval lo haya lahem laamod may patur i hachi addetane sefa im hizhiru ze et ze patur liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim shehaya lahen laamod aval lo haya lahen laamod peturin
Ha ka mashma lan deaf al gav dehaya lahen laamod ki hizhiru ze et ze peturin
Amar rava rishon chayyav benizke sheni ben benizke gufo ben benizke mamono sheni chayyav benizke shelishi benizke gufo aval lo benizke mamono
Mimma nafshach i nitkal poshea hu sheni name lichayyav i nitkal lav poshea hu afilu rishon name liptar
b: Rishon vadday poshea hu sheni aggufo michayyav dehaya lo laamod velo amad ammamono patur deamar leh hay bera lav ana keriteh
Metivi kullan chayyavin al nizke gufan ufturin al nizke mamonan may lav afilu rishon
La levar merishon veha kullam katane amar rav adda bar ahava kullan hannizakin
Hay may i amratte bishlama afilu rishon hayenu dekatane kullan ella i amratte levar merishon may kullan litne hannizakin

Ella amar rava rishon chayyav ben benizke gufo desheni ben benizke mamono desheni vesheni chayyav benizke shelishi benizke gufo aval lo benizke mamono may tama dehave leh bor velo matzinu bor shechiyyev bo et hakkelim
Hanicha lishmuel deamar kol takkala bor hu ella lerav deamar i afkereh in i la la may ika lememar
Leolam kidamar meikara udkashya lach kullan chayyavin targemah rav adda bar minome kammeh deravina shehuzzeku kelim bechelim
Amar mar im mechamat rishon naflu rishon chayyav benizke chullam mechamat rishon hechi nafel rav pappa amar defaskeh leorcheh keshilda rav zevid amar kechutra desamuta
Matni ze ba bechavito veze ba bekorato nishbera kaddo shel ze bekorato shel ze patur shellaze reshut lehallech velaze reshut lehallech
Haya baal hakkora rishon uvaal chavit acharon nishbera chavit bekora patur baal hakkora

a: Veim amad baal kora chayyav veim amar levaal chavit amod patur
Haya baal chavit rishon uvaal kora acharon nishbera chavit bakkora chayyav veim amad baal chavit patur veim amar levaal kora amod chayyav vechen ze ba benero veze befishtano
Gema bea mineh rabbah bar natan merav huna hammazzik et ishto betashmish hammitta mahu kevan devirshut kaaved patur o dilma ibi leh leayyone
Amar leh tenetuha shellaze reshut lehallech velaze reshut lehallech
Amar rava kal vachomer uma yaar shezze lirshuto nichnas veze lirshuto nichnas naasa kemi shennichnas lirshut chavero vechayyav ze shellirshut chavero nichnas lo kol shekken
Ella ha katane shellaze reshut lehallech velaze reshut lehallech
Hatam tarvayehu kahadade ninhu hacha ihu kaaved maase
Vehi la vehachtiv venichretu hannefashot haosot mikkerev ammam
Hanaa letarvayehu it lehu ihu maase hu dekaaved
Haya baal kora rishon ku amar resh lakish shette parot birshut harabbim achat revutza veachat mehallechet baata mehallechet barvutza petura baata revutza bammehallechet chayyevet
Lema mesayya leh haya baal kora rishon uvaal chavit acharon nishbera hechavit bakora patur veim amad baal kora chayyav veha hacha dechirvutza bammehallechet dame vekatane chayyav
Vetisbera ha sayyoe baaya la missatya dela mesayei ella miksha name kashya tama devaata ha huzzeka mimmela patur veha matnitin demimmela vekatane chayyav
Matnitin difsaka leorcha keshilda hacha kegon dirvaa bechad gisa ibi lah lesaggoye beidach gisa

Ella sefa dematnitin mesayya leh leresh lakish dekatane haya baal chavit rishon uvaal kora acharon nishbera chavit bakkora chayyav veim amad baal chavit patur veha hacha dechimhallechet barvutza dame vekatane patur
Matnitin dechi orcheh ka mesagge hacha amra lah nehi deit lich reshut lesaggoye alay levaote bi let lich reshuta
Matni shenayim shehau mehallechin birshut harabbim echad ratz veechad mehallech o shehau shenehem ratzin vehizziku ze et ze shenehem peturin
Gema matnitin dela keisi ben yehuda detanya isi ben yehuda omer ratz chayyav mippene shehu meshunne umode isi beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot shehu patur mippene sheratz birshut
Amar rabbi yochanan halacha keisi ben yehuda umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna utnan echad ratz veechad mehallech o shehau shenehem ratzin peturin
Matnitin beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot

Mimmay middekatane o shehau shenehem ratzin peturin ha tu lema li hashta echad ratz veechad mehallech patur shenehem ratzin mibaya ella hachi kaamar echad ratz veechad mehallech patur bamme devarim amurim beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot aval bachol echad ratz veechad mehallech chayyav shenehem ratzin afilu bachol peturin
Amar mar umode isi beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot shehu patur mippene sheratz birshut beerev shabbat may birshut ika
Kidrabbi chanina deamar rabbi chanina
b: Bou venetze likrat kalla malketa veamri lah likrat shabbat kalla malketa rabbi yannay mitattef vekae veamar boi challa boi challa
Matni hamvakkea birshut harabbim vehizzik birshut hayyachid birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut harabbim birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut hayyachid acher chayyav
Gema utzricha dei tena hamvakkea birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut harabbim mishshum dishchichi rabbim aval mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid dela shechichi rabbim ema la
Vei tena mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid mishshum demeikara shello birshut aved aval mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim devirshut aved ema la
Vei tena hanach tarte ha mishshum dishchichi rabbim veha mishshum deshello birshut aval mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid acher dela shechichi rabbim umeikara birshut ema la tzericha
Tanu rabbanan hannichnas lachanuto shel naggar shello birshut venitteza bekaat vetafcha al panav vamet patur veim nichnas birshut chayyav
May chayyav amar rabbi yose bar chanina chayyav bearbaa devarim ufatur miggalut
Lefi sheen dome leyaar yaar ze lirshuto nichnas veze lirshuto nichnas ze lirshut chavero nichnas
Amar rava kal vachomer uma yaar ze ledato nichnas veze ledato nichnas naasa kemi shennichnas ledaat chavero vegole ze shelledaat chavero nichnas lo kol shekken
Ella amar rava may patur miggalut dela saggi leh begalut vehayenu tama derabbi yose bar chanina mishshum dehave leh shogeg karov lemezid

Metiv rava hosif lo retzua achat vamet hare ze gole al yado veha hacha deshogeg karov lemezid hu deibi assoke addateh demayete inashe bachada retzua vekatane hare ze gole amar rav shimi minnehardea detae beminyana
Tefach leh rava besandaleh amar leh attu hu mane vehatanya gadol shebbedayyanin kore vehashsheni mone vehashshelishi omer hakkehu
Ella amar rav shimi minnehardea dita dayyana gufeh
Metivi hazzorek et haeven lirshut harabbim veharag hare ze gole veha hacha deshogeg karov lemezid hu deibi leh assoke addateh devirshut harabbim shechichi inashe vekatane hare ze gole
Amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak besoter et kotlo
Ibi leh ayyone besoter ballayela
Ballayela name ibi leh ayyone besoter et kotlo bayyom leashpa
Hay ashpa hechi dame i dishchichi rabbim mezid hu vei la shechichi rabbim anus hu

Amar rav pappa la tzericha ella beashpa haasuya lehippanot ballayela veenah asuya lehippanot bayyom veika demikre veyatev mezid la have deha enah asuya lehippanot bayyom anus name la have deha ika demikre veyatev

Rav pappa mishshemeh derava matni lah aresha hannichnas lachanuto shel naggar shello birshut venitteza lo bekaat vetafcha lo al panav vamet patur amar rabbi yose bar chanina chayyav bearbaa devarim ufatur miggalut
Man dematne lah assefa kol shekken aresha uman dematne lah aresha aval assefa kevan devirshut chayyav galut
Umi chayyav galut vehatanya hannichnas lachanuto shel nappach venittezu nitzotzot vetafchu lo al panav vamet patur vaafilu nichnas birshut
Hacha bemay askinan bishvalya denappache shevalya denappache lemiktele kae kesherabbo mesarhev bo latzet veeno yotze
Umishshum derabbo mesarhev bo latzet lemikteleh kae kesavur yatza i hachi acher name

a: Acher let leh emta derabbeh hay it leh emta derabbeh

Rav zevid mishshemeh derava matne lah aha umatza perat lemamtzi et atzmo mikkan amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov mi sheyyatzta even mittachat yado vehotzi halla et rosho vekiblah patur amar rabbi yose bar chanina patur miggalut vechayyav bearbaa devarim
Man dematne lah aha kol shekken akkammayeta uman dematne lah akkammayeta aval aha patur ligmare

Tanu rabbanan poalim shebbau litboa secharan mibbaal habbayit ungachan shoro shel baal habbayit unshachan kalbo shel baal habbayit vamet patur acherim omrim rashshain poalin litboa secharan mibbaal habbayit
Hechi dame i dishchiach bemata may tama daacherim i dishchiach babbayit may tama detanna kamma
La tzericha begavra dishchiach vela shechiach vekare abbava vaamar lehu in mar savar in ul ta mashma umar savar in kum adduchtach mashma

Tanya keman deamar in kum adduchtach mashma detanya poel shennichnas litboa secharo mibbaal habbayit ungacho shoro shel baal habbayit o neshacho kalbo patur af al pi shennichnas birshut ammay patur ella lav dekare abbava veamar leh in ushma minah in kum adduchtach mashma
Matni shene sheorin tammin shechavlu ze et ze meshallemin bammotar chatzi nezek shenehen muadin meshallemin bammotar nezek shalem
Echad tam veechad muad muad battam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem tam bamuad meshallem bammotar chatzi nezek
Vechen shene anashim shechavlu ze baze meshallemin bammotar nezek shalem

Adam bamuad umuad baadam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem adam battam vetam baadam adam battam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem tam baadam meshallem bammotar chatzi nezek rabbi akiva omer af tam shechaval baadam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem

Gema tanu rabbanan kammishpat hazze yease lo kemishpat shor beshor kach mishpat shor beadam ma shor beshor tam meshallem chatzi nezek umuad nezek shalem af shor beadam tam meshallem chatzi nezek umuad nezek shalem
Rabbi akiva omer kammishpat hazze kattachton velo kaelon
Yachol meshallem min haaliyya talmud lomar yease lo miggufo meshallem veeno meshallem min haaliyya
Verabbanan ze lema li lefotro mearbaa devarim
Verabbi akiva lefotro mearbaa devarim mena leh nafka leh meish ki yitten mum baamito ish baamito velo shor baamito
Verabbanan i mehahi hava amena tzaar lechodeh aval ripuy vashevet ema liten leh ka mashma lan
Matni shor shave mane shennagach shor shave matayim veen hannevela yafa kelum notel et hashshor
Gema matnitin manni rabbi akiva hi detanya yusham hashshor bevet din divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer huchlat hashshor
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi yishmael savar baal chov hu vezuze hu demassek leh verabbi akiva savar shuttafe ninhu
Vekamipalgi behay kera umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo rabbi yishmael savar leve dina kamazhar rachamana verabbi akiva savar lenizak umazzik mazhar lehu rachamana
May benayehu hikdisho nizak ika benayehu
Bea mineh rava merav nachman mecharo mazzik lerabbi yishmael mahu kevan deamar rabbi yishmael baal chov hu vezuze hu demassek leh machur o dilma
b: Kevan dimshabad leh lenizak lav kol kemineh amar leh eno machur
Vehatanya mecharo machur chozer vegovehu vechi meachar shechozer vegovehu lamma machur leridya
Shema minah love umocher mittaltelin bet din govin lo mehem shane hatam dichman daasao appoteke dame
Vehaamar rava asa avdo appoteke umcharo baal chov gove hemennu shoro appoteke umcharo en baal chov gove hemennu
Eved may tama mishshum deit leh kala hay name kevan dingach kala it leh detora nagchana karu leh
Tane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu mecharo en machur hikdisho mukdash
Mecharo man ilema mazzik mecharo en machur manni rabbi akiva hi deamar huchlat hashshor vehikdisho mukdash atan lerabbi yishmael deamar yusham hashshor bevet din
Ella nizak mecharo eno machur manni rabbi yishmael hikdisho mukdash atan lerabbi akiva
Leolam mazzik vedivre hakkol mecharo eno machur afilu lerabbi yishmael deha meshabeda leh lenizak
Hikdisho mukdash afilu lerabbi akiva mishshum derabbi avahu deamar rabbi avahu gezera shemma yomru hekdesh yotze belo pidon

Tanu rabbanan shor tam shehizzik ad shello amad baddin mecharo machur hikdisho mukdash shechato untano bemattana ma sheasa asuy mishsheamad baddin mecharo eno machur hikdisho eno mukdash shechato untano bemattana lo asa velo chelum
Kadmu baale chovot vehigbiho vegavuhu ben chav ad shello hizzik ben hizzik ad shello chav lo asu velo kelum lefi sheen mishtallem ella miggufo

Muad shehizzik ben sheamad baddin ben shello amad baddin mecharo machur hikdisho mukdash shechato untano bemattana ma sheasa asuy kadmu baale chovot vehigbihu vegavuhu ben chav ad shello hizzik ben hizzik ad shello chav ma sheasa asuy lefi sheen mishtallem ella min haaliyya
Amar mar mecharo machur leridya
Hikdisho mukdash mishshum derabbi avahu

Detanya chay en li ella chay shechato minnayin talmud lomar umachru et hashshor mikkol makom

Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua zot omeret hammazzik shibudo shel chavero patur
Peshita mahu detema hatam hu deamar leh la chassartach vela mide deamar leh zika bealma hu dishkali minach aval bealma lichayyav ka mashma lan

Kadmu baale chovot vehigbihu vegavuhu ben chav ad shello hizzik ben hizzik ad shello chav lo asa velo chelum lefi sheen meshallem ella miggufo
Bishlama hizzik ad shello chav nizakin kadmu aval chav ad shello hizzik baal chov kedem

a: Vaafilu hizzik ad shello chav baal chov kedem shema minah baal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava ma sheggava lo gava
La leolam ema lach ma sheggava gava veshane hatam daamar leh ilu gabbach hava la minach hava gevay leh dehay tora deazzekan mineh mishtallemna
Tanu rabbanan shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim vechaval bo bachamishshim zuz veshavach veamad al arba meot zuz sheilmale lo hizziko haya omed al shemone meot zuz noten kishat hannezek
Kachash kishat haamada baddin
Shavach mazzik noten lo kishat hannezek kachash kishat haamada baddin
Amar mar shavach mazzik noten kishat hannezek manni rabbi yishmael hi deamar baal chov hu vezuze hu demassek leh
Ema sefa kachash kishat haamada baddin atan lerabbi akiva deamar shuttafe ninhu resha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva
La kullah rabbi akiva hi vehacha bemay askinan kesheppitmo
I kesheppitmo ema resha shavach veamad al arba meot zuz noten lo kishat hannezek i kesheppitmoo tzericha lememar

Amar rav pappa resha mashkachatte lah ben defattemah pattome ben dishvacha mimmela veitzterich leashmoinan dehecha dishvacha mimmela noten lo kishat hannezek sefa la mashkachatte lah ella kesheppittemo
Kachash kishat haamada baddin kachash mechamat may ilema dechachasha mechamat melacha lema leh atte machchashatte vaana yahevna
Amar rav ashe dichchash mechamat makka daamar leh karna detorach kevira beh
Matni shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim veen hannevela yafa kelum amar rabbi meir al ze neemar umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo

Amar lo rabbi yehuda vechen halacha kiyyamta umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo velo kiyyamta vegam hammet yechetzun veeze ze shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim vehannevela yafa chamishshim zuz shezze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet

Gema tanu rabbanan shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim vehannevela yafa chamishshim zuz ze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet vezehu shor haamur battora divre rabbi yehuda

Amar rava pechat nevela ika benayehu rabbi meir savar pechat nevela denizak have verabbi yehuda savar pechat nevela demazzik have palga
Amar leh abbaye im ken matzinu lerabbi yehuda
b: Tam chamur mimmuad
Vechi tema hachi name keditnan rabbi yehuda omer tam chayyav umuad patur emar deshamatte leh lerabbi yehuda leinyan shemira dichtivi kerae leinyan tashlumin mi shamatte leh
Vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer yachol shor shave mane shennagach shor shave chamesh selaim vehannevela yafa sela ze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet
Amarta vechi muad lamma yotze lehachmir alav o lehakel alav heve omer lehachmir alav uma muad eno meshallem ella ma shehizzik tam hakkal lo kol shekken
Ella amar rabbi yochanan shevach nevela ika benayehu demar savar denizak have umar savar palga

Vehayenu deka kashya leh lerabbi yehuda hashta deamratte chas rachamana ilaveh demazzik deshakel bishvacha yachol shor shave chamesh selaim shennagach shor shave mane vehannevela yafa chamishshim zuz ze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet
Amarta hechan matzinu mazzik niskar shezze niskar veomer shallem yeshallem bealim meshallemin veen bealim notlin

May veomer vechi tema hane mile hecha deika peseda lenizak aval hecha deleka peseda lenizak kegon shor shave chamesh selaim shennagach shor shave chamesh selaim vehannevela yafa sheloshim zuz shakel name mazzik bishvacha
Veomer shallem yeshallem bealim meshallemin veen bealim notlin
Amar leh rav acha bar tachlifa lerava im ken matzinu lerabbi yehuda tam meshallem yoter mechatzi nezek vehattora amra umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo
It leh lerabbi yehuda pechat sheppachata mita machatzin bachay
Mena leh mivvegam et hammet yechetzun veha appekeh rabbi yehuda leze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet
Im ken nichtov kera veet hammet may vegam shema minah tarte
Matni yesh chayyav al maase shoro ufatur al maase atzmo patur al maase shoro vechayyav al maase atzmo
Ketzad shoro shebbiyyesh patur vehu shebbiyyesh chayyav shoro shessime et en avdo vehippil et shino patur vehu shessime et en avdo vehippil et shino chayyav
Shoro shechaval beaviv uvimmo chayyav vehu shechaval beaviv veimmo patur shoro shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat chayyav vehu shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat patur mippene shehu mitchayyev benafsho

Gema tane rabbi avahu kammeh derabbi yochanan kol hamkalkelin peturin chutz mechovel umavir amar leh pok tane levara chovel umavir enah mishna veim timtze lomar mishna chovel betzarich lechalbo mavir betzarich leefro
Tenan shoro shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat chayyav vehu shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat patur vekatane hu dumya deshoro ma shoro dela kavae leh

a: Af hu name dela kavae leh vekatane patur mippene shehu niddon benafsho
Lo shoro dumya dideh ma hu dekavae leh af shoro dekavae leh
Shoro hechi mashkachatte lah amar leh rav aveya hacha bemay askinan beshor pikkeach shealta lo neshicha begabbo veka bae lemikleyeh veigandar bekitma
Umna yadinan dilvatar dekalyeh kamiggandar bekitma

Amaru rabbanan kammeh derav pappa mi matzet amratte shoro dumya dideh veha katane shoro shebbiyyesh patur vehu shebbiyyesh chayyav shoro dumya dideh nitkaven levayyesh hechi mashkachatte lah
Kegon shennitkaven lehazzik deamar mar nitkaven lehazzik af al pi shello nitkaven levayyesh
Rava amar matnitin beshogeg
Vechidtana deve chizkiyya detana deve chizkiyya makke adam umakke behema

Ma makke behema lo chillakta bah ben shogeg ben mezid ben mitkaven lesheen mitkaven ben derech yerida lederech aliyya lefotro mamon ella lechayevo mamon af makke adam lo tachlok bo ben shogeg lemezid ben mitkaven lesheen mitkaven ben derech yerida lederech aliyya lechayevo mamon ella lefotro mamon
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava mi matzet mokmatte lah beshogeg veha mippene shenniddon benafsho katane
Hachi kaamar kevan divmezid niddon benafsho vehechi dame deka bae leefro hashta beshogeg patur
Matni shor shehaya rodef achar shor acher vehuzzak ze omer shorcha hizzik veze omer lo chi ella besela laka hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Hau shenayim rodfim achar echad ze omer shorcha hizzik veze omer shorcha hizzik

Gema amar rabbi chiyya bar abba zot omeret chalukim alav chaverav al somchos deamar mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin
Amar leh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi chiyya bar abba amar somchos afilu bari uvari amar leh in amar somchos afilu bari uvari
Umimmay dematnitin bevari uvari hu dekatane ze omer shorcha hizzik veze omer lo chi
Matkef lah rav pappa midderesha bari uvari sefa name bari uvari

Ella bevari veshemma

Ella dekaamar nizak shemma vekaamar mazzik bari

Veamar somchos afilu beha deitzterich leashmoinan dela
La sefa nizak shemma umazzik bari resha nizak bari umazzik shemma
Veha la damya resha lesefa
Amri bari veshemma shemma uvari chad milta hi bari uvari shemma uvari tere mile ninhu
Gufa amar rabba bar natan teano chittin vehoda lo bisorin patur may ka mashma lan tenena teano chittin vehoda lo bisorin patur
I mehatam hava amena patur middeme chittin vechayyav bidme seorin ka mashma lan defatur ligmare

Rauy litol veen lo

Hau shenehem shel ish echad shenehem chayyavim amar leh rava mipparzika lerav ashe shema minah shevarim tammim shehizziku ratza mizze gove ratza mizze gove
Hacha bemay askinan bemuadin

I bemuadin ema sefa haya echad gadol veechad katan hannizak omer gadol hizzik vehammazzik omer lo chi ella katan hizzik hammotzi mechavero alav haraya i bemuadin may nafka leh mineh sof sof deme tora mealleya bae leshallome
Amar leh sefa betammin veresha bemuadin
Amar leh rav acha sava lerav ashe i bemuadin chayyavim chayyav gavra mibe leh vetu may shenehem

Ella leolam betammin verabbi akiva hi deamar shuttafin ninhu vetama deitanhu letarvayehu dela matze medache leh aval letanhu letarvayehu matze amar leh zil ayeti reaya dehay tora azzekach vaashallem lach
Hadaran alach hammanniach

Matni shor shennagach arbaa vachamishsha shevarim ze achar ze yeshallem laacharon shebbahem veim yesh bo motar yachazir leshellefanav veim yesh bo motar yachazir leshellifne fanav vehaacharon acharon niskar divre rabbi meir
Rabbi shimon omer shor shave matayim shennagach leshor shave matayim veen hannevela yafa kelum ze notel mane veze notel mane
Chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim haacharon notel mane veshellefanav ze notel chamishshim zuz veze notel chamishshim zuz
Chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim haacharon notel mane veshellefanav chamishshim zuz ushnayim harishonim dinar zahav
Gema matnitin manni dela kerabbi yishmael udla kerabbi akiva
I kerabbi yishmael deamar baale chovot ninhu hay acharon acharon niskar rishon rishon niskar mibbee leh i kerabbi akiva deamar tora deshuttafe hu hay yesh bo motar

Amar rava leolam kerabbi yishmael deamar baale chovot ninhu udkashya lach acharon acharon niskar rishon rishon niskar mibbee leh hacha bemay askinan kegon shettefaso nizak ligbot hemennu venaasa alav keshomer sachar linzakin
I hachi yesh bo motar yachazir leshellefanav yachazir labbealim mibbee leh
Amar ravina hachi katane im yesh bo motar binzakav yachazir leshellefanav
Vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan mishshum peshiat shomrin nagu bah
Bemay okemtah kerabbi yishmael i hachi ema sefa rabbi shimon omer shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim veen hannevela yafa kelum ze notel mane veze notel mane

Atan lerabbi akiva deamar tora deshuttafe hu resha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva
Amri in deha amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana shevok matnitin veta batray resha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva
Ittemar name amar rabbi yochanan hikdisho nizak ika benayehu
Tenan hatam hattokea lachavero noten lo sela rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili mane
Hahu gavra ditka lechavreh shallecheh rav toviyya bar matna lekammeh derav yosef sela tzori tenan o sela medina tenan
Amar leh tenetuha ushnayim harishonim dinar zahav vei salka datach tane tanna sela medina niflog venitne ad teresar vesela
Amar leh tanna ki rochla litne velezil
May have alah pashtuha meha deamar rav yehuda amar rav kol kesef haamur battora kesef tzori veshel divrehem kesef medina
Amar leh hahu gavra hoil ufalga dezuza hu la baena nitteveh laaniyyim hadar amar leh nitteveh nihali ezil veavre beh nafshay
Amar leh rav yosef kevar zecho beh aniyyim veaf al gav deleka aniyyim hacha anan yad aniyyim anan deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel yetomim

a: Enan tzerichin perozbul
Vechen tane rame bar chama hayetomim enan tzerichin perozbul rabban gamliel uvet dino avihen shel yetomin hau

Chanan bisha teka leh lehahu gavra ata lekammeh derav huna amar leh zil hav leh palga dezuza hava leh zuza macha bae lemitveh leh mineh palga dezuza la hava mishtekil leh teka leh acharina veyahaveh nihaleh

Matni shor shehu muad lemino veeno muad lesheeno mino muad leadam veeno muad livhema muad liktannim veeno muad ligdolim et shehu muad lo meshallem nezek shalem veet sheeno muad lo meshallem chatzi nezek
Amru lifne rabbi yehuda hare ze muad lashshabbatot veeno muad lachol amar lahem lashshabbatot meshallem nezek shalem limot hachol meshallem chatzi nezek
Ematay hu tam mishsheyyachzor bo shelosha yeme shabbatot
Gema itmar rav zevid amar veeno muad tenan rav pappa amar eno muad tenan
Rav zevid amar veeno muad tenan ha setama have muad rav pappa amar eno muad tenan distama la have muad
Rav zevid dayek missefa rav pappa dayek meresha
Rav zevid dayek missefa dekatane muad liktannim veeno muad ligdolim i amratte bishlama veeno muad katane ha setameh have muad ha ka mashma lan daafilu mikketannim ligdolim name missetama have muad
Ella i amratte eno muad katane setama la have muad
Hashta yesh lomar mikketannim liktannim dealma setama la have muad mikketannim ligdolim tzericha lememar dela have muad
Verav pappa amar lach itzterich salka datach amena hoil ufratz beh behahu mina peratz beh la shena gedolim dideh vela shena ketannim dideh ka mashma lan dela have muad
Rav pappa dayek meresha dekatane muad leadam eno muad livhema i amratte bishlama eno muad tenan setama la have muad ha ka mashma lan daafilu meadam livhema name setama la have muad
Ella i amratte veeno muad katane ha setama have muad hashta yesh lomar mibbehema livhema setama have muad meadam livhema tzericha lememar dehave muad

Verav zevid amar lach resha achazara kae kegon dahava muad leadam umuad livhema vahadar beh mibbehema dekae gabbe vehema telata zimne vela nagach mahu detema kevan dela hadar beh meadam chazara divhema lav chazara hi ka mashma lan dachazara divhema miha chazara hi
Metivi somchos omer muad laadam muad livhema mikkal vechomer uma leadam muad livhema lo kol shekken mikkelal detanna kamma eno muad kaamar

Amar lecha rav zevid somchos achazara kae vehachi kaamar leh letanna kamma dekaamratte chazara divhema chazara hi chazara divhema lav chazara hi mikkal vachomer meadam uma meadam la ka mhadar beh mibbehema lo kol shekken
Amar rav ashe ta shema amru lifne rabbi yehuda hare ze muad leshabbatot veeno muad limot hachol amar lahen leshabbatot meshallem nezek shalem limot hachol meshallem chatzi nezek
I amratte bishlama veeno muad katane shayyole hu deka meshayeli leh vehu name kamahdar lehu ella i amratte eno muad katane agmore hu deka magmeri leh vetu ihu may ka mahdar lehu
Amar rav yannay meresha name dayeka dekatane et shemmuad lo meshallem nezek shalem veet sheeno muad lo meshallem chatzi nezek
I amratte bishlama veeno muad katane paroshe ka mefaresh lah

Ella i amratte eno muad katane paskah may tu et shemmuad lo meshallem nezek shalem veet sheeno muad lo meshallem chatzi nezek ad hashta la ashmeinan dehatam meshallem chatzi nezek umuad meshallem nezek shalem
Vei timtze lomar name ita lidrav pappa nagach shor chamor vegamal naasa muad lakkol
Tanu rabbanan raa shor nagach shor lo nagach shor nagach shor lo nagach shor nagach shor lo nagach naasa muad leserugin lishorim
Tanu rabbanan raa shor nagach chamor lo nagach sus nagach gamal lo nagach pered nagach arod lo nagach naasa muad leserugin lakkol
Ibaya lehu nagach
b: Shor shor vashor chamor vegamal mahu

Vechi tema leolam kasavar reehu daveka umihu dehedot ki nagach dehekdesh hayenu tama demichayyav mishshum deka mayete leh mikkal vachomer dehedot uma hedot shennagach shel hedot chayyav ki nagach dehekdesh lo kol shekken demichayyav
Dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon ma lehallan tam chatzi nezek hacha name chatzi nezek
Ella amar resh lakish hakkol hau bichlal nezek shalem keshepparat lecha hakkatuv reehu gabbe tam reehu hu detam meshallem chatzi nezek mikkelal dehekdesh ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem

a: Deim ken nichtov kera lehay reehu gabbe muad
Shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel goy patur amri mimma nafshach i reehu daveka degoy ki nagach deyisrael name liptar vei reehu lav daveka afilu deyisrael ki nagach degoy nichayyav
Amar rabbi avahu amar kera amad vayemoded eretz raa vayyatter goyim raa sheva mitzot shekkiblu alehem bene noach kevan shello kiyemu amad vehittir mamonan leyisrael
Rabbi yochanan amar mehacha hofia mehar paran mipparan hofia mamonam leyisrael

Tanya name hachi shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel goy patur shor shel goy shennagach shor shel yisrael ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem shenneemar amad vayemoded eretz raa vayyatter goyim veomer hofia mehar paran
May veomer

Vechi tema hay amad vayemoded eretz mibbaya leh lechidrav matna vechidrav yosef ta shema hofia mehar paran mipparan hofia mamonan leyisrael may derav matna deamar rav matna amad vayemoded eretz raa vechu ma raa raa sheva mitzot shennitztauu alehen bene noach velo kiyemum amad vehigla otam meal admatam
Umay mashma dehay vayyatter lishana deiggalloye hu ketiv hacha vayyatter goyim uchtiv hatam lenatter bahen al haaretz umtargeminan lekappatza behon al ara
May derav yosef deamar rav yosef amad vayemoded eretz raa vechu ma raa raa sheva mitzot shekkiblu alehem bene noach velo kiyemum amad vehittiran lahem
Itgore ittegur im ken matzinu chote niskar amar mar bereh deravna lomar sheafilu mekayemin otan en mekabbelin alehen sachar

Vela vehatanya rabbi meir omer minnayin sheafilu goy veosek battora shehu kechohen gadol talmud lomar asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem kohanim ulviyyim veyisreelim lo neemar ella adam ha lamadta sheafilu goy veosek battora hare hu kechohen gadol
Amri en mekabbelim alehen sachar kimtzuve veose ella kemi sheeno metzuve veose deamar rabbi chanina gadol hamtzuve veose yoter mimmi sheeno metzuve veose

Tanu rabbanan uchvar shalcha malchut romi shene seradotot etzel chachme yisrael lammedunu toratchem karu veshanu veshilleshu bishat petiratan amru lahem dikdaknu bechol toratchem veemet hu chutz middavar ze sheattem omrim shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel goy patur shel goy shennagach shor shel yisrael ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem
Mimma nafshach i reehu daveka afilu degoy ki nagach deyisrael liptar vei reehu lav daveka afilu deyisrael ki nagach degoy lichayyav vedavar ze en anu modiim oto lammalchut
Rav shemuel bar yehuda shechiva leh beratta amaru leh rabbanan leulla kum nezil ninachameh amar lehu may it li gabbe nechamta devavlae degidufa hu deamri may efshar lemibad ha efshar lemibad avdi

Azal hu lechodeh gabbeh amar leh vayyomer Adonai el moshe al tatzar et moav veal titgar bam milchama vechi ma ala al dato shel moshe laasot milchama shello birshut ella nasa moshe kal vachomer beatzmo amar uma midyanim shello bau ella laazor et moav amra tora tzaror et hammidyanim vehikkitem otam
b: Moavim atzman lo kol shekken
Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lo keshealta al datecha alta al dati shette peridot tovot yesh li lehotzi mehen rut hammoaviyya venaama haammonit

Vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma bishvil shette peridot tovot chas hakkadosh baruch hu al shette ummot gedolot velo hecherivan bitto shel rabbi im keshera hi uruya hi latzet mimmenna davar tov al achat kamma vechamma dahava chayya
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan en hakkadosh baruch hu mekappeach sechar kol beriyya afilu sechar sicha naa
Deilu bechira dekaamra moav amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe al tatzar et moav veal titgar vam milchama milchama hu dela ha angarya aved behu
Tzeira dekaamra ben ammi amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe vekaravta mul bene ammon al tetzurem veal titgar bam kelal daafilu angarya la taaved behu

Veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha leolam yakdim adam lidvar mitzva shebbishvil layela achat shekkedamatta bechira litzira kedamatta arba dorot leyisrael oved yishay vedavid ushlomo veilu tzeira ad rechavam dichtiv veshem immo naama haammonit
Tanu rabbanan shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel kuti patur veshel kuti shennagach shor shel yisrael tam meshallem chatzi nezek umuad meshallem nezek shalem
Rabbi meir omer shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel kuti patur veshel kuti shennagach shor shel yisrael ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem
Lememra desavar rabbi meir kutim gere araot hen
Vrminhi kol hakketamim habbaim merkam tehorim rabbi yehuda metamme mippene shehen gerim vetoim
Mibben haggoyim tehorim mibben yisrael umibben hakkutim rabbi meir metamme vachachamim metaharin shello nechshedu yisrael al kitmehen
Alma kasavar rabbi meir kutim gere emet hem
Amar rabbi avahu kenas hu shekkanas rabbi meir bemamonam shello yittamu bahem
Metiv rabbi zera veellu nearot sheyyesh lahem kenas habba al hammamzeret veal hannetina veal hakkutit vei salka datach kanas rabbi meir bemamonam hachi name niknos kede shello yittamu bahen
Amar abbaye kede

a: Shello yehe chote niskar
Venitteveh laaniyyim amar rav mari mishshum dehave mamon sheen lo tovim
Matni shor shel pikkeach shennagach shor shel cheresh shote vekatan chayyav veshel cheresh shote vekatan shennagach shor shel pikkeach patur
Shor shel cheresh shote vekatan shennagach bet din maamidin lahen appotroppos umidin lahen bifne appotroppos
Nitpakkeach hacheresh nishtappa hashshote vehigdil hakkatan chazar letammuto divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer hare hu bechezkato
Shor haitztadin eno chayyav mita shenneemar ki yiggach velo sheyyaggichuhu

Gema ha gufa kashya amratte shor shel cheresh shote vekatan shennagach shor shel pikkeach patur alma en maamidin appotroppos letam ligbot miggufo ema sefa shor shel cheresh shote vekatan shennagach bet din maamidin lahem appotroppos umidin lahem bifne appotroppos alma maamidin lahem appotroppos letam ligbot miggufo
Amar rava hachi katane veim huchzeku nagchanin maamidin lahem appotroppos umidin lahen bifne appotroppos umshavenan lehu muad dechi hadar venagach leshallem mealiyya
Mealiyyat man rabbi yochanan amar mealiyyat yetomin rabbi yose bar chanina amar mealiyyat appotroppos
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav assi en nizkakin lenichse yetomin ella im ken ribbit ochelet bahen
Verabbi yochanan amar o lishtar sheyyesh bo ribbit o lichtubbat ishsha mishshum mezone
Efoch rabbi yochanan amar mealiyyat appotroppesin rabbi yose bar chanina amar mealiyyat yetomin
Amar rava mishshum dekashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan meshavet leh lerabbi yose bar chanina toe veha rabbi yose bar chanina dayyana hu venachet leumkeh dedina
Ella leolam la tefoch umazzik shane rabbi yochanan amar mealiyyat yetomim dei amratte mealiyyat appotroppos
b: Mimmani vela avdi rabbi yose bar chanina amar mealiyyat appotroppos vechozrin venifrain min hayetomim lechi gadli
Umaamidim lahen appotroppin letam ligbot miggufo tannae hi

Detanya shor shennitcharshu bealav veshennishtattu bealav veshehalchu bealav limdinat hayyam yehuda ben nekosa amar somchos hare hu betammuto ad sheyyaidu bo bifne habbealim vachachamim omrim maamidin lahen appotroppin umidin bahen bifne appotroppin

Nitpakkeach hacheresh nishtappa hashshote vehigdil hakkatan uvau bealav mimmedinat hayyam yehuda ben nekosa amar somchos chazar letammuto ad sheyyaidu bo bifne vealim rabbi yose amar hare hu bechezkato
Amaru may hare hu betammuto dekaamar somchos ilema dela miyyaad kelal ha middekatane sefa chazar letammuto mikkelal deiyyaad

Ella may hare hu betammuto hare hu bitmimuto dela mechasserinan leh alma en maamidin appotroppos letam ligbot miggufo vachachamim omrim maamidin lahen appotroppos umidin lahen bifne appotroppos alma maamidin appotroppos letam ligbot miggufo
Vesefa bemay kamipalgi reshut meshanna ika benayehu somchos savar reshut meshanna verabbi yose savar reshut enah meshanna
Tanu rabbanan shor cheresh shote vekatan shennagach rabbi yaakov meshallem chatzi nezek
Rabbi yaakov may avidteh ella ema rabbi yaakov omer meshallem chatzi nezek
Bemay askinan i betam peshita dechulle alma name chatzi nezek hu dimshallem vei bemuad i deavdi leh shemira kelal kelal la bae leshallome vei dela avdi leh shemira kulleh nezek bae shallome
Amar rava leolam bemuad vehacha bemay askinan deavdi shemira pechuta vela avdi leh shemira meulla
Verabbi yaakov savar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar tzad tammut bimkomah omedet vesavar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar muad saggi leh bishmira pechuta
Vesavar lah kerabbanan deamri maamidin appotroppos letam ligbot miggufo

Amar leh abbaye vela peligi vehatanya shor shel cheresh shote vekatan shennagach rabbi yehuda mechayyev verabbi yaakov omer chatzi nezek hu dimshallem amar rabba bar ulla ma shemmechayyev rabbi yehuda peresh rabbi yaakov
Ulabbaye deamar peligi bemay peligi
Amar lach hacha bemay askinan bemuad vela natreh kelal

Rabbi yaakov savar lah kerabbi yehuda bachada uflig aleh bachada savar kerabbi yehuda bachada deilu rabbi yehuda savar tzad tammut bimkomah omedet uflig aleh bachada deilu rabbi yehuda savar maamidin lahen appotroppos letam ligbot miggufo verabbi yaakov savar en maamidin vela meshallem ella palga demuad
Amar leh rav acha bar abbaye leravina bishlama leabbaye deamar peligi shappir ella lerava deamar la peligi addemoke lah bemuad nokmah betam

a: I lerabbi yehuda daavad leh shemira pechuta vela avad leh shemira meulla i lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov dela aved leh shemira kelal
Detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer echad tam veechad muad sheshshemaran shemira pechuta peturin veha ka mashma lan rabbi yaakov demaamidin lahen appotroppin letam ligbot miggufo
Amar leh hachi kaamar chada deit beh tarte tama
Ravina amar reshut meshanna ika benayehu kegon dahava muad venitpakkeach hacheresh venishtappa hashshote vehigdil hakkatan rabbi yehuda savar hare hu bechezkato rabbi yaakov savar reshut meshanna
Tanu rabbanan appotroppesim meshallemin min haaliyya veen meshallemin kofer
Man tena kufra kappara veyatme lav bene chappara ninhu
Amar rav chisda rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi detanya venatan pidyon nafsho deme nizak rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer deme mazzik
May lav beha kamipalgi derabbanan savri kufra mamona hu verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka savar kufra kappara
Amar rav pappa la dechulle alma kufra kappara hu vehacha beha kamipalgi rabbanan savri bidnizak shayeminan verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka savar bidmazzik shayeminan
May tama derabbanan neemra shita lematta veneemra shita lemala ma lehallan bidnizak af kan bidnizak
Verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka savar venatan pidyon nafsho ketiv
Verabbanan in pidon nafsho ketiv mihu ki shayeminan bidnizak shayeminan
Meshabbach leh rava lerav nachman bidrav acha bar yaakov deadam gadol hu amar leh lichsheyyavo leyadcha haviehu leyadi
Ki ata legabbeh amar leh bae minay milta bea mineh shor shel shene shuttafin ketzad meshallemin kofer
Meshallem hay kofer vehay kofer kofer echad amar rachamana velo shene chufrin hay chatzi chofer vehay chatzi chofer kofer shalem amar rachamana velo chatzi chofer
Addeyatev veka meayyen bah amar leh tenan chayyave arachin memashkenin otan chayyave chattaot vaashamot en memashkenin otan chayyave chufrin may
Kevan dechappara hu kechattat veasham dameyy michmar chamir ilaveh vela bae mashkoneh o dilma kevan dilchavreh hu devae mitva leh mamona hu vela legavoha hu vela chamir aleh uvae mashkoneh
I name kevan dehu la chata umamoneh hu deazzek la chamir milta ilaveh uvae mashkoneh
Amar leh shivkan estaggar bekammayeta
Tanu rabbanan shealo bechezkat tam venimtza muad bealim meshallemin chatzi nezek veshoel meshallem chatzi nezek
Huad bevet shoel vehechziro labbealim bealim meshallemin chatzi nezek veshoel patur mikkelum
Amar mar shealo bechezkat tam venimtza muad bealim meshallemin chatzi nezek veshoel chatzi nezek veammay lema leh tora sheeli arya la sheeli
Amar rav hacha bemay askinan shehikkir bo shehu nagchan
Venema leh tam sheeli muad la sheeli
Mishshum deamar leh sof sof i tam hava palga nizka baet shallome hashta name zil shallem palga nizka
Venema leh i tam hava mishtallem miggufo
Mishshum deamar leh sof sof atte lav tora baet shallome ledidi
Venema leh
b: Im tam hava modena umippetarna
Vaafilu leman deamar palga nizka mamona nema leh i tam hu hava maarekna leh leagma
Ella hacha bemay askinan kegon deakdem be dina vetafseh
I hachi bealim ammay meshallemim chatzi nezek nema leh atpasteh letoray bida deman dela matzena leishtaoye dina bahadeh mishshum deamar leh i ahdarteh nihalach lav minach hao shakli leh
Venema leh i ahdarteh nihali hava maarekna leh leagma mishshum deamar leh sof sof lav mealiyya hao mishtallemi
Hanicha hecha deit leh nichse hecha delet leh nichse may ika lememar
Mishshum deamar leh ki hecha demishtabadna ledidach hachi name mishtabadna lehayeche midderabbi natan
Detanya rabbi natan omer minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane vachavero bachavero minnayin shemmotziin mizze venotnim laze talmud lomar venatan laasher asham lo
Huad bevet shoel vehechziro labbealim bealim meshallemin chatzi nezek veshoel patur mikkelum
Sefa reshut meshanna resha reshut enah meshanna
Amar rabbi yochanan tivrah mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo
Rabba amar midderesha reshut enah meshanna sefa name reshut enah meshanna vesefa hayenu tama mishshum deamar leh lav kol keminach dimyaadatte leh letoray
Rav pappa amar middesefa reshut meshanna resha name reshut meshanna veresha hayenu tama mishshum dechol makom sheholech shem bealav alav
Shor haitztadin eno chayyav mita ibaya lehu mahu legabbe mizbeach
Rav amar kasher ushmuel amar pasul rav amar kasher anus hu ushmuel amar pasul hare neevda bo avera
Metivi min habbehema lehotzi et harovea veet hannirba min habbakar lehotzi et hanneevad min hatztzon lehotzi et hammuktze umin hatztzon lehotzi et hannogeach
Amar rabbi shimon im neemar rovea lamma neemar nogeach veim neemar nogeach lamma neemar rovea
Mippene sheyyesh barovea sheen bannogeach veyesh bannogeach sheen barovea
Rovea asa bo ones keratzon nogeach lo asa bo ones keratzon nogeach meshallem kofer rovea eno meshallem et hakkofer lefichach hutzrach lomar rovea vehutzrach lomar nogeach
Katane mihat rovea asa bo ones keratzon nogeach lo asa bo ones keratzon lemay hilcheta lav lekorban
La liktala
Hachi name mistabbera dei amratte lekorban nogeach lo asa bo ones keratzon lav ones dideh ketiv velav ratzon dideh ketiv ella lav liktala
Amar mar nogeach meshallem et hakkofer rovea eno meshallem et hakkofer hechi dame ilema deravah vekatlah ma li katlah bekarna ma li katlah birvia
Veella deravah vela katlah hay dela meshallem kofer mishshum dela katlah hu
Amar abbaye leolam deravah vela katlah deatuha leve dina vekatluha mahu detema

a: Keman dekatlah dame ka mashma lan
Rava amar leolam deravah vekatlah udka kashya lach ma li katlah bekarnayim ma li katlah birvia keren kauonato lehazzik hay kauonato lahanaat atzmo hu
Bemay peligi beregel sheddarsa al gabbe tinok bachatzar hannizak leabbaye meshallem kofer lerava la meshallem kofer
Tanya keoteh derav shor haitztadin eno chayyav mita vechasher legabbe mizbeach mippene shehu kimusse

Matni shor shennagach et haadam umet muad meshallem kofer vetam patur min hakkofer veze veze chayyavin mita vechen babben vechen babbat nagach eved o ama noten sheloshim selaim ben shehu yafe mea mane uven sheeno yafe ella dinar echad
Gema vechi meachar demittam katlinan leh muad hechi mashkachatte lah
Amar rabba hacha bemay askinan kegon sheamaduhu lishlosha bene adam
Rav ashe amar umdana lav kelum hu ella hacha bemay askinan kegon shessiken lishlosha bene adam
Rav zevid amar kegon sheharag shalosho behemot
Umuad livhema have muad leadam ella amar rav shimi kegon sheharag shelosha goyim
Umuad legoyim have muad leyisrael ella amar rabbi shimon ben lakish kegon sheharag shelosha bene adam terefa
Umuad litrefa have muad leshalem ella amar rav pappa diktal vaarak leagma diktal vaarak leagma
Rav acha bereh derav ika amar kegon shehuzmu zomme zommin
Hanicha i leyaode tora baenan shappir ella i leyaode gavra baenan memar amar leh la hava yadana kegon deamri kol emat dekatel toreh gabbeh hava kae
Ravina amar bemakkirin et baal hashshor veen makkirin et hashshor
May hava leh lemebad mishshum deamri leh tora nagchana it lach bevakrach ibi lach nattore kulle bakrach

Veze vaze chayyavin mita ku tanu rabbanan mimmashma shenneemar sakol yissakel hashshor eni yodea shennevela hi unvela asura baachila ma talmud lomar lo yeachel et besaro maggid lecha hakkatuv sheim shechato leachar shennigmar dino asur baachila
En li ella baachila bahanaa minnayin talmud lomar uvaal hashshor naki
May mashma shimon ben zoma omer keadam sheomer lachavero yatza ish peloni naki minnechasav veen lo bahem hanaa shel kelum

Umimmay delo yeachel et besaro lehecha dishchato achar shennigmar dino sheasur baachila ema dehecha dishchato leachar shennigmar dino shere baachila hu vehay lo yeachel et besaro lehecha desakleh miskal deasur bahanaa hu kidrabbi avahu
Deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar kol makom shenneemar lo yochal lo tochal lo tochlu echad isur achila veechad isur hanaa bammashma
Ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv kederech shepparat lecha binvela lagger bintina velannochri bimchira

Amri hane mile hecha denafek leh isur achila veisur hanaa mikkera millo yochal aval hacha deisur achila missakol yissakel nafka i salka datach hay lo yeachel et besaro isur hanaa hu nichtov rachamana lo yehane i name lo yeachel et besaro lema li deaf al gav deavdeh keen basar deshachteh asur
Matkef lah mar zutra ema hane mile
b: Hecha devadak tzur veshachat bo deavdeh keen sekila aval hecha deshachteh besakkin la
Amri attu sakkin ketiva beorayeta vehatnan hashshochet bemaggal yad betzor uvkane shechitato keshera

Vehashta denafka leh isur achila veisur hanaa millo yeachel et besaro baal hashshor naki lema li lahanaat oro desalka datach amena besaro hu deasur bahanaa oro nishtere bahanaa kamashma lan baal hashshor naki
Ulhanach tannae demappeki leh lehay baal hashshor naki lidrasha acharina kidvaenan lememar kamman hanaat oro mena lehu
Nafka lehu meet besaro et hattafel livsaro may nihu oro
Vehay tanna et la daresh

Kidtanya shimon haamsoni veamri lah nechemya haamsoni haya doresh kol ettin shebbattora kevan shehiggia leet Adonai elohecha tira perash amru lo talmidav rabbi kol ettin sheddarashta ma tehe alehen amar lahem keshem shekkibbalti sachar al hadderisha kach kibbalti sachar al happerisha
Ad shebba rabbi akiva velimed et Adonai elohecha tira lerabbot talmide chachamim
Tanu rabbanan uvaal hashshor naki rabbi eliezer omer naki mechatzi chofer
Amar lo rabbi akiva vahalo hu atzmo en mishtallem ella miggufo haviehu levet din vishallem lach
Amar lo rabbi eliezer kach ani beenecha sheddini baze shechayyav mita en dini ella keshehemit et haadam al pi ed echad o al pi vealim
Al pi vealim mode biknas hu
Kasavar kufra kappara

Tanya idach amar lo rabbi eliezer akiva kach ani beenecha sheddini baze shechayyav mita en dini ella bemitkaven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam legoy veharag yisrael linfalim veharag ben kayyama
He amar leh beresha rav kahana mishshemeh derava amar mitkaven amar leh beresha rav tavome mishshemeh derava amar hemit amar leh beresha
Rav kahana mishshemeh derava amar mitkaven amar leh beresha mashal letzayyad sheshshole dagim min hayyam

a: Mashkach ravreve shakel zutre shakel
Rav tavome mishshemeh derava amar hemit amar leh beresha mashal letzayyad sheshshole dagim min hayyam mashkach zutre shakel mashkach ravreve shade zutre veshakel ravreve
Tanya idach baal hashshor naki rabbi yose haggelili omer naki middeme veladot
Amar lo rabbi akiva hare hu omer ki yinnatzu anashim venagfu ishsha anashim velo shevarim
Shappir kaamar rabbi akiva
Amar rav ulla bereh derav idi itzterich salka datach amena anashim velo shevarim haddomin laanashim ma anashim muadin af shevarim muadin ha tam michayyav ketav rachamana baal hashshor naki defatur
Amar rava yatztziva beara vegiyyora bishme shemayya

Ella amar rava itzterich salka datach amena anashim velo shevarim haddomin laanashim ma anashim muadin af shevarim muadin vekal vachomer letammin diftiri hadar ketav rachamana baal hashshor naki tam patur umuad chayyav

Amar leh abbaye ella meatta gabbe boshet name nema hachi anashim velo shevarim haddomin laanashim ma anashim muadin af shevarim muadin vekal vachomer letammin diftiri hadar ketav rachamana baal hashshor naki tam patur umuad chayyav
Vechi tema hachi name i hachi litne baal hashshor naki rabbi yose haggelili omer patur middeme veladot umibboshet
Ella abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu anashim en ason beishsha yeanshu yesh ason baishsha lo yeanshu velo shevarim deaf al gav deyesh ason yeanshu hadar ketav rachamana baal hashshor naki defatur
Matkef lah rav adda bar ahava attu beason talya milta bechavana talya milta

Ella amar rav adda bar ahava anashim ki nitkavvenu ze laze af al gav sheyyesh ason baishsha yeanshu ki nitkavvenu laishsha atzmah lo yeanshu velo shevarim daafilu nitkavvenu laishsha atzmah yeanshu ketav rachamana baal hashshor naki diftiri
Vechen ki ata rav chaggay middaroma ata veayeti matnita bideh keoteh derav adda bar ahava
Tanya idach baal hashshor naki rabbi akiva omer naki middeme eved
b: Venema rabbi akiva lenafsheh vahalo atzmo en mishtallem ella miggufo haviehu levet din vishallem lach
Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak keshekkadam bealav ushchato mahu detema lishtallam mineh ka mashma lan hoil uvar ketala hu af al gav deshachteh la lishtallam mineh
I hachi lerabbi eliezer name keshekkadam ushchato
Hachi name vesavar dilma it leh tama acharina daadif mehay venema leh

Verabbi eliezer name lishanne leh shekkadam ushchato amar lach hatam hu denitkaven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam deshor lav bar ketala hu kelal desalka datach amena nichayyav itzterich kera lemaote aval hacha demeikara bar ketala hava la tzerich kera af al gav deshachteh
Ulrabbi akiva name vadday hachi hava

Ella amar rav assi hay milta mippi degavra rabba shemia li umannu rabbi yose berabbi chanina salka datach amena hoil veamar rabbi akiva af tam shechaval baadam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem mishtallam name deme eved mealiyya ketav rachamana baal hashshor naki

Amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi veha tavreh rabbi akiva ligzizeh detanya rabbi akiva omer yachol yeshallem min haaliyya talmud lomar kammishpat hazze yease lo miggufo meshallem veeno meshallem min haaliyya

Ella amar rava itzterich salka datach amena hoil umachmirani beeved yoter mibben chorin shebben chorin yafe sela noten sela sheloshim noten sheloshim veeved yafe sela noten sheloshim mishtallam name deme eved min haaliyya ketav rachamana baal hashshor naki
Tanya kevateh derava baal hashshor naki rabbi akiva omer naki middeme eved
Vahalo din hu hoil vechayyav beeved vechayyav beven chorin ma keshechiyyev beven chorin chalakta bo ben tam lemuad af keshechiyyev beeved nachlok bo ben tam lemuad
Veod kal vachomer uma ben chorin shennoten kol shoveyo chalakta bo ben tam lemuad eved sheeno noten ella sheloshim eno din shennachlok bo ben tam lemuad

Lo machmirani beeved yoter mibben chorin shebben chorin yafe sela noten sela sheloshim noten sheloshim veeved yafe sela noten sheloshim yachol yehe chayyav talmud lomar baal hashshor naki naki middeme eved
Tanu rabbanan vehemit ish o ishsha amar rabbi akiva vechi ma ba ze lelammedenu im lechayyev al haishsha kaish hare kevar neemar ki yiggach shor et ish o et ishsha
Ella lehakkish ishsha leish ma ish nezakav leorshav af ishsha nezakeha leorsheha
Vesavar rabbi akiva la yaret lah baal vehatanya veyarash otah mikkan shehabbaal yoresh et ishto divre rabbi akiva
Amar resh lakish lo amar ella bechofer hoil veen mishtallem ella leachar mita vehave leh rauy veen habbaal notel barauy kivmuchzak
May tama amar kera vehemit ish o ishsha hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat im kofer yushat alav
Uvinzakin lo amar rabbi akiva
Vehatanya hikka et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha noten nezek vatzaar laishsha udme veladot labbaal en habbaal noten leorshav en haishsha notenet leorsheha hayeta shifcha venishtachrera

a: O giyyoret zacha
Amar rabba bigrusha vechen amar rav nachman bigrusha
Amri gerusha name tiflog bidme veladot
Amar rav pappa hattora zikketa deme veladot labbaal afilu ba aleha biznut may tama amar kera kaasher yashit alav baal haishsha
Venokmah lerabba kegon sheggavu maot ulrav nachman kegon sheggavu karka
Deamar rabba gavu karka yesh lo gavu maot en lo verav nachman amar gavu maot yesh lo gavu karka en lo
Hane mile livne mareva alliba derabbanan
Ki kaamri hacha kerabbi

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish shor shehemit et haeved shello bechavana patur mishsheloshim shekalim shenneemar kesef sheloshim shekalim yitten ladonav vehashshor yissakel kol zeman shehashshor biskila habbealim meshallemin sheloshim shekalim en hashshor biskila en habbealim meshallemin sheloshim shekalim

Amar rabba shor shehemit ben chorin shello bechavana patur mikkofer shenneemar hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat im kofer yushat alav kol zeman shehashshor biskila bealim meshallemin kofer en hashshor biskila en bealim meshallemin kofer
Etiveh abbaye hemit shori et peloni o shoro shel peloni hare ze meshallem al pi atzmo may lav kofer
La damim
I damim ema sefa hemit shori et avdo shel peloni eno meshallem al pi atzmo vei damim ammay la
Amar leh yachelna leshannoye lach resha damim vesefa kenas mihu shinnuya dechika la meshannena lach ide veide damim
b: Mihu ben chorin dimshallem kofer al pi atzmo vehechi dame dei ato sahade veashidu beh diktal vela yadi i tam hava i muad hava vaamar mareh demuad hu dimshallem kofer al pi atzmo hecha deleka edim meshallem damim

Gabbe eved sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo vehechi dame dei ato edim veashidu beh diktal vela yadi i tam hava i muad hava vaamar mareh muad hu la mishtallam kenas al pi atzmo hecha deleka edim la meshallem damim
Metiv rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak kol shechayyav beven chorin chayyav beeved ben bechofer ben bemita
Kofer beeved mi ika ella lav damim

Ika deamri hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah ika deamri amar leh rabba hachi katane kol shechayyav beven chorin bechavana al pi edim kofer chayyav beeved kenas vechol shechayyav beven chorin shello bechavana al pi edim damim chayyav beeved shello bechavana al pi edim damim
Amar leh rava i hachi ishsho shello bechavana al pi edim neshallem damim
Umna leh lerava dela meshallem
Ilema midditnan haya gedi kafut lo veeved samuch lo venisraf immo chayyav eved kafut lo ugdi samuch lo venisraf immo patur
Haamar resh lakish kegon shehitztzit begufo shel eved dekam leh bidrabba mineh

Veella meha detanya chomer beesh mibbevor shehaesh muedet leechol ben davar harauy lah ben davar sheen rauy lah ma sheen ken bevor veilu shehaesh meshallemet shello bechavana damim ma sheen ken bevor la katane
Dilma tena veshayyar
Ella rava gufeh ibbeoye mibbaya leh ishsho shello bechavana mi meshallem damim o la

Mi amrinan gabbe shor hu divchavana meshallem kofer shello bechavana meshallem damim aval ishsho divchavana la meshallem kofer shello bechavana name la meshallem damim o dilma kevan degabbe shoro shello bechavana af al gav deleka kofer meshallem damim gabbe ishsho name af al gav divchavana la meshallem kofer shello bechavana mihat meshallem damim
Vela yadinan teku
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan kofer ma talmud lomar im kofer lerabbot kofer shello bechavana kechofer bechavana

Amar leh abbaye ella meatta eved name ma talmud lomar im eved lerabbot eved shello bechavana keeved bechavana vechi tema hachi name vehaamar resh lakish shor shehemit et haeved shello bechavana patur mishsheloshim shekalim
Amar leh gavra aggavra ka ramet
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan eved ma talmud lomar im eved lerabbot eved shello bechavana keeved bechavana
Ulresh lakish name nema middeeved im eved la daresh kofer im kofer name la daresh
Amri la eved im eved la daresh kofer im kofer daresh
Umay shena eved im eved la ketiv bimkom tashlumin kofer im kofer ketiv bimkom tashlumin
Vechen beven o bevat tanu rabbanan o ven yiggach o vat yiggach lechayyev al hakketannim kaggedolim
Vahalo din hu hoil vechiyyev adam beadam vechiyyev shor beadam ma keshechiyyev adam beadam la shena ben ketannim ligdolim af keshechiyyev shor beadam lo tachlok bo ben ketannim ligdolim
Veod kal vachomer hu uma adam beadam shello asa bo ketannim kigdolim chiyyev bo al hakketannim kigdolim

a: Shor beadam sheasa bo ketannim kigdolim eno din shechayyav al hakketannim kigdolim
Lo im amarta adam beadam shekken chayyav bearbaa devarim tomar beshor sheeno chayyav bearbaa devarim talmud lomar o ven yiggach o vat yiggach lechayyev al hakketannim kigdolim
Veen li ella bemuadin betam minnayin
Din hu hoil vechiyyev beish veishsha vechiyyev beven uvat ma keshechiyyev beish veishsha lo chillakta bo ben tam lemuad af keshechiyyev beven uvat lo tachlok bo ben tam lemuad
Veod kal vachomer ma ish veishsha shekken hora kocham binzakin lo chillakta bo ben tam lemuad ben uvat sheyyippa kocham binzakin eno din shello tachlok bahen ben tam lemuad
Amarta vechi danin kal mechamur lehachmir alav im hechmir bemuad hechamur tachmir betam hakkal
Veod im amarta beish veishsha shekken chayyavin bemitzot tomar beven uvat sheppeturin min hammitzot
Talmud lomar o ven yiggach o vat yiggach negicha betam negicha bemuad negicha lemita negicha linzakin
