Matni shor shehaya mitchakkech bakkotel venafal al haadam nitkaven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam legoy veharag ben yisrael linfalim veharag ben kayyama patur
Gema amar shemuel patur mimmita vechayyav bechofer verav amar patur mizze umizze
Veammay ha tam hu kidamar rav bemuad lipol al bene adam bevorot hacha name bemuad lehitchakkech al bene adam bichtalim
I hachi bar ketala hu bishlama hatam dachaza yeroka unfal ella hacha may ika lememar
Hacha name bemitchakkech bakkotel lahanaato umna yadinan devatar dinfal ka mitchakkach beh
b: Veakkatti tzerorot ninhu amar rav mari bereh derav kahana dekaazel mineh mineh
Tanya keoteh dishmuel utuvta derav yesh chayyav bemita uvchofer veyesh chayyav bechofer ufatur mimmita veyesh chayyav bemita ufatur min hakkofer veyesh patur mizze umizze
Ha ketzad muad bechavana chayyav bemita uvchofer muad shello bechavana chayyav bechofer ufatur mimmita tam bechavana chayyav bemita ufatur mikkofer tam shello bechavana patur mizze umizze
Vehannezakin shello bechavana rabbi yehuda mechayyev verabbi shimon poter
May tama derabbi yehuda yalef mikkofro ma kofro shello bechavana chayyav af hannezakin name shello bechavana chayyav
Verabbi shimon yalef mikketaleh deshor ma ketaleh shello bechavana patur af nezakin shello bechavana patur
Verabbi yehuda name nelaf mikketaleh danin tashlumin mittashlumin veen danin tashlumin mimmita
Verabbi shimon name nelaf mikkofro danin chiyyuveh deshor mechiyyuveh deshor leappoke kofer dechiyyuveh divalim hu

Nitkaven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam vechu patur ha nitkaven laharog et ze veharag et ze chayyav matnitin dela kerabbi shimon detanya rabbi shimon omer afilu nitkaven laharog et ze veharag et ze patur
May tama derabbi shimon deamar kera hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat kemitat bealim kach mitat hashshor ma bealim ad demikaven leh af shor name ad demikaven leh
Uvalim gufayehu menalan deamar kera vearav lo vekam alav ad sheyyitkaven lo
Verabbanan hay vearav lo may avdi leh amri deve rabbi yannay perat lazzorek even lego
Hechi dame ilema deika tisha goyim veechad yisrael benehem tipok leh derubba goyim ninhu i name palga ufalga sefek nefashot lehakel
La tzericha deika tisha yisreelim veechad goy deaf al gav derubba yisreelim ninhu kevan deika chado goy benayehu have leh kavua vechol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame vesafek nefashot lehakel

Matni shor haishsha veshor hayetomim shor haappotroppos shor hammidbar shor hahekdesh shor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshin hare ellu chayyavin mita rabbi yehuda omer shor hammidbar shor hahekdesh shor hagger shemmet peturin min hammita lefi sheen lahem bealim

Gema tanu rabbanan shor shor shiva lehavi shor haishsha shor hayetomim shor haappotroppos shor hammidbar shor hahekdesh shor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshin rabbi yehuda omer shor hammidbar shor hahekdesh shor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshin peturin min hammita lefi sheen lahem bealim
Amar rav huna poter haya rabbi yehuda afilu nagach ulvassof hikdish nagach ulvassof hifkir

Mimmay middekatane tarte shor hammidbar veshor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshin shor hagger shemmet may nihu dechevan deen lo yorshin hava leh shor hefker hayenu shor hammidbar hayenu shor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshin ella lav ha kamashma lan daafilu nagach ulvassof hikdish nagach ulvassof hifkir shema minah
Tanya name hachi yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda afilu nagach ulvassof hikdish nagach ulvassof hifkir patur shenneemar vehuad bivalav vehemit vego ad shettehe mita vehaamada baddin shavin keechad
Ugmar din la baenan veha hashshor yissakel gemar din hu ella ema ad shettehe mita vehaamada baddin ugmar din shavin keechad
Matni shor shehu yotze lisakel vehikdisho bealav eno mukdash shechato besaro asur veim ad shello nigmar dino hikdisho bealav mukdash veim shechato besaro muttar
Mesaro leshomer chinnam ulshoel lenose sachar ulsocher nichnesu tachat habbealim muad meshallem nezek shalem vetam meshallem chatzi nezek
Gema tanu rabbanan shor shehemit ad shello nigmar dino mecharo

a: Machur hikdisho mukdash shechato besaro muttar hechziro shomer levet bealav muchzar
Mishshennigmar dino mecharo eno machur hikdisho eno mukdash shechato besaro asur hechziro shomer levet bealav eno muchzar rabbi yaakov omer af mishshennigmar dino hechziro shomer livalav muchzar
Lema beha kamipalgi derabbanan savri en omrin beisure hanaa hare shellecha lefanecha verabbi yaakov savar omrin beisure hanaa hare shellecha lefanecha
Amar rabba dechulle alma omrin beisure hanaa hare shellecha lefanecha deim ken niflog leinyan chametz bappesach

Ella hacha begomrin dino shel shor shello befanav kamipalgi derabbanan savri en gomrin dino shel shor ella befanav deamar leh i ahdarteh nihali hava marekna leh leagma hashta atpasteh letoray bida dela yachelna leishtaoye dina bahadeh
Verabbi yaakov savar gomrin dino shel shor shello befanav deamar leh sof sof migmar hao gamri leh ledina
May tama derabbanan hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat kemitat habbealim kach mitat hashshor ma bealim bifnehem af shor befanav
Verabbi yaakov bishlama bealim bene taana ninhu ella shor bar taanta hu

Mesaro leshomer chinnam ulshoel ku tanu rabbanan arbaa nichnesu tachat habbealim veellu hen shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher hargu tammin neheragin ufturin min hakkofer muadin neheragin umshallemin et hakkofer vechayyavin lehachazir deme shor livalav chutz mishshomer chinnam
Amri hechi dame i denatreh afilu kullehu name lipatru vei dela natreh afilu shomer chinnam nichayyav
Amri hacha bemay askinan denatreh shemira pechuta vela natreh shemira meulla shomer chinnam kalta lo shemirato hanach la kalta shemiratan
Amri keman i kerabbi meir
b: Deamar socher keshomer chinnam dame litne chutz mishshomer chinnam vehassocher
Vei kerabbi yehuda deamar socher kenose sachar dame nitne chutz mishshomer chinnam vechullan bemuadin peturin leinyan kofer
Amar rav huna bar chinana ha manni rabbi eliezer hi deamar en lo shemira ella sakkin ulinyan socher savar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar socher kenose sachar dame
Abbaye amar leolam kerabbi meir vechidmachlif rabba bar avuh vetane socher ketzad meshallem rabbi meir omer keshomer sachar rabbi yehuda omer keshomer chinnam
Amar rabbi elazar masar shoro leshomer chinnam hizzik chayyav huzzak patur
Amri hechi dame i dekabbel aleh shemirat nezakav afilu huzzak name lichayyev vei dela kabbel aleh shemirat nezakav afilu hizzik name liptar

Amar rava leolam shekkibel alav shemirat nezakav vehacha bemay askinan kegon shehikkir bo shehu nagchan ustama demilta dela azel ihu umazzik acharine kabbel aleh deate acharine umazzeki leh ledideh la assek addateh
Matni kesharo bealav bemosera venaal befanav karauy veyatza vehizzik echad tam veechad muad chayyav divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda omer tam chayyav umuad patur shenneemar velo yishmerennu bealav veshamur hu ze
Rabbi eliezer omer en lo shemira ella sakkin

Gema may tama derabbi meir kasavar setam sheorim lav bechezkat shimur kayemi veamar rachamana tam nichayyav denive leh shemira pechuta hadar amar rachamana velo yishmerennu gabbe muad denive leh shemira meulla veyalef negicha letam negicha lemuad

Rabbi yehuda savar setam sheorim bechezkat shimur kayemi amar rachamana tam neshallem denive leh shemira meulla hadar amar rachamana velo yishmerennu gabbe muad denaaved leh shemira meulla have ribuy achar ribuy veen ribuy achar ribuy ella lemaet miet hakkatuv lishmira meulla
Vechi tema negicha letam negicha lemuad ha miet rachamana velo yishmerennu laze velo leacher
Veha mibe leh lelav im ken nichtov rachamana velo yishmor may velo yishmerennu laze velo leacher
Tanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer echad tam veechad muad sheshshemaro shemira pechuta patur
May tama savar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar muad bishmira pechuta saggi leh veyalef negicha letam ungicha lemuad
Amar rav adda bar ahava la patar rabbi yehuda ella tzad haadaa shebbo aval tzad tammut bimkomah omedet
Amar rav muad lekeren yamin eno muad lekeren semol
Amri alliba deman i alliba derabbi meir haamar echad tam veechad muad shemira meulla bae i alliba derabbi yehuda may irya keren semol afilu beyamin name it beh tzad tammut veit beh tzad muadut
Amri leolam kerabbi yehuda vela sevira leh derav adda bar ahava vehachi kaamar ki hay gavena hu demashkachatte beh tzad tammut umuadut

a: Aval muad ligmare la mashkachatte beh tzad tammut kelal
Rabbi eliezer omer en lo shemira ella sakkin ku amar rabba may tama derabbi eliezer deamar kera velo yishmerennu shuv en lo shemira laze
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta dichtiv velo yechassennu name shuv en lo kisuy laze
Vechi tema hachi name vehatnan kissahu karauy venafal letocho shor o chamor umet patur
Ella amar abbaye hayenu tameh derabbi eliezer kidtanya rabbi natan omer minnayin shello yegaddel adam kelev ra betoch beto veal yaamid sullam raua betoch beto shenneemar velo tasim damim bevetecha
Hadaran alach shor shennagach arbaa vachamishsha
Matni shor shennagach et happara venimtza ubbarah betziddah veen yadua im ad shello nagcha yalda im mishshennagcha yalda meshallem chatzi nezek lappara urvia nezek lavalad
Vechen para shennagcha et hashshor venimtza veladah betziddah veen yadua im ad shello nagcha yalda im mishshennagcha yalda mishtallem chatzi nezek min happara urvia nezek min havalad
Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel zo divre somchos deamar mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin aval chachamim omrim ze kelal gadol baddin hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Lema li lememar ze kelal gadol baddin itzterich daafilu nizak omer bari umazzik omer shemma hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
I name lechi ha deittemar hammocher shor lachavero venimtza nagchan rav amar hare ze mikkach taut ushmuel amar yachol sheyyomar lo lishchita mechartiv lach
Ammay venichze i gavra dezaven leridya i gavra dezaven lenichseta la tzericha begavra dezaven leha ulha
Venichze i deme ridya leridya i deme nichseta lenichseta
La tzericha deiyyakkar bisra vekae bidme ridya
Amri
b: Vei leka leishtallome mineh lishkeleh letora bezuze deamri enashe mimmare rashotach pare ippera
La tzericha deika leishtallome mineh

Rav amar hare ze mikkach taut zil batar rubba verubba deinashe leridya hu dezavni ushmuel amar yachol sheyyomar lo lishchita mechartiv lach vela azlinan batar rubba ki azlinan batar rubba beisura aval bemamona la azlinan batar rubba ella hammotzi mechavero alav haraya

Tanya name hachi shor shennagach et happara venimtza ubbarah betziddah veeno yodea im ad shello negachah yalda im mishshennegachah yalda meshallem chatzi nezek lappara urvia nezek lavalad divre somchos vachachamim omrim hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani minnayin lehammotzi mechavero alav haraya shenneemar mi vaal devarim yiggash alehem yaggish reaya alehem
Matkef lah rav ashe ha lema li kera sevara hu dechaev leh keeva azel leve asya
Ella kera lechidrav nachman amar rabba bar avuh deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh minnayin sheen nizkakin ella lattovea techilla shenneemar mi vaal devarim yiggash alehem yaggish devarav alehem
Amri nehardae peamim shennizkakin lannitba techilla vehechi dame deka zili nichseh
Vechen para shennagcha et hashshor vechu chatzi nezek urvia nezek palga nizka hu devae shallome kulle nizka neche riva may avidteh
Amar abbaye chatzi nezek echad mearbaa bannezek urvia nezek echad mishshemona bannezek
Vei para uvalad dechad ninhu hachi name dematze amar leh levaal para mimma nafshach chatzi nezek hav li ella la tzericha defara dechad uvalad dechad
Vei dikdem taveh levaal para techilla hachi name deamar leh levaal para para didach azzektan hav li reaya deit lach shuttafe
Ella dikdem taveh levaal valad techilla daamar leh gallet addatach deshuttafa it li
Ika deamri af al gav dikdem taveh levaal para techilla matze medache leh daamar leh mida yedai ana deshuttafa it li

Amar rava attu echad mearbaa bannezek veechad mishshemona bannezek katane chatzi nezek urvia nezek katane ella amar rava leolam befara uvalad dechad vehachi kaamrinan itah lefara mishtallam chatzi nezek mippara

a: Letah lefara mishtallem revia nezek mivalad
Tama dela yadinan i hava valad bahadah ki negacha i la hava aval i peshita lan dahava valad bahadah ki negacha mishtallem kulleh chatzi nezek mivalad
Rava letameh deamar rava para shehizzika gove mivveladah may tama gufah hi tarnegolet shehizzika eno gove mibbetzatah may tama pirsha bealma hu
Veamar rava en shamin lappara bifne atzmah velavalad bifne atzmo ella shamin lavalad al gav para sheim i atta omer ken nimtza atta machchish et hammazzik
Vechen atta motze bekotea yad avdo shel chavero vechen atta motze bemazzik sade shel chavero
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe vei dina hu lichchosh mazzik
Mishshum daamar leh para meabbarta azzektach para meabbarta shayemna lach
Peshita para dechad uvalad dechad pitma levaal para nifcha may rav pappa amar levaal para rav acha bereh derav ika amar cholkin vehilcheta cholkin

Matni hakkaddar shehichnis kederotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut veshibberatan behemto shel baal habbayit patur veim huzzeka bahen baal hakkederot chayyav veim hichnis birshut baal hechatzer chayyav
Hichnis perotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit patur veim huzzeka bahen baal happerot chayyav veim hichnis birshut baal hechatzer chayyav
Hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello
b: Birshut ungacho shoro shel baal habbayit o shenneshacho kalbo shel baal habbayit patur nagach hu shoro shel baal habbayit chayyav nafal levoro vehivish memav chayyav haya aviv o beno letocho meshallem et hakkofer veim hichnis birshut baal hechatzer chayyav
Rabbi omer bechullan eno chayyav ad sheyekabbel alav lishmor
Gema tama deshello birshut ha birshut la michayyav baal kederot benizke vehemto devaal chatzer vela amrinan kabbole kabbel baal kederot netiruta divhemto devaal chatzer
Manni rabbi hi deamar kol bistama la kabbel aleh netiruta
Ema sefa im hichnis birshut baal chatzer chayyav atan lerabbanan deamri bistama name kabbole kabbel aleh netiruta
Vetu rabbi omer bechullan eno chayyav ad sheyekabbel alav baal habbayit lishmor resha vesefa rabbi umtziata rabbanan
Amar rabbi zera tivrah mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo rava amar kullah rabbanan hi uvirshut shemirat kederot kibbel alav baal hechatzer vaafilu nishberu baruach
Hichnis perotav lachatzar baal habbayit vechu amar rav lo shanu ella shehuchleka bahen aval achla patur may tama hava lah shello tochal

Amar rav sheshet amena ki nayem veshachev rav amar leha shemata detanya hannoten sam hammavet lifne behemat chavero patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim sam hammavet hu dela avida deachla aval perot daavida deachla bedine adam name michayyav veammay hava lah shello tochal
Amri hu haddin afilu perot name patur middine adam veha ka mashma lan daafilu sam hammavet name dela avida deachla chayyav bedine shamayim
Veibaet ema sam hammavet name beafrazta dehayenu pere
Metivi haishsha shennichnesa litchon chittim etzel baal habbayit shello birshut vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit patur im huzzeka chayyevet veammay nema hava lah shello tochal
Amri umi adifa mimmatnitin deokemna shehuchleka bahen
Udkaare lah may kaare lah amar lach bishlama matnitin katane im huzzeka bahen shehuchleka bahen hu aval hacha katane im huzzeka vela katane bahen achila hu dekatane
Veidach amar lach la shena
Ta shema hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut veachal chittin vehitriz vamet patur veim hichnis birshut baal hechatzer chayyav veammay hava leh shello yochal
Amar rava birshut ashshello birshut karamet birshut shemirat shoro kibbel alav vaafilu chanak et atzmo
Ibaya lehu hecha dekabbel aleh netiruta mahu denafsheh hu dekabbel aleh o dilma afilu netiruta dealma kabbel aleh

Ta shema detane rav yehuda bar simon binzakin deve karna hichnis perotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut uva shor mimmakom acher vaachalan patur veim hichnis birshut chayyav man patur uman chayyav lav patur baal chatzer vechayyav baal chatzer
Amri la patur baal hashshor vechayyav baal hashshor
Vei baal hashshor

a: May birshut umay shello birshut ika
Amri birshut haveya lah shen birshut hannizak veshen birshut hannizak chayyevet shello birshut haveya lah shen birshut harabbim veshen birshut harabbim petura
Ta shema hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut uva shor mimmakom acher ungacho patur veim hichnis birshut chayyav man patur uman chayyav lav patur baal chatzer vechayyav baal chatzer
La patur baal hashshor vechayyav baal hashshor i hachi may birshut umay shello birshut ika

Amri ha manni rabbi tarfon hi deamar meshunne keren bachatzar hannizak nezek shalem meshallem birshut haveya lah keren bachatzar hannizak umshallem nezek shalem shello birshut haveya lah keren birshut harabbim vela meshallema ella chatzi nezek
Hahi itta dealla lemefa behahu beta ata barcha demare deveta achleh lelesha chavil umit chayevah rava leshallome deme varcha
Lema peliga adderav deamar rav hava lah shello tochal
Amri hachi hashta hatam shello birshut la kabbel aleh netiruta hacha birshut kabbel aleh netiruta
Umay shena mehaishsha shennichnesa litchon chittin etzel baal habbayit shello birshut vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit patur veim huzzeka chayyevet tama shello birshut ha birshut petura

Amri litchon chittim kevan dela baaya tzeniuta mide la bae mesalleki maraota dechatzer nafshayehu vaaleh dideh rame netiruta aval lemefa kevan devaaya hi tzeniuta maraota dechatzer mesalleki nafshayehu hilkach alah didah ramya netiruta

Hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit amar rava hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut vechafar bah borot shichin umarot baal hashshor chayyav benizke chatzer uvaal chatzer chayyav benizke habbor
Af al gav deamar mar ki yichre ish bor velo shor bor hacha kevan deit leh lehayeche lemalloyeh vela ka malleyeh keman decharyeh dame
Veamar rava hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut vehizzik et baal habbayit o baal habbayit huzzak bo chayyav ravatz patur
Umishshum deravatz patur amar rav pappa may ravatz shehirbitz gelalim venitnefu kelav shel baal habbayit dehave gelalim bor velo matzinu bor shechiyyev bo et hakkelim
Hanicha lishmuel deamar kol takkala bor hu ella lerav deamar ad demafkar leh may ika lememar
Amri setam gelalim afkore mafkar lehu
Veamar rava nichnas lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut vehizzik et baal habbayit o baal habbayit huzzak bo chayyav hizziko baal habbayit patur
Amar rav pappa la amaran ella dela hava yada beh aval hava yada beh hizziko baal habbayit chayyav may tama mishshum deamar leh nehi deit lach reshuta leappoke leazzoke let lach reshuta
Veazdu letamayehu deamar rava veitema rav pappa
b: Shenehem birshut o shenehem shello birshut hizziku ze et ze chayyavin huzzeku ze baze peturin tama dishnehem birshut o shenehem shello birshut aval echad birshut veechad shello birshut devirshut patur shello birshut chayyav
Nafal levor vehivish memav chayyav amar rava lo shanu ella shehivish bishat nefila aval leachar nefila patur may tama have shor bor umayim kelim velo matzinu bor shechiyyev bo et hakkelim
Hanicha lishmuel deamar kol takkala bor hu ella lerav deamar ad demafkar leh may ika lememar
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rava lo shanu ella shehivish miggufo aval hivish merecho patur may tama gerama bealma hu ugrama bealma la michayyav
Haya aviv o beno letocho meshallem et hakkofer veammay ha tam hu amar rav bemuad lipol al bene adam bevorot askinan
I hachi bar ketala hu amar rav yosef dachaza yeroka unfal
Shemuel amar ha manni rabbi yose haggelili hi deamar tam meshallem chatzi kofer
Ulla amar rabbi yose haggelili hi deamar kerabbi tarfon deamar keren bachatzar hannizak nezek shalem meshallem hachi name kofer shalem meshallem
Bishlama leulla hayenu dekatane haya aviv o beno letocho ella lishmuel may irya aviv o beno afilu acher name
Orcheh demilta katane
Veim hichnis birshut baal chatzer chayyav ku itmar rav amar hilcheta ketanna kamma ushmuel amar hilcheta kerabbi
Tanu rabbanan kenos shorcha veshomro hizzik chayyav huzzak patur kenos shorcha vaani eshmerennu huzzak chayyav hizzik patur
Ha gufa kashya amratte kenos shorcha veshomro hizzik chayyav huzzak patur
Tama daamar leh shomro dechayyav baal hashshor ufatur baal chatzer ha setama chayyav baal chatzer ufatur baal hashshor devistama mekabbel aleh netiruta
Ema sefa kenos shorcha vaani eshmerennu huzzak chayyav hizzik patur
Tama daamar leh vaani eshmerennu hu dimchayyev baal hechatzer ufatur baal hashshor ha setama chayyav baal hashshor ufatur baal chatzer devistama la mekabbel aleh netiruta
Atan lerabbi deamar ad sheyekabbel aleh netiruta baal habbayit lishmor resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi
Amar rabbi elazar tavra mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo rava amar kullah rabbanan hi ayede denasev resha shomro tena sefa vaani eshmerennu
Rav pappa amar kullah rabbi hi vesavar lah kerabbi tarfon deamar keren bachatzar hannizak nezek shalem meshallem
Hilkach amar leh shomro la makne leh makom bechatzer vehaveya lah keren bachatzar hannizak vekeren bachatzar hannizak meshallem nezek shalem
La amar leh shomro aknoye akni leh makom bechatzer vehaveya leh chatzar hashshuttafin vekeren bachatzar hashshuttafin eno meshallem ella chatzi nezek
Matni shor shehaya mitkaven lachavero vehikka et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha patur middeme veladot veadam shehaya mitkaven lachavero vehikka haishsha veyatzu yeladeha meshallem deme veladot
Ketzad meshallem deme veladot shamin haishsha kamma hi yafa ad shello yalada vechamma hi yafa mishsheyyalada amar rabban shimon ben gamliel

a: Im ken mishshehaishshe yoledet mashbachat ella shamin et havveladot kamma hen yafin venoten labbaal veim en lah baal noten leorshav
Hayeta shifcha venishtachrera o giyyoret patur
Gema tama demitkaven lachavero ha mitkaven laishsha meshallem deme veladot lema tehve teuvta derav adda bar ahava deamar rav adda bar ahava sheorim shennitkavvenu laishsha peturim middeme veladot

Amar lecha rav adda bar ahava hu haddin daafilu nitkavvenu laishsha name peturim middeme veladot veha dekatane shor shehaya mitkaven lachavero ayede deka bae lemitna sefa adam shehaya mitkaven lachavero dehachi ketiv kera katane resha name shor shehaya mitkaven lachavero
Amar rav pappa shor shennagach et hashshifcha veyatzu yeladeha meshallem deme veladot may tama chamarta meabbarta bealma hu deazzek deamar kera shevu lachem po im hachamor am haddome lachamor

Ketzad meshallem deme veladot deme veladot shevach veladot mibe leh hachi name kaamar ketzad meshallem deme veladot ushvach veladot shamin et haishsha kamma hi yafa ad shello yalada vechamma hi yafa mishsheyyalada

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel im ken mishshehaishshe yoledet mashbachat may kaamar amar rabba hachi kaamar vechi ishsha mashbachat kodem shetteled yoter milleachar shetteled vahalo ishsha mashbachat leachar shetteled yoter mikkodem shetteled ella shamin et havveladot venotnin labbaal
Tanya name hachi vechi ishsha mashbachat kodem shetteled yoter milleachar shetteled vahalo ishsha mashbachat leachar shetteled yoter mikkodem shetteled ella shamin et havveladot venotnin labbaal
Rava amar hachi katane vechi ishsha lemi sheyyoledet mashbachat veen leatzmah bishvach veladot kelum ella shamin et havveladot venotnin labbaal ushvach veladot cholkin

Tanya name hachi amar rabban shimon ben gamliel vechi ishsha lemi sheyyoledet mashbachat veen leatzmah bishvach veladot kelum ella shamin nezek bifne atzmo vetzaar bifne atzmo veshamin et havveladot venotnin labbaal ushvach veladot cholkin
Kashya derabban shimon ben gamliel adderabban shimon ben gamliel
La kashya kan bimvakkeret kan besheenah mevakkeret
Verabbanan deamri shevach veladot name labbaal may tama keditnan mimmashma shenneemar veyatzu yeladeha eni yodea shehi hara ma talmud lomar hara lomar lach shevach heraon labbaal

Verabban shimon ben gamliel hay hara may daresh beh mibbee leh lechidtanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer leolam eno chayyav ad sheyyakkenna keneged bet haheraon amar rav pappa la tema keneged bet heraon mammash ella kol hecha desalek beh shichma levalad leappoke yad varegel dela

Hayeta shifcha venishtachrera o giyyoret patur amar rabba lo shanu ella shechaval bah bechayye hagger umet hagger dechevan dechaval bah bechayye hagger zecha behu ger vechevan demet hagger zecha behu min hagger aval chaval bah leachar mitat hagger zachya lah ihi begavayehu umichayyav leshallome lah ledidah
Amar rav chisda mare dechi attu veladot tzerare ninhu vezachya behu ella iteh levaal zecha leh rachamana leteh levaal la
Metivi hikka et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha noten nezek vatzaar laishsha udme veladot labbaal en habbaal noten leorshav en haishsha noten leorsheha hayeta shifcha venishtachrera o giyyoret zacha
Amri umi adifa mimmatnitin deokemna shechaval bah bechayye hagger umet hagger hacha name shechaval bah bechayye hagger umet hagger veibaet ema leachar mitat hagger
b: Utni zachta

Lema ketannae bat yisrael shenniset leger venitabbera mimmennu vechaval bah bechayye hagger noten deme veladot lagger leachar mitat hagger tane chada chayyav vetane chada patur may lav tannae ninhu lerabba vadday tannae hi ella lerav chisda mi lema tannae hi
La kashya ha rabbanan ha rabban shimon ben gamliel
I rabban shimon ben gamliel may irya leachar mita afilu mechayyim name it lah palga mechayyim it lah palga leachar mita kulleh
Veibaet ema ha veha rabban shimon ben gamliel kan bishvach veladot kan bidme veladot
Amri mishshevach veladot lishma deme veladot umerabban shimon ben gamliel lishma lerabbanan
Amri la shevach veladot deshayecha yedah begavayehu zachya behu bechullehu deme veladot la shayecha yedah begavayehu la zachya behu kelal

Bae mineh rav yeva sava merav nachman hammachzik bishtarotav shel ger mahu man demachzek bishtara addata deara hu machzek uvara ha la achzek ushtara name la kena delav dateh ashshetara o dilma dateh name ashshetara
Amar leh anay mori vechi latzor al pi tzelochito hu tzarich amar leh latzor velatzor
Amar rabba mashkono shel yisrael beyad ger umet hagger uva yisrael acher vehechzik bo motziin oto miyyado may tama kevan demit leh ger peka leh shibudeh
Mashkono shel ger beyad yisrael umet hagger uva yisrael acher vehechezik bo ze kana keneged meotav veze kana et hashshear
Veammay tikne leh chatzero dehaamar rabbi yose bar chanina chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato
Amri hacha bemay askinan deleteh kol hecha deite ledideh dei bae mikne matze kane kanya leh name chatzero kol hecha deleteh ledideh dei bae hu lemikne la matze kane chatzero name la kanya
Vehilcheta deleteh bachatzero delo kana
Matni hachofer bor birshut hayyachid uftacho lirshut harabbim o birshut harabbim uftacho lirshut hayyachid birshut hayyachid uftacho lirshut hayyachid acher chayyav

Gema tanu rabbanan hachofer bor birshut hayyachid uftacho lirshut harabbim birshut harabbim uftacho lirshut hayyachid chayyav vezehu bor haamur battora divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer hifkir reshuto velo hifkir boro zehu bor haamur battora

Amar rabba bevor birshut harabbim kulle alma la peligi demichayyav may tama amar kera ki yiftach vechi yichre im al peticha chayyav al keriyya lo kol shekken ella sheal iske peticha veal iske keriyya baa lo lo nechleku ella

a: Bevor birshuto rabbi akiva savar bor birshuto name chayyav dichtiv baal habbor bevor deit leh bealim kaamar rachamana
Verabbi yishmael savar baal hattakkala
Ella may zehu bor haamur battora dekaamar rabbi akiva zehu bor sheppatach bo hakkatuv techilla letashlumin
Verav yosef amar bevor birshut hayyachid kulle alma la peligi demichayyav may tama baal habbor amar rachamana bevor deit leh bealim askinan

Ki peligi bevor birshut harabbim rabbi yishmael savar bor birshut harabbim name chayyav dichtiv ki yiftach vechi yichre im al peticha chayyav al keriyya lo kol shekken ella sheal iske feticha veal iske cheriyya baa lo
Verabbi akiva hanhu mitzrach tzerichi dei ketav rachamana ki yiftach hava amena poteach hu desaggi leh bechissuy kore la saggi leh bechissuy ad detaem leh
Vei ketav rachamana ki yichre hava amena keriyya hu devae kissuy mishshum daavad maase aval poteach dela avad maase ema kissuy name la bae ka mashma lan
Veella may zehu bor haamur battora dekaamar rabbi yishmael zehu bor sheppatach bo hakkatuv techilla linzakin
Metivi hachofer bor birshut harabbim uftacho lirshut hayyachid patur veaf al pi sheeno rashshay laasot ken lefi sheen osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim

Hachofer borot shichin umarot birshut hayyachid uftacho lirshut harabbim chayyav vehachofer borot birshut hayyachid hassemucha lirshut harabbim kegon ellu hachofrim leushshin patur verabbi yose berabbi yehuda mechayyev ad sheyyaase mechitza asara o ad sheyyarchik mimmekom derisat ragle adam umimmekom derisat ragle vehema arbaa tefachim
Tama dilushshin ha lav leushshin chayyav
Ha manni bishlama lerabba resha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva
Ella lerav yosef bishlama sefa divre hakkol ella resha manni la rabbi yishmael vela rabbi akiva
Amar lecha rav yosef kullah divre hakkol hi veresha shello hifkir lo reshuto velo boro
Amar rav ashe hashta deokemtah lerav yosef ledivre hakkol lerabba name la tokmah ketannae
Midderesha rabbi yishmael sefa name rabbi yishmael vetama dilushshin ha lav leushshin chayyav kegon dearvach aroche lirshut harabbim

Metivi hachofer bor birshut hayyachid uftacho lirshut harabbim chayyav birshut hayyachid hassemucha lirshut harabbim patur bishlama lerabba kullah rabbi yishmael hi ella lerav yosef bishlama resha rabbi yishmael ella sefa manni la rabbi yishmael vela rabbi akiva
Amar lach bechofer leushshin vedivre hakkol

Tanu rabbanan chafar ufatach umasar larabbim patur chafar ufatach velo masar larabbim chayyav vechen minhago shel nechunya chofer borot shichin umarot shehaya chofer ufoteach umoser larabbim uchsheshshamu chachamim baddavar amru kiyyem ze halacha zo halacha zo vetu la ella ema af halacha zo

Tanu rabbanan maase bevitto shel nechunya chofer shichin shennafla levor gadol bau vehodiu et rabbi chanina ben dosa shaa rishona amar lahem shalom sheniyya amar lahem shalom shelishit amar lahem alta

Amru lah mi heelich amra lahem zachar shel rechelim nizdammen li vezaken echad manhigo amru lo navi atta amar lahem lo navi anochi velo ben navi anochi ella kach amarti davar sheoto tzaddik mitztaer bo yikkashel bo zaro

Amar rabbi acha af al pi chen met beno batztzama shenneemar usvivav nisara meod melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu medakdek im sevivav afilu kechut hassaara rabbi nechunya amar mehacha el naaratz besod kedoshim rabba venora al kol sevivav
Amar rabbi chanina kol haomer hakkadosh baruch hu vatteran hu yivatru chayyav shenneemar hatztzur tamim poolo ki chol derachav mishpat amar rabbi chana veitema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani may dichtiv
b: Erech appayim vela ketiv erech af erech appayim latztzaddikim velarshaim

Tanu rabbanan lo yesakkel adam mershuto lirshut harabbim maase beadam echad shehaya mesakkel mershuto lirshut harabbim umtzao chasid echad amar lo reka mippene ma atta mesakkel mershut sheenah shellach lirshut shellach ligleg alav
Leyamim nitzrach limkor sadehu vehaya mehallech beoto reshut harabbim venichshal beotan avanim amar yafe amar li oto chasid mippene ma atta mesakkel mershut sheenah shellach lirshut shellach

Matni hachofer bor birshut harabbim venafal letocho shor o chamor chayyav echad hachofer bor shiach umara charitzin unitzin chayyav im ken lamma neemar bor ma bor sheyyesh bo kede lehamit asara tefachim af kol sheyyesh bo kede lehamit asara tefachim hau pechutin measara tefachim venafal letocho shor o chamor umet patur veim huzzak bo chayyav
Gema amar rav bor shechiyeva alav tora lehevlo velo lachavato alma kasavar chavata karka olam hu demazzeka leh
Ushmuel amar lehevlo vechol shekken lachavato veim tomar lachavato amra tora velo lehevlo hattora heida al habbor vaafilu male sefogin shel tzemer
May benayehu ika benayehu daavad govah birshut harabbim lerav aggovah la michayyav lishmuel aggovah name michayyav
May tama derav deamar kera venafal ad sheyyippol derech nefila velishmuel venafal kol dehu mashma
Tenan im ken lamma neemar bor ma bor sheyyesh bo kede lehamit asara tefachim af kol sheyyesh bo kede lehamit asara tefachim bishlama lishmuel af kol leetoye govah ella lerav af kol leetoye may
Leetoye charitzin unitzin charitzin unitzin behedya katane lehu tane vahadar mefaresh
Vehane kullehu dekatane lema li tzericha dei tena bor hava amena bor asara hu deit beh havla mishshum dekattin uchricha aval shiach daarich ema baasara let beh havla
Vei tena shiach hava amena shiach asara hu deit beh havla mishshum dekattin aval meara dimrabbea ema baasara let bah havla
Vei tane meara hava amena meara baasara hu deit bah havla mishshum dimtallela aval charitzin dela metalleli ema baasara let behu havla

Vei tena charitzin hava amena charitzin asara hu deit behu havla mishshum delet behu revicha milleel tefe mittattay aval neitzin dirvichi milleel tefe mittattay ema baasara let behu havla ka mashma lan
Tenan hau pechutin measara tefachim venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet patur veim huzzak bo chayyav nafal letocho shor o chamor umet patur may tama lav mishshum delet beh chavta
La mishshum delet beh havla i hachi im huzzak bo chayyav ha let beh havla amri en havla lemita veyesh havla linzakin
Hahu tora dinfal laarita dedallae shachteh mareh tarfeh rav nachman

Amar rav nachman i shekel mareh dehay tora kabba dekimcha vaazal tena be midresha im shahata meet leet keshera la afsedeh letora deshave kamma kabbe alma kasavar rav nachman yesh chavata befachot measara
Etiveh rava lerav nachman hau pechutin measara tefachim venafal letocho shor o chamor umet patur may tama lav mishshum delet beh chavta

a: La mishshum delet beh havla i hachi huzzak bo chayyav ha let beh havla amar leh en hevel lemita veyesh hevel linzakin
Etiveh bet hassekila haya gavoha shette komot vetane alah vekoma shello hare kan shalosh vei salka datach yesh chavata befachot measara lema li kulle hay
Ultamach naaved asara ella kerav nachman deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar kera veahavta lereacha kamocha beror lo mita yafa
I hachi nagbah tefe mishshum deminaval
Etiveh ki yippol hannofel mimmennu mimmennu velo betocho
Ketzad hayeta reshut harabbim gavoha mimmennu asara tefachim venafal mittochah letocho patur amukka mimmennu asara tefachim venafal mittocho letochah chayyav
Vei salka datach yesh chavata befachot measara lema li asara amar leh shane bayit dechol pachot measara lav bayit hu
I hachi hashta name dehave meabbaray asara dal mineh tikra umaaziva miggavay la have asara amar leh kegon dechak miggavay
I hachi ki la have name meabbaray asara mashkachatte lah dehave miggavay asara kegon dechak bah tefe
Ella hayenu tama derav nachman savar mikkeresa detora leara kamma have arbea arita dedallae kamma have shita ha asra ishtechach dechi ka michavat measara hu deka michavat
Ella matnitin dekatane ma bor shehu kede lehamit asara tefachim af kol sheyyesh bo kede lehamit asara tefachim beshita name sagya
Amri matnitin deigandar levor
Matni bor shel shene shuttafin avar alav harishon velo kissahu vehashsheni velo kissahu hashsheni chayyav

Gema amri bor shel shene shuttafin hechi mashkachatte lah hanicha i sevira lan kerabbi akiva deamar bor birshuto chayyav mashkachatte lah bechatzer shel shenehem uvor shel shenehem vehifkiru reshutan velo hifkiru boran
Ella i sevira lan bor birshuto patur hechi mashkachatte lah dechayyav aleh birshut harabbim uvirshut harabbim bor shel shene shuttafin hechi mashkachatte lah
I deshauo shaliach tarvayehu veamri leh zil keri lan vaazal kera lehu en shaliach lidvar avera vei dichra hay chamsha vehay chamsha nistalleku lehu maase rishon
Hanicha lerabbi velinzakin mashkachatte lah ella lerabbi ulmita ulrabbanan ben lemita ben linzakin hechi mashkachatte lah
Amar rabbi yochanan kegon sheakru shenehen chulya bevat achat vehishlimu laasara
May rabbi umay rabbanan detanya echad hachofer bor tisha uva acher vehishlimah laasara haacharon chayyav rabbi omer achar acharon lemita veachar shenehem linzakin
May tama derabbanan deamar kera ki yiftach vechi yichre im al peticha chayyav al keriyya lo kol shekken ella lehavi kore achar kore shessilek maase rishon
Verabbi amar lach hanhu mitzrach tzerichi kidamrinan verabbanan name mitzrach tzerichi
Ella hayenu tama derabbanan amar kera ki yichre ish bor echad velo shenayim
Verabbi hahu mibe leh ki yichre ish bor velo shor bor
Verabbanan tere ish bor ketivi
Verabbi ayede dichtav hay ketav hay
Umimmay dilchayyove batra dilma lechayyove kamma
La salka datach deamar kera vehammet yihye lo hahu deka aved mita
Vehay vehammet yihye lo mibbee leh lechidrava deamar rava shor pesule hammukdashin shennafal levor patur shenneemar vehammet yihye lo bemi shehammet shello
Amri velav mimmela shamatte minah divhahu daavad mita askinan
Tanu rabbanan echad hachofer bor asara uva acher vehishlimah leesrim uva acher vehishlimah lishloshim kullan chayyavin urminhu echad hachofer bor asara uva acher vesiyyed vechiyyed haacharon chayyav
b: Lema ha rabbi veha rabbanan
Amar rav zevid ha veha rabbanan ad kan la kaamri rabbanan acharon chayyav ella hecha dela avad kamma shiur mita aval hecha daavad kamma shiur mita afilu rabbanan modu dechullan chayyavin
Veha siyyed vechiyyed deka avad kamma shiur mita vekatane acharon chayyav amri hatam shello haya bo hevel lemita uva acher vehosif bah hevel lemita

Ika deamri amar rav zevid ha veha rabbi hach dekatane kullan chayyavin shappir ha dekatane acharon chayyav kegon shello haya bo hevel lo lemita velo linzakin uva acher vehosif bo hevel ben lemita ben linzakin
Amar rava hinniach even al pi habbor vehishlimah laasara banu lemachloket rabbi verabbanan
Peshita mahu detema lematta hu dehavla dideh ka katel leh aval lemala dela havla dideh ka katel ema la ka mashma lan
Bae rava tam tefach vesilek avanav mahu mi amrinan may daavad shakleh
O dilma nistalleku maase rishon vekama lah kullah birshuteh teku
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar shemuel bar marta bor shemona umehen shene tefachim mayim chayyav may tama kol tefach demayya kitre deyabbasha dame
Ibaya lehu bor tisha umehen tefach echad mayim mahu mi amrinan kevan dela nefishi mayya let beh havla o dilma kevan deammik tefe it beh havla
Bor shiva umehen shelosha tefachim mayim mahu mi amrinan kevan dinfishi mayim tefe it beh havla o dilma kevan dela ammika let beh havla teku
Bea mineh rav shezvi merabba hirchivah mahu amar leh hare miet havla amar leh adderabba hare kerav hezzeka

Ella amar rav ashe nichze anan i behavla miyt hare miet havla i bechavta miyt hare kerav hezzeka ika deamri amar rav ashe nichze anan i mehahi gisa nefal hare kerav hezzeka vei meidach gisa nefal hare miet havla

Itmar bor sheomkah kerochbah rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu mishshemeh derabba bar bar chana deamar mishshemeh derabbi mani chad amar leolam yesh bah hevel ad sheyehe rochbah yater al omkah vechad amar leolam en bah hevel ad sheyehe omkah yater al rochbah

Avar alav harishon velo kissahu verishon meemat miptar rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu mishshemeh derabba bar bar chana deamar mishshemeh derabbi mani chad amar mishshemmannicho mishtammesh vechad amar mishsheyyimsor lo dolo
Ketannae hamdalle mayim min habbor uva chavero veamar lo hannach li vaani adalle mayim kevan shehinnicho mishtammesh patur rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer mishsheyyimsor lo dolo
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar yesh berera
Hay middideh ka memalle vehay middideh ka memalle verabbanan savri en berera
Amar ravina veazdu letamayehu ditnan hashshuttafin shennadru hanaa ze mizze asurin likanes lechatzer rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer ze nichnas letoch shello veze nichnas letoch shello
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar yesh berera hay lidnafsheh ayel vehay lidnafsheh ayel verabbanan savri en berera
Amar rabbi elazar hammocher bor lachavero kevan shemmasar lo dolo kana hechi dame i bechaspa likne bechaspa i bachazaka likne bachazaka
Leolam bachazaka uvae lememar leh lech chazek ukne vechevan shemmasar lo dolo keman daamar leh lech chazek ukne dame
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hammocher bayit lachavero

a: Kevan shemmasar lo mafteach kana
Hechi dame i bechaspa likne bechaspa i bachazaka likne bachazaka leolam bachazaka uvae lememar leh lech chazek ukne vechevan shemmasar lo mafteach keman daamar leh lech chazek ukne dame
Amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yannay hammocher eder lachavero kevan shemmasar lo mashkuchit kana
Hechi dame i bimshicha likne bimshicha i bimsira likne bimsira leolam bimshicha uvae lememar leh lech meshoch ukne vechevan demasar lo mashkuchit keman deamar leh lech meshoch ukne dame
May mashkuchit hacha targimu karkashta rabbi yaakov omer iza deazla beresh edra kedidrash hahu galilaa aleh derav chisda kad ragez raaya al ana aved lenaggada samvata

Matni kissahu harishon uva hashsheni umtzao megulle velo kissahu hashsheni chayyav kissahu karauy venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet patur lo kissahu karauy venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet chayyav
Nafal lefanav mikkol hakkeriyya chayyav leacharav mikkol hakkeriyya patur
Nafal letocho shor vechelav venishtabberu chamor vechelav venitkaru chayyav al habbehema ufatur al hakkelim
Nafal letocho shor cheresh shote vekatan chayyav ben o bat eved o ama patur
Gema verishon ad emat miptar amar rav bichde sheyyeda ushmuel amar bichde sheyyodiuhu verabbi yochanan amar bichdi sheyyodiuhu veyiskor poalim veyichrot arazim vichassennu
Kissahu karauy venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet patur kevan dechissahu karauy hechi nefal amar rabbi yitzchak bar bar chana shehitlia mittocho

Ibaya lehu kissahu kissuy sheyyachol laamod lifne sheorim veen yachol laamod bifne gemallim vaato gemallim vearuh veatu sheorim venafli beh may amri hechi dame i dishchichi gemallim poshea hu vei dela shechichi gemallim anus hu
La tzericha daato lifrakim mi amrinan kevan deatayin lifrakim poshea hu deibi leh assoke addateh o dilma kevan dehashta mihat leka anus hu
Ta shema kissahu karauy venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet patur hechi dame ilema karauy lishorim vecharauy ligmallim hechi neful ella lav karauy lishorim
b: Velo karauy ligmallim vei dishchichi gemallim ammay patur poshea hu vei dela shechichi gemallim peshita anus hu ella lav deatayin lifrakim vaato gemallim vearuh vaato sheorim unfalu beh vekatane patur alma kevan dehashta leka anus hu
Amri la leolam karauy lishorim vecharauy ligmallim udka kashya lach hechi neful amar rabbi yitzchak bar bar chana shehitlia mittocho

Ta shema lo kissahu karauy venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet chayyav hechi dame ilema lo karauy lishorim velo karauy ligmallim peshita tzericha lememar dechayyav ella lav karauy lishorim velo karauy ligmallim hechi dame i dishchichi gemallim poshea hu vei dela shechichi gemallim anus hu
Ella lav deatayin lifrakim vaato gemallim vearuh vaato sheorim unfalu beh vekatane chayyav alma kevan deatayin lifrakim poshea hu deibi leh assoke addateh
Leolam karauy lishorim velo karauy ligmallim ushchichi gemallim udka kashya lach poshea hu ayede dinsev resha kissahu karauy nesev sefa name lo kissahu karauy
Ika deamri ha name vadday la ibaya lan dechevan deatayin lifrakim poshea hu deibi leh assoke addateh

Ki ibi lan hachi hu deibaya lan kissahu kissuy sheyyachol laamod bifne sheorim veeno yachol laamod bifne gemallim ushchichi gemallim vehitlia mittocho mahu mi amrinan miggo dehave poshea etzel gemallim have poshea name leinyan hatlaa o dilma la amrinan miggo

Ta shema kissahu karauy venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet patur veittemar alah amar rabbi yitzchak bar bar chana shehitlia mittocho hechi dame ilema karauy lishorim vecharauy ligmallim vehitlia mittocho peshita defatur may hava leh lemebad
Ella lav karauy lishorim velo karauy ligmallim ushchichi gemallim vehitlia mittocho vekatane patur alma la amrinan miggo dehave poshea leinyan gemallim have poshea leinyan hatlaa
La leolam karauy ligmallim uchrauy lishorim vehitlia mittocho udka kashya lach ki hitlia may hava leh lemebad mahu detema ibi leh lemezal uminkash aleh ka mashma lan
Ta shema lo kissahu karauy venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet chayyav hechi dame ilema lo karauy lishorim velo karauy ligmallim tzericha lememar dechayyav

Ella lav karauy lishorim velo karauy ligmallim vei dishchichi gemallim poshea hu vei dela shechichi gemallim anus hu ella lav dishchichi gemallim vehitlia mittocho vekatane chayyav alma amrinan miggo dehave poshea leinyan gemallim have poshea leinyan hatlaa

Amri la leolam karauy lishorim velo karauy ligmallim ushchichi gemallim vaato gemallim vearuh vaato sheorim unfalu beh udka kashya lach peshita poshea hu ayede dinsev resha kissahu karauy nesev sefa name lo kissahu

Ta shema nafal letocho shor cheresh shote vekatan some umhallech ballayela chayyav pikkeach umhallech bayyom patur veammay nema middehave poshea leinyan cheresh have name poshea leinyan pikkeach ella lav shema minah la amrinan miggo shema minah
Nafal lefanav ku amar rav lefanav lefanav mammash leacharav acharav mammash

a: Veze vaze bevor
Rav letameh deamar rav bor shechiyeva alav tora lehevlo velo lachavato
Ushmuel amar bevor ben millefanav ben milleacharav chayyav
Shemuel letameh deamar lehevlo vechol shekken lachavato ella hechi dame leacharav mikkol hakkeriyya defatur kegon denitkal babbor venafal laachore habbor chutz labbor
Etiveh bevor ben lefanav ben leacharav chayyav teuvta derav
Amar rav chisda mode rav bevor birshuto dechayyav mishshum deamar leh mimma nafshach i behavla mit havla didach hu i bechavta mit chavta didach hu
Rabba amar hacha bemay askinan bemithappech dinfal aappeh veithafich unfal aggabbeh dehavla deahani beh ahani beh
Rav yosef amar hacha benizke vor beshor askinan may nihu shehivish et memav dela shena lefanav vela shena leacharav michayyav
Tane rav chananya lesayyoe lerav venafal ad sheyyippol derech nefila mikkan amru nafal lefanav mikkol hakkeriyya chayyav leacharav mikkol hakkeriyya patur veze vaze bevor

Amar mar nafal lefanav mikkol hakkeriyya chayyav veammay nema kore geram leh amar rav shimi bar ashe ha manni rabbi natan hi deamar baal habbor hezzeka ka aved vechol hecha dela efshar leishtallome mehay mishtallem mehay
Detanya shor sheddachaf et chavero levor baal hashshor chayyav baal habbor patur rabbi natan omer baal hashshor meshallem mechetza uvaal habbor meshallem mechetza
Vehatanya rabbi natan omer baal habbor meshallem shelosha chalakim uvaal hashshor revia la kashya ha betam ha bemuad
Uvtam may kasavar i kasavar hay kulleh hezzeka avad vehay kulleh hezzeka avad hay meshallem palga vehay meshallem palga
Vei kasavar hay palga hezzeka avad vehay palga hezzeka avad baal habbor meshallem palga uvaal hashshor revia veidach riva mafsid

Amar rava rabbi natan dayyana hu venachet leumka dedina leolam kasavar hay kulleh hezzeka avad vehay kulleh hezzeka avad udka kashya lach leshallem hay palga vehay palga mishshum deamar leh baal hashshor levaal habbor shuttafutay may ahanya li

Ibaet ema leolam kasavar hay palga hezzeka avad vehay palga hezzeka avad udka kashya lach baal habbor meshallem palga uvaal hashshor meshallem revia veidach riva nafsed mishshum daamar leh baal hashshor levaal habbor ana toray beverach ashkechiteh atte ketalteh may deit li leishtallome mehayech mishtallamna may delet li leishtallome mehayech mishtallamna mimmach
Amar rava hinniach even al pi habbor uva shor venitkal bah venafal babbor banu lemachloket rabbi natan verabbanan peshita

Mahu detema hatam hu deamar baal habbor levaal hashshor i lav bera didi tora didach hava katel leh aval hacha matze amar leh baal even levaal habbor i lav bera didach avna didi may hava avda i hava mitkel bah hava nafel vekae ka mashma lan daamar leh i lav even la hava nafel levera
Itmar
b: Shor veshor pesule hammukdashin shennagchu may nihu shor bechor dela parek leh abbaye amar meshallem chatzi nezek ravina amar meshallem revia nezek
Ha veha betam ha kerabbanan veha kerabbi natan
Ibaet ema ha veha kerabbanan ha betam ha bemuad
Ika deamri abbaye amar chatzi nezek ravina amar kulleh nezek ha veha bemuad ha kerabbanan veha kerabbi natan
Ibaet ema ha veha kerabbi natan ha bemuad veha betam
Amar rava shor veadam sheddachafu levor leinyan nezakin kullan chayyavin leinyan arbaa devarim udme veladot adam chayyav veshor uvor patur
Leinyan kofer ushloshim shel eved shor chayyav adam uvor peturim leinyan kelim veshor pesule hammukdashin adam veshor chayyavin uvor patur
May tama amar kera vehammet yihye lo bemi shehammet shello yatza ze sheen hammet shello

Lememra difshita leh lerava veha mibaya bae leh lerava devae rava shor pesule hammukdashin shennafal labbor mahu hay vehammet yihye lo bemi shehammet shellov yatza ze sheen hammet shello o dilma vehammet yihye lo livalim mittappelin bannevela hu daata
Batar devayah hadar pashtah

Ella bealim mittappelin binvela mena leh nafka leh min vehammet yihye lo deshor may chazet divehammet yihye lo deshor mappekatte leh livalim mittappelin binvela vehammet yihye lo devor mappekatte leh lemi shehammet shello efoch ana
Mistabbera petur gabbe vor hoil ufatar bo et hakkelim adderabba petur gabbe shor shekken patar bo chatzi nezek kulleh nezek mihat la ashkechan
Nafal letocho shor vechelav venishtabberu ku matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda mechayyev al nizke chelim bevor
May tama derabbanan deamar kera venafal shamma shor o chamor shor velo adam chamor velo kelim verabbi yehuda o lerabbot et hakkelim verabbanan

a: O mibe leh lechallek verabbi yehuda lechallek mivvenafal nafka verabbanan venafal tuva mashma
Ema venafal kalal shor vachamor parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat shor vachamor in mide acharina la
Amri baal habbor yeshallem chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella cheen happerat ma happerat meforash baale chayyim af kol baale chayyim
I ma happerat meforash davar shennivlato metammea bemagga uvmassa af kol davar shennivlato metammea bemagga uvmassa aval ofot lo

Im ken nichtov rachamana chad perata he nichtov i ketav shor hava amena karev legabbe mizbeach in sheeno karev legabbe mizbeach la vei ketav rachamana chamor hava amena kadosh bivchora in sheen kadosh bivchora la
Ella amar kera vehammet yihye lo kol devar mita
Ben lerabbanan deka memaati lehu lechelim uven lerabbi yehuda deka merabbe lehu lechelim kelim bene mita ninhu amri sheviratan zo hi mitatan
Ulrav deamar bor shechiyeva alav tora lehevlo velo lachavato ben lerabbanan ben lerabbi yehuda kelim bene havla ninhu amri bechadte demipaki mehavla
Hay vehammet yihye lo mibbee leh lechidrava deamar rava shor pesule hammukdashin shennafal levor patur shenneemar vehammet yihye lo bemi shehammet shello yatza ze sheen hammet shello
Ella amar kera kesef yashiv livalav lerabbot kol deit leh bealim i hachi afilu kelim veadam name
Amar kera shor velo adam chamor velo kelim ulrabbi yehuda deka merabbe lehu lechelim bishlama shor memaet beh adam ella chamor may memaet beh
Ella amar rava chamor devor lerabbi yehuda vese daaveda ledivre hakkol kashya
Nafal letocho shor cheresh shote vekatan chayyav may shor cheresh shote vekatan ilema shor shel cheresh shor shel shote shor shel katan ha shor shel pikkeach patur
Amar rabbi yochanan shor shehu cheresh shor shehu shote shor shehu katan
b: Ha shor shehu pikkeach patur
Amar rabbi yirmeya la mibaya kaamar la mibbaya shor shehu pikkeach dechayyav aval shor cheresh shote vekatan ema chershuto garma lo katnuto garma lo veliptar ka mashma lan
Amar leh rav acha leravina vehatanya nafal letocho bar daat patur may lav shor bar daat amar leh la adam ella meatta adam ben daat hu defatur ha lav ben daat hu dechayyav shor velo adam ketiv
Ella may ben daat min ben daat amar leh vehatanya nafal letocho shor ben daat patur

Ella amar rava shor vehu cheresh shor vehu shote shor vehu katan daveka aval shor vehu pikkeach patur may tama devae leh ayyone umezal tanya name hachi nafal letocho shor cheresh shote vekatan vesome umhallech ballayela chayyav pikkeach umhallech baom patur
Matni echad shor veechad kol behema linfilat habbor ulhafrashat har sinay ultashlume chefel velahashavat aveda lifrika lachasima lakkilayim velashshabbat
Vechen chayya vaof kayyotze bahen im ken lamma neemar shor o chamor ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove
Gema linfilat habbor kesef yashiv livalav ketiv kol deit leh bealim kedaamaran lehafrashat har sinay im behema im ish lo yichye vechayya bichlal behema haveya im lerabbot et haofot
Letashlume chefel kidamrinan al kol devar pesha kalal kol devar peshia lahashavat aveda lechol avedat achicha lifrika yalef chamorchamor mishshabbat
Lachasima yalef shorshor mishshabbat
Lechilayim i kilayim dacharisha yalef shorshor mishshabbat
I kilayim deharbaa yalef behemtechabbehemtecha mishshabbat

Vegabbe shabbat menalan detanya rabbi yose omer mishshum rabbi yishmael bedibberot harishonot neemar avdecha vaamatcha uvhemtecha uvdibberot haacharonot neemar veshorcha vachamorcha vechol behemtecha vahalo shor vachamor bichlal kol behema hau velamma yatzu lomar lach ma shor vachamor haamur kan chayya vaof kayyotze bahen af kol chayya vaof kayyotze bahen
Ema behema dedibberot harishonot kalal shorcha vachamorcha dedibberot haacharonot parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat shor vachamor in mide acharina la
Amri vechol behemtecha dedibberot haacharonot chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash baale chayyim af kol baale chayyim
Veema ma happerat meforash davar shennivlato metammea bemagga uvmassa af kol davar shennevalato metammea bemagga uvmassa aval ofot lo

Amri im ken nichtov rachamana chad perata he nichtov rachamana i ketav rachamana shor hava amena karev legabbe mizbeach in sheeno karev legabbe mizbeach la ketav rachamana chamor vei ketav rachamana chamor hava amena kadosh bivchora in sheen kadosh bivchora la ketav rachamana shor
Ella vechol behemtecha ribuya hu
Vechol hecha dichtav rachamana kol ribuya hu veha gabbe maaser dichtiv kol veka darshinan leh bichlal ufrat
Detanya venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teave nafshecha kalal babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar parat uvchol asher tisholcha nafshecha chazar vechalal
Kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash peri mipperi vegidule karka af kol peri mipperi vegidule karka

Amri bechol kelala kol ribuya ibaet ema kol name kelala hu mihu hay kol dehacha ribuya hu middahava leh lemichtav uvhemtecha kedichtiv bedibberot harishonot uchtav vechol behemtecha shema minah ribuya
Hashta deamratte kol ribuya hu behemtecha dedibberot harishonot veshor vachamor dedibberot haacharonot lema li
Amri shor leagmore shorshor lachasima
Chamor leagmore chamorchamor lifrika
Behemtecha leagmore behemtechabbehemtecha lechilayim
I hachi afilu adam litsar allema tenan adam muttar im kullan lachrosh velimshoch
Amar rav pappa pappunae yadi tama deha milta umannu rav acha bar yaakov amar kera lemaan yanuach avdecha vaamatcha kamocha lehannacha hikkashtiv velo ledavar acher
Shaal rabbi chanina ben agel et rabbi chiyya bar abba mippene ma bedibberot harishonot lo neemar bahem tov uvdibberot haacharonot

a: Neemar bahem tov amar lo ad sheatta shoaleni lamma neemar bahem tov shealeni im neemar bahen tov im lav sheeni yodea im neemar bahen tov im lav kelach etzel rabbi tanchum bar chanilay shehaya ragil etzel rabbi yehoshua ben levi shehaya baki beaggada
Azal legabbeh amar leh mimmennu lo shamati ella kach amar li shemuel bar nachum achi immo shel rav acha berabbi chanina veamri lah avi immo shel rav achay berabbi chanina hoil vesofan lehishtabber
Vechi sofan lehishtabber may have amar rav ashe chas veshalom paska tova miyyisrael
Amar rabbi yehoshua haroe tet bachalomo siman yafe lo may tama ilema mishshum dichtiv tov ema vetetetiha bematate hashmed chad tet kaamrinan
Ema tumatah beshuleha tet bet kaamrinan ema tavu baaretz sheareha
Ella hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv letova techila shemmibbereshit ad vayyar elohim et haor la ketiv tet
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi haroe hesped bachalomo chasu alav min hashshamayim ufdauhu hane mile bichtava
Vechen chayya vaof kayyotze bahen vechu amar resh lakish kan shana rabbi tarnegol tauos ufasoni kilayim ze baze
Peshita amar rav chaviva mishshum deravu bahade hadade mahu detema min chad hu ka mashma lan

Amar shemuel auoz veauoz habbar kilayim ze baze matkef lah rava bar rav chanan may tama ilema mishshum dehay arich koeh vehay zutar koeh ella meatta gamla parsa vegamla tayyaa dehay allim koeh vehay kattin koeh hachi name dehau kilayim ze baze
Ella amar abbaye ze betzav mibbachutz veze betzav mibbifnim rav pappa amar ha teuna chada beata beshichla veha teuna kamma beata beshichla
Amar rabbi yirmeya amar resh lakish hammarbia shene minim shebbayyam loke may tama amar rav adda bar ahava mishshemeh deulla atya leminehulminehu miyyabbasha
Bae rachava hammanhig beiza veshibuta mahu mi amrinan kevan deiza la nachet bayyam veshibuta la salek layyabbasha lo kelum aved o dilma hashta mihat ka manheg
Matkef lah ravina ella meatta chiber chitta usora beyado vezara chitta baaretz usora bechutza laaretz hachi name demichayyav
Amri hachi hashta hatam eretz mekom chiyyuva chutza laaretz la mekom chiyyuva hacha ide veide chiyyuva hu
Hadaran alach shor shennagach et happara
b: Matni hakkones tzon laddir venaal befaneha karauy veyatza vehizzika patur lo naal befaneha karauy veyatza vehizzika chayyav
Nifretza ballayela o shepperatzuha listim veyatza vehizzika patur hotziuha listim listim chayyavin
Hinnicha bachamma o shemmesarah lecheresh shote vekatan veyatza vehizzika chayyav
Mesarah leroe nichnas haroe tachtav
Nafla legina venehenet meshallemet ma shennehenet yarda kedarkah vehizzika meshallemet ma shehizzika ketzad meshallemet ma shehizzika shamin bet sea beotah sade kamma hayeta yafa vechamma hi yafa
Rabbi shimon omer achla perot gemurim meshallemet perot gemurim im sea sea im satayim satayim
Gema tanu rabbanan ezehu karauy veezehu shello karauy delet sheyechola laamod beruach metzuya zehu karauy sheenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya zehu shello karauy

Amar rabbi mani bar pattish man tanna muad desaggi leh bishmira pechuta rabbi yehuda hi ditnan kesharo bealav bemosera venaal lefanav karauy veyatza vehizzik echad tam veechad muad chayyav divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda omer tam chayyav muad patur shenneemar velo yishmerennu bealav veshamur hu ze rabbi eliezer omer en lo shemira ella sakkin
Afilu tema rabbi meir shane shen varegel dehattora miata bishmiratan deamar rabbi elazar veamri lah bematnita tana arbaa devarim hattora miata bishmiratan veellu hen bor vaesh shen varegel
Bor dichtiv ki yiftach ish bor o ki yichre ish bor velo yechassennu ha kissahu patur
Esh dichtiv shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera ad deaved keen mavir
Shen dichtiv uvier bisde acher ad deaved keen uvier
Regel dichtiv veshillach ad deaved keen veshillach
Vetanya veshillach ze haregel vechen hu omer meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor uvier ze hashshen vechen hu omer kaasher yevaer haggalal ad tummo
Tama deaved keen veshillach uvier ha la aved la
Amar rabba matnitin name dayeka dekatane tzon mikkede beshor ka askinan veate nitne shor may shena dekatane tzon lav mishshum dehattora miata bishmiratan
Lav mishshum dechan keren la ketiva bah shen varegel hu dichtiv beh veka mashma lan deshen varegel demuadin hu shema minah

Tanya amar rabbi yehoshua arbaa devarim haose otan patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim veellu hen happoretz gader bifne behemat chavero vehakkofef kamato shel chavero bifne haddeleka vehassocher ede sheker lehaid vehayyodea edut lachavero veeno meid lo
Amar mar happoretz gader bifne behemat chavero hechi dame ilema bechotel bari bedine adam name nichayyav ella

a: Bechotel raua
Amar mar hakkofef kamato shel chavero bifne haddeleka hechi dame ilema dematya leh beruach metzuya bedine adam name nichayyav ella dematya beruach sheenah metzuya
Verav ashe amar tamun ittemar mishshum deshavveyah tamun baesh
Amar mar hassocher ede sheker hechi dame ilema lenafsheh mamona bae shallome uvdine adam name nichayyav ella lechavreh
Vehayyodea edut lachavero veeno meid lo bemay askinan ilema beve tere peshita deorayeta hu im lo yaggid venasa aono
Ella bechad
Vetu leka vehaika siman haose besam ushliach chavero nishbar haose melacha beme chattat uvfarat chattat patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim
Vehaika hannoten sam hammavet bifne behemat chavero patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim
Vehaika hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh shote vekatan patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim
Vehaika hammavit et chavero patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim
Vehaika nishbera kaddo birshut harabbim velo silkah nafla gemallo velo heemidah rabbi meir mechayyev behezzekan vachachamim omrim patur bedine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim
In miha ika tuva vehane itztericha leh mahu detema bedine shamayim name la lichayyav ka mashma lan
Happoretz gader bifne behemat chavero mahu detema kevan dilmistereh kae ma aved bedine shamayim name la lichayyav ka mashma lan
Hakkofef kamato shel chavero name mahu detema lema mi hava yadana deatya ruach sheenah metzuya uvdine shamayim name la lichayyav ka mashma lan
Ulrav ashe deamar name tamun itmar mahu detema ana kassoye kassiteh nihalach uvdine shamayim name la lichayyav ka mashma lan
Vehassocher ede sheker name mahu detema lema divre harav vedivre hattalmid divre mi shomin uvdine shamayim name la lichayyav ka mashma lan
Vehayyodea edut lachavero veeno meid lo name mahu detema mi yemar dechi hava atena mashedna leh hava mode dilma hava mishteva leshikra uvdine shamayim name la lichayyav ka mashma lan
Nifretza ballayela o shepperatzuha listim ku amar rabba vehu shechatra
Aval lo chatra may chayyav hechi dame ilema bechotel bari ki lo chatra ammay chayyav may hava leh lemebad ella bechotel raua ki chatra ammay patur techillato bifshia vesofo beones hu
Hanicha leman deamar techilato bifshia vesofo beones patur ella leman deamar techilato bifshia vesofo beones chayyav may ika lememar
Ella matnitin bechotel bari vaafilu lo chatra vechi itmar derabba assefa itmar hannicha bachamma o shemmesarah lecheresh shote vekatan veyatzta vehizzika chayyav amar rabba vaafilu chatra
La mibbaya hecha dela chatra dechullah bifshia hu ella afilu chatra name mahu detema haveya lah techilato bifshia vesofo beones ka mashma lan dechullah peshia hi
May tama daamar leh mida yadatte dechevan dishvaktah bechamma kol tatzdeka deit lah lemibad avda venafka
Hotziuha listim listim chayyavin
b: Peshita kevan deappekuha kayema lah birshutayehu lechol mile
La tzericha dekamu lah beappah ki ha deamar rabba amar rav matna amar rav hammaamid behemat chavero al kamat chavero chayyav maamid peshita la tzericha dekam lah beappah
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef hikkishah amarte lan velistim name dehikkishuha

Mesarah leroe nichnas haroe ku amri tachtav deman ilema tachtav devaal behema tenena chada zimna mesaro leshomer chinnam ulshoel lenose sachar ulsocher kullan nichnesu tachat habbealim ella tachtav deshomer
Veshomer kamma ippetar leh ligmare lema tehve teuvta derava deamar rava shomer shemmasar leshomer chayyav
Amar lach rava may mesaro leroe levarzileh deorcheh deroe lemimsar levarzileh
Ika deamri middekatane mesarah leroe vela katane mesarah leacher shema minah may mesarah leroe mesar roe levarzileh deorcheh deroe lemimsar levarzile aval leacher la
Lema mesayya leh lerava deamar rava shomer shemmasar leshomer chayyav amri la dilma orcha demilta katane vehu haddin leacher
Itmar shomer aveda rabba amar keshomer chinnam dame rav yosef amar keshomer sachar dame
Rabba amar keshomer chinnam dame may hanaa ka mate leh rav yosef amar keshomer sachar dame behahi hanaa dela baaya lemitavoy leh rifta leanya have keshomer sachar
Ika dimfarshi hachi rav yosef amar keshomer sachar dame kevan derachamana shabedeh beal kurcheh hilkach keshomer sachar dame
Siman hechzirah leolam hashev chiyya amarta nishbar sachar
Etiveh rav yosef lerabba

a: Hechzirah limkom sheyyirenna eno chayyav littappel bah nigneva o avda chayyav beachrautah
May nigneva o avda lav nigneva mibbeto veavda mibbeto
La mimmekom shehechzirah
Veha katane eno chayyav litappel bah
Amar leh hacha bemay askinan kegon shehechzirah batztzohorayim

Vetarte katane vehachi katane hechzirah shacharit limkom sheyyirenna ushchiach deayel venafek vechaze lah eno chayyav litappel bah hechzirah batztzohorayim limkom sheyyirenna dela shechiach deayel venafek dela chaze lah venigneva o avda chayyav beachrautah
Etiveh leolam hu chayyav ad sheyyachzirenna lirshuto may leolam lav afilu mibbeto shema minah keshomer sachar dame
Amar leh modena lach bevaale chayyim dechevan denakti lehu nigre barayata bae netiruta yattirta
Etiveh rabba lerav yosef hashev en li ella beveto leginato ulchurbato minnayin talmud lomar teshivem mikkol makom

May leginato ulchurbato ilema leginato hammishtammeret ulchurbato hammishtammeret hayenu beto ella peshita leginato sheenah mishtammeret ulchurbato sheenah mishtammeret shema minah keshomer chinnam dame
Amar leh leolam leginato hammishtammeret ulchurbato hammishtammeret udka kashya lach hayenu beto ha ka mashma lan dela baenan daat bealim kidrabbi elazar
Deamar rabbi elazar hakkol tzerichin daat bealim chutz mehashavat aveda shehare ribta bo tora hashavot harbe

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef veatte la tisbera deshomer aveda keshomer chinnam dame veha amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hattoen taanat gannav baaveda meshallem tashlume chefel vei salka datach shomer sachar have ammay meshallem tashlume chefel karna bae shallome
Amar leh hacha bemay askinan kegon shettoen taanat listim mezuyyan
Amar leh listim mezuyyan gazlan hu
Amar leh sheani omer listim mezuyyan kevan demitammar meinashe gannav hu
Etiveh
b: Lo im amarta beshomer chinnam shekken meshallem tashlume chefel tomar beshomer sachar sheeno meshallem tashlume chefel
Vei salka datach listim mezuyyan gannav hu nimtza beshomer sachar meshallem tashlume chefel betoen taanat listim mezuyyan
Amar leh hachi kaamar lo im amarta beshomer chinnam shekken meshallem tashlume chefel bechol taanotav tomar beshomer sachar sheeno meshallem tashlume chefel ella betoen taanat listim mezuyyan

Etiveh venishbar o met en li ella shevura umeta geneva vaaveda minnayin amarta kal vachomer uma shomer sachar sheppatar bo shevura umeta chayyav bigneva vaaveda shoel shechayyav bishvura umeta eno din shechayyav bigneva vaaveda vezehu kal vechomer sheen alav teshuva
Vei salka datach listim mezuyyan gannav hu ammay en alav teshuva ika lemifrach ma leshomer sachar shekken meshallem tashlume chefel betoen taanat listim mezuyyan
Amar leh kasavar hay tanna karna belo shevua adifa mikkefela bishvua
Lema mesayya leh hassocher para mechavero venigneva veamar halla hareni meshallem veeni nishba veachar kach nimtza haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel lassocher
Savruha kerabbi yehuda deamar socher kenose sachar dame umiddekatane veamar hareni meshallem veeni nishba mikkelal dei bae patar leh nafsheh bishvua
Hechi dame kegon deka taen taanat listim mezuyyan vekatane veachar kach nimtza haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel lassocher shema minah listim mezuyyan gannav hu
Amri mi savratte kerabbi yehuda deamar socher kenose sachar dame dilma kerabbi meir sevira leh deamar socher keshomer chinnam dame
Ibaet ema kidmachlef rabba bar avuh vetane socher ketzad meshallem rabbi meir omer keshomer sachar rabbi yehuda omer keshomer chinnam
Rabbi zera amar hacha bemay askinan betoen taanat listim mezuyyan venimtza listim sheeno mezuyyan
Nafla legina venehenet meshallemet ma shennehenet amar rav benechbeta
Aval achla afilu ma shennehenet enah meshallemet lema rav letameh daamar rav haya lah shello tochal
Amri hachi hashta emor deamar rav hatam haya lah shello tochal hecha deitazka hi dematze amar leh mareh defere la meshallamna haya lah shello tochal leazzoke hi acharine diftira leshallome mi amar
Ella

a: La mibbaya kaamar la mibbaya achla dimshallemet ma shennehenet aval nechbeta ema mavriach ari minnichse chavero hu uma shennehenet name la meshallem ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name
Mavriach ari minnichse chavero middato hu hay lav middato i name mavriach ari minnichse chavero let leh peseda hay it leh peseda
Hechi nafal rav kahana amar shehuchleka bememe ragleha rava amar sheddechafatta chavertah

Man deamar sheddechafatta chavertah kol shekken shehuchleka bememe ragleha uman deamar shehuchleka bememe ragleha aval dechafatta chavertah pasha umshallemet ma shehizzika daamar leh ibi lach abbore chada chada
Amar rav kahana lo shanu ella beotah aruga aval mearuga laaruga meshallemet ma shehizzika verabbi yochanan amar afilu mearuga laaruga vaafilu kol hayyom kullo ad shettetze vetachazor ledaat
Amar rav pappa la tema ad shettetze ledaat vetachazor ledaat ella kevan sheyyatzta ledaat af al pi shechazra shello ledaat may tama daamar leh kevan deyalfa kol emat demishtamta lehatam rahata
Yarda kedarkah vehizzika meshallemet ma shehizzika bae rabbi yirmeya yarda kedarkah vehizzika beme leda mahu
Alliba deman deamar techillato bifshia vesofo beones chayyav la tibe lach ki tibe lach alliba deman deamar techillato bifshia vesofo beones patur may
Mi amrinan kevan ditchillato bifshia vesofo beones patur o dilma hacha kullah bifshia hu dechevan deka chaze dikriva lah lemelad ibi leh lenatorah
b: Ulistammore begavah teku
Ketzad meshallemet ma shehizzika vechu mena hane mile
Amar rav matna deamar kera uvier bisde acher melammed sheshshamin al gav sade acher
Hay uvier bisde acher mibbee leh leappoke reshut harabbim
Im ken lichtov rachamana uvier bisde chavero i name sede acher may bisde acher sheshshamin al gav sade acher
Veema kulleh lehachi hu daata leappoke reshut harabbim menalan
Im ken lichteveh rachamana gabbe tashlumin metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem bisde acher lema li dechatveh rachamana gabbe uvier shema minah tarte
Hechi shayeminan amar rabbi yose bar chanina sea beshishshim sein rabbi yannay amar tarkav beshishshim tarkabbim chizkiyya amar kelach beshishshim kelachim
Metivi achla kav o kabbayim en omrim teshallem demehen ella roin otah keilu hi aruga ketanna umshaarim otah may lav bifne atzmah
La beshishshim
Tanu rabbanan en shamin kav mippene shemmashbicho velo bet kor mippene sheppogmo
May kaamar amar rav pappa hachi kaamar en shamin kav beshishshim kabbim mippene shemmashbiach mazzik velo kor beshishshim korin mippene sheppogem mazzik
Matkef lah rav huna bar manoach hay velo bet kor velo kor mibbee leh
Ella amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika hachi katane en shamin kav bifne atzmo mippene shemmashbiach nizak velo kav bevet kor mippene sheppogem nizak ella beshishshim

Hahu gavra dekatz kashba mechavreh ata lekammeh deresh galuta amar leh ledidi chaze li utlata talata bekina hao kayemi vahao shau mea zuze zil hav leh telatin utlata vetilta amar gabbe resh galuta dedaen dina defarsaa lema li ata lekammeh derav nachman amar leh beshishshim
Amar leh rava im amru benizke mamono yomru benizke gufo
Amar leh abbaye lerava benizke gufo may datach detanya hammavkir karmo shel chavero semadar roin oto kamma haya yafe kodem lachen vechamma hu yafe leachar mikkan veilu beshishshim la katane

Attu gabbe vehemto name mi la tanya ki hay gavena detanya katma netia rabbi yose omer gozre gezerot shebbirushalayim omrim netia bat shenatah shette kesef bat shette shanim arbaa kesef achla chaziz rabbi yose haggelili omer nidon bamshuyyar shebbo vachachamim omrim roin otah kamma hayeta yafa vechamma hi yafa

a: Achla semadar rabbi yehoshua omer roin otan keilu hen anavim omdot libatzer vachachamim omrim roin kamma hayeta yafa vechamma hi yafa rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon bamme devarim amurim bizman sheachla lulve gefanim veyichure teenim aval achla paggim o voser roin otan keilu anavim omdot libatzer
Katane mihat vachachamim omrim roin otan kamma hayeta yafa vechamma hi yafa vela katane beshishshim
Ella may it lach lememar beshishshim hacha name beshishshim
Amar abbaye rabbi yose haggelili verabbi yishmael amru davar echad
Rabbi yose haggelili ha daamaran

Rabbi yishmael detanya metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem metav sadehu shel nizak umetav karmo shel nizak divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer lo ba hakkatuv ella ligbot lannizakin min haidit vekal vachomer lahekdesh
Vela tema kerav idi bar avin deamar rav idi bar avin kegon sheachla aruga ben haarugot vela yadinan i kechusha havay i shemena havay deamar kum shallem shemena bemetav deika hashta dehachi la amrinan
May tama hammotzi mechavero alav haraya ella bemetav dilkammeh umay nihu ki hayech desalek

Amar mar rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon bamme devarim amurim sheachla lulve gefanim veyichure teenim ha semadar roin otan keilu anavim omdot libatzer ema sefa achla paggim o voser hu deroin otan keilu anavim omdot libatzer ha semadar roin otan kamma hi yafa vechamma hayeta yafa
Amar ravina keroch utni bamme devarim amurim bizman sheachla lulve gefanim veyichure teenim aval achla semadar paggin o voser roin otan keilu anavim omdot libatzer
I hachi rabbi shimon ben yehuda hayenu rabbi yehoshua
Ika benayehu kechash gufna vela mesayemi

Abbaye amar mesayemi umsayemi man tanna dechayesh lichchash gufna rabbi shimon ben yehuda hi detanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben menasya ones eno meshallem et hatztzaar mippene shessofah lehitztaer tachat balah amru lo eno dome nivelet beratzon lenivelet beones
Amar abbaye hane tannae verabbi shimon ben yehuda amru davar echad rabbi shimon ben yehuda ha daamaran hane tannae may hi
Detanya rabbi yose omer neche chayya ben azzay omer neche mezonot
Man deamar neche chayya kol shekken neche mezonot uman deamar neche mezonot aval neche chayya la deamar leh itteta didi pekicha hi vela mibbaya chayya
Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua avud ovada keoteh derav nachman beshishshim
Lishana acharina rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua shamu dikla aggav kattina deara
Vehilcheta keoteh derav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua bedikla daarammaa vehilcheta keoteh deresh galuta bedikla farsaa
Eliezer zeera
b: Hava sayem mesane ukkame vekae beshuka dinhardea ashkechuh deve resh galuta vaamaru leh may shena hane mesane amar lehu deka miavilna ayerushalayim amaru leh atte chashivatte leitavole ayerushalayim sevur yuhara hava atuh vechavshuh
Amar lehu gavra rabba ana amaru leh mena yadinan amar lehu o attun beo minay milta o ana ive minayechu milta amaru leh bei atte
Amar lehu hay man dekatz kufra may meshallem amaru leh meshallem deme chufra veha hao tamre amaru leh meshallem deme tamre amar lehu veha lav tamre shekal mineh
Amaru leh ema lan atte amar lehu beshishshim amaru leh man amar keotach amar lehu ha shemuel chay uvet dino kayyam shaddaru kammeh dishmuel amar lehu shappir kaamar lechu beshishshim veshavkuhv

Rabbi shimon omer achla perot gemurim ku may tama ha deamar rachamana uvier bisde acher melammed sheshshamin al gav hassade hane mile mide ditzrich lesade hane kevan dela tzerichi lesade beenayehu bae shallome
Amar rav huna bar chiyya amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba dan rav kerabbi meir ufsak hilcheta kerabbi shimon

Dan rav kerabbi meir detanya katav larishon velo chatma lo lashsheni vechatma lo ibbeda ketubbatah divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer yechola hi shettomar nachat ruach asiti levali attem ma lachem alay
Ufsak hilcheta kerabbi shimon ki ha ditnan rabbi shimon omer achla perot gemurin meshallemet perot gemurin im sea sea im satayim satayim
Matni hammagdish betoch sede chavero shello birshut vaachalatan behemto shel baal hassade patur veim huzzeka bahen baal haggadish chayyav veim higdish birshut baal hassade chayyav
Gema lema tenan dela kerabbi dei kerabbi haamar ad sheyekabbel alav baal habbayit lishmor amar rav pappa hacha benatar be dare askinan dechevan daamar leh ayyel ugdosh ayyel veentar lach hu
Matni hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh shote vekatan patur bedine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim shillach beyad pikkeach happikkeach chayyav
Echad hevi et haur veechad hevi et haetzim hammevi et haetzim chayyav echad hevi et haetzim veechad hevi et haur hammevi et haur chayyav
Ba acher veliba hamlabbe chayyav libta haruach kullan peturin
Gema amar resh lakish mishshemeh dechizkiyya lo shanu ella shemmasar lo gachelet velibah aval masar lo shalhevet chayyav may tama maasav ka garmu lo
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu masar lo shalhevet patur may tama tzevata decheresh garma lo vela michayyav ad sheyyimsor lo geoza

a: Silta sheraga dehahu vadday maase dideh garmu
Shillach beyad pikkeach happikkeach chayyav vechu amar rav nachman bar yitzchak man detane liba la mishtabbash uman detane niba la mishtabbash
Man detane liba la mishtabbash dichtiv belabbat esh uman detane niba la mishtabbash dichtiv bore niv sefatayim
Libbeta haruach kullan peturin tanu rabbanan liba velibbeta haruach im yesh belibbuo kede lelabbotah chayyav veim lav patur
Ammay leheve kezore veruach mesayyato

Amar abbaye hacha bemay askinan kegon shelliba mitztzad echad velibbattu haruach mitztzad acher rava amar kegon shelliba beruach metzuya velibbattu haruach beruach sheenah metzuya rabbi zera amar kegon detzammerah tzammore
Rav ashe amar ki amrinan zore veruach mesayyato hane mile leinyan shabbat dimlechet machshevet asra tora aval hacha gerama bealma hu ugrama binzakin patur
Matni hashsholeach et habbeera veachla etzim o avanim o afar chayyav shenneemar ki tetze esh umatza kotzim veneechal gadish o hakkama o hassade shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera
Gema amar rava lema li dichtav rachamana kotzim gadish kama vesade

Tzerichi dei ketav rachamana kotzim hava amena kotzim hu dechayyav rachamana mishshum dishchiach esh gabbayehu ushchiach defasha aval gadish dela shechiach esh gabbayehu vela shechiach defasha ema la vei ketav rachamana gadish hava amena gadish chayyav rachamana mishshum dehefsed merubbe hu aval kotzim dehefsed muat ema la
Kama lema li ma kama begaluy af kol begaluy
Ulrabbi yehuda dimchayyev annizke tamun baesh kama lema li lerabbot kol baale koma verabbanan lerabbot kol baale koma mena lehu nafka lehu meo hakkama
Verabbi yehuda o mibe leh lechallek verabbanan lechallek mena lehu nafka lehu meo hassade
Verabbi yehuda ayede dichtav rachamana o hakkama ketav o hassade
Sade lema li leetoye lichacha niro vesichsecha avanav velichtov rachamana sade vela bae hanach tzericha dei ketav rachamana sade hava amena ma shebbassade in mide acharina la ka mashma lan

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan en puranut baa laolam ella bizman sheharshaim baolam veenah matchelet ella min hatztzaddikim techilla shenneemar ki tetze esh umatza kotzim ematay esh yotza bizman shekkotzim metzuyin lah veenah matchelet ella min hatztzaddikim techilla shenneemar veneechal gadish veachal gadish lo neemar ella veneechal gadish shenneechal gadish kevar

Tane rav yosef may dichtiv veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker kevan shennitan reshut lammashchit eno mavchin ben tzaddikim lirshaim velo od ella shemmatchil min hatztzaddikim techilla shenneemar vehichratti mimmech tzaddik verasha
Bache rav yosef kulle hay name leayin domin amar leh abbaye tevuta hu legabbayehu dichtiv ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik
Amar rav yehuda amar rav
b: Leolam yikkanes adam bechi tov veyetze bechi tov shenneemar veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker

Tanu rabbanan dever bair kannes raglecha shenneemar veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker veomer lech ammi bo vachadarecha usgor delatcha baadecha veomer michutz teshakkel cherev umechadarim ema
May veomer vechi tema hane mile belelya aval bimama la ta shema lech ammi bo vachadarecha usgor delatcha

Vechi tema hane mile hecha deleka ema miggavay aval hecha deika ema miggavay ki nafek yatev bene inashe betzaveta bealma tefe mealle ta shema michutz teshakkel cherev umechadarim ema af al gav demechadarim ema michutz teshakkel cherev
Rava beidan ritcha hava sachar kave dichtiv ki ala mavet bechallonenu
Tanu rabbanan raav bair pazzer raglecha shenneemar vayehi raav baaretz vayyered avram mitzrayema lagur vayyagor sham veomer im amarnu navo hair veharaav bair vamatnu sham
May veomer vechi tema hane mile hecha deleka sefek nefashot aval hecha deika sefek nefashot la ta shema lechu venippela el machane aram im yechayyunu nichye
