Tanu rabbanan dever bair al yehallech adam beemtza hadderech mippene shemmalach hammavet mehallech beemtza hadderachim dechevan dihiva leh reshuta mesagge lehedya shalom bair al yehallech betzidde derachim dechevan delet leh reshuta michabbe chabboye umsagge
Tanu rabbanan dever bair al yikkanes adam yachid levet hakkeneset shemmalach hammavet mafkid sham kelav vehane mile hecha dela karu beh dardeke vela metzallu beh asara
Tanu rabbanan kelavim bochim malach hammavet ba lair kelavim mesachakim eliyyahu hannavi ba lair vehane mile delet behu nekeva

Yatev rav amme verav assi kammeh derabbi yitzchak nappacha mar amar leh lema mar shemateta umar amar leh lema mar aggadta patach lememar aggadta vela shavek mar patach lememar shematata vela shavek mar
Amar lahem emshol lachem mashal lema haddavar dome leadam sheyyesh lo shette nashim achat yalda veachat zekena yalda melakketet lo levanot zekena melakketet lo shechorot nimtza kereach mikkan umikkan

Amar lahen i hachi ema lechu milleta deshaveya letarvayechu ki tetze esh umatza kotzim tetze meatzmah shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera amar hakkadosh baruch hu alay leshallem et habbeera shehivarti
Ani hitztzati esh betziyyon shenneemar vayyatztzet esh betziyyon vattochal yesodoteha vaani atid livnotah baesh shenneemar vaani ehye lah chomat esh saviv ulchavod ehye vetochah
Shemateta patach hakkatuv benizke mamono vesiyyem benizke gufo lomar lach ishsho mishshum chitztzav
Vayyitave david vayyomar mi yashkeni mayim mibbor bet lechem asher bashshaar vayyivkeu sheloshet haggibborim bemachane felishtim vayyishavu mayim mibbor bet lechem asher bashshaar vego
May ka mibaya leh amar rava amar rav nachman tamun baesh kamibaya leh i kerabbi yehuda i kerabbanan ufshatu leh may difshatu leh
Rav huna amar gedishim disorim deyisrael hao dahao mittammeri pelishtim behu veka mibaya leh mahu lehatztzil atzmo bemamon chavero
Shelachu leh asur lehatztzil atzmo bemamon chavero aval atta melech atta umelech poretz laasot lo derech veen mochin beyado

Verabbanan veitema rabba bar mari amru gedishim disorin deyisrael hao ugdishin daadashim diflishtim veka mibaya lehu mahu litol gedishin shel seorin deyisrael liten lifne behemto al menat leshallem gedishin shel adashim diflishtim
Shelachu leh chavol yashiv rasha gezela yeshallem af al pi sheggezela meshallem rasha hu aval atta melech atta umelech poretz laasot lo derech veen mochin beyado
Bishlama leman deamar leachlofe hayenu dichtiv chad kera vattehi sham chelkat hassade melea adashim uchtiv chad kera vattehi chelkat hassade melea seorim
Ella leman deamar lemikle may ibaya lehu lehane tere kerae amar lach dahao name gedishim daadashim deyisrael dahao mitammeru behu pelishtim
Bishlama leman deamar lemikle hayenu dichtiv vayyityatztzev betoch hachelka vayyatztzileha ella leman deamar leachlofe may vayyatztzileha
Dela shevak lehu leachlofe
Bishlama hane tarte hayenu dichtiv tere kerae

a: Ella leman deamar tamun baesh kamibaya leh may ibi leh kerae amar lach tamun vachada mehanach kamibaya leh

Bishlama leman deamar hane tarte hayenu dichtiv velo ava david lishtotam amar kevan deika isura la nicha li ella leman deamar tamun baesh ka mibbaya leh mikkedi gemara hu dishlachu leh may lo ava david lishtotam
Dela amrinhu mishshemayehu amar kach mekubbelani mibbet dino shel shemuel haramati kol hammoser atzmo lamut al divre tora en omrim devar halacha mishshemo
Vayyassech otam la bishlama leman deamar hane tarte mishshum daavad leshem shamayim ella leman deamar tamun baesh may vayyassech otam la deamrinhu mishshema digmara
Matni avra gader shehu gavoha arba ammot o derech harabbim o nahar patur
Gema vehatanya avra gader shehu gavoha arba ammot chayyav

Amar rav pappa tanna didan ka chashev millemala lematta shesh ammot patur chamesh ammot patur ad arba ammot patur tanna bara millematta lemala ka chashev shette ammot chayyav shalosh ammot chayyav ad arba ammot chayyav
Amar rava arba ammot sheamru defatur afilu bisde kotzim amar rav pappa umissefat kotzim ulmala arba ammot
Amar rav lo shanu ella bekolachat aval benichpefet afilu ad mea amma chayyav ushmuel amar matnitin benichpefet aval bekolachat afilu kol shehu patur
Tanya keoteh derav bamme devarim amurim bekolachat aval benichpefet veetzim metzuyin lah afilu ad mea mil chayyav avra nahar o shelulit shehem rechavim shemone ammot patur
Derech harabbim man tanna amar rava rabbi eliezer hi ditnan rabbi eliezer omer shesh esre ammot kederech reshut harabbim patur
O nahar rav amar nahar mammash ushmuel amar arita dedallae
Man deamar nehar mammash af al gav deleka mayya uman deamar arita dedallae i it beh mayya in aval let beh mayya la
Tenan hatam veellu mafsikin lappea hannachal vehashshelulit vederech hayyachid vederech harabbim
May shelulit amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mekom shemme geshamim shollin sham rav bivi amar rabbi yochanan ammat hammayim shemmechalleket shalal laagappeha
Man deamar mekom shemme geshamim shollin sham kol shekken ammat hammayim uman deamar ammat hammayim aval mekom shemme geshamim shollin sham la mafseki dehanhu
b: Bagane deara mikkeru

Matni hammadlik betoch shello ad kamma taavor haddeleka rabbi elazar ben azarya omer roin oto keilu hu beemtza bet kor rabbi eliezer omer shesh esre ammot kederech reshut harabbim rabbi akiva omer chamishshim amma rabbi shimon omer shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera hakkol lefi haddeleka
Gema velet leh lerabbi shimon shiura bidleka

Vehatnan lo yaamid adam tannur betoch habbayit ella im ken yesh al gabbo govah dearba ammot haya maamido baaliyya ad sheyehe tachtav maaziva shelosha tefachim uvakkira tefach veim hizzik meshallem ma shehizzik
Rabbi shimon omer lo neemru shiurin hallalu ella sheim hizzik patur milleshallem
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh hakkol lefi govah haddeleka
Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi shimon vechen amar rav nachman amar shemuel halacha kerabbi shimon
Matni hammadlik et haggadish vehau bo kelim vedalku rabbi yehuda omer meshallem ma shebbetocho vachachamim omrim eno meshallem ella gadish shel chittin o shel seorin
Haya gedi kafut lo veeved samuch lo venisraf immo chayyav eved kafut lo ugdi samuch lo venisraf immo patur
Umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bemadlik et habbira shehu meshallem kol ma shebbetochah shekken derech bene adam lehanniach babbattim

Gema amar rav kahana machaloket bemadlik betoch shello vehalcha veachla betoch shel chavero derabbi yehuda mechayyav annizke tamun baesh verabbanan patri aval bemadlik betoch shel chavero divre hakkol meshallem kol ma shebbetocho

Amar leh rava i hachi addetane sefa modim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bemadlik et habbira shemmeshallem kol ma shebbetochah shekken derech bene adam lehanniach babbattim liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim bemadlik betoch shello vehalcha veachla betoch shel chavero aval madlik betoch shel chavero divre hakkol meshallem kol ma shehaya betocho

Ella amar rava betarte peligi peligi bemadlik betoch shello vehalcha veachla betoch shel chavero derabbi yehuda mechayyav attamun baesh verabbanan savri la michayyav ufligi name bemadlik beshel chavero derabbi yehuda savar meshallem kol ma shebbetocho vaafilu arneki verabbanan savri kelim sheddarkan lehatmin begadish kegon morigin uchle bakar hu dimshallem kelim sheen darkan lehatmin begadish la meshallem

Tanu rabbanan hammadlik et haggadish vehau bo kelim vedalku rabbi yehuda omer meshallem kol ma shehaya betocho vachachamim omrim eno meshallem ella gadish shel chittin o gadish shel seorin veroin mekom kelim keilu hu male tevua

a: Bamme devarim amurim bemadlik betoch shello vehalcha vedalka betoch shel chavero aval madlik betoch shel chavero divre hakkol meshallem kol ma shehaya betocho

Umode rabbi yehuda lachachamim bemashil makom lachavero lehagdish gadish vehigdish vehitmin sheen meshallem ella deme gadish bilvad lehagdish chittin vehigdish seorin seorin vehigdish chittin chittin vechipan bisorin seorin vechipan bechittim sheeno meshallem ella deme seorin bilvad

Amar rava hannoten dinar zahav leishsha veamar lah hizzahari bo shel kesef hu hizzikattu meshallemet dinar zahav mishshum deamar lah may hava lich gabbeh deazzakteh pasha bo meshallemet shel kesef deamra leh netiruta dechaspa kabbeli alay netiruta dedahava la kabbeli alay

Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe attun bidrava matnitu lah anan mimmatnita peshita lan chittin vechipan bisorin seorin vechipan bechittin eno meshallem ella deme seorin bilvad alma amar leh netiruta disare kabbeli alay hacha name amara leh netiruta dedahava la kabbeli alay
Amar rav shemait milta lerabbi yehuda vela yadana may hi amar shemuel vela yada abba may shemia leh lerabbi yehuda dimchayyev al nizke tamun baesh asu takkanat nigzal beishsho
Bae ammemar asu takkanat nigzal bemasor o la alliba deman deamar la dayeninan dina digrame la tibbee lach demasorot name la dayeninan
Ella ki tibbee lach alliba deman deamar dayeninan dina digrame asu takkanat nigzal bemasor demishteva veshakel o la teku
Hahu gavra divtash bechaspeta dechavreh shadyah benahara ata mareh veamar hachi vehachi hava li begavah yatev rav ashe veka meayyen beh ki hay gavena may

Amar leh ravina lerav acha bereh derava veamri lah rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe lav hayenu matnitin ditnan umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bemadlik et habbira shemmeshallem kol ma shebbetocho shekken derech bene adam lehanniach babbattim
Amar leh i deka taen zuze hacha name hacha bemay askinan deka taen marganita may mi mannechi inashe marganita bechaspeta o la teku

Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe taen kasa dechaspa bevira may amar leh chazena chazenan i inish amid hu deit leh kasa dechaspa i name inish mehemna hu demafkedi inashe gabbeh mishteva veshakel vei la lav kol kemineh
Amar leh rav adda bereh derav aveya lerav ashe ma ben gazlan lechamsan amar leh chamsan yahev deme gazlan la yahev deme
Amar leh i yahev deme chamsan karet leh vehaamar rav huna teluh vezabben zevineh zevine la kashya ha deamar rotze ani ha dela amar rotze ani
b: Matni getz sheyyatza mittachat happattish vehizzik chayyav

Gamal shehaya taun pishtan veavar birshut harabbim venichnesa pishtano letoch hachanut vedalka benero shel chenvani vehidlik et habbira baal gamal chayyav hinniach chenvani nero mibbachutz hachenvani chayyav rabbi yehuda omer bener chanukka patur

Gema amar ravina mishshemeh derava shema minah midderabbi yehuda ner chanukka mitzva lehannichah betoch asara dei salka datach lemala measara ammay amar rabbi yehuda ner chanukka patur lema leh hava leh leannochah lemala miggamal verochvo ella lav shema minah mitzva lehannichah betoch asara
Amri la leolam ema lach afilu lemala measara may amratte ibbei lach leannochah lemala miggamal verochvo kevan divmitzva ka asek kulle hay la atrechuh rabbanan
Amar rav kahana daresh rav natan bar minome mishshemeh derabbi tanchum ner chanukka shehinnichah lemala meesrim amma pesula kesukka uchmavoy
Hadaran alach hakkones

Matni merubba middat tashlume chefel mimmiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha shemmiddat tashlume chefel noheget ben bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim uven bedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim umiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha enah noheget ella beshor vase bilvad shenneemar ki yignov ish shor o se utvacho o mecharo vego
En haggonev achar haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel velo hattoveach velo hammocher achar haggannav meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Gema veilu middat tashlume chefel noheget ben begannav ben betoen taanat gannav umiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha enah noheget ella begannav bilvad la katane
Mesayya leh lerabbi chiyya bar abba deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon meshallem tashlume chefel tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha

Ika deamri lema mesayya leh lerabbi chiyya bar abba deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon meshallem tashlume chefel tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Mi katane en ben merubba katane tena veshayyar
Shemmiddat tashlume chefel noheget ku mena hane mile detanu rabbanan al kol devar pesha kalal al shor al chamor al se veal salma parat al kol aveda chazar vechalal
Kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon
Yatzu karkaot sheenan mittaltelin yatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot yatzu shetarot sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin en gufan mamon yatza hekdesh reehu ketiv
I ma happerat meforash davar shennivlato metammea bemagga uvmassa af kol davar shennivlato metammea bemagga uvmassa aval ofot la
Umi matzet amratte hachi veha salma ketiv amri anan bevaale chayyim kaamrinan ema bevaale chayyim davar shennivlato metammea bemagga uvmassa in davar sheen nivlato metammea bemagga uvmassa la

a: Deha kol chad vechad kelal ufrat beappe nafsheh darshinan leh aval ofot la
Im ken nichtov rachamana chad perata
He nichtov rachamana i ketav rachamana shor hava amena karev legabbe mizbeach in sheen karev legabbe mizbeach la vei ketav rachamana chamor hava amena kadosh bivchora in sheen kadosh bivchora la
Amri im ken nichtov rachamana shor vachamor se lema li shema minah leetoye ofot
Veema leetoye ofot tehorim dumya dese dimtamme begadim abbet habbelia aval ofot temeim delet behu tuma dela metammei begadim abbet habbelia la kol ribuya hu
Vechol hecha dichtav kol ribuya hu veha gabbe maaser dichtiv kol veka darshinan leh bichlal ufrat

Detanya venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teave nafshecha kalal babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar parat uvchol asher tisholcha nafshecha chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash peri mipperi vegidule karka af kol peri mipperi vegidule karka
Amri bakkol kelala kol ribuya hu veibaet ema kol kelala hu mihu kol dehacha ribuya hu
Mikkede ketiv meikara kelal ufrat uchlal dichtiv ki yitten ish el reehu kalal kesef o chelim parat lishmor hadar chazar vechalal
Vei salka datach hay al kol devar pesha name lichlal ufrat hu daata nichtov rachamana lehane perate gabbe hayeche kelal ufrat al kol devar pesha lema li shema minah ribuya hu

Hashta deamratte kol ribuya kol hane perate lema li chad lemaote karka vechad lemaote avadim vechad lemaote shetarot salma lemaote davar sheeno mesuyyam al kol aveda lechidrabbi chiyya bar abba deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hattoen taanat gannav
b: Baaveda meshallem tashlume chefel shenneemar al kol aveda asher yomar
Tenan hatam hechan pikdoni amar leh avad mashbiacha ani veamar amen vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo meshallem et hakkeren hoda al pi atzmo meshallem keren vachomesh veasham
Hechan pikdoni amar lo nignav mashbiacha ani veamar amen vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo meshallem tashlume chefel hoda meatzmo meshallem keren vachomesh veasham

Katane miha betoen taanat gannav dimshallem tashlume chefel aval betoen taanat avad la meshallem tashlume chefel vaafilu toen taanat gannav bishvua hu dimshallem tashlume chefel aval shello bishvua eno meshallem tashlume chefel
Menahane mile detanu rabbanan im yimmatze haggannav betoen taanat gannav hakkatuv medabber
Atta omer betoen taanat gannav o eno ella begannav atzmo keshehu omer im lo yimmatze haggannav betoen taanat gannav hakkatuv medabber

Tanya idach im yimmatze haggannav begannav atzmo hakkatuv medabber atta omer begannav atzmo o eno ella betoen taanat gannav keshehu omer im lo yimmatze haggannav hare toen taanat gannav amur ha ma ani mekayyem im yimmatze haggannav begannav atzmo hakkatuv medabber
Dechulle alma mihat im lo yimmatze haggannav betoen taanat gannav ketiv may mashma amar rava im lo yimmatze kema sheamar ella shehu atzmo genavo yeshallem shenayim
Umnalan devishvua
Detanya venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim lishvua atta omer lishvua o eno ella ledin neemar shelichut yad lematta veneemar shelichut yad lemala ma lehallan lishvua af kan lishvua
Bishlama leman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav hayenu dichtivi tere kerae ella leman deamar tarvayehu betoen taanat gannav tere kerae lema li
Amri chad lemaote taanat avad
Ulman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav dela meyatar lemaote taanat avad mena leh miggannavhaggannav
Ulman deamar tarvayehu betoen taanat gannav demaet leh toen taanat avad gannavhaggannav may daresh beh

Amar lach mibbee leh lechidrabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon meshallem tashlume chefel tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Leman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav dehay gannavhaggannav appekeh lemaote taanat avad derabbi chiyya bar abba mena leh
Amar lach hekkesha hu veen meshivin al hekkesha
Bishlama leman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav shappir ella leman deamar tarvayehu betoen taanat gannav gannav atzmo mena leh
Vechi tema lete bekal vachomer mittoen taanat gannav dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon ma lehallan bishvua af kan bishvua
Nafka leh middetana deve chizkiyya detana deve chizkiyya yeamer shor ugneva vehakkol bakkelal
Ilu kach hayiti omer ma happerat meforash karev legabbe mizbeach af kol karev legabbe mizbeach ma yesh lecha lehavi se

a: Keshehu omer se hare se amur ha ma ani mekayyem geneva lerabbot kal davar
Yeamer shor se ugneva vehakkol bakkelal ilu kach hayiti omer ma happerat meforash davar hakkadosh bivchora af kol davar hakkadosh bivchora
Ma yesh lecha lehavi chamor keshehu omer chamor hare chamor amur ha ma ani mekayyem geneva lerabbot kol davar
Yeamer shor vachamor se ugneva vehakkol bakkelal ilu kach hayiti omer ma happerat meforash baale chayyim af kol baale chayyim
Ma yesh lecha lehavi shear baale chayyim keshehu omer chayyim hare chayyim amur ha ma ani mekayyem geneva lerabbot kol davar
Amar mar yeamer shor ugneva mi ketiv shor ugneva geneva vashor hu dichtiv
Vechi tema ilu neemar kaamar ilu neemar shor ugneva umi matzet amratte ma happerat meforash have shor perat ugneva kelal perat uchlal naasa kelal mosif al happerat veitrabbu lehu kol mile
Ella kedichtiv kaamri geneva veshor mi matzet amratte hakkol bakkelal o ma happerat meforash have leh geneva kelal veshor perat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat shor in mide acharina la
Amar rava tanna achayyim ka samech leh uchlal ufrat uchlal kaamar leh
Veha la dame kelala batra lichlala kamma ha tanna deve rabbi yishmael hu dichhay gavena daresh kelale ufrate
Vehachi ka kashya leh im himmatze timmatze lema li yeamer shor ugneva vechayyim vehakkol bakkelal
Ilu ken hayiti omer ma happerat meforash davar hakkarev legabbe mizbeach af kol hakkarev legabbe mizbeach ma yesh lehavi se keshehu omer se hare se amur ha ma ani mekayyem geneva lerabbot kol davar
Yeamer geneva veshor vase vechayyim vehakkol bakkelal ilu ken hayiti omer ma happerat meforash davar hakkadosh bivchora af kol davar hakkadosh bivchora
Ma yesh lecha lehavi chamor keshehu omer chamor hare chamor amur ha ma ani mekayyem geneva lerabbot kol davar
Yeamer geneva veshor vase vachamor vechayyim vehakkol bakkelal ilu ken hayiti omer ma happerat meforash baale chayyim af kol baale chayyim
Ma yesh lecha lehavi shear baale chayyim keshehu omer chayyim hare chayyim amur ha ma ani mekayyem geneva lerabbot kol davar im himmatze timmatze lema li
b: I hachi shappir kashya leh
Mishshum deit leh pircha lerabbot kol davar mehecha kamayete leh mikkelal batra kelala gufeh chayyim ketiv beh
Kelal ufrat uchlal may ka mahane leh i leetoye kol davar ha chayyim ketiv baale chayyim in mide acharina la mishshum hacha itzterich im himmatze
Amri veha shene chelalot dismichi ahadade ninhu amar ravina kidamri bemareva kol makom sheatta motze shene chelalot hassemuchim ze laze hattel perat benehem vedunem bichlal ufrat

Shedi shor ben himmatze letimmatze leetoye may i leetoye baale chayyim mechayyim nafka ella leetoye davar sheen baale chayyim udrosh hachi ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon
Vetu shedi chamor ben himmatze letimmatze leetoye may i leetoye davar sheen baale chayyim mishshor nafka ella leetoye davar mesuyyam
I hachi se lema li ella riba umiet veriba hu kidtana deve rabbi yishmael
Detana deve rabbi yishmael bammayim bammayim shette peamim en ze kelal ufrat ella riba umiet veriba riba hakkol
May rabbi rabbi kol mile i hachi kol hane perate lema li chad lemaote karka vechad lemaote avadim vechad lemaote shetarot geneva vechayyim lechidrav deamar achayah lekeren keen shegganav
Ulman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav vegannav atzmo nafka leh meim yimmatze haggannav hay im himmatze timmatze may daresh beh

Mibbee leh lechidrava bar ahilay deamar rava bar ahilay may tama derav deamar mode biknas veachar kach bau edim patur dichtiv im himmatze timmatze im himmatze beedim timmatze bedayyanim perat lemarshia et atzmo
Ulman deamar tarvayehu betoen taanat gannav dehay im himmatze timmatze mappek leh legannav atzmo marshia atzmo menalan measher yarshiun elohim velo hammarshia et atzmo
Ulman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav deayeti leh mehimmatze timmatze lemarshia et atzmo hay asher yarshiun may daresh beh amar lach hahu mibe leh lemode biknas defatur
Uman deamar tarvayehu betoen taanat gannav kasavar mode biknas veachar kach bau edim chayyav
Ulman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav denafka leh gannav mehatam bishlama im himmatze timmatze lechidrava bar ahilay aval kol hane perate lema li
Kidtana deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael kol parasha shenneemra venishnet lo nishnet ella ledavar shennitchaddesh bah
Veema gannav atzmo bishvua
La salka datach detanya rabbi yaakov omer shenayim yeshallem shello bishvua atta omer shello bishvua o eno ella bishvua amarta lo kach haya

May lo kach haya amar abbaye la lichtov rachamana shenayim yeshallem begannav velete bekal vachomer mittoen taanat gannav uma toen taanat gannav divhetera ata lideh amar kera lishallem tere gannav atzmo divisura ata lideh lo kol shekken
Ella shenayim yeshallem dichtav rachamana begannav atzmo lema li daafilu shello bishvua
Vehay im himmatze lehachi hu daata ha mibe leh lechidtanya yado

a: En li ella yado gaggo chatzero vekarpefo minnayin talmud lomar im himmatze timmatze mikkol makom
Im ken lema kera o himmatze himmatze o timmatze timmatze middeshanni kera shema minah tarte
Gufa amar rav keren keen shegganav tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha kishat haamada baddin
May tama derav amar kera geneva vechayyim ammay kaamar rachamana chayyim bigneva achayah lekeren keen shegganav
Amar rav sheshet amena ki nayem veshachev rav amar leha shemata detanya kechusha vehishminah meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha keen shegganav
Amri mishshum daamar leh ana pattemna veatte shaklatte
Ta shema shemena vehichchishah meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha keen shegganav
Hatam name mishshum deamrinan leh ma li katlah kullah ma li katlah palga ki kaamar rav beukra vezula hu dekaamar

Hechi dame ilema demeikara shaveya zuza ulvassof shaveya arbea zuze keren keen shegganav lema peliga derav adderabba deamar rabba hay man digzal chavita dechamra mechavreh meikara shaveya zuza ulvassof shaveya arbea zuze tavrah o shatyah meshallem arbea itvar mimmela meshallem zuza
Amri ki kaamar rav kegon demeikara shaveya arbea ulvassof shaveya zuza keren keen shegganav tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha kishat haamada baddin

Tane rabbi chanina lesayyoeh lerav baal habbayit shettaan taanat gannav befikkadon venishba vehoda uvau edim im ad shello bau edim hoda meshallem keren vachomesh veasham veim mishshebbau edim hoda meshallem tashlume chefel veasham vechumsho ole lo bichfelo divre rabbi yaakov
b: Vachachamim omrim berosho vachamishitav mamon hammishtallem berosh mosif chomesh mamon sheen mishtallem berosh en mosif chomesh rabbi shimon ben yochay omer en chomesh veasham mishtallem bemakom sheyyesh kefel
Katane mihat chumsho ole lo bichfelo divre rabbi yaakov hechi dame ilema demeikara shaveya arbea ulvassof shaveya arbea chumsho ole lo bichfelo
Kefela arbea vechumsha zuza ella lav demeikara shaveya arbea ulvassof shaveya zuza dichfela zuza vechumsheh zuza
Alma keren keen shegganav tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha kishat haamada baddin

Amar rava leolam demeikara shaveya arbea vehashta name shaveya arbea udka kashya kefela arbea vechumsheh zuza hacha bemay askinan kegon shennishba vechazar venishba arba peamim vehoda vehattora amra vachamishitav
Hattora ribta chamishiyyot harbe bekeren achat
Amar mar vachachamim omrim berosho vachamishitav mamon hammishtallem berosh mosif chomesh mamon sheen mishtallem berosh en mosif chomesh aval asham mayete
May shena chomesh dela meshallem dichtiv berosho vachamishitav asham name la meshallem deha ketiv berosho vachamishitav veet ashamo
Amri lach rabbanan et paskeh kera
Verabbi shimon ben yochay veet arveh kera verabbanan amri lach la lichtov rachamana la vav velo et
Verabbi shimon ben yochay amar lach et la saggi dela ketav leafsoke ben mamon gavoha lemamon hedot hilkach ata vav arveh kera
Amar rabbi ila ganav tale venaasa ayil egel venaasa shor naasa shinuy beyado uknao tavach umachar shello hu toveach shello hu mocher

Etiveh rabbi chanina lerabbi ila ganav tale venaasa ayil egel venaasa shor meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha keen shegganav vei salka datach kanyeh beshinuy ammay meshallem shello hu toveach shello hu mocher
Amar leh veella may shinuy la kane ammay meshallem keen shegganav leshallem ki hashta
Amar leh ki hashta hayenu tama dela meshallem mishshum daamar leh tora genavi mimmach dichra genavi mimmecha amar leh rachamana natzlan mehay data amar leh adderabba rachamana natzlan middata didach
Matkef lah rabbi zera venikninhu beshinuy hashshem
Amar rava shor ben yomo karuy shor ayil ben yomo karuy ayil shor ben yomo karuy shor dichtiv shor o chesev o ez ki yivaled
Ayil ben yomo karuy ayil dichtiv veele tzoncha lo achalti elim hu dela achal kevasim achal ella lav shema minah ayil ben yomo karuy ayil
Mikkol makom kashya amar rav sheshet ha manni bet shammay hi deamri shinuy bimkomo omedt vela kane

Detanya natan lah beetnannah chitin vaasaan solet zetim vaasaan shemen anavim vaasaan yayin tane chada asur vetane chada muttar veamar rav yosef tane guron demeasporak bet shammay osrin uvet hillel mattirin
May tama devet shammay dichtiv gam lerabbot shinuyehem uvet hillel hem velo shinuyehem
Uvet shammay hahu

a: Hem velo valdotehem hu daata uvet hillel tarte shemait minah hem velo shinuyehem hem velo valdotehem uvet hillel hachtiv gam gam levet hillel kashya

Ad kan la peligi ella demar savar shinuy kone umar savar en shinuy kone aval leinyan shallome kulle alma kidmeikara meshallem dekatane meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha keen shegganav
Lema tehve teuvta derav deamar rav keren keen shegganav meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha kishat haamada baddin amar rava telaim kidmeikara damim keshel achshav
Amar rabba shinuy kone ketiva utnena ketiva veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal ma talmud lomar asher gazal im keen sheggazal yachazir veim lav damim bealma bae shallome
Tenena haggozel etzim vaasaan kelim tzemer vaasaan begadim meshallem kishat haggezela
I name lo hispik litno lo ad shetztzevao patur alma shinuy kone
Yeush amri rabbanan denikne mihu la yadinan i deorayeta i derabbanan
I deorayeta mide dahava ammotze aveda motze aveda lav kevan demiyyaash marah minah mikkamme detete lideh kane leh hay name kevan dimyaesh marah kane leh alma kane
O dilma la damya laaveda aveda hu dechi atay lideh behettera atay lideh aval hay kevan divisura atay lideh midderabbanan hu
Daamur rabbanan nikne mippene takkanat hashshavim
Verav yosef amar yeush eno kone vaafilu midderabbanan
Etiveh rav yosef lerabba gazal chametz veavar alav happesach
b: Omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha vehay kevan dimta idan isura vadday miyyaash vei salka datach yeush kone ammay omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha deme mealleya bae shallome leh
Amar leh ki kaamena ana ze mityaesh veze rotze liknot hay ze mityaesh veze eno rotze liknot
Etiveh abbaye lerabba korbano velo haggazul hechi dame ilema lifne yeush lema li kera peshita
Ella lav leachar yeush shema minah yeush la kane
Amar leh rava velitamach ha detanya mishkavo velo haggazul
Hechi dame ilema digzal amra veavdeh mishkav mi ika leman deamar shinuy maase la kane ella may it lach lememar digzal mishkav dechavreh hachi name digzal korban dechavreh
Etiveh abbaye lerav yosef orot shel baal habbayit machshava metammeatan
Veshel abbedan en machshava metammeatan
Shel gannav machshava metammeatan shel gazlan en machshava metammeatan
Rabbi shimon omer chiluf haddevarim shel gazlan machshava metammeatan veshel gannav en machshava metammeatan lefi shello nityaashu habbealim
Ushma minah yeush kone amar leh hacha bemay askinan kegon shekkitzan
Matkef lah rabba bar rav chanan vahalo itzba shanu kan veitzba en tzericha kitzua
Ditnan kol makom sheen chesron melacha machshava metammeato yesh chesron melacha en machshava metammeato chutz min haetzva
Ella amar rava hay milta keshi bah rabba lerav yosef esrin vetarten shenin vela iparka ad deyatev rav yosef beresha ufarkah shinuy hashshem keshinuy maase dame
Shinuy maase may tama hatam meikara etzim hashta kelim shinuy hashshem name meikara karu leh mashka vehashta abbarzin
Vahare marish deika shinuy hashshem demeikara keshura vehashta telala utnan al hammarish haggazul shebbenao bevira shennotel damav mippene takkanat hashshavim
Tama mippene takkanat hashshavim

a: Ha lav hachi hadar beeneh amar rav yosef marish shemo alav detanya tzalot habbayit ellu hammaltetin vehaubbim ellu hammerishot
Rabbi zera amar shinuy hachozer livriyyato beshinuy hashshem la have shinuy
Veshinuy hashshem sheeno chozer livriyyato mi have shinuy vahare tzinor demeikara ketzitzta vehashta tzinora vetanya tzinor shechakako ulvassof kevao posel et hammikve
Kevao ulvassof chakako eno posel et hammikve
Vei amratte shinuy hashshem milta hi afilu kevao ulvassof chakako name lifsol
Shane sheiva demidderabbanan hi i hachi afilu deresha name hatam ika torat keli alav betalush hacha en torat keli alav betalush
Metivi haggannav vehaggazlan vehaannas hekdeshan hekdesh utrumatan teruma umaserotan maaser
Amri hatam ika shinuy hashshem demeikara tivla vehashta teruma hekdesh meikara chullin vehashta hekdesh
Amar rav chisda amar rabbi yonatan minnayin leshinnuy shehu kone shenneemar veheshiv et haggezela ma talmud lomar asher gazal im keen sheggazal yachazir veim lav damim bealma bae shallome
Hay asher gazal mibe lemaote gezel aviv sheeno mosif chomesh al gezel aviv
Im ken nichtov rachamana veheshiv et gezelo asher gazal lema li lemichtav shema minah tarte

Veika deamri amar rav chisda amar rabbi yonatan minnayin leshinnuy sheeno kone shenneemar veheshiv et haggezela mikkol makom veha ketiv asher gazal hahu mibe leh al gezelo shello mosif chomesh veen mosif chomesh al gezel aviv
Amar ulla minnayin leyeush sheeno kone shenneemar vahavetem gazul et happisseach veet hachole gazul dumya defisseach ma pisseach delet leh takkanta kelal
b: Af gazul delet leh takkanta la shena lifne yeush vela shena achar yeush
Rava amar mehacha korbano velo haggazul emat ilema lifne yeush peshita lema li kera
Ella lav leachar yeush ushma minah yeush la kane shema minah
Veha rava hu deamar digzal korban dechavreh ibaet ema hadar beh veibaet ema chad minayehu rav pappa amrah
Umiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vechu
Veammay nelaf shorshor mishshabbat ma lehallan chayya veof kayyotze bahen af kan chayya vaof kayyotze bahen
Amar rava amar kera shor vase shor vase shene peamim shor vase in mide acharina la

Amri he meyatar ilema shor vase desefa meyatar denichtov rachamana ki yignov shor o se utvacho umcharo chamishsha vakar yeshallem tachtav vearba tzon tachtav i ketav rachamana hachi hava amena bae shallome tisha lechol echad veechad
Vechi tema ha ketiv tachtav tachtav chad tachtav meyatar
Hahu mibe leh lidrasha acharina detanya yachol ganav shor shave mane yeshallem tachtav chamishsha negidin talmud lomar tachtav tachtav
Ella shor vase deresha meyatar denichtov rachamana ki yignov ish utvacho umcharo chamishsha vakar yeshallem tachat hashshor vearba tzon tachat hasse
I ketav rachamana hachi hava amena ad deganev tere vetavach lehu utvacho ketiv lechad
Veema ad deganev tarvayehu umzabben lehu umcharo ketiv lechad
Veema have amena ad deganev tere vetavach chad umzabben chad o mecharo ketiv
Veakkatti hava amena ad deganev tarvayehu vetavach chad umshayyar chad o mezabben chad umshayyar chad

Ella shor desefa vese deresha meyatar denichtov rachamana ki yignov ish shor utvacho umcharo chamishsha vakar yeshallem tachtav vearba tzon tachat hasse shor desefa vese deresha lema li shema minah shor vase in mide acharina la
En haggonev achar haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel amar rav lo shanu ella lifne yeush aval leachar yeush kenao gannav rishon vegannav sheni meshallem tashlume chefel legannav rishon

Amar rav sheshet amena ki nayem veshachev rav amar leha shemata detanya amar rabbi akiva mippene ma amra tora tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha mippene shennishtaresh bachet emat ilema lifne yeush

a: Mi ika nishtaresh ella leachar yeush vei salka datach yeush kane ammay meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha shello hu toveach shello hu mocher
Amri kidamar rava mippene sheshshana bachet hacha name mippene sheshshana bachet
Ta shema utvacho o mecharo ma tevicha sheenah chozeret af mechira sheenah chozeret
Emat ilema lifne yeush ammay enah chozeret ella leachar yeush vei salka datach kanyeh ammay meshallem arbaa vachamishsha shello hu toveach shello hu mocher
Kidamar rav nachman perat leshehikna lishloshim yom hacha name perat leshehikna lishloshim yom
Metivi ganav uva acher ugnavo harishon meshallem tashlume chefel vehashsheni eno meshallem ella keren bilvad

Ganav umachar uva acher ugnavo harishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vehashsheni meshallem tashlume chefel ganav vetavach uva acher ugnavo harishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vehashsheni eno meshallem tashlume chefel ella keren bilvad
Katane miha metziata ganav umachar uva acher ugnavo harishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vehashsheni meshallem tashlume chefel
Emat ilema lifne yeush sheni ammay meshallem tashlume chefel shinuy reshut belo yeush mi ika leman deamar dekane
Ella peshita leachar yeush vei salka datach yeush kone ammay meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha dideh hu dezabben
Vetu dekatane resha ganav uva acher ugnavo rishon meshallem tashlume chefel vehashsheni en meshallem ella keren
Mikkede leachar yeush kayeminan vei salka datach yeush kone sheni ammay eno meshallem ella keren ella lav shema minah yeush la kane vekashya lerav

Amar rava vetisbera ha metaratzta hi ella dekatane sefa ganav vetavach uva acher ugnavo rishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vesheni eno meshallem ella keren umi ika leman deamar shinuy maase la kane

Ella leolam kullah lifne yeush veefoch sefa limtziata umtziata lesefa veema hachi ganav umachar uva acher ugnavo harishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vehashsheni eno meshallem ella keren deshinuy reshut belo yeush la kane
Ganav vetavach uva acher ugnavo harishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vehashsheni meshallem tashlume chefel dekanyeh beshinuy maase
Rav pappa amar leolam la tefoch sefa bet shammay hi deamri shinuy bimkomo omed
I hachi kashya resha umtziata lerav
Amar rav zevid leolam kullah lifne yeush vehacha bemay askinan shennityaashu habbealim belokeach velo nityaashu begannav dehave leh yeush veshinuy reshut
Vela tema mishshum devaenan yeush veshinuy reshut ella afilu beyeush lechodeh name kane gabbe gannav
Ella dela mashkachatte dimshallemi tarvayehu gannav rishon vegannav sheni ella behachi
Itmar hammocher lifne yeush rav nachman amar chayyav rav sheshet amar patur

Rav nachman amar chayyav umcharo amar rachamana veha zabben la shena lifne yeush la shena leachar yeush rav sheshet amar patur chiyyuveh leachar yeush hu deahano maasav aval lifne yeush dela ahano maasav la michayyav dumya ditvicha baenan deahano maasav
Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah detanya amar rabbi akiva mippene ma amra tora tavach umachar meshallem arbaa vachamishsha mippene shennishtaresh bachet
Emat ilema lifne yeush mi ika nishtaresh ella lav leachar yeush hu amar rava mippene sheshshana bachet

Ta shema utvacho umcharo ma tevicha sheenah chozeret af mechira sheenah chozeret emat ilema lifne yeush ammay enah chozeret ella leachar yeush ushma minah chiyyuva leachar yeush hu targemah rav nachman perat leshehikna lo lishloshim yom
Veaf rabbi elazar savar chiyyuveh leachar yeush hu deamar rabbi elazar
b: Teda shessetam geneva yeush bealim hu
Shehare amra tora tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vedilma la iyyaash ella lav mishshum deamrinan setam geneva yeush bealim hi
Vedilma af al gav dela iyyaash
Amri la salka datach dumya ditvicha ma tevicha deahano maasav af mechira deahano maasav vei lifne yeush may ahano
Vedilma deshamineh deiyyaash amri la salka datach dumya ditvicha ma tevicha lealtar af mechira lealtar
Amar lo rabbi yochanan geneva benefesh tochiach sheen yeush bealim vechayyav mikkelal desavar rabbi yochanan lifne yeush chayyav
Leachar yeush may rabbi yochanan amar chayyav veresh lakish amar patur
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyav chiyyuveh ben lifne yeush ben leachar yeush resh lakish amar patur chiyyuveh lifne yeush hu aval leachar yeush kana veshello hu toveach veshello hu mocher
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish ganav vehikdish veachar kach tavach meshallem tashlume chefel veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Emat illema lifne yeush mi kadosh ish ki yakdish et beto kodesh amar rachamana ma beto shello af kol shello

Ella peshita leachar yeush vetama dehikdish hu deeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha dechi ka tavach dehekdesh ka tavach aval lo hikdish tavach meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vei salka datach yeush kone ammay meshallem shello hu toveach shello hu mocher
Amar leh hacha bemay askinan kegon shehikdishuhu bealim beyad gannav
Umi kadosh vehaamar rabbi yochanan gazal velo nityaashu habbealim shenehen enan yecholin lehakdish ze lefi sheeno shello veze lefi sheeno birshuto amri hu deamar kitznuin
Ditnan hatztzenuin mannichin et hammaot veomrim kol hannilkat mizze yehe mechullal al hammaot haellu
Vahare chazra keren labbealim
Kesheamad baddin
Hechi dame i deamri tze ten lo may irya hikdish afilu lo hikdish name la lichayeveh
Deamar rava tze ten lo tavach umachar patur may tama
Kevan defaskuha lemilteh vetavach umachar have leh gazlan vegazlan eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha

a: Chayyav atta liten lo tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha may tama kevan dela pesika milta akkatti gannav hu
La tzericha deamri leh chayyav atta liten lo

Gufa amar rabbi yochanan gazal velo nityaashu habbealim shenehem enan yecholim lehakdish ze lefi sheeno shello veze lefi sheeno birshuto umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna
Utnan kerem revai hau metzayenin oto bikzuzot adama simana ki adama ma adama ika hanaa minah af hay name ki mipparka shere leithanoye minah
Veshel orla becharsit simana kecharsit ma charsit sheen hanaa minah af hay delet beh hanaa mineh
Veshel kevarot besid simana dechivar kaatzamot ummache veshofech ki hechi denichavar tefe
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim bishviit dehefker ninhu
Aval bishar shene shavua halitehu larasha veyamut
Vehatztzenuin mannichin et hammaot veomrim kol hannilkat mizze mechullal al hammaot hallalu
Vechi tema man tena tzenuin rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yochanan kistam yechidaa la amar
Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu halacha kemoto chutz mearev vetzayedan uraya acharona
Amri la tema kol hannilkat mizze ella ema kal hammitlakket mizze
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan tzenuin verabbi dosa amru davar echad verabbi dosa nilkat kaamar
Detanya rabbi yehuda omer shacharit baal habbayit omed veomer kol sheyelakketu aniyyim hayyom yehe hefker
Rabbi dosa omer leitote erev omer kol shellaktu aniyyim yehe hefker
Efoch derabbi yehuda lerabbi dosa verabbi dosa lerabbi yehuda ammay afchatte matnita ifchah lerabbi yochanan veema tzenuin verabbi yehuda amru davar echad
Amri la saggi dela mithafcha matnita divha matnitin katane deit leh lerabbi yehuda berera veshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda bealma delet leh berera ditnan
b: Hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim omer shene luggin sheani atid lehafrish hare hen teruma asara maaser rishon tisha maaser sheni umechel veshote miyyad divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin
Amri sof sof ammay ka afchatte lah lematnitin mishshum dekashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda hashta name kashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan
Deamratte lerabbi yochanan la tema kol hannilkat ella ema kal hammitlakket alma it leh berera veha rabbi yochanan let leh berera
Deamar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan haachin shechalku lakochot hen umachzirin ze laze bayyovel
Ella leolam kol hannilkat

Verabbi yochanan setama acharina ashkach ditnan en haggonev achar haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel ammay bishlama legannav rishon la meshallem vegunnav mibbet haish velo mibbet haggannav ella livalim neshallem
Ella lav shema minah ze lefi sheeno shello veze lefi sheeno birshuto
Umay chazet deazel batar hahi setama lebed ki hay setama ditznuin
Mishshum dimsayya leh kera veish ki yakdish et beto kodesh la ma beto birshuto af kol birshuto
Amar abbaye i lav deamar rabbi yochanan tzenuin verabbi dosa amru davar echad hava amena tzenuin it lehu derabbi dosa verabbi dosa let leh ditznuin

Tzenuin it lehu derabbi dosa uma begannav avadu rabbanan takkanta aniyyim tzericha lememar rabbi dosa let leh ditznuin aniyyim hu daavadu lehu rabbanan takkanta aval gannav la avadu lah rabbanan takkanta
Amar rava i lav deamar rabbi yochanan tzenuin verabbi dosa amru davar echad hava amena man tena tzenuin rabbi meir hi
Lav amar rabbi meir maaser mamon gavoha hu vaafilu hachi leinyan pediyya okmeh rachamana birshuteh dichtiv veim gaol yigal ish mimmaasro chamishito yosef alav
Karyeh rachamana maasro umosif chomesh
Kerem revai name gamar kodesh kodesh mimmaaser ketiv hacha kodesh hillulim uchtiv gabbe maaser vechol masar haaretz mizzera haaretz mipperi haetz la hu kodesh

Ma kodesh dichtiv gabbe maaser af al gav demamon gavoha hu leinyan pediyya okmeh rachamana birshuteh af hay kodesh name dichtiv gabbe kerem revai af al gav delav mamon dideh hu leinyan achole okmeh rachamana birshuteh
Deha ki iteh birshuteh name ha lav dideh hu veha matze machel mishshum hachi matze machel
Aval gabbe leket kevan demamona dideh ki iteh birshuteh hu dematze mafkar leh ki leteh birshuteh la matze mafkar leh
Amar ravina i lav deamar rabbi yochanan tzenuin verabbi dosa amru davar echad hava amena man tanna tzenuin rabbi dosa hi ki hechi dela tikshe setam mishna lerabbi yochanan verabbi yochanan

a: Kistam yechidaa la amar
Amri nehardae la katvinan orachta ammittalteli amar rav ashe leammemar may tama amar leh mishshum derabbi yochanan
Deamar rabbi yochanan gazal velo nityaashu habbealim shenehem enan yecholin lehakdish ze lefi sheeno shello veze lefi sheeno birshuto
Ika deamri amri nehardae la katvinan orachta ammittalteli dechafreh tama dechafreh demichaze keshikra aval la kafreh katvinan
Veamri nehardae orachta dela ketiv beh zil dun uzchi veappek lenafshach let beh meshasha may tama mishshum deamar leh hayeche lav baal devarim didi atte
Amar abbaye vei ketiv beh lemechetza lishlish velirvia migo demishtae dina appalga mishtae dina akkulleh
Amar ammemar i tefas la mappekinan mineh rav ashe amar kevan dechatveh leh kol demitane min dina kabbelit alay shaliach shavveyeh
Veika deamar shuttafa shavveyeh lemay nafka minah lemitpas palga vehilcheta shaliach shavveyeh
Matni ganav al pi shenayim vetavach umachar al pihem o al pi shenayim acherim meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Ganav umachar beshabbat ganav umachar laavoda zara ganav vetavach beom hakkippurim
Ganav mishshel aviv vetavach umachar veachar kach met aviv ganav vetavach veachar kach hikdish meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Ganav vetavach lirfua o lichlavim hashshochet venimtzet terefa hashshochet chullin baazara meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Rabbi shimon poter bishne ellu
Gema lema matnitin dela kerabbi akiva
Dei rabbi akiva haamar davar velo chatzi davar
Detanya amar rabbi yose keshehalach abba chalafta etzel rabbi yochanan ben nuri lilmod tora veamri lah rabbi yochanan ben nuri etzel abba
b: Chalafta amar lo
Hare sheachalah shana rishona bifne shenayim sheniyya bifne shenayim shelishit bifne shenayim mahu
Amar lo hare zo chazaka amar lo af ani omer ken ella sherabbi akiva cholek baddavar shehaya rabbi akiva omer davar velo chatzi davar
Amar abbaye afilu tema rabbi akiva mi la mode rabbi akiva bishnayim omrim kidesh ushnayim omrim baal
Deaf al gav deede via tzerichi leede kiddushin kevan deede kiddushin la tzerichi leede via davar karena beh
Hacha name af al gav deede tevicha tzerichi leede geneva kevan deede geneva la tzerichi leede tevicha davar karena beh
Verabbanan hay davar velo chatzi davar lemaote may lemaote echad omer echad begabbah veechad omer echad bichresah
Hay chatzi davar vachatzi edut hu
Ella lemaote shenayim omrim echad begabbah ushnayim omrim echad bichresah hane amri ketanna hi vehane amri ketanna hi
Ganav umachar beshabbat vechu vehatanya patur
Amar rame bar chama ki tanya hahi defatur beomer lo akotz lecha teena mitteenati vetikne li genevutach
Amri vechevan dechi tava leh kamman bedina la amrinan leh zil shallem demichayyav benafsho hu ha mechira name lav mechira hi
Ella amar rav pappa beomer lo zerok genevutach lachatzeri vetikne li genevutach
Keman kerabbi akiva deamar keluta kemi shehunnecha damya
Dei kerabbanan kevan dematya lachatzar beto kana leinyan shabbat la mechayyav ad dematya leara
Beomer lo tikne li genevutach ad shettanuach
Rava amar leolam kerame bar chama etnan asra tora vaafilu ba al immo vei tava leh kamman bedina mi amrinan leh kum hav lah etnan
Ella af al gav dechi ka tava leh bedina la amrinan leh zil hav lah kevan dechi yahev lah have etnan hacha name af al gav dilinyan tashlumin i tava leh bedina kamman la amrinan leh zil shallem

a: Afilu hachi kevan deka makne leh behachi haveya mechira
Ganav vetavach beom hakkippurim vechu amri ammay nehi diktala leka malkot miha ika vekayema lan deeno loke umshallem
Amri ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar loke umshallem
I rabbi meir afilu tavach beshabbat vechi tema loke umshallem it leh met umshallem let leh
Vela vehatanya ganav vetavach bashshabbat ganav vetavach laavoda zara ganav shor hanniskal utvacho meshallem arbaa vachamishsha divre rabbi meir vachachamim potrin

Amri bar minah dehahi deha ittemar alah amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan veamri lah amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi shimon ben lakish rabbi avin verabbi ila vechol chavurata mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amri betoveach al yede acher
Vechi ze chote veze mitchayyev
Amar rava shane hacha deamar kera utvacho umcharo ma mechira al yede acher af tevicha al yede acher
Deve rabbi yishmael tana o lerabbot et hashshaliach deve chizkiyya tana tachat lerabbot et hashshaliach
Matkef lah mar zutra mi ika mide deilu aved ihu la michayyav veaved shaliach umichayyav
Amar leh rav ashe hatam lav mishshum dela michayyav hu ella dekam leh bidrabba mineh
Vei betoveach al yede acher may tama derabbanan defatri
Amri man chachamim rabbi shimon deamar shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita
Amri bishlama avoda zara veshor hanniskal shechita sheenah reuya hi ella shabbat shechita reuya hi ditnan hashshochet bashshabbat uvom hakkippurim af al pi shemmitchayyev benafsho shechitato keshera
Amri savar lah kerabbi yochanan hassandelar
Ditnan hamvashshel bashshabbat beshogeg yeachel bemezid lo yeachel divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer beshogeg yeachel bemotzae shabbat bemezid lo yeachel olamit
Rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer beshogeg yeachel lemotzae shabbat laacherim velo lo bemezid lo yeachel olamit lo lo velo laacherim
May tama derabbi yochanan hassandelar kiddaresh rabbi chiyya appitcha deve nesia ushmartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi lachem ma kodesh asur baachila af maase shabbat asurin baachila
I ma kodesh asur bahanaa af maase shabbat asur bahanaa talmud lomar lachem shellachem yehe
Yachol afilu beshogeg talmud lomar mechalleleha mot yumat bemezid amarti lecha velo beshogeg
Peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar maase shabbat deorayeta vechad amar maase shabbat derabbanan
Man deamar deorayeta kedaamaran uman deamar derabbanan amar kera kodesh hu hu kodesh veen maasav kodesh
Bishlama leman deamar deorayeta ammetu
b: Lehachi patri rabbanan ella leman deamar derabbanan ammay patri rabbanan
Ashsheara aavoda zara veshor hanniskal
Verabbi meir ammay mechayyev shochet laavoda zara
Kevan dishchat bah purta asrah idach isure hanaa hu vela demarah ka tavach vela dideh ka tavach
Amar rava beomer bigmar zevicha hu ovdah
Shor hanniskal isure hanaa ninhu lav demareh ka tavach velav dideh ka tavach
Amar rava hacha bemay askinan kegon shemmesaro leshomer vehizzik bevet shomer vehuad bevet shomer venigmar dino bevet shomer verabbi meir savar lah kerabbi yaakov vesavar lah kerabbi shimon
Savar lah kerabbi yaakov deamar af mishshennigmar dino hechziro shomer labbealim muchzar
Vesavar lah kerabbi shimon deamar davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame
Ditnan rabbi shimon omer kodashim shechayyav beachrautan chayyav alma davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame

Amar rav kahana amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea mi matzet mokmatte matnitin kerabbi meir vela kerabbi shimon veha katane sefa rabbi shimon poter bishne ellu mikkelal divchullah matnitin mode
Amar leh la mikkelal demode betavach umachar lirfua velichlavim
Ganav mishshel aviv vetavach umachar vechu bea mineh rava merav nachman ganav shor shel shene shuttafin utvacho vehoda leechad mehen mahu

Chamishsha bakar amar rachamana velo chamishsha chatzae vakar o dilma chamishsha bakar amar rachamana vaafilu chamishsha chatzae vakar amar leh chamishsha bakar amar rachamana velo chamishsha chatzae vakar

Etiveh ganav mishshel aviv vetavach umachar veachar kach met aviv meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha veha hacha kevan demet aviv kemo shekkadam vehoda leechad mehen dame vekatane meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Amar leh hacha bemay askinan kegon sheamad aviv baddin

Aval lo amad baddin may eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha i hachi addetane sefa ganav mishshel aviv vamet veachar kach tavach umachar eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha niflog bedideh bamme devarim amurim kesheamad baddin aval lo amad baddin eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Amar leh hachi name ayede denasev resha ganav mishshel aviv vetavach umachar veachar kach met aviv nasev sefa name ganav mishshel aviv umet aviv veachar kach tavach umachar
Letzafra amar leh chamishsha bakar amar rachamana vaafilu chamishsha chatzae bakar vehay dela amari lach beurta

a: Dela achali bisra detora
Veella may shena resha umay shena sefa
Amar leh resha karena beh utvacho kullo beisura sefa la karena bah utvacho kullo beisura
Hashshochet venimtzet terefa vechu amar leh rav chavivi machoznaa lerav ashe shema minah enah lishchita ella levassof
Dei yeshnah lishchita mittechila vead sof kevan dishchat bah purta asrah idach la demarah ka tavach
Amar leh rav huna bereh derava ki ka michayyav ahahu purta amar leh rav ashe la tidchayah utvacho kullo baenan veleka
Ella kashya amar leh hachi amar rav gammada mishshemeh derava kegon sheshshachat miktzat simanin bachutz ugmaran bifnim

Ika dematne lah aha amar rabbi shimon mishshum derabbi levi sava enah lishchita ella levassof verabbi yochanan amar yeshnah lishchita mittechila vead sof amar leh rav chavivi machoznaa lerav ashe lema kasavar rabbi yochanan chullin shennishchatu baazara lav deorayeta
b: Dei salka datach deorayeta mikki shachet lah purta asrah idach lav demarah ka tavach
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava ki ka michayyav name ahahu purta amar leh rav ashe la tidchayah utvacho kullo baenan veleka
Ella kashya amar leh hachi amar rav gammada mishshemeh derava ki ka mechayyev kegon sheshshachat miktzat simanin bachutz ugmaran bifnim
Matni ganav al pi shenayim vetavach umachar al pihen venimtzeu zommim meshallemin hakkol
Ganav al pi shenayim vetavach umachar al pi shenayim acherim ellu vaellu nimtzeu zommin harishonim meshallemin tashlume chefel veacharonim meshallemin tashlume shelosha
Nimtzeu acharonim zommin hu meshallem tashlume chefel vehen meshallemin tashlume shelosha
Echad min acharonim zommin batla edut sheniyya echad min harishonim zommin batla kol haedut sheim en geneva en tevicha veen mechira
Gema itmar ed zomem abbaye amar lemafrea hu nifsal rava amar mikkan ulhabba hu nifsal
Abbaye amar lemafrea hu nifsal mehahu shata deashed have leh rasha vehattora amra al tashet rasha ed
Rava amar mikkan ulhabba hu nifsal ed zomem chidush hu deha tere utre ninhu may chazet detzayetatte lehane tzeyet lehane
Hilkach en lecha bo ella mishsheat chidush veelach
Ika deamri rava name keabbayye sevira leh deamar lemafrea hu nifsal vehacha hayenu tameh derava

a: Mishshum peseda delakochot
May benayehu deashidu beh tere lechad utre lechad i name defaslinhu begazlanuta
Lehach lishana deamratte mishshum chidush leka lehach lishana deamratte mishshum peseda delakochot ika
Amar rabbi yirmeya middifti avad rav pappa ovada keoteh derava rav ashe amar hilcheta keoteh deabbaye vehilcheta keoteh deabbaye bel
Tenan ganav al pi shenayim vetavach umachar al pihem venimtzeu zommin meshallemin et hakkol
May lav sheheidu al haggeneva vechazru veheidu al hattevicha vehuzzammu al haggeneva vechazru vehuzzammu al hattevicha
Vei salka datach lemafrea hu nifsal hane kevan deitazzamu lehu aggeneva igallay milta lemafrea dechi ashidu attevicha pesulin hao ammay meshallemin attevicha
Amri hacha bemay askinan kegon shehuzzammu al hattevicha techila
Amri sof sof ki hadri mitazzemi aggeneva igallay milta dechi ashidu attevicha pesulin hao ammay meshallemi attevicha
Vehilcheta sheheidu bevat achat vehuzzammu
Lema ketannae hau shenayim meidin oto shegganav vehen meidin oto shettavach vehuzzammu al haggeneva edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah
Huzzammu al hattevicha hu meshallem tashlume chefel vehen meshallemin tashlume shelosha
Amar rabbi yose bamme devarim amurim bishte ediyyot aval beedut achat edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah
May bishte ediyyot umay beedut achat ilema bishte ediyyot bishte ediyyot mammash bishte kittot beedut achat bechat achat beze achar ze

Veamar rabbi yose beedut achat bechat achat beze achar ze ki mashadi aggeneva vahadar mashadi attevicha ki mittazzemi attevicha edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah veitazzamu lehu aggeneva mehecha tete hach
Ella lav bishte ediyyot beedut achat keen shette ediyyot umay ninhu kat achat beze achar ze aval beedut achat bevat achat lo
Vesavruha dechulle alma toch kede dibur kedibur dame
May lav beha kamipalgi derabbanan savri mikkan ulhabba hu nifsal vechevan demehahi shata ka mitazzemi attevicha deka mitazzemi itazzum aggeneva dela mitazzemi la itazzum
Rabbi yose savar lemafrea hu nifsal vechevan demiyyad ki ashidu hu demipasli i itazzamu lehu attevicha itazzamu lehu name aggeneva deha toch kede dibur kedibur dame
Amri i toch kede dibur kedibur dame dechulle alma lemafrea hu nifsal ella hacha betoch kede dibur kedibur dame ka mipalgi rabbanan savri toch kede dibur
b: Lav kedibur dame verabbi yose savar toch kede dibur kedibur dame
Vesavar rabbi yose toch kede dibur kedibur dame vehatnan hare zo temurat ola temurat shelamim hare zo temurat ola divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yose omer im lechach nitkaven mittechila hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keechad devarav kayyamin veim amar temurat ola venimlach veamar temurat shelamim hare zo temurat ola
Vehavenan bah nimlach peshita
Veamar rav pappa nimlach betoch kede dibur kaamrinan

Amri tere toch kede dibur have chad kede sheelat talmid lerav vechad kede sheelat harav letalmid ki let leh lerabbi yose kede sheelat talmid lerav shalom alecha rabbi umori dinfish kede sheelat harav letalmid shalom alecha it leh
Amar rava edim shehuchchashu ulvassof huzzammu neheragin dehachchasha techilat hazamma hi ella shello nigmera
Amar rava mena amena lah detanya meidani beish peloni shessime et en avdo vehippil et shino shehare harav omer ken venimtzeu zommin meshallemin deme ayin laeved
Hechi dame ilema kidkatane deleka kat acharina meshallemin deme ayin laeved batar demappeki leh lecherut deme eno kavae shallome
Veod deme kulleh eved lerav bae leshallome veod shehare harav omer ken harav mi nicha leh

Ella lav kegon daato be tere veamri hippil et shino sime et eno devae metiv leh harav deme eno vaato be tere metziae veamri eno vahadar shino dela bae lemitav leh ella deme shino deka machchashi leh kammae limtziae
Vehayenu shehare harav omer ken denicha leh bemay dekaamri
Vekatane venimtzeu zommin metziae meshallemin deme ayin laeved
Shema minah hachchasha techilat hazamma hi
Amar abbaye la
Deafchinhu veazzeminhu
Mimmay

a: Middesefa bemefach vahazamma resha name bemefach vahazamma
Dekatane sefa meidanu et ish peloni shehippil et shen avdo vesime et eno shehare haeved omer ken venimtzeu zommin meshallemin deme ayin larav
Hechi dame i dela ka modu lehu batrae bechavla kelal deme kulleh eved lerav bae shallome leh
Ella peshita deka modu kullehu bechavla
Udka afchinan udafchinhu veazzeminhu
Vehechi dame i deka meachari achore hane batrae akkatti deme eved lerav bae shallome
Dechi mechayevi leh legavra akkatti gavra lav bar chiyyuva hu ella deka mekaddemi kaddome hane batrae
Vei dela amad baddin akkatti deme kulleh eved lerav bae shallome leh deakkatti gavra la michayyav
Ella deamad baddin
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav ika lerav ashe dukya derava mehecha ilema meresha resha mi ka mittachchashi metziae
Kevan dei la mittazzemi sahaduta keotayehu ka kayema dedina keotayehu paskinan deyesh bichlal matayim mane
Hilkach kammae hu deka mittachchashi metziae la mittachchashi mide
Amar leh rava savar midderesha beshalosh kitot sefa name beshalosh vedayek missefa
Kegon deatu be tere veamri hippil et shino vesime eno ufaskineh ledina appummayehu
Veatu be tere acharine veamri sime et eno vehippil et shino deka machchashi lehu lehane kammae venimtzeu zommin kammae meshallemin deme ayin lerav
Vei salka datach hachchasha lav techilat hazama hi ammay meshallemi ha ittachchashu lehu meikara ella shema minah hachchasha techilat hazama hi
Veabbayye amar lach bishlama resha la saggi dela shalosh kitot shehare katane harav omer ken
Ella sefa lema li shalosh kitot shehare haeved omer ken
Eved kol dehu memar amar denicha leh denipok lecherut
Matkef lah rabbi zera ema sime et eno
b: Nipok beeno hippil et shino nipok beshino sime et eno vehippil et shino nipok beeno veshino
Amar abbaye alecha amar kera tachat eno velo tachat eno veshino tachat shino velo tachat shino veeno
Amar rav idi bar avin af anan name tenena ganav al pi shenayim vetavach umachar al pihem venimtzeu zommin meshallemin lo et hakkol
May lav deheidu al haggeneva vechazru veheidu al hattevicha vehuzzammu al haggeneva vechazru vehuzzammu al hattevicha

Veha kevan shehuzzammu al haggeneva legabbe tevicha hau lehu muchchashin vekatane meshallemin lo et hakkol vei salka datach hachchasha lav techilat hazama hi attevicha ammay meshallemin ella lav shema minah hachchasha techilat hazama hi
Amri hacha bemay askinan kegon shehuzzammu al hattevicha techila
Uviflugta edim shehuchchashu ulvassof huzzammu rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar chad amar neheragin vechad amar en neheragin
Tistayyem derabbi elazar hu deamar en neheragin deamar rabbi elazar edim shehuchchashu benefesh lokin
Vei salka datach rabbi elazar hu deamar neheragin ammay lokin have leh lav shennitan leazharat mitat bet din vechol lav shennitan leazharat mitat bet din en lokin alav
Ella lav shema minah rabbi elazar hu deamar en neheragin tistayyam
Lokin tere utre ninhu may chazet desamchatte ahane semoch ahane
Amar abbaye beva harug beraglav
Matni ganav al pi shenayim vetavach umachar al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo meshallem tashlume chefel veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha

Ganav vetavach bashshabbat ganav vetavach laavoda zara ganav mishshel aviv umet aviv veachar kach tavach umachar ganav vehikdish veachar kach tavach umachar meshallem tashlume chefel veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Rabbi shimon omer kodashim shechayyav beachrautam meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha sheen chayyav beachrautam patur
Gema al pi ed echad peshita
Amri ha ka mashma lan al pi atzmo dumya deal pi ed echad ma al pi ed echad ki ate ed echad mitztaref bahadeh michayyav al pi atzmo name ki atu edim michayyav
Leappoke midderav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav mode biknas veachar kach bau edim patur
Gufa amar rav huna amar rav mode biknas veachar kach bau edim patur etiveh rav chisda lerav huna maase berabban gamliel shessime et en tavi avdo vehaya sameach simcha gedola
Metzao lerabbi yehoshua amar lo i atta yodea shettavi avdi yatza lecherut amar lo lamma amar lo shessimmiti et eno amar lo en bidvarecha kelum shekkevar en lo edim
Ha yesh lo edim chayyav veshaminan minah mode biknas veachar kach bau edim chayyav
Amar leh shane rabban gamliel dela bifne bet din odi veha rabbi yehoshua av bet din hava

a: Shello bevet din hava kae
Vehatanya amar lo en bidvarecha kelum shekkevar hodita
May lav tannae hi hay tanna deamar shekkevar en lecha edim savar mode biknas veachar kach bau edim chayyav vehay tanna deamar shekkevar hodita savar mode biknas veachar kach bau edim patur
La dechulle alma mode biknas veachar kach bau edim patur uvha kamipalgi hay tanna deamar shekkevar en lecha edim savar chutz levet din hava vehach tanna deamar shekkevar hodita savar bevet din hava
Itmar mode biknas veachar kach bau edim rav amar patur ushmuel amar chayyav
Amar rava bar ahilay may tama derav im himmatze beedim timmatze bedayyanin perat lemarshia et atzmo
Lema li measher yarshiun nafka ella shema minah mode biknas veachar kach bau edim patur
Ushmuel amar lach hahu mibbee leh legannav atzmo kidtana deve chizkiyya
Etiveh rav lishmuel raa edim shemmemashmeshim uvaim veamar ganavti aval lo tavachti velo macharti eno meshallem ella keren amar leh hacha bemay askinan kegon shechazru edim laachorehem
Veha middetane sefa rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer yavou edim veyaidu mikkelal detanna kamma savar la
Amar leh shemuel lav ika rabbi elazar berabbi shimon dekae keoti ana daamari kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon
Lishmuel vadday tannae hi lerav mi lema tannae hi

Amar lecha rav ana daamari afilu lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hatam ella mishshum deka mode mechamat biatuta deedim aval hacha demode meatzmo afilu rabbi elazar berabbi shimon mode
Amar rav hamnuna mistabbera milteh derav beomer ganavti uvau edim shegganav patur shehare chiyyev atzmo bekeren
Aval amar lo ganavti uvau edim shegganav vechazar veamar tavachti umacharti uvau edim shettavach umachar chayyav shehare patar atzmo mikkelum
Amar rava kappachtinhu lesave deve rav deha rabban gamliel poter atzmo mikkelum hava vekaamar leh rav chisda lerav huna vela ka meshanne leh

Itmar name amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan ganavti uvau edim shegganav patur shehare chiyyev atzmo bekeren aval amar lo ganavti uvau edim shegganav vechazar veamar tavachti umacharti uvau edim shettavach umachar chayyav shehare patar atzmo mikkelum
Amar rav ashe matnitin uvarayeta name dayeka matnitin ditnan ganav al pi shenayim vetavach umachar al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo meshallem tashlume chefel veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Lema li detane ganav al pi shenayim litne ganav vetavach umachar al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo eno meshallem ella hakkeren
b: Ella lav ha ka mashma lan ganav al pi shenayim vetavach al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo hu dela mechayyev atzmo bekeren
Hu deamrinan al pi atzmo dumya deal pi ed echad ma al pi ed echad ki ate ed echad mitztaref bahadeh michayyav al pi atzmo name ki atu edim michayyav
Aval ganav vetavach umachar al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo dechiyyev atzmo bekeren la amrinan al pi atzmo dumya deal pi ed echad

Barayeta detanya raa edim shemmemashmeshin uvain veamar ganavti aval lo tavachti velo macharti eno meshallem ella keren lema li lemitne veamar ganavti aval lo tavachti velo macharti nitne o ganavti o tavachti umacharti

Ella ha ka mashma lan tama deamar ganavti hu dechiyyev atzmo bekeren defatur aval amar lo ganavti uvau edim shegganav vechazar veamar tavachti umacharti uvau edim shettavach umachar delo chiyyev atzmo bekeren chayyav alma hodaa ditvicha lav hodaa hi
Amri la hi gufah ka mashma lan dechevan deamar ganavti af al gav deamar lo tavachti velo macharti uvau edim shettavach umachar patur may tama
Tashlume arba chamishsha amar rachamana velo tashlume arbaa velo tashlume shelosha
Lema ketannae hau shenayim meidin shegganav vehau shenayim meidim oto shettavach umachar huzzammu ede geneva edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah
Huzzammu ede tevicha hu meshallem tashlume chefel vehen meshallemin tashlume shelosha mishshum somchos amru hen meshallemin tashlume chefel vehu meshallem tashlume shelosha lappar ushnayim laayil
Aheya kae somchos ilema aresha let leh lesomchos edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah
Veella assefa shappir kaamri rabbanan hu meshallem tashlume chefel vehem meshallemin tashlume shelosha

Ella milta achariti ika benayehu kegon deatu be tere amri leh ganavta amar lehu in ganavti vetavachti umacharti mihu lo bifnechem ganavti veayeti sahadi veazzeminhu dela beappayehu genav veayeti baal habbayit sahade veashidu beh deganav vetavach umachar
Uvhodaat tevicha kamipalgi
Derabbanan savri af al gav dehodaa digneva mechamat edim hu deka mode hodaa ditvicha hodaa hi ufatur
Vesomchos savar kevan dehodaa digneva mechamat edim hu deka mode ditvicha lav hodaa
Vehanach edim kammae deazzeminhu meshallemin tashlume chefel vehu meshallem shelosha lappar ushnayim laayil
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika la dechulle alma hodaa ditvicha lav hodaa hi

Ella beedut shei atta yachol lahazimah kamipalgi kegon deatu sahade veamri leh ganavta veamar lehu ganavti vetavachti umacharti mihu lo bifnechem ganavti ella bifne peloni ufloni veayeti sahadi veazzeminhu dela beappayehu genav vaato peloni ufloni veashidu beh deganav vetavach umachar
Uvha kamipalgi derabbanan savri haveya lah edut shei atta yachol lahazimah vechol edut shei atta yachol lahazimah la haveya edut
Vesomchos savar edut shei atta yachol lahazimah haveya edut
Veha kayema lan deedut shei atta yachol lahazimah la haveya edut hane mile hecha dela yadi beeze yom beeze shaa deleka leedut kelal aval hacha sayyoe hu deka mesayei leh
Amar mar hen meshallemin tashlume chefel middeka mode dignav keren bae shallome amar rabbi elazar mishshemeh derav teni

a: Tashlum dechefel
Ganav vehikdish veachar kach tavach umachar ku amri bishlama attevicha la michayyav dechi ka tavach dehekdesh ka tavach vela demareh ka tavach
Ella ahekdesh lichayyav ma li mecharo lehedot ma li mecharo lashshamayim
Ha manni rabbi shimon hi deamar kodashim shechayyav beachrautan birshuteh demareh kayemi
Ha middesefa rabbi shimon have resha lav rabbi shimon
Ella hacha bemay askinan bekadashim kallim vealliba derabbi yose haggelili deamar kadashim kallim mamon bealim hu uvirshuteh kayemi
Aval kodshe kadashim may meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha addetane resha ganav vetavach veachar kach hikdish meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha liflog velitne bedidah
Bamme devarim amurim bekadashim kallim aval bekodshe kodashim meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha

Ella leolam la shena kodshe kadashim vela shena kadashim kallim udkashya lach ma li mecharo lehedot ma li mecharo lashshamayim mecharo lehedot meikara tora diruven vehashta tora deshimon mecharo lashshamayim meikara tora diruven vehashta tora diruven
Rabbi shimon omer vechu amri nehi desavar rabbi shimon ma li mecharo lehedot ma li mecharo lashshamayim ipcha mibe leh
Kodashim shechayyav beachrautan patur deakkatti la nefak mershuteh
Kodashim sheeno chayyav beachrautan chayyav demappeki leh mershuteh
Amri rabbi shimon ammilta achariti kae
Vehachi katane en haggonev achar haggannav meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vechen gonev hekdesh mibbet bealim patur
May tama vegunnav mibbet haish velo mibbet hekdesh
Rabbi shimon omer kodashim shechayyav beachrautan chayyav may tama karena beh vegunnav mibbet haish vesheeno chayyav beachrautan patur dela karenan beh vegunnav mibbet haish
Mikkedi shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita kodashim name shechita sheenah reuya hi
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan beshochet temimim mibbifnim leshem bealim
Vahare chazra keren labbealim amar rabbi yitzchak bar avin shennishpach haddam
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan beshochet temimim bifnim shello leshem bealim
b: Veresh lakish amar beshochet baale mumin bachutz
Tahe bah rabbi elazar lerabbi yochanan shechita matteret vahalo zerika matteret
Leresh lakish shechita matteret vahalo pediyya matteret
Ishtemitteh ha derabbi shimon kol haomed lizrok kezaruk dame vechol haomed lifdot kefaduy dame
Kol haomed lizrok kezaruk dame detanya rabbi shimon omer yesh notar shehu metamme tumat ochalin veyesh notar sheeno metamme tumat ochalin
Ketzad lan lifne zerika eno metamme tumat ochalin leachar zerika metamme tumat ochalin
Vekayema lan may lifne zerika kodem shennira lizrika leachar zerika leachar shennira lizrika
Kodem shennira lizrika lan may hi dela haveya shehut bayyom lemizrekeh deshachteh samuch lishkiat hachamma veeno metamme tumat ochalin
Leachar shennira lizrika lan dahava shehut bayyom lemizrekeh metamme tumat ochalin alma kal haomed lizrok kezaruk dame
Vechol haomed lifdot kefaduy dame detanya rabbi shimon omer

a: Para metamme tumat ochalin hoil vehayeta lah sheat hakkosher
b: Veamar resh lakish omer haya rabbi shimon para nifdet al gabbe maarachtah alma kol haomed lifdot kefaduy dame
Bishlama rabbi yochanan la amar kerabbi shimon ben lakish deka bae leokomah lematnitin afilu bitmimin ella resh lakish may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan
Amar lach utvacho umcharo kol hecha deiteh bimchira iteh bitvicha vechol hecha deleteh bimchira leteh bitvicha vehane kodashim hoil dechi mezabben kodashim la haveya mechira letanhu bitvicha
Veazdu letamayehu deittemar hammocher terefa ledivre rabbi shimon rabbi yochanan amar chayyav veresh lakish amar patur
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyav af al gav deleteh bitvicha iteh bimchira veresh lakish amar patur kevan deleteh bitvicha leteh bimchira
Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish ganav kilayim utvachah terefa umcharah meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha may lav rabbi shimon hi alma af al gav deleteh bitvicha iteh bimchira
Amar leh la rabbanan
I rabbanan terefa bimchira itah bizvicha letah
Veella may rabbi shimon kilayim bitvicha itah bimchira letah
Ella tena tevicha vehu haddin limchira ema lerabbanan name tena mechira vehu haddin litvicha
Verabbi yochanan amar lach hay may i amratte bishlama rabbi shimon ayede ditna terefa bachada tena kilayim bachada
Ella i amratte rabbanan nearvinhu venitninhu ganav kilayim utrefa tevachan umcharan meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha kashya
Kilayim se ketiv veamar rava ze bana av kol makom shenneemar se eno ella lehotzi et hakkilayim
Shane hacha deamar kera o lerabbot et hakkilayim
Vechol o lerabbot hu vehatanya shor o chesev perat lechilayim o ez perat lenidme

Amar rava hacha meinyaneh dikra vehacha meinyaneh dikra hacha gabbe geneva dichtiv shor o se shei atta yachol lehotzi kilayim mibbenehem o lerabbot kilayim gabbe kodashim dichtiv kesev vaez sheatta yachol lehotzi kilayim mibbenehem o lemaet hu

a: Ha gabbe kodashim name neemar shor o chesev sheen atta yachol lehotzi kilayim mibbenehem unrabbe middesefa lemaet resha name lemaet adderabba midderesha lerabbot sefa name lerabbot
Hay may i amratte bishlama lemaet hu deitzterich tere miute deaf al gav deimaat kilayim itzterich lemaote nidme ella i amratte lerabbot tere ribuye lema hashta kilayim irabbi leh nidme mibbaya
Ella ha deamar rava ze bana av kol makom shenneemar se eno ella lehotzi et hakkilayim lemay hilcheta i lekadashim behedya ketiv behu shor o chesev perat lechilayim
I lemaaser tachattachat yalef mikkodashim
I livchor haavarahhaavara yalef mimmaaser
I name nidme amratte la dichtiv ach bechor shor ad sheyehe hu shor uvchoro shor kilayim mibbaya
Ella ki itmar derava leinyan peter chamor keditnan en podin lo beegel velo bechayya velo bishchuta velo bitrefa velo bechilayim velo bechoy
Ulrabbi elazar demattir bechilayim ditnan rabbi elazar mattir bechilayim mippene shehu se lemay hilcheta

Amar lach rabbi elazar ki itmar derava letame shennolad min hattahor veiburo min hattame udla kerabbi yehoshua dei rabbi yehoshua misse chesavim vese izzim nafka leh ad sheyehe aviv keves veimmo kivsa
Uthora mittemea mi miabbera in dekayema lan
b: Deiabbar mikkalut kerabbi shimon

Bae rava hare alay ola vehifrish shor uva acher veganav mi patar gannav nafsheh becheves lerabbanan beolat haof lerabbi elazar ben azarya ditnan hare alay ola yavi keves rabbi elazar ben azarya omer yavi tor o ben yona
May mi amrinan shem ola kabbel ilaveh o dilma matze amar leh ana mitzva min hammuvchar baena lemebad
Batar deibaya hadar pashtah gannav poter atzmo becheves lerabbanan beolat haof lerabbi elazar ben azarya
Rav acha bereh derav ika matne lah behedya amar rava hare alay ola vehifrish shor uva acher ugnavo poter atzmo becheves lerabbanan uvolat haof lerabbi elazar ben azarya
Matni mecharo chutz meechad mimmea shebbo o shehayeta lo bo shuttafut hashshochet venitnabbela beyado hannocher vehamakker meshallem tashlume chefel veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Gema may chutz meechad mimmea shebbo amar rav chutz middavar hannitar immo bishchita velevi amar chutz miggizoteha vechen tanya bematnita chutz miggizoteha
Metivi mecharah chutz miyyadah chutz meraglah chutz mikkarnah chutz miggizoteha eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha rabbi omer davar hamakkev bishchita eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Vesheeno meakkev bishchita meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer chutz mikkarnah eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha chutz miggizoteha meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Bishlama lelevi ketanna kamma ella lerav keman

Amri rav deamar ki hay tanna detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mecharah chutz miyyadah vechutz meraglah eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha chutz mikkarnah chutz miggizoteha meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Bemay kamipalgi tanna kamma savar utvacho kullo baenan umcharo kullo baenan
Verabbi savar utvacho mide dehave bitvicha leappoke mide dela haveya bitvicha umcharo dumya ditvicha
Verabbi shimon ben elazar savar karna dela lemiggaz kayema have shiyyur veeno meshallem tashlum arbaa vachamishsha gizoteha dilmigaz kayemi la have shiyyur umshallem tashlum arbaa vachamishsha
Veidach tanna deve rabbi shimon ben elazar savar yadav veraglav ditzrichi tevicha have shiyyur vela meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha karneha vegizoteha dela tzerichi tevicha la have shiyyur
Kashya derabbi shimon ben elazar adderabbi shimon ben elazar tere tannae vealliba derabbi shimon ben elazar
Tanu rabbanan haggonev hakkitaat veet hachigeret veet hassoma vechen haggonev behemat hashshuttafin chayyav veshuttafim shegganvu peturim vehatanya shuttafin shegganvu chayyavin
Amar rav nachman la kashya kan beshuttaf shegganav mechavero kan beshuttaf shegganav mealma
Etiveh rava lerav nachman yachol shuttaf shegganav mechavero veshuttafim shegganvu yehu chayyavin talmud lomar utvacho kullo baenan veleka
Ella amar rav nachman la kashya kan beshuttaf shettavach ledaat chavero kan beshuttaf shettavach shello ledaat chavero
Bae rabbi yirmeya mecharah chutz mishsheloshim yom chutz mimmelachtah chutz meubbarah mahu

Alliba deman deamar ubbar yerech immo hu la tibbee lach deha shayyar bah ki tibbee lach alliba deman deamar deubbar lav yerech immo may memar amrinan kevan dimchubbar bah have shiyyur o dilma kevan dilmifrash minah kae la have shiyyur
Ika deamri kevan delav yerech immo hu la have shiyyur o dilma kevan ditzrich leishteroye bahadah bishchita keman deshayyar begufah dame teku
Bae rav pappa genavah ketaah umcharah mahu mi amrinan may dignav ha la zabben o dilma ma dezabben ha la shayyar teku
Tanu rabbanan ganav venatan leacher vetavach ganav venatan leacher umachar

a: Ganav vehikdish ganav vehikkif ganav vehechlif ganav venatan bemattana ganav ufara chovo ganav ufara behekkefo ganav veshalach sivlonot bevet chamiv meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
May ka mashma lan ashmeinan resha ganav venatan leacher vetavach deyesh shaliach lidvar avera af al gav divchol hattora kullah en shaliach lidvar avera hacha yesh shaliach lidvar avera
May tama utvacho umcharo ma mechira dela efshar delav al yede acher af tevicha al yede acher michayyav
Veashmeinan sefa ganav vehikdish ma li mecharo lehedot ma li mecharo lashshamayim

Matni ganav birshut habbealim vetavach umachar chutz mershutam o shegganav chutz mershutam vetavach umachar birshutam o shegganav vetavach umachar chutz mershutam meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha aval ganav vetavach umachar birshutam patur
Haya moshcho veotze umet birshut habbealim patur higbiho o hotzio mershut bealim vamet chayyav
Netano livchorot beno o levaal chov leshomer chinnam leshoel lenose sachar ulsocher vehaya moshcho umet birshut habbealim patur higbiho o shehotzio mershut habbealim vamet chayyav
Gema bae ammemar tiknu meshicha beshomrim o lo

Amar rav yemar ta shema netano livchorot beno o levaal chovo leshomer chinnam ulshoel lenose sachar ulsocher haya moshcho veotze umet birshut habbealim patur may lav shomer ushma minah tiknu meshicha beshomrin
Amar leh la gannav
Ha tena leh resha tena gannav shegganav mibbet habbealim utna gannav shegganav mibbet shomer
Amar leh rav ashe la tedachayeh ma li gannav shegganav mibbet shomer ma li gannav shegganav mibbet bealim
Ella lav shomer ushma minah tiknu meshicha beshomrin shema minah itmar name amar rabbi elazar kederech shettiknu meshicha belakochot kach tiknu meshicha beshomrin
Tanya name hachi kederech shettiknu meshicha belakochot kach tiknu meshicha beshomrin uchshem shehakkarka niknet bechesef bishtar uvachazaka kach sechirut niknet bechesef bishtar uvachazaka
Sechirut demay ilema
b: Sechirut demittaltelin mittalteli bene shetara ninhu amar rav chisda sechirut dekarka
Amar rabbi elazar rauhu shehitmin bachorashin vetavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha ammay ha lo mashach amar rav chisda shehikkishah bemakkel
Amri vechevan derauhu gazlan hu kevan deka mittammaroy minnayehu gannav hu
Veella gazlan hechi dame amar rabbi avahu kegon benayahu ben yehoyada shenneemar vayyigzol et hachanit miyyad hammitzri vayyahargehu bachanito
Rabbi yochanan amar kegon baale shechem shenneemar vayyasimu lo vaale shechem mearvim al rashe heharim vayyigzelu et kol asher yaavor alehem baddarech
Verabbi avahu may tama la amar mehay amar lach kevan demittammeri itammore la gazlane ninhu verabbi yochanan ha deka mittammeri dela nichzinhu inashe venireku minnayehu
Shaalu talmidav et rabban yochanan ben zakkay mippene ma hechmira tora begannav yoter miggazlan amar lahen ze hishva kevod eved lichvod kono veze lo hishva kevod eved lichvod kono

Kivyachol asa ayin shel matta keilu enah roa veozen shel matta keilu enah shomaat shenneemar hoy hammaamikim me lastir etza vehaya vemachshach maasehem vego uchtiv vayyomru lo yire yah velo yavin elohe yaakov uchtiv ki amru azav Adonai et haaretz veen Adonai roe

Tanya amar rabbi meir mashlu mashal mishshum rabban gamliel lema haddavar dome lishne bene adam shehau beir veasu mishte echad zimen et bene hair velo zimen et bene hammelech veechad lo zimen et bene hair velo zimen et bene hammelech eze mehen onsho merubbe heve omer ze shezzimen et bene hair velo zimen et bene hammelech
Amar rabbi meir bo ure kamma gadol koach shel melacha shor shebbitlo mimmelachto chamishsha se shello bitlo mimmelachto arbaa
