Amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay bo ure kamma gadol kevod habberiyyot shor shehalach beraglav chamishsha se shehirkivo al ketefo arbaa
Matni en megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael aval megaddelin besurya uvammidbarot shel eretz yisrael
En megaddelin tarnegolin birushalayim mippene hakkodashim velo kohanim beeretz yisrael mippene hatteharot
En megaddelin chazirin bechol makom lo yegaddel adam et hakkelev ella im ken haya kashur beshalshelet en porsin nishuvim leonim ella im ken haya rachok min hayyishshuv sheloshim ris
Gema tanu rabbanan en megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael aval megaddelin bachorashin shel eretz yisrael besurya afilu bayyishshuv veen tzarich lomar bechutza laaretz

Tanya idach en megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael aval megaddelin bammidbar shebbihuda uvammidbar shebbisfar akko veaf al pi sheamru en megaddelin behema dakka aval megaddelin behema gassa lefi sheen gozrin gezera al hatztzibbur ella im ken rov tzibbur yecholin laamod bah
Behema dakka efshar lehavi mechutza laaretz behema gassa i efshar lehavi mechutza laaretz
Veaf al pi sheamru en megaddelin behema dakka aval meshahah hu kodem laregel sheloshim yom vekodem mishte beno sheloshim yom uvilvad shello yeshahe et haacharona sheloshim yom
Desalka datach amena dei nefak leh regel umikki zavnah ad hashta akkatti la melo leh telatin yomin la nema telatin mishra shere leh leshahoye ella kevan dinfak leh regel la mibbee leh leshahoye

a: Vehattabbach lokeach veshochet lokeach veshohe uvilvad shello yeshahe haaguna shebbahen sheloshim yom
Shaalu talmidav et rabban gamliel mahu legaddel amar lahen muttar vehatnan en megaddelin
Ella hachi ka bau mineh mahu leshahot amar lahen muttar uvilvad shello tetze vetire baeder ella koshrah bechare hammitta

Tanu rabbanan maase bechasid echad shehaya goneach millibbo veshaalu larofim veamru en lo takkana ad sheyyinak chalav roteach mishshacharit leshacharit veheviu lo ez vekashru lo bechare hammitta vehaya yonek mimmenna mishshacharit leshacharit
Leyamim nichnesu chaverav levakkero kevan sherau otah haez keshura bechare hammitta chazru laachorehem veamru listim mezuyyan beveto shel ze veanu nichnasin etzlo
Yashvu uvadku velo matzu bo ella oto aon shel otah haez veaf hu bishat mitato amar yodea ani sheen bi aon ella aon otah haez sheavarti al divre chaveray

Amar rabbi yishmael mibbaale vattim shebbaggalil haelon hau bet abba umippene ma charvu shehau marin bachorashin vedanin dine mamonot beyachid veaf al pi shehau lahem chorashim samuch levattehem sade ketanna hayeta umaavirin derech aleha

Tanu rabbanan roe sheasa teshuva en mechayevin oto limkor miyyad ella mocher al yad al yad vechen ger shennaflu lo kelavim vachazirim birushshato en mechayevin oto limkor miyyad ella mocher al yad al yad
Vechen mi shennadar likach bayit velikach ishsha beeretz yisrael en mechayevin oto likach miyyad ad sheyyimtza et hahogenet lo

Umaase beishsha achat shehaya benah metzer lah vekaftza venishbea kol mi sheyyavo eni machzirato vekaftzu aleha bene adam sheenan mehugganin uchshebba haddavar etzel chachamim amru lo nitkavvena zo ella lehagun lah
Keshem sheamru en megaddelin behema dakka kach amru en megaddelin chayya dakka rabbi yishmael omer megaddelin kelavim kufrin vachatulim vekofin vechuldot senaim mippene sheasuyim lenakker et habbayit
May chuldot senaim amar rav yehuda shirtza chartza veika deamri charza dekattine shakah veraaya bene vardine umay shirtza demittattiy shakah
Amar rav yehuda amar rav asinu atzmenu bevavel keeretz yisrael livhema dakka amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerav huna didach may

Rav ushmuel verav assi iklau leve shevua habben veamri lah leve yeshua habben rav la ayel kammeh dishmuel
b: Shemuel la ayel kammeh derav assi rav assi la ayel kammeh derav amri man nittarach nittarach shemuel venete rav verav assi
Venittarach rav o rav assi rav milta bealma hu daavad leh lishmuel mishshum hahu maase delatyeh adbereh rav aleh
Addehachi vehachi ata shunara kateh lida deyanoka nefak rav udrash chatul muttar lehorgo veasur lekayemo veen bo mishshum gazel veen bo mishshum hashev aveda labbealim
Vechevan deamratte muttar lehorgo may nihu tu asur lekayemo mahu detema muttar lehorgo isura leka ka mashma lan
Amri vechevan deamratte en bo mishshum gazel may nihu tu en bo mishshum hashev aveda labbealim amar ravina leoro
Metivi rabbi shimon ben elazar omer megaddelin kelavim kufrin vachatulin vekofin vechuldot senaim mippene sheasuyin lenakker et habbayit la kashya ha beukkama ha bechiuora
Veha maase derav ukkama hava hatam ukkama bar chivara hava veha miva bae leh ravina
Devae ravina ukkama bar chivara mahu ki kamibbaya leh leravina beukkama bar chivara bar ukkama maase derav beukkama bar chivara bar chivara hava

Siman amar rabbi acha bar pappa mishshum rabbi abba bar pappa mishshum rabbi adda bar pappa veamri lah amar rabbi abba bar pappa mishshum rabbi chiyya bar pappa mishshum rabbi acha bar pappa veamri lah amar rabbi abba bar pappa mishshum rabbi acha bar pappa mishshum rabbi chanina bar pappa
Matriin al hachikuch beshabbat vedelet hanninelet lo bimhera tippatach vehallokeach bayit beeretz yisrael kotvin alav ono afilu beshabbat
Metivi ushar puraniyyot hammitraggeshot uvaot al hatztzibbur kegon chikuch chagav zevuv tzira veyattush veshiluach nechashim veakrabbim lo hau matriin ella tzoakim

La kashya kan belach kan beyavesh deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi shechin shehevi hakkadosh baruch hu al hammitzrim lach mibbachutz veyavesh mibbifnim shenneemar vayehi shechin avabuot poreach baadam uvabbehema

Vedelet hanninelet lo bimhera tippatach may hi mar zutra amar semicha rav ashe amar kol hammeriin lo lo bimhera metivin lo rav acha middifti amar leolam en metivin lo vela hi rav acha middifti milta denafsheh hu deamar
Vehallokeach bayit beeretz yisrael kotvin alav ono afilu beshabbat beshabbat salka datach
Ella kidamar rava hatam omer legoy veose hachi name omer legoy veose veaf al gav daamira legoy shevut hi mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael la gezaru beh rabbanan
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan hallokeach ir beeretz yisrael kofin oto likach lah derech mearba ruchoteha mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael
Tanu rabbanan asara tenain hitna yehoshua

a: Sheyehu marin bachorashin umlakketin etzim bisdotehem umlakketim asavim bechol makom chutz mittiltan vekotmim netiot bechol makom chutz miggerofiyyot shel zayit umayan hayyotze battechila bene hair mistappekin mimmennu umchakkin beyammah shel teverya uvilvad shello yifros kela veyaamid et hassefina

Venifnin laachore haggader vaafilu besade melea karkom umhallechim bishvile harshut ad shettered revia sheniyya umistallekin letzide hadderachim mippene yetedot hadderachim vehattoe ben hakkeramim mefasseg veole mefasseg veored umet mitzva kone mekomo
Sheyehu marin bachorashin amar rav pappa la amaran ella dakka begassa aval dakka bedakka vegassa begassa la vechol shekken gassa bedakka dela
Umlakketin etzim missedotehem la amaran ella behizme vehige aval bishar etzim la vaafilu behizme vehige la amaran ella bimchubbarin aval bitlushin la
Vaafilu bimchubbarin la amaran ella belachin aval biveshin la uvilvad shello yesharesh
Umlakketin asavim bechol makom chutz missede tiltan lememra detiltan meallu lah asavim urminhi tiltan shealta im mine asavim en mechayevin oto laakor
Amar rav yirmeya la kashya kan lezera kan lezirin lezera kashu lah asavim demachchashi lah lezirin mealle lah dechi kayemi bene asavim mirakkeva
Ibaet ema kan leadam kan livhema dechevan delivhema hu dezarah asavim name mibe lah umna yadinan amar rav pappa sharya meshare leadam la sharya meshare livhema

Vekotmin netia bechol makom chutz miggerofiyyot shel zayit pershu rabbi tanchum verabbi biryas mishshum zaken echad bezayit kevetza bekanim uvigfanim min happekak ulmala ushar kol hailanot min ubbo shel ilan velo min chuddo shel ilan
Min chadash sheeno ose perot velo min yashan shehu ose perot mimmekom sheeno roe et hachamma
b: Velo mimmekom shehu roe et hachamma shenneemar umimmeged tevuot shamesh
Umayan hayyotze techila bene hair mistappekin mimmennu amar rabba bar rav huna venoten lo damim velet hilcheta keoteh

Umchakkin beyammah shel teverya uvilvad shello yifros kela veyaamid et hassefina aval tzad hu birshatot uvmichmarot tanu rabbanan barishona hitnu shevatim ze im ze shello yifros kelia veyaamid et hassefina aval tzad hu birshatot uvmichmarot
Tanu rabbanan yammah shel teverya bechelko shel naftali hayeta velo od ella shennatal melo chevel cherem bidromah lekayyem ma shenneemar yam vedarom yerasha
Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer telushin shebbeharim bechezkat kol hashshevatim hen omdim umchubbarim bechezkat oto hashshevet

Veen lecha kol shevet veshevet miyyisrael sheen lo bahar uvashshefela uvannegev uvaemek shenneemar penu usu lachem uvou har haemori veel kol shechenav baarava vahar bashshefela uvannegev uvchof hayyam vego vechen atta motze bakkenaanim uvapperizim uvaemoriyyim shellifnehem shenneemar veel kol shechenav alma shechenav hachi hau

Venifnin laachore haggader vaafilu besade shehi melea karkom amar rav acha bar yaakov lo nitzrecha ella litol hemennu tzeror amar rav chisda vaafilu beshabbat mar zutra chasida shakel umahdar vaamar leh leshammaeh limchar zil shirkeh
Umhallechin bishvile harshut ad shettered revia sheniyya amar rav pappa vehay didan afilu tal kashe leh

Umsallekin letzide hadderachim mippene yetedot hadderachim shemuel verav yehuda hao shakli veazli beorcha hava mistallak shemuel letzide hadderachim amar leh rav yehuda tenain shehitna yehoshua afilu bevavel amar leh sheani omer afilu bechutza laaretz

Rabbi verabbi chiyya hao shakli veazli beorcha istallaku letzide hadderachim hava ka mefassa veazel rabbi yehuda ben kenosa nekosa kammayehu amar leh rabbi lerabbi chiyya mi hu ze shemmare gedulla befanenu

Amar leh rabbi chiyya shemma rabbi yehuda ben kenosa nekosa talmidi hu vechol maasav leshem shamayim ki meto legabbeh chazyeh amar leh i lav yehuda ben kenosa nekosa atte gezartinhu leshakach begizra defarzela

Hattoe ben hakkeramim mefasseg veored mefasseg veole tanu rabbanan haroe chavero toe ben hakkeramim mefasseg veole mefasseg veored ad shemmaalehu lair o ladderech vechen hu shettoe ben hakkeramim mefasseg veole mefasseg veored ad sheyyaale lair o ladderech
May vechen mahu detema chavero hu deyada lehecha mesallek denifsog aval hu dela yeda lehecha ka salek la nifsog nahdereh nehdar mihdar be mitzre ka mashma lan
Ha deorayeta hu detanya hashavat gufo minnayin talmud lomar vahashevoto
Deorayeta hu dekae be mitzre ata hu takken dimfasseg veole mefasseg veored
Umet mitzva kana mekomo urminhi hammotze met mutal beisratya mefannehu limin isratya o lismol isratya sede vur usde nir mefannehu lisde vur
Sede nir usde zera mefannehu lisde nir hau shettehen burot shettehen nirot shettehen zeruot mefannehu lemakom sheyyirtze
Amar rav bivi bemuttal al hammetzar mittoch shennitan lefannoto mefannehu lechol makom sheyyirtze
Amri asara hane chad sere haveyan mehallechin bishvile harshut shelomo amrah

Kidtanya hare shekkalu perotav min hassade veeno manniach bene adam likanes betoch sadehu ma habberiyyot omrot alav ma hanaa yesh lifloni uma habberiyyot mazzikot lo alav hakkatuv omer mihot tov al tikkare ra umi ketiv mihot tov al tikkare ra in ketiv ki hay gavena al timna tov mibbealav bihot leel yadcha laasot

Vetu leka veha ika derabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer bishat hotzaat zevalim adam motzi zivlo lirshut harabbim vetzovro kol sheloshim kede sheyehe nishof beragle adam uvragle vehema sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz

Bichidae la kaamrinan

a: Veha ki ata rabbi avin amar rabbi yochanan echad ilan hannote letoch sede chavero veechad ilan hassamuch lammetzer mevi vekore sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz

Ella man tana asara tenain shehitna yehoshua rabbi yehoshua ben levi hu rav geviha mibbe chetil matne lah behedya rabbi tanchum verabbi biryas amri mishshum zaken echad umannu rabbi yehoshua ben levi asara tenain hitna yehoshua

Asara takkanot tiken ezra shekkorin bammincha bashshabbat vekorin besheni uvachamishi vedanin besheni uvachamishi umchabbesim bachamishi bashshabbat veochlin shum beerev shabbat veshettehe ishsha mashkemet veofa veshettehe ishsha chogeret besinar veshettehe ishsha chofefet vetovelet vesheyehu rochlin machazirin baayarot vetiken tevila levaale kerayin
Sheyehu korin bammincha bashshabbat mishshum yoshve keranot

Vesheyehu korin besheni uvachamishi ezra tiken veha meikara hava mitakna detanya vayyelchu sheloshet yamim bammidbar velo matzu mayim dorshe reshumot amru en mayim ella tora shenneemar hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim

Kevan shehalchu sheloshet yamim belo tora nilu amdu neviim shebbenehem vetiknu lahem sheyehu korin bashshabbat umafsikin beechad bashshabbat vekorin besheni umafsikin shelishi urvii vekorin bachamishi umafsikin erev shabbat kede shello yalinu shelosha yamim belo tora
Meikara tikkenu chad gavra telata pesuke i name telata gavre telata pesuke keneged kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim ata hu taken telata gavre veasra pesuke keneged asara batlanin
Vedanin besheni uvachamishi dishchichi deatu lemikre besifra
Vesheyehu mechabbesin bachamishi bashshabbat mishshum kevod shabbat

Vesheyehu ochlin shum beerev shabbat mishshum ona dichtiv asher piro yitten beitto veamar rabbi yehuda veitema rav nachman veitema rav kahana veitema rabbi yochanan ze hamshammesh mittato meerev shabbat leerev shabbat
Tanu rabbanan chamishsha devarim neemru bashshum masbia umashchin umatzhil panim umarbe hazzera vehoreg kinnim shebbivne meayim veyesh omrim machnis ahava umotzi et hakkina
Veshettehe ishsha mashkemet veofa kede shettehe pat metzuya laaniyyim
Veshettehe ishsha chogeret besinar mishshum tzeniuta
Veshettehe ishsha chofefet vetovelet deorayeta hi
Detanya verachatz et besaro bammayim shello yehe davar chotzetz ben besaro lammayim et besaro et hattafel livsaro umay nihu sear

Vetiken tevila levaale kerayin deorayeta hu dichtiv veish ki tetze mimmennu shichvat zara verachatz et besaro bammayim deorayeta hu litruma vekadashim ata hu tiken afilu ledivre tora
Asara devarim neemru birushalayim en habbayit chalut bah veenah mevia egla arufa veenah naaset ir hanniddachat

Veenah mittammea bingaim veen motziin bah zizin ugzuzteraot veen osin bah ashpattot veen osin bah kivshonot veen osin bah gannot ufardesot chutz miggannot veradin shehau mimot neviim harishonim veen megaddelim bah tarnegolin veen melinin bah et hammet
En habbayit chalut bah dichtiv vekam habbayit asher lo choma latztzemitut lakkone oto ledorotav vekasavar lo nitchalleka yerushalayim lishvatim
Veenah mevia egla arufa dichtiv ki yimmatze chalal baadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha lerishtah virushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim
Veenah naaset ir hanniddachat dichtiv arecha virushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim
Veenah mittammea bingaim dichtiv venatatti nega tzaraat bevet eretz achuzzatchem virushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim
Veen motziin bah zizin ugzuzteraot mippene ohel hattuma umishshum dela litazku ole regalim
Veen osin bah ashpattot mishshum shekatzim
Veen osin bah kivshonot mishshum kutra

Veen megaddelin bah tarnegolin mishshum kodashim
Veen melinin bah et hammet gemara

Amri shane bet rabban gamliel shehau kerovim lammalchut vechidtanya hamsapper kome hare ze middarche haemori avtulmos bar reuven hittiru lo lesapper kome mippene shehu karov lammalchut shel bet rabban gamliel hittiru lahem lesapper bechochmat yevanit mippene shekkerovim lammalchut

Lo yegaddel adam et hakkelev ella im ken kashur beshalshelaot ku tanu rabbanan lo yegaddel adam et hakkelev ella im ken kashur beshalshelet aval megaddel hu bair hassemucha lassefar vekoshro bayyom umattiro ballayela
Tanya rabbi eliezer haggadol omer hamgaddel kelavim kimgaddel chazirim lemay nafka minah lemekam aleh bearur
Amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman bavel keir hassemucha lassefar dame targemah nehardea

Hahi itta deallat lemefa behahu beta nevach bah kalba amar lah mareh la tistefay mineh shekili niveh amara leh shekila tevutach veshadya achizre kevar nad valad

Umeshat sheloshim ris vetu la vehatanya bayyishshuv afilu mea mil lo yifros rav yosef amar beyishshuv keramim rabba amar beyishshuv shovachin
Vetipok leh mishshum shovachin gufayehu ibaet ema bidgoy veibaet ema bidhefker veibaet ema bedideh
