Benezek ketzad sime et eno kata et yado shiber et raglo roin oto keilu hu eved nimkar bashshuk veshamin kamma haya yafe vechamma hu yafe
Tzaar kevao o beshappud o bemasmer vaafilu al tziporno mekom sheeno ose chabbura omdin kamma adam kayyotze baze rotze litol lihot mitztaer kach

Ripuy hikkahu chayyav lerappooto ala bo tzemachim im mechamat hammakka chayyav shello mechamat hammakka patur chayeta venistera chayeta venistera chayyav lerappooto chayeta kol tzorkah eno chayyav lerappooto
Shevet roin oto keilu hu shomer kishuin shekkevar natan lo deme yado udme raglo
Boshet hakkol lefi hamvayyesh vehammitbayyesh
Gema ammay ayin tachat ayin amar rachamana ema ayin mammash

La salka datach detanya yachol sime et eno mesamme et eno kata et yado mekattea et yado shiber et raglo meshabber et raglo talmud lomar makke adam umakke vehema ma makke vehema letashlumin af makke adam letashlumin
Veim nafshecha lomar hare hu omer lo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach asher hu rasha lamut lenefesh rotzeach i atta lokeach kofer aval atta lokeach kofer lerashe evarim sheen chozrin
He makke ilema makke vehema yeshallemenna umakke adam yumat hahu biktala ketiv

Ella mehacha makke nefesh behema yeshallemenna nefesh tachat nafesh usmich leh veish ki yitten mum baamito kaasher asa ken yease lo hay lav makke hu hakkaahhakkaa kaamrinan ma hakkaa haamura bivhema letashlumin af hakkaa haamura beadam letashlumin
Veha ketiv veish ki yakke kol nefesh adam mot yumat bemamon mimmay divmamon ema bemita mammash
La salka datach chada deha itakkash lemakke vehema yeshallemenna veod ketiv batreh kaasher yitten mum baadam ken yinnaten bo ushma minah mamon
Umay im nafshecha lomar tu ka kashya letanna may chazet deyalfatte mimmakke vehema lelaf mimmakke adam
Amri danin nezakin minnezakin veen danin nezakin mimmita adderabba danin adam meadam veen danin adam mibbehema

Hayenu dekatane im nafshecha lomar hare hu omer lo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach asher hu rasha lamut ki mot yumat lenefesh rotzeach i atta lokeach kofer aval atta lokeach kofer lerashe evarim sheenan chozrin

Vehay lo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach lemaote rashe evarim hu daata hay mibbee leh deamar rachamana la taaved beh tarte la tishkol mineh mamon vetikteleh hay mikkede rishato nafka risha achat atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo shette rishaot

Veakkatti mibbee leh dekaamar rachamana la tishkol mamon vetiftereh im ken lichtov rachamana lo tikkechu chofer laasher hu rasha lamut lenefesh rotzeach lema li shema minah lenefesh rotzeach i atta lokeach kofer aval atta lokeach kofer lerashe evarim sheenan chozrin

Vechi meachar dichtiv lo tikkechu chofer makkehmakke lema li amri i mehay hava amena i bae eno nitev vei bae deme eno nitev ka mashma lan mibbehema ma makke vehema letashlumin af makke adam letashlumin
Tanya rabbi dostay ben yehuda omer ayin tachat ayin mamon atta omer mamon o eno ella ayin mammash amarta hare shehayeta eno shel ze gedola veeno shel ze ketanna heach ani kore beh ayin tachat ayin
Vechi tema kal ki hay shakel mineh mamona hattora amra mishpat echad yihye lachem mishpat hashshave lechullechem
Amri may kushya dilma nehora shekal mineh nehora amar rachamana nishkol mineh dei la tema hachi

a: Katan sheharag et haggadol vegadol sheharag et hakkatan hechi katlinan leh hattora amra mishpat echad yihye lachem mishpat hashshave lechullechem ella neshama shekal mineh neshama amar rachamana nishkol mineh hachi name nehora shekal mineh nehora amar rachamana nishkol mineh

Tanya idach rabbi shimon ben yochay omer ayin tachat ayin mamon atta omer mamon o eno ella ayin mammash hare shehaya some vesime kitea vekita chiger vechiger heach ani mekayyem baze ayin tachat ayin vehattora amra mishpat echad yihye lachem mishpat hashshave lechullechem
Amri umay kushya dilma hecha deefshar efshar hecha dela efshar la efshar ufatrinan leh dei la tema hachi terefa sheharag et hashshalem may avdinan leh
Ella hecha deefshar efshar hecha dela efshar la efshar ufatrinan leh
Deve rabbi yishmael tana amar kera ken yinnaten bo veen netina ella mamon ella meatta kaasher yitten mum baadam hachi name demamon hu

Amri deve rabbi yishmael kera yattira darshi mikkede ketiv veish ki yitten mum baamito kaasher asa ken yease lo ken yinnaten bo lema li shema minah mamon kaasher yitten mum baadam lema li ayede devae michtav ken yinnaten bo ketav name kaasher yitten mum baadam
Deve rabbi chiyya tana amar kera yad beyad davar hannitan miyyad leyad umay nihu mamon ella meatta regel beragel name hachi hu

Amri deve rabbi chiyya kera yattira ka darshi mikkede ketiv vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv i salka datach mammash yad beyad lema li shema minah mamon regel beragel lema li ayede dichtiv yad beyad ketav name regel beragel

Abbaye omer atya middetane deve chizkiyya detana deve chizkiyya ayin tachat ayin nefesh tachat nafesh velo nefesh veayin tachat ayin vei salka datach mammash zimnin demashkachatte lah ayin vanefesh tachat ayin devahade deavar leh nefaka leh nishmeteh

Umay kushya dilma memad amdinan leh i matze mekabbel avdinan vei la matze mekabbel la avdinan vei amdinan dematze mekabbel veavdinan beh unfak rucheh i mayet lemut mi la tenan gabbe malkot amaduhu umet tachat yado patur
Rav zevid mishshemeh derabba amar amar kera petza tachat patza liten tzaar bimkom nezek vei salka datach mammash ki hechi dilhay have leh tzaara lehay name it leh tzaara
Umay kushya dilma ika inish dimfannak it leh tzaara tefe veika inish dela mefannak let leh tzaara lemay nafka minah lemittavoy leh hayech devene bene
Rav pappa mishshemeh derava amar amar kera verappo yerappe liten refua bimkom nezek vei salka datach mammash ki hechi dehay bae asya hay name bae asya
May kushya dilma ika desalek bisreh hayya veika dela salek bisreh hayya lemay nafka minah lemitav leh hayech devene bene
Rav ashe amar atya tachattachat mishshor ketiv hacha ayin tachat ayin uchtiv hatam shallem yeshallem shor tachat hashshor ma lehallan mamon af kan mamon
May chazet deyalfatte tachattachat mishshor nelaf tachattachat meadam dichtiv venatatta nefesh tachat nefesh ma lehallan mammash af kan mammash
Amri danin nezakin minnezakin veen danin nezakin mimmita adderabba danin adam meadam veen danin adam mibbehema
Ella amar rav ashe mittachat asher innah yalef leh adam meadam unzikin minnezikin
Tanya rabbi eliezer omer ayin tachat ayin mammash mammash salka datach rabbi eliezer let leh kechol hane tannae
Amar rabba lomar sheen shamin oto keeved amar leh abbaye ella keman keven chorin ben chorin mi it leh dame ella amar rav ashe lomar sheen shamin oto benizak ella bemazzik

Hahu chamra dekatta yeda deyanoka ata lekammeh derav pappa bar shemuel amar lehu zilu shumu leh arbaa devarim amar leh rava veha anan chamishsha tenan amar leh levar minnezek kaamena amar leh abbaye veha chamor hu vachamor eno meshallem ella nezek amar lehu zilu shumu leh nizkeh veha keavda bae lemishyemeh amar lehu zilu shayemuhv keavda
Amar lehu avuh deyanoka la baena dezila beh milta amaru leh veha ka mechayevatte leh leyanoka amar lehu lechi gadel mefayyesna leh middidi
Hahu tora daalas yedeh deyanoka ata lekammeh derava amar lehu zilu shayemuhv keavda amaru leh veha mar hu deamar kol hannishom keeved en govin oto bevavel amar lehu la tzericha dei tefas
Rava letameh deamar rava nizke shor beshor venizke shor beadam govin oto bevavel nizke adam beadam venizke adam beshor en govin oto bevavel
May shena nizke adam beadam venizke adam beshor dela elohim baenan veleka nizke shor beshor veshor beadam name
b: Elohim baenan veleka
Ella may shena shor beshor veshor beadam dishlichutayehu ka avdinan mide dehave ahodaot vehalvaot adam beadam veadam beshor name shelichutayehu ka avdinan mide dehave ahodaot vehalvaot
Amri ki ka avdinan shelichutayehu bemide dekim lan begaveh bemide dela kim lan begaveh la avdinan shelichutayehu
Amri shor beshor veshor beadam name la kim lan begaveh ella pok chazi hecha kamma mizdabbeni tore beshuka adam beadam veadam beshor name pok chazi hecha kamma mizdabbeni avde beshuka
Veod tashlum kefel vetashlum arbaa vachamishsha dekitzi naaved shelichutayehu
Amri ki ka avdinan shelichutayehu bemamona biknasa la avdinan shelichutayehu
Adam beadam demamona hu naaved shelichutayehu ki ka avdinan shelichutayehu bemilta dishchicha adam beadam dela shechicha la avdinan shelichutayehu

Hare boshet ufgam dishchiach naaved shelichutayehu amri hachi name deha rav pappa agbi arba mea zuze levoshet veha leteh lidrav pappa dishlach leh rav chisda lerav nachman ushlach leh chisda chisda kenasa ka magbet bevavel

Ella ki avdinan shelichutayehu bemilta dishchicha veit beh chesron kis aval milta dishchicha velet beh chesron kis i name milta dela shechicha veit beh chesron kis la avdinan shelichutayehu hilkach adam beadam af al gav deit beh chesron kis kevan dela shechicha la avdinan shelichutayehu boshet af al gav dishchicha kevan delet beh chesron kis la avdinan shelichutayehu

Veshor beshor govin bevavel vehaamar rava shor shehizzik en govin oto bevavel deazzek man ilema deazzek adam may irya shor deazzek adam afilu adam deazzek adam name en govin oto bevavel ella peshita deazzek shor vekatane en govin oto bevavel
Amri hatam betam hacha bemuad vehaamar rava en muad bevavel amri deiyyaad hatam veayetuh lehacha

Veha milta dela shechicha hi umilta dela shechicha ha amratte dela avdinan shelichutayehu daato rabbanan dehatam veyaaduh hacha sof sof milta dela shechicha hi veatte amratte milta dela shechicha la ka avdinan shelichutayehu
Ella ki kaamar rava beshen varegel demuadin mittechilatan ninhu
Tzaar keoo beshappud o bemasmer vechu tzaar shello bimkom nezek mishtallem man tanna amar rava ben azzay hi detanya rabbi omer keviyya neemra techila ben azzay omer chabbura neemra techila
Bemay ka mipalgi rabbi savar keviyya delet bah chabbura mashma ketav rachamana chabbura legalloye alah dichviyya deit bah chabbura in i la la
Uven azzay savar keviyya deit bah chabbura mashma ketav rachamana chabbura legalloye alah dichviyya delet bah chabbura
Matkef lah rav pappa adderabba ipcha mistabbera rabbi omer keviyya neemra techila savar keviyya deit bah chabbura mashma ketav rachamana chabbura legalloye alah dichviyya delet bah chabbura
Ben azzay omer chabbura neemra techila savar keviyya delet bah chabbura mashma ketav rachamana chabbura legalloye alah dichviyya deit bah chabbura in i la la veammassekana kayemi
I name dechulle alma keviyya ben deit bah chabbura ben delet bah chabbura mashma vehacha

a: Bichlal ufrat hamruchakim ze mizze kamipalgi
Rabbi savar en danin oto bichlal ufrat uven azzay savar danin oto bichlal ufrat vechi tema chabbura lerabbi lema li ledamim yeterim
Omdin kamma adam kayyotze baze rotze litol vechu tzaar bimkom nezek hechi shayeminan

Amar avuh dishmuel omdin kamma adam rotze litol liktoa lo yado liktoa lo yado la tzaar lechodeh hu ha kullehu chamishsha devarim ika veod beshuftane askinan ella liktoa yado hakketua yado hakketua name la tzaar lechodeh ika ha tzaar uvoshet ika dichsifa leh milta lemishkal mibbesaro lemishdeyeh lichlavim
Ella omdin kamma adam rotze litol liktoa lo yado hammuchtevet lammalchut ben sam lesayif amri hacha name la shakel umtzaar nafsheh
Ella omdin kamma adam rotze liten liktoa lo yado hammuchtevet lammalchut ben sayif lesam
Hay litol liten mibbee leh amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua litol ze mizze ma shennatan ze

Rippuy hikkahu chayyav lerappooto vechu tanu rabbanan alu bo tzemachim mechamat hammakka venistera hammakka chayyav lerappooto vechayyav liten lo deme shivto shello mechamat hammakka eno chayyav lerappooto veeno chayyav liten lo deme shivto

Rabbi yehuda omer af mechamat hammakka chayyav lerappooto veeno chayyav liten lo deme shivto vachachamim omrim shivto urfuato kol shechayyav beshevet chayyav beripuy vesheeno chayyav beshevet eno chayyav beripuy
Bemay ka mipalgi amar rabba ashkachtinhu lerabbanan beve rav deyatvi vekaamri hacha bemakka nitna leeged kamipalgi
Rabbanan savri makka nitna leeged verabbi yehuda savar makka lo nitna leeged ripuy ditna beh kera michayyav shevet dela tena beh kera la michayyav
Veamena lehu ana i makka lo nitna leeged ripuy name la michayyav ella dechulle alma makka nitna leeged velo nitna leeged yetera

Rabbi yehuda savar kevan delo nitna leeged yetera ripuy ditna beh kera michayyav shevet dela tena beh kera la michayyav verabbanan savri kevan ditna beh kera beripuy ashshevet name michayyav deitakkash leripuy
Verabbi yehuda savar shevet la michayyav demaateh rachamana rak verabbanan rak leshello mechamat hammakka hu daata

Ulrabbanan batrae deamri kol shechayyav beshevet chayyav beripuy vechol sheeno chayyav beshevet eno chayyav beripuy ripuy ditna beh kara lema li mibe leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael detanya deve rabbi yishmael omer verappo yerappe mikkan shennitan reshut larofe lerappoot

Tanu rabbanan minnayin sheim alu bo tzemachim mechamat hammakka venistera hammakka shechayyav lerappooto vechayyav liten lo shivto talmud lomar rak shivto yitten verappo yerappe yachol afilu shello mechamat hammakka talmud lomar rak rabbi yose bar yehuda omer af mechamat hammakka patur shenneemar rak
Ika deamri af mechamat hammakka patur ligmare kerabbanan batrae veika deamri af mechamat hammakka patur mishshevet vechayyav beripuy keman kaavuh
Amar mar yachol afilu shello mechamat hammakka talmud lomar rak shello mechamat hammakka bae kera

Amri may shello mechamat hammakka kidtanya hare sheavar al divre rofe veachal devash o kol mine metika mippene sheddevash vechol mine metika kashin lammakka veheela makkato gargutni yachol yehe chayyav lerappooto talmud lomar rak may gargutni amar abbaye nata kerichta may asuteh ahala vekira vekalba
Vei amar leh asyach ana amar leh damet alay kearya arva vei amar leh mayetina asya demaggan bemaggan amar leh asya demaggan bemaggan maggan shave
Vei amar mayetina lach asya rachika amar leh asya rachika ena avar

Vei amar leh hayech hav li ledidi vaana massena nafshay amar leh pashatte benafshach veshaklatte minay tefe vei amar leh kutz li mikkatz amar leh kol shekken defashatte benafshach vekaru li shor hammazzik
Tana vechullan mishtallemin bimkom nezek menahane mile amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava amar kera petza tachat patza liten tzaar bimkom nezek
Hay mibbee leh
b: Lerabbot shogeg kemezid veones keratzon im ken nichtov kera petza befatza may petza tachat patza shema minah tarte
Rav pappa mishshemeh derava amar amar kera verappo yerappe liten refua bimkom nezek

Hay mibbee leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael verappo yerappe mikkan shennitna reshut larofe lerappoot im ken nichtov kera verofe yerappe shema minah liten refua bimkom nezek
Veakkatti mibbee leh lichdaamaran lemitne beh kera beripuy im ken lema kera o rappo rappo o yerappe yerappe may verappo yerappe shema minah liten refua bimkom nezek
Michlal demashkachatte lehu shello bimkom nezek shello bimkom nezek hechi mashkachatte lehu

Tzaar kidkatane tzaar keoo beshappud o bemasmer vaafilu al tzipporno mekom sheeno ose chabbura ripuy dahava kaev leh mide uslek veayeti leh samma charifa veachvereh levisreh ditzrich leotove leh samma leankoteh gavena devisreh
Shevet dehaddekeh beinderona uvatteleh boshet derak leh beappeh

Shevet roin oto keilu hu shomer kishuin tanu rabbanan shevet roin oto keilu hu shomer kishuin veim tomar lakta middat haddin dechi mitfach hay gavra lav agra deshomer kishuin hu shakel ella dale davela veshakel agra i name azel bishlichuta veshakel agra
Middat haddin lo lakta shekkevar natan lo deme yado udme raglo
Amar rava kitta et yado noten lo deme yado veshevet roin oto keilu hu shomer kishuin shiber et raglo noten lo deme raglo veshevet roin oto keilu hu shomer et happetach
Sime et eno noten lo deme eno veshevet roin oto keilu hu matchino berechayim chersho noten lo deme chullo

Bae rava kitta et yado velo amaduhu shiber et raglo velo amaduhu sime et eno velo amaduhu ulvassof chersho mahu mi amrinan kevan dela amaduhu bechad umdana saggi leh veyahev leh deme chulleh bahade hadade o dilma chada chada amdinan veyahavinan leh

Nafka mineh devae lemitav leh tzaar uvoshet dechol chada vachada nehi denezek veripuy veshevet dechol chada vachada la yahavinan leh dechevan deka yahev leh deme chulleh keman dekatleh dame veha yehav leh deme chulleh tzaar uvoshet mihat dechol chada vachada yahev deha hava leh tzaar uvoshet
Veim timtze lomar kevan delo amaduhu ka yahev leh deme kulleh bahade hadade amaduhu mahu mi amrinan kevan daamaduhu chada chada bae lemitav leh o dilma kevan dela shallem yahev leh deme chulleh teku
Bae rabba shevet happochatto bedamim mahu hechi dame kegon shehikkahu al yado vetzamta yado vesofah lachazor may kevan desofah lachazor la yahev leh vela mide o dilma hashta mihat afchateh
Ta shema hammakke aviv veimmo velo asa bahen chabbura vehachovel bachavero beom hakkippurim

a: Chayyav bechullan
Hay lo asa bo chabbura hechi dame lav kegon shehikkahu al yado vesofo lachzor vekatane chayyav bechullan
Amri hacha bemay askinan kegon shechersho velo asa bo chabbura vehaamar rabba hachoresh cheresh et aviv neherag lefi shei efshar lacharisha belo chabbura tipta didma nefala leh beudneh
Ella hacha bemay askinan kegon sheggilcho gilcho mihdar hadar vehayenu bayan
Amri hacha bemay askinan kegon shessacho nasha dela hadar

Tzaar deit leh kartufane beresheh vetzavachoy leh mehanhu kartufane ripuy devae assoye shevet dahava merakked be chubbe devae machve gavene aresheh vela machve mehanhu kartufane boshet en lecha boshet gadol mizze

Umilta devaya leh lerabba peshita leh leabbaye lehach gisa ulrava lehach gisa deittemar hikkahu al yado vetzamta vesofah lachazor abbaye amar noten lo shevet gedola veshevet ketanna verava amar eno noten lo ella deme shivto shebbechol yom vaom
Itmar hakkotea yad eved ivri shel chavero abbaye amar noten lo shevet gedola laeved veshevet ketanna larav rava amar hakkol yinnaten laeved veyillakach bahen karka veharav ochel perot
Peshita pichet etzel atzmo veetzel rabbo lo pichet hechi dame defaskeh leresh unne o leresh nechireh hakkol leatzmo pichet etzel rabbo pelugta deabbaye verava
Boshet hakkol lefi hamvayyesh vehammitbayyesh manni matnitin la rabbi meir vela rabbi yehuda ella rabbi shimon hi

Ditnan vechullan roin otan keilu hem bene chorin sheyyardu minnichsehem shehen bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer haggadol lefi godlo vehakkatan lefi kotno rabbi shimon omer ashirim roin otan keilu hem bene chorin sheyyardu minnichsehem aniyyim kifchutin shebbahen

Manni hashta i rabbi meir matnitin katane hakkol lefi hamvayyesh vehammitbayyesh verabbi meir kullehu bahade hadade ninhu vei rabbi yehuda matnitin katane hamvayyesh et hassome chayyav veilu rabbi yehuda omer some en lo boshet ella lav rabbi shimon hi
Afilu tema rabbi yehuda ki amar rabbi yehuda some en lo boshet lemishkal mineh aval lemitva leh yahavinan leh
Veha middekatane sefa hamvayyesh et hayyashen chayyav veyashen shebbiyyesh patur vela katane some shebbiyyesh patur mikkelal dela shena hachi vela shena hachi ella mechavarta matnitin rabbi shimon hi

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan nitkaven levayyesh et hakkatan uviyyesh et haggadol noten laggadol deme voshto shel katan levayyesh et haeved uviyyesh et ben chorin noten leven chorin deme voshto shel eved manni la rabbi meir vela rabbi yehuda vela rabbi shimon

Ka salka datach katan katan binchasim gadol gadol binchasim i rabbi meir haamar kullehu bahade hadade ninhu vei rabbi yehuda haamar en laavadim boshet vei rabbi shimon haamar nitkaven levayyesh et ze uviyyesh et ze patur
May tama kiktala ma ketala ad demitkaven leh dichtiv vearav lo vekam alav ad sheyyitkaven lo boshet name ad demikaven leh dichtiv veshalcha yadah vehechezika bimvushav ad sheyyitkaven lo
Leolam rabbi yehuda vechi kaamar rabbi yehuda en laavadim boshet lemitva lehu aval lemesham shayeminan behu
Vei baet ema afilu tema rabbi meir mi savratte gadol gadol binchasim katan katan binchasim lo gadol gadol mammash vekatan katan mammash
Vekatan bar boshet hu in kidamar rav pappa demachlemu leh umiklam hacha name
b: Demachlemu leh umiklam

Matni hamvayyesh et hearom hamvayyesh et hassome vehamvayyesh et hayyashen chayyav veyashen shebbiyyesh patur nafal min haggag vehizzik uviyyesh chayyav al hannezek ufatur al habboshet ad sheyehe mitkaven
Gema tanu rabbanan biyesho arom chayyav veeno dome biyesho arom leviyesho lavush biyesho bevet hammerchatz chayyav veeno dome biyesho bevet hammerchatz leviyesho bashshuk
Amar mar biyesho arom chayyav arom bar boshet hu amar rav pappa may arom daata zika karchinhu lemaneh vaata hu dallinhu tefe uvayesheh
Biyesho bevet hammerchatz chayyav bet hammerchatz bar boshet hu amar rav pappa shebbiyesho al gav hannahar
Bae rabbi abba bar memel biyesho yashen vamet mahu may kamibbaya leh amar rav zevid hachi kamibbaya leh mishshum kisufa hu veha mit leh velet leh kisufa o dilma mishshum ziluta hu veha ozleh
Ta shema rabbi meir omer cheresh vekatan yesh lahen boshet shote en lo boshet i amratte bishlama mishshum ziluta hayenu dekatane katan ella i amratte mishshum kisufa katan bar boshet hu
Ella may mishshum ziluta afilu shote name amri shote en lecha boshet gedola mizzo
Mikkol makom nifshot minah demishshum ziluta hu dei mishshum kisufa katan bar kisufa hu kidamar rav pappa demachlemu leh umiklam hacha name demachlemu leh umiklam
Rav pappa amar hachi kamibbaya leh mishshum kisufa dideh hu vehu miyt leh o dilma mishshum boshet mishpacha
Ta shema cheresh vekatan yesh lo boshet shote en lo boshet i amratte bishlama mishshum boshet mishpacha hayenu dekatane katan ella i amratte mishshum kisufa dideh katan bar boshet hu
Ella may mishshum boshet divne mishpacha afilu shote name shote en lecha boshet gedola mizzo
Mikkol makom nifshot minah demishshum boshet mishpacha dei mishshum kisufa katan bar kisufa hu amar rav pappa in demachlemu leh umiklam
Vehatanya rabbi omer cheresh yesh lo boshet shote en lo boshet katan peamim yesh lo peamim en lo ha demachlemu leh umiklam ha demachlemu leh vela miklam

Hamvayyesh et hassome vechu matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer some en lo boshet vechach haya rabbi yehuda poter mechayyave galiyyot umechayyave malkiyyot umechayyave mitot bet din
May tama derabbi yehuda gamar enechaenecha meedim zommin ma hatam somin la af hacha somin la
Mechayyave galiyyot detanya belo reot perat lassome divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer lerabbot et hassome
May tama derabbi yehuda amar lach vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar lachtov etzim vaafilu some ketav rachamana belo reot lemaote
Verabbi meir ketav rachamana belo reot lemaote uchtav rachamana bivli daat lemaote have miut achar miut veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot
Verabbi yehuda hahu bivli daat perat lemitkaven hu daata
Chayyave mitot bet din atya rotzecharotzeach mechayyave galiyyot
Chayyave malkiyyot atya rasharasha mechayyave mitot bet din
Tanya idach rabbi yehuda omer some en lo boshet

a: Vechen haya rabbi yehuda potro mikkol dinim shebbattora may tama derabbi yehuda amar kera veshaftu haeda ben hammakke uven goel haddam al hammishpatim haelle kol sheyyeshno bemakke uvgoel haddam yeshno bemishpatim kol sheeno bemakke uvaggoel haddam eno bemishpatim

Tanya idach rabbi yehuda omer some en lo boshet vechen haya rabbi yehuda potro mikkol mitzot haamurot battora amar rav shisha bereh derav idi may tama derabbi yehuda amar kera veelle hammitzot hachukkim vehammishpatim kol sheyyeshno bemishpatim yeshno bemitzot vechukkim vechol sheeno bemishpatim eno bemitzot vechukkim
Amar rav yosef meresh hava amena man deamar halacha kerabbi yehuda deamar some patur min hammitzot ka avedna yoma tava lerabbanan may tama dela mippakkadna veka avedna mitzot

Vehashta dishmait leha derabbi chanina deamar rabbi chanina gadol hamtzuve veose mimmi sheeno metzuve veose man deamar li en halacha kerabbi yehuda avedna yoma tava lerabbanan may tama dechi mippakkadna it li agra tefe
Matni ze chomer baadam mibbashshor shehaadam meshallem nezek tzaar ripuy shevet uvoshet umshallem deme veladot veshor eno meshallem ella nezek ufatur middeme veladot
Hammakke et aviv veet immo velo asa bahen chabbura vechovel bachavero beom hakkippurim chayyav bechullan
Hachovel beeved ivri chayyav bechullan chutz min hashshevet bizman shehu shello hachovel beeved kenaani shel acherim chayyav bechullan rabbi yehuda omer en laavadim boshet
Cheresh shote vekatan pegiatan raa hachovel bahen chayyav vehem shechavlu baacherim peturin
Haeved vehaishsha pegiatan raa hachovel bahem chayyav vehem shechavlu baacherim peturin aval meshallemin leachar zeman nitgarsha haishsha nishtachrer haeved chayyavin leshallem
Hammakke aviv veimmo veasa bahen chabbura vehachovel bachavero beshabbat patur mikkullan mippene shehu niddon benafsho
Vehachovel beeved kenaani shello patur mikkullan
Gema bea mineh rabbi elazar merav hachovel bevat ketanna shel acherim chavala lemi

Mi amrinan kevan deakni leh rachamana shevach neurim leav chavala name daavuh have may tama deha afchatah mikkaspah o dilma shevach neurim hu deakni leh rachamana dei bae lemimsar lah lemukke shechin matze masar aval chavala kevan dei bae mitchbal bah la matze chavel la kanyeh akni leh rachamana
b: Amar leh lo zikketa tora laav ella shevach neurim bilvad etiveh hachovel beeved ivri chayyav bechullan chutz min hashshevet bizman shehu shello amar abbaye mode rav beshevet demaase yadeha ad sheat bagrut daavuh have
Etiveh hachovel bivno gadol yitten lo miyyad bivno katan yaase lo segulla hachovel bevitto ketanna patur velo od ella acherim shechavlu bah chayyavin liten leaviha hachi name beshevet
Uvivno gadol yitten lo miyyad urminhu hachovel bevanav uvivnotav shel acherim gedolim yitten lahem miyyad ketannim yaase lahem segulla bevanav uvivnotav shello patur
Amri la kashya kan keshessemuchim al shulchano kan kesheen semuchin al shulchano

Bemay okemtah lekammayeta besheen semuchin al shulchano i hachi ema sefa hachovel bevitto hakketanna patur velo od ella acherim shechavlu bah chayyavin liten leaviha ledidah bae lemitav lah devaya mezone

Vaafilu leman deamar yachol harav lomar laeved ase immi veeni zanach hane mile beeved kenaani deamar leh aved avidta kulle yoma ulurta zil sechar veechol aval eved ivri dichtiv ki tov lo immach immecha bemaachal immecha bemishte lo kol shekken bitto
Kidamar rava bereh derav ulla lo nitzrecha ella lehadafa hacha name la nitzrecha ella lehadafa
Bemay okemtah levatrayeta bismuchin al shulchano gedolim yitten lahem miyyad ketannim yaase lahem segulla ammay laavihem bae lemitav
Amri ki ka kafed bemide deka chasar bemide daata mealma la kafed
Veha metzia demealma kaate lehu veka kafed amri ravecha dekaate lehu mealma velet lehu tzaara degufayehu begavah kafed aval chavala deit lehu tzaara degufayehu umealma kaate lehu la kafed
Veha hatam deit lah tzaara degufa umealma kaate lah veka kafed dekatane velo od ella afilu acherim shechavlu bah chayyavin liten leaviha

Amri hatam degavra kafdana hu deha en semuchin al shulchano afilu bemide deate lehu mealma kafed hacha delav gavra kafdana hu deha semuchin al shulchano ki ka kafed bemide deka chasar leh bemide deate lehu mealma la kafed
May segulla rav chisda amar sefer tora rabba bar rav huna amar dikla deachel mineh tamre
Vechen amar resh lakish lo zikketa tora laav ella shevach neurim bilvad verabbi yochanan amar afilu petzia
Petzia salka datach afilu rabbi elazar la kamibaya leh ella chavala

a: Deafchatah mikkaspah aval petzia dela afchatah mikkaspah la kamibaya leh
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina sheppetzaah befaneha veafchatah mikkaspah

Hachovel beeved kenaani shel acherim chayyav vechu may tama derabbi yehuda amar kera ki yinnatzu anashim yachdav ish veachiv bemi sheyyesh lo achva yatza eved sheen lo achva verabbanan achiv hu bemitzot
Ella meatta lerabbi yehuda zomme eved lo yehargu dichtiv vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv amar rava amar rav sheshet amar kera uviarta hara mikkirbecha mikkol makom
Ella meatta lerabbanan eved yehe kasher lammalchut amri ultamach tikshe lach ger ledivre hakkol ella amar kera mikkerev achecha mimmuvchar shebbeachecha
Ella meatta lerabbanan yehe eved kasher leedut dichtiv vehinne ed sheker haed sheker ana veachiv
Amar ulla edut la matzet amratte atya edut bekal vachomer meishsha uma ishsha shehi reuya lavo bakkahal pesula leedut eved sheeno rauy lavo bakkahal eno din sheppasul leedut
Ma leishsha shekken enah reuya lemila tomar beeved shehu rauy lemila katan yochiach sheyyeshno bemila ufasul leedut
Ma lekatan sheeno bemitzot tomar beeved shehu bemitzot ishsha tochiach sheyyeshnah bemitzot ufsula leedut
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze chiri ze velo rei ze chiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken enan bechol hammitzot ufsulin lehaid af ani avi et haeved sheeno bechol hammitzot ufasul lehaid
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahem shekken eno ish tomar beeved shehu ish
Ella tete miggazlan ma legazlan shekken maasav garmu lo tomar beeved sheen maasav garmu lo
Ella tete miggazlan umechad mehanach

Mar bereh deravina amar amar kera lo yumtu avot al banim lo yumtu al pi avot sheen lahem chayis banim dei salka datach kidamrinan lo yumtu avot al banim beedut banim lichtov rachamana lo yumtu avot al benehem may banim shema minah delo yumtu al pi avot sheen lahem chayis banim
Ella meatta uvanim lo yumtu al avot hachi name lo yumtu al pi banim sheen lahem chayis avot ella ger hachi name defasul leedut
Amri hachi hashta ger nehi deen lo chayis lemala lematta yesh lo chayis leappoke eved deen lo chayis lo lemala velo lematta

Dei salka datach ger pasul leedut lichtov rachamana lo yumtu avot al benehem lechidamrinan lo yumtu beedut banim venichtov rachamana uvanim lo yumtu al avot deshamatte minah tere chada lo yumtu banim beedut avot veidach lo yumtu al pi banim sheen lahem chayis avot
Veeved nafka leh bekal vachomer migger uma ger dilmala hu deen lo chayis aval lematta yesh lo chayis pasul leedut eved sheen lo chayis lo lemala velo lematta eno din sheyehe pasul leedut

Ella middichtav rachamana lo yumtu avot al banim demashma lo yumtu al pi avot sheen lo chayis banim shema minah eved sheen lo chayis lo lemala velo lematta hu defasul leedut aval ger kevan deyesh lo chayis lematta kasher leedut

Vechi tema lichtov rachamana uvanim lo yumtu al avotehem lema li dichtav rachamana uvanim lo yumtu al avot demashma lo yumtu al pi banim sheen lahem chayis avot ayede dichtav la yumtu avot al banim ketav name uvanim lo yumtu al avot
Cheresh shote vekatan pegiatan raa imeh derav shemuel bar abba mehagronya havat nesiva leh lerabbi abba ketavtinhu lenichse lenichsah lerav shemuel bar abba berah batar dishchiva
b: Azal rav shemuel bar abba kammeh derabbi yirmeya bar abba okmeh benichse azal rabbi abba amrah lemilta kammeh derav hoshaya azal rav hoshaya amrah kammeh derav yehuda amar leh hachi amar shemuel haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah vameta habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot

Amruha kammeh derabbi yirmeya bar abba amar lehu ana matnita yadana ditnan hakkotev nechasav livno leachar moto habben eno yachol limkor mippene shehen birshut haav vehaav eno yachol limkor mippene shehen ketuvin labben machar haav mechurim ad sheyyamut machar habben en lo lallokeach ad sheyyamut haav
Ki mayet av miha it leh lelokeach veaf al gav demet habben bechayye av dela ato lide habben
Kerabbi shimon ben lakish deamar la shena met habben bechayye haav dela ato lideh deven la shena met haav bechayye habben daato lideh deven kana lokeach
Deittemar machar habben bechayye haav umet habben bechayye haav rabbi yochanan amar lo kana lokeach resh lakish amar kana lokeach

Rabbi yochanan amar lo kana lokeach amar lach ki katane matnitin machar habben lo kana lokeach ad sheyyamut haav vechi mayet haav it leh lelokeach delo met habben bechayye haav daato lide habben aval met habben bechayye haav dela ato lideh deven ki mayet av name let leh lelokeach
Alma ka savar kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame vechi zabben lav dideh zabben

Rabbi shimon ben lakish omer kana lokeach ki katane matnitin machar habben en lallokeach ad sheyyamut haav ki mayet av mihat it leh lelokeach la shena la met habben bechayye haav daato lideh deven vela shena met habben bechayye haav dela ato lideh deven kana lokeach
Alma kasavar kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame vechi ka zabben dideh ka zabben

Vaanan hashta ben rabbi yirmeya bar abba uven rav yehuda kerabbi shimon ben lakish sevira lehu vekaamar rabbi yirmeya bar abba i salka datach kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame ki mayet av umayet habben bechayye haav ammay it leh lelokeach ki ka zabben hay lav dideh ka zabben
Ella lav shema minah kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame
Ahderuha lekammeh derav yehuda amar lehu hachi amar shemuel zo enah doma lemishnatenu
May tama amar rav yosef bishlama i tane ipcha hakkotev nechasav leaviv ika lemifshat minah dekinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame
Ella hashta dekatane hakkotev nechasav livno mishshum derauy leorsho hu
Amar leh abbaye attu bera yaret abba abba la yaret bera ella leavrochinhu lenichse mibbereh ka ate hacha name leavrochinhu lenichse meachuh ate
Ella may enah doma lemishnatenu mishshum takkanat usha deamar rabbi yose bar chanina beusha hitkinu haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah umeta habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot
Amar rav idi bar avin af anan name tenena meidim anu beish peloni sheggerash et ishto venatan ketubbatah

a: Vahare hi tachtav umshammashto venimtzeu zommin en omrim yeshallemu kol ketubbatah ella tovat hanaat ketubbatah ezehu tovat hanaat ketubbatah omdin kamma adam rotze liten bichtubba shel zo sheim nitarmela o nitgarsha veim meta yirashenna baalah
Vei salka datach letah letakkanat usha ammay yirashenna baalah tezabben ketubbetah ligmare
Amar abbaye im amru benichse melog yomru benichse tzon barzel

Amar abbaye tovat hanaa hoil vaata leyadan nema bah milta tovat hanaa leishsha haveya dei salka datach levaal haveya lemru lah edim may afsednich i hava mezabbenatte lah letovat hanaa baal hava shakel minich amar rav shalman mishshum deika revach beta
Amar rava hilcheta tovat hanaa laishsha veen habbaal ochel perot may tama pera takkinu leh rabbanan pera defera la takkinu leh rabbanan

Ki ata rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua mibbe rav amri tenena letakkanat usha haeved vehaishsha pegiatan raa hachovel bahen chayyav vehem shechavlu baacherim peturin vei salka datach letah letakkanat usha tezabben nichse melog vetitten leh
Ultamach nehi name deitah letakkanat usha vela matze mezabbena ligmare tezabben lenichse melog betovat hanaa vetitten leh ella delet lah hachi name delet lah
Utzabben ketubbetah betovat hanaa vetitten leh ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar asur lo leadam sheyeshahe et ishto afilu shaa achat belo ketubba
Vetama may kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah hacha la megaresh lah dei megaresh lah atu hanach dezavni gavu lah lichtubbetah mineh
Ella tovat hanaa mile ninhu umile la mishtabedi
Allema la mile demizdabbeni bedinare ninhu ella mishshum dishmuel deamar shemuel hammocher shetar chov lachavero vechazar umchalo machul vaafilu yoresh mochel
Amri zabbone tezabben vetitten leh vei machala leh legabbe vaal timchalah
Amri kol legabbe vaal vadday machala leh veafsedineh lehahu zevina beyadayim la afsedinhu
Vechi tema zevina tezabbenah nihaleh lehahu dachavala beh betovat hanaa
b: Dei machala legabbe vaal la ka mafsed dehashta name la mide ka yahava leh sof sof kol legabbe vaal vadday machala veatroche be dina bichdi la matrechinan
Ella ha detanya vechen hi shechavla bevalah lo hifsida ketubbatah ammay tezabbeninah nihaleh lichtubbetah levalah betovat hanaa beha chavala dei machala legabbe vaal leka peseda
Ha vadday rabbi meir hi deamar asur leadam sheyeshahe et ishto afilu shaa achat belo ketubba
Vetama may kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah hacha megaresh lah vegave leh bachavaleh minah i hachi hashta name megaresh lah vegave leh bachavaleh minah
Kegon dinfisha ketubbetah demishshum hahu purta la mafsed tuva
Vei dinfisha ketubbetah mikketubba deorayeta nokmah akketubba deorayeta veidach tezabbenah nihaleh bachavaleh
Kegon dela nefisha ketubbetah mikketubba deorayeta dehave chavaleh arbea zuze demishshum arbea zuze la mafsed esrim vechamsha
Ella ha detanya keshem shello timkor vehi tachtav kach lo tafsid vehi tachtav veha zimnin mashkach lah demafseda vehechi dame kegon dinfisha ketubbetah mikketubba deorayeta
Amar rava sefa atan lichtubbat benin dichrin

Vehachi katane keshem shehammocheret ketubbatah laacherim lo hifsida ketubbat benin dichrin may tama zuze hu deansuha kach mocheret ketubbatah levalah lo hifsida ketubbat benin dichrin may tama zuze hu deansuha
Lema takkanat usha tannae hi detane chada avde melog yotzin beshen vaayin laishsha aval lo laish vetanya idach lo laish velo laishsha
Savruha dechulle alma kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame may lav beha ka mipalgi deman deamar laishsha let leh takkanat usha uman deamar lo laish velo laishsha it leh takkanat usha
La dechulle alma it lehu takkanat usha ella kan kodem takkana kan leachar takkana
Vei baet ema ide veide leachar takkana veit lehu takkanat usha ella leman deamar laishsha velo laish may tama kidrava deamar rava

a: Hekdesh chametz veshichrur mafkiim mide shibud
Lema derava tannae hi la dechulle alma it lehu derava vehacha almuh rabbanan leshibuda devaal
Veibaet ema dechulle alma let lehu lehane tannae takkanat usha vehacha bekinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame kamipalgi
Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya hammocher avdo leacher ufasak immo al menat sheyeshammeshennu sheloshim yom
Rabbi meir omer rishon yeshno bedin yom o yomayim mippene shehu tachtav kasavar kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame
Rabbi yehuda omer sheni yeshno bedin yom o yomayim mippene shehu kaspo kasavar kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame

Rabbi yose omer shenehem yeshnan bedin yom o yomayim ze mippene shehu tachtav veze mippene shehu kaspo mesappeka leh kinyan perot i kekinyan hagguf dame i lav kekinyan hagguf dame vesafek nefashot lehakel
Rabbi eliezer omer shenehem enan bedin yom o yomayim ze lefi sheeno tachtav veze lefi sheeno kaspo
Amar rava may tama derabbi eliezer amar kera ki chaspo hu kaspo hamuchad lo
Keman azla ha deamar ammemar ish veishsha shemmachru benichse melog lo asu velo kelum keman kerabbi eliezer

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin vechen eved shel shene shuttafin en yotzin berashe evarim sheenan chozrin amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hachi amri mishshemeh derava rabbi eliezer hi
Mi la amar rabbi eliezer kaspo hamuchad lo hacha name avdo hamuchad lo
Matni hattokea lachavero noten lo sela rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili mane setaro noten lo matayim zuz leachar yado noten lo arba meot zuz
Tzaram beozno talash bisaro rakak vehiggia bo rukko heevir tallito mimmennu para rosh haishsha bashshuk noten lo arba meot zuz
b: Ze hakkelal hakkol lefi kevodo amar rabbi akiva afilu aniyyim shebbeyisrael roin otam keilu hem bene chorin sheyyardu minnichsehem shehem bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov
Umaase beechad sheppara rosh haishsha bashshuk bat lifne rabbi akiva vechiyevo liten lah arba meot zuz amar lo rabbi ten li zeman venatan lo zeman
Shemarah omedet al petach chatzerah veshavar et hakkad befaneha uvo keisar shemen gilta et roshah vehayeta metappachat umannachat yadah al roshah
Heemid aleha edim uva lifne rabbi akiva amar lo lazo ani noten arba meot zuz
Amar lo lo amarta kelum hachovel beatzmo af al pi sheeno rashshay patur acherim shechavlu bo chayyavim vehakkotzetz netiotav af al pi sheeno rashshay patur acherim chayyavin
Gema ibaya lehu mane tzori tenan o mane medina tenan
Ta shema dehahu gavra ditka leh lechavreh ata lekammeh derabbi yehuda nesia amar leh ha ana ha rabbi yose haggelili hav leh mane tzori shema minah mane tzori tenan shema minah
May ha ana ha rabbi yose haggelili ilema hachi kaamar leh ha ana dachazetach veha rabbi yose haggelili deamar mane tzori zil hav leh mane tzori lememra deed naase dayyan
Vehatanya sanhedrin sherau echad sheharag et hannefesh miktzatan naasu edim umiktzatan naasu dayyanin divre rabbi tarfon rabbi akiva omer kullam edim hem veen ed naase dayyan
Ad kan la kaamar rabbi tarfon ella demiktzatan naasu edim umiktzatan naasu dayyanin aval ed naase dayyan la kaamar
Ki tanya hahi kegon sherau ballayela dela lemebad bene mebad dina ninhu
Veibaet ema hachi kaamar leh ha ana disvira li kerabbi yose haggelili deamar mane tzori veha sahadi demashadi bach zil hav leh mane tzori
Vesavar rabbi akiva deen ed naase dayyan
Vehatanya vehikka ish et reehu beeven o veegrof shimon hattimni omer ma egrof meuchad shemmasur laeda velaedim af kol shemmasur laeda velaedim perat lesheyyatzta mittachat yad haedim
Amar lo rabbi akiva vechi bifne bet din hikkahu sheyyodin kamma hikkahu veal ma hikkahu im al shoko o tzipar nafsho
Veod hare sheddachaf et chavero merosh haggag o merosh habbira vamet bet din holchin etzel bira o vira holechet etzel bet din veod im nafla chozer uvone
Ella ma egrof meuchad shehu masur laedim af kol shehu masur laedim
Perat lichsheyyatzta even mittachat yado shel makke patur
Katane mihat amar lo rabbi akiva vechi bifne bet din hikkahu sheyyodin kamma hikkahu ha hikkahu bifnehem ed naase dayyan
Lidvarav derabbi shimon hattimni kaamar veleh la sevira leh
Tanu rabbanan shor tam shehemit vehizzik danin oto dine nefashot veen danin oto dine mamonot
Muad shehemit vehizzik danin oto dine mamonot vechozrin vedanin oto dine nefashot kadmu vedanuhu dine nefashot en chozrin vedanin oto dine mamonot
Vechi kadmu vedanuhu dine nefashot may have lihdar velidayeneh name dine mamonot
Amar rava ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi vekaamri ha manni rabbi shimon hattimni hi deamar ma egrof meuchad shemmasur laeda velaedim

a: Alma baenan umdana deve dina veha kevan digmar dineh liktala la meshahenan leh leumdana deve dina vela meannenan ledineh
Veamena lehu ana afilu tema rabbi akiva hacha bemay askinan kegon shebbarach
I barach ki lo danuhu dine nefashot hechi dayeninan leh dine mamonot belo bealim dekabbel sahadi uvarach
Sof sof mehecha mishtallam meridya i hachi tam nedayeneh dine mamonot beresha venishtallam meridya vahadar nedayeneh dine nefashot
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana zot omeret ridya aliyya demareh hu
Ibaya lehu yesh omed linzakin o en omed linzakin
Mi amrinan liktala hu deamdinan behachi nafka neshama behachi la nafka neshama aval linzakin kol dehu o dilma la shena
Ta shema ma bor sheyyesh bo kede lehamit asara tefachim af kol sheyyesh bo kede lehamit asara tefachim hau pechutin measara tefachim venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet patur huzzak bo chayyav
May lav mimmatta lemala ka chashev vehachi kaamar mittefach vead asara mita leka nezakin ika alma linzakin kol dehu shema minah en omdin linzakin
Lo mimmala lematta ka chashev vehachi kaamar asara mita ika pachot measara purta nezakin ita mita leka ulolam ema lach yesh omed linzakin vechol mide umide ki hechi demitazka beh baenan

Ta shema hikkahu al eno vesimo al ozno vechersho eved yotze bahen lecherut keneged eno veeno roe keneged ozno veeno shomea en eved yotze bahen lecherut may tama lav mishshum devaenan umdana ushma minah yesh umdana linzakin
La mishshum deamrinan hu deavet nafsheh kidtanya hammavit et chavero patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim ketzad taka beozno vechersho patur achazo vetaka beozno vechersho chayyav
Ta shema chamishsha devarim omdin oto venotnin lo miyyad ripuy vashevet ad sheyyitrappe amaduhu vehaya mitnavene veholech en notnin lo ella kemo sheamaduhu

Amaduhu vehivri notnin lo kol ma sheamaduhu shema minah yesh omed linzakin lememad gavra kamma liktzar meha makka kamma la mikketzar la ka mibbee lan devadday amdinan ki ka mibbaya lan lememad cheftza i aved hay nizka o la may
Ta shema shimon hattimni omer ma egrof meuchad shemmasur laeda velaedim af kol meuchad shemmasur laeda velaedim shema minah yesh omed linzakin shema minah

Amar mar amaduhu vehivri notnin lo kol ma sheamaduhu mesayya leh lerava deamar rava hay man daamaduhu lechulle yoma veitfach lefalga deoma veka aved avidta yahavinan leh dechulle yoma min shemayya hu derachame derachimu aleh
Rakak vehiggia bo harok veheevir ku amar rav pappa lo shanu ella bo aval bevigdo la venihve ki viyyesh bidvarim
Amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose bar avin zot omeret biyesho bidvarim patur mikkelum
Hakkol lefi chevodo vechu ibaya lehu tanna kamma lekulla kaamar o lechumra kaamar lekulla kaamar deika ani dela bae lemishkal kulle hay o dilma lechumra kaamar deika ashir devae lemitav leh tefe

Ta shema middekaamar rabbi akiva afilu aniyyim shebbeyisrael roin otan keilu hen bene chorin sheyyardu minnichsehem shehem bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov shema minah tanna kamma lekulla kaamar shema minah
Umaase beechad sheppara rosh haishsha vechu umi yahavinan zeman vehaamar rabbi chanina en notnin zeman lachavalot
Ki la yahavinan leh zeman lachavala dechassereh mamona aval levoshet dela chassereh mamona yahavinan
Shemarah omedet al petach chatzerah vechu vehatanya amar lo rabbi akiva tzalalta bemayim addirim veheelita cheres beyadcha adam rashshay lachbol beatzmo
Amar rava la kashya kan bachavala kan bevoshet veha matnitin bevoshet hu
b: Vekatane hachovel beatzmo af al pi sheeno rashshay patur hachi kaamar leh la mibbaya boshet deadam rashshay levayyesh et atzmo ella afilu chavala deen adam rashshay lechabbel beatzmo acherim shechavlu bo chayyavin
Veen adam rashshay lechabbel beatzmo vehatanya yachol nishba lehara beatzmo velo hera yehe patur talmud lomar lehara o lehetiv ma hatava reshut af haraa reshut avi nishba lehara beatzmo velo hera
Amar shemuel beeshev betaanit
Dichotah gabbe haraat acherim lehoshivam betaanit acherim mi motev lehu betaanita
In dimhaddak lehu beinderona
Vehatanya ezehu haraat acherim akke peloni veeftza et mocho
Ella tannae hi deika leman deamar en adam rashshay lechabbel beatzmo veika man deamar adam rashshay lechabbel beatzmo
Man tanna deshamatte leh deamar en adam rashshay lechabbel beatzmo ilema hay tanna hu detanya veach et dimchem lenafshotechem edrosh rabbi elazar omer miyyad nafshotechem edrosh et dimchem
Vedilma ketala shane
Ella hay tanna hu detanya mekarin al hammet velo middarche haemori amar rabbi elazar shamati shehamkarea al hammet yoter midday loke mishshum bal tashchit vechol shekken gufo

Vedilma begadim shane difseda dela hadar hu ki ha derabbi yochanan kare lehu lemaneh mechabbedotay verav chisda kad hava mesagge bene hizme vehigge vehigge medalle lehu lemaneh amar ze maale arucha veze eno maale arucha

Ella hay tanna hu detanya amar rabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi ma talmud lomar vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh vechi beeze nefesh chata ze ella shetztzier atzmo min hayyayin vahalo devarim kal vechomer uma ze shello tzier atzmo ella min hayyayin nikra chote hamtzaer atzmo mikkol davar al achat kamma vechamma

Hakkotzetz netiotav vechu tane rabba bar bar channa kammeh derav shori haragta netiotay katzatzta atta amarta li lehorgo atta amratte li lekotztzo patur amar leh im ken la shevakte chayye leviryata kol kemineh
Amar leh esmeyah amar leh la tittargam matnitach beshor haomed lahariga uvilan haomed liktzitza
I hachi may ka taen leh deamar leh ana baena lemibad ha mitzva
Detanya veshafach vechissa mi sheshshafach yechasse umaase beechad sheshshachat vekadam chavero vechissa vechiyevo rabban gamliel liten lo asara zehuvim
Amar rav dikla ditan kabba asur lemiktzetzeh
Metivi kamma yehe bazzayit velo yiktzetzennu rova shane zetim dachashivi
Amar rabbi chanina la shechev shivchat beri ella dekatz teenta bela zimnah amar ravina veim haya meulle bedamim muttar
Tanya name hachi rak etz asher teda ze ilan maachal ki lo etz maachal hu ze ilan serak
Vechi meachar shessofenu lerabbot kol davar ma talmud lomar ki lo etz maachal lehakdim serak lemaachal

a: Yachol afilu meulle bedamim talmud lomar rak
Shemuel ayeti leh ariseh tamre achel taem behu tama dechamra amar leh may hay amar leh bene gufne kayemi amar machchashi bechamra kulle hay limchar ayeti li mikkorayehu
Rav chisda chaza tale be gufne amar leh laariseh akrinhu gufne kane dikle dikle la kane gufne

Matni af al pi shehu noten lo en nimchal lo ad sheyevakkesh mimmennu shenneemar veatta hashev eshet vego uminnayin sheim lo machal lo shehu achzari shenneemar vayyitpallel avraham el haelohim vayyirpa elohim et avimelech vego
Haomer samme et eni katta et yadi shabber et ragli chayyav al menat liftor chayyav
Kera et kesuti shabber et kaddi chayyav al menat liftor patur ase ken leish peloni al menat liftor chayyav ben begufo ben bemamono
Gema tanu rabbanan kol ellu sheamru deme voshto aval tzaaro afilu hevi kol ele nevaot shebbaolam en nimchal lo ad sheyevakkesh mimmennu shenneemar hashev eshet haish ki navi hu veyitpallel baadcha
Deeshet navi bae ahdore eshet acher la bae ahdore

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan hashev eshet haish mikkol makom udka amratte hagoy gam tzaddik taharog halo hu amar li achoti hi vehi gam hi amra achi hu navi hu uchvar limed achsenay shebba lair al iske achila ushtiyya shoalin oto o al iske ishto shoalin oto ishtecha hi achotcha hi
Mikkan leven noach shenneherag shehaya lo lilmod velo lamad
Ki atzor atzar Adonai amar rabbi elazar shette atzirot hallalu lamma achat beish shichvat zera shettayim beishsha shichvat zera veleda
Bematnita tena shettayim beish shichvat zera uktannim shelosha baishsha shichvat zera uktannim veleda
Ravina amar shalosh beish shichvat zera uktannim ufi tabbaat arbaa beishsha shichvat zera veleda uktannim ufi tabbaat
Bead kol rechem amri deve rabbi yannay afilu tarnegolet shel bet avimelech lo hetila betzatah

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta daamur rabbanan kol hamvakkesh rachamim al chavero vehu tzarich leoto davar hu naane techila amar leh dichtiv va shav et shevut iyyov behitpallo bead reehu

Amar leh atte amratte mehatam vaana amena mehacha vayyitpallel avraham el haelohim vayyirpa elohim et avimelech veet ishto veamhotav vego uchtiv va pakad et sara kaasher amar vego kaasher amar avraham el avimelech
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe bahade hutza lake kerava amar leh dichtiv lamma tarivu elay kullechem peshatem bi neum Adonai
Amar leh atte amratte mehatam vaana amena mehacha ad ana meantem lishmor mitzotay vetorotay
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari ketiv umiktze echav lakach chamishsha anashim man ninhu chamishsha amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan otan shehuchpelu beshemot
Yehuda name ikfole mikfal
Amar leh lemilteh hu deikfal deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan may dichtiv yechi reuven veal yamot vihi metav mispar vezot lihuda
Kol otan arbaim shana shehau yisrael bammidbar hau atzmotav shel yehuda megulgalin baaron ad shebba moshe uvikkesh rachamim amar lefanav ribbono shel olam mi garam liruven sheyyode yehuda

Miyyad shema Adonai kol yehuda al evreh leshafa la hao ka masseki leh limtivta dirkia veel ammo teviennu la hava yada may kaamri rabbanan ulmishkal umitrach bahade rabbanan yadav rav lo la hava salek leh shemateta alliba dehilcheta veezer mitztzarav tihye

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe batar anya azla anuta amar leh ditnan ashirim meviin bikkurim biklatot shel zahav veshel kesef vaaniyyim besalle netzarim shel arava kelufa hassallim vehabbikkurim netunim lakkohanim amar leh atte amratte mehatam vaana amena mehacha
b: Vetame tame yikra

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta daamur rabbanan hashkem veechol bakkayitz mippene hachamma uvachoref mippene hatztzina veamri inashe shitin rahote rehut vela meto legavra demitztzafra kerach dichtiv lo yiravu velo yitzmau velo yakkem sharav vashamesh

Amar leh atte amratte mehatam vaana amena mehacha vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem zo keriyyat shema utfilla uverach et lachmecha veet memecha zo pat bemelach vekiton shel mayim mikkan veelach vahasiroti machala mikkirbecha
Vetanya machala zo mara velamma nikra shemah machala sheshshemonim ushlosha cholain yesh bah machala begimatriyya hachi hau vechullan pat bammelach shacharit vekiton shel mayim mevattelan

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta daamur rabbanan chavrach karyach chamara ukkafa legabbach mush amar leh dichtiv vayyomar hagar shifchat saray e mizze vat veana telechi vattomer mippene saray gevirti anochi borachat
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe milta genaa deit bach kedem amrah amar leh dichtiv vayyomar eved avraham anochi
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe shafel veazel bar aoza veeneh metayefi amar leh dichtiv vehetiv Adonai ladoni vezacharta et amatecha

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe shitin tichle matuh lechakka dekal chavreh shema vela achal amar leh dichtiv veli ani avdecha ultzadok hakkohen velivnayahu ven yehoyada velishlomo avdecha lo kara

Amar leh atte amratte mehatam vaana amena mehacha vayevieha yitzchak haohela sara immo vayyikkach et rivka vattehi lo leishsha vayyeehaveha vayyinnachem yitzchak achare immo uchtiv batreh vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushmah ketura

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe chamra lemareh tevuta leshakyeh amar leh dichtiv vesamachta et yadcha alav lemaan yishmeun veyirun kol adat bene yisrael uchtiv vihoshua bin nun male ruach chochma ki samach moshe et yadav alav vayyishmeu elav kol bene yisrael vego
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe kalba bechafneh gelale mbala dichtiv nefesh sevea tavus nofet venefesh reeva kol mar matok

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe metayyel veazel dikla bisha gabbe kina dishrache amar leh davar ze katuv battora shanuy banneviim umshullash bakketuvim utnan bematnitin utnena bevarayeta

Katuv battora dichtiv vayyelech esav el yishmael shanuy banneviim dichtiv vayyitlakketu el yiftach anashim rekim vayyihu immo umshullash bakketuvim dichtiv kol of lemino yishkon uvne uven adam laddome lo tenan bematnitin kol hamchubbar lattame tame kol hamchubbar lattahor tahor utnena bevarayeta rabbi eliezer omer lo lechinnam halach zarzir etzel orev ella mippene shehu mino
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe karet chavrach vela anach remi gudda rabba shedi beh amar leh yaan tihartich velo taharte mittumatech lo tithari od
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe bera dishtet mineh la tishde beh kala amar leh dichtiv lo tetaev adomi ki achicha hu velo tetaev mitzri ki ger hayita veartzo
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe i delet dura dalena vei la la dalena amar leh dichtiv vayyomer eleha barak im telchi immi vehalachti veim lo telchi immi lo elech

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe kad havenan zutre legavre hashta dekashshishna ledardeke amar leh meikara ketiv va holech lifnehem yomam beammud anan lanchotam hadderech velayela beammud esh lehair lahem ulvassof ketiv

a: Hinne anochi sholeach malach lefanecha lishmarcha baddarech
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe batar mare nichse tzive meshoch amar leh dichtiv vegam lelot haholech et avram haya tzon uvakar veohalim
Amar rav chanan hammoser din al chavero hu neenash techila shenneemar vattomer saray el avram chamasi alecha uchtiv vayyavo avraham lispod lesara velivkotah vehane mile deit leh dina beara
Amar rabbi yitzchak oy lo latztzoek yoter min hannitzak tanya name hachi echad hatztzoek veechad hannitzak bammashma ella shemmemaharin latztzoek yoter min hannitzak

Veamar rabbi yitzchak leolam al tehi killat hedot kalla beenecha shehare avimelech killel et sara venitkayyem bezarah shenneemar hinne hu lach kesut enayim amar lah hoil vechissit mimmenni velo gilit shehu ishech vegaramte li hatztzaar hazze yehi ratzon sheyehu lach banim kesuye enayim venitkayyem bezarah dichtiv vayehi ki zaken yitzchak vattichhena enav merot
Amar rabbi avahu leolam yehe adam min hannirdafin velo min harodfin sheen lecha nirdof baofot yoter mittorim uvne yona vehichshiran hakkatuv legabbe mizbeach
Haomer samme et eni ku amar leh rav assi bar chama lerava may shena resha umay shena sefa
Amar leh resha lefi sheen adam mochel al rashe evarim
Amar leh vechi adam mochel al tzaaro detanya hakkeni petzaeni al menat liftor patur ishtik
Amar mide shemia lach beha amar leh hachi amar rav sheshet mishshum pegam mishpacha
Itmar rabbi oshaya amar mishshum pegam mishpacha rava amar mishshum sheen adam mochel al rashe evarim shello
Rabbi yochanan amar yesh hen shehu kelav veyesh lav shehu kehen
Tanya name hachi hakkeni petzaeni al menat liftor veamar lo hen hare yesh hen shehu kelav kera et kesuti al menat liftor veamar lo lav hare lav shehu kehen
Shabber et kaddi kera et kesuti chayyav urminhi lishmor velo leabbed lishmor velo likroa lishmor velo lechallek laaniyyim
Amar rav huna la kashya ha daatay lideh ha dela atay lideh
Amar leh rabba lishmor daatay lideh mashma
Ella amar rabba ha veha daata lideh vela kashya ha daata lideh betorat shemira ha daata lideh betorat keria
Hahu arneka ditzdaka daatay lefumbedita afkedah rav yosef gabbe hahu gavra pesha bah ato gannave ganvuha chayeveh rav yosef amar leh abbaye vehatanya lishmor velo lechallek laaniyyim
Amar leh anye defumbedita mikatz kitz lehu velishmor hu
Hadaran alach hachovel
b: Matni haggozel etzim vaasaan kelim tzemer vaasaan begadim meshallem kishat haggezela
Gazal para meubberet veyalda rachel teuna ugzazah meshallem deme fara haomedet leled udme rachel haomedet ligazez
Gazal para venitabbera etzlo veyalda rachel venitana etzlo ugzazah meshallem kishat haggezela ze hakkelal kol haggazlanim meshallemin kishat haggezela
Gema amri etzim vaasaan kelim in shipan la tzemer vaasaan begadim in libnan la
Urminhi gazal etzim veshipan avanim vesittan tzemer velibnan velibno pishtan venikkahu meshallem kishat haggezela
Amar abbaye tanna didan katane shinuy derabbanan dehadar vechol shekken shinuy deorayeta

Etzim vaasaan kelim beetzim meshuppin umay ninhu nesarim deshinuy dehadar livriyyateh hu dei bae meshallef lehu tzemer vaasaan begadim betzemer tauy deshinuy dahadar livriyyateh hu dei bae satar leh vechol shekken shinuy deorayeta
Vetanna bara shinuy deorayeta katane veshinuy derabbanan la katane
Rav ashe amar tanna didan name shinuy deorayeta katane etzim vaasaan kelim buchane dehayenu shipan tzemer vaasaan begadim namte dehayenu shinuy dela hadar
Velibun mi have shinuy urminhi lo hispik litno lo ad shetztzevao patur libbeno velo tzevao chayyav
Amar abbaye la kashya ha rabbi shimon ha rabbanan detanya gezazo teoo vaarago en mitztaref libbeno rabbi shimon omer en mitztaref vachachamim omrim mitztaref
Rava amar ha veha rabbi shimon vela kashya ha denappetzeh nappotze ha disarkeh saroke
Rabbi chiyya bar avin amar ha dechavvereh chauore ha dechavreh kavroye

Hashta yesh lomar tzeva lerabbi shimon la have shinuy libun have shinuy detanya gazaz rishon rishon utzvao rishon rishon utoo rishon rishon vaarago en mitztaref rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon tzevao mitztaref
Amar abbaye la kashya ha rabbanan alliba derabbi shimon ha rabbi shimon ben yehuda alliba derabbi shimon

Rava amar leolam la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi shimon ben yehuda veshane tzeva hoil veyachol lehaaviro al yede tzafon vechi katane hatam lo hispik litno lo ad shetztzevao patur veokimna kedivre hakkol bekala ilan dela avar
Amar abbaye rabbi shimon ben yehuda uvet shammay verabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbi shimon ben elazar verabbi yishmael kullehu sevira lehu shinuy bimkomo omed rabbi shimon ben yehuda ha daamaran
Bet shammay may hi detanya natan lah chittin beetnannah vaasaan solet zetim vaasaan shemen anavim vaasaan yayin tane chada asur vetanya idach muttar veamar rav yosef tane guron

a: Demeasporak bet shammay osrin uvet hillel mattirin may tameh devet shammay amar kera gam shenehem lerabbot shinuyehem uvet hillel amar kera hem velo shinuyehem
Uvet shammay ha ketiv hem hahu mibe leh hem velo valdotehem uvet hillel tarte shamatte minah hem velo shinuyehem hem velo valdotehem
Uvet hillel name hachtiv gam gam levet hillel kashya
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov may hi

Detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer hare sheggazal sea shel chittin techanah lashah vaafaah vehifrish mimmenna challa ketzad mevarech en ze mevarech ella menaetz veal ze neemar botzea berech nietz Adonai
Rabbi shimon ben elazar may hi detanya kelal ze amar rabbi shimon ben elazar kol shevach shehishbiach gazlan yado al haelona ratza notel shivcho ratza omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha
May kaamar amar rav sheshet hachi kaamar hishbiach notel shivcho kachash omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha deshinuy bimkomo omed
I hachi afilu hishbiach name amri mippene takkanat hashshavim
Rabbi yishmael may hi detanya mitzvat pea lehafrish min hakkama lo hifrish min hakkama mafrish min haomarim lo hifrish min haomarim mafrish min hakkeri ad shello mercho
Mercho measser venoten lo mishshum rabbi yishmael amru af mafrish min haisa venoten lo
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye ikful kol hane tannae leashmoinan kevet shammay amar leh hachi kaamri lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel bedavar ze
Amar rava mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi shimon ben yehuda hatam ella betzeva hoil veyachol lehaaviro al yede tzafon
Vead kan la kaamri bet shammay hatam ella legavoha mishshum deimis
Vead kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hatam ella leinyan beracha mishshum dehave leh mitzva habbaa baavera
Vead kan la kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar hatam ella behachchasha dehadar
Vead kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael hatam ella leinyan pea mishshum dichtiv taazov yattira vechi tema ligmar mineh mattenot aniyyim shane
Kidvae rabbi yonatan devae rabbi yonatan may tama derabbi yishmael mishshum dekasavar shinuy eno kone o dilma bealma kasavar shinuy kone vehacha mishshum dichtiv taazov yattira
Veim timtze lomar tama derabbi yishmael mishshum dekasavar shinuy eno kone taazov yattira dichtav rachamana lema li vetu lerabbanan taazov yattira dichtav rachamana lema li
Mibbee leh lechidtanya hammafkir karmo vehishkim labboker uvtzaro chayyav beferet uvolelot uvshichcha uvfea ufatur min hammaaser
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar
Umi amar shemuel hachi vehaamar shemuel en shamin lo legannav velo legazlan ella linzakin

Bishlama lerava deamar ki kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar hatam behachchasha dehadar la kashya ki kaamar halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar deshinuy bimkomo omed behachchasha dehadar vechi kaamar shemuel hatam en shamin lo legannav velo legazlan ella linzakin behachchasha dela hadar
Ella leabbaye deamar ki kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar behachchasha dela hadar kaamar may ika lememar
Abbaye matne hachi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel
b: Amru halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar veleh la sevira leh

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan devar tora gezela hannishtannet chozeret beeneha shenneemar veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal mikkol makom veim tomar mishnatenu mishshum takkanat hashshavim
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna utnan lo hispik litno lo ad shetztzevao patur
Amar lehu hahu midderabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh ledidi mipparsha li mineh derabbi yochanan kegon sheggazal etzim meshuppin vaasaan kelim dehave leh shinuy hachozer livriyyato
Tanu rabbanan haggazlanin umalve beribbit shehechziru en mekabbelin mehen vehamkabbel mehen en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu

Amar rabbi yochanan bime rabbi nishnet mishna zo detanya maase beadam echad shebbikkesh laasot teshuva amra lo ishto reka im atta ose teshuva afilu avnet eno shellecha venimna velo asa teshuva beotah shaa amru haggazlanin umalve ribbiyyot shehechziru en mekabbelin mehem vehamkabbel mehem en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu
Metivi hinniach lahem avihem maot shel ribbit af al pi shehen yodin shehen ribbit en chayyavin lehachzir inhu hu dela ha avihem chayyav lehachzir

Bedin hu daavihem name eno chayyav lehachzir veha dekatane bedidhu mishshum deka bae lemitne sefa hinniach lahem avihem para vetallit vechol davar hamsuyyam chayyavin lehachzir mippene kevod avihem tena resha name bedidhu
Umippene kevod avihem chayyavin lehachzir ekre kan venasi veammecha lo taor beose maase ammecha
Kidamar rav pinchas besheasa teshuva hacha name besheasa teshuva i asa teshuva may bae gabbeh ibi leh leahdore shello hispik lehachzir ad shemmet
Ta shema haggazlanim umalve beribbit af al pi sheggavu machazirin
Gazlanin may sheggavu ika i gezul gezul vei la gezul la gezul ella ema haggazlanin umay nihu malve ribbiyyot af al pi sheggavu machzirin amri machzirin veen mekabbelin mehem
Ella lamma machzirin latzet yede shamayim
Ta shema haroim vehaggabbain vehammochsin teshuvatan kasha umachzirin lemakkirin
Amri machzirin veen mekabbelin mehem veella lamma machzirin latzet yede shamayim i hachi ammay teshuvatan kasha
Veod ema sefa vesheen makkirin yaase bahen tzorche tzibur veamar rav chisda borot shichin umarot ella la kashya kan kodem takkana kan leachar takkana
Vehashta deamar rav nachman besheen gezela kayyemet afilu tema ide veide leachar takkana vela kashya

a: Kan bigzela kayyemet kan besheen gezela kayyemet veha avnet digzela kayyemet hi may avnet deme avnet

Vechol hecha digzela kayyemet la avud rabbanan takkanta vahare marish digzela kayyemet hi utnan al hammarish haggazul shebbenao babbira sheyyittol damav mippene takkanat hashshavim shane hatam dechevan deika peseda devira shavveuha rabbanan kidletah

Gazal para meubberet veyalda vechu tanu rabbanan haggozel rachel ugzazah para veyalda meshallem otah veet gizoteha veet valdoteha divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer gezela chozeret beeneha rabbi shimon omer roin otah keilu hi shuma etzlo bechesef
Ibaya lehu may tameh derabbi meir mishshum dekasavar shinuy bimkomo omed o dilma bealma shinuy kone vehacha kenasa hu deka kanes
Lemay nafka minah lehecha dichchasha michchash
Ta shema gazal behema vehizkina avadim vehizkinu meshallem kishat haggezela rabbi meir omer baavadim omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha veilu behema kishat haggezela
Vei salka datach savar rabbi meir shinuy bimkomo omed afilu behema name ella lav shema minah kasavar rabbi meir shinuy kone vehacha kenasa hu deka kanes

Amri rabbi meir ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi shinuy en kone vaafilu behema name ella ledidchu deamritu shinuy kone odo li mihat beavda dechimkarkee dame vekarka enah nigzelet veamri leh rabbanan la avda kemittalteli dame

Ta shema litzboa lo adom utzvao shachor shachor utzvao adom rabbi meir omer noten lo deme tzamro deme tzamro in deme tzamro veshivcho la vei salka datach savar rabbi meir shinuy en kone deme tzamro veshivcho bae lemitav leh
Ella lav shema minah kasavar rabbi meir shinuy kone vehacha kenasa hu deka kanes shema minah

Ika deamri ha la ibi lan middeafech rav vetane gazal para vehizkina avadim vehizkinu meshallem kishat haggezela divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim baavadim omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha vadday lerabbi meir shinuy kone vehacha kenasa hu deka kanes leh
Ki ka ibi lan hachi ibi lan ki ka kanes bemezid aval beshogeg la kanes o dilma afilu beshogeg name kanes
Ta shema chamishsha govin min hamchorarin
Veellu hen perot ushvach perot vehamkabbel alav lazun ben ishto uvat ishto veget chov sheen bo achraut uchtubbat ishsha sheen bah achraut
Man shamatte leh deamar achraut lav taut sofer hu rabbi meir vekatane perot ushvach perot
Shevach perot hechi dame kegon sheggazal sade mechavero umcharah leacher vehishbichah vahare hi yotza mittachat yado keshehu gove
b: Gove et hakkeren minnechasim meshubadim veet hashshevach minnechasim bene chorin deate baal ara veshakel areh ushvacheh

Ta shema litzboa lo adom utzvao shachor shachor utzvao adom rabbi meir omer noten lo deme tzamro deme tzamro in deme tzamro veshivcho la
Vei salka datach beshogeg name kanes deme tzamro veshivcho bae lemitva leh ella lav shema minah bemezid kanes beshogeg la kanes shema minah
Rabbi yehuda omer gezela chozeret beeneha rabbi shimon omer roin otah keilu hi shuma etzlo bechesef may benayehu
Amar rav zevid beshevach sheal gabbe gezela kamipalgi rabbi yehuda savar denigzal have verabbi shimon savar degazlan have

Rav pappa amar dechulle alma shevach sheal gabbe gezela degazlan have vehacha lemechetza lishlish velirvia kamipalgi rabbi yehuda savar shevach sheal gabbe gezela kulleh degazlan have verabbi shimon savar lemechetza lishlish velirvia hu deshakel gazlan
Tenan gazal para venitabbera etzlo veyalda rachel venitana etzlo ugzazah meshallem kishat haggezela yalda in lo yalda hadra beena
Bishlama lerav zevid deamar shevach sheal gabbe gezela denigzal have lerabbi yehuda ha manni rabbi yehuda hi ella lerav pappa deamar degazlan have ha manni la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi shimon
Amar lecha rav pappa hu haddin afilu lo yalda name kishat haggezela hu dimshallem veha dekatane yalda ayede denasev resha yalda nasev sefa name yalda
Tanya keoteh derav pappa rabbi shimon omer roin otah keilu hi shuma etzlo bechesef lemechetza lishlish velirvia
Amar rav ashe ki havenan be rav kahana ibaya lan lerabbi shimon deamar lemechetza lishlish velirvia hu deshakel gazlan ki mesallekinan leh bidme mesallekinan leh o dilma mibbisra shakel
Ufshatna meha deamar rav nachman amar shemuel shelosha shamin lahen hashshevach umaalin otan bedamim veellu hen bechor lefashut
Uvaal chov lelokeach uvaal chov litomim

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe mi amar shemuel baal chov lelokeach yahev leh shevach vehaamar shemuel baal chov gove et hashshevach amar leh la kashya kan beshevach hammaggia lichtefayim vechan beshevach sheen maggia lichtefayim
Amar leh veha maasim bechol yom veka magbe shemuel afilu shevach hammaggia lichtefayim amar leh la kashya

a: Ha demassek beh keshiur ara ushvacha ha dela massek beh ella keshiur ara

Amar leh hanicha leman deamar i it leh zuze lelokeach la matze mesallek leh levaal chov shappir ella leman deamar i it leh zuze lelokeach matze mesallek leh levaal chov lema leh i hao li zuze hava mesallekna lach mikkulleh ara hashta hav li geriva deara shiur shevachay
Amar leh hacha bemay askinan kegon deshavveyah nihaleh appoteke daamar leh lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizze
Amar rava gazal vehishbiach umachar vegazal vehishbiach vehorish ma shehishbiach machar ma shehishbiach horish
Bae rava hishbiach lokeach mahu batar devayah hadar pashtah ma machar rishon lashsheni kol zechut shettavo leyado
Bae rava hishbiach goy mahu amar leh rav acha middifti leravina takkanta legoy neku venabed amar leh la tzericha kegon dezabbeneh leyisrael sof sof habba mechamat goy hare hu kegoy

La tzericha kegon degazlah yisrael vezabbenah nihaleh vehishbichah goy vahadar goy vezabbenah leyisrael may mi amrinan kevan demeikara yisrael vahadar yisrael avdi rabbanan takkanta o dilma kevan deika goy baemtza la avadu leh rabbanan takkanta teku

Amar rav pappa hay man digzal dikla mechavreh vekatleh af al gav deshadye meara leara dideh la kene may tama meikara dikla mikre vehashta name dikla mikre dikla vaaved veavdeh gubbe la kane hashta mihat gubbe dedikla mikre
Gubbe veavdinhu keshure kane keshure ravreve veavdinhu keshure zutre la kane avdinhu ketzutzyata kane

Amar rava hay man digzal luliba veavdinhu hutze kane demeikara luliba mikre vehashta hutze hutze veavdinhu chufya kane meikara hutze vehashta chufya chufya veavdeh sharshura la kane may tama dahadar satar leh vehave chufya
Bae rav pappa nechleka hatteomet mahu ta shema deamar rabbi matun amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi nitla hatteomet pasul
b: May lav hu haddin lenechleka la nitla shane deha chasar leh
Ika deamri ta shema deamar rabbi matun amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi nechleka hatteomet naasa kemi shennittela ufasul shema minah

Amar rav pappa hay man digzal afra mechavreh veavdeh leventa la kane may tama dehadar meshave leh afra leventa veavdah afra kane may amratte dilma hadar veaved leh leventa hay leventa achariti hu ufanim chadashot bau lechan
Veamar rav pappa hay man digzal nesacha mechavreh veaved veavdeh zuze la kane may tama hadar aved lehu nesacha zuze veavdinhu nesacha kane may amratte hadar aved lehu zuze panim chadashot bau lechan
Shechime veavdinhu chadte la kane chadte veavdinhu shechime kane may amratte hadar aved lehu chadte mida yedia shichmayehu

Ze hakkelal kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela ze hakkelal leetoye may leetoye ha deamar rabbi ila ganav tale venaasa ayil egel venaasa shor naasa shinuy beyado uknao tavach umachar shello hu toveach shello hu mocher
Hahu gavra digzal paddana detore mechavreh azal kerav behu kerava zera behu zara lesof ahderinhu lemareh ata lekammeh derav nachman amar lehu zilu shumu shevacha deashbach
Amar leh rava tore ashbuch ara la ashbach amar mi kaamena neshayemu kulleh palga kaamena amar leh sof sof gezela hu veka hadra beena ditnan kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela
Amar leh la amena lach ki yatevna bedina la tema li mide deamar huna chavrin alay ana veshabbur malka ache bedina hay inash gazlana attika hu uvaena deekneseh
Matni gazal behema vehizkina avadim vehizkinu meshallem kishat haggezela rabbi meir omer baavadim omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha
Gazal matbea venisdak perot vehirkivu yayin vehechmitz meshallem kishat haggezela
Matbea venifsal teruma venitmet chametz veavar alav happesach behema venitabbeda bah avera o shennifsela meal gabbe hammizbeach o shehayeta yotza lisakel omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha
Gema amar rav pappa lo hizkina hizkina mammash ella afilu kachasha veha anan hizkina tenan kachasha kegon hizkina dela hadra barya

Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe hachi kaamri mishshemeh derabbi yochanan afilu ganav tale venaasa ayil egel venaasa shor naasa shinuy beyado uknao tavach umachar shello hu toveach shello hu mocher amar leh lav amena lach la tachlef gavre hahu mishshemeh derabbi ila itmar

Rabbi meir omer baavadim omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha amar rav chanina bar avdimi amar rav halacha kerabbi meir verav shavek rabbanan veaved kerabbi meir amri mishshum devarayeta ipcha tanya verav shavek matnitin veaved kevarayeta rav matnitin name ipcha tane
Umay tameh derav deafech matnitin mikkamme devarayeta adderabba nefoch levarayeta mikkamme matnitin amri rav name matnitin ipcha atnuyah
Vei baet ema ki la afech chada mikkamme chada chada mikkamme tarte afech
Detanya hammachlif para bachamor veyalda vechen hammocher shifchato veyalda ze omer birshuti yalda vehalla shotek zacha bah ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea yachloku
Ze omer birshuti veze omer birshuti yishshava hammocher shebbirshuto yalda lefi shekkol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim en nishbain lo al haavadim velo al hakkarkaot
Hay halacha kerabbi meir halacha kerabbanan mibe leh hachi kaamar lemay deafchitu vetanetu halacha kerabbi meir

a: Umi amar rav avda kimkarkee dame vehaamar rav daniel bar rav kattina amar rav hattokef beavdo shel chavero veasa bo melacha patur vei salka datach avda kimkarkee dame ammay patur birshuta demareh kae

Hachi hashta bishlama hatam ben leman deamar beta meyatteva yatev nicha leh ben leman deamar ushiyya yukkat shaar nicha leh
Ella hacha mi nicha leh denichchosh avdeh amri hachi name nicha leh dela listere avdeh

Amar leh hane mile hecha dela massek behu zuze mar kevan demassek behu zuze michaze keribbit deamar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman af al pi sheamru haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato en tzarich lehaalot lo sachar hilvahu vedar bachatzar chavero tzarich lehaalot lo sachar amar leh hadari bi

Verav yehuda amar pesalattu malchut name hayenu nisdak ella hechi dame nifsal sheppesalattu medina zo veotze bimdina acheret
Amar leh rav chisda lerav huna ledidach deamratte nifsal pesalattu malchut hare perot vehirkivu yayin vehechmitz dechi pesalattu malchut dame vekatane meshallem kishat haggezela
Amar leh hatam nishtanna tamo verecho hacha lo nishtanna
Amar leh rava lerav yehuda ledidach deamratte pesalattu malchut name hayenu nisdak hare teruma venitmet dechi pesalattu malchut dame vekatane omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha
Amar leh hatam la minchar hezekah hacha minchar hezekah

b: Noten lo matbea hayyotze beotah shaa ushmuel amar yachol lomar lo lech hotzio bemeshan amar rav nachman mistabbera milteh dishmuel deit leh orcha lemezal lemeshan aval let leh orcha la
Etiveh rava lerav nachman en mechallelin al hammaot sheenam yotzot ketzad hau lo maot kozviyyot yerushalmiyyot o shel melachim harishonim en mechallelin ha shel acharonim dumya derishonim mechallelin
Amar leh hacha bemay askinan kesheen malchiyyot makpidot zo al zo
Ella ki amar shemuel keshemmalchiyyot makpidot zo al zo hechi matze mamte lehu demamte lehu al yede haddechak dela bachashi vei mashkechi kafdi

Ta shema en mechallelin al maot shel kan vehen bevavel veshel bavel vehen kan shel bavel vehen bevavel mechallelin katane mihat en mechallelin al maot shel kan vehen bevavel af al gav desofo lemisak lehatam
Hacha bemay askinan keshemmalchiyyot makpidot zo al zo i hachi shel bavel vehen bevavel lemay chazu chazu dezaven behu behema umassek lirushalayim
Vehatanya hitkinu sheyehu hammaot yotzot birushalayim mippene kach amar rabbi zera la kashya kan bizman sheyyad yisrael takkifa al ummot haolam kan bizman sheyyad ummot haolam takkifa al atzman

Tanu rabbanan ezehu matbea shel yerushalayim david ushlomo mitztzad echad virushalayim ir hakkodesh mitztzad acher veezehu matbea shel avraham avinu zaken uzkena mitztzad echad uvachur uvtula mitztzad acher
Bea mineh rava merav chisda hammalve et chavero al hammatbea vehosifu alav mahu amar lo noten lo matbea hayyotze beotah shaa amar leh vaafilu ki nafya amar leh in amar leh afilu ki terita amar leh in
Veha ka zayelin pere amar rav ashe chazenan i mechamat tiva zil menakkenan leh
