Veha ka shavach leinyan nesacha ella ki ha derav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua avdi ovada bezuze daagardemis tayyaa ad asara bitmanya

Amar rabba hazzorek matbea shel chavero layyam haggadol patur may tama amar ha mannach kammach i baet shikleh vehane mile bitzlulin deka chaze leh aval achurin dela kachaze leh la vehane mile deaddeyeh addoye aval shakleh bideh migzal gazleh hashava bae mebad

Metiv rava en mechallelin al maot sheenan birshuto ketzad hau lo maot bekastera o behar hammelech o shennafal kiso layyam haggadol en mechallelin amar rabba shane leinyan maaser devaenan matzuy beyadcha derachamana amar vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha veleka
Veamar rabba hashshaf matbea shel chavero patur may tama deha la avad vela mide vehane mile demachyeh bekurnasa vetarsheh aval shayefeh beshofina chassore chassereh
Metiv rava hikkahu al eno vesimmeah al ozno vechersho vechershah eved yotze bahen lecherut keneged eno veeno roe keneged ozno veeno shome en eved yotze bahen lecherut
Rabba letameh deamar rabba chersho leaviv neherag shei efshar lacharisha belo chabbura detippeta didma nefalat leh beunneh
Veamar rabba hatztzorem ozen parato shel chavero patur may tama para kidkayema kayema dela avad vela mide vechullehu sheorim lav legabbe mizbeach kayemi
Metiv rava haose melacha beme chattat uvfarat chattat patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim melacha hu dela minchar hezekah aval tzorem deminchar hezekah hachi name dimchayyev bedine adam
Amri hu haddin daafilu tzorem patur veha ka mashma lan daafilu melacha dela minchar hezekah chayyav bedine shamayim
Veamar rabba hassoref shetaro shel chavero patur daamar leh neyara kelay minach matkef lah rame bar chama hechi dame
b: I deika sahadi deyadi may hava bishtara lichtevu leh shetara mealleya vei deleka sahadi anan mena yadinan amar rava tehe bemaamino

Amar rav dimi bar chanina ha derabba machaloket rabbi shimon verabbanan hi lerabbi shimon deamar davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame mechayyev lerabbanan deamri davar haggorem lemamon lav kemamon dame la mechayyev

Matkef lah rav huna bereh derav yehoshua emar deshamatte leh lerabbi shimon davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame bedavar sheikaro mamon kidrabba deamar rabba gazal chametz lifne happesach uva acher usrafo bammoed patur shehakkol metzuviym alav levaaro leachar happesach machloket rabbi shimon verabbanan
Lerabbi shimon deamar davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame chayyav lerabbanan deamri davar haggorem lemamon lav kemamon dame patur bedavar sheen ikaro mamon mi amrinan
Amar ammemar man dedaen dina degarme magbe beh deme shetara mealleya uman dela daen dina degarme magbe beh deme neyara bealma hava ovada vechafyeh rafram lerav ashe veagbi beh ki keshura letzalma

Chametz veavar alav happesach omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha man tanna omrin beisure hanaa hare shellecha lefanecha amar rav chisda rabbi yaakov hi detanya shor shehemit ad shello nigmar dino mecharo machur hikdisho mukdash shechato besaro muttar hechziro shomer livalav muchzar
Mishshennigmar dino mecharo eno machur hikdisho eno mukdash shechato besaro asur hechziro shomer livalav eno muchzar rabbi yaakov omer af mishshennigmar dino hechziro shomer livalav muchzar
May lav beha kamipalgi derabbi yaakov savar omrin beisure hanaa hare shellecha lefanecha verabbanan savri en omrin beisure hanaa hare shellecha lefanecha
Amar leh rabba la dechulle alma amrinan beisure hanaa hare shellecha lefanecha deim ken niflegu bechametz bappesach ella amar rabba hacha begomrin dino shel shor shello befanav ka mipalgi

Rabbanan savri en gomrin dino shel shor shello befanav daamar leh i ayetiteh nihala hava marekna leh leagma hashta mesarteh beyad man dela matzena leishtaoye dina bahadeh verabbi yaakov savar gomrin dino shel shor shello befanav daamar leh may avadi leh sof sof hava gamri leh dina ledineh shello befanav
Ashkecheh rav chisda lerabba bar shemuel amar leh tenet mide beisure hanaa amar leh in tenena veheshiv et haggezela ma talmud lomar asher gazal yachazir keen sheggazal

Mikkan amru gazal matbea venifsal perot vehirkivu yayin vehechmitz teruma venitmet chametz veavar alav happesach behema veneevda bah avera veshor ad shello nigmar dino omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha

Man shamatte leh deamar ad shello nigmar dino in mishshennigmar dino la rabbanan vekatane chametz veavar alav happesach omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha amar leh i mashkachatte lehu la tema lehu vela mide
Perot vehirkivu omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha vehatnan perot vehirkivu meshallem kishat haggezela amar rav pappa kan shehirkivu kullan kan shehirkivu miktzatan

May tama umman kone bishvach keli

a: Vehikdicho yora noten lo deme tzamro deme tzamro in deme tzamro veshivcho la lav shehikdicho leachar nefila deika shevacha ushma minah umman kone bishvach keli
Amar shemuel hacha bemay askinan kegon shehikdicho bishat nefila deleka shevacha aval hikdicho leachar nefila may noten lo deme tzamro veshivcho lema shemuel let leh derav assi
Amar lach shemuel hacha bemay askinan kegon detzemer vesammanin devaal habbayit vetzabba agar yedeh hu deshakel
I hachi noten lo deme tzamro vesammanin mibe leh ella shemuel dachoye ka medache leh
Ta shema hannoten tallito leumman gemaro vehodio afilu mikkan vead asara yamim eno over alav mishshum lo talin netanah lo bachatzi hayyom kevan sheshshaka alav hachamma over alav mishshum bal talin
Vei salka datach umman kone bishvach keli ammay over mishshum bal talin
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana begirda desarbala deleka shevacha
Sof sof lemay yahavah nihaleh lerakkoche kevan derakkecheh hayenu shevacha la tzericha deagreh levitshe bitsha bitsha bemaata dehayenu sechirut
Ulmay dislek addatin meikara dela agreh levitshe mesayya leh lerav sheshet divo mineh merav sheshet kabbelanut over alav mishshum bal talin o eno over vaamar lehu rav sheshet over
Lema derav sheshet peliga adderav assi amar shemuel bar acha bishlicha deigarta
Lema ketannae ase li sherim nezamin vetabbaot veekkaddesh lach kevan sheasaan mekuddeshet divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim enah mekuddeshet ad sheyyaggia mamon leyadah
May mamon ilema oto mamon mikkelal derabbi meir savar oto mamon la ella bemay ku mikkaddesha ella peshita may mamon mamon acher
Vesavruha dechulle alma yeshnah lischirut mittechila vead sof udchulle alma hamkaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet
May lav beumman kone bishvach keli kamipalgi derabbi meir savar umman kone bishvach keli verabbanan savri en umman kone bishvach keli
La dechulle alma en umman kone bishvach keli ella hacha beyeshnah lischirut mittechila vead sof ka mipalgi
Rabbi meir savar en lischirut ella levassof verabbanan savri yesh lischirut mittechila vead sof

Vei baet ema dechulle alma yeshnah lischirut mittechila vead sof vehacha bimkaddesh bemilva kamipalgi derabbi meir savar hamkaddesh bemilva mekuddeshet verabbanan savri hamkaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet
b: Rava amar dechulle alma yeshnah lischirut mittechila vead sof udchulle alma hamkaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet udchulle alma en umman kone bishvach keli
Ella hacha bemay askinan kegon shehosif lah nofech mishshello rabbi meir savar milva ufruta datah apperuta verabbanan savri milva ufruta datah ammilva

Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya bischar sheasiti immach enah mekuddeshet bischar sheeese immach mekuddeshet rabbi natan omer bischar sheeese immach enah mekuddeshet vechol shekken bischar sheasiti immach
Verabbi yehuda hannasi omer beemet amru ben bischar sheasiti immach uven bischar sheeese immach enah mekuddeshet veim hosif lah nofech mishshello mekuddeshet
May ika ben tanna kamma lerabbi natan ika benayehu sechirut ben rabbi natan lerabbi yehuda hannasi ika benayehu milva ufruta
Amar shemuel tabbach umman shekkilkel chayyav leshallem mazzik hu poshea hu naasa keomer lo shechot li mikkan veshachat lo mikkan
Lema leh lememar mazzik hu poshea hu i amar mazzik hu hava amena hane mile hecha deka aved besachar aval hecha deka aved bechinnam la ka mashma lan poshea hu
Etiveh rav chama bar gurya lishmuel hannoten behema lattabbach veniblah umman patur hedot chayyav veim noten sachar ben hedot ben umman chayyav amar leh liachar mochach

Ata hahu merabbanan ka motev leh amar leh hashta shaklatte may dishkal chavrach kaamena lechu ana rabbi meir vekaamritu li rabbanan ammay la dayekatte mile sheani omer mazzik hu poshea hu naase keomer lo shechot li mikkan veshachat lo mikkan man it leh hay sevara rabbi meir deamar mibbee leh lemirme annafsheh
He rabbi meir ilema ha rabbi meir siman
Ditnan kesharo bealav bemosera venaal befanav karauy veyatza vehizzik ben tam ben muad chayyav divre rabbi meir
Hatam bikrae peligi
Ella ha rabbi meir ditnan litzboa lo adom utzvao shachor shachor utzvao adom rabbi meir omer noten lo deme tzamro hatam beyadayim kelav mineh

Ella ha rabbi meir ditnan nishbera kaddo velo silkah nafla gemallo velo heemida rabbi meir omer chayyav benizkan vachachamim omrim patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim vekayema lan divnitkal poshea hu peligi

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan tabbach umman shekkilkel chayyav vaafilu hu umman ketabbache tzipori umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabba bar bar chana ovada hava kammeh derabbi yochanan bichnishta demaon vaamar leh zil ayeti reaya demamchet letarnegolim veefterach
La kashya kan bechinnam kan besachar ki ha deamar rabbi zera harotze sheyyitchayyev lo tabbach yakdim lo dinar

Metivi hammolich chittim lattachon velo letatan vaasaan subbin o mursan kemach lannachtom vaasao pat nipulin behema lattabbach veniblah chayyav mippene shehu kenose sachar ema mippene shehu nose sachar
Hahu magrumta daatay lekammeh derav tarfeh ufatreh letabbach milleshallome deme pegau beh rav kahana verav assi behahu gavra amaru leh aved bach rav tarte
May tarte ilema tarte ligriuta deibi leh leachshore kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda vetarfah kerabbanan vei name kerabbanan deibi leh chiyyuva letabbacha umi shere lememar ki hay gavena
Vehatanya lichsheyyetze lo yomar ani mezakke vachaveray mechayevin aval ma eese shechaveray rabbu alay veal ze neemar holech rachil megalle sod
Ella tarte limalleuta dela ochlach sefek isura umanach missefek gezela
Itmar hammare dinar lashshulchani venimtza ra tane chada umman patur hedot chayyav vetanya idach ben umman ben hedot chayyav
Amar rav pappa ki tanya umman patur kegon danku veisur dela tzerichi lemigmar kelal ella bemay teo teo besikta chadta dehahi shata dinfak mittute sikta

Hahi itta deachzeya dinara lerabbi chiyya amar lah mealleya hu lemachar atay lekammeh vaamara leh achaziteh vaamaru li bisha hu vela ka nafek li amar leh lerav zil challefeh nihalah uchtov appinkasi den esek bish
Umay shena danku veisur diftiri mishshum dela tzerichi lemigmar rabbi chiyya name lav lemigmar ka bae rabbi chiyya lifnim mishshurat haddin hu daavad kidtane rav yosef vehodata lahem ze

Ha itmar alah amar rabbi ila amar rav vehu shennatal venatan bayyad
Ella ha rabbi meir ditnan litzboa lo adom utzvao shachor shachor utzvao adom rabbi meir omer noten lo deme tzamro hatam ka aved beyadayim
Ella ha rabbi meir ditnan hamsakkech gafno al gabbe tevuato shel chavero hare ze kidesh vechayyav hatam name ka aved beyadayim
Ella ha rabbi meir detanya mechitzat hakkerem shennifretza
b: Omer lo gedor nifretza omer lo gedor nityaesh mimmenna velo gedarah hare ze kidesh vechayyav beachrauto

Tanu rabbanan hannoten etzim lecharash laasot mehen kisse veasa mehen safsal safsal veasa mehen kisse rabbi meir omer noten lo deme etzav rabbi yehuda omer im hashshevach yater al hayetzia noten lo et hayetzia veim hayetzia yetera al hashshevach noten lo et hashshevach

Umode rabbi meir im natan etzim lecharash laasot mehen kisse nae veasa mehen kisse kaur safsal nae veasa safsal kaur im hashshevach yater al hayetzia noten lo deme hayetzia veim hayetzia yetera al hashshevach noten lo deme hashshevach
Ibaya lehu yesh shevach sammanin al hatztzemer o en shevach sammanin al hatztzemer
Hechi dame ilema digzal sammanin vedakkinhu utranhu utzva bahen behu tipok leh mishshum diknanhu beshinuy

La tzericha digzal sammanin sheruyin utzva behu may yesh shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer daamar leh hav li sammanay dishkaltinhu o dilma en shevach sammanin al gabbe hatztzemer daamar leh let lacha gabbay vela mide
Amri vei en shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer mi matze amar leh let lacha gabbay vela mide nema leh hav li sammanay deafsedtinhu

Ella lehach gisa en shevach sammanin al gabbe hatztzemer uvae shallome leh o dilma yesh shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer vaamar leh ha mannechi kammach shiklinhu shiklinhu bemay shakleh shakel lehu betzafon tzafon abbore meabbar hashava la aved

Ella hacha bemay askinan kegon digzal tzemer vesammanin dechad vetzaveh lehahu tzemer behanach sammanin veka mahdar leh nihaleh letzemer yesh shevach sammanin al gabbe hatztzemer veka mahdar leh sammanin vetzemer o dilma en shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer vetzemer mahdar leh sammanin la mahdar leh
Amri tipok leh deiyyakar leh nihaleh bidme la tzericha dezal tziva veibaet ema kegon shetztzava behu kofa

Ravina amar hacha bemay askinan kegon detzemer dechad vesammanin dechad vekaate kof vetzaveh lehahu tzemer behanach sammanin yesh shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer daamar leh hav li sammanay degabbach ninhu o dilma en shevach sammanin al gabbe tzemer vaamar leh let lacha gabbay kelum
Ta shema beged shetztzevao biklipe orla yiddalek alma chazuta milta hi
Amar rava hanaa hannire laenayim asra tora detanya arelim lo yeachel en li ella isur achila minnayin shello yehane mimmennu velo yitzba bo velo yadlik bo et hanner
Talmud lomar vaaraltem orlato et piro arelim lo yeachel lerabbot et kullam
Ta shema beged shetztzevao biklipe sheviit yiddalek shane hatam deamar kera tihye bahavayatah tehe
b: Rava rame tenan beged shetztzevao biklipe orla yiddalek alma chazuta milta hi urminhi reviit dam shennivlea babbayit habbayit tame veamri lah habbayit tahor vela peligi ha bechelim dahao meikara ha bechelim daato levassof
Nivlea bichsut roin im mitkabbeset hakkesut veotza mimmenna reviit dam temea veim lav tehora
Amar rav kahana mikkulle reviiyyot shanu kan bedam tevusa derabbanan

Urminhi ale kanim vaale gefanim sheggibvan becheve al pene hassade likketan laachila yesh bahen mishshum kedushshat sheviit leetzim en bahen mishshum kedushshat sheviit

a: Setam etzim lehassaka hen omdin
Amar rav kahana veetzim lehassaka tannae hi detanya en mosrin perot sheviit lo lemishra velo lichvusa verabbi yose omer notnin perot sheviit letoch hammishra ultoch hakkevusa
May tama derabbanan amar kera leochla velo lemishra leochla velo lichvusa verabbi yose omer amar kera lachem lechol tzorchechem
Verabbanan name hachtiv lachem lachem dumya dilachla bemi shehanaato uviuro shavin yatzu mishra uchvusa shehanaatan achar biuran

Verabbi yose name hachtiv leochla amar lach hahu mibe leh lechidtanya detanya leochla velo limlugma atta omer leochla velo limlugma o eno ella leochla velo lichvusa keshehu omer lachem hare kevusa amur ha ma ani mekayyem leochla leochla velo limlugma
Uma raita lerabbot hakkevusa ulhotzi et hammelugma merabbe ani et hakkevusa sheshshava bechol adam umotzi ani et hammelugma sheeno shave bechol adam
Keman azla ha detanya leochla velo limlugma leochla velo leziluf leochla velo laasot mimmenna appiktevizin keman kerabbi yose dei kerabbanan ika name mishra uchvusa
Rabbi yehuda omer im hashshevach ku siman
Yatev rav yosef achore derabbi abba kammeh derav huna veyatev rav huna vekaamar halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha vahalacha kerabbi yehuda
Ahderinhu rav yosef leappeh amar bishlama rabbi yehoshua ben korcha itzterich salka datach amena yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim ka mashma lan halacha keyachid
Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha may hi detanya rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer milva bishtar en nifrain mehen milva al pe nifrain mehen mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam
Ella halacha kerabbi yehuda lema li machloket veachar kach setam hi umachloket veachar kach setam halacha kistam

Machaloket bevava kamma litzboa lo adom utzvao shachor shachor utzvao adom rabbi meir omer noten lo deme tzamro rabbi yehuda omer im hashshevach yater al hayetzia noten lo et hayetzia veim hayetzia yetera al hashshevach noten lo et hashshevach ustam bevava metzia ditnan kol hamshanne yado al hattachtona vechol hachozer bo yado al hattachtona

Verav huna itzterich salka datach amena en seder lammishna ustam veachar kach machloket hi verav yosef i hachi kol machloket veachar kach setama nema en seder lammishna ustam veachar kach machaloket hi
Verav huna ki la amrinan en seder lammishna bachada massechta aval bitre massechtot amrinan verav yosef kullah nezikin chada massechta hi
Veibaet ema mishshum dekatane lah gabbe hilchata pesikata kol hamshanne yado al hattachtona vechol hachozer bo yado al hattachtona
Tanu rabbanan hannoten maot lishlucho
b: Likach lo chittin velakach mehem seorin seorin velakach mehem chittin tanya chada im pachatu pachatu lo veim hotiru hotiru lo vetane chada im pachatu pachatu lo veim hotiru hotiru laemtza
Amar rabbi yochanan la kashya ha rabbi meir veha rabbi yehuda
Ha rabbi meir deamar shinuy kone veha rabbi yehuda deamar shinuy eno kone
Matkef lah rabbi elazar mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir ella bemide dachaze leh legufeh aval lischora la amar
Ella amar rabbi elazar ha veha rabbi meir vela kashya kan laachila kan lischora
Machachu alah bemareva lerabbi yochanan alliba derabbi yehuda vechi mi hodio levaal chittin sheyyakne chittin levaal maot matkef lah rav shemuel bar sasrati i hachi afilu chittin vechittin name la
Amar rabbi avahu shane chittin vechittin dishlichuteh ka aved vechi baal habbayit dame
Tidda ditnan echad hammakdish nechasav veechad hammaarich et atzmo en lo bichsut ishto velo bichsut banav velo betzeva shetztzava lishman velo besandalim chadashim shellekachan lishman
Veammay lema hacha name mi hodio latzabba sheyyakne tzivo laishsha ella lav mishshum deamrinan dishlichuteh ka aved uchyad ishto dame hacha name shelichuteh ka aved uchyad baal habbayit dame
Amar rabbi abba lo kol hammakdish nechasav en dato al kesut ishto uvanav

Matkef lah rabbi zera vechi dato shel adam al tefilav utnan hammakdish nechasav maalin lo tefilin amar leh abbaye in dato shel adam al tefilin hammakdish nechasav savar mitzva ka avedna veen dato shel adam al kesut ishto uvanav mishshum eva
Matkef lah rav oshaya vahalo chayyave arachin shanu kan utnan chayyave arachin memashkenin otan
Vechi dato shel adam al atzmo lemashkeno
Ella amar rabbi abba kol hammakdish nechasav naasa kemi shehikna lahen kesut ishto uvanav meikara
Tanu rabbanan hallokeach sade beshem chavero en kofin oto limkor veim amar lo al menat kofin oto limkor
May kaamar amar rav sheshet hachi kaamar hallokeach sade mechavero beshem resh galuta en kofin oto resh galuta limkor veim amar al menat kofin et resh galuta limkor
Amar mar hallokeach sade beshem resh galuta en kofin oto resh galuta limkor mikkelal demikna kanya leh lema peliga divne mareva deamri vechi mi hodio levaal chittin sheyyakne chittin levaal habbayit
I mishshum ha la kashya kegon deodeh levaal sade veodinhu lesahade
Ella ema sefa al menat kofin oto resh galuta limkor ammay velema resh galuta la yekarayechu baena vela zilutayechu baena
Ella amar abbaye hachi kaamar hallokeach sade beshem chavero resh galuta

a: En kofin et hammocher limkor zimna achariti veim amar lo al menat kofin et hammocher limkor

Amar mar hallokeach sade beshem chavero en kofin et hammocher limkor zimna achariti peshita mahu detema matze amar leh mida yadatte daana lenafshay shakelna ufanchayya bealma hu dekavaena vezuzi bichdi la shadena ella addata dechatev leh shetara acharina ka mashma lan deamar leh inyana avadi lach bahade hahu dizvante leh bishmeh veyichtov lach shetara acharina

Veim amar lo al menat kofin et hammocher limkor peshita la tzericha daamar lehu lesahadi kammeh dideh chazo dishtara acharina ka vaena mahu detema matze amar leh amena shetara mehayech deka shaklatte bishmeh kaamratte ka mashma lan daamar leh lehachi terachi vaamari lehu leedim kammach deminach hu deka vaena

Rav kahana yehav zuza akkitana lesof iyyakar kitana zabbeneh maraoteh dechitana ata lekammeh derav amar leh ma ebed ezil eshkol zuzay amar leh i ki ka mezabbeni amri hay kitana dechahana hu zil shekol vei la la tishkol
Keman kivne mareva deamri mi hodio levaal chittin sheyyakne chittin levaal maot
Attu mi yahev rav kahana arba veshakel tamne kitana mimmela hu deiyyakar migzal gazluh utnan kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela
Amri hatam amana havay vela mashcheh rav kahana lechitana verav letameh daamar rav osin amana beferot veen osin amana bedamim
Matni haggozel et chavero shave peruta venishba lo yolichennu acharav lemaday lo yitten lo livno velo lishlucho aval noten lishliach bet din veim met yachazir leorshav

Natan lo et hakkeren venishba lo al hachomesh

Leolam rabbi akiva hi vechi kaamar rabbi akiva ad sheyeshallem gezela lechol echad veechad hecha deishteva hu dekaamar may tama deamar kera laasher hu lo yittenennu beom ashmato

Verabbi tarfon af al gav deishteva avud rabbanan takkanta detanya rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer takkana gedola hitkinu sheim hayeta hotzaa yetera al hakkeren meshallem keren vachomesh levet din umevi ashamo umitkapper lo
Verabbi akiva ki avud rabbanan takkanta hecha deyada leman gazleh deka mahdar leh mamona lemareh gazal echad mechamishsha dela yada leman gazleh dela hadar mamona lemareh la avud rabbanan takkanta

Metiv rav huna bar yehuda amar rabbi shimon ben elazar lo nechleku rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva al shellakach echad mechamishsha veeno yodea meeze mehen lakach shemmanniach deme mikkach benehem umistallek al ma nechleku sheggazal echad mechamishsha bene adam veeno yodea meeze mehen gazal sherabbi tarfon omer manniach deme gezela benehem umistallek verabbi akiva omer en lo takkana ad sheyeshallem gezela lechol echad veechad
Vei salka datach deishteva ma li lakach ma li gazal

Veod metiv rava maase bechasid echad shellakach mishshene bene adam velo haya yodea meeze mehen lakach uva lifne rabbi tarfon amar lo hannach deme mikkachacha benehem vehistallek ba lifne rabbi akiva amar lo en lecha takkana ad shetteshallem lechol echad veechad vei salka datach demishteva chasid mi mishteva beshikra

Vechi tema demishteva vahadar have chasid veha kol hecha deamrinan maase bechasid echad o rabbi yehuda ben bava o rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay verabbi yehuda ben bava verabbi yehuda berabbi ilay chasidim demeikara hao
Ella leolam rabbi tarfon hi umode rabbi tarfon hecha deishteva may tama deamar kera laasher hu lo yittenennu beom ashmato verabbi akiva deamar af al gav dela mishteva kanes

Verabbi tarfon mikkede hecha demishteva la saggi dela hoda may irya venishba afilu bela shevua name detanya mode rabbi tarfon beomer lishnayim gazalti echad mikkem mane veeni yodea eze mikkem noten laze mane velaze mane

a: Shekkevar hoda mippi atzmo

Ella amar rava shane matnitin dechevan deyada leman gazleh veodi leh kevan deefshar leahdore mamona lemareh have leh keman deamar leh yihu li beyadcha hilkach nishba af al gav dekaamar leh yihu li beyadcha kevan devae kappara la saggi ad demate lideh ha la ishteva have gabbeh pikkadon ad deate veshakel leh
Lo yitten lo livno velo lishlucho itmar shaliach sheasao beedim rav chisda amar have shaliach rabba amar la have shaliach
Rav chisda amar have shaliach lehachi terachi veokmeh beedim deleku birshuteh rabba amar la have shaliach hachi kaamar inish mehemna hu i samchatte semoch i baet leshaddore bideh shaddar bideh
Tenan hashshoel et happara veshilchah beyad beno beyad avdo beyad shelucho o beyad beno beyad avdo beyad shelucho shel shoel umeta patur
Hay shelucho hechi dame i delo asa asao beedim mena yadinan ella deasa daasao beedim vekatane defatur kashya lerav chisda
Kidamar rav chisda bischiro ulkito hacha name bischiro ulkito
Tenan lo yitten lo livno velo lishlucho hay shelucho hechi dame i dela asao beedim mena yadinan ella lav daasao beedim targemah rav chisda bischiro ulkito
Aval shaliach sheasao beedim may hachi name dehave shaliach addetane sefa aval noten hu lishliach bet din liflog velitne bedideh shaliach sheasao beedim hachi name dehave shaliach

Amri la pesika leh sheliach bet din la shena asao nigzal vela shena asao gazlan have shaliach pesika leh sheliach sheasao beedim dechi asao nigzal hu dehave shaliach asao gazlan la have shaliach la pesika leh
Ulappoke mehay tanna detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer sheliach bet din sheasao nigzal velo asao gazlan o asao gazlan veshalach halla venatal et shello miyyado patur
Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayehu shaliach sheasao beedim have shaliach veim tomar mishnatenu
Bemamtzi lo shaliach daamar leh it li zuze gabbe felanya vela ka meshaddar lehu itchazi leh dilma inish hu dela mashkach leshaddore leh
I name kidrav chisda bischiro ulkito
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel
b: En meshallechin maot bidokne vaafilu edim chatumim aleha verabbi yochanan amar im edim chatumim aleha meshallechin

Amri lishmuel may takkanta ki ha derabbi abba have massek zuze bidrav yosef bar chama amar leh lerav safra bahade deatet ayetinhu nihali ki azal lehatam amar leh rava bereh mi katav lach hitkabbalti amar leh la i hachi zil beresha veyichtov lach hitkabbalti

Lesof amar leh i katav lach name hitkabbalti lav kelum hu dilma addeatet shachev rabbi abba venaflu zuze kamme yatme vehitkabbalti derabbi abba lav kelum hu amar leh veella may takkanta zil nakninhu lach aggav ara veta atte ketov lan hitkabbalti
Ki ha derav pappa hava massek teresar alfe zuze be chozae akninhu nihaleh lerav shemuel bar abba aggav assipa deveteh ki ata nefak leappeh ad tevach
Natan lo et hakkeren vechu alma chomesh mamona hu veim mayet meshallemi leh yorshin
Utnan name natan et hakkeren venishba al hachomesh hare mosif chomesh al chomesh alma chumsha mamona hu
Vetanya name hachi haggozel et chavero venishba lo vamet yorshin meshallemim keren vachomesh ufturin min haasham
Veorshin bene shallome chumsha daavuhon hau alma chomesh mamona hu uvae shallome yorshin urminhu adayin ani omer ematay eno meshallem chomesh al gezel aviv bizman shello nishba lo hu velo aviv
Hu velo aviv aviv velo hu hu veaviv minnayin talmud lomar asher gazal vaasher ashak vehu lo gazal velo ashak
Amar rav nachman la kashya kan shehoda kan shello hoda
I lo hoda keren name la meshallem vechi tema hachi name dela meshallem veha middeka mehaddar achomesh lememra dekeren meshallem

Veod tanya vaadayin ani omer ematay hu meshallem keren al gezel aviv bizman shennishba hu veaviv aviv velo hu hu velo aviv lo hu velo aviv minnayin talmud lomar gezela vaoshek aveda ufikkadon yesh talmud
Veyatev rav huna vekaamar leha shemata amar leh rabba bereh yesh talmud kaamar mar o yishtalmu kaamar mar amar leh yesh talmud kaamena umeribuya dikrae amari
Ella may lo hoda lo hoda aviv vehoda beno
Venichayyav beno chomesh ashshevua dideh amri besheen gezela kayyemet i besheen gezela kayyemet afilu keren name la meshallem la tzericha deika achraut
Vechi ika achraut nechasim may have milva al pe hi umilva al pe eno gove lo min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot
Amri

a: Besheamad baddin i besheamad baddin afilu chomesh name meshallem amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lefi sheen meshallemin chomesh al kefirat shibud karkaot
Rava amar hacha bemay askinan kegon shehayeta disakkayya shel aviv mufkedet beyad acherim keren meshallem deha iteh chomesh la meshallem dechi ishteva bekushta ishteva deha la hava yada
Chutz mippachot shave peruta bakkeren ku amar rav pappa lo shanu ella sheen gezela kayyemet aval gezela kayyemet tzarich lelech acharav chayeshinan shemma tiyyaker
Ika deamri amar rav pappa la shena gezela kayyemet vela shena sheen gezela kayyemet eno tzarich lelech acharav leshemma tiyyaker la chayeshinan

Amar rava gazal shalosh aguddot beshalosh perutot vehuzlu veamdu al shettayim im hechzir lo shettayim chayyav lehachazir lo acheret vetanna tuna gazal chametz veavar alav happesach omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha
Tama deiteh beeneh ha leteh beeneh af al gav dehashta lav mamona kevan demeikara mamona hu bae shallome hacha name af al gav dehashta lo shave peruta kevan demeikara have shave peruta bae shallome
Bae rava gazal shette aguddot bifruta vehechzir lo achat mehen mahu mi amrinan hashta leka gezela o dilma ha la ahdar gezela dahavay gabbeh
Hadar pashtah gezela en kan hashava en kan i gezela en kan hashava yesh kan hachi kaamar af al pi sheggezela en kan mitzvat hashava en kan

Veamar rava hare amru nazir sheggilach veshiyyer shette searot lo asa velo chelum bae rava gilach achat venashra achat mahu amar leh rav acha middifti leravina nazir sheggilach achat achat ka mibbaya leh lerava

Amar leh la tzericha kegon shennashra achat mehen vegilach achat mi amrinan hashta mihat ha leka shiur o dilma ha lav giluach hu demeikara ha shayyar shette searot vehashta ki gilach la have shette searot
Hadar pashtah sear en kan giluach en kan i sear en kan giluach yesh kan hachi kaamar af al pi shessear en kan mitzvat giluach en kan
Veamar rava hare amru chavit shennikva ustamuha shemarim hitztziluha bae rava agaf chetzyah mahu

Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe lav mishnatenu hi zo ditnan chavit shennikva ustamuha shemarim hitztziluha pekakah bizmora ad sheyemarach hau bah shettayim ad sheyemarach min hatztzedadim uven zemora lachavertah
Tama demarach ha la marach la ammay vetihve ki agaf chetzyah
Amri hachi hashta hatam i la marach la kae agaf chetzyah bemide dekae kae
Veamar rava hare amru gazal chametz veavar alav happesach omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha bae rava
b: Nishba alav mahu mi amrinan kevan dei mignev bae shallome leh mamona ka chafar leh o dilma hashta mihat ha mannach veafra bealma hu vela kafar leh mamona
Milta deibaya leh lerava peshita leh lerabba deamar rabba shori ganavta vehu omer lo ganavti
Ma tivo etzlecha shomer chinnam ani alav chayyav shehare patar atzmo miggeneva vaaveda
Shomer sachar ani alav chayyav shehare patar atzmo mishshevura umeta
Shoel ani alav chayyav shehare patar atzmo mimmeta mechamat melacha

Alma af al gav deha kaem kevan dei mignev mamona ka chafar hashta name mamona ka chafar hacha name af al gav deafra bealma hu kevan dei migniv bae shallome leh mamona mealleya hashta name mamona ka chafar leh
Yatev rava vekaamar leha shemata etiveh rav amram lerava vechichesh bah perat lemode baikar
Ketzad shori ganavta vehu omer lo ganavti

Ma tivo etzlecha atta mecharto li atta netatto li bemattana avicha mecharo li avicha netano li bemattana achar parati ratz meelav ba etzli toe badderech metzativ shomer chinnam ani alav shomer sachar ani alav shoel ani alav venishba vehoda yachol yehe chayyav talmud lomar vechichesh bah perat lemode baikar
Amar leh tedora ki tanya hahi dekaamar leh helach ki kaamena dekayema baagam
Atta mecharto li may mode baikar ika la tzericha deamar leh lo natatti lecha deme shekol torach vezil
Atta netatto li avicha netano li may mode baikar ika deamar leh al menat deavedna lach neyach denafsha vela avadi lach shekol torach vezil
Toe badderech metzativ lema ibi lach leahadoreh li amar avuh dishmuel beomer shevua aveda matzati velo hayiti yodea shehi shellecha sheachzirenna lach
Tanya amar ben azzay shalosh shevuot hen hikkir bah velo bemotzah bemotzah velo bah lo bah velo bemotzah
Lo bah velo bemotzah kushta ishteva ema bah uvmotzah
Lemay hilcheta rav amme amar rabbi chanina liftur ushmuel amar lechiyyuv
Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya hammashbia ed echad patur verabbi elazar berabbi shimon mechayyev
Bemay ka mipalgi mar savar davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame umar savar lav kemamon dame
Amar rav sheshet hakkofer befikkadon naase alav gazlan vechayyav baonasin vetanna tuna vechichesh bah lamadnu onesh azhara minnayin talmud lomar lo techachashu may lav leonesh mamon

La leonesh shevua ha middekatane sefa veishteva mikkelal deresha dela ishteva dekatane sefa venishba al shaker lamadnu onesh azhara minnayin talmud lomar lo teshakkeru umiddesefa deishteva resha dela ishteva
Amri ide veide deishteva kan shehoda kan shebbau edim ato edim chayyav beunsin odoye odi chayyav bekeren vechomesh veasham
Metiv rame bar chama veshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua ketzad echad shevuat haedut veechad shevuat happikkadon vaafilu shevuat shave
Veim ita bichfira hu deipsil leh
Amri hacha bemay askinan dekae baagam delav kefira hu desavar ishtemitna leh addeazelna umayetena leh
Tidda deamar rav idi bar avin hakkofer bemilva kasher leedut

a: Befikkadon pasul leedut
Vehaamar ilfa shevua kona shevua hi dekanya aval kefira la kanya hacha name dekayema baagam

Veibaet ema may shevua kona kidrav huna deamar rav huna amar rav mane li beyadcha vehalla omer en lecha beyadi venishba veachar kach bau edim patur shenneemar velakach bealav velo yeshallem kevan shekkibbelu habbealim shevua shuv en meshallem mamon

Gufa amar rav huna amar rav mane li beyadcha vehalla omer en lecha beyadi kelum venishba uvau edim patur shenneemar velakach bealav velo yeshallem kevan shekkibbelu bealim shevua shuv en meshallemin mamon
Amar rava mistabbera milteh derav bemilva dilhotzaa nitna aval pikkadon birshuteh demareh kae vehaelohim amar rav afilu befikkadon dechi ketiv kera befikkadon ketiv

Yatev rav nachman vekaamar leha shemata etiveh rav acha bar minome lerav nachman hechan pikdoni amar lo avad mashbiacha ani veamar amen vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo meshallem et hakkeren hoda meatzmo meshallem keren vachomesh veasham

Amar leh rav nachman hacha bemay askinan kegon denishba chutz levet din amar leh i hachi ema sefa hechan pikdoni amar lo nignav mashbiacha ani veamar amen vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo meshallem tashlume chefel hoda meatzmo meshallem keren vachomesh veasham vei salka datach chutz levet din mi ika kefel
Amar leh yachelna leshannoye lach resha chutz levet din vesefa bevet din mihu shinuya dechika la meshannena lach ide veide bevet din vela kashya kan bekafatz kan beshello kafatz
Amar leh rame bar chama lerav nachman mikkede derav la sevira lach mashkone nafshach adderav lema lach amar leh lefaroshah lidrav derav hachi metaretz lah lematnitin
Veha rav kera kaamar amri kera lechol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin hu daata velakach bealav velo yeshallem mi shealav leshallem hu nishba
Metiv rav hamnuna hishbia alav chamishsha peamim ben bifne bet din uven shello bifne bet din vechafar alav chayyav al kol achat veachat veamar rabbi shimon ma taam hoil veyachol lachazor ulhodot
Vehacha kafatz la matzet amratte hishbia alav katane chutz levet din la matzet amratte bifne bet din katane
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah litzdadin katane hishbia alav chutz levet din uvvet din kafatz

Metiv rava baal habbayit shettaan taanat gannav befikkadon venishba vehoda uvau edim im ad shello bau edim hoda meshallem keren vachomesh veasham veim mishshebbau edim hoda meshallem tashlume chefel veasham
Vehacha chutz levet din vekafatz la matzet amratte kefel katane
Ella amar rava kol hoda la shena toen taanat avad vela shena toen taanat gannav name la amar rav deha ketiv vehitvadda devae shallome keren vachomesh
Toen taanat gannav uvau edim name la amar rav deha ketiv tashlume chefel ki kaamar kegon shettoen taanat avad venishba velo hoda uvau edim
Azal rav gammada veamrah lishmata kammeh derav ashe amar leh hashta uma rav hamnuna talmideh derav veyada deamar rav hoda vekamotev hoda veatte amratte hoda la amar rav
Amar leh rav acha sava lerav ashe rav hamnuna hachi ka kashya leh
b: I amratte bishlama nishba ki ato edim michayyav ammetu lehachi mechayevinan leh korban ashshevua batrayeta hoil veyachol lachazor ulhodot
Ella i amratte ki ato edim patur mi ika mide deilu atu sahadi umashadi beh patur vaanan neku nichayeveh korban ashshevua hoil veyachol lachazor ulhodot hashta mihat la odi
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon meshallem tashlume chefel tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha

Hoil vegannav meshallem tashlume chefel vetoen taanat gannav meshallem tashlume chefel ma gannav shehu meshallem kefel tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha af toen taanat gannav befikkadon keshehu meshallem tashlume chefel tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Ma legannav shekken meshallem tashlume chefel shello bishvua tomar betoen taanat gannav sheen meshallem tashlume chefel ella bishvua
Amri hekesha hi veen meshivin al hekesha
Hanicha leman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav shappir ella leman deamar hay im yimmatze haggannav veim lo yimmatze tarvayehu betoen taanat gannav may ika lememar

Etiveh rabbi chiyya bar abba lerabbi yochanan hechan shori nignav mashbiacha ani veamar amen vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo meshallem tashlume chefel veha hacha dei efshar lichzayit basar belo shechita vekatane meshallem tashlume chefel tashlume chefel in tashlume arbaa vachamishsha la

Velishanne leh kegon sheachalo terefa kerabbi meir deamar shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita
Velishanne leh beven pekua kerabbi meir deamar ben pekua taun shechita

Velishanne leh kegon sheamad baddin veamru lo tze ten lo deha amar rava tze ten lo tavach umachar patur may tama kevan defaskeh lemilteh vetavach umachar have gazlan vegazlan la meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha
Chayyav atta liten lo vetavach umachar chayyav may tama kol kamma dela pesika leh milta akkatti gannav hu
Amri velitamach lishanne leh beshuttaf shettavach shello middaat chavero ella chada mittere utlata naket
Veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hattoen taanat gannav baaveda meshallem tashlume chefel may tama dichtiv al kol aveda asher yomar

Etiveh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi chiyya bar abba ki yitten ish en netinat katan kelum veen li ella shennetano keshehu katan utvao keshehu katan netano keshehu katan utvao keshehu gadol minnayin talmud lomar ad haelohim yavo devar shenehem ad shettehe netina utvia shavin keechad
Veim ita tehve name kaaveda amar leh hacha bemay askinan kegon sheachalo keshehu katan

Aval keshehu gadol may hachi name dimshallem i hachi additna ad shettehe netina utvia shavin keechad litne ad shettehe achila utvia shavin keechad amar leh teni ad shettehe achila utvia shavin keechad
Rav ashe amar la dame aveda ka atya mikkoach ben daat veha la atya mikkoach ben daat

Veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon eno chayyav ad sheyyichpor bemiktzat veode bemiktzat may tama deamar kera ki hu ze ufliga derabbi chiyya bar yosef deamar rabbi chiyya bar yosef

Uvchulleh bae delode leh vehay dichfar leh bemiktzat savar i modena leh bechulleh tava li bechulleh eshtemet leh miha hashta addehau li zuze ufarana hilkach rema rachamana shevua ilaveh ki hechi delode leh bechulleh
Vegabbe milva hu deika lememar hachi aval gabbe pikkadon meiz umeiz
Tane rame bar chama arbaa shomrin
b: Tzerichin kefira bemiktzat vehodaa bemiktzat veellu hen shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher
Amar rava may tama derame bar chama shomer chinnam behedya ketiv beh ki hu ze shomer sachar yalef netinahntina mishshomer chinnam
Shoel vechi yishal vav mosif al inyan rishon socher i leman deamar keshomer sachar hayenu shomer sachar i leman deamar keshomer chinnam hayenu shomer chinnam

Veamar rabbi chiyya bar yosef hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon eno chayyav ad sheyyishlach bo yad may tama venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu mikkelal dei shalach bah yad michayyav lememra divshalach bah yad askinan

Amar lehu rabbi chiyya bar abba hachi amar rabbi yochanan beomedet al avusah shanu amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi chiyya bar abba daveka beomedet al avusah kaamar aval shalach bah yad kana ushvua la mahneya beh kelum o dilma afilu omedet al avusah kaamar

Amar leh zo lo shamati kayyotze bah shamati deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan hattoen taanat avad venishba vechazar vetaan taanat gannav venishba uvau edim patur may tama lav mishshum dekana bishvua rishona
Amar leh la hoil veyatza yede bealim bishvua rishona
Itmar name amar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila amar rabbi yochanan hattoen taanat aveda befikkadon venishba vechazar vetaan taanat geneva venishba uvau edim patur hoil veyatza yede bealim bishvua rishona
Amar rav sheshet hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon kevan sheshshalach bo yad patur may tama hachi kaamar rachamana venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim im lo shalach yado vego ha shalach yado patur

Amar leh rav nachman vahalo shalosh shavuot mashbiin oto shevua shello pashati bah shevua shello shalachti bah yad shevua sheenah birshuti may lav shevua shello shalachti bah yad dumya dishvua sheenah birshuti ma shevua sheenah birshuti ki migalleya milta deiteh birshuteh chayyav af shevua shello shalachti bah yad ki migalleya milta dishlach bah yad chayyav

Amar leh la shevua shello shalachti bah yad dumya deshello pashati bah ma shevua shello pashati bah ki migalleya milta defasha bah patur mikkefel af shevua shello shalachti bah yad ki migalleya milta dishlach bah yad patur mikkefel
Bae rame bar chama mamon hamchayevo kefel potro min hachomesh o dilma shevua hamchayyavto kefel potarto min hachomesh
Hechi dame kegon shettaan taanat gannav venishba vechazar vetaan taanat avad venishba

Vei salka datach shevua hamchayyavto kefel potarto min hachomesh ammay hoda achar edim la mikkedi ha shevua la ka mechayeva leh kefela techayeveh chumsha
Ella lav shema minah mamon hamchayevo kefel potrto min hachomesh shema minah
Bae ravina chomesh uchfela bitre gavre may hechi dame kegon shemmasar shoro lishne bene adam vetaanu bo taanat gannav chad nishba vehoda vechad nishba uvau edim may

Mi amrinan bechad gavra kafed rachamana dela meshallem chumsha uchfela hay neshallem kefela vehay neshallem chumsha o dilma illave chad mamona kafed rachamana dela neshallem aleh chumsha uchfela vehacha name chad mamona hu teku

Bae rav pappa tere chumshe o tere chefele bechad gavra may hechi dame shettaan taanat avad venishba vehoda vechazar vetaan taanat avad venishba vehoda i name kegon shettaan taanat gannav venishba uvau edim vechazar vetaan taanat gannav venishba uvau edim may

Mi amrinan tere gavene mamona kaamar rachamana dela nishtallemu ilave chad mamona vehacha chad gavena hu o dilma tere mamone amar rachamana dela lishtallemu ilave chad mamona vehacha name tere mamone ninhu
Ta shema deamar rava vachamishitav yosef alav hattora ribta chamishiyyot harbe lekeren achat shema minah
Tevauhu bealim lashshomer venishba veshilem vehukkar haggannav kefel lemi abbaye amar levaal happikkadon rava amar lemi shehappikkadon etzlo
Abbaye amar levaal happikkadon kevan deatrecheh bishvua la makne leh kefela rava amar lemi shehappikkadon etzlo kevan deshilem makne leh kefela

Veka mipalgi bediyyuka dematnitin ditnan hammafkid etzel chavero behema o chelim venignevu o sheavdu shilem velo ratza lishava shehare amru shomer chinnam nishba veotze nimtza haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha lemi hu meshallem lemi shehappikkadon etzlo
Nishba velo ratza leshallem venimtza haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha lemi hu meshallem levaal happikkadon
Abbaye dayek meresha rava dayek missefa abbaye dayek meresha dekatane shilem velo ratza lishava tama delo ratza lishava
b: Ha nishba af al pi sheshshilem lemi meshallem levaal happikkadon
Rava dayek missefa nishba velo ratza leshallem tama delo ratza leshallem ha shilem af al pi shennishba lemi meshallem lemi shehappikkadon etzlo

Leabbaye kashya sefa amar lach abbaye hachi katane nishba velo ratza leshallem kodem hashshevua ella leachar hashshevua lemi meshallem levaal happikkadon lerava kashya resha amar lach rava hachi katane shilem velo ratza laamod bishvuato ella shilem lemi meshallem lemi shehappikkadon etzlo
Tevauhu bealim lashshomer venishba vehukkar haggannav tevao shomer vehoda tevauhu bealim vechafar veheviu edim mi niftar haggannav behodaat shomer o lo niftar haggannav behodaat shomer
Amar rava im beemet nishba niftar haggannav behodaat shomer im besheker nishba lo niftar haggannav behodaat shomer
Bae rava amad lishava besheker velo hinnichuhu mahu teku rav kahana matne hachi rav tavome matne bae rava nishba lashsheker mahu teku
Tevauhu bealim lashshomer veshilem vehukkar haggannav tevauhu bealim vehoda tevao shomer vechafar vehevi edim niftar gannav behodaat bealim o lo

Mi amrinan matze amar leh shomer livalim attun kevan deshaklitu lechu deme isteliktu lechu mehacha o dilma matze amri leh ki hechi deatte avadte lan milta anan name avdinan lach tarchinan batar gannava shakelna shaklinan anan didan ushkol atte didach teku

Ittemar nigneva beones vehukkar haggannav amar abbaye im shomer chinnam hu ratza ose immo din ratza nishba im shomer sachar hu ose immo din veeno nishba rava amar echad ze veechad ze ose immo din veeno nishba
Lema peliga adderav huna bar avin dishlach rav huna bar avin nigneva beones vehukkar haggannav im shomer chinnam hu ratza ose immo din ratza nishba veim shomer sachar hu ose immo din veeno nishba
Amar lach rava hacha bemay askinan kegon shekkadam venishba veha ratza ose immo din ratza nishba kaamar hachi kaamar ratza shomer chinnam omed bishvuato ratza ose immo din
Rabba zute bae lah hachi nigneva beones vehechzir gannav bevet shomer umeta bifshia mahu mi amrinan kevan denigneva beones kalya leh shemirato o dilma kevan deahderah hadara lishmirato teku
Matni hechan pikdoni amar lo avad mashbiacha ani veamar amen vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo meshallem keren hoda meatzmo meshallem keren vachomesh veasham
Hechan pikdoni amar lo nignav mashbiacha ani veamar amen vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo meshallem tashlume chefel hoda meatzmo meshallem keren chomesh veasham
Haggozel et aviv venishba lo vamet hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh veasham levanav o leechav veim eno rotze o sheen lo love uvaale chov bain venifraim
Haomer livno kunnam i atta nehene mishshelli im met yirashennu

a: Bechayyav uvmoto im met lo yirashennu veyachzir levanav o leechav veim en lo love uvaale chov baim venifraim
Gema amar rav yosef afilu learnaki shel tzedaka amar rav pappa vetzarich sheyyomar ze gezel avi
Ammay nimchaleh lenafsheh mi la tenan machal lo al hakkeren velo machal lo al hachomesh alma bar mechila hu
Amar rabbi yochanan la kashya ha rabbi yose haggelili ha rabbi akiva
Detanya veim en laish goel lehashiv haasham vechi yesh adam beyisrael sheen lo goalim ella begezel hagger hakkatuv medabber

Hare sheggazal hagger venishba lo veshama shemmet hagger vehaya maale kaspo vaashamo lirushalayim ufaga beoto hagger uzkafo alav bemilva umet zacha halla bema shebbeyado divre rabbi yose haggelili rabbi akiva omer en lo takkana ad sheyyotzi gezelo mittachat yado
Lerabbi yose haggelili la shena lenafsheh la shena laacherim matze machel ulrabbi akiva la shena laacherim vela shena lenafsheh la matze machel
Ulrabbi yose hu haddin daafilu lo zekafo bemilva vehay dekatane zekafo alav bemilva lehodiacha kocho derabbi akiva daafilu zekafan alav bemilva en lo takkana ad sheyyotzi gezela mittachat yado
Matkef lah rav sheshet i hachi lerabbi yose haggelili lashmeinan lenafsheh vechol shekken laacherim lerabbi akiva lashmeinan laacherim dela matze machel vechol shekken lenafsheh dela matze machel

Ella amar rav sheshet ha veha rabbi yose haggelili ki kaamar rabbi yose haggelili dematze machel laacherim aval lenafsheh la matze machel ella ammay zacha halla bema shebbeyado mishshum dizkafan alav bemilva
Rava amar ha veha rabbi akiva ki amar rabbi akiva dela matze machel lenafsheh aval laacherim matze machel
b: Mikkelal derabbi yose haggelili savar afilu lenafsheh name matze machel ella gezel hagger dekaamar rachamana netina lechohanim hechi mashkachatte lah
Amar rava hacha bemay askinan kesheggazal et hagger venishba lo umet hagger vehoda leachar mita dividana deodi kenao hashshem untano lechohanim
Bae ravina gezel haggiyyoret mahu ish amar rachamana velo ishsha o dilma orcheh dikra hu
Amar leh rav aharon leravina ta shema detanya ish en li ella ish ishsha minnayin keshehu omer hammushav hare kan shenayim
Im ken ma talmud lomar ish ish atta tzarich lachazor acharav im yesh lo goalim im lav katan i atta tzarich lachazor acharav beyadua sheen lo goalin

Tanu rabbanan la lakkohen kenao hashshem untano lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar atta omer lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar o eno ella lechol kohen sheyyirtze keshehu omer millevad el hakkippurim asher yechapper bo alav hare lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar hakkatuv medabber
Tanu rabbanan hare shehaya gozel kohen minnayin shello yomar hoil veotze lakkohanim vahare hu tachat yadi yehe shelli vedin hu i beshel acherim hu zoche beshel atzmo lo kol shekken

Rabbi natan omer belashon acher uma davar sheen lo chelek bo ad sheyyikkanes birshuto kesheyyikkanes lirshuto eno yachol lehotzio miyyado davar sheyyesh lo chelek bo ad shello yikkanes birshuto mishshennichnas lirshuto eno din deen acher yachol lehotzio miyyado

Lo im amarta bedavar sheen lo chelek bo shekkeshem sheen lo chelek bo kach en laacherim chelek bo tomar begazel shekkeshem sheyyesh lo chelek bo kach yesh laacherim chelek bo ella gezelo yotze mittachat yado umitchallek lechol echav hakkohanim
Vehachtiv veish et kodashav lo yihu hacha bemay askinan bechohen tame
I bechohen tame davar sheyyesh lo chelek bo mi it leh ella atya lakkohenlakkohen missede achuzza
Detanya achuzzato ma talmud lomar minnayin lesade hayyotza lakkohanim bayyovel ugalah echad min hakkohanim minnayin shello yomar hoil veotza lakkohanim bayyovel vahare hi tachat yadi tehe shelli
Vedin hu beshel acherim ani zoche beshel atzmi lo kol shekken
Talmud lomar kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato achuzza shello veen zo shello ha ketzad yotza mittachat yado umitchalleket lechol echav hakkohanim
Tanu rabbanan minnayin lechohen shebba umakriv korbenotav bechol et uvchol shaa sheyyirtze talmud lomar uva bechol avat nafsho vesheret
Uminnayin sheavodatah veorah shello talmud lomar veish et kodashav lo yihu ha ketzad im haya baal mum notnah lechohen shebbeoto mishmar vaavodatah veorah shello

a: Veim haya zaken o chole notnah lechol kohen sheyyirtze vaavodatah veorah leanshe mishmar
Hay zaken o chole hechi dame i dematze aved avoda avodatah veorah name tehve dideh vei dela matze aved avoda shaliach hechi meshave

Amar rav pappa sheyyachol laasot al yede haddechak avoda dechi aved leh al yede haddechak avoda hi umshave shaliach achila dechi achel al yede haddechak achila gassa hi vaachila gassa lav kelum hu mishshum hachi avodatah veorah leanshe mishmar

Amar rav sheshet im haya kohen tame bekorban tzibbur notnah lechol mi sheyyirtze vaavodatah veorah leanshe mishmar hechi dame i deika tehorim temeim mi matzu avdi vei deleka tehorim avodatah veorah leanshe mishmar ha temeim ninhu vela matzu achli
Amar rava ema levaale mumin tehorin shebbeoto mishmar
Amar rav ashe im haya kohen gadol onen notnah lechol kohen sheyyirtze vaavodatah veorah leanshe mishmar may ka mashma lan tenena kohen gadol makriv onen veeno ochel veeno cholek leechol laerev
Salka datach amena ki chas rachamana aleh dechohen gadol lekarove hu aval leshauoye shaliach la matze meshave ka mashma lan

Matni haggozel et hagger venishba lo vamet hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh lakkohanim veasham lammizbeach shenneemar veim en laish goel lehashiv haasham elav haasham hammushav la lakkohen millevad el hakkippurim asher yechapper bo alav

Haya maale et hakkesef veet haasham vamet hakkesef yinnaten levanav vehaasham yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava natan hakkesef leanshe mishmar vamet en hayyorshin yecholin lehotzi miyyadam shenneemar veish asher yitten lakkohen lo yihye

Natan hakkesef lihoyariv veasham lidaya yatza asham lihoyariv vechesef lidaya im kayyam haasham yakrivuhu bene yedaya veim lo yachazir veyavi asham acher shehammevi gezelo ad shello hevi ashamo yatza hevi ashamo ad shello hevi gezelo lo yatza
Natan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh en hachomesh meakkev
Gema tanu rabbanan asham ze keren hammushav ze chomesh o eno ella asham ze ayil
Ulmay nafka minah leappoke midderava deamar rava gezel hagger shehechziro ballayela lo yatza hechziro chatzain lo yatza may tama asham karyeh rachamana
Keshehu omer millevad el hakkippurim heve omer asham ze keren

Tanya idach asham ze keren hammushav ze chomesh o eno ella asham ze chomesh lemay nafka minah leappoke mimmatnitin ditnan natan lo et hakkeren velo natan lo et hachomesh en hachomesh meakkev adderabba chomesh meakkev
Keshehu omer veheshiv et ashamo berosho vachamishito heve omer asham ze keren

Tanya idach asham ze keren hammushav ze chomesh uvgezel hagger hakkatuv medabber o eno ella hammushav ze kefel uvignevat hagger hakkatuv medabber keshehu omer veheshiv et ashamo berosho vachamishito hare bemamon hammishtallem barosh hakkatuv medabber
Gufa amar rava gezel hagger shehechziro ballayela lo yatza hechziruhu chatzain lo yatza may tama asham karyeh rachamana
Veamar rava gezel hagger sheen bo shave peruta lechol kohen vechohen lo yatza yede chovato may tama dichtiv haasham hammushav ad sheyehe hashava lechol kohen vechohen
Bae rava en bo lemishmeret yehoyariv veyesh bo
b: Lemishmeret yedaya mahu
Hechi dame ilema deyahaveh lidaya bemishmeret yedaya ha it beh
La tzericha deyahaveh lidaya bemishmarto dihoyariv may mi amrinan kevan delav mishmarto hu vela kelum hu o dilma kevan dela chaze leh meikara lidaya kae teku
Bae rava kohanim mahu sheyyachleku gezel hagger keneged gezel hagger
Mi amrinan asham karyeh rachamana ma asham en cholkin asham keneged asham af gezel en cholkin gezel hagger keneged gezel hagger o dilma gezel hagger mamona hu
Hadar pashtah asham karyeh rachamana rav acha bereh derava matne lah behedya amar rava kohanim en cholkin gezel hagger keneged gezel hagger may tama asham karyeh rachamana
Bae rava kohanim begezel hagger yorshin hau o mekabbele mattanot hau

Lemay nafka minah kegon sheggazal chametz sheavar alav happesach i amratte yorshin hau hayenu hay deyarti moret vei amratte mekabbele mattanot hau mattana kaamar rachamana denitev lehu veha la ka yahev lehu mide deafra bealma hu
Rav zeera bae hachi afilu im timtze lomar mekabbele mattana hau ha la ibaya lan dehahi mattana amar rachamana denitev lehu
Ella ki kamibbaya lan kegon shennaflu lo eser behemot begezel hagger mi michayevi leafroshe minayehu maaser o la
Yorshin hau deamar mar kanu bitfisat habbayit chayyavin o dilma mekabbele mattanot hau utnan hallokeach vehannitan lo bemattana patur mimmasar behema may
Ta shema esrim vearba mattenot kehunna nitnu leaharon ulvanav vechullan nitnu bichlal ufrat uchlal uvrit melach
Kol hamkayeman keilu mekayyem kelal ufrat uchlal uvrit melach kol haover alehem keilu over al kelal ufrat uchlal uvrit melach

Veellu hen eser bammikdash vearba birushalayim veeser baggevulim eser bammikdash chattat behema vechattat haof veasham vadday veasham taluy vezivche shalme tzibbur velog shemen shel metzora umotar haomer ushte hallechem velechem happanim ushyare menachot
Vearba birushalayim habbechora vehabbikurim vehammuram min hattoda veel nazir veorot kodashim
Vaasara baggevulin teruma utrumat maaser vechalla vereshit haggez vehammattanot ufidon habben ufidon peter chamor usde achuzza usde charamim vegezel hagger
Veka kare mihat mattana shema minah mekabbele mattanot hau shema minah
Natan et hakkesef leanshe mishmar vechu amar abbaye shema minah kesef mechapper mechetza dei la mechapper hava amena mahdar leorshin may tama addata dehachi la yehav leh
Ella meatta chattat shemmetu bealeha tipok lechullin deaddata dehachi la afreshah amri chattat shemmetu bealeha hilcheta gemiri lah dilmita azla
Ella meatta asham shemmetu bealav lipok lechullin deaddata dehachi la afresheh asham name hilcheta gemiri lah kol shebbachattat meta beasham roe
Ella meatta yevama shennafla lifne mukke shechin tipok bela chalitza deaddata dehachi lo kiddesha atzmah hatam anan sahadi

a: Demenach nicha lah bechol dehu keresh lakish deamar resh lakish tav lemetav tan du millemetav armelu
Natan et hakkesef lihoyariv vechu tanu rabbanan natan asham lihoyariv vechesef lidaya yachazir kesef etzel asham divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim yachazir asham etzel kesef
Hechi dame ilema deyahev leh asham lihoyariv bemishmarto dihoyariv vechesef lidaya bemishmarto didaya ze zacha beshello veze zacha beshello

Amar rava hacha bemay askinan deyahev asham lihoyariv bemishmarto dihoyariv vechesef lidaya bemishmarto dihoyariv rabbi yehuda savar kevan delav mishmarto didaya hi lidaya kansinan leh hilkach yachazir kesef etzel asham verabbanan savri shello kaddin hu avud bene yehoyariv dekabilu asham mikkamme chesef hilkach ledidhu kansinan lehu veyachzor asham etzel kesef
Tanya amar rabbi ledivre rabbi yehuda im kadmu bene yehoyariv vehikrivu et haasham yachzor veyavi asham acher veyakrivuhu bene yedaya vezachu hallalu bema shebbeyadan
Amri lemay chaze asham pasul hu amar rava leoro
Tanya amar rabbi ledivre rabbi yehuda im kayyam asham yachazir asham etzel kesef
Veha rabbi yehuda yachazir kesef etzel asham it leh hacha bemay askinan kegon dinfak mishmarto dihoyariv vela tevau veha ka mashma lan deachole achilu gabbayehu
Tanya idach amar rabbi ledivre rabbi yehuda im kayyam asham yachzor kesef etzel asham peshita hachi it leh
Hacha bemay askinan kegon dinfak mishmartam dehane udhane vela tevau mahu detema achole gabbe hadade ka mashma lan deamrinan kevan dela tavi lihderu beresha
Shehammevi gezelo ad shello hevi ashamo vechu menahane mile amar rava deamar kera haasham hammushav la lakkohen millevad el hakkippurim asher yechapper bo mikkelal dechesef beresha
Amar hahu merabbanan lerava ella meatta millevad olat habboker hachi name mikkelal demusafin beresha
Vehatanya minnayin shello yehe davar kodem letamid shel shachar talmud lomar vearach aleha haola veamar rava haola ola rishona
Amar leh ana measher yechapper bo nafka leh vaadayin lo kiper
Natan lo et hakkeren vechu tanu rabbanan minnayin sheim hevi meilato velo hevi ashamo ashamo velo hevi meilato shello yatza
Talmud lomar beel haasham venislach lo
Uminnayin sheim hevi ashamo ad shello hevi meilato shello yatza talmud lomar beel haasham haasham bichvar
Yachol keshem sheayil veasham meakkevim kach chomesh meakkev talmud lomar beel haasham venislach lo ayil veasham meakkevim behekdesh veen chomesh meakkev
Veyilmad hekdesh mehedot vehedot mehekdesh
Hekdesh mehedot ma asham dehatam keren af asham dehacha keren vehedot mehekdesh ma hekdesh en chomesh meakkev af hedot name en chomesh meakkev
Hadaran alach haggozel etzim
b: Matni haggozel umaachil et banav vehinniach lifnehem peturin milleshallem veim haya davar sheyyesh bo achraut chayyavin leshallem
Gema amar rav chisda gazal velo nityaashu habbealim uva acher vaachalo mimmennu ratza mizze gove ratza mizze gove may tama kol kamma delo nityaashu habbealim birshuteh demareh kae
Tenan haggozel umaachil et banav vehinniach lifnehem peturin milleshallem teuvta derav chisda amar lecha rav chisda ki tanya hahi leachar yeush
Im hinniach lifnehem peturin milleshallem amar rame bar chama zot omeret reshut yoresh kirshut lokeach dame
Rava amar reshut yoresh lav kirshut lokeach dame vehacha bemay askinan kesheachalum

Ha middekatane sefa im haya davar sheyyesh bo achraut chayyavin leshallem mikkelal deresha bigzela kayyemet askinan amar lach rava hachi kaamar im hinniach lahem avihem achraut nechasim chayyavin leshallem
Veha matne leh rabbi lerabbi shimon bereh lo davar sheyyesh bo achraut mammash ella afilu para vechoresh bah chamor umchammer acharav chayyavin lehachzir mippene kevod avihen

Ella amar rava ki shachevna rabbi oshaya nafek leoti detaretzna matnitin keoteh detane rabbi oshaya haggozel umaachil et banav peturin milleshallem hinniach lifnehem gezela kayyemet chayyavin en haggezela kayyemet peturin hinniach lahem avihem achraut nechasim chayyavin leshallem
Amar mar en haggezela kayyemet peturin nema tehve teuvta derav chisda amar lach rav chisda ki tanya hahi leachar yeush
Amar mar gezela kayyemet chayyavin leshallem nema tehve teuvta derame bar chama amar lach rame bar chama ki tanya hahi

a: Lifne yeush

Rav adda bar ahava matne leha derame bar chama aha hinniach lahen avihen maot shel ribbit af al pi sheyyodin shehen shel ribbit en chayyavin lehachzir amar rame bar chama zot omeret reshut yoresh kirshut lokeach dame

Rava amar leolam ema lach reshut yoresh lav kirshut lokeach dame veshane hacha deamar kera al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit ahdar leh ki hechi deneche bahadach ledideh ka mazhar leh rachamana livreh la mazhar leh rachamana
Man dematne lah abbarayeta kol shekken ammatnitin man dematne lah ammatnitin aval abbarayeta rame bar chama kerava matne lah

Tanu rabbanan haggozel umaachil et banav peturin milleshallem hinniach lifnehem gedolim chayyavin leshallem ketannim peturin milleshallem veim amru gedolim en anu yodin cheshbonot shechishshev avinu immach peturin
Mishshum deamri en anu yodin peturim amar rava hachi kaamar gedolim sheamru yodim anu cheshbonot shechishshev avinu immach vela pash lach gabbeh vela mide peturin

Tanya idach haggozel umaachil banav peturin milleshallem hinniach lifnehem vaachalum ben gedolim ben ketannim chayyavin ketannim mi michayevi lo yehe ella deazzek azzoke amar rav pappa hachi kaamar hinniach lifnehem vaadayin lo achalum ben gedolim ben ketannim chayyavin

Amar rava hinniach lahem avihem para sheula mishtammeshin bah kol yeme sheelatah meta en chayyavin beonseha kisvurim shel avihem hi utvachuha vaachaluha meshallemin deme vasar bezol hinniach lahem avihem achraut nechasim chayyavin leshallem
Ika dematne lah aresha veika dematne lah assefa
Man dematne lah aresha kol shekken assefa ufliga derav pappa man dematne lah assefa aval aresha la vehayenu derav pappa

Deamar rav pappa hayeta para genuva lo utvachah beshabbat chayyav shekkevar chayyav bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide isur shabbat hayeta para sheula lo utvachah beshabbat patur sheisur shabbat veisur geneva bain keechad
Tanu rabbanan veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal ma talmud lomar asher gazal yachazir keen sheggazal
Mikkan amru haggozel umaachil et banav peturin milleshallem hinniach lifnehen ben gedolim ben ketannim chayyavin mishshum somchos amru gedolim chayyavin ketannim peturin
Bar chamuh derabbi yirmeya terak galla beappeh derabbi yirmeya ata lekammeh derabbi avin
Amar shello hu tovea amar leh veha mayetina sahadi deachzaki beh bechayye daavuh amar leh vechi mekabbelin edim
b: Shello bifne baal din vela veha katane ben gedolim ben ketannim chayyavin amar leh hare machloket somchos betzidach amar ikfal kulle alma vekae kesomchos leafkoan ledidi

Addehachi igalgal milta ata umta lekammeh derabbi avahu amar la shemia lechu ha derav yosef bar chama amar rabbi oshaya deamar rav yosef bar chama amar rabbi oshaya tinok shettakaf baavadav veyarad letoch sade shel chavero veamar shelli hu en omrim namtin ad sheyyagdil ella motziin miyyado miyyad velichsheyyagdil yavi edim venire
Mi dame hatam hu demappekinan mineh dela kayema leh achazaka daavuh aval hecha deit leh chazaka daavuh la
Amar rav ashe amar rabbi shabbetay mekabbelin edim shello bifne baal din tahe bah rabbi yochanan vechi mekabbelin edim shello bifne baal din
Kablah mineh rabbi yose bar chanina kegon shehaya hu chole o edav cholim o shehau edav mevakkeshin lelech limdinat hayyam veshalchu lo velo ba

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mekabbelin edim shello bifne baal din amar mar ukva ledidi miparsha li mineh dishmuel kegon diftachu leh bedineh ushlachu leh vela ata aval la petachu leh bedina matze amar leh ana levet din haggadol azelna
I hachi ki fatchu leh name matze amar leh levet din haggadol azelna amar ravina kegon denaket diska mibbet din haggadol

Amar rav mekayemin et hashshetar shello bifne baal din verabbi yochanan amar en mekayemin et hashshetar shello bifne baal din amar leh rav sheshet lerabbi yose bar avahu asberah lach tameh derabbi yochanan amar kera vehuad bivalav velo yishmerennu amra tora yavo baal hashshor veyaamod al shoro

Amar rava hilcheta mekayemin et hashshetar shello bifne baal din vaafilu omed vetzoveach vei amar nekitu li zimna ad demayetena sahadi umarana leh lishtara naktinan leh i ata ata i la ata natrinan leh sheni vachamishi vesheni

I la ata katvinan peticha illaveh tishin yomin telatin kammae la nachatinan lenichseh deamrinan ka tarach bezuze venezof metziae name la nachatinan leh lenichseh deamar dilma la ashkach lemezaf veka tarach umzabben batrae name la nachatinan lenichseh deamar lokeach gufeh ka tarach bezuze
La ata katvinan adrachta annichseh vehane mile daamar atena aval amar la atena lealtar katvinan
Vehane mile bemilve aval befikkadon lealtar katvinan
Vechi katvinan ammekarkee aval ammittalteli la dilma shamet veachel lehu malve lemittaltele vechi ate love umayete sahadi umara leh lishtara la mashkach mide lemigbe
Vei it leh mekarkee lemalve katvinan vela hi adrachta ammittalteli la katvinan af al gav deit leh mekarkee chayeshinan shemma tachsif
Vechi katvinan adrachta modinan leh vehane mile dimkarav aval merachak la

Vei merachak veika kerovim i name ika sheyarata deazli veatu hatam meshahenan leh teresar yarche shatta ad deazla veate sheyara ki ha deravina sheha lemar acha teresar yarche shatta ad deazla veatya sheyara mibbe chozae

Vela hi hatam inish allima hava i haveya matya adrachta lideh la hava efshar leappoke mineh aval hacha la natrinan leh ella ad deazel shelicha bitlata beshabbeta veate bearbea beshabbeta ulchamsha beshabbeta kae bedineh
Amar ravina hay shelucha derabbanan mehemninan leh keve tere vehane mile leshamta aval lifticha kevan demamona ka mechassar leh deka vae leh lemitav leh zuze lesafra la
Amar ravina yahavinan zimna appumma deitta veippuma deshivave vela amaran ella deleteh bemata

a: Aval iteh bemata la deamrinan emar la amaru leh deamri ashkechinhu ashkecheh shelicha devet din vaamar leh
Vela amaran ella dela chalef abbava deve dina aval chalef abbava deve dina la amri ashkechuh be dina veamri leh
Vela amaran ella deate beomeh aval la ate beomeh la ema ishteloye ishteli
Amar rava hay man dichtiv aleh peticha al dela ate ledina ad deate ledina la mekarinan leh al dela tzayet ledina ad detzayet la mekarinan leh vela hi kevan deamar tzayetna karinan leh
Amar rav chisda kovim zeman sheni vachamishi vesheni zimna vezimna batar zimna ulmachar katvinan
Rav assi ikla be rav kahana chaza hahi itta deazmenah ledina befanya uvtzafra ketuv alah peticha amar leh la savar lah mar leha deamar rav chisda kovin zeman sheni vachamishi vesheni
Amar leh hane mile gavra daanis veleteh bemata aval itta kevan deitah bemata vela atya moredet hi

Amar rav yehuda la yahavina yahavinan zimna la beome nisan vela beome tishre la bemaale yoma tava vela bemaale shabbeta aval minnisan levatar yome nisan uvome tishre levatar tishre kavinan mimmaale shabbeta levatar maale shabbeta la kavinan may tama baavidteh deshabbeta terid
Amar rav nachman la yahavinan zimna la livne challa bechalla vela livne rigla berigla ki hao atu lekammeh derav nachman amar lehu vechi ledidchu kinnufayechu vehaidana deika rammae chayeshinan

Im haya devar sheyyesh bo achraut chayyav leshallem matne leh rabbi lerabbi shimon bereh lo davar sheyyesh bo achraut mammash ella afilu para vechoresh bah chamor umchammer acharav chayyavin lehachazir mippene kevod avihen
Bae mineh rav kahana merav mitta umesev aleha shulchan veochel alav mahu amar lo ten lechacham veyechkam od
Matni en portin lo mittevat hammochsin velo mikkis shel gabbain veen notlin mehem tzedaka aval notel hu mittoch beto o min hashshuk
Gema tana aval noten lo dinar venoten lo et hashshear
Umochsin vehaamar shemuel dina demalchuta dina
Amar rabbi chanina bar kahana amar shemuel bemoches sheen lo kitzva deve rabbi yannay amri bemoches haomed meelav

Ika dematne lah aha lo yilbash adam kilayim afilu al gabbe asara begadim lehavriach bo et hammeches matnitin dela kerabbi akiva detanya asur lehavriach et hammeches rabbi shimon omer mishshum rabbi akiva muttar lehavriach et hammeches
Bishlama leinyan kilayim beha kamipalgi demar savar davar sheen mitkaven muttar umar savar davar sheen mitkaven asur ella lehavriach bo et hammeches mi shere vehaamar shemuel dina demalchuta dina
Amar rabbi chanina bar kahana amar shemuel bemoches sheen lo kitzva deve rabbi yannay amri bemoches haomed meelav

Veika dematne aha nodrin leharagin velecharamin velammochsin shehi shel teruma shehi shel bet melech af al pi sheenah shel teruma af al pi sheenah shel melech velammochsin vehaamar shemuel dina demalchuta dina
Amar rabbi chanina bar kahana amar shemuel bemoches sheen lo kitzva deve rabbi yannay amri bemoches haomed meelav

Rav ashe amar bemoches goy detanya yisrael vegoy shebbau laddin im atta yachol lezakkoto bedine yisrael zakkehu veemor lo kach dinenu bedine goyim zakkehu veemor lo kach dinchem veim lav bain alav baakifin divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer en bain alav baakifin mippene kidush hashshem
Verabbi akiva tama deika kidush hashshem ha leka kidush hashshem bain
Vegezel goy mi shere vehatanya amar rabbi shimon devar ze darash rabbi akiva keshebba mizzefirin minnayin legezel goy shehu asur talmud lomar achare nimkar geulla tihye lo
b: Shello yimshechennu veyetze yachol yiglom alav talmud lomar vechishshav im konehu yedakdek im konehu
Amar rav yosef la kashya ha begoy ha beger toshav
Amar leh abbaye veha tarvayehu gabbe hadade ketivi lo lecha ella leger shenneemar leger velo leger tzedek ella leger toshav shenneemar leger toshav
Mishpachat ger ze haggoy keshehu omer o leeker ze hannimkar laavoda zara
Ella amar rava la kashya kan bigzelo vechan behafkaat haloato
Amar leh abbaye eved ivri hafkaat haloato hu rava letameh deamar rava eved ivri gufo kanuy

Amar rav bivi bar gidel amar rabbi shimon chasida gezel goy asur avedato mutteret gezelo asur deamar rav huna minnayin legezel haggoy shehu asur shenneemar veachalta et kol haammim asher Adonai elohecha noten lach bizman shehen mesurim beyadcha velo bizman sheenam mesurin beyadcha
Avedato mutteret deamar rav chama bar gurya amar rav minnayin laavedat haggoy shehi mutteret shenneemar lechol avedat achicha leachicha atta machzir vei atta machzir legoy

Veema hane mile hecha dela atay lideh dela michayyav leahdore batrah aval hecha deate lideh ema lahderah amar ravina umtzatah daatay lideh mashma tanya rabbi pinchas ben yair omer bemakom sheyyesh chilul hashshem afilu avedato asur
Amar shemuel tauto mutteret ki ha dishmuel zevan miggoy lakana dedahava bemar defarzela bearba zuze veavla leh chad zuza

Rav kahana zevan miggoy mea veesrin chavyata bima veavla leh chad zuza amar leh chazi daalach ka samechna ravina zevan dikla hu vegoy letzallacha amar leh leshammaeh kedem veayeti meikaro degoy minyana yada

Rav ashe hava kaazel beorcha chaza shivsha degufna befardesa utlu bah kitufe deinve amar leh leshammaeh zil chazi i degoy ninhu ayeti i deyisrael ninhu la ayeti li shema hahu goy dahava yatev befardesa amar leh degoy shere amar leh goy shakel deme yisrael la shakel deme
Gufa amar shemuel dina demalchuta dina amar rava tidda dekatli dikle vegashri gishre veavrinan alayehu
Amar leh abbaye vedilma mishshum deiyyaush lehu minayehu marayehu amar leh i la dina demalchuta dina hechi miyyaashi
Veha la ka avdi kidamar malka malka amar zilu uktulu mikkol bage veinhu azlu vekatlu mechad baga
Shelucha demalka kemalka vela tarach veinhu afsid annafshayehu deibi lehu deinkut leminkat mikkulleh bage umishkal deme
Amar rava man demishtechach beve dare para menata demalka vehane mile shuttafa aval arisa arisuteh hu deka mappek
Veamar rava bar mata abbar mata miavat vehane mile devorala ara uchraga dehay shatta aval shatta dachalef hoil veippayyas malka chalef
Veamar rava hane dedayeri dare betoch hattechum asur likach mehen may tama mishshum dimarva cheveta demata bahadayehu
Chutz lattechum muttar likach mehem amar ravina im hau bealim meraddefim acharehem afilu chutz lattechum asur

Machrez rava veitema rav huna desalkin leela udnachatin letatta hay bar yisrael deyada sahaduta degoy velo tevao mineh veazel umashed leh bedina degoyim al yisrael chavreh meshammetinan leh may tama deinhu mappeki mamona

a: Appumma dechad vela amaran ella chad aval bitre la vechad name la amaran ella bedine demagista aval be dauor inhu name chad ammomta shadu leh

Amar rav ashe ki havena be rav huna ibaya lan adam chashuv desamchi aleh keve tere mappeki mamona appummeh vela ibi leh leashode o dilma kevan deadam chashuv hu la matze mishtemit lehu umatze leashode teku

Amar rav ashe hay bar yisrael dezabben leh ara legoy ammitzra devar yisrael chavreh meshammetinan leh may tama i nema mishshum dina devar mitzra vehaamar mar zevan miggoy vezabben legoy leka mishshum dina devar mitzra
Ella deamrinan leh arbate li arya ammitzray meshammetinan leh ad dekabbel aleh kol unsa deate mechamateh

Matni natlu mochsin et chamoro venatnu lo chamor acher natlu listim et kesuto venatnu lo kesut acheret hare ellu shello mippene shehabbealim mityaashin mehen hammatztzil min hannahar o min haggayis o min hallistin im nityaashu habbealim hare ellu shello vechen nechil shel devorim im nityaashu hare ellu shello

Amar rabbi yochanan ben beroka neemenet ishsha o katan lomar mikkan yatza nechil ze umhallech betoch sede chavero lehatztzil et nechilo veim hizzik meshallem ma shehizzik aval lo yakotz et socho al menat liten et haddamim rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer af kotzetz venoten et haddamim
Gema tana im natal machzir livalim harishonim kasavar yeush kedi la kene umeikara beisura ata lideh
Veika deamri im ba lehachzir yachzir livalim rishonim may tama yeush kedi kane mihu i amar i efshi bemamon sheeno shelli machzir livalim harishonim
Hare ellu shello mippene shehabbealim ku amar rav ashe lo shanu ella listim goy aval listim yisrael la savar limchar naketna leh bedina
Matkef lah rav yosef adderabba ipcha mistabbera goyim dedayeni begete la miyyaash yisrael kevan deamri memar miyyaash
Ella i itmar assefa itmar hammatztzil min haggoyim umin hallistim im nityaashu habbealim in setama la
Lo shanu ella goy mishshum dedayeni begete aval listim yisrael kevan deamri memar miyyaash
Tenan hatam orot shel baal habbayit machshava metammeatan
Veshel abbedan en machshava metammeatan
Shel gazlan en machshava metammeatan veshel gannav machshava metammeatan
Rabbi shimon omer chiluf haddevarim shel gazlan machshava metammeatan shel gannav en machshava metammeatan lefi shello nityaashu habbealim
Amar ulla machaloket bistam aval beyadua divre hakkol yeush kane rabba amar beyadua name machaloket
Amar leh abbaye lerabba la tiflog aleh deulla ditnan bematnitin keoteh lefi shello nityaashu habbealim tama delo nityaashu habbealim aval nityaashu habbealim hare ellu shello
Amar leh anan lefi sheen yeush labbealim matninan lah
Tenan natlu mochsin chamoro ku manni
I rabbanan kashya gazlan i rabbi shimon kashya gannav
Bishlama leulla deamar beyadua kane hacha name beyadua vedivre hakkol
Ella lerabba deamar beyadua name machloket ha manni la rabbanan vela rabbi shimon belistim mezuyyan verabbi shimon hi
I hachi hayenu gazlan tere gavene gazlan
Ta shema haggannav vehaggazlan vehaannas hekdeshan hekdesh utrumatan teruma umaserotan maaser
Manni i rabbanan kashya gazlan i rabbi shimon kashya gannav
Bishlama leulla deamar beyadua kane hacha name beyadua vedivre hakkol hi ella lerabba deamar beyadua name machloket ha manni la rabbanan vela rabbi shimon
Hacha name belistim mezuyyan verabbi shimon hi i hachi hayenu gazlan tere gavene gazlan
Vei baet ema ha matnita rabbi hi detanya rabbi amar gannav kegazlan
b: Vekayema lan kegazlan lerabbi shimon
Gufa rabbi omer omer ani gannav kegazlan ibaya lehu kegazlan derabbanan kaamar vela kane o dilma kegazlan derabbi shimon kaamar ukne
Ta shema natlu mochsin chamoro vechu
Manni i rabbanan kashya gazlan i rabbi shimon kashya gannav
I amratte bishlama rabbi kegazlan derabbi shimon kaamar vekane ha manni rabbi hi mishshum hachi kane
Ella i amratte kegazlan derabbanan kaamar vela kane ha manni la rabbi vela rabbi shimon vela rabbanan
Hacha bemay askinan belistim mezuyyan verabbi shimon hi i hachi hayenu gazlan tere gavene gazlan
Ta shema haggannav vehaggazlan vehaannas hekdeshan hekdesh utrumatan teruma umaserotan maaser
Manni i rabbanan kashya gazlan i rabbi shimon kashya gannav
I amratte bishlama gannav kegazlan derabbi shimon kaamar mishshum hachi kane ella i amratte gannav kegazlan derabbanan ha manni
Belistim mezuyyan verabbi shimon hi i hachi hayenu gazlan tere gavene gazlan

Amar leh rav ashe lerabba ta shema dematne rabbi lerabbi shimon bereh lo davar sheyyesh bo achraut mammash ella afilu para vechoresh bah chamor umchammer acharav chayyavin lehachzir mippene kevod avihen
Tama mippene kevod avihen ha lav kevod avihen la shema minah rabbi gazlan derabbi shimon kaamar shema minah
Vechen nechil shel devorim may vechen
Hachi kaamar afilu nechil shel devorim dekinyan derabbanan hu salka datach amena hay kevan derabbanan bealma hu dekane leh afilu setama name miyyaash ka mashma lan im nityaashu habbealim en i la la
Amar rabbi yochanan ben beroka neemenet ishsha vekatan ku
Ishsha vekatan bene edut ninhu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hacha bemay askinan kegon shehau bealim meraddefin acharehem veishsha vekatan massichin lefi tummam veomer mikkan yatza nechil ze
Amar rav ashe en mesiach lefi tummo kasher ella leedut ishsha bilvad
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe vela vahare nechil shel devorim mesiach lefi tummo hu shane nechil shel devorim dekinyan derabbanan hu

Udorayeta la vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel maase beadam echad shehaya mesiach lefi tummo veomer zechurani kesheani tinok umurkavani al ketefo shel abba vehotziuni mibbet hassefer vehifshituni et kuttonti vehitbiluni leechol bitruma laerev
Verabbi chanina mesayyem bah hachi vachaveray bedelin mimmenni vehau korin oti yochanan ochel challot veheelahu rabbi lakkehunna al piv
Bitruma derabbanan

Veakkatti deorayeta la veha ki ata rav dimi amar rav chana kartigana veamri lah rav acha kartigana mishtae maase ba lifne rabbi yehoshua ben levi veamri lah maase ba lifne rabbi betinok echad shehaya mesiach lefi tummo veamar ani veimmi nishbinu leven haggoyim yatzati lishov mayim dati al immi lilkot etzim dati al immi
Vehissiah rabbi al piv lakkehunna
Bishvuya hekelu

Aval lo yakotz et socho vechu tanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer tenay bet din hu sheyehe yored letoch sade shel chavero vekotzetz socho shel chavero lehatztzil et nechilo venotel deme socho mittoch nechilo shel chavero

Utnay bet din hu sheyehe shofech yeno umatztzil et duvshano shel chavero venotel deme yeno mittoch duvshano shel chavero utnay bet din hu sheyehe mefarek et etzav vetoen pishtano shel chavero venotel deme etzav mittoch pishtano shel chavero sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz
Matni hammakkir kelav usfarav beyad acher veyatza lo shem geneva bair yishshava lo lokeach kamma natan veyittol veim lav lav kol hemennu sheani omer mecharan leacher ulkachan ze hemennu
Gema vechi yatza lo shem geneva bair may have lechush dilma zabbeninhu vehu nihu ka mappek shema
Amar rav yehuda amar rav kegon shebbau bene adam betoch beto veamad vehifgin ballayela veamar nignevu chelayi kol shekken ila matza

Rav kahana mesayyem bah mishshemeh derav kegon shehayeta machteret chatura betoch beto uvne adam shellanu betoch beto yatzu veanburkeraot shel kelim al kitfehem vehakkol omrim nignevu kelav shel peloni
Vedilma kelim hao sefarim la hao amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan kegon dekaamri name sefarim
Velechush dilma zutre veka taen ravreve amar rabbi yose bar chanina dekaamri sefer peloni ufloni
Vedilma hao attike veka taen chadte amar rav kegon deamri hallalu kelav shel peloni hallalu sefarav shel peloni
Umi amar rav hachi vehaamar rav ba bammachteret venatal kelim veyatza patur may tama bidme kenanhu
Hane mile diknanhu beva bammachteret demeikara mesar nafsheh liktala aval hane kevan dela mesaru nafshayehu liktala la
Amar rava lo shanu ella baal habbayit heasuy limkor kelav aval baal habbayit sheeno asuy limkor kelav

a: La tzarich leahdore aleh kulle hay
Vedilma itzterich leh zuze vezabben amar rav ashe hare yatza lo shem geneva bair
Itmar ganav umachar veachar kach hukkar haggannav rav mishshemeh derabbi chiyya amar haddin im harishon rabbi yochanan mishshemeh derabbi yannay amar haddin im hashsheni
