Amar rav yosef la peligi kan lifne yeush haddin im hashsheni kan leachar yeush haddin im harishon
Vetarvayehu it lehu derav chisda

Amar leh abbaye vela peligi ha mattenot kehunna kelifne yeush dame ufligi ditnan amar lo mechor li meeha shel para vehau bahen mattanot notnan lechohen veeno menakke lo min haddamim lakach hemennu bemishkal notno lechohen umnakke lo min haddamim
Veamar rav lo shanu ella sheshshakal leatzmo aval shakal lo hattabbach haddin im hattabbach
Ema af din im hattabbach mahu detema en mattenot kehunna nigzalot ka mashma lan
Ulabbaye deamar peligi bemay peligi bidrav chisda
Rav zevid amar kegon shennityaashu habbealim beyad lokeach velo nityaashu beyad gannav
Uvha peligi mar savar yeush veachar kach shinuy reshut kane shinuy reshut veachar kach yeush la kane umar savar la shena
Rav pappa amar biglima dechulle alma la peligi dehadar lemareh vehacha beasu bo takkanat hashshuk kamipalgi

Rav mishshemeh derabbi chiyya amar haddin im harishon dina delokeach delishkol zuze miggannav velo asu bo takkanat hashshuk verabbi yochanan mishshum derabbi yannay amar haddin im hashsheni dina delokeach delishkol mibbaal habbayit veasu bo takkanat hashshuk
Vesavar rav lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk veha rav huna talmideh derav hava vechanan bisha genav gelima vezabbenah ata lekammeh derav huna amar leh lehahu gavra zil sheri avitach
Shane chanan bisha kevan deleka leishtallome mineh kelo hukkar dame
Amar rava im gannav mefursam hu lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk veha chanan bisha dimfursam hava veasu bo takkanat hashshuk nehi dimfursam levishuta lignivuta la mefursam
Itmar ganav ufara bechovo ganav ufara behekefo lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk deamri la addata dehanhu yehavte leh mide
Mashkanta shave matan bima asu bo takkanat hashshuk shave beshave ammemar amar lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk mar zutra amar asu bo takkanat hashshuk
Vehilcheta asu bo takkanat hashshuk
Zevina shave beshave asu bo takkanat hashshuk shave mea bematan rav sheshet amar lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk rava amar asu bo takkanat hashshuk
Vehilcheta bechullehu asu bo takkanat hashshuk levar migganav ufara bechovo ganav ufara behekefo
Avimi bar nazi chamuh deravina hava massek behahu gavra arbea zuze genav gelima etya nihaleh ozfeh arbea zuze acharine lesof hukkar haggannav ata lekammeh deravina
Amar kammae ganav ufara bechovo vela bae lemitav leh vela mide hanach arbea zuze acharine shekol zuzach veahdar gelimeh

Matkef lah rav kohen vedilma gelima behane zuze kammae yahavah nihaleh ganav ufara bechovo ganav ufara behekefo vearbea zuze batrae hemone hemneh ki hechi dehemneh meikara igalgal milta meta lekammeh derabbi avahu amar hilcheta kerav kohen

Narshaa genav sifra zabbeneh lefappunaa bitmanan zuze azal pappunaa zabbeneh levar machozaa bima veesrin zuze lesof hukkar haggannav amar abbaye lezil mare desifra veyahev leh levar machoza temanan zuze veshakel sifreh veazel bar machozaa veshakel arbein mippappunaa
Matkef lah rava hashta lokeach miggannav asu bo takkanat hashshuk lokeach millokeach mibaya
Ella amar rava lezil mareh desifra veyahev leh levar machozaa mea veesrin zuze veshakel sifreh velezil mareh desifra velishkol arbein mippappunaa utmanan minnarshaa
Matni ze ba bechavito shel yayin veze ba bechaddo shel devash nisdeka chavit shel devash veshafach ze et yeno vehitztzil et haddevash letocho
b: En lo ella secharo veim amar atztzil et shellecha veatta noten li deme shelli chayyav liten lo

Shataf nachal chamoro vachamor chavero shello yafe mane veshel chavero matayim vehinniach ze et shello vehitztzil et shel chavero en lo ella secharo veim amar lo ani atztzil et shellecha veatta noten li et shelli chayyav liten lo

Gema veammay lema leh mehefkera ka zachena mi la tanya hare shehaya taun kadde yayin vechadde shemen veraa shehen mishtabberot lo yomar hare ze teruma umaaser al perot sheyyesh li betoch beti veim amar lo amar kelum
Kidamar rabbi yirmeya kesheekel bet habbad karuch aleha hachi name kesheekel bet habbad karuch aleha
Veim amar lo amar kelum vehatanya mi shebba badderech umaot beyado veannas kenegdo lo yomar hare perot sheyyesh li betoch beti mechullalim al maot hallalu veim amar devarav kayyamin
Hacha bemay askinan besheyyachol lehatztzil i besheyyachol lehatztzil lechattechilla ammay lo yomar besheyyachol lehatztzil al yede haddechak

Vechol hecha deika hefseda lechattechilla lo yomar vehatanya hare shehau lo eser chaviyyot shel tevel tame veraa achat mehen shennishbera o shennitgalleta omer hare hi terumat maaser al tesha chavroteha uvshemen lo yaase ken mippene hefsed kohen
Amar rabbi yirmeya kesheekel bet habbad karuch aleha bishlama shennishbera chazya ella nitgalleta lemay chazya

Vechi tema chazya leziluf vehatanya mayim shennitgallu hare ze lo yishpechem birshut harabbim velo yegabbel bahen et hattit velo yerabbetz bahen et habbayit velo yashke mehem et behemto velo behemat chavero

Deabbar lah bimsannenet kerabbi nechemya detanya mesannenet yesh bah mishshum giluy amar rabbi nechemya ematay bizman shehattachtona megulla aval bizman shehattachtona mechussa af al pi shehaelona megulla en bah mishshum giluy lefi sheeres shel nachash dome lisfog vetzaf veomed bimkomo
Lav itmar alah amar rabbi simon amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi lo shanu ella shello terako aval terako asur
Hatam name efshar demannach mide appumma dechavita deshafe veshafe leh
Verabbi nechemya mittame attame mi tarminan

Vehatanya tormin min hattame al hattame umin hattahor al hattahor umin hattahor al hattame aval lo min hattame al hattahor rabbi nechemya omer af min hattame al hattame lo hittiru litrom ella beshel demay hacha name beshel demay

Amar mar uvshemen lo yaase ken mippene hefsed kohen may shena shemen derauy lehadlik yayin name rauy leziluf vechi tema ziluf lav milta hi vehaamar shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyya shotin millog besela umzallefin millog bishtayim
Hacha bemay askinan bechadash veha rauy leyashsheno ate beh lide takkala
Shemen name ate beh lide takkala demannach leh bichli maus yayin name mannach leh bichli maus hashta leziluf ka bae leh bichli maus ka mannach leh
Vetakkala atzmah tannae hi detanya chavit shel yayin shel teruma shennitmet bet shammay omrim

a: Tishshafech hakkol uvet hillel omrim tease ziluf amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose ani achria babbayit tease ziluf uvassade tishshafech hakkol
Ika deamri beyashan tease ziluf uvchadash tishshafech hakkol amru lo en hachraa shelishit machraat
Im amar lo atztzil et shellecha vechu ammay venema leh meshatte ani bach
Mi la tanya hare shehaya boreach mibbet haasurin vehayeta maboret lefanav amar lo tol dinar vehaavireni en lo ella secharo alma amar leh meshatte ani bach hacha name lema leh meshatte ani bach
Ha la dame ella lesefa veim amar lo tol dinar ze bischarcha vehaavireni noten lo secharo mishshalem
May shena resha umay shena sefa amar rame bar chama betzayyad hashshole dagim min hayyam veamar leh afsedtani keore bezuza

Shataf nahar chamoro vachamor chavero shello yafe mane vechu utzricha dei ashmeinan kammayeta hatam hu dechi peresh yahev leh deme kulleh mishshum divyadayim ka fased aval hacha demimmela nema en lo ella secharo
Vei ashmeinan sefa hacha hu devistama en lo ella secharo mishshum demimmela aval hatam divyadayim ema afilu bistama yahev leh deme kulleh tzericha
Bea mineh rav kahana merav yarad lehatztzil veala shello meelav mahu amar leh mishshemayya rechimu aleh

Ki ha derav safra hava ka azel bishyarta lavinhu hahu ari kol lelya ka shaddar shadu leh chamara dechad minayehu veka achel ki meta zimneh derav safra shaddar sheda leh chamare vela achleh kedem rav safra uzcha beh
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina lema leh lemizke beh nehi dechi afkereh addata dearya afkereh addata dechulle alma la afkereh amar leh rav safra leravecha demilta hu daavad
Bea mineh rav merabbi yarad lehatztzil velo hitztzil mahu amar lo vezo sheela en lo ella secharo
Etiveh hassocher et happoel
b: Lehavi keruv vedurmaskanin lachole vehalach umtzao shemmet o shehivri noten lo secharo mishshalem
Amar leh mi dame hatam aved shaliach shelichuteh hacha la aved shaliach shelichuteh
Tanu rabbanan sheyara shehayeta mehallechet bammidbar veamad aleha gayis letorfah mechashshevin lefi mamon veen mechashshevin lefi nefashot
Veim sachru tayyar haholech lifnehem mechashshevin af lefi nefashot velo yeshannu mimminhag hachammarin
Rashshain hachammarin lehatnot shekkol mi sheyyovad lo chamoro naamid lo chamor acher bechusya en maamidin shello bechusya maamidin lo veim amar tenu li vaani eshmor en shomin lo
Peshita la tzericha deit leh chamara acharina mahu detema ha ka menattar leh ka mashma lan shane netiruta dechad minnetiruta deve tere
Tanu rabbanan sefina shehayeta mehallechet bayyam amad aleha nachshol letovah vehekelu mimmassaah mechashshevin lefi massooy veen mechashshevin lefi mamon velo yeshannu mimminhag hassappanim
Verashshain hassappanim lehatnot shekkol mi sheavda lo sefina naamid lo sefina acheret avda lo bechusya en maamidin shello bechusya maamidin lo vei perash lemakom sheen hassefinot holchin en maamidin
Peshita la tzericha divnisan merachaki chad ashla uvtishri merachaki tere ashle veka azel beome nisan limkom tishre mahu detema davesheh naket veazel ka mashma lan
Tanu rabbanan sheyara shehayeta mehallechet bammidbar veamad gayis utrafah veamad echad mehen vehitztzil hitztzil laemtza veim amar ani atztzil leatzmi hitztzil leatzmo
Hechi dame i deyachol lehatztzil afilu sefa name laemtza vei delo yachol lehatztzil afilu resha name leatzmo
Amar rame bar chama hacha beshuttafin askinan uchgon ze shuttaf cholek shello ledaat chavero amar paleg la amar la paleg
Rava amar hacha befoalin askinan uchrav deamar rav poel yachol lachazor bo afilu bachatzi hayyom
Vechamma dela hadar beh kevirshuteh devaal habbayit dame vechi hadar beh tama acharina hu dichtiv ki li vene yisrael avadim velo avadim laavadim
Rav ashe amar kesheyyachol lehatztzil al yede haddechak galli dateh leatzmo la galli dateh laemtza
Matni haggozel sade mechavero untaluha massikin im makkat medina hi omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha im mechamat haggazlan chayyav lehaamid lo sade acher
Gema amar rav nachman bar yitzchak man detane massikin la mishtabbash uman detane matztzikin la mishtabbash man detane matztzikin la mishtabbash dichtiv bematzor uvmatzok
Uman detane massikin la mishtabbash dichtiv yeyaresh hatztzelatzal umtargeminan yachsenineh sakkaa
Im mechamat haggazlan chayyav hechi dame ilema deansuha leara dideh vela anasu kulle arata ha meresha shamatte minah im makkat medina hi ku i la la
La tzericha deachvay achoye lishana acharina hacha bemay askinan kegon deansuh goyim veamri veachvi leh achoye arateh veachvi hahi bahadayehu

Hahu gavra deachvi akkarya dechitte deve resh galuta ata lekammeh derav nachman chayeveh rav nachman leshallome yatev rav yosef achoreh derav huna bar chiyya veyatev rav huna bar chiyya kammeh derav nachman amar leh rav huna bar chiyya lerav nachman dina o kenasa
Amar leh matnitin hi ditnan im mechamat haggazlan chayyav lehaamid lo sade veokimna deachvi achoye batar dinfak amar leh rav yosef lerav huna bar chiyya may nafka lach mineh

a: I dina i kenasa amar leh i dina gamrinan mineh i kenasa la gamrinan mineh
Umna temra demikkenasa la gamrinan detanya barishona hau omrim hamtamme vehamnassech chazru lomar af hamdammea
Chazru in lo chazru la may tama lav mishshum diknasa hu uknasa la gamrinan mineh
La meikara savri lehefsed merubbe chashshu lehefsed muat lo chashshu ulvassof savri lehefsed muat name chashshu
Ini veha tane avuh derabbi avin barishona hau omrim hamtamme vehamdammea chazru lomar af hamnassech chazru in lo chazru la
May tama lav mishshum dela gamrinan mikkenasa
La meikara savri kerabbi avin ulvassof savri kerabbi yirmeya
Meikara savri kerabbi avin deamar rabbi avin zarak chetz mittechilat arba lesof arba vekara shirain bahalichato patur shehare akira tzorech hannacha hi umitchayyev benafsho
Ulvassof savri kerabbi yirmeya deamar rabbi yirmeya mishsheat hagbaha kanyeh ichayyav leh mamon mitchayyev benafsho la have ad sheat nisuch
Rav huna bar yehuda ikla leve evone ata lekammeh derava amar leh kelum maase ba lidach amar leh yisrael sheanasuhu goyim vehera mamon chavero ba leyadi vechiyyavtiv
Amar leh ahdar ovada lemareh detanya yisrael sheanasuhu goyim vehera mamon chavero patur veim natal venatan bayyad chayyav
Amar rabba im hera meatzmo kenasa venatan bayyad dame
Hahu gavra daanasuhu goyim veachvi achamra derav mari bereh derav pinchas bereh derav chisda amaru leh deri veamti bahadan dera veamti bahadayehu ata lekammeh derav ashe patrineh
Amaru leh rabbanan lerav ashe vehatanya im nasa venatan bayyad chayyav amar lehu hane mile hecha dela okmeh ilaveh meikara aval hecha deokmeh ilaveh meikara mikle kalyeh
Etiveh rabbi avahu lerav ashe amar lo annas hoshet li pekia amir ze o eshkol anavim ze vehoshit lo chayyav hacha bemay askinan kegon dekae bitre evre nahara
Dayeka name dekatane hoshet vela tane ten shema minah

Hahu shuta dahao minnetzu alah be tere hay amar didi hu vehay amar didi hu azal chad minnayehu umasrah lefarhagbana demalka amar abbaye yachol lomar ana ki mesari didi mesari amar leh rava vechol kemineh ella amar rava meshammetinan leh ad demayete leh vekae bedina
Hahu gavra dahava bae achoye attivna dechavreh ata lekammeh derav amar leh la tachve vela tachve amar leh machvena umachvena yatev rav kahana kammeh derav shamteh lekoeh mineh
Kare rav ilaveh banayich ullefu shachvu berosh kol chutzot keto michmar ma to ze kevan shennafal bemichmar en merachamin alav af mamon shel yisrael kevan shennafal beyad goyim en merachamin alav

Amar leh rav kahana ad haidana hao parsae dela kafdi ashshefichut damim vehashta ika yavenae dekafdu ashshefichut damim veamri mardin mardin kum sak leara deyisrael vekabbel alach dela takshe lerabbi yochanan sheva shenin

Azal ashkecheh leresh lakish deyatev veka mesayyem metivta deoma lerabbanan amar lehu resh lakish hecha amaru leh ammay amar lehu hay kushya vehay kushya vehay peruka vehay peruka amaru leh leresh lakish azal resh lakish amar leh lerabbi yochanan ari ala mibbavel leayyen mar bimtivta delimchar

Limchar otvuh bedara kamma kammeh derabbi yochanan amar shemateta vela akshi shemateta vela akshi anchateh achore sheva dare ad deotveh bedara batra amar leh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish ari sheamarta naasa shual
Amar yehe raava dehane sheva dare liho chiluf sheva shenin daamar li rav kam akkareh amar leh nehdar mar beresha amar shemateta veakshi okmeh bedara kamma amar shemateta veakshi

Rabbi yochanan hava yatev ashsheva bistarke shalfi leh chada bistarka mittuteh amar shemateta veakshi leh ad deshalfi leh kullehu bistarke mittuteh ad deyatev al ara rabbi yochanan gavra sava hava umsarchi gevineh amar lehu dallo li enay veechzeyeh dallo leh bemachchalta dechaspa

Chaza difrita sifoteh sevar achoche kamchayyech beh chalash dateh venach nafsheh limchar amar lehu rabbi yochanan lerabbanan chazetu levavlaa hechi aved amaru leh darkeh hachi al legabbe mearta chaza dahava
b: Hadra leh achna amar leh achna achna petach pummach veyikkanes harav etzel talmid vela petach yikkanes chaver etzel chaver vela petach yikkanes talmid etzel harav petach leh bea rachame veokmeh
Amar leh i hava yadana dedarkeh demar hachi la chalsha dati hashta lete mar bahadan amar leh i matzet lemive rachame detu la shachevna azelna vei la la azelna hoil vachalef shata chalef
Tayereh okmeh shayeleh kol sefeka dahava leh ufashtinhu nihaleh hayenu deamar rabbi yochanan dilchon amari dilhon hi
Hahu deachvi ammetachsa derabbi abba yetev rabbi avahu verabbi chanina bar pappi verabbi yitzchak nappacha veyatev rabbi ila gabbayehu
Sevur lechayyoveh meha ditnan dan et haddin zika et hachayyav vechiyyev et hazzakkay time et hattahor vetiher et hattame ma sheasa asuy vishallem mibbeto
Amar lehu rabbi ila hachi amar rav vehu shennasa venatan bayyad amri leh zil legabbe derabbi shimon ben elyakim verabbi elazar ben pedat dedayeni dina digrame
Azal legabbayehu chayeveh mimmatnitin im mechamat haggazlan chayyav lehaamid lo sade acher veokimna deachvi achoye

Hahu gavra dahava mippekid leh kasa dechaspa seliku gannave ilaveh shaklah yahavah lehu ata lekammeh derabba patreh amar leh abbaye hay matztzil atzmo bemamon chavero hu ella amar rav ashe chazenan i inish amid hu addata dideh ato vei la addata dechaspa ato

Hahu gavra dahava mippekid gabbeh arneka defidon shevuyim seliku gannave ilaveh shaklah yahavah nihalayehu ata lekammeh derava patreh amar leh abbaye veha matztzil atzmo bemamon chavero hu amar leh en lecha pidon shevuyim gadol mizze

Hahu gavra deakdem veassek chamara lemabbara kamme disliku inashe bemabbara bae leatboe ata hahu gavra melach leh lachamara dehahu gavra veshadyeh lenahara utva ata lekammeh derabba patreh amar leh abbaye veha matztzil atzmo bemamon chavero hu amar leh hay meikara rodef hava
Rabba letameh deamar rabba rodef shehaya rodef achar chavero lehorgo veshiber et hakkelim ben shel nirdof ben shel kol adam patur shehare mitchayyev benafsho
Venirdof sheshshiber et hakkelim shel rodef patur shello yehe mamono chaviv alav miggufo aval shel kol adam chayyav deasur lehatztzil atzmo bemamon chavero
Verodef shehaya rodef achar rodef lehatztzil veshibber kelim ben shel nirdof ben shel kol adam patur velo min haddin ella sheim i atta omer ken en lecha adam shemmatztzil et chavero min harodef
Matni shetafah nahar omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha
Gema tanu rabbanan haggozel sade mechavero ushtafah nahar chayyav lehaamid lo sade acher divre rabbi elazar vachachamim omrim omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha
Bemay ka mipalgi rabbi elazar daresh ribuye umiute vechichesh baamito ribuy riba befikkadon miet kol asher yishshava alav lashsheker chazar veriba
Riba umiet veriba riba hakkol umay rabbi rabbi kol mile
Umay miet miet shetarot
Verabbanan darshi kelale ufrate vechichesh kalal befikkadon parat o mikkol chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella cheen happerat

Ma happerat davar hammitaltel vegufo mamon af kol davar hammitaltel vegufo mamon yatzu karkaot sheen mittaltelin yatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot yatzu shetarot sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin en gufan mamon
Vehadtanya haggozel et happara ushtafah nahar chayyav lehaamid lo para divre rabbi elazar vachachamim omrim omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha hatam bemay kamipalgi
Amar rav pappa hatam bemay askinan kegon sheggazal sade mechavero vehayeta

a: Para revutza bo ushtafah nahar derabbi elazar letameh verabbanan letamayehu
Matni haggozel et chavero o shehilva hemennu o shehifkid lo bayyishshuv lo yachazir lo bammidbar al menat latzet bammidbar yachazir lo bammidbar
Gema urminhu milva mishtallemet bechol makom aveda ufikkadon en mishtallemin ella bimkoman amar abbaye hachi kaamar milva nitna litava bechol makom aveda ufikkadon lo nitnu litava ella bimkoman
Al menat latzet bammidbar peshita la tzericha daamar leh leheve hay pikkadon gabbach daana lemidbar nafekna vaamar leh ihu ana lemidbar name baena lemipak i baena leahdorinhu lach hatam mahdarna lach

Matni haomer lachavero gezalticha hilvitani hifkadta etzli veeni yodea im hechzarti lach im lo hechzarti lach chayyav leshallem aval im amar lo eni yodea im gezalticha im hilvitani im hifkadta etzli patur milleshallem
Gema itmar mane li beyadcha vehalla omer eni yodea rav huna verav yehuda amri chayyav verav nachman verabbi yochanan amri patur
Rav huna verav yehuda amri chayyav bari veshemma bari adif rav nachman verabbi yochanan amri patur oki mamona bechezkat mareh
Tenan aval im amar lo eni yodea im hilvitani patur hechi dame ilema dela ka tava leh resha name dela ka tava leh ammay chayyav ella dekatava leh vekatane sefa patur milleshallem
La leolam dela ka tava leh veresha beva latzet yede shamayim
Itmar name amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan haomer lachavero mane li beyadcha vehalla omer eni yodea chayyav beva latzet yede shamayim
Matni haggonev tale min haeder vehechziro umet o nignav chayyav beachrauto lo yadu bealim lo bignevato velo bachazirato umanu et hatztzon ushlema hi patur
Gema amar rav ledaat tzarich daat shello ledaat minyan poter vechi katane umanu et hatztzon vehi shelema assefa
Ushmuel amar ben ledaat ben shello ledaat minyan poter vechi katane umanu vehi shelema patur akkullah
Verabbi yochanan omer ledaat minyan poter shello ledaat afilu minyan name la tzerich vechi katane umanu et hatztzon vehi shelema aresha
Rav chisda amar ledaat minyan poter shello ledaat tzarich daat vechi katane umanu et hatztzon vehi shelema aresha
Amar rava
b: May tama derav chisda hoil veanketah nigre barayata
Umi amar rava hachi vehaamar rava hay man dechazyeh lechavreh deagbah imra meedra dideh urma beh kala veshadyeh vela yeda i hadara i la hadara umet o nignav chayyav beachrauto
May lav af al gav dimni la dela meni
Umi amar rav hachi vehaamar rav hechziro leeder shebbammidbar yatza amar rav chanan bar abba mode rav birkoata
Lema ketannae haggonev tale min haeder vesela min hakkis limkom shegganav yachazir divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer tzarich daat bealim
Savruha dechulle alma it lehu derabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak adam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa may lav besela ledaat uviflugta derav ushmuel
La betale shello ledaat uviflugta derav chisda verabbi yochanan

Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava beshomer shegganav mershut bealim kulle alma la peligi kidrav chisda vehacha beshomer shegganav mershuto sheyyachazir limkom shegganav kamipalgi rabbi akiva savar kalta lo shemirato verabbi yishmael savar lo kalta lo shemirato
Lema minyan poter tannae hi detanya haggozel et chavero vehivlia lo becheshbon tane chada yatza vetanya idach lo yatza

Savruha dechulle alma it lehu derabbi yitzchak deamar adam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa veshaa may lav beha kamipalgi deman deamar yatza savar minyan poter uman deamar lo yatza savar minyan eno poter
Amri i sevira lan kerabbi yitzchak kulle alma la peligi deminyan poter ella bidrabbi yitzchak kamipalgi mar it leh derabbi yitzchak umar let leh derabbi yitzchak
Vei baet ema dechulle alma it lehu derabbi yitzchak vela kashya ha dimni urma leh bechiseh veha dimni urma lideh
Veibaet ema ide veide dimni urma bechiseh ha deit leh zuze acharine bechiseh ha delet leh zuze acharine bechiseh
Matni en lokchin min haroim tzemer vechalav ugdayim velo mishshomre ferot etzim uferot
Aval lokchin min hannashim kele tzemer bihuda uchle fishtan baggalil vaagalim bashsharon vechullan sheamru lehatmin asur velokchin betzim vetarnegolin mikkol makom

Gema tanu rabbanan en lokchin min haroim lo izzim velo gedayim velo gizin velo telushin shel tzemer aval lokchin mehen tefurin mippene shehen shellahen velokchin mehen chalav ugvina bammidbar velo bayyishshuv
Velokchin mehen arba vechamesh tzon arba vechamesh gizin aval lo shette tzon velo shette gizin
Rabbi yehuda omer bayyatot lokchin mehen midbariyyot en lokchin mehen kelalo shel davar kol sheharoe mocher uvaal habbayit margish bo lokchin mehen en margish bo en lokchin mehen

Amar mar lokchin mehen arba vechamesh tzon arba vechamesh gizin hashta yesh lomar arba zavninan chamesh mibaya amar rav chisda arba mittoch chamesh veika deamri amar rav chisda arba meeder katan vechamesh meeder gadol
Ha gufa kashya amratte arba vechamesh tzon arba vechamesh gizin arba vechamesh in aval shalosh la ema sefa aval lo shette tzon ha shalosh zavninan
La kashya ha bevaryata ha bichchishata
Rabbi yehuda omer bayyatot lokchin mehen midbariyyot en lokchin mehen ku ibaya lehu rabbi yehuda aresha kae ulchumra o dilma assefa kae ulkulla

Aresha kae ulchumra deamar lokchin mehen arba vechamesh tzon hane mile bayyatot aval midbariyyot afilu arba vechamesh lo o dilma assefa kae ulkulla deamar aval lo shette tzon velo shette gizin hane mile midbariyyot aval bayyatot shettayim name lokchin
Ta shema detanya rabbi yehuda omer lokchin bayyatot mehen veen lokchin mehen midbariyyot uvchol makom lokchin mehen arba vechamesh tzon

a: Middeamar bechol makom shema minah assefa kae ulkulla shema minah

Velo mishshomre ferot ku rava zaven shevishata mearisa amar leh abbaye veha tenan velo mishshomre ferot etzim uferot amar leh hane mile beshomer delet leh begufa deara mide aval aris deit leh begaveyh ema middenafsheh ka mezabben
Tanu rabbanan shomre ferot lokchin mehen keshehen yoshvin umochrin vehassallin lifnehem veturtane lifnehem vechullan sheamru hatmen asur lokchin mehen mippetach haggina aval lo meachore haggina
Itmar gazlan meemat muttar liknot hemennu rav amar ad shettehe rov mishshello ushmuel amar afilu miut shello
Ori leh rav yehuda leadda dayyala kedivre haomer afilu miut shello
Mamon masor rav huna verav yehuda chad amar muttar leabbedo bayyad vechad amar asur leabbedo bayyad
Man deamar muttar leabbedo bayyad lo yehe mamono chamur miggufo uman deamar asur leabbedo dilma have leh zara mealleya uchtiv yachin rasha vetzaddik yilbash
Rav chisda hava leh hahu arisa dahava takel veyahev takel veshakel sallekeh kera annafsheh vetzafun latztzaddik chel chote
Ki ma tikvat chanef ki yivtza ki yeshel eloha nafsho rav huna verav chisda chad amar nafsho denigzal vechad amar nafsho shel gazlan

Man deamar nafsho shel nigzal dichtiv ken orchot kol botzea batza et nefesh bealav yikkach man deamar nafsho shel gazlan dichtiv al tigzol dal ki dal hu veal tedakke ani vashshaar ki Adonai yariv rivam vekava et kovehem nafesh
Veidach name hachtiv nefesh bealav yikkach may bealav bealav dehashta
Veidach name hachtiv vekava et kovehem nafesh ma taam kaamar ma taam vekava et kovehem mishshum dekavi nefesh

Amar rabbi yochanan kol haggozel et chavero shave peruta keilu notel nishmato mimmennu shenneemar ken orchot kol botzea batza et nefesh bealav yikkach veomer veachal ketzircha velachmecha banecha uvnotecha
Veomer mechamas bene yehuda asher shafchu dam naki beartzam veomer el shaul veel bet haddamim al asher hemit et haggivonim
May veomer vechi tema nefesh dideh aval nefesh banav uvnotav la ta shema besar banav uvnotav
Vechi tema hane mile hecha dela yahev deme aval hecha deyahev deme la ta shema mechamas bene yehuda asher shafchu dam naki beartzechem beartzam

Vechi tema hane mile hecha dekaaved beyadayim aval gerama la ta shema el shaul veel bet haddamim al asher hemit et haggivonim vechi hechan matzinu sheharag shaul et haggivonim ella mittoch sheharag nov ir hakkohanim shehau maspikin lahen mayim umazon maale alav hakkatuv keilu haragan

Aval lokchin min hannashim tanu rabbanan lokchin min hannashim kele tzemer bihuda uchle fishtan baggalil aval lo yenot ushmanim uslatot velo min haavadim velo min hattinokot abba shaul omer mocheret ishsha bearbaa vachamishsha dinarin kede laasot kippa leroshah vechullan sheamru lehatmin asur
Gabbae tzedaka lokchin mehen davar muat aval lo davar merubbe

Vehabbaddadin lokchin mehen zetim bemida veshemen bemida aval lo zetim bemuat veshemen bemuat rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lokchin minnashim zetim bemuat baggalil haelon sheppeamim adam bosh limkor al petach beto venoten leishto umocheret

Ravina ikla leve machoza ato neshe deve machoza remo kammeh kavle veshere kabbel minayehu amar leh rabba tosfaa leravina vehatanya gabbae tzedaka mekabbelin mehen davar muat aval lo davar merubbe amar leh hane livne machoza davar muat ninhu

Matni mochin shehakkoves motzi hare ellu shello vehassorek motzi hare ellu shel baal habbayit koves notel shelosha chutin vehen shello yater mikken hare ellu shel baal habbayit im haya shachor al gabbe hallavan notel et hakkol vehen shello

Hachayyat sheshshiyyer et hachut kede litpor bo umatlet shehi shalosh al shalosh hare ellu shel baal habbayit ma shehecharash motzi bemaatzad hare ellu shello uvchashshil shel baal habbayit veim haya ose etzel baal habbayit af hannesarim shel baal habbayit
Gema tanu rabbanan lokchin mochin min hakkoves mippene shehen shello hakkoves notel shene chutin haelonim vehen shello
b: Velo yatil bo yoter mishshelosha chubbin velo yisrok habbeged leshito ella leerbo umashvehu leorko aval lo lerochbo veim ba lehashoto ad tefach rashshay
Amar mar shene chutin vehaanan tenan shalosh la kashya ha beallime veha bekattine
Velo yisrok habbeged leshito ella leerbo vehatanya ipcha la kashya ha biglima ha besarbala
Velo yatil bo yoter mishshelosha chubbin bae rabbi yirmeya amtoye veetoye chad o dilma amtoye veetoye tere teku
Umashvehu leorko aval lo lerochbo vehatanya ipcha la kashya ha biglima ha behemone
Tanu rabbanan en lokchin min hassorek mochin mippene sheeno shello uvimkom shennahagu lihot shello lokchin uvchol makom lokchin mehen kar male mochin vecheset melea mochin may tama kenanhu beshinuy
Tanu rabbanan en lokchin miggardi lo irin velo nirin velo punkalin velo shiyyure pakiyyot
Aval lokchin mehen beged menummar erev ushti teviy vearig
Amri hashta teviy shakli arug mibbaya may arig tiche
Tanu rabbanan en lokchin min hatztzabba lo otot velo dugmot velo telushim shel tzemer aval lokchin mehen beged tzavua teviy begadim hashta teviy shakel begadim mibaya may begadim namte
Tanu rabbanan hannoten orot leabbedan hakkitzuin vehattelushin hare ellu shel baal habbayit vehaole umishshattef bemayim hare ellu shello
Im haya shachor vechu amar rav yehuda katztzara shemeh vekatzra shakel leh amar rav yehuda hakkol olin leminyan techelet veyitzchak beri kafed alayehu
Hachayyat sheshshiyyer min et hachut ku vechamma litpor amar rav assi melo machat chutz lammachat ibaya lehu melo machat vechutz lammachat kimlo machat o dilma melo machat vechutz lammachat mashshehu

Ta shema detanya hachayyat sheshshiyyer et hachut pachot mikkede litpor bo umatlet shehi pechuta mishshalosh al shalosh bizman shebbaal habbayit makpid alehen hare ellu shel baal habbayit en baal habbayit makpid alehen hare ellu shello
I amratte bishlama melo machat vechutz lammachat kimlo machat pachot mikkan chaze lesikta ella i amratte melo machat vechutz lammachat mashshehu pachot mikkan lemay chaze
Ella shema minah melo machat vechutz lammachat kimlo machat shema minah
Ma shehecharash ku urminhi ma shehecharash motzi bemaatzad vehannifsak bimgera hare ellu shel baal habbayit vehayyotze mittachat makdeach umittachat rahitne vehannigrar bimgera hare ellu shello
Amar rava beatra detanna didan ika tarte chatzine lerabbati kare lah kashshil ulzutarti kare lah maatzad beatra detanna bara chad hu deika vekaru lah maatzad

Veim haya ose etzel ku tanu rabbanan mesattete avanim en bahem mishshum gazel mefassege ilanot mefassege gefanim menakkefe hige menakkeshi zeraim veodre yerakot bizman shebbaal habbayit makpid alehem yesh bahen mishshum gazel en baal habbayit makpid alehen hare ellu shello
Amar rav yehuda keshut vachaziz en bahem mishshum gazel beatra dekafdi yesh bahen mishshum gazel amar ravina umata machseya atra dekafdi hu
Hadaran alach haggozel batra uslika lah massechet bava kamma

a: Shenayim ochazin betallit ze omer ani metzatiha veze omer ani metzatiha ze omer kullah shelli veze omer kullah shelli ze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah veze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah veyachloku

Ze omer kullah shelli veze omer chetzyah shelli haomer kullah shelli yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mishshelosha chalakim vehaomer chetzyah shelli yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mervia ze notel shelosha chalakim veze notel revia

Hau shenayim rochvin al gabbe behema o shehaya echad rochev veechad manhig ze omer kullah shelli veze omer kullah shelli ze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah veze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah veyachloku
Bizman shehem modim o sheyyesh lahen edim cholkin belo shevua

Gema lema li lemitna ze omer ani metzatiha veze omer ani metzatiha ze omer kullah shelli veze omer kullah shelli litne chada chada katane ze omer ani metzatiha vechullah shelli veze omer ani metzatiha vechullah shelli
Velitne ani metzatiha vaana yadana dechullah shelli i tena ani metzatiha hava amena may metzatiha reitiha af al gav dela atay lideh biriyya bealma kane tena kullah shelli deviriyya la kane
Umi matzet amratte may metzatiha reitiha veha amar ravnay umtzatah daatay lideh mashma

In umtzatah dikra daata lideh mashma umihu tanna lishana dealma naket umiddechaze leh amar ana ashkachit veaf al gav dela atay lideh biriyya bealma kane tane kullah shelli deviriyya bealma la kane lah

Velitne kullah shelli vela bae ani metzatiha i tane kullah shelli hava amena bealma dekatane metzatiha biriyya bealma kane tena ani metzatiha vahadar tena kullah shelli demimmishna yattira ashmeinan diriyya la kane
Umi matzet amratte chada katane veha ze veze katane ze omer ani metzatiha veze omer ani metzatiha ze omer kullah shelli vechu
Amar rav pappa veitema rav shimi bar ashe veamri lah kedi resha bimtzia vesefa bemikkach umimkar
Utzricha
b: Dei tena metzia hava amena metzia hu dirmo rabbanan shevua aleh mishshum demore veamar chavray lav mide chasar bah ezil etpis veitpeleg bahadeh aval mikkach umimkar deleka lememar hachi ema la

Vei tena mikkach umimkar hu dirmo rabbanan shevua aleh mishshum demore veamar chavray deme ka yahev vaana deme ka yahevna hashta ditzricha ledidi eshkeleh ana vechavray lezil litrach lizban aval metzia deleka lememar hachi ema la tzericha
Mikkach umimkar velichze zuze mimman naket la tzericha denaket mittarvayehu mechad middateh umechad beal karcheh vela yadana mi hu middateh umi hu beal karcheh
Lema matnitin dela keven nannas dei ben nannas haamar
Ketzad ellu vaellu bain lide shevuat shave
Afilu tema ben nannas hatam vadday ika shevuat shave hacha ika lememar deleka shevuat shave emor detarvayehu bahade hadade agbehuha
Lema matnitin dela kesomchos dei kesomchos haamar mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin belo shevua
Veella may rabbanan ha amri hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Hay may i amratte bishlama rabbanan hatam dela tafsi tarvayehu amaru rabbanan hammotzi mechavero alav haraya hacha detarvayehu tafsi palgi lah bishvua
Ella i amratte somchos hashta uma hatam dela tafsi tarvayehu cholkin belo shevua hacha detarvayehu tafsi lah lo kol shekken
Afilu tema somchos ki amar somchos shemma veshemma aval bari uvari la amar
Ulrabba bar rav huna deamar amar somchos afilu bari uvari may ika lememar
Afilu tema somchos ki amar somchos hecha deika derara demamona aval hecha deleka derara demamona la
Velav kal vachomer hu uma hatam deika derara demamona lemar veika derara demamona lemar

a: Veika lememar kullah lemar veika lememar kullah lemar amar somchos mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin belo shevua hacha deleka derara demamona deika lememar detarvayehu hi lo kol shekken

Afilu tema somchos shevua zo midderabbanan hi kidrabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan shevua zo takkanat chachamim hi shello yehe kol echad veechad holech vetokef betallito shel chavero veomer shelli hu
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi yose dei kerabbi yose ha amar im ken ma hifsid rammay ella hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu
Ella may rabbanan kevan deamri rabbanan hashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu ha name kishar dame disfeka hi
Hay may i amratte bishlama rabbanan hatam devadday hay mane dechad minayehu hu amri rabbanan yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu hacha deika lememar detarvayehu hu amri rabbanan palgi bishvua
Ella i amratte rabbi yose hi hashta uma hatam divvadday ika mane lemar veika mane lemar amar rabbi yose yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu hacha deika lememar dechad minayehu hu lo kol shekken
Afilu tema rabbi yose hatam vadday ika rammay hacha mi yemar deika rammay ema tarvayehu bahade hadade agbehuha
I name hatam kanes leh rabbi yose lerammay ki hechi delode hacha may peseda it leh delode
Tinach metzia mikkach umimkar may ika lememar ella mechavarta kidshannin meikara
Ben lerabbanan uven lerabbi yose hatam gabbe chenvani al pinkaso dekatane ze nishba venotel veze nishba venotel
May shena dela amrinan nappekeh lemamona mibbaal habbayit vihe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu deha bevadday ika rammay

Amri hatam hayenu tama deamar leh chenvani levaal habbayit ana shelichuta didach ka avdina may it li gabbe sachir af al gav deka mishteva li la meheman li bishvua atte heemanteh dela amarte li besahade hav leh
Vesachir name amar leh levaal habbayit ana avadi avidta gabbach may it li gabbe chenvani af al gav demishteva li la meheman li hilkach tarvayehu mishtavi veshakli mibbaal habbayit
Tane rabbi chiyya mane li beyadcha vehalla omer en lecha beyadi kelum vehaedim meidim oto sheyyesh lo chamishshim zuz noten lo chamishshim zuz veyishshava al hashshear
Shello tehe hodaat piv gedola mehaadaat edim mikkal vachomer
Vetanna tuna shenayim ochazin betallit ze omer ani metzatiha vechu veha hacha kevan detafes anan sahadi demay detafes hay dideh hu umay detafes hay dideh hu vekatane yishshava
May shello tehe hodaat piv gedola mehaadaat edim mikkal vachomer shello tomar hodaat piv hu deramya rachamana shevua aleh kidrabba
Deamar rabba mippene ma amra tora mode miktzat hattaana yishshava chazaka en adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo vehay bechulleh bae denichpereh veha dela kafreh mishshum deen adam meiz panav
b: Vehay bechulleh bae delode leh vehay dela odi ishtemote hu deka mishtemet mineh savar ad dehau li zuzi ufarana leh veamar rachamana remi shevua aleh ki hechi delode leh bechulleh
Aval haadaat edim deleka lememar hachi ema la ka mashma lan kal vachomer
Umay kal vachomer uma piv sheen mechayevo mamon mechayevo shevua edim shemmechayevin oto mamon eno din shemmechayevin oto shevua
Ufiv en mechayevo mamon veha hodaat baal din kemea edim dame
May mamon kenas uma piv sheen mechayevo kenas mechayevo shevua edim shemmechayevin oto kenas eno din shemmechayevin oto shevua
Ma lefiv shekken mechayevo korban tomar beedim sheen mechayevin oto korban
Ha la kashya rabbi chiyya kerabbi meir sevira leh deamar edim mechayevin oto korban mikkal vachomer
Ditnan amru lo shenayim achalta chelev vehu omer lo achalti rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrim
Amar rabbi meir im heviuhu shenayim lide mita chamura lo yeviuhu lide korban hakkal amru lo ma im yirtze lomar mezid hayiti yippater
Ella ma lefiv shekken mechayevo asham asham hayenu korban
Ella ma lefiv shekken mechayevo chomesh ha la kashya rabbi chiyya kerabbi meir sevira leh ki hechi dimchayyev leh korban mikkal vachomer mechayyev leh chomesh mikkal vachomer
Ella ma lefiv shekken eno behachchasha uvahazama tomar beedim sheyyeshnan behachchasha uvahazama
Ella atya meed echad uma ed echad sheen mechayevo mamon mechayevo shevua edim shemmechayevin oto mamon eno din shemmechayevin oto shevua
Ma leed echad shekken al ma shehu meid hu nishba

a: Tomar beedim sheal ma shekkafar hu nishba
Ella amar rav pappa ate miggilgul shevua deed echad
Ma legilgul shevua deed echad shekken shevua goreret shevua tomar beedim demamon ka mechayevi
Piv yochiach ma lefiv shekken eno behachchasha ed echad yochiach sheyyeshno behachchasha umchayevo shevua
Ma leed echad shekken al ma shemmeid hu nishba tomar beedim sheal ma shekkafar hu nishba piv yochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheal yede taana uchfira hen bain venishba af ani avi edim sheal yede taana uchfira hem bain venishba
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken lo huchzak kafran tomar beedim shekken huchzak kafran
Uvedim mi huchzak kafran vehaamar rav idi bar avin amar rav chisda hakkofer bemilve kasher leedut befikadon pasul leedut
Ella parech hachi ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken enan betorat hazama tomar beedim sheyyeshnan betorat hazama
Ha la kashya rabbi chiyya torat hazama la parech

Ella dekaamar vetanna tuna mi dame hatam lemalve it leh sahade lelove let leh sahade dela massek leh vela mide dei hao leh sahade lelove dela massek leh vela mide la bae rabbi chiyya leishtevoe hacha ki hechi daanan sahade behay anan sahade behay vaafilu hachi mishtavi
Ella ki itmar vetanna tuna aidach derabbi chiyya itmar deamar rabbi chiyya mane li beyadcha vehalla omer en lecha beyadi ella chamishim zuz vehelach chayyav
May tama helach name kemode miktzat hatteana dame
Vetanna tuna shenayim ochazin betallit
Veha hacha kevan detafes anan sahade demay detafes helach hu vekatane yishshava
Verav sheshet amar helach patur may tama kevan deamar leh helach hane zuzi deka mode begavayehu keman denaket lehu malve dame beinach chamishshim ha la mode hilkach leka hodaat miktzat hatteana
Ulrav sheshet kashya matnitin amar lecha rav sheshet matnitin takkanat chachamim hi

Veidach in takkanat chachamim hi umihu i amratte bishlama middeorayeta helach chayyav metakkeni rabbanan shevua keen deorayeta ella i amratte middeorayeta helach patur metakkeni rabbanan shevua deleta dichotah bidorayeta
Metivi
b: Selaim dinarin malve omer chamesh velove omer shalosh rabbi shimon ben elazar omer hoil vehoda miktzat hatteana yishshava rabbi akiva omer eno ella kemeshiv aveda ufatur
Katane mihat rabbi shimon ben elazar omer hoil vehoda miktzat hatteana yishshava tama deamar shalosh ha shettayim patur vehay shetar dekamode beh helach hu ushma minah helach patur
La leolam ema lach shettayim chayyav vehay dekatane shalosh leappoke midderabbi akiva deamar meshiv aveda have ufatur ka mashma lan demode miktzat hatteana have vechayyav
I hachi rabbi shimon ben elazar omer hoil vehoda miktzat hatteana yishshava af ze yishshava mibbee leh
Ella leolam shettayim patur vehelach chayyav veshane hacha deka mesayya leh shetara
I name mishshum dehave leh shetar shibud karkaot veen nishbain al kefirat shibud karkaot
Ika demotev missefa rabbi akiva omer eno ella kemeshiv aveda ufatur tama deamar shalosh ha shettayim chayyav veha shetar kevan deka mode beh kehelach dame shema minah helach chayyav
La leolam ema lach shettayim name patur vehay dekatane shalosh leappoke midderabbi shimon ben elazar deamar mode miktzat hattaana have vechayyav ka mashma lan demeshiv aveda have ufatur

Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach shettayim chayyav beshalosh hechi patar leh rabbi akiva hay iarome ka maarim savar i amena shettayim baena ishtevoe ema shalosh deehve kemeshiv aveda veipater ella shema minah shettayim name patur
Ella kashya lerabbi chiyya shane hatam deka mesayya leh shetara i name mishshum dehave leh shetar shibud karkaot veen nishbain al kefirat shibud karkaot
Metiv mar zutra bereh derav nachman teano kelim vekarkaot hoda bakkelim vechafar bakkarkaot hoda bakkarkaot vechafar bakkelim patur hoda miktzat karkaot patur miktzat kelim chayyav
Tama dechelim vekarkaot dekarka lav bat shevua hi ha kelim vechelim dumya dechelim vekarkaot chayyav hechi dame lav deamar leh helach ushma minah helach chayyav
La leolam ema lach kelim vechelim name patur veha dekatane kelim vekarkaot ha ka mashma lan hoda bemiktzat kelim chayyav af al hakkarkaot
May ka mashma lan zokkin tenena zokkin hannechasim sheen lahen achraut et hannechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut lishava alehem
Hacha ikar hatam aggav gerara nasvah

a: Ulman deamar helach patur ammay itzterich kera lemaote karka mishshevua ha kol karka helach hu
Amar lach itzterich kera hecha dechafar bah borot shichin umarot
I name hecha ditano kelim vekarkaot vehoda bakkelim vechafar bakkarkaot
Ta shema detane rame bar chama arbaa shomrin tzerichin kefira bemiktzat vehodaa bemiktzat shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher
Hechi dame lav daamar leh helach
La daamar leh shalosh parot masarti lach umetu kullehu bifshia veamar leh ihu chada la hau devarim meolam vachada meta beones vachada meta bifshia divena shallome lach delav helach hu
Ta shema detane avuh derabbi aftoriki lidrabbi chiyya kammayeta mane li beyadcha vehalla omer en lecha beyadi kelum vehaedim meidim oto sheyyesh beyado chamishshim zuz yachol yishshava al hashshear
Talmud lomar al kol aveda asher yomar ki hu ze al hodaat piv atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo al haadaat edim
Matnita ka ramet aleh derabbi chiyya rabbi chiyya tanna hu ufaleg
Veha kera kaamar hahu lemode miktzat hattaana
Vaavuh derabbi aftoriki amar lach ketiv hu uchtiv ze chad lemode miktzat hattaana vechad lehaadaat edim defatur
Veidach chad lemode miktzat hattaana vechad lemode mimmin hattaana
Veidach mode mimmin hattaana let leh vesavar leh kerabban gamliel ditnan teano chittin vehoda lo bisorin patur verabban gamliel mechayyev

Hahu raaya dehau masri leh kol yoma chevata besahade yoma chad mesaru leh bela sahade lesof amar lehu lo hau devarim meolam ato sahade ashidu beh daachal tarte minayehu amar rabbi zera im ita lidrabbi chiyya kammayeta mishteva ashsheara
Amar leh abbaye im ita mishteva veha gazlan hu amar leh shekkenegdo kaamena
Hashta name deleta lidrabbi chiyya nechayeveh midderav nachman
Ditnan mane li beyadcha en lecha beyadi patur veamar rav nachman mashbiin oto shevuat heset
Derav nachman takkanta hi
b: Vetakkanta letakkanta la avdinan
Vetipok leh dehave leh roe veamar rav yehuda setam roe pasul
La kashya ha dideh ha dealma dei la tema hachi anan chevata leroa hechi masrinan veha ketiv lifne iver lo titten michshol ella chazaka en adam chote velo lo
Ze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah vechu al deit leh mishteva o al delet leh mishteva amar rav huna deamar shevua sheyyesh li bah veen li bah pachot mechetzyah
Venema shevua shekkullah shelli umi yahavinan leh kullah
Venema shevua shechetzyah shelli mara leh ledibureh
Hashta name mara leh ledibureh deamar kullah shelli uldivrechem shevua sheyyesh li bah veen li bah pachot mechetzyah

Vechi meachar shezze tafus veomed veze tafus veomed shevua zo lamma amar rabbi yochanan shevua zo takkanat chachamim hi shello yehe kol echad veechad holech vetokef betallito shel chavero veomer shelli hu
Venema migo dachashid ammamona chashid name ashshevuata
La amrinan migo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata dei la tema hachi hay deamar rachamana mode miktzat hattaana yishshava nema migo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata
Hatam ishtemote ka mishtemit leh kidrabba
Tidda deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav chisda hakkofer bemilve kasher leedut befikadon pasul leedut
Ella ha detane rame bar chama arbaa shomrin tzerichin kefira bemiktzat vehodaa bemiktzat shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher nema migo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata
Hatam name ishtemote ka mishtemit savar mashkachna legannav vetafesna leh i name mashkachna leh baagam umayetena leh
I hachi hakkofer befikkadon ammay pasul leedut nema ishtemote ka mishtemit savar ad devacheshna umshakkachna leh
Ki amrinan hakkofer befikkadon pasul leedut kegon deatu sahade veashidu beh dehahi shata iteh lefikkadon beveteh vahava yada i name dahava naket leh bideh
Ella ha deamar rav huna mashbiin oto shevua sheenah birshuto nema migo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata
Hatam name more veamar deme ka yahevna leh
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina veha ka avar al lav delo tachmod
Lo tachmod leinashe bela deme mashma lehu

a: Veella ha deamar rav nachman mashbiin oto shevuat heset nema migo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata
Vetu ha detane rabbi chiyya shenehem nishbain venotlin mibbaal habbayit nema migo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata
Vetu ha deamar rav sheshet shalosh shavuot mashbiin oto shevua shello pashati bah shevua shello shalachti bah yad shevua sheenah birshuti nema migo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata
Ella la amrinan migo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata
Abbaye amar chayeshinan shemma milve yeshana yesh lo alav
I hachi nishkol bela shevua
Ella chayeshinan shemma sefek milve yeshana yesh lo alav
Velav amrinan tafes mamona missefeka mishteva name missafek
Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi parshi inashe missefek shevua vela parshi missefek mamona may tama mamon iteh bachazara shevua leteh bachazara
Bae rabbi zera tekafah echad befanenu mahu
Hechi dame i deshatek odoye odi leh vei deka tzavach may hava leh lemebad
La tzericha dishtek meikara vahadar tzavach may middeishtik odoye odi leh o dilma kevan deka tzavach hashta igallay milta dehay dishtek meikara savar ha ka chazu leh rabbanan

Amar rav nachman ta shema bamme devarim amurim sheshshenehem adukin bah aval hayeta tallit yotzet mittachat yado shel echad mehen hammotzi mechavero alav haraya hechi dame i nema kidkatane peshita ella shettekafah echad befanenu

La hacha bemay askinan kegon deatu lekamman keditfisu lah tarvayehu veamrinan lehu zilu pelugu unfaku vahadar ato ki tafes lah chad minayehu hay amar odoye odi li vehay amar bidme ogarti nihaleh deamrinan leh ad hashta chashdatte leh begazlan vehashta mograt leh bela sahadi
Veibaet ema kidkatane deatu lekamman ki tafes lah chad minayehu veidach mesarech bah saroche vaafilu lesomchos deamar mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin belo shevua mode somchos desircha lav kelum hi
Im timtze lomar tekafah echad befanenu motziin otah miyyado hikdisha enah mekuddeshet im timtze lomar tekafah echad befanenu en motziin otah miyyado hikdishah belo tekafah mahu
Kevan deamar mar amirato laggavoha kimsirato lahedot dame keman detakfah dame
O dilma hashta miha ha la takfah uchtiv veish ki yakdish et beto kodesh vego ma beto birshuto af kol birshuto leappoke hay delo birshuto
Ta shema dehahi
b: Massuta dahao minnetzu alah be tere hay amar didi hu vehay amar didi hu kam chad minayehu akdeshah parshi minah rav chananya verav oshaya vechullehu rabbanan vaamar leh rav oshaya lerabba ki azlatte kammeh derav chisda lechafri bei mineh
Ki ata lesura amar leh rav hamnuna matnitin hi sefek bechorot echad bechor adam veechad bechor behema ben tehorim ben temeim hammotzi mechavero alav haraya vetane alah asurim begiza uvaavoda
Veha hacha deamar tekafo kohen en motziin oto miyyado dekatane hammotzi mechavero alav haraya vechi lo tekafo asurin begiza uvaavoda
Amar leh rabba kedushshat bechor kaamratte leolam ema lach tekafo kohen motziin oto miyyado vaafilu hachi asurim begiza uvaavoda dikdushsha habbaa meeleha shane
Amar leh rav chananya lerabba tanya dimsayya lach hassefekot nichnasin laddir lehitasser
Vei salka datach tekafo kohen en motziin oto miyyado ammay nichnasin laddir nimtza ze poter mamono bemamono shel kohen
Amar leh abbaye i mishshum ha la tesayeeh lemar hacha bemay askinan kegon delet leh ella tisha vehu dema nafshach i bar chiyyuva hu shappir ka meassar i lav bar chiyyuva hu tisha lav bar assore ninhu
Hadar amar abbaye lav milta hi deamri disfeka lav bar assore hi ditnan kafatz echad min hammenuyin letochan kullan peturin
Vei salka datach sefeka bae assore leasser mimma nafshach dei bar chiyyuva hu shappir meassar vei lav bar chiyyuva hu nippetar beminyan harauy
Deamar rava minyan harauy poter

a: Ella may it lach lememar asiri vadday amar rachamana velo asiri safek hacha name asiri vadday amar rachamana velo asiri safek
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina may sefekot ilema sefek bechorot yihye kodesh amar rachamana velo shekkevar kadosh
Ella sefek pidon peter chamor vechidrav nachman deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh yisrael sheyyesh lo asara sefek pitre chamor betoch beto mafrish alehen asara seyin umasseran vehen shello

May have alah demassuta ta shema deamar rabbi chiyya bar avin hava ovada be rav chisda verav chisda be rav huna ufashtah meha deamar rav nachman kol mamon sheen yachol lehotzio bedayyanin hikdisho eno kadosh

Ha yachol lehotzio bedayyanin hikdisho kadosh af al gav dela appekeh vehaamar rabbi yochanan gazal velo nityaashu habbealim shenehem enam yecholin lehakdisho ze lefi sheenah shello veze lefi sheenah birshuto
Mi savratte bemassuta mittaltelin askinan bemassuta mekarkee askinan dechi yachol lehotzia bedayyanin birshuteh kayema

Tane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu shenayim adukim betallit ze notel ad makom sheyyado maggaat veze notel ad makom sheyyado maggaat vehashshear cholkin beshave machve leh rabbi avahu uvishvua
Ella matnitin dekatane defalgi bahadade vela katane ze notel ad mekom sheyyado maggaat hechi mashkachatte lah amar rav pappa ditfisi becharkeshata
Amar rav mesharsheya shema minah hay sudara kevan detafes beh shalosh al shalosh karenan beh venatan lereehu
Dichman difsik deme vekane
Umay shena midderav chisda deamar rav chisda get beyadah umshicha beyado im yachol lenatteko velahavio etzlo enah megoreshet veim lav megoreshet
Hatam keritut baenan veleka hacha netina baenan veha ika
Amar rava im hayeta tallit muzhevet cholkin peshita la tzericha dekae dahava be mitze
Ha name peshita la tzericha demikrav legabbe dechad mahu detema daamar leh pelog hachi ka mashma lan daamar leh may chazet defalgatte hachi pelog hachi
Tanu rabbanan shenayim adukin bishtar malve omer shelli hu venafal mimmenni umtzativ velove amar shellecha hu ufrativ lach yitkayyem hashshetar bechotmav divre rabbi
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer yachloku
Nafal leyad dayyan lo yotzio olamit rabbi yose omer hare hu bechezkato
Amar mar yitkayyem hashshetar bechotmav vegave leh malve kulleh velet leh matnitin shenayim ochazin ku
Amar rava amar rav nachman bimkuyyam divre hakkol yachloku ki peligi besheeno mekuyyam
Rabbi savar mode bishtar shekketavo tzarich lekayemo vei mekayyem leh paleg vei la mekayyem leh la paleg
May tama chaspa bealma hu man ka meshave leh lehay shetara love ha kaamar difria
Verabbi shimon ben gamliel savar mode bishtar shekketavo en tzarich lekayemo veaf al gav dela mekayyem leh yachloku
Nafal leyad dayyan lo yotzio olamit
b: May shena leyad dayyan amar rava hachi kaamar veacher shemmatza shetar shennafal leyad dayyan vehechi dame dichtav beh henpek lo yotzio olamit
Vela mibaya la ketav beh henpek deika lememar katav lilot velo lava ella afilu ketav beh henpek dimkuyyam lo yachazir dechayeshinan leferaon
Verabbi yose omer hare hu bechezkato vela chayeshinan leferaon vela chayesh rabbi yose leferaon
Vehatanya matza shetar ketubba bashshuk bizman shehabbaal mode yachazir laishsha en habbaal mode lo yachazir lo laze velo laze
Rabbi yose omer odah tachat baalah yachazir laishsha nitarmela o nitgarsha lo yachazir lo laze velo laze
Efoch nafal leyad dayyan lo yotzio olamit divre rabbi yose vachachamim omrim hare hu bechezkato
I hachi kashya derabbanan adderabbanan

Shetar ketubba kullah rabbi yose vechassore mechassera vehachi katane en habbaal mode lo yachazir lo laze velo laze bamme devarim amurim shennitarmela o shennitgarsha aval odah tachat baalah yachazir laishsha sherabbi yose omer odah tachat baalah yachazir laishsha nitarmela o shennitgarsha lo yachazir lo laze velo laze
Rav pappa amar leolam la tefoch rabbi yose ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu
Ledidi afilu nitarmela o nitgarsha name la chayeshinan leferaon ledidchu odo li mihat beodah tachat baalah deyachazir laishsha delav bat peraon hi
Vaamaru leh rabbanan emor tzerare atpesa
Ravina amar leolam efoch kammayeta vetama derabbanan hacha mishshum dechayeshinan lishte chetubbot verabbi yose lishte chetubbot la chayesh
Amar rabbi elazar machaloket besheshshenehem adukim battofes ushnehem battoref aval echad aduk battofes veechad aduk battoref ze notel tofes veze notel toref verabbi yochanan amar leolam cholkin
Vaafilu echad aduk battofes veechad battoref vehatanya ze notel ad makom sheyyado maggaat la tzericha dekae toref be mitze
I hachi may lememra la tzericha dimkarav legabbe dechad mahu detema amar leh pelog hachi ka mashma lan deamar leh may chazet defalgatte hachi pelog hachi
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina lerabbi elazar deamar ze notel tofes veze notel toref lema leh vechi latzur al pi tzelochito hu tzarich
Amar leh lidme
Deamar hachi shetara deit beh zeman kamma shave udlet beh zeman kamma shave bishtara deit beh zeman gave mimmeshabede veidach la gave mimmeshabede yahev leh heach devene bene
Veyachloku name daamaran ledame dei la tema hachi shenayim ochazin betallit hachi name defalgi ha afseduh ha la kashya

a: Dechazya liktannim
Veha deamar rava im hayeta tallit muzhevet cholkin hachi name defalgi lah ha afseduha ha la kashya dechazya livne melachim
Veha ditnan hau shenayim rochvin al gabbe behema vechu hachi name defalgi lah ha afseduha bishlama tehora chazya levasar ella temea ha afseduha ella lidme hacha name lidme
Amar rame bar chama zot omeret hammagbiha metzia lachavero kana chavero

Dei salka datach lo kana chavero tease zo kemi shemmunnachat al gabbe karka vezo kemi shemmunnachat al gabbe karka velo yikne lo ze velo ze ella lav shema minah hammagbiha metzia lachavero kana chavero
Amar rava leolam ema lach hammagbiha metzia lachavero lo kana chavero vehacha hayenu tama miggo dezache lenafsheh zache name lechavreh
Tidda sheilu amar lishlucho tze ugnov li veganav patur veshuttafin shegganvu chayyavin may tama lav mishshum deamrinan miggo dezache lenafsheh zache name lechavreh shema minah
Amar rava hashta deamratte amrinan miggo cheresh ufikkeach shehigbihu metzia mittoch shekkana cheresh kana pikkeach
Bishlama cheresh kana deka magbah leh ben daat ella pikkeach bemay kana
Ella ema cheresh kana pikkeach la kana umay miggo miggo dishne chershin bealma kanu hay name kane
Hay may im timtza lomar hammagbiha metzia lachavero kana chavero hane mile hecha deka magbah leh addata dechavreh hay addata dideh ka magbah leh ihu la kane leacharine makne
Ella ema mittoch shello kana pikkeach lo kana cheresh
Vechi tema may shena mishshene chershin dealma hatam takkinu lehu rabbanan dela ate leinnetzoye hacha memar amar pikkeach la kane ana ekne

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav adda lerav ashe diyyukeh derame bar chama mehecha i nema meresha shenayim ochazin betallit hatam hay kaamar kullah shelli vaana aggebbahtah kullah vehay amar kullah shelli vaana aggebbahtah kullah
Ella meha dekatane ze omer kullah shelli veze omer kullah shelli ha tu lema li ella mimmishna yetera shema minah hammagbiha metzia lachavero kana chavero
Veha okemna resha bimtzia vesefa bemikkach umimkar
Ella missefa ze omer kullah shelli veze omer chetzyah shelli ha tu lema li ella mimmishna yetera shema minah hammagbiha metzia lachavero kana chavero
Umimmay devimtzia dilma bemikkach umimkar

Vechi tema i bemikkach umimkar may lememra itzterich salka datach amena hay dekaamar chetzyah shelli leheve kemeshiv aveda veliptar kamashma lan dehay iarome ka maarim savar i amena kullah shelli baena ishtevoe ema hachi deehve kemeshiv aveda veiptar
Ella meha hau shenayim rochvin al gabbe behema ha tu lema li ella mimmishna yetera shema minah hammagbiha metzia lachavero kana chavero
Vedilma ha kamashma lan derochev name kane
Ella missefa bizman shehen modin o sheyyesh lahen edim cholkin belo shevua bemay i bemikkach umimkar tzericha lememar ella lav bimtzia ushma minah hammagbiha metzia lachavero kana chavero
Verava amar lach miggo dezache lenafsheh zache name lechavreh
Hau shenayim rochvin amar rav yosef amar li rav yehuda
b: Shemait mineh demar shemuel tarte rachuv umanhig chad kane vechad la kane vela yadana he minayehu
Hechi dame ilema rachuv lechodeh umanhig lechodeh manhig lechodeh mi ika man deamar la kane ella i ika lememar dela kane rachuv hu deika lememar
Ella rachuv bimkom manhig ibaya leh may rachuv adif deha tafes bah o dilma manhig adif deazla mechamateh
Amar rav yosef amar li rav yehuda nechze anan ditnan hammanhig sofeg et haarbaim vehayyoshev bakkaron sofeg et haarbaim rabbi meir poter et hayyoshev bakkaron
Umiddeafech shemuel vetane vachachamim potrin et hayyoshev bakkaron shema minah rachuv lechodeh la kane vechol shekken rachuv bimkom manhig
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef ha zimnin saggiin amarte lan nechze anan vela amarte lan mishshemeh derav yehuda
Amar leh ivra udchirna name daamari leh hechi pashet mar rachuv miyyoshev yoshev la tafes bemosera rachuv tafes bemosera vaamar li rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu mosera la kane
Ika deamri amar leh abbaye lerav yosef hechi pashet mar rachuv miyyoshev yoshev la tafes bemosera rachuv tafes bemosera amar leh hachi tena ide mosera la kane
Ittemar name amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna mosera mechavero kana bimtzia uvnichse hagger la kane
May leshon mosera amar rava idi asbera li keadam hammoser davar lachavero bishlama mechavero kane deka masar leh chavreh ella bimtzia uvnichse hagger man ka masar leh delikne
Metivi hau shenayim rochvin al gabbe behema vechu manni ilema rabbi meir hashta yoshev kane rachuv mibe ella lav rabbanan ushma minah rachuv kane
Hacha bemay askinan bemanhig beraglav i hachi hayenu manhig tere gavene manhig mahu detema rachuv adif deha manhig vetafes bah ka mashma lan
Ta shema shenayim shehau moshchin begamal umanhigin bachamor o shehaya echad moshech veechad manhig

a: Bemidda zot kanu rabbi yehuda omer leolam lo kana ad shettehe meshicha begamal vehanhaga bachamor
Katane mihat o shehaya echad moshech veechad manhig moshech umanhig in aval rachuv la
Hu haddin daafilu rachuv veha dekatane moshech umanhig leappoke midderabbi yehuda deamar ad shettehe meshicha begamal vehanhaga bachamor kamashma lan daafilu ipcha name kane
I hachi liarvinhu velitninhu shenayim shehau moshchin umanhigin ben begamal ben bachamor
Ika chad tzad dela kane ika deamri meshicha bachamor veika deamri hanhaga begamal
Veit demotev missefa bemidda zo kana bemidda zo lemaote may lav lemaote rachuv la lemaote ipcha
I hachi hayenu rabbi yehuda ika benayehu tzad echad delo kana it deamri meshicha bachamor veika deamri hanhaga begamal
Ta shema echad rachuv chamor veechad tafus bemosera ze kana chamor veze kana mosera shema minah rachuv kane
Hacha name bemanhig beraglav i hachi nikne name rachuv bemosera ema ze kana chamor vachatzi mosera veze kana chatzi mosera
Bishlama rachuv kane dekamagbah leh ben daat ella tafus bemosera bemay kane
Ema ze kana chamor vechulleh mosera veze kana ma shettafus beyado
Hay may im timtze lomar hammagbiha metzia lachavero kana chavero hane mile hecha deka magbah leh addata dechavreh hay addata dideh ka magbah leh ihu la kane leacharine makne
Amar rav ashe ze kana chamor uvet paggeha veze kana ma shettafus beyado vehashshear lo kana lo ze velo ze
Rabbi avahu amar leolam kidkatane hoil veyachol lenattekah velahaviah etzlo

Veha derabbi avahu beruta hi dei la tema hachi tallit shehi munnachat chetzyah al gabbe karka vechetzyah al gabbe ammud uva echad vehigbiha chetzyah meal gabbe karka uva acher vehigbiha chetzyah meal gabbe ammud hachi name dekamma kane uvatra la kane hoil veyachol lenattekah velahaviah etzlo ella ha derabbi avahu beruta hi
Ta shema rabbi eliezer omer rachuv bassade umanhig bair kana hacha name manhig beraglav i hachi hayenu manhig tere gavene manhig
I hachi rachuv bair may tama la kane amar rav kahana lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lirkov bair

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana ella meatta higbiha arnaki beshabbat sheen darkan shel bene adam lehagbiha arnaki beshabbat hachi name dela kane ella may daavad avad vekane hacha name may daavad avad ukni
Ella bemikkach umimkar askinan daamar leh kene kederech shebbene adam konin
b: Vei reshut harabbim hu kane vei adam chashuv hu kane vei ishsha hi kanya vei inish zila hu kane
Bae rabbi elazar haomer lachavero meshoch behema zo liknot kelim shealeha mahu
Liknot mi amar leh kene ella meshoch behema zo ukne kelim shealeha mahu mi mahneya meshicha divhema leaknoye kelim o la
Amar rava i amar leh kene behema ukne kelim mi kane kelim chatzer mehallechet hi vechatzer mehallechet lo kana
Vechi tema kesheamda veha kol sheilu mehallech lo kana omed veoshev lo kana
Vehilcheta bichfutah

Amaru leh rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava ella meatta haya mehallech bisfina vekaftzu dagim venaflu letoch hassefina hachi name dechatzer mehallechet hi vela kane amar leh sefina menach nayecha umayya hu deka mamtu lah

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ella meatta hayeta mehallechet birshut harabbim vezarak lah get letoch chekah o letoch kaltah hacha name dela miggarsha amar leh kaltah menach nayecha veihi deka mesaggeya mittutah
Matni haya rochev al gabbe behema veraa et hammetzia veamar lachavero tenah li netalah veamar ani zachiti bah zacha bah im mishshennetanah lo amar ani zachiti bah techilla lo amar kelum
Gema tenan hatam mi shelliket et happea veamar hare zo lifloni ani rabbi eliezer omer zacha lo vachachamim omrim yittenenna leani hannimtza rishon
Amar ulla amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi machloket meashir leani
Derabbi eliezer savar miggo dei bae mafkar nichseh vehave ani vachaze leh hashta name chaze leh umiggo dezache lenafsheh zache name lechavreh verabbanan savri chad miggo amrinan tere miggo la amrinan
Aval meani leani divre hakkol zacha lo demiggo dezache lenafsheh zache name lechavreh

Amar leh rav nachman leulla velema mar meani leani machloket deha metzia hakkol aniyyim etzlah utnan haya rochev al gabbe behema veraa et hammetzia veamar lachavero tenah li netalah veamar ani zachiti bah zacha bah
I amratte bishlama meani leani machloket

a: Matnitin manni rabbanan hi ella i amratte beashir veani machloket aval meani leani divre hakkol zacha lo ha manni la rabbanan vela rabbi eliezer
Amar leh matnitin deamar techila

Hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa im mishshennetanah lo amar ani zachiti bah techila lo amar kelum techila besefa lema li peshita af al gav dela amar techila techila kaamar ella lav ha ka mashma lan resha deamar techila
Veidach tena sefa legalloye resha sefa deamar techila resha dela amar techila
Rav nachman verav chisda deamri tarvayehu hammagbiha metzia lachavero lo kana chavero
May tama have tofes levaal chov bimkom shechav laacherim vehattofes levaal chov bimkom shechav laacherim lo kana
Etiveh rava lerav nachman metziat poel leatzmo
Bamme devarim amurim bizman sheamar lo baal habbayit nakkesh immi hayyom ador immi hayyom aval amar lo ase immi melacha hayyom metziato shel baal habbayit hu
Amar leh shane poel deyado keyad baal habbayit hu
Vehaamar rav poel yachol lachazor bo afilu bachatzi hayyom
Amar leh kol kamma dela hadar beh keyad baal habbayit hu ki hadar beh tama acharina hu dichtiv ki li vene yisrael avadim avaday hem velo avadim laavadim
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hammagbiha metzia lachavero kana chavero veim tomar mishnatenu deamar tenah li vela amar zechah li
Matni raa et hammetzia venafal aleha uva acher vehechzik bah ze shehechzik bah zacha bah

Gema amar resh lakish mishshum abba kohen bardela arba ammot shel adam konot lo bechol makom may tama takkinu rabbanan dela ate leto leinnetzoye amar abbaye motev rabbi chiyya bar yosef pea amar rava motev rabbi yaakov bar idi nezikin
Amar abbaye motev rabbi chiyya bar yosef pea natal miktzat pea vezarak al hashshear en lo bah kelum nafal lo aleha peras tallito aleha maavirin oto hemenna vechen beomer shichcha
Vei amratte arba ammot shel adam konot lo bechol makom nikno leh arba ammot dideh
Hacha bemay askinan dela amar ekne
Vei takkun rabbanan ki la amar may have
Kevan dinfal galli dateh devinfila nicha leh denikne bearba ammot la nicha leh denikne
b: Rav pappa amar ki takkinu le rabbanan arba ammot bealma besade devaal habbayit la takkinu le rabbanan veaf al gav dizcha leh rachamana begavah ki zecha leh rachamana lehalloche bah ulnakkote pea lemihve chatzero la zecha leh rachamana

Amar rava motev rabbi yaakov bar idi nezikin raa et hammetzia venafal lo aleha uva acher vehechzik bah ze shehechzik bah zacha bah vei amratte arba ammot shel adam konot lo bechol makom nikno leh arba ammot dideh
Hacha bemay askinan dela amar ekne vei takkun rabbanan ki la amar may have kevan denafal aleha galli dateh devinfila nicha leh denikne bearba ammot la nicha leh denikne
Rav sheshet amar ki takkinu rabbanan besimta dela dachaki rabbim birshut harabbim deka dachaki rabbim la takkinu rabbanan
Veha bechol makom kaamar
Kol makom leetoye tzide reshut harabbim
Veamar resh lakish mishshum abba kohen bardela ketanna en lah chatzer veen lah arba ammot verabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yannay amar yesh lah chatzer veyesh lah arba ammot
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar chatzer mishshum yadah itrabbay ki hechi deit lah yad chatzer name it lah umar savar chatzer mishshum shelichut itrabbay vechi hechi dishlichut let lah chatzer name let lah
Mi ika man deamar chatzer mishshum shelichut itrabbay vehatanya beyado en li ella yado gaggo chatzero vekarpefo minnayin talmud lomar himmatze timmatze mikkol makom
Vei salka datach chatzer mishshum shelichut itrabbay im ken matzinu shaliach lidvar avera vekayema lan en shaliach lidvar avera
Amar ravina hecha amrinan deen shaliach lidvar avera hecha deshaliach bar chiyyuva hu aval bechatzer delav bar chiyyuva hu michayyav sholcho
Ella meatta haomer leishsha veeved tzeu ginvu li delav bene chiyyuva ninhu hachi name demichayyav sholchan
Amratte ishsha veeved bene chiyyuva ninhu vehashta miha let lehu leshallome ditnan nitgarsha haishsha nishtachrer haeved chayyavin leshallem
Rav samma amar hecha amrinan en shaliach lidvar avera hecha dei bae aved vei bae la aved aval chatzer dival kurcheh motev bah michayyav sholcho
May benayehu ika benayehu kohen deamar leh leyisrael tze vekaddesh li ishsha gerusha i name ish deamar lah leishsha akkifi li katan

Lehach lishana deamar kol hecha dei bae aved i bae la aved la michayyav sholcho hane name i bae aved i bae la aved la michayyav sholchan lehach lishana deamratte kol hecha deshaliach lav bar chiyyuva michayyav sholcho hane name kevan delav bene chiyyuva ninhu michayyav shulchan
Umi ika leman deamar chatzer lav mishshum yadah itrabbay vehatanya yadah en li ella yadah gaggah chatzerah vekarpefah minnayin talmud lomar venatan mikkol makom
Leinyan get kulle alma la peligi dechatzer mishshum yadah itrabbay ki peligi leinyan metzia mar savar

a: Yalfinan metzia migget umar savar la yalfinan metzia migget
Veibaet ema biktanna kulle alma la peligi deyalfinan metzia migget vehacha bekatan ka mipalgi
Mar savar yalfinan katan mikketanna umar savar la yalfinan katan mikketanna
Veibaet ema mar amar chada umar amar chada vela peligi

Matni raa otan ratzin achar metzia achar tzevi shavur achar gozalot shello perchu veamar zachta li sadi zachta lo haya tzevi ratz kedarko o shehau gozalot mafrichin veamar zachta li sadi lo amar kelum
Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel vehu sheomed betzad sadehu
Vetikne leh sadehu deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato
Hane mile bechatzer hammishtammeret aval chatzer sheenah mishtammeret i omed betzad sadehu in i la la
Umna temra dechatzer sheenah mishtammeret i omed betzad sadehu in i la la
Detanya haya omed bair veomer yodea ani sheomer sheyyesh li bassade poalim shechechuhu lo yehe shichcha yachol lo yehe shichcha talmud lomar veshachachta omer bassade bassade veshachachta velo bair
Ha gufah kashya amratte yachol lo yehe shichcha alma have shichcha venasev lah talmuda bassade veshachachta velo bair alma la have shichcha
Ella lav hachi kaamar bassade shachuach meikaro have shichcha zachur ulvassof shachuach en shichcha may tama dechevan dekae gabbah haveya lah chatzero vezachta leh
Aval bair afilu zachur ulvassof shachuach haveya shichcha may tama deleteh gabbeh delizke leh
Mimmay dilma gezerat hakkatuv hi devassade neheve shichcha uvair la neheve shichcha
Amar kera lo tashuv lekachto lerabbot shichchat hair
Hay mibe leh lelav
Im ken nema kera lo tikkachennu may lo tashuv lerabbot shichchat hair
Veakkatti mibe leh lichditnan shellefanav en shichcha shelleacharav yesh shichcha shehu beval tashuv
Ze hakkelal kol shehu beval tashuv shichcha kol sheeno beval tashuv eno shichcha
Amar rav ashe amar kera yihye lerabbot shichchat hair
Vechen amar ulla vehu sheomed betzad sadehu vechen amar rabba bar bar chana vehu sheomed betzad sadehu
Etiveh rabbi abba leulla maase berabban gamliel uzkenim shehau baim bisfina amar rabban gamliel isur sheani atid lamod natun lihoshua
b: Umkomo muskar lo veisur acher sheani atid lamod natun laakiva ben yosef kede sheyyizke bo laaniyyim umkomo muskar lo
Vechi rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva betzad sadehu shel rabban gamliel hau omdin
Amar leh dame hay merabbanan kidla gamri inashe shemata
Ki ata lesura amar lehu hachi amar ulla vehachi otviteh amar leh hahu merabbanan rabban gamliel mittaltele aggav mekarkee hikna lahem rabbi zera kabbelah rabbi abba la kabbelah

Amar rava shappir avad dela kabbelah vechi lo haya lahem sudar liknot mimmennu bachalifin ella tovat hanaa enah mamon liknot mimmennu bachalifin hacha name tovat hanaa enah mamon liknot al gabbe karka
Vela hi mattenot kehunna netina ketiva behu chalifin derech mikkach umimkar hu mittaltelin aggav mikkarka netina allimta hi
Rav pappa amar daat acheret makna otan shane

Umna temra ditnan raa otan ratzin achar hammetzia ku veamar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan vehu sheratz acharehen umaggian uvae rabbi yirmeya bemattana heach kabbelah mineh rabbi abba bar kahana af al pi sheratz acharehen veen maggian may tama lav mishshum dedaat acheret makna otan shane
Amar leh rav shimi lerav pappa hare get dedaat acheret makna otah veamar ulla vehu sheomedet betzad betah o betzad chatzerah shane get deiteh beal korchah
Matkef lah rav sheshet bereh derav idi velav kal vachomer hu uma get deiteh beal korchah i omedet betzad betah uvtzad chatzerah in i la la mattana demiddateh lo kol shekken
Ella amar rav ashe

a: Chatzer itrabbay mishshum yad vela gara mishshelichut gabbe get dechov hu lah en chavin leadam ella befanav gabbe mattana dizchut hu lo zachin leadam shello befanav

Gufa raa otan ratzin achar hammetzia vechu amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan vehu sheratz acharehen umaggian bae rabbi yirmeya bemattana heach kabbelah mineh rabbi abba bar kahana af al pi sheratz acharehen veen maggian
Bae rava zarak arnaki befetach ze veyatza befetach acher mahu avir sheen sofo lanuach kemunnach dame o la

Amar leh rav pappa lerava veamri lah rav adda bar matna lerava veamri lah ravina lerava lav hayenu matnitin raa otan ratzin achar hammetzia veamar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan vehu sheratz acharehen umaggian uvae rabbi yirmeya bemattana heach vekabbelah mineh rabbi abba bar kahana bemattana af al pi sheratz acharehen veen maggian
Amar leh mitgalgel kaamratte shane mitgalgel dichmunnach dame

Matni metziat beno uvitto hakketannim metziat avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim metziat ishto hare ellu shello metziat beno uvitto haggedolim metziat avdo veshifchato haivrim metziat ishto sheggershah af al pi shello natan ketubba hare ellu shellahen
Gema amar shemuel mippene ma amru metziat katan leaviv shebbeshaa shemmotzah meritzah etzel aviv veeno meacher beyado

Lememra desavar shemuel katan let leh zechiyya lenafsheh middeorayeta vehatanya hassocher et happoel yelakket beno acharav lemechetza lishlish velirvia lo yelakket beno acharav rabbi yosi omer ben kach uven kach yelakket beno veishto acharav veamar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose

I amratte bishlama katan it leh zechiyya lenafsheh ki ka melakket lenafsheh ka melakket vaavuh mineh ka zache ella i amratte katan let leh zechiyya lenafsheh ki ka melakket leaviv ka melakket avuh ashir hu ammay ishto uvno melakket acharav
Shemuel tama detanna didan kaamar veleh la sevira leh
Vesavar rabbi yose katan it leh zechiyya middeorayeta vehatnan metziat cheresh shote vekatan yesh bahen mishshum gazel mippene darche shalom rabbi yose omer gazel gamur
Veamar rav chisda gazel gamur middivrehen nafka minah lehotziah bedayyanin
Ella amar abbaye asauha kemi shehalchu bah namoshot daaniyyim gufayehu massechi datayehu savri bereh dehayech melakketoy leh
Amar leh rav adda bar matna leabbaye vechi muttar laadam leharbitz ari betoch sadehu kede sheyyiru aniyyim veyivrechu
Ella amar rava
b: Asu sheeno zoche kezoche may tama aniyyim gufayehu nicha lehu ki hechi dechi agru ledidhu nilkot benayehu batrayehu

Ufliga derabbi chiyya bar abba deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lo gadol gadol mammash velo katan katan mammash ella gadol vesamuch al shulchan aviv zehu katan katan veeno samuch al shulchan aviv zehu gadol
Metziat avdo veshifchato haivrim hare hu shel atzman ammay lo yehe ella poel vetanya metziat poel leatzmo bamme devarim amurim bizman sheamar lo nakkesh immi hayyom ador ammi hayyom
Aval amar lo ase immi melacha hayyom metziato levaal habbayit
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hacha beeved nokev margaliyyot askinan sheen rabbo rotze leshannoto limlacha acheret
Rava amar bemagbiha metzia im melachto askinan
Rav pappa amar kegon shessecharo lelakket metziot vehechi dame deakkefay agma bichore
Hay shifcha hechi dame i deayetay shette searot may baaya gabbeh
Vei dela ayetay shette searot i iteh leav daavuh haveya vei deleteh laav tipok bemitat haav
Deamar resh lakish ama haivriyya kona atzmah bemitat haav mershut haadon mikkal vachomer velav itotav resh lakish
Nema mehay name tehve teuvta
La leolam deiteh leav umay hare hen shellahen leappoke derabba
Metziat ishto gershah peshita
Hacha bemay askinan bimgoreshet veenah megoreshet deamar rabbi zera amar shemuel kol makom sheamru chachamim megoreshet veenah megoreshet balah chayyav bimzonoteha
Tama may amur rabbanan metziat ishsha levalah ki hechi dela tehve lah eva hacha it lah eva veeva
Matni matza shitre chov im yesh bahen achraut nechasim lo yachzir shebbet din nifrain mehen en bahen achraut nechasim yachzir sheen bet din nifrain mehen divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach lo yachzir mippene shebbet din nifrain mehen

Gema bemay askinan ilema keshechayyav mode ki yesh bahen achraut nechasim ammay lo yachzir ha mode vei kesheen chayyav mode ki en bahen achraut nechasim ammay yachzir nehi dela gave mimmeshabede mibbene chare migba gave
Leolam keshechayyav mode vehacha hayenu tama dechayeshinan shemma katav lilot benisan velo lava ad tishri veate lemitraf lakochot shello kaddin
I hachi kol shetare deatu lekamman nechush lehu hachi
Kol shetare la rie hane rie
Ella ha ditnan kotvin shetar lallove af al pi sheen malve immo lechattechila hechi katvinan nechush shemma katav lilot benisan velo lava ad tishri veate lemitraf lakochot shello kaddin
Amar rav assi

a: Bishtare haknaa deha shabed nafsheh

I hachi matnitin dekatane im yesh bahen achraut nechasim lo yachazir veokemna keshechayyav mode umishshum shemma katav lilot benisan velo lava ad tishre veate lemitraf lakochot shello kaddin ammay lo yachazir
Nechze i bishtar haknaa ha shabed leh nafsheh i bishtar dela haknaa leka lemechash deha amratte ki leka malve bahadeh la katvinan
Amar lecha rav assi af al gav dishtare delav haknaa ki leka malve bahadeh la katvinan matnitin kevan dinfal ittera leh vechayeshinan dilma ikkeri uchtuv
Abbaye amar edav bachatumav zachin lo vaafilu shetare delav haknaa
Mishshum dekashya leh kevan deamratte bishtare delav haknaa ki leteh lemalve bahadeh la katvinan leka lemechash deikkeri uchtuv

Ella ha ditnan matza gite nashim veshichrure avadim deyateke mattana veshovarim hare ze lo yachzir shemma ketuvim hau venimlach alehem shello litnam vechi nimlach alehem may have veha amratte edav bachatumav zachin lo
Hane mile hecha deka matu lideh aval hecha dela matu lideh la amrinan
Ella matnitin dekatane matza shitre chov im yesh bahem achraut nechasim lo yachzir veokimna keshechayyav mode umishshum shemma katav lilot benisan velo lava ad tishre
Bishlama lerav assi deamar bishtare akneyata moke lah bishtare delav akneyata vechidamrinan ella leabbaye deamar edav bachatumav zachin lo may ika lememar
Amar lach abbaye matnitin hayenu tama dechayeshinan leferaon veliknunya

Velishmuel deamar la chayeshinan leferaon veliknunya may ika lememar hanicha i savar lah kerav assi deamar bishtare haknaa moke matnitin bishtare delav haknaa ella i savar keabbaye deamar edav bachatumav zachin lo may ika lememar
Shemuel moke lematnitin kesheen chayyav mode
I hachi ki en bahen achraut nechasim ammay yachzir nehi dela gave min meshabede mibbene chare migbe gave
Shemuel letameh deamar shemuel omer haya rabbi meir shetar chov sheen bo achraut nechasim en gove la mimmeshabedi vela mibbene chare
Vechi meachar sheeno gove ammay yachzir amar rabbi natan bar oshaya latzor al pi tzelochito shel malve
Venahdereh lehu lelove latzor al pi tzelochito shel love love hu
b: Deamar lo hau devarim meolam

Amar rabbi elazar machloket besheen chayyav mode derabbi meir savar shetar sheen bo achraut nechasim eno gove la mimmeshabedi vela mibbene chare verabbanan savri mimmeshabedi hu dela gave mibbene chare migba gave aval keshechayyav mode divre hakkol yachzir vela chayeshinan leferaon veliknunya

Verabbi yochanan amar machloket keshechayyav mode derabbi meir savar shetar sheen bo achraut nechasim mimmeshabedi hu dela gave aval mibbene chare migba gave verabbanan savri mimmeshabede name gave aval kesheen chayyav mode divre hakkol lo yachzir dechayeshinan leferaon
Tanya keoteh derabbi yochanan utuvta derabbi elazar bachada utuvta dishmuel betarte
