Matza shitre chov veyesh bahem achraut nechasim af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze en bahen achraut nechasim bizman shehallove mode yachzir lammalve en hallove mode lo yachzir lo laze velo laze divre rabbi meir

Shehaya rabbi meir omer shetaroy sheyyesh bahem bo achraut nechasim gove minnechasim meshubadim vesheen bahem bo achraut nechasim gove minnechasim bene chorin vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze gove minnechasim meshubadim

Teuvta derabbi elazar bachada deamar lerabbi meir shetar sheen bo achraut nechasim eno gove minnechasim meshubadim velo minnechasim bene chorin vekaamar ben lerabbi meir ben lerabbanan la chayeshinan liknunya

Uvarayeta katane shetar sheen bo achraut nechasim mimmeshabedi hu dela gave ha mibbene chorin migba gave vekatane ben lerabbi meir ben lerabbanan chayeshinan liknunya dekatane af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze alma chayeshinan liknunya
Veha hane tarte hu

a: Chada hu dechad taam hu demishshum dekaamar rabbi elazar machloket besheen chayyav mode hu metaretz hachi
Teuvta dishmuel betarte chada kerabbi elazar deha moke matnitin besheen chayyav mode
Vachada deamar shemuel matza shetar haknaa bashshuk yachzir labbealim vela chayeshinan leferaon
Teuvta dekatane hacha af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze alma chayeshinan leferaon vechol shekken hacha dela mode love dechayeshinan leferaon
Amar shemuel may tamayehu derabbanan savri achraut taut sofer hu
Amar leh rava bar itay lerav idi bar avin umi amar shemuel hachi vehaamar shemuel shevach shefer veshibud tzarich limalech
Lema man deamar ha la amar ha
La kashya kan bishtar halvaa dela yahev inash zuze bichdi kan bemikkach umimkar deaved inash dezaven ara leomeh

Ki hahi daavuh bar ihi zevan illita meachateh ata baal chov tarfah mineh ata lekammeh demar shemuel amar leh ketava lach achraut amar leh la amar leh im ken zil lishlama amar leh veha mar hu deamar achraut taut sofer hu amar leh hane mile bishtare halvaa aval bishtare mikkach umimkar la daavid inash dezaven ara leomeh

Amar abbaye reuven shemmachar sade leshimon beachraut uva baal chov diruven veka taref leh mineh dina hu deazel reuven umishtae dina bahadeh vela matze amar leh lav baal devarim didi atte deamar leh demappekatte mineh alay didi hadar
Ika deamri afilu shello beachraut name deamar leh la nicha li delehve leshimon taromet alay
Veamar abbaye reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beachraut veyatzu aleha asikin ad shello hechzik bah
b: Yachol lachazor bo mishshehechzik bah eno yachol lachazor bo deamar leh chayeta dekitre sevarte vekabbelte meematay haveya chazaka mikki dayesh ammitzre
Veika deamri afilu beachraut name deamar leh achvi tirfach vaashallem lach
Itmar hammocher sade lachavero venimtzet sheenah shello rav amar yesh lo maot veyesh lo shevach ushmuel amar maot yesh lo shevach en lo

Beo mineh merav huna peresh lo et hashshevach mahu tama dishmuel mishshum dela paresh shevacha vehacha ha paresh leh o dilma tameh dishmuel kevan delet leh karka michaze keribit amar lehu in velav verafya bideh
Itmar amar rav nachman amar shemuel maot yesh lo shevach en lo af al pi shepperash lo et hashshevach may tama kevan dekarka en lo sechar meotav omed venotel
Etiveh rava lerav nachman en motziin laachilat perot velishvach karkaot velimzon haishsha vehabbanot minnechasim meshubadim mippene tikun haolam
Mimmeshabedi hu dela mappekinan ha mibbene chorin chare mappekinan vekatane miha lishvach karkaot may lav belokeach miggazlan
La bevaal chov
I bevaal chov ema resha en motziin laachilat perot vei bevaal chov baal chov mi it leh pere vehaamar shemuel baal chov gove et hashshevach shevach in aval perot la
Ella peshita begozel venigzal umidderesha begozel venigzal sefa name begozel venigzal
Mide irya ha kidita veha kidita
Veha la tane hachi leshevach karkaot ketzad hare sheggazal sade mechavero vahare hi yotza mittachat yado keshehu gove gove et hakkeren minnechasim meshubadim veshevach gove minnechasim bene chorin
Hechi dame ilema kidkatane gazlan mimman gave ella lav kegon sheggazal sade mechavero umcharah leacher vehishbichah
Amar lach lav tarotze ka metartzatte taretz name bevaal chov
Ta shema laachilat perot ketzad hare sheggazal sade mechavero vahare hi yotza mittachat yado keshehu gove gove et hakkeren minnechasim meshubadim uferot gove minnechasim bene chorin
Hechi dame ilema kidkatane gazlan mimman gave ella lav kegon sheggazal sade mechavero umcharah leacher vehishbichah

Amar rava hacha bemay askinan kegon sheggazal sade mechavero melea perot veachal et happerot vechafar bah borot shichin umarot ba nigzal ligbot keren gove minnechasim meshubadim ba nigzal ligbot perot gove minnechasim bene chorin
Rabba bar rav huna amar kegon

a: Shennetaluha massikin ba nigzal ligbot keren gove minnechasim meshubadim ba nigzal ligbot perot gove minnechasim bene chorin
Rava la amar kerabba bar rav huna hare hi yotza mittachat yado bedina mashma verabba bar rav huna la amar kerava hare hi yotza mittachat yado beena mashma

Rav ashe amar litzdadin katane kegon sheggazal sade mechavero melea perot veachal et happerot umachar et hassade ba lokeach ligbot keren gove minnechasim meshubadim ba nigzal ligbot perot gove minnechasim bene chorin
Ben lerava ben lerabba bar rav huna milva al pe hu umilva al pe eno gove minnechasim meshubadim
Hacha bemay askinan kesheamad baddin vahadar zabben
I hachi perot name kesheamad baddin al hakkeren velo amad baddin al happerot umay paska setama demilta ki tava inish karna tava beresha
Vesavar shemuel lokeach miggazlan let leh shevacha
Veha amar leh shemuel lerav chinana bar shilat immelech uchtov shufra shevacha ufere
Bemay i bevaal chov mi it leh pere vehaamar shemuel baal chov gove et hashshevach shevach in aval perot la ella lav belokeach miggazlan
Amar rav yosef hacha bemay askinan kegon sheyyesh lo karka
Amar leh abbaye vechi muttar lilot sea bisa bimkom sheyyesh lo karka
Amar leh hatam halvaa hacha zevine
Ika deamri amar rav yosef hacha bemay askinan kegon shekkanu miyyado
Amar leh abbaye vechi muttar lilot sea bisa bimkom shekkanu miyyado
Amar leh hatam halvaa vehacha zevine

Gufa amar shemuel baal chov gove et hashshevach amar rava teda shekkach kotev lo mocher lallokeach ana ekum vaashappe vaadakke vaamarek zevine ilen inun veamlehon ushvachehon veekum kodamach utzvi zavona denan vekabbel alohi
Amar leh rav chiyya bar avin lerava ella meatta mattana dela katev leh hachi hachi name dela taref shevacha amar leh in
Vechi yafe koach mattana mimmecher amar leh in yafe veyafe

Amar rav nachman ha matnita mesayya leh lemar shemuel vehuna chavrin mokem lah bemile acharine detanya hammocher sade lachavero vahare hi yotza mittachat yado keshehu gove gove et hakkeren minnechasim meshubadim veshevach gove minnechasim bene chorin
Vehuna chavrin mokem lah bemile acharine belokeach miggazlan

Tanya idach hammocher sade lachavero vehishbichah uva baal chov utrafah keshehu gove im hashshevach yoter al hayetzia notel et hashshevach mibbaal hakkarka vehayetzia mibbaal chov veim hayetzia yetera al hashshevach en lo ella hotzaa shiur shevach mibbaal chov
Veha shemuel bemay mokem lah i belokeach miggazlan kashya resha deamar shemuel lokeach miggazlan let leh shevacha i bevaal chov kashya resha vesefa deamar shemuel baal chov gove et hashshevach
Ibaet ema belokeach miggazlan kegon sheyyesh lo karka i name beshekkanu miyyado
Ibaet ema bevaal chov vela kashya kan beshevach
b: Hammaggia lakketefayim kan beshevach sheeno maggia lakketefayim
Veha maasim bechol yom veka magbe shemuel afilu beshevach hammaggia lichtefayim
La kashya ha demassek beh keshiur ara ushvacha ha dela massek beh ella keshiur ara deyahev leh shevacheh umsallek leh

Hanicha leman deamar i it leh zuze lelokeach la matze mesallek leh levaal chov shappir ella leman deamar ki it leh zuze lelokeach matze mesallek leh levaal chov nema leh ilu hava li zuze hava mesallekinach mikkullah ara hashta delet li zuze hav li geriva deara beara beha ara shiur shevachay
Hacha bemay askinan kegon sheasao appoteke daamar leh lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizzo
Hikkir bah sheenah shello ulkachah amar rav maot yesh lo shevach en lo ushmuel amar afilu maot en lo
Bemay kamipalgi rav savar adam yodea shekkarka en lo vegamar venatan leshum pikkadon venema leh leshum pikkadon savar la mekabbel
Ushmuel savar adam yodea shekkarka en lo vegamar venatan leshum mattana venema leh leshum mattana kesifa leh milta

Veha peligi bah chada zimna deitmar hamkaddesh et achoto rav amar maot chozrin ushmuel amar maot mattana rav amar maot chozrin adam yodea sheen kidushin tofsin baachoto vegamar venatan leshum pikkadon venema lah leshum pikkadon savar la mekabbela mineh
Ushmuel amar maot mattana adam yodea sheen kidushin tofsin baachoto vegamar venatan leshum mattana venema lah leshum mattana kesifa lah milta
Tzericha dei itmar beha beha kaamar rav dela avdi inashe deyahavi mattanot lenuchraa aval gabbe achoto ema mode leh lishmuel
Vei itmar behach behach kaamar shemuel aval beha ema mode leh lerav tzericha
Ben lerav deamar pikkadon ben lishmuel deamar mattana hay leara bemay ka nachet uferot hechi achel
Savar ana echot leara veebed veechol begavah ki hechi dahava ka aved ihu lechi ate mareh deara zuzay neho lerav deamar pikkadon pikkadon lishmuel deamar mattana mattana
Amar rava hilcheta yesh lo maot veyesh lo shevach veaf al pi shello peresh lo et hashshevach hikkir bah sheenah shello ulkachah maot yesh lo shevach en lo
Achraut taut sofer hu ben bishtare halvaa ben bishtare mikkach umimkar
Bea mineh shemuel merav chazar ulkachah mibbealim harishonim mahu amar leh ma machar lo rishon lashsheni kol zechut shettavo leyado
May tama mar zutra amar nicha leh dela nikreyeh gazlana rav ashe amar nicha leh deleku behemanuteh
May benayehu ika benayehu demit lokeach man deamar nicha leh dela likreyeh gazlana

a: Ha mit leh uman deamar nicha leh delekum behemanuteh bahade bene name nicha leh delekum behemanuteh
Sof sof karu leh bene lokeach gazlana
Ella ika benayehu demit gazlan man deamar nicha leh leinish dela likreuhv gazlan ha mit leh leman deamar nicha leh delekum behemanuteh hachi name af al gav demit nicha leh delekum behemanuteh
Sof sof karu livneh bene gazlana
Ella ika benayehu deyahavah bemattana man deamar nicha leh delekum behemanuteh mattana name nicha leh delekum behemanuteh man deamar nicha leh dela nikreuhv gazlana amar leh may gezali minach
Peshita zabbenah ortah veyahavah bemattana lav leokomah kamme lokeach ka bae
Nefala leh birusha yerushsha mimmela hi velav ihu ka tarach abbatrah
Gavyah ihu bechovo chazenan i it leh ara achariti vaamar hay baena leokomah kammeh lokeach ka bae
Vei la zuze hu devae ipperoe

Yahavah nihaleh bemattana peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar mattana kirushsha deha mimmela vechad amar mattana kemecher dei lav detarach veartzi kammeh la have yahev leh mattana lehachi terach veartzi kammeh ki hechi delekum behemanuteh
Vead emat nicha leh delekum behemanuteh amar rav huna ad sheat haamada baddin
Chiyya bar rav amar ad dematya adrachta lideh rav pappa amar ad dematchalin yome achrazta
Matkef lah rame bar chama mikkedi hay lokeach bemay kane lehay ara behay shetara hay shetara chaspa bealma hu
Amar leh rava tehe bemaamino behahi hanaa dela kaamar leh mide veka samech aleh tarach umayete leh gamar umakne leh
Metiv rav sheshet ma sheirash meabba machur lach ma shettaale metzudati machur lach lo amar kelum ma sheirash min abba hayyom machur lach ma shettaale metzudati hayyom machur lach devarav kayyamin
Amar rame bar chama ha gavra veha teuvta
Amar rava gavra ka chazena utuvta la ka chazena hacha samcha dateh vehacha la samcha dateh hacha samcha dateh deazel tarach umayete leh ki hechi dela nikreyeh gazlana hacha la samcha dateh
Shalchuha lekammeh derabbi abba bar zavda amar lehu zo enah tzericha lifnim amar rava zo tzericha lifnim velifnay lifnim hacha samcha dateh vehacha la samcha dateh
Hava ovada befumbedita veotveh amar lehu rav yosef zo enah tzericha lefanim vaamar leh abbaye tzericha lifnim velifnay lifnim hacha samcha dateh hacha la samcha dateh
Umay shena resha umay shena sefa amar rabbi yochanan sefa ma sheirash meabba hayyom mishshum kevod aviv ma shettaale metzudati hayyom
b: Mishshum kede chayyav
Amar rav huna amar rav haomer lachavero sade sheani lokeach lichsheekkachenna kenuya lach meachshav kana
Amar rava mistabbera millete derav besade setam aval besade zo la mi yemar dimzabben lah nihaleh
Vehaelohim amar rav afilu besade zo mikkede rav keman amrah lishmateh kerabbi meir deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam

Detanya haomer leishsha hitkaddeshi li leachar sheetgayyer leachar shettitgayeri leachar sheeshtachrer leachar shettishtachreri leachar sheyyamut balich leachar sheyyachlotz lach yevamich leachar shettamut achotich enah mekuddeshet
Rabbi meir omer mekuddeshet
Veha ishsha kesade zo damya veamar rabbi meir mekuddeshet

Amar shemuel hammotze shetar haknaa bashshuk yachziro labbealim dei mishshum dechatav lilot velo lava ha shabed nafsheh vei mishshum peraon la chayeshinan leferaon deim ita defareh mikra hava kara leh
Amar rav nachman abba min safre dayyane demar shemuel hava vahavena kevar sheta kevar sheva udchirna dahao machrezi veamri hane shetare akneyata demishtachchi beshuka nahderinhu lemarayehu
Amar rav amram af anan tenena kol maase bet din hare ze yachzir alma la chayeshinan leferaon amar leh rabbi zera matnitin bishtare chaltata veadrachta delav bene feraon ninhu
Amar rava vehane lav bene feraon ninhu veha amri nehardae shuma hadar ad teresar yarche shatta veamar ammemar ana minnehardea ana usvira li deshuma hadar leolam
Ella amar rava hatam hayenu tama daamari ihu hu deafsed annafsheh dividana defareh ibbei leh lemikreeh lishtareh i name lemichtav shetara acharina ilaveh
Demiddina ara la baaya lemehdar umishshum veasita hayyashar vehattov beene Adonai hu daamur rabbanan tehdar hilkach meresha hu deka zaven ibi leh lemichtav shetar zevine
Gabbe shetar chov may ika lememar im ita defareh ibi leh lemikreeh lishtareh emor ishtemote ka mishtemit leh deamar leh limchar yahevna lach dehashta leteh gabbay i name appeshite desafra zayer leh
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan hammotze shetar chov bashshuk af al pi shekkatuv bo henpek lo yachziro labbealim
La mibaya hecha delo katuv bo henpek deika lememar katav lilot velo lava ella afilu katuv bo henpek umay nihu dimkuyyam lo yachzir dechayeshinan leferaon
Etiveh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi avahu kol maase bet din hare ze yachzir amar leh yirmeya beri lo kol maase bet din shavim ella kegon shehuchzak kafran
Amar rava umishshum dehuchzak kafran chada zimna tu la para kelal ella amar rava matnitin bishtar chaltata veadrachta vechidrabbi zera
Vechafran hoil vaata lidan nema veh milleta deamar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman amru lo tze ten lo

a: Veamar parati neeman ba malve lichtov en kotvin venotnin lo
Chayyav atta liten lo veamar parati eno neeman ba malve lichtov kotvin venotnin lo
Rav zevid mishshemeh derav nachman amar ben tze ten lo ben chayyav atta liten lo veamar parati neeman ba malve lichtov en kotvin venotnin lo
Ella i ika lefalloge hachi hu deika lefalloge amru lo tze ten lo veamar parati vehaedim meidin oto shello perao vechazar veamar parati huchzak kafran leoto mamon
Chayyav atta liten lo veamar parati vehaedim meidin oto shello para vechazar veamar parati lo huchzak kafran leoto mamon
May tama ishtemote hu ka mishtemit mineh savar ad dimayenu bi rabbanan bedini
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mane li beyadcha vehalla omer en lecha beyadi kelum vehaedim meidim oto sheyyesh lo vechazar veamar parati huchzak kafran leoto mamon

Ki ha deshabbetay bereh derabbi marinus ketav lah lechalleteh itztela demelata bichtubbetah vekabbelah aleh irchas ketubbetah amar lah la hau devarim meolam ato sahade veamri in ketav lah lesof amar lehu peratiha ata lekammeh derabbi chiyya amar leh huchzakta kafran leotah itztela
Amar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila amar rabbi yochanan haya chayyav lachavero shevua veamar nishbati vehaedim meidin oto shello nishba vechazar veamar nishbati huchzak kafran leotah shevua

Amruha kammeh derabbi avahu amar lehu mistabbera milleta derabbi avin shennitchayyev shevua bevet din aval chiyyev atzmo shevua neeman aved inish demikkere veamar ahderuha kammeh derabbi avin amar lehu ana name bevet din amari

Itmar name amar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila amar rabbi yochanan haya chayyav lachavero shevua bevet din veamar nishbati vehaedim meidin oto shello nishba vechazar veamar nishbati huchzak kafran leotah shevua
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan hammotze shetar chov bashshuk vechatuv bo henpek vechatuv bo zemanno bo bayyom yachziro labbealim
I mishshum katav lilot velo lava ha katuv bo henpek i mishshum peraon lifria bat yoma la chayeshinan
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi mi amar rabbi yochanan hachi ha atte hu deamratte mishshemeh derabbi yochanan shetar shellava bo ufrao eno chozer velove bo shekkevar nimchal shibudo
Emat ilema limchar uloma chara may irya shekkevar nimchal shibudo tipok leh dehave leh mukdam utnan shitre chov hammukdamin pesulin
Ella lav beomeh alma pari inashe beomeh
Amar leh mi ka amena dela pari kelal dela shechichi inashe defari beomeh ka amena
Rav kahana amar keshechayyav mode i hachi may lememra

Mahu detema hay mifra pareh vehay deka amar la perateh mishshum dekavae mehdar lemezfa beh zimna achariti velifshite desafra chayesh ka mashma lan deim ken malve gufeh la shavek savar shami be rabbanan umafsedi li
May shena meha ditnan matza shitre chov im yesh bahen achraut nechasim lo yachazir
Veokimna keshechayyav mode umishshum shemma katav lilot benisan velo lava ad tishre veate lemitraf lakochot minnisan vead tishre shello kaddin
Vela amrinan deim ken malve gufeh la shavek deamar leh ketov shetara acharina betishri dedilma shami rabbanan umafsedi li

Amri hatam mishshum deit leh ravecha deka taref lakochot minnisan vead tishre menach nicha leh vela amar vela mide hacha kevan delet leh ravecha desof sof shetara haidana ketiv may ika dekataref lakochot bishtar shennimchal shibudo la shavek
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hattoen achar maase bet din
b: Lo amar kelum may tama kol maase bet din keman denaket shetara bideh dame
Amar leh rabbi chiyya bar abba lerabbi yochanan velo mishnatenu hi zo hotzia get veen immo ketubba gova ketubbatah
Amar leh i lav dedallay lach chaspa la mashkachatte marganita tutah
Amar abbaye may marganita dilma bimkom sheen kotvin ketubba askinan deget hayenu ketubbetah aval bimkom shekkotvin ketubba i nekita ketubba gavya i la la gavya
Hadar amar abbaye lav milleta hi deamri dei salka datach bimkom sheen kotvin ketubba askinan aval bimkom shekkotvin ketubba i nekita ketubba gavya i la la gavya almana min haerusin bemay gavya
Beede mitat baal liton velema peratiha vechi tema hachi name im ken ma hoilu chachamim betakkanatan
Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe vealmana min haerusin deit lah ketubba mena lan
Ilema meha ditnan nitarmela o nitgarsha ben min haerusin uven min hannisuin gova et hakkol dilma hecha dichtav lah
Vechi tema may lememra leappoke midderabbi elazar ben azarya deamar shello katav lah ella al menat lechonsah itztericha leh
Dayeka name dekatane gova et hakkol i amratte bishlama dichtav lah hayenu deka tane gove et hakkol ella i amratte dela ketav lah

a: May gova et hakkol mane umatayim hu deit lah
Veella middetane rav chiyya bar amme ishto arusa lo onen velo mittamme lah vechen hi lo onenet velo mittammea lo meta eno yorshah met hu gova ketubbatah
Dilma dichtav lah vechi tema dichtav lah may lememra meta eno yorshah itztericha leh
Ella abbaye miggufah dematnitin ka hadar beh dei salka datach bimkom sheen kotvin ketuva askinan deget hayenu ketubbetah attu get mane matayim ketiv beh
Vechi tema kevan detakkinu rabbanan lemigbe lah beh keman dichtiv beh dame liton velema parati
Vechi tema deamrinan leh i peratah ibi lach lemikreeh amar lan la shevaktan amra baena leinnesove beh
Vechi tema amrinan leh ibi lach lemikreeh umichtav aggabbeh gita denan dikranuhv la mishshum degita pesula hu ella ki hechi dela tigbe beh zimna achariti attu kol demagbe beve dina magbe
Matni matza gite nashim veshichrure avadim deyateke mattana veshovarin hare ze lo yachazir sheani omer ketuvin hau venimlach alehen shello littenan
Gema tama denimlach shello littenan ha amar tenu notnin vaafilu lizman merubbe
Urminhu hammevi get veavad hemennu metzao lealtar kasher im lav pasul
Amar rabba la kashya kan bimkom shehashsheyarot metzuot kan bimkom sheen hashshayyarot metzuot
Vaafilu bimkom shehashsheyarot metzuot vehu shehuchzeku shene yosef ben shimon beir achat
Dei la tema hachi kashya derabba adderabba dehahu gita deishtechach be dina derav huna dahava ketiv beh bishvire mata deal rachis nahara amar rav huna
b: Chayeshinan lishne shevire vaamar leh rav chisda lerabba pok ayyen bah dilurta bae minach rav huna nefak dak veashkach ditnan kol maase bet din hare ze yachazir
Veha be dina derav huna dechi mekom shehashsheyarot metzuot dame veka pashet rabba deyachzir alma i huchzeku shene yosef ben shimon in i la la
Avad rabba ovada behahu gita deishtechach be chitana defumbedita kishmateh
Ika deamri hecha dimzabbeni kitana vehu shello huchzeku af al gav dishchichan sheyarata
Veika deamri hecha detaru kitana veaf al gav dehuchzeku dela shechicha sheyarot

Rabbi zera rame matnitin abbarayeta umshanne tenan hammevi get veavad hemennu metzao lealtar kasher veim lav pasul urminhi matza get ishsha bashshuk bizman shehabbaal mode yachzir leishsha en habbaal mode lo yachzir lo laze velo laze
Katane mihat bizman shehabbaal mode yachzir laishsha vaafilu lizman merubbe
Umshanne kan bimkom shehashsheyarot metzuot vechan bimkom sheen hashsheyarot metzuot
Ika deamri vehu shehuchzeku dela nahdar vehayenu derabba ika deamri af al gav dela huchzeku la nahdar ufliga derabba
Bishlama rabba la amar kerabbi zera matnitin allima leh leakshoye ella rabbi zera may tama la amar kerabba
Amar lach mi ka tane ha amar tenu notnin vaafilu lizman merubbe dilma ha amar tenu notnin ulolam kidkayema lan lealtar
Leman deamar lerabbi zera bimkom shehashsheyarot metzuot veaf al gav shello huchzeku shene yosef ben shimon ufliga derabba bemay ka mipalgi
Rabba savar dekatane kol maase bet din hare ze yachzir deishtechach bevet din askinan uvet din kimkom shehashsheyarot metzuot vehu shehuchzeku lo yachzir lo huchzeku yachzir
Verabbi zera amar lach mi katane kol maase bet din shennimtzeu bevet din kol maase bet din yachzir katane ulolam deishtechach abbaray
Rabbi yirmeya amar kegon deka amri edim meolam lo chatamnu ella al get echad shel yosef ben shimon
I hachi may lememra mahu detema lechush dilma itremi shema kishma veedim keedim ka mashma lan
Rav ashe amar kegon deka amar nekev yesh bo betzad ot pelonit
Vedaveka betzad ot pelonit aval nekev bealma la
Rav ashe mesappeka leh simanim i deorayeta i derabbanan
Rabba bar bar chana

a: Irchas leh gita be midresha amar i simana it li begaveh i teviut ena it li begaveh ahderuh nihaleh amar la yadana i mishshum simana ahderuh nihali veka savri simanin deorayeta i mishshum teviut ena ahderuh nihali vedaveka tzurba midderabbanan aval inish dealma la
Gufa matza get ishsha bashshuk bizman shehabbaal mode yachzir leishsha en habbaal mode lo yachzir lo laze velo laze

Bizman shehabbaal mode miha yachzir laishsha velechush shemma katav liten benisan velo natan lah ad tishre vaazal baal zabben pere minnisan vead tishre umappeka legita dichtiv benisan veatya lemitraf lakochot shello kaddin
Hanicha leman deamar kevan shennatan enav legarshah shuv en labbaal perot shappir ella leman deamar yesh labbaal perot ad sheat netina may ika lememar
Ki atya lemitraf amrinan lah ayetay reaya emat meta gita leyadcha

Umay shena mishshetare chov ditnan matza shetare chov im yesh bahen achraut nechasim lo yachzir veokemna keshechayyav mode umishshum shemma katav lilot benisan velo lava ad tishre veka taref lakochot shello kaddin
Hatam name lihdar vechi ate lemitraf nema leh ayeti reaya emat meta shetar chov leyadach
Amri hacha gabbe get ishsha ate lokeach vetavao amar hay deahderuh nihalah rabbanan legita mishshum dela tiagin vetetiv hashta deka atya lemitraf tezil vetayete reaya emat meta gita lidah

Hacha gabbe shetar chov la ate lokeach vetava amar middeahderuh nihaleh rabbanan lishtar chov peshita lemay hilcheta ahderuh nihaleh lemitraf hu shema minah kamu rabbanan bemilta umikkamme didi meta shetara lideh
Shichrure avadim vechu tanu rabbanan matza shetar shichrur beshuk bizman sheharav mode yachzir laeved en harav mode lo yachzir lo laze velo laze

Bizman sheharav mode miha yachzir laeved veammay nechush shemma katav liten lo benisan velo natan lo ad tishre vaazal avda ukna nichsin minnisan vead tishre vaazal harav vezabbeninhu umappek leh leshichrur dichtiv benisan veka taref lakochot shello kaddin

Hanicha leman deamar zechut hu laeved sheyyotze mittachat rabbo lecherut uchabbaye deamar edav bachatumav zachin leh shappir ella leman deamar chov hu laeved sheyyotze mittachat rabbo lecherut may ika lememar
Dechi ate lemitraf amrinan leh ayeti reaya emat meta shichrur leyadach
Deyateke mattana vechu tanu rabbanan ezo hi deyateke da tehe lemekam velihot sheim met nechasav lifloni mattana kol shekkatuv bo mehayyom ulachar mita
Alma i ketiva mehayyom ulachar mita hu dekane vei la la kane
Amar abbaye hachi kaamar ezo hi mattenat bari shehi kemattenat shechiv mera dela kane ella leachar mita kol shekkatuv bah mehayyom ulachar mita
Tama dela amar tenu ha amar tenu notnin
Urminhu matza deyatekaot appotekaot umattanot af al pi sheshshenehem modin lo yachzir lo laze velo laze
Amar rabbi abba bar memel la kashya
b: Ha bevari veha bishchiv mera
Matnitin dekatane ha amar tenu notnin bishchiv mera devar mihdar hu
Deamrinan may ika lememar dilma katvah meikara lehay veimmelich vela yahavah nihaleh vahadar katvah leinish acharina veyahavah nihaleh hashta ka hadar beh mehahu deyahavah nihaleh
I bemattenat bari yahavah leh let leh peseda dechi nafka tarte batrayeta zache deha hadar beh mikkammayeta
I bemattenat shechiv mera name yahavah nihaleh let bah peseda devatrayeta zache deka hadar beh mikkammayeta
Ki katane bevarayeta af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze bevari delav bar mihdar hu

Deamrinan dilma katvah lehay meikara veimmelich vela yahavah leh vahadar katvah leinish acharina veyahavah leh hashta ka hadar beh mehahu deyahavah leh vesavar mihdar la matzena hadarna bi emar lehu daana lehay yahavitah venahderu nihaleh ketava ki hechi dechi mappek hay ketava dekadem zache beh hu

Ella amrinan leh anan hay ketava la yahavinan leh lehay dilma michtav ketavte mehav la yehavte nihaleh vihavtah leinish acharina veka hadratte beh i la yehavtah leinish acharina veka baet detittevah lehay ketov leh hashta ketava acharina veyahaveh nihaleh dei yahavatte leinish acharina let bah peseda dekadem zache
Matkef lah rav zevid veha ide veide deyatekaot ka tane ella amar rav zevid ha veha bishchiv mera vela kashya ha beh veha bivreh
Deka amar tenu notnin bedideh devar mihdar hu deamrinan i name yahavah leinish acharina let bah peseda dekamma uvatra batra zache deha hadar beh mikkamma
Ki ka tane bevarayeta af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze bivreh

Deamrinan dilma ketav avuh lehay veimmelich vela yahavah nihaleh uvatar avuh ketav ihu leinish acharina veyahavah leh vehashta ka hadar beh mehahu savar mihdar la matzena hadarna bi emar lehu deabba yahavah leh lehay venittevu leh ketaveh venezil venappek mineh dehu zache veniflog bahadeh
Hilkach amrinan leh anan hay ketava la yahavinan leh lehay dedilma michtav katveh avuh mehav la yahavah leh vihavteh atte leinish acharina veka hadratte beh
Ella i kushta ka amratte dihav leh avuch zil atte hashta ketov leh shetara acharina dei name la yahavah leh avuh uchtavteh atte leinish acharina let bah peseda dekamma uvatra kamma zache
Tanu rabbanan matza shovar bizman shehaishsha mode yachzir labbaal en haishsha mode lo yachzir lo laze velo laze
Bizman shehaishsha mode mihat yachzir labbaal velechush dilma katva liten benisan velo natna ad tishre vaazala zeventah lichtubbetah betovat hanaa minnisan ad tishre
Umappek leh leshovar dichtiv benisan veate lemitraf lakochot shello kaddin
Amar rava

a: Shema minah ita ledishmuel deamar shemuel hammocher shetar chov lachavero vechazar umchalo machul vaafilu yoresh mochel
Abbaye amar afilu tema letah ledishmuel hacha bemay askinan besheshshetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah verava amar i mishshum shetar ketubba chayeshinan lishte chetubbot
Veabbaye amar chada lishte chetubbot la chayeshinan veod shovar bizmanno taref abbaye letameh deamar edav bachatumav zachin lo
Matni matza igrot shum veigrot mazon shetare chalitza umeunin ushtare verurin vechol maase bet din hare ze yachzir

Matza bachafisa o vidloskama tachrich shel shetarot o agudda shel shetarot hare ze yachzir vechamma agudda shel shetarot shelosha keshurin ze baze rabban shimon ben gamliel omer echad hallove mishshelosha yachzir lallove shelosha hallovin min haechad yachzir lammalve
Matza shetar ben shetarotav veeno yodea ma tivo yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu im yesh immahen simponot yaase ma shebbassimponot
Gema may shetare verurin hacha targimu shetare taanata rabbi yirmeya amar ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad
Vechol maase bet din hare ze yachzir hahu gita deishtechach be dina derav huna dahava ketiv beh bishvire mata deal rachis nahara amar rav huna
b: Chayeshinan lishne shevire amar leh rav chisda lerabba pok ayyen dilurta bae lah rav huna minach nefak dak veashkach ditnan kol maase bet din hare ze yachzir
Amar leh rav amram lerabba hechi pashet mar isura mimmamona amar leh terada shetare chalitza umeunin tenan
Peka arza deve rav mar amar mishshum lattay didi peka umar amar mishshum lattay didi peka
Matza bachafisa o vidloskama may chafisa amar rabba bar bar chana chemet ketanna may deloskama amar rabba bar shemuel telika desave
Tachrich shel shetarot o agudda shel shetarot vechu tanu rabbanan kamma hu tachrich shel shetarot shelosha keruchin ze baze vechamma hi agudda shel shetarot shelosha keshurin ze baze
Shamatte minah kesher siman
Ha tane rabbi chiyya shelosha keruchin ze baze
I hachi hayenu tachrich tachrich kol chad vechad beresheh dechavreh agudda dirmu ahadade uchruchot
May machriz minyan
May irya telata afilu teren name
Ella kidamar ravina tiva machrez hacha name shetare machrez
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer echad hallove mishshelosha yachzir lallove vechu dei salka datach demalvin ninhu may bau gabbe hadade
Dilma lekayyominhu azli dimkayemi
Dilma mida desafra neful la meshahe inish kiyyumeh bida desafra
Shelosha shellau meechad yachzir lammalve vechu dei salka datach delovin ninhu may bau gabbe hadade
Dilma lemichtevinhu azul dichtivi bitlat yede safre
Vedilma lekayyominhu azul malve mekayyem shetareh love la mekayyem shetareh
Im yesh immahen simponot yaase ma shebbassimponot amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav simpon hayyotze mittachat yede malve af al pi shekkatuv bichtav yado eno ella kimsachek ufasul

La mibbaya katuv bichtav yad sofer deika lememar safra itremi leh uchtav ella afilu katuv bichtav yado pasul savar dilma mitreme veate ben hashshemashot veka fara li dei la yahevna leh la yahev li zuze echtov ana dechi ayetay mayete li zuzay etten leh
Tenan im yesh immahen simponot yaase ma shebbesimponot
Kidamar rav safra shennimtza ben shetarot keruin hacha name shemmetzao ben shetarot keruin
Ta shema nimtza leechad ben shetarotav shetaro shel yosef ben shimon parua shetarot shenehem peruin
Kidamar rav safra shennimtza ben shetarot keruin hacha name shennimtza ben shetarot keruin
Ta shema shevua shello pekadanu abba veshello amar lanu abba veshello matzanu ben shetarotav shel abba sheshshetar ze parua
Amar rav safra shennimtza ben shetarot keruin
Ta shema simpon sheyyesh alav edim yitkayyem bechotmav ema yitkayyem mechotmav

a: Deshayelinan lehu lesahadi i parua i la parua
Ta shema simpon sheyyesh alav edim kasher may edim ede kiyyum
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane sefa vesheen alav edim pasul may en alav edim ilema deleka illaveh edim kelal tzericha lememar defasul ella lav ede kiyyum
Gufa simpon sheyyesh alav edim yitkayyem bechotmav en alav edim veotze mittachat yede shalish o sheyyotze leachar chitum shetarot kasher
Yotze mittachat yede shalish deha hemneh malve leshalish yotze leachar chitum shetarot name dei lav difria la hava mara leh lishtareh
Hadaran alach shenayim ochazin
Matni ellu metziot shello veellu chayyav lehachriz

Ellu metziot shello matza perot mefuzzarin maot mefuzzarot kerichot birshut harabbim veiggule devela kikkarot shel nachtom machrozot shel dagim vachatichot shel basar vegize tzemer hallekuchin mimmedinatan vaanitze fishtan ulshonot shel argaman hare ellu shello divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda omer kol sheyyesh bo shinuy chayyav lehachriz ketzad matza iggul uvtocho cheres kikkar uvtocho maot
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer kol kele anpurya en chayyav lehachriz
Gema matza perot mefuzzarin vechamma amar rabbi yitzchak kav bearba ammot
Hechi dame i derech nefila afilu tuva name vei derech hinuach afilu betzir mehachi name la

Amar rav ukva bar chama bemachnashta deve dare askinan kav bearba ammot dinfish tirchayehu la tarach inish vela hadar ate veshakel lehu afkore mafkar lehu betzir mehachi tarach vehadar ate veshakel lehu vela mafkar lehu

Bae rabbi yirmeya chatzi kav bishte ammot mahu kav bearba ammot tama may mishshum dinfish tirchayehu chatzi kav bishte ammot kevan dela nefish tirchayehu la mafkar lehu o dilma mishshum dela chashivi vachatzi kav bishte ammot kevan dela chashivi mafkar lehu

Kabbayim bishmone ammot mahu kav bearba ammot tama may mishshum dinfish tirchayehu vechol shekken kabbayim bishmone ammot kevan dinfisho tirchayehu tefe mafkar lehu o dilma mishshum dela chashivi vekabbayim bishmone ammot kevan dachashivi la mafkar lehu

Kav shumshemin bearba ammot mahu kav bearba ammot tama may mishshum dela chashivi veshumshemin kevan dachashivi la mafkar lehu o dilma mishshum dinfish tirchayehu vechol shekken shumshemin kevan dinfish tirchayehu tefe mafkar lehu
Kav tamre bearba ammot kav rimmone bearba ammot mahu kav bearba ammot tama may mishshum dela chashivi kav tamre bearba ammot kav rimmone bearba ammot name kevan dela chashivi mafkar lehu
O dilma mishshum dinfisho tirchayehu vekav tamre bearba ammot vekav rimmone bearba ammot kevan dela nefish tirchayehu la mafkar lehu may teku
Itmar
b: Yeush shello middaat abbaye amar la have yeush verava amar have yeush

Bedavar sheyyesh bo siman kulle alma la peligi dela have yeush veaf al gav deshamineh demiyyaash lesof la have yeush dechi ata lideh beisura hu daata lideh dilchi yada dinfal mineh la miyyaash memar amar simana it li begaveh yahevna simana veshakelna leh
Bezuto shel yam uvishlulito shel nahar af al gav deit beh siman rachamana sharyeh kidvaenan lememar lekamman
Ki peligi bedavar sheen bo siman abbaye amar la have yeush deha la yada dinfal mineh rava amar have yeush dilchi yada dinfal mineh miyyaash memar amar simana let li begaveh mehashta hu demiyyaash
Siman
Ta shema perot mefuzzarin ha la yada dinfal mineh ha amar rav ukva bar chama hacha bemachnashta devizre deve dare askinan daaveda middaat hi

Ta shema maot mefuzzarot hare ellu shello ammay ha la yada dinfal mineh hatam name kidrabbi yitzchak deamar adam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa veshaa hacha name adam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa veshaa
Ta shema igule devela vechikkarot shel nachtom hare ellu shello ammay veha la yada dinfal mineh hatam name aggav deyakkire mida yada behu
Ta shema ulshonot shel argaman hare ellu shello veammay ha la yada dinfal mineh hatam name aggav dachashivi mashmushe memashmesh behu vechidrabbi yitzchak

Ta shema hammotze maot bevatte chenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot uvchol makom sheharabbim metzuyin sham hare ellu shello mippene shehabbealim mityaashin mehen veha la yada dinfal mineh amar rabbi yitzchak adam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa
Ta shema meematay kol adam muttarim balleket mishsheyyelchu bah hannamoshot veamrinan may namoshot veamar rabbi yochanan save deazli attigra resh lakish amar lakote batar lakote
Veammay nehi daaniyyim dehacha miyyaashi ika aniyyim beduchta achrita dela miyyaashi amri kevan deika aniyyim hacha hanach meikara iyyaoshe miyyaash veamri aniyyim dehatam melakketi leh
Ta shema ketziot badderech vaafilu betzad sede ketziot vechen teena hannota ladderech umatza teenim tachteha muttarot mishshum gazel ufturot min hammaaser bezetim uvcharuvim asur
Bishlama resha leabbaye la kashya aggav dachashivi memashmesh behu teena name mida yedia denatra
Ella sefa lerava kashya dekatane bezetim uvcharuvim asur amar rabbi avahu shane zayit hoil vechazuto mochiach alav veaf al gav denatrin zete mida yedia duchta deinish inish hu
I hachi afilu resha name amar rav pappa teena im nefilatah nimeset
Ta shema haggannav shennatal mizze venatan laze vechen gazlan shennatal mizze venatan laze

a: Vechen yarden shennatal mizze venatan laze ma shennatal natal uma shennatan natan
Bishlama gazlan veyarden deka chaze lehu umiyyaash ella gannav mi ka chaze leh demiyyaash targemah rav pappa belistim mezuyyan i hachi hayenu gazlan tere gavene gazlan

Ta shema shataf nahar korav etzav vaavanav untano betoch sede chavero hare ellu shello mippene shennityaashu habbealim tama denityaashu habbealim ha setama la hacha bemay askinan kesheyyachol lehatztzil

I hachi ema sefa im hau habbealim meraddefin acharehem chayyav lehachzir i bicholin lehatztzil may irya meraddefin afilu en meraddefin name hacha bemay askinan bicholin lehatztzil al yede haddechak meraddefin la iyyaush en meraddefin iyyaoshe miyyaash
Ta shema ketzad amru hattorem shello middaat terumato teruma hare sheyyarad letoch sede chavero veliket vetaram shello birshut im choshesh mishshum gazel en terumato teruma veim lav terumato teruma

Uminnayin hu yodea im choshesh mishshum gazel veim lav hare shebba baal habbayit umtzao veamar lo kelach etzel yafot im nimtzeu yafot mehen terumato teruma veim lav en terumato teruma liktu habbealim vehosifu alehen ben kach uven kach terumato teruma
Vechi nimtzeu yafot mehen terumato teruma ammay beidana ditram ha la hava yada targemah rava alliba deabbaye deshavveyeh shaliach
Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach dela shavveyeh shaliach mi haveya terumato teruma veha attem gam attem amar rachamana lerabbot sheluchachem ma attem ledatechem af sheluchachem ledatechem

Ella hacha bemay askinan kegon deshavveyeh shaliach vaamar leh zil terom vela amar leh terom mehane ustameh devaal habbayit ki tarem mibbenonit hu tarem vaazal ihu utram miyyafot uva baal habbayit umtzao vaamar leh kelach etzel yafot im nimtzeu yafot mehen terumato teruma veim lav en terumato teruma

Ammemar umar zutra verav ashe ikkelau levustana demari bar isak ayeti ariseh tamre verimone ushda kammayehu ammemar verav ashe achli mar zutra la achal addehachi ata mari bar isak ashkechinhu vaamar leh laariseh ammay la ayetet lehu lerabbanan mehanach shappirata

Amaru leh ammemar verav ashe lemar zutra hashta ammay la achel mar vehatanya im nimtzeu yafot mehen terumato teruma amar lehu hachi amar rava lo amru kelach etzel yafot ella leinyan teruma bilvad mishshum demitzva hu venicha leh aval hacha mishshum kesifuta hu deamar hachi
Ta shema odehu hattal alehen vesamach hare ze bechi yuttan niggevu af al pi shessamach
b: Enan bechi yuttan
Tama may lav mishshum dela amrinan kevan deigallay milta dehashta nicha leh meikara name nicha leh shane hatam dichtiv ki yitten ad sheyyitten
I hachi resha name hatam kidrav pappa derav pappa rame ketiv ki yitten vekarenan ki yuttan ha ketzad
Baenan ki yuttan dumya dechi yitten ma yitten ledaat af ki yuttan name ledaat

Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael ben yehotzadak minnayin laaveda sheshshetafah nahar shehi mutteret dichtiv vechen taase lachamoro vechen taase lesimlato vechen taase lechol avedat achicha asher tovad mimmennu umtzatah mi sheavuda hemennu umtzuya etzel kol adam yatzata zo sheavuda mimmennu veenah metzuya etzel kol adam
Veisura dumya dehetera ma hetera ben deit bah siman uven delet bah siman sharya af isura ben deit bah siman uven delet bah siman asira teuvta derava teuvta
Vehilcheta keoteh deabbaye beyaal kaggam
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe vechi meachar deitotav rava hane tamre dezika hechi achlinan lehu amar leh kevan deika shekatzim urmasim deka achli lehu meikara yaoshe meyaash minnayehu
Yatme delav bene mechila ninhu may amar leh baga beara deyatme la machzekinan
Muchzak veomed may kerachta may amar leh asiran

Kerichot birshut harabbim hare ellu shello amar rabba vaafilu bedavar sheyyesh bo siman alma kasavar rabba siman heasuy lidares la have siman rava amar lo shanu ella bedavar sheen bo siman aval bedavar sheyyesh bo siman chayyav lehachriz alma kasavar rava siman heasuy lidares have siman
Veika dematne leha shemata beanpe nafshah siman heasuy lidares rabba amar la have siman verava amar have siman

Tenan kerichot birshut harabbim hare ellu shello birshut hayyachid notel umachriz hechi dame i delet behu siman birshut hayyachid may machrez ella lav deit behu siman vekatane birshut harabbim hare ellu shello alma siman heasuy lidares la have siman teuvta derava
Amar lach rava leolam delet behu siman udka amratte birshut hayyachid may machrez machrez makom verabba amar makom la have siman deitmar makom rabba amar la have siman verava amar have siman

Ta shema kerichot birshut harabbim hare ellu shello birshut hayyachid notel umachriz vehaalummot ben birshut harabbim ben birshut hayyachid notel umachriz rabba hechi metaretz lah verava hechi metaretz lah rabba metaretz letameh besiman verava metaretz letameh bemakom
Rabba metaretz letameh besiman kerichot birshut harabbim hare ellu shello mishshum

a: Demiddarsa birshut hayyachid notel umachriz dela middarsa vehaalummot ben birshut harabbim uven birshut hayyachid notel umachriz kevan digvihan la middarsa

Verava metaretz letameh bemakom kerichot birshut harabbim hare ellu shello deminashtefa birshut hayyachid chayyav lehachriz dela minashtefa vehaalummot ben birshut harabbim uven birshut hayyachid notel umachriz kevan deyakkire la minashtefa

Ta shema kikkarot shel nachtom hare ellu shello ha shel baal habbayit chayyav lehachriz shel baal habbayit may tama kevan deit behu siman demida yedia rifta deinish inish hu vela shena reshut harabbim vela shena reshut hayyachid notel umachriz alma siman heasuy lidares have siman teuvta derabba
Amar lach rabba hatam hayenu tama mishshum deen maavirin al haochalin veha ika goyim goyim chayeshi lichshafim vehaika behema uchlavim beatra dela shechichi behema uchlavim
Lema ketannae rabbi yehuda omer kol davar sheyyesh bo shinuy chayyav lehachriz ketzad matza igul uvtocho cheres kikkar uvtocho maot mikkelal detanna kamma savar hare ellu shello
Savruha dechulle alma siman habba meelav have siman umaavirin al haochalin may lav besiman heasuy lidares ka mipalgi mar savar la have siman umar savar have siman
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava i salka datach deka savar tanna kamma siman heasuy lidares la have siman umaavirin al haochalin kikkarot shel baal habbayit birshut harabbim ammay machriz

Ella amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava dechulle alma savri siman heasuy lidares have siman umaavirin al haochalin vehacha besiman habba meelav ka mipalgi detanna kamma savar siman habba meelav la have siman verabbi yehuda savar have siman
Verabba amar lach dechulle alma siman heasuy lidares la have siman veen maavirin al haochalin vehacha besiman habba meelav kamipalgi tanna kamma savar la have siman verabbi yehuda savar have siman
Ika deamri savruha dechulle alma siman habba meelav have siman vesiman heasuy lidares la have siman may lav bemaavirin al haochalin ka mipalgi demar savar maavirin umar savar en maavirin
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava i salka datach savar tanna kamma siman heasuy lidares la have siman umaavirin al haochalin kikkarot shel baal habbayit birshut harabbim ammay machriz

Ella amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava dechulle alma savri siman heasuy lidares have siman umaavirin al haochalin vehacha besiman habba meelav ka mipalgi detanna kamma savar siman habba meelav la have siman verabbi yehuda savar have siman

Verabba amar lach dechulle alma siman heasuy lidares la have siman veen maavirin al haochalin vehacha besiman habba meelav ka mipalgi tanna kamma savar siman habba meelav la have siman verabbi yehuda savar have siman
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava kelala daavedta kevan deamar vay leh lechesron kis miyyaash leh minah

Veamar rav zevid mishshemeh derava hilcheta kerichot birshut harabbim hare ellu shello birshut hayyachid i derech nefila hare ellu shello i derech hannacha notel umachriz veze vaze bedavar sheen bo siman aval bedavar sheyyesh bo siman la shena birshut harabbim vela shena birshut hayyachid ben derech nefila uven derech hannacha chayyav lehachriz
b: Umachrozot shel dagim ammay leheve kesher siman bekitra detzayyade dechulle alma hachi mekatteri veleheve minyan siman beminyana deshavin

Beo mineh merav sheshet minyan have siman o la have siman amar lehu rav sheshet tenetuha matza kele chesef uchle nechoshet gisteron shel avar vechol kele mattachot hare ze lo yachazir ad sheyyitten ot o ad sheyechaven mishkelotav umiddemishkal have siman midda uminyan name have siman

Vachatichot shel basar vechu ammay leheve mashkela siman bemashkela deshavin veteheve chaticha gufah siman o dedafka o deatma mi la tanya matza chatichot dagim vedag nashuch chayyav lehachriz chaviyyot shel yayin veshel shemen veshel tevua veshel gerogrot veshel zetim hare ellu shello
Hacha bemay askinan bidika simana bifsaka ki ha derabba bar rav huna mechattech leh attelat karnata dayeka name dekatane dumya dedag nashuch shema minah

Amar mar chaviyyot shel yayin veshel shemen veshel tevua veshel gerogrot veshel zetim hare ellu shello veha tenan kadde yayin vechadde shemen chayyav lehachriz amar rabbi zera amar rav matnitin berashum mikkelal devarayeta befatuach i befatuach aveda middaat hi amar rav hoshaya bemetzif

Abbaye amar afilu tema ide veide berashum vela kashya kan kodem shenniftechu haotzarot kan leachar shenniftechu haotzarot ki ha derav yaakov bar abba ashkach chavita dechamra leachar shenniftechu haotzarot ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh zil shekol lenafshach

Bea mineh rav bivi merav nachman makom have siman o la have siman amar leh tenetuha matza chaviyyot shel yayin veshel shemen veshel tevua veshel gerogrot veshel zetim hare ellu shello vei salka datach demakom have siman lichroz makom amar rav zevid hacha bemay askinan berakketa denahara

Amar rav mari may tama amaru rabbanan rakketa denahara la have siman deamrinan leh ki hechi deitremi ledidach itremi name lechavrach ika deamri amar rav mari may tama amaru rabbanan makom la have siman deamrinan leh ki hechi deitremi ledidach hay mekom itremi name lechavrach hay makom

Hahu gavra deashkach kufra be maatzarta ata lekammeh derav amar leh zil shekol lenafshach chazyeh dahava ka mechassem amar leh zil pelog leh lechiyya beri mineh lema ka savar rav makom la have siman amar rabbi abba mishshum yeush bealim nagu bah dachaza dekadchi beh chilfe

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer vechu may anpurya amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kelim chadashim shello sevaatan haayin hechi dame i it behu siman ki lo sevaatan haayin may have i delet behu siman ki sevaatan haayin may have

Leolam delet behu siman nafka minah leahdore letzurba merabbanan bitviut ena sevaatan haayin kim leh begavayehu umahderinan leh ki lo sevaatan haayin la kim leh begavayehu vela mahderinan leh deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel behane telat mile avidi rabbanan dimshannu bemillayehu bemassechet uvfurya

a: Uvushpiza may nafka minah amar mar zutra leahdore leh avedta bitviut ena i yadinan beh dela meshanne ella behane telat mahderinan leh vei meshanne bemile acharine la mahderinan leh
Mar zutra chasida iggeniv leh kasa dechaspa meushpiza chazye lehahu bar be rav demashe yedeh venagev biglima dechavreh amar hayenu hay dela ichpat leh ammamona dechavreh kafteh veodi

Tanya mode rabbi shimon ben elazar bechelim chadashim shessevaatan haayin shechayyav lehachriz veellu hen kelim chadashim shello sevaatan haayin sheeno chayyav lehachriz kegon badde mechatin vetzinoriyyot umachrozot shel kardummot kol ellu sheamru ematay muttarim bizman shemmetzaan echad echad aval metzaan shenayim shenayim chayyav lehachriz
May badde soche veammay karu leh badde davar detalu beh mide bad karu leh ki hahu ditnan hatam ale echad bevad echad

Vechen haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer hammatztzil min haari umin haddov umin hannamer umin habbardelas umin zoto shel yam umishshelulito shel nahar hammotze bisratya uflatya gedola uvchol makom sheharabbim metzuyin sham hare ellu shello mippene shehabbealim mityaashin mehen
Ibaya lehu ki kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar berov goyim aval berov yisrael la o dilma afilu berov yisrael name amar
Im timtza lomar afilu berov yisrael name amar peligi rabbanan aleh o la peligi
Veim timtza lomar peligi berov yisrael vadday peligi berov goyim peligi o la peligi
Veim timtza lomar peligi afilu berov goyim halacha kemoto o en halacha kemoto
Im timtza lomar halacha kemoto daveka berov goyim o afilu berov yisrael

Ta shema hammotze maot bevatte chenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot uvchol makom sheharabbim metzuyin sham hare ellu shello mippene shehabbealim mityaashin mehen man shamatte leh deazel batar rubba rabbi shimon ben elazar shamatte minah afilu berov yisrael name
Hacha bemay askinan bimfuzzarin i bimfuzzarin may irya makom sheharabbim metzuyin sham afilu en harabbim metzuyin sham

Ella leolam bitzrurin vehacha bemay askinan bevatte chenesiyyot shel goyim batte midrashot may ika lememar batte midrashot didan deyatvi behu goyim hashta deatet lehachi batte chenesiyyot name didan deyatvi behu nachrim

Ta shema matza bah aveda im rov yisrael chayyav lehachriz im rov goyim eno chayyav lehachriz man shamatte leh deamar azlinan batar rubba rabbi shimon ben elazar shamatte minah ki kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar berov goyim aval berov yisrael la
Manni rabbanan hi tifshot minah demodu leh rabbanan lerabbi shimon ben elazar berov goyim
Ella leolam rabbi shimon ben elazar hi vaafilu berov yisrael name vehacha bemay askinan betamun i betamun may avidteh gabbeh vehatnan matza keli baashpa mechusse lo yigga bo megulle notel umachriz
Kidamar rav pappa beashpa sheenah asuya lefannot venimlach aleha lefannotah hacha name beashpa sheenah asuya lefannot venimlach aleha lefannotah
b: Veibaet ema leolam rabbanan mi katane hen shello eno chayyav lehachriz katane veyanniach veyete yisrael veyahev beh simana veshakel
Ta shema deamar rav assi matza chavit yayin beir sherubbah goyim mutteret mishshum metzia vaasura bahanaa ba yisrael venatan bah siman mutteret bishtiyya lemotzah

Keman kerabbi shimon ben elazar shema minah ki kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar berov goyim aval berov yisrael la leolam ema lach rabbi shimon ben elazar afilu berov yisrael name kaamar verav assi savar lah keoteh bachada uflig aleh bachada
Vechi meachar daasira bahanaa mutteret mishshum metzia lemay hilcheta amar rav ashe lekankannah

Hahu gavra deashkach arbaa zuze detzayeri bisdina ushdu binhar beran ata lekammeh derav yehuda amar leh zil achrez veha zoto shel yam hu shane nehar beran kevan demittekil la miyyaash veha rubba goyim ninhu shema minah en halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar afilu berov goyim shane nehar beran deyisrael sachru leh veyisrael karu leh kevan deyisrael sachru leh emor miyyisrael nefal vechevan deyisrael karu leh la miyyaash

Rav yehuda hava shakel veazel batreh demar shemuel beshuka deve dayesa amar leh matza kan arnaki mahu amar leh hare ellu shello ba yisrael venatan bah siman mahu amar leh chayyav lehachzir tarte amar leh lifnim mishshurat haddin ki ha daavuh dishmuel ashkach hanach chamare bemadbera veahderinhu lemarayehu levatar teresar yarche shatta lifnim mishshurat haddin

Rava hava shakel veazel batreh derav nachman beshuka degildae veamri lah beshuka derabbanan amar leh matza kan arnaki mahu amar leh hare ellu shello ba yisrael venatan bah siman mahu amar leh hare ellu shello vahalo omed vetzoveach naasa ketzoveach al beto shennafal veal sefinato shettava bayyam

Hahu dayyo deshakel bisra beshuka veshadyeh betzinyata deve bar mariyyon ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh zil shekol lenafshach veha rubba deyisrael ninhu shamatte minah halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar afilu berov yisrael shane dayyo dichzoto shel yam dame veha amar rav basar shennitallem min haayin asur beomed veroehu

Rabbi chanina matza gedi shachut ben teverya letzipori vehittiruhu lo amar rabbi amme hittiruhu lo mishshum metzia kerabbi shimon ben elazar mishshum shechita kerabbi chananya beno shel rabbi yose haggelili detanya hare sheavdu lo gedayav vetarnegolav halach umtzaan shechutin rabbi yehuda oser verabbi chananya beno shel rabbi yose haggelili mattir

Amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yehuda keshemmetzaan beashpa vedivre rabbi chananya beno shel rabbi yose haggelili keshemmetzaan babbayit middehittiruhu lo mishshum shechita rubba yisrael ninhu shamatte minah halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar afilu berov yisrael amar rava rov goyim verov tabbache yisrael

Rabbi amme ashkach pargiyyot shechutot ben teverya letzipori ata lekammeh derabbi assi veamri lah lekammeh derabbi yochanan veamri lah be midresha vaamaru leh zil shekol lenafshach rabbi yitzchak nappacha ashkach kibura deizle be azloye ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan veamri lah beve midresha vaamaru leh zil shekol lenafshach
Matni veellu chayyav lehachriz matza perot bichli o keli kemot shehu maot bechis o kis kemot shehu tzibbure ferot tzibbure maot

a: Shelosha matbeot ze al gav ze kerichot birshut hayyachid vechikkarot shel baal habbayit vegize tzemer hallekuchin mibbet haumman kadde yayin vechadde shemen hare ellu chayyav lehachriz

Gema tama dematza perot bichli umaot bechis ha keli ulfanav perot kis ulfanav maot hare ellu shello tenena leha detanu rabbanan matza keli ulfanav perot kis ulfanav maot hare ellu shello miktzatan bakkeli umiktzatan al gabbe karka miktzatan bakkis umiktzatan al gabbe karka chayyav lehachriz
Urminhu matza davar sheen bo siman betzad davar sheyyesh bo siman chayyav lehachriz ba baal siman venatal et shello zacha halla bedavar sheen bo siman
Amar rav zevid la kashya ha bechubba vechitana ha betzanna ufere
Rav pappa amar ha veha betzanna ufere vela kashya ha deishteyar bah mide ha dela ishteyar bah mide
Veibaet ema ha veha dela ishteyar bah mide vela kashya ha dimhadderi appeh legabbe pere ha dela mehadderi appeh legabbe pere
Veibaet ema ha veha dimhadderi appeh legabbe pere vela kashya ha deit leh ugnin letzanna ha delet leh ugnin letzanna
Tzibbure ferot vetzibbure maot shamatte minah minyan have siman teni tzibbur perot shamatte minah makom have siman teni tzibbure perot

Shelosha matbeot ze al gav ze amar rabbi yitzchak magdelaa vehu sheasuyin kemigdalin tanya name hachi matza maot mefuzzarot hare ellu shello asuyin kemigdalim chayyav lehachriz veellu hen asuyin kemigdalim shelosha matbein ze al gav ze

Ha gufah kashya amratte matza maot mefuzzarot hare ellu shello ha meshalchafi shalchofe chayyav lehachriz ema sefa asuyin kemigdalin chayyav lehachriz ha meshalchafi shalchofe hare ellu shello tana kol sheen asuyin kemigdalin mefuzzarot kare lehu

Amar rabbi chanina lo shanu ella shel shelosha melachim aval shel melech echad eno chayyav lehachriz hechi dame i daasuyin kemigdalin afilu shel melech echad name vei deen asuyin kemigdalin afilu shel shelosha melachim name la

Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar lo shanu ella shel melech echad keen shelosha melachim aval shel melech echad eno chayyav lehachriz vehechi dame daasuyin kemigdalim revicha tattaa umtzia ilaveh vezuta ilaveh metzia deamrinan annoche anchinhu aval shel melech echad dechullehu ki hadade ninhu af al gav demannechi ahadade hare ellu shello emar itremoye itremi uvahade hadade neful
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu shel melech echad name machrez may machrez minyan may irya telata afilu teren name amar ravina tiva machrez
Bae rabbi yirmeya kesher mahu keshura mahu kachatzuva mahu kesullam mahu
Peshot meha chada deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh kol sheilu machnis lahen kesam benehen venotlam bevat achat chayyav lehachriz
Bae rav ashe
b: Keavne bet kulis mahu
Ta shema detanya matza maot mefuzzarot hare ellu shello keavne bet kulis chayyav lehachriz veellu hen avne bet kulis achat mikkan veachat mikkan veachat al gabbehen

Tanu rabbanan hammotze sela beshuk umtzao chavero veamar shelli hi chadasha hi nironit hi shel melech peloni hi lo amar kelum velo od ella afilu shemo katuv aleha lo amar kelum lefi sheen siman lematbea deamar dilma appoke appekah umeinish acharina nefal
Matni matza achar haggafa o achar haggader gozalot mekushsharim o bishvilin shebbassadot hare ze lo yigga bahen matza keli baashpa im mechusse lo yigga bo im megulle notel umachriz
Gema may tama deamrinan hane inash atzneinhu vei shakel lehu let lehu lemarayehu simana begavayehu hilkach lishbekinhu ad deate marayehu veshakel lehu
Veammay leheve kesher simana amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav bimkushsharin bechanfehen dechulle alma hachi mekatteri lehu
Veleheve makom siman amar rav ukva bar chama bemiddaddin i bemiddaddin mealma atu umuttarin
Ika lememar mealma ato veika lememar inash atzneinhu vehave leh sefek hinuach veamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav kol sefek hinuach lechattechila lo yittol veim natal lo yachazir
Matza keli baashpa mechusse lo yigga bo megulle notel umachriz urminhu matza keli tamun baashpa notel umachriz shekken derech ashpa lippannot
Amar rav zevid la kashya ha bechubbe vechase ha besakkine vehemnek bechubbe vechase lo yigga besakkine vehemnek notel umachriz
Rav pappa amar ha veha bechubbe vechase vela kashya kan beashpa haasuya lippannot kan beashpa sheenah asuya lippannot
Ashpa haasuya lippannot aveda middaat hi ella beashpa sheenah asuya lippannot venimlach aleha lefannotah
Bishlama lerav pappa hayenu dekatane shekken derech ashpa lippannot ella lerav zevid may shekken derech ashpa lippannot shekken derech ashpa lefannot lah kelim ketannim

Matni matza begal uvchotel yashan hare ellu shello matza bechotel chadash mechetzo velachutz shello mechetzo velifnim shel baal habbayit im haya maskiro laacherim afilu betoch habbayit hare ellu shello
Gema tana mippene sheyyachol lomar lo shel amoriyyim hen attu emorim matznei yisrael la matznei la tzericha

a: Dishtich tefe
Bechotel chadash mechetzo velachutz shello mechetzo velifnim shel baal habbayit
Amar rav ashe sakkina batar katta vechisa batar shintzeh
Veella matnitin dekatane mechetzo velachutz shello mechetzo velifnim shel baal habbayit velechze i katta legav i katta levar i shintzeh legav i shintzeh levar matnitin beudra unsacha
Tana im haya kotel memulla mehen cholkin peshita la tzericha dimshappa bechad gisa mahu detema ishtefoche ishtefuch ka mashma lan
Im haya maskiro laacherim afilu matza betoch habbayit hare ellu shello veammay lezil batar batra
Mi la tenan maot shennimtzeu lifne sochare behema leolam maaser behar habbayit chullin
Uvirushalayim bishar yemot hashshana chullin bishat haregel hakkol maaser
Veamar rav shemaya bar zeera may tama hoil veshuke yerushalayim asuyin lehitkabbed bechol yom alma amrinan kammae kammae azalu vehane acharine ninhu hacha name kamma kamma azal vehane devatra hu
Amar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara kegon sheasao pundak lishlosha yisrael
Shema minah halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar afilu berov yisrael
Ella amar rav menashsheya bar yaakov kegon sheasao pundak lishlosha nachrim

Rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh afilu tema lishlosha yisrael may tama hahu dinfal mineh miyyaash memar amar mikkede inish acharina la hava bahaday ella hane amari kammayehu kamma zimne lahderu li vela ahdaru li vehashta lahderu i datayehu leahdorah ahderuha nihali vehay dela ahderuha li bedatayehu lemigzelah
Veazda rav nachman letameh deamar rav nachman raa sela
b: Shennafal mishshenayim chayyav lehachzir may tama hahu dinfal mineh la miyyaash memar amar mikkede inish acharina la hava bahaday ella hay naketna leh veamena leh ante hu dishkalteh
Bishlosha eno chayyav lehachzir may tama hahu dinfal mineh vadday miyyaash memar amar mikkede tere hao bahaday i naketna lehay amar la shekalteh vei naketna lehay amar la shekalteh

Amar rava hay deamratte bishlosha eno chayyav lehachzir la amaran ella delet beh shave peruta lechol chad vechad aval it beh shave peruta lechol chad vechad chayyav lehachzir may tama emor shuttafe ninhu vela miyyaashu
Ika deamri amar rava af al gav delet beh ella shave shette ferutot chayyav lehachzir may tama emor shuttafe ninhu vechad minnayehu achole achaleh limnateh gabbe chavreh

Veamar rava raa sela shennafla netalah lifne yeush al menat legozlah over bechullan mishshum lo tigzol umishshum hashev teshivem umishshum lo tuchal lehitallem veaf al gav dachazara deahderah leachar yeush mattana hu deyahev leh veisura daavad avad
Netalah lifne yeush al menat lehachzirah ulachar yeush nitkaven legozlah over mishshum hashev teshivem
Himtin lah ad shennityaashu habbealim untalah eno over ella mishshum lo tuchal lehitallem bilvad

Amar rava hay man dechaze dinful zuze mechavreh be chalata veashkecheh veshakleh la michayyav leahdore leh may tama hahu dinfal mineh miyyaash hu af al gav dechazyeh deayeti arbela veka merabbel memar amar ki hechi dinful minay didi hachi neful meinish acharina umashkachna mide
Matni matza bachanut hare ellu shello ben hatteva velachenvani shel chenvani lifne shulchani hare ellu shello ben hakkisse velashshulchani hare ellu shel shulchani
Hallokeach perot mechavero o sheshshilach lo chavero perot umatza bahen maot hare ellu shello im hau tzerurin notel umachriz
Gema amar rabbi elazar afilu munnachin al gabbe shulchan
Tenan lifne shulchani hare ellu shello ha al gabbe shulchan deshulchani ema sefa ben hakkisse velashshulchani shel shulchani ha al gabbe shulchan shello ella meha leka lemishma minah

Verabbi elazar ha mena leh amar rava matnitin keshiteh may irya detane ben hakkisse lashshulchani shel shulchani litne al shulchan i name matza bashshulchanut kidkatane resha matza bachanut shello ella shema minah afilu munnachin al gabbe shulchan hare ellu shello
Hallokeach perot mechavero vechu amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yannay lo shanu ella

a: Belokeach min hattaggar aval belokeach mibbaal habbayit chayyav lehachzir vechen tane tanna kammeh derav nachman lo shanu ella belokeach min hattaggar aval belokeach mibbaal habbayit chayyav lehachzir
Amar leh rav nachman vechi baal habbayit beatzmo dashan amar leh esmeyah amar leh la tittargam matnitin kegon sheddashan al yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim

Matni af hassimla hayeta bichlal kol ellu velamma yatzat lehakkish eleha lomar lecha ma simla meuchedet sheyyesh bah simanin veyesh lah tovin af kol davar sheyyesh bo simanin veyesh lo tovim chayyav lehachriz
Gema may bichlal kol ellu amar rava bichlal kol avedat achicha
Amar rava lema li dichtav rachamana shor chamor se vesimla

Tzerichi dei ketav rachamana simla hava amena hane mile beedim degufah vesimanin degufah aval chamor beedim deukkaf vesimanin deukkaf ema la mahderinan leh ketav rachamana chamor daafilu chamor besimane haukkaf
Shor vase dichtav rachamana lema li shor daafilu legizat zenavo vese legizotav velichtov rachamana shor daafilu legizat zenavo vechol shekken se legizotav
Ella amar rava chamor devor lerabbi yehuda vese daaveda ledivre hakkol kashya
Veema liglalim hu daata gelalim afkore mafkar lehu vedilma lesimanin hu daata deibaya lan simanin deorayeta o derabbanan ketav rachamana se daafilu besimanin mahderinan vesimanin deorayeta

Amri middekatane lehu tanna lesimanin gabbe simla dekatane ma simla meuchedet sheyyesh bah simanin veyesh lah tovin chayyav lehachriz af kol davar sheyyesh bo simanin veyesh lo tovin chayyav lehachriz shema minah dese lav lesimanin hu daata
Tanu rabbanan asher tovad perat laaveda sheen bah shave peruta rabbi yehuda omer umtzatah perat laaveda sheen bah shave peruta
May benayehu amar abbaye mashmaut dorshin ika benayehu mar nafka leh measher tovad umar nafka leh miumtzatah
Ulman denafka leh measher tovad hay umtzatah may aved leh
Hahu mibe leh lechidravnay deamar ravnay umtzatah daatay lideh mashma
Ulman denafka leh miumtzatah hay asher tovad may aved leh

Mibbee leh lechidrabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay minnayin laaveda sheshshetafah nahar shehi mutteret shenneemar ken taase lechol avedat achicha asher tovad mimmennu umtzatah mi sheavuda hemennu umtzuya etzel kol adam yatzta zo sheavuda hemennu veenah metzuya etzel kol adam
Veidach ha deravnay mena leh nafka leh miumtzatah
Veidach ha derabbi yochanan mena leh nafka leh mimmennu veidach mimmennu la mashma leh
Rava amar peruta shehuzla ika benayehu man deamar measher tovad ika uman deamar miumtzatah leka
Ulman deamar asher tovad ha baenan umtzatah veleka
Ella peruta shehukra ika benayehu man deamar umtzatah ika uman deamar asher tovad leka
Ulman deamar umtzatah ha baenan asher tovad veleka
Ella peruta shehukra vehuzla vechazra vehukra ika benayehu man deamar asher tovad ika uman deamar umtzatah baenan deit bah shiur metzia mishsheat aveda vead sheat metzia
Ibaya lehu simanin deorayeta o derabbanan may nafka minah
b: Leahdore get ishsha besimanim i amratte deorayeta mahderinan vei amratte derabbanan ki avud rabbanan takkanta bemamona aval beisura la avud rabbanan takkanta

Ta shema af hassimla hayeta bichlal kol ellu velamma yatzat lehakkish eleha velomar lecha ma simla meuchedet sheyyesh lah simanin veyesh lah tovin chayyav lehachriz af kol davar sheyyesh lo simanin veyesh lo tovin chayyav lehachriz tanna tovin itztericha leh simanin kedi nasvah
Ta shema chamor besimane ukkaf ema beede ukkaf
Ta shema vehaya immecha ad derosh achicha oto vechi taale al datecha sheyyittenennu lo kodem sheyyidreshennu ella dorshehu im rammay hu o eno rammay
May lav besimanin lo beedim
Ta shema en meidin ella al partzuf happanim im hachotem af al pi sheyyesh simanin begufo uvchelav
Shema minah simanin lav deorayeta amri gufo dearoch vegutz kelav dechayeshinan lishela
I chayeshinan lishela chamor besimane ukkaf hechi mahderinan amri ukkaf la shayeli inashe ukkafa mishshum dimsakkev leh lachamara
Ibaet ema kelav bechivare uvsumki
Ella ha detanya metzao kashur bechis o bearnaki uvtabbaat o shemmetzao ben kelav afilu lizman merubbe kasher vei salka datach chayeshinan lishela ki metzao kashur bechis ammay kasher nechush lishela
Amri kis vearnaki vetabbaat la mashali inashe kis vearnaki mishshum dimsammeni vetabbaat mishshum dimzayyef
Lema chetannae en meidin al hashshuma veelazar ben mahavay omer meidin al hashshuma may lav beha kamipalgi detanna kamma savar simanin derabbanan veelazar ben mahavay savar simanin deorayeta
Amar rava dechulle alma simanin deorayeta vehacha beshuma metzuya beven gilo kamipalgi mar savar shuma metzuya beven gilo umar savar shuma enah metzuya beven gilo

Ibaet ema dechulle alma shuma enah metzuya beven gilo vehacha besimanin haasuyin lehishtannot leachar mita kamipalgi mar savar simanin asuyim lehishtannot leachar mita umar savar simanin en asuyim lehishtannot leachar mita
Ibaet ema dechulle alma shuma enah asuya lehishtannot leachar mita vesimanin derabbanan vehacha beshuma siman muvhak hu kamipalgi mar savar shuma siman muvhak hu umar savar shuma lav siman muvhak hu
Amar rava im timtze lomar simanin lav deorayeta hechi mahderinan avedta besimanin denicha leh lemotze aveda denahdar besimanin ki hechi dechi avda leh ledideh name nahderu leh besimanin
Amar leh rav safra lerava vechi adam ose tova leatzmo bemamon sheeno shello
Ella nicha leh levaal aveda lemehav simanin ulmishkeleh mida yada deedim let leh umemar amar kulle alma la yadi simanin muvhakim didah vaana yahevna simanin muvhakim didah veshakelna lah
Ella ha ditnan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer echad hallove mishshelosha yachzir lallove shelosha shellau min haechad yachzir lammalve nicha leh lelove leahdore leh lemalve

Amar leh hatam sevara hu echad hallove mishshelosha yachzir lallove degabbe love shechichi gabbe malve la shechichi shema minah millove neful shelosha shellau meechad yachzir lammalve degabbe malve shechichi gabbe love la shechichi
