Lema li lemichtav hane tarte ulma li lemichtav aveda tzerichi dei ketav rachamana hane tarte mishshum detzaara demarah ita tzaara didah ita aval aveda detzaara demarah ita vetzaara didah leta ema la vei ashmeinan aveda mishshum delete lemarah bahadah
b: Aval hane tarte deite lemarah bahadah ema la tzericha

Mot yumat hammakke en li ella bemita hakketuva bo minnayin sheim i atta yachol lahamito bemita hakketuva bo sheatta rashshay lahamito bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito talmud lomar mot yumat mikkol makom

Hakke takke en li ella behakkaa hakketuva bahen minnayin sheim i atta yachol lahamitan behakkaa hakketuva bahen sheatta rashshay lehakkotan bechol hakkaa sheatta yachol talmud lomar hakke takke mikkol makom
Hashev tashiv en li ella shemmishkeno birshut bet din mishkeno shello birshut bet din minnayin talmud lomar hashev tashiv mikkol makom
Chavol tachbol en li ella shemmishkeno birshut mishkeno shello birshut minnayin talmud lomar chavol tachbol mikkol makom
Vehane tere kerae lema li chad lichsut yom vechad lichsut layela
Patoach tiftach en li ella laaniyye irecha laaniyye ir acheret minnayin talmud lomar patoach tiftach mikkol makom
Naton titten en li ella mattana merubba mattana muetet minnayin talmud lomar naton titten mikkol makom
Haanek taanik en li ella shennitbarech habbayit biglalo maanikin lo nitbarech habbayit biglalo minnayin talmud lomar haanek taanik mikkol makom
Ulrabbi elazar ben azarya deamar nitbarech habbayit biglalo maanikin lo lo nitbarech habbayit biglalo en maanikin taanik lema li dibbera tora kilshon bene adam
Haavet taavitennu en li ella sheen lo veeno rotze lehitparnes amar rachamana ten lo derech halvaa yesh lo veeno rotze lehitparnes minnayin talmud lomar taavitennu mikkol makom
Ulrabbi shimon deamar yesh lo veeno rotze lehitparnes en nizkakin lo taavitennu lema li dibbera tora kilshon bene adam
Haya batel min hassela lo yomar lo ten li sela ella noten lo secharo kefoel batel tenan noten lo secharo kefoel batel
May kefoel batel amar abbaye kefoel batel shel otah melacha divtal minah

Im yesh sham bet din matne bifnehem isur verav safra avud iska bahade hadade azal rav safra pelag leh bela dateh deisur beappe be tere ata lekammeh derabba bar rav huna amar leh zil ayeti telata diflagte kammayehu i name

a: Tere miggo telata vei name tere sahadi diflagte beappe be telata
Amar leh mena lach ha amar leh ditnan im yesh sham bet din matne bifnehem en sham bet din bifne mi yatne shello kodem
Amar leh mi dame hatam demappek mamona mehay umotev lehay baenan bet din aval hacha didi shekali giluy milta bealma hu bitre saggi leh tidda ditnan almana mocheret shello bifne bet din
Amar leh abbaye velav mi ittemar alah amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman almana enah tzericha bet din shel mumchin aval tzericha bet din shel hedotot
Matni metzaah barefet en chayyav bah birshut harabbim chayyav bah veim hayeta bevet hakkevarot lo yittamme lah im amar lo aviv hitamme o sheamar lo al tachzir lo yishma lo
Parak vetaan parak vetaan afilu arbaa vachamisha peamim chayyav shenneemar azov taazov
Halach veyashav lo veamar hoil vealecha mitzva im retzoncha lifrok perok patur shenneemar immo im haya zaken o chole chayyav
Mitzva min hattora lifrok aval lo liton rabbi shimon omer af liton
Rabbi yose haggelili omer im haya alav yater al massao en zakuk lo shenneemar tachat massao massooy sheyyachol laamod bo
Gema amar rava refet sheamru enah mata veenah meshammeret enah mata middekatane eno chayyav bah veenah meshammeret middeitzterich lemitne eno chayyav bah
Dei salka datach meshammeret hashta mashkach lah abbaray meayyel lah legavay mashkach lah miggavay mibbaya ella shema minah enah meshammeret shema minah
Metzaah barefet eno chayyav amar rabbi yitzchak vehu sheomedet toch lattechum mikkelal devirshut harabbim vaafilu betoch hattechum name chayyav
Ika dematne lah assefa birshut harabbim chayyav bah amar rabbi yitzchak vehu sheomedet chutz lattechum mikkelal devarefet afilu omedet chutz lattechum name eno chayyav bah

Bevet hakkevarot lo yittamme lah tanu rabbanan minnayin sheim amar lo aviv hitamme o sheamar lo al tachzir shello yishma lo shenneemar ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru ani Adonai kullechem chayyavin bichvodi
Tama dichtav rachamana et shabbetotay tishmoru ha lav hachi hava amena tzayeta netzit leh veammay hay ase vehay lo taase vaase vela ate ase vedache et lo taase vaase

Itzterich salka datach amena hoil vehukkash kibud av vaem lichvodo shel makom shenneemar kan kabbed et avicha veet immecha veneemar lehallan kabbed et Adonai mehonecha hilkach letziyt leh ka mashma lan dela lishma leh
Mitzva min hattora lifrok aval lo liton may aval lo liton ilema aval lo liton kelal may shena perika dichtiv azov taazov immo teina name hachtiv hakem takim immo

Ella mitzva min hattora lifrok bechinnam velo liton bechinnam ella besachar rabbi shimon omer af liton bechinnam tenena leha detanu rabbanan perika bechinnam teina besachar rabbi shimon omer zo vazo bechinnam

May tamayehu derabbanan dei salka datach kerabbi shimon lichtov rachamana teina vela bae perika vaana amena uma teina delet bah tzaar baale chayyim veleka chesron kis chayyav perika deit bah tzaar baale chayyim vechesron kis lo kol shekken ella lemay hilcheta katveh rachamana lomar lach perika bechinnam teina besachar
Verabbi shimon may tama mishshum dela mesayemi kerae
Verabbanan ammay la mesayemi kerae hacha ketiv rovetz tachat massao hatam ketiv noflin badderech dirmu inhu utunayehu beorcha mashma verabbi shimon noflin badderech inhu utunayehu illavayehu mashma
Amar rava
b: Middivre shenehem nilmad tzaar baale chayyim deorayeta vaafilu rabbi shimon la kaamar ella mishshum dela mesayemi kerae aval mesayemi kerae darshinan kal vachomer mishshum may lav mishshum tzaar baale chayyim darshinan
Dilma mishshum deika chesron kis vehachi kaamar uma teina delet bah chesron kis chayyav perika deit bah chesron kis lo kol shekken
Utina en bah chesron kis mi la askinan deaddehachi vehachi batel mishshukeh i name atu gannave veshakli kol ma deika bahadeh

Teda detzaar baale chayyim deorayeta dekatane sefa rabbi yose haggelili omer im haya alav yater al massao en zakuk lo shenneemar tachat massao massooy sheyyachol laamod bo lav mikkelal detanna kamma savar zakuk lo may tama lav mishshum detzaar baale chayyim deorayeta
Dilma betachat massao peligi derabbi yose savar darshinan tachat massao massooy sheyyachol laamod bo verabbanan savri la darshinan tachat massao

Teda detzaar baale chayyim lav deorayeta dekatane resha halach veyashav lo veamar lo hoil vealecha mitzva lifrok perok patur shenneemar immo vei salka datach tzaar baale chayyim deorayeta ma li iteh lemareh bahadeh uma li ki leteh lemareh bahadeh

Leolam tzaar baale chayyim deorayeta mi savratte patur patur ligmare vedilma patur bechinnam vechayyav besachar vehachi kaamar rachamana ki iteh lemareh bahadeh aved gabbeh bechinnam vechi leteh lemareh bahadeh aved gabbeh besachar ulolam tzaar baale chayyim deorayeta
Siman behemat behemat ohev sone ravtzan

Lema mesayya leh behemat goy mittappel bah kevehemat yisrael i amratte bishlama tzaar baale chayyim deorayeta mishshum hachi mittappel bah kevehemat yisrael ella i amratte tzaar baale chayyim lav deorayeta ammay mittappel bah kevehemat yisrael hatam mishshum eva

Hachi name mistabbera dekatane im hayeta teuna yen nesech en zakuk lah i amratte bishlama lav deorayeta mishshum hachi en zakuk lah ella i amratte deorayeta ammay en zakuk lah hachi kaamar ulhatinah yen nesech en zakuk lah
Ta shema behemat goy umassooy yisrael vechadalta vei amratte tzaar baale chayyim deorayeta ammay vechadalta azov taazov mibbee leh leolam tzaar baale chayyim deorayeta hatam bitina
I hachi ema sefa behemat yisrael umassooy goy azov taazov vei bitina ammay azov taazov mishshum tzaara deyisrael
I hachi afilu resha name resha bechammar goy sefa bechammar yisrael may paskatte setama demilleta inish batar chamareh azel
Veha vechadalta veazov taazov bifrika hu dichtivi
Amar leh ha manni rabbi yose haggelili hi deamar tzaar baale chayyim lav deorayeta
Ta shema ohev lifrok vesone liton mitzva besone kede lachof et yitzro vei salka datach tzaar baale chayyim deorayeta ha adif leh afilu hachi kede lachof et yitzro adif
Ta shema sone sheamru sone yisrael velo sone ummot haolam i amratte tzaar baale chayyim deorayeta ma li sone yisrael uma li sone ummot haolam
Mi savratte assone dikra kae assone dematnitin kae
Ta shema

a: Rovetz velo ravtzan rovetz velo omed tachat massao velo meforak tachat massao massooy sheyyachol laamod bo vei amratte tzaar baale chayyim deorayeta ma li rovetz uma li ravtzan uma li omed
Ha manni rabbi yose haggelili hi deamar tzaar baale chayyim derabbanan
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane tachat massao massooy sheyyachol laamod bo man shamatte leh deit leh hay sevara rabbi yose haggelili shema minah

Umi matzet mokmatte lah kerabbi yose haggelili veha katane sefa tachat massao velo meforak may lo meforak ilema lo meforak kelal ha ketiv hakem takim immo ella peshita lo meforak bechinnam ella besachar man shamatte leh deit leh hay sevara rabbanan leolam rabbi yose haggelili hi uvitina savar lah kerabbanan

Tanu rabbanan ki tire yachol afilu merachok talmud lomar ki tifga i ki tifga yachol pegia mammash talmud lomar ki tire veezo hi reiyya sheyyesh bah pegia shiaru chachamim echad mishsheva umechetza bemil veze hu ris
Tana umiddadde immo ad parsa amar rabba bar bar chana venotel sachar
Matni avedato vaavedat aviv avedato kodemet avedato vaavedat rabbo shello kodem
Avedat aviv vaavedat rabbo shel rabbo kodemet sheaviv hevio laolam hazze verabbo shellimmedo chochma mevio lechayye haolam habba veim aviv chacham shel aviv kodemet

Haya aviv verabbo nosin massooy manniach et shel rabbo veachar kach manniach et shel aviv haya aviv verabbo bevet hashshevi pode et rabbo veachar kach pode et aviv veim aviv chacham pode et aviv veachar kach pode et rabbo
Gema mena hane mile amar rav yehuda amar rav amar kera efes ki lo yihye becha evon shellecha kodem leshel kol adam
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav kol hamkayyem beatzmo kach sof ba lide kach

Haya aviv verabbo nosin massooy vechu tanu rabbanan rabbo sheamru rabbo shellimmedo chochma velo rabbo shellimmedo mikra umishna divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer kol sherov chochmato hemennu rabbi yose omer afilu lo heir enav ella bemishna achat ze hu rabbo
Amar rava kegon rav sechora deasberan zuhama listeron shemuel kera maneh aleh hahu merabbanan deasbereh echad yored leammat hashshechi veechad poteach kevan
Amar ulla talmide chachamim shebbevavel omdin ze mippene ze vekorin ze al ze ulinyan aveda bimkom aviv enan chozrin ella lerabbo muvhak

Kavae mineh rav chisda merav huna talmid vetzarich lo rabbo may amar leh chisda chisda la tzerichna lach atte tzerichatte li ad arbein shenin ikfadu ahadade vela ayeli legabbe hadade yetev rav chisda arbein taaniyyata mishshum dachalash dateh derav huna yatev rav huna arbein taaniyyata mishshum dechashdeh lerav chisda
Itmar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yehuda rav acha bar rav huna amar rav sheshet halacha kerabbi yose
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna utnan rabbo shellimmedo chochma may chochma rov chochmato
Tanu rabbanan haoskin bemikra midda veenah midda bammishna midda venotlin aleha sachar battalmud en lach midda gedola mizzo ulolam heve ratz lammishna yoter min hattalmud
Ha gufa kashya amratte battalmud en lecha midda gedola mizzo vahadar amratte ulolam heve ratz lammishna yoter min hattalmud amar rabbi yochanan
b: Bime rabbi nishnet mishna zo shevaku kulle alma matnitin vaazalu batar talmuda hadar derash lehu ulolam heve ratz lammishna yoter min hattalmud
May derush kiddaresh rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay may dichtiv hagged leammi pisham ulvet yaakov chattotam

Hagged leammi pisham ellu talmide chachamim sheshshegagot naasot lahem kizdonot ulvet yaakov chattotam ellu amme haaretz shezzedonot naasot lahem kishgagot vehayenu ditnan rabbi yehuda omer heve zahir battalmud sheshshiggat talmud ola zadon
Daresh rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay may dichtiv shimu devar Adonai hacharedim el devaro ellu talmide chachamim amru achechem ellu baale mikra sonechem ellu baale mishna menaddechem ellu amme haaretz
Shemma tomar pasak sivram uvatal sikuyam talmud lomar venire besimchatchem shemma tomar yisrael yevoshu talmud lomar vehem yevoshu ummot haolam yevoshu veyisrael yismachu
Hadaran alach ellu metziot
Matni hammafkid etzel chavero behema o chelim venignevu o sheavdu shilem velo ratza lishava shehare amru shomer chinnam nishba veotze
Nimtza haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha lemi meshallem lemi shehappikkadon etzlo
Nishba velo ratza leshallem nimtza haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha lemi meshallem levaal happikkadon
Gema lema leh lemitne behema ulma leh lemitne kelim
Tzerichi dei tena behema hava amena behema hu demakne leh kefela mishshum dinfish tirchah leayyolah ulappokah aval kelim dela nefish tirchayehu ema la makne leh kefela
Vei tena kelim hava amena kelim hu dekamakne leh kefela mishshum dela nefish kefelayehu aval behema dechi tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha ema la makne leh kefela tzericha
Matkef lah rame bar chama veha en adam makne davar shello ba laolam vaafilu lerabbi meir deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam hane mile kegon perot dekel daavidi deatu
Aval hacha

a: Mi yemar demigganva veim timtze lomar demigganva mi yemar demishtechach gannav vei mishtechach gannav mi yemar dimshallem dilma mode umippetar amar rava naasa keomer lo lichshettigganev vetirtze utshallemeni hare parati kenuya lecha meachshav
Matkef lah rabbi zera i hachi afilu gizoteha uvaldoteha name allema tanya chutz miggizoteha uvaldoteha ella amar rabbi zera naasa keomer lo chutz miggizoteha uvaldoteha
Umay pesaka setama demilleta shevacha deate mealma avid inish demakne shevacha demiggufah la avid inish demakne
Ika deamri amar rava naasa keomer lo lichshettigganev vetirtze utshallemeni samuch lignevatah kenuya lach may benayehu
Ika benayehu kushya derabbi zera i name dekayema baagam
Shilem velo ratza lishava vechu amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lo shilem shilem mammash ella kevan sheamar hareni meshallem af al pi shello shilem
Tenan shilem velo ratza lishava shilem in lo shilem la ema sefa nishba velo ratza leshallem tama delo ratza ha ratza af al pi shello shilem ella meha leka lemishma minah
Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan hassocher para mechavero venigneva veamar halla hareni meshallem veeni nishba veachar kach nimtza haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel lassocher
Amar rav pappa shomer chinnam kevan sheamar pashati makne leh kefela dei bae patar nafsheh bigneva shomer sachar kevan sheamar nigneva makne leh kefela dei bae patar nafsheh bishvura umeta
Shoel sheomer hareni meshallem la makne leh kefela bemay hava leh lemiftar nafsheh bemeta mechamat melacha meta mechamat melacha la shechiach

Ika deamri amar rav pappa shoel name kevan sheamar hareni meshallem makne leh kefela dei bae patar nafsheh bemeta mechamat melacha amar leh rav zevid hachi amar abbaye shoel ad sheyeshallem may tama hoil vechol hanaa shello bedibura la makne leh kefela
Tanya keoteh derav zevid hashshoel para mechavero venigneva vekidem hashshoel veshilem veachar kach nimtza haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel lashshoel
Lelishana kamma derav pappa vadday la haveya teuvta lelishana batra lema tehve teuvteh
Amar lecha rav pappa mi allima mimmatnitin dekatane shilem veokemna beamar hacha name beamar
Mi dame hatam la katane kidem hacha katane kidem may kidem kidem veamar
Ha middekatane gabbe socher veamar vegabbe shoel kidem shema minah daveka katane mide gabbe hadade tanya
Shayelinhu letannae deve rabbi chiyya udve rabbi oshaya veamri gabbe hadade tanyan
Peshita amar eni meshallem vechazar veamar hareni meshallem ha kaamar hareni meshallem ella amar hareni meshallem
b: Vechazar veamar eni meshallem may mi amrinan mihdar ka hadar beh o dilma bemilleteh kae vedachoye hu deka medache leh
Amar hareni meshallem vamet veamru banav en anu meshallemin may mi amrinan mihdar ka hadri behu o dilma bemilleta daavuhon kayemi vedachoye hu deka medachu leh
Shillemu banim may matze amar lehu ki aknay kefela laavuchon daavad li neyach nafshay ledidchu la o dilma la shena
Shilem levanim may matzu amri leh ki akni lach avuna kefela daavadte leh neyach nafsheh aval anan ledidan la o dilma la shena shillemu banim levanim may

Shilem mechetza may shaal shette parot veshilem achat mehen may shaal min hashshuttafin veshilem leechad mehen may shuttafin sheshshaalu veshilem echad mehen may shaal min haishsha veshilem levalah may ishsha sheshshaala veshilem baalah may teku
Amar rav huna mashbiin oto shevua sheenah birshuto may tama chayeshinan shemma enav natan bah
Metivi hammalve et chavero al hammashkon veavad hammashkon veamar lo sela hilviticha alav shekel haya shave vehalla omer lo ki ella sela hilvitani alav sela haya shave patur
Sela hilviticha alav shekel haya shave vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilvitani alav shelosha dinarim haya shave chayyav
Sela hilvitani alav shenayim haya shave vehalla omer lo ki ella sela hilviticha alav sela haya shave patur
Sela hilvitani alav shenayim haya shave vehalla omer lo ki ella sela hilviticha alav chamishsha dinarim haya shave chayyav
Mi nishba mi shehappikkadon etzlo shemma yishshava ze veotzi halla et happikkadon
Aheya ilema assefa vetipok leh dishvua gabbe malve hi deha ka mode miktzat hattaana ella amar shemuel aresha

May aresha assefa deresha sela hilviticha alav shekel haya shave vehallah omer lo ki ella sela hilvitani alav shelosha dinarin haya shave chayyav dishvua gabbe love hu vaamur rabbanan lishteva malve shemma yishshava ze veotzi halla et happikkadon
Veim

a: Ita lidrav huna kevan demishteva milve sheenah birshuto hechi matze mappek lah amar rava sheyyesh edim shennisrefa
I hachi mehecha mayete lah ella amar rav yosef sheyyesh edim shennigneva sof sof mehecha mayete lah detarach umayete lah
I hachi ki mishteva malve name litrach love velayete bishlama malve yada man ka ayel venafek beveteh veazel vetarach umayete lah ella love mi yada man ayel venafek beveteh demalve

Abbaye omer gezera shemma yiton veyomar lo achar shevua metzatiha rav ashe amar ze nishba veze nishba ze nishba sheenah birshuto veze nishba kamma haya shave vehachi kaamar mi nishba techila malve nishba techila shemma yishshava ze veotzi halla et happikkadon

Rav huna bar tachlifa mishshemeh derava amar resha desefa teuvta lerav huna sela hilvitani alav shettayim haya shave vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilviticha alav sela haya shave patur veim ita lidrav huna miggo demishteva malve sheenah birshuto lishteva name aggilgul shevua kamma haya shave
Amar rav ashe amritah lishmata kammeh derav kahana veamar li tehe bemaamino unhemneh love lemalve name beha kamma hava shave la kim leh begaveh unhemneh malve lelove dekim leh begaveh la meheman leh
Umay shena love dimheman leh lemalve umay shena malve dela meheman leh lelove love mekayyem beh bemalve tummat yesharim tanchem malve mekayyem beh belove veselef bogdim yeshaddem

Hahu gavra deafked kipe gabbe chavreh amar leh hav li kipay amar leh la yadana hecha otvitinhu ata lekammeh derav nachman amar leh kol la yadana peshiuta hi zil shallem la shalem azal rav nachman aggabbeyeh leappadneh mineh lesof ishtechuch kipe veiyyakkur amar rav nachman hadri kipe lemarayehu vehadra appadna lemarah
Amar rava hava yatevna kammeh derav nachman ufirkin hammafkid hava vaamari leh shilem velo ratza lishava vela ahdar li
Veshappir avad dela ahdar li may tama hatam la atrecheh leve dina hacha atrecheh leve dina
Lememra desavar rav nachman deshuma hadar shane hatam deshuma betaut hava deka deha hava kipe meikara
Amri nehardae shuma hadar ad teresar yarche shatta veamar ammemar ana minnehardea ana usvira li shuma hadar leolam vehilcheta shuma hadar leolam mishshum shenneemar veasita hayyashar vehattov

Peshita shamu leh levaal chov vaazal ihu veshamah levaal chov dideh amrinan leh la adif atte miggavra daatet mineh zabbenah orta veyahavah bemattana vadday hane meikara addata deara nechut velav addata dezuze nechut
Shamu lah leishsha veinsiva o shamu minah deishsha veinsiva umeta baal benichse ishto lokeach have la mahdar vela mahderinan leh
Deamar rabbi yose bar chanina beusha hitkinu haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah vameta habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot
b: Agbeyeh ihu bechovo peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar hadra vechad amar la hadra
Man deamar la hadra savar hay zevine mealleya hi deha middata denafsheh agbeyeh uman deamar hadra savar la zevine mealleya hu vehay deagbeyeh middateh vela ata ledina mechamat kisufa hu deagbeyeh
Umeemat achel pere rabba amar mikki matya adrachta lideh abbaye amar edav bachatumav zachin lo
Rava amar mikki shelimu yeme achrazta

Matni hassocher para mechavero vehishilah leacher umeta kedarkah yishshava hassocher shemmeta kedarkah vehashshoel yeshallem lassocher amar rabbi yose ketzad halla ose sechora befarato shel chavero ella tachzor para labbealim
Gema amar leh rav idi bar avin leabbaye mikkede socher bemay kane lehay para bishvua

Venema leh maskir lesocher dal ante vedal shevuatach vaana mishtaena dina bahade shoel amar leh mi savratte socher bishvua hu deka kane lah mishsheat mita hu dekane ushvua kede lehafis dato shel baal habbayit

Amar rabbi zera peamim shehabbealim meshallemin kamma parot lassocher hechi dame agrah mineh mea yome vahadar shayelah mineh tishin yome hadar agrah mineh temanan yome vahadar shayelah mineh shivin yome umeta betoch yeme sheelatah deakkol sheela ushela michayyav chada para
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina mikkedi chada para hi ayelah veappekah appekah missechirut veayelah lishela appekah mishsheela veayelah lischirut amar leh umi itah lefara beena denema leh hachi

Mar bar rav ashe amar en lo alehen ella shette parot chada dishela vachada dischirut shum sheela achat hi veshum sechirut achat hi dishela kane ligmare dischirut aved bah yeme sechiruteh umahdar lah lemarah
Amar rabbi yirmeya peamim sheshshenehem bechattat

a: Peamim sheshshenehem beasham peamim shehassocher bechattat vehashshoel beasham peamim shehassocher beasham vehashshoel bechattat
Ha ketzad kefirat mamon asham bituy sefatayim chattat
Peamim sheshshenehem bechattat kegon shemmeta kedarkah veamru neensa socher deven kach uven kach miptar patur bechattat shoel deven kach uven kach chayyove michayyav bechattat
Peamim sheshshenehem beasham kegon shennigneva veamru meta mechamat melacha detarvayehu ka chafri mamona deha michayevi veka fatri nafshayehu

Socher bechattat veshoel beasham kegon shemmeta kedarkah veamru meta mechamat melacha socher deven kach uven kach miptar patur chayyav bechattat shoel demichayyav bemeta kedarkah veka fatar nafsheh bemeta mechamat melacha beasham

Socher beasham veshoel bechattat kegon shennigneva veamru meta kedarkah socher hu demichayyav bigneva vaaveda veka fatar nafsheh bemeta kedarkah beasham shoel deven kach uven kach chayyove michayyav bechattat

May ka mashma lan leappoke midderabbi amme deamar kol shevua shehaddayyanim mashbiim otah en chayyavin aleha mishshum shevuat bituy shenneemar o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim ki tishshava meatzmah ka mashma lan dela kerabbi amme
Ittemar shomer shemmasar leshomer rav amar patur verabbi yochanan amar chayyav

Amar abbaye letameh derav la mibbaya shomer chinnam shemmasar leshomer sachar dealloye alleyah lishmirato ella afilu shomer sachar shemmasar leshomer chinnam degaroe garah lishmirato patur may tama deha mesarah leven daat

Ultameh derabbi yochanan la mibaya shomer sachar shemmasar leshomer chinnam degaroe garah lishmirato ella afilu shomer chinnam shemmasar leshomer sachar dealloye alleyah lishmirato chayyav deamar leh en retzoni sheyehe pikdoni beyad acher

Amar rav chisda ha derav lav beferush ittemar ella mikkelala dehanhu ginae dechol yoma hao mafkedi marayehu gabbah dehahi savta yoma chad afkedunhu legabbe chad minayehu shema kala be hillula nefak azal afkedinhu legabbah dehahi savta addaazal vaata iggenuv marayehu
Ata lekammeh derav ufatreh man dachaza savar mishshum shomer shemmasar leshomer patur vela hi shane hatam dechol yoma name inhu gufayehu gabbah dehahi savta hao mafkedi lehu

Yatev rabbi amme vekaamar lah leha shemata etiveh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi amme hassocher para mechavero vehishilah leacher umeta kedarkah yishshava hassocher shemmeta kedarkah vehashshoel meshallem lassocher veim ita lema leh en retzoni sheyehe pikdoni beyad acher amar leh hacha bemay askinan beshennatnu lo reshut habbealim lehashil
I hachi livalim bae leshallome daamaru leh ledatach
Metiv rame bar chama hammafkid maot etzel chavero tzeraran vehifshilan laachorav mesaran livno uvitto hakketannim venaal bifnehem shello karauy chayyav shello shamar kederech hashshomrim
Tama diktannim ha gedolim patur ammay nema leh en retzoni sheyehe pikdoni beyad acher
Amar rava kol hammafkid
b: Al daat ishto uvanav hu mafkid

Amri nehardae dayeka name dekatane o shemmesaran livno uvitto hakketannim chayyav ha livno ulvitto haggedolim patur michlal delaacherim la shena gedolim vela shena ketannim chayyav deim ken litne ketannim setama shema minah

Amar rava hilcheta shomer shemmasar leshomer chayyav la mibbaya shomer sachar shemmasar leshomer chinnam degaroe garah lishmirato ella afilu shomer chinnam shemmasar leshomer sachar chayyav may tama daamar leh atte mehemnatte li bishvua hayeche la meheman li bishvua
Ittemar pasha bah veyatzat laagam umeta kedarkah abbaye mishshemeh derabba amar chayyav rava mishshemeh derabba amar patur

Abbaye mishshemeh derabba amar chayyav kol dayyana dela daen ki hay dina lav dayyana hu la mibbaya leman deamar techilato bifshia vesofo beones chayyav dechayyav ella afilu leman deamar patur hacha chayyav may tama deamrinan havla deagma katlah

Rava mishshemeh derabba amar patur kol dayyana dela daen ki hay dina lav dayyana hu la mibaya leman deamar techilato bifshia vesofo beones patur defatur ella afilu leman deamar chayyav hacha patur may tama deamrinan malach hammavet ma li hacha uma li hatam

Umode abbaye dei hadara leve marah umita defatur may tama deha hadara lah veleka lememar havla deagma katlah umode rava kol hecha dei ganvah gannav baagam umeta kedarkah be gannav dechayyav may tama dei shavkah malach hammavet beveteh degannava hava kayema

Amar leh abbaye lerava ledidach deamratte malach hammavet ma li hacha uma li hatam hay deotveh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi amme veshanni leh beshennatnu lo bealim reshut lehashil velema leh malach hammavet ma li hacha uma li hatam
Amar leh ledidchu dematnitu en retzoni sheyehe pikdoni beyad acher ika leotovah lehahi ledidi deamena ante mehemnatte li bishvua vehayeche la meheman li bishvua leka leotovah kelal
Metiv rame bar chama heelah lerashe tzukin venafla en ze ones vechayyav ha meta kedarkah hare ze ones ufatur veammay lema leh avera dehar katlah i name uvtzana dehar katlah
Hacha bemay askinan sheheelah lemire shamen vetov i hachi nafla name shehaya lo letokpah velo tekafah
I hachi ema resha alta lerashe tzukin venafla hare ze ones ibi leh lemitkefah la tzericha shettekafattu vealta tekafattu veyarda

Amar rabbi yose ketzad halla ose sechora befarato ku amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose amar leh rav shemuel bar yehuda lerav yehuda amarte lan mishshemeh dishmuel chaluk haya rabbi yose

a: Af barishona halacha kemoto o en halacha kemoto amar leh chaluk haya rabbi yose af barishona vahalacha kemoto af barishona
Ittemar name amar rabbi elazar chaluk haya rabbi yose af barishona vahalacha kemoto af barishona verabbi yochanan amar mode haya rabbi yose barishona shekkevar shilem

Shilem in lo shilem la vehaamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lo shilem shilem mammash ella kevan sheamar hareni meshallem af al pi shello shilem ema mode haya rabbi yose barishona shekkevar amar hareni meshallem
Matni amar lishnayim gazalti leechad mikkem mane veeni yodea eze mikkem o aviv shel echad mikkem hifkid li mane veeni yodea eze hu noten laze mane velaze mane shehoda mippi atzmo
Shenayim shehifkidu etzel echad ze mane veze matayim ze omer shelli matayim veze omer shelli matayim noten laze mane velaze mane vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu
Amar rabbi yose im ken ma hifsid harammay ella hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu

Vechen shene chelim echad yafe mane veechad yafe elef zuz ze omer yafe shelli veze omer yafe shelli noten et hakkatan leechad mehen umittoch haggadol noten deme katan lashsheni vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu amar rabbi yose im ken ma hifsid harammay ella hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu
Gema alma missefeka mappekinan mamona vela amrinan oke mamona bechezkat mareh
Urminhi shenayim shehifkidu etzel echad ze mane veze matayim ze omer shelli matayim veze omer shelli matayim noten laze mane velaze mane vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu
Amar leh pikkadon aggazel ka ramet gazel daavad isura kansuh rabbanan pikkadon dela avad isura la kansuh rabbanan

Urmi pikkadon appikkadon urmi gazel aggazel pikkadon appikdon dekatane resha o aviv shel echad mikkem hifkid etzli mane veeni yodea eze hu noten laze mane velaze mane urminhi shenayim shehifkidu vechu

Amar rava resha naasa kemi shehifkidu lo bishne cherichot dahava leh lemedak sefa naasa kemi shehifkidu lo becherech echad dela hava leh lemedak kegon deafkidu tarvayehu bahade hadade bechad zimna deamar lehu ante gufayechu la kafditu ahadade ana kafedna
Urmi gazel aggazel katane hacha amar lishnayim gazalti leechad mikkem mane veeni yodea eze mikkem o aviv shel echad mikkem hifkid li mane veeni yodea eze hu noten laze mane velaze mane

Urminhi gazal echad mechamishsha veeno yodea eze mehen gazal ze omer oti gazal veze omer oti gazal manniach gezela benehem umistallek divre rabbi tarfon alma missefeka la mappekinan mamona veamrinan okem mamona bechezkat mareh
Umimmay dematnitin dehacha rabbi tarfon hi dekatane alah dehahi mode rabbi tarfon beomer lishnayim gazalti leechad mikkem mane veeni yodea eze mikkem shennoten laze mane velaze mane
Hatam deka tavi leh hacha beva latzet yede shamayim dayeka name dekatane shehoda mippi atzmo shema minah
Amar mar hatam deka tavi leh vehalla ma toen rav yehuda amar rav halla shotek rav matna amar rav halla
b: Tzoveach man deamar halla tzoveach aval shetika kehodaa uman deamar halla shotek shetika dehacha lav kehodaa hu matze amar leh hay dishtiki lechol chad vechad deamena dilma hay hu

Amar mar manniach gezela benehem umistallek veshakli lah kullehu veazli vehaamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav kol sefek hinuach lechattechila lo yittol veim natal lo yachazir amar rav safra veyanniach
Amar leh abbaye lerava mi amar rabbi akiva lo zo hadderech motziato mide avera ad sheyeshallem gezela lechol chad vechad alma missefeka mappekinan mamona vela amrinan okem mamona bechezkat mareh

Urminhi nafal habbayit alav veal immo yorshe habben omrim haem meta rishona veorshe haem omrim habben met rishon ellu vaellu modim sheyyachloku veamar rabbi akiva mode ani bazo shehannechasim bechezkatan
Amar leh hatam shemma veshemma gazal echad mechamishsha bari veshemma veha matnitin dehacha amar lishnayim gazalti leechad mikkem mane deshemma veshemma hu vekatane noten laze mane velaze mane
Umimmay derabbi akiva hi dekatane alah dehahi mode rabbi tarfon beomer lishnayim gazalti leechad mikkem mane veeni yodea eze mikkem ku leman mode lav lerabbi akiva bar pelugteh
Umimmay deshemma veshemma hu chada dela katane tovin oto veod ha tane rabbi chiyya ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea
Ha okemna lah beva latzet yede shamayim

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe umi amar rava kol bishte kerichot hava leh lemedak vehaamar rava vei tema rav pappa hakkol modim bishnayim shehifkidu etzel roe shemmanniach roe benehen umistallek amar leh hatam keshehifkidu beedro shel roe shello middato
Vechen shene chelim echad yafe mane veechad yafe elef zuz ku utzricha

Dei ashmeinan hach kammayeta behahi kaamri rabbanan mishshum deleka peseda aval beha deika peseda degadol ema modu leh lerabbi yose vei ittemar beha beha kaamar rabbi yose aval behach ema mode lehu lerabbanan tzericha

a: Veha tama derabbi yose mishshum hefsed harammay hu ella tarvayehu lerabbanan itzterich velo zo af zo katane
Matni hammafkid perot etzel chavero afilu hen avudin lo yigga bahen rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mochran bifne bet din mippene shehu kemeshiv aveda labbealim
Gema may tama amar rav kahana adam rotze bekav shello mittisha kabbim shel chavero verav nachman bar yitzchak amar chayeshinan shemma asaan hammafkid teruma umaaser al makom acher
Metivi hammafkid perot etzel chavero hare ze lo yigga bahen lefichach baal habbayit ose otan teruma umaaser al makom acher bishlama lerav kahana hayenu dekatane lefichach
Ella lerav nachman bar yitzchak may lefichach hachi kaamar hashta daamur rabbanan la nezabben dechayeshinan lefichach baal habbayit ose otan teruma umaaser al makom acher
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan machaloket bichde chesronan aval yoter mikkede chesronan divre hakkol mochran bevet din
Adderav nachman bar yitzchak vadday peliga adderav kahana mi lema peliga ki kaamar rav kahana bichde chesronan kaamar
Veha rotze bekav shello mittisha kabbin shel chavero kaamar guzma bealma
Metivi lefichach baal habbayit ose otan teruma umaaser al makom acher velechush dilma hao lehu yoter mikkede chesronan vezabbeninhu veka achel tevalim yoter mikkede chesronan la shechiach
Vei mishtachchi may mezabbeninan lehu velechush shemma asaan baal habbayit teruma umaaser al makom acher ki mezabbeninan name lechohanim bidme teruma mezabbeninan lehu

Ulrav nachman bar yitzchak name nezabbeninhu lechohanim bidme teruma beha peligi derabba bar bar channa sevar yoter mikkede chesronan la shechiach mide vechi mishtechach lekammeh hu dehaveya yater mikkede chesronan i aved lehu baal habbayit teruma umaaser al makom acher mikkamme dehau lehu yoter mikkede chesronan aved lehu hilkach ki hau lehu yoter mikkede chesronan nezabbeninhu lechohanim bidme teruma

Verav nachman bar yitzchak savar yater mikkede chesronan mishkach shechiach vechi hau lehu lealtar hu dehau lehu vei amratte nezabbeninhu zimnin dekadem umzabben lehu vechi aved lehu baal habbayit teruma umaaser al mekom acher la yada dimzabbena veka achel tevalim

Metivi hammafkid perot etzel chavero vehirkivu yayin vehechmitz shemen vehivish devash vehidbish hare ze lo yigga bahen divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim ose lahem takkana umochran bevet din uchshehu mochran mochran laacherim veeno mochran leatzmo
Kayyotze bo gabbae tzedaka bizman sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek portin laacherim veen portin leatzman gabbae tamchuy bizman sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek mochrin laacherim veen mochrim leatzman

Katane mihat perot vehirkivu may lav afilu yater mikkede chesronan lo bichde chesronan veha yayin vehechmitz shemen vehivish devash vehidbish deyater mikkede chesronan ninhu shane hane kevan dekam kam
Shemen vehivish devash vehidbish
b: Lemay chazu shemen chaze legildae devash lichtisha degamle
Vachachamim omrim ose lahem takkana umochran bevet din may takkanta aved lehu amar rav ashe lekankannim
Bemay ka mipalgi demar savar lehefsed merubbe chashshu lehefsed muat lo chashshu umar savar afilu lehefsed muat name chashshu

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer yimkerem bevet din mippene shehu kemeshiv aveda livalim ittemar rabbi abba berabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel verava amar rav nachman halacha kedivre chachamim
Veha amrah rabbi yochanan chada zimna deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu halacha kemoto chutz mearev vetzayedan uraya acharona
Amorae ninhu vealliba derabbi yochanan
Midderabban shimon ben gamliel nishma demoridin karov lenichse shavuy midderabbanan nishma deen moridin karov lenichse shavuy

Umimmay dilma ad kan la kaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel hacha ella mishshum deka chalya karna aval hatam hachi name deen moridin vead kan la kaamri rabbanan hacha ella i kerav kahana i kerav nachman bar yitzchak aval hatam hachi name demoridin
Lememra ditre tame ninhu vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel veamar shemuel moridin karov lenichse shavuy lav mishshum dechad tama hu la tere tame ninhu
Hachi name mistabbera deamar rava amar rav nachman halacha kedivre chachamim veamar rav nachman moridin karov lenichse shavuy ella shema minah tere tame ninhu shema minah
Ittemar shavuy shennishba rav amar en moridin karov linchasav shemuel amar moridin karov linchasav
Besheshshamu bo shemmet kulle alma la peligi demoridin
Ki peligi beshello shamu bo shemmet rav amar en moridin dilma mafsid lehu ushmuel amar moridin kevan deamar mar shayeminan lehu kearis la mafsed lehu
Metivi rabbi eliezer omer mimmashma shenneemar vechara appi veharagti etchem yodea ani shenneshotehem almanot uvnehem yetomim ella ma talmud lomar vehau neshechem vego
Melammed shenneshotehem mevakkeshot linase veen mannichin otan uvnehen rotzim lered lenichse avihen veen mannichin otan amar rava lered velimkor tenan

Hava ovada binhardea ufashtah rav sheshet meha matnita amar leh rav amram dilma lered velimkor tenan amar leh dilma mippumbedita atte dimayelin pila bekofa demachta veha dumya dinshotehem uvnehem katane ma hatam kelal la af hacha name kelal la

Umoridin karov lenichse shavuy tannae hi detanya hayyored lenichse shavuy en motziin oto miyyado velo od ella afilu shama shemmemashmeshin uvain vekadam vetalash veachal hare ze zariz veniskar veellu hen nichse shevuyin hare shehaya aviv o achiv o echad min hammorishin halchu lahem limdinat hayyam veshamu bahen shemmet

Hayyored lenichse netushim motziin oto miyyado veellu hen nichse netushim hare shehaya aviv o achiv o echad min hammorishin halchu lahem limdinat hayyam velo shamu bahem shemmet veamar rabban shimon ben gamliel shamati shehannetushim kishvuyin
Hayyored lenichse retushim motziin oto miyyado veellu hen nichse retushim hare shehaya aviv o achiv o echad min hammorishin kan veeno yodea lehechan halchu
May shena hanach dekaru lehu netushim umay shena hane dekaru lehu retushim

a: Netushim dival korchan dichtiv vehashsheviit tishmetenna untashtah afkata demalka retushim demiddatan dichtiv em al banim ruttasha
Tana vechullam shamin lahem kearis aheya ilema ashshevuyin hashta zariz veniskar hava may deashbach mibaya ella artushim veha motziin otan miyyado katane
Ella annetushim leman ilema lerabbanan ha amri motziin oto miyyado i rabban shimon ben gamliel ha amar shamati shehannetushim kishvuyin
Kishvuyin velo shevuyin kishvuyin deen motziin otan miyyado velo shevuyin deilu hatam zariz veniskar veilu hacha shayeminan leh kearis
Umay shena meha ditnan hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto hotzi harbe veachal kima kima veachal harbe ma shehotzi hotzi uma sheachal achal

Ha la damya ella leha ditnan hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto ketanna kemotzi al nichse acher dame alma kevan dela samcha dateh takkinu le rabbanan ki hechi dela lafsedinhu hacha name takkinu le rabbanan ki hechi dela lafsedinhu
Vechullan shamin lahem kearis vechullan leetoye may

Leetoye ha deamar rav nachman amar shemuel shavuy shennishba moridin karov linchasav yatza ledaat en moridin karov linchasav verav nachman dideh amar boreach hare hu keshavuy boreach mechamat may ilema mechamat keraga hayenu ledaat ella boreach mechamat meradin

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shavuy shennishba vehinniach kama liktzor anavim livtzor temarim ligdor zetim limsok bet din yordin linchasav umaamidin appotroppos vekotzer uvotzer vegoder umosek veachar kach moridin karov linchasav velokem appotroppa leolam appotroppa lediknane la mokminan
Amar rav huna en moridin katan lenichse shavuy velo karov lenichse katan vela karov mechamat karov lenichse katan
En moridin katan lenichse shavuy dilma mafsed lehu vela karov mechamat karov lenichse katan beache meima vela karov lenichse katan kevan dela mache ate leachzoke beh
Amar rava shema mineh midderav huna en machazikin benichse katan
b: Vaafilu higdil
Vela amaran ella beache deabba aval beache deimma let lan bah vaache deabba name la amaran ella bearata aval bevatte let lan bah uvarata name la amaran ella dela avid itda aval avid itda kala it lah
Vela hi la shena ache deabba vela shena ache deimma la shena arata vela shena batte vela shena avid itda la shena la avid itda la machatinan

Hahi savta dahavaya lah telat benata ishtevay ihi vachada beratta idach tarte benata shechiva chada minayehu ushvaka yanoka amar abbaye hechi naaved lokminhu lenichse bida daachata dilma shechiva savta veen moridin karov lenichse katan nokminhu lenichse bida deyanoka dilma la shechiva savta veen moridin katan lenichse shavuy
Amar abbaye hilkach palga yahavina lah laachata veidach palga mokminan leh appotroppa leyanoka rava amar miggo demokminan appotroppa lefalga mokminan leh appotroppa leidach palga

Lesof shemau dishchiva savta amar abbaye tilta yahavinan lah laachata vetilta yahavinan leh leyanoka veidach tilta yahavinan danka laachata veidach danka mokminan leh appotroppa leyanoka rava amar miggo demokem appotroppa ledanka mokminan name appotroppa leidach danka
Mari bar isak ata leh acha mibbe chozae amar leh pelog li amar leh la yadana lach

Ata lekammeh derav chisda amar leh shappir kaamar lach shenneemar vayyakker yosef et echav vehem lo hikkiruhu melammed sheyyatza belo chatimat zakan uva bachatimat zakan amar leh zil ayeti sahadi daachuh atte amar leh it li sahadi vedachali mineh degavra allima hu amar leh ledideh zil ante ayeti sahade delav achuch hu
Amar leh dina hachi hammotzi mechavero alav haraya amar leh hachi dayenina lach ulchol allime dechavrach amar leh sof sof atu sahadi vela mashadi amar leh tarte la avdi

Lesof ato sahadi daachuh hu amar leh liflog li name mippardese uvustani dishtal amar leh shappir kaamar lach ditnan hinniach banim gedolim uktannim vehishbichu gedolim et hannechasim hishbichu laemtza

a: Vechen amar rabba hishbichu laemtza amar leh abbaye mi dame hatam gedolim gabbe ketannim yadi veka machali hacha mi yada delechil
Iggalgal milleta umta lekammeh derabbi amme amar lehu gedola mizzo amru shamin lahem kearis hashta dideh la yahavinan leh
Ahderuha ha lekammeh derav chisda amar lehu mi dame hatam birshut nachet hacha lav birshut nachet veod katan hu veen moridin karov lenichse katan

Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri vechu tanya amru lo lerabbi yochanan harbe ovdot mehen harbe mitpazzerot mehen
Tana bamme devarim amurim sheervan im perotav aval yiched lo keren zavit omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha

Rabbi yehuda omer im hayeta vechu kamma midda merubba amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan asara korin tanya name hachi kamma midda merubba asara korin

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman bamme devarim amurim shemmadad lo mittoch gorno vehechzir lo mittoch gorno aval madad lo mittoch gorno vehechzir lo mittoch beto eno yotzi lo chesronot mippene shemmotirot

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye im ken lifka kadda hava ovada ufka kadda ibaet ema mishshum itztza

Gema vela peligi mar ki atreh umar ki atreh beatreh demar chafu bekira vela mayetz tefe beatreh demar chafu bechufra umayetz tefe ibaet ema mishshum gargishta ha mayetza tefe veha la mayetza tefe

b: Dal telatin veshita beshita pashu leh teresar dal temanya shetute pashu lehu arbea

Ika gulfe ushmarayya i hachi nefish leh tefe mishshetut ika tircheh udme barzanyata
Im haya shemen mezukkak eno yotzi lo shemarim vechu veha i efshar dela bala amar rav nachman bimzuppafin shanu abbaye amar afilu tema shello bimzuppafin kevan ditun teun

Rabbi yehuda omer af hammocher shemen mezukkak lachavero kol yemot hashshana hare ze mekabbel alav log umechetza shemarim lemea amar abbaye keshettimtza lomar ledivre rabbi yehuda muttar learev shemarim ledivre chachamim asur learev shemarim
Ledivre rabbi yehuda muttar learev shemarim vehayenu tama dimkabbel daamar leh i beay learove lach mi la arevi lach hashta name kabbel
Velema leh i arevte leh hava mizdabban li hashta may eeved leh lechodeh la mizdabban li bevaal habbayit askinan denicha leh betzila velema leh middela arevit li achole achelte li
Rabbi yehuda letameh delet leh mechila ditnan machar lo et hatztzemed lo machar lo et habbakar machar lo et habbakar lo machar lo et hatztzemed
Rabbi yehuda omer haddamim modiin ketzad amar lo mechor li tzimdecha bematayim zuz haddavar yadua sheen hatztzemed bematayim zuz vachachamim omrim en haddamim reaya
Ledivre chachamim asur learev shemarim vehayenu tama dela mekabbel daamar leh i baet learove mi hava shere lach hashta name la mekabbelna

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye adderabba ipcha mistabbera ledivre chachamim muttar learev shemarim vehayenu tama dela mekabbel daamar leh middela arevte li achole achelt li ledivre rabbi yehuda asur learev shemarim vehayenu tama dimkabbel deamar leh i beay learove la shere li learove lach kabbole la mekabbelatte zevon vezabben taggara ikri
Tanna echad hallokeach veechad hammafkid lifkatim may lifkatim ilema ki hechi delokeach la mekabbel pekatim mafkid name la mekabbel pekatim velema leh pekatach may ebed lehu

Ella ki hechi demafkid mekabbel pekatim lokeach name mekabbel pekatim umi mekabbel lokeach pekatim vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer lo amru shemen achur ella lammocher bilvad shehare lokeach mekabbel alav log umechetza shemarim belo pekatim
La kashya ha deyahev leh zuze betishri veka shakel mineh benisan ki midda detishri ha deyahev leh zuze benisan veka shakel mineh benisan ki midda denisan

Matni hammafkid chavit etzel chavero velo yichadu lah bealim makom vetiltelah venishtabbera im mittoch yado nishbera letzorko chayyav letzorkah patur im mishshehinnichah nishbera ben letzorko ben letzorkah patur yichadu lah habbealim makom vetiltelah venishbera ben mittoch yado uven mishshehinnichah letzorko chayyav letzorkah patur
Gema ha manni rabbi yishmael hi deamar la bainan daat bealim detanya haggonev tale min haeder vesela min hakkis limkom shegganav yachzir divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer

a: Tzarich daat bealim
I rabbi yishmael may irya lo yichadu afilu yichadu name
La mibaya kaamar la mibaya yichadu dimkomah hu ella afilu lo yichadu delav mekomah hu la baenan daat bealim
Ema sefa yichadu lah habbealim makom vetiltelah venishbera ben mittoch yado ben mishshehinnichah letzorko chayyav letzorkah patur atan lerabbi akiva deamar baenan daat bealim
I rabbi akiva may irya yichadu afilu lo yichadu name
La mibaya kaamar la mibaya lo yichadu delav mekomah hu ella afilu yichadu name dimkomah hu baenan daat bealim
Resha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva in deamar rabbi yochanan man dimtargem li chavit alliba dechad tanna movelna maneh batreh leve massuta
Targemah rabbi yaakov bar abba kammeh derav shennetalah al menat legozlah
Targemah rabbi natan bar abba kammeh derav shennetalah al menat lishloach bah yad
Bemay kamipalgi bishlichut yad tzericha chesron man deamar legozlah kasavar shelichut yad tzericha chesron uman deamar lishloach bah yad kasavar shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron

Matkef lah rav sheshet mide netalah katane tiltelah katane ella amar rav sheshet hacha bemay askinan kegon shettiltelah lehavi aleha gozalot veka savar shoel shello middaat gazlan have vechullah rabbi yishmael hi vesefa shehinnichah bemakom sheenah mekomah
Verabbi yochanan hinnichah bimkomah mashma

Itmar rav velevi chad amar shelichut yad tzericha chesron vechad amar shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron tistayyem derav hu deamar shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron detanya roe shehaya roe edro vehinniach edro uva lair uva zeev vetaraf uva ari vedaras patur hinniach maklo vetarmilo aleha chayyav
Vehavenan bah mishshum dehinniach maklo vetarmilo aleha chayyav ha shaklinhu
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav beodan aleha vechi odan aleha may have ha la mashchah
Veamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav shehikkishah bemakkel veratzta lefanav veha la chasserah ella lav shema minah kasavar shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron
Ema shehichchishah bemakkel dayeka name dekatane shehikkishah bemakkel shema minah

Umidderav savar shelichut yad tzericha chesron levi savar shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron may tama delevi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben nehoray meshunna shelichut yad haamura beshomer sachar mishshelichut yad haamura beshomer chinnam
b: Vaani omer enah meshunna

Umay meshunna lo teamer shelichut yad beshomer sachar vetete mishshomer chinnam uma shomer chinnam sheppatur bigneva vaaveda shalach bah yad chayyav shomer sachar shechayyav bigneva vaaveda lo kol shekken lemay hilcheta katvinhu rachamana lomar lach shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron
Vaani omer enah meshunna kerabbi elazar deamar da veda achat hi may da veda achat mishshum deika lemifrach ma leshomer chinnam shekken meshallem tashlume chefel betoen taanat gannav
Uman dela parech savar karna bela shevua adifa mikkefela bishvua
Rava amar lo teamer shelichut yad lo beshomer chinnam velo beshomer sachar vetete mishshoel uma shoel dildaat bealim ka aved shalach bah yad chayyav shomer chinnam veshomer sachar lo kol shekken
Lamma neemar chada lomar lach shelichut yad en tzericha chesron veidach shello tomar dayyo labba min haddin lihot kenidon ma shoel bivalim patur af shomer chinnam veshomer sachar bivalim patur
Ulman deamar shelichut yad tzericha chesron hane tarte shelichut yad lema li chada shello tomar dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon
Veidach lechidtanya venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim lishvua atta omer lishvua o eno ella ledin neemra shelichut yad lematta veneemra shelichut yad lemala ma lehallan lishvua af kan lishvua

a: Matni hammafkid maot etzel chavero tzeraran vehifshilan laachorav o shemmesaram livno ulvitto hakketannim venaal bifnehem shello karauy chayyav shello shimer kederech hashshomrim veim shimer kederech hashshomrim patur

Gema bishlama kullehu shello shimer kederech hashshomrim ella tzeraran vehifshilan laachorav may hava leh lemibad amar rava amar rabbi yitzchak amar kera vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha af al pi shetztzerurin yihu beyadcha

Veamar rabbi yitzchak leolam yehe kaspo shel adam matzuy beyado shenneemar vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha veamar rabbi yitzchak leolam yashlish adam et meotav shelish bekarka ushlish bifrakmatya ushlish tachat yado

Veamar rabbi yitzchak en habberacha metzuya ella bedavar hassamuy min haayin shenneemar yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha tana deve rabbi yishmael en habberacha metzuya ella bedavar sheen haayin sholetet bo shenneemar yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha

Tanu rabbanan haholech lamod et gorno omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettishlach beracha bemaase yadenu hitchil lamod omer baruch hashsholeach beracha bakkeri hazze madad veachar kach berach hare ze tefilat shave lefi sheen habberacha metzuya lo bedavar hashshakul velo bedavar hammadud velo bedavar hammanuy ella bedavar hassamuy min haayin shenneemar yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha

Amar shemuel kesafim en lahem shemira ella bakkarka amar rava umode shemuel beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot dela atrechuh rabbanan vei sheha lemotzae shabbat shiur lemikberinhu vela kavrinhu mechayyav vei tzurba merabbanan hu savar dilma mibe leh zuze leavdalta

Vehaidana dishchichi gashoshae en lahen shemira ella bishme kora vehaidana dishchichi paromae en lahem shemira ella bene urve amar rava umode shemuel bechotel i name ben hakkeranot vehaidana dishchichi tafochae en lahen shemira ella betefach hassamuch lakkarka o betefach hassamuch lishme kora

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe hatam tenan chametz shennafla alav mappolet hare hu kimvoar rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol sheen hakkelev yachol lechappes acharav vetana kamma chafisat hakkelev shelosha tefachim hacha may mi baenan shelosha tefachim o la
Amar leh hatam mishshum recha baenan shelosha tefachim hacha mishshum ikassoye meena la baenan shelosha tefachim vechamma amar rafram missichra tefach

Hahu gavra deafked zuze gabbe chavreh otvinhu bitzrifa deurbane ignuv amar rav yosef af al gav dilinyan gannave netiruta hi leinyan nura peshiuta hi have techilato bifshia vesofo beones chayyav veika deamri af al gav dilinyan nura peshiuta hi leinyan gannave netiruta hi utchillato bifshia vesofo beones patur vehilcheta techilato bifshia vesofo beones chayyav
Hahu gavra deafked zuze gabbe chavreh amar leh hav li zuzay amar leh la yadana hecha otvinhu ata lekammeh derava amar leh kol la yadana peshiuta hi zil shallem
Hahu gavra deafked zuze gabbe chavreh ashleminhu leimeh veotvinhu bekartelita veignuv amar rava hechi nedayenu dayyane lehay dina
Nema leh ledideh zil shallem amar
b: Kol hammafkid al daat ishto uvanav hu mafkid
Nema lah leimeh zili shallimi amra la amar li delav dideh ninhu deekberinhu
Nema leh ammay la amarte lah amar kol shekken dechi amena lah dedidi ninhu tefe mizdahara behu
Ella amar rava mishteva ihu dehanhu zuze ashleminhu leimeh umishtava imeh dehanhu zuze otvinhu bekartelita veignuv ufatur
Hahu appotroppa deyatme dizvan lehu tora leyatme umasreh levakkara la hao leh kakke veshine lemechal umit amar rame bar chama hechi nedayenu dayyane lehay dina
Nema leh leappotroppa zil shallem amar ana levakkara mesarteh
Nema leh levakkara zil shallem amar ana bahade tore okemteh uchla sheday leh la hava yadayna dela achal
Mikkede bakkara shomer sachar deyatme hu ibi leh leayyone i ika peseda deyatme hachi name vehacha bemay askinan deleka peseda deyatme deashkechuh lemareh detora ushkul yatme zuze mineh

Ella man ka taen mareh detora kataen ibi leh leodoan may modinan leh mida yada demikkach taut have besafsera dezaven mehacha umzabben lehacha hilkach mishteva ihu dela hava yada umshallem bakkara deme vasar bezol
Hahu gavra deafked keshuta gabbe chavreh hava leh ledideh name karya dichshuta amar leh lesarseyeh mehay reme azal rema meidach amar rav amram hechi nedayenu dayyane lehay dina
Nema leh ledideh zil shallem amar ana amri leh mehay remi
Nema leh lesarseyeh zil shallem amar la amar li mehay remi umehay la tirme
Vei dishha shiur leetoye leh vela ayeti leh galli addateh denicha leh bidla sheha
Sof sof may peseda ika veha ka mishtarshi leh amar rav samma bereh derava dahava shichra challa rav ashe amar bechise

a: Umshallem leh deme kise

Matni hammafkid maot etzel shulchani im tzerurin lo yishtammesh bahen lefichach im avdu eno chayyav beachrautan muttarin yishtammesh bahen lefichach im avdu chayyav beachrautan etzel baal habbayit ben tzerurin uven muttarin lo yishtammesh bahen lefichach im avdu eno chayyav beachrautan chenvani kevaal habbayit divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer chenvani kashshulchani
Gema mishshum ditzrurin lo yishtammesh bahen amar rav assi amar rav yehuda bitzrurin vachatumin shanu rav mari amar bekesher meshunne ika deamri bae rav mari kesher meshunne may teku
Muttarin yishtammesh bahen ku amar rav huna vaafilu neensu veha avdu katane kidrabba deamar rabba nignevu belistes mezuyyan avdu shettava sefinato bayyam

Verav nachman amar neensu la amar leh rava lerav nachman ledidach deamratte neensu la alma la have shoel alayehu i shoel la have shomer sachar name la have amar leh beha modena lach dehoil venehena mahane behahu hanaa dei mitreme leh zevina deit beh ravecha zaven behu have alayehu shomer sachar
Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna hammafkid maot etzel shulchani im tzerurin lo yishtammesh bahen lefichach im hotzi lo maal haggizbar veim muttarin yishtammesh bahen lefichach im hotzi maal haggizbar
Vei amratte afilu neensu may irya hotzi afilu lo hotzi name
Amar leh hu haddin af al gav delo hotzi veayede ditna resha hotzi tena sefa name hotzi
Matni hashsholeach yad befikkadon bet shammay omrim yilke bechaser uvyater uvet hillel omrim kishat hotzaa rabbi akiva omer kishat hattevia
Gema amar rabba hay man digzal chavita dechamra mechavreh meikara shaveya zuza hashta shaveya arbea tavrah o shatyah meshallem arbea itvar mimmela meshallem zuza

May tama kevan dei itah hadra lemarah beena hahi shata deka shate lah o deka tavar lah ka gazel mineh utnan kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela itvar mimmela meshallem zuza may tama hashta la aved lah vela mide ammay ka mechayevatte leh ahahi shata degazlah hahi shata zuza hu deshaveya
Tenan bet hillel omrim kishat hotzaa may kishat hotzaa ilema kishat hotzaa min haolam
Uvmay i bechaser mi ika leman deamar veha tenan kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela vei beyater hayenu bet shammay
b: Ella peshita kishat hotzaa mibbet bealim lema rabba deamar kevet shammay amar lach rabba beyater kulle alma la feligi ki peligi bechaser
Bet shammay savri shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron vechi chasar birshuta dideh chasar uvet hillel savri shelichut yad tzericha chesron vechi chasar birshuta demareh chasar
Ella ha deamar rava shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron lema rava deamar kevet shammay ella hacha bemay askinan kegon shettiltelah lehavi aleha gozalot uvshoel shello middaat ka mipalgi
Bet shammay savri shoel shello middaat gazlan have vechi chasar birshuta dideh chasar uvet hillel savri shoel shello middaat shoel have vechi chasar birshuta demareh chasar

Ella ha deamar rava shoel shello middaat lerabbanan gazlan have lema rava deamar kevet shammay ella hacha beshevach shel gezela kamipalgi bet shammay savri shevach gezela denigzal have uvet hillel savri shevach gezela degazlan have
Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya haggozel et harachel gezazah veyalda meshallem otah veet gizoteha veet valdoteha divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer gezela chozeret beeneha
Dayeka name dekatane bet shammay omrim yilke bechaser uvyater uvet hillel omrim kishat hotzaa shema minah

Rabbi akiva omer kishat hattevia amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi akiva umode rabbi akiva bimkom sheyyesh edim may tama deamar kera laasher hu lo yittenennu beom ashmato vechevan deika edim mehahu shata hu deichayyav leh ashma

Amar leh rav oshaya lerav yehuda rabbi atta omer ken hachi amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan chaluk haya rabbi akiva afilu bimkom sheyyesh edim may tama deamar kera laasher hu lo yittenennu beom ashmato uve dina hu deka mechayevi leh ashma

Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi abba bar pappa ki azlatte lehatam akkef assullama detzor veul legabbeh derabbi yaakov bar idi uvi mineh i shemia leh lerabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi akiva o en halacha kerabbi akiva amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi akiva leolam
May leolam amar rav ashe shello tomar hane mile hecha deleka edim aval hecha deika edim la
Vei name deahderah leduchtah veitvara leappoke midderabbi yishmael deamar la baenan daat bealim ka mashma lan devaenan daat bealim verava amar halacha kevet hillel

Matni hachoshev lishloach yad befikkadon bet shammay omrim chayyav uvet hillel omrim eno chayyav ad sheyyishlach bo yad shenneemar im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu hitta et hechavit venatal hemenna reviit venishbera eno meshallem ella reviit higbihah venatal hemenna reviit venishbera meshallem deme chullah

a: Menahane mile detanu rabbanan al kol devar pesha bet shammay omrim melammed shechayyav al hammachshava kemaase uvet hillel omrim eno chayyav ad sheyyishlach bo yad shenneemar im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu amru lahen bet shammay levet hillel vahalo kevar neemar al kol devar pesha amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay vahalo kevar neemar im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu
Im ken ma talmud lomar al kol devar pesha sheyyachol en li ella hu amar leavdo velishlucho minnayin talmud lomar al kol devar pesha
Hitta et hechavit ku amar rabba lo shanu ella nishbera aval hechmitza meshallem et kullah may tama gire dideh hu deahano lah
Higbihah venatal hemenna ku amar shemuel lo natal natal mammash ella kevan shehigbihah litol af al pi shello natal
Lema ka savar shemuel shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron amri la shane hacha denicha leh detihve ha chavit kullah basis leha reviit
Bae rav ashe higbiha arnaki litol hemenna dinar mahu chamra hu dela mintar ella aggav chamra aval zuza mintar o dilma shane netiruta dearnaki minnetiruta dedinar teku
Hadaran alach hammafkid
Matni hazzahav kone et hakkesef vehakkesef eno kone et hazzahav
Hannechoshet kona et hakkesef vehakkesef eno kone et hannechoshet maot haraot konot et hayyafot vehayyafot enan konot et haraot
Asimon kone et hammatbea vehammatbea eno kone et asimon mittaltelin konin et hammatbea matbea eno kone et hammittaltelin
Ze hakkelal kol hammittaltelim konin ze et ze ketzad mashach hemennu perot velo natan lo maot eno yachol lachzor bo natan lo maot velo mashach hemennu perot yachol lachzor bo
Aval amru mi sheppara meanshe dor hammabbul umiddor happelagga hu atid lehippara mimmi sheeno omed bedibburo
Rabbi shimon omer kol shehakkesef beyado yado al haelona
Gema matne leh rabbi lerabbi shimon bereh hazzahav kone et hakkesef amar lo rabbi shanita lanu beyaldutecha hakkesef kone et hazzahav vetachazor vetishne lanu beziknutecha hazzahav kone et hakkesef
Beyalduteh may sevar uvziknuteh may savar beyalduteh sevar dahava dachashiv have tiva kaspa dela chashiv have pera vekane leh pera letiva beziknuteh sevar kaspa
b: Decharif have tiva dahava dela charif have pera vekane leh pera letiva
Amar rav ashe keyalduteh mistabbera middekatane hannechoshet kona et hakkesef

I amratte bishlama kaspa legabbe dahava pera have hayenu deka tane hannechoshet kona et hakkesef deaf al pi dilgabbe dahava pera have legabbe nechoshet tiva have ella i amratte kaspa legabbe dahava tiva have hashta legabbe dahava dachashiv mineh amratte tiva have legabbe nechoshet deihu chashiv veihu charif mibbaya
Itzterich salka datach amena hane perite beatra desagayi inhu charifi tefe mikkaspa ema tiva have ka mashma lan kevan deika duchta dela sage beh pera have

Veaf rabbi chiyya sevar dahava tiva have derav ozef dinare mibberatte derabbi chiyya lesof iyyakur dinare ata lekammeh derabbi chiyya amar leh zil shallem lah tavin utkilin i amratte bishlama dahava tiva have shappir ella i amratte pera have have leh sea bisa veasur
Rav dinare hao leh vechevan dahao leh dinare naasa keomer lah halveni ad sheyyavo beni o ad sheemtza mafteach

Amar rava hay tanna savar dahava tiva have detanya peruta sheamru echad mishshemona baisar haitalki lemay nafka minah lekiddushe ishsha isar echad meesrim vearbaa bedinar shel kesef lemay nafka minah lemikkach umimkar
Dinar shel kesef echad meesrim vachamishsha bedinar shel zahav lemay nafka minah lefidon habben

I amratte bishlama tiva have meshaer tanna bemide dekitz ella i amratte pera have meshaer tanna bemide deoker vezil zimnin demahdar leh kahana vezimnin demosef leh ihu lechahana ella shema minah tiva have shema minah

Tenan hatam bet shammay omrim lo yaase adam selain dinre zahav uvet hillel mattirin rabbi yochanan veresh lakish chad amar machloket bislaim al dinarin devet shammay savri kaspa tiva vedahava pera vetiva appera la mechallelinan uvet hillel savri kaspa pera vedahava tiva ufera attiva mechallelinan aval perot al dinarin divre hakkol mechallelinan

May tama mide dehave akkesef levet hillel kesef levet hillel af al gav dechaspa legabbe dahava pera have legabbe pera tiva have zahav name levet shammay af al gav dedahava legabbe kaspa pera have legabbe pera tiva have vechad amar af beferot al dinarin machloket

Ulman deamar af beferot al dinarin machloket addemipalgi besilin al dinarin liflug beferot al dinarin i iplug beferot al dinarin hava amena hane mile beferot al dinarin aval besilin al dinarin modu lahen bet hillel levet shammay dedahava legabbe kaspa pera have vela mechallelinan ka mashma lan
Tistayyem derabbi yochanan hu deamar en mechallelin deamar rabbi yochanan

a: Asur lilot dinar bedinar

Dinar demay ilema dinar shel kesef bedinar shel kesef legabbe nafsheh mi ika leman deamar lav tiva have ella peshita dinar shel zahav bedinar shel zahav ulman i levet hillel ha amri tiva have ella lav levet shammay ushma minah rabbi yochanan hu deamar en mechallelin
La leolam ema lach rabbi yochanan hu deamar mechallelin veshane halvaa kevan dilinyan mikkach umimkar shavveuhv rabbanan ki fera deamrinan ihu nihu deoker vezil legabbe halvaa name pera have
Hachi name mistabbera dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan af al pi sheamru asur lilot dinar bedinar aval mechallelin maaser sheni alav shema minah

Ta shema happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni bet shammay omrim bechol hassela maot uvet hillel omrim beshekel kesef beshekel maot hashta levet shammay legabbe perite mechallelinan legabbe dahava mibaya shane perite beatra desagayin charife
Lishana acharina amri lah rabbi yochanan veresh lakish chad amar machloket bislain al dinarim devet shammay savri hakkesef kesef rishon velo kesef sheni
Uvet hillel savri hakkesef kesef riba vaafilu kesef sheni aval perot al dinarin divre hakkol mechallelinan deakkatti kesef rishon hu
Vechad amar af beferot al dinarin name machloket
Ulman deamar selain al dinarin machloket addemipalgi bislain al dinarin liflog bislain al selain
I ippelug bislain al selain hava amena hane mile bislain al selain aval bislain al dinarin modu lehu bet hillel levet shammay dedahava legabbe kaspa pera have vela mechallelinan ka mashma lan

Ta shema happoret sela shel maaser sheni birushalayim bet shammay omrim bechol hassela maot uvet hillel omrim beshekel kesef beshekel maot hashta kaspa legabbe perite mechallelinan vela amrinan kesef rishon velo kesef sheni legabbe dahava dachashiv mineh mi amrinan kesef rishon velo kesef sheni
Amar rava yerushalayim kamotvatte shane yerushalayim dichtiv beh venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teave nafshecha babbakar uvatztzon
Ta shema happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni bet shammay omrim bechol hassela maot uvet hillel omrim beshekel kesef beshekel maot
Ella dechulle alma hakkesef kesef riba vaafilu kesef sheni ella i itmar derabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish hachi itmar chad amar machloket bislain al dinarin devet shammay savri gazrinan
b: Shemma yeshahe aliyyotav dezimnin dela malu zuze bedinara vela massek uvet hillel savri la gazrinan shemma yeshahe aliyyotav dechi la malu name bedinara assoke massek lehu aval beferot al dinarin divre hakkol mechallelinan dechevan demarkevi la meshahe lehu
Vechad amar afilu beferot al dinarin name machloket

Bishlama lehach lishana deamratte demiddeorayeta mishra shere verabbanan hu digzaru beh hayenu dekatane yaase velo yaase ella lehach lishana deamratte demiddeorayeta peligi mechallelinan vela mechallelinan mibbee leh kashya
Itmar rav velevi chad amar matbea naase chalifin vechad amar en matbea naase chalifin amar rav pappa may tama deman deamar en matbea naase chalifin mishshum dedateh atztzurta vetzurta avida devatla
Tenan hazzahav kone et hakkesef may lav bachalifin ushma minah matbea naase chalifin lo bedamim i hachi hazzahav kone et hakkesef mechayyev mibbee leh teni hazzahav mechayyev

Hachi name mistabbera middekatane sefa hakkesef eno kone et hazzahav i amratte bishlama bedamim hayenu deamrinan dahava pera vechaspa tiva vetiva pera la kane ella i amratte bachalifin tarvayehu likno ahadade

Veod tanya hakkesef eno kone et hazzahav ketzad machar lo esrim vachamishsha dinar shel kesef bedinar shel zahav af al pi shemmashach et hakkesef lo kana ad sheyyimshoch et hazzahav i amratte bishlama bedamim mishshum hachi la kane ella i amratte bachalifin nikne
Ella may bedamim i hachi ema resha hazzahav kone et hakkesef ketzad machar lo dinar shel zahav beesrim vachamishsha dinar shel kesef kevan shemmashach et hazzahav nikna kesef bechol makom shehu
I amratte bishlama bachalifin hayenu dekatane nikne kesef bechol makom shehu ella i amratte bedamim hay nikne kesef bechol makom shehu nitchayyev gavra mibe leh

Amar rav ashe leolam bedamim umay bechol makom shehu kemot shehu kedaamar leh i amar leh mearnaki chadasha yahavina lach la matze yahev leh mearnaki yeshana af al gav daadifi minayehu may tama deamar leh leyashshenan ka vaena lehu

Amar rav pappa afilu leman deamar en matbea naase chalifin mebad hu dela aved chalifin aknoye miknu bachalifin mide dehave appere lerav nachman pere lerav nachman lav af al gav deinhu la avdi chalifin aknoye mikkenu bachalifin tiva name la shena
Metivi haya omed baggoren veen beyado maot omer lachavero hare perot hallalu netunim lecha bemattana

a: Vechozer veomer hare hen mechullalin al meot sheyyesh li babbayit tama deen beyado maot ha im yesh beyado maot lakne lehu leidach bimshicha ufarek dehachi adif dehave leh nuchray
Vei amratte matbea nikne bachalifin nikno leh maot lehayech aggav sudar velifrok delet leh sudar venakninhu nihaleh aggav karka delet leh karka
Veha omed baggoren katane begoren sheeno shello veikfal tanna leashmoinan gavra artilay delet leh vela kelum ella lav shema minah en matbea nikne bachalifin shema minah
Veaf rav pappa hadar beh ki ha derav pappa hao leh teresar alfe dinare be chozae akninhu lerav shemuel bar acha aggav assipa deveteh ki ata nefak leappeh ad teoch
Vechen amar ulla en matbea naase chalifin vechen amar rav assi en matbea naase chalifin vechen amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan en matbea naase chalifin

Etiveh rabbi abba leulla hare shehau chamarav ufoalav tovin oto bashshuk veamar lashshulchani ten li bedinar maot vaafarnesem vaani aale lecha yafe dinar utresit mimmaot sheyyesh li beveti im yesh lo maot muttar veim lav asur vei salka datach en matbea naase chalifin haveya leh halvaa veasur ishtik

Amar leh dilma ide veide bifrutatot shanu deleka alayehu tiva veide veide pera hau umishshum hachi nikkeno bachalifin amar leh in dayeka name dekatane yafe dinar utresit vela katane dinar yafe utresit shema minah
Rav ashe amar leolam bedamim uvifrutatot kevan deit leh naase keomer halveni ad sheyyavo beni o ad sheemtza mafteach
Ta shema kol hannaase damim beacher kevan shezzacha ze nitchayyev ze bachalifin kol hannaase damim beacher may nihu matbea ushma minah matbea naase chalifin
Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar
b: Kol hannishom damim beacher kevan shezzacha ze nitchayyev ze bachalifin
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane sefa ketzad hechlif shor befara o chamor beshor shema minah
Ulmay dislek addateh meikara matbea may ketzad hachi kaamar ufere name avdi chalifin ketzad hechlif shor befara o chamor beshor
Hanicha lerav sheshet deamar pere avdi chalifin ella lerav nachman deamar keli in aval pere la avdi chalifin may ketzad
Hachi kaamar yesh damim shehen kachalifin ketzad hechlif deme shor befara o deme chamor beshor
May tameh derav nachman savar lah kerabbi yochanan deamar devar tora maot konot umippene ma amru meshicha kona gezera shemma yomar lo nisrefu chittecha baaliyya
Umilleta dishchicha gezaru beh rabbanan milleta dela shechicha la gezaru beh rabbanan
Ulresh lakish deamar meshicha meforeshet min hattora hanicha i savar lah kerav sheshet metaretz lah kerav sheshet
Ella i savar lah kerav nachman deamar pere la avdi chalifin umatbea la kane hechi metaretz lah al kurchach kerav sheshet metaretz lah
Tenan kol hammittaltelin konin ze et ze veamar resh lakish vaafilu kis male maot bechis male maot targema rav acha bedinar anyaka vaanigra echad sheppesalattu malchut veechad sheppesalattu medina
Utzricha dei ashmeinan pesalattu malchut mishshum dela sage kelal aval pesalattu medina desage leh bimdina achariti ema akkatti matbea hu veen matbea nikne bachalifin
Vei ashmeinan pesalattu medina mishshum dela sage leh la betzina vela befarhesya aval pesalattu malchut desage leh betzina ema akkatti matbea hu veen matbea nikne bachalifin tzericha
Amar rabba amar rav huna mechor li beellu kana

a: Veyesh lo alav onaa
Kana af al gav dela mashach dechevan dela kafed kana dechi chalifin dame veyesh lo alav onaa dimchor li beellu kaamar leh rav abba amar rav huna mechor li beellu kana veen lo alav onaa
Peshita damim veen makpid alehen ha kaamrinan dekane dechachalifin damu chalifin umakpid alehen may

Amar rav adda bar ahava ta shema hare shehaya tofes parato veomed uva chavero veamar lo paratcha lamma lachamor ani tzarich yesh li chamor sheani noten lecha paratcha bechamma bechach vechach chamorcha bechamma bechach vechach
Mashach baal hachamor et happara velo hispik baal happara limshoch et hachamor ad shemmet hachamor lo kana baal hachamor et happara
Shema minah chalifin umakpid alehen lo kana

Amar rava attu chalifin beshuftane askinan dela kafdi ella kol chalifin mikpad kafdi vekana vehacha bemay askinan daamar leh chamor befara vetale umashach et happara vaadayin lo mashach et hattale dela have leh meshicha maalya
Amar mar mechor li beellu kana veyesh lo alav onaa lema savar rav huna matbea naase chalifin

La rav huna savar lah kerabbi yochanan deamar devar tora maot konot umippene ma amru meshicha kona gezera shemma yomar lo nisrefu chittecha baaliyya milleta dishchicha gezaru bah rabbanan umilleta dela shechicha la gezaru bah rabbanan amar leh mar huna bereh derav nachman lerav ashe attun hachi matnitu lah anan hachi matnenan lah vechen amar rav huna en matbea naase chalifin
Bamme konin
Rav amar bechilo shel kone denicha leh lekone deleheve makne kone ki hechi deligmar velakne leh velevi amar bechilo shel makne kidvaenan lememar lekamman

Amar leh rav huna middiskarta lerava ullevi deamar bechilo shel makne ha ka kane ara aggav gelima im ken hau leh nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut veniknin im nechasim sheen lahen achraut vaanan ipcha tenan nechasim sheen lahen achraut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut
Amar leh i hava levi hacha hava mappek leappach pulse denura mi savratte gelima makne leh behahi hanaa deka mekabbel mineh gamar umakne leh

Ketannae vezot lefanim beyisrael al haggeulla veal hattemura lekayyem kol davar shalaf ish naalo venatan lereehu geulla zo mechira vechen hu omer lo yiggael temura zo chalifin vechen hu omer lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto
Lekayyem kol davar shalaf ish naalo venatan lereehu mi natan lemi boaz natan laggoel rabbi yehuda omer goel natan levoaz
Tana konin bichli af al pi sheen bo shave peruta amar rav nachman lo shanu ella bichli aval befere la rav sheshet amar afilu beferot may tama derav nachman amar kera naalo naal in mide acharina la

May tameh derav sheshet amar kera lekayyem kol davar lerav nachman name hachtiv lekayyem kol davar hahu lekayyem kol davar deniknin beminal verav sheshet name hachtiv naalo amar lecha rav sheshet ma naalo davar hamsuyyam af kol davar hamsuyyam leappoke chatzi rimmon vachatzi egoz dela
Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi keman katvinan haidana bemana dechashar lemikneya beh bemana leappoke midderav sheshet deamar konin beferot dechashar leappoke middishmuel deamar konin
b: Bemaroka lemikneya leappoke middelevi deamar bechilo shel makne ka mashma lan lemikneya vela leaknoye beh rav pappa amar lemaote matbea verav zevid veitema rav ashe amar lemaote isure hanaa
Ika deamri beh amar rav pappa lemaote matbea dechashar amar rav zevid veitema rav ashe lemaote isure hanaa aval morika la itzterich
Asimon kone et hammatbea vechu may asimon amar rav maot hannitanot besiman levet hammerchatz

Metivi en mechallelin maaser sheni al asimon velo al maot hannitanot besiman levet hammerchatz mikkelal daasimon lav maot hannitanot besiman levet hammerchatz vechi tema paroshe kamfaresh veha la tanna hachi mechallelin maaser sheni al asimon divre rabbi dosa vachachamim omrim en mechallelin veshavin sheen mechallelin al maot hannitanot besiman levet hammerchatz

Ella amar rabbi yochanan may asimon pulsa veazda rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi yochanan rabbi dosa verabbi yishmael amru davar echad rabbi dosa ha daamaran rabbi yishmael may hi detanya vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha lerabbot kol davar hannitzrar bayyad divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer lerabbot kol davar sheyyesh alav tzura
Ketzad mashach hemennu perot velo natan lo maot eno yachol lachazor bo vechu amar rabbi yochanan devar tora maot konot umippene ma amru meshicha kona gezera shemma yomar lo nisrefu chittecha baaliyya
Sof sof man dishda deleka bae shallome ella gezera shemma tippol deleka beones i mokmatte lehu birshuteh masar nafsheh tarach umatztzel vei la la masar nafsheh tarach umatztzel
Resh lakish amar meshicha meforeshet min hattora may tama deresh lakish amar kera vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha davar hannikne miyyad leyad
Verabbi yochanan amar miyyad lemaote karka delet bah onaa
Veresh lakish im ken lichtov kera vechi timkeru mimkar miyyad amitecha al tonu o kano lema li shema minah limshicha
Verabbi yochanan o kano may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya vechi timkeru mimkar al tonu en li ella shennitanna lokeach nitanna mocher minnayin talmud lomar o kano al tonu
Veresh lakish tarte gamar mineh

Tenan rabbi shimon omer kol shehakkesef beyado yado al haelona mocher hu dematze hadar beh lokeach la matze hadar beh i amratte bishlama maot konot mishshum hachi mocher matze hadar beh lokeach la matze hadar beh ella i amratte maot enan konot lokeach name lihdar beh
Amar lach resh lakish alliba derabbi shimon la kaamena ki kaamena alliba derabbanan

Bishlama leresh lakish hayenu deika ben rabbi shimon lerabbanan ella lerabbi yochanan may ika ben rabbi shimon lerabbanan ika benayehu derav chisda deamar rav chisda kederech shettikkenu meshicha bammochrin kach tiknu meshicha ballakochot rabbi shimon let leh derav chisda rabbanan it lehu derav chisda

Tenan aval amru mi sheppara middor hammabbul hu atid lipara mimmi sheeno omed bediburo i amratte bishlama maot konot mishshum hachi kae baaval ella i amratte maot enan konot ammay kae baaval mishshum devarim
Uvidvarim mi kae baaval vehatanya

a: Rabbi shimon omer af al pi sheamru tallit kona dinar zahav veen dinar zahav kone tallit mikkol makom kach halacha aval amru mi sheppara meanshe dor hammabbul umeanshe dor happelagga umeanshe sedom vaamora umimmitzrayim bayyam hu atid lipara mimmi sheeno omed bediburo
Vehannose venoten bidvarim lo kana vehachozer bo en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu
Veamar rava anu en lanu ella en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu devarim veika bahadayehu maot kae baaval devarim veleka bahadayehu maot la kae baaval

Amar rava kera umatnita mesayya leh leresh lakish kera dichtiv vechichesh baamito befikkadon o vitsumet yad o vegazel o ashak et amito tesumet yad amar rav chisda kegon sheyyiched lo keli lehalvaato ashak amar rav chisda kegon sheyyiched lo keli leoshko

Vechi ahdereh kera ketiv vehaya ki yecheta veashem veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal o et haoshek asher ashak o et happikkadon asher hofkad itto veilu tesumet yad la ahdereh may tama lav mishshum dimchassera meshicha
Amar leh rav pappa lerava ema meoshek hu deahdar kera hacha bemay askinan kegon shennetalo mimmennu vechazar vehifkido etzlo
Hayenu pikkadon tere gavene pikkadon
I hachi tesumet yad name lahdereh velokmeh kegon shennetalo hemennu vechazar vehifkido etzlo i ahdereh kera la teuvta vela siyyata hashta dela ahdereh kera mesayya leh

Utsumet yad la ahdereh kera vehatanya amar rabbi shimon minnayin liten et haamur lemala lematta dichtiv o mikkol asher yishshava alav lashsheker veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav lerabbot tesumet yad lehishavon behedya miha la ahdereh kera
Matnita menalan detanya netanah levallan maal veamar rav daveka ballan hu dela mechassera meshicha aval mide achariti dimchassera meshicha lo maal ad demashech
Vehatanya netanah lesappar maal vesappar ha bae lemimshach tisporet hacha bemay askinan besappar goy delav bar meshicha hu
Tanya name hachi netanah lesappar o lesappan o lechol baale ummanut lo maal ad demashech kashyan ahadade ella lav shema minah kan besappar goy kan besappar yisrael shema minah
Vechen amar rav nachman devar tora maot konot uvadkah levi bematniteh veashkach netanah lesiton maal
b: Ella kashya leresh lakish amar lach resh lakish ha manni rabbi shimon hi
Aval amru mi sheppara vechu itmar abbaye amar odoe modinan leh rava amar melat layetinan leh
Abbaye amar odoe modinan leh dichtiv venasi veammecha lo taor rava amar melat layetinan leh dichtiv beammecha beose maase ammecha

Amar rava mena amena lah derabbi chiyya bar yosef yehavu leh zuze ammilcha lesof iyyakar milcha ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh zil hav lehu vei la kabbel alach mi sheppara vei amratte odoe modinan leh rabbi chiyya bar yosef bar odoe hu veella may melat layetinan leh rabbi chiyya bar yosef ate lekabbole aleh latuta derabbanan
