Ella rabbi chiyya bar yosef eravon hu deyahavi leh hu savar kenegdo hu kone vaamar leh rabbi yochanan keneged kullo hu kone
Ittemar eravon rav omer kenegdo hu kone verabbi yochanan amar keneged kullo hu kone

Metivi hannoten eravon lachavero veamar lo im ani chozer bi ervoni machul lach vehalla omer lo im ani echzor bi echpol lecha ervoncha nitkayemu hattenaim divre rabbi yose rabbi yose letameh deamar asmachta kanya

Rabbi yehuda omer dayyo sheyyikne keneged ervono amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim bizman sheamar lo ervoni yikkon aval machar lo bayit o sade beelef zuz ufara lo mehem chamesh meot zuz kana umachazir lo et hashshear afilu leachar kamma shanim may lav hu haddin lemittaltelin bedistama devistama kane lehu lechullehu
La mittaltelin bistama la kane umay shena karka divchaspa kane leh mammash kane leh lechullah mittaltele dela kane ella lekabbole mi sheppara la kane leh kulleh

Lema ketannae hammalve et chavero al hammashkon venichnesa hashshemita af al pi sheeno shave ella pelag eno meshammet divre rabban shimon ben gamliel rabbi yehuda hannasi omer im haya mashkon keneged halvaato eno meshammet veim lav meshammet
May eno meshammet dekaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel ilema kenegdo mikkelal derabbi yehuda hannasi savar lehach palga name meshammet

a: Ella mashkon denaket lema leh ella lav shema mineh may eno meshammet dekaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel eno meshammet bechullo umay meshammet dekaamar rabbi yehuda hannasi lehach palga dela naket aleh mashkon
Uvha kamipalgi derabban shimon ben gamliel savar keneged kullo hu kone verabbi yehuda hannasi savar kenegdo hu kone

La may eno meshammet dekaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel lehach palga denaket aleh mashkon mikkelal derabbi yehuda hannasi savar lehach palga denaket aleh mashkon name meshammet ella mashkon denaket lema leh lezichron devarim bealma
Rav kahana yehavu leh zuze akkitana lesof iyyakar kitana ata lekammeh derav amar leh bemay dinkitatte zuze hav lehu veidach devarim ninhu udvarim en bahen mishshum mechussere amana
Deitmar devarim rav amar en bahen mishshum mechussere amana verabbi yochanan amar yesh bahem mishshum mechussere amana

Metivi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer ma talmud lomar hin tzedek vahalo hin bichlal efa haya ella lomar lach sheyehe hen shellecha tzedek velav shellecha tzedek amar abbaye hahu shello yedabber echad bappe veechad ballev

Metivi rabbi shimon omer af al pi sheamru tallit kona dinar zahav veen dinar zahav kone tallit mikkol makom kach halacha aval amru mi sheppara meanshe dor hammabbul umeanshe dor happelagga hu atid lipara mimmi sheeno omed bediburo

Tannae hi ditnan maase berabbi yochanan ben matya sheamar livno tze uschor lanu poalim halach ufasak lahem mezonot uchshebba etzel aviv amar lo beni afilu atta ose lahem kisudat shelomo bishato lo yatzata yede chovatcha immahem shehen bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov ella ad shello yatchilu bimlacha tze veemor lahem al menat sheen lachem alay ella pat vekitnit bilvad
Vei salka datach devarim yesh bahen mishshum mechussere amana hechi amar leh zil hadar bach shane hatam defoalim gufayehu la samcha datayehu may tama mida yadi deal avuh samech
I hachi afilu hitchilu bimlacha name hitchilu bimlacha vadday samchi datayehu amaru memar amar kammeh daavuh venicha leh

Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan haomer lachavero mattana ani noten lach yachol lachazor bo yachol peshita ella muttar lachazor bo amar rav pappa umode rabbi yochanan bemattana muetet desamcha datayehu

Hachi name mistabbera deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan yisrael sheamar leven levi kor maaser yesh lecha beyadi ben levi rashshay laasoto terumat maaser al makom acher i amratte bishlama la matze lemihdar beh mishshum hachi rashshay ella i amratte matze lemihdar beh ammay rashshay ishtechach deka achel tevalim
Hacha bemay askinan kegon shennetalo mimmennu vechazar vehifkido etzlo

I hachi ema sefa netano leven levi acher en lo alav ella taromet vei salka datach kegon shennetalo mimmennu vechazar vehifkido etzlo ammay en lo alav ella taromet kevan demashcheh mamona it leh gabbeh ella lav shema minah bidla netalo shema minah

Hahu gavra dihav zuze ashshumsheme lesof iyyakar shumsheme hadaru behu vaamaru leh let lan shumsheme shekol zuzach la shekel zuzeh ignuv ato lekammeh derava amar leh kevan deamri lach shekol zuzach vela shekalt la mibbaya shomer sachar dela have ella afilu shomer chinnam name la have amaru leh rabbanan lerava veha bae lekabbole aleh mi sheppara amar lehu hachi name

Amar rav pappe amar li ravina ledidi amar li hahu merabbanan verav tavut shemeh veamri lah rav shemuel bar zutra shemeh dei hao yahavi leh kol chalala dealma la have ka have meshanne bedibbureh bedidi hava ovada hahu yoma appanya demaale shabbeta hava vahava yatevna vaata hahu gavra vekae abbava amar li it lach shumsheme lezabbone
b: Amari leh la amar li leho hanach zuze befikkadon gabbach deha chashacha li amari leh ha beta kammach otvinhu beveta veignuv ata lekammeh derava amar leh kol ha beta kammach la mibaya shomer sachar dela have ella afilu shomer chinnam name la have amari leh veha amaru leh rabbanan lerava ibi leh lekabbole aleh mi sheppara vaamar li lo hau devarim meolam

Rabbi shimon omer kol shehakkesef beyado yado al haelona vechu tanya amar rabbi shimon ematay bizman shehakkesef vehapperot beyad mocher aval kesef beyad mocher uferot beyad lokeach eno yachol lachazor bo mippene shekkaspo beyado beyado beyad mocher hu ella mippene sheddeme chaspo beyado

Peshita amar rava hacha bemay askinan kegon shehayeta aliyya shel lokeach muskeret beyad mocher tama may takkinu rabbanan meshicha gezera shemma yomar lo nisrefu chittecha baaliyya hacha birshuteh delokeach ninhu i nafla deleka beones ihu tarach umayete lah

Hahu gavra dihav zuze achamra lesof shema deka vae leminseveh deve parzak rufila amar leh hav li zuzay la baena chamra ata lekammeh derav chisda amar leh kederech shettiknu meshicha bammochrin kach tiknu meshicha ballakochot
Matni haonaa arbaa kesef meesrim vearbaa kesef lassela shetut lemikkach ad matay muttar lehachzir ad kede sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo

Hora rabbi tarfon belod haonaa shemona kesef meesrim vearba kesef lassela shelish lemikkach vesamchu taggare lod amar lahem kol hayyom muttar lachzor amru lo yanniach lanu rabbi tarfon bimkomenu vechazru ledivre chachamim

Gema ittemar rav amar shetut mikkach shaninu ushmuel amar shetut maot name shaninu shave shita bechamsha shave shita beshiva kulle alma la peligi devatar mikkach azlinan veonaa haveya ki peligi shave chamsha beshita veshave shiva beshita
Lishmuel deamar batar maot azlinan ide veide onaa have lerav deamar batar mikkach azlinan shave chamsha beshita bitul mikkach haveya shave shiva beshita mechila haveya
Ushmuel amar ki amrinan mechila uvitul mikkach hecha deleka shetut mishshene tzedadim aval hecha deika shetut mitztzad echad onaa haveya
Tenan haonaa arbaa kesef meesrim vearbaa kesef lassela shetut lemikkach may lav dezabben shave esrim beesrin vearbea ushma minah shetut maot name shaninu la dezabben shave esrim vearbea beesrim
Mi nitanna mocher ema sefa ad matay muttar lehachzir bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo veamar rav nachman lo shanu ella lokeach aval mocher leolam chozer

Ella dezabben shave esrim vearbea beesrin utmanya tenan hora rabbi tarfon belod haonaa shemona kesef meesrim vearbaa kesef lassela shelish lemikkach may lav dezabben shave shitasre beesrim vearbea ushma minah shelish maot name shaninu

La dezabben shave esrim vearbea beshitsar mi nitanna mocher ema sefa amar lahem kol hayyom muttar lachzor veamar rav nachman lo shanu ella lokeach aval mocher leolam chozer ella dezabben shave esrim vearbea bitlatin utren

Tanya keoteh dishmuel mi shehuttal alav yado al haelona ketzad machar lo shave chamishsha beshishsha mi nitanna lokeach yad lokeach al haelona ratza omer ten li meotay o ten li ma sheonetani machar lo

a: Shave shesh bechamesh mi nitanna mocher yad mocher al haelona ratza omer lo ten li mikkachi o ten li ma sheonetani
Ibaya lehu pachot mishshetut lerabbanan lealtar haveya mechila o bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo veim timtze lomar bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo may ika ben shetut lefachot mishshetut
Ika deillu shetut yado al haelona ratza chozer ratza kone umachazir onaa veilu pachot mishshetut kana umachzir onaa
May ta shema chazru ledivre chachamim

Savruha pachot mishshelish lerabbi tarfon kefachot mishshetut lerabbanan dame i amratte bishlama pachot mishshetut lerabbanan bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo ulrabbi tarfon kol hayyom mishshum hachi chazru ella i amratte pachot mishshetut lerabbanan lealtar haveya mechila
b: Ulrabbi tarfon name lealtar haveya mechila ammay chazru bidrabbi tarfon nicha lehu tefe demay derabbanan ka meshave lehu onaa lerabbi tarfon haveya mechila
Mi savratte pachot mishshelish lerabbi tarfon kefachot mishshetut lerabbanan dame la mishshetut vead shelish lerabbi tarfon kishtut atzmah lerabbanan dame i hachi bemay samchu meikara
Tifshot devittul mikkach lerabbanan leolam chozer dechevan daamar lehu rabbi tarfon haveya onaa samchu ki amar lehu kol hayyom chazru
Dei salka datach devittul mikkach lerabbanan bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo bemay samchu samchu beshettut atzmah dilrabbi tarfon mechila ulrabbanan onaa

Ibaya lehu bittul mikkach lerabbanan leolam chozer o dilma bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo veim timtza lomar bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo ma ika ben shetut leyater al shetut ika deilu shetut mi shennitanna chozer veilu yater al shetut shenehem chozrim

May ta shema chazru ledivre chachamim i amratte bishlama bittul mikkach lerabbanan bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo ulrabbi tarfon kol hayyom mishshum hachi chazru ella i amratte bittul mikkach lerabbanan leolam chozer ammay chazru bidrabbi tarfon nicha lehu tefe deka meshave lehu onaa kol hayyom vetu la
Bittul mikkach la shechiach
Amar rava hilcheta pachot mishshetut nikne mikkach yoter al shetut bitul mikkach shetut kana umachzir onaa veze vaze bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo

Tanya keoteh derava onaa pachot mishshetut nikne mikkach yater al shetut batel mikkach shetut kana umachzir onaa divre rabbi natan rabbi yehuda hannasi omer yad mocher al haelona rotze omer lo ten li mikkachi o ten li ma sheonetani veze vaze bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo
Ad matay muttar lehachazir ku amar rav nachman lo shanu ella lokeach aval mocher leolam chozer nema mesayya leh chazru ledivre chachamim i amratte bishlama mocher leolam chozer

a: Mishshum hachi chazru
Ella i amratte mocher name kelokeach dame may nafka lehu minah ki hechi deavdi lah rabbanan takkanta lelokeach hachi name avdi lah rabbanan takkanta lemocher
Taggare lod la shechiach detau

Ushpizchaneh derame bar chama zabben chamara uta ashkecheh dahava atziv amar leh ammay atzivatte amar leh zabbeni chamara utay amar leh zil hadar bach amar leh ha shehay li yoter mikkede sheare lattaggar o likrovi shaddereh lekammeh derav nachman amar leh lo shanu ella lokeach aval mocher leolam chozer
May tama lokeach mikkacho beyado kol hecha deazel machvi leh veamri leh i tea i la tea mocher dela naket mikkacheh bideh ad demitreme leh zevinta kizvinteh veyada i tea vei la tea

Hahu gavra dahava naket varsheche lezabbone kare shita veshaveya chamsha vei hao yahavi leh chamsha ufalga hava shakel ata hahu gavra veamar i yahevna leh chamsha ufalga haveya mechila etten leh shita veetbeeh ledina ata lekammeh derava amar leh lo shanu ella belokeach min hattaggar aval belokeach mibbaal habbayit en lo alav onaa

Hahu gavra dahava naket kipe lezabbone kare shittin veshave chamshin vei hao yahavi leh chamshin vechamsha hava shakel ata hahu gavra veamar i yahevna leh chamshin vechamsha haveya mechila etten leh shitin veetbeeh ledina ata lekammeh derav chisda amar leh lo shanu ella belokeach min hattaggar aval belokeach min baal habbayit en lo alav onaa

Amar leh rav dimi yishar vechen amar rabbi elazar yishar veha anan tenan keshem sheonaa lehedot kach onaa lattaggar man hedot lav baal habbayit amar rav chisda betzadreyata aval mane tashmishteh deyakkiri aleh la mezabben lehu i lav bidme yattire

Matni echad hallokeach veechad hammocher yesh lahen onaa keshem sheonaa lahedot kach onaa lattaggar rabbi yehuda omer en onaa lattaggar mi shehuttal alav yado al haelona ratza omer lo ten li meotay o ten li ma sheonetani
Gema menahane mile detanu rabbanan vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha al tonu en li ella shennitanna lokeach nitanna mocher minnayin talmud lomar o kano al tonu
Veitzterich lemichtav lokeach veitzterich lemichtav mocher dei ketav rachamana mocher mishshum dekim leh bizvinteh aval lokeach dela kim leh bizvinteh ema la azhareh rachamana belo tonu
Vei ketav rachamana lokeach mishshum deka kane deamri inashe zevante kenet aval mocher deovode ka moved deamri inashe zabben oved ema la azhareh rachamana belo tonu tzericha
Rabbi yehuda omer en onaa lattaggar mishshum shehu taggar en lo onaa
Amar rav nachman amar rav betaggar safsar shanu may tama mida yada zevinteh kamma shaveya veachole achel gabbeh vehay dezabbenah hachi mishshum deitramya leh zevinta achariti
Vehashta miha ka hadar beh rav ashe amar may en lattaggar onaa eno betorat onaa sheafilu pachot mikkede onaa chozer tanya keoteh derav nachman rabbi yehuda omer taggar en lo onaa mippene shehu baki
Mi shehuttal alav yado al haelona vechu manni matnitin la rabbi natan vela rabbi yehuda hannasi
I rabbi natan matnitin katane ratza uvarayeta la katane ratza i rabbi yehuda hannasi matnitin katane lokeach barayeta katane mocher
Siman zav rash

Amar rabbi elazar onaa zo eni yodea mi shenaah rabba amar leolam rabbi natan hi utni name bevarayeta ratza rava amar leolam rabbi yehuda hannasi hi umay deshayyar bematnitin ka mefaresh bevarayeta amar rav ashe dayeka name dekatane echad hallokeach veechad hammocher umfaresh leh lelokeach shema minah shayyore shayereh lemocher shema minah
Itmar haomer lachavero al menat sheen lecha alay onaa rav amar yesh lo alav onaa ushmuel amar en lo alav onaa lema rav deamar kerabbi meir ushmuel deamar kerabbi yehuda
Detanya haomer leishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li al menat sheen lecha alay sheer kesut veona hare zo mekuddeshet utnao batel divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer bedavar shebbemamon tenao kayyam
Amar lecha rav ana daamari afilu lerabbi yehuda ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam ella deyada veka machala
b: Aval hacha mi yada demachel
Ushmuel amar ana daamari afilu lerabbi meir ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella devadday ka akar aval hacha mi yemar deka akar mide
Amar rav anan ledidi mipparsha li mineh demar shemuel haomer lachavero al menat sheen lecha alay onaa en lo alav onaa al menat sheen bo onaa hare yesh bo onaa
Metivi hannose vehannoten baamana vehaomer lachavero al menat sheen lecha alay onaa en lo alav onaa lerav deamar ana daamari afilu lerabbi yehuda ha manni
Amar abbaye mechavarta rav amar kerabbi meir ushmuel deamar kerabbi yehuda
Rava amar la kashya kan bistam kan bimfaresh

Detanya bamme devarim amurim bistam aval bimfaresh mocher sheamar lallokeach chefetz ze sheani mocher lach bematayim yodea ani bo sheeno shave ella mane al menat sheen lecha alay onaa en lo alav onaa vechen lokeach sheamar lammocher chefetz ze sheani lokeach mimmecha bemane yodea ani bo sheshshave matayim al menat sheen lecha alay onaa en lo alav onaa
Tanu rabbanan hannose vehannoten baamana hare ze lo yechashshev et hara baamana veet hayyafe beshave ella o ze vaze baamana o ze vaze beshave
Venoten lo sechar kattaf sechar gammal sechar pundak sechar atzmo eno notel shekkevar natan lo secharo mishshalem
Secharo mishshalem mehecha ka yahev leh amar rav pappa betzadroye deyahavi arba lima
Matni kamma tehe hassela chasera velo yehe bah onaa rabbi meir omer arba isarot isar ledinar verabbi yehuda omer arba pundeonot pundeon ledinar verabbi shimon omer

a: Shemona pundeonot shene pundeonot ledinar
Ad matay muttar lehachzir bichrakkim ad kede sheyyare lashshulchani bichfarim ad arve shabbatot im haya makkirah afilu leachar shenem asar chodesh mekabbelah hemennu veen lo alav ella taromet
Venotnah lemaaser sheni veeno choshesh sheeno ella nefesh raa
Gema urminhi ad kamma tehe hassela chasera veyihye bah onaa
Amar rav pappa la kashya tanna didan ka chashev mimmatta lemala tanna bara ka chashev millemala lematta
May shena besela difligi umay shena betallit dela peligi
Amar rava man tena tallit rabbi shimon hi abbaye amar tallit ad shetut machel inish deamri inashe ashik legabbach veshave lichresach sela kevan dela saggi leh la machel

Gufa ad kamma tehe hassela chasera vihe bah onaa rabbi meir omer arbaa isarot isar ledinar rabbi yehuda omer arbaa pundeonot pundeon ledinar rabbi shimon omer shemona pundeonot shene pundeonim ledinar yater al ken mochrah beshoveyah

Ad kamma tipachet vihe rashshay lekayemah besela ad shekel bedinar ad rova pachot mikken isar asur lehotziah hare ze lo yimkerenna lo lattaggar velo lecharam velo leharag mippene shemmerammin bah et acherim ella yikkovenna veyitlenna betzavar beno o betzavar bitto
Amar mar besela ad shekel bedinar ad rova may shena besela ad shekel umay shena bedinar ad rova
Amar abbaye may rova dekatane name rova shekel amar rava dayeka name deka tane rova vela katane revia shema minah
Lema leh lemitleyeh ledinar beshekel milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan deika dinar deate mishshekel
Mesayya leh lerabbi amme deamar rabbi amme dinar habba mishshekel muttar lekayemo dinar habba missela asur lekayemo

Pachot mikken isar asur lehotziah may kaamar amar abbaye hachi kaamar pachata sela yoter mikkede onaa isar asur amar leh rava i hachi afilu mashshehu name ella amar rava pachata sela isar ledinar asur ustama kerabbi meir
Tenan hatam sela shennifsela vehitkinah sheyehe shokel bah mishkalot temea ad kamma tipachet vihe rashshay lekayemah lassela shene dinarim pachot mikken yakotz
Yater al ken may amar rav huna pachot mikken yakotz yater al ken yakotz rabbi amme amar pachot mikken yakotz yater al ken yekayyem
Metivi
b: Yater al ken mochrah beshoveyah may lav sheppachata yoter mikkede onaatah la yetera deakkatti la pachata bichde onaatah mochrah beshoveyah
Metivi ad kamma tipachet vihe rashshay lekayemah besela ad shekel may lav difchat purta purta la dinfil lenura veippechit bachada zimna

Amar mar yikkovenna veyitlenna betzavar beno o betzavar bitto urminhu lo yaasenna mishkal ben mishkelotav velo yizrekenna ben gerutotav velo yikkovenna veyitlenna betzavar beno uvtzavar bitto ella o yishchok o yittoch o yakotz o yolich leyam hammelach
Amar rabbi elazar veamri lah rav huna amar rabbi elazar la kashya kan baemtza kan min hatztzad
Ad matay muttar lehachazir bichrakkim ad sheyyare lashshulchani bichfarim ad arve shabbatot may shena besela dimfalleg umay shena betallit dela mefalleg

Amar abbaye ki tenan name matnitin betallit bichrakkin tenan rava amar tallit kol inish kim leh begavah sela kevan delav kol inish kim leh begavah ella shulchani hilkach bichrakkim deika shulchani ad sheyyare lashshulchani bichfarim deleka shulchani ad arve shabbatot desalkin leshuka
Veim haya makkirah afilu leachar shenem asar chodesh ku hecha i bichrakkin ha amratte ad sheyyare lashshulchani i bichfarim ha amratte ad arve shabbatot

Amar rav chisda midat chasidut shanu kan i hachi ema sefa en lo alav ella taromet leman i lechasid la kabbole likabbelah mineh vela taromet tehve leh veella lehayeche dekabbelah mineh ulvatar dimkabbelah mineh taromet tehve leh
Hachi kaamar ha acher af al pi sheen mekabbelah hemennu en lo alav ella taromet
Venotnah lemaaser sheni veeno choshesh sheeno ella nefesh raa amar rav pappa shema minah hay man demokem azzuze mikre nefesh raa vehane mile hu desage lehu
Mesayya leh lechizkiyya deamar chizkiyya ba lefortah portah beshoveyah ba lechallelah mechallelah beyafa
May kaamar hachi kaamar af al pi keshebba lefortah portah beshoveyah keshehu mechallelah mechallelah beyafa

Lememra desavar chizkiyya dimzalzelinan bemaaser sheni vehaamar chizkiyya maaser sheni sheen bo shave peruta omer hu vechumsho mechullal al maot harishonot lefi shei efshar lo leadam letzamtzem meotav
May beyafa betorat yafa ditre zile la mezalzelinan beh
Gufa amar chizkiyya maaser sheni sheen bo shave peruta omer hu vechumsho mechullal al maot harishonot lefi shei efshar lo leadam letzamtzem meotav
Metivi hatteruma vehabbikurim chayyavin alehen mita vachomesh

a: Vaasurim lezarim vehen nichse chohen veolim beechad umea utunin rechitzat yadayim veheerev shemesh hare ellu bitruma uvikkurim ma sheen ken bammaaser
May ma sheen ken bammaaser lav mikkelal demaaser batel berubba veim ita dechizkiyya hava leh davar sheyyesh lo mattirin vechol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin afilu beelef lo batel
Umimmay dema sheen ken bammaaser devatel berubba dilma la batel kelal la matzet amratte hachi dilgabbe teruma chumre ditruma katane kulle ditruma la katane veha ka tane vehen nichse chohen

La salka datach detanya behedya maaser sheni batel berubba uveze maaser sheni amru bemaaser sheen bo shave peruta veshennichnas lirushalayim veyatza veim ita lidchizkiyya lebed leh lidchizkiyya venichalleleh al maot harishonot dela parek
Venayete maaser deit leh venitztarfinhu untzaref deorayeta udrabbanan la mitztarfi
Venayete demay dilma ate leetoye vadday

Venayete shette ferutot unchallel alayehu maaser bifruta umechetza unchallel hay al hayech yattira mi savratte peruta umechetza tafsa shette ferutot la peruta tafsa peruta vachatzi peruta la tafsa hadar haveya leh deorayeta udrabbanan udorayeta udrabbanan la mitztarfi
Venayete isar dilma ate leetoye perutot
Veshennichnas lirushalayim veyatza veammay velihdar unayeleh beshennitma venifrekeh deamar rabbi elazar minnayin lemaaser sheni shennitma sheppodin oto
b: Afilu birushalayim shenneemar ki lo tuchal seeto veen seet ella achila shenneemar vayyissa masot meet panav
Ella belakuach bechesef maaser sheni lakuach bechesef maaser name lifrekeh ditnan hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni shennitma yippade kerabbi yehuda deamar yikkaver
I rabbi yehuda may irya yatza afilu lo yatza name ella leolam betahor umay yatza dinful mechitzot

Vehaamar rava mechitza leechol deorayeta mechitzot liklot derabbanan vechi gezaru derabbanan ki itanhu limchitzot ki letanhu limchitzot la gezaru rabbanan la pelug rabbanan ben itanhu limchitzot ben letanhu limchitzot
Rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet chada katane maaser sheni sheen bo shave peruta shennichnas lirushalayim veyatza ammay venihdar unayeleh venechleh dinful mechitzot
Venifrekeh haamar rava mechitza leechol deorayeta mechitza liklot derabbanan vechi gezaru rabbanan ki itanhu limchitzot ki letanhu limchitzot la gezaru rabbanan la pelug rabbanan
I hachi may irya en bo shave peruta afilu yesh bo name la mibaya kaamar la mibaya yesh bo dekaltan leh mechitzot aval en bo ema la kelatu leh mechitzot ka mashma lan

Tanu rabbanan im gaol yigal ish mimmaasro mimmaasro velo kol maasro perat lemaaser sheni sheen bo shave peruta itmar rav amme amar en bo rav assi amar en bechumsho rabbi yochanan amar en bo rabbi shimon ben lakish amar en bechumsho
Metivi maaser sheni sheen bo shave peruta dayyo sheyyomar hu vechumsho mechullal al maot rishonot
Bishlama leman deamar en bechumsho hayenu dekatane dayyo deaf al gav divdideh it beh kevan divchumsheh leka shappir ella leman deamar en bo may dayyo kashya
Ibaya lehu chumsha millegav o chumsha millevar amar ravina ta shema habbealim omrim beesrim vechol adam beesrim habbealim kodmin mippene shemmosifin chomesh amar echad hare alay beesrim veechad

a: Habbealim notnin esrim vashesh esrim ushnayim habbealim notnin esrim vasheva beesrim veshalosh habbealim notnin esrim ushmone beesrim vearba habbealim notnin esrim vatesha
Esrim vechamesh habbealim notnin sheloshim lefi sheen mosifin chomesh al iluy shel ze shema minah chumsha millevar shema minah
Ketannae veyasaf chamishito alav sheyehe hu vechumsho chamishsha divre rabbi yoshiyya rabbi yonatan omer chamishito chumsho shel keren
Ibaya lehu chomesh meakkev o eno meakkev arbea bearbea parek veakkenafsheh mosif chomesh alma chomesh la meakkev o dilma arbea bechamsha parek vechomesh meakkev
Amar ravina ta shema haddemay en lo chomesh veen lo biur
Ha keren yesh lo may tama keren dimakkev bidorayeta itah bidrabbanan chomesh dela meakkev bidorayeta letah bidrabbanan
Lema ketannae natan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh rabbi eliezer omer yochal rabbi yehoshua omer lo yochal amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi eliezer bashshabbat vedivre rabbi yehoshua bachol
Middeamar nirin divre rabbi eliezer bashshabbat mikkelal difligi afilu bechol middeamar nirin divre rabbi yehoshua bachol mikkelal difligi afilu beshabbat
May lav beha sevara kamipalgi derabbi eliezer savar chomesh la meakkev verabbi yehoshua savar chomesh meakkev
Amar rav pappa la dechulle alma chomesh la meakkev vehacha bechayeshinan lifshiuta kamipalgi mar savar chayeshinan lifshiuta umar savar la chayeshinan lifshiuta
Amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim behekdesh shechilel hoil vegizbarin tovin oto bashshuk

Uvhekdesh la peligi vehatanya natan et hakkeren velo natan lo et hachomesh rabbi eliezer omer chilel vachachamim omrim lo chilel amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi eliezer behekdesh vedivre chachamim bemaaser
Middeamar nirin divre rabbi eliezer behekdesh mikkelal diflig afilu bemaaser middekaamar nirin divre chachamim bemaaser mikkelal deinhu peligi afilu behekdesh
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim beshabbat behekdesh shechilel chada dichtiv vekarata lashshabbat oneg veod hoil vegizbarin tovin oto bashshuk
Amar rame bar chama hare amru hekdesh eno mitchallel al hakkarka derachamana amar venatan hakkesef vekam lo chumsho mahu sheyyitchallel al hakkarka
Teruma enah mishtallemet ella min hachullin derachamana amar venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh davar harauy lihot kodesh chumshah mahu sheyyishtallem shello min hachullin
Maaser en mitchallel al haasimon derachamana amar vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha lerabbot kol davar sheyyesh alav tzura chumsho mahu sheyyitchallel al haasimon
Itgalgal milleta umta lekammeh derava amar lehu amar kera alav lerabbot chumsho kemoto
Amar ravina af anan name tenena haggonev teruma velo achalah meshallem tashlume chefel deme teruma achalah meshallem shene keranim vachomesh keren vachomesh min hachullin vehakkeren deme teruma
b: Shema minah chumsho kemoto shema minah
Amar rava gabbe gazel ketiv vachamishitav yosef alav utnan natan lo et hakkeren venishba lo al hachomesh hare ze mosif chomesh al chomesh ad sheyyitmaet hakkeren pachot mishshave peruta

Gabbe teruma ketiv ish ki yochal kodesh bishgaga veyasaf chamishito alav utnan haochel teruma beshogeg meshallem keren vachomesh echad haochel veechad hashshote veechad hassach echad teruma tehora veechad teruma temea meshallem chumshah vechumsha dechumsha veilu gabbe maaser la michtav ketiv vela mitna tene vela iboye ibaya lan

Gabbe hekdesh ketiv veim hammakdish yigal et beto veyasaf chamishit kesef erkecha utnan happode et hekdesho mosif chomesh chumsha tenan chumsha dechumsha la tenan may gabbe teruma ketiv veyasaf gabbe kodesh name ha ketiv veyasaf

O dilma gabbe teruma ketiv veyasaf i shaklatte leh levav diveyasaf veshadet leh al chamishshito have leh chamishitav gabbe hekdesh ketiv veyasaf chamishit af al gav dechi shaklatte leh levav diveyasaf veshadet leh al chamishit sof sof have leh chamishito

Vetipok leh dehave leh hekdesh sheni veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi ahekdesh rishon mosif chomesh al hekdesh sheni en mosif chomesh amar leh rav pappi leravina hachi amar rava chomesh kitchilat hekdesh dame
May have alah amar rav tavome mishshemeh deabbaye amar kera veyasaf chamishit kesef erkecha makkish chumsho lechesef erko ma kesef erko mosif chomesh af kesef chumsho name mosif chomesh

Gufa amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi al hekdesh rishon mosif chomesh veal hekdesh sheni en mosif chomesh amar rava may tama derabbi yehoshua ben levi amar kera veim hammakdish yigal et beto hammakdish velo hammatpis

Tane tanna kammeh derabbi elazar veim babbehema hattemea ufada veerkecha ma behema temea meuchedet shettechilatah hekdesh vechullah lashshamayim umoalin bah af kol shettechilatah hekdesh vechullah lashshamayim moalin bah

Amar leh rabbi elazar letanna bishlama kullah lashshamayim lemaote kadashim kallim kevan deit lehu livalim begavayehu let behu meila ella techilat hekdesh lemaote may techilat hekdesh hu deit beh meila sof hekdesh let beh meila dilma leinyan chomesh kaamratte uchrabbi yehoshua ben levi amar leh in hachi kaamena
Amar leh rav ashe leravina behema temea bitchilat hekdesh itah

a: Beemtza hekdesh letah amar leh lefi sheenah besof hekdesh
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina beemtza hekdesh miha itah velosef name chomesh amar leh hare hu kesof hekdesh ma sof hekdesh eno mosif chomesh af emtza hekdesh eno mosif chomesh

Amar leh rav zutra bereh derav mari leravina may chazet dimdammet leh lesof hekdesh nedammeyeh litchilat hekdesh amar leh mistabbera lesof hekdesh hava leh ledammoye shekken nitpas minnitpas adderabba litchilat hekdesh hava leh ledammoye shekken davar sheyyesh acharav kedushsha middavar sheyyesh acharav kedushsha
Kidamar rava haola ola rishona hachi name hattemea temea rishona
Tanya keoteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi para zo tachat para shel hekdesh tallit zo tachat tallit shel hekdesh hekdesho paduy veyad hekdesh al haelona
Para zo bechamesh selaim tachat para shel hekdesh tallit zo bechamesh selaim tachat tallit shel hekdesh hekdesho paduy al hekdesh rishon mosif chomesh al hekdesh sheni en mosif chomesh
Matni haonaa arbaa kesef vehattaana shette kesef vehahodaa shave peruta

Chamesh perutot hen hahodaa shave peruta vehaishsha mitkaddeshet beshave peruta vehannehene beshave peruta min hahekdesh maal vehammotze shave peruta chayyav lehachriz vehaggozel et chavero shave peruta venishba lo yolichennu acharav afilu lemaday
Gema tenena chada zimna haonaa arbaa kesef meesrim vearbaa kesef lassela shetut lemikkach hattaana shette kesef vehahodaa shave peruta itztericha leh
Ha name tenena shevuat haddayyanin hattaana shette kesef vehahodaa shave peruta sefa itztericha leh dekatane chamesh perutot hen
Chamesh perutot hen ku velitne name haonaa peruta amar rav kahana zot omeret en onaa lifrutot
Velevi amar yesh onaa lifrutot vechen tane levi bematniteh chamesh perutot hen haonaa peruta vehahodaa peruta vekiddushe ishsha bifruta vegazel bifruta vishivat haddayyanin bifruta
Vetanna didan may tama la katane yeshivat haddayyanin tena leh gazel

Umi la tane gazel vekatane aveda hanach itztericha leh gazel haggozel mechavero shave peruta venishba lo yolichennu acharav vaafilu limdi aveda hammotze aveda shave peruta chayyav lehachriz veaf al gav dezal
Velevi may tama la tane aveda bifruta tena leh gazel
Umi la katane gazel vekatane yeshivat haddayyanin yeshivat haddayyanin itztericha leh leappoke midderav kattina deamar rav kattina bet din nizkakin afilu lefachot mishshave peruta
Velevi may tama la katane hekdesh bechullin kamayere bekadashim la kamayere
Ella tanna didan deka mayere bekadashim nitne maaser bifruta keman deamar en bechumsho peruta velitne chomesh maaser bifruta bekarna ka mayere bechomesh la ka mayere
Gufa amar rav kattina bet din nizkakin afilu lefachot mishshave peruta metiv rava veet asher chata min hakkodesh yeshallem
b: Lerabbot pachot mishshave peruta lehishavon lekodesh in aval lehedot la
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar amar rav kattina im huzkeku bet din leshave peruta gomrin afilu lefachot mishshave peruta techilat haddin baenan peruta gemar haddin la baenan peruta

Matni chamishsha chumshin hen ellu hen haochel teruma utrumat maaser utrumat maaser shel demay vehachalla vehabbikkurim mosif chomesh vehappode neta revai umaaser sheni shello mosif chomesh happode et hekdesho mosif chomesh hannehene shave peruta min hahekdesh mosif chomesh vehaggozel et chavero shave peruta venishba lo mosif chomesh
Gema amar rava kashya leh lerabbi elazar terumat maaser shel demay vechi asu chachamim chizuk ledivrehem keshel tora

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar asu chachamim chizuk ledivrehem keshel tora detanya hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam netano lah velo amar lah befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam yotzi vehavalad mamzer divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim en havalad mamzer ketzad yaase yittelennu mimmenna veyachazor veyittenennu lah bifne shenayim veyomar lah befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam

Ulrabbi meir mishshum delo amar lah befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam yotzi vehavalad mamzer in rabbi meir letameh deamar rav hamnuna mishshemeh deulla omer haya rabbi meir kal hamshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim begitin yotzi vehavalad mamzer

Metiv rav sheshet mechallelin oto kesef al kesef nechoshet al nechoshet kesef al nechoshet unchoshet al happerot veyachzor veyifde et happerot divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim yaalu perot veyochlu birushalayim

Umi mechallelinan kesef al nechoshet veha tenan sela shel maaser sheni veshel chullin shennitarvu mevi besela maot veomer kol makom sheyyeshnah sela shel maaser sheni mechullelet al maot hallalu uvorer et hayyafe shebbahen umchallelo aleha

a: Mippene sheamru mechallelin oto kesef al nechoshet middochak lo sheyekayyem ken ella shechozer umchallelan al hakkesef katane mihat mechallelin middochak middochak in shello middochak la
Amar rav yosef af al pi shemmekel rabbi meir befidono machmir hu baachilato detanya lo hittiru limkor demay ella lesiton bilvad uvaal habbayit ben kach uven kach tzarich leasser divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim echad hassiton veechad baal habbayit mocher vesholeach lachavero venoten lo bemattana veeno choshesh
Metiv ravina hallokeach min hannachtom measser min hachamma al hatztzonenet umin hatztzonenet al hachamma vaafilu middefusim harbe divre rabbi meir

Bishlama min hatztzonenet al hachamma kidrabbi ilay deamar rabbi ilay minnayin lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma shenneemar velo tisu alav chet baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu im eno kodesh nesiat chet lamma mikkan lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma
Ella afilu middefusim harbe lechush dilma ate leafroshe min hachiyyuv al happetur umin happetur al hachiyyuv

Amar abbaye rabbi elazar shappir ka kashya leh ushmuel la shappir ka meshanne leh dekashya leh lerabbi elazar mita devide shamayim umshanne leh shemuel mitat bet din dilma shane mitat bet din dachamira
Verav sheshet la shappir ka motev leh dekaamri inhu mita umotev rav sheshet lav dichtiv lo tuchal leechol bisharecha ulmay demotev rav sheshet rav yosef shappir ka meshanne leh
Ella ravina ad demotev minnachtom lesayya leh mippalter ditnan hallokeach min happalter measser min kol defus udfus divre rabbi meir
Ella may it lach lememar palter mittere telata gavra zaven nachtom name mechad gavra hu zaven
Rava amar shemuel shappir ka meshanne leh shem mita baolam

Matni ellu devarim sheen lahem onaa haavadim vehashshetarot vehakkarkaot vehahekdeshot en lahen tashlume chefel velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha shomer chinnam eno nishba venose sachar eno meshallem rabbi shimon omer
b: Kodashim shehu chayyav beachrautan yesh lahen onaa vesheeno chayyav beachrautan en lahen onaa rabbi yehuda omer af hammocher sefer tora behema umargalit en lahem onaa amru lo lo amru ella et ellu

Gema menahane mile detanu rabbanan vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha davar hannikne miyyad leyad yatzu karkaot sheenan metaltelim yatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot yatzu shetarot dichtiv vechi timkeru mimkar sheggufo machur vegufo kanuy yatzu shetarot sheen gufan machur veen gufan kanuy veenan omdin ella liraya shebbahem
Mikkan amru hammocher shetarotav levassam yesh lahem onaa peshita leappoke midderav kahana deamar en onaa lifrutot ka mashma lan yesh onaa lifrutot hekdeshot amar kera achiv achiv velo hekdesh
Matkef lah rabba bar memel kol hecha dichtiv yado yado mammash hu ella meatta dichtiv vayyikkach et kol artzo miyyado hachi name dechol ara bideh hava naket lah ella mershuto hacha name mershuto
Vechol hecha dichtiv yado lav yado mammash hu vehatanya im himmatze timmatze veyado en li ella yado gaggo chatzero vekarpefo minnayin talmud lomar im himmatze timmatze mikkol makom

Tama dichtav rachamana im himmatze timmatze ha lav hachi hava amena kol hecha dichtav yado yado mammash hu vetu tanya venatan beyadah en li ella yadah gaggah chatzerah vekarpefah minnayin talmud lomar venatan mikkol makom tama dichtav rachamana venatan ha lav hachi hava amena kol hecha dichtav yado yado mammash
Ella kol yado yado mammash hu veshane hatam deleka lememar hachi ella birshuto
Bae rabbi zera sechirut yesh lo onaa o en lo onaa mimkar amar rachamana aval lo sechirut o dilma la shena amar leh abbaye mi ketiv mimkar leolam mimkar setama ketiv vehay name beomeh mechira hi
Bae rava chittin uzraan bakkarka mahu yesh lahem onaa o en lahem onaa keman deshadyan bechadda damyan veyesh lahem onaa o dilma battelinhu al gav ara
Hechi dame ilema deamar ihu sheday bah shita vaato sahadi veamri dela sheda bah ella chamsha vehaamar rava kol davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan afilu pachot mikkede onaa chozer
Ella deamar ihu sheday bah kidibbei lah veigallay milta dela sheda bah kidibbei lah yesh lahem onaa o en lahem onaa keman dishde bechadda damyan veyesh lahem onaa o dilma battelinhu aggav ara
Nishbain alehen o en nishbain alehen keman deshadyan bechadda damyan venishbain alehen o dilma battelinhu aggav ara veen nishbain alehen
Omer mattiran o en omer mattiran hechi dame i deashrush tenena i dela ashrush tenena ditnan im hishrishu kodem laomer omer mattiran veim lav asurin ad sheyyavo omer habba
La tzericha dechatzdinhu vezarinhu kodem laomer vaata leh omer vachalef ilavayehu vela ashrush kodem laomer

a: Mahu leminkat umechal minayehu keman deshadyan bechadda dame ushrinhu omer o dilma battelinhu aggav ara teku

Amar rava amar rav chassa bae rabbi amme onaa en lahem bitul mikkach yesh lahem o en lahen amar rav nachman hadar amar rav chassa pashet rabbi amme onaa en lahem bitul mikkach yesh lahem rabbi yona amar ahekdeshot rabbi yirmeya amar akkarkaot vetarvayehu mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amru onaa en lahem bitul mikkach yesh lahen
Man deamar ahekdeshot kol shekken akkarkaot man deamar akkarkaot aval ahekdeshot la kedishmuel deamar shemuel hekdesh shave mane shechillo al shave peruta mechullal

Tenan hatam im haya kodesh baal mum yatza lechullin vetzarich laasot lo damim amar rabbi yochanan yatza lechullin devar tora vetzarich laasot lo damim middivrehem veresh lakish amar af tzarich laasot lo damim min hattora
Bemay askinan ilema bichde onaa beha lema resh lakish tzarich laasot lo damim devar tora vehatnan ellu devarim sheen lahem onaa hakkarkaot vehaavadim vehashshetarot vehahekdeshot

Ella bitul mikkach beha lema rabbi yochanan tzarich laasot lo damim middivrehem vehaamar rabbi yona ahekdeshot verabbi yirmeya amar akkarkaot vetarvayehu mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amri onaa en lahem bitul mikkach yesh lahem leolam bevitul mikkach veefoch derabbi yochanan leresh lakish udresh lakish lerabbi yochanan
Bemay kamipalgi bedishmuel deamar shemuel hekdesh shave mane shechillo al shave peruta mechullal mar it leh dishmuel umar let leh dishmuel
Ibaet ema dechulle alma it lehu dishmuel vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar shechillo in lechattechila la umar savar afilu lechattechilla
Ibaet ema leolam bichde onaa vela tefoch uvidrav chisda kamipalgi deamar may en lahem onaa enan betorat onaa
b: Daafilu pachot mikkede onaa chozer
Metivi ribbit veonaa lahedot veen ribbit veonaa lahekdesh mi allima mimmatnitin deokemna betorat onaa hachi name ribbit vedin onaa lahedot veen ribbit vedin onaa lahekdesh
I hachi hayenu dekatane sefa ze chomer bahedot mibbahekdesh aribbit litne name ze chomer bahekdesh mibbahedot aonaa
Hachi hashta bishlama ze chomer bahedot mibbahekdesh vetu la ella hekdesh ze chomer vetu la
Ribbit dehekdesh hechi dame ilema deozfeh gizbar mea bemea veesrim vahalo maal haggizbar vechevan shemmaal haggizbar yatzu meotav lechullin vehau lehu dehedot

Amar rav hoshaya hacha bemay askinan kegon shekkibel alav lesappek selatot mearba veamdu mishshalosh kidtanya hamkabbel alav lesappek selatot mearba veamdu mishshalosh mesappek mearba mishshalosh veamdu mearba mesappek mearba sheyyad hekdesh al haelona
Rav pappa amar hacha beavne vinyan hammesurot legizbar askinan kedishmuel deamar shemuel bonin bachol veachar kach makdishin
En bahen tashlume chefel vechu menahane mile detanu rabbanan al kol devar pesha kelal al shor al chamor al se al salma perat al kol aveda asher yomar chazar vechalal
Kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon
Yatzu karkaot sheenan mittaltelin yatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot yatzu shetarot sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin en gufan mamon hekdeshot amar kera reehu reehu velo hekdesh
Velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vechu may tama tashlume arbaa vachamishsha amar rachamana velo tashlume shelosha vearbaa
Shomer chinnam eno nishba vechu menahane mile detanu rabbanan ki yitten ish el reehu kelal kesef o kelim perat vegunnav mibbet haish chazar vechalal
Kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon
Yatzu karkaot sheenan mittaltelin yatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot yatzu shetarot sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin en gufan mamon hekdeshot amar kera reehu reehu velo shel hekdesh
Nose sachar eno meshallem vechu menahane mile detanu rabbanan ki yitten ish el reehu kelal chamor o shor o se parat vechol behema lishmor chazar vechalal
Kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon
Yatzu karkaot sheenan mittaltelin yatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot yatzu shetarot sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin en gufan mamon hekdeshot amar kera reehu reehu velo shel hekdesh
Shomer chinnam eno nishba vechu urminhu bene hair sheshshalchu et shiklehen venignevu o sheavdu
Im mishshennitrema hatteruma

a: Nishbain laggizbarin veim lav nishbain livne hair uvne hair shoklin acherim tachtehen nimtzeu o shehechzirum haggannavim ellu veellu shekalim hem veen olin lahem lashshana habbaa

Amar shemuel hacha benose sachar askinan venishbain litol secharan i hachi nishbain laggizbarin livne hair mibbee leh amar rabba nishbain livne hair bemaamad gizbarin ki hechi dela nichshedinhu vei name ki hechi dela likro lehu poshim
Veha nignevu o sheavdu katane veshomer sachar bigneva vaaveda chayyove michayyav vehacha name nehi deshallome la meshallemi agrayehu miha lafsed
Amar rabba nignevu belistim mezuyyan avdu shettava sefinato bayyam
Rabbi yochanan amar ha manni rabbi shimon hi deamar kadashim shechayyav beachrautan yesh lahen onaa venishbain alehem
Hatinach ad shello nitrema hatteruma mishshennitrema hatteruma kadashim sheeno chayyav beachrautan ninhu detanya tormin al haavud veal haggavuy veal heatid liggavot
Ella amar rabbi elazar shevua zo takkanat chachamim hi shello yehu bene adam mezalzelim bahekdeshot

Nose sachar eno meshallem rame leh rav yosef bar chama lerabba tenan nose sachar eno meshallem urminhu hassocher et happoel lishmor et happara lishmor et hattinok lishmor et hazzeraim en notnim lo sechar shabbat lefichach en achraut shabbat alav
Haya sechir shabbat sechir chodesh sechir shana sechir shavua notnin lo sechar shabbat lefichach achraut shabbat alav may lav leshallem
La lehafsid secharo i hachi resha dekatane en achraut shabbat alav hachi name dilhafsid secharo umi it leh sechar shabbat veha katane en notnin lo sechar shabbat ishtik
Amar leh mide shemia lach beha amar leh hachi amar rav sheshet beshekkanu miyyado vechen amar rabbi yochanan beshekkanu miyyado
Rabbi shimon omer kadashim shechayyav beachrautan yesh lahen onaa vesheeno chayyav beachrautan en lahen onaa tane tanna kammeh derabbi yitzchak bar abba
Kadashim shechayyav beachrautan chayyav sheani kore bahen ba vechichesh vesheeno chayyav beachrautan patur sheani kore bahen baamito vechichesh
Amar leh kelappe leya
b: Ipcha mistabbera amar leh esmeyah
Amar leh la hachi kaamar kadashim shechayyav beachrautan chayyav deitrabbu mibba vechichesh vesheeno chayyav beachrautan patur deimmeit mibbaamito vechichesh

Rabbi yehuda omer af hammocher sefer tora margalit uvhema en lahem onaa tanya rabbi yehuda omer af hammocher sefer tora en lah onaa lefi sheen ketz ledameha behema umargalit en lahem onaa mippene sheadam rotze lezavvegan
Amru lo vahalo hakkol adam rotze lezavvegan verabbi yehuda hane chashivi leh vehane la chashivi leh vead kamma amar ammemar ad kede demehem
Tanya rabbi yehuda ben betera omer af hammocher sus vesayif vachatitom bammilchama en lahem onaa mippene sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh

Matni keshem sheonaa bemikkach umimkar kach onaa bidvarim lo yomar lo bechamma chefetz ze vehu eno rotze likach im haya baal teshuva lo yomar lo zechor maasecha harishonim im hu ben gerim lo yomar lo zechor maase avotecha shenneemar veger lo tone velo tilchatzennu

Gema tanu rabbanan lo tonu ish et amito beonaat devarim hakkatuv medabber atta omer beonaat devarim o eno ella beonaat mamon keshehu omer vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha hare onaat mamon amur ha ma ani mekayyem lo tonu ish et amito beonaat devarim

Ha ketzad im haya baal teshuva al yomar lo zechor maasecha harishonim im haya ben gerim al yomar lo zechor maase avotecha im haya ger uva lilmod tora al yomar lo pe sheachal nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim ba lilmod tora shenneemra mippi haggevura

Im hau yissurin bain alav im hau cholaim bain alav o shehaya mekabber et banav al yomar lo kederech sheamru lo chaverav leiyyov halo yiratcha kislatecha tikvatcha vetom derachecha zechor na mi hu naki avad

Im hau chammarim mevakkeshin tevua mimmennu lo yomar lahem lechu etzel peloni shehu mocher tevua veodea bo shello machar meolam rabbi yehuda omer af lo yitle enav al hammikkach beshaa sheen lo damim shehare haddavar masur lallev vechol davar hammasur lallev neemar bo veyareta meelohecha

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay gadol onaat devarim meonaat mamon shezze neemar bo veyareta meelohecha veze lo neemar bo veyareta meelohecha verabbi elazar omer ze begufo veze bemamono rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar ze nitan lehishavon veze lo nitan lehishavon

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman bar yitzchak kol hammalbin pene chavero barabbim keilu shofech damim amar leh shappir ka amratte dechazena leh deazel summaka veate chiuora amar leh abbaye lerav dimi bemareva bemay zehiri amar leh beachore appe deamar rabbi chanina hakkol yordin legehinnam chutz mishshelosha

Hakkol salka datach ella ema kal hayyordin legehinnam olim chutz mishshelosha sheyyordin veen olin veellu hen habba al eshet ish vehammalbin pene chavero barabbim vehamchanne shem ra lachavero mechanne hayenu malbin af al gav dedash beh bishmeh
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan

a: Noach lo leadam sheyyavo al sefek eshet ish veal yalbin pene chavero barabbim mena lan middedaresh rava dedaresh rava may dichtiv uvtzali samchu veneesafu karu velo dammu amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam galuy veyadua lefanecha sheim hau mekarim besari lo haya dami shotet laaretz

Velo od ella afilu beshaa sheoskin bingaim veohalot omrim li david habba al eshet ish mitato bamme vaani omer lahem mitato bechenek veyesh lo chelek laolam habba aval hammalbin et pene chavero barabbim en lo chelek laolam habba

Veamar mar zutra bar toviyya amar rav veamri lah amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida veamri lah amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay noach lo leadam sheyyappil atzmo lechivshan haesh veal yalbin pene chavero barabbim mena lan mittamar dichtiv hi mutzet vehi shalcha el chamiha

Amar rav chinnana bereh derav idi may dichtiv velo tonu ish et amito am sheittecha betora uvammitzot al tonehu amar rav leolam yehe adam zahir beonaat ishto shemmittoch sheddimatah metzuya onaatah kerova

Amar rabbi elazar miyyom shennechrav bet hammikdash ninalu shaare tefila shenneemar gam ki ezak vaashavea satam tefilati veaf al pi sheshshaare tefila ninalu shaare demaot lo ninalu shenneemar shima tefillati Adonai veshaveati haazina el dimati al techerash

Veamar rav kol haholech baatzat ishto nofel begehinnam shenneemar rak lo haya cheachav vego amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veha amri inashe ittach gutza gechen vetilchosh lah la kashya ha bemile dealma veha bemile deveta lishana acharina ha bemile dishmayya veha bemile dealma

Amar rav chisda kol hashshearim ninalim chutz mishshaare onaa shenneemar hinne Adonai nitztzav al chomat anach uvyado anach amar rabbi elazar hakkol nifra bide shaliach chutz meonaa shenneemar uvyado anach

Amar rabbi avahu shelosha en happargod ninal bifnehem onaa vegazel vaavoda zara onaa dichtiv uvyado anach gazel dichtiv chamas vashod yishshama bah al panay tamid avoda zara dichtiv haam hammachisim oti al panay tamid vego

Amar rav yehuda leolam yehe adam zahir bitvua betoch beto sheen meriva metzuya betoch beto shel adam ella al iske tevua shenneemar hassam gevulech shalom chelev chittim yasbiech amar rav pappa hayenu deamri inashe kemishlam seare mikkadda nakesh veate tigra beveta

Veamar rav chinana bar pappa leolam yehe adam zahir bitvua betoch beto shello nikreu yisrael dallim ella al iske tevua shenneemar vehaya im zara yisrael vego uchtiv vayyachanu alehem vego uchtiv vayyiddal yisrael meod mippene midyan

Veamar rabbi chelbo leolam yehe adam zahir bichvod ishto sheen beracha metzuya betoch beto shel adam ella bishvil ishto shenneemar ulavram hetiv baavurah vehayenu daamar lehu rava livne machoza okiru linshayechu ki hechi detitatteru
Tenan hatam chatacho chulot venatan chol ben chulya lechulya rabbi eliezer metaher vachachamim metammein
b: Veze hu tannur shel achnay may achnay amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shehikkifuhu devarim keachna zo vetimmeuhu tana beoto hayyom heshiv rabbi eliezer kol teshuvot shebbaolam velo kiblu hemennu

Amar lahem im halacha kemoti charuv ze yochiach neekar charuv mimmekomo mea amma veamri lah arba meot amma amru lo en meviin reaya min hecharuv chazar veamar lahem im halacha kemoti ammat hammayim yochichu chazru ammat hammayim laachorehem amru lo en meviin reaya meammat hammayim

Chazar veamar lahem im halacha kemoti kotle bet hammidrash yochichu hittu kotle bet hammidrash lipol gaar bahem rabbi yehoshua amar lahem im talmide chachamim menatztzechim ze et ze bahalacha attem ma tivchem lo naflu mippene chevodo shel rabbi yehoshua velo zakfu mippene chevodo shel rabbi eliezer vaadayin mattin veomdin
Chazar veamar lahem im halacha kemoti min hashshamayim yochichu yatzata bat kol veamra ma lachem etzel rabbi eliezer shehalacha kemoto bechol makom

Amad rabbi yehoshua al raglav veamar lo vashshamayim hi may lo bashshamayim hi amar rabbi yirmeya shekkevar nittena tora mehar sinay en anu mashgichin bevat kol shekkevar katavta behar sinay battora achare rabbim lehattot ashkecheh rabbi natan leeliyyahu amar leh may aved kudsha berich hu behahi shata amar leh ka chayech veamar nitztzechuni banay nitztzechuni banay

Amru oto hayyom heviu kol teharot shettiher rabbi eliezer usrafum baesh venimnu alav uverchuhu veamru mi yelech veodio amar lahem rabbi akiva ani elech shemma yelech adam sheeno hagun veodio venimtza machriv et kal haolam kullo

Ma asa rabbi akiva lavash shechorim venitattef shechorim veyashav lefanav berichuk arba ammot amar lo rabbi eliezer akiva ma yom miyyamim amar lo rabbi kimdumme li shechaverim bedelim mimmecha af hu kara begadav vechalatz minalav venishmat veyashav al gabbe karka

Zalgu enav demaot laka haolam shelish bezetim ushlish bechittim ushlish bisorim veyesh omrim af batzek shebbide ishsha tafach tana af gadol haya beoto hayyom shebbechal makom shennatan bo enav rabbi eliezer nisraf

Veaf rabban gamliel haya ba bisfina amad alav nachshol letabbeo amar kimdumme li sheen ze ella bishvil rabbi eliezer ben hurkanos amad al raglav veamar ribbono shel olam galuy veyadua lefanecha shello lichvodi asiti velo lichvod bet abba asiti ella lichvodcha shello yirbu machlokot beyisrael nach hayyam mizzapo

Ima shalom devethu derabbi eliezer achateh derabban gamliel havay mehahu maase veelach la hava shavka leh lerabbi eliezer lemipal al appeh hahu yoma resh yarcha hava veichallaf lah ben male lechaser ika deamri ata anya vekae abbava appika leh rifta

Ashkachteh denafel al anpeh amara leh kum ketalteh leach addehachi nefak shipura mibbet rabban gamliel dishchev amar lah mena yedate amara leh kach mekubbelani mibbet avi abba kol hashshearim ninalim chutz mishshaare onaa
Tanu rabbanan hamanne et hagger over bishlosha lavin vehallochatzo over bishnayim

May shena meanne dichtivi shelosha lavin veger lo tone vechi yagur ittecha ger beartzechem lo tonu oto velo tonu ish et amito veger bichlal amito hu lochatzo name shelosha ketivi velo tilchatzennu veger lo tilchatz velo tihye lo kenoshe veger bakkelal hu ella echad ze veechad ze bishlosha
Tanya rabbi eliezer haggadol omer mippene ma hizhira tora bishloshim veshishsha mekomot veamri lah bearbaim veshishsha mekomot beger mippene shessoro ra

May dichtiv veger lo tone velo tilchatzennu ki gerim heyitem beeretz mitzrayim tenena rabbi natan omer mum shebbecha al tomar lachaverecha vehayenu deamri inashe dizkif leh zekifa bidutkeh la nema leh lechavreh zekef binita
Matni en mearvin perot beferot afilu chadashim bachadashim

a: Veen tzarich lomar chadashim bishanim
Beemet amru beyayin hittiru learev kashe berach mippene shehu mashbicho en mearvin shimre yayin beyayin aval noten lo et shemarav
Mi shennitarev mayim beyeno lo yimkerennu bachanut ella im ken hodio velo lattaggar af al pi shehodio sheeno ella lerammot bo makom shennahagu lehatil mayim bayyayin yatilu
Hattaggar notel mechamesh goranot venoten letoch megura achat mechamesh gittot venoten letoch pitom echad uvilvad shello yehe mitkaven learev
Gema tanu rabbanan en tzarich lomar chadashot mearba vishanot mishshalosh deen mearvin ella afilu chadashot mishshalosh vishanot mearba en mearvin mippene sheadam rotze leyashshenan
Beemet amru bayyayin hittiru learev kashe berach mippene shehu mashbicho vechu amar rabbi elazar ada amra kol beemet amru halacha hi
Amar rav nachman uven haggitot shanu
Vehaidana deka mearvi shello ben haggitot amar rav pappa deyadi veka machali rav acha bereh derav ika amar ha manni rabbi acha hi detanya rabbi acha mattir bedavar hannitam

Veen mearvin shimre yayin beyayin aval noten lo et shemarav vechu veha amratte resha en mearvin kelal vechi tema may noten lo et shemarav deka moda leh ha middekatane sefa lo yimkerennu bachanut ella im ken modio velo lattaggar af al pi shemmodio mikkelal deresha af al gav dela moda leh

Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar en mearvin shemarim shel emesh beshel yom velo shel yom beshel emesh aval noten lo et shemarav tanya name hachi rabbi yehuda omer hashshofe yayin lachavero hare ze lo yearev shel emesh beshel yom velo shel yom beshel emesh aval mearev shel emesh beshel emesh veshel yom beshel yom

Mi shennitarev mayim beyeno hare ze lo yimkerennu bachanut ella im ken modio vechu rava ayeto leh chamra mechanuta mazgeh tameh la hava besim shaddereh lechanuta amar leh abbaye veha anan tenan velo lattaggar af al pi shehodio amar leh mizga didi mida yedia vechi tema detafe umchayeleh umzabben leh im ken en laddavar sof
Makom shennahagu lehattil mayim bayyayin yatilu vechu tana lemechetza lishlish velirvia amar rav uven haggitot shanu
Matni rabbi yehuda omer lo yechallek hachenvani kelaot veegozin lattinokot mippene shehu margilan lavo etzlo vachachamim mattirin velo yifchot et hashshaar vachachamim omrim zachur lattov
Lo yavor et haggerisin divre abba shaul vachachamim mattirin umodim shello yavor meal pi megura sheeno ella kegonev et haayin en mefarkesin lo et haadam velo et habbehema velo et hakkelim
Gema may tamayehu derabbanan daamar leh ana mefallegna amgoze veatte palleg shiske
Velo yifchot et hashshaar vachachamim omrim zachur lattov vechu may tama derabbanan
b: Mishshum deka marvach letara
Velo yavor et haggerisin divre abba shaul vachachamim mattirin vechu man chachamim rabbi acha detanya rabbi acha mattir bedavar hannire

En mefarkesin lo et haadam vechu velo et hakkelim tanu rabbanan en mesharbetin et habbehema veen nofchin bakkeravayim veen shorin et habbasar bammayim may en mesharbetin hacha targimu mayya dechizra zeeri amar rav kahana mazkafta

Shemuel shera lemirme tume lesarbala rav yehuda shera lechaskose kirme rabba shera lemidak tzarde tzadre rava shera letzallome gire rav pappa bar shemuel shera letzallome dikule veha anan tenan en mefarkesin lo et haadam velo et habbehema velo et hakkelim la kashya ha bechadte ha beattike
Pirkus deadam may hi ki ha dehahu avda sava daazal tzaveh leresheh uldikneh ata lekammeh derava amar leh zivnan amar leh yihu aniyyim bene vetecha

Ata lekammeh derav pappa bar shemuel zavneh yoma chad amar leh ashkeyan mayya azal chavvereh leresheh uldikneh amar leh chazi daana kashshish meavuch kare annafsheh tzaddik mitztzara nechelatz vayyavo acher tachtav
Hadaran alach hazzahav
Matni ezehu neshech veezehu tarbit
Ezehu neshech hammalve sela bachamishsha dinarin satayim chittin beshalosh asur mippene shehu noshech
Veezehu tarbit hammarbe beferot ketzad lakach hemennu chittin bedinar zahav hakkor vechen hashshaar amdu chittin bishloshim dinarin
Amar lo ten li chittay sheani rotze lemochran velikach bahen yayin amar lo hare chittecha asuot alay bishloshim vahare lecha etzli bahen yayin veyayin en lo
Gema middeshavek leribit deorayeta veka mefaresh derabbanan mikkelal deorayeta deneshecha vetarbit chada milleta hi veha kerae ketivi neshech kesef veribit ochel
Vetisbera deika neshech belo tarbit vetarbit belo neshech neshech belo tarbit hechi dame

I deozfeh mea bima veesrim meikara kayemi mea bedanka ulvassof kayemi mea veesrim bedanka neshech ika deka nachet leh deka shakel mineh mide dela yahev vetarbit leka delet leh ravecha dedanka ozfeh vedanka ka shakel mineh
Sof sof i batar meikara azlatte hare neshech vahare tarbit i batar besof azlatte la neshech ika vela tarbit ika
Vetu tarbit belo neshech hechi dame i deozef mea bima meikara kayemi mea bedanka ulvassof mea bechumsha
I batar meikara azlatte la neshech ika vela tarbit ika i batar sof azlatte hare neshech vahare tarbit
Ella amar rava i atta motze lo neshech belo tarbit velo tarbit belo neshech velo chillekan hakkatuv ella laavor alav bishne lavin

Tanu rabbanan et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech uvmarbit lo titten ochlecha en li ella neshech bechesef veribbit beochel neshech beochel minnayin talmud lomar neshech ochel ribbit bechesef minnayin talmud lomar neshech kesef

a: Im eno inyan leneshech kesef shehare kevar neemar lo tashshich leachicha tenehu inyan leribbit kesef
En li ella belove bemalve minnayin

Neemar neshech ballove veneemar neshech bammalve ma neshech haamur ballove lo chillakta bo ben bechesef ben beochel ben beneshech ben beribbit af neshech haamur bammalve lo tachlok bo ben bechesef ben beochel ben beneshech ben beribbit minnayin lerabbot kol davar talmud lomar neshech kol davar asher yishshach

Ravina amar la neshech beochel vela ribbit bechesef tzerichi kera dei ketiv et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech veochlecha bemarbit kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech uvmarbit lo titten ochlecha keri beh hachi et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech uvmarbit uvneshech uvmarbit lo titten ochlecha
Veha tanna neemar neemar kaamar
Hachi kaamar ilu lo neemar kera hayiti omer gezera shava achshav shenneemar kera gezera shava la tzerich ella gezera shava lema li leneshech kol davar asher yishshach dela ketiv bemalve
Amar rava lema li dichtav rachamana lav beribbit lav begazel lav beonaa
Tzerichi dei ketav rachamana lav beribbit mishshum dechidush hu daafilu belove asra rachamana
Vei ketav rachamana lav begazel mishshum dival kurcheh aval onaa ema la
Vei ketav rachamana lav beonaa mishshum dela yada demachel
Chada mechada la atya tete chada mittarte he tete la lichtov rachamana lav beribbit vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken shello middaat tomar beribbit demiddateh
La lichtov rachamana lav beonaa vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken en derech mikkach umimkar bechach
Ella la lichtov rachamana lav begazel vetete mehanach demay parchatte ma leribbit shekken chidush onaa tochiach
Ma leonaa shekken la yada umachel ribbit tochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken gozlo af ani avi gazel
Amri hachi name ella lav begazel lema li lechovesh sechar sachir
Kovesh sechar sachir behedya ketiv beh lo taashok sachir ani veevon laavor alav bishne lavin
Velokmah beribbit veonaa velaavor alav bishne lavin davar hallamed meinyano
b: Uvinyana desachir ketiv
Lo tignovu dichtav rachamana lema li lechidtanya lo tignov al menat lemekat lo tignov al menat leshallem tashlume chefel
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe lav dichtav rachamana bemishkalot lema li amar leh letomen mishkelotav bemelach hayenu gazel mealleya hu laavor alav mishsheat asiyya

Tanu rabbanan lo taasu avel bammishpat bammidda bammishkal uvammesura bammidda zo medidat karka shello yimdod leechad bimot hachamma ulechad bimot haggeshamim bammishkal shello yatmin mishkelotav bemelach uvammesura shello yartiach
Vahalo devarim kal vechomer uma mesura shehi echad mishsheloshim ushlosha ballog hikpida alav tora kal vechomer lehin vachatzi hin ushlishit hin urviit hahin velog vachatzi log urviit hallog
Amar rava lema li dichtav rachamana yetziat mitzrayim beribbit yetziat mitzrayim gabbe tzitzit yetziat mitzrayim bemishkalot

Amar hakkadosh baruch hu ani hu shehivchanti bemitzrayim ben tippa shel bechor letippa sheenah shel bechor ani hu sheatid lipara mimmi shettole meotav begoy umalva otam leyisrael beribbit umimmi shettomen mishkelotav bemelach umimmi shettole kala ilan bevigdo veomer techelet hu

Ravina ikla lesura difrat amar leh rav chanina missura difrat leravina yetziat mitzrayim dichtav rachamana gabbe sheratzim lema li amar leh amar hakkadosh baruch hu ani hu shehivchanti ben tippa shel bechor letippa sheenah shel bechor ani atid lipara mimmi shemmearev kirve dagim temein bekirve dagim tehorin umochran leyisrael
Amar leh ana hammaale ka kashya li may shena hacha hammaale dichtav rachamana
Amar leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael amar hakkadosh baruch hu ilmale lo heeleti et yisrael mimmitzrayim ella bishvil davar ze sheen metammein bishratzim dayyi
Amar leh umi nefish agrayehu tefe meribbit umitztzitzit umimmishkalot amar leh af al gav dela nefish agrayehu tefe meisi lemechlinhu
Veezehu tarbit hammarbe beferot ketzad lakach hemennu chittim bedinar zahav vechu attu kol hane deamrinan ad hashta lav ribbit hu
Amar rabbi avahu ad kan shel tora mikkan veelach shel divrehem vechen amar rava ad kan shel tora mikkan veelach shel divrehem
Ad kan yachin rasha veyilbash tzaddik ad kan vetu la ella afilu ad kan yachin rasha veyilbash tzaddik
Ad kan ribbit ketzutza mikkan veelach avak ribbit
Amar rabbi elazar ribbit ketzutza yotza bedayyanin avak ribbit enah yotza bedayyanin rabbi yochanan amar afilu ribbit ketzutza name enah yotza bedayyanin

Amar rabbi yitzchak may tama derabbi yochanan deamar kera banneshech natan vetarbit lakach vachay lo yichye et kol hattoevot haelle asa lemita nitan velo lehishavon rav adda bar ahava amar amar kera el tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit veyareta meelohecha lemora nitan velo lehishshavon
Rava amar miggufeh dikra shemia leh mot yumat damav bo yihye hukshu malve ribbit leshofche damim ma shofche damim lo nitnu lehishshavon af malve ribbit lo natnu lehishshavon
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak may tama derabbi elazar deamar kera

a: Veche achicha immach ahdar leh ki hechi deneche

Verabbi yochanan hay veche achicha immach may aved leh mibbee leh lechidtanya shenayim shehau mehallechin badderech uvyad echad mehen kiton shel mayim im shotin shenehem metim veim shote echad mehen maggia layyishshuv darash ben petora mutav sheyyishtu shenehem veyamutu veal yire echad mehem bemitato shel chavero ad shebba rabbi akiva velimed veche achicha immach chayyecha kodmim lechayye chaverecha
Metivi hinniach lahem avihem maot shel ribbit af al pi sheyyodim shehen shel ribbit enan chayyavin lehachziran ha avihen chayyav lehachzir
Bedin hu daavuhon name la michayyav lehachzir veayede deka vae lemitne sefa hinniach lahen avihem para vetallit vechol davar hamsuyyam chayyavin lehachzir mippene kevod avihem tane name resha bedidhu
Vehane mippene kevod avihem mi michayevi keri kan venasi veammecha lo taor beose maase ammecha
Kidamar rabbi pinchas mishshemeh derava besheasa teshuva hacha name besheasa teshuva i asa teshuva may bae gabbeh shello hispik lehachzir ad shemmet

Metivi haggazlanin umalve ribbit af al pi sheggavu machzirin gazlanim may af al pi sheggavu ika i gezul gezul i la gezul gazlanin karet lehu ella ema gazlanin may nihu malve ribbit af al pi sheggavu machzirin
Tannae hi detanya rabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer ben yaakov potrin et hammalve veet hearev mippene sheyyesh bahen kum ase may kum ase lav mishshum deamrinan lehu kumu ahaduru
Mikkelal detanna kamma savar lav bene ahdore ninhu la may kum ase likroa shetara
May kasavar i kasavar shetar haomed ligbot kegavuy dame veha avadu isurayehu vei lav kegavuy dame ha la avud velo kelum
Leolam kasavar shetar haomed ligbot lav kegavuy dame veha ka mashma lan desuma milta hi
Hachi name mistabbera ditnan veellu ovrim belo taase hammalve vehallove hearev vehaedim bishlama kullehu avud maase ella edim may avud ella lav shema minah desuma milta hi shema minah
Amar rav safra kol sheilu bedinehem motziim millove lemalve bedinenu machzirin mimmalve lelove kol sheilu bedinehem en motziin millove lemalve bedinenu en machzirin mimmalve lelove
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef uchlala hu vahare sea bisa divdinehem motziin millove lemalve uvdinenu en machzirin mimmalve lelove amar leh inhu betorat pikkadon ata lideh
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe vahare mashkanta bela nachyeta divdinehem motziin millove lemalve
b: Uvdinenu en machzirin mimmalve lelove amar leh inhu betorat zevine ata lidayehu

Ella kol sheilu bedinehen dekaamar rav safra may ata leashmoinan hachi ata leashmoinan kol sheilu bedinehen motziin millove lemalve bedinenu machzirin mimmalve lelove umay nihu beribbit ketzutza vechidrabbi elazar
Kol sheilu bedinehem en motziin bedinenu en machzirin ribbit mukdemet ribbit meucheret
Ketzad lakach hemennu chittim bedinar zahav hakkor vechen hashshaar vechu vechi en lo yayin may have
Vehatanya en poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar yatza hashshaar poskin af al pi sheen laze yesh laze
Amar rabba matnitin beva lachuv bidmehen askinan

Vechidtanya hare shehaya noshe bachavero mane vehalach veamad al gorno veomer ten li meotay sheani rotze likach bahem chittim amar lo chittim yesh li sheani noten lecha tze vaase alay keshaar shel achshav vaani aale lecha kol shenem asar chodesh asur delav keisaro habba leyado dame
Amar leh abbaye i dela keisaro habba leyado may irya en lo afilu yesh lo name ella amar abbaye matnitin kidtane rav safra beribbit deve rabbi chiyya

Detane rav safra beribbit deve rabbi chiyya yesh devarim shehem muttarin vaasurin mippene haaramat ribbit ketzad amar lo halveni mane amar lo mane en li chittin bemane yesh li sheani noten lach natan lo chittin bemane vechazar ulkachan hemennu beesrim vearba sela muttar veasur laasot ken mippene haaramat ribbit

Hacha name kegon deamar halveni sheloshim dinarim amar leh sheloshim dinarim en li chittin bishloshim dinarim yesh li sheani noten lach natan lo chittin bishloshim dinarim vechazar ulkacham hemennu bedinar zahav i it leh chamra lelove deyahev leh bishloshim dinar pera hu deka shakel mineh velet lan bah vei la kevan delet leh chamra vadday mishkal zuze mineh michaze keribbit

Amar leh rava i hachi ten li chitay deme chitay mibbee leh teni deme chitay sheani mochran shemmechartim lach mibbaya leh teni shemmechartim lach hare chittecha asuot alay bishloshim dinarin meikara name hachi okminhu ilaveh hachi kaamar leh bidme chittecha sheasita alay bishloshim dinar
Hare lach etzli bahen yayin veyayin en lo veha bedinar zahav hakkor vechen hashshaar katane ella amar rava ki shachevna rabbi oshaya nefak leoti

a: Dimtaratzna matnitin keoteh

Detane rabbi oshaya hare shehaya noshe bachavero mane vehalach veamad al gorno veamar ten li meotay sheani rotze likach bahen chittin veamar lo chittin yesh li sheani noten lecha tze vaasaen alay keshaar shel achshav higgia zeman chittin limkor amar lo ten li chittin sheani rotze lemochran velikach bahen yayin amar lo yesh li yayin sheani noten lecha tze vaasaen alay keshaar shel achshav

Higgia zeman yayin limkor veamar lo ten li yeni sheani rotze lemochro velikach bo shemen amar lo shemen yesh li sheani noten lecha tze vaasehu alay keshaar shel achshav kullam im yesh lo muttar en lo asur umay lakach lakach behalvaato
Amar rava shema minah midderabbi oshaya telat shema minah demaamidin milve al gabbe perot vela amrinan dela keisaro habba leyado hu ushma minah hu deyesh lo ushma minah itah lidrabbi yannay
Deamar rabbi yannay ma li hen ma li demehen
Deittemar rav amar osin amana beferot veen osin amana bedamim verabbi yannay amar ma li hen uma li demehen
Metivi kullam im yesh lo muttar amar rav huna amar rav beshemmashach i beshemmashach tzericha lememar ella kegon sheyyiched lo keren zavit
Ushmuel amar ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar tzad echad beribbit muttar
Detanya hare shehaya noshe bachavero mane veasa lo sadehu mecher bizman shehammocher ochel perot muttar lokeach ochel perot asur rabbi yehuda omer af bizman shehallokeach ochel perot muttar
Amar lahem rabbi yehuda maase bevayetos ben zonin sheasa sadehu mecher al pi rabbi elazar ben azarya velokeach ochel perot haya amru lo mishsham reaya mocher ochel perot haya velo lokeach
May benayehu amar abbaye tzad echad beribbit ika benayehu rava amar ribbit al menat lehachazir ika benayehu
Amar rava hashta deamar rabbi yannay
b: Ma li hen uma li demehen amrinan ma li demehen uma li hen name amrinan ufoskin al shaar shebbashshuk veaf al pi sheen lo
Etiveh rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava kullam im yesh lo muttar im en lo asur amar lehu hatam halvaa hacha zevine

Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu may tama amaru rabbanan poskin al shaar shebbashshuk veaf al pi sheen lo deamar leh shekila tevutach veshadya achizre may ahnet li i hao li zuze bide hava mezabbenna behine uvshile bezula
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef ella meatta muttar lilot sea bisa mishshum dematze amar leh shekila tevutach veshadya achizre deamar leh chitte dekadchi baachalbay amar leh hatam halvaa hacha zevine
Amar leh adda bar abba lerava veha bae lemitav zuze lesafsera amar leh deka yahev leh name rav ashe amar zuze deinashe inhu avdi leh safseruteh
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu hay man deyahev zuze attara charifa tzarich leitchazoye leve dare
Lemay i lemikne ha la kane i lekabbole aleh mi sheppara ki la mitchaze name mekabbel aleh mi sheppara
Leolam lekabbole aleh mi sheppara uman deyahev zuze attara charifa leve tere telata yahev i mitchaze leh samcha dateh vei la amar leh amena deashkachte pere deshappire middidi ushkalte
Amar rav ashe hashta deamratte mishshum mismach data afilu ashkecheh beshuka vaamar leh samcha dateh

Amar rav nachman kelala deribita kol agar netar leh asur veamar rav nachman hay man deyahev zuze lekiraa veka azli arba arba vaamar leh yahevna lach chamesh chamesh itanhu gabbeh shere letanhu gabbeh asur
Peshita la tzericha deit leh ashray bemata mahu detema kevan deit leh ashray bemata kead sheyyavo beni o ad sheemtza mafteach dame ka mashma lan kevan dimchasseri guvyana keman deletanhu dame
Veamar rav nachman hay man deozef peshite mechavreh veashkach beh tufyana i bichde shehaddaat toa michayyav leahadoreh leh vei lav mattana bealma hu deyahev leh
Hechi dame bichde shehaddaat toa amar rav acha bereh derav yosef

a: Beisuryata vechumsheyata
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe vei inish takkifa hu dela yahev mattana may amar leh dilma migzal gazleh veavla leh becheshbon detanya haggozel et chavero vehivlia lo becheshbon yatza
Vei inish deate mealma dela shakel vetare bahadeh may amar leh dilma inish acharina gazleh vaamar leh ki yazef peloni peshite minach avla leh becheshbon
Amar rav kahana hava yatevna beshilhe pirke derav ushmait dekaamar kare kare vela yadana may kaamar batar dekam rav amri lehu may kare kare dekaamar rav
Amaru li hachi kaamar rav hay man deyahev zuze leginaa akkare veka azli asara kare bene zarta vaamar leh yahevna lach bene garmida itanhu shere letanhu asur
Peshita mahu detema kevan demimmela ka ravu shappir dame ka mashma lan

Keman ki hay tanna detanya haholech lachlov et izzav veligzoz et rechelav velirdot et kavarto metzao chavero veamar lo ma sheizzay cholvot machur lach ma sherchelay gozzot machur lach ma shekkavarti roda machur lach muttar

Aval im amar lo ma sheizzay cholvot kach vechach machur lach ma sherchelay gozzot kach vechach machur lach ma shekkavarti roda kach vechach machur lach asur veaf al gav demimmela ka ravu kevan deletanhu behahi shata asur
Ika deamri amar rava kevan demimmela ka ravu shappir dame vehatanya kach vechach asur
Hatam lav mineh ka ravu deshakli leh lehay veate acharina beduchteh hacha mineh ka ravu dechi shakli leh lehay la ate acharina beduchteh
Amar abbaye share leh leinish lememar leh lechavreh helach arbea zuze achavita dechamra i takfa birshutach i yakra i zila birshutay amar leh rav sherevya leabbaye
b: Hay karov lesachar verachok lehefsed hu amar leh kevan dimkabbel aleh zola karov laze velaze hu
Matni hammalve et chavero lo yadur bachatzero chinnam velo yiskor mimmennu befachot mippene shehu ribbit

Gema amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman af al pi sheamru haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar hilvahu vedar bachatzero tzarich lehaalot lo sachar may ka mashma lan tenena hammalve et chavero lo yadur bachatzero chinnam velo yiskor mimmennu befachot mippene shehu ribbit
I mimmatnitin hava amena hane mile bechatzer dekayema leagra vegavra daavid lemegar aval chatzer dela kayema leagra vegavra dela avid lemegar ema la ka mashma lan
Ika deamri amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman af al pi sheamru haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar halveni vedur bachatzeri tzarich lehaalot lo sachar
Man deamar hilvahu kol shekken halveni uman deamar halveni aval hilvahu la may tama kevan demeikara lav addata dehachi ozfeh let lan bah

Rav yosef bar chama takef avde deinashe demassek behu zuze veaved behu avidta amar leh rava bereh may tama aved mar hachi amar leh ana kerav nachman sevira li deamar rav nachman avda nehom kereseh la shave

Amar leh emor deamar rav nachman kegon daru avdeh dimrakked be chuve avde acharine mi amar amar leh ana ki ha derav daniel bar rav kattina amar rav sevira li deamar hattokef avdo shel chavero veasa bo melacha patur

a: Denicha leh dela nistere avdeh

Amar leh hane mile hecha dela massek beh zuze mar kevan demassek behu zuze michaze keribbit deamar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman af al pi sheamru haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar hilvahu vedar bachatzero tzarich lehaalot lo sachar amar leh hadari bi

Amar abbaye hay man demassek zuze deribita bechavreh veka azli chitte arbea gerive bezuza beshuka veyahev leh ihu chamsha ki mappekinan mineh arbea mappekinan mineh idach ozole hu deka mozel gabbeh rava amar chamsha mappekinan mineh demeikara betorat ribita atay lideh

Veamar abbaye hay man demassek arbea zuze deribita bechavreh veyahev leh gelima begavayehu ki mappekinan mineh arbea mappekinan mineh gelima la mappekinan mineh rava amar gelima mappekinan mineh may tama ki hechi dela lemru gelima dimchasse vekae gelima deribita hu
Amar rava hay man demassek teresar zuze deribita bechavreh veogar leh chatzer demittagra beasra veograh nihaleh bitresar ki mappekinan mineh teresar mappekinan mineh
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina velema leh ki agra agari hachi dahava ka mishtarshi li hashta dela mishtarshi li kidagri kulle alma hu deagarna mishshum daamar leh sevarte vekabbelte

Matni marbin al hassachar veen marbin al hammecher ketzad hiskir lo et chatzero veamar lo im meachshav atta noten li hare hu lecha beeser selaim lashshana veim shel chodesh bachodesh sela lachodesh muttar machar lo et sadehu veamar lo im meachshav atta noten li hare hi shellecha beelef zuz im laggoren bishnem asar mane asur

Gema may shena resha umay shena sefa rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu sechirut enah mishtallemet ella bassof vehay kevan dela meta zimneh lemigbe lav agar netar leh misho hu dehachi shaveya vehay dekaamar leh im meachshav atta noten li hare hu lecha beeser selaim leshana ozole hu deka mozel gabbeh

Sefa kevan dizvine ninhu uvae lemishkal deme meachshav hilkach agar netar leh hu veasur amar rava daku bah rabbanan beha milta veokmuha akkera kischir shana beshana sechirut shel shana zo enah mishtallemet ella beshana acheret
Veim laggoren bishnem asar mane asur amar rav nachman tarsha shere
Etiveh rame bar chama lerav nachman veamri lah rav ukva bar chama lerav nachman veim laggoren bishnem asar mane asur amar leh hatam katz leh hacha la katz leh
Amar rav pappa tarsha didi shere may tama shichray la pased zuze la tzerichna ana hu deka avedna milta gabbe lokeach
Amar leh rav sheshet bereh derav idi lerav pappa may chaze mar deka azlatte batar didach zil batar didhu deilu hao lehu zuze hao shakli ki hashta hashta delet lehu zuze shakli keukra dilkammeh
Amar rav chama tarsha didi vadday shere
May tama nicha lehu deleku birshuti dechol hecha deka azli shavki lehu michsa unkut venakti lehu shuka
b: Vehilcheta kerav chama vehilcheta kerabbi elazar vehilcheta kerabbi yannay deamar ma li hen uma li demehen

Matni machar lo et hassade venatan lo miktzat damim veamar lo ematay shettirtze have maot vetol et shellecha asur hilvahu al sadehu veamar lo im i atta noten li mikkan vead shalosh shanim hare hi shelli hare hi shello vechach haya bayetos ben zonin ose al pi chachamim
Gema mi ochel perot rav huna amar mocher ochel perot rav anan amar meshalleshin et happerot vela peligi ha deamar lechi mayetet keni ha deamar lechi mayetet keni meachshav
Tane rav safra beribbit deve rabbi chiyya peamim sheshshenehem muttarin peamim sheshshenehem asurin ufamim shehammocher muttar velokeach asur ufamim shehallokeach muttar umocher asur
Ane rava batreh peamim sheshshenehem muttarin deamar leh keni keshiur zuzach peamim sheshshenehem asurin deamar leh lechi mayetet keni meachshav
Peamim mocher muttar velokeach asur deamar leh lechi mayetet keni peamim shehallokeach muttar umocher asur deamar leh keni meachshav vezuzay liho halvaa gabbach
Man tana shenehem asurin amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua dela kerabbi yehuda dei rabbi yehuda haamar tzad echad beribbit muttar
Mishken lo bayit mishken lo sade veamar lo lichshettirtze lemochram lo timkerem ella li baddamim hallalu asur beshoveyehen muttar
Man tanna baddamim hallalu asur amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua dela kerabbi yehuda dei rabbi yehuda haamar tzad echad beribbit muttar

Machar lo bayit machar lo sade veamar lo lichsheyyihu li maot hachzirem li asur lichsheyyihu lecha maot achazirem lach muttar man tanna amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua dela kerabbi yehuda dei rabbi yehuda haamar tzad echad beribbit muttar
May shena resha umay shena sefa amar rava resha dela amar leh middateh sefa deamar leh middateh
Hahu gavra dezabben leh ara lechavreh shello beachraut chazyeh dahava ka atziv amar leh ammay atzivatte i tarfu lah minach magbena lach shufra shevacha ufere
Amar ammemar

a: Pattome mile bealma hu amar leh rav ashe leammemar tama may kevan delokeach bae leatnoye vehacha mocher ka matne amratte pattome mile bealma hu
Ella matnita dekatane lichsheyyihu lecha maot achzir lach muttar democher hu devae leatnoye mocher la atni velokeach ka matne
Veamrinan may shena resha umay shena sefa veamar rava sefa daamar leh middateh tama daamar leh middateh ha la amar leh middateh la amrinan pattome mile bealma hu
Amar leh naase keman daamar leh middateh ittemar
