Hahu shechiv mera dichtav lah gita lidvethu innegid veittenach amara leh ammay ka mittenachatte i kayematte didach ana amar rav zevid pattome mile bealma hu
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina vei lav pattome mile may bedidah kayema lemishde tenaa begita bedideh kayema lemishde tenaa mahu detema hu gufeh addata didah ka gamer veyahev gita ka mashma lan
Hilvahu al sadehu amar rav huna bishat mattan maot kana hakkol leachar mattan maot lo kana ella keneged meotav verav nachman amar afilu leachar mattan maot kana hakkol
Avad rav nachman ovada gabbe resh galuta kishmateh kareh rav yehuda lishtareh amar leh resh galuta rav yehuda kera lishtarach amar leh dardeka kareh gavra rabba kareh chaza beh tama vekareh
Ika deamri amar leh dardeka kareh dechulle alma legabbe didi bedina dardeke ninhu
Hadar amar rav nachman afilu bishat mattan maot lo kana velo kelum etiveh rava lerav nachman im i atta noten li mikkan vead shalosh shanim hare hi shelli hare hi shello
Amar leh ani omer asmachta kanya uminome amar asmachta la kanya
Ulminome kashya matnitin ibaet ema matnitin rabbi yose hi deamar asmachta kanya
b: Ibaet ema daamar leh keni meachshav
Amaru leh mar yanoka umar kashshisha bene derav chisda lerav ashe hachi amri nehardeae mishshemeh derav nachman hay asmachta bezimneh kanya bela zimneh la kanya
Amar lehu kol mide bezimneh kane bela zimneh la kane
Dilma hachi kaamritu ashkecheh bego zimneh vaamar leh keni kane batar zimneh vaamar leh keni la kane may tama mechamat kisufa hu dekaamar leh
Vela hi daafilu bego zimneh name la kane vehay dekaamar leh keni ka savar ki mate zimneh la layete litredan
Amar rav pappa hay asmachta zimnin kanya vezimnin la kanya ashkecheh deka shate shichra kane deka mehappech azzuze la kane
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina dilma lefakkoche pachdeh ka shate i name inish acharina asmecheh azzuze ella amar ravina i kafed bidme vadday kane
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina dilma savar ki hechi dela titzil areh ella amar rav pappa i kafed beara vadday kane
Veamar rav pappa af al gav daamur rabbanan asmachta la kanya appoteke haveya lemigbe minah
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa mi kaamar leh keni leguvyana amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina vei amar keni lemigbe mineh kane sof sof asmachta hi veasmachta la kanya
Ella appoteke deamar rav pappa may hi daamar leh lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizzo

Hahu gavra dezabben leh ara lechavreh beachraut amar leh i tarfu lah minnay magbet li meide idit deit lach amar leh meide idit la magbena lach devaena lemekam kammay ella magbena lach meidit achariti deit li lesof tarfuha mineh ata bidka shekel leide idit
Sevar rav pappa lememar meidit amar leh veha kayema
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina velema leh ki amari lach ana magbena lach dahava ide idit kayema hashta kayema leh idit bimkom ide idit

Rav bar sheva hava massek beh rav kahana zuze amar leh i la parana lach leom peloni gevi mehay chamra sevar rav pappa lememar ki amrinan asmachta la kanya hane mile beara delav lezabbone kayema aval chamra kevan dilzabbone kae kezuze dame
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa hachi amrinan mishshemeh derabba kol dei la kane
Amar rav nachman hashta daamur rabbanan asmachta la kanya hadra ara vehadri pere lememra desavar rav nachman mechila betaut la haveya mechila
Vehaitmar hammocher perot dekel lachavero amar rav huna ad shello bau laolam yachol lachzor bo mishshebbau laolam en yachol lachzor bo verav nachman amar af mishshebbau laolam yachol lachzor bo
Veamar rav nachman modena dei shamet veachel la mappekinan mineh hatam zevine hacha halvaa
Amar rava

a: Hava yatevna kammeh derav nachman uvay leotoveh onaa veodek chazitan ayelonit vahare onaa dimchila betaut hi vela haveya mechila veodek chazitan ayelonit hare ayelonit dimchila betaut hi vehaveya mechila
Ditnan hammaenet vehashsheniyya vehaayelonit en lahen lo ketubba velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot
Vela hi la onaa haveya teuvteh vela ayelonit mesayya leh
La onaa teuvteh dela yada deiteh onaa demachel gabbeh vela ayelonit mesayya leh denicha lah detipok denipok alah shema deishut
Hahi itta daamara leh lehahu gavra zil zeven li ara mikkarivay azal zevan lah amar leh i hau li zuze mahderatte lah nihali amar leh atte venavela ache
Amar rabba bar rav huna kol atte venavela ache amar samcha dateh vela gamar umakne
Ara hadra pere may ribbit ketzutza hau veotzin bedayyanin o dilma ki avak ribbit hau veen yotzin
Amar rabba bar rav huna mistabbera ki avak ribbit hau veen yotzin bedayyanin vechen amar rava ki avak ribbit hau veen yotzin bedayyanin
Amar leh abbaye lerabba mashkanta may hatam tama may mishshum dela katz leh hacha name la katz leh o dilma hatam zevine hacha halvaa
Amar leh hatam tama may mishshum dela katz leh hacha name la katz leh
Amar rav pappi avad ravina ovada vechashshev veappek pere dela kerabba bar rav huna
Amar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava ha mashkanta beatra dimsalleki achal shiur zuze mesallekinan leh
Achal tefe la mappekinan mineh vela mechashshevinan mishshetara lishtara
Uvidyatme achal shiur zuze mesallekinan leh achal tefe mappekinan mineh umchashshevinan mishshetara lishtara

Amar rav ashe hashta deamratte achal tefe la mappekinan mineh achal shiur zuze name la mesallekinan leh bela zuze may tama salloke bela zuze appoke mineh hu have avak ribbit vaavak ribbit enah yotza bedayyanin
Avad rav ashe ovada bitomim ketannim
b: Kigdolim
Amar rava bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava hay mashkanta beatra dimsalleki la nechol ella benachyeta vetzurba midderabbanan afilu benachyeta la nechol ella bemay nechol bekitzuta

Hanicha leman deamar kitzuta sharya ella leman deamar kitzuta asira may ika lememar deittemar kitzuta peliga bah rav acha veravina chad amar kitzuta sharya vechad amar kitzuta asira hechi dame kitzuta deamar leh ad chamesh shenin achelna lah bela nachyeta mikkan veelach shayemna lach kullehu pere
Ika deamri kol bela nachyeta asur aval hechi dame kitzuta deamar leh ad chamesh shenin achelna benachyeta mikkan veelach shayemna lach kullehu pere
Man deasar bekammayeta share bevatrayeta man deasar bevatrayeta hechi shere lemechal shere ki mashkanta desura dechatvi bah hachi bemishlam shenayya ilen tipok ara da bela kesaf
Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua amri tarvayehu hay mashkanta beatra dimsalleki en baal chov gove hemenna veen habbechor notel bah pi shenayim ushviit meshammattah
Uvatra dela mesalleki baal chov gove hemenna uvchor notel bah pi shenayim veen sheviit meshammattah

Veamar mar zutra mishshemeh derav pappa hay mashkanta beatra dimsalleki mesalleki leh vaafilu mittamre deabbudya vei agbehinhu besisane kenanhu ulman deamar kilo shel lokeach birshut mocher kana lokeach afilu dela agbehinhu besisane kenanhu
Peshita beatra dimsalleki veamar la mistallakna ha kaamar dela mistallakna ella beatra dela mesalleki veamar mistallakna may tzarich lemikne mineh o la
Rav pappa amar la tzerich lemikne mineh rav sheshet bereh derav idi amar tzerich lemikne mineh vehilcheta tzerich lemikne mineh
Amar ezil veayete zuze la achel ezil veetrach veayete zuze ravina amar achel umar zutra bereh derav mari amar la achel vehilcheta la achel
Rav kahana verav pappa verav ashe la achli benachyeta ravina achel benachyeta
Amar mar zutra may tama deman deachel benachyeta mide dehave assede achuzza sede achuzza lav af al gav deka achel pere tuva amar rachamana

a: Ka farek lah bearbea zuze hacha name la shena
Uman deasar amar lach sede achuzza hekdesh hi verachamana okmeh appidon hacha halvaa hi umichaze keribbit
Amar rav ashe amaru li save demata machseya setam mashkanta shatta lemay nafka minah dei achel lah shatta matze mesallek leh vei la la matze mesallek leh
Veamar rav ashe amaru li save demata machseya may mashkanta dishchuna gabbeh lemay nafka minah ledina devar mitzra
Amar rava let hilcheta la ketarshe pappunae vela kishtare machoznae vela kachachire narshae
Ketarshe pappunae ketarshe derav pappa
Shetare machoznae dezakfi leh leravecha akkarna vechatvi leh bishtara mi yemar dehave ravecha

Amar leh mar bar ammemar lerav ashe abba aved hachi vechi atu lekammeh meheman lehu amar leh tinach hecha deiteh ledideh i shachev venafel shetara kamme yatme may have kishgaga sheyyotza millifne hashshallit venach nafsheh deammemar
Chachire narshae dechatvi hachi mishken leh pelanya areh liflanya vahadar chachrah mineh emat kenaah deakneyah nihaleh
Vehaidana deka chatvi hachi kenena mineh ushhena kamma idane vahadar chachrah kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin shappir dame velav milleta hi
Matni en moshivin chenvani lemachatzit sachar velo yitten maot likach bahen perot lemachatzit sachar ella im ken noten lo secharo kefoel
En moshivin tarnegolin lemechetza veen shamin agalin usyachin lemechetza ella im ken noten lo sechar amalo umzono
Aval mekabbelin agalin usyachin lemechetza umgaddelin otan ad sheyehu meshullashin vachamor ad shettehe toenet
Gema tana kefoel batel may kefoel batel
b: Amar abbaye kefoel batel shel otah melacha divtal minah
Utzricha dei tena chenvani chenvani hu desaggi leh kefoel batel mishshum dela nefish tircheh aval maot likach bahen perot dinfish tircheh ema la saggi leh kefoel batel

Vei tena maot likach bahen perot hava amena hatam hu devae kefoel batel mishshum dinfish tircheh aval chenvani dela nefish tircheh ema saggi leh bemashshehu bealma daafilu lo tibbel immo ella betzir velo achal immo ella gerogeret achat zehu secharo tzericha
Kamma ize vetarnegolin maalin siman

Tanu rabbanan kamma hu secharo ben merubbe uven muat divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer afilu lo tibbel immo ella betzir velo achal immo ella gerogeret achat zehu secharo rabbi shimon ben yochay omer noten lo secharo meshallem
Tanu rabbanan en shamin lo et haizzim velo et harchelim velo kol davar sheeno ose veochel lemechetza
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer shamin et haizzim mippene shecholvot veet harchelim mippene sheggozzot veshotfot umortot veet hattarnegolet mippene shehi osa veochelet
Vetanna kamma giza vechalav la safek sechar amalo umzono begiza vechalav kulle alma la peligi ki feligi benasove vetutre

Tanna kamma savar lah kerabbi shimon ben yochay deamar noten lo secharo mishshalem rabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar lah kaavuh deamar afilu lo tibbel immo ella betzir velo achal immo ella gerogeret achat zehu secharo

Tanu rabbanan maskeret ishsha lachavertah tarnegolet bishne efrochin ishsha sheamra lachavertah tarnegolet shelli uvetzim shellichi vaani veatte nachlok baefrochin rabbi yehuda mattir rabbi shimon oser
Verabbi yehuda la bae sechar amalo umzono ika betzim muzarot

Tanu rabbanan makom shennahagu lehaalot sechar kattaf lemaot livhema maalin veen meshannin mimminhag hammedina rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shamin egel im immo usyach im immo vaafilu bimkom shennahagu lehaalot sechar kattaf lemaot
Verabban shimon ben gamliel la bae sechar amalo umzono ika gelalim veidach gelalim afkore mafker lehu
Amar rav nachman halacha kerabbi yehuda vahalacha kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Bene rav ilish nefak alayehu hahu shetara dahava ketiv beh palga baagar palga behefsed amar rava rav ilish gavra rabba hu veisura leinashe la have safe ma nafshach i palga baagar tere tilte behefsed

a: I palga behefsed tere tilte baagar
Amar rav kahana amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea vaamar li dilma rav ilish tovel immo betzir hava veamar rav nachman halacha kerabbi yehuda amar leh lav hilcheta itmar ella shita itmar
Hachi name mistabbera dei la tema hachi lema leh lemichshav ulmemar halacha halacha lema halacha kerabbi yehuda demekel mikkullehu
Amar rav motar shelish bischarcha hare ze muttar ushmuel amar lo matza motar shelish yelech leveto rekan ella amar shemuel kotzetz lo dinar
Vesavar rav en kotztzin lo dinar vehaamar rav resh igla lefatoma may lav deamar leh motar shelish bischarcha
Lo dekaamar leh i motar shelish i resh igla lefatoma ibaet ema ki kaamar rav motar shelish bischarcha muttar kegon deit leh behema ledideh deamri inashe gabbel letora gabbel letore

Rabbi elazar mehagronya zaven behema veyahev leh laariseh mefattem leh veyahev leh resha beagreh veyahev palga ravecha amara leh devethu i mishtattefatte bahadeh yahev lach name alyeta azal zaven bahadeh peleg leh mealyeta amar leh ta niflegeh leresha amar leh hashta kemeikara name la

Amar leh ad haidana zuze didi hao i la hava yahevna lach tefe purta michaze keribbit hashta shuttafe anan may kaamratte tarachna tefe purta amri inashe setam arisa lemare ara kamshabed nafsheh leetoye leh riya

Tanu rabbanan hashsham behema lachavero ad matay chayyav littappel bah somchos omer baatonot shemona asar chodesh begodrot esrim vearbaa chodesh veim ba lachalok betoch zemanno chavero meakkev alav aval eno dome tipulah shel shana zo letipulah shel shana acheret
Aval may kaamar ella lefi sheeno dome tipulah shel shana zo letipulah shel shana acheret

Tanya idach hashsham behema lachavero ad matay chayyav littappel bavveladot baddakka sheloshim yom uvaggassa chamishshim yom rabbi yose omer baddakka shelosha chodashim mippene shettipulah merubbe may tipulah merubbe mippene sheshshineha dakkot mikkan veelach notel mechetza shello vachatzi mechetza beshel chavero

Rav menashsheya bar gadda shekal mechetza shello vachatzi mechetza beshel chavero ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh man pelag lach veod makom shennahagu legaddel hu utnan makom shennahagu legaddel yegaddelu
Hanhu tere kutae daavud iska bahade hadade azal chad minnayehu pelag zuze bela dateh dechavreh ato lekammeh derav pappa amar leh may nafka minah hachi amar rav nachman zuze keman difligi damu
Leshana zevun chamra bahade hadade kam idach pelag leh bela dateh dechavreh ato lekammeh derav pappa amar leh man pelag lach amar leh ka chazena devatar didi ka ate mar amar rav pappa
b: Kehay gavena vadday tzerich leodoeh zuze mi shakel tave veshavek chassire
Amar leh la amar leh chamra kulle alma yadi deika divsim veika dela besim
Gufa amar rav nachman zuze keman difligi damu hane mile tave vetave tekule utkule aval tave utkule la
Rav chama hava mogar zuze bifshita beoma kelo zuze derav chama hu savar may shena mimmara vela hi mara hadra baena vidia pechateh zuze la hadri beenayehu vela yedia pechateh

Amar rava shere leh leinish lememar leh lechavreh helach arbea zuze veozfeh liflanya zuze lo asra tora ella ribbit habbaa millove lemalve veamar rava shere leh leinish lememar leh lechavreh shekol lach arbea zuze veemor leh lifloni leozofan zuze may tama sechar amira ka shakel

Ki ha deabba mar bereh derav pappa hava shakel ugna dekira mikkirae vaamar leh laavuh ozfinhu zuze amaru leh rabbanan lerav pappa achel bereh demar ribbita amar lehu kol ki hay ribbita nechol lo asra tora ella ribbit habbaa millove lemalve hacha sechar amira ka shakel ushre
Matni shamin para vachamor vechol davar shehu ose veochel lemechetza makom shennahagu lachlok et havveladot miyyad cholkin makom shennahagu legaddel yegaddelu
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shamin egel im immo usyach im immo umafriz al sadehu veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit

Gema tanu rabbanan mafriz al sadehu veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit ketzad hassocher et hassade mechavero baasara korim chittin leshana veomer lo ten li matayim zuz vaafarnesenna vaani aale lecha shenem asar korin leshana muttar
Aval en mafriz lo al chanut velo al sefina

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh peamim shemmafriz al chanut latzor bah tzura sefina laasot lah iskarya chanut latzor bah tzurta detzavu bah inashe vehave agra tefe sefina laasot lah iskarya kevan deshappira iskarya tefe agra tefe
Sefinta amar rav agra ufagra amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav i agra la pagra i pagra la agra shetek rav

Amar rav sheshet may tama shetek rav la shemia leh ha detanya af al pi sheamru en mekabbelin tzon barzel miyyisrael aval mekabbelin tzon barzel min haggoyim aval amru hashsham para lachavero veamar lo hare paratcha asuya alay bishloshim dinar vaani aale lecha sela bechodesh muttar lefi shello asaah damim
Velo asaah amar rav sheshet lo asaah damim mechayyim ella leachar mita
Amar rav pappa hilcheta sefina agra ufagra

a: Venahagu bene chufra agra bishat meshicha pagra bishat shevira attu beminhaga talya milta mishshum dematnita tanya minhaga

Amar rav anan amar shemuel maot shel yetomim muttar lehalotan beribbit amar leh rav nachman mishshum deyatme ninhu safena safenan lehu isura yatme deachli delav didhu lezlu batar shavkayehu amar leh ema li izi gufa deovada hechi hava
Amar leh hahu duda divne mar ukva dahava be mar shemuel takel veyahev leh takel veshakel leh shakel agra veshakel pachata i agra la pachata vei pachata la agra
Amar leh ki ha afilu bediknane name shere lemibad deha mekabbeli alayehu chuscha dinchasha dechamma demikkele nechasha betzir demeh
Amar rabba bar shela amar rav chisda veamri lah amar rabba bar yosef bar chama amar rav sheshet maot shel yetomim muttar lehalotan karov lesachar verachok lehefsed
Tanu rabbanan karov lesachar verachok lehefsed rasha karov lehefsed verachok lesachar chasid karov laze velaze rachok mizze umizze zo hi middat kol adam
Amar leh rabba lerav yosef hane zuze deyatme hechi avdinan lehu amar leh motvinan lehu be dina veyahavinan lehu zuza zuza amar leh veha ka chalya karna

Amar leh mar hechi aved amar leh badkinan gavra deit leh dahava pericha venaktinan dahava mineh veyahavinan lehu nihaleh karov lesachar verachok lehefsed aval davar mesuyyam la dilma pikkadon ninhu veate mareh yahev simanin veshakel leh

Amar rav ashe tinach i mishtechach gavra deit leh dahava pericha i la mishtechach gavra deit leh dahava pericha nechlu zuze deyatme ella amar rav ashe chazenan gavra dimshappu nichseh umheman veshama dina deorayeta vela mekabbel shamta derabbanan veyahavinan lehu nihaleh beve dina
b: Matni en mekabbelin tzon barzel miyyisrael mippene shehu ribbit aval mekabbelin tzon barzel min haggoyim
Velovin mehen umalvin otan beribbit vechen beger toshav malve yisrael meotav shel nochri middaat hannochri aval lo middaat yisrael
Gema lememra devirshuta dimkabbel kayema urminhu hamkabbel tzon barzel min haggoyim veladot peturin min habbechora
Amar abbaye la kashya ha dimkabbel aleh unsa vezola ha dela kabbel aleh unsa vezola
Amar leh rava i dekabbel aleh marah unsa vezola tzon barzel karet leh
Veod addetane sefa aval mekabbelin tzon barzel min haggoyim liflog bedideh bamme devarim amurim dela kabbel aleh unsa vezola aval kabbel marah unsa vezola shappir dame

Ella amar rava ide veide dela kabbel aleh marah unsa vezola vegabbe bechorot hayenu taam diveladot peturin min habbechora kevan dei la yahev zuze ate goy tafes lah livhema vei la mashkach lah livhema tafes lehu liveladot vehave lah yad goy baemtza
Vechol yad goy baemtza patur min habbechora
Marbe hono beneshech vetarbit lechonen dallim yikbetzennu may lechonen dallim amar rav kegon shabbur malka
Amar rav nachman amar li huna lo nitzrecha ella daafilu ribbit degoy etiveh rava lerav nachman lannochri tashshich may tashshich lav tishshoch la tashshich
La saggi delav hachi leappoke achicha dela
Achicha behedya ketiv beh ulachich lo tashshich laavor alav baase velo taase
Etiveh lovin mehen umalvin otam beribbit vechen beger toshav amar rav chiyya bereh derav huna lo nitzrecha ella

a: Bichde chayyav
Ravina amar hacha betalmide chachamim askinan tama may gezur rabbanan shemma yilmod mimmaasav vechevan detalmid chacham hu lo yilmod mimmaasav

Ika dematne lah leha derav huna aha detane rav yosef im kesef talve et ammi et heani immach ammi vegoy ammi kodem ani veashir ani kodem aniyyecha vaaniyye irecha aniyyecha kodmin aniyye irecha vaaniyye ir acheret aniyye irecha kodmin
Amar mar ammi vegoy ammi kodem peshita amar rav nachman amar li huna la nitzrecha daafilu legoy beribbit ulyisrael bechinnam
Tanya amar rabbi yose bo ure samut enehem shel malve beribbit adam kore lachavero rasha yored immo lechayyav vehem meviin edim velavlar vekulmos udo vechotvin vechotmin peloni ze kafar belohe yisrael

Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer kal mi sheyyesh lo maot umalve otam shello beribbit alav hakkatuv omer kaspo lo natan beneshech veshochad al naki lo lakach ose elle lo yimmot leolam ha lamadta shekkol hammalve beribbit nechasav mitmottin veha ka chazenan dela mozfi beribbit veka mitmottin amar rabbi elazar hallalu mitmottin veolin vehallalu mitmottin veenan olin
Lamma tabbit bogdim tacharish kevalla rasha tzaddik mimmennu amar rav huna tzaddik mimmennu bolea tzaddik gamur eno bolea
Tanya rabbi omer ger tzedek haamur leinyan mechira veger toshav haamur leinyan ribbit eni yodea ma hu
Ger tzedek haamur leinyan mechira dichtiv vechi yamuch achicha immach venimkar lach velo lecha ella leger shenneemar leger
Velo leger tzedek ella leger toshav shenneemar leger toshav mishpachat ger ze haggoy keshehu omer o leeker ze hannimkar laavoda zara atzmah
Amar mar velo lecha ella leger shenneemar leger lememra deger kane eved ivri vrminhi en hagger nikne beeved ivri veen ishsha veger konin eved ivri
Ger lo nikne beeved ivri veshav el mishpachto baenan veha leka veen ishsha veger konin eved ivri ishsha lav orach ara ger name gemiri demikkene kane dela mikkene la kane
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak eno kone vedino keyisrael aval kone vedino kegoy
Detanya hannirtza vehannimkar legoy eno oved lo et habben velo et habbat

Amar mar veen ishsha veger konin eved ivri nema dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel detanya ishsha kona et hashshefachot veenah kona et haavadim rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af kona et haavadim afilu tema rabban shimon ben gamliel vela kashya kan beeved ivri kan beeved kenaani
Eved ivri tzenia lah eved kenaani peritz lah

Ella ha detane rav yosef armalta la terabbe kalba vela tashre bar be rav beushpiza bishlama bar be rav tzenia lah ella kalba kevan dimsarech bah miratteta amri kevan dechi shadya leh umtza mesarech batrah amri inashe mishshum umtza deshadya leh hu dimsarech

Ger toshav haamur leinyan ribbit may hi dichtiv vechi yamuch achicha umata yado immach vehechezakta bo ger vetoshav vachay immach al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit veyareta meelohecha veche achicha immach urminhi lovin mehen umalvin otan beribbit vechen beger toshav
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mi ketiv al tikkach meittam meitto ketiv miyyisrael
Tanu rabbanan al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit aval atta naase lo arev
b: Arev leman ilema arev leyisrael veha tana ellu ovrin belo taase hammalve vehallove hearev vehaedim
Ella legoy vechevan dedineh degoy deazel batar arva ihu nihu deka shakel mineh ribbita
Amar rav sheshet shekkibel alav ladun bedine yisrael i kibel alav ladun bedine yisrael ribbit name la lishkol amar rav sheshet shekkibel alav lazo velo kibel alav lazo

Malve yisrael meotav shel nochri middaat hannochri ku tanu rabbanan malve yisrael meotav shel nochri middaat hannochri aval lo middaat yisrael ketzad yisrael shellava maot min haggoy beribbit uvikesh lehachziram lo metzao yisrael acher veamar lo tenem li vaani aale lach kederech sheatta maale lo asur veim heemidu etzel goy muttar
Vechen goy shellava maot miyyisrael beribbit uvikesh lehachziram lo metzao yisrael acher veamar lo tenem li vaani aale lecha kederech sheatta maale lo muttar veim heemido etzel yisrael asur
Bishlama sefa lechumra ella resha kevan deen shelichut legoy ihu nihu deka shakel mineh ribbita
Amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika hacha bemay askinan kegon daamar leh hannichem al gabbe karka vehipater i hachi may lememra
Ella amar rav pappa kegon shennatal venatan bayyad veakkatti may lememra mahu detema goy gufeh ki aved addata deyisrael ka gamer veyahev ka mashma lan
Rav ashe amar ki amrinan en shelichut legoy hane mile bitruma aval bechol hattora kullah yesh shelichut legoy
Veha derav ashe beruta hi may shena teruma dela dichtiv attem gam attem ma attem bene berit af sheluchachem name bene berit
Shelichut dechol hattora kullah name mitteruma gamrinan lah ella derav ashe beruta hi

Ika deamri amar rav ashe ki amrinan en shelichut legoy hane mile inhu ledidan aval anan ledidhu havena lehu sheliach veha derav ashe beruta hi may shena inhu ledidan dela dichtiv attem gam attem lerabbot sheluchachem ma attem bene verit af sheluchachem bene verit
Anan ledidhu name ma attem bene verit kaamar ella ha derav ashe beruta hi
Ravina amar nehi dishlichut legoy let leh zechiyya midderabbanan it leh mide dehave akkatan katan lav af al gav delet leh shelichut

a: It leh zechiyya midderabbanan hacha name la shena
Vela hi yisrael ate lichlal shelichut nochri la ate lichlal shelichut

Tanu rabbanan yisrael shellava maot min hannochri beribbit uzkafan alav bemilve venitgayyer im kodem shennitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve gove et hakkeren vegove et haribbit veim leachar shennitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve gove et hakkeren veeno gove et haribbit

Vechen nochri shellava maot miyyisrael beribbit uzkafan alav bemilve venitgayyer im ad shello nitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve gove et hakkeren vegove et haribbit im mishshennitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve gove et hakkeren veeno gove et haribbit

Rabbi yose omer nochri shellava maot miyyisrael beribbit ben kach uven kach gove et hakkeren vegove et haribbit amar rava amar rav chisda amar rav huna halacha kerabbi yose amar rava may tama derabbi yose kede shello yomru bishvil meotav nitgayyer ze

Tanu rabbanan shetar shekkatuv bo ribbit konsin oto veeno gove lo et hakkeren velo et haribbit divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim gove et hakkeren veeno gove et haribbit bemay kamipalgi rabbi meir savar kansinan hettera mishshum isura verabbanan savri la kansinan hettera mishshum isura
Tenan hatam shetare chov hammukdamin pesulin vehamucharin kesherin mukdamin ammay pesulin nehi dela gevo mizzeman rishon nigbo mizzeman sheni
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish bemachloket shenuya verabbi meir hi verabbi yochanan amar afilu tema rabbanan gezera shemma yigbe mizzeman rishon
Hahu gavra demashken leh pardesa lechavreh achlah telat shene amar leh i mezabbenatte lah nihali mutav vei la kaveshna lah lishtar mashkanta veamena lekucha hi beyadi
Azal kam akneyah livno katan vahadar zabbenah nihaleh

Zevine vadday la hau zevine zuze kemilve bishtar damu vegove minnechasim meshubadim o dilma kemilve al pe damu veeno gove minnechasim meshubadim amar abbaye velav hayenu derabbi assi deamar rabbi assi
b: Mode bishtar shekketavo eno tzarich lekayemo vegove minnechasim meshubadim
Amar leh rava mi dame hatam nitan lehikkatev hacha lo nitan lehikkatev

Yatev marimar vekaamar leha shemata amar leh ravina lemarimar ella ha deamar rabbi yochanan gezera shemma yigbe mizzeman rishon nema lo nitan likatev amar leh hachi hashta hatam nehi delo nitan likatev mizzeman rishon aval nitan likatev mizzeman sheni hacha lo nitan likatev kelal

Ella ha detanya leshevach karkaot ketzad hare sheggazal sade mechavero umcharah leacher vehishbichah vahare hi yotza mittachat yado keshehu gove gove et hakkeren minnechasim meshubadim veshevach gove minnechasim bene chorin nema lo nitan likatev

Hachi hashta hatam i leman deamar nicha leh dela nikreyeh gazlana i leman deamar nicha leh delekum behemanuteh mefayyes leh lemareh umokem leh lishtareh hacha leavroche mineh kamchaven shetara mekayyem leh
Matni en poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar yatza hashshaar poskin veaf al pi sheen laze yesh laze
Haya hu techila lakkotzrim posek immo al haggadish veal heavit shel anavim veal hammaatan shel zetim veal habbetzim shel yotzer veal hassid mishsheshshikkeo bakkivshan
Ufosek immo al hazzevel kol yemot hashshana rabbi yose omer en poskin al hazzevel ella im ken hayeta lo zevel baashpa vachachamim mattirim
Ufosek immo beshaar haggavoha rabbi yehuda omer af al pi shello pasak immo beshaar haggavoha yachol lomar ten li kaze o ten li et meotay

Gema amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan en poskin al hashshaar shebbashshuk amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan afilu kaddormus hazze amar leh la amar rabbi yochanan ella bashshuk shel ayarot dela kevii tarayehu

Ulman dislek addatin meikara deamar rabbi yochanan afilu kaddormus hazze ella matnitin dekatane en poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar yatza hashshaar poskin hechi mashkachatte lah matnitin bechite deachlabbe vearve dimshich tarayehu tefe

Tanu rabbanan en poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar yatza hashshaar poskin af al pi sheen laze yesh laze hau chadashot mearba vishanot mishshalosh en poskin ad sheyyetze hashshaar lechadash velayyashan
Hau lakotot mearba ulchol adam mishshalosh en poskin ad sheyyetze hashshaar lalloket velammocher

Amar rav nachman poskin lallakotot keshaar hallakotot amar leh rava lerav nachman may shena lakot dei let leh yazef millakot chavreh baal habbayit name yezef millakot amar leh baal habbayit zila beh milta lemezaf millakot ibaet ema man deyahev zuze levaal habbayit appere shappire yahev

Amar rav sheshet amar rav huna en lovin al shaar shebbashshuk amar leh rav yosef bar chama lerav sheshet veamri lah rav yose bar abba lerav sheshet umi amar rav huna hachi veha bae mineh merav huna hane bene be rav deyazfi betishri ufari betevet shere o asir amar lehu ha chite behine veha chite beshile i bae zavni ufari leh
Meikara savar rav huna en lovin kevan deshamah leha deamar rabbi shemuel bar chiyya amar rabbi elazar lovin amar ihu name lovin
Tanu rabbanan hammolich chavila mimmakom lemakom metzao chavero veamar lo tenah li vaani aale lecha kederech shemmaalin lecha beoto makom

a: Birshut mocher muttar birshut lokeach asur

Hammolich perot mimmakom lemakom metzao chavero veamar lo tenem li vaani aale lecha perot sheyyesh li beoto makom im yesh lo perot beoto makom muttar veim lav asur vehachammarin maalim bimkom hayyoker kevimkom hazzol veenan choshshin
May tama rav pappa amar nicha lehu dimgallu lehu tara rav acha bereh derav ika amar nicha lehu demozli gabbayehu
May benayehu ika benayehu taggara chadta
Besura azli arbaa arbea bechafri azlan shita shita yahev rav zuze lechammare umkabbel aleh unsa deorcha veshakel minayehu chamsha venishkol shita adam chashuv shane

Bea mineh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan mahu laasot bigrutaot ken amar leh bikesh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose laasot ken bichle fishtan velo hinnicho rabbi ika deamri bikesh rabbi laasot bigrutaot ken velo hinnicho rabbi yishmael berabbi yose
Pardesa rav asar ushmuel share rav asar kevan dilkammeh shaveya tefe mitchaze ki agar netar leh ushmuel share kevan dehave beh tiveha la michaze ki agar netar leh
Amar rav shimi bar chiyya umode rav betore dinfish pesedayehu
Amar lehu shemuel lehanhu deshavshi shivsha hafochu beara ki hechi dikne lechu gufa deara vei la haveya lechu kehalvaa veasur
Amar lehu rava lehanhu dimnatteri bage puku hafochu beve dare ki hechi dela tishtallam sechirut didchu ad hahi shata dischirut enah mishtallemet ella bassof vehahi shata ozole deka mozli gabbayechu
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava ka achel mar ribbit dechulle alma shakli arbea umsalleki learisa benisan mar natar lehu ad iyyar veshakel shita
Amar lehu attun ka avditun shello kaddin ara learis mishtabad i attun mesallekitu lehu benisan mafsedtu lehu bechamma ana natarna lehu ad iyyar umarvachna lehu bechamma
b: Rav mari bar rachel mashken leh hahu goy beta hadar zabbeneh lerava netar teresar yarche shatta shekal agar beta amti leh lerava amar leh hay dela amtay lemar agar beta ad haidana distam mashkanta shatta i bae goy lesalloke la hava matze mesallek li hashta lishkol mar agar beta

Amar leh i hava yadana dahava memushkan leh lemar la hava zavenna leh hashta kedinehem avedna lach kol emat dela mesalleki bezuze la shakel agar beta ana name la shakelna minach agar beta ad dimsallekna lach bezuze
Amar leh rava mibbarnish lerav ashe chazi mar rabbanan deka achli ribbita deyahavi zuze achamra betishri umvachari leh betevet
Amar leh inhu name achamra ka yahavi achalla la ka yahavi meikara dechamra chamra dechalla challa hahi shata hu dekamvachari
Ravina hava yahev zuze livne akra deshanota veshafchi leh tefe kufita ata lekammeh derav ashe amar leh mi shere amar leh in achole hu deka machali gabbach
Amar leh ha ara lav didhu hi amar leh ara letaska meshabeda umalka amar man deyahev taska lechol ara

Amar leh rav pappa lerava chazi mar hane rabbanan deyahavi zuze akkeraga deinashe umshabedi behu tefe amar leh hashta iko shechevi la amari lechu ha milta hachi amar rav sheshet muhrekayehu dehane betufsa demalka mannach umalka amar man dela yahev keraga lishtabad leman deyahev keraga

Rav seuram achuh derava hava takef inashe dela meallu umayyel lehu beguharka derava amar leh rava shappir ka avdatte ditnena reito sheeno noheg kashshura minnayin sheatta rashshay lehishtabed bo talmud lomar leolam bahem taavodu uvachechem yachol afilu noheg kashshura talmud lomar uvachechem bene yisrael ish beachiv vego
Amar rav chama hay man deyahev zuze lechavreh lemizban leh chamra ufsha vela zevan leh meshallem leh kidka azel apparota dezulshefat
Amar ammemar amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea amar ki kaamar rav chama hane mile beyayin setam aval beyayin ze la mi yemar dimzabbeni leh nihaleh
Rav ashe amar afilu yayin setam name la may tama asmachta hi veasmachta la kanya
Ulrav ashe may shena meha ditnan im over vela eeved ashallem bemetva hatam beyado

a: Hacha lav beyado

Amar rava hane be telata deyahavi zuze lechad lemizban lehu mide uzvan lechad minayehu zevan lechullehu vela amaran ella dela tzar vachatem inish inish lechodeh aval tzar vachatem inish inish lechodeh leman dizvan zevan ulman dela zevan la zevan
Amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava hay situmta kanya lemay hilcheta rav chaviva amar lemikne mammash
Rabbanan amri lekabbole aleh mi sheppara
Vehilcheta lekabbole aleh mi sheppara uvatra dinhigu lemikne mammash kanu
Haya hu techilla lakkotzrim amar rav mechussar shettayim posek shalosh eno posek ushmuel amar bide adam afilu mea posek bide shamayim afilu achat eno posek
Tenan posek immo al haggadish veha mechussar mishde bechamma lemevash ulmedash umidre kegon dishda bechamma vivash
Velishmuel deamar bide shamayim afilu achat eno posek veha mechussar midre devide shamayim hi efshar benafota
Veal heavit shel anavim veha mechussar michmar veayyole leve matzarta lemedash ulmingad kidtane rabbi chiyya al hakkomer shel zetim hacha name al hakkomer shel anavim
Veha mechussere telat beatra dehahu dezaven hu denaged
Veal hammaatan shel zetim veha mechussar michmar veayyole leve dappe lemedash ulmingad tane rabbi chiyya al komer shel zetim ha ika telat beatra dehahu dezaven hahu menagged
Veal habbetzim shel yotzer ammay veha mechussar lafofe veyabboshe ayyole leattuna lemisraf ulmipak kegon dimlaffa vivishu veha ika telat beatra dehahu dezaven hu demappek

Veal hassid mishsheyeshakkeennu bakkivshan veha mechussar mikle veappoke umedak beatra dehahu dezaven hahu dayek velishmuel deamar bide adam afilu mea posek lema li mishsheyeshakkeennu bakkivshan ema mishsherauy leshakkeo bakkivshan

Veal habbetzim shel yotzer tanu rabbanan en poskim al habbetzim shel yotzer ad sheyyeasu divre rabbi meir amar rabbi yose bamme devarim amurim beafar lavan aval beafar shachor kegon kefar chananya vechavroteha kefar shichin vechavroteha poskin af al pi sheen leze yesh leze

Ammemar yahev zuze mikki meayeli afra keman i kerabbi meir haamar ad sheyyeasu i kerabbi yose haamar af al pi sheen leze yesh leze leolam kerabbi yose uvatreh deammemar ashik afra i dimayeli afra samcha dateh veyahev lehu zuze vei la la samcha dateh
Ufosek immo al hazzevel kol yemot hashshana chachamim hayenu tanna kamma amar rava
b: Yemot haggeshamim ika benayehu
Ufosek immo keshaar haggavoha
Hahu gavra dihav zuze lindunya deve chamuh lesof zal nedunya ato lekammeh derav pappa amar leh i pesakte immo keshaar haggavoha shekol kihashta vei la shekol ki meikara

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav pappa vei la pesak shakel kemeikara maot ninhu umaot la kanu amar lehu ana name lekabbole aleh mi sheppara ka amena i pesak keshaar haggavoha mocher ka hadar beh mekabbel aleh mocher mi sheppara i la pesak lokeach ka hadar beh mekabbel aleh lokeach mi sheppara
Amar leh ravina lerav pappa umimmay derabbanan hi difligi aleh derabbi shimon deamri maot la kanu vaafilu hachi i pesak keshaar haggavoha shakel kidhashta i la pesak shakel kidmeikara

Dilma rabbi shimon hi deamar maot konot vechi pesak keshaar haggavoha shakel ki hashta i la pesak shakel kemeikara mishshum dekane lehu zuze aval lerabbanan ben pesak ben la pesak shakel ki hashta dedateh deinish attara zila
Amar leh emor deamar rabbi shimon bechad tara bitre tare mi amar dei la tema hachi mi sheppara belokeach lerabbi shimon let leh
Vechi tema hachi name vehatanya mikkol makom kach halacha aval amru chachamim mi sheppara ku
May mikkol makom lav dela shena lokeach vela shena mocher mekabbel aleh mi sheppara ella ki kaamar rabbi shimon bechad tara bitre tare la amar
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe vetipok leh deshaliach shavveyeh meikara amar leh betaggara dezaven umzabben

Matni malve adam et arisav chittin bechittin lezera aval lo leechol shehaya rabban gamliel malve et arisav chittin bechittin lezera beoker vehuzlu o bezol vehukru notel mehen keshaar hazzol velo mippene shehalacha ken ella sheratza lehachmir al atzmo

Gema tanu rabbanan malve adam et arisav chittim bechittim lezera bamme devarim amurim shello yarad aval yarad asur may shena tanna didan dela ka mefalleg ben yarad uven lo yarad umay shena tanna bara deka mefalleg ben yarad uven lo yarad
Amar rava rabbi idi asberah nihali beatra detanna didan arisa yahev bizra ben yarad uven lo yarad kamma dela yahev bizra matze mesallek leh vechi ka nachet livtzir mehachi ka nachet
Beatra detanna bara mare ara yahev bizra i lo yarad dematze mesallek leh ki ka nachet livtzir mehachi ka nachet i yarad dela matze mesallek leh asur
Tanu rabbanan omer adam lachavero

a: Halveni kor chittin vekotzetz lo damim huzlu noten lo chittim hukru noten demehem
Vahalo katzatz amar rav sheshet hachi kaamar im lo katzatz huzlu notel chittav hukru noten demehem

Matni lo yomar adam lachavero halveni kor chittin vaani etten lach laggoren aval omer lo halveni ad sheyyavo beni o ad sheemtza mafteach vehillel oser vechen haya hillel omer lo talve ishsha kikkar lachavertah ad shettaaseha damim shemma yukru chittin venimtzeu baot lide ribbit
Gema amar rav huna yesh lo sea love sea satayim love satayim rabbi yitzchak omer afilu yesh lo sea love aleha kamma korin
Tane rabbi chiyya lesayyoeh lerabbi yitzchak tipat yayin en lo tipat shemen en lo ha yesh lo love aleha kamma tipin
Vehillel oser amar rav nachman amar shemuel halacha kedivre hillel velet hilcheta keoteh
Vechen haya hillel omer lo talve ishsha vechu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel zo divre hillel aval chachamim omrim lovim setam uforim setam
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel bene chavura hammakpidin ze al ze ovrin mishshum midda umishshum mishkal umishshum minyan umishshum lovin uforin beom tov uchdivre hillel af mishshum ribbit

Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel talmide chachamim muttarim lilot ze mizze beribbit may tama mida yadi deribbit asura umattana hu deyahavi ahadade amar leh shemuel laavuh bar ihi halveni mea pilpelin bemea veesrin pilpelin vaarich
Amar rav yehuda amar rav muttar lo laadam lehalot banav uvne veto beribbit kede lehatiman taam ribbit velav milta hi mishshum deate lemisrach
Matni omer adam lachavero nakkesh immi vaanakkesh immach ador immi veeedor immach velo yomar lo nakkesh immi veeedor immach ador immi vaanakkesh immach
b: Kol yeme gerid echad kol yeme revia achat lo yomar lo charosh immi bigrid vaani echrosh immecha barvia

Rabban gamliel omer yesh ribbit mukdemet veyesh ribbit meucheret ketzad natan enav lilot hemennu vehu meshalleach lo veomer bishvil shettalveni zo hi ribbit mukdemet lava hemennu vehechzir lo et meotav vehu meshalleach lo veomer bishvil meotecha shehau betelot etzli zo hi ribbit meucheret
Rabbi shimon omer yesh ribbit devarim lo yomar lo da ki ba ish peloni mimmakom peloni

Veellu ovrin belo taase hammalve vehallove vehearev vehaedim vachachamim omrim af hassofer ovrim mishshum lo titten umishshum al tikkach meitto umishshum lo tihye lo kenoshe umishshum lo tesimun alav neshech umishshum velifne iver lo titten michshol veyareta meelohecha ani Adonai
Gema tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane veeno ragil lehakdim lo shalom sheasur lehakdim lo shalom talmud lomar neshech kol davar asher yishshach afilu dibur asur

Veellu ovrin amar abbaye malve over bechullan love over mishshum lo tashshich leachicha ulachicha lo tashshich velifne iver lo titten michshol arev vehaedim en ovrin ella mishshum lo tesimun alav neshech

Tanya rabbi shimon omer malve ribbit yoter mimma shemmarvichim mafsidim velo od ella shemmesimim moshe rabbenu chacham vetorato emet veomrin ilu haya yodea moshe rabbenu sheyyihye revach baddavar lo haya kotvo
Ki ata rav dimi amar minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane veodea sheen lo sheasur laavor lefanav talmud lomar lo tihye lo kenoshe
Rabbi amme verabbi assi deamri tarvayehu keilu dano bishne dinin shenneemar hirkavta enosh leroshenu banu vaesh uvammayim

Amar rav yehuda amar rav kal mi sheyyesh lo maot umalve otan shello beedim over mishshum velifne iver lo titten michshol veresh lakish amar gorem kelala leatzmo shenneemar tealamna sifte shaker haddovrot al tzaddik atak

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav ashe ka mekayyem ravina kol ma daamur rabbanan shelach leh bahade panya demaale shabbeta lishaddar li mar asra zuze deitremi li kattina deara lemizban shelach leh nayete mar sahade venichtov ketava shelach leh afilu ana name shelach leh kol shekken mar ditrid begirseh mishtele vegorem kelala leatzmo
Tanu rabbanan shelosha tzoakin veenan naanin veellu hen mi sheyyesh lo maot umalve otan shello beedim vehakkone adon leatzmo umi sheishto moshelet alav
Kona adon leatzmo may hi ika deamri tole nechasav begoy ika deamri hakkotev nechasav levanav bechayyav ika deamri devish leh beha mata vela azel lemata achariti
Hadaran alach ezehu neshech

Matni hassocher et haummanin vehitu ze et ze en lahem ze al ze ella taromet sachar et hachammar veet hakkaddar lehavi periyafarin vachalilim lakkalla o lammet ufoalin lehaalot pishtano min hammishra vechol davar sheaved vechazru bahen makom sheen sham adam socher alehen o matan
Hassocher et haummanin vechazru bahen yadam al hattachtona

a: Im baal habbayit chozer bo yado al hattachtona kol hamshanne yado al hattachtona vechol hachozer bo yado al hattachtona
Gema chazru ze baze la katane ella hitu ze et ze deato poalim ahadade hechi dame daamar leh baal habbayit zil agar li poalim vaazal ihu veatinhu

Hechi dame i daamar leh baal habbayit bearbea vaazal ihu amar lehu bitlata taromet may avidteh sevur vekabbel i daamar leh baal habbayit bitlata vaazal ihu amar lehu bearbea hechi dame i daamar lehu secharchem alay nittev lehu middideh
Detanya hassocher et happoel laasot beshello veherahu beshel chavero noten lo secharo mishshalem vechozer venotel mibbaal habbayit ma shehehenahu
La tzericha daamar lehu secharchem al baal habbayit
Velichze poalim hechi mitagri la tzericha deika demittegar bearbea veika demittegar bitlata deamru leh i lav daamarte lan bearbea tarchinan umittagrinan bearbea
Ibaet ema hacha bevaal habbayit askinan deamru leh i lav daamarte lan bearbea hava zila ban milta leittegore
Ibaet ema leolam befoalim askinan deamri leh kevan daamarte lan bearbea tarchinan veavdinan lach avidta shappirta velichze avidtayehu berifka rifka name mida yedia dimle mayya vela yedia
Ibaet ema leolam daamar leh baal habbayit bearbea vaazal ihu amar lehu bitlata udkaamratte sevur vekabbel deamri leh let lacha al timna tov mibbealav
Peshita i amar leh baal habbayit bitlata vaazal ihu amar lehu bearbea veamri leh kemo sheamar baal habbayit datayehu ailuya

Ella i amar leh baal habbayit bearbea vaazal ihu amar lehu bitlata veamri kema sheamar baal habbayit may addibura dideh ka samchi deamri leh mehemnatte lan dehachi amar baal habbayit o dilma addibura devaal habbayit ka samchi
Ta shema have li giti
Veishtecha amra hitkabbel li giti vehu omer helach kema sheamra amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav afilu higgia get leyadah enah megoreshet
Shamatte minah addibura dideh ka samech dei salka datach deaddibura didah ka samech mikki mate gita lidah miha tigarash amar rav ashe
b: Hachi hashta bishlama i itmar ipcha hitkabbel li giti veishtecha amra have li giti vehu omer helach kemo sheamra veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav mishsheyyaggia get leyado megoreshet alma deaddibura didah ka semich
I name mishshehiggia get leyadah megoreshet alma deaddibura dideh ka samech ella hatam mishshum deakar shaliach lishlichuteh ligmare deamar leh shaliach likabbala havena leholacha la havena
Ibaet ema hay tanna chazru name hitu kare leh detanya hassocher et haummanin vehitu et baal habbayit o baal habbayit hita otan en lahem ze al ze ella taromet

Bamme devarim amurim shello halchu aval halchu chammarim velo matzu tevua poalin umatzu sade keshehi lacha noten lahen secharan mishshalem aval eno dome habba taun labba rekan ose melacha leoshev uvatel

Bamme devarim amurim shello hitchilu bimlacha aval hitchilu bimlacha shamin lahen ma sheasu ketzad kibbelu kama liktzor bishne selaim katzru chetzyah vehinnichu chetzyah beged leerog bishne selaim argu chetzo vehinnichu chetzo shamin lahen et ma sheasu
Haya yafe shishsha dinarim noten lahen sela o yigmeru melachtan veyittelu shene selaim veim sela noten lahem sela
Rabbi dosa omer shamin lahen ma sheatid leheasot haya yafe shishsha dinarim noten lahem shekel o yigmeru melachtan veyittelu shene selaim veim sela noten lahem sela
Bamme devarim amurim bedavar sheen avud aval bedavar haavud socher alehen o matan ketzad matan omer lahen sela katzatzti lachem bou utlu shettayim vead kamma socher alehen ad arbaim vachamishshim zuz
Bamme devarim amurim bizman sheen sham poalim liskor aval yesh sham poalim liskor veamar tze uschor meellu en lo alehen ella taromet

Tane tanna kammeh derav noten lahem secharan mishshalem amar leh chavivi amar ilu ana havay la hava yahevna lahen ella kefoel batel veatte amratte noten lahem secharan mishshalem veha alah katane eno dome habba taun lehabba rekan ose melacha leoshev uvatel la sayemuha kammeh
Ika deamri sayemuha kammeh vehachi kaamar chavivi amar i havay ana la hava yahevna leh kelal veatte amratte kefoel batel ella kashya hach
La kashya ha desayerah leareh middeurta ha dela sayerah leareh meurta
Ki ha deamar rava hay man daagar agire lerifka vaata mitra umalyah mayya i sayerah leareh meurta

a: Peseda defoalim la sayerah leareh meurta peseda devaal habbayit veyahev lehu kefoel batel
Veamar rava hay man deogar agire ledavela vaata mitra peseda defoalim ata nahara peseda devaal habbayit veyahev lehu kefoel batel
Veamar rava hay man deogar agire ledavela ufsak nahara befalga deoma i la avid defasek peseda defoalim avid defasek i bene mata peseda defoalim lav bene mata peseda devaal habbayit

Veamar rava hay man daagar agire laavidta ushlim avidta befalga deoma i it leh avidta denicha minah yahev lehu i name dichvatah mefakked lehu dekashya minah la mefakked lehu venoten lahem secharan mishshalem
Ammay velitev lehu kefoel batel ki kaamar rava beachloshe demachoza dei la avdi chalshi
Amar mar shamin lahem et ma sheasu ketzad haya yafe shishsha dinarim noten lahem sela ka savri rabbanan yad poel al haelona

O yigmeru melachtan veyittelu shene selaim peshita la tzericha deiyyakar avidta veimru poalim vaazal baal habbayit ufayesinhu mahu detema matzu amri leh ki mefayesinan addata detafet lan aagra ka mashma lan deamar lehu addata detarachna lechu baachila ushtiyya
Sela noten lahem sela peshita la tzericha dezal avidta meikara veagrinhu bitfe zuza ulsof iyyakar avidta vekam bitfe zuza
Mahu detema amri leh tefe zuza amarte lan tefe zuza hav lan ka mashma lan daamar lehu ki amari lechu tefe zuza dela hava kim lechu hashta kim lechu
Rabbi dosa omer shamin lahen et ma sheatid leheasot haya yafe shishsha dinarim noten lahem shekel kasavar yad poel al hattachtona

O yigmeru melachtan veyittelu shene selaim peshita la tzericha dezal avidta veimar baal habbayit vaazul poalim ufayesuh mahu detema matze amar lehu addata devatzritu li meagray ka mashma lan deamri leh addata deavdinan lach avidta shappirta
Sela noten lahem sela peshita amar rav huna bereh derav natan la tzericha deozilu inhu gabbeh zuza meikara ulsof zal avidta
Mahu detema betzir zuza amritu li betzir zuza yahevna lechu ka mashma lan deamri leh ki amarna lach bivtzir zuza dela hava kim lach hashta kim lach

Amar rav halacha kerabbi dosa umi amar rav hachi vehaamar rav poel yachol lachazor bo afilu bachatzi hayyom vechi tema shane leh lerabbi dosa ben sechirut lekabbelanut umi shane leh vehatanya hassocher et happoel velachatzi hayyom shama shemmet lo met o sheachazattu chamma im sachir hu
b: Noten lo secharo im kabbelan hu noten lo kabbelanuto

Manni ilema rabbanan may irya shama shemmet lo met o sheachazattu chamma daanis ki la anis name ha amaru rabbanan yad poel al haelona ella lav rabbi dosa hi ushma minah la shane leh lerabbi dosa ben sechirut lekabbelanut
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak bedavar haavud vedivre hakkol

Tenan kol hamshanne yado al hattachtona vechol hachozer bo yado al hattachtona bishlama kol hamshanne yado al hattachtona distam lan tanna kerabbi yehuda ella kol hachozer bo yado al hattachtona leetoye may lav leetoye poel uchrabbi dosa
Ella rabbi dosa tarte kaamar verav savar lah keoteh bachada ufaleg aleh bachada

Ibaet ema kal hachozer bo yado al hattachtona lechidtanya kol hachozer bo ketzad hare shemmachar sade lachavero beelef zuz venatan lo maot mehen matayim zuz bizman shehammocher chozer bo yad lokeach al haelona

Ratza omer lo ten li meotay o ten li karka keneged meotay mehechan magbehu min haidit uvizman shellokeach chozer bo yad mocher al haelona ratza omer lo helach meotecha ratza omer helach karka keneged meotecha mehechan magbehu min hazziburit

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer melammedin otan shello yachzeru ketzad kotev lo ani peloni ben peloni macharti sade pelonit lifloni beelef zuz venatan li mehem matayim zuz vahareni noshe bo shemone meot zuz kana umachazir lo et hashshear afilu leachar kamma shanim
Amar mar mehechan magbehu min haidit ka salka datach meidit dinchasav velo yehe ella baal chov utnan baal chov dino bevenonit veod ha ara deyahev zuze
Amar rabbi nachman bar yitzchak meidit shebbah umizziburit shebbah
Rav acha bereh derav ika amar afilu tema meidit dinchasav setam man dezaven ara bealpa zuze ozole mozel umzabben nechasav vehave leh kenizak utnan hannizakin shamin lahen beidit
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer melammedin otan shello yachzeru ketzad kotev lo ani peloni ben peloni ku tama dichtav leh hachi ha la ketav hachi la kane
Vehatanya hannoten eravon lachavero veamar lo im ani chozer bi ervoni machul lach vehalla omer im ani chozer bi echpol lach ervoncha nitkayemu hattenain divre rabbi yose
Rabbi yose letameh deamar asmachta kanya

Rabbi yehuda omer dayyo sheyyikne keneged ervono amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim bizman sheamar lo ervoni yikkon aval machar lo sade beelef zuz venatan lo mehem chamesh meot zuz kana umachzir lo et hashshear afilu leachar kamma shanim
La kashya ha deka ayel venafek azzuze ha dela ka ayel venafek azzuze
Deamar rava hay man dezabben mide lechavreh veka ayel venafek azzuze la kane la ka ayel venafek azzuze kane
Veamar rava hay man deozfeh mea zuze lechavreh ufareh zuza zuza peraon have ella deit leh taromet gabbeh deamar leh afsadtinhu minay

Hahu gavra dezabben leh chamara lechavreh ufash leh chad zuza veka ayel venafek azzuza yatev rav ashe veka meayyen bah ki hay gavena may kane o la kane amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hachi amar avimi mehagronya mishshemeh derava zuza kezuze dame vela kane
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe veha amrinan mishshemeh derava kane amar leh tittargam shematacha bemocher sadehu

a: Mippene raatah

Peshita bae lezabbone bima vela ashkach vezabben bematayim veka ayel venafek azzuze la kane ella i bae lezabbone bima vela ashkach vei tarach hava mashkach vela terach vezabben bematayim veka ayel venafek azzuze may kemocher sadehu mippene raatah dame o la teku
Sachar et hachammar veet hakkaddar vechu socher alehen o matan ad kamma socher alehen amar rav nachman ad kede secharan
Etiveh rava lerav nachman ad arbaim vachamishshim zuz amar leh ki tanya hahi shebbata chavila leyado

Matni hassocher et hachamor leholicho bahar veholicho babbika babbika veholicho bahar afilu zo eser milin vezo eser milin umeta chayyav hassocher et hachamor leholichah bahar veholicha babbika im hechlika patur veim huchama chayyav leholichah babbika veholicha bahar im hechlika chayyav veim huchamma patur im mechamat hammaala chayyav
Hassocher et hachamor vehivrika o shennaaset angarya omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha meta o nishbera chayyav lehaamid lo chamor
Gema may shena resha dela ka mefalleg umay shena sefa deka mefalleg

Amri deve rabbi yannay resha shemmeta mechamat avir deamrinan avera dehar katlah veamrinan avera devika katlah rabbi yose bar chanina amar kegon shemmeta mechamat uvtzana rabba amar kegon shehikkishah nachash
Rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar kol hammaavir al daat shel baal habbayit
b: Nikra gazlan
He rabbi meir ilema rabbi meir detzabba ditnan hannoten tzemer latzabba litzboa lo adom utzvao shachor shachor utzvao adom rabbi meir omer noten lo deme tzamro
Rabbi yehuda omer im hashshevach yater al hayetzia noten lo et hayetzia veim hayetzia yetera al hashshevach noten lo et hashshevach
Mimmay dilma shane hatam dekanye beshinuy maase

Ella ha rabbi meir demigbat purim detanya migbat purim lefurim migbat hair leotah hair veen medakdekin baddavar aval lokchin et haagalim veshochatin veochlim otan vehammotar yippol lechis shel tzedaka

Rabbi eliezer omer migbat purim lefurim veen heani rashshay likach mehen retzua lesandalo ella im ken hitna bemaamad anshe hair divre rabbi yaakov sheamar mishshum rabbi meir verabban shimon ben gamliel mekel
Dilma hatam name deaddata defurim hu deyahev leh addata demide acharina la yahev leh

Ella ha rabbi meir detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir hannoten dinar leani likach lo chaluk lo yikkach bo tallit tallit lo yikkach bo chaluk mippene shemmaavir al dato shel baal habbayit
Vedilma shane hatam deatu lemichshedeh deamri inashe amar pelanya zavenna leh levusha lifloni anya vela zevan leh i name zavenna leh gelima vela zevan leh
Im ken litne mippene hachashad may mippene shemmaavir al dato shel baal habbayit shema minah mishshum doshanni hu vechol hammaavir al daat shel baal habbayit nikra gazlan
Hassocher et hachamor vehivrika may vehivrika hacha targimu nehorita rava amar avzekat
Hahu daamar lehu avzekat bemelata demalka amaru leh bemay betalle chesaf o betalle dehav ika deamri betalle chesaf amar vekatluh ika deamri betalle dehav amar veshavkuh
O shennaaset angarya omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha amar rav lo shanu ella beangarya chozeret aval angarya sheenah chozeret chayyav lehaamid lo chamor
Ushmuel amar ben angarya chozeret ben angarya sheenah chozeret im bederech halicha nitla omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha veim lav bederech halichatah nitla chayyav lehaamid lo chamor
Metivi hassocher et hachamor vehivrika o shennishtatteta omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha meta o shennaaset angarya chayyav lehaamid lo chamor
Bishlama lerav la kashya kan beangarya chozeret kan beangarya sheenah chozeret ella lishmuel kashya
Vechi tema lishmuel name la kashya kan shebbederech halichatah nitla kan shello bederech halichatah nitla
Ha middekatane sefa rabbi shimon ben elazar omer im bederech halichatah nitla omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha veim lav chayyav lehaamid lo chamor mikkelal diltanna kamma la shane leh

Amar lecha shemuel lav mi ika rabbi shimon ben elazar dekae keoti ana daamari kerabbi shimon ben elazar ibaet ema kullah rabbi shimon ben elazar hi vechassore michassera vehachi katane hassocher et hachamor vehivrika o nishtattet omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha meta o shennaaset angarya chayyav lehaamid lo chamor bamme devarim amurim shello bederech halichatah nitla aval nitla bederech halichatah omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha

a: Divre rabbi shimon ben elazar shehaya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer im bederech hiluchah nitla omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha veim lo chayyav lehaamid lo chamor

Umi matzet mokmatte lah kerabbi shimon ben elazar veha katane resha hassocher et hachamor vehivrika o shennishtatteta omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha veilu rabbi shimon ben elazar amar hassocher et hachamor lirkov aleha vehivrika o shennishtatteta chayyav lehaamid lo chamor
Amar rabba bar rav huna lirkov aleha shane amar rav pappa uchle zechuchit kelirkov aleha dame
Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav hassocher et hachamor lirkov aleha umeta lo bachatzi hadderech noten lo secharo shel chatzi hadderech veen lo alav ella taromet
Hechi dame i dishchiach leogore taromet may avidteh i dela shechiach leogore agra bae lemitav leh
Leolam dela shechiach leogore umishshum deamar leh ilu baet lemete ad hacha lav agra baet lemitav
Hechi dame i daamar leh chamor setam ha chayyav lehaamid lo chamor acher i daamar leh chamor ze im yesh bedameha likach yikkach
La tzericha besheen bedameha likach im yesh bedameha liskor yiskor rav letameh deamar rav la mechallenan karna
Deittemar hassocher et hachamor umeta lo bachatzi hadderech amar rav im yesh bedameha likach yikkach liskor al yiskor ushmuel amar af liskor yiskor
Bemay kamipalgi rav savar la mechallenan karna ushmuel savar mechallenan karna
Metivi yavesh hailan o niktzatz shenehem asurin bo ketzad yaase yillakach bo karka vehu ochel perot veha hacha kevan dechi mate yovel ka hadra ara lemarah veka chalya karna

Hacha bemay askinan dezabben leh leshittin shenin deamar rav chisda amar rav kattina minnayin lammocher sadehu leshishshim shana sheenah chozeret bayyovel shenneemar vehaaretz lo timmacher litzmitut mi sheen sham yovel nitzmetet yesh sham yovel enah nitzmetet yatzta zo sheaf al pi sheen sham yovel enah nitzmetet

Sof sof lechi matu shitin shenin ka hadra ara lemarah veka chalya karna ella hacha bemay askinan bizman sheen hayyovel noheg hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach bizman shehayyovel noheg umchallenan karna nitzlecheh letzive venishkeleh
I mishshum ha la kashya zimnin deshalmu shene mashkanta mikkamme yovel i name dematu leh zuze ufarek lah arba vechamesh shenin mikkamme yovel
Tanu rabbanan hassocher et hassefina vetava lah bachatzi hadderech rabbi natan omer im natan lo yittol veim lo natan lo yitten
Hechi dame ilema bisfina zo veyayin setam im natan ammay lo yittol nema leh hav li sefinta daana mayetena chamra ella bisfina setam veyayin ze im lo natan ammay lo yitten
b: Nema leh hav li hahu chamra vaana mayetena sefinta
Amar rav pappa la mashkachatte lah ella bisfina zo veyayin ze aval bisfina setam veyayin setam cholkin

Tanu rabbanan hassocher et hassefina ufrakah lah bachatzi hadderech noten lo secharo shel chatzi hadderech veen lo alav ella taromet hechi dame ilema deka mashkach leogorah ammay it leh taromet vei dela ka mashkach leogorah kulleh agrah bae shallome
Leolam deka mashkach leogorah ella ammay it leh taromet mishshum rafseta disfinta i hachi taanta meallayeta hi umamona it leh gabbeh
Ella may perakah defarkeh letuneh begavah ella may taromet mishshum shinuy data i name leashla yattira

Tanu rabbanan hassocher et hachamor lirkov aleha socher manniach aleha kesuto ulginoto umzonot shel otah hadderech mikkan veelach chammar meakkev alav chammar manniach alav seorim veteven umzonotav shel oto hayyom mikkan veelach socher meakkev alav
Hechi dame i dishchiach lemizban chammar name liakkev vei dela shechiach lemizban socher name la liakkev
Amar rav pappa la tzericha dishchiach lemitrach ulmizban meauona leauona chammar darkeh lemitrach ulmizban socher lav darkeh lemitrach ulmizban
Tanu rabbanan hassocher et hachamor lirkov aleha ish lo tirkav aleha ishsha ishsha rochev aleha ish veishsha ben gedola uven ketanna afilu meubberet vaafilu menika
Hashta menika amratte meubberet mibaya amar rav pappa meubberet vehi menika kaamar
Amar abbaye shema minah binita akkeresah takla lemay nafka minah lemikkach umimkar

a: Matni hassocher et happara lacharosh bahar vecharash babbika im nishbar hakkankan patur babbika vecharash bahar im nishbar hakkankan chayyav ladush bekitnit vedash bitvua patur ladush bitvua vedash bekitnit chayyav mippene shehakkitnit machleket

Gema hecha dela shanni bah man meshallem amar rav pappa denaket perasha meshallem rav shisha bereh derav idi amar denaket mana meshallem vehilcheta denaket mana meshallem vei duchta demachzeki gundere gerunde tarvayehu meshallemin

Amar rabbi yochanan hammocher para lachavero veamar lo para zo nagchanit hi nashchanit hi baatanit hi ravtzanit hi vehaya bah mum echad usnafo ben hammumin hare ze mikkach taut mum ze umum acher en ze mikkach taut
Tanya name hachi hammocher shifcha lachavero veamar lo shifcha zo shota hi nichpet hi meshumemet hi vehaya bah mum echad usnafo ben hammumin hare ze mikkach taut mum ze umum acher en ze mikkach taut
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe hau bah kol hammumin hallalu mahu amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava hau bah kol hammumin hallalu en ze mikkach taut

Matni hassocher et hachamor lehavi aleha chittin vehevi aleha seorin chayyav tevua vehevi aleha teven chayyav mippene shehannefach kashe kemassooy lehavi letech chittin vehevi letech seorin patur veim mosif al massao chayyav vechamma yosif al massao vihe chayyav somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir sea legamal shelosha kabbin lachamor

Gema itmar abbaye amar kashe kemassoy tenan rava amar kashe lemassoy tenan abbaye amar kashe kemassoy tenan nifcha ki tikla vei mosif shelosha kabbin chayyav rava amar kashe lemassoy tenan tikla ki tikla venifcha have tosefet

Tenan lehavi letech chittin vehevi letech seorin patur veim hosif al massao chayyav may lav sheloshet kabbin lo sea veha alah katane vechamma yosif al massao vihe chayyav somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir sea legamal shelosha kabbin lachamor
Hachi kaamar hecha dela shanni chittin vehevi chittin seorin vehevi seorin kamma yosif al massao vihe chayyav somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir sea legamal shelosha kabbin lachamor
Ta shema lehavi letech chittin vehevi
b: Shesh esre seorim chayyav ha sheloshet kabbin patur targemah abbaye bimchikata
Tanu rabbanan kav lechattaf adriv laareva kor lisfina sheloshet korim levurni gedola

Amar mar kav lechattaf im ita dela matze beh bar daat hu lishdeyeh amar abbaye beshechavato lealtar rava amar afilu tema beshello chavato lealtar la tzericha ella leagra yattira rav ashe amar hu savur chulsha hu denaket leh
Kor lisfina sheloshet korin levurni gedola amar rav pappa shema minah setam sefinot bat telatin korin lemay nafka minah lemikkach umimkar
Matni kol haummanin shomre sachar hen vechullan sheamru tol et shellecha vehave maot shomer chinnam shemor li veeshmor lach shomer sachar shemor li veamar lo hannach lefanay shomer chinnam

Hilvahu al hammashkon shomer sachar rabbi yehuda omer hilvahu maot shomer chinnam hilvahu perot shomer sachar abba shaul omer rashshay adam lehaskir mashkono shel ani lihot posek veholech alav mippene shehu kemeshiv aveda
Gema lema matnitin dela kerabbi meir detanya socher ketzad meshallem rabbi meir omer keshomer chinnam rabbi yehuda omer keshomer sachar

Afilu tema rabbi meir behahi hanaa deka shavek kulle alma veagar leh ledideh have ilaveh shomer sachar i hachi socher name behahi hanaa deka shavek kulle alma umogar leh ledideh have ilaveh shomer sachar
Ella afilu tema rabbi meir behahi hanaa deka yahev leh tefe purta have ilaveh shomer sachar
Socher name mi la askinan deka meshave leh tefe purta ella afilu tema rabbi meir behahi hanaa detafes leh aagreh dela bae lemeal ulmipak azzuze have aleh shomer sachar
Ibaet ema kidmachlef rabba bar avuh vetane socher ketzad meshallem rabbi meir omer keshomer sachar rabbi yehuda omer keshomer chinnam
Vechullan sheamru tol et shellecha vehave maot shomer chinnam tenan hatam amar lo shoel shallach veshillechah umeta chayyav vechen beshaa shemmachzirah

Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda lo shanu ella shehechzirah betoch yeme sheelatah aval leachar yeme sheelatah patur metiv rav nachman bar pappa vechullan sheamru tol et shellecha vehave maot shomer chinnam

a: Ha gemartiv shomer sachar la ha have maot vetol et shellecha shomer sachar
Aval gemartiv may shomer chinnam i hachi addetane vechullan sheamru tol et shellecha vehave maot shomer chinnam nashmeinan gemartiv vechol shekken tol et shellecha
Tol et shellecha itztericha leh salka datach amena shomer chinnam name la have ka mashma lan
Ika deamri amar rav nachman bar pappa af anan name tenena vechullan sheamru tol et shellecha vehave maot shomer chinnam may lav hu haddin gemartiv lo tol et shellecha shane

Huna mar bar marimar kammeh deravina rame matnitin ahadade umshanne tenan vechullan sheamru tol et shellecha vehave maot shomer chinnam vehu haddin ligmartiv urminhu amar lo shoel shallach veshillechah umeta chayyav vechen beshaa shemmachzirah umshanne amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda lo shanu ella shehechzir betoch yeme sheelatah aval leachar yeme sheelatah patur
Ibaya lehu patur mishshoel vechayyav keshomer sachar o dilma shomer sachar name la have amar ammemar mistabbera patur mishshoel vechayyav keshomer sachar hoil venehene mehanne have

Tanya keoteh deammemar hallokeach kelim mibbet haumman leshaggeran levet chamiv veamar lo im mekabbelin otan mimmenni ani noten lecha demehen veim lav ani noten lecha lefi tovat hanaa shebbahen veneensu bahalicha chayyav
Bachazira patur mippene shehu kenose sachar

Hahu gavra dezabben leh chamara lechavreh amar leh ka mamtena lah leduchta peloni i mizdabbena mutav vei la mahdarna lah nihalach azal vela izdabbena uvahade deka ate ittenis ata lekammeh derav nachman chayeveh
Etiveh rabba lerav nachman neensu bahalicha chayyav uvachazara patur mippene shehu kenose sachar
Amar leh chazara dehay halicha hi may tama sevara hu bachazirato ilu ashkach lezabboneh mi la zabbeneh
Shemor li veeshmor lach shomer sachar veammay shemira bivalim hi amar rav pappa daamar leh shemor li hayyom veeshmor lecha lemachar

Tanu rabbanan shemor li veeshmor lach hashileni veashilecha shemor li veashilecha hashileni veeshmor lach kullan naasu shomre sachar ze laze veammay shemira bivalim hi amar rav pappa daamar leh shemor li hayyom veeshmor lecha lemachar

Hanhu ahaloye dechol yoma hava afe lehu chad minayehu hahu yoma amaru leh lechad minayehu zil afi lan amar lehu netaru li gelimay addaata peshau beh veiggenuv veiggeniv ato lekammeh derav pappa chayevinhu
Amaru leh rabbanan lerav pappa ammay peshia bivalim hi ikkesif lesof igallay milta dehahu shata shichra hava ka shate

Hanicha leman deamar peshia bivalim patur mishshum hachi ikkesif ella leman deamar chayyav ammay ikkesif ella hahu yoma lav dideh hava vaamaru leh ledideh zil afi lan atte vaamar lehu behahu agra deka afena lechu neturu gelimay
b: Ad daata iggeniv ato lekammeh derav pappa chayevinhu amaru leh rabbanan lerav pappa ha shemira bivalim hi ikkesif lesof igallay milta dehahi shata shichra hava shate

Hanhu be tere dahao ka mesaggu beorcha chad arich vechad gutza aricha rechiv chamara vahava leh sedina gutza mikasse sarbala veka mesagge bechareh ki meto lenahara shakleh lesarbaleh veotveh ilave chamara veshakleh lisdineh dehahu veikassi beh shatfuh mayya lisdineh
Ata lekammeh derava chayeveh amaru leh rabbanan lerava ammay sheela bivalim hi ikkesif lesof igallay milta divla dateh shakleh uvla dateh otveh

Hahu gavra deogar leh chamara lechavreh amar leh chazi la tezol beorcha dinhar pekod deika mayya zil beorcha denaresh deleka mayya azel beorcha dinhar pekod umit chamra ki ata amar in beorcha dinhar pekod azali umihu leka mayya
Amar leh rava ma leh leshakker i bae amar leh ana beorcha denaresh azali amar leh abbaye ma li leshakker bimkom edim la amrinan

Shemor li veamar lo hannach lefanay shomer chinnam amar rav huna amar lo hannach lefanecha eno lo shomer chinnam velo shomer sachar ibaya lehu hannach setama may ta shema shemor li veamar lo hannach lefanay shomer chinnam ha setama velo kelum
Adderabba middeamar rav huna hannach lefanecha hu deeno lo shomer chinnam velo shomer sachar ha setama shomer chinnam have ella meha leka lemishma minah
Lema ketannae im hichnis birshut baal chatzer chayyav rabbi omer bechullam eno chayyav ad sheyekabbel alav baal habbayit lishmor

Mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella bechatzer devat nattore hi vechi kaamar leh ayyel ayyel deintar lach kaamar leh aval hacha shuka lav bar nattore hu annach vetiv netar lach kaamar leh

I name ad kan la kaamar rabbi hatam ella bachatzero dilayyole reshuta ka vae lemishkal mineh vechi yahev leh reshuta leayyole tiv venattar lach kaamar leh aval hacha hannach vaana menattarna kaamar leh dei salka datach hannach vetiv venattar kaamar leh i leotove reshuta bae lemishkal mineh
Hilvahu al hammashkon shomer sachar lema matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer detanya hammalve et chavero al hammashkon veavad hammashkon yishshava veyittol meotav divre rabbi eliezer
Rabbi akiva omer yachol lomar lo kelum hilvitani ella al hammashkon avad hammashkon avdu meotecha aval hilvahu elef zuz bishtar vehinniach lo mashkon alehem divre hakkol avad hammashkon avdu meotav
Afilu tema rabbi eliezer vela kashya kan shemmishkeno bishat halvaato kan shemmishkeno shello bishat halvaato
Veha ide veide

a: Hilvahu al hammashkon katane ella la kashya kan shehilvahu maot kan shehilvahu perot
Veha middekatane sefa rabbi yehuda omer hilvahu maot shomer chinnam hilvahu perot shomer sachar michlal diltanna kamma la shane leh

Kullah rabbi yehuda hi vechassore michassera vehachi katane hilvahu al hammashkon shomer sachar bamme devarim amurim shehilvahu perot aval hilvahu maot shomer chinnam sherabbi yehuda omer hilvahu maot shomer chinnam hilvahu perot shomer sachar
I hachi kama lah matnitin dela kerabbi akiva ella mechavarta matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer
Lema bidla shave mashkon shiur zuze uvdishmuel ka mipalgi deamar shemuel hay man deozfeh alpa zuze lechavreh veannach leh katta demaggela ilavayehu avad katta demaggela avadu alpa zuze
I bidla shave mashkon shiur zuze dechulle alma let lehu dishmuel vehacha bidshave shiur zuze veka mipalgi bidrabbi yitzchak
Deamar rabbi yitzchak minnayin levaal chov shekkone mashkon shenneemar ulcha tihye tzedaka im eno kone mashkon tzedaka mena leh mikkan levaal chov shekkone mashkon
Vetisbera emor deamar rabbi yitzchak bemishkeno shello bishat halvaato aval mishkeno bishat halvaato mi amar

Ella mishkeno shello bishat halvaato kulle alma it lehu derabbi yitzchak vehacha bemishkeno bishat halvaato uvshomer aveda ka mipalgi deitmar shomer aveda rabba amar keshomer chinnam rav yosef amar keshomer sachar
Lema derav yosef tannae hi la beshomer aveda dechulle alma it lehu derav yosef vehacha
b: Bemilve tzarich lemashkon kamipalgi mar savar mitzva ka aved shehilvahu vehave shomer sachar umar savar lav mitzva ka aved shellahanaato mitkaven vehave shomer chinnam

Abba shaul omer muttar laadam lehaskir mashkono shel ani lihot pochet veholech amar rav chanan bar amme amar shemuel halacha keabba shaul veaf abba shaul la amar ella bemara ufasal vekardom hoil unfish agrayehu vezutar pechatayehu
Matni hammaavir chavit mimmakom lemakom ushvarah ben shomer chinnam ben shomer sachar yishshava rabbi eliezer omer ze veze yishshava vetameha ani im yecholin ze vaze lishava

Gema tanu rabbanan hammaavir chavit lachavero mimmakom lemakom ushvarah ben shomer chinnam ben shomer sachar yishshava divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer shomer chinnam yishshava nose sachar yeshallem rabbi eliezer omer ze veze yishshava vetameha ani im yecholin ze vaze lishava

Lememra desavar rabbi meir nitkal lav poshea hu vehatanya nishbera kaddo velo silkah nafla gemallo velo heemidah rabbi meir mechayyev behezekan vachachamim omrim patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim vekayema lan divnitkal poshea peligi

Amar rabbi elazar tivrah mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo vaata rabbi yehuda lememar shomer chinnam yishshava nose sachar yeshallem hay ki dineh vehay ki dineh vaata rabbi eliezer lememar in gemara kerabbi meir umihu tameha ani im yecholin ze vaze lishava

Bishlama shomer chinnam mishteva dela pesha bah ella shomer sachar ammay mishteva ki la pesha name shallome bae vaafilu shomer chinnam name hatinach bimkom midron shello bimkom midron mi matze mishteva dela pesha bah

a: Vaafilu bimkom midron name hatinach hecha deleka reaya aval hecha deika reaya nayete reaya venippetar detanya isi ben yehuda omer en roe shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem ha yesh roe yavi reaya veyippater
Verabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan shevua zo takkanat chachamim hi sheim i atta omer ken en lecha adam hammaavir chavit lachavero mimmakom lemakom

Hechi mishteva amar rava shevua shello bechauona shevartiha vaata rabbi yehuda lememar shomer chinnam yishshava nose sachar yeshallem hay kedineh vehay kedineh vaata rabbi elazar lememar in gemara kerabbi meir umihu tameha ani im yecholim ze vaze lishava

Bishlama shomer chinnam mishteva shello pasha bah ella shomer sachar ammay mishteva ki la pesha name bae shallome vaafilu shomer chinnam name ha tinach bimkom midron shello bimkom midron mi matze mishteva shello pasha

Vaafilu bimkom midron name ha tinach hecha deleka reaya hecha deika reaya nayete reaya veyippater detanya isi ben yehuda omer en roe shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem ha yesh roe yavi reaya veyippater

Hahu gavra dahava ka meabbar chavita dechamra beristeka demachoza vetavrah beziza demachoza ata lekammeh derava amar leh risteka demachoza shechichi bah inashe zil ayeti reaya veiptar amar leh rav yosef bereh keman keisi amar leh in keisi usvira lan keoteh
Hahu gavra daamar leh lechavreh zil zeven li arba mea danne chamra azal zevan leh lesof ata lekammeh amar leh zevine lach arba mea danne chamra utkifu lehu

Ata lekammeh derava amar leh arba mea danne chamra tekifi kala it lah lemilta zil ayeti reaya demeikara ki mezabbenatte lehu chamra mealleya hava veiptar amar leh rav yosef bereh keman keisi amar leh in keisi usvira lan keoteh
Atken rav chiyya bar yosef besichra hane dedaru beagra veitvar neshallem palga may tama nefish lechad vezutar litre karov leones vekarov lifshia bedigla meshallem kullah

Rabba bar bar chanan tevaru leh hanhu shakolae chavita dechamra shekal liglimayehu ato amaru lerav amar leh hav lehu gelimayehu amar leh dina hachi amar leh in lemaan telech bederech tovim yehav lehu gelimayehu amaru leh anye anan vetarchinan kulleh yoma vechafenan velet lan mide amar leh zil hav agrayehu amar leh dina hachi amar leh in veorchot tzaddikim tishmor
Hadaran alach hassocher et haummanin

Matni hassocher et happoalim veamar lahem lehashkim ulhaariv makom shennahagu shello lehashkim veshello lehaariv eno rashshay lechofan makom shennahagu lazun yazun lesappek bimtika yesappek hakkol keminhag hammedina
Maase berabbi yochanan ben matya sheamar livno tze sechor lanu poalin halach ufasak lahem mezonot

Uchshebba etzel aviv amar lo beni afilu im atta ose lahem kisudat shelomo bishato lo yatzata yede chovatcha immahen shehen bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov ella ad shello yatchilu bimlacha tze veemor lahem al menat sheen lachem alay ella pat vekitnit bilvad rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo haya tzarich lomar hakkol keminhag hammedina
