Amar resh lakish
b: Poel bichnisato mishshello bitziato mishshel baal habbayit shenneemar tizrach hashshemesh yeasefun veel meonotam yirbatzun yetze adam lefoolo velaavodato ade arev
Velichze hechi nehigi beir chadasha venichze mehecha ka atu benakotae ibaet ema deamar lehu deagritu li kefoel deorayeta

Daresh rabbi zera veamri lah tane rav yosef may dichtiv tashet choshech vihi layela bo tirmos kol chayeto yaar tashet choshech vihi layela ze haolam hazze sheddome lelayela bo tirmos kol chayeto yaar ellu reshaim shebbo sheddomin lechayya shebbayyaar

Tizrach hashshemesh yeasefun veel meonotam yirbatzun tizrach hashshemesh latztzaddikim yeasefun reshaim legehinnam veel meonotam yirbatzun en lach kol tzaddik vetzaddik sheen lo mador lefi chevodo yetze adam lefoolo yetzu tzaddikim lekabbel secharan velaavodato ade arev bemi shehishlim avodato ade arev

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon ashkach lehahu parhagvana deka tafes gannave amar leh hechi yachlatte lehu lav kechevata metili dichtiv bo tirmos kol chayeto yaar ika deamri mehay kera kaamar leh yeerov bammistar kearye vesukko dilma shaklatte tzaddike veshavkatte rashshie
Amar leh umay eeved harmana demalka hu amar ta agmerach hechi taaved ul bearba shae lechanuta ki chazet inish deka shate chamra veka naket kasa bideh veka menamnem sheol ilaveh
I tzurba merabbanan hu venayem kaddome kaddem legirseh i poel hu kadem ka aved avidteh vei avidteh belelya raddode radded vei la gannava hu vetifseh

Ishtema milta be malka amaru karyana deigarta ihu leheve parvanka atuh lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon veka tafes gannave veazel shelach leh rabbi yehoshua ben korcha chometz ben yayin ad matay atta moser ammo shel elohenu lahariga

Shelach leh kotzim ani mechalle min hakkerem shelach leh yavo baal hakkerem vichalle et kotzav yoma chad pega beh hahu koves karyeh chometz ben yayin amar middachatzif kulle hay shema minah rashshia hu amar lehu tifsuh tafsuh

Levatar denach dateh azal batreh lefarokeh vela matze kare aleh shomer piv ulshono shomer mitztzarot nafsho zakfuh kam tute zekifa veka vache amaru leh rabbi al yera beenecha shehu uvno baalu naara meorasa beom hakkippurim
Hinniach yado al bene meav amar sisu bene meay sisu uma sefekot shellachem kach vaddaot shellachem al achat kamma vechamma muvtach ani bachem sheen rimma vetolea sholetet bachem
Vaafilu hachi la meyatva dateh ashkeuh samma deshinta veayeluh leveta deshesha ukrau lichreseh hao mappeki mineh dikule dikule detarba umotvi beshimsha betammuz veav vela masrechi
Kol tarba name la masrach kol tarba la seriach ki it beh shuryake summake masrach hacha af al gav deikka shuryake summake la masrach kare annafsheh af besari yishkon lavetach
Veaf rabbi yishmael berabbi yose meta

a: Ki hay maase lideh pega beh eliyyahu
Amar leh ad matay atta moser ammo shel elohenu lahariga amar leh may eeved harmana demalka hu amar leh avuch arak leasya atte arok leludkiyya
Ki hao mikkali rabbi yishmael berabbi yose verabbi elazar berabbi shimon bahade hadade hava ayel bakra detore benayehu vela hava naga behu

Amara lehu hahi matronita benechem enam shellachem amaru lah shellahen gadol mishshellanu kol shekken ika deamri hachi amaru lah ki chaish gevurato ika deamri hachi amaru lah ahava docheket et habbasar
Ulma lehu leahdore lah veha ketiv al taan kesil keivalto shello lehotzi laaz al benehem

Amar rabbi yochanan evreh derabbi yishmael berabbi yose kechemet bat tesha kabbin amar rav pappa evreh derabbi yochanan kechemet bat chameshet kabbin veamri lah bat sheloshet kabbin derav pappa gufeh ki dekure deharpenae

Amar rabbi yochanan ana ishtayyari mishshappire yerushalayim hay man devae michze shufreh derabbi yochanan nayete kasa dechaspa mibbe silke unmalleyeh partzidayya derummana summaka venahdar leh kelila devarda summaka lefummeh venotveh ben shimsha letulla hahu hanhu zaharure meen shufreh derabbi yochanan

Ini vehaamar mar shufreh derav kahana meen shufreh derabbi avahu shufreh derabbi avahu meen shufreh deyaakov avinu shufreh deyaakov avinu meen shufreh deadam harishon veilu rabbi yochanan la ka chashev leh shane rabbi yochanan dehadrat panim la haveya leh
Rabbi yochanan hava azel veyatev ashshaare tevila amar ki salkan benot yisrael mittevilat mitzva lifgeu bi ki hechi deleheo lehu bene shappire keoti gemiri orayeta keoti

Amaru leh rabbanan la mistefe mar meena bisha amar lehu ana mizzara deosef kaatena dela shalta beh ena bisha dichtiv ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin veamar rabbi avahu al tikre ale ayin ella ole ayin
Rabbi yose bar chanina amar mehacha veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz ma dagim shebbayyam mayim mechassim otam veen haayin sholetet bahen af zaro shel yosef en haayin sholetet bahen

Yoma chad hava ka sache rabbi yochanan beyardena chazyeh resh lakish ushvar leyardena abbatreh amar leh chelach leorayeta amar leh shufrach lenashe amar leh i hadratte bach yahevna lach achoti deshappira minay kabbel aleh bae lemihdar leetoye maneh vela matze hadar
Akreyeh veatneyeh veshavveyeh gavra rabba yoma chad hao mippalgi be midresha hassayif vehassakkin vehappigon veharomach umaggal yad umaggal katzir meematay mekabbelin tuma mishsheat gemar melachtan

Umeematay gemar melachtan rabbi yochanan omer mishsheyetzarfem bakkivshan resh lakish amar mishsheyetzachtzechen bemayim amar leh listaa belisteuteh yada amar leh umay ahanet li hatam rabbi karu li hacha rabbi karu li amar leh ahanay lach daakarvinach tachat kanfe hashshechina
Chalash dateh derabbi yochanan chalash resh lakish atay achateh ka vachya amara leh ase bishvil banay amar lah ozva yetomecha ani achayye ase bishvil almenuti amar lah vealmenotecha alay tivtachu
Nach nafsheh derabbi shimon ben lakish vahava ka mitztaar rabbi yochanan batreh tuva amaru rabbanan man lezil leyattoveh ledateh nezil rabbi elazar ben pedat dimchaddedan shematateh

Azal yetev kammeh kol milta dahava amar rabbi yochanan amar leh tanya dimsayea lach amar atte kevar lekisha bar lekisha ki hava amena milta hava makshe li esrin vearba kushyata umfarkina leh esrin vearbea peruke umimmela ravecha shemata veatte amratte tanya dimsayya lach attu la yadana deshappir kaamena
Hava ka azel vekara maneh veka vache veamar hecha atte bar lakisha hecha atte bar lakisha vahava ka tzavach ad deshaf dateh mineh beo rabbanan rachame aleh venach nafsheh
b: Vaafilu hachi la semach rabbi elazar berabbi shimon addateh kabbel aleh yissure beurta hao mayechi leh shitin namte letzafra nagdi mittuteh shitin meshichle dema vechiva
Limchar avada leh devethu shitin mine lafda veachel lehu uvare vela havat shavka leh devethu lemipak leve midresha ki hechi dela lidchakuhu rabbanan
Beurta amar lehu achay vereay bou betzafra amar lehu zilu mippene bitul tora yoma chad shemaa devethu amara leh atte ka mayetet lehu ilavach killita mamon shel bet abba imrada azala levet nasha
Seliku vaato hanach shitin safonae ayalu leh shitin avde ki nekiti shitin arnake vaavadu leh shitin mine lafda veachel lehu

Yoma chad amara lah levartah zili bekay baavuch may ka aved haidana atya amar lah zili emari leimich shellanu gadol mishshellahem kare annafsheh hayeta kooniyyot socher mimmerchak tavi lachmah achal ushti uvri nefak leve midresha

Ayeto lekammeh shitin mine dema taharinhu hava ka meranneni rabbanan veamri salka datach let behu chad safek amar lehu im kemoti hu yihu kullam zecharim veim lav tehe nekeva achat benehem hau kullam zecharim veassiku lehu rabbi elazar al shemeh
Tanya amar rabbi kamma periyya urviyya bitla reshaa zo miyyisrael

Ki hava ka nayecha nafsheh amar lah lidvethu yadana bidrabbanan dirtichi alay vela miaski bi shappir agneyan beilitay vela tidchalin minay amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani ishtaya li imeh derabbi yonatan deishtaya lah devethu derabbi elazar berabbi shimon la pachot mittamne sere vela tefe meesrin utren shenin agneteh beilita

Ki hava salkana meayenana leh bemazyeh ki hava mishtamta binita mineh hava ate dema yoma chad chazay richsha deka nafek meunneh chalash datay itchazi li bechelma amar li la mide hu yoma chad shami beziluta detzurba merabbanan vela machay kidvae li

Ki hao atu be tere ledina hao kayemi abbava amar mar milteh umar milteh nafek kala meiliteh veamar ish peloni atta chayyav ish peloni atta zakkay yoma chad hava ka minatzya devethu bahade shivavta amara lah tehe kevaalah shello nitan likvura amri rabbanan kulle hay vadday lav orach ara

Ika deamri rabbi shimon ben yochay itchazay lehu bechelma amar lehu pereda achat yesh li benechem vei attem rotzim lahaviah etzli azul rabbanan leiasoke beh la shevaku bene achberayya dechol shene dahava nayem rabbi elazar berabbi shimon beiliteh la selik chayya raa lematayehu

Yoma chad maale yoma dechipure hava hao teridi shaddaru rabbanan livne vere veassekuhu learseh veamteuh limarta daavuh ashkechuha leachna dehadra lah limarta amaru lah achna achna pitchi pich veyikkanes ben etzel aviv petacha lehu

Shalach rabbi ledabber beishto shelacha leh keli shennishtammesh bo kodesh yishtammesh bo chol tamman amrin baatar demare veta tela zeyaneh kulba raaya kulleteh tela shelach lah nehi divtora gadol mimmenni aval bemaasim tovim mi gadol mimmenni shelacha leh betora miha gadol mimmecha la yadana bemaasim yadana deha kabbel aleh yissure
Betora may hi dechi hao yatvi rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yehoshua ben korcha assafsalle yatvi kammayehu rabbi elazar berabbi shimon verabbi aara
Makshu umfarku amri mimehen anu shotim vehem yoshvim al gabbe karka avadu lehu safsalle assekinhu

Amar lahen rabban shimon ben gamliel pereda achat yesh li benechem veattem mevakkeshim leabbedah hemeni achatuh lerabbi amar lahen rabbi yehoshua ben korcha mi sheyyesh lo av yichye umi sheen lo av yamut achatuh name lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon chalash dateh amar ka chashvitu leh keoti

Ad hahu yoma ki hava amar rabbi milta hava mesayya leh rabbi elazar berabbi shimon mikkan veelach ki hava amar rabbi yesh li lehashiv amar leh rabbi elazar berabbi shimon kach vechach yesh lecha lehashiv zo hi teshuvatcha hashta hikaftanu teshuvot chavilot sheen bahen mammash
Chalash dateh derabbi ata amar leh laavuh amar leh bene al yera lach shehu ari ben ari veatta ari ben shual
Hayenu deamar rabbi shelosha invetanin hen veellu hen abba

a: Uvne vetira veonatan ben shaul rabban shimon ben gamliel ha daamaran bene vetira deamar mar hoshivuhu barosh uminuhu lenasi alehen yonatan ben shaul dekaamar leh ledavid veatta timloch al yisrael vaani ehye lecha lemishne
Mimmay dilma yonatan ben shaul dachaza digrir alma batar david bene vetira name dachazo lehillel daadif minayehu ella rabban shimon ben gamliel vadday invetan hava
Amar rabbi chavivin yissurin kabbel aleh telesar shene shet bitzmirta ushva betzafrina betzafdina veamri lah shiva bitzmirta veshet betzafrina

Ahuryareh deve rabbi hava attir mishshabbur malka kad hava rame kista lechevata hava azel kala bitlata mile hava mechaven derame behahi shata deayel rabbi levet hakkisse vaafilu hachi mavar leh kaleh lekalayehu veshamu leh nachote yamma
Vaafilu hachi yissure derabbi elazar berabbi shimon adifi midderabbi deilu rabbi elazar berabbi shimon meahava bau umeahava halchu derabbi al yede maase bau veal yede maase halchu
Al yede maase bau may hi dehahu igla dahao ka mamtu leh lishchita azal talye leresheh bechanfeh derabbi veka vache amar leh zil lechach notzarta amri hoil vela ka merachem leto aleh yissurin
Veal yede maase halchu yoma chad hava ka chansha ammeteh derabbi beta hava shadya bene karkushta veka chansha lehu amar lah shivkinhu ketiv verachamav al kol maasav amaru hoil umrachem nerachem aleh

Kullehu shene yissure derabbi elazar la shachev inish bela zimneh kullehu shene yissure derabbi la itzterich alma lemitra deamar rabba bar rav shela keshe yoma demitra keoma dedina veamar ammemar i lav tzerich lealma bau rabbanan rachame aleh umvatteli leh afilu hachi ki hao akri pugla mimmeshara hava kayema bera malya mayya

Ikla rabbi leatreh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon amar lahem yesh lo ben leoto tzaddik amru lo yesh lo ben vechol zona shenniskeret bishnayim socharto bishmona atyeh asmecheh berabbi veashlemeh lerabbi shimon ben isi ben lakonya achuha deimmeh

Kol yoma hava amar lekiryati ana azel amar leh chakkim avdu yatach vegulleta dedahava parsu alach verabbi karu lach veatte amratte lekiryati ana azel amar leh mome azuva da ki gedal ata yetev bimtivta derabbi shameh lekaleh amar ha kala dame lekaleh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon amaru leh bereh hu
Kare aleh peri tzaddik etz chayyim velokeach nefashot chacham peri tzaddik etz chayyim ze rabbi yose berabbi elazar berabbi shimon velokeach nefashot chacham ze rabbi shimon ben isi ben lakonya
Ki nach nafsheh amteuh limarta daavuh hava hadra lah achna limarta amar leh achna achna petach picha veyikkanes ben etzel aviv la petacha lehu kisvurim haam lomar shezze gadol mizze
Yatzta bat kol veamra lo mippene shezze gadol mizze ella ze haya betzaar meara veze lo haya betzaar meara
Ikla rabbi leatreh derabbi tarfon amar lehu yesh lo ben leoto tzaddik shehaya mekappeach et banav amru lo ben en lo ben bat yesh lo vechol zona shenniskeret bishnayim socharto bishmona
Atuh lekammeh amar leh i hadratte bach yahevna lach bartay hadar beh ika deamri nasvah vegarshah ika deamri la nasvah kelal kede shello yomru bishvil zo chazar ze

Ulma leh kulle hay deamar rav yehuda amar rav veamri lah amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan veamri lah amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol hamlammed et ben chavero tora zoche veoshev bishiva shel mala shenneemar im tashuv vaashivcha lefanay taamod
Vechol hamlammed et ben am haaretz tora afilu hakkadosh baruch hu gozer gezera mevattelah bishvilo shenneemar veim totzi yakar mizzolel kefi tihye

Amar rabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan kol shehu talmid chacham uvno talmid chacham uven beno talmid chacham shuv en tora poseket mizzaro leolam shenneemar vaani zot beriti vego lo yamushu mippicha umippi zaracha umippi zera zaracha amar Adonai meatta vead olam
May amar Adonai amar hakkadosh baruch hu ani arev lecha bedavar ze may meatta vead olam amar rabbi yirmeya mikkan veelach tora mechazzeret al achsanya shellah

Rav yosef yetev arbein taaniyyata veakreuh lo yamushu mippicha yetev arbaim taaniyyata acharine veakreuhu lo yamushu mippicha umippi zaracha yetev mea arbein taaniyyata achranyata veakreuh lo yamushu mippicha umippi zaracha umippi zera zaracha amar mikkan veelach la tzerichna tora mechazzeret al achsanya shellah

Rabbi zera ki selek leara deyisrael yatev mea taaniyyata delishtakkach talmuda bavlaa mineh ki hechi dela nitredeh yetev mea achranyata dela lishkov rabbi elazar bishneh venaflin ilaveh mile detzibbura vitev mea acharine dela nishlot beh nura degehinnam
Kol telatin yome hava badek nafsheh shegar tannura selek vitev begaveh vela hava shalta beh nura yoma chad yehavu beh rabbanan ena veicharachu shakeh ukro leh katin charich shakeh
Amar rav yehuda amar rav may dichtiv mi haish hechacham veyaven et zot vaasher dibber pi Adonai elav veyaggidah al ma avda haaretz davar ze

Ketiv vadoni zaken uchtiv vaani zakanti dela motev hakkadosh baruch hu kidkaamra ihi
Tana deve rabbi yishmael gadol shalom sheafilu hakkadosh baruch hu shina bo shenneemar vattitzchak sara bekirbah vego vadoni zaken uchtiv vayyomer Adonai el avraham vego vaani zakanti

Vattomer mi millel leavraham henika vanim sara kamma banim henika sara amar rabbi levi oto hayyom sheggamal avraham et yitzchak beno asa seuda gedola hau kol ummot haolam merannenim veomrim reitem zaken uzkena sheheviu asufi min hashshuk veomrim benenu hu velo od ella sheosin mishte gadol lehaamid divrehem

Matni veellu ochlin min hattora haose bimchubbar lakkarka bishat gemar melacha uvtalush min hakkarka ad shello nigmera melachto uvdavar sheggidulo min haaretz veellu sheen ochlim haose bimchubbar lakkarka
b: Beshaa sheen gemar melacha uvtalush min hakkarka meachar shennigmera melachto uvdavar sheen gidulo min haaretz
Gema mena hane mile dichtiv ki tavo becherem reecha veachalta ashkechan kerem kol mile mena lan
Gamrinan mikkerem ma kerem meuchad davar sheggidule karka uvishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo af kol davar sheggidule karka bishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo
Ma lecherem shekken chayyav beolelot gamrinan mikkama kama gufah mena lan dichtiv ki tavo bekamat reecha vekatafta melilot beyadecha
Ma lekama shekken chayyevet bachalla umimmay dehay kama kama demitchayyevet bechalla hi dilma kol kama kaamar rachamana
Atya kama kama ketiv hacha ki tavo bekamat reecha uchtiv hatam mehachel chermesh bakkama ma hatam kama demichayeva bechalla af hacha name kama demichayeva bechalla
Ika lemifrach ma lekama shekken chayyevet bechalla kerem yochiach ma lecherem shekken chayyav beolelot kama tochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken davar sheggidule karka uvishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo af kol davar sheggidule karka bishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahen tzad mizbeach vaata name zayit deit beh tzad mizbeach
Vezayit bema hatztzad ate hu gufeh kerem ikri dichtiv vayyaver miggadish vead kama vead kerem zayit amar rav pappa kerem zayit ikkere kerem setama la ikkere
Mikkol makom kashya ella amar shemuel amar kera vechermesh lerabbot kol baale chermesh
Vehay chermesh mibe leh bishat chermesh echol shello bishat chermesh la techol
Hahu mivveel kelyecha lo titten nafka tinach devar chermesh delav bar chermesh mena lan
Ella amar rabbi yitzchak amar kera kama lerabbot kol baale koma veha amratte kama kama demichayeva bechalla
Hane mile mikkamme denete chermesh hashta deate chermesh itrabbi leh kol devar chermesh veaf al gav dela michayyav bechalla kama lema li lerabbot kol baale koma
Vehashta denafka lan mechermesh umikkama ki tavo becherem reecha lema li
Amar rava lehilchotav kidtanya ki tavo neemar kan bia veneemar lehallan lo tavo alav hashshemesh ma lehallan befoel hakkatuv medabber af kan befoel hakkatuv medabber
Becherem reecha velo becherem nochri hanicha leman deamar gezel nochri asur hayenu deitzterich kera lemishre poel ella leman deamar gezel nochri muttar hashta gezela muttar poel mibaya
Mokem lah becherem reecha velo shel hekdesh veachalta velo motzetz anavim velo anavim vedavar acher
Kenafshecha kenefesh shel baal habbayit kach nafsho shel poel ma nafshecha ochel ufatur af nafsho shel poel ochel ufatur
Sovecha velo achila gassa veal kelyecha lo titten beshaa sheatta noten lechelo shel baal habbayit atta ochel uvshaa shei atta noten lechelo shel baal habbayit i atta ochel
Amar rabbi yannay en hattevel mitchayyev bemaaser

a: Ad sheyyire pene habbayit shenneemar biarti hakkodesh min habbayit
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu chatzer kovaat shenneemar veachlu visharecha vesaveu
Verabbi yochanan name ha ketiv min habbayit amar lach chatzer dumya devayit ma bayit hammishtammer af chatzer hammishtammeret
Verabbi yannay name hachtiv bisharecha hahu mibe leh dimayyel leh derech shaar leappoke derech gaggot vekarpefot dela
Metiv rav chanina chozaa kenafshecha kach nafsho shel poel ma nafshecha ochel ufatur af nafsho shel poel ochel ufatur
Ha lokeach chayyav may lav bassade
Amar rav pappa hacha bitena haomedet begina venofah note lechatzer askinan ulman deamar levayit levayit
I hachi baal habbayit name nichayyav baal habbayit enav bitenato velokeach enav bemikkacho
Velokeach middeorayeta mi michayyav vehatanya mippene ma charvu chanuot shel bet hino shalosh shanim kodem yerushalayim mippene sheheemidu divrehem al divre tora shehau omrin
b: Asser teasser veachalta velo mocher tevuat zarecha velo lokeach ella midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma
Ella kenafshecha lemay ata lechidtanya kenafshecha ma nafshecha im chasamta patur af poel im chasamta patur
Metiv mar zutra ezehu gornan lemaasrot bakkishuim uvaddilluim mishsheyefakkesu veamar rabbi assi mishsheyyinnatel pekes shellahen may lav mishsheyefakkesu afilu bassade
Lo mishsheyefakkesu babbayit i hachi mishsheyefakkesu ad sheyefakkesu mibe leh
I tena ad sheyefakkesu hava amena ad degamar lefikusayehu ka mashma lan mishsheyefakkesu mikki atchole matchel pikusayehu
Metiv mar zutra bereh derav nachman gorno lemaaser lechayyev alav mishshum tevel mishshettiggamer melachtan veezehu gemar melachtan melechet hachnasatan may lav hachnasatan afilu bassade
La hachnasatan labbayit ze hu gemar melachtan veibaet ema ki kaamar rabbi yannay bezetim vaanavim delav bene goren ninhu aval chittin usorin goren behedya ketiv beh
Ashkechan adam bimchubbar veshor betalush adam betalush menalan

Kal vachomer mishshor uma shor sheeno ochel bimchubbar ochel betalush adam sheochel bimchubbar eno din sheochel betalush ma leshor shekken atta metzuve al chasimato tomar beadam shei atta metzuve al chasimato
Vihe adam metzuve al chasimato mikkal vachomer mishshor uma shor shei atta metzuve lehachoto atta metzuve al chasimato adam sheatta metzuve lehachoto eno din sheatta metzuve al chasimato
Amar kera kenafshecha kenafsho shel poel ma nafsho im chasamto patur af poel im chasamto patur
Veella adam betalush menalan amar kera kama kama shette peamim im eno inyan leadam bimchubbar tenehu inyan leadam betalush
Rabbi amme amar adam betalush la tzerich kera ketiv ki tavo becherem reecha mi la askinan shessecharo lechattef veamar rachamana lechol

Shor bimchubbar menalan kal vachomer meadam uma adam sheeno ochel betalush ochel bimchubbar shor sheochel betalush eno din sheochel bimchubbar ma leadam shekken atta metzuve lehachoto tomar beshor shei atta metzuve lehachoto
Vihe shor metzuve lehachoto mikkal vachomer uma adam shei atta metzuve al chasimato atta metzuve lehachoto shor sheatta metzuve al chasimato eno din sheatta metzuve lehachoto
Amar kera veche achicha immach achicha velo shor veella shor bimchubbar menalan amar kera reecha reecha shette peamim im eno inyan leadam bimchubbar tenehu inyan leshor bimchubbar
Ravina amar la adam betalush velo shor bimchubbar tzerichi kerae dichtiv lo tachsom shor bedisho

a: Mikkede kol mile itanhu bachasima deyalfinan shor shor mishshabbat im ken lichtov rachamana lo tadush bachasima shor dichtav rachamana lema li
Leakkoshe chosem lenechsam venechsam lechosem ma chosem ochel bimchubbar af nechsam ochel bimchubbar uma nechsam ochel betalush af chosem ochel betalush

Tanu rabbanan dayish ma dayish meuchad davar sheggidule karka uvishat gemar melacha ufoel ochel bo af kol sheggidule karka poel ochel bo yatza hacholev vehamchabbetz vehamgabben sheen gidule karka veen poel ochel bo
Lema li mikki tavo becherem reecha nafka itzterich salka datach amena hoil uchtiv kama lerabbot kol baale koma lerabbot name mide delav giddule karka ninhu ka mashma lan

Tanya idach dayish ma dayish meuchad davar shebbishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo af kol shehu bishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo yatza hamnakkesh beshumim uvivtzalim hoil veen gemar melacha en poel ochel bahem
Lema li miveel kelyecha lo titten nafka la tzericha af al gav deka meshallef kattine mibbene allime

Tanya idach dayish ma dayish meuchad davar shello nigmera melachto lemaaser poel ochel bo af kol shello nigmera melachto lemaaser poel ochel bo yatza habbodel bitmarim uvigrogrot hoil venigmera melachto lemaaser en poel ochel bo
Vehatanya habbodel bitmarim uvigrogrot poel ochel bo amar rav pappa ki tanya hahi betuchlane

Tanya idach dayish ma dayish meuchad davar shello nigmera melachto lechalla ufoel ochel bo af kol davar shello nigmera melachto lechalla poel ochel bo yatza hallash vehamkattef vehaofe shennigmera melachto lechalla deen poel ochel bo vahalo nigmera melachto lemaaser

La kashya bechutza laaretz askinan deleka maaser i hachi challa name leka ella leolam baaretz vela kashya besheva shekkibshu uvsheva shechilku deamar mar sheva shekkibshu vesheva shechilku nitchayevu bechalla velo nitchayevu bemaaser
Mide maaser ka garem gemar melacha ka garem
Ella amar ravina keroch utni dayish ma dayish meuchad davar shello nigmar melachto lemaaser ulchalla ufoel ochel bo af kol shello nigmar melachto lemaaser ulchalla poel ochel bo

Ibaya lehu poel mahu sheyehavhev baur veyochal mi have kaanavim vedavar acher o la ta shema rashshay baal habbayit lehashkot poalim yayin kede shello yochlu anavim harbe rashshain poalin letabbel pitam betzir kede sheyyochlu anavim harbe
b: Leachshore gavra la kamibaya lan ki kamibaya lan leachshore pera may ta shema poalin ochlin anavim berashe ummaniyyot shellahem uvilvad shello yehavhavu baur
Hatam mishshum bitul melacha ki ka mibaya lan hecha deika ishto uvanav may

Ta shema lo yehavhev baur veyochal velo yichmor baadama veyochal velo yafrich al gabbe hassela veyochal aval mefarech al yad al yad veochel hatam mishshum bitul melacha hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach mishshum mattoke pera sela may mattoke pera ika i efshar dela memattek purta

Ta shema poalin shehau odrim bitenim vegodrim bitmarim uvotzrim baanavim umoskin bezetim hare ellu ochlim ufturim shehattora zikta lahem befitam lo yochlu ella im ken natlu reshut mibbaal habbayit velo yispot bammelach veyochal
Melach vadday kaanavim vedavar acher dame

Velo yispot bammelach veyochal urminhu hassocher et happoel leadder ulkashkesh tachat hazzetim hare ze lo yochal secharo livtzor secharo limsok secharo lelakket hare ze ochel ufatur shehattora zikta lahen katzatz achat veachat yochal shettayim shettayim lo yochal vesofet bammelach veyochal
Aheya ilema assefa kevan dekatzatz kol hechi devae lechol ella lav aresha

Amar abbaye la kashya kan baaretz kan bechutza laaretz baaretz kava sefita bechutza laaretz la kevaa sefeta amar rava mi ika mide devaaretz kevaa sefeta middeorayeta uvchutza laaretz lo kiva sefeta umuttar lechattechila

Ella amar rava ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz chada la kiva sefeta tarte kevaa sefeta katzatz ben safat uven lo safat achat achat ochel shettayim shettayim lo yochal lo katzatz velo safat ochel shettayim shettayim safat achat achat ochel shettayim shettayim lo yochal veaf al gav denatal reshut mibbaal habbayit deitvil lehu lemaaser vekava sefita
Vetarte dekava sefita mena lan amar rav matna deamar kera ki kibbetzam keamir gorna
Tanu rabbanan parot hamrakkesot bitvua

a: Vehaddashot bitruma umaaser eno over mishshum bal tachsom aval mippene marit haayin mevi bul meoto hammin vetole lah batteraskalin shebbefiha rabbi shimon ben yochay omer mevi karshinim vetole lah shehakkarshinim yafot lah min hakkol

Urminhi parot hamrakkesot bitvua eno over mishshum bal tachsom vehaddashot bitruma umaaser over mishshum bal tachsom venochri haddash befarato shel yisrael eno over mishshum bal tachsom veyisrael haddash befarato shel nochri over mishshum bal tachsom kashya teruma atteruma kashya maaser ammaaser
Bishlama teruma atteruma la kashya kan bitruma kan begidule teruma ella maaser ammaaser kashya
Vechi tema maaser ammaaser name la kashya kan bemaaser kan begidule maaser bishlama gidule teruma teruma ella gidule maaser chullin ninhu ditnan gidule tevel vegidule maaser sheni chullin
Ella la kashya ha bemaaser rishon ha bemaaser sheni veibaet ema ha veha bemaaser sheni vela kashya ha rabbi meir ha rabbi yehuda
Ha rabbi meir deamar maaser mamon gavoha hu ha rabbi yehuda deamar maaser sheni mamon hedot hu
Hechi dame kegon shehikdimo beshibbolin
Ulrabbi yehuda veha bae choma kegon sheddash lifnim mechomat bet page
Ibaet ema la kashya kan bemaaser vadday kan bemaaser demay hashta deatet lehachi teruma atteruma name la kashya kan bitrumat vadday kan bitrumat demay
Bishlama maaser demay ika ella terumat demay mi ika vehatanya af hu bitel et haviduy vegazar al haddemay lefi sheshshalach bechol gevul yisrael veraa shello hau mafrishin ella teruma gedola bilvad
Ella la kashya kan bitrumat maaser vadday kan bitrumat maaser demay
Beo mineh merav sheshet hayeta ochelet umatrezet mahu mishshum dimalle lah hu veha la mealle lah o dilma dechazya umitztaara veha chazya umitztaara
Amar lehu rav sheshet tenetuha rabbi shimon ben yochay omer mevi karshinim vetole lah shehakkarshinim yafot lah min hakkol shema minah mishshum dimalle lah hu shema minah
Ibaya lehu mahu sheyyomar adam lenochri chasom parati vedush bah mi amrinan ki amrinan amira lenochri shevut hane mile leinyan shabbat deisur sekila aval chasima deisur lav la o dilma la shena

Ta shema nochri haddash befarato shel yisrael eno over mishshum bal tachsom mibar hu dela avar ha isura ika bedin hu deisura name leka veayede ditna sefa deyisrael haddash befarato shel nochri over tena resha eno over
Ta shema dishlachu leh laavuh dishmuel halen tore
b: Deganvin armae umgannechin yathon mahu shelach lehu haarama itavid behu aarimu alayehu veyizdabbenun
Amar rav pappa bene mareva savri lah kerabbi chidka deamar bene noach metzuviyn al hasserus veka avri mishshum velifne iver lo titten michshol
Sevar rava lememar yimmachru lishchita amar lo abbaye dayyan shekkanasta alehem mechira
Peshita beno gadol ki acher dame beno katan may rav achay asar verav ashe share marimar umar zutra veamri lah hanhu tere chaside mechallefi ahadade
Bae rame bar chama hoshiv lah kotz befiha mahu hoshiv lah chasima meallayeta hi ella yashav lah kotz befiha mahu
Hirbitz lah ari mibbachutz mahu hirbitz lah chasima meallayeta hi ella ravatz lah ari mibbachutz mahu heemid benah mibbachutz mahu hayeta tzemea lemayim mahu paras lah katvulya al gabbe disha mahu
Peshot miha chada detanya rashshay baal para lehariv parato kede shettochal min haddisha harbe verashshay baal habbayit lehattir pekia amir lifne habbehema kede shello tochal min haddisha harbe
Shane hatam deka achla ibaet ema rashshay baal habbayit lehattir pekia amir lifne behema meikara kede shello tochal harbe min haddisha
Bea mineh rabbi yonatan merabbi simay chasamah mibbachutz mahu shor bedisho amar rachamana veha lav bedisho hu o dilma lo tadush bachasima amar rachamana
Amar lo mibbet avicha atta lamed yayin veshechar al teshte atta uvanecha ittach bevoachem bevoachem hu deasur ha mishta umeal shere
Ulhavdil ben hakkodesh uven hachol amar rachamana ella ma hatam bishat bia lo tehe shichrut hacha name bishat disha lo tehe chasima
Tanu rabbanan hachosem et happara vehamzaveg bechilayim patur veeno loke ella dash umanhig bilvad
Itmar chasamah bekol vehinhigah bekol rabbi yochanan amar chayyav resh lakish amar patur rabbi yochanan amar chayyav akimat piv haveya maase resh lakish amar patur kala la have maase
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish

a: Lo sheadam rashshay lehamir ella sheim hemir mumar vesofeg et haarbaim amar leh ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar lav sheen bo maase lokin alav
Umi matzet mokmatte lah kerabbi yehuda veha katane resha hakkol memirin echad haanashim veechad hannashim vehavenan bah hakkol leetoye may leetoye yoresh udla kerabbi yehuda
Dei kerabbi yehuda haamar yoresh eno memir yoresh eno somech hay tanna savar lah keoteh bachada ufaleg aleh bachada

Tanu rabbanan hachosem et happara vedash bah loke umshallem arbaa kabbin lefara ushlosha kabbin lachamor veha eno loke vamet veeno loke umshallem amar abbaye ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar loke umshallem
Rava amar etnan asra tora vaafilu ba al immo
Rav pappa amar mishsheat meshicha ichayyav leh bimzonoteha umilka la lake ad sheat chasima
Amar rav pappa hane mile beo minay deve rav pappa bar abba ufshati lehu leisura chada kehilcheta vachada delav kehilcheta

Beo minay mahu lalush et haisa bechalav ufshati lehu leisura kehilcheta detanya en lashin et haisa bechalav veim lash kol happat kullah asura mippene hergel avera kayyotze vo en tashin et hattannur bealya veim tash kol happat kullah asura ad sheyyassik et hattannur
Veidach beo minay mahu lehachnis min vesheeno mino laddir ufshati lehu leisura delav kehilcheta
Deamar shemuel uvimnaafim ad sheyyiru kederech hamnaafim uvchilayim ad sheyyachnis kemichchol bashshefoferet
Metiv rav achadvuy bar amme ilu neemar behemtecha lo tarbia hayiti omer lo yeechoz adam habbehema beshaa sheole aleha zachar talmud lomar kilayim
Lav mikkelal dechilayim achiza name la may achiza hachnasa veammay kare lah achiza lishana mealleya
Amar rav yehuda min bemino muttar lehachnis kemichchol bashshefoferet vaafilu mishshum peritzuta leka may tama baavidteh terid metiv rav achadvuy bar amme
b: Illu neemar behemtecha lo tarbia hayiti omer lo yeechoz adam et habbehema kede sheyyaale aleha zachar talmud lomar kilayim kilayim hu deasur ha min bemino shere
Umin bemino name achiza in hachnasa la may achiza hachnasa veammay kare leh achiza lishana mealleya

Amar rav ashe ha milta beo minay deve rav nechemya resh galuta mahu lehachnis min umino vesheeno mino laddir kevan deika mineh batar mineh gerir o dilma afilu hachi la ufshati lehu leisura dela kehilcheta mishshum peritzuta deavde
Matni haya ose beyadav aval lo beraglav beraglav aval lo beyadav afilu bichtefo hare ze ochel rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyaase beyadav uvraglav
Gema may tama ki tavo becherem reecha bechol may deaved
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyaase beyadav uvraglav may tama derabbi yose berabbi yehuda ki shor ma shor ad sheyyaase beyadav uvraglav af poel ad sheyyaase beyadav uvraglav
Bae rabba bar rav huna dash baaozin vetarnegolim lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda mahu bechol kocho baenan veha ika o dilma beyadav uvraglav baenan veha leka teku
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh poalim ad shello hilchu sheti vaerev baggat ochlin anavim veen shotin yayin mishshehilchu sheti vaerev baggat ochlin anavim veshotin yayin
Matni haya ose bitenim lo yochal baanavim baanavim lo yochal bitenim aval monea et atzmo ad shemmaggia limkom yafot veochel
Vechullan lo amru ella bishat melacha aval mishshum hashev aveda labbealim amru poalin ochlin bahalichatan meoman leoman uvachaziratan min haggat uvachamor keshehi poreket
Gema ibaya lehu ose begefen ze mahu sheyyochal begefen acher mimmin sheatta noten lechelav shel baal habbayit baenan veha ika o dilma mimma sheatta noten lechelav shel baal habbayit baenan veha leka
Veim timtze lomar ose begefen ze lo yochal begefen acher shor bimchubbar hechi achel amar rav shisha bereh derav idi bishracha

Ta shema haya ose bitenim lo yochal baanavim ha teenim utenim dumya ditenim vaanavim ochel vei amratte ose begefen ze eno ochel begefen acher hechi mashkachatte lah amar rav shisha bereh derav idi bemudlet

Ta shema aval monea et atzmo ad shemmaggia limkom hayyafot veochel vei amratte ose begefen ze ochel begefen acher nezil venete venechol hatam mishshum bitul melacha la ka mibaya lan ki ka mibbaya lan hecha deika ishto uvanav may
Ta shema vechullam lo amru ella bishat melacha aval mippene hashev aveda labbealim amru poalim ochlim bahalichatan meoman leoman uvachaziratan min haggat
Savruha mehallech keose maase dame umishshum hashev aveda livalim hu deachel middeorayeta la achel alma ose begefen ze eno ochel begefen acher
La leolam ema lach ose begefen ze ochel begefen acher umhallech lav keose maase dame
Ika deamri savruha mehallech lav keose maase dame vehayenu tama demiddeorayeta la achel mishshum delav keose maase dame ha ose maase achel middeorayeta alma ose begefen ze ochel begefen acher
La leolam ema lach ose begefen ze eno ochel begefen acher

a: Umhallech keose maase dame
Uvachamor keshehi poreket keshehi poreket mehechan achla ema ad shettehe poreket tenena leha detanu rabbanan chamor vegamal ochlim mimmassooy sheal gabbehen uvilvad shello yittol beyado veyaachilem

Matni ochel poel kishut afilu bedinar kotevet vaafilu bedinar rabbi elazar chassama omer lo yochal poel yater al secharo vachachamim mattirin aval melammedin et haadam shello yehe raavtan vihe sotem et happetach befanav
Gema chachamim hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu aval melammedin letanna kamma let leh melammedin lerabbanan it lehu melammedin
Ibaet ema ika benayehu derav assi deamar rav assi afilu lo secharo ella livtzor eshkol echad ochlo veamar rav assi afilu lo batzar ella eshkol echad ochlo
Utzricha dei ashmeinan hach kammayeta mishshum dela ika lemitav lechelav shel baal habbayit aval hecha deika lemitav lechelav shel baal habbayit ema litev beresha vahadar lechol
Vei ashmeinan beha deefshar lekayyome levassof aval hacha dela efshar lekayyome levassof ema la tzericha
Ibaet ema ika benayehu derav deamar rav matzati megilat setarim be rabbi chiyya vechatuv bah isi ben yehuda omer ki tavo becherem reecha beviat kol adam hakkatuv medabber
Veamar rav la shevak isi chayye lechol beriyya

Amar rav ashe amritah lishmata kammeh derav kahana dilma beosin bisuddatam deavdu veachlu amar li afilu hachi nicha leh leinish leogar agore denogar agire veniktefeh lefardeseh vela neto kulle alma veachlu leh
Ibaya lehu poel mishshello hu ochel o mishshel shamayim hu ochel

Lemay nafka minah deamar tenu leishti uvanay i amratte mishshello hu ochel yahavinan lehu ella i amratte mishshel shamayim hu ochel ledideh zakki leh rachamana leishto uvanav la zakki lehu rachamana may

Ta shema ochel poel kishut vaafilu bedinar kotevet vaafilu bedinar i amratte mishshello hu ochel agir bedanka achel bezuza veella may mishshel shamayim hu ochel sof sof agir bedanka achel bezuza ella may it lach lememar rachamana zakki leh hacha name rachamana zakki leh
Ta shema rabbi elazar chassama omer lo yochal poel yoter al secharo vachachamim mattirin may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar mishshello hu ochel umar savar mishshel shamayim hu ochel
La dechulle alma mishshello hu ochel vehacha bichnafshecha kamipalgi mar savar kenafshecha bidvar shemmoser nafsho alav
Umar savar kenafshecha ma nafshecha im chasamta patur af poel im chasamta patur
Ta shema nazir sheamar tenu leishti uvanay en shomin lo vei amratte mishshello hu ochel ammay en shomin lo hatam mishshum lach lach amrin nezira sechor sechor lecharma la tikrav
Ta shema poel sheamar tenu leishti uvanay en shomin lo vei amratte mishshello hu ochel ammay en shomin lo may poel nazir vehatanya nazir vehatanya poel mide gabbe hadade tanyan

Ta shema minnayin lefoel sheamar tenu leishti uvanay sheen shomin lo shenneemar veel kelyecha lo titten vechi tema hachi name nazir i hachi mishshum el kelyecha lo titten mishshum lach lach amrin nezira hu
In hachi name veayede dekatane lah bilshon poel ka nasev leh kera defoel
Ta shema hassocher et happoel lekatztzot bitenim
b: Hare ze ochel ufatur min hammaaser al menat sheochel ani uvni o sheyyochal beni bischari hu ochel ufatur uvno ochel vechayyav
Vei amratte mishshello hu ochel beno ammay chayyav amar ravina mishshum demichaze kemikkach
Ta shema hassocher et happoel laasot beneta revai shello hare ellu lo yochelu veim lo hodiam pode umaachilan
Vei amratte mishshel shamayim hu ochel ammay pode umaachilan isura la zakki lehu rachamana hatam mishshum demichaze kemikkach taut
Ema sefa nitparsu iggulav nitpattechu chaviyyotav hare ellu lo yochelu veim lo hodian measser umaachilan vei amratte mishshel shamayim hu ochel ammay measser umaachilan isura la zakki lehu rachamana
Vechi tema hacha name mishshum demichaze kemikkach taut bishlama nitparsu iggulav michaze kemikkach taut ella nitpattechu chaviyyotav may mikkach taut ika mida yada deitvil lehu lemaaser
Amar rav sheshet shennitpattechu chaviyyotav labbor vehatanya yayin mishsheyyered labbor
Kerabbi akiva deamar mishsheyekappe daamaru leh la hava yadinan venema lehu ibi lechu assoke addatayechu dilma mekappe beatra dehahu gavra denaged ihu mekappe

Vehashta detane rav zevid bidve rabbi hoshaya yayin mishsheyyered labbor vikappe verabbi akiva omer mishsheyeshalle bechaviyyot afilu tema shello nitpattechu chaviyyotav labbor daamaru leh la hava yadinan dimshalle
Venema lehu ibi lechu assoke addatayechu dilma meshalle beatra dehahu desharek hahu meshalle

Ta shema kotzetz adam al yede atzmo al yede beno uvitto haggedolim al yede avdo veshifchato haggedolim veal yede ishto mippene sheyyesh bahen daat aval eno kotzetz lo al yede beno uvitto hakketannim velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakketannim velo al yede behemto mippene sheen bahen daat
Ka salka datach bemaale lahen mezonot i amratte bishlama mishshel shamayim hu ochel mishshum hachi eno kotzetz ella i amratte mishshello hu ochel ketannim name nikkotz lehu
Hacha bemay askinan besheen maale lahen mezonot i hachi gedolim name gedolim yadi veka machali

Veha tane rabbi hoshaya kotzetz adam al yede atzmo veal yede ishto aval lo al yede behemto veal yede beno uvitto haggedolim aval lo al yede beno uvitto hakketannim vekotzetz al yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim ben gedolim uven ketannim

May lav ide veide bemaale lahen mezonot uvha ka mipalgi demar savar mishshello hu ochel umar savar mishshel shamayim hu ochel la dechulle alma mishshello hu ochel vela kashya kan besheen maale lahen mezonot uvarayeta bemaale lahen mezonot
Bemay okemtah bemaale lahen mezonot i hachi ketannim name nikkotz lehu tzaarayehu divno uvitto hakketannim la zakki leh rachamana
Bemay okemta lematnitin besheen maale lahen mezonot

a: Hanicha leman deamar en harav yachol lomar laeved ase immi veeni zanach shappir ella leman deamar yachol harav lomar laeved ase immi veeni zanach may ika lememar
Ella ide veide besheen maale lahen mezonot uvha peligi demar savar yachol umar savar en yachol verabbi yochanan deamar yachol harav shavek matnitin veaved kevarayeta
Ella dechulle alma mishshel shamayim hu ochel vela matze katzetz umay kotzetz deamar rabbi hoshaya mezonot
Dichoteh gabbe behemto teven nikkotz lah ella beha kamipalgi demar savar mishshello hu ochel umar savar mishshel shamayim hu ochel

Matni kotzetz adam al yede atzmo al yede beno uvitto haggedolim al yede avdo veshifchato haggedolim al yede ishto mippene sheyyesh bahen daat aval eno kotzetz al yede beno uvitto hakketannim velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakketannim velo al yede behemto mippene sheen bahen daat
Hassocher et happoalim laasot beneta revai shello hare ellu lo yochlu im lo hodian pode umaachilan nitparsu iggulav nitpattechu chaviyyotav hare ellu lo yochlu im lo hodian measser umaachilan
Shomre ferot ochlin mehilchot medina aval lo min hattora
Gema shomre ferot amar rav lo shanu ella shomre gannot ufardesin aval shomre gitot vaaremot ochlin min hattora kasavar meshammer keose maase dame
Ushmuel amar lo shanu ella shomre gitot vaaremot aval shomre gannot ufardesim enan ochlim lo min hattora velo mehilchot medina ka savar meshammer lav keose maase dame
Metiv rav acha bar rav huna hamshammer et happara metamme begadim vei amratte meshammer lav keose maase dame ammay metamme begadim amar rabba bar ulla gezera shemma yaziz bah ever
Metiv rav kahana hamshammer arba vechamesh mikshaot hare ze lo yemalle kereso meechad mehen ella mikkol echad veechad ochel lefi cheshbon vei amratte meshammer lav keose maase dame ammay ochel
Amar rav shimi bar ashe baakurin shanu akurin vahalo nigmera melachtan lemaaser shello nital pekes shellahem
Amar rav ashe keoteh dishmuel mistabbera ditnan veellu ochlin min hattora haose bimchubbar lakkarka bishat gemar melacha uvtalush ku mikkelal deika dela ka achel min hattora ella mehilchot medina

Ema sefa veellu sheenan ochlin may enan ochlin ilema sheen ochlin min hattora ella mehilchot medina hayenu resha ella lav sheen ochlin lo min hattora velo mehilchot medina umay nihu ose bimchubbar lakkarka beshaa sheen gemar melacha vechol shekken shomre gannot ufardesot
Matni arbaa shomrim hen shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol
Venose sachar vehassocher nishbaim al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta umshallemin et haaveda veet haggeneva

Veha rabbi meir ipcha shaminan leh detanya socher ketzad meshallem rabbi meir omer keshomer chinnam rabbi yehuda omer keshomer sachar rabba bar avuh ipcha katane
I hachi arbaa shelosha ninhu amar rav nachman bar yitzchak arbaa shomrin vedinehem shelosha
Hahu raaya dahava ka rae chevata aggudda dinhar pappa serig chada minayehu unfalat lemayya ata lekammeh derabba ufatreh amar may hava leh lemebad
b: Ha netar kidnatri inashe amar leh abbaye ella meatta al lemata beidana deayeli inashe hachi name defatur amar leh in gena purta beidana deganu inashe hachi name defatur amar leh in
Etiveh ellu hem onasin sheshshomer sachar patur alehen kegon vattippol sheva vattikkachem veet hannearim hikku lefi charev amar leh hatam bechazzane mata
