Etiveh roe shehaya roe vehinniach edro uva lair ba zeev vetaraf uva ari vedaras en omrim ilu haya sham haya matztzil ella omdin oto im yachol lehatztzil chayyav im lav patur
May lav deal beidana deayeli inashe la deal beidana dela ayeli inashe i hachi ammay patur techilato bifshia vesofo beones chayyav
Dishma kal arya veal i hachi omdin oto may hava leh lemebad haya lo lekaddem beroim uvmaklot
I hachi may irya shomer sachar afilu shomer chinnam name deha mar hu deamar shomer chinnam shehaya lo lekaddem beroim uvmaklot velo kidem chayyav shomer chinnam bechinnam shomer sachar besachar
Vead kamma ad kede demehen vehechan matzinu beshomer sachar shechayyav baonasin dahadar shakel demehen mibbaal habbayit
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye i hachi may ahani leh minah nafka minah lechushra dechevata i name letircha yattirta
Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna la sevira lehu ha derabba deamri lehachi yehavi lach agra lenattore li netiruta yattirta

Bar adda savolaa have hava ka meabbar chevata aggamla denaresh dechafa chada lachavertah ushdatah bemayya ata lekammeh derav pappa chayeveh amar leh may hava li lemebad amar leh ibbei lach leabbore chada chada amar leh yadatte beh bevar achatach dematze lmabbar chada chada amar leh kevar tzevachu kammae dekammach vela ika deashgach behu
Ayevu afked kitana be runya azal shabbu shamteh mineh lesof hukkar haggannav ata lekammeh derav nachman chayeveh lema peliga derav huna bar avin
Dishlach rav huna bar avin nigneva beones veachar kach hukkar haggannav im shomer chinnam hu ratza nishba ratza ose immo din im shomer sachar hu ose immo din veeno nishba
Amar rava hatam gavre defarmuska hao kayemi dei rema kala hao atu umatztzelin leh
Matni zeev echad eno ones shene zeevim ones rabbi yehuda omer bishat mishlachat zeevim af zeev echad ones
Shene chelavim eno ones yadua habbavli omer mishshum rabbi meir meruach achat eno ones mishte ruchot ones hallistim hare ze ones haari haddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash hare ellu ones
Ematay bizman shebbau mealehen aval holichan limkom gedude chayya velistim eno ones
Meta kedarkah hare ze ones siggefah vameta eno ones alta lerashe tzukin venafla hare ze ones heelah lerashe tzukin venafla vameta eno ones
Gema vehatanya zeev echad ones amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hahi bishat mishlachat zeevim verabbi yehuda hi
Hallistim hare ze ones ammay loke gavra lahade gavra amar rav belistim mezuyyan

Ibaya lehu listim mezuyyan veroe mezuyyan mahu mi amrinan oke gavra lahade gavra o dilma hay masar nafsheh vehay la masar nafsheh mistabbera dehay masar nafsheh vehay la masar nafsheh amar leh abbaye lerava ashkecheh roe vaamar leh gannava sarya beduchta pelanya yetivinan

a: Kach vechach gavre ika bahadan kach vechach kalve ika bahadan kach vechach zukata pesika lan vaazal ushkal mineh may amar leh hare holichan limkom gedude chayya velistim
Matni matne shomer chinnam lihot patur mishshevua vehashshoel lihot patur milleshallem nose sachar vehassocher lihot peturin mishshevua umilleshallem kol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel
Vechol tenay sheyyesh maase bitchilato tenao batel vechol sheefshar lo lekayemo besofo vehitna immo mittechilato tenao kayyam
Gema ammay matne al ma shekkatuv battora hu vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel

Ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar bedavar shebbemamon tenao kayyam detanya haomer leishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li al menat sheen lich alay sheer kesut veona hare zo mekuddeshet utnao batel divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer bedavar shebbemamon tenao kayyam
Umi matzet mokmatte lah kerabbi yehuda ema sefa kol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel atan lerabbi meir ha la kashya leolam rabbi yehuda hi vesefa bedavar sheeno shel mamon

Ema sefa kol tenay sheyyesh bo maase bitchilato tenao batel man shamatte leh deit leh ha sevara rabbi meir detanya abba chalafta ish kefar chananya amar mishshum rabbi meir tenay kodem lammaase hare ze tenay maase kodem lattenay eno tenay
Ella kullah rabbi meir hi veshane hacha demeikara la shabed nafsheh
Tana umatne shomer sachar lihot keshoel bemay bidvarim amar shemuel beshekkanu miyyado
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu tema beshello kanu miyyado behahi hanaa deka nafek leh kala deinish mehemna hu gamar umshabed nafsheh
Vechol sheefshar lo lekayemo besofo vechu amar rav tavla amar rav zo divre rabbi yehuda ben tema aval chachamim omrim af al pi shei efshar lo lekayemo besofo vehitna alav mittechilato tenao kayyam

Detanya hare ze gitich al menat shettaali larakia al menat shetterdi lattehom al menat shettivlei kane shel mea amma al menat shettaavri et hayyam haggadol beraglayich nitkayyem hattenay hare ze get lo nitkayyem hattenay eno get
Rabbi yehuda ben tema omer kaze get kelal amar rabbi yehuda ben tema kol shei efshar lo lekayemo besofo vehitna alav mittechilato eno ella kemafligah vechasher

Amar rav nachman amar rav halacha kerabbi yehuda ben tema amar rav nachman bar yitzchak matnitin name dayeka dekatane kol sheefshar lo lekayemo besofo vehitna alav mittechilato tenao kayyam ha i efshar lo lekayemo tenao batel shema minah
Hadaran alach hassocher et happoalim
Matni hashshoel et happara veshaal bealeha immah o sachar bealeha immah shaal habbealim o secharan veachar kach shaal et happara vameta patur shenneemar im bealav immo lo yeshallem
b: Aval shaal et happara veachar kach shaal et habbealim o secharan vameta chayyav shenneemar bealav en immo shallem yeshallem
Gema middekatane sefa veachar kach shaal et happara mikkelal deresha dekatane immah immah mammash immah mammash mi mashkachatte lah para bimshicha uvalim baamira
Ibaet ema kegon dekayema para bachatzero deshoel dela mechassera meshicha ibaet ema daamar leh atte gufach lo tishshael ad sheat meshichat paratcha
Tenan hatam arbaa shomrim hem shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher
Shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol nose sachar vehassocher nishbain al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta umshallemim et haaveda veet haggeneva
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan parasha rishona neemra beshomer chinnam sheniyya beshomer sachar shelishit beshoel
Bishlama shelishit beshoel meforash vechi yishal ish meim reehu venishbar o met bealav en immo shallem yeshallem ella rishona beshomer chinnam sheniyya beshomer sachar efoch ana
Mistabbera sheniyya beshomer sachar shekken chayyav bigneva vaaveda adderabba rishona beshomer sachar shekken meshallem tashlume chefel betoen taanat gannav
Afilu hachi karna bela shevua adifa mikkefela bishvua
Tidda deha shoel kol hanaa shello veeno meshallem ella keren
Vehashshoel kol hanaa shello veha baaya mezone dekayema baagam veha baaya netira benatar mata veibaet ema la tema kol hanaa shello ella ema rov hanaa shello veibaet ema bishelat kelim
Nose sachar vehassocher nishbain al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta umshallemin et haaveda veet haggeneva
Bishlama geneva dichtiv im ganov yigganev meimmo yeshallem livalav ella aveda mena lan detanya im ganev yigganev en li ella geneva aveda minnayin talmud lomar im ganov yigganev mikkol makom
Hanicha leman deamar la amrinan dibbera tora kilshon bene adam ella leman deamar amrinan dibbera tora chilshon bene adam may ika lememar
Amri bemareva kal vachomer uma geneva shekkerova leones meshallem aveda shekkerova lifshia lo kol shekken
Veidach milta deatya bekal vechomer tarach vechatav lah kera
Vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol bishlama shevura umeta dichtiv vechi yishal ish meim reehu venishbar o met ella shevuya beshoel mena lan
Vechi tema nelaf mishshevura umeta ma lishvura umeta shekken unsa desalek addata hu tomar bishvuya shekken unsa dela salek addata hu
Ella neemra shevura umeta beshoel veneemra shevura umeta beshomer sachar ma lehallan shevuya immo af kan shevuya immo
Ika lemifrach ma leshomer sachar shekken liftur tomar bashshoel shekken lechiyyuv
Ella kerabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer o lerabbot shevuya
Hay o mibaya leh lechallek desalka datach amena ed demitavra umeta la mechayyev ka mashma lan
Hanicha lerabbi yonatan ella lerabbi yoshiyya may ika lememar
Detanya ish asher yekallel et aviv veet immo en li ella aviv veimmo aviv belo immo immo belo aviv minnayin talmud lomar aviv veimmo killel aviv killel immo killel divre rabbi yoshiyya
Rabbi yonatan omer mashma shenehem keechad umashma echad bifne atzmo

a: Ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv yachdav
Afilu tema rabbi yoshiyya lechallek hacha la tzarich may tama sevara hu ma li katlah kullah ma li katlah palga
Geneva vaaveda beshoel mena lan
Vechi tema nelaf mishshevura umeta ma lishvura umeta dela efshar lemitrach veetoye tomar bigneva vaaveda deefshar lemitrach veetoye

Ella ki ha detanya venishbar o met en li ella shevura umeta geneva vaaveda minnayin amarta kal vachomer uma shomer sachar sheppatur mishshevura umeta chayyav bigneva vaaveda shoel shechayyav bishvura umeta eno din shechayyav bigneva vaaveda veze hu kal vachomer sheen alav teshuva
May en alav teshuva vechi tema ika lemifrach ma leshomer sachar shekken meshallem tashlume chefel betoen taanat listim mezuyyan
Afilu hachi karna deshoel adifa
Ibaet ema kasavar listim mezuyyan gazlan hu
Ashkechan lechiyyuv liftur mena lan
Vechi tema nelaf mishshevura umeta ma lishvura umeta shekken ones
Ella gamar mishshomer sachar veshomer sachar gufeh menalan gamri chiyyuva deshomer sachar mechiyyuva deshoel ma lehallan bivalim patur af kan bivalim patur
Bemay gamar i bamma matzinu ika lemifrach kidfarchinan shekken ones
Ella amar kera vechi yishal vav mosif al inyan rishon veyilmad elon mittachton
Veakkatti shoel mishshomer sachar la gamar deika lemifrach ma leshomer sachar shekken patur bishvura umeta tomar beshoel shechayyav bishvura umeta

Ella geneva vaaveda beshoel lechiyyuva menalan degamar mishshomer sachar dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon ma geneva vaaveda deshomer sachar bivalim patur af geneva vaaveda deshoel name bivalim patur
Hanicha leman deit leh dayyo ella leman delet leh dayyo may ika lememar
Ella amar kera vechi yishal vav mosif al inyan rishon veyilmad elon mittachton vetachton meelon
Itmar peshia bivalim peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar chayyav vechad amar patur
Man deamar chayyav kasavar mikra nidrash lefanav velo lifne fanav
Hilkach im bealav immo ashshomer chinnam la ketiv ufshia name beshomer sachar uvshoel la ketiv hilkach beshomer sachar uvshoel lechiyyuv atya bekal vachomer mishshomer chinnam
Aval bivalim liftur af beshomer sachar uvshoel la may tama ki ketiv im bealav immo lo yeshallem ashshoel veashshomer sachar ahanach chiyyuve dichtiv behu behedya hu demiktiv
Man deamar patur kasavar mikra nidrash lefanav velifne fanav vechi ketiv im bealav immo ashshomer chinnam name ketiv
Tenan hashshoel happara veshaal bealeha immah hashshoel happara vesachar bealeha immah shaal bealeha o secharan veachar kach shaal happara umeta patur veilu shomer chinnam la katane
Ultamach shomer sachar mi katane
Ella tanna milta
b: Dichtiva behedya katane deatya midderasha la katane
Ta shema shealah veshaal bealeha immah secharah vesachar bealeha immah shealah vesachar bealeha immah secharah veshaal bealeha immah af al pi shehabbealim osin melacha bemakom acher vameta patur
Savruha ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar socher keshomer sachar dame veha hay tanna katane milta deatya midderasha veilu shomer chinnam la katane
Ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar socher keshomer chinnam dame vetanna shomer chinnam vehu haddin leshomer sachar
Ibaet ema kidmachlef rabba bar avuh vetane socher ketzad meshallem rabbi meir omer keshomer sachar rabbi yehuda omer keshomer chinnam
Amar rav hamnuna leolam hu chayyav ad shettehe para vechoresh bah chamor umchammer achareha vead sheyehu bealim mishsheat sheela ad sheat shevura umeta alma kasavar bealav immo akkullah milta mashma

Metiv rava shealah veshaal bealeha immah secharah vesachar bealeha immah secharah veshaal bealeha immah shealah vesachar bealeha immah af al pi shehabbealim osin melacha bemakom acher vameta patur may lav bimlacha acheret
La beotah melacha ella may makom acher deka merappe veazel kammah

Veha middesefa al gabbah have resha bimlacha acheret dekatane sefa shealah veachar kach shaal bealeha secharah veachar kach sachar bealeha immah af al pi shehabbealim chorshin al gabbah vameta chayyav

Amri resha vesefa beotah melacha veresha revuta ka mashma lan vesefa revuta ka mashma lan resha revuta ka mashma lan deaf al gav delav al gabbah ella beotah melacha kevan dahao bealim bishat sheela patur vesefa revuta ka mashma lan deaf al gav deal gabbah kevan dela hao bealim bishat sheela chayyav
Hay may i amratte bishlama resha bimlacha acheret vesefa beotah melacha hayenu revuta
Ella i amratte resha vesefa beotah melacha may revuta ide veide beotah melacha have

Veod tanya mimmashma shenneemar im bealav immo lo yeshallem eni yodea sheim bealav en immo shallem yeshallem ella ma talmud lomar bealav en immo lomar lach haya immo bishat sheela en tzarich lihot immo bishat shevura umeta haya immo bishat shevura umeta tzarich lihot immo bishat sheela

Vetanya idach mimmashma shenneemar bealav en immo shallem yeshallem eni yodea sheim bealav immo lo yeshallem ella ma talmud lomar im bealav immo lomar lecha kevan sheyyatza mershut mashil shaa achat bivalim vameta patur teuvta derav hamnuna teuvta
Abbaye savar lah kerabbi yoshiyya umtaretz likrae kerabbi yoshiyya rava savar lah kerabbi yonatan umtaretz likrae kerabbi yonatan
Abbaye savar lah kerabbi yoshiyya umtaretz likrae kerabbi yoshiyya bealav en immo shallem yeshallem tama deleteh betarvayehu ha iteh bachada veleteh bachada patur
Veha ketiv im bealav immo lo yeshallem tama deiteh betarvayehu ha i iteh bachada veleteh bachada michayyav
Lomar lach haya immo bishat sheela eno tzarich lihot immo bishat shevura umeta haya immo bishat shevura umeta tzarich lihot immo bishat sheela

a: Rava savar lah kerabbi yonatan umtaretz likrae kerabbi yonatan detanya im bealav immo lo yeshallem mashma deiteh betarvayehu umashma name dechi iteh bachada veleteh bachada patur
Uchtiv bealav en immo shallem yeshallem mashma deleteh betarvayehu mashma name dechi iteh bachada veleteh bachada chayyav
Lomar lach haya immo bishat sheela en tzarich lihot immo bishat shevura umeta haya immo bishat shevura umeta tzarich lihot immo bishat sheela
Efoch ana mistabbera sheela adifa mishshum deka mayete lah lirshuteh
Adderabba shevura umeta adifa shekken chayyav baonasin
I la sheela shevura umeta may aved vei lav shevura umeta sheela may aved afilu hachi sheela adifa shekken chayyav bimzonoteha
Rav ashe amar amar kera vechi yishal ish meim reehu velo reehu immo shallem yeshallem ha reehu immo patur
I hachi bealav en immo veim bealav immo lema li i lav hanach hava amena hay orcheh dikra hu
Bae rame bar chama shealah lerivah mahu kidshayeli inashe baenan ulhachi la shayeli inashe o dilma tama may mishshum hanaa vehay name ha it leh hanaa
Shealah leraot bah mahu mamona baenan vehaika o dilma mamona deit leh hanaa mineh baenan veleka
Shealah laasot bah pachot mipperuta mahu mamona baenan veika o dilma kol pachot mipperuta lo kelum hi
Shaal shette parot laasot bahen peruta mahu mi amrinan zil batar shoel umashil veika o dilma zil batar parot vechol chada vachada leka mamona
Shaal mishshuttafin venishal lo echad mehen mahu kullo bealav baenan veha leka o dilma mehahu palga dideh miha miptar
Shuttafin sheshshaalu venishal leechad mehen mahu kullo shoel baenan veleka o dilma behahi palga deshayeleh mihat miptar
Shaal mehaishsha venishal balah ishsha sheshshaala venishal labbaal mahu kinyan perot kekinyan guf dame o la
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe haomer lishlucho tze vehishshael li im parati mahu bealav mammash baenan veleka o dilma shelucho shel adam kemoto veika
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe baal pelugta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish shaliach pelugta derabbi yonatan verabbi yoshiyya
Baal pelugta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish deitmar hammocher sadehu lachavero leferot rabbi yochanan omer mevi vekore resh lakish omer mevi veeno kore
Rabbi yochanan omer mevi vekore kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame veresh lakish omer mevi veeno kore kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame

Shaliach pelugta derabbi yonatan verabbi yoshiyya detanya haomer leappotroppos kol nedarim shettehe ishti noderet mikkan ad sheavo mimmakom peloni hafer lah vehefer lah yachol yehu mufarin talmud lomar ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu divre rabbi yoshiyya rabbi yonatan omer matzinu bechol makom sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto
Amar leh rav ilish lerava haomer leavdo tze vehishshael im parati mahu tibe leman deamar shelucho shel adam kemoto tibe leman deamar shelucho shel adam eno kemoto

Tibe leman deamar shelucho shel adam kemoto hane mile shaliach devar mitzva hu aval eved delav bar mitzva la o dilma afilu leman deamar en shelucho shel adam kemoto hane mile shaliach aval eved yad eved keyad rabbo damya
Amar leh mistabbera yad eved keyad rabbo damya
Bae rame bar chama baal benichse ishto
b: Shoel have o socher have
Amar rava lefum churpa shabbeshta ma nafshach i shoel have shealah bivalim hi i socher have sechirut bivalim hi
Ella ki kamibaya leh lerami bar chama daagar minah para vahadar nasvah shoel have o socher have
Shoel have veatya sheela bivalim mafkea sechirut shello bivalim o dilma socher have uschirut kidkayema kayema
Umay shena dei shoel have deate sheela bivalim mafkea sechirut shello bivalim i socher name have tete sechirut bivalim tapek tafka sechirut shello bivalim
Ella ki ka mibaya lerame bar chama kegon daagara ihi para mealma vahadar nasvah
Vealliba derabbanan deamri shoel meshallem lassocher la tibe lach devadday sheela bivalim hi
Ki tibe lach alliba derabbi yose deamar tachzor para labbealim harishonim may shoel have o socher have

Amar rava baal la shoel have vela socher have ella lokeach have midderabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina beusha hitkinu haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah vameta habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot
Bae rame bar chama baal benichse ishto mi maal
Amar rava man limol limol baal dehetera nicha leh delikne isura la nicha leh delikne
Timol ihi dehetera name la nicha lah delikne
Nimalu bet din ki avadu rabbanan takkanta vaamaru baal lokeach have lehetera leisura la avud rabbanan takkanta
Ella amar rava baal maal lichsheyyotzi mide dehave ammotzi meot hekdesh lechullin
Ibaya lehu kachash basar mechamat melacha may
Amar leh hahu merabbanan verav chilkiyya bereh derav aveya shemeh mikkelal dechi meta mechamat melacha mechayyev nema lav leokomah bechilta sheeltah
Ella amar rava la mibaya kachash basar mechamat melacha defatur ella afilu meta mechamat melacha name patur daamar leh lav leokomah bechilta sheeltah
Hahu gavra dishel narga mechavreh itvar ata lekammeh derava amar leh zil ayeti sahadi delav shannet beh veiptar
Vei leka sahadi may ta shema dehahu gavra dishel narga mechavreh veitvar ata lekammeh derav amar leh zil shallem leh narga mealleya
Amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav

a: Dina hachi ushtek rav
Vehilcheta kerav kahana verav assi demahdar leh tavreh ummalle leh deme mana
Hahu gavra dishel davela mechavreh itvar ata lekammeh derav pappa amar leh ayeti sahadi dela shannet beh veiptar

Hahu gavra dishel shunara mechavreh chavur aleh achbere vekatluh yatev rav ashe vekamibaya leh ki hay gavena may ki meta mechamat melacha dame o la amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hachi amar avimi mehagronya mishshemeh derava gavra dinshe katluh la dina vela dayyana
Ika deamri achal achbere tuva vachavil umit yatev rav ashe veka meayyen bah kehay gavena may amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hachi amar avimi mehagronya gavra dinshe katluh la dina vela dayyana
Amar rava hay man devae lemishal mide mechavreh veliptar nema leh ashkeyan mayya dehave sheela bivalim
Vei pikkeach hu nema leh sheel beresha vahadar ashkeyach
Amar rava makre dardeke shattala tabbacha veummana sappar mata kullehon beidan avidtayehu kishela bivalim damu
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava sheil lan mar ikkefid amar lehu leafkoe mamonay ka vaetu adderabba attun sheiltun li deilu ana matze ishtemote lechu mimmassechta lemassechta attun la matzetu leishtemote
Vela hi ihu sheil lehu beoma dechalla inhu sheilu leh bishar yome

Marimar bar chanina ogar kudanyata be chozae nefak ledalloye teunah bahadayehu peshau bah umit ato lekammeh derava chayevinhu amaru leh rabbanan lerava peshia bivalim hi iksif lesof igallay milta dilmesar teunah hu dinfak
Hanicha leman deamar peshia bivalim patur mishshum hachi iksif ella leman deamar chayyav ammay iksif

La mifsha peshau bah ella ignove ignuv umeta kedarkah be gannav have vaato lekammeh derava vechayevinhu amaru leh rabbanan lerava geneva bivalim hi ikkesif lesof igallay milta dilmesar teunah hu dinfak
Matni hashshoel et happara shealah chatzi yom uscharah chatzi yom shealah hayyom uscharah lemachar sachar achat veshaal achat umeta hammashil omer sheula meta beom shehayeta sheula meta
b: Beshaa shehayeta sheula meta vehalla omer eni yodea chayyav
Hassocher omer sechura meta beom shehayeta sechura meta beshaa shehayeta sechura meta vehalla omer eni yodea patur
Ze omer sheula veze omer sechura yishshava hassocher shessechura meta
Ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea yachloku
Gema shamatte minah mane li beyadcha vehalla omer eni yodea chayyav
Lema tihve teuvta derav nachman deitmar mane li beyadcha vehalla omer eni yodea rav huna verav yehuda amri chayyav rav nachman verabbi yochanan amri patur
Kidamar rav nachman kegon sheyyesh esek shevua benehen hacha name kegon sheyyesh esek shevua benehen
Hechi dame esek shevua kidrava

a: Deamar rava mane li beyadcha vehalla omer en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim vehashshear eni yodea mittoch sheeno yachol lishava meshallem
Mashkachatte lah resha bishtayim vesefa beshalosh
Resha bishtayim daamar leh shette farot masarti lach palgeh deoma bishela ufalgeh deoma bischirut i name chad yoma bishela vechad yoma bischirut umetu tarvayehu beidan sheela
Vaamar leh shoel chada in beidan sheela meta veidach la yadana i beidan sheela meta vei beidan sechirut meta demittoch sheeno yachol lishava meshallem

Vesefa beshalosh daamar leh shalosh parot natatti lach shettayim bishela veachat bischirut vametu hane tarte dishela vaamar leh shoel in chada dishela meta idach la yadana i dishela meta udkayema dischirut hi i dischirut meta veha dekayema dishela hi umittoch sheeno yachol lishava meshallem
Ulrame bar chama deamar arbaa shomrim tzerichin kefira bemiktzat vehodaa bemiktzat mashkachatte lah resha beshalosh vesefa bearba
Resha beshalosh daamar leh shalosh parot natatti lecha palgeh deoma bishela ufalgeh deoma bischirut i name chad yoma bishela vechad yoma bischirut umetu telat kullehu beidan sheela
Vaamar leh shoel chada lo hau devarim meolam vachada in beidan sheela meta veidach la yadana i beidan sheela meta vei beidan sechirut meta demittoch sheeno yachol lishava meshallem
Sefa bearba daamar leh arba parot natatti lecha shalosh bishela chada bischirut umetu hanach shalosh dishela vaamar leh
b: Shoel chada lo hau devarim meolam vachada in dishela meta veidach la yadana i dischirut meta udkayema dishela o dishela meta udkayema dischirut demittoch sheeno yachol lishava meshallem
Ze omer sheula veze omer sechura yishshava hassocher shessechura meta
Veammay ma shetteano lo hoda lo uma shehoda lo lo teano amar ulla al yede gilgul
Daamar leh ishteva li ezo mihat dichdarkah meta umigo demishteva dichdarkah meta mishteva name dischura meta
Ze omer eni yodea veze omer ku ha manni somchos hi deamar mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin
Bae rabbi abba bar memel shealah bivalim secharah shello bivalim mahu
Mi amrinan sheela lechodah kayema uschirut lechodah kayema o dilma sechirut bishela meshach shayechi deha michayyav bigneva vaaveda
Im timtza lomar sechira bishela meshach shayechi secharah bivalim shealah shello bivalim mahu
Sheela bischirut vadday la shayecha o dilma kevan deshayecha bemiktzat keman deshayecha bechullah dame
Im timtza lomar la amrinan kevan deshayecha bemiktzat keman deshayecha bechullah dame shealah bivalim uscharah shello bivalim vechazar ushalah mahu
Hadar atya lah sheela leduchtah o dilma ippesika lah sechirut bene uvene
Secharah bivalim ushalah vechazar uscharah mahu mi amrinan atya lah sechirut leduchtah o dilma ippesika lah sheela bene uvene
Teku
Matni hashshoel et happara veshillechah lo beyad beno beyad avdo beyad shelucho o beyad beno beyad avdo beyad shelucho shel shoel umeta patur

Amar lo hashshoel shallechah li beyad beni beyad avdi beyad sheluchi o beyad bincha beyad avdecha beyad sheluchecha o sheamar lo hammashil hareni meshallechah lecha beyad beni beyad avdi beyad sheluchi o beyad bincha beyad avdecha beyad sheluchecha veamar lo hashshoel shallach veshillechah umeta chayyav
Vechen beshaa shemmachzirah

a: Gema beyad avdo chayyav yad eved keyad rabbo
Amar shemuel beeved ivri dela kene leh gufeh rav amar afilu tema beeved kenaani naase keomer leh hakkishah bemakkel vehi tavo
Metivi hashshoel happara veshillechah lo beyad beno beyad shelucho chayyav beyad avdo patur
Bishlama lishmuel matnitin beeved ivri barayeta beeved kenaani ella lerav kashya
Amar lecha rav la tema naasa keamar lo ella ema beamar lo hakkishah bemakkel vehi tavo
Deitmar hashileni paratcha veamar lo beyad mi veamar lo hakkishah bemakkel vetavo amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav kevan sheyyatzat mershut mashil umeta chayyav
Nema mesayya leh hashileni paratcha veamar lo beyad mi veamar lo hakkishah bemakkel vehi tavo kevan sheyyatzat mershut mashil umeta chayyav
Amar rav ashe hacha bemay askinan kegon shehayeta chatzero shel shoel lifnim mechatzero shel mashil dechi meshallechah lah vadday lehatam azla
I hachi may lememra la tzericha deika gazyata mahu detema la samcha dateh dilma kayema hatam vela atya azla lehedya ka mashma lan desamcha dateh
Amar rav huna hashshoel kardom mechavero bikka bo kenao lo bikka bo lo kenao
Lemay ilema loonasin may shena para demishsheat sheela ella lachazara bikka bo la matze hadar beh mashil lo bikka bo matze mashil hadar beh
Ufliga derabbi amme deamar rabbi amme hammashil kardom shel hekdesh maal lefi tovat hanaa shebbo vachavero muttar levakkea bo lechattechila
Vei lo kenao ammay maal veammay chavero muttar levakkea bo lechattechila nahdereh velo likneyeh vela limol
Ufliga derabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar kederech shettikkenu meshicha ballakochot kach tiknu meshicha bashshomrim
Tanya name hachi keshem shettikkenu meshicha ballakochot kach tiknu meshicha bashshomrim uchshem
b: Shekkarka niknet bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka kach sechirut niknet bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka sechirut may avidtah amar rav chisda sechirut karka
Amar shemuel hay man degazel chavitza detamre mechavreh veit bah chamshin tamre aggav hadade mizdabbenan bechamshin neche chada chada chada mizdabbenan bechamshin
Lehedot meshallem chamshin neche chada lehekdesh meshallem chamshin vechumshayehu ma sheen ken bemazzik dela meshallem chumsha deamar mar veish ki yochal kodesh perat lemazzik
Matkef lah rav bivi bar abbaye lehedot ammay meshallem chamshin neche chada nema leh ana chada chada hava mezabbenina lehu
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua shamin bet sea beotah sade tenan

Lememra desavar shemuel din hedot lav kedin gavoha dame vehatnan natal even o kora mehekdesh lo maal netanah lachavero hu maal vachavero lo maal benaah betoch beto lo maal ad sheyyadur tachteha beshave peruta

Vitev rabbi avahu kammeh derabbi yochanan veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh dishmuel zot omeret haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato tzarich lehaalot lo sachar amar leh rabbi yochanan hadar beh shemuel mehahi
Umimmay demehahi hadar beh dilma meha hadar la mehahi hadar beh kidrava deamar rava hekdesh shello middaat kehedot middaat dame

Amar rava hane shakolae ditvaru chavita dechamra lechanoa beoma deshuka mizdabbena bechamesh bishar yome mizdabbena bearba ahdaru leh beoma deshuka mahderu leh chavita dechamra bishar yome mahderu leh chamesh
Vela amaran ella dela hava leh chamra lezabbone aval hava leh chamra lezabbone ha ibi leh lezabbone
Umnakke leh agar tircheh udme barzanyata

a: Matni hammachlif para bachamor veyalda vechen hammocher shifchato veyalda ze omer ad shello macharti veze omer mishshellakachti yachloku
Hau lo shene avadim echad gadol veechad katan vechen shette sadot achat gedola veachat ketanna
Hallokeach omer gadol lakachti vehalla omer eni yodea zacha baggadol
Hammocher omer katan macharti vehalla omer eni yodea en lo ella katan
Ze omer gadol veze omer katan yishshava hammocher shehakkatan machar
Ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea yachloku
Gema ammay yachloku velichze birshut deman kayema veleheve idach hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Amar rav chiyya bar avin amar shemuel beomedet baagam shifcha name dekayema besimta
Venokmah achazaka demarah kamma velihve idach hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Ha manni somchos hi deamar mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin belo shevua
Emor deamar somchos beshemma veshemma bevari uvari mi amar
Amar rabba bar rav huna in amar somchos afilu bevari uvari
Rava amar leolam ki amar somchos shemma veshemma aval bari uvari la amar utni ze omer shemma ad shello macharti veze omer shemma mishshellakachti
Tenan ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea yachloku
Bishlama lerava middesefa shemma veshemma resha name shemma veshemma ella lerabba bar rav huna deamar in amar somchos afilu bari uvari hashta bari uvari amar yachloku shemma veshemma mibaya
I mishshum ha la irya tena sefa legalloye resha shello tomar resha shemma veshemma aval bari uvari la tena sefa shemma veshemma mikkelal deresha bari uvari vaafilu hachi yachloku
Tenan ze omer gadol veze omer katan yishshava hammocher shekkatan machar

Bishlama lerava deamar ki amar somchos shemma veshemma aval bari uvari la amar mishshum hachi yishshava ella lerabba bar rav huna deamar in amar somchos afilu bari uvari ammay yishshava mocher yachloku mibe leh
Mode somchos hecha deika shevua deorayeta kidvaenan lememar lekamman
Hau lo shene avadim echad gadol veechad katan vechu ammay yishshava ma shetteano lo hoda lo uma shehoda lo lo teano
Veod helach hu
Veod en nishbain al haavadim
Amar rav betoano damim deme eved gadol deme eved katan deme sade gedola deme sade ketanna
Ushmuel amar betoano kesut eved gadol kesut eved katan omre sade gedola omre sade ketanna
b: Kesut ma shetteano lo hoda lo uma shehoda lo lo teano kidamar rav pappa bidlayefi hacha name bidlayefi
Kashya leh lerabbi hoshaya mide kesut katane eved katane
Ella amar rabbi hoshaya kegon shetteano eved bichsuto vesade baomareha veakkatti kesut ma shetteano lo hoda lo uma shehoda lo lo teano amar rav pappa bidlayefi
Kashya leh lerav sheshet zokkin ata leashmoinan tenena zokkin hannechasim sheen lahen achraut et hannechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut lishava alehen
Ella amar rav sheshet ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar avda kemittaltelin dame
Veakkatti ma shetteano lo hoda lo uma shehoda lo lo teano savar lah kerabban gamliel ditnan teano chittim vehoda seorim patur rabban gamliel mechayyev
Akkatti helach hu amar rava avda dikta lideh vesade shechafar bah borot shichin umarot
Veha rabbi meir ipcha shaminan leh ditnan gazal behema vehizkina avadim vehizkinu meshallem kishat haggezela rabbi meir omer baavadim omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha
Ha la kashya kidmachlef rabba bar avuh vetane rabbi meir omer meshallem kishat haggezela vachachamim omrim omer lo baavadim hare shellecha lefanecha
Ella mimmay desavar rabbi meir makkeshinan karka leeved ma eved nishbain af karka nishbain dilma aeved hu denishbain aval akkarka la
La salka datach detanya hammachlif para bachamor veyalda vechen hammocher shifchato veyalda
Ze omer birshuti veze shotek zacha
Ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea yachloku

Ze omer birshuti veze omer birshuti yishshava hammocher shebbirshuto yalda lefi shekkol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim en nishbain lo al haavadim velo al hakkarkaot
Lav mikkelal derabbi meir savar nishbain
Mimmay dilma keshem kaamru leh ki hechi deodet lan bekarkaot odi lan name baavadim

Tidda ditnan rabbi meir omer yesh devarim shehen kakkarka veenan kakkarka veen chachamim modim lo ketzad eser gefanim teunot masarti lach vehalla omer enan ella chamesh rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim omrim kol hamchubbar lakkarka hare hu kakkarka
Veamar rabbi yose bar chanina anavim haomdot libatzer ika benayehu demar savar kivtzurot damyan umar savar lav kivtzurot damyan
Ella leolam kidrabbi hoshaya udkashya lach zokkin itzterich salka datach amena kesut eved keeved dame omre sade kesade dame ka mashma lan
Ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea yachloku ha manni somchos hi deamar mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin
Ema sefa ze omer birshuti veze omer birshuti yishshava hammocher shebbirshuto yalda ulrabba bar rav huna deamar in amar somchos afilu bari uvari ammay yishshava mocher yachloku mibaya
Mode somchos hecha deika shevua deorayeta udkatah lidah kidrava
Matni hammocher zetav leetzim veasu pachot merviit lassea hare ellu shel baal hazzetim
Asu reviit lassea ze omer zetay giddelu veze omer artzi giddela yachloku
Shataf nahar zetav untanam letoch sede chavero ze omer zetay giddelu veze omer artzi giddela yachloku
Gema hechi dame i daamar leh kotz lealtar afilu pachot merviit name levaal hakkarka i daamar leh kol emat devaet kotz afilu reviit name levaal zetim
La tzericha daamar leh setama pachot merviit la kafdi inashe reviit kafdi inashe
Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi urviit sheamru

a: Chutz min hahotzaa
Shataf nahar zetav amar ulla amar resh lakish lo shanu ella shenneekru begushehen ulachar shalosh
Aval betoch shalosh hakkol shel baal hazzetim daamar leh i atte netate betoch shalosh mi hava achlatte
Velema leh i ana netai leachar shalosh hava achelna leh kulleh hashta kaachlatte palga bahaday
Ella ki ata ravin amar resh lakish lo shanu ella shenneekru begushehen uvtoch shalosh aval leachar shalosh hakkol levaal hakkarka daamar leh i ana netai leachar shalosh mi la hava achelna leh kulleh
Velema leh i atte netate betoch shalosh la hava achlatte hashta ka achlatte palga bahaday mishshum daamar leh i ana netai hava kattine uzrana techotayehu silka veyarka
Tana amar halla zetay ani notel en shomin lo may tama amar rabbi yochanan mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael amar rabbi yirmeya kegon da tzericha rabba
Tenan hatam rabbi yehuda omer hamkabbel sade avotav min hannochri measser venoten lo
Savruha may sede avotav eretz yisrael veammay karu lah sede avotav sede avraham yitzchak veyaakov
Vekasavar en kinyan lenochri beeretz yisrael lehafkia miyyad maaser
Umkabbel kechocher dame ma chocher ben avad uven la avad bae assore umitan leh dechi porea chovato dame af mekabbel name ki porea chovato dame measser venoten lo
Amar leh rav kahana lerav pappi veamri lah lerav zevid ella ha detanya rabbi yehuda omer hamkabbel sade avotav mimmetzik nochri measser venoten lo may irya metzik afilu en metzik name
Ella leolam yesh kinyan lenochri beeretz yisrael lehafkia miyyad maaser umkabbel lav kechocher dame
Umay sede avotav sede avotav mammash uldideh hu dekansuh rabbanan deayede dachaviva aleh tafe veazel mekabbel lah aval inish dealma la
Uldideh may tama kansuh rabbanan amar rabbi yochanan kede shettehe bara beyado
Amar rabbi yirmeya kegon da tzericha rabba
Itmar hayyored letoch sede chavero untaah shello birshut amar rav shamin lo veyado al hattachtona ushmuel amar omdin kamma adam rotze liten besade zo lenotah
Amar rav pappa vela peligi kan besade haasuya lita kan besade sheenah asuya lita
Veha derav lav beferush itmar ella mikkelala itmar dehahu daata lekammeh derav amar leh zil shum leh amar leh la baena amar leh zil shum leh veyado al hattachtona amar leh la baena
Lesof chazyeh degadrah veka menattar lah amar leh gallit addatach denicha lach zil shum leh veyado al haelona
Itmar hayyored letoch churbato shel chavero uvnaah shello birshuto veamar lo etzay vaavanay ani notel rav nachman amar shomin lo rav sheshet amar en shomin lo
Metivi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer bet shammay omrim shomin lo uvet hillel omrim en shomin lo lema rav nachman deamar kevet shammay
Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya shomin lo divre rabbi shimon ben elazar rabban shimon ben gamliel omer bet shammay omrim shomin lo uvet hillel omrim en shomin lo
May have alah amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan
b: Bevayit shomin lo besade en shomin lo
Besade may tama mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael ika deamri mishshum kachsha deara may benayehu ika benayehu chutza laaretz

Matni hammaskir bayit lachavero bimot haggeshamim eno yachol lehotzio min hechag vead happesach bimot hachamma sheloshim yom uvakkerakkim echad yemot hachamma veechad yemot haggeshamim shenem asar chodesh uvachanuot echad ayarot veechad kerakkim shenem asar chodesh rabban shimon ben gamliel omer chanut shel nachtomim veshel tzabbaim shalosh shanim

Gema may shena yemot haggeshamim dechi agar inish beta bimot haggeshamim agar lechullehu yemot haggeshamim yemot hachamma name dechi agar inish beta lechullehu yemot hachamma agar ella bimot haggeshamim hayenu tama dela shechiach beta lemegar
Ema sefa bakkerakkim echad yemot hachamma veechad yemot haggeshamim shenem asar chodesh veilu melo leh yome sechirut bimot haggeshamim mappek leh veammay ha la shechiach beta lemegar
Amar rav yehuda lehodia katane vehachi kaamar hammaskir bayit lachavero setam en yachol lehotzio bimot haggeshamim mechag vead happesach ella im ken hodio sheloshim yom meikara

Tanya name hachi kesheamru sheloshim uchsheamru shenem asar chodesh lo amru ella lehodio uchshem shemmaskir tzarich lehodia kach socher tzarich lehodia deamar leh i odatan hava tarachna umotevna beh inish mealleya

Amar rav assi im nichnas yom echad bimot haggeshamim eno yachol lehotzio min hechag ad happesach veha anan sheloshim yom kaamar hachi kaamar im nichnas yom echad bimot haggeshamim mehane sheloshim yom eno yachol lehotzio min hachag vead happesach
Amar rav huna veim ba lerabbot bedameha merabbe amar leh rav nachman hay linketeh bechuvseh delishbekeh liglime la tzericha deiyyakur batte
Peshita nefal leh beta amar leh la adifatte minay
Zabbeneh o orteh o yahaveh bemattana amar leh la adifatte miggavra daatet mineh
Kalleleh livreh chazenan i hava efshar leodoeh ibi leh leodoe vei la amar leh la adifatte minay

Hahu gavra dizvan arba dechamra la ashkach duchta leotoveh amar leh lehahi itta it lach duchta leogoray amara leh la azal kaddeshah yehava leh duchta leayyoleh azal leveteh ketav lah gita shaddar lah azala ihi agara shakolae mineh uveh appekteh veotveh bishvila amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua kaasher asa ken yease lo gemulo yashuv berosho
La mibaya chatzer dela kayema leagra ella afilu chatzer dekayema leagra amra leh lechulle alma nicha li leogore velach la nicha li dedamet alay ki arya arva
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shel nachtomim veshel tzabbain shalosh shanim tana mippene shehekkefan merubbe
Matni hammaskir bayit lachavero hammaskir chayyav baddelet banneger uvammanul uvchol davar shemmaase umman aval davar sheeno maase umman hassocher osehu
Hazzevel shel baal habbayit veen lassocher ella hayyotze min hattannur umin hakkirayim bilvad

Gema tanu rabbanan hammaskir bayit lachavero maskir chayyav lehaamid lo delatot liftoach lo challonot lechazzek lo tikra lismoch lo kora vesocher chayyav laasot lo sullam laasot lo maake laasot lo marzev ulhatiach et gaggo
Beo mineh merav sheshet mezuza al mi mezuza haamar rav mesharsheya mezuza chovat haddar hi ella mekom mezuza al mi
Amar lehu rav sheshet tenetuha davar sheen maase umman hassocher osehu vehay name lav maase umman hu efshar hu

a: Beguvta dekanya

Tanu rabbanan hammaskir bayit lachavero al hassocher laasot lo mezuza uchshehu yotze lo yittelenna beyado veyetze uminnochri notlah beyado veotze umaase beechad shennetalah beyado veyatza vekavar ishto ushne banav
Maase listor amar rav sheshet aresha

Hazzevel shel baal habbayit veen lassocher ella hayyotze min hattannur umin hakkirayim bilvad bemay askinan ilema bechatzer daagira leh lesocher vetore desocher ammay shel baal habbayit ella bechatzer dela agira lesocher vetore demaskir peshita
La tzericha bechatzer demaskir vetore deatu mealma kamu bah
Mesayya leh lerabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato
Metivi im amar kol metziot sheyyavou letocho hayyom tikne li chatzeri lo amar kelum veim ita leha deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato ammay lo amar kelum
Hacha bemay askinan bechatzer sheenah mishtammeret
I hachi ema sefa yatza lo shem metzia bair devarav kayyamin vei bechatzer sheenah mishtammeret ki yatza lo shem metzia bair may have
Kevan deyatza lo shem metzia bair mivdal bedili inashe minah vehaveya lah kechatzer hammishtammeret

Metivi zevel hayyotze min hattannur umin hakkirayim vehakkolet min haavir hare hu shello veshebbarefet veshebbechatzer shel baal habbayit veim ita leha derabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato kolet meavir ammay hare hu shello avir chatzero hu
Amar abbaye bemadbik keli beshule fara

Umi peshita leh lerava veha mive bae lah devae rava zarak arnaki befetach ze veyatzata befetach ze mahu avir sheen sofo lanuach kemunnach dame o lav kemunnach dame
Hatam la mafsek vela mide hacha mafsek keli
Veshebbarefet veshebbechatzer hare ellu shel baal habbayit tarte
Amar abbaye hachi kaamar veshebbarefet shebbechatzer hare ellu shel baal habbayit amar rav ashe zot omeret hammaskir chatzero setam lo hiskir refet shebbah
Metivi yone shovach veone aliyya chayyavot beshiluach vaasurot begazel mippene darche shalom
Veim ita leha deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato keri kan ki yikkare perat limzumman
Amar rava betza bitziat rubbah hu deichayyava lah beshiluach umikna la kanya ad denafla lachatzero vechi katane chayyavot beshiluach mikkamme detipol lachatzero
I hachi ammay asurot mishshum gazel aimman
Veibaet ema leolam abbetzim umiddenafek rubbah dateh ilavah

Vehashta deamar rav yehuda amar rav asur lizkot babbetzim kol zeman shehaem rovetzet alehem shenneemar shalleach teshallach et haem vahadar et habbanim tikkach lach afilu tema dinfala lah lachatzero kol hecha deihu matze zache leh chatzero zachya leh vechol hecha deihu la matze zache leh chatzero name la zachya leh
I hachi asurot begazel mippene darche shalom i deshallechah gazel mealleya hu i dela shallechah ha bae shallochah
Bekatan delav bar shiluach hu katan bar darche shalom hu hachi kaamar aviv shel katan chayyav lehachzir lo mippene darche shalom
Matni hammaskir bayit lachavero leshana nitabbera hashshana nitabbera lassocher hiskir lo lachodashim nitabbera hashshana nitabbera lammaskir

b: Uva maase lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel velifne rabbi yose veamru yachloku et chodesh haibur

Ha amar rav chada zimna deamar rav huna amri be rav istera mea mae mea mae mea mae istera istera

Ushmuel amar beva beemtza chodesh askinan aval ba bitchillat chodesh kulleh lemaskir ba besof chodesh kulleh lesocher

Hatam tama may mishshum detafes hacha name ka tafes

Beo mineh merabbi yannay socher amar natatti umaskir amar lo natalti al mi lehavi reaya

Sachir hu dirmo rabbanan shevua aleh mishshum devaal habbayit tarud befoalav aval hacha socher meheman bishvua

Amar rava amar rav nachman hay man deogar leh beta lechavreh laasar shenin uchtav leh shetara vaamar leh nekitatte chamesh shenin meheman amar leh rav acha middifti leravina ella meatta ozfeh mea zuze bishtara vaamar leh peraticha palga hachi name dimheman
Amar leh hachi hashta hatam shetar leguvyana kae im ita defareh ibi leh lemichtavo aggabbeh i name michtav aleh tevara aval hacha amar leh hay dichtavi lach shetara ki hechi dela tachzek aleh
Amar rav nachman shoel adam betuvo leolam
Amar rav mari berah devat shemuel vehu dikne dikno mineh
Amar rav mari bereh derav ashe umahdar leh katteh
Amar rava hay man daamar leh lechavreh oshlan mara lemirpak beh hay pardesa rafek beh hahu pardesa pardesa rafek beh kol pardesa devae pardese rafek veazel kol pardese deit leh umahdar leh katteh
Amar rav pappa hay man deamar leh lechavreh oshlan hay garguta venafla la bane lah garguta venafla bane lah be garguta kare veazel kamma gargute beareh ad demitreme leh vetzarich lemikne mineh

Matni hammaskir bayit lachavero venafal chayyav lehaamid lo bayit haya katan lo yaasennu gadol gadol lo yaasennu katan echad lo yaasennu shenayim shenayim lo yaasennu echad lo yifchot min hachallonot velo yosif alehem ella middaat shenehem

I hachi may lememra

Hadaran alach hashshoel

Matni hamkabbel sade mechavero makom shennahagu liktzor yiktzor laakor yaakor lachrosh acharav yachrosh hakkol keminhag hammedina keshem shecholkin battevua kach cholkin batteven uvakkash keshem shecholkin bayyayin kach cholkin
b: Bazzemorot uvakkanim ushnehem mesappekin et hakkanim
Gema tana mekom shennahagu liktzor eno rashshay laakor laakor eno rashshay liktzor ushnehem meakkevin ze al ze
Liktzor eno rashshay laakor hay amar baena detittabban li aray vehay amar la matzena laakor eno rashshay liktzor hay amar baena detinakkar aray vehay amar baena tivna
Ushnehem meakkevin ze al ze lema li ma taam kaamar ma taam liktzor eno rashshay laakor laakor eno rashshay liktzor mishshum dishnehem meakkevin ze al ze
Lachrosh acharav yachrosh peshita la tzericha beatra dela menakkeshi vaazal ihu venakkesh mahu detema amar leh hay denakkeshna addata dela karevna lah ka mashma lan deibi leh lefaroshe leh
Hakkol keminhag hammedina hakkol leetoye may leetoye ha detanu rabbanan makom shennahagu lehaskir ilanot al gabbe karka maskirin makom sheen nahagu lehaskir en maskirin

Makom shennahagu lehaskir maskirin peshita la tzericha dechulle alma yahavi betilta vaazal ihu veyahaveh beriva mahu detema daamar leh hay divtzari lach addata dela yahevna lach bailanot ka mashma lan deibi leh lefaroshe leh

Makom shennahagu shello lehaskir en maskirin peshita la tzericha dechulle alma mekabbeli beriva vaazal ihu vekablah betilta mahu detema amar leh hay ditfay lach addata dihavte li beilanot ka mashma lan deibi leh lefaroshe leh
Keshem shecholkin bitvua kach cholkin beteven uvkash amar rav yosef bevavel nehigu dela yahavi tivna laarisa lemay nafka minah dei ika inish deyahev ayin yafa hu vela gamrinan mineh

Amar rav yosef buchra vetafta vearkavta ukne dechizra devaal habbayit vechizra gufeh daarisa kelala demilta kol ikar belama devaal habbayit netiruta yattirta daarisa veamar rav yosef mara uzvila vedavela vezarnuka devaal habbayit arisa aved be yeore
Keshem shecholkin bayyayin kach cholkin bazzemorot uvakkanim kanim may avidtayehu amri deve rabbi yannay kanim hammuchlakin shebbahen maamidin et haggefanim
Ushnehem mesappekin et hakkanim lema li ma taam kaamar ma taam shenehem cholkin bakkanim mishshum dishnehem mesappekin et hakkanim

Matni hamkabbel sade mechavero vehi bet hashshelachin o bet hailan yavash hammayan veniktzatz hailan eno menakke lo min chachoro im amar lo chachor li sade bet hashshelachin zo o sede bet hailan ze yavash hammayan veniktzatz hailan menakke lo mechachoro
Gema hechi dame ilema divash nahara rabba ammay eno menakke lo min chachoro nema leh makkat medina hi amar rav pappa divash nahara zuta deamar leh

a: Ibi lach leetoye bedavela
Amar rav pappa hane tarte matneyata kammayata mashkachatte lah ben bechachranuta ben bekabbelanuta mikkan veelach deitah bekabbelanuta letah bechachranuta uditah bechachranuta letah bekabbelanuta

Im amar lo chachor li sede bet hashshelachin ze vechu veammay lema leh shema bealma amari lach mi la tanya haomer lachavero bet kor afar ani mocher lach af al pi sheen bo ella letech higgio shello machar lo ella shema vehu demitkere bet kor

Karma ani mocher lach af al pi sheen bo gefanim higgio shello machar lo ella shema vehu demitkere karma pardes ani mocher lach af al pi sheen bo rimmonim higgio shello machar lo ella shema vehu demitkere pardesa alma amar leh shema bealma amari lach hachi name nema leh shema bealma amari lach
Amar shemuel la kashya ha daamar leh machkir lechocher ha daamar leh chocher lemachkir amar leh machkir lechocher shema bealma amar leh amar leh chocher lemachkir kefeda
Ravina amar ide veidi daamar leh machkir lechocher middekaamar ze mikkelal dekae begavah askinan bet hashshelachin lema leh lememar dekaamar leh bet hashshelachin kidkayema hashta
Matni hamkabbel sade mechavero vehovirah shamin otah kamma reuya laasot venoten lo shekkach kotev lo im ovir vela eeved ashallem bemetva
Gema rabbi meir haya doresh leshon hedot detanya rabbi meir omer im ovir vela eeved ashallem bemetva
Rabbi yehuda haya doresh leshon hedot detanya rabbi yehuda omer adam mevi korban ashir al ishto vechen kol korban vekorban shehi chayyevet shekkach kotev lah achraut deit lich alay min kadmat dena

Hillel hazzaken haya doresh leshon hedot detanya anshe alekkesanderiyya hau mekaddeshin et neshotehem uvishat kenisatan lachuppa bain acherim vechotfim otam mehen uvikkeshu chachamim laasot benehem mamzerim
Amar lahen hillel hazzaken haviu li ketubbat immechem heviu lo ketubbat imman umatza shekkatuv bahen lichshettikkansi lachuppa hevay li leintu velo asu benehem mamzerim

Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha haya doresh leshon hedot detanya rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer hammalve et chavero lo yemashkenennu yoter mechovo shekkach kotev lo tashlumta deit lecha alay kol kovel dechi
Tama dichtav leh hachi ha i la ketav leh hachi la kanyeh veha amar rabbi yochanan mishkeno veheshiv lo hammashkon vamet shomto meal gabbe banav
b: Ahanay ketiva legeraon
Rabbi yose haya doresh leshon hedot detanya rabbi yose omer makom shennahagu laasot ketubba milva gove milva lichpol gove mechetza
Neharbelae gavu tilta marimar magbe name shevacha
Amar leh ravina lemarimar vehatanya lichpol gove mechetza la kashya ha dikne dikno mineh ha dela kane keno mineh
Ravina mashbach vechatev livratteh amaru leh nikne mineh demar amar lehu i mikne la michpal i michpal la mikne

Hahu gavra daamar lehu havu lah arba mea zuze livratti bichtubbetah shelach rav acha bereh derav aveya lekammeh derav ashe arba mea deinun tamne mea o arba mea zuze deinun matan amar rav ashe chazenan i amar havu lah arba mea zuze deinun tamne mea i amar ketovu lah arba mea zuze deinun matan
Ika deamri amar rav ashe chazenan i amar lichtubbetah arba mea zuze deinun tamne mea vei amar bichtubbetah arba mea zuze deinun matan
Vela hi la shena deamar lichtubbetah vela shena deamar bichtubbetah arba mea zuze deinun matan ad deamar havu lah setama
Hahu gavra dekabbel ara mechavreh amar i movarna lah yahevna lach alpa zuze ovar tilta amri nehardae dina hu deyahev leh telat mea utlatin utlata vetilta rava amar asmachta hi veasmachta la kanya
Ulrava may shena meha ditnan im ovir vela eeved ashallem bemetva hatam la ka gazem hacha kevan dekaamar milta yattirta guzma bealma hu dekagazem
Hahu gavra dekabbel ara leshumsheme zarah chite avada chite keshumsheme sevar rav kahana lememar menakke leh kachsha deara
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana amri inashe kachasha tichchosh ara vela lichchosh marah
Hahu gavra dekabbel ara leshumsheme zara chite avada chite tefe min shumsheme sevar ravina lememar yahev leh shevacha devene bene amar leh rav acha middifti leravina attu hu ashbach ara la ashbacha
Amri nehardae hay iska palga milva ufalga pikkadon avud rabbanan milta denicha leh lelove venicha leh lemalve
Hashta deamrinan palga milva i bae lemishte beh shichra shappir dame rava amar lehachi karu leh iska daamar leh ki yahavina lach leiasoke beh vela lemishte beh shichra
Amar rav idi bar avin veim met naase mittaltelin etzel banav rava amar lehachi karu leh iska deim met lo yease mittaltelin etzel banav
Amar rava chada iska utre shetare peseda demalve
