Veamar rava hay man dekabbel iska min chavreh ufsed terach umalleyeh vela odeh la matze amar leh deri mehayech peseda bahaday mishshum daamar leh lehachi terachte lemallaoteh umalleteh ki hechi dela likro lach mafsed iske

Veamar rava hane be tere deavdi iska bahade hadade urvach vaamar leh chad lechavreh ta liflog i amar leh idach narvach tefe dina hu dimakkev vei amar leh hav li palga deravecha amar leh ravecha lekarna mishtabed
Vei amar leh hav li palga ravecha ufalga karna amar leh iska lahadade meshubad vei amar leh niflog ravecha veniflog karna vei mate lach peseda darena bahadach amar leh la mazzala deve tere adif

Matni hamkabbel sade mechavero velo ratza lenakkesh veamar lo ma ichpat lecha hoil vaani noten lecha et chachirach en shomin lo mippene sheyyachol lomar lo lemachar atta yotze mimmenna umaalet lefanay asavim

Gema i amar leh levatar hachi karevna lah amar leh chitte mealleyata baena vei amar leh zavenna lach chitte mishshuka amar leh chitte dearay baena vei amar leh menakkeshna lach shiur menatach amar leh ka mansevatte shem ra learay
Vehatnan mippene shemmaalet lefanay asavim ella mishshum deamar leh bizra dinfal nefal
Matni hamkabbel sade mechavero velo asta im yesh bah kede lehaamid keri chayyav littappel bah amar rabbi yehuda may kitzva bichri ella im yesh bah kede nefila

Gema tanu rabbanan hamkabbel sade mechavero velo asta im yesh bah kede lehaamid keri chayyav littappel bah shekkach kotev lo ana ekom veenur veezra veechtzod vaaammar veedush veedre veokem karya kodamach vetete ante vetitol palga vaana beamli uvnafkut yeday palga
Vechamma kede lehaamid bah keri amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina kede shettaamod bo harachat ibaya lehu rachat hayyotze mehay gisa lehay gisa may

Ta shema amar rabbi avahu ledidi mipparsha li mineh derabbi yose berabbi chanina kol sheen kones shello roe pene hachamma itmar levi amar shalosh sein deve rabbi yannay amri satayim amar resh lakish satayim sheamru chutz min hahotzaa
Tenan hatam paritze zetim vaanavim bet shammay metammein uvet hillel metaharin
May paritze zetim amar rav huna rishe zetim amar rav yosef umay keraa uvne paritze ammecha yinnasseu lehaamid chazon venichshalu rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha veholid ben paritz shofech dam
Vechamma paritze zetim rabbi elazar amar arbaat kabbin lakkora deve rabbi yannay amri satayim lakkora
Vela peligi ha beatra dimayeli kora beolala ha beatra dimayeli telata korin beolala
Tanu rabbanan
b: Alu beilan shekkocho ra uvsocha shekkochah ra tame
Hechi dame ilan shekkocho ra amri deve rabbi yannay kol sheen beikaro lachok rova hechi dame socha shekkochah ra amar resh lakish kol shennechbet bechezonah
Tenan hatam hamhallech bevet happeras al gabbe avanim sheyyachol lehasit al haadam veal habbehema shekkochan ra tame
Hechi dame adam shekkocho ra amar resh lakish kol sherochvo vearchubbotav nokshot hechi dame behema shekkochah ra amri deve rabbi yannay kol sherochvah umtila gelalim
Amri deve rabbi yannay litfilla velitfilin arbaa kabbin
Litfilla may hi detanya hannose massooy al ketefo vehiggia zeman tefilla pachot mearbaa kabbin mafshilan laachorav umitpallel arbaa kabbin manniach al gabbe karka umitpallel
Litfilin may hi detanya haya nose massooy al rosho utfilin berosho im hau tefilin rotztzot asur veim lav muttar beezo massooy amru bemassooy shel arbaat kabbin
Tane rabbi chiyya hammotzi zevel al rosho utfilin berosho hare ze lo yesallekem litzdadin velo yiksherem bemotnav mippene shehu noheg bahen minhag bizzaon aval koshram al zeroo bimkom tefilin
Mishshum rabbi shela amru afilu mitpachat shellahen asur lehanniach al harosh sheyyesh bo tefilin vechamma amar abbaye afilu riva deriva defumbedita

Amar rabbi yehuda may kitzva bichri ella im yesh bo kede nefila vechamma kede nefila rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan arbao sein lechor rabbi amme dileh amar shemonat sein lechor amar leh hahu sava lerav chama bereh derabba bar avuh asberah lach bishne derabbi yochanan hava shammina ara bishne derabbi amme hava kechisha ara
Tenan hatam haruach sheppizra et haomarin omdim otah kamma leket reuya laasot venoten laaniyyim rabban shimon ben gamliel omer noten laaniyyim kede nefila
Vechamma kede nefila ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi elazar veitema rabbi yochanan arbaat kabbin lechor bae rabbi yirmeya lechor zera o lechor tevua lemappolet yad o lemappolet sheorim
Ta shema dechi ata ravin amar rabbi avuh amar rabbi elazar veamri lah amar rabbi yochanan arbaat kabbin lechor zera vaadayin tibbee lach lemappolet yad o lemappolet sheorim teku

Matni hamkabbel sade mechavero vaachalah chagav o nishdefa im makkat medina hi menakke lo min chachoro im enah makkat medina en menakke lo min chachoro rabbi yehuda omer im kiblah hemennu bemaot ben kach uven kach eno menakke lo mechachoro
Gema hechi dame makkat medina amar rav yehuda kegon deishteduf rubba devaga ulla amar kegon shennishtaddefu arba sadot mearba ruchoteha
Amar ulla bau bemareva nishdaf telem echad al pene kullah may nishtayyer telem echad al pene kullah mahu ippesiko beyara may aspasta

a: May zera acher may chite legabbe seorim seare kezera acher dame o la kal haolam kullo beshiddafon veshello beyerakon i name kal haolam kullo beyerakon veshello beshiddafon may teku

Amar leh zirah chite vaazal hu vezarah seare veishteduf rubba devaga veishteduf name hanach seare dileh may mi amrinan deamar leh ilu zeratah chite hava name mishtadfa o dilma matze amar leh ilu zeratah chite hava mikkayyam bi vetigzar omer veyakom lach
Mistabbera deamar leh i zeratah chite hava mikkayyam bi vetigzar omer veyakom lach veal derachecha nagah or

Nishtadfu kol sedotav shel machkir veishteduf name ha bahadayehu vela ishteduf rubba devaga may mi amrinan kevan dela ishteduf rubba devaga la menakke leh o dilma kevan deishteduf kullehu arateh matze amar leh hay mishshum lattach didach hu deha mishtadfu nishtadfu kal sedotecha
Mistabbera deamar leh i mishshum lattay didi hava mishtayyar li purta kedichtiv ki nisharnu meat meharbe

Nishtadfu kol sedotav shel chocher veishteduf rubba devaga veishteduf name ha bahadayehu may mi amrinan kevan deishteduf rubba devaga menakke leh o dilma kevan deishteduf kullehu arateh matze amar leh mishshum lattach didach hu deha mishtadfu nishtadfu kal sedotecha mistabbera deamar leh mishshum lattach hu

Ammay hacha name nema leh i mishshum lattay didi hu hava mishtayyar li purta dahava mikkayyam bi ki nisharnu meat meharbe mishshum daamar leh i hava chazet leishtayyore lach mide hava mishtayyar lach middenafshach
Metivi hayeta shenat shiddafon veyerakon o sheviit o shehau shanim kishne eliyyahu eno ole lo min hamminyan
Katane shiddafon veyerakon dumya deshanim kishne eliyyahu ma shene eliyyahu dela havay tevua kelal af hacha name dela havay tevua kelal aval deika tevua salka leh vela kaamrinan makkat medina hi
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak shane hatam deamar kera bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach shanim sheyyesh bahen tevua baolam
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana ella meatta sheviit taale lo min hamminyan deha ika tevua bechutza laaretz amar leh sheviit afkata demalka hi
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina ella meatta sheviit lo taale lo min haggerua allema tenan noten sela ufundeon leshana amar leh shane hatam dechazya lemishtacho bah pere
Amar shemuel lo shanu ella shezzeraah vetzimmecha vaachalah chagav aval lo zeraah kelal la deamar leh ilu zeratah hava mikkayyam bi lo yevoshu beet raa uvime reavon yisbau

Metiv rav sheshet roe shehaya roe vehinniach edro uva lair uva zeev vetaraf uva ari vedaras en omrim ilu haya sham haya matztzil ella omdin oto im yachol lehatztzil chayyav veim lav patur veammay nema leh i havet hatam hava mikkayyam bi gam et haari gam haddov hikka avdecha

Mishshum daamar leh i havet chazet leitrechoshe lach nisa hava itrechish mitrechish lach nisa kerabbi chanina ben dosa demetyan ize dubbe bekarnayehu venema leh nehi dilnisa rabba la hava chazena lenisa zuta
b: Chazena kashya
Tane chada paam rishona ushniyya zorah ushlishit eno zorah vetanya idach shelishit zorah reviit eno zorah la kashya ha kerabbi ha kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Ha kerabbi deamar bitre zimne haveya chazaka ha kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar bitlat zimne haveya chazaka

Amar resh lakish lo shanu ella shezzeraah vetzimmecha vaachalah chagav aval zeraah velo tzimmecha matze amar leh baal hakkarka kol yeme zera zerao lah veezil vead emat amar rav pappa ad deatu arise middavra vekayema kima areshayehu
Metivi rabban shimon ben gamliel mishshum rabbi meir omer vechen haya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer kidvarav chatzi tishre merachshevan vachatzi chislev zera
Chatzi chislev tevet vachatzi shevat choref chatzi shevat adar vachatzi nisan kor chatzi nisan iyyar vachatzi sivan katzir chatzi sivan tammuz vachatzi av kayitz chatzi av elul vachatzi tishre chom
Rabbi yehuda mone mittishri rabbi shimon mone mimmerachshevan
Man mekel bechullehu rabbi shimon vechulle hay la kaamar la kashya ha dekabbelah mineh becharfe ha dekabbeleh mineh beafle

Rabbi yehuda omer im kibbela mimmennu bemaot hahu gavra dekabbel ara lemizrao bahv tume aggudda dinhar malka sava bezuze istechar nehar malka sava ata lekammeh derava amar leh nehar malka sava la avid demistechar makkat medina hi zil nakke leh
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava ha anan tenan rabbi yehuda omer im kibbela hemennu bemaot ben kach uven kach eno menakka lo min chachoro amar lehu let dechash lah lidrabbi yehuda
Matni hamkabbel sade mechavero baasara kor chittim leshana velakta noten lo mittochah hau chitteha yafot lo yomar lo hareni lokeach min hashshuk ella noten lo mittochah

Gema hahu gavra dekabbel ara leaspasta bechore disare avada aspasta vecharshah vezarah seare ulko hane seare shalchah rav chaviva missura difrat lekammeh deravina ki hay gavena may ki lakta noten lo mittochah dame o la
Amar leh mi dame hatam la avada ara shelichuta demarah hacha avada ara shelichuta demarah

Hahu gavra dekabbel pardes mechavreh baasar danne chamra tekef hahu chamra sevar rav kahana lememar hayenu matnitin lakta noten lo mittochah amar leh rav ashe mi dame hatam la avada ara shelichuta hacha avada ara shelichuta
Umode rav ashe beinve dichdum uvsade shellakta baomareha

Matni hamkabbel sade mechavero lezorah seorim lo yizraenna chittim chittim yizraenna seorim rabban shimon ben gamliel oser tevua lo yizraenna kitnit kitnit yizraenna tevua verabban shimon ben gamliel oser
Gema amar rav chisda may tama derabban shimon ben gamliel dichtiv sheerit yisrael lo yaasu avela velo yedabberu chazav velo yimmatze befihem leshon tarmit

Metivi migbat purim lefurim veen medakdekin baddavar veen heani rashshay likach mehen retzua lesandalo ella im ken hitna bemaamad anshe hair divre rabbi yaakov sheamar mishshum rabbi meir rabban shimon ben gamliel

a: Mekel
Amar abbaye tama derabban shimon kidmar deamar mar hay man denicha leh detitbayyar areh lizreah shatta chitte veshatta seare shatta sheti veshatta erev
Vela amaran ella dela karev vetane aval karev vetane let lan bah
Tevua lo yizraenna kitnit vechu matne leh rav yehuda leravin tevua yizraenna kitnit amar leh veha anan tenan tevua lo yizraenna kitnit amar leh la kashya ha lan veha lehu
Amar leh rav yehuda leravin bar rav nachman ravin achi hane tachle deve chittana en bahen mishshum gazel omdot al gevulin yesh bahen mishshum gazel
Veim hukshu lezera afilu deve chittana name yesh bahem mishshum gazel may tama may deafsed afsed
Amar leh rav yehuda leravin bar rav nachman ravin achi hane dili dilach vedilach dili nehug bene mitzra ilan hannote lechan lechan vehannote lechan lechan
Deitmar ilan haomed al hammetzer amar rav hannote lechan lechan vehannote lechan lechan ushmuel amar cholkin
Metivi ilan haomed al hammetzer yachloku teuvta derav targema shemuel alliba derav bimmalle kal hammetzer kullo
I hachi may lememra la tzericha ditle tuneh lechad gisa veakkatti may lememra mahu detema deamar leh pelog hachi ka mashma lan deamar leh may chazet defalgatte hachi pelog hachi
Amar leh rav yehuda leravin bar rav nachman ravin achi la tizbon ara dismicha lemata deamar rabbi avahu amar rav huna amar rav asur lo leadam sheyyaamod al sede chavero beshaa sheomedet bekamoteha
Ini veha ashkechinhu rabbi abba letalmideh derav amar lehu may amar rav behane kerae baruch atta bair uvaruch atta bassade baruch atta bevoecha uvaruch atta betzetecha

Vaamaru leh hachi amar rav baruch atta bair sheyehe betcha samuch levet hakkeneset baruch atta bassade sheyehu nechasecha kerovim lair baruch atta bevoecha shello timtza ishtecha sefek nidda bishat biatcha min hadderech baruch atta betzetecha sheyehu tzeetzae meecha kemotcha
Vaamar lehu rabbi yochanan la amar hachi ella baruch atta bair sheyehe bet hakkisse samuch leshulchancha aval bet hakkeneset la verabbi yochanan letameh deamar sechar pesiot yesh

Baruch atta bassade sheyehu nechasecha meshullashin shelish bitvua shelish bezetim ushlish bigfanim baruch atta bevoecha uvaruch atta betzetecha shettehe yetziatcha min haolam keviatcha leolam ma biatcha leolam belo chet af yetziatcha min haolam belo chet
b: La kashya ha dimhaddar leh shura veritka ha dela mehaddar leh shura veritka
Vehesir Adonai mimmecha kol choli amar rav zo haayin rav letameh derav salek leve kivre avad may daavad amar tishin vetisha beayin raa veechad bederech eretz
Ushmuel amar ze haruach shemuel letameh deamar shemuel hakkol baruach velishmuel ha ika haruge malchut hanach name i lav zika avdi lehu samma vechaye
Rabbi chanina amar zo tzina deamar rabbi chanina hakkol bide shamayim chutz mitztzinnim pachim shenneemar tzinnim pachim bederech ikkesh shomer nafsho yirchak mehem
Rabbi yose bar chanina amar zo tzoa deamar mar tzoat hachotem vetzoat haozen rubban kashe umiutan yafe

Rabbi elazar amar zo mara tanya name hachi machala zo mara velamma nikra shemah machala shehi machala kol gufo shel adam davar acher machala sheshshemonim ushlosha cholaim teluyin bammara vechullan pat shacharit bemelach vekiton shel mayim mevattaltan

Tanu rabbanan shelosha asar devarim neemru befat shacharit matztzelet min hachamma umin hatztzinna umin hazzikin umin hammazzikin umachkimat peti vezoche baddin lilmod tora ullammed udvarav nishmain vetalmudo mitkayyem beyado
Veen besaro maale hevel venizkak leishto veeno mitave leishsha acheret vehoreget kina shebbivne meayim veyesh omrim af motzia et hakkina umachneset et haahava

Amar leh rabba lerava bar mari mena ha milta deamri inashe shitin rahote rehut vela meto legavra demitztzafra kerach vaamaru rabbanan hashkem veechol bekayitz mippene hachamma uvachoref mippene hatztzina
Amar leh dichtiv lo yiravu velo yitzmau velo yakkem sharav vashamesh lo yakkem sharav vashamesh kevan dela yiravu velo yitzmau

Amar leh atte amratte li mehatam vaana amena lach mehacha vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem uverach et lachmecha veet memecha vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem zo keriat shema utfilla uverach et lachmecha veet memecha zo pat bammelach vekiton shel mayim mikkan veelach vahasiroti machala mikkirbecha

Amar leh rav yehuda lerav adda mashochaa la tezalzel bemishchata dechol purta ufurta chazi lechurkema rishka amar leh rav yehuda lerav adda mashochaa arba ammot deannigra zalzel behu deannahara la timshechinhu kelal
Rav yehuda letameh deamar rav yehuda arba ammot deannigra livne nigra deannahara dechulle alma

Machriz rabbi amme mele katfe naggade bitre evre nahara kutzu rav natan bar hoshaya katz shitsar ammeta ato aleh bene mashronya dafnuh hu savar kirshut harabbim vela hi hatam baenan kulle hay hacha mishshum amtoche ashlehen ashlayehu hu kimle katfe naggade saggi

Rabba bar rav huna hava leh hahu ibba aggudda denahara amaru leh nikotz mar amar lehu kutzu ilae vetattae vahadar nikotz ana hechi aved hachi vehachtiv hitkoshshu vakoshshu veamar resh lakish keshot atzmecha veachar kach keshot acherim
Hatam ibba deve farzak rufila hava veamar i kayetzu kayetzna vei la kayetzu ammay ikotz dei mimmatchi lehu ashlayehu mistaggi lehu

a: Vei la la mistagge lehu

Rabba bar rav nachman hava ka azel bearba chaza hahu ibba dekae aggudda denahra amar lehu deman amaru leh derabba bar rav huna amar veyad hassarim vehasseganim hayeta bammaal hazze rishona amar lehu kutzu katztzu
Ata rabba bar rav huna ashkecheh dekayitz amar man katzyeh tikkotz anfeh amri kullehu shene derabba bar rav huna la ikkayyam leh zara lerabba bar rav nachman
Amar rav yehuda hakkol leigle gappa vaafilu miyyatme aval rabbanan la may tama rabbanan la tzerichi netiruta lecharya defatya vaafilu merabbanan
Vela amaran ella dela nafki bechaloza aval lechaloza la derabbanan lav bene mipak bechaloza ninhu
Amar rav yehuda lecharya denahra tattae mesayei ilae ilae la mesayei tattae vechilufa bemayya demitra

Tanya name hachi chamesh gannot hammistappekot mayim mimmayan echad venitkalkel hammayan kullam metakkenot im haelona nimtzet hattachtona metakkenet im kullan umtakkenet leatzmah vechen chamesh chatzerot shehau mekallechot mayim leviv echad venitkalkel habbiv kullan metakkenot im hattachtona nimtzet haelona metakkenet im kullan umtakkenet leatzmah
Amar shemuel hay man deachzek berakta denahra chatzifa have salloke la mesallekinan leh vehaidana deka katvi parsae kene lach ad mele tzavvere susya mayya salloke name mesallekinan leh
Amar rav yehuda amar rav hay man deachzek bene ache uvene shuttafe chatzifa have salloke la mesallekinan leh verav nachman amar name mesallekinan vei mishshum dina devar mitzra la mesallekinan leh
Nehardae amri afilu mishshum dina devar mitzra mesallekinan leh mishshum shenneemar veasita hayyashar vehattov beene Adonai
Ata imlich beh amar leh ezil ezbon vaamar leh zil zevon tzerich lemikne mineh o la ravina amar la tzerich lemikne mineh nehardae amri tzerich lemikne mineh vehilcheta tzerich lemikne mineh
Hashta deamratte tzerich lemikne mineh i la keno mineh iyyakur vezul birshuteh
Zevan bima veshave matan chazena chazenan i lechulle alma ka mozelo umzabben yahev leh mea veshakel leh vei la yahev leh matan veshakel leh

Zevan bematan veshaveya mea sevur mina matze amar leh letakkone shaddartacha vela leauote amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe hachi amri nehardae mishshum derav nachman en onaa lekarkaot
Zabben leh geriva deara bemitza nichseh chazenan i idit hi i ziburit hi zevineh zevine
b: Vei la iarome ka maarem
Mattana let bah mishshum dina devar mitzra amar ammemar i ketav leh achraut it bah mishshum dina devar mitzra
Machar kol nechasav leechad let bah mishshum dina devar mitzra livalim harishonim let bah mishshum dina devar mitzra zevan miggoy vezabben legoy let bah mishshum dina devar mitzra
Zevan miggoy daamar leh ari avrachi lach mimmitzrach zabben legoy goy vadday lav bar veasita hayyashar vehattov hu shammote vadday meshammetinan leh ad dimkabbel aleh kol unse deate leh mechamateh
Mashkanta let bah mishshum dina devar mitzra deamar rav ashe amaru li save demata machseya may mashkanta dishchuna gabbeh may nafka minah ledina devar mitzra
Limkor berachok veligol bekarov bera veligol beyafe let bah mishshum dina devar mitzra
Lichraga velimzone velikvura let bah mishshum dina devar mitzra deamri nehardeae lichraga limzone velikvura mezabbeninan bela achrazta leishsha ulyatme ulshuttafe let bah mishshum dina devar mitzra
Shechene hair ushchene sade shechene hair kodmin
Shachen vetalmid chacham talmid chacham kodem karov vetalmid chacham talmid chacham kodem ibaya lehu shachen vekarov may ta shema tov shachen karov meach rachok
Hane zuze tave vehane zuze tekule let beh mishshum dina devar mitzra hane tzayeri vehane sheru let beh mishshum dina devar mitzra
Amar ezil veetrach veayete zuze la natrinan leh amar ezil ayete zuze chazenan i gavra daamid hu deazel umayete zuze natrinan leh vei la la natrinan leh
Ara dechad uvatte dechad mare ara meakkev ammare batte mare batte la meakkev ammare deara ara dechad vedikle dechad mare deara matze meakkev ammare dikle mare dikle la matze meakkev ammare deara
Ara levatte veara lezara yishshuv adif velet bah mishshum dina devar mitzra
Afsek meshunnita o richba dedikla chazena chazenan im yachol lehachnis bah afilu telem echad it bah mishshum dina devar mitzra vei la let bah mishshum dina devar mitzra
Hane arbaa bene mitzrane dekadem chad minayehu vezaven zevineh zevine vei kullehu atu bahade hadade palgu lah bekarnezil

a: Matni hamkabbel sade mechavero leshanim muatot lo yizraenna pishtan veen lo bekorot shikma kiblah hemennu lesheva shanim shana rishona yizraenna pishtan veyesh lo bekorot shikma
Gema amar abbaye bekorot shikma en lo bishvach shikma yesh lo verava amar afilu bishvach shikma name en lo
Metivi hamkabbel sade mechavero vehiggia zemanno latzet shamin lo may lav shamin lo bishvach shikma la shamin lo yarka vesilka
Yarka vesilka naakor venishkol bidla meta yoma deshuka
Ta shema hamkabbel sade mechavero vehiggia sheviit shamin lo sheviit mi ka mafkea ara ella ema hamkabbel sade mechavero vehiggia yovel shamin lo
Veakkatti yovel mi mafkea kabbelanut litzmitut amar rachamana ella ema hallokeach sade mechavero vehiggia yovel shamin lo
Vechi tema hachi name shamin lo beyarka vesilka silka veyarka beovel hefkera hu ella lav shevach shikma
Targemah abbaye alliba derava shane hatam deamar kera veyatza mimkar bayit mimkar chozer shevach eno chozer venigmar mineh hatam zevine mealleya hu veovel afkata demalka hi

Rav pappa kabbel ara leaspasta kedachu bah tale ki ka mistallak amar lehu havu li shevacha amar leh rav shisha bereh derav idi lerav pappa ella meatta dikla vaalem hachi name devae mar shevacheh amar leh hatam lav addata dehachi nachet ana hacha addata dehachi nechetna
Keman keabbayye deamar bishvach shikma yesh lo afilu tema kerava hatam let leh peseda hacha ika peseda

Amar leh may pesedach yeda deaspasta shekol yeda deaspasta vezil amar leh ana kurkema rishka rabbay amar leh gallet addatach dilmishkal veistalloke avadte shekol kurkema rishka vezil en lecha ella deme etzim bilvad

Rav bivi bar abbaye kabbel ara veahdar leh meshunnita kedachu beh zardata ki ka mistallak amar lehu havu li shevachay amar rav pappe mishshum deatetu mimmulae amritu mile mulyata afilu rav pappa la amar ella deit leh peseda hacha may peseda it lach

Rav yosef hava leh hahu shattala shechev ushvak chamsha chatnaota amar ad haidana chad hashta chamsha ad haidana la hao samchu ahadade vela mafsedu li hashta chamsha samchu ahadade umafsedu li amar lehu i shaklitu shevachayechu umistallekitu mutav vei la mesallekna lechu bela shevacha
Deamar rav yehuda veitema rav huna veitema rav nachman hay shattala dishchev yorshin dileh mistallekin mesallekinan lehu bela shevacha velav milta hi

Hahu shattala daamar lehu i mafsedna mistallakna afsed amar rav yehuda mistallak bela shevacha rav kahana amar mistallak veshakel shevacha umode rav kahana dei amar i mafsedna mistallakna bela shevacha mistallak bela shevacha rava amar asmachta hi veasmachta la kanya
Ulrava may shena meha ditnan im ovir vela aaved ashallem bemetva hatam may deafsed meshallem hacha may deafsed menakkenan leh veidach yahavinan leh

Runya shattala deravina hava afsed sallekeh ata lekammeh derava amar leh chazi mar may ka aved li amar leh shappir avad amar leh ha lo hitra bi amar leh la tzericha lehatrot tzerichatte leatroye rava letameh deamar rava makre dardeke shattala tabbacha veummana
b: Vesafar mata kullan kemutrin veomdin dame kelala demilta kol peseda dela hadar kemutrin veomdin dame

Hahu shattala daamar lehu havu li shevachay devaena lemisak leara deyisrael ata lekammeh derav pappa bar shemuel amar lehu havu leh shevacheh amar leh rava ihu ashbach ara la ashbach amar leh ana palga dishvacha kaamena lach amar leh ad haidana hava shakel baal habbayit palga veshattala palga hashta bae lemitav menata laarisa amar leh riva dishvacha kaamena

Sevar rav ashe lememar riva dehu danka deamar rav minome bereh derav nechumi beatra deshakel shattala palga vaarisa tilta hay shattala devae leistalloke yahavinan leh shevacha umsallekinan leh ki hechi dela nimteyeh hefsed levaal habbayit
I amratte bishlama riva dehu danka shappir ella i amratte riva mammash ka mate leh peseda levaal habbayit palga danka
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe velema leh ante menata dilach hav leh laarisa vaana menata dili may devaena avedna beh amar ki matet lishchitat kodashim ta veakshi li

Gufa amar rav minome bereh derav nechumi beatra deshakel shattala palga vaarisa tilta hay shattala devae istalloke yahavinan leh shevacheh umsallekinan leh ki hechi dela lifsod baal habbayit amar rav minome bereh derav nechumi kofa sava palga shatfah nahara riva
Hahu gavra demashken pardesa lechavreh laasar shenin vekash lachamesh shenin abbaye amar pera have rava amar karna have veyillakach bo karka vehu ochel perot

Metivi yavash hailan o niktzatz shenehem asurim bo ketzad yaasu yimmachru leetzim veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot may lav yavash dumya deniktzatz ma niktzatz bizmanno af yavash bizmanno vekatane yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot alma karna have
La niktzatz dumya deyavash ma yavash belo zemanno af niktzatz belo zemanno
Ta shema naflu lah gefanim vezetim zekenim

a: Yimmachru leetzim veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot ema vehizkinu
Veibaet ema lav mi okemna lehahi kegon shennaflu lah besade acheret deka chalya karna

Hahu shetara dahava ketiv beh shenin setama malve amar shalosh love amar shettayim kedem malve veachlinhu lefere mi neeman rav yehuda amar karka bechezkat bealeha kayema rav kahana amar perot bechezkat ochlehen kayemi
Vehilcheta keoteh derav kahana deamar perot bechezkat ochlehen kayemi veha kayema lan dehilcheta keoteh derav nachman deamar karka bechezkat bealeha omedet
Hatam milta dela avida leigalloye hi hacha milta daavida leigalloye hi veatroche be dina tere zimne la matrechinan
Malve omer chamesh love omer shalosh amar leh ayeti li shetarach amar leh shetara irchas li amar rav yehuda malve neeman miggo dei bae amar lekucha hi beyadi

Amar leh rav pappa lerav ashe rav zevid verav avira la sevira lehu ha derav yehuda may tama hay shetara kevan dilguvyana kae mizhar zehir beh umichbash hu dechavsheh lishtareh savar ochlah tarten shenin yattirta

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ella meatta hay mashkanta desura dechatvi hachi bemishlam shenayya illen tipok ara da bela kesaf hecha dechavsheh lishtar mashkanta veamar lekucha hi beyadi hachi name dimheman vechi metakkeni rabbanan milta deate bah lide peseda amar leh hatam takkinu le rabbanan demare ara yahev taska vechare karya
Ara delet lah karya vela yahev taska may amar leh ibi leh lemachoye la imcha machi may ihu hu deafsed annafsheh
Aris omer lemechetza yaradti uvaal habbayit omer lishlish horadtiv mi neeman rav yehuda amar baal habbayit neeman rav nachman amar hakkol keminhag hammedina
Sevur minah la peligi ha beatra deshakel arisa palga ha beatra deshakel arisa tilta
Amar lehu rav mari berah devat shemuel hachi amar abbaye afilu beatra deshakel arisa palga peligi rav yehuda amar baal habbayit neeman dei bae amar sechiri ulkiti hu
Yetomim omrim anu hishbachnu uvaal chov omer avichem hishbiach al mi lehavi reaya
b: Savar rabbi chanina lememar ara bechezkat yatme kayema veal baal chov lehavi reaya amar lehu hahu sava hachi amar rabbi yochanan al hayetomim lehavi reaya may tama ara kevan dilguvyana kayema keman degavya damya veal hayetomin lehavi reaya
Amar abbaye af anan name tenena safek ze kadam vesafek ze kadam kotzetz veeno noten damim
Alma kevan dilmikatz kayema amrinan leh ayeti reaya ushkol hachi name hay shetara kevan dilguvyana kayema keman degavya damya veal hayetomim lehavi reaya
Ayeto yatme reaya deinhu ashbachu savar rabbi chanina lememar ki mesallekinan lehu beara mesallekinan lehu
Vela hi bidme mesallekinan lehu midderav nachman deamar rav nachman amar shemuel shelosha shamin lahem et hashshevach umaalin otan bedamim veellu hen bechor lefashut
Uvaal chov uchtubbat ishsha litomim uvaal chov lelakochot

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe lememra desavar shemuel baal chov lelakochot umay it leh shevacha lelokeach vehaamar shemuel baal chov gove et hashshevach vechi tema la kashya kan beshevach hammaggia lichtefayim kan beshevach sheen maggia lakketefayim veha maasim bechol yom veka magbe shemuel afilu beshevach hammaggia lichtefayim
La kashya ha demassek beh keshiur ara ushvacha ha dela massek beh shiur ara ushvacha

Vechi la massek shiur ara ushvacha deyahev leh zuze lelokeach umsallek leh hanicha leman deamar i it leh zuze lelokeach la matze mesallek leh levaal chov shappir ella leman deamar it leh zuze lelokeach matze mesallek leh levaal chov venema leh i hao li zuze hava mesallekna lach mikkulla ara hashta delet li zuze hav li geriva deara bearay shiur shevachay
Hacha bemay askinan kegon deshavveya nihaleh appoteke daamar leh lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizzo
Matni hamkabbel sade mechavero leshavua echad bishva meot zuz hashsheviit min hamminyan kibbelah hemennu sheva shanim bishva meot zuz en hashsheviit min hamminyan

Sechir yom gove kol hallayela sechir layela gove kol hayyom sechir shaot gove kol hallayela vechol hayyom sechir shabbat sechir chodesh sechir shana sechir shavua yatza bayyom gove kol hayyom yatza ballayela gove kol hallayela vechol hayyom
Gema tanu rabbanan minnayin lischir yom sheggove kol hallayela talmud lomar lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker uminnayin lischir layela sheggove kol hayyom shenneemar beomo titten secharo
Veema ipcha sechirut enah mishtallemet ella bassof
Tanu rabbanan mimmashma shenneemar lo talin peullat sachir ittecha eni yodea shead boker ma talmud lomar ad boker melammed sheeno over ella ad boker rishon bilvad
Mikkan veelach may amar rav over mishshum bal teshahe amar rav yosef may keraa al tomar lereacha lech vashuv umachar etten veyesh ittach
Tanu rabbanan haomer lachavero tze sechor li poalim shenehen en ovrin mishshum bal talin ze lefi shello secharan

a: Veze lefi sheen peullato etzlo hechi dame i daamar lehu secharchem alay secharo alav hu detanya hassocher et happoel laasot beshello veherahu beshel chavero noten lo secharo mishshalem vechozer venotel mibbaal habbayit ma shehehena oto
La tzericha daamar lehu secharchem al baal habbayit
Yehuda bar marimar amar leh leshammaeh zil egor li poalim veema lehu secharchem al baal habbayit marimar umar zutra agri lahadade
Amar rabba bar rav huna hane shukae desura la avri mishshum bal talin mida yadi deal yoma deshuka semichi aval mishshum bal teshahe vadday over

Sechir shaot gove kol hallayela vechol hayyom amar rav sechir shaot deom gove kol hayyom sechir shaot delayela gove kol hallayela ushmuel amar sechir shaot deom gove kol hayyom uschir shaot delayela gove kol hallayela vechol hayyom
Tenan sechir shaot gove kol hallayela vechol hayyom teuvta derav amar lecha rav litzdadin katane sechir shaot deom gove kol hayyom sechir shaot delayela gove kol hallayela
Tenan haya sechir shabbat sechir chodesh sechir shana sechir shavua yotze bayyom gove kol hayyom yotze ballayela gove kol hallayela vechol hayyom

Amar lecha rav tannae hi detanya sechir shaot deom gove kol hayyom sechir shaot delayela gove kol hallayela divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer sechir shaot deom gove kol hayyom sechir shaot delayela gove kol hallayela vechol hayyom

Mikkan amru kol hakkovesh sechar sachir over bachamishsha shemot hallalu vaase mishshum bal taashok et reacha umishshum bal tigzol umishshum bal taashok sachir ani umishshum bal talin umishshum beomo titten secharo umishshum lo tavo alav hashshemesh
Hane deika bimama leka belelya deika belelya leka bimama amar rav chisda shem sechirut bealma
Eze hu oshek veezehu gazel amar rav chisda lech vashuv lech vashuv ze hu oshek yesh lecha beyadi veeni noten lecha ze hu gazel
Matkef lah rav sheshet ezehu oshek shechiyeva alav tora korban dumya defikkadon deka chafar leh mamona ella amar rav sheshet netattiv lach zehu oshek yesh lecha beyadi veeni noten lach ze hu gazel
Matkef lah abbaye eze hu gazel shechiyeva alav tora korban dumya defikkadon baenan deka chafar leh mamona ella amar abbaye lo secharticha meolam ze hu oshek netattiv lach ze hu gazel
Ulrav sheshet may shena oshek dekashya leh umay shena gazel dela kashya leh amar lach gazel degazleh vahadar kafreh
I hachi afilu oshek name dahadar kafreh hachi hashta bishlama hatam ketiv o vegazel mikkelal deodi leh meikara aval gabbe oshek mi ketiv o veoshek o ashak ketiv sheashako kevar
Rava amar ze hu oshek zehu gazel velamma chillekan hakkatuv laavor alav bishne lavin

Matni echad sechar adam veechad sechar behema veechad sechar kelim yesh bo mishshum beomo titten secharo veyesh bo mishshum lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker ematay bizman shettevao lo tevao eno over alav himchahu etzel chenvani o etzel shulchani eno over alav
Sachir bizmanno nishba venotel avar zemanno eno nishba venotel im yesh edim shettevao bizmanno hare ze nishba venotel
Ger toshav yesh bo mishshum beomo titten secharo veen bo mishshum lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker
Gema manni matnitin la tanna kamma demeachecha vela rabbi yose berabbi yehuda may hi detanya
b: Meachecha perat laacherim gercha ze ger tzedek bisharecha ze ochel nevelot
En li ella sechar adam minnayin lerabbot behema vechelim talmud lomar beartzecha kol shebbeartzecha vechullan ovrim bechol hashshemot hallalu

Mikkan amru echad sechar adam veechad sechar behema veechad sechar kelim yesh bo mishshum beomo titten secharo veyesh bahen mishshum bal talin peullat sachir rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer ger toshav yesh bo mishshum beomo titten secharo veen bo mishshum lo talin behema vechelim en bahen ella mishshum bal taashok bilvad
Manni i tanna kamma demeachecha kashya ger toshav i rabbi yose kashya behema vechelim

Amar rava hay tanna tanna deve rabbi yishmael hu detana deve rabbi yishmael echad sechar adam veechad sechar behema veechad sechar kelim yesh bo mishshum beomo titten secharo umishshum lo talin ger toshav yesh bo mishshum beomo titten secharo veen bo mishshum bal talin
May tama detanna kamma demeachecha gamar sachir sachir verabbi yose berabbi yehuda la gamar sachir sachir

Nehi dela gamar sachir sachir behema vechelim mishshum beomo titten secharo name nichayyav tane rabbi chananya amar kera velo tavo alav hashshemesh ki ani hu mi shehen bain lide aniyyut vaashirut yatzu behema vechelim sheenan bain lide aniyyut vaashirut
Vetanna kamma hay ki ani hu may aved leh hahu mibe lehakdim ani leashir verabbi yose berabbi yehuda hahu millo taashok sachir ani veevon nafka
Vetanna kamma chad lehakdim ani leashir vechad lehakdim ani leevon
Utzricha dei ashmeinan evon mishshum dela kesif lemitbeeh aval ashir dichsif lemitbeeh ema la vei ashmeinan ashir mishshum dela tzerich leh aval evon ditzrich leh ema la tzericha
Vetanna didan ma nafshach i yalef sachir sachir afilu ger toshav name i la yalef sachir sachir behema vechelim mena leh
Leolam la yalef sachir sachir veshane hatam deamar kera velo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker kol sheppeullato ittecha i hachi afilu ger toshav name amar kera reacha reacha velo ger toshav

I hachi afilu behema vechelim name ha ketiv ittecha ma raita lerabbot behema vechelim ulhotzi ger toshav mistabbera behema vechelim hava leh lerabbot shekken yeshnan bichlal mamon reacha ger toshav eno bichlal mamon reacha
Vetanna kamma demeachecha ver yose ber yehuda hay reacha may avdi leh hahu mibe leh lechidtanya reacha velo goy goy meachecha nafka

Chad lemishre oshko vechad lemishre gezelo veka savar gezel goy muttar utzrichi dei ashmeinan gezelo mishshum dela tarach beh aval oshko detarach beh ema la vei ashmeinan oshko mishshum dela ata lideh aval gezelo daata lideh ema la tzericha

Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda hay lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker may aved leh mibaya leh lechidrav assi deamar rav assi afilu lo secharo ella livtzor lo eshkol echad shel anavim over mishshum bal talin
Veidach miveelav hu nose et nafsho nafka davar hammoser nafsho alav

a: Veidach hahu mibe leh lechidtanya veelav hu nose et nafsho mippene ma ala ze bakkevesh venitla bailan umasar et atzmo lemita lo al secharo
Davar acher veelav hu nose et nafsho kal hakkovesh sechar sachir keilu notel nafsho mimmennu rav huna verav chisda chad amar nafsho shel gazlan vechad amar nafsho shel nigzal

Man deamar nafsho shel gazlan dichtiv al tigzol dal ki dal hu veal tedakke ani vashshaar uchtiv ki Adonai yariv rivam vekava et kovehem nafesh uman deamar nafsho shel nigzal dichtiv ken orchot kol botzea batza et nefesh bealav yikkach
Veidach name hachtiv et nefesh bealav yikkach bealav dehashta veidach name hachtiv vekava et kovehem nafesh ma taam kaamar ma taam kava et kovehem mishshum denatlu nafesh
Ematay bizman shettevao lo tevao eno over alav tanu rabbanan lo talin peullat sachir yachol afilu lo tevao talmud lomar ittecha ledatecha
Yachol afilu en lo talmud lomar ittecha sheyyesh ittecha yachol afilu himchahu etzel chenvani veetzel shulchani talmud lomar ittecha velo shehimchahu etzel chenvani veetzel shulchani
Himchahu etzel chenvani veetzel shulchani eno over ibaya lehu chozer o eno chozer rav sheshet amar eno chozer verabba amar chozer
Amar rabba mena amena lah middekatane eno over alav mibar hu dela avar ha mihdar hadar verav sheshet amar may eno over eno betorat laavor
Beo mineh merav sheshet kabbelanut over alav mishshum bal talin o en over mishshum bal talin
Umman kone bishvach keli vehalvaa hi o en umman kone bishvach keli uschirut hi
Amar lehu rav sheshet over vehatanya eno over hatam shehimchahu etzel chenvani veetzel shulchani
Nema mesayea leh hannoten tallito leumman gemarah vehodio afilu mikkan vead asara yamim eno over mishshum bal talin netanah lo bachatzi hayyom mishsheshshaka alav chamma over mishshum bal talin
Vei amratte umman kone bishvach keli ammay over
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana bigrada desarbala lemay yahaveh nihaleh lerakkoche hayenu shevacheh
La tzericha deka agreh mineh levattoshe bitsha uvitsha bemaata
b: Sachir bizmanno nishba venotel vechu sachir ammay takkinu le rabbanan lemishteva demishteva veshakel
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halachot gedolot shanu kan hane hilcheta ninhu hane takkanot ninhu ella amar rav yehuda amar shemuel takkanot gedolot shanu kan gedolot mikkelal deika ketannot

Ella amar rav nachman amar shemuel takkanot kevuot shanu kan shevua devaal habbayit hi veakruha rabbanan lishvua devaal habbayit veshaduha assachir mishshum kede chayyav desachir umishshum kede chayyav desachir mafsedna mafsedinan leh levaal habbayit

Baal habbayit gufeh nicha leh demishteva sachir veshakel ki hechi delitagru leh poalim sachir gufeh nicha leh demishteva baal habbayit venifka ki hechi deligruh baal habbayit al kurcheh agar sachir name beal kurcheh itgar
Ella baal habbayit tarud befoalim hu i hachi nitev leh bela shevua kede lehafis dato shel baal habbayit
Venitev leh beedim tericha lehu milta venitev leh meikara shenehem rotzim behakkafa
I hachi afilu katzatz name allema tanya umman omer shettayim katzatzta li vehalla omer lo katzatzti lecha ella achat hammotzi mechavero alav haraya ketzitza vadday midkar dechiri lah inashe
I hachi afilu avar zemanno name allema tenan avar zemanno eno nishba venotel chazaka en baal habbayit over mishshum bal talin
Veha amratte baal habbayit tarud befoalav hu hane mile mikkamme delimteyeh zeman chiyyuveh

a: Aval meta zeman chiyyuveh rame annafsheh umidchar

Vechi sachir over mishshum bal tigzol hatam tere chazake hacha chada chazaka gabbe baal habbayit ika tere chazake chada deen baal habbayit over mishshum bal talin vachada deen sachir meshahe secharo vehacha chada chazaka
Im yesh edim shettevao hare ze nishba venotel veha katavo lekamman ka tava leh kamman amar rabbi assi shettevao bizmanno vedilma levatar hachi pera amar abbaye shettevao kal zemanno
Ulolam la para leh amar rav chama bar ukva keneged oto hayyom shel tevia
Matni hammalve et chavero lo yemashkenennu ella bevet din velo yikkanes leveto litol mashkono shenneemar bachutz taamod hau lo shene chelim notel echad umanniach echad

Umachzir et hakkar ballayela veet hammachresha bayyom veim met eno machzir leorshav rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af leatzmo eno machzir ella ad sheloshim yom umishsheloshim yom ulhallan mochran bevet din
Gema amar shemuel sheliach bet din menattach nattoche in aval mashkone la vehatnan hammalve et chavero lo yemashkenennu ella bevet din mikkelal divvet din memashkenin
Amar lach shemuel ema lo yenattechennu ella bevet din hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa lo yikkanes leveto litol mashkono manni ilema baal chov meresha shamatte minah ella lav sheliach bet din
I mishshum ha la irya hachi kaamar hammalve et chavero lo yemashkenennu ella bevet din mikkelal divvet din memashkenim uvaal chov afilu nattoche name la shello yikkanes leveto litol mashkono

Metiv rav yosef la yachavol rechayim varachev ha devarim acherim chavol lo tachavol beged almana ha shel acherim tachbol man i nema baal chov ha ketiv lo tavo el beto laavot avoto ella lav sheliach bet din
Targemah rav pappa bereh derav nachman kammeh derav yosef veamri lah rav pappa bereh derav yosef kammeh derav yosef leolam bevaal chov velaavor alav bishne lavin
Ta shema mimmashma shenneemar bachutz taamod eni yodea shehaish asher atta noshe vo yotzi ella ma talmud lomar vehaish lerabbot sheliach bet din may lav sheliach bet din kelove
b: La sheliach bet din kemalve

Ta shema im chavol tachbol salmat reecha bishliach bet din hakkatuv medabber atta omer bishliach bet din hakkatuv medabber o eno ella bevaal chov keshehu omer lo tavo el beto laavot avoto hare baal chov amur ha ma ani mekayyem im chavol tachbol salmat reecha bishliach bet din hakkatuv medabber
Tannae hi detanya sheliach bet din shebba lemashkeno lo yikkanes leveto lemashkeno ella omed mibbachutz vehalla motzi lo mashkon shenneemar bachutz taamod vehaish

Vetanya idach baal chov shebba lemashkeno lo yikkanes leveto lemashkeno ella omed bachutz vehalla nichnas umotzi lo mashkono shenneemar bachutz taamod ushliach bet din shebba lemashkeno hare ze nichnas leveto ummashkeno
Velo yemashkenennu devarim sheosin bahen ochel nefesh venoten mitta umitta umatztza leashir mitta umitta umappatz leani lo aval lo leishto velo levanav velivnotav
Kederech shemmesadderin levaal chov kach mesadderin baarachin kelappe leya ikar sidur baarachin ketiv ella ema kederech shemmesadderin baarachin kach mesadderin bevaal chov
Amar mar noten mitta umitta umatztza leashir mitta umitta umappatz leani leman ilema leishto ulvanav velivnotav ha amratte lo aval lo leishto ulvanav velivnotav ella ide veide ledideh

Tarte lema li chada deachel alah vachada dezag alah kedishmuel deamar shemuel kol mile yadana asutayehu levar mehane telat man deachel ahina merira alliba rekana man deasar mitna dechitana rattiva achartzeh uman deachel nahama vela mesagge arbea garmide

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman kederech shemmesadderin baarachin kach mesadderin bevaal chov amar leh hashta zabbone mezabbeninan leh saddore mesadderinan leh umi mezabbeninan leh vehatnan machzir et hakkar ballayela veet hammachresha bayyom

Tanna kerabban shimon ben gamliel tanna kammeh vehachi kaamar leh hashta lerabban shimon ben gamliel zabbone mezabbeninan leh saddore mesadderinan leh ditnan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af leatzmo eno machzir ella ad sheloshim yom mikkan veelach mochran bevet din
Umimmay dechi kaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel zabbone ligmare kaamar dilma hachi kaamar ad sheloshim yom mahdar leh beeneh mikkan veelach mahdar leh lemay dachaze leh umzabbeninan may dela chaze leh

I salka datach it leh lerabban shimon ben gamliel hay sevara leka mide dela chaze leh deamar abbaye rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi shimon verabbi yishmael verabbi akiva kullehu sevira lehu kol yisrael bene melachim hen
Rabban shimon ben gamliel ditnan lo et halluf vela et hachardal rabban shimon ben gamliel mattir balluf mippene shehu maachal leorvin
Rabbi shimon ditnan bene melachim sachin shemen vered al gabbe makkotehen beshabbat shekken darkan lasuch bachol rabbi shimon omer kol yisrael bene melachim hen

Rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva detanya hare shehau noshin bo elef zuz velavush itztela bat mea mane mafshitin otah mimmennu umalbishim oto itztela haruya lo vetana mishshum rabbi yishmael vetana mishshum rabbi akiva kol yisrael reuyin leotah itztela
Ulmay dislek addatin meikara deyahev leh may dachaze leh umzabbeninan may dela chaze leh bishlama kar vacheset chaze leh devene bene ella machresha lemay chazya amar rava bar rabba machresha dechaspa
Matkef lah rav chagga velema leh lav alay karmet amar leh abbaye

a: Ivra aleh karme mishshum shenneemar ulcha tihye tzedaka
Ibaya lehu mahu sheyesadderu bevaal chov mi gamar micha micha mearachin o la
Ta shema dishlach ravin beiggarteh davar ze shaalti lechol rabbotay velo amru li davar beram kach hayeta sheela haomer hare alay mane levedek habbayit mahu sheyesadderu

Rabbi yaakov mishshemeh devar padda verabbi yirmeya mishshemeh deilfa amri kal vachomer mibbaal chov uma baal chov shemmachzirin en mesadderin hekdesh sheen machzirin eno din sheen mesadderin verabbi yochanan amar neder beerkecha ketiv ma arachin mesadderin af hekdesh mesadderin
Veidach hahu lenidon bichvodo hu daata ma arachin nidon bichvodo af hekdesh nidon bichvodo
Visadderu bevaal chov kal vachomer mearachin uma arachin sheen machzirin mesadderin baal chov shemmachzirin eno din shemmesadderin amar kera veim mach hu meerkecha hu velo baal chov
Veidach hay ad sheyehe bemachuto mittechilato vead sofo

Veyachziru behekdesh kal vachomer mibbaal chov uma baal chov sheen mesadderin machzirin hekdesh shemmesadderin eno din shemmachzirin amar kera veshachav besalmato uverchekka yatza hekdesh sheen tzarich beracha
Vela vehachtiv veachalta vesavata uverachta vego ella amar kera ulcha tihye tzedaka mi shetztzarich tzedaka yatza hekdesh sheen tzarich tzedaka

Ashkecheh rabba bar avuh leeliyyahu dekae bevet hakkevarot shel goyim amar leh mahu sheyesadderu bevaal chov amar leh gamar micha micha mearachin gabbe arachin ketiv veim mach hu meerkecha gabbe baal chov ketiv vechi yamuch achicha
b: Minnayin learom shello yitrom dichtiv velo yire vecha ervat davar

Amar leh lav kohen hu mar may tama kae mar bevet hakkevarot amar leh la matne mar teharot detanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer kivrehen shel nochrim en metammein shenneemar veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem attem keruyin adam veen nochrim keruyin adam
Amar leh bearbea la matzena beshita matzena amar leh veammay amar leh dechika li milta davreh veayeleh legan eden amar leh peshot gelimach sefi shekol mehane tarfe sefa shekal
Ki hava nafek shema dekaamar man ka achel lealmeh kerabba bar avuh nefatz shedanhu afilu hachi atyeh liglimeh sechat gelima recha zabbeneh bitresar alfe dinare palginhu lechatnaoteh
Tanu rabbanan veim ish ani hu lo tishkav baavoto ha ashir shechav may kaamar amar rav sheshet hachi kaamar veim ish ani hu lo tishkav vaavoto etzlecha ha ashir shechav vaavoto etzlecha

Tanu rabbanan hammalve et chavero eno rashshay lemashkeno veeno chayyav lehachzir lo veover bechol hashshemot hallalu may kaamar amar rav sheshet hachi kaamar hammalve et chavero eno rashshay lemashkeno veim mishkeno chayyav lehachzir lo veover bechol hashshemot hallalu assefa

Rava amar hachi kaamar hammalve et chavero eno rashshay lemashkeno veim mishkeno chayyav lehachzir lo bamme devarim amurim shemmishkeno shello bishat halvaato aval mishkeno bishat halvaato eno chayyav lehachzir lo veover bechol hashshemot hallalu aresha
Tane rav shezvi kammeh derava ad bo hashshemesh teshivennu lo zo kesut layela hashev tashiv lo et haavot kevo hashshemesh zo kesut yom amar leh dimama belelya lema li udlelya bimama lema li

Amar leh ismeyah amar leh la hachi kaamar ad bo hashshemesh teshivennu lo zo kesut yom shennitna lachavol ballayela hashev tashiv lo et haavot kevo hashshemesh zo kesut layela shennitna lachavol bayyom
Amar rabbi yochanan mishkeno umet shomto meal gabbe vanav metivi amar rabbi meir vechi meachar shemmemashkenin lamma machzirin lamma machzirin rachamana amar ahdar ella meachar shemmachzirin

a: Lamma chozrin ummashkenin shello tehe sheviit meshammatto velo yease mittaltelin etzel banav
Tama dahadar umashkeneh ha la hadar umashkeneh la
Amar rav adda bar matna velav tarotze ka metartzatte lah taretz hachi vechi meachar shemmachzirin lamma memashkenin meikara shello tehe sheviit meshammatto velo yease mittaltelin etzel banav
Tanu rabbanan lo tavo el beto laavot avoto leveto i atta nichnas aval atta nichnas leveto shel arev vechen hu omer lekach bigdo ki arav zar vego
Veomer beni im aravta lereecha takata lazzar kappecha nokashta veimre ficha nilkadta beimre ficha ase zot efo beni vehinnatzel ki vata vechaf reecha lech hitrappes urhav reecha
Im mamon yesh lo beyadecha hatter lo pisat yad veim lav harbe alav reim
Letzad sheni leveto i atta nichnas aval atta nichnas lischar kattaf lischar chammar lischar pundak lischar deoknaot yachol afilu zekafan alav bemilve talmud lomar mashshat meuma
Matni almana ben shehi aniyya ben shehi ashira en memashkenin otah shenneemar velo tachavol beged almana
Gema tanu rabbanan almana ben shehi aniyya ben shehi ashira en memashkenin otah divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi shimon omer ashira memashkenin otah aniyya en memashkenin otah sheatta chayyav lehachazir lah veatta massiah shem ra bishchenoteha
Lememra derabbi yehuda la daresh tama dikra verabbi shimon daresh tama dikra veha ipcha shaminan lehu

Detanya velo yarbe lo nashim rabbi yehuda omer marbe hu uvilvad shello yehu mesirot et libbo rabbi shimon omer afilu achat vehi mesira et libbo hare ze lo yissaenna im ken ma talmud lomar velo yarbe lo nashim afilu kaavigayil
Leolam rabbi yehuda la daresh tama dikra veshane hacha dimfaresh kera velo yarbe lo nashim velo yasur may tama lo yarbe lo nashim mishshum delo yasur

Verabbi shimon mikkede bealma darshinan tama dikra lichtov rachamana lo yarbe vela baenan lo yasur vaana yadana may tama lo yarbe mishshum delo yasur lo yasur dichtav rachamana lema li afilu achat umsira et libbo hare ze lo yissaenna

Matni hachovel et harechayim over mishshum lo taase vechayyav mishshum shene kelim shenneemar lo yachavol rechayim varachev velo rechayim varechev bilvad amru ella kol davar sheosin bo ochel nefesh shenneemar ki nefesh hu chovel
Gema amar rav huna chaval rechayim loke shettayim mishshum rechayim umishshum ki nefesh hu chovel rechayim varechev loke shalosh mishshum rechayim varechev umishshum ki nefesh hu chovel
Verav yehuda amar chaval rechayim loke achat verechev loke achat rechayim varechev loke shettayim ki nefesh hu chovel
b: Lishar devarim hu daata
Lema abbaye verava biflugta derav huna verav yehuda kamipalgi

Deamar rava achal na loke shettayim mishshum na umishshum ki im tzeli esh mevushshal loke shettayim mishshum mevushshal umishshum ki im tzeli esh na umvushshal loke shalosh mishshum na umishshum mevushshal umishshum lo tochlennu ki im tzeli esh
Abbaye amar en lokin al lav shebbichlalot lema abbaye deamar kerav yehuda verava deamar kerav huna
Amar lach rava ana daamari afilu kerav yehuda ad kan la kaamar rav yehuda hatam ella dechi nefesh hu chovel la mashma rechayim varechev hilkach lishar devarim hu daata
Aval hacha ki im tzeli esh lemay ata shema minah lelav
Veabbaye amar lach ana daamari afilu lerav huna ad kan la kaamar rav huna hatam ella dechi nefesh hu chovel

a: Yattira hu kevan deyattira hu shidyeh arechayim varachev
Aval hacha ki im tzeli esh lav yattira hu demibbee leh lechidtanya beshaa sheyyeshno bekum echol tzali yeshno beval tochal na beshaa sheeno bekum echol tzali eno beval tochal na
Tanya keoteh derav yehuda chaval zug shel sapparim vetzemed shel parot chayyav shettayim ze beatzmo veze beatzmo eno chayyav ella achat

Vetanya idach chaval zug shel sapparim vetzemed shel parot yachol lo yehe chayyav ella achat talmud lomar lo yachavol rechayim varachev ma rechayim varechev shehen meuchadin shene kelim veosin melacha achat vechayyav al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo af kol devarim shehen shene kelim meuchadim veosin melacha achat chayyav al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo

Hahu gavra dachaval sakkina deashkavta mechavreh ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh zil ahdereh dehave leh keli sheosim bo ochel nefesh veta kum bedina aleh rava amar la tzerich lemekam bedina aleh veyachol liton ad kede demehen
Veabbaye let leh hahi sevara may shena mehanhu ize deachli chushla binhardea vaata mara dechushla utfas lehu veka taen tuva vaamar avuh dishmuel yachol liton ad kede demehen
Hatam lav mide daavida daavid leoshole ulogore hu hacha mide daavid leoshole ulogore hu dishlach rav huna bar avin devarim haasuyin lehashil ulhaskir veamar lekuchin hen beyadi eno neeman
Verava let leh hay sevara veha rava appek zuga desarbala vesifra deaggadta miyyatme bidvarim haasuyin lehashil ulhaskir amar lach rava hay name kevan demipagma kafdi inashe vela moshli
Hadaran alach hamkabbel
b: Matni habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim shennaflu shenehem cholkin baetzim uvaavanim uveafar veroin ellu avanim haasuot lehishtabber im haya echad mehen makkir miktzat avanav notlan veolot lo min hacheshbon
Gema middekatane roin mikkelal deika lemekam alayehu i bechavsa nefil i bechavta nefil
I hachi resha ammay cholkin nechze i bechavta nefil illayata itvur i bechavsa nefil tattayata itvur
La tzericha dinfil belelya velechzinhu betzafra defanninhu velichze man panninhu ulshayeleh defanninhu bene reshut harabbim vaazalu lealma
Velichze birshuta deman yatvan velihve idach hammotzi mechavero alav haraya la tzericha deyatvan bechatzer detarvayehu i name birshut harabbim veibaet ema shuttafin bechi hay gavena la kafdi ahadade
Im haya echad mehen makkir ku vehalla ma toen i dekaamar in peshita vei la amar in lamma notel ella deamar leh eni yodea
Lema tihve teuvta derav nachman deitmar mane li beyadcha vehalla omer eni yodea rav huna verav yehuda amri chayyav rav nachman verabbi yochanan amri patur
Kidamar rav nachman kegon sheyyesh esek shevua benehen hacha name kegon sheyyesh esek shevua benehen
Hechi dame esek shevua kidrava deamar rava mane li beyadcha vehalla omer en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim vehashshear eni yodea mittoch sheeno yachol lishava yeshallem
Veolot lo min hacheshbon savar rava lememar lefi cheshbon shevurot alma kevan deamar eni yodea ria tefe
Amar leh abbaye adderabba ha ria tefe middehane yada tefe la yada tu let leh veidach kullehu dehayech ninhu
Ella amar abbaye lefi cheshbon shelemot i hachi may kamhanne leh lemalbena ravecha i name tina dimabbeda
Matni habbayit vehaaliyya nifchata haaliyya veen baal habbayit rotze letakken hare baal haaliyya yored vedar lematta ad sheyetakken lo et haaliyya
Rabbi yose omer hattachton noten et hattikra vehaelon et hammaaziva
Gema nifchata bechamma rav amar berubbah ushmuel amar bearbaa
Rav amar berubbah aval bearbaa lo adam dar chetzo lematta vechetzo lemala ushmuel amar bearbaa en adam dar chetzo lematta vechetzo lemala
Hechi dame i deamar aliyya zo azada ella daamar leh aliyya setam logar leh achariti
Amar rava la tzericha daamar leh aliyya zo sheani maskir lach ki salka selek bahadah vechi nachata chut bahadah i hachi may lememra
Ella amar rav ashe daamar leh aliyya zo sheal gabbe bayit ze ani maskir lach deha shabed bayit laaliyya

Vechi ha deamar ravin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak maase beechad sheamar lachavero dalit sheal gabbe parsek ze ani mocher lach veneekar happarsek uva maase lifne rabbi chiyya veamar chayyav atta lehaamid lo parsek kol zeman shehaddalit kayyemet
Bae rabbi abba bar memel

a: Keshehu dar levaddo hu dar kidmeikara o dilma shenehem darin daamar leh addata leappokinan la ogari lach

Im timtza lomar shenehem darin bo keshehu mishtammesh derech petachim mishtammesh o derech gaggin mishtammesh mi amar kidmeikara ma meikara derech gaggin hashta name derech gaggin o dilma matze amar leh aliyya kabbeli alay aliyya virida la kabbeli alay
Im timtza lomar matze amar leh aliyya virida la kabbeli alay shette aliyyot zo al gav zo mahu ipchit elona nachet vedar betachtona ipchit tachtona mahu lemislak ligmare beelona
Mi amrinan daamar leh shem aliyya kabbelt alach o dilma chad aliyya kabbel aleh shette aliyyot la kabbel aleh teku
Rabbi yose omer hattachton noten et hattikra ku may tikra rabbi yose bar chanina amar kinim usnain veustini amar rabbi shimon ben lakish leochim vela peligi mar ki atreh umar ki atreh

Hanhu be tere dahao dayeri chad ilay vechad tattay ipchit maaziva ki mashe mayya ilay azli umazzeki letattay mi metakken rabbi chiyya bar abba amar haelon metakken verabbi ilay mishshum rabbi chiyya berabbi yose amar hattachton metakken vesiman veosef hurad mitzrayema

Lema rabbi chiyya bar abba verabbi ilay biflugta derabbi yose verabbanan kamipalgi leman deamar haelon metakken kasavar al hammazzik leharchik et atzmo min hannizak uman deamar tachton metakken kasavar al hannizak leharchik et atzmo min hammazzik

Vetisbera rabbi yose verabbanan leinyan nezakin peligi veha ipcha shaminan lehu ditnan marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma uvecharuv uvashshikma chamishshim amma ben millemala ben min hatztzad im habbor kadam kotzetz venoten damim im hailan kadam lo yakotz safek ze kadam safek ze kadam lo yakotz

Rabbi yose omer af al pi shehabbor kodemet lailan lo yakotz shezze chofer betoch shello veze notea betoch shello alma rabbi yose savar al hannizak leharchik et atzmo verabbanan savri al hammazzik leharchik et atzmo
Ella i ika lememar peligi biflugta derabbi yose verabbanan dehatam kamipalgi

Verabbi yose verabbanan dehacha bemay peligi bechozek tikra kamipalgi rabbanan savri maaziva achzoke tikra hu veachzoke tikra al hattachton bae leachzoke verabbi yose savar maaziva ashoye gummot hu veashoye gummot al haelon leashoye
Ini vehaamar rav ashe ki havena be rav kahana hava amrinan mode rabbi yose begire dileh
Defaski mayya vahadar nafli
Matni habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim shennaflu amar baal haaliyya levaal habbayit livnot vehu eno rotze livnot hare baal haaliyya bone et habbayit vedar betochah ad sheyyitten lo et yetziotav
Rabbi yehuda omer af ze dar betoch shel chavero tzarich lehaalot lo sachar ella baal haaliyya bone et habbayit veet haaliyya umkare et haelona veoshev babbayit ad sheyyitten lo et yetziotav
b: Gema amar rabbi yochanan bishlosha mekomot shana lanu rabbi yehuda asur leadam sheyyehane mimmamon chavero chada ha ditnan

Idach ma hi ditnan hannoten tzemer latzabba litzboa lo adom utzvao shachor shachor utzvao adom rabbi meir omer noten lo deme tzamro rabbi yehuda omer im hashshevach yoter al hahotzaa noten lo hayetzia veim hahotzaa yetera al hashshevach noten lo et hashshevach

Veidach may hi ditnan mi sheppara miktzat chovo vehishlish et shetaro veamar lo im en ani noten lecha mikkan vead zeman peloni ten lo shetaro higgia zeman velo natan rabbi yose omer yitten rabbi yehuda omer lo yitten
Ammay dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hacha ella mishshum deika shachrurita
I name litzboa lo adom utzvao shachor mishshum deka meshanne vehatnan kol hamshanne yado al hattachtona
Umi sheppara miktzat chovo name have asmachta veshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda deamar la kane
Amar rav acha bar adda mishshemeh deulla tachton habba leshannot bigvil shomin lo begazit en shomin lo
Bichfisin shomin lo bilvenim en shomin lo lesakkech baarazim shomin lo beshikmim en shomin lo
Lemaet bechallonot shomin lo leharbot bechallonot en shomin lo lehagbiha en shomin lo lemaet shomin lo
Elon shebba leshannot begazit shomin lo bigvil en shomin lo
Bichfisin en shomin lo bilvenim shomin lo baarazim en shomin lo beshikma shomin lo lerabbot bechallonot shomin lo lemaet bechallonot en shomin lo lehagbiha en shomin lo lemaet shomin lo
En lo laze velo laze may tanya en lo lo laze velo laze en lo levaal aliyya bakkarka kelum

Tanya rabbi natan omer tachton notel shene chalakim vehaelon shelish vaacherim omrim tachton notel shelosha chalakim vehaelon notel revia amar rabba nekot derabbi natan bidach dedayyana hu venachet leumka dedina ka savar kamma mafsed aliyya babbayit tilta hilkach it leh tilta
Matni vechen bet habbad shehu banuy bassela vegina achat al gabbav venifchat hare baal haggina yored vezorea lematta ad sheyyaase levet baddo kipin
Hakkotel vehailan shennaflu lirshut harabbim vehizziku patur milleshallem natnu lo zeman lakotz et hailan velistor et hakkotel venaflu betoch hazzeman patur leachar hazzeman chayyav
Mi shehaya kotlo samuch leginat chavero venafal veamar lo panne avanecha veamar lo

a: Higgiucha en shomin lo mishshekkibbel alav amar lo helach et yetziotecha vaani ettol et shelli en shomin lo

Hassocher et happoel laasot immo batteven uvakkash veamar lo ten li sechari veamar lo tol ma sheasit bischarcha en shomin lo mishshekkibbel alav veamar lo helach secharcha vaani ettol et shelli en shomin lo
Gema nifchata rav amar berubbah ushmuel amar bearba rav amar berubbah aval bearba adam zorea chetzo lematta vechetzo lemala ushmuel amar bearba en adam zorea chetzo lematta vechetzo lemala

Utzricha dei ashmoinan dira beha kaamar shemuel mishshum dela avidi inashe dedayeri purta hacha ufurta hacha aval leinyan zeria avidi inashe dezari hacha purta vehacha purta ema mode leh lerav vei itmar behach behach kaamar rav aval beha ema mode leh lishmuel tzericha
Natnu lo zeman vechamma zeman bet din amar rabbi yochanan sheloshim yom
Mi shehaya kotlo ku ha middekatane sefa helach yetziotecha mikkelal defanninhu askinan tama defanninhu ha la panninhu la
Ammay vetikne leh sadehu deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato
Hane mile hecha deka mikaven leaknoye leh aval hacha ishtemote hu deka mishtemit leh
Hassocher laasot immo beteven ku utzricha
Dei ashmoinan lehach kammayeta dechi kaamar leh higgiuch en shomin lo mishshum delet leh agra gabbeh aval hacha deit leh agra gabbeh ema shomin lo deamri inashe mimmare rashvatach pare ippera
Vei ashmoinan hacha hacha shemmishshekkibbel alav en shomin lo mishshum deit leh agra gabbeh aval hacha delet leh agra gabbeh ema shomin lo tzericha
En shomin lo vehatanya shomin lo amar rav nachman la kashya kan beshello kan beshel chavero

Amar leh rava lerav nachman beshello may tama daamar leh agra alach beshel chavero name secharo alav detanya hassocher et happoel laasot beshello veherahu beshel chavero noten lo secharo mishshalem vechozer venotel mibbaal habbayit ma shehehena oto
Ella amar rav nachman la kashya kan beshello kan beshel hefker
Etiveh rava lerav nachman metziat poel leatzmo ematay bizman sheamar lo baal habbayit nakkesh immi hayyom o ador immi hayyom aval im amar lo ase immi melacha hayyom metziato levaal habbayit
Ella amar rav nachman la kashya kan behagbaha kan behabbata

Amar rabba habbata behefker tannae hi ditnan shomre sefiche sheviit notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka rabbi yose omer harotze mitnaddev hu veshomer chinnam amru lo atta omer ken en bain mishshel tzibbur
May lav beha kamipalgi detanna kamma savar habbata behefker kane vei yahavi leh agra in vei la la verabbi yose savar habbata behefker la kane vechi azli tzibbur umayeti hashta hu deka zache beh
Uma atta omer hachi kaamri leh middevarecha lidvarenu en omer ushte lechem bain mishshel tzibbur
Amar rava la dechulle alma habbata behefker kane vehacha chayeshinan shemma lo yimserem yafe yafe kamipalgi derabbanan savri yahavinan leh agra vei la chayeshinan shemma lo yimserem yafe yafe

Rabbi yose savar la chayeshinan shemma lo yimserem yafe yafe uma atta omer hachi kaamri leh middevarecha lidvarenu dechayeshinan shemma lo yimserem yafe yafe en omer ushte hallechem bain mishshel tzibbur

Ika deamri rava amar dechulle alma habbata behefker la kane vehacha bechayeshinan levaale zeroot kamipalgi detanna kamma savar detakkinu rabbanan lemitav leh arba zuze ki hechi delishmeu baale zeroot velifreshu minayehu verabbi yose savar la takkinu
b: Uma atta omer hachi kaamri leh middevarecha lidvarenu en temidin umusafin bain mishshel tzibbur vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan choshshin levaale zeroot ika benayehu
Matni hammotzi zevel lirshut harabbim hammotzi motzi vehamzabbel mezabbel en shorin tit birshut harabbim veen lovnim levenim aval govlin tit birshut harabbim aval lo levenim
Habbone birshut harabbim hammevi avanim mevi vehabbone bone veim hizzik meshallem ma shehizzik rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af metakken hu et melachto lifne sheloshim yom

Gema lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer bishat hotzaat zevalim adam motzi zivlo lirshut harabbim vetzovro kol sheloshim yom kede sheyehe nishof beragle adam uvragle behema sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz
Afilu tema rabbi yehuda mode rabbi yehuda sheim hizzik chayyav leshallem vehatnan mode rabbi yehuda bener chanukka shehu patur mippene shehu ose birshut may lav reshut devet din la reshut demitzva
Vehatanya kol ellu sheamru muttarin lekalkel birshut harabbim im hizzik chayyav leshallem verabbi yehuda poter ella mechavarta matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda

Amar abbaye rabbi yehuda verabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi shimon kullehu sevira lehu kol makom shennatnu lo chachamim reshut vehizzik patur rabbi yehuda ha daamaran rabban shimon ben gamliel ditnan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af metakken hu et melachto lifne sheloshim yom

Rabbi shimon ditnan haya maamido baaliyya tzarich sheyehe tachtav maaziva shelosha tefachim uvakkira tefach veim hizzik meshallem ma shehizzik rabbi shimon omer lo amru kol hashshiurim hallalu ella sheim hizzik patur milleshallem

Tanu rabbanan hachatztzav shemmasar lassattat hassattat chayyav hassattat shemmasar lachammar hachammar chayyav hachammar shemmasar lakkattaf hakkattaf chayyav hakkattaf shemmasar labbannay habbannay chayyav habbannay shemmasar laadrichal adrichal chayyav veim hinniach even al haddimos vehizzika kullan chayyavin leshallem
Vehatanya acharon chayyav vechullan peturim la kashya kan bischirut kan bekabbelanut

Matni shette gannot zo al gav zo vehayyarak bentayim rabbi meir omer shel elon rabbi yehuda omer shel tachton amar rabbi meir im yirtze haelon likach et afaro en kan yarak amar rabbi yehuda im yirtze hattachton lemallot et ginnato en kan yarak
Amar rabbi meir meachar sheshshenehen yecholin lemachot ze al ze roin mehechan yarak ze chay amar rabbi shimon kol shehaelon yachol lifshot et yado velitol hare hu shello vehashshear shel tachton
Gema amar rava beikaro kulle alma la peligi deelon have ki peligi benofo rabbi meir savar shedi nofo batar ikaro verabbi yehuda savar la amrinan shedi nofo batar ikaro
Veazda letamayehu detanya hayyotze min haggeza umin hashshorashin hare ellu shel baal hakkarka divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer min haggeza shel baal hailan umin hashshorashin shel baal hakkarka

a: Utnan name gabbe arla ki hay gavena ilan hayyotze min haggeza umin hashsharashin chayyav bearla divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer min haggeza patur min hashsharashin chayyav

Utzrichi dei ashmoinan kammayeta beha kaamar rabbi yehuda mishshum demamona aval gabbe arla deisura ema mode leh lerabbi meir vei itmar beha beha kaamar rabbi meir aval behahi ema mode leh lerabbi yehuda tzerichi
Amar rabbi shimon kol shehaelon yachol lifshot vechu amri deve rabbi yannay uvilvad shello yeanes
Bae rav anan veitema rabbi yirmeya maggia lenofo veen maggia leikaro maggia leikaro veen maggia lenofo may teku
Amar efrayim safra talmido shel resh lakish mishshum resh lakish halacha kerabbi shimon amruha kammeh deshabbur malka amar lehu afrin nimteyeh lerabbi shimon
Hadaran alach habbayit vehaaliyya uslika lah massechet bava metzia
Hashshuttafin sheratzu laasot mechitza bechatzer bonin et hakkotel beemtza makom shennahagu livnot gevil gazit kefisin levenin bonin hakkol keminhag hammedina

Gevil ze noten shelosha tefachim veze noten shelosha tefachim baggazit ze noten tifchayim umechetza veze noten tifchayim umechetza bakkefisin ze noten tifchayim veze noten tifchayim bilvenin ze noten tefach umechetza veze noten tefach umechetza lefichach im nafal hakkotel hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem
Vechen baggina mekom shennahagu ligdor mechayevin oto aval babbika mekom shennahagu shello ligdor en mechayevin oto
Ella im ratza kones letoch shello uvone veose chazit mibbachutz lefichach im nafal hakkotel hammakom vehaavanim shello
Im asu middaat shenehem bonin et hakkotel baemtza veosin chazit mikkan umikkan lefichach im nafal hakkotel hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem
Gema savruha may mechitza gudda kidtanya mechitzat hakkerem shennifretza omer lo gedor chazra venifretza omer lo gedor
b: Nityaesh hemenna velo gedarah hare ze kidesh vechayyav beachrautah
Tama deratzu ha lo ratzu en mechayevin oto alma hezek reiyya lav shemeh hezek
Veema mechitza pelugta kedichtiv vattehi mechetzat haeda vechevan deratzu bonin et hakkotel beal korcho alma hezek reiyya shemeh hezek
I hachi hay sheratzu laasot mechitza sheratzu lachatzot mibbee leh ella may gudda bonin et hakkotel bonin oto mibbee leh i tena oto hava amena bimsifas bealma ka mashma lan kotel
Bonin et hakkotel baemtza vechu peshita
La tzericha dikdem chad veratztzeyyeh lechavreh mahu detema matze amar leh ki itretzay lach beavera betashmishta la itretzay lach ka mashma lan
Vehezek reiyya lav shemeh hezek siman gina kotel kofin vecholkin challonot derav nachman
Ta shema vechen begina
Gina shane kidrabbi abba deamar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav asur laadam laamod bisde chavero beshaa shehi omedet bekamoteha
Veha vechen katane aggevil vegazit
Ta shema kotel chatzer shennafal mechayevin oto livnot ad arba ammot nafal shane
Udkaare lah may kaare lah sefa itztericha leh mearba ammot ulmala en mechayevin oto
Ta shema kofin oto livnot bet shaar vedelet lechatzer shema minah hezek reiyya shemeh hezek hazzika derabbim shane
Udyachid la ta shema en cholkin et hechatzer ad sheyehe bah arba ammot laze vearba ammot laze ha yesh bah kede laze uchde laze cholkin may lav bechotel la bimsifas bealma
Ta shema hachallonot ben millemala ben millematta uven mikkenegdan arba ammot vetane alah millemalan kede shello yatzitz veyire millemattan kede shello yaamod veyire mikkenegdan kede shello yaafil
Hezzeka devayit shane

Ta shema deamar rav nachman amar shemuel gag hassamuch lachatzar chavero osin lo maake gavoha arba ammot shane hatam deamar leh baal hechatzer levaal haggag ledidi kevia li tashmishi ledidach la kevia lach tashmishtach vela yadana behe idana selika veatet

Ketannae va berach et avraham bakkol may bakkol rabbi meir omer shello hayeta lo bat rabbi yehuda omer shehayeta lo bat acherim omrim bat hayeta lo leavraham uvakkol shemah rabbi elazar hammodai omer itztagninut hayeta belibbo shel avraham avinu shekkol malche mizrach umaarav mashkimin lefitcho rabbi shimon ben yochay omer even tova hayeta teluya betzavaro shel avraham avinu shekkol chole haroe oto miyyad mitrappe uvshaa shenniftar avraham avinu min haolam telaah hakkadosh baruch hu begalgal chamma amar abbaye hayenu deamri inashe idalli yoma idalli ketzira

Davar acher shello marad esav beyamav davar acher sheasa yishmael teshuva beyamav shello marad esav beyamav menalan dichtiv vayyavo esav min hassade vehu ayef vetana oto hayyom niftar avraham avinu veasa yaakov avinu tavshil shel adashim lenachem et yitzchak aviv

Amar rabbi yochanan chamesh averot avar oto rasha beoto hayyom ba al naara meorasa veharag et hannefesh vechafar baikar vechafar bitchiyyat hammetim veshat et habbechora

Ba al naara meorasa ketiv hacha vayyavo esav min hassade uchtiv hatam ki vassade metzaah harag et hannefesh ketiv hacha ayef uchtiv hatam oy na li ki ayefa nafshi lehorgim vechafar baikar ketiv hacha lamma ze li uchtiv hatam ze eli veanvehu vechafar bitchiyyat hammetim dichtiv hinne anochi holech lamut veshat et habbechora dichtiv vayyivez esav et habbechora
