Veha yishmael dichtiv beh gevia vaasifa addehachi itar behu rava amar lehu dardeke hachi amar rabbi yochanan yishmael asa teshuva bechayye aviv shenneemar vayyikberu oto yitzchak veyishmael banav

Vedilma derech chochmatan ka chashev lehu ella meatta vayyikberu oto esav veyaakov banav may tama la chashev lehu derech chochmatan ella middeakdemeh adbore adbereh umiddeadbereh shema minah teshuva avad beyamav
Tanu rabbanan shelosha hitiman hakkadosh baruch hu baolam hazze

a: Meen haolam habba ellu hen avraham yitzchak veyaakov avraham dichtiv beh bakkol yitzchak dichtiv beh mikkol yaakov dichtiv beh kol
Shelosha lo shalat bahen yetzer hara ellu hen avraham yitzchak veyaakov dichtiv behu bakkol mikkol kol veyesh omrim af david dichtiv velibbi chalal bekirbi veidach tzaareh hu deka madkar

Tanu rabbanan shishsha lo shalat bahen malach hammavet veellu hen avraham yitzchak veyaakov moshe aharon umiryam avraham yitzchak veyaakov dichtiv behu bakkol mikkol kol moshe aharon umiryam dichtiv behu al pi Adonai
Veha miryam la ketiv bah al pi Adonai amar rabbi elazar miryam name binshika meta deatya shamsham mimmoshe umippene ma lo neemar vah al pi Adonai sheggenay haddavar lomar

Tanu rabbanan shiva lo shalat bahen rimma vetolea veellu hen avraham yitzchak veyaakov moshe aharon umiryam uvinyamin ben yaakov avraham yitzchak veyaakov dichtiv behu bakkol mikkol kol moshe aharon umiryam dichtiv behu al pi Adonai binyamin ben yaakov dichtiv ulvinyamin amar yedid Adonai yishkon lavetach alav veyesh omrim af david dichtiv af besari yishkon lavetach veidach hahu rachame hu deka bae

Tanu rabbanan arbaa metu beeto shel nachash veellu hen binyamin ben yaakov veamram avi moshe veyishay avi david vechilav ben david vechullehu gemara levar miyyishay avi david dimfarash beh kera dichtiv veet amasa sam avshalom tachat yoav al hatztzava vaamasa ven ish ushmo yitra hayyisreeli asher ba el avigayil bat nachash achot tzeruya em yoav vechi bat nachash hi vahalo bat yishay hi dichtiv veachyotehem tzeruya vaavigayil ella bat mi shemmet beeto shel nachash
Hadran alach hashshuttafin
Matni lo yachpor adam bor samuch levoro shel chaveroo velo shich velo meara velo ammat hammayim velo nivrechet kovsin ella im ken hirchik mikkotel chavero shelosha tefachim vesad besid

Umarchikim et haggefet veet hazzevel veet hammelach veet hassid veet hasselaim mikkotlo shel chavero shelosha tefachim o sad besid marchikin et hazzeraim veet hammacharesha veet me raglayim min hakkotel shelosha tefachim
Umarchikin et harechayim shelosha min hashshechev shehen arbaa min harechev veet hattannur shelosha min hakkilya shehen arbaa min hassafa
b: Gema patach bevor umsayyem bechotel litne ella im ken hirchik mibboro shel chavero shelosha tefachim
Amar abbaye veitema rav yehuda mikkotel boro shaninu

Velitne ella im ken hirchik mibboro shel chavero shelosha tefachim ha ka mashma lan dechotel bor shelosha tefachim nafka minah lemikkach umimkar kidtanya haomer lachavero bor vechotleha ani mocher lach tzarich sheyehe hakkotel shelosha tefachim
Itmar habba lismoch betzad hammetzer abbaye amar somech verava amar eno somech besade haasuya levorot divre hakkol eno somech ki peligi besade sheenah asuya levorot
Abbaye amar somech deha enah asuya levorot rava amar eno somech deamar leh ki hechi deatte imlachte vachafarte ana name mimmelachna vechafarna

Ika deamri besade sheenah asuya levorot divre hakkol somech ki peligi besade haasuya levorot abbaye amar somech afilu lerabbanan deamri marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma hatam hu dividana deka nata ita levor aval hacha beidana deka chafar leta levor

Verava amar eno somech vaafilu lerabbi yose deamar ze chofer betoch shello veze notea betoch shello hane mile hatam dividana deka nata letanhu leshorashav demazzeki lah levor aval hacha amar leh kol mara umara deka machayet ka merappet lah learay

Tenan lo yachpor adam bor samuch levoro shel chavero tama deika bor ha leka bor somech bishlama lehach lishana deamratte besade sheenah asuya levorot divre hakkol somech matnitin besade sheenah asuya levorot
Ella lehach lishana deamratte besade sheenah asuya levorot peligi bishlama leabbaye nicha ella lerava kashya
Amar lach rava ha itmar alah amar abbaye veitema rav yehuda mikkotel boro shaninu
Ika deamri veitmar alah amar abbaye veitema rav yehuda mikkotel boro shaninu bishlama lehach lishana deamratte besade haasuya levorot divre hakkol eno somech matnitin besade haasuya levorot
Ella lehach lishana deamratte besade haasuya levorot peligi bishlama lerava nicha ella leabbaye kashya
Amar lach abbaye matnitin shebbau lachpor bevat achat
Ta shema sela habba beyadayim ze chofer boro mikkan veze chofer boro mikkan ze marchik shelosha tefachim vesad besid vaze marchik shelosha tefachim vesad besid ba beyadayim shane
Udkaare lah may kaare lah ba beyadayim itztericha leh salka datach amena kevan deva beyadayim live name ravecha tefe ka mashma lan
Ta shema marchikin et haggefet veet hazzevel veet

a: Hammelach veet hassid veet hasselaim mikkotlo shel chavero shelosha tefachim o sad besid tama deika kotel ha leka kotel somech
La ki leka kotel name la samech veella may ka mashma lan ha ka mashma lan dehane kashu lechotel

Ta shema marchikim et hazzeraim veet hammacharesha veet me raglayim min hakkotel shelosha tefachim tama deika kotel ha leka kotel samech la ki leka kotel name la samech veella may ka mashma lan ha ka mashma lan dimtunta kashe lakkotel

Ta shema veet harechayim shelosha min hashshechev shehen arbaa min harechev tama deika kotel ha leka kotel samech la ki leka kotel name la samech veella may ka mashma lan ha ka mashma lan detirya kashe lakkotel

Ta shema veet hattannur shelosha min hakkilya shehen arbaa min hassafa tama deika kotel ha leka kotel samech la ki leka kotel name la samech ella may ka mashma lan ha ka mashma lan dehavla kashe lakkotel
Ta shema lo yiftach adam chanut shel nachtomin veshel tzabbain tachat otzaro shel chavero velo refet bakar tama deika otzar ha leka otzar aved
Dira shane dayeka name detane alah im hayeta refet bakar kodemet laotzar muttar
Ta shema lo yitta adam ilan samuch lassade ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot vetane alah arba ammot sheamru kede avodat hakkerem
Tama demishshum kede avodat hakkerem ha lav mishshum kede avodat hakkerem samech veaf al gav deika shorashin deka mazzeki hacha bemay askinan demafsek tzunma
Dayeka name dekatane haya gader benatayim ze somech laggader mikkan veze somech laggader mikkan

I hachi ema sefa hau shorashav yotzin betoch shel chavero maamik lahen shelosha tefachim kede shello yeakkev hammacharesha vei demafsek tzunma may bau hatam hachi kaamar vei lav tzunma vehau shorashav yotzin letoch shel chavero maamik shelosha tefachim kede shello yeakkev hammacharesha
Ta shema marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma tama deika bor ha leka bor samech la ki leka bor name la samech veha kamashma lan dead esrim vechamesh amma azli shorashim umazzeki levor
I hachi ema sefa veim ilan kadam lo yakotz vei dela samech hechi mashkachatte lah kidamar rav pappa belokeach hachi name belokeach

Ta shema marchikin et hammishra min hayyarak veet hakkereshin min habbetzalin veet hachardal min haddevorim tama deika yarak ha leka yarak samech la ki leka yarak name la samech veha ka mashma lan dehane kashu ahadade
I hachi ema sefa rabbi yose mattir bechardal mippene sheyyachol lomar lo ad sheatta omer li harchek chardalecha min devoray harchek devorecha min chardalay shebbaot veochlot liglugay chardalay
b: Vei dela samech hechi mashkachatte lah amar rav pappa belokeach
I belokeach may tama derabbanan veod may tama derabbi yose afilu mishra veyarka name
Amar ravina ka savri rabbanan al hammazzik leharchik et atzmo
Mikkelal derabbi yose savar al hannizak leharchik et atzmo i al hannizak afilu mishra veyarka name

Ella leolam rabbi yose name al hammazzik sevira leh vehachi kaamar lehu rabbi yose lerabbanan tinach mishra veyarka dehane mazzeki hane vehane la mazzeki hane ella chardal udvorim tarvayehu mazzeki ahadade
Verabbanan devorim lechardal la mazzeki leh i bevinta la mashkecha leh i betarpa hadar pare

Vesavar rabbi yose al hammazzik leharchik et atzmo vehatnan rabbi yose omer af al pi shehabbor kodemet leilan lo yakotz shezze chofer betoch shello veze notea betoch shello ella leolam rabbi yose al hannizak sevira leh uldivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu

Ledidi al hannizak leharchik et atzmo vaafilu mishra veyarka la bae rachoke ella ledidchu deamritu al hammazzik tinach mishra veyarka dehane mazzeki hane vehane la mazzeki hane ella chardal udvorim tarvayehu mazzeki ahadade
Verabbanan devorim lechardal la mazzeki leh i bevinta

a: La mashkachatte leh i betarpa hadar pare

Velo nivrechet hakkovsin vechu amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lo shanu ella min hammachmetzan aval min hannadyan arba ammot tanya name hachi nivrechet hakkovsin arba ammot veha anan tenan shelosha tefachim ella lav shema minah kidrav nachman

Veika derame lehu mirme tenan nivrechet hakkovsin shelosha tefachim vehatanya arba ammot amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh la kashya kan min hammachmetzan kan min hannadyan rav chiyya bereh derav aveya matne lah behedya ella im ken hirchik missefat machmetzan velakkotel shelosha tefachim
Vesad besid ibaya lehu vesad besid tenan o dilma o sad besid tenan
Peshita divesad besid tenan dei salka datach deo sad besid tenan im ken liarvinhu velitninhu
Dilma mishshum dela dame hay hezeka lehay hezeka resha hezeka dimtuna sefa hezeka dehavla

Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer sela habba beyadayim ze chofer boro mikkan veze chofer boro mikkan ze marchik shelosha tefachim vesad besid vaze marchik shelosha tefachim vesad besid tama deva beyadayim ha lo ba beyadayim lo
Hu haddin deaf al gav delo ba beyadayim name sad besid uva beyadayim itztericha leh salka datach amena kevan deva beyadayim live ravecha tefe ka mashma lan
Marchikin et haggefet veet hazzevel veet hammelach veet hasselaim vechu tenan hatam bamme tomnin uvamma en tomnin
En tomnin lo baggefet velo bazzevel velo bammelach velo bassid velo bachol ben lachin ben yeveshin may shena hacha dekatane selaim vela katane chol umay shena hatam dekatane chol vela katane selaim

Amar rav yosef lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lehatmin bislaim amar leh abbaye vechi darkan shel bene adam lehatmin begize tzemer ulshonot shel argaman detanya tomnin begize tzemer uvtzipe tzemer uvilshonot shel argaman uvmochin veen metaltelin otan

Ella amar abbaye yaggid alav reo tena hacha selaim vehu haddin lechol tena hatam chol vehu haddin lislaim amar leh rava i yaggid alav reo litninhu lechullehu bachada velitne chada minnayehu beidach vehu haddin leidach
Ella amar rava hatam hayenu tama dela katane selaim mishshum dimshattechi lah likdera hacha hayenu tama dela katane chol mishshum demechammime chayem umikkarire karer
Veha tane rabbi oshaya chol hatam bimtuna tanna didan name litne velokmeh bimtuna ha tena leh ammat hammayim
Attu mi la katane ammat hammayim vekatane nivrechet hakkovsin
Hanhu tzerichi dei tena ammat hammayim mishshum dikvia aval nivrechet hakkovsin dela kevia ema la vei tena nivrechet hakkovsin mishshum diku vekayemi aval ammat hammayim la tzericha
Marchikin et hazzeraim veet hammacharesha vechu zeraim tipok leh mishshum macharesha bemappolet yad
Macharesha vetipok leh mishshum zeraim bechoresh leilanot vetipok leh mishshum mayya tanna beeretz yisrael kae dichtiv limtar hashshamayim tishte mayim
Lememra dizraim
b: Litzdadin ka mishtarshi veha tenan hammavrich et haggefen baaretz im en al gabbah afar shelosha tefachim lo yavi zera aleha
Vetane alah aval zorea et hatztzedadin elach veelach amar rabbi chagga beshem rabbi yose mippene shemmachalidin et hakkarka umaalin afar tichuach

Veet me raglayim min hakkotel shelosha tefachim vechu amar rabba bar bar chana muttar laadam lehashtin mayim betzad kotlo shel chavero dichtiv vehichratti leachav mashtin bekir veatzur veazuv beyisrael veha anan tenan veet me raglayim min hakkotel shelosha tefachim hatam beshofchin
Ta shema lo yishpoch adam mayim betzad kotlo shel chavero ella im ken hirchik mimmennu shelosha tefachim hatam name beshofchin

Ta shema lo yashtin adam mayim betzad kotlo shel chavero ella im ken hirchik mimmennu shelosha tefachim bamme devarim amurim bechotel levenim aval bechotel avanim bichde shello yazzik vechamma tefach veshel tzunma muttar teuvta derabba bar bar chana teuvta
Veha rabba bar bar chana kera kaamar hatam hachi kaamar afilu mide dedarkeh leashtone bekir la shavekna leh umay nihu kalba
Amar rabbi tovi bar kisna amar shemuel rakik eno memaet bachallon may irya rakik afilu ave name
La mibaya kaamar la mibaya ave kevan deichazi leh la mevattel leh aval rakik demimmeis ema battole mevattel leh ka mashma lan
Vetipok leh dehave leh davar shehu mekabbel tuma vechol davar shehu mekabbel tuma eno chotzetz bifne hattuma shennilosh beme ferot
Metivi kuppa melea teven vechavit melea gerogrot hammunnachim bachallon roin kol sheilu yinnatlu vicholin teven ugrogrot laamod bifne atzman chotztzin veim lav en chotztzin veha teven chaze livhemto
Besarya chaze letina deit beh kotze chaze lehassaka bimtuna chaze lehessek gadol hessek gadol la shechiach
Gerogrot ha chazu leh amar shemuel beshehitrifu vechen tane rabba bar avuh beshehitrifu
Hay chavit hechi damya i defumma levar

a: Hi gufah techutz deha keli cheres eno mittamme miggabbo ella defumma legav vei baet ema leolam defumma levar hacha bemay askinan bechavit shel mattechet

Metivi asavin shettelashan vehinnichan bachallon o shealu mealehen bachallonot umatloniyyot sheen bahen shalosh al shalosh vehaever vehabbasar hamduldalin bivhema uvchayya veof sheshshachan bachallon vegoy sheyyashav bachallon uven shemone hammunnach bachallon vehammelach uchli cheres vesefer tora kullam memaatin bachallon aval hashsheleg vehabbarad vehaggelid vehakkefor vehammayim kullan en memaatin bachallon
Veha asavin chazu livhemto beafrazta
O shealu mealehen kevan dekashu lechotel shakel lehu amar rabba bechotel churba rav pappa amar afilu bechotel yishuv bevain chutz lishlosha lachallon
Matloniyyot chazu leh likria dilvusha bismichta chazu leummana berisakka
I berisakka sheen bahen shalosh al shalosh sheen bahen arbaa al arbaa mibe leh keen risakka
Vehaever vehabbasar hamduldalin bivhema uvchayya arka veazla bikshura
Shachet lah bitmea mezabben lah legoy bichchusha pasek shade lah lichlavim kevan deika tzaar baale chayyim la aved
Veof sheshshachan bachallon parach veazel bekashur shachet leh betame mezabben leh legoy biklanita
Yahev leh leyanoka bimsaret kelanita la mesarta keen kelanita
Vegoy sheyyashav bachallon kae veazel bechafut ate chavreh share leh bimtzora ate metzora chavreh share leh ella bachavushe malchut
Uven shemone hammunnach bachallon atya immeh darya leh beshabbat detanya ben shemone hare hu keeven veasur letaltelo beshabbat aval immo shocha alav umnikato mippene hassakkana
Melach chazya leh bimrirta chazya leorot deit bah kotze
Kevan dekashya lechotel shakla deyatva achaspa chaspa gufa techutz
b: Delet bah shiura keditnan cheres kede liten ben patztzim lachavero
Keli cheres chaze leh demitannaf chaze leummana dimnakkav
Sefer tora chaze lemikra bevaluy veha bae geniza sham tehe genizatah
Veamar rav bakkol osin mechitza chutz mimmelach urvav ushmuel amar afilu melach amar rav pappa vela peligi ha bemelach sedomit ha bemelach isterokanit

Vehashta deamar rabba ose adam shene tzibbure melach umanniach alehem kora shehammelach maamedet et hakkora vehakkora maamedet et hammelach afilu melach isterokanit vela peligi ha deika kora ha deleka kora

Marchikin et harechayim shelosha min hashshechev shehen arbaa min harechev vechu may tama mishshum tirya veha tanya veshel chamor shelosha min haisterovel shehen arbaa min hakkelet hatam may tirya ika ella mishshum kala
Veet hattannur shelosha min hakkilya shehen arbaa min hassafa amar abbaye shema minah kilya detannur tefach nafka minah lemikkach umimkar
Matni lo yaamid adam tannur betoch habbayit ella im ken yesh al gabbav govah arba ammot haya maamido baaliyya tzarich sheyehe tachtav maaziva shelosha tefachim uvakkira tefach
Veim hizzik meshallem ma shehizzik rabbi shimon omer lo amru kol hashshiurin haellu ella sheim hizzik patur milleshallem
Lo yiftach adam chanut shel nachtomin veshel tzabbain tachat otzaro shel chavero velo refet bakar beemet bayyayin hittiru aval lo refet bakar
Gema vehatanya battannur arbaa uvakkira shelosha amar abbaye ki tanya hahi bidnachtomin detannur didan ki kira denachtomin
Lo yiftach chanut vechu tana im hayeta refet kodemet laotzar muttar bae abbaye kibed veribetz leotzar mahu
Riba bachallonot mahu achsadra tachat haotzar mahu bana aliyya al gabbe beto mahu teku bae rav huna bereh derav yehoshua tamre verimmone may teku

Beemet beyayin hittiru vechu tana beyayin hittiru mippene shemmashbicho velo refet bakar mippene shemmasricho amar rav yosef hay didan afilu kutra dishraga name kashya leh amar rav sheshet veaspasta kerefet bakar damya

Matni chanut shebbechatzer yachol limchot beyado velomar lo eni yachol lishan mikkol hannichnasin umikkol hayyotzin aval ose kelim yotze umocher betoch hashshuk veeno yachol limchot beyado velomar lo eni yachol lishan lo mikkol happattish velo mikkol harechayim velo mikkol hattinokot
Gema may shena resha umay shena sefa amar abbaye sefa atan lechatzer acheret amar leh rava i hachi litne chatzer acheret muttar ella amar rava

a: Sefa atan letinokot shel bet rabban umittakkanat yehoshua ben gamla veelach

Deamar rav yehuda amar rav beram zachur oto haish lattov vihoshua ben gamla shemo sheilmale hu nishtakkach tora miyyisrael shebbitchilla mi sheyyesh lo av melammedo tora mi sheen lo av lo haya lamed tora may derush velimmadtem otam velimmadtem attem

Hitkinu sheyehu moshivin melammede tinokot birushalayim may derush ki mitztziyyon tetze tora vaadayin mi sheyyesh lo av haya maalo umlammedo mi sheen lo av lo haya ole velamed hitkinu sheyehu moshivin bechol pelech ufelech umachnisin otan keven shesh esre keven sheva esre
Umi shehaya rabbo koes alav mevaet bo veyotze ad shebba yehoshua ben gamla vetiken sheyehu moshivin melammede tinokot bechol medina umdina uvchol ir vair umachnisin otan keven shesh keven sheva

Amar leh rav lerav shemuel bar shilat ad shet la tekabbel mikkan veelach kabbel veaspi leh ketora vaamar leh rav lerav shemuel bar shilat ki machet leyanoka la timche ella bearketa dimsana dekare kare dela kare leheve tzaveta lechavreh
Metivi echad mibbene chatzer shebbikesh leasot rofe umman vegardi umlammed tinokot bene chatzer meakkevin alav hacha bemay askinan betinokot degoyim
Ta shema shenayim sheyyoshvin bechatzer uvikesh echad mehen leasot rofe veumman vegardi umlammed tinokot chavero meakkev alav hacha name betinokot degoyim
Ta shema mi sheyyesh lo bayit bachatzar hashshuttafin hare ze lo yaskirennu lo lerofe velo leumman velo legardi velo lesofer yehudi velo lesofer armay hacha bemay askinan besofer mata

Amar rava mittakkanat yehoshua ben gamla veelach la mamtinan yanoka mimmata lemata aval mibbe chenishta leve chenishta mamtinan vei mafsek nahara la mamtinan vei ika titura mamtinan vei ika gamla la mamtinan
Veamar rava sach makre dardeke esrin vechamsha yanoke vei ika chamshin motvinan tere vei ika arbein mokminan resh duchna umsayein leh mimmata
Veamar rava hay makre yanoke degares veika acharina degares tefe mineh la mesallekinan leh dilma ate leitrashshole rav dimi minnehardea amar kol shekken degares tefe kinat sofrim tarbe chachma

Veamar rava hane tere makre dardeke chad gares vela dayek vechad dayek vela gares motvinan hahu degares vela dayek shabbeshta mimmela nafka rav dimi minnehardea amar motvinan dedayek vela gares shabbeshta kevan deal al
Dichtiv ki sheshet chodashim yashav sham yoav vechol yisrael ad hichrit kol zachar beedom ki ata lekammeh dedavid amar leh
b: May tama avadte hachi amar leh dichtiv timche et zechar amalek amar leh veha anan zecher karenan amar leh ana zechar akreun azal shayeleh lerabbeh amar leh heach akritan amar leh zecher

Shekal safsira lemikteleh amar leh ammay amar leh dichtiv arur ose melechet Adonai remiyya amar leh shivkeh lehahu gavra delekum bearur amar leh ketiv vearur monea charbo middam ika deamri katleh veika deamri la katleh
Veamar rava makre yanoka shattala tabbacha veummana vesofer mata kullan kemutrin veomdin ninhu kelala demilta kol peseda dela hadar mutre veomed hu
Amar rav huna hay bar mevoa deoki richya vaata bar mevoa chavreh vekamoke gabbeh dina hu dimakkev ilaveh deamar leh ka paskatte leh lechayyuti
Lema mesayya leh marchikim metzudat haddag min haddag kimlo ritzat haddag vechamma amar rabba bar rav huna ad parsa shane dagim deyahavi seyara
Amar leh ravina lerava lema rav huna deamar kerabbi yehuda ditnan rabbi yehuda omer lo yechallek chenvani kelaot veegozin letinokot mippene shemmergilan etzlo vachachamim mattirin
Afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yehuda hatam ella daamar leh ana kamfallegna amgoze atte pelog sheuske aval hacha afilu rabbanan modu daamar leh ka paskatte leh lechayyuti
Metivi ose adam chanut betzad chanuto shel chavero umerchatz betzad merchatzo shel chavero veeno yachol limchot beyado mippene sheyyachol lomar lo atta ose betoch shellecha vaani ose betoch shelli

Tannae hi detanya kofin bene mevoot ze et ze shello lehoshiv benehen lo chayyat velo burseki velo melammed tinokot velo echad mibbene baale ummaniyyot velishcheno eno kofehu rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af lishcheno kofehu
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua peshita li bar mata abbar mata achariti matze meakkev vei shayech bichraga dehacha la matze meakkev bar mevoa abbar mevoa denafsheh la matze meakkev

Bae rav huna bereh derav yehoshua bar mevoa abbar mevoa acharina may teku amar rav yosef umode rav huna bemakre dardeke dela matze meakkev deamar mar ezra tiken lahen leyisrael sheyehu moshivin sofer betzad sofer
Venechush dilma ate leitrashshole amar leh

a: Kinat sofrim tarbe chachma

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak umode rav huna bereh derav yehoshua berochlin hammachazirin baayarot dela matze meakkev deamar mar ezra tikken lahen leyisrael sheyehu rochlin machazirin baayarot kede sheyehu tachshitin metzuyin livnot yisrael

Vehane mile leahdore aval leikkevoe la vei tzurba merabbanan hu afilu leikkevoe name ki ha derava shera lehu lerabbi yoshiyya ulrav ovadya leikkevoe dela kehilcheta may tama kevan derabbanan ninhu atu littardu miggirsayehu

Hanhu dikulae deayeto diklae levavel ato bene mata ka meakkevi illavayehu ato lekammeh deravina amar lehu mealma atu ulalma lizabbenu vehane mile beoma deshuka aval bela yoma deshuka la uvoma deshuka name la amrinan ella lezabbone beshuka aval leahdore la

Hanhu amorae deayeto amra lefum nahara ato bene mata ka meakkevi illavayehu ato lekammeh derav kahana amar lehu dina hu dimakkevi alayechu amaru leh it lan ashray amar lehu zilu zabbenu shiur chayyutayechu ad deakritu ashray didchu veazlitu
Rav dimi minnehardea ayeti gerogrot bisfina amar leh resh galuta lerava pok chazi i tzurba merabbanan hu nakket leh shuka amar leh rava lerav adda bar abba pok tehi leh bekankanneh

Nefak azal bea mineh pil shebbela kefifa mitzrit vehekiah derech bet hari mahu la hava bideh amar leh mar nihu rava tefach leh besandaleh amar leh ben didi lerava ika tuva mihu al korchach ana rabbach verava rabba derabbach

La nakkitu leh shuka pesud gerogrot dideh ata lekammeh derav yosef amar leh chazi mar may avadu li amar leh man dela shahayah leonita demalka deedom la neshahayah leonitach dichtiv ko amar Adonai al shelosha pishe moav veal arbaa lo ashivennu al sorfo atzmot melech edom lassid

Nach nafsheh derav adda bar abba rav yosef amar ana aneshteh daana latyiteh rav dimi minnehardea amar ana aneshteh deafsed gerogrot didi abbaye amar ana aneshteh daamar lehu lerabbanan addimgarmitu garme be abbaye tu ichlu bisra shammina be rava verava amar ana aneshteh dechi hava azel leve tabbacha lemishkal umtza amar lehu letabbache ana shakelna bisra mikamme shammaeh derava daana adifna mineh
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar ana aneshteh derav nachman bar yitzchak resh kalla hava kol yoma mikamme deneul lechalla marhet bahadeh rav adda bar abba lishmateh vahadar ayel lechalla

Hahu yoma naktuh rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav adda bar abba mishshum dela hao besiyyuma amaru leh ema lan hane shematata demasar behema hechi amrinhu rava amar lehu hachi amar rava vehachi amar rava addehachi negah leh lerav nachman bar yitzchak vela ate rav adda bar abba

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav nachman bar yitzchak kum dingah lan lema yatev mar amar lehu yatevna veka menattera learseh derav adda bar abba addehachi nefak kala denach nafsheh derav adda bar abba umistabbera derav nachman bar yitzchak ansheh
Matni mi shehaya kotlo samuch lechotel chavero lo yismoch lo kotel acher ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot hachallonot ben millemalan ben millemattan ben kenegdan arba ammot
Gema vekamma hechi samech amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar
b: Habba lismoch lo yismoch ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot matkef lah rava veha mi shehaya kotlo samuch lechotel chavero katane

Ella amar rava hachi katane mi shehaya kotlo samuch lechotel chavero berachok arba ammot venafal lo yismoch lo kotel acher ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot may tama dedavesha dehacha mealle lehatam
Amar rav lo shanu ella kotel gina aval kotel chatzer im ba lismoch somech rabbi oshaya omer echad kotel gina veechad kotel chatzer im ba lismoch eno somech
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina vela peligi ha beir yeshana ha beir chadasha
Tenan hachallonot ben millemalan ben millemattan ben mikkenegdan arba ammot vetane alah millemalan kede shello yatzitz veyire millemattan shello yaamod veyire umikkenegdan shello yaafil
Tama shello yaafil aval mishshum davesha la hacha bemay askinan beva min hatztzad
Vechamma amar yeva chamuh deashyan bar nidbach mishshemeh derav kimlo rochav challon vahalo metzitz amar rav zevid bemaddir et kotlo
Veha anan tenan arba ammot la kashya kan meruach achat kan mishte ruchot

Ta shema veet hakkotel min hammazchela arba ammot kede sheyehe zokef et hassullam tama mishshum sullam aval mishshum davesha la hacha bemay askinan bemazchela meshuppaat dei mishshum davesha hu ha ka azel veate tuteh
Matni marchikin et hassullam min hashshovach arba ammot kede shello tikpotz hannemiyya veet hakkotel min hammazchela arba ammot kede sheyehe zokef et hassullam
Gema lema matnitin dela kerabbi yose dei rabbi yose ha amar ze chofer betoch shello veze notea betoch shello

Afilu tema rabbi yose ha amar rav ashe ki havenan be rav kahana hava amar mode rabbi yose begire dideh hacha name zimnin devahade demannach leh yatva bechor vekaftza veha gerama hu amar rav tovi bar matna zot omeret gerama benizakin asur
Rav yosef hava leh hanhu tale dahao

a: Atu ummane veyatvi tutayehu veatu orve achli dema vesalki abbe tale umafsedi tamre amar lehu rav yosef appiku li kurkur mehacha amar leh abbaye veha gerama hu amar leh hachi amar rav tovi bar matna zot omeret gerama benizakin asur

Veha achzek lehu ha amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh en chazaka linzakin velav itmar alah rav mari amar bekutra verav zevid amar bevet hakkisse amar leh hane ledidi daanina datay ki kutra uvet hakkisse damu li

Matni marchikin et hashshovach min hair chamishshim amma velo yaase adam shovach betoch shello ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma lechol ruach rabbi yehuda omer bet arbaat korin melo sheger hayyone veim lekacho afilu bet rova hare hu bechezkato
Gema chamishshim amma vetu la urminhi en porsin nishbin leonim ella im ken haya rachok min hayyishshuv sheloshim ris
Amar abbaye meshat shayeti tuva uchresayehu bachamishshim ammeta malya umeshat sheloshim ris vetu la vehatanya uvayyishshuv afilu mea mil lo yifros rav yosef amar beyishshuv keramim
Rava amar beyishshuv shovachin vetipok leh mishshum shovachin gufayehu ibaet ema dideh veibaet ema degoy veibaet ema dehefker
Rabbi yehuda omer bet arbaat korin vechu amar rav pappa veitema rav zevid zot omeret toanin lelokeach vetoanin leoresh
Yoresh tenena habba mishshum yerushsha eno tzarich taana lokeach itztericha leh lokeach name tenena lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugzuzteraot hare ze bechezkatah
Tzericha dei ashmeinan hatam gabbe reshut harabbim deemor kones letoch shello hu i name achole achul bene reshut harabbim gabbeh aval hacha la
Vei ashmeinan hacha dechevan deyachid hu ema payyose payeseh i name achole achel gabbeh aval rabbim man payyes uman shavek ema la tzericha
Hare hu bechezkato veha amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh en chazaka linzakin rav mari amar bekutra rav zevid amar bevet hakkisse
b: Matni nipul hannimtza betoch chamishshim amma hare hu shel baal hashshovach chutz mechamishshim amma hare hu shel motzo nimtza ben shene shovachot karov laze shello karov laze shello mechetza al mechetza shenehem yachloku
Gema amar rabbi chanina rov vekarov holchin achar harov veaf al gav derubba deorayeta vekurva deorayeta afilu hachi rubba adif
Metiv rabbi zera vehaya hair hakkerova el hechalal veaf al gav deika achariti dinfisha minah
Bidleka velezil batar rubba dealma beoshevet ben heharim
Tenan nipul hannimtza betoch chamishshim amma hare hu shel baal hashshovach veaf al gav deika acharina dinfish mineh bidleka
I hachi ema sefa chutz mechamishshim amma hare hu shel motzo vei deleka vadday mehahu nefal hacha bemay askinan bimdadde deamar rav ukva bar chama kol hamdadde en medadde yoter mechamishshim
Bae rabbi yirmeya raglo achat betoch chamishshim amma veraglo achat chutz mechamishshim amma mahu veal da appekuhu lerabbi yirmeya mibbe midresha

Ta shema nimtza ben shene shovachot karov laze shello vekarov laze shello veaf al gav dechad minayehu nefish mechavreh hacha bemay askinan sheshshenehen shavin velezil batar rubba dealma hacha bemay askinan

a: Bishvil shel keramim deim ita demealma ate kevan demidadde la matze ate dechol demidadde vahadar chaze leh lekineh midadde vei la la midadde
Amar abbaye af anan name tenena dam shennimtza bapperozdor sefeko tame shechezkato min hammakor veaf al gav deika aliyya dimkarva
Amar leh rava rov umatzuy ka amratte rov umatzuy leka leman deamar
Detane rabbi chiyya dam hannimtza bapperozdor chayyavin alav al biat mikdash vesorfin alav et hatteruma
Veamar rava shema minah midderabbi chiyya telat shema minah rov vekarov hallech achar harov ushma minah rubba deorayeta ushma minah ita lidrabbi zera
Deamar rabbi zera af al pi sheddaltot medina neulot
Deha ishsha dechi daltot medina neulot damya vaafilu hachi ka azlinan batar rubba
Veha rava hu dekaamar rov umatzuy leka leman deamar hadar beh rava mehahi

Itmar chavit shetztzafa bannahar amar rav nimtzet keneged ir sherubbah yisrael muttar keneged ir sherubbah nochrim asira ushmuel amar afilu nimtzet keneged ir sherubbah yisrael asira emor mehay dekira atay
Lema bidrabbi chanina ka mipalgi demar it leh derabbi chanina umar let leh derabbi chanina
La dechulle alma it lehu derabbi chanina vehacha beha kamipalgi demar savar im ita demehay dekira atay ikkule ufashore hava matbei lah umar savar charifa denahara nekat vaatay
Hahu chatzba dechamra deishtechach befardesa deorla sharye ravina lema mishshum desavar lah derabbi chanina
Shane hatam dei migniv mineh atznoe begaveh la matznei vehane mile chamra aval inve matznei
Hanhu zike dechamra deishtechachu be kufae sheranhu rava lema la savar lah lidrabbi chanina shane hatam derubba
b: Deshafochae yisrael ninhu vehane mile beravreve aval zutre emor meovre derachim neful vei ika ravreve bahadayehu emor baavarvare hava mannechi

Matni marchikin et hailan min hair esrim vechamesh amma uvecharuv uvashshikma chamishshim amma abba shaul omer kol ilan serak chamishshim amma veim hair kadma kotzetz veeno noten damim veim ilan kadam kotzetz venoten damim safek ze kadam vesafek ze kadam kotzetz veeno noten damim
Gema may tama amar ulla mishshum noye hair vetipok leh deen osin sade migrash velo migrash sade
La tzericha lerabbi elazar deamar osin sade migrash umigrash sade hacha mishshum noye hair la avdinan
Ulrabbanan name deamri en osin sade migrash velo migrash sade hane mile zeraim aval ilanot avdinan vehacha mishshum noye hair la
Umna temra deshane ben zerain leilanot detanya karpef yoter mibbet satayim shehukkaf ledira
Nizra rubbo hare hu kegina veasur nita rubbo hare hu kechatzer umuttar
Veim hair kadma kotzetz veeno noten damim vechu may shena gabbe bor dekatane kotzetz venoten damim umay shena hacha dekatane kotzetz veeno noten damim
Amar rav kahana kidra deve shuttafe la chammima vela karira
Umay kushya dilma shane hezzeka derabbim mehezzeka deyachid
Ella i itmar derav kahana assefa itmar im hailan kadam kotzetz venoten damim velema lehu havu li beresha deme vahadar ikotz amar rav kahana kidra deve shuttafe la chammima vela karira
Safek ze kadam vesafek ze kadam kotzetz veeno noten damim may shena mibbor deamratte lo yakotz
Hatam devadday lav lemikatz kae sefeko name la amrinan leh kotz hacha devadday lemikatz kae sefeko name amrinan leh kotz vei mishshum deme amrinan leh ayeti reaya ushkol

Matni marchikin et goren kavua min hair chamishshim amma lo yaase adam goren kavua betoch shello ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma lechol ruach umarchik minnetiotav shel chavero uminniro bichde shello yazzik
Gema may shena resha umay shena sefa amar abbaye sefa atan legoren sheeno kavua
Hechi dame goren sheeno kavua amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina kol sheeno zore berachat
Rav ashe amar ma taam kaamar may tama marchikin goren kavua min hair chamishshim amma kede shello yazzik

Metivi marchikin goren kavua min hair chamishshim amma uchshem shemmarchikin min hair chamishshim amma kach marchikin middilluav umikkishshuav uminnetiotav uminniro shel chavero chamishshim amma kede shello yazzik bishlama lerav ashe nicha ella leabbaye kashya kashya
Bishlama mimmikshoav umiddeloav deazel avka veate belibeh umtzave leh ella minniro ammay amar rabbi abba bar zavda veitema rabbi abba bar zutra mippene

a: Sheose oto galal

Matni marchikin et hannevelot veet hakkevarot veet habburseki min hair chamishshim amma en osin burseki ella lemizrach hair rabbi akiva omer lechol ruach hu ose chutz mimmaaravah umarchik chamishshim amma umerchikin et hammishra min hayyarak veet hakkereshin min habbetzalim veet hachardal min haddevorim verabbi yose mattir bechardal

Gema ibaya lehu rabbi akiva hechi kaamar lechol ruach hu ose vesomech chutz mimmaaravah demarchik chamishshim amma veose o dilma lechol ruach hu ose umarchik chamishshim amma chutz mimmaaravah deeno ose kelal
Ta shema detanya rabbi akiva omer lechol ruach hu ose umarchik chamishshim amma chutz mimmaaravah deeno ose kol ikar mippene shehi tedira

Amar leh rava lerav nachman may tedira ilema tedira beruchot veha amar rav chanan bar abba amar rav arba ruchot menashshevot bechol yom veruach tzefonit im kullan sheilmale ken en haolam mitkayyem afilu shaa achat veruach deromit kasha mikkullan veilmale ben netz shemmaamidah machrevet et haolam shenneemar hamibbinatcha yaaver netz yifros kenafav leteman
Ella may tedira tedira bishchina deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi bou venachazik tova laavotenu shehodiu mekom tefilla dichtiv utzva hashshamayim lecha mishtachavim
Matkef lah rav acha bar yaakov vedilma keeved shennotel peras merabbo vechozer laachorav umishtachave kashya

Verabbi oshaya savar shechina bechol makom deamar rabbi oshaya may dichtiv atta hu Adonai levaddecha atta asita et hashshamayim vego sheluchecha lo kishluche basar vadam sheluche basar vadam mimmakom shemmishtallechim lesham machazirim shelichutan aval sheluchecha lemakom shemmishtallechin mishsham machzirin shelichutan shenneemar hatshallach berakim veyelechu veyomru lecha hinnenu yavou veyomru lo neemar ella veyelechu veyomru melammed shehashshechina bechol makom

Veaf rabbi yishmael savar shechina bechol makom detana deve rabbi yishmael minnayin sheshshechina bechol makom shenneemar hinne hammalach haddover bi yotze umalach acher yotze likrato acharav lo neemar ella likrato melammed sheshshechina bechol makom
Veaf rav sheshet savar shechina bechol makom daamar leh rav sheshet leshammaeh lechol ruchata okman levar mimmizrach velav mishshum delet beh shechina ella mishshum demoru beh mine
Verabbi avahu amar shechina bammaarav deamar rabbi avahu may orya avir yah
Amar rav yehuda may dichtiv yaarof kammatar likchi zo ruach maaravit shebbaa meorpo shel olam
Tizzal kattal imrati zo ruach tzefonit shemmazzelet et hazzahav vechen hu omer hazzalim zahav mikkis
Kisirim ale deshe zo ruach mizrachit shemmaseret et kol haolam kesair vechirvivim ale esev zo ruach deromit shehi maala revivim umgaddelet asavim
Tanya rabbi eliezer omer olam
b: Leachsadra hu dome veruach tzefonit enah mesubbevet vechevan shehiggia chamma etzel keren maaravit tzefonit nichpefet veole lemala min harakia verabbi yehoshua omer olam lekubba hu dome veruach tzefonit mesubbevet vechevan shechamma maggaat lekeren maaravit tzefonit makkefet vechozeret achore chipa

Shenneemar holech el darom vesovev el tzafon vego holech el darom bayyom vesovev el tzafon ballayela sovev sovev holech haruach veal sevivotav shav haruach ellu pene mizrach ufne maarav sheppeamim mesabbavtan ufamim mehallachtan
Hu haya omer atan lerabbi eliezer min hacheder tavo sufa zo ruach deromit umimmezarim kara zo ruach tzefonit minnishmat el yitten karach zo ruach maaravit verochav mayim bemutzak zo ruach mizrachit
Vehaamar mar ruach deromit maala revivim umgaddelet asavim la kashya ha deatya mitra benichuta ha bishfichuta
Amar rav chisda may dichtiv mitztzafon zahav yeete zo ruach tzefonit shemmazzelet et hazzahav vechen hu omer hazzalim zahav mikkis
Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash lo hugshema ruach deromit shenneemar vayyigzor al yamin veraev vayyochal al semol velo saveu uchtiv tzafon veyamin atta veratam

Veamar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en haggeshamim yordin meotzar tov shenneemar yiftach Adonai lecha et otzaro hattov bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom veyisrael sheruyin al admatam geshamim yordin meotzar tov bizman sheen yisrael sheruyin al admatam en geshamim yordin meotzar tov

Amar rabbi yitzchak harotze sheyyachkim yadrim vesheyyaashir yatzpin vesimanach shulchan batztzafon umnora baddarom verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar leolam yadrim shemmittoch shemmitchakkem mitashsher shenneemar orech yamim biminah bismolah osher vechavod

Veha rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar shechina bammaarav dematzded atzdode amar leh rabbi chanina lerav ashe kegon attun deyatvitu bitzfonah deeretz yisrael adrimu adrome umna lan devavel litzfonah deeretz yisrael kayema dichtiv mitztzafon tippatach haraa al kol yoshve haaretz

Marchikin et hammishra min hayyarak vechu tana rabbi yose mattir bachardal sheyyachol lomar lo ad sheatta omer li harchek chardalecha min devoray harchek devorecha min chardalay shebbaot veochlot ligluge chardalay

Matni marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma uvcharuv uvashshikma chamishshim amma ben millemala ben min hatztzad im habbor kadma kotzetz venoten damim veim ilan kadam lo yakotz safek ze kadam vesafek ze kadam lo yakotz rabbi yose omer af al pi shehabbor kodemet lailan lo yakotz shezze chofer betoch shello veze notea betoch shello

Gema tana ben shehabbor lematta veilan lemala ben shehabbor lemala veilan lematta bishlama bor lematta veilan lemala ka azlin shorashin mazzeki lah levor ella bor lemala veilan lematta ammay amar rabbi chagga beshem rabbi yose mippene shemmachlidin et hakkarka umalkin karkaitah shel bor

Rabbi yose omer af al pi shehabbor kodemet leilan lo yakotz shezze chofer betoch shello veze notea betoch shello amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose amar rav ashe ki havan be rav kahana hava amrinan mode rabbi yose begire dideh

Papi yonaa ani veheeshir hava bena appadna hao hanach atzore beshivavuteh dechi hao dayeki shumsheme hava nayeda appadneh ata lekammeh derav ashe amar leh ki havan be rav kahana hava amrinan mode rabbi yose begire dileh
Vechamma

a: Kidnayed nichtema appummeh dechatzba

Deve bar mariyyon bereh deravin ki hava naftzi kitana hava azla rakta umazzeka inashe ato lekammeh deravina amar lehu ki amrinan mode rabbi yose begire dileh hane mile deka azla mikkocho hacha zika hu deka mamte lah
Matkef lah mar bar rav ashe may shena mizzore veruach mesayyato amruha kammeh demarimar amar lehu hayenu zore veruach mesayyato
Ulravina may shena miggetz hayyotze mittachat happattish vehizzik dechayyav leshallem hatam nicha leh delezil hacha la nicha leh delezil
Matni lo yitta adam ilan samuch lisde chavero ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot echad gefanim veechad kol ilan haya gader benatayim ze somech laggader mikkan veze somech laggader mikkan
Hau shorashim yotzim letoch shel chavero maamik shelosha tefachim kede shello yeakkev et hammacharesha haya chofer bor shiach umara kotzetz veored vehaetzim shello

Gema tana arba ammot sheamru kede avodat hakkerem amar shemuel lo shanu ella beeretz yisrael aval bevavel shette ammot tanya name hachi lo yitta adam ilan samuch lisde chavero ella im ken hirchik mimmennu shette ammot veha anan tenan arba ammot ella lav kedishmuel shema minah
Veika derame lah mirme tenan lo yitta adam ilan samuch lisde chavero ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot vehatanya shette ammot amar shemuel la kashya kan bevavel kan beeretz yisrael

Rava bar rav chanan hao leh hanhu dikle ammitzra defardesa derav yosef hao atu tzippore yatvi bedikle venachati befardesa umafsedi leh amar leh zil kotz amar leh veha archeki li amar leh hane mile leilanot aval ligfanim bainan tefe
Veha anan tenan echad gefanim veechad kol ilan amar leh hane mile ilan leilan ugfanim ligfanim aval ilan ligfanim bainan tefe
Amar leh ana la kayetzna deamar rav hay dikla detaen kabba asur lemiktzeyeh veamar rabbi chanina la shechev shichchat beri ella dekatz teenta bela zimneh mar i nicha leh likotz

Rav pappa hao leh hanhu dikle ammitzra derav huna bereh derav yehoshua azal ashkecheh dahava chafar veka kaetz shorashav amar leh may hay amar leh tenan hau shorashim yotzim letoch shel chavero maamik shelosha kede shello yeakkev hammacharesha

Amar leh hane mile shelosha mar ka chafar tefe amar leh ana borot shichin umarot ka chafarna ditnan haya chofer bor shiach umara kotzetz veored vehaetzim shello amar rav pappa amari leh kullehi vela yecheli leh
b: Ad daamari leh ha deamar rav yehuda metzer shehecheziku bo rabbim asur lekalkelo levatar dinfak amar ammay la amari leh kan betoch shesh esre amma kan chutz leshesh esre amma
Haya chofer bor shiach umara kotzetz veored vehaetzim shello vechu bea mineh yaakov hadyava merav chisda etzim shel mi
Amar leh tenetuha shorshe ilan shel hedot habbain beshel hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin
I amratte bishlama batar ilan azlinan mishshum hachi lo moalin ella i amratte batar karka azlinan ammay lo moalin
Ella may batar ilan azlinan ema sefa shel hekdesh habbaim beshel hedot lo nehenin velo moalin vei batar ilan azlinan ammay lo moalin
Mide irya begidulin habbain leachar mikkan askinan veka savar en meila begidulin
Ravina amar la kashya kan betoch shesh esre amma kan chutz leshesh esre amma
Amar ulla ilan hassamuch lammetzer betoch shesh esre amma gazlan hu veen meviin mimmennu bikkurim
Mena leh leulla ha ilema midditnan eser netiot hamfuzzarot betoch bet sea chorshin kol bet sea bishvilan ad rosh hashshana
Kamma hau lehu tere alfin vachamesh mea garmide lechol chad vechad kamma mate leh matan vechamshin ha la have deulla
Veella midditnan shelosha ilanot shel shelosha bene adam hare ellu mitztarfin vechorshin kol

a: Bet sea bishvilan kamma hau lehu tere alfe vachamesh mea garmide lechol chad kamma mate leh tamne mea utlatin utlata vetilta akkatti nefishi leh deulla la dak
Emor deamrinan la dak lechumra lekulla la dak mi amrinan
Mi savratte beribua ka amrinan beigula ka amrinan
Mikkede kamma merubba yoter al haigul revia pashu lehu sheva mea veshittin utmanya akkatti pash leh palga deammeta hayenu dela dak ulchumra la dak
Ta shema hakkone ilan vekarkao mevi vekore may lav kol shehu lo shesh esre amma
Ta shema kana shene ilanot betoch shel chavero mevi veeno kore ha shelosha mevi vekore may lav kol shehu la hacha name shesh esre amma
Ta shema rabbi akiva omer karka kol shehu chayyav bappea uvabbikkurim vechotvin alav perozbul
b: Veniknin immah nechasim sheen lahem achraut hacha bemay askinan bechite
Dayeka name dekatane kol shehu shema minah
Ta shema ilan miktzato baaretz umiktzato bechutz laaretz tevel vechullin meoravin ze baze divre rabbi
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer haggadel bechiyyuv chayyav haggadel biftur patur
Ad kan la peligi ella demar savar yesh berera umar savar en berera
Aval gadel biftur divre hakkol patur
Hacha bemay askinan demafsik tzunma i hachi may tameh derabbi dehadri orvi
Uvmay ka mipalgi mar savar avera mevalbel umar savar hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae
Veshesh esre amma vetu la veha tenan marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma amar abbaye mezal tuva azli achchoshe la machchashi ella ad shesh esre amma tefe la machchashi
Ki ata rav dimi amar bea mineh resh lakish merabbi yochanan ilan hassamuch lammetzer betoch shesh esre amma mahu amar leh gazlan hu veen meviin mimmennu bikkurim
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan echad ilan hassamuch lammetzer veechad ilan hannote mevi vekore sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz

Matni ilan shehu note lisde chavero kotzetz melo hammardea al gabbe hammacharesha uvecharuv uvashshikma keneged hammishkolet bet hashshelachin kol hailan keneged hammishkolet abba shaul omer kol ilan serak keneged hammishkolet
Gema ibaya lehu abba shaul aresha kae o assefa kae
Ta shema detanya bet hashshelachin abba shaul omer kol hailan keneged hammishkolet mippene shehatztzel ra levet hashshelachin shema minah aresha kae shema minah

Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane kol ilan serak i amratte bishlama aresha kae hayenu dekatane kol ilan ella i amratte assefa kae ilan serak mibe leh ella lav shema minah aresha kae shema minah

Matni ilan shehu note lirshut harabbim kotzetz kede sheyehe gamal over verochvo rabbi yehuda omer gamal taun pishtan o chavile zemorot rabbi shimon omer kol hailan keneged hammishkolet mippene hattuma
Gema man tena devinzakin batar umdana dehashta azlinan
Amar resh lakish bemachaloket shenuya verabbi eliezer hi ditnan en osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim borot shichin umarot rabbi eliezer mattir bichde shettehe agala mehallechet utunah avanim
Rabbi yochanan amar afilu tema rabbanan hatam zimnin demafchit velav addateh aval hacha kamma kamma ka keyitz leh
Rabbi yehuda omer gamal taun pishtan o chavile zemorot ibaya lehu shiura derabbi yehuda nefish o dilma shiura derabbanan nefish

Peshita deshiura derabbanan nefish dei salka datach shiura derabbi yehuda nefish rabbanan beshiura derabbi yehuda hechi avdi veella may shiura derabbanan nefish rabbi yehuda beshiura derabbanan may aved efshar digchin vechalef tuteh
Rabbi shimon omer kol hailan keneged hammishkolet mippene hattuma tana mippene ohel hattuma peshita mippene hattuma tenan
I mimmatnitin hava amena dilma mayete orev tuma veshade hatam vesagya bedachluli bealma ka mashma lan
Hadran alach la yachpor

a: Chezkat habbattim vehabborot vehashshichin vehammearot vehashshovachot vehammerchatzaot uvet habbaddin uvet hashshelachin vehaavadim vechol shehu ose perot tadir chezkatan shalosh shanim miyyom leom
Sede habbaal chezkatah shalosh shanim veenan miyyom leom
Rabbi yishmael omer shelosha chodashim barishona shelosha baacharona ushnem asar chodesh baemtza hare shemona asar chodesh
Rabbi akiva omer chodesh barishona vechodesh baacharona ushnem asar chodesh baemtza hare arbaa asar chodesh
Amar rabbi yishmael bamme devarim amurim bisde lavan aval bisde ilan kanas et tevuato umasak et zetav kanas et kayetzo hare ellu shalosh shanim

Gema amar rabbi yochanan shamati meholche usha shehau omrim minnayin lachazaka shalosh shanim mishshor hammuad ma shor hammuad kevan shennagach shalosh negichot nefak leh mechezkat tam vekam leh bechezkat muad hacha name kevan deachlah telat shenin nefak lah mershut mocher vekayema lah birshut lokeach
I ma shor hammuad ad negicha reviit la michayyav hacha name ad shana reviit la kayema birshuteh hachi hashta hatam mikki negach shalosh negichot have muad
b: Veidach ki la negach may leshallem hacha kevan deachlah telat shene kayema lah birshuteh
Ella meatta chazaka sheen immah taana tehve chazaka allema tenan kol chazaka sheen immah taana enah chazaka
Tama may deamrinan dilma kidkaamar hashta ihu la taen anan liton leh
Matkef lah rav avira ella meatta mechaa shello befanav la tehve mechaa dumya deshor muad ma shor hammuad befanav baenan af hacha name befanav baenan
Hatam vehuad bivalav ketiv hacha chavrach chavra it leh vechavra dechavrach chavra it leh
Ulrabbi meir deamar richek negichotav chayyav kerav negichotav lo kol shekken achlah telata pere bechad yoma kegon teena leheve chazaka
Dumya deshor hammuad ma shor hammuad beidana deit leh ha negicha leta leha negicha hacha name beidana deita lehay pera leta lehay pera
Achlah telata pere bitlata yome kegon tzalaf leheve chazaka hatam pera miha iteh umigmar hu deka gamar veazel
Achlah telata pere bitlatin yome kegon aspasta leheve chazaka hechi dame dekadach veachla dekadach veachla hatam mishmat hu deka shamet veachel
Achlah telata pere bitlata yarche kegon aspasta leheve chazaka man holche usha rabbi yishmael lerabbi yishmael hachi name
Ditnan rabbi yishmael omer bamme devarim amurim bisde hallavan aval bisde ilan kanas et tevuato umasak et zetav vechanas et kayetzo hare ellu shalosh shanim
Lerabbanan may
Amar rav yosef kera ketiv sadot bakkesef yiknu vechatov bassefer vechatom shehare navi omed beeser umazhir al achat esre
Amar leh abbaye dilma hatam etza tova ka mashma lan

a: Dei la tema hachi benu vattim veshevu venitu gannot veichlu et piryan may kaamar ella etza tova ka mashma lan hacha name etza tova ka mashma lan tidda dichtiv untattam bichli chares lemaan yaamdu yamim rabbim
Ella amar rava shatta kammayeta machel inish tarte machel telat la machel
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta ki hadra ara tihdar levar mippere allema amar rav nachman hadra ara vehadri pere
Ella amar rava shatta kammayeta la kafed inish tarte la kafed telat kafed
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta kegon hane deve bar elyashiv dekafdi afilu amman dechalef ammitzra didhu hachi name dilaltar have chazaka vechi tema hachi name im ken natatta devarecha leshiurin
Ella amar rava shatta kammayeta mizdehar inish bishtareh tarte utlat mizdehar tefe la mizdehar
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta mechaa shello befanav la tihve mechaa daamar leh i machet beappay hava mizdeharna bishtaray
Deamar leh chavrach chavra it leh vechavra dechavrach chavra it leh

Amar rav huna shalosh shanim sheamru hu sheachalan retzufot may kamashma lan tenena chezkatan shalosh shanim miyyom leom mahu detema miyyom leom leappoke mekuttaot ulolam afilu mefuzzarot ka mashma lan
Amar rav chama umode rav huna beatre demovri bage
Peshita la tzericha deika demovar veika dela movar vehay gavra movrah mahu detema amar leh im ita dedidach havay ibi lach lemizreah ka mashma lan daamar leh chada ara bechulleh baga la matzena lintar
Vei name behachi nicha li deavda tefe
Tenan chezkat habbattim veha battim devimama yadi belelya la yadi
Amar abbaye man mashed abbattim shivave shivave mida yadi bimama uvlelya
Rava amar kegon deatu be tere veamri anan agrinan mineh vedarenan beh telat shenin bimama uvlelya
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe hane nogin beedutan hen dei la amri hachi amrinan lehu zilu havu leh agar beta lehay
Amar leh dayyane dishfili hachi dayani mi la askinan kegon dinkiti agar beta veamri leman litveh
Amar mar zutra vei taen veamar leto tere sahadi leashode leh dedar beh telat shene bimama uvlelya taneteh taana
b: Umode mar zutra berochlin hammachazirin baayarot deaf al gav dela taan taaninan leh anan
Umode rav huna bechanvata demachoza delimama avida lelelya la avida
Rame bar chama verav ukva bar chama zevun hahi ammeta bahade hadade mar ishtammash bah rishona shelishit vachamishit umar ishtammash bah sheniyya reviit veshishshit nefak arar ilavah
Ato lekammeh derava amar lehu may tama avditu hachi ki hechi dela tachzeku ahadade ki hechi dildidchu la have chazaka lealma name la have chazaka
Vela amaran ella dela ketuv itra aval ketuv itra kala it leh
Amar rava achalah kullah chutz mibbet rova kana kullah chutz mibbet rova
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua vela amaran ella devar zeria hi aval lav bar zeria hi kane lah aggav ara
Matkef lah rav bivi bar abbaye ella meatta tzunma bamme yikne ella beokome bah chevata umishtecha bah pere hacha name ibi leh leokome bah chevata i name mishtecha bah pere
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh may baet behay beta amar leh minach zeventeh vaachalit shene chazaka amar leh ana bishchune gauoe havay
Ata lekammeh derav nachman amar leh zil beror achiltach amar leh rava hachi dina hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Verame derava adderava verame derav nachman adderav nachman dehahu

a: Daamar leh lechavreh kol nichse deve bar sisin mezabbena lach havay hahi ara dahava mikre deve bar sisin amar leh ha lav deve bar sisin hi veikroye hu demikarya deve bar sisin ato lekammeh derav nachman okma bida delokeach amar leh rava dina hachi hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Kashya derava adderava kashya derav nachman adderav nachman
Derava adderava la kashya hatam mocher kae benichseh hacha lokeach kae benichseh

Derav nachman adderav nachman name la kashya kevan daamar leh deve bar sisin umikarya deve bar sisin aleh dideh ramya legalloye delav deve bar sisin hi aval hacha lo yehe ella denaket shetara mi la amrinan leh kayyem shetarach vekum benichse

Hahu daamar leh lechavreh may baet behay beta amar leh minach zeventeh vaachalteh shene chazaka amar leh beshuke barae havay amar leh veha it li sahadi dechol shatta hava atet telatin yome amar leh telatin yome beshukay hava teridna amar rava avid inish dechol telatin yome terid beshuka
Hahu deamar leh lechavreh may baet behay ara amar leh mippelanya zeventah deamar li dezavnah minach amar leh atte lav ka modet
b: Dehay ara didi hi veatte la zeventah minay zil lav baal devarim didi atte amar rava dina kaamar leh
Hahu deamar leh lechavreh may baet behay ara amar leh mippelanya zeventah vaachaltiha shene chazaka amar leh pelanya gazlana hu
Amar leh veha it li sahadi daatay imlachi bach vaamarte li zil zevon amar leh hashsheni noach li harishon kashe hemennu amar rava dina kaamar leh
Keman keadmon ditnan haorer al hassade vechatum aleha beed admon omer hashsheni noach li harishon kashe hemennu vachachamim omrim ibed et zechuto
Afilu tema rabbanan hatam avad leh maase aval hacha dibbura avid inish demikre veamar

Hahu deamar leh lechavreh may baet behay ara amar leh mippelanya zeventah vaachaltiha shene chazaka amar leh pelanya gazlana hu amar leh veha it li sahadi daatet beurta vaamarte li zavnah nihali amar leh amena ezbon dinay amar rava avid inish dezaven dineh
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh may baet behay ara amar leh mippelanya zeventah vaachaltiha shene chazaka amar leh veha nekitna shetara dizvani lah mineh ha arbei shene
Amar leh mi savratte shene chazaka telat shene ka amena shene chazaka tuva ka amena amar rava avidi inashe dekaru lishne tuva shene chazaka
Vehane mile deachlah sheva dikdem chazaka dehay lishtara dehach

a: Aval shet en lecha mechaa gedola mizzo
Ze omer shel avotay veze omer shel avotay hay ayeti sahade daavahateh hi vehay ayeti sahade deachlah shene chazaka
Amar rabba ma lo leshakker i bae amar leh minach zeventah vaachaltiha shene chazaka amar leh abbaye ma li leshakker bimkom edim la amrinan
Hadar amar leh in daavahatach hi uzventah minach vehay daamari lach daavahati dismich li alah kedaavahati
Toen vechozer vetoen o en toen vechozer vetoen ulla amar toen vechozer vetoen nehardae amri eno toen vechozer vetoen
Umode ulla hecha daamar leh shel avotay velo shel avotecha deeno toen vechozer vetoen vehecha dahava kae be dina vela tean vaata meabbaray utan eno chozer vetoen may tama taneteh agmereh

Umodu nehardae hecha daamar leh shel avotay shellekachuha meavotecha dechozer vetoen vehecha deishtai mile abbaray vela tean vaata leve dina utan dechozer vetoen may tama avid inish dela megalle taneteh ella leve dina
Amar ammemar ana nehardaa ana usvira li detoen vechozer vetoen vehilcheta toen vechozer vetoen
Ze omer shel avotay veze omer shel avotay hay ayeti sahade daavahateh veachlah shene chazaka vehay ayeti sahade deachlah shene chazaka
Amar rav nachman oki achila levahade achila veoki ara bechezkat avahata amar leh rava ha edut muchcheshet hi amar leh nehi deitachchash baachilta
b: Baavahata mi ittachchash
Lema rava verav nachman biflugta derav huna verav chisda kamipalgi

Deitmar shette kitte edim hammachchishot zo et zo amar rav huna zo baa bifne atzmah umida vezo baa bifne atzmah umida verav chisda amar bahade sahade shakkare lema li lema rav nachman deamar kerav huna verava kerav chisda
Alliba derav chisda kulle alma la feligi ki peligi alliba derav huna rav nachman kerav huna verava ad kan la kaamar rav huna ella leedut acheret aval leotah edut la
Hadar ayeti sahade daavahateh hi amar rav nachman anan achatineh anan massekinan leh leziluta deve dina la chayeshinan

Metiv rava veitema rabbi zeera shenayim omrim met ushnayim omrim la met shenayim omrim nitgarsha ushnayim omrim lo nitgarsha hare zo lo tinnase veim nisset lo tetze rabbi menachem berabbi yose omer tetze
Amar rabbi menachem berabbi yose ematay ani omer tetze bizman shebbau edim veachar kach nisset aval nisset veachar kach bau edim hare zo lo tetze
Amar leh ana sevari lemebad ovada hashta deotevtan atte veotvan rav hamnuna besurya la avedna bah ovada
Nefak avad ovada man dachaza savar tauta hi bideh vela hi ella mishshum detalya beashle ravreve

Ditnan rabbi yehuda omer en maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad amar rabbi elazar ematay bimkom sheyyesh orrin aval bimkom sheen orrin maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad
Rabban shimon ben gamliel hayenu rabbi elazar vechi tema arar chad ika benayehu rabbi elazar savar arar chad

a: Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar arar tere vehaamar rabbi yochanan divre hakkol en arar pachot mishshenayim
Ella arar tere vehacha bemay askinan kegon demachzekinan leh baavuh dehay dechohen hu unfak aleh kala deven gerusha uven chalutza hu veachatineh vaata ed echad veamar dechohen hu veassekineh
Vaato be tere veamri deven gerusha vachalutza hu veachatineh vaata ed echad veamar dechohen hu udchulle alma mitztarfin edut

Vehacha bemechash leziluta deve dina ka mipalgi rabbi elazar savar kevan deachatineh la massekinan leh chayeshinan leziluta deve dina verabban shimon ben gamliel savar anan achatineh vaanan massekinan leh ulziluta deve dina la chayeshinan
Matkef lah rav ashe i hachi may irya chad afilu bitre name ella amar rav ashe dechulle alma la chayeshinan leziluta deve dina vehacha biltzaref edut ka mipalgi uviflugta dehane tannae

Detanya leolam en edutan mitztarefet ad sheyyiru shenehen keechad rabbi yehoshua ben karcha omer afilu beze achar ze en edutan mitkayyemet bevet din ad sheyyaidu shenehem keechad rabbi natan omer shomin devarav shel ze hayyom ulichsheyyavo chavero lemachar shomin devarav
Hahu daamar lechavreh may baet behay ara amar leh minach zeventah veha shetara
b: Amar leh shetara zayefa hu gechen lechesh leh lerabba in shetara zayefa hu mihu shetara mealleya hava li veirchas veamena enkot hay biday kal dehu
Amar rabba ma lo leshakker i bae amar leh shetara mealleya hu amar leh rav yosef ammay samchatte ahay shetara hay shetara chaspa bealma hu
