Hahu arva daamar leh lelove hav li mea zuzi difrati lemalve ilavach veha shetara amar leh lav peratach amar lav hadarte shekaltinhu minay

Shalchah rav idi bar avin lekammeh deabbaye ki hay gavena may shelach leh abbaye may tibe leh ha ihu deamar hilcheta keoteh derabba beara vehilcheta keoteh derav yosef bezuze dehecha deokmu zuze lokmu
Vehane mile deamar leh hadarte oziftinhu minay aval amar leh haddartinhu nihalach mechamat dahao shayefi vesummake akkatti iteh leshibuda dishtara
Rava bar sharshum nafek aleh kala deka achel ara deyatme amar leh abbaye ema li izi gufa deovada hechi hava amar leh ara bemashkanta hava naketna meavuhon deyatme vahava li

a: Zuzi acharine gabbeh vaachaltah shene mashkanta

Amena i mahdarna lah ara leyatme veamena deit li zuzi acharine gabbe daavuchon amur rabbanan habba lipara minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella bishvua ella echbesheh lishtar mashkanta veochlah shiur zuze demigo dei baena amena lekucha hi beyadi mehemanna ki amena deit li zuzi gabbayechu mehemanna
Amar leh lekucha beyadi la matzet amratte deha ika alah kala deara deyatme hi ella zil ahderah nihalayehu vechi gadli yatme ishtai dina bahadayehu
Keriveh derav idi bar avin shechev ushvak dikla rav idi bar avin amar ana karivna tefe vehahu gavra amar ana karivna tefe lesof odi leh deihu kariv tefe okmah rav chisda bideh
Amar leh lahdar li pere daachal mehahu yoma ad hashta amar ze hu sheomrim alav adam gadol hu amman ka semich mar ahay ha kaamar daana mekaravna tefe abbaye verava la sevira lehu ha derav chisda
b: Kevan deodi odi
Ze omer shel avotay veze omer shel avotay hay ayeti sahadi daavahateh hu vehay ayeti sahadi daachal shene chazaka
Amar rav chisda ma lo leshakker i bae amar leh minach zeventah vaachaltiha shene chazaka abbaye verava la sevira lehu ha derav chisda ma li leshakker bimkom edim la amrinan
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh may baet behay ara amar leh minach zevani vaachaltiha shene chazaka azal ayeti sahadi deachlah tarte shene amar rav nachman hadra ara vehadri pere

Amar rav zevid im taan veamar leferot yaradti neeman lav mi amar rav yehuda hay man denaket maggala vetuvalya veamar ezil egdereh ledikla diflanya dezabbeneh nihali meheman alma la chatzif inish degazar dikla delav dileh hacha name la chatzif inish lemechal pere delav dileh
I hachi ara name ara amrinan leh achvi shetarach i hachi pere name shetara lefere la avdi inashe
Hahu daamar lechavreh may baet behay ara amar leh minach zevanit vaachaltiha shene chazaka ayeti chad sahada deachlah telat shene sevur rabbanan kammeh deabbaye lememar hayenu nesacha derabbi abba
Dehahu gavra dachataf nesacha mechavreh ata lekammeh derabbi amme hava yatev rabbi abba kammeh ayeti chad sahada demichtaf chatafa mineh amar leh in chatafi vedidi chatafi amar rabbi amme

a: Hechi nidayenuh dayyane lehay dina lishallem leka tere sahadi liftereh ika chad sahada lishteva ha amar michtaf chatfah vechevan deamar dechatfah have leh kegazlan
Amar lehu rabbi abba have mechuyyav shevua sheeno yachol lishava vechol hamchuyyav shevua sheeno yachol lishava meshallem
Amar lehu abbaye mi dame hatam sahada leoroe kaate ki ate acharina bahadeh mappekinan lah mineh hacha lesayyoe ka ate ki ata acharina mokminan lah bideh
Ella i damya ha derabbi abba lechad sahada ultarte shene ulfere
b: Hahu arba dahao mintzu alah be tere hay amar didi hi vehay amar didi hi ata chad minayehu leve dina veamar tifsuha addemayetena sahade dedidi hi tafsinan o la tafsinan rav huna amar tafsinan rav yehuda amar la tafsinan
Azal vela ashkach sahade amar lehu appekuha vechol deallim gavar mappekinan o la mappekinan rav yehuda amar la mappekinan rav pappa amar mappekinan vehilcheta la tafsinan vehecha ditfas la mappekinan
Ze omer shel avotay veze omer shel avotay amar rav nachman kol deallim gavar umay shena mishshene shetarot hayyotzin beom echad

a: Derav amar yachloku ushmuel amar shuda dedayyane hatam leka lemekam alah demilta hacha ika lemekam alah demilta
Umay shena meha ditnan hammachalif para bachamor veyalda vechen hammocher shifchato veyalda ze omer ad shello macharti yalda veze omer mishshellakachti yalda yachloku
Hatam lehay
b: It leh derara demamona ulhahu it leh derara demamona hacha i demar la demar vei demar la demar
Amri nehardae im ba echad min hashshuk vehechzik bah en motziin otah miyyado detane rabbi chiyya gazlan shel rabbim lav shemeh gazlan
Rav ashe amar leolam shemeh gazlan umay la shemeh gazlan shello nitan lehishshavon

Chozkatan shalosh shanim miyyom leom vechu amar rabbi abba i dale leh ihu gufeh tzanna defere lealtar have chazaka amar rav zevid veim taan veamar leferot horadtiv neeman vehane mile betoch shalosh aval leachar shalosh la
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana i lefira achateh may hava leh lemebad amar leh ibi leh lemachoye

Dei la tema hachi hane mashkenata desura dichtiv behu bemishlam shenayya illen tipok ara da bela kesaf i kavesh leh lishtar mashkanta gabbeh veamar lekucha hi beyadi hachi name dimheman metakkeni rabbanan mide deate beh lide peseda ella ibi leh lemachoye hacha name ibi leh lemachoye
Amar rav yehuda amar rav yisrael habba mechamat goy hare hu kegoy ma goy en lo chazaka ella bishtar af yisrael habba mechamat goy en lo chazaka ella bishtar amar rava vei amar yisrael

a: Ledidi amar li goy deminach zavnah meheman mi ika mide deilu goy amar la meheman veilu amar yisrael mishshemeh degoy meheman
Ella amar rava i amar yisrael kamme didi zavnah goy minach vezabbenah nihali meheman migo dei bae amar leh ana zeventah minach
Veamar rav yehuda hay man denaket maggala vetuvalya veamar ezil egzereh ledikla diflanya dizventeh mineh meheman la chatzif inish lemigzar dikla delav dileh
Veamar rav yehuda hay man deachzek migguda daarode ulvar la have chazaka may tama memar amar kol dezara name arode achli leh
Veamar rav yehuda achalah orla enah chazaka tanya name hachi achalah orla sheviit vechilayim enah chazaka
Amar rav yosef achlah shachat la have chazaka amar rava vei betzavar machoza kayema have chazaka
Amar rav nachman tafticha la have chazaka appek kora veayyel kora la have chazaka
Vehane deve resh galuta la machzeki ban vela machzekinan behu
Vehaavadim vechu avadim yesh lahem chazaka vehaamar resh lakish haggodrot en lahen chazaka amar rava en lahen chazaka lealtar aval yesh lahen chazaka leachar shalosh shanim
Amar rava im haya katan muttal baarisa yesh lo chazaka lealtar peshita la tzericha deit leh ima mahu detema nechush dilma imeh ayyelteh lehatam kamashma lan ima la menashsheya bera

Hanhu ize daachalu chushla binhardea ata mare chushla tafsinhu vahava ka taen tuva amar avuh dishmuel yachol liton ad kede demehen dei bae amar lekuchot hen beyadi vehaamar resh lakish haggodrot en lahen chazaka shane ize dimsira leroe
Veha ika tzafra ufanya binhardea tayyai shechichi umiyeda lida meshallemi
Rabbi yishmael omer shelosha chodashim vechu lema nir ika benayehu derabbi yishmael savar nir la have chazaka verabbi akiva savar nir have chazaka
Vetisbera lerabbi akiva may irya chodesh
b: Afilu yom echad name ella dechulle alma nir la have chazaka vehacha pera rabba ufera zuta ika benayehu

Tanu rabbanan nir eno chazaka veyesh omrim hare ze chazaka man yesh omrim amar rav chisda rabbi acha hi detanya narah shana uzraah shettayim narah shettayim uzraah shana enah chazaka rabbi acha omer hare zo chazaka

Amar rav ashe sheelit kol gedole haddor veamru li nir hare ze chazaka amar leh rav bivi lerav nachman may tama deman deamar nir have chazaka la avid inish decharvu leh leareh veshatek umay tama deman deamar nir la have chazaka memar amar kol shiba veshiba dichrava leayyel beh
Shelachu leh bene pum nahara lerav nachman bar rav chisda yelammedenu rabbenu nira have chazaka o la have chazaka amar lehu rabbi acha vechol gedole haddor amri nir hare ze chazaka
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak revuta lemichshav gavre ha rav ushmuel bevavel verabbi yishmael verabbi akiva beeretz yisrael amri nir la have chazaka

Rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva matnitin hi rav may hi deamar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva aval chachamim omrim chezkatah shalosh shanim miyyom leom miyyom leom lemaote may lav lemaote nir dela

Shemuel may hi deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel zo divre rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva aval chachamim omrim ad sheyyigdor shalosh gederot veyivtzor shalosh betzirot veyimsok shalosh mesikot may benayehu amar abbaye dekel naara ika benayehu sheose shalosh peamim beshana

Amar rabbi yishmael bamme devarim amurim bisde hallavan amar abbaye midderabbi yishmael nishma lerabbanan hau lo sheloshim ilanot mimmatta asara levet sea achal asara beshana zo vaasara beshana zo vaasara beshana zo hare zo chazaka

a: Lav mi amar rabbi yishmael chad pera have chazaka lechullehu pere hacha name hane hau chazaka lehane vehane hau chazaka lehane
Vehane mile hecha dela appiku aval appiku vela achal la haveya chazaka vehu devazi bazoze

Ze hechzik bailanot veze hechzik bakkarka amar rav zevid ze kana ilanot veze kana karka matkef lah rav pappa im ken en lo levaal ilanot bakkarka kelum lema leh baal karka levaal ilanot akor ilanach shekol vezil ella amar rav pappa ze kana ilanot vachatzi karka vaze kana chatzi karka
Peshita machar karka veshiyyer ilanot lefanav yesh lo karka vaafilu lerabbi akiva deamar mocher beayin yafa mocher hane mile gabbe bor vadut
Dela machchashu beara aval ilanot
b: Dekamachchashi beara shayyore shayyar dei la shayyar lema leh akor ilana vezil
Machar ilanot veshiyyer karka lefanav pelugta derabbi akiva verabbanan lerabbi akiva deamar mocher beayin yafa mocher it leh lerabbanan let leh
Lerabbi akiva it leh vaafilu lerav zevid deamar en lo hane mile gabbe shene lakochot deamar leh ki hechi dildidi let li beilanot ledidach name let lach bekarka aval hacha mocher beayin yafa mocher

Lerabbanan let leh vaafilu lerav pappa deamar yesh lo hane mile gabbe shene lakochot deamar leh ki hechi dildidach zabben beayin yafa ledidi name zabben beayin yafa aval hacha mocher beayin raa mocher
Amri nehardae achalan retzufin en lo chazaka matkef lah rava ella meatta hay meshara deaspasta bemay kane lah ella amar rava mecharan retzufin en lo karka
Amar rabbi zera ketannae kerem shehu natua al pachot mearba ammot rabbi shimon omer eno kerem vachachamim omrim hare zo kerem veroin et haemtzaiyyim keilu enan
Amri nehardae hay man dezaven dikla lechavreh kane leh mishshippuleh ad tehoma

a: Matkef lah rava velema leh kurkema derishka zabbeni lach akor kurkema derishka vezil ella amar rava beva mechamat taana
Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe vei kurkema derishka zabben leh may hava leh lemebad ibi leh lemachoye

Dei la tema hachi hane mashkenata desura dichtiv behi hachi bemishlam shenayya illen tipok ara da bela kesaf i kavesh leh lishtar mashkanta veamar lekucha hi beyadi hachi name dimheman metakkeni rabbanan milta deate bah lide feseda ella ibi leh lemachoye hacha name ibi leh lemachoye

Matni shalosh aratzot lachazaka yehuda veever hayyarden vehaggalil haya bihuda vehechezik baggalil baggalil vehechezik bihuda enah chazaka ad sheyehe immo bimdina achat amar rabbi yehuda lo amru shalosh shanim ella kede sheyehe beaspamya veyachzik shana yelchu veodiuhu shana veyavo leshana acheret
Gema may kasavar tanna kamma i kasavar mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa afilu yehuda vegalil name i kasavar mechaa shello befanav la haveya mechaa afilu yehuda vihuda name la
Amar rabbi abba bar memel amar rav leolam kasavar mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa umishnatenu bishat cherum shanu umay shena yehuda vegalil denaket
Ha ka mashma lan
b: Distam yehuda uglil kishat cherum damu
Amar rav yehuda amar rav en machazikin benichse voreach ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li vechi limchot befanav hu tzarich
Verav may ka mashma lan mechaa shello befanav la haveya mechaa vehaamar rav mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa rav tama detanna didan kamfaresh veleh la sevira leh
Veika deamri amar rav yehuda amar rav machazikim benichse voreach ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li peshita vechi limchot befanav hu tzarich
Verav may ka mashma lan mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa veha amrah rav chada zimna ella ha ka mashma lan daafilu micha bifne shenayim sheen yecholin lomar lo haveya mechaa

Deamar rav anan ledidi mipparsha li mineh demar shemuel micha bifne shene bene adam sheyecholim lomar lo haveya mechaa micha bifne shene bene adam sheen yecholin lomar lo la haveya mechaa verav chavrach chavra it leh vechavra dechavrach chavra it leh
Amar rava hilcheta en machzikin benichse voreach umechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa tarte la kashya kan boreach mechamat mamon kan boreach mechamat meradin
Hechi dame mechaa amar rav zevid pelanya gazlana hu la haveya mechaa pelanya gazlana hu denaket lah learay begazlanuta

a: Velimchar tavana leh bedina haveya mechaa
Amar la temru leh may amar rav zevid ha kaamar la temru leh rav pappa amar ledideh la temru leh leacharine emaru lehu chavrach chavra it leh chavra dechavrach chavra it leh
Amaru leh la amrinan leh amar rav zevid ha ka amaru leh la amrinan leh rav pappa amar ledideh la amrinan leh leacharine amri lehu chavrach chavra it leh vechavra dechavrach chavra it leh

Amar lehu la tipok lechu shuta amar rav zevid ha kaamar la tipok lechu shuta amaru leh la mappekinan shuta amar rav pappa ha kaamri leh la mappekinan shuta rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar kol milta dela ramya aleh deinish amar lah velav addateh

Amar rava amar rav nachman mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa etiveh rava lerav nachman amar rabbi yehuda lo amru shalosh shanim ella kede sheyehe beaspamya veyachzik shana veyelchu veodiuhu shana veyavo leshana acheret vei salka datach mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa lema li lemete litev hatam adduchteh velimache hatam etza tova ka mashma lan denete venishkol ara ufere
Middeka motev leh rava lerav nachman mikkelal dela sevira leh demechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa vehaamar rava mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa batar deshamah merav nachman savrah

Ashkechinhu rabbi yose berabbi chanina letalmidav derabbi yochanan amar lehu mi amar rabbi yochanan mechaa bechamma rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan mechaa bifne shenayim rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan mechaa bifne shelosha
Lema bidrabba bar rav huna ka mipalgi deamar rabba bar rav huna kol milta demitamra beappe telata
b: Let bah mishshum lishana bisha man deamar bifne shenayim let leh derabba bar rav huna uman deamar bifne shelosha it leh derabba bar rav huna

La dechulle alma it lehu derabba bar rav huna vehacha beha ka mipalgi man deamar bifne shenayim kasavar mechaa shello befanav la haveya mechaa uman deamar bifne shelosha kasavar mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa
I baet ema dechulle alma mechaa shello befanav haveya mechaa vehacha beha kamipalgi man deamar bifne shenayim savar sahaduta baenan uman deamar bifne shelosha kasavar galloye milta baenan

Gidel bar minome hava leh machuyata lemachoye ashkechinhu lerav huna ulchiyya bar rav ulrav chilkiyya bar tovi dahao yatvi umacha kammayehu leshana hadar ata lemachoye amaru leh la tzerichatte hachi amar rav kevan shemmicha shana rishona shuv eno tzarich lemachot veika deamri amar leh chiyya bar rav kevan shemmicha shana rishona shuv en tzarich lemachot
Amar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara vetzarich lemachot besof kol shalosh veshalosh tahe bah rabbi yochanan vechi gazlan yesh lo chazaka gazlan salka datach ella kegazlan yesh lo chazaka
Amar rava hilcheta tzarich lemachot besof kol shalosh veshalosh tane bar kappara irer chazar veirer chazar veirer im mechamat taana rishona irer en lo chazaka veim lav yesh lo chazaka
Amar rava amar rav nachman mechaa bifne shenayim

a: Veen tzarich lomar ketovu modaa bifne shenayim veen tzarich lomar ketovu
Hodaa bifne shenayim vetzarich lomar ketovu kinyan bifne shenayim veeno tzarich lomar ketovu vekiyyum shetarot bishlosha
Siman
Amar rava i kashya li ha kashya li hay kinyan hechi dame i kemaase bet din dame live telata i la kemaase bet din dame ammay eno tzarich lomar ketovu
Batar devae hadar pashta leolam lav kemaase bet din dame vehacha tama may deeno tzarich lomar ketovu mishshum distam kinyan lichtiva omed
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu la katvinan modaa ella amman dela tzayet dina abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu afilu alay vealecha amri nehardae kol modaa
b: Dela ketiv bah anan yadinan beh beunsa diflanya lav modaa hi
Modaa demay i degita udmattanta galloye milta bealma hi vei dizvine vehaamar rava la katvinan modaa azzevine

Leolam dizvine mode rava hecha daanis uchmaase defardesa dehahu gavra demashken pardesa lechavreh litlat shenin batar deachlah telat shene chazaka amar i mezabbenatte li mutav vei la kaveshna lishtar mashkanta veamena lekucha hi beyadi kehay gavena katvinan modaa

Amar rav yehuda hay mattanta temirta la magbenan bah hechi dame mattanta temirta amar rav yosef deamar lehu lesahadi zilu ittammuru vechitvu leh veika deamri amar rav yosef dela amar lehu titvu beshuka uvvarayata vetichtevu leh may benayehu ika benayehu setama
Amar rava vehaveya modaa lachavertah amar rav pappa ha derava lav beferush itmar ella mikkelala itmar

Dehahu gavra daazal lekaddoshe itteta amara leh i katvatte li kullehu nichsach havena lach vei la la havena lach azal katveh lah lechullehu nichse ata bereh kashshisha amar leh vehahu gavra ma tihve aleh amar lehu lesahade zilu ittammuru baavar yammina vechitvu leh ato lekammeh derava amar lehu la mar kena vela mar kena
Man dachaza savar mishshum dehaveya modaa lachavertah vela hi hatam mochcha milta demechamat unsa hu dichtav lah aval hacha mar nicha leh delikne umar la nicha leh delikne
Ibaya lehu

a: Setama may ravina amar la chayeshinan rav ashe amar chayeshinan vehilcheta chayeshinan
Matni kol chazaka sheen immah taana enah chazaka ketzad amar lo ma atta ose betoch shelli vehu amar lo shello amar li adam davar meolam enah chazaka
Shemmacharta li shennatatta li bemattana avicha mechara li avicha netanah li bemattana hare zo chazaka vehabba mishshum yerushsha eno tzarich taana
Gema peshita

Mahu detema hay gavra mizban zevina leh hay ara ushtara hava leh veirchas vehay dekaamar hachi savar i amena mizban zevina li hay ara amri li achvi shetarach hilkach lema leh anan dilma shetara hava lach veirchas kegon ze petach picha laillem hu ka mashma lan
Enav siman
Rav anan shekal bidka beareh azal haddar guda beareh dechavreh ata lekammeh derav nachman amar leh zil haddar
Veha achzeki li amar leh keman kerabbi yehuda verabbi yishmael deamri kol befanav lealtar have chazaka let hilcheta keotayehu
Amar leh veha achel daata vesayya beguda bahaday amar leh mechila betaut hi atte gufach i hava yadatte la avadte ki hechi deatte la hava yadatte hu name la hava yada
Rav kahana shekal bidka beareh azal haddar guda beara dela dideh
b: Ata lekammeh derav yehuda azel ayetay tere sahade chad amar tarte utzyata al vechad amar telat utzyata al amar leh zil shallem tarte miggo telat

Amar leh keman kerabbi shimon ben elazar detanya amar rabbi shimon ben elazar lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al shette kite edim sheachat omeret mane veachat omeret matayim sheyyesh bichlal matayim mane
Al ma nechleku al kat achat sheechad omer mane veechad omer matayim shebbet shammay omrim nechleka edutan uvet hillel omrim yesh bichlal matayim mane
Amar leh veha mayetina lach igarta mimmareva deen halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar amar leh lechi tayete

Hahu gavra dedar bekashta beilita arba shene ata mare deveta ashkecheh amar leh may baet behay beta amar leh mippelanya zeventah dezavnah minach ata lekammeh derabbi chiyya amar leh i it lach sahade dedar bah ihu dizvante mineh vaafilu chad yoma okemna lah bidach vei la la

Amar rav hava yatevna kammeh dechabbivi vaamari leh vechi en adam asuy likach velimkor ballayela vachaziteh ledateh i amar leh kammay didi zavnah minach meheman migo dei bae amar leh ana zeventah minach
Amar rava keoteh derabbi chiyya mistabbera dekatane habba mishshum yerushsha eno tzarich taana taana hu dela bae ha reaya bae
Vedilma la reaya bae vela taana bae veibaet ema shane lokeach dela shade zuzi bichdi
Ibaya lehu nira bo may amar abbaye hi hi rava amar avid inish desayar areh vela zaven
Shelosha lakochot mitztarfin amar rav vechullam bishtar
Lememra desavar rav shetar it leh kala veedim let lehu kala vehaamar rav hammocher sade beedim gove minnechasim meshubadim hatam lakochot

a: Inhu afsidu annafshayehu
Umi amar rav hachi vehatnan hammalve et chavero bishtar gove minnechasim meshubadim al yede edim gove minnechasim bene chorin
Vechi tema rav tanna hu ufaleg veha rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu milve al pe eno gove lo min hayyorshim velo min hallakochot
Milve azzevine ka ramet milve ki ka yazef betzina ka yazef ki hechi dela litazlu nichseh aleh zevine man dezaven ara befarhesya zaven ki hechi delipok lah kala
Tanu rabbanan achalah haav shana vehabben shettayim haav shettayim vehabben shana haav shana vehabben shana vehallokeach shana hare zo chazaka

Lememra delokeach it leh kala urminhi achalah bifne haav shana uvifne habben shettayim bifne haav shettayim uvifne habben shana bifne haav shana uvifne habben shana uvifne lokeach shana hare zo chazaka vei salka datach lokeach it leh kala en lecha mechaa gedola mizzo
Amar rav pappa ki tanya hahi bemocher sedotav setam
Matni haummanin vehashshuttafin vehaarisin vehaappotroppin en lahem chazaka lo laish chazaka benichse ishto velo laishsha chazaka benichse baalah velo laav benichse habben velo labben benichse haav
Bamme devarim amurim bemachzik aval benoten mattana vehaachin shechalku vehammachzik benichse hagger naal vegader ufaratz kol shehu hare zo chazaka
b: Gema avuh dishmuel velevi tanu shuttaf en lo chazaka vechol shekken umman shemuel tane umman en lo chazaka aval shuttaf yesh lo chazaka veazda shemuel letameh deamar shemuel hashshuttafin machzikin ze al ze umidin ze al ze venaasim shomre sachar ze laze

Rame leh rabbi abba lerav yehuda bimarta deve rav zakkay mi amar shemuel shuttaf yesh lo chazaka vehaamar shemuel shuttaf keored birshut dame lav lememra deshuttaf en lo chazaka la kashya ha dinchet lechullah ha dinchet lefalga
Amri lah lehay gisa veamri lah lehay gisa
Ravina amar ha veha dinchet lechullah vela kashya ha deit bah din chalukah ha delet bah din chalukah
Gufa amar shemuel shuttaf keored birshut dame may ka mashma lan shuttafut en lo chazaka lema shuttaf en lo chazaka
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lomar shennotel bashshevach hammaggia lichtefayim besade sheenah asuya lita kesade haasuya lita
Umidin ze laze

a: Ammay nogin beedutan hen
Hacha bemay askinan dichtav leh din udvarim en li al sade zo vechi ketav lo may have vehatanya haomer lachavero din udvarim en li al sade zo veen li esek bah veyaday mesullakot hemenna lo amar kelum
Hacha bemay askinan keshekkanu miyyado vechi kanu miyyado may have hare maamidah bifne baal chovo
Deamar ravin bar shemuel mishshemeh dishmuel hammocher sade lachavero shello beachraut en meid lo aleha mippene shemmaamidah bifne baal chovo
Hacha bemay askinan dekabbel aleh achraut achraut deman i nema achraut dealma kol shekken denicha leh ella achraut deatya leh mechamateh

Vechi mesallek nafsheh mineh mi mistallak vehatanya bene ir shennignav sefer tora shellahen en danin bedayyane otah hair veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair veim ita lisalleku be tere minayehu velidayenu
Shane sefer tora delishmia kae
Ta shema haomer tenu mane livne iri en danin bedayyane otah hair veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair ammay lisalleku be tere nafshayehu velidayenu
Hacha name besefer tora

Ta shema haomer tenu mane laaniyye iri en danin bedayyane otah hair veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair vetisbera aniyyim shakli dayyane mipasli ella ema en danin bedayyane aniyye otah hair veen meviin reaya meaniyye otah hair veammay listalleku be tere nafshayehu velidayenu
Hacha name besefer tora veammay kare lehu aniyyim dehakkol etzel sefer tora aniyyim hen
Veibaet ema leolam kidkatane aniyyim mammash uvanye deramu alayehu vehechi dame i dekitz lehu litvu be tere minayehu may dekitz lehu velidayenu
Hacha bemay askinan dela kitz lehu veibaet ema leolam dekitz lehu venicha lehu dechevan deravach ravach
Venaashin shomre sachar ze laze
b: Ammay shemira bivalim hi amar rav pappa deamar leh shemor li hayyom vaani eshmor lecha lemachar
Tanu rabbanan machar lo bayit machar lo sade en meid lo aleha mippene sheachrauto alav machar lo para machar lo tallit meid lo aleha mippene sheen achrauto alav may shena resha umay shena sefa
Amar rav sheshet resha biruven sheggazal sade mishshimon umcharah lelevi vaata yehuda veka mearer dela lezil shimon lashed leh lelevi denicha leh dehadra
Vechevan deashed leh delevi hu hechi matze mappek lah mineh deamar yadana dehay ara delav dihuda hi uvhahu zechuta deka mappek lah millevi lapkah mihuda
Deamar hashsheni noach li harishon kashe hemennu
Vei baet ema kegon deit leh sahade lemar veit leh sahade lemar vaamur rabbanan ara hecha dekayema tekum

a: Velokmah begazlan
Mishshum deka bae lemitna sefa machar lo para machar lo tallit dedaveka machar dehave leh yeush veshinuy reshut aval lo machar dehadra leh la tena resha name machar
Vesefa name nehi demiyyaash miggufah middemeha mi miyyaash la tzericha demit gazlan ditnan haggozel umaachil et banav vehinniach lifnehem peturim milleshallem
Velokmah beoresh
Hanicha leman deamar reshut yoresh lav kirshut lokeach dame shappir ella leman deamar reshut yoresh kirshut lokeach dame may ika lememar
Veod kashya leh leabbaye mippene sheachrauto alav veen achrauto alav mippene shehi chozeret lo veenah chozeret lo mibe leh
Ella kidravin bar shemuel deamar ravin bar shemuel mishshemeh dishmuel hammocher sade lachavero shello beachraut en meid lo aleha mippene shemmaamidah bifne baal chovo
Vedaveka bayit o sade aval para vetallit la mibaya
b: Bistama dela mishtabeda leh may tama mittaltele ninhu umittaltele levaal chov la mishtabedi veaf al gav dichtav leh miggelima deal katpeh hane mile deitanhu beenayehu aval letanhu beenayehu la
Ella afilu asao appoteke name la may tama kidrava deamar rava asa avdo appoteke umcharo baal chov gove mimmennu shoro vachamoro appoteke umcharo en baal chov gove hemennu
May tama hay it leh kala veha let leh kala

Velechush dilma akni leh mittaltele aggav mekarkee deamar rabba i akni leh mittaltele aggav mekarkee kane mekarkee kane mittaltele veamar rav chisda vehu dichtav leh dela keasmachta udla ketufsa dishtare
Hacha bemay askinan kegon shellakach umachar lealtar
Velechush dilma deekne hu shamatte minah deekne kana umachar kana vehorish lo mishtabed
La tzericha dekaamri edim yadinan beh behay dela hava leh ara meolam
Vehaamar rav pappa af al gav daamur rabbanan hammocher sade lachavero shello beachraut uva baal chov utrafah eno chozer alav nimtzet sheenah shello chozer alav
Hacha bemay askinan bemakkir bah shehi bat chamoro
Verav zevid amar afilu nimtzet sheenah shello eno chozer alav daamar leh lehachi zabbeni lach shello beachraut
Gufa amar ravin bar shemuel mishshemeh dishmuel hammocher sade lachavero shello beachraut en meid lo aleha mippene shemmaamidah bifne baal chovo hechi dame

a: I deit leh ara achariti aleh dideh hadar i delet leh ara achariti may nafka leh mina
Leolam delet leh ara achariti deamar la nicha delehve love rasha velo yeshallem
Sof sof legabbe idach name love rasha velo yeshallem hu deamar lehachi zabbeni lach shello beachraut
Machrez rava veitema rav pappa desalkin leela udnachatin letatta hay bar yisrael dezaven leh chamara leyisrael chavreh veka ate goy veanes leh mineh dina hu dimfatztze leh mineh
Vela amaran ella sheeno makkir bah shehi bat chamoro aval makkir bah shehi bat chamoro la vela amaran ella dela anes leh ledideh ulukkafa aval anes leh ledideh ulukkafa la
Ammemar amar afilu leka kol hane la may tama mida yada distam goy annas hu shenneemar asher pihem dibber shave viminam yemin shaker
Umman en lo chazaka vechu amar rabba lo shanu ella shemmasar lo beedim aval masar lo shello beedim mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo lo hau devarim meolam ki amar leh name lekucha hi beyadi meheman
Amar leh abbaye i hachi afilu beedim name mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo hechzartiv lecha ki amar leh lekucha hi beyadi meheman
Amar leh rabba mi savratte
b: Hammafkid etzel chavero beedim eno tzarich lehachzir lo beedim la salka datach ella hammafkid etzel chavero beedim tzarich lehachazir lo beedim

Metivi abbaye raa avdo beyad umman vetallito beyad koves amar lo ma tivo etzlecha atta mecharto li atta netatto li bemattana lo amar kelum befanay amarta lo lemochrov velitno lo bemattana devarav kayyamin
May shena resha umay shena sefa

Amar rabba sefa beotze mittachat yede acher vekaamar leh acher befanay amarta lo lemochro velitno bemattana migo dei bae amar leh minach zevanteh ki amar leh name befanay amarta lo lemochro devarav kayyamin umheman
Katane mihat resha raa hechi dame i deika edim lema li raa nayete edim venishkol ella lav deleka edim vechi raa miha tafes leh
La leolam deika edim vehu deraa
Veha atte hu deamratte hammafkid etzel chavero beedim tzarich leforo beedim amar leh hadari bi

Metiv rava lesayyoe lerabba hannoten tallito leumman umman omer shettayim katzatzta li vehalla omer lo katzatzti lecha ella achat kol zeman shehattallit beyad umman al baal habbayit lehavi reaya netanah lo bizmanno nishba venotel avar zemanno hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Hechi dame i deika edim lichze edim may kaamri

a: Ella lav deleka edim vekatane umman meheman migo dei bae amar leh lekucha hi beyadi meheman name aagreh
La leolam deleka edim vehu delo raa
Metiv rav nachman bar yitzchak umman en lo chazaka umman hu deen lo chazaka ha acher yesh lo chazaka
Hechi dame i deika edim acher ammay yesh lo chazaka ella lav deleka edim vekatane umman en lo chazaka teuvta derabba teuvta

Tanu rabbanan nitchallefu lo kelim bechelim bevet haumman hare ze yishtammesh bahen ad sheyyavo halla veyittol et shello bevet haevel o bevet hammishte hare ze lo yishtammesh bahen ad sheyyavo halla veyittol et shello may shena resha umay shena sefa
Amar rav hava yatevna kammeh dechabbivi vaamar li vechi en adam asuy lomar laumman mechor li talliti
Amar rav chiyya bereh derav nachman lo shanu ella hu aval ishto uvanav lo vehu name la amaran ella daamar leh tallit setam aval tallitcha la hay lav tallit dideh hu

Amar leh abbaye lerava ta achvi lach rammae defumbedita may avdi amar leh hav li sarbalay lo hau devarim meolam ha it li sahadi dechazuh gabbach amar leh hahu acharina hava appekineh venechzinhu amar leh ivra la mappekna leh
Amar rava shappir kaamar leh
b: Raa tanya

Amar rav ashe vei chakkim meshave leh raa deamar leh ammay tefisatte leh lav mishshum deit lach gabbay hashta appekinhu veshayeminhu shekol atte didach veeshkol ana didi amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe matze amar leh la tzerichna leshuma didach kevar shamuha kammae dekammach
Aris en lo chazaka ammay ad haidana palga vehashta kullah amar rabbi yochanan baarise batte avot
Amar rav nachman aris shehorid arisin tachtav yesh lo chazaka may tama dela avid inash denachati arise leareh veshatek
Amar rabbi yochanan aris shechillek laarisin en lo chazaka may tama emor harmanya bealma shavveuh
Shelach leh rav nachman bar rav chisda lerav nachman bar yaakov yelammedenu rabbenu aris meid o eno meid hava yatev rav yosef kammeh amar leh hachi amar shemuel aris meid vehatanya eno meid
La kashya ha deika pera beara veha deleka pera beara
Amalek siman
Tanu rabbanan arev meid lallove vehu deit leh ara achariti malve meid lallove vehu deit leh ara achariti
Lokeach rishon meid lelokeach sheni vehu deit leh ara achariti

a: Kabbelan amri lah meid veamri lah eno meid amri lah meid kearev dame veamri lah eno meid denicha leh deleheo bideh tarvayehu dechi ate baal chov may devae shakel
Amar rabbi yochanan umman en lo chazaka ben umman yesh lo chazaka aris en lo chazaka ben aris yesh lo chazaka gazlan uven gazlan en lahen chazaka ben beno shel gazlan yesh lo chazaka
Hechi dame i atu betaneta daavuhon afilu hanach name la i dela atu betaneta daavuhon afilu ben gazlan name
La tzericha deka amri edim befanenu hoda lo hanach ika lememar kushta ka amri hay af al gav deodi name la meheman kidrav kahana deamar rav kahana i lav deodi leh hava mamte leh ulchamreh leshachor
Amar rava peamim sheafilu ben beno shel gazlan name en lo chazaka hechi dame kegon deka ate betaneta deabba daavuh
Hechi dame gazlan amar rabbi yochanan kegon shehuchzak al sade zo begazlanuta verav chisda amar kegon devet peloni shehorgin nefashot al iske mamon
Tanu rabbanan umman en lo chazaka yarad meummanuto yesh lo chazaka aris en lo chazaka yarad mearisuto yesh lo chazaka ben shechalak veishsha shennitgarsha hare hen kishar kol adam
Bishlama ben shechalak itzterich salka datach amena achole achel gabbeh kamashma lan dela ella ishsha shennitgarsha peshita la tzericha
b: Bimgoreshet veenah megoreshet vechidrabbi zera deamar rabbi zera amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar shemuel kol makom sheamru chachamim megoreshet veenah megoreshet balah chayyav bimzonoteha
Amar rav nachman amar li huna kullan sheheviu reaya reayatan reaya umaamidin sade beyadan gazlan shehevi reaya en reayato reaya veen maamidin sade beyado
May ka mashma lan tenena lakach missikarikon vechazar velakach mibbaal habbayit mikkacho batel
Leappoke midderav deamar rav lo shanu ella daamar leh lech chazek ukni aval bishtar kana
Ka mashma lan kedishmuel deamar af bishtar name lo kana ad sheyyichtov achraut nechasim

Verav bivi mesayyem bah mishshemeh derav nachman karka en lo aval maot yesh lo bamme devarim amurim sheamru edim befanenu mana lo aval amru edim befanenu hoda lo lo kidrav kahana deamar i lav deodi leh hava mamte leh ledideh velachamareh leshachor
Amar rav huna taluhu vezabben zevineh zevine may tama kol dimzabben inish i lav daanis la hava mezabben vaafilu hachi zevineh zevine vedilma shane unsa denafsheh meunsa deacharine ella kidtanya

a: Yakriv oto melammed shekkofin oto yachol beal korcho talmud lomar lirtzono ha ketzad kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani
Vedilma shane hatam denicha leh detihve leh kappara veella missefa vechen atta omer begite nashim kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani
Vedilma shane hatam demitzva lishmoa divre chachamim ella sevara hu aggav unseh gamar umakne
Motev rav yehuda get hamusse beyisrael kasher uvgoyim pasul uvgoyim chovtin oto veomrin lo ase ma sheyyisrael omer lach veammay hatam name nema aggav unseh gamar umgaresh
Ha itmar alah amar rav mesharsheya devar tora afilu begoyim kasher uma taam amru begoyim pasul kede shello tehe kol achat veachat holechet vetola atzmah beyad goy umafkaat atzmah miyyad balah
Motev rav hamnuna lakach missikarikon vechazar velakach mibbaal habbayit mikkacho batel veammay hatam name nema aggav unseh gemar umakne
Ha ittemar alah amar rav lo shanu ella daamar leh lech chazek ukni aval bishtar kana
Velishmuel deamar af bishtar name lo kana may ika lememar mode shemuel hecha dihav zuze
Ulrav bivi dimsayyem bah mishshemeh derav nachman karka en lo maot yesh lo may ika lememar rav bivi memra hu umemra lerav huna la sevira leh
Amar rava hilcheta taluhu vezabben zevineh zevine vela amaran ella
b: Besade setam aval besade zo lo
Uvsade zo name la amaran ella dela artzi zuze aval artzi zuze la
Vela amaran ella dela hava leishtemote aval hava leh leishtemote la
Vehilcheta bechullehu dehau zevineh zevine vaafilu besade zo deha ishsha kesade zo damya veamar ammemar taluha vekaddesh kiddushav kiddushin
Mar bar rav ashe amar beishsha vadday kiddushin la hau hu asa shello kahogen lefichach asu immo shello kahogen veafkeinhu rabbanan lekidusheh mineh
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe tinach dekaddesh bechaspa kaddesh bevia may ika lememar amar leh shavveuh rabbanan livilato beilat zenut
Tavi tela lefapi akkinara vezabben chatam rabba bar bar chana ammodaa veaashkalta amar rav huna man dechatem ammodaa shappir chatem uman dechatem aashkalta shappir chatem
Ma nafshach i modaa la ashkalta vei ashkalta la modaa hachi kaamar i lav modaa man dechatem aashkalta shappir chatem rav huna letameh deamar rav huna taluhu vezabben zevineh zevine
Ini vehaamar rav nachman haedim sheamru amana hau devarenu

a: En neemanim modaa hau devarenu en neemanin
Hane mile al pe dela ate al pe umara lishtara aval bishtara ate shetara umara lishtara
Gufa amar rav nachman amana hau devarenu en neemanin modaa hau devarenu en neemanin
Umar bar rav ashe amar amana hau devarenu en neemanin modaa hau devarenu neemanin may tama shezze nitan likatev veze lo nitan likatev
Velo laish chazaka benichse ishto vechu peshita kevan deit leh lefera pera hu dekaachel
La tzericha dichtav lah din udvarim en li binchasayich
Vechi ketav lah may have vehatanya haomer lachavero din udvarim en li al sade zo veen li esek bah veyaday mesullakot mimmenna lo amar kelum
Amri lah deve rabbi yannay matnitin bechotev lah veodah arusa vechidrav kahana deamar rav kahana
b: Nachala habbaa lo leadam mimmakom acher adam matne aleha shello yirashenna vechidrava deamar rava kol haomer i efshi betakkanat chachamim kegon zot shomin lo
May kegon zot kidrav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav yechola ishsha shettomar levalah eni nizonet veeni osa
Ha reaya yesh tema nachat ruach asiti levali
Mi la tenan lakach min haish vechazar velakach min haishsha mikkacho batel alma amra nachat ruach asiti levali hacha name tema nachat ruach asiti levali
Ha itmar alah amar rabba bar rav huna lo nitzrecha ella beotan shalosh sadot achat shekkatav lah bichtubbatah

a: Veachat sheyyiched lah bichtubbatah veachat shehichnisa lo shum mishshellah
Lemaote may ilema lemaote shear nechasim kol shekken dehaveya leh eva deamar lah enayich natatte begerushin uvmita
Ella lemaote nichse melog haamar ammemar ish veishsha shemmachru benichse melog lo asu velo kelum

Ki itmar deammemar hecha dezabben ihu umit atya ihi umappeka i name zabbina ihi umita ate ihu umappek betakkanta derabbanan vechidrabbi yose bar chanina deamar rabbi yose bar chanina beusha hitkinu haishsha shemmachra benichse melog umeta habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot
Aval hecha dezabbinu tarvayehu lealma i name zabbina ihi ledideh zevinah zevine
Veibaet ema ammemar deamar kerabbi elazar
Detanya hammocher et avdo ufasak immo sheyeshammeshennu sheloshim yom
Rabbi meir omer harishon yeshno bedin yom o yomayim mippene shehu tachtav vehashsheni eno bedin yom o yomayim mippene sheeno tachtav
Kasavar kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame
Rabbi yehuda omer hashsheni yeshno bedin yom o yomayim mippene shehu kaspo harishon eno bedin yom o yomayim sheeno kaspo kasavar kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame
Rabbi yose omer
b: Shenehem yeshnan bedin yom o yomayim ze mippene shehu tachtav veze mippene shehu kaspo umsappeka leh i kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame i lav kekinyan hagguf dame vesafek nefashot lehakel
Rabbi elazar omer shenehem enan bedin yom o yomayim ze lefi sheeno tachtav veze lefi sheeno kaspo
Veamar rava may tama derabbi elazar amar kera lo yukkam ki chaspo hu kaspo hamuchad lo
Velo laish chazaka benichse ishto vehaamar rav eshet ish tzericha lemachot beman ilema beacher vehaamar rav en machazikin benichse eshet ish ella lav bevaal
Amar rava leolam bevaal uchgon shechafar bah borot shichin umarot
Vehaamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh en chazaka linzakin
Ema en din chazaka linzakin
I baet ema lav itmar alah rav mari amar bekutra rav zevid amar bevet hakkisse

Rav yosef amar leolam beacher uchgon sheachalah miktzat chazaka bechayye habbaal veshalosh leachar mitat habbaal migo dei bae amar lah ana zeventah minach ki amar lah name atte zabbentah leh vezabbenah nihali meheman
Gufa amar rav en machzikin benichse eshet ish

a: Vedayyane gola amru machzikin amar rav halacha kedayyane gola amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav hadar beh mar mishshemateh amar lehu mistabbera amari kidrav yosef
Velo leishsha benichse valah vechu peshita kevan deit lah mezone mezone hu deka achla la tzericha deyached lah ara achariti limzonah
Ha reaya yesh lema legalloye zuze hu devae
Shamatte minah hammocher sade leishto kanta vela amrinan legalloye zuze hu devae la ema ha reaya yesh bishtar mattana
Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna la hava mar gabban beurta bitchuma deamrinan mile mealleyata amar leh may mile mealleyata amritu hammocher sade leishto kanta vela amrinan legalloye zuze hu devae
Amar leh peshita dal zuze mehacha vetikne bishtara mi la tenan nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka

Amar leh velav itmar alah amar shemuel lo shanu ella bishtar mattana aval bishtar mecher lo kana ad sheyyitten lo dameha velav motev rav hamnuna bishtar ketzad katav lo al hanneyar o al hacheres af al pi sheen bo shave peruta sadi mechura lach sadi kenuya lach hare zo mechura untuna
Velav hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah bemocher sadehu mippene raatah
Rav bivi mesayyem bah mishshemeh derav nachman verav ashe amar bemattana bikkesh litnah lo velamma katav lo bilshon mecher kede leyappot kocho
Metivi lava min haeved veshichrero min haishsha vegershah en lahen alav kelum may tama lav mishshum deamrinan legalloye zuze hu devae
Shane hatam dela nicha leh leshauoyeh nafsheh eved love leish malve
Shelach rav huna bar avin hammocher sade leishto kanta
b: Uvaal ochel perot beram rabbi abba verabbi avahu vechol gedole haddor amru bemattana bikkesh litno lah velamma katav lah leshum mecher kede leyappot et kochah
Metivi lava min haeved veshichrero min haishsha vegershah en lahen alav kelum may tama lav mishshum deamri legalloye zuze hu diva
Shane hatam dela lishave inish eved love leish malve
Amar rav hammocher sade leishto kanta vehabbaal ochel perot bemattana kanta veen habbaal ochel perot verabbi elazar amar echad ze veechad ze kanta veen habbaal ochel perot

Avad rav chisda ovada kerabbi elazar amaru leh rabban ukva verabban nechemya bene venateh derav lerav chisda shavek mar ravreve veaved kezutre amar lehu vaana name keravreve avadi dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan echad ze veechad ze kanta veen habbaal ochel perot
Amar rava hilcheta hammocher sade leishto lo kanta vehabbaal ochel perot bemattana kanta veen habbaal ochel perot tarte
La kashya kan bemaot temunin kan bemaot sheen temunin deamar rav yehuda maot temunin lo kanta maot sheenan temunin kanta

Tanu rabbanan en mekabbelin pikdonot lo min hannashim velo min haavadim velo min hattinokot kibbel min haishsha yachzir laishsha veim meta yachzir levalah kibbel min haeved yachzir laeved veim met yachzir lerabbo

a: Kibbel min hakkatan yaase lo segulla veim met yachazir leorshav
Vechullan sheamru bishat mitatan shel peloni hen yaase keferushan veim lav yaase perush leferushan
Devethu derabba bar bar chana ki ka shachva amara hane kefe demarta uvne veratta ata lekammeh derav amar leh i mehemna lach ase keferushah vei la ase perush leferushah
Veika deamri hachi amar leh i amida lach ase keferushah vei la ase perush leferushah

Veidach amar leh zimnin divitatte

Amar rav nachman

a: Velistom lealtar have chazaka sheen adam asuy shessotmim oro befanav veshotek
Lakach bayit bechatzer acheret lo yiftachennu lachatzar hashshuttafin may tama mippene shemmarbe alehem et hadderech
Ema sefa ella im ratza bone et hacheder lifnim mibbeto uvone aliyya al gabbe beto vahalo marbe alav et hadderech amar rav huna may cheder shechalako bishnayim umay aliyya appetay

Matni lo yiftach adam lachatzar hashshuttafin petach keneged petach vechallon keneged challon haya katan lo yaasennu gadol echad lo yaasennu shenayim aval poteach hu lirshut harabbim petach keneged petach vechallon keneged challon haya katan ose oto gadol veechad ose oto shenayim

Gema menahane mile amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera vayyissa vilam et enav vayyar et yisrael shochen lishvatav ma raa raa sheen pitche oholehem mechuuonin ze leze amar reuyin hallalu shettishre alehem shechina

Haya katan lo yaasennu gadol savar rame bar chama lememar bar arbee la lishavveyeh bar temanya deka shakel temanya bechatzer aval bar tarte lishavveyeh bar arbee shappir dame amar leh rava matze amar leh befitcha zutra matzena leitztenoe minach befitcha rabba la matzena itztenoe minach

Echad lo yaasennu shenayim savar rame bar chama lememar bar arbee la lishavveyeh tere bene tarte tarte deka shakel tamne bechatzer aval bar tamne lishavveyeh bene arbee arbee shappir dame amar leh rava matze amar leh bechad pitcha matzena itztenoe minach bitre la matzena itztenoe minach
Aval poteach hu lirshut harabbim petach keneged petach deamar leh sof sof ha baet itztenoe mibbene reshut harabbim

Matni en osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim borot shichin umarot rabbi eliezer mattir kede shettehe agala mehallechet utuna avanim en motziin zizin ugzuzteraot lirshut harabbim ella im ratza kones letoch shello umotzi lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugzuzteraot hare zo bechezkatah
Gema verabbanan zimnin demippechit velav addateh

En motziin zizin ugzuzteraot vechu rabbi amme hava leh ziza dahava nafek limvoa vehahu gavra name hava leh ziza dahava mappek lirshut harabbim hao ka meakkevi aleh bene reshut harabbim ata lekammeh derabbi amme amar leh zil kotz
Amar leh veha mar name it leh didi limvoa mappek bene mevoa machalin gabbay didach lirshut harabbim mappek man machel gabbach
Rabbi yannay hava leh ilan hannote lirshut harabbim hava hahu gavra dahava leh name ilan hannote lirshut harabbim ato bene reshut harabbim hao ka meakkevi ilaveh ata lekammeh derabbi yannay amar leh
b: Zil haidana veta limchar belelya shaddar katzyeh lehahu dideh
Limchar ata lekammeh amar leh zil kotz amar leh ha mar name it leh amar leh zil chazi i kutz didi kotz didach i la kutz didi la tikkotz atte

Meikara may sevar ulvassof may sevar meikara sevar nicha lehu livne reshut harabbim deyatvi betulleh kevan dachaza deka meakkevi shaddar katzyeh velema leh zil kotz didach vahadar ekkotz didi mishshum deresh lakish deamar hitkoshshu vakoshshu keshot atzmecha veachar kach keshot acherim
Aval im ratza kones letoch shello umotzi ibaya lehu kanas velo hotzi mahu sheyyachazor veotzi rabbi yochanan amar kanas motzi veresh lakish amar kanas eno motzi

Amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa asberah lach lehotzi kulle alma la peligi demotzi ki peligi lehachazir ketalim limkoman veipcha itmar rabbi yochanan amar eno machzir veresh lakish amar machzir
Rabbi yochanan amar eno machzir mishshum derav yehuda deamar rav yehuda metzer shehecheziku bo rabbim asur lekalkelo veresh lakish amar machzir hane mile hecha deleka ravecha hacha ha ika ravecha
Lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugzuzteraot hare hi bechezkatah amar rav huna nafla chozer uvone otah
Metivi en mesayedin veen mechayerin veen mefayechin bazzeman hazze lakach chatzer mesuyyedet mechuyyeret mefuyyachat hare zo bechezkatah nafla eno chozer uvone otah
Isura shane
Tanu rabbanan lo yasud adam et beto besid veim erav bo chol o teven muttar rabbi yehuda omer erav bo chol hare ze terachsid veasur teven muttar

Tanu rabbanan keshecharav habbayit bashsheniyya rabbu perushin beyisrael shello leechol basar veshello lishtot yayin nitpal lahen rabbi yehoshua amar lahen banay mippene ma i attem ochlin basar veen attem shotin yayin amru lo nochal basar shemmimmennu makrivin al gabbe mizbeach veachshav batel nishte yayin shemmenassechin al gabbe hammizbeach veachshav batel
Amar lahem im ken lechem lo nochal shekkevar batlu menachot efshar beferot perot lo nochal shekkevar batlu bikkurim efshar beferot acherim mayim lo nishte shekkevar batel nisuch hammayim shatku

Amar lahen banay bou veomar lachem shello lehitabbel kol ikar i efshar shekkevar nigzera gezera ulhitabbel yoter midday i efshar sheen gozrin gezera al hatztzibbur ella im ken rov tzibbur yecholin laamod bah dichtiv bammeera attem nearim veoti attem kovim haggoy kullo
Ella kach amru chachamim sad adam et beto besid umshayyer bo davar muat vechamma amar rav yosef amma al amma amar rav chisda keneged happetach
Ose adam kol tzorche seuda umshayyer davar muat may hi amar rav pappa kasa deharsana
Osa ishsha kol tachshiteha umshayyeret davar muat may hi amar rav bat tzida shenneemar im eshkachech yerushalam tishkach yemini tidbak leshoni lechikki vego
May al rosh simchati amar rav yitzchak ze efer mikle shebberosh chatanim amar leh rav pappa leabbaye hecha mannach leh bimkom tefilin shenneemar lasum laavele tziyyon latet lahem peer tachat efer
Vechol hammitabbel al yerushalayim zoche veroe besimchatah shenneemar simchu et yerushalami vego

Tanya amar rabbi yishmael ben elisha miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash din hu shennigzor al atzmenu shello leechol basar velo lishtot yayin ella en gozrin gezera al hatztzibbur ella im ken rov tzibbur yecholin laamod bah

Umiyyom sheppashta malchut harshaa sheggozeret alenu gezerot raot vekashot umvattelet mimmennu tora umitzot veen mannachat otanu likanes lishvua habben veamri lah lishua habben din hu shennigzor al atzmenu shello lisa ishsha ulholid banim venimtza zaro shel avraham avinu kale meelav
Ella hannach lahem leyisrael mutav sheyyihu shoggin veal yihu mezidin
Hadran alach chezkat habbattim

a: Hammocher et habbayit lo machar yatzia veaf al pi shehi petucha letocho velo et hacheder shellefanim hemennu velo et haggag bizman sheyyesh lo maake gavoha asara tefachim rabbi yehuda omer im yesh lo tzurat petach af al pi sheeno gavoha asara tefachim eno machur
Gema may yatzia hacha targimu appeta rav yosef amar badka chalila leman deamar appeta la mizdabbena kol shekken badka chalila la mizdabbena leman deamar badka chalila aval appeta mizdabbena

Tane rav yosef shalosh shemot yesh lo yatzia tzela ta yatzia dichtiv hayyatzia hattachtona chamesh baamma rochbah tzela dichtiv vehatztzelaot tzela el tzela shalosh ushloshim peamim ta dichtiv vehatta kane echad orech vekane echad rochav uven hattaim chamesh ammot vei baet ema mehacha kotel hahechal shesh vehatta shesh kotel hatta chamesh
Amar mar zutra vehu dehave arba ammot
Amar leh ravina lemar zutra ledidach deamratte ad dehave arba ammot ella meatta gabbe vor ditnan lo et habbor velo et haddut af al pi shekkatav lo umka veruma hachi name i hau arba ammot in i la la
Hachi hashta hatam ha tashmishta lechud veha tashmishta lechud hacha ide veide chada tashmishta hi i have arba ammot chashiv vei la la chashiv
Velo et hacheder shellifnim hemennu hashta yatzia la mizdabban cheder mibaya
b: La tzericha deaf al gav dimtzar leh mitzre abbaray
Kidrav nachman deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh hammocher bayit lachavero bevira gedola af al pi shemmatzar lo metzarim hachitzonim metzarim hirchiv lo
Hechi dame ilema dekaru leh levayit bayit ulvira bira peshita bayit zabben leh bira la zabben leh ella dilvira name karu lah bayit kulleh zabben leh

La tzericha derubba karu leh levayit bayit levira bira veika name dilvira karu leh bayit mahu detema kulleh zabben leh ka mashma lan middahava leh lemichtav vela shayyarit bizvini illen kelum vela ketav shema minah shayyore shayyar
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh hammocher sade lachavero bevika gedola af al pi shemmatzar lo metzarim hachitzonim metzarim hirchiv lo
Hechi dame ilema dekaru leh lesade sade ulvika bika peshita sade zabben leh bika la zabben leh veella dilvika name karu lah sade kullah zabben leh

La tzericha deika dilsade karu leh sade ulvika bika veika name dilvika karu lah sade mahu detema kulleh zabben leh ka mashma lan middahava leh lemichtav leh la shayyarit bizvine illen kodamay kelum vela ketav leh shema minah shayyore shayyar
Utzricha dei ashmeinan bayit mishshum deha tashmishta lechod veha tashmishta lechod aval bika dechullah chada tashmishta hi ema kulleh zabben leh
Vei ashmeinan bika mishshum dela hava leh lemimtzar leh aval bayit dahava leh lemimtzar leh vela metzar leh kulleh zabben leh tzericha

Keman azla ha deamar rav mari bereh devat shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh deabbaye hay man dimzabbeni leh mide lechavreh tzerich lemichtav leh la shayyarit bizvini illen kodamay kelum keman kerav nachman amar rabba bar avuh
Hahu deamar leh lechavreh ara deve chiyya mezabbenna lach havay leh tarte arata dahava mitkaryan deve chiyya amar rav ashe chada amar leh tarte la amar leh
Vei amar leh arata setama miut arata shettayim vei amar leh kol arata kol arata deit leh levar mibbustane ufardese vei amar leh zihara afilu be vustane ufardese levar mibbatte veavde

a: Vei amar leh nichse afilu batte veavde
Matzar lo metzer echad aroch umetzer echad katzar amar rav lo kana ella keneged hakkatzar
Amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav veyikne keneged rosh tor shetek rav

Umode rav hecha deika metzer reuven veshimon mechad gisa umetzer levi vihuda mechad gisa middahava leh lemichtav leh diruven keneged levi udshimon keneged yehuda vela ketav leh shema minah keneged rosh tor hu daamar leh
Metzer reuven mizrach umaarav umetzer shimon tzafon vedarom tzerich lemichtav leh metzer reuven ruchin teren umetzer shimon ruchin teren
Ibaya lehu siyyem lo et hakkeranot mahu kemin gam mahu
b: Beserugin mahu teku

Matzar lo metzer rishon umetzer sheni umetzer shelishi umetzer revii lo matzar lo amar rav kana hakkol chutz mimmetzer revii ushmuel amar afilu metzer revii verav assi amar lo kana ella telem echad al pene kullah
Savar lah kerav deamar shayyore shayyar umiddeshayyar bemetzer shayyar name bechullehi
Amar rava hilcheta kana hakkol chutz mimmetzer revii vela amaran ella dela mavla aval mavla kana

Vechi la mavla name la amaran ella deika aleh richba dedikla vehave tishat kabbin aval leka aleh richba dedikla vela have tishat kabbin kana mikkelal dechi muvla af al gav deika aleh richba dedikla vehave tishat kabbin kana
Ika deamri amar rava hilcheta kana hakkol vaafilu metzer revii vela amaran ella demavla aval la mavla la kene

Vechi mavla name la amaran ella deleka aleh richba dedikla vela have tishat kabbin aval ika aleh richba dedikla vehave tishat kabbin lo kana mikkelal dechi la muvla af al gav deleka aleh richba dedikla vela have tishat kabbin la kane

Shaminan mittarvayehu lishane derava divsade la shayyar vela mide veshaminan name dehecha demavla veleka aleh richba dedikla vela have tishat kabbin kana la mavla veika aleh richba dedikla vehave tishat kabbin lo kana
Mavla veika aleh la mavla veleka aleh ittemar lah lehay gisa veittemar lah lehay gisa shuda dedayyane
Amar rabba palga deit li beara palga palga beara deit li riva amar leh abbaye may shena hachi umay shena hachi ishtik
Amar abbaye ana savri middeishtik kabbole kabbelah vela hi chazena hanhu shetare denafki mibbe mar uchtiv behu hachi palga deit li beara palga palga beara deit li riva
Veamar rabba metzer ara deminah palga palga metzer ara deminah pesika tisha kabbin
Amar leh abbaye may shena hachi umay shena hachi ishtik sevur mina ide veide palga

a: Vela hi deamar rav yemar bar shelemya ledidi mipparsha li mineh deabbaye ben metzer ara deminah palga uven metzer ara deminah pesika i amar leh illen mitzranaha palga la amar leh illen mitzranaha tisha kabbin
Peshita amar yachalok peloni binchasay palga tenu chelek lifloni binchasay may

Amar ravina bar kisi ta shema detanya haomer tenu chelek lifloni bevor somchos omer en pachot mervia lechavit en pachot mishsheminit likdera en pachot mishshenem asar letafiach en pachot mishshishsha asar
Tanu rabbanan ben levi shemmachar sade leyisrael veamar lo al menat shemmaaser rishon shelli maaser rishon shello veim amar li ulvanay met yitten levanav
Veim amar lo kol zeman shehassade zo beyadcha mecharah vechazar ulkachah en lo alav kelum
Ammay en adam makne davar shello ba laolam kevan deamar leh al menat shemmaaser rishon shelli shayyore shayereh limkom maaser
Amar resh lakish zot omeret hammocher bayit lachavero veamar lo al menat sheddeota haelona shelli deota haelona shello
b: Lemay hilcheta rav zevid amar sheim ratza lehotzi bah zizin motzi rav pappa amar sheim ratza livnot aliyya al gabbah bone
Bishlama lerav zevid hayenu dekatane zot omeret ella lerav pappa may zot omeret kashya

Amar rav dimi minnehardea hay man dimzabben leh beta lechavreh af al gav dichtav leh umka veruma tzarich lemichtav leh keni lach mittehom ara vead rum rekia may tama deumka veruma bistama la kane ahani umka veruma lemikne umka veruma veahani mittehom ara vead rum rekia lemikne bor vadut umchilot
Lema mesayya leh velo et habbor velo et haddut af al pi shekkatav lo umka veruma vei salka datach bistama kane umka veruma lahane umka veruma lemikne bor vadut umchilot dela ketav leh
Veha af al pi shekkatav lo katane hachi kaamar af al pi shello katav lo kemi shekkatav dame lemikne umka veruma lemikne bor vadut umchilot i ketav leh umka veruma kane vei la katav la kane
Ta shema velo et haggag bizman sheyyesh lo maake gavoha asara tefachim

a: Vei salka datach bistama kane umka veruma ki gavoha asara tefachim may have kevan degavoha asara tefachim chashiv

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ta shema deamar resh lakish zot omeret hammocher bayit lachavero veamar lo al menat sheddeota haelona shelli deota haelona shello veamrinan lemay hilcheta rav zevid amar sheim ratza lehotzi bah zizin motzi rav pappa amar sheim ratza livnot aliyya al gabbah bone
Vei salka datach bistama la kane lema li al menat ahani leh al menat dei nafel hadar bane lah
Matni lo et habbor velo et haddut af al pi shekkatav lo umka veruma vetzarich likach lo derech divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim eno tzarich likach lo derech
Umode rabbi akiva bizman sheamar lo chutz meellu sheen tzarich likach derech
Mecharan leacher rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich likach lo derech vachachamim omrim tzarich likach lo derech

Gema yetev ravina veka kashya leh hayenu bor hayenu dut amar leh rava tosfaa leravina ta shema detanya echad habbor veechad haddut bekarka ella shehabbor bachafira vehaddut bevinyan yatev rav ashe veka kashya leh hayenu bor hayenu dut amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe ta shema detanya echad habbor veechad haddut bakkarka ella shehabbor bachafira vehaddut bevinyan
Vetzarich likach lo derech divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim eno tzarich vechu may lav beha ka mippalgi
b: Derabbi akiva savar mocher beayin yafa mocher verabbanan savri mocher beayin raa mocher udkaamar name bealma rabbi akiva letameh deamar mocher beayin yafa mocher mehacha
Mimmay dilma rabbi akiva savar en adam rotze sheyyitten meotav veyidresuhu acherim verabbanan savri en adam rotze sheyyittol maot veyifrach baavir
Veella missefa mecharan leacher rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich likach lo derech vachachamim omrim tzarich
Dilma behay peligi derabbi akiva savar batar data delokeach azlinan verabbanan savri batar data democher azlinan
Ella meha la et habbor velo et haggat velo et hashshovach ben charevin ben yeshuvin vetzarich likach lo derech divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim eno tzarich
Ha tu lema li ella lav ha ka mashma lan derabbi akiva savar mocher beayin yafa mocher verabbanan savri mocher beayin raa mocher
Vedilma ashmeinan bayit veka mashma lan sade utzricha dei ashmeinan bayit mishshum devae tzeniuta aval sade ema la
Vei ashmeinan sade mishshum dekashe leh davesha aval bayit ema la
Ella missefa mecharan leacher rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich likach lo derech vachachamim omrim tzarich
Ha tu lema li hayenu hach ella lav ha ka mashma lan derabbi akiva savar mocher beayin yafa mocher verabbanan savri mocher beayin raa mocher shema minah
Itmar rav huna amar rav

a: Halacha kedivre chachamim verav yirmeya bar abba amar shemuel halacha kerabbi akiva amar leh rav yirmeya bar abba lerav huna veha zimnin saggiin amritah kammeh derav hilcheta kerabbi akiva vela amar li vela mide amar leh hechi tenitah amar leh ipcha tanena mishshum hachi la amar lach vela mide
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe lema azdu letamayehu
Deamar rav nachman amar shemuel haachin shechalku en lahen lo derech ze al ze velo sullamot ze al ze velo challonot ze al ze velo ammat hammayim ze al ze
Vehizzaharu bahen shehalachot kevuot hen verav amar yesh lahen
Tzericha dei ashmeinan behahi behahi kaamar rav mishshum daamar leh baena lemedar beh ki hechi dedaru beh avahati tidda dichtiv tachat avotecha yihu vanecha aval beha ema mode leh lishmuel
Vei itmar beha behach kaamar shemuel aval beha ema mode leh lerav tzericha
Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna hilcheta keotin o hilcheta keotayechu amar leh hilcheta keotayechu dimkarvitu levava deresh galuta dishchichi dayyane
Itmar shene vattim ze lefanim mizze shenehem bemecher shenehem bemattana en lahen derech ze al ze kol shekken chitzon bemattana ufnimi bemecher
Chitzon bemecher ufnimi bemattana sevur minah en lahen derech ze al ze
Vela hi mi la tenan bamme devarim amurim bemocher aval benoten mattana noten et kullan alma man deyahev mattana beayin yafa yahev hacha name man deyahev mattana beayin yafa yahev

Matni hammocher et habbayit machar et haddelet aval lo et hammafteach machar et hammachteshet kevua aval lo et hammitaltelet machar et haitzterovel aval lo et hakkelet velo et hattannur velo et hakkirayim bizman sheamar lo hu vechol ma shebbetocho
b: Hare kullan mechurin
Gema lema matnitin dela kerabbi meir dei rabbi meir ha amar machar et hakkerem machar tashmishe cherem
Afilu tema rabbi meir hatam kevia hacha la kevia veha mafteach dumya dedelet katane ma delet dikvia af mafteach dikvia ella mechavarta matnitin dela kerabbi meir

Tanu rabbanan hammocher et habbayit machar et haddelet veet hanneger veet hammanul aval lo et hammafteach machar et hammachteshet hachakuka aval lo et hakkevua machar haitzterovel aval lo et hakkelet lo et hattannur velo et hakkirayim velo et harechayim rabbi eliezer omer kol hamchubbar lakkarka hare hu kakkarka
Bizman sheamar lo hu vechol ma shebbetocho hare kullan mechurin ben kach uven kach lo machar lo et habbor velo et haddut velo et hayyatzia
Tanu rabbanan tzinor shechakako ulvassof kevao posel et hammikve kevao ulvassof chakako eno posel et hammikve manni la rabbi eliezer vela rabbanan
He rabbi eliezer ilema rabbi eliezer devayit dilma hayenu tama derabbi eliezer savar mocher beayin yafa mocher verabbanan savri mocher beayin raa mocher
Veella rabbi eliezer dechaveret devorim ditnan kaveret devorim rabbi eliezer omer hare hi kakkarka vechotvin aleha perozbul

a: Veenah mekabbelet tuma bimkomah veharode mimmenna beshabbat chayyav chattat
Vachachamim omrim enah kakkarka veen kotvin aleha perozbul umkabbelet tuma bimkomah veharode mimmenna beshabbat patur
Hatam kidamar rabbi elazar tama deamar rabbi elazar may tama derabbi eliezer dichtiv vayyitbol otah beyarat haddevash
Ma yaar hattolesh mimmennu beshabbat chayyav chattat af devash harode mimmennu beshabbat chayyav chattat
Ella rabbi eliezer dedaf ditnan daf shel nachtomin shekkevao bakkotel rabbi eliezer metaher vachachamim metammein
Manni i rabbi eliezer afilu chakako ulvassof kevao i rabbanan afilu kevao ulvassof chakako name
Leolam rabbi eliezer hi veshane peshute chele etz detuma derabbanan
