Leolam rabbanan hi veshane sheiva derabbanan
I hachi afilu chakako ulvassof kevao name shane hatam deika torat keli alav betalush
Bae rav yosef me geshamim shechishshev alehem lehaddiach et haitzterovlin mahu lizraim
Alliba derabbi eliezer deamar kol hamchubbar lakkarka hare hu kakkarka la tibe lach ki tibe lach alliba derabbanan deamri eno kakkarka may teku
Shelach leh rav nechemya bereh derav yosef lerabba bereh derav huna zute linhardea ki atya hach itta lekammach

a: Agbah isur nichse afilu meitzterovle derechayim amar rav ashe ki havenan be rav kahana magbenan afilu meamla devatte

Matni hammocher et hechatzer machar battim borot shichin umarot aval lo et hammittaltelin bizman sheamar lo hu vechol ma shebbetocho hare kullan mechurin ben kach uven kach lo machar lo et hammerchatz velo et bet habbad shebbetochah rabbi eliezer omer hammocher et hechatzer lo machar ella avirah shel chatzer

Gema tanu rabbanan hammocher et hechatzer machar battim hachitzonim uvattim happenimim uvet hacholsaot chanuot petuchot letochah nimkarot immah vesheen petuchot letochah en nimkarot immah petuchot lechan ulchan ellu veellu nimkarot immah rabbi eliezer omer hammocher et hechatzer lo machar ella milusa shel chatzer
Amar mar petuchot lechan ulchan nimkarot immah veha tane rabbi chiyya en nimkarot immah la kashya ha derov tashmishtayehu lego ha derov tashmishtayehu levar

Rabbi eliezer omer hammocher et hechatzer lo machar ella avirah shel chatzer amar rabba i daamar leh derta dechulle alma la peligi devatte mashma ki peligi daamar leh darta mar savar tarbitza mashma umar savar batte mashma
Ika deamri amar rabba i daamar leh darta dechulle alma la peligi devatte mashma ki peligi daamar leh chatzer mar savar chatzer avera mashma umar savar kachatzar hammishkan

Veamar rabba amar rav nachman machar lo cholsit umtzula hechzik bacholsit lo kana metzula hechzik bammetzula lo kana cholsit ini veha amar shemuel machar lo eser sadot beeser medinot kevan shehechzik beachat mehen kana kullan
Hatam hu desaddana deara chad hu vechullah chada tashmishta hu aval hacha ha tashmishta lechod veha tashmishta lechod
Veika deamri
b: Amar rabba amar rav nachman hechzik bacholsit kana metzula peshita deha amar shemuel machar lo eser sadot vechu mahu detema hatam hu desaddana deara chad hu aval hacha ha tashmishta lechod veha tashmishta lechod ka mashma lan

Matni hammocher bet habbad machar et hayyam veet hammemel veet habbetulot aval lo machar et haavirim veet haggalgal veet hakkora uvizman sheamar lo hu vechol ma shebbetocho hare kullan mechurin rabbi eliezer omer hammocher bet habbad machar et hakkora
Gema yam telafcha memel amar rabbi abba bar memel mafrachta betulot amar rabbi yochanan kelonsot shel erez shemmaamidin bahen et hakkora avirim kivshe galgal chumarta kora kora

Tanu rabbanan hammocher bet habbad machar et hannesarim veet hayekavim veet hammafrechot veet harechayim hattachtonot aval lo haelona uvizman sheamar lo hu vechol ma shebbetocho hare kullan mechurin ben kach uven kach lo machar lo et haavirim velo et hassakkin velo et hammartzufin
Rabbi eliezer omer hammocher bet habbad machar et hakkora shello nikra bet habbad ella al shum kora

Matni hammocher et hammerchatz lo machar et hannesarin veet hassefalin veet habbelaniyyot bizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah hare kullan mechurin ben kach uven kach lo machar lo et hammegurot shel mayim velo et otzarot shel etzim

Gema tanu rabbanan hammocher et hammerchatz machar et bet hannesarin veet bet hayekamin veet bet hassefalim veet bet havilaot aval lo et nesarin atzman velo yekamin atzman velo sefalim atzman velo vilaot atzman uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah hare kullan mechurin ben kach uven kach lo machar lo et habberechot hamsappekot lo mayim ben

a: Bimot hachamma uvimot haggeshamim velo bet kinus haetzim veim amar lo bet hammerchatz vechol tashmishav ani mocher lach kullan mechurin
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh bet habbad vechol tashmishav ani mocher lach havaya hanhu chanvata abbaray dahao shatchu behu shumsheme ata lekammeh derav yosef

Amar leh tenena im amar bet hammerchatz vechol tashmishav ani mocher lach hare kullan mechurin amar leh abbaye veha tane rabbi chiyya en kullan mechurin ella amar rav ashe chazenan i amar leh bet habbad vechol tashmishav veillen mitzranaha kane vei la la kane

Matni hammocher et hair machar battim borot shichin umarot merchatzaot veshovachot bet habbaddin uvet hashshelachin aval lo et hammittaltelin uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah afilu hau bah behema vaavadim hare kullan mechurin rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hammocher et hair machar et hassanter
Gema amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe shamatte minah avda kemittaltela dame dei kimkarka dame nizdabban aggav mata veella may avda kemittaltela dame may afilu
Ella may it lach lememar shane ben mittaltela denayed mimmittaltela dela nayed afilu tema avda kimkarka dame shane ben mekarka denayed limkarka dela nayed

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hammocher et hair machar et hassanter may santer hacha targimu bar machonita shimon ben avtulmos omer bage man deamar bar machonita kol shekken bage man deamar bage aval bar machonita la mizdabban

Tenan bet habbaddim uvet hashshelachin savruha may shelachin bage dichtiv vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot bishlama leman deamar bar machonita amar tanna kamma bage mizdabbeni bar machonita la mizdabban vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar afilu bar machonita name mizdabban ella leman deamar bage tanna kamma name hachi kaamar
Mi savratte may shelachin bage la may shelachin ginunyata shenneemar shelachayich pardes rimmonim aval bage la mizdabbeni vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar afilu bage name mizdabbeni
Ika deamri savruha may shelachin ginunyata bishlama leman deamar bage amar tanna kamma genunayeyata mizdabban bage la mizdabbeni vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar afilu bage mizdabbeni
b: Ella leman deamar bar machonita amar tanna kamma ginunyata umahdar leh rabban shimon ben gamliel bar machonita mi savratte may shelachin ginunyata la may shelachin bage dichtiv vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot aval bar machonita la mizdabban vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar daafilu bar machonita name mizdabban
Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer santer eno machur ankulmus machur may lav middeankulmus gavra santer name gavra mide irya ha kidita veha kidita

Umi matzet amratte hachi veha katane sefa aval lo sheyareha velo benoteha velo chorashin hammuktzin lah velo bevarin shel chayya veshel ofot veshel dagim veamrinan may sheyareha bizle may bizle amar rabbi abba piske bage piske bage hu dela mizdabbeni ha bage atzman mizdabbeni
Efoch rabbi yehuda omer santer machur ankulmos eno machur

Umi matzet amratte rabbi yehuda kerabban shimon ben gamliel sevira leh veha rabbi yehuda kerabbanan sevira leh dekatane sefa aval lo sheyareha velo benoteha veilu rabban shimon ben gamliel haamar machar et hair machar benoteha detanya hammocher et hair la machar et benoteha rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hammocher et hair machar benoteha
Rabbi yehuda savar leh keoteh bachada uflig aleh bachada

Velo bevarin shel chayya veshel ofot veshel dagim urminhi hau lah banot en nimkarot immah haya lah chelek echad bayyam vechelek echad bayyabbasha bevarim shel chayya veshel ofot veshel dagim hare ellu nimkarim immah
La kashya ha dingiach kayehi legav veha dingiach kayehi levar veha ka tane velo et chorashin hammuktzin lah ema hammuktzin hemenna

Matni hammocher et hassade machar et haavanim shehem letzorkah veet hakkanim shebbakkerem shehem letzorko veet hattevua shehi mechubberet lakkarka veet chitzat hakkanim shehi pechuta mibbet rova veet hashshomera sheenah asuya betit veet hecharuv sheeno murkav veet betulat hashshikma

Aval lo machar lo et haavanim sheenan letzorkah velo et hakkanim shebbakkerem sheenan letzorko velo et hattevua shehi telusha min hakkarka bizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah hare kullan mechurin ben kach uven kach lo machar lo et chitzat hakkanim shehi bet rova velo et hashshomera shehi asuya betit velo et hecharuv hammurkav velo et saddan hashshikma

a: Gema may avanim shehen letzorkah hacha targimu avne deachpa ulla amar avanim hassedurot legader veha tane rabbi chiyya avanim tzevurot legader teni sedurot
Hacha targimu avne deachpa lerabbi meir dimtakkenan af al gav dela machatan lerabbanan hu demachatan
Ululla deamar avanim hassedurot legader lerabbi meir dimtakkenan af al gav dela sediran lerabbanan hu disdiran

Veet hakkanim shebbakkerem shehen letzorko kanim may avidtayehu amri deve rabbi yannay kanim hamchullakin shemmaamidim tachat haggefanim lerabbi meir dimshappeyan af al gav dela mokman lerabbanan hu demokman
Veet hattevua hamchubberet lakkarka vechu veaf al gav dimtay lemichtzad veet chitzat hakkanim sheppechuta mibbet rova veaf al gav deallimi
Veet hashshomera sheenah asuya betit af al gav dela kevia beara veet hecharuv sheeno murkav veet betulat hashshikma af al gav deallimi
Aval lo machar et haavanim sheenan letzorkah lerabbi meir dela metakkenan lerabbanan dela machatan
Ululla deamar avanim hassedurot legader lerabbi meir dela metakkenan lerabbanan dela sediran
Velo et hakkanim shebbakkerem sheenan letzorko lerabbi meir dela meshappeyan lerabbanan dela mokman velo et hattevua hattelusha min hakkarka veaf al gav ditzricha leara

Velo et chitzat hakkanim shehi bet rova veaf al gav dekattine amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lo chitzat hakkanim bilvad ella afilu aruga ketanna shel besamim veyesh lah shem bifne atzmah enah nimkeret immah amar rav pappa vehu dekaru lah varda diflanya
Velo hashshomera haasuya betit veaf al gav dimchabbera beara velo et charuv hammurkav velo saddan hashshikma veaf al gav dekattine
Bae rabbi elazar malbenot shel petachim mahu hecha dimchabberi betina la tibe lach deha mechabbar ki tibe lach dinkiti besike may teku
Bae rabbi zera malbenot shel challonot mahu mi amrinan lenoy bealma hu daavidi o dilma kevan dimchabberi mechabberi teku
Bae rabbi yirmeya malbenot shel kare hammitta mahu kol hecha demittaltele bahadah la tibe lach deha mittalteli ki tibe lach hecha dela mittalteli may teku
Velo et charuv hammurkav velo saddan hashshikma vechu
b: Mena hane mile amar rav yehuda amar rav deamar kera vayyakom sede efron asher bammachpela vego mi shetztzarich ligvul saviv yatzu ellu sheen tzerichin ligvul saviv amar rav mesharsheya mikkan limtzarim min hattora
Amar rav yehuda hay man dimzabben ara lechavreh tzarich lemichtav leh keni lach diklin vetalin vehutzin vetzitzin veaf al gav dechi la ketav leh hachi kene afilu hachi shufra dishtara hu
Amar leh ara vedikle chazenan i it leh dikle yahev leh tere dikle vei let leh zaven leh tere dikle vei meshabedi parek leh tere dikle

Ara bedikle chazenan i it bah dikle yahev leh vei lav mikkach taut hu ara be dikle let leh dikle dechazya ledikle kaamar leh amar leh levar middikla pelanya chazenan i dikla tava hu shayyore shayereh i dikla bisha hu kol shekken hanach
Amar leh levar meilane i it leh ilane levar meilane i it leh dikle levar middikle i it leh gufne levar miggufne
Ilane vegufne levar meilane ilane vedikle levar meilane gufne vedikle levar miggufne
Amar rav kol sheolin lo bechevel have shiyyur kol sheen olin lo bechevel la have shiyyur

a: Vedayyane gola amri kol shehaol kovsho la have shiyyur kol sheen haol kovsho have shiyyur vela peligi ha bedikle ha beilane
Bea mineh rav acha bar huna merav sheshet chutz mecharuv peloni chutz missaddan peloni mahu oto charuv hu dela kane ha shear charuvim kane o dilma shear charuvin name la kane amar leh lo kana
Etiveh chutz mecharuv peloni chutz missaddan peloni lo kana may lav oto charuv hu delo kana ha shear charuvin kana
Amar leh la afilu shear charuvin name lo kana teda deilu amar leh sadi mechura lach chutz missade pelonit hahi hu dela kane ha achranyata kane ella la kana hacha name lo kana

Veika deamri bea mineh rav acha bar huna merav sheshet chutz mechatzi charuv peloni chutz mechatzi saddan peloni mahu shear charuvin vadday la kane ha ma sheshshiyyer beoto charuv kane o dilma afilu ma sheshshiyyer beoto charuv name la kane amar leh la kane
Etiveh chutz mechatzi charuv peloni chutz mechatzi saddan peloni shear charuvin lo kana may lav shear charuvin hu dela kana ha ma sheshshiyyer beoto charuv kana
Amar leh la afilu ma sheshshiyyer beoto charuv name lo kana teda deilu amar leh sadi mechura lach chutz mechatzi sade peloni hahu hu dela kana ha idach kana ella la kane hacha name la kane

Bea mineh rav amram merav chisda hammafkid etzel chavero bishtar veamar lo hechzartim lach mahu mi amrinan migo dei bae amar neensu meheman hashta name meheman o dilma amar leh shetarach bidi may bae amar leh meheman
Velema leh shetarach bidi may bae amar leh velitamach vechi amar leh neensu mi matze amar leh shetarach bidi may bae amar leh
b: Sof sof ki amar leh neensu lav shevua bae hacha name may neeman neeman bishvua
Lema biflugta dehane tannae detanya shetar kis hayyotze al hayetomim dayyane gola amri nishba vegove kullo vedayyane eretz yisrael amri nishba vegove mechetza
Udchulle alma it lehu dinhardae deamri nehardae hay iska palga milve ufalga pikkadon
May lav beha ka mipalgi demar savar matze amar leh shetarach bidi may bae umar savar la amri
La dechulle alma it lehu derav chisda vehacha beha kamipalgi demar savar im ita defareh memar hava amar umar savar emor malach hammavet hu deanseh
Shelach rav huna bar avin hammafkid etzel chavero bishtar veamar lo hechzartiv lach neeman ushtar kis hayyotze al hayetomin nishba vegove kullo
Tarte shane hatam deim ita defareh memar hava amar
Rava amar hilcheta nishba vegove mechetza amar mar zutra hilcheta kedayyane gola amar leh ravina lemar zutra ha amar rava nishba vegove mechetza amar leh anan dedayyane gola

a: Ipcha matninan lah
Matni lo et habbor velo et haggat velo et hashshovach ben charevin ben yeshuvin vetzarich likach lo derech divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim eno tzarich
Umode rabbi akiva bizman sheamar lo chutz meellu sheeno tzarich likach lo derech mecharan leacher rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich likach lo derech vachachamim omrim tzarich likach lo derech
Bamme devarim amurim bemocher aval benoten mattana noten et kullah haachin shechalku zachu bassade zachu bechullah hammachazik benichse hagger hechzik bassade hechzik bechullah
Hammakdish et hassade hikdish et kullah rabbi shimon omer hammakdish et hassade lo hikdish ella et hecharuv hammurkav veet saddan hashshikma
Gema may shena mecher umay shena mattana peresh yehuda ben nekosa lifne rabbi ze peresh veze lo peresh
Hay ze peresh veze lo peresh ze lo peresh veze lo peresh hu ella ze haya lo lefaresh veze lo haya lo lefaresh
Hahu daamar lehu havu leh liflanya beta demachzik mea gulfe ishtechach dahava machzik mea veesrin amar mar zutra mea amar leh mea veesrin la amar leh
Rav ashe amar mi la tenan bamme devarim amurim bemocher aval benoten mattana noten et kullan alma man deyahev mattana beayin yafa yahev hacha name man deyahev mattana beayin yafa yahev

Hammakdish et hassade hikdish vechu amar rav huna af al gav daamur rabbanan hakkone shene ilanot betoch shel chavero hare ze lo kana karka machar karka veshiyyer shene ilanot lefanav yesh lo karka vaafilu lerabbi akiva deamar mocher beayin yafa mocher hane mile gabbe bor vadut dela ka machchashi beara aval ilanot deka machchashi beara
b: Im ita dela shayyar lema leh akor ilanach shekol vezil
Tenan rabbi shimon omer hammakdish et hassade lo hikdish ella charuv hammurkav vesaddan hashshikma vetane alah amar rabbi shimon ma taam hoil veonkin missede hekdesh
Vei salka datach shayyore shayyar ki ka yanki middenafsheh ka yanki
Rabbi shimon deamar kerabbi akiva verav huna deamar kerabbanan
Kerabbanan peshita nafka minah dei nafli hadar shatel lehu

a: Umi matzet mokmatte lah lerabbi shimon kerabbi akiva veha tanya hikdish shelosha ilanot mimmatta asara levet sea hare hikdish et hakkarka veet hailanot shebbenehem lefichach keshehu pode pode bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef

Pachot mikkan o yoter al ken o shehikdishan baze achar ze hare ze lo hikdish lo hakkarka velo et hailanot shebbenehem lefichach keshehu pode pode et hailanot beshoveyehen velo od ella afilu hikdish et hailanot vechazar vehikdish et hakkarka keshehu pode pode et hailanot beshoveyehen vechozer ufode bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef
Manni i rabbi akiva ha amar mocher beayin yafa mocher vechol shekken makdish i rabbanan ha amri mocher hu divayin raa mocher aval makdish beayin yafa makdish ella peshita rabbi shimon hi

Verabbi shimon alliba deman i alliba derabbi akiva ha amar mocher beayin yafa mocher vechol shekken makdish ella peshita alliba derabbanan veka savar rabbi shimon ki hechi democher beayin raa mocher makdish name beayin raa makdish umshayyar ara
b: Veella kashya hoil veonkin missede hekdesh

Ella rabbi shimon ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi ki hechi democher beayin raa mocher makdish name beayin raa makdish veshayyore meshayyar ledidchu odu li miha delo hikdish ella charuv hammurkav vesaddan hashshikma veamri leh rabbanan la shena

Bemay okemta lah kerabbi shimon ema sefa velo od ella afilu hikdish et hailanot vechazar vehikdish et hakkarka keshehu pode pode et hailanot beshoveyehen vechozer ufode bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef
Vei rabbi shimon lezil batar pidon veniparku aggav arayehu deha shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deazel batar pidon

Detanya minnayin lallokeach sade meaviv vehikdishah veachar kach met aviv minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza talmud lomar veim et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato sade sheen reuya lihot sede achuzza yatzta zo sheruya lihot sede achuzza divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon

Rabbi meir omer minnayin lallokeach sade meaviv umet aviv veachar kach hikdish minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza talmud lomar veim et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato sade sheenah sede achuzza yatzta zo shehi sede achuzza
Veilu rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hecha demet aviv veachar kach hikdishah la tzerichi kera ki itzterich kera hecha dehikdishah veachar kach met aviv
Mena lehu i mehay kera ema lechidrabbi meir hu daata ella lav mishshum deazli batar pidon

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak leolam bealma rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon la azli batar pidon vehacha kera ashkachu udrush im ken lichtov kera veim et sede miknato asher lo achuzzato i name sede achuzzato may asher lo missede achuzzato et sheenah reuya lihot sede achuzza yatzta zo sheruya lihot sede achuzza

Amar rav huna charuv hammurkav vesaddan hashshikma torat ilan alav vetorat karka alav torat ilan alav dehecha deakdesh o zabben shene ilanot vehay yesh lo karka torat karka alav dela mizdabban aggav ara
Veamar rav huna omer sheyyesh bo satayim torat omer alav vetorat gadish alav torat omer alav dishne omarim shichcha shenayim vahu enan shichcha
Torat gadish alav ditnan omer sheyyesh bo satayim shechacho en shichcha
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish charuv hammurkav vesaddan hashshikma banu lemachloket rabbi menachem bar yose verabbanan

a: Velema machloket rabbi shimon verabbanan ha ka mashma lan derabbi menachem berabbi yose kerabbi shimon sevira leh
Hadran alach hammocher et habbayit

Hammocher et hassefina machar et hattoren veet hannes veet haogin veet kal hammanhigin otah aval lo machar lo et haavadim velo et hammartzufin velo et haantike uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah hare kullan mechurin

Gema toren iskarya vechen hu omer erez millevanon lakachu laasot toren alayich nes adra vechen hu omer shesh berikma mimmitzrayim haya mifrasech lihot lach lenes ogin tane rabbi chiyya ellu oginin shellah vechen hu omer halahen tesabberna ad asher yigdalu halahen teagena levilti heot leish
Manhigin amar rabbi abba ellu hammeshotin shellah vechen hu omer allonim mibbashan asu mishshotayich vei baet ema mehacha veyardu meoniyyotehem kol tofse mashot

Tanu rabbanan hammocher et hassefina machar et haiskala veet bor hammayim shebbetochah rabbi natan omer hammocher et hassefina machar et habbitzit somchos omer hammocher et hassefina machar et haddugit
Amar rava bitzit hayenu dugit rabbi natan bavlaa hava kare lah butztzit kidamri inashe butztziyata demeshan somchos devar eretz yisrael kare lah dugit kedichtiv veacharitchen besirot duga

Amar rabba ishtau li nachote yamma hay galla dimtabba lisfina mitchaze ki tzutzita denura chiuorta beresha umachenan leh bealota dachakik aleh ehye asher ehye yah Adonai tzevaot amen amen sela venayach

Amar rabba ishtau li nachote yamma ben galla legalla telat mea parse veruma degalla telat mea parse zimna chada hava azlinan beorcha vedallinan galla ad dachazenan be marbateh dechochva zuta vehaveya li kemivzar arbein gerive bizra dechardela vei dallinan tefe hava mikkelenan mehavleh
