La tzericha beatra dekaru leh letzimda tzimda ulvakar bakar veika name dekaru levakar tzimda rabbi yehuda savar haddamim modiin verabbanan savri en haddamim reaya vei en haddamim reaya leheve bitul mikkach

a: Vechi tema bitul mikkach lerabbanan let lehu vela vehatnan rabbi yehuda omer hammocher sefer tora behema umargalit en lahen onaa amru lo lo amru ella et ellu
May en damim reaya name dekatane dehave bitul mikkach veibaet ema ki amur rabbanan onaa uvitul mikkach bichde shehaddaat toa aval bichde sheen haddaat toa la emor mattana yehav leh

Matni hammocher et hachamor lo machar kelav nachum hammadi omer machar kelav rabbi yehuda omer peamim mechurin peamim enan mechurin ketzad haya chamor lefanav vechelav alav veamar lo mechor li chamorcha ze hare kelav mechurin chamorcha hu en kelav mechurin

Gema amar ulla machaloket besak vedisakkayya vechumni detanna kamma savar setam chamor lirkov kae venachum hammadi savar setam chamor lemassooy kae aval ukkaf umardaat kilkeli vachavak divre hakkol mechurin

Metivi chamor vechelav ani mocher lach hare ze machar et haukkaf veet hammardaat veet hakkilkeli veet hachavak aval lo machar sak vedisakkayya vechumni uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shealeha hare kullan mechurin tama deamar leh chamor vechelav hu dekane ukkaf umardaat ha la amar leh hachi la
Hu haddin deaf al gav dela amar leh chamor vechelav name ukkaf umardaat mechurin veha ka mashma lan deaf al gav daamar leh chamor vechelav sak vedisakkayya vechumni la kane
May vechumni amar rav pappa bar shemuel markavta denashe

Ibaya lehu beodan alav machaloket aval besheenan alav mode lehu nachum hammadi o dilma besheenan alav machaloket aval beodan alav modu leh rabbanan lenachum ta shema uvizman sheamar lo hu vechol ma shealav hare kullan mechurin
I amratte bishlama beodan alav machloket ha manni rabbanan hi ella i amratte besheen odan alav machloket aval beodan alav divre hakkol mechurin ha manni
Leolam besheen odan alav machloket verabbanan hi veema uvizman sheamar lo hu vechol ma sherauy lihot alav
Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer peamim mechurin peamim sheenan mechurin may lav ammay dekaamar tanna kamma kae rabbi yehuda la rabbi yehuda
b: Milleta achariti kaamar

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ta shema machar et hakkaron lo machar et happeradot vetane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu machar et hakkaron machar et happeradot vaamar leh veha anan lo machar tenan vaamar leh ismeyah vaamar leh la tittargem matnitach baadukim bo
Mikkelal dematnitin besheen adukim bo umidderesha besheen odan alav sefa name besheen odan alav
Adderabba ema resha aval lo machar lo et haavadim velo et haantike veamrinan may antike amar rav pappa iska divgavah umidderesha beodan alav sefa name beodan alav ella tena mile mile katane

Siman zaggam nissan amar abbaye rabbi eliezer verabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi meir verabbi natan vesomchos venachum hammadi kullehu sevira lehu ki mezabben inish mide ihu vechol tashmishteh mezabben

Rabbi eliezer ditnan rabbi eliezer omer hammocher et bet habbad machar et hakkora rabban shimon ben gamliel ditnan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hammocher et hair machar et hassanter rabbi meir detanya rabbi meir omer machar et hakkerem machar tashmishe hakkerem rabbi natan vesomchos bitzit vedugit nachum hammadi ha daamaran
Rabbi yehuda omer peamim mechurin vechu may shena chamorcha zo umay shena chamorcha hu
Amar rava chamorcha zo yada dachamara dideh hu vehay deka amar leh zo mishshum kelav kaamar leh chamorcha hu dela yeda dachamara dideh hu vehachi kaamar leh chamorcha hu shettimkerenna li
Matni hammocher et hachamor machar et hasseyach machar et happara lo machar et benah machar ashpa machar zivlah machar bor machar memeha machar kaveret machar devorim machar shovach machar yonim
Gema hechi dame i deamar leh hi uvnah afilu para uvnah name i dela amar leh hi uvnah afilu chamor name la

Amar rav pappa deamar leh chamor menika ufara menika ani mocher lach bishlama para ika lememar lachalavah bae lah ella chamor may kaamar leh shema minah hi uvnah kaamar leh veammay kare leh seyach shemmehallech achar sicha naa
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv al ken yomru hammoshlim vego
Hammoshlim ellu hammoshlim beyitzram bou cheshbon bou unchashshev cheshbono shel olam hefsed mitzva keneged secharah uschar avera keneged hefsedah

Tibbane vetikkonen im atta ose ken tibbane baolam hazze vetikkonen laolam habba ir sichon im mesim adam atzmo keayir ze shemmehallech achar sicha naa ma ketiv acharav ki esh yatza mecheshbon vego tetze esh mimmechashshevin vetochal et sheenan mechashshevin

Velehava mikkiryat sichon mikkiryat tzaddikim shennikreu sichin achla ar moav ze hamhallech achar yitzro keayir ze shemmehallech achar sicha naa baale bamot arnon ellu gasse haruach deamar mar kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach nofel begehinnam
Vanniram amar rasha en ram avad cheshbon avad cheshbono shel olam ad divon amar hakkadosh baruch hu hamten ad sheyyavo din vannashshim

a: Ad nofach ad shettavo esh sheenah tzericha nipuach ad medva ad shettadiv nishmatan veamri lah ad deaved may devae
Amar rav yehuda amar rav kol happoresh middivre tora esh ochalto shenneemar venatatti et panay bahem mehaesh yatzau vehaesh tochlem

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yonatan kol happoresh atzmo middivre tora nofel begehinnam shenneemar adam toe midderech haskel bikhal refaim yanuach veen refaim ella gehinnam shenneemar velo yada ki refaim sham beimke sheol kerueha
Machar ashpa machar zivlah vechu tenan hatam kol harauy lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit levedek habbayit velo lammizbeach lo lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit moalin bahen uvma shebbetochan
Ketzad hikdish bor melea mayim ashpot meleot zevel shovach male yonim sade melea asavim ilan nasuy perot moalin bahen uvma shebbetochan

Aval hikdish bor veachar kach nitmalle mayim ashpa veachar kach nitmallea zevel shovach veachar kach nitmalle yonim ilan veachar kach nasa perot sade veachar kach nitmallea asavim moalin bahen veen moalin bema shebbetochan divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer hikdish et hassade veet hailan moalin bahen uvgidulehem mippene shehen gidule hekdesh
Tanya amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yehuda bevor veshovach vedivre rabbi yose besade veilan hay may bishlama nirin divre rabbi yehuda bevor veshovach mikkelal diflig assade veilan
Ella nirin divre rabbi yose besade veilan mikkelal diflig bevor veshovach veha rabbi yose sade veilan kaamar
Vechi tema lidvarav derabbi yehuda kaamar vehattanya amar rabbi yose en ani roe devarav shel rabbi yehuda besade veilan mippene shehen gidule hekdesh besade veilan hu deeno roe ha bevor veshovach roe
Hachi kaamar nirin divre rabbi yehuda lerabbi yose bevor veshovach sheaf rabbi yose lo nechlak alav ella besade veilan aval bevor veshovach mode leh
Tanu rabbanan hikdishan rekanin veachar kach nitmalleu moalin bahen veen moalin bema shebbetochan rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer af moalin bema shebbetochan

Amar rabba machaloket besade veilan detanna kamma savar lah kerabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar lah kerabbi yose aval bevor veshovach divre hakkol moalin bahen veen moalin bema shebbetochan
Amar leh abbaye veella ha detanya hikdishan melein moalin bahen uvma shebbetochan verabbi elazar berabbi shimon machlif
b: Vei besade veilan ammay machlif ella amar rabba machaloket bevor veshovach aval besade veilan divre hakkol moalin bahen uvma shebbetochan
Uvvor veshovach berekanin bemay peligi uvimlein bemay peligi berekanin peligi biflugta derabbi meir verabbanan
Detanna kamma savar lah kerabbanan deamri en adam makne davar shello ba laolam verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar kerabbi meir deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam
Emor deshamatte leh lerabbi meir kegon perot dekel daavidi deatu hane mi yemar deatu amar rava mashkachatte lah bemayim habbain derech chatzero labbor veonim habbain derech shovacho lashshovach
Uvimleim bemay peligi amar rava kegon shehikdish bor setam verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar lah kaavuh deamar danin din gavoha middin hedot
Ma din hedot matze amar bera zabbeni lach mayya la zabbeni lach af din gavoha bera akdesh mayya la akdesh vetanna kamma savar en danin din gavoha middin hedot
Vedin hedot la vehatnan machar bor machar memav amar rava matnitin yechidaa hi detanya machar bor lo machar memav rabbi natan omer machar bor machar memav

a: Matni hallokeach perot shovach mechavero mafriach bericha rishona perot kaveret notel shelosha nechilim umsares challot devash manniach shette challot zetim lakotz manniach shette gerofiyyot
Gema vehatanya bericha rishona ushniyya amar rav kahana la kashya ha lah ha leimmah
May shena immah demitztavveta abbarta veazzuga deshavkinan lah ihi name titztavat aimmah veazzuga deshavkinan lah immah abbarta mitztavveta beratta aimmah la mitztavveta

Perot kaveret notel shelosha nechilin umsares bamme mesarsan amar rav yehuda amar shemuel bechardal amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose bar chanina lo chardal mesarsan ella mittoch sheppihen chad chozrot veochlot et duvshanan
Rabbi yochanan amar notel shelosha nechilin beserus bematnita tana notel shelosha nechilin baze achar ze mikkan veelach notel achat umanniach achat
Challot devash manniach shette challot vechu amar rav kahana devash bechaveret eno yotze mide maachal leolam alma kasavar la bae machshava
Metivi devash bechaveret eno lo ochel velo mashke amar abbaye la tzericha ella leotan shette challot rava amar derabbi eliezer hi
b: Ditnan kaveret devorim rabbi eliezer omer hare hi kakkarka vechotvin aleha perozbul
Veenah mekabbelet tuma bimkomah veharode mimmenna beshabbat chayyav chattat
Vachachamim omrim en kotvin aleha perozbul veenah kakkarka umkabbelet tuma bimkomah veharode mimmenna beshabbat patur

Amar rabbi elazar may tama derabbi eliezer dichtiv vayyitbol otah beyarat haddevash vechi ma inyan yaar etzel devash ella lomar lach ma yaar hattolesh mimmennu beshabbat chayyav chattat af devash harode mimmennu beshabbat chayyav chattat
Metivi devash hazzav mikkavarto eno lo ochel velo mashke bishlama leabbaye nicha
Ella lerava kashya amar rav zevid kegon shezzav al gabbe keli maus rav acha bar yaakov amar kegon shezzav al gabbe kashkashshin
Metivi devash bechavarto eno lo ochel velo mashke chishev alav laachila metamme tumat ochalin lemashkin metamme tumat mashkin bishlama leabbaye nicha
Ella lerava kashya
Amar lach rava taretz hachi chishev alav laachila eno metamme tumat ochalin lemashkin eno metamme tumat mashkin tanya keoteh derav kahana devash bechavarto metamme tumat ochalin shello bemachshava

Zetim lakotz manniach shette gerofiyyot tanu rabbanan hallokeach ilan mechavero lakotz magbiha min hakkarka tefach vekotzetz betulat hashshikma shelosha tefachim saddan hashshikma shene tefachim bekanim uvigfanim min happekak ulmala bidkalim uvaarazim chofer umsharesh lefi sheen gizan machlif
Uvtulat hashshikma shelosha tefachim baenan urminhi en kotztzin betulat hashshikma bishviit mippene shehi avoda
Rabbi yehuda omer kedarko asur ella magbiha asara tefachim vekotzetz o gomem meim haaretz meim haaretz hu dekashe ha idach mealle lah

Amar abbaye shelosha tefachim mealle lah meim haaretz vadday kashe lah mikkan veelach la mikshe kashe lah velav alloye mealle lah gabbe sheviit avdinan mide devadday kashe lah gabbe mikkach umimkar avdinan mide devadday mealle lah

Bidkalim uvaarazim chofer umsharesh lefi sheen gizan machlif veerez en gizo machlif veha deresh rabbi chiyya bar lulyani may dichtiv tzaddik kattamar yifrach keerez ballevanon yisge im neemar tamar lamma neemar erez veim neemar erez lamma neemar tamar
Ilu neemar erez velo neemar tamar hayiti omer ma erez en ose perot af tzaddik en ose perot lechach neemar tamar
Veim neemar tamar velo neemar erez hayiti omer ma tamar en gizo machlif af tzaddik en gizo machlif lechach neemar erez

Ella hacha bemay askinan bishar mine arazim kidrabba bar rav huna deamar rabba bar rav huna amri be rav asara mine arazim hen shenneemar etten bammidbar erez shitta vahadas veetz shamen asim vego erez arza shita turnita hadas assa etz shemen afarsema berosh berate tidhar shaga utashshur shurbina
Hane shiva have ki ata rav dimi amar hosifu alehen allonim almonim almuggim allonim butne almonim balute almuggim

a: Kesita ika deamri aronim armonim almuggim aronim are armonim dulve almuggim kesita

Matni hakkone shene ilanot betoch sede chavero hare ze lo kana karka rabbi meir omer kana karka higdilu lo yeshappe vehaole min haggeza shello umin hashshorashim shel baal hakkarka veim metu en lo karka
Kana shelosha kana karka higdilu yeshappe vehaole min haggeza umin hashshorashin shello veim metu yesh lo karka
Gema tenan hatam hakkone shene ilanot betoch shel chavero mevi veeno kore rabbi meir omer mevi vekore
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mechayyev haya rabbi meir af belokeach perot min hashshuk mimmay middekatane mishna yattira mikkede tena leh deyesh lo karka peshita demevi vekore
Ella shema minah mechayyev haya rabbi meir af belokeach perot min hashshuk
Veha ketiv asher tavi meartzecha hahu lemaote chutza laaretz
Veha ketiv admatcha lemaote admat goy vehachtiv asher natatta li dihavte li zuze uzvani behu
Metiv rabba hakkone ilan echad betoch shel chavero mevi veeno kore lefi shello kana karka divre rabbi meir teuvta
Amar lo rabbi shimon ben elyakim lerabbi elazar
b: May tama derabbi meir beilan echad umay tama derabbanan bishne ilanot amar lo davar sheharishonim lo amru bo taam tishaleni bevet hammidrash kede levayesheni
Amar rabba may kushya dilma rabbi meir beilan echad sappoke mesappeka leh verabbanan bishne ilanot sappoke mesappeka lehu
Umi mesappeka leh veha katane lefi shello kana karka divre rabbi meir ema shemma lo kana karka
Velechush dedilma lav bikurim ninhu veka meayyel chullin laazara demakdesh lehu veha bae mechlinhu defarek lehu vedilma lav bikkurim ninhu veka mafka lehu mitteruma umaaser demafresh lehu
Bishlama teruma gedola yahev lah lechohen maaser sheni name yahev leh lechohen masar ani name yahev leh lechohen ani ella maaser rishon delevi hu leman yahev leh

Deyahev leh lechohen kerabbi elazar ben azarya detanya teruma gedola lechohen maaser rishon lelevi divre rabbi akiva rabbi elazar ben azarya omer maaser rishon af lechohen vedilma bikkurim ninhu uvau keriyyah keriyyah lo meakkevet
Vela vehaamar rabbi zera kol harauy levila en bila meakkevet bo vesheeno rauy levila bila meakkevet bo
Deaved lehu kerabbi yose bar chanina deamar betzaran veshiggeran beyad shaliach umet shaliach badderech mevi veeno kore may tama dichtiv velakachta veheveta

a: Ad shettehe lekicha vahavaa keechad veha leka amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe mikkede pesuke ninhu likre
Amar leh mishshum demichaze keshikra rav mesharsheya bereh derav chiyya amar dilma ate leafkuinhu mitteruma umaaser
Higdilu lo yeshappe ku hechi dame min haggeza vehechi dame min hashshorashin
Amar rabbi yochanan kol sheroe pene chamma zehu min haggeza vesheeno roe pene chamma zehu min hashshorashin
Velechush dilma masseka ara sirton veamar leh telata zabbente li veit li ara ella amar rav nachman yakotz vechen amar rabbi yochanan yakotz
Amar rav nachman nekitinan dekel en lo geza savar rav zevid lememar en lo geza levaal dekel dechevan dilmichpar ulsharesh kae assoche massach dateh
Matkef lah rav pappa veha kone shene ilanot dilmichpar ulmishrash kayemi vekatane deyesh lo geza ella amar rav pappa en lo geza levaal dekel lefi sheen motzi geza
Ulrav zevid kashya matnitin dezabben lachamesh shenin
Kana shelosha kana karka vechamma amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hare ze kana tachtehen uvenehen vechutza lahen
b: Kimlo ore vesallo matkef lah rabbi elazar hashta derech en lo ore vesallo yesh lo derech en lo deara achariti hi ore vesallo yesh lo
Amar rabbi zera middivre rabbenu nilmad shelosha hu deen lo derech ha shenayim yesh lo deamar leh beara didach kayemi
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava lema rabbi elazar let leh dishmuel rabbeh deamar shemuel halacha kerabbi akiva deamar mocher beayin yafa mocher
Amar leh la mittokma matnitin kerabbi akiva
Mimmay middekatane higdilu yeshappe vei salka datach rabbi akiva hi ammay yeshappe haamar mocher beayin yafa mocher
Amar leh emor deamar rabbi akiva gabbe bor vadut dela machchashi ara gabbe ilan mi shamatte leh
Mi la mode rabbi akiva beilan hannote letoch sede chavero shekkotzetz melo mardea meal gabbe macharesha
Tanya keoteh derabbi chiyya bar abba hare ze kana tachtehen uvenehen vechutza lahen kimlo ore vesallo
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef otan ore vesallo mi zoran amar leh tenetuha hachitzon zorea et hadderech
Amar leh mi dame hatam let leh peseda lelokeach aval hacha it leh peseda lelokeach daamar leh kamitannefi pere
Ha la damya ella lesefa veze vaze enan rashshain lezorah
Tanya keoteh deabbaye hare ze kana tachtehen uvenehen vechutza lahen kimlo ore vesallo veze vaze enan rashshain lezorah

Vechamma yehe benehen rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mearba ammot vead shemone rava amar rav nachman amar shemuel mishshemone vead shesh esre amar leh abbaye lerav yosef la tiflog aleh derav nachman ditnan matnitin keoteh
Ditnan hannotea et karmo shesh esre amma al shesh esre amma muttar lehavi zera lesham

Amar rabbi yehuda maase betzalmon beechad shennata et karmo shesh esre al shesh esre amma vehaya hofech sear shette shurot letzad echad vezorea et hannir leshana acheret haya hofech et hassear limkom hazzera vezara et habbur uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiruhu
Amar leh ana la yadana ella ovada hava

a: Bedura deraavata vaato lekammeh derav yehuda vaamar leh zil hav leh kimlo bakar vechelav vela hava yadana kimlo bakar vechelav kamma kevan deshamitah leha ditnan lo yitta adam ilan samuch lisde chavero ella im ken hirchik mimmenna arba ammot
Vetane alah arba ammot sheamru kede avodat hakkerem amena shema minah kimlo bakar vechelav arba ammot
Uchrav yosef mi la tenan rabbi meir verabbi shimon omrim hannotea et karmo shemone ammot al shemone muttar lehavi zera lesham
Afilu hachi maase adif

Bishlama lerav yosef alliba derabbi shimon shaminan leh mefuzzarin veshaminan leh retzufin mefuzzarin ha daamaran retzufin ditnan kerem hannatua al pachot mearba ammot eno kerem divre rabbi shimon vachachamim omrim kerem veroin et haemtzaiyyim keilu enan
Ella lerav nachman alliba derabbanan mefuzzarin shaminan leh retzufin mi shaminan leh sevara hu middilrabbi shimon palga lerabbanan name palga
Amar rava hilcheta mearba ammot vead shesh esre tanya keoteh derava kamma yehu mekoravin arba ammot vechamma yehu meruchakin shesh esre

Hare ze kana karka veet hailanot shebbenehen lefichach yavesh hailan o niktzatz yesh lo karka pachot mikkan o yater al kan o shellekachan beze achar ze hare ze lo kana lo et hakkarka velo et hailanot shebbenehen lefichach yavesh hailan o niktzatz en lo karka
Bae rabbi yirmeya keshehu moded mimmakom katzar hu moded o mimmakom rachav hu moded amar leh rav geviha mibbe chetil lerav ashe ta shema ditnan harchuva shebbaggefen eno moded ella meikar hashsheni
Bae rabbi yirmeya machar lo shelosha badde ilan mahu

Amar leh rav geviha mibbe chetil lerav ashe ta shema ditnan hammavrich shalosh gefanim veikkerehen nirin rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer im yesh benehen mearba ammot vead shemone mitztarfin veim lav en mitztarfin
Bae rav pappa machar lo shenayim betoch sadehu veechad al hammetzer mahu shenayim betoch shello veechad betoch shel chavero may teku
b: Bae rav ashe bor mahu shettafsik ammat hammayim mahu shettafsik reshut harabbim mahu richba dedikle mahu teku
Bea mineh hillel merabbi ala erez benehen mahu ala birshuta dideh nefak ella haya erez benehen mahu amar leh kana vekana
Ketzad hen omdim rav amar keshura ushmuel amar kachatzuva man deamar keshura kol shekken kachatzuva uman deamar kachatzuva aval keshura la may tama mishshum demizdera bentayehu

Matkef lah rav hamnuna ulman deamar kachatzuva may tama dela mizdera bentayehu ella meatta zabben leh telat hige romayata dela mizdera bentayehu hachi name deyesh lo karka amar leh hanach la chashivi hanach chashivi

Matni hammocher rosh behema gassa lo machar et haraglayim machar et haraglayim lo machar et harosh machar et hakkane lo machar et hakkaved machar et hakkaved lo machar et hakkane aval bedakka machar et harosh machar et haraglayim machar et haraglayim lo machar et harosh machar et hakkane machar et hakkaved machar et hakkaved lo machar et hakkane

Arba middot bammochrin machar lo chittin yafot venimtzeu raot hallokeach yachol lachazor bo raot venimtzeu yafot mocher yachol lachazor bo raot venimtzeu raot yafot venimtzeu yafot en echad mehem yachol lachazor bo

Shechamtit venimtzet levana levana venimtzet shechamtit etzim shel zayit venimtzeu shel shikma shel shikma venimtzeu shel zayit yayin venimtza chometz chometz venimtza yayin shenehem yecholin lachazor bahen
Gema amar rav chisda machar lo shave chamesh beshesh vehukar veamad al shemone mi nitanna lokeach lokeach yachol lachazor bo velo mocher mishshum

a: Deamar leh ilu la onitan la hava matzet hadratte bach hashta deonitan matzet hadratte bach vetanna tuna yafot venimtzeu raot lokeach yachol lachazor bo velo mocher

Veamar rav chisda machar lo shave shesh bechamesh vehuzlu veamdu al shalosh mi nitanna mocher mocher yachol lachazor bo velo lokeach deamar leh ilu la onitan la hava matzet hadratte bach hashta matzet hadratte bach vetanna tuna raot venimtzeu yafot mocher yachol lachazor bo velo lokeach
May ka mashma lan matnitin hi i mimmatnitin hava amena dilma derav chisda tarvayehu matzu hadri behu umatnitin ha ata leashmoinan delokeach yachol lachazor bo
Desalka datach amena mishshum dichtiv ra ra yomar hakkone
Shechamtit venimtzet levana ku amar rav pappa middekatane levana shema minah hay shimsha summakti hi teda deka samka tzafra ufanya vehay dela ka chazenan kulleh yoma nehorin hu dela bari
Metivi umarehu amok min haor kemare chamma amukka min hatztzel vehatam lavan hu kemare chamma velo kemare chamma kemare chamma daamukka min hatztzel velo kemare chamma deilu hatam lavan vehacha adom
Ulmay dislek datin meikara ha ka samka tzafra ufanya betzafra dechalfa abbe varde degan eden befanya dechalfa appitcha degehinnam veika deamri ipcha
Yayin venimtza chometz shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen lema matnitin rabbi hi vela rabbanan detanya
b: Yayin vachometz min echad hu rabbi omer shene minin afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi ella leinyan maaser utruma vechidrabbi illaa
Deamar rabbi ila minnayin lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma shenneemar velo tisu alav chet baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu
Im eno kadosh nesiut chet lamma mikkan lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma
Aval leinyan mikkach umimkar dechulle alma ika denicha leh bechamra vela nicha leh bechalla veika denicha leh bechalla vela nicha leh bechamra
Matni hammocher perot lachavero mashach velo madad kana madad velo mashach lo kana im haya pikeach socher et mekoman
Hallokeach pishtan mechavero hare ze lo kana ad sheyetaltelennu mimmakom lemakom veim haya mechubbar lakkarka vetalash kol shehu kana
Gema amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan madad vehinniach al gabbe simta kana
Amar lo rabbi zera lerabbi assi shemma lo shama rabbi ella bemoded letoch kuppato amar leh dame hay merabbanan kidla gamri inashe shemata madad letoch kuppato memra bae
Kablah mineh o la kablah mineh ta shema deamar rabbi yannay amar rabbi chatzar hashshuttafin konin ze mizze may lav al gabbe karka lo letoch kuppato

Hachi name mistabbera deamar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan madad vehinniach al gabbe simta lo kana kashyan ahadade ella lav shema minah kan bemoded letoch kuppato kan bemoded al gabbe karka shema minah
Ta shema madad velo mashach lo kana may lav besimta lo birshut harabbim i hachi ema resha mashach velo madad kana meshicha birshut harabbim mi kanya
Veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu mesira kona birshut harabbim uvchatzer sheenah shel shenehen meshicha kona besimta uvchatzer shehi shel shenehen vehagbaha kona bechol makom

May mashach name dekatane mershut harabbim lesimta i hachi ema sefa im haya pikeach socher et mekoman vei birshut harabbim mimman agar hachi kaamar veim birshut bealim hi im haya pikeach socher et mekoman
Rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu

a: Kilo shel adam kone lo bechol makom chutz mershut harabbim verabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish deamri tarvayehu afilu birshut harabbim
Amar rav pappa la peligi kan birshut harabbim kan besimta veammay karu lah reshut harabbim sheen reshut hayyachid
Hachi name mistabbera deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan kilo shel adam kone lo bechol makom sheyyesh lo reshut lehannicho yesh lo reshut in en lo reshut la shema minah

Ta shema arba middot bammochrin ad shello nitmallea midda lammocher mishshennitmallea midda lallokeach bamme devarim amurim bemidda sheenah shel shenehen aval im hayeta midda shel echad mehen rishon rishon kana

Bamme devarim amurim birshut harabbim uvchatzer sheenah shel shenehen aval birshut mocher lo kana ad sheyyagbihenna o ad sheyyotzienna mershuto birshut lokeach kevan shekkibbel alav mocher kana lokeach birshut halla hammufkadim etzlo lo kana ad sheyekabbel alav o ad sheyyiskor et mekoman
Katane miha birshut harabbim uvchatzer sheenah shel shenehen
b: May lav birshut harabbim mammash la simta veha dumya dechatzer sheenah shel shenehem katane
May chatzer sheenah shel shenehem name dela dehay kullah vela dehay kullah ella detarvayehu
Bea mineh rav sheshet merav huna kilo shel lokeach birshut mocher kana lokeach o la amar leh tenetuha zerako lah letoch chekah o letoch kaltah hare zo megoreshet
Amar leh rav nachman may tama pashtatte leh mehahi demachu lah mea uchle beuchla

Deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel vehu shehayeta kaltah teluya bah veresh lakish amar keshura veaf al pi sheenah teluya bah rav adda bar ahava amar kegon shehayeta kaltah munnachat lah ben yarchoteha rav mesharsheya bereh derabbi amme amar kegon shehaya balah mocher kelatot
Rabbi yochanan amar mekom chekah kanuy lah mekom kaltah kanuy lah amar rava may tama derabbi yochanan lefi sheen adam makpid lo al mekom chekah velo al mekom kaltah
Ella peshot lah meha birshut mocher lo kana ad sheyyagbihenna o ad sheyyotzienna mershuto may lav bechilo delokeach lo bechilo democher
Umidderesha bechilo democher sefa name bechilo democher ema sefa birshut lokeach kevan shekkibel alav mocher kana lokeach vei bechilo democher ammay kana lokeach sefa atan lechilo delokeach
Umay paska setama demilta be mocher mane democher shechichi be lokeach mane delokeach shechichi
Amar rava ta shema mashach chamarav ufoalav vehichnisan letoch beto ben pasak ad shello madad uven madad ad shello pasak shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen

a: Perkan vehichnisan letoch beto pasak ad shello madad en shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen madad ad shello pasak shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen umiddechilo democher birshut lokeach lo kana kilo delokeach name birshut mocher lo kana
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak besheshshefachan ikfad rava mide shefachan katane perkan katane ella amar mar bar rav ashe bimtakle detume
Amar leh huna bereh demar zutra leravina mikkede perkan katane ma li pasak uma li lo pasak amar leh pasak samcha dateh lo pasak la samcha dateh
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ta shema derav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kilo shel adam kone lo bechol makom leetoye may lav leetoye reshut mocher hatam deamar leh zil keni

Tenan hatam nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka vesheen lahen achraut en niknin ella bimshicha besura matnu lah leha shemata mishshemeh derav chisda befumbedita matnu lah mishshemeh derav kahana veamri lah mishshemeh derava lo shanu ella devarim sheen darkan lehagbiha aval devarim sheddarkan lehagbiha behagbaha in bimshicha la
Yetev abbaye vekaamar leha shemata etiveh rav adda bar matna leabbaye haggonev kis beshabbat chayyav shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide isur shabbat
Haya megarer veotze megarer veotze patur shehare isur shabbat ugneva bain keechad
Vahare kis devar hagbaha hu vaafilu hachi kane bimshicha amar leh bemitna ana name bemitna ka amena amar leh bemide devae mitna

Ta shema birshut mocher lo kana ad sheyyagbihenna o ad sheyyotzienna mershuto alma mide devar hagbaha i bae behagbaha kane leh vei bae bimshicha kane leh amar rav nachman bar yitzchak litzdadin katane mide devar hagbaha behagbaha mide devar meshicha bimshicha
b: Ta shema hammocher perot lachavero mashach velo madad kane veha perot divne hagbaha ninhu vekatane dekane bimshicha

Hacha bemay askinan bishlife ravreve i hachi ema sefa hallokeach pishtan mechavero lo kana ad sheyetaltelennu mimmakom ze lemakom acher attu pishtan bishlife ravreve mi la avdi shane pishtan demishtemit

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ta shema behema gassa niknet bimsira vehaddakka behagbaha divre rabbi meir verabbi shimon ben elazar vachachamim omrim behema dakka bimshicha veha behema dakka devar hagbaha hi vekatane dekane bimshicha shane behema desarcha
Rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kor bishloshim ani mocher lach yachol lachazor bo afilu bisa haacharona kor bishloshim sea besela ani mocher lach rishon rishon kana
Ta shema im hayeta midda shel echad mehen rishon rishon kana veaf al gav delo nitmallea hammidda
Kegon daamar leh hin bishnem asar selaim log besela ani mocher lach vechidamar rav kahana shenatot hau bahin hacha name shenatot hau bammiddot
Ta shema hassocher et happoel laasot immo laggoren hayyom bedinar

a: Velaggoren yafe sela asur lehanot hemennu aval im secharo mehayyom bedinar leom velaggoren yafe sela muttar

Vei salka datach kor bishloshim sea besela ani mocher lach rishon rishon kana hacha name kamma kamma mifsak pesak veasur lehanot hemennu middinar leom velaggoren yafe sela muttar ammay veha agar netar li hu
Amar rava vetisbera zalzole bischirut mi asir may shena resha umay shena sefa
Resha dela ka aved bahadeh mehashta michaze ki agar netar li sefa deka aved bahadeh mehashta la michaze ki agar netar li
Veim haya mechubbar bekarka vetalash kol shehu kana mishshum detalash kol shehu kana amar rav sheshet hacha bemay askinan deamar leh lech yappe lecha karka kol shehu vekane kol ma shealeha

Matni hammocher yayin vashemen lachavero vehukru o shehuzlu im ad shello nitmallet hammidda lammocher mishshennitmallet hammidda lallokeach veim haya sarsur benehen nishbera hechavit nishbera lassarsur
Vechayyav lehattif lo shalosh tipin hirkinah umitzet hare hu shel mocher vehachenoni eno chayyav lehattif shalosh tipin rabbi yehuda omer erev shabbat im chashecha patur
Gema ha midda deman ilema midda delokeach ad shello nitmallet midda lammocher midda delokeach hi veella midda democher mishshennitmallet midda lallokeach midda democher hi
Amar rabbi ila bemiddat sarsur veha middekatane sefa veim haya sarsur benehem nishbera hechavit nishbera lassarsur mikkelal deresha lav besarsur askinan resha midda belo sarsur sefa besarsur atzmo

Hirkinah umitzet hare hu shel mocher ki salek rabbi elazar ashkecheh lizeri amar leh mi kan tanna deatneyeh rav middot achaveyeh rav yitzchak bar avdimi amar leh may ka kashya lach ditnan hirkinah umitzita hare hu shel mocher
b: Vehatnan hirkinah umitzah hare zo teruma
Amar leh ha itmar alah amar rabbi avahu mishshum yeush bealim nagu bah
Vehachenoni eno chayyav lehattif vechu ibaya lehu rabbi yehuda aresha kae ulkulla o dilma assefa kae ulchumra
Ta shema detanya rabbi yehuda omer erev shabbat im chashecha chenoni patur mippene shechenoni tarud

Matni hashsholeach et beno etzel chenoni ufondeon beyado umadad lo beisar shemen venatan lo et haisar shavar et hatztzelochit veibbed et haisar chenoni chayyav rabbi yehuda poter sheal menat ken shelacho umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bizman shehatztzelochit beyad hattinok umadad chenoni letochah shechenoni patur
Gema bishlama beisar vashemen beha peligi derabbanan savri leodoe shaddereh verabbi yehuda savar leshaddore leh shaddereh ella shavar tzelochit aveda middaat hi

Amar rav hoshaya hacha bevaal habbayit mocher tzelochiyyot askinan uchgon shennetalah chenoni al menat levakkerah uchdishmuel deamar shemuel hannotel keli min haumman al menat levakkero veneenas beyado chayyav
Lema dishmuel tannae hi ella rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu hacha bechenoni mocher tzelochiyyot askinan veazda rabbi yehuda letameh verabbanan letamayehu

I hachi ema sefa modim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bizman shehatztzelochit beyad hattinok umadad chenoni letochah shechenoni patur veha amratte leodoe shaddereh ella abbaye bar avin verabbi chanina bar avin deamri tarvayehu hacha bemay askinan

a: Kegon shennetalah lamod bah vechidrabba deamar rabba hikkishah nitchayyev bah
Emor deamar rabba bevaale chayyim deanketinhu nigra barayata ki hay gavena mi amar
Ella amar rava ani vaari shebbachavura targemnuha umannu rabbi zera hacha bemay askinan kegon shennetalah lamod bah laacherim
Uvshoel shello middaat ka mipalgi mar savar shoel have umar savar gazlan have
Gufa amar shemuel hannotel keli min haumman levakkero veneenas beyado chayyav vehane mile hu dekayetzi demeh
Hahu gavra deal leve tabbacha agbah atma devisra bahade deka agbah ata parasha mirme mineh ata lekammeh derav yemar chayeveh leshallome demah vehane mile hu dekayetzi demah
Hahu gavra deayeti kare lefum nahara ato kulle alma shekul kara kara amar lehu hare hen mukdashin lashshamayim
Ato lekammeh derav kahana amar lehu en adam makdish davar sheeno shello vehane mile hu dekayetzi demayehu aval la kayetzi demayehu birshut marayehu kayemi veshappir akdesh
Tanu rabbanan hallokeach yarak min hashshuk uverar vehinniach afilu kol hayyom kullo lo kana velo nitchayyev bemaaser
Gamar belibbo liknoto kana venitchayyev bemaaser lehachziro i efshar shekkevar nitchayyev bemaaser ulassero i efshar shekkevar mafchitan bedamim ha ketzad meassero venoten lo deme maaser
Attu mishshum degamar belibbo liknot kana venitchayyev bemaaser amar rav hoshaya hacha bire shamayim askinan kegon rav safra dekayyem benafsheh vedover emet bilvavo
Matni hassiton mekanneach middotav echad lishloshim yom uvaal habbayit echad lishnem asar chodesh rabban shimon ben gamliel omer chiluf haddevarim

Chenoni mekanneach middotav paamayim beshabbat ummache mishkelotav paam achat beshabbat umkannech moznayim al kol mishkal umishkal amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim belach aval beyavesh eno tzarich
b: Vechayyav lehachria lo tefach haya shokel lo ayin beayin noten lo gerumin echad laasara ballach veechad leesrim bayyavesh
Makom shennahagu lamod bedakka lo yamod begassa begassa lo yamod bedakka limchok lo yigdosh ligdosh lo yimchok

Gema menahane mile amar resh lakish deamar kera even shelema vatzedek tzaddek mishshellecha veten lo i hachi ema sefa haya shokel lo ayin beayin noten lo gerumin vei hachraa deorayeta hechi yahev leh ayin beayin

Ella resha bemakom shennahagu vei itmar deresh lakish assefa itmar haya shokel lo ayin beayin noten lo gerumin menahane mile amar resh lakish deamar kera vatzedek tzaddek mishshellecha veten lo vechamma gerumin amar rabbi abba bar memel amar rav echad measara ballitra ballach laasara litrin

Echad laasara ballach veechad leesrim beyavesh vechu ibaya lehu hechi kaamar echad measara ballach laasara delach veechad meesrim bayyavesh leesrim deyavesh o dilma echad measara laasara delach ulesrim deyavesh teku
Amar rabbi levi kashe onshan shel middot yoter meonshan shel araot shezze neemar bahen el veze neemar bahen elle umay mashma dehay el kashe hu dichtiv veet ele haaretz lakach
Gabbe araot name hachtiv elle hahu lemaote middot mikkaret
Veella may udpayehu dehatam efshar bitshuva vehacha la efshar bitshuva
Veamar rabbi levi kashe gezel hedot yoter miggezel gavoha shezze hikdim chet limmeila veze hikdim meila lechet

Veamar rabbi levi bo ure shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam hakkadosh baruch hu berach yisrael beesrim ushtayim vekillelan bishmone berchan beesrim ushtayim meim bechukkotay ad kommiyyut
Vekillelan bishmona mivveim bechukkotay timasu ad veet chukkotay gaala nafsham
Veilu moshe rabbenu berchan bishmone vekillelan beesrim ushtayim berchan bishmone

a: Mivvehaya im shamoa tishma vead leovdam vekillelan beesrim ushtayim mivvehaya im lo tishma ad veen kone
Makom shennahagu lamod begassa ku siman en meayenin veen godshin baagardemin uvlitra shelosha vaeser nefesh mishkalot mimmechak ave lo taasu lo yaase
Tanu rabbanan minnayin sheen mochakin bimkom sheggodshin veen godshin bimkom shemmochakin talmud lomar efa shelema
Uminnayin sheim amar hareni mochek bimkom sheggodshin velifchot lo min haddamim vahareni godesh bimkom shemmochakin ulhosif lo al haddamim sheen shomin lo talmud lomar efa shelema vatzedek yihye lach
Tanu rabbanan minnayin sheen meayenin bimkom shemmachriin veen machriin bimkom shemmeayenin talmud lomar even shelema
Uminnayin sheim amar hareni meayyen bimkom shemmachriin velifchot lo min haddamim vahareni machria bimkom shemmeayenin ulhosif lo al haddamim sheen shomin lo talmud lomar even shelema vatzedek
Amar rav yehuda missura lo yihye lecha bevetcha ma taam mishshum efa veefa
Lo yihye lecha bechischa ma taam mishshum even vaaven aval even shelema vatzedek yihye lach efa shelema vatzedek yihye lach

Tanu rabbanan lo yihye lecha melammed shemmaamidin agardemin lammiddot veen maamidin agardemin lashshearim deve nesia okimu agardemin ben lammiddot ben lashshearim amar leh shemuel lekarna pok teni lehu maamidin agardemin lammiddot veen maamidin agardemin lashshearim

Nefak derash lehu maamidin agardemin ben lammiddot ben lashshearim amar leh ma shemach karna tipok leh karna beeneh nefaka leh karna beeneh veihu keman savar ki ha deamar rame bar chama amar rabbi yitzchak maamidin agardemin ben lammiddot ben lashshearim mippene harammain
Tanu rabbanan haya mevakkesh mimmennu litra shokel lo litra chatzi litra shokel lo chatzi litra revia litra shokel lo revia litra may ka mashma lan dimtakkeninan matkale ad hachi
Tanu rabbanan haya mevakkesh mimmennu shelosha rive litra lo yomar lo shekol li shelosha rive litra achat achat ella shokel litra umanniach revia litra im habbasar
Tanu rabbanan haya mevakkesh mimmennu eser litrin lo yomar lo shekol li achat achat vehachriah ella shokel lo kullan bevat achat venoten hechrea echad lechullan

Tanu rabbanan nefesh moznayim teluya baavir shelosha tefachim ugvoha min haaretz shelosha tefachim vekane umitna shellah shenem asar tefachim veshel tzammarim veshel zaggagin teluya baavir shene tefachim ugvoha min haaretz shene tefachim vekane umitna shellah tisha tefachim

Veshel chenoni veshel baal habbayit teluya baavir tefach ugvoha min haaretz tefach vekane umitna shellah shishsha tefachim veshel turtani teluya baavir shalosh etzbaot ugvoha min haaretz shalosh etzbaot vekane umitna shellah eni yodea
Veella hach kammayeta demay
b: Amar rav pappa digarome
Amar rabbi mani bar pattish kederech sheamru leinyan isuran kach amru leinyan tumatan
May ka mashma lan tenena chut moznayim shel chenvani veshel baale vattim tefach kane umitna shellah itztericha leh dela tenan
Tanu rabbanan en osin mishkalot lo shel baatz velo shel avar velo shel gisteron velo shel shear mine mattachot aval ose hu shel tzunma veshel zechuchit
Tanu rabbanan en osin hammechak shel delaat mippene shehu kal velo shel mattechet mippene shehu machbid aval osehu shel zayit veshel egoz shel shikma veshel eshberoa

Tanu rabbanan en osin et hammechak tziddo echad av vetziddo echad katzar lo yimchok bevat achat shehammochek bevat achat ra lammocher veyafe lallokeach velo yimchok meat meat shera lallokeach veyafe lammocher

Al kullan amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay oy li im omar oy li im lo omar im omar shemma yilmedu harammain veim lo omar shemma yomru harammain en talmide chachamim bekiin bemaase yadenu ibaya lehu amrah o la amrah amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amrah umehay kera amrah ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam ufoshim yikkashlu vam

Tanu rabbanan lo taasu avel bammishpat bammidda bammishkal uvammesura bammidda zo medidat karka shello yimdod leechad bimot hachamma ulechad bimot haggeshamim bammishkal shello yatmin mishkelotav bemelach bammesura shello yartiach
Vekal vachomer uma mesura shehi echad mishsheloshim veshishsha ballog hikpida alav tora kal vachomer lehin vachatzi hin ushlishit hahin urviit hahin velog vachatzi log urviit vachatzi tomen veuchla

Amar rav yehuda amar rav asur laadam sheyyashhe midda chasera o yetera betoch beto vaafilu hi avit shel meme raglayim amar rav pappa la amaran ella beatra dela chatimi aval beatra dachatimi i la chaze chatima la shakel uvatra dela chatimi name la amaran ella dela mehandesi aval mehandesi let lan bah

Vela hi zimnin demikre ben hashshemashot umikre veshakel tanya name hachi lo yashhe adam midda chasera o yetera betoch beto vaafilu hi avit shel meme raglayim aval ose hu sea tarkav vachatzi tarkav vekav vachatzi kav verova vetomen vachatzi tomen

a: Veuchla vechamma hi uchla echad mechamishsha birvia uvmiddat hallach hu ose hin vachatzi hin ushlishit hahin urviit hahin velog vachatzi log urviit ushminit veechad mishshemona bishminit vezehu kurtov
Velebed name kabbayim ate leichallofe betarkav alma tau inashe tilta i hachi kav name la lebed deate leichallofe bachatzi tarkav ella kabbayim hayenu tama dela aved deate leichallofe bachatzi tarkav
Alma tae inish riva i hachi chatzi tomen veuchla la lebed amar rav pappa middot ketannot bekii behu inashe
Shelishit hahin reviit hahin la lebed kevan dahao bammikdash la gezaru behu rabbanan bammikdash name ligzor kohanim zerizin hen

Amar shemuel en mosifin al hammiddot yoter mishshetut velo al hammatbea yater mishshetut vehammistakker al yishtakker yoter mishshetut en mosifin al hammiddot yoter mishshetut may tama ilema mishshum afkoe tara shetut name la
Ella mishshum onaa dela leheve bitul mikkach vehaamar rava kol davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan afilu pachot mikkede onaa chozer
Ella dela leheve peseda letaggara
Peseda hu dela leheve leh ravecha la bae zevan vezabben taggara ikri
Ella amar rav chisda shemuel kera ashkach udrash vehashshekel esrim gera esrim shekalim chamishsha veesrim shekalim asara vachamishsha shekel hammane yihye lachem
b: Mane matan vearbein hau ella shema minah telat shema minah mane shel kodesh kaful haya ushma minah mosifin al hammiddot veen mosifin yoter mishshetut ushma minah shetuta millevar

Rav pappa bar shemuel takken keyala bar telata kefize amaru leh veha amar shemuel en mosifin al hammiddot yoter mishshetut amar lehu ana keyala chadta takkeni shaddereh lefumbedita vela kabbeluh shaddereh lefapunya vekabbeluh vekaru leh ruz pappa
Siman otzre ferot en otzrin veen motziin veen mistakkerin paamayim bevetzim matriin velo motziin

Tanu rabbanan otzre ferot umalve beribbit umaktine efa umafkie shearim alehen hakkatuv omer lemor matay yaavor hachodesh venashbira shever vehashshabbat veniftecha bar lehaktin efa ulhagdil shekel ulavet mozne mirma uchtiv nishba Adonai bigon yaakov im eshkach lanetzach kol maasehem
Otzre ferot kegon man amar rabbi yochanan kegon shabbetay atztzar perot
Avuh dishmuel mezabben lehu lefere betara charfa ketara charfa shemuel bereh mashhe lefere umzabben lehu betara afla ketara charfa shelachu mittam tava deabba middivra may tama tara deravach ravach

Amar rav ose adam et kabbo otzar tanya name hachi en otzrin perot devarim sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh kegon yenot shemanin uslatot aval tevalin kammon ufilpelin muttar bamme devarim amurim belokeach min hashshuk aval bemachnis mishshello muttar
Umuttar laadam leetzor perot beeretz yisrael shalosh shanim erev sheviit ushviit umotzae sheviit

Uvishne vatztzoret afilu kav charuvin lo yeetzor mippene shemmachnis meera bashshearim amar leh rabbi yose berabbi chanina lefuga shammaeh puk etzar li pere shalosh shanim erev sheviit ushviit umotzae sheviit

Tanu rabbanan en motziin perot meeretz yisrael devarim sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh kegon yenot shemanim uslatot rabbi yehuda ben betera mattir bayyayin mippene shemmemaet et hattifla uchshem sheen motziin meeretz lechutz laaretz kach en motziin meeretz yisrael lesurya verabbi mattir

a: Mehiparcheya lehiparcheya
Tanu rabbanan en mistakkerim beeretz yisrael bidvarim sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh kegon yenot shemanim uslatot
Amru alav al rabbi elazar ben azarya shehaya mistakker beyayin vashemen beyayin savar lah kerabbi yehuda beshemen beatreh derabbi elazar ben azarya shechiach mishcha
Tanu rabbanan en mistakkerin paamayim bevetzim amar mari bar mari peligi bah rav ushmuel chad amar al chad tere vechad amar taggar letaggara
Tanu rabbanan matriin al perakmatya vaafilu beshabbat
Amar rabbi yochanan kegon kele fishtan bevavel veyayin vashemen beeretz yisrael amar rav yosef vehu dezal vekam asra beshita
Tanu rabbanan en yotzin mearetz lechutz laaretz ella im ken amdu satayim besela amar rabbi shimon ematay bizman sheeno motze likach aval bizman shemmotze likach afilu amda sea besela lo yetze

Vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer elimelech machlon vechilon gedole haddor hau ufarnese haddor hau umippene ma neneshu mippene sheyyatzu mearetz lechutza laaretz shenneemar vattehom kol hair alehen vattomarna hazot noomi may hazot naomi amar rabbi yitzchak amru chazitem naomi sheyyatzat mearetz lechutz laaretz ma alta lah
Veamar rabbi yitzchak oto hayyom shebbat rut hammoaviyya leeretz yisrael meta ishto shel boaz vehayenu deamri inashe ad dela shachev shichva kayema menu vayeteh

Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav ivtzan ze boaz may ka mashma lan ki idach derabba bar rav huna deamar rabba bar rav huna amar rav mea veesrim mishtaot asa boaz levanav shenneemar vayehi lo sheloshim banim ushloshim banot shillach hachutza ushloshim banot hevi levanav min hachutz vayyishpot et yisrael sheva shanim
Uvchol achat veachat asa shene mishtaot echad bevet aviv veechad bevet chamiv uvchullan lo zimen et manoach amar kudana akara bemay para li
Tana vechullan metu bechayyav vehayenu deamri inashe bechayyich diladte shitin shitin lema lich ikfal veolid chad demishshitin zariz

Siman malach avraham eser shanim shenniftar nitnasse levaddo amar rav chanan bar rava amar rav elimelech vesalmon ufloni almoni vaavi naomi kullan bene nachshon ben amminadav hen may ka mashma lan sheafilu mi sheyyesh lo zechut avot enah omedet lo beshaa sheyyotze mearetz lechutza laaretz
Veamar rav chanan bar rava amar rav immeh deavraham ammatlay bat karnevo immeh dehaman ammatlay bat orevti vesimanach tame tame tahor tahor
Immeh dedavid nitztzevet bat adel shemah immeh deshimshon tzelelponit vaachateh nashyan lemay nafka minah litshuvat hamminim
Veamar rav chanan bar rava amar rav eser shanim nechbash avraham avinu shalosh bechuta vesheva bekardu verav dimi minnehardea matni ipcha amar rav chisda ivra zeera dechuta zehu ur kasdim
Veamar rav chanan bar rava amar rav oto hayyom shenniftar avraham avinu min haolam amdu kol gedole ummot haolam beshura veamru oy lo laolam sheavad
b: Manhigo veoy lah lassefina sheavad kabbarnitah
Vehammitnasse lechol lerosh amar rav chanan bar rava amar rav afilu resh garguta mishshemayya mokmi leh

Amar rav chiyya bar avin amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha chas veshalom sheafilu matzu subbin lo yatzu veella mippene ma neenshu shehaya lahen levakkesh rachamim al doram velo bikkeshu shenneemar bezaakech yatztziluch kibbutzayich
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella maot bezol uferot beoker aval maot beoker afilu amdu arba sein besela yotzin

Siman sela poel charuva talya amrin deamar rabbi yochanan nehirna kad hao kayemin arba sein besela vahao nefishi nefiche chefan bitverya middelet isar veamar rabbi yochanan nehirna kad la hao mitagrin poalayya lemadnach karta mereach pita mayetin

Veamar rabbi yochanan nehirna kad hava batza yanoka charuva vahava negid chuta deduvsha al teren deraohi veamar rabbi elazar nehirna kad hava natel orva bisra ungid chuta demishcha meresh shura vead leara veamar rabbi yochanan nehirna kad hao metayelin talya vetalyeta beshuka kevar shet esre uchvar shav esre vela hao chatan veamar rabbi yochanan nehirna kad hao amrin be midresha demode lehon nafel bidehon demitrechitz alehon dileh dilhon
Ketiv machlon vechilon uchtiv yoash vesaraf rav ushmuel chad amar machlon vechilon sheman velamma nikra sheman saraf veoash yoash shennityaashu min haggeulla saraf shennitchayevu serefa lammakom
Vechad amar yoash vesaraf sheman velamma nikra sheman machlon vechilon machlon sheasu gufan chullin vechilon shennitchayevu kelaya lammakom

Tanya keman deamar machlon vechilon sheman detanya may dichtiv veokim veanshe chozeva veoash vesaraf asher baalu lemoav veyashuvi lachem vehaddevarim attikim veokim ze yehoshua shehekim shevua leanshe givon veanshe chozeva ellu anshe givon shekkizzevu bihoshua veoash vesaraf ellu machlon vechilon velamma nikra sheman yoash vesaraf yoash shennityaashu min haggeulla saraf shennitchayevu serefa lammakom

Asher baalu lemoav shennasu nashim moaviyyot veyashuvi lachem zo rut hammoaviyya sheshshava venidbeka bevet lechem yehuda vehaddevarim attikim devarim hallalu attik yomayya amaran dichtiv matzati david avdi uchtiv shette venotecha hannimtzaot
Hemma hayyotzrim veyoshve netaim ugdera im hammelech bimlachto yashvu sham hemma hayyotzrim ellu bene yonadav ben rechav shennatzru shevuat avihem

Yoshve netaim ze shelomo sheddome lintia bemalchuto ugdera zo sanhedrin sheggadru pirtzotehen shel yisrael im hammelech bimlachto yashvu sham zo rut hammoaviyya sheraata bemalchut shelomo ben beno shel ben benah shenneemar vayyasem kisse leem hammelech veamar rabbi elazar leimmah shel malchut
Tanu rabbanan vaachaltem min hattevua yashan belo salmanton may belo salmanton rav nachman amar bela retzinta verav sheshet amar bela shedifa

Tanya kevateh derav sheshet tanya kevateh derav nachman tanya kevateh derav nachman vaachaltem yashan yachol yehu yisrael metzappin lechadash mippene yashan shekkala talmud lomar ad bo tevuatah ad shettavo tevua meeleha
Tanya kevateh derav sheshet vaachaltem min hattevua yashan yachol yehu yisrael metzappin lechadash mippene yashan shera talmud lomar ad bo tevuatah ad shettavo tevua meeleha

Tanu rabbanan vaachaltem yashan noshan melammed shekkol hamushshan mechaveroo have yafe mechavero veen li ella devarim sheddarkan leyashnan devarim sheen darkan leyashnan minnayin talmud lomar yashan noshan mikkol makom

Veyashan mippene chadash totziu melammed shehau otzarot melein yashan vagoranot melein chadash vehau yisrael omrim heach notzi ze mippene ze amar rav pappa kol mile attika mealleya levar mittamre veshichra veharsana
Hadaran alach hammocher et hassefina

a: Hammocher perot lachavero uzraan velo tzimmechu vaafilu zera pishtan eno chayyav beachrautan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer zerone gina sheenan neechalin chayyav beachrautan
Gema itmar hammocher shor lachavero venimtza nagchan rav amar hare ze mikkach taut ushmuel amar yachol lomar lo lishchita mechartiv lach
Velichze i gavra dezaven lenichseta lenichseta i leridya leridya begavra dezaven lehachi ulhachi
Velichze deme hechi ninhu
La tzericha deiyyakar bisra vekam bidme ridya i hachi lemay nafka minah nafka minah letircha
Hechi dame
b: I deleka leishtallome mineh liakkav tora bezuzeh deamri inashe min mare reshutach pare ippera
La tzericha deika leishtallome mineh
Rav amar hare ze mikkach taut batar rubba azlinan verubba leridya zavni ushmuel amar lach ki azlinan batar rubba beisura bemamona la
Siman ishsha veeved shor shevarin uferot
Metivi haishsha shennitalmena o nitgarsha vehi omeret betula niseti vehu omer lo chi ella almana nesatich im yesh edim sheyyatza behinuma veroshah parua ketubbatah matayim
Tama deika edim ha leka edim la veammay lema hallech achar rov hannashim verov nashim betulot nisaot
Amar ravina mishshum deika lememar rov nashim betulot nisaot umiut almanot vechol hanniset betula yesh lah kol vezo hoil veen lah kol itra leh rubba
I kol hannisaot betulot yesh lahen kol ki ika edim may have middelet lah kol sahadi shakkare ninhu
Ella rov hannisaot betulot yesh lahen kol vezo hoil veen lah kol itra leh rubba
Ta shema hammocher eved lachavero venimtza gannav o kuvustus higgio listim mezuyyan o muchtav lammalchut omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha
Resha

a: May tama lav mishshum derubba hachi itanhu
La kullehu hachi itanhu
Ta shema shor shennagach et happara venimtza ubbarah betziddah veeno yadua im ad shello negachah yalda o im mishshennegachah yalda meshallem chatzi nezek lappara urvia lavalad
Veammay lema hallech achar rov parot verov parot mitabberot veoldot veha vadday mechamat negicha hippila

Hatam mishshum dimsappeka lan deika lememar mikkammah ata umibbiatuta hippila veika lememar meachorah ata umingach nagchah vehippila have mamon hammuttal besafek vechol mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin

Lema ketannae shor shehaya roe venimtza shor harug betziddo af al pi shezze menuggach veze muad ligach ze menushshach veze muad lishoch en omrim beyadua shezze negacho veze neshacho rabbi acha omer gamal haocher ben haggemallim venimtza gamal harug betziddo beyadua shezze harago
Savruha derubba vachazaka ki hadade ninhu lema rav deamar kerabbi acha ushmuel deamar ketanna kamma
Amar lecha rav ana daamari afilu letanna kamma ad kan la kaamar tanna kamma hatam ella dela azlinan batar chazaka aval batar rubba azlinan
Ushmuel amar lach ana daamari afilu lerabbi acha ad kan la kaamar rabbi acha hatam ella deazlinan batar chazaka dehu gufeh muchzak aval batar rubba la azlinan
Ta shema hammocher perot lachavero uzraan velo tzimmechu vaafilu zera pishtan eno chayyav beachrautan
May afilu lav afilu zera pishtan derubba lizria zavni vaafilu hachi la azlinan batar rubba
Tannae hi detanya hammocher perot lachavero uzraan velo tzimmechu zerone gina sheen neechalin chayyav beachrautan zera pishtan eno chayyav beachrautan rabbi yose omer
b: Noten lo deme zera amru lo harbe lokchin oto lidvarim acherim
Man tannae ilema rabbi yose veamru lo tarvayehu batar rubba azli mar azel batar rubba deinashe umar azel batar rubba dizria
Ella i tanna kamma verabbi yose i tanna kamma veamru lo
Tanu rabbanan mahu noten lo deme zera velo hotzaa veyesh omrim af hotzaa
Man yesh omrim amar rav chisda rabban shimon ben gamliel hi

He rabban shimon ben gamliel ilema rabban shimon ben gamliel dematnitin ditnan hammocher perot lachavero uzraan velo tzimmechu vaafilu zera pishtan eno chayyav beachrautan ha zerone gina sheenan neechalin chayyav beachrautan

Ema sefa rabban shimon ben gamliel omer zerone gina sheenan neechalin chayyav beachrautan tanna kamma name hachi kaamar zera pishtan hu deeno chayyav beachrautan ha zerone gina sheenan neechalin chayyav beachrautan
Ella lav hotzaa ika benayehu mar savar deme zera umar savar af hotzaa
Mimmay dilma ipcha ha la kashya kol tanna batra letappoye milta ka ate

Vedilma kullah rabban shimon ben gamliel hi vechassore mechassera vehachi katane hammocher perot lachavero uzraan velo tzimmechu afilu zera pishtan eno chayyav beachrautan ha zerone gina sheenan neechalin chayyav beachrautan divre rabban shimon ben gamliel sherabban shimon ben gamliel omer zera pishtan hu deeno chayyav beachrautan ha zerone gina sheenan neechalin chayyav beachrautan

Ella ha rabban shimon ben gamliel detanya hammolich chittin lattachon velo letatan vaasaan subbin o mursan kemach lannachtom vaafao pat nipulin behema lattabbach veniblah chayyav mippene shehu kenose sachar

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer noten lo deme voshto udme boshet orchav vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer minhag gadol haya birushalayim hammoser seuda lachavero vekilkelah noten lo deme voshto udme boshet orchav
Od minhag gadol haya birushalayim mappa perusa al gabbe happetach kol zeman shemmappa perusa orchin nichnasin nistalleka hammappa en haorchin nichnasin

Matni hammocher perot lachavero hare ze mekabbel alav rova tinnofet lisa teenim mekabbel alav eser metullaot lemea martef shel yayin mekabbel alav eser kossot lemea kankannim bashsharon mekabbel alav eser pitasot lemea
Gema tane rav kattina rova kitnit lisa veafrurit la vehaamar rabba bar chiyya ketosfaa mishshemeh derabba borer tzeror miggorno shel chavero

a: Noten lo deme chittin
Kitnit rova afrurit pachot merova
Veafrurit rova la veha tanya hammocher perot lachavero chittin mekabbel alav rova kitnit lisa seorim mekabbel alav rova nishovet lisa adashim mekabbel alav rova afrurit lisa
May lav hu haddin lechittim velisorin shane adashim demikar akri lehu
Ella tama daadashim demikar akri lehu aval chitte usare la tifshot minah chitte usare deafrurit la mekabbel
Leolam chitte usare mekabbel afrurit adashim itztericha leh desalka datach amena kevan demikar akri lehu yoter merova name lekabbel ka mashma lan
Amar rav huna im ba lenappot menappe et kullo amri lah dina veamri lah kinsa
Amri lah dina man deyahev zuze appere shappire yahev verova la tarach inish yoter merova tarach inish vechevan detarach tarach bechulleh
Veamri lah kinsa rova shechiach yoter la shechiach veihu hu dearev vechevan dearev kansuhu rabbanan bechulleh
Siman kol tere shetare deravin bar rav nachman onaa vekabbelanuta
Metivi kol sea sheyyesh bah rova mimmin acher yemaet savruha derova dechilayim keoter merova dehacha veka tane yemaet
Lo rova dechilayim ki rova dehacha dame
I hachi ammay yemaet mishshum chumra dechilayim
I hachi
b: Ema sefa rabbi yose omer yavor
I amratte bishlama keoter merova tinnofet dame beha ka mipalgi tanna kamma savar la kansinan hettera attu isura verabbi yose savar kansinan ella i amratte kerova dame ammay yavor
Hatam hayenu tama derabbi yose mishshum demichaze ki mekayyem kilayim
Ta shema shenayim shehifkidu etzel echad ze mane veze matayim ze omer matayim shelli veze omer matayim shelli noten laze mane velaze mane vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu
Hachi hashta hatam vadday mane lemar umane lemar hacha mi yemar delav kulleh arove arev
Ta shema missefa amar rabbi yose im ken ma hifsid harammay ella hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu
Hachi hashta hatam vadday ika rammay hacha mi yemar dearove arev
Ta shema shetar sheyyesh bo ribbit konsin oto veeno gove lo et hakkeren velo et haribbit divre rabbi meir
Hachi hashta hatam mishsheat ketiva hu daavad leh suma hacha mi yemar dearove arev
Ta shema missefa vachachamim omrim gove et hakkeren veeno gove et haribbit
Hachi hashta hatam vadday karna dehettera hu hacha mi yemar dechulleh la arove arev
Ta shema detane ravin bar rav nachman lo et hammotar bilvad hu machazir ella machazir lo et kal harvain kullan alma hecha devae ahdore kullah mahdar
Hachi hashta

a: Hatam hen chaser hen yater amar leh mihu revia la chashiv yater mervia chashiv
Dechevan dachaze leh leitzterofe betishat kabbin haveya lah ara chashivta beappe nafsha vehadra
Ta shema haonaa pachot mishshetut nikne mikkach yoter mishshetut batel mikkach shetut kana umachzir onaa
Ammay lahdar ad pachot mishshetut shema minah kol hechi devae leahdore kullah mahdar
Hachi hashta hatam meikara shave beshave amar leh mihu pachot mishshetut la yedia bemane umachel inish shetut yedia vela machel inish yater mishshetut mikkach taut hu uvatel mikkach
Ta shema hamkabbel sade mechavero lita hare ze mekabbel alav eser boriyyot lemea yoter mikkan megalgelin alav et hakkol
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua kol yater mikkan keva lita mittechilla dame
Martef shel yayin vechu hechi dame i deamar leh martef shel yayin setam kashya i deamar leh martef ze shel yayin kashya

I deamar leh martef ze kashya detanya martef shel yayin ani mocher lach noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe martef ze shel yayin ani mocher lach noten lo yayin hannimkar bachanut martef ze ani mocher lach afilu kullo chometz higgio
Leolam deamar leh martef shel yayin setam vetane beresha devarayeta umkabbel alav eser kossot lemea
Uvistam mi mekabbel veha tane rabbi chiyya hammocher chavit yayin lachavero noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe shane chavit dechulla chad chamra hu

Veha tane rav zevid deve rabbi oshaya martef shel yayin ani mocher lach noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe martef ze shel yayin ani mocher lach noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe umkabbel alav eser kossot lemea
b: Vezehu otzar sheshshanu chachamim bemishnatenu
Ella matnitin name deamar leh ze
Kashya ze azze
La kashya ha deamar leh lemikpa ha dela amar leh lemikpa derav zevid deamar leh lemikpa barayeta dela amar leh lemikpa

Hilkach martef shel yayin veamar lo lemikpa noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe martef ze shel yayin veamar leh lemikpa noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe umkabbel alav eser kossot lemea martef ze shel yayin vela amar leh lemikpa noten lo yayin hannimkar bachanut
Ibaya lehu martef shel yayin vela amar leh lemikpa may peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar mekabbel vechad amar la mekabbel
Man deamar mekabbel dayek midderav zevid dekatane martef shel yayin ani mocher lach noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe veokimna deamar leh lemikpa tama deamar leh lemikpa ha la amar leh lemikpa mekabbel
Uman deamar la mekabbel dayek mibbarayeta dekatane martef shel yayin ani mocher lach noten lo yayin shekkullo yafe veokemna dela amar leh lemikpa

Ulman dedayek midderav zevid kashya barayeta chassore mechassera vehachi katane bamme devarim amurim deamar leh lemikpa ha la amar leh lemikpa mekabbel umartef ze shel yayin vela amar leh lemikpa noten lo yayin hannimkar bachanut
Ulman dedayek mibbarayeta kashya derav zevid deokemna deamar leh lemikpa ha la amar leh lemikpa mekabbel
Hu haddin deaf al gav dela amar leh lemikpa la mekabbel vehay deokemna deamar leh lemikpa mishshum dekashya ze azze
Amar rav yehuda yayin hannimkar bachanut mevarchin alav bore peri haggefen verav chisda amar gabbe chamra deakrem lema li
Metivi al happat sheippesha veal hayyayin shehikrim veal tavshil sheibbera tzurato omer shehakkol nihye bidvaro
Amar rav zevid mode rav yehuda befurtzema demizdabban akkarnata
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef ha rav yehuda ha rav chisda mar keman sevira leh amar leh matnita yadana

a: Detanya habbodek et hechavit lihot mafrish aleha teruma veholech veachar kach nimtzet chometz kol shelosha yom vadday mikkan veelach safek
May kaamar amar rabbi yochanan hachi kaamar kol shelosha yamim harishonim vadday yayin mikkan veelach safek
May tama chamra meilay akar vehay taameh vela akar im timtza lomar batar detaameh akar have recha challa vetameh chamra vechol recheh challa vetameh chamra chamra
Verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar kol shelosha yamim haacharonim vadday chometz mikkan ulhallan safek

May tama chamra mittattay akar veemor akar velav addateh veim timtza lomar meilay akar veha taameh vela akar dilma batar detaameh akar have recheh challa vetameh chamra verecheh challa vetameh chamra challa
Daromae matnu mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi rishonim vadday yayin acharonim vadday chometz emtzaiyyim safek
Ha gufa kashya amratte rishonim vadday yayin alma recheh challa vetameh chamra chamra vahadar amratte acharonim vadday chometz alma recheh challa vetameh chamra challa
Kegon deishtechach challa sifteka dei lav daakar telata yome la hava mishtechach challa sifteka
Keman peshat leh peligi bah rav mari verav zevid chad amar kerabbi yochanan vechad amar kerabbi yehoshua ben levi
Itmar hammocher chavit yayin lachavero vehechmitza amar rav kol shelosha yamim harishonim birshut mocher mikkan veelach birshut lokeach
b: Ushmuel amar chamra akkatpa demareh shavar

Vehatanya pichet shivat kabbin umechetza lechor o hotir shivat kabbin umechetza lechor higgio yoter mikkan kofin et hammocher limkor veet hallokeach likach
Hatam kegon dahava yakkira meikara vezal hashta deamrinan leh i ara yahavatte li hav li kezula dehashta
Vehatanya keshehu noten lo noten lo keshaar shellakach mimmennu hatam kegon dahava zula meikara veyakra lah hashta
Sheim shiyyer bassade bet tisha kabbin vechu amar rav huna tisha kabbin sheamru vaafilu bevika gedola
Verav nachman amar noten shivat kabbin umechetza lechol kor vachor
b: Vei ika milta yattira dehave letishat kabbin hadri
Etiveh rava lerav nachman sheim shiyyer bassade bet tishat kabbin lav dezabben leh korayim la dezabben leh kor
Uvagginna bet chatzi kav lav dezabben leh satayim la dezabben leh sea
Uchdivre rabbi akiva bet rova may lav dezabben leh sea la dezabben leh chatzi sea
Bae rav ashe sade venaaset ginna ginna venaaseta sade may teku
Tana im haya samuch lesadehu afilu kal shehu machazir lo karka
Bae rav ashe bor mahu shettafsik ammat hammayim mahu shettafsik derech harabbim mahu shettafsik richba dedikla mahu shettafsik teku
Velo et harova bilvad machazir lo ella kal hammotar kelappe leya tane ravin bar rav nachman lo et hammotar bilvad machazir lo ella et kal harvain kullan
Matni midda bechevel ani mocher lach hen chaser hen yater bittel hen chaser hen yater midda bechevel hen chaser hen yater midda bechevel

Gema amar rabbi abba bar memel amar rav cholkin alav chaverav al ben nannas may ka mashma lan tenena maase betzipori beechad shessachar merchatz mechavero bishnem asar zehuvim leshana dinar zahav lechodesh
Uva maase lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel velifne rabbi yose veamru yachloku et chodesh haibur
I mehatam hava amena hatam hu deika lememar mihdar ka hadar beh veika lememar paroshe ka mefaresh aval hacha devadday ka hadar beh ema la ka mashma lan
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel zo divre ben nannas aval chachamim omrim hallech achar pachot shebballeshonot
Zo vela sevira leh veha rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kor bishloshim ani mocher lach yachol lachazor bo afilu bassea haacharona
Kor bishloshim sea besela ani mocher lach rishon rishon kana ella zo usvira leh
Umi sevira leh vehaamar shemuel beva baemtza hachodesh askinan aval ba bitchillat hachodesh kullo lammaskir besof hachodesh kullo lassocher
b: Ella leolam zo vela sevira leh vehatam tama may mishshum detafes
Hacha name ha tafes
Amar rav huna amri be rav istera mea mae mea mae mea mae istera istera
