I itmar ha vela itmar ha hava amena mihdar ka hadar beh aval hacha mahu detema paroshe ka mefaresh ka mashma lan

a: Matni besimanav uvimtzarav pachot mishshetut higgio ad shetut yenakke
Gema itmar rav huna amar shetut kefachot mishshetut rav yehuda amar shetut keoter mishshetut

Rav huna amar shetut kefachot mishshetut hachi kaamar pachot mishshetut ushtut bakkelal higgio yoter mishshetut yenakke rav yehuda amar shetut keoter mishshetut hachi kaamar pachot mishshetut higgio ad shetut ushtut bakkelal yenakke
Metivi besimanav uvimtzarav pichet shetut o hotir shetut hare hu keshum haddayyanin higgio veha shum haddayyanin dishtut keoter mishshetut hu
Amar lecha rav huna ultamach higgio ka tane ella keshum haddayyanin velo keshum haddayyanin keshum haddayyanin lishtut velo keshum haddayyanin deilu hatam batel mikkach veilu hacha higgio
Rav pappa zevan ara mehahu gavra
b: Amar leh haveya esrin gerive meshacheh vela havay ella chamesra ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh sevarte vekabbelte
Vehatnan pachot mishshetut higgio ad shetut yenakke hane mile hecha dela kim leh begavah aval hecha dekim leh begavah sevar vekabbel
Veha esrin amar li amar leh daadifa keesrin
Tanya rabbi yose omer haachin shechalku kevan sheala goral leechad mehen kanu kullam may tama amar rabbi elazar kitchillat eretz yisrael ma techilla begoral af kan begoral
I ma lehallan bekalpi veurim vetummim af kan bekalpi veurim vetummim amar rav ashe behahu hanaa deka tzayeti lahadade gamri umaknu lahadade
Itmar shene achin shechalku uva lahen ach mimmedinat hayyam rav amar batla machloket ushmuel amar mekammetzin
Amar leh rava lerav nachman lerav deamar batla machloket alma hadar dina ella meatta hane be telata dekayemi vaazul be tere minayehu uflug hachi name devatla machloket
Hachi hashta hatam nechitu addata deve telata meikara hacha la nechitu addata deve telata meikara

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye lishmuel deamar mekammetzin lememra dekam dina veha rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kor bishloshim ani mocher lach yachol lachazor bo afilu bisa haacharona kor bishloshim sea besela ani mocher lach rishon rishon kana

a: Hatam avud rabbanan milta denicha leh lemocher venicha leh lelokeach
Itmar achin shechalku uva baal chov venatal chelko shel echad mehen rav amar batla machloket ushmuel amar viter verav assi amar notel revia bekarka urvia bemaot
Rav amar batla machloket ka savar haachin shechalku yorshin hen
Ushmuel amar viter ka savar haachin shechalku lakochot hau uchlokeach shello beachraut dame
Rav assi mesappeka leh i yorshin hau i lakochot hau hilkach notel revia bekarka urvia bemaot
Amar rav pappa hilcheta bechol hane shematata mekammetzin ammemar amar batla machloket vehilcheta batla machloket
Tanu rabbanan shelosha sheyyardu lashum echad omer bemane ushnayim omrim bematayim echad omer bematayim ushnayim omrim bemane batel yachid bemiuto
Echad omer bemane veechad omer beesrim veechad omer bishloshim niddon bemane rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer niddon betishim acherim omrim osin shuma benehen umshalleshin
Man deamar niddon bemane milta metziata rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer niddon betishim ka savar ha ara
b: Tishin shaveya vehay dekaamar esrim deka tae asra laachoreh vehay deka amar mane ka tae asra lekammeh
Adderabba hay ara mea veasra shaveya vehay dekaamar mane ka tae asra laachoreh vehay dekaamar sheloshim ka tae asra lekammeh nekot mihat tere kammae bidach demittorat mane la mappeki leh

Acherim omrim osin shuma benehen umshalleshin ka savri hay ara tishin utlata vetilta shaveya hay deka amar esrim ka tae telesar vetilta laachoreh vehay dekaamar mane ka tae telesar vetilta lekammeh uvdin hu delema tefe vehay dela kaamar savar misatay deka metappena kulle hay achavray

Adderabba ha ara mea utlesar utlata shaveya hay dekaamar mane ka tae telesar utlata laachoreh vehay dekaamar sheloshim tae telesar utlata lekammeh uvdin hu dekaamar tefe savar misatay deka metappena kulle hay achavray nekot mihat tere kammae bidach demittorat mea la mappeki leh

Amar rav huna halacha kaacherim amar rav ashe tama daacherim la yadinan hilcheta avdinan keotayehu tanu dayyane gola osin shuma benehen umshalleshin amar rav huna hilcheta kedayyane gola amar rav ashe tama dedayyane gola la yadinan hilcheta avdinan keotayehu

Matni haomer lachavero chatzi sade ani mocher lach meshammenin benehen venotel chatzi sadehu chetzyah baddarom ani mocher lach meshammenin benehen venotel chetzyah baddarom vehu mekabbel alav mekom haggader charitz uven charitz vechamma hu charitz shishsha tefachim uven charitz shelosha

Gema amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lokeach notel kachush shebbo amar leh rabbi chiyya bar abba lerabbi yochanan veha anan meshammenin benehen tenan amar leh addaachalte kafneyata bevavel targemna missefa
Dekatane sefa chetzyah baddarom ani mocher lach meshammenin benehen venotel chetzyah baddarom veammay meshammenin benehen veha chetzyah baddarom amar leh ella lidme hacha name lidme
Mekabbel alav mekom gader ku tana charitz mibbachutz uven charitz mibbifnim veze vaze achore gader

a: Kede shello tehe chayya kofetzet velaaved charitz vela laaved ben charitz ayede deravach kayema begaveh vekaftza velaaved ben charitz vela laaved charitz ayede dekattin kayema assifteh vekaftza vechamma ben charitz leven charitz tefach
Hadaran alach bet kor
Yesh nochalin umanchilin veyesh nochalin velo manchilin manchilin velo nochalin lo nochalin velo manchilin

Veellu nochalin umanchilin haav et habbanim vehabbanim et haav vehaachin min haav nochalin umanchilin haish et immo vehaish et ishto uvne achaot nochalin velo manchilin haishsha et baneha vehaishsha et balah vaache haem manchilin velo nochalin vehaachin min haem lo nochalin velo manchilin
Gema may shena dekatane haav et habbanim beresha litne habbanim et haav beresha chada deatchole befuranuta la matchalinan
b: Veod kedichtiv ish ki yamut uven en lo
Vetanna ayede deatya leh midderasha chaviva leh
Umay derasha detanya sheero ze haav melammed shehaav kodem laachin yachol yehe kodem labben talmud lomar hakkarov karov karov kodem
Uma raita lerabbot et habben ulhotzi et haach merabbe ani et habben shekken kam tachat aviv liida velisde achuzza
Adderabba merabbe ani et haach shekken kam tachat achiv leyibbum kelum yesh yibbum ella bemakom sheen ben ha bemakom sheyyesh ben en yibbum
Tama deika hay pircha ha lav hachi hava amena ach adif tipok leh

a: Dehacha tarte vehacha chada
Sede achuzza gufah mehay tama hu deka kayema leh letanna kelum yesh yibbum ella bemakom sheen ben ha yesh ben en yibbum
Ema sheero ze haav melammed shehaav kodem labbat yachol yakdim labben talmud lomar hakkarov karov karov kodem
Kevan dilinyan yibbum ben uvat ki hadade ninhu leinyan nachala name ben uvat ki hadade ninhu
Veema sheero ze haav melammed shehaav kodem laache haav yachol yakdim laachin talmud lomar hakkarov karov karov kodem
Ache haav la tzerichi kera ache haav mikkoach man ka atu mikkoach av kae av ka yarti ache haav
Veha kerae lav hachi ketivi dichtiv veim en achim leaviv vego kerae shello kesidran ketivi
Vehay tanna mayete lah mehacha detanya et zo darash rabbi yishmael berabbi yose ish ki yamut uven en lo vego bimkom bat atta maavir nachala min haav vei atta maavir nachala min haav bimkom achin
Veema bimkom bat atta maavir nachala min haachin
b: Vei atta maavir nachala min haav afilu bimkom bat im ken la nichtov rachamana vehaavartem
Ulman denafka leh mivehaavartem hay sheero may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya sheero zo ishto melammed shehabbaal yoresh et ishto

Ulman denafka leh mishsheero hay vehaavartem may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya rabbi omer bechullan neemar bahen netina vechan neemra bahen haavara sheen lecha shemmaavir nachala mishshevet leshevet ella bat hoil uvnah uvalah yorshin otah
Umimmay dishero ze haav dichtiv sheer avicha hi ema sheero zo haem dichtiv sheer immecha hi
Amar rava amar kera mimmishpachto veyarash otah mishpachat av keruya mishpacha mishpachat em enah keruya mishpacha dichtiv lemishpechotam levet avotam

Umishpachat em enah keruya mishpacha veha ketiv vayehi naar mibbet lechem yehuda mimmishpachat yehuda vehu levi vehu gar sham ha gufa kashya amratte vehu levi alma millevi ate mimmishpachat yehuda alma mihuda ate ella lav daavuh millevi veimeh mihuda vekaamar mimmishpachat yehuda
Amar rava bar rav chanan la gavra dishmeh levi i hachi hayenu dekaamar micha atta yadati ki yetiv Adonai li ki haya li hallevi lechohen in deitremi leh gavra dishmeh levi

Vechi levi shemo vahalo yehonatan shemo shenneemar vihonatan ben gershom ben menashshe hu uvanav hau chohanim leshevet haddani amar leh velitamach vechi ben menashshe hu vahalo ben moshe hu dichtiv bene moshe gershom veeliezer
Ella mittoch sheasa maase menashshe telao hakkatuv bimnashshe hacha name mittoch sheasa maase menashshe deate mihuda telao hakkatuv bihuda

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay mikkan shettolin et hakkalkala bamkulkal rabbi yose bar chanina amar mehacha vegam hu tov toar meod veoto yalda achare avshalom vahalo adoniyya ben chaggit veavshalom ben maacha ella mittoch sheasa maase avshalom demarad bammalchut telao hakkatuv beavshalom hacha name mittoch sheasa maase menashshe telao hakkatuv bimnashshe
Amar rabbi elazar leolam yidbak adam battovim shehare moshe shennasa bat yitro yatza mimmennu yehonatan aharon shennasa bat amminadav yatza mimmennu pinchas
Ufinchas lav miyyitro ate veha ketiv veelazar ben aharon lakach lo mibbenot putiel lo leishsha may lav deate miyyitro sheppitem agalim laavoda zara la deate miyyosef sheppitpet beyitzro
Vahalo shevatim mevazzim oto veomrim reitem ben puti ze ben sheppitem avi immo agalim laavoda zara yaharog nesi shevet miyyisrael

a: Ella i avuh deimmeh miyyosef immah deimmeh miyyitro i avuh deimmeh miyyitro immah deimmeh miyyosef dayeka name dichtiv mibbenot putiel tarte shema minah

Amar rava hannose ishsha tzarich sheyyivdok beacheha shenneemar vayyikkach aharon et elisheva bat amminadav achot nachshon mimmashma shenneemar bat amminadav eni yodea sheachot nachshon hi ma talmud lomar achot nachshon mikkan shehannose ishsha tzarich sheyyivdok beacheha tana rov banim domin laache haem

Vayyasuru shamma vayyomer mi heviacha halom uma atta ose baze uma lecha fo amru lo lav mimmoshe ka atet dichtiv beh al tikrav halom lav mimmoshe ka atet dichtiv beh ma ze beyadcha lav mimmoshe ka atet dichtiv beh veatta po amod immadi tease komer laavoda zara
Amar lahen kach mekubbelani mibbet avi abba leolam yaskir adam atzmo laavoda zara veal yitztarech labberiyyot
Vehu savar laavoda zara mammash vela hi ella avoda zara avoda shezzara lo kedaamar leh rav lerav kahana netosh nevelta beshuka ushkol agra vela tema gavra rabba ana vezila bi milta

Kevan sheraa david shemmamon chaviv alav beoter minahu al haotzarot shenneemar ushvuel ben gershom ben menashshe nagid al haotzarot vechi shevuel shemo vahalo yehonatan shemo amar rabbi yochanan sheshshav lael bechol libbo

Vehabbanim et haav menalan dichtiv ish ki yamut vego tama deen lo ben ha yesh lo ben ben kodem amar leh rav pappa leabbaye ema i ika ben lerot ben ika bat terot bat ika ben uvat la hay lerot vela hay lerot
Veella
b: Man ku lerot attu bar kashsha demata lerot hachi ka amena ika ben uvat la hay lerot kulleh vela hay lerot kulleh ella ki hadade lertu
Amar leh abbaye veitzterich kera leashmoinan hecha delet leh ella chad bera lertinhu lechullehu nichse vedilma ha ka mashma lan devat name bat yerushsha hi hahu mivvechol bat yoreshet nachala nafka
Rav acha bar yaakov amar mehacha lamma yiggara shem avinu mittoch mishpachto ki en lo ben tama deen lo ben ha yesh lo ben ben kodem
Vedilma benot tzelafchad hu dekaamran hachi nitna tora venitchaddesha halacha ella mechavarta kidshannin meikara
Ravina amar mehacha hakkarov elav hakkarov karov kodem

Umay kurveh deven mibbat shebben kam tachat aviv liida velisde achuzza yeida bat lav bat yeida hi sede achuzza name mehay pircha gufah hu deha kayema leh letanna kelum yesh yibbum ella bemakom sheen ben ella mechavarta kidshannin meikara
Vei baet ema mehacha vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem benechem velo benotechem ella meatta lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem hachi name benechem velo benotechem
Beracha shane
Vehaachin min haav nochalin umanchilin vechu menalan amar rabba atya achvahachva mibbene yaakov ma lehallan min haav velo min haem af kan min haav velo min haem
Ulma li mimmishpachto veyarash otah ketiv mishpachat av keruya mishpacha mishpachat em enah keruya mishpacha
In hachi name vechi itmar derabba leinyan yibbum itmar
Vehaish et immo vechu mena hane mile detanu rabbanan

a: Vechol bat yoreshet nachala mimmattot bene yisrael heach bat yoreshet shene mattot ella zo sheaviha mishshevet echad veimmah mishshevet acher umetu virashatan

Veen li ella bat ben minnayin amarta kal vachomer uma bat shehora kochah benichse haav yippa kochah benichse haem ben sheyyippa kocho benichse haav eno din sheyyippa kocho benichse haem umimmakom shebbata ma lehallan ben kodem labbat af kan ben kodem labbat
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi yose amru mishshum rabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav echad habben veechad habbat shavin benichse haem may tama dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon
Vetanna kamma la daresh dayyo veha dayyo deorayeta hu
Detanya middin kal vachomer ketzad vayyomer Adonai el moshe veaviha yarok yarak befaneha halo tikkalem shivat yamim kal vachomer lashshechina arbaa asar
Ella dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon
Bealma daresh dayyo veshane hacha deamar kera mimmattot makkish matte haem lematte haav ma matte haav ben kodem labbat af matte haem ben kodem labbat

Rav nitay savar lemebad ovada kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav amar leh shemuel keman kizcharya afes zecharya rabbi tavla avad ovada kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav amar leh rav nachman may hay amar leh deamar rav chinana bar shelemya mishshemeh derav halacha kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav amar leh zil ahdar bach vei la mappekna lach rav chinana bar shelemya meunnach

Rav huna bar chiyya savar lemebad ovada kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav amar leh rav nachman may hay amar leh deamar rav huna amar rav halacha kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav amar leh eshlach leh iksif amar leh hashta ki nach nafsheh derav huna atreste lekivli
Veihu keman savrah ki ha derav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu en halacha kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav

Mistemich veazel rabbi yannay akkatpa derabbi simlay shammaeh veate rabbi yehuda nesia leappayehu amar leh bar inash daata lekivlana hu yae vegulleteh yae ki meta legabbeh gashsheshah amar leh den shiureh kesak

Bea mineh minnayin leven shekkodem labbat benichse haem amar leh dichtiv mattot makkish matte haem lematte haav ma matte haav ben kodem labbat af matte haem ben kodem labbat amar leh i ma matte haav bechor notel pi shenayim af matte haem bechor notel pi shenayim
b: Amar leh leshammaeh gud let den tzave lemelaf vetama may amar abbaye amar kera bechol asher yimmatze lo lo velo lah
Veema hane mile bachur shennasa almana aval bachur shennasa betula hachi name deshakel
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar kera reshit ono ono velo onah
Hahu mibbaya leh labba achar nefalim deleheve bechor lenachala mi shellibbo dave alav yatza ze sheen libbo dave alav
Im ken lema kera ki hu reshit on may ono shema minah tarte
Veakkatti ema hane mile almon shennasa betula aval bachur shennasa betula hachi name deshakel
Ella amar rava amar kera lo mishpat habbechora mishpat habbechora laish velo mishpat habbechora laishsha
Vehaish et ishto vechu menahane mile detanu rabbanan sheero zo ishto melammed shehabbaal yoresh et ishto yachol af hi tirashennu talmud lomar veyarash otah hu yoresh otah veen hi yoreshet oto
Veha kerae lav hachi ketivi amar abbaye taretz hachi untattem et nachalato lakkarov elav sheero veyarash otah
Amar rava sakkina charifa mafseka kerae ella amar rava hachi kaamar untattem et nachalat sheero lo ka savar gorin umosifin vedorshin
Vehay tanna mayete lah mehacha detanya veyarash otah melammed shehabbaal yoresh et ishto divre rabbi akiva
Rabbi yishmael omer eno tzarich hare hu omer vechol bat yoreshet nachala mimmattot bene yisrael leechad mimmishpachat vego bahasavat habbaal hakkatuv medabbar
Veomer velo tissov nachala livne yisrael mimmatte el matte veomer velo tissov nachala mimmatte lematte acher
Veomer veelazar ben aharon met vayyikberu oto begivat pinchas beno vechi minnayin lefinchas shello haya lo leelazar ella melammed shennasa pinchas ishsha umeta virashah
Veomer usguv holid et yair vayehi lo esrim veshalosh arim beeretz haggilad

a: Vechi minnayin leyair shello haya lo lisguv melammed shennasa yair ishsha umeta virashah
May veomer vechi tema besibbat habben ka kafed kera aval baal la yaret ta shema velo tissov nachala livne yisrael mimmatte lematte
Vechi tema laavor alav belav vaase ta shema lo tissov nachala mimmatte lematte acher
Vechi tema laavor alav bishne lavin vaase ta shema veelazar ben aharon met vego
Vechi tema elazar hu dinsev itta umeta veyartah pinchas ta shema usguv holid et yair vego
Vechi tema hatam name hachi hu im ken tere kerae lema li
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye mimmay dilma leolam ema lach baal la yaret ukrae besibbat habben kidshanninan veyair dizvan mizban ufinchas name dizvan mizban
Amar leh pinchas dizvan mizban la matzet amratte deim ken nimtzet sade chozeret bayyovel venimtza tzaddik kavur bekever sheeno shello
Ella ema dinfala leh missede charamim
Amar abbaye sof sof ha ka mitakra nachala mishshivta deima leshivta deabba
Umimmay vedilma shane hatam shekkevar husabba amar leh shekkevar husabba la amrinan
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe i amratte bishlama shekkevar husabba hayenu demittokma kera ben besibbat habben ben besibbat habbaal
Ella i amratte la amrinan shekkevar husabba ki minasva leechad mimmishpachat matte aviha may have ha mitakra nachala mishshivta deima leshivta deabba
Demansevinan lah legavra daavuhi mishshivta daavuha veimeh mishshivta deimeh
b: I hachi hay leechad mimmishpachat matte aviha veimmah mibe leh i ketiv hachi hava amena afilu ipcha ka mashma lan
Tanya besibbat habben vetanya besibbat habbaal tanya besibbat habben velo tissov nachala livne yisrael mimmatte el matte besibbat habben hakkatuv medabbar

Atta omer besibbat habben o eno ella besibbat habbaal keshehu omer velo tissov nachala mimmatte lematte acher hare besibbat habbaal amur ha ma ani mekayyem velo tissov nachala livne yisrael mimmatte el matte besibbat habben hakkatuv medabber

a: Tanya idach velo tissov nachala mimmatte lematte acher besibat habbaal hakkatuv medabber

Atta omer besibat habbaal o eno ella besibat habben keshehu omer velo tissov nachala livne yisrael mimmatte el matte hare hasibat habben amur ha ma ani mekayyem velo tissov nachala mimmatte lematte acher besibat habbaal hakkatuv medabber
Dechulle alma mihat mimmatte lematte acher besibat habbaal hakkatuv medabber may mashma siman amar rabba bar rav shela amar kera ish tarvayehu ish ketiv behu
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar kera yidbeku tarvayehu yidbeku ketiv behu
Ella amar rava amar kera yidbeku mattot rav ashe amar amar kera mimmatte lematte acher uven lav acher hu

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi yannay amar rabbi umatu bah mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben korcha minnayin levaal sheeno notel barauy kivmuchzak shenneemar usguv holid et yair vayehi lo esrim veshalosh arim beeretz haggilad minnayin leyair shello haya lo lisguv ella melammed shennasa seguv ishsha umeta bechayye morisheha umetu morisheha virashah yair
Veomer veelazar ben aharon met vayyikberu vego minnayin lefinchas shello haya lo leelazar melammed shennasa elazar ishsha umeta bechayye morisheha umetu morisheha virashah pinchas
Umay veomer vechi tema yair dahava nesiv itta umeta veyartah talmud lomar veelazar ben aharon met vechi tema dinfala leh bisde charamim amar kera beno nachala haruya lo virashah beno
Uvne achot tana bene achot velo benot achot
b: Lemay hilcheta amar rav sheshet lekaddem
Tane rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak kammeh derav huna veyarash makkish yerushsha sheniyya lirushsha rishona ma yerushsha rishona ben kodem labbat af yerushsha sheniyya ben kodem labbat

Tane rabba bar chanina kammeh derav nachman vehaya beom hanchilo et banav baom atta mappil nachalot vei atta mappil nachalot ballayela amar leh abbaye ella meatta deshachev bimama hu deyarti leh beneh man deshachev belelya la yarti leh beneh
Dilma din nachalot ka amratte detanya vehayeta livne yisrael lechukkat mishpat ora kal happarasha kullah lihot din
Vechidrav yehuda deamar rav yehuda shelosha shennichnesu levakker et hachole ratzu kotvin ratzu osin din shenayim kotvin veen osin din veamar rav chisda lo shanu ella bayyom

a: Aval ballayela afilu shelosha kotvin veen osin din may tama dehau lehu edim veen ed naase dayyan amar leh in hachi name kaamena
Itmar kinyan ad ematay chozer rabba amar kol zeman sheyyoshvin rav yosef amar kol zeman sheoskin beoto inyan
Amar rav yosef keoti didi mistabbera deamar rav yehuda shelosha shennichnesu levakker et hachole ratzu kotvin ratzu osin din vei salka datach kol zeman sheyyoshvin lechush dilma hadar beh
Amar rav ashe amritah lishmata kammeh derav kahana ulrav yosef mi nicha velechush dilma hadar beh ella may it lach lememar disliku
b: Meinyana leinyana hachi name dekamu vahadar yetivu vehilcheta keoteh derav yosef besade inyan umechetza
Haishsha et benah vechu ha tu lema li ha tena leh resha haish et immo vehaish et ishto
Ha ka mashma lan deishsha et benah dumya deishsha et balah ma ishsha et balah en habbaal yoresh et ishto bakkever af ishsha et benah en habben yoresh et immo bakkever lehanchil laachin min haav

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda ben rabbi shimon devar tora haav yoresh et beno veishsha yoreshet et benah shenneemar mattot makkish matte haem lematte haav ma matte haav av yoresh et beno af matte haem ishsha yoreshet et benah

a: Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi yehuda ben shimon haishsha et benah vehaishsha et balah vaache haem manchilin velo nochalin amar leh mishnatenu eni yodea mi shenaah
Velema leh rabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav hi dela daresh mattot
La mitokma matnitin kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav dekatane uvne achot vetana bene achot velo benot achot veamrinan lemay hilcheta veamar rav sheshet lekaddem
Vei salka datach matnitin rabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav hi ha amar echad habben veechad habbat shavin benichse haem
Vetanna didan mimma nafshach i daresh mattot ishsha name tirash et benah i la daresh mattot ben dekodem labbat benichse haem mena leh
Leolam daresh mattot veshane hacha deamar kera vechol bat yoreshet nachala yoreshet veenah moreshet

Matni seder nachalot kach hu ish ki yamut uven en lo vehaavartem et nachalato levitto ben kodem labbat kol yotze yerecho shel ben kodmin labbat bat kodemet laachin yotze yerechah shel bat kodmin laachin achin kodmin laache haav yotze yerechan shel achin kodmin laache haav
Ze hakkelal kol hakkodem bannachala yotze yerecho kodmin vehaav kodem lechol yotze yerecho
Gema tanu rabbanan ben en li ella ben ben habben o bat habben o ben bat habben minnayin talmud lomar en lo ayyen alav
Bat en li ella bat bat habbat uven habbat uvat ben habbat minnayin talmud lomar en lo ayyen alav
b: Ha ketzad nachala memashmeshet veholechet ad reuven velema ad yaakov amar abbaye gemiri dela kale shivta

Amar rav huna amar rav kol haomer tirash bat im bat habben afilu nasi shebbeyisrael en shomin lo sheenan ella maase tzadokin detanya bearbaa veesrim betevet tavna ledinana shehau tzadokin omrin tirash habbat im bat habben

Nitpal lahen rabban yochanan ben zakkay amar lahem shotim minnayin ze lachem velo haya adam shehechziro davar chutz mizzaken echad shehaya mefatpet kenegdo veomer uma bat beno habbaa mikkoach beno tirashennu bitto habbaa mikkocho lo kol shekken
Kara alav et hammikra hazze elle vene seir hachori yoshve haaretz lotan veshoval vetzivon vaana uchtiv elle bene tzivon veayya vaana ella melammed shebba tzivon al immo veholid ana
Vedilma tere ana hao amar rabba amena milleta dela amrah shabbur malka umannu shemuel ika deamri amar rav pappa amena milleta dela amrah shabbur malka umannu rabba amar kera hu ana hu ana demeikara
Amar leh rabbi bechach atta potreni amar lo shote

a: Velo tehe tora shelema shellanu kesicha betela shellachem ma levat beno shekken yippa kochah bimkom haachin tomar bevitto shehora kochah bimkom achin venitztzechum veoto hayyom asauhu yom tov
Vayyomru yerushshat peleta levinyamin velo yimmache shevet miyyisrael
Amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme melammed shehitnu al shevet binyamin shello tirash bat habben im haachin
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay kol sheeno manniach ben leorsho hakkadosh baruch hu male alav evra ketiv hacha vehaavartem et nachalato uchtiv hatam yom evra hayyom hahu
Asher en chalifot lamo velo yaru elohim rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi chad amar kol sheeno manniach ben vechad amar kol sheeno manniach talmid
Tistayyem rabbi yochanan deamar talmid deamar rabbi yochanan den garmeh daasiraa bir tistayyem derabbi yochanan deamar talmid
Umidderabbi yochanan amar talmid rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar ben

Veha rabbi yehoshua ben levi la azel leve tamya ella leve man deshachev bela bene dichtiv bechu vacho laholech veamar rav yehuda amar rav laholech belo ben zachar ella rabbi yehoshua ben levi hu deamar talmid
Umidderabbi yehoshua ben levi hu deamar talmid rabbi yochanan amar ben
Kashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan la kashya ha dideh ha derabbeh
Siman hadad ani vechacham

Darash rabbi pinchas ben chama may dichtiv vahadad shama bemitzrayim ki shachav david im avotav vechi met yoav sar hatztzava mippene ma bedavid neemra bo shechiva uvoav neemra bo mita david shehinniach ben neemra bo shechiva yoav shello hinniach ben neemra bo mita
Veoav lo hinniach ben vehachtiv mibbene yoav ovadya ben yechiel ella david shehinniach ben kemoto neemra bo shechiva yoav shello hinniach ben kemoto neemra bo mita

Darash rabbi pinchas ben chama kasha aniyyut betoch beto shel adam yoter mechamishshim makkot shenneemar chonnuni chonnuni attem reay ki yad eloha naga bi veka amri leh chavreh hishshamer al tefen el aven ki al ze bacharta meoni
Darash rabbi pinchas bar chama kol sheyyesh lo chole betoch beto yelech etzel chacham vivakkesh alav rachamim shenneemar chamat melech malache mavet veish chacham yechapperenna

Ze hakkelal kol hakkodem bannachala yotze yerecho kodmin vehaav kodem lechol yotze yerecho bae rame bar chama avi haav vaache haav kegon avraham veyishmael benichse esav eze mehen kodem amar rava ta shema haav kodem lechol yotze yerecho verame bar chama
b: Aggav churpeh la ayyen bah

Bae rame bar chama avi haav veachiv kegon avraham veyaakov benichse esav eze mehen kodem amar rava ta shema haav kodem lechol yotze yerecho verame bar chama yotze yerecho shello velo yotze yerecho shel beno
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane ze hakkelal kol hakkodem bannachala yotze yerecho kodmin veilu iteh leyitzchak yitzchak kodem hashta name deleteh yitzchak yaakov kodem shema minah
Matni benot tzelafchad natlu shelosha chalakim bannachala chelek avihen shehaya im yotze mitzrayim vechelko im echav benichse chefer veshehaya bechor notel shene chalakim

a: Gema tenan keman deamar leotze mitzrayim nitchalleka haaretz
Detanya rabbi yoshiyya omer leotze mitzrayim nitchalleka haaretz shenneemar lishmot mattot avotam yinchalu ella ma ani mekayyem laelle techalek haaretz benachala laelle kaelle lehotzi et hattefalim

Rabbi yonatan omer levae haaretz nitchalleka haaretz shenneemar laelle techalek haaretz benachala ella ma ani mekayyem lishmot mattot avotam yinchalu meshunna nachala zo mikkol nechalot shebbaolam shekkol nechalot shebbaolam chayyin yorshin metim vechan metim yorshin chayyin

Amar rabbi emshol lecha mashal lema haddavar dome lishne achin kohanim shehau beir achat leechad yesh lo ben echad veechad yesh lo shene vanim vehalchu laggoren ze sheyyesh lo ben echad notel chelek echad veze sheyyesh lo shene vanim notel shene chalakim umachzirin etzel avihen vechozrin vecholkin beshave
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer
b: Leellu ulellu nitchalleka haaretz kede lekayyem shene mikraot hallalu ha ketzad haya miyyotze mitzrayim notel chelko im yotze mitzrayim haya mibbae haaretz notel chelko im bae haaretz mikkan umikkan notel chelko mikkan umikkan
Meraggelim yehoshua vechalev natlu chelkam mitlonnim vaadat korach lo haya lahem chelek baaretz habbanim natlu bizchut avi avihen uvizchut avi immotehen
May mashma dehay lishmot mattot avotam beotze mitzrayim ketiv dilma lishvatim kaamar lah dichtiv venatatti otah lachem morasha ani Adonai yerushsha hi lachem meavotechem ulotze mitzrayim kaamar lehu
Siman larav tzelafchad veosef ikfal menashshe yechashshev
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye bishlama leman deamar leotze mitzrayim nitchalleka haaretz hayenu dichtiv larav tarbe nachalato velamat tamit nachalato

a: Ella leman deamar levae haaretz may larav tarbu nachalato kashya
Vaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye bishlama leman deamar leotze mitzrayim hayenu deka tzavechan benot tzelafchad ella leman deamar levae haaretz ammay tzavechan ha leteh delishkol
Ella lachazara velitol benichse chefer
Bishlama leman deamar leotze mitzrayim hayenu deka tzavechan bene yosef dichtiv vayedabberu bene yosef ella leman deamar levae haaretz may ka tzavechi kullehu shekul
Mishshum tefalim dahao nefishi lehu

Amar abbaye shema minah la hava chad dela shakel dei salka datach hava chad dela shakel ibi leh lemitzvach vechi tema ditzvach veahani katveh kera ditzvach vela ahani la katveh kera ha bene yosef detzavechi vela ahani vechatvinhu kera

Hatam etza tova ka mashma lan deibi leh leinish leizdehore meena bisha vehayenu dekaamar lehu yehoshua dichtiv vayyomer alehem yehoshua im am rav atta ale lecha hayyara amar lehu lechu vehachbiu atzmechem biarim shello tishlot bachem ayin ra
b: Amaru leh anan mizzara deosef dela shalta beh ena bisha dichtiv ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin veamar rabbi avahu al tikre ale ayin ella ole ayin
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar mehacha veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz ma dagim shebbayyam mayim mechassim alehem veen haayin sholetet bahem af zaro shel yosef en haayin sholetet bahem

Meraggelim yehoshua vechalev natlu chelkam menahane mile amar ulla deamar kera vihoshua bin nun vechalev ben yefunne chau min haanashim hahem may chau ilema chau mammash veha ketiv kera acharina velo notar mehem ish ki im kalev ben yefunne vihoshua bin nun ella may chau shechau bechelkam

Mitlonnin vaadat korach lo haya lahen chelek baaretz vehatanya meraggelim mitlonnim vaadat korach yehoshua vechalev natlu chelkam la kashya mar makkesh mitlonnim limraggelim mar la makkesh mitlonnim limraggelim
Detanya avinu met bammidbar ze tzelafchad vehu lo haya betoch haeda ze adat meraggelim hannoadim al Adonai ellu mitlonnim baadat korach kemashmao
Mar makkesh mitlonnim limraggelim umar la makkesh mitlonnim limraggelim
Vaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye ulman demakkesh mitlonnim limraggelim ikful yehoshua vechalev viritu lechullah eretz yisrael amar leh mitlonnim shebbaadat korach kaamrinan
Vaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye bishlama leman deamar leotze mitzrayim nitchalleka haaretz hayenu dichtiv vayyippelu chavle menashshe asara shita deshita batte avot vearbea didhu ha asara
Ella leman deamar levae haaretz temanya hu dahao shita deshita batte avot utre didhu ha temanya
Velitamach ulman deamar leotze mitzrayim nitchalleka haaretz tisha hao ella may it lach lememar chad acha deabba hava lehu hachi name tere ache deabba hava lehu
Detanya naton titten lahem zo nachalat avihen betoch ache avihen zo nachalat avi avihen vehaavarta et nachalat avihen lahen zo chelek bechora
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer af chelek achi avihem natlu shenneemar naton titten ulman deamar tere ache deabba hava lehu hahu meachuzzat nachala nafka
Vaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye kera may ka chashev i tefalim ka chashev tuva hao i batte avot kachashev shita hao

a: Leolam batte avot ka chashev veha ka mashma lan divnot tzelafchad natlu chelek bechora alma eretz yisrael muchzeket hi
Amar mar vehabbanim natlu bizchut avi avihem uvizchut avi immotehen vehatanya bizchut atzman la kashya ha keman deamar leotze mitzrayim ha keman deamar levae haaretz
Veibaet ema ha veha levae haaretz vela kashya ha dahava ben esrim ha dela hava ben esrim
Veshehaya bechor notel shene chalakim veammay rauy hu veen habbechor notel barauy kivmuchzak amar rav yehuda amar shemuel beyitdot ohalim
Metiv rabba rabbi yehuda omer benot tzelafchad natlu arbaa chalakim shenneemar vayyippelu chavle menashshe asara ella amar rabba eretz yisrael muchzeket hi

Metivi amar rabbi chidka shimon hashshikmoni haya li chaver mittalmide rabbi akiva vechach haya rabbi shimon hashshikmoni omer yodea haya moshe rabbenu shebbenot tzelafchad yorshot hen aval lo haya yodea im notlot chelek bechora im lav
Uruya hayeta parashat nachalot likatev al yede moshe ella shezzachu benot tzelafchad venichteva al yadan

Veodea haya moshe rabbenu shehamkoshesh bemita shenneemar mechalleleha mot yumat aval lo haya yodea bee zo mita hu yamut uruyah hayeta parashat mekoshesh shettikkatev al yede moshe ella shennitchayyev mekoshesh venichteva al yado lelammedcha
b: Shemmegalgelim zechut al yede zakkay vechova al yede chayyav
Vei salka datach eretz yisrael muchzeket may ka mistappeka leh
Hi gufah ka mistappeka leh dichtiv venatatti otah lachem morasha ani Adonai yerushsha hi lachem meavotechem o dilma shemmorishin veenan yorshin

Ufshatu leh tarvayehu yerushsha lachem meavotechem umorishin veenan yorshin vehayenu dichtiv teviemo vetittaemo behar nachalatcha tevienu lo neemar ella teviemo melammed shemmitnabbein veenan yodin ma mitnabbein
Vattaamodna lifne moshe velifne elazar hakkohen velifne hannesiim vechol haeda efshar amdu lifne moshe ku velo amru lahen davar veamdu lifne hannesiim vechol haeda
Ella sares hammikra vedorshehu divre rabbi yoshiyya abba chanan amar mishshum rabbi eliezer bevet hammidrash hau yoshvin vehalchu veamdu lahen lifne kullan
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar cholkin kavod letalmid bimkom harav umar savar en cholkin
Vehilcheta cholkin vehilcheta en cholkin kashya hilcheta ahilcheta hilcheta ahilcheta la kashya ha diflig leh rabbeh yekara ha dela pelig leh rabbeh yekara
Tana benot tzelafchad chachmaniyyot hen darshaniyyot hen tzidkaniyyot hen

Chachmaniyyot hen shellefi shaa dibberu deamar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak melammed shehaya moshe rabbenu yoshev vedoresh befarashat yevamin shenneemar ki yeshvu achim yachdav amru lo im keven anu chashuvin tena lanu nachala keven im lav tityabbem immenu miyyad vayyakrev moshe et mishpatan lifne Adonai
Darshaniyyot hen shehau omrot ilu haya lo ben lo dibbarnu vehatanya bat amar rabbi yirmeya semi mikkan bat abbaye amar afilu haya bat labben lo dibbarnu
Tzidkaniyyot hen shello nisu ella lehagun lahen tane rabbi eliezer ben yaakov afilu ketanna shebbahen lo nisset pechuta mearbaim shana

Ini veha amar rav chisda nisat pechuta mibbat esrim yoledet ad shishshim bat esrim yoledet ad arbaim bat arbaim shuv enah yoledet ella mittoch shetztzidkaniyyot hen naasa lahen nes keocheved dichtiv vayyelech ish mibbet levi vayyikkach et bat levi

a: Efshar bat mea ushloshim shana vekore lah bat deamar rabbi chama bar chanina zo yocheved shehoratah badderech venolda ben hachomot dichtiv asher yalda otah lelevi bemitzrayim

Ledatah bemitzrayim vehoratah shello bemitzrayim veammay karu lah bat amar rav yehuda bar zevida melammed shennoldu bah simane naarut nitadden habbasar nitpashshetu hakkematin vechazar hayyofi limkomo
Vayyikkach vayyachzor mibe leh amar rav yehuda bar zevida melammed sheasa lah maase likkuchin hoshiva beappiron veaharon umiryam meshorrim lefaneha umalache sharet omrim em habbanim simcha

Lehallan menaan hakkatuv derech gedullatan vechan derech chochmatan mesayea leh lerabbi amme deamar rabbi amme bishiva hallech achar chochma bimsiba hallech achar zikna amar rav ashe vehu demaflag bechochma vehu demaflag bezikna
Tana deve rabbi yishmael benot tzelafchad shekulot hau shenneemar vattihyena havaya achat lechullan

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel benot tzelafchad hutteru lehinnase lechol hashshevatim shenneemar lattov beenehem tihyena lenashim ella ma ani mekayyem ach lemishpachat matte avihem tihyena lenashim etza tova hissian hakkatuv shello yinnasu ella lehagun lahen

Motev rabba emor alehem leotan haomdim al har sinay ledorotechem ellu dorot habbaim im neemar avot lamma neemar banim veim neemar banim lamma neemar avot mippene sheyyesh baavot ma sheen babbanim veyesh babbanim ma sheen baavot

Baavot hu omer vechol bat yoreshet nachala veharbe mitzot nitztauu banim shello nitztauu avot ha mippene sheyyesh baavot sheen babbanim veyesh babbanim ma sheen baavot hutzrach lomar avot hutzrach lomar banim
Katane mihat baavot hu omer vechol bat yoreshet nachala hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah levar mibbenot tzelafchad
Amar mar baavot hu omer vechol bat yoreshet nachala baavot in bavanim la may mashma amar rava amar kera ze haddavar davar ze lo yehe noheg ella bedor ze
Amar leh rabba zute lerav ashe ella meatta ze haddavar dishchute chutz hachi name dela yehe noheg ella bedor ze shane hatam dichtiv ledorotam
b: Ze haddavar derashe hammattot hachi name dela yehe noheg ella bedor ze amar leh hahu yalef zehze mehatam
Hay name lelaf zehze mehatam hay may bishlama hatam itzterich ligzera shava hacha lemay itzterich lishtok kera mineh vaana yadana dildorot hu

May gezera shava detanya neemar kan ze haddavar veneemar lehallan ze haddavar ma lehallan aharon uvanav vechol yisrael af kan aharon uvanav vechol yisrael uma kan rashe hammattot af lehallan rashe hammattot
Amar mar ma lehallan aharon uvanav vechol yisrael af kan aharon uvanav vechol yisrael lemay hilcheta amar rav acha bar yaakov lomar shehafarat nedarim bishlosha hedotot
Veha rashe hammattot ketiv beh kidamar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan beyachid mumche hachi name beyachid mumche
Uma kan rashe hammattot af lehallan rashe hammattot lemay hilcheta amar rav sheshet lomar sheyyesh sheela behekdesh
Ulvet shammay deamri en sheela behekdesh ditnan bet shammay omrim hekdesh taut hekdesh uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh hay ze veze may avdi leh
Ze haddavar dishchute chutz mibe leh al hashshochet hu chayyav veeno chayyav al hammolek ze haddavar derashe hammattot mibe leh lechacham mattir veen baal mattir baal mefer veen chacham mefer
Ulvet shammay delet lehu gezera shava hafarat nedarim bishlosha hedotot mena lehu nafka lehu middetanya vayedabber moshe et moade Adonai el bene yisrael rabbi yose haggelili omer

a: Moade Adonai neemru shabbat bereshit lo neemra ben azzay omer moade Adonai neemru hafarat nedarim lo neemra

Rabbi yose bar natan gemir lah leha matnita vela yada leh lefaroshah azal batreh derav sheshet linhardea vela ashkecheh azal batreh lemachoza ashkecheh amar leh may moade Adonai neemru shabbat bereshit lo neemra
Amar leh moade Adonai tzerichin kidush bet din shabbat bereshit enah tzericha kidush bet din salka datach amena hoil uchtivi gabbe moadot tibe kidush bet din kemoadot ka mashma lan
May moade Adonai neemru hafarat nedarim lo neemra moade Adonai tzerichin mumchin hafarat nedarim enah tzericha mumchin
Veha rashe hammattot ketiv amar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan beyachid mumche
