Rav sherevya amar af en immo temea leda deamar kera ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vetama shivat yamim ad sheyehe zachar mishsheat leda
Metivi hammappelet tumtum veanderoginos teshev lezachar velinkeva teuvteh derav sherevya teuvta
Lema tehve teuvta derav shezvi
Tanna sappoke mesappeka leh ulchumra
I hachi teshev lezachar velinkeva ulnidda mibe leh kashya
Amar rava tanya keoteh derabbi amme ben velo tumtum bechor velo safek
Bishlama ben velo tumtum kidrabbi amme ella bechor velo safek leappoke may
Leappoke middedaresh rava dedaresh rava shette nashim sheyyaldu shene zecharim bemachave kotvin harshaa ze laze

Amar leh rav pappa lerava veha shelach ravin davar ze shaalti lechol rabbotay velo amru li davar beram kach amru mishshum rabbi yannay hukkeru ulvassof nitarvu kotvin harshaa ze laze lo hukkeru en kotvin harshaa ze laze
Hadar oki rava amora aleh udrash devarim sheamarti lachem taut hen beyadi beram kach amru mishshum rabbi yannay hukkeru ulvassof nitarvu kotvin harshaa ze leze lo hukkeru en kotvin harshaa ze laze
Shelachu leh bene akra deagma lishmuel yelammedenu rabbenu hau muchzakin baze shehu bechor veamar aviv al acher bechor hu mahu shelach lehu kotvin harshaa
b: Ze laze
Ma nafshach i kerabbanan sevira leh lishlach lehu kerabbanan i kerabbi yehuda sevira leh lishlach lehu kerabbi yehuda
Mesappeka leh i kerabbi yehuda i kerabbanan
May hi detanya yakkir yakkirennu laacherim
Mikkan amar rabbi yehuda neeman adam lomar ze beni bechor uchshem shenneeman adam lomar ze beni bechor kach neeman adam lomar ze ben gerusha veze ben chalutza vachachamim omrim eno neeman
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava bishlama lerabbi yehuda hayenu dichtiv yakkir ella lerabbanan yakkir lema li
Bitzrich hekera
Lemay hilcheta lemitva lo pi shenayim lo yehe ella acher ilu bae lemitva leh bemattana mi la yahev leh
La tzericha binchasim shennaflu lo leachar mikkan
Ulrabbi meir deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam yakkir lema li
Binchasim shennaflu lo keshehu goses
Tanu rabbanan hau muchzakin bo shehu bechor veamar aviv al acher shehu bechor neeman hau muchzakin bo sheeno bechor veamar aviv bechor hu eno neeman
Resha rabbi yehuda vesefa rabbanan
Amar rabbi yochanan amar beni hu vechazar veamar avdi hu eno neeman avdi hu vechazar veamar beni hu neeman dimshammesh li keavda kaamar
Vechilufeh abbet hammeches haya over al bet hammeches veamar beni hu vechazar veamar avdi hu neeman amar avdi hu vechazar veamar beni hu eno neeman
Metivi haya meshammesho keven uva veamar beni hu vechazar veamar avdi hu eno neeman haya meshammesho keeved uva veamar avdi hu vechazar veamar beni hu eno neeman
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hatam dekaru leh avda metzar mea may metzar mea metzar avda mea zuze
Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama haomer lachavero avdi ganavta vehu omer lo ganavti ma tivo etzlecha atta mecharto li

a: Atta netatto li bemattana retzoncha hishshava vetol venishba eno yachol lachzor bo
May ka mashma lan tenena amar lo neeman alay abba neeman alay avicha neemanin alay shelosha roe vakar rabbi meir omer yachol lachazor bo vachachamim omrim eno yachol lachazor bo
Ha ka mashma lan divetten lach machloket vahalacha kedivre chachamim
Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama halacha govin min haavadim verav nachman amar en govin
Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama halacha shelishi besheni kasher rava amar af berishon
Mar bar rav ashe achshar beabba deabba velet hilcheta kemar bar rav ashe
Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama haya yodea lo beedut karka ad shello nistamme venistamme pasul

Ushmuel amar kasher efshar dimchaven mitzranaha aval gelima la verav sheshet amar afilu gelima efshar dimchaven middat orko umiddat rochbo aval nesacha la verav pappa amar afilu nesacha efshar dimchaven middat mishkelotav
Metivi haya yodea lo beedut ad shello naasa chatano venaasa chatano pikeach venitcharesh piteach venistamme shafuy venishtatta pasul

Aval haya yodea lo beedut ad shello naasa chatano venaasa chatano umeta bitto pikeach venitcharesh vechazar venitpakkeach piteach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa kasher
Ze hakkelal kol shettechillato o sofo befaslut pasul techillato vesofo bechashrut kasher
b: Teuvta dechullehu teuvta
Shelach rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama haomer al tinok ben habbanim neeman verabbi yochanan amar eno neeman
May kaamar amar abbaye hachi kaamar haomer al tinok ben habbanim yirash kol nechasay neeman kerabbi yochanan ben beroka verabbi yochanan amar eno neeman kerabbanan
Matkef lah rava hay neeman veeno neeman yirash velo yirash mibbaya leh
Ella amar rava hachi kaamar haomer al tinok ben habbanim bechor hu neeman kerabbi yehuda verabbi yochanan amar eno neeman kerabbanan
Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama haomer tittol ishti keechad min habbanim notelet keechad min habbanim amar rava uvinchasim shel achshav uvvanim habbain leachar mikkan

Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama hammotzi shetar chov al chavero malve omer lo nifrati kelum velove omer parati mechetza vehaedim meidin sheppara kullo hare ze nishba vegove mechetza minnechasim bene chorin aval mimmeshubadin la deamri anan aedim samchinan
Vaafilu lerabbi akiva deamar meshiv aveda have hane mile hecha deleka edim aval hecha deika edim irtote irtat

Matkef lah mar bar rav ashe adderabba afilu lerabbi shimon ben elazar deamar mode miktzat hattaana have hane mile hecha deleka edim deka mesayei leh aval hecha deika edim deka mesayei leh vadday meshiv aveda have

Daresh mar zutra mishshemeh derav shimi bar ashe hilcheta bechol hane shematata kedishlach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama amar leh ravina lerav ashe derav nachman may amar leh en govin matnenan lah vechen amar rav nachman
Veella hilcheta leappoke may

a: I leappoke midderava mosif hu i demar bar rav ashe let hilcheta kemar bar rav ashe i leappoke middishmuel verav sheshet verav pappa ha itotvu
Ella leappoke midderabbi yochanan umeatkafta demar bar rav ashe
Hamchallek nechasav al piv riba leechad umiet leechad ku hechi dame mattana battechilla hechi dame baemtza hechi dame bassof

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan tinnaten sade pelonit lifloni veyirasheha zo hi mattana battechilla veyirasheha vetinnaten lo zo hi mattana bassof yirasheha vetinnaten lo veyirasheha zo hi mattana baemtza
Vedaveka beadam echad vesade achat aval beadam echad ushte sadot sade achat ushne bene adam lo
Rabbi elazar omer afilu adam echad ushte sadot sade achat ushne bene adam aval bishte sadot ushne bene adam lo
Ki ata ravin amar tinnaten sade pelonit lifloni veyirash peloni sade pelonit rabbi yochanan omer kana rabbi elazar omer lo kana
Amar leh abbaye leravin anchette lan chada veatkefte lan chada bishlama derabbi elazar adderabbi elazar la kashya kan beadam echad ushte sadot kan bishne bene adam ushte sadot
Ella derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan kashya
Amorae ninhu vealliba derabbi yochanan
Veresh lakish amar lo kana ad sheyyomar peloni ufloni yirshu sade pelonit uflonit shennetattim lahem bemattana veyirashum

Biflugta amar rav hamnuna lo shanu ella adam echad vesade achat aval adam echad ushte sadot sade achat ushne bene adam lo verav nachman amar afilu adam echad ushte sadot sade achat ushne bene adam aval shette sadot ushne bene adam lo verav sheshet amar afilu shette sadot ushne bene adam
Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah detanya haomer tenu shekel levanay beshabbat uruyin liten sela noten lahen sela veim amar al tittenu lahen ella shekel en notnin lahen ella shekel veim amar im metu
b: Yirshu acherim tachtehem ben sheamar tenu ben sheamar al tittenu en notnin lahen ella shekel
Veha hacha dechishte sadot vechishne vene adam dame vekatane dekane
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah berauy leorsho verabbi yochanan ben beroka hi

Amar rav ashe ta shema nechasay lecha veacharecha yirash peloni veachare acharecha yirash peloni met rishon kana sheni met sheni kana shelishi veim met sheni bechayye rishon yachzeru nechasim leorshe rishon
Veha hacha dechishte sadot ushne bene adam dame vekatane dekana
Vechi tema hacha name berauy leorsho verabbi yochanan ben beroka hi i hachi met sheni kana shelishi

Ha shelach rav acha bereh derav aveya ledivre rabbi yochanan ben beroka nechasay lecha veacharecha lifloni verishon rauy leorsho en lashsheni bimkom rishon kelum sheen ze leshon mattana ella leshon yerushsha virushsha en lah hefsek
Teuvta dechullehu teuvta
Lema name tehve teuvteh deresh lakish vetisbera veha amar rava hilcheta kevateh deresh lakish behane telat
La kashya kan betoch kede dibbur kan leachar kede dibbur
Vehilcheta kol toch kede dibbur kedibbur dame levar meavoda zara

a: Vekiddushin

Matni haomer ish peloni yirasheni bimkom sheyyesh bat bitti tirasheni bimkom sheyyesh ben lo amar kelum shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer im amar al mi sherauy leorsho devarav kayyamin veal mi sheen rauy lo leorsho en devarav kayyamin

Gema tama deacher bimkom bat uvat bimkom ben ha ben ben habbanim uvat ben habbanot devarav kayyamin ema sefa rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer im amar al mi sherauy leorsho devarav kayyamin hayenu tanna kamma

Vechi tema rabbi yochanan ben beroka afilu acher bimkom bat uvat bimkom ben kaamar vehatanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer lo nechleku abba vachachamim al acher bimkom bat uvat bimkom ben shello amar kelum
Al ma nechleku al ben ben habbanim uvat ben habbanot sheabba omer yirash vachachamim omrim lo yirash
Ibaet ema middekaamar lo nechleku mikkelal detanna kamma savar nechleku

Ibaet ema kulleh derabbi yochanan ben beroka hi vechassore mechassera vehachi katane haomer ish peloni yirasheni bimkom sheyyesh bat bitti tirasheni bimkom sheyyesh ben lo amar kelum ha bat ben habbanot uven ben habbanim im amar yirash kol nechasav devarav kayyamin sherabbi yochanan omer im amar al mi sherauy leorsho devarav kayyamin
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka vechen amar rava halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka
Amar rava may tameh derabbi yochanan ben beroka amar kera vehaya beom hanchilo et banav hattora natna reshut laav lehanchil lechol mi sheyyirtze
Amar leh abbaye ha millo yuchal levakker nafka
Hahu mibe leh lechidtanya abba chanan amar mishshum rabbi eliezer
b: Ma talmud lomar lo yuchal levakker

Lefi shenneemar vehaya beom hanchilo et banav sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma pashut sheyyippa kocho shennotel barauy kivmuchzak hattora natna reshut laav lehanchil lechol mi sheyyirtze bechor shehora kocho sheeno notel barauy kivmuchzak lo kol shekken talmud lomar lo yuchal levakker
Veyomar lo yuchal levakker ma talmud lomar vehaya beom hanchilo et banav
Sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma bechor shehora kocho sheeno notel barauy kivmuchzak amra tora lo yuchal levakker pashut sheyyippa kocho shennotel barauy kivmuchzak lo kol shekken
Talmud lomar vehaya beom hanchilo et banav hattora natna reshut laav lehanchil lechol mi sheyyirtze
Amar rabbi zerika amar rabbi amme amar rabbi chanina amar rabbi halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka amar leh rabbi abba hora itmar
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar halacha adifa umar savar maase rav
Tanu rabbanan en lemedin halacha lo mippi talmud velo mippi maase ad sheyyomru lo halacha lemaase shaal veamru lo halacha lemaase yelech veyaase maase uvilvad shello yedamme
May uvilvad shello yedamme veha kol hattora kullah dammoye medammenan lah
Amar rav ashe hachi kaamar uvilvad shello yedamme bitrefot
Detanya en omrim bitrefot zo doma lazo veal titmah shehare chotchah mikkan umeta chotchah mikkan vechayeta
Amar leh rabbi assi lerabbi yochanan ki amar lan mar halacha hachi naaved maase amar la tabedu ad deamena halacha lemaase

Amar lehu rava lerav pappa ulrav huna bereh derav yehoshua ki ate piska dedina didi lekammayechu vechazetu beh pircha la tikreuhu ad deatetu lekammay i it li tama amena lechu vei la hadarna bi leachar mita la mikra tikreuhu umigmar name la tigmeru mineh la mikra tikreuneh dei havay hatam dilma hava amena lechu tama

a: Migmar name la tigmeru mineh deen laddayyan ella ma sheenav root
Bae rava bevari heach ki kaamar rabbi yochanan ben beroka bishchiv mera devar orote hu aval bevari la o dilma afilu bevari name

Amar leh rav mesharsheya lerava ta shema deamar lo rabbi natan lerabbi shenitem mishnatchem kerabbi yochanan ben beroka ditnan lo katav lah benin dichrin deyihon lich minay inun yirtun kesef ketubbetich yoter al chulakhon deim achuhon chayyav shettenay bet din hu
Veamar lo rabbi yissevun tenan

Veamar rabbi yaldut hayeta bi veheazti panay benatan habbavli ella dekayema lan benin dichrin la tarfa mimmeshabedi i salka datach yissevun tenan ammay la tarfa mimmeshabedi ella shema minah yirtun tenan
Man shamatte leh deit leh hay sevara rabbi yochanan ben beroka ushma minah afilu bevari
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye ben leman deamar yissevun uven leman deamar yirtun ha en adam makne davar shello ba laolam
Vaafilu lerabbi meir deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam hane mile ledavar sheyyeshno baolam aval ledavar sheeno baolam lo
Ella tenay bet din shane hacha name tenay bet din shane
Amar leh mishshum deka mappek lah bilshon yirtun
Hadar amar abbaye lav milta hi daamari ditnan lo katav lah benan nukvan deyihveyan lichi minay yihveyan yatvan beveti veyittaznan minnichsay ad detilakchan leguvrin chayyav shehu tenay bet din
Vehave laze bemattana velaze birusha vechol laze birushsha velaze bemattana afilu rabbanan modu
Amar leh rav nechumi veit deamar rav chananya bar minome leabbaye
b: Mimmay divchad be dina itkun dilma bitre be dina itkun

La salka datach dekatane resha ze midrash darash rabbi elazar ben azarya lifne chachamim bakkerem beyavne habbanim yirshu vehabbanot yizzonu ma habbanim enan yorshin ella leachar mitat avihem af banot lo yizzonu ella leachar mitat avihen
I amratte bishlama bechad be dina itkun hayenu deyalfinan takkana mittakkana ella i amratte bitre be dina itkun hechi yalfinan takkana mittakkana
Mimmay dilma leolam ema lach bitre be dina itkun uve dina batra takkun keve dina kamma ki hechi dela tikshe takkanta attakkanta
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hakkotev kol nechasav leishto lo asaah ella appotroppa
Peshita beno haggadol lo asao ella appotroppos beno hakkatan may
Itmar rav chanilay bar ide amar shemuel afilu beno katan hammuttal baarisa
Peshita beno veacher acher bemattana uvno appotroppos ishto veacher leacher bemattana veishto appotroppos
Ishto arusa veishto gerusha bemattana
Ibaya lehu bat etzel habbanim veishsha etzel haachim veishsha etzel bene habbaal mahu
Amar ravina mishshemeh derava bechullehu lo kana levar meishto arusa veishto gerusha rav avira mishshemeh derava amar bechullehu kane levar mehaishsha etzel haachin veishsha etzel bene habbaal

a: Bae rava bevari heach bishchiv mera hu denicha leh delishtamun milleh aval bevari ha kae ihu o dilma bari name nicha leh delishtamun milleh mehashta
Ta shema hakkotev perot nechasav leishto gova ketubbatah min hakkarka lemechetza lishlish velirvia gova ketubbatah min hashshear

Katav kol nechasav leishto veyatza alav shetar chov rabbi eliezer omer tikkara mattenatah vetaamod al ketubbatah vachachamim omrim tikkara ketubbatah vetaamod al mattenatah venimtzet kerachat mikkan umikkan
Veamar rabbi yehuda hannachtom maase veera haddavar bevat achoti kalla uva maase lifne chachamim veamru tikkara ketubbatah vetaamod al mattenatah venimtzet kerachat mikkan umikkan
Tama deyatza alav shetar chov ha lo yatza alav shetar chov kanya uvmay ilema bishchiv mera veha amratte lo asaah ella appotroppos ella lav bevari
Leolam bishchiv mera verav avira moke lah bechullehu ravina moke lah beishto arusa veishto gerusha
Amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman halacha tikkara ketubbatah vetaamod al mattenatah venimtzet kerachat mikkan umikkan
Lememra dela azel rav nachman batar umdana

Vehatanya hare shehalach beno limdinat hayyam veshama shemmet beno veamad vechatav kol nechasav laacherim veachar kach ba beno mattenato mattana rabbi shimon ben menasya omer en mattenato mattana sheilu haya yodea shebbeno kayyam lo ketavan veamar rav nachman halacha kerabbi shimon ben menasya
Shane hatam denicha lah detipok alah kala dechatvinhu nihalah lehanhu nechasim
Tenan hatam hakkotev nechasav levanav vechatav leishto karka kol shehu ibbeda ketubbatah mishshum dechatav lah karka kol shehu ibbeda ketubbatah
Amar rav bimzakke lahen al yadah ushmuel amar bimchallek lefaneha vehi shoteket rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar beomer lah teli karka zo bichtubbatich
b: Umikkulle chetubba shanu kan
Tenan rabbi yose omer im kibbela aleha af al pi shello katav lah ibbeda ketubbatah mikkelal detanna kamma savar ketiva vekabbala bae

Vechi tema kullah rabbi yose hi veha tanya amar rabbi yehuda ematay shehayeta sham vekibbela aleha aval hayeta sham velo kibbela aleha kibbela aleha velo hayeta sham lo ibbeda ketubbatah teuvta dechullehu teuvta
Amar leh rava lerav nachman ha rav ha shemuel ha rabbi yose berabbi chanina mar may sevira leh amar leh sheani omer kevan sheasaah shuttaf ben habbanim ibbeda ketubbatah
Itmar name amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman kevan sheasaah shuttaf ben habbanim ibbeda ketubbatah
Bae rava bevari heach mi amrinan bishchiv mera hu deyada delet leh vekamachala aval bevari savra hadar kane o dilma hashta mihat let leh teku

Hahu daamar lehu palga livrat ufalga livrat vetilta leitat befere ikla rav nachman lesura ul legabbe rav chisda amar leh ki hay gavena may amar leh hachi amar shemuel afilu lo hikna lah ella dekel echad leferotav ibbeda ketubbatah
Amar leh emor deamar shemuel hatam deakni lah begufah deara hacha pera hu amar leh mittalteli ka amratte mittalteli vadday la ka amena
Hahu daamar lehu tilta livrat vetilta livrat vetilta leitat shechiva chada mibbenateh sevar rav pappe lememar la shakla ella telata

a: Amar leh rav kahana ilu hadar kane mi la shakla vechevan deilu hadar kane shakla hashta name shakla

Hahu defalginhu lenichseh leitteteh velivneh shayyar chad dikla sevar ravina lememar let lah ella chad dikla amar leh rav yemar leravina i let lah chad dikla name let lah ella migo denachata ledikla nachata name lechullehu nichse
Amar rav huna shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav leacher roin im rauy leorsho notlan mishshum yerushsha veim lav notlan mishshum mattana
Amar leh rav nachman gannava gannove lema lach i sevira lach kerabbi yochanan ben beroka ema halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka deha shematetach kerabbi yochanan ben beroka hu deazla

Dilma ki ha kaamratte dehahu dahava ka shachev vaamaru leh nichseh leman dilma liflanya vaamar lehu ella leman vaamarte lan alah im rauy leorsho notlan mishshum yerushsha veim lav notlan mishshum mattana amar leh in hachi kaamena
Lemay hilcheta savar rav adda bar ahava kammeh derava lememar im rauy leorsho almenato nizzonet minnechasav veim lav en almenato nizzonet minnechasav
Amar leh rava migra gara hashta birusha deorayeta amratte almenato nizzonet minnechasav bemattana derabbanan lo kol shekken

Ella amar rava kedishlach rav acha bar rav aveya ledivre rabbi yochanan ben beroka nechasay lecha veacharecha lifloni im haya rishon rauy leorsho en lashsheni bimkom rishon kelum sheen leshon mattana ella leshon yerushsha virushsha en lah hefsek
Amar leh rava lerav nachman veha afsekah hu savar yesh lah hefsek verachamana amar en lah hefsek
b: Hahu daamar leh lechavreh nechasay lecha veacharecha lifloni verishon rauy leorsho hava shachev rishon ata sheni ka tava
Sevar rav ilish kammeh derava lememar sheni name shakel amar leh dayyane dachatzatzta hachi dayeni lav hayenu dishlach rav acha bar rav aveya
Ikkesif kare aleh ani Adonai beittah achishenna
Matni hakkotev et nechasav laacherim vehinniach et banav ma sheasa asuy ella en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im lo hau banav nohagim kashshura zachur lattov
Gema ibaya lehu mi peligi rabbanan aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel o la

Ta shema deosef ben yoezer haya lo ben shello haya noheg kashshura hava leh ilita dedinare kam akdeshah azal nesev bat gadel kelile deyannay malka olida devethu zabben lah binita karah ashkach bah margalita
Amara leh la tamteyah lemalka deshakli lah minach bidme kallile zil amteyah legabbe gizbare vela teshayemah atte daamirato legavoha kimsirato lehedot ella leshayemuha inhu
Amteyah shamuha bitlesre illiyyata dedinare amri leh sheva ika shet leka amar lehu sheva havu li shet hare hen mukdashot lashshamayim
Amdu vechatvu yosef ben yoezer hichnis achat uvno hichnis shesh veika deamri yosef ben yoezer hichnis achat uvno hotzi sheva
Middeka amri hichnis mikkelal deshappir avad adderabba middeka amri hotzi mikkelal delav shappir avad ella meha leka lemishma minah
May have alah ta shema daamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana la tehave be abbore achsanta vaafilu mibbera bisha livra tava vechol shekken mibbera levarta
Tanu rabbanan maase beadam echad shello hau banav nohagin kashshura amad vechatav nechasav leonatan ben uzziel ma asa yonatan ben uzziel machar shelish vehikdish shelish vehechezir levanav shelish
Ba alav shammay bemaklo vetarmilo amar lo shammay im atta yachol lehotzi et ma shemmacharti uma shehikdashti atta yachol lehotzi ma shehechzarti

a: Im lav i atta yachol lehotzi ma shehechzarti amar hetiach alay ben uzziel hetiach alay ben uzziel
Meikara may savar mishshum maase devet choron

Ditnan maase bevet choron beechad shehaya aviv muddar hemennu hanaa vehaya massi beno veamar lachavero hare chatzer usuda netunin lecha bemattana veenan lefanecha ella kede sheyyavo abba veyochal immanu basseuda

Amar lo im shelli hen hare hen mukdashin lashshamayim amar lo lo natatti lecha et shelli shettakdishem lashshamayim amar lo lo natatta li et shellecha ella shettehe atta veavich ochlin veshotin umratztzin ze laze vihe aon taluy berosho
Amru chachamim kol mattana sheenah sheim hikdishah mukdeshet enah mattana

Tanu rabbanan shemonim talmidim hau lo lehillel hazzaken sheloshim mehen reuyim shettishre alehen shechina kemoshe rabbenu sheloshim mehen reuyim shettaamod lahen chamma kihoshua bin nun esrim benoniyyim gadol shebbechullan yonatan ben uzziel katan shebbechullan rabban yochanan ben zakkay

Amru alav al rabban yochanan ben zakkay shello hinniach mikra umishna talmud halachot veaggadot dikduke tora vedikidduke sofrim vekallin vachamurin ugzerot shaot utkufot vegimatriyyaot umishlot kovsim umishlot shualim sichat shedim vesichat dekalim vesichat malache hashsharet vedavar gadol vedavar katan
Davar gadol maase merkava vedavar katan havaot deabbaye verava lekayyem ma shenneemar lehanchil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle
Vechi meachar dekatan shebbechullam ken gadol shebbechullam al achat kamma vechamma amru alav al yonatan ben uzziel beshaa sheyyoshev veosek battora kol of shepporeach alav nisraf
Matni haomer ze beni neeman ze achi eno neeman veyittol immo bechelko
Met yachzeru nechasim limkoman
Naflu lo nechasim mimmakom acher yirshu echav immo
Gema ze beni neeman lemay hilcheta amar rav yehuda amar shemuel leorsho veliftor et ishto min hayyibbum
b: Leorsho peshita liftor et ishto min hayyibbum itztericha leh
Ha name tenena mi sheamar bishat mitato yesh li banim neeman yesh li achim eno neeman
Hatam dela muchzak lan beach hacha af al gav demuchzak leh beach
Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mippene ma amru ze beni neeman hoil uvaal sheamar gerashti et ishti neeman
Amar rav yosef mareh deavraham tale tanya bidla tanya
Ella i ittemar hachi itmar amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mippene ma amru ze beni neeman hoil uvyado legarshah
Amar rav yosef hashta deamratte amrinan hoil baal sheamar gerashti et ishti neeman hoil uvyado legarshah
Ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan baal sheamar gerashti et ishti eno neeman menappach rav sheshet bideh azal leh hoil derav yosef
Ini veha amar rabbi chiyya bar avin amar rabbi yochanan baal sheamar gerashti et ishti neeman
La kashya kan lemafrea
Kan lehabba
Ibaya lehu amar lemafrea mahu lehemoneh lehabba
Mi palginan dibbura o la palginan dibbura rav mari verav zevid chad amar palginan vechad amar la palginan
May shena midderava deamar rava ish peloni ba al ishti hu veacher mitztarfin lehorgo lehorgo velo lehorgah
Bitre gufe palginan bechad gufa la palginan

a: Hahu dahava ka shachev amaru leh itteteh leman amar lehu chazya lechahana rabba

Amar rava may nechush lah ha amar rav chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan baal sheamar gerashti et ishti neeman amar leh abbaye veha ki ata rabbi yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan baal sheamar gerashti et ishti eno neeman amar leh velav mi la shanninhu kan lemafrea vechan lehabba
Veashshinnuye nekum velismoch amar leh rava lerav natan bar amme chush lah

Hahu dahava muchzak lan delet leh ache vaamar bishat mita delet leh ache amar rav yosef may lechush lah chada demuchzak lan delet leh achin veod ha amar bishat mita delet leh amar leh abbaye ha amri deika edim bimdinat hayyam deyadi deit leh ache
Hashta mihat ha letanhu kamman lav hayenu derabbi chanina deamar rabbi chanina edim betzad astan veteaser
Amar leh abbaye im hekalnu bishvuya mishshum dimnavvela nafshah legabbe shabbay nakel beeshet ish amar leh rava lerav natan bar amme chush lah
Ze achi eno neeman veidach may kaamri i kaamri achuna hu ammay yittol immo bechelko vetu la ella deka amri lav achinu hu
Ema sefa naflu lo nechasim mimmakom acher yirshu echav immo ha amri leh lav achuna hu
La tzericha deka amri en anu yodin
Amar rava zot omeret mane li beyadcha vehalla omer eni yodea patur
Abbaye amar
b: Leolam ema lach chayyav veshane hacha dichmane leacher beyadcha dame
Met yachzeru nechasim limkoman bae rava shevach sheshshavchu nechasim mealehem mahu
Beshevach hammaggia lakketefayim la tibe lach dechi naflu lo nechasim mimmakom acher dame ki tibe lach beshevach sheeno maggia lakketefayim kegon dikla vaalem ara veasseka sirton may teku
Matni mi shemmet venimtzet deyateke keshura al yerecho hare zo enah kelum zika bah leacher ben min hayyorshin ben sheenan min hayyorshin devarav kayyamin
Gema tanu rabbanan eze hi deyateke kol shekkatuv bah da tehe lemekam velihot veeze hi mattana kol shekkatuv bah mehayyom ulachar mita

Ella mehayyom ulachar mita hu dehaveya mattana meachshav la haveya mattana amar abbaye hachi kaamar ezo hi mattenat bari shehi kemattenat shechiv mera dela kane ella leachar mita kol shekkatuv bah mehayyom ulachar mita

Yatev rabba bar rav huna beachsadra deve rav veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi yochanan shechiv mera sheamar kitvu utnu mane lifloni umet en kotvin venotnin shemma lo gamar lehaknoto ella bishtar veen shetar leachar mita
Amar lehu rabbi elazar izdeharu bah rav shezvi amar rabbi elazar amra vaamar lehu rabbi yochanan izdeharu bah

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak kevateh derav shezvi mistabbera i amratte bishlama rabbi elazar amrah itzterich rabbi yochanan leashode aleh derabbi elazar ella i amratte rabbi yochanan amrah itzterich rabbi elazar leashode aleh derabbi yochanan rabbeh

Veod ta shema derabbi elazar amrah dishlach ravin mishshemeh derabbi avahu heu yodim sheshshalach rabbi elazar laggola mishshum rabbenu shechiv mera sheamar kitvu utnu mane lifloni umet en kotvin venotnin shemma lo gamar lehaknoto ella bishtar veen shetar leachar mita verabbi yochanan amar tibadek
May tibadek ki ata rav dimi amar deyateke mevattelet deyateke shechiv mera sheamar kitvu utnu mane lifloni umet roin im kimyappe et kocho kotvin veim lav en kotvin
Metiv rabbi abba bar memel bari sheamar kitvu utnu mane lifloni umet en kotvin venotnin ha shechiv mera kotvin venotnin hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah bimyappe et kocho
Hechi dame meyappe et kocho

a: Kidamar rav chisda uknena mineh mosif al mattanta da hacha name deamar af ketovu vachatomu vehavu leh
Itmar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kotvin venotnin vechen amar rava amar rav nachman halacha kotvin venotnin
Matni hakkotev nechasav levanav tzarich sheyyichtov mehayyom ulachar mita divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer eno tzarich
Hakkotev nechasav livno leachar moto haav eno yachol limkor mippene shehen ketuvin labben vehabben eno yachol limkor mippene shehen birshut haav
Machar haav mechurim ad sheyyamut machar habben en lallokeach bahen kelum ad sheyyamut haav
Gema vechi katav mehayyom ulachar mita may have ha tenan mehayyom ulachar mita get veeno get veim met choletzet velo mityabemet
Hatam mesappeka lan i tenaa have i chazara have aval hacha hachi kaamar leh gufa keni mehayyom pera leachar mita

Rabbi yose omer eno tzarich rabba bar avuh chalash al legabbeh rav huna verav nachman amar leh rav huna lerav nachman bei mineh halacha kerabbi yose o en halacha kerabbi yose amar leh tameh derabbi yose la yadana halacha eve mineh amar leh atte bei mineh i halacha i la vetameh ana amena lach

Bea mineh amar leh hachi amar rav halacha kerabbi yose batar dinfaku amar leh hayenu tameh derabbi yose deamar zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav tanya name hachi rabbi yose omer eno tzarich mippene shezzemanno shel shetar mochiach alav
Bea mineh rava merav nachman behaknaa mahu amar leh behaknaa eno tzarich
Rav pappe amar ika akneyata ditzrich veika akneyata dela tzerich akneyeh uknena mineh la tzarich kenena mineh veakneyeh tzerich
Matkef lah rav chanina missura mi ika mide daanan la yadinan vesafre yadi sheelunhu lesafre deabbaye veyadi ulsafre derava veyadi
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar ben akneyeh uknena mineh ben kenena mineh veakneyeh la tzerich uvduchran pitgame dahave beanpana peligi

Amar rav kahana amritah lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea vaamar li attun hachi matnitu lah anan hachi matnenan lah amar rava amar rav nachman behaknaa eno tzarich ben akneyeh uknena mineh ben kenena mineh veakneyeh la tzerich beduchran pitgame dahao beanpana peligi
Hakkotev nechasav livno leachar moto itmar machar habben bechayye haav umet habben bechayye haav
b: Amar rabbi yochanan lo kana lokeach veresh lakish amar kana lokeach
Rabbi yochanan amar lo kana lokeach kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame
Veresh lakish amar kana lokeach kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame
Veha ipligu bah chada zimna deitmar hammocher sadehu leferot rabbi yochanan amar mevi vekore veresh lakish amar mevi veeno kore
Rabbi yochanan amar mevi vekore kasavar kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame veresh lakish amar mevi veeno kore kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame
Amar lach rabbi yochanan af al gav divalma kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame hacha itzterich salka datach amena abba legabbe bereh achole achel ka mashma lan
Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar af al gav divalma kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame hacha itzterich salka datach amena kol legabbe nafsheh afilu bimkom bereh nafsheh adifa leh ka mashma lan
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish nechasay lecha veacharecha yirash peloni veacharav yirash peloni met rishon kana sheni met sheni kana shelishi
Met sheni bechayye rishon yachzeru nechasim leorshe rishon
Veim ita leorshe noten mibe leh
Amar leh kevar targemah rav hoshaya bevavel acharecha shane vechen rame rabba bar rav huna kammeh derav veamar acharecha shane
Vehatanya yachzeru leorshe noten

a: Tannae hi detanya nechasay lecha veacharecha lifloni veyarad rishon umachar veachal hashsheni motzi miyyad hallakochot divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer en lashsheni ella ma sheshshiyyer rishon
Urminhi nechasay lecha veacharecha lifloni yored rishon umocher veochel divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer en larishon ella achilat perot bilvad
Kashya derabbi adderabbi udrabban shimon ben gamliel adderabban shimon ben gamliel
Derabbi adderabbi la kashya ha legufa ha lefera derabban shimon ben gamliel adderabban shimon ben gamliel la kashya ha lechattechilla ha diavad
Amar abbaye ezehu rasha arum ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel umode sheim netanan bemattenat shechiv mera lo asa kelum
May tama amar abbaye mattenat shechiv mera lo kana ella leachar mita uchvar kedamo acharecha
Umi amar abbaye hachi veha itmar mattenat shechiv mera meematay kana abbaye amar im gemar mita verava amar leachar gemar mita
Hadar beh abbaye mehahi mimmay demehahi hadar beh dilma meha hadar beh
La salka datach ditnan ze gitech im matti ze gitech mecholi ze ze gitech leachar mita lo amar kelum
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel vaafilu hau bahen avadim vehotzian lecherut
Peshita mahu detema amar leh lemebad isura la yahavinan lach ka mashma lan
Amar rav yosef amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel vaafilu asaan tachrichin lemet peshita mahu detema leshauoyinhu isure hanaa la yehavi lach ka mashma lan
Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda etrog ze natun lecha bemattana veacharecha lifloni netalo rishon veyatza bo banu lemachloket rabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel

Matkef lah rav nachman bar yitzchak ad kan la peligi rabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel hatam ella demar savar kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame umar savar kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame ella hacha
b: I mipak la nafek beh lemay yahaveh nihaleh
Ella mipak dechulle alma la peligi denafek beh mecharah o achalah banu lemachloket rabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel
Amar rabba bar rav huna haachin shekkanu etrog bitfusat habbayit netalo echad mehen veyatza bo im yachol leochlo yatza veim lav lo yatza
Vedaveka deika etrog lechol chad vechad aval parish o rimmon lo
Amar rava etrog ze natun lecha bemattana al menat shettachzirehu li netalo veyatza bo hechziro yatza lo hechziro lo yatza ka mashma lan demattana al menat lehachazir shemah mattana
Hahi itta dahava lah dikla beara derav bivi bar abbaye kol emat dahavat azla lemigzereh hava kafed ilavah akniteh nihaleh kol shene chayyav azal ihu akneyeh nihaleh livno katan
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua mishshum deatu mimmulae amritu mile mulyata afilu rabban shimon ben gamliel la kaamar ella leacher aval leatzmo lo
Amar rava amar rav nachman shor ze natun lecha bemattana al menat shettachzirehu li hikdisho vehechziro hare ze mukdash umuchzar

Amar leh rava lerav nachman may ahdereh amar leh umay chassereh ella amar rav ashe chazenan i amar leh al menat shettachzirehu ha ahdereh i amar leh al menat shettachzirehu li mide dachaze leh kaamar leh
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hakkotev nechasav leacher veamar halla i efshi bahen kana vaafilu omed vetzoveach verabbi yochanan amar lo kana
Amar rabbi abba bar memel vela peligi

a: Kan betzoveach meikara kan beshotek meikara ulvassof tzoveach
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak zika lo al yede acher veshatak ulvassof tzavach banu lemachloket rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan

Detanya hakkotev nechasav leacher vehau bahen avadim veamar halla i efshi bahen im haya rabban sheni kohen hare ellu ochlin bitruma rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kevan sheamar halla i efshi bahen kevar zachu bahen yorshin
Vehavenan bah vetanna kamma afilu omed vetzoveach
Amar rava veitema rabbi yochanan betzoveach meikaro dechulle alma la peligi dela kane shatak ulvassof tzavach dechulle alma la peligi dekane
Ki peligi shezzika lo al yede acher veshatak ulvassof tzavach detanna kamma savar middishtek keninhu vehay deka tzavach mihdar hu deka hadar beh
Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar hochiach sofo al techillato vehay dela tzavach ad hashta desavar ki la matu lidi may etzvach
Tanu rabbanan shechiv mera sheamar tenu matayim zuz lifloni ushlosh meot lifloni vearba meot lifloni en omrin kol hakkodem bishtar zoche lefichach yatza alav shetar chov gove mikkullam

Aval amar tenu matayim zuz lifloni veacharav lifloni veacharav lifloni omrin kol hakkodem bashshetar zoche lefichach yatza alav shetar chov gove min haacharon en lo gove mishshellefanav en lo gove mishshellifne fanav
Tanu rabbanan shechiv mera sheamar tenu matayim zuz lifloni beni bechor karauy lo notlan venotel et bechorato im amar bivchorato yado al haelona ratza notlan ratza notel bechorato
Ushchiv mera sheamar tenu matayim zuz liflonit ishti karauy lah notaltan venotelet et ketubbatah im amar bichtubbatah
b: Yadah al haelona ratza notaltan ratza notelet ketubbatah
Ushchiv mera sheamar tenu matayim zuz lifloni baal chovi karauy lo notlan venotel et chovo veim amar bechovo notlan bechovo
Mishshum deamar karauy lo notlan venotel et chovo vedilma karauy lo bechovo kaamar
Amar rav nachman amar li huna ha manni rabbi akiva hi dedayek lishana yattira
Ditnan velo et habbor velo et haddut af al pi shekkatav lo umka veruma vetzarich likach lo derech divre rabbi akiva
Vachachamim omrim eno tzarich likach lo derech umode rabbi akiva bizman sheamar lo chutz meellu sheeno tzarich likach lo derech
Alma kevan dela tzerich vekaamar letappoye milleta kaate hacha name kevan dela tzerich vekaamar letappoye milleta ka ate

Tanu rabbanan shechiv mera sheamar mane yesh li etzel peloni haedim kotvin af al pi sheen makkirin lefichach keshehu gove tzarich lehavi reaya divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim en kotvin ella im ken makkirin lefichach keshehu gove en tzarich lehavi reaya
Amar rav nachman amar li huna tana rabbi meir omer en kotvin vachachamim omrim kotvin veaf rabbi meir la amar ella mishshum bet din toin amar rav dimi minnehardea hilcheta en choshshin levet din toin
Umay shena midderava deamar rava en choltzin ella im ken makkirin veen memaanin ella im ken makkirin lefichach kotvin get chalitza veget meun veaf al pi sheen makkirin
May tama lav mishshum dechoshshin levet din toin
La bet dina batar bet dina la dayeki bet dina batar edim dayeki
Matni haav tolesh umaachil lechol mi sheyyirtze uma shehinniach talush hare hu shel yorshin
Gema talush in mechubbar lo

a: Veha tanya shamin et hamchubbarin lallokeach
Amar ulla la kashya kan bivno kan beacher hoil vedato shel adam kerova etzel beno
Matni hinniach banim gedolim uktannim en haggedolim mitparnesin al yede hakketannim velo hakketannim nizzonin al haggedolim ella cholkin beshave
Nasu haggedolim yisou hakketannim veim amru ketannim hare anu nosin kederech shennesatem attem en shomin lahem ella ma shennatan lahem avihem natan
Hinniach banot gedolot uktannot en haggedolot mitparnesot al yede hakketannot velo hakketannot nizzonot al haggedolot ella cholkot beshave
Nasu gedolot yisseu ketannot veim amru ketannot hare anu nosot kederech shennesatem attem en shomin lahen
Ze chomer babbanot mibbabbanim shehabbanot nizzonot al habbanim veen nizzonot al habbanot
Gema amar rava hay gedol ache dilvash veikassi mibbeta may daavad avad
Veha anan tenan en haggedolim mitparnesin al hakketannim matnitin bishracha
Sheracha peshita mahu detema nicha lehu dela ninaval ka mashma lan
Nasu gedolim yisseu ketannim may kaamar

Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar nasu gedolim leachar mitat avihen yisseu ketannim leachar mitat avihen aval nasu gedolim bechayye avihen veamru ketannim leachar mitat avihen hare anu nosin kederech shennesatem attem en shomin lahen ella ma shennatan lahen avihen natan
Hinniach banot gedolot uktannot shelach leh avuh bar geniva lerava yelammedenu rabbenu laveta veachla veamda venisset baal lokeach have o yoresh have
Lokeach have umilve al pe eno gove min hallakochot o dilma yoresh have umilve al pe gove min hayyorshin
Amar leh tenena nasu gedolot yisseu ketannot may lav nasu gedolot levaal yisseu ketannot mibbaal
Lo nasu gedolot levaal yisseu ketannot levaal
Ini veha tane rabbi chiyya nasu gedolot levaal yisseu ketannot mibbaal
Dilma shane parnasa deit lah kala

Amar leh rav pappa lerava lav hayenu dishlach ravin beiggarteh mi shemmet vehinniach almana uvat almenato nizzonet minnechasav nisset habbat almenato nizzonet minnechasav meta habbat amar rav yehuda ben achoto shel rabbi yose ben chanina al yadi haya maase veamru almenato nizzonet minnechasav
I amratte bishlama yoresh have mishshum hachi almenato nizzonet minnechasav ella i amratte lokeach have ammay nizzonet minnechasav
Amar abbaye i lav dishlach ravin anan la yadinan veha tenan ellu hen sheen chozrin bayyovel habbechora
b: Vehayyoresh et ishto
Amar leh rava vehashta dishlach mi yadinan haamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina beusha hitkinu haishsha shemmachra nichse melog bechayye balah umeta habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot

Ella amar rav ashe baal shavveuhu rabbanan keoresh veshavveuhu rabbanan kelokeach vehecha detava leh avadu leh gabbe yovel shavveuhu rabbanan keoresh mishshum peseda dideh gabbe derabbi yose berabbi chanina shavveuhu rabbanan kelokeach mishshum peseda dideh gabbe deravin mishshum peseda dealmana shavveuhu rabbanan keoresh
Veha gabbe derabbi yose berabbi chanina deika peseda lelakochot veshavveuhu rabbanan kelokeach
Hatam inhu afsidu annafshayehu kevan deika baal la ibi lehu lemizban meitta deyatva tute gavra
Hadaran alach yesh nochalin

Mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot bizman shehannechasim merubbin habbanim yirshu vehabbanot yizzonu nechasim muatin habbanot yizzonu vehabbanim yishalu al happetachim admon omer bishvil sheani zachar hifsadti amar rabban gamliel roe ani et divre admon

Gema vechamma merubbin amar rav yehuda amar rav kede sheyyizzonu mehen ellu vaellu shenem asar chodesh ki amrita kammeh dishmuel amar zo divre rabban gamliel bar rabbi aval chachamim omrim kede sheyyizzonu mehen ellu vaellu ad sheyyivgeru
Itmar name ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan veamri lah amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol sheyyizzonu mehen ellu vaellu ad sheyyivgeru hen merubbin pachot mikkan hare ellu muatin
Vei leka leellu vaellu ad sheyyivgeru

a: Shakli lehu banot lechullehu ella amar rava motziin lahen mezonot labbanot ad sheyyivgeru vehashshear labbanim
Peshita merubbin venitmaatu kevar zachu bahen yorshin muatin venitrabbu may birshut yorshin kayemi hilkach birshut yorshin shevuch o dilma salloke mesalleki yorshin mehacha
Ta shema deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan yetomin shekkadmu umachru binchasim muatin ma shemmachru machru
Yatev rabbi yirmeya kammeh derabbi avahu veka bae mineh almenato mahu shettemaet bannechasim mi amrinan kevan deit lah mezone memaata o dilma kevan deilu minnasva let lah hashta name let lah

Im timtza lomar kevan deilu minnasva let lah hashta name let lah bat ishto mahu shettemaet bannechasim mi amrinan kevan dechi minnasva name it lah ummaata o dilma kevan deilu meta let lah vela memaata
Veim timtza lomar kevan deilu meta let lah vela memaata baal chov mahu sheyemaet bannechasim mi amrinan kevan dechi mayet name it leh memaet o dilma kevan dimchasseri guvyana la memaet
Veika devae lah leidach gisa baal chov mahu sheyemaet bannechasim
b: Bat ishto mahu shettemaet bannechasim almenato mahu shettemaet bannechasim almenato uvat e ze mehen kodemet

Amar leh zil haidana veta limchar ki ata amar leh peshot mihat chada deamar rabbi abba amar rabbi assi asu almana etzel habbat kabbat etzel haachin binchasim muatin ma bat etzel achin habbat nizonet vehaachin yishalu al happetachim af almana etzel habbat almana nizonet vehabbat tishal al happetachim

Admon omer bishvil sheani zachar hifsadti vechu may kaamar amar abbaye hachi kaamar bishvil sheani zachar verauy ani laasok battora hifsadti amar leh rava ella meatta man deasek battora hu deyaret dela asek battora la yeret ella amar rava hachi kaamar bishvil sheani zachar verauy ani lirash binchasim merubbin hifsadti binchasim muatin
Matni hinniach banim uvanot vetumtum bizman shehannechasim merubbin hazzecharim dochin oto etzel nekevot nechasim muatin hannekevot dochot oto etzel zecharim
Haomer im teled ishti zachar yittol mane yalda zachar yittol mane nekeva matayim yalda nekeva notelet matayim

Im zachar mane im nekeva matayim veyalda zachar unkeva zachar notel mane nekeva notelet matayim yalda tumtum eno notel im amar kol ma shetteled ishti yittol hare ze yittol veim en sham yoresh ella hu yoresh et hakkol
Gema dochin oto veshakel kevat ha katane sefa yalda tumtum eno notel amar abbaye dochin oto veen lo
Verava amar dochin oto veyesh lo vesefa atan lerabban shimon ben gamliel detanya yalda tumtum veanderoginos rabban shimon ben gamliel omer en kedushsha chala alehen
Metivi tumtum yoresh keven venizon kevat bishlama lerava yoresh keven binchasim muatin venizon kevat binchasim merubbin

a: Ella leabbaye may nizon kevat ultamach lerava may yoresh keven ella rauy lirash veen lo hacha name rauy lizzon veen lo

Haomer im yalda ishti zachar vechu lememra devat adifa leh mibben veha amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay kol sheeno manniach ben leorsho hakkadosh baruch hu male alav evra shenneemar vehaavartem et nachalato levitto veen haavara ella evra shenneemar yom evra hayyom hahu
Leinyan yerushsha ben adif leh leinyan harvacha bitto adifa leh

Ushmuel amar hacha bimvakkeret askinan vechidrav chisda deamar rav chisda bat techilla siman yafe levanim ika deamri dimrabbeya laachaha veika deamri dela shalta beh ena bisha amar rav chisda uldidi benatan adifan li mibbene
Veibaet ema ha manni rabbi yehuda hi

He rabbi yehuda ilema rabbi yehuda devakkol detanya va berach et avraham bakkol rabbi meir omer shello haya lo bat rabbi yehuda omer shehayeta lo bat uvakkol shemah emor deshamatte leh lerabbi yehuda beratta name la chassereh rachamana leavraham daadifa mibben mi shamatte leh
Ella ha rabbi yehuda detanya mitzva lazun et habbanot vekal vachomer labbanim deaski battora divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer mitzva lazun et habbanim vekal vachomer libbanot dela litazlan
Ella ha detanya yalda zachar unkeva hazzachar notel shishsha dinarin vehannekeva notelet shene dinarin bemay

Amar rav ashe amritah lishmata kammeh derav kahana bimsares deamar zachar techilla matayim nekeva acharav vela kelum nekeva techilla mane zachar achareha mane veyalda zachar unkeva vela yadinan he minayehu nefak beresha zachar shakel mane mimma nafshach idach mane have mamon hammuttal besafek vecholkin
Veha detanya yalda zachar unkeva en lo ella mane hechi mashkachatte lah amar ravina bimvassereni
b: Detanya hamvassereni bamme niftar rachmah shel ishti im zachar yittol mane yalda zachar notel mane im nekeva mane yalda nekeva notel mane yalda zachar unkeva en lo ella mane
Veha zachar unkeva la amar deamar name im zachar unkeva name yittol mane ella lemaote may lemaote nefel
Hahu daamar lah lidvethu nichsay lehay dimabberatte amar rav huna have mezakke leubbar vehamzakke leubbar lo kana
Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna haomer im yalda ishti zachar yittol mane yalda zachar notel mane amar leh mishnatenu eni yodea mi shenaah
Velema leh rabbi meir hi deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam
Emor deshamatte leh lerabbi meir ledavar sheyyeshno baolam ledavar sheeno baolam mi shamatte leh
Velema leh rabbi yose hi deamar ubbar kane ditnan ubbar posel veeno maachil divre rabbi yose
Shane yerushsha habbaa meeleha
Velema leh rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi daamar la shena yerushsha vela shena mattana ditnan rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer im amar al mi sherauy leorsho devarav kayyamin
Emor deshamatte leh lerabbi yochanan ben beroka ledavar sheyyeshno baolam ledavar sheeno baolam mi amar
Velema leh rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi vesavar lah kerabbi yose mi yemar desavar lah
Velema leh bimvassereni i hachi dekatane sefa veim en sham yoresh ella hu yoresh hakkol i bimvassereni yoresh may avidteh
Velema leh besheyyalda i hachi dekatane sefa veim amar kol ma shetteled ishti yittol hare ze yittol kol shetteled kal sheyyalda mibe leh

a: Velema leh deamar lichshetteled rav huna letameh deamar rav huna af lichshetteled lo kana
Deamar rav nachman hamzakke leubbar lo kana lichshetteled kana verav huna amar af lichshetteled lo kana verav sheshet amar echad ze veechad ze kana

Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah detanya ger shemmet uvizbezu yisrael nechasav veshamu sheyyesh lo ben o shehayeta ishto meubberet chayyavin lehachazir hechziru hakkol veachar kach shamu shemmet beno o shehippila ishto hechzik bashsheniyya kana uvarishona lo kana
Vei salka datach ubbar la kane lema lehu achzoke bashsheniyya ha achziku lehu chada zimna
Amar abbaye yerushsha habbaa meeleha shane rava amar shane hatam derappoye merappeyan bidayehu meikara
May benayehu ika benayehu sheshshamu bo shemmet velo met veachar kach met
Ta shema tinok ben yom echad nochel umanchil ben yom echad in ubbar la ha amar rav sheshet nochel benichse haem lehanchil laachin min haav vedaveka ben yom echad aval ubbar la may tama
b: Dehu mayet beresha veen habben yoresh et immo bakkever lehanchil laachin min haav
Lememra dehu mayet beresha veha hava ovada ufarkes telata pirkuse amar mar bar rav ashe mide dehave azzenav halletaa shemmefarkeset
Mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava amar lomar shemmemaet bechelek bechora vedaveka ben yom echad aval ubbar la may tama veyaldu lo amar rachamana
Deamar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava ben shennolad leachar mitat aviv eno memaet bechelek bechora may tama veyaldu lo amar rachamana veha leka

Besura matnu hachi befumbedita matnu hachi amar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava bechor shennolad leachar mitat aviv eno notel pi shenayim may tama yakkir amar rachamana veha leta deyakkir vehilcheta kechol hane lishane deamar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava
Amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan hamzakke leubbar lo kana veim tomar mishnatenu hoil vedato shel adam kerova etzel beno
Amar leh shemuel lerav chana bagdataa pok ayeti li be asra veemar lach beappayehu hamzakke leubbar kana vehilcheta hamzakke leubbar lo kana
Hahu daamar lidvethu nichsay livne deyihu li minich ata bereh kashshisha amar leh hahu gavra may tehve aleh amar leh zil keni kechad mibbera hanach vadday la kanu deakkatti letanhu

Ammay atte vachamor hu

Achaot hu deen mekuddashot ha nachriyyot mekuddashot veammay atte vachamor hi
Amar leh hayenu dachazay rav huna bar aveya bechelma demotev rav aveya teuvta lav mi okemna deamar haruya mikkem levia titkaddesh li
Hahu daamar lah lidvethu nichsay lich velivnich amar rav yosef kanta mechetza veamar rav yosef mena amena lah detanya rabbi omer vehayeta leaharon ulvanav mechetza leaharon mechetza levanav
Amar leh abbaye bishlama hatam aharon bar chalukka hu lehachi perat beh rachamana lemishkal palga ishsha lav bat yerushsha hi dayya shettittol keechad min habbanim

Ini veha ovada hava binhardea veagbeyah shemuel palga bitverya veagbeyah rabbi yochanan palga vetu ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef amar hahu deme chelila dishdo deve malka aabbule veaisteruge amar rabbi nitvu abbule palga veisteruge palga
Hachi hashta hatam meikara ki hao katvi aabbule hao katvi veisteruge hao mesayei bahadayehu veyada malka dahao ka mesayei hashta may deka katvi aabbule veaisteruge lememra dehane palga vehane palga
Metiv rabbi zera haomer hare alay mincha mea issaron lehavi bishne chelim mevi shishshim bichli echad vearbaim bichli echad

Hachi hashta hatam anan sahadi dehay gavra meikara lekorban gadol ka mechaven vehay dekaamar bishne chelim deyada dela efshar leetoye bichli echad kamma deefshar leetoye mayetinan
Vehilcheta keoteh derav yosef besade inyan umechetza

Hahu deshaddar piske deshirae leveteh amar rabbi amme haruyin levanim labbanim reuyin levanot labbanot vela amaran ella delet leh kallata aval it leh kallata lechallateh shaddar vei benateh la nesivan la shavak benateh umshaddar lechallateh
Hahu daamar lehu nichsay livnay hava leh bera uvratta mi karu inashe livra benay ulsalloke livratta meisur kaate o dilma la karu inashe livra benay ulmoshchah levarta bemattana kaate
Amar abbaye ta shema uvne dan chushim amar leh rava dilma kidtana deve chizkiyya shehau merubbin kechushim shel kane ella amar rava uvne fallu eliav rav yosef amar uvne etan azarya

Matni hinniach banim gedolim uktannim hishbichu gedolim et hannechasim hishbichu laemtza im amru reu ma shehinniach abba hare anu osin veochlim hishbichu leatzman vechen haishsha shehishbicha et hannechasim hishbicha laemtza im amra reu ma shehinniach li bali hare ani osa veochelet hishbicha leatzmah
Gema amar rav chaviva bereh derav yosef bereh derava mishshemeh derava lo shanu ella sheshshavchu nechasim mechamat nechasim aval shavchu nechasim mechamat atzman hishbichu leatzman
Ini veha amar rabbi chanina afilu lo hinniach lahem avihem ella

a: Udyane hassachar laemtza veha udyane demechamat atzmo hu shane udyane delintiruta hu daavida vaafilu ketannim name matzu menatteri lah

Amru reu ma shehinniach abba hare anu osin veochlin hishbichu leatzman rav safra shevak avuh zuze shaklinhu avad behu iska ato ache tavuhu bedina kammeh derava amar lehu rav safra gavra rabba hu la shavek girseh vetarach leacharine
Haishsha shehishbicha et hannechasim hishbicha laemtza ishsha benichse yatme may avidtah amar rabbi yirmeya beishsha yoreshet
Peshita mahu detema kevan delav darkah lemitrach af al gav dela paresh kemo defaresh dame kamashma lan
Veim amra reu ma shehinniach li bali hareni osa veochelet hishbicha leatzmah peshita mahu detema kevan dishvicha lah milta deamri ka tarcha kamme yatme achole achala ka mashma lan
Amar rabbi chanina hammassi ishsha livno gadol babbayit kenao vedaveka gadol vedaveka betula vedaveka ishto rishona vedaveka shehissio rishon
Peshita yiched lo aviv bayit vaaliyya bayit kana aliyya lo kana bayit veachsadra mahu shene vattim ze lifnim mizze mahu teku

Metivi yiched lo aviv bayit uchle vayit kele vayit kana bayit lo kana amar rabbi yirmeya kegon shehaya otzaro shel aviv munnach sham nehardae amri afilu shovacha deone rav yehuda verav pappe amri afilu atzitza deharsana mar zutra anseveh livreh utla leh sandala rav ashe anseveh livreh utla leh ashisha demishcha

Amar mar zutra hane telat mile shavinhu rabbanan kehilcheta bela tama chada ha idach deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel hakkotev kol nechasav leishto lo asaah ella appotroppa idach deamar rav mane li beyadcha tenehu lifloni bemaamad shelashtan kana
b: Matni achin hashshuttafin shennafal echad mehen leummanut nafal laemtza chala venitrappe nitrappe mishshel atzmo
Gema tana hay ummanut leummanut hammelech tanu rabbanan echad min haachin shemminuhu gabbay o pulmostus im mechamat haachin laachin im mechamat atzmo leatzmo
Im mechamat achin laachin peshita la tzericha decharif tefe mahu detema churpeh garem leh ka mashma lan
Tanu rabbanan echad min haachin shennatal matayim zuz lilmod tora o lilmod ummanut yecholin haachin lomar lo im atta etzlenu yesh lecha mezonot im en atta etzlenu en lecha mezonot
Velitvu leh kol hecha deiteh mesayya leh lerav huna deamar rav huna birkat habbayit berubba velitvu leh lefi birkat habbayit hachi name

Chala venitrappe nitrappe mishshel atzmo shelach ravin mishshemeh derabbi ila lo shanu ella shechala bifshia aval beones nitrappe min haemtza hechi dame bifshia kidrabbi chanina deamar rabbi chanina hakkol bide shamayim chutz mitztzinnim pachim shenneemar tzinnim pachim bederech ikkesh shomer nafsho yirchak mehem

Veha achin sheasu miktzatan shoshvinut katane teni lemiktzatan veha chazra shoshvinut katane hachi kaamar chazra ligbot nigbet meemtza
Rabbi assi amar la kashya kan bistam kan bimfaresh kidtanya shalach lo aviv shoshvinut keshehi chozeret chozeret lo shalach aviv shoshvinut setam keshehi chozeret chozeret laemtza
Ushmuel amar hacha beyavam askinan sheeno notel barauy kivmuchzak
Mikkelal deidach meshallem lema tenu li shoshvini veesmach immo

Mi la tanya makom shennahagu lehachzir kiddushin machzirin makom shennahagu shello lehachzir en machzirin veamar rav yosef bar abba amar mar ukva amar shemuel lo shanu ella shemmeta hi aval met hu en machzirin may tama yechola hi shettomar

a: Tenu li bali veesmach immo hacha name nema tenu li shoshvini veesmach immo
Amar rav yosef hacha bemay askinan kegon shessamach immo shiva yeme mishte velo hispik leforo ad shemmet

Lema tenu li bali veesmach immo tannae hi detanya hamares et haishsha betula gova matayim vealmana mane makom shennahagu lehachzir kiddushin machzirin makom shennahagu shello lehachzir kiddushin en machzirin divre rabbi natan rabbi yehuda hannasi omer beemet amru makom shennahagu lehachzir machzirin makom shennahagu shello lehachzir en machzirin
Rabbi yehuda hannasi hayenu tanna kamma ella lav tenu li bali veesmach immo ika benayehu

Vechassore mechassera vehachi katane hamares et haishsha betula gova matayim vealmana mane bamme devarim amurim dahadar beh ihu aval meta makom shennahagu lehachzir machzirin makom shennahagu shello lehachzir en machzirin vedaveka shemmeta hi aval met hu en machzirin may tama yechola hi shettomar tenu li bali veesmach immo
Vaata rabbi yehuda hannasi lememar beemet amru ben met hu uven meta hi makom shennahagu lehachzir machzirin makom shennahagu shello lehachzir en machzirin vela matzya amra tenu li bali veesmach immo

La dechulle alma yechola shettomar tenu li bali veesmach immo udmit hu kulle alma la peligi ki peligi shemmeta hi vehacha bekiddushin letibuin nitnu ka mipalgi rabbi natan savar kiddushin lav letibuin nitnu verabbi yehuda hannasi savar kiddushin letibuin nitnu
Veha makom shennahagu lehachzir machzirin katane hachi kaamar vesivlonot vadday makom shennahagu lehachzir machazirin

Vehane tannae kehane tannae detanya kiddeshah bechikkar betula gova matayim vealmana mane divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer betula gova matayim vealmana mane umachzeret lo et hashshear rabbi yose omer kiddeshah beesrim noten lah sheloshim chatzain kiddeshah bishloshim noten lah esrim chatzain

Bemay askinan ilema shemmeta mi it lah ketubba veella shemmet hu ammay machzeret lo et hashshear venema tenu li bali veesmach immo veella beeshet yisrael shezzinta uvmay i beratzon mi it lah ketubba veella beones mishre sharya leh
Veella beeshet kohen shenneensa uvkiddushin letibuin nitnu kamipalgi rabbi meir savar kiddushin letibuin nitnu verabbi yehuda savar lav letibuin nitnu verabbi yose mesappeka leh i letibuin nitnu i la
Vehilkach kiddeshah beesrim noten lah sheloshim chatzain kiddeshah bishloshim noten lah esrim chatzain

Amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman bechol makom shennahagu lehachzir machzirin vetarguma nehardea shear bavel may rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu muhre hadri kiddushe la hadri amar rav pappa hilcheta ben shemmet hu ben shemmeta hi vahadar beh hu muhre hadri kiddushe la hadri hadara bah ihi afilu kiddushe name hadri
Ammemar amar kiddushe la hadri gezera shemma yomru kiddushin tofsin baachotah rav ashe amar gitah mochiach aleha veha derav ashe beduta hi deika deshama beha vela shama beha
Shehashshoshvinut nigbet bevet din tanu rabbanan chamishsha devarim neemru beshoshvinut nigbet bevet din vechozeret beonatah veen bah mishshum ribbit
