Nigbet bevet din may tama kemilve damya veen bah mishshum ribbit delav addata dehachi yehav leh veen hashsheviit meshammattah dela karena beh lo yiggos
Veen habbechor notel pi shenayim dehave leh rauy veen habbechor notel barauy kivmuchzak
Amar rav kahana kelala deshoshvinuta hava bemata ibi leh lemete shema kal tavla ibi leh lemete la shema kal tavla ibi leh leodoeh taromet it leh shallome meshallem
Vead kamma amar abbaye nahagu bene genana ad zuza ayete bechappeh achleh bichreseh ad arbea meshallem palga mikkan veelach inish inish kachashivuteh

Tanu rabbanan asa immo befumbe uvikkesh laasot immo betzina yachol lomar lo befumbe eese immecha kederech sheasita immi asa immo bivtula uvikkesh laasot immo bealmana yachol lomar lo bivtula eese immecha kederech sheasita immi

Asa immo bashsheniyya uvikkesh laasot immo barishona yachol lomar lo lichshettissa ishsha acheret eese immecha asa immo beachat uvikkesh laasot immo bishtayim yachol lomar lo beachat eese immecha kederech sheasita immi
Tanu rabbanan attir nichsin attir pumbe ze hu baal haggadot attir selaim attir tekoa zehu baal pilpul attir meshach attir kemas zehu baal shemuot hakkol tzerichin lemare chittayya talmud
Amar rabbi zera amar rav may dichtiv kol yeme ani raim ze baal talmud vetov lev mishte tamid ze baal mishna

Rava amar ipcha vehayenu deamar rav mesharsheya mishshemeh derava may dichtiv massia avanim yeatzev bahem bokea etzim yissachen bam massia avanim yeatzev bahen ellu bale mishna bokea etzim yissachen bam ellu bale talmud
Rabbi chanina amar kol yeme ani raim ze sheyyesh lo ishsha raa vetov lev mishte tamid ze sheyyesh lo ishsha tova rabbi yannay amar kol yeme ani raim ze istenis vetov lev mishte tamid ze sheddato yafa
Rabbi yochanan amar kol yeme ani raim ze rachman vetov lev mishte tamid ze achzari verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar kol yeme ani raim ze sheddato ketzara vetov lev mishte tamid ze sheddato rechava

a: Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol yeme ani raim veha ika shabbatot veyamim tovim kedishmuel deamar shemuel shinnuy veset techillat choli
Ketiv besefer ben sira kol yeme ani raim ben sira omer af lelot bishfal gaggim gaggo mimmetar gaggim legaggo berum harim karmo meafar karmo lichramim

Matni hashsholeach sivlonot levet chamiv shalach sham mea mane veachal sham seudat chatan afilu bedinar enan nigbin lo achal sham seudat chatan hare ellu nigbin shalach sivlonot merubbin sheyyachzeru immah levet balah hare ellu nigbin sivlonot muatin shettishtammesh bahen bevet aviha en nigbin
Gema amar rava daveka dinar aval pachot middinar la peshita dinar tenan mahu detema hu haddin daafilu pachot middinar vehay dekatane dinar orcha demilta katane ka mashma lan
Achal tenan shata may hu tenan shelucho may sham tenan shigger lo may

Ta shema deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel maase beadam echad sheshshigger levet chamiv mea keronot shel kadde yayin veshel kadde shemen veshel kele chesef veshel kele zahav veshel keli melat verachav besimchato vehalach veamad al petach bet chamiv vehotziu kos shel chammin veshata umet
Vezo halacha heela rabbi acha sar habbira lifne chachamim leusha veamru sivlonot haasuyin livlot en nigbin vesheen asuyin livlot nigbin shema minah afilu shata

Shamatte minah afilu pachot middinar amar rav ashe man lema lan dela shachaki leh marganita deshaveya alpa zuze veashkeyuh shamatte minah afilu shiggeru lo dilma kol petach bet chamiv kevet chamiv dame
Ibaya lehu mahu sheyeshallesh shevach sivlonot mahu kevan dei itanhu ledideh hadri birshuteh shevuch o dilma kevan dei avdi o migganvi bae shallome leh birshuta didah shevuch teku

Bae rava sivlonot haasuyin livlot velo balu mahu ta shema vezo halacha heela rabbi acha sar habbira lifne chachamim beusha veamru sivlonot haasuyin livlot en nigbin vesheen asuyin livlot nigbin may lav af al gav delo balu la devalu
Ta shema sivlonot muatin shettishtammesh bahen vehi bevet aviha en nigbin targemah rava beyeva usvachta

Amar rav yehuda amar rav maase beadam echad sheshshigger levet chamiv yayin chadash veshemen chadash uchle pishtan chadash baatzeret may ka mashma lan ibaet ema chashivuta deeretz yisrael ka mashma lan veibaet ema dei taen taanteh taana
Amar rav yehuda amar rav maase beadam echad sheamru lo ishto totranit hi venichnas achareha lechurba levodkah amar lah reach tzenon ani meriach baggalil
b: Amara leh min yahev lan mikkotavot diricho veachalna beh nefal alah churba umeta amru chachamim hoil velo nichnas achareha ella levodkah meta eno yorshah

Sivlonot muatin shettishtammesh bahen bevet aviha vechu yatev ravin sava kammeh derav pappa veyatev vekaamar ben shemmeta hi uven shemmet hu hadar hu sivlonot hadri maachal umishte la hadar hadra bah ihi hadra afilu kisha deyarka amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua veshamin lahen deme vasar bezol ad kamma bezol ad tilta
Matni shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim veshiyyer karka kol shehu mattenato kayyemet lo shiyyer karka kal shehu en mattenato kayyemet

Gema man tena deazlinan batar umdana amar rav nachman rabbi shimon ben menasya hi detanya hare shehalach beno limdinat hayyam veshama shemmet beno veamad vechatav kol nechasav leacher veachar kach ba beno mattenato mattana rabbi shimon ben menasya omer en mattenato mattana sheilmale haya yodea shebbeno kayyam lo haya kotvan

Rav sheshet amar rabbi shimon shezuri hi detanya barishona hau omrim hayyotze bekolar veamar kitvu get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu chazru lomar af hamfaresh vehayyotze bishyara rabbi shimon shezuri omer af hamsukkan
Verav nachman may tama la mokem lah kerabbi shimon shezuri shane hatam deamar kitvu verav sheshet may tama la mokem lah kerabbi shimon ben menasya umdana demochach shane
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan hare shehaya chole umutal bammitta veamru lo nechasecha lemi veamar lahen

a: Dome sheyyesh li ben achshav sheen li ben nechasay lifloni haya chole umutal bammitta veamru lo nechasav lemi amar lahen dome sheishti meubberet achshav sheen ishti meubberet nechasay lifloni venoda sheyyesh lo ben o shehayeta ishto meubberet en mattenato mattana
Lema rabbi shimon ben menasya hi vela rabbanan afilu tema rabbanan dome shane
Udkaare lah may kaare lah mahu detema tzareh hu deka madkar ka mashma lan
Amar rabbi zera amar rav minnayin lemattenat shechiv mera shehi min hattora shenneemar vehaavartem et nachalato levitto yesh lecha haavara acheret shehi kazo vee zo zo mattenat shechiv mera
Rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh mehacha untattem et nachalato leechav yesh lecha netina acheret shehi kazo vee zo zo mattenat shechiv mera

Verav nachman may tama la amar mivehaavartem hahu mibe leh lechidrabbi detanya rabbi omer bechullan neemra bahen netina vechan neemra haavara en lecha shemmaavir nachala mishshevet leshevet ella bat hoil uvnah uvalah yorshin otah
Verabbi zera may tama la amar miuntattem orcheh dikra hu

Rav menashsheya bar yirmeya amar mehacha bayyamim hahem chala chizkiyyahu lamut vayyavo elav yeshayahu ven amotz hannavi vayyomer elav ko amar Adonai tzav levetecha ki met atta velo tichye betzavaa bealma
Rame bar yechezkel amar mehacha vaachitofel raa ki lo neesta atzato vayyachavosh et hachamor vayyelech el beto el iro vayetzav el beto vayyechanak betzavaa bealma

Tanu rabbanan shelosha devarim tziva achitofel et banav al tihu bemachloket veal timredu bemalchut bet david veom tov shel atzeret barur ziru chittim mar zutra amar balul itmar amri nehardae mishshemeh derabbi yaakov lo barur barur mammash velo balul balul mammash ella afilu balul veruach tzefonit menashshavto ze hu barur

Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe anan adderav yitzchak bar avdimi matnenan lah deamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi motzae yom tov haacharon shel chag hakkol tzofin laashan hammaaracha nata kelappe tzafon aniyyim semechim uvale vattim atzevin mippene sheggishme shana merubbin uferot markivin
Nata kelappe darom aniyyim atzevim uvale vattim semechin mippene sheggishme shana muatin uferot mishtammerin nata kelappe mizrach hakkol semechin kelappe maarav hakkol atzevin

Urminhi mizrachit leolam yafa maaravit leolam kasha ruach tzefonit yafa lechittim beshaa sheheviu shelish vekasha lezetim beshaa sheyyanetzu veruach deromit kasha lechittin beshaa sheheviu shelish veyafa lezetim beshaa sheyyanetzu
Veamar rav yosef veitema mar zutra veitema rav nachman bar yitzchak vesimanach shulchan batztzafon umnora baddarom hay merabbe dideh vehay merabbe dideh
La kashya ha lan veha lehu

Tanya abba shaul omer yom tov shel atzeret barur siman yafe lechol hashshana kullah amar rav zevid hay yoma kamma deresh shatta i chammim kullah shatta chammima i karir kullah shatta karira lemay nafka minah
b: Litfillato shel kohen gadol
Verava amar rav nachman mattenat shechiv mera midderabbanan bealma hi shemma tittaref dato alav

Umi amar rav nachman hachi veha amar rav nachman af al gav deamar shemuel hammocher shetar chov lachavero vechazar umchalo machul vaafilu yoresh mochel mode shemuel sheim netano bemattenat shechiv mera deeno yachol lemochlo
I amratte bishlama deorayeta mishshum hachi eno yachol limchol ella i amratte derabbanan hi ammay eno yachol limchol enah shel tora vaasauha keshel tora
Amar rava amar rav nachman shechiv mera sheamar yadur peloni bevayit ze yochal peloni perot dekel ze lo amar kelum ad sheyyomar tenu bayit ze lifloni veyadur bo tenu dekel ze lifloni veyochal perotav
Lememra desavar rav nachman milta deita bevari ita bishchiv mera deleta bevari leta bishchiv mera veha amar rava amar rav nachman

a: Shechiv mera sheamar tenu halvaati lifloni halvaato lifloni veaf al gav deleteh bevari rav pappa amar hoil veoresh yorshah
Rav acha bereh derav ika amar halvaa ita bevari vechidrav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav mane li beyadcha tenehu lifloni bemaamad shelashtan kana
Ibaya lehu dekel leechad uferotav leacher mahu mi shayyar mekom pere o la shayyar im timtze lomar leacher la have shiyyur leatzmo chutz mipperotav mahu

Amar rava amar rav nachman im timtze lomar dekel leechad uferotav leacher la have shiyyur mekom pere dekel leechad veshiyyer perotav lefanav shayyar mekom pere may tama kol legabbe nafsheh beayin yafa meshayyer
Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe anan adderabbi shimon ben lakish matnenan lah deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish hammocher bayit lachavero veamar lo al menat sheddeota haelona shelli deota haelona shello
b: Ibaya lehu bayit leechad udota leechad mahu mi have shiyyur o la im timtza lomar bayit leechad udota leechad la have shiyyur chutz middeota mahu
Amar rava amar rav nachman im timtza lomar bayit leechad udota leechad la have shiyyur chutz middeota have shiyyur vealliba derav zevid deamar sheim ratza lehotzi bah zizin motzi
Alma kevan deshayyar deota mekom zizin name shayyar hacha name kevan deamar chutz mipperotav mekom pere shayyar
Amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim roin im bimchallek met kanu kullan amad chozer bechullan
Im benimlach met kanu kullan amad eno chozer ella baacharon vedilma ayyone ka meayyen vahadar yahev setameh dishchiv mera midak dayek vahadar yahev
Amar rav acha bar minome amar rav nachman shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim veamad eno chozer chayeshinan shemma yesh lo nechasim bimdina acheret
Veella matnitin dekatane lo shiyyer karka kal shehu en mattenato kayyemet hechi mashkachatte lah amar rav chama beomer kol nechasay mar bar rav ashe amar bemuchzak lan delet leh
Ibaya lehu chazara bemiktzat have chazara bechullah o la ta shema kullan larishon umiktzatan lashsheni sheni kana rishon lo kana may lav beshemmet
La besheamad

Hachi name mistabbera middekatane sefa miktzatan larishon vechullan lashsheni rishon kana sheni lo kana i amratte bishlama besheamad mishshum hachi sheni lo kana ella i amratte beshemmet tarvayehu likno

Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe veteheve name besheamad i amratte bishlama chazara bemiktzat haveya chazara bechullah hayenu desheni mihat kana ella i amratte chazara bemiktzat la haveya chazara bechullah nihve kimchallek ulchad minayehu la likno
Vehilcheta chazara bemiktzat haveya chazara bechullah resha mashkachatte lah ben shemmet ben sheamad sefa la mashkachatte lah ella kesheamed
Ibaya lehu hikdish kal nechasav veamad mahu mi amrinan kol legabbe hekdesh gamar umakne o dilma kol legabbe nafsheh la gamar umakne
Hifkir kol nechasav mahu mi amrinan kevan deaf laaniyyim kaashirim gamar umakne o dilma kol legabbe nafsheh la gamar umakne
Chilek kol nechasav laaniyyim may mi amrinan tzedaka vadday migmar gamar umakne o dilma kol legabbe nafsheh la gamar umakne teku
Lishana acharina hikdish kol nechasav mahu hifkir kol nechasav mahu chilek kol nechasav laaniyyim mahu teku
Amar rav sheshet yittol veyizke veyachazik veyikne kullan leshon mattana hen bematnita tana af yachsen veyerat berauy leorsho verabbi yochanan ben beroka hi
Ibaya lehu

a: Yehane bahen mahi denehve kullehu mattana kaamar o dilma lithane minayehu mide kaamar yerae bahen mahu yaamod bahen mahu yishshaen bahen mahu teku
Ibaya lehu machar kol nechasav mahu amar rav yehuda amar rav im amad eno chozer vezimnin amar rav yehuda amar rav im amad chozer vela peligi ha deitanhu lezuzi beenayehu ha defarinhu bechovo
Ibaya lehu shechiv mera shehoda mahu ta shema deisur giyyora hava leh teresar alfe zuze be rava rav mari bereh horato shello bikdushsha veledato bikdushsha havay uve rav hava

Amar rava hechi nikninhu rav mari lehane zuze i birusha lav bar yerushsha hu i bemattana mattenat shechiv mera kirushsha shavveuha rabbanan kol hecha deiteh birusha iteh bemattana kol hecha deleteh birusha leteh bemattana
I bimshicha letanhu gabbeh i bachalifin en matbea nikne bachalifin i aggav karka let leh ara i bemaamad shelashtan i shalach li la azelna
Matkef lah rav ika bereh derav amme ammay velode isur dehalen zuze derav mari ninhu velikninhu beodita addehachi nefak odita mibbe isur ikfad rava amar ka magmeri taanata leinashe umafsedi li
b: Shiyyer karka kol shehu mattenato kayyemet vechamma kol shehu amar rav yehuda amar rav karka kede farnasato verav yirmeya bar abba amar metaltelin kede farnasato
Amar rabbi zera kamma mechavvenan shematata desave karka tama may dei kae samech aleh mittalteli name i kae samech ilavayehu
Matkef lah rav yosef umay kauonta man deamar metaltelin karka tenan man deamar kede farnasato kol shehu tenan

Amar leh abbaye vechol hecha detane karka karka daveka veha tenan hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo yatza ben chorin shiyyer karka kal shehu lo yatza ben chorin rabbi shimon omer leolam hu ben chorin ad sheyyomar kol nechasay netunin lifloni avdi chutz meechad meribbo shebbahen

a: Veamar rav dimi bar yosef amar rabbi elazar asu metaltelin shiyyur etzel eved velo asu metaltelin shiyyur etzel ketubba

Hatam bedin hu dela litne karka veayedi ditna resha rabbi akiva omer karka kol shehu chayyevet bappea uvabbikkurim velichtov alehem perozbul veliknot immahem nechasim sheen lahem achraut bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka mishshum hachi katane karka

Vechol hecha detane kol shehu let leh shiura veha tenan rabbi dosa ben harkinas omer chamesh rechelot gozzot mane mane ufras chayyavot bereshit haggez vachachamim omrim chamesh rechelot gozzot kol shehen veamrinan vechamma kol shehen amar rav mane ufras uvilvad sheyehu mechummashot
Hatam bedin hu dela litne kol shehu veayede dekaamar tanna kamma shiura rabba amar ihu name shiura zutra kare lah kol shehu

Peshita amar mittaltelay liflanya kol mane tashmishteh kane levar mechitti usare kol mittaltelay liflanya afilu chitte usare vaafilu rechayim haelona kana levar merechayim hattachtona kol demittaltal afilu rechayim hattachtona kane

Ibaya lehu avda kimkarkea o kemittaltela dame amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe ta shema hammocher et hair machar battim shichin umarot umerchatzaot uvet habbaddin uvet hashshelachin aval lo et hammittaltelin uvizman sheamar hi vechol ma shebbetochah afilu hau bah behema o avadim hare kullan mechurin i amratte bishlama kemittaltela dame mishshum hachi la mizdabban beresha ella i amratte kimkarkea dame ammay la mizdabban
Veella may kemittaltela dame may afilu ella may it lach lememar shane mittaltela denayed mimmittaltela dela nayed afilu tema kimkarkea dame shane mekarkea denayed mimmekarkea dela nayed

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ta shema hakkotev leavdo kol nechasav yatza ben chorin shiyyer karka kal shehu lo yatza ben chorin rabbi shimon omer leolam hu ben chorin ad sheyyomar kol nechasay netunin lifloni avdi chutz meechad meribbo shebbahen

Veamar rav dimi bar yosef amar rabbi elazar asu mittaltelin shiyyur etzel eved velo asu mittaltelin shiyyur etzel ketubba vaamar leh rava lerav nachman may tama avda mittaltela hu umittaltela lemittaltela have shiyyur uchtubbat ishsha mekarkea hu umittaltela limkarkea la have shiyyur
b: Amar leh anan mishshum delav kerot gita matnenan lah
Amar rava amar rav nachman chamishsha ad sheyyichtevu kal nichsehem veellu hen shechiv mera avdo ishto uvanav mavrachat
Shechiv mera ditnan shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim veshiyyer karka kol shehu mattenato kayyemet lo shiyyer karka kal shehu en mattenato kayyemet
Avdo ditnan hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo yatza ben chorin shiyyer karka kal shehu lo yatza ben chorin
Ishto deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel hakkotev kol nechasav leishto lo asaah ella appotroppa
Banav ditnan hakkotev kol nechasav levanav vechatav leishto karka kol shehu ibbeda ketubbatah
Mavrachat deamar mar mavrachat tzericha shettichtov kol nechaseha
Uvchullehu mittaltele have shiyyur levar mikketuva deammekarkee takkinu rabbanan mimmittaltele la takkun rabbanan
Ammemar amar mittaltele dichtivi bichtubba veitanhu beenayehu have shiyyur

Amar nichsay liflanya avda ikri nichse ditnan hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo yatza ben chorin ara ikri nichse ditnan nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka gelima ikri nichse ditnan vesheen lahen achraut en niknin ella bimshicha

Zuze ikri nichse ditnan vesheen lahen achraut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka ki ha derav pappa hao leh teresar alfe zuze be chozae akninhu nihaleh lerav shemuel bar acha aggav assipa deveteh ki ata nefak leappeh ad teoch

Shetara ikri nichse deamar rabba bar yitzchak shene shetarot hen amar zechu besade ze lifloni vechitvu lo et hashshetar chozer bashshetar veeno chozer bassade al menat shettichtevu lo et hashshetar chozer ben bashshetar ben bassade
Verav chiyya bar avin amar rav huna shelosha shetarot hen tere hane daamaran idach im kadam mocher vechatav et hashshetar keotah sheshshaninu

a: Kotvin shetar lammocher veaf al pi sheen lokeach immo kevan shehechzik ze bakkarka nikna shetar kol makom shehu vezo hi sheshshaninu nechasim sheen lahen achraut niknin im hannechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka

Behema ikri nichse ditnan hammakdish nechasav vehayeta bahen behema reuya legabbe mizbeach zecharim olot unkevot yimmachru letzorche zivche shelamim ofot ikri nichse ditnan hammakdish nechasav vehau bahen devarim haruyin legabbe mizbeach yenot shemanim veofot

Tefillin ikri nichse ditnan hammakdish nechasav maalin lo tefillin ibaya lehu sefer tora may kevan dela mizdabban deasur lezabboneh lav nichse hu o dilma kevan demizdabban lilmod tora velisa ishsha nichse hu teku
Siman zutra imeh deamram mittarte achota rav tovi verav dimi verav yosef
Imeh derav zutra bar toviyya katvinhu lenichsah lerav zutra bar toviyya devaaya leinnesove leh lerav zevid insiva vegarshah atya lekammeh derav bivi bar abbaye amar mishshum innesove veha insiva

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua mishshum deattu mimmulae amritu mile mulyata afilu leman deamar mavrachat kane hane mile hecha dela galleya datah aval hacha galleya datah demishshum insove hu veha insiva veigarsha

Imeh derame bar chama beurta ketavtinhu lenichsah lerami bar chama betzafra ketavtinhu lerav ukva bar chama ata rame bar chama lekammeh derav sheshet okmeh benichse azal rav ukva bar chama kammeh derav nachman okmeh benichse
Ata rav sheshet lekammeh derav nachman amar leh may tama okmeh mar lerav ukva bar chama i mishshum dahadara bah veha shechiva amar leh hachi amar shemuel kol sheilu amad chozer chozer bemattenato
Emor deamar shemuel leatzmo leacher mi amar amar leh beferush amar shemuel ben leatzmo ben leacher

Imeh derav amram chasida hava lah meluga dishtarey ki ka shachva amra leheve leamram beri ato achoha lekammeh derav nachman amaru leh veha la meshach amar lehu divre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin damu

Achateh derav tovi bar rav matna ketavtinhu lenichsah lerav tovi bar rav matna betzafra lefanya ata rav achadvuy bar rav matna becha lah amar lah hashta amri mar tzurba merabbanan umar lav tzurba merabbanan ketavtinhu nihaleh ata lekammeh derav nachman amar leh hachi amar shemuel kol sheilu amad chozer chozer bemattenato
Achateh derav dimi bar yosef hava lah pisketa defardesa kol emat dahavat chalsha hava makneya leh nihaleh
b: Vechi kayema havat hadra bah zimna chada chalasha shelacha leh ta keni shelach la baena shelacha leh ta keni kol hecha devaet azal shayyaro ukno minah ki kayema hadra bah
Atay lekammeh derav nachman shelach leh ta la ata amar may ete ha shayyari ukno minah shelach leh i la atet machena lach besilva dela mabba dema
Amar lehu lesahadi hechi hava maase amaru leh amara hachi vay deka mayeta hach itta amar lehu im ken hava metzave mechamat mita umtzave mechamat mita chozer

Itmar mattenat shechiv mera bemiktzat amruha rabbanan kammeh derava mishshemeh demar zutra bereh derav nachman deamar mishshemeh derav nachman hare hi kemattenat bari vahare hi kemattenat shechiv mera hare hi kemattenat bari sheim amad eno chozer vahare hi kemattenat shechiv mera dela baaya kinyan
Amar lehu rava lav amena lechu la titlo buke serike berav nachman hachi amar rav nachman hare hi kemattenat bari uvaaya kinyan

Etiveh rava lerav nachman shiyyer karka kol shehu mattenato kayyemet may lav dela keno mineh la dikno mineh i hachi ema sefa lo shiyyer karka kal shehu en mattenato kayyemet vei dikno mineh ammay en mattenato kayyemet
Amar leh hachi amar shemuel shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim af al pi shekkanu miyyado amad chozer beyadua shello haya metzave ella mechamat mita
Etiveh rav mesharsheya lerava maase beimman shel bene rochel shehayeta chola veamra tinnaten kevinti levitti vehi bishnem asar mane umeta vekiyemu devareha hatam bimtzava mechamat mita
Etiveh ravina lerava haomer tenu get ze leishti ushtar shichrur ze leavdi umet lo yittenu leachar mita tenu mane lifloni umet yittenu leachar mita
Umimmay dela keno mineh dumya deget ma get lav bar kinyan af hay name dela keno mineh hatam name bimtzave mechamat mita
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar metzave mechamat mita bealma baaya kinyan vechi tanya hane matneyata bimchallek kol nechasav dehahi mattenat shechiv mera shavveuha
Vehilcheta mattenat shechiv mera bemiktzat baaya kinyan veaf al gav demet metzave mechamat mita la baaya kinyan vehu demet amad chozer veaf al gav dikno mineh

a: Itmar mattenat shechiv mera shekkatuv bah kinyan be rav mishshemeh derav amri arkeveh attere richshe ushmuel amar la yadana may edun bah

Be rav mishshemeh derav amri arkeveh attere richshe hare hi kemattenat bari hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera hare hi kemattenat bari sheim amad eno chozer hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera sheim amar halvaato lifloni halvaato lifloni
Ushmuel amar la yadana may edun bah shemma lo gamar lehaknoto ella bishtar veen shetar leachar mita

Urmi derav adderav vedishmuel addishmuel dishlach ravin mishshemeh derabbi avahu heo yadi sheshshalach rabbi elazar laggola mishshum rabbenu shechiv mera sheamar kitvu utnu mane lifloni umet en kotvin venotnin shemma lo gamar lehaknoto ella bishtar veen shetar leachar mita veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel hilcheta kotvin venotnin
Kashya derav adderav kashya dishmuel addishmuel
Derav adderav la kashya ha dikno mineh ha dela keno mineh dishmuel addishmuel la kashya bimyappe et kocho

Yatev rav nachman bar yitzchak achoreh derava veyatev rava kammeh derav nachman ka bae mineh mi amar shemuel shemma lo gamar lehaknoto ella bishtar veen shetar leachar mita veha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim af al pi shekkanu miyyado amad chozer
b: Beyadua shello haya kinyan ella mechamat hammita veachvi leh bideh veishtik
Ki kam amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava may achvi lach amar leh bimyappe et kocho
Hechi dame meyappe et kocho amar rav chisda uknena mineh mosif al mattanta da
Peshita katav laze vechatav laze hayenu dechi ata rav dimi amar deyateke mevattelet deyateke katav vezika laze katav vezika laze rav amar rishon kana ushmuel amar sheni kana
Rav amar rishon kana hare hi kemattenat bari ushmuel amar sheni kana hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera
Veha ippeligu bah chada zimna bemattenat shechiv mera shekkatuv bah kinyan
Tzericha dei itmar beha beha kaamar rav mishshum dikno mineh aval beha dela keno mineh ema mode leh lishmuel vei itmar beha beha kaamar shemuel aval behach ema mode leh lerav tzericha

Besura matnu hachi befumbedita matnu hachi amar rav yirmeya bar abba shelachu leh mibbe rav lishmuel yelammedenu rabbenu shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim vekanu miyyado mahu shelach lehu en achar kinyan kelum

a: Sevur mineh hane mile leacher aval leatzmo lo amar lehu rav chisda ki ata rav huna mikkufri parshah ben leatzmo ben laacherim
Hahu dikno mineh ata lekammeh derav huna amar may ebed lach dela aknet kidmaknu inashe
Hahi mattanta dahava katuv bah bachayyim uvammavet rav amar hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera ushmuel amar hare hi kemattenat bari
Rav amar hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera middichtiv bah bammavet achar mita kaamar leh vehay dichtiv bachayyim siman bealma dechaye
Ushmuel amar hare hi kemattenat bari middichtiv bah bachayyim mechayyim kaamar vehay dichtav uvammavet keman deamar meatta vead olam amri nehardae hilcheta keoteh derav
Amar rava vei ketiv bah mechayyim kena
Amar ammemar let hilcheta keoteh derava amar leh rav ashe leammemar peshita deha amri nehardae hilcheta keoteh derav mahu detema mechayyim mode rav ka mashma lan
Hahu daata lekammeh derav nachman linhardea shaddereh lekammeh derabbi yirmeya bar abba leshum tamya amar hacha atra dishmuel hechi naaved keoteh derav
Hahi daatay lekammeh derava avad lah rava kishmateh hava ka tarda leh
Amar leh lerav pappa bereh derav chanan safreh zil ketov lah uchtov bah socher alehen o matan amra litba arbeh atoye ka matet li amshinhu lemaneh derava bemayya vaafilu hachi la iprak mittiva
Matni lo katav bah shechiv mera hu omer shechiv mera hayiti vehen omrim bari hayita tzarich lehavi reaya sheshshechiv mera haya divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Gema hahu mattanta dahava ketiv bah kad hava ketzir urme bearseh vela ketav bah umiggo mareh iptar levet olameh
b: Amar rabba hare met vahare kivro mochiach alav amar leh abbaye hashta uma sefina sherubban leaved notnin alehen chumre chayyim vechumre metim cholin sherov cholin lechayyim lo kol shekken
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua keman azla ha shemata derabba kerabbi natan detanya mi motzi miyyad mi hu motzi midehen belo reaya vehen en motziin miyyado ella biraya divre rabbi yaakov
Rabbi natan omer im bari hu alav lehavi reaya shehaya shechiv mera im shechiv mera hu alehen lehavi reaya shebbari haya
Amar rabbi elazar ultuma kammachloket ditnan bika bimot hachamma reshut hayyachid lashshabbat urshut harabbim lattuma
Bimot haggeshamim reshut hayyachid lechan ulchan
Amar rava lo shanu ella shello avru alav yemot haggeshamim aval avru alav yemot haggeshamim reshut hayyachid lechan ulchan
Vachachamim omrim hammotzi mechavero alav haraya vechu

a: Reaya bemay rav huna amar reaya beedim rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri reaya bekiyyum hashshetar
Rav huna amar reaya beedim ka mipalgi biflugta derabbi yaakov verabbi natan
Siman manniach rabbi meir kerabbi natan verabbanan kerabbi yaakov

Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri reaya bekiyyum hashshetar ka mipalgi bemode bishtar shekketavo tzarich lekayemo derabbi meir savar mode bishtar shekketavo eno tzarich lekayemo verabbanan savri mode bishtar shekketavo tzarich lekayemo
Veha ipligu vah chada zimna detanya en neemanin lefoslo divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim neemanin
Tzericha dei itmar hahi behahi kaamri rabbanan mishshum deallime edim umari shetara aval hacha hu delav kal kemineh ema la
Vei itmar beha beha kaamar rabbi meir aval behach ema mode lehu lerabbanan tzericha

Vechen amar rabba reaya beedim amar leh abbaye may tama i nema middechullehu ketiv behu kad hava mehallech al raglohi beshuka uvha la ketiv bah shema minah shechiv mera have adderabba middechullehu ketiv behu kad ketzir urme bearseh veha la ketiv bah shema minah bari have
Ika lememar hachi veika lememar hachi oki mamona bechezkat mareh
Uviflugta derabbi yochanan amar reaya beedim verabbi shimon ben lakish amar reaya bekiyyum hashshetar

Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish maase bivne verak beechad shemmachar benichse aviv umet uvau bene mishpacha veiraru lomar katan haya bishat mita uvau veshaalu et rabbi akiva mahu levodko amar lahem i attem rashshaim lenavvelo veod simanin asuyin lehishtannot leachar mita
b: Bishlama ledidi deamena reaya beedim kevan deamar lelakochot ayeto edim vela ashkachu hayenu deka ato vaamaru leh mahu levodko ella ledidach deamratte reaya bekiyyum hashshetar lema lehu levodko lekayemu shetarayehu velokmu benichse
Mi savratte nichse bechezkat bene mishpacha kayemi veka atu lakochot umarari nichse bechezkat lakochot kayemi veka atu bene mishpacha veka mearari

Hachi name mistabbera middekaamar lehu i attem rashshaim lenavvelo veishtiku i amratte bishlama bene mishpacha ka mearari mishshum hachi ishtiku ella i amratte lakochot ka mearari ammay shatki lemru leh anan zuze yahavinan leh linaval velinaval
I mishshum ha la irya hachi kaamar lehu chada dei attem rashshaim lenavvelo veod vechi temru zuze shekal linaval velinaval simanim asuyin lehishtannot leachar mita

Ta shema shaal rabbi shimon ben lakish et rabbi yochanan zo sheshshenuya bemishnat bar kappara hare shehaya ochel sade uva bechezkat shehi shello vekara alav echad arar lomar shelli hi vehotzi ze et ono lomar shemmechartah li o shennetattah li bemattana im amar eni makkir bishtar ze meolam yitkayyem hashshetar bechotmav
Im amar shetar passim hu ze o shetar amana shemmacharti lach velo natatta li damim im yesh edim hallech achar edim veim lav hallech achar hashshetar
Lema rabbi meir hi deamar mode bishtar shekketavo eno tzarich lekayemo vela rabbanan
Amar leh la sheani omer divre hakkol mode bishtar shekketavo eno tzarich lekayemo veha miflag peligi ditnan en neemanin lefoslo divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim neemanin
Amar leh i edim allime umari shetara ihu kal kemineh amar leh vahalo mishshimcha amru yafe iraru bene mishpacha amar leh zo elazar amarah ani lo amarti davar ze meolam

Amar rabbi zera im yichpor rabbi yochanan berabbi elazar talmido yichpor berabbi yannay rabbo deamar rabbi yannay amar rabbi mode bishtar shekketavo eno tzarich lekayemo vaamar leh rabbi yochanan rabbi lo mishnatenu hi zo vachachamim omrim hammotzi mechavero alav haraya en reaya ella bekiyyum hashshetar

Beram nirin divre rabbenu yosef deamar rabbenu yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel zo divre chachamim aval rabbi meir omer mode bishtar shekketavo shetztzarich lekayemo umay divre hakkol derabbanan legabbe rabbi meir divre hakkol hi
Veha ipcha tenan vachachamim omrim hammotzi mechavero alav haraya efoch veha tanya en neemanin lefoslo divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim neemanin efoch
Veha rabbi yochanan reaya beedim kaamar efoch lema lefoch name teuvta la

a: Hachi kaamar leh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish bishlama ledidi deamena reaya bekiyyum hashshetar hayenu demashkachatte lah denachati lakochot linchasim ella ledidach deamratte reaya beedim hechi mashkachatte lah denachati lakochot binchasim
Amar leh modena lach bearar divne mishpacha delav arar hu may kaamri katan haya chazaka en haedim chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken naasa gadol
Itmar katan meematay mocher benichse aviv rava amar rav nachman ben shemone esre shana verav huna bar chinana amar rav nachman mibben esrim shana veha derava lav beferush itmar ella mikkelala itmar

Metiv rabbi zera maase bivne verak beechad shemmachar benichse aviv umet uvau bene mishpacha veiraru lomar katan haya bishat mita uvau veshaalu et rabbi akiva mahu levodko amar lahem i attem rashshain lenavvelo veod simanin asuyin lehishtannot leachar mita bishlama leman deamar ben shemone esre shana
b: Hayenu dekaatu veamru leh mahu levodko ella i amratte mibben esrim ki badku leh may have veha tenan ben esrim shello hevi shette searot yaviu reaya shehu ben esrim vehu hassaris lo choletz velo meyabbem
Lav itmar alah amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav vehu shennoldu bo simane saris amar rava dayeka name dekatane vehu hassaris shema minah

Vechi la noldu lo simane saris ad kamma tane rabbi chiyya ad rov shenotav ki ata lekammeh derabbi chiyya i kachesh amar lehu livre vei ibberi amar lehu lichchosh dehane simane zimnin deatu mechamat kechishuta zimnin deatu mechamat beriyyuta
Ibaya lehu toch zeman kelifne zeman o kilachar zeman amar rava amar rav nachman toch zeman kelifne zeman rava bar rav shela amar rav nachman toch zeman kilachar zeman

Veha derava lav beferush itmar ella mikkelala itmar dehahu toch zeman deazel zabben nichse vaata lekammeh derava amar lehu lo asa velo chelum man dachaza savar mishshum detoch zeman kelifne zeman vela hi hatam shetuta yattirta chaza beh dahava ka meshachrar lehu leavdeh

Shelach leh gidel bar menashsheya lerava yelammedenu rabbenu tinoket bat arba esre shana veom echad yodaat betiv massa umattan mahu shelach leh im yodaat betiv massa umattan mikkachah mikkach umimkarah mimkar
Velishlach leh tinok maase shehaya kach haya velishlach leh tinoket bat shettem esre shana veom echad maase shehaya kach haya

Veha derava lav beferush itmar ella mikkelala itmar dehahu pachut mibben esrim daazal zabben nichse avuhu kegidel bar menashsheya ata lekammeh derava amaru leh keroveh zil echol tamre ushdi beh kashyata be rava avad hachi amar lehu zevineh lav zevine

Ki ka katvu leh shetara amaru leh lakochot zil ema leh lerava megillat ester bezuza shetara demar bezuza azal amar leh amar lehu zevineh zevine amaru leh keroveh lakochot agmeruhu amar lehu masberi leh savar kevan demasberi leh vesavar mida yada vehay daavad hachi chutzpa yattira hu dahava beh
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua uledut eduto edut amar mar zutra la amaran ella lemittaltele aval limkarkee la

Amar leh rav ashe lemar zutra may shena mittalteli dizvineh zevine ella meatta ha ditnan happaotot mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar bemittaltelin hachi name deedutan edut amar leh hatam baena veamdu shene haanashim veleka
Amar ammemar umattenato mattana amar leh rav ashe leammemar hashta uma zevine dimkabbel zuze amratte dela dilma mozel umzabben kol shekken mattana dela mate leh vela mide amar leh

a: Ultamach zabben shave chamsha beshita hachi name dizvineh zevine

Ella kim lehu lerabbanan deyanoka mekarva dateh gabbe zuze vei amratte zevineh zevine zimnin dimkarkeshi leh zuze azel mezabben lechullehu nichse daavuh aval gabbe mattana i lav dahava leh hanaa mineh la hava yahev leh mattana amaru rabbanan tehve mattenato mattana delibedu lehu mile
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel bodkin lekiddushin legerushin velachalitza ulmeunin velimkor benichse aviv ad sheyehe ben esrim
Vechevan divdakna lekiddushin legerushin lema li lo nitzrecha ella leyibbum ditnan ben tesha shanim veom echad shebba al yevimto kenaah veen noten get ad sheyyigdal
Lachalitza leappoke midderabbi yose deamar ish katuv bapparasha aval ishsha ben gedola uven ketanna ka mashma lan demakkeshinan ishsha leish dela kerabbi yose
Ulmeunin leappoke midderabbi yehuda deamar ad sheyyirbe shachor ka mashma lan dela kerabbi yehuda
Velimkor benichse aviv ad sheyehe ben esrim leappoke mimman deamar ben shemone esre
Vehilcheta toch zeman kelifne zeman vehilcheta kegidel bar menashshe
Vehilcheta kemar zutra vehilcheta keammemar vehilcheta kerav nachman amar shemuel bechullehu
Matni hamchallek nechasav al piv rabbi elazar omer echad bari veechad mesukkan nechasim sheyyesh lahen achraut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka vesheen lahen achraut en niknin ella bimshicha
b: Amru lo maase beimman shel bene rochel shehayeta chola veamra tenu kevinti levitti vehi bishnem asar mane umeta vekiyemu et devareha amar lahen bene rochel tikberem imman
Gema tanya amar lahen rabbi eliezer lachachamim maase bemaroni echad shehaya birushalayim vehau lo mittaltelin harbe uvikesh litnam bemattana amru lo en lahem takkana ad sheyyakne al gav karka

Halach velakach bet sela echad samuch lirushalayim veamar tzefono lifloni veimmo mea tzon umea chaviyyot udromo lifloni veimmo mea tzon umea chaviyyot vamet vekiyemu chachamim et devarav amru lo mishsham reaya maroni bari haya

Amar lahen bene rochel tikberem imman vechu may tama ka layet lehu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mekayeme kotzim bakkerem hau verabbi eliezer letameh ditnan hamkayyem kotzim bakkerem rabbi eliezer omer kiddesh vachachamim omrim lo kiddesh ella davar shekkamohu mekayemin
Bishlama karkom chaze ella kotzim lemay chaze amar rabbi chanina may tama derabbi eliezer shekken baaravya mekayemin kotzim bassadot ligmallehen
Amar rabbi levi konin kinyan mishshechiv mera afilu beshabbat velo lachosh ledivre rabbi eliezer ella shemma tittaref dato alav
Matni rabbi eliezer omer bashshabbat devarav kayyamin mippene sheen yachol lichtov aval lo bachol rabbi yehoshua omer bashshabbat amru kal vachomer bachol
Kayyotze bo zachin lakkatan veen zachin laggadol divre rabbi eliezer rabbi yehoshua omer lakkatan amru kal vachomer laggadol
Gema matnitin manni rabbi yehuda hi detanya rabbi meir omer rabbi eliezer omer bachol devarav kayyamin mippene sheyyachol lichtov aval lo bashshabbat
Rabbi yehoshua

a: Omer bachol amru vekal vachomer lashshabbat kayyotze bo zachin laggadol veen zachin lakkatan divre rabbi eliezer rabbi yehoshua omer begadol amru kal vachomer lakkatan

Rabbi yehuda omer rabbi eliezer omer bashshabbat devarav kayyamin mippene sheeno yachol lichtov aval lo bachol rabbi yehoshua omer bashshabbat amru kal vachomer bachol kayyotze bo zachin lakkatan veen zachin laggadol divre rabbi eliezer rabbi yehoshua omer lakkatan amru kal vachomer laggadol

Matni nafal habbayit alav veal aviv o alav veal morishav vehayeta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov yorshe haav omrim habben met rishon veachar kach met haav uvaale hachov omrim haav met rishon veachar kach met habben
Bet shammay omrim yachloku uvet hillel omrim nechasim bechezkatan
Gema tenan hatam hammalve et chavero bishtar gove minnechasim meshubadim al yede edim gove minnechasim bene chorin
Bae shemuel deikne vekana mahu alliba derabbi meir deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam la tibe lach devadday kana ella ki tibe lach alliba derabbanan deamri en adam makne davar shello ba laolam
Amar rav yosef ta shema vachachamim omrim ze haya pikeach shemmachar lo et hakkarka mippene shehu yachol lemashkeno alav
Amar leh rava mineh kaamar mineh afilu miggelima deal katpeh ki ka mibaya lan deikne kana umachar deikne kana vehorish may

Amar rav chana ta shema nafal habbayit alav veal aviv alav veal morishav vehayeta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov yorshe haav omrim habben met rishon veachar kach met haav uvaale chovot omrim haav met rishon ku
Vei salka datach deikne kana umachar deikne kana vehorish la mishtabed nehi name deav mayet beresha deikne hu

Amar lehu rav nachman zeera chavrin targemah mitzva al hayetomim lifroa chovat avihen matkef lah rav ashe milve al pe hu verav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu milve al pe eno gove lo min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot
b: Ella ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam
Amar rav yaakov minnehar pekod mishshemeh deravina ta shema shitre chov hammukdamin pesulin vehamucharin kesherin
Vei salka datach deikne kana umachar deikne kana vehorish lo mishtabed meucharin ammay kesherin deikne hu
Ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam

Amar rav mesharsheya mishshemeh derava ta shema leshevach karkaot ketzad hare shemmachar sade lachavero vehishbichah uva baal chov utrafah keshehu gove gove et hakkeren minnechasin meshubadin veet hashshevach minnechasin bene chorin
Vei salka datach deikne kana umachar deikne kana vehorish lo mishtabed baal chov ammay gove shevacha
Ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam
Im timtza lomar deikne kana umachar deikne kana vehorish lo mishtabed ha lo mishtabed im timtza lomar mishtabed lava velava vechazar vekana mahu lekamma mishtabad o levatra mishtabad

Amar rav nachman ha milta ibaya lan ushlachu mittam rishon kana rav huna amar yachloku vechen tane rabba bar avuh yachloku amar ravina mahdura kamma derav ashe amar lan rishon kana mahdura batra derav ashe amar lan yachloku vehilcheta yachloku

Metivi leshevach karkaot ketzad hare shemmachar sade lachavero vehishbichah uva baal chov utrafah keshehu gove gove et hakkeren minnechasin meshubadin veet hashshevach minnechasin bene chorin veim ita chatzi shevach mibbee leh
May gove name dekatane chatzi shevach

a: Matni nafal habbayit alav veal ishto yorshe habbaal omrim ishsha meta rishon veachar kach met habbaal yorshe ishsha omrim baal met rishon veachar kach meta ishsha
Bet shammay omrim yachloku uvet hillel omrim nechasim bechezkatan ketubba bechezkat yorshe habbaal nechasim hannichnasin vehayyotzin immah bechezkat yorshe haav
b: Gema bechezkat mi rabbi yochanan amar bechezkat yorshe habbaal verabbi elazar amar bechezkat yorshe haishsha
Verabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum bar kappara amar yachloku vechen tane bar kappara hoil vehallalu bain lirash vehallalu bain lirash yachloku

Matni nafal habbayit alav veal immo ellu vaellu modin sheyyachloku amar rabbi akiva mode ani bazo shehannechasim bechezkatan amar lo ben azzay al hachalukin anu mitztaarin ella shebbata lechallek alenu et hashshavin

Gema bechezkat mi rabbi ila amar bechezkat yorshe haem rabbi zera amar bechezkat yorshe habben ki salek rabbi zera kam beshitteh derabbi ila kam rabba beshitteh derabbi zera amar rabbi zera shema minah avera deeretz yisrael machkim
Vetama may amar abbaye hoil vehuchzeka nachala beoto shevet
Amar lo ben azzay al hachalukin anu mitztaarin vechu amar rabbi simlay ada amra ben azzay talmid chaver derabbi akiva hava dekaamar leh shebbata
Shelachu mittam ben shellava benichse aviv bechayye aviv vamet beno motzi miyyad hallakochot vezo hi shekkasha bedine mamonot lava may mappek veod lakochot may avidteh ella i itmar hachi

Umay kushya dilma matze amar mikkoach avuh deabba kaatena tidda dichtiv tachat avotecha yihu vanecha teshitemo lesarim bechol haaretz

Ella i kashya ha kashya ben bechor shemmachar chelek bechora bechayye aviv vamet bechayye aviv beno motzi miyyad hallakochot vezo hi shekkasha bedine mamonot avuh mezabben ihu mappek vechi tema hacha name amar mikkoach avuh deabba kaatena i mikkoach avuh deabba ka atya bechelek bechora may avidteh
Umay kushya dilma matze amar mikkoach avuh deabba kaatena uvimkom av kaemna

Ella i kashya ha kashya haya yodea lo edut bishtar ad shello naasa gazlan venaasa gazlan hu eno meid al ketav yado aval acherim meidin hashta ihu la meheman achrine mehemni vezo hi shekkasha bedine mamonot
May kushya dilma kegon shehuchzak ketav yado bevet din

Ella i kashya ha kashya haya yodea lo edut bishtar ad shello tippol lo birushsha hu eno yachol lekayyem ketav yado aval acherim yecholin lekayyem ketav yado umay kushya dilma hacha name kegon shehuchzak ketav yado bevet din
Ella i kashya ha kashya haya yodea lo beedut ad shello naasa chatano venaasa chatano hu eno meid al ketav yado aval acherim meidin hu la meheman achrine mehemni
Vechi tema hacha name kegon shehuchzak ketav yado bevet din veha amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman af al pi shello huchzak ketav yado bevet din

Umay kushya dilma gezerat melech hi deihu la meheman veachrine mehemni velav mishshum dimshakkar dei la tema hachi moshe veaharon lechotnam mishshum dela mehemni hu ella gezerat melech hu shello yaidu lahem hacha name gezerat melech hu shello yaid al ketav yado lechotno
Ella leolam kidamrinan meikara udka kashya lach tachat avotecha yihu vanecha hahu bivracha ketiv
Umi matzet amratte bivracha ketiv
b: Aval leinyan dina la
