May lav yorshe haav bene morishav ache vei salka datach la matze amar mikkoach avuh deabba kaatena dechi ketiv tachat avotecha yihu vanecha bivracha ketiv ki met habben veachar kach met haav may have nema lehu baal chov yerushshat avuhon ka shakelna
La yorshe haav echav morishav ache daavuh

Beo mineh merav sheshet ben mahu sheyyirash et immo bakkever lehanchil laachin min haav amar lehu rav sheshet tenetuha haav shennishba umet beno bammedina uven shennishba umet aviv bammedina yorshe haav veorshe habben yachloku

Hechi dame ilema kidkatane he ninhu yorshe haav vehe ninhu yorshe habben ella lav hachi kaamar av shennishba umet ben bitto bammedina uven bitto shennishba umet avi immo bammedina vela yadinan he minayehu mit beresha yorshe haav veorshe habben yachloku
Veim ita nehi name deven met beresha lerteh laavuh deimmeh bekivreh velertinhu laachoha min avuh ella lav shema minah en habben yoresh et immo bakkever lehanchil laachin meav

Amar leh rav acha bar minome leabbaye af anan name tenena nafal habbayit alav veal immo ellu vaellu modim sheyyachloku veim ita nehi name deven met beresha lertah leimmeh bekivreh velertu inhu leache meavuh ella lav shema minah en habben yoresh et immo bakkever lehanchil laachin min haav shema minah

Vetama may amar abbaye neemra siba babben veneemra siba babbaal ma siba haamura babbaal en habbaal yoresh et ishto bakkever af siba haamura babben en habben yoresh et immo bakkever lehanchil laachin min haav
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh nichse devar sisin mezabbenna lach havay chada ara dahava mikarya deve bar sisin amar leh ha lav deve bar sisin hi veikroye hu demikarya deve bar sisin
Ata lekammeh derav nachman okmah bida delokeach amar leh rava lerav nachman dina hachi hammotzi mechavero alav haraya verame derava adderava udrav nachman adderav nachman
Dehahu daamar leh lechavreh may baet behay beta amar leh minach zeventah vaachalit shene chazaka amar leh ana beshikkune gavae havay
Ata lekammeh derav nachman amar leh zil beror achilatach amar leh rava lerav nachman dina hachi hammotzi mechavero alav haraya kashya derava adderava udrav nachman adderav nachman
Derava adderava la kashya hacha mocher kae benichseh hatam lokeach kae benichseh

Derav nachman adderav nachman la kashya hacha kevan deamar leh deve bar sisin umikarya deve bar sisin aleh dideh ramya legalloye delav deve bar sisin hi hacha lo yehe ella denaket shetara mi la amrinan leh kayyem shetarach vekum benichse
Hadaran alach mi shemmet

a: Get pashut edav mittocho mekushshar edav meachorav

Pashut shekkatvu edav meachorav mekushshar shekkatvu edav mittocho shenehem pesulin rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer mekushshar shekkatvu edav mittocho kasher mippene sheyyachol laasoto pashut rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hakkol keminhag hammedina
Get pashut edav bishnayim umkushshar bishlosha pashut shekkatav bo ed echad umkushshar shekkatav bo shene edim shenehem pesulin
Gema menahane mile amar rabbi chanina deamar kera sadot bakkesef yiknu vechatov bassefer vechatom vehaed edim sadot bakkesef yiknu vechatov bassefer
b: Ze pashut vechatom ze mekushshar vehaed shenayim edim shelosha ha ketzad shenayim lefashut shelosha limkushshar
Veefoch ana mittoch shennitrabba biksharav nitrabba beedav
Rafram amar mehacha vaekkach et sefer hammikna et hechatum hammitzva vehachukkim veet haggaluy vaekkach et sefer hammikna ze pashut et hechatum ze mekushshar veet haggaluy ze pashut shebbamkushshar
Hammitzva vehachukkim ellu devarim shebben pashut limkushshar ha ketzad ze edav shenayim veze edav shelosha ze edav mittocho veze edav meachorav
Veefoch ana mittoch shennitrabba biksharav nitrabba beedav
Rame bar yechezkel amar mehacha al pi shenayim edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar im titkayyem edutan bishnayim lamma parat lach bishlosha lomar lach shenayim lefashut shelosha limkushshar
Veefoch ana mittoch shennitrabba biksharav nitrabba beedav

Vehane lehachi hu deatu kol chad vechad lemilteh hu daata lechidtanya sadot bakkesef yiknu vechatov bassefer vechatom etza tova ka mashma lan vaekkach et sefer hammikna hachi hava maase al pi shenayim edim o al pi shelosha edim lehakkish shelosha lishnayim biflugta derabbi akiva verabbanan
Ella mekushshar midderabbanan ukrae asmachta bealma
Vetama may takkinu rabbanan mekushshar atra dechahane hao vahao kafdi tuva umgarshi nashayehu veavdi rabbanan takkanta addehachi vehachi miyyatteva datayehu
Hatinach gitin shetarot may ika lememar kede shello techallek ben gitin lishtarot
Hechan edim chotmin rav huna amar ben kesher lekesher verav yirmeya bar abba amar achore hakketav uchneged hakketav mibbachutz

Amar leh rame bar chama lerav chisda lerav huna deamar ben kesher lekesher ka salka datin ben kesher lekesher miggavay veha hahu mekushshar daata lekammeh derabbi veamar rabbi en zeman baze amar leh rabbi shimon berabbi lerabbi shemma ben kesharav muvla palyeh vechazyeh veim ita en zeman baze veen edim baze mibaya leh
Amar leh mi savratte ben kesher lekesher miggavay la ben kesher lekesher meabbaray
Venechush dilma zayyef vechatev may devae vachatimi sahadi
Dichtiv beh sharir vekayyam
Venechush dilma katev may devae vahadar katev sharir vekayyam acharina chad sharir vekayyam katvinan tere sharir vekayyam la katvinan
Velechush dilma machek leh lesharir vekayyam vechatav may devae vahadar katev sharir vekayyam ha amar rabbi yochanan teluya mekuyyemet keshera

a: Mechak pasul veaf al pi shemmekuyyam
Velo amru mechak pasul ella bimkom sharir vekayyam uchshiur sharir vekayyam
Ulrav yirmeya bar abba deamar achore hakketav uchneged hakketav mibbachutz lechush dilma katev miggavay may devae umachtim sahade yattire meabbaray veamar ana lerabbot beedim hu daavadi
Amar leh mi savratte edim kesidran chatimi edim mimmatta lemala chatimi
Velechush dilma mitramya reuta beshita acharona vegayez lah leshita acharona vegayez leh liruven bahadeh umittachshar beven yaakov ed ditnan ben ish peloni ed kasher
Dichtiv reuven ben bechad dara veyaakov ed illaveyh
Velichosh dilma gayez leh liruven ben umittachshar beyaakov ed ditnan ish peloni ed kasher
Dela ketiv ed
Veibaet ema leolam dichtiv ed deyadinan bah deha chatimut yeda
b: Lav deyaakov hu
Vedilma bishmeh daavuh chatam la shavek inish shemeh dideh vechatem bishmeh daavuh
Vedilma simana bealma hu deshavveyeh deha rav tzayer keora rabbi chanina tzayer charuta rav chisda samech rav hoshaya ayin rava bar rav huna machuta la chatzif inash leshauoyeh lishmeh daavuh simana
Mar zutra amar lema lach kulle hay kol mekushshar sheen edav kalin beshita achat pasul
Amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan kol hammechakin kullan tzarich sheyyichtov veden kiyyumehon vetzarich sheyyachazor meinyano shel shetar beshita acharona may tama

a: Amar rav amram lefi sheen lemedin mishshita acharona
Amar leh rav nachman lerav amram mena lach ha amar leh detanya hirchik et haedim shene shitin min hakketav pasul shita achat kasher
May shena shene shitin dilma mezayyef vechatev shita achat name mezayyef vechatav ella lav shema minah en lemedin mishshita acharona shema minah
b: Ibaya lehu shita umechetza may ta shema hirchik et haedim shene shitin pasul ha shita umechetza kasher
Ema sefa shita achat kasher shita achat hu dechasher ha shita umechetza pasul ella meha leka lemishma minah
May have alah ta shema detanya hirchik et haedim shene shitin min hakketav pasul pachot mikkan kasher
Hau arbaa vachamishsha edim chatumin al hashshetar venimtza echad mehen karov o pasul titkayyem edut bashshear
Mesayya leh lechizkiyya deamar chizkiyya milleahu bikrovim kasher
Veal titmah shehare avir sukka posel bishlosha sechach pasul posel bearbaa
Ibaya lehu shene shitin sheamru

a: Hen vaaviran o dilma hen velo aviran
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mistabbera dehen vaaviran dei salka datach hen velo aviran shita achat belo avirah lemay chazya ella shema minah hen vaaviran shema minah
Rabbi shabbetay amar mishshemeh dechizkiyya shene shitin sheamru bichtav yede edim velo ketav yede sofer may tama dechol hamzayyef lav legabbe safra azel umzayyef
Vechamma amar rav yitzchak ben elazar kegon lechalcha ze al gabbe ze alma kasavar shene shitin vearbaa avirin
Rav chiyya bar amme mishshemeh deulla amar kegon lamed millemala vechaf millematta alma kasavar shene shitin ushlosha avirin
Rabbi avahu amar kegon baruch ben levi beshita achat ka savar shita achat ushne avirin
Amar rav lo shanu ella ben edim lakketav aval ben edim laashsharta afilu tuva name kasher
May shena ben edim lakketav dilma mezayyef vechatev may devae vachatimi sahadi ben edim laashsharta name mezayyef vechatev may devae vachatimi sahadi
Dimtayyet leh i hachi ben edim lashshetar name metayyet leh
Amri sahade atteuta hu dachatimi ben edim laashsharta name amri be dina atteuta hu dachatimi be dina atteuta la chatimi
Velechush dilma gayez leh leela umachek leh lituta vechatev may devae umachtim sahade veamar rav shetar habba hu veedav al hammechak kasher
b: Hanicha lerav kahana dematne lah mishshemeh dishmuel shappir ella lerav tavome dematne lah mishshemeh derav may ika lememar
Kasavar kol ki hay gavena en mekayemin oto min haashsharta shebbo ella min haedim shebbo
Verabbi yochanan amar lo shanu ella ben haedim lakketav aval ben edim laashsharta afilu shita achat pasul
May shena ben edim laashsharta dilma gayez leilay vechatev hu veedav beshita achat vekasavar shetar habba hu veedav beshita achat kasher
I hachi ben edim lakketav name dilma gayez leh leilay vechatev may devae vachatimi sahade ka savar shetar habba hu beshita achat veedav beshita acheret pasul
Velechush dilma katev hu veedav beshita achat veamar ana lerabbot beedim hu daavadi
Kasavar kol ki hay gavena en mekayemin oto min haedim shellematta ella min haedim shellemala
Gufa amar rav shetar habba hu veedav al hammechak kasher

a: Veim tomar mochek vechozer umochek eno dome nimchak paam achat lenimchak shette feamim
Velechush dilma shade deota ammekom edim meikara umachek leh dechi hadar machek leh lehay have leh ide veide nimchak shette feamim
Amar abbaye kasavar rav en haedim chotmin al hammechak ella im ken nimchak bifnehem
Metivi hu al hanneyar veedav al hammechak kasher venechush dilma machek leh vechatev may devae vehave leh hu veedav al hammechak
Dechatvi hachi anachna sahade chatamna al mechaka ushtara ketiv al neyara
Dechatvi hecha i milletachat gayez leh i ilay machek leh dechatvi ben sahada lesahada
I hachi ema sefa hu al hammechak veedav al hanneyar pasul ammay pasul hacha name nichtevu hachi anachna sahade chatamna al neyara ushtara al mechaka

Hashta name may amratte mochek chozer umochek ha amratte eno dome nimchak paam achat lenimchak shette feamim hane mile hecha dachatimi sahade ammechaka hecha dela chatimi sahade ammechaka ella anneyara la yedia
Velayete megilta achariti velimchok velidamme la dame mechaka deha megilta limchaka deha megilta
Ulkabbelah lachatimut yeda desahadi beve dina velimchok velidamme amar rav hoshaya eno dome nimchak ben yomo lenimchak ben shene yamim
Velishahayeh amar rabbi yirmeya chayeshinan levet din toin
Rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer mekushshar vechu heshiv rabbi ledivre rabbi chanina ben gamliel
b: Vahalo eno dome zemanno shel ze lizmanno shel ze pashut malach shana monin lo shana shettayim monin lo shettayim mekushshar malach shana monin lo shettayim shettayim monin lo shalosh
Vezimnin deyazef mineh zuze bimkushshar umitreme leh zuze bene bene ufara leh veamar leh hav li shetaray veamar leh irchas li vechatev leh tevara
Vechi mate zimneh meshave leh pashut veamar leh hane hashta dizafte minay
Ka savar en kotvin shovar

Umi baki rabbi bimkushshar veha hahu mekushshar daata lekammeh derabbi veamar rabbi shetar meuchar ze veamar lo zunin lerabbi kach minhagah shel umma zo malach shana monin lo shettayim shettayim monin lo shalosh
Batar deshamah mizzunin savrah
Hahu shetara dahava ketiv beh bishnat peloni archan amar rabbi chanina yivdok ematay amad archan bearchanuteh
Vedilma daarich malchuteh amar rav hoshaya kach minhagah shel umma zo shana rishona korin lo archan sheniyya korin lo digon
Vedilma abbore abberuhu vahadar okmuhu amar rabbi yirmeya hahu archan digon karu leh
Tanu rabbanan hareni nazir hena somchos amar hena achat digon shettayim terigon shalosh tetrigon arba pentigon chamesh
Tanu rabbanan bayit agol digon terigon pentigon eno mittamme bingaim tetrigon mittamme bingaim
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan lemala omer kirkirot shettayim lematta omer kirkirot shettayim hare kan arba

Hahu mekushshar daata lekammeh derabbi veamar rabbi en zeman bazze amar leh rabbi shimon bar rabbi lerabbi shemma ben kesharav muvla palyeh vechazyeh hadar chaza beh rabbi bevishut amar leh lav ana ketavteh rabbi yehuda chayyata katveh amar leh kelach millashon hara hazze
Zimnin hava yatev kammeh veka fasek sidra besefer tehillim amar rabbi kamma meushshar ketav ze amar leh lav ana ketavteh yehuda chayyata katveh amar leh kelach millashon hara hazze
Bishlama hatam ika lashon hara ella hacha may lashon hara ika mishshum derav dimi detane rav dimi achuh derav safra leolam al yesapper adam betovato shel chavero shemmittoch tovato ba lide raato
Amar rav amram amar rav shalosh averot en adam nitzol mehen bechol yom hirhur avera veiyyun tefilla velashon hara lashon hara salka datach

a: Ella avak lashon hara
Amar rav yehuda amar rav rov begazel umiut baaraot vehakkol belashon hara belashon hara salka datach ella avak lashon hara
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hakkol keminhag hammedina vetanna kamma let leh minhag medina
Amar rav ashe beatra dinhigi pashut vaamar leh aved li pashut vaazal avad leh mekushshar kefeda nehigi mekushshar vaamar leh aved li mekushshar vaazal avad leh pashut kefeda
Ki peligi beatra dinhigi befashut umkushshar vaamar leh aved li pashut vaazal avad leh mekushshar mar savar kefeda umar savar mare makom hu lo
Amar abbaye rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi shimon verabbi elazar kullehu sevira lehu mare makom hu lo
Rabban shimon ben gamliel ha daamaran rabbi shimon ditnan
Rabbi shimon omer im hitah leshevach hare zo mekuddeshet
Rabbi elazar ditnan haishsha sheamra hitkabbel li giti mimmakom peloni vekiblo lah mimmakom acher pasul verabbi elazar machshir mar savar kefeda umar savar mare makom hu lo

Pashut shekkatuv bo ed echad ku bishlama mekushshar shekkatuv bo shene edim pasul itzterich salka datach amena hoil uvalma kasher hacha name kasher ka mashma lan defasul ella pashut shekkatuv bo ed echad peshita
Amar abbaye la nitzrecha daafilu ed echad bichtav veed echad befe
Ammemar achshar beed echad bichtav veed echad al pe amar leh rav ashe leammemar veha deabbaye may amar leh la shemia li kelomar la sevira li
Ella kashya
b: Matnitin
Ha ka mashma lan dishnayim bimkushshar keed echad befashut ma hatam pesula deorayeta af hacha name pesula deorayeta
Tidda dishlachu mittam chavrayya lerabbi yirmeya
Ed echad bichtav veed echad al pe mahu sheyyitztarfu

Alliba detanna kamma derabbi yehoshua ben korcha la tibe lach daafilu shenayim bichtav ushnayim al pe la mitztarfi ella ki tibe lach alliba derabbi yehoshua ben korcha shenayim bichtav ushnayim al pe hu demitztarfi aval ed echad bichtav veechad al pe la metzarfinan o dilma la shena
Shelach lehu ani eni keday sheshshelachtem li ella kach daat talmidchem nota sheyyitztarfu
Amar leh anan hachi matnenan lah dishlachu leh chavrayya lerabbi yirmeya shenayim sheheidu echad bevet din ze veechad bevet din ze mahu sheyyavou bet din etzel bet din veyitztarfu

Alliba detanna kamma derabbi natan la tibe lach daafilu bechad bet dina name la mitztarfi ella ki tibe lach alliba derabbi natan bechad be dina hu demitztarfi aval bitre be dina la mitztarfi o dilma la shena
Ushlach lehu ani eni keday sheattem shelachtem li ella kach daat talmidchem note sheyyitztarfu
Mar bar chiyya amar hachi shelachu leh shenayim sheheidu bevet din ze vechazru veheidu bevet din ze mahu sheyyavo echad mikkol bet din veyitztarfu
Alliba derabbi natan la tibe lach hashta edim metzarfinan dayyane mibaya ella ki tibe lach alliba detanna kamma derabbi natan edim hu dela metzarfinan aval dayyane metzarfinan o dilma la shena
Shelach lehu ani eni keday sheattem shelachtem li ella kach daat talmidchem note sheyyitztarfu
Ravina amar hachi shelachu leh shelosha sheyyashvu lekayyem et hashshetar umet echad mehen tzerichi lemichtav bemotav telata havena vechad letohi o la
Shelach lehu ani eni keday sheattem shelachtem li ella kach daat talmidchem note shetztzerichin lemichtav bemotav telata havena vechad letohi
Veal da ayeluhu lerabbi yirmeya beve midresha
Matni katuv bo zuzin mea deinun silin esrin en lo ella esrin zuzin mea deinun telatin silin en lo ella mane
Kesaf zuzin deinun venimchak en pachot mishshettayim kesaf silin deinun venimchak en pachot mishshettayim darkonot deinun venimchak en pachot mishshettayim
Katuv bo millemala mane umillematta matayim millemala matayim umillematta mane hakkol holech achar hattachton im ken lama kotvin et haelon sheim timmachek ot achat min hattachton yilmad min haelon
Gema tanu rabbanan amar kesef en pachot middinar kesef kesef dinarin vedinarin kesef en pachot mishshene dinarin kesef kesef bedinarin en pachot mibbishne dinarin dehav kesef
Amar mar kesef en pachot middinar kesef veema nesacha amar rabbi elazar dechatuv beh matbea veema perite amar rav pappa beatra dela sage perite dechaspa
Tanu rabbanan dehav en pachot middinar dehav dehav dinarin vedinarin dehav en pachot mishshene dinarin dehav dehav bedinarin en pachot mibbishne dinarin kesef dehav
Amar mar dehav en pachot middinar dehav ema nesacha amar rabbi elazar dichtav matbea

a: Veema perite perite dedahava la avdi inashe
Zahav bedinarin en pachot mibbishne dinarin kesef zahav veema dahava pericha bitre dinare dahava kaamar amar abbaye yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona
Resha dekatane kesef bedinarin en pachot mishshene dinarin zahav kesef ammay ema kaspa nesacha bitre dinare kaspa kaamar
Amar rav ashe resha dichtav dinare sefa dichtav dinarin
Umna temra deshane ben dinare ledinarin

Detanya haishsha shehau aleha sefek chamesh ledot sefek chamesh zivot mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim veen hashshear aleha chova hau aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot chamesh zivot vaddaot mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim vehashshear aleha chova

Maase veamdu kinim birushalayim bedinre zahav amar rabban shimon ben gamliel hammaon hazze im alin hallayela ad sheyehu bedinarin nichnas levet din velimed haishsha shehau aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot chamesh zivot vaddaot mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim veen hashshear aleha chova
b: Veamdu kinin bo bayyom berivatayim
Katuv millemala vechu tanu rabbanan yilmad hattachton min haelon beot achat aval lo bishte otiyyot
Kegon chanan mechanani veanan meanani
May shena shette otiyyot dela dilma mitreme shem ben arba otiyyot vehave leh palgeh dishma i hachi ot achat name dilma mitreme shem ben shette otiyyot vehave leh palgeh dishma
Ella shette otiyyot hayenu tama dilma mitreme shem ben shalosh otiyyot vehave leh rubba dishma
Amar rav pappa peshita li sefel millemala vekefel millematta hakkol holech achar hattachton
Bae rav pappa kefel millemala vesefel millematta may mi chayeshinan lizvuv o la teku
Hahu dahava ketiv beh shet mea vezuza shalcheh rav sherevya kammeh deabbaye shet mea istere vezuza o dilma shet mea perite vezuza amar leh dal perite dela katvi bishtara daasoche maskan lehu

a: Umshave lehu zuzi may amratte shet mea istere vezuza shet mea zuze vechad zuza yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona

Amar abbaye hay man devae lemachve chatimut yedeh beve dina la lachve besof megilta dilma mashkach lah acher vechatev demassek beh zuzi utnan hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyav lo gove minnechasim bene chorin

Hahu bazbana daata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh nachze li mar chatimut yedeh dechi atu rabbanan machu li meabbarna lehu bela michsa achvi leh beresh megilta hava ka naged beh amar leh kevar kadmucha rabbanan
Amar abbaye mittelat vead asar la lichtov besof shita dilma mezayyef vechatev vei itremi leh nahdereh ledibbureh teren telata zimne i efshar dela mitreme leh beemtza shita
Hahu dahava ketiv beh tilta befardesa azal machkeh legaggeh devet vechareh veshavveyeh ufardesa ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh may tama reviach leh alma lehay vav kafteh veodi

Hahu dahava ketiv beh menat reuven veshimon ache hava lehu acha dishmeh achay azal ketav beh vav veshavveyeh veachay ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh may tama dechik leh alma lehay vav kulle hay kafteh veodi

Hahu shetara dahava chatim aleh rava verav acha bar adda ata lekammeh derava amar leh den chatimut yeda didi hi mihu kammeh derav acha bar adda la chatimi li meolam kafteh veodi amar leh bishlama didi zayyefte ella derav acha bar adda deratet yedeh hechi avadte amar annachi yeday ammitzra veamri lah kam azzarnuka uchtav
Matni kotvin get laish af al pi sheen ishto immo vehashshovar laishsha af al pi sheen balah immah uvilvad sheyehe makkiran vehabbaal noten sachar
b: Kotvin shetar lallove af al pi sheen malve immo veen kotvin lammalve ad sheyehe love immo vehallove noten sachar
Kotvin shetar lammocher af al pi sheen lokeach immo veen kotvin lallokeach ad sheyehe mocher immo vehallokeach noten sachar
En kotvin shetare erusin venissuin ella middaat shenehem vehechatan noten sachar
En kotvin shetar arisut vekabbelanut ella middaat shenehem vehamkabbel noten sachar
En kotvin shetare berurin vechol maase bet din ella middaat shenehem ushnehem notnin sachar rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lishnehem kotvin shenayim laze leatzmo velaze leatzmo
Gema may uvilvad sheyehe makkiran amar rav yehuda amar rav uvilvad sheyehe makkir shem haish bagget veshem haishsha bashshovar
Yatev rav safra verav acha bar huna verav huna bar chinana veyatev abbaye gabbayehu veyatvi vekamibaya lehu shem haish bagget in shem haishsha la shem haishsha bashshovar in shem haish la
Velechush dilma katev gita veazel umamte leh leitteh dehayech
Vezimnin azla katva ishsha shovar veyahava legavra delav dilah
Amar lehu abbaye hachi amar rav shem haish bagget vehu haddin leshem haishsha shem haishsha bashshovar vehu haddin leshem haish

Velechush lishne yosef ben shimon haddarim beir achat dilma katev gita veazel umamte leh leitteh dehayech amar lehu rav acha bar huna hachi amar rav shene yosef ben shimon haddarim beir achat en megarshin neshotehen ella ze bifne ze
Velechush dilma azel lemata achrita umachzek leh lishmeh beosef ben shimon vechatev gita umamte leh leitteh dehayech
Amar lehu rav huna bar chinana hachi amar rav kol shehuchzak shemo bair sheloshim yom en choshshin lo
La itachzak may amar abbaye dekaru leh veane rav zevid amar rammaa berammauteh zehir
Hahu tevara dahava chatim alah rav yirmeya bar abba atya lekammeh hahi itta amara leh lav ana havay amar ana name amari lehu lav ihi hi vaamaru li mikash hu dekashsha lah uvgar lah kala
Amar abbaye af al gav daamur rabbanan

a: Kevan shehiggid shuv eno chozer umaggid tzurba merabbanan lav orcheh lemedak
Hahu tevara dahava chatim aleh rav yirmeya bar abba amara leh lav ana havay amar lah ivra ante havit amar abbaye af al gav detzurba merabbanan lav orcheh lemedak kevan dedak dak
Amar abbaye hay tzurba merabbanan deazel lekaddoshe itta nidbar am haaretz bahadeh dilma mechallefu lah mineh
Vehabbaal noten sachar vechu may tama deamar kera vechatav venatan vehaidana dela avdinan hachi shaduhu rabbanan aishsha ki hechi dela leshahayeh
Kotvin shetar lallove af al pi sheen malve immo vechu peshita la tzericha beiska
Kotvin shetar lammocher af al pi sheen lokeach vechu peshita la tzericha bemocher sadehu mippene raatah
En kotvin shetare erusin vechu peshita la tzericha daafilu tzurba merabbanan denicha leh lachamuh lekaroveh
En kotvin shetar arisut vekabbelanut vechu peshita la tzericha bevura
En kotvin shetare verurin ella middaat shenehem vechu may shetare verurin hacha targimu shetare taanata rav yirmeya bar abba amar ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lishnehem kotvin shenayim leze beatzmo ulze beatzmo lema bechofin al middat sedom ka mipalgi
Demar savar kofin umar savar en kofin
La dechulle alma kofin vehacha hayenu tama derabban shimon ben gamliel daamar leh la nicha li detehve zechutach gabbe zechuti dedamet alay ki arya arva
Matni mi sheppara miktzat chovo vehishlish et shetaro veamar lo im lo natatti lecha mikkan vead yom peloni ten lo shetaro higgia zeman velo natan rabbi yose omer yitten rabbi yehuda omer lo yitten
Gema bemay kamipalgi rabbi yose savar asmachta kanya verabbi yehuda savar asmachta la kanya

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav halacha kerabbi yose ki ato lekammeh derabbi amme amar lehu vechi meachar sherabbi yochanan melammedenu paam rishona ushniyya halacha kerabbi yose ani ma eese
Veen halacha kerabbi yose
Matni mi shennimchak shetar chovo maamid alav edim uva lifne bet din veosin lo kiyyum ish peloni ben peloni nimchak shetaro beom peloni
b: Ufloni ufloni edav

Gema tanu rabbanan ezehu kiyyumo bemotav telata havena anu peloni ufloni ufloni hotzi peloni ben peloni shetar machuk lefanenu beom peloni ufloni ufloni edav veim katuv bo huzkaknu leedutan shel edim venimtzet edutan mechuvenet gove veeno tzarich lehavi reaya veim lav tzarich lehavi reaya
Nikra pasul nitkara kasher nimchak o nittashtesh im rishumo nikar kasher
Hechi dame nikra hechi dame nitkara amar rav yehuda nikra kera shel bet din nitkara kera sheeno shel bet din
Hechi dame kera shel bet din amar rav yehuda mekom edim umkom hazzeman umkom hattoref abbaye amar sheti vaerev
Hanhu arvae daato lefumbedita dahao ka ansi arata deinashe ato maraotayehu lekammeh deabbaye amaru leh lichze mar shetarin velichtov lan mar shetara acharina aleh dei mitnis chad nekitinan chad bidan
Amar lehu may eeved lechu deamar rav safra en kotvin shene shetarot al sade achat dilma taref vahadar taref
Hao ka tardi leh amar leh lesafreh zil ketov lehu hu al hammechak veedav al hanneyar defasul
Amar leh rav acha bar minome leabbaye vedilma rishumo nikar vetanya nimchak o nittashtesh im rishumo nikar kasher amar leh mi kaamena shetara mealleya alef bet bealma kaamena

Tanu rabbanan hare shebba veamar avad shetar chovi af al pi sheamru edim anu katavnu vechatamnu venatannu lo en kotvin lo et hashshetar bamme devarim amurim beshitre halvaa aval shitre mikkach umimkar kotvin chutz min haachraut shebbo

a: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af shitre mikkach umimkar en kotvin vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hannoten mattana lachavero vehechzir lo et hashshetar chazra mattenato vachachamim omrim mattenato kayyemet
Amar mar chutz meachraut shebbo may tama

Amar rav safra lefi sheen kotvin shene shetarot al sade achat dilma azel baal chov taref leh lehay veazel hay umappek chad vetaref lakochot veamar leh levaal chov shuf li deekum bah vahadar ta tirfan umappek acharina vahadar azel taref lakochot acharine
Vechevan dikraneh lishtara demalve bemay hadar taref lah

Vechi tema dela keraneh veha amar rav nachman kol tirfa dela ketiv beh keraneh lishtara demalve lav tirfa hu vechol adrachta dela ketiv bah keraneh letirfa lav adrachta hi vechol shuma dela ketiv bah keraneh leadrachta lav shuma hi
La tzericha dekaate mikkoach avahateh
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina ulma leh lememar leh levaal chov shuf li behay ara veekum bah tipok leh dechevan denaket tere shetare taref vahadar taref
Im ken nefishi aleh baale dinin
Velichtov lehay shetara mealleya velichtov tevara lemocher kol shetare deyippekun al ara da pesulin levar min deyippok bezimna da
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa veamri lah kammeh derav ashe zot omeret en kotvin shovar
b: Amar lehu bealma kotvin shovar vehacha hayenu tama dedilma azel baal chov vetaref mineh delokeach veazel ihu vetaref lakochot veshovar gabbe lakochot leka
Sof sof lakochot lav ammare deara hadri
Addehachi vehachi shamet veachel pere
I name lelokeach shello beachraut
I hachi shetare halvaa name
Hatam dezuze massek amri payeseh baal chov bezuze hacha deara massek mida yadi deman demassek ara bezuze la mippayyas
Amar mar chutz min haachraut shebbo hechi katvinan amar rav nachman dechatvi hachi shetara denan dela lemigbe beh la mimmeshabedi vela mibbene chare ella ki hechi detekum ara bideh delokeach
Amar rafram zot omeret achraut taut sofer hu tama dichtav leh hachi ha la ketav leh hachi gave
Rav ashe amar achraut lav taut sofer hu umay chutz meachraut shebbo dela ketiv beh achraut
Hahi itta dihava leh zuze lehahu gavra lemizban lah ara azal zevan lah shello beachraut atya lekammeh derav nachman
Amar leh letakkone shaddartacha vela leauote zil zivnah mineh shello beachraut vahadar zabbenah nihalah beachraut

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hannoten mattana lachavero vehechzir lo et hashshetar chazra mattenato vachachamim omrim mattenato kayyemet may tama derabban shimon ben gamliel amar rav assi naasa keomer lo sade zo netuna lecha kol zeman shehashshetar beyadcha
Matkef lah rabba i hachi nignav o avad name
Ella amar rabba beotiyyot niknot bimsira kamipalgi rabban shimon ben gamliel savar otiyyot niknot bimsira verabbanan savri en otiyyot niknot bimsira
Tanu rabbanan habba lidon bishtar uvachazaka nidon bishtar divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer bachazaka
Bemay kamipalgi ki ata rav dimi amar beotiyyot niknot bimsira ka mipalgi

a: Rabban shimon ben gamliel savar en otiyyot niknot bimsira verabbi savar otiyyot niknot bimsira
Amar leh abbaye im ken pelugta lidmar amar leh vetiflog
Amar leh hachi kaamena lach matnita la mitartza ella kedimtartza mar veim ken kashya derabban shimon ben gamliel adderabban shimon ben gamliel
Ella amar abbaye hacha bemay askinan kegon shennimtza echad mehen karov o pasul
Uviflugta derabbi meir verabbi elazar ka mipalgi rabbi savar lah kerabbi elazar deamar ede mesira karti
Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar lah kerabbi meir deamar ede chatima karti
Veha amar rabbi abba mode haya rabbi elazar bimzuyyaf mittocho shehu pasul

Ella amar rabbi avina hakkol modim sheim katuv bo huzkaknu leedutan shel edim venimtzet edutan mezuyyefet shehu pasul kidrabbi abba lo nechleku ella bishtar sheen alav edim kelal derabbi savar lah kerabbi elazar deamar ede mesira karti verabban shimon ben gamliel savar lah kerabbi meir deamar ede chatima karti
Veibaet ema bemode bashshetar shekketavo tzarich lekayemo ka mipalgi
Derabbi savar mode bishtar shekketavo en tzarich lekayemo verabban shimon ben gamliel savar tzarich lekayemo

Veha ipcha shaminan lehu detanya shenayim adukin bishtar malve omer shelli hu venafal mimmenni umtzato velove omer shellecha hu ufrativ lach yitkayyem hashshetar bechotmav divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer yachloku

Vehavenan bah velet leh lerabbi ha ditnan shenayim ochazin betallit ze omer ani metzatiha veze omer ani metzatiha ze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah veze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah veyachloku

Veamar rava amar rav nachman bimkuyyam dechulle alma la peligi deyachaloku ki peligi besheeno mekuyyam rabbi savar mode bishtar shekketavo tzarich lekayemo vei mekayyem leh gave palga vei la chaspa bealma hu
Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar mode bishtar shekketavo en tzarich lekayemo veyachloku
Efoch
Veibaet ema leolam la tefoch ella hacha bilvarer kamipalgi

Ki ha derav yitzchak bar yosef hava massek beh zuze berabbi abba ata lekammeh derabbi yitzchak nappacha amar peraticha bifne peloni ufloni amar leh rabbi yitzchak yavou peloni ufloni veyaidu amar leh i la atu la mehemnina veha kayema lan hammalve et chavero beedim eno tzarich leforo beedim

Amar leh ana behahi kishmata demar sevira li deamar rabbi abba amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav haomer lachavero peraticha bifne peloni ufloni tzarich sheyyavou peloni ufloni veyaidu amar leh veha amar rav gidel amar rav halacha kedivre rabban shimon ben gamliel veaf rabbi lo
b: Amar ella levarer amar leh ana name levarer kaamena

Matni mi sheppara miktzat chovo rabbi yehuda omer yachlif rabbi yose omer yichtov shovar amar rabbi yehuda nimtza ze tzarich lihot shomer shovaro min haachbarim amar lo rabbi yose kach yafe lo velo yera kocho shel ze
Gema amar rav huna amar rav en halacha lo kerabbi yehuda velo kerabbi yose ella bet din mekarin hashshetar vechotvin lo shetar acher mizzeman rishon
Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna veamri lah rav yirmeya bar abba lerav huna i shemia leh lerav ha barayeta detanya edim mekarin et hashshetar vechotvin lo shetar acher mizzeman rishon hava hadar beh
Amar leh shemia leh vela hadar beh

a: Bishlama be dina allime leafkoe mamona ella edim sheasu shelichutan chozrin veosin shelichutan
Vela veha amar rav yehuda amar rav edim kotvin afilu asara shetarot al sade achat
Rav yosef amar bishtar mattana
Verabba amar bishtar sheen bo achraut

May barayeta detanya hare shehau noshin bo elef zuz ufara mehen chamesh meot zuz edim mekarin et hashshetar vechotvin lo shetar acher mizzeman rishon divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer shetar ze yehe munnach bimkomo veyichtevu shovar
Umippene shene devarim amru kotvin shovar achat kede sheyyachof leforo veachat kede sheyyigbe mizzeman rishon
Veha rabbi yehuda name mizzeman rishon kaamar hachi kaamar leh rabbi yose lerabbi yehuda i mizzeman rishon kaamratte peligna alach bachada i mizzeman sheni kaamratte peligna alach betarte

Tanu rabbanan shetar shezzemanno katuv beshabbat o baasara betishri shetar meuchar hu vechasher divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose posel amar lo rabbi yehuda vahalo maase ba lefanecha betzippori vehichsharta amar lo keshehichsharti baze hichsharti
Veha rabbi yehuda name baze kaamar
Amar rabbi pedat hakkol modim sheim huzkaknu leonato shel shetar venimtzet onato mechuvenet beshabbat o baasara betishri sheshshetar meuchar hu vechasher
b: Lo nechleku ella bishtar meuchar bealma
Derabbi yehuda letameh deamar en kotvin shovar vela nafek mineh churba
Verabbi yose letameh deamar kotvin shovar venafek mineh churba
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua afilu leman deamar kotvin shovar hane mile appalga aval akkulleh la
Vela hi afilu akkulleh katvinan

Ki ha derav yitzchak bar yosef hava massek beh zuzi berabbi abba ata lekammeh derabbi chanina bar pappe amar leh hav li zuzay amar leh hav li shetaray ushkol zuzach amar leh shetarach irchas li echtov lach tevara amar leh ha rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu en kotvin shovar
Amar man yahev lan meafreh derav ushmuel raminan beayenin ha rabbi yochanan veha resh lakish deamri tarvayehu kotvin shovar
Vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi ila kotvin shovar
Umistabbera dechotvin shovar dei salka data en kotvin shovar avad shetaro shel ze yochal halla vechade
Matkef lah abbaye veella may kotvin shovar avad shovaro shel ze yochal halla vechade amar leh rava in eved love leish malve
Tenan hatam shitre chov hammukdamin pesulin vehamucharin kesherin

Amar rav hamnuna lo shanu ella shetare halvaa aval shetare mikkach umimkar afilu meucharin name pesulin may tama zimnin dimzabben leh ara benisan vechatev leh betishri umitreme leh zuze bene bene vezaven lah mineh vechi mate tishri mappek leh veamar leh hadar zeventah minach

I hachi shetare halvaa name zimnin deyazef benisan uchtiv leh shetara betishri umitreme leh zuze bene bene ufara leh veamar leh hav li shetaray veamar leh irchas li vechatev leh tevara vechi mate zimneh mappek leh vaamar leh hane hashta hu dizafte minay
Kasavar en kotvin shovar

Amar leh rav yemar lerav kahana veamri lah rav yirmeya middifti lerav kahana vehaidana dechatvinan shetare meuchare vechatvinan tevara ammay kaavdinan hachi amar leh batar daamar lehu rabbi abba lesafreh ki katvitu shetare meuchare ketuvu hachi shetara denan la bezimneh ketavneh ella acharnohi uchtavnohi
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana vehaidana dela ka avdinan hachi batar daamar leh rav safra lesafreh ki katvitu hane tevare i yaditu zimna dishtara ketuvu i la ketuvu setama dechol emat denafek lareh
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe veamri lah rav ashe lerav kahana

a: Veha haidana dela kaavdinan hachi amar leh rabbanan takkone takkinu man deaved aved man dela aved ihu hu deafsed annafsheh
Amar lehu rava bar rav shela lehanhu katve shetare akneyata ki katvitu shetare akneyata i yaditu yoma diknetu beh ketuvu vei la ketuvu yoma dekayemitu beh ki hechi dela mitchaze keshikra

Amar lehu rav lesafreh vechen amar lehu rav huna lesafreh ki kayemitu beshile ketuvu beshile veaf al gav dimsiran lechu mile behine ki kayemitu behine ketuvu behine veaf al gav dimsiran lechu mile beshile
Amar rava hay man dinkit shetara bar mea zuze veamar shavveyuh nihali tere bene chamshin chamshin la meshavenan lehu
May tama avadu rabbanan milta denicha leh lemalve venicha leh lelove nicha leh lemalve kede sheyyachof leforo venicha lelove ki hechi denifgom shetareh
Veamar rava hay man dinkit tere shetare bene chamshin chamshin veamar shavinhu nihali chad bar mea la meshavenan leh
Avud rabbanan milta denicha leh lemalve venicha leh lelove nicha leh lemalve ki hechi dela nifgom shetareh venicha leh lelove kede shello yachof leforo
Amar rav ashe hay man dinkit shetara bar mea zuze veamar shauonhi nihali chad bar chamshin la meshavena leh
May tama amrinan hay mifra pareh vaamar leh hav li shetaray vaamar leh irchas li uchtav leh tevara umappek leh hay veamar leh hay acharina hu

Matni shene achin echad ani veechad ashir vehinniach lahen avihen merchatz uvet habbad asaan lesachar hassachar laemtza asaan leatzmo hare heashir omer leani kach lecha avadim veyirchatzu bammerchatz kach lecha zetim uvo vaase bevet habbad
Shenayim shehau beir achat shem echad yosef ben shimon veshem acher yosef ben shimon en yecholin lehotzi shetar chov ze al ze velo acher yachol lehotzi alehen shetar chov
Nimtza leechad ben shetarotav shetaro shel yosef ben shimon parua shetarot shenehen peruin
Ketzad yaasu yeshalleshu veim hau meshullashin yichtevu siman veim hau mesummanin yichtevu kohen
Gema hahu shetara dinfak leve dina derav huna dahava ketiv beh ani peloni bar peloni laviti mane mimmecha
b: Amar rav huna mimmecha afilu meresh galuta vaafilu mishshabbur malka
Amar leh rav chisda lerabba pok ayyen bah dilurta bae lah rav huna minach
Nefak dak veashkach detanya get sheyyesh alav edim veen bo zeman abba shaul omer im katuv bo gerashtiha hayyom kasher
Alma hayyom hahu yoma denafek beh mashma hacha name mimmecha mehahu gavra denafek mittute yedeh mashma
Amar leh abbaye vedilma abba shaul kerabbi eliezer sevira leh deamar ede mesira karti aval hacha lechush linfila
Amar leh linfila la chayeshinan umna temra dela chayeshinan linfila

Ditnan shenayim shehau beir achat shem echad yosef ben shimon veshem acher yosef ben shimon enan yecholin lehotzi shetar chov ze al ze velo acher yachol lehotzi alehen shetar chov ha hem al acherim yecholin veammay lechush linfila ella lav shema minah linfila la chayeshinan
Veabbaye linfila dechad la chayeshinan linfila derabbim chayeshinan

a: Veella ha detanya keshem sheen motziin shetar chov ze al ze kach en motziin al acherim bemay kamipalgi
Beotiyyot niknot bimsira kamipalgi
Tanna didan savar otiyyot niknot bimsira vetanna bara savar en otiyyot niknot bimsira
Vei baet ema dechulle alma otiyyot niknot bimsira vehacha betzarich lehavi reaya ka mipalgi tanna didan savar en tzarich lehavi reaya vetanna bara savar tzarich lehavi reaya
Deitmar otiyyot niknot bimsira abbaye amar tzarich lehavi reaya verava amar eno tzarich lehavi reaya
Amar abbaye mena amena lah detanya echad min haachin shehashshetar chov yotze mittachat yado alav lehavi reaya may lav hu haddin leachrine
Verava amar shane achin deshamtu mehadade
Ika deamri amar rava mena amena lah detanya echad min haachin shehashshetar chov yotze mittachat yado alav lehavi reaya achin hu deshamtu mehadade aval achrine la
Veabbaye achin itztericha leh salka datach amena kevan deshamtu mehadade ema mizdehar zehiri vela tzerichi lehavi reaya kamashma lan
Veella ha detanya keshem shemmotziin hen shetar chov al acherim kach motziin ze al ze bemay kamipalgi
Bechotvin shetar lallove veaf al pi sheen malve immo kamipalgi

Tanna didan savar kotvin shetar lallove veaf al pi sheen malve immo zimnin deazel legabbe safra vesahade veamar lehu ketuvu li shetara devaenan lemezaf miyyosef ben shimon chavray uvatar dechatvi vechatmi leh naketo leh veamar leh hav li mea dizafte minay
Tanna bara savar en kotvin shetar lallove ad sheyehe malve immo
Nimtza leechad ben shetarotav shetaro shel yosef ben shimon parua shetarot shenehem peruin vechu tama denimtza ha lo nimtza matze mappek vehaanan velo acher yachol lehotzi alehen shetar chov tenan
Amar rabbi yirmeya bimshullashin
Venecheze tevara bishma deman dichtiv amar rav hoshaya bimshullashin bashshetar veen meshullashin bashshovar
Abbaye amar hachi kaamar nimtza lallove ben shetarotav shetaro shel yosef ben shimon alay parua shetarot shenehem peruin
Ketzad yaasu yeshalleshu ku tana im hau shenehem kohanim yichtevu dorot
Matni haomer livno shetar ben shetarotay parua veeni yodea e zehu shetarot kullan peruin nimtza leechad sham shenayim haggadol parua vehakkatan eno parua
Gema amar rava shetar lecha beyadi parua haggadol parua vehakkatan eno parua chov lecha beyadi parua shetarot kullan peruin
Amar leh ravina lerava ella meatta sadi mechura lach sade gedola mechura lo sade sheyyesh li mechura lach kol sedotav mechurin lo
Hatam yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona
Matni hammalve et chavero al yede arev lo yippara min hearev
b: Veim amar lo al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze yippara min hearev rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im yesh nechasim lallove ben kach uven kach lo yippara min hearev
Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hearev leishsha bichtubbatah vehaya balah megarshah yaddirenna hanaa shemma yaasu kenunya al nechasim shel ze veyachzir et ishto
Gema may tama rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu gavra ashlemte li gavra ashlemi lach
Matkef lah rav nachman hay dina defarsae
Adderabba batar arva azli
Ella be dina defarsae dela yahavi tama lemiltayehu
Ella amar rav nachman may lo yippara min hearev lo yitba arev techilla
Tanya name hachi hammalve et chavero al yede arev lo yitba arev techilla veim amar al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze yitba arev techilla
Amar rav huna minnayin learev demishtabed dichtiv anochi eervennu miyyadi tevakshennu
Matkef lah rav chisda ha kabbelanut hi dichtiv tena oto al yadi vaani ashivennu
Ella amar rabbi yitzchak mehacha lekach bigdo ki arav zar uvad nochriyya chavlehu

Veomer beni im aravta lereecha takata lazzar kappecha nokashta veimre ficha nilkadta beimre ficha ase zot efo beni vehinnatzel ki vata vechaf reecha lech hitrappes urhav reecha im mamon yesh lo beyadecha hatter lo pisat yad veim lav harbe alav reim
Amar ammemar arev demishtabad machloket rabbi yehuda verabbi yose lerabbi yose deamar asmachta kanya arev mishtabad lerabbi yehuda deamar asmachta la kanya arev la mishtabad
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar ha maasim bechol yom deasmachta la kanya vearev mishtabad
Ella amar rav ashe behahu hanaa deka meheman leh gamar umishtabad nafsheh
Veim amar al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze ku amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella sheen nechasim lallove aval yesh nechasim lallove lo yippara min hearev
Veha middekatane sefa rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im yesh nechasim lallove lo yippara min hearev mikkelal detanna kamma savar la shena hachi vela shena hachi

Chassore mechassera vehachi katane hammalve et chavero al yede arev lo yippara min hearev veim amar al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze yippara min hearev bamme devarim amurim besheen nechasim lallove aval yesh nechasim lallove lo yippara min hearev vekabbelan af al pi sheyyesh nechasim lallove yippara min hakkabbelan

Vela hi la miptar love mineh demalve ad sheyyissa veyitten bayyad
Hahu dayyana deachateh lemalve lenichse delove mikkamme delitbeeh lelove sallekeh rav chanin bereh derav yeva

Amar rav pappa periat baal chov mitzva veyatme lav bene mebad mitzva ninhu
Verav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar emar tzerare atpeseh
b: May benayehu
Ika benayehu keshechayyav mode i name deshammetuhu umit beshamteh
Shelachu mittam shammetuhu umit beshamteh hilcheta kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua
Metivi arev shehaya shetar chov yotze mittachat yado eno gove veim katuv bo hitkabbalti mimmecha gove
Bishlama lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua mashkachatte lah keshechayyav mode ella lerav pappa kashya
Shane hatam lehachi terach uchtav leh hitkabbalti

Hahu arva degoy defareh legoy mikkamme delitbeinhu leyatme amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hachi amar avimi mehagronya mishshemeh derava afilu leman deamar chayeshinan litzrare hane mile yisrael aval goy kevan devatar arva azel la chayeshinan litzrare
Amar leh adderabba afilu leman deamar la chayeshinan litzrare hane mile yisrael aval goyim kevan dedinayehu batar arva azli i lav deatpeseh tzerare meikara la hava mekabbel leh

Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hearev leishsha bichtubbatah vechu moshe bar atzri arva dichtubbetah dechallateh hava rav huna bereh tzurba midderabbanan hava udchika leh milta amar abbaye leka denezil denasseveh etza lerav huna dingarshah lidvethu vetezil vetigbe ketubba meavuh vahadar nahderah
Amar leh rava veha yaddirenna hanaa tenan amar leh abbaye attu kol dimgaresh beve dina megaresh
Lesof igallay milta dechohen hu amar abbaye hayenu deamri inashe batar anya azla anuta
Umi amar abbaye hachi veha amar abbaye ezehu rasha arum ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Beno shane vetzurba merabbanan shane
Veha arev hu vekayema lan arev dichtubba lo mishtabed kabbelan hava
Hanicha leman deamar kabbelan dichtubba af al gav delet leh nichse levaal mishtabad shappir ella leman deamar i it leh mishtabad i let leh la mishtabad may ika lememar
Ibaet ema mihve hava leh veishteduf veibaet ema abba legabbe bereh shabode meshabad nafsheh

Deitmar arev dichtubba divre hakkol la mishtabad kabbelan devaal chov divre hakkol mishtabad kabbelan dichtubba vearev devaal chov peligi mar savar i it leh nichse lelove mishtabad i let leh la mishtabad umar savar ben it leh uven let leh mishtabad
Vehilcheta arev ben it leh uven let leh mishtabad bar mearev dichtubba deaf al gav deit leh levaal la mishtabad may tama mitzva hu daavad velav mide chassereh
Amar rav huna shechiv mera shehikdish kol nechasav veamar mane lifloni beyadi neeman chazaka en adam ose kenunya al hekdesh

Matkef lah rav nachman vechi adam ose kenunya al banav derav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu shechiv mera sheamar mane lifloni beyadi amar tenu notnin lo amar tenu en notnin alma adam asuy shello lehasbia et banav

a: Hacha name adam asuy shello lehasbia et atzmo
Ki kaamar rav huna hatam denaket shetara
Mikkelal derav ushmuel dela naket shetara amar tenu notnin milve al pe hava verav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu milve al pe eno gove lo min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot
Ella amar rav nachman ide veide denaket shetara vela kashya ha dimkuyyam ha dela mekuyyam amar tenu kayemeh lishtareh lo amar tenu la kayemeh lishtareh
Amar rabba shechiv mera sheamar mane lifloni beyadi veamru yetomin paranu neemanin tenu mane lifloni veamru yetomin paranu en neemanin
Kelappe leya ipcha mistabbera amar tenu mane kevan defaskah avuhon lemilta ika lememar defareh mane lifloni beyadi kevan dela pesak avuhon lemilta ika lememar dela pareh

Ella i itmar hachi itmar shechiv mera sheamar mane lifloni beyadi veamru yetomin chazar veamar lanu abba parati neemanin may tama iddechore midchar tenu mane lifloni veamru yetomin chazar veamar abba parati en neemanin deim ita defareh la hava amar tenu
Bae rava shechiv mera shehoda mahu tzarich lomar attem eday o en tzarich lomar attem eday tzarich sheyyomar ketovu o en tzarich lomar ketovu adam meshatte bishat mita o en adam meshatte bishat mita
Batar devaya hadar pashtah en adam meshatte bishat mita vedivre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin damu
Matni hammalve et chavero bishtar gove minnechasim meshubadim al yede edim govin minnechasim bene chorin
b: Hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyav lo gove minnechasim bene chorin
Arev hayyotze leachar chitum shetarot gove minnechasim bene chorin
Maase uva lifne rabbi yishmael veamar gove minnechasim bene chorin amar lo ben nannas eno gove lo minnechasim meshubadim velo minnechasim bene chorin

Amar lo lamma amar lo hare hachonek et echad bashshuk umtzao chavero veamar lo hannach lo vaani etten lach patur shello al emunato hilvahu ella eze hu arev shehu chayyav halvehu vaani noten lach chayyav shekken al emunato hilvahu
Veamar rabbi yishmael harotze sheyyachkim yaasok bedine mamonot sheen lach miktzoa battora yoter mehen vehen kemayan hannovea veharotze sheyyaasok bedine mamonot yeshammesh et shimon ben nannas

Gema amar ulla devar tora echad milve bishtar veechad milve al pe gove minnechasim meshubadim may tama shibuda deorayeta veella ma taam amru milve al pe eno gove ella minnechasin bene chorin mishshum peseda delakochot
I hachi milve bishtar name hatam inhu ninhu deafsidu annafshayehu

Verabba amar devar tora echad milve bishtar veechad milve al pe eno gove ella minnechasim bene chorin may tama shibuda lav deorayeta uma taam amru milve bishtar gove minnechasim meshubadim kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin
I hachi milve al pe name hatam let leh kala
Umi amar rabba hachi veha amar rabba gavu karka yesh lo gavu maot en lo
Vechi tema efoch derabba leulla udulla lerabba veha amar ulla devar tora baal chov dineh bezibburit
Ella rabba tama divne mareva kaamar veleh la sevira leh
Rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu milve al pe eno gove lo min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot may tama shibuda lav deorayeta
Rabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish deamri tarvayehu milve al pe gove ben min hayyorshin uven min hallakochot may tama shibuda deorayeta
Metivi hachofer bor birshut harabbim venafal alav shor vaharago patur velo od ella sheim met hashshor yorshe baal habbor chayyavim leshallem deme shor livalav
Amar rabbi ila amar rav besheamad baddin
Veha harago katane amar rav adda bar ahava sheasao terefa
Veha amar rav nachman tane tanna met ukvaro hatam deyatvi dayyane appumma devera vechayevuhu

a: Amar rav pappa hilcheta milve al pe gove min hayyorshin veeno gove min hallakochot gove min hayyorshin kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin veeno gove min hallakochot delet leh kala

Rabbi elazar omer af al pi sheen alav edim ella shennetano lah bifne edim kasher vegove minnechasim meshubadim
Shane hatam demishsheat ketiva hu deshabad nafsheh
Arev hayyotze leachar chitum shetarot vechu amar rav kodem chitum shetarot gove minnechasim meshubadim leachar chitum shetarot gove minnechasim bene chorin
Zimnin amar rav afilu kodem chitum shetarot eno gove ella minnechasim bene chorin
Kashya derav adderav la kashya ha dichtiv beh peloni arev ha dichtiv beh ufloni arev
Verabbi yochanan amar echad ze veechad ze eno gove ella minnechasim bene chorin veaf al gav dichtiv beh ufloni arev
Metiv rava edim hachatumin al sheelat shalom beget pasul chayeshinan shemma al sheelat shalom chatmu
Veamar rabbi avahu ledidi miparsha leh mineh derabbi yochanan sheilu pasul ushilu kasher
Hacha name dichtiv peloni arev
I hachi hayenu derav ema vechen amar rabbi yochanan
Maase uva lifne rabbi yishmael vechu amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan af al pi shekkiles rabbi yishmael et ben nannas halacha kemoto
Ibaya lehu bechanuk ma li amar rabbi yishmael ta shema deamar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan chaluk haya rabbi yishmael af bechanuk
Halacha kemoto o en halacha kemoto ta shema dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan chaluk haya rabbi yishmael af bechanuk vahalacha kemoto af bechanuk
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel chanuk vekanu miyyado mishtabed mikkelal dearev bealma la bae kinyan ufliga derav nachman deamar rav nachman
b: Arev devet din hu dela bae kinyan ha bealma bae kinyan
Vehilcheta arev bishat mattan maot lo bae kinyan achar mattan maot bae kinyan arev devet din la bae kinyan divhahi hanaa dimheman leh gamar umshabed leh
Hadaran alach get pashut uslika lah massechet bava batra

a: Matni dine mamonot bishlosha gezelot vachavalot bishlosha nezek vachatzi nezek tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha bishlosha
Haones vehamfatte vehammotzi shem ra bishlosha divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim motzi shem ra beesrim ushlosha mippene sheyyesh bo dine nefashot
Makkot bishlosha mishshum rabbi yishmael amru beesrim ushlosha
Ibur hachodesh bishlosha ibur hashshana bishlosha divre rabbi meir rabban shimon ben gamliel omer bishlosha matchilin uvachamishsha nosin venotnin vegomrin beshiva veim gamru bishlosha meubberet
Semichat zekenim vaarifat egla bishlosha divre rabbi shimon rabbi yehuda omer bachamishsha hachalitza vehammeunin bishlosha
Neta revai umaaser sheni sheen damav yeduin bishlosha hahekdeshot bishlosha haarachin hammittaltelim bishlosha rabbi yehuda omer echad mehen kohen
Vehakkarkaot tisha vechohen veadam kayyotze bahen
Dine nefashot beesrim ushlosha harovea vehannirba beesrim ushlosha shenneemar veharagta et haishsha veet habbehema veomer veet habbehema taharogu

Shor hanniskal beesrim ushlosha shenneemar hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat kemitat bealim kach mitat hashshor hazzeev vehaari haddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash mitatan beesrim ushlosha rabbi eliezer omer kol hakkodem lehorgan zacha rabbi akiva omer mitatan beesrim ushlosha

En danin lo et hashshevet velo et nevi hashsheker velo et kohen gadol ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad veen motziin lemilchemet harshut ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad en mosifin al hair veal haazarot ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad en osin sanhedraot lashshevatim ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad
En osin ir hanniddachat ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad en osin ir hanniddachat bassefar velo shalosh aval osin achat o shettayim

Sanhedrin gedola hayeta shel shivim veechad uktanna shel esrim ushlosha minnayin laggedola shehi shel shivim veechad shenneemar esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael umoshe al gabbehen rabbi yehuda omer shivim
Uminnayin lakketanna shehi shel esrim ushlosha shenneemar veshaftu haeda vehitztzilu haeda eda shofetet veeda matztzelet hare kan esrim
Uminnayin leeda shehi asara shenneemar ad matay laeda haraa hazzot yatzu yehoshua vechalev

Uminnayin lehavi od shelosha mimmashma shenneemar lo tihye achare rabbim leraot shomea ani sheehye immahem letova im ken lamma neemar achare rabbim lehattot lo kehattayatcha letova hattayatcha leraa hattayatcha letova al pi echad hattayatcha leraa al pi shenayim
b: Veen bet din shakul mosifin alehem od echad hare kan esrim ushlosha
Vechamma yehe bair uthe reuya lesanhedrin mea veesrim rabbi nechemya omer matayim ushloshim keneged sare asarot
Gema attu gezelot vechabbalot lav dine mamonot ninhu amar rabbi avahu ma hen katane ma hen dine mamonot gezelot vechabbalot aval hodaot vehalvaot la

Utzricha dei tena dine mamonot hava amena daafilu hodaot vehalvaot tena gezelot vachavalot vei tena gezelot vachavalot vela katane dine mamonot hava amena hu haddin daafilu hodaot vehalvaot vehay dekatane gezelot vachavalot mishshum deikar shelosha dichtivi bigzelot vachavalot ketivi
Gezelot dichtiv venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim chavalot ma li chaval begufo ma li chaval bemamono tena ma hen dine mamonot gezelot vachavalot aval hodaot vehalvaot lo
Ulmay ilema dela baenan shelosha vehaamar rabbi avahu shenayim sheddanu dine mamonot ledivre hakkol en dinehem din
Ella dela baenan mumchin
May kasavar i kasavar eruv parashiyyot katuv kan live name mumchin vei kasavar en eruv parashiyyot katuv kan shelosha lema li

Leolam kasavar eruv parashiyyot katuv kan uvdin hu delive name mumchin vehay dela baenan mumchin mishshum derabbi chanina deamar rabbi chanina devar tora echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot bidrisha uvachakira

a: Shenneemar mishpat echad yihye lachem uma taam amru dine mamonot la baenan derisha vachakira kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin
Ella meatta tau lo yeshallemu kol shekken atta noel delet bifne lovin
I hachi tarte katane dine mamonot bishlosha hedotot gezelot vachavalot bishlosha mumchin
Veod shelosha shelosha lema li
Ella amar rava tarte katane mishshum derabbi chanina rav acha bereh derav ika amar middeorayeta chad name kasher shenneemar betzedek tishpot amitecha ella mishshum yoshve keranot
Attu bitlata mi la hau yoshve keranot i efshar delet behu chad digmir ella meatta tau lo yeshallemu kol shekken dinfishi yoshve keranot

May ika ben rava lerav acha bereh derav ika ika benayehu deamar shemuel shenayim sheddanu dinehen din ella shennikreu bet din chatzuf lerava let leh dishmuel lerav acha bereh derav ika it leh dishmuel
Nezek vachatzi nezek vechu nezek hayenu chavalot mishshum deka bae lemitne chatzi nezek tane name nezek shalem
Chatzi nezek name hayenu chavalot tena mamona vekatane kenasa
Hanicha leman deamar palga nizka kenasa ella leman deamar palga nizka mamona may ika lememar
Ella ayede deka bae lemitne tashlume kefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha demamon
b: Sheeno mishtallem berosh hu tena name chatzi nezek demamon sheeno mishtallem berosh hu veayede deka bae lemitne chatzi nezek tena name nezek
Shelosha menalan detanu rabbanan venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim hare kan echad ad haelohim yavo devar shenehem hare kan shenayim asher yarshiun elohim hare kan shelosha divre rabbi yoshiyya

Rabbi yonatan omer rishon techila neemar veen dorshin techilot ella ad haelohim yavo devar shenehem hare kan echad asher yarshiun elohim hare kan shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehen od echad hare kan shelosha

Nema bedorshin techilot kamipalgi demar savar dorshin techilot umar savar en dorshin techilot la dechulle alma en dorshin techilot amar lach rabbi yoshiyya im ken nema kera venikrav baal habbayit el hashshofet may el haelohim shema minah leminyana
Verabbi yonatan lishana dealma nekat kidamri inashe man deit leh dina likrav legabbe dayyana
Verabbi yoshiyya let leh bet din note vehatanya rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer ma talmud lomar lintot achare rabbim lehattot hattora amra ase lecha bet din note
Savar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar shivim ditnan sanhedri gedola hayeta shel shivim veechad rabbi yehuda omer shivim
Emar deshamatte leh lerabbi yehuda besanhedri gedola dichtivi kerae bishar be dina mi shamatte leh
Vechi tema la shena vehatnan semichat zekenim vaarifat egla bishlosha divre rabbi shimon rabbi yehuda omer bachamishsha
Veamrinan may tama derabbi yehuda vesamchu shenayim zikne shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehen od echad hare kan chamishsha

Derabbi yoshiyya adifa midderabbi yehuda deilu rabbi yehuda besanhedri gedola hu delet leh ha bishar be dina it leh verabbi yoshiyya bishar be dina name let leh veella hay lintot may aved leh mokem leh bedine nefashot
Aval bedine mamonot la ella ha ditnan shenayim omrim zakkay veechad omer chayyav zakkay shenayim omrim chayyav veechad omer zakkay chayyav nema dela kerabbi yoshiyya
Afilu tema rabbi yoshiyya mayete lah bekal vachomer middine nefashot uma dine nefashot dachamiri amar rachamana zil batar rubba dine mamonot lo kol shekken

Tanu rabbanan dine mamonot bishlosha rabbi omer bachamishsha kede sheyyiggamer haddin bishlosha attu bitlata mi la gamar dina bitre hachi kaamar mippene sheggemar din bishlosha alma kasavar telata ki ketivi bigmar dina ketivi

Megaddef bah rabbi avahu ella meatta tehe sanhedri gedola tzericha mea vearbaim veechad kede sheyyiggamer haddin beshivim veechad uthe sanhedri ketanna tzericha arbaim vachamishsha kede sheyyiggamer haddin bishlosha veesrim
Ella esfa li shivim ish amar rachamana mishsheat asifa shivim veshaftu haeda vehitztzilu haeda name mishsheat shefitat haeda hachi name venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim mishsheat keriva shelosha
Ella hayenu tama derabbi asher yarshiun elohim tere neemar elohim lematta veneemar elohim lemala ma lematta shenayim af lemala shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehem od echad hare kan chamishsha
