Ella dechulle alma yesh em lammikra verabbi verabbanan beha kamipalgi rabbi savar yarshiun elohim acharine verabbanan savri yarshiun dehayeche vehay
Verabbi yehuda ben roetz la peligi rabbanan aleh
Bet hillel detanya vechipper vechipper vechipper mippene haddin
Vahalo din hu neemar damim lematta veneemar damim lemala ma damim haamurim lematta shennetanan bemattana achat kiper af damim haamurim lemala shennetanan bemattana achat kiper
O kelach lederech zo neemar damim bachutz veneemar damim bifnim ma damim haamurim bifnim chiser achat mimmattanot lo asa velo kelum af damim haamurim bachutz chiser achat mimmattanot lo asa kelum
Nire lemi dome danin chutz michutz veen danin chutz mippenim
O kelach lederech zo danin chattat vearba keranot mechattat vearba keranot veal yochiach ze sheen chattat vearba keranot
Talmud lomar vechipper vechipper vechipper mippene haddin kiper af al pi shello natan ella shelosha kiper af al pi shello natan ella shettayim kiper af al pi shello natan ella achat
Verabbi shimon verabbanan beha peligi rabbi shimon savar sechacha la bae kera verabbanan savri sechacha bae kera
Verabbi akiva verabbanan beha peligi rabbi akiva savar nefashot tarte mashma verabbanan savri nefashot dealma mashma
Udchulle alma yesh em lammikra vehatanya letotefet letotefet letotafot hare kan arba divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich tat bechatpi shettayim pat beafriki shettayim
Ella leolam peligi vehane mile ki peligi hecha deshane kera mimmasoret aval hay chelev vachalev dechi hadade ninhu yesh em lammikra

Vahare yire yerae dechi hadade ninhu ufligi detanya yochanan ben dahavay omer mishshum rabbi yehuda ben tema hassome beachat meenav patur min hariyya shenneemar yire yerae kederech shebba lirot kach ba leraot ma lirot bishte enav af leraot bishte enav
Ella amar rav acha bereh derav ika amar kera lo tevashshel gedi derech bishul asra tora
Tanu rabbanan dine mamonot bishlosha

a: Veim haya mumche lerabbim dan afilu yechidi amar rav nachman kegon ana dan dine mamonot bichidi vechen amar rabbi chiyya kegon ana dan dine mamonot bichidi
Ibaya lehu kegon ana digmirna usvirna unkitna reshuta aval la nekit reshuta dineh la dina o dilma af al gav dela naket reshuta dineh dina
Ta shema demar zutra bereh derav nachman dan dina uta ata lekammeh derav yosef amar lo im kibluch alayehu la teshallem vei la zil shallem shema minah ki la naket reshuta dineh dina shema minah
Amar rav hay man devae lemedan dina vei tea mive lemiptar lishkol reshuta mibbe resh galuta vechen amar shemuel lishkol reshuta mibbe resh galuta
Peshita mehacha lehacha umehatam lehatam mahane umehacha lehatam name mahane dehacha shevet vehatam mechokek
Kidtanya lo yasur shevet mihuda ellu rashe galiyyot shebbevavel sherodin et yisrael beshevet umchokek mibben raglav ellu bene banav shel hillel shemmelammedin tora barabbim

Mehatam lehacha may ta shema derabba bar chana dan dina uta ata lekammeh derabbi chiyya amar leh i kibluch alayehu la teshallem vei la zil shallem veha rabba bar chana reshuta hava nekit shema minah mehatam lehacha la mahane shema minah

Vela mahane veha rabba bar rav huna ki hava mintze bahade deve resh galuta amar lav minayechu nekitna reshuta nekitna reshuta meabba mari veabba mari merav verav merabbi chiyya verabbi chiyya merabbi bemilta dealma hu deokem lehu
Vechi meachar dela mahane rabba bar chana reshuta dinkat lema li laayarot haomdim al haggevulin
May reshuta ki hava nachet rabba bar chana levavel amar leh rabbi chiyya lerabbi ben achi yored levavel yore yore yadin yadin yattir bechorot yattir
Ki hava nachet rav levavel amar leh rabbi chiyya lerabbi ben achoti yored levavel yore yore yadin yadin yattir bechorot al yattir

May shena lemar deka kare ben achi umay shena lemar deka kare ben achoti vechi tema hachi hava maase vehaamar mar ayevu vechanna veshela umarta verabbi chiyya kullehu bene abba bar acha karsalla mikkafri hao rav bar achuh dahava bar achateh rabba bar chana bar achuh delav bar achateh
Vei baet ema
b: Al shem chochmato dichtiv emor lachochma achoti atte
Yattir bechorot al yattir may tama ilema mishshum dela chakkim ha ka amrinan dechakkim tuva ella mishshum dela bekia bemume
Vehaamar rav shemona asar chodashim gadalti etzel roe vehema leda eze mum kavua veeze mum over ella lechallek lo kavod lerabba bar chana
Veibaet ema mishshum ha gufeh derav bekia bemume tefe veshare mume dela yadi inashe veamri ki hay gavena shera rav veatu lemishre mum over
Yore yore i gemir reshuta lema li lemishkal mishshum maase shehaya

Detanya paam achat halach rabbi lemakom echad veraa bene adam shemmegabbelin isotehem betuma amar lahem mippene ma attem megabbelin isotechem betuma amru lo talmid echad ba lechan vehora lanu me vetzaim en machshirin vehu me vetzim derash lehu veinhu sevur me vetzaim kaamar

Vetau name beha me keramon ume fega pesulin mippene shehen me vetzaim veinhu sevur middilgabbe chattat pesili achshore name la machsheri vela hi hatam leinyan chattat baenan mayim chayyim hacha achshore kal dehu machsheri
Tana beotah shaa gazru talmid al yore ella im ken notel reshut merabbo

Tanchum bereh derabbi amme ikla lecheter derash lehu muttar liltot chitin bappesach amru lo lav rabbi manni demin tzur ika hacha vetanya talmid al yore halacha bimkom rabbo ella im ken haya rachok mimmennu shalosh parsaot keneged machane yisrael amar lehu lav addatay
Rabbi chiyya chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava kae bevet hakkevarot amar leh lav ben ish peloni kohen atta amar leh in avuh dehahu gavra gevah enayim hava natan enav bigrusha vechillo
Peshita lefalga ha kaamar demahane al tenay may ta shema daamar leh rabbi yochanan lerav shemen hare atta birshutenu ad shettavo etzlenu

Gufa amar shemuel shenayim sheddanu dinehem din ella shennikra bet din chatzuf yatev rav nachman vekaamar leha shemata etiveh rava lerav nachman afilu shenayim mezakkin o shenayim mechayevin veechad omer eni yodea yosifu haddayyanin vei ita liho kishnayim sheddanu
Shane hatam demeikara addata ditlata yetivi hacha lav addata ditlata yetevi

Etiveh rabban shimon ben gamliel omer haddin bishlosha ufshara bishnayim veyafe koach peshara mikkoach haddin sheshshenayim sheddanu baale dinin yecholin lachazor bahen ushnayim sheasu peshara en baale dinin yecholin lachazor bahen

a: Vechi tema peligi rabbanan aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel vehaamar rabbi avahu shenayim sheddanu ledivre hakkol en dinehem din gavra aggavra ka ramet

Gufa amar rabbi avahu shenayim sheddanu dine mamonot ledivre hakkol en dinehem din etiveh rabbi abba lerabbi avahu dan et haddin vezika et hachayyav vechiyyev et hazzakkay time et hattahor tiher et hattame ma sheasa asuy umshallem mibbeto
Hacha bemay askinan dekabluhu alayehu i hachi ammay meshallem mibbeto deamru leh dayenatte lan din tora
Amar leh rav safra lerabbi abba dita bemay ilema dita bidvar mishna vehaamar rav sheshet amar rabbi amme taa bidvar mishna chozer ella dita beshikul haddaat

Hechi dame beshikul haddaat amar rav pappa kegon tere tannae utre amorae difligi ahadade vela itmar hilcheta la kemar vela kemar vesugyan dealma alliba dechad minayehu vaazal ihu vaavad keidach hayenu shikul haddaat
Lema ketannae bitzua bishlosha divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim peshara beyachid savruha lechulle alma makkeshinan peshara ledin

May lav beha kamipalgi demar savar din bishlosha umar savar din bishnayim la dechulle alma din bishlosha vehacha beha kamipalgi demar savar makkeshinan peshara ledin umar savar la makkeshinan peshara ledin

Lema telata tannae bifshara demar savar bishlosha umar savar bishnayim umar savar beyachid amar rav acha bereh derav ika veitema rabbi yemar bar shelemya man deamar tere afilu chad name vehay dekaamar tere ki hechi deliho aleh sahadi
Amar rav ashe shema minah peshara enah tzericha kinyan dei salka datach tzericha kinyan leman deamar tzericha telata lema li tisge bitre velikne mineh vehilcheta peshara tzericha kinyan
Tanu rabbanan keshem shehaddin bishlosha kach bitzua bishlosha
b: Nigmar haddin i atta rashshay livtzoa
Siman rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer asur livtzoa vechol habbotzea hare ze chote vechol hamvarech et habbotzea hare ze menaetz veal ze neemar botzea berech nietz Adonai

Ella yikkov haddin et hahar shenneemar ki hammishpat lelohim hu vechen moshe haya omer yikkov haddin et hahar aval aharon ohev shalom verodef shalom umesim shalom ben adam lachavero shenneemar torat emet hayeta befihu veavela lo nimtza visfatav beshalom uvmishor halach itti verabbim heshiv meaon
Rabbi eliezer omer hare sheggazal sea shel chittim utchanah vaafaah vehifrish mimmenna challa ketzad mevarech en ze mevarech ella menaetz veal ze neemar uvotzea berech nietz Adonai

Rabbi meir omer lo neemar botzea ella keneged yehuda shenneemar vayyomer yehuda el echav ma betza ki naharog et achinu vechol hamvarech et yehuda hare ze menaetz veal ze neemar uvotzea berech nietz Adonai

Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer mitzva livtzoa shenneemar emet umishpat shalom shiftu beshaarechem vahalo bimkom sheyyesh mishpat en shalom uvimkom sheyyesh shalom en mishpat ella ezehu mishpat sheyyesh bo shalom heve omer ze bitzua
Vechen bedavid hu omer vayehi david ose mishpat utzdaka vahalo kol makom sheyyesh mishpat en tzedaka utzdaka en mishpat ella ezehu mishpat sheyyesh bo tzedaka heve omer ze bitzua
Atan letanna kamma dan et haddin zika et hazzakkay vechiyyev et hachayyav veraa shennitchayyev ani mamon veshillem lo mittoch beto ze mishpat utzdaka

Mishpat laze utzdaka laze mishpat laze shehechzir lo mamon utzdaka laze sheshshilem lo mittoch beto vechen bedavid hu omer vayehi david ose mishpat utzdaka lechol ammo mishpat laze shehechzir lo et mamono utzdaka laze sheshshilem lo mittoch beto

Kashya leh lerabbi hay lechol ammo laaniyyim mibe leh ella rabbi omer af al pi shello shilem mittoch beto zehu mishpat utzdaka mishpat laze utzdaka laze mishpat laze shehechzir lo mamono utzdaka laze shehotzi gezela mittachat yado

Rabbi shimon ben menasya omer shenayim shebbau lefanecha laddin ad shello tishma divrehen o mishshettishma divrehen vei atta yodea lehechan din note atta rashshay lomar lahen tzeu uvitzu mishshettishma divrehen veatta yodea lehechan haddin note i atta rashshay lomar lahen tzeu uvitzu shenneemar poter mayim reshit madon velifne hitgalla hariv netosh kodem shennitgalla hariv atta yachol lenotsho mishshennitgalla hariv i atta yachol lenotsho

Veresh lakish amar shenayim shebbau laddin echad rach veechad kashe ad shello tishma divrehem o mishshettishma divrehen veen atta yodea lehechan din note atta rashshay lomar lahem en ani nizkak lachem shemma nitchayyev chazak venimtza chazak rodfo mishshettishma divrehen veatta yodea lehechan haddin note i atta yachol lomar lahen eni nizkak lachem shenneemar lo taguru mippene ish

Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer minnayin letalmid sheyyoshev lifne rabbo veraa zechut leani vechova leashir minnayin shello yishtok shenneemar lo taguru mippene ish rabbi chanin omer lo tachnis devarecha mippene ish vihu edim yodim et mi hen meidin velifne mi hen meidin umi atid lipara mehen shenneemar veamdu shene haanashim asher lahem hariv lifne Adonai

Vihu haddayyanin yodin et mi hen danin velifne mi hen danin umi atid lipara mehen shenneemar elohim nitztzav baadat el vechen bihoshafat hu omer vayyomer el hashshoftim reu ma attem osim ki lo leadam tishpetu ki im la shemma yomar haddayyan ma li betzaar hazze talmud lomar immachem bidvar mishpat en lo laddayyan ella ma sheenav root

Hechi dame gemar din amar rav yehuda amar rav ish peloni atta chayyav ish peloni atta zakkay amar rav halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha ini veha rav huna talmideh derav hava ki hava atu lekammeh derav huna amar lehu i dina baetu i peshara baetu may mitzva name dekaamar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha

a: Mitzva lememra lehu i dina baetu i peshara baetu hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu mitzva rabbi yehoshua ben korcha savar mitzva tanna kamma savar reshut
Hayenu derabbi shimon ben menasya ika benayehu mishshettishma divrehen veatta yodea lehechan haddin note i atta rashshay lomar lahen tzeu uvitzu

Ufliga derabbi tanchum bar chanilay deamar rabbi tanchum bar chanilay lo neemar mikra ze ella keneged maase haegel shenneemar vayyar aharon vayyiven mizbeach lefanav ma raa amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar raa chur shezzavuach lefanav
Amar i la shamana lehu hashta avdu li kedaavadu bechur umikayam bi im yehareg bemikdash Adonai kohen venavi vela haveya lehu takkanta leolam mutav delibedu leegel efshar haveya lehu takkanta bitshuva

Vehane tannae poter mayim reshit madon may darshi beh kidrav hamnuna deamar rav hamnuna en techilat dino shel adam nidon ella al divre tora shenneemar poter mayim reshit madon amar rav huna hay tigra damya letzinora devidka demayya kevan deravach ravach
Abbaye kashshisha amar dame legudda degamla kevan dekam kam
Shimi ushte sheva zemirot hu siman
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel tuveh deshama veadesh chalfuh bishateh mea amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda kera ketiv poter mayim reshit madon resh mea dine
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel attarte telat gannava la miktal amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda kera ketiv ko amar Adonai al shelosha pishe yisrael veal arbaa lo ashivennu
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel shav bere lishlamana vachada leaved bish amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda kera ketiv ki sheva yippol tzaddik vakam verasha yippol beachat
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel deazel mibbe dina shekil gelima lizammar zemar velezil beorcha amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda kera ketiv vegam kol haam hazze al mekomo yavo veshalom
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel hi nayema vedikula shafel amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda kera ketiv baatzaltayim yimmach hammekare vego
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel gavra dirchitzna aleh adyeh ligzizeh vekam amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda kera ketiv gam ish shelomi asher batachti vo vego

Hahu dahava kaamar veazel ki rechimtin hava azziza apputya desafsera shechivan hashta dela azziza rechimtin purya bar shitin garmide la saggi lan amar rav huna kerae ketivi meikara ketiv venoadti lecha sham vedibbarti ittecha meal hakkapporet vetanya aron tisha vechapporet tefach hare kan asara

Uchtiv vehabbayit asher bana hammelech shelomo la shishshim amma orko veesrim rochbo ushloshim amma komato ulvassof ketiv ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay eze vayit asher tivnu li vego

May mashma dehay lo taguru lishana dechannoshe hu amar rav nachman amar kera veyayin lo tishte velo teegor rav acha bar yaakov amar mehacha tachin bakkayitz lachmah agra vakkatzir maachalah rav acha bereh derav ika amar mehacha oger bakkayitz ben maskil

Emet mamon yira siman amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol dayyan sheddan din emet laamito mashre shechina beyisrael shenneemar elohim nitztzav baadat el bekerev elohim yishpot vechol dayyan sheeno dan din emet laamito gorem lishchina shettistallek miyyisrael shenneemar mishshod aniyyim meankat evonim atta akum yomar Adonai vego

Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol dayyan shennotel mizze venoten leze shello kaddin hakkadosh baruch hu notel mimmennu nafsho shenneemar al tigzol dal ki dal hu veal tedakke ani vashshaar ki Adonai yariv rivam vekava et kovehem nafesh
Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan leolam yire dayyan atzmo keilu cherev munnachat lo ben yarchotav vegehinnam petucha lo mittachtav
b: Shenneemar hinne mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah miggibbore yisrael kullam achuze cherev melummede milchama ish charbo al yerecho mippachad ballelot mippachdah shel gehinnam sheddoma lelayela

Darash rabbi yoshiyya veitema rav nachman bar yitzchak may dichtiv bet david ko amar Adonai dinu labboker mishpat vehatztzilu gazul miyyad oshek vechi babboker danin vechol hayyom en danin ella im barur lecha haddavar kabboker omrehu veim lav al tomrehu rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yonatan mehacha emor lachochma achoti atte im barur lecha haddavar kaachotcha shehi asura lecha omrehu veim lav al tomrehu
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi asara sheyyoshvin baddin kolar taluy betzavar kullan peshita la tzericha ella letalmid hayyoshev lifne rabbo

Rav huna ki hava ate dina lekammeh mechannef umayeti asara rabbanan mibbe rav amar ki hechi delimteyan shiba mikkeshura rav ashe ki hava ate terefta lekammeh mechannef umayete lehu lechullehu tabbache demata machseya amar ki hechi delimteyan shiba mikkeshura

Ki ata rav dimi amar darash rav nachman bar kohen may dichtiv melech bemishpat yaamid aretz veish terumot yehersenna im dayyan dome lemelech sheeno tzarich lichlum yaamid aretz veim dome lechohen shemmechazzer bevet haggeranot yehersenna
Deve nesia okmu dayyana dela hava gemir amar leh lihuda bar nachmani meturgemaneh deresh lakish kum aleh beamora kam gechen aleh vela amar leh vela mide

Patach veamar hoy omer laetz hakitza uri leeven dumam hu yore hinne hu tafus zahav vachesef vechol ruach en bekirbo veatid hakkadosh baruch hu lipara mimmaamidan shenneemar va behechal kodsho has mippanav kol haaretz

Amar resh lakish kol hammaamid dayyan al hatztzibur sheeno hagun keilu notea ashera beyisrael shenneemar shoftim veshotrim titten lecha usmich leh lo titta lecha ashera kal etz amar rav ashe uvimkom sheyyesh talmide chachamim keilu netao etzel mizbeach shenneemar etzel mizbach Adonai elohecha
Ketiv lo taasun itti elohe chesef velohe zahav elohe chesef velohe zahav hu dela avdi ha deetz shere amar rav ashe eloha habba bishvil kesef veeloha habba bishvil zahav
Rav ki hava ate leve dina amar hachi birut nafsheh liktala nafek utzvu beteh let hu aved verekan leveteh ayel ulvay shettehe bia kitzia

Ki have chaze ambuha desafre abbatreh amar im yaale lashshamayim sio vego kegello lanetzach yoved vego mar zutra chasida ki hao mechattefi leh beshabbeta derigla amar hachi ki lo leolam chosen veim nezer ledor vador

Daresh bar kappara mena ha milta daamaru rabbanan heu metunin baddin dichtiv lo taale vemaalot usmich leh veelle hammishpatim amar rabbi eliezer minnayin ledayyan shello yefassea al rashe am kodesh shenneemar lo taale vemaalot usmich leh veelle hammishpatim

Asher tasim asher telammedem mibe leh amar rabbi yirmeya veitema rabbi chiyya bar abba ellu kele haddayyanin rav huna ki hava nafek ledina amar hachi appiku li mane chanutay makkel urtzua veshofara vesandala

Vaatzave et shoftechem baet hahi amar rabbi yochanan keneged makkel urtzua tehe zariz shamoa ben achechem ushfattem amar rabbi chanina azhara laddayyan shello yishma divre baal din kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero veazhara levaal din shello yatim devarav laddayyan kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero keri beh name shamma ben achechem
Rav kahana amar mehacha millo tissa lo tassi
Ushfattem tzedek amar resh lakish tzaddek et haddin veachar kach chotchehu ben ish uven achiv uven gero amar rav yehuda afilu ben bayit laaliyya
Uven gero amar rav yehuda afilu ben tannur lechirayim
Lo takkiru fanim bammishpat rabbi yehuda omer lo takkirehu rabbi elazar omer lo tenakkerehu
Ushpizchaneh derav ata lekammeh ledina amar lo lav ushpizchani atte amar lo in amar leh dina it li amar leh

a: Pesilna lach ledina amar leh rav lerav kahana pok dayeneh chazyeh dahava ka gaes beh amar leh i tzayetatte tzayetatte vei la mappekna lach rav meunnach
Kakkaton kaggadol tishmaun amar resh lakish sheyehe chaviv alecha din shel peruta kedin shel mea mane lemay hilcheta ilema leayyone beh umifsekeh peshita ella leakdomeh

Lo taguru mippene ish amar rabbi chanan al tachnis devarecha mippene ish ki hammishpat lelohim hu amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina amar hakkadosh baruch hu lo dayyan larshaim shennotlin mizze mamon venotnim laze shello kaddin ella shemmatrichin oti lehachazir mamon livalav

Vehaddavar asher yikshe mikkem amar rabbi chanina veitema rabbi yoshiyya al davar ze neenash moshe shenneemar vayyakrev moshe et mishpatan lifne Adonai matkef lah rav nachman bar yitzchak mi ketiv veashmiachem ushmativ ketiv i gemirna gemirna vei la azelna ugmirna

Ella kidtanya reuya parashat nachalot shettikatev al yede moshe rabbenu ella shezzachu benot tzelafchad venichteva al yadan reuya hayeta parashat mekoshesh shettikatev al yede moshe rabbenu ella shennitchayyev mekoshesh venichteva al yado lelammedcha shemgalgelin chova al yede chayyav uzchut al yede zakkay

Ketiv vaatzave et shoftechem baet hahi uchtiv vaatzave etchem baet hahi amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi simlay azhara latztzibur shettehe emat dayyan alehen veazhara laddayyan sheyyisbol et hatztzibur ad kamma amar rabbi chanan veitema rabbi shabbetay kaasher yissa haomen et hayyonek

Ketiv ki atta tavo uchtiv ki atta tavi amar rabbi yochanan amar lo moshe lihoshua atta vehazzekenim shebbaddor immahem amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu tol makkel vehach al kodkodam dabbar echad laddor veen shene dabbarin laddor
Tana zimun bishlosha may zimun ilema birkat zimun vehatanya zimun uvirkat zimun bishlosha vechi tema paroshe kamfaresh may zimun birkat zimun vehatanya zimun bishlosha birkat zimun bishlosha

Ella may zimun azmone ledin ki ha deamar rava hane be telata dayyane deyatvi veazel shelicha deve dina veamar mippumma dechad lo amar kelum ad deamar mishshemeh dechullehu hane mile bela yoma dedina aval beoma dedina let lan bah

Tashlume kefel ku shelach leh rav nachman bar rav chisda lerav nachman bar yaakov yelammedenu rabbenu dine kenasot bechamma may kamibaya leh ha anan tenan bishlosha ella yachid mumche kamibaya leh deen dine kenasot o la

Amar leh tenetuha tashlume kefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha bishlosha may shelosha ilema shelosha hedotot haamar avuh daavuch mishshemeh derav afilu asara vehen hedotot pesulin ledine kenasot ella mumchin vekaamar shelosha

Amar rava

a: Peloni ba al ishti hu veacher mitztarfin lehorgo aval lo lehorgah
May ka mashma lan dimfalleginan bedibura hayenu hach mahu detema adam karov etzel atzmo amrinan etzel ishto la amrinan ka mashma lan
Veamar rava peloni ba al naara hamorasa vehuzzammu neheragin veen meshallemin mamon bitto shel peloni vehuzzammu neheragin umshallemin mamon mamon laze unfashot laze
Veamar rava peloni rava hashshor vehuzzammu neheragin veen meshallemin mamon shoro shel peloni vehuzzammu neheragin umshallemin mamon mamon laze unfashot laze

Ha tu lema li hayenu hach mishshum deka vae baya ilaveh devae rava peloni rava shori mahu mi amrinan adam karov etzel atzmo veen adam karov etzel mamono o dilma amrinan adam karov etzel mamono batar devaya hadar pashtah adam karov etzel atzmo veen adam karov etzel mamono
Makkot bishlosha ku menahane mile amar rav huna amar kera ushfatum shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehem od echad hare kan shelosha
Ella meatta vehitzdiku shenayim vehirshiu shenayim hare kan shiva hahu mibe leh kidulla deamar ulla remez leedim zommin min hattora minnayin
Remez leedim zommin veha ketiv kaasher zamam ella remez leedim zommin shellokin minnayin dichtiv vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik vehirshiu et harasha

Mishshum dehitzdiku et hatztzaddik vehirshiu et harasha vehaya im bin hakkot harasha ella edim shehirshiu et hatztzaddik vaato ede acharine vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik demeikara veshavinhu lehanach reshaim vehaya im bin hakkot harasha
Vetipok leh millo taane mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav

Mishshum rabbi yishmael amru beesrim ushlosha may tama derabbi yishmael amar abbaye atya rasha rasha mechayyave mitot ketiv hacha vehaya im bin hakkot harasha uchtiv hatam asher hu rasha lamut ma lehallan beesrim ushlosha af kan beesrim ushlosha
Rava amar malkot bimkom mita omedet amar rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe i hachi umdana lema li limchayeh vei maet lemut
Amar leh amar kera venikla achicha leenecha ki machet aggabba dechaye machet ella ha detanya amaduhu lekabbel esrim en makkin oto ella makkot haruot lehishtallesh vechamma hen tamne sere
b: Limchayeh esrim vachada vechi mayet behach chada lemut deha ki mache aggabba dechayya ka mache amar leh amar kera venikla achicha leenecha achar shellaka achicha baena veleka
Ibur hachodesh bishlosha chishuv la katane kidush la katane ella ibur la likaddesheh umimmela liabbar

Amar abbaye teni kidush hachodesh tanya name hachi kidush hachodesh veibur hashshana bishlosha divre rabbi meir amar rava veha ibur katane ella amar rava kidush beom ibur bishlosha achar ibur leka kidush
Umanni rabbi elazar ben tzadok hi detanya rabbi elazar ben tzadok omer im lo nira bizmanno en mekaddeshin oto shekkevar kidshuhu bashshamayim
Rav nachman amar kidush achar ibur bishlosha beom ibur leka kidush umanni pelemo hi detanya pelemo omer bizmanno en mekaddeshin oto shello bizmanno mekaddeshin oto
Rav ashe amar leolam chishuv katane umay ibur chishuv deibur veayede dekavae lemitne ibur shana tena name ibur chodesh

Chishuv chodesh in kidush chodesh la manni rabbi eliezer hi detanya rabbi eliezer omer ben bizmanno ben shello bizmanno en mekaddeshin oto shenneemar vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana shanim atta mekaddesh vei atta mekaddesh chodashim

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer bishlosha ku tanya ketzad amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bishlosha matchilin uvachamishsha nosin venotnin vegomrin beshiva echad omer leshev ushnayim omrim shello leshev batel yachid bemiuto

Shenayim omrim leshev veechad omer shello leshev mosifin alehem od shenayim venosin venotnin baddavar shenayim omrim tzericha ushlosha omrim enah tzericha batlu shenayim bemiutan shelosha omrim tzericha ushnayim omrim enah tzericha mosifin alehem od shenayim sheen hamminyan pachot mishshiva

Hane shelosha chamishsha veshiva keneged mi peligi bah rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani vechad deimeh umannu rabbi shimon ben pazzi veamri lah rabbi shimon ben pazzi vechad deimeh umannu rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani chad amar keneged birkat kohanim vechad amar shelosha keneged shomre hassaf chamishsha meroe pene hammelech shiva roe pene hammelech

Tane rav yosef hane shelosha vachamishsha veshiva shelosha keneged shomre hassaf chamishsha meroe pene hammelech shiva roe pene hammelech amar leh abbaye lerav yosef ad haidana may tama la paresh lan mar hachi amar lehu la hava yadana ditzrichitu mi beetu minnay milta vela amari lechu
Zeman nasi tzarich gedi siman tanu rabbanan en meabberin et hashshana ella

a: Bimzummanin lah maase berabban gamliel sheamar hashkimu li shiva laaliyya hishkim umatza shemona amar mi hu sheala shello birshut yered

Amad shemuel hakkatan veamar ani hu shealiti shello birshut velo leabber hashshana aliti ella lilmod halacha lemaase hutzrachti amar lo shev beni shev reuot kol hashshanim kullan lehitabber al yadecha ella amru chachamim en meabberin et hashshana ella bamzummanin lah vela shemuel hakkatan hava ella inish acharina umechamat kisufa hu daavad

Ki ha deyatev rabbi veka daresh veheriach reach shum amar mi sheachal shum yetze amad rabbi chiyya veyatza amdu kullan veyatzu bashshachar metzao rabbi shimon berabbi lerabbi chiyya amar leh atta hu shetztziarta leabba amar lo lo tehe kezot beyisrael

Verabbi chiyya mehecha gemir lah merabbi meir detanya maase beishsha achat shebbata levet midrasho shel rabbi meir amra lo rabbi echad mikkem kiddeshani bevia amad rabbi meir vechatav lah get keritut venatan lah amdu katvu kullam venatnu lah

Verabbi meir mehecha gemir lah mishshemuel hakkatan ushmuel hakkatan mehecha gemir lah mishshechanya ven yechiel dichtiv vayyaan shechanya ven yechiel mibbene elam vayyomer leezra anachnu maalnu velohenu vannoshev nashim nochriyyot meamme haaretz veatta yesh mikve leyisrael al zot

Ushchanya ven yechiel mehecha gemar lah mihoshua dichtiv vayyomer Adonai el yehoshua kum lach lamma ze atta nofel al panecha chata yisrael amar lefanav ribbono shel olam mi chata amar lo vechi delator ani lech hattel goralot veibaet ema mimmoshe dichtiv ad ana meantem

Tanu rabbanan mishshemmetu neviim haacharonim chaggay zecharya umalachi nistalleka ruach hakkodesh miyyisrael veaf al pi chen hau mishtammeshin bevat kol paam achat hau mesubbin baaliyyat bet gurya biricho venittena alehem bat kol min hashshamayim yesh kan echad sherauy shettishre alav shechina kemoshe rabbenu ella sheen doro zakkay lechach natnu chachamim et enehem behillel hazzaken uchshemmet amru alav hi chasid hi anav talmido shel ezra

Shuv paam achat hau mesubbin baaliyya beyavne venittena alehem bat kol min hashshamayim yesh kan echad sherauy shettishre alav shechina ella sheen doro zakkay lechach natnu chachamim et enehem bishmuel hakkatan uchshemmet amru alav hi chasid hi anav talmido shel hillel af hu amar bishat mitato shimon veyishmael lecharba vechavrohi liktala ushar amma leviza veakan saggian atidan lemete al alma
Veal yehuda ben bava bikkeshu lomar ken ella shennitrefa shaa sheen maspidin al haruge malchut

Tanu rabbanan en meabberin et hashshana ella im ken yirtze nasi umaase berabban gamliel shehalach litol reshut etzel hegmon echad shebbesurya veshaha lavo veibru et hashshana al menat sheyyirtze rabban gamliel uchshebba rabban gamliel veamar rotze ani nimtzet shana meubberet

Tanu rabbanan en meabberin et hashshana ella im ken hayeta tzericha mippene hadderachim umippene haggesharim umippene tannure fesachim umippene galiyyot yisrael shenneekru mimmekoman vaadayin lo higgiu aval lo mippene hashsheleg velo mippene hatztzina velo mippene galiyyot yisrael shello akru mimmekoman

Tanu rabbanan en meabberin et hashshana lo mippene haggedayim velo mippene hattelaim velo mippene haggozalot shello perchu aval osin otan saad lashshana ketzad rabbi yannay omer mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel mehodin anachna lechon degozalayya rakkichin veimrayya dadekin vezimna daaviva la meta ushfarat milta beanpay veosefit al shatta da telatin yomin
Metivi kamma ibur hashshana sheloshim yom rabban shimon ben gamliel omer chodesh amar rav pappa ratzu chodesh ratzu sheloshim yom
Ta chazi may ika ben
b: Takkifey kadmae leinvetane batrae
Detanya maase berabban gamliel shehaya yoshev al gav maala behar habbayit vehaya yochanan sofer hallaz omed lefanav veshalosh igrot chatuchot lefanav munnachot

Amar lo tol igarta chada uchtov laachana bene galila ilaa velaachana bene galila tattaa shelomchon yisge mehodin anachna lechon dizman biura meta leafroshe masera mimmatana dezeta vetol igarta chada uchtov laachana bene daroma shelomchon yisge mehodin anachna lechon dizman biura meta leafroshe masera meumre shuvlayya

Vetol igarta chada uchtov laachana bene galvata bevavel velaachana divmaday velishar kol galota deyisrael shelomchon yisge lealam mehodin anachna lechon degozalayya rakkichin veimrayya dadekin vezimna daaviva la meta ushfara milta beanpay uvanpe chaveray veosefit al shatta da yomin telatin dilma batar deabberuho
Tanu rabbanan al shelosha devarim meabberin et hashshana al haaviv veal perot hailan veal hattekufa al shenayim mehen meabberin veal echad mehen en meabberin
Uvizman sheaviv echad mehen hakkol semechin rabban shimon ben gamliel omer al hattekufa ibaya lehu al hattekufa semechin o al hattekufa meabberin teku

Tanu rabbanan al shelosha aratzot meabberin et hashshana yehuda veever hayyarden vehaggalil al shettayim mehen meabberin veal achat mehen en meabberin uvizman sheyehuda achat mehen hakkol semechin sheen omer ba ella mihuda

Tanu rabbanan en meabberin et hashshanim ella bihuda veim ibruha baggalil meubberet heid chananya ish ono im ibruha baggalil enah meubberet amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi may tama dachananya ish ono amar kera leshichno tidreshu uvata shamma kol derishot sheatta doresh lo yihu ella beshichno shel makom

Tanu rabbanan en meabberin et hashshana ella beom veim ibruha ballayela enah meubberet veen mekaddeshin et hachodesh ella bayyom veim kidshuhu ballayela eno mekuddash amar rav abba may kera tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leom chaggenu ezehu chag shehachodesh mitkasse bo heve omer ze rosh hashshana uchtiv ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat lelohe yaakov ma mishpat bayyom af kidush hachodesh beom
Tanu rabbanan en meabberin et hashshana

a: Bishne reavon
Tanya rabbi omer veish ba mibbaal shalisha vayyave leish haelohim lechem bikkurim esrim lechem seorim vego

Veen lecha kalla bechol eretz yisrael levashshel peroteha yoter mibbaal shalisha veaf al pi chen lo bikkera ella min echad shemma tomar chittim talmud lomar seorim shemma tomar lifne haomer talmud lomar ten laam veyochelu achar haomer haya
Emor meatta reuya hayeta otah shana shettitabber umippene ma lo ibrah elisha sheshshenat batztzoret hayeta vehau hakkol ratzin levet haggoranot
Tanu rabbanan en meabberin et hashshana lifne rosh hashshana veim ibruha enah meubberet aval mippene haddechak meabberin otah achar rosh hashshana miyyad veaf al pi ken en meabberin ella adar
Ini veha shelachu leh lerava zug ba merakkat utfaso nesher uvyado devarim hannaasim beluz umay nihu techelet bizchut harachamim uvizchutam yatzu beshalom

Vaamuse yereche nachshon bikkeshu likboa netziv echad velo hinnichan adomi hallaz aval baale asuppot neesfu vekavu lo netziv echad beyerach shemmet bo aharon hakkohen chashshove mechashshevi galloye la megallu

May mashma dehay netziv lishana deyarcha hu dichtiv velishlomo shenem asar nitztzavim al kol yisrael vechilkelu et hammelech veet anashav chodesh bashshana vehachtiv untziv echad asher baaretz rav yehuda verav nachman chad amar echad memunne al kullam vechad amar keneged chodesh haibur

Tanu rabbanan en meabberin et hashshana lo mishshana lachavertah velo shalosh shanim zo achar zo amar rabbi shimon maase berabbi akiva shehaya chavush bevet haasurim veiber shalosh shanim zo achar zo amru lo mishsham reaya bet din yashvu vekavu achat achat bizmannah
Tanu rabbanan en meabberin et hashshana lo bishviit velo bemotzae sheviit ematay regilin leabber erev sheviit shel bet rabban gamliel hau meabberin bemotzae sheviit
Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya en meviin yarak mechutza laaretz verabbotenu hittiru may benayehu amar rabbi yirmeya choshshin legushehen ika benayehu
Tanu rabbanan en meabberin et hashshana mippene hattuma

Rabbi yehuda omer meabberin amar rabbi yehuda maase bechizkiyya melech yehuda sheiber et hashshana mippene hattuma uvikkesh rachamim al atzmo dichtiv ki marbit haam rabbat meefrayim umnashshe yissashchar uzvulun lo hitteharu
b: Ki achlu et happesach belo chakkatuv ki hitpallel chizkiyyahu alehem lemor Adonai hattov yechapper bead

Rabbi shimon omer im mippene hattuma ibruha meubberet ella mippene ma bikesh rachamim al atzmo sheen meabberin ella adar vehu iber nisan benisan rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon mippene shehissi et yisrael laasot pesach sheni
Amar mar rabbi yehuda omer meabberin alma it leh lerabbi yehuda tuma dechuya hi betzibur
Veha tanya tzitz ben sheyyeshno al mitzcho uven sheeno al mitzcho meratztze divre rabbi shimon rabbi yehuda omer odo al mitzcho meratztze en odo al mitzcho eno meratztze
Amar lo rabbi shimon kohen gadol beom hakkipurim yochiach sheeno al mitzcho umratztze amar lo rabbi yehuda hannach leom hakkipurim shettuma huttera betzibur

Velitamach tikshe lach hi gufah rabbi yehuda omer meabberin veamar rabbi yehuda maase bechizkiyya melech yehuda sheiber et hashshana mippene hattuma uvikesh rachamim al atzmo ella chassore mechassera vehachi katane en meabberin et hashshana mippene hattuma veim ibruha meubberet rabbi yehuda omer enah meubberet veamar rabbi yehuda vechu

I hachi rabbi shimon omer im mippene hattuma ibruha meubberet hayenu tanna kamma amar rava lechattechilla ika benayehu tanya name hachi en meabberin et hashshana mippene hattuma lechattechila rabbi shimon omer meabberin ella mippene ma bikkesh rachamim al atzmo sheen meabberin ella adar vehu iber nisan benisan

Amar mar sheen meabberin ella adar vehu iber nisan benisan velet leh lechizkiyya hachodesh hazze lachem ze nisan veen acher nisan tea bedishmuel deamar shemuel en meabberin et hashshana beom sheloshim shel adar hoil verauy lekovo nisan
Veihu savar hoil verauy la amrinan tanya name hachi en meabberin et hashshana beom sheloshim shel adar hoil verauy lekovo nisan

Rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon mippene shehissi et yisrael laasot pesach sheni hechi dame amar rav ashe kegon shehau yisrael mechetza temeim mechetza tehorim venashim mashlimot lattehorim veodfot alehem
Meikara sevar nashim barishon chova dehau miutan temeim umiutan midchu lefesach sheni ulvassof sevar nashim barishon reshut dehau lehu temeim rubba verubba la middechu lefesach sheni

Gufa amar shemuel en meabberin et hashshana beom sheloshim shel adar hoil verauy lekovo nisan ibruha may amar ulla en mekaddeshin et hachodesh kidshu may amar rava batel haibur rav nachman amar meubbar umkuddash

Amar leh rava lerav nachman mikkede mippurayya lefischa telatin yomin hao umippurayya darshinan behilchot happesach detanya shoalin behilchot happesach kodem lefesach sheloshim yom rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shette shabbatot vechi mate resh yarcha merachakin leh ate lezalzole bechametz
Amar leh mida yadi deshatta meabbarta bechushbana talya milta amri chushbana hu dela selek lehu lerabbanan ad hashta
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel en meabberin et hashshana ella im ken hayeta tekufa chasera rubbo shel chodesh vechamma rubbo shel chodesh shishsha asar yom divre rabbi yehuda

a: Rabbi yose omer echad veesrim yom ushnehem mikra echad darshu chag haasif tekufat hashshana mar savar kulleh chag baenan bitkufa chadasha umar savar miktzat chag baenan bitkufa chadasha

Metivi yom tekufa gomer divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer yom tekufa matchil

Amar mar rabbi yehuda omer shette yadot bachodesh esrim yom rabbi yose omer mechashshevin shishsha asar yom lifne happesach meabberin hayenu rabbi yehuda
Yom tekufa gomer veom tekufa matchil ika benayehu

Vehaamar shishsha asar lifne happesach in betzir la

Rabbi shimon omer af shishsha asar lifne hachag meabberin hayenu tanna kamma

Veliabbereh laadar amar rav acha bar yaakov tanna millemala lematta kachashev vehachi kaamar ad miuto meabberin vechamma miuto arbaa asar yom
Ravina amar leolam acherim betishri kayemi vekasavri acherim kulleh chag baenan veom tov rishon yom tov rishon chag haasif ketiv chag habba bizman asifa
Semichat zekenim tanu rabbanan vesamchu zikne yachol zikne hashshuk talmud lomar eda

I eda yachol ketanne eda talmud lomar haeda meuchadin shebbaeda vechamma hen vesamchu shenayim zikne shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehem od echad hare kan chamishsha divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer zikne shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehen od echad hare kan shelosha
Verabbi shimon hachtiv vesamchu hahu mibe leh legufeh verabbi yehuda legufeh la tzerich deim ken dela ate vesamchu lidrasha lichtov zikne haeda yedehem al rosh happar
Verabbi shimon i ketiv hachi hava amena may al besamuch verabbi yehuda gamar rosh rosh meola verabbi shimon la gamar rosh rosh meola
Tana semicha usmichat zekenim bishlosha may semicha umay semichat zekenim amar rabbi yochanan mismach save
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef mismach save bishlosha menalan ilema middichtiv vayyismoch et yadav alav i hachi tisge bechad vechi tema moshe bimkom shivim vechad kae i hachi live shivim vechad kashya
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe bida mammash samchin leh amar leh samchin leh bishma karu leh rabbi veyahavi leh reshuta lemedan dine kenasot
Vechad la samech veha amar rav yehuda amar rav beram zachur oto haish lattov verabbi yehuda ben bava shemo sheilmale hu nishtachchu dine kenasot miyyisrael nishtachchu nigrosinhu ella

a: Batlu dine kenasot miyyisrael sheppaam achat gazra malchut harshaa shemad al yisrael shekkol hassomech yehareg vechol hannismach yehareg veir shessomchin bah techarev utchumin shessomchin bahen yeakru

Ma asa yehuda ben bava halach veyashav lo ben shene harim gedolim uven shette ayarot gedolot uven shene techume shabbat ben usha lishfaram vesamach sham chamishsha zekenim veellu hen rabbi meir verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon verabbi yose verabbi elazar ben shammua rav aveya mosif af rabbi nechemya

Kevan shehikkiru oyevehem bahen amar lahen banay rutzu amru lo rabbi ma tehe alecha amar lahen hareni mutal lifnehem keeven sheen lah hofchim amru lo zazu mishsham ad shennaatzu bo shelosh meot lunchiot shel barzel vaasauhu kichvara

Rabbi yehuda ben bava acharine hao bahadeh vehay dela chashev lehu mishshum kevodo derabbi yehuda ben bava verabbi meir rabbi yehuda ben bava samcheh veha amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol haomer rabbi meir lo semacho rabbi akiva eno ella toe samcheh rabbi akiva velo kabluh semacheha rabbi yehuda ben bava vekabluh

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi en semicha bechutza laaretz may en semicha ilema dela dayeni dine kenasot kelal bechutza laaretz veha tenan sanhedrin noheget ben baaretz uven bechutza laaretz ella dela samchinan bechutza laaretz
Peshita somchin bechutza laaretz venismachin baaretz ha amrinan dela ella somchin baaretz venismachin bechutza laaretz may

Ta shema derabbi yochanan hava mitztaer aleh derav shemen bar abba dela hava gabbayehu delismecheh rabbi shimon ben zerud vechad deimeh umannu rabbi yonatan ben achmay veamri lah rabbi yonatan ben achmay vechad deimeh umannu rabbi shimon ben zerud chad dahava gabbayehu samchuhv vechad dela hava gabbayehu la samchuhv
Rabbi chanina verabbi hoshaya hava ka mishtekid rabbi yochanan lemismechinhu la hava mistayea milta hava ka mitztaar tuva amaru leh la nitztaar mar daanan middevet eli kaatenan

Deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yonatan minnayin sheen nismachin levet eli shenneemar lo yihye zaken bevetcha kol hayyamim may zaken ilema zaken mammash vehachtiv kol marbit betcha yamutu anashim ella semicha

Rabbi zera hava mitammar millemismecheh deamar rabbi elazar leolam heve kavel vekayyam kevan deshamah leha deamar rabbi elazar en adam ole ligdulla ella im ken mochalin lo al kol aonotav amtzi nafsheh

Ki samchuh lerabbi zera sharu leh hachi lo kachal velo sarak velo pirkus veyaalat chen ki samchuh lerabbi amme ulrabbi assi sharu lehu hachi kol min den kol min den semuchu lana la tismechu lana la missarmitin vela missarmisin veamri lah la mechamisin vela mitturmisin
Rabbi avahu ki hava ate mimmetivta leve kesar nafki matronyata deve kesar umsharyan leh rabba deammeh medabberana deummeteh butzina dinhora berich metyach lishlam

Arifat egla bishlosha tanu rabbanan veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha zekenecha shenayim shoftecha shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehen od echad hare kan chamishsha divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer zekenecha shenayim veen bet din shakul mosifin alehem od echad hare kan shelosha
Verabbi shimon hay shoftecha may aved leh hahu mibe leh limuchadin shebbeshoftecha verabbi yehuda mizzikne zekenecha nafka

Verabbi shimon i mizzikne hava amena zikne hashshuk ketav rachamana zekenecha vei ketiv zekenecha hava amena sanhedri ketanna ketav rachamana veshoftecha mimmeuchadin shebbeshoftecha verabbi yehuda gamar zikne zikne mivesamchu zikne haeda et yedehem ma lehallan meuchadin shebbaeda af kan meuchadin shebbizkenecha
I yalef lelaf kullah mehatam zekenecha veshoftecha lema li ella vav veshoftecha leminyana verabbi shimon vav la daresh
Ella meatta veyatzu shenayim umaddu shenayim lerabbi yehuda hare tisha lerabbi shimon shiva hahu mibe leh lechidtanya veyatzu hen velo sheluchan umaddu sheafilu nimtza
b: Baalil lair tzarich laasok bimdida

Matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha zekenecha zo sanhedrin veshoftecha ze melech vechohen gadol melech dichtiv melech bammishpat yaamid aretz kohen gadol dichtiv uvata el hakkohanim halviyyim veel hashshofet

Ibaya lehu rabbi eliezer ben yaakov bachada pelig o betarte pelig bemelech vechohen gadol pelig aval besanhedre i kerabbi yehuda i kerabbi shimon o dilma besanhedre name pelig deamar kullah sanhedri baenan
Amar rav yosef ta shema metzaan abbet pagge vehimra alehen yachol tehe hamraato hamraa talmud lomar vekamta vealita el hammakom melammed shehammakom gorem

Dinfuk kamma ilema miktzatan dilma hanach deika gavay kayemi kevateh ella peshita dinfuk kullehu lemay ilema lidvar harshut mi matzu nafki vehachtiv shorrech aggan hassahar al yechsar hammazeg ella peshita lidvar mitzva

Hechi dame lav limdidat egla verabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi deamar kulle sanhedre baenan amar leh abbaye la kegon sheyyatzu lehosif al hair veal haazarot keditnan en mosifin al hair veal haazarot ella bevet din shel shivim veechad

Tanya kevateh derav yosef metzaan abbet page vehimra alehen kegon sheyyatzu limdidat egla ulhosif al hair veal haazarot yachol shettehe hamraato hamraa talmud lomar vekamta vealita el hammakom melammed shehammakom gorem

Neta revai umaaser sheni sheen damav yeduin bishlosha tanu rabbanan ezehu maaser sheni sheen damav yeduin perot shehirkivu veyayin shehikris umaot shehechlidu tanu rabbanan maaser sheni sheen damav yeduin podin oto bishlosha lakochot aval lo bishlosha sheen lakochot afilu goy echad mehen afilu echad mehem bealim
Bae rabbi yirmeya shelosha umtilin letoch kis echad mahu ta shema ish ushte nashav podin maaser sheni sheen damav yeduin dilma kegon rav pappa uvat abba suraa
Hahekdeshot bishlosha matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer afilu tzinora shel hekdesh tzericha asara bene adam lifdotah
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye bishlama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov deamar kishmuel deamar shemuel asara kohanim ketuvin bapparasha ella lerabbanan shelosha mena lehu
Vechi tema dichtiv behu shelosha karkaot dichtiv behu arbaa tisge bearbaa vechi tema hachi name allema tenan hakkarkaot tisha vechohen
Ella may demashlemi behu asara hekdeshot demashlemi behu shita livo shita kashya
Haarachin ku may arachin hammittaltelin amar rav gidel amar rav beomer erech keli ze alay deamar rav gidel amar rav

a: Haomer erech keli ze alay noten damav may tama adam yodea sheen erech lichli vegamar veamar leshum damim mishshum hachi noten damav hay arachin hammittaltelin arachin shel mittaltelin mibbaya leh teni arachin shel mittaltelin
Rav chisda amar avimi bematpis mittaltelin laarachin hay arachin hammittaltelin mittaltelin shel arachin mibe leh teni mittaltelin shel arachin

Rabbi avahu amar beomer erki alay ba kohen ligbot mimmennu mittaltelin bishlosha karkaot baasara amar leh rav acha middifti leravina bishlama leappoke mehekdesh baenan shelosha ella leayyole lehekdesh shelosha lema li
Amar leh sevara hu ma li ayyole ma li appoke appoke may tama dilma tae ayyole name dilma tae
Rabbi yehuda omer ku amar leh rav pappa leabbaye bishlama lerabbi yehuda hayenu dichtiv kohen ella lerabbanan kohen lema lehu kashya
Hakkarkaot tisha vechohen menahane mile amar shemuel asara kohanim ketuvin bapparasha chad legufeh hanach have miut achar miut veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot daafilu tisha yisrael veechad kohen
Matkef lah rav huna bereh derav natan ema chamishsha kohanim vachamishsha yisreelim kashya
Veadam keotze bahen adam mi kadosh amar rabbi avahu beomer damay alay detanya haomer damay alay shamin oto keeved hannimkar bashshuk veeved ittakkash lekarkaot
Bae rabbi avin sear haomed leyiggazez bechamma kegazuz dame uvishlosha o kimchubbar dame uvaasara
Ta shema hammakdish et avdo en moalin bo rabban shimon ben gamliel omer moalin bisaro vekayema lan devisaro haomed ligazez peligi shema minah

Nema hane tannae kehane tannae ditnan rabbi meir omer yesh devarim shehen kakkarka veenan kakkarka veen chachamim modim lo ketzad eser gefanim teunot masarti lach vehalla omer enan ella chamesh rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim omrim kol hamchubbar lakkarka hare hu kakkarka

Veamar rabbi yose bar chanina baanavim haomdot libatzer askinan mar savar kivtzurot damyan umar savar lav kivtzurot damyan la afilu tema rabbi meir ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam kol kamma deshavkatte lehu michchash kachashi aval searo kol kamma deshavkatte lehu ashboche mashbach
Dine nefashot ku ka pasek vetane la shena rovea zachar vela shena rovea nekeva bishlama rovea nekeva dichtiv veharagta et haishsha veet habbehema ella rovea zachar mena lan

Dichtiv kol shochev im behema mot yumat im eno inyan leshochev tenehu inyan lenishkav veappekeh rachamana bilshon shochev leakkoshe nishkav leshochev ma shochev hu uvhemto beesrim ushlosha af nishkav hu uvhemto beesrim ushlosha

Shor hanniskal beesrim ushlosha shenneemar hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat kemitat habbealim kach mitat hashshor amar leh abbaye lerava mimmay dehay vegam bealav yumat lichmitat bealim kach mitat hashshor hu daata
b: Ema liktala hu daata im ken lichtov vegam bealav velishtok
I ketav rachamana hachi hava amena biskila biskila salka datach ketal ihu besayif mamono biskila
Vedilma hay dichtav rachamana yumat leakkole ilaveh leappoke missayif lechenek hanicha leman deamar chenek chamur ella leman deamar chenek kil may ika lememar
La salka datach dichtiv im kofer yushat alav vei salka datach bar ketala hu vehachtiv lo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach

Adderabba mishshum hi gufah ketal ihu la tisge leh bemamona ella biktala ketal shoro lifrok nafsheh bemamona ella amar chizkiyya vechen tana deve chizkiyya amar kera mot yumat hammakke rotzeach hu al retzichato atta horgo vei atta horgo al retzichat shoro
Ibaya lehu shor sinay bechamma mi gamar shaa middorot o la ta shema detane rame bar yechezkel im behema im ish lo yichye ma ish beesrim ushlosha af behema beesrim ushlosha

Haari vehazzeev ku amar resh lakish vehu shehemitu aval lo hemitu la alma kasavar yesh lahen tarbut veyesh lahen bealim rabbi yochanan amar af al pi shello hemitu alma kasavar en lahem tarbut veen lahem bealim

Tenan rabbi eliezer omer kol hakkodem lehorgan zacha bishlama lerabbi yochanan lemay zacha zacha leoran ella leresh lakish lemay zacha kevan shehemitu shavinhu rabbanan keman digmar dinayehu veisure hanaa ninhu

May zacha zacha lashshamayim tanya kevateh deresh lakish echad shor shehemit veechad behema vechayya shehemitu beesrim ushlosha rabbi eliezer omer shor shehemit beesrim ushlosha ushar behema vechayya shehemitu kol hakkodem lehorgan zacha bahen lashshamayim
Rabbi akiva omer vechu rabbi akiva hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu nachash
En danin ku hay shevet dachata bemay ilema shevet shechillel et hashshabbat emar defalleg rachamana ben yechidim limrubbin leinyan avodat kochavim bishar mitzot mi pelig ella beshevet shehuddach

Lememra divdina derabbim dayeninan leh keman la kerabbi yoshiyya vela kerabbi yonatan detanya ad kamma osin ir hanniddachat measara vead mea divre rabbi yoshiyya rabbi yonatan omer mimmea vead rubbo shel shevet
Vaafilu rabbi yonatan la kaamar ella rubbo aval kullo la amar rav matna hacha

a: Binsi shevet shechata askinan mi la amar rav adda bar ahava kol haddavar haggadol yaviu elecha devarav shel gadol hay name gadol hu
Ulla amar rabbi elazar bevain al iske nechalot vechitchilatah shel eretz yisrael ma techilatah shivim veechad af kan shivim veechad
I ma techilatah kalpi urim vetummim vechol yisrael af kan kalpi urim vetummim vechol yisrael ella mechavarta kidrav matna
Ravina amar leolam beshevet shehuddach udka kashya lach bedina derabbim dayeninan leh in af al gav dekatlinan beyachid be dina derabbim dayeninan leh

Mi la amar rabbi chama berabbi yose amar rabbi oshaya vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi vego ish veishsha atta motzi lisharecha vei atta motzi kal hair kullah lisharecha hacha name ish veishsha atta motzi lisharecha vei atta motzi kol hashshevet kullo lisharecha
Lo et nevi hashsheker menahane mile
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina atya hazada hazada mizzaken mamre ma lehallan beshivim veechad af kan beshivim veechad
Veha hazada ki ketiva biktala hu dichtiva uktala beesrin utlata hu ella amar resh lakish gamar davar davar mehamraato
Velehdar zaken mamre veligmar hazada hazada minnevi hashsheker davar davar gemir hazada hazada la gemir
Velo et kohen gadol menahane mile amar rav adda bar ahava deamar kera kol haddavar haggadol yaviu elecha devarav shel gadol
Metivi davar gadol davar kashe atta omer davar kashe o eno ella devarav shel gadol keshehu omer et haddavar hakkashe yeviun el moshe hare davar kashe amur

Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya davar gadol devarav shel gadol atta omer devarav shel gadol o eno ella davar hakkashe keshehu omer haddavar hakkashe hare davar kashe amur ha ma ani mekayyem davar gadol devarav shel gadol
Vehay tanna tere kerae lema li chad letzavaa bealma vechad laasiyya veidach im ken lichtov o gadol gadol o kashe kashe may gadol umay kashe shema minah tarte
Bae rabbi elazar shoro shel kohen gadol bechamma lemitat bealim dideh medammenan leh o dilma lemitat bealim dealma medammenan leh amar abbaye middeka mibbaya leh shoro michlal demamono peshita leh
Peshita mahu detema hoil vechatav kol haddavar haggadol kol devarav shel gadol ka mashma lan
En motziin vechu menahane mile amar rabbi avahu deamar kera velifne elazar hakkohen yaamod
Hu ze melech vechol bene yisrael itto ze meshuach milchama vechol haeda ze sanhedre
Vedilma lesanhedre hu dekaamar lehu rachamana delishayelu beurim vetummim

Ella ki ha deamar rav acha bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida kinnor haya taluy lemala mimmittato shel david kevan shehiggia chatzot layela ruach tzefonit menashshevet bo vehaya menaggen meelav miyyad haya david omed veosek betora ad sheala ammud hashshachar kevan sheala ammud hashshachar nichnesu chachme yisrael etzlo

Amru lo adonenu hammelech ammecha yisrael tzerichin lefarnasa amar lahen lechu vehitparnesu ze mizze amru lo en hakkometz masbia et haari veen habbor mitmalle mechulyato amar lahem lechu pishtu yedechem bigdud
Miyyad yoatzin baachitofel venimlachin besanhedrin veshoalin beurim vetummim amar rav yosef may kera
b: Veachare achitofel benayahu ben yehoyada veevyatar vesar tzava lammelech yoav achitofel ze yoetz vechen hu omer vaatzat achitofel asher yaatz vego uvnayahu ben yehoyada zo sanhedrin evyatar ellu urim vetummim
Vechen hu omer uvnayahu ben yehoyada al hakkereti veal happeleti velamma nikra sheman kereti ufleti kereti shekkortin divrehen ufleti shemmuflain maasehen veachar kach sar hatztzava lammelech yoav
Amar rabbi yitzchak bereh derav adda veamri lah amar rabbi yitzchak bar avudimi may kera ura chevodi ura hannevel vechinnor aira shachar
Veen mosifin al hair menahane mile amar rav shimi bar chiyya amar kera kechol asher ani mare otcha et tavnit hammishkan vechen taasu ledorot habbain
Metiv rava kol hakkelim sheasa moshe meshichatan mekaddashtan mikan veelach avodatan mechannachtan veammay nema vechen taasu ledorot habbain
Shane hatam deamar kera vayyimshachem vayekaddesh otam otam bimshicha velo ledorot bimshicha
Veema otam bimshicha uldorot i bimshicha i baavoda amar rav pappa amar kera asher yeshartu vam bakkodesh hakkatuv telaan besherut
Ella otam lema li i lav otam hava amena ledorot bimshicha uvaavoda deha ketiv vechen taasu ketav rachamana otam otam bimshicha velo ledorot bimshicha
Veen osin sanhedraot ku mena lan kidashkechan bemoshe deoki sanhedraot umoshe bimkom shivim vechad kae

Tanu rabbanan minnayin shemmaamidin shoftim leyisrael talmud lomar shoftim titten shotrim leyisrael minnayin talmud lomar shotrim titten shoftim lechol shevet veshevet minnayin talmud lomar shoftim lishvatecha shotrim lechol shevet veshevet minnayin talmud lomar shotrim lishvatecha

Shoftim lechol ir vair minnayin talmud lomar shoftim lisharecha shotrim lechol ir vair minnayin talmud lomar shotrim lisharecha rabbi yehuda omer echad memunne al kullan shenneemar titten lecha rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lishvatecha veshaftu mitzva bashshevet ladun et shivto

Veen osin ir hanniddachat mena hane mile amar rabbi chiyya bar yosef amar rabbi oshaya deamar kera vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi ish veishsha atta motzi lisharecha vei atta motzi kal hair kullah lisharecha
En osin ir hanniddachat bassefar may tama mikkirbecha amar rachamana velo min hassefar

Velo shalosh are hanniddachat dichtiv achat aval osin achat o shettayim dichtiv arecha tanu rabbanan achat achat velo shalosh atta omer achat velo shalosh o eno ella achat velo shettayim keshehu omer arecha hare shettayim amur ha ma ani mekayyem achat achat velo shalosh

Zimnin amar rav bevet din echad hu deen osin ha bishnayim ushlosha batte dinin osin vezimnin amar rav afilu bishnayim ushlosha batte dinin leolam en osin may tama derav mishshum korcha amar resh lakish lo shanu ella bemakom echad aval bishnayim ushlosha mekomot osin rabbi yochanan amar en osin mishshum korcha

Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan en osin shalosh ayarot menuddachot beeretz yisrael aval osin otam shettayim kegon achat bihuda veachat baggalil aval shettayim bihuda ushtayim baggalil en osin usmucha lassefar afilu achat en osin may tama shemma yishmeu goyim veyachrivu et eretz yisrael
Vetipok li demikkirbecha amar rachamana velo min hassefar rabbi shimon hi dedaresh tama dikra
Sanhedri gedola hayeta may tamayehu derabbanan deamri umoshe al gabbehen amar kera vehityatztzevu sham

a: Immach immach veatte bahadayehu verabbi yehuda immach mishshum shechina
Verabbanan amar kera venasu ittecha bemassa haam ittecha veatte bahadayehu verabbi yehuda ittecha bedomin lach
Verabbanan mivehakel mealecha venasu ittach nafka veyalfa sanhedri gedola missanhedri ketanna
Tanu rabbanan vayyishshaaru shene anashim bammachane yesh omrim bakkalpi nishtayeru

Shebbeshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael amar moshe ketzad eese evror shishsha mikkol shevet veshevet nimtzeu shenayim yeterim evror chamishsha chamishsha mikkol shevet veshevet nimtzeu asara chaserim evror shishsha mishshevet ze vachamishsha mishshevet ze hareni metil kina ben hashshevatim

Ma asa berar shishsha shishsha vehevi shivim ushnayim pitkin al shivim katav zaken ushnayim hinniach chalak belalan untanan bekalpi amar lahem bou utlu pitkechem kol mi sheala beyado zaken amar kevar kideshcha shamayim mi sheala beyado chalak amar hammakom lo chafetz becha ani ma eese lach
Keotze baddavar atta omer velakachta chameshet chameshet shekalim laggulgolet amar moshe ketzad eese lahen leyisrael im omar lo ten li pidoncha vatze yomar li kevar pedaani ben levi

Ma asa hevi esrim ushnayim alafim pitkin vechatav alehen ben levi veal shelosha veshivim umatayim katav alehen chamishsha shekalim belalan untanan bekalpi amar lahen telu pitkechem mi sheala beyado ben levi amar lo kevar pedaacha ben levi mi sheala beyado chameshet shekalim amar lo ten pidoncha vatze

Rabbi shimon omer bammachane nishtayeru beshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe esfa li shivim ish amru eldad umedad en anu reuyin leotah gedulla amar hakkadosh baruch hu hoil umiattem atzmechem hareni mosif gedulla al gedullatchem uma gedulla hosif lahem shehanneviim kullan nitnabbeu ufasku vehem nitnabbeu velo pasku
Uma nevua nitnabbeu amru moshe met yehoshua machnis et yisrael laaretz abba chanin omer mishshum rabbi eliezer al iske selav hen mitnabbeim ali selav ali selav

Rav nachman amar al iske gog umagog hau mitnabbein shenneemar ko amar Adonai elohim haatta hu asher dibbarti beyamim kadmonim beyad avaday nevie yisrael hannibbeim bayyamim hahem shanim lehavi otcha alehem vego al tikre shanim ella shenayim elu hen shenayim neviim shennitnabbeu beferek echad nevua achat heve omer eldad umedad

Amar mar kol hanneviim kullan nitnabbeu ufasku vehen nitnabbeu velo pasku mena lan defasku ilema middichtiv vayyitnabbeu velo yasafu ella meatta kol gadol velo yasaf hachi name dela osef hu ella dela pesak hu
Ella hacha ketiv vayyitnabbeu hatam ketiv mitnabbeim adayin mitnabbeim veholchim

Ulvassof lo malach ella al yisrael shenneemar ani kohelet hayiti melech al yisrael vego ulvassof lo malach ella al yerushalayim shenneemar divre kohelet ben david melech birushalam ulvassof lo malach ella al mittato shenneemar hinne mittato shellishlomo vego
Ulvassof lo malach ella al maklo shenneemar ze haya chelki mikkol amali rav ushmuel chad amar maklo vechad amar gundo
Hadar o la hadar rav ushmuel chad amar hadar vechad amar la hadar man deamar la hadar melech vehedot uman deamar hadar melech vehedot vamelech

Poretz laasot lo derech tanu rabbanan otzrot melachim lammelech ushar biza shebbozzin mechetza lammelech umechetza laam amar leh abbaye lerav dimi veamri lah lerav acha bishlama otzrot melachim lammelech orcha demilleta ella shear biza shebbozzin mechetza lammelech umechetza laam menalan dichtiv

a: Vayyimshechu la lenagid ultzadok makkish nagid letzadok ma tzadok mechetza lo umechetza leechav af nagid mechetza lo umechetza leechav
Vetzadok gufeh menalan detanya rabbi omer vehayeta leaharon ulvanav mechetza leaharon umechetza levanav

Matni lo yarbe lo nashim ella shemone esre rabbi yehuda omer marbe hu lo uvilvad shello yehu mesirot et libbo rabbi shimon omer afilu achat umsira et libbo hare ze lo yissaenna im ken lamma neemar lo yarbe lo nashim daafilu kaavigayil
Gema lememra derabbi yehuda daresh tama dikra verabbi shimon la daresh tama dikra veha ipcha shaminan lehu

Detanya almana ben shehi aniyya ben shehi ashira en memashkenin otah shenneemar lo tachavol beged almana divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer ashira memashkenin otah aniyya en memashkenin otah veatta chayyav lehachzir lah veatta massiah shem ra bishchenoteha
Veamrinan may kaamar hachi kaamar mittoch sheatta memashkenah atta chayyav lehachazir lah veatta massiah shem ra bishchenoteha alma rabbi yehuda la daresh tama dikra verabbi shimon daresh tama dikra
Bealma rabbi yehuda la daresh tama dikra veshane hacha dimfaresh tama dikra ma taam lo yarbe lo nashim mishshum delo yasur levavo

Verabbi shimon amar lach mikkedi bealma darshinan tama dikra im ken lichtov kera lo yarbe lo nashim velishtok vaana amena ma taam lo yarbe mishshum delo yasur lo yasur lema li afilu achat umsira et libbo hare zo lo yissaenna ella ma ani mekayyem lo yarbe daafilu kaavigayil

Hane shemone esre menalan dichtiv vayyivaldu ledavid banim bechevron vayehi vechoro amnon laachinoam hayyizreelit umishnehu chilav laavigayil eshet naval hakkarmeli vehashshelishi avshalom ben maacha veharvii adoniyya ven chaggit vehachamishi shefatya ven avital vehashshishshi yitream leegla eshet david elle yulledu ledavid bechevron
Vekaamar leh navi im meat veosifa lecha kahenna vechahenna kahenna shet vechahenna shet dehau lehu tamne sere
Matkef lah ravina emar kahenna tarte sere vechahenna esrin vearba
Tanya name hachi lo yarbe lo nashim yoter meesrim vearba leman dedaresh vav arbaim ushmone hau tanya name hachi lo yarbe lo nashim yoter mearbaim ushmone
Vetanna didan may tameh amar rav kahana makkish kahenna batra lekkahenna kamma ma kahenna kamma shet af kahenna batra shet
Veha havay michal amar rav egla zo michal velamma nikra shemah egla shechaviva alav keegla vechen hu omer lule charashtem beeglati vego
Umi hao lemichal bene vehachtiv ulmichal bat shaul lo haya lah valad ad yom motah amar rav chisda ad yom motah lo haya lah beom motah haya lah

Mikkede banim hecha ka chashev lehu bechevron veilu maase demichal birushalayim hava dichtiv umichal bat shaul nishkefa bead hachallon vattere et hammelech david mefazzez umcharker lifne Adonai vattivez veamar rav yehuda veitema rav yosef shekalteh michal lemitrafsah ella ema ad oto maase haya lah mikkan veelach lo haya lah

Vehachtiv vayyikkach david od pilagshim venashim birushalayim lemalloye shemona esre may nashim umay pilagshim amar rav yehuda amar rav nashim bichtubba uvkidushin pilagshim belo ketubba uvlo kidushin

Amar rav yehuda amar rav arba meot yeladim hau lo ledavid vechullan bene yefat toar hau umgaddele veloriyyot hau vechullan yoshvin bikronot shel zahav umhallechin berashe geyasot hau vehem hau baale egrofin shel bet david

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav tamar bat yefat toar hayeta shenneemar veatta dabber na el hammelech ki lo yimnaeni mimmekka vei salka datach bat nisuin havay achateh mi hava sharya leh ella shema minah bat yefat toar hayeta
Ulamnon rea ushmo yonadav ben shima achi david veonadav ish chacham vego amar rav yehuda amar rav ish chacham lerisha

Vayyomer maddua atta kacha dal ben hammelech vayyomer lo yonadav shechav al mishkavcha vehitchal vego ad veasta leenay et habbirya vattikkach hammasret vattitzok lefanav amar rav yehuda amar rav sheasta lo mine tigun
Vayyisnaeha amnon sina gedola meod may tama amar rabbi yitzchak nima nikshera lo vaasaattu kerut shofcha vechi nikshera lo ihi may avada ella ema kashra lo nima vaasaattu kerut shofcha
Ini veha daresh rava may dichtiv vayyetze lach shem baggoyim beyofyech sheen lahen livnot yisrael lo sear bet hashshechi vela bet haerva shane tamar devat yefat toar havay

Vattikkach tamar efer al roshah veet ketonet happassim asher aleha karaa tana mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben korcha gader gadol gadra tamar beotah shaa amru livnot melachim kach livnot hedotot al achat kamma vechamma im latztzenuot kach lapperutzot al achat kamma vechamma amar rav yehuda amar rav beotah shaa gazru
b: Al hayyichud veal happenuya

Yichud deorayeta hu deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak remez leyichud min hattora minnayin shenneemar ki yesitcha achicha ven immecha vechi ben em mesit ben av eno mesit ella lomar lach ben mityached im immo veen acher mityached im kol araot shebbattora
Ella ema gazru al yichud difnuya
Vaadoniyya ven chaggit mitnasse lemor ani emloch amar rav yehuda amar rav melammed shebbikesh leholmo velo holamto
Vayyaas lo rechev ufarashim vachamishshim ish ratzim lefanav may revuta amar rav yehuda amar rav kullan netule techol vachakuke kappot raglayim hau

Matni lo yarbe lo susim ella kede merkavto vechesef vezahav lo yarbe lo meod ella kede liten afsanya vechotev lo sefer tora lishmo yotze lammilchama motziah immo nichnas hu machnisah immo yoshev baddin hi immo mesev hi kenegdo shenneemar vehayeta immo vekara vo kol yeme chayyav

Gema tanu rabbanan lo yarbe lo susim yachol afilu kede merkavto ufarashav talmud lomar lo lo eno marbe aval marbe hu kede richbo ufarashav ha ma ani mekayyem susim susim habbatlanin minnayin sheafilu sus echad vehu batel shehu belo yarbe talmud lomar lemaan harbot sus
Vechi meachar daafilu sus echad vehu batel kae belo yarbe susim lema li laavor belo taase al kol sus vesus
Tama dichtav rachamana lo ha lav hachi hava amena afilu kede richbo ufarashav name la la tzericha leapposhe
Vechesef vezahav lo yarbe lo ella kede liten afsanya tanu rabbanan vechesef vezahav lo yarbe lo yachol afilu kede liten afsanya talmud lomar lo lo eno marbe aval marbe hu kede liten afsanya
Tama dichtav rachamana lo ha lav hachi hava amena afilu kede liten afsanya name la la tzericha leharvacha
Hashta deamratte lo lidrasha lo yarbe lo nashim may darshatte beh lemaote hedotot

Rav yehuda rame ketiv vayehi lishlomo arbaim elef urot susim lemerkavto uchtiv vayehi lishlomo arbaat alafim urot susim ha ketzad im arbaim elef itztavlaot hau kol echad veechad hau bo arbaat alafim urot susim veim arbaat alafim itztavlaot hau kol echad veechad hau bo arbaim elef urot susim

Rabbi yitzchak rame ketiv en kesef nechshav bime shelomo limuma uchtiv vayyitten shelomo et hakkesef birushalam kaavanim la kashya kan kodem shennasa shelomo et bat paro kan leachar shennasa shelomo et bat paro
Amar rabbi yitzchak beshaa shennasa shelomo et bat paro yarad gavriel venaatz kane bayyam veheela sirton vealav nivna kerach gadol shebberomi

Veamar rabbi yitzchak mippene ma lo nitgallu taame tora shehare shette mikraot nitgallu taman venichshal bahen gedol haolam ketiv lo yarbe lo nashim amar shelomo ani arbe velo asur uchtiv vayehi leet ziknat shelomo nashav hittu et levavo
Uchtiv lo yarbe lo susim veamar shelomo ani arbe velo ashiv uchtiv vattetze merkava mimmitzrayim beshesh vego
Vechotev sefer tora lishmo tena uvilvad shello yitnae beshel avotav

Amar rava af al pi shehinnichu lo avotav leadam sefer tora mitzva lichtov mishshello shenneemar veatta kitvu lachem et hashshira etiveh abbaye vechotev lo sefer tora lishmo shello yitnae beshel acherim melech in hedot lo
La tzericha lishte torot vechidtanya vechatav lo et mishne vego kotev lishmo shette torot achat shehi yotza venichneset immo veachat shemmunnachat lo bevet genazav

Otah sheyyotza venichneset immo ose otah kemin kamea vetolah bizroo shenneemar shiviti Adonai lenegdi tamid ki mimini bal emmot eno nichnas bah lo levet hammerchatz velo levet hakkisse shenneemar vehayeta immo vekara vo makom harauy likrot bo

Amar mar zutra veitema mar ukva battechilla nitna tora leyisrael bichtav ivri ulshon hakkodesh chazra venitna lahem bime ezra bichtav ashshuri ulshon arammi berru lahen yisrael ketav ashshuri ulshon hakkodesh vehinnichu lahedotot ketav ivrit ulshon arammi
Man hedotot amar rav chisda kutae may ketav ivrit amar rav chisda ketav libonaa

Tanya rabbi yose omer rauy haya ezra shettinaten tora al yado leyisrael ilmale lo kedamo moshe bemoshe hu omer umoshe ala el haelohim beezra hu omer hu ezra ala mibbavel ma aliyya haamura kan tora af aliyya haamura lehallan tora

Bemoshe hu omer veoti tziva Adonai baet hahi lelammed etchem chukkim umishpatim beezra hu omer ki ezra hechin levavo lidrosh et torat Adonai elohav velaasot ullammed beyisrael chok umishpat veaf al pi shello nitna tora al yado nishtanna al yado hakketav shenneemar

a: Uchtav hannishtevan katuv aramit umturgam arammit uchtiv la chahalin ketava lemikre ufishreh lehodaa lemalka melammed shebbeoto hayyom nitan uchtiv vechatav et mishne hattora hazzot ketav harauy lehishtannot
Lamma nikra shemo ashshuri sheala immahem meashshur

Tanya rabbi omer battechilla bichtav ze nitna tora leyisrael kevan shechatu nehpach lahen leroetz kevan shechazru bahen hechziro lahem shenneemar shuvu levitztzaron asire hattikva gam hayyom maggid mishne ashiv lach
Lamma nikra shemo ashshuri shemmeushshar bichtavoo

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi eliezer ben parta sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar hammodai ketav ze lo nishtanna kol ikar shenneemar vave haammudim ma ammudim lo nishtannu af vavim lo nishtannu veomer veel hayehudim kichtavam vechilshonam ma leshonam lo nishtanna af ketavam lo nishtanna

Ella ma ani mekayyem et mishne hattora hazzot lishte torot achat sheyyotza venichneset immo veachat shemmunnachat lo bevet genazav otah sheyyotza venichneset immo ose otah kemin kamea vetolah bizroo shenneemar shiviti Adonai lenegdi tamid

Veidach hay shiviti may daresh beh hahu mibe leh kidrav chana bar bizna deamar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida hammitpallel tzarich sheyyire atzmo keilu shechina kenegdo shenneemar shiviti Adonai lenegdi tamid
Lerabbi shimon deamar ketav ze lo nishtanna may la chahalin ketava lemikre amar rav begimatriyya iktiv lehon
May paresh lehu mene mene tekel ufarsin mene mena elaha malchutach vehashlemah lach tekel tekilta vemozanya vehishtechachatte chassir parsin perisat malchutach vihivat lemaday ufaras
Ushmuel amar verabbi yochanan amar rav ashe amar

Matni en rochvin al suso veen yoshvin al kiso veen mishtammeshin besharvito veen roin oto keshehu mistapper velo keshehu arom velo keshehu bevet hammerchatz shenneemar som tasim alecha melech shettehe emato alecha
Gema amar rav yaakov amar rabbi yochanan avishag mutteret lishlomo vaasura laadoniyya mutteret lishlomo demelech haya umelech mishtammesh besharvito shel melech vaasura laadoniyya dehedot hu

Avishag may hi dichtiv vehammelech david zaken ba bayyamim vego vayyomru lo avadav yevakshu vego uchtiv vayevakshu naara yafa vego uchtiv vehannaara yafa ad meod vattehi lammelech sochenet vatteshartehu amara ninsevan amar lah asiratte li

Amara leh chassereh legannava nafsheh beshalmana naket amar lehu kiru li levat sheva uchtiv vattavo vat sheva el hammelech hachadra amar rav yehuda amar rav beotah shaa kincha bat sheva bishlosh esre mappot
Amar rav shemen bar abba bo ure kamma kashin gerushin shehare david hammelech hittiru lo leyached velo hittiru lo legaresh

Amar rabbi eliezer kol hamgaresh et ishto rishona afilu mizbeach morid alav demaot shenneemar vezot shenit taasu kassot dima et mizbach Adonai bechi vaanaka meen od penot el hammincha velakachat ratzon miyyedchem uchtiv vaamartem al ma al ki Adonai heid bencha uven eshet neurecha asher atta bagadta bah vehi chavertecha veeshet beritecha
Amar rabbi yochanan veitema rabbi elazar en ishto shel adam meta ella im ken mevakkeshin mimmennu mamon veen lo shenneemar veim en lecha leshallem lamma yikkach mishkavcha mittachtecha

Veamar rabbi yochanan kol adam shemmeta ishto rishona keilu charav bet hammikdash beyamav shenneemar ben adam hinni lokeach mimmecha et machmad enecha bemaggefa lo tispod velo tivke velo tavo dimatecha uchtiv vaadabber el haam babboker vattamot ishti baarev uchtiv hinni mechallel et mikdashi geon uzzechem machmad enechem

Amar rabbi alekkesanderi kol adam shemmeta ishto beyamav olam chashach baado shenneemar or chashach beoholo venero alav yidach rabbi yose bar chanina amar pesiotav mitkatztzerot shenneemar yetzru tzaade ono rabbi avahu amar atzato nofelet shenneemar vetashlichehu atzato

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kashe lezavvegam kikriat yam suf shenneemar elohim moshiv yechidim bayeta motzi asirim bakkosharot al tikre motzi asirim ella kemotzi asirim al tikre bakkosharot ella bechi veshirot
Ini vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav arbaim yom kodem yetzirat havalad bat kol yotzet veomeret bat peloni lifloni la kashya ha beziuug rishon ha beziuug sheni

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachman lakkol yesh temura chutz meeshet neurim shenneemar veeshet neurim ki timmaes matne lah rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh en adam motze korat ruach ella meishto rishona shenneemar yehi mekorcha varuch usmach meeshet
b: Neurecha amar lo kegon man amar lo kegon immach
Ini veha makre leh rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha asher hi metzodim vacharamim veamar lo kegon man veamar lo kegon immach mitkaf takkifa abore meabbera bemillah
Amar rav shemuel bar unya mishshemeh derav ishsha golem hi veenah koretet berit ella lemi sheasaah keli shenneemar ki voalayich osayich Adonai tzevaot shemo

Tana en ish met ella leishto veen ishsha meta ella levalah en ish met ella leishto shenneemar vayyamat elimelech ish noomi veen ishsha meta ella levalah shenneemar vaani bevoi mippaddan meta alay rachel
En roin oto ku tanu rabbanan melech mistapper bechol yom kohen gadol meerev shabbat leerev shabbat kohen hedot echad lishloshim yom
Melech mistapper bechol yom shenneemar melech beyofo techezena enecha kohen gadol meerev shabbat amar rav shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yochanan hoil umishmarot mitchaddeshot

Kohen hedot echad lishloshim yom dichtiv verosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu kasom yichsemu et rashehem veyalef pera pera minnazir ketiv hacha pera lo yeshallechu uchtiv hatam gaddel pera sear rosho ma lehallan sheloshim af kan sheloshim utnan name setam nezirut sheloshim yom
Vehatam mena lan amar rav matna deamar kera kadosh yihye begimatriyya telatin hau
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye ema la lirabbo kelal amar leh i ketiv lo yeshallechu pera kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv ufera lo yeshallechu pera leheve shalloche la lishallechu
I hachi haidana name dumya deyayin ma yayin bizman bia hu deasur shello bizman bia shere af perue rosh bizman bia asur shello bizman bia shere

Veyayin shello bizman bia shere vehatanya rabbi omer omer ani kohanim asurin lishtot yayin leolam aval ma eese shettakkanato kalkalato veamar abbaye keman shatu kahane chamra haidana kerabbi mikkelal derabbanan asri
Hatam hayenu tama mehera yibbane bet hammikdash uvaenan kohen harauy laavoda veleka hacha name baena kohen harauy laavoda veleka

Hacha efshar dimsappar veayel hatam name efshar denayem purta veayel deamar rav acha derech mil veshena kol shehu mefigin et hayyayin velav itmar alah amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lo shanu ella sheshshata kede reviit aval yoter mikkede reviit kol shekken dederech toradto veshena meshakkarto
Rav ashe amar shetuye yayin demachali avoda gezaru behu rabbanan perue rosh dela machali avoda la gezaru behu rabbanan
Metivi veellu shebbemita perue rosh ushtuye yayin
Bishlama shetuye yayin dichtiv yayin veshechar al teshte atta uvanecha velo tamutu ella perue rosh mena lan
Deitakkash shetuye yayin lifrue rosh ketiv verosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu uchtiv veyayin lo yishtu vego ma shetuye yayin bemita af perue rosh bemita
Uminah ma shetuye yayin demachali avoda af perue rosh demachali avoda kashya

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe hay ad dela ata yechezkel man amrah velitamach ha deamar rav chisda davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu ad shebba yechezkel velimdanu kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi lesharteni ad delo ba yechezkel man amrah ella gemara gemiri lah vaata yechezkel veasmechah akkera hacha name gemara gemiri lah vaata yechezkel veasmechah akkera
Vechi gamri halacha lemita leachole avoda la gemiri
May kasom yichsemu et rashehem tana kemin tisporet lulyanit may tisporet lulyanit amar rav yehuda amar shemuel tispurta yechidaa hechi dame amar rav ashe rosho shel ze betzad ikaro shel ze
Shaalu et rabbi ezehu tisporet shel kohen gadol amar lahen tzeu uru mittisporet shel ben elasa tanya rabbi omer lo al chinnam pizer ben elasa et meotav ella kede leharot bo tisporet shel kohen gadol
Hadaran alach kohen gadol

a: Matni dine mamonot bishlosha ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad ushnehen borrin lahen od echad divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim shene dayyanin borrin lahen od echad

Ze posel dayyano shel ze veze posel dayyano shel ze divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim ematay bizman shemmevi alehen reaya shehen kerovin o pesulin aval im hau kesherin o mumchin mippi bet din eno yachol lefoslan
Ze posel edav shel ze veze posel edav shel ze divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim ematay bizman shemmevi alehen reaya shehen kerovin o pesulin aval im hau kesherin eno yachol lefoslan
Gema may ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad bitlata saggi
Hachi kaamar keshezze borer lo bet din echad veze borer lo bet din echad shenehen borrin lahen od echad
Vaafilu love matze meakkev vehaamar rabbi elazar lo shanu ella malve aval love kofin oto vedan beiro
Kidamar rabbi yochanan bearkaot shebbesurya shanu hacha name bearkaot shebbesurya shanu aval mumchin la
Rav pappa amar afilu tema mumchin kegon be dina derav huna udrav chisda dekaamar leh mi ka matrachna lach
Tenan vachachamim omrim shene dayyanin borrin lahen od echad vei salka datach kidkaamrinan bet din bet din batar defasli lehu azlu uvarru lehu be dina acharine
Veod may ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad
Ella hachi kaamar keshezze borer lo dayyan echad veze borer lo dayyan echad shenehen borrin lahen od echad
May shena deavdi hachi amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi zera mittoch shezze borer lo dayyan echad veze borer lo dayyan echad ushnehen borrin lahen od echad yetze haddin laamito
Vachachamim omrim ku nema bidrav yehuda amar rav kamipalgi
Deamar rav yehuda amar rav en haedim chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken yodin mi chotem immahen rabbi meir let leh derav yehuda amar rav verabbanan it lehu derav yehuda amar rav

La dechulle alma it lehu derav yehuda amar rav vedaat haddayyanin kulle alma la peligi devaenan ki peligi daat baale dinin rabbi meir savar daat baale dinin name baenan verabbanan savri daat haddayyanin baenan daat baale dinin la baenan

Gufa amar rav yehuda amar rav en haedim chotmin al hashshetar ku tanya name hachi kach hau nekiyye haddaat shebbirushalayim osin lo hau chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken yodin mi chotem immahen velo hau yoshvin bedin ella im ken yodin mi yoshev immahen velo hau nichnasin bisuda ella im ken yodin mi mesev immahen
Ze posel dayyano ku kol kemineh defasel dayyane
Amar rabbi yochanan bearkaot shebbesurya shanu aval mumchim lo
Ha middekatane sefa vachachamim omrim ematay bizman shemmevi reaya shehen kerovin o pesulin aval im hau kesherin o mumchin mippi bet din eno yachol lefoslan mikkelal derabbi meir mumchin name kaamar
Hachi kaamar aval im hau kesherin naasu kemumchin mippi bet din veeno yachol lefoslan
Ta shema amru lo lerabbi meir lo kol hemennu shepposel dayyan shemmumche lerabbim
Ema lo kol hemennu shepposel dayyan shehimchuhu rabbim alehem
Tanya name hachi leolam posel veholech ad sheyekabbel alav bet din shemmumche lerabbim divre rabbi meir
Veha edim kemumchin dame veamar rabbi meir ze posel edav shel ze veze posel edav shel ze
Ha itmar alah amar resh lakish pe kadosh yomar davar ze teni edo
Edo lemay ilema lemamon rachamana pasleh i lishvua hemone meheman keve tere
Leolam lemamon la tzericha dekabbeleh aleh keve tere
