May ka mashma lan dematze hadar beh tenena amar lo neeman alay abba neeman alay avicha neemanin alay shelosha roe bakar rabbi meir omer yachol lachazor bo vachachamim omrim eno yachol lachazor bo
b: Veamar rav dimi bereh derav nachman bereh derav yosef kegon dekabbeleh aleh bechad
Tzericha dei tena abba veavich beha kaamri rabbanan dela matze hadar beh mishshum deabba veavich chazu lealma aval chad keve tere dilalma la chaze ema modu leh lerabbi meir
Vei ashmeinan beha beha kaamar rabbi meir aval behahi ema modu lehu lerabbanan tzericha
Ha middekatane resha dayyano vesefa edav alma daveka katane
Amar rabbi elazar beva hu veacher lefoslan
Kol kemineh nogea beeduto hu
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika kegon shekkara alav arar
Arar demay ilema arar degazlanuta kol kemineh nogea beeduto hu
Ella arar difgam mishpacha rabbi meir savar hane ammishpacha kamashadi veihu mimmela kafasel verabbanan savri sof sof nogea beeduto hu
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan machaloket bishte kite edim
Derabbi meir savar tzarich levarer verabbanan savri eno tzarich levarer aval bechat achat divre hakkol en yachol lefoslan
Amru lefanav rav amme verav assi en sham ella kat achat mahu
En sham ella kat achat vehaamratte aval bechat achat divre hakkol en yachol lefoslan ella nimtzet kat sheniyya kerovin o fesulin mahu
Amar lahen kevar heidu edim harishonim ika deamri amar rav ashe kevar heidu edim harishonim
Nema biflugta derabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel kamipalgi
Detanya habba lidon bishtar uvachazaka nidon bishtar divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer nidon bachazaka
Vehavenan bah bachazaka velo bishtar ella ema af bachazaka
Vekayema lan divtzarich levarer peligi
La alliba derabban shimon ben gamliel kulle alma la peligi ki peligi alliba derabbi derabbi meir kerabbi
Verabbanan amri lach ad kan la kaamar rabbi hatam ella bachazaka demikkoach shetara kaate aval hacha dehane edim lav mikkoach edim acharine kaatu afilu rabbi mode deen tzarich levarer
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan resha

a: Beedim pesulin vedayyanin kesherin migo defasli ede pasli name dayyane sefa bedayyanin pesulin veedim kesherin demigo defasli dayyane pasli name ede
Matkef lah rava bishlama migo defasli ede pasli name dayyane ika be dina acharina ella migo defasli dayyane pasli name ede veha edim tu leka
La tzericha deika kat acheret
Ha leka kat acheret may hachi name dela matze pasli hayenu derav dimi
Ika benayehu migo demar savar amrinan migo umar savar la amrinan migo
Gufa amar resh lakish pe kadosh yomar davar ze teni edo
Ini vehaamar ulla haroe et resh lakish bevet hammidrash keilu oker harim vetochanan ze baze
Amar ravina vahalo kol haroe rabbi meir bevet hammidrash keilu oker hare harim vetochanan ze baze
Hachi kaamar ba ure kamma mechabbevin ze et ze
Ki ha deyatev rabbi vekaamar asur lehatmin et hatztzonen amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose abba hittir lehatmin et hatztzonen amar lahem kevar hora zaken

Amar rav pappa bo ure kamma mechabbevin ze et ze deilu rabbi yose kayyam haya kafuf veoshev lifne rabbi deha rabbi yishmael berabbi yose memalle mekom avotav hava vehaya kafuf veoshev lifne rabbi veka amar kevar hora zaken

Amar rabbi oshaya may dichtiv vaekkach li et shene maklot leachad karati noam ulachad karati chovlim noam ellu talmide chachamim shebbeeretz yisrael shemmanimin ze laze bahalacha chovlim ellu talmide chachamim shebbevavel shemmechabbelim ze laze bahalacha

Vayyomer elay elle shene vene hayyitzhar haomdim vego ushnayim zetim aleha yitzhar amar rabbi yitzchak ellu talmide chachamim shebbeeretz yisrael shennochin ze laze bahalacha keshemen zayit ushnayim zetim aleha ellu talmide chachamim shebbevavel shemmerorin ze laze bahalacha kezayit

Vaessa enay vaere vehinne shettayim nashim yotzot veruach bechanfehem velahenna chenafayim kechanfe hachasida vattissena haefa ben hashshamayim uven haaretz vaomar el hammalach haddover bi ana hemma molichot et haefa vayyomer elay livnot la vayit beeretz shinar amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay zo chanuppa vegassut haruach sheyyardu levavel
Vegassut haruach levavel nechit vehaamar mar asara kabbin gassut yardu leolam tisha natla elam veachat kol haolam kullo
In levavel nechit veishtarbove hu deishtarbav leelam dayeka name dichtiv livnot la vayit beeretz shinar shema minah

Vehaamar mar siman legassut haruach aniyyut vaaniyyut levavel nechit may aniyyut aniyyut tora dichtiv achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah amar rabbi yochanan zo elam shezzachta lilmod velo zachta lelammed
May bavel amar rabbi yochanan belula bammikra belula bammishna belula battalmud bemachashakkim hoshivani kemete olam amar rabbi yirmeya ze talmudah shel bavel
Matni amar lo neeman alay abba neeman alay avicha neemanim alay shelosha roe bakar rabbi meir omer yachol lachzor bo vachachamim omrim eno yachol lachzor bo
Haya chayyav lachavero shevua veamar lo dor li bechayye roshecha rabbi meir omer yachol lachzor bo vachachamim omrim en yachol lachzor bo
Gema amar rav dimi bereh derav nachman bereh derav yosef kegon dekabbeleh aleh bechad
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel machloket bemachul lach aval beetten lach divre hakkol yachol lachzor bo verabbi yochanan amar beetten lach machloket
Ibaya lehu beetten lach machloket aval bemachul lach divre hakkol en yachol lachzor bo o dilma ben bazo uven bazo machloket
Ta shema deamar rava machloket beetten lach aval bemachul lach divre hakkol en yachol lachzor bo
I amratte bishlama beetten lach machloket aval bemachul lach divre hakkol en yachol lachzor bo rava deamar kerabbi yochanan ella i amratte ben bazo uven bazo machloket rava deamar keman
Rava tama denafsheh kaamar
Etiveh rav acha bar tachlifa lerava haya chayyav lachavero shevua veamar lo dor li bechayye roshecha rabbi meir omer yachol lachzor bo vachachamim omrim en yachol lachzor bo
b: May lav beotan hannishbain velo meshallemin dahava leh kemachul lach
La beotan hannishbain venotlin dehave leh keetten lach
Veha tena leh resha
Tena tole bedaat acherim utna tole bedaat atzmo
Utzricha dei tena tole bedaat acherim beha kaamar rabbi meir dematze hadar beh mishshum dela gamar umakne deamar mi yemar dimzakke leh aval tole bedaat atzmo ema mode lehu lerabbanan
Vei ashmeinan beha beha kaamri rabbanan aval behahi ema modu leh rabbanan lerabbi meir tzericha
Amar resh lakish machloket lifne gemar din aval leachar gemar din divre hakkol en yachol lachzor bo verabbi yochanan amar leachar gemar din machloket
Ibaya lehu leachar gemar din machloket aval lifne gemar din divre hakkol yachol lachzor bo o dilma ben bazo uven bazo machloket
Ta shema deamar rava kibel alav karov o pasul lifne gemar din yachol lachzor bo leachar gemar din en yachol lachzor bo

I amratte bishlama leachar gemar din machloket aval lifne gemar din divre hakkol yachol lachzor bo rava deamar kerabbi yochanan vealliba derabbanan ella i amratte ben bazo ben bazo machloket rava deamar keman
Ella lav shema minah leachar gemar din machloket shema minah

Shelach leh rav nachman bar rav chisda lerav nachman bar yaakov yelammedenu rabbenu lifne gemar din machloket o leachar gemar din machloket vahalacha kedivre mi shelach leh leachar gemar din machloket vahalacha kedivre chachamim
Rav ashe amar hachi shelach leh beetten lach machloket o bemachul lach machloket vahalacha kedivre mi shelach leh beetten lach machloket vahalacha kedivre chachamim
Besura matnu hachi befumbedita matnu hachi amar rav chanina bar shelemya shelachu leh mibbe rav lishmuel yelammedenu rabbenu lifne gemar din vekanu miyyado may shelach lehu en leachar kinyan kelum
Matni veellu hen happesulin hamsachek bekuvya vehammalve beribit umafriche yonim vesochare sheviit
Amar rabbi shimon battechila hau korin otan osfe sheviit mishsherabbu haannasin chazru likrotan sochare sheviit
Amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman sheen lahen ummanut ella hu aval yesh lahen ummanut shello hu kesherin
Gema mesachek bekuvya may ka aved amar rame bar chama mishshum dehave asmachta veasmachta la kanya
Rav sheshet amar kol ki hay gavena lav asmachta hi ella lefi sheen asukin beyishuvo shel olam
May benayehu ika benayehu digmar ummanuta achariti
Utnan amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman sheen lahen ummanut ella hu aval yesh lahen ummanut shello hu hare ze kesherim alma tama dematnitin mishshum yishuvo shel olam hu kashya lerame bar chama
Vechi tema peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yehuda veha amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol makom sheamar rabbi yehuda

a: Ematay uvamme eno ella lefaresh divre chachamim
Rabbi yochanan amar ematay lefaresh uvamme lachlok udchulle alma ematay lefaresh hu
Gavra aggavra ka ramet mar savar peligi umar savar la peligi
Vela peligi vehatanya ben sheyyesh lo ummanut shello hu ben sheen lo ummanut ella hu hare ze pasul
Hahi rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi tarfon hi detanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon leolam en echad mehen nazir lefi shello nittena nezirut ella lehaflaa
Malve beribbit amar rava lava beribbit pasul leedut vehaanan tenan malve beribbit milva habbaa beribbit
Bar binitos ashidu beh tere sahade chad amar kamme didi ozef beribita vechad amar ledidi ozfan beribita pasleh rava levar binitos
Veha rava hu deamar lava beribbit pasul leedut vehave leh rasha vehattora amra al tashet rasha ed
Rava letameh deamar rava adam karov etzel atzmo veen adam mesim atzmo rasha
Hahu tabbacha deishtechach dinfaka terefta mittute yedeh pasleh rav nachman veabbereh azal rabbi mazyeh vetufreh sevar rav nachman leachshoreh
Amar leh rava dilma iarome ka maarem

Ella may takkanteh kidrav idi bar avin deamar rav idi bar avin hechashud al hatterefot en lo takkana ad sheyyelech lemakom sheen makkirin oto veyachzir aveda bedavar chashuv o sheyyotzi terefa mittachat yado bedavar chashuv mishshello
Umafriche yonim may mafriche yonim hacha targimu i tikdemeh yonach leon rabbi chama bar oshaya amar ara
Man deamar i tikdemeh yonach leon may tama la amar ara
Amar lach ara mippene darche shalom bealma
Uman deamar ara may tama la amar i tikdemeh yonach leon amar lach hayenu mesachek bekuvya
Veidach
Tena tole bedaat atzmo utna tole bedaat yono
Utzricha dei tena tole bedaat atzmo hatam hu dela gamar umakne deamar
b: Kim li benafshay deyadana tefe aval tole bedaat yono ema la
Vei tena tole bedaat yono deamar benakkasha talya milta vaana yadana lenakkoshe tefe aval tole bedaat atzmo ema la tzericha
Metivi hamsachek bekuvya ellu hen hamsachakim bifsefasim velo bifsefasim bilvad amru ella afilu kelipe egozim uklipe rimonim
Veematay chazaratan mishsheyeshabberu et pesefasehen veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura daafilu bechinnam la avdi
Malve beribit echad hammalve veechad hallove veematay chazaratan mishsheyekaru et shetarehen veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura daafilu legoy la mozfi

Umafriche yonim ellu shemmamrin et hayyonim velo yonim bilvad amru ella afilu behema chayya vaof veematay chazaratan mishsheyeshabberu et pegamehen veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura daafilu bammidbar name la avdi
Sochare sheviit ellu shennosin venotnin beferot sheviit veematay chazaratan mishshettaggia sheviit acheret veyibbadlu
Veamar rabbi nechemya lo chazarat devarim bilvad amru ella chazarat mamon ketzad omer ani peloni bar peloni kinasti matayim zuz beferot sheviit vahare hen netunin bemattana laaniyyim
Katane mihat behema bishlama leman deamar i tikdemeh yonach leon hayenu demashkachatte lah behema ella leman deamar ara behema bat hachi hi
In beshor habbar uchman deamar shor habbar min behema hu ditnan shor habbar min behema hu rabbi yose omer min chayya
Tana hosifu alehen haggazlanin vehachamsanin
Gazlan deorayeta hu lo nitzrecha ella limtziat cheresh shote vekatan
Meikara sevur metziat cheresh shote vekatan la shechicha i name mippene darche shalom bealma kevan dachazo desof sof mamona hu deka shakli paslinhu rabbanan
Hachamsanin meikara sevur deme ka yahev akray bealma hu kevan dachazo deka chatfi gezaru behu rabbanan
Tana od hosifu alehen haroim haggabbain vehammochsin

Roim meikara sevur akray bealma hu kevan dachazo deka mechavveni veshadu lechattechila gezaru behu rabbanan haggabbain vehammochsin meikara sevur may dekitz lehu ka shakli kevan dachazo deka shakli yattira paslinhu
Amar rava roe sheamru echad roe behema dakka veechad roe behema gassa
Umi amar rava hachi vehaamar rava roe behema dakka beeretz yisrael pesulin bechutza laaretz kesherin roe behema gassa afilu beeretz yisrael kesherin hahu bimgaddelim itmar
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane neemanin alay shelosha roe vakar may lav leedut
La ledina dayeka name dekatane shelosha roe vakar vei leedut shelosha lema li
Veella may ledina may irya shelosha roe vakar kol be telata dela gemiri dina name
Hachi kaamar afilu hane dela shechichi bayyishuv
Amar rav yehuda setam roe pasul setam gabbay kasher

Avuh derabbi zera avad gavuta telesar shenin ki hava ate resh nahara lemata ki hava chaze rabbanan amar lehu lech ammi bo vachadarecha ki hava chaze inashe demata amar resh nahara ata lemata vehaidana naches abba lefum bera uvra lefum abba

a: Umiganzu kulle alma ki ate amar leh mimman nive
Ki nicha nafsheh amar lehu shekulu telesar mae detzayeri li bisdinay veahdaru leh liflanya dishkaltinhu mineh vela itzterichu li
Amar rabbi shimon battechila hau korin otan osfe sheviit
May kaamar amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar battechila hau omrim osfe sheviit kesherin socharin pesulin
Mishsherabbu mamtzie maot laaniyyim veazli aniyyim veasfi lehu umayetu chazru lomar echad ze veechad ze pesulin
Kashu bah bene rachava hay mishsherabbu haannasim mishsherabbu hattaggarin mibe leh

Ella battechila hau omrim echad ze veechad ze pesulin mishsherabbu haannasin umay ninhu arnona kidmachriz rabbi yannay puku uzrau bashsheviit mishshum arnona chazru lomar osfin kesherin socharin pesulin
Rabbi chiyya bar zarnoke verabbi shimon ben yehotzadak hao kaazli leabber shana beasya pega behu resh lakish itappal bahadayehu amar ezil ichze hechi avdi ovada
Chazyeh lehahu gavra deka charev amar lahen kohen vechoresh amru lo yachol lomar aggistevan ani betocho
Tu chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava kasach becharme amar lahen kohen vezamar amru lo yachol lomar leekel bet habbad ani tzarich amar lahem hallev yodea im leekel im laakalkallot
He amar lehu beresha ilema ha kammayeta amar lehu beresha ha name lemru aggistevan ani betocho ella ha amar lehu beresha vahadar amar lehu hach
May shena kohen mishshum dachashidi ashsheviit
Ditnan sea teruma shennafla lemea sein shel sheviit taale pachot miken yerakvu
Vehavenan bah ammay yerakvu yimkerennu lakkohen bidme teruma chutz middeme otah sea
Veamar rav chiyya mishshemeh deulla zot omeret nechshedu kohanim ashsheviit
Amru taroda hu den ki meto lehatam seliku leigara shallefuh ledarga mittuteh
Ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh bene adam hachashudin al hashsheviit kesherin leabber shana
Hadar amar la kashya li mide dehave ashshelosha roe vakar verabbanan achushbanayehu semuch
Vahadar amar la dame hatam hadur imno rabbanan veabberuha lehahi shatta hacha kesher reshaim hu vekesher reshaim eno min hamminyan amar rabbi yochanan da aka
Ki ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan amaru leh kare lan roe vakar vela amar leh mar vela mide amar lehu vei kare lechu roe tzon may amena leh
May kesher reshaim shevna hava daresh bitlesar ribbevata chizkiyya hava daresh bechad sar ribbevata
Ki ata sancheriv vetzar alah dirushlem ketav shevna pitka sheda begira shevna vesiato hishlimu chizkiyya vesiato lo hishlimu shenneemar ki hinne harshaim yidrechun keshet konnu chitztzam al yeter

Hava ka mistefe chizkiyya amar dilma chas veshalom natya dateh dekudsha berich hu batar rubba kevan derubba mimasri inhu name mimasri ba navi veamar lo lo tomrun kesher lechol asher yomar haam hazze kasher kelomar kesher reshaim hu vekesher reshaim eno min hamminyan
Halach lachtzov lo kever bekivre bet david ba navi veamar lo ma lecha fo umi lecha fo ki chatzavta lecha po kaver hinne Adonai metaltelcha taltela gaver
Amar rav tiltula degavra kashe middeitta
Veotcha ato amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina melammed shepparcha bo tzaraat ketiv hacha veotcha ato uchtiv hatam veal safam yate
Tzanof yitznofcha tzenefa kaddur el eretz rachavat yadayim vego tana hu bikesh kelon bet adonav lefichach nehpach kevodo lekalon ki hava nafek ihu ata gavriel achdeh ledashsha beappe mashreyateh
b: Amaru leh mashryatach hecha amar hadaru bi amaru leh im ken achoche ka machyechatte ban nekavuhu baakavav utlauhu bezanve susehem vehau megarrin oto al hakkotzim veal habbarkanin
Amar rabbi elazar shevna baal hanaa haya ketiv hacha lech bo el hassochen hazze uchtiv hatam vattehi lo sochenet

Veomer ki hashshatot yeharesun tzaddik ma paal rav yehuda verav ena chad amar ilu chizkiyya vesiato neherasim tzaddik ma paal vechad amar ilu bet hammikdash yahares tzaddik ma paal veulla amar ilu machshevotav shel oto rasha enan neherasot tzaddik ma paal
Bishlama leman deamar ilu machshevotav shel oto rasha hayenu dichtiv ki hashshatot yeharesun
Ulman deamar bet hammikdash name ditnan even hayeta sham mimot neviim harishonim ushtiyya hayeta nikret
Ella leman deamar chizkiyya vesiato hecha ashkechan tzaddike deikru shatot
Dichtiv ki la metzuke eretz vayyashet alehem tevel veibaet ema mehacha hifli etza higdil tushiyya

Amar rabbi chanan lamma nikra shemah tushiyya mippene shehi matteshet kocho shel adam davar acher tushiyya shennitna bachashay mippene hassatan davar acher tushiyya devarim shel tohu shehaolam meshuttat alehem
Amar ulla machshava moelet afilu ledivre tora shenneemar mefer machshevot arumim velo taasena yedehem tushiyya
Amar rabba im asukin lishmah enah moelet shenneemar rabbot machashavot belev ish vaatzat Adonai hi takum etza sheyyesh bah devar Adonai hi takum leolam
Amar rabbi yehuda ematay amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar halacha kerabbi yehuda
Veamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar kullan tzerichin hachraza bevet din
Roe peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar bae hachraza vechad amar la bae hachraza
Bishlama leman deamar la bae hachraza hayenu deamar rav yehuda amar rav setam roe pasul ella leman deamar bae hachraza may setam roe pasul
Devistama machrezinan aleh
Hahi mattana dahao chatimi alah teren gazlanin sevar rav pappa bar shemuel leachshorah deha la achrezinan alayehu
Amar leh rava nehi devaenan hachraza begazlan derabbanan begazlan deorayeta mi baenan hachraza
Siman davar vaaraot gannav
Amar rav nachman ochle davar acher pesulin leedut
Hane mile befarhesya aval betzina la uvfarhesya name la amaran ella deefshar leh leitzone betzina veka mevazze nafsheh befarhesya aval la efshar leh chayyuteh hu
Amar rav nachman hechashud al haaraot kasher leedut amar rav sheshet ani mari arbein bechatpeh vechasher
Amar rava umode rav nachman leinyan edut ishsha shehu pasul amar ravina veitema rav pappa la amaran ella leappokah aval leayyolah let lan bah
Peshita mahu detema ha adifa leh dichtiv mayim genuvim yimtaku vego ka mashma lan dechamma dekayema hachi shechicha leh
Veamar rav nachman gannav nisan vegannav tishre la shemeh gannav
Vehane mile baarisa vedavar muat uvdavar shennigmera melachto
Ikareh derav zevid chad genav kabba disare ufasleh vechad genav kibura daahine ufasleh
Hanhu kavorae dikvur nafsha beom tov rishon shel atzeret shammetinhu rav pappa ufaslinhu leedut veachsherinhu rav huna bereh derav yehoshua
Amar leh rav pappa veha reshaim ninhu savri mitzva ka avdi
Veha ka meshammetinan lehu savri kappara ka avdi lan rabbanan
Itmar

a: Ed zomem abbaye amar lemafrea hu nifsal verava amar mikan ulhabba hu nifsal
Abbaye amar lemafrea hu nifsal meidana deashed rasha hu vehattora amra al tashet yadcha im rasha al tashet rasha ed
Rava amar mikan ulhabba hu nifsal ed zomem chidush hu may chazet desamchatte ahane semoch ahane en lach bo ella mishsheat chidusho veelach
Ika deamri rava name keabbayye sevira leh umay taam kaamar mikkan ulhabba mishshum peseda delakochot
May benayehu ika benayehu deashidu be tere bechad i name defaslinhu begazlanuta
Veamar rabbi yirmeya middifti avad rav pappi ovada kevateh derava mar bar rav ashe amar hilcheta kevateh deabbaye
Vehilcheta kevateh deabbaye beyaal kagam
Mumar ochel nevelot leteavon divre hakkol pasul
Lehachis abbaye amar pasul rava amar kasher
Abbaye amar pasul dehave leh rasha verachamana amar al tashet rasha ed verava amar kasher rasha dechamas baenan
Metivi al tashet rasha ed al tashet chamas ed ellu gazlanin umoalin bishvuot may lav echad shevuat shave veechad shevuat mamon
La idi veidi shevuat mamon umay shevuot shevuot dealma
Metivi al tashet rasha ed al tashet chamas ed ellu gazlanin umalve ribbiyyot teuvta deabbaye teuvta
Nema ketannae ed zomem pasul lechol hattora kullah divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer bamme devarim amurim shehuzam bedine nefashot aval huzam bedine mamonot kasher ledine nefashot
Nema abbaye kerabbi meir verava kerabbi yose abbaye kerabbi meir deamar amrinan mikkulla lechumra verava deamar kerabbi yose deamar mechumra lekulla amrinan mikkulla lechumra la amrinan
La alliba derabbi yose kulle alma la feligi ki peligi alliba derabbi meir
Abbaye kerabbi meir verava ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella gabbe ed zomem demamon dera lashshamayim vera labberiyyot aval hacha dera lashshamayim veen ra labberiyyot la
Vehilcheta kevateh deabbaye veha itotav hahi rabbi yose hi
Vetihve name rabbi yose rabbi meir verabbi yose halacha kerabbi yose
Shane hatam distam lan tena kerabbi meir vehecha setam lan

Ki ha devar chama ketal nafsha amar leh resh galuta lerav abba bar yaakov pok ayyen bah i vadday ketal lichhauh leeneh ato tere sahadi ashidu beh devadday ketal azal ihu ayeti tere sahade ashidu beh bechad mehanach chad amar kammay didi genav kabba dechushla vechad amar kammay didi genav
b: Katta devurteya
Amar leh may datach kerabbi meir rabbi meir verabbi yose halacha kerabbi yose verabbi yose haamar huzam bedine mamonot kasher ledine nefashot
Amar leh rav pappe hane mile hecha dela setam lan tanna kerabbi meir hacha setam lan tanna kerabbi meir

Mimmay ilema meha ditnan kol harauy ladun dine nefashot rauy ladun dine mamonot manni ilema rabbi yose hi ha ika ed zomem demamon dechasher ledine nefashot ufasul ledine mamonot ella lav rabbi meir hi
Mimmay dilma bifsule yuchasin kae

Dei la tema hachi sefa dekatane yesh rauy ladun dine mamonot veen rauy ladun dine nefashot ammay eno rauy deitazzam bedine nefashot rauy ladun dine mamonot veha divre hakkol pasul hu ella bifsul yuchasin kae hacha name bifsul yuchasin kae

Ella hacha ka satam lan tena ditnan ellu hen happesulim hamsachek bekuvya umalve beribbit umafriche yonim vesochare sheviit vehaavadim ze hakkelal kol edut sheen haishsha keshera lah af hen en kesherin lah
Manni ilema rabbi yose vehaika edut bedine nefashot sheen haishsha keshera lah vehen kesherin lah ella lav rabbi meir hi
Kam bar chama nashshekeh akkareh vekabbeleh lichrageh dechulle sheneh
Matni veellu hen hakkerovin achiv vaachi aviv vaachi immo uvaal achoto uvaal achot aviv uvaal achot immo uvaal immo vechamiv vegiso hen uvnehen vechatnehen vechorgo levaddo
Amar rabbi yose zo mishnat rabbi akiva aval mishna rishona dodo uven dodo vechol harauy leorsho vechol hakkarov lo beotah shaa
Haya karov venitrachek hare ze kasher rabbi yehuda omer afilu meta bitto veyesh lo banim mimmenna hare ze karov
Haohev vehassone ohev ze shoshvino sone kol shello dibber immo shelosha yamim beeva amru lo lo nechshedu yisrael al kach
Gema menahane mile detanu rabbanan lo yumtu avot al banim ma talmud lomar im lelammed shello yumtu avot baaon banim uvanim baaon avot hare kevar neemar ish becheto yumatu
Ella lo yumtu avot al banim beedut banim uvanim lo yumtu al avot beedut avot
Uvanim baaon avot la vehachtiv poked aon avot al banim
Hatam kesheochazin maase avotehen bidehen

Kidtanya veaf baaonot avotam ittam yimmakku kesheochazin maase avotehem bidehem atta omer kesheochazin o eno ella kesheen ochazin keshehu omer ish becheto yumatu hare kesheochazin maase avotehen bidehen
Vela vehachtiv vechashlu ish beachiv ish baaon achiv melammed shekkullan arevim ze baze
Hatam shehaya beyadam limchot velo michu

a: Ashkechan avot levanim uvanim leavot
Vechol shekken avot lahadade
Banim levanim menalan
Im ken lichtov kera lo yumtu avot al ben may banim daafilu banim lahadade
Ashkechan banim lahadade banim lealma menalan
Amar rame bar chama sevara hu kidtanya en haedim naasin zommin ad sheyyizzommu shenehen vei salka datach banim lealma kesherin nimtza ed zomem neherag beedut achiv
Amar leh rava velitamach ha ditnan shelosha achin veechad mitztaref immahen hare ellu shalosh ediyyot vehen edut achat lahazama
Nimtza ed zomem meshallem mamon beedut achiv
Ella hazama mealma kaate hacha name hazama mealma kaate
Ella im ken lichtov kera uven al avot i name hem al avot may uvanim afilu banim lealma
Ashkechan kerove haav kerove haem menalan amar kera avot avot tere zimne im eno inyan likrove haav tenehu inyan likrove haem
Ashkechan lechova lizchut mena lan
Amar kera yumtu yumtu tere zimne im eno inyan lechova tenehu inyan lizchut
Ashkechan bedine nefashot bedine mamonot menalan
Amar kera mishpat echad yihye lachem mishpat hashshave lachem
Amar rav achi abba lo yaid li hu uvno vachatano af ani lo aid lo ani uvni vachatani
Veammay have leh shelishi berishon vaanan sheni besheni tenan shene berishon tenan shelishi berishon la tenan
May chatano dekatane bematnitin chatan beno
Velitne ben beno
Milta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan devaal keishto
Veella ha detane rabbi chiyya shemona avot shehen esrim vearbaa hane telatin vetarten have
Ella leolam chatano mammash veammay kare leh chatan beno kevan demealma kaate kedor acher dame
I hachi have leh shelishi besheni verav achshar shelishi besheni
Ella rav deamar kerabbi elazar detanya rabbi elazar omer keshem sheachi abba lo yaid li hu uvno vachatano kach ben achi abba lo yaid li hu uvno vachatano
Veakkatti have leh shelishi besheni verav achshar shelishi besheni
Rav savar leh kevateh bachada uflig aleh bachada
May tama derav deamar kera lo yumtu avot al banim uvanim lerabbot dor acher
Verabbi elazar al banim amar rachamana pesule deavot shedi abbanim
Amar rav nachman achi chamoti lo yaid li ben achi chamoti lo yaid li ben achot chamoti lo yaid li utna tuna baal achoto uvaal achot aviv uvaal achot immo hen uvnehen vechatnehen
Amar rav ashe ki havenan be ulla ibi lan achi chamiv mahu ben achi chamiv mahu ben achot chamiv mahu
Amar lan tenetuha achiv vaachi aviv vaachi immo hen uvnehen vechatnehen
Rav ikla lemizban
b: Gevile beo mineh mahu sheyyaid adam beeshet chorgo
Besura amri baal keishto

Befumbedita amri ishsha kevalah deamar rav huna amar rav nachman minnayin shehaishsha kevalah dichtiv ervat achi avicha lo tegalle el ishto lo tikrav dodatcha hi vahalo eshet dodo hi mikkelal deishsha kevalah
Uvaal immo hu uvno vachatano beno hayenu achiv
Amar rabbi yirmeya lo nitzrecha ella laachi haach
Rav chisda achshar baachi haach amaru leh la shemia lach ha derabbi yirmeya amar lehu la shemia li kelomar la sevira li
I hachi hayenu achiv tena achiv min haav vekatane achiv min haem
Amar rav chisda avi chatan vaavi kalla meidin ze al ze vela damu lahadade ella ki achla ledanna
Amar rabba bar bar chana meid adam leishto arusa amar ravina la amaran ella leappoke minah aval leayyole lah la meheman
Vela hi la shena leappoke vela shena leayyole la meheman
May datach kidamar rabbi chiyya bar amme mishshemeh deulla ishto arusa lo onen velo mittamme lah vechen hi lo onenet velo mittammea lo meta eno yorshah met hu gova ketubbatah
Hatam bishero tela rachamana akkatti lav sheero hi hacha mishshum ikarove data hu veha ikarava dateh legabbah
Chorgo levaddo tanu rabbanan chorgo levaddo rabbi yose omer giso vetanya idach giso levaddo rabbi yehuda omer chorgo

May kaamar ilema hachi kaamar chorgo levaddo vehu haddin legiso vaata rabbi yose lememar giso levaddo vehu haddin lechorgo ella matnitin dekatane giso hu uvno vachatano manni la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yose
Veella hachi kaamar chorgo levaddo aval giso hu uvno vachatano vaata rabbi yose lememar giso levaddo aval chorgo hu uvno vachatano
Veella ha detane rabbi chiyya shemona avot shehen esrim vearbaa keman la kerabbi yose vela kerabbi yehuda
Ella hachi kaamar chorgo levaddo aval giso hu uvno vachatano vaata rabbi yose lememar giso levaddo vechol shekken chorgo umatnitin rabbi yehuda barayeta rabbi yose
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose
Hahi mattanta dahao chatimi alah tere gise sevar rav yosef leachshorah deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose
Amar leh abbaye mimmay derabbi yose dematnitin demachshar begiso dilma rabbi yose devarayeta defasel begiso
La salka datach deamar shemuel kegon ana ufinchas dehavenan ache vegise aval gise dealma shappir dame
Vedilma kegon ana ufinchas mishshum giso kaamar
Amar leh zil kanyah beede mesira kerabbi elazar
Vehaamar rabbi abba mode rabbi elazar bimzuyyaf mittocho shehu pasul amar leh zil la shavki li deotvineh lach

Rabbi yehuda omer ku amar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi tavla amar rabbi berona amar rav halacha kerabbi yehuda rava amar rav nachman en halacha kerabbi yehuda vechen amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan en halacha kerabbi yehuda

Ika dematne lah leha derabba bar bar chana aha et zo darash rabbi yose haggelili uvata el hakkohanim halviyyim veel hashshofet asher yihye bayyamim hahem vechi taale al datecha sheadam holech etzel shofet shello haya beyamav ella ze shehaya karov venitrachek
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yose haggelili
Bene chamuh demar ukva

a: Kerovim venitrachaku hao ato lekammeh ledina amar lehu pesilna lechu ledina
Amaru leh may datach kerabbi yehuda anan mayetinan igarta mimmareva deen halacha kerabbi yehuda
Amar lehu attu bekabba dekira idvakna bechu dela kaamena pesilna lechu ledina ella mishshum dela tzayetitu dina
Ohev ze shoshvino vechu
Vechamma amar rabbi abba amar rabbi yirmeya amar rav kol shivat yeme hammishte verabbanan mishshemeh derava amri afilu miyyom rishon veelach
Hassone kol shello dibber ku tanu rabbanan vehu lo oyev lo yeidennu velo mevakkesh raato yedinennu
Ashkechan sone ohev menalan
Kare beh hachi vehu lo oyev lo velo ohev lo yeidennu velo mevakkesh raato velo tovato yedinennu
Mide ohev ketiv ella sevara hu oyev may tama mishshum dimrachaka dateh ohev name mekarva dateh
Verabbanan hay lo oyev lo velo mevakkesh raato may darshi beh
Chad ledayyan
Idach kidtanya amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda vehu lo oyev lo velo mevakkesh raato mikkan lishne talmide chachamim shessonin ze et ze sheen yoshvin baddin keechad
Matni ketzad bodkim et haedim hau machnisin otan lacheder umayemin alehen umotziin et kol haadam lachutz umshayerin et haggadol shebbahen
Veomrim lo emor heach atta yodea shezze chayyav laze im amar hu amar li sheani chayyav lo ish peloni amar li shehu chayyav lo lo amar kelum ad sheyyomar befanenu hoda lo shehu chayyav lo matayim zuz
Veachar kach machnisin et hashsheni uvodkin oto im nimtzeu divrehen mechuvanin nosin venotnin baddavar

Shenayim omrim zakkay veechad omer chayyav zakkay shenayim omrim chayyav veechad omer zakkay chayyav echad omer chayyav veechad omer zakkay afilu shenayim mezakkin o shenayim mechayevin veechad omer eni yodea yosifu haddayyanin
Gamru et haddavar hau machnisin otan haggadol shebbaddayyanin omer ish peloni atta zakkay ish peloni atta chayyav
Uminnayin lichsheyyetze lo yomar ani mezakke vachaveray mechayevim aval ma eese shechaveray rabbu alay al ze neemar lo telech rachil beammecha veomer holech rachil megalle sod
Gema hechi amrinan lehu amar rav yehuda hachi amrinan lehu nesiim veruach vegeshem ayin ish mithallel bemattat shaker
Amar leh rava yachli lememar shav shene hava kafna veabbava ummana la chalef
Ella amar rava amrinan lehu mefitz vecherev vechetz shanun ish one vereehu ed shaker
Amar leh rav ashe yachli lememar shav shene hava motana veinish bela sheneh la shechev
Ella amar rav ashe amar li natan bar mar zutra amrinan lehu sahade shakkare aograyehu zili dichtiv vehoshivu shenayim anashim bene veliyyaal negdo viiduhu lemor berachta elohim vamelech
Im amar hu amar li ku ad sheyyomru befanenu hoda lo shehu chayyav lo matayim zuz
Mesayya leh lerav yehuda deamar rav yehuda amar rav tzarich sheyyomar attem eday
Itmar name amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan mane li beyadecha amar lo hen lemachar amar lo tenehu li amar meshatte ani bach patur
Tanya name hachi mane li beyadecha amar lo hen lemachar amar lo tenehu li amar lo meshatte ani bach patur

Velo od ella afilu hichmin lo edim achore gader veamar lo mane li beyadecha amar lo hen retzoncha shettode bifne peloni ufloni amar lo mityare ani shemma tichpeni ledin lemachar amar lo tenehu li amar lo meshatte ani bach patur
Veen toanin lammesit
Mesit man dechar shemeh chassore michassera vehachi katane im lo taan en toanin lo uvdine nefashot af al gav dela taan toanin lo veen toanin lammesit
May shena mesit amar rabbi chama bar chanina mippirkeh derabbi chiyya bar abba shemia li shane mesit derachamana amar lo tachmol velo techasse alav

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yonatan minnayin sheen toanin lammesit minnachash hakkadmoni deamar rabbi simlay harbe teanot haya lo lannachash liton velo taan umippene ma lo taan lo hakkadosh baruch hu lefi shello taan hu
May hava leh lememar divre harav vedivre talmid divre mi shomin divre harav shomin
Amar chizkiyya minnayin shekkol hammosif gorea shenneemar amar elohim lo tochlu mimmennu velo tiggeu bo
Rav mesharsheya amar mehacha ammatayim vachetzi orko
Rav ashe amar ashte esre yeriot
Amar abbaye lo shanu ella deamar meshatte ani bach aval amar
b: Lo hau devarim meolam huchzak kafran
Amar rav pappa bereh derav acha bar adda hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava kol mile dichdi la dechiri inashe
Hahu deachmen leh edim lechavreh bechilteh amar leh mane li bidach amar leh hen amar ere veshachve leheo alach sahade amar leh la amar rav kahana ha amar leh la
Hahu deachmen edim bekivra lechavreh amar leh mane li bidach amar leh hen chayye umite leheo alach sahadi amar leh la amar rabbi shimon ben lakish ha amar leh la

Amar ravina veitema rav pappa shema minah meha ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav tzarich sheyyomar attem eday la shena ki amar love vela shena ki amar malve veshatek love tama deamar love la aval i shatek hachi name
Hahu dahava karu leh kav rashu amar man massek bi ella peloni ufloni ato tavuhv ledina kammeh derav nachman
Amar rav nachman adam asuy shello lehasbia et atzmo
Hahu dahao karu leh achbera deshachev addinare ki ka shachev amar pelanya uflanya masseku bi zuze batar dishchev ato tavinhu leorshin
Ato lekammeh derabbi yishmael berabbi yose amar lehu ki amrinan adam asuy shello lehasbia et atzmo hane mile mechayyim aval leachar mita la

Perau palga tavinhu ledina leidach palga ato lekammeh derabbi chiyya amar lehu keshem sheadam asuy shello lehasbia et atzmo kach adam asuy shello lehasbia et banav amaru leh nezil venahdar amar lehu kevar hora zaken
Hoda bifne shenayim vekanu miyyado kotvin veim lav en kotvin
Bifne shelosha velo kanu miyyado rav amme amar kotvin verav assi amar en kotvin hava ovada vechash lah rav leha derav assi
Amar rav adda bar ahava ha odita zimnin katvinan vezimnin la katvinan kenifi veyatvi la katvinan kanfinhu ihu katvinan
Rava amar afilu kanfinhu ihu la katvinan ad deamar lehu heo alay dayyane
Mar bar rav ashe amar afilu amar heo alay dayyane la katvinan ad dekavi duchta veshalchi umazmeni leh leve dina
Hoda bemittaltele vekanu miyyado kotvin veim lav en kotvin bimkarkee velo kanu miyyado may ammemar amar en kotvin mar zutra amar kotvin vehilcheta kotvin
Ravina ikla ledimharya amar leh rav dimi bar rav huna middimharya leravina mittalteli veitanhu beenayehu may amar leh kimkarkee damu rav ashe amar kevan dimchasseri guvyana la
Hahi odita dela hava ketiv bah amar lana ketuvu vachatumu vehavu leh abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu hayenu deresh lakish
Deamar resh lakish chazaka en haedim chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken naasa gadol
Matkef lah rav pappe veitema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua mi ika mide daanan la yadinan vesafre deve dina yadi
Sheelinhu lesafre deabbaye veyadi lesafre derava veyadi
Hahi odita dahava ketiv bah duchran pitgame

a: Vechol lishane deve dina vela hava ketiv bah bemotav telata havena vechad letohi
Sevar ravina lememar hayenu deresh lakish amar leh rav natan bar amme hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava kol ki hay gavena chayeshinan levet din toin
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak i ketiv bah be dina tu la tzerich
Vedilma bet din chatzuf hu deamar shemuel shenayim sheddanu dinehen din ella shennikreu bet din chatzuf dichtiv bah be dina deravna ashe
Vedilma rabbanan deve rav ashe kishmuel sevira lehu dichtiv bah vaamarna leh lerabbana ashe vaamar lan rabbana ashe
Tanu rabbanan amar lahen echad ani raiti avichem shehitmin maot beshida teva umigdal veamar shel peloni hen shel maaser sheni hen babbayit lo amar kelum bassade devarav kayyamin
Kelalo shel davar kol shebbeyado litlan devarav kayyamin en beyado litlan lo amar kelum
Hare sherau et avihen shehitmin maot beshida teva umigdal veamar shel peloni hen shel maaser sheni hen im kemoser devarav kayyamin im kemaarim lo amar kelum
Hare shehaya mitztaer al maot shehinniach lo aviv uva baal hachalom veamar lo kach vechach hen bemakom peloni hen shel maaser sheni hen ze haya maase veamru divre chalomot lo maalin velo moridin
Shenayim omrim zakkay ku michtav hechi katvi
Rabbi yochanan amar zakkay resh lakish amar peloni ufloni mezakkin ufloni ufloni mechayevin rabbi eliezer amar middivrehen nizdakka peloni
May benayehu ika benayehu leshallome ihu menata bahadayehu dilman deamar zakkay meshallem ulman deamar peloni ufloni mezakkin ufloni ufloni mechayevin la meshallem
Ulman deamar zakkay meshallem lema lehu i ledidi tzayetitun attun name la meshallemitun
Ella ika benayehu leshallome inhu menata dideh leman deamar zakkay meshallemi leman deamar peloni ufloni mezakkin ufloni ufloni mechayevin la meshallemi
Ulman deamar zakkay meshallemi velemru leh i lav atte bahadan la hava salek dina mide
Ella ika benayehu mishshum lo telech rachil beammecha rabbi yochanan amar zakkay mishshum lo telech rachil
Resh lakish amar peloni ufloni mezakkin ufloni ufloni mechayevin mishshum demichaze keshikra
Verabbi elazar it leh demar veit leh demar hilkach katvi hachi middivrehem nizdakka peloni
Gamru et haddavar hau machnisin ku leman ilema levaale dinin hatam kayemi ella leedim
Keman dela kerabbi natan detanya leolam en edutan mitztarefet ad sheyyiru shenehen keechad rabbi yehoshua ben karcha omer afilu baze achar ze
Veen edutan mitkayyemet bevet din ad sheyyaidu shenehen keechad rabbi natan omer shomin devarav shel ze hayyom uchsheyyavo chavero lemachar shomin et devarav

La leolam levaale dinin verabbi nechemya hi detanya rabbi nechemya omer kach haya minhagan shel nekiyye haddaat shebbirushalayim machnisin levaale dinin veshomin divrehen umachnisin et haedim veshomin divrehem umotziin otan lachutz venosin venotnin bedavar gamru et haddavar machnisin otan ku
Vehatanya gamru et haddavar machnisin et haedim hahi dela kerabbi natan
Gufa leolam en edutan mitztarefet ad sheyyiru shenehem keechad rabbi yehoshua ben karcha omer afilu baze achar ze bemay kamipalgi ibaet ema kera veibaet ema sevara
Ibaet ema sevara ammane deka mashed hay la ka mashed hay umane deka mashed hay la kamashed hay veidach ammane bealma tarvayehu kamashadi
Veibaet ema kera dichtiv vehu ed o raa o yada
Vetanya mimmashma shenneemar lo yakum ed eni yodea shehu echad ma talmud lomar echad
Ze bana av kol makom shenneemar ed hare kan shenayim ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv echad
Veappekeh rachamana bilshon chad lememar ad dechazu tarvayehu kechad veidach vehu ed o raa o yada mikkol makom

Veen edutan mitkayyemet bevet din ad sheyyaidu shenehen keechad rabbi natan omer shomin devarav shel ze hayyom uchsheyyavo chavero lemachar shomin devarav bemay kamipalgi ibaet ema sevara ibaet ema kera
Ibaet ema sevara mar savar ed echad ki ate lishvua ate lemamona la ate
Veidach attu ki atu bahade hadade bechad pumma ka mashadi ella metzarfinan lehu hacha name litzarfinhu
Veibaet ema kera im lo yaggid venasa aono
b: Udchulle alma kerabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yehoshua ben korcha vehacha beakkoshe haggada liriyya ka mipalgi mar savar makkeshinan haggada liriyya umar savar la makkeshinan
Rabbi shimon ben elyakim hava mishtekid aleh derabbi yose berabbi chanina lemismecheh vela ka mistayya milta yoma chad hava yatev kammeh derabbi yochanan
Amar lehu mi ika deyada halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha o la amar leh rabbi shimon ben elyakim den yada amar leh lema ezo amar leh lismecheh mar beresha samcheh
Amar leh beni emor li ketzad shamata amar leh kach shamati shemmode rabbi yehoshua ben korcha lerabbi natan
Amar laze hutzrachti hashta uma ikar reiyya bahade hadade amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha la baenan haggada mibaya
Amar leh hoil vealita lo tered amar rabbi zera shema minah gavra rabba kevan deistemich istemich
Amar rabbi chiyya bar avin amar rav halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha ben bekarkaot ben bemittaltelin
Ulla amar halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha bekarkaot aval lo bemittaltelin
Amar leh abbaye halacha mikkelal difligi vehaamar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav modim chachamim lerabbi yehoshua ben korcha beedut karka
Vetane rav idi bar avin binzikin deve karna modin chachamim lerabbi yehoshua ben korcha beedut bechor uvedut karka uvedut chazaka vechen shebbabben veshebbabbat
Gavra aggavra ka ramet mar savar peligi umar savar la peligi
May vechen shebbabben veshebbabbat ilema echad omer achat begabbah veechad omer achat bichresah hay chatzi davar vachatzi edut hu
Ella echad omer shettayim begabbah veechad omer shettayim bichresah

Amar rav yosef ana amena mishshemeh deulla halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha ben bekarkaot ben bemittaltelin verabbanan deatu mimmachoza amri amar rabbi zera mishshemeh derav bakkarkaot in aval la bemittaltelin
Rav letameh deamar rav hodaa achar hodaa hodaa achar halvaa mitztarfi
Halvaa achar halvaa halvaa achar hodaa la mitztarfi

Ashkecheh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar leh may shena halvaa achar halvaa dela demane deka chaze hay la ka chaze hay hodaa achar hodaa name ammane deka mode kamme hay la mode kamme hay
Deamar leh lehay batra behay mane deoday leh kammach oday leh name kamme peloni
Akkatti batra yada kamma la yada
Dahadar azel amar leh lekamma hay mane deoday leh kammach oday leh name kamme peloni amar leh tanuach datecha shehitnachta et dati
Amar leh may nichuta derava veitema rav sheshet sheda bah narga lav hayenu hodaa achar halvaa
Amar leh hayenu dishmia li alayechu derametu dikle vezakfitu lehu
Nehardae amri ben hodaa achar hodaa ben hodaa achar halvaa ben halvaa achar halvaa ben halvaa achar hodaa mitztarfot keman kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha
Amar rav yehuda edut hammachcheshet zo et zo bivdikot keshera bedine mamonot
Amar rava mistabbera milteh derav yehuda beechad omer bearnaki shechora veechad omer bearnaki levana aval echad omer mane shachor veechad omer mane lavan en mitztarfin
Vearnaki shechora bedine nefashot la vehaamar rav chisda echad omer besayif harago veechad omer baariran harago en ze nachon echad omer kelav shechorim veechad omer kelav levanim hare ze nachon

a: Gavra aggavra ka ramet
Nehardae amri afilu echad omer mane shachor veechad omer mane lavan mitztarfim
Keman kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha emar deshamatte leh lerabbi yehoshua ben korcha hecha dela machchashi ahadade hecha demachchashi ahadade mi amar
Ella hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya amar rabbi shimon ben elazar lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al shette kite edim sheachat omeret matayim veachat omeret mane sheyyesh bichlal matayim mane
Al ma nechleku al kat achat shebbet shammay omrim nechleka edutan uvet hillel omrim yesh bichlal matayim mane
Echad omer chavit shel yayin veechad omer chavit shel shemen hava ovada veate lekammeh derabbi amme chayeveh rabbi amme leshallome leh chavita dechamra migo chavita demishcha
Keman kerabbi shimon ben elazar emar deamar rabbi shimon ben elazar hecha deyesh bichlal matayim mane ki hay gavena mi amar
La tzericha lidme
Echad omer bidota haelona veechad omer bidota hattachtona amar rabbi chanina maase ba lifne rabbi vetzeraf edutan

Uminnayin lichsheyyetze ku tanu rabbanan minnayin lichsheyyetze lo yomar hareni mezakke vachaveray mechayevin aval ma eese shechaveray rabbu alay talmud lomar lo telech rachil beammecha veomer holech rachil megalle sod
Hahu talmida dinfak aleh kala degalli milta deitmar be midresha batar esrin vetarten shenin appekeh rav amme mibbe midresha amar den gale razayya
Matni kol zeman shemmevi reaya soter et haddin amar lo kol reaot sheyyesh lecha have mikan ad sheloshim yom matza betoch sheloshim yom soter leachar sheloshim yom eno soter
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel ma yaase ze shello matza betoch sheloshim umatza leachar sheloshim
Amar lo have edim veamar en li edim amar have reaya veamar en li reaya ulachar zeman hevi reaya umatza edim hare ze eno kelum
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel ma yaase ze shello haya yodea sheyyesh lo edim umatza edim lo haya yodea sheyyesh lo reaya umatza reaya
Raa shemmitchayyev baddin veamar karvu peloni ufloni viiduni o shehotzi reaya mittachat pundato hare ze eno kelum
Gema amar rabba bar rav huna halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel veamar rabba bar rav huna en halacha kedivre chachamim
Peshita kevan deamar halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel mimmela yadana deen halacha kachachamim
Mahu detema hane mile lechattechila aval diavad shappir dame ka mashma lan dei aved mahderinan leh

Amar lo have edim ku amar rabban shimon ben gamliel ku amar rabba bar rav huna amar rabbi yochanan halacha kedivre chachamim veamar rabba bar rav huna amar rabbi yochanan en halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Peshita kevan deamar halacha kedivre chachamim mimmela yadana deen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Ha ka mashma lan divhahi en halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel ha bechullehu halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Leappoke meha deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu halacha kemoto chutz mearev vetzayedan uraya acharona
Hahu yanoka detavuh ledina kammeh derav nachman amaru leh it lecha sahade amar lehu la it lach reaya amar lehu la chayeveh rav nachman
Hava ka vache veazel shamuh hanach inashe amaru leh anan yadinan bemile daavuch amar rav nachman beha afilu rabbanan modu deyanoka bemile daavuh la yada
Hahi itta dinfak shetara mittute yedah amara leh yadana behay shetara difria hava hemnah rav nachman
Amar leh rava lerav nachman keman kerabbi deamar otiyyot niknot bimsira
Amar leh shane hacha dei baaya kelateh
Ika deamri la hemnah rav nachman amar leh rava lerav nachman veha i baaya
b: Kelateh
Kevan deitachzak beve dina ibaya kelateh la amrinan
Etiveh rava lerav nachman simpon sheyyesh alav edim yitkayyem bechotmav en alav edim veyatza mittachat yede shalish o sheyyatza achar chitum shetarot kasher alma shalish meheman
Teuvta derav nachman teuvta
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan leolam mevi reaya vesoter ad sheyyistattem taanotav veyomar kirvu peloni ufloni vehaiduni
Ha gufa kashya amratte yistattem taanotav atan lerabbanan vahadar amratte kirvu ish peloni ufloni vehaiduni atan lerabban shimon ben gamliel

Vechi tema kullah rabban shimon ben gamliel ufaroshe ka mefaresh may ad sheyyistattem taanotav ad sheyyomar kirvu peloni ufloni vehaiduni veha amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu halacha kemoto chutz mearev vetzayedan uraya acharona

Ella ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan leolam mevi reaya vesoter ad sheyyistattem taanotav veyomru lo have edim veomer en li edim have reaya veomer en li reaya aval bau edim mimmedinat hayyam o shehayeta disakkayya shel aviv mufkedet beyad acher hare ze mevi reaya vesoter
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan hattokef et chavero baddin echad omer niddon kan veechad omer nelech limkom havaad kofin oto veyelech limkom havaad
Amar lefanav rabbi elazar rabbi mi shennoshe bachavero mane yotzi mane al mane ella kofin oto vedan beiro
Itmar name amar rav safra amar rabbi yochanan shenem shennitatztzemu baddin echad omer niddon kan veechad omer nelech limkom havaad kofin oto vedan beiro veim hutzrach davar lishol kotvin vesholchin
Veim amar kitvu utnu li meeze taam dantuni kotvin venotnin lo
Vehayevama holechet achar hayyavam lehattirah
Ad kamma amar rabbi amme afilu mitteverya letzippori
Amar rav kahana may kera vekaru lo zikne iro velo zikne irah

Amar ammemar hilcheta kofin oto veyelech limkom havaad amar leh rav ashe leammemar veha amar rabbi elazar kofin oto vedan beiro hane mile hecha dekaamar leh love lemalve aval malve eved love leish malve
Shelachu leh lemar ukva lidziv leh kevar bitya shelam ukvan habbavli keval kodamana yirmeya achi heevir alay et hadderech imru lo hassiuhu veyire panenu bitverya
Ha gufa kashya amratte imru lo alma dayenuh attun hassiuhu veyire panenu bitverya alma shadderuh hacha
Ella hachi kaamri emaru leh dayenuh attun i tzayet tzayet vei la hassiuhu veyire panenu bitverya
Rav ashe amar dine kenasot hava uvvavel la dayeni dine kenasot veha dishlachu leh hachi kede lachalok kavod lemar ukva
Hadaran alach ze borer

a: Matni echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot bidrisha uvachakira shenneemar mishpat echad yihye lachem
Ma ben dine mamonot ledine nefashot dine mamonot bishlosha vedine nefashot beesrim ushlosha dine mamonot potchin ben lizchut ben lechova vedine nefashot potchin lizchut veen potchin lechova
Dine mamonot mattin al pi echad ben lizchut ben lechova vedine nefashot mattin al pi echad lizchut veal pi shenayim lechova
Dine mamonot machzirin ben lizchut ben lechova dine nefashot machzirin lizchut veen machzirin lechova
Dine mamonot hakkol melammedin zechut vechova dine nefashot hakkol melammedin zechut veen hakkol melammedin chova
Dine mamonot hamlammed chova melammed zechut vehamlammed zechut melammed chova dine nefashot hamlammed chova melammed zechut aval hamlammed zechut en yachol lachzor ullammed chova
Dine mamonot danin bayyom vegomrin ballayela dine nefashot danin bayyom vegomrin bayyom
Dine mamonot gomrin bo bayyom ben lizchut ben lechova dine nefashot gomrin bo bayyom lizchut uvayyom shelleacharav lechova lefichach en danin lo beerev shabbat velo beerev yom tov
Dine mamonot hattemaot vehatteharot matchilin min haggadol dine nefashot matchilin min hatztzad
Hakkol kesherin ladun dine mamonot veen hakkol kesherin ladun dine nefashot ella kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim hammassiin lakkehunna

Gema dine mamonot mi baenan derisha vachakira urminhu shetar shezzemanno katuv beechad benisan bashshemita uvau edim veamru heach attem meidin al shetar ze vahalo beom peloni immanu heyitem bemakom peloni shetar kasher veedav kesherin chayeshinan shemma icharuhu uchtavuhu
Vei salka datach baenan derisha vachakira hechi chayeshinan shemma icharuhu uchtavuhu
Velitamach tikshe lach matnitin shitre chov hammukdamin pesulim vehamucharim kesherin vei salka datach baenan derisha vachakira meucharin ammay kesherin

Ha la kashya daadifa minah kaamrinan daafilu echad benisan bishmita dela shechichi inashe demozfi deleka lememar shemma icharuhu uchtavuhu dela mara lishtareh afilu hachi kevan dishviit sofah meshammetet machsherinan
Mikkol makom kashya siman

Amar rabbi chanina devar tora echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot bidrisha uvachakira shenneemar mishpat echad yihye lachem uma taam amru dine mamonot la baenan derisha vachakira kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin
Ella meatta
b: Tau lo yeshallemu kol shekken shettinol delet bifne lovin
Rava amar matnitin dehacha bedine kenasot veidach behodaot vehalvaot
Rav pappa amar ide veide behodaa vehalvaa kan bedin merumme kan bedin sheeno merumme
Kidresh lakish deresh lakish rame ketiv betzedek tishpot amitecha uchtiv tzedek tzedek tirdof ha ketzad kan bedin merumme kan bedin sheen merumme
Rav ashe amar matnitin kidshannin kerae echad ledin veechad lifshara

Kidtanya tzedek tzedek tirdof echad ledin veechad lifshara ketzad shette sefinot ovrot bannahar ufagu ze baze im ovrot shettehen shettehen tovot beze achar ze shettehen ovrot vechen shene gemallim shehau olim bemaalot bet choron ufagu ze baze im alu shenehen shenehen noflin beze achar ze shenehen olin

Ha ketzad teuna vesheenah teuna tidache sheenah teuna mippene teuna kerova vesheenah kerova tidache kerova mippene sheenah kerova hau shettehen kerovot shettehen rechokot hatel peshara benehen umealot sachar zo lazo
Tanu rabbanan tzedek tzedek tirdof hallech achar bet din yafe achar rabbi eliezer lelod achar rabban yochanan ben zakkay livrur chayil
Tana kol rechayim bevurni shevua habben shevua habben or hanner bivrur chayil mishte sham mishte sham

Tanu rabbanan tzedek tzedek tirdof hallech achar chachamim lishiva achar rabbi eliezer lelod achar rabban yochanan ben zakkay livrur chayil achar rabbi yehoshua lifkiin achar rabban gamliel leyavne achar rabbi akiva livne verak achar rabbi matya leromi achar rabbi chananya ben teradon lesichni achar rabbi yose letzipori achar rabbi yehuda ben betira lintzivin achar rabbi yehoshua laggola achar rabbi levet shearim achar chachamim lelishkat haggazit
Dine mamonot potchin ku hechi amrinan amar rav yehuda hachi amrinan lehu mi yemar kidkaamritu
Amar leh ulla veha chasminan lehu velichasmu mi la tanya rabbi shimon ben eliezer omer massiin et haedim mimmakom lemakom kede shettitaref datan veyachzeru bahen
Mi dame hatam mimmela ka midchu hacha ka dachenan lehu beyadayim
Ella amar ulla hachi amrinan yesh lecha edim lahazimam amar leh rabba vechi potchin bizchuto shel ze shehi chovato shel ze
Umi haveya chovato vehatnan en edim zommin neheragin ad sheyyiggamer haddin
Hachi amena ilu shatek hay ad demigmar dineh umayeti edim umazzem lehu haveya leh chovato shel ze ella amar rabba amrinan leh yesh lecha edim lehachchishan
Rav kahana amar middivrechem nizdakka peloni abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu amrinan leh i la ketalte la tidchal rav ashe amar kol mi sheyyodea lo zechut yavo vilammed alav
Tanya kevateh deabbaye verava rabbi omer im lo shachav ish otach veim lo satit vego

a: Mikan sheppotchin bedine nefashot techilla lizchut
Dine mamonot machazirin ku urminhu dan et haddin zika et hachayyav chiyyev et hazzakkay time et hattahor tiher et hattame ma sheasa asuy vishallem mibbeto
Amar rav yosef la kashya kan bemumche kan besheeno mumche uvmumche machzirin vehakatane im haya mumche levet din patur milleshallem
Amar rav nachman kan sheyyesh gadol hemennu bechachma uvminyan kan sheen gadol hemennu bechachma uvminyan
Rav sheshet amar kan shettaa bidvar mishna kan shettaa beshikul haddaat deamar rav sheshet amar rav assi taa bidvar mishna chozer taa beshikul haddaat eno chozer
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe afilu taa berabbi chiyya verabbi oshaya amar leh in afilu bidrav ushmuel amar leh in afilu bedidi vedidach amar leh attu anan katle kene beagma anan

Hechi dame shikul haddaat amar rav pappa kegon tere tannae o tere amorae difligi ahadade vela itmar hilcheta la kemar vela kemar veikri vaavad kechad minayehu vesugya dishmata azli keidach hayenu shikul haddaat
Etiveh rav hamnuna lerav sheshet maase befara shel bet menachem shennitla haem shellah veheechilah rabbi tarfon lichlavim

Uva maase lifne chachamim beyavne vehittiruha sheamar todos harofe en para vachazira yotzet mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim ella im ken chotchin haem shellah kede shello teled amar rabbi tarfon halcha chamorcha tarfon amar lo rabbi akiva patur atta shekkol hammumche larabbim patur milleshallem
Vei ita lema leh toe bidvar mishna atta vetoe bidvar mishna chozer
Chada veod kaamar chada detoe bidvar mishna atta vetoe bidvar mishna chozer veod i name beshikul haddaat taita mumche larabbim atta vechol hammumche larabbim patur milleshallem
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava may ka motev rav hamnuna lerav sheshet mippara para hare heechilah lichlavim veleta detehdar

Hachi kaamar leh i amratte bishlama taa bidvar mishna eno chozer alma kam dina hayenu deka mefached rabbi tarfon vekaamar leh ihu mumche levet din atta veatta patur milleshallem ella i amratte taa bidvar mishna chozer lema leh kevan deilu havay para dinach lav dina vela kelum avadte hashta name la kelum avadte
Rav chisda amar kan shennatal venatan bayyad kan shello natal venatan bayyad

Bishlama chiyyev et hazzakkay kegon shennatal venatan bayyad ella zika et hachayyav hechi mashkachatte lah daamar leh patur atta veha lo natal venatan bayyad kevan deamar patur atta kemo shennatal venatan bayyad dame

Ella matnitin dekatane dine mamonot machzirin ben lizchut ben lechova bishlama lizchut mashkachatte lah daamar leh meikara chayyav atta velo natal velo natan bayyad ella lechova hechi mashkachatte lah deamar leh patur atta vehaamratte kevan deamar leh patur atta kemo shennatal venatan bayyad dame
Chada katane dine mamonot machzirin lizchut shehi chova dichvatah gabbe nefashot machzirin lizchut
b: Veen machzirin lechova machzirin lizchut zechut geredta veen machzirin lechova lizchut shehi chova
Chovteh deman ha la kashya chovteh degoel haddam mishshum chovteh degoel haddam katlinan leh lehay veod may ben ben kashya
Ravina amar kegon shehaya lo beyado mashkon untalo mimmennu
Time et hattahor deagga beh sheretz tiher et hattame sheervan ben perotav
Dine nefashot ku tanu rabbanan minnayin leotze mibbet din chayyav veamar echad yesh li lelammed alav zechut minnayin shemmachzirin oto talmud lomar naki al taharog
Uminnayin leotze mibbet din zakkay veamar echad yesh li lelammed alav chova minnayin sheen machzirin oto talmud lomar tzaddik al taharog
Amar rav shimi bar ashe vechilufa lemesit dichtiv lo tachmol velo techasse alav rav kahana matne mikki harog tahargennu
Bea minneh rabbi zera merav sheshet chayyave galiyyot minnayin atya rotzeach rotzeach
Chayyave malkiyyot minnayin atya rasha rasha
Tanya name hachi chayyave galiyyot minnayin atya rotzeach rotzeach chayyave malkot minnayin atya rasha rasha
Veen machzirin lechova amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan vehu shettaa bedavar sheen hatztzaddukin modin bo aval taa bidvar shehatztzaddukin modin bo zil keri be rav hu
Bea mineh rabbi chiyya bar abba merabbi yochanan taa benoef venoefet mahu amar leh addemokdach yekid zil kutz karach utzli itmar name amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan taa benoef chozer
Ella hechi dame en chozrin amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan kegon shettaa shello kedarkah
Dine mamonot hakkol ku hakkol vaafilu edim nema matnitin rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi vela rabbanan
Detanya veed echad lo yaane venefesh ben lizchut ben lechova rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer one lizchut veen one lechova
Amar rav pappa beechad min hattalmidim vedivre hakkol

a: May tama derabbi yose bar yehuda deamar kera ed echad lo yaane venefesh lamut lamut hu deeno one aval lizchut one verabbanan amar resh lakish mishshum demichaze kenogea beeduto

Verabbanan hay lamut may darshi beh mokmi leh beechad min hattalmidim kidtanya amar echad min haedim yesh li lelammed alav zechut minnayin sheen shomin lo talmud lomar ed echad lo yaane minnayin leechad min hattalmidim sheamar yesh li lelammed alav chova minnayin sheen shomin lo talmud lomar echad lo yaane venefesh lamut
Dine nefashot hamlammed ku amar rav lo shanu ella bishat massa umattan aval bishat gemar din melammed zechut chozer umlammed chova

Metivi lemochorat mashkimin uvain hamzakke omer ani hamzakke umzakke ani bimkomi hamchayyev omer ani hamchayyev umchayyev ani bimkomi hamlammed chova melammed zechut aval hamlammed zechut eno yachol lachazor ullammed chova
Veha lammochorat gemar din hu velitamach lammochorat massa umattan mi leka ki katane bishat massa umattan
Ta shema danin ellu keneged ellu ad sheyyire echad min hamchayevin divre hamzakkin veim itah litne name ipcha tanna azzechut ka mehaddar achova la ka mehaddar
Ta shema deamar rabbi yose bar chanina echad min hattalmidim shezzika vamet roin oto keilu chay veomed bimkomo veammay nema ilu hava kayyam hava hadar beh hashta miha la hadar beh
Veha shelachu mittam ledivre rabbi yose bar chanina mutza mikkelal rabbenu en mutza itmar
Ta shema shene sofre haddayyanin omdin lifnehen echad min hayyamin veechad min hassemol vechotvin divre hamzakkin vedivre hamchayevin
Bishlama divre hamchayevin limchar chazu tama acharina uvau lemebad halanat din ella divre hamzakkin may tama lav mishshum dei chazu tama acharina lechova la mashgechinan behu
Lo kede shello yomru shenayim taam echad mishshene mikraot kediva mineh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan amru shenayim taam echad mishshene mikraot mahu amar leh en monin lahen ella echad

Menahane mile amar abbaye deamar kera achat dibber elohim shettayim zu shamati ki oz lelohim mikra echad yotze lechamma teamim veen taam echad yotze mikkamma mikraot deve rabbi yishmael tana uchfattish yefotzetz sala ma pattish ze mitchallek lechamma nitzotzot af mikra echad yotze lechamma teamim
Hechi dame taam echad mishshene mikraot amar rav zevid keditnan mizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo
Rabbi yehoshua omer kol harauy laishshim im ala lo yered shenneemar haola al mokda ma ola shehi reuya laishshim im alta lo tered af kol shehu rauy laishshim im ala lo yered

Rabban gamliel omer kol harauy lammizbeach im ala lo yered shenneemar hi haola al mokda al hammizbeach ma ola shehi reuya legabbe mizbeach im alta lo tered af kol shehu rauy lemizbeach im ala lo yered
Vetarvayehu may kamrabbu pesulin mar mayete lah mimmokda umar mayete lah mimmizbeach
Veha hatam miflag peligi dekatane sefa en ben divre rabban gamliel ledivre rabbi yehoshua ella haddam vehannesachim sherabban gamliel omer lo yerdu verabbi yehoshua omer yerdu
Ella amar rav pappa kidtanya rabbi yose haggelili omer mittoch shenneemar
b: Kal hannogea bammizbeach yikdash shomea ani ben rauy ben sheeno rauy talmud lomar kevasim ma kevasim reuyin af kol rauy rabbi akiva omer ola ma ola reuya af kol rauy
Vetarvayehu may ka memaatu pesule mar mayete lah mikkevasim umar mayete lah meola
Vehaamar rav adda bar ahava olat haof pesula ika benayehu man demayete lah mikkevasim kevasim in aval olat haof la uman demayete lah meola afilu olat haof name
Ella amar rav ashe kidtanya dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach lerabbot et hazzorek divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer o zavach lerabbot et hazzorek vetarvayehu may ka merabbu zerika mar mayete lah middam yechashev umar mayete lah meo zavach
Vehaamar rabbi avahu shachat vezarak ika benayehu ledivre rabbi yishmael eno chayyav ella achat ledivre rabbi akiva chayyav shettayim
Ha itmar alah amar abbaye af ledivre rabbi akiva name eno chayyav ella achat deamar kera sham taale olotecha vesham taase arvinhu rachamana lechullehu asiyyot
Dine mamonot danin bayyom vechu siman mishpat maane matte menahane mile amar rabbi chiyya bar pappa deamar kera veshaftu et haam bechol et
I hachi techillat din name kidrava derava rame ketiv veshaftu et haam bechol et uchtiv vehaya beom hanchilo et banav ha ketzad yom litchillat din layela ligmar din

Deve chizkiyya tana vechi yazid ish al reehu lehorgo veorma shehitru bo vaadayin hu mezid

Vei ketav rachamana vechi yazid hava amena hane mile sayif dekil aval sekila dachamura ema la tzericha

Beishsha chavera vealliba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer chaver en tzarich hatraa lefi shello nittena hatraa ella lehavchin ben shogeg lemezid

Hachi name kaamar mittoch sheen neheragin sheyecholin lomar leosrah al balah banu af hi enah nehereget dehaveya lah edut shei atta yachol lahazimah
Ella beishsha chavera dekayema lan demikatla alliba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda hechi mashkachatte lah keshezzinta vechazra vezinta
Veha yecholin lomar leosrah al boalah sheni banu shezzinta mibboel rishon i name shezzinta mikkeroveha
May shena naara meorasa denaket afilu nesua name in ella afilu hay dela yatva tuteh yecholin lomar leosrah al balah banu
Amar rav chisda echad omer besayif harago veechad omer baariran harago en ze nachon echad omer kelav shechorin veechad omer kelav levanim hare ze nachon

Ta shema maase uvadak ben zakkay beuktze teena amar rame bar chama kegon sheakatz teena beshabbat daalah ka miktil
Veha tanya amru lo tachat teena harago ella amar rame bar chama kegon sheshshippedo beyichur shel teena
Ta shema amar lahen teena zo okatzeha dakkin okatzeha gassin teenim shechorot teenim levanot ella amar rav yosef mibben zakkay lotev inish shane ben zakkay divdikot kachakirot meshave leh

Man ben zakkay ilema rabbi yochanan ben zakkay mi hava besanhedri vehatanya kol shenotav shel rabbi yochanan ben zakkay mea veesrim shana arbaim shana asak bifrakmatya arbaim shana lamad arbaim shana limed
