Utnan mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay
Ella ben zakkay dealma hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach rabban yochanan ben zakkay kare leh rabbi ben zakkay
Vehatanya maase uvadak rabban yochanan ben zakkay beuktze teenim ella talmid hayyoshev lifne rabbo hava vaamar milta umistabbar lehu tameh
b: Vekavuha bishmeh ki hava lamad ben zakkay hava kare leh ketalmid hayyoshev lifne rabbo ki hava limed hava kare leh rabban yochanan ben zakkay ki kare leh ben zakkay al shem demeikara vechi kare leh rabban yochanan ben zakkay al shem dehashta
Maase uvadak ku ma ben chakirot ku may afilu shenayim omrim peshita ki amar echad eni yodea edutan kayyemet ki amri be tere name edutan kayyemet
Amar rav sheshet aresha kae vehachi kaamar bachakirot afilu shenayim omrim yadanu veechad omer eni yodea edutan betela keman kerabbi akiva demakkesh shelosha lishnayim
Amar rava veha edutan kayyemet katane ella amar rava hachi kaamar afilu bachakirot shenayim omrim yadanu veechad omer eni yodea edutan kayyemet keman dela kerabbi akiva
Rav kahana verav safra tanu sanhedrin be rabba pega behu rame bar chama amar lehu may amritu bah besanhedrin deve rabba amri leh umay amrinan bah besanhedrin geredta umay kashya lach

Amar lehu meha dekatane ma ben chakirot livdikot chakirot echad omer eni yodea edutan betela bedikot amar echad eni yodea vaafilu shenayim omrim en anu yodim edutan kayyemet mikkede ide veide deorayeta hi may shena chakirot umay shena bedikot
Amri leh hachi hashta bachakirot amar echad eni yodea edutan betela dehaveya lah edut shei atta yachol lahazimah bedikot amar echad mehen eni yodea edutan kayyemet edut sheatta yachol lahazimah hu
Amar lehu i hachi amritu bah tuva amritu bah amri leh mittevuteh demar amrinan bah tuva minnezihuteh demar la amrinan bah vela chada
Echad omer ku ad kamma amar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan ad rubbo shel chodesh
Amar rava af anan name tenena echad omer bishlosha veechad omer bachamishsha edutan betela veammay nema shezze yodea bishne iburin veze eno yodea bishne iburin ella lav mishshum divrubba yada
Leolam ema lach berubba name la yada uvshipura yada bechad shipura amar detae bitre shipure la amar detae

Veamar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan ad kamma mevarchin al hachodesh ad shettitmalle pegimatah vechamma amar rav yaakov bar idi amar rav yehuda ad shiva nehardae amri ad shishsha asar

a: Vetarvayehu kerabbi yochanan sevira lehu ha lemihve ki yitra ha lemihve ki nafya

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina velivarech hattov vehammetiv amar leh attu ki chasar mi mevarchinan dayyan haemet dilvarech hattov vehammetiv velivarchinhu letarvayehu kevan dehayenu orcheh la mevarchinan

Veamar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan kol hamvarech al hachodesh bizmanno keilu mekabbel pene shechina ketiv hacha hachodesh hazze uchtiv hatam ze eli veanvehu tana deve rabbi yishmael ilmale lo zachu yisrael ella lehakbil pene avihen shebbashshamayim kal chodesh vachodesh dayyam amar abbaye hilkach nemrinhu meummad
Marimar umar zutra mechattefi ahadade umvarchi amar leh rav acha lerav ashe bemareva mevarchi baruch mechaddesh chodashim amar leh hay neshe didan name mevarchi

Ella kidrav yehuda deamar rav yehuda baruch vechu asher bemaamaro bara shechakem uvruach piv kol tzevaam chok uzman natan lahem shello yeshannu et tafkidam sasim usmechim laasot retzon konam poale emet sheppeullatan emet velallevana amar shettitchaddesh ateret tiferet laamuse vaten shehen atidin lehitchaddesh kemotah ulfaer leotzram al shem kevod malchuto baruch atta Adonai mechaddesh chodashim

Ki vetachbulot taase lecha milchama amar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan bemi atta motze milchamtah shel tora bemi sheyyesh beyado chavilot shel mishna kare rav yosef annafsheh verov tevuot bechoach shor
Echad omer bishte shaot ku amar rav shimi bar ashe lo shanu ella shaot aval echad omer kodem hanetz hachamma veechad omer leachar hanetz hachamma edutan betela
Peshita ella echad omer kodem hanetz veechad omer betoch hanetz ha name peshita mahu detema ha begiluya kae vezaharure bealma hu dachaza ka mashma lan

Veachar kach machnisin ku oto hayyom vetu la vehatanya im yesh mammash bidvarav lo haya yored mishsham leolam veim en mammash bidvarav en yored kol hayyom kullo kede shello tehe aliyyato yerida lo amar abbaye targumah aim en mammash bidvarav
Matzu lo zechut ku yayin may tama la amar rabbi acha bar chanina amar kera ulroznim e shechar haoskin berazo shel olam al yishtakkeru
Matzu lo zechut ku lo rau may
Amar rabbi acha potrin oto vechen amar rabbi yochanan potrin oto amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veliftereh meikara amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan kede shello yetzu mibbet din meurbavin

Ika deamri amar leh rav pappa leabbaye ulma li yosifu liftereh mibbe dina kamma amar leh rabbi yose kae kevatach detanya rabbi yose omer keshem sheen mosifin al bet din shel shivim veechad kach en mosifin al bet din shel esrim ushlosha
Tanu rabbanan omer bedine mamonot nizdakken haddin veen omer bedine nefashot nizdakken haddin
May nizdakken haddin ilema kash dina ipcha mibaya leh amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika efoch rav ashe amar leolam la tefoch umay nizdakken haddin chacham dina
Metivi gadol shebbaddayyanin omer nizdakken haddin i amratte bishlama chacham dina hayenu deamar gadol ella i amratte kash dina la saggi dela amar gadol kassofe hu deka mechassef nafsheh
In eno dome mitbayyesh meatzmo lemitbayyesh meacherim
Ika deamri i amratte bishlama kash dina hayenu deeno dome mitbayyesh meatzmo lemitbayyesh meacherim ella i amratte chacham dina gadol ashboche mashbach nafsheh vehachtiv yehallelcha zar velo ficha
Shane milta deve dina deaggadol ramya keditnan gamru et haddavar hau machnisin otan gadol shebbaddayyanin omer ish peloni atta zakkay ish peloni atta chayyav
Hadaran alach hau bodkin
b: Matni nigmar haddin motziin oto lesoklo bet hassekila haya chutz levet din shenneemar hotze et hamkallel

Echad omed al petach bet din vehassudarin beyado vesus rachok mimmennu kede sheyehe roehu omer echad yesh lelammed alav zechut halla menif besudarin vehassus ratz umaamidan vaafilu hu omer yesh li lelammed al atzmi zechut machazirin oto afilu arba vechamesh peamim uvilvad sheyyesh mammash bidvarav
Gema uvet hassekila chutz levet din hava vetu la veha tanya bet hassekila haya chutz leshalosh machanot

In kidkaamratte veha dekatane hachi nafka minah dei nafek be dina veyatev chutz leshalosh machanot avdinan bet hassekila chutz levet din ki hechi dela mitchaze bet din rotzchin i name ki hechi detihve leh hatztzala

Menahane mile detanu rabbanan hotze et hamkallel el michutz lammachane chutz leshalosh machanot atta omer chutz leshalosh machanot o eno ella chutz lemachane achat neemar kan michutz lammachane veneemar befarim hannisrafin chutz lemachane ma lehallan chutz leshalosh machanot af kan chutz leshalosh machanot
Vehatam menalan detanu rabbanan vehotzi et kol happar el michutz lammachane chutz leshalosh machanot atta omer chutz leshalosh machanot o eno ella chutz lemachane achat
Keshehu omer el michutz lammachane befar haeda sheen talmud lomar shehare kevar neemar vesaraf oto kaasher saraf et happar harishon liten lo machane sheniyya
Uchshehu omer al michutz lammachane bedeshen sheen talmud lomar shehare kevar neemar al shefech haddeshen yissaref liten lo machane shelishit
Velelaf mishshechute chutz ma lehallan chutz lemachane achat af kan chutz lemachane achat
Mistabbera mipparim hannisrafin hava leh lemelaf
Shekken hotze el michutz lammachane machshir umchapper
Adderabba mishshechute chutz hava leh lemelaf
Shekken adam chote binshama pigul
Machshir mimmachshir adif leh

Rav pappa amar moshe hecha hava yatev bemachane leviyya vaamar leh rachamana hotze et hamkallel el michutz lammachane chutz lemachane leviyya vayyotziu et hamkallel el michutz lammachane chutz lemachane yisrael
Hay mibe leh laasiyya asiyya behedya ketiva

a: Uvne yisrael asu kaasher tziva Adonai et moshe
Ella meatta vayyirgemu oto aven may avdi leh hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya vayyirgemu oto baaven oto velo bichsuto aven sheim met beeven achat yatza

Veitzterich lemichtav aven veitzterich lemichtav avanim dei ketav rachamana aven hava amena hecha dela met bachada la nayete achariti venikteleh ketav rachamana avanim vei ketav rachamana avanim hava amena meikara nayete tarte ketav rachamana aven
Veha hay tanna neemar kaamar ilu lo neemar kaamar vehachi kaamar ilu lo neemar kera hayiti omer gezera shava achshav shenneemar kera gezera shava la tzerich
Rav ashe amar moshe hecha hava yatev bemachane leviyya vaamar leh rachamana hotze et hamkallel chutz lemachane leviyya el michutz lammachane chutz lemachane yisrael vayyotziu et hamkallel laasiyya
Asiyya behedya ketiv behu uvne yisrael asu kaasher tziva Adonai et moshe hahu mibe leh chad lismicha vechad lidchiyya
Amaru leh rabbanan lerav ashe ledidach kol hane hotzi dichtivi befarim hannisrafim may darshatte behu kashya

Echad omed ku amar rav huna peshita li echad even shenniskal bah veechad etz shennitle bo veechad sayif shenneherag bo veechad sudar shennechnak bo kullan mishshel tzibbur may tama demiddideh la amrinan leh zil veleteh veliktol nafsheh
Bae rav huna sudar shemmenifin bo vesus sheratz umaamidan mishshel mi hu kevan dehatztzala dideh middideh hu o dilma kevan deve dina mechayevin lemebad leh hatztzala middidhu

Vetu ha deamar rav chiyya bar rav ashe amar rav chisda hayyotze lehareg mashkin oto koret shel levona bechos shel yayin kede shettittaref dato shenneemar tenu shechar leoved veyayin lemare nafesh vetanya nashim yekarot shebbirushalayim hau mitnaddevot umviot otan lo hitnaddevu nashim yekarot mishshel mi ha vadday mistabbera mishshel tzibbur kevan dichtiv tenu middidhu

Bea mineh rav acha bar huna merav sheshet amar echad min hattalmidim yesh li lelammed alav zechut venishtattek mahu menappach rav sheshet bideh nishtattek afilu echad besof haolam name hatam la kaamar hacha kaamar may
Ta shema deamar rabbi yose bar chanina echad min hattalmidim shezzika vamet roin oto keilu chay veomed bimkomo zika in lo zika la
Zika peshita li amar tibe lach

Afilu hu ku vaafilu paam rishona ushniyya vehatanya paam rishona ushniyya ben sheyyesh mammash bidvarav ben sheen mammash bidvarav machzirin oto mikkan vaelach im yesh mammash bidvarav machzirin oto en mammash bidvarav en machzirin oto
Amar rav pappa targumah mippaam sheniyya veelach
Mena yadi amar abbaye demasrinan leh zuga derabbanan i ika mammash bidvarav in i la la
Velimsar leh meikara aggav divit la matze amar kol may deit leh

Matni matzu lo zechut petaruhu veim lav yotze lisakel vecharoz yotze lefanav ish peloni ben peloni yotze lisakel al sheavar avera pelonit ufloni ufloni edav kol mi sheyyodea lo zechut yavo vilammed alav
Gema amar abbaye vetzarich lememar beom peloni uvshaa pelonit uvmakom peloni dilma ika deyadaoy veate umazzem lehu

Vecharoz yotze lefanav lefanav in meikara la vehatanya beerev happesach telauhu leyeshu hannotzri vehakkaroz yotze lefanav arbaim yom yeshu hannotzri yotze lisakel al shekkishef vehesit vehiddiach et yisrael kol mi sheyyodea lo zechut yavo vilammed alav velo matzu lo zechut utlauhu beerev happesach
Amar ulla vetisbera yeshu hannotzri bar happoche zechut hu mesit hu verachamana amar lo tachmol velo techasse alav ella shane yeshu dekarov lemalchut hava

Tanu rabbanan chamishsha talmidim hau lo leyeshu hannotzri mattay nakkay netzer uvuni vetoda atuh lemattay amar lehu mattay yehareg hachtiv mattay avo veerae pene elohim amru lo in mattay yehareg dichtiv matay yamut veavad shemo
Atuh lenakkay amar lehu nakkay yehareg hachtiv venaki vetzaddik al taharog amru lo in nakkay yehareg dichtiv bammistarim yaharog naki
Atuh lenetzer amar netzer yehareg hachtiv venetzer mishshorashav yifre amru lo in netzer yehareg dichtiv veatta hoshlachta mikkivrecha kenetzer nitav
Atuh levuni amar buni yehareg hachtiv beni vechori yisrael amru lo in buni yehareg dichtiv hinne anochi horeg et bincha bechorecha
Atuh letoda amar toda yehareg hachtiv mizmor letoda amru lo in toda yehareg dichtiv zoveach toda yechabbedanni
b: Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol hazzoveach et yitzro umitvadde alav maale alav hakkatuv keilu kibdo lehakkadosh baruch hu bishne olamim haolam hazze vehaolam habba dichtiv zoveach toda yechabbedanni

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam adam makriv ola sechar ola beyado mincha sechar mincha beyado aval mi sheddato shefala maale alav hakkatuv keilu hikriv kol hakkarbanot kullan shenneemar zivche elohim ruach nishbara velo od ella sheen tefillato nimeset shenneemar lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze

Matni haya rachok mibbet hassekila keeser ammot omrim lo hitvadde shekken derech kol hammumatin mitvaddin shekkol hammitvadde yesh lo chelek laolam habba shekken matzinu beachan sheamar lo yehoshua beni sim na chavod la elohe yisrael veten lo toda vayyaan achan et yehoshua vayyomar omna anochi chatati vechazot vechazot vego uminnayin shekkiper lo viduo shenneemar vayyomer yehoshua me achartanu yakorcha Adonai bayyom hazze beom hazze atta achur vei atta achur laolam habba

Veim eno yodea lehitvadot omrim lo emor tehe mitati kappara al kol aonotay rabbi yehuda omer im haya yodea shehu mezummam omer tehe mitati kappara al kol aonotay chutz meaon ze amru lo im ken yehu kol adam omrin ken kede lenakkot atzman
Gema tanu rabbanan na en na ella leshon bakkasha

Beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu lihoshua chata yisrael amar lefanav ribbono shel olam mi chata amar leh vechi delator ani lech happel goralot halach vehippil goralot venafal haggoral al achan amar lo yehoshua begoral atta ba alay atta veelazar hakkohen shene gedole haddor attem im ani mappil alechem goral al echad mikkem hu nofel amar lo bevakkasha mimmecha al totzi laaz al haggoralot sheatida eretz yisrael shettitchallek begoral shenneemar ach begoral yechalek et haaretz

Ten toda amar ravina shachode shachadeh bemile kelum nevakkesh mimmecha ella hodaa ten lo toda vehipater miyyad vayyaan achan et yehoshua vayyomar omna anochi chatati la elohe yisrael vechazot vechazot asiti

Amar rav assi amar rabbi chanina melammed shemmaal achan bishlosha charamim shenayim bime moshe veechad bime yehoshua shenneemar kazot vechazot asiti rabbi yochanan amar mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon chamishsha arbaa bime moshe veechad bime yehoshua shenneemar anochi chatati vechazot vechazot asiti
Vead hashta may tama la ianush amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon lefi shello anash al hannistarot ad sheavru yisrael et hayyarden

Ketannae hannistarot la elohenu vehanniglot lanu ulvanenu ad olam lamma nakud al lanu ulvanenu veal ayin shebbead melammed shello anash al hannistarot ad sheavru yisrael et hayyarden divre rabbi yehuda
Amar lo rabbi nechemya vechi anash al hannistarot leolam vahalo kevar neemar ad olam ella keshem shello anash al hannistarot kach lo anash al onashin shebbaggaluy ad sheavru yisrael et hayyarden ella

a: Achan may tama ianush mishshum dahao yadi beh ishto uvanav
Chata yisrael amar rabbi abba bar zavda af al pi shechata yisrael hu amar rabbi abba hayenu deamri inashe asa dekae bene chilfe asa shemeh veasa karu leh

Vegam avru et beriti asher tziviti otam gam lakchu min hacherem gam ganvu gam kichashu gam samu bichlehem amar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi yehuda bar masparta melammed sheavar achan al chamishsha chumshe tora shenneemar chamishsha gam
Veamar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi yehuda bar masparta achan moshech beorlato haya ketiv hacha vegam avru et beriti uchtiv hatam et beriti hefar
Peshita mahu detema bemitzva gufeh la pekar ka mashma lan
Vechi asa nevala beyisrael amar rabbi abba bar zavda melammed shebbaal achan naara hamorasa ketiv hacha vechi asa nevala uchtiv hatam ki asta nevala beyisrael
Peshita mahu detema kulle hay la pekar nafsheh ka mashma lan ravina amar dineh kenaara hamorasa deviskila

Amar leh resh galuta lerav huna ketiv vayyikkach yehoshua et achan ben zerach veet hakkesef veet haadderet veet leshon hazzahav veet banav veet benotav veet shoro veet chamoro veet tzono veet oholo veet kol asher lo im hu chata banav uvnotav me chatu
Amar leh velitamach im hu chata kal yisrael me chatu dichtiv vechol yisrael immo ella lirdotan hachi name kede lirdotan
Vayyisrefu otam baesh vayyiskelu otam baavanim betarte amar ravina harauy lisrefa lisrefa harauy liskila liskila
Vaere vashshalal adderet shinar achat tova umatayim shekalim kesef rav amar itztela demelata ushmuel amar sarbala ditzrifa

Vayyatztzikum lifne Adonai amar rav nachman ba vachavatam lifne hammakom amar lefanav ribbono shel olam al ellu tehareg rubbah shel sanhedrin dichtiv vayyakku mehem anshe haay kishloshim veshishsha ish vetanya sheloshim veshishsha mammash divre rabbi yehuda amar lo rabbi nechemya vechi sheloshim veshishsha hau vahalo lo neemar ella kishloshim veshishsha ish ella ze yair ben menashshe sheshshakul keneged rubbah shel sanhedrin
Amar rav nachman amar rav may dichtiv tachanunim yedabber rash veashir yaane azzot tachanunim yedabber rash ze moshe veashir yaane azzot ze yehoshua

May tama ilema mishshum dichtiv vayyatztzikum lifne Adonai veamar rav nachman ba vachavatan lifne hammakom attu pinchas la avad hachi dichtiv vayyaamod pinchas vayefallel vatteatzar hammaggefa veamar rabbi elazar vayyitpallel lo neemar ella vayefallel melammed sheasa pelilut im kono ba vachavatan lifne hammakom amar lefanav ribbono shel olam al ellu yippelu esrim vearbaa elef miyyisrael dichtiv veyihu hammetim bammaggefa arbaa veesrim alef
Veella mehacha lamma heavarta haavir et haam hazze et hayyarden moshe name memar amar lema hareota laam hazze ella mehacha velu hoalnu vanneshev beever hayyarden
Vayyomer Adonai el yehoshua kum lach daresh rabbi shela amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu shellecha kasha mishshellahem ani amarti vehaya beovrechem et hayyarden takimu veattem richaktem shishshim mil
Batar dinfak okem rav amora aleh udrash kaasher tziva Adonai et moshe avdo ken tziva moshe et yehoshua vechen asa yehoshua lo hesir davar mikkol asher tziva Adonai et moshe
Im ken ma talmud lomar kum lach amar lo atta garamta lahem vehayenu dekaamar leh beay veasita laay ulmalkah kaasher asita liricho ulmalkah vego

Vayehi bihot yehoshua biricho vayyissa enav vayyar vego vayyomer lo ki ani sar tzeva Adonai atta vati vayyippol yehoshua el panav artza vayyishtachu hechi aved hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan asur lo leadam sheyyitten shalom lachavero ballayela chayeshinan shemma shed hu
Shane hatam dekaamar leh ani sar tzeva Adonai atta vati vego vedilma meshakkeri gemiri dela mappeki shem shamayim levattala
b: Amar leh emesh bitaltem tamid shel ben haarbayim veachshav bitaltem talmud tora al eze mehen bata amar leh atta bati
Miyyad vayyalen yehoshua ballayela hahu betoch haemek veamar rabbi yochanan melammed shellan beumkah shel halacha
Amar shemuel bar inya mishshemeh derav gadol talmud tora yoter mehakravat temidin shenneemar atta vati
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi hay kera bemareva bemay mokmitu leh al tetze lariv maher pen ma taase beacharitah behachlim otcha reecha rivcha riv et reecha vesod acher al tegal

Beshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lichezkel lech emor lahem leyisrael avich haemori veimmech chittit amra ruach piskonit lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam im yavou avraham vesara veyaamdu lefanecha atta omer lahem umachlim otam rivcha riv et reecha vesod acher al tegal

Umi it leh reshuta kulle hay in deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina shalosh shemot yesh lo piskon itmon sigron piskon shepposek devarim kelappe mala itmon sheotem aonotehen shel yisrael sigron kevan shessoger shuv eno poteach

Hayaaroch shuacha lo vetzar amar rabbi elazar leolam yakdim adam tefilla latztzara sheilmale lo hikdim avraham tefilla latztzara ben bet el uven haay lo nishtayyer missonehen shel yisrael sarid ufalit resh lakish amar kol hamammetz atzmo bitfilla millematta en lo tzarim millemala rabbi yochanan amar leolam yevakkesh adam rachamim sheyehu hakkol meammetzin et kocho veal yehu lo tzarim millemala

Minnayin shekkiper lo viduo vechu tanu rabbanan minnayin shekkiper lo viduo shenneemar vayyomer lo yehoshua me achartanu yakorcha Adonai hayyom hazze hayyom hazze atta achur vei atta achur laolam habba uchtiv uvne zerach zimri veetan veheman vechalkol vedarda kullam chamishsha may kullam chamishsha kullan chamishsha hen laolam habba
Ketiv zimri uchtiv achan rav ushmuel chad amar achan shemo velamma nikra shemo zimri sheasa maase zimri vechad amar zimri shemo velamma nikra shemo achan sheiken aonotehen shel yisrael
Im eno yodea lehitvadot ku rabbi yehuda omer ku lenakkot atzman vinakku atzman kede shello lehotzi laaz al batte dinin veal haedim

Tanu rabbanan maase beadam echad sheyyatza lehareg amar im yesh bi aon ze lo tehe mitati kappara lechol aonotay veim en bi aon ze tehe mitati kappara lechol aonotay uvet din vechol yisrael menukkin vehaedim lo tehe lahem mechila leolam uchsheshshamu chachamim baddavar amru lehachziro i efshar shekkevar nigzera gezera ella yehareg vihe kolar taluy betzavar edim
Peshita kol kemineh la tzericha deka hadri behu sahadi
Vechi hadri behu may have kevan shehiggid shuv eno chozer umaggid la tzericha deaf al gav deka yahavi tama lemiltayehu ki hahu maase devaya mochsa

Matni haya rachok mibbet hassekila arba ammot mafshitin oto et begadav haish mechassin oto millefanav vehaishsha millefaneha umeachareha divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim haish niskal arom veen haishsha niskelet arumma

a: Gema tanu rabbanan haish mechassin oto perek echad millefanav veishsha shene perakim ben millefaneha ben milleachareha mippene shekkullah erva divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim haish niskal arom veen haishsha niskelet arumma
May tamayehu derabbanan amar kera veragmu oto may oto
Ilema oto velo otah vehachtiv vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi ella may oto oto belo kesuto ha otah bichsutah rabbi yehuda omer oto belo kesuto la shena ish vela shena ishsha

Lememra derabbanan chayeshi lehirhura verabbi yehuda la chayesh lehirhura veha ipcha shemana lehu ditnan hakkohen ochez bivgadeha im nikreu nikreu veim nifremu nifremu ad shemmegalle et libbah vesoter et searah rabbi yehuda omer im haya libbah nae lo haya megallehu veim haya searah nae lo haya sotro

Amar rabba hatam hayenu tama shemma tetze mibbet din zakkaa veyitgaru bah pirche kehunna hacha ha mikkatla vechi tema ate leitgaroye beachranyata amar rabba gemiri en yetzer hara sholet ella bemi sheenav root
Amar rava derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda kashya derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya ella amar rava derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya kidshannin
Derabbanan adderabbanan name la kashya amar kera venivasseru kol hannashim velo taasena kezimmatchena hacha en lecha yisur gadol mizze
Vechi tema lebed bah tarte amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar kera veahavta lereacha kamocha beror lo mita yafa
Lema derav nachman tannae hi la dechulle alma it lehu derav nachman vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar bizone deinish adif leh tefe minneyacha degufeh umar savar neyacha degufeh adif mibbizoneh
Matni bet hassekila haya gavoha shette komot echad min haedim dochafo al motnav nehpach al libbo hofcho al motnav veim met bah yatza
Veim lav hashsheni notel et haeven venotno al libbo im met bah yatza veim lav regimato bechol yisrael shenneemar yad haedim tihye bo varishona lahamito veyad kol haam baacharona
Gema tana vekoma shello hare kan shalosh umi baenan kulle hay urminhu ma bor shehu kede lehamit asara tefachim af kol kede lehamit asara tefachim
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar kera veahavta lereacha kamocha beror lo mita yafa i hachi lagbeheh tefe mishshum deminaval
Echad min haedim dochafo tanu rabbanan minnayin shebbidchiyya talmud lomar yaro uminnayin shebbiskila talmud lomar sakol
Uminnayin shebbiskila uvidchiyya talmud lomar sakol yissakel o yaro yiyyare uminnayin sheim met bidchiyya yatza talmud lomar o yaro yiyyare minnayin sheaf ledorot ken
b: Talmud lomar sakol yissakel

Veim lav ed hashsheni notel et haeven notel vehatanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer even hayeta sham massoy shene bene adam notlah venotnah al libbo im met bah yatza velitamach tikshe lach hi gufah massoy shene bene adam notlah venotnah al libbo
Ella demadle lah bahade chavreh veshade lah ihu ki hechi detete merazya
Veim lav regimato ku vehatanya meolam lo shana bah adam mi kaamena deaved dei mitztzerich kaamena

Amar mar even hayeta ku vehatanya achat even shenniskal bah veachat etz shennitle alav veechad sayif shenneherag bo veechad sudar shennechnak bo kullan nikbarin immo la tzericha dimtakkeni umayeti acharine chillufayehu
Nikbarin immo vehatanya en nikbarin immo amar rav pappa may immo immo bitfisato
Amar shemuel niktea yad haedim patur may tama devaena yad haedim tihye bo varishona veleka
Ella meatta edim gidmin demeikara hachi name difsili shane hatam deamar kera yad haedim shehayeta kevar
Metivi kol makom sheyeiduhu shenayim veyomru meidin anu beish peloni shennigmar dino bevet din peloni ufloni ufloni edav hare ze yehareg targema shemuel behen hen edav

Umi baenan kera kedichtiv vehatanya mot yumat hammakke rotzeach hu en li ella bemita hakketuva bo minnayin sheim i atta yachol lahamito bemita hakketuva bo sheatta memito bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito talmud lomar mot yumat hammakke mikkol makom
Shane hatam deamar kera mot yumat
Veligmar mineh mishshum dehave rotzeach vegoel haddam shene ketuvin habbain keechad vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Rotzeach ha daamaran goel haddam may hi detanya goel haddam yamit et harotzeach mitzva begoel haddam uminnayin sheim en lo goel shebbet din maamidin lo goel shenneemar befigo bo mikkol makom
Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe umi la baenan kera kedichtiv vehatnan haya echad mehen gidem o ilem o chiger o some o cheresh eno naasa ben sorer umore
Shenneemar vetafsu vo velo gidmin vehotziu oto velo chigrin veamru velo ilmin benenu ze velo somin enennu shomea bekolenu velo chershin
May tama lav mishshum devaenan kera kedichtiv la shane hatam dechulleh kera yattira hu
Ta shema en lah rechov en naaset ir hanniddachat divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer en lah rechov osin lah rechov
Ad kan la peligi ella demar savar rechovah demeikara bainan umar savar rechovah dehashta name kidmeikara dame aval dechulle alma baenan kera kedichtiv
Tannae hi ditnan en lo bohen yad bohen regel ozen yamanit en lo tohora olamit rabbi eliezer omer noten al mekomo veotze rabbi shimon omer noten al semolo veotze
Matni kol hanniskalin nitlin divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim eno nitle ella hamgaddef vehaoved avoda zara

Haish tolin oto panav kelappe haam vehaishsha paneha kelappe haetz divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim haish nitle veen haishsha nitlet amar lahen rabbi eliezer vahalo shimon ben shatach tala nashim beashkelon amru lo shemonim nashim tala veen danin shenayim beom echad
Gema tanu rabbanan vehumat vetalita yachol kol hammumatin nitlin talmud lomar ki killat elohim taluy ma mekallel ze shebbiskila af kol shebbiskila divre rabbi eliezer
Vachachamim omrim ma mekallel ze shekkafar baikar af kol shekkafar baikar
Bemay ka mipalgi rabbanan darshi kelale ufrate rabbi eliezer daresh ribuye umiute
Rabbanan darshi kelale ufrate vehumat vetalita kelal ki killat perat i hao mekarvi lahadade amrinan en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat hane in mide acharina la

a: Hashta dimrachaki mehadade ahani lerabboye avoda zara dedame leh bechol mile

Verabbi eliezer daresh ribuye umiute vehumat vetalita ribbuy ki killat miut i hao mekarvi lahadade la hao merabbinan ella avoda zara dedame leh bechol mile hashta dimrachaki mehadade ahani lerabboye shear hanniskalin
Haish tolin vechu may tama derabbanan amar kera vetalita oto oto velo otah verabbi eliezer oto belo kesuto
Verabbanan in hachi name ella amar kera vechi yihye veish chet ish velo ishsha

Verabbi eliezer hay vechi yihye veish may daresh beh amar resh lakish hahu lemaote ben sorer umore vehatanya ben sorer umore niskal venitle divre rabbi eliezer ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lerabbot ben sorer umore may tama
Deamar kera vechi yihye veish chet ish velo ben chet mi sheal cheto neherag yatza ben sorer umore sheal shum sofo neherag have miut achar miut veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot

Amar lahen rabbi eliezer vahalo shimon ben shatach tala nashim ku amar rav chisda lo shanu ella bishte mitot aval bemita achat danin veha maase deshimon ben shatach demita achat havay veka amru leh deen danin
Ella i itmar hachi itmar lo shanu ella bemita achat keen shette mitot vehechi dame kegon shette averot aval bemita achat vaavera achat danin
Metiv rav adda bar ahava en danin shenayim beom echad vaafilu benoef venoefet targema rav chisda bevat kohen uvoalah
O bevat kohen vezomme zommeha
Tanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer shamati shebbet din makkin veonshin shello min hattora velo laavor al divre tora ella kede laasot seyag lattora

Umaase beechad sherachav al sus beshabbat bime yevanim veheviuhu levet din uskaluhu lo mippene sherauy lechach ella shehashshaa tzericha lechach shuv maase beadam echad shehetiach et ishto tachat hatteena veheviuhu levet din vehilkuhu lo mippene sherauy lechach ella shehashshaa tzericha lechach
Matni ketzad tolin oto meshakkein et hakkora baaretz vehaetz yotze umakkif shette yadav zo al gav zo vetole oto rabbi yose omer hakkora mutta al hakkotel vetole oto kederech shehattabbachin osin

Umattirin oto miyyad veim lan over alav belo taase shenneemar lo talin nivlato al haetz ki kavor tikberennu ki killat elohim taluy vego kelomar mippene ma ze taluy mippene shebberach et hashshem venimtza shem shamayim mitchallel
Amar rabbi meir beshaa sheadam mitztaer shechina ma lashon omeret kallani meroshi kallani mizzeroi im ken hammakom mitztaer al daman shel reshaim shennishpach kal vechomer al daman shel tzaddikim
Velo zo bilvad amru ella kal hammelin et meto over belo taase helino lichvodo lehavi lo aron vetachrichim eno over alav

Velo hau kovrin oto bekivrot avotav ella shette batte kevarot hau metukkanin levet din achat lanneheragin velannechnakin veachat lanniskalin velannisrafin nitakkel habbasar melakketin et haatzamot vekovrin otan bimkoman vehakkerovim baim veshoalim bishlom haddayyanin uvishlom haedim kelomar sheen belibbenu alechem sheddin emet dantem
b: Velo hau mitabbelin aval onnin sheen aninut ella ballev

Gema tanu rabbanan ilu neemar chet vetalita hayiti omer tolin oto veachar kach memitin oto kederech shehammalchut osa talmud lomar vehumat vetalita memitin oto veachar kach tolin oto ha ketzad meshahin oto ad samuch lishkiat hachamma vegomrin et dino ummitin oto veachar kach tolin oto echad kosher veechad mattir kede lekayyem mitzvat teliyya
Tanu rabbanan etz shomea ani ben betalush ben bimchubbar talmud lomar ki kavor mi sheeno mechussar ella kevura yatza ze shemchussar ketzitza ukvura
Rabbi yose omer mi sheeno mechussar ella kevura yatza ze shemchussar telisha ukvura verabbanan telisha lav kelum hi

Kelomar mippene ma ze taluy mippene shebberach ku tanya omer rabbi meir mashlu mashal lema haddavar dome lishne achim teomim beir achat echad minuhu melech veechad yatza lelistiyyut tziva hammelech utlauhu kol haroe oto omer hammelech taluy tziva hammelech vehoriduhu
Amar rabbi meir ku may mashma amar abbaye keman deamar kal let amar leh rava im ken kaved alay roshi kaved alay zeroi mibe leh ella amar rava keman deamar kil li alma
Hay mibe leh legufeh im ken nema kera mekallel may killat veema kulleh lehachi hu daata im ken nema kera kallat may killat shema minah tarte
Velo zo bilvad ku amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay minnayin lammelin et meto sheover alav belo taase talmud lomar ki kavor tikberennu mikkan lammelin et meto sheover belo taase
Ika deamri amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay remez likvura min hattora minnayin talmud lomar ki kavor tikberennu mikkan remez likvura min hattora
Amar leh shabbur malka lerav chama kevura min hattora minnayin ishtik vela amar leh vela mide amar rav acha bar yaakov imsar alma bida detafshae deibi leh lememar ki kavor
Deleeved leh aron tikberennu la mashma leh
Venema middeikvur tzaddike minhaga bealma middekavreh hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe dela lishtanne mimminhaga
Ta shema vesafdu lo chol yisrael vekavru oto dela lishtanne mimminhaga
Lo yissafdu velo yikkaveru ledomen al pene haadama yihu delishtanno mimminhaga
Ibaya lehu kevura mishshum bizona hu o mishshum kappara hu
Lemay nafka minah deamar la baena delikberuh lehahu gavra i amratte mishshum bizona hu la kol kemineh vei amratte mishshum kappara hu ha amar la baena kappara may
Ta shema middeikvur tzaddike vei amratte mishshum kappara tzaddike lechappara tzerichi in dichtiv adam en tzaddik baaretz asher yaase tov velo yecheta

Ta shema vesafdu lo chol yisrael vekavru oto vei amratte ki hechi deteheve leh kappara hanach name likavru ki hechi deteheve lehu kappara hay detzaddik hu teheve leh kappara hanach la leheve lehu kappara
Ta shema lo yissafdu velo yikkaveru dela teheve lehu kappara
Ibaya lehu hespeda yekara dechaye have o yekara deshachve have lemay nafka minah deamar la tispeduh lehahu gavra i name leappoke miyyorshin
Ta shema vayyavo avraham lispod lesara velivkotah vei amratte mishshum yekara dechayye hu mishshum yekara deavraham meshahu lah lesara sara gufah nicha lah ki hechi demiyyakar bah avraham
Ta shema vesafdu lo chol yisrael vekavru oto vei amratte mishshum yekara dechayye hu hanach bene yekara ninhu nicha lehu letzaddikayya demiyyakri behu inashe
Ta shema lo yissafdu velo yikkaveru la nicha letzaddikayya demiyyakri barshiiyya

Ta shema beshalom tamut uvmisrefot avotecha hammelachim harishonim asher hau lefanecha ken yisrefu lach vehoy adon yispedu lach vei amratte mishshum yekara dechaye hu may nafka leh mineh hachi kaamar leh liyyakru bach yisrael ki hechi demityakri baavahatach

a: Ta shema nivze beenav nimas ze chizkiyyahu melech yehuda sheggerar atzmot aviv al mitta shel chavalim vei mishshum yekara dechayye hu may tama
Ki hechi detihve leh kappara laavuh umishshum kappara daavuh meshahu leh likara deyisrael yisrael gufayehu nicha lehu demachali yekarayehu legabbeh
Ta shema amar lahen al tispeduni baayarot vei amratte yekara dechayye may nafka leh minah kasavar lityakru beh yisrael tefe
Ta shema helino lichvodo lehavi lo aron vetachrichin eno over alav may lav lichvodo shel met lo lichvodo shel chay
Umishshum kevodo shel chay mevit leh lemet in ki amar rachamana lo talin nivlato al haetz dumya detaluy deit beh bizzaon aval hacha kevan delet beh bizzaon la

Ta shema helino lichvodo leshammea alav ayarot lehavi lo mekonnot lehavi lo aron vetachrichin eno over alav shekkol haose eno ella lichvodo shel met hachi kaamar kol haose lichvodo shel chay en bo bizzaon lammet

Ta shema rabbi natan omer siman yafe lammet shennifrain mimmennu leachar mita met shello nispad velo nikbar o shechayya gorarto o shehau geshamim mezallefin al mittato zehu siman yafe lammet shema minah yekara deshachve hu shema minah

Lo hau kovrin ku vechol kach lamma lefi sheen kovrin rasha etzel tzaddik deamar rabbi acha bar chanina minnayin sheen kovrin rasha etzel tzaddik shenneemar vayehi hem kovrim ish vehinne rau et haggedud vayyashlichu et haish bekever elisha vayyigga haish beatzmot elisha vayechi vayyakom al raglav
Amar leh rav pappa vedilma leikome vihi na pi shenayim beruchacha elay amar leh i hachi hayenu detanya al raglav amad ulveto lo halach
Ella vihi na pi shenayim hechi mashkachatte lah deachaye amar leh rabbi yochanan sheripe tzaraat naaman shehi shekula kemet dichtiv al na tehi kammet
Uchshem sheen kovrin rasha etzel tzaddik kach en kovrin rasha chamur etzel rasha kal velitkon arba kevarot shene kevarot gemara gemiri lah
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan achal chelev vehifrish korban vehishtammed vechazar bo hoil venidcha yiddache
Itmar name amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan achal chelev vehifrish korban venishtatta vechazar venishtappa hoil venidcha yiddache
Utzricha dei ashmeinan kammayeta mishshum deihu decha nafsheh beyadayim aval hay demimmela ka dache ema keyashen dame
Vei ashmeinan hacha mishshum deen beyado lachzor aval hatam divyado lachzor ema la tzericha

Amar rav yosef af anan name tenena hau bah kodashim kodshe mizbeach yamutu kodshe bedek habbayit yippadu vehavenan bah ammay yamutu kevan deiktul haveya lehu kappara velisku legavoha lav mishshum deamrinan hoil venidchu yiddachu

Amar leh abbaye mi savratte met mittoch risho haveya leh kappara met mittoch risho la haveya leh kappara detane rav shemaya yachol afilu pershu avotav middarche tzibur yittamme talmud lomar beammav beose maase ammav

Amar leh rava mi ka medammet neherag mittoch risho lemet mittoch risho met mittoch risho kevan dechi orcheh kamayet la haveya leh kappara neherag mittoch risho kevan delav ki orcheh mayet haveya leh kappara

Tidda dichtiv mizmor leasaf elohim bau goyim benachalatecha timmeu et hechal kodshecha vego natnu et nivlat avadecha maachal leof hashshamayim besar chasidecha lechayeto aretz may avadecha umay chasidecha lav chasidecha chasidecha mammash avadecha hanach dimchayevi dina demeikara vechevan deiktul kare lehu avadecha
Amar leh abbaye mi ka medammet
b: Haruge malchut laharuge bet din haruge malchut kevan deshello bedin ka mikatli haveya lehu kappara haruge bet din kevan divdin ka mikatli la have lehu kappara
Teda ditnan lo hau kovrin oto bekivrot avotav vei salka datach kevan deiktul haveya lehu kappara likavru mita ukvura baenan
Motev rav adda bar ahava la hau mitabbelin ella onnin sheen aninut ella ballev vei salka datach kevan deikvur haveya lehu kappara liabbelu
Baenan name ikul basar dayeka name dekatane nitakkel habbasar melakketin et haatzamot vekovrin otan bimkoman shema minah
Rav ashe amar avelut meematay ka matchala missetimat haggolel kappara meematay ka haveya mikki chazu tzaara dekivra purta hilkach hoil venidchu yiddachu
I hachi lema li ikul basar mishshum dela efshar

Kivreh derav hao shakli mineh afra leishata bat yoma ato amaru leh lishmuel amar lehu yaut avdin karka olam hu vekarka olam enah neeseret dichtiv vayyashlech et afarah al kever bene haam makkish kever bene haam laavoda zara
Ma avoda zara bimchubbar la mitasra dichtiv asher attem yorshim otam et elohehem al heharim haramim al heharim elohehem velo heharim elohehem hacha name bimchubbar la mitsar
Metivi hachotzev kever leaviv vehalach ukvaro bemakom acher hare ze lo yikkaver bo olamit hacha bemay askinan bekever binyan
Ta shema kever chadash muttar bahanaa hetil bo nefel asur bahanaa hacha name bekever binyan
Ta shema nimtza atta omer shalosh kevarot hen kever hannimtza kever hayyadua kever hammazzik et harabbim kever hannimtza muttar lefannoto pinahu mekomo tahor umuttar bahanaa
Kever hayyadua asur lefannoto pinahu mekomo tame veasur bahanaa
Kever hammazzik et harabbim muttar lefannoto pinahu mekomo tahor veasur bahanaa hacha name bekever binyan
Vekever hannimtza muttar lefannoto dilma met mitzva hu umet mitzva kana mekomo shane met mitzva dekala it leh
Itmar haoreg beged lammet abbaye amar asur verava amar muttar
Abbaye amar asur hazmana milleta hi verava amar muttar hazmana lav milta hi
May tama deabbaye gamar sham sham meegla arufa ma egla arufa behazmana mitasra hay name behazmana mitasra
Verava gamar sham sham meavoda zara ma avoda zara behazmana la mitasra af hacha name behazmana la mitasra
Verava may tama la gamar meegla arufa amar lach

a: Meshammeshin mimmeshammeshin gamrinan leappoke egla arufa dehi gufah kedosha
Veabbaye may tama la gamar meavoda zara amar lach mide deorcheh mimmide deorcheh gamrinan leappoke avoda zara delav orcha
Siman kippa nafsheh dachatziva bekivreh deyattir meavuh bechisa deummana
Metivi kippa shehu tame midras untanattu lesefer tahor min hammidras aval tame magga midras ema netanattu uchrachattu

Lema li netanattu uchrachattu kidrav chisda deamar rav chisda hay sudara deazmeneh lemetzar beh tefilin vetzar beh tefilin asur lemetzar beh peshite azmeneh vela tzar beh tzar beh vela azmeneh shere lemetzar beh peshite
Vlabbaye deamar hazmana milta hi azmeneh af al gav dela tzar beh tzar beh i azmeneh in i la azmeneh la
Ta shema nefesh shebbenao leshem chay muttar bahanaa hosif bo dimos echad leshem met asur bahanaa hacha bemay askinan dirma beh met
I hachi may irya hosif ki lo hosif name la tzericha af al gav defanneyeh
Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda im haya makkiro choltzo umuttar
Ta shema hachotzev kever leaviv vehalach ukvaro bekever acher hare ze lo yikkaver bo olamit hatam mishshum kevod aviv
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af hachotzev avanim leaviv vehalach ukvaro bemakom acher hare ze lo yikkaver bahen olamit
I amratte bishlama mishshum kevod aviv shappir ella i amratte mishshum hazmana teviy laariga mi ika leman deamar
Ta shema kever chadash muttar bahanaa hetil bo nefel asur bahanaa hetil in lo hetil la
Hu haddin deaf al gav dela hetil ulappoke midderabban shimon ben gamliel deamar en linfalim tefisat hakkever ka mashma lan
Ta shema motar hammetim lemetim motar hammet leorshav hacha bemay askinan sheggavu mechayyim
Ha la tane hachi ditnan motar hammetim lemetim motar hammet leorshav vetane alah ketzad gavu lemetim setam zehu motar hammetim lemetim gavu lemet ze zehu motar hammet leorshav
Velitamach ema sefa rabbi meir omer lo yigga bahen ad sheyyavo eliyyahu rabbi natan omer yaasennu dimos al kivro o ziluf lifne mittato
Ella abbaye metaretz letameh verava metaretz letameh abbaye metaretz letameh dechulle alma hazmana milta hi tanna kamma savar dachaze leh tafes dela chaze leh la tafes
Verabbi meir mesappeka leh i tafes i la tafes hilkach lo yigga bahen ad sheyyavo eliyyahu verabbi natan peshita leh devadday tafes hilkach yease dimos al kivro
Verava metaretz letameh lechulle alma hazmana lav milta hi tanna kamma savar ki bazu leh achole machel ziluteh gabbe yorshin
Verabbi meir mesappeka leh i machel i la machel hilkach lo yigga bahen ku verabbi natan peshita leh dela machel hilkach yease dimos al kivro o ziluf lifne mittato
Ta shema hau aviv veimmo mezarkin bo kelim mitzva al haacherim lehatztzilan
b: Hatam mishshum merarayehu i hachi hayenu dekatane alah amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim shello nagu bammitta aval nagu bammitta asurin
Targemah ulla bemitta hannikberet immo demichallefi betachrichi hammet
Ta shema kis sheasao lehanniach bo tefilin asur lehanniach bo maot hinniach bo tefilin yanniach bo maot ema asao vehinniach bo tefilin asur lehanniach bo maot kidrav chisda
Ta shema amar leumman ase li tik shel sefer o nartik shel tefilin ad shello nishtammesh bahen kodesh muttar lehishtammesh bahen chol nishtammesh bahen kodesh asur lehishtammesh bahen chol

Tannae hi detanya tzipan zahav o shettala alehen or shel behema temea pesulot or behema tehora kesherot af al pi shello ibdan lishman rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af or behema tehora pesulot ad sheyeabbedo lishman
Amar leh ravina lerava mi ika duchta deramu beh met veargi beged lammet amar leh in kegon shachve deharpanya
Derash marimar hilcheta kevateh deabbaye verabbanan amri hilcheta kevateh derava vehilcheta kevateh derava

Tanu rabbanan haruge malchut nichsehen lammelech haruge bet din nichsehen layyorshin rabbi yehuda omer af haruge malchut nichsehen layyorshin amaru leh lerabbi yehuda vahalo kevar neemar hinne becherem navot asher yarad sham lerishto

Amar lahen ben achi aviv haya verauy leorsho haya vahalo harbe banim hau lo amar lahen oto veet banav harag shenneemar im lo et deme navot veet deme vanav raiti verabbanan hahu banim haruyin latzet mimmennu
Bishlama leman deamar nichsehen lammelech hayenu dichtiv berach navot elohim vamelech ella leman deamar nichsehen layyorshin lema li vamelech
Ultamach elohim lema li ella leapposhe ritcha hachi name leapposhe ritcha

Bishlama leman deamar nichsehen lammelech hayenu dichtiv vayyanos yoav el ohel Adonai vayyachazek bekarnot hammizbeach uchtiv vayyomer lo etze ki po amut ella leman deamar nichsehen layyorshin may nafka leh minah lechayye shaa

Vayyashev benayahu et hammelech davar lemor ko dibber yoav vecho anani amar leh zil ema leh tarte la taaved behay gavra i katlatte leh kabbel latuteh delatyeh avuch vei la shivkeh deleku belatuteh delatyeh avuch vayyomer lo hammelech ase kaasher dibber ufga bo ukvarto
Amar rav yehuda amar rav kol kelalot shekkilel david et yoav nitkayemu bezaro shel david al yikkaret mibbet yoav zav umtzora umachazik bappelech venofel bacherev vachasar lachem
Zav merchavam dichtiv vehammelech rechavam hitammetz laalot bammerkava lanus yerushalam uchtiv vechol hammerkav asher yirkav alav hazzav yitma
Metzora meuzziyyahu dichtiv uvchezkato gavah libbo ad lehashchit vayyimal ba elohav vayyavo el hechal Adonai lehaktir al mizbach hakketoret uchtiv vehatztzaraat zarcha vemitzcho

Machazik befelech measa dichtiv rak leet ziknato chala et raglav veamar rav yehuda amar rav sheachazo podagra amar leh mar zutra bereh derav nachman lerav nachman hechi dame amar leh kemachat bivsar hachay mena yada i baet ema mechash hava chayesh beh veibaet ema merabbeh hava gemir lah veibaet ema sod Adonai lireav uvrito lehodiam
Nofel bacherev miyyoshiyyahu dichtiv vayyoru hammorim lammelech yoshiyyahu veamar rav yehuda amar rav sheasu kol gufo kichvara
Vachasar lechem michonya dichtiv vaaruchato aruchat tamid nittena lo amar rav yehuda amar rav hayenu deamri inashe

a: Tehe luta vela tehe lata
Atuh leoav dayeneh amar leh may tama ketalteh leavner amar leh goel haddam daasael havay asael rodef hava amar leh haya lo lehatztzilo beechad meevarav

Amar leh la yechel leh amar leh hashta bedofen chamishit kaven leh dichtiv vayyakkehu avner beachare hachanit el hachomesh veamar rabbi yochanan bedofen chamishit bemakom shemmara vechaved teluyin bo beechad meevarav la yechel leh

Amar leh nezil avner may tama ketalteh laamasa amar leh amasa mored bammalchut hava dichtiv vayyomer hammelech laamasa hazek li et ish yehuda sheloshet yamim vego vayyelech amasa lehazik et yehuda vayyocher vego
Amar leh amasa akkin verakkin derash
Ashkechinhu diftiach lehu bemassechta amar ketiv kol ish asher yamre et picha velo yishma et devarecha lechol asher tetzavennu yumat yachol afilu ledivre tora talmud lomar rak chazak veematz
Ella hahu gavra mored bammalchut hava dichtiv vehashshemua baa ad yoav ki yoav nata achare adoniyya veachare avshalom lo nata
May lo nata amar rav yehuda shebbikesh lintot velo nata umay tama la nata amar rabbi elazar adayin lichluchit shel david kayyemet

Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar adayin itztagnine shel david kayyamin deamar rav yehuda amar rav arba meot yeladim hau lo ledavid kullan bene yefat toar hau umgaddele velorit hau umhallechin berashe haggeyasot hau vehen hen baale egrofin shel david

Ufliga derabbi abba bar kahana deamar rabbi abba bar kahana ilmale david lo asa yoav milchama veilmale yoav lo asak david battora dichtiv vayehi david ose mishpat utzdaka lechol ammo veoav ben tzeruya al hatztzava ma taam david ose mishpat utzdaka lechol ammo mishshum deoav al hatztzava uma taam yoav al hatztzava mishshum dedavid ose mishpat utzdaka lechol ammo
Vayyetze yoav meim david vayyishlach malachim achare avner vayyashivu oto mibbor hassira may bor hassira amar rabbi abba bar kahana bor vesira garmu lo leavner sheyyehareg

Vayyattehu yoav el toch hashshaar ledabber itto bashsheli amar rabbi yochanan sheddano din sanhedri amar leh may tama ketalteh laasael asael rodef haya haya lecha lehatztzilo beechad meevarav la yecheli leh hashta bedofen chamishit kavente leh beechad meevarav la yechelte leh
Ledabber itto bashsheli amar rav yehuda amar rav al iske shalu vayyakkehu sham el hachomesh amar rabbi yochanan bedofen chamishit makom shemmara vechaved teluyin bo
Veheshiv Adonai et damo al rosho asher paga bishne anashim tzaddikim tovim mimmennu tovim shehau dorshin akkin verakkin vehu lo darash tzaddikim shehen bappe velo asu vehu beigeret asa
Vaamasa lo nishmar bacherev asher beyad yoav amar rav shello chashado

Vayyikkaver beveto bammidbar attu beto midbar hu amar rav yehuda amar rav kammidbar ma midbar mufkar lakkol af beto shel yoav mufkar lakkol davar acher kammidbar ma midbar menukke miggazel vaaraot af beto shel yoav menukke miggazel vaaraot veoav yechayye et shear hair amar rav yehuda afilu munine vetzachanata taem pares lehu

b: Matni arba mitot nimseru levet din sekila serefa hereg vachenek rabbi shimon omer serefa sekila chenek vahereg zo mitzvat hanniskalin
Gema amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna kol makom sheshshanu chachamim derech minyan en mukdam umuchar chutz mishshiva sammanin
Ditnan shiva sammanin maavirin al hakketem rok tafel ume gerisin ume raglayim veneter uvorit kimolya veashlach
Vekatane sefa heeviran shello kesidran o sheheeviran shivatan keechad lo asa velo chelum
Rav pappa sava mishshemeh derav amar af arba mitot middeka mippelig rabbi shimon shema minah daveka katane veidach biflugta la ka mayere
Rav pappa amar af seder yoma ditnan kol maase yom hakkippurim haamurim al hasseder im hikdim maase lachavero lo asa velo chelum
Veidach hahu chumra bealma
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar af seder tamid dekatane alah zehu seder tamid veidach hahu lemitzva bealma
Ulappoke mimmitzvat chalitza ditnan mitzvat chalitza ba hu vivimto lifne bet din hau notnin lo etza hahogenet lo shenneemar vekaru lo zikne iro vedibberu elav
Vehi omeret meen yevami vego vehu omer lo chafatzti lekachtah uvilshon hakkodesh hau omrin
Veniggesha yevimto elav leene hazzekenim vechaltza naalo veyarka befanav rok hannire laddayyanin veanta veamra kacha yease leish vego venikra shemo beyisrael vego
Veamar rav yehuda mitzvat chalitza kora vekore choletzet verokeket vekora
Vehavenan bah may ka mashma lan matnitin hi ha ka mashma lan mitzva hachi vei afech let lan bah tanya name hachi ben shehikdim chalitza lirkika o rekika lachalitza ma sheasa asuy
Ulappoke meha ditnan kohen gadol meshammesh bishmona kelim vehedot bearbaa bichtonet bemichnasayim bemitznefet veavnet mosif alehen kohen gadol choshen veefod umil vetzitz
Vetanya minnayin shello yehe davar kodem lammichnasayim shenneemar umichnese vad yihu al besaro
Vetanna may tama akdemeh lichtonet mishshum deakdemeh kera ukra may tama akdemeh mishshum dimchasseya kulleh gufeh adifa leh
Sekila serefa ku sekila chamura misserefa shekken nitna limgaddef uloved avoda zara may chumra shekken poshet yado baikar
Adderabba serefa chamura shekken nitna levat kohen shezzinta umay chumra shekken mechallelet et aviha

a: Kasavri rabbanan nesua yotza lisrefa velo arusa umiddeappekah rachamana laarusa biskila shema minah sekila chamura
Sekila chamura missayif shekken nitna limgaddef uloved avoda zara umay chumra kedaamaran
Adderabba sayif chamur shekken nitan leanshe ir hanniddachat umay chumra shekken mamonan aved
Amarta eze koach merubbe koach hammaddiach o koach hannidach heve omer koach hammaddiach vetanya maddiche ir hanniddachat biskila
Sekila chamura mechenek shekken nitan limgaddef uloved avoda zara umay chumra kedaamaran
Adderabba chenek chamur shekken nitan lemakke aviv veimmo umay chumra shekken hukkash kevodan lichvod hammakom
Middeappekeh rachamana laarusa bat yisrael mikkelal nesua bat yisrael mechenek liskila shema minah sekila chamura
Serefa chamura missayif shekken nitna levat kohen shezzinta umay chumra shekken mechallelet et aviha
Adderabba sayif chamur shekken nitan leanshe ir hanniddachat umay chumra shekken mamonan aved
Neemar aviha biskila veneemar aviha bisrefa ma aviha haamur biskila sekila chamura missayif af aviha haamur bisrefa serefa chamura missayif
Serefa chamura mechenek shekken nitna levat kohen shezzinta umay chumra kedaamaran
Adderabba chenek chamur shekken nitan lemakke aviv veimmo umay chumra shekken hukkash kevodan lichvod hammakom
Middeappekeh rachamana linsua bat kohen mikkelal nesua bat yisrael mechenek lisrefa shema minah serefa chamura
Sayif chamur mechenek shekken nitan leanshe ir hanniddachat umay chumra shekken mamonam aved

Rabbi shimon omer ku serefa chamura missekila shekken nitna levat kohen shezzinta umay chumra shekken mechallelet et aviha
Adderabba sekila chamura shekken nitna limgaddef uloved avoda zara umay chumra shekken poshet yado baikar
Rabbi shimon letameh deamar achat arusa veachat nesua yatza lisrefa umiddeappekeh rachamana laarusa bat kohen mikkelal arusa bat yisrael missekila lisrefa shema minah serefa chamura

Chenek chamur missayif shekken nitan lemakke aviv veimmo umay chumra kedaamaran
Adderabba sayif chamur shekken nitan leanshe ir hanniddachat umay chumra shekken mamonam aved
Amarta vechi eze koach merubbe koach hammaddiach o koach hannidach heve omer koach hammaddiach vetanya maddiche ir hanniddachat biskila rabbi shimon omer bechenek
Margela befummeh derabbi yochanan naara hamorasa bat kohen shezzinta biskila rabbi shimon omer bisrefa zinta meaviha biskila rabbi shimon omer bisrefa
May ka mashma lan lerabbanan nesua yatza lisrefa velo arusa lerabbi shimon achat arusa veachat nesua yatza lisrefa vetama may mishshum dilrabbanan sekila chamura lerabbi shimon serefa chamura
Nafka minah lemi shennitchayyev shette mitot bet din nidon bachamura
May rabbi shimon detanya rabbi shimon omer shene kelalot neemru bevat kohen
Bevat kohen velo bevat yisrael ema af bevat kohen
Vehotzi hakkatuv nesua mikkelal nesua vaarusa mikkelal arusa
Ma keshehotzi hakkatuv nesua mikkelal nesua lehachmir af keshehotzi hakkatuv arusa mikkelal arusa lehachamir
Zomme nesua bat kohen bichlal zomme nesua bat yisrael vezomme arusa bat kohen bichlal zomme arusa bat yisrael
Tanu rabbanan uvat ish kohen ki techel yachol afilu chillela et hashshabbat talmud lomar liznot bechilulin shebbiznut hakkatuv medabber
Yachol afilu penuya neemar kan aviha veneemar lehallan aviha ma lehallan zenut im zikat habbaal af kan zenut im zikat habbaal
O eno omer aviha ella lehotzi et kol haadam keshehu omer hi mechallelet heve kal adam amur
Ha ma ani mekayyem aviha neemar kan aviha veneemar lehallan aviha ma lehallan zenut im zikat habbaal af kan zenut im zikat habbaal
I ma lehallan naara vehi arusa af kan naara vehi arusa naara vehi nesua bogeret vehi arusa bogeret vehi nesua vaafilu hizkina minnayin
Talmud lomar uvat kohen mikkol makom
Bat kohen

a: En li ella shenniset lechohen niset lelevi ulyisrael lechuti lechalal lemamzer ulnatin minnayin talmud lomar uvat ish kohen af al pi sheenah kohenet
Hi bisrefa veen boalah bisrefa hi bisrefa veen zommeha bisrefa
Rabbi eliezer omer et aviha bisrefa veet chamiha biskila
Amar mar yachol afilu chilla shabbat chilla shabbat bat sekila hi
Amar rava ha manni rabbi shimon hi deamar serefa chamura salka datach amena hoil veachmer behu rachamana bechahane derabbi behu mitzot yeterot tidon bisrefa ka mashma lan
May shena mineh dideh
Salka datach amena ihu deishtarya leh shabbat legabbe avoda hi kevan dela ishtarya shabbat legabbah ema tidon bisrefa ka mashma lan
Yachol afilu penuya ha liznot ketiv
Kidrabbi elazar deamar panuy habba al happenuya shello leshum ishut asaah zona
O eno omer aviha ella lehotzi et kol adam ella may nihu shezzinta meaviha may irya bat kohen afilu bat yisrael name
Deamar rava amar li rav yitzchak bar avudimi atya henna henna
Atya zimma zimma
Itzterich salka datach amena kera leappoke midderava middegalli rachamana bevat kohen velo bevat yisrael ka mashma lan
Bat kohen en li ella shenniset lechohen niset lelevi leyisrael ulchuti ulchallel lenatin ulmamzer minnayin talmud lomar bat ish kohen af al pi sheenah kohenet
Mishshum deinasva lehu lehane lav bat kohen hi vetu mide kohenet lechohen ketiv
Salka datach amena ki techel liznot amar rachamana hane mile hecha deka matchala hashta aval ha kevan deka matchala vekayema meikara
Deamar mar uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar kevan shennivala lefasul lah pesalah
Lelevi veyisrael name veshava el bet aviha kinureha mikkelal dechi iteh gabbeh la achla
Ema la tidon bisrefa ka mashma lan
Udla kerabbi meir detanya bat kohen shenniset leyisrael veachla teruma meshallemet et hakkeren veenah meshallemet et hachomesh umitatah bisrefa
Niset leechad min happesulin meshallemet keren vachomesh umitatah bechenek divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim zo vazo meshallemot keren velo chomesh umitatan bisrefa
Rabbi eliezer omer et aviha bisrefa veet chamiha biskila may et aviha veet chamiha
Ilema et aviha meaviha veet chamiha mechamiha may irya bat kohen afilu bat yisrael name bitto bisrefa vechallato biskila
Ella et aviha birshut aviha veet chamiha birshut chamiha
Keman i kerabbanan haamri nesua yatzat lisrefa velo arusa i kerabbi shimon haamar achat arusa veachat nesua bisrefa
Vei kerabbi yishmael haamar arusa yatzat lisrefa velo nesua et chamiha chenek hu

Shelach ravin mishshemeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina kach hi hatztzaa shel mishna leolam kerabbanan vehachi kaamar kol shehi lematta mimmitat aviha umay nihu nesua bat yisrael deilu nesua bat yisrael bechenek hacha bemitat aviha bisrefa
Kol shehi lemala mimmitat aviha umay nihu arusa bat yisrael deilu arusa bat yisrael bealma biskila hacha bemitat chamiha biskila
Matkef lah rabbi yirmeya mide lemala lematta katane ella amar rabbi yirmeya
b: Leolam kerabbi yishmael vehachi kaamar et aviha birshut aviha bisrefa veet chamiha mechamiha biskila vechol adam bechenek
Amar rava may shena o ide veide mammash o ide veide reshut
Ella amar rava leolam kerabbi shimon vekasavar rabbi eliezer nesua kaarusa ma arusa chad darga massekinan lah missekila lisrefa af nesua chad darga massekinan lah mechenek liskila
Matkef lah rabbi chanina ha ide veide rabbi shimon bisrefa kaamar
Ella amar ravina leolam kerabbanan veefoch et aviha biskila veet chamiha bisrefa vehay dekaamar et aviha sircha bealma naket
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav halacha kedishlach ravin mishshemeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina amar rav yosef hilcheta limshicha
Amar leh abbaye ella meatta shechitat kodashim la litne hilcheta limshicha ella derosh vekabbel sachar hacha name derosh vekabbel sachar
Hachi kaamri hilcheta lema li sugya dishmata halacha kaamar
May rabbi yishmael detanya uvat ish kohen ki techel liznot benaara vehi arusa hakkatuv medabber

Atta omer benaara vehi arusa o eno ella afilu nesua talmud lomar ish asher yinaf et eshet reehu mot yumat hannoef vehannoafet hakkol hau bichlal hannoef vehannoefet hotzi hakkatuv bat yisrael biskila uvat kohen bisrefa ma keshehotzi hakkatuv et bat yisrael liskila arusa velo nesua af keshehotzi hakkatuv bat kohen lisrefa arusa velo nesua
Zommeha uvoalah bichlal vaasitem lo kaasher zamam vego
Boalah may kaasher zamam ika ella zommeha bichlal mitat boalah
Mishshum shenneemar vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv velo laachoto divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer achat arusa veachat nesua yatzat lisrefa yachol afilu penuya neemar kan aviha veneemar lehallan aviha ma lehallan zenut im zikat habbaal af kan zenut im zikat habbaal
Amar lo rabbi yishmael i ma lehallan naara vehi arusa af kan naara vehi arusa
Amar lo rabbi akiva yishmael achi bat uvat ani doresh
Amar lo vechi mippene sheatta doresh bat uvat notzi zo lisrefa im mashma lehavi et hannesua have et happenuya veim mashma lehotzi et happenuya hotze et hannesua
Verabbi akiva ahani gezera shava lemaote penuya veahani bat uvat lerabbot et hannesua
Verabbi yishmael savar middekaamar leh bat uvat shema minah hadar beh miggezera shava

Verabbi yishmael hay bat uvat may daresh beh mibe leh lechidtane avuh dishmuel bar avin lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv bizcharim ben temimim levaale mumin yachol nachlok bivnotehen talmud lomar bat uvat
Verabbi akiva min hem makrivim vehau kodesh nafka
Verabbi yishmael i mehahi hava amena hane mile inhu aval benotehen la ka mashma lan
Verabbi yishmael

a: Hay aviha hi mechallelet may daresh beh

Mibbee leh lechidtanya haya rabbi meir omer ma talmud lomar et aviha hi mechallelet sheim hau nohagin bo kodesh nohagin bo chol kavod nohagin bo bizzaon omrin arur shezzo yalad arur shezzo gidel arur sheyyatza zo mechalatzav
Amar rav ashe keman karenan rashshia bar rashshia vaafilu lerashshia bar tzaddika keman kehay tanna
Zo mitzvat hanniskalin may tanna dekatane zo mitzvat hanniskalin
Mishshum ditna nigmar haddin motziin oto lesoklo bet hassekila haya gavoha shette komot veayede deka vae lemitne mitzvat hannisrafin tena name zo mitzvat hanniskalin

Matni mitzvat hannisrafin hau meshakkein oto bazzevel ad archubbotav venotnin sudar kasha letoch harakka vechorech al tzavaro ze moshech etzlo veze moshech etzlo ad sheppoteach et piv umadlik et happetila vezorkah letoch piv veoredet letoch meav vechomeret et bene meav

Rabbi yehuda omer af hu im met beyadam lo hau mekayemin bo mitzvat serefa ella poteach et piv bitzvat shello betovato umadlik et happetila vezorkah letoch piv veoredet letoch meav vechomeret et bene meav
Amar rabbi elazar ben tzadok maase bevat kohen achat shezzinta vehikkifuha chavile zemorot usrafuha amru lo mippene shello haya bet din shel otah shaa baki
Gema may petila amar rav matna petila shel avar
Mena lan atya serefa serefa meadat korach ma lehallan serefat neshama veguf kayyam af kan serefat neshama veguf kayyam
Rabbi elazar amar atya serefa serefa mibbene aharon ma lehallan serefat neshama veguf kayyam af kan serefat neshama veguf kayyam
Man deyalef meadat korach mena leh dichtiv veet machtot hachattaim haelle benafshotam shennishmatan nisrefet veguf kayyam
Veidach hahi serefa mammash hi umay benafshotam shennitchayevu serefa al iske nafshotam
Kidresh lakish deamar resh lakish may dichtiv bechanfe laage maog charok alay shinnemo bishvil chanuppa shehechnifu lekorach al iske legima charak alehen sar shel gehinnam shinnav
Uman deyalef mibbene aharon mena leh dichtiv vayyamutu lifne Adonai keen mita

Veidach hahu serefa mammash havay umay dichtiv vayyamutu deatchel behu miggavay keen mita detanya abba yose ben dostay omer shene chutin shel esh yatzu mibbet kodesh hakkodashim venechleku learba venichnesu shenayim bechotmo shel ze ushnayim bechotmo shel ze usrafum
Vehachtiv vattochal otam otam velo bigdehem
Venelaf mipparim hannisrafim ma lehallan serefa mammash af kan serefa mammash
Mistabbera meadam hava leh lemelaf shekken adam chote neshama pigul
Adderabba mipparim hannisrafim hava leh lemelaf shekken machshir ledorot
Hanach nefishin
Man deyalef meadat korach may tama la yalef mibbene aharon hahu serefa mammash havay venelaf minah
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar kera veahavta lereacha kamocha beror lo mita yafa
Vechi meachar deika derav nachman gezera shava lema li
I lav gezera shava hava amena serefat neshama veguf kayyam lav serefa hi kelal vei mishshum veahavta lereacha kamocha lappesh leh chavile zemorot ki hechi delisrof laagal ka mashma lan

Uchvar hau moshe veaharon mehallechin badderech venadav vaavihu mehallechin acharehen vechol yisrael acharehen amar lo nadav laavihu ematay yamutu shene zekenim hallalu vaani veatta nanhig et haddor amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu hanire mi kover et mi amar rav pappa hayenu deamri inashe nefishe gamle save ditini mashche dehugne
Amar rabbi eliezer
b: Lema talmid chacham dome lifne am haaretz battechilla dome lekiton shel zahav siper hemennu dome lekiton shel kesef nehena mimmennu dome lekiton shel cheres kevan shennishbar shuv en lo takkana
Imarta bat tale bat kohen shezzinta havay akkefah rav chama bar toviyya chavile zemorot vesarfah
Amar rav yosef tea betarte tea bidrav matna uta bidtanya uvata el hakkohanim halviyyim veel hashshofet asher yihye bayyamim hahem bizman sheyyesh kohen yesh mishpat bizman sheen kohen en mishpat
Amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok maase bevat kohen shezzinta vechu amar rav yosef bet din shel tzaddukim hava

Hachi amar lehu vehachi ahdaru leh vehatanya amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok zechurani keshehayiti tinok umurkav al ketefo shel abba veheviu bat kohen shezzinta vehikkifuha chavile zemorot usrafuha amru lo katan hayita veen meviin reaya min hakkatan shene maasim hao
He amar lehu beresha ilema ha kammayeta amar lehu beresha amar leh keshehu gadol vela ashgachu beh amar lehu keshehu katan veashgachu beh
Ella ha amar lehu beresha vaamaru leh katan hayita vaamar lehu keshehu gadol vaamaru leh mippene shello haya bet din shel otah shaa baki

Matni mitzvat hanneheragin hau mattizin et rosho besayif kederech shehammalchut osa rabbi yehuda omer niuul hu lo ella mannichin et rosho al hassaddan vekotzetz bekofitz amru lo en mita menveulet mizzo
Gema tanya amar lahen rabbi yehuda lachachamim af ani yodea shemmita menuvelet hi aval ma eese shehare amra tora uvchukkotehem lo telechu
Verabbanan kevan dichtiv sayif beorayeta la minayehu ka gamrinan

Dei la tema hachi ha detanya sorfin al hammelachim velo middarche haemori hechi sarfinan vehachtiv uvchukkotehem lo telechu ella kevan dichtiv serefa beorayeta dichtiv uvmisrefot avotecha vego lav minayehu ka gamrinan vehacha name kevan dichtiv sayif beorayeta lav minayehu ka gamrinan
Veha ditnan beidach pirkin ellu hen hanneheragin harotzeach veanshe ir hanniddachat bishlama ir hanniddachat ketiv behu lefi charev ella rotzeach menalan
Detanya nakom yinnakem nekima zo eni yodea ma hi keshehu omer veheveti alechem cherev nokemet nekam berit heve omer nekima zo sayif
Veema devarez leh mivraz lefi charev ketiv
Veema deaved leh gistera amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar kera veahavta lereacha kamocha beror lo mita yafa
Ashkechan diktal avda bar chorin mena lan
Velav kal vachomer hu ketal avda besayif bar chorin bechenek
Hanicha leman deamar chenek kal ella leman deamar chenek chamur may ika lememar
Nafka leh middetanya veatta tevaer haddam hannaki mikkirbecha hukshu kol shofche damim leegla arufa ma lehallan besayif umin hatztzavar af kan besayif umin hatztzavar
I ma lehallan bekofitz umimmul oref af kan bekofitz umimmul oref amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar kera veahavta lereacha kamocha beror lo mita yafa
Matni mitzvat hannechnakin hau meshakkein oto bezevel ad archubbotav venoten sudar kasha letoch harakka vechorech al tzavaro ze moshech etzlo veze moshech etzlo ad shennafsho yotzet
Gema tanu rabbanan ish perat lekatan asher yinaf et eshet ish perat leeshet katan eshet reehu perat leeshet acherim

Mot yumat bechenek atta omer bechenek o eno ella beachat mikkol mitot haamurot battora amarta kol makom shenneemar mita betora setam en atta rashshay lemoshchah lehachmir aleha ella lehakel aleha divre rabbi yoshiyya
Rabbi yonatan omer lo mippene shehi kalla ella kol mita haamura betora setam enah ella chenek
Rabbi omer neemar mita bide shamayim veneemar mita bide adam ma mita haamura bide shamayim mita sheen bah roshem af mita haamura bide adam mita sheen bah roshem
Veema serefa middeamar rachamana bat kohen bisrefa mikkelal deha lav bat serefa hi

a: Bishlama lerabbi yonatan kidka mefaresh rabbi tama ella lerabbi yoshiyya mimmay deika chenek baolam ema sayif
Amar rava arba mitot gemara gemiri lehu
May lo mippene shehi kalla kamipalgi biflugta derabbi shimon verabbanan
Amar leh rabbi zera leabbaye shear hanniskalin dela ketiv behu sekila degamri meov veyiddeoni bemay gamri bemot yumatu gamri o bidmehem bam gamri
Amar leh bidmehem demehem bam gamri dei bemot yumatu gamri demehem demehem lema li
Ella may bidmehem demehem gamri mot yumatu lema li

Kidtanya mot yumat hammakke rotzeach hu en li ella bemita hakketuva bo minnayin sheim i atta yachol lahamito bemita hakketuva bo sheatta memito bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito talmud lomar mot yumat hammakke mikkol makom
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina vei bemot yumatu gamri may ka kashya leh
Ilema eshet ish ka kashya leh lemete ulmigmar mot yumat meov veyiddeoni ma lehallan biskila af kan biskila
Middeamar rachamana arusa biskila mikkelal dinsua lav biskila
Veella makke aviv veimmo ka kashya leh lemete ulmigmar meov veyiddeoni
Ad degamri meov veyiddeoni ligmeru meeshet ish dei atta rashshay lemoshchah lehachmir aleha ella lehakel aleha
Amar leh shear hanniskalin gufayehu ka kashya leh dei bemot yumat gamri ad degamri meov veyiddeoni ligmeru meeshet ish

Matni ellu hen hanniskalin habba al haem veal eshet haav veal hakkalla veal hazzechur veal habbehema vehaishsha hammevia et habbehema vehamgaddef vehaoved avoda zara vehannoten mizzaro lammolech uvaal ov veyiddeoni vehamchallel et hashshabbat vehamkallel aviv veimmo vehabba al naara hamorasa vehammesit vehammediach vehamchashshef uven sorer umore
Habba al haem chayyav aleha mishshum em umishshum eshet av rabbi yehuda omer eno chayyav ella mishshum haem bilvad
Habba al eshet av chayyav mishshum eshet av umishshum eshet ish ben bechayye aviv ben leachar mitat aviv ben min haerusin ben min hannisuin
Habba al kallato chayyav aleha mishshum kallato umishshum eshet ish ben bechayye veno ben leachar mitat beno ben min haerusin ben min hannisuin
Gema tanya rabbi yehuda omer im lo hayeta immo reuya leaviv eno chayyav ella mishshum haem bilvad
May enah reuya lo ilema chayyave charetot vechayyave mitot bet din mikkelal derabbanan savri af al gav deenah reuya lo ha let leh kidushin begavah
Ella chayyave lavin verabbi yehuda savar lah kerabbi akiva deamar en kidushin tofsin bechayyave lavin
Metiv rav oshaya isur mitzva veisur kedushsha choltzot velo mityabmot
b: Isur mitzva sheniyyot middivre sofrim veammay karu lehu isur mitzva shemmitzva lishmoa divre chachamim
Isur kedushsha almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot veammay karu lehu isur kedushsha dichtiv kedoshim yihu lelohehem
Vetanya alah rabbi yehuda machlif

Challofe hu demachlef ha chalitza baaya vei salka datach rabbi yehuda kerabbi akiva sevira leh mikkedi chayyave lavin lerabbi akiva kechayyave charetot deme vechayyave charetot lav bene chalitza veyibbum ninhu
Lidvarav detanna kamma kaamar veleh la sevira leh
Ki ata rabbi yitzchak tane keditnan rabbi yehuda omer eno chayyav ella mishshum haem bilvad
Vetama may amar abbaye deamar kera immecha hi mishshum immo atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum eshet av
Ella meatta ervat eshet avicha lo tegalle ervat avicha hi mishshum eshet av atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum immo
Ella immo shehi eshet aviv kae hacha ummaet lah kae hacha ummaet lah hashta immo sheenah eshet aviv michayyav eshet aviv sheenah immo michayyav immo shehi eshet aviv la michayyav kelal
Vetu lerabbanan name hachtiv immecha hi ella hahu mibe leh lechidrav shisha bereh derav idi lerabbi yehuda name hahu mibe leh lechidrav shisha bereh derav idi
Ella amar rav acha bereh derav ika amar kera ervatah mishshum erva achat atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum shette araot
Ella meatta ervat kallatcha lo tegalle eshet bincha hi lo tegalle ervatah hachi name mishshum erva achat atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum shette araot
Vehatnan habba al kallato chayyav aleha mishshum kallato umishshum eshet ish ben bechayye veno ben leachar mitat beno vela pelig rabbi yehuda
Ella kevan dechad gufa hu af al gav ditre isure ninhu ketiv ervatah hacha name kevan dechad gufa hu af al gav ditre isure ninhu ketiv ervatah
Ella amar rava kasavar rabbi yehuda ervat avicha zo eshet avicha umayete lah bigzera shava

Umashma ben eshet aviv shehi immo ben eshet aviv sheenah immo immo sheenah eshet aviv minnayin talmud lomar ervat immecha lo tegalle immecha hi mishshum immo atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum eshet aviv

a: Tanya kevateh derava ish perat lekatan
Asher yishkav et eshet aviv mashma ben eshet aviv shehi immo uven eshet aviv shello immo immo sheenah eshet aviv minnayin talmud lomar ervat aviv gilla mufne lehakkish veladun mimmennu gezera shava
Mot yumtu biskila atta omer biskila o eno ella beachat mikkol mitot haamurot battora neemar kan demehem bam veneemar beov veyiddeoni demehem bam ma lehallan biskila af kan biskila
Onesh shamanu azhara minnayin talmud lomar ervat avicha lo tegalle ervat avicha zo eshet avicha
Atta omer eshet avicha o eno ella ervat avicha mammash neemar kan ervat avicha lo tegalle veneemar lehallan ervat aviv gilla ma lehallan beishut hakkatuv medabber af kan beishut hakkatuv medabber
Umashma ben eshet aviv shehi immo ben eshet aviv sheenah immo immo sheenah eshet aviv minnayin talmud lomar ervat immecha lo tegalle
En li ella beazhara sheasa hakkatuv immo sheenah eshet aviv keimmo shehi eshet aviv onesh minnayin

Neemar kan ervat avicha lo tegalle veneemar lehallan ervat aviv gilla ma beazhara asa hakkatuv immo sheenah eshet aviv keimmo shehi eshet aviv af beonesh asa hakkatuv immo sheenah eshet aviv keimmo shehi eshet aviv
Immecha hi mishshum immo atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum eshet av
Verabbanan ervat avicha mammash
Hay mivveet zachar nafka lechayyev alav shettayim
Vechidrav yehuda deamar rav yehuda nochri habba al aviv chayyav shettayim habba al achi aviv chayyav shettayim
Amar rava mistabbera milta derav yehuda beyisrael beshogeg uvkorban vehay dekaamar nochri lishana mealleya hu dei salka datach nochri mammash dino may nihu ketala bitre ketale katlatte leh
Tanya name hachi habba al aviv chayyav shettayim habba al achi aviv chayyav shettayim
Ika deamri dela kerabbi yehuda
Veika deamri afilu tema rabbi yehuda umayete lah bekal vachomer meachi aviv uma achi aviv dekurva deaviv hu chayyav shettayim aviv lo kol shekken
Vekamipalgi biflugta deabbaye verava mar savar onshin min haddin umar savar en onshin min haddin
Verabbanan azhara leeshet aviv mena lehu nafka lehu meervat eshet avicha lo tegalle
Verabbi yehuda hahu mibe leh leazhara leeshet aviv leachar mita
Verabbanan hahu missefa dikra nafka ervat avicha hi
Verabbi yehuda hahu mibe leh mishshum eshet av atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum eshet ish
Vehaanan tenan habba al eshet av chayyav aleha mishshum eshet av umishshum eshet ish ben bechayye aviv ben leachar mitat aviv vela pelig rabbi yehuda
Amar abbaye pelig bevarayeta
Verabbanan onesh deeshet aviv leachar mita mena lehu bishlama rabbi yehuda mayete lah bigzera shava ella rabbanan mena lehu
Amri lach hahu ervat aviv gilla demappek lah rabbi yehuda ligzera shava mappeki leh inhu leonesh deeshet aviv leachar mita
Verabbanan onesh leimmo sheenah eshet aviv mena lehu amar rav shisha bereh derav idi amar kera immecha hi asaah hakkatuv leimmo sheenah eshet aviv keimmo shehi eshet aviv
Habba al kallato ku velichayyav name mishshum eshet beno amar abbaye patach hakkatuv bechallato vesiyyem beeshet beno lomar lach zo hi kallato zo hi eshet beno

Matni habba al hazzechur veal habbehema vehaishsha hammevia et habbehema biskila im adam chata behema me chata ella lefi shebbaa leadam takkala al yadah lefichach amar hakkatuv tissakel davar acher shello tehe behema overet bashshuk veyomru zo hi shenniskal peloni al yadah
Gema zachar mena lan detanu rabbanan ish perat lekatan asher yishkav et zachar ben gadol ben katan mishkeve ishsha maggid lecha hakkatuv sheshshene mishkavot baishsha
Amar rabbi yishmael hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed
Mot yumatu biskila atta omer biskila o eno ella beachat mikkol mitot haamurot battora neemar kan demehem bam veneemar beov veyiddeoni demehem bam ma lehallan biskila af kan biskila
b: Onesh shamanu azhara minnayin talmud lomar veet zachar lo tishkav mishkeve ishsha toeva hi

Lamadnu azhara lashshochev azhara lannishkav minnayin talmud lomar lo yihye kadesh mibbene yisrael veomer vegam kadesh haya vaaretz asu kechol hattoavot haggoyim asher horish vego divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich hare hu omer veet zachar lo tishkav mishkeve ishsha keri beh lo tishshachev
Behema mena lan detanu rabbanan ish perat lekatan asher yitten shechovto bivhema ben gedola ben ketanna
Mot yumat biskila atta omer biskila o eno ella beachat mikkol mitot haamurot battora neemar kan taharogu veneemar lehallan ki harog tahargennu ma lehallan biskila af kan biskila
Lamadnu onesh lashshochev onesh lannishkav menalan talmud lomar kol shochev im behema mot yumat im eno inyan lashshochev tenehu inyan lannishkav
Lamadnu onesh ben lashshochev ben lannishkav azhara minnayin talmud lomar uvchol behema lo titten shechovtecha letoma vah
Lamadnu azhara lashshochev lannishkav minnayin talmud lomar lo yihye kadesh mibbene yisrael veomer vegam kadesh haya baaretz vego divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich hare hu omer lo titten shechovtecha lo titten shechivatcha
Habba al hazzechur vehevi alav zachar
Amar rabbi avahu ledivre rabbi yishmael chayyav shettayim chada millo tishkav vachada millo yihye kadesh ledivre rabbi akiva eno chayyav ella achat lo tishkav lo tishshachev chada hi

Habba al habbehema vehevi behema alav amar rabbi avahu ledivre rabbi yishmael chayyav shettayim chada millo titten shechovtecha vachada millo yihye kadesh ledivre rabbi akiva eno chayyav ella achat shechovtecha ushchivatcha chada hi
Abbaye amar afilu ledivre rabbi yishmael name eno chayyav ella achat dechi chetiv lo yihye kadesh begavre ketiv
Ella lerabbi yishmael azhara lannishkav mena leh nafka leh mikkol shochev im behema mot yumat im eno inyan lashshochev tenehu inyan lannishkav
Veappekeh rachamana lannishkav bilshon shochev ma shochev anash vehizhir af nishkav anash vehizhir

Hannirba lezachar vehannirba livhema amar rabbi avahu ledivre rabbi akiva chayyav shettayim chada millo tishkav vachada millo titten shechovtecha ledivre rabbi yishmael eno chayyav ella achat ide veidi lo yihye kadesh hu

Abbaye amar afilu ledivre rabbi yishmael name chayyav shettayim dichtiv kol shochev im behema mot yumat im eno inyan lashshochev tenehu inyan lannishkav veappekeh rachamana lannishkav bilshon shochev ma shochev anash vehizhir af nishkav anash vehizhir
Aval habba al hazzechur vehevi zachar alav habba al habbehema vehevi behema alav ben lerabbi avahu ben leabbaye lerabbi yishmael chayyav shalosh lerabbi akiva chayyav shettayim
Tanu rabbanan zechur lo asu bo katan kegadol behema asu bah ketanna kigdola
May lo asu bo katan kegadol amar rav lo asu biat pachot mibben tesha shanim keven tesha shanim ushmuel amar lo asu biat pachot mibben shalosh shanim keven shalosh shanim
Bemay kamipalgi rav savar kol deiteh beshochev iteh benishkav vechol deleteh beshochev leteh benishkav
Ushmuel savar mishkeve ishsha ketiv
Tanya kevateh derav zachar ben tesha shanim veom echad

a: Habba al habbehema ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah vehaishsha hammevia et habbehema aleha ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah chayyav
Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda beishsha shene mishkavot uvivhema mishkav echad
Matkef lah rav pappa adderabba ishsha deorchah hi ammishkav michayyav ammidaam acharina la michayyav behema delav orcha hi lichayyav alah al kol nekev vanekev
Tanya dela ketarvayehu zachar ben tesha shanim veom echad habba al habbehema ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah vehaishsha hammevia et habbehema aleha ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah chayyav
Amar leh ravina lerava hamare bizchur mahu
Hamare bizchur mishkeve ishsha ketiv beh ella hamare bivhema mahu
Amar leh im eno inyan lehaaraa dichtiva gabbe achot aviv vaachot immo dela tzericha deha itakkash lehaaraa denidda tenehu inyan lehaaraa divhema
Mikkede behema mechayyave mitot bet din hi lema li dichtiv lehaaraa didah gabbe chayyave charetot lichteveh gabbe chayyave mitot bet din veligmor chayyave mitot bet din mechayyave mitot bet din
Hoil vechulleh kera lidrasha hu deate ketiva name milta didrasha
Bea mineh rav achadvuy bar amme merav sheshet hamare beatzmo mahu amar leh kevastan

Amar rav ashe may tibe lach bekoshi la mashkachatte lah ki mashkachatte lah bimshammesh met leman deamar meshammesh met baaraot patur hacha patur ulman deamar chayyav hacha michayyav tarte michayyav ashshochev umichayyav annishkav
Beo mineh merav sheshet goy habba al habbehema mahu takkala vekalon baenan vehacha takkala ika kalon leka o dilma takkala af al pi sheen kalon

Amar rav sheshet tenetuha ma ilanot sheen ochlin veen shotin veen merichin amra tora hashchet serof vechalle hoil uvat leadam takkala al yadan hammate et chavero middarche chayyim ledarche mita al achat kamma vechamma
Ella meatta goy hammishtachave livhemto titsar umikkatla mi ika mide dilyisrael la asar ulgoy asar
Yisrael gufeh litsar mide dehave arvia amar abbaye ze kelono merubbe veze kelono muat
Vahare ilanot deen kelonan merubbe veamra tora hashchet serof vechalle bevaale chayyim kaamrinan dechas rachamana alayehu
Rava amar amra tora behema nehenet meavera tehareg
