Vahare ilanot deen nehenin meavera veamra tora hashchet serof vechalle bevaale chayyim kaamrinan dechas rachamana alayehu
Ta shema davar acher shello tehe behema overet bashshuk veyomru zo hi shenniskal peloni al yadah may lav
b: Middesefa takkala vekalon resha takkala belo kalon vehechi dame goy habba al habbehema
La sefa takkala vekalon resha ha ka mashma lan daafilu kalon belo takkala name michayevi vehechi dame yisrael habba al habbehema beshogeg vechidvae rav hamnuna
Devae rav hamnuna yisrael habba al habbehema beshogeg mahu takkala vekalon baenan vehacha kalon ika takkala leka o dilma kalon af al pi sheen takkala
Amar rav yosef ta shema bat shalosh shanim veom echad mitkaddeshet bevia veim ba aleha yavam kenaah vechayyavin aleha mishshum eshet ish
Umtammea et boalah letamme mishkav tachton keelon niset lechohen ochelet bitruma ba aleha echad min happesulim pesalah min hakkehunna
Veim ba aleha echad mikkol haaraot haamurot betora mumatin al yadah vehi petura
Echad mikkol araot vaafilu behema veha hacha dekalon ika takkala leka vekatane mumatin al yadah
Kevan dimzida hi takkala name ika verachamana hu dechas alah alah didah chas abbehema la chas
Amar rava ta shema ben tesha shanim veom echad habba al yevimto kenaah veeno noten get ad sheyyagdil umtamme kenidda letamme mishkav tachton keelon
Posel veeno maachil ufosel et habbehema meal gabbe hammizbeach veniskelet al yado veim ba al achat mikkol haaraot haamurot betora mumatim al yado
Veha hacha kalon ika takkala leka vekatane niskelet al yado
Kevan demezid hu takkala name ika verachamana hu dechas ilaveh aleh dideh chas rachamana abbehema la chas rachamana

Ta shema davar acher shello tehe behema overet bashshuk veyomru zo hi shenniskal peloni al yadah may lav middesefa takkala vekalon resha kalon belo takkala vehechi dame yisrael habba al habbehema beshogeg
La sefa takkala vekalon resha takkala belo kalon vehechi dame goy habba al habbehema uchdivo mineh merav sheshet
Matni hamgaddef eno chayyav ad sheyefaresh hashshem amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha

a: Bechol yom danin et haedim bechinuy yakke yosi et yosi

Nigmar haddin lo hau horgin bechinuy ella motziin kol adam lachutz shoalin et haggadol shebbenehen veomer lo emor ma sheshshamata beferush vehu omer vehaddayyanin omdin al raglehen vekorin velo meachin
Vehashsheni omer af ani kamohu vehashshelishi omer af ani kamohu
Gema tana ad sheyevarech shem beshem
Menahane mile amar shemuel deamar kera venokev shem vego benokvo shem yumat
Mimmay dehay nokev lishana devaroche hu dichtiv ma ekkov lo kabbo el veazharteh mehacha elohim lo tekallel
Veema mivraz hu dichtiv vayyikkov chor bedalto veazharteh mehacha veibbadtem et shemam lo taasun ken la elohechem
Baena shem beshem veleka
Veema demannach shene shemot ahadade uvaza lehu hahu nokev vechozer venokev hu veema dechayek shem appumma desakkina uvaza bah hahu churpa desakkina hu deka vaza
Ema paroshe shemeh hu dichtiv vayyikkach moshe veaharon et haanashim haelle asher nikkevu beshemot veazharteh mehacha et Adonai elohecha tira
Chada devaena shem beshem veleka veod haveya leh azharat ase veazharat ase la shemah azhara
Veibaet ema amar kera vayyikkov vayekallel lememra denokev kelala hu
Vedilma ad deaved tarvayehu la salka datach dichtiv hotze et hamkallel vela ketiv hotze et hannokev vehamkallel shema minah chada hi
Tanu rabbanan ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot et haggoyim shemmuzharin al birkat hashshem keyisrael veenan neheragin ella besayif shekkol mita haamura bivne noach enah ella besayif
Veha mehacha nafka mehatam nafka Adonai zo birkat hashshem
Amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha lo nitzrecha ella lerabbot et hakkinuyin vealliba derabbi meir

Detanya ish ish ki yekallel elohav venasa cheto ma talmud lomar vahalo kevar neemar venokev shem Adonai mot yumat lefi shenneemar venokev shem mot yumat yachol lo yehe chayyav ella al shem hamuchad bilvad minnayin lerabbot kal hakkinuyin talmud lomar ish ki yekallel elohav mikkol makom divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim al shem hamuchad bemita veal hakkinuyin beazhara
Ufliga derabbi meyasha deamar rabbi meyasha ben noach shebberach et hashshem bechinuy lerabbanan chayyav
May tama deamar kera kagger kaezrach ger veezrach hu devaenan benokvo shem aval goy afilu bechinuy
Verabbi meir hay kagger kaezrach may aved leh ger veezrach biskila aval goy besayif salka datach amena hoil veitrabbo itrabbo ka mashma lan
Verabbi yitzchak nappacha alliba derabbanan hay kagger kaezrach may aved leh ger veezrach hu devaenan shem beshem aval goy la baenan shem beshem
Ish ish lema li dibra tora chilshon bene adam
Tanu rabbanan sheva mitzot nitztauu bene noach dinin uvirkat hashshem avoda zara giluy araot ushfichut damim vegazel veever min hachay
b: Rabbi chananya ben gamla omer af al haddam min hachay rabbi chidka omer af al hasserus rabbi shimon omer af al hakkishuf

Rabbi yose omer kol haamur befarashat kishuf ben noach muzhar alav lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh kosem kesamim meonen umnachesh umchashshef vechover chaver veshoel ov veyiddeoni vedoresh el hammetim vego uviglal hattoevot haelle Adonai elohecha morish otam mippanecha velo anash ella im ken hizhir
Rabbi elazar omer af al hakkilayim muttarin bene noach lilbosh kilayim velizroa kilayim veen asurin ella beharbaat behema uvharkavat hailan
Menahane mile amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera vayetzav Adonai elohim al haadam lemor mikkol etz haggan achol tochel
Vayetzav ellu haddinin vechen hu omer ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzave et banav vego

Adonai zo birkat hashshem vechen hu omer venokev shem Adonai mot yumat elohim zo avoda zara vechen hu omer lo yihye lecha elohim acherim al haadam zo shefichut damim vechen hu omer shofech dam haadam vego
Lemor zo giluy araot vechen hu omer lemor hen yeshallach ish et ishto vehalcha meitto vehayeta leish acher mikkol etz haggan velo gazel achol tochel velo ever min hachay
Ki ata rabbi yitzchak tane ipcha vayetzav zo avoda zara elohim zo dinin
Bishlama elohim zo dinin dichtiv venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim ella vayetzav zo avoda zara may mashma
Rav chisda verav yitzchak bar avdimi chad amar saru maher min hadderech asher tzivitim asu lahem vego vechad amar ashuk efrayim retzutz mishpat ki hoil halach achare tzav
May benayehu ika benayehu goy sheasa avoda zara velo hishtachava lah leman deamar asu mishsheat asiyya mechayyev leman deamar ki hoil halach ad deazel batrah ufalach lah

Amar rava umi ika leman deamar goy sheasa avoda zara velo hishtachava lah chayyav vehatanya baavoda zara devarim shebbet din shel yisrael memitin alehen ben noach muzhar alehen en bet din shel yisrael memitin alehen en ben noach muzhar alehen lemaote may lav lemaote goy sheasa avoda zara velo hishtachava lah
Amar rav pappa la lemaote gipuf venishuk
Gipuf venishuk demay ilema kedarkah bar ketala hu ella lemaote shello kedarkah
Dinin bene noach ipkud vehatanya eser mitzot nitztauu yisrael bemara sheva shekkiblu alehen bene noach vehosifu alehen dinin veshabbat vechibud av vaem
Dinin dichtiv sham sam lo chok umishpat shabbat vechibud av vaem dichtiv kaasher tzivvecha Adonai elohecha veamar rav yehuda kaasher tzivvecha bemara
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lo nitzrecha ella laeda veedim vehatraa
I hachi may vehosifu alehen dinin
Ella amar rava lo nitzrecha ella ledine kenasot akkatti vehosifu bedinin mibe leh

Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov lo nitzrecha ella lehoshiv bet din bechol pelech vafelech uvchol ir vair veha bene noach la ipkud vehatanya keshem shennitztauu yisrael lehoshiv batte dinin bechol pelech vafelech uvchol ir vair kach nitztauu bene noach lehoshiv batte dinin bechol pelech vafelech uvchol ir vair
Ella amar rava hay tanna tanna deve menashshe hu demappek dach veayel sach
Detanna deve menashshe sheva mitzot nitztauu bene noach avoda zara vegiluy araot ushfichut damim gazel veever min hachay serus vechilayim
Rabbi yehuda omer adam harishon lo nitztava ella al avoda zara bilvad shenneemar vayetzav Adonai elohim al haadam rabbi yehuda ben betira omer af al birkat hashshem veyesh omrim af al haddinim
Keman azla ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav elohim ani lo tekalleluni elohim ani lo temiruni elohim ani yehe morai alechem keman keyesh omrim
Vetanna deve menashshe i daresh vayetzav afilu hanach name i la daresh vayetzav hane mena leh
Leolam la daresh vayetzav hane kol chada vachada beappe nafshah ketiva avoda zara vegiluy araot

a: Dichtiv vattishshachet haaretz lifne haelohim vetana deve rabbi yishmael bechol makom shenneemar hashchata eno ella devar erva vaavoda zara davar erva shenneemar ki hishchit kol basar et darko avoda zara dichtiv pen tashchitun vaasitem vego
Veidach orchayehu deka megalle
Shefichut damim dichtiv shofech dam haadam vego veidach ketalayehu hu dekamgalle
Gazel dichtiv keyerek esev natatti lachem et kol veamar rabbi levi keyerek esev velo keyerek ginna veidach hahu lemishre basar hu daata
Ever min hachay dichtiv ach basar benafsho damo lo tochelu veidach hahu lemishre sheratzim hu daata
Serus dichtiv shirtzu vaaretz urvu vah veidach livracha bealma
Kilayim dichtiv mehaof leminehu veidach hahu letzavetta bealma
Amar rav yosef amri be rav al shalosh mitzot ben noach neherag gesher siman al giluy araot veal shefichut damim veal birkat hashshem
Matkef lah rav sheshet bishlama shefichut damim dichtiv shofech dam haadam vego ella hanach mena lehu
I gamar mishshefichut damim afilu kullehu name i mishshum deitrabbay meish ish avoda zara name itrabbay meish ish
Ella amar rav sheshet amri be rav al arba mitzot ben noach neherag

Veal avoda zara ben noach neherag vehatanya baavoda zara devarim shebbet din shel yisrael memitin alehen ben noach muzhar alehen azhara in mita la amar rav nachman bar yitzchak azhara shellahen zo hi mitatan
Rav huna verav yehuda vechullehu talmide derav amri al sheva mitzot ben noach neherag galli rachamana bachada vehu haddin lechullehu
Veal haggazel ben noach neherag vehatanya al haggazel ganav vegazal vechen yefat toar vechen kayyotze bahen goy begoy vegoy beyisrael asur veyisrael begoy muttar veim ita nitne chayyav
Mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa yisrael begoy muttar tena resha asur
Veha kol hecha deit leh chiyyuva mitna katane dekatane resha al shefichut damim goy begoy vegoy beyisrael chayyav yisrael begoy patur
Hatam hechi litne litne asur umuttar vehatanya goy veroe behema dakka lo maalin velo moridin
Kayyotze bo begazel may hi amar rav acha bar yaakov lo nitzrecha ella lefoel bakkerem
Poel bakkerem emat i bishat gemar melacha hettera hu i lav bishat gemar melacha gazel mealleya hu
Ella amar rav pappa lo nitzrecha ella lefachot mishshave peruta i hachi goy beyisrael asur ha bar mechila hu nehi devatar hachi machel leh tzaara beshateh mi let leh
Goy begoy kayyotze bahen kevan delav bene mechila ninhu gazel mealleya hu
Ella amar rav acha bereh derav ika lo nitzrecha ella lechovesh sechar sachir goy begoy vegoy beyisrael asur yisrael begoy muttar
Kayyotze bifat toar may hi ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina ben noach sheyyiched shifcha leavdo uva aleha neherag aleha

Kayyotze bo dishfichut damim la tanya amar abbaye i mashkachatte detanya rabbi yonatan ben shaul hi detanya rabbi yonatan ben shaul omer rodef achar chavero lehorgo veyachol lehatztzilo beechad meevarav velo hitztzil
b: Neherag alav

Ashkach rabbi yaakov bar acha dahava ketiv besefer aggadta deve rav ben noach neherag bedayyan echad uved echad shello behatraa mippi ish velo mippi ishsha vaafilu karov mishshum rabbi yishmael amru af al haubbarin
Menahane mile amar rav yehuda deamar kera ach et dimchem lenafshotechem edrosh afilu bedayyan echad
Miyyad kol chayya afilu shello behatraa edreshennu umiyyad haadam afilu beed echad miyyad ish velo miyyad ishsha achiv afilu karov
Mishshum rabbi yishmael amru af al haubbarin may tameh derabbi yishmael dichtiv shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech ezehu adam shehu baadam heve omer ze ubbar shebbime immo

Vetanna kamma tanna deve menashshe hu deamar kol mita haamura livne noach eno ella chenek ushdi leh hay baadam assefeh dikra udrosh beh hachi baadam damo yishshafech ezehu shefichut damim shel adam shehu begufo shel adam heve omer ze chenek
Metiv rav hamnuna veishsha la mippakda vehachtiv ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzave vego
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah banav ledin beto litzdaka
Amar leh rav aveya sava lerav pappa ema bat noach sheharga lo tehareg miyyad ish velo miyyad ishsha ketiv amar leh hachi amar rav yehuda shofech dam haadam mikkol makom
Ema bat noach shezzinta lo tehareg dichtiv al ken yaazov ish velo ishsha amar leh hachi amar rav yehuda vehau levasar echad hadar arvinhu kera
Tanu rabbanan ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot et haggoyim shemmuzharin al haaraot keyisrael
Veha mehacha nafka mehatam nafka lemor ze giluy araot
Hatam baaraot didhu vehacha baaraot didan dekatane sefa ba al araot yisrael nidon bedine yisrael
Lemay hilcheta amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lo nitzrecha ella laeda veedim vehatraa
Migra gara
Ella amar rav yochanan lo nitzrecha ella lenaara hamorasa dildidhu let lehu dedayeninan lehu bedina didan
Aval eshet ish bedina didhu dayeninan lehu vehatanya ba al naara hamorasa nidon biskila al eshet ish nidon bechenek vei bedina didhu sayif hu
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak may eshet ish dekatane kegon shennichnesa lechuppa velo nivala dildidhu let lehu dayeninan lehu bedina didan
Detane rabbi chanina beulat baal yesh lahen nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala en lahen

Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan kol erva shebbet din shel yisrael memitin aleha ben noach muzhar aleha en bet din shel yisrael memitin aleha en ben noach muzhar aleha divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim harbe araot yesh sheen bet din shel yisrael memitin alehen uven noach muzhar alehen
Ba al araot yisrael nidon bedine yisrael ba al araot ben noach nidon bedine ben noach veanu en lanu ella naara hamorasa bilvad
Venichshov name nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala hay tanna tanna deve menashshe hu deamar kol mita haamura livne noach eno ella chenek ide veide chenek hu
Vesavar rabbi meir kol erva shebbet din shel yisrael memitin aleha ben noach muzhar aleha veha tanya ger

a: Shehayeta horato shello bikdushsha veledato bikdushsha yesh lo sheer haem veen lo sheer haav
Ha ketzad nasa achoto min haem yotzi min haav yekayyem achot haav min haem yotzi min haav yekayyem
Achot haem min haem yotzi achot haem min haav rabbi meir omer yotzi vachachamim omrim yekayyem shehaya rabbi meir omer kol erva shehi mishshum sheer em yotzi mishshum sheer haav yekayyem
Umuttar beeshet achiv uveshet achi aviv ushar kol araot muttarot lo leetoye eshet aviv
Nasa ishsha uvittah kones achat umotzi achat ulchattechila lo yichnos meta ishto muttar bachamoto veika deamri asur bachamoto
Amar rav yehuda la kashya ha rabbi meir alliba derabbi eliezer veha rabbi meir alliba derabbi akiva
Detanya al ken yaazov ish et aviv veet immo rabbi eliezer omer aviv achot aviv immo achot immo rabbi akiva omer aviv eshet aviv immo immo mammash
Vedavak velo bezachar beishto velo beeshet chavero vehau levasar echad mi shennaasim basar echad yatzu behema vechayya sheen naasin basar echad
Amar mar rabbi eliezer omer aviv achot aviv ema aviv mammash hayenu vedavak velo bezachar
Ema eshet aviv hayenu beishto velo beeshet chavero ema leachar mita dumya deimmo ma immo delav ishut af aviv delav ishut
Immo achot immo veema immo mammash hayenu beishto velo beeshet chavero veema leachar mita dumya deaviv ma aviv delav mammash af immo delav mammash
Rabbi akiva omer aviv eshet aviv veema aviv mammash hayenu vedavak velo bezachar i hachi eshet aviv name hayenu beishto velo beeshet chavero leachar mita
Immo immo mammash hayenu beishto velo beeshet chavero immo meanusato
Bemay ka mipalgi rabbi eliezer savar
b: Aviv dumya deimmo veimmo dumya deaviv la mashkachatte lah ella beachva
Verabbi akiva mutav leokmeh beeshet aviv deikray ervat aviv leappoke achot aviv disher aviv ikray ervat aviv la ikray
Ta shema vayyikkach amram et yocheved dodato may lav dodato min haem
Lo dodato min haav
Ta shema vegam omna achoti vat avi hi ach lo vat immi mikkelal devat haem asura
Vetisbera achoto havay bat achiv havay vechevan dehachi hu la shena min haav vela shena min haem sharya ella hatam hachi kaamar leh kurba deachot it li bahadah meabba vela meimma
Ta shema mippene ma lo nasa adam et bitto kede sheyyissa kayin et achoto shenneemar ki amarti olam chesed yibbane ha lav hachi asira
Kevan deishteray ishteray
Amar rav huna goy muttar bevitto veem tomar mippene ma lo nasa adam et bitto kede sheyyissa kayin et achoto mishshum olam chesed yibbane
Veika deamri amar rav huna goy asur bevitto tidda shello nasa adam et bitto vela hi hatam hayenu tama kede sheyyissa kayin et achoto mishshum deolam chesed yibbane
Amar rav chisda eved muttar beimmo umuttar bevitto yatza mikkelal goy velichlal yisrael lo ba
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina ben noach sheyyiched shifcha leavdo uva aleha neherag aleha
Meemat amar rav nachman middekaru lah revita diflanya meemat hattaratah amar rav huna mishsheppara roshah bashshuk
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina ben noach shebba al ishto shello kedarkah chayyav shenneemar vedavak velo shello kedarkah
Amar rava mi ika mide deyisrael la michayyav venochri michayyav
Ella amar rava ben noach shebba al eshet chavero shello kedarkah patur may tama beishto velo beeshet chavero vedavak vela shello kedarkah
Amar rabbi chanina goy shehikka et yisrael chayyav mita shenneemar vayyifen ko vacho vayyar ki en ish vayyach et hammitzri vego
Veamar rabbi chanina hassoter loo shel yisrael keilu soter loo shel shechina shenneemar mokesh adam yala kodesh

Magbiha avdo shavat siman amar resh lakish hammagbiha yado al chavero af al pi shello hikkahu nikra rasha shenneemar vayyomer larasha lamma takke reecha lamma hikkita lo neemar ella lamma takke af al pi shello hikkahu nikra rasha
Amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina nikra chote shenneemar veim lo lakachti vechozka uchtiv vattehi chattat hannearim gedola meod
Rav huna amar tikatzetz yado shenneemar uzroa rama tishshaver rav huna katz yeda
Rabbi elazar omer en lo takkana ella kevura shenneemar veish zeroa lo haaretz
Veamar rabbi elazar lo nittena karka ella levaale zeroot shenneemar veish zeroa lo haaretz
Veamar resh lakish may dichtiv oved admato yisba lachem im ose adam atzmo keeved laadama yisba lechem veim lav lo yisba lechem
Veamar resh lakish nochri sheshshavat chayyav mita shenneemar veom valayela lo yishbotu veamar mar azhara shellahen zo hi mitatan amar ravina afilu sheni bashshabbat
Velichshevah gabbe sheva mitzot ki ka chashev shev veal taase kum ase la ka chashev

a: Veha dinin kum ase hu veka chashev kum ase veshev al taase ninhu
Veamar rabbi yochanan goy sheosek battora chayyav mita shenneemar tora tziva lanu moshe morasha lanu morasha velo lahem
Velichshevah gabbe sheva mitzot man deamar morasha migzal ka gazel lah man deamar meorasa dino kenaara hamorasa deviskila

Metivi haya rabbi meir omer minnayin sheafilu goy veosek battora shehu kechohen gadol shenneemar asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim lo neemar ella haadam ha lamadta sheafilu goy veosek battora hare hu kechohen gadol
Hatam besheva mitzot didhu
Rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer af haddam min hachay tanu rabbanan ach basar benafsho damo lo tochelu ze ever min hachay rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer af haddam min hachay
May tama derabbi chanina ben gamliel keri beh basar benafsho lo tochel damo benafsho lo tochel verabbanan hahu lemishre sheratzim hu daata
Keotze baddavar atta omer rak chazak levilti achol haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh vego rak chazak levilti achol haddam ze ever min hachay ki haddam hu hannafesh ze dam min hachay
Verabbanan hahu ledam hakkaza shehanneshama yotza bo hu daata
Lema li lemichtav livne noach ulma li lemishne besinay
Kidrabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina kol mitzva shenneemra livne noach venishnet besinay laze velaze neemra
Livne noach velo nishnet besinay leyisrael neemra velo livne noach veanu en lanu ella gid hannashe vealliba derabbi yehuda
Amar mar kol mitzva shenneemra livne noach venishnet besinay laze velaze neemra adderabba middenishnet besinay leyisrael neemra velo livne noach
Middeitnay avoda zara besinay veashkechan daanash goyim ilavah shema minah laze velaze neemra
Livne noach velo nishnet besinay leyisrael neemra velo livne noach adderabba middelo nishnet besinay livne noach neemra vela leyisrael leka midaam dilyisrael shere ulgoy asir
Vela vahare yefat toar hatam mishshum delav bene chibush ninhu
Vahare pachot mishshave peruta hatam mishshum delav bene mechila ninhu
Kol mitzva shenneemra livne noach venishnet besinay laze velaze neemra
b: Vahare mila shenneemra livne noach dichtiv veatta et beriti tishmor venishnet besinay uvayyom hashshemini yimmol leyisrael neemra velo livne noach
Hahu lemishre shabbat hu daata bayyom vaafilu beshabbat
Vahare periyya urviyya shenneemra livne noach dichtiv veattem peru urvu venishnet besinay lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem leyisrael neemra velo livne noach
Hahu lechol davar shebbeminyan tzarich minyan acher lehattiro hu daata
I hachi kol chada vachada name nema mishshum milta itnay
Hachi kaamar azhara mihdar umitna bah lema li
Veen lanu ella gid hannashe bilvad vealliba derabbi yehuda hane name la itnay
Hane itnay leshum milta bealma ha la itnay kelal
I baet ema mila meikara leavraham hu deka mazhar leh rachamana veatta et beriti tishmor atta vezaracha acharecha ledorotam atta vezaracha in inish acharina la
Ella meatta bene yishmael lichayevu ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara
Bene esav lichayevu beyitzchak velo kol yitzchak
Matkef lah rav oshaya ella meatta bene ketura la lichayevu haamar rabbi yose bar avin veitema rabbi yose bar chanina et beriti hefar lerabbot bene ketura
Amar rav yehuda amar rav adam harishon lo huttar lo basar laachila dichtiv lachem yihye leochla ulchol chayyat haaretz velo chayyat haaretz lachem

Uchshebbau bene noach hittir lahem shenneemar keyerek esev natatti lachem et kol yachol lo yehe ever min hachay noheg bo talmud lomar ach basar benafsho damo lo tochelu yachol af lishratzim talmud lomar ach
Umay talmuda amar rav huna damo mi sheddamo chaluk mibbesaro yatzu sheratzim sheen damam chaluk mibbesheram
Metivi urdu bidgat hayyam may lav laachila lo limlacha
Vedagim bene melacha ninhu in kidrachava devae rachava hinhig beiza veshibuta may
Ta shema uvof hashshamayim may lav laachila la limlacha
Veofot bene melacha ninhu in kidvae rabba bar rav huna dash baavazin vetarnegolin lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda may
Ta shema uvchol chayya haromeset al haaretz hahu leetoye nachash hu daata

Detanya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer chaval al shammash gadol sheavad min haolam sheilmale lo nitkallel nachash kol echad veechad miyyisrael hau mizdammenin lo shene nechashim tovim echad meshaggero latztzafon veechad meshaggero laddarom lehavi lo sandalbonim tovim vaavanim tovot umargaliyyot velo od ella shemmafshilin retzua tachat zenavo umotzi bah afar leginnato ulchurbato

Metivi haya rabbi yehuda ben tema omer adam harishon mesev began eden haya vehau malache hashsharet tzolin lo basar umsannenin lo yayin hetzitz bo nachash veraa bichvodo venitkanne bo hatam bevasar hayyored min hashshamayim

Mi ika basar hayyored min hashshamayim in ki ha derabbi shimon ben chalafta hava kaazel beorcha pegau beh hanach aryavata dahao ka nahami leappeh amar hakkefirim shoagim lattaref nechitu leh tarte atmata chada achluha vachada shavkuha ayeteyah vaata leve midresha bae alah davar tame hu ze o davar tahor amaru leh en davar tame yored min hashshamayim
Bae mineh rabbi zera merabbi avahu yarda lo demut chamor mahu amar leh yarud nala ha amri leh en davar tame yored min hashshamayim
Rabbi shimon omer af al hakkishuf may tameh derabbi shimon dichtiv

a: Mechashshefa lo techayye uchtiv kol shochev im behema mot yumat kol sheyyeshno bichlal kol shochev im behema yeshno bichlal mechashshefa lo techayye
Rabbi elazar omer af al hakkilayim mena hane mile amar shemuel deamar kera et chukkotay tishmoru chukkim shechakakti lecha kevar behemtecha lo tarbia kilayim sadcha lo tizra kilayim
Ma behemtecha beharbaa af sadcha beharkava ma behemtecha ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz af sadcha ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz
Ella meatta ushmartem et chukkotay veet mishpatay chukkim shechakakti lecha kevar
Hatam ushmartem et chukkotay dehashta hacha et chukkotay tishmoru chukkim demeikara tishmoru
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha ku
Amar rav acha bar yaakov eno chayyav ad sheyevarech shem ben arba otiyyot leappoke ben shette otiyyot dela
Peshita yakke yosi et yosi tenan mahu detema milta bealma hu denaket ka mashma lan
Ika deamri amar rav acha bar yaakov shema minah shem ben arba otiyyot name shem hu
Peshita yakke yosi et yosi tenan mahu detema ad deika shem rabba umilta bealma hu denaket ka mashma lan
Nigmar haddin ku

Omdin menalan amar rabbi yitzchak bar amme deamar kera veehud ba elav vehu yoshev baaliyyat hammekera asher lo levaddo vayyomer ehud devar elohim li elecha vayyakom meal hakkisse vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma eglon melech moav shehu goy velo yada ella bechinuy amad yisrael veshem hamforash al achat kamma vechamma
Korin menalan dichtiv vayyavo elyakim ben chilkiyyahu vego veshevna hassofer veoach ben asaf hammazkir el chizkiyyahu kerue vegadim vayyaggidu lo et divre ravshake
Velo meachin menalan

Amar rabbi avahu atya keria keria ketiv hacha kerue vegadim uchtiv hatam veelisha roe vehu metzaek avi avi rechev yisrael ufarashav velo raahu od vayyachazek bivgadav vayyikraem lishnayim keraim mimmashma shenneemar vayyikraem lishnayim eni yodea shehen keraim uma talmud lomar keraim melammed shehen keruim leolam
Tanu rabbanan echad hashshomea veechad shomea mippi shomea chayyav likroa vehaedim en chayyavin likroa shekkevar karu beshaa sheshshamu
Vechi karu beshaa sheshshamu may have ha ka shami hashta la salka datach dichtiv vayehi kishmoa hammelech chizkiyyahu et divre ravshake vayyikra et begadav hammelech chizkiyyahu kara vehem lo karu
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hashshomea azkara mippi haggoy eno chayyav likroa veim tomar ravshake yisrael mumar haya
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel en korin ella al shem hamuchad bilvad leappoke kinuy dela
Ufligi derabbi chiyya betarvayehu deamar rabbi chiyya hashshomea azkara bizman hazze eno chayyav likroa sheim i atta omer ken nitmalle kol habbeged keraim
Mimman ilema miyyisrael mi pekiri kulle hay ella peshita miggoy vei shem hamuchad mi gemiri ella lav bechinuy
Ushma minah bizman hazze hu dela ha meikara chayyav shema minah
Hashsheni omer af ani kamohu amar resh lakish shema minah af ani kamohu kasher bedine mamonot uvdine nefashot umaala hu daavud rabbanan vehacha kevan dela efshar okmuha rabbanan addeorayeta
Dei salka datach pasul hacha mishshum dela efshar katlinan legavra
Vehashshelishi omer af ani kamohu setama kerabbi akiva demakkesh shelosha lishnayim
b: Matni haoved avoda zara echad haoved veechad hamzabbeach veechad hamkatter veechad hamnassech veechad hammishtachave veechad hamkabbelo alav leeloha vehaomer lo eli atta
Aval hamgappef vehamnashshek vehamchabbed vehamrabbetz vehamrachetz vehassach vehammalbish vehammanil over belo taase hannoder bishmo vehamkayyem bishmo over belo taase
Happoer atzmo levaal peor zo hi avodatah hazzorek even lemarkulis zo hi avodatah
Gema may echad haoved
Amar rabbi yirmeya hachi kaamar echad haoved kedarkah veechad hamzabbeach veechad hamkatter veechad hamnassech veechad hammishtachave vaafilu shello kedarkah
Velichshov name zorek amar abbaye zorek hayenu menassech dichtiv bal assich niskehem middam
Menahane mile
Detanu rabbanan ilu neemar zoveach yochoram hayiti omer bezoveach kodashim bachutz hakkatuv medabber talmud lomar laelohim bezoveach laavoda zara hakkatuv medabber
En li ella bezoveach mekatter umnassech minnayin talmud lomar bilti la levaddo riken haavodot kullan lashshem hamuchad
Lefi sheyyatza zevicha lidon baavodot penim minnayin lerabbot hishtachavaa
Talmud lomar vayyelech vayyaavod elohim acherim vayyishtachu lahem usmich leh vehotzeta et haish hahu vego
Onesh shamanu azhara minnayin talmud lomar ki lo tishtachave leel acher
Yachol sheani merabbe hamgappef vehamnashshek vehammanil talmud lomar zoveach
Zevicha bakkelal hayeta velamma yatza lehakkish eleha velomar lach ma zevicha meuchedet shehi avodat penim vechayyavin aleha mita af kol shehi avodat penim vechayyavin aleha mita
Yatza hishtachavaa lidon beatzmah yatza zevicha lidon al hakkelal kullo
Amar mar hayiti omer bezoveach kodashim bachutz hakkatuv medabber zoveach kodashim bachutz karet hu
Salka datach amena ki atro beh ketala ki la atro beh karet ka mashma lan
Amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye ema yatza hishtachavaa lelammed al hakkelal kullo
Vechi tema zoveach lema li legufeh dimchashshevin meavoda laavoda
Deitmar hashshochet behema lizrok damah laavoda zara ulhaktir chelbah laavoda zara rabbi yochanan amar

a: Asura veresh lakish amar mutteret
Hanicha lerabbi yochanan ella leresh lakish bae kera
Matkef lah rav pappa ulrabbi yochanan la bae kera ad kan la ka asar rabbi yochanan ella behema aval gavra la bar ketala hu vaata kera lechayyove gavra liktala
Matkef lah rav acha bereh derav ika ulresh lakish mi bae kera ad kan la ka share resh lakish ella behema aval gavra bar ketala hu mide dehave ammishtachave lehar dehar muttar veovdo besayif
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina lemay dekaamar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye ema yatza hishtachavaa lelammed al hakkelal kullo echa yaavdu lemaote may
Vechi tema lemaote happoer atzmo lezovchim mehishtachavaa nafka ma hishtachavaa derech kibud af kol derech kibud
Ella lemaote happoer atzmo lemarkulis salka datach amena hoil vaavodato bizzaon hu af kol bizzaon ka mashma lan
Ella ha deamar rabbi eliezer minnayin lazzoveach behema lemarkulis shehu chayyav shenneemar velo yizbechu od et zivchehem lasseirim
Im eno inyan lichdarkah dichtiv echa yaavdu tenehu inyan leshello kedarkah
Shello kedarkah mehishtachavaa nafka
Hatam bezoveach lehachis
Rav hamnuna irchasu leh tore pega beh rabba rema leh matneyatin ahadade tenan haoved avoda zara oved in omer la vehaanan tenan haomer eevod elech veeevod nelech venaavod
Amar leh beomer eni mekabbelo alay ella baavoda
Rav yosef amar tannae shaklatte mealma tannae hi detanya haomer bou veivduni rabbi meir mechayyev verabbi yehuda poter
Hecha diflachu kulle alma la peligi dichtiv lo taase lecha fesel ki peligi bedibura bealma rabbi meir savar dibura milta hi verabbi yehuda savar dibura lav milta hi
Hadar amar rav yosef lav milta hi daamari daafilu lerabbi yehuda bedibura name chayyove mechayyev ditnan rabbi yehuda omer leolam eno chayyav ad sheyyomar eevod elech veeevod nelech venaavod
Bemay kamipalgi bemesit leatzmo veamri leh in kamipalgi mar savar mesit leatzmo shami leh vein dekaamri leh kushta hu umar savar mesit leatzmo la shami leh memar amri
b: May shena ihu minan didan vein dekaamri achoche aleh
Umatneyatin kan beyachid hannisat kan berabbim hannisatim yachid la mimlach vetae batreh rabbim mimalchi vela tau batreh
Amar rav yosef mena amena lah dichtiv lo tove lo velo tishma elav ha ava veshama chayyav

Etiveh abbaye mi shane ben nisat derabbim lenisat yachid vehatanya ki yesitcha achicha ven immecha echad yachid hannisat veechad rabbim hannisatim vehotzi hakkatuv yachid mikkelal rabbim verabbim mikkelal yachid
Yachid mikkelal rabbim lehachmir al gufo ulhakel al mamono
Rabbim mikkelal yachid lehakel al gufam ulhachmir al mamonam
Beha milta hu deshane aval bechol mile ki hadade ninhu
Ella amar abbaye kan benisat mippi atzmo kan benisat mippi acherim mippi atzmo mimlech mippi acherim gerir batrayehu
Amar abbaye mena amena lah dichtiv lo tove lo velo tishma elav ha ava veshama chayyav
Rava amar ide veide benisat mippi acherim ha daamar leh kach ochelet kach shota kach metiva kach merea ha dela amar leh kach ochelet kach shota ku
Amar rava mena amena lah dichtiv meelohe haammim asher sevivotechem hakkerovim elecha vego ma li kerovim uma li rechokim hachi kaamar lach mittivutan shel kerovim atta lamed ma tivutan shel rechokim
May lav daamar leh kach ochelet kach shote kach mittivah kach merea shema minah
Rav ashe amar sefa beyisrael meshummad
Ravina amar la zo af zo katane
Itmar haoved avoda zara meahava umiyyira abbaye amar chayyav rava amar patur
Abbaye amar chayyav deha palchah rava amar patur i kabbelah aleh beeloha in i la la
Siman eved yishtachave lemashiach
Veamar abbaye mena amena lah ditnan haoved avoda zara echad haoved ku may lav echad haoved meahava umiyyira
Verava amar lach la kedimtaretz rabbi yirmeya

Amar abbaye mena amena lah detanya lo tishtachave lahem lahem i atta mishtachave aval atta mishtachave leadam kemotcha yachol afilu neevad kehaman talmud lomar velo taovdem veha haman miyyira hava neevad
Verava kehaman velo kehaman kehaman deihu gufeh avoda zara velo kehaman deilu haman miyyira vehacha lav miyyira
Veamar abbaye mena amena lah detanya kohen mashiach baavoda zara rabbi omer beshiggat maase vachachamim omrim behelem davar
Veshavin shebbisira keyachid veshavin sheen mevi asham taluy
Hay shiggat maase daavoda zara hechi dame i kasavar bet hakkeneset hu vehishtachava lo hare libbo lashshamayim ella dachaza inderata vehishtachava lo
I kabbeleh aleh beeloha mezid hu

a: Vei la kabbeleh aleh beeloha la kelum hu ella lav meahava umiyyira
Verava amar lach la beomer muttar
Omer muttar hayenu helem davar
Beomer muttar ligmare helem davar kiyyum miktzat uvitul miktzat
Tane rabbi zakkay kammeh derabbi yochanan zibach vekiter venisech vehishtachava behelem echad eno chayyav ella achat
Amar leh pok teni levara
Amar rabbi abba ha deamar rabbi zakkay machloket rabbi yose verabbi natan detanya havara lelav yatzat divre rabbi yose
Verabbi natan omer lechallek yatzat
Leman deamar havara lelav yatzat hishtachavaa name lelav yatzat
Leman deamar havara lechallek yatzat hishtachavaa name lechallek yatzat
Matkef lah rav yosef dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hatam havara lelav yatzat denafka leh chiluk melachot meachat mehenna
Detanya rabbi yose omer veasa meachat mehenna peamim shechayyav achat al kullan peamim shechayyav al kol achat veachat
Veamar rabbi yonatan may tama derabbi yose dichtiv veasa meachat mehenna achat meachat henna mehenna achat shehi henna vehenna shehi achat
Achat shimon meachat shem mishshimon
Henna avot mehenna toladot achat shehi henna zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot henna shehi achat shiggat shabbat uzdon melachot
Aval hacha dela nafka leh chiluk melachot midduchta achariti dechulle alma hishtachavaa lechallek yatzat
Chiluk melachot daavoda zara name tipok leh meachat mehenna achat zevicha meachat siman echad
Henna avot zibuach kitur nisuch vehishtachavaa mehenna toladot shavar makkel lefaneha
Achat shehi henna zedon avoda zara veshiggat avodot henna shehi achat shiggat avoda zara uzdon avodot
Hay shiggat avoda zara hechi dame i kasavar bet hakkeneset hu vehishtachava lo hare libbo lashshamayim
Ella dachaza inderata usged leh i kabbeleh aleh mezid hu i la kabbeleh aleh la kelum hu
Ella meahava umiyyira hanicha leabbayye deamar chayyav ella lerava deamar patur may ika lememar
Ella beomer muttar tifshot diva mineh rava merav nachman helem ze vaze beyado mahu
Tifshot deeno chayyav ella achat ha la kashya vetifshot
Umi matzet mokmatte lehane kerae baavoda zara deilu hacha ketiv bemashiach par uvnasi sair uvyachid kisba usira
Veilu baavoda zara tenan veshavin shebbisira keyachid
Vetu la mide
Ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar
b: Hachi tena kammeh chomer bashshabbat mishshear mitzot chomer bishar mitzot mibbashshabbat chomer bashshabbat shehashshabbat asa shettayim behelem echad chayyav al kol achat veachat ma sheen ken bishar mitzot chomer bishar mitzot shebbishar mitzot shagag belo mitkaven chayyav ma sheen ken bashshabbat
Amar mar chomer bashshabbat shehashshabbat asa shettayim ku hechi dame ilema daavad ketzira utchina dichvatah gabbe shear mitzot daachal chelev vadam hacha tarte michayyav vehacha tarte michayyav
Ella gabbe shear mitzot deeno chayyav ella achat hechi dame daachal chelev vachelev dichvatah gabbe shabbat daavad ketzira uktzira hacha chada michayyav vehacha chada michayyav
Vehayenu daamar leh pok teni levara
May kushya dilma leolam ema lecha daavad ketzira utchina ma sheen ken bishar mitzot atan laavoda zara kidrabbi amme deamar rabbi amme zibach vekiter venisech behelem echad eno chayyav ella achat
La mitokma leh baavoda zara dekatane sefa chomer bishar mitzot shebbishar mitzot shagag belo mitkaven chayyav

Shogeg belo mitkaven baavoda zara hechi dame i dekasavar bet hakkeneset hu vehishtachava lo hare libbo lashshamayim ella dachaza inderata usged leh i kabbeleh aleh beeloha mezid hu vei la kabbeleh aleh lo kelum hi
Ella meahava umiyyira hanicha leabbayye deamar chayyav ella lerava deamar patur may ika lememar
Ella beomer muttar ma sheen ken bashshabbat defatur ligmare
Ad kan la bea mineh rava merav nachman helem ze vaze ella i lechayyove chada i lechayyove tarte patur ligmare leka leman deamar
May kushya dilma leolam ema lach resha baavoda zara vesefa bishar mitzot
Veshagag belo mitkaven dekasavar rok hu uvlao ma sheen ken bashshabbat defatur shennitkaven lehagbiha et hattalush vechatach et hamchubbar patur
Vechidrav nachman amar shemuel deamar hammitassek bachalavim uvaaraot chayyav shekken nehene hammitassek beshabbat patur melechet machshevet asra tora
Rabbi yochanan letameh dela mokem matnita resha bechad tama vesefa bechad tama
Deamar rabbi yochanan man dimtargem li chavit alliba dechad tanna movelna maneh batreh leve massuta
Gufa

a: Amar rabbi amme zibach vekiter venisech behelem echad eno chayyav ella achat amar abbaye may tama derabbi amme amar kera lo taovdem hakkatuv asaan kullan avoda achat
Umi amar abbaye hachi vehaamar abbaye shalosh hishtachavaot baavoda zara lamma
Achat lichdarkah veachat shello kedarkah veachat lechallek
Lidvarav derabbi amme kaamar veleh la sevira leh
Gufa amar abbaye shalosh hishtachavaot baavoda zara lamma achat lichdarkah veachat shello kedarkah veachat lechallek
Lichdarkah meecha yaavdu haggoyim haelle nafka
Ella achat kedarkah veshello kedarkah veachat leshello kedarkah veachat lechallek
Hamkabbelo alav beeloha haomer lo eli atta amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav kevan sheamar lo eli atta chayyav
Lemay i liktala matnitin hi ella lekorban

Vaafilu lerabbanan vehatanya eno chayyav ella al davar sheyyesh bo maase kegon zibuach vekitur venisuch vehishtachavaa veamar resh lakish man tena hishtachavaa rabbi akiva hi deamar la baenan maase mikkelal derabbanan savri baenan maase
Ki kaamar rav name lerabbi akiva kaamar
Lerabbi akiva peshita hayenu megaddef
Mahu detema ad kan la mechayyev rabbi akiva korban ella bimgaddef dichtiv beh karet aval hacha dela ketiv beh karet ema la
Ka mashma lan deittakkoshe ittakkush dichtiv vayyishtachau lo vayyizbechu lo vayyomru vego
Amar rabbi yochanan ilmale vav shebbeheelucha nitchayevu sonehem shel yisrael kelaya
Ketannae acherim omrim ilmale vav shebbeheelucha nitchayevu sonehem shel yisrael kelaya
Amar lo rabbi shimon ben yochay vahalo kol hamshattef shem shamayim vedavar acher neekar min haolam shenneemar bilti la levaddo ella ma talmud lomar asher heelucha sheiuu elohot harbe
Aval hamgappef vehamnashshek hamchabbed vehamrabbetz ku ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi elazar al kullam loke chutz mehannoder bishmo vehamkayyem bishmo
May shena hannoder bishmo vehamkayyem bishmo dela lake mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase hane name lav shebbichlalot hu veen lokin al lav shebbichlalot
Detanya minnayin leochel min habbehema kodem shettetze nafshah shehu belo taase talmud lomar lo tochlu al haddam
Davar acher lo tochlu al haddam lo tochlu basar vaadayin dam bemizrak
Rabbi dosa omer minnayin sheen mavrin al haruge bet din talmud lomar lo tochlu al haddam
Rabbi akiva omer minnayin lesanhedrin shehargu et hannefesh sheen toamin kelum kol oto hayyom talmud lomar lo tochlu al haddam
Amar rabbi yochanan azhara leven sorer umore minnayin talmud lomar lo tochlu al haddam
Veamar rabbi avin bar chiyya veitema rabbi avin bar kahana al kullam eno loke mishshum dehave leh lav shebbichlalot
Ella ki ata ravin amar rabbi elazar al kullan eno loke chutz min hannoder bishmo vehamkayyem bishmo
May shena ahanach dela lake dehave leh lav shebbichlalot hane name lav sheen bo maase ninhu
Hahu kerabbi yehuda deamar lav sheen bo maase lokin alav
Detanya lo totiru mimmennu ad boker ba hakkatuv liten ase achar lo taase
b: Lomar sheen lokin alav divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi yaakov omer lo min hashshem hu ze ella mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav
Mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar lokin alav
Hannoder bishmo vehamkayyem bishmo hare ze belo taase hannoder bishmo vehamkayyem bishmo menalan

Detanya veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru shello yomar adam lachavero shemor li betzad avoda zara pelonit lo yishshama al picha shello yiddor bishmo velo yekayyem bishmo velo yigrom laacherim shidru bishmo vesheyekayemu bishmo
Davar acher lo yishshama al picha azhara lammesit velammaddiach
Mesit behedya ketiv beh vechol yisrael yishmeu veyirau vego ella azhara lammaddiach

Velo yigrom laacherim sheyyidderu bishmo vesheyekayemu bishmo mesayea leh laavuh dishmuel deamar avuh dishmuel asur leadam sheyyaase shuttafut im hannochri shemma yitchayyev lo shevua venishba baavoda zara shello vehattora amra lo yishshama al picha

Ki ata ulla bat bekalnevo amar leh rava vehecha bat mar amar leh bekalnevo amar leh vehachtiv veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan kol avoda zara hakketuva battora muttar lehazkir shemah veha hecha ketiva dichtiv kara bel kores nevo

Vei la ketiva la metiv rav mesharsheya raa achat merubba keshalosh shehi kemiggadon leshilo shehen shette tevilot ushne sefogin hare ze zav gamur amar ravina gad name michtav ketiv dichtiv haorchim laggad shulchan
Amar rav nachman kol letzanuta asira chutz milletzanuta daavoda zara desharya dichtiv kara bel kores nevo karsu charu yachdav lo yachlu mallet massa
Uchtiv dibberu leeglot bet aven yaguru shechan shomron ki aval alav ammo uchmarav alav yagilu al kevodo ki gala mimmennu al tikre kevodo ella kevedo

Amar rabbi yitzchak may dichtiv veatta yosifu lachato vayyasu lahem massecha mikkaspam kitvunam atzabbim vego may kitvunam atzabbim melammed shekkol echad veechad ose demut yirato umannichah bechiso beshaa shezzochrah motziah mittoch cheko umchabbekah umnashshekah

May zovche adam agalim yishshakun amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme shehau komarim notnim enehem bevaale mamon umarivim et haagalim veosin demut atzabbim umaamidin betzad avusehen umotziin otan lachutz kevan sherau otan ratzin acharehen ummashmeshin bahen omrim lo avoda zara chafetz becha yavo veyizbach atzmo lo
Amar rava hay zovche adam agalim yishshakun agalim yishshakun lizboach adam mibe leh ella amar rava kol hazzoveach et beno laavoda zara omer lo doron gadol hikriv lo yavo veyishshak lo

Amar rav yehuda amar rav veanshe vavel asu et sukkot benot umay nihu tarnegolet veanshe chut asu et nergal umay nihu tarnegol veanshe chamat asu et ashima umay nihu barcha karcha vehaavim asu et nivchan veet tartak umay nihu kelev vachamor
Vehasfarvim sorfim et benehem veet benotehem baesh leadrammelech vaanammelech elohe sefarvayim umay nihu happered vehassus adrammelech deadar leh lemareh bitina vaanammelech deane leh lemareh bikrava
Af chizkiyya melech yehuda bikesh aviv laasot lo ken ella shessachattu immo salamandera
Amar rav yehuda amar rav yodin hau yisrael baavoda zara sheen bah mammash velo avdu avoda zara ella lehattir lahem araot befarhesya
Metiv rav mesharsheya kizkor benehem mizbechotam vego veamar rabbi elazar keadam sheyyesh lo gaguin al beno
Batar daaviku bah
Ta shema venatatti pigrechem al pigre gillulechem amar eliyyahu hatztzaddik haya mechazzer al tefuche raav shebbirushalayim paam achat matza tinok shehaya tafuach umutal baashpa

Amar lo meeze mishpacha atta amar lo mimmishpacha pelonit ani amar lo kelum nishtayyer meotah mishpacha amar lo lav chutz mimmenni amar lo im ani melammedcha davar sheatta chay bo atta lamed amar lo hen amar lo emor bechol yom shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad amar lo

a: Has shello lehazkir beshem Adonai shello limdo aviv veimmo
Miyyad hotzi yirato mecheko umchabbekah umnashshekah ad shennivkea kereso venafla yirato laaretz venafal hu aleha lekayyem ma shenneemar venatatti et pigrechem al pigre gillulechem batar daaviku beh

Ta shema vayyizaku bekol gadol el Adonai elohehem may amur amar rav yehuda veitema rav yonatan biyya biyya hayenu deachreveh leveta vekalye lehechla vekatlinhu letzaddike veaglinhu leyisrael mearayehu vaadayin hu merakked benan kelum yehavteh lan ella lekabbole beh agra la ihu baenan vela agreh baenan batar daaviku beh
Yetavu telata yome betaanita bau rachame nefal lehu pitka merkia dahava ketiv bah emet
Amar rabbi chanina shema minah chotamo shel hakkadosh baruch hu emet

Nefak kegurya denura mibbet kadshe hakkodashim amar lehu navi leyisrael hayenu yitzra daavoda zara bahade dekatafsi leh ishtemit binita mineh vaazal kaleh bearba mea parse amru hechi nebed dilma mishshemayya merachami aleh
Amar lehu navi shaduh beduda daavara vechasseuh baavara deshayef kaleh dichtiv vayyomer zot harisha vayyashlech otah el toch haefa vayyashlech et haeven haoferet el piha
Amri hoil veet ratzon hu nive rachame ayyitzra daavera beo rachame imsar bidayehu
Chavshuh telata yome beo beata bat yoma lechole vela ashkachu amaru hechi naaved nive palga palga merkia la yahavi kachlinhu leeneh ahani beh dela migare inish bekarivteh

Amar rav yehuda amar rav maase begoya achat shehayeta chola beoter amra im taamod hahi ishsha mecholyah telech vetaavod lechol avoda zara shebbaolam amda veavda lechol avoda zara shebbaolam kevan shehiggia lifor shaala lakkomarim bamma ovdin lazo amru lah ochlin teradin veshotin shechar umatrizin befaneha amra mutav shettachazor hahi ishsha lecholyah velo taavod avoda zara bechach
Attem bet yisrael enan ken hannitzmadim levaal peor ketzamid patil veattem haddevekim ba elohechem kishte temarot haddevukot zo bazo
Bematnita tana hannitzmadim levaal peor ketzamid al yede ishsha veattem haddevekim ba elohechem devukim mammash

Tanu rabbanan maase besavta ben allas shehiskir chamoro legoya achat kevan shehiggia lifor amra lo hamten ad sheekkanes veetze leachar sheyyatza amar lah af atte hamtini ad sheekkanes veetze amra lo velo yehudi atta amar lah umay ichpat lich nichnas paar befanav vekinach bechotmo vehau komarin mekallesin lo veomrim meolam lo haya adam sheavado laze bechach
Happoer atzmo levaal peor hare ze avodato af al gav demikaven levizuy hazzorek even lemarkulis zo hi avodato af al gav demikaven lemirgemeh
Rav menashshe hava kaazel leve torta amaru leh avoda zara hi dekae hacha shekal pisa sheda bah amru lo markulis hi amar lehu hazzorek even lemarkulis tenan

Ata sheal be midresha amru lo hazzorek even bemarkulis tenan af al gav demikaven lemirgemeh amar lehu ezil eshkelah amru lo echad hannotlah veechad hannotnah chayyav kol chada vachada ravecha lachavertah shavek

Matni hannoten mizzaro lammolech eno chayyav ad sheyyimsor lammolech veyaavir baesh masar lammolech velo heevir baesh heevir baesh velo masar lammolech eno chayyav ad sheyyimsor lammolech veyaavir baesh

Gema katane avoda zara vekatane molech amar rabbi avin tenan keman deamar molech lav avoda zara hi detanya echad lammolech veechad lishar avoda zara chayyav rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer lammolech chayyav shello lammolech patur

Amar abbaye rabbi elazar berabbi shimon verabbi chanina ben antignos amru davar echad rabbi elazar berabbi shimon ha daamaran rabbi chanina ben antignos detanya rabbi chanina ben antignos omer mippene ma tafsa tora leshon molech kol shehimlichuhu alehem afilu tzeror vaafilu kesam
Rava amar molech aray ika benayehu
b: Amar rabbi yannay eno chayyav ad sheyyimserennu lechomarin shenneemar umizzaracha lo titten lehaavir lammolech

Tanya name hachi yachol heevir velo masar yehe chayyav talmud lomar lo titten masar lammolech velo heevir yachol yehe chayyav talmud lomar lehaavir masar veheevir shello lammolech yachol yehe chayyav talmud lomar lammolech

Masar veheevir lammolech velo baesh yachol yehe chayyav neemar kan lehaavir veneemar lehallan lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh ma lehallan baesh af kan baesh uma kan molech af lehallan molech
Amar rav acha bereh derava heevir kol zaro patur shenneemar mizzaracha velo kol zaracha
Bae rav ashe heeviro some mahu yashen mahu ben beno uven bitto mahu

Tifshot miha chada detanya ki mizzaro natan lammolech ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh en li ella beno uvitto ben beno uven bitto minnayin talmud lomar betitto mizzaro
Tanna patach bekki mizzaro vesalek betitto mizzaro
Derasha acharina hu zaro en li ella zera kasher zera pasul minnayin talmud lomar betitto mizzaro
Amar rav yehuda eno chayyav ad sheyyaavirennu derech haavara hechi dame amar abbaye sheraga delivne bemitze nura mehay gisa venura mehay gisa
Rava amar kemashvarta defurayya
Tanya kevateh derava eno chayyav ad sheyyaavirennu derech avarah heeviro baregel patur
Veeno chayyav ella al yotze yerecho ha ketzad beno uvitto chayyav aviv veimmo achiv vaachoto patur heevir atzmo patur verabbi elazar berabbi shimon mechayyev
Echad lammolech veechad lishar avoda zara chayyav rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer lammolech chayyav shello lammolech patur
Amar ulla may tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon amar kera lo yimmatze vecha becha beatzmecha
Verabbanan la darshi becha vehatnan avedato vaavedat aviv shello kodemet veamrinan may tama veamar rav yehuda amar kera efes ki lo yihye becha evon shello kodemet leshel kol adam
Hatam meefes
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina shalosh karetot baavoda zara lamma
Achat lichdarkah veachat leshello kedarkah veachat lammolech
Ulman deamar molech avoda zara hi karet bemolech lema li lemaavir beno shello kedarkah
Ulman deamar megaddef avoda zara hi karet bimgaddef lema li
Lechidtanya hikkaret tikkaret hikkaret baolam hazze tikkaret laolam habba divre rabbi akiva
Amar lo rabbi yishmael vahalo kevar neemar venichreta vechi shelosha olamim yesh ella venichreta baolam hazze hikkaret laolam habba tikkaret dibbera tora chilshon bene adam

a: Matni baal ov ze pitom hamdabber mishshecho veyiddeoni ze hamdabber befiv hare ellu biskila vehannishal bahem beazhara
Gema may shena hacha dekatane baal ov veyiddeoni umay shena gabbe karetot dekatane baal ov veshayereh leyiddeoni
Rabbi yochanan amar hoil ushnehen belav echad neemru
Resh lakish amar yiddeoni lefi sheen bo maase
Verabbi yochanan may shena baal ov denaket mishshum diftach beh kera
Veresh lakish may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan amar rav pappa chalukin hen bemita
Verabbi yochanan chalukka delav shemah chalukka demita lo shemah chalukka
Verabbi yochanan may tama la amar keresh lakish amar lach matnitin decharetot rabbi akiva hi deamar la baenan maase
Veresh lakish nehi dela bae rabbi akiva maase rabba maase zuta bae
Megaddef may maase ika akimat sefatav have maase
Baal ov may maase ika hakkashat zerootav have maase
Vaafilu lerabbanan vehatanya eno chayyav ella al davar sheyyesh bo maase kegon zibuach kitur venisuch vehishtachavaa
Veamar resh lakish man tena hishtachavaa rabbi akiva hi deamar la baenan maase verabbi yochanan amar afilu tema rabbanan kefifat komato lerabbanan have maase
Hashta leresh lakish kefifat komato lerabbanan la have maase hakkashat zerootav devaal ov have maase
Ki kaamar resh lakish name lerabbi akiva aval lerabbanan la
I hachi yatza megaddef uvaal ov mibe leh
Ella amar ulla bimkatter lashshed
Amar leh rava mekatter lashshed oved avoda zara hu ella amar rava bimkatter lechabbar
Amar leh abbaye hamkatter lechabbar chover chaver hu
In vehattora amra chover ze biskila
Tanu rabbanan chover chaver echad chever gadol veechad chever katan vaafilu nechashim veakrabbim
Amar abbaye hilkach hay man detzamed zibura veakrabba af al gav deka mikaven dela lazku asur
Verabbi yochanan may shena dichfifat komato lerabbanan have maase vaakimat sefatav la have maase
Amar rava shane megaddef hoil veyeshno ballev
b: Metiv rabbi zera yatzu edim zommin sheen bahen maase veammay ha letanhu ballev
Amar rava shane edim zommin hoil veyeshno bekol
Vekol lerabbi yochanan lav maase hu veha itmar chasamah bekol vehinhigah bekol rabbi yochanan amar chayyav veresh lakish amar patur
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyav akimat piv have maase resh lakish amar patur akimat piv la have maase
Ella amar rava shane edim zommin hoil veyeshnan biriyya
Tanu rabbanan baal ov ze hamdabber ben happerakim umibben atztzile yadav yiddeoni ze hammanniach etzem yadua befiv vehu medabber meelav
Metivi vehaya keov meeretz kolech may lav demishtae ki orcheh la desalek veyatev ben happerakim umishtae
Ta shema vattomer haishsha el shaul elohim raiti olim min haaretz may lav demishtae ki orcheh la deyatev ben happerakim umishtae
Tanu rabbanan baal ov echad hammaale bizchuro veechad hannishal begulgolet ma ben ze laze maale bizchuro eno ole kedarko veeno ole bashshabbat nishal begulgolet ole kedarko veole bashshabbat
Ole lehecha salek ha kammeh mannach ella ema one kedarko veone bashshabbat
Veaf sheela zo shaal toranusrufus harasha et rabbi akiva amar lo uma yom miyyamim amar lo uma gevar migguvrin amar leh demari tzave shabbat name demari tzave
Amar leh hachi kaamena lach mi yemar dehaidana shabbeta amar lo nehar sabbaton yochiach baal ov yochiach kivro shel aviv yochiach sheen maale ashan bashshabbat amar lo bizito biyyashto vekilalto
Shoel ov hayenu vedoresh el hammetim
Doresh lammetim kidtanya vedoresh el hammetim ze hammariv atzmo veholech velan bevet hakkevarot kede shettishre alav ruach tuma

Uchshehaya rabbi akiva maggia lemikra ze haya boche uma hammariv atzmo keday shettishre alav ruach tuma shora alav ruach tuma hammariv atzmo keday shettishre alav ruach tohora al achat kamma vechamma aval ma eese sheaonotenu garmu lanu shenneemar ki im aonotechem hau mavdilim benechem leven elohechem
Amar rava i bau tzaddike baru alma shenneemar ki aonotechem hau mavdilim vego
Rava bera gavra shaddereh lekammeh derabbi zera hava ka mishtae bahadeh vela hava ka mahdar leh amar leh min chavrayya atte hadar leafrach
Rav chanina verav oshaya hao yatvi kol maale shabbeta veaski besefer yetzira umibre lehu igla tilta veachli leh

Tanu rabbanan meonen rabbi shimon omer ze hammaavir shiva mine zechur al haayin vachachamim omrim ze haochez et haenayim rabbi akiva omer ze hamchashshev ittim veshaot veomer hayyom yafe latzet lemachar yafe likach limmude arve sheviiyyot chittin yafot ikure kitniyyot meheot raot
Tanu rabbanan menachesh ze haomer pitto nafla mippiv maklo nafla mido beno kore lo meacharav orev kore lo tzevi hifsiko badderech nachash mimino veshual missemolo

a: Al tatchil bi shacharit hu rosh chodesh hu motzae shabbat hu
Tanu rabbanan lo tenachashu velo teonenu kegon ellu hamnachashim bechulda beofot uvdagim
Matni hamchallel et hashshabbat bedavar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat
Gema mikkelal deika mide dechilul shabbat have veen chayyavin lo al shiggato chattat velo al zedono karet
May hi techumin vealliba derabbi akiva havara vealliba derabbi yose
Matni hamkallel aviv veimmo eno chayyav ad sheyekallelem bashshem killelam bechinnuy rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrin

Gema man chachamim rabbi menachem berabbi yose hu detanya rabbi menachem berabbi yose omer benokvo shem yumat ma talmud lomar shem limed al mekallel aviv veimmo sheeno chayyav ad sheyekallelem bashshem
Tanu rabbanan ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot bat tumtum veanderoginos
Asher yekallel et aviv veet immo en li ella aviv veimmo aviv shello immo immo shello aviv minnayin talmud lomar aviv veimmo killel damav bo aviv kilel immo kilel divre rabbi yoshiyya
Rabbi yonatan omer mashma shenehen keechad umashma echad bifne atzmo ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv yachdav
Mot yumat biskila atta omer biskila o eno ella beachat mikkol mitot haamurot battora neemar kan damav bo veneemar lehallan demehem bam ma lehallan biskila af kan biskila
Onesh shamanu azhara minnayin talmud lomar elohim lo tekallel vego im haya aviv dayyan hare hu bichlal elohim lo tekallel veim haya aviv nasi hare hu bichlal venasi veammecha lo taor
Eno lo dayyan velo nasi minnayin amratte hare atta dan binyan av mishshenehen lo rei nesi kiri dayyan velo rei dayyan kiri nasi

Lo rei dayyan kiri nasi shehare dayyan atta metzuve al horaato kiri nasi shei atta metzuve al horaato velo rei nasi kiri dayyan shehannasi atta metzuve al hamraato kiri dayyan shei atta metzuve al hamraato
Hatztzad hashshave shebbahem shehen beammecha veatta muzhar al killatan af ani avi avicha shebbeammecha veatta muzhar al killato
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken gedullatan garma lahen
Talmud lomar lo tekallel cheresh beumlalim shebbeammecha hakkatuv medabber
Ma lecheresh shekken charishato garma lo
Nasi vedayyan yochichu ma lenasi vedayyan shekken gedullatan garma lahen cheresh yochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze chiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shehen beammecha veatta muzhar al killatan af ani avi avicha shebbeammecha veatta muzhar al killato
Ma letzad hashshave shebbahen shekken meshunnin
Ella im ken nichtov kera o elohim vecheresh o nasi vecheresh elohim lema li im eno inyan legufo tenehu inyan leaviv
Hanicha leman deamar elohim chol ella leman deamar kodesh may ika lememar
Detanya elohim chol divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer elohim kodesh vetanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer azhara limvarech et hashshem minnayin talmud lomar elohim lo tekallel
Leman deamar elohim chol gamar kodesh mechol leman deamar elohim kodesh gamrinan chol mikkodesh
Bishlama leman deamar elohim chol gamar kodesh mechol ella leman deamar elohim kodesh gamar chol mikkodesh dilma akkodesh azhar achol la azhar
Im ken lichtov kera lo takel
b: May lo tekallel shema minah tarte
Matni habba al naara hamorasa eno chayyav ad shettehe naara betula meorasa vehi bevet aviha bau aleha shenayim harishon biskila vehashsheni bechenek
Gema tanu rabbanan naara velo bogeret betula velo beula meorasa velo nesua bevet aviha perat leshemmasar haav lishluche habbaal
Amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi meir aval chachamim omrim naara hamorasa afilu ketanna bammashma
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina mimmay dematnitin rabbi meir hi ulmaote ketanna name dilma rabbanan hi ulmaote bogeret vetu la
Amar leh hay eno chayyav ad shettehe naara betula meorasa eno chayyav ella al naara betula meorasa mibe leh vetu la midi
Bea mineh rabbi yaakov bar adda merav ba al hakketanna meorasa lerabbi meir mahu legamre memaet leh o missekila memaet leh amar leh mistabbera missekila memaet leh
Vehachtiv umetu gam shenehem ad sheyehu shenehen shavin shetek rav
Amar shemuel may tama shetek rav venema leh umet haish asher shachav immah levaddo
Ketannae umetu gam shenehem ad sheyehu shenehen shavin divre rabbi yoshiyya rabbi yonatan omer umet haish asher shachav immah levaddo
Veidach hahi umetu gam shenehem may daresh beh amar rava lemaote maase chidudim veidach maase chidudim lav kelum hi
Veidach hay levaddo may daresh beh
Kidtanya bau aleha asara bene adam vaadayin hi betula kullam biskila rabbi omer harishon biskila vechullan bechenek
Tanu rabbanan uvat ish kohen ki techel liznot rabbi omer techila vechen hu omer umet haish asher shachav immah levaddo
May kaamar amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua rabbi kerabbi yishmael sevira leh deamar arusa yatza lisrefa velo nesua vehachi kaamar im techilat bia biznut bisrefa idach bechenek
May vechen ki hatam ma hatam bitchilat bia kamishtae kera hacha name bitchilat bia kamishtae kera
Amar leh rav bivi bar abbaye mar la hachi amar umannu rav yosef
Rabbi kerabbi meir sevira leh deamar nisset leechad min happesulin mitatah bechenek
Vehachi kaamar im techilat achalatah biznut bisrefa veidach bechenek umay vechen

a: Simana bealma
Matni hammesit ze hedot vehammesit et hahedot amar yesh yira bemakom peloni kach ochelet kach shote kach metiva kach merea
Kol chayyave mitot shebbetora en machminin alehem chutz mizzo
Amar lishnayim hen edav umviin oto levet din vesoklin oto amar leechad hu omer yesh li chaverim rotzim bechach

Im haya arum veeno yachol ledabber bifnehem machminin lo edim achore haggader vehu omer lo emor ma sheamarta beyichud vehalla omer lo vehu omer lo heach nanniach et elohenu shebbashshamayim venelech venaavod etzim vaavanim im chozer bo hare ze mutav veim amar kach hi chovatenu kach yafe lanu haomdin meachore haggader meviin oto levet din vesoklin oto

Haomer eevod elech veeevod nelech venaavod ezbach elech veezbach nelech venizbach aktir elech veaktir nelech venaktir anassech elech vaanassech nelech unnassech eshtachave elech veeshtachave nelech venishtachave
Gema hammesit ze hedot tama dehedot ha navi bechenek vehammesit et hahedot tama deyachid ha rabbim bechenek
Matnitin manni rabbi shimon hi detanya navi shehediach biskila rabbi shimon omer bechenek maddiche ir hanniddachat biskila rabbi shimon omer bechenek
Ema sefa hammaddiach ze haomer nelech venaavod avoda zara veamar rav yehuda amar rav maddiche ir hanniddachat shanu atan lerabbanan resha rabbi shimon vesefa rabbanan
Ravina amar kullah rabbanan hi vela zo af zo katane
Rav pappa amar ki katane mesit ze hedot lehachmana
Detanya ushar kol chayyave mitot shebbattora en machminin alehen chutz mizzo

Ketzad osin lo madlikin lo et hanner babbayit happenimi umoshivin lo edim babbayit hachitzon kede sheyehu hen roin oto veshomin et kolo vehu eno roe otan vehalla omer lo emor ma sheamarta li beyichud vehu omer lo vehalla omer lo heach nanniach et elohenu shebbashshamayim venaavod avoda zara im chozer bo mutav veim amar kach hi chovatenu vechach yafe lanu haedim sheshshomin mibbachutz meviin oto levet din vesoklin oto
Vechen asu leven satada belod utlauhu beerev happesach
Ben satada ben pandira hu amar rav chisda baal satada boel pandira baal pappus ben yehuda hu ella immo satada immo miryam megaddela neshayya havay kidamri befumbedita setat da mibbalah
Matni hammaddiach ze haomer nelech venaavod avoda zara

Hamchashshef haose maase chayyav velo haochez et haenayim rabbi akiva omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua shenayim loktin kishshuin echad loket patur veechad loket chayyav haose maase chayyav haochez et haenayim patur
Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav maddiche ir hanniddachat shanu kan
Hamchashshef ze haose maase vechu tanu rabbanan mechashshefa echad haish veechad haishsha im ken ma talmud lomar mechashshefa mippene sherov nashim metzuot bichshafim
Mitatan bamme rabbi yose haggelili omer neemar kan mechashshefa lo techayye veneemar lehallan lo techayye kol neshama ma lehallan besayif af kan besayif
Rabbi akiva omer neemar kan mechashshefa lo techayye veneemar lehallan im behema im ish lo yichye ma lehallan biskila af kan biskila
Amar lo rabbi yose ani danti lo techayye millo techayye veatta danta lo techayye millo yichye
Amar lo rabbi akiva ani danti yisrael miyyisrael sheriba bahen hakkatuv mitot harbe veatta danta yisrael miggoyim shello riba bahen hakkatuv ella
b: Mita achat
Ben azzay omer neemar mechashshefa lo techayye veneemar kol shochev im behema mot yumat semacho inyan lo ma shochev im behema biskila af mechashshef biskila

Amar lo rabbi yehuda vechi mippene shessemacho inyan lo notzi laze biskila ella ov veyiddeoni bichlal mechashshefim hau velamma yatzu lehakkish alehen velomar lach ma ov veyiddeoni biskila af mechashshef biskila
Lerabbi yehuda name liho ov veyiddeoni shene chetuvim habbaim keechad vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Amar rabbi zecharya ada amra kasavar rabbi yehuda shene chetuvin habbain keechad melammedin
Amar rabbi yochanan lamma nikra sheman keshafim shemmachchishin pamalya shel mala
En od milvaddo amar rabbi chanina afilu lidvar keshafim
Hahi itta dahavat ka mehaddera lemishkal afra mittute kareh derabbi chanina amar lah i mistayyate zili avidi en od milvaddo ketiv
Ini vehaamar rabbi yochanan lamma nikra sheman mechashshefim shemmachchishin pamalya shel mala shane rabbi chanina dinfish zechuteh
Amar rabbi ayevu bar naggare amar rabbi chiyya bar abba belatehem ellu maase shedim belahatehem ellu maase cheshafim vechen hu omer veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet
Amar abbaye dekafed ammana shed dela kafed ammana keshafim

Haose maase biskila haochez et haenayim patur aval asur muttar lechattechilla kidrav chanina verav oshaya kol maale shabbeta hao aski behilchot yetzira umibre lehu igla tilta veachli leh

Mishsheyyavi shette searot vead sheyyakkif zakan hattachton velo haelon ella sheddibberu chachamim bilshon nekiyya shenneemar ki yihye leish ben ben velo bat ben velo ish katan patur shello ba lichlal mitzot
Gema katan menalan defatur menalan kidkatane tama shello ba lichlal mitzot vetu hecha ashkechan deanash hakkatuv dehacha live kera lemiftereh
Anan hachi kaamrinan attu ben sorer umore al cheto neherag al shem sofo neherag vechevan deal shem sofo neherag afilu katan name veod ben velo ish katan mashma
Amar rav yehuda amar rav deamar kera vechi yihye leish ben ben hassamuch ligvurato shel ish
Vead sheyyakkif zakan hattachton ku tane rabbi chiyya ad sheyyakkif atara ki ata rav dimi amar hakkafat gid velo hakkafat betzim

Amar rav chisda katan sheholid en beno naase ben sorer umore shenneemar ki yihye leish ben leish ben velo leven ben hay mibe leh lechidrav yehuda amar rav im ken lema kera ki yihye ben leish may ki yihye leish ben shema minah lechidrav chisda
Veema kulleh lehachi hu daata im ken nema kera ben ish may leish ben shema minah tarte
Ufliga derabba deamar rabba katan eno molid shenneemar veim en laish goel vechi yesh lecha adam beyisrael sheen lo goel
Ella begezel hagger hakkatuv medabber

a: Veamar rachamana ish ish atta tzarich lachazor alav im yesh lo goalin veim lav katan i atta tzarich lachazor alav beyadua sheen lo goalin
Etiveh abbaye ish en li ella ish ben tesha shanim veom echad sherauy levia minnayin talmud lomar veish
Amar leh yesh lo veeno molid kitvua shello hevia shelish dame
Deve chizkiyya tana vechi yazid ish ish mezid umazria veen katan mezid umazria amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe may mashma dehay mezid lishana devashshole hu dichtiv vayyazed yaakov nazid
Veha tana deve rabbi yishmael ben velo av

Hechi dame ilema deiabbar batar deayeti shette searot veoled mikkamme delakkef zakan mi ika shehut kulle hay veha amar rabbi keruspaday kol yamav shel ben sorer umore eno ella shelosha chodashim bilvad ella lav deiabbar mikkamme delayete shette searot veoled mikkammeh delakkef zakan ushma minah katan moled
La leolam deiabbar batar deayeti shette searot veolid batar deakkef zakan udka kashya derabbi keruspaday ki ata rav dimi amar amri bemareva ben velo harauy likroto av

Gufa amar rabbi keruspaday amar rabbi shabbetay kol yamav shel ben sorer umore enan ella shelosha chodashim bilvad vehaanan tenan mishsheyyavi shette searot vead sheyyakkif zakan hikkif zakan af al gav dela melo shelosha chodashim melo shelosha chodashim af al gav delo hikkif

Yatev rabbi yaakov minnehar pekod kammeh deravina veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derav huna bereh derav yehoshua shema minah midderabbi keruspaday amar rabbi shabbetay yoledet leshiva en ubbarah nikar lishlish yameha
Dei salka datach ubbarah nikar lishlish yameha lema li shelosha bitre vetilta saggi
Amar leh leolam ema lach ubbarah nikar lishlish yameha zil batar rubba
Amruha kammeh derav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar leh uvdine nefashot mi azlinan batar rubba hattora amra veshaftu haeda vehitztzilu haeda veatte amratte zil batar rubba

Ahderuha kammeh deravina amar leh uvdine nefashot la azlinan batar rubba vehatnan echad omer bishnayim bachodesh veechad omer bishlosha edutan kayyemet shezze yodea beiburo shel chodesh veze eno yodea

Vei salka datach la amrinan zil batar rubba nema hane daveka ka mashadi veachchoshe hu deka machchashi ahadade ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba verubba deinashe avidi detau beibura deyarcha
Amar rabbi yirmeya middifti af anan name tenena bat shalosh shanim veom echad mitkaddeshet bevia veim ba aleha yavam kenaah vechayyavin aleha mishshum eshet ish

Umtammea et boalah letamme mishkav hattachton keelon niset lakkohen ochelet bitruma ba aleha echad min happesulin pesalah min hakkehunna veim ba aleha echad mikkol haaraot haamurot betora mumatin aleha vehi petura
b: Ammay ema ayelonit hi veaddata dehachi la kaddesh ella lav deamrinan zil batar rubba verov nashim lav ayelonit ninhu
La may chayyav aleha dekatane korban
Veha mumatin al yadah katane beva aleha aviha
Veha im ba aleha echad mikkol haaraot katane ella hacha bemay askinan dekabbelah ilaveh
Tanu rabbanan hamsolelet bivnah katan veheera bah bet shammay omrim pesalah min hakkehunna uvet hillel machshirin

Amar rabbi chiyya bereh derabba bar nachmani amar rav chisda veamri lah amar rav chisda amar zeeri hakkol modim beven tesha shanim veom echad shebbiato bia pachot mibben shemone sheen biato bia lo nechleku ella beven shemone devet shammay savri gamrinan middorot harishonim uvet hillel savri la gamrinan middorot harishonim

Vedorot harishonim menalan deolid ilema middichtiv halo zot bat sheva bat eliam eshet uriyya hachitti uchtiv eliam ben achitofel haggiloni uchtiv vayyishlach beyad natan hannavi vayyikra et shemo yedidyah baavur ki Adonai ahevo
Uchtiv vayehi lishnatayim yamim vayyihu gozzim leavshalom uchtiv veavshalom barach vayyelech geshura vayehi sham shalosh shanim

Uchtiv vayyeshev avshalom birushalam shenatayim yamim ufne hammelech lo raa uchtiv vayehi mikketz arbaim shana vayyomer avshalom el hammelech elcha na vaashallema et nidri asher nadarti la bechevron uchtiv vaachitofel raa ki lo neesta atzato vayyachavosh et hachamor vayyakom vayyelech el beto veel iro vayetzav el beto vayyechanak

Uchtiv anshe damim umirma lo yechetzu yemehem vetanya kol shenotav shel doeg enan ella sheloshim vearba veshel achitofel enan ella sheloshim veshalosh kamma haveya lehu telatin utlat dal sheva dahava shelomo pash lehu esrim veshet dal tarte shene litlata ibbure ishtechach dechol chad vechad betamne oled
Mimmay dilma tarvayehu bitsha oled uvat sheva olida beshet mishshum deitta barya teda deha havay lah valad meikara

Ella mehacha elle toldot terach terach holid et avram et nachor veet haran veavraham gadol minnachor shana venachor gadol meharan shana nimtza avraham gadol shette shanim meharan uchtiv vayyikkach avram venachor lahem nashim vego

Veamar rabbi yitzchak yiska zo sara velamma nikra shemah yiska shessocha beruach hakkodesh vehayenu dichtiv kol asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah davar acher yiska shehakkol sachim beofyah uchtiv vayyippol avraham al panav vayyitzchak vayyomer belibbo vego kamma kashshish avraham missara asar shenin vekashshish meavuh tarten shenin ishtechach ki oldah haran lesara betamne oldah
Mimmay dilma avraham zuta daachuh hava vederech chochmatan ka chashev lehu

Teda deka chashev lehu kera derech chochmatan uchtiv vayehi noach ben chamesh meot shana vayyoled noach et shem et cham veet yafet shem gadol mecham shana vecham gadol miyyefet shana nimtza shem gadol miyyefet shette shanim uchtiv venoach ben shesh meot shana vehammabbul haya mayim al haaretz uchtiv veelle toldot shem shem ben meat shana vayyoled et arpachshad shenatayim achar hammabbul ben mea shana bar mea vetarten shenin hava
Ella derech chochmatan ka chashev lehu hacha name derech chochmatan ka chashev lehu

Ella menalan mehacha uvtzalel ben uri ven chur lematte yehuda uchtiv vattamot azuva eshet kalev vayyikkach lo chalev et efrat vatteled lo et chur vechi avad betzalel mishkan bar kamma have bar telesar dichtiv ish ish mimmelachto asher hemma osim vetanya shana rishona asa moshe mishkan sheniyya hekim mishkan veshalach meraggelim

Ben velo bat tanya amar rabbi shimon bedin hu shettehe bat reuya lihot keven sorer umore

Matni meematay chayyav mishsheyyochal tartemar basar veyishte chatzi log yayin haitalki rabbi yose omer mane basar velog yayin

Achal bachavurat mitzva achal beibur hachodesh achal maaser sheni birushalayim achal nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim achal tevel umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu
