Gema amar rabbi zera tartemar ze eni yodea mahu ella mittoch shekkafal rabbi yose beyayin nimtza kofel af babbasar venimtza tartemar chatzi mane
Amar rav chanan bar molada amar rav huna eno chayyav ad sheyyikkach basar bezol veyochal yayin bezol veyishte dichtiv zolel vesove

Veamar rav chanan bar molada amar rav huna eno chayyav ad sheyyochal basar chay veyishte yayin chay ini veha rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu achal basar chay veshata yayin chay eno naase ben sorer umore amar ravina yayin chay mezig vela mezig basar chay beshil vela beshil kivsar kiva deachli gannave

Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu achal basar maliach veshata yayin miggito en naase ben sorer umore tenan hatam erev tisha beav lo yochal adam shene tavshilin velo yochal basar velo yishte yayin vetana aval ochel hu basar maliach veshote yayin miggitto
Bevasar maliach ad kamma amar rabbi chanina bar kahana kol zeman shehu kishlamim
Veyayin miggito ad kamma kol zeman shehu toses vehatanya yayin toses en bo mishshum giluy vechamma tesisato shelosha yamim
Hacha may hatam mishshum simcha hu kol zeman shehu kishlamim name it beh simcha hacha mishshum imshoche hu uvchal shehu la mimshich veyayin ad arbaim yom
Amar rav chanan lo nivra yayin baolam ella lenachem avelim ulshallem sachar larshaim shenneemar tenu shechar leoved veyayin lemare nafesh

Amar rabbi yitzchak may dichtiv al tere yayin ki yitaddam al tere yayin shemmaadim penehem shel reshaim baolam hazze umalbin penehem laolam habba rava amar al tere yayin ki yitaddam al tere yayin sheacharito dam
Rav kahana rame ketiv tirash vekarenan tirosh zacha naase rosh lo zacha naase rash
Rava rame ketiv yeshammach vekarenan yesammach zacha mesammecho lo zacha meshammemehu vehayenu deamar rava chamra verechane pakkachin

Amar rav amram bereh derabbi shimon bar abba amar rabbi chanina may dichtiv lemi oy lemi avoy lemi medanim lemi siach lemi petzaim chinnam lemi chachlilut enayim vego lamacharim al hayyayin labbaim lachkor mimsach ki ata rav dimi amar amri bemareva hay kera man dedaresh leh meresheh lesefeh midderish umissefeh leresheh midderish

Daresh over galilaa shelosh esre vavin neemar bayyayin vayyachel noach ish haadama vayyitta karem vayyeshte min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal betoch oholo vayyar cham avi chenaan et ervat aviv vayyagged lishne echav bachutz vayyikkach shem vayefet et hassimla vayyasimu al shechem shenehem vayyelchu achorannit vayechassu et ervat avihem ufnehem vego vayyiketz noach miyyeno vayyeda et asher asa lo beno hakkatan
Rav ushmuel chad amar serso vechad amar revao
Man deamar serso mittoch shekkilkelo barvii killelo barvii uman deamar revao gamar vayyar vayyar ketiv hacha vayyar cham avi chenaan et ervat aviv uchtiv hatam vayyar otah shechem ben chamor vego
Bishlama leman deamar serso mishshum hachi killelo barvii ella leman deamar revao may shena revii nilteyeh behedya ha veha havay

Vayyachel noach ish haadama vayyitta karem amar rav chisda amar rav ukva veamri lah mar ukva amar rabbi zakkay amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lenoach noach lo haya lecha lilmod meadam harishon shello garam lo ella yayin keman deamar oto ilan sheachal mimmennu adam harishon gefen haya
Detanya rabbi meir omer oto ilan sheachal adam harishon mimmennu gefen haya
b: Sheen lecha davar shemmevi yelala leadam ella yayin rabbi yehuda omer chitta haya sheen hattinok yodea likro abba veima ad sheyyitom taam dagan rabbi nechemya omer teena haya shebbaddavar shekkilkelu bo nitkenu shenneemar vayyitperu ale teena

Divre lemuel melech massa asher yisserattu immo amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay melammed shekkefaattu immo al haammud veamra lo ma beri uma bar bitni ume bar nedaray ma beri hakkol yodim sheavich yere shamayim hava achshav yomru immo garma lo
Uma bar bitni kol hannashim shel bet avicha kevan shemmitabberot shuv enan root pene hammelech vaani dachakti venichnasti kede sheyehe li ben mezoraz umlubban
Uma bar nedaray kal nashim shel bet avicha hau nodrot yehe li ben hagun lammalchut vaani nadarti veamarti yehe li ben zariz ummulla battora vehagun linviut

Al lamlachim lemoel al lamlachim sheto yayin al lamlachim amra lo ma lecha etzel melachim sheshshotim yayin umishtakkerim veomrim lamma lanu el ulroznim e shechar mi shekkol raze olam geluyim lo yishte yayin veyishtakker ika deamri mi shekkol rozne olam mashkimin lefitcho yishte yayin veyishtakker

Amar rabbi yitzchak minnayin shechazar shelomo vehoda leimmo dichtiv ki vaar anochi meish velo vinat adam li ki vaar anochi meish minnoach dichtiv vayyachel noach ish haadama velo vinat adam li ze adam harishon
Achal bachavurat mitzva amar rabbi avahu eno chayyav ad sheyyochal bachavura shekkullah serikin

Vehaanan tenan achal bachavurat mitzva eno naase ben sorer umore tama demitzva ha lav mitzva af al gav delav kullah serikin ha ka mashma lan deaf al gav dechullah serikin kevan divmitzva ka asek la mimshich

Achal beibur hachodesh lememra devasar veyayin masseku vehatanya en olin lah ella befat dagan vekitnit bilvad ha ka mashma lan af al gav deen olin lah ella befat vekitnit veihu assek basar veyayin vaachal kevan divmitzva ka asek la mimmeshich

Tanu rabbanan en olin beibur hachodesh pachot measara bene adam veen olin lah ella befat dagan vekitnit veen olin lah ella leor iburo veen olin lah bayyom ella ballayela vehatanya en olin lah ballayela ella bayyom kedaamar rabbi chiyya bar abba livneh achrifu veulu achrifu ufuku ki hechi delishmeu bechu inashe
Achal maaser sheni birushalayim kevan dechi orcheh hu ka achel leh la mimmeshich
Achal nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim amar rava achal besar of eno naase ben sorer umore
Veha anan tenan achal nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim eno naase ben sorer umore ha tehorin naase ben sorer umore ki tenan name matnitin lehashlim
Achal davar shehu mitzva udvar avera devar mitzva tanchume avelim devar avera taanit tzibur
Vetama may amar kera enennu shomea bekolenu bekolenu velo bekolo shel makom
Achal kol maachal velo achal basar shata kol mashke velo shata yayin vechu achal kol maachal velo achal basar leetoye devela keilit shata kol mashke velo shata yayin leetoye devash vechalav
Detanya achal devela keilit veshata devash vechalav venichnas lammikdash

a: Chayyav

Eno naase ben sorer umore ad sheyyochal basar veyishte yayin tanu rabbanan achal kol maachal velo achal basar shata kol mashke velo shata yayin eno naase ben sorer umore ad sheyyochal basar veyishte yayin shenneemar zolel vesove

Veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar shenneemar al tehi vesove yayin bezolle vasar lamo veomer ki sove vezolel yivaresh ukraim talbish numa amar rabbi zera kol hayyashen bevet hammidrash torato naaset lo keraim keraim shenneemar ukraim talbish numa

Matni ganav mishshel aviv veachal birshut aviv mishshel acherim veachal birshut acherim mishshel acherim veachal birshut aviv eno naase ben sorer umore ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv veyochal birshut acherim rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv umishshel immo
Gema ganav mishshel aviv veachal birshut aviv af al gav dishchiach leh beit
Mishshel acherim veachal birshut acherim af al gav dela beit la shechiach leh vechol shekken mishshel acherim veachal birshut aviv dela shechiach leh uvit
Ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv veyochal birshut acherim dishchiach leh vela beit
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv umishshel immo immo mena lah ma shekkanta ishsha kana balah amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina misseuda hammuchenet leaviv ulimmo
Vehaamar rabbi chanan bar molada amar rav huna eno chayyav ad sheyyikne basar bezol veyochal yayin bezol veyishte ella ema middeme seuda hammuchenet leaviv ulimmo
Ibaet ema deakni lah acher vaamar lah al menat sheen levalich reshut bahen
Matni haya aviv rotze veimmo enah rotze aviv eno rotze veimmo rotza eno naase ben sorer umore ad sheyehu shenehem rotzin rabbi yehuda omer im lo hayeta immo reuya leaviv eno naase ben sorer umore
Gema may enah reuya ilema chayyave charetot vechayyave mitot bet din sof sof avuh avuh nihu veimmeh immeh nihi

Ella beshava leaviv kaamar tanya name hachi rabbi yehuda omer im lo hayeta immo shava leaviv bekol uvmare uvakkoma eno naase ben sorer umore may tama deamar kera enennu shomea bekolenu middekol baenan shavin mare vekoma name baenan shavin
Keman azla ha detanya ben sorer umore lo haya velo atid lihot velamma nichtav derosh vekabbel sachar keman kerabbi yehuda

Ibaet ema rabbi shimon hi detanya amar rabbi shimon vechi mippene sheachal ze tartemar basar veshata chatzi log yayin haitalki aviv veimmo motziin oto lesoklo ella lo haya velo atid lihot velamma nichtav derosh vekabbel sachar amar rabbi yonatan ani reitiv veyashavti al kivro

Keman azla ha detanya ir hanniddachat lo hayeta velo atida lihot velamma nichteva derosh vekabbel sachar keman kerabbi eliezer detanya rabbi eliezer omer kol ir sheyyesh bah afilu mezuza achat enah naaset ir hanniddachat
May tama amar kera veet kol shelalah tikbotz el toch rechovah vesarafta vaesh vechevan dei ika mezuza la efshar dichtiv lo taasun ken la elohechem amar rabbi yonatan ani reitiha veyashavti al tilah

Keman azla ha detanya bayit hamnugga lo haya velo atid lihot velamma nichtav derosh vekabbel sachar keman kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon ditnan rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer leolam en habbayit tame ad sheyyerae kishte gerisin al shette avanim bishte chetalim bekeren zavit orko kishne gerisin verochbo kigris
May tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon ketiv kir uchtiv kirot ezehu kir shehu kekirot heve omer ze keren zavit

Tanya amar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok makom haya bitchum azza vehau korin oto churbata segirta amar rabbi shimon ish kefar akko paam achat halachti legalil veraiti makom shemmetzayenin oto veamru avanim menuggaot pinu lesham

Matni haya echad mehem gidem o chiger o illem o some o cheresh eno naase ben sorer umore shenneemar vetafsu vo aviv veimmo velo gidmin vehotziu oto velo chiggerin veamru velo illemin benenu ze velo somin enennu shomea bekolenu velo chershin
Matrin bo bifne shelosha umalkin oto chazar vekilkel niddon beesrim ushlosha veeno niskal ad sheyehu sham shelosha harishonim shenneemar benenu ze zehu shellaka bifnechem

Malkut beven sorer umore hecha ketiva kidrabbi avahu deamar rabbi avahu lamadnu veyisseru mivveyisseru veyisseru mibben uven mibbin vehaya im bin hakkot harasha
Chazar vekilkel nidon beesrim ushlosha vechu hay mibe leh ze velo somin im ken lichtov benenu hu may benenu ze shema minah tarte
Matni barach ad shello nigmar dino veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton patur veim mishshennigmar dino barach veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton chayyav
Gema amar rabbi chanina ben noach shebberach et hashshem veachar kach nitgayyer patur hoil venishtanna dino nishtannet mitato
Nema mesayea leh barach ad shello nigmar dino veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton patur may tama lav mishshum deamrinan hoil veishtanni ishtanni
La shane hacha dei avad hashta lav bar ketala hu
Ta shema im mishshennigmar dino barach veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton chayyav nigmar dino kaamratte nigmar dino gavra ketila hu
Ta shema ben noach shehikka et chavero uva al eshet chavero venitgayyer patur asa ken beyisrael venitgayyer chayyav veammay nema hoil veishtanni ishtanni
Dino umitato baenan vehay dino ishtanni mitato la ishtannay

Rabbi shimon savar lah ketanna deve menashshe deamar kol mita haamura livne noach enah ella chenek
Bishlama eshet ish meikara chenek vehashta chenek ella rotzeach meikara chenek vehashta sayif kalla bachamura meshach shayecha

Lema mesayea leh sarcha veachar kach bagra tidon bechenek biskila may tama la lav mishshum dehoil veishtannay ishtanni vechol shekken hacha deishtanni ligmare haamar leh rabbi yochanan letanna teni tidon biskila
Matni ben sorer umore nidon al shem sofo yamut zakkay veal yamut chayyav shemmitatan shel reshaim hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam latztzaddikim ra lahen vera laolam

Matni habba bammachteret nidon al shem sofo haya ba bammachteret veshavar et hechavit im yesh lo damim chayyav im en lo damim patur

Gema amar rava may tama demachteret chazaka en adam maamid atzmo al mamono vehay memar amar i azelna kae leappay vela shavek li vei kae leappay katelna leh vehattora amra im ba lehorgecha hashkem lehorgo
Amar rav habba bammachteret venatal kelim veyatza patur may tama bedamim kenanhu amar rava mistabbera milteh derav besheshshiber deletanhu aval natal la
Vehaelohim amar rav afilu natal deha yesh lo damim veneensu chayyav alma birshuteh kayemi hacha name birshuteh kayemi
Vela hi ki okminhu rachamana birshuteh leinyan onasin aval leinyan mikna birshuteh demarayehu kayemi mide dehave ashshoel
Tenan ba bammachteret veshiber et hechavit yesh lo damim chayyav en lo damim patur tama deshiber dechi en lo damim patur ha natal la
Hu haddin daafilu natal name veha deka tane shavar et hechavit ka mashma lan dechi yesh lo damim af al gav deshiber name chayyav
Peshita mazzik hu ha ka mashma lan daafilu shello bechavana may ka mashma lan adam muad leolam tenena adam muad leolam ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon kashya
Metiv rav bivi bar abbaye haggonev kis beshabbat chayyav shehare nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide isur shabbat
Haya megarer veotze patur shehare isur geneva veisur sekila bain keechad
Vehilcheta dishdanhu benahara
Rava ignavu leh dichre bemachtarta ahderinhu nihaleh vela kabbelinhu amar hoil unfak mippummeh derav
Tanu rabbanan en lo damim im zarcha hashshemesh alav vechi hashshemesh alav bilvad zarcha ella im barur lecha haddavar kashshemesh sheen lo shalom immecha horgehu veim lav al tahregehu
Tanya idach im zarcha hashshemesh alav damim lo vechi hashshemesh alav bilvad zarcha ella im barur lecha kashshemesh sheyyesh lo shalom immecha al tahargehu veim lav horgehu kashya setama assetama

b: Kan beav al habben kan beven al haav

Amar rav kol deate alay bemachtarta katelna leh levar merav chanina bar shela may tama ilema mishshum detzaddik hu ha kaate bemachtarta ella mishshum dekim li begaveyh dimrachem alay kerachem av al habben
Tanu rabbanan damim lo ben bachol ben bashshabbat en lo damim ben bachol ben bashshabbat

Bishlama en lo damim ben bachol ben bashshabbat itzterich salka datach amena mide dehave aharuge bet din divshabbat la katlinan ka mashma lan dekatlinan ella damim lo ben bachol ben bashshabbat hashta bachol la katlinan leh bashshabbat mibbaya
Amar rav sheshet la nitzrecha ella lefakkeach alav et haggal

Tanu rabbanan vehukka bechol adam vamet bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito bishlama vehukka bechol adam itzterich salka datach amena baal habbayit hu dekim leho deen adam maamid atzmo al mamono aval acher la
Ka mashma lan derodef hu vaafilu acher name ella vamet bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito lema li

Merotzeach nafka detanya mot yumat hammakke rotzeach hu en li ella bemita haamura bo uminnayin sheim i atta yachol lahamito bemita hakketuva bo sheatta rashshay lahamito bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito talmud lomar mot yumat mikkol makom
Shane hatam deamar kera mot yumat

Tanya idach machteret en li ella machteret gaggo chatzero vekarpefo minnayin talmud lomar yimmatze haggannav mikkol makom im ken ma talmud lomar machteret machtarto zo hi hatraato
Amar rav huna katan harodef nitan lehatztzilo benafsho kasavar rodef eno tzarich hatraa la shena gadol vela shena katan
Etiveh rav chisda lerav huna yatza rosho en nogin bo lefi sheen dochin nefesh mippene nefesh veammay rodef hu shane hatam demishshemayya ka radfi lah

Nema mesayya leh rodef shehaya rodef achar chavero lehorgo omrin lo ree sheyyisrael hu uven berit hu vehattora amra shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech amra tora hatztzel damo shel ze bedamo shel ze
Hahi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi detanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer chaver en tzarich hatraa lefi shello nitna hatraa ella lehavchin ben shogeg lemezid

Ibaet ema amar lecha rav huna ana daamari ketanna demachteret deamar machtarto zo hi hatraato

a: Matni veellu hen shemmatztzilin otan benafshan harodef achar chavero lehorgo veachar hazzachar veachar hannaara hamorasa aval harodef achar behema vehamchallel et hashshabbat veoved avoda zara en matztzilin otan benafshan

Gema tanu rabbanan minnayin lerodef achar chavero lehorgo shennitan lehatztzilo benafsho talmud lomar lo taamod al dam reecha veha lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidtanya minnayin laroe et chavero shehu tovea bannahar o chayya gorarto o listin bain alav shehu chayyav lehatztzilo talmud lomar lo taamod al dam reecha in hachi name

Veella nitan lehatztzilo benafsho menalan atya bekal vachomer minnaara hamorasa ma naara hamorasa shello ba ella lefogmah amra tora nitan lehatztzilah benafsho rodef achar chavero lehorgo al achat kamma vechamma
Vechi onshin min haddin deve rabbi tana hekkesha hu ki kaasher yakum ish al reehu urtzacho nefesh vechi ma lamadnu merotzeach
Meatta hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed makkish rotzeach lenaara hamorasa ma naara hamorasa nitan lehatztzilah benafsho af rotzeach nitan lehatztzilo benafsho
Venaara meorasa gufah menalan kidtana deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael veen moshia lah ha yesh moshia lah bechol davar sheyyachol lehoshia

Gufa minnayin laroe et chavero shehu tovea bannahar o chayya gorarto o listin bain alav shehu chayyav lehatztzilo talmud lomar lo taamod al dam reecha veha mehacha nafka mehatam nafka avedat gufo minnayin talmud lomar vahashevoto lo
I mehatam hava amena hane mile benafsheh aval mitrach umegar agore ema la ka mashma lan

Tanu rabbanan echad harodef achar chavero lehorgo veachar hazzachar veachar naara hamorasa veachar chayyave mitot bet din veachar chayyave charetot matztzilin otan benafsho almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot en matztzilin otan benafsho
Neevda bah avera en matztzilin otah benafsho yesh lah moshia en matztzilin otah benafsho rabbi yehuda omer af haomeret hannichu lo shello yahargenna
Mena hane mile amar kera velannaara lo taase davar en lannaara chet mavet naar ze zechur naara zo naara hamorasa chet ellu chayyave charetot mavet ellu chayyave mitot bet din
Kol hane lema li tzerichi dei ketav rachamana naar mishshum delav orcheh aval naara deorchah ema la

Velichtov rachamana chet mavet vela bae naar venaara in hachi name veella naar naara chad lemaote oved avoda zara vechad lemaote behema veshabbat

Rabbi yehuda omer af haomeret hannichu lo shello yahargenna bemay kamipalgi

Amar rava bemakpedet al pigmah umannichato shello yahargenna rabbanan savri appigma kafed rachamana vahare makpedet al pigmah verabbi yehuda hay dekaamar rachamana katleh mishshum demasra nafshah liktala ha la masra nafshah liktala
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye almana lechohen gadol name ka fagem lah amar leh appigma rabba kafed rachamana appigma zuta la kafed rachamana
Chet ellu chayyave charetot urminhu veellu nearot sheyyesh lahen kenas habba al achoto
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav chisda mishsheat haaraa defagmah iptar leh mikketala mamona la meshallem ad gemar bia
Hanicha leman deamar haaraa zo neshika ella leman deamar haaraa zo hachnasat atara may ika lememar

May tama derabbi yonatan ben shaul dichtiv vechi yinnatzu anashim yachdav vego veamar rabbi elazar bematztzut shebbemita hakkatuv medabbar dichtiv veim ason yihye venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh vaafilu hachi amar rachamana velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh
I amratte bishlama yachol lehatztzil beechad meevarav lo nitan lehatztzilo benafsho hayenu demashkachatte lah deyeanesh kegon sheyyachol lehatztzil beechad meevarav
Ella i amratte yachol lehatztzil beechad meevarav name nitan lehatztzilo benafsho hechi mashkachatte lah deyeanesh
Dilma shane hacha demita laze vetashlumin laze
La shena deamar rava rodef shehaya rodef achar chavero veshiber et hakkelim ben shel nirdof uven shel kol adam patur may tama mitchayyev benafsho hu
Venirdof sheshshiber et hakkelim shel rodef patur shel kol adam chayyav shel rodef patur shello yehe mamono chaviv alav miggufo shel kol adam chayyav shemmatztzil atzmo bemamon chavero

Verodef shehaya rodef achar rodef lehatztzilo veshiber et hakkelim ben shel rodef ben shel nirdof ben shel kol adam patur velo min haddin sheim i atta omer ken nimtza en lach kol adam shemmatztzil et chavero miyyad harodef

Aval harodef achar behema tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer haoved avoda zara nitan lehatztzilo benafsho mikkal vachomer uma pegam hedot nitan lehatztzilo benafsho pegam gavoha lo kol shekken vechi onshin min haddin ka savar onshin min haddin
Tanya rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer hamchallel et hashshabbat nitan lehatztzilo benafsho savar lah kaavuh deamar onshin min haddin veatya shabbat bechilul chilul meavoda zara

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak nimnu vegamru baaliyyat bet natteza belod kol averot shebbattora im omrin laadam avor veal tehareg yaavor veal yehareg chutz meavoda zara vegiluy araot ushfichut damim
Vaavoda zara la veha tanya amar rabbi yishmael minnayin sheim amru lo laadam avod avoda zara veal tehareg minnayin sheyyaavod veal yehareg talmud lomar vachay bahem velo sheyyamut bahem
Yachol afilu befarhesya talmud lomar velo techallelu et shem kodshi venikdashti

Inhu daamur kerabbi eliezer detanya rabbi eliezer omer veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha uvchol nafshecha uvchol meodecha im neemar bechol nafshecha lamma neemar bechol meodecha veim neemar bechol meodecha lamma neemar bechol nafshecha
Im yesh lecha adam sheggufo chaviv alav mimmamono lechach neemar bechol nafshecha veim yesh lach adam shemmamono chaviv alav miggufo lechach neemar bechol meodecha
Giluy araot ushfichut damim kidrabbi detanya rabbi omer ki kaasher yakum ish al reehu urtzacho nefesh ken haddavar hazze vechi ma lamadnu merotzeach
Meatta hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed makkish rotzeach lenaara hamorasa ma naara hamorasa nitan lehatztzilo benafsho af rotzeach nitan lehatztzilo benafsho
Umakkish naara hamorasa lerotzeach ma rotzeach yehareg veal yaavor af naara hamorasa tehareg veal taavor

Rotzeach gufeh mena lan sevara hu dehahu daata lekammeh derabba vaamar leh amar li mare duray zil katleh liflanya vei la katelna lach amar leh liktelucha vela tiktol mi yemar didma didach summak tefe dilma dema dehu gavra summak tefe
