Neemar kan zimma veneemar lehallan zimma ma lehallan bittah uvat bittah uvat benah af kan bittah uvat bittah uvat benah
Minnayin laasot zecharim kinkevot neemar kan zimma veneemar lehallan zimma ma lehallan zecharim kinkevot af kan zecharim kinkevot
Minnayin laasot lematta kilmala neemar kan zimma veneemar lehallan zimma ma lehallan lematta kilmala af kan lematta kilmala uma kan lemala kilmatta af lehallan lemala kilmatta
Amar mar minnayin laasot zecharim kinkevot may zecharim kinkevot ilema bat benah kevat bittah bahade hadade kaatyan
Ella em chamiv keem chamoto hashta em chamoto la kama lan em chamiv mihdar alah
b: Amar abbaye hachi kaamar minnayin laasot sheer habba mimmennu kisher habba mimmenna neemar kan zimma veneemar lehallan zimma vechu veha bisher dideh la ketiva beh zimma
Amar rava amar li rav yitzchak bar avudimi atya henna henna atya zimma zimma
Amar mar minnayin laasot lematta kilmala may lematta kilmala ilema bat benah uvat bittah kevittah bahade hadade kaatyan
Ella em chamiv veem chamoto kachamoto hay lematta kilmala lemala kilmatta hu teni lemala kilmatta
I hachi neemar kan zimma veneemar lehallan zimma uma hashta inhi la ketiva zimma didhu ketiva
Amar abbaye hachi kaamar minnayin laasot shelosha dorot lemala kishlosha dorot lematta neemar lematta zimma veneemar lemala zimma ma lematta shelosha dorot af lemala shelosha dorot
Uma baonesh asa lematta kilmala af baazhara name asa lemala kilmatta
Rav ashe amar leolam kidkatane umay lematta lematta beisur
I ma hi em immah asura af hu em immo asura
Amar abbaye amar kera immecha hi mishshum immo atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum em immo
Rava amar ben leman deamar dun minah uminah uven leman deamar dun minah veoke veatrah la atya
Leman deamar dun minah uminah ma hi em immah asura af hu name em immo asura uminah ma hi bisrefa af hu name bisrefa
Leman deamar serefa chamura ika lemifrach ma lehi shekken immah bisrefa tomar behu sheimmo biskila
Veod immo biskila em immo bisrefa
Veod ma hi lo chillakta bah ben immah leem immah af hu name la tachlok bo ben immo leem immo
Ulman deamar sekila chamura mehay kushya la nedunah
Ulman deamar dun minah veoke veatrah ma hi em immah asura af hu name em immo asura veoke beatrah hatam hu devisrefa aval hacha biskila kidashkechan beimmo
Leman deamar serefa chamura ika lemifrach

a: Ma lehi shekken immah bisrefa tomar behu sheimmo biskila
Veod hu kehi ma hi lo chillakta bah ben bittah leem immah af hu lo tachlok bo ben bitto leem immo
Ulman deamar sekila chamura mehay kushya la nedunah
I ma hu kallato asura af hi kallatah asura
Amar abbaye amar kera eshet bincha hi mishshum eshet bincha atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum eshet benah
Rava amar ben leman deamar dun minah uminah ben leman deamar dun minah veoke veatrah la atya
Leman deamar dun minah uminah ma hu kallato asura af hi name kallatah asura uminah ma hu biskila af hi name biskila
Leman deamar sekila chamura ika lemifrach ma lehu shekken immo biskila tomar behi sheimmah bisrefa
Veod bittah bisrefa vechallatah biskila hu beatzmo yochiach devitto bisrefa vechallato biskila
Ella ma hu lo chillakta bo ben immo lechallato af hi lo tachlok bah ben immah lechallatah ulman deamar serefa chamura mehay kushya la nedunen
Ulman deamar dun minah veoke veatrah ma hu kallato asura af hi kallatah asura veoke beatrah hatam hu deviskila aval hacha bisrefa kidashkechan beimmah
Leman deamar sekila chamura ika lemifrach ma lehu shekken immo biskila tomar behi sheimmah bisrefa
Veod ma hu chillakta bo ben bitto lechallato af hi tachlok bah ben bittah lechallatah ulman deamar name serefa chamura mehay kushya la nedunen
Bitto meanusato minnayin haamar abbaye kal vachomer al bat bitto anush al bitto lo kol shekken
Vechi onshin min haddin galloye milta vealma hu
Rava amar amar li rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi atya henna henna atya zimma zimma
Tane avuh derabbi avin lefi shello lamadnu levitto meanusato hutzrach hakkatuv lomar uvat ish kohen
I ma bat kohen hi bisrefa veen boalah bisrefa af bitto meanusato hi bisrefa veen boalah bisrefa
Amar abbaye amar kera et aviha hi mechallelet mi shemmechallelet et aviha yatzta zo sheaviha mechallelah
Rava amar bishlama hatam appekteh middina devat kohen veokemteh addina devat yisrael hacha addina deman mokmatte leh addina difnuya mokmatte leh
Azhara levitto meanusato minnayin bishlama leabbaye verava mehecha denafka lehu onesh mehatam nafka lehu azhara
Ella lidtane avuh derabbi avin may amar rabbi ila amar kera al techallel et bittecha lehaznotah

Matkef lah rabbi yaakov achuh derav acha bar yaakov hay al techallel et bittecha lehaznotah lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidtanya al techallel et bittecha lehaznotah yachol bechohen hammassi et bitto lelevi veyisrael hakkatuv medabber talmud lomar lehaznotah bechilul shebbiznut hakkatuv medabber bemoser et bitto shello leshem ishut
Im ken lema kera al tachel may al techallel shema minah tarte veabbaye verava hay al techallel et bittecha lehaznotah may avdi leh amar rabbi mani ze hammassi et bitto lezaken
Kidtanya al techallel et bittecha lehaznotah rabbi eliezer omer ze hammassi et bitto lezaken rabbi akiva omer ze hammashhe bitto bogeret
Amar rav kahana mishshum rabbi akiva en lecha ani beyisrael ella rasha arum vehammashhe bitto bogeret attu hammashhe bitto bogeret lav rasha arum hu
Amar abbaye
b: Hachi kaamar ezehu ani rasha arum ze hammashhe bitto bogeret veamar rav kahana mishshum rabbi akiva heve zahir min hayyoetzcha lefi darko
Amar rav yehuda amar rav hammassi et bitto lezaken vehammassi ishsha livno katan vehammachzir aveda lenochri alav hakkatuv omer lemaan sefot harava et hatztzemea lo yove Adonai seloach lo

Metivi haohev et ishto kegufo vehamchabbedah yoter miggufo vehammadrich banav uvnotav bederech yeshara vehammassian samuch lefirkan alav hakkatuv omer veyadata ki shalom oholecha ufakadta navecha velo techeta samuch lefirkan shane
Tanu rabbanan haohev et shechenav vehamkarev et kerovav vehannose et bat achoto vehammalve sela leani bishat dochko alav hakkatuv omer az tikra va yaane
Tanu rabbanan oto veethen oto veet achat mehen divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer oto veet shettehen
May benayehu amar abbaye mashmaut dorshim ika benayehu

Rabbi yishmael savar oto veethen oto veet achat mehen shekken belashon yevani korin leachat hina veem chamoto midderasha atya rabbi akiva savar oto veethen oto veet shettehen veem chamoto hacha ketiva
Rava amar chamoto leachar mita ika benayehu rabbi yishmael savar chamoto leachar mita bisrefa verabbi akiva savar isura bealma
Matni veellu hanneheragin harotzeach veanshe ir hanniddachat
Rotzeach shehikka et reehu beeven o bevarzel vechavash alav letoch hammayim o letoch haur veeno yachol laalot mishsham vamet chayyav
Dechafo letoch hammayim o letoch haur veyachol laalot mishsham vamet patur shisa bo et hakkelev shisa bo et hannachash patur hishshich bo et hannachash rabbi yehuda mechayyev vachachamim potrin
Gema amar shemuel mippene ma lo neemra yad babbarzel shehabbarzel memit bechol shehu
Tanya name hachi rabbi omer galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam shehabbarzel memit bechol shehu lefichach lo natna tora bo shiur vehane mile devarzeh mivraz

Vechavash alav letoch hammayim resha revuta ka mashma lan vesefa revuta ka mashma lan resha revuta ka mashma lan af al gav delav ihu dechafo kevan deen yachol laalot mishsham vamet chayyav sefa revuta ka mashma lan af al gav didchafo kevan deyachol laalot mishsham vamet patur
Kavash menalan amar shemuel deamar kera o veeva lerabbot et hamtzamtzem
Hahu gavra detzamtzemah lecheveta dechavreh beshimsha umita ravina mechayyev rav acha bar rav patar
Ravina mechayyev kal vachomer uma rotzeach shello asa bo shogeg kemezid veones keratzon chiyyev bo et hamtzamtzem

a: Nezakin sheasa bahen shogeg kemezid veones keratzon eno din shechiyyev bahen et hamtzamtzem
Rav acha bar rav poter amar rav mesharsheya may tama daavuh deabba defoter amar kera mot yumat hammakke rotzeach hu berotzeach hu dechayyev lan metzamtzem binzakin la chayyev lan metzamtzem
Amar rava kefato umet baraav patur veamar rava kefato bachamma vamet betzina vamet chayyav sof chamma lavo sof tzina lavo patur
Veamar rava kefato lifne ari patur lifne yattushin chayyav rav ashe amar afilu lifne yattushin name patur hane azli vehane atu
Itmar kafa alav gigit ufara alav maaziva rava verabbi zera chad amar chayyav vechad amar patur
Tistayyam derava hu deamar patur deamar rava kefato umet baraav patur
Adderabba tistayyem derabbi zera hu deamar patur deamar rabbi zera hay man deayeleh lechavreh beveta deshesha veadlek leh sheraga vamet chayyav tama deadlek leh sheraga ha la adlek leh sheraga la
Amri hatam bela sheraga la matchel havla
b: Beshateh hacha bela sheraga name matchel havla beshateh
Siman sullam teris sammanin bakkotel
Amar rava dechafo levor vesullam babbor uva acher vesilko vaafilu hu kadam vesilko patur dividana deshadyeh yachol laalot hu
Veamar rava zarak chetz utris beyado uva acher untalo vaafilu hu kadam untalo patur dividana deshadyeh beh mifsak pesiki gireh
Veamar rava zarak bo chetz vesammanin beyado uva acher ufizran vaafilu hu kadam ufizran patur dividana dishda beh yachol lehitrappeot hava
Amar rav ashe hilkach afilu sammanin bashshuk amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe nizdammenu lo sammanin mahu amar leh hare yatza mibbet din zakkay
Veamar rava zarak tzeror bakkotel vechazra laachoreha veharga chayyav vetanna tuna kegon ellu hamsachakin bechaddur shehargu bemezid neheragin beshogeg golin
Beshogeg golin peshita bemezid neheragin itzterich leh mahu detema hatraat safek hi mi yemar dehadra ka mashma lan
Tane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu kegon ellu hamsachakin bechaddur shehargu toch arba ammot patur chutz learba ammot chayyav
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe hechi dame i deka nicha leh afilu purta name i dela nicha leh afilu tuva name la amar leh setam mesachakin bechaddur kamma deayeli tefe menach nicha leh
Lememra dichhay gavena kocho hu urminhu hamkaddesh venafal kidush al yado o al hatztzad veachar kach nafal leshoket pasul
Hacha bemay askinan beshotet
Ta shema machat shehaya netuna al hacheres vehizza aleha safek al hammachat hizza safek al hacheres hizza umitza aleha hazzaato pasul
Amar rav chinana bar yehuda mishshemeh derav matza itmar
Amar rav pappa hay man dechafteh lechavreh veashkel aleh bidka demayya gire dideh hu umichayyav hane mile bechoach rishon aval bechoach sheni gerama bealma hu
Veamar rav pappa zarak tzeror lemala vehalcha litzdadin veharga chayyav amar leh mar bar rav ashe lerav pappa may tama mishshum dechocho hu i kocho tezil leel

a: Vei lav kocho hu tezil letachat ella koach kachush hu
Tanu rabbanan hikkuhu asara bene adam baasara maklot vamet ben bevat achat ben beze achar ze peturin rabbi yehuda ben betira omer beze achar ze haacharon chayyav mippene shekkerav et mitato
Amar rabbi yochanan ushnehem mikra echad darshu veish ki yakke kol nefesh adam rabbanan savri kal nefesh ad deika kol nefesh verabbi yehuda ben betira savar kol nefesh kol dehu nefesh
Amar rava hakkol modim behoreg et hatterefa shehu patur begoses bide shamayim shehu chayyav lo nechleku ella begoses bide adam mar medamme leh litrefa umar medamme leh legoses bide shamayim
Man dimdamme leh litrefa may tama la medamme leh legoses bide shamayim goses bide shamayim la itavid beh maase hay itavid beh maase
Uman dimdamme leh legoses bide shamayim may tama la medamme leh litrefa terefa mechattechi simanim ha la mechattechi simanim
Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet veish ki yakke kol nefesh adam lehavi hammakke et chavero veen bo kede lehamit uva acher vehemito shehu chayyav
En bo kede lehamit peshita ella yesh bo kede lehamit uva acher vehemito shehu chayyav ustama kerabbi yehuda ben betira
Amar rava hahoreg et hatterefa patur utrefa sheharag bifne bet din chayyav shello bifne bet din patur
Bifne bet din may tama chayyav dichtiv uviarta hara mikkirbecha shello bifne bet din patur dehaveya lah edut shei atta yachol lahazimah vechol edut shei atta yachol lahazimah lo shemah edut

Veamar rava harovea et hatterefa chayyav terefa sherava bifne bet din chayyav shello bifne bet din patur bifne bet din chayyav dichtiv uviarta hara mikkirbecha shello bifne bet din patur dehaveya lah edut shei atta yachol lahazimah
Ha tu lema li hayenu hach harovea et hatterefa itztericha leh mahu detema leheve keman dimshammesh met veliptar ka mashma lan demishshum hanaa hu veha it leh hanaa
Veamar rava edim sheheidu bitrefa vehuzzammu en neheragin ede terefa shehuzzammu neheragin rav ashe amar afilu ede terefa shehuzzammu en neheragin lefi sheenan bezomme zommin

Veamar rava shor terefa sheharag chayyav veshor shel adam terefa sheharag patur may tama amar kera hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat kol hecha dekarena beh vegam bealav yumat karenan beh hashshor yissakel vechol hecha dela karenan beh vegam bealav yumat la karenan beh hashshor yissakel
Rav ashe amar afilu shor terefa name sheharag patur may tama kevan deilu bealim hao petiri shor name patur
Shisa bo et hakkelev vechu amar rav acha bar yaakov keshettimtza lomar ledivre rabbi yehuda eres nachash ben shinav hu omed lefichach makkish besayif venachash patur
Ledivre chachamim eres nachash meatzmo hu meki lefichach nachash biskila vehammakkish patur
Matni hammakke et chavero ben beeven ben beegrof vaamaduhu lemita vehekel mimma shehaya ulachar mikkan hichbid vamet chayyav rabbi nechemya omer patur sheraglayim laddavar
Gema tanu rabbanan et zo darash rabbi nechemya im yakum vehithallech bachutz
b: Al mishanto venikka hammakke vechi taale al datecha shezze mehallech bashshuk veze neherag ella ze sheamaduhu lemita vehekel mimma shehaya ulachar kach hichbid vamet shehu patur
Verabbanan hay venikka hammakke may darshi beh melammed shechovshin oto
Verabbi nechemya chavisha mena leh yalef mimmekoshesh
Verabbanan name lelfu mimmekoshesh mekoshesh bar ketala hu umoshe la hava yada ketaleh bemay leappoke hay dela yadinan i bar ketala hu i lav bar ketala hu
Verabbi nechemya yalef mimmegaddef dela hava yada i bar ketala hu vechavshuh
Verabbanan megaddef horaat shaa hayeta

Kidtanya yodea haya moshe rabbenu shehamkoshesh bemita shenneemar mechalleleha mot yumat ella lo haya yodea beezo mita neherag shenneemar ki lo forash vego aval megaddef lo neemar bo ella lifrosh lahem al pi Adonai shello haya moshe yodea im hu ben mita kol ikar im lav
Bishlama lerabbi nechemya hayenu dichtivi tere umdane chad amaduhu lemita vechaya vechad amaduhu lemita vehekel mimma shehaya ella lerabbanan tere umdane lema li
Chad amaduhu lemita vechaya vechad amaduhu lechayyim vamet
Verabbi nechemya amaduhu lechayyim vamet la tzerich kera shehare yatza mibbet din zakkay

Tanu rabbanan hammakke et chavero vaamaduhu lemita vechaya potrin oto amaduhu lemita vehekel mimma shehaya omdin oto omed sheni lemamon veim leachar ken hichbid vamet hallech achar omed haemtzai divre rabbi nechemya vachachamim omrim en omed achar omed

Tanya idach amaduhu lemita omdin oto lechayyim lechayyim en omdin oto lemita amaduhu lemita vehekel mimma shehaya omdin oto omed sheni lemamon veim leachar ken hichbid vamet meshallem nezek vatzaar layyorshim
Meematay meshallem mishshaa shehikkahu ustama kerabbi nechemya
Matni nitkaven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam lannochri veharag et yisrael lannefalim veharag et ben kayyama patur
Nitkaven lehakkoto al motnav velo haya bah kede lahamito al motnav vehalcha lah al libbo vehaya bah kede lahamito al libbo vamet patur nitkaven lehakkoto al libbo

a: Vehaya bah kede lehamit al libbo vehalcha lah al motnav velo haya bah kede lehamit al motnav vamet patur

Nitkaven lehakkot et haggadol velo haya bah kede lehamit haggadol vehalcha lah al hakkatan vehaya bah kede lehamit et hakkatan vamet patur nitkaven lehakkot et hakkatan vehaya bah kede lehamit et hakkatan vehalcha lah al haggadol velo haya bah kede lehamit et haggadol vamet patur

Aval nitkaven lehakkot al motnav vehaya bah kede lehamit al motnav vehalcha lah al libbo vamet chayyav nitkaven lehakkot et haggadol vehaya bah kede lehamit et haggadol vehalcha lah al hakkatan vamet chayyav rabbi shimon omer afilu nitkaven laharog et ze veharag et ze patur
Gema rabbi shimon aheya ilema assefa rabbi shimon poter mibe leh

Ella aresha nitkaven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam lannochri veharag et yisrael lannefalim veharag et ben kayyama patur ha nitkaven laharog et ze veharag et ze chayyav rabbi shimon omer afilu nitkaven laharog et ze veharag et ze patur

Peshita kae reuven veshimon veamar ana liruven ka mikavana leshimon la ka mikavana hayenu pelugtayehu amar lechad minayehu may i name kesavur reuven venimtza shimon may ta shema detanya rabbi shimon omer ad sheyyomar lifloni ani mitkaven
May tama derabbi shimon amar kera vearav lo vekam alav ad sheyyitkaven lo verabbanan amri deve rabbi yannay perat lezorek even lego
Hechi dame ilema deika tisha goyim veechad yisrael benehen tipok leh derubba goyim ninhu i name palga ufalga sefek nefashot lehakel
La tzericha deika tisha yisrael vegoy echad benehen dehave leh goy kavua vechol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame

Bishlama lerabbanan deamri nitkaven laharog et ze veharag et ze chayyav dichtiv vechi yinnatzu anashim venagfu ishsha hara veamar rabbi elazar bematztzut shebbemita hakkatuv medabber dichtiv im ason yihye venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh

Ella lerabbi shimon hay venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh may aved leh mamon vechidrabbi detanya rabbi omer venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh mamon atta omer mamon o eno ella nefesh mammash neemra netina lematta veneemra
b: Netina lemala ma lehallan mamon af kan mamon
Amar rava hay detana deve chizkiyya mappeka midderabbi umappeka midderabbanan detana deve chizkiyya makke adam umakke behema

Ma makke behema lo chillakta bah ben shogeg lemezid ben mitkaven lesheeno mitkaven ben derech yerida lederech aliyya lefotro mamon ella lechayevo mamon af makke adam lo tachlok bo ben shogeg lemezid ben mitkaven lesheen mitkaven ben derech yerida lederech aliyya lechayevo mamon ella lefotro mamon
May sheen mitkaven ilema sheen mitkaven kelal hayenu shogeg ella peshita sheen mitkaven laze ella laze vekatane lechayevo mamon ella lefotro mamon vei bar ketala hu may itzterich lemiftereh mamon
Ella lav shema minah lav bar ketala hu velav bar mamona hu
Matni rotzeach shennitarev baacherim kullan peturin rabbi yehuda omer konsin otan lakkipa
Kol chayyave mitot shennitarvu ze baze nidonin bakkalla hanniskalin bannisrafin rabbi shimon omer nidonin biskila shehasserefa chamura vachachamim omrim nidonin bisrefa shehassekila chamura
Amar lahen rabbi shimon ilu lo hayeta serefa chamura lo nittena levat kohen shezzinneta amru lo ilu lo hayeta sekila chamura lo nittena limgaddef uloved avoda zara
Hanneheragin bannechnakin rabbi shimon omer besayif vachachamim omrim bechenek
Gema man acherim ilema acherim kesherim peshita vetu beha lema rabbi yehuda konsin otan lechipa

Amar rabbi avahu amar shemuel hacha berotzeach shello nigmar dino shennitarev berotzchim acherim shennigmar dinan askinan rabbanan savri en gomrin dino shel adam ella befanav hilkach kullan peturin verabbi yehuda mifterinhu ligmare name la kevan derotzchin ninhu hilkach konsin otan lakkipa

Resh lakish amar beadam dechulle alma la peligi diftiri aval hacha beshor shello nigmar dino shennitarev bishvarim acherim shennigmar dinan kamipalgi rabbanan savri kemitat bealim kach mitat hashshor veen gomrin dino shel shor ella befanav hilkach kullan peturin verabbi yehuda savar konsin otan lakkipa
Amar rava

a: I hachi hayenu dekatane alah amar rabbi yose afilu abba chalafta benehen
Ella amar rava hachi kaamar shenayim shehau omdin veyatza chetz mibbenehem veharag shenehem peturin veamar rabbi yose afilu abba chalafta benehen
Veshor shennigmar dino shennitarev bishvarin acherim mealleye soklin otan rabbi yehuda omer konsin otan lakkipa

Vehatanya para shehemita veachar kach yalda im ad shello nigmar dina yalda veladah muttar im mishshennigmar dina yalda veladah asur nitarev baacherim vaacherim baacherim konsin otan lakkipa rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer meviin otan levet din vesoklin otan
Amar mar im ad shello nigmar dina yalda veladah muttar veaf al gav dechi negacha havat meabbera vehaamar rava velad hannogachat asur hi uveladah nagchu velad hannirbaat asur hi uveladah nirbeu
Ema im ad shello nigmar dina ibra veyalda veladah muttar im mishshennigmar dina ibra veyalda veladah asur
Hanicha leman deamar ze vaze gorem asur
b: Ella leman deamar ze vaze gorem muttar may ika lememar
Ella amar ravina ema im ad shello nigmar dina ibra veyalda veladah muttar veim ad shello nigmar dina ibra umishshennigmar dina yalda veladah asur ubbar yerech immo hu
Kol chayyave mitot shema minah mutre ledavar chamur have mutre ledavar kal

Amar rabbi yirmeya hacha bemay askinan kegon shehitru bo setam vehay tanna hu detanya ushar chayyave mitot shebbetora en memitin otan ella beeda veedim vehatraa vead sheyyodiuhu shehu chayyav mitat bet din rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyodiuhu beeze mita hu neherag
Tanna kamma yalef mimmekoshesh verabbi yehuda omer mekoshesh horaat shaa hayeta
Hanniskalin bannisrafin matne leh rav yechezkel lerame bereh hannisrafin banniskalin rabbi shimon omer yiddonu biskila shehasserefa chamura
Amar leh rav yehuda abba la tatneyeh hachi may irya disrefa chamura tipok leh derubba niskalin ninhu ella hechi atneyeh
Hanniskalin bannisrafin rabbi shimon omer yiddonu biskila shehasserefa chamura i hachi ema sefa vachachamim omrim yiddonu bisrefa shehassekila chamura tipok leh derubba nisrafin ninhu
Hatam rabbanan hu dekaamru leh lerabbi shimon ledidach deamratte serefa chamura la sekila chamura
Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana

a: La tema leh laavuch hachi detanya hare shehaya aviv over al divre tora lo yomar lo abba avarta al divre tora ella omer lo abba kach ketiv battora sof sof hayenu hach ella omer lo abba mikra katuv battora kach hu
Matni mi shennitchayyev bishte mitot bet din nidon bachamura avar avera shennitchayyev shette mitot nidon bachamura rabbi yose omer nidon bazzika harishona shebbaa alav
Gema peshita ella itgore itgur

Amar rava hachi bemay askinan kegon sheavar avera kalla venigmar dino al avera kalla vechazar veavar avera chamura salka datach amena kevan denigmar dino laavera kalla hay gavra ketila hu ka mashma lan

Bea minneh avuh derav yosef bar chama merabba bar natan mena ha milta daamur rabbanan mi shennitchayyev shette mitot bet din nidon bachamura dichtiv veholid ben paritz shofech dam vego el heharim achal veet eshet reehu timme veel haggillulim nasa enav
Veholid ben paritz shofech dam besayif et eshet reehu timme zo eshet ish bechenek veel haggillulim nasa enav zo avoda zara biskila uchtiv mot yumat damav bo yihye biskila

Matkef lah rav nachman bar yitzchak ema kullehu biskila veholid ben paritz shofech dam ze ben sorer umore deviskila eshet reehu timme zo naara hamorasa deviskila veel haggillulim nasa enav zo avoda zara deviskila
Im ken may ka mashma lan yechezkel dilma tora ka mahdar im ken ibi leh leahdorah ki hechi deahderah moshe rabbenu
Daresh rav acha berabbi chanina may dichtiv el heharim lo achal shello achal bizchut avotav veenav lo nasa el gillule bet yisrael shello halach bekoma zekufa

Veet eshet reehu lo timme shello yarad leummanut chavero veel ishsha nidda lo yikrav shello nehena mikkuppa shel tzedaka uchtiv tzaddik hu chayo yichye keshehaya rabban gamliel maggia lemikra hazze haya boche amar man deaved lechullehu hu dechaye bachada minayehu la
Amar leh rabbi akiva ella meatta al tittammeu bechol elle hachi name bechullehu in bachada minayehu la ella beachat mikkol elle hachi name beachat mikkol elle
Avar avera tanya ketzad amar rabbi yose nidon bezika rishona habbaa alav chamoto venaaset eshet ish nidon bachamoto eshet ish venaaset chamoto nidon beeshet ish
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava chamoto venaaset eshet ish nidon bachamoto
Lidon name aisur eshet ish deha amar rabbi avahu mode rabbi yose beisur mosif
b: Amar leh adda beri bitre ketale katlatte leh
Matni mi shellaka veshana bet din machnisin oto lakkipa umaachilin oto seorin ad shekkereso mitbakkaat

Gema mishshum delaka veshana bet din konsin oto lakkipa amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi shimon ben lakish hacha bemalkiyyot shel karetot askinan degavra bar ketala hu vekarove hu dela mekarav ketaleh vechevan deka mevatar lah lenafsheh mekarvinan leh liktaleh ilaveh
Amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa ta asbera lach bemalkiyyot shel karet achat aval shel shettayim veshel shalosh karetot isure hu deka taem vela mevatar kulle hay
Mi shellaka veshana shana af al gav dela shilesh lema matnitin dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel dei rabban shimon ben gamliel ha amar ad telat zimne la haveya chazaka
Amar ravina afilu tema rabban shimon ben gamliel kasavar averot machazikot

Metivi avar avera sheyyesh bah malkot paam rishona ushniyya malkin oto ushlishit konsin oto lakkipa abba shaul omer af bashshelishit malkin oto barviit konsin oto lakkipa may lav dechulle alma malkiyyot machzikot uviflugta derabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel kamipalgi
La dechulle alma it lehu derabban shimon ben gamliel vehacha beha ka mipalgi demar savar averot machzikot umar savar malkiyyot machzikot
Vehadtanya hitru bo veshatak hitru bo vehirkin rosho paam rishona ushniyya matrin bo shelishit konsin oto lakkipa abba shaul omer af bashshelishit matrin bo birviit konsin oto lakkipa
Vehatam malkot leka bemay kamipalgi amar ravina bechipa tzericha hatraa kamipalgi
Umay kipa amar rav yehuda melo komato vehecha remiza amar resh lakish temotet rasha raa
Veamar resh lakish may dichtiv ki gam lo yeda haadam et itto kaddagim shenneechazim bimtzoda raa may metzoda raa amar resh lakish chakka
Matni hahoreg nefesh shello beedim machnisin oto lakkipa umaachilin oto lechem tzar umayim lachatz
Gema mena yadinan amar rav beedut meuchedet ushmuel amar shello behatraa
Verav chisda amar avimi kegon deitachchush bivdikot vela itachchush bachakirot keditnan maase uvadak ben zakkay beuktze teenim

Umaachilin oto lechem tzar umayim lachatz may shena hacha dekatane notnin lo lechem tzar umayim lachatz umay shena hatam dekatane maachilin oto seorin ad shekkereso mitbakkaat amar rav sheshet ide veide notnin lo lechem tzar umayim lachatz ad sheyyuktan mayano vahadar maachilin oto seorin ad shekkereso mitbakkaat

Matni haggonev et hakkasva vehamkallel bekosem vehabboel arammit kannain pogin bo kohen sheshshimmesh betuma en echav hakkohanim meviin oto levet din ella pirche chehunna motziin oto chutz laazara umfatzin et mocho bigzirin zar sheshshimmesh bammikdash rabbi akiva omer bechenek vachachamim omrim bide shamayim
Gema may kasva amar rav yehuda keli sharet vechen hu omer veet kesot hannasech vehecha remiza velo yavou lirot kevalla et hakkodesh vametu
Vehamkallel bekosem tane rav yosef yakke kosem et kosmo rabbanan veitema rabba bar mari amri yakkehu kosem lo ulkono ulmakno
Vehabboel arammit bea mineh rav kahana merav

a: Lo pagu bo kannain mahu inashyeh rav ligmareh akreuh lerav kahana bechelmeh bagda yehuda vetoeva neesta veyisrael uvirushalam ki chillel yehuda kodesh Adonai asher ahev uvaal bat el nechar ata amar leh hachi akreun

Iddachreh rav ligmareh bagda yehuda zo avoda zara vechen hu omer ken begadtem bi bet yisrael neum Adonai vetoeva neesta veyisrael uvirushalam ze mishkav zechur vechen hu omer veet zachar lo tishkav mishkeve ishsha toeva hi ki chillel yehuda kodesh Adonai zo zona vechen hu omer lo tihye kedesha mibbenot yisrael uvaal bat el nechar ze habba al haggoya

Uchtiv batreh yachret Adonai laish asher yaasenna er veone meohole yaakov umaggish mincha la tzevaot im talmid chacham hu lo yihye lo er bachachamim veone battalmidim im kohen hu lo yihye lo ben maggish mincha la tzevaot
Amar rabbi chiyya bar avuya kol habba al haggoya keilu mitchatten baavoda zara dichtiv uvaal bat el nechar vechi bat yesh lo leel nechar ella ze habba al haggoya

Veamar rabbi chiyya bar avuya katuv al gulgolto shel yehoyakim zot veod acheret zekeno derabbi perida ashkach hahu gulgulta dahavat shadya beshaare yerushalayim vahava katuv ilavah zot veod acheret kavrah vahadar nevug kavrah vahadar nevug amar hay gulgulta dihoyakim dichtiv beh kevurat chamor yikkaver sachov vehashlech mehala leshaare yerushalam

Amar malka hu velav orach ara levazzoye shaklah karchah beshirae veotvah besifta atay devethu chazetah nefakat amara lehu leshivavataha amri lah hay deitta kammayeta hi dela ka minneshe lah shegarta letannura vekaltah ki ata amar hayenu dichtiv ilavah zot veod acheret
Ki ata rav dimi amar bet dino shel chashmonay gazru habba al haggoya chayyav aleha mishshum nidda shifcha goya eshet ish
Ki ata ravin amar mishshum nidda shifcha goya zona aval mishshum ishut let lehu veidach neshayehu vadday la mafkeri
Amar rav chisda habba limalech en morin lo itmar name amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan habba limalech en morin lo
Velo od ella sheim perash zimri vaharago pinchas neherag alav nehpach zimri vaharago lefinchas en neherag alav shehare rodef hu

Vayyomer moshe el shofte yisrael vego halach shivto shel shimon etzel zimri ben salu amru lo hen danin dine nefashot veatta yoshev veshotek ma asa amad vekibetz esrim vearbaa elef miyyisrael vehalach etzel kozbi amar lah hishshamei li amra lo bat melech ani vechen tziva li avi lo tishshami ella laggadol shebbahem amar lah af hu nesi shevet hu vela od ella shehu gadol mimmennu shehu sheni labbeten vehu shelishi labbeten

Tefasah bivloritah veheviah etzel moshe amar lo ben amram zo asura o mutteret veim tomar asura bat yitro mi hittira lach nitallema mimmennu halacha gau kullam bivchiyya vehayenu dichtiv vehemma vochim petach ohel moed uchtiv vayyar pinchas ben elazar
Ma raa amar rav raa maase venizkar halacha amar lo achi avi abba lo kach limadtani beridtecha mehar sinay habboel aramit kannain pogin bo amar lo karyana deigarta ihu leheve parvanka
Ushmuel amar raa sheen chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged Adonai kol makom sheyyesh chilul hashshem en cholkin kavod larav rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi eliezer raa shebba malach vehishchit baam
Vayyakom mittoch haeda vayyikkach romach beyado mikan sheen nichnasin bichle zayin levet hammidrash shalaf shenanah vehinnichah beunkalo vehaya
b: Nishan veholech al maklo vechevan shehiggia etzel shivto shel shimon amar hechan matzinu sheshshivto shel levi gadol mishshel shimon amru hannichu lo af hu laasot tzerachav nichnas hittiru perushin et haddavar

Amar rabbi yochanan shishsha nissim naasu lo lefinchas echad shehaya lo lezimri lifrosh velo perash veechad shehaya lo ledabber velo dibber veechad shekkiven bezachruto shel ish uvnakvutah shel ishsha veechad shello nishmetu min haromach veechad shebba malach vehigbiha et hammashkof veechad shebba malach vehishchit baam

Ba vachavatan lifne hammakom amar lefanav ribbono shel olam al ellu yippelu esrim vearbaa elef miyyisrael shenneemar vayyihu hammetim bammaggefa arbaa veesrim alef vehayenu dichtiv vayyaamod pinchas vayefallel

Amar rabbi elazar vayyitpallel lo neemar ella vayefallel melammed kivyachol sheasa pelilut im kono bikkeshu malache hashsharet ledochofo amar lahen hannichu lo kannay ben kannay hu meshiv chema ben meshiv chema hu
Hitchilu shevatim mevazzin oto reitem ben puti ze sheppitem avi immo agalim laavoda zara veharag nesi shevet miyyisrael ba hakkatuv veyichaso pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen
Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe hakdem lo shalom shenneemar lachen emor hinni noten lo et beriti shalom uruya kappara zo shettehe mechapperet veholechet leolam

Amar rav nachman amar rav may dichtiv zarzir motnayim o tayish umelech alkum immo arba meot veesrim vearba beilot baal oto rasha oto hayyom vehimtin lo pinchas ad shettashash kocho vehu eno yodea shemmelech alkum immo
Bematnita tana shishshim ad shennaasa kevetza hammuzeret vehi hayeta kaaruga melea mayim amar rav kahana umoshavah bet sea tane rav yosef kever shellah amma
Amar rav sheshet lo kozbi shemah ella shevilnay bat tzur shemah velamma nikra shemah kozbi shekkizzeva beaviha davar acher kozbi sheamra leaviha kos bi am ze
Vehayenu deamri inashe ben kene leurbane shevilnay may baaya bahade kelippe dikne shevilnay may baaya gaftah leimmah

Amar rabbi yochanan chamishsha shemot yesh lo zimri uven salu veshaul uven hakkenaanit ushlumiel ben tzuri shadday zimri al shennaasa kevetza hammuzeret ben salu al shehisli aonot shel mishpachto shaul al shehishil atzmo lidvar avera ben hakkenaanit al sheasa maase chenaan uma shemo shelumiel ben tzuri shadday shemo
Kohen sheshshimesh betuma bea mineh rav acha bar huna merav sheshet kohen sheshshimesh betuma chayyav mita bide shamayim o en chayyav mita bide shamayim

Amar leh tenetuha kohen sheshshimesh betuma en echav hakkohanim meviin oto levet din ella pirche chehunna motziin oto chutz laazara ufotzin et mocho begizrin vei salka datach mechayyev bide shamayim lishbekeh deliktol bide shamayim ella may eno chayyav

Mi ika mide derachamana patreh vaanan nekum veniktol leh vela vehatnan mi shellaka veshana bet din machnisin oto lakkipa rachamana patreh vaanan katlinan leh haamar rabbi yirmeya amar resh lakish bemalkot shel karetot askinan degavra bar ketala hu
Veha gonev hakkasva haamar rav yehuda bichli sharet askinan urmiza lo yavou lirot kevalla et hakkodesh vametu
Veha hamkallel et hakkosem ha tane rav yosef yakke kosem et kosmo demichaze kimvarech et hashshem
Veha boel aramit ha akreuh lerav kahana bechelmeh veiddachreh rav ligmareh
Etiveh hayyotzek vehabbolel vehappotet hammoleach hammenif hammaggish vehamsadder et hashshulchan hammetiv et hannerot vehakkometz vehamkabbel damim bachutz patur
Veen chayyavin alehen

a: Lo mishshum zarut velo mishshum tuma velo mishshum mechussar begadim velo mishshum richutz yadayim veraglayim
Ha mekatter chayyav may lav mita la beazhara
Ella zar name leazhara vehachtiv vehazzar hakkarev yumat ha kidita veha kidita
Mikkelal deotzek uvolel lav name la vehatanya azhara leotzek uvolel minnayin talmud lomar kedoshim yihu velo yechallelu midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma
Metivi veellu hen shebbemita tame sheshshimesh teuvta

Gufa veellu shebbemita haochel et hattevel vechohen tame sheachal teruma tehora vezar sheachal et hatteruma vezar sheshshimesh vetame sheshshimesh utvul yom sheshshimesh umchussar begadim umchussar kappara veshello rachatz yadayim veraglayim ushtuye yayin ufrue rosh
Aval arel veonen veoshev enan bemita ella beazhara baal mum rabbi omer bemita vachachamim omrim baazhara
Hezid bimila rabbi omer bemita vachachamim omrim baazhara

Haochel et hattevel menalan deamar shemuel mishshum rabbi eliezer minnayin leochel et hattevel shehu bemita dichtiv velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael et asher yarimu la baatidim litrom hakkatuv medabber
Veyalef chilul chilul mitteruma ma lehallan bemita af kan bemita
Venelaf chilul chilul minnotar ma lehallan becharet af kan becharet
Mistabbera mitteruma hava leh lemelaf shekken teruma chutza laaretz huttera berabbim perot pigul venotar
Adderabba minnotar hava leh lemelaf shekken pesul ochel en lo heter bemikve hanach nefishan ravina amar chilul derabbim mechilul derabbim adif
Vechohen tame sheachal teruma tehora menalan deamar shemuel minnayin lechohen tame sheachal teruma tehora shehu bemita bide shamayim dichtiv veshamru et mishmarti velo yisu alav chet vego
Tehora in temea la deamar shemuel amar rabbi eliezer minnayin lechohen tame sheachal teruma temea sheeno bemita shenneemar umetu vo ki yechalleluhu
b: Perat lazo shemmechullelet veomedet
Vezar sheachal et hatteruma amar rav zar sheachal et hatteruma loke amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav lema mar bemita dichtiv vechol zar lo yochal kodesh
Ani Adonai mekaddesham hifsik hainyan metivi veellu hen shebbemita zar haochel et hatteruma matnita adderav ka ramet rav tanna hu ufaleg
Vezar sheshshimesh dichtiv vehazzar hakkarev yumat

Vetame sheshshimesh kediva mineh rav chiyya bar avin merav yosef minnayin letame sheshshimesh shehu bemita dichtiv dabber el aharon veel banav veyinnazru mikkodshe vene yisrael velo yechallelu et shem kodshi
Veyalef chilul chilul mitteruma ma lehallan bemita af kan bemita
Venelaf chilul chilul minnotar ma lehallan karet af kan karet
Mistabbera mitteruma hava leh lemelaf shekken guf tame mikve berabbim
Adderabba minnotar hava leh lemelaf shekken kodesh penim pigul venotar chilul derabbim mechilul derabbim adif
Tevul yom sheshshimesh menalan detanya rabbi simay omer remez litvul yom sheim avad chilel minnayin talmud lomar kedoshim yihu lelohehem velo yechallelu
Im eno inyan letame sheshshimesh denafka lan miveyinnazru tenehu inyan litvul yom sheshshimesh
Veyalef chilul chilul mitteruma ma lehallan bemita af kan bemita
Umchussar begadim menalan amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan umatu bah mishshemeh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon vechagarta otam avnet
Bizman shebbigdehem alehem kehunnatam alehem en bigdehem alehem en kehunnatam alehem vehau lehu zarim veamar mar zar sheshshimesh bemita
Umchussar kappara menalan amar rav huna deamar kera vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera tahera mikkelal shehi temea veamar mar tame sheshshimesh bemita
Veshello rechutz yadayim veraglayim menalan dichtiv bevoam el ohel moed yirchatzu mayim velo yamutu
Ushtuye yayin dichtiv yayin veshechar al teshte vego
Ufrue rosh dichtiv rosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu uchtiv batreh veyayin lo yishtu itakkash perue rosh lishtuye yayin ma shetuye yayin bemita af perue rosh bemita
Aval arel onen yoshev beazhara arel menalan amar rav chisda davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu ad shebba yechezkel ben buzi velimmedanu kol ben nechar erel lev

a: Veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi lesharteni
Onen menalan dichtiv umin hammikdash lo yetze velo yechallel et mikdash elohav ha acher shello yatza chilel
Amar leh rav adda lerava venelaf chilul chilul mitteruma ma lehallan bemita af kan bemita
Mi ketiv beh begufeh mikkelala kaate have davar habba min hakkelal vechol davar habba min hakkelal en danin oto bigzera shava
Yoshev menalan amar rava amar rav nachman amar kera ki vo bachar Adonai elohecha mikkol shevatecha laamod lesharet laamida bechartiv velo lishiva
Baal mum rabbi omer bemita vachachamim omrim baazhara may tama derabbi dichtiv ach el happarochet lo yavo vego veyalef chilul chilul mitteruma ma lehallan bemita af kan bemita
Venelaf chilul chilul minnotar ma lehallan becharet af kan becharet
Mistabbera mitteruma hava leh lemelaf shekken pesul hagguf mippesul hagguf adderabba minnotar hava leh lemelaf shekken kodesh penim pigul venotar
Ella mittame sheshshimesh gamar pesul hagguf mippesul hagguf kodesh penim pigul venotar mikkodesh penim pigul venotar
Verabbanan amar kera bo velo bevaal mum
Hezid bimila rabbi omer bemita vachachamim omrim baazhara may tama derabbi amar rabbi avahu gamar chet chet mitteruma ma lehallan bemita af kan bemita
Verabbanan amri amar kera bo bo velo bimila
Zar sheshshimesh bemikdash tanya rabbi yishmael omer neemar kan vehazzar hakkarev yumat veneemar lehallan kol hakkarev hakkarev el mishkan Adonai yamut ma lehallan bide shamayim af kan bide shamayim

Rabbi akiva omer neemar kan vehazzar hakkarev yumat veneemar lehallan vehannavi hahu o cholem hachalom hahu yumat ma lehallan biskila af kan biskila rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer ma lehallan bechenek af kan bechenek

Bemay kamipalgi rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva rabbi akiva savar danin yumat miyyumat veen danin yumat miyyamut verabbi yishmael savar danin hedot mehedot veen danin hedot minnavi verabbi akiva kevan shehiddiach en lecha hedot gadol mizze
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi akiva verabbi yochanan ben nuri biflugta derabbi shimon verabbanan detanya navi shehiddiach biskila rabbi shimon omer bechenek ha anan tenan rabbi akiva omer bechenek
Tere tannae vealliba derabbi akiva matnitin rabbi shimon vealliba derabbi akiva barayeta rabbanan vealliba derabbi akiva
Hadaran alach ellu hen hannisrafin
b: Matni ellu hen hannechnakin hammakke aviv veimmo vegonev nefesh miyyisrael vezaken mamre al pi bet din unvi hashsheker vehammitnabbe beshem avoda zara vehabba al eshet ish vezomme bat kohen uvoalah
Gema makke aviv veimmo menalan dichtiv umakke aviv veimmo mot yumat vechol mita haamura battora setam enah ella chenek
Ema ad dekatel leh miktal salka datach ketal chad besayif veaviv bechenek
Hanicha leman deamar chenek kal ella leman deamar chenek chamur may ika lememar
Ella middichtiv makke ish vamet mot yumat uchtiv o veeva hikkahu veyado vayyamot shema minah kol hecha deika hakkaa setam lav mita hu

Veitzterich lemichtav makke ish veitzterich lemichtav kol makke nefesh dei ketav rachamana makke ish vamet hava amena ish devar mitzva in katan la ketav rachamana kol makke nefesh vei ketav rachamana kol makke nefesh hava amena afilu nefalim afilu ben shemona tzerichi
Veema af al gav dela aved beh chabbura allema tenan hammakke aviv veimmo eno chayyav ad sheyyaase bahen chabbura
Amar kera makke adam umakke vehema ma makke vehema ad deaved bah chabbura dichtiv bah nefesh af makke adam ad deaved chabbura
Matkef lah rav yirmeya ella meatta hichchishah baavanim hachi name dela michayyav ella im eno inyan lenefesh behema deha i name hichchishah baavanim chayyav tenehu inyan lenefesh adam
Ella hekkesha lema li lechidtanya deve chizkiyya
Hanicha leman deit leh tanna deve chizkiyya ella leman delet leh tanna deve chizkiyya hekesha lema li
Ma makke vehema lirfua patur af makke adam lirfua patur
Deibaya lehu ben mahu sheyyakkiz dam leaviv rav matna amar veahavta lereacha kamocha rav dimi bar chinana amar makke adam umakke vehema ma makke vehema lirfua patur af makke adam lirfua patur
Rav la shavek livreh lemishkal leh silva mar bereh deravina la shavek livreh lemiftach leh kevata dilma chavel vehaveya leh shiggat isur
I hachi acher name acher shiggat lav beno shiggat chenek
Vehaditnan machat shel yad litol bah et hakkotz lechush dilma chavel vehaveya lah shiggat sekila
Hatam mekalkel hu
Hanicha leman deamar mekalkel patur ella leman deamar chayyav may ika lememar
Man shamatte leh deamar mekalkel bechabbura chayyav rabbi shimon hi

a: Verabbi shimon haamar kol melacha sheenah tzericha legufah patur aleha
Beo mineh merav sheshet ben mahu sheyyease shaliach leaviv lehakkoto ulkallo
Amar lehu veacher mi hittiro ella kevod shamayim adif hacha name kevod shamayim adif
Metivi uma mi shemmitzva lehakkoto mitzva shello lehakkoto mi sheeno mitzva lehakkoto eno din shemmitzva shello lehakkoto
May lav ide veide bimkom mitzva ha bivno ha beacher
La ide veidi la shena beno vela shena acher vela kashya kan bimkom mitzva kan shello bimkom mitzva
Vehachi katane uma bimkom mitzva shemmitzva lehakkoto mitzva shello lehakkoto shello bimkom mitzva sheeno mitzva lehakkoto eno din shemmitzva shello lehakkoto
Ta shema hayyotze lehareg uva beno vehikkahu vekillo chayyav ba acher vehikkahu vekillo patur vehavenan bah may shena beno umay shena acher veamar rav chisda bimsarvin bo latzet veeno yotze
Rav sheshet moke lah besheen mesarvin bo latzet
I hachi acher name acher gavra ketila hu
Vehaamar rav sheshet biyesho yashen vamet chayyav hacha bemay askinan beshehikkahu hakkaa sheen bah shave peruta
Vehaamar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan hikkahu hakkaa sheen bah shave peruta loke may patur dekaamar patur mimmamon
Michlal divno chayyav bemamon ella bedino hacha name bedino
Ella acher hayenu tama defatur deamar kera venasi veammecha lo taor beose maase ammecha
Hatinach kelala hakkaa menalan demakkeshinan hakkaa liklala
I hachi beno name kidamar rav pinchas besheasa teshuva hachi name besheasa teshuva
I hachi acher name amar rav mari beammecha bimkuyyam shebbeammecha
I hachi beno name
b: Mide dehave leachar mita
May hava alah amar rabba bar rav huna vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael lakkol en habben naase shaliach leaviv lehakkoto ulkallo chutz mimmesit shehare amra tora velo tachmol velo techasse alav
Matni hammakke aviv veimmo eno chayyav ad sheyyaase bahen chabbura ze chomer bamkallel mibbammakke shehamkallel leachar mita chayyav vehammakke leachar mita patur
Gema tanu rabbanan aviv veimmo killel leachar mita sheyyachol hoil vechiyyev bammakke vechiyyev bamkallel ma makke eno chayyav ella mechayyim af hamkallel eno chayyav ella mechayyim
Veod kal vachomer uma makke sheasa bo shello beammecha kivammecha lo chiyyev bo leachar mita mekallel shello asa bo shello beammecha kivammecha eno din shello chiyyev bo leachar mita
Talmud lomar aviv veimmo killel leachar mita
Hanicha lerabbi yonatan dimyatar leh kera aviv veimmo ella lerabbi yoshiyya may ika lememar

Detanya ish ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot bat tumtum veanderoginos asher yekallel et aviv veet immo en li ella aviv veimmo aviv shello immo immo shello aviv minnayin talmud lomar aviv veimmo killel aviv killel immo killel divre rabbi yoshiyya
Rabbi yonatan omer mashma shenehen keechad umashma echad veechad bifne atzmo ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv yachdav
Mena leh nafka leh miumkallel aviv veimmo mot yumat
Veidach hahu mibe leh lerabbot bat tumtum veanderoginos
Vetipok leh meish ish dibbera tora kilshon bene adam
Velitne chomer bammakke mibbamkallel shehammakke asa bo shello beammecha kivammecha ma sheen ken bamkallel kasavar makkeshinan hakkaa liklala
Lema hane tannae kehane tannae detane chada kuti atta metzuve al hakkaato vei atta metzuve al killato vetanya idach i atta metzuve lo al killato velo al hakkaato
Savruha dechulle alma kutim gere emet hen may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar makkeshinan hakkaa liklala umar savar la makkeshinan hakkaa liklala
La dechulle alma la makkeshinan hakkaa liklala vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar kutim gere emet hen umar savar kutim gere araot hen
I hachi hayenu dekatane alah veshoro keyisrael ella shema minah behekesha peligi shema minah

Matni haggonev nefesh miyyisrael eno chayyav ad sheyyachnisennu lirshuto rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyachnisennu lirshuto veyishtammesh bo shenneemar vehitammer bo umcharo haggonev et beno rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka mechayyev vachachamim potrin ganav mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin rabbi yehuda mechayyev vachachamim potrin
Gema vetanna kamma la bae imur amar rabbi acha bereh derava imur pachot mishshave peruta ika benayehu
Bae rabbi yirmeya genavo umcharo yashen mahu machar ishsha leubbarah mahu yesh derech imur bechach o en derech imur bechach
Vetipok leh deleka imur kelal la tzericha yashen dizga aleh ishsha deokmah beappe zika derech imur bechach o en derech imur bechach may teku
Tanu rabbanan ki yimmatze ish gonev nefesh meechav en li ella ish shegganav ishsha minnayin talmud lomar vegonev ish
En li ella ish shegganav ben ishsha uven ish veishsha shegganva ish ishsha shegganva ishsha minnayin talmud lomar umet haggannav hahu mikkol makom

Tanya idach ki yimmatze ish gonev nefesh meechav echad haggonev et haish veechad haggonev et haishsha veechad ger veechad eved meshuchrar vekatan chayyav genavo velo mecharo mecharo vaadayin yeshno birshuto patur mecharo leaviv o leachiv o leechad min hakkerovim chayyav haggonev et haavadim patur

a: Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet amar leh ani shone rabbi shimon omer meechav ad sheyyotziennu mershut echav veatte amratte chayyav teni patur
May kushya dilma ha rabbi shimon ha rabbanan
La salka datach deamar rabbi yochanan setam matnitin rabbi meir setam tosefta rabbi nechemya setam sifra rabbi yehuda setam sifre rabbi shimon vechullehu alliba derabbi akiva
Haggonev beno may tama derabbanan
Amar abbaye deamar kera ki yimmatze perat lematzuy
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye ella meatta ki yimmatze ish shochev im ishsha veulat baal hachi name ki yimmatze perat lematzuy kegon shel bet peloni dishchichan gabbayehu hachi name diftiri
Amar leh ana mivenimtza beyado kaamena
Amar rava hilkach hane makre dardeke umatnu rabbanan kimtzuyin beyadan damu uftiri
Ganav mi shechetzo vechu tenan hatam rabbi yehuda omer en laavadim boshet
May tama derabbi yehuda amar kera ki yinnatzu anashim yachdav ish veachiv mi sheyyesh lo achva yatza eved sheen lo achva
Verabbanan achiv hu bemitzot
Vehacha hechi daresh rabbi yehuda

Savar meechav leappoke avadim bene yisrael lemaote mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin mibbene yisrael lemaote mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin have miut achar miut veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot
Verabbanan meechav leappoke avadim la mashma lehu deha achiv hu bemitzot bene yisrael mibbene yisrael chad lemaote eved vechad lemaote mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin
Azhara legonev nefesh minnayin rabbi yoshiyya amar millo tignov rabbi yochanan amar millo yimmachru mimkeret eved vela peligi mar ka chashev lav digneva umar ka chashev lav dimchira

Tanu rabbanan lo tignov begonev nefashot hakkatuv medabber atta omer begonev nefashot o eno ella begonev mamon amarta tze ulmad mishshelosh esre middot shehattora nidreshet bahen davar hallamed meinyano bema hakkatuv medabber binfashot af kan binfashot

Tanya idach lo tignovu begonev mamon hakkatuv medabber atta omer begonev mamon o eno ella begonev nefashot amarta tze ulmad mishshelosh esre middot shehattora nidreshet bahen davar hallamed meinyano bema hakkatuv medabber bemamon af kan bemamon
Itmar ede geneva veede mechira benefesh shehuzzammu chizkiyya amar en neheragin rabbi yochanan amar neheragin
Chizkiyya deamar kerabbi akiva deamar davar velo chatzi davar verabbi yochanan amar kerabbanan deamri davar vaafilu chatzi davar
Umode chizkiyya beedim haacharonim shel ben sorer umore shehuzzammu shenneheragin mittoch sheyecholim lomar harishonim
b: Lehalkoto banu vehane acharine kulleh davar ka avdi leh
Matkef lah rav pappa i hachi ede mechira name likteleh mittoch sheyecholin ede geneva lomar lehalkoto banu vechi tema dekasavar chizkiyya dela lake
Veha itmar ede geneva benefesh shehuzzammu chizkiyya verabbi yochanan chad amar lokin vechad amar en lokin veamrinan tistayyem dechizkiyya deamar lokin middeamar chizkiyya en neheragin
Dei rabbi yochanan kevan deamar neheragin have leh lav shennitan leazharat mitat bet din vechol lav shennitan leazharat mitat bet din en lokin alav ihu la lake inhu hechi laku

Ella amar rav pappa beede mechira dechulle alma la peligi deneheragin ki peligi beede geneva chizkiyya amar en neheragin geneva lechodah kayema umchira lechudah kayema rabbi yochanan amar neheragin geneva atchalta dimchira hi
Umode rabbi yochanan beedim harishonim shel ben sorer umore shehuzzammu sheen neheragin mittoch sheyecholin lomar lehalkoto banu
Amar abbaye hakkol modim beven sorer umore vehakkol modim beven sorer umore umachloket beven sorer umore
Hakkol modim beven sorer umore beedim harishonim sheen neheragin mittoch sheyecholin lomar lehalkoto banu
Vehakkol modim beven sorer umore beedim acharonim shenneheragim mittoch sheedim harishonim yecholin lomar lehalkoto banu vehane kulleh davar ka avdi leh
Umachloket beven sorer umore shenayim omrim befanenu ganav ushnayim omrim befanenu achal
Amar rav assi ede mechira benefesh shehuzzammu en neheragin mittoch sheyyachol lomar avdi macharti
Amar rav yosef keman azla ha shemata derav assi kerabbi akiva deamar davar velo chatzi davar amar leh abbaye dei kerabbanan neheragin ha mittoch kaamar
Ella afilu tema rabbanan uvidla ato ede geneva i hachi may lememra la tzericha deaf al gav daato levassof
Veakkatti may lememra la tzericha deka merammezi rammoze mahu detema remiza milta hi ka mashma lan remiza lav kelum hu

Matni zaken mamre al pi bet din shenneemar ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat shelosha batte dinin hau sham echad yoshev al petach har habbayit veechad yoshev al petach haazara veechad yoshev belishkat haggazit
Bain laze sheal petach har habbayit veomer kach darashti vechach darshu chaveray kach limadti vechach limdu chaveray im shamu amru lahem
Veim lav bain lahen leotan sheal petach azara veomer kach darashti vechach darshu chaveray kach limadti vechach limdu chaveray im shomu amru lahem

Veim lav ellu vaellu bain levet din haggadol shebbelishkat haggazit shemmimmennu yotza tora lechol yisrael shenneemar min hammakom hahu asher yivchar Adonai chazar leiro shana velimmed badderech shehaya lamed patur veim hora laasot chayyav shenneemar vehaish asher yaase vezadon eno chayyav ad sheyyore laasot
Talmid shehora laasot patur nimtza chumro kullo
Gema tanu rabbanan ki yippale mimmecha davar

a: Bemufla shebbevet din hakkatuv medabber mimmecha ze yoetz vechen hu omer mimmech yatza choshev al Adonai raa yoetz beliyyaal davar zo halacha lammishpat ze haddin
Ben dam ledam ben dam nidda dam leda dam ziva ben din ledin ben dine nefashot dine mamonot dine makkot ben nega lanega ben nige adam nige vattim nige vegadim
Divre ellu hacharamim vehaarachin vehahekdeshot rivot zo hashkaat sota vaarifat egla vetohorat metzora bisharecha zo leket shichcha ufea
Vekamta mibbet din vealita melammed shebbet hammikdash gavoha meeretz yisrael veeretz yisrael gavoha mikkol haaratzot el hammakom melammed shehammakom gorem

Bishlama bet hammikdash gavoha meeretz yisrael dichtiv vealita ella eretz yisrael gavoha mikkol haaratzot mena leh dichtiv lachen hinne yamim baim neum Adonai lo yeamer chay Adonai asher heela et bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim ki im chay Adonai asher heela vaasher hevi et zera bet yisrael meeretz tzafona umikkol haaratzot asher hiddachtim sham veyashvu al admatam

Tanu rabbanan zaken mamre eno chayyav ella al davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer al davar sheikaro middivre tora uferusho middivre sofrim rabbi shimon omer afilu dikduk echad middikidduke sofrim

May tama derabbi meir gamar davar davar ketiv hacha ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat uchtiv hatam venelam davar meene hakkahal ma lehallan davar shechayyav al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat af kan davar shechayyav al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat
Verabbi yehuda al pi hattora asher yorucha ad deika tora veorucha
Verabbi shimon asher yaggidu lecha min hammakom hahu afilu kol dehu
Amar leh rav huna bar chinana lerava targemah li leha matnita alliba derabbi meir amar leh rava lerav pappa pok targemah leh
Ki yippale bemufla shebbevet din hakkatuv medabber mimmecha ze yoetz sheyyodea leabber shanim velikboa chodashim keditnan hen heidu shemmeabberim et hashshana kol adar shehau omrim ad happurim
Dei lehay gisa ka share chametz befesach vei lehay gisa ka share chametz befesach
Davar ze halacha zo hilchat achad asar deitmar asiri rabbi yochanan amar asiri kitshii verabbi shimon ben lakish amar asiri keachad asar
Rabbi yochanan amar asiri kitshii ma teshii bae shimur af asiri bae shimur
Resh lakish amar asiri keachad asar ma achad asar lo bae shimur af asiri la bae shimur
Mishpat ze haddin
b: Din bitto meanusato
Deamar rava amar li rav yitzchak bar avudimi atya henna henna
Atya zimma zimma
Ben dam ledam ben dam nidda dam leda dam ziva dam nidda biflugta akavya ben mahalalel verabbanan ditnan dam hayyarok akavya ben mahalalel metamme vachachamim metaharin
Dam leda biflugta derav velevi deittemar rav amar mayan echad hu hattora timmeattu vehattora tiharattu
Velevi amar shene maayanot hen nistam hattame niftach hattahor nistam hattahor niftach hattame
Dam ziva biflugta derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua ditnan kishta shelosha yamim betoch achad asar yom im shafta meet leet veyalda hare zo yoledet bezov divre rabbi eliezer
Verabbi yehoshua omer layela vaom kelele shabbat veomo sheshshafta min hatztzaar velo min haddam

Ben din ledin ben dine mamonot dine nefashot dine makkot dine mamonot biflugta dishmuel verabbi avahu deamar shemuel shenayim sheddanu dinehem din ella shennikrain bet din chatzuf verabbi avahu amar ledivre hakkol en dinehen din
Dine nefashot biflugta derabbi verabbanan detanya rabbi omer venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh mamon
Atta omer mamon o eno ella nefesh mammash neemar netina lemala veneemar netina lematta ma lehallan mamon af kan mamon
Dine makkot biflugta derabbi yishmael verabbanan ditnan makkot bishlosha mishshum rabbi yishmael amru beesrim ushlosha
Ben nega lanega ben nige adam nige vattim nige vegadim
Nige adam biflugta derabbi yehoshua verabbanan ditnan im baheret kadam lassear hallavan tame im sear lavan kadam labbaheret tahor safek tame rabbi yehoshua omer keha may keha amar rava keha tahor

Nige vattim biflugta derabbi elazar berabbi shimon verabbanan ditnan rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer leolam en habbayit tame ad sheyyerae kishne gerisin al shette avanim bishne chetalim bekeren zavit orko kishne gerisin verochbo kigris
May tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon ketiv kir uchtiv kirot ezehu kir shehu kekirot heve omer ze keren zavit
Nige vegadim biflugta derabbi yonatan ben avtulmos verabbanan detanya rabbi yonatan ben avtulmos omer minnayin

a: Lifricha bivgadim shehi tehora
Neemra karachat vegabbachat baadam veneemra karachat vegabbachat bivgadim ma lehallan parach bechullo tahor af kan parach bechullo tahor
Divre ellu haarachin vehacharamim vehahekdeshot haarachin biflugta derabbi meir verabbanan ditnan hammaarich pachot mibben chodesh rabbi meir omer noten damav vachachamim omrim lo amar kelum
Hacharamim biflugta derabbi yehuda ben betira verabbanan ditnan rabbi yehuda ben betira omer setam charamim levedek habbayit shenneemar kol cherem kodesh kodashim hu la
Vachachamim omrim setam charamim lakkohen shenneemar kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato im ken ma talmud lomar kodesh kadashim hu la shechal al kodshe kadashim veal kadashim kallim
Hekdeshot biflugta derabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbanan detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer afilu tzinora shel hekdesh tzericha asara bene adam lifdotah

Rivot ze hashkaat sota vaarifat haegla vetohorat metzora hashkaat sota biflugta derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua ditnan hamkanne leishto rabbi eliezer omer mekanne al pi shenayim umashke al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo
Rabbi yehoshua omer mekanne al pi shenayim umashke al pi shenayim
Arifat egla biflugta derabbi eliezer verabbi akiva ditnan meayin hau moddin rabbi eliezer omer mittiburo rabbi akiva omer mechotmo rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer mimmakom shennaase chalal mitztzavaro

Tohorat metzora biflugta derabbi shimon verabbanan ditnan en lo bohen yad bohen regel ozen yemanit en lo tohora olamit rabbi eliezer omer noten lo al mekomo veotze rabbi shimon omer noten al shel semol veotze
Bisharecha ze leket shichcha pea leket ditnan shene shibbolin leket shelosha enan leket shichcha shene omarin shichcha shelosha enan shichcha
Veal kullan bet shammay omrim shalosh leani vearba levaal habbayit

Pea biflugta derabbi yishmael verabbanan ditnan mitzvat pea lehafrish min hakkama lo hifrish min hakkama yafrish min haomarin lo hifrish min haomarin yafrish min hakkeri ad shello mercho mercho measser venoten lo
Mishshum rabbi yishmael amru af mafrish min haisa
Shelosha batte dinin vechu amar rav kahana hu omer mippi hashshemua vehen omrin mippi hashshemua eno neherag

Hu omer kach hu beenay vehen omrin kach hu beenenu eno neherag vechol shekken hu omer mippi hashshemua vehen omrin kach hu beenenu eno neherag ad sheyyomar kach hu beenay vehen omrim mippi hashshemua teda shehare lo hargu et akavya ben mahalalel

Verabbi elazar omer afilu hu omer mippi hashshemua vehen omrin kach hu beenenu neherag kede shello yirbu machlokot beyisrael veim tomar mippene ma lo hargu et akavya ben mahalalel mippene shello hora halacha lemaase

Tenan kach darashti vechach darshu chaveray kach limmadti vechach limmedu chaveray may lav dehu amar mippi hashshemua vehem omrin kach hu beenenu la hu omer kach hu beenay vehem omrim mippi hashshemua
Ta shema deamar rabbi yoshiyya shelosha devarim sach li zeera meanshe yerushalayim baal shemmachal al kinuo kinuo machul
b: Ben sorer umore sheratzu aviv veimmo limchol lo mochalin lo
Zaken mamre sheratzu bet dino limchol lo mochalin lo uchshebbati etzel chaveray shebbaddarom al shenayim hodu li al zaken mamre lo hodu li kede shello yirbu machlokot beyisrael teuvta

Tanya amar rabbi yose mittechila lo hau marbin machlokot beyisrael ella bet din shel shivim veechad yoshvin belishkat haggazit ushne batte dinin shel esrim ushlosha echad yoshev al petach har habbayit veechad yoshev al petach haazara ushar batte dinin shel esrim ushlosha yoshvin bechol ayerot yisrael

Hutzrach haddavar lishol shoalin mibbet din shebbeiran im shamu amru lahen veim lav bain laze shessamuch leiran im shamu amru lahem veim lav bain laze sheal petach har habbayit im shamu amru lahem veim lav bain laze sheal petach haazara

Veomer kach darashti vechach darshu chaveray kach limmadti vechach limmedu chaveray im shamu amru lahem veim lav ellu vaellu bain lelishkat haggazit sheshsham yoshvin mittamid shel shachar ad tamid shel ben haarbayim
Uvshabbatot uvyamim tovim yoshvin bachel nishala sheela bifnehem im shamu amru lahem veim lav omdin lamminyan rabbu hamtammeim timmeu rabbu hammetaharin tiharu
Mishsherabbu talmide shammay vehillel shello shimmeshu kol tzarkan rabbu machlokot beyisrael venaaset tora kishte torot

Mishsham kotvin vesholchin bechol mekomot kol mi shehu chacham ushfal berech vedaat habberiyyot nocha hemennu yehe dayyan beiro mishsham maalin oto lehar habbayit mishsham laazara mishsham lelishkat haggazit
Shelachu mittam ezehu ben haolam habba anvetan ushfal berech shayef ayel shayef venafek vegares beorayeta tedira vela machzek tevuta lenafsheh yehavu beh rabbanan enayehu berav ulla bar abba
Chazar leiro veshana tanu rabbanan eno chayyav ad sheyyaase kehoraato o sheyyore laacherim veyaasu kehoraato

Bishlama yore laacherim veyaasu kehoraato meikara lav bar ketala hu vehashta bar ketala hu ella sheyyaase kehoraato meikara name bar ketala hu hatinach hecha deori bechelev vadam demeikara lav bar ketala hu vehashta bar ketala hu ella hecha deori bechayyave mitot bet din meikara name bar ketala hu
Meikara bae hatraa hashta la bae hatraa
Mesit dela bae hatraa may ika lememar meikara i amar tama mekabbelinan mineh hashta i amar tama la mekabbelinan mineh
Matni chomer bedivre sofrim mibbedivre tora haomer en tefilin kede laavor al divre tora patur chamesh totafot lehosif al divre sofrim chayyav
Gema amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya eno chayyav ella al davar sheikaro middivre tora uferusho middivre sofrim veyesh bo lehosif veim hosif gorea veen lanu ella tefilin alliba derabbi yehuda
Vehaika lulav deikaro middivre tora uferusho middivre sofrim veyesh bo lehosif veim hosif gorea
Belulav may sevira lan i sevira lan delulav en tzarich eged hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae vei sevira lan detzarich eged garua veomed hu
Vehaika tzitzit deikaro middivre tora uferusho middivre sofrim veyesh bo lehosif veim hosif gorea
Betzitzit may sevira lan i sevira lan dekesher haelon lav deorayeta hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae vei sevira lan

a: Dekesher haelon deorayeta garua veomed

Velishmuel deamar en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud galiyyot bilvad la kashya kan bemachane tzaddikim kan bemachane shechina
Rava rame ketiv ani amit vaachayye uchtiv machatzti vaani erpa amar hakkadosh baruch hu ma sheani memit ani mechayye vahadar ma shemmachatzti vaani erpa

Tanu rabbanan ani amit vaachayye yachol shettehe mita beechad vechayyim beechad kederech shehaolam noheg talmud lomar machatzti vaani erpa ma mechitza urfua beechad af mita vechayyim beechad mikan teshuva laomrin en techiyyat hammetim min hattora

Ella meatta az yivne shelomo bama lichmosh shikkutz moav hachi name deyivne ella maale alav hakkatuv keilu bana

Amar rabbi yochanan

a: Gedolim tzaddikim yoter mimmalache hashsharet shenneemar ane veamar ha ana chaze guvrin arbea sherayin mahlechin bego nura vachaval la itay behon vereveh di reviaa dame levar elahin

Kevan shennistakkel bachananya mishael vaazarya nitkarra dato shenneemar vehu omed ben hahadassim asher bammetzula veen hadassim ella tzaddikim shenneemar vayehi omen et hadassa veen metzula ella bavel shenneemar haomer latztzula choravi venaharotayich ovish miyyad meleim rogez naasim serukkim vaadummim naasu levanim amar rav pappa shema minah susya chivara mealle lechelma
Verabbanan lehecha azalu amar rav beayin hara metu ushmuel amar berok tavu verabbi yochanan amar alu leeretz yisrael venasu nashim veholidu banim uvanot

Ketannae rabbi eliezer omer beayin hara metu rabbi yehoshua omer berok tavu vachachamim omrim alu leeretz yisrael venasu nashim veholidu banim uvanot shenneemar shema na yehoshua hakkohen haggadol atta vereecha hayyoshvim lefanecha ki anshe mofet hemma ezo hem anashim shennaasa lahen mofet heve omer ze chananya mishael vaazarya

Tanu rabbanan shelosha hau beotah etza hakkadosh baruch hu vedaniyyel unvuchadnetztzar hakkadosh baruch hu amar nezil daniyyel mehacha dela lemru bizchuteh itantzul
Vedaniyyel amar ezil mehacha dela likayyam bi pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh
Unvuchadnetztzar amar yezil daniel mehacha dela lemru kalyeh leelaheh benura uminnayin disgid leh dichtiv bedayin malka nevuchadnetztzar nefal al anpohi uldaniyyel segid vego
