Af atta uma bischar arba pesiot sheshshillamti leoto rasha sheratz achar kevodi atta tameha kesheani meshallem sachar leavraham yitzchak veyaakov sheratzu lefanay kesusim al achat kamma vechamma hayenu dichtiv lanneviim nishbar libbi vekirbi rachafu kol atzmotay hayiti keish shikkor uchgever avaro yayin mippene Adonai umippene divre kodsho

Hane arba pesiot may hi dichtiv baet hahi shalach merodach baladan ben baladan melech bavel sefarim vego mishshum ki chala chizkiyyahu vayyechezak shaddar leh sefarim umincha in lidrosh et hammofet asher haya vaaretz deamar rabbi yochanan oto hayyom shemmet bo achaz shette shaot haya

Vechi chala chizkiyyahu veitfach ahderinhu kudsha berich hu lehanach asar shae nihaleh dichtiv hinni meshiv et tzel hammaalot asher yarda vemaalot achaz bashshemesh achorannit eser maalot vattashov hashshemesh eser maalot bammaalot asher yarada amar lehu may hay amaru leh chizkiyyahu chalash veitfach amar ika gavra ki hay vela baena leshaddore leh shelama ketavu leh shelama lemalka chizkiyya shelam lekarta dirushlem shelam leelaha rabba

Nevuchadnetzar safreh devaladan hava hahi shata la hava hatam ki ata amar lehu hechi katvitu amaru leh hachi katvinan amar lehu keretu leh elaha rabba vechatvitu leh levassof amar ella hachi ketuvu shelam leelaha rabba shelam lekarta dirushlem shelam lemalka chizkiyya amri leh karyana deigarta ihu leheve parvanka
Rehat batreh kidrahet arba pesiot ata gavriel veokmeh amar rabbi yochanan ilmale lo ba gavriel veheemido lo haya takkana lesonehem shel yisrael

May baladan ben baladan amri baladan malka hava veishtanni appeh vahava ki dechalba hava yatev bereh al malchuta ki hava katev hava katev shemeh ushmeh daavuh baladan malka hayenu dichtiv ben yechabbed av veeved adonav

Ben yechabbed av ha daamaran veeved adonav dichtiv uvachodesh hachamishi beasor lachodesh hi shenat tesha esre shana lammelech nevuchadnetzar melech bavel ba nevuzaradan rav tabbachim amad lifne melech bavel birushalam vayyisrof et bet Adonai veet bet hammelech
b: Umi selek nevuchad netztzar lirushalayim vehachtiv vayyaalu oto el melech bavel rivlata veamar rabbi avahu zo antochya rav chisda verav yitzchak bar avudimi chad amar demut deokno hayeta chakuka lo al merkavto vechad amar ema yetera hayeta lo mimmennu vedome kemi sheomed lefanav

Amar rava teon telat mea kudanyata narga defarzela deshalet befarzela shaddar leh nevuchadnetztzar linvuzaradan kullehu belatinhu chad dashsha dirushlem shenneemar pittucheha yachad bechashshil vechelappot yahalomun bae lemihdar amar mistefena dela libedu bi ki hechi daavadu besancheriv

Nafka kala veamar shavar bar shavar nevuzaradan shevar dimta zimna demakdesha chariv vehechla mikle pash leh chad narga ata machyeh bekofa veiptach shenneemar yivada kemevi lemala bisvoch etz kardummot

Hava katel veazel ad dimta lehechla adlek beh nura gevah hechla derachu beh min shemayya shenneemar gat darach Adonai livtulat bat yehuda ka zicha dateh nefaka bat kala vaamara leh amma ketila katlatte hechla kalya kelet kimcha techina techente shenneemar kechi rechayim vetachani kamach galli tzammatech chespi shovel galli shok ivri neharot chittim lo neemar ella kemach

Chaza demeh dizcharya dahava ka ratach amar lehu may hay amaru leh dam zevachim hu deishtefich amar lehu ayete vaanasse i middemu kassi vela idmo amar lehu gallo li vei la sarekna lechu levisrayechu bemasreka defarzela

Amaru leh hay kohen venavi hu deinabbi lehu leyisrael bechurbana dirushlem vekatluh amar lehu ana mefayyesna leh ayeti rabbanan katel ilaveh vela nach ayeti dardakke deve rav katel ilaveh vela nach ayeti pirche chehunna katel ilaveh vela nach ad di ketal ilaveh tishin vearbea ribo vela nach

Kerav legabbeh amar zecharya zecharya tovim shebbahen ibadtim nicha lach deektelinhu lechullehu miyyad nach harhar teshuva bedateh amar ma hem shello ibdu ella nefesh achat kach hahu gavra ma tehve aleh arak shaddar purteta leveteh veitgayyar
Tanu rabbanan naaman ger toshav haya nevuzar adan ger tzedek haya mibbene vanav shel sisra limmedu tora birushalayim mibbene vanav shel sancheriv limdu tora barabbim uman ninhu shemaya veavtalon

Mibbene banav shel haman limmedu tora bivne berak veaf mibbene banav shel oto rasha bikesh hakkadosh baruch hu lehichnisan tachat kanfe hashshechina amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam mi shehecheriv et betcha vesaraf et hechalecha tachnis tachat kanfe hashshechina hayenu dichtiv rippinu et bavel velo nirpata ulla amar ze nevuchadnetztzar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar ellu naharot bavel vetargumah tzinyata tzeridata devavlae
Amar ulla ammon umoav shivave bishe dirushlem hao kevan deshaminhu linvie deka mitnabbei lechurbana dirushlem shelachu linvuchadnetztzar pok veta amar mistefena dela libedu li kedaavadu bekammae

Shelachu leh ki en haish beveto halach bederech merachok veen ish ella hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar Adonai ish milchama shelach lehu bekariva hu veate shelachu leh halach bederech merachok shelach lehu it lehu tzaddike devau rachame umayetu leh
Shelachu leh tzeror hakkesef lakach beyado veen kesef ella tzaddikim shenneemar vaekkereha li bachamishsha asar kasef vechomer seorim veletech seorim

Shelach lehu hadri rashshie bitshuva uvau rachame umayetu leh shelachu leh kevar kava lahen zeman shenneemar leom hakkese yavo beto en kese ella zeman shenneemar bakkese leom chaggenu shelach lehu sitva hu vela matzena deate mittalga umimmitra

Shelachu leh ta ashshina detura shenneemar shilchu char moshel eretz missela midbara el har bat tziyyon shelach lehu i atena let li duchta deyatevna beh shelachu leh kevarot shellahem meullin mippalterin shellecha dichtiv baet hahi neum Adonai yotziu et atzmot malche yehuda veet atzmot sarav veet atzmot hakkohanim veet atzmot hanneviim veet atzmot yoshve yerushalam mikkivrehem ushtachum lashshemesh velayyareach ulchol tzeva hashshamayim asher ahevum vaasher avadum vaasher halchu acharehem
Amar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak mi shemia lach emat ate bar nafle amar leh man bar nafle amar leh mashiach mashiach bar nafle karet leh amar leh in dichtiv bayyom hahu akim

a: Et sukkat david hannofelet amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan dor shebben david ba bo talmide chachamim mitmaatim vehashshear enehem kalot beyagon vaanacha vetzarot rabbot ugzerot kashot mitchaddeshot ad sheharishona pekuda sheniyya memaheret lavo

Tanu rabbanan shavua shebben david ba bo shana rishona mitkayyem mikra ze vehimtarti al ir echat veal ir achat lo amtir sheniyya chitze raav mishtallechim shelishit raav gadol umetim anashim venashim vataf chasidim veanshe maase vetora mishtakkachat millomdeha birviit sova veeno sova bachamishit sova gadol veochlin veshotin usmechin vetora chozeret lelomdeha beshishshit kolot bishviit milchamot bemotzae sheviit ben david ba
Amar rav yosef ha kamma shavue dahava ken vela ata amar abbaye beshishshit kolot bishviit milchamot mi hava veod kesidran mi hava

Asher cherfu oyevecha Adonai asher cherfu ikkevot meshichecha tanya rabbi yehuda omer dor shebben david ba bo bet havaad yihye liznut vehaggalil yecherav vehaggavlan yesham veanshe gevul yesovvu meir lair velo yechonanu vechochmat hassofrim tisrach veyire chet yimmaesu ufne haddor kifne chelev

Vehaemet nederet shenneemar vattehi haemet nederet vesar mera mishtolel may vattehi haemet nederet amri deve rav melammed shennaaset adarim adarim veholechet lah may vesar mera mishtolel amri deve rabbi shela kol mi shessar mera mishtolel al habberiyyot

Amar rava meresh hava amena leka kushta bealma amar li hahu merabbanan verav tavut shemeh veamri lah rav tavome shemeh dei hao yahavi leh kol chalale dealma la hava meshanne bedibureh zimna chada iklai lehahu atra vekushta shemeh vela hao meshanne bediburayehu vela hava mayet inish mehatam bela zimneh nesevi itta minhon vahao li teren benin minah

Yoma chad hava yatva devethu veka chayefa resha atay shivavtah terafa addashsha sevari lav orach ara amari lah letah hacha shechivu leh teren beneh ato inashe deatra lekammeh amaru leh may hay amar lehu hachi hava maase amaru leh bematuta minach pok meatrin vela tegare behu motana behanach inashe
Tanya rabbi nehoray omer dor shebben david ba bo nearim yalbinu pene zekenim uzkenim yaamdu lifne nearim uvat kama beimmah vechalla bachamotah ufne haddor kifne chelev veen habben mitbayyesh meaviv

Tanya rabbi nechemya omer dor shebben david ba bo haazzut tirbe vehayyokar yeavet vehaggefen yitten piro vehayyayin beoker venehefacha kol hammalchut leminut veen tochecha mesayya leh lerabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak en ben david ba ad shettithappech kol hammalchut leminut amar rava may kera kullo hafach lavan tahor hu

Tanu rabbanan ki yadin Adonai ammo vego ki yire ki azlat yad veefes atzur veazuv en ben david ba ad sheyyirbu hammasorot davar acher ad sheyyitmaatu hattalmidim davar acher ad shettichle peruta min hakkis davar acher ad sheyyityaashu min haggeulla shenneemar veefes atzur veazuv kivyachol en somech veozer leyisrael
Ki ha derabbi zera ki hava mashkach rabbanan demiasseki beh amar lehu bematuta baena minnayechu la terachakuh ditnena shelosha bain behesach haddaat ellu hen mashiach metzia veakrav

Amar rav kattina shet alfe shene have alma vechad charuv shenneemar venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu abbaye amar tere charuv shenneemar yechayyenu miyyomayim bayyom hashshelishi yekimenu venichye lefanav

Tanya kevateh derav kattina keshem shehashsheviit meshammetet shana achat lesheva shanim kach haolam meshammet elef shanim leshivat alafim shana shenneemar venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu veomer mizmor shir leom hashshabbat yom shekkullo shabbat veomer ki elef shanim beenecha keom etmol ki yaavor
Tana deve eliyyahu sheshet alafim shana have alma shene alafim tohu shene alafim tora shene alafim yemot hammashiach
b: Uvaaonotenu sherabbu yatzu mehem ma sheyyetzu

Amar leh eliyyahu lerav yehuda achuh derav salla chasida en haolam pachot mishshemonim vachamishsha yovlot uvayyovel haacharon ben david ba amar leh bitchilato o besofo amar leh eni yodea kale o eno kale amar leh eni yodea rav ashe amar hachi amar leh ad hacha la tistakke leh mikkan veelach istakke leh

Shelach leh rav chanan bar tachlifa lerav yosef matzati adam echad uvyado megila achat ketuva ashshurit ulshon kodesh amarti lo zo minnayin lach amar li lachayalot shel romi niskarti uven ginze romi metzatiha vechatuv bah leachar arbaat alafim umatayim vetishim veechad shana livriato shel olam haolam yittom mehen milchamot tanninim mehen milchamot gog umagog ushar yemot hammashiach veen hakkadosh baruch hu mechaddesh et olamo ella leachar shivat alafim shana rav acha bereh derava amar leachar chameshet alafim shana itmar
Tanya rabbi natan omer mikra ze nokev veored ad tehom ki od chazon lammoed veyafeach lakketz velo yechazzev im yitmahmah chakke lo ki vo yavo lo yeacher
Lo kerabbotenu shehau dorshin ad iddan iddanin uflag iddan
Vela kerabbi simlay shehaya doresh heechaltam lechem dima vattashkemo bidmaot shelish
Vela kerabbi akiva shehaya doresh od achat meat hi vaani marish et hashshamayim veet haaretz
Ella malchut rishona shivim shana malchut sheniyya chamishshim ushtayim umalchut ben kozeva shette shanim umechetza

May veyafeach lakketz velo yechazzev amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan tipach atzman shel mechashsheve kitzin shehau omrim kevan shehiggia et hakketz velo ba shuv eno ba ella chakke lo shenneemar im yitmahmah chakke lo shemma tomar anu mechakkin vehu eno mechakke talmud lomar velachen yechakke Adonai lachananchem velachen yarum lerachemchem
Vechi meachar sheanu mechakkim vehu mechakke mi meakkev middat haddin meakkevet vechi meachar shemmiddat haddin meakkevet anu lamma mechakkin lekabbel sachar shenneemar ashre kol choche lo

Amar abbaye la pachet alma mittelatin veshita tzaddike dimkabbeli appe shechina bechol dara shenneemar ashre kol choche lo lo begimatriyya telatin veshita hau ini vehaamar rava dara dekamme kudsha berich hu tamne sere alfe parsa havey shenneemar saviv shemona asar alef la kashya ha demistakkeli beispaklarya hammeira ha demistakkeli beispaklarya sheenah meira

Umi nefishi kulle hay vehaamar chizkiyya amar rabbi yirmeya mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay raiti bene aliyya vehen muatin im elef hem ani uvni mehem im mea hem ani uvni mehem im shenayim hem ani uvni hem
La kashya ha deayeli bevar ha deayeli bela bar

Amar rav kalu kol hakkitzin veen haddavar taluy ella bitshuva umaasim tovim ushmuel amar dayyo laavel sheyyaamod beevlo ketannae rabbi eliezer omer im yisrael osin teshuva nigalin veim lav en nigalin amar lo rabbi yehoshua im en osin teshuva en nigalin ella hakkadosh baruch hu maamid lahen melech sheggezerotav kashot kehaman veyisrael osin teshuva umachziran lemutav

Tanya idach rabbi eliezer omer im yisrael osin teshuva nigalin shenneemar shuvu banim shovavim erpa meshuvotechem amar lo rabbi yehoshua vahalo kevar neemar chinnam nimkartem velo vechesef tiggaelu chinnam nimkartem baavoda zara velo bechesef tiggaelu lo bitshuva umaasim tovim

Amar lo rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua vahalo kevar neemar shuvu elay veashuva alechem amar lo rabbi yehoshua vahalo kevar neemar ki anochi baalti vachem velakachti etchem echad meir ushnayim mimmishpacha veheveti etchem tziyyon

Amar lo rabbi eliezer vahalo kevar neemar beshuva vanachat tivasheun amar lo rabbi yehoshua lerabbi eliezer vahalo kevar neemar ko amar Adonai goel yisrael kedosho livzo nefesh limtaev goy leeved moshlim

a: Melachim yiru vakamu sarim veyishtachau

Amar lo rabbi eliezer vahalo kevar neemar im tashuv yisrael neum Adonai elay tashuv amar lo rabbi yehoshua vahalo kevar neemar vaeshma et haish levush habbaddim asher mimmaal lememe hayeor vayyarem yemino usmolo el hashshamayim vayyishshava beche haolam ki lemoed moadim vachetzi uchchallot nappetz yad am kodesh tichlena chol elle vego veshatak rabbi eliezer

Veamar rabbi abba en lecha ketz megulle mizze shenneemar veattem hare yisrael anpechem tittenu uferyechem tisu leammi yisrael vego rabbi eliezer omer af mizze shenneemar ki lifne hayyamim hahem sechar haadam lo nihya uschar habbehema enenna velayyotze velabba en shalom min hatztzar

May layyotze velabba en shalom min hatztzar rav amar af talmide chachamim shekkatuv bahem shalom dichtiv shalom rav leohave toratecha en shalom mippene tzar ushmuel amar ad sheyyihu kol hashshearim kullan shekulin
Amar rabbi chanina en ben david ba ad sheyyitbakkesh dag katan lechole velo yimmatze shenneemar az ashkia memehem venaharotam kashshemen olich uchtiv batreh bayyom hahu atzmiach keren levet yisrael
Amar rabbi chama bar chanina en ben david ba ad shettichle malchut hazzala miyyisrael shenneemar vecharat hazzalzallim bammazmerot uchtiv batreh baet hahi yuval shay la tzevaot am memushshach umorat
Amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu gasse haruach miyyisrael shenneemar ki az asir mikkirbech allize gaavatech uchtiv vehisharti vekirbech am ani vadal vechasu beshem Adonai

Amar rabbi simlay mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu kol shoftim veshotrim miyyisrael shenneemar veashiva yadi alayich veetzrof kabbor sigayich vego veashiva shoftayich

Amar ulla en yerushalayim nifdet ella bitzdaka shenneemar tziyyon bemishpat tippade veshaveha bitzdaka amar rav pappa i batli yehire batli amgushe i batli dayyane batli gezirpate i batli yehire batli amgushe dichtiv veetzrof kabbor sigayich veasira kol bedilayich vei batli dayyane batli gezirpate dichtiv hesir Adonai mishpatayich pinna oyevech

Amar rabbi yochanan im raita dor shemmitmaet veholech chakke lo shenneemar veet am ani toshia vego amar rabbi yochanan im raita dor shetztzarot rabbot baot alav kannahar chakke lo shenneemar ki yavo channahar tzar ruach Adonai nossa vo usmich leh uva letziyyon goel

Veamar rabbi yochanan en ben david ba ella bedor shekkullo zakkay o kullo chayyav bedor shekkullo zakkay dichtiv veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz bedor shekkullo chayyav dichtiv vayyar ki en ish vayyishtomem ki en mafgia uchtiv lemaani eese
Amar rabbi alekkesanderi rabbi yehoshua ben levi rame ketiv beittah uchtiv achishenna zachu achishenna lo zachu beittah
Amar rabbi alekkesanderi rabbi yehoshua ben levi rame ketiv vaaru im anane shemayya kevar enash ate uchtiv ani verochev al chamor zachu im anane shemayya lo zachu ani verochev al chamor
Amar leh shabbur malka lishmuel amritu mashiach al chamra ate eshaddar leh susya barka deit li amar leh mi it lach bar chevar gavene

Rabbi yehoshua ben levi ashkach leeliyyahu dahava kae appitcha dimarta derabbi shimon ben yochay amar leh atena lealma deate amar leh im yirtze adon hazze amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi shenayim raiti vekol shelosha shamati

Amar leh emat ate mashiach amar leh zil shayeleh ledideh vehecha yatev appitcha deromi umay simaneh yatev bene anye sovle cholaim vechullan sharu veasri bechad zimna ihu share chad veasar chad amar dilma mibbeena dela iakkav

Azal legabbeh amar leh shalom alecha rabbi umori amar leh shalom alecha bar levay amar leh leemat ate mar amar leh hayyom ata legabbe eliyyahu amar leh may amar lach amar leh shalom alecha bar levay amar leh avtechach lach velaavuch lealma deate amar leh shakkore ka shakkar bi daamar li hayyom atena vela ata amar leh hachi amar lach hayyom im bekolo tishmau
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi yose ben kisma ematay ben david ba amar mityare ani shemma tevakkeshu mimmenni ot amru lo en anu mevakkeshin mimmecha ot

Amar lahem lichsheyyippol hashshaar hazze veyibbane veyippol veyibbane veyippol veen maspikin livnoto ad shebben david ba amru lo rabbenu ten lanu ot amar lahem velo kach amartem li sheen attem mevakkeshin mimmenni ot
Amru lo veaf al pi chen amar lahem im kach yehafchu me mearat pamyas ledam venehefchu ledam
Bishat petirato amar lahen haamiku li aroni
b: Sheen kol dekel vadekel shebbevavel sheen sus shel parsiyyim nikshar bo veen lach kol aron vearon shebbeeretz yisrael sheen sus madi ochel bo teven
Amar rav en ben david ba ad shettitpashshet malchut harshaa al yisrael tisha chodashim shenneemar lachen yittenem ad et yoleda yalada veyeter echav yeshuvun al bene yisrael
Amar ulla yete vela ichmineh vechen amar rabba yete vela ichmineh rav yosef amar yete veezke deetev betulla dechufita dachamareh

Amar leh abbaye lerabba may tama ilema mishshum chevlo shel mashiach vehatanya shaalu talmidav et rabbi elazar ma yaase adam veyinnatzel mechevlo shel mashiach yaasok betora uvigmilut chasadim umar ha tora veha gemilut chasadim
Amar leh shemma yigrom hachet kidrabbi yaakov bar idi derabbi yaakov bar idi rame ketiv vehinne anochi immach ushmarticha bechol asher telech uchtiv vayyira yaakov meod vayyetzer lo
Shehaya mityare shemma yigrom hachet kidtanya ad yaavor ammecha Adonai zo bia rishona ad yaavor am zu kanit zo bia sheniyya
Emor meatta reuyim hau yisrael laasot lahem nes bevia sheniyya kevia rishona ella sheggaram hachet

Vechen amar rabbi yochanan yete vela ichmineh amar leh resh lakish may tama ilema mishshum dichtiv kaasher yanus ish mippene haari ufgao haddov uva habbayit vesamach yado al hakkir unshacho hannachash bo vearekka dugmato baolam hazze bizman sheadam yotze lassade ufaga bo santar dome kemi sheppaga bo ari nichnas lair paga bo gabbay dome kemi sheppegao dov nichnas leveto umatza banav uvnotav mutalin baraav dome kemi shenneshacho nachash
Ella mishshum dichtiv shaalu na uru im yoled zachar maddua raiti chol gever yadav al chalatzav kayyoleda venehefchu chol panim leyerakon

May raiti kal gever amar rava bar yitzchak amar rav mi shekkol gevura shello umay venehefchu chol panim leyerakon amar rabbi yochanan pamalya shel mala ufamalya shel matta beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu hallalu maase yaday vehallalu maase yaday heach aabbed ellu mippene ellu
Amar rav pappa hayenu deamri inashe rahet venafel tora veazel veshade leh susya beuryeh

Amar rav gidel amar rav atidin yisrael deachli shene mashiach amar rav yosef peshita veella man achel lehu chilak uvilak achli lehu leappoke midderabbi hilel deamar en mashiach leyisrael shekkevar achaluhu bime chizkiyya

Naana rabbi elazar ben azarya veamar tov atta leyisrael yoter meav vaem sheav vaem baolam hazze verabbi baolam hazze uvaolam habba

Naana rabbi akiva veamar chavivin yissurin amar lahem sammechuni veeshmea divre akiva talmidi sheamar chavivin yissurin amar lo akiva zo minnayin lach amar mikra ani doresh ben shettem esre shana menashshe vemolcho vachamishshim vechamesh shana malach birushalam vego vayyaas hara beene Adonai uchtiv
b: Gam elle mishle shelomo asher hetiku anshe chizkiyya melech yehuda vechi chizkiyya melech yehuda lechol haolam kullo limed tora velimnashshe beno lo limed tora ella mikkol torach shettarach bo umikkol amal sheamel bo lo heelahu lemutav ella yissurin shenneemar vayedabber Adonai el menashshe veel ammo velo hikshivu vayyave Adonai alehem et sare hatztzava asher lemelech ashshur vayyilkedu et menashshe bachochim vayyaasruhu banchushtayim vayyolichuhu bavela

Uchtiv uchhatzer lo chilla et pene Adonai elohav vayyikkana meod millifne elohe avotav vayyitpallel elav vayyeater lo vayyishma techinnato vayeshivehu yerushalam lemalchuto vayyeda menashshe ki Adonai hu haelohim ha lamadta shechavivin yissurin

Tanu rabbanan shelosha bau baalila ellu hen kayin esav umnashshe kayin dichtiv gadol aoni minneso amar lefanav ribbono shel olam kelum gadol aoni mishshishshim ribo sheatidin lachto lefanecha veatta soleach lahem esav dichtiv havracha achat hi lach avi menashshe battechila kara leelohot harbe ulvassof kara lelohe avotav
Abba shaul omer af hahoge et hashshem beotiyyotav vechu tana uvaggevulin uvilshon aga

Shelosha melachim vearbaa hedotot vechu tanu rabbanan yarovam sheribea am davar acher yarovam sheasa meriva baam davar acher yarovam sheasa meriva ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim ben nevat ben shennibat velo raa
Tanna hu nevat hu micha hu sheva ben bichri nevat shennibat velo raa micha shennitmachmech bevinyan uma shemo sheva ben bichri shemo
Tanu rabbanan shelosha nibtu velo rau veellu hen nevat vaachitofel veitztagnine paro
Nevat raa esh sheyyotzet meammato hu savar ihu malech vela hi yarovam hu dinfak mineh
Achitofel raa tzaraat shezzarcha lo al ammato hu savar ihu malech vela hi bat sheva bitto hu dinfak minah shelomo

Itztagnine paro deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina may dichtiv hemma me meriva hemma sherau itztagnine paro vetau rau shemmoshian shel yisrael bemayim hu loke amar kol habben hayyillod hayeora tashlichuhu vehen lo yadu sheal iske me meriva loke
Umna lan dela ate lealma deate dichtiv vayehi baddavar hazze lechattat bet yarovam ulhachchid ulhashmid meal pene haadama lehachchid baolam hazze ulhashmid laolam habba

Amar rabbi yochanan mippene ma zacha yarovam lammalchut mippene shehochiach et shelomo umippene ma neenash mippene shehochicho barabbim shenneemar veze haddavar asher herim yad bammelech shelomo bana et hammillo sagar et peretz ir david aviv amar lo david avicha paratz peratzot bachoma kede sheyyaalu yisrael laregel veatta gadarta otam kede laasot angarya levat paro

Umay veze asher herim yad bammelech amar rav nachman shechalatz tefilav befanav amar rav nachman gassut haruach shehaya bo beyarovam teradattu min haolam shenneemar vayyomer yarovam belibbo atta tashuv hammamlacha levet david im yaale haam hazze laasot zevachim bevet Adonai birushalam veshav lev haam hazze el adonehem el rechavam melech yehuda vaharaguni veshavu el rechavam melech yehuda

Amar gemiri deen yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet yehuda bilvad kevan dechazu leh lirchavam deyatev vaana kaemna savri ha malka veha avda vei yatevna mored bammalchut hu vekatlin li veazlu batreh miyyad vayyivaatz hammelech vayyaas shene egle zahav vayyomer alehem rav lachem mealot yerushalam hinne elohecha yisrael asher heelucha meeretz mitzrayim vayyasem et haechad bevet el veet haechad natan bedan

May vayyivaatz amar rabbi yehuda shehoshiv rasha etzel tzaddik amar lehu chatmitu al kol deavedna amaru leh hin amar lehu malka baena lemihve amaru leh hin kol deamena lechu avedtu amaru leh hin afilu lemiflach laavoda zara amar leh tzaddik chas vechalila amar leh rasha letzaddik salka datach degavra keyarovam palach laavoda zara ella lemensinhu hu deka bae i kabbelitu lememreh

a: Veaf achiyya hashshiloni taa vechatam deha yehu tzaddika rabba hava shenneemar vayyomer Adonai el yehu yaan asher hetivota laasot hayyashar beenay kechol asher bilvavi asita levet achav bene reviim yeshvu lecha al kisse yisrael uchtiv veyehu lo shamar lalechet betorat Adonai elohe yisrael bechol levavo lo sar meal chattot yarovam asher hecheti et yisrael
May gerama leh amar abbaye berit keruta lassefatayim shenneemar achav avad et habbaal meat yehu yaavdennu harbe rava amar chotamo shel achiyya hashshiloni raa vetaa

Dichtiv veshachata setim hemiku vaani musar lechullam amar rabbi yochanan amar hakkadosh baruch hu hem haamiku mishshelli ani amarti kol sheeno ole laregel over baase vehem amru kol haole laregel yiddaker bacherev
Vayehi baet hahi veyarovam yatza mirushalam vayyimtza oto achiyya hashshiloni hannavi badderech vehu mitkasse besalma chadasha tana mishshum rabbi yose et hi mezummenet lefuranut

Beet pekuddatam yovedu tana mishshum rabbi yose et mezummenet lefuranut beet ratzon aniticha tana mishshum rabbi yose et mezummenet letova uvom pokdi ufakadti alehem chattatam tana mishshum rabbi yose et hi mezummenet lefuranut vayehi baet hahi vayyered yehuda meet echav tana mishshum rabbi yose et mezummenet lefuranut

Vayyelech rechavam shechem ki shechem ba chol yisrael lehamlich oto tana mishshum rabbi yose makom mezumman lefuranut bishchem inu et dina bishchem machru echav et yosef bishchem nechleka malchut bet david
Veyarovam yatza mirushalayim amar rabbi chanina bar pappa sheyyatza mippitkah shel yerushalayim

Vayyimtza oto achiyya hashshiloni hannavi badderech vehu mitkasse besalma chadasha ushnehem levaddam bassade may besalma chadasha amar rav nachman kesalma chadasha ma salma chadasha en bah shum dofi af torato shel yarovam lo haya bah shum dofi davar acher salma chadasha shechidshu devarim shello shama ozen meolam
May ushnehem levaddam bassade amar rav yehuda amar rav shekkol talmide chachamim domin lifnehem keisve hassade veika deamar shekkol taame tora megullin lahem kassade

Lachen titteni shilluchim al moreshet gat batte achziv leachzav lemalche yisrael amar rabbi chanina bar pappa yatza bat kol veamra lahen mi sheharag et happelishti vehorish etchem gat tittenu shiluchim levanav batte achziv leachzav lemalche yisrael

Amar rabbi chanina bar pappa kol hannehene min haolam hazze belo beracha keilu gozel lehakkadosh baruch hu uchneset yisrael shenneemar gozel aviv veimmo veomer en pasha chaver hu leish mashchit veen aviv ella hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar halo hu avicha kanecha veen immo ella keneset yisrael shenneemar shema beni musar avicha veal tittosh torat immecha
May chaver hu leish mashchit chaver hu leyarovam ben nevat shehishchit yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim
Veyaddach yarovam ben nevat et yisrael meachare Adonai vehechetiam chataa gedola amar rabbi chanin kishte maklot hammattizot zo et zo

Vedi zahav amru deve rabbi yannay amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam bishvil kesef vezahav shehishpata lahen leyisrael ad sheyyomru day garam lahem laasot lahem elohe zahav mashal en ari dores venohem mittoch kuppa shel teven ella mittoch kuppa shel basar

Amar rabbi oshaya ad yarovam hau yisrael yonkim meegel echad mikkan veelach mishshenayim ushlosha agalim amar rabbi yitzchak en lach kol puranut ufuranut shebbaa leolam sheen bah echad meesrim vearbaa behechrea litra shel egel harishon shenneemar uvom pokdi ufakadti alehem chattotam
Amar rabbi chanina leachar esrim vearbaa dorot nigba pasuk ze shenneemar vayyikra veoznay kol gadol lemor karvu pekuddot hair veish keli mashcheto beyado

Achar haddavar hazze lo shav yarovam middarko haraa may achar amar rabbi abba achar shettefaso hakkadosh baruch hu leyarovam bevigdo veamar lo chazor becha vaani veatta uven yishay netayyel began eden amar lo mi barosh ben yishay barosh i hachi la baena
Rabbi avahu hava regil dahava ka daresh bishlosha melachim chalash kabbel aleh dela daresh kevan
b: Deittefach hadar ka daresh amri la kabbelte alach dela darshatte behu amar inhu mi hadaru behu daana ehdar bi
Rav ashe oke ashshelosha melachim amar limchar niftach bechavrin ata menashshe itchazi leh bechelmeh amar chaverach vachavere daavuch karet lan

Mehecha baet lemishre hammotzi amar leh la yadana amar leh mehecha devaet lemishre hammotzi la gemiratte vachaverach karet lan amar leh agmereh li velimchar dareshna leh mishshemach befirka amar leh mehecha dekarem bishula
Amar leh meachar dechakkimatte kulle hay may tama ka palchitu laavoda zara amar leh i havet hatam havet naketatte beshipule gelima verahatatte abbatray limchar amar lehu lerabbanan niftach berabbeota
Achav ach lashshamayim av laavoda zara ach lashshamayim dichtiv ach letzara yivaled av laavoda zara dichtiv kerachem av al banim

Vayehi hanakel lechto bechattot yarovam ben nevat amar rabbi yochanan kallot sheasa achav kachamurot sheasa yarovam umippene ma tala hakkatuv beyarovam mippene shehu haya techila lakkalkala gam mizbechotam kegallim al talme saday amar rabbi yochanan en lach kol telem vatelem beeretz yisrael shello heemid alav achav avoda zara vehishtachava lah
Umna lan dela ate lealma deate dichtiv vehichratti leachav mashtin bekir veatzur veazuv beyisrael atzur baolam hazze veazuv laolam habba

Amar rabbi yochanan mippene ma zacha omri lammalchut mippene shehosif kerach echad beeretz yisrael shenneemar vayyiken et hahar shomron meet shemer bechikkerayim kasef vayyiven et hahar vayyikra et shem hair asher bana al shem shemer adone hahar shomron
Amar rabbi yochanan mippene ma zacha achav lammalchut esrim ushtayim shana

Mippene shekkibed et hattora shennitna beesrim ushtayim otiyyot shenneemar vayyishlach malachim el achav melech yisrael haira vayyomer lo ko amar ben hadad kaspecha uzhavcha li hu venashecha uvanecha hattovim li hem ki im kaet machar eshlach et avaday elecha vechippesu et betcha veet batte avadecha vehaya kol machmad enecha yasimu veyadam velakachu vayyomer lemalache ven hadad imru ladoni hammelech kol asher shalachta el avdecha varishona eese vehaddavar hazze lo uchal laasot
May machmad enecha lav sefer tora

Dilma avoda zara la salka datach dichtiv vayyomru elav kol hazzekenim vechol haam lo tove velo tishma vedilma save devahata hao mi la ketiv vayyishar haddavar beene avshalom uvene kol zikne yisrael veamar rav yosef save devahata
Hatam la ketiv vechol haam hacha ketiv vechol haam dei efshar dela hao behon tzaddike uchtiv vehisharti veyisrael shivat alafim kol habbirkayim asher lo charu labbaal vechol happe asher lo nashak lo

Amar rav nachman achav shakul haya shenneemar vayyomer Adonai mi yefatte et achav veyaal veyippol beramot gilad vayyomer ze becho veze omer becho matkef lah rabbi yosef man dichtiv beh rak lo haya cheachav asher hitmakker laasot hara beene Adonai asher hesatta oto izevel ishto utnena bechol yom hayeta shokelet shikle zahav laavoda zara veatte amratte shakul haya ella achav vatran bemamono haya umittoch shehehena talmide chachamim minnechasav kipru lo mechetza

Vayyetze haruach vayyaamod lifne Adonai vayyomer ani afattennu vayyomer Adonai elav bamma vayyomer etze vehayiti ruach sheker befi kol neviav vayyomer tefatte vegam tuchal tze vaase chen may ruach amar rabbi yochanan rucho shel navot hayyizreeli
May tze amar ravina tze mimmechitzati shekken ketiv dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay amar rav pappa hayenu deamri inashe defara kineh machrev beteh

Vayyaas achav et haashera vayyosef achav laasot lehachis et Adonai elohe yisrael mikkol malche yisrael asher hau lefanav amar rabbi yochanan shekkatav al daltot shomron achav kafar belohe yisrael lefichach en lo chelek belohe yisrael
Vayevakkesh et achazyahu vayyilkeduhu vehu mitchabbe veshomron amar rabbi levi shehaya koder azkarot vechotev avoda zara tachtehen

Menashshe shennasha yah davar acher menashshe shehinshi et yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim umnalan dela ate lealma deate dichtiv ben shettem esre shana menashshe vemolcho vachamishshim vechamesh shana malach birushalam vayyaas ashera kaasher asa achav melech yisrael ma achav en lo chelek laolam habba af menashshe en lo chelek laolam habba

Rabbi yehuda omer menashshe yesh lo chelek laolam habba shenneemar vayyitpallel menashshe el Adonai vayyeater lo vego amar rabbi yochanan ushnehem mikra echad darshu shenneemar untattim lezaava lechol mamlechot haaretz biglal menashshe ven yechizkiyyahu mar savar biglal menashshe sheasa teshuva veinhu la avud umar savar

a: Biglal menashshe dela avad teshuva

Amar rabbi yochanan kol haomer menashshe en lo chelek laolam habba merappe yedehen shel baale teshuva detane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan menashshe asa teshuva lishloshim sheloshim veshalosh shanim dichtiv ben shettem esre shana menashshe vemolcho vachamishshim vechamesh shana malach birushalam vayyaas hara ashera vechu kaasher asa achav melech yisrael kamma malach achav esrin vetarten shenin menashshe kamma malach chamishshim vechamesh dal minayehu esrim vetarten pashu lehu telatin utlat

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay may dichtiv vayyishma elav vayyechater lo vayyeater lo mibe leh melammed sheasa lo hakkadosh baruch hu kemin machteret barakia kede lekabbelo bitshuva mippene middat haddin
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay may dichtiv bereshit mamlechet yehoyakim ben yoshiyyahu uchtiv bereshit mamlechet tzidkiyya vechi ad haidana la hao malche
Ella bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu lehachzir et haolam kullo letohu vavohu bishvil yehoyakim nistakkel bedoro venitkarra dato

Bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu lehachzir et haolam kullo letohu vavohu bishvil doro shel tzidkiyya nistakkel betzidkiyya venitkarra dato betzidkiyya name ketiv vayyaas hara beene Adonai shehaya beyado limchot velo micha

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay may dichtiv ish chacham nishpat et ish evil veragaz vesachak veen nachat amar hakkadosh baruch hu kaasti al achaz untattiv beyad malche dammesek zibach vekiter lelohehem shenneemar vayyizbach lelohe darmesek hammakkim bo vayyomer ki elohe malche aram hem mazerim otam lahem azabbeach veyazeruni vehem hau lo lehachshilo ulchol yisrael

Sachakti im amatzya venatatti malche edom beyado hevi elohehem vehishtachava lahem shenneemar vayehi achare vo amatzyahu mehakkot et adomim vayyave et elohe bene seir vayyaamidem lo lelohim velifnehem yishtachave velahem yekatter amar rav pappa hayenu deamri inashe bechay leh lemar vela yada chayachi lemar vela yada vay leh lemar dela yada ben tav levish

Vayyavou kol sare melech bavel vayyavou vayyeshvu beshaar hattavech amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay makom shemmechattechin bo halachot amar rav pappa hayenu deamri inashe beatra demareh tela leh zeyaneh tamman kulba raaya kulleteh tela
Siman al sede vattim kittim lo teunne

Amar rav chisda amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba may dichtiv al sede ish atzel avarti veal kerem adam chasar lev vehinne ala chullo kimmesonim kossu fanav charullim vegeder avanav neherasa al sede ish atzel avarti ze achaz veal kerem adam chasar lev ze menashshe vehinne ala chullo kimmesonim ze amon kossu fanav charullim ze yehoyakim vegeder avanav neherasa ze tzidkiyyahu shennechrav bet hammikdash beyamav

Veamar rav chisda amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba arba kitot en mekabbelot pene shechina kat letzim kat shakranim kat chanefim kat mesappere lashon hara kat letzim dichtiv mashach yado et lotztzim kat shakranim dichtiv dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay kat chanefim dichtiv ki lo lefanav chanef yavo kat mesappere lashon hara dichtiv ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurcha ra tzaddik atta velo yihye bimgurcha ra

Veamar rav chisda amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba may dichtiv lo teunne elecha raa venega lo yikrav beoholecha lo teunne elecha raa shello yishlot bahen yetzer hara venega lo yikrav beoholecha shello timtza ishtecha sefek nidda beshaa shettavo min hadderech
Davar acher lo teunne elecha raa shello yevaatucha chalomot raim vehirhurim raim venega lo yikrav beoholecha shello yehe lecha ben o talmid shemmakdiach tavshilo barabbim kegon yeshu hannotzri
Ad kan bercho aviv mikkan veelach berchattu immo ki malachav yetzave lach lishmorcha bechol derachecha al kappayim yissauncha vego al shachal vafeten tidroch vego
Ad kan berchattu immo mikkan veelach berchattu shamayim
b: Ki vi chashak vaafalletehu asaggevehu ki yada shemi yikraeni veeenehu immo anochi vetzara achalletzehu vaachabbedehu orech yamim asbiehu vearehu bishuati
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish may dichtiv veyimmana mershaim oram uzroa rama tishshaver mippene ma ayin shel reshaim teluya kevan shennaase adam rash millematta naase rash millemala
Vela nichtevah kelal rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar chad amar mippene kevodo shel david vechad amar mishshum kevodo shel nechemya ben chachalya
Tanu rabbanan menashshe haya shone chamishshim vachamishsha panim betorat kohanim keneged shene malchuto achav shemonim vachamishsha yarovam mea ushlosha

Tanya haya rabbi meir omer avshalom en lo chelek laolam habba shenneemar vayyakku et avshalom vayemituhu vayyakkuhu beolam hazze vayemituhu laolam habba tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir achaz vaachazya vechol malche yisrael shekkatuv bahen vayyaas hara beene Adonai lo chayyin velo nidonin

Vegam dam naki shafach menashshe harbe meod ad asher mille et yerushalam pe lafe levad mechattato asher hecheti et yehuda laasot hara beene Adonai hacha targimu sheharag yeshaya bemareva amri sheasa tzelem massooy elef bene adam uvchol yom vaom horeg et kullam keman azla ha deamar rabba bar bar chana shekula neshama shel tzaddik echad keneged kol haolam kullo keman deamar yeshaya harag
Ketiv pesel uchtiv pesilim amar rabbi yochanan battechilla asa lo partzuf echad ulvassof asa lo arbaa partzufim kede shettire shechina vetichos

Achaz heemido baaliyya shenneemar veet hammizbechot asher al haggag aliyyat achaz vego menashshe heemido bahechal shenneemar vayyasem et pesel haashera asher asa babbayit asher amar Adonai el david veel shelomo veno babbayit hazze uvirushalam asher bacharti mikkol shivte yisrael asim et shemi leolam amon hichniso levet kodshe hakkodashim shenneemar ki katzar hammatztza mehistarea vehammassecha tzara kehitkannes

May ki katzar hammatztza mehistarea amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan ki katzar hammatztza ze millehistarer alav shene reim keechad may vehammassecha tzara vego amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani rabbi yonatan ki hava mate lehay kera hava ka vache mi shekkatav bo kones kanned me hayyam tease lo massecha tzara

Achaz bittel et haavoda vechatam et hattora shenneemar tzor teuda chatom tora belimmuday menashshe kadar et haazkarot veharas et hammizbeach amon saraf et hattora veheela semamit al gabbe hammizbeach achaz hittir et haerva menashshe ba al achoto

Amon ba al immo shenneemar ki hu amon hirba ashma rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar chad amar shessaraf et hattora vechad amar shebba al immo amra lo immo kelum yesh lecha hanaa mimmakom sheyyatzata mimmennu amar lah kelum ani ose ella lehachis et bori

Ki ata yehoyakim amar kammae la yadi leargoze kelum anu tzerichin ella leoro yesh lanu zehav parvayim sheanu mishtammeshin bo yittol oro amru lo vahalo kesef vezahav shello hu shenneemar li hakkesef veli hazzahav neum Adonai tzevaot amar lahem kevar netano lanu shenneemar hashshamayim shamayim la vehaaretz natan livne adam

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari mippene ma lo manu et yehoyakim mishshum dichtiv beh veyeter divre yehoyakim vetoavotav asher asa vehannimtza alav may vehannimtza alav rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar chad amar shechakak shem avoda zara al ammato vechad amar shechakak shem shamayim al ammato
Amar leh bimlachim lo shamati behedotot shamati mippene ma lo manu et micha mippene sheppitto metzuya leovre derachim shenneemar kol haover veshav el halviyyim
Veavar bayyam tzara vehikka vayyam gallim amar rabbi yochanan ze pislo shel micha tanya rabbi natan omer miggarev leshilo shelosha milin vehaya ashan hammaaracha vaashan pesel micha mitarvin ze baze

Bikkeshu malache hashsharet ledochfo amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu hannichu lo sheppitto metzuya leovre derachim veal davar ze neneshu anshe pilegesh baggiva amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu bichvodi lo mechitem al kevodo shel basar vadam mechitem

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben kisma gedola legima shehirchika shette mishpachot miyyisrael shenneemar al devar asher lo kiddemu etchem ballechem uvammayim verabbi yochanan dideh amar meracheket et hakkerovim umkarevet et harchokim umaalemet enayim min harshaim umashra shechina al nevie habbaal veshiggato ola zadon
