Vayemaher moshe vayyikkod artza vayyishtachu ma raa moshe

Rabbi chanina ben gamla amar erech appayim raa verabbanan amri emet raa tanya keman deamar erech appayim raa detanya kesheala moshe lemarom metzao lehakkadosh baruch hu sheyyoshev vechotev erech appayim amar lefanav ribbono shel olam erech appayim latztzaddikim amar lo af larshaim amar leh reshaim yovedu amar leh hashta chazet may demibbee lach
Keshechatu yisrael amar lo lo kach amarta li erech appayim latztzaddikim
b: Amar lefanav ribbono shel olam velo kach amarta li af larshaim vehayenu dichtiv veatta yigdal na koach Adonai kaasher dibbarta lemor

Rabbi chagga hava salek veazel bedarga deve rabba bar shela shameh lehahu yanoka deamar edotecha neemnu meod levetcha naava kodesh Adonai leorech yamim usmich leh tefilla lemoshe vego amar shema minah erech appayim raa

Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina atid hakkadosh baruch hu lihot atara berosh kol tzaddik vetzaddik shenneemar bayyom hahu yihye Adonai tzevaot laateret tzevi velitzfirat tifara lishar ammo vego may laateret tzevi velitzfirat tifara laosim retzono umtzappim lishuato yachol lakkol talmud lomar lishar ammo lemi shemmesim atzmo keshirayim

Ulruach mishpat layyoshev al hammishpat veligvura meshive milchama shara ulruach mishpat ze harode et yitzro velayyoshev al hammishpat ze haddan din emet laamito veligvura ze hammitgabber beyitzro meshive milchama ze shennose venoten bemilchamtah shel tora shara ellu shemmashkimin umaarivin bevatte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot

Amra middat haddin lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam ma nishtannu ellu meellu amar lah vegam elle bayyayin shagu uvashshechar tau vego paku peliliyya veen puka ella gehinnam shenneemar lo tihye zot lecha lefuka veen pelila ella dayyanin shenneemar venatan biflilim

Matni anshe ir hanniddachat en lahem chelek laolam habba shenneemar yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal mikkirbecha vayyaddichu et yoshve iram lemor veenan neheragim ad sheyyihu maddicheha meotah hair umeoto hashshevet vead sheyyudach rubbah vead sheyyaddichuha anashim hiddichuha nashim uktannim o shehuddach miutah o shehau maddicheha chutza lah hare ellu kichidim utzrichin shene edim vehatraa lechol echad veechad
Ze chomer bayechidim mibbamrubbim shehayechidim biskila lefichach mamonam palet vehamrubbin besayif lefichach mamonam aved
Hakke takke et yoshve hair hazzot lefi cherev hachammeret vehaggammelet haoveret mimmakom lemakom hare ellu matztzilin otah

Shenneemar hacharem otah veet kol asher bah veet behemtah lefi charev mikkan amru nichse tzaddikim shebbetochah ovdin shebbechutza lah peletin veshel reshaim ben shebbetochah ben shebbechutza lah hare ellu ovdin
Shenneemar veet kol shelalah tikbotz el toch rechovah vego im en lah rechov osin lah rechov hayeta rechovah chutza lah konsin otah letochah
Shenneemar vesarafta vaesh et hair veet kol shelalah kalil la elohecha shelalah velo shelal shamayim mikkan amru hahekdeshot shebbah yippadu utrumot yerakvu maaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh yigganzu
Kalil la elohecha amar rabbi shimon amar hakkadosh baruch hu im attem osin din beir hanniddachat maale ani alechem keilu attem maalim ola kalil lefanay

Vehayeta tel olam lo tease gannot ufardesim divre rabbi yose haggelili rabbi akiva omer lo tibbane od lichmot shehayeta enah nivnet aval naaset hi gannot ufardesim velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem shekkol zeman sheharshaim baolam charon af baolam avdu reshaim min haolam nistallek charon af min haolam
Gema tanu rabbanan yatzu hen velo sheluchin anashim en anashim pachot mishshenayim davar acher anashim velo nashim anashim velo ketannim
Bene beliyyaal banim shepparku ol shamayim mitztzavverehem mikkirbecha velo min hassefar yoshve iram velo yoshve ir acheret lemor shetztzerichin edim vehatraa lechol echad veechad

Itmar rabbi yochanan amar cholkin ir achat lishne shevatim veresh lakish amar en cholkin ir achat lishne shevatim etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish ad sheyehu maddicheha meotah hair umeoto shevet may lav af al gav demaddicheha meotah hair i ika meoto shevet in i la la shema minah cholkin ir achat lishne shevatim
La dinfala leh birusha i name deyahavuha nihaleh bemattana
Etiveh arim tesha meet shene hashshevatim haelle may lav arba ufalga mehay vearba ufalga mehay ushma minah cholkin ir achat lishne shevatim la arba mehay vechamesh mehay
I hachi lifrosh paroshe

a: Kashya
Ibaya lehu huddechu mealehen mahu vayyaddichu amar rachamana velo shehuddechu mealehen o dilma afilu huddechu mealehen
Ta shema hiddichuha nashim uktannim ammay leheve kehuddechu mealehen hanach batar nafshayehu geridi hane batar nashim uktannim geridi
Ad sheyyudach rubbah hechi avdinan amar rav yehuda danin vechovshin danin vechovshin amar leh ulla nimtza atta meanne et dinan shel ellu ella amar ulla danin vesoklin danin vesoklin
Itmar rabbi yochanan amar danin vesoklin danin vesoklin veresh lakish amar marbin lahen batte dinin

Ini vehaamar rabbi chama bar yose amar rabbi oshaya vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi ish veishsha atta motzi lisharecha vei atta motzi kal hair kullah lisharecha ella marbin lahen batte dinin umayenin bedinehen umassekinan lehu levet din haggadol vegamri lehu ledinayehu vekatli lehu

Hakke takke et yoshve hair vechu tanu rabbanan hachammeret vehaggammelet haoveret mimmakom lemakom lanu betochah vehuddechu immah im nishtahu sham sheloshim yom hen besayif umamonan aved pachot mikan hen biskila umamonan palet
Urminhi kamma yihye bair veyihye keanshe hair shenem asar chodesh amar rava la kashya ha lemihve mibbene mata ha lemihve miyyatve mata

Vehatanya hammuddar hanaa mibbene hair im yesh adam shennishtaha sham shenem asar chodesh asur lehanot mimmennu pachot mikan muttar lehanot mimmennu beoshve hair im nishtaha sheloshim yom asur lehanot mimmennu pachot mikan muttar lehanot mimmennu

Hacharem otah veet kol asher bah ku tanu rabbanan hacharem otah veet kol asher bah perat lenichse tzaddikim shebbechutza lah veet kol asher bah lerabbot nichse tzaddikim shebbetochah shelalah velo shelal shamayim veet kol shelalah lerabbot nichse reshaim shechutza lah

Amar rabbi shimon mippene ma amra tora nichse tzaddikim shebbetochah yovedu mi garam lahem sheyyaduru betochah mamonam lefichach mamonam aved amar mar veet kol shelalah tikbotz lerabbot nichse reshaim shebbechutza lah amar rav chisda uvnikbatzim letochah

Amar rav chisda pikdonot shel anshe ir hanniddachat muttarin hechi dame i lema deir acheret veitanhu begavah peshita demuttarin lav shelalah hu veella didhu veitanhu beir acheret i denikbatzin letochah ammay muttarin vei en nikbatzin letochah ha amrah chada zimna
La leolam deir acheret demafkedi betochah vehacha bemay askinan kegon dekabbel aleh achraut mahu detema kevan dekabbel aleh achraut kedideh dame ka mashma lan

Amar rav chisda behema chetzyah shel ir hanniddachat vechetzyah shel ir acheret asura isa chetzyah shel ir hanniddachat vechetzyah shel ir acheret mutteret may tama behema keman dela peliga damya isa keman difliga damya

Bae rav chisda behemat ir hanniddachat mahu detithane bah shechita letaharah mide nevela lefi cherev amar rachamana la shena shachatah mishchat la shena katlah miktal o dilma kevan deshachtah mahneya lah shechita may teku
Bae rav yosef sear nashim tzidkaniyyot mahu amar rava ha dirshaiyyot asur tikbotz vesarafta ketiv mi sheeno mechussar ella kevitza usrefa yatza ze shemchussar telisha ukvitza usrefa
Ella amar rava befea nochrit hechi dame i dimchubbar begufah kegufah damya la tzericha ditle besivta kenichse tzaddikim shebbetochah dame veavad o dilma kevan deayela venafka kilvushah dame teku

Veet kol shelalah tikbotz el toch rechovah vechu tanu rabbanan en lah rechov enah naaset ir hanniddachat divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer en lah rechov osin lah rechov bemay kamipalgi mar savar rechovah meikara mashma umar savar rechovah hashta name mashma
b: Vehahekdeshot shebbah yippadu ku tanu rabbanan hau bah kodshe kodashim kodshe mizbeach yamutu kodshe bedek habbayit yippadu utrumot yerakvu umaaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh yigganzu rabbi shimon omer behemtah velo behemat bechor umaaser shelalah perat lechesef hekdesh vechesef maaser
Amar mar hau bah kodshe kodashim kodshe mizbeach yamutu veammay yamutu yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava
Rabbi yochanan amar zevach reshaim toeva resh lakish amar mamon bealim hu vehacha bekadashim shechayyav beachrautan verabbi shimon hi deamar mamon bealim hu
Ha middesefa rabbi shimon hi resha lav rabbi shimon bekadashim kallim vealliba derabbi yose haggelili deamar kadashim kallim mamon bealim aval kodshe kadashim may yippadu
Addetane sefa kodshe bedek habbayit yippadu liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim bekadashim kallim aval kodshe kadashim yippadu kevan deika chattat shemmetu bealeha dilmita azla la pesika leh

Bishlama rabbi yochanan la amar keresh lakish dichtiv zevach reshaim toeva ella resh lakish may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan amar lach ki amrinan zevach reshaim toeva hane mile hecha deitanhu beenayehu aval hacha kevan deishtanni ishtanni
Rabbi shimon omer behemtah velo behemat bechor umaaser bemay askinan ilema bitmimin shelal shamayim hu ella bevaale mumin shelalah ninhu
Amar ravina leolam bevaale mumin umi shenneechal betorat behemtah yatzu ellu sheen neechalin betorat behemtah ella betorat bechor umaaser dishlal shamayim ninhu

Ufliga dishmuel deamar shemuel hakkol karev vehakkol nifde may kaamar hachi kaamar kol shekkarev keshehu tam venifde keshehu baal mum mishshelalah imit vechol shekkarev keshehu tam veeno nifda keshehu baal mum kegon bechor umaaser mibbehemtah nafka
Terumot yerakvu amar rav chisda lo shanu ella teruma beyad yisrael aval teruma beyad kohen kevan demamoneh hu tissaref

Metiv rav yosef maaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh yigganzu veha maaser sheni beyad yisrael kitruma beyad kohen dame vekatane yigganzu ella i ittemar hachi ittemar amar rav chisda lo shanu ella teruma beyad kohen aval teruma beyad yisrael tinnaten lechohen shebbeir acheret

Tenan hatam isa shel maaser sheni petura min hachalla divre rabbi meir vachachamim mechayevin amar rav chisda machloket bemaaser sheni birushalayim derabbi meir savar maaser sheni mamon gavoha hu verabbanan savri mamon hedot hu aval bigvulin divre hakkol patur

Metiv rav yosef maaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh yigganzu bemay askinan ilema birushalayim mi haveya ir hanniddachat vehatanya asara devarim neemru birushalayim vezo achat mehen enah naaset ir hanniddachat veella beir acheret veassekuh legavah ha kaltuh mechitzot
Ella lav bigvulin vekatane yigganzu la leolam deir acheret veassekuh legavah vehacha bemay askinan shennitma

Velifrekeh deamar rabbi elazar minnayin lemaaser sheni shennitma sheppodin oto afilu birushalayim talmud lomar lo tuchal seeto veen seet ella achila shenneemar vayyissa masot meet panav hacha bemay askinan belakuach

a: Velifrekeh ditnan hallakuach bechesef maaser shennitma yippade kerabbi yehuda deamar yikkaver i hachi may irya ir hanniddachat afilu dealma name
Ella leolam betahor uchgon dinful mechitzot vechidrava deamar rava mechitza leechol deorayeta liklot derabbanan vechi gezur rabbanan ki itanhu limchitzot ki letanhu limchitzot la

Kitve hakkodesh yigganzu matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer detanya rabbi eliezer omer kol ir sheyyesh bah afilu mezuza achat enah naaset ir hanniddachat shenneemar vesarafta vaesh et hair veet kol shelalah kalil vehecha deika mezuza la efshar dichtiv lo taasun ken la elohechem

Rabbi shimon omer amar hakkadosh baruch hu vechu lema bidrabbi avin amar rabbi ila kamipalgi deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila kol makom sheatta motze kelal baase ufrat belo taase en danin oto bichlal ufrat
Demar it leh derabbi avin umar let leh derabbi avin
La dechulle alma it lehu derabbi avin vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar od ligmare mashma umar savar od lichma shehayeta enah nivnet aval naaset hi gannot ufardesim

Tanu rabbanan hau bah ilanot telushin asurin mechubbarin muttarin shel ir acheret ben telushin ben mechubbarin asurin may ir acheret amar rav chisda yericho dichtiv vehayeta hair cherem la vayyashba yehoshua baet hahi lemor arur haish lifne Adonai asher yakum uvana et hair hazzot et yericho bivchoro yeyassedenna uvitziro yatztziv delateha
Tanya lo yericho al shem ir acheret velo ir acheret al shem yericho dichtiv bana chiel bet haeli et yericho baaviram bechoro yissedah uvisguv tzeiro hitztziv delateha
Tanya baaviram bechoro rasha lo haya lo lilmod bisguv tzeiro haya lo lilmod

Aviram usguv may avud may kaamar hachi kaamar baaviram bechoro haya lo lilmod leoto rasha bisguv tzeiro mimmashma shenneemar baaviram bechoro eni yodea shesseguv tzeiro ma talmud lomar seguv tzeiro melammed shehaya mekabber veholech meaviram ad seguv

Achav shoshvineh hava ata ihu veeliyyahu lemishal bishlama be tamya yatev vekaamar dilma ki lat yehoshua hachi lat lo yericho al shem ir acheret velo ir acheret al shem yericho amar leh eliyyahu in amar leh hashta levatta demoshe la ka mikkayema dichtiv vesartem vaavadtem vego uchtiv vechara af Adonai bachem veatzar et hashshamayim vego vehahu gavra okem leh avoda zara al kol telem vetelem vela shavek leh mitra lemezal misgad leh levatta dihoshua talmideh mikkayema
Miyyad vayyomer eliyyahu hattishbi mittoshave gilad chay Adonai elohe yisrael im yihye tal umatar vego bae rachame vihavu leh aklida demitra vekam vaazal

Vayehi devar Adonai elav lemor lech mizze ufanita lecha kedma venistarta benachal kerit vehaorvim meviim lo lechem uvasar babboker vego mehecha amar rav yehuda amar rav mibbe tabbache deachav vayehi mikketz yamim vayyivash hannachal ki lo haya geshem baaretz kevan dachaza deika tzaara bealma ketiv vayehi devar Adonai elav lemor kum lech tzarfata

Uchtiv vayehi achar haddevarim haelle chala ben haishsha baalat habbayit bea rachame lemitan leh aklida ditchiyyat hammetim amri leh shalosh maftechot lo nimseru leshaliach shel chayya veshel geshamim veshel techiyyat hammetim yomru shettayim beyad talmid veachat beyad harav ayeti ha ushkel hay dichtiv lech herae el achav veettena matar
Derash hahu galilaa kammeh derav chisda mashal deeliyyahu lamma haddavar dome legavra detarkeh legalleh veabbedeh lemaftecheh
Daresh rabbi yose betzipori abba eliyyahu
b: Kappedan hava regil lemete gabbeh ikassi mineh telata yome vela ata ki ata amar leh ammay la ata mar amar leh kappedan karet li amar leh ha dekamman deka kafed mar
Velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem kol zeman shershaim baolam charon af baolam vechu man reshaim amar rav yosef gannave

Tanu rabbanan rasha ba laolam charon ba leolam shenneemar bevo rasha ba gam buz veim kalon cherpa rasha aved min haolam tova baa leolam shenneemar uvaavod reshaim rinna tzaddik niftar min haolam raa baa leolam shenneemar hatztzaddik avad veen ish sam al lev veanshe chesed neesafim been mevin ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik tzaddik ba laolam tova baa leolam shenneemar ze yenachamenu mimmaasenu umeitztzevon yadenu
Hadaran alach kol yisrael yesh lahem chelek uslika lah massechet sanhedrin

a: Matni ketzad haedim naasim zommin meidin anu beish peloni shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza en omrim yease ze ben gerusha o ben chalutza tachtav ella loke arbaim
Meidin anu beish peloni shehu chayyav liglot en omrim yigle ze tachtav ella loke arbaim

Gema ha ketzad en haedim naasim zommin mibe leh veod middekatane lekamman aval amru lahem heach attem meidin hare beoto hayyom attem heyitem immanu bemakom peloni hare ellu zommin mikkelal deellu en zommin
Tanna hatam kae kol hazzommin makdimin leotah mita chutz mizzomme bat kohen uvoalah sheen makdimin leotah mita ella lemita acheret

Veyesh edim zommin acherim sheen osin bahen din hazama kol ikar ella malkot arbaim ketzad meidin anu beish peloni shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza en omrim yease ze ben gerusha o ben chalutza tachtav ella loke et haarbaim

Menahane mile amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar rabbi shimon ben lakish deamar kera vaasitem lo kaasher zamam lo velo lezaro velifseluhu ledideh vela lifselu lezareh bainan kaasher zamam laasot veleka
Bar peda omer kal vachomer uma hamchallel eno mitchallel habba lechallel velo chilel eno din shello yitchallel matkef lah ravina im ken bittalta torat edim zommin
b: Uma hassokel eno niskal habba liskol velo sakal eno din shello yissakel ella mechavarta kidshanninan meikara
Meidin anu beish peloni shehu chayyav galut ku mena hane mile amar resh lakish deamar kera hu yanus el achat hearim hu vela zommin
Rabbi yochanan omer kal vachomer uma hu sheasa maase bemezid eno gole hen shello asu maase bemezid eno din shello yiglu
Vehi notenet vahalo din hu hu sheasa maase bemezid la ligle ki hechi dela tehve leh kappara hen shello asu maase bemezid name liglo ki hechi delehve lehu kappara ella mechavarta kidresh lakish

Amar ulla remez leedim zommin min hattora minnayin remez leedim zommin veha ketiv vaasitem lo kaasher zamam ella remez leedim zommin shellokin min hattora minnayin dichtiv vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik vehirshiu et harasha vehaya im bin hakkot harasha mishshum vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik vehirshiu et harasha vehaya im bin hakkot harasha
Ella edim shehirshiu et hatztzaddik vaato edim acharine vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik demeikara veshavinhu lehane reshaim vehaya im bin hakkot harasha
Vetipok leh millo taane mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav

Tanu rabbanan arbaa devarim neemru beedim zommin en naasin ben gerusha uven chalutza veen golin leare miklat veen meshallemin et hakkofer veen nimkarin beeved ivri mishshum rabbi akiva amru af en meshallemin al pi atzman
En naasin ben gerusha uven chalutza kedaamaran veen golin leare miklat kedaamaran veen meshallemin et hakkofer kasavri kufra kappara vehane lav bene kappara ninhu

Man tana kufra kappara amar rav chisda rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi detanya venatan pidyon nafsho deme nizak rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer deme mazzik may lav beha ka mipalgi demar savar kufra mamona umar savar kufra kappara
Amar rav pappa la dechulle alma kufra kappara vehacha beha ka mipalgi mar savar bidnizak shayeminan umar savar bidmazzik shayeminan
May tamayehu derabbanan neemar hashata lematta veneemar hashata lemala ma lehallan bidnizak af kan bidnizak
Verabbi yishmael venatan pidyon nafsho ketiv verabbanan en pidon nafsho ketiv mihu ki shayeminan bidnizak shayeminan

Veen nimkarin beeved ivri savar rav hamnuna lememar hane mile hecha deit leh ledideh demigo deihu la nizdabban inhu name la mizdabbenu aval hecha delet leh ledideh af al gav deit lehu ledidhu mizdabbenu

Amar leh rava velemru leh i ante hava lach mi hava mizdabbenatte anan name la mizdabbeninan ella savar rav hamnuna lememar hane mile hecha deit leh o ledideh o ledidhu aval hecha delet leh la ledideh vela ledidhu mizdabbeni amar leh rava venimkar bignevato amar rachamana bignevato velo bizmamo

Mishshum rabbi akiva amru vechu may tama derabbi akiva kasavar kenasa hu uknas en meshallem al pi atzmo amar rabba teda shehare lo asu maase veneheragim umshallemin amar rav nachman teda shehare mamon beyad bealim umshallemim

a: May nihu delo asu maase hayenu derabba ema vechen amar rav nachman
Amar rav yehuda amar rav ed zomem meshallem lefi chelko may meshallem lefi chelko ilema dehay meshallem palga vehay meshallem palga tenena meshalleshin bemamon veen meshalleshin bemalkot
Ella kegon deitazzum chad minayehu dimshallem palga dideh umi meshallem veha tanya en ed zomem meshallem mamon ad sheyyizzommu shenehem
Amar rava beomer edut sheker headti kol kemineh kevan shehiggid shuv eno chozer umaggid
Ella beomer headnu vehuzamnu bevet din peloni keman dela kerabbi akiva dei kerabbi akiva ha amar af eno meshallem al pi atzmo
Ella beomer headnu vehuzamnu bevet din peloni vechuyyavnu mamon
Salka datach amena kevan dilchavreh la matze mechayyev leh ihu name la michayyav ka mashma lan
Matni meidin anu et ish peloni sheggerash et ishto velo natan lah ketuvatah vahalo ben hayyom uven lemachar sofo liten lah ketuvatah
Omdin kamma adam rotze liten bichtubbatah shel zo sheim nitalmena o nitgarsha veim meta yirashenna baalah
Gema ketzad shamin amar rav chisda babbaal
Rav natan bar oshaya omer baishsha
Amar rav pappa baishsha uvichtubbatah
Matni meidin anu beish peloni shehu chayyav lachavero elef zuz al menat litnan lo mikkan vead sheloshim yom vehu omer mikkan vead eser shanim
Omdim kamma adam rotze liten veyihu beyado elef zuz ben notnan mikkan vead sheloshim yom ben notnan mikkan vead eser shanim
Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hammalve et chavero leeser shanim sheviit meshammatto
b: Veaf al gav dehashta la karenan beh lo yiggos sof ate lide lo yiggos

Metiv rav kahana omdim kamma adam rotze liten veyihu elef zuz beyado ben liten mikkan vead sheloshim yom uven liten mikkan vead eser shanim vei amratte sheviit meshammatto kullehu name bae shallome leh
Amar rava hacha bemay askinan bemalve al hammashkon uvmoser shetarotav levet din ditnan hammalve al hammashkon vehammoser shetarotav levet din en mashmitin
Ika deamri amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hammalve et chavero leeser shanim en sheviit meshammatto veaf al gav deate lide lo yiggos hashta miha la karenan beh lo yiggos

Amar rav kahana af anan name tenena omdin kamma adam rotze liten veyihu elef zuz beyado ben liten mikkan vead sheloshim yom uven liten mikkan vead eser shanim vei amratte sheviit meshammatto kullehu name bau shallome leh
Amar rava hacha bemay askinan bemalve al hammashkon uvmoser shetarotav levet din ditnan hammalve al hammashkon vehammoser shetarotav levet din en mashmitin

Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel haomer lachavero al menat shello teshammeteni sheviit sheviit meshammetet lema kasavar shemuel matne al ma shekkatuv battora hu vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel
Veha itmar haomer lachavero al menat sheen lecha alay onaa rav omer yesh lo alav onaa ushmuel omer en lo alav onaa
Ha itmar alah amar rav anan ledidi mipparsha leh mineh dishmuel al menat sheen lecha alay onaa en lo alav onaa al menat sheen bo onaa hare yesh bo onaa
Hacha name al menat shello teshammeteni bashsheviit en sheviit meshammatto al menat shello teshammeteni sheviit sheviit meshammatto

Tana hammalve et chavero setam eno rashshay letovo pachot mishsheloshim yom sevar rabba bar bar channa kammeh derav lememar hane mile bemilve bishtar dela avid inish detarach dechatev shetar betzir mittelatin yomin aval milve al pe la amar leh rav hachi amar chavivi echad hammalve bishtar veechad hammalve al pe
Tanya name hachi hammalve et chavero setam eno rashshay letovo pachot mishsheloshim yom echad hammalve bishtar veechad hammalve al pe

Amar leh shemuel lerav matna la titev akkaracha ad dimfarshatte lah leha shemata mena ha milta daamur rabbanan hammalve et chavero setam eno rashshay letovo pachot mishsheloshim yom echad hammalve bishtar veechad hammalve al pe

Amar leh dichtiv karva shenat hashsheva shenat hashshemitta mimmashma shenneemar karva shenat hashsheva eni yodea shehi shenat shemitta ella ma talmud lomar shenat hashshemitta lomar lach yesh shemitta acheret shehi kazo veezo zo hammalve et chavero setam sheeno rashshay letovo befachot mishsheloshim yom deamar mar sheloshim yom bashshana chashuv shana
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav happoteach bet hatztzavar beshabbat chayyav chattat matkef lah rav kahana vechi ma ben ze limgufat chavit amar leh ze chibbur veze eno chibbur

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav sheloshet luggin mayim shennafal letochan kurtov shel yayin umarehen kemare yayin venaflu lemikve lo pesaluhu matkef lah rav kahana vechi ma ben ze leme tzeva ditnan rabbi yose omer me tzeva poslin et hammikve bishloshet luggin amar leh rava hatam mayya detziva mikkere hacha chamra meziga mikkere
Vehatane rabbi chiyya horidu et hammikve amar rava la kashya ha rabbi yochanan ben nuri ha rabbanan ditnan sheloshet luggin mayim

a: Chaser kurtov shennafal letochan kurtov yayin umarehen kemare yayin venaflu lammikve lo pesaluhu vechen shelosha luggin mayim chaser kurtov shennafal letochan kurtov chalav umarehen kemare mayim venaflu lammikve lo pesaluhu
Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer hakkol holech achar hammare

Ha mibaya bae lah rav pappa devae rav pappa rav tane chaser kurtov beresha aval shelosha luggin letanna kamma pasli vaata rabbi yochanan lememar hakkol holech achar hammare verav omer kerabbi yochanan ben nuri
O dilma rav la tane chaser kurtov beresha verabbi yochanan ben nuri ki pelig assefa hu diflig
Verav deamar kedivre hakkol
Lerav pappa mibaya leh lerava peshita leh
Amar rav yosef la shemia li ha shemata amar leh abbaye atte amarte lah nihalan vehachi amarte nihalan derav la tane chaser kurtov beresha verabbi yochanan assefa pelig verav deamar kedivre hakkol

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav chavit melea mayim shennafla layyam haggadol hattovel sham lo alta lo tevila chayeshinan lishlosha luggin shello yehu bemakom echad vedaveka layyam haggadol dekae vekayema aval nahara bealma la

Tanya name hachi chavit melea yayin shennafla layyam haggadol hattovel sham lo alta lo tevila chayeshinan lishlosha luggin sheuvin shello yehu bemakom echad vechen kikkar shel teruma shennafal sham tame
May vechen mahu detema hatam oke gavra achezkeh hacha oke teruma achezkah ka mashma lan

Matni meidin anu beish peloni shechayyav lachavero matayim zuz venimtzeu zommin lokin umshallemin shello hashshem hammevian lide makkot mevian lide tashlumin divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim kol hamshallem eno loka

Meidin anu beish peloni shehu chayyav malkot arbaim venimtzeu zommin lokin shemonim mishshum lo taane vereacha ed shaker umishshum vaasitem lo kaasher zamam divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim en lokin ella arbaim
b: Gema bishlama lerabbanan kede rishato ketiv mishshum risha achat atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum shette rishaot ella rabbi meir may tama
Amar ulla gamar mimmotzi shem ra ma motzi shem ra loke umshallem af kol loke umshallem ma lemotzi shem ra shekken kenas savar lah kerabbi akiva deamar edim zommin kenasa hu
Ika dematne leha deulla aha detanya lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vehannotar mimmennu ad boker vego ba hakkatuv liten ase achar lo taase lomar sheen lokin alav divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi akiva omer lo min hashshem hu ze ella mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar lav sheen bo maase lokin alav mena leh
Amar ulla gamar mimmotzi shem ra ma motzi shem ra lav sheen bo maase lokin alav af kol lav sheen bo maase lokin alav ma lemotzi shem ra shekken loke umshallem
Ella amar resh lakish gamar meedim zommin ma edim zommin lav sheen bo maase lokin alav af kol lav sheen bo maase lokin alav ma leedim zommin shekken en tzerichin hatraa
Motzi shem ra yochiach vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen lav sheen bo maase velokin alav af kol lav sheen bo maase lokin alav
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken kenas ha la kashya rabbi yehuda la savar lah kerabbi akiva
Ella ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahen tzad chamur verabbi yehuda tzad chamur la parech
Verabbanan hay lo taane vereacha ed shaker may darshi beh
Hahu mibe leh leazhara leedim zommin verabbi meir azhara leedim zommin mena leh amar rabbi yirmeya nafka leh mivvehannisharim yishmeu veyirau velo yosifu od
Verabbanan hahu mibe leh

a: Lehachraza verabbi meir hachraza miyyishmeu veyirau nafka

Matni meshalleshin bammamon veen meshalleshin bammakkot ketzad heiduhu shehu chayyav lachavero matayim zuz venimtzeu zommin meshalleshin benehem aval im heiduhu shehu chayyav malkot arbaim venimtzeu zommin kol echad veechad loke arbaim
Gema mena hane mile amar abbaye neemar rasha bechayyave malkiyyot veneemar rasha bechayyave mitot bet din ma lehallan en mita lemechetza af kan en malkot lemechetza
Rava amar bainan kaasher zamam laasot leachiv veleka i hachi mamon name mamon mitztaref malkot la mitztaref
Matni en haedim naasim zommin ad sheyyazemu et atzman

Ketzad amru meidin ani beish peloni sheharag et hannefesh amru lahem heach attem meidin shehare neherag ze o hahoreg ze haya immanu oto hayyom bemakom peloni en ellu zommin aval amru lahem heach attem meidin shehare attem heyitem immanu oto hayyom bemakom peloni hare ellu zommin veneheragin al pihem
Bau acherim vehezimum bau acherim vehezimum afilu mea kullam yehargu rabbi yehuda omer istatit hi zo veeno neherag ella kat harishona bilvad
Gema mena hane mile amar rav adda deamar kera vehinne ed sheker haed sheker ana ad shettishshaker gufah shel edut
Deve rabbi yishmael tana laanot bo sara ad shettisre gufah shel edut

Amar rava bau shenayim veamru bemizrach bira harag peloni et hannefesh uvau shenayim veamru vahalo bemaarav bira immanu heyitem chazenan i kidkayemi bemaarav bira michze chazu lemizrach bira en ellu zommin veim lav hare ellu zommin
Peshita mahu detema lechush linhora barya kamashma lan

Veamar rava bau shenayim veamru besura betzafra bechad beshabbeta harag peloni et hannefesh uvau shenayim veamru befanya bechad beshabbeta immanu heyitem binhardea chazenan i mitztzafra lefanya matze azel missura linhardea la hau zommin vei lav hau zommin
Peshita mahu detema lechush legamla paracha ka mashma lan

Veamar rava bau shenayim veamru bechad beshabbeta harag peloni et hannefesh uvau shenayim veamru immanu heyitem bechad beshabbeta ella bitre beshabbeta harag peloni et hannefesh velo od ella afilu amru erev shabbat harag peloni et hannefesh neheragin dividana deka mashadi gavra lav bar ketala hu
May ka mashma lan tenena lefichach nimtzet achat mehen zomemet hu vahen neheragin vehashsheniyya petura

Sefa ma sheen ken bigmar din itztericha leh bau shenayim veamru bechad beshabbeta nigmar dino shel peloni uvau shenayim veamru bechad beshabbeta immanu heyitem ella beerev shabbat nigmar dino shel peloni velo od ella afilu amru bitre beshabbeta nigmar dino shel peloni en ellu neheragin dividana deka mashadi gavra bar ketala hu
Vechen leinyan tashlume kenas

Bau shenayim veamru bechad beshabbeta ganav vetavach umachar uvau shenayim veamru bechad beshabbeta immanu heyitem ella bitre beshabbeta ganav vetavach umachar meshallemin velo od ella afilu amru beerev shabbat ganav vetavach umachar meshallemin dividana deka mashadi gavra lav bar tashlumin hu

Bau shenayim veamru bechad beshabbeta ganav vetavach umachar venigmar dino uvau shenayim veamru bechad beshabbeta immanu heyitem ella erev shabbat ganav vetavach umachar venigmar dino velo od ella afilu amru bechad beshabbeta ganav vetavach umachar uvitre beshabbeta nigmar dino en meshallemin dividana deka mashadi gavra bar tashlumin hu
Rabbi yehuda omer istatit hi zo ku
b: I istatit hi zo afilu kat rishona name la amar rabbi avahu shekadmu vehargu
May dahava hava ella amar rava hachi kaamar im enah ella kat achat nehereget i ika tefe en neheragin ha bilvad kaamar kashya
Hahi itta daatay sahadi veishtakkur ayeti sahadi veishtakkur azala ayeti sahadi acharine dela ishtakkur amar resh lakish huchzeka zo amar leh rabbi elazar im hi huchzeka kol yisrael mi huchzeku

Zimnin hau yatvi kammeh derabbi yochanan ata ki hay maase lekammayehu amar resh lakish huchzeka zo amar leh rabbi yochanan im huchzeka zo kol yisrael mi huchzeku hadar chazyeh lerabbi elazar bishut amar leh shamatte mile mibbar nappacha vela amarte li mishshemeh
Lema resh lakish deamar kerabbi yehuda verabbi yochanan deamar kerabbanan
Amar lach resh lakish ana daamari lach afilu lerabbanan ad kan la ka amri rabbanan hatam deleka deka mehaddar aval hacha ika ha deka mehaddera

Verabbi yochanan amar lach ana daamari afilu lerabbi yehuda ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam deamrinan attu kulle alma gabbe hane hau kayemi aval hacha hane yadi besahaduta vehane la yadi besahaduta
Matni en haedim zommin neheragin ad sheyyiggamer haddin shehare hatztzaddukin omrim ad sheyyehareg shenneemar nefesh tachat nafesh

Amru lahem chachamim vahalo kevar neemar vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv vahare achiv kayyam veim ken lamma neemar nefesh tachat nafesh yachol mishshaa shekkibbelu edutan yehargu talmud lomar nefesh tachat nafesh ha enam neheragin ad sheyyiggamer haddin
Gema tana beribi omer lo hargu neheragin hargu en neheragin amar aviv beni lav kal vachomer hu

Amar lo limadtanu rabbenu sheen onshin min haddin detanya ish asher yikkach et achoto bat aviv o vat immo en li ella bat aviv shello bat immo uvat immo shello bat aviv bat immo uvat aviv minnayin talmud lomar ervat achoto gilla
Ad shello yeamer yesh li baddin im anash al bat aviv shello bat immo uvat immo shello bat aviv bat aviv uvat immo lo kol shekken ha lamadta sheen onshin min haddin

Onesh shamanu azhara minnayin talmud lomar ervat achotcha vat avicha o vat immecha en li ella bat aviv shello bat immo uvat immo shello bat aviv bat aviv uvat immo minnayin talmud lomar ervat bat eshet avicha moledet avicha achotcha hi
Ad shello yeamer yesh li min haddin ma im huzhar al bat immo shello bat aviv uvat aviv shello bat immo bat aviv uvat immo lo kol shekken ha lamadta sheen mazhirin min haddin
Chayyave malkiyyot minnayin talmud lomar rasha rasha
Chayyave galiyyot minnayin atya rotzeach rotzeach
Tanya amar rabbi yehuda ben tavay ere benechama im lo haragti ed zomem lehotzi millibban shel tzaddukim shehau omrim en haedim zommin neheragin ad sheyyehareg hanniddon
Amar lo shimon ben shatach ere benechama im lo shafachta dam naki shehare amru chachamim en haedim zommin neheragin ad sheyyizzommu shenehem veen lokin ad sheyyizzommu shenehem

Miyyad kibbel alav rabbi yehuda ben tavay sheeno more horaa ella lifne shimon ben shatach vechol yamav shel rabbi yehuda ben tavay haya mishtatteach al kivro shel oto haed vehaya kolo nishma vechisvurin haam lomar kolo shel harug amar koli shelli hu tedu lemachar hu met en kolo nishma
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe dilma bedina kam bahadeh i name payyose payeseh

Matni al pi shenayim edim o shelosha edim yumat hammet im mitkayyemet haedut bishnayim lamma parat hakkatuv bishlosha ella lehakkish shelosha lishnayim ma shelosha mezimin et hashshenayim af hashshenayim yazommu et hashshelosha uminnayin afilu mea talmud lomar edim
Rabbi shimon omer ma shenayim enan neheragin ad sheyyihu shenehem zommin af shelosha enan neheragin ad sheyyihu sheloshtam zommin uminnayin afilu mea talmud lomar edim
Rabbi akiva omer lo ba hashshelishi lehakel ella lehachamir alav velaasot dino kayyotze baellu
Veim ken anash hakkatuv lannitpal leovre avera keovre avera al achat kamma vechamma yeshallem sachar lannitpal leose mitzva keose mitzva
Uma shenayim nimtza echad mehen karov o pasul edutan betela af shelosha nimtza echad mehen karov o pasul edutan betela minnayin afilu mea talmud lomar edim

a: Amar rabbi yose bamme devarim amurim bedine nefashot aval bedine mamonot titkayyem haedut bashshear rabbi omer echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot
Veematay bizman shehitru bahen aval bizman shello hitru bahen ma yaasu shene achin sherau beechad sheharag et hannefesh
Gema amar rava vehu sheheidu kullam betoch kede dibur amar leh rav acha middifti leravina mikkedi toch kede dibur hechi dame kede sheelat talmid lerav mea tuva hao
Amar leh kol chad vechad betoch kede dibur shel chavero
Rabbi akiva omer lo ba shelishi ku uma shenayim ku amar leh rav pappa leabbaye ella meatta harug yatztzil kesheharago meachorav
Nirba yatztzil keshervao meachorav
Horeg verovea yatztzilu ishtik ki ata lekammeh derava amar leh yakum davar bimkayeme davar hakkatuv medabber
Amar rabbi yose bamme devarim amurim ku ma yaasu shene achim vechu hechi amrinan lehu

Amar rava hachi amrinan lehu lemichze atitu o leashode atitu i amri leashode ato nimtza echad mehen karov o pasul edutan betela i amri lemichze ato ma yaasu shene achin sherau beechad sheharag et hannefesh
Itmar amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose verav nachman omer halacha kerabbi
b: Matni hau shenayim roin oto mechallon ze ushnayim roin oto mechallon ze veechad matre bo baemtza bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu hare ellu edut achat veim lav hare ellu shette eduot lefichach im nimtzet achat mehen zomemet hu vahen neheragin vehashsheniyya petura
Rabbi yose omer leolam en neheragin ad sheyehu shene edav matrin bo shenneemar al pi shenayim edim davar acher al pi shenayim edim shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi hatturgeman

Gema amar rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav minnayin leedut meuchedet shehi pesula shenneemar lo yumat al pi ed echad may echad ilema ed echad mammash meresha shaminan lah al pi shenayim edim ella may echad echad echad

Tanya name hachi lo yumat al pi ed echad lehavi shenayim sheroim oto echad mechallon ze veechad mechallon ze veen roin ze et ze sheen mitztarfin velo od ella afilu beze achar ze bechallon echad en mitztarfin

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye hashta uma echad mechallon ze veechad mechallon ze dehay ka chaze kullo maase vehay ka chaze kullo maase amratte la mitztarfi beze achar ze dehay chaze palga demaase vehay chaze palga demaase mibaya amar leh lo nitzrecha ella levoel et haerva
Amar rava im hau roin et hammatre o hammatre roe otan mitztarfin amar rava matre sheamru afilu mippi atzmo vaafilu mippi hashshed
Amar rav nachman edut meuchedet keshera bedine mamonot dichtiv lo yumat al pi ed echad bedine nefashot hu deen keshera aval bedine mamonot keshera
Matkef lah rav zutra ella meatta bedine nefashot tatztzil allema tenan hu vahen neheragin kashya
Rabbi yose omer vechu amar leh rav pappa leabbaye umi it leh lerabbi yose hay sevara vehatnan rabbi yose omer hassone neherag mippene shehu kemuad umutre
Amar leh hahu rabbi yose bar yehuda hi detanya rabbi yose bar yehuda omer chaver en tzarich hatraa lefi shello nitna hatraa ella lehavchin ben shogeg lemezid

Davar acher al pi shenayim edim shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi hatturgeman hanhu laoze daato lekammeh derava oki rava turgeman benayehu vehechi avid hachi vehatnan shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi hatturgeman rava mida hava yada ma dahao amri veahdore hu dela hava yada

a: Ila vetoviyya kariveh dearva hao sevar rav pappa lememar gabbe love umalve rachiki ninhu amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa i let leh lelove lav batar arva azel malve

Matni mi shennigmar dino uvarach uva lifne oto bet din en sotrin et dino kol makom sheyyaamdu shenayim veyomru meidim anu beish peloni shennigmar dino bevet din shel peloni ufloni ufloni edav hare ze yehareg

Sanhedrin noheget baaretz uvchutza laaretz sanhedrin hahoreget echad beshavua nikret chovlanit rabbi eliezer ben azarya omer echad leshivim shana rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva omrim ilu hayinu besanhedrin lo neherag adam meolam rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af hen marbin shofche damim beyisrael

Gema lifne oto bet din hu deen sotrin ha lifne bet din acher sotrin ha tane sefa kol makom sheyyaamdu shenayim veyomru meidin anu et ish peloni shennigmar dino bevet din peloni ufloni ufloni edav hare ze neherag
Amar abbaye la kashya kan beeretz yisrael kan bechutza laaretz
Detanya rabbi yehuda ben dostay omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben shatach barach mearetz lechutza laaretz en sotrin et dino mechutza laaretz laaretz sotrin et dino mippene zechutah shel eretz yisrael
Sanhedrin noheget ku mena hane mile detanu rabbanan vehau elle lachem lechukkat mishpat ledorotechem lamadnu lesanhedrin shennoheget baaretz uvchutza laaretz
Im ken ma talmud lomar bisharecha bisharecha atta moshiv batte dinim bechol pelech vafelech uvchol ir vair uvchutza laaretz atta moshiv bechol pelech vafelech vei atta moshiv bechol ir vair
Sanhedrin hahoreget vechu ibaya lehu achat leshivim shana nikret chabbelanit o dilma orach ara hi teku
Rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva omrim ilu hayinu vechu hechi hao avdi rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayehu reitem terefa harag shalem harag
Amar rav ashe im timtza lomar shalem hava dilma bimkom sayif nekev hava
Bevoel et haerva hechi hao avdi abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu reitem kemichchol bishfoferet verabbanan hechi dayenu kishmuel deamar shemuel bimnaafim mishsheyyiru kimnaafim
Hadaran alach ketzad haedim

Matni ellu hen haggolin hahoreg nefesh bishgaga haya meaggel bammagela venafla alav vaharagattu haya meshalshel bechavit venafla alav vaharagattu haya yored bassullam venafal alav vaharagattu vaharago hare ze gole aval im haya moshech bammagela venafla alav vaharagattu haya dole bechavit venifsak hachevel venafla alav vaharagattu
b: Haya ole bassullam venafal alav vaharago hare ze eno gole ze hakkelal kol shebbederech yeridato gole veshello bederech yeridato eno gole
Gema mena hane mile deamar shemuel deamar kera vayyappel alav vayyamot ad sheyyippol derech nefila
Tanu rabbanan bishgaga perat lemezid bivli daat perat lemitkaven
Mezid peshita bar ketala hu ella amar rava ema perat leomer muttar amar leh abbaye i omer muttar anus hu amar leh sheani omer haomer muttar karov lemezid hu
Bivli daat perat lemitkaven mitkaven peshita bar ketala hu amar rabba perat lemitkaven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam laggoy veharag et yisrael lannefel veharag ben kayyama

Tanu rabbanan im befeta perat lekeren zavit belo eva perat lesone hadafo sheddechafo begufo o hishlich alav lehavi yerida shehi tzorech aliyya belo tzediyya perat lemitkaven letzad ze vehalcha lah letzad acher
Vaasher lo tzada perat lemitkaven lizrok shettayim vezarak arba vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar ma yaar reshut lannizak velammazzik likanes lesham af kol reshut lannizak velammazzik likanes lesham
Bea mineh rabbi avahu merabbi yochanan haya ole bassullam venishmeta sheliva mittachtav venafla veharga mahu ki hay gavena aliyya hi o yerida hi amar leh kevar nagata birida shehi tzorech aliyya
Etiveh ze hakkelal kol shebbederech yeridato gole shello bederech yeridato eno gole shello bederech yeridato leetoye may lav leetoye kehay gavena velitamach kal shebbederech yeridato leetoye may

a: Vehaamar rav yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan rabbi verabbi yehuda ben roetz uvet shammay verabbi shimon verabbi akiva kullehu seviri lehu yesh em lammikra hayenu dekaamar lehu veod

Ella koach kocho lerabbi hechi mashkachatte lah kegon dishda pisa umachayeh legirma vaazal girma umachayeh lichvasa veattar tamre vaazul tamre uktul
Matni hazzorek even lirshut harabbim veharag hare ze gole rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer im mikkesheyyatzata haeven miyyado hotzi halla et rosho vekibbelah hare ze patur

Zarak et haeven lachatzero veharag im yesh reshut lannizak likanes lesham gole veim lav eno gole shenneemar vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar ma hayyaar reshut lannizak velammazzik likanes lesham af kol reshut lannizak velammazzik lehikkanes lesham yatza chatzar baal habbayit sheen reshut lannizak velammazzik likanes lesham
Abba shaul omer ma chatavat etzim reshut af kol reshut yatza haav hammakke et beno veharav harode et talmido ushliach bet din
Gema lirshut harabbim mezid hu amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak besoter et kotlo ibi leh leayyone besoter et kotlo ballayela ballayela name ibi leh leayyone
Besoter et kotlo leashpa hay ashpa hechi dame i shechichi bah rabbim poshea hu i la shechichi bah rabbim anus hu

Amar rav pappa la tzericha ella leashpa haasuya lipanot bah ballayela veen asuya lipanot bah bayyom veika demikkere veyatev poshea la have deha enah asuya lipanot bah bayyom ones name la have deha ika demikkere veyatev
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer vechu tanu rabbanan umatza perat lemamtzi et atzmo mikkan amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov im mishsheyyatzata haeven miyyado hotzi halla et rosho vekibbelah patur
Lememra dematza meikara mashma urminhi umatza perat lematzuy shello yimkor berachok veyigol bekarov beraa veyigol beyafa

Hazzorek et haeven vechu amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava mimmay demachatavat etzim dirshut dilma mechatavat etzim desukka umechatavat etzim demaaracha vaafilu hachi amar rachamana ligle amar leh kevan deim matza chatuv eno chotev lav mitzva hashta name lav mitzva

Hadar amar rava lav milta hi daamari vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar ma yaar dei bae ayel vei bae la ayel vei salka datach mitzva mi saggi dela ayel
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava kol hecha dichtiv asher dei bae hu ella meatta veish asher yitma velo yitchatta i bae mitamme i bae la mitamme met mitzva dela saggi dela mitamme hachi name defatur
Shane hatam deamar kera
b: Tame yihye mikkol makom
Hahu mibe leh lechidtanya tame yihye lerabbot tevul yom tumato vo lerabbot mechussar kipurim amar leh ana meod tumato ka amena

Ika dematne lah aha becharish uvakkatzir tishbot rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich lomar charish shel sheviit vekatzir shel sheviit shehare kevar neemar sadcha lo tizra vecharmecha lo tizmor ella afilu charish shel erev sheviit shennichnas lishviit vekatzir shel sheviit sheyyatza lemotzae sheviit
Rabbi yishmael omer ma charish reshut af katzir reshut yatza ketzir haomer shehu mitzva
Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava mimmay dacharisha dirshut dilma charishat omer demitzva vaafilu hachi amar rachamana tishbot amar leh kevan deim matza charush eno choresh lav mitzva

Etiveh ravina lerava yatza haav hammakke et beno veharav harode et talmido ushliach bet din veammay lema kevan deilu gemir lav mitzva hashta name lav mitzva hatam af al gav digmir name mitzva ka aved dichtiv yasser bincha vinichecha

Hadar amar rava lav milta hi daamari ketzira dumya dacharisha ma charisha matza charush eno choresh af ketzira name matza katzur eno kotzer vei salka datach mitzva matza katzur eno kotzer mitzva liktzor ulhavi
Matni haav gole al yede habben vehabben gole al yede haav hakkol golin al yede yisrael veyisrael golin al yedehen chutz migger toshav veger toshav eno gole ella al yede ger toshav
Gema haav gole al yede habben vehaamratte yatza haav hammakke et beno digmir haamratte af al gav digmir mitzva kaaved bishvalya denaggare
Shevalya denaggare chayyute hi delammedeh digmir ummanuta achariti
Vehabben gole al yede haav ku urminhi makke nefesh perat lammakka aviv amar rav kahana la kashya ha rabbi shimon veha rabbanan
Lerabbi shimon deamar chenek chamur missayif shiggat sayif nitna lechappara shiggat chenek lo nitna lechappara
Lerabbanan deamri sayif chamur mechenek horeg aviv beshogeg shiggat sayif hu veshiggat sayif nitna lechappara
Rava amar perat leose chabbura beaviv beshogeg salka datach amena kevan divmezid bar ketala hu beshogeg name ligle ka mashma lan

Hakkol golin al yede yisrael vechu hakkol golin al yede yisrael leetoye may leetoye eved vechuti tenena leha detanu rabbanan eved vechuti gole veloke al yede yisrael veyisrael gole veloke al yede kuti veeved

Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov kegon sheheid bo vehuzam dichoteh gabbe eved sheheid bo vehuzam eved bar edut hu ella amar rav acha bereh derav ika hacha bemay askinan kegon shehikkahu hakkaa

a: Sheen bah shave peruta deamar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan hikkahu hakkaa sheen bah shave peruta loke vela makkeshinan hakkaa liklala
Chutz meal yede ger toshav vechu alma ger toshav goy hu ema sefa ger toshav gole al yede ger toshav amar rav kahana la kashya kan beger toshav sheharag ger toshav kan beger toshav sheharag yisrael

Ika derame kerae ahadade ketiv livne yisrael velagger velattoshav betocham tihyena shesh hearim uchtiv vehau lachem hearim lemiklat lachem velo legerim amar rav kahana la kashya kan beger toshav sheharag yisrael kan beger toshav sheharag ger toshav

Urminhi lefichach ger vegoy shehargu neheragin katane ger dumya degoy ma goy la shena diktal bar mineh vela shena diktal delav bar mineh neherag af ger la shena diktal bar mineh vela shena ketal delav bar mineh neherag
Amar rav chisda la kashya kan sheharago derech yerida kan sheharago derech aliyya derech yerida deyisrael gale ihu name saggi leh begalut derech aliyya deyisrael patur hu neherag
Amar leh rava velav kal vachomer hu uma derech yerida deyisrael gale ihu name saggi leh begalut derech aliyya deyisrael patur ihu neherag
Ella amar rava beomer muttar amar leh abbaye omer muttar anus hu amar leh sheani omer omer muttar karov lemezid hu
Veazdu letamayehu deitmar kesavur behema venimtza adam goy venimtza ger toshav rava omer chayyav omer muttar karov lemezid hu rav chisda omer patur omer muttar anus hu

Verabbi yehuda bivli daat perat lemitkaven hu daata

Nishmat annishmat la kashya ha rabbi veha rabbanan

Umchuuonot lahen derachim mizzo lazo shenneemar tachin lecha hadderech veshillashta vego

Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer battechilla echad shogeg veechad mezid makdimin leare miklat uvet din sholchin umviin oto mishsham mi shennitchayyev mita bevet din haraguhu veshello nitchayyev mita petaruhu mi shennitchayyev galut machzirin oto limkomo shenneemar veheshivu oto haeda el ir miklato vego

Amar rabbi yitzchak may kera venas el achat min hearim hael vachay aved leh mide detehve leh chiyyuta
Tana talmid sheggala maggelin rabbo immo shenneemar vachay aved leh mide detehve leh chiyyuta amar rabbi zeera mikkan shello yishne adam letalmid sheeno hagun
Amar rabbi yochanan harav sheggala maggelin yeshivato immo ini veha amar rabbi yochanan minnayin ledivre tora shehen koltin shenneemar et betzer bammidbar vego uchtiv batreh vezot hattora
La kashya ha beidana deasek bah ha beidana dela asek bah

Amar rabbi tanchum bar chanilay mippene ma zacha reuven limanot behatztzala techilla mippene shehu patach behatztzala techilla shenneemar vayyishma reuven vayyatztzilehu miyyadam

Darash rabbi simlay may dichtiv az yavdil moshe shalosh arim beever hayyarden mizrecha shamesh amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe hazrach shemesh larotzchim ika deamri amar lo hizrachta shemesh larotzchim

Umi ohev behamon lo tevua lemi nae lelammed behamon mi shekkol tevua shello vehayenu deamar rabbi elazar may dichtiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato lemi nae lelammed lemallel gevurot Adonai mi sheyyachol lehashmia kol tehillato
Verabbanan veitema rabba bar mari amar mi ohev behamon lo tevua kol haohev limlammed behamon lo tevua yehavu beh rabbanan enayehu berava bereh derabba
Siman ashe lilmod ravina lelammed

Rav ashe amar kol haohev lilmod behamon lo tevua vehayenu deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina may dichtiv cherev el habbaddim venoalu cherev al tzavvere sonehem shel talmide chachamim sheyyoshvin veoskin battora bad bevad velo od ella shemmittappeshin ketiv hacha venoalu uchtiv hatam asher noalnu velo od ella shechotin shenneemar vaasher chatanu veibaet ema mehacha noalu sare tzoan
Ravina amar kol haohev lelammed behamon lo tevua vehayenu deamar rabbi harbe tora lamadti merabbotay umechaveray yoter mehem umittalmiday yoter mikkullan
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may dichtiv omdot hau raglenu bisharayich yerushalam mi garam leraglenu sheyyaamdu bammilchama shaare yerushalami shehau oskim battora

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may dichtiv shir hammaalot ledavid samachti beomrim li bet Adonai nelech amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam shamati bene adam shehau omrim matay yamut zaken ze veyavo shelomo beno veyivne bet habbechira venaale laregel vesamachti amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu ki tov yom bachatzerecha mealef tov li yom echad sheatta osek battora lefanay meelef olot sheatid shelomo bincha lehakriv lefanay al gabbe hammizbeach
Umchuuonot lahem derachim vechu tanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer
b: Miklat haya katuv al parashat derachim kede sheyyakkir harotzeach veyifne lesham amar rav kahana may kera tachin lecha hadderech ase lecha hachana ladderech

Rabbi shimon ben lakish patach lah pitcha lehay parashta mehacha vaasher lo tzada vehaelohim inna leyado vego kaasher yomar meshal hakkadmoni mershaim yetze resha vego

Bamma hakkatuv medabber bishne bene adam shehargu et hannefesh echad harag beshogeg veechad harag bemezid laze en edim velaze en edim hakkadosh baruch hu mazminan lefundak echad ze sheharag bemezid yoshev tachat hassullam veze sheharag beshogeg yored bassullam venofel alav vehorgo ze sheharag bemezid neherag veze sheharag beshogeg gole
Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav huna veamri lah amar rav huna amar rabbi elazar min hattora umin hanneviim umin hakketuvim badderech sheadam rotze lelech bah molichin oto

Min hattora dichtiv lo telech immahem uchtiv kum lech ittam min hanneviim dichtiv ani Adonai elohecha melammedcha lehoil madrichcha bederech zu telech min hakketuvim dichtiv im lalletzim hu yalitz velaanavim yitten chen
Amar rav huna rotzeach sheggala leir miklat umtzao goel haddam vaharago patur kasavar velo en mishpat mavet begoel haddam hu dichtiv
Metivi velo en mishpat mavet barotzeach hakkatuv medabber atta omer barotzeach o eno ella begoel haddam keshehu omer vehu lo sone lo mittemol shilshom heve omer barotzeach hakkatuv medabber

Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya velo en mishpat mavet begoel haddam hakkatuv medabber atta omer begoel haddam hakkatuv medabber o eno ella barotzeach keshehu omer ki lo sone hu lo mittemol shilshom hare rotzeach amur ha ma ani mekayyem velo en mishpat mavet begoel haddam hakkatuv medabber
Tenan mosrin lo shene talmide chachamim shemma yahargennu badderech vidabberu elav may lav dematru beh dei katel bar ketala hu

Amar mar bishgaga ba maase leyado peshita dei bemezid bar galut hu in
Veha tanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer battechilla echad shogeg veechad mezid makdimin leare miklat uvet din sholchin umviin otam mishsham

Mi shennitchayyev mita haraguhu shenneemar veshalchu zikne iro velakchu oto mishsham venatnu oto beyad goel haddam vamet mi shello nitchayyev petaruhu shenneemar vehitztzilu haeda et harotzeach miyyad goel haddam mi shennitchayyev galut machzirin oto limkomo shenneemar veheshivu oto haeda el ir miklato asher nas shamma
Rabbi omer meatzman hen golin kisvurin hen echad shogeg veechad mezid koltot vehen enan yodin shebbashshogeg koltot bemezid enan koltot

Vayyichtov yehoshua et haddevarim haelle besefer torat elohim peligi bah rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya chad omer shemona pesukim vechad omer are miklat

Sefer shettefaro befishtan peligi bah rabbi yehuda verabbi meir chad omer kasher vechad omer pasul

Gema mena hane mile amar rav kahana deamar kera veyashav bah ad mot hakkohen haggadol uchtiv ki veir miklato yeshev ad mot hakkohen haggadol uchtiv veachare mot hakkohen haggadol
Verabbi yehuda ketiv kera acharina lashuv lashevet baaretz ad mot hakkohen vego veidach middela ketiv haggadol chad mehanach hu

Hatam amri shechem nasev umivgay gazar

b: Amar rav yehuda amar rav niduy al tenay tzarich hafara menalan miyehuda dichtiv im lo haviotiv elecha vego veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan may dichtiv yechi reuven veal yamot vego vezot lihuda

Im ad shello nigmar dino vechu mena hane mile amar rav kahana deamar kera veyashav bah ad mot hakkohen haggadol asher mashach oto beshemen hakkodesh vechi hu moshcho ella ze shennimshach beyamav
May hava leh lemebad haya lo levakkesh rachamim sheyyigmor dino lizchut velo bikesh

Amar abbaye naktinan nigmar dino vamet molichin et atzmotav lesham dichtiv lashuv lashevet baaretz ad mot hakkohen veezehu yeshiva shehi baaretz heve omer zo kevura tana met kodem shemmet kohen gadol molichin atzmotav al kivre avotav dichtiv yashuv harotzeach el eretz achuzzato ezehu yeshiva shehi beeretz achuzzato heve omer zo kevura

Amar mar zutra bar toviyya amar rav rotzeach sheyyetze chutz lattechum umtzao goel haddam vaharago neherag alav keman la kerabbi yose haggelili vela kerabbi akiva

Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya rabbi eliezer omer ad omdo lifne haeda lammishpat ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar veratzach goel haddam et harotzeach yachol miyyad talmud lomar ad omdo lifne haeda lammishpat

Tanu rabbanan im yatzo yetze harotzeach en li ella bemezid beshogeg minnayin talmud lomar im yatzo yetze mikkol makom
Vehatanya vehahorgo bemezid neherag beshogeg gole la kashya ha keman deamar amrinan dibbera tora chilshon bene adam ha keman deamar la amrinan dibbera tora chilshon bene adam

a: Maalim hau sachar lalviyyim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer lo hau maalim lahen sachar vechozer lisrara shehaya bah divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer lo haya chozer lisrara shehaya bah

b: Yeshnan bichlal malkot arbaim divre rabbi yishmael

Rabbi yitzchak omer chayyave charetot bakkelal hau velamma yatzat karet baachoto leduno becharet velo bemalkot

May tama derabbi yishmael dichtiv im lo tishmor laasot et kol divre hattora hazzot uchtiv vehifla Adonai et makkotcha haflaa zo eni yodea ma hi keshehu omer vehippilo hashshofet vehikkahu lefanav heve omer haflaa zo malkot hi uchtiv im lo tishmor laasot et kol vego
I hachi chayyave ase name im lo tishmor ketiv vechidrabbi avin amar rabbi ilay deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ilay kol makom shenneemar hishshamer pen veal eno ella lo taase
I hachi lav sheen bo maase name laasot ketiv

Verabbi yishmael hane mile mita umamon o malkot umamon aval mita umalkot mita arichta hi
Ulrabbi akiva i hachi chayyave charetot name may amratte sheim asu teshuva hashta mihat la avdi
Amar rabbi avahu beferush ribta tora chayyave charetot lemalkut digmar leene milleenecha matkef lah rabbi abba bar memel i hachi chayyave mitot bet din name nigmar meene milleenecha
Danin leene milleenecha veen danin meene milleenecha

Veod ligmar meene milleene deha gamar leene milleenecha
Kabbelah mineh rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak kede rishato mishshum risha achat atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo mishshum shette rishaot berisha hammesura levet din hakkatuv medabber

Vedilma azhara lekorban deha pesach umila delet behu azhara la mayete korban

Ravina amar leolam

a: Kidamrinan meikara sheim asu teshuva bet din shel mala mochalin lahen may amratte ha la avud teshuva la pesika milta lecharet
Rabbi yitzchak omer chayyave charetot bakkelal hau velamma yatzat karet baachoto leduno becharet velo bemalkot
Verabbanan karet baachoto lema li lechallek vechidrabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan sheim asaan kullam behelem echad chayyav al kol achat veachat
Verabbi yitzchak lechallek mena leh nafka leh mivveel ishsha beniddat tumatah lechayyev al kol ishsha veishsha
Verabbanan name tipok leh meha in hachi name veella karet daachoto lema li lechayevo al achoto veal achot aviv veal achot immo
Peshita hare gufin muchlakin hare shemot muchlakin ella lechayevo al achoto shehi achot aviv shehi achot immo vehechi mashkachatte lah berashshia bar rashshia

Verabbi yitzchak ha mena leh nafka leh mikkal vachomer detanya amar rabbi akiva shaalti et rabban gamliel verabbi yehoshua baitliz shel emaum shehalchu likach behema lemishte veno shel rabban gamliel habba al achoto shehi achot aviv shehi achot immo mahu eno chayyav al kullan ella achat o chayyav al kol achat veachat

Amru lo zo lo shamanu aval shamanu habba al chamesh nashim niddot behelem echad shechayyav al kol achat veachat venirin devarim mikkal vachomer uma nidda shehi shem echad chayyav al kol achat veachat kan sheshshelosha shemot lo kol shekken
Veidach kal vachomer pericha hu ma lenidda shekken gufin muchlakin

Veidach savar kerabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya deamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya kol makom sheatta motze shene lavin vecharet echad chalukin hen lekorban

Bishlama resh lakish la amar kerabbi yochanan gezera shava la gemir ella rabbi yochanan may tama la amar keresh lakish amar lach hahu azhara litruma
Veresh lakish azhara litruma mena leh nafka leh meish ish mizzera aharon vehu tzarua o zav e zehu davar shehu shave bezaro shel aharon heve omer zo teruma veidach hahu laachila veha lingia
