Im yisrael hu machzir veeno loke ammay lo taase shekkedamo ase hu velilke
Amar ulla lo yeamer lo tihye leishsha beones veligmar mimmotzi shem ra uma motzi shem ra shello asa maase amar rachamana velo tihye leishsha ones lo kol shekken
Lamma neemar im eno inyan lefanav tenehu inyan leacharav sheim gerash yachazir
Veakkatti ones mimmotzi shem ra la gamar deika lemifrach ma lemotzi shem ra shekken loke umshallem

Ella lo yeamer lo tihye leishsha bemotzi shem ra veligmar meones uma ones sheeno loke umshallem amar rachamana velo tihye leishsha motzi shem ra lo kol shekken velamma neemar im eno inyan lammotzi shem ra tenehu inyan laones im eno inyan lefanav tenehu inyan leacharav
Umotzi shem ra meones name la gamar deika lemifrach ma leones shekken asa maase
Ella lo yeamer lo tihye leishsha bemotzi shem ra shehare ishto hi lamma neemar im eno inyan lammotzi shem ra tenehu inyan laones veim eno inyan lefanav tenehu inyan leacharav
Veema veim eno inyan lefanav demotzi shem ra tenehu inyan leacharav dideh dela lake
In hachi name veate ones vegamar mineh bemay gamar mineh i bekal vachomer i bema matzinu ika lemifrach kidfarchinan ma lemotzi shem ra shekken lo asa maase
Ella amar rava kol yamav baamod vehachzer vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan kol yamav baamod vehachzer
Amar leh rav pappa lerava veha la dame laveh lelav dachasima amar leh mishshum dichtav beh rachamana ase yattira migra gara
I hachi lav shennitak laase name lema mishshum dichtav beh rachamana ase yattira migra gara amar leh hahu lenattoke lav hu daata
Hanicha leman deamar bitlo velo bitlo
Ella leman deamar kiyemo velo kiyemo may ika lememar
b: Mide hu tama ella lerabbi yochanan haamar leh rabbi yochanan letanna teni bittelo chayyav velo bittelo patur
Detane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase kiyyem ase shebbah patur bitel ase shebbah chayyav
Amar leh may ka amratte kiyyem patur lo kiyyem chayyav bitel chayyav lo bitel patur teni bitlo velo bitlo verabbi shimon ben lakish omer kiyemo velo kiyemo
Bemay ka mipalgi behatraat safek ka mipalgi mar savar hatraat safek shemah hatraa
Umar savar hatraat safek lo shemah hatraa
Veazdu letamayehu deitmar shevua sheochal kikkar ze hayyom veavar hayyom velo achalah rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu eno loke rabbi yochanan omer eno loke

a: Mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav resh lakish omer eno loke mishshum dehave hatraat safek vechol hatraat safek lo shemah hatraa

Vetarvayehu alliba derabbi yehuda detanya velo totiru mimmennu ad boker vehannotar mimmennu ad boker vego ba hakkatuv liten ase achar lo taase lomar sheen lokin alav divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yochanan dayek hachi tama deva hakkatuv ha lo ba hakkatuv loke alma hatraat safek shemah hatraa
Veresh lakish dayek hachi tama deva hakkatuv ha lo ba hakkatuv loke alma lav sheen bo maase lokin alav
Verabbi shimon ben lakish name ha vadday hatraat safek hu

Savar lah keidach tanna derabbi yehuda detanya hikka ze vechazar vehikka ze kilel ze vechazar vekilel ze hikka shenehem bevat achat o kilel shenehem bevat achat chayyav rabbi yehuda omer bevat achat chayyav beze achar ze patur
Verabbi yochanan name ha vadday lav sheen bo maase hu

Savar lah ki ha deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav amram amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili kol lo taase shebbattora lav sheyyesh bo maase lokin alav lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav chutz min hannishba umemir vehamkallel et chavero bashshem
Kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda
I lerabbi shimon ben lakish tere tannae alliba derabbi yehuda i lerabbi yochanan la kashya ha dideh ha derabbeh

Tenan hatam hannotel em al habbanim rabbi yehuda omer loke veeno meshalleach vachachamim omrim meshalleach veeno loke ze hakkelal kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase en chayyavin aleha amar rabbi yochanan en lanu ella zot veod acheret
Amar leh rabbi elazar hecha amar leh lechi tashkach nefak dak veashkach detanya ones sheggerash im yisrael hu machzir veeno loke veim kohen hu loke veeno machzir
Hanicha leman detane kiyemo velo kiyemo
Ella leman detane bitlo velo bitlo bishlama gabbe shiluach hakken mashkachatte lah ella ones bitlo velo bitlo hechi mashkachatte lah
I dekatlah kam leh bidrabba mineh amar rav shimi machoznaa kegon shekkibel lah kidushin meacher amar rav i shaveyteh shaliach ihi ka mevattela leh i la shaveyteh shaliach kol kemineh vela kelum hi

Ella amar rav shimi minnehardea kegon shehiddirah barabbim hanicha leman deamar neder shehuddar barabbim en lo hafara ella leman deamar yesh lo hafara may ika lememar demaddirah lah kegon shehiddirah al daat rabbim deamar ammemar hilcheta neder shehuddar barabbim yesh lo hafara al daat rabbim en lo hafara
Vetu leka veha ika siman gazel mashkon ufea gazel derachamana amar lo tigzol veheshiv et haggezela mashkon derachamana amar lo tavo el beto laavot avoto hashev tashiv lo haavot kevo hashshemesh
Umashkachatte lah bekiyemo velo kiyemo uvitlo velo bitlo hatam kevan dechayyav betashlumin en loke umshallem
Matkef lah rabbi zera ha ika mashkono shel ger umet hagger
b: Hatam gavra bar tashlumin hu veshibuda deger hu deka faka
Veha ika pea derachamana amar lo techalle peat vego leani velagger taazov otam vego

Demashkachatte lah bekiyemo velo kiyemo bitlo velo bitlo ditnan mitzvat pea lehafrish min hakkama lo hifrish min hakkama mafrish min haomarin lo hifrish min haomarin mafrish min hakkeri ad shello merach mercho measser venoten lo
Kidrabbi yishmael deamar af mafrish min haisa ulrabbi yishmael name mashkachatte lah daachal isa
Ella zot veod acheret aha aval ones la dehecha amrinan al daat rabbim en lo hafara lidvar harshut aval lidvar mitzva yesh lo hafara
Ki ha dehahu makre dardeke dahava pasha beyanoke addereh rav acha veahdereh ravina dela ishtechach dedayek keoteh

Vehaochel nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim vechu amar rav yehuda hay man daachal binita deve cherava malkinan leh mishshum sheretz hashshoretz al haaretz hahu daachal binita deve cherava venaggedeh rav yehuda
Amar abbaye achal putita loke arbaa
Nemala loke chamesh mishshum sheretz hashshoretz al haaretz
Tzira loke shesh mishshum sheretz haof
Amar rav achay hamshahe et nekavav over mishshum lo teshakketzu amar rav bivi bar abbaye hay man deshate bekarna deummana ka avar mishshum lo teshakketzu

Amar rava bar rav huna risek tisha nemalim vehevi echad chay vehishliman lichzayit loke shesh chamesh mishshum beriyya veechad mishshum kezayit nevela rava amar rabbi yochanan afilu shenayim vehu rav yosef amar afilu achad vehu vela peligi ha beravreve veha bezutre
Achal tevel umaaser rishon ku amar rav achal tevel shel masar ani loke

Keman ki hay tanna detanya amar rabbi yose yachol lo yehe chayyav ella al hattevel shello huram mimmennu kol ikar huram mimmennu teruma gedola velo huram mimmennu maaser rishon maaser rishon velo maaser sheni vaafilu masar ani minnayin
Talmud lomar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha vego ulhallan hu omer veachlu visharecha vesaveu ma lehallan masar ani af kan masar ani veamar rachamana lo tuchal
Amar rav yosef ketannae rabbi eliezer omer en tzarich likrot et hashshem al masar ani shel demay vachachamim omrim

a: Kore et hashshem veeno tzarich lehafrish
May lav beha ka mipalgi demar savar vadday tovlo umar savar vadday eno tovlo amar leh abbaye i hachi addemipalgi bisfeko lipalgu bevadday

Ella dechulle alma vadday tovlo vehacha beha ka mipalgi mar savar lo nechshedu amme haaretz al masar ani shel demay kevan demamona hu afroshe mafresh verabbanan savri kevan ditricha leh milta la mafresh

Kamma yochal min hattevel vechu amar rav bivi amar rabbi shimon ben lakish machloket bechitta aval bekemach divre hakkol kezayit verabbi yirmeya amar rabbi shimon ben lakish kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo
Tenan amar lahem rabbi shimon i attem modim li beochel nemala kol shehu shehu chayyav amru lo mippene shehi kivriyyatah amar lahen af chitta achat kivriyyatah chitta in kemach la

Ledivrehem kaamar lehu ledidi afilu kemach name ella ledidchu odo li mihat dechitta achat kivriyyatah verabbanan beriyyat neshama chashiva chitta la chashiva tanya kevateh derabbi yirmeya rabbi shimon omer kol shehu lemakkot lo amru kezayit ella leinyan korban

Matni haochel bikkurim ad shello kara alehem kodshe kadashim chutz lakkelaim kadashim kallim umaaser sheni chutz lachoma hashshover et haetzem bappesach hattahor hare ze loke arbaim aval hammotir battahor vehashshover battame eno loke arbaim
Hannotel em al habbanim rabbi yehuda omer loke veeno meshalleach vachachamim omrim meshalleach veeno loke ze hakkelal kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase en chayyavin aleha
Gema amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi akiva setimtaa aval chachamim omrim bikkurim hannacha meakkevet bahen keria en meakkevet bahen
Velema zo divre rabbi shimon setimtaa ha ka mashma lan derabbi akiva kerabbi shimon sevira leh
May rabbi shimon detanya utrumat yadecha ellu bikkurim

Amar rabbi shimon ma ba ze lelammedenu im leochlan chutz lachoma kal vachomer mimmaaser hakkal uma maaser hakkal ochlan chutz lachoma loke bikkurim lo kol shekken ha lo ba hakkatuv ella laochel mibbikkurim ad shello kara alehem shehu loke
Venidvotecha zo toda ushlamim amar rabbi shimon ma ba ze lelammedenu im leochlan chutz lachoma kal vachomer mimmaaser ha lo ba hakkatuv ella laochel betoda uvishlamim lifne zerika shehu loke

Uvchorot ze habbechor amar rabbi shimon ma ba ze lelammedenu im leochlan chutz lachoma kal vachomer mimmaaser im lifne zerika kal vachomer mittoda ushlamim ha lo ba hakkatuv ella laochel min habbechor afilu leachar zerika shehu loke
Bekarcha vetzonecha zo chattat veasham amar rabbi shimon ma ba ze lelammedenu

Im leochlan chutz lachoma kal vachomer mimmaaser im lifne zerika kal vachomer mittoda ushlamim im leachar zerika kal vachomer mibbechor ha lo ba hakkatuv ella laochel mechattat veasham afilu leachar zerika chutz lakkelaim shehu loke
Nedarecha zo ola amar rabbi shimon ma ba ze lelammedenu

Im leochlan chutz lachoma kal vachomer mimmaaser im lifne zerika kal vachomer mittoda ushlamim im leachar zerika kal vachomer mibbechor im chutz lakkelaim kal vachomer mechattat veasham ha lo ba hakkatuv
b: Ella laochel min haola leachar zerika afilu bifnim shehu loke
Amar rava deyalda imeh kerabbi shimon telid vei la la telid veaf al gav deit lehu pircha
May chumra devikkurim mimmaaser shekken asurim lezarim adderabba maaser chamur shekken asur leonen
Umay chumra detoda ushlamim mimmaaser shekken teunin mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach adderabba maaser chamur shekken teunin kesef tzura
Umay chumra divchor mittoda ushlamim shekken kedushshato merechem adderabba toda ushlamim chamurim shekken teunim semicha unsachim utnufat chaze vashok
Umay chumra dechattat veasham mibbechor shekken kodshe kadashim adderabba bechor chamur shekken kedushshato merechem
Umay chumra deola mechattat veasham shekken kalil adderabba chattat veasham chamiri shekken mechapperi
Vechullehu chamiri meola deit behu shette achilot
Ella may deyalda imeh kerabbi shimon dilmay disvira leh ledideh mesares leh likra vedaresh leh
Vechi mazhirin min haddin ha afilu leman deamar onshin min haddin en mazhirin min haddin isura bealma
Vehaamar rava zar sheachal min haola lifne zerika chutz lachoma lerabbi shimon loke chamesh chamishsha isurin hau
Veha anan tenan ellu hen hallokin

a: Ella kera yattira hu mikkede ketiv veheveta sham veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha bammakom vego lichtov rachamana lo tuchal leochlam mihdar mefaresh behu rachamana lema li
Ella leyachode lehu lave lechol chad vechad

Gufa amar rava zar sheachal min haola lifne zerika chutz lachoma lerabbi shimon loke chamesh velilke name mishshum vezar lo yochal ki kodesh hem hane mile hecha dilchohanim chaze hacha dilchohanim name la chaze
Velilke name mishshum uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu kevan sheyyatza basar chutz limchitzato neesar hane mile hecha devifnim chaze hacha divfanim name la chaze
Velilke name kidrabbi eliezer deamar rabbi eliezer lo yeachel ki kodesh hu
b: Kol shebbakkodesh pasul ba hakkatuv liten lo taase al achilato hane mile hecha dekodem pesulo chaze hacha dekodem pesulo name la chaze
Velilke name keidach derabbi eliezer detanya rabbi eliezer omer kol shehu bechalil tihye liten lo taase al achilato in hachi name verava mehay kera kaamar

Amar rav gidel amar rav siman kuza kohen sheachal mechattat veasham lifne zerika loke may tama deamar kera veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem leachar kappara in lifne kappara la lav habba mikkelal ase lav hu
Metiv rava vechol behema mafreset parsa veshosaat shesa shette ferasot maalat gera babbehema otah tochelu otah tochelu veen behema acheret tochelu vei kidkaamratte et ze lo tochlu lema li

Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav gidel amar rav zar sheachal mechattat veasham lifne zerika patur may tama deamar kera veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem kol hecha dekarenan beh veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem karenan beh vezar lo yochal kodesh vechol hecha dela karenan beh veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem la karenan beh vezar lo yochal
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya bikkurim hannacha meakkevet bahen keriyya en meakkevet bahen

Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi veha amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya hifrish bikkurim kodem lechag veavar alehen hechag yerakvu may lav mishshum dela matze lemikre alehen vei salka datach keriyya en meakkevet bahen ammay yerakvu
Kidrabbi zera deamar rabbi zera kol harauy levila en bila meakkevet bo vechol sheeno rauy levila bila meakkevet bo

Rabbi acha bar yaakov matne lah kidrabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan vekashya leh derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan umi amar rabbi yochanan bikkurim hannacha meakkevet bahen keriyya en meakkevet bahen veha bea mineh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan bikkurim meematay muttarin lechohanim vaamar leh haruyin likriyya mishshekkara alehen vesheen reuyin likriyya mishsherau pene habbayit
Kashya keriyya akkeriyya kashya hannacha ahannacha
Keriyya akkeriyya la kashya ha rabbi shimon ha rabbanan hannacha ahannacha name la kashya ha rabbi yehuda veha rabbanan
May rabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer vehinnachto zo tenufa atta omer zo tenufa o eno ella hannacha mammash keshehu omer vehinnicho hare hannacha amur ha ma ani mekayyem vehinnachto zo tenufa

Uman tanna diflig aleh derabbi yehuda rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi detanya velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha limed al habbikkurim shetteunin tenufa divre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov may tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov

Atya yad yad mishshelamim ketiv hacha velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha uchtiv yadav teviena et ishshe Adonai ma kan kohen af lehallan kohen ma lehallan bealim af kan bealim ha ketzad manniach kohen yadav tachat yede bealim umenif
Amar rava bar adda amar rabbi yitzchak bikkurim

a: Meematay mchayyavin alehem mishsheyyiru pene habbayit keman ki hay tanna detanya rabbi eliezer omer bikkurim miktzatan bachutz umiktzatan bifnim shebbachutz hare hen kechullin lechol divrehem shebbifnim hare hen kehekdesh lechol divrehem
Amar rav sheshet bikkurim hannacha meakkevet bahen keriyya en meakkevet bahen

Keman ki hay tanna detanya rabbi yose omer shelosha devarim mishshum shelosha zekenim rabbi yishmael omer yachol yaale adam maaser sheni bizman hazze birushalayim veyochlennu vedin hu bechor taun havaat makom umaaser sheni taun havaat makom ma bechor eno ella bifne habbayit af maaser eno ella bifne habbayit
Ma livchor shekken taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach bikkurim yochichu ma levikkurim shekken teunim hannacha

Talmud lomar veachalta sham lifne Adonai elohecha vego makkish maaser livchor ma bechor eno ella lifne habbayit af maaser eno ella lifne habbayit veim ita lifroch ma levikkurim shekken teunin keriyya vehannacha
Amar rav ashe nehi deikuva leka mitzva mi leka velema mitzva velifroch ella amar rav ashe kevan deika bikkure hagger devae lememar asher nishba Adonai laavotenu vela matze amar la pesika leh
Velihdar dina vetete bamma hatztzad mishshum deika lemifrach ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahen tzad mizbeach
Umay kasavar i kasavar kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo bechor name i kasavar kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo afilu bechor name tibbee

Amar ravina leolam kasavar kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo vehacha bivchor shennizrak damo kodem churban habbayit vecharav habbayit vaadayin besaro kayyam umakkeshinan besaro ledamo ma damo bammizbeach af besaro bammizbeach umakkish maaser livchor
Vechi davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umlammed behekkesh masar dagan chullin hu
b: Hanicha leman deamar batar lamed azlinan ella leman deamar batar melammed azlinan may ika lememar
Dam uvasar chada milta hi

Kodshe kodashim vechu tenena chada zimna maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu amar rabbi yose bar chanina sefa bemaaser sheni tahor vegavra tahor deka achel chutz lachoma resha bemaaser sheni tame vegavra tame veka achel leh birushalayim
Umnalan demichayyav aleh mishshum tuma detanya rabbi shimon omer lo biarti mimmennu betame ben sheani tame vehu tahor ben sheani tahor vehu tame vehechan muzhar al achila eni yodea
Tumat hagguf behedya ketiv nefesh asher tigga bo vetama ad haarev velo yochal min hakkodashim vego ella tumat atzmo minnayin
Dichtiv lo tuchal leechol bisharecha ulhallan hu omer bisharecha tochlennu hattame vehattahor
Vetanya deve rabbi yishmael afilu tame vetahor ochlin bikara achat veen choshshin vekaamar rachamana hayeche tame dishray lach gabbe tahor hatam hacha la techol
Umna lan devar pediyya hu
Deamar rabbi elazar minnayin lemaaser sheni shennitma sheppodin oto afilu birushalayim talmud lomar ki lo tuchal seeto veen seet ella achila shenneemar vayyissa masot meet panav
Amar rav bivi amar rav assi minnayin lemaaser sheni tahor sheppodin oto afilu bifsia achat chutz lachoma shenneemar ki lo tuchal seeto hay mibbee leh lechidrabbi elazar
Im ken lema kera lo tuchal leochlo may seeto veema kullo lehachi hu daata im ken lema kera lo tuchal litlo may seeto shema minah tarte
Yatev rav chanina verav hoshaya veka mibbaya lehu appitcha dirushalayim mahu peshita hu bachutz umassao bifnim kelatuhu mechitzot hu bifnim umassao bachutz mahu
Tena lehu hahu sava bidve rabbi shimon ben yochay ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom mimmiluacha
Bae rav pappa naket leh bekanya may teku

Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan maaser sheni meematay chayyavin alav mishsheraa pene hachoma may tama deamar kera lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana uchtiv ki lo tuchal leechol bisharecha kol hecha dekarenan beh lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu karenan beh lo tuchal leechol bisharecha vechol hecha dela karenan beh lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu la karenan beh lo tuchal leechol bisharecha

Metivi rabbi yose omer kohen shealta beyado teena shel tevel amar teena zo terumatah beuktzah maaser rishon bitzfonah umaaser sheni lidromah vehi shenat maaser sheni vehu birushalayim o masar ani vehu bigvulin achalah

a: Loke achat
Vezar sheachalah loke shettayim sheilu battechilla achalah eno loke ella achat
Tama deiteh birushalayim ha bigvulin loke shalosh deaf al gav delav roe pene choma deayelah veappekah
I hachi may lememra hacha bemay askinan kegon deayelinhu betivlayehu vekasavar mattanot shello hurmu kemi shehurmu damyan

Vesavar rabbi yose mattanot shello hurmu kemi shehurmu dame vehatanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al perot shello nigmera melachtan veavru birushalayim sheyyippade maaser sheni shellahen veyeachel bechol makom

Veal ma nechleku al perot shennigmera melachtan veavru birushalayim shebbet shammay omrim yachzir maaser sheni shellahem veyeachel birushalayim uvet hillel omrim yippade veyeachel bechol makom vei salka datach mattanot shello hurmu kemi shehurmu damyan ha kelatuhu mechitzot
Amar rabba mechitza leechol deorayeta mechitza liklot derabbanan vechi gezur rabbanan ki iteh beeneh betivleh la gezur rabbanan
Ravina amar kegon denaket leh bekanya vetifshot baya derav pappa

Matni hakkoreach korcha berosho vehammakkif peat rosho vehammashchit peat zekano vehassoret serita achat al hammet chayyav sarat serita achat al chamishsha metim o chamesh seritot al met echad chayyav al kol achat veachat
Al harosh shettayim achat mikkan veachat mikkan al hazzakan shettayim mikkan ushtayim mikkan veachat millematta rabbi eliezer omer im nitlu kullan keachat eno chayyav ella achat
Veeno chayyav ad sheyyittelennu betaar rabbi eliezer omer afilu likketo bemalket o birhitani chayyav

Gema tanu rabbanan lo yikrechu yachol afilu karach arba vechamesh kerichot lo yehe chayyav ella achat talmud lomar korcha lechayyev al kol korcha vekorcha berosham ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar lo titgoddu velo tasimu korcha ben enechem lamet yachol lo yehe chayyav ella al ben haenayim bilvad minnayin lerabbot kal harosh talmud lomar berosham lerabbot kol harosh
Veen li ella bakkohanim sheriba bahen hakkatuv mitzot yeterot yisrael minnayin

Neemar kan korcha veneemar lehallan korcha ma lehallan chayyav al kol korcha vekorcha vechayyav al harosh keven haenayim af kan chayyav al kol korcha vekorcha vechayyav al harosh keven haenayim uma lehallan al met af kan al met
Hane arba vechamesh kerichot hechi dame ilema beze achar ze uvchamesh hatraot peshita
b: Ella bachada hatraa mi michayyav vehatnan nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom eno chayyav ella achat amru lo al tishte al tishte vehu shote chayyav al kol achat veachat la tzericha desach chamesh etzbeotav nasha veotvinhu bevat achat dehaveya leh hatraa lechol chada vachada

Ella amri nehardae mishshemeh derava shalosh tumot bishlamim lamma achat lichlal veachat lifrat veachat letuma hakketuva betora setam veeni yodea ma hi

Vehay name mibe leh ayede devae lemichtav karet lechidrabbi avahu ketav name temaot dela saggi lah belav hachi
Ella amar rava atya tumatotumato ketiv hacha lechol tumato
b: Uchtiv hatam tame yihye od tumato bo ma lehallan tumat mikdash af kan tumat mikdash
Veella bah lema li
Lerabbot nivlat of tahor
Ha amratte bah miuta hu mishshum demiuta hu iyyatar ketiv o ki yigga devar negia in delav bar negia la uchtiv bah miuta have miut achar miut veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot
Yesh bah yedia battechilla veen bah yedia bassof sair hannaase bifnim vechu tanu rabbanan vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot bene yisrael vego
Yesh li beinyan ze lehavi shalosh temaot tumat avoda zara vetumat giluy araot vetumat shefichut damim

Baavoda zara hu omer lemaan tamme et mikdashi begiluy araot hu omer ushmartem et mishmarti levilti asot mechukkot hattoevot vego velo tittammeu bahem bishfichut damim hu omer velo tetamme et haaretz yachol al shalosh temaot hallalu yehe sair mechapper talmud lomar mittumot bene yisrael velo kol tumot
Ma matzinu shechillek hakkatuv mikkelal kol tumot heve omer tumat mikdash vekadashav af kan betumat mikdash vekadashav divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi shimon omer mimmekomo hu muchra hare hu omer vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot mittumot shel kodesh
Yachol al kol tuma shebbakkodesh yehe sair ze mechapper talmud lomar umippishehem lechol chattotam chataim dumya difshaim ma peshaim sheenam bene korban af chataim sheenam bene korban
Uminnayin leyesh bah yedia battechilla veen bah yedia bassof shessair ze tole talmud lomar lechol chattotam chayyave chattaot bammashma
Amar mar yesh li beinyan ze lehavi shalosh tumot tumat avoda zara vetumat giluy araot vetumat shefichut damim
Hay avoda zara hechi dame i bemezid bar ketala hu i beshogeg bar korban hu
Bemezid vela atro beh beshogeg vela ityeda leh

a: Giluy araot name hechi dame i bemezid bar ketala hu i beshogeg bar korban hu
Bemezid vela atro beh beshogeg vela ityeda leh
Shefichut damim name hechi dame i bemezid bar ketala hu i beshogeg bar galut hu
Bemezid vela atro beh beshogeg vela ityeda leh i name behanach delav bene galut ninhu

Amar mar yachol al shalosh temaot hallalu yehe sair mechapper talmud lomar mittumot velo kol tumot ma matzinu shechalak hakkatuv mikkelal kol hattemaot betumat mikdash vekadashav af kan betumat mikdash vekadashav divre rabbi yehuda
May chalak demayete beole veored ema avoda zara umay chalak
Siman avoda zara yoledet metzora nazir vechu
Demayete seira velo kisba
Amar rav kahana anan chalak lehakel kaamrinan vehay chalak lehachmir hu
Ema yoledet dechalak demayeta ole veored amar rav hoshaya lechol chattotam velo lechol tumotam
Ulrabbi shimon ben yochay deamar yoledet name chotet hi may ika lememar rabbi shimon letameh deamar mimmekomo hu muchra
Ema metzora amar rav hoshaya lechol chattotam velo lechol tumotam
Ulrabbi shemuel bar nachmani deamar al shiva devarim negaim bain may ika lememar hatam nigeh deikkappar leh vekorban leishteroye bakkahal
Veema nazir tame dechalak demayete torim uvne yona amar rav hoshaya lechol chattotam velo lechol tumotam
Ulrabbi elazar hakkappar deamar nazir name chote hu may ika lememar savar lah kerabbi shimon deamar mimmekomo hu muchra

Amar mar rabbi shimon omer mimmekomo hu muchra hare hu omer vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot mittumato shel kodesh ku shappir kaamar rabbi shimon verabbi yehuda amar lach hahu mibe leh ki hechi deaved lifnay velifnim hachi naaved bahechal
Verabbi shimon hahu mivvechen yaase nafka verabbi yehuda i mehahi hava amena nayete par vesair acharine venaaved ka mashma lan verabbi shimon vechen yaase leohel moed mineh mashma
Amar mar yachol al kol tumot shebbakkodesh yehe sair ze mechapper talmud lomar mippishehem lechol chattotam vego may nihu yesh bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof hay bar korban hu
La tzericha deityeda leh samuch lishkiat hachamma salka datach amena addemayete
b: Nitle leh ka mashma lan
Amar mar minnayin sheyyesh bah yedia battechilla veen bah yedia bassof shessair ze tole minnayin may ka kashya leh

Hachi ka kashya leh hashta deamratte chataim dumya difshaim ma peshaim delav bene korban af chattaim name delav bene korban ema ma peshaim delav bene korban leolam af chattaim delav bene korban leolam umay ninhu in bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof aval yesh bah yedia battechilla veen bah yedia bassof kevan dechi mityeda leh bar korban hu ema la litle
Vechi tema en bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof sair hannaase bachutz veom hakkippurim mechapper
Salka datach amena nefoch mefach amar kera lechol chattotam mikkelal divne chattaot ninhu
Venitkappar unchappar kappara gemura i ketiv mechattotam kidka amratte hashta dichtiv lechol chattotam lehanach deatu lichlal chattat
Vechi meachar sheeno mechapper lamma tole amar rabbi zera lomar sheim met met belo aon amar leh rava im met mita memareket ella amar rava lehagen alav min hayyissurin
En bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof sair hannaase bachutz veom hakkippurim mechapper ku
Mikkede itakkoshe itakkush lahadade unchappar penimi addideh veaddechitzon venafka minah lehecha dela avad chitzon amar kera achat kappara achat mechapper veeno mechapper shette kapparot
Unchappar chitzon addideh veammay deaved penimi nafka minah letuma deera ben ze leze amar kera achat bashshana kappara zo lo tehe

a: Ella achat bashshana
Ulrabbi yishmael deamar en bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof bar korban hu sair hannaase bachutz ammay mechapper al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof
Hay seire hargalim usire rashe chodashim mechapperin savar lah kerabbi meir deamar kol hasseirim kapparatan shava al tumat mikdash vekadashav
Ella lemay hilcheta itakkash chitzon lifnimi ma penimi eno mechapper bishar averot af chitzon eno mechapper bishar averot
Al sheen bah yedia battechilla velo bassof seire regalim usire rashe chodashim mechapperin divre rabbi yehuda
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel may tama derabbi yehuda amar kera usir izzim echad lechattat la chet sheen makkir bo ella Adonai yehe sair ze mechapper
Vehay mibe leh lechidresh lakish deamar resh lakish ma nishtanna sair shel rosh chodesh shenneemar bo la amar hakkadosh baruch hu sair ze yehe kappara al shemmiatti et hayyareach
Im ken lema kera al Adonai may la lichdaamaran
Veema kulleh lehachi hu daata im ken nema kera chattat Adonai may la shamatte minah tarte

Unchappar name afilu bishar averot tana deve rabbi yishmael hoil veze ba bizman kavua veze ba bizman kavua ma ze eno mechapper ella al tumat mikdash vekadashav af ze eno mechapper ella al tumat mikdash vekadashav

Ashkechan seire rashe chodashim seire hargalim menalan vechi tema ha name kidtana deve rabbi yishmael ika lemifrach i midderosh chodesh shekken tadir i middeom hakkippurim shekken merubba kapparato vechi tema
b: Ha gamrinan rosh chodesh middeom hakkippurim vela parchinan hatam kappara michtav ketiva galloye milta bealma hu aval hacha ika lememar kullah milta la gamrinan

Ella kidamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina seirusir hacha name seirusir veitakkush seire regalim lisire rashe chodashim ma seire rashe chodashim enan mechapperin ella al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof af seire hargalim enan mechapperin ella al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof

Ibaya lehu ki amar rabbi yehuda al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof hane mile bechet sheen sofo livada aval chet shessofo livada kemi sheyyesh yedia bassof dame vesair hannaase bachutz veom hakkippurim mechapper o dilma afilu chet shessofo livada hashta miha chet sheen makkir bo ella Adonai karena beh
Ta shema detanya al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof vechet shessofo livada seire hargalim usire rashe chodashim mechapperim divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi shimon omer seire hargalim mechapperin aval lo seire rashe chodashim vechu

Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya may tameh derabbi shimon amar kera veotah natan lachem laset et aon haeda vehay kera besair derosh chodesh ketiv veyalef aonaon mitztzitz neemar kan aon veneemar lehallan aon ma lehallan tumat basar af kan tumat basar
I ma lehallan olin af kan olin aon haeda ketiv
Mikkede migmar gamri mehadade nechappar derosh chodesh addideh veaddetzitz nafka minah lehecha denishbar hatztzitz amar kera aon aon echad hu nose veen nose shene aonot
Unchappar tzitz addideh veadderosh chodesh nafka minah letuma deera ben ze leze amar kera otah otah nose aon veen acheret nose aon
Rav ashe amar ketiv hacha aon haeda eda velo kadashim vehatam ketiv aon hakkodashim kadashim velo eda
Ashkechan seire rashe chodashim dimchapperi al tahor sheachal et hattame seire regalim dimchapperi al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof menalan
Kidamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina seirusir hacha name seirusir

a: Veitakkush seire hargalim lisire rashe chodashim ma sair derosh chodesh bemilta dekodesh mechapperi af seire regalim bemilta dekodesh mechapperi
Vechi tema nichapperu adderosh chodesh ha amrinan otah otah nose aon veen acher nose aon
Vechi tema nichapperu addeom hakkippurim ha amrinan achat bashshana kappara zo lo tehe ella achat bashshana
Ammay mechapperi

I al sheyyesh bah yedia battechilla veyesh bah yedia bassof hay bar korban hu i al sheyyesh bah yedia battechilla veen bah yedia bassof hay sair hannaase bifnim veom hakkippurim tole i al sheen bah yedia battechilla aval yesh bah yedia bassof hay sair hannaase bachutz veom hakkippurim mechapper
Al korchach eno mechapper ella al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof
Rabbi meir omer kol hasseirim kapparatan shava ku
Amar rabbi chama bar rabbi chanina may tama derabbi meir amar kera seirusir hukkeshu kol hasseirim ze laze vav mosif al inyan rishon
Kasalka datach kol chad vechad mechavreh gamar vehaamar rabbi yochanan kol hattora kullah lemedin lamed millamed chutz mikkodashim sheen lemedin lamed millamed
Ha la kashya kullehu mikkamma gamri
Tinach kol dichtiv beh usir atzeret veom hakkippurim dela ketiv beh usir menalan
Ella amar rabbi yona amar kera elle taasu la bemoadechem hukkeshu kol hammoadim kullan ze laze veha rosh chodesh lav moed hu
Ivra rosh chodesh name ikri moed kidamar abbaye deamar abbaye tammuz dehahi shatta malloye malleuho dichtiv kara alay moed lishbor bachuray
Amar rabbi yochanan umode rabbi meir besair hannaase bifnim shehu eno mechapper kapparatan vehen enan mechapperin kapparato
Hu eno mechapper kapparatan kappara achat mechapper veeno mechapper shette kapparot hen enan mechapperin kapparato amar kera achat bashshana kappara zo lo tehe ella achat bashshana

Tanya name hachi al sheen bah yedia lo battechilla velo bassof veal sheen bah yedia battechilla aval yesh bah yedia bassof veal tahor sheachal et hattame seire hargalim usire rashe chodashim vesair hannaase bachutz mechapperin divre rabbi meir
Veilu sair hannaase bifnim shayereh vechapparato name shayerah
Haya rabbi shimon omer seire rashe chodashim mechapperin al tahor sheachal et hattame ku

Bishlama derashe chodashim la mechapperi addirgalim deamar kera aon aon echad hu nose veeno nose shene aonot ella dirgalim nichapperu adderashe chodashim amar kera otah otah nose aon veen acher nose aon

Bishlama dirgalim la mechapperin addeom hakkippurim deamar kera achat bashshana kappara zo lo tehe ella achat bashshana ella deom hakkippurim nichapperu addirgalim amar kera achat kappara achat mechapper veeno mechapper shette kapparot
Veha ki ketiv achat besair hannaase bifnim hu dichtiv amar kera millevad
b: Chattat hakkippurim veitakkush chitzon lifnimi
Rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshemo ku

May shena derashe chodashim dela mechapperi addirgalim deamar kera aon aon echad hu nose veeno nose shene aonot dirgalim name la nichapperu adderashe chodashim deamar kera otah otah hu nose aon veen acher nose aon otah lo mashma leh

May shena dirgalim dela mechapperi addeom hakkippurim deamar kera achat bashshana kappara zo lo tehe ella achat bashshana i hachi deom hakkippurim name la nichapperu addirgalim achat ketiv kappara achat mechapper veeno mechapper shette kapparot achat la mashma leh
Ammay dechi ketiv achat besair hannaase bifnim ketiv i hachi dirgalim name nechapperu addeom hakkippurim dechi ketiv achat besair hannaase bifnim ketiv

Leolam achat mashma leh veshane hacha deamar kera vechipper aharon al karnotav achat bashshana karnotav demizbeach happenimi hu dechappara achat mechapper veeno mechapper shette kapparot ha dechitzon afilu shette kapparot
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan temidin shello hutzrechu latztzibbur nifdin temimim
Yatev rabba vekaamar lah leha shemata amar leh rav chisda man tzayet lach ulrabbi yochanan rabbach vechi kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha

Amar leh atte la tisberah dela amrinan kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha vehatnan motar hakketoret ma hau osin bah mafrishin mimmenna sechar haummanin umchallelin otah al meot haummanin venotnin otah laummanin bischaran vechozrin velokchin otah mitteruma chadasha
Veammay nema kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha
Amar leh ketoret kaamratte shane ketoret

a: Dikdushshat damim hu
Ella meatta lo tippasel bitvul yom allema tanya netanah bemachteshet nifselet bitvul yom
Vechi tema kol kedushshat damim mipasli bitvul yom vehatnan hammenachot moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu kadshu bichli huchsheru lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvlina
Kadshu bichli in lo kadshu bichli la

Ella may kedushshat hagguf hi ella meatta tipasel belina allema tenan hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashuach uminchat nesachim moalim bahen mishshehukdeshu kadshu bichli huchsheru lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvlina
Kadshu bichli in lo kadshu bichli la
Amar leh lina kaamratte shane ketoret hoil vetzuratah bechol hashshana kullah
Mikkol makom kashya vechi kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha amar rabba lev bet din matne alehen im hutzrechu hutzrechu veim lav yihu lidmehen
Amar leh abbaye veha mar hu deamar hikdish zachar ledamav kadosh kedushshat hagguf la kashya ha deamar lidme ola ha deamar lidme nesachim
Etiveh abbaye par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehem
b: Vechen seire avoda zara sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen kullan yamutu divre rabbi yehuda rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava sheen chattat tzibbur meta
Veammay lema lev bet din matne alehen
Avudin kaamratte shane avudin dela shechichi

Hare para dela shechicha vetanya para nifdet al kol pesul shebbah meta tippade nishchata tippade matza acheret naa hemenna tippade shechatah al gabbe maarachtah en lah pediyya olamit shane para dekodshe bedek habbayit hi
I hachi meta o nishchata tippade ha baenan haamada vehaaracha ha manni rabbi shimon hi deamar kodshe mizbeach hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha kodshe bedek habbayit la hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha
I rabbi shimon ema sefa shechatah al gabbe maarachtah en lah pediyya olamit
Vehatanya rabbi shimon omer para metammea tumat ochalin hoil vehayeta lah sheat hakkosher veamar resh lakish omer haya rabbi shimon para nifdet al gav maarachtah
Ella shane para hoil vedameha yekarin
Amar mar meta tippade vechi podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim amar rav mesharsheya mishshum orah vekayemi bet din umatnu addata deorah amar rav kahana amri inashe miggamla unnah
Etiveh amru lo lerabbi shimon mahu sheyyikrevu ze baze amar lehu yikrevu amru lo hoil veen kapparatan shava heach hen kerevin amar lahen kullan bain lechapper al tumat mikdash vekadashav

Veammay lema lev bet din matne alehen rabbi shimon kaamratte rabbi shimon let leh lev bet din matne alehen deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav amram amar rabbi yochanan temidin shello hutzrechu latztzibbur ledivre rabbi shimon en nifdin temimim ledivre chachamim nifdin temimim
Verabbanan difligi aleh derabbi shimon man ninhu i nema rabbanan diktoret

a: Shane ketoret dela bar reiyya hi
Ella rabbanan defara dilma shane para dedameha yekarin
Veella rabbanan deamru lo
Mimmay derabbi yehuda hi vehachi kaamar leh bishlama ledidi deamena lev bet din matne alehen ammetu lehachi yikrevu ella ledidach deamratte la ammay yikrevu
Vedilma rabbi meir hi vehachi kaamar leh bishlama ledidi deamena kol hasseirim kapparatan shava mishshum hachi yikrevu ella ledidach ammay yikrevu
Ella rabbi yochanan gemara gemir lah ledivre rabbi shimon en nifdin ledivre chachamim nifdin
Ulrabbi shimon delet leh lev bet din matne alehen may avdin lehu amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan mekayetzin bahen et hammizbeach
Amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak umode rabbi shimon bisire chattat sheen mekayetzin begufan ella bidmehen
Hacha hu demeikara ola vehashta ola aval hatam demeikara chattat vehashta ola gezera leachar kappara attu lifne chappara

Amar abbaye af anan name tenena par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehem vechen seire avoda zara sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen kullan yamutu divre rabbi yehuda rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava sheen chattat tzibbur meta
Veammay nikrevu inhu gufayehu ola ella lav shema minah gezera leachar kappara attu lifne chappara
Amar rava af anan name tenena vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava
Veammay yikrav ihu gufeh ola ella lav shema minah gezera achar kappara attu lifne chappara
Amar ravina af anan name tenena asham shemmetu bealav o shennitkapperu bealav yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava rabbi eliezer omer yamut rabbi yehoshua omer yavi bedamav ola
Velikrav ha gufa ola ella lav gezera leachar kappara attu lifne kappara shema minah
Tanya name hachi ma hen meviin min hammotarot
b: Kayitz kivnot shuach lammizbeach vehachtiv ki chol seor vechol devash vego tane rav chanina kivnot shuach leadam

Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda en mekayetzin beolat haof amar rava ha burcha amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava may burcheta ana amritah nihaleh umishshemeh derav shimi minnehardea amritah nihaleh deamar rav shimi minnehardea motarot lenidvat tzibbur azli veen olat of betzibbur
Veaf shemuel savar leha derabbi yochanan deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel korbenot tzibbur sakkin moshachtan lema shehen

Tanya name hachi umode rabbi shimon besair sheim lo karav baregel yikrav berosh chodesh veim lo karav berosh chodesh yikrav beom hakkippurim veim lo karav beom hakkippurim yikrav baregel veim lo karav beregel ze yikrav beregel acher shemmittechillato lo ba ella lechapper al mizbeach hachitzon
Tana lo hukdash ella lechapper al mizbeach hachitzon
Veal zedon tumat mikdash vekadashav sair hannaase bifnim ku menahane mile

Detanu rabbanan vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot bene yisrael vego peshaim ellu hammeradim vechen hu omer melech moav pasha bi veomer az tifsha livna baet hahi chattaot ellu hashshegagot vechen hu omer nefesh ki techeta vishgaga
Al shear averot shebbetora hakkallot vehachamurot hazzedonot vehashshegagot ku
Hayenu kallot hayenu ase velo taase chamurot hayenu karetot umitot bet din hoda hayenu mezid lo hoda hayenu shogeg

Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar al shear averot shebbattora ben kallot ben chamurot ben sheasaan beshogeg ben sheasaan bemezid otan sheasaan beshogeg ben noda lo sefekan ben lo noda lo sefekan veellu hen kallot ase velo taase veellu hen chamurot karetot umitot bet din
Hay ase hechi dame i dela avad teshuva zevach reshaim toeva i daavad teshuva kol yoma name detanya avar al mitzvat ase veasa teshuva la zaz mishsham ad shemmochalin lo
Amar rabbi zera

a: Beomed bemirdo verabbi hi detanya rabbi omer al kol averot shebbattora ben asa teshuva ben lo asa teshuva yom hakkippurim mechapper chutz mipporek ol umgalle panim battora umefer berit bevasar sheim asa teshuva yom hakkippurim mechapper veim lav en yom hakkippurim mechapper

May tama derabbi detanya ki devar Adonai baza ze happorek ol umgalle panim battora veet mitzvato hefer ze hammefer berit babbasar hikkaret tikkaret hikkaret lifne yom hakkippurim tikkaret leachar yom hakkippurim
Yachol afilu asa teshuva talmud lomar aonah bah lo amarti ella bizman sheaonah bah
Verabbanan hikkaret baolam hazze tikkaret laolam habba aonah bah sheim asa teshuva vamet mita memareket

Umi matzet mokmatte lah kerabbi veha middesefa rabbi yehuda hi resha name rabbi yehuda hi dekatane sefa echad yisrael veechad kohanim veechad kohen mashuach uman it leh hay sevara rabbi yehuda mikkelal deresha rabbi yehuda
Amar rav yosef rabbi hi vesavar lah kerabbi yehuda

Amar leh abbaye daveka kaamar mar rabbi savar lah kerabbi yehuda aval rabbi yehuda la savar lah kerabbi o dilma midderabbi savar lah kerabbi yehuda af rabbi yehuda savar lah name kerabbi mihu orcha demilta katane lememar detalmid savar lah kerabbeh
Amar leh in daveka kaamena rabbi savar lah kerabbi yehuda aval rabbi yehuda la savar lah kerabbi

Detanya yachol yehe yom hakkippurim mechapper al shavim veal sheenan shavim vedin hu hoil vechattat veasham mechapperin veom hakkippurim mechapper ma chattat veasham en mechapperin ella al hashshavim af yom hakkippurim en mechapper ella al hashshavim ma lechattat veasham sheen mechapperin al hammezid kashshogeg tomar leom hakkippurim shemmechapper al hammezid kashshogeg
Hoil umchapper al hammezid kashshogeg yechapper al shavim veal sheenan shavim talmud lomar ach chalak
Setam sifra manni rabbi yehuda vekaamar shavim in lo shavim la

Echad yisrael veechad kohanim veechad kohen mashuach

Umanni rabbi yehuda hi detanya vechipper et mikdash hakkodesh ze lifnay velifnim et ohel moed ze hechal mizbeach kemashmao yechapper ellu azarot kohanim kemashmao am hakkahal ellu yisrael yechapper ellu halviyyim
Hushu kullan lechappara achat shemmitkapperin besair hammishtalleach bishar averot divre rabbi yehuda

Rabbi shimon omer keshem sheddam sair hannaase bifnim mechapper al yisrael al tumat mikdash vekadashav kach dam happar mechapper al hakkohanim al tumat mikdash vekadashav uchshem sheviduo shel sair hammishtalleach mechapper al yisrael bishar averot kach viduo shel par mechapper al hakkohanim bishar averot
Ulrabbi shimon ha vadday hushu may hushu divne kappara ninhu mihu kol chad vechad mechappar bidnafsheh

May tameh derabbi shimon dichtiv velakach et shene hasseirim itakkash sair hammishtalleach lesair hannaase bifnim ma sair hannaase bifnim eno mechapper al hakkohanim al tumat mikdash vekadashav dichtiv beh asher laam af sair hammishtalleach eno mechapper al hakkohanim bishar averot
Verabbi yehuda amar lach lehachi itakkush sheyyihu shavim bemare uvkoma uvdamim hu daata
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan veshachat et seir hachattat asher laam sheen hakkohanim mitkapperin bo uvamme mitkapperin befaro shel aharon
Yachol lo yitkapperu befaro shel aharon shehare kevar neemar asher lo meatta en lahen kappara keshehu omer yechapper al hakkohanim matzinu lahen kappara
Bamma hen mitkapperin mutav sheyyitkapperu befaro shel aharon shehare huttar mikkelalo etzel beto veal yitkapperu besair hannaase bifnim shello huttar mikkelalo etzel beto
Veim nafshecha lomar hare hu omer bet aharon barchu et Adonai bet hallevi barchu et Adonai yire Adonai barchu et Adonai

Man tanna amar rabbi yirmeya dela kerabbi yehuda dei rabbi yehuda haamar kohanim yesh lahen kappara besair hammishtalleach umanni rava amar rabbi shimon hi deamar kohanim en lahem kappara besair hammishtalleach

Abbaye amar afilu tema rabbi yehuda hachi kaamar meatta en lahem kappara betumat mikdash vekadashav keshehu omer yechapper al hakkohanim matzinu sheyyesh lahen kappara bishar averot uchmo dematzinu sheyyesh lahen kappara bishar averot kach yesh lahen kappara

a: Betumat mikdash vekadashav bamma hem mitkapperin mutav sheyyitkapperu befaro shel aharon shehare huttar mikkelalo etzel beto veal yitkapperu besair hannaase bifnim shehare lo huttar mikkelalo

Hadaran alach shevuot shettayim
Matni yediot hattuma shettayim shehen arba nitma veyada veneelma mimmennu hattuma vezachur et hakkodesh
Nelam mimmennu hakkodesh vezachur et hattuma neelmu mimmennu ze vaze veachal et hakkodesh velo yada umishsheachal yada hare ze beole veored
Nitma veyada veneelma mimmennu tuma vezachur et hammikdash nelam mimmennu mikdash vezachur et hattuma nelam mimmennu ze vaze venichnas lammikdash velo yada umishsheyyatza yada hare ze beole veored
Echad hannichnas laazara veechad hannichnas letosefet haazara sheen mosifin al hair veal haazarot ella bemelech venavi veurim vetummim vesanhedrin shel shivim veechad uvishte todot uvshir

Rabbi eliezer omer hashsheretz venelam mimmennu al helem sheretz chayyav veeno chayyav al helem mikdash

Gema amar rav pappa leabbaye shettayim shehen arba shettayim shehen shesh haveyan yediot hattuma techilla vasof yediot hakkodesh techilla vasof yediot mikdash techilla vasof
Ultamach tamne haveyan deha ika tuma dekodesh vetuma demikdash techilla vasof
Ha la kashya shem tuma achat hi mikkol makom shet haveyan
Amar rav pappa leolam tamne haveyan arbee kammayata dela mayetan leh lide korban la ka chashev arbee batrayata demayetan leh lide korban ka chashev
Veika deamri amar rav pappa leolam tamne haveyan vearbee kammayata deletanhu bechol hattora kullah ka chashev arbee batrayata deitanhu bechol hattora kullah la ka chashev
Bae rav pappa neelmu mimmennu hilchot tuma mahu hechi dame ilema dela yada i sheretz tame i tzefardea tame zil keri be rav hu

Leolam deyada betumat sheretz uchgon dinga bechaadasha vela yada kaadasha i metamme i la metamme may kevan deyada dimtamme sheretz baolam yedia hi o dilma kevan dechaadasha la yada i metamme i la metamme haalama hi teku

Alliba deman i alliba derabbi akiva devae yedia battechilla ha la mechayyev al helem mikdash i alliba derabbi yishmael dimchayyev al helem mikdash ha la bae yedia battechilla

Attu lachme toda baazara mi la mitachli ella kirushalayim ma yerushalayim davar hanneechal bah veotze mimmenna nifsal af azara davar hanneechal bah vehayyotze mimmenna nifsal

Vehishtachava o sheshshaha kede hishtachavaa amar rava lo shanu ella shehishtachava kelappe fenim aval hishtachava kelappe chutz shaha in lo shaha la

Hechi dame hishtachavaa deit bah shehiyya vehechi dame hishtachavaa delet bah shehiyya delet bah shehiyya zo keria bealma hi deit bah shehiyya pishut yadayim veraglayim

Bae rava tzarich shehiyya lemalkut o en tzarich shehiyya lemalkut lekorban gemiri shehiyya lemalkut la gemiri shehiyya

Have bah rabba bemay ilema samuch levistah uvman ilema betalmid chacham bishlama akkenisa lichayyav kasavar yacholni livol ella apperisha ammay lichayyav mezid hu

Veella besheen samuch levistah uvman ilema betalmid chacham vela chada la michayyav akkenisa anus apperisha mezid i beam haaretz chada hu demichayyav apperisha
Hadar amar rava leolam besamuch levistah uvtalmid chacham vetalmid chacham lezo veen talmid chacham lazo
Amar rava vetarvayehu tenanhi kenisa tenena perisha tenena perisha tenena dekatane haya meshammesh im hattehora veamra lo nitmeti uferash miyyad chayyav
Kenisa tenena nimtza al shello temein vechayyavin bekorban may lav besamuch levistah veakkenisa

Amar leh rav adda bar matna lerava leolam ema lach beshello samuch levistah veapperisha vechi tema perisha lema li ha tena leh ha itzterich leashmoinan nimtza al shellah temeim besafek ufturin min hakkorban veayede devae mitne nimtza al shellah tena name nimtza al shello
Amar leh ravina lerav adda mi matzet leokomah lehahi beshello samuch levistah veapperisha veha nimtza katane venimtza levatar hachi mashma vei apperisha meikara ki paresh leh meikara haveya leh yedia
Amar leh rava tzayet may dekaamar rabbach hechi etzet detanya alah zo hi mitzvat ase shebbenidda shechayyavin aleha veim ita mitzvat lo taase hi
Amar leh i taneta chassar utni hachi zo hi mitzvat lo taase shebbenidda shechayyavin aleha haya meshammesh im hattehora veamra lo nitmeti uferash miyyad chayyav zo hi mitzvat ase shebbenidda ku
Amar mar perash miyyad chayyav hechi aved amar rav huna mishshemeh derava noetz eser tzippornav bakkarka ad sheyyamut vetuveh
Amar rava zot omeret hamshammesh met baaraot patur dei salka datach chayyav hacha may tama patur mishshum deanus hu i anus hu ki perash miyyad name niptar anus hu

Amar leh abbaye leolam ema lach hamshammesh met baaraot chayyav vehacha may tama patur mishshum deanus hu veha deamratte ki faresh miyyad ammay chayyav shehaya lo lifrosh bahanaa muetet uferash bahanaa merubba
Amar leh rabba bar chanan leabbaye im ken matzinu arukka uktzara benidda
b: Vaanan bammikdash tenan ella mishshum dela dame arukka dehacha ketzara dehatam vaarukka dehatam ketzara dehacha
Matkef lah rav huna bereh derav natan mi amar abbaye anus hu alma beshello samuch levistah kaamrinan veha abbayye deamar chayyav shettayim alma besamuch levistah askinan
Ki itmar deabbaye bealma itmar

Bea mineh rabbi yonatan ben yose ben lakonya merabbi shimon ben yose ben lakonya azhara levoel nidda minnayin min hattora shekal kala petak beh azhara levoel nidda veel ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tikrav
Ella azhara limshammesh im hattehora veamra lo nitmeti dela nifrosh miyyad menalan amar chizkiyya amar kera uthi niddatah alav afilu bishat niddatah tehe alav
Ashkechan ase lo taase menalan amar rav pappa amar kera lo tikrav lo tikrav name la tifrosh hu dichtiv haomrim kerav elecha al tiggash bi ki kedashticha
Tanu rabbanan vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumatam amar rabbi yoshiyya mikan azhara livne yisrael sheyyifreshu minneshotehen samuch levistan vechamma amar rabba ona

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay kol sheeno poresh meishto samuch levistah afilu hoyin lo banim kivne aharon metim dichtiv vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumatam vehaddava beniddatah usmich leh achare mot

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan kol happoresh meishto samuch levistah hoyin lo banim zecharim dichtiv lehavdil ben hattame uven hattahor usmich leh ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar hoyin lo banim reuyin lehoraa dichtiv lehavdil ulhorot

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan kol hammavdil al hayyayin bemotzae shabbatot hoyin lo banim zecharim dichtiv lehavdil ben hakkodesh uven hachol uchtiv hatam lehavdil ben hattame uven hattahor usmich leh ishsha ki tazria rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar banim reuyin lehoraa dichtiv lehavdil ulhorot
Amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar kol hamkaddesh et atzmo bishat tashmish hoyin lo banim zecharim shenneemar vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim usmich leh ishsha ki tazria
Rabbi eliezer omer hashsheretz venelam mimmennu ku may benayehu

Amar chizkiyya sheretz unvela ika benayehu rabbi eliezer savar baenan ad deyada i besheretz itammi i binvela itammi verabbi akiva savar la baenan ad deyada dechevan deyada deitamma deitammi baolam la tzerich i besheretz itammi i binvela itammi
Vechen amar ulla sheretz unvela ika benayehu deulla rame derabbi eliezer adderabbi eliezer umshanne mi amar rabbi eliezer baenan ad deyada i besheretz itammi i binvela itammi
Vrminhi amar rabbi eliezer ma nafshach chelev achal chayyav notar achal chayyav shabbat chilel chayyav yom hakkippurim chilel chayyav ishto nidda baal chayyav achoto baal chayyav
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua hare hu omer o hoda elav chattato asher chata bah ad sheyyivada lach bamme chata
Umshanne hatam asher chata vehevi amar rachamana chet kol shehu hacha mikkede ketiv bechol davar tame o benivlat sheretz tame lema li shema minah baenan ad deyada i besheretz itammi i binvela itammi
Verabbi akiva ayede

a: Devae lemichtav behema vechayya lechidrabbi katev name sheretz kidtana deve rabbi yishmael kal parasha shenneemra venishnet lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah
Verabbi eliezer hay bah may aved leh perat lammitassek
Verabbi yochanan amar mashmaut dorshin ika benayehu vechen amar rav sheshet mashmaut dorshin ika benayehu derav sheshet machlef derabbi eliezer lerabbi akiva udrabbi akiva lerabbi eliezer
Bea mineh rava merav nachman helem ze veze beyado mahu amar leh hare helem tuma beyado vechayyav adderabba hare helem mikdash beyado ufatur

Amar rav ashe chazenan i mittuma ka faresh hare helem tuma beyado vechayyav i mimmikdash ka faresh hare helem mikdash beyado ufatur amar leh ravina lerav ashe kelum peresh mimmikdash ella mishshum tuma kelum peresh mittuma ella mishshum mikdash ella la shena
Tanu rabbanan shene shevilin echad tame veechad tahor vehalach barishon velo nichnas bashsheni venichnas chayyav
Halach barishon venichnas hizza veshana vetaval veachar kach halach bashsheni venichnas chayyav rabbi shimon poter verabbi shimon ben yehuda poter bechullan mishshum rabbi shimon
Bechullan
b: Vaafilu bekammayeta mimma nafshach tame hu amar rava hacha bemay askinan kegon shehalach barishon uvshaa shehalach bashsheni shachach shehalach barishon dehaveya leh miktzat yedia
Uvha ka mipalgi tanna kamma savar amrinan miktzat yedia kechol yedia verabbi shimon savar la amrinan miktzat yedia kechol yedia
Halach barishon venichnas hizza veshana vetaval chazar vehalach bashsheni venichnas chayyav verabbi shimon poter veammay chayyav sefek yedia hu
Amar rabbi yochanan kan asu sefek yedia kidia veresh lakish amar ha manni rabbi yishmael hi deamar la baenan yedia battechilla

Urmi derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan urmi deresh lakish adderesh lakish detanya achal sefek chelev venoda sefek chelev venoda rabbi omer keshem shemmevi chattat al kol echad veechad kach mevi asham taluy al kol echad veechad
Rabbi shimon ben yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon amru mishshum rabbi shimon eno mevi ella asham taluy echad shenneemar al shiggato asher shagag hattora ribta shegagot harbe veasham taluy echad
Veamar resh lakish kan shana rabbi yediot sefekot mitchallekot lechattaot
Verabbi yochanan amar keshem sheyediot vadday bealma mitchallekot lechattaot kach yediot safek mitchallekot laashamot

Bishlama derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan la kashya kan asu velo bechol hattora kullah asu hacha hu dela ketiva yedia behedya mivvenelam hu deka ate velo bechol hattora kullah asu dichtiv o hoda elav yedia meallayeta baenan
Ella leresh lakish addemokem leh kerabbi yishmael nokmah kerabbi ha ka mashma lan derabbi yishmael la bae yedia battechilla
Peshita dela bae middela meyatri leh kerae venelam demichayyav al helem mikdash mahu detema ki let leh mikkerae aval miggemara it leh ka mashma lan
Hadaran alach yediot hattuma
Matni shevuot shettayim shehen arba shevua sheochal veshello ochal sheachalti veshello achalti

Shevua shello ochal veachal kol shehu chayyav divre rabbi akiva amru lo lerabbi akiva hechan matzinu beochel kal shehu shehu chayyav shezze chayyav amar lahem rabbi akiva vechi hechan matzinu bimdabber umevi korban shezze medabber umevi korban
Gema lememra desheochal deachelna mashma urminhi shevua lo ochal lach shevua sheochal lach lo shevua shello ochal lach asur
Amar abbaye leolam deachelna mashma la kashya kan bimsarvin bo leechol kan besheen

a: Mesarvin bo leechol
Matnitin besheen mesarvin bo leechol barayeta bimsarvin bo leechol vekaamar la achelna vela achelna dechi ka mishteva hachi kaamar shevua shello ochal
Rav ashe amar teni shevua shei ochal lach i hachi may lememra mahu detema lishaneh itkilo leh ka mashma lan
Tanu rabbanan mivta shevua isar shevua isur isar im atta omer isar shevua chayyav veim lav patur im atta omer isar shevua veha amratte isar shevua hu
Amar abbaye hachi kaamar mivta shevua isar mitfes bishvua isur isar im atta omer mitfes bishvua kemotzi shevua mippiv dame chayyav veim lav patur
Mimmay demivta shevua dichtiv o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim isar name dichtiv kol neder vechol shevuat issar
Ella mimmay deisar mitfes bishvua hu dichtiv o asra issar al nafshah bishvua
Mevatte name hachtiv lechol asher yevatte haadam bishvua
Ella amar abbaye mivta shevua mehacha veim hao tihye leish undareha aleha o mivta sefateha asher asra al nafshah veilu shevua la kaamar bemay asra atzmah bemivta

Rava amar leolam ema lach mitfes bishvua lav kemotzi shevua mippiv dame vehachi kaamar mivta shevua isar name shevua issareh deisar hittilo hakkatuv ben neder lishvua hotzio bilshon neder neder bilshon shevua shevua
Hechan hittilo veim bet ishah nadara o asra issar al nafshah bishvua vego
Veazdu letamayehu deitmar matpis bishvua abbaye amar kemotzi shevua mippiv dame verava amar lav kemotzi shevua mippiv dame

Metivi eze isar haamur battora haomer hare alay shello ochal basar veshello eshte yayin kayyom shemmet bo aviv kayyom shemmet bo peloni keom shenneherag bo gedalya ben achikam kayyom sheraa yerushalayim bechurbanah asur veamar shemuel vehu shennadur uva meoto hayyom
Bishlama leabbaye middematpis beneder neder matpis bishvua shevua
b: Ella lerava kashya

Amar lach rava taretz veema hachi ezehu isar neder haamur battora haomer hare alay shello ochal basar veshello eshte yayin kayyom shemmet bo aviv kayyom shenneherag bo peloni veamar shemuel vehu shennadur uva meoto hayyom
May tama amar kera ish ki yiddor neder la ad sheyyiddor bedavar hannadur

Kayyom shemmet bo aviv peshita keom shenneherag bo gedalya ben achikam itzterich leh salka datach amena kevan dechi la nadar name asur ki nadar name la haveya aleh isur vehay lav mitfes beneder hu ka mashma lan
Veaf rabbi yochanan savar lah leha derava dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan mivta lo ochal lach isar lo ochal lach shevua
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan ochal velo ochal sheker veazharteh mehacha la tishshavu vishmi lashshaker achalti velo achalti shave veazharteh mehacha lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshave
Kunnamot over belo yachel devaro
Metivi shave vesheker echad hen may lav middeshave lesheavar af sheker name lesheavar alma achalti velo achalti sheker hu
Mide irya ha kidita veha kidita umay davar echad hen divdibur echad neemru kidtanya zachor veshamor bedibur echad neemru ma sheen yachol happe ledabber uma sheen haozen yachol lishmoa

Bishlama hatam bedibur echad neemru kidrav adda bar ahava deamar rav adda bar ahava nashim chayyavot bekidush hayyom devar tora deamar kera zachor veshamor kol sheyyeshno bishmira yeshno bizchira vehane neshe hoil veitanhu bishmira itanhu name bizchira ella hacha lemay hilcheta mibe leh
Ella keshem shelloke al shave kach loke name al sheker
Kelappe leya ella ema keshem shelloke al sheker kach loke name al shave
Peshita hay lav vehay lav mahu detema kedaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye lo yinnake kelal

a: Ka mashma lan kidshanni leh
Veibaet ema keshem shemmevi korban al sheker kach mevi korban al shave verabbi akiva hi dimchayyev lesheavar kilhabba
Metivi e zo hi shevuat shave nishba leshannot et hayyadua leadam shevuat sheker nishba lehachlif ema nishba umachlif

Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan achalti velo achalti sheker veazharteh millo tishshavu vishmi lashshaker ochal velo ochal over belo yachel devaro vee zo hi shevuat shave nishba leshannot et hayyadua leadam

Amar rav pappa ha derabbi avahu lav beferush itmar ella mikkelala itmar deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav amram amar rav yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili kol lo taase shebbattora lav sheyyesh bo maase lokin alav vesheen bo maase en lokin alav chutz minnishba umemer umkallel et chavero bashshem

Nishba menalan amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay amar kera lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshave ki lo yenakke bet din shel mala en menakkin oto aval bet din shel matta malkin oto umnakkin oto

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye dilma hachi kaamar rachamana lo yenakke kelal i ketiv ki lo yenakke kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv ki lo yenakke Adonai Adonai hu deeno menakke aval bet din shel matta malkin oto umnakkin oto
Ashkechan shevuat shave shevuat sheker menalan rabbi yochanan dideh amar lashshave lashshave shette peamim im eno inyan lishvuat shave tenehu inyan lishvuat sheker

Vehave bah rabbi avahu hay shevuat sheker hechi dame ilema shevua shello ochal veachal lav sheyyesh bo maase hu veella deamar shevua sheochal velo achal hay mi loke veha itmar shevua sheochal kikkar zo hayyom veavar hayyom velo achalah rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu eno loke
Rabbi yochanan amar eno loke mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav veresh lakish amar eno loke mishshum dehave hatraat safek vehatraat safek lo shemah hatraa
Veamar rabbi avahu tehe beachalti velo achalti umay shena amar rava beferush ribta tora shevuat sheker doma leshave ma shave lesheavar af sheker name lesheavar

Etiveh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi avahu shevua shello ochal kikkar zo shevua shello ochlenna shevua shello ochlenna vaachalah eno chayyav ella achat zo hi shevuat bittuy shechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah korban ole veored
Zo hi lemaote may lav lemaote achalti velo achalti dela lake
La lemaote achalti velo achalti mikkorban zo hi deal shiggatah korban ole veored aval achalti velo achalti la verabbi yishmael hi deamar eno chayyav ella al heatid lavo aval milka lake
b: Ema sefa zo hi shevuat shave shechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah patur zo hi lemaote may may lav lemaote achalti velo achalti dela lake
La zo hi deal shiggatah patur mikkorban aval achalti velo achalti al shiggatah chayyav korban verabbi akiva hi dimchayyev lesheavar kilhabba

Ha amratte resha rabbi yishmael hi resha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva kullah rabbi akiva veresha lav lemaote achalti velo achalti mikkorban ella lemaote ochal velo achal mimmalkot aval korban michayyav
Umay shena mistabbera kae bilhabba memaet lehabba kae bilhabba memaet lesheavar

Shevua shello ochal veachal kol shehu chayyav ku ibaya lehu rabbi akiva bechol hattora kullah kerabbi shimon sevira leh dimchayyev bemashshehu detanya rabbi shimon omer kol shehu lemakkot velo amru kezayit ella leinyan korban
Uvdin hu devae iploge bealma vehay deka mipalgi hacha lehodiacha kochan derabbanan deaf al gav deika lememar hoil umfaresh chayyav setam name chayyav ka mashma lan defatri
O dilma bealma kerabbanan sevira leh vehacha hayenu tama hoil umfaresh chayyav setam name chayyav
Ta shema deamru lo lerabbi akiva hechan matzinu beochel kal shehu chayyav shezze chayyav veim ita lema lehu ana bechol hattora kullah kerabbi shimon sevira li
Ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi bechol hattora kullah kerabbi shimon sevira li ledidchu odo li miha hoil umfaresh chayyav setam name chayyav vaamaru leh rabbanan la
Ta shema rabbi akiva omer nazir sheshshara pitto beyayin veyesh bah kede letzaref kezayit chayyav vei salka datach bealma kerabbi shimon sevira leh lema li letzaref

Veod tenan shevua shello ochal veachal nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim chayyav verabbi shimon poter vehavenan bah ammay chayyav mushba mehar sinay hu rav ushmuel verabbi yochanan deamri tarvayehu becholel devarim hammuttarin im devarim haasurin
Veresh lakish amar i atta motze ella i bimfaresh chatzi shiur vealliba derabbanan i bistam vealliba derabbi akiva deamar adam oser atzmo bechol shehu
Vei salka datach bealma kerabbi shimon sevira leh kal shehu name mushba veomed mehar sinay hu ella lav shema minah bealma kerabbanan sevira leh shema minah
Amru lo lerabbi akiva hechan matzinu ku vela vahare nemala beriyya shane
Vahare hekdesh ha baenan shave peruta
Vahare mefaresh mefaresh name kivriyya dame
Vahare afar ella

a: Tifshot devae rava shevua shello ochal veachal afar bechamma tifshot ad deika kezayit ki kaamrinan bemide devar achila kaamrinan
Vahare kunnamot kunnamot name kimfaresh dame
Amar lahen hechan matzinu bimdabber umevi korban shezze medabber umevi korban vela vahare megaddef medabber veoser kaamrinan vehay medabber vechote hu
Vahare nazir mevi korbano al dibburo kaamrinan vehay mevi korban leishteroye leh chamra hu deka mayete
Vahare hekdesh oser leatzmo kaamrinan vehay oser al kol haolam kullo hu
Hare kunnamot kasavar en meila bekunnamot
Amar rava machaloket bistam aval bimfaresh divre hakkol bechol shehu may tama mefaresh name kivriyya dame
Veamar rava machloket beshello ochal aval beshello etom divre hakkol bechol shehu peshita mahu detema litom name kidamri inashe ka mashma lan
Amar rav pappa machloket bishvuot aval bekunnamot divre hakkol bechol shehu may tama kunnamot name kevan dela ka madkar shema daachila kedimfaresh dame
Metivi shene kunnamot mitztarfin shette shevuot en mitztarfot rabbi meir omer kunnamot kishvuot vei salka datach chayyav bechol shehu lema li letzaref
Deamar achila mizzo alay kunnam achila mizzo alay kunnam i hachi ammay mitztarfot sof sof zil lehacha leka shiura vezil lehacha leka shiura deamar achila mishshettehen alay kunnam
Dichvatah gabbe shevuot deamar shevua shello ochal mishshettehen ammay en mitztarfin amar rav pinchas shane shevuot mittoch shechalukot lechattaot en mitztarfot
I hachi rabbi meir omer kunnamot kishvuot bishlama shevuot hoil vachalukot lechattaot ella kunnamot ammay la efoch rabbi meir omer shevuot kekunnamot velet leh lidrav pinchas
Ravina amar ki kaamar rav pappa leinyan malkot ki tanya hahi leinyan korban devaenan shave peruta

Lememra desavri rabbanan yesh meila bekunnamot vehatanya kikkar zo hekdesh vaachalah ben hu ben chavero maal lefichach yesh lah pidon kikkar zo alay hekdesh hare hu maal chavero lo maal lefichach en lah pidon divre rabbi meir
b: Vachachamim omrim ben hu uven chavero lo maal lefi sheen meila bekunnamot
Efoch echad ze veechad ze lo maal lefi sheen meila bekunnamot divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim hu maal vachavero lo maal
I hachi rabbi meir omer kunnamot kishvuot ella kunnamot itzterofe hu dela mitztarfi ha meila it behu vehaamar rabbi meir en meila bekunnamot kelal
Ledivrehen derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi en meila bekunnamot kelal ledidchu odo li mihat dekunnamot kishvuot
Verabbanan shevuot ika derav pinchas kunnamot leka derav pinchas
Amar rava shevua shello ochal veachal afar patur bae rava shevua shello ochal afar bechamma kevan deamar shello ochal dateh akkezayit o dilma kevan delav mide deachli inashe hu bechol shehu teku
Bae rava shevua shello ochal chartzan bechamma kevan demitachil al yede taarovet dateh akkezayit o dilma kevan dela beeneh achli leh inashe dateh ammashshehu teku

Bae rav ashe nazir sheamar shevua shello ochal chartzan bechamma dechevan dichzayit isura deorayeta hu ki ka mishteva ahettera ka mishteva vedateh ammashshehu o dilma kevan deamar shello ochal dateh akkezayit

Ta shema shevua shello ochal veachal nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim chayyav verabbi shimon poter vehavenan bah ammay chayyav mushba veomed mehar sinay hu rav ushmuel verabbi yochanan deamri becholel devarim hammuttarin im devarim haasurin
Veresh lakish amar i atta motze ella i bimfaresh chatzi shiur vealliba derabbanan i bistam vealliba derabbi akiva deamar adam oser atzmo bechol shehu
Veha nevela demushba veomed mehar sinay hu dechi chartzan legabbe nazir damya vetama defaresh ha la paresh dateh akkezayit shema minah
Ella tifshot devae rava shevua shello ochal afar bechamma tifshot dead deika kezayit deha nevela keafar damya vetama defaresh ha lo parish dateh akkezayit
Lo afar lav bar achila hu kelal nevela bat achila vearya hu dirvia ilavah

Matni shevua shello ochal veachal veshata eno chayyav ella achat shevua shello ochal veshello eshte veachal veshata chayyav shettayim shevua shello ochal veachal pat chittin ufat seorin ufat kussemin eno chayyav ella achat shevua shello ochal pat chittin ufat seorin ufat kussemin veachal chayyav al kol achat veachat shevua shello eshte veshata mashkin harbe eno chayyav ella achat shevua shello eshte yayin veshemen udvash veshata chayyav al kol achat veachat

Shevua shello ochal veachal ochalin sheenan reuyin laachila veshata mashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya patur shevua shello ochal veachal nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim chayyav verabbi shimon poter amar kunnam ishti nehenet li im achalti hayyom vehu achal nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim hare ishto asura
Gema amar rabbi chiyya bar avin amar shemuel shevua shello ochal veshata chayyav ibaet ema sevara veibaet ema kera

Vedilma hacha name al yede anigron
Shechar ketiv mide dimshakkar
Vedilma devela keilit detanya achal devela keilit veshata devash vechalav venichnas lammikdash veavad chayyav
Ella gamar shecharshechar minnazir ma lehallan yayin af kan yayin

Amar rava af anan name tenena shevua shello ochal veachal veshata eno chayyav ella achat i amratte bishlama shetiyya bichlal achila itzterich leh letanna leashmoinan deeno chayyav ella achat ella i amratte shetiyya lav bichlal achila shevua shello ochal veachal veasa melacha mi itzterich leashmoinan deeno chayyav ella achat

Amar leh abbaye ella may shetiyya bichlal achila ema sefa shevua shello ochal veshello eshte veachal veshata chayyav shettayim kevan deamar shello ochal itsar leh bishtiyya ki amar shello eshte ammay chayyav ilu amar shello eshte tere zimne mi michayyav tarte
Amar leh hatam deamar shello eshte vahadar amar shello ochal dishtiyya bichlal achila itah achila bichlal shetiyya letah

Aval amar shevua shello ochal veshello eshte veachal veshata may eno chayyav ella achat i hachi addetane resha shevua shello ochal veachal veshata eno chayyav ella achat litne shevua shello ochal veshello eshte eno chayyav ella achat vechol shekken shello ochal lechodeh
Ella leolam kidkatane veshane hacha kevan deamar shello ochal vahadar amar shello eshte galli addateh dehach achila deamar achila geredta hi
Amar rav ashe matnitin name dayeka shevua shello ochal veachal ochalin sheen reuyin laachila veshata mashkin sheen reuyin lishtiyya patur ha reuyin chayyav veammay ha shevua shello ochal kaamar
Dilma deamar tarte shevua shello ochal shevua shello eshte
Shevua shello ochal veachal pat chittin ku vedilma lemiftar nafsheh meachranyata kaate
Hava leh lememar chittin usorin vechussemin vedilma lachos
Dahava leh lememar pat chittin usorin vechussemin vedilma pat chittin leechol seorin vechussemin lachos
Dahava leh lememar pat chittin veshel seorin veshel kussemin
b: Vedilma al yede taarovet
Ema vechen shel seorim vechen shel kussemin pat pat lema li shema minah lechallek
