Amar rav pappa hacha bemunnachin lefanav askinan shehaya lo lomar shevua shello eshte ellu vedilma ellu hu dela shatena acharine shatena
Ella deamar shevua dela shatena kegon ellu dilma kegon ellu dela shatena betzir mehachi utfe mehachi shatena
Ella kegon deamar shevua shello eshte mimmin ellu vedilma min ellu hu dela shatena ha inhu gufayehu shatena
Ema shello eshte ellu uminayehu

Rav acha bereh derav ika amar bimsarhev bo chavero askinan deamar lo bo ushte immi yayin veshemen udvash dehaya lo lomar shevua shello eshte immecha yayin veshemen udvash lema li lechayyev al kol achat veachat

Tenan hatam ten li chittin usorin vechussemin sheyyesh li beyadcha shevua sheen lecha beyadi kelum eno chayyav ella achat shevua sheen lecha beyadi chittin usorin vechussemin chayyav al kol achat veachat
Veamar rabbi yochanan afilu peruta mikkullam mitztarefet
Peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar apperate michayyav akkelale la michayyav vechad amar akkelale name michayyav
Hacha may
Amar rava hachi hashta hatam michayyav akkelala umichayyav apperata deha i mishteva vahadar mishteva michayyav tarte hacha i salka datach ita bichlala apperate ammay michayyav mushba veomed hu

Shevua shello ochal vechu ha gufa kashya amratte shevua shello ochal veachal ochalin sheen reuyin laachila veshata mashkin sheen reuyin lishtiyya patur vahadar tane shevua shello ochal veachal nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim chayyav may shena resha defatur umay shena sefa dechayyav
Ha la kashya resha bistam vesefa bimfaresh
Mefaresh name gufeh tikshe ammay mushba mehar sinay hu
Rav ushmuel verabbi yochanan deamri becholel devarim hammuttarin im devarim haasurin
Veresh lakish amar i atta motze ella i bimfaresh chatzi shiur vealliba derabbanan i bistam alliba derabbi akiva deamar adam oser atzmo bechol shehu
Bishlama rabbi yochanan la amar keresh lakish demokem lah lematnitin kedivre hakkol ella resh lakish may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan
Amar lecha ki amrinan isur kolel

a: Beisur habba meelav beisur habba al yede atzmo la amrinan
Bishlama leresh lakish mishshum hachi ka fatar rabbi shimon detanya rabbi shimon omer kol shehu lemakkot velo amru kezayit ella lekorban ella lerabbi yochanan may tama derabbi shimon defatar
Mide hu tama ella mishshum isur kolel rabbi shimon letameh delet leh isur kolel detanya rabbi shimon omer haochel nevela beom hakkippurim patur
Bishlama leresh lakish mashkachatte lah belav vahen ella lerabbi yochanan bishlama lav mashkachatte lah ella hen hechi mashkachatte lah
Ella kidrava deamar rava shevua shello ochal veachal afar patur
Amar rav mari af anan name tenena kunnam ishti nehenet li im achalti hayyom veachal nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim hare ishto asura lo
Hachi hashta hatam kevan demeikara achleh vahadar ishteva aleh
b: Achshove ella hacha mi achsheveh
Amar rava may tama deman deit leh isur kolel
Mide dehave aisur mosif
Uman defatar delet leh ki amar isur mosif bachada chaticha bishte chatichot la amrinan
Veamar rava leman deit leh isur kolel amar shevua shello ochal teenim vechazar veamar shevua shello ochal teenim vaanavim migo dechayela shevua aanavim chayela name atteenim
Peshita
Mahu detema isur habba meelav amrinan isur habba meatzmo la amrinan ka mashma lan
Metiv rava bereh derabba yesh ochel achila achat vechayyav aleha arba chattaot veasham echad veellu hen tame sheachal chelev vehu notar min hammukdashin beom hakkippurim
Rabbi meir omer af im hayeta shabbat vehotzio chayyav amru lo eno min hashshem
Veim ita mashkachatte lah chamesh kegon sheamar shevua shello ochal temarim vechelev migo dechayela shevua attemarim chayela name achelev
Ki katane isur habba meelav isur habba meatzmo la katane
Vahare hekdesh
Bivchor dikdushshato merechem
Ibaet ema ki katane mide delet leh sheela shevua deit leh sheela la katane
Hare hekdesh
Ha okminan bivchor
Ibaet ema ki katane korban kavua korban ole veored la katane
Hare tame sheachal et hakkodesh dekorban ole veored hu
Benasi verabbi eliezer hi deamar nasi mevi sair
Rav ashe amar ki katane mide devae shiur shevua dechayela appachot mikkeshiur la katane
Hare hekdesh
Ha baenan shave peruta
Verav ashe meaverya amar rabbi zera ki katane zedono karet zedono lav la katane
Vahare asham dizdono lav vekatane

a: Bechattat kaamrinan
Ravina amar ki katane mide dechayel ammide devar achila hu shevua dechayela ammide delav bar achila hu la katane
Vahare hekdesh dechayel name aetzim vaavanim
Ella ki katane mide dechayel ammide deit beh meshasha shevua dechayela ammide delet beh meshasha kegon sheishan veshello ishan la katane
Matni echad devarim shel atzmo veechad devarim shel acherim veechad devarim sheyyesh bahen mammash veechad devarim sheen bahen mammash
Ketzad amar shevua sheetten leish peloni veshello etten shennatatti veshello natatti
Sheishan veshello ishan sheyyashanti veshello yashanti sheezrok tzeror layyam veshello ezrok shezzarakti veshello zarakti
Rabbi yishmael omer eno chayyav ella al heatid lavo shenneemar lehara o lehetiv
Amar lo rabbi akiva im ken en li ella devarim sheyyesh bahen haraa vahatava devarim sheen bahen haraa vahatava minnayin
Amar lo meribuy hakkatuv amar lo im riba hakkatuv lechach riba hakkatuv lechach
Gema tanu rabbanan chomer bannedarim mibbashshevuot chomer bashshevuot mibbannedarim chomer bannedarim shehannedarim chalim al devar mitzva kidvar harshut ma sheen ken bashshevuot
Chomer bashshevuot shehashshevuot chalot al davar sheen bo mammash kedavar sheyyesh bo mammash ma sheen ken bannedarim
Ketzad amar shevua sheetten lifloni veshello etten may etten ilema tzedaka leani mushba veomed mehar sinay hu shenneemar naton titten lo
Ella mattana leashir
Sheishan veshello ishan ini vehaamar rabbi yochanan haomer shevua shello ishan shelosha yamim malkin oto veyashen lealtar
Hatam deamar shelosha hacha dela amar shelosha
Sheezrok tzeror layyam veshello ezrok itmar shevua shezzarak peloni tzeror layyam veshello zarak rav amar chayyav ushmuel amar patur
Rav amar chayyav iteh belav vehen ushmuel amar patur leteh bilhabba

Lema biflugta derabbi yishmael verabbi akiva ka mipalgi ditnan rabbi yishmael omer eno chayyav ella al heatid lavo shenneemar lehara o lehetiv amar lo rabbi akiva im ken en li ella devarim sheyyesh bahen haraa vahatava devarim sheen bahen haraa vahatava minnayin
Amar lo meribuy hakkatuv amar lo im riba hakkatuv lechach riba hakkatuv lechach
Rav deamar kerabbi akiva ushmuel deamar kerabbi yishmael
Alliba derabbi yishmael kulle alma la peligi hashta milta deitah bilhabba la mechayyav alah rabbi yishmael lesheavar milta deletah bilhabba mibaya

Ki peligi alliba derabbi akiva rav kerabbi akiva ushmuel amar ad kan la mechayyev rabbi akiva hatam lesheavar ella milleta deitah bilhabba mechayyev rabbi akiva lesheavar aval mide deleteh bilhabba la
Lema biflugta
b: Derabbi yehuda ben betera verabbanan kamipalgi ditnan nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bitel patur lekayyem et hammitzva velo kiyyem patur shehaya baddin sheyehe chayyav kedivre rabbi yehuda ben betira deamar rabbi yehuda ben betira uma im harshut sheeno mushba aleha mehar sinay hare hu chayyav aleha mitzva shemmushba aleha mehar sinay eno din sheyehe chayyav aleha
Amru lo lo im amarta bishvuat harshut shekken asa bah lav kehen tomar bishvuat mitzva shekken lo asa bah lav kehen
Nema rav deamar kerabbi yehuda ben betira ushmuel deamar kerabbanan
Alliba derabbi yehuda ben betira kulle alma la peligi hashta lav vahen la bae lehabba ulsheavar bae
Ki peligi alliba derabbanan shemuel kerabbanan verav ki la mechayevi rabbanan belav vahen dichtiv lehara o lehetiv behedya aval lehabba ulsheavar demeribuya dikrae atu mechayevi
Metiv rav hamnuna lo achalti hayyom velo hinnachti tefilin hayyom mashbiacha ani veamar amen chayyav bishlama lo achalti iteh belo ochal ella lo hinnachti mi iteh belo anniach
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah litzdadin katane lo achalti lekorban lo hinnachti lemalkot

Metiv rava ezo hi shevuat shave nishba leshannot et hayyadua laadam veamar al ammud shel even shehu bemakom peloni shehu shel zahav veamar ulla vehu shennikar lishlosha bene adam tama denikar ha lo nikar over mishshum shevuat bituy veammay ha eno bihe shel zahav
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah nikar over mishshum shevuat shave lo nikar over mishshum shevuat sheker
Amar abbaye umode rav beomer lachavero shevua sheani yodea lecha edut veishtechach dela yeda leh defatur hoil veleteh bichlal sheeni yodea lecha edut
Yadati velo yadati machloket headti velo headti machloket
Bishlama lishmuel deamar milta deleteh bilhabba la mechayyev aleh lesheavar lehachi appekah rachamana lishvuat edut mikkelal shevuat bituy ella lerav lemay hilcheta appekah rachamana
Amruha rabbanan kammeh deabbaye leichayyove alah tarte
Amar lehu tarte la matzitu amritu detanya leachat meelle leachat atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo shettayim
Ulabbaye lemay hilcheta appekah rachamana
Lechidtanya bechullan neemar veneelam vechan lo neemar venelam lechayyev al hammezid kashshogeg
Amaru leh rabbanan leabbaye ema bemezid michayyav chada beshogeg michayyav tarte
Amar lehu lav hayenu daamari leachat achat atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo shettayim vei bemezid mi ika tarte
Rava amar mishshum dehave davar shebbakkelal veyatza lidon bedavar hechadash en lecha bo ella chidusho bilvad
Mikkelal deabbaye savar itah lishvua baolam
Vehaamar abbaye mode rav beomer lachavero shevua sheani yodea lach edut veishtechach dela yeda leh defatur hoil veleteh beeni yodea lach edut
Hadar beh abbaye mehahi veibaet ema

a: Chada minayehu rav pappa amrah

Rabbi yishmael omer eno chayyav ella al heatid lavo tanu rabbanan lehara o lehetiv en li ella devarim sheyyesh bahen haraa vahatava sheen bahen haraa vahatava minnayin talmud lomar o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim
En li ella lehabba lesheavar minnayin talmud lomar lechol asher yevatte haadam bishvua divre rabbi akiva rabbi yishmael omer lehara o lehetiv lehabba

Amar lo rabbi akiva im ken en li ella devarim sheyyesh bahen hatava veharaa devarim sheen bahen haraa vahatava minnayin amar lo meribbuy hakkatuv amar lo im riba hakkatuv lechach riba hakkatuv lechach
Shappir ka amar leh rabbi akiva lerabbi yishmael

Amar rabbi yochanan rabbi yishmael sheshshimesh et rabbi nechunya ben hakkana shehaya doresh et kal hattora kullah bichlal ufrat ihu name doresh bichlal ufrat rabbi akiva sheshshimesh et nachum ish gam zo shehaya doresh et kal hattora kullah beriba umiet ihu name doresh riba umiet
May rabbi akiva dedaresh ribuye umiute detanya o nefesh ki tishshava riba lehara o lehetiv miet lechol asher yevatte haadam chazar veriba riba umiet veriba riba hakkol
May riba riba kol mile umay miet miet devar mitzva

Verabbi yishmael daresh kelal ufrat o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim kelal lehara o lehetiv perat lechol asher yevatte haadam chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella cheen happerat ma happerat meforash lehabba af kol lehabba
Ahani kelala leetoye afilu devarim sheen bahen haraa vahatava lehabba ahani perata lemaote afilu devarim sheyyesh bahen haraa vahatava lesheavar
Efoch ana
Amar rabbi yitzchak dumya dilhara o lehetiv mi sheisuro mishshum bal yachel devaro yatzata zo sheen isuro mishshum bal yachel devaro ella mishshum bal teshakkeru

Rav yitzchak bar avin amar amar kera o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim mi shehashshevua kodemet labbituy velo shehabbituy kodemet lashshevua yatza ze achalti velo achalti shehammaase kodem lashshevua
Tanu rabbanan haadam bishvua perat leanus venelam perat lemezid
Mimmennu shennitallema mimmennu shevua yachol shennitallema mimmennu chefetz talmud lomar bishvua venelam al helem shevua hu chayyav veeno chayyav al helem chefetz
Amar mar haadam bishvua perat leanus hechi dame

Kidrav kahana verav assi ki hao kayemi mikkamme derav mar amar shevuata dehachi amar rav umar amar shevuata dehachi amar rav ki ato lekammeh derav amar kechad minayehu amar leh idach vaana beshikra ishtevai
Amar leh libbach anasach
Venelam mimmennu shennitallem mimmennu shevua yachol shennitallem mimmennu chefetz talmud lomar bishvua venelam mimmennu al helem shevua hu chayyav veeno chayyav al helem chefetz

Machachu aleh bemareva bishlama shevua mashkachatte lah bela chefetz kegon deamar shevua shello ochal pat chittin uchsavur sheochal kaamar dishvuateh inshi cheftza dechir ella chefetz belo shevua hechi dame
Kegon deamar shevua shello ochal pat chittin uchsavur shel seorim kaamar dishvuateh dechir leh cheftza inshi kevan decheftza inshi lehu hayenu helem shevua
Ella amar rabbi elazar da veda achat hi

Matkef lah rav yosef alma chefetz belo shevua la mashkachatte lah veha mashkachatte lah kegon deamar shevua shello ochal pat chittin vehoshit yado lassal litol pat seorin vealta beyado shel chittin uchsavur seorim hi vaachalah dishvuateh dechir leh cheftza hu dela yada leh
Amar leh abbaye kelum mechayevatte leh korban ella ammay ditfis bideh helem shevua hu
Lishana acharina amar leh abbaye lerav yosef sof sof korban deka mayete alah dehay pat mihat helem shevua hu
Verav yosef amar lach kevan dechi yada leh dechittin hu paresh mineh helem chefetz hu
Bea mineh rava merav nachman helem ze veze beyado mahu amar leh hare helem shevua beyado vechayyav adderabba hare helem chefetz beyado ufatur
Amar rav ashe chazenan i mechamat shevua ka faresh hare helem shevua beyado vechayyav i mechamat chefetz ka faresh hare helem chefetz beyado ufatur
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe kelum paresh mishshevua ella mishshum chefetz kelum paresh mechefetz ella mishshum shevua ella la shena
Bea mineh rava merav nachman
b: Ezo hi shiggat shevuat bituy lesheavar i deyada mezid hu i dela yada anus hu
Amar leh beomer yodea ani sheshshevua zo asura aval eni yodea im chayyavin aleha korban o lav
Keman kemonbaz deamar shiggat korban shemah shegaga
Afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh demonbaz ella bechol hattora kullah delav chidush hu aval hacha dechidush hu divchal hattora kullah la ashkechan lav demayete korban
Deyalfinan meavoda zara vehacha mayete afilu rabbanan modu
Bea mineh ravina merava nishba al kikkar umistakken aleha mahu
Mistakken lishre leh mar ella mitztaer vaachalah beshiggat shevua may
Amar leh tenena shav midiato mevi korban al shiggato lo shav midiato en mevi korban al shiggato
Amar shemuel gamar belibbo tzarich sheyyotzi bisfatav shenneemar levatte bisfatayim
Metivi bisfatayim velo ballev gamar belibbo minnayin talmud lomar lechol asher yevatte haadam bishvua
Ha gufah kashya amratte bisfatayim velo ballev vahadar amratte gamar belibbo minnayin
Amar rav sheshet ha la kashya hachi kaamar bisfatayim velo sheggamar belibbo lehotzi bisfatav velo hotzi gamar belibbo setam minnayin talmud lomar lechol asher yevatte
Ella lishmuel kashya

Amar rav sheshet taretz veema hachi bisfatayim velo sheggamar belibbo lehotzi pat chittin vehotzi pat seorin gamar belibbo lehotzi pat chittin vehotzi pat setam minnayin talmud lomar lechol asher yevatte haadam
Metivi motza sefatecha tishmor veasita en li ella shehotzi bisfatav gamar belibbo minnayin talmud lomar kol nediv lev
Shane hatam dichtiv kol nediv lev
Venigmar minah
Mishshum dehau teruma vekadashim shene ketuvin habbain keechad vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar
Hau chullin vekadashim vechullin mikkodashim la gamrinan

a: Matni nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bitel patur lekayyem velo kiyyem patur shehaya baddin sheyehe chayyav kedivre rabbi yehuda ben betera
Amar rabbi yehuda ben betera ma im harshut sheeno mushba alav mehar sinay hare hu chayyav alav mitzva shehu mushba aleha mehar sinay eno din sheyehe chayyav aleha
Amru lo lo im amarta bishvuat harshut shekken asa bah lav kehen tomar bishvuat mitzva shello asa bah lav kehen sheim nishba levattel velo bitel patur
Gema tanu rabbanan yachol nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bitel yehe chayyav talmud lomar lehara o lehetiv ma hatava reshut af haraa reshut otzi nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bitel shehu patur
Yachol nishba lekayyem et hammitzva velo kiyyem sheyehe chayyav talmud lomar lehara o lehetiv ma haraa reshut af hatava reshut otzi nishba lekayyem et hammitzva velo kiyyem shehu patur
Yachol nishba lehara leatzmo velo hara yachol yehe patur talmud lomar lehara o lehetiv ma hatava reshut af haraa reshut avi nishba lehara leatzmo velo hera sheharshut beyado

Yachol nishba lehara laacherim velo hera sheyehe chayyav talmud lomar lehara o lehetiv ma hatava reshut af haraa reshut otzi nishba lehara laacherim velo hera sheen harshut beyado minnayin lerabbot hatavat acherim talmud lomar o lehetiv veezo hi haraat acherim akke et peloni vaafatztzea et mocho
Umimmay dikrae bidvar harshut ketivi dilma bidvar mitzva ketivi
La salka datach devaenan hatava dumya daharaa vaharaa dumya dahatava deakkesh haraa lahatava ma hatava enah bevitul mitzva af haraa enah bevitul mitzva haraa gufah hatava hi
Veakkesh hatava laharaa ma haraa enah bekiyyum mitzva af hatava enah bekiyyum mitzva hatava gufah haraa hi
I hachi bidvar harshut name la mashkachatte lah
Ella middeitzterich o lerabbot hatavat acherim shema minah bidvar harshut ketivi dei salka datach bidvar mitzva ketivi hashta haraat acherim itrabbay hatavat acherim mibaya

Tenan shette kesef yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella peruta patur may tama lav mishshum dechasra lah taana utuvta dishmuel
Amar lecha shemuel mi savratte shave katane daveka katane ma shetteano lo hoda lo uma shehoda lo lo teano

a: Teda deka tane sefa dinar zahav li beyadecha en lecha beyadi ella dinar kesef utresit ufundeon ufruta chayyav shehakkol min matbea achat hen i amratte bishlama shave mishshum hachi chayyav ella i amratte daveka ammay chayyav

Verav shehakkol din matbea achat

La sefa daveka dekatane shehakkol min matbea achat veresha kerav o kishmuel
Ta shema dinar zahav zahuv li beyadecha en lecha beyadi ella dinar kesef chayyav tama daamar leh zahav zahuv ha setama shave kaamar leh

La hu haddin daafilu chittin usorin name patur vehay dekamipalgi bechittin lehodiacha kocho derabban gamliel

Ta shema teano chittin vehoda lo bisorin patur verabban gamliel mechayyev tama ditano chittin vehoda lo bisorin ha chittin usorin vehoda lo beechad mehen chayyav

Hahu daamar leh lechavreh hav li shet mea zuze demassekna bach amar leh vela peratacha mea kabbe

Lishana acharina hahu daamar leh lechavreh mehemnatte li keve tere kol emat deamratte la parana azal ufareh beappe telata amar rav pappa keve tere hemneh keve telata la hemneh
Matkef lah rav huna bereh derav yehoshua tere kima uma kitre vei amar leh keve telata vaazal pareh beappe be arbea kevan dinchet ledeot nechet ledeot
En nishbain al taanat cheresh shote vekatan veen mashbiin et hakkatan may tama amar kera ki yitten ish el reehu kesef o chelim lishmor veen netinat katan kelum

Amar rav beva betaanat aviv verabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer peamim sheadam nishba al taanat atzmo ketzad amar lo mane leavicha beyadi veheechaltiv peras hare ze nishba vezehu shennishba al taanat atzmo vachachamim omrim eno ella kemeshiv aveda ufatur
Verabbi eliezer ben yaakov let leh meshiv aveda patur amar rav beshetteano katan
Katan vehaamratte en nishbain al taanat cheresh shote vekatan leolam gadol veammay karu leh katan dilgabbe mile daavuh katan hu
I hachi taanat atzmo taanat acherim hi taanat acherim vehodaat atzmo
b: Kullehu name taanat acherim vehodaat atzmo ninhu

Ella bidrabba kamipalgi deamar rabba mippene ma amra tora mode miktzat hattaana yishshava chazaka en adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo vehay bechulleh bae delichpereh vehay dela kafreh mishshum deeno meiz panav bifne baal chovo
Uvchulleh bae delode leh vehay dela odi leh ishtemote hu deka mishtemit mineh savar ad dehave li zuze ufarana leh verachamana amar remi shevua ilaveh ki hechi delode leh bechulleh
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar la shena bo vela shena bivno eno meez vehilkach lav meshiv aveda hu verabbanan savri befanav hu deeno meez aval bifne beno meez umiddelo meez meshiv aveda hu

Mi matzet mokmatte lah kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov ha katane resha mane leabba beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim dinar patur mippene shemmeshiv aveda hu hatam dela amar bari li hacha deamar bari li
Shemuel amar lekatan lipara minnichse katan lahekdesh lipara minnichse hekdesh
Lekatan lipara minnichse katan tenena minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella bishvua tarte lema li
Ha kamashma lan kidabbaye kashshisha detane abbaye kashshisha yetomin sheamru gedolim veen tzarich lomar ketannim ben lishvua ben leziburit
Lehekdesh lipara minnichse hekdesh tenena minnechasim meshubadim lo yipparu ella bishvua uma li meshubadim lehedot uma li meshubadim legavoha
Itzterich salka datach amena hedot hu deadam ose kenunya al hedot aval hekdesh deen adam ose kenunya al hekdesh ka mashma lan

Vehaamar rav huna shechiv mera shehikdish kol nechasav veamar mane lifloni beyadi neeman chazaka en adam ose kenunya al hekdesh amri hane mile shechiv mera deen adam chote velo lo aval gabbe bari vadday chayeshinan

Matni veellu devarim sheen nishbain alehen haavadim vehashshetarot vehakkarkaot vehahekdeshot en bahen tashlume chefel velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha shomer chinnam eno nishba nose sachar eno meshallem
Rabbi shimon omer kodashim shechayyav beachrautan nishbain alehen vesheeno chayyav beachrautan en nishbain alehen

Rabbi meir omer yesh devarim shehen bekarka veenan kekarka veen chachamim modim lo ketzad eser gefanim teunot masarti lach vehalla omer enan ella chamesh rabbi meir mechayyev shevua vachachamim omrim kol hamchubbar lekarka hare hu kekarka

En nishbain ella al davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan ketzad bayit male masarti lach vechis male masarti lach vehalla omer eni yodea ella ma shehinnachta atta notel patur ze omer ad hazziz veze omer ad hachallon chayyav
Gema tashlume chefel menalan detanu rabbanan al kol devar pesha kelal al shor veal chamor veal se veal salma perat al kol aveda chazar vechalal
Kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon
Yatzu karkaot sheen metaltelin yatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot yatzu shetarot sheaf al pi shehen mittaltelin en gufan mamon hekdesh reehu ketiv
Velo tashlume chefel velo arbaa vachamishsha may tama tashlume arbaa vachamishsha amar rachamana velo tashlume shelosha vearbaa
Shomer chinnam eno nishba mena hane mile detanu rabbanan

a: Ki yitten ish el reehu kelal kesef o kelim perat lishmor chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon
Yatzu karkaot sheen metaltelin yatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot yatzu shetarot sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin en gufan mamon hekdesh reehu ketiv
Nose sachar eno meshallem menalan detanu rabbanan ki yitten ish el reehu kelal chamor o shor o se perat vechol behema lishmor chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal ku ad hekdesh reehu ketiv
Rabbi meir omer yesh devarim shehen kekarka veenan kekarka ku mikkelal derabbi meir savar kol hamchubbar lakkarka eno kekarka addemipalgi bitunot lipalgi bisrukot
Ella amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina hacha baanavim omdot lehibbatzer kamipalgi derabbi meir savar kivtzurot damyan verabbanan savri la kivtzurot damyan
En nishbain ella al davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal ku amar abbaye lo shanu ella daamar leh bayit setam aval amar leh bayit ze male yedia taanteh
Amar leh rava i hachi addetane sefa ze omer ad hazziz veze omer ad hachallon chayyav liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim bevayit male aval bayit ze male chayyav
Ella amar rava leolam eno chayyav ad sheyyitanennu bedavar shebbemidda shebbemishkal veshebbeminyan veode lo bedavar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan

Tanya kevateh derava kor tevua li beyadcha vehalla omer en lecha beyadi patur menora gedola yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella menora ketanna patur azora gedola yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella azora ketanna patur
Aval amar lo kor tevua yesh li beyadcha vehalla omer en lecha beyadi ella letech chayyav menora bat eser litrin yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella bat chamesh litrin chayyav
Kelalo shel davar leolam eno chayyav ad sheyyitanennu bedavar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan veode lo bedavar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan
Kelalo shel davar leetoye may lav leetoye bayit ze male
Umay shena menora gedola umnora ketanna ma shetteano lo hoda lo uma shehoda lo lo teano i hachi bat eser bat chamesh name ma shetteano lo hoda lo uma shehoda lo lo teano
Amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak hacha bimnora shel chulot askinan deka mode leh minah
I hachi azora name nitne velokme bidlayefi ella delayefi la katane hacha name beshel chulot la katane
Ella amar rabbi abba bar memel shane menora hoil veyachol legorrah ulhaamidah al chamesh litrin
Matni hammalve et chavero al hammashkon veavad hammashkon amar lo sela hilviticha alav veshekel haya shave vehalla omer lo ki ella sela hilvitani alav vesela haya shave patur
Sela hilviticha alav veshekel haya shave vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilvitani alav ushlosha dinarim haya shave chayyav

Sela hilvitani alav ushtayim haya shave vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilviticha alav vesela haya shave patur sela hilvitani alav ushtayim haya shave vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilviticha alav vachamishsha dinarim haya shave chayyav
Umi nishba mi shehappikkadon etzlo shemma yishshava ze veotzi halla et happikkadon
b: Gema aheya ilema assefa vetipok leh dishvua gabbe malve
Amar shemuel aresha vechen amar rabbi chiyya bar rav aresha vechen amar rabbi yochanan aresha

May resha sefa deresha sela hilviticha alav veshekel haya shave vehalla omer lo ki ella sela hilvitani alav ushlosha dinarin haya shave chayyav dishvua gabbe love hi veshakluha rabbanan millove veshaduha ammalve
Vehashta deamar rav ashe dekayema lan ze nishba sheenah birshuto veze nishba kamma shave hachi kaamar mi nishba techilla mi shehappikkadon etzlo shemma yishshava ze veotzi halla et happikkadon
Amar shemuel hay man deozfeh alpa zuze lechavreh umashken leh katta demaggala avad katta demaggala avad alpa zuze aval tarte kattate la
Verav nachman amar afilu tarte kattate avad chada avad chamesh mea avad idach avad kulleh aval katta unsacha la nehardae amri afilu katta unsacha avad nesacha avad palga avad katta avad kulleh
Tenan sela hilviticha alav veshekel haya shave vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilvitani alav ushlosha dinarin haya shave chayyav lema leh ha kabbelteh
Matnitin bidfaresh shemuel bidla paresh

Lema ketannae hammalve et chavero al hammashkon veavad hammashkon yishshava veyittol et meotav divre rabbi eliezer rabbi akiva omer yachol hu sheyyomar lo kelum hilvitani ella al hammashkon avad hammashkon avdu meotecha
Aval hammalve elef zuz bishtar vehinniach mashkon beyado divre hakkol avad hammashkon avdu meotav
Hechi dame i deshave shiur zuze

a: May tameh derabbi eliezer ella lav bidla shave shiur zuze uvdishmuel ka mipalgi
La bidla shave kulle alma let lehu dishmuel vehacha bidshave shiur zuze uvidrabbi yitzchak ka mipalgi deamar rabbi yitzchak minnayin levaal chov shekkone mashkon shenneemar ulcha tihye tzedaka
Im eno kone mashkon tzedaka minnayin lo mikkan levaal chov shekkone mashkon
Lema derabbi yitzchak tannae hi vetisbera emor deamar rabbi yitzchak shemmishkeno shello bishat halvaa mishkeno bishat halvaa mi amar
Ella mishkeno shello bishat halvaato kulle alma la peligi deit lehu derabbi yitzchak vehacha bemishkeno bishat halvaato
Uvshomer aveda kamipalgi deitmar shomer aveda rabba amar keshomer chinnam
b: Verav yosef amar keshomer sachar dame
Lema derav yosef tannae hi la beshomer aveda dechulle alma it lehu derav yosef vehacha bemalve tzarich lemashkon ka mipalgi mar savar mitzva ka aved umar savar lav mitzva ka aved

Lema ketannae hammalve et chavero al hammashkon venichnesa shemita af al pi sheeno shave ella pelag eno meshammet divre rabban shimon ben gamliel rabbi yehuda hannasi omer im haya mashkono keneged chovo eno meshammet veim lav meshammet
May eno meshammet dekaamar tanna kamma ilema kenegdo mikkelal derabbi yehuda hannasi savar kenegdo name meshammet ella ammay tafes mashkon
Ella lav keneged kullo uvdishmuel ka mipalgi
La leolam kenegdo uvha kamipalgi tanna kamma savar kenegdo verabbi yehuda hannasi savar kenegdo name meshammet udka amratte lemay tafes leh mashkon lezichron devarim bealma
Hadaran alach shevuat haddayyanin
Matni kol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin veellu nishbain venotlin hassachir vehannigzal vehannechbal veshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua vechenvani al pinkaso

Hassachir ketzad amar lo ten li sechari sheyyesh li beyadcha hu omer natatti vehalla omer lo natalti hu nishba venotel rabbi yehuda omer ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa ketzad amar lo ten li sechari chamishshim dinar sheyyesh li beyadcha vehu omer hitkabbalta dinar zahav

Nigzal ketzad hau meidin oto shennichnas leveto lemashkeno shello birshut hu omer kelyi natalta vehu omer lo natalti hu nishba venotel rabbi yehuda omer ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa ketzad amar lo shene kelim natalta vehu omer lo natalti ella echad

Nechbal ketzad hau meidim oto shennichnas tachat yado shalem veyatza chavul veamar lo chavalta bi vehu omer lo chavalti hare ze nishba venotel rabbi yehuda omer ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa ketzad amar lo chavalta bi shettayim vehalla omer lo chavalti becha ella echat
Shekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua ketzad

a: Achat shevuat haedut veachat shevuat happikkadon vaafilu shevuat shave haya echad mehen mesachek bekuvya umalve beribbit umafriche yonim vesochare sheviit shekkenegdo nishba venotel
Hau shenehen chashudin chazra hashshevua limkomah divre rabbi yose rabbi meir omer yachloku

Vehachenvani al pinkaso ketzad lo sheyyomar lo ketov al pinkasi sheatta chayyav li matayim zuz ella omer lo ten livni satayim chittin ten lefoalay besela maot hu omer natatti vehen omrim lo natalnu hu nishba venotel vehen nishbain venotlin
Amar ben nannas ketzad ellu veellu bain lide shevuat shave ella hu notel shello bishvua vehen notlin shello bishvua

Amar lachenvani ten li bedinar perot venatan lo amar lo ten li oto dinar amar lo netattiv lach untatto beunpali yishshava baal habbayit shennatan lo et haddinar amar lo ten li et happerot amar lo netattim lach veholachtim letoch betcha yishshava chenvani rabbi yehuda omer kol shehapperot beyado yado al haelona

Amar lashshulchani ten li bedinar maot venatan lo amar lo ten li et haddinar amar lo natatti lecha untatto beunpali yishshava baal habbayit natan lo et haddinar amar lo ten li et hammaot amar lo netattim lach vehishlachta letoch kischa yishshava shulchani rabbi yehuda omer en derech shulchani liten isar ad sheyyittol dinar

Keshem sheamru happogemet ketubbatah lo tippara ella bishvua veed echad meidah shehi perua lo tippara ella bishvua minnechasim meshubadim uminnichse yetomim lo tippara ella bishvua vehannifraat shello befanav lo tippara ella bishvua vechen hayetomim lo yipparu ella bishvua

Shevua shello pekadanu abba vela amar lanu abba shello matzinu ben shetarotav shel abba sheshshetar ze parua rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer afilu nolad habben leachar mitat haav hare ze nishba venotel amar rabban shimon ben gamliel im yesh edim sheamar haav bishat mitato shetar ze eno parua hu notel shello bishvua
Veellu nishbain shello betaana hashshuttafin vehaarisin vehaappotroppin vehaishsha hannoset vehannotenet betoch habbayit uven habbayit amar lo ma atta toaneni retzoni shettishshava li chayyav
Chalku hashshuttafin vehaarisin en yachol lehashbio nitgalgela lo shevua mimmakom acher megalgelin alav et hakkol vehashsheviit meshammetet et hashshevua
Gema kol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin menalan deamar kera velakach bealav velo yeshallem mi shealav leshallem lo shevua

Veellu nishbain venotlin ku may shena sachir detakkinu le rabbanan demishteva veshakel amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halachot gedolot shanu kan halachot hane hilcheta ninhu ella ema takkanot gedolot shanu kan
Gedolot mikkelal deika ketannot

Ella amar rav nachman amar shemuel takkanot kevuot shanu kan akruha rabbanan lishvua mibbaal habbayit veshaduha assachir mishshum kede chayyav mishshum kede chayyav desachir kansinan leh levaal habbayit baal habbayit gufeh nicha leh demishteva sachir veshakel ki hechi deitagrun delitagrun leh poalin
Adderabba sachir nicha leh dilshetteva baal habbayit venifka ki hechi delegreh baal habbayit baal habbayit al kurcheh agar sachir name al kurcheh mitgar ella baal habbayit tarud befoalav hu
Velitev leh bela shevua
Kede lehafis dato shel baal habbayit velitev leh beedim tericha leh milta velitev leh meikara shenehen rotzin behakkafa
b: I hachi afilu katzatz name allema tanya umman omer shettayim katzatzta li vehalla omer lo katzatzti lecha ella achat hammotzi mechavero alav haraya ketzitza vadday midkar dechir leh
I hachi afilu avar zemanno name allema tanya avar zemanno velo natan lo hare ze eno nishba venotel
Chazaka en baal habbayit over beval talin vehaamratte baal habbayit tarud befoalav hu hane mile mikkamme delimte zeman chiyyuva hu ki mate zeman chiyyuva rame annafsheh umidchar
Vechi sachir over mishshum bal tigzol gabbe baal habbayit ika tere chazake chada deen baal habbayit over beval talin vachada deen sachir meshahe secharo

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel lo shanu ella shessecharo beedim aval secharo shello beedim mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo lo secharticha meolam yachol lomar lo secharticha venatatti lecha secharcha amar leh rabbi yitzchak yishar vechen amar rabbi yochanan
Mikkelal diflig aleh resh lakish ika deamri mishta hava shate leh veshatek leh veika deamri mishha hava shahe leh ushtek leh

Itmar name amar rav menashsheya bar zevid amar rav lo shanu ella shessecharo beedim aval secharo shello beedim mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo lo secharticha meolam yachol lomar lo secharticha venatatti lecha secharecha

Amar rame bar chama kamma mealleya ha shemata amar leh rava may mealleuta im ken shevuat shomrin dechayyev rachamana hechi mashkachatte lah mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo lo hau devarim meolam yachol lomar lo neensu
Deafked leh beedim mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo hechzartiv lach yachol lomar lo neensu
Deafked leh bishtara
Mikkelal detarvayehu sevira lehu hammafkid etzel chavero beedim en tzarich lehachzir lo beedim bishtar tzarich lehachzir lo beedim

Kare rame bar chama aleh derav sheshet vayyasem david et haddevarim haelle belibbo deashkecheh rav sheshet lerabba bar shemuel amar leh tane mar mide besachir amar leh in tenena sachir bizmanno nishba venotel ketzad bizman sheamar lo sechartani velo natatta li sechari vehalla omer secharticha venatatti lecha secharecha aval amar lo shettayim katzatzta li vehalla omer lo katzatzti lecha ella echat hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Ha middesefa biraya have resha belo reaya
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak

a: Resha vesefa biraya reaya dilshallem katane reaya dishvua la katane

Amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba shelachu leh mibbe rav lishmuel yelammedenu rabbenu umman omer shettayim katzatzta li vehalla omer lo katzatzti lecha ella echat mi nishba amar lahen bezo yishshava baal habbayit veyafsid umman ketzitza vadday midkar dechiri inashe

Ini veha tane rabba bar shemuel katzatz hammotzi mechavero alav haraya vei la mayete reaya paka ammay yishshava baal habbayit veyafsid umman amar rav nachman litzdadin katane o mevi reaya veyittol o yishshava baal habbayit veyafsid umman

Metivi hannoten tallito leumman umman omer katzatzta li shettayim vehalla omer lo katzatzti lecha ella echat kol zeman shettallit beyad umman al baal habbayit lehavi reaya netanah lo bizmanno nishba venotel avar zemanno hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Bizmanno miha nishba venotel ammay yishshava baal habbayit veyafsid umman
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar kol zeman sheshshevua nota etzel baal habbayit sachir nishba venotel
He rabbi yehuda ilema rabbi yehuda dematnitin achmore ka machmar ditnan rabbi yehuda omer ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa

Ella rabbi yehuda devarayeta detanya sachir kol zeman shello avar alav zemanno hare ze nishba venotel veim lav eno nishba venotel veamar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman sheamar lo ten li sechari chamishshim dinar sheyyesh li beyadecha vehu omer hitkabbalte mehen dinar zahav o sheamar lo shettayim katzatzta vehalla omer lo katzatzti lecha ella echat
Aval amar lo lo secharticha meolam o sheamar lo secharticha venatatti lecha secharecha hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Matkef lah rav shisha bereh derav idi ella katzatz rabbi yehuda hi vela rabbanan hashta hechi demachmir rabbi yehuda mekili rabbanan hecha demekel rabbi yehuda machmeri rabbanan
Veella may rabbanan veella ha detane rabba bar shemuel katzatz hammotzi mechavero alav haraya manni la rabbi yehuda vela rabbanan
Ella amar rava beha kamipalgi rabbi yehuda savar bidorayeta avadu leh takkanta lesachir uvidrabbanan havay takkanta vetakkanta letakkanta la avdinan
Verabbanan savri bidrabbanan name avdinan takkanta lesachir uktzitza midkar dechir

Nigzal ketzad hau meidin oto shennichnas leveto lemashkeno ku vedilma lo mishkeno mi la amar rav nachman hay man dinkit narga bideh veamar ezil veekteleh ledikla diflanya veishtechach diktil ushde la amrinan dehu katleh
Alma avid inish degazem vela aved hacha name degazem vela aved ema umishkeno velichze may mishkeno amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan betoano kelim hannitalin tachat kenafav
Amar rav yehuda rauhu shehitmin kelim tachat kenafav veyatza
b: Veamar lekuchin hen beyadi eno neeman vela amaran ella baal habbayit sheeno asuy limkor kelav aval baal habbayit heasuy limkor et kelav neeman vesheen asuy limkor et kelav name la amaran ella devarim sheen darkan lehatmin aval devarim sheddarkan lehatmin neeman

Vesheen darkan lehatmin name la amaran ella inish dela tzenia aval inish ditznia hayenu orcheh vela amaran ella ze omer sheulin veze omer lekuchin aval bignuvin lav kol kemineh leachzoke inish begannave la machzekinan

Vela amaran ella bidvarim haasuyin lehashil ulhaskir aval devarim sheen asuyin lehashil ulhaskir neeman dishlach rav huna bar avin devarim haasuyin lehashil ulhaskir veamar lekuchin hen beyadi eno neeman ki ha derava appek zuga desarbala vesifra deaggadta miyyatme bidvarim haasuyin lehashil ulhaskir
Amar rava afilu shomer nishba afilu ishto shel shomer nishbaat bae rav pappa sechiro ulkito may teku
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe teano bechasa dechaspa may chazena i inish daamid hu o inish dimheman hu demafkedi inashe gabbeh mishteva veshakel vei la la
Nechbal ketzad amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella bimkom sheyyachol lechabbel beatzmo aval bimkom sheeno yachol lechabbel beatzmo notel shello bishvua
Venechush dilma bechotel nitchakkech tane rabbi chiyya shealta lo neshicha begabbo uven atztzile yadav vedilma acher aved leh deleka acher
Uchshennegdo chashud vechu vaafilu shevuat shave may afilu shevuat shave
La mibaya kaamar la mibaya hanach deit behu kefirat mamon ella afilu ha name dichfirat devarim bealma hu la meheman
Velitne name shevuat bittuy ki katane shevua dechi ka mishteva beshikra ka mishteva aval shevuat bittuy deika lememar divkushta ka mishteva la katane
Tinach ochal velo ochal achalti velo achalti may ika lememar tana shevuat shave

a: Vechol dedame leh
Haya echad mehen mesachek bekuvya ha tu lema li tena pesula deorayeta vekatane pesula derabbanan
Hau shenehen chashudin amar leh rava lerav nachman hechi tenan amar leh la yadana hilcheta may amar leh la yadana

Itmar amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman rabbi yose omer yachloku vechen tane rav zevid bar oshaya rabbi yose omer yachloku ika deamri tane rav zevid amar rabbi oshaya rabbi yose omer yachloku amar rav yosef bar minome avad rav nachman ovada yachloku
Chazra shevua limkomah lehechan chazra amar rabbi amme rabbotenu shebbevavel amru chazra shevua lesinay rabbotenu shebbeeretz yisrael amru chazra shevua lamchuyyav lah

Amar rav pappa rabbotenu shebbevavel rav ushmuel rabbotenu shebbeeretz yisrael rabbi abba rabbotenu shebbevavel rav ushmuel ditnan vechen hayetomin lo yipparu ella bishvua vehavenan bah mimman ilema millove avuhon shakel bela shevua veinhu bishvua ella hachi kaamar vechen hayetomin min hayetomin lo yipparu ella bishvua
Verav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu lo shanu ella shemmet malve bechayye love aval met love bechayye malve kevar nitchayyev malve livne love shevua veen adam morish shevua levanav

Rabbotenu shebbeeretz yisrael rabbi abba dehahu gavra dachataf nesacha mechavreh ata lekammeh derav amme yetev rabbi abba kammeh ayeti chada sahada demichtaf chatfeh mineh amar leh in chatafi vedidi chatafi
Amar rabbi amme hechi lidayenu dayyane lehay dina nema leh zil shallem leka tere sahadi niftereh ika chad sahada nema leh zil ishteva kevan deamar michtaf chatafi have leh kegazlan
Amar leh rabbi abba have mechuyyav shevua veen yachol lishava vechol hamchuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishava meshallem
Amar rava kevateh derabbi abba mistabbera detane rabbi amme shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem velo ben hayyorshin hechi dame
Ilema deamar leh mane leabba beyad avicha veamar leh chamshin it leh vechamshin let leh ma li hu uma li avuha
Ella lav deamar leh mane leabba beyad avicha amar leh chamshin yadana vechamshin la yadana
b: I amratte bishlama aviv ki hay gavena michayyav itzterich kera lemiftar gabbe yorshin ella i amratte aviv ki hay gavena name patur kera gabbe yorshin lema li
Verav ushmuel hay shevuat Adonai may ka darshi beh
Mibe leh lechidtanya shimon ben tarfon omer shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem melammed shehashshevua chala al shenehem
Shimon ben tarfon omer azhara laokev acher noef minnayin talmud lomar lo tinaf lo tanif
Vatteragnu beoholechem shimon ben tarfon omer tartem veginitem beoholo shel makom
Ad hannahar haggadol nehar perat shimon ben tarfon omer kerav legabbe dehina veidhan deve rabbi yishmael tana eved melech kemelech
Vehachenvani al pinkaso ku tanya amar rabbi torach shevua zo lamma amar lo rabbi chiyya bar abba tenena shenehem nishbain venotlin mibbaal habbayit
Kiblah mineh o la kiblah mineh ta shema detanya rabbi omer poalin nishbain lachenvani veim ita levaal habbayit mibe leh

Metiv rav huna bar yehuda

Vei itmar beha beha kaamar rabbi yehuda aval behach ema mode lehu lerabbanan tzericha

Keshem sheamru happogemet ketubbatah vechu vechen hayetomin lo yipparu mimman ilema millove avuhon shakel bela shevua veinhu bishvua hachi kaamar vechen hayetomim min hayetomim lo yipparu ella bishvua
Rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu lo shanu ella shemmet malve bechayye love aval met love bechayye malve kevar nitchayyev malve livne love shevua veen adam morish shevua levanav

Amad baddin vamet kevar nitchayyev malve livne love shevua veen adam morish shevua levanav lo amad baddin vamet yorshin nishbain shevuat yorshin venotlin
Matkef lah rav nachman attu be dina ka mechayevi leh shevua meidana dishchev love ichayyav leh malve livne love shevua
Ella amar rav nachman i itah lidrav vedishmuel itah i letah letah alma mesappeka leh vehaamar rav yosef bar minome avad rav nachman ovada yachloku lidvarav derabbi meir kaamar veleh la sevira leh
Metiv rav oshaya meta yorsheha mazkirin et ketubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim hacha bemay askinan shennishbea umeta

Hahu dishchev ushvak arva sevar rav pappa lememar ha name dela losef alah hu amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa attu arva lav batar yatme azel
Hahu dishchev ushvak acha savar rame bar chama lememar ha name dela losef alah hu amar leh rava ma li shello pekadani abba uma li shello pekadani achi
Amar rav chama hashta dela itmar hilcheta la kerav ushmuel vela kerabbi elazar hay dayyana daavad kerav ushmuel avad daavad kerabbi elazar avad

Hahu dayyana daavad kerabbi elazar hava tzurba merabbanan bemateh amar leh ayetina igarta mimmareva delet hilcheta kerabbi elazar amar leh lechi tayete ata lekammeh derav chama amar leh hay dayyana daavad kerabbi elazar avad
Veellu nishbain attu beshuftane askinan hachi kaamar veellu nishbain shello betaanat bari ella betaanat shemma hashshuttafin vehaarisin
Tana ben bayit sheamru lo shennichnas veotze beraglav ella machnis lo poalin umotzi lo poalin machnis lo perot umotzi lo perot
Umay shena hane mishshum demoru beh hettera
Amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman vehu sheyyesh taana benayehu shette kesef

Chalku hashshuttafin vehaarisin ibaya lehu mahu legalgel bidrabbanan
Ta shema lava hemennu erev sheviit ulmotzae sheviit naasa lo shuttaf o aris en megalgelin tama delava hemennu erev sheviit daatay sheviit afkateh ha shear shene shavua megalgelin

Ha behedya katane lah naasa lo shuttaf o aris erev sheviit ulmotzae sheviit lava hemennu megalgelin shema minah megalgelin bidrabbanan shema minah

Hadaran alach kol hannishbain
Matni arbaa shomrin hen shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher

Nose sachar vehassocher nishbain al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta umshallemin et haaveda veet haggeneva

Hechan shori amar lo eni yodea ma atta sach vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav o avad mashbiacha ani veamar amen patur
Hechan shori amar lo avad mashbiacha ani veamar amen vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo meshallem et hakkeren hoda meatzmo meshallem keren vachomesh veasham
Hechan shori veamar lo nignav mashbiacha ani veamar amen vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo meshallem tashlume chefel hoda meatzmo meshallem keren vachomesh veasham

Amar leechad bashshuk hechan shori shegganavta hu omer lo ganavti vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo meshallem tashlume chefel tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha raa edim shemmemashmeshin uvain amar ganavti aval lo tavachti velo macharti eno meshallem ella keren

Met o nishbar o nishba vehu shennignav o avad mashbiacha ani veamar amen chayyav avad o nignav vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba mashbiacha ani veamar amen patur
Ze hakkelal kol hamshanne mechova lechova umippetur liftur umippetur lechova patur mechova liftur chayyav ze hakkelal kol hannishba lehakel al atzmo chayyav lehachmir al atzmo patur

Gema man tena arbaa shomrin amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh rabbi meir hi amar leh rava lerav nachman mi ika tanna delet leh arbaa shomrin amar leh hachi kaamena lach man tanna deamar socher kenose sachar dame amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh rabbi meir hi
Veha rabbi meir ipcha shaminan leh ditnan socher ketzad meshallem rabbi meir omer keshomer chinnam rabbi yehuda omer kenose sachar rabba bar avuh ipcha tane
Hane arbaa hau shelosha hau amar rav nachman bar yitzchak arbaa shomrin vedinehen shelosha

Amar leshomer chinnam ku hechan shori ku amar leechad bashshuk ku amar leshomer ku hechan shori amar lo eni yodea ma atta sach ku amar rav vechullan peturin mishshevuat shomrin vechayyavin mishshum shevuat bituy ushmuel amar af peturin mishshum shevuat bituy
Bemay kamippalgi shemuel savar letah bilhabba verav savar iteh belav vahen

Veha ipligu vah chada zimna deittemar shevua shezzarak peloni tzeror layyam shevua shello zarak rav amar chayyav ushmuel amar patur rav amar chayyav deitah belav vehen ushmuel amar patur deletah bilhabba

Tzericha dei ashmeinan beha beha kaamar rav mishshum deminnafsheh kamishteva aval behach deve dina mashbei leh ema mode leh lishmuel kidrabbi amme deamar rabbi amme kol shevua shehaddayyanim mashbiin otah en chayyavin aleha mishshum shevuat bituy
Vei itmar beha beha kaamar shemuel aval behach ema mode leh lerav tzericha

Gufa amar rabbi amme kol shevua shehaddayyanin mashbiin otah en bah mishshum shevuat bituy shenneemar o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim meatzmo kidresh lakish deamar resh lakish ki mishtammesh bearba leshonot i dilma ella deha

Rabbi elazar omer kullan peturin mishshevuat shomrin vechayyavin mishshum shevuat bituy chutz meeni yodea ma atta sach deshoel ugneva vaaveda denose sachar veshebbesocher shehu chayyav shehare kefaro mamon
Hadaran alach arbaa shomrin uslika lah massechet shevuot

a: Matni lifnay edehen shel goyim shelosha yamim asur laset velatet immahem lehashilan velishol mehen lehalotan velilot mehen leforan velifroa mehen rabbi yehuda omer nifrain mehen mippene shemmetzer hu lo amru lo af al pi shemmetzer hu achshav sameach hu leachar zeman
Gema rav ushmuel chad tane edehen vechad tane edehen man detane edehen la mishtabbash uman detane edehen la mishtabbash
Man detane edehen la mishtabbash dichtiv ki karov yom edam uman detane edehen la mishtabbash dichtiv yittenu edehem veyitzdaku
Uman detane edehen may tama la tane edehen amar lach tevara adif uman detane edehen may tama la tane edehen amar lach man ka garem lehu tevara edut sheheidu beatzman hilkach edut adifa

Vehay yittenu edehem veyitzdaku beummot haolam ketiv ha beyisrael ketiv deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol mitzot sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze baot umidot lahem laolam habba shenneemar yittenu edehem veyitzdaku ellu yisrael yishmeu veyomru emet ellu ummot haolam
Ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua man deamar edehen mehacha yotzre fesel kullam tohu vachamudehem bal yoilu veedehem hemma
Daresh rabbi chanina bar pappa veitema rabbi simlay leatid lavo mevi hakkadosh baruch hu sefer tora umannicho becheko veomer lemi sheasak bah yavo veyittol secharo
Miyyad mitkabbetzin uvain ummot haolam beirbuvya shenneemar kol haggoyim nikbetzu yachdav vego omer lahem hakkadosh baruch hu al tikkansu lefanay beirbuvya ella tikkanes kol umma veummah
b: Vesofreha shenneemar veyeasfu leummim veen leom ella malchut shenneemar ulom milleom yeematz umi ika irbuvya kamme hakkadosh baruch hu ella ki hechi dela liarbevu inhu bahade hadade delishmeu may deamar lehu

Miyyad nichnesa lefanav malchut romi techilla may tama mishshum dachashiva umnalan dachashiva dichtiv vetechul kol ara utdushinnah vetaddekinah amar rabbi yochanan zo romi chayyevet shettivah yatza bechol haolam

Umna lan deman dachashiv ayel beresha kidrav chisda deamar rav chisda melech vetzibbur melech nichnas techilla ledin shenneemar laasot mishpat avdo umishpat ammo yisrael vego vetama may ibaet ema lav orach ara lemetav malka meabbaray veibaet ema mikkamme deliposh charon af

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu bemay asaktem omrim lefanav ribbono shel olam harbe shevakim tikannenu harbe merchatzaot asinu harbe kesef vezahav hirbenu vechullam lo asinu ella bishvil yisrael kede sheyyitasseku betora

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu shotim shebbaolam kol ma sheasitem letzorech atzmechem asitem tikkantem shevakim lehoshiv bahen zonot merchatzaot leadden bahen atzmechem kesef vezahav shelli hu shenneemar li hakkesef veli hazzahav neum Adonai tzevaot
Kelum yesh bachem maggid zot shenneemar mi vachem yaggid zot veen zot ella tora shenneemar vezot hattora asher sam moshe miyyad yatzu befache nefesh

Yatzat malchut romi venichnesa malchut paras achareha may tama deha chashiva batrah umnalan dichtiv vaaru cheva achori tinyana damya ledov vetane rav yosef ellu parsiyyim sheochlin veshotin kedov umsurbalin basar kedov umgaddelin sear kedov veen lahem menucha kedov

Omer lahem hakkadosh baruch hu bemay asaktem omrim lefanav ribbono shel olam harbe gesharim gasharnu harbe kerakkim kavashnu harbe milchamot asinu vechullam lo asinu ella bishvil yisrael kede sheyyitasseku battora

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu kol ma sheasitem letzorech atzmechem asitem tikkantem gesharim litol mehem meches kerakkim laasot bahem angarya milchamot ani asiti shenneemar Adonai ish milchama kelum yesh bachem maggid zot shenneemar mi vachem yaggid zot veen zot ella tora shenneemar vezot hattora asher sam moshe miyyad yatzu millefanav befache nefesh
Vechi meachar dachazat malchut paras lemalchut romi dela mahneya vela mide may tama ayela amri inhu satri bet hammikdash vaanan baninan vechen lechol umma veumah

Vechi meachar dachazo lekammae dela mahane vela mide may tama ayeli savri hanach ishtabadu behu beyisrael vaanan la shabadnu beyisrael may shena hane dachashivi umay shena hane dela chashivi lehu mishshum dehanach mashchi bemalchutayehu ad deate meshicha

Omrim lefanav ribbono shel olam kelum natatta lanu velo kibalnuha umi matze lememar hachi vehachtiv vayyomar Adonai missinay ba vezarach misseir lamo uchtiv eloha mitteman yavo vego may bae beseir umay bae befaran
Amar rabbi yochanan melammed shehechzirah hakkadosh baruch hu al kol umma velashon velo kibbeluha ad shebba etzel yisrael vekibbeluha
Ella hachi amri kelum kibalnuha velo kiyyamnuha veal da tevartehon ammay la kabbeltuha ella kach omrim lefanav ribbono shel olam kelum kafita alenu har kegigit velo kibbalnuha kemo sheasita leyisrael

Dichtiv vayyityatztzevu betachtit hahar veamar rav dimi bar chama melammed shekkafa hakkadosh baruch hu har kegigit al yisrael veamar lahem im attem mekabbelin et hattora mutav veim lav sham tehe kevuratchem
Miyyad omer lahem hakkadosh baruch hu harishonot yashmiunu shenneemar verishonot yashmiunu sheva mitzot shekkibaltem hechan kiyyamtem

Umnalan delo kiyemum detane rav yosef amad vayemoded eretz raa vayyatter goyim may raa raa sheva mitzot shekkibbelu alehen bene noach velo kiyemum kevan shello kiyemum amad vehittiran lahen itgore itgur im ken matzinu chote niskar
Amar mar bereh deravina

a: Lomar sheaf al pi shemmekayemin otan en mekabbelin alehem sachar

Vela vehatanya haya rabbi meir omer minnayin sheafilu goy veosek battora shehu kechohen gadol talmud lomar asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim lo neemar ella haadam ha lamadta sheafilu goy veosek battora hare hu kechohen gadol
Ella lomar lach sheen mekabbelin alehem sachar kimtzve veose ella kemi sheeno metzve veose deamar rabbi chanina gadol hamtzve veose yoter mishsheeno metzve veose
Ella kach omrim haggoyim lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam yisrael shekkibluha hechan kiyemuha

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu ani meid bahem shekkiyemu et hattora kullah omrim lefanav ribbono shel olam kelum yesh av shemmeid al beno dichtiv beni bechori yisrael amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu shamayim vaaretz yaidu bahem shekkiyemu et hattora kullah

Omrim lefanav ribbono shel olam shamayim vaaretz nogin beedutan shenneemar im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti deamar veamar rabbi shimon ben lakish may dichtiv vayehi erev vayehi voker yom hashshishshi melammed shehitna hakkadosh baruch hu im maase vereshit veamar im yisrael mekabbelin et torati mutav veim lav ani achazir etchem letohu vavohu
Vehayenu deamar chizkiyya may dichtiv mishshamayim hishmata din eretz yara veshakata im yara lamma shakta veim shakta lamma yara ella battechilla yara ulvassof shakta

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu mikkem yavou veyaidu bahen beyisrael shekkiyemu et hattora kullah yavo nimrod veyaid beavraham shello avad avoda zara yavo lavan veyaid beyaakov shello nechshad al haggazel tavo eshet potifera vetaid beosef shello nechshad al haavera

Yavo nevuchadnetztzar veyaid bachananya mishael vaazarya shello hishtachau latztzelem yavo daryavesh veyaid bedaniyyel shello bitel et hattefilla yavo bildad hashshuchi vetzofar hannaamati veelifaz hattemani veelihu ben barachel habbuzi veyaidu bahem beyisrael shekkiyemu et kal hattora kullah shenneemar yittenu edehem veyitzdaku

Amru lefanav ribbono shel olam teneha lanu merosh venaasenna amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu shotim shebbaolam mi shettarach beerev shabbat yochal beshabbat mi shello tarach beerev shabbat mehechan yochal beshabbat ella af al pi chen mitzva kalla yesh li vesukka shemah lechu vaasu otah
Umi matzet amratte hachi veha amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may dichtiv asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom hayyom laasotam velo lemachar laasotam hayyom laasotam velo hayyom litol sachar
Ella sheen hakkadosh baruch hu ba bitrunya im beriyyotav veammay kare leh mitzva kalla mishshum delet bah chesron kis

Miyyad kol echad veechad notel veholech veose sukka berosh gaggo vehakkadosh baruch hu makdir alehem chamma bitkufat tammuz vechol echad veechad mevaet besukkato veotze shenneemar nenatteka et mosrotemo venashlicha mimmennu avotemo makdir veha amratte en hakkadosh baruch hu ba bitrunya im beriyyotav mishshum deyisrael name zimne
b: Demashcha lehu tekufat tammuz ad chagga vehave lehu tzaara vehaamar rava mitztaer patur min hassukka nehi defatur baote mi mevaati
Miyyad hakkadosh baruch hu yoshev umsachek alehen shenneemar yoshev bashshamayim yischak vego amar rabbi yitzchak en sechok lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ella oto hayyom bilvad

Ika dematne leha derabbi yitzchak aha detanya rabbi yose omer leatid lavo bain ummot haolam umitgayerin umi mekabbelinan minayehu vehatanya en mekabbelin gerim limot hammashiach kayyotze vo lo kibbelu gerim lo bime david velo bime shelomo
Ella shennaasu gerim gerurim umannichin tefilin berashehen tefilin bizrootehem tzitzit bevigdehem mezuza befitchehem
Kevan sheroin milchemet gog umagog omer lahen al ma batem omrim lo al Adonai veal meshicho shenneemar lamma ragshu goyim ulummim yehgu rik vego

Vechol echad menattek mitzvato veholech shenneemar nenatteka et mosrotemo vego vehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev umsachek shenneemar yoshev bashshamayim yishchak vego amar rabbi yitzchak en lo lehakkadosh baruch hu sechok ella oto hayyom bilvad

Ini veha amar rav yehuda amar rav shettem esre shaot have hayyom shalosh harishonot hakkadosh baruch hu yoshev veosek battora sheniyyot yoshev vedan et kal haolam kullo kevan sheroe shennitchayyev olam kelaya omed mikkisse haddin veoshev al kisse rachamim

Shelishiyyot yoshev vezan et kal haolam kullo mikkarne remim ad betze chinnim reviiyyot yoshev umsachek im liveyatan shenneemar liveyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo amar rav nachman bar yitzchak im beriyyotav mesachek veal beriyyotav eno mesachek ella oto hayyom bilvad

Amar leh rav acha lerav nachman bar yitzchak miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en sechok lehakkadosh baruch hu umnalan deleka sechok ilema middichtiv vayyikra Adonai elohim tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulmisped ulkorcha vego dilma hahu yoma vetu la
Ella dichtiv im eshkachech yerushalam tishkach yemini tidbak leshoni lechikki im lo ezkerechi dilma shichcha hu deleka aval sechok miha ika ella meha hechesheti meolam acharish etappak vego

Birviiyyot may aved yoshev umlammed tinokot shel bet rabban tora shenneemar et mi yore dea veet mi yavin shemua gemule mechalav attike mishshadayim lemi yore dea ulmi yavin shemua ligmule mechalav ulattike mishshadayim
Umeikara man hava magmar lehu ibaet ema metatron veibaet ema ha veha aved

Uvlelya may aved ibaet ema meen yemama veibaet ema rochev al keruv kal shello veshat bishmona asar elef olamot shenneemar rechev elohim ribbotayim alfe shinan al tikre shinan ella sheenan veibaet ema yoshev veshomea shira mippi chayyot shenneemar yomam yetzave Adonai chasdo uvallayela shiro immi

Amar rabbi levi kol happosek middivre tora veosek bedivre sicha maachilin lo gachale retamim shenneemar hakkotfim malluach ale siach veshoresh retamim lachmam amar resh lakish kol haosek battora ballayela hakkadosh baruch hu moshech alav chut shel chesed bayyom shenneemar yomam yetzave Adonai chasdo uvallayela shiro immi ma taam yomam yetzave Adonai chasdo mishshum devallayela shiro immi
Ika deamri amar resh lakish kol haosek battora baolam hazze haddome lelayela hakkadosh baruch hu moshech alav chut shel chesed baolam habba haddome leom shenneemar yomam yetzave Adonai chasdo vego

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel may dichtiv vattaase adam kidge hayyam keremes lo moshel bo lamma nimshelu bene adam kidge hayyam lomar lach ma dagim shebbayyam kevan sheolin layyabbasha miyyad metim af bene adam kevan shepporshin middivre tora umin hammitzot miyyad metim davar acher ma dagim shebbayyam kevan shekkadra alehem chamma miyyad metim kach bene adam kevan shekkadra alehem chamma miyyad metim

Ibaet ema baolam hazze veibaet ema laolam habba ibaet ema baolam hazze kidrabbi chanina deamar rabbi chanina hakkol bide shamayim chutz mitztzinnim pachim shenneemar tzinnim pachim bederech ikkesh shomer nafsho yirchak mehem

Veibaet ema laolam habba kidrabbi shimon ben lakish deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish en gehinnam leatid lavo ella hakkadosh baruch hu motzi chamma minnartikah umakdir reshaim nidonin bah vetzaddikim mitrappein bah reshaim nidonin

a: Bah dichtiv ki hinne hayyom ba boer kattannur vehau chol zedim vechol ose risha kash velihat otam hayyom hava amar Adonai tzevaot asher lo yaazov lahem shoresh veanaf lo shoresh baolam hazze velo anaf laolam habba
Tzaddikim mitrappein bah dichtiv vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe bichnafeha vego velo od ella shemmitaddenin bah shenneemar vitzatem ufishtem keegle marbek

Davar acher ma dagim shebbayyam kol haggadol mechavero bolea et chavero af bene adam ilmale moraa shel malchut kal haggadol mechavero bolea et chavero vehayenu ditnan rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer heve mitpallel bishlomah shel malchut sheilmale moraah shel malchut ish et reehu chayyim balau
Rav chinana bar pappa rame ketiv shadday lo metzanuhu saggi choach uchtiv gadol adonenu verav koach uchtiv yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach la kashya kan bishat haddin kan bishat milchama

Rabbi chama berabbi chanina rame ketiv chema en li uchtiv nokem Adonai uvaal chema la kashya kan beyisrael kan beummot haolam rav chinana bar pappa amar chema en li shekkevar nishbati mi yitteneni shello nishbati ehye shamir vashayit vego

Vehayenu deamar rabbi alekkesanderi may dichtiv vehaya bayyom hahu avakkesh lehashmid et kol haggoyim avakkesh mimmi amar hakkadosh baruch hu avakkesh benigne shellahem im yesh lahem zechut efdem veim lav ashmidem

Vehayenu deamar rava may dichtiv ach lo vei yishlach yad im befido lahen shua amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael kesheani dan et yisrael en ani dan otam keummot haolam dichtiv ava ava ava asimenna vego ella ani nifra mehen kefid shel tarnegolet

Davar acher afilu en yisrael osin mitzva lefanay ki im meat kefid shel tarnegolin shemmenakkerin baashpa ani metzarfan lecheshbon gadol shenneemar im befido lahen shua davar acher bassachar shemmeshavvein lefanay ani moshia otam
Vehayenu deamar rabbi abba may dichtiv veanochi efdem vehemma dibberu alay kezavim ani amarti efdem bemamonam baolam hazze kede sheyyizku laolam habba vehemma dibberu alay kezavim

Vehayenu deamar rav pappi mishshemeh derava may dichtiv vaani yissarti chizzakti zerootam veelay yechashshevu ra amar hakkadosh baruch hu ani amarti ayasserem beyissurin baolam hazze kede sheyyechzeku zerootam laolam habba veelay yechashshevu ra

Mishtabbach lehu rabbi avahu lemine berav safra deadam gadol hu shevaku leh michsa ditlesar shenin yoma chad ashkechuhu amaru leh ketiv rak etchem yadati mikkol mishpechot haadama al ken efkod alechem et kol aonotechem man deit leh sisya berachameh massek leh ishtik vela amar lehu vela mide remo leh sudara betzavvereh veka metzaaru leh

Ata rabbi avahu ashkechinhu amar lehu ammay metzaaritu leh amaru leh velav amratte lan deadam gadol hu vela yada lememar lan perusha dehay pesuka amar lehu emar daamari lechu betannae bikrae mi amari lechu
Amaru leh may shena attun deyaditun amar lehu anan dishchichinan gabbechon raminan annafshin umayenan inhu la meayeni
Amaru leh lema lan atte amar lehu emshol lachem mashal lema haddavar dome leadam shennoshe mishshene bene adam echad ohavo veechad sono ohavo nifra mimmennu meat meat sono nifra mimmennu bevat achat

Amar rabbi abba bar kahana may dichtiv chalila lecha measot kaddavar hazze lehamit tzaddik im rasha amar avraham lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam chullin hu measot kaddavar hazze lehamit tzaddik im rasha
Vela vehachtiv vehichratti mimmech tzaddik verasha betzaddik sheeno gamur

Aval betzaddik gamur la vehachtiv umimmikdashi tachellu vetane rav yosef al tikre mimmikdashi ella mimmekuddashay ellu bene adam shekkiyemu et hattora mealef vead tav hatam name kevan shehaya beyadam limchot velo michu hau lehu ketzaddikim sheenan gemurim
Rav pappa rame ketiv el zoem bechol yom uchtiv lifne zamo mi yaamod la kashya kan beyachid kan betzibbur

Tanu rabbanan el zoem bechol yom vechamma zamo rega vechamma rega achat mechamesh ribo ushloshet alafim ushmone meot vearbaim ushmone beshaa zo hi rega veen kal beriyya yechola lechaven otah rega chutz mibbilam harasha dichtiv beh
b: Veyodea daat elon efshar daat behemto la hava yada daat elon mi hava yada

May daat behemto la hava yada beidana dachazo leh dahava rechiv achamareh amaru leh may tama la rechavta assusya amar lehu birtiva sheday leh miyyad vattomer haaton halo anochi atoncha amar lah litina bealma

Amara leh asher rachavta alay amar lah akray bealma amara leh meodcha vead hayyom hazze velo od ella sheani osa lach rechivut bayyom veishut ballayela ketiv hacha hahasken hiskanti uchtiv hatam vattehi lo sochenet

Ella may veodea daat elon shehaya yodea lechaven otah shaa shehakkadosh baruch hu koes bah vehayenu dekaamar lehu navi ammi zechor na ma yaatz balak melech moav ume ana oto bilam ben beor min hashshittim vead haggilgal lemaan daat tzidkot Adonai

Amar rabbi elazar amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael ammi reu kamma tzedakot asiti immachem shello kaasti alechem kal otan hayyamim sheim kaasti alechem lo nishtayyer missonehem shel yisrael sarid ufalit vehayenu dekaamar leh bilam levalak ma ekkov lo kabbo el uma ezom lo zoem Adonai
Vechamma zamo rega vechamma rega amar ammemar veitema ravina rega kememreh umnalan derega hava ritcheh dichtiv ki rega beappo chayyim birtzono veibaet ema mehacha chavi kimat rega ad yaavor zaam
Emat ratach amar abbaye bitlat shae kammayata ki chivara karbalta detarnegola kol shata veshata michvar chavera kal shata it beh suryake summake hahi shata let beh suryake summake
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi hava metzaer leh hahu mina bikrae yoma chad nekat tarnegola veokmeh ben kareh dearsa veayyen beh sevar ki mata hahi shata elteh ki meta hahi shata namnem
Amar shema minah lav orach ara lemibad hachi verachamav al kol maasav ketiv uchtiv gam anosh latztzaddik lo tov

Tana mishshemeh derabbi meir beshaa shehammelachim mannichin kitrehen berashehen umishtachavin lachamma miyyad koes hakkadosh baruch hu amar rav yosef la litzalle inish tzelota demusafe bitlat shae kammayata deoma beoma kamma deresh shatta beyachid dilma kevan demippekid dina dilma meayeni beovadeh vedachafu leh midche
I hachi detzibbur name detzibbur nefisha zechuteh i hachi deyachid detzafra name la kevan deika tzibbura deka metzallu la ka middeche
Veha amratte shalosh rishonot hakkadosh baruch hu yoshev veosek battora efoch

Veibaet ema leolam la tefoch tora dichtiv bah emet dichtiv emet kene veal timkor en hakkadosh baruch hu ose lifnim mishshurat haddin din dela ketiv beh emet hakkadosh baruch hu ose lifnim mishshurat haddin
Yom meid taraf baegel siman gufa amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may dichtiv asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom laasotam hayyom laasotam velo lemachar laasotam hayyom laasotam velo hayyom litol secharan

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol mitzot sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze baot umidot otam laolam habba shenneemar yittenu edehem veyitzdaku yishmeu veyomru emet yittenu edehem veyitzdaku ellu yisrael yishmeu veyomru emet ellu ummot haolam

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol mitzot sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze baot vetorfot otam leummot haolam laolam habba al penehem shenneemar ushmartem vaasitem ki hi chochmatchem uvinatchem leene haammim neged haammim lo neemar ella leene haammim melammed shebbaot vetorfot leummot haolam al penehem laolam habba
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi lo asu yisrael et haegel ella liten pitchon pe levaale teshuva shenneemar mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem leyira oti kol hayyamim vego
Vehayenu deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay lo david rauy leoto maase velo yisrael reuyin leoto maase lo david rauy leoto maase dichtiv velibbi chalal bekirbi
Velo yisrael reuyin leoto maase dichtiv mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem leyira oti kal hayyamim ella lama asu

a: Lomar lach sheim chata yachid omrim lo kelach etzel yachid veim chatu tzibbur omrim lo kelach etzel tzibbur

Utzricha dei ashmoinan yachid mishshum dela mefarsam chiteh aval tzibbur dimfarsam chitayehu ema la vei ashmoinan tzibbur mishshum dinfishi rachamayehu aval yachid dela allima zechuteh ema la tzericha
Vehayenu derabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan may dichtiv neum david ben yishay unum haggever hukam al neum david ben yishay shehekim ullah shel teshuva

Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan kol haose mitzva achat baolam hazze mekaddamto veholechet lefanav laolam habba shenneemar vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha uchvod Adonai yaasfecha vechol haover avera achat melappafto umolichato leom haddin shenneemar yillaftu orchot darkam vego
Rabbi elazar omer keshura bo kechelev shenneemar velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihot immah lishkav etzlah baolam hazze lihot immah baolam habba
Amar resh lakish bou venachazik tova laavotenu sheilmale hen lo chatu anu lo banu laolam shenneemar ani amarti elohim attem uvne elon kullechem chibbaltem maasechem achen keadam temutun vego
Lememra dei la chatu la hao moldu vehachtiv veattem peru urvu ad sinay besinay name ketiv lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem lesimchat ona
Vehachtiv lemaan yitav lahem velivnehem vego leotan haomdim al har sinay

Vehaamar resh lakish may dichtiv ze sefer toldot adam vego vechi sefer haya lo leadam harishon melammed shehera lo hakkadosh baruch hu leadam harishon dor dor vedorshav dor dor vachachamav dor dor ufarnasav kevan shehiggia ledoro shel rabbi akiva samach betorato venitatztzev bemitato amar veli ma yakru reecha el vego
Veamar rabbi yose en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu neshamot shebbagguf shenneemar ki lo leolam ariv velo lanetzach ekketzof ki ruach millefanay yaatof unshamot ani asiti
La tema anu lo banu laolam ella kemi shello banu laolam lememra dei la chatu la hao mayeti vehachtiv parashat yevamot ufarashat nachalot

Al tenay umi ketivi kerae al tenay in dehachi amar rabbi shimon ben lakish may dichtiv vayehi erev vayehi voker yom hashshishshi melammed shehitna hakkadosh baruch hu im maase vereshit veamar im mekabbelin yisrael et hattora mutav veim lav achzir etchem letohu vavohu
Metivi mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem levattel mehem malach hammavet i efshar shekkevar nigzera gezera
Ha lo kiblu yisrael et hattora ella kede shello tehe umma velashon sholetet bahen shenneemar lemaan yitav lahem velivnehem ad olam

Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya rabbi yose omer lo kiblu yisrael et hattora ella kede shello yehe malach hammavet sholet bahen shenneemar ani amarti elohim attem uvne elon kullechem chibbaltem maasechem achen keadam temutun
Verabbi yose name hachtiv lemaan yitav lahem velivnehem ad olam tova hu dehaveya ha mita ika rabbi yose amar lach kevan deleka mita en lecha tova gedola mizzo
Vetanna kamma name hachtiv achen keadam temutun may mita aniyyut deamar mar arbaa chashuvim kemetim ellu hen ani suma umtzora umi sheen lo banim
Ani dichtiv ki metu kol haanashim uman ninhu datan vaaviram umi metu mihve hao ella sheyyardu minnichsehem
Suma dichtiv bemachashakkim hoshivani kemete olam metzora dichtiv al na tehi kammet umi sheen lo banim dichtiv hava li vanim veim ayin meta anochi

Tanu rabbanan im bechukkotay telechu en im ella leshon tachanunim vechen hu omer lu ammi shomea li vego kimat oyevehem achnia veomer lu hikshavta lemitzotay vayehi channahar shelomecha vego vayehi chachol zarecha vetzeetzae meecha vego

Tanu rabbanan mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem amar lahen moshe leyisrael kefuye tova bene kefuye tova beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem haya lahem lomar ten atta
Kefuye tova dichtiv venafshenu katza
b: Ballechem hakkelokel bene kefuye tova dichtiv haishsha asher natatta immadi hi natna li min haetz vaochel

Af moshe rabbenu lo remazah lahen leyisrael ella leachar arbaim shana shenneemar vaolech etchem bammidbar arbaim shana uchtiv velo natan Adonai lachem lev vego amar rabba shema minah la kae inish addateh derabbeh ad arbein shenin

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi benaa may dichtiv ashrechem zore al kol mayim meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor ashrehem yisrael bizman sheoskin betora uvigmilut chasadim yitzram masur beyadam veen hem mesurim beyad yitzram shenneemar ashrechem zore al kol mayim veen zeria ella tzedaka shenneemar ziru lachem litzdaka vekitzru lefi chesed veen mayim ella tora shenneemar hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim
Meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor tana deve eliyyahu laolam yasim adam atzmo al divre tora keshor leol vechachamor lemassooy
Shelosha yamim asur laset velatet immahem vechu umi bainan kulle hay
Vehatnan bearbaa perakim bashshana hammocher behema lachavero tzarich lehodio immah macharti lishchot bittah macharti lishchot
Veellu hen erev yom tov haacharon shel chag erev yom tov harishon shel pesach veerev atzeret veerev rosh hashshana uchdivre rabbi yose haggelili af erev yom hakkippurim baggalil

Hatam delaachila saggi bechad yoma hacha dilhakrava bainan telata yome ulhakrava saggi bitlata yome vehatnan shoalin behilchot happesach kodem happesach sheloshim yom rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shette shabbatot
Anan dishchichi mumin defasli afilu bedukkin shebbaayin bainan telatin yomin inhu dimchussar ever it lehu bitlata yome saggi
Deamar rabbi elazar minnayin limchussar ever deasur livne noach dichtiv umikkol hachay mikkol basar shenayim mikkol vego amra tora have behema shechayyin rashe evarim shellah
Hay mibe leh lemaote terefa dela terefa millechayyot zera nafka hanicha leman deamar terefa enah yoledet

a: Ella leman deamar terefa yoledet may ika lememar amar kera ittach bedomin lach vedilma noach gufeh terefa hava tamim ketiv beh
Vedilma tamim bidrachav haya tzaddik ketiv beh
Dilma tamim bidrachav tzaddik bemaasav hava la salka datach denoach gufeh terefa havay dei salka datach denoach terefa hava amar leh rachamana kevatach ayyel shalmin la teayyel
Vehashta denafka leh meittach lechayyot zera lema li i meittach hava amena letzaveta bealma vaafilu zaken vaafilu saris ketav rachamana zera
Ibaya lehu shelosha yamim hen veedehen o dilma hen belo edehen
Ta shema rabbi yishmael omer shelosha lifnehem ushlosha leacharehen asur i salka datach hen veedehen rabbi yishmael yom edehen chashshev lehu meikara vechashshev lehu levassof
Ayede ditna shelosha lifnehem tena name shelosha leacharehem
Ta shema deamar rav tachlifa bar avdimi amar shemuel notzrim ledivre rabbi yishmael leolam asur vei salka datach hen veedehen haika arbaa vachamishsha deshare
Alliba derabbi yishmael la kamibbaya li dehen belo edehen ki ka mibbaya li alliba derabbanan may

Amar ravina ta shema veellu hen edehen shel goyim kalenda setarunya ukratesim veamar rav chanin bar rava kalenda shemona yamim acher tekufa setarunya shemona yamim lifne tekufa vesimanach achor vakedem tzartani
Vei salka datach hen veedehen asra hau tanna kulleh kalenda chad yoma hu chashev leh
Amar rav ashe ta shema lifnay edehen shel goyim shelosha yamim vei salka datach hen veedehen litne edehen shel goyim shelosha yamim
Vechi tema hay dekatane lifne edehen lemaote leachar edehen litne edam shel goyim shelosha yamim lifnehem ella shema minah hen belo edehen shema minah
Ibaya lehu mishshum harvacha o dilma mishshum velifne iver lo titten michshol
Lemay nafka minah deit leh behema ledideh i amratte mishshum harvacha ha ka marvach leh i amratte mishshum iver lo titten michshol ha it leh ledideh
Vechi it leh la avar mishshum iver lo titten michshol vehatanya amar rabbi natan
b: Minnayin shello yoshit adam kos shel yayin lenazir veever min hachay livne noach talmud lomar velifne iver lo titten michshol veha hacha dechi la yahavinan leh shakli ihu vekaavar mishshum lifne iver lo titten michshol
Hacha bemay askinan dekae bitre evre nahara dayeka name dekatane lo yoshit vela katane lo yitten shema minah

Ibaya lehu nasa venatan may rabbi yochanan amar nasa venatan asur resh lakish amar nasa venatan muttar etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish edehen shel goyim nasa venatan asurin may lav lifne edehen la edehen daveka
Ika deamri etiveh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan edehen shel goyim nasa venatan asur edehen in lifne edehen la tanna ide veide edehen kare leh

Tanya kevateh deresh lakish kesheamru asur laset velatet immahem lo asru ella bedavar hammitkayyem aval bedavar sheeno mitkayyem lo vaafilu bedavar hammitkayyem nasa venatan muttar tane rav zevid bidve rabbi oshaya davar sheen mitkayyem mochrin lahem aval en lokchin mehem

Hahu minaa deshaddar leh dinara kesarnaa lerabbi yehuda nesia beom edo hava yatev resh lakish kammeh amar hechi eeved eshkeleh azel umode la eshkeleh haveya leh eva amar leh resh lakish tol uzrok oto levor befanav amar kol shekken dehaveya leh eva kilachar yad hu dekaamena
Lehashilan velishol mehen ku bishlama lehashilan deka marvach lehu aval lishol mehen maote ka memaet lehu amar abbaye gezera lishol mehen attu lehashilan rava amar kullah mishshum deazel umode hu
Lehalotam velilot mehen bishlama lehalotam mishshum deka marvach lehu ella lilot mehen ammay amar abbaye gezera lilot mehen attu lehalotam rava amar kullah mishshum deazel umode hu
Leforan velifroa mehen ku bishlama leforan mishshum deka marvach lehu ella lifroa mehen maote memaet lehu amar abbaye gezera lifroa mehen attu leforan rava amar kullah mishshum deazel umode hu
Utzrichi dei tena laset velatet immahen mishshum deka marvach lehu veazel umode aval lishol mehen demaote ka memaet lehu shappir dame
Vei tena lishol mehen mishshum dachashiva leh milta veazel umode aval lilot mehen tzaara bealma it leh amar tuv la hadri zuze
Vei tena lilot mehen mishshum dekaamar beal karcheh miprana vehashta miha azel umode aval lipara mehen detu la hadri zuze ema tzaara it leh vela azel umode tzericha
Rabbi yehuda omer nifrain mehen ku velet leh lerabbi yehuda af al pi shemmetzer achshav sameach hu leachar zeman

Vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer ishsha lo tasud bammoed mippene shenniuul hu lah umode rabbi yehuda besid sheyechola lekappelo bammoed shettofalto bammoed af al pi shemmetzera achshav semecha hi leachar zeman
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hannach lehilchot moed dechullehu metzer achshav semecha sameach leachar zeman ravina amar goy leinyan peraon leolam metzer
Matnitin dela kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha detanya rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer milve bishtar en nifrain mehen milve al pe nifrain mehen mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam
Yatev rav yosef achoreh derabbi abba veyatev rabbi abba kammeh derav huna veyatev vekaamar hilcheta kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha vehilcheta kerabbi yehuda
Hilcheta kerabbi yehoshua ha daamaran kerabbi yehuda detanya hannoten tzemer latzabba litzboa lo adom utzvao shachor shachor utzvao adom

a: Rabbi meir omer noten lo deme tzamro rabbi yehuda omer im hashshevach yater al hayetzia noten lo et hayetzia veim hayetzia yetera al hashshevach noten lo et hashshevach
Ahderinhu rav yosef leappeh bishlama halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha itzterich salka datach amena yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim ka mashma lan halacha keyachid
Ella halacha kerabbi yehuda lema li peshita demachloket veachar kach setam hilcheta kistam
Machloket bevava kamma ustam bevava metzia ditnan kol hamshanne yado al hattachtona vechol hachozer bo yado al hattachtona
Verav huna mishshum deen seder lammishna deika lememar setam tena beresha veachar kach machloket i hachi kol machloket veachar kach setam lema en seder lammishna
Verav huna ki la amrinan en seder bachada massechta bitre massechate amrinan verav yosef kullah nezikin chada massechta hi
Vei baet ema mishshum dekatane lah gabbe hilchata pesikata kol hamshanne yado al hattachtona vechol hachozer bo yado al hattachtona

Tibe lerabbi yehuda ad kan la ka share rabbi yehuda ella bishvura dela ate lichlal melacha aval hay dechi meshahe leh ate lichlal melacha asur
O dilma afilu lerabbanan la ka asri hatam ella distameh lav lishchita kae aval hay distameh lishchita kae afilu rabbanan sharu

Ta shema deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel shel bet rabbi hau makrivin shor shel pattam beom edam chaser arba rivvan sheen makrivin oto hayyom ella lemachar chaser arba rivvan sheen makrivin oto chay ella shachut chaser arba rivvan sheen makrivin oto kol ikar
May tama lav mishshum dilma ate leshahoye velitamach sheen makrivin oto hayyom ella lemachar may tama ella rabbi mikar milta bae vesavar yiakar veate purta purta
Vechi meshahe leh bare veaved melacha amar rav ashe amar li zevida bar tora meshahenan leh veaved al chad teren
