Matni en mochrin lahem dubbin vaaraot vechol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim en bonin immahem basilke gardom itztadya uvima aval bonin immahem bimosyaot uvet merchatzaot higgia lechipa shemmaamidin bah avoda zara asur livnot
Gema amar rav chanin bar rav chisda veamri lah amar rav chanan bar rava amar rav chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus aval lo limchira
Vaani omer af limchira makom shennahagu limkor mochrin shello limkor en mochrin
Tenan en mochrin lahen dubbin vaaraot velo kol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim tama deit beh nezek larabbim ha let beh nezek larabbim shere amar rabba bar ulla baari shavur
b: Vealliba derabbi yehuda rav ashe amar setam ari shavur hu etzel melacha
Metivi keshem sheen mochrin lahen behema gassa kach en mochrin lahen chayya gassa vaafilu bimkom shemmochrin lahen behema dakka chayya gassa en mochrin lahen teuvta derav chanan bar rava teuvta
Ravina rame matnitin abbarayeta umshanne tenan en mochrin lahen dubbin vaaraot velo kol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim tama deit beh nezek ha let beh nezek mochrin

Urminhi keshem sheen mochrin behema gassa kach en mochrin chayya gassa vaafilu bimkom shemmochrin behema dakka chayya gassa en mochrin umshanne baari shavur vealliba derabbi yehuda rav ashe amar setam ari shavur hu etzel melacha
Matkef lah rav nachman man lema lan daari chayya gassa hi dilma chayya dakka hi
Rav ashe dayek matnitin umotev teuvta tenan en mochrin lahen dubbim vaaraot velo kol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim tama deit beh nezek ha let beh nezek mochrin
Vetama ari distam ari shavur hu etzel melacha aval mide acharina deaved melacha la teuvta derav chanan bar rava teuvta
Vechayya gassa mihat may melacha avda amar abbaye amar li mar yehuda deve mar yochani tachani rechayim baarode
Amar rabbi zera ki havenan be rav yehuda amar lan gemiru minay ha milta demiggavra rabba shemia li vela yadana i merav i mishshemuel chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus

Ki atay lekurkunya ashkachteh lerav chiyya bar ashe veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh dishmuel chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus amena shema minah mishshemeh dishmuel itmar ki atay lesura ashkachteh lerabba bar yirmeya deyatev vekaamar lah mishshemeh derav chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus amena shema minah itmar mishshemeh derav veitmar mishshemeh dishmuel

Ki selekit lehatam ashkachteh lerav assi deyatev vekaamar amar rav chama bar gurya mishshemeh derav chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus amari leh vela savar lah mar deman mara dishmateta rabba bar yirmeya amar li patya ukkama minay uminach tistayyem shemata
Itmar name amar rabbi zera amar rav assi amar rabba bar yirmeya amar rav chama bar gurya amar rav chayya gassa hare hi kivhema dakka lefirkus

En bonin ku amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan shalosh basilkaot hen shel melachim veshel merchatzaot veshel otzarot amar rava shettayim leheter veechad leisur vesiman lesor malchehem bezikkim
Veika deamri amar rava kullam leheter vehatnan en bonin immahen basilke gardom itztadya uvima ema shel gardom veshel itztadya veshel bima
Tanu rabbanan keshennitpas rabbi eliezer leminut heeluhu laggardom lidon amar lo oto hegmon zaken shekkemotcha yaasok bidvarim betelim hallalu
Amar lo neeman alay haddayyan kesavur oto hegmon alav hu omer vehu lo amar ella keneged aviv shebbashshamayim amar lo hoil veheemanti alecha dimos patur atta

Keshebba leveto nichnesu talmidav etzlo lenachamo velo kibel alav tanchumin amar lo rabbi akiva rabbi tarsheni lomar davar echad mimma shellimadtani amar lo emor amar lo rabbi shemma minut ba leyadcha

a: Vehinacha vealav nitpasta amar lo akiva hizkartani paam achat hayiti mehallech bashshuk haelon shel tzipori umatzati adam echad mittalmide yeshu hannotzri veyaakov ish kefar sechanya shemo amar li katuv betoratchem lo tavi etnan zona vego mahu laasot hemennu bet hakkisse lechohen gadol velo amarti lo kelum
Amar li kach limdani yeshu hannotzri ki meetnan zona kubbatza vead etnan zona yashuvu mimmekom hattinnofet bau limkom hattinnofet yelechu

Vehinani haddavar al yede ze nitpasti leminut veavarti al ma shekkatuv battora harchek mealeha darkecha zo minut veal tikrav el petach betah zo harashut veika deamri harchek mealeha darkecha zo minut veharashut veal tikrav el petach betah zo zona vechamma amar rav chisda arba ammot
Verabbanan hay meetnan zona may darshi beh kidrav chisda deamar rav chisda kol zona shenniskeret levassof hi socheret shenneemar uvtittech etnan veetnan lo nittan lach vattehi lehefech
Ufliga derabbi pedat deamar rabbi pedat lo asra tora ella keriva shel gilluy araot bilvad shenneemar ish ish el kol sheer besaro lo tikrevu legallot erva

Ulla ki hava ate mibbe rav hava menashshek lehu laachateh abbe yedayehu veamri lah abbe chadayehu ufliga dideh addideh deamar ulla keriva bealma asur mishshum lach lach amrin nezira sechor sechor lecharma la tikrav

Laaluka shette vanot hav hav may hav hav amar mar ukva kol shette banot shetztzoakot miggehinnam veomrot baolam hazze have have uman ninhu minut veharashut ika deamri amar rav chisda amar mar ukva kol gehinnam tzoeket veomeret haviu li shette banot shetztzoakot veomrot baolam hazze have have
Kol baeha lo yeshuvun velo yassigu orchot chayyim vechi meachar shello shavu hechan yassigu hachi kaamar veim yashuvu lo yassigu orchot chayyim

Lememra dechol happoresh mimminut mayet veha hahi daatay lekammeh derav chisda veamra leh kalla shebbakkallot asta benah hakkatan mibbenah haggadol vaamar lah rav chisda terachu lah bizvadta vela mita
Middekaamra kalla shebbakkallot asta mikkelal deminut name haveya bah hahu dela hadra bah shappir umishshum hachi lo meta
Ika deamri mimminut in meavera la veha hahi daatay kammeh derav chisda vaamar lehu rav chisda zavidu lah zevadta umita middekaamra kalla shebbakkallot mikkelal deminut name haveya bah

Umeavera la vehatanya amru alav al rabbi elazar ben durdeya shello hinniach zona achat baolam shello ba aleha paam achat shama sheyyesh zona achat bichrakke hayyam vehayeta notelet kis dinarin bischarah natal kis dinarin vehalach veavar aleha shiva neharot bishat hergel davar heficha amra keshem shehafacha zo enah chozeret limkomah kach elazar ben durdeya en mekabbelin oto bitshuva

Halach veyashav ben shene harim ugvaot amar harim ugvaot bakkeshu alay rachamim amru lo ad sheanu mevakkeshim alecha nevakkesh al atzmenu shenneemar ki heharim yamushu vehaggevaot temutena amar shamayim vaaretz bakkeshu alay rachamim amru ad sheanu mevakkeshim alecha nevakkesh al atzmenu shenneemar ki shamayim keashan nimlachu vehaaretz kabbeged tivle

Amar chamma ulvana bakkeshu alay rachamim amru lo ad sheanu mevakkeshim alecha nevakkesh al atzmenu shenneemar vechafra hallevana uvosha hachamma amar kochavim umazzalot bakkeshu alay rachamim amru lo ad sheanu mevakkeshim alecha nevakkesh al atzmenu shenneemar venamakku kol tzeva hashshamayim

Amar en haddavar taluy ella bi hinniach rosho ben birkav vegaa bivchiyya ad sheyyatzta nishmato yatzta bat kol veamra rabbi elazar ben durdeya mezuman lechayye haolam habba veha hacha baavera hava umit hatam name kevan daavik bah tuva keminut damya
Bacha rabbi veamar yesh kone olamo bechamma shanim veyesh kone olamo beshaa achat veamar rabbi lo dayyan levaale teshuva shemmekabbelin otan ella shekkorin otan rabbi
Rabbi chanina verabbi yonatan hao kaazli beorcha meto lehanhu tere shevile chad patze appitcha daavoda zara vechad patze appitcha deve zonot amar leh chad lechavreh nezil appitcha daavoda zara
b: Dinchis yitzreh amar leh idach nezil appitcha deve zonot venichpeyeh leyitzrin unkabbel agra ki matu hatam chazonhu lezonot itkenau mikkammayehu
Amar leh mena lach ha amar leh mezimma tishmor alecha tevuna tintzerekka

Amaru leh rabbanan lerava may mezimma ilema tora dichtiv bah zimma umtargeminan etzat chitin uchtiv hifli etza higdil tushiyya i hachi zimma mibbee leh hachi kaamar middevar zima tishmor alecha tora tintzerekka

Tanu rabbanan keshennitpesu rabbi elazar ben parta verabbi chanina ben teradon amar lo rabbi elazar ben parta lerabbi chanina ben teradon ashrecha shennitpasta al davar echad oy li shennitpasti al chamishsha devarim

Amar lo rabbi chanina ashrecha shennitpasta al chamishsha devarim veatta nitzol oy li shennitpasti al davar echad veeni nitzol sheatta asakta battora uvigmilut chasadim vaani lo asakti ella battora bilvad

Vechidrav huna deamar rav huna kol haosek battora bilvad dome kemi sheen lo eloha shenneemar veyamim rabbim leyisrael lelo elohe emet vego may lelo elohe emet shekkol haosek battora bilvad dome kemi sheen lo eloha

Uvigmilut chasadim lo asak vehatanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer lo yitten adam meotav learnaki shel tzedaka ella im ken memunne alav talmid chacham kerabbi chanina ben teradon hemnuh hemone hu dahava meheman mebad la avad
Vehatanya amar lo maot shel purim nitchallefu li bemaot shel tzedaka vechillaktim laaniyyim mebad avad kidvae leh la avad

Atuh lerabbi elazar ben parta amaru may tama tanet umay tama ganvatte amar lehu i sayyafa la safra vei safra la sayyafa umiddeha letah ha name letah umay tama karu lach rabbi rabban shel tarsiyyim ani
Ayeto leh tere kibure amaru leh he deshitya vehe deirba itrechish leh nisa atya atay ziburita itiv al deshitya vaatay zibura vitev al deirba amar lehu hay deshitya vehay deirba
Amaru leh umay tama la atet leve avidan amar lehu zaken hayiti umityare ani shemma tirmesuni beraglechem amaru vead haidana kamma save itremus itrechish nisa hahu yoma irmas chad sava

Umay tama ka shavkatte avdach lecherut amar lehu lo hau devarim meolam kam chad minayehu leashode beh ata eliyyahu idmi leh kechad mechashshive demalchuta amar leh middeitrechish leh nisa bechullehu beha name itrechish leh nisa vehahu gavra bishuteh hu deka achvi machve
Vela ashgach beh kam lememar lehu hava ketiva igarta dahava ketiv mechashshive demalchut leshaddore leve kesar veshadderuha al yedeh dehahu gavra ata eliyyahu patkeh arba mea parse azal vela ata

Atuh lerabbi chanina ben teradon amaru leh ammay ka askatte beorayeta amar lehu kaasher tzivani Adonai elohay miyyad gazru alav lisrefa veal ishto lahariga veal bitto leshev bekubba shel zonot alav lisrefa shehaya

a: Hoge et hashshem beotiyyotav vehechi aved hachi vehatnan ellu sheen lahem chelek laolam habba haomer en tora min hashshamayim veen techiyyat hammetim min hattora abba shaul omer af hahoge et hashshem beotiyyotav
Lehitlammed avad kidtanya lo tilmad laasot aval atta lamed lehavin ulhorot
Ella may tama ianash mishshum dehoge et hashshem befarhesya hava veal ishto lahariga dela macha machata beh mikkan amru kal mi sheyyesh beyado limchot veeno moche neenash alav

Veal bitto leshev bekubba shel zonot deamar rabbi yochanan paam achat hayeta bitto mehallechet lifne gedole romi amru kamma naot pesioteha shel riva zo miyyad dikdeka bifsioteha vehayenu deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish may dichtiv aon akevay yesubbeni aonot sheadam dash baakevav baolam hazze mesubbin lo leom haddin

Beshaa sheyyatzu shelashtan tziddeku alehem et haddin hu amar hatztzur tamim poolo vego veishto amra el emuna veen avel bitto amra gedol haetza verav haaliliyya asher enecha fekuchot al kol darche vego amar rabbi kamma gedolim tzaddikim hallalu shennizdammenu lahen shalosh mikraot shel tzidduk haddin bishat tzidduk haddin

Tanu rabbanan keshechala rabbi yose ben kisma halach rabbi chanina ben teradon levakkero amar lo chanina achi achi i atta yodea sheumma zo min hashshamayim himlichuha shehechriva et beto vesarfa et hechalo veharga et chasidav veibbeda et tovav vaadayin hi kayyemet vaani shamati alecha sheatta yoshev veosek battora umakhil kehillot barabbim vesefer munnach lecha bechekecha

Amar lo min hashshamayim yerachamu amar lo ani omer lecha devarim shel taam veatta omer li min hashshamayim yerachamu tameha ani im lo yisrefu otcha veet sefer tora baesh amar lo rabbi ma ani lechayye haolam habba
Amar lo kelum maase ba leyadecha amar lo maot shel purim nitchallefu li bemaot shel tzedaka vechillaktim laaniyyim amar lo im ken mechelkecha yehi chelki umiggoralcha yehi gorali

Amru lo hau yamim muatim ad shenniftar rabbi yose ben kisma vehalchu kol gedole romi lekovro vehispiduhu hesped gadol uvachazaratan metzauhu lerabbi chanina ben teradon shehaya yoshev veosek battora umakhil kehillot barabbim vesefer tora munnach lo becheko

Heviuhu uchrachuhu besefer tora vehikkifuhu bachavile zemorot vehitztzitu bahen et haur veheviu sefogin shel tzemer ushraum bemayim vehinnichum al libbo kede shello tetze nishmato mehera amra lo bitto abba eracha bechach amar lah ilmale ani nisrafti levaddi haya haddavar kashe li achshav sheani nisraf vesefer tora immi mi shemvakkesh elbonah shel sefer tora hu yevakkesh elboni

Amru lo talmidav rabbi ma atta roe amar lahen gilon gevilin nisrafin veotiyyot porchot af atta petach picha vetikkanes becha haesh amar lahen mutav sheyyittelenna mi shennetanah veal yechabbel hu beatzmo

Amar lo kelatztoneri rabbi im ani marbe bashshalhevet venotel sefogin shel tzemer meal libbecha atta mevieni lechayye haolam habba amar lo hen hishshava li nishba lo miyyad hirba bashshalhevet venatal sefogin shel tzemer meal libbo yatza nishmato bimhera af hu kafatz venafal letoch haur
Yatza bat kol veamra rabbi chanina ben teradon uklatztoneri mezummanin hen lechayye haolam habba bacha rabbi veamar yesh kone olamo beshaa achat veyesh kone olamo bechamma shanim

Berurya devethu derabbi meir beratte derabbi chanina ben teradon havay amara leh zila bi milleta deyatva achatay bekubba shel zonot shekal tarkabba dedinare vaazal amar i la itavid bah isura mitavid mitrechish nisa i avada isura la itavid mitrechish lah nisa

Azal nekat nafsheh kechad parasha amar lah hashmiini hishshami li amara leh dashtana ana amar lah mittarachna mirtach amara leh nefishan tuva veika tuva hacha deshappiran minay amar shema minah la avada isura kol deate amra leh hachi

Azal legabbe shomer didah amar leh havah nihalay amar leh mistefena mimmalchuta amar leh shekol tarkabba dedinare palga pelach ufalga leheve lach amar leh vechi shalmi may ebed amar leh ema elaha demeir aneni umittatztzelatte amar leh
b: Umi yemar dehachi ika amar leh hashta chazet hao hanhu kalve dahao ka achli inashe shekal kala sheda behu hao kaatu lemechleh amar elaha demeir aneni shavkuh veyahavah leh
Lesof ishtema milta be malka atuh assekuh lizkifa amar elaha demeir aneni achatuh amaru leh may hay amar lehu hachi hava maase

Ato chakaku lidmuteh derabbi meir appitcha deromi amri kol dechaze lefartzufa haden layeteh yoma chada chazuhi rehut abbatreh rehat mikkammayehu al leve zonot ika deamri bishshule goyim chaza temash beha umtak beha ika deamri ata eliyyahu iddemi lehu kezona kerachteh amri chas veshalom i rabbi meir hava la hava aved hachi
Kam arak ata levavel ika deamri mehay maase veika deamri mimmaase divrurya

Tanu rabbanan haholech leitztadinin ulcharkom veraa sham et hannechashim veet hachabbarin bukon umukon umulon velulon belurin salgurin hare ze moshav letzim vaalehem hakkatuv omer ashre haish asher lo halach vego ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo ha lamadta sheddevarim hallalu meviin et haadam lide bitul tora

Urminhi leitztadinin muttar mippene shetztzoveach umatztzil ulcharkom muttar mippene yishshuv medina uvilvad shello yitchashshev immahem veim nitchashshev immahem asur kashya itztedinin aitztadinin kashya karkom akkarkom
Bishlama karkom akkarkom la kashya kan bemitchashshev immahen kan besheen mitchashshev immahen ella itztadinin aitztadinin kashya
Tannae hi detanya en holchin leitztadinin mippene moshav letzim verabbi natan mattir mippene shene devarim echad mippene shetztzoveach umatztzil veechad mippene shemmeid edut ishsha lehassiah

Tanu rabbanan en holchin leteratyaot ulkirkesiot mippene shemmezabbelin sham zibul laavoda zara divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim makom shemmezabbelin asur mippene chashad avoda zara umakom sheen mezabbelin sham asur mippene moshav letzim
May benayehu amar rabbi chanina missura nasa venatan ika benayehu

Derash rabbi shimon ben pazzi may dichtiv ashre haish asher lo halach baatzat reshaim uvderech chattaim lo amad uvmoshav letzim lo yashav vechi meachar shello halach hechan amad umeachar shello amad hechan yashav umeachar shello yeshev hechan latz
Ella lomar lach sheim halach sofo laamod veim amad sofo leshev veim yashav sofo lalutz veim latz alav hakkatuv omer im chachamta chachamta lach veim latzta levaddecha tissa

Amar rabbi eliezer kol hammitlotzetz yissurin bain alav shenneemar veatta al titlotzatzu pen yechzeku mosrechem amar lehu rava lerabbanan bematuta baena minayechu dela titlotztzu dela leto alayechu yissurin

Amar rav kattina kal hammitlotzetz mezonotav mitmaatin shenneemar mashach yado et lotztzim amar rabbi shimon ben lakish kol hammitlotzetz nofel begehinnam shenneemar zed yahir letz shemo ose beevrat zadon veen evra ella gehinnam shenneemar yom evra hayyom hahu

Amar rabbi oshaya kol hammityaher nofel begehinnam shenneemar zed yahir letz shemo ose beevrat zadon veen evra ella gehinnam shenneemar yom evra hayyom hahu amar rabbi chanilay bar chanilay kol hammitlotzetz gorem kelaya laolam shenneemar veatta al titlotzatzu pen yechzeku mosrechem ki chala venecheratza shamati

Amar rabbi eliezer kasha hi shettechilato yissurin vesofo kelaya darash rabbi shimon ben pazzi ashre haish asher lo halach leteratyaot ulkirkesiot shel goyim uvderech chattaim lo amad ze shello amad bekinigon uvmoshav letzim lo yashav shello yashav betachbulot
Shemma yomar adam hoil velo halachti leteratyaot ulkirkesiot velo amadti bekinigon elech veetgare beshena talmud lomar uvtorato yehge yomam valayela
Amar rav shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan ashre haish asher lo halach baatzat reshaim ze

a: Avraham avinu shello halach baatzat anshe dor happelagga shershaim hau shenneemar hava nivne lanu ir uvderech chattaim lo amad shello amad baamidat sedom shechataim hau shenneemar veanshe sedom raim vechattaim la meod
Uvmoshav letzim lo yashav shello yashav bemoshav anshe pelishtim mippene shelletzanim hau shenneemar vayehi ketov libbam vayyomru kiru leshimshon visachek lanu
Ashre ish yare et Adonai ashre ish velo ashre ishsha amar rav amram amar rav ashre mi sheose teshuva keshehu ish rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar ashre mi shemmitgabber al yitzro keish

Bemitzotav chafetz meod amar rabbi elazar bemitzotav velo bischar mitzotav vehayenu ditnan hu haya omer al tihu kaavadim hamshammeshin et harav al menat lekabbel peras ella heu kaavadim hamshammeshin et harav shello al menat lekabbel peras
Ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo amar rabbi en adam lomed tora ella mimmakom shellibbo chafetz shenneemar ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo

Levi verabbi shimon berabbi yatvi kammeh derabbi veka paski sidra selek sifra levi amar layeto lan mishle rabbi shimon berabbi amar layeto lan tilim kafyeh lelevi veayeto tilim ki meto hacha ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo paresh rabbi vaamar en adam lomed tora ella mimmakom shellibbo chafetz amar levi rabbi natatta lanu reshut laamod

Amar rabbi avdimi bar chama kol haosek battora hakkadosh baruch hu ose lo chafatzav shenneemar ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo amar rava leolam yilmod adam tora bemakom shellibbo chafetz shenneemar ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo
Veamar rava battechila nikret al shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu ulvassof nikret al shemo shenneemar betorat Adonai cheftzo uvtorato yehge yomam valayela
Veamar rava leolam yilmad adam tora veachar kach yehege shenneemar betorat Adonai vahadar uvtorato yehge
Veamar rava leolam ligres inish veaf al gav dimshakkach veaf al gav dela yada may kaamar shenneemar garsa nafshi letaava garsa ketiv vela ketiv tachana
Rava rame ketiv al gappe uchtiv al kisse battechilla al gappe ulvassof al kisse
Ketiv berosh meromim uchtiv ale darech battechilla berosh meromim ulvassof ale darech
Ulla rame ketiv shete mayim mibborecha uchtiv venozlim mittoch beerecha battechilla shete mibborecha ulvassof venozlim mittoch beerecha
Amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna may dichtiv hon mehevel yimat vekovetz al yad yarbe im ose adam torato chavilot chavilot mitmaet veim kovetz al yad yarbe
Amar rava yadi rabbanan leha milta veavri alah amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ana avidtah veikkayyam bidi
Amar rav shezvi mishshemeh derabbi elazar ben azarya may dichtiv lo yacharoch remiyya tzedo lo yichye velo yaarich yamim tzayyad harammay
Verav sheshet amar tzayyad harammay yacharoch ki ata rav dimi amar mashal leadam shetztzad tzipporin im meshabber kenafeha shel rishona kullam mitkayemot beyado veim lav en mitkayemot beyado
Vehaya keetz shatul al palge mayim amri deve rabbi yannay keetz shatul velo keetz natua kol hallomed tora merav echad eno roe siman beracha leolam

Amar lehu rav chisda lerabbanan baena deema lechu milleta umistefena deshavkitu li veazlitu kol hallomed tora merav echad eno roe siman beracha leolam shavkuh vaazul kammeh derava amar lehu hane mile sevara aval gemara merav echad adif ki hechi
b: Dela lipallug lishane al palge mayim amar rabbi tanchum bar chanilay leolam yeshallesh adam shenotav shelish bammikra shelish bammishna shelish battalmud
Mi yada inish kamma chaye ki kaamrinan beome
Asher piro yitten beitto amar rava im piro yitten beitto vealehu lo yibbol veim lav al hallomed veal hamlammed alehem hakkatuv omer lo chen harshaim ki im vego
Amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav may dichtiv ki rabbim chalalim hippila ze talmid shello higgia lehoraa umore vaatzumim kol harugeha ze talmid shehiggia lehoraa veeno more
Vead kamma ad arbein shenin veha rava ori hatam beshavin

Vealehu lo yibbol amar rav acha bar adda amar rav veamri lah amar rav acha bar abba amar rav hamnuna amar rav sheafilu sichat chullin shel talmide chachamim tzericha talmud shenneemar vealehu lo yibbol

Vechol asher yaase yatzliach amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi davar ze katuv battora veshanuy banneviim umshullash bakketuvim kol haosek battora nechasav matzlichin lo katuv battora dichtiv ushmartem et divre habberit hazzot vaasitem otam lemaan taskilu et kol asher taasun

Shanuy banneviim dichtiv lo yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha vehagita bo yomam valayela lemaan tishmor laasot kechol hakkatuv bo ki az tatzliach et derachecha veaz taskil meshullash bakketuvim dichtiv ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo uvtorato yehge yomam valayela vehaya keetz shatul al palge mayim asher piro yitten beitto vealehu lo yibbol vechol asher yaase yatzliach
Machriz rabbi alekkesanderi man bae chayye man bae chayye iknuf vaato kulle alma legabbeh amri leh hav lan chayye amar lehu mi haish hechafetz chayyim vego netzor leshoncha mera vego

Sur mera vaase tov vego shemma yomar natzarti leshoni mera usfatay middabber mirma elech veetgare beshena talmud lomar sur mera vaase tov tov ella tora shenneemar ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu

Higgia lakkipa makom shemmaamidin bah avoda zara amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi yochanan im bana secharo muttar peshita meshammeshe avoda zara hen umshammeshe avoda zara ben lerabbi yishmael ben lerabbi akiva enan asurin ad shibedu

Amar rabbi yirmeya lo nitzrecha ella laavoda zara atzmah hanicha leman deamar avoda zara shel yisrael asura miyyad veshel goy ad shetteaved shappir ella leman deamar shel goy asura miyyad may ika lememar
Ella amar rabba bar ulla lo nitzrecha ella bemakkosh acharon avoda zara man ka garem lah gemar melacha veemat haveya gemar melacha bemakkosh acharon makkosh acharon let beh shave peruta
Alma kasavar yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof

Matni veen osin tachshitin laavoda zara katlaot unzamim vetabbaot rabbi eliezer omer besachar muttar en mochrin lahem bimchubbar lakkarka aval mocher hu mishsheyyikkatzetz rabbi yehuda omer mocher hu al menat lakotz
Gema menahane mile amar rabbi yose bar chanina

a: Deamar kera lo techonnem lo titten lahem chanaya bakkarka hay la techonnem mibe leh dehachi kaamar rachamana lo titten lahem chen
Im ken lema kera lo techunnem may lo techonnem shema minah tarte
Veakkatti mibe leh dehachi amar rachamana lo titten lahem mattenat shel chinnam im ken lema kera lo techinem may lo techonnem shema minah kullehu
Tanya name hachi lo techonnem lo titten lahem chanaya bakkarka davar acher lo techonnem lo titten lahem chen davar acher lo techonnem lo titten lahem mattenat chinnam

Umattenat chinnam gufah tannae hi detanya lo tochlu kol nevela lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenochri en li ella leger bintina ulgoy bimchira leger bimchira minnayin talmud lomar tittenenna o machor

Legoy bintina minnayin talmud lomar tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenochri nimtza atta omer echad ger veechad goy ben bintina ben bimchira divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer devarim kichtavan leger bintina ulgoy bimchira
Shappir kaamar rabbi meir verabbi yehuda amar lach i salka datach kidkaamar rabbi meir lichtov rachamana tittenenna vaachalah vmachor o lema li shema minah lidvarim kichtavan hu daata
Verabbi meir hahu leakdome netina deger limchira degoy verabbi yehuda kevan deger atta metzve lehachoto vegoy i atta metzve lehachaoto lehakdim la tzerich kera
Davar acher lo techonnem lo titten lahem chen mesayya leh lerav deamar rav asur laadam sheyyomar kamma naa goya zo

Metivi maase berabban shimon ben gamliel shehaya al gabbe maala behar habbayit veraa goya achat naa beoter amar ma rabbu maasecha Adonai veaf rabbi akiva raa eshet toranusrufus harasha rak sachak uvacha rak shehayeta baa mittipa serucha sachak daatida demiggayera venasev lah bacha dehay shufra bale afra
Verav odoye hu deka mode deamar mar haroe beriyyot tovot omer baruch shekkacha bara beolamo
Ulistakkole mi shere metivi venishmarta mikkol davar ra shello yistakkel adam beishsha naa vaafilu penuya beeshet ish vaafilu mechoeret
b: Velo bevigde tzeva shel ishsha velo bachamor velo bachamora velo bachazir velo bachazira velo beofot bizman shennizkakin ze laze vaafilu male enayim kemalach hammavet

Amru alav al malach hammavet shekkullo male enayim bishat petirato shel chole omed meal meraashotav vecharbo shelufa beyado vetipa shel mara teluya bo kevan shechole roe oto mizdazea ufoteach piv vezorkah letoch piv mimmenna met mimmenna masriach mimmenna panav morikot
Keren zavit havay

Velo bevigde tzeva shel ishsha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel afilu shetuchin al gabbe kotel amar rav pappa uvmakkir baalehen amar rava dayeka name dekatane velo bevigde tzeva ishsha vela katane velo bevigde tzivonin shema minah
Amar rav chisda hane mile beattike aval bechadte let lan bah dei la tema hachi anan mana leashpore hechi yahavinan ha ka mistakkel
Ultamach ha deamar rav yehuda min bemino muttar lehachnis kemichchol bishfoferet ha ka mistakkal ella baavidteh terid hachi name baavidteh terid

Amar mar mimmenna met nema peliga daavuh dishmuel deamar avuh dishmuel amar li malach hammavet i la dechayeshna likara divriyyata hava parana bet hashshechita kivhema dilma hahi tipa mechattecha lehu lesimanin
Mimmenna masriach mesayya leh lerabbi chanina bar kahana deamar rabbi chanina bar kahana amri be rav harotze shello yasriach meto yehappechennu al panav
Tanu rabbanan venishmarta mikkol davar ra shello yeharher adam bayyom veyavo lide tuma ballayela

Mikkan amar rabbi pinchas ben yair tora mevia lide zehirut zehirut mevia lide zerizut zerizut mevia lide nekiyyut nekiyyut mevia lide perishut perishut mevia lide tohora tohora mevia lide chasidut chasidut mevia lide anava anava mevia lide yirat chet yirat chet mevia lide kedushsha kedushsha mevia lide ruach hakkodesh ruach hakkodesh mevia lide techiyyat hammetim vachasidut gedola mikkullan shenneemar az dibbarta vechazon lachasidecha

Ufliga derabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi anava gedola mikkullan shenneemar ruach Adonai elohim alay yaan mashach Adonai oti levasser anavim chasidim lo neemar ella anavim ha lamadta sheanava gedola mikkullan

En mochrin lahen vechu tanu rabbanan mochrin lahen ilan al menat lakotz vekotzetz divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer en mochrin lahen ella ketzutza shachat al menat ligzoz vegozez divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer en mochrin lahen ella gezuza kama al menat liktzor vekotzer divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer en mochrin ella ketzura
Utzricha dei ashmeinan ilan beha kaamar rabbi meir kevan dela pased meshahe leh aval hay dechi meshahe leh pased ema mode leh lerabbi yehuda
Vei ashmeinan behane tarte mishshum dela yedia shevachayehu aval shachat didia shevachayehu ema mode leh lerabbi meir
Vei ashmeinan beha beha kaamar rabbi meir aval behanach ema mode leh lerabbi yehuda tzericha
Ibaya lehu behema al menat lishchot mahu
Hatam tama may share rabbi yehuda delav birshuteh kayemi vela matze meshahe lehu aval behema kevan devirshuteh degoy kayema meshahe lah o dilma la shena
Ta shema detanya behema al menat lishchot veshochet divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer en mochrin lo ella shechuta
Matni en maskirin lahem battim beeretz yisrael veen tzarich lomar sadot uvsurya

a: Maskirin lahem battim aval lo sadot uvchutza laaretz mochrin lahem battim umaskirin sadot divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer beeretz yisrael maskirin lahem battim aval lo sadot uvsurya mochrin battim umaskirin sadot uvchutza laaretz mochrin ellu vaellu
Af bemakom sheamru lehaskir lo levet dira amru mippene shehu machnis letocho avoda zara shenneemar lo tavi toeva el betecha uvchol makom lo yaskir lo et hammerchatz mippene shehu nikra al shemo
Gema may en tzarich lomar sadot ilema mishshum deit bah tarte chada chanayat karka vachada deka mafka lah mimmaaser
I hachi battim name ika tarte chada chanayat karka vachada deka mafka lah mimmezuza amar rav mesharsheya mezuza chovat haddar hu
Besurya maskirin battim ku may shena mechira dela mishshum mechira deeretz yisrael i hachi missechirut name nigzor hi gufah gezera vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera
Veha sechirut sade divsurya digzera ligzera hi veka gazrinan hatam lav gezera hu kasavar kibush yachid shemeh kibush
Sade deit beh tarte gezaru beh rabbanan battim delet behu tarte la gezaru behu rabbanan
Bechutza laaretz vechu sade deit beh tarte gezaru behu rabbanan battim delet behu tarte la gezaru behu rabbanan
Rabbi yose omer beeretz yisrael maskirin lahem battim vechu may tama sadot deit behu tarte gezaru behu rabbanan battim delet behu tarte la gezaru behu rabbanan
Uvsurya mochrin vechu may tama kasavar kibush yachid la shemeh kibush vesade deit bah tarte gezaru bah rabbanan battim delet behu tarte la gezaru behu rabbanan
Uvchutza laaretz mochrin vechu may tama kevan dimrachak la gazrinan
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose amar rav yosef uvilvad shello yaasenna shechuna vechamma shechuna tana en shechuna pechuta mishshelosha bene adam
Velechush dilma azel hay yisrael umzabben lechad goy veazel hayeche umzabben lah litre amar abbaye allifne mippakkedinan allifne delifne la mippakkedinan
Af bemakom sheamru lehaskir mikkelal deika duchta dela mogri
b: Ustama kerabbi meir dei rabbi yose bechol duchta mogri
Uvchol makom lo yiskor vechu tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo yiskor adam merchatzo legoy mippene shennikra al shemo vegoy ze ose bo melacha beshabbatot uvyamim tovim
Aval lechuti may shere kuti emar aved beh melacha bechullo shel moed bechullo shel moed anan name avdinan
Aval sadehu legoy may shere may tama arisa arisuteh kaaved merchatz name amri arisa arisuteh kaaved arisa demerchatz la avdi anshe

Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer lo yaskir adam sadehu lechuti mippene shennikret al shemo vechuti ze ose bo melacha bechullo shel moed aval goy may shere deamri arisa arisuteh aved i hachi kuti name amri arisa arisuteh aved

a: Arisuta lerabbi shimon ben elazar let leh ella goy may tama muttar deamrinan leh vetzayet kuti name amrinan leh vetzayet kuti la tzayet deamar ana gemirna tefe minach
I hachi may irya mippene shennikret al shemo tipok leh mishshum lifne iver lo titten michshol chada veod kaamar chada mishshum lifne iver veod mippene shennikret al shemo
Hanhu morikae degoy naket beshabbeta veyisrael bechad beshabbeta ato lekammeh derava shera lehu
Etiveh ravina lerava yisrael vegoy shekkiblu sade beshuttafut lo yomar yisrael legoy tol chelkecha bashshabbat vaani bachol veim hitnu mittechilla muttar
Veim bau lecheshbon asur iksif lesof igallay milleta dehitnu meikara hao
Rav geviha mibbe chetil amar hanhu shetile deorla hava goy achel shene deorla veyisrael shene dehettera ato lekammeh derava shera lehu
Veha otveh ravina lerava lesayyoe sayeeh veha ikkesif lo hau devarim meolam
Ibaya lehu setama may ta shema im hitnu mittechila muttar ha setama asur
Ema sefa im bau lecheshbon asur ha setama muttar ella meha leka lemishma minah
Hadaran alach lifne edehen

Matni en maamidin behema befundekaot shel goyim mippene shechashudin al harvia velo tityached ishsha immahen mippene shechashudin al haaraot velo yityached adam immahen mippene shechashudin al shefichut damim
b: Gema urminhi lokchin mehen behema lekorban veen choshshin lo mishshum rovea velo mishshum nirba velo mishshum muktze velo mishshum neevad

Bishlama muktze veneevad im ita deaktzeyeh veim ita defalcheh la hava mezabben leh ella rovea venirba lechush amar rav tachlifa amar rav shela bar avina mishshemeh derav goy chas al behemto shello teaker
Hatinach nekevot zecharim may ika lememar amar rav kahana hoil umachchishin babbasar
Ella ha detanya lokchin behema meroe shellahen lechush dilma ravah lah roe shellahen mityare mishshum hefsed sachar
Ella ha detanya en mosrin behema laroe shellahen lema roe shellahen mityare mishshum hefsed secharo
Inhu deyadi bahadade miratti anan dela yadinan behu la miratti amar rabba hayenu deamri inashe machteva gelala baza raggala bechavreh yada
I hachi zecharim minnekevot la nizbon dechayeshinan dilma marbea leh ilavah kevan demigare bah miratta
Ella ha detane rav yosef armalta la terabbe kalba vela tashre bar be rav beushpiza bishlama bar be rav tzenia lah ella kalba kevan demigare bah miratta
Kevan dechi shadya leh umtza umisserich abbatrah memar amri inashe hay demisserich abbatrah mishshum umtza deka misserich
Nekevot etzel nekevot may tama la meyachadinan amar mar ukva bar chama mippene shehaggoyim metzuyin etzel neshe chavrehen ufamim sheeno motzah umotze et habbehema verovah

Veibaet ema afilu motzah name rovah deamar mar chaviva alehen behemtan shel yisrael yoter minneshotehen deamar rabbi yochanan beshaa shebba nachash al chava hetil bah zuhama i hachi yisrael name yisrael sheamdu al har sinay paska zuhamatan goyim shello amdu al har sinay lo paska zuhamatan

Ibaya lehu ofot may ta shema deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi chanina ani raiti goy shellakach avaz min hashshuk revaah chanakah tzelaah vaachalah veamar rabbi yirmeya middifti ani raiti arvi echad shellakach yarech min hashshuk vechakak bah kede revia revaah tzelaah vaachalah

a: Ravina amar la kashya ha lechattechilla ha diavad

Umna temra deshane ben lechattechilla ben lediavad ditnan lo tityached ishsha immahem mippene shechashudin al haaraot urminhu haishsha shennechbesha bide goyim al yede mamon mutteret levalah al yede nefashot asura levalah
Ella lav shema minah shane lan ben lechattechilla lediavad mimmay dilma leolam ema lach afilu diavad name la vehacha hayenu tama demityare mishshum hefsed mamono
Teda dekatane sefa al yede nefashot asura levalah vetu la midi

Rabbi pedat amar la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ha rabbanan ditnan gabbe parat chattat rabbi eliezer omer enah nikkachat min haggoyim vachachamim mattirin may lav beha kamipalgi derabbi eliezer savar chayeshinan lirvia verabbanan savri la chayeshinan lirvia

Mimmay dilma dechulle alma la chayeshinan lirvia vehacha hayenu tama derabbi eliezer kidrav yehuda amar rav deamar rav yehuda amar rav hinniach alehen aleha udda shel sakkin pesalah uvegla ad shettimshoch bah
Mar savar chayeshinan umar savar la chayeshinan la salka datach mishshum nicha purta la mafsed tuva
Hachi name lema mishshum hanaa purta la mafsed tuva hatam yitzro tokfo

Vedilma dechulle alma la chayeshinan lirvia vehacha hayenu tama derabbi eliezer kidtane shela detane shela may tama derabbi eliezer dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu elecha bene yisrael yikchu veen haggoyim yikchu

La salka datach dekatane sefa vechen haya rabbi eliezer posel bechol hakkarbanot kullan vei salka datach kidtane shela bishlama para ketiv bah kicha ella kullehu korbanot kicha ketiv behu vedilma ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer
b: Ella befara dedameha yekarin aval bishar korbenot modu leh
Veella ha detanya lokchin mehen behema lekorban manni la rabbi eliezer vela rabbanan
Veod tanya behedya may otivu leh chavrohi lerabbi eliezer kol tzon kedar yikkavtzu lach yaalu leratzon al mizbechi
Ad kan la peligi ella bachashasha aval hecha devadday ravah paslah shema minah defara kodshe mizbeach hi dei kodshe bedek habbayit mi mafsela bah revia
Shane para dechattat karyah rachamana
Ella meatta tipasel beotze dofen vechi tema hachi name allema tanya hikdishah beotze dofen pesula verabbi shimon machshir
Vechi tema rabbi shimon letameh deamar yotze dofen valad mealleya hu vehaamar rabbi yochanan mode haya rabbi shimon leinyan kadashim sheeno kadosh

Ella shane para hoil umum posel bah devar erva vaavoda zara name posel bah dichtiv ki moshchatam bahem mum bam vetana deve rabbi yishmael kal makom shenneemar hashchata eno ella devar erva vaavoda zara
Devar erva dichtiv ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz vaavoda zara dichtiv pen tashchitun vaasitem lachem pesel veha para name hoil umum posel bah devar erva vaavoda zara pasli bah

Gufa tane shela may tama derabbi eliezer dichtiv dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu bene yisrael yikchu veen haggoyim yikchu ella meatta dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu li teruma hachi name divne yisrael yikchu veen haggoyim yikchu

Vechi tema hachi name vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel shaalu et rabbi eliezer ad hechan kibud av vaem amar lahem tzeu uru ma asa goy echad leaviv beashkelon vedama ben netina shemo paam achat bikkeshu mimmennu avanim laefod

a: Beshishshim ribbo sachar rav kahana matne bishmonim ribbo vehau maftechot munnachot tachat meraashotav shel aviv velo tzaaro
Avne shoham hifsik hainyan veha veavne milluim ketiv dahadar arveh

Veod katane sefa leshana acheret nolda lo para adumma beedro nichnesu chachme yisrael etzlo amar lahem yodea ani bachem sheim ani mevakkesh mikkem kol mamon shebbaolam attem notnin li achshav eni mevakkesh mikkem ella oto mamon shehifsadti bishvil abba
Hatam al yede taggare yisrael zevun
Verabbi eliezer la chayesh lirvia

Vehatanya amru lo lerabbi eliezer maase ulkachuha min haggoy vedama shemo veamri lah remetz shemo amar lahen rabbi eliezer mishsham reaya yisrael hau meshammerin otah mishshaa shennolda rabbi eliezer tarte it leh kicha vechayesh name lirvia

Amar mar yisrael hau meshammerin otah mishshaa shennolda venechush dilma ravi leimmah ki hava meabbera deamar rava velad hannogachat asura hi uveladah nagchu velad hannirbaat asura hi uveladah nirbeu ema yisrael hau meshammerin otah mishshaa shennotzra
Venechush dilma ravuha leimmah meikara ditnan kol happesulin legabbe mizbeach valdotehen muttarin vetane alah rabbi eliezer oser
Hanicha lerava deamar rava amar rav nachman machloket keshennirbeu keshehen mukdashin aval keshehen chullin divre hakkol muttarin
Ella lerav huna bar chinana amar rav nachman machloket keshennirbeu keshehen chullin aval keshehen mukdashin divre hakkol asurin may ika lememar
Ema yisrael hau meshammerin otah leimmah mishshaa shennotzra venechush dilma ravuha leimma deimmah kulle hay la chayeshinan
Amar mar yisrael hau meshammerin otah mishshaa shennotzra mena yadinan amar rav kahana kos adom maavirin lefaneha beshaa sheole aleha zachar
I hachi ammay dameha yekarin hoil ushte searot poslot bah umay shena didhu amar rav kahana bemuchzeket
Yatev rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha akkila derabbi yitzchak nappacha petach chad minayehu vaamar vechen haya rabbi eliezer posel bechol hakkarbanot kullan
Petach idach minayehu veamar may otivu leh chavrohi lerabbi eliezer kol tzon kedar yikkavtzu lach vego amar lahen rabbi eliezer kullam gerim gerurim hem leatid lavo
Amar rav yosef may kera ki az ehpoch el ammim safa verura vego amar leh abbaye vedilma meavoda zara hu dahadur behu amar leh rav yosef leovdo shechem echad ketiv

Rav pappa matne hachi verav zevid matne hachi vetarvayehu amri vechen haya rabbi eliezer posel bechol hakkarbanot vetarvayehu amri umay otivu leh chavrohi lerabbi eliezer kol tzon kedar yikkavtzu lach vego amar rabbi eliezer kullam gerim gerurim hem leatid lavo
Umay keraa ki az ehpoch el ammim safa verura likro chullam beshem Adonai matkef lah rav yosef vedilma meavoda zara hu dehadri behu amar leh abbaye leovdo shechem echad ketiv
Metivi vayyomer moshe gam atta titten beyadenu zevachim veolot kodem mattan tora shane
Ta shema vayyikkach yitro choten moshe ola uzvachim lelohim yitro name kodem mattan tora hava hanicha leman deamar yitro kodem mattan tora hava ella leman deamar
b: Yitro leachar mattan tora hava may ika lememar ella yitro miyyisrael zevan
Ta shema vayyomer shaul meamaleki hevium asher chamal haam al metav hatztzon vehabbakar hammishnim vehakkarim veal kol hatztzon lemaan zevoach la elohecha may metav deme metav
Umay shena metav ki hechi delikpotz alayehu zavona
Ta shema vayyomer aravena el david yikkach veyaal adoni hammelech et hattov beeno veet ree habbakar laola vehammoriggim uchle habbakar laetzim amar rav nachman aravena ger toshav haya

May moriggim amar ulla mitta shel turbil may mitta shel turbil iza dekurkesa dedayeshan amar rav yosef may kera hinne samtich lemorag charutz chadash baal pifiyyot tadush harim vetadok ugvaot kammotz tasim
Metivi veet happarot heelu ola la horaat shaa hayeta
Hachi name mistabbera dei la tema hachi ola nekeva mi ika
Umay kushya dilma bevamat yachid vechidrav adda bar ahava deamar rav adda bar ahava minnayin leola nekeva shehi keshera bevamat yachid shenneemar vayyikkach shemuel tele chalav echad vayyaalehu ola
Vayyaalehu zachar mashma amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vayyaaleha ketiv
Rabbi yochanan amar gevul yesh lah pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim neekeret bat shalosh shanim enah neekeret
Etiveh kol hane teuvata shanni lehu pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim ta shema veet happarot heelu ola la bifchuta mibbat shalosh shanim
Matkef lah rav huna bereh derav natan im ken hayenu veet benehem kalu vabbayit pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim
Ufchuta mibbat shalosh shanim mi ka yalda vehatanya para vachamor mibbat shalosh vadday lakkohen mikkan veelach safek ella mechavarta kidshannin meikara

Vayyishsharna happarot badderech al derech bet shemesh vego may vayyishsharna amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir sheamru shira verav zutra bar toviyya amar rav sheyyishsheru penehem keneged aron veamru shira
Umay shira amru amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir az yashir moshe uvne yisrael verabbi yochanan dideh amar vaamartem bayyom hahu hodu la kiru vishmo vego
Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar mizmora yatma mizmor shiru la shir chadash ki niflaot asa hoshia lo yemino uzroa kodsho rabbi elazar amar Adonai malach yirgezu ammim

Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar Adonai malach geut lavesh rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar ronni ronni hashshita hitnoffi berov hadarech hamchushsheket berikme zahav hamhullala bidvir armon umfoara baadi adayim
Rav ashe matne lah leha derabbi yitzchak aha vayehi binsoa haaron vayyomer moshe kuma Adonai yisrael may amru amar rabbi yitzchak ronni ronni hashshita vechu
Amar rav keman karu parsae lesafra devir mehacha veshem devir lefanim kiryat sefer
Rav ashe amar keman karu parsae lenida dashtana mehacha ki derech nashim li

a: Vayyiddom hashshemesh veyareach amad ad yikkom goy oyevav halo hi chetuva al sefer hayyashar may sefer hayyashar amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan ze sefer avraham yitzchak veyaakov shennikreu yesharim shenneemar tamot nafshi mot yesharim
Vehecha remiza vezaro yihye melo haggoyim ematay yihye melo haggoyim beshaa sheamda lo chamma lihoshua vayyaamod hashshemesh bachatzi hashshamayim velo atz lavo keom tamim
Vechamma amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi esrim vearba shae azal shet vekam shet azal shet vekam shet kullah milleta keom tamim

Rabbi elazar amar sheloshim veshet azal shet vekam teresar azal shet vekam teresar amidato keom tamim rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar arbaim ushmona azal shet vekam teresar azal shet vekam esrim vearbea shenneemar velo atz lavo keom tamim mikkelal demeikara lav keom tamim hava

Ika deamri betosefta peligi rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar esrim vearbea azal shet vekam teresar azal shet vekam teresar amidato keom tamim rabbi elazar amar sheloshim vashesh azal shet vekam teresar azal shet vekam esrim vearbea velo atz lavo keom tamim
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar arbaim ushmona azal shet vekam esrim vearbea azal shet vekam esrim vearbea makkish amidato leviato ma biato keom tamim af amidato keom tamim

Tana keshem sheamda lo chamma lihoshua kach amda lo chamma lemoshe ulnakdimon ben guron yehoshua kerae nakdimon ben guron gemara lemoshe menalan atya achel achel ketiv hacha achel tet pachdecha uchtiv hatam bihoshua achel gaddelcha
Verabbi yochanan amar atya tet tet ketiv hacha achel tet pachdecha uchtiv bihoshua beom tet Adonai et haemori
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar miggufeh dikra shamatte leh asher yishmeun shimacha veragzu vechalu mippanecha ematay ragzu vechalu mippanecha beshaa sheamda lo chamma lemoshe

Metivi velo haya kayyom hahu lefanav veacharav ibaet ema shaot hu dela hao nefishan kulle hay veibaet ema avne varad la hao dichtiv vayehi benusam mippene bene yisrael hem bemorad bet choron va hishlich alehem avanim gedolot min hashshamayim ad azeka vayyamutu

Ketiv vayyomer lelammed bene yehuda kashet hinne chetuva al sefer hayyashar may sefer hayyashar amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan ze sefer avraham yitzchak veyaakov shennikreu yesharim dichtiv behu tamot nafshi mot yesharim uthi achariti kamohu
Vehecha remiza yehuda atta yoducha achecha yadcha beoref oyevecha veezo hi milchama shetztzericha yad keneged oref heve omer zo keshet

Rabbi elazar omer ze sefer mishne tora veammay karu leh sefer hayyashar dichtiv veasita hayyashar vehattov beene Adonai vehecha remiza yadav rav lo veezo hi milchama shetztzericha shette yadayim heve omer zo keshet

Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar ze sefer shoftim veammay karu leh sefer hayyashar dichtiv bayyamim hahem en melech beyisrael ish hayyashar beenav yaase vehecha remiza lemaan daat dorot bene yisrael lelammedam milchama veezo hi milchama shetztzericha limud heve omer zo keshet
Umnalan devihuda ketiv dichtiv mi yaale lanu vattechilla el hakkenaani lehillachem bo vayyomer Adonai yehuda yaale
Vayyarem hattabbach et hashshok vehealeha vayyasem lifne shaul may vehealeha rabbi yochanan omer shok vealya may vehealeha dimsammecha shok lealya
Verabbi elazar omer shok vechaze may vehealeha demachet leh lechaze ilaveh deshok ki vae onofe umonfi leh verabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar shok veshofi may vehealeha shofi ilaveh deshok kae
Lo tityached ishsha immahem bemay askinan ilema bechad dichvatah gabbe yisrael mi shere vehatnan lo yityached ish echad im shette nashim
b: Ella bitlata dichvatah gabbe yisrael bifrutzim mi shere vehatnan aval ishsha achat mityachedet im shene anashim veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella bichsherim aval bifrutzim afilu asara name la maase haya vehotziuha asara bemitta
La tzericha beishto immo goy en ishto meshammarto aval yisrael ishto meshammarto
Vetipok leh mishshum shefichut damim amar rabbi yirmeya beishsha chashuva askinan demiratti minah rav idi amar ishsha kele zayenah aleha
May benayehu ika benayehu ishsha chashuva ben anashim vesheenah chashuva ben hannashim
Tanya kevateh derav idi bar avin haishsha af al pi shehashshalom immah lo tityached immahen mippene shechashudin al haaraot
Lo yityached adam immahen tanu rabbanan yisrael shennizdammen lo goy badderech toflo limino rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer besayif toflo limino bemakkel toflo lismolo
Hau olin bemaale o yordin birida lo yehe yisrael lematta vegoy lemala ella yisrael lemala vegoy lematta veal yashuach lefanav shemma yarotz et gulgolto
Shealo lehechan holech yarchiv lo et hadderech kederech sheasa yaakov avinu leesav harasha dichtiv ad asher avo el adoni seira
Uchtiv veyaakov nasa sukkota

Maase betalmide rabbi akiva shehau holchim lichziv pagu bahen listim amru lahen lean attem holchim amru lahen leakko kevan shehiggiu lichziv pershu amru lahen talmide mi attem amru lahen talmide rabbi akiva amru lahen ashre rabbi akiva vetalmidav shello paga bahen adam ra meolam
Rav menashshe hava azel

a: Leve torta pegau beh gannave amaru leh lean kaazlatte amar lahen lefumbedita ki meta leve torta paresh amaru leh talmida dihuda rammaa atte amar lehu yaditu leh yehe raava deliho hanhu inashe beshamteh

Azalu avadu genevata esrin vetarten shenin vela atzlachu kevan dachazo ato kullehu tevau shamtayehu vahava behu chad girdena dela ata lesharoye shammeteh achleh arya hayenu deamri inashe girdana dela tayezan shatta betzira mishsheneh
Ta chazi ma ben gannave vavel velistin deeretz yisrael

Matni bat yisrael lo teyaled et hannochrit mippene shemmeyalledet ben laavoda zara aval nochrit meyalledet bat yisrael bat yisrael lo tanik benah shel nochrit aval nochrit menika benah shel yisrael birshutah
Gema tanu rabbanan bat yisrael lo teyaled et hannochrit mippene shemmeyalledet ben laavoda zara venochrit lo teyaled et bat yisrael mippene shechashudin al shefichut damim divre rabbi meir

Vachachamim omrim nochrit meyalledet et bat yisrael bizman sheacherot omdot al gabbah aval lo benah levenah verabbi meir omer afilu acherot omdot al gabbah name la dezimnin demannecha leh yeda appute vekatla leh vela mitchaze
Ki hahi itta daamara lachavertah molda yehudayyata bat molda yehudayyata amara lah nefishin bishata dehahi itta deka mashpelna minayehu dema ki ufya denahara
Verabbanan amaru lach la hi bemilta bealma hu deokemtah

Bat yisrael lo tanik tanu rabbanan bat yisrael lo tanik benah shel nochrit mippene shemmegaddelet ben laavoda zara venochrit lo tanik et benah shel bat yisrael mippene shechashuda al shefichut damim divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim nochrit menika et benah shel bat yisrael bizman sheacherot omdot al gabbah aval lo beno levenah verabbi meir omer afilu acherot omdot al gabbah name la dezimnin deshayefa leh samma ledad meabbaray vekatla leh
Utzricha dei ashmeinan meyalledet behahi kaamri rabbanan dishre dela efshar mishshum daacherot root otah aval menika deefshar deshayefa leh sam ledad meabbaray vekatla leh ema mode leh lerabbi meir

Vei ashmeinan menika behahi kaamar rabbi meir deasur mishshum deshayefa leh sam ledad meabbaray vekatla leh aval meyalledet dela efshar hecha daacherot omdot al gabbah ema mode lehu lerabbanan tzericha
Urminhu yehudit meyalledet arammit besachar aval lo bechinnam amar rav yosef besachar shere mishshum eva

Savar rav yosef lememar olode nochrit beshabbeta besachar shere mishshum eva amar leh abbaye yachla lememar lah didan dimnatteri shabbeta mechallelinan alayehu didchu dela menatteri shabbeta la mechallelinan
Savar rav yosef lememar onoke besachar shere mishshum eva amar leh abbaye yachla lememar i penuya hi baena leinsove i eshet ish hi la ka mizdahamna beappe gavray
Savar rav yosef lememar ha detanya haggoyim veroe behema dakka lo maalin velo moridin assoke besachar shere mishshum eva
Amar leh abbaye yachol lomar lo kae beri aigara i name nekita li zimna leve davar
Tane rabbi avahu kammeh derabbi yochanan haggoyim veroe behema dakka lo maalin
b: Velo moridin aval hamminin vehammasorot vehamshummadim moridin velo maalin
Amar leh ani shone lechol avedat achicha lerabbot et hamshummad veatte amratte moridin semi mikkan meshummad
Velishanne leh kan bimshummad ochel nevelot leteavon kan bimshummad ochel nevelot lehachis kasavar ochel nevelot lehachis min hu
Itmar meshummad peligi rav acha veravina chad amar leteavon meshummad lehachis min have vechad amar afilu lehachis name meshummad ella ezehu min ze haoved avoda zara
Metivi achal parosh echad o yattush echad hare ze meshummad veha hacha dilhachis hu vekatane meshummad hatam bae lemitam tama deisura

Amar mar moridin aval lo maalin hashta achote machatinan assoke mibe amar rav yosef bar chama amar rav sheshet lo nitzrecha sheim hayeta maala babbor megarrah denaket leh ila veamar la techot cheveta illaveh
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu lo nitzrecha sheim hayeta even al pi habbeer mechassah amar leabbore chayyuta ilavah ravina amar sheim haya sullam mesalleko amar baena leachote beri meigara
Tanu rabbanan yisrael mal et haggoy leshum ger leappoke leshum murna dela vegoy lo yamul yisrael mippene shechashudin al shefichut damim divre rabbi meir

Vachachamim omrim goy mal et yisrael bizman sheacherim omdin al gabbo aval beno leveno la verabbi meir omer afilu acherim omdim al gabbo name la dezimnin dematzle leh sakkina umshave leh kerut shofcha
Vesavar rabbi meir goy la urminhu ir sheen bah rofe yisrael veyesh bah rofe kuti verofe armay yamul armay veal yamul kuti divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer yamul kuti veal yamul armay
Efoch rabbi meir omer yamul kuti velo armay rabbi yehuda omer armay velo kuti
Vesavar rabbi yehuda armay shappir dame vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer minnayin lemila begoy shehi pesula shenneemar veatta et beriti tishmor
Ella leolam la tefoch vehacha bemay askinan

a: Berofe mumche dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan im haya mumche lerabbim muttar
Vesavar rabbi yehuda kuti shappir dame vehatanya yisrael mal et hakkuti vechuti lo yamul yisrael mippene shemmal leshem har gerizim divre rabbi yehuda
Amar lo rabbi yose vechi hechan matzinu mila min hattora lishmah ella mal veholech ad shettetze nishmato
Ella leolam efoch kidafchinan meikara udka kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda hahi derabbi yehuda hannasi hi
Detanya rabbi yehuda hannasi omer minnayin lemila begoy shehi pesula talmud lomar veatta et beriti tishmor
Amar rav chisda may tama derabbi yehuda dichtiv la himmol verabbi yose himmol yimmol
Veidach hachtiv la himmol hahu befesach ketiv veidach name hachtiv himmol yimmol dibbera tora chilshon bene adam
Itmar minnayin lemila begoy shehi pesula daru bar pappa mishshemeh derav amar veatta et beriti tishmor verabbi yochanan himmol yimmol
May benayehu arvi mahul vegavnuni mahul ika benayehu man deamar himmol yimmol ika uman deamar et beriti tishmor leka
Ulman deamar himmol yimmol ika vehatnan kunnam sheani nehene min haarelim muttar bearle yisrael veasur bemule ummot haolam alma af al gav dimhili keman dela mehili damu
Ella ika benayehu yisrael shemmetu echav mechamat mila velo maluhu leman deamar veatta et beriti tishmor ika leman deamar himmol yimmol leka
Ulman deamar himmol yimmol leka vehatnan kunnam sheani nehene mimmulim asur bearle yisrael umuttar bemule ummot haolam alma af al gav dela mehili keman dimhili damu
Ella ika benayehu ishsha leman deamar veatta et beriti tishmor leka deishsha lav bat mila hi ulman deamar himmol yimmol ika deishsha keman dimhila damya

Umi ika leman deamar ishsha la vehachtiv vattikkach tzippora tzor keri beh vattakkach vehachtiv vattichrot keri beh vattachret deamra leinish acharina vaavad veibaet ema atay ihi veatchila vaata moshe veagmerah
Matni mitrappein mehen ripuy mamon aval lo ripuy nefashot veen mistapperin mehen bechol makom divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim birshut harabbim muttar aval lo beno leveno
Gema may ripuy mamon umay ripuy nefashot ilema ripuy mamon besachar ripuy nefashot bechinnam litne mitrappein mehen besachar aval lo bechinnam
Ella ripuy mamon davar sheen bo sakkana ripuy nefashot davar sheyyesh bo sakkana vehaamar rav yehuda afilu rivda dechusilta la mittassenan minayehu
Ella ripuy mamon behemto ripuy nefashot gufeh vehayenu deamar rav yehuda afilu rivda dechusilta la mittassenan minayehu
Amar rav chisda amar mar ukva aval im amar lo sam peloni yafe lo sam peloni ra lo muttar
b: Savar shayyole meshael lo ki hechi demashil lo meshael leinish acharina vaata hahu gavra leoroe nafsheh
Amar rava amar rabbi yochanan veamri lah amar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan safek chay safek met en mitrappein mehen vadday met mitrappein mehen
Met haika chayye shaa lechayye shaa la chayeshinan
Umna temra dilchayye shaa la chayeshinan dichtiv im amarnu navo hair veharaav bair vamatnu sham vehaika chayye shaa ella lav lechayye shaa la chayeshinan
Metivi lo yissa veyitten adam im hamminin veen mitrappein mehen afilu lechayye shaa

Maase beven dama ben achoto shel rabbi yishmael shehikkisho nachash uva yaakov ish kefar sechanya lerappooto velo hinnicho rabbi yishmael veamar lo rabbi yishmael achi hannach lo veerafe mimmennu vaani avi mikra min hattora shehu muttar velo hispik ligmor et haddavar ad sheyyatzta nishmato vamet
Kara alav rabbi yishmael ashrecha ben dama sheggufcha tahor veyatzta nishmatcha betohora velo avarta al divre chaverecha shehau omrim uforetz gader yishshechennu nachash
Shane minut demashcha deate lemimshach batrayehu
Amar mar lo avarta al divre chaverecha shehau omrim uforetz gader yishshechennu nachash ihu name chiveya tarkeh chiveya derabbanan delet leh asuta kelal
Umay hava leh lememar vechay bahem velo sheyyamut bahem

Verabbi yishmael hane mile betzina aval befarhesya la detanya haya rabbi yishmael omer minnayin sheim omrim lo laadam avod avoda zara veal tehareg sheyyaavod veal yehareg talmud lomar vechay bahem velo sheyyamut bahem yachol afilu befarhesya talmud lomar velo techallelu et shem kodshi
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol makka shemmechallelin aleha et hashshabbat en mitrappein mehen veika deamri amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol

a: Makka shel chalal en mitrappein mehen may benayehu ika benayehu gav hayyad vegav haregel deamar rav adda bar matna amar rav gav hayyad vegav haregel hare hen kemakka shel chalal umchallelin alehen et hashshabbat

Amar rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav kol makka shetztzericha omed mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat amar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan vehay ishata tzemirta kemakka shel chalal dame umchallelin aleha et hashshabbat
Mehechan makka shel chalal peresh rabbi amme min hassafa velifnim bae rabbi eliezer kakke veshine may kevan daakushe ninhu kemakka devarae damu o dilma kevan degavae kayemi kemakka shel chalal damu
Amar abbaye ta shema hachoshesh beshinav lo yegammea bahen et hachometz choshesh hu dela ha kaev leh tuva shappir dame dilma tanna hecha dechaev leh tuva choshesh name kare leh

Ta shema rabbi yochanan chash betzafdina azal legabbah dehahi matronita avada chamsha umaale shabbeta amar lah lemachar may amara leh la tzerichatte i tzerichna may amara ishteva li dela megallet ishteva lah lelaha yisrael la megallena galliyah leh limchar nefak darshah befirka
Veha ishteva lah lelaha deyisrael la megallena aval leammeh yisrael megallena vehaika chilul hashshem degalli lah meikara
Alma kemakka shel chalal damya amar rav nachman bar yitzchak shane tzafdina hoil umatchil befe vegomer bivne meayim

May simaneh rame mide be chakke umayete dema mibbe dare mimmay have mikkarire karire dechite umechammime chammime disare umishshiyyure kasa deharsana may avada leh amar rabbi acha bereh derava me seor veshemen zayit vamelach umar bar rav ashe amar mishcha daavaza begadpa daavaza
Amar abbaye ana avadi kullehu vela itassay ad daamar li hahu tayyaa ayeti kashyata dezeta dela melo tilta uklinhu ammara chadta vedabbek beh abbe dedarech avadi hachi veitassay
Verabbi yochanan hechi aved hachi vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol makka shemmechallelin aleha et hashshabbat en mitrappein mehen adam chashuv shane
Veha rabbi avahu deadam chashuv hava urma leh yaakov minaa samma ashshakeh vei la rabbi amme verabbi assi delachachuh leshakeh paskeh leshakeh
Derabbi yochanan rofe mumche hava derabbi avahu name rofe mumche hava shane rabbi avahu demokmi beh mine benafshayehu tamot nafshi im pelishtim
Amar shemuel hay pedata sakkanta hi umchallelin aleha et hashshabbat may asuta lemifsak dema tachle bechalla leassoke girda deyavla vegirda daasanna o nikra mikkilkalta
Amar rav safra hay inbeta parvanka demalacha demota hi may asuta tigna beduvsha o karpesa betilya addehachi vehachi layete inbeta bat mina venigandar ilavah chivarti lechivarti veukkamti leukkamti
Amar rava hay simta parvanka deishshata hi may asute limchayeh shitin itkutle velikreeh sheti vaerev vehane mile dela chivar resheh aval chivar resheh let lan bah
Rabbi yaakov chash
b: Befika ori leh rabbi amme veamri lah rabbi assi ori leh layete shav bine ahala tolana vetzayar leh bachalala deve tzavvera velichrich ilaveh nira barka vetamesh leh benitfa chivara velikleyeh uvadar leh ilaveh addehachi vehachi layete kashyata daasanna lanach pika lahade pika
Vehane mile pika ilaa pika tattaa may layete tarba ditzfirta dela ippetach velifashshar velishde beh
Vei la layete telat tarfe kara dimyabshi betulla velikle velivaddar ilaveh vei la layete meshakkede chelzone vei la mayete meshach kira velinkot beshachke dechitana bekayeta vedaamar gufna besitva

Rabbi avahu chash beudneh ori leh rabbi yochanan veamri lah be midresha may ori leh ki ha deamar abbaye amara li em la ibray kulyeta ella leudna veamar rava amar li minome asya kullehu shakyanu shakyane kashu leudna levar mimmayya dechulyeta layete kulyeta devarcha karcha velikreah sheti vaerev velanach ammillela denura vehanhu mayya denafki mineh lishdinhu beudneh la karire vela chammime ella pashore

Vei la layete tarba dechipushta gamlanita velifashshar velishde beh vei la lemalleyeh leudneh mishcha velebed shav petilata deaspasta velayete shufta detuma velotev barka bechad resha velitle behu nura veidach resha motevo beudna velotev udneh lehada nura veyizdehar mizzika venishkol chada venannach chada
Lishana acharina vei la layete shav petilata bikra veshayef leh mishcha deaspasta venayete chad resha benura vechad resha beudneh venishkol chada venannach chada veyizdehar mizzika

Vei la layete udra denada dela meshakkef venannach bah velitleyyah leudneh lahade nura umizdehar mizzika vei la layete guvta dekanya attika bar mea shenin velimlecheh milcha gelalnita velikle velidabbek vesimanach rattiva leyabbishta veyabbishta lerattiva
Amar rabba bar zutra amar rabbi chanina maalin oznayim beshabbat tane rav shemuel bar yehuda bayyad aval lo besam ika deamri besam aval lo bayyad may tama mizraf zaref

Amar rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav ayin shemmarda muttar lechochlah beshabbat sevur mineh hane mile hu dishchiki sammanin meetmol aval mishchak beshabbat veetoye derech reshut harabbim la amar leh hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh ledidi miparsha mineh derav yehuda afilu mishchak beshabbat veetoye derech reshut harabbim muttar
Rav yehuda shera lemichchal ena beshabbat amar lehu rav shemuel bar yehuda man tzayet lihuda machel shabbe lesof chash beeneh shelach leh shere o asir shelach leh lechulle alma shere ledidach asir

Vechi middidi hu demar shemuel hi hahi amta dahavay be mar shemuel dikdacha lah ena beshabbeta tzevacha veleka deashgach bah pekaa ena limchar nefak mar shemuel udrash ayin shemmarda muttar lechochlah beshabbat may tama deshuryane deena beovanta deliba telu
Kegon may amar rav yehuda kegon rira ditza dema dimata vekidcha utchillat uchla leappoke sof uchla ufatztzoche ena dela

Amar rav yehuda zibura udcharzeh silva vesimta udchaev leh ena veate ilaveh ishata kullehu be vane sakkanta chamma lechamma vesilka letzina vechilufa sakkanta chammime leakrabba vekarire lezibura vechilufa sakkanta chammime lesilva vekarire

a: Lechaspanita vechilufa sakkanta
Challa lesibure umonine letaanita vechilufa sakkanta tachle vesibura sakkanta ishata vesibura sakkanta keev ena vesibure sakkanta sheni laddag dam sheni laddam dag shelishi lo sakkanta

Tanu rabbanan hammakkiz dam lo yochal lo chalav velo gevina velo betzalim velo shachalayim im achal amar abbaye nayete reviata dechalla urviata dechamra unarbevinhu bahade hadade venishte vechi mippene la mippene ella lemizrachah shel ir mishshum dekashe recha
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi maalin unkele beshabbat may unkele amar rabbi abba istumcha deliba may asuta mayete kammona kervayya veninya veagdana vetzitri veavdata
Leliba bechamra vesimanach veyayin yesammach levav enosh lerucha bemayya vesimanach veruach elohim merachefet al pene hammayim lechuda beshichra vesimanach vechaddah al shichmah

Rav acha bereh derava shachek lehu lechullehu bahade hadade veshakel leh mele chamesh etzbeateh veshate leh rav ashe shachek kol chad vechad lechodeh veshakel mele etzbeeh rabbati umle etzbeeh zutarti amar rav pappa ana avadi lechol hane vela itassay ad daamar li hahu tayyaa ayeti kuza chadta umalleyeh mayya urmi beh tarvada deduvsha ditle leh be chochve velimchar ishti avadi hachi veitassay

Tanu rabbanan shishsha devarim merappein et hachole mecholo urfuatan refua veellu hen keruv utradin ume sisin yevesha vekevat yeveshin vekeva veheret veoteret hakkaved veyesh omrim af dagim ketannim vela od ella sheddagim ketannim mafrin umarbin kol gufo shel adam

Asara devarim machzirin et hachole lecholo vecholo kashe ellu hen haochel besar shor shomen besar tzali besar tziporim uvetza tzeluya veshachalayim vetiglachat umerchatz ugvina vechaved veyesh omrim af egozim veyesh omrim af kishshuin tana deve rabbi yishmael lamma nikra sheman kishshuin mippene shehen kashin lechol gufo shel adam kacharavot
Veen mistapperin mehen bechol makom tanu rabbanan yisrael hammistapper miggoy roe bammara vegoy hammistapper miyyisrael kevan shehiggia livlorito shomet et yado
Amar mar yisrael hammistapper miggoy roe bammara hechi dame i birshut harabbim lema li mara vei birshut hayyachid ki roe may have leolam birshut hayyachid vechevan deika mara mitchaze keadam chashuv
Rav chana bar bizna hava mistapper miggoy bishvile dinhardea amar leh chana chana yae koach lezuga amar tete li daavari adderabbi meir
Veadderabbanan la avar emar daamur rabbanan birshut harabbim birshut hayyachid mi amur vehu savar shevile dinhardea kevan dishchichi rabbim kirshut harabbim damu
Vegoy hammistapper miyyisrael kevan shehiggia livlorito shomet et yado vechamma amar rav malkiyya amar rav adda bar ahava shalosh etzbaot lechol ruach varuach
Amar rav chanina bereh derav ika shappud shefachot vegumot rav malkiyyo belorit efer mikle ugvina rav malkiyya
Amar rav pappa matnitin umatnita rav malkiyya shematata rav malkiyyo vesimanach matnita malketa may benayehu ika benayehu shefachot
b: Matni ellu devarim shel goyim asurin veisuran isur hanaa hayyayin vehachometz shel goyim shehaya mittechillato yayin vecheres hadreyani veorot levuvin rabban shimon ben gamliel omer bizman shehakkera shello agol asur mashuch muttar
Basar hannichnas laavoda zara muttar vehayyotze asur mippene shehu kezivche metim divre rabbi akiva haholchin lattarput asur laset velatet immahen vehabbain muttarin

Nodot haggoyim vekankannehen veyayin shel yisrael kanus bahen asurin veisuran isur hanaa divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim en isuran isur hanaa hachartzannim vehazzaggin shel goyim asurin veisuran isur hanaa divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim lachin asurin yeveshin muttarin
Hammuryas ugvinat bet unyaki shel goyim asurin veisuran isur hanaa divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim en isuran isur hanaa
Amar rabbi yehuda shaal rabbi yishmael et rabbi yehoshua keshehau mehallechin badderech amar lo mippene ma asru gevinot goyim amar lo mippene shemmaamidin otah bekeva shel nevela
Amar lo vahalo kevat ola chamura mikkevat nevela amru kohen sheddato yafa sorfa chayya velo hodu lo aval amru en nehenin velo moalin
Amar lo mippene shemmaamidin otah bekevat egle avoda zara amar lo im ken lamma lo asaruha bahanaa
Hissio ledavar acher amar lo yishmael heach atta kore ki tovim dodecha miyyayin o ki tovim dodayicha
Amar lo ki tovim dodayicha amar lo en haddavar ken shehare chavero melammed alav lereach shemanecha tovim
Gema yayin menalan amar rabba bar avuh amar kera asher chelev zevachemo yochelu yishtu yen nesicham ma zevach asur bahanaa af yayin name asur bahanaa
Zevach gufeh menalan dichtiv vayyitztzamdu levaal peor vayyochlu zivche metim ma met asur bahanaa af zevach name asur bahanaa
Umet gufeh menalan atya sham sham meegla arufa ketiv hacha vattamot sham miryam uchtiv hatam vearfu sham et haegla bannachal ma lehallan asur bahanaa af kan name asur bahanaa
Vehatam menalan amri deve rabbi yannay kappara ketiv bah kekadashim

Vehachometz shel goyim shehaya mittechillato yayin peshita mishshum deachmetz peka leh isureh amar rav ashe ha ata leashmoinan chometz shellanu beyad goy en tzarich chotam betoch chotam i mishshum inassoche la menassechi vei mishshum ichallofe kevan deika chotam la tarach umzayyef

Amar rabbi ila shaninu yayin mevushshal shel goyim shehaya mittechillato yayin asur peshita mishshum deibashshil peka leh isureh amar rav ashe ha ata leashmoinan yayin mevushshal shellanu beyad goyim en tzarich chotam betoch chotam i mishshum inassoche la menassechi vei mishshum

a: Ichallofe kevan deika chotam echad la tarach umzayyef

Tanu rabbanan yayin mevushshal vaaluntit shel goyim asurin aluntit kivriyyatah mutteret veezo hi aluntit keditnan gabbe shabbat osin enomelin veen osin aluntit veezo hi enomelin veezo hi aluntit enomelin yayin udvash ufilpelin aluntit yayin yashan umayim tzelulin vaafarsemon deavdi leve massuta

Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu yayin mazug en bo mishshum giluy yayin mevushshal en bo mishshum nisuch ibaya lehu yayin mevushshal yesh bo mishshum giluy o en bo mishshum giluy ta shema heid rabbi yaakov bar idi al yayin mevushshal sheen bo mishshum giluy

Rabbi yannay bar yishmael chalash al legabbeh rabbi yishmael ben zerud verabbanan leshayyole beh yatvi veka mibbaya lehu yayin mevushshal yesh bo mishshum giluy o en bo mishshum giluy amar lehu rabbi yishmael ben zerud hachi amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum gavra rabba umannu rabbi chiyya yayin mevushshal en bo mishshum giluy amaru leh nismoch machve lehu rabbi yannay bar yishmael alay veal tzavari
Shemuel veavlet hao yatvi ayeto lekammayehu chamra mevashshela mashcheh lideh amar leh shemuel hare amru yayin mevushshal en bo mishshum yen nesech

Ammeteh derabbi chiyya igalliyy lah hahu chamra mevashshela atay lekammeh derabbi chiyya amar lah hare amru yayin mevushshal en bo mishshum giluy shammaeh derav adda bar ahava igalli leh chamra meziga amar leh hare amru yayin mazug en bo mishshum giluy

Amar rav pappa la amaran ella dimzig tuva aval mezig vela mezig shate umzig vela mezig mi shate veha rabba bar rav huna hava kaazel bearba vahava naket chamra bahadeh vechazyeh lehahu chiveya detzare veate amar leh leshammaeh sammi eneh deden shekel kalli mayya sheda beh vesar laachoreh
Achayya masar nafsheh ammeziga la mesar nafsheh

Veammeziga la masar nafsheh veha rabbi yannay hava be achbore veamri leh bar hedya hava be achbore hao yatvi vahao ka shatu chamra meziga pash lehu chamra bechuva utzrunhi bifronka vechazye lehahu chiveya dishkel mayya urma bechubba ad dimla bechubba uslek chamra ilave peronka veshate
Amri demazeg ihu shate demazgi acharine la shate

Amar rav ashe veitema rav mesharsheya peruka lesakkanta amar rava hilcheta yayin mazug yesh bo mishshum giluy veyesh bo mishshum yen nesech yayin mevushshal en bo mishshum giluy veen bo mishshum yen nesech

Shammaeh derav chilkiyya bar tovi igallay leh hahu kista demayya vahava nayem gabbah ata legabbeh derav chilkiyya bar tovi amar leh hare amru emat yashen alehen vehane mile bimama aval belelya la vela hi la shena bimama vela shena belelya emat yashen alehen la amrinan
Rav la shate mayya mibbe arammaa amar la zehiri begiluy mibbe armalta shate amar sircha degavra nekita

Shemuel la shate mayya mibbe armalta amar let lah emta degavra vela mechasseya mayya aval mibbe arammaa shate nehi deaggiluya la kafdi ammenakkeruta miha kafdi ika deamri rav la shate mayya mibbe arammaa aval mibbe armalta shate shemuel la shate mayya la mibbe arammaa vela mibbe armalta

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi shalosh yenot hen veen bahen mishshum giluy veellu hen chad mar matok chad tila charifa dimtzare zike mar yarnaka matok chulya rav chama matne leiluya chad chamar ufilpelin mar appesintin matok me barg

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish kerina en bo mishshum giluy may kerina amar rabbi avahu chamra chalya deate measya amar rava uvimkomo yesh bo mishshum giluy may tama chamar medina hu amar rava hay chamra deakrem ad telata yome yesh bo mishshum giluy umishshum yen nesech
b: Mikkan veelach en bo mishshum giluy veen bo mishshum yen nesech unhardae amri afilu levatar telata yome chayeshinan mishshum giluy may tama zimnin mikre shate

Tanu rabbanan yayin toses en bo mishshum giluy vechamma tesisato shelosha yamim hashshachalayim en bahem mishshum giluy uvne gola nahagu bahen isur vela amaran ella delet behu challa aval it behu challa migare behu

Kuttach habbavli en bo mishshum giluy uvne gola nahagu bo isur amar rav menashshe i it beh nikkure chayeshinan amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar shemuel me tif tif en bo mishshum giluy amar rav ashe vehu deaved tif lahade tif tif

Amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar shemuel pi teena en bo mishshum giluy keman ki hay tanna detanya rabbi eliezer omer ochel adam anavim utenim ballayela veeno choshesh mishshum shenneemar shomer petaim Adonai

Amar rav safra mishshum rabbi yehoshua daroma shelosha mine eres hen shel bachur shokea shel benoni mefapea veshel zaken tzaf lememra dichma dekashshish kechish cheleh vehatanya shelosha kol zeman shemmazkinin gevura mittosefet bahen ellu hen dag nachash vachazir koach osofe hu deka mosef zihareh kelish

Shel bachur shokea lemay hilcheta detanya chavit shennitgalleta af al pi sheshshatu mimmenna tisha velo metu lo yishte mimmenna asiri maase haya sheshshatu mimmennu tisha velo metu veshata asiri vamet amar rabbi yirmeya zehu shokea
Vechen avattiach shennitgalleta af al pi sheachlu mimmenna tisha bene adam velo metu lo yochal mimmenna asiri maase haya veachlu mimmenna tisha velo metu veachal asiri vamet amar rabbi zehu shokea

Tanu rabbanan mayim shennitgallu hare ze lo yishpechem birshut harabbim velo yerabbetz bahen et habbayit velo yegabbel bahen et hattit velo yashke mehen lo behemto velo behemat chavero velo yirchatz bahen panav yadav veraglav acherim omrim makom sheyyesh sirta asur en sirta muttar
Acherim hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu gav hayyad vegav haregel verummane deappe

Amar mar lo yashke mehen lo behemto velo behemat chavero vehatanya aval mashkehu levehemat atzmo ki tanya hahi leshunnara i hachi dechavreh name dechavreh kachesh dideh name kachesh hadar bare dechavreh name hadar bare zimnin devae lezabboneh umafsed leh mineh
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betera shelosha yenot hen yen nesech asur bahanaa umtamme tuma chamura bichzayit

a: Setam yenam asur bahanaa umtamme tumat mashkin birviit hammafkid yeno etzel goy asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaa
Vehatnan hammafkid perotav etzel goy hare hen keferotav shel goy lishviit ulmaaser kegon sheyyiched lo keren zavit
I hachi bishtiyya name lishtere deha rabbi yochanan ikkela lefarod amar kelum yesh mishnat bar kappara tena leh rabbi tanchum demin parod hammafkid yeno etzel goy muttar bishtiyya
Kare aleh mekom sheyyippol haetz sham yehu sham yehu salka datach ella sham yehu perotav
Amar rabbi zera la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ha rabbanan
Detanya echad hallokeach veechad hassocher bayit bachatzero shel goy umilleuhu yayin umafteach o chotam beyad yisrael rabbi eliezer mattir vachachamim osrin

Amar rabbi chiyya bereh derabbi chiyya bar nachmani amar rav chisda amar rav veamri lah amar rav chisda amar zeeri veamri lah amar rav chisda amar li abba bar chama hachi amar zeeri halacha kerabbi eliezer

Amar rabbi elazar hakkol mishtammer bechotam echad chutz min hayyayin sheen mishtammer bechotam echad verabbi yochanan amar afilu yayin mishtammer bechotam echad vela peligi ha kerabbi eliezer ha kerabbanan

Ika deamri amar rabbi elazar hakkol mishtammer bechotam betoch chotam chutz min hayyayin sheen mishtammer bechotam betoch chotam verabbi yochanan amar afilu yayin mishtammer bechotam betoch chotam vetarvayehu kerabbanan mar savar ki peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer bechotam echad aval bechotam betoch chotam sharu umar savar afilu chotam betoch chotam asri

Hechi dame chotam betoch chotam amar rava aggana defumma dechavita sherika vachatima have chotam betoch chotam vei la la dikula umihaddak have chotam betoch chotam la mihaddak la have chotam betoch chotam nod bedisakkayya chatimat piv lematta have chotam betoch chotam piv lemala la have chotam betoch chotam vechi kayif pummeh legav vetzayir vachatim have chotam betoch chotam

Tanu rabbanan barishona hau omrim yayin shel en kushi asur mippene birat serika veshel barkata asur mippene kefar parshay veshel zagdor asur mippene kefar shalem chazru lomar chaviyyot petuchot asurot setumot muttarot
Meikara may sevur ulvassof may sevur meikara sevur en kuti makpid al magga goy la shena petuchot vela shena setumot ulvassof sevur ki la kafed appetuchot assetumot mikpad kafed
Ustumot muttarot urminhi
b: Hashsholeach chavit shel yayin beyad kuti veshel tzir veshel muryas beyad goy im makkir chotamo ustamo muttar im lav asur
Amar rabbi zera la kashya kan bair kan badderech
Matkef lah rabbi yirmeya mide hanach deir la bederech atu ella amar rabbi yirmeya ben haggitot shaninu kevan dechulle alma afchi mirtat amar hashta i chazu li mafsedu li
Ittemar mippene ma asru shechar shel goyim rame bar chama amar rabbi yitzchak mishshum chatnut rav nachman amar mishshum giluy
Aggiluy demay ilema giluy denazyata anan name megallenan veella dechavita anan name megallenan la tzericha beatra dimtzallu mayya
Ella meatta yashan tishtere deamar rabbi yashan muttar en mannicho leyashen hechmitz muttar en mannicho lehachmitz gezera yashan attu chadash
Rav pappa mappekin leh abbava dechanuta veshate rav achay mayetu leh leveteh veshate vetarvayehu mishshum chatnut rav achay aved harchaka yattirta
Rav shemuel bar bisna ikla lemargevan ayeto leh chamra vela ishti ayeto leh shichra vela ishti bishlama chamra mishshum shimtza shichra mishshum may mishshum shimtza deshimtza
Amar rav hay shichra daarammaa shere vechiyya beri la nishte mineh ma nafshach i shere lechulle alma shere i asir lechulle alma asir
Ella rav savar mishshum giluya veazel merora dichshuta vekale leh zihareh vedilke malke leh tefe vechiyya beri hoil ulke la nishte mineh

Amar shemuel kol hashsheratzim yesh lahen eres shel nachash memit shel sheratzim eno memit amar leh shemuel lechiyya bar rav bar arya ta veema lach milta mealleyata dahava amar rav avuch hachi amar avuch hane arammae zukane dahao shatu mishshum deshatu giluya vela mitu vehay dela mayeti ayede deachli shekatzim urmasim chavil gufayehu
Amar rav yosef

a: Hay challa deshichra daarammaa asur dimarvi beh durdeya deyen nesech amar rav ashe umeotzar shere kevan dimarvi beh misra sere

Vacheres hadreyani may hadreyani amar rav yehuda amar shemuel cheres shel hadreyanus kesar ki ata rav dimi amar karka betula hayeta shello avadah adam meolam avadah untaah verame leh lechamra begulfe chivare umayetzi lehu lechamrayehu umtabberu lehu bechasfe vedaru bahadayehu vechol hecha dematu taru lehu veshatu amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi verishon shellanu kishlishi shellahen
Ibaya lehu mahu lismoch bahen kare hammitta rotze bekiyyumo al yede davar acher shere o asur
Ta shema derabbi elazar verabbi yochanan chad asar vechad share vehilcheta keman deasar

Metivi haddardurin veharukbaot shel goyim yayin shel yisrael kanus bahen asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaa heid shimon ben gudda lifne beno shel rabban gamliel al rabban gamliel sheshshata mimmennu beakko velo hodu lo
Nodot shel goyim rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben kapposay asur laasot mehen shetichin lachamor veha hacha derotze bekiyyumo al yede davar acher vekatane deasur
Velitamach kankannim shel goyim litasru lemizban may shena nodot umay shena kankannim amar rava gezera shemma yibbaka nodo veyittelennu veyitperennu al gabbe nodo
Ulman deamar rotze bekiyyumo al yede davar acher asur may shena kankannim dishru amar lach hatam leteh leisureh beeneh hacha iteh leisureh beeneh
Velo hodu lo urminhi yayin habba berukbaot shel goyim asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaa heid shimon ben gudda lifne beno shel rabban gamliel al rabban gamliel sheshshata mimmennu beakko vehodu lo
May lo hodu lo dekaamar hatam kol siato aval beno mode leh ibaet ema gudda lechod vegudda lechod
