Veorot levuvin tanu rabbanan ezehu or lavuv kal shekkarua keneged hallev vekadur kemin arubba yesh alav koret dam asur
b: En alav koret dam muttar amar rav huna lo shanu ella shello melacho aval melacho asur ema milcho heevirattu
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer bizman shehakkera shello agol asur mashuch muttar amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel
Amar leh abbaye halacha mikkelal difligi amar leh may nafka lach minah amar leh gemara gemor zemorta tehe
Basar hannichnas laavoda zara muttar man tanna amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan dela kerabbi elazar dei kerabbi elazar haamar setam machshevet goy laavoda zara
Vehayyotze asur mippene shehu kezivche metim may tama i efshar deleka tikrovet avoda zara manni rabbi yehuda ben betera hi

Detanya rabbi yehuda ben betira omer minnayin letikrovet avoda zara shemmetamme beohel shenneemar vayyitztzamdu levaal peor vayyochlu zivche metim ma met metamme beohel af tikrovet avoda zara metammea beohel
Haholchin lattarput asurin laset velatet immahem amar shemuel goy haholech lattarput bahalicha asur deazel umode kamme avoda zara bachazara muttar may dahava hava
Yisrael haholech lattarput bahalicha muttar dilma hadar beh vela azel bachazara asur kevan

a: Daavik bah mihdar hadar azel
Vehatanya yisrael haholech lattarput ben bahalicha ben bachazara asur amar rav ashe ki tanya hahi beyisrael meshummad devadday azel
Tanu rabbanan goy haholech leyarid ben bahalicha ben bachazara muttar yisrael haholech leyarid bahalicha muttar bachazara asur
May shena yisrael devachazara asur deamri avoda zara zabben deme avoda zara ika bahadeh goy name nema avoda zara zabben deme avoda zara ika bahadeh
Ella goy amrinan gelima zabben chamra zabben yisrael name nema emor gelima zabben chamra zabben i ita dahava leh hacha hava mezabben leh
Vehabbain muttarin amar rabbi shimon ben lakish lo shanu ella sheen keshurin ze baze aval keshurin ze baze asurin ema dato lachzor
Nodot haggoyim vekankannehem tanu rabbanan nodot haggoyim gerudim chadashim muttarin yeshanim umzuppafin asurin goy ribvan veibdan venatan letochan yayin veyisrael omed al gabbav eno choshesh
Vechi meachar degoy noten letochan yayin ki yisrael omed al gabbav may have amar rav pappa hachi kaamar goy ribvan veibdan veyisrael noten letochan yayin veyisrael acher omed al gabbav veeno choshesh
Umeachar deyisrael noten letochan yayin yisrael acher omed al gabbav lema li dilma aggav tirdeh menassech velav addateh
Rav zevid amar leolam kidkaamratte meikara vehacha beidana deka shade leh naase kezorek mayim letit amar rav pappe shema minah midderav zevid hay goy dishda chamra leve milche deyisrael shere
Matkef lah rav ashe mi dame hatam kaazel leibud hacha la kaazel leibud

Bar adi tayyaa anas hanhu zike merav yitzchak bar yosef rema behu chamra veahderinhu nihaleh ata sheel be midresha amar leh rabbi yirmeya kach hora rabbi amme halacha lemaase memallean mayim shelosha yamim umaran veamar rava tzarich learan meet leet

Sevur minah hane mile didan aval didhu la ki ata ravin amar rabbi shimon ben lakish echad shellanu veechad shellahem sevar rav acha bereh derava kammeh derav ashe lememar hane mile nodot aval kankannim la amar leh rav ashe la shena nodot vela shena kankannim

Tanu rabbanan kankannim shel goyim chadashim gerudim muttarin yeshanim umzuppafin asurin goy noten letochan yayin yisrael noten letochan mayim goy noten letochan yayin yisrael noten letochan tzir umuryas veeno choshesh

Keman ki hay tanna detanya rabbi eliezer omer hammaamid bisraf haorla asur mippene shehu peri

Darash rav nachman bereh derav chisda may dichtiv lereach shemanecha tovim lema talmid chacham dome litzlochit shel pilyaton megulla rechah nodef mechussa en rechah nodef

Gema chalav lemay nechush lah i mishshum ichallofe tahor chivar tame yarok vei mishshum iarove nekum deamar mar chalav tahor omed chalav tame eno omed

Veibaet ema afilu tema dekavae leh ligvina ika dekae bene itfe

Ella ledidach deamratte daniel gazar alav daniel gezar vaata rabbi yehuda hannasi umvattel leh vehatnan en bet din yachol levattel divre bet din chavero ella im ken gadol hemennu bechachma uvminyan
Amar leh simlay luddaa ka amratte shane luddae dimzalzelu amar leh eshlach leh iksif

Veshemen daniel gezar vehaamar bali avimi nivetaa mishshemeh derav pitan veshamnan yenan uvnotehen kullan mishshemona asar davar hen
Vechi tema ata daniel gezar vela kabul vaato talmide dehillel veshammay ugzur vekabul im ken may ashaduteh derav ella daniel gazar alav bair vaato inhu ugzur afilu bassade

Zenut name bevet dino shel shem gazru dichtiv vayyomer yehuda hotziuha vetissaref
Ella deorayeta goy habba al bat yisrael demashcha batreh aval yisrael habba al haggoya la vaato inhu gezur afilu yisrael habba al haggoya
Yisrael habba al haggoya halacha lemoshe missinay hi deamar mar habboel arammit kannain pogin bo
Amar leh deorayeta befarhesya uchmaase shehaya vaato inhu gezur afilu betzina betzina name bet dino shel chashmonay gazru

Ki ata ravin amar mishshum

Deamar rav yehuda beotah shaa gazru al yichud amri hatam yichud devat yisrael aval yichud degoya la vaato inhu gezaru afilu ayyichud degoya

Yichud devat yisrael deorayeta hi deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak remez leyichud min hattora minnayin shenneemar ki yesitcha achicha ven immecha vechi ben em mesit ben av eno mesit
Ella ben mityached im immo veen acher mityached im kol araot shebbattora

May al davar acher mishshum davar acher amar rav nachman bar yitzchak gazru al tinok goy sheyetamme beziva shello yehe tinok yisrael ragil etzlo bemishkav zechur

Amar leh hatam shera telat umar shera chada vei share mar chada achariti akkatti tarten hu dehaveyan amar leh ana name sheray achariti may hi

Savri lah kerabbi yose deamar zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav veamar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba rabbi yehuda hannasi hora velo hodu lo kol sheato veamri lah kol siato
Amar leh rabbi eliezer elazar lehahu sava ki sherituha lealtar sherituha dela ate o dilma leachar shenem asar chodesh deha ikayyam leh tenaeh
Vetibe lach ammatnitin ditnan hare ze gitich meachshav im lo bati mikkan ad shenem asar chodesh umet betoch shenem asar chodesh have get deha ikayyam leh tenay
Vetibe lach lealtar have gita deha la ata o dilma leachar shenem asar chodesh deha ikayyam leh tenaeh in hachi name ella mishshum dahavet behahu minyana
Amar abbaye hakkol modim lichshettetze chamma minnartikah lechi nafka kaamar lah vechi mayet belelya get leachar mita hu
Al menat shettetze chamma minnartikah meachshav kaamar lah vechi mayet belelya ha vadday tenaa have veget mechayyim hu kidrav huna deamar rav huna kol haomer al menat keomer meachshav dame

Vehatanya achat yora gedola veachat yora ketanna muttar la kashya ha keman deamar noten taam lifgam asur ha keman deamar noten taam lifgam muttar

Beo mineh merabbi assi hane ahine shelike daarammae may chulye la tibe lach devadday sheru merire la tibe lach devadday asiri ki tibe lach metziae may amar lehu may tibe lehu derabbi asar umannu levi

Ledivre haomer zo vezo asura ze vaze meoravin bah amar rabbi avahu mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel zaken echad haya bishchunatenu shehaya machlik paneha beshumman chazir

Rabbi yose omer hashshelachin asurin hachagavim habbaim min hasselula asurin min haheftek muttarin vechen litruma
Gema tenena leha detanu rabbanan yoshev yisrael betzad edro shel goy vegoy cholev umevi lo veeno choshesh hechi dame i deleka davar tame beedro peshita vei deika davar tame beedro ammay

Vehadduvdevaniyyot af al pi shemmenattefot en bahen mishshum hechsher mashke urminhi habbotzer laggat shammay omer huchshar hillel omer lo huchshar veodi leh hillel leshammay

Targemah rav pappa keshechatichot shaot i hachi may lememra mahu detema nechush dilma itremi ka mashma lan

Hahu arba detzachanta daatay lesichra nefak rav huna bar chinana vachaza beh kilfe vesharyeh amar leh rava umi ika deshare kehay gavena beatra dishchichi kilfe nafek shipure derava veasar shipure derav huna bar chinana veshare
Amar rav yirmeya middifti ledidi amar li rav pappe ki shera rav huna bar chinana betziran aval begufan la amar rav ashe ledidi amar li rav pappa ki shera rav huna bar chinana afilu begufan

Vaana la mesar asarna dekaamar li rav pappa vela mishre sharena deha amar li rav yehuda mishshemeh deulla machloket letabbel betziran aval begufan divre hakkol ad sheyehe rosh veshidra nikar shel kol echad veechad

Efshar daavad kidrabbi oshaya deamar maarim adam al tevuato umachnisah bammotz shellah kede shettehe behemto ochelet uftura min hammaaser
Veen safek motzi mide vadday vehatanya amar rabbi yehuda maase beshifchato

a: Shel metzik echad berimon shehetila nefel levor uva kohen vehetzitz leda im zachar im nekeva uva maase lifne chachamim vetiharuhu mippene shechulda uvardelas metzuyin sham
Veha hacha devadday hetila nefel safek gerruhu safek lo gerruhu vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday
La tema hetila nefel levor ella ema hetila kemin nefel levor
Veha leda im zachar im nekeva hu katane
Hachi kaamar leda im ruach hippila im nefel hetila veim timtze lomar nefel hetila leda im zachar im nekeva
Veibaet ema kevan shechulda uvardelas metzuyin sham vadday gerruhu
Etiveh matza tavnit yad tavnit regel hare ellu asurin mippene shekkayyotze bahen neevad ammay ha shevarim ninhu
Ha targemah shemuel beomdin al besisan
Etiveh goy mevattel avoda zara shello veshel chavero veyisrael eno mevattel avoda zara shel goy ammay tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha
Amar abbaye sheppechasah vechi pechasah may have veha tenan pechasah af al pi shello chisserah bittelah
Hane mile defachasah goy aval pachasah yisrael la battelah
Verava amar leolam ki fachasah yisrael name battelah ella gezera dilma magbah lah vahadar mevattel lah vehave avoda zara beyad yisrael vechol avoda zara beyad yisrael enah betela leolam

Etiveh goy shehevi avanim min hammarkulis vechipa bahen derachim utratyaot muttarot veyisrael shehevi avanim min hammarkulis vechipa bahen derachim utratyaot asurot ammay tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha
Hacha name kidrava

Etiveh goy sheshshipa avoda zara letzorko hi veshipuyeha muttarin letzorkah hi asura veshipuyeha muttarin veyisrael sheshshipa avoda zara ben letzorko ben letzorkah hi veshipuyeha asurin ammay tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha
Hacha name kidrava
Etiveh rabbi yose omer shochek vezore laruach o metil layyam amru lo af hi naaset zevel uchtiv lo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem ammay tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha
Hacha name kidrava
Etiveh rabbi yose ben yasyan omer matza tzurat derakon verosho chatuch safek goy chatacho safek yisrael chatacho muttar vadday yisrael chatacho asur ammay tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha
Hacha name kidrava
Etiveh rabbi yose omer af lo yerakot bimot haggeshamim mippene shehanneviyya nosheret alehen ammay tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha
Shane hatam deikar avoda zara kayyemet
b: Veha shipuyan deikar avoda zara kayyemet vekatane letzorkah hi asura veshipuyeha muttarin
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar lefi sheen avoda zara betela derech gedilatah
Etiveh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan ken shebberosh hailan shel hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin beroshah shel ashera yattiz bekane
Ka salka datach kegon sheshshibbera mimmennu etzim vekintah bahen vekatane yattiz bekane
Hacha bemay askinan kegon deayetay etzim mealma vekintah bahen

Dayeka name dekatane gabbe hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin i amratte bishlama deayetay etzim mealma hayenu dekatane gabbe hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin lo nehenin midderabbanan velo moalin middeorayeta deha la kaddishi
Ella i amratte sheshshibbera etzim mimmennu vekintah bahen ammay lo moalin ha kaddishi
Mide irya hacha begidulin habbain leachar mikkan askinan veka savar en meila begidulin
Verabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan may yattiz yattiz baefrochin
Amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa asberah lach beefrochin kan vechan muttarin bevetzim kan vechan asurin amar rav ashe veefrochin shetztzerichin leimman kevetzim damu
Matni hammotze kelim vaalehem tzurat chamma tzurat levana tzurat derakon yolichem leyam hammelach rabban shimon ben gamliel omer sheal hamchubbadin asurin sheal hamvuzzin muttarin

Gema lememra dilhane hu defalchi lehu lemide acharina la urminhi hashshochet leshum yammim leshum neharot leshum midbar leshum chamma leshum levana leshum kochavim umazzalot leshum michael sar haggadol leshum shilshul katan hare ellu zivche metim
Amar abbaye miflach lechol demashkechi palchi metzar umiflachoy hane telata dachashivi tzayeri lehu ufalchi lehu lemide acharina lenoy bealma avdi lehu

Menakket rav sheshet chumre matneyata vetane kol hammazzalot muttarin chutz mimmazzal chamma ulvana vechol happartzufin muttarin chutz mippartzuf adam vechol hatztzurot muttarot chutz mitztzurat derakon

Amar mar kol hammazzalot muttarin chutz mimmazzal chamma ulvana hacha bemay askinan ilema beose i beose kol hammazzalot mi shere vehachtiv lo taasun itti lo taasun kidmut shammashay hamshammeshin lefanay bammarom
Ella peshita bemotze uchditnan hammotze kelim vaalehem tzurat chamma tzurat levana tzurat derakon yolichem leyam hammelach

I bemotze ema metziata kol happartzufot muttarin chutz mippartzuf adam i bemotze partzuf adam mi asur vehatnan hammotze kelim vaalehem tzurat chamma tzurat levana tzurat derakon yolichem leyam hammelach tzurat derakon in partzuf adam la
Ella peshita beose vechidrav huna bereh derav yehoshua
I beose ema sefa kol hatztzurot muttarot chutz mitztzurat derakon vei beose tzurat derakon mi asir vehachtiv lo taasun itti elohe chesef velohe zahav

a: Hane in tzurat derakon la
Ella peshita bemotze uchditnan hammotze kelim vaalehem tzurat chamma
Resha vesefa bemotze umtziata beose
Amar abbaye in resha vesefa bemotze umtziata beose

Rava amar kullah bemotze umtziata rabbi yehuda hi detanya rabbi yehuda mosif af demut menika vesar afes menika al shem chava shemmenika kal haolam kullo sar afes al shem yosef shessar umefis et kal haolam kullo vehu denaket geriva veka chayel vehi denakta ben veka menika

Tanu rabbanan ezehu tzurat derakon peresh rabbi shimon ben elazar kol sheyyesh lo tzitzin ben perakav machve rabbi assi ben pirke tzavar amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi paam achat hayiti mehallech achar rabbi elazar hakkappar beribi badderech umatza sham tabbaat vealeha tzurat derakon umatza goy katan vela amar lo kelum matza goy gadol veamar lo battelah velo bittelah setaro uvittelah

Shema minah telat shema minah goy mevattel avoda zara shello veshel chavero ushma minah yodea betiv shel avoda zara umshammesheha mevattel vesheeno yodea betiv avoda zara umshammesheha eno mevattel ushma minah goy mevattel beal korcho

Megaddef bah rabbi chanina velet leh lerabbi elazar hakkappar beribi ha ditnan hammatztzil min haari umin haddov umin hannamer umin haggayis umin hannahar umizzoto shel yam umishshelulito shel nahar vehammotze bisratya uflatya gedola uvchol makom sheharabbim metzuyin sham hare ellu shello mippene shehabbealim mityaashin mehen
Amar abbaye nehi deminah miyyaash meisura mi miyyaash memar amar i goy mashkach lah miflach palach lah i yisrael mashkach lah ayede dedameha yekarin mezabben lah legoy ufalach lah
Tenan hatam demut tzurot levanot haya lo lerabban gamliel baaliyyato betavla bakkotel shebbahen mare et hahedotot veomer lahen kaze reitem o kaze reitem
Umi shere vehachtiv lo taasun itti lo taasun kidmut shammashay hamshammeshim lefanay
Amar abbaye lo asra tora ella shammashin sheefshar laasot kemotan

Kidtanya lo yaase adam bayit tavnit hechal achsadra tavnit ulam chatzer tavnit azara shulchan tavnit shulchan menora tavnit menora aval hu ose shel chamesh veshel shesh veshel shemone veshel sheva lo yaase afilu shel shear mine mattachot
Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer af shel etz lo yaase kederech sheasu bet chashmonay
Amru lo mishsham reaya shappudin shel barzel hau vechofin vechipum bevaatz heeshiru asaum shel kesef chazru veheeshiru asaum shel zahav
Veshammashin shei efshar laasot kemotan mi shere vehatanya lo taasun itti lo taasun kidmut shammashay hamshammeshim lefanay bammarom
Amar abbaye
b: Lo asra tora ella bidmut arbaa panim bahade hadade
Ella meatta partzuf adam lechodeh tishtere allema tanya kol happartzufot muttarin chutz mippartzuf adam
Amar rav yehuda bereh derav yehoshua mippirkeh derabbi yehoshua shemia li lo taasun itti lo taasun oti aval shear shammashin shere
Ushar shammashin mi shere vehatanya lo taasun itti lo taasun kidmut shammashay hamshammeshin lefanay bemarom kegon ofannim usrafim vechayyot hakkodesh umalache hashsharet
Amar abbaye lo asra tora ella shammashin shebbammador haelon
Veshebbemador hattachton mi shere vehatanya asher bashshamayim lerabbot chamma ulvana kochavim umazzalot mimmaal lerabbot malache hashsharet
Ki tanya hahi leovdam
I leovdam afilu shilshul katan name in hachi name umissefeh dikra nafka detanya asher baaretz lerabbot yammim unharot harim ugvaot mittachat lerabbot shilshul katan
Vaasiyya geredta mi shere vehatanya lo taasun itti lo taasun kidmut shammashay hamshammeshin lefanay bammarom kegon chamma ulvana kochavim umazzalot
Shane rabban gamliel daacherim asu lo
Veha rav yehuda daacherim asu lo vaamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana sammi eneh deden
Hatam bechotamo bolet umishshum chashada detanya tabbaat shechotamah bolet asur lehannichah umuttar lachtom bah chotamah shokea muttar lehannichah veasur lachtom bah
Umi chayeshinan lachashada veha be chenishta deshaf vitev binhardea deokmi deokimu beh inderata vahao ayeli beh avuh dishmuel velevi umtzallu begaveh vela chayeshi lachashada rabbim shane
Veha rabban gamliel deyachid hava kevan denasi hu shechichi rabbim gabbeh veibaet ema difrakim havay
Veibaet ema lehitlammed shane detanya lo tilmad laasot aval atta lamed lehavin ulhorot
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechu ezo hen mechubbadin veezo hen mevuzzin
Amar rav mechubbadin lemala min hammayim mevuzzin lematta min hammayim ushmuel amar ellu vaellu mevuzzin hen ella ellu hen mechubbadin sheal hashsherin veal hannezamim veal hattabbaot
Tanya kevateh dishmuel mechubbadin sheal hashsherin veal hannezamim veal hattabbaot mevuzzin sheal hayyorot veal hakkumkemosin veal mechamme chammim vesheal hassedinin veal hammitpachot
Matni rabbi yose omer shochek vezore laruach o metil layyam amru lo af hu naase zevel shenneemar lo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem
Gema tanya amar lahem rabbi yose vahalo kevar neemar veet chattatchem

a: Asher asitem et haegel lakachti vaesrof oto baesh vaekkot oto tachon hetev ad asher dak leafar vaashlich et afaro el hannachal hayyored min hahar
Amru lo mishsham reaya hare hu omer vayyizer al pene hammayim vayyashke et bene yisrael lo nitkaven ella levodkan kesotot

Amar lahem rabbi yose vahalo kevar neemar vegam et maacha immo hesirah miggevira asher asta miflatztah vego vayyadek vayyisrof benachal kidron amar lo mishsham reaya nachal kidron eno megaddel tzemachin

Vela vehatanya ellu veellu mitarvin beamma veotzin lenachal kidron venimkarin legannanin lezevel umoalin bahen mekomot mekomot yesh bo yesh makom megaddel tzemachin veyesh makom sheen megaddel tzemachin
May miflatztah amar rav yehuda dahava mafleya letzanuta kidtane rav yosef kemin zachrut asta lah vehayeta nivelet lo bechol yom
Amar lahen rabbi yose vahalo kevar neemar vechittat nechash nechoshet asher asa moshe
Amru lo mishsham reaya hare hu omer vayyomer Adonai el moshe ase lecha saraf lecha mishshellecha veen adam oser davar sheeno shello vehatam bedin hu dechattote la hava tzerich
Ella kevan dachaza deka tau yisrael batreh amad vechitato

Amar lahem vahalo kevar neemar vayyaazvu sham et atzabbehem vayyissaem david vaanashav umay mashma dehay vayyissaem david lishana dezaroye hu kedimtargem rav yosef tizrem veruach tissaem umtargeminan tizrenun veruach tetaltelinun
Amru lo mishsham reaya hare hu omer vayyissarfu baesh umiddela ketiv vayyisrefem vayyissaem shema minah vayyissaem mammash
Mikkol makom kashu kerae ahadade
Kidrav huna derav huna rame ketiv vayyomer david vayyissarfu baesh uchtiv vayyissaem
La kashya kan kodem shebba itay haggiti kan leachar shebba itay haggiti
Dichtiv vayyikkach et ateret malkam meal rosho umishkalah kikkar zahav umi shere isure hanaa ninhu amar rav nachman itay haggiti ba uvitlah

Mishkalah kikkar zahav hechi matze mannach lah amar rav yehuda amar rav reuya lanuach al rosh david rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar even shoevet hayeta bah dahavat dara lah rabbi elazar amar even yekara hayeta bah sheshshava kikkar zahav

Zot hayeta li ki fikkudecha natzarti may kaamar hachi kaamar bischar sheppikkudecha natzarti zot hayeta li leedut may edutah amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi shehaya mannichah bimkom tefilin veholamto veha bae annoche tefilin amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak makom yesh barosh sherauy lehanniach bo shette tefilin

Vayyotziu et ben hammelech vayyittenu alav et hannezer veet haedut nezer zo kelila edut amar rav yehuda amar rav edut hu levet david shekkol harauy lammalchut holamto vechol sheeno rauy lammalchut en holamto
Vaadoniyya ven chaggit mitnasse lemor ani emloch amar rav yehuda amar rav shemmitnasse leholmo velo holamto
Vayyaas lo rechev ufarashim vachamishshim ish ratzim lefanav may revutayehu tana kullam netule techol vachakuke kappot haraglayim hau
b: Matni shaal peroklus ben pelosfus et rabban gamliel beakko shehaya rochetz bammerchatz shel afrodite amar leh katuv betoratchem la yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem mippene ma atta rochetz bemerchatz shel afrodite
Amar lo en meshivin bammerchatz uchsheyyatza amar lo ani lo bati bigvulah hi baa bigvuli en omrim naasa merchatz noy leafrodite ella omer naasa afrodite noy lammerchatz

Davar acher im notnim lecha mamon harbe i atta nichnas laavoda zara shellecha arom uvaal keri umashtin befaneha zo omedet al pi habbiv vechol haam mashtinin lefaneha lo neemar ella elohehem et shennoheg bo mishshum eloha asur et sheeno noheg bo mishshum eloha muttar
Gema vehechi aved hachi vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan bechol makom muttar leharher chutz mibbet hammerchatz umibbet hakkisse
Vechi tema bilshon chol amar leh vehaamar abbaye devarim shel chol muttar leomran bilshon kodesh devarim shel kodesh asur leomran bilshon chol
Tana kesheyyatza amar lo en meshivin bammerchatz
Amar rav chama bar yosef berabbi amar rabbi oshaya teshuva genuva heshivo rabban gamliel leoto hegmon vaani omer enah genuva
Ma genuvtah dekaamar lo zo omedet al pi habbiv vechol adam mashtin befaneha vechi mashtin befaneha may have vehaamar rava peor yochiach shemmefaarin lefanav bechol yom veeno batel
Vaani omer enah genuva zo avodatah bechach vezo en avodatah bechach

Amar abbaye genuvtah mehacha dekaamar leh ani lo bati bigvulah vehi baa bigvuli vechi ba bigvulah may have vehatnan avoda zara sheyyesh lah merchatz o gina nehenin mehen shello betova veen nehenin mehen betova
Vaani omer enah genuva shello betovat rabban gamliel kivtovat acherim dame

Rav shimi bar chiyya amar genuvtah mehacha dekaamar lo zo omedet al habbiv vechol adam mashtinin befaneha vechi mashtinin befaneha may have vehatnan rak befaneha hishtin befaneha gerra vezarak bah et hatztzoa hare zo enah betela
Vaani omer enah genuva hatam lefi shata hu ratach alah vahadar mefayyes lah hacha kol shata veshata bezilzulah kayema

Rabba bar ulla amar genuvtah mehacha dekaamar leh en omrin naasa merchatz noy leafrodite ella naasa afrodite noy lammerchatz vechi amar naasa merchatz leafrodite noy may have vehatanya haomer bayit ze laavoda zara kos ze laavoda zara lo amar kelum sheen hekdesh laavoda zara
Vaani omer enah genuva nehi deitsore la mitasra noy miha ika

a: Matni haggoyim haovdim et heharim veet haggevaot hen muttarin uma shealehen asurin shenneemar lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem
Rabbi yose haggelili omer elohehem al heharim velo heharim elohehem elohehem al haggevaot velo haggevaot elohehem
Umippene ma ashera asura mippene sheyyesh bah tefisat yede adam vechol sheyyesh bah tefisat yede adam asur
Amar rabbi akiva ani ovin veadun lefanecha kol makom sheatta motze har gavoha vegiva nissaa veetz raanan da sheyyesh sham avoda zara

Gema verabbi yose haggelili hayenu tanna kamma amar rame bar chama amar resh lakish tzippuy har kehar ika benayehu tanna kamma savar tzippuy har eno kehar umitsar verabbi yose haggelili savar tzippuy har hare hu kehar
Rav sheshet amar dechulle alma tzippuy har eno kehar
b: Vehacha bailan shennetao ulvassof avado kamipalgi tanna kamma savar ilan shennetao ulvassof avado muttar verabbi yose haggelili savar ilan shennetao ulvassof avado asur

Mimmay middekatane sefa mippene ma ashera asura mippene sheyyesh bah tefisat yede adam vechol sheyyesh bo tefisat yede adam asur vechol sheyyesh bo tefisat adam leetoye may lav leetoye ilan shennetao ulvassof avado

Veaf rabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar ilan shennetao ulvassof avado asur detanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer mittoch shenneemar elohehem al heharim velo heharim elohehem elohehem al haggevaot velo gevaot elohehem shomea ani tachat kol etz raanan elohehem velo raanan elohehem
Talmud lomar vaasherehem tisrefun baesh

Ella tachat kol etz raanan lema li hahu lechidrabbi akiva hu daata deamar rabbi akiva ani ovin veadun lefanecha kol makom sheatta motze har gavoha vegiva nissaa veetz raanan da sheyyesh sham avoda zara
Verabbanan hay vaasherehem tisrefun baesh may avdi leh mibe leh leilan shennetao mittechila lechach

Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda name mibe leh lehachi hachi name ella ilan shennetao ulvassof avado mena leh nafka leh mivaasherehem tegaddeun ezehu etz sheggiduo asur veikaro muttar heve omer ilan shennetao ulvassof avado
Veha vaasherehem tisrefun baesh ka nasev lah talmuda

Ilu lo neemar kaamar ilu lo neemar tisrefun baesh hayiti omer asherehem tegaddeun beilan shennetao mittechila lechach hashta dichtiv vaasherehem tisrefun baesh iyyatar leh vaasherehem tegaddeun leilan shennetao ulvassof avado

Verabbanan hay vaasherehem tegaddeun may avdi leh lechidrabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi gidue avoda zara kodmin lechibush eretz yisrael kibush eretz yisrael kodem leviur avoda zara
Detane rav yosef venittatztem et mizbechotam vehannach veshibbartem et matztzevotam vehannach
Vehannach salka datach serefa bae amar rav huna redof veachar kach serof
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda hay sevara mena leh nafka leh meabbed teabbedun abbed veachar kach teabbedun
Verabbanan ha mibe leh leoker avoda zara shetztzarich lesharesh achareha
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda lesharesh achareha mena leh nafka leh mivveibbadtem et shemam min hammakom hahu
Verabbanan hahu lechannot lah shem detanya rabbi eliezer omer minnayin leoker avoda zara shetztzarich lesharesh achareha talmud lomar veibbadtem et shemam

a: Amar lo rabbi akiva vahalo kevar neemar abbed teabbedun im ken ma talmud lomar veibbadtem et shemam min hammakom hahu lechannot lah shem
Yachol leshevach leshevach salka datach ella yachol lo leshevach velo lignay talmud lomar shakketz teshakketzennu vetaev tetaavennu ki cherem hu
Ha ketzad hau korin otah bet galya korin otah bet karya pene melech pene kelev en kol en kotz
Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet haggoyim haovdim et heharim veet haggevaot hen muttarin veovdehen besayif veet hazzeraim veet hayerakot hen asurin veovdehen besayif
Amar leh deamar lach manni rabbi yose bar yehuda hi deamar ilan shennetao ulvassof avado asur
Velokmah beilan shennetao mittechilla lechach verabbanan la salka datach dekatane dumya dehar ma har shello netao mittechilla lechach af hay name shello netao mittechilla lechach

Itmar avne har shenniddaldelu bene rabbi chiyya verabbi yochanan chad amar asurot vechad amar muttarot may tama deman deamar muttarot kehar ma har sheen bo tefisat yede adam umuttar af hane sheen bahen tefisat yede adam umuttarin
Ma lehar shekken mechubbar behema tochiach
Ma livhema shekken baalat chayyim har yochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze chiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheen bahen tefisat yede adam umuttar af kol sheen bahen tefisat yede adam umuttar
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken lo nishtannu mibberiyyatan
Ella atya mibbehema baalat mum umehar
Vei name mibbehema tamma umeilan yavesh
Uman deasar lehachi ketiv shakketz teshakketzennu vetaev tetaavennu deaf al gav deatya middina lehetera la tetya
Tistayyem divne rabbi chiyya desharu devae chizkiyya zakaf betza lehishtachaot lah mahu
Ka salka datach lehishtachaot lah vehishtachava lah veka mibaya leh hay zekifatah i have maase i la have maase aval lo zakaf la mitasra shema minah bene rabbi chiyya desharu
La leolam ema lach bene rabbi chiyya deasri dehishtachava lah af al gav delo zekafah asura vehacha bemay askinan kegon shezzakaf betza lehishtachaot lah velo hishtachava lah
Ulman i leman deamar avoda zara shel yisrael asura miyyad asura i leman deamar ad shetteaved ha la palchah
La tzericha kegon shezzakaf betza lehishtachaot lah velo hishtachava lah uva goy vehishtachava lah
Ki ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel yisrael shezzakaf levena lehishtachaot lah uva goy vehishtachava lah asura veka mibaya leh levena hu deminachra zekifatah aval betza la o dilma la shena teku
Bae rame bar chama hammishtachave lehar avanav mahu lammizbeach
b: Yesh neevad bimchubbar etzel gavoha o en neevad bimchubbar etzel gavoha
Im timtze lomar yesh neevad bimchubbar etzel gavoha machshire korban kekorban damu o la

Amar rava kal vachomer uma etnan shemmuttar betalush lehedot asur bimchubbar legavoha dichtiv lo tavi etnan zona umchir kelev la shena talush vela shena bimchubbar neevad sheasur betalush lehedot eno din sheasur bimchubbar legavoha

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava o chiluf uma neevad sheasur betalush etzel hedot muttar bimchubbar legavoha shenneemar elohehem al heharim velo heharim elohehem la shena lehedot vela shena legavoha etnan shemmuttar betalush lehedot eno din shemmuttar bimchubbar legavoha
Vei mishshum bet Adonai elohecha mibe leh lechidtanya bet Adonai elohecha perat lefara sheenah baa labbayit divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim lerabbot et harikuim
Amar leh ana kaamena lechumra veatte amratte lekulla kulla vechumra lechumra parchinan

Amar leh rav pappa lerava vechol hecha deika kulla vechumra lekulla la parchinan veha hazzaa defesach difligi rabbi eliezer verabbi akiva derabbi eliezer savar lechumra veka mechayyev leh legavra verabbi akiva lekulla ufatar veka farech rabbi akiva lekulla
Ditnan heshiv rabbi akiva o chiluf uma hazzaa shehi mishshum shevut enah docha et hashshabbat shechita shehi deorayeta lo kol shekken
Hatam rabbi eliezer gamreh veiyyakar leh talmuda vaata rabbi akiva leadkoreh vehayenu daamar leh rabbi al tachpireni bishat haddin kach mekubbal ani mimmecha hazzaa shevut veenah docha et hashshabbat
Bae rame bar chama hammishtachave lekamat chittim mahu limnachot yesh shinuy beneevad o en shinuy beneevad
Amar mar zutra bereh derav nachman ta shema kol haasurin legabbe mizbeach valdotehen muttarim vetane alah rabbi eliezer oser
Velav ittemar alah amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh machloket keshennirbeu ulvassof ibru

a: Aval ibru ulvassof nirbeu divre hakkol asurin vehacha name keibru ulvassof nirbeu dame
Ika deamri machloket keshennirbeu ulvassof ibru aval ibru ulvassof nirbeu divre hakkol asur vehane name ki ibru ulvassof nirbeu dame
Hachi hashta hatam meikara behema vehashta behema dashsha hu daachida beanpah hacha meikara chite vehashta kimcha
Bae resh lakish hammishtachave laddekel lulavo mahu lemitzva
Beilan shennetao mittechilla lechach la tibe lach daafilu lehedot name asur ki tibe lach beilan shennetao ulvassof avado
Vealliba derabbi yose bar yehuda la tibe lach daafilu lehedot name asur ki tibe lach alliba derabbanan leinyan mitzva may mi meis kelappe gavoha o la
Ki ata rav dimi amar baashera shebbitlah kamibbaya leh yesh dichuy etzel mitzot o en dichuy etzel mitzot

Tifshot leh midditnan kisahu venitgalla patur millechassot kisahu haruach chayyav lechassot veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shechazar venitgalla aval lo chazar venitgalla patur millechassot
Vehavenan bah ki chazar venitgalla may have hoil veidchi idchi
Veamar rav pappa zot omeret en dichuy etzel mitzot
Derav pappa gufeh ibaya leh mifshat peshita leh lerav pappa deen dichuy etzel mitzot la shena lekulla vela shena lechumra
O dilma sappoke mesappeka leh ulchumra amrinan lekulla la amrinan teku
Bae rav pappa hammishtachave livhema tzamrah mahu litchelet
Techelet demay i techelet lechohanim hayenu baya derame bar chama vei techelet letzitzit hayenu baya deresh lakish
In hachi name dela hava lemibe leh vehay deka vae leh ha mishshum deika mile achranyata tzamrah mahu litchelet karneha mahu lachatzotzrot shokeha mahu lachalilin bene meeha mahu leforot
Alliba deman deamar ikar shira bichli la tibe lach devadday asir
Ki tibe lach alliba deman deamar ikar shira bappe bassome kala bealma hu umayetinan o dilma afilu hachi asir teku
Bae rabba hammishtachave lemayan memav mahu linsachim may ka mibaya leh ilema levavua ka saged o dilma lemayya ka saged vetibe leh sefel lehedot
Leolam lemayya ka saged vehachi kamibbaya leh lemayya dekammeh ka saged vekammae kammae azadu o dilma ledavruna demayya ka saged
Umi mitasri veha amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak mayim shel rabbim en neesarin la tzericha deka navi meara
Matni mi shehaya beto samuch laavoda zara venafal asur livnoto ketzad yaase kones betoch shello arba ammot uvone
Shello veshel avoda zara
b: Nidon mechetza al mechetza
Avanav etzav vaafaro metammein kesheretz shenneemar shakketz teshakketzennu
Rabbi akiva omer kenidda shenneemar tizrem kemo dava tze tomar lo ma nidda metammea bemassa af avoda zara metammea bemassa
Gema veha ka marvach laavoda zara amar rav chanina missura deaved leh bet hakkisse
Veha bae tzeniuta deaved leh bet hakkisse delayela
Veha amar mar ezehu tzanua hannifne ballayela bemakom shennifna bayyom veaf al gav deokemna bichderech mihu tzeniuta bae lemebad
Deaved leh letinokot
I name degadar leh behizme vehige
Matni shelosha battim hen bayit shebbenao mittechilla laavoda zara hare ze asur siyedo vechiyedo laavoda zara vechidesh notel ma shechidesh hichnis letochah avoda zara vehotziah hare ze muttar
Gema amar rav hammishtachave levayit asaro alma kasavar talush ulvassof chibbero ketalush dame vehaanan benao tenan
Benao af al pi shello hishtachava lo hishtachava af al pi shello benao i hachi hane shelosha arbaa hau
Kevan dilinyan bitul bana vehishtachava chad ka chashev leh

Matni shalosh avanim hen even shechatzavah mittechilla levimos hare zo asura siyedah vechiyedah leshem avoda zara notel ma shessiyyed vechiyyed umutteret heemid aleha avoda zara vesilkah hare zo mutteret
Gema amar rabbi amme vehu shessiyyed vechiyyed begufah shel even
Veha dumya devayit tenan uvayit lav begufeh hu umitsar bayit name ika bene urve
Mi la askinan deshiya vahadar shayeeh
Ella ki ittemar derabbi amme leinyan bitul ittemar veaf al gav desiyyed vechiyyed begufah shel even ki natal ma shechidesh shappir dame
Demahu detema kevan shessiyyed vechiyyed begufah shel even keeven shechatzavah mittechilla laavoda zara damya vetitsar kullah ka mashma lan

a: Matni shalosh asherot hen ilan shennetao mittechilla leshem avoda zara hare zo asura gido ufislo leshem avoda zara vehechlif notel ma shehechlif heemid tachteha avoda zara untalah hare zo mutteret
Gema amri deve rabbi yannay vehu shehivrich vehirkiv begufo shel ilan
Vehaanan gido ufislo tenan

Ella ki itmar derabbi yannay leinyan bitul itmar deaf al gav dehivrich vehirkiv begufo shel ilan ki natal ma shehechlif shappir dame demahu detema kevan dehivrich vehirkiv begufo shel ilan keilan shennetao mittechilla dame velitsar kullah ka mashma lan
Amar shemuel hammishtachave leilan tosefteh tosafto asura metiv rabbi elazar gido ufislo laavoda zara vehechlif notel ma shehechlif gido ufislo in lo gido ufislo lo
Amar lecha shemuel ha manni rabbanan hi ushmuel deamar kerabbi yose bar yehuda deamar ilan shennetao ulvassof avado asur
Matkef lah rav ashe mimmay derabbi yose bar yehuda verabbanan betosefet peligi dilma tosefet ledivre hakkol asur uvikaro peligi

Derabbi yose bar yehuda savar ikaro name asur dichtiv vaasherehem tisrefun baesh verabbanan savri ikar ilan shere dichtiv vaasherehem tegaddeun ezehu ilan sheggiduo asur veikaro shere heve omer ilan shennetao ulvassof avado
Vechi tema ha dela metartzinan hachi efoch rabbanan lidrabbi yose bar yehuda udrabbi yose bar yehuda lerabbanan
Im ken gido ufislo man katane lah la rabbanan vela rabbi yose bar yehuda i rabbanan belo gido ufislo name tosefet asura i rabbi yose bar yehuda ikar ilan name asur

I baet ema rabbanan vei baet ema rabbi yose bar yehuda i baet ema rabbi yose bar yehuda ki kaamar rabbi yose bar yehuda belo gido ufislo ikar ilan asur bistama aval gido ufislo galli addateh divtosefet nicha leh beikar ilan la nicha leh
Ibaet ema rabbanan gido ufislo itztericha leh salka datach amena kevan daavad leh maase begufeh ikar ilan name litsar kamashma lan

Matni ezo ashera kol sheyyesh tachteha avoda zara rabbi shimon omer kol sheovdin otah umaase betzayeddan beilan shehau ovdin oto umatzu tachtav gal amar lahen rabbi shimon bidku et haggal hazze uvdakuhu umatzu bo tzura amar lahen hoil velatztzura hen ovdin nattir lahen et hailan

Gema ezehu ashera veha anan shalosh asherot tenan hachi kaamar shettayim ledivre hakkol veachat machloket derabbi shimon verabbanan ezo hi ashera shennechleku bah rabbi shimon vachachamim kol sheyyesh tachteha avoda zara rabbi shimon omer kol sheovdim otah

Ezo hi ashera setam amar rav kol shekkomarim yoshvin tachteha veen toamin mipperoteha ushmuel amar afilu amri hane tamre leve nitzrefe asur derame be shichra veshate leh beom edam amar ammemar amaru li save defumbedita hilcheta kishmuel
b: Matni lo yeshev betzilah veim yashav tahor velo yaavor tachteha veim avar tame hayeta gozelet et harabbim veavar tachteha tahor
Gema lo yeshev betzilah peshita amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo nitzrecha ella letzel tzilah
Mikkelal divtzel komatah im yashav tame lo daafilu letzel komatah name im yashav tahor veha ka mashma lan daafilu letzel tzilah lo yeshev

Ika dematne lah assefa veim yashav tahor peshita amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo nitzrecha ella letzel komatah mikkelal diltzel tzilah afilu lechattechilla yeshev la ha ka mashma lan daafilu letzel komatah im yashav tahor
Velo yaavor tachteha veim avar tame may tama i efshar deleka tikrovet avoda zara

Manni rabbi yehuda ben betera hi detanya rabbi yehuda ben betira omer minnayin letikrovet avoda zara shemmetammea beohel shenneemar vayyitztzamdu levaal peor vayyochlu zivche metim ma met metamme beohel af tikrovet avoda zara metamme beohel
Hayeta gozelet et harabbim veavar tachteha tahor ibaya lehu avar o over rabbi yitzchak ben elazar mishshemeh dechizkiyya amar over verabbi yochanan amar im avar
Vela peligi ha deika dirka acharina ha deleka dirka acharina
Amar leh rav sheshet leshammaeh ki matet lehatam arhetni hechi dame i deleka dirka acharina lema li arhetni mishra shere vei deika dirka achrina ki amar arhetni mi shere
Leolam deleka dirka acharina veadam chashuv shane

Matni zorin tachteha yerakot bimot haggeshamim aval lo bimot hachamma vehachazerin lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim rabbi yose omer af lo yerakot bimot haggeshamim mippene shehanneviyya nosheret alehen vehova lahen lezevel
Gema lememra derabbi yose savar ze vaze gorem asur verabbanan amri ze vaze gorem muttar
Ha ipcha shaminan lehu ditnan rabbi yose omer shochek vezore laruach o metil layyam amru lo af hi naasa zevel veneemar lo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem
Kashya derabbanan adderabbanan kashya derabbi yose adderabbi yose
Bishlama derabbi yose adderabbi yose la kashya hatam dekaazel leibud mattir hacha dela kaazel leibud asur
Ella derabbanan adderabbanan kashya efoch
Veibaet ema la tefoch derabbi yose kidshannin derabbanan kidamar rav mari bereh derav kahana ma shemmashbiach baor pogem babbasar
Hacha name ma shemmashbiach banneviyya pogem batztzel

Vesavar rabbi yose ze vaze gorem asur vehatanya rabbi yose omer notin yichur shel orla veen notin egoz shel orla mippene shehu peri veamar rav yehuda amar rav mode rabbi yose sheim nata vehivrich vehirkiv muttar
Vetanya name hachi mode rabbi yose

a: Sheim nata vehivrich vehirkiv muttar

Vechi tema shane leh lerabbi yose ben shear isurin laavoda zara umi shane leh vehatanya sade shennizdabbela bezevel avoda zara vechen para shennitpattema becharshine avoda zara tane chada sade tizzara para tishshachet vetanya idach sade tavor ufara tirze
May lav ha rabbi yose veha rabbanan la ha rabbi eliezer veha rabbanan
He rabbi eliezer verabbanan ilema rabbi eliezer verabbanan disor
Ditnan seor shel chullin veshel teruma shennaflu letoch haisa lo baze kede lechammetz velo baze kede lechammetz venitztarfu vechimtzu
Rabbi eliezer omer achar haacharon ani ba vachachamim omrim ben shennafal isur lechitchilla uven shennafal isur levassof eno asur ad sheyehe bo kede lechammetz
Veamar abbaye lo shanu ella shekkadam vesilek et haisur aval lo kadam vesilek et haisur asur
Umimmay detama derabbi eliezer kidabbaye dilma tama derabbi eliezer mishshum deachar acharon ani ba i gemir beisura asura vei gemir behetera muttarin ben sallekeh uven la sallekeh
Ella rabbi eliezer verabbanan deetzim
Ditnan natal hemenna etzim asura bahanaa hissik bah et hattannur chadash yuttatz yashan yutzan afa bo et happat asura bahanaa
Nitarva baacherim kullan asurot bahanaa rabbi eliezer omer yolich hanaa leyam hammelach amru lo en pidon laavoda zara
Rabbanan difligi aleh derabbi eliezer man ninhu
Ilema rabbanan deetzim achmore machmeri
Ella rabbanan disor emar deshamatte lehu lerabbanan dimkili bisor baavoda zara mi mekili
Ella leolam ha rabbi yose veha rabbanan
Rabbi yose ledivrehem derabbanan amar lehu ledidi ze vaze gorem muttar
Ledidchu deamritu ze vaze gorem asur odo li mihat af yerakot bimot haggeshamim
Verabbanan kidamar rav mari bereh derav kahana
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose hahu ginta deizdabbal bezivla daavoda zara shelach rav amram kammeh derav yosef amar leh hachi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose
b: Matni natal mimmenna etzim asurin bahanaa hissik bahen et hattannur im chadash yuttatz veim yashan yutzan afa bo et happat asura bahanaa
Nitarva baacherot kullan asurot bahanaa rabbi eliezer omer yolich hanaa leyam hammelach amru lo en pidon laavoda zara

Natal hemenna karker asur bahanaa arag bo et habbeged asur bahanaa nitarev baacherim vaacherim baacherim kullan asurin bahanaa rabbi eliezer omer yolich hanaa leyam hammelach amru lo en pidon laavoda zara
Gema utzricha dei ashmeinan kammayeta beha kaamar rabbi eliezer mishshum dividana deka gamra pat kale lah isura aval karker deiteh leisura beeneh ema mode lerabbanan
Vei ashmeinan karker beha kaamri rabbanan aval pat ema modu leh lerabbi eliezer tzericha
Amar rav chiyya bereh derabba bar nachmani amar rav chisda amar zeeri halacha kerabbi eliezer ika deamri amar rav chisda amar li abba bar rav chisda hachi amar zeeri halacha kerabbi eliezer
Amar rav adda bar ahava lo shanu ella pat aval chavit la verav chisda amar afilu chavit mutteret
Hahu gavra deitarav leh chavita deyen nesech bechamreh ata lekammeh derav chisda amar shekol arba zuze ushdi benahara venishtere lach
Matni ketzad mevattelah kirsem vezered natal mimmenna makkel o sharvit afilu ale hare zo betela shipah letzorkah asura shello letzorkah mutteret
Gema otan shefain ma tehe alehen peligi bah rav huna verabbi chiyya bar rav chad amar asurin vechad amar muttarin

Tanya keman deamar muttarin detanya goy sheshshipa avoda zara letzorko hi ushfaeha muttarin letzorkah hi asura ushfaeha muttarin veyisrael sheshshipa avoda zara ben letzorkah ben letzorko hi ushfaeha asurin
Itmar avoda zara shennishtabbera rav amar tzarich levattel kol kesam vekesam ushmuel amar avoda zara enah betela ella derech gedilatah
Adderabba derech gedilatah mi mevattela ella hachi kaamar en avoda zara tzericha levattel ella derech gedilatah
Lema beha kamipalgi demar savar ovdin lishvarin umar savar en ovdin lishvarin
La dechulle alma ovdin lishvarin vehacha beshivre shevarim kamipalgi mar savar shivre shevarim asurin umar savar shivre shevarim muttarin

Vei baet ema dechulle alma shivre shevarim muttarin vehacha baavoda zara shel chulot uvhedot sheyyachol lehachzirah kamipalgi mar savar kevan dehedot yachol lehachzirah la batla umar savar en avoda zara betela ella derech gedilatah dehayenu orcheh ha lav gedilatah hi veen tzericha levattel
Hadaran alach kol hatztzelamim
Matni rabbi yishmael omer shalosh avanim zo betzad zo betzad markulis asurot ushtayim muttarot vachachamim omrim shennirot immo asurot vesheen nirot immo muttarot
Gema bishlama rabbanan kasavri ovdin lishvarim nirot immo deika lememar mineh nefal asurot sheen nirot immo muttarot
Ella rabbi yishmael may kasavar i ovdin lishvarin afilu tarte name litsar i en ovdin lishvarim afilu telat name la

Amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan beyadua shennashru mimmennu divre hakkol asurot vaafilu leman deamar en ovdin lishvarim hane mile avoda zara delav hayenu orcheh aval hacha demeikara tabbore mitabberi hayenu orcheh ki peligi bistama

a: Bimkoravot name deika lememar mineh nefal divre hakkol asurot ki peligi bimruchakot
Veha betzad markulis katane may betzad betzad arba ammot dideh

Rabbi yishmael savar osin markulis katan betzad markulis gadol shalosh dedomyan lemarkulis asurot shettayim muttarot rabbanan savri en osin markulis katan betzad markulis gadol la shena shalosh vela shena shettayim nirot immo asurot sheen nirot immo muttarot

Amar mar beyadua shennashru mimmennu divre hakkol asurot urminhi avanim shennashru min hammarkulis nirot immo asurot sheen nirot immo muttarot verabbi yishmael omer shalosh asurot shettayim muttarot amar rava la tema shennashru ella ema shennimtzeu
Vesavar rabbi yishmael shettayim muttarot vehatanya rabbi yishmael omer shettayim bitfisa lo asurot shalosh afilu meruchakot asurot
Amar rava la kashya kan bitfisa achat kan bishte tefisot vehechi dame deika guvha bene uvene
Umarkulis kehay gavena mi have veha tanya ellu hen avne bet kulis achat mikkan veachat mikkan veachat al gabbehen amar rava ki tanya hahi beikar markulis
Be yannay malka charuv ato goyim okimu beh markulis ato goyim acharine dela palchi lemarkulis shaklinhu vechipu bahen derachim ustartaot ika rabbanan defarshi veika rabbanan dela parshi

Amar rabbi yochanan benan shel kedoshim mehallech alehen vaanan nifrosh mehen man nihu benan shel kedoshim rabbi menachem berabbi simay veammay karu leh benan shel kedoshim daafilu betzurta dezuza la mistakkal

May tama deman defaresh savar lah ki ha deamar rav gidel amar rav chiyya bar yosef amar rav minnayin letikrovet avoda zara sheen lah betila olamit shenneemar vayyitztzamdu levaal peor vayyochlu zivche metim ma met en lo betila leolam af tikrovet avoda zara en lah betila leolam
Uman dela paresh amar baena keen penim veleka
Amar rav yosef bar abba ikla rabba bar yirmeya leatrin vaata veayeti matnita bideh goy shehevi avanim min hammarkulis vechipa bahen derachim usratyaot
b: Muttarot yisrael shehevi avanim min hammarkulis vechipa bahen derachim usratyaot asurot velet naggar vela bar naggar deyifrekinah
Amar rav sheshet ana la naggar ana vela bar naggar ana ufarekna leh may kushya leh derav gidel baena keen penim veleka
Amar rav yosef bar abba ikla rabba bar yirmeya leatrin vaata veayeti matnita bideh matliin umzahamin bashsheviit veen matliin umzahamin bammoed
Kan vechan en megazzemin vesachin shemen ligzom ben bammoed ben bashsheviit velet naggar vela bar naggar deyifrekinah

Amar ravina ana la naggar ana vela bar naggar ana umfarekna lah may ka kashya leh ilema moed ashsheviit ka kashya leh may shena sheviit deshare umay shena moed deasur mi dame sheviit melacha asar rachamana tircha shere moed afilu tircha name asur
Veella zihum aggizum ka kashya leh may shena zihum deshare umay shena gizum deasur mi dame zihum okome ilana ushre gizum avroye ilana veasur

Veella zihum azzihum ka kashya leh dekatane matliin umzahamin bashsheviit urminhi mezahamin et hannetiot vechorchin otan vekotmin otan veosin lahem battim umashkin otan ad rosh hashshana ad rosh hashshana in bishviit la

Vedilma kidrav ukva bar chama deamar rav ukva bar chama tere kishkushe hau chad leavroye ilana veasur vechad lesattome pile ushre hachi name tere zihume have chad leokome ilane ushre vechad leavroye ilane veasur
Veella sicha assicha ka kashya leh dekatane sachin shemen ligzom ben bammoed uven bashsheviit urminhi sachin et happaggin umnakkevin umfattemin otan ad rosh hashshana ad rosh hashshana in bishviit la
Mi dame hacha okome ilana ushre hatam pattome pera vaasir

Amar leh rav samma bereh derav ashe leravina bar yirmeya sicha demoed azzihum demoed ka kashya leh mikkedi hay okome vehay okome may shena hay dishre umay shena hay daasir hayenu dekaamar leh let naggar vela bar naggar deyifrekinah

Amar rav yehuda amar rav avoda zara sheovdin otah bemakkel shavar makkel befaneha chayyav zarak makkel befaneha patur amar leh abbaye lerava may shena shavar dahava leh keen zevicha zarak name hava leh keen zerika amar leh baena zerika mishtabberet veleka
Etiveh safat lah tzoa o shennissech lefaneha avit shel meme raglayim

a: Chayyav bishlama avit shel meme raglayim ika zerika mishtabberet ella tzoa may zerika mishtabberet ika betzoa lacha
Lema ketannae shachat lah chagav rabbi yehuda mechayyev vachachamim potrim
May lav beha kamipalgi demar savar amrinan keen zevicha umar savar la amrinan keen zevicha ella keen penim
La dechulle alma la amrinan keen zevicha ella keen penim baenan veshane chagav hoil vetzavaro dome letzavar behema
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav avoda zara sheovdin otah bemakkel shavar makkel befaneha chayyav veneeseret zarak makkel lefaneha chayyav veenah neeseret
Amar leh rava lerav nachman may shena shavar dehaveya leh keen zevicha zarak name haveya leh keen zerika amar leh baenan zerika mishtabberet veleka
Ella meatta avne bet markulis bamme yeasru amar leh af ledidi kashya li ushelteh lerabba bar avuh verabba bar avuh lechiyya bar rav vechiyya bar rav lerav vaamar leh naasa kimgaddel avoda zara
Hanicha leman deamar avoda zara shel goy asura miyyad ella leman deamar ad shetteaved tishtere deha la palchah amar leh kol achat veachat naaset avoda zara vetikrovet lachavertah
I hachi batrayeta miha tishtere amar leh i yadatte lah zil shiklah rav ashe amar kol achat veachat naaset tikrovet leatzmah vetikrovet lachavertah
Tenan matza berosho kesut umaot o chelim hare ellu muttarin parkile anavim vaatarot shel shibbolim veyenot shemanim uslatot vechol davar shekkayyotze bo karev legabbe mizbeach asur
Bishlama yenot shemanim uslatot ika keen penim veika keen zerika mishtabberet ella parkile anavim vaatarot shel shibbolim la keen penim ika vela keen zerika mishtabberet ika
Amar rava amar ulla kegon shebbetzaran mittechilla lechach
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan minnayin lazzoveach behema baalat mum laavoda zara shehu patur shenneemar zoveach laelohim yochoram bilti la levaddo lo asra tora ella keen penim
Have beh rava bemay ilema bedukkin shebbaayin hashta livne noach chazya legavoha bevama didhu laavoda zara mibaya

Ella bimchussar ever vechidrabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar minnayin limchussar ever shehu asur livne noach shenneemar umikkol hachay mikkol basar shenayim mikkol amra tora have behema shechayyin rashe evarin shellah
Hay umikkol hachay mibe leh lemaote terefa millehachaot zera nafka
Hanicha leman deamar terefa enah yoledet ella leman deamar terefa yoledet may ika lememar
Amar kera ittach ittach bedomin lach vedilma noach gufeh terefa hava tamim ketiv beh
Dilma tamim bidrachav tzaddik ketiv beh
Dilma tamim bidrachav vetzaddik bemaasav la matzet amratte denoach gufeh terefa hava dei salka datach noach terefa hava amar leh rachamana dichvatach ayyel shalmin la teayyel
Hashta denafka meittach lehachaot zera lema li i meittach hava amena letzaveta bealma vaafilu zaken vaafilu saris ka mashma lan lehachaot zera

Amar rabbi elazar minnayin lashshochet behema lemarkulis shehu chayyav shenneemar velo yizbechu od et zivchehem lasseirim im eno inyan lichdarkah dichtiv echa yaavdu haggoyim haelle et elohehem tenehu inyan leshello kedarkah
Veha lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidtanya
b: Ad kan hu medabber bekadashim shehikdishan bishat isur habbamot vehikrivan bishat isur habbamot
Shehare onshan amur shenneemar veel petach ohel moed lo hevio vego onesh shamanu azhara minnayin talmud lomar pen taale olotecha
Vechidrabbi avin amar rabbi ila deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila kol makom shenneemar hishshamer ufen veal eno ella belo taase
Mikkan veelach hu medabber bekadashim shehikdishan bishat heter habbamot vehikrivan bishat isur habbamot

Shenneemar lemaan asher yaviu bene yisrael et zivchehem asher hem zovchim shehittarti lecha kevar al pene hassade melammed shekkol hazzoveach bevama bishat isur habbamot maale alav hakkatuv keilu hu zoveach al pene hassade
Veheviam la zo mitzvat ase umitzvat lo taase minnayin talmud lomar velo yizbechu od et zivchehem
Yachol yehe anush karet talmud lomar chukkat olam tihye zot lahem zot lahem velo acheret lahem
Amar rava keri beh velo yizbechu ukri beh velo od
Matni matza berosho maot kesut o chelim hare ellu muttarin parkile anavim vaatarot shel shibbolim veyenot ushmanim uslatot vechol davar shekkayyotze bo karev al gabbe hammizbeach asur

Gema menahane mile amar rav chiyya bar yosef amar rabbi oshaya katuv echad omer vattiru et shikkutzehem veet gillulehem etz vaeven kesef vezahav asher immahem vechatuv echad omer lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem ha ketzad
Immahem dumya daalehem ma alehem davar shel noy asur sheeno shel noy muttar af immahem davar shel noy asur vesheeno shel noy muttar
Veema alehem dumya deimmahem ma immahem kol ma sheimmahem af alehem kol shealehem im ken lo yeamer alehem
Maot davar shel noy hu amri deve rabbi yannay bakkis kashur vetaluy lo betzavaro
Kesut davar shel noy hu amri deve rabbi yannay bichsut mekuppelet umunnachat lo al rosho keli davar shel noy hu amar rav pappa dischifa leh mashkilta aresheh

Amar rav assi bar chiyya kol shehu lifnim min hakkilkelin afilu mayim umelach asur chutz lekilkelin davar shel noy asur sheeno shel noy muttar amar rabbi yose bar chanina naktinan en kilkelin lo lifor velo lemarkulis
Lemay ilema daafilu penim kechutz dame veshare hashta paore mefaarin kammeh mayim umelach la makrevin leh ella afilu chutz kevifnim dame veasur

Matni avoda zara shehaya lah gina o merchatz nehenin mehen shello betova veen nehenin mehen betova haya shellah veshel acherim nehenin mehen ben betova uven shello betova avoda zara shel nochri asura miyyad veshel yisrael en asura ad shetteaved
Gema amar abbaye betova betovat komarin shello betova shello betovat komarin leappoke tovat ovdeha dishre
Ika dematne lah assefa haya shellah veshel acherim nehenin mehen betova veshello betova amar abbaye betova betovat acherim shello betova shello betovat komarin
Man dematne assefa kol shekken aresha uman dematne aresha aval assefa kevan deika acherim bahadah afilu betovat komarin name shappir dame
Avoda zara shel nochri asura miyyad matnitin manni rabbi akiva hi detanya abbed teabbedun et kol hammekomot asher avdu sham haggoyim bechelim shennishtammeshu bahen laavoda zara hakkatuv medabber

Yachol asaum velo gemarum gemarum velo hevium hevium velo nishtammeshu bahen yachol yehu asurim talmud lomar asher avdu sham haggoyim sheen asurin ad sheyyeavdu mikkan amru avoda zara shel nochri enah asura ad shetteaved veshel yisrael asura miyyad divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer chiluf haddevarim avoda zara shel nochri asura miyyad veshel yisrael ad shetteaved
Amar mar bechelim shennishtammeshu bahen laavoda zara hakkatuv medabber ha mekomot ketiv im eno inyan limkomot dela mitasri dichtiv elohehem al heharim velo heharim elohehem

a: Tenehu inyan lechelim mikkan amru avoda zara shel nochri enah asura ella ad shetteaved veshel yisrael miyyad

Veha bechelim okemna lah amar kera asher attem yorshim otam et elohehem makkish elohehem lechelim ma kelim ad sheyyeavedu af elohehem name ad sheyyeavedu verabbi akiva dela makkesh amar lach et hifsik hainyan

Verabbi yishmael ashkechan avoda zara shel nochri deen asura ad shetteaved deyisrael daasura miyyad mena leh sevara hu middenochri ad shetteaved deyisrael asura miyyad ema deyisrael kelal uchlal la hashta geniza baaya itsore la mitasra
Veema kidnochri amar kera veet chattatchem asher asitem et haegel mishsheat asiyya kam leh bechet
Ema hane mile lemekam gavra bechet itsore la mitasra amar kera arur haish asher yaase fesel umassecha mishsheat asiyya kam leh bearur
Ema hane mile lemekam gavra bearur itsore la mitasra toavat Adonai ketiv
Verabbi akiva davar hammevi lide toeva
Verabbi akiva avoda zara shel nochri daasura miyyad mena leh amar ulla amar kera pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh mishsheppisselo naase eloha
Veidach hahu mibe leh lechidtane rav yosef detane rav yosef minnayin legoy shepposel eloho shenneemar pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh
Veidach nafka leh middishmuel dishmuel rame ketiv lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem uchtiv velakachta lach ha ketzad pisselo leeloha lo tachmod pesalo meeloha velakachta lach
Verabbi akiva ashkechan avoda zara shel nochri daasura miyyad deyisrael ad shetteaved menalan amar rav yehuda amar kera vesam bassater ad sheyyaase lah devarim shebbasseter
Veidach hahu mibaya leh lechidrabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak minnayin laavoda zara shel yisrael shetteuna geniza shenneemar vesam bassater

Veidach nafka leh midderav chisda amar rav deamar rav chisda amar rav minnayin laavoda zara shel yisrael shetteuna geniza shenneemar lo titta lecha ashera kal etz etzel mizbach ma mizbeach taun geniza af ashera teuna geniza

Veidach hahu mibe leh lechidresh lakish deamar resh lakish kol hammaamid dayyan sheeno hagun keilu notea ashera beyisrael shenneemar shoftim veshotrim titten lecha bechol shearecha usmich leh lo titta lecha ashera kal etz
Amar rav ashe uvimkom talmide chachamim keilu netao etzel mizbeach shenneemar etzel mizbach

Bae rav hamnuna ritech keli laavoda zara mahu avoda zara deman ilema avoda zara denochri ben lerabbi yishmael uven lerabbi akiva meshammeshe avoda zara hen umshammeshe avoda zara en asurin ad sheyyeavedu ella avoda zara deyisrael
Alliba deman ilema alliba derabbi akiva hashta hi gufah la mitasra ad shetteaved meshammesheha mibaya veella alliba derabbi yishmael deamar asura miyyad
May meshammeshin memashmeshin gamrinan ma hatam ad sheyyeavedu af hacha ad sheyyeavedu o dilma minah gamar ma hi asura miyyad af meshammesheha asurin miyyad
May irya deka mibaya leh ritech keli tibe leh asa
Rav hamnuna mishshum tuma yeshana kamibaya leh ditnan kele mattachot peshutehen umkabbelehen temein nishtabberu taheru chazar vaasaan kelim yachzeru letuma yeshana
Vehachi kamibaya leh ki hadra tuma hane mile letuma deorayeta aval tuma derabbanan la o dilma la shena vetibe leh shear tumot derabbanan
Chada miggo chada kamibaya leh tuma derabbanan mi hadra o la hadra veim timtze lomar la hadra tuma daavoda zara mishshum chumra daavoda zara mi shavveuha rabbanan ketuma deorayeta o la teku
Bae mineh rabbi yochanan merabbi yannay tikrovet avoda zara shel ochalim mahu mi mahane lehu bitul letahorinhu mittuma o la
Vetibe leh kelim kelim la kamibaya leh kevan deit lehu tohora bemikve tuma name batla ki kamibaya leh ochalin
Vetibe leh avoda zara gufah avoda zara gufah la mibaya leh
b: Kevan deisurah batel tuma name batla ki ka mibaya leh tikrovet laavoda zara shel ochlin may kevan deisureh la batel kidrav gidel tuma name la batla o dilma isur deorayeta la batel tuma derabbanan batel teku
Bea mineh rabbi yose ben shaul merabbi kelim sheshshimshu bahen bevet chono mahu sheyyishtammeshu bahen bevet hammikdash
Veka mibaya leh alliba deman deamar bet chono lav bet avoda zara hi ditnan kohanim sheshshimshu bevet chono lo yeshammeshu bammikdash shebbirushalayim veeno tzarich lomar ledavar acher
Kohanim hu dekansinhu rabbanan mishshum divne dea ninhu aval kelim la o dilma la shena
Amar lo asurim hen umikra haya beyadenu ushchachnuhu
Etiveh kol hakkelim asher hizniach hammelech achaz bemalchuto bemaalo hechannu vehikdashnu may lav hechannu deatbelinanhu hikdashnu deakdeshinnanhu
Amar lo baruch atta lashshamayim shehechzarta li avedati hechannu sheggenaznum vehikdashnu shehikdashnu acherim tachtehem
Lema mesayya leh mizrachit tzefonit bah ganzu bet chashmonay et avne hammizbeach sheshshikketzu anshe yavan veamar rav sheshet sheshshikketzu laavoda zara
Amar rav pappa hatam kera ashkach udrash dichtiv uvau vah paritzim vechilleluha
Amri hechi naaved nitberinhu avanim shelemot amar rachamana nenasserinhu lo tanif alehem barzel amar rachamana

Veammay litberinhu velishkelinhu lenafshayehu mi la amar rav oshaya bikkeshu lignoz kol kesef vezahav shebbaolam mishshum kaspa vedahava shel yerushalayim vehavenan bah yerushalayim haveya rubba dealma
Ella amar abbaye bikkeshu lignoz dinara hadreyana turyana shifa mippene tivah shel yerushalayim ad shemmatzu lah mikra min hattora shehu muttar uvau vah paritzim vechilleluha
Hatam la ishtammashu behu legavoha hacha kevan deishtammash behu legavoha lav orach ara leishtammoshe behu hedota
Matni nochri mevattel avoda zara shello veshel chavero veyisrael en mevattel avoda zara shel nochri hamvattel avoda zara mevattel meshammesheha bitel meshammesheha meshammeshin muttarin vehi asura

Gema matne leh rabbi lerabbi shimon berabbi nochri mevattel avoda zara shello veshel chavero amar lo rabbi shanita lanu beyaldutecha nochri mevattel avoda zara shello veshel yisrael deyisrael mi ka mevattelah veha vesam bassater ketiv amar rabbi hilel bereh derabbi vales lo nitzrecha sheyyesh lo bah shuttafut

Beyalduto may kasavar uvziknuto may kasavar beyalduto savar yisrael addata denochri palach kevan denochri mevattel denafsheh deyisrael name mevattelah uvziknuto savar yisrael addata denafsheh palach ki mevattel nochri denafsheh deyisrael la batel
Ika dematne lah assefa yisrael eno mevattel avoda zara shel nochri peshita amar rabbi hilel bereh

a: Derabbi vales lo nitzrecha sheyyesh lo bah shuttafut veka mashma lan yisrael hu dela mevattel denochri aval nochri denafsheh mevattel

Ika dematne lah abbarayeta rabbi shimon ben menasya omer avoda zara shel yisrael en lah betila olamit may olamit amar rabbi hilel bereh derabbi vales lo nitzrecha ella sheyyesh lo legoy bah shuttafut veka mashma lan deyisrael addata denafsheh palach

Matni ketzad mevattelah kata rosh oznah rosh chotmah rosh etzbaah pechasah af al pi shello chisrah bitlah rak befaneha hishtin befaneha gerrah zarak bah et hatztzoa hare zo enah betela mecharah o mishkenah rabbi omer bitel vachachamim omrim lo bitel
Gema ki lo chisrah bemay bitlah amar rav zera sheppechasah befaneha
Rakak befaneha vehishtin befaneha menahane mile

Amar chizkiyya deamar kera vehaya chi yirav vehitkatztzaf vekillel bemalko uvelohav ufana lemala uchtiv batreh veel eretz yabbit vehinne tzara vachashecha vego deaf al gav dekillel malko velohav ufana lemala el eretz yabbit

Mecharah o mishkenah rabbi omer bitel vechu zeeri amar rabbi yochanan verabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav chad amar machloket betzoref goy aval betzoref yisrael divre hakkol bitel vechad amar betzoref yisrael machloket
Ibaya lehu betzoref yisrael machloket aval tzoref goy divre hakkol lo bitel o dilma ben baze uven baze machloket
Ta shema deamar rabbi nirin devaray keshemmecharah lechabbelah vedivre chaveray shemmecharah leovdah
May lechabbelah umay leovdah ilema lechabbelah lechabbelah mammash leovdah leovdah mammash may tama deman deamar bitel umay tama deman deamar lo bitel
Ella lav lechabbelah lemi sheatid lechabbelah umannu tzoref yisrael leovdah lemi sheatid leovdah umannu tzoref goy ushma minah ben baze uven baze machloket
La hachi kaamar amar rabbi nirin devaray lachaveray keshemmecharah lechabbelah umannu tzoref yisrael sheaf chaveray lo nechleku alay ella keshemmecharah leovdah aval lechabbelah modu li
Metivi hallokeach gerutaot min haggoyim umatza bahen avoda zara im ad shello natan maot mashach yachazir im mishshennatan maot mashach yolich leyam hammelach
I amratte bishlama betzoref yisrael machloket ha manni rabbanan hi ella i amratte betzoref goy machloket aval betzoref yisrael divre hakkol bitel ha manni
Shane hatam deaddata digrutaot zabben addata daavoda zara la zabben
Tanu rabbanan lava aleha o shennafla aleha mappolet o sheggenavuha listin o shehinnichuha habbealim vehalchu limdinat hayyam
b: Im atidin lachzor kemilchemet yehoshua enah betela
Utzricha dei tena lava aleha middela zabbenah la battelah aval nafla aleha mappolet middela ka mefanne lah ema battole battelah tzericha
Vei tena nafla aleha mappolet mishshum desavar ha mannecha kol emat devaena lah shakelna lah aval genavuha listim middela ka mahdar abbatrah battole battelah tzericha

Vei tena genavuha listin mishshum desavar i goy shakel lah miflach palach lah i yisrael shakla ayede dedameha yekarin mezabben lah legoy ufalach lah aval hinnichuha habbealim vehalchu limdinat hayyam middela shaklu bahadayehu battole batteluha tzericha
Im atidin lachzor kemilchemet yehoshua enah betela mide milchemet yehoshua mihdar hadur hachi kaamar im atidin lachzor hare hu kemilchemet yehoshua veen lah betila
Ulma li lemitleyah bemilchemet yehoshua milleta aggav orche ka mashma lan ki ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav yisrael shezzakaf levena lehishtachaot lah uva goy vehishtachava lah asarah
Menalan daasarah amar rabbi elazar kattechila shel eretz yisrael deamar rachamana vaasherehem tisrefun baesh mikkede yerushsha hi lahem meavotehem veen adam oser davar sheeno shello
Vei mishshum hanach demeikara bevitula bealma saggi lehu

Ella middiflachu yisrael leegel gallo addatayehu denicha lehu baavoda zara vechi ato goyim shelichuta didhu avdi hachi name yisrael shezzakaf levena galli dateh denicha leh baavoda zara vechi ata goy uflach lah shelichuta dideh kaaved
Vedilma beegel hu denicha lehu bemide acharina la amar kera elle elohecha yisrael melammed sheiuu leelohot harbe
Ema kol devahade egel nitasru mikkan veelach nishtere man mochach
Matni avoda zara shehinnichuha ovdeha bishat shalom mutteret bishat milchama asura bimosyaot shel melachim hare ellu muttarot mippene shemmaamidin otah beshaa shehammelachim ovrim

Gema amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav bet nimrod hare hi kaavoda zara shehinnichuha ovdeha bishat shalom umuttar af al gav dechi badderinhu rachamana kishat milchama dame i baaya beo lemihdar hadur middela hadur battole batteluha
Bimosyaot shel melachim hare ellu muttarot vechi mippene shemmaamidin otah beshaa shehammelachim ovrin muttarin
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan hachi kaamar mippene shemmaamidin otan beshaa shehammelachim ovrin umlachim mannichin derech zo veholchin bederech acheret

Ki ata ulla yatev abbimsa pegima amar leh rav yehuda leulla veha rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu bimos shennifgam asur vaafilu leman deamar en ovdim lishvarim hane mile avoda zara dezila beh milleta lemiflach lishvarim aval hay la ichpat leh

Amar leh man yahev lan meafra derav ushmuel umalinan ayenin ha rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu bimos shennifgam muttar vaafilu leman deamar ovdin lishvarim hane mile avoda zara dechevan defalchah zila beh milta levattolah aval hane shakli lehay umayetu bimos acharina

Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan veresh lakish bimos shennifgam muttar mizbeach shennifgam asur ad sheyyinnatetz rubbo hechi dame bimos hechi dame mizbeach amar rabbi yaakov bar ide amar rabbi yochanan bimos even achat mizbeach avanim harbe

a: Amar chizkiyya may kera besumo kol avne mizbeach keavne gir menuppatzot lo yakumu asherim vechammanim i ika keavne gir menuppatzot lo yekumun asherim vechammanim i lav yakumu

Tana neevad shello asur veshel chavero muttar urminhi ezehu neevad kol sheovdim oto ben beshogeg uven bemezid ben beones uven beratzon hay ones hechi dame lav kegon deanas behemat chavero vehishtachava lah
Amar rame bar chama la kegon sheanasuhu goyim vehishtachava livhemto dideh matkef lah rabbi zera ones rachamana patreh dichtiv velannaara lo taase davar
Ella amar rava hakkol hau bichlal lo taovdem uchshepparat lecha hakkatuv vachay bahem velo sheyyamut bahem yatza ones
Vahadar ketav rachamana velo techallelu et shem kodshi daafilu beones ha ketzad ha betzina veha befarhesya
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava tanya dimsayea lach bimosyaot shel goyim bishat hashshemad af al pi shehashshemad batel otan bimosyaot lo batlu
Amar lehu i mishshum ha la tesayean emar yisrael meshummad hava uflach lah beratzon rav ashe amar la tema emar ella vadday yisrael meshummad hava uflach lah beratzon
Chizkiyya amar kegon shennisech laavoda zara yayin al karneha matkef lah rav adda bar ahava hay neevad hu hay bimos bealma hu vesharyeh

Ella amar rav adda bar ahava kegon shennisech lah yayin ben karneha daavad bah maase vechi ha daata ulla amar rabbi yochanan af al pi sheamru hammishtachave levehemat chavero lo asra asa bah maase asarah
Amar lehu rav nachman puku veemaru leh leulla kevar targemah rav huna lishmatach bevavel deamar rav huna hayeta behemat chavero revutza bifne avoda zara kevan sheshshachat bah siman echad asarah
Mena lan daasarah ilema mikkohanim vedilma shane kohanim divne dea ninhu
Veella meavne mizbeach vedilma kidrav pappa
b: Veella mikkelim dichtiv veet kol hakkelim asher hizniach hammelech achaz bemalchuto bemaalo hechannu vehikdashnu veamar mar hechannu sheggenaznum vehikdashnu shehikdashnu acherim tachtehen veha en adam oser davar sheeno shello
Ella kevan daavad behu maase itsaru lehu hacha name kevan sheasa bah maase asarah

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan af al pi sheamru hammishtachave lekarka olam lo asarah chafar bah borot shichin umarot asarah ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan af al pi sheamru hammishtachave levaale chayyim lo asaran asaan chalifin laavoda zara asaran
Ki ata ravin amar peligu bah rabbi yishmael bar rabbi yose verabbanan chad amar chalifin asurin chalife chalifin muttarin vechad amar afilu chalife chalifin name asurin
May tama deman deamar chalife chalifin asurin amar kera vehayita cherem kamohu kol sheatta mehayye mimmennu hare hu kamohu veidach amar kera hu hu velo chalife chalifin
Veidach hahu mibe leh lemaote orla vechile hakkerem sheim mecharan vekidesh bidmehen mekuddeshet
Veidach orla vechile hakkerem la tzerichi miuta dehaveya lehu avoda zara ushviit shene ketuvin habbain keechad vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Avoda zara ha daamaran sheviit dichtiv ki yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem ma kodesh tofes et damav veasur af sheviit tofeset et dameha vaasura
I ma kodesh tofes et damav veotze lechullin af sheviit tofeset et dameha veotza lechullin talmud lomar tihye bahavayatah tehe

Ha ketzad lakach beferot sheviit basar ellu veellu mitbaarin bashsheviit lakach babbasar dagim yatza basar nichnesu dagim baddagim yayin yatzu dagim nichnas yayin bayyayin shemen yatza yayin venichnas shemen ha ketzad acharon acharon nitpas bishviit ufri atzmo asur
Veidach kasavar shene chetuvin habbain keechad melammedin veitzterich hu lemaotinhu
