Rav nachman amar zeeri lehachmir vehachi kaamar tanna kamma bamme devarim amurim birshuto aval birshut goy acher muttar vela chayeshinan legomlin rabbi shimon ben elazar omer kol reshut goyim achat hi
Tanya kevateh derav nachman amar zeeri lehachmir amar rabbi shimon ben elazar kol reshut goyim achat hi mippene harammain

Deve parzak rufila otivu chamra gabbe arisayehu sevur rabbanan kammeh derava lememar ki chayeshinan legomlin hane mile hecha deka motev hay gabbe hay aval hacha kevan daariseh lav darkeh leotoveh be parzak rufila legomlin la chayeshinan
Amar lehu rava adderabba afilu leman deamar la chayeshinan legomlin hane mile hecha dela mirtat mineh aval hacha kevan demirtat mineh mechappe aleh zechuta
Hahu karcha dahava yatev beh chamra deyisrael ishtechach goy dahava kae bene danne amar rava im nitpas alav kegannav chamra shere vei la asur
Hadaran alach rabbi yishmael

a: Matni hassocher et happoel laasot immo beyen nesech secharo asur secharo laasot immo melacha acheret af al pi sheamar lo haaver li chavit shel yayin nesech mimmakom lemakom secharo muttar hassocher et hachamor lehavi aleha yen nesech secharah asur secharah leshev aleha af al pi shehinniach goy legino aleha secharah muttar
Gema may tama secharo asur ilema hoil veyen nesech asur bahanaa secharo name asur hare orla vechile hakkerem daasurin bahanaa utnan mecharan vekidesh bidmehen mekuddeshet
Ella hoil vetofes et damav kaavoda zara vahare sheviit detofeset et dameha utnan haomer lefoel helach dinar ze lekot li bo yarak hayyom secharo asur lekot li yarak hayyom secharo muttar

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan kenas hu shekkansu chachamim bachamarin uvyen nesech yen nesech ha daamaran chammarin may hi detanya hachammarin shehau osin melacha beferot sheviit secharan sheviit
May secharan sheviit ilema deyahavinan lehu sachar mipperot sheviit nimtza ze porea chovo mipperot sheviit vehattora amra leochla velo lischora
Veella dekadosh secharan bikdushshat sheviit umi kadosh vehatanya haomer lefoel helach dinar ze ulkot li yarak hayyom secharo muttar lekot li yarak bo hayyom secharo asur
Amar abbaye leolam yahavinan leh sachar mipperot sheviit udka kashya lach leochla velo lischora deyahaveh nihaleh betzad heter keditnan lo yomar adam lachavero
b: Haale li perot hallalu lirushalayim lechallek aval omer lo haalem leochlam velishtotam birushalayim venotnin ze laze mattana shel chinnam
Verava amar leolam dekadosh bikdushshat sheviit udka kashya lach poel poel dela nefish agreh la kansuh rabbanan chammarin dinfish agrayehu kenasu rabbanan behu umatnitin chumra deyen nesech shane
Ibaya lehu secharo listam yenan mahu mi amrinan kevan deisura chamur kidyen nesech secharo name asur o dilma hoil vetumato kila af secharo name kil
Ta shema dehahu gavra deogar arbeh listam yenan yehavu leh chite beagra ata lekammeh derav chisda amar leh zil kelinhu vekivrinhu be kivre
Velema leh badderinhu atu behu lide takkala veliklinhu velivadderinhu dilma mezabbeli behu
Velikberinhu beenayehu mi la tenan echad even shenniskal bah veechad etz shennitla alav veechad sayif shenneherag bo veechad sudar shennechnak bo kullam nikbarim immo
Hatam deka kavri beve dina mochcha milta daharuge bet din ninhu hacha la mochcha milta emar inash genav veayeti kevar hacha
Deve rabbi yannay yazfi pere sheviit meaniyyim ufaru lehu bishminit ato amaru leh lerabbi yochanan amar lehu yaut hen avdin
Uchnegdan beetnan muttar detanya natan lah velo ba aleha ba aleha velo natan lah etnanna muttar
Natan lah velo ba aleha peshita kevan dela ba aleha mattana bealma hu deyahev lah vetu ba aleha velo natan lah ha la yahev lah vela mide vechevan dela natan lah may etnanna muttar
Ella hachi kaamar natan lah veachar kach ba aleha o ba aleha veachar kach natan lah etnanna muttar
Natan lah veachar kach ba aleha lechi ba aleha

a: Lechul alah isur etnan lemafrea amar rabbi eliezer keshekkadma vehikrivattu
Hechi dame i deamar lah kenay lich meachshav peshita dishre deha leteh bishat bia umattana bealma hu deyahev lah
Vei dela amar lah kenay lich meachshav hechi matzya makreva veish ki yakdish et beto kodesh amar rachamana ma beto birshuto af kol birshuto
Ella deamar lah leheve gabbich ad sheat bia vei mitzterich lich kenay meachshav
Bae rav hoshaya kadma vehikdishattu mahu kevan deamar mar amirato legavoha kimsirato lehedot keman deakrevteh dame o dilma hashta miha ha kae veiteh beeneh
Vetifshot midderabbi eliezer deamar rabbi eliezer shekkadma vehikrivattu daveka hikrivattu aval hikdishattu la

Derabbi eliezer gufeh ka mibaya leh may mifshat peshita leh lerabbi eliezer dehikrivattu daveka aval hikdishattu la deha iteh bishat bia o dilma hikrivattu peshita leh vehikdishattu mesappeka leh teku
Ba aleha veachar kach natan lah etnannah muttar urminhi ba aleha veachar kach natan lah afilu mikkan ad shalosh shanim etnannah asur
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar rav chisda la kashya ha deamar hitbaali li betale ze ha daamar lah hitbaali betale setam
Vechi amar lah betale ze may have ha mechassar meshicha bezona goya dela kanya bimshicha veibaet ema leolam bezona yisreelit uchgon dekae bachatzerah
I dekae bachatzerah ba aleha veachar kach natan lah ha kanya leh la tzericha deshavveyeh nihalah appoteke daamar lah i mayetena lich zuze mikkan ad yom peloni mutav vei la shikleh beetnannich
Metiv rav sheshet omer adam lachamarav ulfoalav lechu veichlu bedinar ze tzeu ushtu bedinar ze veeno choshesh
b: Lo mishshum sheviit velo mishshum maaser velo mishshum yen nesech
Veim amar lahem tzeu veichlu vaani porea tzeu ushtu vaani porea choshesh mishshum sheviit umishshum maaser umishshum yen nesech
Alma ki ka fara deme isur ka fara hacha name ki ka fara deme isura ka fara
Targemah rav chisda bechenvani hammakkifo demishtabad leh dechevan deorcheh leakkofe kene leh dinar gabbeh
Aval chenvani sheen makkifo may muttar i hachi addetane tzeu veichlu bedinar ze tzeu ushtu bedinar ze liflog velitne bedidah
Bamme devarim amurim bechenvani hammakkifo demishtabad leh aval chenvani sheen makkifo muttar
Veod chenvani sheen makkifo mi la mishtabad vehaamar rava haomer lachavero ten mane lifloni veyikkanu kol nechasay lach kana middin arev
Ella amar rava la shena makkifo vela shena sheen makkifo af al gav dimshabad leh kevan dela meyachad shibudeh la mitsar
Ella hacha ammay choshesh mishshum sheviit ha la meyachad shibudeh hacha amar rav pappa kegon shehikdim lo dinar

Amar rav kahana amritah lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea amar li i hachi addetane tzeu veichlu tzeu ushtu vaani porea tzeu veichlu tzeu ushtu vaani mechashshev mibe leh amar leh teni tzeu vaani mechashshev
Rav ashe amar kegon shennatal venatan bayyad amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe i hachi addetane tzeu veichlu tzeu ushtu telu veichlu telu ushtu mibe leh amar leh tane telu veichlu telu ushtu

Yatev rav nachman veulla vaavimi bar pappi veyatev rabbi chiyya bar amme gabbayehu veyatvi veka mibaya lehu secharo lishbor beyen nesech mahu mi amrinan kevan derotze bekiyyumo asur o dilma kol lemaote tifla shappir dame
Amar rav nachman yishbor vetavo alav beracha lema mesayya leh en odrin im haggoy bechilayim

a: Aval okrin immo kede lemaetoy et hattifla
Savruha ha manni rabbi akiva hi deamar hamkayyem bechilayim loke detanya hamnakkesh vehamchappe bechilayim loke rabbi akiva omer af hamkayyem
May tama derabbi akiva amar kera sadcha lo tizra kilayim en li ella zorea mekayyem minnayin talmud lomar lo kilayim
Veilu lemaote tifla shere
La ha manni rabbanan hi
I rabbanan may irya okrin afilu kayyome name shappir dame hacha bemay askinan kegon deka aved bechinnam verabbi yehuda hi deamar liten lahem mattenat chinnam asur

Midderabbi yehuda nishma lerabbi akiva lav amar rabbi yehuda asur liten lahem mattenat chinnam aval lemaote tifla shappir dame lerabbi akiva name af al gav deamar rabbi akiva hamkayyem bechilayim loke lemaote tifla shappir dame vetu la midi
Hadur yatvi vekamibbaya lehu deme avoda zara beyad goy mahu mi tofeset dameha beyad goy o la
Amar lehu rav nachman mistabbera deme avoda zara beyad goy muttarin middehanhu daato lekammeh derabba bar avuh amar lehu zilu zabbinu kol ma deit lechu vetu itgayyaru
May tama mishshum dekasavar deme avoda zara beyad goy muttarin vedilma shane hatam dechevan dedateh leigayyore vadday battelah
Ella mehacha yisrael shehaya noshe begoy mane umachar avoda zara vehevi lo yen nesech vehevi lo muttar aval im amar lo hamten li ad sheemkor avoda zara veavi lach yen nesech veavi lach asur
May shena resha umay shena sefa amar rav sheshet sefa mishshum dehave leh ki rotze bekiyyumo

Vechi rotze bekiyyumo kehay gavena mi asir vehatnan ger vegoy sheyyarshu avihen goy ger yachol lomar lo tol atta avoda zara vaani maot tol atta yen nesech vaani perot im mishshebbau lirshut hagger asur
Amar rava bar ulla matnitin baavoda zara hammitchalleket lefi shevareha
Tinach avoda zara yen nesech may ika lememar becheres hadreyani
Vahalo rotze bekiyyumo shello yigganevu veshello yeavedu ella amar rav pappa yerushshat hagger kaamratte shane yerushshat hagger deakkilu bah rabbanan gezera shemma yachzor lekilkulo
b: Tanya name hachi bamme devarim amurim sheyyarshu aval nishtattefu asur
Hadur yetavu vekamibaya lehu ger toshav mahu sheyevattel avoda zara defalach mevattel dela palach la mevattel o dilma kol devar mineh mevattel vehay bar mineh hu
Amar lehu rav nachman mistabbera defalach mevattel dela palach la mevattel

Metivi yisrael shemmatza avoda zara bashshuk ad shello bata leyado omer legoy umvattelah mishshebbata leyado eno omer legoy umvattelah mippene sheamru goy mevattel avoda zara shello veshel chavero ben ovdah uven sheen ovdah
May ovdah umay sheeno ovdah ilema ide veide goy hayenu shello veshel chavero ella lav ovdah goy umay sheeno ovdah ger toshav ushma minah ger toshav name mevattel
La leolam ema lach ide veide goy udkaamratte hayenu shello veshel chavero resha ze vaze lifor veze vaze lemarkulis sefa ze lifor veze lemarkulis
Metivi ezehu ger toshav kol shekkibel alav bifne shelosha chaverim shello laavod avoda zara divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim kol shekkibel alav sheva mitzot shekkibbelu alehem bene noach
Acherim omrim ellu lo bau lichlal ger toshav ella ezehu ger toshav ze ger ochel nevelot shekkibbel alav lekayyem kol mitzot haamurot battora chutz meisur nevelot
Meyachadin etzlo yayin veen mafkidin etzlo yayin vaafilu beir sherubbah yisrael aval meyachadin etzlo yayin vaafilu beir sherubbah goyim shamno keyeno
Shamno keyeno salka datach shemen mi ka have yen nesech ella yeno keshamno
Velishar kol davar hare hu kegoy rabban shimon omer yeno yen nesech veamri lah muttar bishtiyya
Katane miha velishar kol devarav hare hu kegoy lemay hilcheta lav dimvattel avoda zara kegoy amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lo liten reshut ulvattel reshut
Vechidtanya yisrael meshummad meshammer shabbatto bashshuk mevattel reshut sheen meshammer shabbatto bashshuk en mevattel reshut mippene sheamru yisrael noten reshut umvattel reshut
Uvgoy ad sheyyiskor ketzad omer lo reshuti kenuya lach reshuti mevuttelet lach kana veen tzarich lizkot
Rav yehuda shaddar leh kurbana

a: Laavidarna beom edam amar yadana beh dela palach laavoda zara amar leh rav yosef vehatanya ezehu ger toshav kol shekkibel alav bifne shelosha chaverim shello laavod avoda zara ki tanya hahi lehachoto
Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan ger toshav sheavru alav shenem asar chodesh velo mal hare hu kemin shebbaummot hatam kegon shekkibel alav lamul velo mal

Rava amti leh kurbana levar sheshach beom edam amar yadana beh dela palach laavoda zara azal ashkecheh deyatev ad tzavvereh bevarda vekayeman zonot arummot kammeh amar leh it lechu kehay gavena lealma deate amar leh didan adifa tefe mehay amar leh tefe mehay mi have amar leh attun ika alayechu emta demalchuta anan la tehve alan emta demalchuta amar leh ana miha may emta demalchuta ika alay
Ad deyatvi ata hahu peristaka demalka amar leh kum dekavae lach malka ki nafek veazel amar leh ena devae lemichze lechu bishuta tifka amar leh rava amen peka eneh devar sheshach

Amar rav pappi ibi leh lememra leh mehay kera benot melachim beyikkerotecha nitztzeva shegal limincha bechetem ofir amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ibi leh lememra leh mehacha ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo
Secharo laasot immo melacha acheret veaf al gav dela amar leh leitote erev
Urminhi hassocher et happoel ulitote erev amar lo haaver chavit shel yayin nesech mimmakom lemakom secharo muttar tama daamar leh leitote erev in kulle yoma la
Amar abbaye ki tenan name matnitin deamar leitote erev tenan rava amar la kashya ha daamar leh haaver li mea chaviyyot bemea perutot ha daamar leh haaver li chavit chavit bifruta

Vehatanya hassocher et happoel veamar lo haaver li mea chaviyyot bemea perutot venimtzet chavit shel yen nesech benehen secharo asur chavit chavit bifruta venimtzet chavit shel yen nesech benehen secharo muttar
Hassocher et hachamor lehavi aleha yen nesech secharo asur ha tu lema li hayenu resha sefa itztericha leh secharah leshev aleha af al pi shehinniach goy legino aleha secharo muttar
Lememra delagin lav dina hu leotoveh

Urminhi hassocher et hachamor socher manniach aleha kesuto ulginato umzonotav shel oto hadderech mikkan veelach chammar meakkev alav chammar manniach aleha seorim veteven umzonotav shel oto hayyom mikkan veelach socher meakkev alav
Amar abbaye nehi delagin dina hu leotove miha i la motev leh mi amrinan leh nakki leh agra dilginato
Hechi dame i dishchiach lemizban chammar name leakkev vei dela shechiach lemizban socher name la leakkev
Amar rav pappa la tzericha dishchiach lemitrach ulmizban meavana leavana chammar darkeh lemitrach ulmizban socher lav darkeh lemitrach ulmizban
Avuh derav acha bereh derav ika
b: Hava shafech lehu chamra legoyim veazel meabbar lehu mabara veyahavu leh gulfe beagra ato amaru leh leabbaye amar lehu ki ka tarach behettera ka tarach
Veha rotze bekiyyumo dela nitztero zike dematne bahadayehu i name demayetu perisdeke pardiske bahadayehu
Veha ka meabbar lehu mabara deka tarach beisura daamar leh lemabbaroya meikara i name dinkiti beh kitre

Matni yen nesech shennafal al gabbe anavim yaddichen vehen muttarot veim hau mevukkaot asurot nafal al gabbe teenim o al gabbe temarim im yesh bahen benoten taam asur umaase bevayetos ben zunen shehevi gerogrot bisfina venishtabbera chavit shel yen nesech venafal al gabbehen veshaal lachachamim vehittirum
Ze hakkelal kol shebbahanaato benoten taam asur kol sheen bahanaato benoten taam muttar kegon chometz shennafal al gabbe gerisin

Gema maase listor chassore michassera vehachi katane im noten taam lifgam hu muttar umaase name bevayetos ben zunen shehaya mevi gerogrot bisfina venishtabbera chavit shel yen nesech venafal al gabbehen uva maase lifne chachamim vehittirum
Hahu karya dechite dinfal aleh chavita deyen nesech sharyeh rava lezabboneh legoyim
Etiveh rabba bar levay lerava beged sheavad bo kilayim hare ze lo yimkerenna legoy velo yaasenna mardaat lachamor aval ose oto tachrichin lemet mitzva
Legoy may tama la dilma ate lezabboneh leyisrael hacha name ate lezabboneh leyisrael
Hadar shera lemitchinhu velimfinhu ulzabboninhu legoyim shello bifne yisrael
Tenan yen nesech shennafal al gabbe anavim yaddichen vehen muttarot veim hau mevukkaot asurot mevukkaot in sheen mevukkaot la amar rav pappa shane chite hoil veaggav tzirayehu kimvukkaot damyan

a: Chamra attika beinve divre hakkol benoten taam chamra chadta beinve abbaye amar bemashshehu verava amar benoten taam
Abbaye amar bemashshehu batar tama azlinan ide veide chad tama hu dehave leh min bemino umin bemino bemashshehu
Verava amar benoten taam batar shema azlinan vehay shema lechud vehay shema lechud vehave leh min besheeno mino umin besheeno mino benoten taam
Tenan yen nesech shennafal al gabbe anavim ku ka salka datin chamra chadta beinve may lav benoten taam la bemashshehu
Ha middekatane sefa ze hakkelal kol shebbahanaato benoten taam asur kol sheen bahanaato benoten taam muttar mikkelal divnoten taam askinan
Veabbaye matnitin bechamra attika beinve

Challa dechamra vechalla deshichra vachamira dechite vachamira disare abbaye amar benoten taam batar tama azlinan vehay tama lechud vehay tama lechud vehave leh min besheeno mino umin besheeno mino benoten taam
Verava amar bemashshehu batar shema azlinan vehay challa mikre vehay challa mikre vehay chamira mikre vehay chamira mikre vahava leh min bemino vechol min bemino bemashshehu

Amar abbaye mena amena lah devatar tama azlinan detanya tavlin shenayim ushlosha shemot vehen min echad o min shelosha asurin umitztarfin veamar chizkiyya hacha bemine metika askinan hoil uruyin lemattek bahen et hakkedera i amratte bishlama batar tama azlinan kulle chad tama hu ella i amratte batar shema azlinan hay shema lechud vehay shema lechud

Verava amar lach ha manni rabbi meir hi detanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi meir minnayin lechol isurin shebbattora shemmitztarfin ze im ze shenneemar lo tochal kol toeva kol shettiavti lach hare hu beval tochal
Challa lego chamra divre hakkol benoten taam chamra lego challa abbaye amar bemashshehu verava amar benoten taam
Abbaye amar bemashshehu
b: Recheh challa vetama chamra challa vehave leh min bemino vechol min bemino bemashshehu
Rava amar benoten taam recheh challa vetama chamra chamra vehave leh min besheeno mino vechol min besheeno mino benoten taam
Hay bat tiha goy bidyisrael shappir dame yisrael bidgoy abbaye amar asur rava amar muttar abbaye amar asur recha milta hi rava amar muttar recha lav milta hi

Amar rava mena amena lah derecha vela kelum hu ditnan tannur shehissiko bechammon shel teruma veafa bo et happat happat mutteret lefi sheen taam kammon ella recha kammon veabbayye shane hatam demikla isureh

Amar rav mari ketannae harode pat chamma untanah al pi chavit shel yayin shel teruma rabbi meir oser verabbi yehuda mattir rabbi yose mattir beshel chitin veoser beshel seorim mippene shehasseorim shoavot may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar recha milta hi umar savar recha vela kelum hu
Lerava vadday tannae hi leabbaye mi lema tannae hi
Amar lach abbaye lav mi itmar alah amar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish befat chamma vechavit petucha

a: Divre hakkol asura befat tzonenet vechavit megufa divre hakkol mutteret lo nechleku ella befat chamma vechavit megufa befat tzonenet vechavit petucha veha didi name kefat chamma vechavit petucha dame
Ze hakkelal kol shebbahanaato benoten taam ku amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hachi hilcheta
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella shennafal letoch gerisin rotchin aval nafal letoch gerisin tzonnin vehirtichan naasa kemi shehishbiach ulvassof pagam veasur

Vechen ki ata ravin amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shennafal letoch gerisin rotchin aval nafal letoch gerisin tzonnin vehirtichan naasa kemi shehishbiach ulvassof pagam veasur vechen ki ata rav dimi ku vechach hau osin bearve shabbatot betzipori vekorin otam shachalayim
Amar resh lakish noten taam lifgam sheamru lo sheyyomru kedera zo chasera melach yetera melach chasera tavlin yetera tavlin ella kol sheen chasera kelum veenah neechelet mippene ze
Veika deamri amar resh lakish noten taam lifgam sheamru en omrin kedera zo chasera melach yetera melach chasera tavlin yetera tavlin ella hashta miha ha pagma
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan kol shettamo umammasho asur lokin alav vezehu kezayit bichde achilat peras
b: Tamo velo mammasho asur veen lokin alav veim riba taam lifgam muttar
Velema im natan taam lifgam muttar ha kamashma lan deaf al gav deika mile achranyata defagmah bahadeh vehilcheta kelishana batra deresh lakish
Amar rav kahana middivre kullam nilmad noten taam lifgam muttar amar leh abbaye bishlama mikkullehu lechayye ella deresh lakish amru kaamar veleh la sevira leh
Mikkelal deika leman deamar noten taam lifgam asur
In vehatanya echad noten taam lifgam veechad noten taam leshevach asur divre rabbi meir rabbi shimon omer leshevach asur velifgam muttar
May tama derabbi meir gamar miggiule goyim giule goyim lav noten taam lifgam hu veasar rachamana hachi name la shena
Veidach kidrav huna bereh derav chiyya deamar rav huna bereh derav chiyya lo asra tora ella kedera bat yoma dela lifgam hu veidach kedera bat yoma name i efshar dela pagma purta
Verabbi shimon may tama detanya lo tochlu kol nevela lagger asher bisharecha kal haruya lagger keruya nevela

a: Sheen reuya leger enah keruya nevela
Verabbi meir hahu lemaote serucha meikara verabbi shimon serucha meikara la tzericha miuta afra bealma hu
Amar ulla machloket shehishbiach ulvassof pagam aval pagam meikara divre hakkol muttar
Etiveh rav chagga leulla yayin shennafal letoch adashim vechometz shennafal letoch gerisin asur verabbi shimon mattir veha hacha difgam meikara hu ufligi
Amar ulla chagga la mida yada may kaamri rabbanan teuvta ka motev hacha bemay askinan kegon shennafal letoch gerisin tzonnin vehirticham naasa kemi shehishbiach ulvassof pagam veasur
Verabbi yochanan amar befogem meikara machloket
Ibaya lehu befogem meikara machloket aval hishbiach ulvassof pagam divre hakkol asur o dilma ben bazo uven bazo machloket teku
Amar rav amram efshar ita leha derabbi yochanan vela tanya lah bematnitin

Nefak dak veashkach detanya seor shel chullin shennafal letoch haisa veyesh bo kede lehachmitz vehechmitza veachar kach nafal seor shel teruma o seor shel kile hakkerem veyesh bo kede lehachmitz asur verabbi shimon mattir
Veha hacha difgam meikara hu ufligi
Amar rabbi zera shane isa hoil uruya lechammea bah kamma isot acherot

Ta shema seor shel teruma veshel chullin shennaflu letoch haisa beze kede lehachmitz uvze kede lehachmitz vechimtzu asur verabbi shimon mattir nafal shel teruma techilla divre hakkol asur nafal shel chullin veachar kach nafal shel teruma o shel kile hakkerem asur verabbi shimon mattir
Veha hacha difgam meikara ufligi vechi tema hacha name
b: Kidrabbi zera ta shema missefa hayyayin shennafal letoch adashim vechometz shennafal letoch gerisin asur verabbi shimon mattir veha hachi name difgam meikara ufligi
Vechi tema hacha name kidshanni leh ulla lerabbi chagga keshehishbiach ulvassof pagam umi peligi keshehishbiach ulvassof pagam veha katane nafal shel teruma techilla divre hakkol asur
Ella lav shema minah bifgam meikara machloket shema minah
Hane telata bave dekatane lema li bishlama bava desefa ka mashma lan befogem meikara machloket metziata name hishbiach ulvassof pagam divre hakkol asur
Ella resha lema li hashta uma sefa dela ka mashbach kelal asri rabbanan resha deka mashbach mibaya
Amar abbaye resha lerabbi shimon itzterich vehachi kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi shimon isa zo reuya lehachmitz bishte shaot mi garam lah shettachamitz beshaa achat isur
Verabbi shimon keshehishbichu shenehem hishbichu kesheppagmu shenehem pagmu
Lerabbi shimon litztaref heter veisur bahade hadade velitsar
Rabbi shimon letameh deamar afilu isur veisur name la mitztarfi
Ditnan haorla vechile hakkerem mitztarfin rabbi shimon omer en mitztarfin
Hahu achbera dinfal lechavita deshichra asreh rav lehahu shichra amruha rabbanan kammeh derav sheshet nema kasavar noten taam lifgam asur
Amar lehu rav sheshet bealma savar rav noten taam lifgam muttar vehacha chidush hu deha mimas meis uvdili inashe mineh vaafilu hachi asreh rachamana hilkach noten taam lifgam name asur
Amaru leh rabbanan lerav sheshet ella meatta litamme lach veyavesh allema tenan metammein lachim veen metammein yeveshim
Ultamach shichvat zera tetamme lach veyavesh allema tenan metammein lachin veen metammein yeveshin
Ella may it lach lememar shichvat zera amar rachamana biruya lehazria hacha name bemotam amar rachamana keen motam
Matkef lah rav shimi minnehardea umi meis vahalo ole al shulchan shel melachim amar rav shimi minnehardea la kashya ha biddavra ha bidmata

Amar rava hilcheta noten taam lifgam muttar veachbera beshichra la yadana may tama derav i mishshum dekasavar noten taam lifgam asur velet hilcheta kevateh i mishshum dekasavar noten taam lifgam muttar veachbera beshichra ashboche mashbach
Ibaya lehu

a: Nefal lego challa may amar leh rav hilel lerav ashe hava ovada be rav kahana vaasar rav kahana amar leh hahu imartute imartat
Ravina sevar leshaore bima vechad amar la gara mitteruma ditnan teruma ola beechad umea amar leh rav tachlifa bar giza leravina dilma ketavlin shel teruma bikdera dame dela batel tamayehu
Rav achay shaar bechalla bechamshin rav shemuel bereh derav ika shaar beshichra beshitin
Vehilcheta ide veide beshitin vechen kol isurin shebbattora

Matni nochri shehaya maavir im yisrael kadde yayin mimmakom lemakom im haya bechezkat hammishtammer muttar im hodio shehu maflig kede sheyyishtom veyistom veyiggov rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kede sheyyiftach et hechavit veyiggof vetigov
Hammanniach yeno bekaron o bisfina vehalach lo bekafendarya nichnas limdina verachatz muttar
Im hodio shehu maflig kede sheyyishtom veyistom veyiggov rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kede sheyyiftach et hechavit veyiggof vetigov
Hammanniach nochri bachanut af al pi sheyyotze venichnas muttar veim hodio shehu maflig kede sheyyishtom veyistom veyiggov rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kede sheyyiftach et hechavit veyiggof vetigov

Haya ochel immo al hashshulchan vehinniach leginin al hashshulchan velagin al haddulbeki vehinnicho veyatza ma sheal hashshulchan asur sheal haddulbeki muttar veim amar lo heve mozeg veshote af sheal haddulbeki asur chaviyyot petuchot asurot setumot muttarot kede sheyyiftach veyiggof vetigov

Gema hechi dame bechezkat hammishtammer kidtanya hare shehau chamarav ufoalav teunin teharot afilu hiflig mehen yoter mimmil tohorotav tehorot veim amar lahen lechu vaani ba acharechem kevan shennitallema eno mehem tohorotav temeot
May shena resha umay shena sefa amar rav yitzchak resha bimtaher chamarav ufoalav lechach
I hachi sefa name en am haaretz makpid al magga chavero i hachi afilu resha name nema hachi
Amar rava
b: Beva lahem derech akallaton i hachi sefa name kevan deamar lahem lechu vaani ba acharechem samcha datayehu
Hammanniach nochri bachanuto ku hammanniach yeno bekaron o bisfina ku utzricha dei tena nochri desavar dilma ate vechaze leh aval bekaron o bisfina ema demafleg lah lisfinteh veaved may devae
Vei tena bekaron o bisfina mishshum desavar dilma ate beorcha achariti vekae aggudda vechaze li aval nochri bachanuto ema ached leh levava veaved kol devae ka mashma lan
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan machloket beshel sid aval beshel tit divre hakkol kede sheyyiftach veyiggof veyiggov
Metivi amar rabban shimon ben gamliel lachachamim vahalo sittumo nikar ben millemala uven millematta
I amratte bishlama beshel tit machloket hayenu dekatane sittumo nikar ben millemala uven millematta ella i amratte beshel sid machloket bishlama lematta yedia ella lemala ha la yedia

Rabban shimon ben gamliel hu dela yada may kaamri rabbanan vehachi kaamar lehu i beshel tit kaamritu sittumo nikar ben millemala uven millematta vei beshel sid kaamritu nehi dilmala la yedia lematta miha yedia verabbanan kevan demillemala la yedia la massik addateh deafech vachaze leh i name zimnin dechalem
Amar rava halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel hoil utnan setama kevateh

Ditnan haya ochel al hashshulchan immo vehinniach lagin al hashshulchan lagin al haddulbeki vehinniach veyatza ma sheal hashshulchan asur ma sheal haddulbeki muttar veim amar lo heve mozeg veshote af sheal haddulbeki asur chaviyyot petuchot asurot setumot muttarot kede sheyyiftach veyiggof vetigov
Peshita mahu detema kullah rabban shimon ben gamliel katane lah ka mashma lan

Vechi meachar dekayema lan kevateh derabban shimon ben gamliel dela chayesh leshittuma vehilcheta kevateh derabbi eliezer dela chayesh leziyyufa haidana may tama la motvinan chamra beyad goyim mishshum shayeka
Amar rava zona goya veyisrael mesubbin etzlah chamra shere nehi detakef lehu yitzra daavera

a: Yitzra deyen nesech la takef lehu zona yisreelit vegoyim mesubbin chamra asur may tama hoil vezila alayehu batrayehu gerira
Hahu beta dahava yatev beh chamra deyisrael al goy achdah ledashsha beappeh vahava biza bedashsha ishtechach goy dekae bene danne amar rava kol delahade biza shere dehay gisa vehay gisa asir

Hahu chamra deyisrael dahava yatev beveta dahava dayar yisrael baelona vegoy battachtona shemau kal tigra nafki kedem ata goy achdah ledashsha beappeh amar rava chamra shere memar amar ki hechi dikdem atay ana kedem vaata yisrael veyatev baelona veka chaze li
Hahu ushpiza dahava yatev beh chamra deyisrael ishtechach goy dahava yatev be danne amar rava im nitpas alav kegannav shere vei la asir

Hahu beta dahava yatev beh chamra ishtechach goy dahava kaem be danne amar rava i it leh leishtemote chamra asir vei la chamra shere metivi ninal happundak o sheamar lo shemor asur may lav af al gav delet leh leishtemote la bidit leh leishtemote
Hahu yisrael vegoy dahao yatvi veka shatu chamra shema yisrael kal tzalloye be chenishta kam vaazal amar rava chamra shere memar amar hashta middechar leh lechamreh vehadar ate
Hahu yisrael vegoy dahao yatvi bearba shema yisrael kal shipure deve shimshe nefak vaazal amar rava chamra shere memar amar hashta middechar leh lechamreh vehadar ate

Vei mishshum shabbeta haamar rava amar li isur giyyora ki havenan bearmautan amrinan yehudae la menatteri shabbeta dei menatteri shabbeta kamma kise ka mishtachchi beshuka vela yadana disvira lan kerabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak hammotze kis beshabbat molicho pachot pachot mearba ammot
Hahu arya dahava nahem bematzarta shema goy tesha bene danne amar rava chamra shere memar amar ki hechi detashena ana itsha name yisrael achoray veka chaze li
Hanhu gannave desalki lefumbedita uftachu chavyata tuva amar rava chamra shere may tama rubba gannave yisrael ninhu hava ovada binhardea veamar shemuel chamra shere
Keman kerabbi eliezer deamar sefek bia tahor

Ditnan hannichnas levika bimot haggeshamim vetuma besade pelonit veamar halachti bammakom hallaz veeni yodea im nichnasti leotah sade im lo nichnasti rabbi eliezer omer sefek bia tahor sefek magga tame
La shane hatam kevan deika defatchi leshum mamona have leh sefek sefeka
b: Hahi revita deishtechach dahavat be danne vahavat nekita ufya bidah amar rava chamra shere emar miggabbah dechavita shekalteh veaf al gav deleka tu emar itremoye itremi lah

Hahu pulmusa dislek linhardea petachu chavyata tuva ki ata rav dimi amar ovada hava kammeh derabbi elazar ushra vela yadana i mishshum desavar lah kerabbi eliezer deamar sefek bia tahor i mishshum desavar rubba deazli bahade pulmusa yisrael ninhu
I hachi hay sefek bia sefek magga hu kevan demippatchi tuva ema addata demamona petachu vechisfek bia dame
Hahi masovita dimsara lah iklida maftecha legoya amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi elazar ovada hava be midresha vaamaru lo masra lah ella shemirat mafteach bilvad
Amar abbaye af anan name tenena hammoser maftechot leam haaretz tohorotav tehorot lefi shello masar lo ella shemirat mafteach bilvad hashta tohorotav tehorot yen nesech mibaya
Lememra ditharot allimi miyyen nesech in deitmar chatzer shechillekah bimsifas amar rav tohorotav temeot uvgoy eno ose yen nesech verabbi yochanan amar af tohorotav tehorot
Metivi happenimit shel chaver vehachitzona shel am haaretz oto chaver shoteach sham perot umanniach sham kelim veaf al pi sheyyado shel am haaretz maggaat lesham kashya lerav
Amar lecha rav shane hatam shennitpas alav kegannav

Ta shema rabban shimon ben gamliel omer gaggo shel chaver lemala miggaggo shel am haaretz oto chaver shoteach sham perot umanniach sham kelim uvilvad shello tehe yado shel am haaretz maggaat lesham kashya lerabbi yochanan
Amar lach rabbi yochanan shane hatam deit leh leishtemote memar amar imtzore ka mimmetzarna

Ta shema gaggo shel chaver betzad gaggo shel am haaretz oto chaver shoteach sham perot umanniach sham kelim veaf al pi sheyyado shel am haaretz maggaat lesham kashya lerav amar lecha rav lav ika rabbi shimon ben gamliel dekae kevati ana daamari kerabbi shimon ben gamliel
Matni boleshet shennichnesa leir bishat shalom chaviyyot petuchot asurot setumot muttarot bishat milchama ellu veellu muttarot lefi sheen penay lenassech

a: Gema urminhi ir shekkevashuha karkom kol kohanot shebbetochah pesulot amar rav mari lenassech en penay livol yesh penay
Matni haummanin shel yisrael sheshshalach lahem nochri chavit shel yen nesech bischaran muttar lomar ten lanu et dameha mishshennichnesa lirshutan asur
Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav muttar laadam lomar legoy tze vehafes alay menat hammelech
Metivi al yomar adam legoy ul tachtay laotzer amar leh rav ul tachtay laotzer kaamratte ha la damya ella leha aval omer lo malleteni min haotzer
Matni hammocher yeno lenochri pasak ad shello madad damav muttarin madad ad shello pasak damav asurin

Gema amar ammemar meshicha begoy kona tidda dehane parsae meshadderi pardashne lahadade vela hadri behu rav ashe amar leolam ema lach meshicha begoy enah kona vehay dela hadri behu deramut rucha hu dinkita lehu

Amar rav ashe mena amena lah middeamar lehu rav lehanhu savoyata ki chayelitu chamra legoyim shiklu zuze minayehu vahadar kayelan kayelu lehu vei la nekitu bahadayehu zuze ozifunhu vahadar shekilu minayehu ki hechi detihve halvaa gabbayehu dei la avditu hachi ki ka have yen nesech birshutayechu ka have vechi shaklitu deme yen nesech ka shaklitu vei salka datach meshicha begoy kona
b: Middemashcheh goy kanyeh yen nesech la have ad denaga beh
I deka chayel verame lemana deyisrael hachi name la tzericha deka chayel verame lemana degoy
Sof sof ki meta leavera demana kanyeh yen nesech la have ad demate leariteh demana shema minah nitztzok chibbur
La i denaket leh goy lichli bideh hachi name la tzericha demannach aara
Vetikne leh kilo shamatte minah kilo shel lokeach birshut mocher lo kana lokeach
La leolam ema lach kana lokeach vehacha bemay askinan kegon deika akkevet yayin appummah dechuzanta dekamma kamma insech leh
Uchman dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel dei rabban shimon ben gamliel haamar yimmacher kullo legoyim chutz middeme yen nesech shebbo
Mide hu tama ella lerav haamar rav halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel chavit bechavit aval lo yayin beyayin

Metivi hallokeach gerutaot min haggoyim umatza bahen avoda zara im ad shello natan maot mashach yachazir im mishshennatan maot mashach yolich leyam hammelach i salka datach meshicha begoy kona ammay yachzir amar abbaye mishshum demichaze ki mikkach taut

Amar rava resha mikkach taut sefa lav mikkach taut ella amar rava resha vesefa mikkach taut veresha dela yahev zuze la mitchaze kaavoda zara beyad yisrael sefa deyahev zuze mitchaze kaavoda zara beyad yisrael

Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe ta shema hammocher yeno lenochri pasak ad shello madad damav muttarim vei amratte meshicha begoy enah kona ammay damav muttarin hacha bemay askinan deakdem leh dinar
I hachi ema sefa madad ad shello pasak damav asurin vei dekadem leh dinar ammay damav asurin
Amar leh uldidach deamratte meshicha begoy kona ammay resha damav muttarin vesefa damav asurin
Ella may it lach lememar pasak samcha dateh lo pasak la samcha dateh
Ledidi name af al gav dikdem leh dinar pasak samcha dateh lo pasak la samcha dateh

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ta shema deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan ben noach neherag al pachot mishshave peruta velo nitan lehishavon vei amratte meshicha begoy enah kona ammay neherag
Mishshum detzaareh leyisrael

a: Umay lo nitan lehishavon deeno betorat hishavon
I hachi ema sefa ba chavero untalah mimmennu neherag aleha bishlama resha mishshum detzaareh leyisrael ella sefa may aved
Ella shema minah meshicha begoy kona shema minah
Hahu gavra daamar leh lechavreh i mezabbenna lah leha ara lach mezabbenna lah azal zabbenah leinish acharina amar rav yosef kena kamma
Amar leh abbaye veha la pesak umna temra dechol hecha dela pesak la kena ditnan hammocher yeno lenochri pasak ad shello madad damav muttarin madad ad shello pasak damav asurin
May have alah may have alah kidkaamrinan dilma chumra deyen nesech shane

Ta shema deamar rav idi bar avin ovada hava be rav chisda verav chisda be rav huna ufashtuha meha ditnan mashach chamarav ufoalav vehichnisan letoch beto ben pasak ad shello madad uven madad ad shello pasak lo kana ushnehen yecholin lachazor bahen
Perkan vehichnisan letoch beto pasak ad shello madad en shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen madad ad shello pasak shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen

Hahu gavra daamar leh lechavreh i mezabbenna lah leha ara mezabbenna lach bima zuze azal zabbenah leinish acharina bima veesrin amar rav kahana kena kamma matkef lah rav yaakov minnehar pekod hay zuze ansuh vehilcheta kerav yaakov minnehar pekod
Amar leh kidshayemi bitlata afilu tere miggo telata kidamri bitlata ad deamri bitlata kidshayemi bearbea ad deamri bearbaa vechol shekken hecha daamar leh kidamri bearbaa

Amar leh kidshayemi bitlata vaato telata veshamuha vaamar leh idach leto telata acharine dekim lehu tefe amar rav pappa dina hu dimakkev matkef lah rav huna bereh derav yehoshua mimmay dehane kim lehu tefe dilma hane kim lehu tefe vehilcheta kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua

Matni natal et hammashpech umadad letoch tzelochito shel nochri vechazar umadad letoch tzelochito shel yisrael im yesh bo akkevet yayin asur hamare mikkeli el keli et sheera mimmennu muttar veet sheera letocho asur
Gema tenan hatam hannitztzok vehakkatafres umashke tofeach eno chibur lo letuma velo letohora haashboren chibur letuma ultohora
Amar rav huna nitztzok vekatafres umashke tofeach chibur leinyan yen nesech

Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna mena lach ha ilema midditnan hannitztzok vehakkatafres umashke tofeach eno chibur lo letuma velo letohora letuma ultohora hu dela have chibur ha leinyan yen nesech have chibur ema sefa haashboren chibur letuma ultohora letuma ultohora hu dehave chibur ha leinyan yen nesech la have chibur ella meha leka lemishma minah
Tenan natal et hammashpech umadad letoch tzelochito shel nochri vechazar umadad letoch tzelochito shel yisrael
b: Im yesh bo akkevet yayin asur ha akkevet yayin bemay ka mittasra lav benitztzok shema minah nitztzok chibur
Tane rabbi chiyya sheppechasattu tzelochito aval lo pechasattu tzelochito may la tifshot denitztzok eno chibur la pechasattu tzelochito tifshot lach deasur nitztzok tibe
Ta shema hamare mikkeli lichli et shemmeare mimmennu muttar ha devene bene asur shema minah nitztzok chibur
I nitztzok chibur afilu degaveh demana name litsar ha la kashya deka mekattef kattofe mikkol makom nitztzok chibur
Ultamach ema sefa et sheera letocho hu daasir ha devene bene shere ella meha leka lemishma minah
Ta shema hamare mechavit labbor kiluach hayyored missefat chavit lematta asur targemah rav sheshet begoy hamare deate mikkocho
I goy hamare afilu gava dechavita name mittesar koach degoy midderabbanan hu daasir hahu dinfak levaray gezaru beh rabbanan hahu dilgavay la gezaru beh rabbanan

Amar lehu rav chisda lehanhu savoyata ki chayelitu chamra legoyim katfi kattifu kattofe i name naftzi nappitzu nappotze amar lehu rava lehanhu shafochae ki shafchitu chamra la likrav goy lesayya bahadayechu dilma mishtelitu veshadetu leh aleh vekaate mikkocho vaasir
Hahu gavra deassek chamra begishta uvat gishta ata goy annach yedeh aggishta asreh rava lechulleh chamra
Amar leh rav pappa lerava veamri lah rav adda bar matna lerava veamri lah ravina lerava bemay benitztzok shamatte minah nitztzok chibur shane hatam dechulle chamra aggishta uvat gishta gerir
Amar mar zutra bereh derav nachman kenishkenin shere vehane mile dikdem pesak yisrael aval kedem pesak goy la rabba bar rav huna ikla leve resh galuta shera lehu lemishte biknishkenin

a: Ika deamri rabba bar rav huna gufeh ishti biknishkenin
Matni yen nesech asur veoser bechol shehu yayin beyayin umayim bemayim bechol shehu yayin bemayim umayim beyayin benoten taam
Ze hakkelal min bemino bemashshehu veshello bemino benoten taam
Gema ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan hamare yen nesech mechavit labbor afilu kol hayyom kullo rishon rishon batel
Tenan yen nesech asur veoser bechol shehu may lav deka nafel isura lego hettera la deka nafel hettera lego isura
Ta shema yayin bemayim benoten taam may lav deka nafel chamra deisura lemayya dehettera la deka nafel chamra dehettera lemayya deisura

Umidderesha bemayya deisura sefa name bemayya deisura vekatane sefa mayim beyayin benoten taam amar lecha rav dimi kullah matnitin hettera lego isura veresha deka nafel chamra dehettera lemayya deisura sefa deka nafel mayya dehettera lachamara deisura

Ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan hamare yen nesech mitztzartzur katan levor afilu kol hayyom kullo rishon rishon batel vedaveka tzartzur katan dela nefish ammudeh aval chavit dinfish ammudeh la
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan yen nesech shennafal labbor venafal sham kiton shel mayim roin et haheter keilu eno vehashshear mayim ravin alav umvattelin oto
Ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shennafal kiton shel mayim techilla aval lo nafal sham kiton shel mayim techilla matza min et mino veneor

Ika dematne lah ammatnitin yayin beyayin kol shehu amar rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shello nafal sham kiton shel mayim aval nafal sham kiton shel mayim roin et haheter keilu eno vehashshear mayim ravin alav umvattelin oto
May ika ben lidmatne lah ammatnitin ben lidmatne lah adderavin man dematne lah ammatnitin la bae techilla uman dematne lah adderavin bae techilla
Itmar yen nesech shennafal labbor venafal sham kiton shel mayim
b: Amar chizkiyya higdilu beisur asur higdilu beheter muttar
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu higdilu beisur muttar
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera lema chizkiyya verabbi yochanan biflugta derabbi eliezer verabbanan kamipalgi
Ditnan seor shel chullin veshel teruma shennaflu letoch haisa lo baze kede lechammetz velo baze kede lechammetz venitztarfu vechimmetzu
Rabbi eliezer omer achar acharon ani ba vachachamim omrim ben shennafal isur battechilla uven bassof eno asur ad sheyehe bo kede lehachmitz
Vetisbera vehaamar abbaye lo shanu ella shekkadam vesilek et haisur aval lo kadam vesilek et haisur asur chizkiyya deamar keman
Ella hacha beroin kamipalgi lechizkiyya let leh roin lerabbi yochanan it leh
Umi it leh lerabbi yochanan roin veha bae mineh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan shene kosot echad shel chullin veechad shel teruma umzagan veervan ze baze mahu vela peshat leh

Ultamach ha detanya baasotah achat yachid haose mippi atzmo chayyav behoraat bet din patur ketzad horu bet din shechelev muttar venoda leechad mehen shettau o talmid yoshev lifnehen verauy lehoraa kegon shimon ben azzay yachol yehe patur talmud lomar baasotah achat yachid haose al pi atzmo chayyav behoraat bet din patur

Ze hakkelal hattole beatzmo chayyav leetoye may leetoye mevaet behoraa
Tole bevet din leetoye horu bet din veyadu shettau vechazru bahen ha behedya katane lah tane vahadar mefaresh

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel zo divre rabbi yehuda aval chachamim omrim yachid sheasa behoraat bet din chayyav may rabbi yehuda detanya im nefesh achat techeta vishgaga baasotah hare ellu shelosha miutin haose mippi atzmo chayyav behoraat bet din patur

Bemay ilema beshiggat maase bet din shello behoraa bet din may avidtayehu shello behoraat bet din bet din mi mayetu shello behoraa ella behoraa veha ki ketiv meam haaretz beshiggat maase hu dichtiv
Ella lav hachi kaamar miut kahal shechatu beshiggat maase chayyavin sheen bet din meviin al yedehen par behoraa ha hen chayyavin
Yachol rov tzibbur sheasu beshiggat maase yehu peturin shehare bet din meviin alehem par behoraa talmud lomar meam haaretz afilu rubbo
Amar rav pappa mimmay dilma lo hen velo bet din

Ella lav middela mehaddar al miut demichayevin beshiggat maase uvsof mehaddar al rubba lechiyyuva beshiggat maase shema minah miut behoraa chayyavin hen kisba usira veshello behoraa beshiggat maase chayyavin
Mikkede tarvayehu setame tenan mimmay dekammayeta rabbi yehuda uvatrayeta rabbanan ema ipcha man shamatte leh dedaresh miute ki hay gavena rabbi yehuda hi detanya rabbi yehuda omer

Detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshemo chatu shishsha vehen rubbo shel kahal o shiva af al pi sheenan rubbo shel kahal chayyavin

Vetanya name gabbe nasi kehay gavena asher nasi yecheta perat lakkodmot

Matni kohen gadol porem millematta vehahedot milmala kohen gadol makriv onen velo ochel vehahedot lo makriv velo ochel
Gema amar rav lematta lematta mammash lemala lemala mammash ushmuel amar lematta lematta mikkamme safa lemala lemala mikkamme safa veze vaze batztzavar
Metivi al kol hammetim kullan ratza mavdil kamme safa shello ratza eno mavdil kamme safa shello al aviv veal immo mavdil kevan divalma have kera keri kan begadav lo yifrom

Matni kol hattadir mechavero kodem et chavero vechol hamkuddash mechavero kodem et chavero par hammashiach ufar haeda omdim par hammashiach kodem lefar haeda bechol maasav
Gema mena hane mile amar abbaye deamar kera millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid lema li mikkede ketiv olat habboker olat hattamid lema li hachi kaamar rachamana kol ditdira kadma
Vechol hamkuddash mechavero hu kodem et chavero menalan detana deve rabbi yishmael vekiddashto lechol davar shebbikdushsha liftoach rishon ulvarech rishon velitol mana yafa rishon

a: Par kohen mashuach ufar eda ku mena hane mile detanu rabbanan vesaraf oto kaasher saraf et happar harishon ma talmud lomar harishon sheyehe rishon kodem lefar haeda bechol maasav

Tanu rabbanan par kohen mashiach ufar haeda omdim par kohen mashiach kodem lefar haeda bechol maasav hoil umashiach mechapper veeda mitkapperet din hu sheyyakdim hamchapper lammitkapper vechen hu omer vechipper baado uvad beto uvad kol kehal yisrael

Par avoda zara kodem lisir avoda zara ammay hay chattat vehay ola amri bemareva mishshemeh derava bar mari chattat avoda zara chassira alef lechattat ketiv rava amar kammishpat ketiv beh
Seir avoda zara kodem lisir nasi may tama hay tzibbur vehay yachid seir nasi kodem lisirat yachid may tama hay melech vehay hedot

Seirat yachid kodemet lechivsat yachid veha tanya kivsat yachid kodemet lisirat yachid amar abbaye tannae hi mar savar seira adifa shekken nitrabbeta etzel avoda zara beyachid umar savar kivsa adifa shekken nitrabbeta bealya
Omer kodem lecheves habba immo shette hallechem kodmim lichvasim habbaim immahem ze hakkelal davar habba begin laom kodem ledavar habba begin lechem
Matni haish kodem laishsha lehachaot ulhashev aveda vehaishsha kodemet laish lichsut ulhotzi mibbet hashshevi bizman sheshshenehem omdim bekalkala haish kodem laishsha
Gema tanu rabbanan haya hu veaviv verabbo bashshevi hu kodem lerabbo verabbo kodem leaviv immo kodemet lechullam
Chacham kodem lemelech yisrael chacham shemmet en lanu kayyotze bo melech yisrael shemmet kol yisrael reuyim lammalchut
Melech kodem lechohen gadol shenneemar vayyomer hammelech alehem lahem kechu immachem o meavde et avde adonechem vego

Kohen gadol kodem lenavi shenneemar umashach oto sham tzadok hakkohen venatan hannavi hikdim tzadok lenatan veomer shema na yehoshua hakkohen haggadol atta vereecha vego yachol hedotot hau talmud lomar ki anshe mofet hemma veen mofet ella navi shenneemar venatan elecha ot o mofet

Segan kodem laamarkal may amarkal amar rav chisda amar kolla amarkal kodem legizbar gizbar kodem lerosh mishmar rosh mishmar kodem lerosh bet av rosh bet av kodem lechohen hedot
Ibaya lehu leinyan tuma segan umshuach milchama eze mehem kodem

Amar mar zutra bereh derav nachman ta shema detanya segan umshuach milchama shehau mehallechim badderech ufaga bahem met mitzva mutav sheyyittamme meshuach milchama veal yittamme segan sheim yeera bo pesul bechohen gadol nichnas hassegan umshammesh tachtav vehatanya meshuach milchama kodem lassegan amar ravina ki tanya hahi lehachoto

Matni kohen kodem lelevi levi leyisrael yisrael lemamzer umamzer lenatin venatin leger veger leeved meshuchrar ematay bizman shekkullam shavim aval im haya mamzer talmid chacham vechohen gadol am haaretz mamzer talmid chacham kodem lechohen gadol am haaretz

Yisrael kodem lemamzer shezze meuchas veze eno meuchas mamzer kodem lenatin ze ba mittippa keshera veze ba mittippa pesula natin kodem leger ze gadal immanu bikdushsha veze lo gadal immanu bikdushsha ger kodem leeved meshuchrar ze haya bichlal arur veze lo haya bichlal arur
Ematay bizman shekkullan shavin ku mena hane mile amar rav acha berabbi chanina deamar kera yekara hi mippeninim mikkohen gadol shennichnas lifnay velifnim
Tanya rabbi shimon bar yochay omer baddin hu sheyyakdim eved meshuchrar leger shezze gadal immanu bikdushsha veze lo gadal immanu bikdushsha ella ze haya bichlal arur veze lo haya bichlal arur

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi eliezer mippene ma hakkol moshlim baachbarim mippene shessuran ra may hi rava amar afilu gelime gayetzi

Haragil beshemen zayit mesayya leh lerabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan keshem shehazzayit meshakkeach talmud shel shivim shana kach shemen zayit meshiv talmud shel shivim shana

Vehattovel etzbao bemelach amar resh lakish uvachat ketannae rabbi yehuda omer achat velo shettayim rabbi yose omer shettayim velo shalosh vesimanach kemitza

Rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok omer af bevet hammishte osim otam senifim amar rava bechayye avihem bifne avihem

Ashkechan zevicha shear avodot menalan
Vechi tema lelaf mizzevicha ma lizvicha shekken posel shello leshem ochlin bappesach

Neemra zevicha beshinuy kodesh veneemra zevicha beshinuy vealim ma zevicha haamura beshinuy kodesh lo chillakta ben zevicha lishar avodot af zevicha haamura beshinuy vealim lo techallek bahen ben zevicha lishar avodot
Ika lemifrach ma leshinuy kodesh shekken pesulah begufah veyeshno bearba avodot
Veyeshno leachar mita veyeshno betzibur kivyachid
b: Veaf al gav detarte lav daveka tarte miha daveka
May shena shinuy vealim dela have pesulo begufo machshava bealma shinuy kodesh name machshava bealma hu ella kevan deachshevah paslah hacha name kevan deachshevah paslah
Ulrav pinchas bereh derav mari deamar yesh shinuy vealim leachar mita tarte miha ika lemifrach
Ella amar rav ashe amar kera venirtza lo lechapper alav velo al chavero
Vehay lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidtanya venirtza lo lechapper alav rabbi shimon omer et shealav chayyav beachrauto veet sheeno alav eno chayyav beachrauto
Veamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi may tama kevan deamar alay keman detaun leh akkatpeh dame
Rav ashe mivvenirtza lo lechapper kaamar
Ashkechan zevicha uzrika kabbala menalan
Vechi tema lelaf mizzevicha uzrika ma lizvicha uzrika shekken avoda shechayyavin aleha bachutz
Ella amar rav ashe atya meel nazir dichtiv veet haayil yaase zevach shelamim shettehe asiyyato leshem shelamim veim eno inyan leshinuy kodesh denafka leh mehatam tenehu inyan leshinuy vealim
Amar leh rav acha bar abba lerava ema yaase kalal zevach parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat zevicha in mide acharina la
I ketiv yaase shelamim zevach kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv yaase zevach shelamim have leh kelal sheeno male vechol kelal sheeno male en danin oto bichlal ufrat
Ravina amar leolam danin vela chazar vechalal

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina veha la dame kelala kamma lichlala batra kelala kamma merabbe asiyyot vetu la kelala batra kol la vaafilu shefichat shirayim vehaktarat emurin ha tanna deve rabbi yishmael bichlale ufrate daresh ki hay gavena
Kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash avoda uvaenan lishman af kol avoda uvaenan lishman
I ma happerat meforash avoda vechayyavin aleha bachutz af kol avoda vechayyavin aleha bachutz shechita uzrika in kabbala veholacha la
I name ma happerat meforash davar hattaun tzafon veyeshno bechattaot happenimiyyot af kol hattaun tzafon veyeshno bechattaot happenimiyyot shechita vekabbala in zerika la
Ika lememar hachi veika lememar hachi shekulin hen veyavou shenehen lishana acharina vachada chada teku bemilta
Ibaet ema zerika midderav ashe nafka
Ashkechan el nezir shear shelamim menalan
Vechi tema nelaf meel nazir ma leel nazir shekken yesh immahen damim acherim
Im ken nichtov shelamav may shelamim lerabbot kol shelamim
Ashkechan shelamim shear kol kodashim menalan
Vechi tema nelaf mishshelamim ma lishlamim shekken teunin semicha unsachim utnufat chaze vashok

Ella amar kera zot hattora laola velammincha velachattat velaasham velammilluim ulzevach hashshelamim hakkishan hakkatuv lishlamim ma shelamim ben shinuy kodesh ben shinuy vealim baenan lishmah af kol ben shinuy kodesh ben shinuy vealim baenan lishmah
Ema hecha deshachet lehu shello lishmah lipaslu
Amar kera motza sefatecha tishmor veasita kaasher nadarta vego hay nedava neder hu ella im kema shennadarta asita yehe neder veim lav yehe nedava
Veitzterich motza sefatecha veitzterich zot hattora dei ketav rachamana motza hava amena

a: La yada bemay ketav rachamana zot hattora vei ketav rachamana zot hattora hava amena lipaslu ketav rachamana motza sefatecha
Reme resh lakish al meohi be midresha umakshe im kesherim hem yeratztzu veim en meratztzin lamma bain
Amar lo rabbi eliezer elazar matzinu bevain leachar mita shehen kesherin veen meratztzin ditnan haishsha shehevia chattatah umeta yaviu yorshin olatah olatah umeta lo yaviu yorshin chattatah
Amar leh modena lach beola deatya leachar mita asham dela ate leachar mita menalan
Amar leh hare machloktecha betzido rabbi eliezer omer af haasham
Amar zehu sheomrin alav adam gadol hu kaamena ana mishna shelema veatte amratte li rabbi eliezer
Ella amar resh lakish eftach ana pitcha lenafshay motza sefatecha vego hay nedava neder hu ku kedilel

Yatev rabbi zera verabbi yitzchak bar abba veyatev abbaye gabbayehu veyatvi vekaamri kashya leh leresh lakish asham dela ate leachar mita venasev lah talmuda motza sefatecha ema habba beneder uvindava leyte vela liratztze asham la leyte kelal
Amar lehu abbaye resh lakish mehacha petach veshachat otah lechattat otah lishmah keshera shello lishmah pesula ha shear kodashim shello lishman kesherin yachol yeratztzu talmud lomar motza sefatecha
Veema habba beneder undava leyte vela liratztze asham name artzoye name liratztze
Amar abbaye asham demiratztze la matzet amratte kal vachomer meola uma ola sheenah mechapperet enah meratztza asham shemmechapper eno din sheeno meratztze
Ma leola shekken kalil
Shelamim yochichu
Ma lishlamim shekken teunin nesachin utnufat chaze vashok

Ola tochiach vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shehen kodashim ushchatan shello lishman kesherin veen meratztzin af ani avi asham shehu kodesh ushchato shello lishmo kasher veeno meratztze
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yeshno betzibur
Toda tochiach
b: Ma letoda shekken teuna lechem

Ola ushlamim yochichu vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shehen kodashim ushchatan shello lishman kasher veeno meratztze af ani avi asham shehu kodesh ushchato shello lishmo kasher veeno meratztze
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shehen bain beneder uvindava
Ella amar rava zot hattora vego hikkisho hakkatuv lishlamim ma shelamim shehen kodashim ushchatan shello lishman kesherim veen meratztzin af ani avi asham shehu kodesh ku
May chazet deakkeshte lishlamim akkesh lechattat
Ha maet rachamana otah
Siman
Yatev rav huna verav nachman veyatev rav sheshet gabbayehu veyatvi vekaamri kashya leh leresh lakish asham dela ate leachar mita lema leh rabbi elazar asham name ate leachar mita
Amar lehu rav sheshet asham lemay karev lemotaro chattat name mikrav karva motarah
Chattat af al gav dekarva motarah miet rachamana hu
Asham name ketiv beh hu
Hahu leachar haktarat emurim hu dichtiv kidtanya aval asham lo neemar bo hu ella leachar haktarat emurin vehu atzmo im lo haktiru emurin kasher
Veella hu lema li lechidrav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav asham shennitak liriyya ushchato setam kasher
Nitak in lo nitak la may tama amar kera hu bahavayato yehe

Yatvi rav nachman verav sheshet veyatev rav adda bar matna gabbayehu veyatvi vekaamri ha dekaamar rabbi elazar matzinu bevain leachar mita shehen kesherin veen meratztzin lema leh resh lakish hanhu name leyto veliratztzo
Amar lahen rav adda bar matna yoledet im hi yalda baneha mi yaldu
Matkef lah rav assi uman lema lan dei ika kamma ase gabbah la mitkappera vechevan dechi ika kamma ase gabbah mikappera yorsheha name mikappar
Lememra dekanya lehu vehaamar rabbi yochanan hinniach mincha lishne vanav vamet kereva veen bo shuttafut vei salka datach kanya lehu nefesh amar rachamana
Vela kanya lehu vehaamar rabbi yochanan hinniach behema lishne vanav vamet kereva veen memirin bah i amratte bishlama kanya lehu hayenu deen memirin bah dehaveya lehu keshuttafin

a: Veshuttafin la matzu memirin ella i amratte la kanya lehu amore name limru
Shane hatam deamar kera im hamer yamir lerabbot et hayyoresh echad memir veen shenayim memirin
Matkef lah rav yaakov minnehar pekod ella meatta gabbe maaser dichtiv veim gaol yigal lerabbot et hayyoresh hachi name echad goel veen shenayim goalin
Shane maaser degabbe avuhon name iteh beshuttafut
Amar leh rav assi lerav ashe uminah i amratte bishlama kanya lehu hayenu dechad miha memar ella i amratte la kanya lehu hechi memar
Vehaamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan hammakdish mosif chomesh umitkapper ose temura vehattorem mishshello al shel chavero tovat hanaa shello
Mikkiva la mechappera mikkufya mechappera
Ibaya lehu kipru al ma shebbau o lo kipru
Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi mistabbera delo kipru dei salka datach kipru sheni lama hu ba
Veella may lo kipru lama hu karev
Amar rav ashe rav shisha bereh derav idi hachi ka kashya leh i amratte bishlama lo kipru shello lishmo mikkoach lishmo kaate vesheni lama hu ba lechapper ella i amratte kipru sheni lama hu ba
Ibaya lehu aase dilachar hafrasha mechappera o la mechappera
Mi amrinan mide dehave achattat ma chattat dekodem hafrasha in dilachar hafrasha la af hacha name dekodem hafrasha in leachar hafrasha la
O dilma la damya lechattat dechattat al kol chet vechet bae leetoye chada chattat vehacha kevan deika kamma ase gabbeh mechappera aase dilachar hafrasha name mechappera

Ta shema vesamach venirtza vechi semicha mechapperet vahalo en kappara ella baddam shenneemar ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper ella ma talmud lomar vesamach venirtza lechapper sheim asaah lismicha sheyare mitzva maale alav hakkatuv keilu lo kiper vechiper
May lav dechiper ase dekodem hafrasha lo kiper aase dismicha dehave leh ase dilachar hafrasha
Amar rava ase dismicha kaamratte shane hatam dechol kamma dela shachet baamod usmoch kae emat ka have ase leachar shechita leachar shechita la ka mibaya lan
Amar leh rav huna bar yehuda lerava ema kiper gavra
b: Lo kiper kamme shemayya

Mi la tenan vehannotar bashshemen asher al kaf vego lechapper alav lifne Adonai im natan kiper veim lo natan lo kiper divre rabbi akiva rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer sheyare mitzva hen ben nitan ben shello nitan kiper umaalin alav keilu lo kiper
May keilu lo kiper ilema demibbee leetoye korban acharina haamratte ben nitan ben lo nitan kiper ella kiper gavra lo kiper kamme shemayya hacha name kiper ku
Hatam name kiper mattan behonot lo kiper mattenot harosh
Ta shema rabbi shimon omer kivse atzeret lama hen bain
Kivse atzeret shelamim ninhu ella seire atzeret lama hen bain
Al tumat mikdash vekadashav
Nizrak damo shel rishon sheni lamma karev al tuma sheora ben ze laze emor meatta reuyin hau yisrael lehakriv korbenotehen bechol et uvchol shaa ella shechisech hakkatuv
Veha hacha daase dilachar hafrasha veka mechappera
I deafreshinhu bevat achat hachi name hacha bemay askinan deafreshinhu beze achar ze
Veleko velema leh likra dechi ketiva beze achar ze ketiva
Amar rav pappa korbenot tzibbur kaamratte shane korbenot tzibbur delev bet din kamatne alehen kidrav yehuda amar shemuel deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel korbenot tzibbur sakkin moshachtan lema shehen

Amar leh rav yosef bereh derav shemuel lerav pappa umi it leh lerabbi shimon lev bet din matne alehen haamar rav idi bar avin amar rav amram amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan temidin shello hutzrechu latztzibbur

a: Ledivre rabbi shimon en nifdin temimim ledivre chachamim nifdin temimin

Veod ha bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera seire atzeret shekkibbel daman bishne kosot venizrak damo shel rishon sheni lama hu ba al tuma sheora ben zerika shel ze laze nizrak damo shel sheni lama hu kerevin
Ad kan la mibaya leh ella ase dilachar shechita aval asa dilachar hafrasha la ka mibaya leh
Dilma im timtze lomar kaamar
Itmar toda sheshshechatah leshem todat chavero keshera rabba amar keshera rav chisda amar pesula
Rabba amar keshera toda leshem toda nishchata rav chisda amar pesula leshum shelamim dideh nishchata baenan

Amar rabba mena amena lah detanya uvsar zevach todat shelamav beom hakrivo et zivcho vego abba chanin amar mishshum rabbi eliezer ba lelammed toda sheshshechatah leshem shelamim keshera shelamim shennishchatu leshem toda pesulim uma hefresh ben ze laze toda keruya shelamim veen shelamim keruyin toda
Shelamim leshem toda pesula ha toda leshem toda keshera may lav dechavreh
La dideh
Aval dechavreh may pesula addetane shelamim leshem toda pesula litne toda leshem toda vechol shekken shelamim leshem toda
Shelamim leshem toda dideh itzterich leh salka datach amena middetoda keruya shelamim shelamim name keruyin toda vechi shachet lehu leshem toda likashsheru ka mashma lan
Amar rava chattat sheshshechatah leshem chattat keshera leshem ola pesula
May tama veshachat otah lechattat amar rachamana vahare chattat leshem chattat nishchata leshem ola pesula
Veamar rava chattat sheshshechatah al mi shemmechuyyav chattat pesula al mi shemmechuyyav ola keshera
May tama vechipper alav alav velo al chavero chavero dumya dideh bimchuyyav kappara kemoto
Veamar rava chattat sheshshechatah al mi sheeno mechuyyav kelum pesula sheen lecha adam beyisrael sheeno mechuyyav ase
Veamar rava chattat mechapperet al chayyave ase mikkal vechomer al chayyave charetot mechapperet al chayyave ase lo kol shekken
Lememra devat minah hi vehaamar rava chattat sheshshechatah al mi shemmechuyyav chattat pesula al mi shemmechuyyav ola keshera
b: Mikkiva la mechappera mikkufya mechappera
Veamar rava ola sheshshechatah shello lishmah asur lizrok damah shello lishmah
Ibaet ema kera ibaet ema sevara ibaet ema kera motza sefatecha tishmor vego ibaet ema sevara mishshum deshanni bah ku kidresh pirka
Veamar rava ola habbaa leachar mita shechatah beshinuy kodesh pesula beshinuy bealim keshera deen bealim leachar mita

Verav pinchas bereh derav amme amar yesh bealim leachar mita amar leh rav ashe lerav pinchas bereh derav amme daveka kaamar mar yesh bealim leachar mita uvae leetoye ola achariti o dilma dei ika kamma ase gabbeh mechappera
Amar leh daveka kaamena
Veamar rava ola doron hi hechi dame i deleka teshuva zevach reshaim toeva vei deika teshuva hatanya avar al mitzvat ase veshav lo zaz mishsham ad shemmochalim lo ella shema minah doron hu
Chattat al mi mechapper ola leachar doron siman
Tanya name hachi amar rabbi shimon chattat lamma baa lamma baa lechapper ella lamma baa lifne ola lifraklit shennichnas ritza peraklit nichnas doron acharav
Chutz min happesach vehachattat ku pesach menalan
Dichtiv shamor et chodesh haaviv veasita pesach sheyehu kol asiyyotav leshem pesach
Ashkechan shinuy kodesh shinuy bealim menalan
Dichtiv vaamartem zevach pesach hu shettehe zevicha leshem pesach im eno inyan leshinuy kodesh tenehu inyan leshinuy vealim
Ashkechan lemitzva leakkev menalan
Amar kera vezavachta pesach la elohecha vego

Matkef lah rav safra hay vezavachta lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidrav nachman deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh minnayin lemotar pesach shekkarev shelamim shenneemar vezavachta pesach la elohecha tzon uvakar vahalo en pesach ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim mikkan lemotar happesach sheyehe ledavar habba min hatztzon umin habbakar umay nihu shelamim
Ella amar rav safra vezavachta pesach lechidrav nachman shamor et chodesh haaviv lemitzva beshinuy kodesh vaamartem zevach pesach beshinuy bealim lemitzva hu leakkev ben hacha vehacha
Veashkechan zevicha shear avodot menalan hoil vegalli galli
Rav ashe amar hoil vegalli galli la amrinan ella avodot menalan dichtiv zot hattora laola velammincha vego
Vetanya beom tzaoto et bene yisrael lehakriv et korbenehem ze bechor umaaser vafesach
Hikkisho hakkatuv lishlamim ma shelamim ben shinuy kodesh ben shinuy vealim baenan lemitzva af kol ben shinuy kodesh ben shinuy vealim lemitzva
Vechishlamim ma shelamim ben zevicha ben shear avodot lo chalakta bahen lemitzva af pesach lo tachlok bo ben zevicha lishar avodot leakkev mishshum shenneemar hu bizvicha eno ella leakkev
Ella hu lema li
Kidtanya neemar befesach hu bishchita leakkev aval asham lo neemar bo hu ella leachar haktarat emurin vehu atzmo shello hukteru emurav kasher
Chattat menalan dichtiv veshachat otah lechattat shettehe shechita leshem chattat
Ashkechan shechita kabbala menalan dichtiv

a: Velakach hakkohen middam hachattat shettehe kabbala leshem chattat
Veashkechan shechita vekabbala zerika menalan deamar kera vechipper alav hakkohen mechattato shettehe kappara leshem chattat
Ashkechan shinnuy kodesh shinnuy bealim menalan amar kera alav alav velo al chavero
Ashkechan lemitzva leakkev menalan kidamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chattatchattato hacha name chattatchattato
Ashkechan mitzva beshinnuy kodesh uzrika beshinnuy bealim ben lemitzva ben leakkev leakkev bechol avodot beshinnuy kodesh uvishar avodot beshinnuy bealim ben lemitzva ben leakkev menalan
Amar rabbi yona atya mechattat nazir dichtiv vehikriv hakkohen lifne Adonai veasa et chattato veet olato sheyehu kol asiyyotav leshem chattat
Ashkechan shinnuy kodesh shinnuy bealim menalan im eno inyan leshinnuy kodesh tenehu inyan leshinnuy bealim ashkechan lemitzva leakkev menalan
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chattatchattato
Matkef lah ravina ella meatta olatolato may darshatte beh
Ulravina minchatminchato nesechnisko may darshatte behu
Hahu mibbee leh minchatam veniskehem ballayela minchatam veniskehem afilu lemachar ella olatolato may darshatte behu
Vetu mi gamri mehadade chattat chelev mechattat nazir la gamra shekken yesh immah damim acherim chattat nazir mechattat chelev la gamra shekken karet
Ella amar rava atya mechattat metzora dichtiv veasa hakkohen et hachattat sheyehu kol asiyyotav leshem chattat
Veashkechan shinnuy kodesh shinnuy bealim menaleh amar kera vechipper al hammittaher vego al hammittaher ze velo al hammittaher chavero
Veakkatti mi yalfa mehadade chattat chelev mechattat metzora la yalfa shekken yesh immah damim acherim chattat metzora mechattat chelev la gamra shekken karet
Mechada la atya tete chada mittarte
Behe la lichtov la lichtov rachamana bechattat chelev vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken yesh immahem damim acherim
La lichtov rachamana bechattat nazir vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken en lahen sheela
La lichtov rachamana bechattat metzora vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken en bain bedallut

Ella amar kera zot hattora laola velammincha vego hikkisho hakkatuv lishlamim ma shelamim ben shinnuy kodesh ben shinnuy bealim baenan lishman lemitzva af chattat ben shinnuy kodesh ben shinnuy bealim baenan lishman lemitzva
Hilkach mitzva mishshelamim vehanach kerae leakkev
Veashkechan chattat chelev dichtiv bah lachattat
b: Chattat daavoda zara dishmiat hakkol uvittuy sefatayim vetumat mikdash vekadashav dela ketiv behu menalan
Chattat daavoda zara atya mechattat chelev shekken karet kemotah vehanach kullehi atyan bema hatztzad
Tanu rabbanan pesach bizmanno lishmo kasher shello lishmo pasul uvishar yemot hashshana lishmo pasul shello lishmo kasher
Siman
Mena hane mile amar avuh dishmuel amar kera veim min hatztzon korbano lezevach shelamim la davar habba min hatztzon yehe lezevach shelamim
Ema shelamim in mide acharina la amar rabbi ila amar rabbi yochanan lezevach lerabbot kol zevach
Ema kol deshachet leheve kemotah
I hava ketiv lishlamim vezevach kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv lezevach shelamim lechol deshachet leh shelamim leheve
Ema lezevach kalal shelamim parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat shelamim in mide acharina la
La hadar vechalal
Matkef lah rav yaakov minnehar pekod ha la dame kelala batra lichlala kamma kelala kamma merabbe zevachim vetu la kelala batra la kol dela vaafilu leofot vaafilu limnachot
Ha tanna deve rabbi yishmael bichlale ufrate daresh ki hay gavena
Kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash shehu shello lishmo vechasher af kol shehu shello lishmo vechasher
I ma happerat meforash davar habba beneder uvindava af kol habba beneder uvindava ola ushlamim in chattat veasham lo
Ella lezevach ribbuya hu
Ema lechol deshachet leh leheve kevateh
Amar rabbi avin

a: Dochin kadashim hanneechalim etzel kadashim hanneechalin veen dochin kadashim hanneechalin etzel kadashim sheenan neechalin
Attu chattat veasham mi la mitachli
Ella dochin kadashim hanneechalin lechol adam etzel kadashim hanneechalin lechol adam veen dochin kadashim hanneechalin lechol adam etzel kadashim sheen neechalin lechol adam
Rabbi yose berabbi avin amar dochin kadashim kallim etzel kadashim kallim veen dochin kadashim kallim etzel kodshe kadashim
Matkef lah rav yitzchak berabbi savriu savrin ema shachteh leshem maaser leheve maaser lemay hilcheta dela live nesachim ulmilke aleh belo yimmacher belo yiggael
Amar kera haasiri yihye kodesh ze maaser veen acher maaser
Ema shachteh leshem bechor leheve kivchor lemay hilcheta dela live nesachim i name delitveh lechohanim
Bechor name avarahavara mimmaaser gamar
Veema shachteh leshem temura leheve temura lemay hilcheta lemilke aleh i name lemekam aleh belo yimmacher velo yiggael
Amar mar zutra bereh derav nachman amar kera vehaya hu utmurato zo temura veen acher temura
Veema shachteh leshem toda leheve ki toda lemay hilcheta lehatino lechem
Mi ika mide defesach gufeh la bae lechem umotaro bae lechem
I hachi hashta name mi ika mide defesach gufeh la bae nesachim umotaro bae nesachim
Anan hachi kaamrinan mi ika mide demotar toda atzmah la bae lechem veilu motar deatya lehu mealma baaya lechem
Matkef lah rav yemar bereh derav hilel umimmay divmotar pesach ketiv dilma bemotar asham ketiv
Amar rava amar kera veim min hatztzon korbano lezevach shelamim davar hashshave bechol hatztzon
Matkef lah rabbi avin bar chiyya veitema rabbi avin bar kahana bechol atar atte amratte min lehotzi vechan min lerabbot
Amar rabbi mani hacha name min lehotzi dela ate ben shette shanim vela ate binkeva
Matkef lah rav chana bagdataa umi matzet amratte dechi ketiv hay bemotar pesach ketiv veha middichtiv im kesev im ez mikkelal delav bemotar pesach ketiv
Hahu mibe leh lechidtanya keves lerabbot et happesach lealya

Keshehu omer im keves lerabbot pesach sheibra shenatah ushlamim habbaim mechamat pesach lechol mitzvat shelamim sheyyittaanu semicha unsachim utnufat chaze veshok keshehu omer im ez hifsik hainyan limed al haez sheenah teuna alya
Veha mehacha nafka middaavuh dishmuel nafka deamar avuh dishmuel veim min hatztzon korbano lezevach shelamim davar habba min hatztzon yehe lezevach shelamim

Veakkatti midderav nachman amar rabba bar avuh nafka deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh minnayin lemotar pesach shekkarev shelamim shenneemar vezavachta pesach la elohecha tzon uvakar vahalo en pesach ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim ella mikkan lemotar happesach sheyehe ledavar habba min hatztzon umin habbakar umay nihu shelamim
Ella telata kerae ketivi
b: Chad leibra zemanno veibra shenato vechad leibra zemanno velo shenato vechad lelo ibra lo zemanno velo shenato
Utzrichi dei ketav rachamana chad hava amena hecha deibra shenato uzmanno deidchi mippesach ligmare aval ibra zemanno velo shenato dachaze lefesach sheni ema la
Vei ketav rachamana hane tarte mishshum deidchi lehu mimmiltayehu aval hecha dela ibber lo zemanno velo shenato dachaze lefesach ema la tzerichi
Amar rav mishshemeh demavog chattat sheshshechatah leshum chattat nachshon keshera deamar kera zot torat hachattat tora achat lechol hachattaot
Yatev rava vekaamar lah leha shemata etiveh rav mesharsheya lerava rabbi shimon omer kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman kesherot vealu labbealim leshum chova
Lefi sheen hammenachot domot lizvachim shehakkometz machavat leshem marcheshet maaseha mochichin aleha shehi machavat chareva leshem belula maaseha mochichin shehi chareva
Aval bizvachim eno ken shechita achat lechullan kabbala achat lechullan zerika achat lechullan
Tama demaaseha mochichin ha en maaseha mochichin la ammay lema zot torat hammincha tora achat lechol hammenachot
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav mishshemeh demavog chattat sheshshechatah al menat sheyyitkapper bah nachshon keshera en kappara lemetim
Velema met bealma
Ha ka mashma lan tama demet ha dechay dumya denachshon pesula umay nihu chattat nazir vechattat metzora
Hane olot ninhu
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav mishshemeh demavog chattat sheshshechatah al shemmechuyyav chattat kenachshon keshera chattat nachshon ola hi
Ika deamar amar rav mishshemeh demavog chattat sheshshechatah leshem chattat nachshon pesula chattat nachshon ola hi
Velema chattat nazir vechattat metzora ikar chattat naket
Amar rav chattat chelev sheshshechatah leshem chattat dam leshem chattat avoda zara keshera
Leshem chattat nazir leshem chattat metzora pesula hane olot ninhu
Bae rava chattat chelev sheshshechatah leshem chattat detumat mikdash vekadashav mahu mi amrinan karet kemotah
O dilma en kavua kemotah
Rav acha bereh derava matne kullehu lifsula may tama veshachat otah lechattat leshem otah chattat
Amar leh rav ashe lerav acha bereh derava baya derava hechi matnitu lah

Amar leh anan beshinuy bealim matnenan lah vehachi matnenan lah amar rava chattat chelev sheshshechatah al mi shemmechuyyav chattat dam vechattat avoda zara pesula al mi shemmechuyyav chattat nazir vechattat metzora keshera
Uvaayin lah hachi bae rava chattat chelev sheshshechatah al mi shemmechuyyav chattat detumat mikdash vekadashav mahu mi amrinan karet kemotah o dilma en kavua kemotah
Teku
Itmar shechatah lishmah lizrok damah shello lishmah rabbi yochanan amar pesula veresh lakish amar keshera
Rabbi yochanan amar pesula mechashshevin meavoda laavoda veyalfinan mimmachshevet pigul
Veresh lakish amar keshera en mechashshevin meavoda laavoda vela yalfinan mimmachshevet pigul
Veazdu letamayehu deitmar

a: Hashshochet et habbehema al menat lizrok damah laavoda zara ulhaktir chelbah laavoda zara rabbi yochanan amar asura mechashshevin meavoda laavoda veyalfinan chutz mibbifnim
Resh lakish amar mutteret en mechashshevin meavoda laavoda vela yalfinan chutz mippenim
Vei ashmeinan beha beha amar resh lakish aval penim mippenim ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan
Vei ashmeinan ha beha kaamar rabbi yochanan aval behahi ema mode leh leresh lakish tzerichi
Ki ata rav dimi amar metiv rav yirmeya lesayyoeh lerabbi yochanan verabbi ila lesayyoeh leresh lakish

Rav yirmeya lesayyoeh lerabbi yochanan uma bimkom sheim amar hareni shochet chutz lizmanno shehu kasher shechato al menat lizrok damo chutz lizmanno pasul makom sheim amar hareni shochet shello lishmo pasul shechato al menat lizrok damo shello lishmo eno din sheyehe pasul
Matkef lah rava bar ahilay ma lechutz lizmanno shekken karet

Ella amar rava bar ahilay hachi kaamar uma makom sheim amar hareni shochet chutz limkomo shehu kasher shechato al menat lizrok damo chutz limkomo pasul makom sheim amar hareni shochet shello lishmo shehu pasul shechato al menat lizrok damo shello lishmo eno din sheyehe pasul
Matkef lah rav ashe ma lechutz limkomo shekken noheg bechol hazzevachim tomar beshello lishmo sheeno noheg ella befesach vechattat

Ella amar rav ashe hachi kaamar uma bemakom sheim amar hareni shochet leshem peloni shehu kasher lizrok damo shello lishmo leshem peloni pasul makom sheim amar hareni shochet shello lishman shehu pasul shechato al menat lizrok daman shello lishman eno din sheyehe pasul
Rabbi ila lesayyoeh leresh lakish lo tomar bizrika vetete mikkal vachomer mibbenayya mishshechita vekabbala lemay hilcheta ketav rachamana lomar deen mechashshevin meavoda laavoda
Matkef lah rav pappa vedilma dimchashshevin meavoda laavoda
Im ken lishtok kera mineh vetete mikkal vachomer derav ashe
Veidach parech hachi ma lehanach shekken teunot tzafon veyeshnan bechattaot happenimiyyot
Veidach hashta miha bishlamim kayyamin
Itmar shechatah lishmah lizrok damah shello lishmah rav nachman amar pesula rabba amar keshera vahadar beh rabba legabbe rav nachman mikkal vachomer derav ashe
Rabbi eliezer omer af et haasham tanya amar rabbi eliezer chattat baa al chet veasham ba al chet ma chattat shello lishmah pesula af asham shello lishmo pasul
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua lo im amarta bechattat shekken damah lemala
Amar lo rabbi eliezer pesach yochiach sheddamo lematta ushchato shello lishmo pasul
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua ma lefesach shekken zemanno kavua
Amar lo rabbi eliezer chattat tochiach
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua
b: Chozrani chalila
Chazar rabbi eliezer vedano din acher chattat neemar bah hi bishchita hi lishmah keshera shello lishmah pesula ufesach neemar bo hu bizvicha hu lishmo kasher shello lishmo pasul
Af asham neemar bo hu hu lishmo kasher shello lishmo pasul

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua chattat neemar bah hi bishchita hi lishmah keshera shello lishmah pesula pesach neemar bo hu bizvicha hu lishmo kasher shello lishmo pasul aval asham lo neemar bo hu ella leachar haktarat emurin vehu atzmo shello hukteru emurin kasher
Amar lo rabbi eliezer hare hu omer kachattat kaasham ma chattat shello lishmo pasul af asham shello lishmo pasul
Amar mar amar lo rabbi yehoshua chozrani chalila ulmihdar dina velayete bema hatztzad
Mishshum deika lemifrach ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahen tzad karet
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua lo im amarta bechattat shekken damah lemala velema leh lo im amarta bechattat shekken nichnas damah lifnay velifnim
Bechattaot hachitzonot kaamrinan
Sheim nichnas damah lifnay velifnim pesula
It leh lerabbi eliezer af haasham
Shekken mechapperet al chayyave charetot
Mechattat dishmiat hakkol
Shekken teuna arba mattanot
Kerabbi yishmael deamar kol haddamim teuna teunin arba mattanot
Shekken teuna al arba keranot
Velitamach haika etzba haika keren haika chuddah ella chad mittere telat tame naket
Amar mar amar lo rabbi yehoshua lo im amarta lema leh rabbi eliezer asham name damo lemala
Amar abbaye asham damo lemala la matzet amratte kal vechomer meola uma ola shehi kalil damah lematta asham sheeno kalil lo kol shekken
Ma leola shekken enah mechapperet
Chattat haof tochiach
Ma lechattat haof shekken enah min zevach
Ola tochiach lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shehen kodshe kadashim vedaman lematta af ani avi asham shehu kodesh kodashim vedamo lematta
Amar leh rava mipparzikya lerav ashe velifroch ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken en lahen kitzva tomar beasham sheyyesh lo kitzva
Ella hayenu tama derabbi eliezer deamar kera hakkohen hamchatte otah otah damah lemala veen damo shel acher lemala
I hachi chattat name nema otah lishmah keshera shello lishmah pesula ha shear zevachim ben lishman ben shello lishman kesherin
Hahu otah lav daveka deha shayyar pesach
Hacha name lav daveka deha shayyar olat haof
Bizvicha miha la shayyar mide
Vei baet ema ha manni rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi deamar hay makom lechod vehay makom lechod

Detanya damim hattachtonim nitanin michut hassikra ulmatta vehaelonim michut hassikra ulmala amar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon bamme devarim amurin beolat haof aval bechattat behema hi atzmah en naase ella al gufah shel keren
Tenan hatam shehaya rabbi akiva omer kol damim shennichnesu lahechal lechapper pesulim vachachamim omrim chattat bilvad rabbi eliezer omer af haasham shenneemar kachattat kaasham
Bishlama rabbi eliezer kidkaamar tama ella rabbanan may tama
Amar rava asham nichnas damo lifnim pasul la matzet amratte kal vachomer meola ma

a: Ola shehi kalil nichnas damah lifnim keshera asham sheeno kalil lo kol shekken
Ma leola shekken enah mechapperet
Minchat chote tochiach
Velema chattat haof tochiach chattat haof baya derabbi avin hi
Velifroch ma leminchat chote shekken enah min zevach
