Ola tochiach vechazar haddin lo rei ze chiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shehen kodshe kadashim venichnas daman lifnim kesherin af ani avi asham shehu kodesh kodashim venichnas damo lifnim kasher
Amar leh rava mibbarnish lerav ashe velifroch ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken en lahen kitzva tomar beasham sheyyesh lo kitzva
Ella hayenu tamayehu derabbanan deamar kera damah damah shel zo vela damah shel acher
Veidach damah velo besarah
Veidach damdamah
Veidach damdamah la daresh
Bishlama lerabbanan deamri asham sheshshechato shello lishmo kasher hayenu deitakkash mincha lechattat mincha leasham

Detanya rabbi shimon omer kodesh kadashim hi kachattat vechaasham minchat chote hare hi kechattat lefichach kematzah shello lishmah pesula minchat nedava hare hi keasham lefichach kematzah shello lishmah keshera
Ella lerabbi eliezer lemay hilcheta itakkash mincha lechattat umincha leasham
Lechi idach derabbi shimon ditnan shello bichle sharet pesula verabbi shimon machshir
Veamar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya may tama derabbi shimon amar kera kodesh kodashim hi kachattat uchasham ba leovdah bayyad ovdah bayyamin kachattat bichli ovdah bismol kaasham
Verabbi shimon hay kera mappek leh lehachi umappek leh lehachi
Ikar kera lechidrav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya hu daata uminchat chote difsula shello lishmah tama acharina hu chattat tama may dichtiv bah hi minchat chote name ketiv bah hi
Ulrabbanan lemay hilcheta itakkash asham lechattat lomar lach ma chattat teuna semicha af asham taun semicha
Yosef ben choni omer hannishchatin ku amar rabbi yochanan yosef ben choni verabbi eliezer amru davar echad
Rabba amar baacherim leshem chattat peligi
Detanya happesach sheibbera shenato ushchato bizmanno lishmo vechen hashshochet acherim leshem pesach bizmanno rabbi eliezer posel verabbi yehoshua machshir
Amar rabbi yehoshua im bishar yemot hashshana sheeno kasher lishmo acherim kesherim lishmo bizmanno shehu kasher lishmo eno din sheyyichsheru acherim lishmo

Amar lo rabbi eliezer o chiluf haddevarim uma im bishar yemot hashshana sheeno kasher lishmo kasher hu leshem acherim bizmanno shehu kasher lishmo eno din sheyyuchshar leshem acherim veuchshar pesach bearbaa asar shello lishmo
Vechach atta omer ma li huchsheru acherim bishar yemot hashshana lishmo shekken hu kasher leshem acherim veuchsheru acherim bizmanno lishmo shekken hu pasul leshem acherim
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua im ken horata koach pesach venatatta koach bishlamim
Chazar rabbi eliezer vedano din acher matzinu motar pesach ba shelamim veen motar shelamim ba pesach
Uma pesach shemmotaro ba shelamim shechato bizmanno leshum shelamim pasul shelamim sheen motaran ba pesach im shechatam leshem pesach bizmanno eno din sheyehu pesulin
b: Amar lo rabbi yehoshua matzinu motar chattat ba ola veen motar ola ba chattat
Uma chattat shemmotarah ba ola shechatah leshem ola pesula ola sheen motarah ba chattat shechatah leshem chattat eno din shettehe pesula
Amar lo rabbi eliezer lo im amarta bechattat shekken keshera lishmah kol hashshana kullah tomar bappesach sheeno kasher lishmo ella bizmanno hoil vehu pasul lishmo din hu sheyyippaslu acherim lishmo
Shimon achi azarya omer ku

Rav ashe matne mishshemeh derabbi yochanan verav acha bereh derava matne mishshemeh derabbi yannay may tama deshimon achi azarya deamar kera velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael et asher yarimu la bemuram mehen en mitchallelin benamuch mehem mitchallelin

Vehay lehachi hu daata veha mibe leh lichdishmuel deamar shemuel minnayin laochel et hattevel shehu bemita shenneemar velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael et asher yarimu la baatidim litrom hakkatuv medabber
Im ken lichtov kera asher hurmu may asher yarimu shema minah tarte
Bae rabbi zera kesherin veen meratztzin vechi pelig bachada pelig o dilma kesherin umratztzin uvtarte peligi
Amar abbaye veitema rabbi zerika ta shema habbechor vehammaaser sheshshechatan leshem shelamim kesherim shelamim sheshshechatan leshem bechor o leshem maaser pesulin
Vei salka datach kesherin umratztzin bechor bar ratzoye hu ella kesherin veen meratztzin umiddesefa kesherin veen meratztzin resha name kesherin veen meratztzin
Mide irya ha kiditah veha kiditah
Ella may ka mashma lan gavoha venamuch ka mashma lan tenena ketzad kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan leshem kodashim kallim ku
Mahu detema kodshe kadashim vekadashim kallim hu deika gavoha venamuch aval kallim vekallim la
Ha name tenena shelamim kodmim et habbechor mippene shehen teunin mattan arba usmicha unsachim utnufat chaze vashok
Ha ikar hahi aggerara nasvah
Matni happesach sheshshechato shacharit bearbaa asar shello lishmo rabbi yehoshua machshir keilu nishchat bishlosha asar ben betira posel keilu nishchat ben haarbayim

Amar shimon ben azzay mekubbal ani mippi shivim ushnayim zaken bayyom shehoshivu et rabbi eliezer bishiva shekkol hazzevachim hanneechalin shennizbechu shello lishman kesherin ella shello alu labbealim mishshum chova chutz min happesach umin hachattat velo hosif ben azzay ella haola velo hodu lo chachamim
Gema amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya machshir haya ben betira befesach sheshshechato shacharit bearbaa asar lishmo dechulleh yoma zimneh hu
Umay keilu
Ayede deamar rabbi yehoshua keilu amar ihu name keilu
I hachi addemipalgi beshello lishmo lipalgu belishmo
I ipligu belishmo hava amena aval beshello lishmo mode rabbi yehoshua leven betira hoil umiktzato rauy ka mashma lan
Vehachtiv ben haarbayim
Amar ulla bereh derav ilay ben shene aravim
Tamid dichtiv beh ben haarbayim hachi name dechulle yoma kasher
Hatam middichtiv et hakkeves echad taase vabboker mikkelal deven haarbayim ben haarbayim mammash
Ema chad babboker idach kulleh yoma
Echad babboker velo shenayim babboker
Nerot dichtiv ben haarbayim hachi name dechulle yoma kasher
Shane hatam dichtiv meerev vead boker vetanya meerev vead boker ten lah middatah shettehe doleket veholechet meerev vead boker davar acher en lecha avoda keshera meerev vead boker ella zo bilvad
Ketoret dichtiv bah ben haarbayim hachi name dechulle yoma kasher
Shane ketoret

a: Deitakkash lenerot
Hatam name ketiv sham tizbach et happesach baarev
Hahu liuchar davar hu daata detanya yeuchar davar shenneemar bo baarev uven haarbayim ledavar shello neemar bo ella ben haarbayim bilvad
Umi ika mide deilu shachet leh mitztzafra amratte zimneh hu vechi mate ben haarbayim amratte yeuchar davar
In dehaamar rabbi yochanan halacha mitpallel shel mincha veachar kach mitpallel shel musafin
Uven haarbayim dichtiv gabbe ketoret venerot lema li
Veod heshiv rabbi tachat ben betira ledivre rabbi yehoshua lo im amarta bishlosha asar sheen miktzato rauy tomar bearbaa asar shemmiktzato rauy
Veim ita kullo rauy hu
Ella amar rabbi yochanan posel haya ben betira befesach sheshshechato bearbaa asar shacharit ben lishmo ben shello lishmo hoil umiktzato rauy
Megaddef bah rabbi avahu im ken pesach kasher leven betira hechi mashkachatte lah i deafresheh haidana dachuy meikaro hu vei deafreshinhu meetmol nire venidche hu
Ella amar rabbi avahu tehe leachar chatzot
Abbaye amar afilu tema mitztzafra en mechussar zeman levo bayyom
Rav pappa amar afilu tema meurta layela en mechussar zeman detane deve rabbi yishmael lel shemini nichnas laddir lehitasser
Vechidrabbi aftoriki derabbi aftoriki rame ketiv vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo ha layela chaze uchtiv umiyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze ha layela la chaze
Ha ketzad layela likdushsha veom lehartzaa
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi avahu lema kasavar rabbi yochanan baale chayyim nidchin
Amar leh in deamar rabbi yochanan behema shel shene shuttafin hikdish chetzyah vechazar velakach chetzyah vehikdishah kedosha veenah kereva
Veose temura utmuratah keotze bah
Ushma minah telat shema minah baale chayyim nidchin ushma minah dachuy meikara have dachuy ushma minah
b: Yesh dichuy bedamim
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan achal chelev vehifrish korban venishtammed vechazar bo hoil venidcha yiddache
Itmar name amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan achal chelev vehifrish korban venishtatta vechazar venishtappa hoil venidcha yiddache
Utzrichi dei ashmeinan kammayeta mishshum dehu dache nafsheh beyadayim aval hacha demimmela idchi keyashen dame
Vei ashmeinan hacha mishshum deen beyado lachazor aval hacha deyesh beyado lachazor ema la tzericha
Bae rabbi yirmeya achal chelev vehifrish korban vehoru bet din shechelev muttar vechazru bahen mahu mi have dachuy o la have dachuy
Amar leh hahu sava ki patach rabbi yochanan bidchuyin meha patach may tama hatam gavra idchi korban la idchi hacha korban name idchi
Amar shimon ben azzay mekubbelani mippi shivim ushnayim zaken ku lema li lemitna shivim ushnayim zaken dechullehu bachada shitta hao kayemi
Lo hosif ben azzay ella haola
Amar rav huna may tama deven azzay ola hu ishshe reach nichoach la hi lishmah keshera shello lishmah pesula
Asham name ketiv beh hu
Hahu leachar haktarat emurim hu dichtiv
Hay name leachar haktarat emurim hu dichtiv
Tere hu ketivi
Gabbe asham name tere hu ketivi
Ella ben azzay bekal vachomer mayete lah uma chattat sheenah kalil shechatah shello lishmah pesula ola shehi kalil lo kol shekken
Ma lechattat shekken mechapperet
Pesach yochiach
Ma lefesach shekken zemanno kavua

Chattat tochiach vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shehen kodashim ushchatan shello lishman pasul af ani avi ola shehi kadashim ushchatah shello lishmah pesula
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheyyesh bahen tzad karet
Ben azzay

a: Tzad karet la parech
Asham name layete
Asham parech ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yeshnan betzibbur kivyachid
Veibaet ema tzad karet name parech uven azzay gemara gemir lah veha dekaamar rav huna kal vachomer lo amarah ella lechadded bah talmidav
Matni happesach vehachattat sheshshechatan shello lishman kibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishman o lishman veshello lishman o shello lishman velishman pesulim
Ketzad lishman veshello lishman leshem pesach ulshem shelamim shello lishman velishman leshem shelamim ulshem pesach
Shehazzevach nifsal bearbaa devarim bishchita uvkibbul uvhiluch uvizrika
Rabbi shimon machshir behiluch shehaya omer i efshar shello bishchita veshello bekabbala veshello bizrika aval efshar belo hiluch shochet betzad hammizbeach vezorek
Rabbi elazar omer hamhallech bimkom shehu tzarich lehallech machshava poselet bimkom sheeno tzarich lehallech en machshava poselet
Gema vekabbala mi pasla

Vehatanya vehikrivu zo kabbalat haddam atta omer kabbalat haddam o eno ella zerika keshehu omer vezarku hare zerika amur ha ma ani mekayyem vehikrivu zo kabbalat haddam bene aharon hakkohanim shettehe bechohen kasher uvichli sharet

Amar rabbi akiva minnayin lekabbala shello tehe ella bechohen kasher uvichli sharet neemar kan bene aharon veneemar lehallan elle shemot bene aharon hakkohanim hammeshuchim ma lehallan bechohen kasher uvichli sharet af kan bechohen kasher uvichli sharet
Amar rabbi tarfon akappeach et banay im lo shamati lehavchin hefresh ben kabbala lizrika veen li lefaresh

Amar rabbi akiva ani afaresh kabbala lo asa bah machshava kemaase zerika asa bah machshava kemaase kibbelo bachutz eno chayyav karet zerako bachutz anush karet kibbeluhu pesulin en chayyavin alav zerakuhu pesulin chayyavin alav
Amar lo rabbi tarfon haavoda im hitteta yamin usmol ani shamati veen li lefaresh atta doresh umaskim lashshemua ballashon hazze amar lo akiva kol happoresh mimmecha keforesh mechayyav
Amar rava la kashya kan bemachshevet pigul kan bemachshevet shello lishmah
Dayeka name dekatane shehazzevach nifsal vela katane mitpaggel shema minah
Umachshevet pigul la pasla bekabbala

Vehatanya yachol lo tehe machshava moelet ella bizrika bilvad minnayin lerabbot shechita vekabbala talmud lomar veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav pigul hu bayyom hashshelishi lo yeratze bidvarim hammeviin lide achila hakkatuv medabber
Yachol sheani merabbe af shefichat shirayim vehaktarat emurin

Talmud lomar bayyom hashshelishi lo yeratze hammakriv oto lo yechashev zerika bakkelal hayeta velamma yatzta lehakkish eleha lomar lecha ma zerika meuchedet shehi avoda umchapperet umakkevet kappara af kol avoda umakkevet kappara yatzu shefichat shirayim vehaktarat emurin sheen meakkevin et hakkappara
b: Ella la kashya ha deamar hareni shochet al menat lekabbel damah lemachar ha deamar hareni mekabbel damah al menat lishpoch shirayim lemachar
Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava ushfichat shirayim vehaktarat emurin la pasla behu machshava

Vehatnan yachol lo tehe machshava moelet ella baachilat basar minnayin lerabbot shefichat shirayim vehaktarat emurim talmud lomar veim heachol yeachel bishte achilot hakkatuv medabber achat achilat adam veachat achilat mizbeach
La kashya ha deamar hareni zorek al menat lishpoch shirayim lemachar ha deamar hareni shofech shirayim al menat lehaktir emurin lemachar
Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya shamati shettevilat etzba mefaggelet bechattat penimit
Shamah ilfa amrah kammeh derav peda amar kelum lamadnu pigul ella mishshelamim ma shelamim en tevilat etzba mefaggelet bahen af chattat en tevilat etzba mefaggelet bah
Vechi hakkol mishshelamim lamdu i ma shelamim shello lishman en motzi mide pigul af chattat shello lishmah en motzi mide pigul
Ella may it lach lememar meribbuya dikrae kaatya hacha name meribbuya dikra kaate

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi baaliyya zo shamati shettevilat etzba mefaggelet tahe bah rabbi shimon ben lakish kelum lamdu pigul ella mishshelamim ma shelamim en tevilat etzba mefaggelet bahen af chattat en tevilat etzba mefaggelet bah
Vechi hakkol mishshelamim lamdu i ma shelamim shello lishman en motzi mide pigul af chattat shello lishmah en motzi mide pigul

Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina in hakkol mishshelamim lamdu hoil vechutz limkomo posel bishlamim veshello lishmo posel bechattat ma chutz limkomo happosel bishlamim motzi mide pigul af shello lishmo happosel bechattat motziah mide pigul
Amar rabbi yirmeya mitztziddah tevara ma lechutz limkomo happosel bishlamim shekken noheg bechol hazzevachim tomar beshello lishmo sheeno noheg ella befesach vechattat bilvad
Ella may it lach lememar davar happosel bahen motziam mide pigul davar hamakkev bahen mevian lide pigul
Hacha name davar happosel bah motzi mide pigul davar hamakkev bah mevia lide pigul
Amar rav mari af anan name tenena ze hakkelal kol hakkometz venoten bichli vehammolich vehammaktir
Bishlama kometz hayenu shochet molich hayenu molich maktir name hayenu zorek ella noten bichli may nihu
Ilema dedame lekabbala mi dame hatam mimmela hacha ihu ka shakel verame
Ella kevan dela saggi dela yahev al karcheh avoda chashuva hi hacha name kevan dela saggi dela aved lah al karcheh hayenu holacha
La leolam dedame lekabbala udkaamratte hacha mimmela hatam ihu ka shakel veyahev kevan deide veide mattan keli hu ma li mimmela ma li ka shakel veyahev
Lema ketannae detane chada tevilat etzba mefaggelet bechattat vetanya idach lo mefaggelet velo mitpaggelet may lav tannae hi
La ha rabbanan ha rabbi shimon
I rabbi shimon may irya tevilat etzba haamar

a: Kol sheeno al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim en bo mishshum pigul
Ella ha veha rabbanan vela kashya kan bechattaot hachitzonot kan bechattaot happenimiyyot
Chattaot hachitzonot peshita la ketiv behu vetaval
Itzterich salka datach amena hoil uchtiv velakach vei ate kof rame lehu ayedeh bae lemishkal zimna achariti keman dichtiv vetaval dame
Ka mashma lan lehachi la ketiv vetaval demashma hachi umashma hachi
Rabbi shimon machshir behiluch amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mode rabbi shimon beholachat chattaot happenimiyyot shemmachshava poselet bah hoil vaavoda sheen yachol levattelah
Vehaamar rabbi shimon kol sheeno al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim en chayyavin alav mishshum pigul
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mode haya lifsol mikkal vachomer uma shello lishman shehuchsheru bishlamim pasul bechattat chutz lizmanno shepposel bishlamim eno din sheyyifsol bechattaot
Veashkechan chutz lizmanno chutz limkomo menalan
I michutz lizmanno ma lechutz lizmanno shekken karet
I mishshello lishmah shekken noheg bevama
Chiyyuv shello lishman bemay noheg befesach vechattat pesach vechattat bevama lo karvu
Veibaet ema hekkesha hu shelishi ze chutz lizmanno pigul ze chutz limkomo
Amar rava im timtze lomar rabbi shimon savar lah kivreh deamar ben haulam velammizbeach tzafon en machshava moelet beholachat chattaot happenimiyyot ella mippetach ulam velifnim
Veim timtze lomar savar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar toch azara mekaddesh en machshava moelet beholachat siluk bazichin ella mippetach hechal velachutz
Veim timtze lomar savar kedushshat hechal veulam chada hi en machshava moelet ella mippetach ulam velachutz
Veim timtze lomar toch happetach kelifnim en machshava moelet afilu pesia achat ella bichde hoshatat yado
Veim timtze lomar savar holacha shello baregel lo shemah holacha en machshava moelet kelal
Amar leh abbaye leamoreh derav chisda bei mineh merav chisda holacha bezar mahu
Amar leh keshera umikra mesayeeni vayyishchatu et happesach vayyizreku hakkohanim et haddam miyyadam vehalviyyim mafshitim
Metiv rav sheshet zar veonen
b: Shikor uvaal mum bekabbala beholacha bizrika pasul vechen yoshev vechen semol teuvta
Veha rav chisda kera kaamar
Deaved maase itzteva
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu holacha bezar machloket rabbi shimon verabbanan rabbi shimon deamar avoda sheefshar levattelah lav avoda hi keshera bezar lerabbanan pesula
Amar leh abbaye veha shechita daavoda shei efshar levattelah uchshera bezar amar leh shechita lav avoda hi
Vela vehaamar rabbi zera amar rav shechitat para bezar pesula veamar rav alah elazar vechukka ketiv bah
Shane para dekodshe bedek habbayit hi
Velav kal dechen hu kodshe bedek habbayit haveya avoda kodshe mizbeach lav avoda hi
Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi mide dehave ammarot negaim delav avoda hi uvaaya kehunna
Vahare holachat evarim lakkevesh daavoda sheefshar levattelah hi ufsula bezar dichtiv vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol vehiktir hammizbecha veamar mar zo holachat evarim lakkevesh
Hecha degalli galli vehecha dela galli la galli
Velav kal dechen hu uma holachat evarim lakkevesh dela meakkeva kappara baaya kehunna holachat dam dimakkeva kappara lo kol shekken mibaya
Itmar name amar ulla amar rabbi elazar holacha bezar pesula afilu lerabbi shimon
Ibaya lehu holacha shello baregel shemah holacha o lo shemah holacha
Ta shema vechen yoshev vechen semol pasul ha omed dumya deoshev kasher
Dilma yoshev dekashayef meshaf omed dumya deoshev denayed purta
Ta shema shachat yisrael vekibbel hakkohen netano lachavero vachavero lachavero
Hatam name denayedi purta umay ka mashma lan berov am hadrat melech
Ta shema kibbel hakkasher venatan lappasul yachzir lakkasher
Ema yachzor hakkasher vikabbelah
Itmar amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan holacha shello baregel lo shemah holacha

a: Efshar letakkonah o la efshar letakkonah
Ta shema kibbel hakkasher venatan lappasul yachzir lakkasher
Unhi name deyachzor hakkasher vikabbelennu i salka datach la efshar letakkonah ipsala lah
Mi savratte dekae zar gavay la dekae zar baray
Itmar amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan holacha shello baregel pesula alma la efshar letakkonah
Etiveh rav nachman leulla nishpach min hakkeli al haritzpa vaasafo kasher
Hacha bemay askinan kesheyyatza lachutz
Levaray nafek legavay la ayel bimkom midron ibaet ema begumma veibaet ema bismicha
Veikfal tanna leashmoinan kol hane veod addetane beidach pirkin nishpach al haritzpa vaasafo pasul liflog bedideh bamme devarim amurim kesheyyatza lachutz aval nichnas lifnim pasul teuvta
Ittemar holacha shello baregel machloket rabbi shimon verabbanan beholacha rabbati dechulle alma la peligi difsula ki peligi beholacha zutarti
Machachu alah bemareva ella chattat haof difsula bah machshava lerabbi shimon hechi mashkachatte lah i dechashshev alah mikkamme delipok dam la kelum hi vei batar dinfak dam itavida leh mitzvato
May kushya dilma middefaresh vead dimta lemizbeach
Deha bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera haya mazze veniktea yado shel mazze ad shello higgia dam laavir hammizbeach mahu vaamar leh pesula may tama vehizza venatan baenan
Ki ato rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua mibbe rav amri hayenu chucha uvholacha rabbati la peligi veha ki peligi beholacha rabbati peligi
Ella beholacha zutarti kulle alma la peligi dela pasla ki peligi beholacha rabbati
Holicho zar vehechziro kohen vechazar veholicho peligi bah bene rabbi chiyya verabbi yannay chad amar kasher vechad amar pasul mar savar efshar letakkonah umar savar la efshar letakkonah
Holicho kohen vehechziro vechazar veholicho zar amar rav shimi bar ashe ledivre hammachshir pasul ledivre happosel machshir
Rava amar af ledivre happosel pasul may tama deha tzarich
b: Leamtoyeh
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerav ashe hachi amar rav yirmeya middifti ha tzarich leamtoyeh machloket rabbi elazar verabbanan
Ditnan rabbi elazar omer hamhallech bemakom shetztzarich lehallech machshava poselet makom sheen tzarich lehallech en machshava poselet
Veamar rava hakkol modim kibbelo bachutz vehichniso bifnim zehu hiluch shetztzarich lehallech kibbelo bifnim vehotzio lachutz zehu hiluch sheen tzarich lehallech
Lo nechleku ella keshehichniso vechazar vehotzio mar savar ha tzarich leamtoyeh umar savar lav kehiluch hatztzarich laavoda dame

Etiveh abbaye rabbi elazar omer hamhallech makom shetztzarich lehallech machshava poselet ketzad kibbelo bachutz vehichniso lifnim zehu hiluch shetztzarich lehallech kibbelo bifnim vehotzio lachutz zehu hiluch sheen tzarich lelech veha chazar vehichniso hiluch shetztzarich lehallech hu
Amar leh i tanya tanya
Hadaran alach kol hazzevachim

Matni kol hazzevachim shekkibbelu daman zar onen tevul yom umchussar kippurim umchussar begadim shello rachatz yadayim veraglayim arel tame yoshev omed al gabbe kelim al gabbe behema al gabbe ragle chavero pasal
Kibbel bismol pasal rabbi shimon machshir
Gema zar menalan detane levi dabber el aharon veel banav lemor veyinnazru mikkodshe bene yisrael vego bene yisrael lemaote may ilema lemaote nashim korban nashim betuma karev
Ella lemaote goyim hashta tzitz la meratztze deamar mar uvaggoyim ben beshogeg ben bemezid lo hurtza betuma karev
Ella hachi kaamar veyinnazru mikkodshe vene yisrael velo yechallelu
Deve rabbi yishmael tana atya bekal vachomer mibbaal mum ma baal mum sheochel im avad chilel

a: Zar sheeno ochel eno din sheim avad chilel
Ma levaal mum shekken asa bo karev kemakriv
Tame yochiach ma letame shekken metamme
Baal mum yochiach vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shemmuzharin veim avdu chillu af ani avi zar shehu muzhar veim avad chilel
Menalan demuzhar i mivveyinnazru chilul begufeh ketiv beh ella mivvezar lo yikrav alechem
Ika lemifrach ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken lo hutteru bevama
La tema tame yochiach ella ema onen yochiach ma leonen shekken asur bammaaser baal mum yochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shemmuzharin ku
Hacha name lifroch ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken lo hutteru bevama matkef lah rav samma bereh derava uman lema lan deonen asur bevama dilma shere bevama
Rav mesharsheya amar atya kal vachomer miyyoshev ma yoshev sheochel im avad chilel zar sheeno ochel eno din sheim avad chilel
Ma leoshev shekken pasul leedut miyyoshev talmid chacham
Ma leshem yoshev shekken pasul leedut shem yoshev la parech veim timtza lomar parech atya miyyoshev umechada mehanach
Veoshev dechasher bevama menalan amar kera laamod lifne Adonai lesharto lifne Adonai velo lifne bama
Onen menalan dichtiv umin hammikdash lo yetze velo yechallel ha acher shello yatza chilel
Rabbi elazar amar mehacha hen hikrivu ani hikravti mikkelal dei inhu akriv shappir isteruf
Verabbi elazar may tama la amar miumin hammikdash lo yetze amar lach mi ketiv ha acher shello yatza chilel
Veidach may tama la amar mehen hikrivu kasavar mippene tuma nisrefa
Deve rabbi yishmael tana atya bekal vachomer mibbaal mum uma
b: Baal mum sheochel im avad chilel onen sheen ochel eno din sheim avad chilel
Ma levaal mum shekken asa bo kerevin kemakrivin
Zar yochiach ma lezar shekken en lo takkana
Baal mum yochiach vechazar haddin lo rei ze chiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shehen muzharin veim avdu chillu af ani avi onen shemmuzhar veim avad chilel
Hechan muzhar ilema miumin hammikdash lo yetze chilul begufeh ketiv beh ella mehen hikrivu vekasavar mippene aninut nisrefa
Ika lemifrach ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken lo huttera mikkelalo
Tame yochiach
Ma letame shekken metamme hanach yochichu vechazar haddin ku hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shemmuzharin ku
Velifroch ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken lo hutteru mikkelalan etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid shem tuma miha ishteray
Rav mesharsheya amar atya bekal vachomer miyyoshev uma yoshev sheochel im avad chilel onen sheeno ochel eno din sheim avad chilel
Ma leoshev shekken pasul leedut miyyoshev talmid chacham
Ma leshem yoshev shekken pasul leedut shem yoshev la parech veim timtze lomar parech atya miyyoshev umechada mehanach
Onen pasul amar rava lo shanu ella bekorban yachid aval bekorban tzibbur meratztze kal vachomer mittuma

Ma tuma shello huttera mikkelalah etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid huttera etzel hedot bekorban tzibbur aninut shehuttera mikkelalah etzel kohen gadol bekarban yachid eno din shehuttera etzel kohen hedot bekorban tzibur

Matkef lah rava bar ahilay lo tuttar aninut etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid mikkal vechomer uma tuma shehuttera etzel kohen hedot betzibbur lo huttera etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid aninut shello huttera etzel kohen hedot bekorban tzibbur eno din shello tuttar etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid

Vetuttar tuma etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid mikkal vechomer uma aninut shello huttar etzel kohen hedot bekorban tzibbur huttera etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid tuma shehuttera etzel kohen hedot bekorban tzibbur eno din shehuttera etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid

Velo tuttar tuma etzel kohen hedot bekorban tzibbur mikkal vechomer uma aninut shehuttera etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid lo huttera etzel kohen hedot bekorban tzibbur tuma shello huttera etzel kohen gadol bekarban yachid eno din shello tuttar bechohen hedot bekorban tzibbur
Velo tuttar velo tuttar aninut vetuma tuma yachid veyachid tzibbur siman

a: Ella ika lemifrach hachi veika lemifrach hachi kol chada vachada teku beduchteh
Tevul yom menalan detanya rabbi simay omer remez litvul yom sheim avad chilel minnayin talmud lomar kedoshim yihu velo yechallelu
Im eno inyan letame denafek mivveyinnazru tenehu inyan litvul yom
Ema tenehu inyan lekoreach korcha ulmashchit peat zakan
Tevul yom deim avad bemita mena lan degamar chilulchilul mitteruma defasel bitruma machel avoda dela pasel bitruma la machel avoda
Amar rabba lema li dichtav rachamana tame utvul yom umchussar kippurim
Tzerichi dei ketav rachamana tame shekken metamme bitvul yom mechussar kippurim la ate mineh shekken pasul bitruma bimchussar kippurim tevul yom la ate mineh shekken mechussar maase
Mechada la ate tete chada mittarte
Behe la lichtov rachamana la lichtov bimchussar kippurim vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken pesulim bitruma
Ella la lichtov rachamana bitvul yom vetete mehanach demay parchatte ma lehanach shekken mechussarim maase sof sof kelisha lah tumatan
b: Kasavar mechussar kippurim dezav kezav dame

Umchussar kippurim dezav kezav dame tannae hi detanya serafah onen umchussar kippurim keshera yosef habbavli omer onen keshera mechussar kippurim pesula may lav beha kamipalgi mar savar mechussar kippurim dezav kezav dame umar savar lav kezav dame
La dechulle alma kezav dame vehacha beha kamipalgi dichtiv vehizza hattahor mikkelal shehu tame limed al tevul yom shekkasher bappara
Mar savar tuma dechol hattora kullah umar savar tuma dehach parasha
Hilkach onen utvul yom ditme sheretz dekili atu bekal vachomer mittevul yom demet aval mechussar kippurim dezav dachamir shekken tuma yotza alav miggufo la

Mechussar begadim menalan amar rabbi avuh amar rabbi yochanan umatu bah mishshemeh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon deamar kera vechagarta otam avnet aharon uvanav vechavashta lahem migbaot vehayeta lahem kehunna lechukkat olam bizman shebbigdehem alehem kehunnatam alehem en bigdehem alehem en kehunnatam alehem

Veha mehacha nafka mehatam nafka detanya minnayin lishtuye yayin sheim avad chilel talmud lomar yayin veshechar al teshte vego ulhavdil ben hakkodesh uven hachol mechussar begadim veshello rachutz yadayim veraglayim minnayin

a: Talmud lomar chukkahchukka ligzera shava
I mehatam hava amena hane mile avoda dezar chayyav aleha mita aval avoda deen zar chayyav aleha mita ema la ka mashma lan
Ashkechan mechussar begadim shetuye yayin menalan atya chukkahchukka mimmechussar begadim
Veha tanna ulhavdil ben vego ka nasev lah mikkamme delekum gezera shava

Veha tanna mechussar begadim hu deka yalef mishshetuye yayin hachi kaamar minnayin shello nechleku ben mechussar begadim lishtuye yayin veshello rachutz yadayim veraglayim talmud lomar chukkahchukka ligzera shava
Ella lehavdil lema li lechidrav derav la mokem amora aleh miyyoma tava lechavreh mishshum shichrut
Akkatti mehacha nafka mehatam nafka venatnu bene aharon hakkohen bechihunno limed al kohen gadol shellavash bigde kohen hedot veavad avodato pesula
I mehatam hava amena hane mile avoda dimakkeva kappara aval avoda dela meakkeva kappara la
Veakkatti mehacha nafka mehatam nafka vearchu bene aharon hakkohanim et hannetachim vego hakkohanim bechihunan mikkan lechohen hedot shellavash bigde kohen gadol veavad avodato pesula
I mehatam hava amena hane mile chisur aval yitur la ka mashma lan

Tanu rabbanan hau merushshalin mesullakin meshuchakim veavad avodato keshera lavash shene michnasayim shene avnetim chaser achat yater achat o shehayeta lo retiyya al makkat besaro tachat bigdo o shehau
b: Metushtashin o mekorain veavad avodato pesula
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel merushshalin kesherin mesullakin pesulin vehatanya mesullakin kesherin amar rame bar chama la kashya kan shessilkan al yede avnet kan deletnihu meikara kelal
Rav amar echad ze veechad ze pesulin
Rav huna ikla leargiza rema leh bar ushpizchaneh mi amar shemuel merushshalin kesherin umsullakin pesulin vehatanya mesullakin kesherin amar leh bar minah dehahi deshanneyah rame bar chama
Ella lerav kashya vechi tema may merushshalin mesullakin al yede avnet veavnet megaz agez ella mesullakin kashya
Amar rabbi zera rav chada tane merushshalin shessilkan al yede avnet kesherin

Amar rabbi yirmeya middifti merushshalin shello silkan tannae hi detanya al arba kanfot kesutcha arba velo shalosh o eno ella arba velo chamesh keshehu omer asher techasse bah hare baalat chamesh amur ha ma ani mekayyem arba arba velo shalosh uma raita lerabbot baalat chamesh ulhotzi baalat shalosh merabbe ani baalat chamesh sheyyesh bichlal chamesh arba umotzi ani baalat shalosh sheen bichlal shalosh arba
Vetanya idach al arba kanfot kesutcha arba velo shalosh arba velo chamesh may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar yater keman deiteh dame umar savar keman deleteh dame
La dechulle alma keman deiteh dame veshane hacha derabbi rachamana asher techasse bah

Veidach hay asher techasse bah may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya uritem oto perat lichsut layela o eno ella perat lichsut some keshehu omer asher techasse bah hare kesut some amur ha ma ani mekayyem uritem oto perat lichsut layela
Uma raita lerabbot kesut some ulhotzi kesut layela merabbe ani kesut some sheyyeshnah biriyya etzel acherim umotzi ani kesut layela sheenah biriyya etzel acherim
Veidach nafka leh measher veidach asher la daresh
Tanu rabbanan bad sheyyihu shel butz bad sheyehu chadashim bad sheyehu shezurim bad sheyehu chutan kaful shishsha bad shello yilbash shel chol immahen
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef bishlama sheyehu shel butz ha ka mashma lan butz in mide acharina la ella bad sheyehu chadashim chadashim in shechakin la vehatanya meshuchakin kesherim

Amar leh velitamach bad sheyehu chutan kaful shishsha bad chad chad lechodeh mashma ella hachi kaamar begadim shenneemar bahen bad tzerichin sheyehu shel butz chadashim shezurin sheyehe chutan kaful shishsha yesh mehen lemitzva yesh mehen leakkev
Mimmay dehay bad kittana hu amar rabbi yosef berabbi chanina davar haole min hakkarka bad bevad
Ema amra amra miptzel kitana name miptzel al yede lakuta miptzel
Ravina amar mehacha paare fishtim yihu al rosham umichnese fishtim yihu al motnehem lo yachgeru bayyaza

Amar leh rav ashe leravina veha ad daata yechezkel menalan ultamach ha deamar rav chisda davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu middivre yechezkel ben buzi lamadnu kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi lesharteni ad shebba yechezkel menalan ella gemara gemiri lah vaata yechezkel veasmecheh akkera hacha name gemara gemiri lah ku
May lo yachgeru bayyaza amar abbaye la yachgeru bimkom shemmeziin kidtanya keshehem chogrin en chogrin lo lematta mimmotnehen velo lemala meatztzilehen ella

a: Keneged atztzile yedehen

Amar rav ashe amar li huna bar natan zimna chada hava kaemna kammeh deizgaddar malka vahava middele li hemyanay vetayeteyeh nihaleh vaamar li mamlechet kohanim vegoy kadosh ketiv bechu ki atay kammeh deammemar amar li ikkayyam becha vehau melachim omnayich
Tenan hatam kohen shellaka beetzbao korech aleha gemi bemikdash aval lo bammedina veim lehotzi mimmenna dam kan vechan asur

Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya lo shanu ella gemi aval tziltzol katan have yittur begadim verabbi yochanan amar lo amru yittur begadim ella bimkom begadim aval shello bimkom begadim la have yittur
Vetipok leh mishshum chatzitza bismol i name shello bimkom avoda
Ufliga derava deamar rava amar rav chisda bimkom begadim afilu nima achat chotzetzet shello bimkom begadim shalosh al shalosh chotztzot pachot mikkan enan chotztzot
Adderabbi yochanan vadday peliga adderabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya mi lema difliga
Shane tziltzol katan dachashiv

Lishana acharina amri lah amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya lo shanu ella gemi aval tziltzol katan chotzetz verabbi yochanan amar lo amru chatzitza befachot mishshalosh al shalosh ella bimkom begadim aval shello bimkom begadim shalosh al shalosh chotztzot pachot miken enah chotzetzet vehayenu derava amar rav chisda
Lema peliga adderabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya shane tziltzol katan dachashiv
Ulrabbi yochanan may irya gemi lashmeinan tziltzol katan milta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan degemi masse
Bae rava nichnesa lo ruach bevigdo mahu al besaro baenan veha leka o dilma derech levisha bechach
Kina mahu shettachotz
Meta la tibbee lach devadday chayetza chayya may mi amrinan kevan deatya veazla revita hi vela chayetza o dilma kevan dekafed alah chayetza
Afar mahu sheyyachotz afar vadday chayetz ella avak afar mahu
Bet hashshechi mahu sheyyachotz al besaro baenan veha leka o dilma derech levisha bechach
Hichnis yado letoch cheko mahu gufo mi chayetz o la
Nima mahu shettachotz nima vadday chayetza ella nima meduldelet mahu
Bae mar bar rav ashe yatza searo bevigdo mahu searo kegufo dame o lav kegufo dame

Bae rabbi zera tefilin mahu sheyyachotztzu alliba deman deamar layela lav zeman tefilin hu la tive lach kevan delayela chayetzi yom name chayetzi ki tibe lach leman deamar layela zeman tefilin may mitzva degufeh chayetz o la chayetz
Igalgal milta umta lekammeh derabbi amme amar leh talmud aruch hu beyadenu tefilin chotztzot
Metivi kohanim baavodatan vlviyyim beduchanan veyisrael bemaamadan peturin min hattefilla umin hattefilin may lav im hinnichan enan chotztzot la im hinnichan chotztzot
I hachi peturim asurim mibe leh kevan deika leviyyim veyisrael dela matnu leh asur mishshum hachi tena peturin
Vehatanya im hinnichan enan chotztzot la kashya ha deyad ha derosh
May shena deyad dichtiv yilbash al besaro shello yehe davar chotzetz beno livsaro derosh name ketiv vesamta hammitznefet al rosho
Tana searo haya nire ben tzitz lemitznefet
b: Sheshsham mannichin tefilin
Mechussar kipurim menalan amar rav huna amar kera vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera tahera mikkelal shehi temea
Veshello rachutz yadayim veraglayim atya chukkahchukka mimmechussar begadim

Tanu rabbanan kohen gadol shello taval veshello kidesh ben beged leveged uven avoda laavoda veavad avodato keshera veechad kohen gadol veechad kohen hedot shello kidesh yadav veraglav shacharit veavad avodato pesula
Amar leh rav assi lerabbi yochanan mikkedi chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin deorayeta vechukka ketiv behu liakkevu
Amar leh amar kera ulvesham levisha meakkevet veen davar acher meakkev
Tzahavu panav amar leh vav aufta ketavi lach i hachi detzafra name
Amar chizkiyya amar kera vehayeta lahem chok olam lo ulzaro ledorotam davar hamakkev bezaro meakkev bo davar sheeno meakkev bezaro en meakkev bo
Rabbi yonatan amar mehacha verachatzu mimmennu moshe veaharon uvanav davar hamakkev bevanav meakkev bo davar sheeno meakkev bevanav en meakkev bo
Rabbi yonatan may tama la amar middechizkiyya amar lach hahu ledorot hu dichtiv

Veidach may tama la amar mehay mibe leh lechidrabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina kol kiyyor sheen bo kede lekaddesh arbaa kohanim mimmennu en mekaddeshin bo shenneemar verachatzu mimmennu moshe veaharon uvanav

Tanu rabbanan ketzad mitzvat kidush manniach yado hayemanit al gabbe raglo hayemanit veyado hassemalit al gabbe raglo hassemalit umkaddesh rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer manniach shette yadav zo al gav zo veal gabbe shette raglav zo al gabbe zo umkaddesh amru lo hiflagta i efshar laasot ken
Shappir kaamri leh amar rav yosef vachavero mesayeo
May benayehu amar abbaye amida min hatztzad ika benayehu
Amar leh rav samma bereh derav ashe leravina velitev mitav ulkaddesh amar kera lesharet vesherut meummad hu

Tanu rabbanan kidesh yadav veraglav bayyom en tzarich lekaddesh ballayela ballayela tzarich lekaddesh bayyom divre rabbi shehaya rabbi omer lina moelet bekidush yadayim veraglayim rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer en lina moelet bekidush yadayim veraglayim

Tanya idach haya omed umakriv al gabbe mizbeach kol hallayela laora taun kidush yadayim veraglayim divre rabbi rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer kevan shekkidesh yadav veraglav mittechilat avoda afilu mikan vead asara yamim eno tzarich lekaddesh

Utzricha dei ashmeinan kammayeta behahi kaamar rabbi difsak leh meavoda laavoda aval beha dela pesak leh ema mode leh rabbi lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon vei ashmeinan beha beha kaamar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon aval beha ema mode leh lerabbi tzericha
May tama derabbi dichtiv begishtam may tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon dichtiv bevoam
Veidach name ha ketiv bevoam i ketiv begishtam vela ketiv bevoam hava amena al kol gisha vegisha ketav rachamana bevoam
Veidach name ha ketiv begishtam i ketiv bevoam vela ketiv begishtam hava amena afilu abbia rekanit

Abbia rekanit ha ketiv lesharet ella begishtam mibe leh lechidrav acha bar yaakov deamar rav acha bar yaakov hakkol modim bekidush sheni keshehu lavush mekaddesh deamar kera o vegishtam mi sheeno mechussar ella gisha bilvad yatza ze shemchussar levisha vegisha
Lehaktir ishshe lema li

a: Mahu detema hane mile avoda dimakkeva kappara aval avoda dela meakkeva kappara la ka mashma lan

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan bae ilfa ledivre haomer en lina moelet bekidush yadayim veraglayim me chiyyor mahu sheyyippaslu mi amrinan hane lemay lekidush yadayim veraglayim kidush yadayim veraglayim gufayehu la pasel behu lina o dilma kevan dikdush lehu bichle sharet mipasli
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan hadar pashet ilfa kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo

Amar lefanav rabbi yitzchak bar bisna rabbi atta omer ken ella hachi amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan mishshemeh deilfa kiyyor shello shikkeo mibbaerev mekaddesh mimmennu laavodat layela ulmachar eno mekaddesh
Vehavenan bah lemachar eno mekaddesh dela tzerich lekaddoshe o dilma ipsalu belina vela peshit lan umar ka fashet leh mifshat
Ta shema ben katin asa shenem asar dad lakkiyyor af hu asa muchni lakkiyyor shello yihu memav nifsalin belina may lav rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi la rabbi hi
Veha midderesha rabbi elazar berabbi shimon sefa name rabbi elazar berabbi shimon

Dekatane resha ba lo etzel paro ufar haya omed ben haulam ulmizbeach rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav vehakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav man shamatte leh deamar ben haulam velammizbeach tzafon rabbi elazar berabbi shimon

Detanya ezehu tzafon mikkir mizbeach tzefoni vead kotel azara tzefoni uchneged kol hammizbeach kullo tzafon divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda rabbi elazar berabbi shimon mosif af ben haulam velammizbeach rabbi mosif af mekom derisat ragle hakkohanim umkom derisat ragle yisrael aval min hachalifot velifnim hakkol modim sheppasul
Vetisbera rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi vela rabbi hashta rabbi adderabbi yose berabbi yehuda mosef adderabbi elazar berabbi shimon la mosef
Anan hachi kaamrinan i salka datach rabbi hi lokmah bimkom derisat ragle chohanim uvimkom derisat ragle yisrael
Ella may rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi lokmah mikkir mizbeach tzefoni ad kotel azara tzefoni ella may it lach lememar mishshum chulsha dechohen gadol hacha name mishshum chulsha dechohen gadol
Amar rabbi yochanan kidesh yadav veraglav litrumat haddeshen lemachar eno tzarich lekaddesh shekkevar kidesh mittechilat avoda
Leman i lerabbi haamar pasla lina i lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon haamar en tzarich lekaddesh afilu mikan vead asara yamim
Amar abbaye leolam lerabbi velina derabbanan hi umode demikkerot haggever vead tzafra la pasla lina
Rava amar leolam rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi veraa rabbi yochanan devarav bitchilat avoda velo besof avoda
Metivi rauhu echav hakkohanim sheyyarad vehem ratzu uvau miharu vekidshu yedehem veraglehem min hakkiyyor
b: Bishlama leabbaye demokem lah kerabbi umode rabbi demikkerot haggever ad tzafra la pasla lina ha manni rabbi hi

Ella lerava demokem lah kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon aval lerabbi mikkerot haggever ad tzafra pasla lina ha manni i rabbi pasla lina i rabbi elazar berabbi shimon ha amar afilu mikan vead asara yamim eno tzarich lekaddesh
Leolam kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon vehacha bemay askinan bechahane chadte
Ibaya lehu yetzia mahu shettoil bekidush yadayim veraglayim im timtze lomar lina la pasla dela paresh aval yetzia defaresh assoche massach dateh o dilma kevan divyado lachazor la massach
Ta shema kidesh yadav veraglav venitmeu matbilan veen tzarich lekaddesh yatzu hare hen bikdushshatan
Yatzu yadav la kamibaya lan ki kamibaya lan yatza kol gufo may

Ta shema shello rachutz yadayim veraglayim mekaddesh bichle sharet bifnim kidesh bichle sharet bachutz o bichle chol bifnim o shettaval beme meara veavad avodato pesula tama dekidesh bichle sharet bachutz ha kidesh bifnim veyatza avodato keshera
Dilma kidesh bichle sharet bachutz hechi dame kegon deappek yadav levar vekidesh ha kidesh bifnim veyatza deappek yedeh levar keshera aval yatza kol gufo tibe lach
Amar leh rav zevid lerav pappa ta shema yatza chutz limchitzat chomat haazara im lishhot taun tevila im lefi shaa taun kidush yadayim veraglayim
Amar leh hacha bemay askinan kegon sheyyatza lehasech raglav ulhattil mayim
Ha behedya katane lah kal hammesech raglav taun tevila vechol hammetil mayim taun kidush yadayim veraglayim tane vahadar mefaresh
Ta shema para rabbi chiyya bar yosef amar mekaddesh bichle sharet bifnim veotze verabbi yochanan amar afilu bachutz vaafilu bichli chol vaafilu bimkida shel cheres
Amar rav pappa shane para hoil vechol maaseha bachutz la pasla bah yetzia i hachi lema li dimkaddesh keen avoda penim

Ibaya lehu tuma mahu shettoil lekidush yadayim veraglayim im timtze lomar yetzia la pasla degavra chaze aval hacha degavra la chaze assoche massach dateh o dilma kevan dahadar chaze dak leh vela massach dateh
Ta shema kidesh yadav veraglav venitmeu matbilan veen tzarich lekaddesh
Nitmeu yadav la mibaya lan ki mibaya lan nitma kol gufo kol gufo tipok li kevan devae lemebad heerev shemesh assoche massach dateh kegon deitammi samuch lishkiat hachamma
Ta shema para rabbi chiyya berabbi yosef amar mekaddesh bichle sharet bifnim veotze verabbi yochanan amar afilu bachutz vaafilu bichli chol vaafilu bimkida shel cheres

a: Veha para detammoye metammenan leh ditnan metammein hau hakkohen hassoref et happara umatbilin oto lehotzi millibban shel tzaddukin shehau omrim bimorve shemesh hayeta naaset shema minah la pasla bah machshevet tuma
Shane para hoil ditvul yom la pasel bah i hachi lema li dimkaddesh keen avoda baenan
Ibaya lehu mahu lekaddesh yadav veraglav bakkiyyor mimmennu amar rachamana velo betocho o dilma afilu betocho
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ta shema o shettaval beme meara veavad avodato pesula ha me chiyyor dumya deme meara veavad avodato keshera
La me meara itztericha leh shello tomar kol gufo tovel bahen yadav veraglav lo kol shekken
Amar rabbi chiyya bar yosef me chiyyor nifsalin lemattirin kemattirin leevarim keevarim
Rav chisda amar af lemattirin en nifsalin ella beammud hashshachar kaevarin verabbi yochanan amar kiyyor kevan sheshshikkeo shuv en maalehu
Lememra delaavodat layela name la chaze vehaamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan mishshemeh deilfa kiyyor shello shikkeo mibbaerev mekaddesh mimmennu laavodat layela ulmachar eno mekaddesh
May eno maalehu name dekaamar laavodat yom aval laavodat layela chaze
I hachi hayenu derabbi chiyya bar yosef
b: Ika benayehu gezerat shikua
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan kidesh yadav litrumat haddeshen lemachar en tzarich lekaddesh shekkevar kidesh mittechilat avoda
Bishlama lerava demokem lehahi kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon ha kerabbi
Ella leabbaye demokem lah kerabbi kashya derabbi adderabbi may shena hatam dimshakka leh umay shena hacha dela meshakka leh
Dimsallek leh vahadar meshakka leh
I hachi lemachar eno mekaddesh ammay en tzarich lekaddesh
Lememra dilmattirin michza chaze hayenu derav chisda
Ika benayehu mitzvat shikua

Metivi lo hau roin oto velo shomin et kolo ad sheshshomim kol shel etz sheasa ben katin muchni lakkiyyor vehen omrim higgia et kidush yadayim veraglayim min hakkiyyor may lav dimsallek leh alma meshakka leh
La dimshakka leh i dimshakka leh mi mishtema kaleh meshakka leh begilgela
Lishana acharina dimshakka leh bechumarteh ki hechi delishtema kaleh velishmei velete veha hava gevini karoz abbe tere hekere hao avdi deshama mehay ate veshama mehay ate
Gufa amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina kol kiyyor sheen bo kede lekaddesh arbaa kohanim mimmennu en mekaddeshin bo shenneemar verachatzu mimmennu moshe veaharon uvanav vego
Metivi kol hakkelim mekaddeshin ben sheyyesh bahen reviit

a: Ben sheen bahen reviit uvilvad sheyehu kele sharet
Amar rav adda bar acha bekodeach betocho
Veha mimmennu amar rachamana yirchatzu lerabbot keli sharet
I hachi keli chol name amar abbaye keli chol la matzet amratte mikkal vachomer mikkanno uma kanno shennimshach immo eno mekaddesh keli chol sheeno nimshach immo eno din sheeno mekaddesh

Vechanno menalan detanya rabbi yehuda omer yachol yehe kanno mekaddesh kederech shehakkiyyor mekaddesh talmud lomar veasita kiyyor nechoshet vechanno nechoshet linchoshet hikkashtiv velo ledavar acher
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina ma lechanno sheen asuy letocho tomar bichli chol sheasuy letocho ella mimmennu lemaote keli chol
I hachi keli sharet name ha rabbi rachamana yirchatzu
Uma raita ze taun meshicha kamohu veze en taun meshicha kamohu
Amar resh lakish kol hammashlim leme mikve mashlim leme chiyyor lirviit eno mashlim
Lemaote may ilema lemaote tit haniddok hechi dame i defara shocha veshota mimmennu afilu lirviit name vei en para shocha veshota mimmennu afilu lemikve name en mashlim

Ella lemaote yavchushin adummin afilu beenayehu name deha tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol shettechilat beriyyato min hammayim matbilin bo veamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi matbilin beeno shel dag
Amar rav pappa lemaote natan sea venatal sea ditnan mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mechvanot natan sea venatal sea hare ze kasher veamar rav yehuda bar shela amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan ad rubbo
Amar rav pappa im kadach bo reviit matbilin bo mechatin vetzinoriyyot hoil umehechshera demikve ate
Amar rabbi yirmeya amar resh lakish me mikve kesherim leme chiyyor
Lememra dela mayim chayyim ninhu vehatanya bemayim velo beyayin bemayim velo bemazug bemayim lerabbot shear mayim vekal vachomer leme chiyyor may kal vachomer leme chiyyor lav demayim chayyim ninhu
La likdosh dekaddish vekaddishe mealleuta hi veha tana deve shemuel mayim sheen lahem shem levay
b: Yatzu me chiyyor sheyyesh lahem shem levay ella lav diruyin leme chiyyor alma mayim chayyim ninhu
Tannae hi deamar rabbi yochanan me chiyyor rabbi yishmael omer me mayan hen vachachamim omrim shear memot hen
Arel menalan amar rav chisda davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu middivre yechezkel ben buzi lamadnu kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi lesharteni
Umnalan demachali avoda dichtiv bahaviachem et bene nechar arle lev vearle vasar lihot bemikdashi lechallel et beti

Tanu rabbanan ben nechar yachol ben nechar mammash talmud lomar erel lev im ken ma talmud lomar ben nechar shennitnakkeru maasav leaviv shebbeshamayim veen li ella erel lev erel basar minnayin talmud lomar veerel basar
Utzrichi dei ketav rachamana erel basar mishshum dimis aval erel lev dela meis ema la vei ashmeinan erel lev mishshum deen libbo lashshamayim aval erel basar delibbo lashshamayim ema la tzerichi
Tame pasul amru zikne darom lo shanu ella teme sheretz aval teme met mittoch shemmeratztze betzibur meratztze name beyachid
I hachi teme sheretz name lete bekal vachomer mitteme met ma teme met shettaun hazzaa shelishi ushvii meratztze teme sheretz sheeno taun hazzaa shelishi ushvii eno din shemmeratztze
Kasavri zikne darom mechapperin kemitkapperin ma mitkapperin teme met in teme sheretz la af mechapperin teme met in teme sheretz la
May kasavri i kasavri en shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz ammay la avdi tzibur betuma ha kol shebbeyachid nidche tzibur avdi betuma
Ella kasavri shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz
Amar ulla teka lehu resh lakish lidromae vechi eze koach merubbe koach mechapperin o choach mitkapperin heve omer koach mitkapperin

Uma bimkom shennitmeu bealim besheretz meshallechin korbenotehen kohen shennitma besheretz eno meratztze mekom shennitmeu bealim bemet sheen meshallechin korbenotehen kohen shennitma bemet eno din sheeno meratztze
Kasavri zikne darom teme met name meshalleach korbenotav
Vehachtiv ish ish ki yihye tame vaase pesach bechodesh hashsheni vego lemitzva
Veha ketiv ish

a: Lefi ochlo lemitzva

Ulakkove la vehatanya bemichsat nefashot melammed sheen happesach nishchat ella limnuyav shechato shello limnuyav yachol yehe keover al hammitzva talmud lomar tachossu hakkatuv shana alav leakkev veitakkash ochlin limnuyin

Zikne darom la makkeshi vechi la makkeshi name meha name it lehu pircha uma bimkom shennitmeu bealim besheretz shemmeshallechin korbenotehem lechattechila kohen shennitma besheretz eno meratztze mekom shennitmeu bealim bemet sheen meshallechin korbenotehen lechattechila kohen shennitma bemet eno din sheeno meratztze
Metivi mippene sheamru nazir veose fesach hatztzitz meratztze al tumat dam veen hatztzitz meratztze al tumat hagguf
Bemay ilema betumat sheretz haamratte shochatin vezorkin al tumat sheretz ella tumat met vekatane en hatztzitz meratztze alma nitmeu bealim bemet en meshallechin korbenotehem
La i deitammo bealim bemet hachi name hacha bemay askinan kegon shennitma kohen besheretz
I hachi ema sefa nitma tumat hattehom hatztzitz meratztze ha tane rabbi chiyya lo amru tumat hattehom ella lemet bilvad lemet lemaote may lav lemaote tumat hattehom desheretz
La lemaote tumat hattehom deziva
Veella ha devae rame bar chama kohen hamratztze bekorbenotehem huttera lo tumat hattehom o lo huttera lo tumat hattehom tifshot detumat hattehom huttera lo deha hacha bechohen kayamina
Derame bar chama vadday peligi
Ta shema venasa aharon et aon hakkodashim vechi ezehu aon nose
b: Im aon pigul hare kevar neemar lo yechashev im aon notar hare kevar neemar lo yeratze
Ha eno nose ella aon tuma shehuttera mikkelalah betzibbur
May tuma ilema mittumat sheretz hecha ishteray ella tumat met velav kegon shennitmeu bealim bemet alma nitmeu bealim bemet meshallechin korbenotehen
Uvmay i benazir vechi yamut met alav amar rachamana ella leose fesach velav kegon shennitmeu bealim bemet
Leolam besheretz veshem tuma baolam
Veika dedayek umayete hachi aon hakkodashim in aon makdishin la may tuma ilema tumat sheretz mi ishtera betzibur ella lav tumat met vaaon kodashim in aon makdishim la
Leolam tumat sheretz veshem tuma baolam
Yoshev menalan amar rava amar rav nachman amar kera laamod lesharet laamida bechartiv velo lishiva
Tanu rabbanan laamod lesharet mitzva keshehu omer haomdim shana alav hakkatuv leakkev
Amar leh rava lerav nachman mikkedi yoshev kezar dame umachel avoda ema ma zar bemita af yoshev bemita allema tanya aval arel onen yoshev enan bemita ella beazhara
Mishshum dehave mechussar begadim veshello rachutz yadayim veraglayim shene chetuvin habbain keechad

a: Vechol shene chetuvim habbain keechad en melammedin
Ulman deamar melammedin shetuye yayin have leh shelishi ushlosha ledivre hakkol en melammedin

Omed al gabbe kelim al gabbe behema al gabbe ragle chavero pasul menalan detana deve rabbi yishmael hoil veritzpa mekaddeshet uchle sharet mekaddeshim ma kele sharet lo yehe davar chotzetz beno leven kele sharet af ritzpa lo yehe davar chotzetz beno leven haritzpa
Utzricha dei ashmeinan keli mishshum delav mina devasar ninhu aval behema demina devasar hu ema la vei ashmeinan behema dela mina deadam hu aval chavero deadam hu ema la tzericha

Tanya rabbi eliezer omer raglo achat al hakkeli veraglo achat al haritzpa raglo achat al haeven veraglo achat al haritzpa roin kol sheilu yinnatel hakkeli vetinnatel haeven yachol laamod al raglo achat veyaavod avodato keshera veim lav avodato pesula

Bae rabbi amme niddaldela haeven veamad aleha mahu hecha deen dato lechabberah la tibe lach devadday chayetza ki tibe lach dedato lechabberah may kevan dedato lechabberah kema dimchabbera damya o dilma hashta miha ha telisha
Rabba zute bae lah hachi bae rabbi amme neekra haeven veamad bimkomah mahu
May ka mibaya leh ki kaddesh david ritzpa elona kaddesh o dilma ad learit tehoma kaddesh vetibe leh kol haazara kullah
Leolam peshita leh dead arit tehoma kaddesh vehachi kamibaya leh derech sherut bechach o en derech sherut bechach teku
Kibel bismol pasul verabbi shimon machshir tanu rabbanan beetzbao velakach melammed shello tehe kabbala ella beyamin beetzbao venatan melammed shello tehe netina ella beyamin
Amar rabbi shimon vechi neemra yad bekabbala ella beetzbao venatan shello tehe netina ella beyamin hoil velo neemra yad bekabbala kibel bismol kasher
Verabbi shimon mimma nafshach i it leh gezera shava ki lo neemra yad bekabbala may have vei let leh gezera shava ki neemra yad bekabbala may have
Amar rav yehuda leolam let leh gezera shava vehachi kaamar vechi neemar yad yamin bekabbala hoil velo neemar yad yamin bekabbala kibbel bismol kasher
Amar leh rabba i hachi afilu netina name veod vechi let leh lerabbi shimon gezera shava vehatanya rabbi shimon omer kol makom shenneemar yad enah ella yamin etzba enah ella yamin
Ella amar rava leolam it leh gezera shava vehachi kaamar vechi neemra yad bekabbala hoil velo neemra yad bekabbala ella etzba vei efshar lekabbel beetzba kibel bismol kasher
Amar leh rav samma bereh derav ashe leravina ifshar deaved leh ozen lisfat mizrak umkabbel bah
Ella amar abbaye
b: Bemikra nidrash lefanav ulacharav kamipalgi

Amar abbaye ha derabbi elazar berabbi shimon mappeka middaavuh umappeka midderabbanan detanya rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer kol makom shenneemar etzba bekabbala shina bakkabbala pasul bannetina kasher vechol makom shenneemar etzba bintina shina bannetina pasul bakkabbala kasher
Vehechan neemar etzba bintina dichtiv velakachta middam happar venatatta al karnot hammizbeach beetzbaecha vekasavar mikra nidrash lefanav velo lifne fanav ulacharav
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol makom shenneemar etzba uchhunna enah ella yamin

Ka salka datin tarte baenan kedichtiv velakach hakkohen middam hachattat beetzbao veyalef mimmetzora dichtiv vetaval hakkohen et etzbao hayemanit vahare kemitza dela ketiv bah ella kehunna utnan kamatz bismol pasul
Ella amar rava o etzba o kehunna

Amar leh abbaye hare holachat evarim lakkevesh dichtiv behu kehunna dichtiv vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol vehiktir hammizbecha veamar mar zo holachat evarim lakkevesh utnan haregel shel yamin bismolo uvet orah lachutz
Ki amrinan o etzba o kehunna bedavar hamakkev kappara dumya dimtzora
Vahare kabbala dichtav behu kehunna vedavar hamakkev bechappara hu utnan kibbel bismol pasul verabbi shimon machshir
Rabbi shimon tarte bae
Mi bae rabbi shimon tarte vehatanya rabbi shimon omer kol makom shenneemar yad eno ella yamin etzba eno ella yamin
Etzba la baaya kehunna kehunna baaya etzba
Veella kohen lema li bechihunnan bechihunno
Vahare zerika dela ketiv behu ella kehunna utnan zarak bismol pasul vela pelig rabbi shimon
Amar abbaye pelig bevarayeta detanya kibel bismol pasul verabbi shimon machshir zarak bismol pasul verabbi shimon machshir
Ella ha deamar rava yadyad likmitza regelregel lachalitza ozenozen lirtzia lema li midderabba bar bar chana nafka
Chad lekometz vechad lekidush kometz

a: Ulrabbi shimon dela bae kidush kometz ulman deamar lerabbi shimon name bae kidush kometz bismol achshore machshar yadyad derava lema li
I likmitza atzmah midderav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya nafka deamar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya may tama derabbi shimon deamar kera kodesh kadashim hi kachattat vechaasham
Ba leovdah bayyad ovdah beyamin kechattat ba leovdah bichli ovdah bismol keasham
Lo nitzrecha ella lekometz minchat chote salka datach amena hoil veamar rabbi shimon shello yehe korbano mehuddar ki kamatz lah bismol name titachshar ka mashma lan
Matni nishpach haddam al haritzpa vaasafo pasul
Gema tanu rabbanan velakach hakkohen hammashiach middam happar middam hannefesh velo middam haor velo middam hattamtzit

Middam happar dam mehappar yekabbelennu dei salka datach middam happar kedichtiv middam vaafilu miktzat dam vehaamar rav hashshochet tzarich sheyekabbel et kol damo shel par shenneemar veet kol damo yishpoch
Ella middam happar dam mehappar yekabbelennu vekasavar gorin umosifin vedorshin
Gufa amar rav yehuda amar rav hashshochet tzarich sheyekabbel et kol damo shel par shenneemar veet kol dam happar yishpoch veha beshirayim ketiv
Im eno inyan leshirayim deha leteh lechulleh dam tenehu inyan bekabbala lekabbala
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hashshochet tzarich sheyyagbiha sakkin lemala shenneemar velakach middam happar velo middam happar vedavar acher
Vedam sakkin bemay mekannach leh amar abbaye bisfat mizrak kedichtiv kefore zahav
Amar rav chisda amar rav yirmeya bar abba hashshochet tzarich sheyyitten
b: Veridin letoch hakkeli itmar name amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan veridin tzarich sheyyiru avir keli
Bea mineh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan haya mekabbel venifchatu shule mizrak ad shello higgia dam laavir mahu avir sheen sofo lanuach kemunnach dame o la kemunnach dame
Amar leh tenetuha chavit shemmunnachat tachat hazzinuk mayim shebbetochah veshebbechutza lah pesulin tzeraf piha lazzinuk mayim shebbetochah pesulin veshebbechutza lah kesherin
Hay may bae mineh avir sheen sofo lanuach veka fashet leh avir shessofo lanuach
Tarte ka vae mineh im timtze lomar avir sheen sofo lanuach lav kemunnach dame avir shessofo lanuach may
Rav yosef matne hachi rav kahana matne chavit bea mineh ufshat leh chavit
Rabba matne chavit bea mineh ufshat leh mizrak i atta mode bemizrak shei ifshar lo belo zinuk
Tenan hatam natan yado o raglo o ale yerakot kede sheyyaavru mayim lechavit pesulin ale kanim vaale egozim keshera ze hakkelal davar hamkabbel tuma pesulin davar sheeno mekabbel tuma kesherin
Mena hane mile deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose bar abba amar kera ach mayan uvor mikve mayim yihye tahor havayatan al yede tohora tehe
Amar rabbi chiyya amar rabbi yochanan zot omeret avir keli kichli dame
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi chiyya bar abba vedilma beshotet amar leh terada kede sheyyaavru mayim lechavit tenan

Veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan meeduto shel rabbi tzadok nishnet mishna zo ditnan heid rabbi tzadok al hazzochalin shekkilchan baale egozin shehen kesherin ze haya maase beohaliyya uva maase lifne chachamim belishkat haggazit vehichshiru
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi hatztzorem ozen happar veachar kach kibel damo pasul shenneemar velakach middam happar par shehaya kevar
Ashkechan kodshe kodashim kadashim kallim menalan
Amar rava tanya se tamim zachar ben shana sheyehe tamim uven shana bishat shechita bekabbala beholacha bizrika minnayin talmud lomar yihye kol havayotav lo yihu ella tam uven shana
Etiveh abbaye rabbi yehoshua omer kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer mehen kezayit basar o kezayit chelev zorek et haddam
Targuma abben shana
Umi ika mide devishat shechita ben shana bishat holacha uzrika ben shettem
Amar rava zot omeret shaot poslot bakkodashim
Amar rabbi amme amar rabbi elazar hi bifnim veragleha bachutz chatach veachar kach shachat keshera

a: Shachat veachar kach chatach pesula
Chatach veachar kach shachat keshera baal mum ka makriv ella ema chatach veachar kach kibel keshera kibel veachar kach chatach pesula
Chatach veachar kach kibel keshera veha amar rabbi zera hatztzorem ozen bivchor veachar kach kibel damo pasul shenneemar velakach middam happar par shehaya kevar
Amar rav chisda amar avimi chotech baevar ad shemmaggia laetzem
Kibel veachar kach chatach pesula shamatte minah dam hammuvla baevarim dam hu
Dilma mishshum shamnunit
Shamatte minah besar kadashim kallim sheyyatza lifne zerikat dam pasul
Dilma bekodshe kadashim

Tanu rabbanan kodshe kadashim shechitatan batztzafon vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon amad baddarom vehoshit yado latztzafon veshachat shechitato keshera kibel kabbalato pesula hichnis rosho verubbo keilu nichnas kullo pirkesa veyatzta laddarom vechazra keshera

Kadashim kallim shechitatan bifnim vekibul daman bichli sharet bifnim amad bachutz vehichnis yado lifnim veshachat shechitato keshera kibel kabbalato pesula vehichnis rosho verubbo keilu lo nichnas pirkesa veyatzta lachutz vechazra pesula shema minah besar kadashim kallim sheyyatza lifne zerikat damim pesulim
Dilma bealya veoteret hakkaved ushte chelaot
Bea mineh avuh dishmuel mishshemuel hi bifnim veragleha bachutz mahu
Amar leh ketiv vehevium la ad shettehe kullah lifnim
Tala veshachat mahu amar leh keshera amar leh ishtabbashte baenan shechita al yarech veleka
Nitla veshachat mahu amar leh pesula amar leh ishtabbashte shechita al yarech velo shochet al yarech
Nitla vekibbel mahu amar leh keshera amar leh ishtabbashte en derech sherut bechach
Tala vekibel mahu amar leh pesula amar leh ishtabbashte shechita al yarech velo kabbala al yarech
Amar abbaye bekodshe kadashim kullan pesulot bar minnitla veshachat bekadashim kallim kullan kesherot bar min nitla vekibel
Amar rava may shena tala vekibel bekadashim kallim dichshera daavir penim kifnim dame bekodshe kadashim name avir tzafon ketzafon dame
Ella amar rava ben bekodshe kadashim ben bekadashim kallim kesherot bar min tala veshachat bekodshe kadashim nitla vekibel ben bekodshe kadashim ben bekadashim kallim
Bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera hu bifnim vetzitzito bachutz mahu amar leh lav amratte vehevium la ad shettavo kullah lifnim hacha name bevoam el ohel moed ad sheyyavo kullo leohel moed

Matni netano al gabbe hakkevesh shello keneged hayesod natan et hannitanin lematta lemala veet hannitanin lemala lematta veet hannitanin bifnim bachutz veet hannitanin bachutz bifnim pasul veen bo karet
b: Gema amar shemuel pasul basar aval bealim nitkapperu may tama deamar kera vaani netattiv lachem al hammizbeach lechapper kevan shehiggia dam lammizbeach nitkapperu bealim
I hachi basar name amar kera lechapper lechappara netattiv velo ledavar acher

Alma kasavar shello bimkomo kimkomo dame tenan beidach pirkin netano al hakkevesh shello keneged hayesod natan et hannitanin lematta lemala veet hannitanin lemala lematta veet hannitanin bifnim bachutz veet hannitanin bachutz bifnim im yesh dam hannefesh yachzor hakkasher vikabbel
Vei salka datach shello bimkomo kimkomo lema li yachzor hakkasher vikabbel vechi tema lehattir basar baachila mi ika zerika dela mechappera vesharya basar baachila
I deyahaveh kasher hachi name hacha bemay askinan deyahaveh pasul
Velihve dachuy ditnan vechullan shekkiblu chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo im yesh dam hannefesh yachzor hakkasher vikabbel kiblu in zarku la may tama lav mishshum dehave dachuy
La mishshum difsil bemachshava
I hachi kabbala name veod mi pasla machshava vehaamar rava en machshava moelet ella bemi sherauy laavoda uvdavar harauy laavoda uvmakom harauy laavoda
La tema zarku la ella ema shachatu la
May ka mashma lan defasla machshava tenena lefichach hen poslin bemachshava
Ha ka mashma lan demikkabbala veelach la pasla machshava may tama kidrava
Metivi chishev liten et hannitanin lemala lematta lematta lemala lealtar kasher lemachar pasul chazar vechishev

a: Chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmanno pigul vechayyavin alav karet
Lemachar pasul chazar vechishev ben chutz lizmanno ben chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet
Vei shello bimkomo kimkomo dame hay pasul pigul hu
Amar mar zutra zerika desharya basar baachila mayetya lide pigul zerika dela sharya basar baachila la mayetya lide pigul
Amar leh rav ashe lemar zutra mena lach ha dichtiv veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav piggul yihye mi sheppigulo garam lo yatza ze sheen pigulo garam lo ella isur davar acher garam lo
I hachi ipsole name la lipsel
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mide dehave ammachshevet hinuach vealliba derabbi yehuda
Resh lakish amar leolam pasul mammash veshello bimkomo kimkomo dame vela kashya kan shennatan bishtika kan shennatan baamira
Tenan chishev liten et hannitanin lematta lemala lemala lematta ad mide dehave ammachshevet hinuach vealliba derabbi yehuda ku
Rabbi yochanan amar ide veide shennatan bishtika veshello bimkomo lav kimkomo dame veha deika dam hannefesh ha deleka dam hannefesh
Tenan pasul veen bo karet bishlama leresh lakish hayenu dekatane pasul veen bo karet
Ella lerabbi yochanan may en bo karet kashya
Velishmuel may en bo karet hachi kaamar im natan bemachshava pasul veen bo karet
Verabbi yochanan i shello bimkomo lav kimkomo dame leheve ki nishpach min hakkeli al haritzpa veyaasfennu

Savar lah keman daamar lo yaasfennu deamar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim bannitanin lemala shennetanan lemala lematta shennetanan lematta shello kemitzvatan lo yaasfennu lo nechleku ella bannitanin lemala shennetanan lematta lematta shennetanan lemala sherabbi yose omer lo yaasfennu verabbi shimon omer yaasfennu
b: Umishnatenu kedivre haomer lo yaasfennu

Verav chisda amar avimi hakkol modin bannitanin lematta shennetanan lemala shello yaasfennu vechol shekken bannitanin lemala shennetanan lematta hoil vedamim haelonim lematta hen bain lo nechleku ella bannitanin lifnim shennetanan bachutz bachutz shennetanan lifnim sherabbi yose omer yaasfennu verabbi shimon omer lo yaasfennu
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak af anan name tenena rabbi yehuda omer zot hi haola hare ellu miutin perat lenishchata ballayela veshennishpach damah vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim im alta tered

Rabbi shimon omer ola en li ella ola keshera minnayin lerabbot shennishchata ballayela veshennishpach damah vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim vehallan vehayyotze vehattame veshennishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo veshekkiblu pesulin vezarku et damah vehannitanin lemala shennetanan lematta vehannitanin lematta shennetanan lemala vehannitanin bifnim shennetanan bachutz vehannitanin bachutz shennetanan bifnim vehappesach vehachattat sheshshechatan shello lishman minnayin
Talmud lomar torat haola riba tora achat lechol haolin sheim alu lo yerdu
Yachol sheani merabbe af harovea vehannirba vehammuktze vehanneevad vehaetnan vehammechir vehakkilayim vehatterefa veotze dofen talmud lomar zot
Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulhotzi et ellu merabbe ani et ellu shehaya pesulan bakkodesh umotzi ani et ellu shello haya pesulan bakkodesh
Katane miha hannitanin lematta shennetanan lemala ulmala shennetanan lematta vela pelig rabbi yehuda may tama lav mishshum dekalteh mizbeach ushma minah lo yaasfennu
Amar rabbi eliezer mizbeach happenimi mekaddesh pesulin
May ka mashma lan tenena hannitanin befanim ku
I mehatam hava amena hane mile dam dachaze leh aval kometz dela chaze leh ema la ka mashma lan
Metivi ketoret zara shealta legabbe mizbeach tered sheen lecha mekaddesh pesulin ella mizbeach hachitzon berauy lo chitzon in penimi la
Taretz hachi ketoret zara shealta lemizbeach hachitzon tered sheen mizbeach hachitzon mekaddesh pesulin ella harauy lo vehappenimi ben rauy lo ben sheen rauy lo may tama hay ritzpa vehay kele sharet

Matni hashshochet et hazzevach lizrok damo bachutz o miktzat damo bachutz lehaktir emurav bachutz o miktzat emurav bachutz leechol besaro bachutz o kezayit mibbesaro bachutz o leechol kezayit meor haalya bachutz pasul veen bo karet

Lizrok damo lemachar miktzat damo lemachar lehaktir emurav lemachar o miktzat emurav lemachar leechol besaro lemachar o kezayit mibbesaro lemachar o leechol kezayit meor haalya lemachar pigul vechayyavin alav karet
Gema savruha or alya

a: Kealya dame veha ka mechashshev meachilat mizbeach leadam
Amar shemuel ha manni rabbi eliezer hi deamar mechashshevin meachilat mizbeach laachilat adam umeachilat adam laachilat mizbeach
Ditnan hashshochet et hazzevach leechol davar sheen darko leechol lehaktir davar sheen darko lehaktir kasher verabbi eliezer posel
Bemay okemtah kerabbi eliezer ema sefa ze hakkelal kol hashshochet vehamkabbel vehammolich vehazzorek leechol davar sheddarko leechol ulhaktir davar sheddarko lehaktir
Davar sheddarko leechol in sheen darko leechol la atan lerabbanan resha rabbi eliezer vesefa rabbanan amar leh in
Rav huna amar or alya lav kealya dame amar rava may tama derav huna chelbo haalya velo or haalya
Rav chisda amar leolam or haalya kealya dame vehacha bemay askinan bealya shel gedi
Kullehu kishmuel la amri resha rabbi eliezer vesefa rabbanan la mokmi kerav huna la amri or alya kealya dame ka mashma lehu
Kerav chisda may tama la amri may ka mashma lan or alya kealya deme tenena veellu sheorotehen kivsaran or shettachat haalya

Verav chisda itzterich salka datach amena hane mile leinyan tuma derakkich mitzteref aval hacha ema lemoshcha ligdulla kederech shehammelachim ochlin vela avidi melachim deachli hachi ema la ka mashma lan
Metivi hashshochet et haola lehaktir kezayit meor shettachat haalya chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmanno pigul vechayyavin alav karet

Elazar ben yehuda ish avelim omer mishshum rabbi yaakov vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar ikus omer mishshum rabbi shimon echad or bet happerasot behema dakka veechad or harosh shel egel harach veechad or shettachat haalya vechol shemmanu chachamim gabbe tuma veellu sheorotehen kivsaran lehavi or shel bet habboshet chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmanno pigul vechayyavin alav karet
Ola in aval zevach la bishlama lerav huna hayenu dekatane ola ella lerav chisda may irya detane ola litne zevach
Amar lecha rav chisda ibaet ema bealya shel gedi veibaet ema teni zevach
Pasul veen bo karet ku mena hane mile amar shemuel tere kerae ketivi
May hi amar rabba shelishi zehu chutz lizmanno
Piggul zehu chutz limkomo vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu echad velo shenayim zehu chutz lizmanno ulmaote chutz limkomo
Veema vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu zehu chutz limkomo ulmaote chutz lizmanno mistabbera chutz lizmanno adif diftach beh adderabba chutz limkomo adif dismich leh

Ella amar abbaye ki ata rav yitzchak bar avdimi amar rav samech addetane tanna keshehu omer shelishi befarashat kedoshim tihu sheen talmud lomar shehare kevar neemar veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach hashshelamim beom hashshelishi
b: Im eno inyan lechutz lizmanno tenehu leinyan chutz limkomo umiet rachamana gabbe notar veochlav aono yissa lemaote chutz limkomo
Veema veochlav aono yissa zehu chutz limkomo ulmaote notar mikkaret
Mistabbera notar hava leh leokome becharet lemigmar aonaon lechutz lizmanno dedame leh bezv
Adderabba chutz limkomo hava leh leokome becharet lemigmar aonaon lechutz lizmanno dedame leh bemkdsh
Ella amar rabbi yochanan tane zavdi bar levi atya kodeshkodesh ketiv hacha et kodesh Adonai chillel venichreta uchtiv hatam vesarafta et hannotar baesh vego ma lehallan notar af kan notar
Umiet rachamana gabbe notar veochlav aono yissa lemaote chutz limkomo mikkaret
Umay chazet dikra aricha bechutz lizmanno ushlishi defarashat kedoshim tihu chutz limkomo efoch ana
Mistabbera aricha bechutz lizmanno degamar aonaon minnotar dedame leh bezv
Adderabba aricha bechutz limkomo ushlishi dikdoshim tihu bechutz lizmanno mishshum dedame leh samcheh veka memaet leh
Ella amar rava kullehu mikkera aricha atayin dichtiv heachol yeachel bishte achilot hakkatuv medabber echad achilat adam veechad achilat mizbeach
Mibbesar zevach shelamav ma shelamim mefaggelin umitpaggelin af kol mefaggelin umitpaggelin
Shelishi ze chutz lizmanno
Lo yeratze kehartzaat kasher ken hartzaat pasul uma hartzaat kasher ad sheyyakrivu kol mattirav af hartzaat pasul ad sheyyakrivu kol mattirav
Hammakriv behakrava hu nifsal veeno nifsal bishlishi oto bazzevach hakkatuv medabber veeno medabber bakkohen
Lo yechashev

Yihye melammed shemmitztarfin ze im ze

Ben azzay omer oto ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar lo teacher leshallemo yachol af meacher nidro belo yeratze talmud lomar oto oto belo yeratze veen hamacher nidro belo yeratze

Urminhu veshachat shechita bezar keshera shehashshechita keshera bezarim uvnashim uvaavadim uvitmeim vaafilu bekodshe kadashim o eno ella bakkohanim

a: Mikkelal detarvayehu sevira lehu tuma dechuya hi betzibbur

Veleeved pishpesh abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil et kol melechet hattavnit
Ika deamri amar rav yosef kal hassomech rosho verubbo machnis may tama kol kocho baenan hilkach la efshar
May kasavar i kasavar semichat asham metzora deorayeta vetechef lismicha shechita deorayeta leul velismoch lehedya derachamana amar
Amar rav adda bar matna gezera shemma yarbe bifsiot ika deamri amar rav adda bar matna semichat asham metzora deorayeta vetechef lismicha shechita lav deorayeta
Metivi vesamach veshachat ma semicha bithorin af shechita bithorin vei amratte lav deorayeta bitmein name mashkachatte lah
Ella efoch semichat asham metzora lav deorayeta vetechef lismicha shechita deorayeta
b: Ravina amar leinyan malkot itmar
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi avahu leinyan tame shennaga bakkodesh itmar
Deitmar tame shennaga bekodesh resh lakish amar loke rabbi yochanan amar eno loke resh lakish amar loke bechol kodesh lo tigga verabbi yochanan amar eno loke hahu bitruma ketiv
Veresh lakish hay kera lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh azhara leochel besar kodesh deitmar azhara laochel besar kodesh minnayin resh lakish amar bechol kodesh lo tigga
Rabbi yochanan amar tane bardela atya tumatotumato mibbiat mikdash ma lehallan anash vehizhir af kan anash vehizhir
Tame shennaga bakkodesh middeappekah rachamana bilshon negia azhara laochel middeitakkash kodesh lemikdash
Tanya kevateh deresh lakish bechol kodesh lo tigga azhara laochel atta omer azhara leochel o eno ella lannogea
Talmud lomar bechol kodesh lo tigga veel hammikdash lo tavo makkish kodesh lemikdash ma mikdash davar sheyyesh bo

a: Netilat neshama af kodesh davar sheyyesh bo netilat neshama vei benogea netilat neshama mi ika ella baachila
Veakkatti mibe leh letame sheachal besar kodesh lifne zerika deittemar tame sheachal besar kodesh lifne zerika resh lakish amar loke verabbi yochanan amar eno loke
Resh lakish amar loke bechol kodesh lo tigga la shena lifne zerika vela shena leachar zerika rabbi yochanan amar eno loke kidtane bardela atya tumatotumato vechi ketav hahu leachar zerika
Im ken lema kera bekodesh may bechol kodesh shema minah tarte
Gufa tame sheachal besar kodesh lifne zerika resh lakish amar loke rabbi yochanan amar eno loke amar abbaye machloket betumat hagguf aval betumat basar divre hakkol loke
Deamar kera vehabbasar lerabbot etzim ulvona delav bene achila ninhu vaafilu hachi rabbinhu kera
Verava amar machloket betumat hagguf aval betumat basar divre hakkol eno loke may tama kevan dela karena beh vetumato alav venichreta la karena beh vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel
Vehaamar mar vehabbasar lerabbot etzim ulvona
Hacha bemay askinan kegon shekkadshu bichli denaasa kemi shekkarvu kal mattirav
Ditnan kol sheyyesh lo mattirim mishshekkarvu mattirav kol sheen lo mattirin mishshekkadash bichli

Itmar hammaale evre behema temea al gabbe hammizbeach resh lakish amar loke rabbi yochanan amar eno loke resh lakish amar loke tehora in temea la velav habba mikkelal ase lokin alav verabbi yochanan amar en lokin alav lav habba mikkelal ase en lokin alav
Motev rabbi yirmeya otah tochelu velo behema temea velav habba mikkelal ase ase

Amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa asberah lach beevre behema temea dechulle alma la peligi ki feligi bechayya vehachi itmar rabbi yochanan amar over baase resh lakish amar eno over bivelo kelum
Rabbi yochanan amar over baase behema in chayya la resh lakish amar eno over alav bivelo kelum hahu lemitzva

Motev rava ilu neemar korban la behema hayiti omer chayya bichlal behema keinyan shenneemar zot habbehema asher tochelu shor se chesavim vese izzim ayyal utzvi vego talmud lomar bakar vatzon bakar vatzon amarti lecha velo chayya
Yachol lo yavi veim hevi kasher ha lema ze dome letalmid sheamar lo rabbo have li chittim vehevi lo chittim usorim sheeno kemaavir al devarav ella mosif al devarav vechasher

Talmud lomar bakar vatzon bakar vatzon amarti lecha velo chayya ha lema ze dome letalmid sheamar lo rabbo al tavi li ella chitin vehevi lo chitin usorim sheeno kemosif al devarav ella kemaavir al devarav
