Vechullan shekkiblu ku bea mineh resh lakish merabbi yochanan pasul mahu sheyyaase shirayim
Amar leh en ose shirayim ella chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo hoil umratztze lefigulo

Rav zevid matne hachi bea mineh resh lakish merabbi yochanan kos pasul mahu sheyyaase shirayim amar leh pasul gufeh may sevira lach i pasul meshave shirayim kos pasul name meshave shirayim i pasul la meshave shirayim kos pasul name la meshave shirayim
Rav yirmeya middifti matne hachi bea mineh abbaye merava merabba kos mahu sheyyaase et chavero dachuy o shirayim
Amar leh pelugta derabbi elazar berabbi shimon verabbanan detanya lemala hu omer et damo yishpoch lematta hu omer veet kol damah yishpoch
Minnayin lechattat shekkibel damah bearbaa kosot venatan mattana achat mizze umattana achat mizze shekkullan nishpachin layesod talmud lomar veet kol damah yishpoch
Yachol natan arba mattanot mikkos echad yehu kullan nishpachin layesod talmud lomar veet damo ha ketzad hu nishpach layesod vehen nishpachin laamma

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer minnayin lechattat shekkibel dama bearbaa kosot venatan arba mattanot mikkos echad shekkullan nishpachin layesod talmud lomar veet kol damah yishpoch vehachtiv veet damo yishpoch amar rav ashe hahu lemaote shirayim shebbetzavar behema
Kibel hakkasher venatan lappasul ku
Utzricha dei ashmeinan pasul hava amena may pasul tame dachaze laavodat tzibur aval semol la
Vei ashmeinan semol deit leh hechshera beom hakkipurim aval kele chol la
Vei ashmeinan kele chol mishshum dachazu lekaddoshinhu aval hanach ema la tzericha
Veleheve leh dachuy amar leh ravina lerav ashe hachi amar rav yirmeya middifti mishshemeh derava ha manni chanan hammitzri hu delet leh dechuyin
Detanya chanan hammitzri omer afilu dam bakkos mevi chavero umzaveg lo
Rav ashe amar kol shebbeyado la have dachuy

Amar rav shayya kevateh derav ashe mistabbera man shamatte leh deit leh dechuyin rabbi yehuda ditnan veod amar rabbi yehuda nishpach haddam yamut hammishtalleach met hammishtalleach yishshafech haddam

Veshaminan leh deamar kol shebbeyado la have dachuy detanya rabbi yehuda omer kos echad haya memalle middam hattaarovet vezorko zerika achat keneged hayesod shema minah kol shebbeyado la have dachuy shema minah

Gufa tanya rabbi yehuda omer kos echad haya memalle middam hattaarovet sheim yishshafech echad mehem nimtza shehu machshiro amru lo lerabbi yehuda vahalo lo nitkabbel bichli mena yadi ella shemma lo nitkabbel bichli amar lahen

a: Af ani lo amarti ella keshennitkabbel bichli vehu gufeh mena yada kohanim zerizin veavdin hayya umishtafchin
Vahalo dam hattamtzit meorav bo rabbi yehuda letameh deamar dam hattamtzit karuy dam
Detanya dam hattamtzit beazhara rabbi yehuda omer becharet
Vehaamar rabbi elazar mode rabbi yehuda leinyan kappara sheeno mechapper shenneemar ki haddam hu hannafesh
Dam shehannefesh yotza bo karuy dam sheen hannefesh yotza bo en karuy dam
Ella rabbi yehuda letameh deamar en dam mevattel dam
Amar lahem rabbi yehuda ledivrechem lamma pokkin haazara amru lo shevach hu livne aharon sheyehallechu ad archubbotehen baddam
Veha dam have chatzitza lach hu vela have chatzitza ditnan haddam vehaddeo vehaddevash vehechalav yeveshin chotztzin lachin en chotztzin

Veha ka mitavvesi manayehu utnan hau begadav metushtashin veavad avodato pesula vechi tema dimdallu lehu vehatanya middo kemiddato shello yechasser veshello yotir beholachat evarim lakkevesh delav avoda hi
Vela vehatanya vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol zo holachat evarim lakkevesh ella beholachat etzim lammaaracha delav avoda hi velaavoda hechi azli azli aitzteve
Matni hashshochet et hazzevach leechol davar sheen darko leechol ulhaktir davar sheen darko lehaktir kasher verabbi eliezer posel
Leechol davar sheddarko leechol ulhaktir davar sheddarko lehaktir pachot mikkezayit kasher leechol kachatzi zayit ulhaktir kachatzi zayit kasher sheen achila vehaktara mitztarfin

Hashshochet et hazzevach leechol kezayit min haor umin harotev umin hakkefe umin haalal umin haatzamot umin haggidin umin hakkeranayim umin hattelafayim chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo kasher veen chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul venotar vetame
Hashshochet et hammukdashin leechol shelil o shilya bachutz lo pigel hammolek et hattorin leechol betzehen bachutz lo pigel
Chalev mukdashin uvetze torin en chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul venotar vetame
Gema amar rabbi elazar pigel bazzevach nitpaggel hashshelil bashshelil lo nitpaggel hazzevach pigel baalal nitpaggela mura bammura lo nitpaggel alal
Pigel baemurin nitpaggelu parim bapparim lo nitpaggelu emurim
Lema mesayya leh veshavim sheim chishev baachilat parim uvisrefatan lo asa velo chelum may lav ha chishev baemurim nitpaggelu parim la
b: Ha chishev baemurin nitpaggelu emurin atzman
Ta shema parim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu nishchatu huchsheru lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kipurim uvlina
May lav linat basar ushma minah miggo defasla belina pasla bah machshava
La linat emurim ha middekatane sefa kullan moalin bahen al bet haddeshen ad sheyyuttach habbasar mikkelal deresha linat basar mide irya ha kiditah veha kiditah resha emurim vesefa basar

Motev rava rabba veellu sheen mefaggelin veen mitpaggelin tzemer shebberashe chevasim usar shebbizkan teyashim vehaor veharotev vehakkefe vehaalal vehammura vehaatzamot vehaggidin vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim vehashshelil vehashshilya vachalev hammukdashin uvetze torin
Kullan lo mefaggelin velo mitpaggelin veen chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame vehammaale mehen bachutz patur
May lav lo mefaggelin hazzevach velo mitpaggelin mechamat zevach
La lo mefaggelin et hazzevach velo mitpaggelin mechamat atzman i hachi ha dekatane sefa kullan lo mefaggelin velo mitpaggelin ha tu lema li
Velitamach en chayyavin alav mishshum pigul ha tu lema li ella ayede devae lemitna notar vetame tena pigul
Hacha name ayede devae lemitne hammaale mehen bachutz tena name vechullan lo mefaggelin velo mitpaggelin
Rava amar af anan name tenena hashshochet et hammukdashim leechol shelil o shilya bachutz lo pigel vehammolek et hattorim leechol betzehem bachutz lo pigel
Vahadar tane chalev hammukdashin uvetze torim en chayyav alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame ha shelil veshilya chayyavim
Ella lav shema minah kan mechamat hazzevach kan mechamat atzman shema minah
Tenan hatam uvaale mumin rabbi akiva machshir bevaale mumim
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lo hichshir rabbi akiva ella bedukkin shebbaayin hoil uchsherim beofot vehu shekkadam hekdeshah et mumah
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba umode rabbi akiva beolat nekeva dichman dikdam mumah lehekdeshah dame
Metiv rabbi zera hammaale mehen bachutz patur ha meiman chayyav vehechi mashkachatte lah beolat nekeva
I amratte bishlama kasavar rabbi akiva olat nekeva im alta lo tered ha manni rabbi akiva hi ella i amratte im alta tered ha manni
Ema hammaale mehen bachutz patur ha meemure iman chayyav
Veha mehen katane veiman dumya didhu ella ema hammaale meemurehen bachutz patur ha meemure iman chayyav

Matni shechato al menat lehanniach et damo o emurav lemachar o lehotzian lachutz rabbi yehuda posel vachachamim machshirin al menat litnan al gabbe hakkevesh shello keneged hayesod veliten et hannitanim lemalan lematta veet hannitanim lematta lemalan veet hannitanim

a: Bifnim bachutz veet hannitanin bachutz bifnim sheyyochluhu temeim sheyyakrivuhu temeim sheyyochluhu arelim vesheyyakrivuhu arelim leshabber atzmot happesach leechol hemennu na ularev damo bedam happesulim kasher
Sheen machshava poselet ella bechutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo vehappesach vehachattat shello lishman

Gema may tama derabbi yehuda amar rabbi elazar tere kerae ketivi benotar katuv echad omer lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vechatuv echad omer lo yanniach mimmennu ad boker im eno inyan lehinniach tenehu leinyan machshevet hinuach
Verabbi yehuda hay kera lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidtanya uvsar zevach todat shelamav lamadnu letoda shenneechelet leom valayela
Chalifin veladot temurot minnayin talmud lomar uvsar chattat veasham minnayin talmud lomar zevach
Uminnayin lerabbot shalme nazir veshalme fesach talmud lomar shelamav lachme toda vechallot urkikim shebbenazir minnayin talmud lomar korbano kullan kore ani bahen lo yanniach
Im ken lema kera lo totiru may lo yanniach im eno inyan lehinuach tenehu inyan lemachshevet hinuach
Hatinach lehaniach lehotzi may ika lememar

Veod tama derabbi yehuda sevara hu detanya amar lahem rabbi yehuda i attem modim sheim hinnicho lemachar shehu pasul af chishev lehannicho lemachar pasul ella tama derabbi yehuda sevara hu veniflog name rabbi yehuda bechullehu
Behe niflog beshover atzmot happesach veleechol mimmennu na zivcha gufeh mi mipsil
Al menat sheyyochluhu temeim vesheyyakrivuhu temeim zivcha gufeh mi mipsil sheyyochluhu arelim vesheyyakrivuhu arelim zivcha gufeh mi mipsil lishana acharina kol kemineh
Learev daman bedam happesulin rabbi yehuda letameh deamar en dam mevattel dam liten et hannitanin lemala lematta lematta lemala rabbi yehuda letameh deamar shello limkomo name mekomo karena beh
Veliflog bannitanin bifnim shennetanan bachutz vehannitanin bachutz shennetanan bifnim
Kasavar rabbi yehuda baenan mekom sheyehe meshullash bedam bevasar uvemurin
Umi it leh lerabbi yehuda hay sevara vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer davar ra riba kan chattat sheshshechatah baddarom vechattat shennichnas damah lifnim pesula
Velet lerabbi yehuda shelishi vehatnan amar rabbi yehuda hichnis beshogeg kasher ha bemezid pasul vekayema lan beshekkiper
Hashta uma hatam ayeli ayela deayyole ayeleh i kiper in i lo kiper la hacha dechashshev chashshove lo kol shekken tere tannae vealliba derabbi yehuda
Vesavar rabbi yehuda chattat sheshshechatah baddarom
b: Yehe chayyav

Vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer yachol chattat sheshshechatah baddarom yehe chayyav talmud lomar lo tizbach la elohecha shor vase vego kol davar ra al davar ra atta mechayevo vei atta mechayevo al chattat sheshshechatah baddarom tere tannae alliba derabbi yehuda
Amar rabbi abba umode rabbi yehuda shechozer vekovo lefigul
Amar rava tidda defigul lifne zerika la kelum hu veatya zerika vekava lah befigul
Vela hi hatam hu chada machshava hi hacha tere machshavot
Etiveh rav huna lerabbi abba liten et hannitanin lemala lematta lematta lemala lealtar kasher chazar vechishev chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmanno pigul vechayyavin alav karet
Lemachar pasul chazar vechishev ben chutz lizmanno ben chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet teuvta derabbi abba teuvta
Amar rav chisda amar ravina bar sela chishev sheyyochluhu temeim lemachar chayyav amar rava tidda devasar lifne zerika la chaze vechi mechashshev beh mipsil
Vela hi hatam zarek umichaze hacha la michze kelal
Amar rav chisda margela befummeh derav dimi bar chinana besar pesach shello hutzla velachme toda shello hurmu chayyavin alehen mishshum tuma
Amar rava tidda detanya asher la lerabbot emure kadashim kallim letuma
Alma af al gav delav bene achila ninhu chayyavin alehen mishshum tuma hacha name af al gav delav bene achila ninhu chayyavin alehen mishshum tuma
Vela hi hatam emure kadashim kallim chazu legavoha leappoke besar pesach shello hutzla velachme toda shello hurmu dela chazu la legavoha vela lehedot
Lishana acharina ha emurin la chazu vela hi hanach chazu lemiltayehu vehane la chazu kelal
Hadaran alach kol happesulin
Matni bet shammay omrim kol hannitanin al mizbeach hachitzon shennatan bemattana achat kiper uvchattat shette mattanot uvet hillel omrim af chattat shennetanah mattana achat kiper
Lefichach im natan et harishona ketiknah veet hashsheniyya chutz lizmannah kiper
Veim natan et harishona chutz lizmannah veet hashsheniyya chutz limkomah pigul vechayyavin alav karet
Kol hannitanin al hammizbeach happenimi sheim chiser achat min hammattanot keilu lo kiper lefichach natan kullan ketiknan veachat shello ketiknah pesula veen bo karet
Gema tanu rabbanan minnayin lannitanin al mizbeach hachitzon shennetanan bemattana achat shekkiper talmud lomar vedam zevachecha yishshafech vehay lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidtanya

a: Minnayin lechol haddamim shetteunim mattan dam layesod talmud lomar vedam zevachecha yishshafech nafka leh midderabbi detanya rabbi omer vehannishar baddam yimmatze sheen talmud lomar baddam uma talmud lomar baddam

Lefi shello lamadnu ella lannitanin mattan arba shetteunin mattan damim layesod shear damim minnayin talmud lomar vehannishar baddam yimmatze sheen talmud lomar baddam uma talmud lomar baddam limed al kol haddamim shetteunin mattan damim layesod
Veakkatti lehachi hu deata mibe leh lechidtanya minnayin lannitanin bizrika shennetanan bishficha yatza talmud lomar vedam zevachecha yishshafech
Savar lah kerabbi akiva deamar lo zerika bichlal sheficha velo sheficha bichlal zerika
Ditnan berach birkat happesach patar et shel zevach
Shel zevach lo patar et happesach divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer lo zo poteret zo velo zo poteret zo

Akkatti lehachi hu daata mibe leh lechidtanya rabbi yishmael omer mittoch shenneemar ach bechor shor o vechor kesev o vechor ez vego lamadnu livchor shettaun mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach maaser ufesach minnayin talmud lomar vedam zevachecha yishshafech
Savar lah kerabbi yose haggelili
Detanya rabbi yose haggelili omer damo lo neemar ella damam chelbo lo neemar ella chelbam limed al bechor maaser ufesach shettaun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach
Verabbi yishmael hay kera mappek leh lehachi umappek leh lehachi tere tannae alliba derabbi yishmael
Bishlama lerabbi yishmael demokem leh kulleh bivchor hayenu dichtiv uvsaram yihye lach
Ella lerabbi yose demoke leh name bemaaser vafesach maaser vafesach bealim achli leh may uvsaram yihye lach echad tam veechad baal mum
b: Limed al bechor baal mum shennitan lakkohen shello matzinu lo bechol hattora kullah
Verabbi yishmael nafka leh millecha yihye desefa
Bishlama lerabbi yose haggelili demoke leh name bemaaser vafesach hayenu dichtiv lo tifde ki kodesh hem hem kerevin veen temuratan kereva
Ditnan temurat bechor umaaser hen uveladan uvelad veladan ad sof kol haolam hare hen kivchor umaaser veyochlu bemuman labbealim
Utnan amar rabbi yehoshua shamati shettemurat pesach kereva utmurat pesach enah kereva veen li lefaresh
Ella lerabbi yishmael demoke leh kulleh bivchor maaser vafesach dela kereva temuratan mena leh maaser gamar avarahavara mibbechor
Pesach behedya ketiv beh kesev ma talmud lomar im kesev lerabbot temurat happesach achar happesach shettikrav shelamim yachol af lifne happesach ken talmud lomar hu

Vechol hanach tannae demappeki leh lehay dam zevachecha yishshafech lidrasha acharina hay kol hannitanin al mizbeach hachitzon shennetanan mattana achat shekkiper mena lehu savri lehu kevet hillel deamri af chattat shennetanah mattana achat kiper veyalfinan kullehu mechattat
Vehachattat shette mattanot amar rav huna may tama devet shammay
Karnot karnot karnot hare kan shesh arbaa lemitzva ushtayim leakkev
Uvet hillel karnat karnat karnot hare kan arba shalosh lemitzva achat leakkev
Veema kullehu lemitzva kappara bichdi la ashkechan
Veibaet ema hayenu tama devet hillel ahani mikra veahni masoret ahani mikra letappoye chada veahanay masoret levatztzore chada
Ella meatta letotefet letotefet letotafot hare kan arba ahani kera veahanay masoret chamsha batte bae lemibad
Savar lah kerabbi akiva deamar tat bechatpi shettayim pat beafriki shettayim
Ella meatta besukkat besukkat bassukkot ahani mikra veahanay masoret chamesh dafnata bae lemibad

a: Hatam chad kera kulleh legufeh vechad lischacha atay hilcheta ugratah lishlishit veokemtah attefach
Ella meatta vetama shevuayim shivim ahani kera veahanay masoret arbeim utren baaya lemetav
Shane hatam dichtiv keniddatah
Vetanna mayete lah mehacha vechipper vechipper vechipper mippene haddin
Sheyyachol vahalo din hu neemru damim lematta veneemru damim lemala ma mattan damim haamurim lematta shennetanan bemattana achat kiper af damim haamurim lemala shennetanan bemattana achat kiper

O kelach lederech zo neemru damim bifnim veneemru damim bachutz ma damim haamurim bifnim chiser achat min hammattanot lo asa velo kelum af damim haamurin bachutz chiser achat min hammattanot lo asa velo chelum
Nire lemi dome danin chutz michutz veen danin chutz mibbifnim o kallech lederech zo danin chattat vearba keranot mechattat vearba keranot veal yochiach chutz sheen chattat vearba keranot
Talmud lomar vechipper vechipper vechipper mippene haddin vechipper af al pi shello natan ella shalosh vechipper af al pi shello natan ella shettayim vechipper af al pi shello natan ella achat
Vehay mibe leh legufeh amar rava bar adda mari asberah li amar kera vechipper venislach zo hi kappara zo hi selicha
Ema vechipper af al pi shello natan ella shalosh lemala veachat lematta vechipper af al pi shello natan ella shettayim lematta ushtayim lemala vechipper af al pi shello natan lemala ella lematta
Amar rav adda bar yitzchak im ken bitalta torat arba keranot vei rachamana amar libatlun
Amar rava ezehu davar shetztzarich shalosh heve omer ellu keranot
Ema vechipper af al pi shello natan ella achat lemala veshalosh lematta
Lo matzinu damim shechetzyan lemala vechetzyan lematta vela vehatnan hizza mimmennu achat lemala vesheva lematta
Kematzlif may kematzlif machve rav yehuda kimnaggedana
Hizza al tohoro shel mizbeach sheva peamim
b: May lav appalgeh demizbeach kidamri inashe tehar tihara deoma amar rava bar shela la aggiluyeh dichtiv uchetzem hashshamayim latohar
Vehaika shirayim shirayim la meakkevi
Vehaika shirayim happenimim deika deman deamar meakkevi bechad makom kaamrinan
Tanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer bet shammay omrim shette mattanot shebbachattat veachat shebbechol hazzevachim mattirot umfaggelot
Bet hillel omrim achat shebbachattat veachat shebbechol hazzevachim matteret umfaggelet
Matkef lah rav oshaya im ken litneyah gabbe kulle bet shammay vechumre bet hillel
Amar leh rava ki itshil lehettera itshil dehau lehu bet shammay lechumra
Amar rabbi yochanan shalosh mattanot shebbachattaot enan baot ballayela uvaot leachar mita vehammaale mehen bachutz chayyav
Amar rav pappa yesh mehen kitchillato veyesh mehen kesofo
Chutz velayela zarut uchle sharet keren veetzba kibus veshirayim kitchillatan
Uvaot leachar mita la sharya vela mefaggela vela ayela legavay kesofan
Amar rav pappa mena amena lah ditnan nitaz min hatztzavar al habbeged eno taun kibus min hakkeren umin hayesod eno taun kibus ha min harauy lekeren taun kibus
Velitamach min hayesod eno taun kibus ha min harauy layesod taun kibus asher yizze ketiv perat laze shekkevar huzza
Ha manni rabbi nechemya ditnan rabbi nechemya omer sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz chayyav
Emar deshamatte leh lerabbi nechemya leinyan haalaa mide dehave aevarim ufdarim leinyan kibus mi shamatte leh in

a: Vehatanya damim hatteunin yesod teunin kibus umachshava moelet bahen vehammaale mehen bachutz chayyav
Vedamim hannishpachin laamma en teunin kibus veen machshava moelet bahen vehammaale mehen bachutz patur
Man shamatte leh deamar maale mehen bachutz chayyav rabbi nechemya hi vekaamar taun kibus
Umachshava moelet bahen vehatanya yatzu shirayim vehaktarat emurin sheen meakkevin et hakkappara sheen machshava moelet bahen
Ki tanya hahi beshalosh mattanot shebbachattat
I hachi teunin yesod lekeren azli ema nitanin yesod umachshava moelet bahen haamratte la sharya vela mefaggela vela ayela legavay kesofan
Ella ki tanya hahi bedamim happenimiyyim
Aval bedamim hachitzonim may patur addetane damim hannishpachin laamma liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim bedamim happenimiyyim aval bedamim hachitzonim patur
Ha manni rabbi nechemya hi deamar sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz chayyav vela matne leh telata peture levahade telata chiyyuve
Ravina amar min hakkeren mammash min hayesod min harauy layesod
Amar leh rav tachlifa bar gazza leravina ema ide veide rauy hu hay may hashta rauy lakkeren amratte la rauy layesod mibaya ella min hakkeren min hakkeren mammash min hayesod min harauy layesod
Kol hannitanin al mizbeach happenimi ku tanu rabbanan veasa kaasher asa ma ba lilmod
Lichpol behazzaato velamad sheim chisar achat mikkol hammattanot lo asa velo kelum en li ella mattan sheva shemmeakkevot bechol makom mattan arba minnayin talmud lomar ken yaase
Lappar ze par yom hakkippurim
b: Kaasher asa lefar ze par kohen mashiach hachattat ellu seire avoda zara yachol sheani merabbe af seire hargalim usire rashe chodashim talmud lomar lo
Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulhotzi et ellu achar sheriba hakkatuv umiet merabbe ani et ellu shemmechapperin al averat mitzva yedua umotzi ani ellu sheen mechapperin al averat mitzva yedua
Vechipper af al pi shello samach venislach af al pi shello natan shirayim
Uma raita lifsol behazzaot ulhachshir bismicha veshirayim
Amarta posel ani behazzaot shemmeakkevot bechol makom umachshir ani bismicha veshirayim sheen meakkevot bechol makom

a: Amar mar en li ella mattan sheva shemmeakkevot bechol makom hecha amar rav pappa befara uvingaim
Mattan arba minnayin talmud lomar ken yaase may shena mattan sheva dichtivan uchfilan mattan arba name ketivan uchfilan
Amar rabbi yirmeya lo nitzrecha ella lerabbi shimon detanya lemala omer kerenkarnot shettayim lematta hu omer kerenkarnot arba divre rabbi shimon
Rabbi yehuda omer eno tzarich hare hu omer beohel moed al kol haamur beohel moed verabbi yehuda ken yease may aved leh
Mibe leh lechidtanya lefi shello lamadnu lefar yom hakkippurim lismicha ushyare haddam minnayin talmud lomar ken yaase
Ulfar yom hakkippurim lo lamadnu ha amarta lappar ze yom hakkippurim
Itzterich salka datach amena hane mile avoda dimakkeva kappara aval avoda dela meakkeva kappara ema la kamashma lan
Verabbi shimon hay beohel moed may aved leh beohel moed mibbee leh sheim nifchata tikra shel hechal lo haya mazze veidach measher veidach asher la daresh
Abbaye amar lerabbi yehuda name itzterich salka datach amena mide dehave assemicha ushyare haddam deaf al gav dichtivan uchfilan la meakkeva mattan arba name la titakkav ka mashma lan
Lappar ze par yom hakkippurim lemay hilcheta i leakkev peshita chukka ketiva beh
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lo nitzrecha ella lerabbi yehuda deamar ki ketiva chukka addevarim hannaasim bevigde lavan bifnim sheim hikdim maase lachavero lo asa velo chelum
Aval devarim hannaasim bevigde lavan bachutz hikdim maase lachavero ma sheasa asuy ema middichsidran la meakkevi hazzaot name la meakkevi ka mashma lan
Matkef lah rav pappa umi matzet amratte hachi vehatanya vechilla mikkapper et hakkodesh im kiper kila veim lo kiper lo kila divre rabbi akiva
Amar lo rabbi yehuda mippene ma lo nomar im kila kiper veim lo kila lo kiper
Amar rav pappa lo nitzrecha ella leet bedam uvitvila et amar rav acha bar yaakov lo nitzrecha lehachshir
b: Ammin shebbaetzba baddam sheyehe baddam shiur tevila meikara vetaval velo mesappeg
Veitzterich lemichtav baddam dei ketav rachamana vetaval hava amena af al gav deleka shiur tevila meikara ketav rachamana baddam
Vei ketav rachamana baddam hava amena afilu mesappeg ketav rachamana vetaval
Mizbach ketoret sammim lema li sheim lo nitchannech hammizbeach biktoret hassammim lo haya mazze
Tanya kevateh derav pappa veasa kaasher asa ma talmud lomar lappar lerabbot par yom hakkippurim lechol ma sheamur bainyan divre rabbi
Amar rabbi yishmael kal vachomer uma bemakom shello hushva korban lekorban hishva maasim lemaasim makom shehishva korban lekorban eno din sheyyashve maase lemaase
Ella ma talmud lomar lappar ze par helem davar shel tzibbur lefar ze par kohen mashiach
Amar mar uma bimkom shello hushva korban lekorban may lo hushva korban lekorban
Ilema par yom hakkippurim usir yom hakkippurim ika lemifrach ma lehanach shekken nichnas damam lifnay velifnim
Ella par helem davar shel tzibbur usire avoda zara ika lemifrach ma lehanach shekken mechapperin al averot mitzva yedua

Ella par helem davar shel tzibbur vesair shel yom hakkippurim vehachi kaamar uma bimkom shello hushu korban lekorban dehay par vehay sair hushu maasim lemaasim lemay dichtav behu makom shehushva korban lekorban dehay par vehay par eno din

a: Shehushu maasim lemaasim
Vaata leh par yom hakkippurim name leet bedam utvila mippar kohen mashiach veate leh seir yom hakkippurim misseire avoda zara mikkal vachomer
Vechi davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed bekal vachomer amar rav pappa kasavar tana deve rabbi yishmael davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed bekal vachomer
Lappar ze par helem davar shel tzibbur ha betzibur gufeh ketiv amar rav pappa mishshum devae agmore par helem davar shel tzibbur beoteret ushte kelaot lisire avoda zara
Ufar helem davar shel tzibbur begufeh la ketiv behekesha ate itzterich lappar
Lemihve keman dichtiv beh begufeh vela leheve davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh
Tanya kevateh derav pappa veasa kaasher asa ma talmud lomar lappar
Lefi shenneemar vehem heviu et korbanam ishshe la vego chattatam ellu seire avoda zara shiggatam ze par helem davar shel tzibbur chattatam al shiggatam amra tora chattatam hare hi lach keshiggatam
Shiggatam mehechan lamadta lo behekesh vechi davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh
Talmud lomar lappar ze par helem davar shel tzibbur lefar ze par kohen mashiach
Amar mar chattatam ellu seire avoda zara tipok leh mikkera kamma deamar mar hachattat lerabbot seire avoda zara amar rav pappa itzterich salka datach amena hane mile hazzaot dichtivan begufeh
b: Aval yoteret ushte chelaot dela ketivan begufeh ema la ka mashma lan
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa veha tanna par yom hakkippurim lechol ma sheamar beinyan kaamar tannae hi tanna deve rav merabbe hachi tanna deve rabbi yishmael la merabbe hachi

Tana deve rabbi yishmael mippene ma neemru yoteret ushte chelaot befar kohen mashiach velo neemru befar helem davar shel tzibbur mashal lemelech basar vadam shezzaam al ohavo umiet besirchono mippene chibato

Vetana deve rabbi yishmael mippene ma neemra parochet hakkodesh befar kohen mashiach velo neemar befar helem davar shel tzibbur mashal lemelech basar vadam shessarcha alav medina im miutah sarcha pamalya shello mitkayyemet im rubbah sarcha en pamalya shello mitkayyemet
Lefichach im natan kullan ketiknan ku tenan hatam pigel bakkometz velo ballevona ballevona velo bakkometz rabbi meir omer pigul vechayyavin alav karet
Vachachamim omrim en bo karet ad sheyefaggel bechol hammattir

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish la tema tama derabbi meir dekasavar mefaggelin bachatzi mattir ella hacha bemay askinan kegon shennatan et hakkometz bemachshava vehallevona bishtika kasavar kol haose al daat rishona hu ose
Mimmay middekatane lefichach im natan kullan ketiknan veachat shello ketiknah pasul veen bo karet ha achat shello ketiknah vechullan ketiknan pigul
Manni ilema rabbanan ha amri rabbanan en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir ella rabbi meir
Vei tama derabbi meir mishshum dimfaggelin bachatzi mattir hu afilu kidkatane name lav mishshum dekasavar kol haose al daat rishona hu ose
Amar rabbi shemuel bar yitzchak leolam rabbanan hi umay ketiknan ketiknan lefigul
Veha middekatane lefichach im natan kullan ketiknan veachat shello ketiknan pasul veen bo karet mikkelal detiknah lehechshera hu daata
Amar rava may shello ketiknah chutz limkomo rav ashe amar shello lishmo
Mikkelal dechi la aved lah chutz limkomo veshello lishmo michayyav
Ayede ditna resha pigul vechayyavin alav karet tena name sefa pasul veen bo karet
Metivi bamme devarim amurim bedamim hannitanin al mizbeach hachitzon

a: Aval damim hannitanin al hammizbeach happenimi kegon arbaim veshalosh shel yom hakkipurim veachad asar shel par kohen mashiach veachad asar shel par helem davar shel tzibur pigel ben barishona uven bashsheniyya uven bashshelishit rabbi meir omer pigul vechayyavin alav karet vachachamim omrim en bo karet ad sheyefaggel bechol hammattir
Katane miha pigel ben barishona ben bashsheniyya ben bashshelishit uflig
Amar rav yitzchak bar avin hacha bemay askinan kegon sheppigel bishchita dechad mattir hu i hachi may tama derabbanan

Amar rava man chachamim rabbi elazar hi ditnan hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim shehikriv meachat mehen kezayit bachutz chayyav verabbi elazar poter ad sheyyakriv et kullan
Vehaamar rava umode rabbi elazar bedamim ditnan rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim mimmakom sheppasak mishsham hu matchil
Ella amar rava kegon sheppigel barishona veshatak bashsheniyya vechazar ufigel bashshelishit
Mahu detema i salka datach al daat rishona hu mihdar pigule bashshelishit lema li ka mashma lan matkef lah rav ashe mide shatak katane

Ella amar rav ashe hacha bemay askinan kegon sheppigel barishona uvashsheniyya uvashshelishit mahu detema i salka datach kol haose al daat rishona hu ose mihdar pigule bechol chada vachada lema li ka mashma lan
b: Veha ben ben katane kashya

Amar mar rabbi meir omer pigul vechayyavin alav karet mikkede karet la michayyav ad sheyyikrevu kol mattirav deamar mar kehartzaat kasher kach hartzaat pasul ma hartzaat kasher ad sheyyikrevu kol mattirav af hartzaat pasul ad sheyyikrevu kol mattirav
Veha kevan dechashshev beh bifnim pesula keman dela adde dame ki hadar madde bahechal mayya bealma hu deka madde
Amar rabba mashkachatte lah bearbaa parim uvarbaa seirim
Rava amar afilu tema befar echad vesair echad lefigulo meratztze
Arbaim veshalosh veha tanya arbaim vesheva ha keman deamar mearvin lakkeranot veha keman deamar en mearvin lakkeranot
Veha tanya arbaim ushmone ha keman deamar shirayim meakkevin ha keman deamar en shirayim meakkevin
Metivi bamme devarim amurim bikmitza bemattan keli uvhiluch

Aval ba lo lehaktara natan et hakkometz bemachshava veet hallevona bishtika o shennatan et hakkometz bishtika veet hallevona bemachshava rabbi meir omer pigul vechayyavin alav karet vachachamim omrim en bo karet ad sheyefaggel bechol hammattir
Katane miha et hakkometz bishtika veet hallevona bemachshava uflig ema kevar natan et hallevona bemachshava
Chada dehayenu resha veod ha tanya veachar kach kashya
Matni veellu devarim sheen chayyavin alehem mishshum pigul hakkometz vehakketoret vehallevona

a: Uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach vehaddam vehannesachim habbain bifne atzman divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim af habbain im habbehema

Log shemen shel metzora rabbi shimon omer en chayyavin alav mishshum pigul verabbi meir omer chayyavin alav mishshum pigul sheddam haasham mattiro vechol sheyyesh lo mattirin ben laadam ben lammizbeach chayyavin alav mishshum pigul

Haola damah mattir et besarah lammizbeach veorah lakkohanim olat haof damah mattir et besarah lemizbeach chattat haof damah mattir et besarah lakkohanim parim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim daman mattir et emurehen likarev
Rabbi shimon omer kol sheeno al hammizbeach hachitzon kishlamim en chayyavin alav mishshum pigul

Gema amar ulla kometz pigul sheheelo al gabbe hammizbeach paka pigulo mimmennu im acherim mevi lide pigul hu atzmo lo kol shekken may kaamar hachi kaamar im eno mitkabbel heach mevi acherim lide pigul

May ka mashma lan i deen chayyavin alav mishshum pigul tenena ellu devarim sheen chayyavin alehem mishshum pigul hakkometz vehakketoret vehallevona uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim vehaddam
Ella deim alu lo yerdu tenena hallan vehayyotze vehattame veshennishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo im alu lo yerdu
Veella deim yerdu yaalu ha name tenena keshem sheim alu lo yerdu kach im yerdu lo yaalu la tzericha shemmashla bahen haur
Ha name amrah ulla chada zimna deamar ulla lo shanu ella shello mashla bahen haur aval mashla bahen haur yaalu
b: Mahu detema hane mile ever dimchabbar aval kometz demiprat ema la ka mashma lan
Amar rav achay hilkach hay kometz pigul defalgeh machet aara ufalgeh assekeh ammaaracha umashla bo haur massekna leh lechulleh lechattechilla
Amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan happigul vehannotar vehattame sheheelan legabbe mizbeach paka isur mehen amar rav chisda mare dechi mizbeach mikve tahora amar rabbi zera shemmashla bahen haur
Metiv rabbi yitzchak bar bisna acherim omrim vetumato alav mi shettuma porachat mimmennu yatza basar sheen tuma porachat mimmennu veim ita hare tuma porachat mimmennu al yede haur
Amar rava al yede mikve kaamrinan mide mikve ketiv ella amar rav pappa bivsar shelamim askinan dela chaze lehakrava
Ravina amar vetumato alav mi shettuma porachat mimmennu keshehu shalem yatza basar davar sheen tuma porachat keshehu shalem ella keshehu chaser
Gufa vetumato alav betumat hagguf hakkatuv medabber
Atta omer betumat hagguf o eno ella betumat basar neemar kan tumato veneemar lehallan tumato alav bo ma lehallan betumat hagguf hakkatuv medabber af kan betumat hagguf hakkatuv medabber

Rabbi yose omer hoil veneemru kadashim bilshon rabbim veneemra tuma bilshon yachid betumat hagguf hakkatuv medabber rabbi omer veachal betumat hagguf hakkatuv medabber acherim amru vetumato alav mi shettuma porachat mimmennu yatza basar sheen tuma porachat mimmennu
Amar mar rabbi omer veachal betumat hagguf hakkatuv medabber may mashma amar rava kol kera dela mefaresh leh rav yitzchak bar avudimi vechol matnita dela mefaresho lah rav zeeri la miparsha
Hachi amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi hoil ufatach hakkatuv bilshon nekeva vesiyyem bilshon nekeva ulshon zachar baemtza betumat hagguf hakkatuv medabber

Matnita detanya im neemru kallot lamma neemru chamurot veim neemru chamurot lamma neemru kallot im neemru kallot velo chamurot hayiti omer al hakkallot belav veal hachamurot bemita lechach neemru chamurot veim neemru chamurot velo neemru kallot hayiti omer al hachamurot yehe chayyav veal hakkallot yehe patur lechach neemar kallot
May kallot umay chamurot ilema kallot maaser chamurot teruma hayiti omer bemita hashta name ha bemita
Vetu vei lo neemru hayiti omer bemita dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon
Ella kallot tumat sheretz chamurot tumat met
Uvmay i bitruma ide veide hu bemita vetu lechach neemru chamurot divlav ha bemita hi vei lo neemru hayiti omer bemita dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon
Vei baachilat maaser

a: Im lo neemru chamurot hayiti omer al hachamurot bemita ha mittumat sheretz kaatya vedayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon
Amar zeeri kallot tumat sheretz chamurot tumat met vehachi kaamar ilu neemar tumat sheretz veneemar maaser utruma velo neemra tumat met hayiti omer kallot al hakkallot belav veal hachamurot bemita
Umiddekallot al hachamurot bemita chamurot name al hakkallot bemita lechach neemru chamurot
Kol sheyyesh lo mattirin ben leadam ben lemizbeach chayyavin alav mishshum pigul
Tanu rabbanan o eno mevi ella kayyotze bishlamim ma shelamim meuchadim neechalin lishne yamim velayela echad af kol neechal lishne yamim velayela echad
Neechal leom valayela minnayin talmud lomar mibbesar kol sheshshirin sheshsheyarav neechalin ola sheen sheyareha neechalin minnayin talmud lomar zevach
Minnayin lerabbot haofot vehammenachot ad sheani merabbe log shemen shel metzora talmud lomar asher hem makdishim li
Veate notar chilulchilul mittuma veate pigul aonaon minnotar

Umeachar shessofo lerabbot kol davar lamma neemar shelamim meatta lomar lach ma shelamim meuchadim sheyyesh lahen mattirin ben laadam ben lammizbeach af kol sheyyesh lo mattirin ben laadam ben lammizbeach chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul

Haola damah mattir et besarah lammizbeach veorah lakkohanim olat haof damah mattir et besarah lammizbeach chattat haof damah mattir et besarah lakkohanim parim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim damam mattir et emurehen likrav
Umotzi ani et hakkometz veet hallevona vehakketoret uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim vehaddam

Rabbi shimon omer ma shelamim meuchadin sheyyesh bo al mizbeach hachitzon vechayyavin alav af kol sheyyeshnan al mizbeach hachitzon chayyavin alav mishshum pigul yatzu parim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim hoil sheen al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim en chayyavin alav mishshum pigul
Amar mar kayyotze bishlamim may nihu bechor deneechal lishne yamim velayela echad bemay ate i bema matzinu ika lemifrach
Ma lishlamim shehen teunin semicha unsachim utnufat chaze vashok
Ella meim heachol yeachel
Hane tere kelale dismichi ahadade ninhu amar rava kidamri bemareva kol makom sheatta motze shene kelalot hassemuchim ze laze hattel perat benehem vedunem bichlal ufrat

Ad sheani merabbe log shemen shel metzora ha manni rabbi meir hi detanya log shemen shel metzora chayyavin alav mishshum pigul divre rabbi meir ema sefa umotzi ani minchat nesachim vehaddam atan lerabbanan

Detanya nische vehema chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul mippene sheddam hazzevach mattiran likarev divre rabbi meir amru lo vahalo adam mevi et zevachav hayyom unsachin mikan ad asara yamim amar lahen af ani lo amarti ella bevain im hazzevach
Amar rav yosef ha manni rabbi hi deamar log shemen shel metzora mattenotav sharu leh umiddemattenotav sharu leh mattenotav mefaggeli leh
Detanya log shemen shel metzora moalin bo ad sheyyizrok haddam nizrak haddam lo nehenin velo moalin
Rabbi omer moalin ad sheyyitten mattenotav veshavin sheasur baachila ad sheyyitten mattan sheva umattan behonot
Amruha kammeh derabbi yirmeya amar gavra rabba kerav yosef lema ki ha milta
b: Hare log habba bifne atzmo dilchulle alma mattenotav sharu leh vela mefaggelin leh detanya log shemen shel metzora chayyavin alav mishshum pigul mippene sheddam mattiro labbehonot divre rabbi meir
Amru lo lerabbi meir vahalo adam mevi ashamo achshav velog mikan vead asara yamim amar lahen af ani lo amarti ella beva im haasham

Ella amar rabbi yirmeya leolam rabbi meir hi usmi mikan nesachim amar abbaye leolam la tisme vetana log habba im haasham vehu haddin linsachim habbain im hazzevach vahadar tana nesachim habbain bifne atzman vehu haddin lelog habba lifne atzmo
Chattat haof damah mattir et besarah lakkohanim mena hane mile detane levi
Kol korbanam lerabbot log shemen shel metzora salka datach amena min haesh ketav rachamana vehay lav motar min haesh hu ka mashma lan
Lechol minchatam lerabbot minchat omer uminchat hakkenaot salka datach amena veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem uminchat haomer lehattir atya uminchat kenaot levarer aon kaatya ka mashma lan
Ulchol chattatam lerabbot chattat haof salka datach amena nevela hi
Lechol ashamam lerabbot asham nazir vaasham metzora salka datach amena lehachshir kaatu ka mashma lan
Asham metzora behedya ketiv beh ella lerabbot asham nazir kaasham metzora
Asher yashivu ze gezel hagger lecha hu shellecha yihye afilu lekaddesh bo et haishsha
Tanya rabbi elazar omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili pigel bedavar hannaase bachutz pigel bedavar hannaase bifnim lo pigel

Ketzad haya omed bachutz veamar hareni shochet lehazzot middamo lemachar lo pigel shemmachshava bachutz bedavar hannaase bifnim lo pigel haya omed bifnim veamar hareni mazze al menat lehaktir emurim velishpoch shirayim lemachar lo pigel shemmachshava bifnim bedavar hannaase bachutz
Aval haya omed bachutz veamar hareni shochet lishpoch shirayim lemachar o lehaktir emurim lemachar pigel shemmachshava bachutz bedavar hannaase bachutz
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may kera kaasher yuram mishshor zevach hashshelamim vechi ma lamadnu mishshor zevach hashshelamim meatta

Ella makkish par kohen mashiach leshor zevach hashshelamim ma shor zevach hashshelamim ad sheyehu maasav umachshevotav al mizbeach hachitzon af par kohen mashiach ad sheyehu machshevotav umaasav al hammizbeach hachitzon
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav halacha kerabbi elazar sheamar mishshum rabbi yose
Amar rava

a: Hilcheta limshicha amar leh abbaye ella meatta kol shechitat kodashim la litne hilcheta limshicha hu ella derosh vekabbel sachar hacha name derosh vekabbel sachar hachi kaamena lach hilcheta lema li lishana acharina amar leh halacha kaamena
Matni kodshe goyim en chayyavin alehem mishshum pigul notar vetame vehashshochatan bachutz patur divre rabbi shimon rabbi yose mechayyev
Gema tanu rabbanan kodshe goyim lo nehenin velo moalin veen chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame
Veen osin temura veen meviin nesachim aval korbanan taun nesachim divre rabbi shimon
Amar rabbi yose roe ani bechullan lehachmir shenneemar bahen la bamme devarim amurim bekodshe mizbeach aval bekodshe bedek habbayit moalin bahen
Lo nehenin velo moalin lo nehenin midderabbanan
Velo moalin degamar meila chetchet mitteruma devitruma ketiv bene yisrael velo goyim
Veen chayyavin alav mishshum pigul notar vetame may tama deate pigul aonaon minnotar
Veate notar chilulchilul mittuma uvtuma ketiv bene yisrael velo goyim
Veen osin temura may tama deitakkash temura lemasar behema umasar behema itakkash lemasar dagan uvmasar dagan ketiv bene yisrael velo goyim
Vechi davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh masar dagan chullin hu
Hanicha leman deamar batar melammed azlinan ella leman deamar batar lamed azlinan may ika lememar
Ella masar behema chova sheen kavua lah zeman hu vechova sheen lah zeman kavua yisrael mayetu goyim la mayetu
Veen meviin nesachim tanu rabbanan ezrach ezrach mevi nesachim veen haggoy mevi nesachim yachol lo tehe olato teuna nesachim talmud lomar kacha
Amar rabbi yose roe ani bechullan lehachmir bamme devarim amurim bekodshe mizbeach ku may tama
Kasavar ki gamra meila chetchet mitteruma dumya ditruma dekaddisha kedushshat hagguf aval kedushshat bedek habbayit dikdushshat damim la
Tanu rabbanan dam shennitma uzrako beshogeg hurtza
b: Bemezid lo hurtza bamme devarim amurim beyachid aval betzibur ben beshogeg ben bemezid hurtza uvgoyim ben beshogeg uven bemezid lo hurtza
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa keman dela kerabbi yose dei rabbi yose haamar bechullan ani roe lehachmir
Amar lehu rav pappa afilu tema rabbi yose shane hatam deamar kera lahem lahem velo legoyim
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa ella meatta asher hem makdishim hachi name hem velo goyim
Ella amar rav ashe amar kera leratzon lahem vegoyim lav bene hartzaa ninhu

Matni devarim sheen chayyavim alehem mishshum pigul chayyavin alehen mishshum notar umishshum tame chutz min haddam rabbi shimon mechayyev bedavar sheddarkan leechol aval haetzim vehallevona vehakketoret en chayyavin alav mishshum tuma
Gema tanu rabbanan yachol lo yehu chayyavin mishshum tuma ella al davar sheyyesh lo mattirin ben leadam ben lemizbeach
Vedin hu uma pigul shehu bikvia uvidia achat velo huttar mikkelalo en chayyavin alav ella al davar sheyyesh lo mattirin ben leadam ben lemizbeach
Tuma shehi beole veored uvishte yediot vehuttera mikkelalah eno din sheeno chayyav ella al davar sheyyesh lo mattirin ben leadam ben lemizbeach
Talmud lomar asher hem makdishim li

Ella ma talmud lomar yikrav behuchshar basar likarev hakkatuv medabber ha ketzad yesh lo mattirin mishsheyyikravo mattirin en lo mattirin mishsheyyikdash bichli
Ashkechan tuma notar menalan ate chilulchilul mittuma
Velelaf aonaon mippigul
Mistabbera mittuma have leh lemelaf shekken gezel siman

Chutz min haddam ku mena hane mile amar ulla amar kera vaani netattiv lachem shellachem yehe

Vela vahare terumat haddeshen

Hanicha lerabbanan deamri vehinnicham sham melammed shetteunin geniza
Ella lerabbi dosa deamar muttarot hen lechohen hedot uvilvad shello yishtammesh bahen leom hakkippurim acher may ika lememar
Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene ketuvin habbain keechad vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar
Tere miute ketivi hacha ketiv haarufa vehatam ketiv vesamo
Utlata kerae bedam lema li
Lemaote mimmeila minnotar umittuma
Aval pigul la tzerich kera ditnan kol sheyyesh lo mattirin ben laadam ben lammizbeach chayyavin alav mishshum pigul vedam gufeh mattir hu
Amar rabbi yochanan shelosha karetot bishlamim lamma
b: Achat lichlal veachat lifrat veachat lidvarim sheenan neechalin
Ulrabbi shimon deamar devarim sheen neechalin en chayyavin alehem mishshum tuma leetoye may leetoye chattaot happenimiyyot
Salka datach amena hoil veamar rabbi shimon kol sheeno al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim en chayyavin alav mishshum pigul mishshum tuma name la lichayyav ka mashma lan
Numi rabbi shimon mechayyev et sheddarko leechol ku itmar rabbi yochanan veresh lakish rabbi elazar verabbi yose berabbi chanina chad mehay zuza vechad mehay zuza
Chad amar machloket betumat basar aval betumat hagguf divre hakkol eno loke
Vechad amar kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo may tama kevan dekarena beh vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame karenan beh vetumato alav

Rav tavome matne hachi rav kahana matne hachi chad mehay zuza vechad mehay zuza assefa chad amar machloket betumat hagguf aval betumat basar divre hakkol loke vechad amar kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo
Amar rava mistabbera keman deamar kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo may tama kevan dela karena beh vetumato alav venichreta la karena beh vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel
Vehaamar mar vehabbasar lerabbot etzim ulvona lefoslah lifsula bealma
Matni leshem shishsha devarim hazzevach nizbach leshem zevach leshem zoveach leshem hashshem leshem ishshim leshem reach leshem nichoach vehachattat vehaasham leshem chet
Amar rabbi yose af mi shello haya belibbo leshem echad mikkol ellu kasher shehu tenay bet din sheen hammachshava holechet ella achar haoved
Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav ola leshem ola leappoke leshem shelamim dela ishshim leshem ishshim leappoke kevava dela
Reach leshem reach leappoke evarim shetztzelaan veheelan dela deamar rav yehuda amar rav evarim shetztzelaan veheelan en bahen mishshum reach
Nichoach leshem hanachat ruach la leshem mi sheamar vehaya haolam

Amar rav yehuda amar rav chattat sheshshechatah leshem ola pesula leshem chullin keshera amar rabbi elazar may tama derav velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael kodashim mechallelin kodashim veen chullin mechallelin kodashim
Metiv rabba amar rabbi yose af mi shello haya belibbo leshem echad mikkol ellu kasher shehu tenay bet din tama shello haya belibbo kelal ha haya belibbo leshem chullin pasul
Amar leh abbaye dilma lo haya kelal kasher umratztze ha haya belibbo leshem chullin kasher veeno meratztze
Amar rabbi elazar chattat sheshshechatah leshem chullin keshera mishshum chullin pesula kediva mineh shemuel merav huna

a: Minnayin lammitassek bekadashim shehu pasul shenneemar veshachat et ben habbakar lifne Adonai ad shettehe shechita leshem ben bakar
Amar leh zo beyadenu hi leakkev minnayin amar leh lirtzonchem tizbachuhu ledatechem zevuchu

Sheen hammachshava holechet ella achar haoved matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose shamati shehabbealim mefaggelin amar rava may tama derabbi elazar berabbi yose deamar kera vehikriv hammakriv
Amar abbaye rabbi elazar berabbi yose verabbi eliezer verabbi shimon ben elazar kullehu sevira lehu ze mechashshev veze oved haveya machshava rabbi elazar berabbi yose ha daamaran
Rabbi eliezer ditnan hashshochet legoy shechitato keshera verabbi eliezer posel
Rabbi shimon ben elazar ditnan kelal amar rabbi shimon ben elazar kol sheen kasher lehatznia veen matzniin kamohu huchshar laze vehitznio uva acher vehotzio nitchayyev ze bemachshava shel ze
Tarvayehu it lehu derabbi elazar berabbi yose hashta bachutz amrinan bifnim mibaya
Rabbi elazar berabbi yose let lehu detarvayehu dilma bifnim hu deamrinan bachutz la amrinan
Rabbi shimon ben elazar it leh derabbi eliezer hashta beshabbat amrinan baavoda zara mibaya
Rabbi eliezer let leh derabbi shimon ben elazar dilma baavoda zara hu deamratte keen bifnim aval shabbat melechet machshevet asra tora
Hadaran alach bet shammay
Matni ezehu mekoman shel zevachim kodshe kadashim shechitatan batztzafon

Par vesair shel yom hakkipurim shechitatan batztzafon vekibul daman bichle sharet batztzafon vedaman taun hazzaya al ben habbaddim veal happarochet veal mizbach hazzahav mattana achat mehen meakkevet sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon veim lo natan lo ikkev
Parim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim shechitatan batztzafon vekibul daman bichli sharet batztzafon vedaman taun hazzaya al happarochet veal mizbach hazzahav
b: Mattana achat mehen meakkevet sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon veim lo natan lo ikev ellu vaellu nisrafin abbet haddeshen
Gema venitne name vekibul daman bichli sharet batztzafon kevan deika asham metzora dekibul damo bayyad hu shayereh
Vela veha katane lah lekamman asham nazir vaasham metzora shechitatan batztzafon vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon
Meikara savar kibul damo bayyad hu shayereh vechevan dela saggi leh ella bichli hadar tanyeh
Detanya velakach yachol bichli talmud lomar venatan ma netina beatzmo shel kohen af lekicha beatzmo shel kohen

a: Par vesair shel yom hakkipurim ku mikkede tzafon beola ketiv nitne ola beresha
Chattat ayede deate midderasha chabbiva leh
Venitne chattaot hachitzonot ayede denichnas daman lifnay velifnim chabbiva leh
Vetzafona beola hecha ketiva veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona
Ashkechan ben tzon ben bakar mena lan amar kera veim min hatztzon vav mosif al inyan rishon veyilmad elon mittachton
Hanicha leman deamar melammedin ella leman deamar en melammedin may ika lememar
Detanya veim nefesh vego lechayyev al sefek meilot asham taluy divre rabbi akiva vachachamim potrin may lav beha ka mipalgi mar savar lemedin umar savar en lemedin
Amar rav pappa dechulle alma lemedin vehayenu tama derabbanan neemar kan mitzot veneemar bechattat chelev mitzot
Ma lehallan davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat af kan shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat
Verabbi akiva ma lehallan bikvua af kan bikvua leappoke chattat detumat mikdash vekadashav deole veored hu

In hachi name vehacha beha kamipalgi rabbi akiva savar veim nefesh ketiv vav mosif al inyan rishon
Verabbanan name hachtiv veim nefesh lema beha kamipalgi demar savar hekesh adif umar savar gezera shava adif
La dechulle alma dehekesh adif veamri lach rabbanan tachton hu degamar meelon
Leasham bechesef shekalim shello tomar lo yehe sefeko chamur mivaddao ma vaddao chattat bat danka af sefeko asham bar danka
Verabbi akiva ha sevara mena leh nafka leh mizzot torat haasham tora achat lechol haashamot
Tinach man deit leh torat man delet leh torat mehecha gamar gamar beerkechabbeerkecha

Gamar beelbel

Mekabbel atzmo mena lan amar kera velakach lo yikkach

b: Vechi mikkan atta lamed vahalo kevar neemar bimkom asher tishshachet haola tishshachet hachattat ha lema yatza likboa lo makom sheim lo shechatah batztzafon pasul
Atta omer lechach yatza o eno ella shezze taun tzafon veen acher taun tzafon talmud lomar veshachat et hachattat bimkom haola ze bana av lechol chattaot sheyehu teunot tzafon

Ella oto lema li

Vetanya vesamach yado al rosh hassair lerabbot sair nachshon lismicha divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer lerabbot seire avoda zara lismicha
Salka datach amena hoil veitrabbo lismicha itrabbo name letzafon ka mashma lan
Matkef lah ravina hanicha lerabbi yehuda lerabbi shimon may ika lememar
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav tavi leravina ulrabbi yehuda mi nicha lemay deitrabbi itrabbi umay dela itrabbi la itrabbi
Vechi tema i la maateh kera hava amena tete bevinyan av im ken semicha gufah tete mibbinyan av ella middorot la gamrinan hacha name middorot la gamrinan
Veella oto batztzafon veen shochet batztzafon
Shochet midderabbi achiyya nafka detanya rabbi achiyya omer veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona ma talmud lomar
Lefi shemmatzinu omed batztzafon umkabbel batztzafon veim amad baddarom vekibel batztzafon pasul yachol af ze ken talmud lomar oto oto batztzafon veen hashshochet batztzafon

Ma leven tzon shekken kava lo keli

Ma leola shekken kalil
Mechattat ma lechattat shekken mechapperet al chayyave charetot

Leolam kedaamaran meikara oto batztzafon veen shochet batztzafon udkashya lach midderabbi achiyya nafka lan lav lemaote shochet batztzafon ella en shochet batztzafon aval mekabbel batztzafon
Mekabbel millakachvelakach nafka lakachvelakach la mashma leh

Amar rav adda bar ahava veitema rabba bar shela kal vachomer uma chattat habbaa mikkoach ola meakkevet ola shebbaa chattat mikkochah eno din shemmeakkevet
Ma lechattat shekken mechapperet al chayyave charetot

Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina vela

Temura mikkoach kadashim ka atya vekadashim mikkoach chullin kaate kaatu

Pesach bishar yemot hashshana shelamim hu
Veibaet ema amar kera haola bimkomah tehe
Asham menalan devae tzafon dichtiv bimkom asher yishchatu et haola yishchatu et haasham
Ashkechan shechita kabbala mena lan veet damo yizrok kibbul damo name batztzafon
Mekabbel atzmo mena lan damoveet damo
Ashkechan lemitzva leakkev mena lan kera acharina ketiv veshachat et hakkeves
Vehay lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidtanya davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza lidon bedavar hechadash i atta rashshay lehachziro lichlalo ad sheyyachzirennu hakkatuv lichlalo beferush
Ketzad veshachat et hakkeves bimkom asher yishchat et hachattat veet haola bimkom hakkodesh ki kachattat haasham hu vego sheen talmud lomar kachattat haasham ma talmud lomar kachattat haasham
Lefi sheyyatza asham metzora lidon bedavar hechadash bevohen yad uvohen regel veozen yemanit yachol lo yehe taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach
Talmud lomar kachattat haasham hu ma chattat teuna mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach af asham metzora taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach
Im ken nichtov behay vela nichtov behay
Hanicha i sevira lan yatza lidon bedavar hechadash ihu hu dela gamar mikkelalo
b: Aval kelalo gamar mineh letzafon shappir ella i sevira lan dela hu gamar mikkelalo vela kelalo gamar mineh hay legufeh itzterich
Kevan deahdereh ahdereh
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina ema ki ahdereh kera legabbe mattan damim veemurin devae kehunna aval shechita dela baaya kehunna la mibe tzafon
Im ken nema kera ki kechattat hu may kechattat haasham kishar ashamot yihye
Lema li leakshoye lechattat lema li leakshoye leola
Amar ravina itzterich i akkesheh lechattat vela akkesheh leola hava amena chattat mehechan lamda meola davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina venakshe leola vela nakshe lechattat

Hava amena davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh vechi tema naksheh akkoshe lechattat nicha leh demakkesh leh leikar vela nakkesh leh letafel lehachi akkesheh lechattat veakkesheh leola lememar davar hallamed behekesh sheeno chozer umlammed behekesh
Rava amar mehacha dichtiv kaasher yuram mishshor zevach hashshelamim lemay hilcheta i leoteret hakkaved ushte hakkelaot begufeh ketiv
Mishshum devae agmore yoteret hakkaved ushte hakkelaot mippar helem davar shel tzibbur lisire avoda zara begufeh la ketiv umippar kohen mashiach hu degamar
Lehachi itzterich kaasher yuram denehve keman dichtiv begufeh vela nihve davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh
Amar leh rav pappa lerava velichteveh begufeh vela nakkesh

I ketav begufeh vela akkesh hava amena davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh vechi tema nakkesheh akkoshe nicha leh dechatveh begufeh middeakkesh leh akkoshe lehachi katveh veakkesheh lememra davar hallamed behekesh en chozer umlammed behekesh
Hekesh ugzera shava kal vachomer siman
Davar hallamed behekesh en chozer umlammed mehekesh i midderava i midderavina davar hallamed behekesh mahu sheyelammed bigzera shava
Ta shema rabbi natan ben avtulmos omer minnayin lifricha bivgadim shehi tehora neemar karachat vegabbachat babbegadim veneemar karachat vegabbachat baadam
Ma lehallan parach bechullo tahor af kan parach bechullo tahor

Amar rabbi yochanan bechol hattora kullah lemedin lamed millamed chutz min hakkodashim sheen danin lamed millamed
Deim ken lo yeamer tzafona beasham vetete bigzera shava dekodshe kadashim mechattaot
Lav lememra dedavar hallamed behekesh en chozer umlammed bigzera shava
Vedilma mishshum deika lemifrach ma lechattat shekken mechapperet al chayyave charetot
Kodshe kadashim yattire ketivi
Davar hallamed mehekesh chozer umlammed bekal vachomer

Velitamach tete mibbinyan av meola may tama la ate mishshum deika lemifrach ma leola shekken kalil chattat name ika lemifrach ma lechattat shekken mechapperet al chayyave charetot

La nichtov rachamana bechattat vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken zecharim

Shelamim gufayehu mena lan dichtiv shamsham
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina masar dagan chullin bealma hu
Amar leh amar amrah lamed kodesh umlammed kodesh
Davar hallamed bigzera shava mahu sheyelammed bigzera shava amar rame bar chama tanya solet murbechet lamadnu lirvucha shebbaa solet
Challot minnayin talmud lomar challotchallot rekikin minnayin talmud lomar matztzotmatztzot
Amar leh ravina mimmay dematztzotmatztzot mechallot gamar dilma mimmaafe tannur gamar
Ella amar rava tanya vekirbo ufirsho vehotzi melammed shemmotzio shalem
Yachol yisrefennu shalem neemar kan rosho uchraav veneemar lehallan rosho uchraav ma lehallan al yede nituach af kan al yede nituach
I ma lehallan behefshet af kan name behefshet talmud lomar vekirbo ufirsho may talmuda amar rav pappa keshem sheppirsho bekirbo kach besaro beoro
Vetanya rabbi omer neemar kan or uvasar vaferesh
b: Veneemar lehallan or uvasar vaferesh ma lehallan al yede nituach shello behefshet af kan al yede nituach shello behefshet

Hanicha leman deit leh derav pappa ella leman delet leh derav pappa may ika lememar teku
