Ella kal vachomer uma hekesh sheeno lamed behekesh i midderava i midderavina melammed bekal vachomer middetana deve rabbi yishmael kal vachomer hallamed mehekesh middetane deve rabbi yishmael eno din sheyelammed bekal vachomer vezehu kal vachomer ben kal vachomer
Davar hallamed bekal vachomer mahu sheyelammed bevinyan av amar rabbi yirmeya ta shema malak venimtzet terefa rabbi meir omer enah metammea bevet habbelia rabbi yehuda omer metammea bevet habbelia

Amar rabbi meir kal vachomer uma nivlat behema shemmetammea bemagga uvmassa shechitatah metaheret terefatah mittumatah nevelat of sheen metamme bemagga uvmassa eno din shettehe shechitatah metaheret terefatah mittumatah ma matzinu bishchita shemmachshartah baachila

a: Metaheret terefatah mittumatah af melika shemmachshartah baachila tetaher terefatah mittumatah
Rabbi yose omer dayyah kenivlat behema tehora sheshshechitatah metahartah velo melikatah
Vela hi hatam tehve hi mishshechita dechullin kaatyan
Davar hallamed bevinyan av mahu sheyelammed behekesh uvigzera shava uvkal vachomer uvvinyan av
Peshot miha chada mippene ma amru lan baddam kasher shehare lan baemurin kasher lan beemurin kasher shehare lan babbasar kasher
Yotze hoil veotze kasher bevama
Tame hoil vehuttar baavodat tzibur
Chutz lizmanno hoil umratztze lefigulo
Chutz limkomo hoil vehukkash lechutz lizmanno
Shekkiblu pesulin vezarku daman behanach pesulin dachazu laavodat tzibur
Vechi danin davar shello behechshero middavar shebbehechshero
Tanna mizzot torat haola riba samech leh
Sheyare haddam ku may tama amar kera el yesod mizbach haola asher petach ohel moed hahu defaga beresha
Tanu rabbanan el yesod mizbach haola velo yesod mizbeach happenimi
El yesod mizbach haola en lo yesod lappenimi atzmo
El yesod mizbach haola ten yesod lammizbeach shel ola
O eno ella mizbechah shel ola yehe layesod amar rabbi yishmael kal vachomer ma shirayim sheen mechapperin teunin yesod techillat ola shemmechapperet eno din shetteuna yesod
Amar rabbi akiva ma shirayim sheen mechapperin veen bain lechappara teuna yesod techillat ola shemmechapperet uvaa lechappara eno din shetteuna yesod
Im ken ma talmud lomar el yesod mizbach haola ten yesod lemizbechah shel ola
Amar mar el yesod mizbach velo yesod mizbeach happenimi ha mibe leh legufeh measher petach ohel moed nafka
El yesod mizbach haola
b: Ten yesod lammizbeach shel ola
Dei salka datach kedichtiv hane lema li kera leshirayim shirayim ha baray aved lehu
Vechi tema deafech mefach

a: Devaray legavay udgavay levaray ha en lo yesod lifnimi atzmo
O eno ella mizbechah shel ola yehe layesod mi ketiv el yesod haola el yesod mizbach haola ketiv
I hava ketiv el yesod haola hava amena bizkifa el yesod hashta dichtiv el yesod mizbach haola aggaggo disod
Amar rabbi yishmael gag yesod lema li kera kal vachomer hu uma sheyare chattat sheenah mechapperet teuna gag yesod techillat ola shemmechapperet eno din shetteuna gag yesod

Amar rabbi akiva uma sheyare chattat sheen mechapperin veen bain lechapper teuna gag yesod techillat ola shemmechapperet uvaa lechapper eno din shetteuna gag yesod im ken ma talmud lomar el yesod mizbach haola ten yesod lemizbechah shel ola
May benayehu amar rav adda bar ahava shirayim meakkevim ika benayehu mar savar meakkevi umar savar la meakkevi
Rav pappa amar dechulle alma shirayim en meakkevim vehacha bemitzuy chattat haof meakkev ka mipalgi mar savar meakkev umar savar la meakkev
Tanya kevateh derav pappa veet kol haddam yishpoch ma talmud lomar happar limed al par yom hakkipurim shettaun mattan damim layesod divre rabbi
Amar rabbi yishmael kal vachomer uma im mi sheen nichnas damo lifnim chova taun yesod mi shennichnas damo lifnim chova eno din shettaun yesod
Amar rabbi akiva uma mi sheen damo nichnas lifnay velifnim ben lechova ben lemitzva taun yesod mi shennichnas damo chova lifnay velifnim eno din shettaun yesod
Yachol yeakkevennu talmud lomar vechilla mikkapper et hakkodesh shalmu kal hakkapparot kullan divre rabbi yishmael
Kal vachomer lefar kohen mashiach misseir nasi meatta uma mi sheen nichnas damo lifnim lo chova vela mitzva taun yesod mi shennichnas damo lifnim ben lechova ben lemitzva eno din shettaun yesod
Yachol yeakkevennu talmud lomar veet kol haddam dam happar yishpoch
Nitteko hakkatuv laase vaasao sheyare mitzva lomar lecha shirayim en meakkevin
Vesavar rabbi yishmael mitzuy chattat haof meakkev vehatana deve rabbi yishmael vehannishar baddam yimmatze vehannishar yimmatze
b: Vesheeno nishar lo yimmatze tere tannae vealliba derabbi yishmael
Amar rame bar chama hay tanna savar shirayim meakkevi detanya hakkohen hamchatte otah otah shennitan damah lemala velo otah shennitan damah lematta

Amarta vechi meayin bata mikkelal shenneemar vedam zevachecha yishshafech al mizbach vego lamadnu lannitanin bemattan arba sheim netanan bemattana achat kiper yachol af hannitanin lemala shennetanan lematta kiper
Vedin hu neemru damim lemala veneemru damim lemattan ma damim haamurim lemattan shennetanan lemalan lo kiper af damim haamurim lemalan im natan lematta lo kiper
Lo im amarta battachtonim shennitanin bintina lemala sheen sofan lemalan lo kiper tomar baelonim shennetanan lematta sheyyesh mehen karev lematta
Damim shirayim happenimiyyim yochichu sheyyesh mehen karev bachutz veim netanan battechilla bachutz lo kiper
Lo im amarta bedamim happenimiyyim sheen mizbeach happenimi memarkan tomar beelonim shehare keranot memarkot otan im netanan lematta kesherim
Talmud lomar otah otah shennitan damim lemala velo shennitan damah lematta
May sheen mizbeach happenimi memarkan lav ellu shirayim
Amar leh rava i hachi tete bekal vachomer
Ma shirayim happenimiyyim shessofan chova bachutz asaan battechilla bachutz lo kiper hannitanin lemala sheen sofan chova lematta vaasaan battechilla lematta eno din shello kiper
Ella en mizbeach happenimi memarkan bilvad ella parochet

Tanu rabbanan vechilla mikkapper im kiper killa veim lo kiper la killa divre rabbi akiva amar lo rabbi yehuda mippene ma lo nomar im killa kiper im lo killa lo kiper sheim chisar achat mikkol hammattanot lo asa velo chelum
May benayehu rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi chad amar mashmaut dorshin ika benayehu vechad amar shirayim meakkevin ika benayehu
Tistayyem derabbi yehoshua ben levi hu deamar shirayim dimakkevi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi ledivre haomer shirayim meakkevin mevi par echad umatchil battechilla bifnim
Attu rabbi yochanan let leh ha sevara vehaamar rabbi yochanan tanna rabbi nechemya kedivre haomer shirayim meakkevin
Ella kedivre haomer velav lehane tannae hacha name kedivre haomer velav lehane tannae

Matni chattoot hatztzibbur vehayyachid ellu hen chatteot hatztzibbur seire rashe chodashim veshel moadot shechitatan batztzafon vekibul daman bichli sharet batztzafon vedaman taun arba mattanot al arba keranot ketzad

a: Ala bakkevesh ufana lassovev uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit mizrachit tzefonit tzefonit maaravit maaravit deromit sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod deromit veneechalin lifnim min hakkelaim lezichre chehunna bechol maachal leom valayela ad chatzot
Gema hechi aved rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar chad amar noten amma elach veamma elach vechad amar mechatte veored keneged chuddo shel keren

Alliba derabbi elazar berabbi shimon deamar hi atzmah enah naaset ella begufah shel keren dechulle alma la peligi ki peligi alliba derabbi mar savar amma elach veamma elach keneged keren hu umar savar keneged chuddah in tefe la

Metivi chattat hatztzibur vehayyachid ketzad mattan daman haya ole lakkevesh ufana lassovev uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit vetovel beetzbao hayemanit hamummenet shebbayyamin min haddam shebbammizrak vechomer begudalo millemala uvetzbao ketanna millematta umchatte veored keneged chuddah shel keren ad shemmechalle kal haddam shebbaetzba vechen kol keren vakeren
Hachi kaamar mitzva bechuddah i avad amma elach veamma elach let lan bah
May rabbi umay rabbi elazar berabbi shimon detanya damim haelonim nitanin michut hassikra ulmala damim hattachtonim nitanin michut hassikra ulmattan divre rabbi
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer bamme devarim amurin beolat haof aval bechattat behema hi atzmah en naaset ella al gufah shel keren

Amar rabbi avahu may tama derabbi dichtiv vehaharel arba ammot umehaharel ulmala vego arba ammot hu dehaveya amar rav adda bar ahava umkom keranot arba mekom keranot arba haveya ella ema reshut keranot arba

Tenan hatam chut shel sikra chogro baemtza lehavdil ben damim haelonim ledamim hattachtonim mena hane mile amar rav acha bar rav kattina shenneemar vehayeta hareshet ad chatzi hammizbeach hattora natna mechitza lehavdil ben damim haelonim ledamim hattachtonim
Sheyare haddam ku tanu rabbanan el yesod mizbeach ze yesod deromi atta omer ze yesod deromi o eno ella yesod maaravi
Veyilmad satum min hamforash amarta yilmad yeridato min hakkevesh litziato min hahechal ma yetziato min hahechal besamuch lo af yeridato min hakkevesh besamuch lo
Tanya rabbi yishmael omer ze vaze yesod maaravi rabbi shimon ben yochay omer ze vaze yesod deromi
Bishlama leman deamar yesod maaravi kasavar yilmad satum min hamforash
Ella leman deamar yesod deromi may tama amar rabbi assi kasavar hay tanna kulleh mizbeach betzafon kae lishana acharina kulleh petach bedarom kae
b: Tana deve rabbi yishmael kerabbi shimon ben yochay omrim ze vaze yesod maaravi vesimanech mashchu gavre legavra
Matni haola kodshe kadashim shechitatah batztzafon vekibul damah bichle sharet batztzafon vedamah taun shette mattanot shehen arba utuna hefshet venituach vechalil laishshim
Gema ola may tama tane leh kodshe kadashim mishshum dela ketiv bah la kodshe kadashim hi
Vedamah taun shette mattanot hechi aved amar rav noten vechozer venoten ushmuel amar mattana achat kemin gamma noten
Ketannae yachol yizrekennu zerika achat talmud lomar saviv i saviv yachol yakkifennu kechut talmud lomar vezarku ha ketzad kemin gamma vedamah taun shette mattanot shehen arba
Rabbi yishmael omer neemar kan saviv veneemar lehallan saviv ma lehallan pisuk vearba mattanot af kan pisuk vearba mattanot
I ma lehallan arba mattanot al arba keranot af kan arba mattanot al arba keranot amarta ola teuna yesod vekeren mizrachit deromit lo haya lah yesod
May tama amar rabbi elazar lefi shello hayeta bechelko shel toref deamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak mizbeach ochel bechelko shel yehuda amma

Amar rabbi levi bar chama amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina retzua hayeta yotza mechelko shel yehuda venichneset bechelko shel binyamin vehaya binyamin hatztzaddik mitztaer aleha bechol yom lenotlah shenneemar

a: Chofef alav kol hayyom lefichach zacha binyamin hatztzaddik venaasa ushpizchan lehakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar uven ketefav shachen
Metivi olat haof ketzad hayeta naaset haya molek et roshah mimmul orpah umavdil ummatztze damah al kir hammizbeach
Vei amratte lo haya lah yesod beavera bealma hu deka aved amar rav nachman bar yitzchak emar kach hitnu avera devinyamin karka dihuda
May lo hava haya lah yesod rav amar bevinyan levi amar bedamim rav metargem beachsanteh yitbene madbecha levi metargem beachsanteh yitbene makdesha mekom mekuddash ledamim
Ta shema hayesod haya mehallech al pene kol hatztzafon veal pene kol hammaarav ochel baddarom amma achat uvammizrach amma achat may ochel name bedamim
Ta shema hammizbeach haya sheloshim ushtayim al sheloshim ushtayim hacha bemay askinan min hatztzad
Ta shema nimtza poreach amma al yesod veamma al sovev ema keneged amma yesod veal amma sovev

Ta shema detane levi ketzad bonin et hammizbeach meviin malben shehu sheloshim ushtayim al sheloshim ushtayim vegovho amma umevi chaluke avanim mefullamot ben gedolot ben ketannot umevi sid vekunya vazefet ummache veshofech veze hu mekom yesod

Vechozer umevi malben shehu sheloshim amma al sheloshim amma vegovho chamesh ammot umevi chaluke avanim ku vechozer umevi malben shehu esrim ushmone al esrim ushmone ammot vegovho shalosh ammot umevi chaluke ku vehu mekom hammaaracha
Vechozer umevi malben shehu amma al amma umevi chaluke avanim mefullamot ben gedolot ben ketannot umevi zefet vekunya ummache veshofech vezehu keren vechen lechol keren vakeren
Vechi tema
b: Degayez leh avanim shelemot ketiv

Demachet mide mittuteh veshakel leh dei la tema hachi ha deamar rav kahana avanim shel keranot chalulot hau dichtiv umalu kammizrak kezaviyyot mizbeach hacha name avanim shelemot amar rachamana ella demachet mide mittuteh veshakel leh hacha name demachet mide mittuteh veshakel leh
Daresh rava may dichtiv vayyelech david ushmuel vayyeshvu benoot barama vechi ma inyan noot etzel rama ella shehau yoshvin barama veoskin benoo shel olam
Amri ketiv vekamta vealita el hammakom melammed shebbet hammikdash gavoha mikkol eretz yisrael veeretz yisrael gevoha mikkol aratzot la hao yadi duchteh hecha
Ayeto sefer yehoshua bechullehu ketiv veyarad veala haggevul vetaar haggevul beshevet binyamin veala ketiv veyarad la ketiv amri shema minah hacha hu mekomo
Sevur lemivneyeh been etam demiddele amri nitatte beh kallil kedichtiv uven ketefav shachen
Veibaet ema gemiri desanhedrin bechelko dihuda ushchina bechelko devinyamin vei medallinan leh mitpeleg tuva mutav denitatte beh purta kedichtiv uven ketefav shachen

Veal davar ze nitkanne doeg haadomi bedavid kedichtiv ki kinat betcha achalatni uchtiv zechor Adonai ledavid et kol unnoto asher nishba la vego im avo beohel beti vego im etten shenat leenay leafappay tenuma ad emtza makom la vego
Hinne shemaanuha veefrata metzanuha bisde yaar beefrata ze yehoshua dekaate meefrayim metzanuha bisde yaar ze binyamin dichtiv binyamin zeev yitraf
Matni zivche shalme tzibbur vaashamot ellu hen ashamot asham gezelot asham meilot asham shifcha charufa asham nazir asham metzora asham taluy
Shechitatan batztzafon vekibul daman bichle sharet batztzafon vedaman taun shette mattanot shehen arba veneechalin lifnim min hakkelaim lezichre chehunna lechol maachal leom valayela ad chatzot

a: Gema mena lan devae tzafon detane rabba bar rav chanan kammeh derava vaasitem seir izzim echad lechattat ma chattat batztzafon af shalme tzibbur batztzafon
Amar leh rava vechi chattat mehechan lamda meola davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh
Ella middetane rav mari bereh derav kahana al olotechem veal zivche shalmechem ma ola kodshe kadashim af zivche shalme tzibbur kodshe kadashim ma ola batztzafon af zivche shalme tzibbur batztzafon
Ella hekesha kamma lemay ata ki chattat ma chattat enah neechelet ella lezichre chehunna af zivche shalme tzibbur lezichre chehunna

Amar leh abbaye i hachi gabbe el nazir dichtiv vehikriv et korbano la keves ben shenato tamim echad leola vechavsa achat bat shenatah temima lechattat veayil echad tamim lishlamim hachi name nema dehikkish hakkatuv lechattat ma chattat enah neechelet ella lezichre chehunna af el nazir name eno neechal ella lezichre chehunna
Hachi hashta hatam kevan dichtiv velakach hakkohen et hazzeroa beshela min haayil mikkelal dechulleh bealim achli leh
Zeroa beshela miha la litachil ella lezichre chehunna kashya
Veibaet ema kodshe ikkeri kodshe kodashim la ikru veella lemay hilcheta itakkash amar rava sheim gillach al echad mishsheloshtan yatza

Matni hattoda veel nazir kadashim kallim shechitatan bechol makom baazara vedaman taun shette mattanot shehen arba veneechalin bechol hair lechol adam bechol maachal leom valayela ad chatzot hammuram mehem keotze bahen ella shehammuram neechal lakkohanim linshehem velivnehem ulavdehem
Gema tanu rabbanan et chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma tochlu bemakom tahor amar rabbi nechemya vechi rishonim betuma achalum
Ella tahor mikkelal shehu tame tahor mittumat metzora vetame mittumat zav veeze ze ze machane yisrael
Veema tahor mittumat zav vetame mittumat met veeze ze ze machane leviyya
Amar abbaye amar kera vaachaltem otah bemakom kadosh otah bemakom kadosh velo acheret bemakom kadosh appekah lemachane leviyya hadar ketiv bemakom tahor appekah lemachane yisrael
Rava amar otah bemakom kadosh velo acheret bemakom kadosh appekah ligmare hadar ketav rachamana tochlu bimkom tahor ayela lemachane yisrael
Veema ayela lemachane leviyya lachada meayelinan letarte la meayelinan
I hachi appoke name lachada mappekinan letarte la mappekinan veod lo tuchal leechol bisharecha ketiv ella mechavarta kidabbaye

Matni shelamim kadashim kallim shechitatan bechol makom baazara vedaman taun shette mattanot shehen arba veneechalin bechol hair lechol adam bechol maachal lishne yamim velayela echad hammuram mehem kayyotze bahem ella shehammuram neechal lakkohanim linshehem velivnehem ulavdehem
Gema tanu rabbanan ushchato petach ohel moed veshachat oto lifne ohel moed veshachat oto lifne ohel moed

Lehachshir et kol haruchot bekadashim kallim kal vachomer latztzafon uma kodshe kodashim shello huchsheru bechol haruchot huchsheru batztzafon kadashim kallim shehuchsheru bechol haruchot eno din shehuchsheru batztzafon

Rabbi eliezer omer lo neemar hakkatuv ella lehachshir tzafon sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma kadashim kallim shehuchsheru bechol haruchot lo huchshar mekoman etzel kodshe kadashim kodshe kodashim shello huchsheru ella batztzafon eno din shello huchshar mekoman etzel kadashim kallim talmud lomar ohel moed
b: Bemay ka mipalgi tanna kamma savar telata kerae ketivi chad legufeh denive petach ohel moed vechad lehachshir tzedadin vechad lifsol tzide tzedadin vetzafon la itzterich kera
Verabbi eliezer savar chad legufeh denive petach ohel moed vechad lehachshir tzafon vechad lehachshir tzedadin vetzide tzedadin la itzterich kera

May shena hacha dichtiv petach ohel moed umay shena hatam dichtiv lifne ohel moed ka mashma lan kidrav yehuda amar shemuel deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel shelamim sheshshechatan kodem sheyyippatchu daltot hahechal pesulin shenneemar ushchato petach ohel moed bizman shehu patuach velo bizman shehu naul

Itmar name amar mar ukva bar chama amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina shelamim sheshshechatan kodem sheyyippatchu daltot hahechal pesulin shenneemar ushchato petach ohel moed bizman sheppetach hahechal patuach velo bizman shehu naul

Bemareva matne hachi amar rav yaakov bar acha amar rav ashe shelamim sheshshechatan kodem sheyyippatchu daltot hahechal pesulim uvammishkan kodem sheyyaamidu leviyyim et hammishkan ulachar sheyefarku leviyyim et hammishkan pesulim
Peshita mugaf kenaul dame vilon may amar rabbi zera hu atzmo en naase ella kefetach patuach

Guvha may ta shema detanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer shene pishpashin hau bevet hachalifot vegovhan shemona kede lehachshir et haazara kullah laachilat kodshe kadashim velishchitat kadashim kallim
May lav deika kammayehu shemone la degavhu ninhu shemone
Metivi kol hashshearim shehau sham govhan esrim amma verochban eser amma pishpashin shane
Vehaika tzedadin dimayyel lehu bekeren zavit

Achore bet hakkapporet may ta shema deamar rame bar rav yehuda amar rav lul katan haya achore bet hakkapporet gavoha shemone ammot kede lehachshir et haazara laachilat kodshe kadashim velishchitat kadashim kallim vehayenu dichtiv shenayim lapparbar may lapparbar amar rabba bar rav shela keman deamar kelappe bar
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel en chayyavin mishshum tuma ella al

a: Orech mea ushmonim vasheva al rochav mea ushloshim vechamesh

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman kol haazara hayeta mea shemonim vasheva al rochav mea sheloshim vechamesh amar leh hachi amar li abba kegon ze kohanim nichnasin lesham veochlin sham kodshe kadashim veshochatin sham kadashim kallim vechayyavin mishshum tuma
Lemaote may ilema lemaote challonot delatot veovi hachoma tenena hachallonot veovi hachoma kelifnim
Veella lemaote leshachot vei benuot bachol uftuchot lakkodesh vehatnan tochan kodesh midderabbanan

Udorayeta la vehatanya leshachot benuot bachol uftuchot lakkodesh minnayin shehakkohanim nichnasin lesham veochlim sham kodshe kadashim ushyare mincha talmud lomar bachatzar ohel moed yochluha hattora ribta chatzerot harbe etzel achila achat
Amar rava laachila shane
Aval leinyan tuma la vehatanya leshachot habbenuot lachol uftuchot lakkodesh kohanim nichnasin lesham veochlin sham kodshe kadashim veen shochatin sham kadashim kallim vechayyavin mishshum tuma
Lav amratte en shochatin teni name en chayyavin
Bishlama en shochatin baena keneged happetach veleka ella en chayyavin ammay

Velitamach en shochatin mi la askinan deika shechita keneged happetach dei leka lemay itzterich ella af al gav deka shachet keneged happetach teni en shochatin mishshum dela kadesh teni name en chayyavin

Velaachila la baenan keneged happetach vehatanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer shene pishpashin hau bevet hachalifot govhan shemone kede lehachshir et haazara laachilat kodshe kadashim velishchitat kadashim kallim amar ravina semi mikkan achila
Vehachtiv bashshelu et habbasar petach ohel moed vesham tochlu oto kodshe shaa shane
Amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi minnayin ledam shennifsal bishkiat hachamma shenneemar bayyom hakrivo et zivcho yeachel beom sheatta zoveach atta makriv beom shei atta zoveach i atta makriv
Hay mibe leh
b: Legufeh im ken nema kera beom zivcho yeachel hakrivo lema li shema minah beom sheatta zoveach atta makriv beom shei atta zoveach i atta makriv

Vedilma hachi kaamar rachamana i karev dam haidana nitachel basar haidana velimchar i karev dam limchar nitachel basar limchar uloma uchra im ken nema kera beom hakrivo yochal zivcho lema li shema minah beom sheatta zoveach atta makrivo beom shei atta zoveach i atta makrivo
Itmar hamchashshev leor shelishi chizkiyya amar kasher rabbi yochanan amar pasul chizkiyya amar kasher deha la intik lisrefa rabbi yochanan amar pasul deha idchi leh meachila
Haochel leor shelishi chizkiyya amar patur dela intik lisrefa rabbi yochanan amar chayyav deha idchi leh meachila

Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan kadashim hanneechalin leom echad mechashshevin bedaman mishshettishka hachamma uvivsaran uvemurehen mishsheyyaale ammud hashshachar kadashim hanneechalin lishne yamim velayela achat mechashshevin bedaman mishshettishka hachamma uvemurehen mishsheyyaale ammud hashshachar uvivsaran mishshettishka hachamma shel shene yamim

Tanu rabbanan yachol yehu neechalin leor shelishi vedin hu zevachim neechalin leom echad uzvachim neechalin lishne yamim ma zevachim hanneechalin leom echad layela acharehen af zevachim hanneechalin lishne yamim layela acharehen
Talmud lomar vehannotar ad yom beod yom hu neechal veeno neechal leor shelishi

Yachol yissaref miyyad vedin hu zevachim neechalin leom echad uzvachim neechalin lishne yamim ma zevachim hanneechalin leom echad techef laachila serefa af zevachim hanneechalin lishne yamim techef laachila serefa
Talmud lomar bayyom hashshelishi baesh yissaref bayyom atta sorfo vei atta sorfo ballayela
Matni habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach kadashim kallim shechitatan bechol makom baazara vedaman taun mattana echat uvilvad sheyyitten keneged hayesod

Shina baachilatan habbechor neechal lakkohanim vehammaaser lechol adam veneechalin bechol hair bechol maachal lishne yamim velayela echad happesach eno neechal ella ballayela veeno neechal ella ad chatzot veeno neechal ella limnuyav veeno neechal ella tzali

Gema man tanna amar rav chisda rabbi yose haggelili hi detanya rabbi yose haggelili omer chelbo lo neemar ella chelbam damo lo neemar ella damam limed al bechor umaaser ufesach shetteunin mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach
Keneged hayesod mena lan amar rabbi eliezer atya zerikahzrika meola

a: Veola gufah menalan dichtiv el yesod mizbach haola limmed al olat chova shetteuna yesod
I ma lehallan shette mattanot shehen arba af kan shette mattanot shehen arba
Amar abbaye lema li lemichtav saviv beola saviv bechattat hau shene ketuvin habbain keechad vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar have asham shelosha ushlosha vadday en melammedin

Habbechor neechal lakkohanim tanu rabbanan minnayin labbechor shenneechal lishne yamim velayela shenneemar uvsaram yihye lach kachaze hattenufa uchshok hayyamin hikkisho hakkatuv lechaze vashok shel shelamim ma shelamim neechalin lishne yamim velayela echad af bechor neechal lishne yamim velayela echad
Vezo sheela nishala lifne chachamim bakkerem beyavne bechor lechamma neechal naana rabbi tarfon veamar lishne yamim velayela echad

Haya sham talmid echad shebba levet hammidrash lifne chachamim techilla verabbi yose haggelili shemo amar lo rabbi minnayin lach amar lo beni shelamim kadashim kallim uvchor kadashim kallim ma shelamim neechalin lishne yamim velayela echad af bechor neechal lishne yamim velayela echad
Amar lo rabbi bechor mattana lakkohen vechattat veasham mattana lakkohen ma chattat veasham leom valayela af bechor leom valayela

Amar lo nadun davar mittoch davar venilmad davar mittoch davar ma shelamim en bain al chet af bechor eno ba al chet ma shelamim neechalim lishne yamim velayela echad af bechor neechal lishne yamim velayela echad

Amar lo rabbi nadun davar middavar yilmad davar middavar chattat veasham mattana lakkohen uvchor mattana lakkohen ma chattat veasham en bain beneder undava af bechor eno beneder undava ma chattat veasham neechalin leom echad af bechor neechal leom echad

Kafatz rabbi akiva venistallek rabbi tarfon amar lo hare hu omer uvsaram yihye lach hikkishan hakkatuv lechaze vashok shel shelamim ma shelamim neechalin lishne yamim velayela echad af bechor neechal lishne yamim velayela echad
Amar lo hikashto lechaze vashok shel shelamim vaani makkisho lechaze vashok shel toda ma toda neechelet leom velayela af bechor neechal leom velayela
Amar lo hare hu omer uvsaram yihye lach sheen talmud lomar lecha yihye uma talmud lomar lecha yihye hosif hakkatuv havaya acheret babbechor

Uchshennemeru devarim lifne rabbi yishmael amar lahen tzeu veimru lo lerabbi akiva taita toda mehechan lamda mishshelamim vechi davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh ha en alecha lidon belashon acharon ella belashon rishon
Verabbi yishmael hay lecha yihye may aved leh limed al bechor baal mum shehu mattana lakkohen shello matzinu bechol hattora
Verabbi akiva yalef leh mibbesaram chad tam vechad baal mum verabbi yishmael mibbesaram dehanach bechorot kaamar
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar hemennu vedavar acher have hekesh umar savar la have hekesh
Bishlama leman deamar la have hekesh hayenu dichtiv vechen yaase leohel moed
Keshem shemmazze lifnay velifnim achat lemala vesheva lematta middam happar kach mazze bahechal
Uchshem shellifnay velifnim achat lemala vesheva lematta middam hassair kach mazze bahechal
Ella leman deamar have hekesh may ika lememar mekomot hu degamri mehadade
b: Veibaet ema chutz mippenim bechad zimna gemir
Bishlama leman deamar la have hekesh hayenu dichtiv mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa
Sheen talmud lomar taviu ma talmud lomar taviu kol sheatta mevi mimmakom lemakom acher hare hu kaze ma lehallan issaron lechalla af kan issaron lechalla
I ma lehallan shene esronim af kan shene esronim talmud lomar tihyena
Velamadnu asara lechametz asara lematztza minnayin talmud lomar al challot lechem chametz neged chametz have matztza
Ella leman deamar la have hekesh may ika lememar taviu yattira hi
Happesach eno neechal man tanna amar rav yosef rabbi elazar ben azarya hi detanya rabbi elazar ben azarya omer neemar kan ballayela hazze veneemar lehallan veavarti veeretz mitzrayim ballayela hazze
Ma lehallan ad chatzot af kan ad chatzot
Amar lo rabbi akiva vahalo kevar neemar vaachaltem oto bechippazon ad sheat chippazon
Im ken ma talmud lomar ballayela hazze sheyyachol yehe kechol hakkodashim hanneechalim bayyom talmud lomar ballayela ballayela yehe neechal veeno neechal bayyom
Amar leh abbaye umimmay derabbi elazar ben azarya udorayeta dilma derabbanan ulharchik min haavera im ken may ella ad chatzot ella ki hatam ma hatam deorayeta af kan name deorayeta
Hadaran alach ezehu mekoman

a: Matni kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan berosh hammizbeach rabbi yose omer keilu nishchatu batztzafon rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer mechatzi hammizbeach veladdarom kaddarom mechatzi hammizbeach velatztzafon katztzafon
Gema amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan omer haya yose kulleh mizbeach betzafon kae umay keilu mahu detema baenan al yarech veleka ka mashma lan
Amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi ella meatta lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda hachi name dechetzo betzafon vechetzo baddarom
Vechi tema hachi name veha atte hu deamratte mishshemeh derabbi yochanan mode rabbi yose berabbi yehuda sheim shechatan kenegdan bakkarka pesula
Amar leh hachi kaamar rabbi yochanan shenehem mikra echad darshu vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha
Rabbi yose savar kullo leola vechullo lishlamim verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar chetzo leola vechetzo lishlamim
Dei salka datach kullo leola kasher hashta kullo leola kasher kullo lishlamim mibaya
Veidach itzterich salka datach amena ola hu didchik leh makom aval shelamim dela dechik leh makom ema la ka mashma lan

Gufa amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan mode rabbi yose berabbi yehuda sheim shechatan kenegdan bakkarka pesulot amar leh rav acha middifti leravina may kenegdan bakkarka ilema amma yesod amma sovev hay gufeh mizbeach hu veod may kenegdan bakkarka

Vechi tema deaved mechilot bakkarka veshachet behu vechi hay gavena mi have mizbeach vehatanya mizbach adama taase li sheyehe mechubbar meadama baadama shello yivnennu lo al gabbe mechilot velo al gabbe kipin
La tzericha devatztzereh batztzore
Amar rabbi zera efshar ita leha derabbi yochanan vela tenena lah bematnitin

Nefak dak veashkach ditnan berru mishsham atze teena yafim lesadder maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret keneged keren maaravit deromit mashuch min hakkeren kelappe tzafon arba ammot beomed chamesh sein gechalim uvshabbat beomed shemone sein gechalim sheshsham hau notnin shene beziche levona shel lechem happanim
Umay simana rabbi yose hi detanya
b: Rabbi yose omer ze siman kol hannital bifnim linaten bachutz eno noten ella besamuch sheen lifnim
Vechol hannital bachutz linaten lifnim eno nital ella besamuch sheen lifnim
Kal hannital bifnim linaten bachutz may nihu ilema shirayim behedya ketiv behu el yesod mizbach haola asher petach ohel moed
Vetu kol hannital bachutz linaten bifnim may nihu ilema gechalim shel yom hakkipurim behedya ketiv behu velakach melo hammachta gachale esh vego
Ella kol hannital bifnim linaten bachutz shene beziche levona shel lechem happanim degamri mishshirayim
Hannital bachutz linaten bifnim gechalim dechol yoma veoma degamran miggechalim shel yom hakkippurim
Umay kasavar i kasavar kulleh mizbeach bedarom kae esrim vesheva bae lemete
Vei name kasavar kedushshat hechal veulam chada hi esrim vetarte bae mete
Vei kasavar chetzo batztzafon vechetzo baddarom chad sere bae lemete veella kasavar kedushshat hechal veulam chada milta hi shet bae lemete
Ella lav mishshum dekasavar kulleh mizbeach betzafon kae
Vehane arba ammot amma yesod veamma sovev veamma makom keranot veamma mekom ragle hakkohanim dechi mesaggu lekammeh tefe tu leka petach

Amar rav adda bar ahava ha manni rabbi yehuda hi detanya rabbi yehuda omer mizbeach memutztza veomed beemtza haazara vshloshim ushtayim ammot hau lo eser ammot keneged pitcho shel hechal achat esre amma mikan veachat esre amma mikan nimtza mizbeach mechvan keneged hechal
Sof sof lerabbi yehuda chad sere bae lemete vei kasavar kedushshat hechal veulam chada milta hi shet bae lemete
Mi savratte hane arba ammot bahade amma yesod veamma sovev arba ammot bar meamma yesod veamma sovev
Venokmah kerabbi yose uvimmutztza mishshum derabbi yehuda shemana leh memutztza behedya
Verav sherevya amar ha manni rabbi yose haggelili hi detanya rabbi yose haggelili omer mittoch shenneemar venatatta et hakkiyyor ben ohel moed vegomer veet

a: Mizbach haola vego mizbeach befetach ohel moed velo kiyyor befetach ohel moed hechan haya notno ben haulam velammizbeach mashuch kima kelappe haddarom
May kasavar i kasavar kulleh mizbeach bedarom kae nokmeh mikkotel hechal veladdarom ben ulam lammizbeach
Vei name kasavar kedushshat hechal veulam chada hi nokmeh mikkotel ulam veladdarom beven ulam lammizbeach
I name kasavar chetzo batztzafon vechetzo baddarom nokmeh mikkotel hechal veladdarom ben ulam velammizbeach
Vei name kasavar kedushshat haulam vehechal chada hi nokmeh mikkotel ulam veladdarom ben ulam velammizbeach ella lav mishshum dekasavar kulleh mizbeach batztzafon
Ki name mokmatte lah mikkotel hechal velatztzafon have leh ben ulam velammizbeach
Venokmah mikkotel ulam velatztzafon beven ulam velammizbeach
Amar kera tzafona sheyehe tzafon panuy mikkelim
Man tanna diflig aleh derabbi yose haggelili rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer tzafona sheyehe tzafon panuy mikkelum vaafilu min hammizbeach

Amar rav mizbeach shennifgam kol hakkodashim shennishchatu sham pesulin mikra hu beyadenu ushchachnuhu ki selek rav kahana ashkecheh lerabbi shimon berabbi dekaamar mishshum rabbi yishmael berabbi yose minnayin lammizbeach shennifgam shekkol hakkodashim shennishchatu sham pesulin
Shenneemar vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha vechi alav atta zoveach ella keshehu shalem velo keshehu chaser amar hayenu kera deishtemit leh lerav
Verabbi yochanan amar echad ze veechad ze pesulin bemay peligi rav savar baale chayyim enan nidchim verabbi yochanan savar baale chayyim nidchin
Metivi kol hakkodashim shehau ad shello nivna hammizbeach veachar kach nivna hammizbeach pesulin nivna dechuyin meikara ninhu
Ella ad shello neheras hammizbeach neheras ha izkun lehu
Ella ad shello nifgam hammizbeach veachar kach nifgam hammizbeach pesulin vela tarotze ka metartzatte ema shennishchatu
Vehaamar rav gidel amar rav mizbeach shenneekar maktirin ketoret bimkomo
Kidamar rava mode haya rabbi yehuda bedamim hacha name mode rav bedamim
May rabbi yehuda detanya bayyom hahu kidash hammelech toch hechatzer vego ki mizbeach sheasa moshe katan mehachil devarim kichtavan divre rabbi yehuda
Amar lo rabbi yose
b: Vahalo kevar neemar elef olot yaale shelomo al hammizbeach hahu veilu bevet olamim hu omer vayyizbach shelomo et zevach hashshelamim asher zavach la bakar esrim ushnayim elef
Uchsheatta maggia lecheshbon olot ulminyan ammot ze gadol mizze
Ella mahu katan mehachil keadam haomer lachavero peloni nannas hu ufasul laavoda
Verabbi yehuda shappir kaamar rabbi yose rabbi yehuda letameh deamar mizbeach sheasa moshe gadol haya detanya chamesh ammot orech vechamesh ammot rochav devarim kichtavan divre rabbi yose
Rabbi yehuda omer neemar kan ravua veneemar lehallan ravua ma lehallan meemtzaito haya moded af kan meemtzaito haya moded
Vehatam menalan dichtiv vehaariel shettem esre amma lechol ruach o eno ella shettem esre al shettem esre keshehu omer al arbaat revaav melammed shemmeemtza hu moded
Verabbi yose ki gemir gezera shava begovhah hu digmir detanya veshalosh ammot komato devarim kichtavan divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi yose omer neemar kan ravua veneemar lehallan ravua ma lehallan govho pi shenayim keorko af kan pi shenayim keorko
Amar leh rabbi yehuda vahalo kevar neemar veet hechatzer mea amma vekoma chamesh ammot vego efshar kohen omed al gabbe hammizbeach vaavoda beyado vechol haam roin oto mibbachutz
Amar lo rabbi yose vahalo kevar neemar veet kale hechatzer veet masach shaar hechatzer asher al hammishkan veal hammizbeach ma mishkan eser ammot af mizbeach eser ammot veomer kelaim chamesh esre

a: Amma el hakkatef uma talmud lomar chamesh ammot missefat mizbeach ulmala
Uma talmud lomar veshalosh ammot komato missefat sovev ulmala
Verabbi yehuda ki gemir gezera shava berachbah hu digmir
Ulrabbi yehuda ha ka mitchaze kohen nehi dechohen mitchaze avoda divyado la mitchaze
Bishlama lerabbi yehuda hayenu dichtiv kidesh ella lerabbi yose may kidesh lehaamid bah mizbeach
Bishlama lerabbi yose hayenu dichtiv katan ella lerabbi yehuda may katan hachi kaamar mizbach avanim sheasa shelomo tachat mizbach hannechoshet katan hava
Bemay peligi mar savar danin chutz michutz veen danin chutz mippenim
Umar savar danin keli mikkeli veen danin keli mibbinyan
Amar rava mode rabbi yehuda bedamim detanya rabbi yehuda omer kos echad haya memalle middam hattaarovot veshofcho al gabbe mizbeach sheim yishshafech damo shel achat mehen nimtza ze machshiro
Vei salka datach savar rabbi yehuda kullah azara mikaddesha ha itavida leh mitzveteh
Vedilma mishshum dekasavar sheficha mikkoach haadam baenan im ken nishkeleh venishpoch leh adduchteh
Vedilma mishshum devaenan mitzva min hammuvchar

Amar rabbi elazar mizbeach shennifgam en ochlim begino sheyare mincha shenneemar veichluha matztzot etzel hammizbeach vechi etzel hammizbeach achaluha ella bizman shehu shalem velo bizman shehu chaser
Ashkechan sheyare mincha kodshe kodashim menalan talmud lomar kodesh kadashim
Kadashim kallim minnayin amar abbaye atya midderasha derabbi yose detanya rabbi yose omer shelosha devarim mishshum
b: Shelosha zekenim veze echad mehen rabbi yishmael omer yachol yaale adam maaser sheni lirushalayim veyochlennu bizman hazze vedin hu bechor taun havaat makom umaaser taun havaat makom ma bechor eno ella bifne habbayit af maaser eno ella bifne habbayit
Ma livchor shekken taun mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach
Bikurim yochichu ma levikurim shekken teunin hannacha
Talmud lomar vahavetem shamma olotechem vego makkish maaser livchor ma bechor eno ella bifne habbayit af maaser eno ella bifne habbayit
Venihdar dina venete bema hatztzad
Mishshum deika lemifrach ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahen tzad mizbeach
May kasavar i kasavar kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah vekidsha leatid lavo afilu bechor name vei kasavar lo kidsha leatid lavo afilu bechor name tive
Amar ravina leolam kasavar lo kidsha vehacha bemay askinan bivchor shennizrak damo kodem churban habbayit vecharav habbayit vaadayin besaro kayyam
Veitakkash besaro ledamo ma damo bammizbeach af besaro bammizbeach veate maaser veyalef mibbechor
Vechi davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh masar dagan chullin hu
Hanicha leman deamar batar lamed azlinan ella leman deamar batar melammed azlinan may ika lememar
Dam uvasar chada milta hi

Ki selek ravin amrah lishmata kammeh derabbi yirmeya amar bavlae tafshae ammetul deyatvi beara chashocha amri shemata dimchashshecha la shemia lehu ha detanya bishat siluk massaot kadashim nifsalin vezavim umtzoraim mishtallechim chutz lammechitza
Vetanya idach bishne mekomot kodashim neechalim may lav ha bekodshe kadashim ha bekadashim kallim
Amar ravina ide veide bekadashim kallim vela kashya

a: Ha rabbi yishmael ha rabbanan
Veibaet ema ha veha bekodshe kadashim umay bishne mekomot kodem sheyyaamidu leviyyim et hammishkan
b: Ulachar sheyefarku halviyyim et hammishkan
Mahu detema ipsil lehu beotze ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name amar kera venasa ohel moed af al pi shennasa ohel moed hu

Amar rav huna amar rav mizbeach shel shilo shel avanim haya detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer ma talmud lomar avanim avanim avanim shalosh peamim echad shel shilo veechad shel nov vegivon uvet olamim

Metiv rav acha bar amme esh sheyyarda min hashshamayim bime moshe lo nistalleka meal mizbach hannechoshet ella bime shelomo veesh sheyyarda bime shelomo lo nistalleka ad shebba menashshe vesilkah veim ita meikara hu deistallak leh
Hu deamar kerabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer mizbeach shel shilo shel nechoshet haya chalul umale avanim
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar may lo nistalleka lo nistalleka levattala may hi rabbanan amri sheviva hava meshaddera rav pappa amar ushpiza hava naket vezimnin hacha vezimnin hacha
Tenan hatam uchshealu bene haggola hosifu alav arba ammot min haddarom vearba ammot min hammaarav kemin gamma may tama amar rav yosef mishshum dela safak

Amar leh abbaye hashta mikdash rishon dichtiv beh yehuda veyisrael rabbim kachol asher al sefat hayyam sefek mikdash sheni dichtiv beh kol hakkahal keechad arba ribbo lo safek amar leh hatam esh shel shamayim mesayyatan hacha en esh shel shamayim mesayyatan
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi mishshum bar kappara shitin hosifu meikara sevur mizbach adama shehu atum baadama
Ulvassof sevur shetiyya kaachila umay mizbach adama shehu mechubbar baadama shello yivnennu lo al gabbe kipim

a: Velo al gabbe mechilot
Amar rav yosef lav hayenu detanya vayyachinu et hammizbeach al mechonato shehiggiu lesof middotav vehachtiv hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil
Ella amar rav yosef kera ashkach udrash vayyomer david ze hu bet Adonai haelohim veze mizbeach leola leyisrael ki bayit ma bayit shishshim amma af mizbeach shishshim amma
Bishlama bayit minachra tzurato ella mizbeach mena yadi

Amar rabbi elazar rau mizbeach banuy umichael hassar haggadol omed umakriv alav verabbi yitzchak nappacha amar efro shel yitzchak rau shemmunnach beoto makom verabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar mikkol habbayit kullo herichu reach ketoret mishsham herichu reach evarim

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan shelosha neviim alu immahem min haggola echad sheheid lahem al hammizbeach veechad sheheid lahem al mekom hammizbeach veechad sheheid lahem shemmakrivin af al pi sheen bayit

Bematnita tana rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer shelosha neviim alu immahen min haggola echad sheheid lahem al hammizbeach veal mekom hammizbeach veechad sheheid lahem shemmakrivin af al pi sheen bayit veechad sheheid lahem al hattora shettikkatev ashshurit

Tanu rabbanan keren vechevesh visod veribua meakkevin middat orko umiddat rochbo umiddat komato en meakkevin mena hane mile amar rav huna amar kera hammizbeach kol makom shenneemar hammizbeach leakkev

Ella meatta kiyyor lerabbi vesovev lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda hachi name dimakkev dichtiv venatatta otah tachat karkov hammizbeach millematta vetanya ezehu karkov rabbi omer ze kiyyur rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer ze hassovev

In detanya oto hayyom nifgema keren mizbeach veheviu bul shel melach ustamuhu velo mippene shekkasher laavoda ella shello yerae mizbeach pagum shekkol mizbeach sheen lo keren vechevesh visod veribua pasul rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer af hassovev
Tanu rabbanan ezehu karkov ben keren lekeren mekom hiluch ragle hakkohanim amma attu kohanim ben keren lekeren hao azli ella ema umkom hiluch ragle hakkohanim amma
Vehachtiv tachat karkubbo millematta ad chetzo amar rav nachman bar yitzchak tere hao chad lenoy vechad lechohanim dela nishtarku

Ben betira omer minnayin sheim kamatz bismol sheyyachazir veyikmotz beyamin talmud lomar mishsham mimmakom shekkamatz kevar

Ma haggasha bekeren maaravit deromit af kemitza bekeren maaravit deromit ka mashma lan
Amar rabbi yochanan shelamim sheshshechatan bahechal kesherim shenneemar ushchato oto petach ohel moed velo yehe tafel chamur min haikar

Hachi hashta hatam avoda deadam oved bimkom rabbo amrinan lo yehe tafel chamur min haikar achila deen adam ochel bimkom rabbo lo yehe tafel chamur min haikar la amrinan

Matni chattat haof ketzad haya naaset ala lakkevesh ufana lassovev ba lo lekeren deromit mizrachit haya molek et roshah mimmul orpa veeno mavdil umazze middamah al kir hammizbeach sheyare haddam haya mitmatztze al hayesod veen lemizbeach ella damah vechullah lakkohanim
Gema tanu rabbanan vehizza middam hachattat migguf hachattat ha ketzad ochez barosh uvagguf umazze al kir hammizbeach velo al kir hakkevesh velo al kir hechal velo al kir ulam veeze ze kir hattachton
O eno ella kir haelon vedin hu uma behema sheolatah lematta chattatah lemala of sheolato lemala eno din shechattato lemala
Talmud lomar vehannishar baddam yimmatze el yesod hammizbeach kir shehashsheyarin shello mitmatztzim layesod veeze ze kir hattachton
Venabed meilay vahadar nabed mittattay amar rava mi ketiv yematztze yimmatze ketiv demimmela mashma
Amar rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav ketzad molkin chattat haof ochez gappav bishte etzbaot ushte raglayim bishte etzbaot umoteach tzavarah al rochav gudalo umolkah
Bematnita tena tzipra millevar ochez gappav bishte etzbaot ushne raglayim bishte etzbaot umoteach tzavaro al rochav shette etzbeotav umolek vezo avoda kasha shebbammikdash
Zo hi vetu la vehaika kemitza vachafina ella ema zo avoda kasha meavodot kashot shebbammikdash

Matni olat haof ketzad naaset ala lakkevesh ufana lassovev ba lo lekeren deromit mizrachit haya molek et roshah mimmul orpa umavdil umitza et damah al kir hammizbeach natal et harosh vehikkif bet melikato lammizbeach sefago bemelach uzrako al gabbe haishshim
Ba lo lagguf vehesir et hammura veet hannotza veet bene hammeayim hayyotzin immam vehishlichan levet haddeshen shisa velo hivdil veim hivdil kasher sofgo bemelach vezorko al gabbe haishshim

Lo hesir hammura velo hannotza veet bene meayim hayyotzin immam velo sefago bemelach kol sheshshina bah meacher shemmitza et damah keshera hivdil bachattat velo hivdil baola pasul mitza et dam harosh velo mitza dam hagguf pesula dam hagguf velo mitza dam harosh keshera

Gema tanu rabbanan vehikrivo ma talmud lomar
Lefi shenneemar vehikriv min hattorim o min bene hayyona yachol hammitnaddev of lo yifchot mishshene peridin talmud lomar vehikrivo afilu perida achat yavi el hammizbeach

Ma talmud lomar hakkohen likboa lo kohen sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma ben tzon shekkava lo tzafon la kava lo kohen of shella kava lo tzafon eno din shello yikba lo kohen talmud lomar el hakkohen likboa lo kohen
Yachol yimlekennu besakkin vedin hu uma im shechita shello kava lah kohen kava lah keli melika shekkava lah kohen eno din sheyyikba lah keli
Talmud lomar kohen umalak amar rabbi akiva vechi taale al datecha shezzar karev legabbe mizbeach ella ma talmud lomar kohen shettehe melika beatzmo shel kohen
Yachol yimlekenna ben millemala ben millematta talmud lomar umalak vehiktir ma haktara berosh hammizbeach af melika berosh hammizbeach
Umalak mimmul oref atta omer mimmul oref o eno ella min hatztzavar vedin hu neemar kan umalak veneemar lehallan umalak ma lehallan mimmul oref af kan mimmul oref
I ma lehallan molek veeno mavdil af kan molek veeno mavdil talmud lomar umalak vehiktir ma haktara harosh leatzmo vehagguf leatzmo af melika harosh leatzmo vehagguf leatzmo
Uminnayin shehaktarat harosh beatzmo vehagguf beatzmo shenneemar vehiktir oto hare haktarat hagguf amura ha ma ani mekayyem vehiktir hammizbecha behaktarat harosh hakkatuv medabber
Venimtza damo kullo al kir hammizbeach velo al kir hakkevesh velo al kir hahechal veeze ze ze kir haelon
O eno ella kir hattachton vedin hu ma behema shechattatah lemala olatah lematta of shechattato lematta eno din sheolato lematta

Talmud lomar umalak vehiktir venimtza damo vechi taale al datecha leachar shehiktir chozer ummatztze ella lomar lach ma haktara berosh hammizbeach af mitzuy berosh hammizbeach ha ketzad haya ole bakkevesh ufone lassovev uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit haya molek et roshah mimmul orpa umavdil ummatztze middamah al kir hammizbeach im asaah lematta meraglav afilu amma keshera

Abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu ose maaracha al gabbe sovev ika benayehu
Ba lo lagguf ku tanu rabbanan vehesir et murato benotzatah zo zefek
Yachol yakdir besakkin veyittelennu talmud lomar benotzatah notel et hannotza immah abba yose ben chanan omer notlah venotel kurkevanah immah
Deve rabbi yishmael tana benotzatah benotza shellah kodrah besakkin kemin arubba

May benayehu amar rav chisda mitzuy chattat haof meakkev ika benayehu tanna kamma savar mitzuy chattat haof meakkev vechevan demitztzuy dam kaaved maase ola bechattat haof
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar mitzuy chattat haof lo meakkev umchattech basar bealma hu
Rava amar shehiyya besiman sheni beolat haof meakkev ika benayehu tanna kamma savar shehiyya besiman sheni beolat haof lo meakkev veaf al gav dishhiyya ka aved maase ola bechattat
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar meakkev vechevan dishhiyya mechattech basar bealma hu

Uviflugta derabbi zera verabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak chad amar shehiyya besiman sheni beolat haof meakkev ika benayehu vechad amar rov basar meakkev ika benayehu

Bamme devarim amurim shennitarvu chayyin aval nitarvu shechutin noten arba mattanot mikkullan
Veim natan mattana achat mikkullan yatza rabbi omer roin et hammattana im yesh bah kede laze uchde laze keshera veim lav pesula
Katane yachid dumya detzibur ma tzibur gavre af yachid gavre
Amar rava vetisbera ha metaratzta hi dekatane bamme devarim amurim keshennitarvu chayyin aval nitarvu shechutin la ma li chayyim ma li shechutin
Ella hachi kaamar bamme devarim amurim shennitarvu shechutin keen chayyim bechosot aval bevolel noten arba mattanot lechullan veim natan mattana achat lechullan yatza
Rabbi omer roin et hammattana im yesh bah kede laze uchde laze keshera veim la pesula umi it leh lerabbi hay sevara veha tanya amar rabbi ledivre rabbi eliezer
b: Hazzaa kol shehi metaheret hazzaa enah tzericha shiur hazzaa mechetza kasher umechetza pasul
Lidvarav derabbi eliezer kaamar veibaet ema hazzaa lechud untina lechud
Nitarvu bivchor umaaser ku amar rame bar chama bechor levet shammay en maachilin leniddot temurato mahu
Bechor eno nifde temurato mahu bechor eno nishkal belitra temurato mahu amar rava tanya bechor umaaser mishshehummu osin temura utmuratan keotze bahen
Bae rame bar chama hitpis bechor levedek habbayit mahu sheyyishkol belitra ravecha dehekdesh adif o dilma ziluta divchor adif
Amar rabbi yose bar zevida ta shema nitarvu bivchor uvmaaser yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyeachlu kivchor uchmaaser lav lememra deeno nishkal belitra
Rav huna verabbi chizkiyya talmide rabbi yirmeya amri mi dame hatam shette kedushshot ushne gufin hacha shette kedushshot veguf echad
Matkef lah rabbi yose bar avin ma ilu amar hafdu li bechor shehitpiso levedek habbayit kelum shomin lo hafdu rachamana amar lo tifde
Ella amar rabbi amme kelum hikna ze ella ma shekkanuy lo
Hakkol yecholin lehitarev ku may shena chattat veasham dehay zachar vehay nekeva
Chattat veola name ika seir nasi hay sear vehay tzemer
Pesach veasham name la miarav hay ben shana vehay ben shette shanim ika asham nazir vaasham metzora veibaet ema ika ben shana demichaze keven shette shanim veika ben shettayim demichaze keven shana
Matni asham shennitarev bishlamim rabbi shimon omer shenehem yishshachatu batztzafon veyeachlu kechamur shebbahen
Amru lo en meviin kadashim levet happesul
Nitarvu chatichot bachatichot kodshe kadashim bekadashim kallim hanneechalin leom echad beneechalin lishne yamim velayela yeachlu kechamur shebbahen
Gema tane tanna kammeh derav sheviit en lokchin bedameha teruma mippene shemmemaatin baachilatah
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derava derabba ha dela kerabbi shimon dei kerabbi shimon haamar meviin kadashim levet happesul
Amar lehu afilu temru rabbi shimon hane mile deiavad lechitchila la ulchitchila la etiveh abbaye

a: Vechullan rashshain kohanim leshannot baachilatan leachlan tzeluyin shelukin umvushshalin velatet letochan tavle chullin vetavle teruma divre rabbi yishmael amar leh hannach litrumat tavlin derabbanan
Etiveh en lokchin teruma bechesef maaser mippene shemmemaet baachilatah verabbi shimon mattir ishtik leh
Ki ata lekammeh derav yosef amar leh ammay la totveh meha en mevashshelin yarak shel sheviit beshemen shel teruma shello yaviu kadashim levet happesul verabbi shimon mattir

Amar leh abbaye velav mi otviteh meha detavlin veamar li hannach litrumat tavlin derabbanan hacha name teruma terumat yarak derabbanan i hachi ipcha mibaya leh lemitne yarak shel teruma beshemen shel sheviit
Velav mi otviteh mimmatnitin demattir rabbi shimon veamar li deiarav hacha name deiarav
I deiarav may tamayehu derabbanan mide dehave aasham ushlamim
Mi dame hatam asham it leh takkanta biriyya ha let leh takkanta biriyya
Ha la dame ella lachaticha shebbachatichot kevan delet takkanta deochel kechamur shebbahen
Matkef lah ravina mi dame chaticha shebbachatichot let lah takkanta kelal hay it leh takkanta bischita
Verav yosef hechi nischot nischot tuva ka mafsed bishviit nischot purta sof sof iarove miarav
Etiveh rabbi shimon omer lammochorat mevi ashamo veluggo immo veomer im shel metzora hare ze ashamo veze luggo
b: Veim lav asham ze shel shalme nedava veoto asham taun shechita batztzafon umattan behonot usmicha unsachim utnufat chaze vashok
Veneechal leom velayela takkone gavra shane
Hatinach asham log may ika lememar deamar log ze yehe nedava vedilma lav metzora hu uvae mikmatz demikkemitz
Vedilma metzora hu uvae mattan sheva deyahev
Veha chasar leh demayete purta ummalle leh ditnan chasar hallog ad shello yatzak yemalleennu
Veha bae haktara deaktar demaktar leh
Emat i batar mattenot sheva hau lehu shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaktara veen maktirin et hakkometz alehen
I kodem mattenot sheva kol shemmimmennu laishim hare hu beval taktiru
Amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi demassek lehu leshem etzim detanya rabbi eliezer omer lereach nichoach i atta maale aval atta maale

a: Leshem etzim
Veha ika shirayim devae mechlinhu veika hach purta dela kametz ilaveh defarek leh
Defarek leh hecha i gavay ka meayyel chullin laazara i abbaray ipsil leh beotze leolam gavay chullin mimmela haveyan
Veha amar rabbi shimon en mitnaddevin shemen takkone gavra shane
Yatev rav rechumi kammeh ravina veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derav huna bar tachlifa venema asham ze yehe asham taluy
Shema minah man tanna diflig aleh derabbi eliezer rabbi shimon hu deamar en mitnaddevin asham taluy amar leh tora tora imre bedichre michallefi lach
Matni evre chattat shennitarvu beevre ola rabbi eliezer omer yitten lemala veroe ani et besar hachattat millemala keilu hen etzim vachachamim omrim teubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa
Gema may tama derabbi eliezer amar kera veel hammizbeach lo yaalu lereach nichoach lereach nichoach i atta maale aval atta maale leshem etzim
Verabbanan miet rachamana otam otam hu dei atta maale aval atta maale leshem etzim aval mide acharina la
Verabbi eliezer otam hu derabbay lach kevesh kemizbeach aval mide acharine la
Verabbanan tarte shema minah
Matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya amar rabbi yehuda lo nechleku rabbi eliezer vachachamim al evre chattat shennitarvu beevre ola sheyyikrevu berovea venirba shello yikrevu
Al ma nechleku al evre ola temima shennitarvu beevre baalat mum sherabbi eliezer omer yikrevu veroe ani lemala keilu hen etzim vachachamim omrim lo yikrevu
Verabbi eliezer may shena rovea venirba dela chazu baalat mum name la chaze
b: Amar rav huna bedukkin shebbaayin vealliba derabbi akiva deamar im alu lo yerdu emar deamar rabbi akiva dei avad lechattechilla mi amar
Amar rav pappa hacha bemay askinan kegon shealu al gabbe kevesh i hachi afilu beenayehu
Ella tameh derabbi eliezer miet rachamana mum bam hu delo yeratzu ha al yede taarovet yeratzu
Verabbanan mum bam hu delo yeratzu ha avar mum yeratzu verabbi eliezer mibbambahem verabbanan bambahem la darshi
I hachi roe ha rachamana achshereh ledivrehem kaamar lehu ledidi rachamana achshereh ledidchu odo li miha besar baalat mum keetzim dame mide dehave abbesar chattat
Verabbanan hacha meisi hatam la meisi

Matni evarin beevarin baale mumin rabbi eliezer omer im karav rosh echad mehen yikrevu kol harashin keraayim shel echad mehen yikrevu kal hakkeraayim vachachamim omrim afilu karvu kullam chutz meechad mehen yetze levet hasserefa
Gema amar rabbi elazar lo hichshir rabbi eliezer ella shenayim shenayim aval echad echad lo metiv rabbi yirmeya vachachamim omrim afilu karvu kullan chutz meechad mehen yetze levet hasserefa
Amar lo rabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa asberah lach may echad zug echad
Matni dam shennitarev bemayim im yesh bo marit dam kasher nitarev beyayin roin oto keilu hu mayim nitarev bedam behema o bedam hachayya roin oto keilu hu mayim

a: Rabbi yehuda omer en dam mevattel dam
Nitarev bedam pesulin yishshafech laamma bedam hattamtzit yishshafech laamma rabbi eliezer machshir im lo nimlach venatan kasher
Gema amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shennaflu mayim letoch dam aval nafal dam letoch mayim rishon rishon batel
Amar rav pappa ulinyan kisuy eno ken lefi sheen dichuy bemitzot
Amar resh lakish happigul vehannotar vehattame shebbelalan ze baze vaachalan patur i efshar shello yarbe min al chavero vivattelennu
Shema minah telat shema minah isurin mevattelin ze et ze ushma minah noten taam berov lav deorayeta ushma minah hatraat safek lo shemah hatraa
Metiv rava asa isa min chitin umin orez im yesh bah taam dagan chayyevet bechalla veaf al gav derubba orez
Midderabbanan i hachi ema sefa adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach
b: Ella min besheeno mino betama min bemino berubba
Unshaer min bemino kemin besheeno mino ditnan nitarev beyayin roin oto keilu hu mayim may lav roin oto layyayin keilu hu mayim
Lo roin oto laddam keilu hu mayim i hachi batel mibe leh
Veod tanya rabbi yehuda omer roin oto keilu hu yayin adom im deha marehu kasher
Veim lav pasul
Tannae hi detanya deli sheyyesh bo yayin lavan o chalav vehitbilo holchin achar harov rabbi yehuda omer roin oto keilu hu yayin adom im deha marehu kasher veim lav pasul
Urminhi deli shehu male rukkin vehitbilo keilu lo taval
Me raglayim roin oto keilu hen mayim
Male me chattat ad sheyyirbu hammayim al me chattat
Man shamatte leh deit leh roin rabbi yehuda vekatane desaggi leh berubba
Amar abbaye la kashya

a: Ha dideh ha derabbeh detanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabban gamliel en dam mevattel dam en rok mevattel rok veen me raglayim mevattelin me raglayim
Rava amar bidli shettocho tahor vegabbo tame askinan demiddina saggi lehu bechol dehu
Verabbanan hu digzaru behu dilma chayes alayehu vela mevattel leh vechevan deika ribuya la tzerich
Amar rava amur rabbanan betama vaamur rabbanan berubba vaamur rabbanan bachazuta min besheeno mino betama min bemino berubba hecha deika chazuta bemare
Ufliga derabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar keshem sheen mitzot mevattelot zo et zo kach en isurin mevattelin ze et ze
Man shamatte leh deamar en mitzot mevattelot zo et zo hillel hi detanya amru alav al hillel hazzaken shehaya korchan bevat achat veochlan mishshum shenneemar al matztzot umrorim yochluhu
b: Tanu rabbanan charsan shel zav vezava paam rishon vesheni tame shelishi tahor

Bamme devarim amurim shennatan letocho mayim aval lo natan letocho mayim afilu asiri tame rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer shelishi af al pi shello natan letocho mayim tahor man deshamatte leh deamar min bemino lo batel rabbi yehuda
Urminhu pishtan shettevaato nidda mesito tahor veim haya lach mesito tame mishshum mashke piha rabbi yehuda omer af harotvo bemayim tame mishshum mashke piha vaafilu tuva
Amar rav pappa shane rok dekarir
Nitarev bedam happesulin yishshafech laamma bemay kamipalgi
Amar rav zevid begozrin gezera bammikdash ka mipalgi demar savar gozrin umar savar la en gozrin
Rav pappa amar dechulle alma gozrin
Vehacha bedam hattamtzit matzuy lirbot al dam hannefesh ka mipalgi mar savar shechiach umar savar la shechiach
Bishlama lerav pappa hayenu dekatane nitarev bedam happesulin yishshafech laamma o bedam hattamtzit yishshafech laamma
Ella lerav zevid liarvinhu velitninhu kashya

Matni dam temimim bedam baale mumin yishshafech laamma kos bechosot rabbi eliezer omer im karav kos echad yikrevu kal hakkosot vachachamim omrim afilu karvu kullan chutz meechad mehen yishshafech laamma

Hannitanin lematta shennitarvu bannitanin lemala rabbi eliezer omer yitten lemala veroe ani et hattachtonim millemalan keilu hem mayim veyachazor veyitten lematta vachachamim omrim yishshafech laamma veim lo nimlach venatan kasher

a: Hannitanin bemattana achat shennitarvu bannitanin bemattana achat yinnatnu bemattana echat mehen mattan arba bemattan arba yinnatnu bemattan arba
Mattan arba bemattana achat rabbi eliezer omer yinnatnu bemattan arba rabbi yehoshua omer yinnatnu bemattana echat
Amar lo rabbi eliezer hare hu over al bal tigra amar leh rabbi yehoshua hare hu over al bal tosif

Amar lo rabbi eliezer lo neemar bal tosif ella keshehu beatzmo amar lo rabbi yehoshua lo neemar bal tigra ella keshehu beatzmo veod amar rabbi yehoshua keshennatatta avarta al bal tosif veasita maase beyadecha keshello natatta avarta al bal tigra lo asita maase beyadecha
Gema amar rabbi elazar lo hichshir rabbi eliezer ella shenayim shenayim aval echad echad la
Metiv rav dimi vachachamim omrim afilu karvu kullan chutz meechad mehen yishshafech leamma amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa asberah lach may echad zug echad
Utzricha dei itmar beha beha kaamar rabbi eliezer mishshum deitavid beh kapparato aval beha ema mode lehu lerabbanan
Vei itmar beha beha kaamri rabbanan aval beha ema modu lerabbi eliezer tzericha
Tenan hatam tzelochit shennaflu letochah mayim kol shehu rabbi eliezer omer yazze shette hazzaot vachachamim poslin
Bishlama rabbanan savri yesh bila vehazzaa tzericha shiur veen mitztarfin lehazzaot

Ella rabbi eliezer may kasavar i kasavar en bila ki mazze shette hazzaot may have dilma tarvayehu mayya ka mazze ella ka savar yesh bila i kasavar en hazzaa tzericha shiur lema li shette hazzaot ella kasavar hazzaa tzericha shiur vei kasavar en mitztarfin lehazzaot ki mazze shette hazzaot may have vei name mitztarfin lehazzaot mi yemar dimle leh shiura
Amar resh lakish leolam yesh bila vehazzaa tzericha shiur vehacha bemay askinan kegon shennitarvu achat beachat
Rava amar leolam yesh bila vehazzaa en tzericha shiur uknasa kenasu rabbanan ki hechi dela mishtaresh nishtaresh leh
Rav ashe amar en bila yazze shette hazzaot
Metivi rabbi omer ledivre rabbi eliezer hazzaa kol shehu metaheret hazzaa en tzericha shiur hazzaa mechetza kasher umechetza pasul
b: Veod tanya behedya hannitanin lemala shennitarvu bannitanin lematta rabbi eliezer omer yitten lemala vehattachtonim alu lo
Vei amratte en bila ammay alu lo dilma kayahev elonim lematta vehattachtonim lemala
Hacha bemay askinan kegon deika rubba elonim veka yahev lemala shiur tachtonim veod
Ha tachtonim alu lo katane leshem shirayim
Ta shema natan lematta velo nimlach rabbi eliezer omer yachazor veyitten lemala vehattachtonim alu lo
Hacha name berubba elonim veka yahev lemala shiur tachtonim veod veha tachtonim alu lo katane leshem shirayim
Ta shema netanan lemala velo nimlach ellu veellu modim sheyyachazor veyitten lematta veellu vaellu alu lo
Hacha name berubba elonim veka yahev lemala shiur tachtonim veod
Veha ellu vaellu alu lo katane mi katane ellu veellu modim ellu vaellu alu lo katane sefa atan lerabbanan deamri yesh bila

Ta shema hannitanin bemattana achat shennitarvu bannitanin bemattana achat yinnatnu bemattana echat vei amratte en bila ammay yinnatnu bemattana achat dilma mehay kayahev umehay la kayahev kegon shennitarvu achat beachat
Mattan arba bemattan arba hacha name shennitarvu arba bearba
Mattan arba bemattana achat

a: Vechi tema hacha name benitarev beachat i hachi amar lo rabbi yehoshua hare hu over al bal tosif hacha bal tosif mehecha
Ella amar rava bevalul la peligi ki peligi bechosot lerabbi eliezer it leh roin lerabbanan let lehu roin

Uvvalul la peligi vehatanya amar rabbi yehuda lo nechleku rabbi eliezer vachachamim al dam chattat shennitarev bedam ola sheyyikrav berovea venirba shello yikrav al ma nechleku al dam temima shennitarev bedam baalat mum sherabbi eliezer omer yikrav ben bevalul ben bechosot vachachamim omrim lo yikrav
Rabbi yehuda alliba derabbi eliezer matne ben bevalul ben bechosot verabbanan bechosot peligi
Amar abbaye lo shanu ella techillat chattat veola
Aval sof chattat veola divre hakkol mekom ola mekom shirayim amar leh rav yosef hachi amar rav yehuda shirayim tzerichin itzteva
Vechen amar rabbi shimon lo shanu ella techillat chattat veola aval sof chattat veola divre hakkol mekom ola mekom shirayim amar rabbi yochanan veitema rabbi elazar adayin hi machloket
Metiv rav huna bar yehuda kodesh hem sheim nitarev bedam kadashim acherim yikrevu may lav sof ola uvchor ushma minah mekom ola mekom shirayim la techilat ola uvchor
Umay ka mashma lan deen olin mevattelim ze et ze hay mivvelakach middam happar umiddam hassair nafka tannae hi ika denafka leh mehacha veika denafka leh mehacha
Metiv rava vehikrivu bene aharon et haddam vezarku et haddam ma
b: Talmud lomar dam dam sheyyachol en li ella ellu shennitarvu bitmuratah sheaf mechayyim tikrav minnayin lerabbot toda ushlamim
Merabbe ani toda ushlamim shebbain beneder undava kemotah minnayin lerabbot et haasham
Merabbe ani et haasham shettaun mattan arba kemoto bechor umaaser vafesach minnayin talmud lomar dam dam
May lav sof ola uvchor ushma minah mekom ola mekom shirayim
La techilat ola uvchor umay ka mashma lan en olin mevattelin ze et ze mivvelakach middam happar umiddam hassair nafka tannae hi ika denafka leh mehacha veika denafka leh mehacha
Vehane tannae mivvelakach middam happar umiddam hassair la yalfi kasavri en mearvin likranot middam dam la yalef dam dam la mashma lehu
Ella mikkodesh hem may tama la yalfi kasavri kodesh hem hem kerevin veen temuratan kereva
Veidach nafka leh meim shor im se la hu hu karev veen temurato kereva
Ta shema natan lemala velo nimlach ellu veellu modim sheyyachazor veyitten lematta ellu vaellu olin lo
May lav deiaruv chattat veola vechevan deyahev leh lemala hau lehu shirayim vekatane ellu veellu modim sheyyachazor veyitten lematta ushma minah mekom ola mekom shirayim
Ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef amar amri bemareva hacha bemay askinan kegon deiarav chattat hachitzona beshirayim
Amar leh abbaye venema mar kegon deiarav beshirayim dilma ha ka mashma lan afilu leman deamar shirayim meakkevin chasru en meakkevin
Amar leh rava tosfaa leravina ha okemna hahi berubba elonim veka yahev lemala shiur tachtonim veod amar leh hane mile leman deamru meikara en bila massekana bechosot peligi
Matni hannitanin bifnim shennitarvu benitanin bachutz yishshafchu laamma natan bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim kasher

Bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz rabbi akiva posel vachachamim machshirim sherabbi akiva omer kol damim shennichnesu lechapper bahechal pesulin vachachamim omrim chattat bilvad rabbi eliezer omer af haasham shenneemar kachattat kaasham
Gema veniflog name rabbi eliezer beha
Hechi lebed nitev bachutz vahadar nitev lifnim keshem shemmitzva lehakdim elonim lattachtonim kach mitzva lehakdim penim lachutz

a: Venitev lefanim vahadar nitev lachutz kevan deika chattat veasham dechi nichnas daman pesulin la pesika leh

Shehaya rabbi akiva omer vechu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mashal lema haddavar dome letalmid shemmazag lerabbo bechammin veamar lo mezog li amar lo bamme amar lo lo bechammin anu asukin achshav ben bechammin ben betzonen
Hacha name mikkedi bechattat askinan veate chattat dichtav rachamana lema li ella lav chattat kaamena lah ella kol kadashim
Matkef lah rav huna bereh derav yehoshua mikkede itrabbo kol kadashim legabbe mizbeach leinyan merika ushtifa chattat dichtav rachamana lema li shema minah chattat in mide acharina la
Veha la damya ella letalmid shemmazag lerabbo ben bechammin ben betzonen amar lo al timzog li ella chammin

Ella tama derabbi akiva mechattat vechol chattat detanya chattat en li ella chattat kodshe kadashim minnayin talmud lomar kol chattat kadashim kallim minnayin talmud lomar vechol chattat divre rabbi akiva

Amar lo rabbi yose haggelili afilu atta merabbe kol hayyom kullo eni shomea lecha ella chattat en li ella chattat yachid chattat tzibbur minnayin talmud lomar kol chattat veen li ella chattat zachar chattat nekeva minnayin talmud lomar vechol
Kelappe leya ella hachi kaamar en li ella chattat nekeva chattat zachar minnayin talmud lomar vechol chattat
Vesavar rabbi yose haggelili hay kera lehachi hu daata vehatanya rabbi yose haggelili omer lefi shemmatzinu kol hainyan kullo eno medabber ella befarim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim
Lisrof pesulehen abbet habbira velaamod belo taase al achilato
Amru lo chattat shennichnas damah lifnay velifnim minnayin amar lahem hen lo huva
Lidvarav derabbi akiva kaamar
Matni chattat shekkibbel dama bishne kosot yatza echad mehen lachutz happenimi kasher nichnas echad mehem lifnim rabbi yose haggelili machshir bachitzon vachachamim poslin
Amar rabbi yose haggelili ma im bemakom shehammachshava poselet bachutz lo asa et hamshuyyar kayyotze makom sheen hammachshava poselet bifnim eno din shello naase et hamshuyyar kannichnas
Nichnas lechapper af al pi shello kipper pasul divre rabbi eliezer rabbi shimon omer ad sheyechapper rabbi yehuda omer im hichnis shogeg kasher
Kal haddamim pesulin shennetano al gabbe hammizbeach lo hirtza hatztzitz ella al hattame shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame veeno meratztze al hayyotze

Gema tanya amar rabbi yose haggelili kal vachomer uma bimkom shemmachshava poselet bachutz lo pasal dam shebbachutz et shebbifnim mekom sheen machshava poselet bifnim eno din shello yifsol dam shebbifnim et shebbachutz
Amru lo hare hu omer asher yuva middamah afilu miktzat damah

Amar lahem kal vachomer layyotze meatta uma bimkom sheen machshava poselet bifnim posel dam shebbifnim et shebbachutz mekom shemmachshava poselet bachutz eno din sheyyifsol dam shebbachutz et shebbifnim
Amru lo hare hu omer asher yuva hannichnas posel veen hayyotze posel

Uthe machshava bifnim poselet mikkal vechomer uma bimkom shello pasal dam shebbachutz et shebbifnim machshava poselet bachutz mekom sheppasal dam shebbifnim et dam shebbachutz eno din shettehe machshava poselet bifnim
Hare hu omer bayyom hashshelishi
b: Makom sheyehe meshullash bedam bevasar beemurim

Velo tehe machshava poselet bachutz mikkal vachomer uma mekom sheppasal dam shebbifnim et shebbachutz en machshava poselet bifnim mekom shello pasal dam shebbachutz et shebbefanim eno din shello yehe posel machshava bachutz
Talmud lomar shelishi chutz lizmanno piggul chutz limkomo
Basar hayyotze lachutz pasul hannichnas lifnim kasher
Sheyehe baddin sheppasul uma bimkom shello pasal dam shebbachutz et shebbifnim basar hayyotze lachutz pasul mekom sheppasal dam shebbifnim et shebbachutz basar hannichnas bifnim eno din sheyyifsol
Hare hu omer middamah damah velo besarah
Kal vachomer meatta uma bimkom sheppasal dam shebbifnim et shebbachutz basar hannichnas lefanim kasher makom shello pasal dam shebbachutz et shebbifnim basar hayyotze lachutz eno din shekkasher
Hare hu omer uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu kevan sheyyatza basar chutz limchitzato neesar
Tanu rabbanan penima en li ella penima hechal minnayin talmud lomar el hakkodesh penima
Veyomar kodesh veal veyomar penima amar rava ba ze velimed al ze mide dehave attoshav vesachir
Detanya toshav ze kanuy kinyan olam sachir ze kanuy kinyan shanim
Yomar toshav veal yomar sachir vaani omer kanuy kinyan olam eno ochel kanuy kinyan shanim lo kol shekken
Ilu ken hayiti omer toshav ze kanuy kinyan shanim aval kenuy kinyan olam yehe ochel ba sachir velimed al toshav shezze kanuy kinyan olam veze kanuy kinyan shanim veeno ochel

Amar leh abbaye bishlama hatam tere gufe ninhu veaf al gav dahava leh likra lemichtav nirtza lo yochal veidach ate bekal vachomer milta deatya bekal vachomer tarach vechatav lah kera ella hacha kevan deika deipsel behechal hacha lifnay velifnim may bae
Ella amar abbaye lo nitzrecha ella lederech meshuppash amar leh rava veha havaa ketiv beh ella amar rava kol mide dechashshev aleh lifnay velifnim la mipsel behechal
Bae rava par helem davar shel tzibbur usir avoda zara shehichnis daman lifnay velifnim mahu
Mi amrinan el hakkodesh penima kol hecha dekarenan el hakkodesh karenan leh penima kol hecha dela karenan el hakkodesh la karenan penima o dilma shello bimkoman hu
Veim timtze lomar shello bimkoman hu par vesair shel yom hakkipurim shehizza middaman al habbaddim vehotzian lahechal vehichnisan mahu
Mi amrinan mekoman hu o dilma hoil unfak nefak
Veim timtze lomar hoil unfak nefak hizza middaman al happarochet

a: Vehotzio lammizbeach vehichnisan mahu
Hacha vadday chad makom hu o dilma yetzia karena beh teku
Nichnas lechapper tanya rabbi eliezer omer neemar kan lechapper bakkodesh veneemar lehallan vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed bevoo lechapper bakkodesh
Ma lehallan beshello kiper af kan beshello kiper
Rabbi shimon omer neemar kan lechapper veneemar lehallan veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat asher huva et damam lechapper ma lehallan beshekkiper af kan beshekkiper
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar danin chutz michutz veen danin chutz mibbifnim
Umar savar danin behema mibbehema veen danin behema meadam
Rabbi yehuda omer ku ha mezid pasul beshekkiper o beshello kiper
Amar rabbi yirmeya mimmashma shenneemar veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat asher huva et damam el ohel moed lechapper bakkodesh ma talmud lomar vehassoref
Ma talmud lomar vehassoref legufeh itzterich ella ma talmud lomar chattat chattat
Lefi shello lamadnu ella lefar vesair shel yom hakkippurim shennisrafin abbet haddeshen metammein begadim shear nisrafin minnayin talmud lomar chattat chattat divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi meir omer eno tzarich hare hu omer veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat sheen talmud lomar lechapper ma talmud lomar lechapper limed al kol hammitkapperim shehassorfan metamme begadim
Verabbi yehuda lechapper la mashma leh may tama lav mishshum demibaya leh ligzera shava
Hadaran alach kol hazzevachim shennitarvu
Matni hammizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo
Rabbi yehoshua omer kol harauy laishim im ala lo yered shenneemar hi haola al mokda ma ola shehi reuya laishim im alta lo tered af kol shehu rauy laishim im ala lo yered

Rabban gamliel omer kol harauy lammizbeach im ala lo yered shenneemar hi haola al mokda al hammizbeach ma ola shehi reuya lammizbeach im alta lo tered af kol davar shehu rauy lammizbeach im alta lo tered
En ben divre rabban gamliel ledivre rabbi yehoshua ella haddam vehannesachim sherabban gamliel omer lo yerdu verabbi yehoshua omer yerdu
Rabbi shimon omer hazzevach kasher unsachim pesulin hannesachim kesherim vehazzevach pasul afilu ze vaze pesulin hazzevach lo yered vehannesachim yerdu
b: Gema rauy lo in sheen rauy lo la lemaote may amar rav pappa lemaote kematzin shello kidshu bichli
Matkef lah ravina may shena middeulla deamar ulla emure kadashim kallin sheheelan lifne zerikat daman lo yerdu naasu lachmo shel mizbeach
Hanach la michasseru maase begufayehu hane michasseru maase begufayehu
Rabbi yehoshua omer kol harauy laishim ku verabban gamliel name hachtiv ola al mokda hahu leahdore pokin hu daata
Veidach leahdore pokin mena leh nafka leh measher tochal haesh

Veidach hahu mibe leh leikkule ola atta machazir vei atta machazir ikkule ketoret detane rabbi chanina bar minome berabbi eliezer ben yaakov asher tochal haesh et haola al hammizbeach ikkule ola atta machazir vei atta machazir ikkule ketoret
Veidach lav mimmela shamatte minah deikkule ola mehadderinan
Rabban gamliel omer kol harauy ku verabbi yehoshua name hachtiv mizbeach hahu mibaya leh may tama kaamar rachamana kol harauy lemokda mekaddesh mizbeach
Veidach mizbeach acharina ketiv veidach chad lehecha dehayeta lah sheat hakkosher vechad lehecha delo hayeta lah sheat hakkosher
Veidach kevan difsulin ninhu verabbinhu rachamana la shena hayeta lo sheat hakkosher la shena lo hayeta lo sheat hakkosher
Rabbi shimon omer hazzevach kasher ku tanya rabbi shimon omer ola ma ola habbaa biglal atzmah af kol habbain biglal atzman yatzu nesachim habbain biglal zevach

Rabbi yose haggelili omer mittoch shenneemar kol hannogea bammizbeach yikdash shomea ani ben rauy uven sheeno rauy talmud lomar kevasim ma kevasim reuyin af kol rauy rabbi akiva omer ola ma ola reuya af kol reuya
May benayehu amar rav adda bar ahava olat haof pesula ika benayehu mar mayete lah meola umar mayete lah mikkevasim
Ulman demayete lah mikkevasim hachtiv ola i ketiv kevasim vela ketiv ola hava amena afilu mechayyim ketav rachamana ola
Ulman demayete leh meola ha ketiv kevasim i ketiv ola vela ketiv kevasim hava amena afilu mincha ketav rachamana kevasim
May ika ben hane tannae lehane tannae dematnitin amar rav pappa kematzim shekkadshu bichli ika benayehu letannae didan lo yerdu letannae dematnita yerdu
Resh lakish amar mincha habbaa bifne atzmah ledivre kullan lo tered ledivre rabbi yose haggelili verabbi akiva

a: Tered mincha habbaa im hazzevach ledivre rabban gamliel verabbi yehoshua lo tered ledivre kullan tered
Nesachim habbain bifne atzman ledivre kullan yerdu ledivre rabban gamliel verabbi shimon lo yerdu nesachin habbain im hazzevach ledivre kullan yerdu ledivre rabban gamliel lechodeh lo yerdu
Peshita mincha habbaa bifne atzmah itztericha leh vechidrava deamar rava mitnaddev adam minchat nesachim bechol yom
Venashmeinan kidrava nesachim habbaim im hazzevach itztericha leh deka makrev lehu limchar uloma chara
Salka datach amena hoil veamar mar minchatam veniskehem ballayela minchatam veniskehem lemachar kinsachim habbain bifne atzman damu umode rabbi shimon delo yerdu ka mashma lan
Matni ellu im alu lo yerdu hallan vehayyotze vehattame veshennishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damo

Rabbi yehuda omer shennishchat ballayela venishpach damah veyatza damah chutz lakkelaim im alta tered rabbi shimon omer lo tered shehaya pesulo bakkodesh sherabbi shimon omer kol sheppesulo bakkodesh hakkodesh mekabbelo lo haya pesulo bakkodesh en hakkodesh mekabbelo

Veellu shello haya pesulan bakkodesh harovea vehannirba vehammuktze vehanneevad vehaetnan vehammechir vehakkilayim vehatterefa vehayyotze dofen uvaale mumin rabbi akiva machshir bevaale mumin rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer doche haya abba et baale mumin meal gabbe hammizbeach

Keshem sheim alu lo yerdu kach im yerdu lo yaalu vechullan shealu chayyim lerosh hammizbeach yerdu ola shealta chayya lerosh hammizbeach tered shechatah berosh hammizbeach yafshit vinattecheha bimkomah
Gema tanya rabbi yehuda omer zot hi haola hare ellu shelosha miutin perat leshennishchata ballayela veshennishpach damah vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim sheim alta tered

Rabbi shimon omer ola en li ella ola keshera minnayin lerabbot shennishchata ballayela veshennishpach damah vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim vehallan vehayyotze vehattame veshennishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damo
Hannitanin lematta shennetanan lemala ulmala shennetanan lematta vehannitanin bachutz shennetanan bifnim bifnim shennetanan bachutz
Ufesach vechattat sheshshechatan shello lishman minnayin talmud lomar torat haola riba tora achat lechol haolin sheim alu lo yerdu
Yachol sheani merabbe harovea vehannirba vehammuktze vehanneevad veetnan umchir vechilayim utrefa veotze dofen talmud lomar zot
Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulhotzi et ellu achar sheriba
b: Hakkatuv umiet merabbe ani et ellu shehaya pesulan bakkodesh umotzi ani et ellu shello haya pesulan bakkodesh
Verabbi yehuda mayete lah mehacha mippene ma amru lan baddam kasher
Shehare lan kasher baemurin lan baemurin kasher shehare lan kasher babbasar
Yotze shehayyotze kasher bevama
Tame hoil vehuttar laavodat tzibur
Chutz lizmanno hoil umratztze lefigulo
Chutz limkomo hoil veitakkash lechutz lizmanno
Shekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damo behanach pesule dachazo laavodat tzibur
Vechi danin davar shello behechshero middavar shebbehechshero
Tanna azzot torat haola riba semich leh
Amar rabbi yochanan hashshochet behema ballayela bifnim veheela bachutz chayyav

a: Lo tehe pechuta mishshochet bachutz umaale bachutz
Metiv rav chiyya bar avin hashshochet of bifnim umaale bachutz patur shochet bachutz umaale bachutz chayyav nema lo tehe pechuta mishshochet umaale bachutz
Teuvta ibaet ema shechitat haof bifnim miktal katleh
Amar ulla emure kadashim kallim sheheelan lifne zerikat daman lo yerdu naasu lachmo shel mizbeach
Amar rabbi zera af anan name tenena shennishpach damah vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim uma hatam deim ba lizrok en lo lizrok amarta im alu lo yerdu hacha deim ba lizrok zorek lo kol shekken
Targemah akkodshe kadashim
Hare pesach dekadashim kallim hu targemah beshello lishman
Tenan vechullan shealu chayyin legabbe mizbeach yerdu ha shechutin lo yerdu may lav la shena kodshe kadashim la shena kadashim kallim
La ha shechutin mehen yerdu mehen lo yerdu veha kullan katane kullam achayyin
Peshita leolam achayyin uvdukkin shebbaayin vealliba derabbi akiva deamar im alu lo yerdu

Bemay okemtah bifsulin ema sefa vechen ola shealta chayya lerosh hammizbeach tered shechatah berosh hammizbeach yafshit vinatteach bimkomah vei pesula bat hefshet venittuach hi venittach otah amar rachamana otah keshera vela pesula
Sefa atan lichshera umay kamashma lan deyesh hefshet venittuach berosh hammizbeach
