Ulman deamar en hefshet venittuach berosh hammizbeach may ika lememar hacha bemay askinan kegon shehayeta lo sheat hakkosher venifsela verabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi deamar kevan shennizrak haddam vehurtza basar shaa achat yafshitenna veorah lakkohanim
Veella dekatane ketzad ose morid et hakkeravayim lematta umaddichan lema li
Hechi naaved nakrevinhu befirtayehu hakrivehu na lefechatecha hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha
Anan hachi kaamrinan maddichan lema li dei mitreme kohen acharina vela yada nassekinhu
b: Vaanan neku nebed lehu lechohanim milta deatu bah lide takkala afilu hachi adifa shello yehu kodshe shamayim mutalim kinvela
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba bae rabbi yochanan emure kadashim kallim sheheelan lifne zerikat daman yerdu o lo yerdu
Amar leh rabbi amme vetibe lach meila amar leh meila la kamibaya li dizrika hu dekava lehu bimila ki kamibaya leh yerida ufashet lo yerdu veen bahen meila

Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne hachi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba bae rabbi yochanan emure kadashim kallim sheheelan lifne zerikat daman yesh bahen meila o la amar leh rabbi amme vetibe lach yerida amar leh yerida la ka mibaya li denaasu lachmo shel mizbeach ki kamibaya li meila ufashet hachi lo yerdu veen bahen meila
Veellu lo haya pesulan vechu
Amar rabbi yochanan lo hichshir rabbi akiva ella bedukkin shebbaayin hoil uchsherim baofot vehu shekkadam hekdeshan et muman umode rabbi akiva beolat nekeva dichshekkadam mumah lehekdeshah damya
Bae rabbi yirmeya yesh nirba baofot o en nirba baofot mi amar min habbehema lehotzi et harovea vehannirba
Kol hecha deiteh berovea iteh benirba kol hecha deleteh berovea leteh benirba o dilma hare neevda bo avera
Amar rabba ta shema rabbi akiva machshir bevaale mumin veim ita nachsher name benirba hoil vechasher baofot shema minah
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak af anan name tenena hannirba vehammuktze vehanneevad veetnan umchir vetumtum veanderoginos kullan metammein begadim abbet habbelia shema minah
Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim ku may ka mashma lan ibaet ema maase ka mashma lan veibaet ema may doche kilachar yad
Keshem sheim ala ku amar ulla lo shanu ella shello mashla bahen haur aval mashla bahen haur yaalu

Rav mari matne aresha rav chanina missura matne assefa haatzamot vehaggidin vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim bizman shemmechubbarin yaalu pershu lo yaalu amar ulla lo shanu ella shello mashla bahen haur aval mashla bahen haur yaalu
Man dematne assefa kol shekken aresha uman dematne aresha aval assefa lav bene haktara ninhu
Matni veellu im alu yerdu besar kodshe kadashim uvsar kadashim kallim umotar haomer ushte hallechem velechem happanim ushyare menachot vehakketoret

Hatztzemer shebberashe chevasim vesear shebbizkan teyashim vehaatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim bizman shehem mechubbarim yaalu shenneemar vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol pershu lo yaalu shenneemar veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam
Gema tanu rabbanan vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha lerabbot haatzamot vehaggidim vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim yachol afilu pershu talmud lomar veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam
I basar vadam

a: Yachol yachlotz gidin vaatzamot veyaale basar legabbe mizbeach talmud lomar vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol ha ketzad mechubbarin yaalu pershu afilu hen berosh hammizbeach yerdu
Man tanna deshamatte leh deamar pershu yardu rabbi hi detanya vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha lerabbot haatzamot vehaggidin vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim afilu pershu
Veella ma ani mekayyem veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam lomar lach ikule ola atta machazir vei atta machazir ikule gidin vaatzamot

Rabbi omer katuv echad omer vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha riba vechatuv echad omer veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam miet ha ketzad mechubbarin yaalu pershu afilu hen berosh hammizbeach yerdu
Pershu lo yaalu vechu amar rabbi zera lo shanu ella sheppershu kelappe matta aval kelappe mala karove hu deakrivu leikul vaafilu pershu
Amar rabba hachi kaamar lo shanu ella sheppershu leachar zerika aval pershu kodem zerika atay zerika ushritinhu afilu lemebad minayehu kattata desakkine
Savar lah ki ha deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael neemar lo yihye beola veneemar lo yihye beasham ma asham atzmotav muttarin af ola atzmoteha muttarin
Mufne dei la mufne ika lemifrach ma leasham shekken besaro muttar lo yihye yattira ketiv
Metiv rav adda bar ahava atzmot kadashim lifne zerika moalin bahen
Leachar zerika en moalin bahen veshel ola moalin bahen leolam
Ema veshel ola pershu lifne zerika en moalin bahen leachar zerika moalin bahen leolam
Ufliga derabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar pershu lifne zerika moalin bahem leachar zerika lo nehenin velo moalin

Matni vechullan sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach lo yachzir vechen gachelet sheppaka meal gabbe hammizbeach lo yachazir evarim sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach kodem chatzot yachzir umoalin bahen leachar chatzot lo yachzir veen moalin bahem
Keshem shehammizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo kach hakkevesh mekaddesh keshem shehammizbeach vehakkevesh mekaddeshin et harauy lahen kach hakkelim mekaddeshin
Gema hechi dame i deit behu mammash afilu leachar chatzot name i delet behu mammash afilu kodem chatzot name la la tzericha
b: Bishrire mena hane mile
Amar rav katuv echad omer kol hallayela vehiktir vechatuv echad omer kol hallayela veherim
Challekehu chetzo lehaktara vechetzo laharama

Metiv rav kahana bechol yom torem et hammizbeach mikkerot haggever o samuch lo millefanav o meacharav beom hakkipurim bachatzot bargalim baashmoret harishona vei salka datach mechatzot deorayeta hechi makdeminan vehechi meacharinan
Ella amar rabbi yochanan mimmashma shenneemar kol hallayela eni yodea shead habboker ma talmud lomar ad boker ten boker levokro shel layela

Hilkach kol yoma mikkerot haggever saggi beom hakkipurim mishshum chulsha dechohen gadol mechatzot birgalim dinfishi korbanot dekadmi atu yisrael meashmoret harishona kidkatane sefa lo hayeta keriyyat haggever maggaat ad shehayeta azara melea miyyisrael
Itmar pershu kodem chatzot vehechziran achar chatzot rabba amar

a: Chatzot sheni ochaltan rav chisda amar ammud hashshachar ochaltan
Amri be rav may tama derav chisda uma chatzot sheen ose lina ose ikul ammud hashshachar sheose lina eno din sheose ikul
Pershu kodem chatzot vehechziran leachar ammud hashshachar rabba amar chatzot sheni ochaltan rav chisda amar en bahen ikul leolam
Matkef lah rav yosef uman lema lan dachatzot berosh hammizbeach meshavveya lehu ikul dilma kol hecha demashkecha lehu meshavveya lehu ikul shelachu mittam hilcheta kerav yosef
Itmar name amar rabbi chiyya bar abba pershu kodem chatzot vehechziran achar chatzot lo nehenin velo moalin vechen tana bar kappara pershu kodem chatzot vehechziran leachar chatzot yotzin mide meila
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye vechi meachar dishlachu mittam hilcheta kerav yosef veamar rabbi chiyya bar abba vechen tane bar kappara rabba verav chisda bemay peligi amar leh bishmenim
Bea mineh rava merabba lina moelet berosho shel mizbeach o enah moelet berosho shel mizbeach hechi dame ilema delo yardu hashta lanu baazara amratte delo yerdu berosho shel mizbeach mibaya
Veella deyardu leshulchan medammenan lah ditnan afilu hen al hashshulchan yamim rabbim en bechach kelum o dilma lekarka medammenan
Amar leh en lina berosho shel mizbeach kiblah mineh o la ta shema deitmar evarim shellanu baazara mekatter veholech kol hallayela lan berosho shel mizbeach mekatter veholech leolam
Yardu rabba amar yaalu rava amar lo yaalu shema minah la kablah mineh shema minah
Keshem shehammizbeach mekaddesh ku tanu rabbanan hannogea bemizbeach en li ella mizbeach kevesh minnayin talmud lomar et hammizbeach kele sharet minnayin talmud lomar kol hannogea bahem yikdash
Bea mineh resh lakish merabbi yochanan kele sharet mahu sheyekaddeshu et happesulin amar leh tenetuha keshem shehammizbeach vehakkevesh mekaddeshin et harauy lahen kach kelim mekaddeshin
Amar leh lechattechila likrav kamibe li ha name tenena
b: Shekkiblu pesulin vezarku et damo may lav shekkiblu pesulin vezarku pesulin
Lo shekkiblu pesulin i name shezzarku pesulin
Avir mizbeach kemizbeach dame o la ta shema keshem shehammizbeach mekaddesh kach kevesh mekaddesh
Vei amratte avir mizbeach lav kammizbeach dame avir kevesh name lav kechevesh dame hechi massek leh mikkevesh lemizbeach have leh yarud
Denaged leh veha avir yesh ben kevesh lammizbeach rubbo lakkevesh kakkevesh rubbo lammizbeach kammizbeach
Tifshot meha ha devae rame bar chama yesh chibur leolin o la tifshot deyesh chibur ha la kashya tifshot
Matkef lah rava bar rav chanan vei amratte avir mizbeach kammizbeach dame olat haof defasla bemachshava hechi mashkachatte lah
Ha kaltah mizbeach
Matkef lah rav shimi bar ashe allema la mashkachatte lah kegon deamar hareni molkah al menat lehoridah lemachar ulhaalotah ulhaktirah
Hanicha lerava deamar lina moelet berosh hammizbeach ella lerabba deamar en lina moelet berosh hammizbeach leta lemachshavto
Lerabba name mashkachatte lah kegon deamar hareni molkah al menat lehoridah kodem ammud hashshachar ulhaalotah leachar ammud hashshachar
Lehach gisa miha tifshot daavir mizbeach kemizbeach dame dei salka datach avir mizbeach lav kemizbeach dame

a: Chattat haof pesula hechi mazze middamah have leh yarud shear pesulim hechi zarek lehu middamah
Demagga lehu ha hazzaa hi mitzuy hi ha zerika sheficha hi
Veod derech hazzaa bechach derech zerika bechach
Amar rav ashe i denaket lehu berosh hammizbeach hachi name ki kaamar ditlanhu bekanya may teku

Matni kele hallach mekaddeshin et hallach umiddot yavesh mekaddeshot et hayyavesh en keli hallach mekaddeshet et hayyavesh velo yavesh mekaddesh et hallach kele hakkodesh shennikvu im osin bahen meen melachtan shehau osin vehen shelemim mekaddeshin veim lav en mekaddeshin vechullan en mekaddeshin ella bakkodesh
Gema amar shemuel lo shanu ella middot aval mizrakot mekaddeshin shenneemar shenehem meleim solet
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina mincha lacha hi amar leh lo nitzrecha ella layyavesh shebbah ibaet ema mincha legabbe dam keyavesh dame
Amar shemuel kele sharet en mekaddeshin ella shelemin en mekaddeshin ella melein en mekaddeshin ella mittochan veamri lah en mekaddeshin ella shelemin umleim umibbifnim
May benayehu ika benayehu berutze middot bematnita tana en mekaddeshin ella shelemin umleim umittochan uvifnim
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella sheen dato lehosif aval dato lehosif rishon rishon kodesh
Tanya name hachi melein en melein ella shelemin amar rabbi yose ematay bizman sheen dato lehosif aval dato lehosif rishon rishon kodesh
En keli hallach mekaddesh vechu amar rav veitema rav assi en mekaddeshin likrav aval mekaddeshin lipasel

Ika dematne lah aha en meviin menachot unsachim uminchat behema uvikurim min hamdumma veen tzarich lomar meorla vechile hakkerem veim hevi lo kiddesh amar rav veitema rav assi lo kiddesh likrav aval kadash lipasel

Tanu rabbanan kele kodesh shennikvu en mattichin otan veen mattichin letochan avar nifgemu en metakkenin otan sakkin shennifgema en mashchizin et pegimatah nishmeta en machzirin otah abba shaul omer sakkin matrefet hayeta bammikdash venimnu aleha kohanim ugnazuha
Tanu rabbanan bigde chehunna en osin otam maase machat ella maase oreg shenneemar maase oreg nitgaalu en mechabbesin otan lo beneter velo beahal
Ha bammayim mechabbesin amar abbaye hachi kaamar huggeu bemayim mechabbesin otan beneter veahal
b: Huggeu leneter veahal af bemayim en mechabbesim veyesh omrim en mechabbesin otan kol ikar sheen aniyyut bimkom ashirut

Tanu rabbanan meil kullo shel techelet haya shenneemar vayyaas et meil haefod kelil techelet shulav ketzad mevi techelet veargaman vetolaat shani shezurin veose otan kemin rimonim shello pitchu pihen uchmin konaot shel kenasot shebberashe tinokot

Umevi shivim ushnayim zaggin shebbahen shivim ushnayim inbalin vetole bahen sheloshim veshishsha betzad ze ushloshim veshishsha mitztzad ze rabbi dosa omer mishshum rabbi yehuda sheloshim veshishsha hau shemone esre mitztzad ze ushmone esre mitztzad ze
Amar rabbi inyoni bar sason kemachloket kan kach machloket bemarot negaim ditnan marot negaim rabbi dosa ben harkinas omer sheloshim veshishsha akavya ben mahalalel omer shivim ushnayim
Veamar rabbi inyoni bar sason lamma nismecha parashat korbanot lefarashat bigde chehunna lomar lach ma korbanot mechapperin af bigde chehunna mechapperin

Ketonet mechapperet al shefichut damim shenneemar vayyishchatu seir izzim vayyitbelu et hakkuttonet baddam michnasayim mechapperet al giluy araot shenneemar vaase lahem michnese vad lechassot et besar erva mitznefet mechapperet al gasse haruach minnayin amar rabbi chanina yavo davar shebbaggovah vichapper al govah
Avnet mechapper al hirhur hallev hecha deiteh choshen mechapper al haddinin shenneemar veasita choshen mishpat efod mechapper al avoda zara shenneemar en efod utrafim

Meil mechapper al lashon hara minnayin amar rabbi chanina yavo davar shebbakkol vichapper al kol hara vetzitz mechapper al azzut panim betzitz ketiv vehaya al metzach aharon uvazzut panim ketiv umetzach ishsha zona haya lach
Ini veha amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi shene devarim lo matzinu lahen kappara bekorbanot umatzinu lahen kappara mimmakom acher veellu hen shefichut damim velashon hara
Shefichut damim meegla arufa velashon hara mikketoret detane rav chananya minnayin liktoret shemmechapperet shenneemar vayyitten et hakketoret vayechapper al haam
Vetane deve rabbi yishmael al ma ketoret mechapperet al lashon hara yavo davar shebbachashay vichapper al maase chashay
Kashya lashon hara allashon hara kashya shefichut damim ashshefichut damim
La kashya ha didia man katleh ha dela yedia man katleh i didia man katleh bar ketala hu bemezid vela atro beh
Velashon hara allashon hara name la kashya ha betzina ha befarhesya
Hadaran alach hammizbeach mekaddesh

a: Matni kol hattadir mechavero kodem et chavero hattemidin kodmin lemusafin musfe shabbat kodmin lemusfe rosh chodesh musfe rosh chodesh kodmin lemusfe rosh hashshana shenneemar millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid taasu et elle
Gema mena lan mena lan kidkaamar tama millevad olat habboker dilma temidin hen dekadmi lemusafin mishshum ditdiri musafin lemusafin mena lan
Amar rabbi ila deamar kera kaelle taasu layyom shivat yamim elle kaelle
Vehay mibe leh legufeh im ken nichtov elle taasu layyom
I ketav elle taasu layyom shivat hayyamim hava amena elle leshivat hayyamim in mide acharina la layyom ketiv
Veakkatti ema elle layyom aval shear yome la yadana kamma amar kera taasu sheyehu kol haasiyyot shaot
Abbaye amar miggufah dikra im ken lema kera millevad olat habboker vetishtok asher leolat hattamid lema li lememar dehach ditdira tikdom
Matni kol hamkuddash mechavero kodem et chavero dam hachattat kodem ledam haola mippene shehu meratztze evre ola kodmin leemure chattat mippene shehu kalil laishim

Chattat kodemet leasham mippene sheddamah nitan learba keranot al hayesod asham kodem letoda veel nazir mippene shehu kodshe kadashim toda veel nazir kodmim lishlamim mippene shehen neechalin leom echad utunin lechem
Hashshelamim kodmin labbechor mippene shehen teunin mattan arba usmicha unsachim utnufot chaze vashok habbechor kodem lammaaser mippene shekkedushshato merechem veneechal lakkohanim

Hammaaser kodem laofot mippene shehu zevach veyesh bo kodesh kodashim damu veemurav haofot kodmin lammenachot mippene shehen mine damim minchat chote kodemet leminchat nedava mippene shehu ba al chet chattat haof kodemet leolat haof vechen behekdeshah
b: Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ufar sheni ven bakar tikkach lechattat

Im ba lelammed shehen shenayim hare kevar neemar vaase et haechad chattat veet haechad ola ma talmud lomar ufar sheni ven bakar tikkach lechattat sheyyachol sheyehe chattat kodemet lechol maase ola talmud lomar ufar sheni ven bakar tikkach lechattat
I par sheni yachol tehe ola kodemet lechattat lechol maaseha talmud lomar vaase et haechad chattat veet haechad ola ha ketzad dam chattat kodemet ledam ola mippene shemmeratztza evre ola ku
Veammay mattana kammayeta dimchappera tikdom vehanach la
Amar ravina hacha bechattat halviyyim askinan veaf al gav dechi ola dame kaamar rachamana hi tikdom bemareva amri hoil vehitchil bemattanot gomer
Ibaya lehu dam chattat veevre ola eze mehen kodem dam chattat kodem mippene shemmeratztze o dilma evre ola kodmin mippene shehen kalil laishim
Ta shema dam chattat kodem ledam ola ledam ola hu dekadem leevre ola la kadem
Adderabba missefa evre ola kodmin leemure chattat leemure chattat hu dekadem ledam chattat la kadem ella meha leka lemishma minah
Ibaya lehu dam ola veemure chattat eze mehen kodem dam ola kodem dekaate mikkoach kalil o dilma emure chattat kodmin dekaate dekaatu mikkoach mechapper
Ta shema dam chattat kodem ledam ola dam chattat hu dekadem ledam ola aval emure chattat la
Adderabba missefa evre ola kodmin leemure chattat evre ola hu dekadmi leemure chattat aval dam ola la ella meha leka lemishma minah
Ibaya lehu dam ola vedam asham eze mehen kodem dam ola kodem dekaate mikkoach kalil o dilma dam asham kodem dekaate mikkoach dimchapper
Ta shema dam chattat kodem ledam ola aval dam asham la
Bedin hu deibi lemitne dam asham veayede diva lemitne sefa evre ola kodmin leemure chattat
Dei tena leemure asham hava amena leemure asham hu dekadmi leemure chattat la kadmi mishshum hachi tena chattat
Ta shema chattat kodem leasham chattat hu dekadma leh leasham aval ola la may lav dam
La aemurim dayeka name dekatane mippene sheddamah nitan shema minah
Chattat kodemet ku adderabba asham kadem shekken yesh lo kitzva afilu hachi ribuy demizbeach adif
Asham kodem letoda ku adderabba hattoda veel nazir kadmi shekken teunin lechem afilu hachi kodshe kadashim adifi
Toda veel nazir ku adderabba shelamim kadmi shekken yeshnan betzibur kivyachid afilu hachi neechalin leom echad adifi

Ibaya lehu toda veel nazir eze mehen kodem toda kadma shekken teuna arbaa mine lechem o dilma el nazir kodem shekken yesh immo damim acherim ta shema zo kodemet lazo shezzo teuna arbaa mine lechem vezo enah teuna ella shene mine lechem
Vehashshelamim kodmin livchor ku adderabba bechor kodem shekken kedushshato merechem veneechal lakkohanim afilu hachi mitzot yeterot adifi
Habbechor kodem ku adderabba maaser kodem shekken mekaddesh lefanav ulacharav afilu hachi kedushsha merechem adifa
Maaser kodem laofot ku adderabba ofot kadmi shekken kodshe kadashim afilu hachi min zevach adif
Amar ravina bar shela emure kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim pesulin utna tuna mippene shehu zevach veyeshno kodshe kadashim damav veemurin
Bishlama emurin letanhu beofot ella dam miha iteh ella lav ka mashma lan emurin ki damo
Ma damo lifne zerika af emurin kodem zerika veka kare lehu kodshe kadashim uma damo mipsel beotze af emurin mipsel beotze
Nema mesayya leh besar kadashim kallim sheyyatza lifne zerikat damim rabbi yochanan amar kasher resh lakish amar pesul
Rabbi yochanan amar kasher hoil vesofo latzet resh lakish amar pasul adayin lo higgia zemanno latzet ad kan la peligi ella bevasar aval beemurin la
Hu haddin divemurin name peligi veha deka mipalgi bevasar lehodiacha kocho deresh lakish daafilu basar desofah latzet amar adayin lo higgia zemanno latzet
Lema ketannae emure kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim rabbi eliezer omer en moalin bahen

a: Veen chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame rabbi akiva omer moalin bahen vechayyavin alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame
May lav bedahadar ayelinhu peligi uvha peligi demar savar mipasli beotze umar savar la mipasli beotze
Amar rav pappa bedahadar ayelinhu kulle alma la peligi vehacha biditanhu abbaray peligi uvha peligi demar savar en zerika moelet layyotze umar savar zerika moelet layyotze
Veha rav pappa hu deamar biditanhu abbaray kulle alma la peligi bidayelinhu legavay peligi
Hane mile gabbe shette lechem delav gufeh dezivcha aval emurin degufeh dezivcha hu biditanhu abbaray peligi
Ofot kodmin ku adderabba menachot kodmot shekken yeshnan betzibbur kevayyachid afilu hachi mine damim adifi
Minchat chote ku adderabba minchat nedava kodemet shekken teuna shemen ulvona afilu hachi minchat chote habbaa al chet adifa dimchapperet
Ibaya lehu minchat sota uminchat nedava ezo mehen kodemet minchat nedava kadma shekken teuna shemen o ulvona o dilma minchat sota kadma shekken baa levarer aon
Ta shema minchat chote kodemet leminchat nedava minchat chote hu dekadma leminchat nedava ha minchat sota la mi katane mippene shehi mechapperet mippene shehi baa al chet katane veha name baa al chet
Ta shema zo kodemet lazo shezzo baa min hachitin vezo baa min hasseorin may lav minchat nedava leminchat sota la minchat chote leminchat sota
Tipok li deha mechappera veha la mechappera
Veella may minchat nedava tipok li dezo teuna shemen ulvona vezo enah teuna shemen ulvona ella chad mittere tame naket
Chattat haof kodemet ku mena hane mile detanu rabbanan vehikriv et asher lachattat rishona ma talmud lomar sheen talmud lomar lelammed shettikrav rishona hare kevar neemar veet hashsheni yaase ola
Ella ze bana av lechol chattaot sheyyikdemu leola leolot habbaot immahen ben chattat haof leolat haof ben chattat behema leolat behema vaafilu chattat haof leolat behema
Hilkach chattat haof leolat haof mivveet hashsheni chattat behema leolat behema midderabbi rachamana chattat haof leolat behema mizze bana av
Ta shema rabbi eliezer omer kol makom shennitchallefa chattat chattat kodemet vechan beoledet ola kodemet
Kol makom shebba al chet chattat kodemet vechan ola kodemet vechol makom sheshshenayim baim tachat chattat chattat kodemet vechan ola kodemet
Amar rava lemikraah hikdimah hakkatuv
Ta shema parim kodmin leelim veelim kodmin lichvashim kevasim lisirim
b: May lav dechag la lindava parim kodmin leelim shekken nitrabbu binsachim vechen elim lichvasim kevasim lisirim shekken nitrabbu bealya
Ta shema par kohen mashiach kodem lefar helem davar shel tzibbur par helem davar shel tzibbur kodem lefar avoda zara
Par avoda zara kodem lisire avoda zara deaf al gav defar avoda zara ola usire avoda zara chattat
Veema meresha par helem davar shel tzibbur kodem lefar avoda zara
Bechad mina miha la kaamrinan dechattat kadma ki kaamrinan bitre mine ashkechan ola dekadma lechattat
Amri bemareva mishshemeh derava bar mari chattat avoda zara chaser lechattat ketiv ravina amar kammishpat ketiv behu
Hashta deatet lehachi afilu tema parim dechag name kemishpatam ketiv behu
Ibaya lehu chattat haof veolat behema umaaser ezo mehen kodem tikdom chattat haof ika maaser dekadem lah likdom maaser ika olat behema dekadma leh tikdom olat behema ika chattat haof dekadma lah
Hacha targimu min zevach adif bemareva amri ayela bah olat behema bechattat haof veagbahtah mimmaaser
Matni kol hachattaot shebbattora kodmot laashamot chutz measham metzora mippene shehu ba al hechsher
Kal haashamot shebbattora bain bene shettayim uvain bechesef shekalim chutz measham nazir vaasham metzora shehen bain bene shennatan veen bain bechesef shekalim

Keshem shekkodmin behakravatan kodmin baachilatan shelamim shel emesh ushlamim shel yom shel emesh kodmin leshel yom shelamim shel emesh chattat veasham shel hayyom shelamim shel emesh kodmin divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim chattat kodemet mippene shehi kodshe kadashim

Vechullan hakkohanim rashshain leshannot baachilatan leachlan tzeluyin ushlukin umvushshalin latet letocho tavle chullin vetavle teruma divre rabbi shimon rabbi meir omer lo yitten letocho tavle teruma shello yavi hatteruma lide fesul
Gema ibaya lehu tadir umkuddash eze mehem kodem tadir kodem mishshum ditdir o dilma mekuddash kadem dekaddish ta shema temidin kodmin lemusafin

a: Veaf al gav demusafin kaddishi attu shabbat lemusafin ahanay litmidin la ahanay
Ta shema musfe shabbat kodmin lemusfe rosh chodesh attu rosh chodesh lemusafin dideh ahani lemusfe shabbat la ahani
Ta shema musfe rosh chodesh kodmin lemusfe rosh hashshana af al gav derosh hashshana kaddisha attu rosh hashshana lemusfe dideh ahani lemusfe rosh chodesh la ahani

Ta shema davar acher birkat hayyayin tedira uvirkat hayyom enah tedira vetadir vesheeno tadir tadir kodem af al gav devirkat hayyom kaddisha attu shabbat levirkat hayyom ahanay levirkat hayyayin la ahanay
Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan halacha mitpallel adam shel mincha veachar kach shel musafin attu shabbat litfillat musafin ahanay litfillat mincha la ahanay
Ta shema shelamim shel emesh chattat veasham shel yom shelamim shel emesh kodmin ha ide veide deom chattat veasham kadmi veaf al gav dishlamim tediri
Amar rava matzuy kaamratte tadir kamibaya lan matzuy la kamibaya lan
Amar leh rav huna bar yehuda lerava attu matzuy lav tadir vehatanya otzi et happesach sheeno tadir velo otzi et hammila shehi tedira
May tedira tedira bemitzot veibaet ema mila legabbe pesach ki tadir damya
Ibaya lehu tadir vesheeno tadir ukdem ushchat lesheeno tadir may mi amrinan kevan deshachteh makrev leh o dilma yahev leacher dimmares bedamo ad demakrev leh letadir vahadar makrev lesheeno tadir
Amar rav huna missura ta shema shelamim shel emesh chattat veasham shel yom shel emesh kodem leshel yom ha deom dumya deemesh
Vehechi dame dikdem shachteh lishlamim chattat veasham kadmi
Dilma shelamim deemesh vechattat veasham deom hechi mashkachatte lah deshachtinhu letarvayehu aval la shachtinhu letarvayehu tibe lach
Ta shema davar acher birkat hayyayin tedira uvirkat hayyom enah tedira vetadir vesheeno tadir tadir kodem
Hacha name dechevan deatyan daata yayin keman dishchiti tarvayehu dame
Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan halacha mitpallel adam shel mincha veachar kach shel musafin hacha name kevan demate zeman tefillat mincha keman dishchiti tarvayehu dame
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav ashe leravina shechato kodem chatzot pasul mippene shenneemar bo ben haarbayim kodem lattamid kasher vihe memares bedamo ad sheyyizrok haddam

Hacha bemay askinan kegon dikdem shachteh letamid beresha amar leh rav acha sava lerav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane ad sheyyizzarek haddam tamid vela katane ad sheyyishchot veyizrok dam shema minah
Uvchullan kohanim rashshain ku may tama amar kera lemoshcha ligdulla kederech shehammelachim ochlin
Matni amar rabbi shimon im raita shemen shehu mitchallek baazara en tzarich lishol mahu ella motar rekike menachot yisrael velog shemen shel metzora
Im raita shemen shehu nitan al gabbe haishim en tzarich lishol mahu ella motar rekike minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach sheen mitnaddevin shemen rabbi tarfon omer mitnaddevin shemen
b: Gema amar shemuel ledivre rabbi tarfon hammitnaddev shemen komtzo ushyarav neechalin may tama amar kera korban mincha melammed shemmitnaddevin shemen vechi mincha ma mincha komtzah ushyareha neechalin af shemen komtzo ushyarav neechalin

Amar rabbi zera af anan name tenena amar rabbi shimon im raita shemen shemmitchallek baazara i atta tzarich lishol mahu ella motar rekike minchot yisrael velog shemen shel metzora sheen mitnaddevin mikkelal deman deamar mitnaddevin mitchallek

Amar leh abbaye ema sefa im raita shemen shennitan al gabbe ishim i atta tzarich lishol mahu ella motar rekike minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach sheen mitnaddevin shemen mikkelal dilman deamar mitnaddev kullan laishim leabbaye kashya resha lerabbi zera kashya sefa
Bishlama lerabbi zera resha beshirayim sefa bekometz ella leabbaye kashya tena resha attu sefa
Bishlama sefa tane mishshum resha ella resha mishshum sefa mi tane in amri bemareva tena resha mishshum sefa
Ta shema yayin kedivre rabbi akiva lassefalim shemen kedivre rabbi tarfon laishim may lav middeyayin kullo lassefalim shemen kullo laishim mide irya ha kiditah veha kiditah
Amar rav pappa ketannae shemen lo yifchot millog rabbi omer sheloshet luggin bemay kamipalgi amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa dun minah uminah dun minah veoke beatrah ika benayehu
Derabbanan savri ma mincha mitnaddevin af shemen mitnaddevin uminah ma mincha log shemen af kan log shemen uma mincha komtzah ushyareha neechalin af shemen komtzo ushyarav neechalin

Veidach mimmincha ma mincha mitnaddevin af shemen mitnaddevin veoke beatrah kinsachim ma nesachim sheloshet luggin af shemen shelosha luggin uma nesachim kullan lassefalin af shemen kullan kullo laishim
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye i mimmincha mayete lah rabbi dechulle alma dun minah uminah ella rabbi meezrach gamar lah

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa mi matzet amratte hachi vehatanya korban mincha melammed shemmitnaddevin shemen vechamma shelosha luggin uman shamatte leh deamar shelosha luggin rabbi hi veka mayete lah mikkorban amar leh i tanya tanya
Amar shemuel hammitnaddev yayin mevi umzallefo al gabbe haishim may tama amar kera veyayin takriv lannesech chatzi hahin ishshe reach nichoach la veha ka mechabbe kibuy bemiktzat la shemeh kibuy
Ini vehaamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh hammorid gachelet meal gabbe hammizbeach vechibah chayyav deleka ella hay ibaet ema kibuy demitzva shane
Ta shema detana rabbi eliezer ben yaakov kelappe shennittena tora litrom yachol yechabbe veyitrom amratte lo yechabbe shane hatam efshar deyatev venatar
Ta shema yayin kedivre rabbi akiva lassefalim shemen kedivre rabbi tarfon laishim veod tanya yayin lenassech lassefalim o eno ella laishim amarta lo yechabbe
La kashya ha rabbi yehuda ha rabbi shimon lememra dishmuel kerabbi shimon sevira leh vehaamar shemuel mechabbin gachelet shel mattechet birshut harabbim bishvil shello yizzoku bah rabbim

a: Aval lo gachelet shel etz vei salka datach kerabbi shimon sevira leh afilu gachelet shel etz name
Bedavar sheen mitkaven savar lah kerabbi shimon bimlacha sheenah tzericha legufah savar lah kerabbi yehuda

Amar rav huna nesachim shennitmeu ose lahen maaracha bifne atzman vesorfan mishshum shenneemar bakkodesh baesh tissaref tanya name hachi haddam vehashshemen vehammenachot vehannesachim shennitmeu ose lahen maaracha bifne atzman vesorfan
Amar leh shemuel lerav chana bagdataa ayeti li be asra veema lach kammayehu nesachim shennitmeu ose lahen maaracha bifne atzman vesorfan
Hadaran alach kol hattadir

Matni dam chattat shennittaz al habbeged hare ze taun kibus af al pi sheen hakkatuv medabber ella beneechalot shenneemar bemakom kadosh teachel echad hanneechalot veechad happenimiyyot teunot kibus shenneemar torat hachattat tora achat lechol hachattaot

Chattat pesula en damah taun kibus ben shehayeta lah sheat hakkosher uven shello hayeta lah sheat hakkosher ezo hi shehayeta lah sheat hakkosher shellana veshennitmea vesheyyatzat veezo hi shello hayeta lah sheat hakkosher shennishchata chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah veshekkiblu pesulin vezarku et damah
Gema dam chattat shemmeta shennittaz ku vei tora achat lechol chattaot afilu chattat haof name allema tanya yachol tehe dam chattat haof taun kibus talmud lomar zot
Amar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara amar kera tishshachet benishchatot hakkatuv medabber
Veema beneechalot hakkatuv medabber kedichtiv bemakom kadosh teachel aval penimiyyot la rabbi rachamana torat
I hachi afilu chattat haof name miet rachamana zot
Uma raita mistabbera dechattat behema penimiyyot hava leh lerabboye shekken behema shechitat tzafon vekabbalat keli
b: Vekeren veetzba vechuddah veishim
Adderabba chattat haof hava leh lerabboye shekken chutz kemotah vaachila kemotah hanach nefishin
Rav yosef amar amar kera yochlenna lazo velo leacheret beneechalot miet hakkatuv
Veella zot lema li i lav zot have amena yochlenna orcheh dikra ka mashma lan
Rabba amar amar kera asher yizze behazzaot hakkatuv medabber
Vehatanya af al pi sheen hakkatuv medabber ella beneechalot leinyan merika ushtifa aval leinyan kibus asher yizze ketiv
I hachi echad hanneechalot veechad happenimiyyot echad happenimiyyot veechad hanneechalot mibe leh teni echad happenimiyyot veechad hanneechalot
I hachi chattat haof name maet rachamana zot i hachi chitzona name la rabbi rachamana torat
Uma raita mistabbera chattat behema hava leh lerabboye shekken behema shechitat tzafon vekabbalat keli vekeren veetzba vechuddah veishim
Adderabba chattat haof hava leh lerabboye shekken hazzaa kemotah hanach nefishin
Bae rabbi avin chattat haof shehichnis damah betzavarah bifnim mahu tzavarah kichli sharet dame umipsil
O dilma ketzavar behema middamah amar rachamana vela besarah ta shema pirkesa venichnesa lifnim vechazra keshera ha hichnisah pesula
Velitamach gabbe kodshe kadashim dekatane pirkesa veyatza laddarom vechazra keshera ha hotziah pesula
Ella hay yatzta lachutz itztericha leh hacha name yatzta lachutz itztericha leh
Bae rabbi avin nishpach al haritzpa vaasafah mahu
Atzroche hu dela atzrecheh rachamana keli sharet vehilkach osfo vechasher o dilma mifsal pesal beh rachamana kele sharet vehilkach osfo ufasul
Amar rava ta shema yachol yehe dam chattat haof taun kibus talmud lomar zot vei salka datach mifsal pasel beh rachamana tipok li deha ippesil leh baavir keli
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua bemadbik keli betzavarah
Bea mineh levi nitaz mibbeged leveged mahu mibbeged kamma idchi leh lechibus o dilma la
Amar leh zo sheela taun kibus mimma nafshach i osfo vechasher ha kasher vei osfo ufasul ana kerabbi akiva sevira li deamar hayeta lo lah sheat hakkosher venifsela damah taun kibus

a: Bea mineh rame bar chama merav chisda nitaz al beged tame mahu amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua middekamibaya leh hachi shema minah hayeta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela en damah taun kibus
Hane mile beze achar ze aval bevat achat la o dilma la shena amar leh pelugta derabbi elazar verabbanan alliba derabba vechidka metaretz abbaye
Detanya rabbi elazar omer me chattat shennitmeu metaharin shehare nidda mazzin aleha
Veamar rabba rabbi elazar beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo amarah deamar haavarat keli al gabbe makom tame kemunnach dame

Ditnan haya omed chutz lattannur vesheretz battannur vehoshit yado lachallon venatal et hallagin veheeviro al pi tannur rabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin uvha peligi derabbi akiva savar kemunnach dame verabbanan savri lav kemunnach dame

Veetiveh abbaye mode rabbi akiva behazzaa sheheevirah al kele cheres tame al gabbe mishkav umoshav tame shehi tehora sheen lecha davar shemmetamme lemala kilmatta ella kezayit min hammet ushar kol hammaahilin leetoye even hamnuggaat
Ella amar abbaye dechulle alma lav kemunnach dame vehacha beha kamipalgi derabbi akiva savar gazrinan shemma yanuach verabbanan savri la gazrinan umode rabbi akiva behazzaa kevan dinfak nefak
Verabbi elazar verabbanan bemay kamipalgi amar abbaye bedanin tuma keduma mittuma shebbeotah shaa kamipalgi
Mar savar danin umar savar en danin
Rava amar dechulle alma en danin
Vehacha beha kamipalgi derabbi elazar savar hazzaa tzericha shiur umitztarfin lehazzaot verabbanan savri hazzaa en tzericha shiur

Chattat pesula ku tanu rabbanan middamah middam keshera velo middam pesula rabbi akiva omer hayeta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela damah taun kibus lo hayeta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela en damah taun kibus
Verabbi shimon omer echad ze veechad ze en damah taun kibus may tama derabbi shimon ketiv otah uchtiv middamah chad lehecha dehayeta lo sheat hakkosher
Verabbi akiva otah perat litruma verabbi shimon letameh deamar kadashim kallim en teunin merika ushtifa vechol shekken teruma
Matni nitaz min hatztzavar al habbeged eno taun kibus min hakkeren umin hayesod eno taun kibus nishpach al haritzpa vaasafo en taun kibus en taun kibus ella dam shennitkabbel bichli verauy lehazzaa

Gema tanu rabbanan yachol nitaz min hatztzavar al habbeged yehe taun kibus talmud lomar asher yizze lo amarti lach ella berauy lehazzaa tanya idach yachol nitaz min hakkeren umin hayesod yehe taun kibus talmud lomar asher yizze perat laze shekkevar huzza
Nishpach al haritzpa ku
b: Ha tu lema li ma taam kaamar ma taam nishpach al haritzpa vaasafo en taun kibus lefi sheen taun kibus ella dam shennitkabbel bichli verauy lehazzaya
Rauy lehazzaa lemaote may lemaote kibel pachot mikkede hazzaya bichli ze ufachot mikkede hazzaya bichli ze
Detanya rabbi chalafta bar shaul omer kidesh pachot mikkede hazzaya bichli ze ufachot mikkede hazzaya bichli ze lo kidesh
Ibaya lehu bedam mahu hilcheta hi umehilcheta la gamrinan
O dilma hatam may tama dichtiv vetaval bammayim hacha name ketiv vetaval baddam
Ta shema deamar rabbi zerika amar rabbi elazar af bedam lo kidesh
Amar rava tanya vetaval velo mesappeg baddam ad sheyehe baddam shiur tevila meikaro min haddam min haddam shebbainyan
Veitzterich lemichtav baddam dei ketav rachamana vetaval hava amena af al pi deleka shiur tevila meikaro ketav rachamana baddam
Vei ketav rachamana baddam hava amena afilu mesappeg ketav rachamana vetaval
Min haddam shebbeinyan lemaote may amar rava lemaote shirayim shebbaetzba mesayya lerabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar shirayim shebbaetzba pesulin
Amar leh ravin bar rav adda lerav amar talmidcha amar rav amram tenena haya mazze venitza hazzaa miyyado ad shello hizza taun kibus mishshehizza en taun kibus
May lav hachi kaamar ad shello gamar millehazzot taun kibus mishsheggamar lehazzot en taun kibus la hachi kaamar ad shello yatzta hazzaa miyyado taun kibus mishsheyyatzta hazzaa miyyado en taun kibus
Etiveh abbaye gamar millehazzot mekanneach yado begufah shel para gamar in lo gamar la amar leh gamar mekanneach yado begufah shel para lo gamar mekanneach etzbao
Bishlama gamar mekanneach yado begufah shel para shenneemar vesaraf et happara leenav ella etzbao bemay mekanneach amar abbaye bisfat mizrak kedichtiv kefore zahav
Matni nitaz al haor ad shello hufshat eno taun kibus mishshehufshat taun kibus divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi elazar omer af mishshehufshat eno taun kibus ella mekom haddam vedavar shehu rauy lekabbel tuma verauy lechibus

Echad habbeged veechad hassak veechad haor teunin kibus vehakkibus bemakom kadosh ushvirat keli cheres bemakom kadosh umrika ushtifa bichli nechoshet bimkom kadosh ze chomer bechattat mikkodshe kadashim
Gema menahane mile detanu rabbanan beged en li ella beged minnayin lerabbot or mishshehufshat talmud lomar asher yizze aleha techabbes
Yachol sheani merabbe or ad shello hufshat talmud lomar beged ma beged harauy lekabbel tuma af kol harauy lekabbel tuma divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi elazar omer beged en li ella beged minnayin lerabbot sak

a: Vechol mine vegadim talmud lomar asher aleha techabbes yachol sheani merabbe or mishshehufshat talmud lomar beged ma beged davar hamkabbel tuma af kol davar hamkabbel tuma
May benayehu amar abbaye matlet pechuta mishshalosh ika benayehu man deamar rauy ha name rauy dei bae chashshev aleh man deamar davar hamkabbel tuma ha miha lav bat kabbole tuma hi
Rava amar beged shechishev aleha letzura ika benayehu man deamar rauy ha name rauy dei bae mevattel leh lemachshavteh man deamar davar hamkabbel tuma hashta miha lav bat kabbole tuma hi

Rava amar utzba dechashshev alah lekatztzeah ika benayehu man deamar rauy ha name reuya man deamar davar hamkabbel tuma ha lav mekabbela tuma ad dimkatztza lah vehatanya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer utzba shechishshev aleha lekatztzeah tehora ad sheyekatztzeenna
En taun kibus ku mena hane mile detanu rabbanan yachol nittaz al miktzat beged yehe kol habbeged taun kibus talmud lomar asher yizze lo amarti lecha ella mekom dam bilvad
Davar shehu rauy lekabbel tuma vechu setama kerabbi yehuda
Rauy lechibus lemaote keli devar gerida hu
Echad habbeged veechad hassak ku lememra deor bar kibus hu urminhu hayeta alav lashleshet mekannechah bismartut hayeta al shel or noten aleha mayim ad shettichle
Amar abbaye la kashya ha rabbanan ha acherim detanya habbeged vehassak mechabbeso hakkeli vehaor megarro acherim omrim habbeged vehassak vehaor mechabbeso vehakkeli megarro
Keman azla ha deamar rav chiyya bar ashe zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav veshachshechi leh mesaneh bemayya keman kerabbanan
Amar rava umi ika leman deamar or lav bar kibus hu vehachtiv vehabbeged o hashsheti o haerev o chol keli haor asher techabbes ella amar rava kera umatnitin berakkin ki peligi bekashin
Vehaamar rav chiyya zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav veshachshechi leh mesaneh bemayya bekashin uchrabbanan
Hadar amar rava lav milta hi daamari neku nema leh likra dechi chetivan berakkin ketivan mi la askinan bichle ekkesalgeya habbaim mimmedinat hayyam vekaamar rachamana nive kibus
Ella amar rava tzaraat kevan demiggufeh ka farcha mechalchala leh umshavveya lah rach amar rava i kashya li ha kashya li
b: Karim uchsatot derakkin ninhu utnan hayeta shel or noten aleha mayim ad shettichle ella amar rava kol kibus delet leh kiskus la shemeh kibus
Veha deamar rav chiyya bar ashe zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav veshachshechi leh mesaneh bemayya shichshuch in aval kibbus la i berakkin uchdivre hakkol i bekashin vechaacherim
I hachi beged name beged sheriyyato zehu kibuso
Rava letameh deamar rava zarak sudar lemayim chayyav zarak pishtan lemayim chayyav bishlama sudar aved kibus ella zera pishtan may tama
Vechi tema mishshum demikaddach i hachi chite usare name hanach it lehu rire i hachi shelachim name hatam kaaved lisha

Daresh rava muttar lechabbes minal beshabbat amar leh rav pappa lerava veha amar rav chiyya bar ashe zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav veshachshechi leh mesane bemayya shichshuch in aval kibus la hadar oke rava amora aleh udrash devarim sheamarti lifnechem taut hem beyadi beram kach amru shichshuch muttar kibus asur

Hakkibus bemakom kadosh ku mena hane mile detanu rabbanan techabbes bemakom kadosh shevirat keli cheres minnayin talmud lomar uchli cheres asher tevushshal bo yishshaver merika ushtifa bichli nechoshet minnayin talmud lomar veim bichli nechoshet bushshala umorak veshuttaf bammayim
Ze chomer bechattat ku vetu leka vehaika shennichnas damah lifnay velifnim bechattaot hachitzonot
Sheim nichnas damah lifnay velifnim pesula kerabbi akiva deamar kol damim shennichnesu lahechal lechapper pesula
Shekken mechapperin al chayyave charetot bechattat dishmiat hakkol
Shekken teuna arba mattanot kerabbi yishmael deamar kol damim teunin arba mattanot al arba keranot
Velitamach haika keren haika etzba haika chuddah ella chad mittere telata chumre naket

Matni beged sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim nichnas umchabbeso bemakom kadosh nitma chutz lakkelaim koro nichnas umchabbeso bimkom kadosh keli cheres sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim nichnas veshovro bemakom kadosh nitma chutz lakkelaim nokvo venichnas veshovro bemakom kadosh
Keli nechoshet sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim nichnas umorko veshotfo bemakom kadosh nitma chutz lakkelaim pochato venichnas umorko veshotfo bemakom kadosh
Gema matkef lah ravina koro beged amar rachamana velav beged hu
Dimshayyar beh kede maporet ini vehaamar rav huna lo shanu ella shello shiyyer bah kede maporet aval shiyyer bah kede maporet chibbur have

a: Midderabbanan hu
Keli cheres sheyyatza ku keli amar rachamana velo keli hu shennikav beshoresh katan
Keli nechoshet ku pochato vechu veha lav keli hu deratzef leh mirtzaf hu
Amar resh lakish meil shennitma machniso befachot mishshalosh al shalosh umchabbeso mishshum shenneemar lo yikkarea
Motev rav adda bar ahava heavin veharakkim en bahen mishshum shalosh al shalosh
Aggav avihen chashivi
Veha bae shivat sammanin deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh dam chattat umarot negaim tzerichin shivat sammanin vetanya ella sheen machnisin me raglayim lammikdash
b: Vechi tema demavla lehu bahade shiva sammanin umabbar lehu lechullehu kechad vehatnan heeviran shello kesidran o sheheevir shivatan keechad lo asa velo chelum

Vechi tema demavla lehu bahade chad missammanin veha tzarich lechaskes shalosh peamim bechol echad veechad tenan ella demavla lehu berok tafel deamar resh lakish rok tafel tzarich sheyehe im kol echad veechad
Matni echad shebbishel bo veechad sheera letocho roteach echad kodshe kodashim veechad kadashim kallim teunin merika ushtifa rabbi shimon omer kadashim kallim en teunin merika ushtifa
Gema tanu rabbanan asher tevushshal bo en li ella shebbishel bo era letocho roteach minnayin talmud lomar vaasher tevushshal bo yishshaver
Bae rame bar chama telao baavir tannur mahu abbishul uvilua hu dekafed rachamana o dilma abbishul belo bilua
Amar rava ta shema echad shebbishel bo veechad sheera letocho roteach
Billua belo bishul la kamibaya lan ki kamibaya lan bishul belo bilua may

Ta shema deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh tannur shel mikdash shel mattechet haya vei salka datach bishul belo billua la kafed nebed shel cheres kevan deika sheyare menachot daafiyyatan battannur veika bishul uvilua avdinan shel mattechet
Hahu tannura ditcho beh tichya asrah rabba bar ahilay lemechlah lerifta leolam vaafilu bemilcha dilma ate lemechlah bechuttacha
Metivi en lashin et haisa bechalav veim lash kol happat kullah asura mippene hergel avera
Keotze bo en tashin et hattannur bealya veim tash kol happat kullah asura ad sheyyassik et hattannur teuvta derabba bar ahilay teuvta
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe vechi meachar deitotav rabba bar ahilay ammay amar rav kederot befesach yishshavru amar leh rav moke lah hahi beshel mattechet
Vei baet ema betannur shel cheres ze hesseko mibbifnim veze hesseko mibbachutz
Venabed hesseka mibbifnim chayes alayehu demittavri hilkach hay kuvya hesseko mibbachutz hu vaasir

a: Ella kederot shel mikdash ammay amar rachamana yishshavru nahderinhu lechivshonot amar rabbi zera lefi sheen osin kivshonot birushalayim
Amar abbaye vechi osin ashpattot baazara ishtemitteh ha detane shemaya bekalnevo shivre kele cheres nivlain bimkoman
Ella ha deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh tannur shel mikdash shel mattechet hava nebed decheres dehesseko mibbefanim hu
Dechevan deika shette hallechem velechem happanim daafiyyatan betannur ukdushshatan betannur have leh keli sharet uchli sharet decheres la avdinan
b: Vaafilu rabbi yose berabbi yehuda la kaamar ella deetz aval decheres la

Rav yitzchak bar yehuda hava regil kammeh derame bar chama shavkeh vaazal lerav sheshet yoma chad pega beh amar leh alkafta naktan recha ate lah leyad mishshum deazlatte lach lekammeh derav sheshet havet lach ki rav sheshet

Amar leh lav mishshum hachi mar ki baena milta pashet li missevara ki mashkachna matnita parcha lah rav sheshet ki baena milta mineh pashet li mimmatnita dechi name mashkachatte matnita ufarcha matnita umatnita hi
Amar leh bei minay milta deifshit lach ki matnita bea mineh bishel bemiktzat keli taun merika ushtifa o en taun amar leh eno taun mide dehave ahazzaa
Veha la tena hachi amar leh mistabbera keveged ma beged eno taun kibus ella mekom haddam af keli eno taun merika ushtifa ella bimkom bishul
Amar leh mi dame dam la mefapa bishul mefapa veod tanya chomer behazzaa mimmerika ushtifa vechomer bimrika ushtifa mibbehazzaa
Chomer behazzaa shehazzaa yeshnah bechattaot hachitzonot uvchattaot happenimiyyot veyeshnah lifne zerika ma sheen ken bimrika ushtifa
Chomer bimrika ushtifa shehammerika ushtifa noheget ben bekodshe kadashim ben bekadashim kallim bishel bemiktzat hakkeli taun merika ushtifa kal hakkeli ma sheen ken behazzaa
Amar leh i tanya tanya vetama may amar kera veim bichli nechoshet bushshala vaafilu bemiktzat keli
Echad kodshe kodashim vechu tanu rabbanan chattat en li ella chattat kol kadashim minnayin talmud lomar kodesh kadashim hi

Yachol sheani merabbe et hatteruma talmud lomar otah perat litruma divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer kodshe kadashim teunin merika ushtifa kadashim kallim enan teunin merika ushtifa dichtiv kodesh kadashim kodshe kadashim en kadashim kallim la
May tama derabbi yehuda middeitzterich otah lemaote teruma mikkelal dekadashim kallim teunin merika ushtifa verabbi shimon amar lach otah kidamrinan
Utruma la baaya shetifa umrika vehatanya kedera shebbishel bah basar lo yevashshel bah chalav veim bishel benoten taam teruma lo yevashshel bah chullin veim bishel benoten taam
Amar abbaye la tzericha ella lidamar mar bishel bemiktzat keli taun merika ushtifa kal hakkeli ha teruma la tzerich ella mekom bishul
Rava amar la tzericha ella lidamar mar bammayim velo beyayin bammayim velo bemazug ha afilu beyayin vaafilu bemazug
Rabba bar ulla amar la tzericha ella lidamar mar merika ushtifa betzonen ha afilu bechammin
Hanicha leman deamar merika ushtifa betzonen ella leman deamar merika bechammin ushtifa betzonen may ika lememar shetifa yattirta
Matni rabbi tarfon omer bishel mittechilat haregel yevashshel bo kal haregel vachachamim omrim ad zeman achila merika ushtifa merika kimrikat hakkos ushtifa kishtifat hakkos merika ushtifa betzonen

a: Hashshappud vehaaskala magilan bechammin
Gema may tama derabbi tarfon deamar kera ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha hakkatuv asaan lechullan boker echad
Matkef lah rav achadvuy bar amme vechi en pigul baregel veen notar baregel
Vechi tema hachi name vehatanya rabbi natan omer lo amar rabbi tarfon ella zo bilvad
Ella kidrav nachman amar rabba bar avuh deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh kol yom vaom naase giul lachavero
Vachachamim omrim ad zeman achila ku may kaamar amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh mamtin lah ad zeman achila vahadar aved lah merika ushtifa
Menahane mile amar rabbi yochanan mishshum abba yose ben abba ketiv umorak veshuttaf uchtiv kol zachar bakkohanim yochal ha ketzad mamtin lah ad zeman achila vahadar aved lah merika ushtifa
Merika kimrikat hakkos shetifa kishtifat hakkos tanu rabbanan merika ushtifa betzonen divre rabbi vachachamim omrim merika bechammin ushtifa betzonen
May tama derabbanan mide dehave aggiule goyim verabbi amar lach hagala la kaamena ki kaamena limrika ushtifa devatar hagala
Verabbanan im ken lichtov kera o morak morak o shuttaf shuttaf may umorak veshuttaf shema minah merika bechammin ushtifa betzonen
Verabbi i ketiv umorak morak hava amena tere zimne morak o tere zimne shuttaf lechach ketiv umorak veshuttaf lomar lach merika kimrikat hakkos shetifa kishtifat hakkos
Matni bishel bo kadashim vechullin o kodshe kadashim vekadashim kallim im yesh bahen benoten taam hare hakkallim neechalin kachamurin shebbahen veenan teunin merika ushtifa veenan poslim bemagga
Rakik shennaga berakik vachaticha bachaticha lo kol harkikin velo kol hachatichot asurin eno asur ella bimkom shebbala
Gema may kaamar im yesh bahen benoten taam hare hakkallin neechalin kachamurin utunin merika ushtifa ufoslin bemagga
En bahen benoten taam en hakkallin neechalin kachamurim veen teunin merika ushtifa veen poslin bemagga
Nehi dekodshe kadashim la bau kadashim kallim nive
Amar abbaye may en teunin dekaamar kodshe kadashim aval kadashim kallim teunin rava amar ha manni rabbi shimon hi deamar kadashim kallim en teunin merika ushtifa
Bishlama lerava hayenu dekatane o kodshe kadashim vekadashim kallim ella leabbaye tarte lema li
Tzerichi dei tena kadashim vechullin hava amena chullin hu dimvatteli kadashim delav minayehu aval kodshe kadashim vekadashim kallim ema la
Vei tena kodshe kadashim vekadashim kallim hava amena kadashim hu deallimi levattole kadashim aval chullin ema la tzericha
Rakik shehiggia berakik ku tanu rabbanan kol asher yigga yachol afilu shello bala talmud lomar bivsarah
b: Ad sheyyibbala bivsarah
Yachol naga bemiktzat chaticha yehe kullo pasul talmud lomar yigga hannogea pasul ha ketzad chotech et makom shebbala bivsarah velo baggidin velo baatzamot velo bakkarnayim velo battelafayim
Yikdash lihot kamoha ha ketzad im pesula hi tippasel veim keshera hi teachel kechamur shebbah
Ammay venete ase velidche et lo taase amar rava en ase doche et lo taase shebbammikdash

Shenneemar veetzem lo tishberu vo rabbi shimon ben menasya omer echad etzem sheyyesh bo moach veechad etzem sheen bo moach ammay nete ase velidche et lo taase ella en ase doche lo taase shebbammikdash
Rav ashe amar yikdash ase hu veen ase doche et lo taase vaase
Ashkechan chattat demitkaddeshet bevillua shear kadashim menalan amar shemuel mishshum rabbi eliezer zot hattora laola velammincha velachattat velaasham velammilluim ulzevach hashshelamim
Laola ki ola ma ola teuna keli af kol teuna keli may keli ilema mizrak beshalme tzibur name ketiv behu vayyikkach moshe chatzi haddam vayyasem baagganot
Ella desakkin veola gufah menalan dichtiv vayyishlach avraham et yado vayyikkach et hammaachelet vehatam ola hu dichtiv vayyaalehu leola tachat beno
Mincha ma mincha enah neechelet ella lezichre chehunna af kol enam neechalin ella lezichre chehunna may hi i chattat veasham behedya ketiv behu kol zachar bakkohanim yochlennu
Vei shalme tzibur meribuya dikra ate bekodesh hakkodashim tochlennu kol zachar yochal oto limed al shalme tzibur sheenan neechalin ella lezichre chehunna
Tannae hi

a: Ika denafka leh mehacha veika denafka leh mehacha
Chattat ma chattat mitkaddeshet bevalua af kol mitkaddeshet bevalua
Asham ma asham en shafir veshilya kadosh bo af kol en shafir veshilya kadosh bo kasavar valdot kadashim bahavayatan hen kedoshim vedanin efshar mishshei efshar
Milluim ma milluim motrehen bisrefa veen baale chayyim bemotrehen af kol motrehen bisrefa veen baale chayyim bemotrehen
Shelamim ma shelamim mefaggelin umitpaggelin af kol mefaggelin umitpaggelin
Bematnita tana mishshemeh derabbi akiva mincha ma mincha mitkaddeshet bevalua af kol mitkaddeshet bevalua
Veitzterich lemichtav mincha veitzterich lemichtav chattat dei ashmeinan mincha deayede derakkicha mibala aval chattat ema la vei ashmeinan chattat mishshum dekarir aval mincha ema la tzericha

Chattat ma chattat enah baa ella min hachullin uvayyom uvyado hayemanit af kol enah baa ella min hachullin uvayyom uvyado hayemanit vechattat menalan amar rav chisda amar kera vehikriv aharon et par hachattat asher lo mishshello velo mishshel tzibur velo mishshel maaser
Bayyom mibbeom tzaoto nafka kedi nasvah
Beyado hayemanit midderabba bar bar chana nafka deamar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish kol makom shenneemar etzba uchhunna eno ella yamin kedi nasvah
Veibaet ema savar lah kerabbi shimon deamar etzba la baaya kehunna kehunna baaya etzba
Asham ma asham atzmotav muttarin af kol atzmotav muttarin
Amar rava peshita li
b: Dam chattat lematta vedam ola lemala taun kibus
Bae rava dam ola lematta vedam chattat lemala mahu mishshum nogea hu veha nogea o dilma mishshum balua hu veha la bala hu hadar pashtah deen teunin kibus
Amar rava peshita li dam al bigdo chotzetz veim tabbach hu eno chotzetz revav al bigdo chotzetz veim mocher revav hu eno chotzetz bae rava dam urvav al bigdo mahu
Im tabbach hu tipok li mishshum revav vei mocher revav hu tipok li mishshum dam la tzericha deaved ha veha achada la kafed attarte kafed o dilma attarte name la kafed teku
Hadaran alach dam chattat
Matni tevul yom umchussar kipurim enan cholkin bakkodashim leechol laerev
Onen eno nogea veeno makriv veeno cholek leechol laerev
Baale mumin ben baale mumin ovrin ben baale mumin kevuin cholkin veochlin aval lo makrivin
Kol sheeno rauy laavoda eno cholek babbasar vechol sheen lo babbasar en lo baorot
Afilu tame bishat zerikat damim vetahor bishat hekter chalavim eno cholek babbasar shenneemar hammakriv et dam hashshelamim veet hachelev mibbene aharon lo yihye tihye shok hayyamin lemana

a: Gema mena hane mile amar resh lakish deamar kera hakkohen hamchatte otah yochlenna kohen hamchatte yochal sheeno mechatte eno ochel
Uchlala hu vahare mishmara kullah deen mechattein veochlin rauy lechituy kaamrinan
Hare katan deeno rauy lechituy veochel ella may yochlenna yechallekenna rauy lechituy cholek sheeno rauy lechituy eno cholek
Hare baal mum deeno rauy lechituy vecholek baal mum rachamana rabbeyeh kol zachar bakkohanim lerabbot baal mum
Veema kol zachar lerabbot tevul yom mistabbera baal mum hava leh lerabboye shekken ochel
Adderabba tevul yom hava leh lerabboye dilurta michza chaze hashta miha ha la chaze
Rav yosef amar mikkede may yochlenna yechallekenna lichtov rachamana yechallekenna may yochlenna shema minah rauy laachila cholek sheeno rauy laachila eno cholek
Bae resh lakish baal mum vehu tame mahu sheyyachleku lo kevan dela chaze verachamana rabbeyeh la shena ma li tame ma li baal mum o dilma rauy laachila cholek sheeno rauy laachila eno cholek
Amar rabba ta shema kohen gadol makriv onen veeno ochel veeno cholek leechol laerev shema minah rauy laachila baenan shema minah
Bae rav oshaya tame bekorbenot tzibur mahu sheyyachleku lo mi amrinan hamchatte amar rachamana vehay name mechet hu o dilma rauy laachila cholek sheen rauy laachila eno cholek
Amar ravina ta shema kohen gadol makriv onen veeno ochel veeno cholek leechol laerev shema minah rauy laachila baenan shema minah
Onen nogea veeno makriv ku onen nogea urminhi onen umchussar kipurim tzerichin tevila lakkodesh
Amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan la kashya kan beshettaval kan beshello taval
Vechi taval may have ha hadra aleh aninut deamar rabba bar rav huna onen shettaval aninuto chozeret alav
La kashya ha deassach dateh ha dela assach dateh
Hesach haddaat shelishi ushvii bae deamar rabbi yostay berabbi matun amar rabbi yochanan hesach haddaat tzarich hazzaa shelishi ushvii
La kashya ha deassach dateh mitteme met ha deassach dateh mitteme sheretz
Teme sheretz tame mealleya hu heerev shemesh bae veod afilu teruma name
Amar rabbi yirmeya beomer nishmarti middavar hamtammeeni velo nishmarti middavar happosleni
Umi ika netiruta lefalga in vehatanya odehu hassal al rosho
b: Umagrefa betocho veamar libbi al hassal veen libbi al hammagrefa hassal tahor vehammagrefa temea
Uttamme magrefa lesal en keli metamme keli uttamme ma shebbetocho amar rava beomer shemartiha middavar hamtammeah velo shemartiha middavar happoslah
Igalgal milta umtay lekammeh derabbi abba bar memel amar lehu la shemia lehu ha deamar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi haochel shelishi shel teruma asur leechol umuttar liga
Alma baachila avud rabbanan maala bingia la avud rabbanan maala
Veeno cholek leechol ku miflag hu dela pelig vechi mezammeni leh achel
Urminhi onen umchussar kipurim tovel veochel et pischo laerev aval lo bekadashim
Amar rav yirmeya middifti la kashya kan befesach kan bishar yemot hashshana
Befesach ayede deachel pesach achel name kadashim bishar yemot hashshana dela chaze la chaze umay aval lo bekadashim aval lo bekadashim shel kol hashshana
Rav assi amar la kashya kan shemmet lo met bearbaa asar ukvaro bearbaa asar kan shemmet lo met bishlosha asar ukvaro bearbaa asar yom kevura la tafes lelo midderabbanan

Man tanna aninut layela midderabbanan rabbi shimon hi detanya aninut layela middivre tora divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer onen eno middivre tora ella middivre sofrim teda shehare amru onen tovel veochel et pischo laerev aval lo bakkodashim
Vesavar rabbi shimon aninut layela midderabbanan vehatanya rabbi shimon omer onen eno meshalleach korbenotav may lav vaafilu befesach la levar mippesach
Vehatanya rabbi shimon omer shelamim keshehu shalem mevi veeno mevi keshehu onen minnayin lerabbot et hattoda merabbe ani et hattoda shekken neechelet besimcha kishlamim

Minnayin lerabbot et haola merabbe ani et haola shekken baa beneder uvindava kishlamim minnayin lerabbot bechor umaaser vafesach merabbe ani bechor umaaser vafesach shekken enan bain al chet minnayin lerabbot chattat veasham talmud lomar zevach
Minnayin lerabbot haofot vehammenachot vehayyayin vehaetzim vehallevona talmud lomar shelamim korbano kol korbenot shehu mevi keshehu shalem mevi veeno mevi keshehu onen
Katane miha pesach
Amar rav chisda pesach kedi nasveh
Rav sheshet amar may pesach shalme fesach i hachi hayenu shelamim tena shelamim habbain mechamat pesach utna shelamim habbain mechamat atzman
Dei la tena shelamim habbain mechamat pesach salka datach amena hoil umechamat pesach ate kegufeh defesach dame ka mashma lan
Rav mari amar

a: La kashya kan shemmet lo met bearbaa asar ukvaro bearbaa asar kan shemmet lo met bishlosha asar ukvaro bearbaa asar
Met lo met bearbaa asar ukvaro bearbaa asar yom mita tofes lelo middeorayeta met lo met bishlosha asar ukvaro bearbaa asar yom kevura midderabbanan eno tofes lelo ella midderabbanan

Amar leh rav ashe lerav mari veella ha dekatane amar lo rabbi shimon teda shehare amru onen tovel veochel et pischo aval lo bakkodashim nema leh kaamena lach ana yom mita deorayeta veamratte li et yom kevura derabbanan kashya
Abbaye amar la kashya kan shemmet kodem chatzot kan shemmet leachar chatzot kodem chatzot dela ichazi lefesach chayela aleh aninut achar chatzot deichazi lefesach la chayela aleh aninut

Umna temra deshane leh ben kodem chatzot ben leachar chatzot detanya lah yittamma mitzva lo ratza metammein oto al korcho umaase beosef hakkohen shemmeta ishto beerev happesach velo ratza litamme venimnu echav hakkohanim vetimuhu beal korcho
Urminhi velaachoto ma talmud lomar hare shehalach lishchot et pischo velamul et beno veshama shemmet lo met yachol yittamme amarta lo yittamme
Yachol keshem shello yittamme laachoto kach en mittamme lemet mitzva talmud lomar velaachoto laachoto hu deeno mittamme aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva
Lav shema minah kan kodem chatzot kan leachar chatzot
Mimmay dilma leolam ema lecha ide veide achar chatzot veha rabbi yishmael veha rabbi akiva detanya lah yittamma reshut divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer chova
La salka datach deresha dehahi rabbi akiva katane lah detanya rabbi akiva omer nefesh ellu hakkerovim met ellu harchokim

Leaviv eno mittamme aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva leimmo haya kohen vehu nazir leimmo hu deeno mittamme aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva leachiv sheim haya kohen gadol vehu nazir leachiv hu deeno mittamme aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva

Velaachoto ma talmud lomar hare shehalach lishchot et pischo velamul et beno veshama shemmet lo met yachol yittamme amarta lo yittamme yachol keshem sheen mittamme laachoto kach eno mittamme lemet mitzva talmud lomar velaachoto laachoto lo yittamme aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva
b: Rava amar ide veide achar chatzot vela kashya kan kodem sheshshachatu vezarku alav kan leachar sheshshachatu vezarku alav
Amar leh rav adda bar matna lerava achar sheshshachatu vezarku et damo ma dahava hava amar leh ravina achilat pesachim meakkeva midderabba bar rav huna amar leh tzayet may dekaamar lach rabbach
May derabba bar rav huna detanya yom shemua keom kevura lemitzvat shiva ushloshim velaachilat pesachim keom likut atzamot echad ze veechad ze tovel veochel bakkodashim laerev

Ha gufah kashya amratte yom shemua keom kevura lemitzvat shiva ushloshim velaachilat pesachim keom likut atzamot mikkelal deom kevura afilu laerev name la achel vahadar tane echad ze veechad ze tovel veochel bakkodashim laerev
Amar rav chisda tannae hi

Rabba bar rav huna amar la kashya kan sheshshama shemua al meto samuch lishkiat hachamma vechen shelliktu lo atzamot samuch lishkiat hachamma vechen shemmet lo met ukvaro samuch lishkiat hachamma vechan leachar shekiat hachamma
Leachar shekiat hachamma may dahava hava ella shema minah achilat pesachim meakkeva
Rav ashe amar may echad ze veechad ze hachi kaamar echad yom shemua veechad yom likut tovel veochel bakkodashim laerev
Veha derav ashe beduta hi mikkede alah kae ze vaze mibe leh ella shema minah beduta hi
Umay tannae detanya ad matay mitonen alav kol hayyom rabbi omer kol zeman shello nikbar
Bemay askinan ilema beom mita mi ika delet leh deom mita detafes lelo midderabbanan
Vetu rabbi omer kol zeman shello nikbar ha kevaro ishteri leh umi ika delet leh veacharitah keom mar
Amar rav sheshet ayyom kevura kae

Matkef rav yosef ella ha dekatane hashshomea al meto kimlakket atzamot tovel veochel bakkodashim laerev mikkelal deom kevura afilu laerev name la achel ha manni ella taretz ad matay mitonnin alav kol oto hayyom velelo rabbi omer kol zeman shello nikbar aval nikbar belo lelo

Amruha kammeh derabbi yirmeya amar gavra rabba kerav yosef lema hachi lema derabbi lekulla vehatanya ad matay mitonen alav kol zeman sheeno nikbar afilu mikkan vead asara yamim divre rabbi vachachamim omrim en mitonen alav ella oto hayyom bilvad
Ella taretz hachi ad matay hu mitonen alav kol oto hayyom belo lelo rabbi omer kol zeman shello nikbar veim nikbar tofes lelo
Amruha kammeh derava middekaamar rabbi yom kevura tofes lelo midderabbanan mikkelal deom mita tofes lelo middeorayeta

Vesavar rabbi aninut layela deorayeta vehatanya hen hayyom ani hayyom asur velayela muttar uldorot ben bayyom uven ballayela asur divre rabbi yehuda rabbi omer aninut layela enah middivre tora ella middivre sofrim
Leolam derabbanan hi

a: Vachachamim asu chizuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora
Tanu rabbanan ki chen tzuveti kaasher tziveti kaasher tziva Adonai ki chen tzuveti baaninut yochluha kaasher tziveti bishat maase amar lahen kaasher tziva Adonai lo meelay ani omer
Urminhi mippene aninut nisrefa lechach neemar kaelle
Amar shemuel la kashya ha rabbi yehuda ha rabbi nechemya

Detanya mippene aninut serafuha lechach neemar kaelle divre rabbi nechemya rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim mippene tuma nisrefa sheim atta omer mippene aninut nisrefa hau haya lishloshtan sheyyissarfu davar acher hau haya rauy leochlan laerev davar acher vahalo pinchas haya immahen
Rava amar ide veide rabbi nechemya vela kashya kan bekodshe shaa kan bekodshe dorot
Rabbi nechemya hechi metaretz lehane kerae verabbanan hechi metartzi lehu lehane kerae

Rabbi nechemya metaretz lehu hachi maddua lo achaltem amar lo moshe leaharon shemma nichnas damah lifnay velifnim amar lo hen lo huva et damah shemma chutz limchitzatah yatzat amar lo bakkodesh hayeta
Vedilma baaninut akrevtuha ufsaltuha amar lo moshe vechi hem hikrivu ani hikravti veamar lo hen lo huva et damah uvakkodesh hayata achol tochlu otah kaasher tziveti baaninut yochluha
Amar lo vattikrena oti kaelle veachalti chattat hayyom hayyitav beene Adonai shemma lo shamata ella bekodshe shaa
Dei bekodshe dorot kal vechomer mimmaaser hakkal uma maaser hakkal amra tora lo achalti veoni mimmennu bekodshe dorot lo kol shekken
Miyyad vayyishma moshe vayyitav beenav hoda velo bosh moshe lomar lo shamati ella amar shamati veshachachti

Verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hechi metartzi lehu hachi metartzi lehu maddua lo achaltem et hachattat bimkom hakkodesh shemma nichnas damah lifnay velifnim amar lo hen lo huva et damah el hakkodesh penima
Shemma chutz limchitzatah yatzat amar lo hen bakkodesh hayeta vedilma baaninut akrevtuha ufsaltuha amar lo moshe hen hikrivuha defasla behu aninut ani hikravtiha
Vedilma aggav merarayechu peshatu bah veitammay amar lo moshe kach ani beenecha sheani mevazze kodshe shamayim vattikrena oti kaelle vaafilu elle vechaelle en ani mevazze kodshe shamayim
Amar lo vei hen lo huva et damah uvakkodesh hayeta achol tochlu otah bakkodesh kaasher tziveti baaninut yochluha
Amar lo shemma lo shamata ella ballayela dei bayyom kal vachomer mimmaaser hakkal uma maaser hakkal amra tora lo achalti veoni mimmennu kodesh chamur lo kol shekken
Miyyad vayyishma moshe
b: Vayyitav beenav lo bosh moshe lomar lo shamati ella shamati veshachachti
Ibi lehu leshahoyah ulmechlah beurta tuma beones bata
Bishlama lerabbanan hayenu dichtiv hayyom ella lerabbi nechemya may hayyom chovat hayyom
Bishlama lerabbi nechemya hayenu dichtiv hen hayyom ella lerabbanan may hen hayyom hachi kaamar hen hikrivu ani hikravti
Amar mar hau haya lishloshtan sheyyissarfu may shelashtan
Detanya veet seir hachattat darosh darash moshe seir zo sair nachshon chattat zo chattat shemini darash sair shel rosh chodesh

Yachol shelashtan nisrefu talmud lomar vehinne soraf echad nisraf velo shelashtan nisrefu darosh darash shette derishot lamma amar lehu mippene ma chattat zo nisrefa veellu munnachot veeni yodea ezehu keshehu omer veotah natan lachem laset et aon haeda heve omer ze sair shel rosh chodesh
Shappir kaamri leh rabbi nechemya letameh deamar kodshe shaa la pasla behu aninut
Amar mar haya lo leochlah laerev shappir kaamri leh kasavar aninut layela deorayeta

Davar acher vahalo pinchas haya immahen shappir kaamri leh savar lah kerabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina lo nitkahen pinchas ad sheharago lezimri dichtiv vehayeta lo ulzaro acharav berit kehunnat olam
Rav ashe amar ad shessam shalom ben hashshevatim shenneemar vayyishma pinchas hakkohen unsie haeda verashe alfe yisrael vego
Veidach name vehachtiv vehayeta lo ulzaro acharav ki chetiv hahu bivracha hu dichtiv
Veidach name ha ketiv vayyishma pinchas hakkohen hahu leyaches zaro acharav
Amar rav moshe rabbenu kohen gadol vecholek bekodshe shamayim haya shenneemar meel hammilluim lemoshe haya lemana
Metivi vahalo pinchas haya immahen veim ita lema vahalo moshe rabbenu haya immahen dilma shane moshe ditrid bishchina deamar mar moshe behashkama ala uvhashkama yarad
Metivi lechem elohav mikkodshe hakkodashim umin hakkodashim yochel im neemru kodshe kadashim lamma neemru kadashim kallim veim neemru kadashim kallim lamma neemru kodshe kadashim

Ilu lo neemru kadashim kallim hayiti omer kodshe kadashim hu deochel shehare hutteru lezar velahen kadashim kallim lo yochal veilu lo neemru kodshe kadashim hayiti omer bekadashim kallim yehe ochel shehen kallim bekodshe kodashim lo yehe ochel lechach neemru kodshe kadashim ulchach neemru kadashim kallim
Katane miha shehare hutteru lezar velahen lav moshe amar rav sheshet la bevama lezar uchdivre haomer yesh mincha bevama
Metivi miryam mi hisgirah im tomar moshe hisgirah moshe zar hu

a: Veen zar roe et hannegaim veim tomar aharon hisgirah aharon karov hu veen karov roe et hannegaim ella kavod gadol chalak lah hakkadosh baruch hu lemiryam otah shaa ani kohen vaani masgirah ani choltah vaani potrah
Katane mihat moshe zar veen zar roe et hannegaim
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak shane marot negaim deaharon uvanav ketuvin bapparasha
Metivi chamesh semachot hayeta elisheva yetera al benot yisrael yevamah melech ishah kohen gadol benah segan ben benah meshuach milchama veachiha nesi shevet vaavela al shene baneha
Katane mihat yevamah melech melech in kohen gadol la ema af melech
Ketannae vayyichar af Adonai bemoshe rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer kol charon af shebbattora neemar bo roshem veze lo neemar bo roshem
Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer af ze neemar bo roshem shenneemar halo aharon achicha hallevi vahalo kohen hu hachi kaamar ani amarti atta kohen vehu levi achshav hu kohen veatta levi

Vachachamim omrim lo nitkahen moshe ella shivat yeme hammilluim bilvad veyesh omrim lo paska kehunna ella mizzaro shel moshe shenneemar umoshe ish haelohim banav yikkaru al shevet hallevi veomer moshe veaharon bechohanav ushmuel bekore shemo
May veomer vechi tema ledorot hu dichtiv veomer moshe veaharon bechohanav
Vechol charon af shebbattora neemar bo roshem vehachtiv vayyetze moshe meim paro bochori af vela amar leh vela mide amar resh lakish setaro veyatza
Umi amar resh lakish hachi vehachtiv venitztzavta likrato al sefat hayeor veamar resh lakish melech hu vehasber lo panim verabbi yochanan amar rasha hu vehaez panecha bo efoch
Amar rabbi yannay leolam tehe emat malchut alecha dichtiv veyardu chol avadecha elle elay veilu ledideh la kaamar leh
Rabbi yochanan amar mehacha veyad Adonai hayeta el eliyyahu vayeshannes motnav vayyarotz lifne achav
Amar ulla bikkesh moshe malchut velo natnu lo dichtiv al tikrav halom veen halom ella malchut shenneemar mi anochi Adonai elohim vego ki haviotani ad halom
Metiv rava rabbi yishmael omer yevamah melech amar rava lo ulzaro kaamar
Vechol hecha dichtiv halom ledorot hu veha gabbe shaul dichtiv hava od halom ish hu in zaro la
Ibaet ema ha hava ish boshet veibaet ema shane shaul daafilu begaveh la kaem

Kidrabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina beshaa shepposkim gedulla laadam poskim lo ulzaro ad sof kol haddorot shenneemar lo yigra mitztzaddik enav veet melachim lakkisse vego veim heges dato hakkadosh baruch hu mashpilo shenneemar veim asurim bazzikkim yillachdun bechavle oni
Baale mumin ben baale mumin ku mena hane mile detanu rabbanan kol zachar lerabbot baale mumin
Lemay i laachila hare kevar neemar lechem elohav mikkodshe hakkodashim yochel ella lachalukka
Tanya idach kol zachar lerabbot baale mumin lemay i laachila hare kevar amur i lachalukka hare kevar amur sheyyachol en li ella tam venaasa baal mum baal mum meikaro minnayin talmud lomar kol zachar

Tanya idach kol zachar lerabbot baal mum lemay i laachila hare kevar amur vei lachalukka hare kevar amur vei levaal mum meikaro hare kevar amur sheyyachol en li ella baal mum kavua baal mum over minnayin talmud lomar kol zachar
Kelappe leya amar rav sheshet efoch
Rav ashe amar leolam la tefoch veitzterich salka datach amena
b: Ki tame ma tame kamma dela tahor la achel af hay name kamma dela mittekan la achel ka mashma lan
Kol sheeno rauy vechu vela vahare baal mum delo rauy laavoda vecholek vetu ha rauy laavoda cholek hare tame bekorbenot tzibur derauy laavoda veeno cholek
Rauy laachila kaamar
Vahare katan derauy laachila veeno cholek ha la katane
Hashta deatet lehachi leolam kidkaamratte meikara i mishshum tame tame la katane vei mishshum baal mum rachamana rabbeyeh
Afilu tame bishat zerikat damim vetahor bishat hekter chalavim eno cholek ha tahor bishat zerikat damim vetame bishat hekter chalavim cholek

Matnitin dela keabba shaul detanya abba shaul omer leolam eno ochel ad sheyehe tahor mishsheat zerika ad sheat hekter chalavim deamar kera hammakriv et dam hashshelamim veet hachelev daafilu hekter chalavim name bae
Bae rav ashe nitma bentayim mahu bishat zerika uvishat haktara baenan vehaika o dilma ad sheyehe tahor mishsheat zerika vead sheat hekter chalavim teku
Amar rava hay dina merabbi elazar berabbi shimon gemirna deamar bevet hakkisse dantah ba tevul yom veamar ten li mimmincha veochal
Amar lo uma im bimkom sheyyippa kochacha bechattatecha dechitich mechattat yisrael mekom shehora kochacha beminchatecha eno din sheedchacha mimminchat yisrael
Uma im dechitani mechattat yisrael shekkeshem sheyyippa kochi kach yippa kochecha tidcheni mimmincha mimminchat yisrael shekkeshem shehora kochi kach hora kochecha
Hare hu omer lakkohen hammakriv otah lo tihye bo hakrev veechol
Ten li mechattat yisrael veochal
Amar lo uma bimkom shehora kochi beminchati dechitich mimminchat yisrael mekom sheyyippa kochi bechattati eno din sheedchacha mechattat yisrael
Amar lo uma im sheddechitani mimminchat yisrael shekkeshem shehora kochecha kach hora kochi tidcheni mechattat yisrael shekkeshem sheyyippa kochecha kach yippa kochi
Hare hu omer hakkohen hamchatte otah yochlenna bo chatte veechol
Amar lo ten li mechaze vashok veochal
Amar lo uma bimkom sheyyippa kochacha bechattatecha dechitich mechattat yisrael mechaze vashok mekom shehora kochacha bishlamim sheen lach bahen ella chaze vashok eno din sheedchacha
Ma im dechitani mechattat shekken hora kochi etzel nashay vaavaday tidcheni mechaze vashok shekken yippa kochi etzel nashay vaavaday
Hare hu omer lakkohen hazzorek et dam hashshelamim lo yihye bo zerok veechol
Yatza tevul yom kullav vachamurav al rosho onen mimino mechussar kappara missemolo
Parech rav achay lema leh ten li mibbechor veochal
Mishshum deamar leh uma bimkom shehora kochi bechattat etzel nashay vaavaday dechitich mechattat yisrael mekom sheyyippa kochi bivchor dechulleh dili hi eno din sheedchacha mimmennu
Uma im dechitani mechattat shekkeshem shehora kochacha kach hora kochi tidcheni mibbechor shekkeshem sheyyippa kochacha kach yippa kochi
Hare hu omer et damam tizrok al hammizbeach veet chelbam taktir uvsaram yihye lecha bo zerok veechol
Veidach parech mi ketiv uvsaram lakkohen hazzorek uvsaram yihye lach ketiv afilu lechohen acher
Vehechi aved hachi vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan bechol mekom muttar leharher chutz mimmerchatz umibbet hakkisse leonso shane

a: Matni kol shello zacha hammizbeach bivsarah lo zachu kohanim beorah shenneemar olat ish ola shealta laish
Ola shennishchata shello lishmah af al pi shello alta labbealim orah lakkohanim echad olat haish veechad olat haishsha orotehen lechohanim

Orot kadashim kallim livalim orot kodshe kadashim lechohanim kal vachomer uma im ola shello zachu bivsarah zachu beorah kodshe kadashim shezzachu bivsarah eno din sheyyizku beorah en mizbeach yochiach sheen lo or bechol makom
Gema tanu rabbanan olat ish perat leolat hekdesh divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer perat leolat gerim
May perat leolat hekdesh amar rabbi chiyya bar yosef perat leola havaa min hammotarot
Hanicha leman deamar motarot lenidvat tzibur azli ella leman deamar motarot lenidvat yachid azli may ika lememar
Kidamar rava haola ola rishona hacha name haola ola rishona
Rabbi ayevu amar rabbi yannay perat lematpis ola levedek habbayit
La mibaya leman deamar kodshe bedek habbayit tafsi middeorayeta ella afilu leman deamar la tafsi hane mile basar aval or tafes
Vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh perat leola havaa min hammotarot
Amar leh rav hamnuna lerav nachman keman kerabbi yehuda ha hadar beh detanya shishsha lindava leola havaa min hammotarot shello yehu kohanim zakkain beorah divre rabbi yehuda

Amar lo rabbi nechemya veamri lah rabbi shimon im ken bitalta midrasho shel yehoyada hakkohen detanya ze midrash darash yehoyada hakkohen asham hu ashom asham la kol shebba mishshum chattat umishshum asham yillakach bo olot habbasar lashshem orah lakkohanim
Amar leh ella mar bemay mokem lah amar leh mokemna leh bemakdish nechasav

Vechidrabbi yehoshua ditnan hammakdish nechasav vehau bahen behemot haruot legabbe mizbeach zecharim unkevot rabbi eliezer omer zecharim yimmachru letzorche olot nekevot yimmachru letzorche zivche shelamim udmehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit
Rabbi yehoshua omer zecharim atzmam yikkarvu olot unkevot yimmachru letzorche shelamim veyavi bidmehen olot ushar nechasim yippelu levedek habbayit
Vaafilu lerabbi yehoshua deamar adam cholek hekdesho hane mile basar aval or tafes
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer perat leolat gerim amar leh rav simay bar chilkay leravina attu ger lav ish hu amar leh perat leger shemmet veen lo yorshim
Tanu rabbanan olat ish en li ella olat ish olat gerim nashim vaavadim minnayin talmud lomar or haola riba
Veim ken ma talmud lomar olat ish ola shealta leish perat leshennishchata chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah shello yehu hakkohanim zakkain beorah
Yachol sheani merabbe shennishchata shello lishmah hoil velo alta labbealim
b: Lo yehu kohanim zakkain beorah talmud lomar or haola mikkol makom
Or haola en li ella or haola orot kodshe kadashim minnayin talmud lomar or haola asher hikriv yachol sheani merabbe af kadashim kallim talmud lomar ola ma ola kodshe kadashim af kol kodshe kadashim
Rabbi yishmael omer or haola en li ella haola orot kodshe kadashim minnayin vedin hu uma ola shello zachu bivsarah zachu beorah kodshe kadashim shezzachu bivsaran eno din shezzachu beoran
Mizbeach yochiach shezzacha bevasar velo zacha beor ma lemizbeach shekken lo zacha bemiktzat tomar bakkohanim shezzachu bemiktzat hoil vezachu bemiktzat zachu bechulleh
Rabbi omer kol atzmo lo hutzrachnu ella leor haola bilvad shebbechol makom haor mehallech achar habbasar

Parim hannisrafin usirim hannisrafin hen veorotehen nisrafin immahen chattat veasham vezivche shalme tzibur mattana lakkohen ratzu mafshitin otan lo ratzu ochlin otan al gabbe oran kadashim kallim labbealim ratzu mafshitin otan ratzu ochlin otan al gav oran
Aval ola neemar vah vehifshit et haola venittach otah lintacheha yachol lo yehu hakkohanim zakkain beorah talmud lomar or haola asher hikriv
Lo yihye perat litvul yom umchussar kipurim veonen sheyyachol lo yizku bevasar shehu laachila yizku beor sheeno laachila talmud lomar lo yihye perat limchussar kipurim utvul yom veonen
Vetanna kamma name tipok li middina milta deatya bekal vechomer tarach vechatav lah kera
Verabbi yishmael hay asher hikriv may aved leh perat litvul yom umchussar kipurim veonen
Vetipok leh milo yihye rabbi yishmael letameh deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael neemar beole lo yihye veneemar beasham lo yihye ma lehallan atzmotav muttarin af kan atzmotav muttarin
Mufne dei la mufne ika lemifrach ma leasham shekken besaro muttar lo yihye kera yattira hu

Matni kol hakkodashim sheera bahen pesul kodem lehefshetan en orotehen lakkohanim leachar hefshetan orotehen lechohanim amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim miyyamay lo raiti or sheyyotze levet hasserefa
Amar rabbi akiva middevarav lamadnu shehammafshit et habbechor venimtza terefa sheyyeotu hakkohanim beoro vachachamim omrim en lo rainu reaya ella yetze levet hasserefa
Gema kol shello zacha hammizbeach bivsarah lo zachu hakkohanim beorah veaf al gav deappeshateh leor kodem zerika manni rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi deamar en haddam meratztze al haor bifne atzmo
