Ema sefa kol hakkodashim sheera bahen pesul kodem hefshetan en orotehen lechohanim leachar hefshetan orotehen lechohanim atan lerabbi deamar haddam meratztze al haor bifne atzmo resha rabbi elazar berabbi shimon sefa rabbi
Amar abbaye middesefa rabbi hi resha name rabbi hi umode rabbi sheen hefshet kodem zerika
Rava amar midderesha rabbi elazar berabbi shimon sefa name rabbi elazar berabbi shimon may kodem hefshet

a: Umay acher hefshet kodem shenniru lehefshet achar shenniru lehefshet
May rabbi umay rabbi elazar berabbi shimon detanya rabbi omer haddam meratztze al haor bifne atzmo uchshehu im habbasar nolad bo pesul ben kodem zerika ben leachar zerika hare hu keotze bo

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer en haddam meratztze al haor bifne atzmo uchshehu im habbasar nolad bo pesul kodem zerika hare hu keotze bo achar zerika hurtza basar shaa achat yafshitennu veoro lakkohanim
Lema bidrabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua kamipalgi veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam rabbi yehoshua omer im en dam en basar im en basar en dam

Rabbi eliezer omer dam af al pi sheen basar shenneemar vedam zevachecha yishshafech im ken ma talmud lomar veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam lomar lecha ma dam bizrika af basar bizrika ha lamadta sherevach yesh ben kevesh lammizbeach
Lema man deamar hurtza kerabbi eliezer uman deamar lo hurtza kerabbi yehoshua
Alliba derabbi eliezer kulle alma la peligi ki peligi alliba derabbi yehoshua
Man deamar lo hurtza kerabbi yehoshua man deamar hurtza amar lach ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam ella bevasar deleka peseda lakkohanim aval or deika peseda lakkohanim afilu rabbi yehoshua mode
Mide dehave addiavad ditnan nitma basar o nifsal o sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim rabbi eliezer omer yizrok rabbi yehoshua omer lo yizrok umode rabbi yehoshua sheim zarak hurtza
Amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim ku velo hare parim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim
Lemitzvatan la kaamrinan
Hare kodem hefshet vekodem zerika chalutz kaamrinan
Vehaika achar hefshet vekodem zerika lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon deamar en haddam meratztze al haor bifne atzmo
Rabbi chanina kerabbi sevira leh veibaet ema afilu tokmah kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon mode rabbi sheen hefshet kodem zerika
Vehaika nimtzet terefa bivne meayim
Kasavar nimtzet terefa bivne meayim meratztze dayeka name dekatane amar rabbi akiva middevarav lamadnu shehammafshit et habbechor venimtza terefa sheyyeotu hakkohanim beoro shema minah
Veella may ka mashma lan rabbi akiva ha ka mashma lan afilu bigvulin
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi akiva veaf rabbi akiva lo amar ella keshehittiro mumche aval lo hittiro mumche lo
Vehilcheta kedivre chachamim basar bikvura vehaor bisrefa
Matni parim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim bizman shehen nisrafin kemitzvatan nisrafim bevet haddeshen umtammein begadim veim enan nisrafin kemitzvatan nisrafin bevet habbira veenan metammein begadim
b: Hau sovlin oto bemotot yatzu harishonim chutz lechomat haazara vehaacharonim lo yatzu harishonim metammein begadim vehaacharonim enan metammein begadim ad sheyyatzu yatzu ellu vaellu metammein begadim rabbi shimon omer enan metammein ad sheyyutztzat haur berubban nitach habbasar en hassoref metamme begadim
Gema may bira amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan makom yesh behar habbayit uvira shemo veresh lakish amar kol habbayit kullo karuy bira shenneemar veel habbira asher hachinoti

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh shelosha bet haddeshanin hen bet haddeshen gadol haya baazara sheshsham sorfin pesule kodshe kadashim veemure kadashim kallim ufarim hannisrafin usirim hannisrafin sheera bahen pesul kodem zerika
Uvet haddeshen acher haya behar habbayit sheshsham sorfin parim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim sheera bahen pesul achar zerika uchmitzvatan chutz leshalosh machanot

Tane levi shelosha bet haddeshanin hen bet haddeshen gadol haya baazara sheshsham sorfin pesule kodshe kadashim veemure kadashim kallim ufarim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim sheera bahen pesul ben kodem zerika ben leachar zerika uvet haddeshen acher haya behar habbayit sheshsham sorfin parim hannisrafin usirim hannisrafin sheera bahen pesul bitziatan uchmitzvatan chutz leshalosh machanot
Bae rabbi yirmeya lina mahu shettoil befarim hannisrafim uvisirim hannisrafim mi amrinan ki mahneya lina bevasar devar achila aval hane delav bene achila ninhu la o dilma la shena
Amar rava ha milta ibaya leh leabbaye ufshatna leh meha veshavin sheim chishev baachilat parim uvisrefatan shello asa kelum may lav middemachshava la pasla lina name la pasla
Vedilma machshava hu dela pasla aval lina pasla
Ta shema parim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafin moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu nishchatu huchsheru lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kipurim uvlina may lav linat basar
La linat emurin
Veha middekatane sefa kullan moalin bahen bevet haddeshen ad sheyyuttach habbasar middesefa basar resha name basar mide irya sefa basar resha emurin
Ta shema detane levi sheera bahen pesul bitziatan may lav lina la pesul tuma ufsul yetzia
Bae rabbi elazar yetzia mahu shettoil befarim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim
May kamibaya leh amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba alliba deman deamar adayin lo higgia zemanno latzet
Mi amrinan hane mile basar deen sofo latzet chova aval hane desofan latzet chova la o dilma hacha name lo higgia zemanno latzet
Ta shema detane levi sheera bo pesul bitziato may lav pasul yetzia la pesul tuma ufsul lina
Bae rabbi elazar parim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim sheyyatza rubbo rubban bemiut ever mahu hach miuta deever batar rubba shadenan leh veha la nafka leh o dilma batar rubba divhema shadenan
Peshita dela shavkinan rubba divhema veazlinan batar rubba deevarim ella sheyyatza chetzo berov ever hay miuta deever

a: Batar rov ever shadenan leh veha nefak leh o dilma batar behema shadenan leh teku
Rabba bar rav huna matne lah begavre bemitassekin bo chamishsha bene adam unfaku telata ufashu lehu tere may batar rov mitassekin azlinan o vatar behema azlinan teku
Bae rabbi elazar parim usirim hannisrafim sheyyatzu vechazru mahu mi amrinan kevan denafki lehu itammo lehu o dilma kevan dahadur hadur

Amar rabbi abba bar memel ta shema hau sovlin otan bemotot harishonim yatzu chutz lechomat haazara vehaacharonim lo yatzu harishonim sheyyatzu chutz lechomat haazara metammein begadim vehaacharonim en metammein begadim ad sheyyatzu vei salka datach kevan denafki lehu itammo hanach deika gavay litame litammo
Amar ravina vetisbera ha baena veachar yavo el hammachane veleka
Ella rabbi elazar hechi bae lah kegon dinkiti lah bevakulse

Tanu rabbanan parim ufara vesair hammishtalleach hamshalleach hassorfan vehammotzian metamme begadim vehen atzman en metammein begadim aval metammein ochalin umashkin divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim para ufarim metammein ochalin umashkin sair hammishtalleach eno metamme shehu chay vehachay eno metamme ochalin umashkin
Bishlama lerabbi meir kidtana deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael al kol zera zerua
Ma zeraim sheen sofan letamme tuma chamura utzrichin hechsher af kol sheen sofan letamme tuma chamura tzerichin hechsher yatzta nivlat of tahor shessofah letamme tuma chamura veen tzericha hechsher
Ella lerabbanan i it lehu detana deve rabbi yishmael afilu sair hammishtalleach i let leh afilu para ufarim menalan
Ki ata rav dimi amar amri bemareva tzerichin hechsher tuma mimmakom acher
Bae rabbi elazar parim usirim hannisrafim mahu sheyetammeu ochalin umashkin bifnim kevachutz mechussar yetzia kimchussar maase dame o la
Batar devaya hadar pashtah mechussar yetzia kimchussar maase dame
Bea mineh rabbi abba bar shemuel merabbi chiyya bar abba nivlat of tahor lerabbi meir mahu shettetamme bichzayit
Demachata leara la tibe lach denaket befummeh la tibe lach ki tibe lach denaket leh bideh mechussar keriva kimchussar maase dame o la
Batar devaya hadar pashtah
b: Mechussar keriva lav kimchussar maase dame
Etiveh shelosha asar devarim neemru benivlat of tahor veze echad mehen tzericha machshava veen tzericha hechsher umtamme tumat ochalin bichvetza may lav rabbi meir hi
La rabbanan hi
Veha katane resha tzericha machshava veen tzericha hechsher uman shamatte leh hay sevara rabbi meir umidderesha rabbi meir sefa name rabbi meir
Mide irya ha kidita veha kidita
Veha middekatane sefa shechitatah umlikatah metaheret terefatah mittumatah man shamatte leh hay sevara rabbi meir resha vesefa rabbi meir umtziata rabbanan
In resha vesefa rabbi meir umtziata rabbanan
Amar leh rav hamnuna lerabbi zera la titev akkarach ad deamratte li ha milta nivlat of tahor lerabbi meir monin lah rishon vesheni o en monin rishon vesheni
Amar leh kol hecha dimtamme adam bemagga monin bo rishon vesheni kol hecha deen metamme adam bemagga en monin bo rishon vesheni
Bea mineh rabbi zera merabbi amme bar chiyya veamri lah merabbi avin bar kahana ha ditnan chibure ochlin al yede mashkin chibur letuma kalla veen chibur letuma chamura
Monin bo rishon vesheni o en monin bo rishon vesheni
Amar leh kol hecha dimtamme adam monin bo rishon vesheni en metamme adam en monin bo rishon vesheni
Yatzu ellu vaellu mena hane mile detanu rabbanan lehallan hu omer chutz leshalosh machanot kan lemachane achat lomar lach kevan sheyyatza chutz lemachane achat metamme begadim
Vehi gufah menalan detanu rabbanan vehotzi et kol happar el michutz lammachane chutz leshalosh machanot atta omer chutz leshalosh machanot o eno ella machane achat
Keshehu omer befar haeda michutz lammachane sheen tzarich lomar shehare kevar neemar kaasher saraf et happar harishon liten lo machane sheniyya
Keshehu omer michutz lammachane baddeshen sheen tzarich lomar shehare kevar neemar al shefech haddeshen yissaref liten lo machane shelishit

Verabbi shimon hay michutz lemachane may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya rabbi eliezer omer neemar kan chutz lammachane veneemar lehallan chutz lammachane ma lehallan chutz leshalosh machanot af kan chutz leshalosh machanot uma lehallan lemizrachah shel yerushalayim

a: Af kan lemizrachah shel yerushalayim
Ella lerabbanan hecha saref lehu kidtanya hechan nisrafin litzfon yerushalayim chutz leshalosh machanot rabbi yose haggelili omer abbet haddeshen nisrafin

Amar rava man tanna diflig aleh derabbi yose haggelili rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi detanya al shefech haddeshen yissaref sheyehe sham deshen sheyyakdim lesham deshen rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer sheyehe mekomo meshuppach
Amar leh abbaye dilma bimkomo meshuppach peligi
Tanu rabbanan hassoref metamme begadim velo hammatztzit et haur metamme begadim velo hamsadder et hammaaracha metamme begadim veezehu hassoref hamsayyea bishat serefa

Yachol af mishshennaasu efer metamme begadim talmud lomar otam otam metammein begadim umishshennaasin efer en metammein begadim rabbi shimon omer otam metammein begadim nitach habbasar en metammein begadim
May benayehu amar rava ika benayehu deshavveyeh charocha
Hadaran alach tevul yom
Matni hashshochet vehammaale bachutz chayyav al hashshechita vechayyav al haalaa
Rabbi yose haggelili omer shachat bifnim veheela bachutz shachat bachutz veheela bachutz patur shello heela ella davar pasul amru lo af hashshochet bifnim umaale bachutz kevan shehotzio pesalo

Hattame sheachal ben kodesh tame ben kodesh tahor chayyav rabbi yose haggelili omer tame sheachal tahor chayyav vetame sheachal tame patur shello achal ella davar tame amru lo af tame sheachal et hattahor kevan shennaga bo timmeohu
Vetahor sheachal tame patur sheeno chayyav ella al tumat hagguf

Gema bishlama heela ketiv onesh uchtiv azhara onesh dichtiv veel petach ohel moed lo hevio azhara dichtiv hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha vechi ha deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi elazar kol makom shenneemar hishshamer pen veal eno ella lo taase
Ella shechita bishlama onesh dichtiv veel petach ohel moed lo hevio ella azhara menalan amar kera velo yizbechu od

Hay mibe leh lechidrabbi elazar deamar minnayin lazzoveach behema lemarkulis shehu chayyav dichtiv velo yizbechu od et zivchehem im eno inyan lichdarkah dichtiv echa yaavdu tenehu inyan leshello kedarkah
Amar rabba keri beh velo yizbechu ukri beh velo od
Akkatti mibe leh lechidtanya ad kan hu medabber bekadashim shehikdishan bishat isur habbamot vehikrivan bishat isur habbamot
b: Shehare onshan amur veel petach ohel moed azhara dichtiv hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha
Mikkan veelach bizvachim shehikdishan bishat heter habbamot vehikrivan bishat isur habbamot

Shenneemar lemaan asher yaviu bene yisrael et zivchehem asher hem zovchim zevachim shehittarti lecha kevar al pene hassade lomar lach hazzoveach bishat isur habbamot maale alav hakkatuv keilu hikriv al pene hassade
Vehevium la zo mitzvat ase lo taase minnayin talmud lomar velo yizbechu od
Yachol yehe anush karet talmud lomar chukkat olam tihye zot lahem ledorotam zot lahem velo acheret lahem
Ella amar rabbi avin kal vachomer uma bimkom shello anash hizhir mekom sheanash eno din shehizhir
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe im ken lo yeamer lav bechelev vetete kal vachomer minnevela ma nevela shello anash hizhir chelev sheanash eno din shehizhir
Ata lekammeh derava amar leh minnevela name la atya deika lemifrach ma linvela shekken metamme
Mishsheratzim temein ma lishratzim temein shemmetammein bemashshehu
Mishsheratzim tehorim ma lishratzim tehorim sheisuran bemashshehu
Meorla vechile hakkerem ma leorla vechile hakkerem shekken asurin bahanaa
Mishsheviit ma lishviit shekken tofeset dameha
Mitteruma shekken lo huttar mikkelalah mikkullehu name shekken lo hutteru mikkelalan
Amar rava i kashya li ha kashya li ha ditnan pesach umila mitzvat ase
Tete bekal vachomer mimmotir ma motir shello anash hizhir pesach umila sheanash eno din shehizhir
Amar rav ashe amritah lishmata kammeh derav kahana veamar li mimmotir la atya deika lemifrach ma lemotir shekken en lo takkana tomar pesach yesh lo takkana
Vechi mazhirin min haddin afilu leman deamar onshin min haddin en mazhirin min haddin
Ella kidrabbi yochanan deamar atya havaahhavaa
Ma lehallan lo anash ella im ken hizhir af kan lo anash ella im ken hizhir

a: Rava amar kidrabbi yona deamar rabbi yona atya shamsham ma lehallan lo anash ella im ken hizhir af kan lo anash ella im ken hizhir
Ashkechan muktere penim sheheelan lachutz muktere chutz sheheelan lachutz minnayin
Amar rav kahana amar kera vaalehem tomar al hassemuchin tomar
Matkef lah rava mi ketiv vaalehem vaalehem ketiv ella kidtana deve rabbi yishmael vaalehem tomar learev parashiyyot
Rabbi yochanan amar atya havaahhavaa ma lehallan muktere chutz af kan muktere chutz
Matkef lah rav bivi ha ditnan sheloshim veshesh karetot betora telatin veshav haveyan deika hammaale vehammaale kashya
Vehaditnan hazzorek miktzat damim bachutz chayyav menalan nafka leh middetanya dam yechashev lerabbot hazzorek divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer o zavach lerabbot et hazzorek
Verabbi yishmael hay o zavach may aved leh lechallek
Verabbi akiva lechallek mena leh nafka leh millo yeviennu
Verabbi yishmael hahu mibe leh al hashshalem hu chayyav veeno chayyav al hechaser verabbi akiva nafka leh millaasot oto

Verabbi yishmael chad lemuktere penim shechasru veheelan bachutz vechad lemuktere chutz shechasru veheelu veheelan bachutz veha tanya rabbi yishmael omer yachol muktere panim shechasru veheelu veheelan bachutz chayyav talmud lomar laasot oto al hashshalem chayyav veeno chayyav al hechaser
Verabbi akiva muktere penim shechasru veheelu veheelan bachutz chayyav
Verabbi akiva hay dam yechashev may aved leh lerabbot shechitat haof verabbi yishmael nafka leh meo asher yishchat
Verabbi akiva amar lach hahu mibe leh al hashshochet hu chayyav velo al hammolek verabbi yishmael nafka leh mizze haddavar
Detanya asher yishchat en li ella shochet behema shachat of mena lan talmud lomar o asher yishchat
Yachol af hammolek vedin hu ma shechita deen derech hechsherah bifnim chayyav melika shedderech hechsherah befanim eno din shehu chayyav talmud lomar ze haddavar
Verabbi akiva amar lach hahu mibe leh ligzera shava
Veha ditnan hakkometz vehamkabbel damim bachutz patur menalan umehecha tete dechayyav
Tete mishshechita ma lishchita shekken nifselet shello leochlin befesach
Tete mizzerika ma lizrika shekken zar chayyav aleha mita
b: Tete mibbenayya
Im ken lo yeamer bizrika vetete mibbenayya
Vetete mishshechita ma lishchita shekken nifselet shello leshem ochlin bappesach tete mehaalaa ma lehaalaa shekken yeshnah bammincha vetete mibbenayya
Lehachi ketiv kera lememar dela ata mibbenayya
Amar rabbi avahu shachat vezarak ledivre rabbi yishmael chayyav achat ledivre rabbi akiva chayyav shettayim
Abbaye amar afilu ledivre rabbi akiva eno chayyav ella achat deamar kera sham taase hakkatuv asaan lechullan avoda achat
Zarak veheela ledivre rabbi yishmael chayyav shettayim ledivre rabbi akiva eno chayyav ella achat
Abbaye amar afilu ledivre rabbi akiva chayyav shettayim lehachi palginhu kera sham taale vesham taase
Shachat vezarak veheela ledivre hakkol chayyav shettayim
Tanu rabbanan bammachane yachol hashshochet ola baddarom yehe chayyav talmud lomar el michutz lammachane
Yachol chutz leshalosh machanot talmud lomar o ez bammachane minnayin af bemachane leviyya talmud lomar bammachane
I bammachane yachol hashshochet ola baddarom yehe chayyav talmud lomar o el michutz lammachane
Ma chutz lammachane meuchad sheen rauy lishchitat kadashim velishchitat kol zevach yatza darom sheaf al pi sheen rauy lishchitat kodshe kadashim rauy lishchitat kadashim kallim

Amar ulla hashshochet al gaggo shel hechal chayyav hoil veen rauy lishchitat kol zevach matkef lah rava im ken nichtov kera el michutz lammachane vela bae el petach ohel moed el petach ohel moed lema li lav lemaote gaggo
Ulrava im ken nichtov el petach ohel moed bammachane veel michutz lammachane lema li lav leetoye gaggo
Amar rav mari leetoye kullah bifnim vetzavarah bachutz
Tzavarah bachutz peshita ammay kafed rachamana ashshechita ushchita bachutz hi ella leetoye kullah bachutz vetzavarah bifnim
Itmar hammaale bizman hazze rabbi yochanan amar chayyav resh lakish amar patur
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyav kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah vekidsha leatid lavo resh lakish amar patur kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah velo kidsha leatid lavo

Nema deviflugta derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua kamipalgi ditnan amar rabbi eliezer keshehau bonin bahechal hau osim kelaim bahechal kelaim baazarot ella shebbahechal bonin mibbachutz uvaazara bonin mibbifnim

Amar rabbi yehoshua shamati shehau makrivin af al pi sheen bayit veochlim kodshe kadashim af al pi sheen kelaim kadashim kallim umaaser sheni af al pi sheen choma mippene shekkedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah vekidsha leatid lavo
Lav mikkelal derabbi eliezer savar lo kidsha

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe mimmay dilma dechulle alma kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah vekidsha leatid lavo umar may dishmia leh kaamar umar may dishmia leh kaamar vechi tema kelaim lerabbi eliezer lema li litzniuta bealma
Itmar hammaale veen bo kezayit veetzem mashlimo lichzayit rabbi yochanan amar chayyav resh lakish amar patur
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyav chibure olin keolin dame resh lakish amar patur chibure olin lav keolin damu
Bae rava hammaale

a: Rosh ben yona sheen bo kezayit umelach mashlimo lichzayit mahu
Amar leh rava mipparzikya lerav ashe lav hayenu pelugtayehu derabbi yochanan veresh lakish tibe lerabbi yochanan vetibe leresh lakish

Tibe lerabbi yochanan ad kan la kaamar rabbi yochanan hatam ella etzem demina devasar hu aval melach delav mina devar yona hu la tibe leresh lakish ad kan la kaamar resh lakish hatam ella dei paresh mineh lav mitzva leassoke aval hacha dei paresh mitzva leassoke la o dilma la shena
Teku
Rabbi yose haggelili omer ku
Heshiv rabbi tachat rabbi yose haggelili ma leshochet bifnim umaale bachutz shehayeta lo sheat hakkosher tomar beshochet chutz umaale bachutz shello hayeta lo sheat hakkosher
Heshiv rabbi elazar berabbi shimon tachat rabbi yose haggelili ma leshochet bifnim umaale bachutz shekken kodesh mekabbelo tomar beshochet bachutz sheen kodesh mekabbelo
May benayehu amar zeeri shechitat layela ika benayehu
Rabba amar kabbala bichli chol ika benayehu
Tame sheachal ben kodesh ku
Shappir kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi yose haggelili
Amar rava kol hecha denitma tumat hagguf veachar kach nitma basar dechulle alma la peligi dechayyav shekken tumat hagguf becharet
Ki peligi keshennitma basar veachar kach nitma hagguf
Derabbanan savri amrinan migo verabbi yose haggelili savar la amrinan migo
Verabbi yose nehi demigo la amrinan tete tumat hagguf dachamira vetachul al tumat basar
Amar rav ashe mimmay detumat hagguf chamura dilma tumat basar chamura shekken en lah tohora bammikve
Matni chomer bashshechita mibbaaliyya uvaaliyya mibbashshechita
Chomer bashshechita shehashshochet lahedot chayyav vehammaale lahedot patur chomer baaliyya shenayim sheachazu besakkin veshachatu peturim achazu beever veheelu chayyavin
Heela chazar veheela vechazar veheela chayyav al kol aliyya divre rabbi shimon rabbi yose omer eno chayyav ella achat
Veeno chayyav ad sheyyaale lerosh hammizbeach rabbi shimon omer afilu heela al hassela o al haeven chayyav
Gema may shena hammaale lehedot defatur dichtiv la bashshechita name hachtiv la
Shane hatam deamar kera ish ish gabbe haalaa name ketiv ish ish mibe leh lishnayim sheheelu beever chayyavin
I hachi hacha name mibe leh lishnayim sheachazu besakkin veshachatu shechayyavin shane hatam deamar kera hahu echad velo shenayim
I hachi gabbe haalaa name ha ketiv hahu
b: Mibe leh lemaote shogeg anus umute i hachi hacha name mibe lemaote anus shogeg umute
Tere hahu ketivi
Veella la lema li lehotzi sair hammishtalleach
Chomer behaalaa ku

Tanu rabbanan ish ish ma talmud lomar shenayim sheachazu beever veheelu shechayyavin sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma hashshochet lehedot shechayyav shenayim sheachazu besakkin veshachatu peturin hammaale lehedot sheppatur eno din sheshshenayim sheachazu peturin talmud lomar ish ish divre rabbi shimon
Rabbi yose omer hahu echad velo shenayim im ken ma talmud lomar ish ish dibbera tora kilshon bene adam
Verabbi shimon hay hahu mibe leh lemaote shogeg anus mute verabbi yose mehuhahu verabbi shimon huhahu la daresh

Verabbi yose middehay ish ish dibbera tora chilshon bene adam hahu ish ish name dibbera tora chilshon bene adam veella hashshochet lehedot mena leh dechayyav nafka leh middam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach vaafilu hashshochet laish
Heela vechazar veheela ku

Amar resh lakish machloket bearbaa vachamishsha evarim demar savar ki ketiv laasot oto al hashshalem hu chayyav veeno chayyav al hechaser akkol behema ketiv umar savar akkol ever veever ketiv aval ever echad divre hakkol eno chayyav ella achat
Verabbi yochanan amar machloket beever echad demar savar muktere penim shechasru veheelan bachutz chayyav umar savar patur aval bearbaa vachamishsha evarin divre hakkol chayyav al kol ever veever

Ufliga deulla deamar ulla hakkol modim bemuktere penim shechasru veheelo veheelan bachutz shechayyav lo nechleku ella bemuktere bachutz shechasru veheelo veheelan bachutz demar savar patur umar savar chayyav

Ika deamri amar ulla hakkol modim bemuktere chutz shechasru veheelo veheelan bachutz shehu patur lo nechleku ella bemuktere penim shechasru veheelo veheelan bachutz demar savar patur umar savar chayyav
Ufligi ufliga daavuh dishmuel allishana kamma deulla deamar avuh dishmuel keman mahderinan pokin legabbe mizbeach keman dela kerabbi yose
Veeno chayyav ad sheyyaale ku amar rav huna may tama derabbi yose dichtiv vayyiven noach mizbeach la
Amar rabbi yochanan may tama derabbi shimon dichtiv vayyikkach manoach et gedi haizzim veet hammincha vayyaal al hatztzur la
Veidach name vehachtiv vayyiven mizbeach la hahu guvha bealma veidach name ha ketiv vayyikkach manoach horaat shaa hayeta
Veibaet ema hayenu tama derabbi shimon kidtanya rabbi shimon omer mizbeach petach ohel moed veen mizbeach bevama lefichach heela al hassela o al haeven chayyav
Yatza mibe leh hachi kaamar lefichach bishat isur habbamot heela al hassela o al haeven chayyav
Bae rabbi yose berabbi chanina keren vechevesh visod veribua mahu sheyeakkevu bevama
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya tanya keren vechevesh veribua visod meakkevin bevama gedola veen meakkevin bevama ketanna

a: Matni echad kodashim kesherin veechad kadashim pesulin shehaya pesulan bakkodesh vehikrivan bachutz chayyav
Hammaale kezayit min haola umin haemurin bachutz chayyav
Gema tanu rabbanan asher yaale ola o zavach en li ella ola minnayin lerabbot emure asham veemure chattat veemure kodshe kadashim veemure kadashim kallim talmud lomar zevach

Minnayin lerabbot hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach vehamnassech sheloshet luggin yayin ushloshet luggin mayim talmud lomar veel petach ohel moed lo yeviennu kol habba lefetach ohel moed chayyavin alav bachutz
Veen li ella kodashim kesherim minnayin lerabbot pesulin

Kegon hallan vehayyotze vehattame veshennishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damo vehannitanin lematta shennetanan lemala vehannitanin lemala shennetanan lematta vehannitanin bachutz shennetanan bifnim vehannitanin bifnim shennetanan bachutz ufesach vechattat shennetanan shello lishman
Minnayin talmud lomar lo yeviennu laasot kol hammitkabbel befetach ohel moed chayyavin alav bachutz
Hammaale kezayit min haola ku ola veemureha in shelamim veemurehen la
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan ola veemureha mitztarfin lichzayit lehaalotan bachutz ulchayyev alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame
Bishlama haalaat ola dechalil in shelamim la ella pigul venotar vetame may tama
Veha tenan kol happiggulin mitztarfin vechol hannotarin mitztarfin kashya pigul appigul kashya notar annotar
Pigul appigul la kashya kan befigul kan bemachshevet pigul
Notar annotar la kashya kan benotar kan beshennitotru ad shello nizrak haddam
Umanni rabbi yehoshua hi detanya rabbi yehoshua omer kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer bahen kezayit basar
b: Uchzayit chelev zorek et haddam
Chatzi zayit basar vachatzi zayit chelev eno zorek et haddam uvola chatzi zayit basar vachatzi zayit chelev zorek et haddam mippene shekkullah kalil umincha afilu kullah kayyemet lo yizrok
Mincha may avidtah amar rav pappa minchat nesachim habbaa im hazzevach

Matni hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim shehikriv meachat mehen kezayit bachutz chayyav rabbi eliezer poter ad sheyyakriv et kullan vechullan shehikriv bifnim veshiyyer mehen kezayit vehikrivo bachutz chayyav
Vechullan shechasru kol shehu vehikrivo bachutz patur
Hammakriv kadashim veemurim bachutz chayyav
Gema tanu rabbanan hammaktir kezayit bachutz chayyav chatzi feras bifnim patur
Ka salka datin may patur patur zar ammay haktara hi
Amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav may patur patur tzibur
Amar rabbi zera i kashya li ha kashya li ha deamar rav alah beha afilu rabbi eliezer mode deha rabbi eliezer lav haktara hi kaamar
Amar rabba behaktara dehechal dechulle alma la peligi
Ki peligi behaktara difnim demar savar melo chofnav daveka umar savar melo chofnav lav daveka
Amar leh abbaye veha ki ka chetiva chukka behaktara difnim hu dichtiv
Ella amar abbaye behaktara bifnim kulle alma la peligi
Ki peligi behaktara dechutz mar savar yalfinan penim michutz umar savar la yalfinan
Amar rava hashta chutz mechutz la yalfi rabbanan penim mechutz mibe

Ma hi detanya yachol hammaale pachot mikkezayit kometz ufachot mikkezayit emurin vehamnassech pachot mishsheloshet luggin yayin pachot mishshelosha luggin mayim yehe chayyav talmud lomar laasot al hashshalem chayyav veeno chayyav al hechaser
Veha pachot mishsheloshet luggin deit behu kamma zetim vela yalfi rabbanan chutz michutz
Ella amar rava kegon dekavinhu shene chatzae peras

a: Bemana mar savar keviut mana milta hi umar savar lav milta hi
Amar rava hashta leman deamar keviuta demana vela kelum hu kava shishsha lefar umashach mehen arbaa vehikrivan bachutz chayyav sheruyin leayil
Kava arbaa leayil umashach mehen shelosha vehikrivan bachutz chayyav sheruyin lecheves
Chasru kol shehu vehikrivan bachutz patur
Rav ashe amar nisuch mehaktara la yalfi rabbanan
Af al gav dechutz mechutz la yalfi haktara mehaktara yalfi af al gav dechutz mippenim
Vechullan shechasru ibaya lehu chesron dechutz shemeh chesron o la shemeh chesron
Mi amrinan kevan dinfak ipaslu lehu ma li chaser ma li yater o dilma yotze deiteh beeneh in deleteh beeneh la
Amar abbaye ta shema rabbi eliezer poter ad sheyyakriv et kullan
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanan leabbaye midderabbi eliezer pashet mar
Amar leh beferush shemia li mineh derav ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ella deiteh beeneh aval bechesron modu leh lav dachasar bachutz la dachasar bifnim
Ta shema vechullan shechasru vehikrivan bachutz patur lav dachasar bachutz la dachasar bifnim
Hammakriv kadashim ammay vehaika chatzitza
Amar shemuel keshehafachan
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu tema shello hafachan veha manni rabbi shimon hi deamar afilu heela al hassela chayyav
Rav amar min bemino eno chotzetz
Matni mincha shello nikmetza vehikrivah bachutz patur kematzah vechazar kumtzah letochah vehikrivo bachutz chayyav
Gema veammay livatteli livattelu shirayim lekometz
Amar rabbi zera neemra haktara bakkometz veneemra haktara bashshirayim ma haktarat kometz en kometz mevattel chavero af haktarat shirayim en shirayim mevattelin kometz
Matni hakkometz vehallevona shehikriv et echad mehen bachutz chayyav rabbi eliezer poter ad sheyyakriv et hashsheni echad bifnim veechad bachutz chayyav
Shene beziche levona shehikriv et echad mehem bachutz chayyav rabbi eliezer poter ad sheyyakriv et hashsheni echad bifnim veechad bachutz chayyav
Gema bae rabbi yitzchak nappacha kometz mahu sheyyattir kenegdo bashshirayim mishra share o ikkeloshe miklesh
Alliba deman i alliba derabbi meir deamar mefaggelin bachatzi mattir mishre share
I alliba derabbanan deamri en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir la mishra share vela ikkeloshe mikkelesh kalesh
Ella alliba derabbi eliezer rabbi eliezer kerabbanan sevira leh deamar en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir
Ella alliba derabbanan dehacha may mishra share o kalesh ikkeloshe mikkelesh
Teku
Matni hazzorek miktzat dam bachutz
b: Chayyav rabbi elazar omer af hamnassech me hechag bechag bachutz chayyav rabbi nechemya omer sheyare haddam shehikrivu shehikrivan bachutz chayyav
Gema amar rava umode rabbi elazar bedamim
Detanya rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim mimmakom sheppasak hu matchil

Rabbi elazar omer af hamnassech me hechag bechag bachutz amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi menachem yodfaa rabbi elazar beshittat rabbi akiva rabbo amarah deamar nisuch hammayim deorayeta detanya rabbi akiva omer unsacheha bishne nisuchim hakkatuv medabber echad nisuch hammayim veechad nisuch hayyayin

Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan i ma lehallan sheloshet luggin af kan sheloshet luggin veha rabbi elazar me hechag kaamar i ma lehallan bishar yemot hashshana af kan bishar yemot hashshana verabbi elazar bechag kaamar
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rabbi assi deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi nechunya ish bikat bet chortan eser netiot arava venisuch hammayim halacha lemoshe missinay
Tanu rabbanan hamnassech sheloshet luggin mayim bechag bachutz chayyav rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer im millean leshem chag chayyav
May benayehu amar rav nachman bar yitzchak beyesh shiur bemayim kamipalgi
Rav pappa amar

a: Bekarvu nesachim bammidbar peligi
Ravina amar bilmedin nisuch hammayim minnisuch hayyayin peligi
Tanu rabbanan hamnassech shelosha luggin yayin bachutz chayyav rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer vehu shekkiddeshan bichli
May benayehu amar rav adda bar rav yitzchak berutze midot ika benayehu
Rava bereh derabba amar karvu nesachim bevama ika benayehu
Uviflugta dehane tannae detanya bamat yachid enah tzericha nesachim divre rabbi vachachamim omrim teuna nesachim
Vehane tannae kehane tannae detanya ki tavou lehatinah nesachim levama gedola hakkatuv medabber
Atta omer levama gedola o eno afilu bama ketanna keshehu omer el eretz moshvotechem asher ani noten lachem hare bevama hannoheget lechullechem hakkatuv medabber divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer ki tavou lehatinah nesachim bevama levama ketanna hakkatuv medabber
Atta omer levama ketanna o eno ella levama gedola keshehu omer el eretz moshvotechem hare bevama hannoheget bechol moshavot hakkatuv medabber
Keshettimtza lomar ledivre rabbi yishmael lo karvu nesachim bammidbar uldivre rabbi akiva karvu nesachim bammidbar
Rabbi nechemya omer sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz chayyav
Amar rabbi yochanan tanna rabbi nechemya kedivre haomer shirayim meakkevin

Metivi rabbi nechemya omer sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz chayyav amar lo rabbi akiva vahalo sheyare haddam sheyare mitzva hem amar lo evarin ufdarin yochichu shehen sheyare mitzva vehammakrivan bachutz chayyav amar lo lo im amarta beevarim ufdarim shehen techillat avoda tomar bishyare haddam sheenan techillat avoda
Veim ita lema leh hane name meakkevi teuvta

Vehashta deamar rav adda bar ahava machloket beshirayim happenimiyyim aval beshirayim hachitzonim divre hakkol la meakkevi ki kaamar rabbi nechemya beshirayim happenimim ki tanya hahi beshirayim hachitzonim
Verabbi akiva la yada may kaamar rabbi nechemya hu savar rabbi nechemya shirayim chitzonim amar veka mahdar leh shirayim hachitzonim verabbi nechemya lidvarav derabbi akiva kaamar
Matni hammolek et haof bifnim veheela bachutz chayyav malak bachutz veheela bachutz patur hashshochet et haof bifnim veheela bachutz patur
b: Shachat bachutz veheela bachutz chayyav
Nimtza derech hechshero bifnim peturo bachutz derech hechshero mibbachutz peturo bifnim
Rabbi shimon omer kol shechayyavin alav bachutz chayyavin al kayyotze bo bifnim sheheela bachutz chutz min hashshochet bifnim umaale bachutz
Gema hay hechshero chiyyuvo hu teni chiyyuvo
Rabbi shimon omer vechu ahecha kae

Ilema aresha kae hammolek of bifnim veheela bachutz chayyav malak bachutz veheela bachutz patur vaamar leh rabbi shimon ki hechi difnim michayyav bachutz name michayyav hay kol shechayyavin alav bachutz kol shechayyavin alav bifnim mibe leh
Ella ki hechi divchutz la michayyav bifnim name la lichayyav hay kol sheen chayyavin alav bachutz mibe leh

Ella assefa kae hashshochet of bifnim veheela bachutz patur shachat bachutz veheela bachutz chayyav vaamar leh rabbi shimon ki hechi devifnim la michayyav bachutz name la michayyav hay kol sheen chayyavin mibe leh
Ella ki hechi devachutz michayyav bifnim name michayyav ha katane chutz min hashshochet bifnim vehammaale bachutz
Amar zeeri shechitat behema ballayela ika benayehu vehachi kaamar vechen hashshochet behema bifnim ballayela veheela bachutz patur shachat bachutz ballayela veheela bachutz chayyav
Rabbi shimon omer kol shechayyavin alav bachutz chayyavin al keotze bo bifnim veheela bachutz chutz min hashshochet of bifnim veheela bachutz
Rava amar kabbala bichli chol ika benayehu vehachi kaamar vechen hamkabbel bichli chol bifnim veheela bachutz patur hamkabbel bichli chol bachutz veheela bachutz chayyav
Rabbi shimon omer kol shechayyavin alav bachutz chayyavin al kayyotze bo bifnim veheelo bachutz chutz min hashshochet of bifnim veheelo bachutz

Hashta detane avuh dishmuel bar rav yitzchak hammolek of bifnim veheelo bachutz chayyav malak bachutz veheela bachutz patur verabbi shimon michayyav rabbi shimon hatam kae vetane kol shechayyavin alav bifnim veheela bachutz chayyavin alav bachutz
Matni chattat shekkibbel damah bechos echad natan bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz chayyav shekkullo rauy bifnim
Kibbel damah bishte kosot natan shenehem bifnim patur shenehem bachutz chayyav echad bifnim veechad bachutz patur echad bachutz veechad bifnim chayyav al hachitzon vehappenimi mechapper

Lema haddavar dome lemafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veachar kach nimtzet harishona vahare shettehen omdot shachat shettehen bifnim patur shettehen bachutz chayyav achat bifnim veachat bachutz patur achat bachutz veachat bifnim chayyav al hachitzona vehappenimit mechapperet
Keshem sheddamah poter et besarah kach hi poteret et besar chavertah

a: Gema bishlama bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim shekkullo rauy lihot bifnim aval bifnim veheelan bachutz shirayim ninhu
Ha manni rabbi nechemya hi deamar sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz chayyav

I rabbi nechemya ema sefa kibbel damah bishne kosot natan shenehem bifnim patur shenehem bachutz chayyav echad bifnim veechad bachutz patur vehaamar rabbi nechemya sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz chayyav
Sefa atan letanna kamma derabbi elazar berabbi shimon deamar kos ose dachuy lachavero
Lema haddavar dome lemafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veachar kach nimtzet harishona
Lema haddavar dome lema li ha manni rabbi hi deamar avuda bishat hafrasha meta
Vehachi kaamar tama deavda ha hifrish shette chattaot leachraut chada minayehu meikara ola hi
Vechidrav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav asham shennitak liriyya ushchato setam kasher leola
Mi dame hatam asham zachar veola zachar aval chattat nekeva hi amar rav chiyya miyyostinya bisir nasi
Hadaran alach hashshochet vehammaale
Matni parat chattat shesserafah chutz miggittah vechen sair hammishtalleach shehikriv bachutz patur
Shenneemar veel petach ohel moed lo hevio kol sheen rauy lavo el petach ohel moed en chayyavin alav
Harovea vehannirba vehammuktze vehanneevad vehammechir vehaetnan vehakkilayim vehatterefa veotze dofen shehikrivan bachutz patur
Shenneemar lifne mishkan Adonai kol sheen rauy lavo lifne mishkan Adonai en chayyavin alav
Baale mumin ben baale mumin kevuin ben
b: Baale mumin ovrin shehikrivan bachutz patur rabbi shimon omer baale mumin kevuin patur baale mumin ovrin chayyav belo taase
Torim shello higgia zemannan uvne yona sheavar zemannan shehikrivan bachutz patur rabbi shimon omer bene yona sheavar zemannan patur vetorim shello higgia zemannan belo taase

Oto veet beno umchussar zeman patur rabbi shimon omer hare ze belo taase sherabbi shimon omer kol shehu rauy lavo leachar zeman hare ze belo taase veen bo karet vachachamim omrim kol sheen bo karet en bo lo taase
Mechussar zeman ben begufo ben bivalav
Ezehu mechussar zeman bivalav hazzav vehazzava vehayyoledet vehammetzora shehikrivu chattatam vaashamam bachutz peturin olotehen veshalmehen bachutz chayyavin
Hammaale mibbesar chattat mibbesar asham mibbesar kodshe kadashim mibbesar kadashim kallim umotar haomer ushte hallechem velechem happanim ushyare menachot
Vehayyotzek vehappotet vehabbolel vehammoleach vehammenif vehammaggish vehamsadder et hashshulchan vehammetiv et hannerot vehakkometz vehamkabbel damim bachutz patur
Veen chayyavin alav lo mishshum zarut velo mishshum tuma velo mishshum mechussar begadim velo mishshum shello rechutz yadayim veraglayim

Ad shello hukam hammishkan hau habbamot muttarot vaavoda bivchorot umishshehukam hammishkan neesru habbamot vaavoda bakkohanim kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim vekadashim kallim bechol machane yisrael bau laggilgal hutteru habbamot kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim vekadashim kallim bechol makom

Bau leshilo neesru habbamot velo haya sham tikra ella bet avanim bilvad millemattan vehayeriot millemalan vehi hayeta menucha kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim vekadashim kallim umaaser sheni bechol haroe
Bau lenov vegivon hutteru habbamot kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim vekadashim kallim bechol are yisrael
Bau lirushalayim neesru habbamot velo haya lahen heter vehi hayeta nachala kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim kadashim kallim umaaser sheni lifnim min hachoma
Kol hakkodashim shehikdishan bishat isur habbamot vehikrivan bishat isur habbamot mibbachutz hare ellu baase velo taase vechayyavin alav karet

Hikdishan bishat heter habbamot vehikrivan bishat isur habbamot bachutz hare ellu baase velo taase veen chayyavin alehen karet hikdishan bishat isur habbamot vehikrivan bishat heter habbamot hare ellu baase veen bahen lo taase

Veellu kadashim kerevin bammishkan kadashim shehukdeshu lemishkan korbenot tzibur kerevin bammishkan vekorbenot hayyachid bevama korbenot hayyachid shehukdeshu lammishkan yakrivu bammishkan veim hikrivan bevama patur
Uma ben bamat yachid levamat tzibur semicha ushchitat tzafon

a: Umattan saviv utnufa vehaggasha rabbi yehuda omer en mincha bevama vechihun uvigde sharet uchle sharet vereach nichoach umchitza ledamim verichutz yadayim veraglayim
Aval hazzeman hannotar vehattame shavin baze uvaze
Gema may chutz miggittah amar resh lakish chutz mimmakom habbaduk lah amar lo rabbi yochanan vahalo kol eretz yisrael beduka hi
Ella amar rabbi yochanan kegon sheshshechatah lifnim min chomat yerushalayim
Velokmah kegon sheshshechatah chutz lachoma shello keneged happetach deamar rav adda bar ahava shechatah shello keneged happetach pesula shenneemar veshachat vehizza

Ma hazzaatah keneged happetach af shechitatah keneged happetach vechi tema dela makkesh veha ittemar shechatah shello keneged happetach rabbi yochanan omer pesula veshachat vehizza resh lakish amar keshera el michutz lammachane veshachat
Veitmar name serafah shello keneged happetach rabbi yochanan amar pesula verabbi oshaya amar keshera rabbi yochanan amar pesula vesaraf vehizza
Verabbi oshaya amar keshera al pirshah yisrof mekom shepporeshet lemita sham tehe serefatah
Amri la mibaya kaamar la mibaya chutz lachoma derachoke rachakah ella afilu lifnim min hachoma dekarove karvah veema tittachshar ka mashma lan
Amar mar amar lo rabbi yochanan vahalo kol eretz yisrael beduka hi bemay kamipalgi mar savar yarad mabbul leeretz yisrael umar savar lo yarad
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ushnehem mikra echad darshu ben adam emor lah atte eretz lo metohara hi lo gushmah beom zaam

Rabbi yochanan savar atmohe matmah kera eretz yisrael mi la metohara atte kelum yardu alayich geshamim beom zaam veresh lakish savar kifshateh aretz lo metohara atte mi lo yardu alayich geshamim beom zaam
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan chatzerot hau birushalayim benuot al hassela vetachtehen chalul mippene kever hattehom umviin nashim meubbarot veoldot umgaddelot sham benehem lappara
Umviin shevarim veal gabbehen delatot vetinokot yoshvin alehen vechosot shel even beyadan umilleu veyashvu bimkoman
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua maala asu bappara

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish paam echad matzu atzamot belishkat dir haetzim uvikkeshu ligzor tuma al yerushalayim amad rabbi yehoshua al raglav veamar lo busha uchlima hi lanu shennigzor tuma al ir avotenu ayye mete mabbul ayye mete nevuchadnetztzar
Middekaamar hachi lav lememra dela hao ultamach haruge nevuchadnetztzar hachi name dela hao ella hao ufanninhu hacha name hao ufanninhu vei ippanno
b: Ha ipno nehi deipanno mirushalayim mikkullah eretz yisrael la ipanno
Ika deamri etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan ayye mete mabbul ayye mete nevuchadnetzar may lav middehane hao hane name hao mide irya ha kiditeh veha kiditeh
Etiveh mikkol asher becharava metu bishlama ledidi deamena yarad mabbul leeretz yisrael mishshum hachi metu ella ledidach ammay metu mishshum havla
Kidrav chisda deamar rav chisda berotchin kilkelu uvrotchin nidonu dichtiv hacha vayyashokku hammayim uchtiv hatam vachamat hammelech shachacha

Ika deamri etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish mikkol asher becharava metu bishlama ledidi deamena lo yarad mabbul leeretz yisrael mishshum hachi havay charava ella ledidach may charava charava shehayeta meikara
Veammay kare leh charava kidrav chisda deamar rav chisda bedor hammabbul lo nigzera gezera al dagim shebbayyam shenneemar mikkol asher becharava metu velo dagim shebbayyam
Bishlama leman deamar lo yarad mabbul leeretz yisrael hayenu dekam rema hatam ella leman deamar yarad rema hecha kam amar rabbi yannay guriyyot hichnisu batteva

Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana ledidi chaze li urzila derema bat bar yome vehave kehar tavor vehar tavor kamma have arbein parse meshacha detzavvereh telata parse marbata deresha parsa ufalga rema kabba uschar yardena
Amar rabbi yochanan rosho hichnisu latteva vehaamar mar marbata deresha parsa ufalga ella rosh chotmo hichnisu latteva
Veha amar rabbi yochanan lo yarad mabbul leeretz yisrael ledivre resh lakish kaamar
Veha kasagya teva amar resh lakish karnav kashru batteva vehaamar rav chisda anshe dor hammabbul berotchin kilkelu uvrotchin nidonu
Ultamach teva hechi sagya veod og melech habbashan hecha kae ella nes naasa lahem shennitztannenu betzide hatteva

Ulrabbi shimon ben lakish nehi name deyarad mabbul leeretz yisrael veha la pash deamar resh lakish lamma nikra shemah metzula shekkol mete mabbul nitztallelu sham verabbi yochanan amar lamma nikra shemah shinar shekkol mete mabbul ninaru sham i efshar dela idvaku
Amar rabbi avahu lamma nikra shemah shinar shemmenaeret ashireha veha kachazenan dehau telata dare la mashchi
Amar rabbi amme kal haochel meafarah shel bavel keilu ochel besar avotav tanya name hachi kal haochel meafarah shel bavel keilu ochel besar avotav veyesh omrim keilu ochel shekatzim urmasim
Sair hammishtalleach
Urminhi o korban shomea ani afilu kodshe bedek habbayit shennikreu korban shenneemar vannakrev et korban Adonai
Talmud lomar veel petach ohel moed lo hevio mi sherauy lavo beohel moed yatzu kodshe bedek habbayit sheenan reuyin
Otzi et ellu sheenan reuyin velo otzi et sair hammishtalleach shehu rauy lavo el petach ohel moed talmud lomar la lehotzi sair hammishtalleach sheeno meuchad la
La kashya kan kodem hagrala kan leachar hagrala achar hagrala name haika viduy
Ella amar rav manni la kashya kan kodem viduy kan leachar viduy
Harovea vehannirba
Veha name tipok li mippetach ohel moed

a: Bishlama rovea venirba mashkachatte leh deakdeshinhu meikara vahadar irvau
Ella muktze veneevad en adam oser davar sheeno shello bekadashim kallim vealliba derabbi yose haggelili deamar kadashim kallim mamon bealim hu
Detanya umaala maal ba lerabbot kodashim kallim shehen mamono divre rabbi yose haggelili
Hilkach rovea venirba devar erva muktze veneevad avoda zara bekadashim kallim
Etnan umchir kilayim yotze dofen biveladot kadashim
Kasavar valde kadashim bahavayatan hen kedoshim
Baale mumin vechu oto veet beno vechu
Utzrichi dei tena baale mumin mishshum dimisi aval torin dela meisi ema la demodu leh lerabbi shimon
Vei tena torin mishshum dela ichazo veidcho aval baale mumin deichazo veidcho ema la demode lehu rabbi shimon lerabbanan
Vei tena hane tarte mishshum difsula degufayehu aval oto veet beno difsula mealma kaate lah ema modu leh rabbanan lerabbi shimon tzericha
Shehaya rabbi shimon omer may tama derabbi shimon
Amar rabbi ila amar resh lakish deamar kera lo taasun kechol asher anachnu osim po hayyom amar lehu moshe leyisrael ki ayelitu laaretz yesharot takrivu chovot lo takrivu
Vegilgal legabbe shilo mechussar zeman hu vekaamar lehu moshe lo taasun
Amar rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera i hachi
b: Milke name lilke allema amar rabbi zera hakkatuv nitteko laase
Hane mile lerabbanan lerabbi shimon hachi name
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar penim degilgal legabbe shilo kechutz dame
Rabba amar tameh derabbi shimon kidtanya rabbi shimon omer minnayin lazzoveach pesach bevamat yachid bishat isur habbamot shehu belo taase talmud lomar lo tuchal lizboach et happasach
Yachol af bishat heter habbamot ken talmud lomar beachad shearecha lo amarti lecha ella beshaa shekkol yisrael nichnasin beshaar echad
Emat i nema achar chatzot karet name michayyav ella lav kodem chatzot
Leolam leachar chatzot uvishat heter habbamot kae
Veha bishat isur habbamot kaamar isur bama lo heter bama lachavero
Mechussar zeman ku vehane bene ashamot ninhu amar zeeri teni metzora bahadayehu
Olotehen veshalmehen vehane bene shelamim ninhu amar rav sheshet teni nazir dizeri kavuha tannae derav sheshet la kavuha tannae
Amar rabbi chilkiyya deve rav tovi lo shanu ella lishmo aval shello lishmo chayyav hoil verauy leshello lishmo bifnim
I hachi lishmo name nichayyav hoil verauy leshello lishmo bifnim bae akira
Matkef lah rav huna vechi yesh lecha davar sheeno kasher lishmo vechasher shello lishmo velo vahare

a: Pesach bishar yemot hashshana deeno kasher lishmo vechasher shello lishmo pesach bishar yemot hashshana shelamim ninhu
Lema mesayya leh yachol sheani motzi af olat mechussar zeman bivalim vaasham nazir vaasham metzora
Talmud lomar shor mikkol makom kesev mikkol makom ez mikkol makom veilu chattat shayerah
Bemay askinan ilema bizmanno may irya asham afilu chattat name ella shello lizmanno
Uvmay ilema lishmo asham ammay chayyav ella lav shello lishmo leolam bizmanno veshello lishmo
Verabbi eliezer hi deamar makkeshinan asham lechattat
Utna tafel vehu haddin ikar
Ta shema yachol sheani merabbe olat mechussar zeman begufah vechattat ben begufah ben bivalim
Talmud lomar veel petach ohel moed kol sheeno rauy lavo befetach ohel moed en chayyavin alehen veilu asham shayereh
Bemay askinan ilema lishmo asham name liftereh ella lav shello lishmo
Leolam shello lishmo verabbi eliezer hi demakkesh asham lechattat tena ikar vechol shekken letafel
Ta shema dechi ata rav dimi amar tana deve rabbi levay yachol sheani motzi af olat mechussar zeman bivalim asham nazir vaasham metzora minnayin venasev lehu talmuda lechiyyuva vela yadana may hi
May talmuda amar ravina shor mikkol makom kesev mikkol makom ez mikkol makom ha may rumya kidamratte
Amar rav nachman mishshum derame detana deve rabbi levay addetane levi asham nazir vaasham metzora sheshshechatan shello lishman kesherin velo alu labbealim leshum chova
Shechatan mechussar zeman bivalim o shehau vene shette shanim ushchatan pesulin
Umshanne rav dimi la kashya kan lishmo kan shello lishmo
Rav ashe rame matnitin abbarayeta umshanne kan lishmo vechan shello lishmo
Lema tehve teuvteh derav huna
Amar lecha rav huna hacha bemay askinan kegon shehifrish shette ashamot leachraut dechad minayehu meikara ola hi
b: Kidrav huna amar rav deamar rav huna amar rav asham shennitak liriyya ushchato setam kasher laola

Hammaale mibbesar chattat vechu tanu rabbanan minnayin lammaale mibbesar chattat umibbesar asham umibbesar kodshe kadashim umibbesar kadashim kallim umimmotar haomer ushte hallechem velechem happanim ushyare menachot sheppatur
Talmud lomar ola ma ola shehi reuya lehaalaa af kol sheruya lehaalaa
Minnayin sheaf hayyotzek vehabbolel vehappotet vehammoleach vehammenif vehammaggish vehamsadder hashshulchan vehammetiv et hannerot vehakkometz vehamkabbel bachutz sheppatur
Talmud lomar asher yaale ola o zavach ma haalaa shehi gemar avoda af kol shehu gemar avoda
Ad shello hukam hammishkan vechu yatev rav huna bar rav kattina kammeh derav chisda veka kare vayyishlach et naare bene yisrael amar leh hachi amar rabbi assi karvu ufasku
Sevar leotoveh mimmatnitin shameh dekaamar mishshemeh derav adda bar ahava ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar enah teuna hefshet venituach otveh barayeta deshaveya bechullehu
Detanya ad shello hukam hammishkan habbamot muttarot vaavoda bivchorot vehakkol kesherin lehikkarev behema chayya vaof zecharim unkevot temimin uvaale mumin tehorin aval lo temein
Vehakkol karvu olot veola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar teuna hefshet venituach vegoyim bizman hazze rashshain laasot ken
Tannae hi detanya vegam hakkohanim hanniggashim el Adonai yitkaddashu rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer zo perishut bechorot rabbi omer zo perishut nadav vaavihu
Bishlama leman deamar zo perishut nadav vaavihu hayenu dichtiv hu asher dibber Adonai lemor bikrovay ekkadesh
Ella leman deamar zo perishut bechorot hecha remiza dichtiv venoadti shamma livne yisrael venikdash bichvodi al tikre bichvodi ella bimchubbaday bichvuday

Davar ze amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe velo yadu ad shemmetu bene aharon kevan shemmetu bene aharon amar lo aharon achi lo metu banecha ella lehakdish shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu kevan sheyyada aharon shebbanav yedue makom hen shatak vekibbel sachar shenneemar vayyiddom aharon

Vechen bedavid hu omer dom la vehitcholel lo af al pi shemmappil lecha chalalim chalalim atte shetok vechen bishlomo hu omer et lachashot veet ledabber peamim sheshshotek umkabbel sachar al hashshetika peamim medabber umkabbel sachar al haddibbur

Vehayenu deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv nora elohim mimmikdashecha al tikre mimmikdashecha ella mimmekuddashecha beshaa sheose hakkadosh baruch hu din bikdoshav mityare umitalle umithallel
Ella kashya ola tere tannae hi detanya rabbi yishmael omer kelalot neemru besinay ufratot beohel moed
Rabbi akiva omer kelalot ufratot neemru besinay venishnu beohel moed venishtalleshu bearvot moav
Amar mar hakkol kesherin lehakriv mena hane mile amar rav huna deamar kera vayyiven noach mizbeach la vayyikkach mikkol habbehema hattehora umikkol of hattahor behema kemashmao chayya bichlal behema

a: Zecharim unkevot temimin uvaale mumin deamar mar tammut vezachrut bivhema veen tammut vezachrut beofot
Veitakkash behema leof

Temimin uvaale mumin leappoke mechussar ever dela amar rabbi elazar minnayin limchussar ever shenneesar livne noach talmud lomar umikkol hachay mikkol basar amra tora have behema shechayyin rashe evarin shellah
Vedilma lemaote terefa hahu millechayyot zera nafka
Hanicha leman deamar terefa enah yoledet ella leman deamar terefa yoledet may ika lememar haamar kera ittach bedomin lach
Vedilma noach gufeh terefa hava tamim ketiv beh vedilma tamim bidrachav tzaddik ketiv beh
Vedilma tamim bidrachav tzaddik bemaasav i salka datach denoach gufeh terefa hava mi kaamar leh lenoach dichvatach ayyel shelemim la teayyel
Umeachar denafka lan meittach lechayyot zera lema li mahu detema ittach letzavetta bealma afilu zaken afilu saris kamashma lan
Tehorin aval lo temein umi hao temein uthorin behahi shata amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan meotan shello neevda bahen avera
Mena hao yadi kidrav chisda deamar rav chisda heeviran lifne hatteva kol shehatteva kolattan beyadua shehu tahor en hatteva kolattan beyadua shehen temein
Rabbi avahu amar amar kera vehabbaim zachar unkeva habbain mealehen
Amar mar vehakkol karvu olot olot in shelamim la veha ketiv vayyizbechu zevachim shelamim la parim ella ema hakkol karvu olot ushlamim

Vehatanya aval shelamim la ki im olot olot in shelamim la keman deamar lo kervu shelamim bene noach deitmar rabbi elazar verabbi yose bar chanina chad amar kervu shelamim bene noach vechad amar lo kervu

May tama deman deamar kervu shelamim bene noach dichtiv vehevel hevi gam hu mibbechorot tzono umechelvehen ezehu davar shechelbo karev legabbe mizbeach veen kullo karev legabbe mizbeach heve omer ze shelamim
May tama deman deamar lo kervu dichtiv uri tzafon uvoi teman titnaer umma shemmaaseha batztzafon vetavo umma shemmaaseha batztzafon uvaddarom
Umar name hachtiv umechelvehen mishshamminehon didhu
Umar name hachtiv uri tzafon hahu bekibutz galiyyot hu dichtiv
Veha ketiv vayyomer moshe gam atta titten beyadenu zevachim veolot veasinu la elohenu zevachim laachila veolot lehakrava
Veha ketiv vayyikkach yitro choten moshe ola uzvachim hahu leachar mattan tora hu dichtiv

Hanicha leman deamar yitro achar mattan tora haya ella leman deamar yitro kodem mattan tora haya may ika lememar deitmar bene rabbi chiyya verabbi yehoshua ben levi chad amar yitro kodem mattan tora haya vechad amar yitro achar mattan tora haya leman deamar yitro kodem mattan tora haya kasavar shelamim hikrivu bene noach
Ketannae vayyishma yitro chohen midyan ma shemua shama uva venitgayyer rabbi yehoshua omer milchemet amalek shama shehare ketiv betziddo vayyachalosh yehoshua et amalek veet ammo lefi charev

Rabbi elazar hammodai omer mattan tora shama uva shekkeshennitna tora leyisrael haya kolo holech missof haolam vead sofo vechol malche ummot haolam achazatan reada behechlehen veamru shira shenneemar uvhechalo kullo omer kavod

Nitkabbetzu kullam etzel bilam harasha veamru lo ma kol hehamon asher shamanu shemma mabbul ba laolam amar lahem Adonai lammabbul yashav amar lahem vayyeshev Adonai melech leolam kevar nishba hakkadosh baruch hu sheeno mevi mabbul laolam
Amru lo mabbul shel mayim eno mevi aval mabbul shel esh mevi shenneemar ki hinne baesh Adonai nishpat amar lahen kevar nishba sheeno mashchit kol basar

Ume kol hehamon hazze sheshshamanu amar lahem chemda tova yesh lo bevet genazav shehayeta genuza etzlo tesha meot shivim vearbaa dorot kodem shennivra haolam uvikesh litnah levanav shenneemar Adonai oz leammo yitten miyyad patchu kullam veamru Adonai yevarech et ammo vashshalom
Rabbi eliezer omer keriat yam suf shama uva shenneemar vayehi chishmoa kol malche haemori veaf rachav hazzona amra lishluche yehoshua ki shamanu et asher hovish Adonai et me yam suf
May shena hatam daamar leh velo haya vam od ruach umay shena hacha dekaamar velo kama od ruach beish
b: Daafilu ikkashshoye name la ikkashshu umna yada deamar mar en lach kol sar venagid shello ba al rachav hazzona
Amru bat eser shanim hayeta kesheyyatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim vezinneta kol arbaim shana shehau yisrael bammidbar achar chamishim shana nitgayera amra yehe machul li bischar chevel challon ufishtim
Amar mar vegoyim bizman hazze rashshain laasot ken mena hane mile detanu rabbanan dabber el bene yisrael bene yisrael metzuvin al shechute chutz veen haggoyim metzuvin al shechute chutz
Lefichach kal echad veechad bone lo bama leatzmo umakriv aleha kol ma sheyyirtze amar rabbi yaakov bar acha amar rav assi asur lesayean velaasot shelichutan amar rabba uloroyinhu shere

Ki ha deifra hormiz imeh deshabbur malka shaddara kurbana lerava shelacha leh assekuh nihaleh leshem shamayim amar lehu lerav safra ulrav acha bar huna zilu udvaru tere uleme gulae vachazo hecha demasseka yamma sirton ushkulu tzive chadte veappiku nura mimmara chadta veassekuh nihaleh leshem shamayim

Amar leh abbaye keman kerabbi elazar ben shammua detanya rabbi elazar ben shammua omer ma mizbeach shello yishtammesh bo hedot af etzim shello yishtammesh bahen hedot veha mode rabbi elazar ben shammua bevama
Detanya katuv echad omer vayyitten david leornan bammakom shikle zahav mishkal shesh meot vego uchtiv vayyiken david et haggoren veet habbakar bechesef shekalim chamishshim ha ketzad
Gove mikkol shevet vashevet chamishshim shehen shesh meot rabbi omer mishshum abba yose ben dostay bakar veetzim umkom mizbeach bachamishshim vechol habbayit kullo beshesh meot

Rabbi elazar ben shammua omer bakar veetzim umkom mizbeach bachamishshim vechol habbayit kullo beshesh meot dichtiv vayyomer aravena el david yikkach veyaal adoni hammelech hattov beenav ree habbakar laola vehammoriggim uchle habbakar laetzim verava amar lach hatam name bechadte
May morigim amar ulla mitta shel turbel may mitta shel turbel amar abbaye iza dekurkesa dedayeshan dishae amar abbaye may kera hinne samtich lemorag charutz chadash baal pifiyyot
Makre leh rava livreh verame leh kerae ahadade ketiv vayyitten david leornan vego uchtiv vayyiken david vego ha ketzad gove mikkol shevet vashevet chamishshim shehen shesh meot
Veakkatti kashyan ahadade hatam kesef hacha zahav ella hachi kaamar gove kesef bemishkal shesh meot zahav
Kadashim kallim neechalim bechol machane yisrael amar rav huna bechol mekomot yisrael aval machane la have

Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna umachanot bemidbar la havay veha tanya keshem shemmachane bammidbar kach machane birushalayim mirushalayim lehar habbayit machane yisrael mehar habbayit leshaar nikkanor machane leviyya
Mikkan veelach machane shechina vehen hen kelaim shebbammidbar
Ella ema bechol mekom machane yisrael peshita mahu detema ipsilu beotze ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name amar kera venasa ohel moed af al pi shennasa ohel moed hu
Tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer od acheret hayeta vechel ezrat nashim hi velo hau onshin aleha uvshilo lo hau ella shene machanot bilvad
He minayehu la hava amar rabba mistabbera demachane leviyya havay dei salka datach machane leviyya la havay

a: Nimtzeu zavin utmee metim mishtallechin chutz lemachane achat vehattora amra velo yetammeu et machanehem
Ten machane laze umachane laze
Amar leh rava ella may machane yisrael la havay nimtzeu zavin umtzorain mishtallechin lemakom echad vehattora amra badad yeshev shello yeshev tame acher immo
Ella leolam kullehu telata hau umay lo hau ella shette machanot liklita mikkelal divmidbar havay kalta machane leviyya
In veha tanya vesamti lecha makom bechayyecha makom mekomecha asher yanus shamma melammed shemmaglin bammidbar lehechan golin lemachane leviyya
Mikkan amru ben levi sheharag gole mippelech lefelech veim gala lefilko pilko kolto
May kera amar rav acha bereh derav ika ki veir miklato yeshev ir shekkelatattu kevar

Bau laggilgal tanu rabbanan kol nidar venidav haya karev bevama sheen nidar venidav en karev bevama mincha unzirut kerevin bevama divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim lo kervu yachid ella olot ushlamim bilvad

Rabbi yehuda omer kol shehatztzibbur vehayyachid makrivin beohel moed shebbammidbar makrivin beohel moed shebbaggilgal uma ben ohel moed shebbammidbar leven ohel moed shebbaggilgal ohel moed shebbammidbar lo hau bamot muttarot ohel moed shebbaggilgal hau habbamot muttarot uvamato shebberosh gaggo lo haya makriv aleha ella ola ushlamim

Vachachamim omrim kol shehatztzibbur makrivin beohel moed shebbammidbar makrivin beohel moed shebbaggilgal vechan vechan lo karvu yachid ella ola ushlamim bilvad rabbi shimon omer af tzibbur lo hikrivu ella pesachim
b: Vechovot shekkavua lahen zeman
May tama derabbi meir deamar kera lo taasun kechol asher anachnu osim po hayyom
Amar lahen moshe leyisrael ki ayelitu laaretz yesharot takrivu chovot lo takrivu menachot unzirot yesharot ninhu
Verabbanan en mincha bevama nezirot chovot ninhu
Amar shemuel machloket bechattat veasham aval beolot ushlamim divre hakkol yesharot ninhu vekarvi
Motev rabba chaze vashok utrumat lachme toda nohagin bevama gedola veen nohagin bevama ketanna veilu hazzeroa beshela shayerah
I amratte bishlama beola ushlamim peligi ha manni rabbanan hi ella i amratte bechattat veasham peligi ha manni
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar shemuel machloket beola ushlamim aval bechattat veasham divre hakkol chovot ninhu vela karvi
Amar mar vachachamim omrim kol shehatztzibbur makrivin beohel vechu
May tamayehu derabbanan amar kera ish hayyashar beenav yaase ish yesharot hu delikruv chovot la likruv vetzibbur afilu chovot likruv

a: Verabbi yehuda amar lach ki ketiv hayyashar beenav hu dichtiv aval bevama gedola afilu chovot name likruv
Ella ha ketiv ish lav lememra deish yesharot hu delikruv ha chovot la likruv ki ketiv ish lehachshir et hazzar
Zar mivvezarak hakkohen et haddam al mizbach Adonai nafka
Mahu detema live kiddush bechorot kemeikara ka mashma lan
Chachamim hayenu tanna kamma
Amar rav pappa karvu nesachim bemidbar ika benayehu
Amar mar rabbi shimon omer vechu may tameh derabbi shimon dichtiv vayyaasu vene yisrael et happesach baggilgal
Peshita ella ha ka mashma lan dechovot keen pesach hu dekarev ha lav keen pesach la karev veidach
Mibe leh lechidrabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi bannaa arel mekabbel hazzaa
Tane tanna kammeh derav adda bar ahava en ben bama gedola levama ketanna ella pesach vechovot hakkavua lahen zeman amar leh yachid chovot shekkavua lahen zeman mena leh
Amar leh esmeyah amar leh tittargam matnitach beolat chova deika olat nedava dei chattat yachid hu chovot dikvia leh zeman mi ika
Velokmah beminchat chova deha ika chavitin ka savar en mincha bevama

Bau leshilo vechu mena hane mile amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan katuv echad omer vatteviehu bet Adonai shilo vechatuv echad omer vayyittosh et mishkan shilo ohel shikken baadam uchtiv vayyimas beohel yosef uvshevet efrayim lo vachar
Ha ketzad lo hayeta sham tikra ella avanim millemattan viriot millemalan vehi hayeta menucha

Kodshe kodashim mena hane mile amar rabbi oshaya deamar kera hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha bechol makom asher atta tire bechol makom asher tire i atta maale aval atta ochel bechol makom sheatta roe
Ema bechol makom sheatta roe i atta maale aval atta zoveach bechol makom shettire
Amar rabbi yannay amar kera sham taale vesham taase
Rabbi avdimi bar chassa amar amar kera
b: Velo taanat shilo makom shekkol haroe oto mitanneach alav al achilat kadashim shello
Rabbi avahu amar amar kera ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin ayin shello ratzta lizzon velehanot middavar sheeno shello tizke vetochal kimlo eneha
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar urtzon shochni sene ayin shello ratzta lehanot middavar sheeno shello tizke vetochal ben hassenuin
Tana roe sheamru roe kullo velo hammafsik beno leveno amar leh rabbi shimon ben elyakim lerabbi elazar asbera lach kegon be chenishta demaon amar rav pappa roe sheamru lo roe kullo ella roe miktzato
Bae rav pappa omed veroe yoshev veeno roe may bae rabbi yirmeya omed al gabbe hannachal veroe yoshev betoch hannachal veeno roe may teku

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi bishlosha mekomot sharta shechina al yisrael beshilo venov vegivon uvet olamim uvchullan lo sharta ella bechelek binyamin shenneemar chofef alav kol hayyom kol chafifot lo yehu ella bechelko shel binyamin
Ki azel abbaye amrah kammeh derav yosef amar chad bera hava leh lechayelil vela mitkan vehachtiv vayyittosh et mishkan shilo uchtiv vayyimas beohel yosef uvshevet efrayim lo vachar
Amar rav adda may ka kashya leh dilma shechina bechelek binyamin vesanhedri gedola bechelek yosef middematzinu bevet olamim dishchina bechelko shel binyamin vesanhedrin bechelek yehuda

Amar leh hachi hashta hatam mikarvan nachalot gabbe hadade hacha mi mekarvan hacha name mekarvan kidamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina retzua hayeta yotzet mechelko shel yehuda venichneset lechelko shel binyamin uvah haya mizbeach banuy vehaya binyamin hatztzaddik mitztaer aleha levolah
Hacha name retzua hayeta yotzet mechelko shel yosef lechelko shel binyamin vehayenu dichtiv taanat shilo
Ketannae chofef alav ze mikdash rishon kol hayyom ze mikdash sheni uven ketefav shachen ellu yemot hammashiach
Rabbi omer chofef alav ze haolam hazze kol hayyom ellu yemot hammashiach uven ketefav shachen ze haolam habba

Tanu rabbanan yeme ohel moed shebbammidbar arbaim shana chaser achat yeme ohel moed shebbaggilgal arba esre sheva shekkibbeshu vesheva shechilleku yeme ohel moed shebbenov vegivon chamishshim vasheva nishtayeru leshilo shelosh meot veshivim chaser achat
Yeme ohel moed shebbammidbar arbaim chaser achat menalan deamar mar shana rishona asa moshe et hammishkan sheniyya hukam hammishkan veshalach moshe meraggelim

Shebbaggilgal arba esre sheva shekkibbeshu vesheva shechilleku menalan dekaamar kalev ben arbaim shana anochi bishloach moshe eved Adonai oti mikkadesh barnea leraggel et haaretz vaashev oto davar kaasher im levavi uchtiv veatta hinne anochi hayyom ben chamesh ushmonim shana
Ki avreh leyarden bar kamma have bar shivin vetamne vekaamar ben chamesh ushmonim shana hare sheva shekkibbeshu
Vesheva shechilleku menalan ibaet ema middesheva shekkibbeshu sheva name shechilleku
Veibaet ema middela mashkachatte lah bearba esre shana achar asher hukketa hair
Ohel moed shebbenov vegivon chamishshim vasheva mena lan dichtiv vayehi kehazkiro et aron haelohim
Vetana keshemmet eli hakkohen charva shilo uvau lenov keshemmet shemuel haramati charva nov uvau legivon
Uchtiv vayehi miyyom shevet haaron bekiryat yearim vayyirbu hayyamim vayyihu esrim shana vayyinnahu kol bet yisrael achare Adonai
Hane esrim shana eser shana shemmalach shemuel beatzmo veshana shemmalach shemuel veshaul ushtayim shemmalach shaul vesheva dedavid

a: Dichtiv vehayyamim asher malach david al yisrael arbaim shana bechevron malach sheva shanim vego
Uvishlomo ketiv vayyachel livnoto bishnat arba lemalchuto nishtayeru leshilo shelosh meot veshivim chaser echat
Bau lenov vegivon vechu mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ki lo batem ad atta el hammenucha veel hannachala
El hammenucha zo shilo nachala zo yerushalayim lamma chillekan kede liten heter ben ze laze
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan maaser sheni name litne amar leh maaser shamsham mearon ka yalfi kevan dearon la hava maaser name la havay
I hachi pesach vekadashim name deshamsham mearon yalfi dechevan dearon la hava inhu name la hao

Amar leh daamar lach ha manni rabbi shimon hi deamar af tzibbur lo hikrivu ella pesach vechovot hakkavua lahen zeman aval chovot sheen kavua lahem zeman hacha vehacha la keruv masar behema chovot sheen kavua lahen zeman hu veitakkash masar dagan lemasar behema

Mikkelal dilrabbi yehuda keruv in dehaamar rav adda bar matna maaser sheni umasar behema neechalin benov vegivon ledivre rabbi yehuda veha bae bira velav tane rav yosef shalosh birot hen shilo venov vegivon uvet olamim hu tane lah vehu amar lah laachilat maaser sheni vealliba derabbi yehuda
Bau lirushalayim vechu tanu rabbanan ki lo batem ad atta el hammenucha veel hannachala menucha zo shilo nachala zo yerushalayim
Veomer hayeta li nachalati kearye vayyaar veomer haayit tzavua nachalati li haayit saviv aleha divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi shimon omer menucha zo yerushalayim nachala zo shilo veomer zot menuchati ade ad po eshev ki ivitiha veomer ki vachar Adonai betziyyon ivah lemoshav lo

Bishlama leman deamar menucha zo shilo hayenu dichtiv el hammenucha veel hannachala ella leman deamar menucha zo yerushalayim nachala zo shilo el hannachala veel hammenucha mibe leh hachi kaamar la mibaya menucha dela metetu ella afilu lenachala name la metetu
Tana deve rabbi yishmael zo vezo shilo rabbi shimon ben yochay omer zo vezo yerushalayim bishlama leman deamar menucha zo
b: Shilo nachala zo yerushalayim i name ipcha hayenu dichtiv el hammenucha veel hannachala ella leman deamar zo vazo shilo o zo vazo yerushalayim menucha nachala mibe leh kashya
Bishlama leman deamar zo vazo shilo menucha denachu mikkibush nachala zo diflagu hatam nachalot dichtiv vayechallek lahem yehoshua vayyappel lahem goral beshilo al pi Adonai
Ella leman deamar zo vazo yerushalayim bishlama nachala nachalat olamim ella menucha may menucha menuchat aron dichtiv vayehi kenoach haaron
Bishlama leman deamar zo vazo yerushalayim aval shilo hao sharyan bamot hayenu dichtiv vayyikkach manoach et gedi haizzim veet hammincha vayyaal al hatztzur la
Ella leman deamar zo vazo shilo uvamot hao asiran may vayyikkach manoach horaat shaa hayeta
Tana deve rabbi yishmael kerabbi shimon ben yochay deamar zo vazo yerushalayim vesimanach mashchinhu gavra legavre
Kol hakkodashim vechu amar rav kahana lo shanu ella bishchita aval behaalaa karet name michayyav
May tama deamar kera vaalehem tomar al hassemuchin tomar
Matkef lah rabba mi ketiv vaalehem tomar alehem ketiv vaalehem karenan

Veod tanya arbaa kelalot haya rabbi shimon omer bekadashim hikdishan bishat isur habbamot veshachat veheela bishat isur habbamot bachutz hare hen baase velo taase veyesh bahen karet hikdishan bishat heter habbamot veshachat veheela bishat isur habbamot hare hen baase velo taase veen bahen karet
Hikdishan bishat isur habbamot veshachat veheela bachutz bishat heter habbamot hare hen baase veen bahen belo taase
Hikdishan bishat heter habbamot veshachat veheela bishat heter habbamot patur mikkelum teuvta derav kahana teuvta
Veellu kodashim vechu semicha dichtiv lifne Adonai vesamach
Shechitat tzafon dichtiv tzafona lifne Adonai mattanot saviv dichtiv vezarak al hammizbeach saviv saviv
Tenufa dichtiv vehenif hakkohen lifne Adonai haggasha dichtiv vehiggishah el hammizbeach
Rabbi yehuda omer en mincha bevama amar rav sheshet ledivre haomer yesh mincha bevama yesh ofot bevama ledivre haomer en mincha bevama en ofot bevama
Zevachim velo menachot zevachim velo ofot
Vechohen dichtiv vezarak hakkohen bigde sharet lesharet bakkodesh
Uchle sharet asher yeshartu vam bakkodesh lereach nichoach dichtiv lereach nichoach la
Mechitza bedamim dichtiv vehayeta hareshet ad chatzi hammizbeach richutz yadayim dichtiv uvkorvatam el hammizbeach yirchatzu
Amar rame bar chama lo shanu ella bekodshe bama ketanna vehikrivum bevama ketanna aval bekodshe bama ketanna dekarvinhu bevama gedola yesh chitzuy
Motev rabba chaze vashok terumat lachme toda nohagin bekodshe bama gedola veen nohagin bekodshe bama ketanna ema nohagin bevama gedola veen nohagin bevama ketanna
Ika deamri amar rame bar chama lo shanu ella bekodshe bama gedola vehikrivan bevama gedola aval bekodshe bama ketanna af al gav dekarvinhu bevama gedola en chitzuy
Lema mesayya leh chaze vashok utrumat lachme toda nohagin bekodshe bama gedola veen nohagin bekodshe bama ketanna
Ema nohagin bevama gedola veen nohagin bevama ketanna ufliga derabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar olat bamat yachid shehichnisah bifnim kelatuha mechitzot lechol davar
Bae rabbi zera olat bamat yachid

a: Shehichnisah lifnim vehotziah lachutz mahu mi amrinan kevan daayala kalta lah mechitzta o dilma kevan dahadar hadar
Lav hayenu pelugta derabba verav yosef ditnan kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom moalin bahen veim alu lo yerdu
Veibaya lehu yardu mahu sheyyaalu rabba amar lo yaalu verav yosef amar yaalu
Tibe lerabba tibe lerav yosef tibe lerabba ad kan la kaamar rabba ella bemizbeach dachaze leh mekaddesh dela chaze la mekaddesh aval mechitza af al gav dela chaze lah kalta
O dilma afilu lerav yosef ad kan la kaamar rav yosef hatam ella dechad makom hu aval hacha ditre mekomot ninhu la o dilma la shena teku

Milta difshita leh lerabba bechad gisa ulrav yosef bechad gisa mibe leh lerabbi yannay devae rabbi yannay evre olat bamat yachid shealu lammizbeach veyardu mahu hecha delo mashla bahen haur la tibe lach ki tibe lach hecha demashla bahen haur may teku
Itmar shechitat layela bevamat yachid rav ushmuel chad amar keshera vechad amar pesula veka mipalgi bidrabbi elazar
Derabbi elazar rame kerae ahadade ketiv vayyomer begadtem gollu elay hayyom even gedola

Uchtiv vayyomer shaul putzu vaam vaamartem lahem haggishu elay ish shoro veish seyehu ushchattem baze vaachaltem velo techetu la leechol al haddam vayyaggishu chol haam ish shoro veyado hallayela vayyishchatu sham
Mar meshanne kan bechullin kan bekadashim umar meshanne kan bekodshe bama gedola kan bekodshe bama ketanna

Itmar olat bamat yachid rav amar en teuna hefshet venituach verabbi yochanan amar teuna hefshet venituach veka mipalgi bidrabbi yose haggelili detanya rabbi yose haggelili omer ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar en teuna hefshet venituach sheen hefshet venituach ella meohel moed veelach
Mar savar meohel moed veelach la shena bama gedola vela shena bama ketanna umar savar bevama gedola in bevama ketanna la

Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan devarim shebben bama gedola levama ketanna keren vechevesh visod veribua bevama gedola veen keren visod vechevesh veribua bevama ketanna kiyyor vechanno bevama gedola veen kiyyor vechanno bevama ketanna chaze vashok bevama gedola veen chaze vashok bevama ketanna
Devarim sheshshaveta bama gedola levama ketanna shechita bevama gedola uktanna hefshet venituach bigdola uktanna dam mattir umfaggel bigdola uktanna mumin uzman bigdola uktanna
Aval notar vehazzeman vehattame shavin baze uvaze
Tanu rabbanan minnayin laasot zeman bevama ketanna kevama gedola amra tora lan yissaref ufigul yissaref ma pigul pasul bevama af lan pasul bevama
O kelach lederech zo deha amra tora lan yissaref veotze yissaref ma yotze kasher bevama af lan kasher bevama velav kal vachomer hu meofot
b: Ma ofot sheen hammum posel bahen zeman posel bahen kodshe bama ketanna shehammum posel bahen eno din shezzeman posel bahen
Ma leofot shekken en hazzar kasher bahen tomar bevama ketanna shehazzar kasher bah lo yehe zeman pasul bah talmud lomar vezot torat zevach hashshelamim laasot zeman bama ketanna kizman bama gedola
Hadaran alach parat chattat uslika lah massechet zevachim

a: Matni kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman kesherot ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova chutz mimminchat chote uminchat kenaot
Minchat chote uminchat kenaot shekkematzan shello lishman natan bichli vehalach vehiktir shello lishman o lishman veshello lishman o shello lishman velishman pesulot
Ketzad lishman veshello lishman leshem minchat chote ulshem minchat nedava shello lishman velishman leshem minchat nedava ulshem minchat chote
Gema lema li lemitna ella litne velo alu labbealim leshem chova
Ha ka mashma lan labbealim hu delo alu leshum chova ha mincha gufah keshera veasur leshannoye kidrava deamar rava ola sheshshechatah shello lishmah asur lizrok damah shello lishmah
Ibaet ema sevara veibaet ema kera ibaet ema sevara mishshum dimshanne bah kol hane lishanne bah venezil
Veibaet ema kera motza sefatecha tishmor veasita kaasher nadarta la elohecha nedava nedava neder hu kare leh neder vekare leh nedava ella im kema shennadarta asita yehe neder veim lav yehe nedava
b: Undava mi shere leshannoye bah
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi shimon detanya rabbi shimon omer kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman kesherot vealu labbealim leshem chova
Sheen hammenachot domot lizvachim shehakkometz machavat leshum marcheshet maaseha mochichin aleha leshum machavat chareva leshum belula maaseha mochichin aleha leshum chareva
Aval bizvachim eno chen shechita achat lechullan uzrika achat lechullan vekabbala achat lechullan
Hanicha lerav ashe deamar kan bekometz machavat leshum marcheshet kan bekometz minchat machavat leshum minchat marcheshet
Matnitin mincha leshum mincha hi ella lerabba verava may ika lememar
Vechi tema kidka meshanne rabba kan beshinuy kodesh kan beshinuy bealim
Ha matnitin shinuy kodesh hu dekatane ketzad lishman veshello lishman leshum minchat chote ulshum minchat nedava
Vei name kidka meshanne rava kan bekometz mincha leshum mincha kan bekometz mincha leshum zevach
Ha matnitin mincha leshum mincha hi dekatane shello lishman velishman leshem minchat nedava leshem minchat chote ella lerabba verava mechavarta matnitin dela kerabbi shimon
Verame derabbi shimon adderabbi shimon detanya rabbi shimon omer kodesh kadashim hi kechattat uchasham yesh mehen kechattat veyesh mehen keasham
Minchat chote hare hi kechattat lefichach kematzah shello lishmah pesula kachattat minchat nedava hare hi keasham lefichach kematzah shello lishmah keshera
Uchasham ma asham kasher veeno meratztze af minchat nedava keshera veenah meratztza
Amar rabba la kashya kan beshinuy kodesh kan beshinuy bealim
Amar leh abbaye mikkede machshava difsal rachamana hekkesha hi ma li shinuy kodesh ma li shinuy bealim
Amar leh maaseha mochichin dekaamar rabbi shimon sevara hi derabbi shimon daresh tama dikra
Machshava dela minachra pesal rachamana machshava deminachra la pesal rachamana
Siman ola ola malak umitza chattat haof kodshe kadashim kadashim kallim
Ella meatta olat haof shemmelakah lemala mishshum chattat haof teratztze maaseha mochichin aleha deolat haof hi dei chattat haof hi lematta have aved lah
Attu chattat haof lemala mi leta haamar mar melika bechol makom bammizbeach keshera
Olat haof shemmitza damah lemala leshem chattat haof teratztze maaseha mochichin aleha deolat haof hi dei chattat haof hi lematta hava aved lah hazzaa

a: Amri dilma mitzuy devatar hazzaa hu deamar mar mitza damah bechol makom bammizbeach keshera
Chattat haof shehizza damah lematta leshem olat haof teratztze demaaseha mochichin aleha dechattat of hi dei olat haof hi lemala hava aved lah umitzuy hava aved lah
Hachi name ella lefi sheen hammenachot domot lazzevachim kaamar lazzevachim velo laofot
Kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan batztzafon leshem kadashim kallim liratztzo maasehen mochichin alehen dekodshe kadashim ninhu dei kadashim kallim baddarom hava aved lehu
Emor deamar rachamana af baddarom baddarom velo batztzafon mi amar ditnan shechitatan bechol makom baazara
Kadashim kallim sheshshechatan baddarom leshem kodshe kadashim liratztzo maasehen mochichin alehen dekadashim kallim ninhu dei kodshe kadashim batztzafon hava aved lehu
Amri kodshe kadashim ninhu umibar hu daavar ushchat lehu baddarom
I hachi machavat leshem marcheshet name hay deka kametz leh lemarcheshet amar hay bemarcheshet nedar veha demayete lah bemachavat demarcheshet hi umibar hu daavar veatyah bemachavat
Hatam ki name bemarcheshet nadar ki mayete lah bemachavat machavat haveya
Keditnan haomer hare alay bemachavat vehevi bemarcheshet bemarcheshet vehevi bemachavat ma shehevi hevi vide nidro lo yatza
Vedilma amar zo lehavi bemachavat vehevi bemarcheshet keditnan zo lehavi bemachavat vehevi bemarcheshet bemarcheshet vehevi bemachavat hare zo pesula
