Lerabbanan hachi name lerabbi shimon kevan deamar rabbi shimon af yede nidro yatza alma keviuta demana vela kelum hu vela shena amar zo vela shena amar alay
Ella meatta ola sheshshachat leshem chattat teratztze dehay zachar vehay nekeva kevan deika seir nasi dezachar hu la yedia
Amar leshem chattat yachid may ika lememar vetu chattat yachid sheshshechatah leshem ola teratztze dechattat nekeva veola zachar mikasseya bealya
Hatinach hecha deayeti kivsa ayeti seira may ika lememar ella ben zecharim linkevot lav addatayehu deinashe
Pesach sheshshechato leshem asham liratztze dehay ben shana vehay ben shettayim kevan deika asham nazir vaasham metzora la pesika leh
Amar leshum asham gezelot ulshum asham meilot may ika lememar vetu asham gezelot vaasham meilot sheshshechatan leshum pesach liratztzo defesach ben shana vehane ben shette shanim
Ella ben ben shana leven ben shette shanim lav addatayehu deinashe deika ben shana demichaze keven shettayim veika ben shettayim demichaze keven shana
Sair sheshshechato leshum asham liratztze dehay tzemer vehay sear amri dichra ukkama hu
Egel ufar sheshshechatan leshum pesach veasham liratztzo deegel ufar befesach veasham leka in hachi name
b: Umay zevachim rov zevachim
Rava amar la kashya kan bekometz mincha leshum mincha kan bekometz mincha leshum zevach
Mincha leshum mincha vezot torat hammincha tora achat lechol hammenachot mincha leshum zevach vezot torat hammincha vezevach la ketiv
Veha tanna mippene shemmaaseha mochichin aleha kaamar hachi kaamar af al gav demachshava dela minachra hi vetipsel vezot torat hammincha tora achat lechol hammenachot
Umay aval bizvachim eno chen
Af al gav dishchita achat lechullan vezot torat hammincha vezevach la ketiv

Ella meatta chattat chelev sheshshechatah leshem chattat dam leshum chattat avoda zara leshum chattat nazir leshum chattat metzora tehe keshera utratztze deamar rachamana vezot torat hachattat tora achat lechol chattaot
Lerabbi shimon hachi name lerabbanan ha amar chattat chelev sheshshechatah leshem chattat dam leshum chattat avoda zara keshera leshem chattat nazir metzora pesula dehane olot bahadayehu ninhu
Rav acha bereh derava matne leh lechullehu lifsula veshachat otah lechattat leshem oto chattat
Rav ashe amar la kashya kan bekometz minchat machavat leshum marcheshet kan bekometz minchat machavat leshum minchat marcheshet
Minchat machavat leshum marcheshet bemana ka mechashshev umachshava bemana la pasla minchat machavat leshum minchat marcheshet bemincha defasla bah machshava ka mechashshev
Veha tanna mippene shemmaaseha mochichin aleha kaamar hachi kaamar af al gav demachshava minchar hi tipsel
Umay aval bizvachim eno chen af al gav dishchita achat lechullan zerika achat lechullan kabbala achat lechullan bizvicha defasla beh machshava ka mechashshev
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe chareva mishshum belula ammay amar rabbi shimon amar leh leshum bila bealma
I hachi leshum shelamim name leshum shelamim bealma

Hachi hashta hatam zevach gufeh ikri shelamim dichtiv hammakriv et dam hashshelamim hazzorek et dam hashshelamim hacha mincha gufah mi ikray belula vechol mincha velula vashshemen ketiv belula vashshemen ikray belula setama la ikray
Kullehu kerabba la amri deadderabba machshava deminnachra pesal rachamana
Kerava la amri vezot torat la mashma lehu
Kerav ashe la amri mishshum kushya derav acha bereh derava
Milta difshita leh lerabba lehay gisa ulrava lehay gisa mibaya leh lerav hoshaya devae rav hoshaya veamri lah bea mineh rav hoshaya merabbi assi mincha leshum zevach

a: Ma li amar rabbi shimon tama derabbi shimon mishshum machshava deminachra la pasla veha machshava deminachra hu
O dilma tama derabbi shimon mishshum dichtiv vezot torat hammincha vezevach la ketiv amar leh kelum higganu lesof dato shel rabbi shimon
Kerabba la meshanne leh mishshum kushya deabbaye
Kerava la meshanne leh mishshum kushya vezot torat hachattat
Kerav ashe la meshanne leh mishshum kushya derav acha bereh derava
Chutz mimminchat chote uminchat kenaot bishlama minchat chote chattat karyah rachamana lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona ki chattat hi vego ella minchat kenaot menalan
Detane tanna kammeh derav nachman minchat kenaot motarah nedava

Amar leh shappir kaamratte mazkeret aon ketiv bah uvchattat ketiv veotah natan lachem laset et aon haeda ma chattat motarah nedava af minchat kenaot motarah nedava vechachattat ma chattat pesula shello lishmah af minchat kenaot pesula shello lishmah
Ella meatta asham yehe pasul shello lishmo degamar aon aon mechattat
Danin aon meaon veen danin aono meaon
May nafka minah veha tana deve rabbi yishmael veshav hakkohen uva hakkohen zo hi shiva zo hi bia
Veod ligmar aono aono meaon dishmiat hakkol dichtiv im lo yaggid venasa aono
Ella ki gamri gezera shava lemotar nedava hu degamri
Vechi tema en gezera shava lemechetza galli rachamana gabbe chattat veshachat otah lechattat otah lishmah keshera shello lishmah pesula aval kol kadashim ben lishman ben shello lishman kesherim
Ella minchat chote uminchat kenaot difsulin shello lishman menalan
Chattat tama may mishshum dichtiv bah hi hachi name ha ketiv behu hi
Asham name ha ketiv beh hu hahu hu leachar haktarat emurin hu dichtiv
Kidtanya aval asham lo neemar bo hu ella leachar haktarat emurin hu atzmo shello hukteru emurav kasher
Veella hu lema li lechidrav huna amar rav asham shennitak liriyya ushchato setam kasher leshum ola
Nitak in lo nitak la amar kera hu bahavayato yehe
Amar rav minchat haomer shekkematzah shello lishmah pesula hoil uvat lehattir velo hittira vechen atta omer baasham nazir
b: Vaasham metzora sheshshechatan shello lishman pesulin hoil uvau lehachshir velo hichshiru
Tenan kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman kesherot ella shello alu labbealim leshum chova chutz mimminchat chote uminchat kenaot veim ita litne name chutz mimminchat haomer
Ki katane baa yachid baa tzibbur la katane ki tane baa biglal atzmah baa biglal zevach la katane
Ki katane hanach sheen kavua lahen zeman ha dekavua lah zeman la katane
Amar mar vechen atta omer baasham nazir vaasham metzora sheshshechatan shello lishman pesulin hoil uvau lehachshir velo hichshiru

Tenan kol hazzevachim sheshshechatan shello lishman kesherin ella shello alu labbealim leshum chova chutz mippesach vechattat veim ita litne name chutz measham nazir vaasham metzora devau lehachshir velo hichshiru
Kevan deika asham gezelot vaasham meilot dilchappara atu la pesika leh
May shena asham nazir vaasham metzora devau lehachshir velo hichshiru hane name bau lechappara velo kipperu

Amar rabbi yirmeya matzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben mechapperim uven machshirin mechapperin it behu deatu leachar mita machshirin let behu deatu leachar mita ditnan haishsha shehevia chattatah umeta yaviu yorshin olatah olatah umeta lo yaviu yorshin chattatah
Matkef lah rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi machshirin name mi let behu deatu leachar mita vehatnan hammafrish maot linziruto lo nehenin velo moalin mippene sheruyin lavo kullan shelamim
Met vehau lo maot setumin yippelu lindava meforashin deme chattat yolich leyam hammelach lo nehenin velo moalin deme ola yavi bahen ola umoalin bahen
Deme shelamim yavi bahen shelamim veneechalin leom echad veen teunin lechem veha ola ushlamim denazir demachshirim ninhu veka atu leachar mita
Amar rav pappa hachi ka amar rabbi yirmeya lo matzinu hechsher kavua deva leachar mita udnazir hechsher sheeno kavua hu

a: Deamar mar gilach al achat mishsheloshtan yatza
Metivi asham metzora shennishchat shello lishmo o shello nitan middamo al gabbe behonot hare ze ole legabbe mizbeach vetaun nesachim vetzarich asham acher lehachshiro teuvta derav
Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar minchat haomer shekkematzah shello lishmah keshera ushyareha en neechalin ad shettavi minchat haomer acheret vetattirenna
Sheshsheyareha en neechalin ad shettavi minchat haomer acheret mikrav hechi karva mimmashke yisrael min hammuttar leyisrael
Amar rav adda bar ahava kasavar resh lakish en mechussar zeman levo bayyom
Metiv rav adda bereh derav yitzchak yesh baofot sheen bammenachot yesh bammenachot sheen baofot yesh baofot shehaofot bain benidvat shenayim aval menachot nefesh ketiva
Umchussere chappara zav vezava yoledet umtzora
Vehutteru mikkelal isuran bakkodesh ma sheen ken bammenachot
Veyesh bammenachot shehammenachot teunot keli utnufa vehaggasha veyeshnan batztzibur kevayyachid ma sheen ken baofot
Veim ita bimnachot name mashkachatte lah dehutteru mikkelal isuran bakkodesh umay nihu minchat haomer
Kevan deen mechussar zeman levo bayyom lav isura hu

Metiv rav sheshet hikdim mattan shemen lemattan dam yemalleennu shemen veyachazor veyitten shemen achar mattan dam mattan behonot lemattan sheva yemalleennu shemen veyachazor veyitten mattan behonot achar mattan sheva
Vei amratte en mechussar zeman levo bayyom ammay yachzor veyitten may daavad avad
Amar rav pappa shane hilchot metzora dichtiva behu havaya deamar hakkatuv zot tihye torat hammetzora tihye bahavayatah tehe
Metiv rav pappa hikdim chattato laashamo lo yihye acher memares bedamah ella teubbar tzuratah vetetze levet hasserefa

Ammay ka motev rav pappa veha rav pappa hu deamar shane hilchot metzora dichtiva behu havaya ella rav pappa hachi ka kashya leh ema hane mile avoda shechita lav avoda hi vei en mechussar zeman levo bayyom yehe acher memares bedamah velakrev asham vahadar lakrev chattat
Ella amar rav pappa hayenu tama deresh lakish dekasavar heir mizrach mattir derabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu afilu bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam
b: Heir mizrach mattir
Veha deresh lakish lav beferush itmar ella mikkelala itmar ditnan en meviin minchat bikkurim uminchat behema kodem laomer devaenan mimmashke yisrael veim hevi pasul
Kodem lishte hallechem lo yavi mishshum deikru bikkurim veim hevi kasher
Veamar rabbi yitzchak amar resh lakish lo shanu ella bearbaa asar uvachamishsha asar aval beshishsha asar im hevi kasher vekashya li liho kamchussar zeman alma kasavar heir hammizrach mattir

Verava amar minchat haomer shekkematzah shello lishmah keshera ushyareha neechalin veenah tzericha minchat haomer acheret lehattirah sheen machshava moelet ella bemi sherauy laavoda uvdavar harauy laavoda uvimkom harauy laavoda
Bemi sherauy laavoda leappoke kohen baal mum uvdavar harauy laavoda leappoke minchat haomer dela chazya dechiddush hu uvimkom harauy laavoda leappoke nifgam hammizbeach
Tanu rabbanan keshehu omer min habbakar lematta sheen talmud lomar ella lehotzi et hatterefa
Vahalo din hu uma baal mum shemmutteret lahedot asura laggavoha terefa sheasura lahedot en din sheasura laggavoha chelev vadam yochichu sheasurin lahedot umuttarin laggavoha
Ma lechelev vadam shekken bain mikkelal heter tomar bitrefa shekkullah asura velo tehe mutteret laggavoha
Melika tochiach shekkullah isur vaasura lahedot umutteret laggavoha
Ma limlika shekken kedushshatah osartah bishat kedushshatah lammizbeach hi neesra lahedot dehayenu melikatah aval kodem lachen lo neesra lahedot ma sheen ken bitrefa sheen kedushshatah osartah
Veim heshavta keshehu omer min habbakar lematta sheen talmud lomar lehotzi et hatterefa
Ma im heshavta siman rekiach mar adda leshesheh
Amar rav mishshum deika lememar minchat haomer tochiach sheasura lahedot umutteret laggavoha ma leminchat haomer shekken matteret chadash
Bashsheviit sheviit name shekken matteret sefichin bashsheviit kerabbi akiva deamar sefichin asurim bishviit
Amar leh rav acha bar abba lerav ashe lerabbi akiva name lifroch ma leminchat haomer shekken matteret chadash bechutza laaretz
Vaafilu leman deamar chadash bechutz laaretz lav deorayeta shekken baa lehattir lav shebbetochah
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina i hachi terefa name tikrav vetattir lav shebbetochah ella parech hachi ma leminchat haomer shekken mitzvatah bechach
Resh lakish amar mishshum deika lememar mefattem hakketoret yochiach sheasur lahedot umuttar laggavoha mefattem gavra hu
Ella pittum hakketoret yochiach sheasur lahedot umuttar laggavoha ma lefittum hakketoret shekken mitzvato bechach
Mar bereh deravina amar mishshum deika lememar shabbat tochiach sheasura lahedot umutteret laggavoha
Ma leshabbat shekken huttera mikkelalah etzel hedot bemila
Attu mila tzorech hedot hu mila mitzva hi ella ma leshabbat shekken mitzvatah bechach
Rav adda bar abba amar mishshum deika lememar kilayim tochiach sheasurin lahedot umuttarin laggavoha
Ma lechilayim shekken hutteru mikkelalan etzel hedot betzitzit attu tzitzit tzorech hedot hi mitzva hi ella

a: Ma lechilayim shemmitzvato bechach
Rav shisha bereh derav idi amar mishshum deika lememar lihdar dina vetete bamma hatztzad ma limlika shekken kedushshatah osartah chelev vadam yochichu
Ma lechelev vadam shekken baim mikkelal heter melika tochiach

Vechazar haddin lo rei ze chiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheasurin lahedot umuttarin laggavoha af ani avi terefa af al pi sheasura lahedot tehe mutteret laggavoha ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken mitzvatah bechach
Ella amar rav ashe mishshum deika lememar meikara dedina pircha mehecha ka mayetet lah mibbaal mum
Ma levaal mum shekken asa bo makrivin kikrevin
Amar leh rav acha sava lerav ashe yotze dofen yochiach shello asa bo makrivin kikrevin umuttar lahedot veasur laggavoha
Ma leotze dofen shekken eno kadosh bivchora
Baal mum yochiach ma levaal mum shekken asa bo makrivin kikrevin yotze dofen yochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shemmuttarin lahedot vaasurim laggavoha vechol shekken terefa sheasura lahedot tehe asura laggavoha
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken lo hutteru mikkelalan tomar bitrefa shehuttera mikkelalah

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe terefa shehuttera mikkelalah may hi ilema melika deolat haof laggavoha baal mum name beofot ishteroye ishteri tammut vezachrut babbehema veen tammut vezachrut baofot
Ella melika dechattat haof lakkohanim kohanim mishshulchan gavoha ka zachu
Veella parech hachi ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken muman nikar tomar bitrefa shekken en mumah nikar mishshum hachi itzterich kera
Utrefa mehacha nafka mehatam nafka mimmashke yisrael min hammuttar leyisrael
Mikkol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet nafka perat latterefa sheenah overet
Tzerichi dei mimmashke yisrael hava amena lemaote hecha delo hayeta lah sheat hakkosher dumya deorla vechile hakkerem aval hayeta lah sheat hakkosher ema tittachshar ketav rachamana kol asher yaavor

Vei ketav rachamana kol asher yaavor hava amena lemaote hecha denitrefa ulvassof hikdishah dumya demaaser aval hikdishah ulvassof nitrefa dividana deakdeshah hava chazya ema tittachshar ketav rachamana min habbakar tzerichi

Matni echad minchat chote veechad kol hammenachot shekkematzan zar onen tevul yom mechussar begadim mechussar kipurim shello rachatz yadav veraglav arel tame yoshev omed al gabbe chelim al gabbe vehema al gabbe ragle chavero pasul
Kamatz bismol pasul ben betira omer yachzir veyachazor veyikmotz beyamin
Kamatz veala beyado tzeror o garger melach o koret shel levona pasul mippene sheamru hakkometz hayyater vehechaser pasul veezehu hayyater shekkematzo mevoratz vechaser shekkematzo berashe etzbeotav
Gema lema li lemitna echad minchat chote veechad kol hammenachot litne kol hammenachot shekkematzan zar veonen

Lerabbi shimon itzterich detanya amar rabbi shimon bedin hu shettehe minchat chote teuna shemen ulvona shello yehe chote niskar umippene ma enah teuna shello yehe korbano mehuddar uvaddin hu shettehe chattat chelev teuna nesachim
b: Shello yehe chote niskar umippene ma enah teuna shello yehe korbano mehuddar salka datach amena hoil veamar rabbi shimon shello yehe korbano mehuddar ki kamtzi lah pesulin name tittachshar ka mashma lan
I hachi hatam name litne echad chattat chelev veechad kol hazzevachim shekkibbelu daman zar veonen velema lerabbi shimon itzterich
Alma kevan ditna leh kol vela katane chutz kullehu mashma hacha name kevan ditna kol vela katane chutz kullehu mashma
Itzterich salka datach amena hoil veokemna leresha dela kerabbi shimon sefa name dela kerabbi shimon ka mashma lan
Amar rav zar shekkamatz yachzir veha anan pasal tenan may pasal pasal ad sheyyachazir

I hachi hayenu ben betira i deiteh lekometz beeneh la peligi rabbanan aleh deven betira ki peligi dachasar kometz rabbanan savri la yavi mittoch beto vimalleennu ben betira savar yavi mittoch beto vimalleennu
I hachi ben betira omer yachzir veyachazor veyikmotz beyamin ben betira omer yachzir veyavi mittoch beto vimalleennu veyachazor veyikmotz beyamin mibe leh
Ki ka amar rav leven betira peshita mahu detema ad kan la ka machshar ben betira ella bismol aval bishar pesulin la ka mashma lan
May shena semol deashkechan leh hechshera beom hakkippurim zar name ashkechan leh hechshera bishchita
Shechita lav avoda hi
Vela vehaamar rabbi zera amar rav shechitat para bezar pesula veamar rav alah elazar vechukka ketiv bah shane para dekodshe bedek habbayit hi
Velav kal dechen hu kodshe bedek habbayit bau kehunna kodshe mizbeach la bau kehunna amar rav shisha bereh derav idi mide dehave ammarot negaim delav avoda ninhu uvae kehunna
Venelaf mibbama
Vechi tema mibbama la yalfinan vehatanya minnayin layyotze sheim ala lo yered shehare yotze kasher bevama
Tena azzot torat haola semich leh

Ella tama deashmeinan rav ha lav hachi hava amena bishar pesulin pasal ben betira vehatanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon omrim machshir haya ben betira bechol happesulin kullan
Vetanya vekamatz mishsham mimmakom sheragle hazzar omdot
Ben betira omer minnayin sheim kamatz bismol sheyyachazir veyachazor veyikmotz beyamin talmud lomar vekamatz mishsham mimmakom shekkamatz kevar
Vechevan dikra setama ketiv bah ma li semol uma li shear happesulin

Ella ha kamashma lan rav kamatz vaafilu kidesh ulappoke mehane tannae detanya rabbi yose ben yose ben yasyan verabbi yehuda hannachtom amru bamme devarim amurim shekkamatz velo kidesh aval kidesh pasal
Veika deamri kamatz in kidesh la keman kehane tannae ulappoke mittanna kamma
Matkef lah rav nachman may ka savri hane tannae i kemitzat pesulin avoda hi af al gav dela aved leh mattan keli i kemitzat pesulin lav avoda hi ki avad leh mattan keli may hava
Hadar amar rav nachman leolam avoda hi vela gamra avodatah ad deaved leh mattan keli
I hachi afilu lo kidesh

a: Vechi mahdar leh lekometz leduchteh tikdosh likdosh velifsol
Amar rabbi yochanan zot omeret kele sharet en mekaddeshin ella middaat

Ha middaat mekaddeshin veha bea mineh resh lakish merabbi yochanan kele sharet mahu sheyekaddeshu pesulin lechattechila likrav vaamar leh en mekaddeshin amar leh en mekaddeshin likrav aval mikkaddeshin lipasel
Rav amram amar kegon shehechziro levisa gedusha
Umikmatz hechi kematz ella kegon shehechziro levisa tefufa
Vechevan dikmatz leh avad leh gumma ki mahdar legaveyh demana ka mahdar leh mikki mahdar leh mannach leh addufna demana umnid leh venafel mimmela denaasa kemi shehechziro hakkof

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera velokmah kegon shehechziro lichli hammunnach al gabbe karka ella shema minah komtzin mikkeli sheal gabbe karka amar leh ka nagatte bevaya deibaya lan derabbi avimi tane menachot be rav chisda
Vaavimi be rav chisda tane vehaamar rav chisda kulfe tave belai meavimi alah deha shemata ba lehachriz retzufin sheloshim yom sheni vachamishi vesheni shishshim yom
Avimi massechta itakara itakar leh vaata kammeh derav chisda leiddechore gemareh velishlach leh velete legabbeh sevar hachi mistayea milta tefe
Pega beh rav nachman amar leh ketzad komtzin amar leh mikkeli ze amar leh vechi komtzin mikkeli sheal gabbe karka amar leh demagba leh kohen
Ketzad mekaddeshin et hammenachot amar leh notnah lichli ze vechi mekaddeshin bichli sheal gabbe karka amar leh demagba leh kohen
Amar leh im ken hutzrachta shelosha kohanim amar leh uthe tzericha shelosha asar kattamid
Etiveh ze hakkelal kol hakkometz venoten bichli hammolich vehammaktir leechol davar sheddarko leechol vechu
Veilu magbiha la katane tanna seder avodot naket vela seder kohanim

Beo mineh midderav sheshet mahu likmotz mikkeli sheal gabbe karka amar leh pok chazi ma avdin legav arbaa kohanim nichnasin shenayim beyadam shene sedarim ushnayim beyadam shene bazichin vearbaa mekaddemin lifnehem shenayim litol shene sedarim ushnayim litol shene bazichin
b: Veilu magbiha et hashshulchan la katane
Lav amratte hatam seder avodot naket hacha name seder avodot naket
Mi dame hatam la nachet leminyana dechohanim hacha nachet leminyana dechohanim im ita litne magbiha ella shema minah komtzin mikkeli sheal gabbe karka shema minah
Amar rava peshita li kometz mikkeli sheal gabbe karka shekken matzinu besiluk bazichin mekaddeshin mincha bichli sheal gabbe karka shekken matzinu besidur bazichin
Bae rava kidush kometz may mimmincha yalfinan lah o middam yalfinan lah hadar pashtah middam yalfinan lah
Umi amar rava hachi veha ittemar kometz shechilleko bishne kelim rav nachman amar eno kadosh verava amar kadosh veim ita lelaf middam hadar beh rava mehahi
Vadam menalan dela kadosh lachatzain detane rav tachlifa ben shaul kidesh pachot mikkede hazzaa bichli ze ufachot mikkede hazzaa bichli ze lo kidesh
Veibaya lehu bedam may hilcheta hi umehilcheta la yalfinan
O dilma hatam may tama dichtiv vetaval bammayim hacha name hachtiv vetaval baddam
Veitmar amar rabbi zerika amar rabbi elazar af bedam lo kidesh amar rava tanya name hachi bifne kohen manniach vetaval velo mesappeg
Baddam sheyehe baddam shiur tevila meikaro min haddam min haddam shebbainyan
Veitzterich lemichtav vetaval veitzterich lemichtav baddam dei ketav rachamana vetaval hava amena af al gav delo kibel shiur tevilot dehayenu hazzaa sheva peamim meikaro ketav rachamana baddam
Vei ketav rachamana baddam hava amena afilu mesappeg ketav rachamana vetaval
Min haddam shebbainyan lemaote may amar rava lemaote shirayim shebbaetzba mesayya leh lerabbi elazar deamar shirayim shebbaetzba pesulin
Amar leh ravin bar rav adda lerava amri talmidach amar rav amram tanya haya mazze venitteza hazzaa miyyado im ad shello hizza taun kibus mishshehizza en taun kibus
May lav ad shello gamar hazzaato umishsheggamar hazzaato shema minah deshirayim shebbaetzba kesherim
Lo ad shello yatzta miyyado hazzaa taun kibus umishsheyyatza hazzaa miyyado venitteza mimma shennishar en taun kibus
Etiveh abbaye gamar millehazzot mekanneach yado begufah shel para gamar in lo gamar la
Amar leh gamar mekanneach yado lo gamar mekanneach etzbao

Bishlama gamar mekanneach yado begufah shel para dichtiv vesaraf et happara leenav ella lo gamar mekanneach etzbao bemay mekanneach dei amratte begufah shel para ibi leh lemitne mekanneach yado veetzbao begufah shel para middela katane hachi shema minah dela bae kinuach
Amar abbaye bisfat mizrak kedichtiv kefore zahav vego
Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi veha itmar chavite kohen gadol rabbi yochanan amar enah kedosha lachatzain rabbi elazar amar mittoch shekkereva lachatzain kedosha lachatzain

a: Veim itah lelaf middam vechi tema rabbi elazar milta mimmilta la gamar veha amar rabbi elazar mincha shekkematzah bahechal keshera shekken matzinu besiluk bazichin
Mincha mimmincha yalef mincha middam la yalef
Umincha mimmincha mi yalef vehatanya ad shello perkah nifras lachmah hallechem pasul veen maktir alav et habbazichin mishshepperkah nifras lachmah hallechem pasul umaktir alav et habbazichin
Veamar rabbi elazar lo perkah mammash ella kevan shehiggia zemannah lefarek af al pi shello perkah kemi shepperkah damya
Veammay tehve kemincha shechasra kodem kemitza
Ha la kashya mincha la berir berera kometz didah veha berir berera kometz didah vechevan shehiggia zemannah lefarek keman defarkah damya

Ella meatta tehve keshirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaktara deen maktirin kometz alehen lav pelugta ninhu rabbi elazar savar lah keman deamar shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaktara maktir kometz alehen

Gufa chavite kohen gadol rabbi yochanan amar enah kedosha lachatzain verabbi elazar amar mittoch shekkereva lachatzain kedosha lachatzain amar rabbi acha may tama derabbi yochanan amar kera mincha machatzitah have mincha veachar kach chotzehu

Metivi chavite kohen gadol lo hau baot chatzain ella mevi issaron shalem vechotzehu vetanya ilu neemar mincha machatzit hayiti omer mevi chatzi issaron mibbeto shacharit umakriv chatzi issaron mibbeto arvit umakriv talmud lomar machatzitah babboker mechetza mishshalem hu mevi
Lemitzva amar leh rav geviha mibbe chetil lerav ashe veha chukka ketiv bah amar leh lo nitzrecha ella lahaviah shalem mibbeto
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi veha itmar hifrish chatzi issaron vedato lehosif rav amar eno kadosh verabbi yochanan amar kadosh veim ita lelaf mechavitin
Vechi tema rabbi yochanan milta mimmilta la yalef vehaamar rabbi yochanan shelamim sheshshechatan bahechal kesherin dichtiv ushchato petach ohel moed shello yehe tafel chamur meikar

Dato lehosif shane detanya meleim en meleim ella shelemim kelomar sheeno kadosh ad sheyehe issaron shalem veamar rabbi yose ematay bizman sheen dato lehosif aval bizman sheddato lehosif rishon rishon kadosh
Verav bechavitin keman sevira leh i kerabbi elazar lelaf mechavitin
Vechi tema rav milta mimmilta la yalef vehaamar rav mincha kedosha belo shemen uvlo levona shekken matzinu belechem happanim belo levona shekken matzinu beminchat nesachim
Belo shemen uvlo levona shekken matzinu beminchat chote al korchach rav kerabbi yochanan sevira leh

Gufa amar rav mincha kedosha belo shemen veen dina keissaron chaser shekken matzinu belechem happanim belo levona shekken matzinu beminchat nesachim belo shemen uvlo levona shekken matzinu beminchat chote
Veshemen ulvona kodshi hay bela hay vehay bela hay shemen shekken matzinu belog shemen shel metzora levona shekken matzinu bilvona habbaa bevazichin verabbi chanina amar
b: Lo zo kedosha belo zo velo zo kedosha belo zo
Ulrabbi chanina issaron lamma nimshach vahalo eno asuy ella limdidat kemach bilvad vehakkemach eno kadosh belo shemen leminchat chote
Velog lamma nimshach lelog shel metzora

Veaf shemuel savar lah leha derav ditnan kele hallach mekaddeshin et hallach umiddot hayyavesh mekaddeshin et hayyavesh veen kele hallach mekaddeshin et hayyavesh velo middot hayyavesh mekaddeshin et hallach
Veamar shemuel lo shanu ella middot aval mizrakot shel dam mekaddeshot et hayyavesh shenneemar shenehem meleim solet belula vashshemen lemincha
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina mincha lacha hi amar leh lo nitzrecha ella layyavesh shebbah dehayenu levona
Vei salka datach kasavar shemuel en mincha kedosha ad sheyehu kullan yavesh shebbah hechi mashkachatte lah vahalo kullan lachim hen mippene hashshemen ella shema minah kasavar shemuel hay belo hay
Veibaet ema mincha legabbe dam keyavesh damya
Gufa amar rabbi elazar mincha shekkematzah bahechal keshera shekken matzinu besiluk bazichin
Metiv rabbi yirmeya vekamatz mishsham mimmakom sheragle hazzar omdot
Ben betira omer minnayin sheim kamatz bismol sheyyachazir veyikmotz beyamin talmud lomar vekamatz mishsham mimmakom shekkamatz kevar

Ika deamri hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah ika deamri amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa asberah lach lo nitzrecha ella lehachshir et kol azara kullah shello tomar hoil veola kodshe kadashim umincha kodshe kadashim ma ola teuna tzafon af mincha teuna tzafon
Ma leola shekken kalil mechattat
Ma lechattat shekken mechapperet al chayyave charetot measham
Ma leasham shekken mine damim mikkullehu name shekken mine damim
Ella itzterich salka datach amena hoil uchtiv vehikrivah el hakkohen vehiggishah el hammizbeach vekamatz ma haggasha bekeren deromit maaravit af kemitza name bekeren deromit maaravit ka mashma lan
Gufa amar rabbi yochanan shelamim sheshshechatan bahechal kesherin shenneemar ushchato petach ohel moed velo yehe tafel chamur min haikar
Metivi rabbi yehuda ben betira omer minnayin sheim hikkifu goyim et haazara shehakkohanim nichnasin lahechal veochlin bekodshe kadashim ushyare menachot talmud lomar

a: Bekodesh hakkodashim tochlennu
Veha lema li kera lema bachatzar ohel moed yochluha velo yehe tafel chamur min haikar
Avoda deadam oved bimkom rabbo amrinan shello yehe tafel chamur min haikar achila sheen adam ochel bimkom rabbo tama dichtav kera ha la ketav kera lo yehe tafel chamur min haikar la amrinan

Itmar belalah chutz lechomat azara rabbi yochanan amar pesula resh lakish amar keshera resh lakish amar keshera dichtiv veyatzak aleha shemen venatan aleha levona vahadar veheviah el bene aharon hakkohanim vekamatz
Mikkemitza veelach mitzvat kehunna limed al yetzika uvlila shekkesherin bezar umiddichhunna la baaya penim name la baaya
Verabbi yochanan amar pesula kevan daasiyyatah bichli hu nehi dichhunna la baaya penim mihat baaya tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan belalah zar keshera chutz lechomat haazara pesula
Itmar mincha shechasra kodem kemitza rabbi yochanan amar yavi mittoch beto vimalleenna resh lakish amar la yavi mittoch beto vimalleenna
Rabbi yochanan amar mevi mittoch beto vimalleenna kemitza kava leh resh lakish amar la yavi mittoch beto vimalleenna kedushshat keli kava leh
Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish chaser hallog im ad shello yatzak yemalleennu teuvta

Itmar shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaktara rabbi yochanan amar maktir kometz alehen veresh lakish amar en maktir kometz alehen alliba derabbi eliezer kulle alma la peligi ki peligi alliba derabbi yehoshua
Ditnan nitmeu sheyareha nisrefu sheyareha avdu sheyareha kemiddat rabbi eliezer keshera kemiddat rabbi yehoshua pesula
Man defasel kerabbi yehoshua uman demachshar ad kan lo amar rabbi yehoshua hatam ella dela ishteyar aval hecha deishteyar afilu rabbi yehoshua mode leh
Detanya rabbi yehoshua omer kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer mehem kezayit basar o kezayit chelev zorek haddam kachatzi zayit basar kachatzi zayit chelev eno zorek et haddam
Uvaola afilu kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev zorek et haddam mippene shebbaola kullah kalil uvammincha af al pi shekkullah kayyemet lo yizrok
b: Mincha may avidteh amar rav pappa minchat nesachim
Salka datach amena hoil uvahade zevach atya ki gufeh dezevach damya ka mashma lan
Uman defasel shane hacha deamar kera veherim hakkohen min hammincha et azkaratah vehiktir hammizbecha hammincha ad deitah lechullah mincha lo yaktir
Veidach min hammincha mincha shehayeta kevar shelema bishat kemitza yaktir af al gav dehashta enah shelema

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish ad shello perkah nifras hallechem pasul veen maktir alav et habbazichin veim mishshepperkah nifras lachmah hallechem pasul umaktir alav et habbazichin veamar rabbi elazar lo perkah mammash ella kevan shehiggia zemannah lefarek veaf al pi shello pirkah
Amar leh ha manni rabbi eliezer hi amar leh ana amena lach mishna shelema veamratte li atte rabbi eliezer
I rabbi eliezer may irya nifras afilu saruf veavud name machshar ishtik
Veammay shetek lema leh tzibbur shane hoil veishteray tuma legabbayehu ishteray name chaserot amar rav adda bar ahava zot omeret hachesron kevaal mum dame veen baal mum batztzibbur
Yatev rav pappa vekaamar leha shemata amar leh rav yosef bar shemaya lerav pappa mi la askinan derabbi yochanan veresh lakish beminchat haomer detzibur hi ufligi
Amar rav malkiyyo tana chada missoltah sheim chasra kol shehu pesula mishshamnah sheim chasra kol shehu pasul
Vetanya idach vehannoteret min hammincha perat lammincha shechasra hi veshechasar kumtzah veshello hiktir millevonatah kelum
Tere kerae bachaserot lema li lav chad lemincha shechasra kodem kemitza vechad leshirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaktara
Utuvta derabbi yochanan betarvayehu
La chad lemincha shechasra kodem kemitza dei mevi mibbeto vimalleenna in vei la la vechad leshirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaktara deaf al gav demaktir kometz alehen otan shirayim asurim laachila
Deibaya lehu ledivre haomer shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaktara maktir kometz alehen otan shirayim ma hen baachila
Amar zeeri amar kera vehannoteret velo hannoteret min hannoteret verabbi yannay amar mehammincha mincha shehayeta kevar

Kamatz bismol mena hane mile amar rabbi zera deamar kera vayyakrev et hammincha vayemalle chappo mimmenna kaf ze eni yodea mahu keshehu omer velakach hakkohen millog hashshamen veyatzak al kaf hakkohen hassemalit kan semalit ha kol makom shenneemar kaf eno ella yamin
Veha mibe leh legufeh semalit acharina ketiv
Veema en miut achar miut ella lerabbot semalit acharina ketiv kan semalit veen acher semalit
Veema adderabba ma kan semalit af bealma name semalit arbaa semalit ketivi tere beani utre beashir
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera al bohen yado hayemanit veal bohen raglo hayemanit dichtiv beshemen dimtzora ashir lema li

a: Deha ketiv al dam haasham chad lehachshir tzedadin vechad lifsol tzide tzedadin
Al dam haasham veal mekom dam haasham lemay atu
Hane tzerichi i ketav rachamana al dam haasham hava amena iteh in nitkanneach la ketav rachamana al mekom
Vei ketav rachamana al mekom hava amena daveka nitkanneach aval iteh ema have chatzitza ka mashma lan al dam haasham
Amar rava meachar dichtiv al dam haasham veal mekom dam haasham uchtiva yemanit bedam al bohen yado hayemanit veal bohen raglo hayemanit uchtivi beshemen dimtzora ashir veani lema li
Ella amar rava yad yad likmitza
Regel regel lachalitza
Ozen ozen lirtzia

Semalit heani lemay ata amar rav shisha bereh derav idi lifsol yamin dechohen bimtzora shello tomar uma bimkom shello nitrabbeta semol nitrabbeta yamin bemakom shennitrabbeta semol eno din shennitrabbeta yamin
Veidach semalit veyad varegel yemanit deani lemay ata lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael kol parasha shenneemra venishnet lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi shimon ben lakish kol makom shenneemra etzba uchhunna enah ella yamin

Ka salka datin etzba uchhunna baenan kedichtiv velakach hakkohen middam hachattat beetzbao vegamar mimmetzora dichtiv vetaval hakkohen et etzbao hayemanit hare kemitza dela ketiva bah ella kehunna utnan kamatz bismol pasul
Amar rava o etzba o kehunna

Amar leh abbaye hare holachat evarim lakkevesh dichtiv behu kehunna dichtiv vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha veamar mar zo holachat evarim lakkevesh utnan haregel shel yamin bismol uvet orah lachutz
Ki amrinan o etzba o kehunna bedavar hamakkev kappara
Vahare kabbala dedavar hamakkev kappara hu uchtiv bah kehunna dichtiv vehikrivu bene aharon hakkohanim et haddam zo kabbalat haddam utnan kibbel bismol pasal verabbi shimon machshir
Lerabbi shimon kaamratte rabbi shimon tarte bae
Umi bae rabbi shimon tarte vehatanya rabbi shimon omer kol makom shenneemra yad enah ella yamin etzba enah ella yamin etzba la baaya kehunna kehunna baaya etzba
Ella kohen lema li bechihuno
b: Vahare zerika dela ketiv bah ella kehunna utnan zarak bismol pasul vela pelig rabbi shimon amar abbaye pelig bevarayeta detanya kibbel bismol pasul verabbi shimon machshir zarak bismol pasul verabbi shimon machshir
Veella ha deamar rava yad yad likmitza lema li mikkehunna nafka
Chad lekometz vechad lekidush kometz
Lerabbi shimon dela bae kidush kometz ulman deamar name devae kidush kometz lerabbi shimon uvismol achshore machshar yad yad derava lema li

I likmitza gufah alliba derabbi shimon midderabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya nafka deamar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya may tama derabbi shimon deamar kera kodesh kadashim hi kachattat vechaasham
Ba leovdah bayyad ovdah beyamin kechattat ba leovdah bichli ovdah bismol keasham
Lo nitzrecha ella lekometz deminchat chote salka datach amena hoil veamar rabbi shimon shello yehe korbano mehuddar ki kametz lah name bismol tittachshar kamashma lan
Kamatz veala beyado tzeror o garger melach

a: O koret levona pasul kol hane lema li
Tzericha dei tena tzeror mishshum delav bat hakrava hi aval melach devat hakrava hi ema tittachshar
Vei tena melach dela ikva bahade mincha meikara sheeno moleach ella hakkometz bilvad aval levona deikva bahade mincha meikara ema tittachshar ka mashma lan
Mippene sheamru hakkometz hechaser o hayyater pasul may irya mishshum chaser veyater vetipok leh mishshum chatzitza amar rabbi yirmeya min hatztzad
Amar leh abbaye lerava ketzad komtzin amar leh kidkamtzi inashe etiveh zo zeret zo kemitza
Zo amma zo etzba zo gudal
Ella lehashot kelomar kometz melo hayyad kede shello yehe chaser veachar kach mochek beetzba ketanna millematta
Hechi aved amar rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav chofe shelosh etzbeotav ad shemmaggia al pas yado vekometz
Tanya name hachi melo kumtzo yachol mevoratz talmud lomar bekumtzo
I bekumtzo yachol berashe etzbeotav talmud lomar melo kumtzo ha ketzad chofe shelosh etzbeotav al pas yado vekometz
Bemachavat uvmarcheshet mochek begudalo millemala uvetzbao ketanna millematta vezo hi avoda kasha shebbammikdash
Zehu vetu la vehaika melika vehaika chafina ella zo hi achat meavodot kashot shebbammikdash
Amar rav pappa peshita li melo kumtzo kidkamtzi inashe bae rav pappa kamatz berashe etzbeotav may
Min hatztzedadin may mimmatta lemala may teku
Amar rav pappa peshita li melo chofnav kidchafni inashe bae rav pappa chafan berashe etzbeotav mahu min hatztzedadin mahu chafan bezo uvazo vekervan zo etzel zo mahu teku
Bae rav pappa dabbekeh lekometz bedafneh demana may toch keli baenan vehaika o dilma hannacha betocho baenan veleka teku
Bae mar bar rav ashe hafcheh lemana vedabbekeh lekometz bearita demana may hannacha betocho baenan vehaika o dilma ketikno bainan veleka teku
Matni ketzad hu ose poshet et etzbeotav al pas yado riba shamnah chisser shamnah chiser levonatah pesula
Gema hechi dame riba shamnah amar rabbi eliezer kegon shehifrish lah shene luggin velokmah kegon dearev bah shemen dechullin vashemen dachavertah
Vechi tema shemen dechullin vashemen dachavertah la pasel matkef lah rav zutra bar toviyya ella meatta minchat chote defasel bah shemen hechi mashkachatte lah
I didah ha let lah i dechullin vedachavertah ha amratte la pasel vei amratte deafresh leh shemen kevan delet leh shemen kelal chullin ninhu
Verabbi eliezer la mibaya kaamar la mibaya dechullin vedachavertah defasel aval hifrish lah shene luggin hoil vehay chaze leh vehay chaze leh ema la lipsil ka mashma lan
Umna leh lerabbi eliezer ha amar rava matnitin keshiteh may irya detane riba shamnah litne riba lah shemen ella ha ka mashma lan deaf al gav dehifrish lah shene luggin
Chiser levonatah tanu rabbanan chasra veamda al koret echad pesula al shene keratin keshera divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer al koret echad keshera pachot mikkan pesula
b: Vehatanya rabbi shimon omer kometz levona shechasar kol shehu pasul teni koret levona shechasar kol shehu pasul veibaet ema kan bilvona habbaa im hammincha kan bilvona habbaa bifne atzmah

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan shalosh machlokot baddavar rabbi meir savar kometz battechila vekometz bassof verabbi yehuda savar kometz battechila ushne keratin bassof verabbi shimon savar kometz battechila vekoret echad bassof

Ushloshtan mikra echad darshu veet kol hallevona asher al hammincha rabbi meir savar ad deita lilvona deikvaa bahade mincha meikara verabbi yehuda savar kol vaafilu chad koret et lerabbot koret acher verabbi shimon et la daresh

Veamar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan machloket bilvona habbaa im hammincha aval bilvona habbaa bifne atzmah divre hakkol kometz battechila vekometz bassof lehachi itzterich asher al hammincha devahade mincha in bifne atzmah la
Veamar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan machloket bilvona habbaa im hammincha aval bilvona habbaa bevazichin divre hakkol shene kematzin battechila ushne kematzin bassof
Peshita mahu detema kevan devahade lechem atya kaasher al hammincha damya ka mashma lan

Peligi bah rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha chad amar machloket bilvona habbaa im hammincha aval bilvona habbaa bifne atzmah divre hakkol kometz battechila vekometz bassof vechad amar kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo
Chiser levonatah ha yater keshera vehatanya yater pesula amar rame bar chama kegon shehifrish lah shene kematzin
Veamar rame bar chama hifrish lah shene kematzin veavad echad mehen kodem kemitza lo hukbeu achar kemitza hukbeu
Veamar rame bar chama hifrish arbaa kematzin lishne bazichin veavdu shenayim mehen kodem siluk bazichin la hukbeu leachar siluk bazichin hukbeu
Ha tu lema li hayenu hach
Mahu detema kevan divrir kometz didah kevan shehiggia zemannah leforkah keman difrika damya ka mashma lan

Matni hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha bachutz o kezayit mishsheyareha bachutz lehaktir kumtzah bachutz o kezayit kumtzah bachutz o lehaktir levonatah bachutz pasul veen bo karet leechol sheyareha lemachar o kezayit mishsheyareha lemachar lehaktir kumtzah lemachar o kezayit mikkumtzah lemachar o lehaktir levona lemachar

a: Pigul vechayyavin alav karet

Ze hakkelal kol hakkometz o noten bichli hammolich hammaktir leechol davar sheddarko leechol ulhaktir davar sheddarko lehaktir chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmanno pigul vechayyavin alav karet uvilvad sheyyakriv hammattir kemitzvato

Ketzad karev hammattir kemitzvato kamatz bishtika natan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz lizmanno o shekkamatz chutz lizmanno natan bichli veholich vehiktir bishtika o shekkamatz venatan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz lizmanno zehu shekkarev hammattir kemitzvato

Ketzad lo karav hammattir kemitzvato kamatz chutz limkomo natan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz lizmanno o shekkamatz chutz lizmanno natan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz limkomo o shekkamatz natan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz limkomo zehu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato

Minchat chote uminchat kenaot shekkematzan shello lishman natan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz lizmanno o shekkamatz chutz lizmanno natan bichli veholich vehiktir shello lishman o shekkamatz venatan bichli veholich vehiktir shello lishman zehu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato
Leechol kezayit bachutz kezayit lemachar kezayit lemachar kezayit bachutz kachatzi zayit bachutz kachatzi zayit lemachar kachatzi zayit lemachar kachatzi zayit bachutz pasul veen bo karet

Amar rabbi yehuda ze hakkelal im machshevet hazzeman kadma lemachshevet hammakom pigul vechayyavin alav karet im machshevet hammakom kadma lemachshevet hazzeman pasul veen bo karet vachachamim omrim ze vaze pasul veen bo karet
Gema ibaya lehu ledivre haomer shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaktara maktir kometz alehen vekayema lan deotan shirayim asurim baachila mahu detihanne lehu haktara lemikbeinhu befigul
Ulappokinhu mide meila
Amar rav huna afilu lerabbi akiva deamar zerika moelet layyotze hane mile yotze
Deiteh beeneh ufasul mechamat davar acher hu aval chesron difsula degufeh hu la mahneya leh haktara
Amar leh rava adderabba afilu lerabbi eliezer deamar en zerika moelet layyotze hane mile yotze deleteh bifnim aval chesron deiteh bifnim mahneya leh haktara
Amar rava mena amena lah ditnan hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha bachutz o kezayit mishsheyareha bachutz vetane rabbi chiyya hakkometz et hammincha vela tane o kezayit
May tama la tane o kezayit lav kegon shechasru shirayim vekamu lehu akkezayit vechevan divmattan keli behiluch uvhaktara la mittene leh
b: O kezayit ashshirayim bikmitza name leechol shirayim la tane o kezayit vekatane sefa pigul vechayyavin alav karet alma mahneya lehu haktara

Amar leh abbaye la ha manni rabbi elazar hi ditnan hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim shehikriv meachat mehen kezayit bachutz chayyav verabbi elazar poter ad sheyyakriv et kullo
Kevan divhaktarat kemitza la mittene leh o kezayit mikkumtzah bachutz beshirayim name la mittene leh o kezayit
I rabbi elazar hay lehaktir kumtzah lehaktir kumtzah ulvonatah mibe leh ditnan hakkometz vehallevona shehikriv et echad mehen bachutz chayyav verabbi elazar poter ad sheyyakriv et shenehem
Lo nitzrecha ella lekometz deminchat chote
Veikfel tanna leashmoinan kometz deminchat chote in vechen ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi elazar kometz deminchat chote hu verabbi elazar hi
Hadar amar rava lav milta hi daamari detanya kodesh kadashim hu sheim nifresa achat mehen challoteha kullan pesulot
Ha yatzat hane deika gavay kesherot man shamatte leh deamar zerika moelet layyotze rabbi akiva hi vekaamar nifresa la
Amar leh abbaye mi katane ha yatzat dilma ha nitmet hanach kesherot
May tama dimratztze tzitz aval yatzat la verabbi eliezer hi deamar en zerika moelet layyotze

Uvdin hu deibi leh lemitne name yatzat vehay dekatane nifresa ha ka mashma lan daafilu nifresa deiteh bifnim la mahneya leh haktara aval lerabbi akiva deamar zerika moelet layyotze afilu chesron name mahneya leh haktara
Matni leechol kachatzi zayit ulhaktir kachatzi zayit kasher sheen achila vehaktara mitztarfin
Gema tama deleechol ulhaktir ha leechol veleechol davar sheen darko leechol mitztaref
Vehakatane resha leechol davar sheddarko leechol ulhaktir davar sheddarko lehaktir davar sheddarko leechol in sheen darko leechol la man tanna
Amar rabbi yirmeya ha manni rabbi eliezer hi deamar mechashshevin meachilat adam lammizbeach umeachilat mizbeach laadam
Ditnan hakkometz et hammincha leechol davar sheen darko leechol ulhaktir davar sheen darko lehaktir kasher verabbi eliezer posel
Abbaye amar afilu tema rabbanan la tema ha leechol veleechol davar sheen darko leechol ella ema ha leechol veleechol davar sheddarko leechol

Umay ka mashma lan ha behedya katane lah leechol kezayit bachutz uchzayit lemachar kezayit lemachar uchzayit bachutz kachatzi zayit bachutz vechachatzi zayit lemachar kachatzi zayit lemachar vechachatzi zayit bachutz pasul veen bo karet

a: Ha tu lema li i leechol veleechol davar sheddarko leechol ka mashma lan demitztaref meresha desefa shamatte minah dekatane kachatzi zayit bachutz kachatzi zayit lemachar pasul ha kachatzi zayit lemachar vechachatzi zayit lemachar pigul
I leechol ulhaktir dehi gufah ka mashma lan middiyyuka deresha shamatte minah
Dehashta ma leechol veleechol davar sheen darko leechol amratte la mitztaref leechol ulhaktir mibaya
In leechol ulhaktir itztericha leh salka datach amena hatam hu dela ki orcheh kamchashshev
Aval hacha divhay ki orcheh kamchashshev uvhay ki orcheh ka mechashshev ema litztaref ka mashma lan
Hadaran alach kol hammenachot

Matni hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha o lehaktir kumtzah lemachar mode rabbi yose baze shehu pigul vechayyavin alav karet lehaktir levonatah lemachar rabbi yose omer pasul veen bo karet vachachamim omrim pigul vechayyavin alav karet
Amru lo ma shina shanat zo min hazzevach amar lahen shehazzevach damo uvsaro veemurav echad ulvona enah min hammincha
Gema lema li lemitne mode rabbi yose bazo
Mishshum deka bae lemitne sefa lehaktir levonatah lemachar rabbi yose omer pasul veen bo karet
Mahu detema tama derabbi yose mishshum dekasavar en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir vaafilu resha name
b: Ka mashma lan divha mode
Lehaktir levonatah lemachar rabbi yose omer pasul veen bo karet amar resh lakish omer haya rabbi yose en mattir mefaggel et hammattir
Vechen atta omer bishne beziche levona shel lechem happanim sheen mattir mefaggel et hammattir
May vechen atta omer mahu detema tama derabbi yose bilvona mishshum delav minah demincha hi aval bishne beziche levona deminah dahadade ninhu ema mefaggeli ahadade ka mashma lan

Umi matzet amratte tama derabbi yose bilvona lav mishshum delav minah demincha hi veha katane sefa amru lo ma shinta min hazzevach amar lahen hazzevach damo uvsaro veemurav echad ulvona enah min hammincha

May enah min hammincha enah beikuv mincha delav ki hechi dimakkev lehu kometz leshirayim dechamma delav mitkattar kometz la mitachli shirayim hachi name meakkev lah lilvona ella i bae hay maktar beresha vei bae hay maktar beresha

Verabbanan ki amrinan en mattir mefaggel et hammattir gabbe shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol mechavero lemachar deamratte shenehem kesherim hane mile hecha dela ikvau bechad mana aval hecha deikvau bechad mana kechad dame
Amar rabbi yannay likut levona bezar pasul may tama amar rabbi yirmeya mishshum holacha nagu bah kasavar holacha shello baregel shemah holacha veholacha bezar pesula
Amar rav mari af anan name tenena ze hakkelal kol hakkometz venoten bichli vehammolich vehammaktir
Bishlama kometz hayenu shochet molich name hayenu molich maktir hayenu zorek ella noten bichli may ka aved
Ilema mishshum dedame lekabbala mi dame hatam mimmela hacha ka shakel verame

Ella mishshum dechevan dela saggi leh dela aved lah avoda chashuva hi al kurchach meshave lah kekabbala hacha name kevan dela saggi leh dela aved lah avoda chashuva hi al kurchach meshave lah ki holacha
La leolam dedame lekabbala udka kashya lach hatam mimmela hacha ka shakel verame
Mikkede tarvayehu kedushshat keli hu ma li mimmela ma li ka shakel verame

Matni shachat shene kevasim leechol achat min hachallot lemachar hiktir shene bazichin leechol echad min hassedarim lemachar rabbi yose omer otah hachalla veoto hasseder shechishev alav pigul vechayyavin alav karet vehashsheni pasul veen bo karet vachachamim omrim ze vaze pigul vechayyavin alav karet
Gema amar rav huna omer haya rabbi yose pigel bayyarech shel yamin lo nitpaggel hayyarech shel semol may tama ibaet ema sevara veibaet ema kera
Ibaet ema sevara la adifa machshava mimmaase hattuma ilu itammi chad ever mi itammi leh kulleh veibaet ema kera vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu aonah tissa mimmennu velo mechavero
Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna vachachamim omrim leolam en bo karet ad sheyefaggel bishtehen bichzayit bishtehen in beachat mehen la
Manni ilema rabbanan afilu beachat mehen name ella peshita rabbi yose i amratte bishlama chad gufa hu mishshum hachi mitztaref

a: Ella i amratte tere gufe ninhu mi mitztarfi
Ha manni rabbi hi detanya hashshochet et hakkeves leechol chatzi zayit mechalla zo vechen chavero leechol chatzi zayit mechalla zo rabbi omer omer ani shezze kasher
Tama deamar chatzi chatzi aval amar kezayit mishshettehen mitztaref
Verabbi alliba deman i alliba derabbanan afilu beachat mehen name i alliba derabbi yose hadar kushyan leduchteh
Leolam alliba derabbanan vela tema ad sheyefaggel bishtehen ella ema ad sheyefaggel bishnehen vaafilu beachat mehen
Ulappoke midderabbi meir deamar mefaggelin bachatzi mattir ka mashma lan dela
I hachi may leolam i amratte bishlama bishtehen uvishnehen verabbi yose hi ulappoke midderabbi meir umidderabbanan kaate hayenu dekaamar leolam
Ella i amratte rabbanan ulappoke midderabbi meir may leolam
Veod ha amar rav ashe ta shema rabbi omer mishshum rabbi yose pigel bedavar hannaase bachutz pigel bedavar hannaase bifnim lo pigel

Ketzad haya omed bachutz veamar hareni shochet al menat lehazzot middamo lemachar lo pigel shemmachshava bachutz bedavar hannaase befanim haya omed bifnim veamar hareni mazze al menat lehaktir emurin lemachar velishpoch shirayim lemachar lo pigel shemmachshava bifnim bedavar hannaase bachutz
Haya omed bachutz veamar hareni shochet al menat lishpoch shirayim lemachar ulhaktir emurin lemachar pigel shemmachshava bachutz bedavar hannaase bachutz

Lishpoch shirayim leipaggole may ilema leipaggole dam dam mi mipaggal vehatnan ellu devarim sheen chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret uminchat kohanim uminchat nesachim uminchat kohen mashiach vehaddam

Ella peshita leippaggole basar hashta uma hatam dela chashshev beh bevasar gufeh amar rabbi yose mipaggal hacha dechashshev beh bezevach gufeh lo kol shekken defigel beyerech yamin pigel beyerech semol
Veod haamar ravina ta shema hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha o lehaktir kumtzah lemachar mode rabbi yose bazo sheppigel vechayyavin alav karet

Lehaktir kumtzah leipaggole may ilema leipaggole kometz kometz mi mipaggal vehatnan ellu devarim sheen chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul hakkometz ku ella peshita leipaggole shirayim hashta uma hatam dela chashshev behu beshirayim gufeh
b: Mipaggeli hacha dechashshev behu bizvicha gufah lo kol shekken
Ella amar rabbi yochanan hayenu tama derabbi yose hakkatuv asaan guf echad vehakkatuv asaan shene gufin guf echad dimakkevi ahadade shene gufin deamar rachamana ha lechodah avida veha lechodah avida
Arvinhu mitarvin dehakkatuv asaan guf echad palginhu mipalgi dehakkatuv asaan shene gufin
Bae rabbi yochanan pigel belachme toda mahu beminchat maafe mahu tena leh rav tachlifa mimmareva vechen atta omer belachme toda vechen atta omer beminchat maafe
Tanu rabbanan bishat shechita chishev leechol chatzi zayit uvishat zerika chishev leechol chatzi zayit pigul mippene sheshshechita uzrika mitztarfin
Ika deamri shechita uzrika detarvayehu mattirin in kabbala veholacha la veika deamri hanach dimrachakan vechol shekken hane dimkarvan
Ini veha tane levi arba avodot en mitztarfot lefigul shechita uzrika kabbala veholacha amar rava la kashya ha rabbi ha rabbanan
Detanya hashshochet et hakkeves leechol chatzi zayit mechalla zo vechen chavero leechol chatzi zayit mechalla zo rabbi omer omer ani shezze kasher
Amar leh abbaye emar deshamatte leh lerabbi chatzi mattir vachatzi achila kullo mattir vachatzi achila mi shamatte leh
Amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye vei it leh lerabbi kullo mattir vachatzi achila ligzor chatzi mattir vachatzi achila attu kullo mattir vachatzi achila deha rabbi yose gazar verabbanan gazri
Rabbi yose gazar ditnan lehaktir levonatah lemachar rabbi yose omer pasul veen bo karet vachachamim omrim pigul vechayyavin aleha karet
Verabbanan name gazri ditnan pigel bakkometz velo ballevona ballevona velo bakkometz rabbi meir omer pigul vechayyavin alav karet vachachamim omrim en bo karet ad sheyefaggel bechol hammattir
Amar leh hachi hashta bishlama hatam gazar rabbi yose kometz dilvona attu kometz demincha
Rabbanan gazri kometz attu kometz deminchat chote ulvona attu levona habbaa bevazichin
Kevasim name keves attu keves chavero
Bazech attu bazech chavero
Ella hacha mi ika chatzi mattir vachatzi achila bealma delekum veligzar

Hachi name mistabbera detama derabbanan mishshum hachi hu dekatane sefa modim chachamim lerabbi meir beminchat chote uminchat kenaot sheim pigel bakkometz sheppigul vechayyavin aleha karet shehakkometz hu hammattir
Ha lema li lemitna kelal peshita mi ika mattir acharina ella lav ha ka mashma lan detama dekometz mishshum deika kometz deminchat chote dedame leh
Matni nitmet achat min hachallot o echad min hassedarim rabbi yehuda omer shenehem yetzu levet hasserefa sheen korban tzibur chaluk vachachamim omrim hattame betumato vehattahor yeachel
Gema amar rabbi elazar machloket lifne zerika aval leachar zerika divre hakkol hattame betumato vehattahor yeachel
Velifne zerika bemay peligi amar rav pappa betzitz meratztze al achilot ka mipalgi

a: Rabbanan savri hatztzitz meratztze al achilot verabbi yehuda savar en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa veha olin dehatztzitz meratztze al haolin ufligi
Detanya nitma echad min habbazichin rabbi yehuda omer shenehem yeasu betuma lefi sheen korban tzibur chaluk vachachamim omrim hattame betumato vehattahor betohorato
Veod amar rav ashe ta shema rabbi yehuda omer afilu shevet echad tame vechol hashshevatim tehorin yaasu betuma lefi sheen korbenot korban tzibur chaluk vehacha may hatztzitz meratztze ika

Veod haamar ravina ta shema nitmet achat min hachallot o achat echad min hassedarin rabbi yehuda omer shenehem yetzu levet hasserefa lefi sheen korban tzibur chaluk vachachamim omrim hattame betumato vehattahor yeachel
Veim ita lefi sheen hatztzitz meratztze al achilot mibe leh ella amar rabbi yochanan talmud aruch hu befiv shel rabbi yehuda sheen korban tzibur chaluk

Matni hattoda mefaggelet et hallechem vehallechem eno mefaggel et hattoda ketzad shachat et hattoda leechol mimmenna lemachar hi vehallechem mefuggalin leechol min hallechem lemachar hallechem mefuggal vehattoda enah mefuggelet

Hakkevasim mefaggelin et hallechem vehallechem eno mefaggel et hakkevasim ketzad hashshochet et hakkevasim leechol mehen lemachar hem vehallechem mefuggalin leechol et hallechem lemachar hallechem mefuggal vehakkevasim enan mefuggalin
Gema may tama ilema mishshum derav kahana deamar rav kahana minnayin lelachme toda shennikreu toda shenneemar vehikriv al zevach hattoda challot
I hachi ipcha name ha la kashya lechem ikri toda toda la ikri lechem

Ella ha dekatane hakkevasim mefaggelin et hallechem vehallechem eno mefaggel et hakkevasim lechem hecha ashkechan deikri kevasim ella lav hayenu tama lechem gelal toda veen toda gelal lechem lechem gelal chevasim veen kevasim gelal lechem

Utzrichi dei ashmeinan toda hatam hu dechi mefaggel belechem la mippaggela toda mishshum dela huzkeku ze laze bitnufa aval kevasim dehuzkeku ze laze bitnufa ema ki mefaggel belechem lipaggeli name kevasim tzericha
Bea mineh rabbi elazar merav hashshochet et hattoda leechol kezayit mimmenna umillachmah lemachar mahu leipaggole toda la mibaya li hashta kullo millachmah la mipaggela mimmenna umillachmah mibaya
Ki ka mibaya li leipaggole lechem mi mitztarfa toda leipaggole lelechem o la
Amar leh af bezo hallechem mefuggal vehattoda enah mefuggelet veammay lema kal vachomer uma toda hamfaggel en mitpaggel habba lefaggel velo pigel eno din shello yitpaggel
Umi amrinan kal vachomer ki hay gavena vehatanya maase beechad
b: Shezzara karmo shel chavero semadar uva maase lifne chachamim veasru et hazzeraim vehittiru et haggefanim veammay lema kal vachomer hu uma haoser eno neesar habba leesor velo asar eno din shello yitasser

Hachi hashta hatam kanbos veluf asra tora ditnan hayeta sadehu zerua kanbos velof lo yehe zorea al gabbehem shehen osot leshalosh shanim shear zeraim midderabbanan hu daasiri hay deaved isura kansuh rabbanan hay dela aved isura la kansuh rabbanan aval hacha lema kal vachomer
Veika dematne lah akkevasim bea mineh rabbi elazar merav hashshochet et hakkevasim leechol kezayit mehen umillachman mahu
Leipaggole kevasim la ka mibaya li hashta kullo millechem la mippaggeli mehen umillachman mibaya ki ka mibaya li leipaggole lechem mi mitztarfi kevasim leipaggole lelechem o la
Amar leh af bezo hallechem mefuggal vehakkevasim enan mefuggalin veammay lema kal vachomer uma hamfaggel eno mitpaggel habba lefaggel velo pigel eno din shello yitpaggel
Umi amrinan kal vachomer ki hay gavena vehatanya maase beechad shezzara karmo shel chavero semadar vechu veammay lema kal vachomer ma haoser eno neesar habba leesor vela asar eno din shello yitasser
Hachi hashta hatam kanbos valuf asra tora shear zeraim midderabbanan hu daasiri hay deaved isura kansuh rabbanan dela aved isura la kansuh rabbanan aval hacha lema kal vachomer
Man dematne lah attoda kol shekken akkevasim uman dematne lah akkevasim kevasim hu dehuzkeku ze laze litnufa aval toda delo huzkeka ze laze bitnufa la
Rabbi abba zute bae lah hachi bea mineh rabbi elazar merav hashshochet et hakkeves leechol kezayit mechavero lemachar mahu chavero keves mashma vela mefaggel o dilma lechem mashma umfaggel leh

Amar leh tenetuha shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol mimmennu lemachar hu pigul vachavero kasher leechol mechavero lemachar shenehem kesherim alma chavero keves mashma dilma defaresh veamar chavero keves

Matni hazzevach mefaggel et hannesachim mishshekkadshu bichli divre rabbi meir hannesachim enan mefaggelim et hazzevach ketzad hashshochet et hazzevach leechol mimmennu lemachar hu unsachav mefuggalin lehakriv nesachav lemachar hannesachim mefuggalin hazzevach eno mefuggal
Gema tanu rabbanan nische behema chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul mippene sheddam hazzevach mattiran likrav divre rabbi meir
Amru lo lerabbi meir vahalo adam mevi zivcho hayyom unsachav ad asara yamim amar lahen af ani lo amarti ella bevain im hazzevach amru lo efshar leshannoto lezevach acher
Amar rava kasavar rabbi meir hukbeu bishchita kelachme toda

Tanu rabbanan log shemen shel metzora chayyavin alav mishshum pigul mippene sheddam asham mattiro labbehonot divre rabbi meir amru lo lerabbi meir vahalo adam mevi ashamo hayyom veluggo mikan vead asara yamim
Amar lahen af ani lo amarti ella beva im haasham efshar leshannoto leasham acher amar rava kasavar rabbi meir hukbeu bishchita kelachme toda

a: Matni pigel bakkometz velo ballevona ballevona velo bakkometz rabbi meir omer pigul vechayyavin alav karet vachachamim omrim en bo karet ad sheyefaggel bechol hammattir
Umodim chachamim lerabbi meir beminchat chote uvminchat kenaot sheim pigel bakkometz shehu pigul vechayyavin alav karet shehakkometz hu hammattir

Shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol shette challot lemachar hiktir echad min habbazichin leechol shene sedarim lemachar rabbi meir omer pigul vechayyavin alav karet vachachamim omrim en bo karet ad sheyefaggel bechol hammattir
Shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol mimmennu lemachar hu pigul vachavero kasher leechol mechavero lemachar shenehem kesherim
Gema amar rav machloket shennatan et hakkometz bishtika veet hallevona bemachshava
Aval natan hakkometz bemachshava veet hallevona bishtika divre hakkol pigul shekkol haose al daat rishona hu ose ushmuel amar adayin hi machloket
Yatev rava vekaamar lah leha shemata etiveh rav acha bar rav huna lerava bamme devarim amurim bikmitza uvmattan keli uvhiluch

Ba lo lehaktara natan et hakkometz bishtika veet hallevona bemachshava et hakkometz bemachshava veet hallevona bishtika rabbi meir omer pigul vechayyavin alav karet vachachamim omrim en bo karet ad sheyefaggel bechol hammattir
Katane miha natan et hakkometz bemachshava veet hallevona bishtika ufligi
Ema uchvar natan et hallevona bishtika meikara shette teshuvot baddavar chada dehayenu kammayeta veod hatanya achar kach
Targemah rav chanina bishte deot
Ta shema bamme devarim amurim bedamim hannitanin al mizbeach hachitzon

Aval damim hannitanin al mizbeach happenimi kegon arbaim veshalosh shel yom hakkipurim veachat esre shel par kohen mashuach veachat esre shel par helem davar shel tzibur pigel ben barishona ben bashsheniyya uven bashshelishit rabbi meir omer pigul vechayyavin alav karet vachachamim omrim en bo karet ad sheyefaggel bechol hammattir
Katane miha pigel ben barishona ben bashsheniyya uven bashshelishit ufligi
Vechi tema hacha name bishte deot hanicha leman deamar befar vaafilu bedamo shel par ella leman deamar befar velo bedamo shel par may ika lememar
Amar rava hacha bemay askinan kegon sheppigel barishona veshatak bashsheniyya ufigel bashshelishit deamrinan i salka datach kol haose al daat rishona hu ose mihdar pagole bashshelishit lema li

Matkef lah rav ashe mide shatak katane ella amar rav ashe hacha bemay askinan kegon sheppigel barishona uvashsheniyya uvashshelishit deamrinan i salka datach kol haose al daat rishona hu ose mihdar paggole bashsheniyya uvashshelishit lema li
b: Veha ben ben katane kashya
Amar mar rabbi meir omer piggul vechayyavin alav karet mikkede karet la michayyav ad sheyyikrevu kol hammattirin
Deamar mar yeratze kehartzaat kasher kach hartzaat pasul ma hartzaat kasher ad sheyyikrevu kol hammattirin af hartzaat pasul ad sheyyikrevu kol hammattirin
Vehay kevan dechashshev beh bifnim pasleh ki madde behechal mayya bealma hu deka madde
Amar rabba mashkachatte lah bearbaa parim vearbaa seirim
Rava amar afilu tema par echad vesair echad lefaggole meratztze
Arbaim veshalosh vehatanya arbaim vasheva la kashya ha keman deamar mearvin likranot veha keman deamar en mearvin
Vehatanya arbaim ushmona la kashya ha keman deamar shirayim meakkevin ha keman deamar shirayim lo meakkevin
Ibaya lehu pigel beholacha mahu
Amar rabbi yochanan holacha kikmitza veresh lakish amar holacha kehaktara
Bishlama leresh lakish ika name holacha dilvona ella lerabbi yochanan may tama
Amar rava kasavar rabbi yochanan kol avoda sheenah matteret avoda chashuva hi lefaggel aleha bifne atzmah
Amar leh abbaye hare shechitat echad min hakkevasim daavoda sheenah mattiratah ufligi

Ditnan shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol shette challot lemachar hiktir echad min habbazichin leechol shene sedarim lemachar rabbi meir omer piggul vechayyavin alav karet vachachamim omrim en bo karet ad sheyefaggel bechol hammattir
Amar leh mi savratte lechem betannur kadosh shechitat kevasim mekaddesha leh vehabba lekaddesh keva lehattir dame
Metiv rav shimi bar ashe acherim omrim hikdim mulim laarelim kasher hikdim arelim lemulim pasul
Vekayema lan devachatzi mattir peligi amar leh mi savratte dam betzavar behema kadosh dam sakkin mekaddesha leh vehabba lekaddesh keva lehattir dame
Ta shema bamme devarim amurim bikmitza uvmattan keli uvhiluch
May lav hiluch dehaktara la hiluch demattan keli
I hachi bemattan keli uvhiluch behiluch uvmattan keli mibe leh ha la kashya tane hachi
Ba lo lehaktara ba lo leholacha mibe leh ha la kashya kevan deholacha tzorech dehaktara hi kare lah haktara
Ella natan et hakkometz bishtika holich mibe leh kashya
Hiktir shumshum leechol shumshum ad shekkala kometz kullo rav chisda verav hamnuna verav sheshet chad amar pigul vechad amar pasul vechad amar kasher
Lema man deamar pigul kerabbi meir uman deamar pasul kerabbanan uman deamar kasher kerabbi
Mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella dechishev beshiuro aval hacha delo chishev beshiuro la
Vead kan la ka amri rabbanan hatam ella dela chashshev beh bechulleh mattir aval hacha dechashshev beh bechulleh mattir hachi name defaggel
Vead kan la ka amar rabbi hatam ella dela hadar malleyeh meotah avoda aval hacha dahadar malleyeh meotah avoda hachi name defasel
Ella man deamar pigul divre hakkol man deamar pasul divre hakkol man deamar kasher divre hakkol

Man deamar pigul divre hakkol kasavar derech achila bechach vederech haktara bechach uman deamar pasul divre hakkol kasavar en derech achila bechach veen derech haktara bechach vehaveya lah kemincha shello huktera uman deamar kasher divre hakkol kasavar derech haktara bechach veen derech achila bechach
Amri

a: Charife defumbedita haktara mefaggelet haktara vaafilu lerabbanan deamri en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir hane mile hecha dechashshev beh beshirayim ulvona bemilta kayema aval hacha dechashshev lah bilvona kema dechashshev beh bechulleh mattir dame

Amar rava af anan name tenena ze hakkelal kol hakkometz venoten bichli vehammolich vehammaktir leechol davar sheddarko leechol ulhaktir davar sheddarko lehaktir chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmanno piggul vechayyavin alav karet
May lav haktara dumya dehanach ma hanach ben leechol ben lehaktir af haktara ben leechol ben lehaktir
La hanach ben leechol ben lehaktir haktara leechol in lehaktir la
Yatev rav menashsheya bar gadda kammeh deabbaye veyatev veka amar mishshemeh derav chisda en haktara mefaggelet haktara vaafilu lerabbi meir deamar mefaggelin bachatzi mattir
Hane mile hecha dechashshev behu beshirayim dekometz mattir didhu aval hacha dekometz lav mattir dilvona hu la matze mefaggel beh
Amar leh abbaye ani mari mishshemeh derav amar leh in itmar name amar rav chisda amar rav en haktara mefaggelet haktara

Amar rav yaakov bar idi mishshemeh deabbaye af anan name tenena shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol mimmennu lemachar hu pigul vachavero kasher leechol mechavero lemachar shenehem kesherin may tama lav mishshum dechevan delav mattir dideh hu la matze mefaggel beh
La hatam hu dela ikva bechad mana aval hacha deikva bechad mana ki chad damu
Amar rav hamnuna ha milta avla li rabbi chanina utkila li kechulleh talmuday hiktir kometz lehaktir levona ulvona leechol shirayim lemachar piggul

May ka mashma lan i haktara mefaggelet haktara ka mashma lan lema hiktir kometz lehaktir levona i mefaggelin bachatzi mattir ka mashma lan lema hiktir kometz leechol shirayim lemachar i tarvayehu ata ka mashma lan lema hiktir kometz lehaktir levona veleechol shirayim lemachar
Amar rav adda bar ahava leolam kasavar en haktara mefaggelet haktara veen mefaggelin bachatzi mattir veshane hacha defashta lah machshava bechullah mincha
Tane tanna kammeh derav yitzchak bar abba hiktir kometz leechol shirayim ledivre hakkol piggul veha miflag peligi ella ema ledivre hakkol pasul
Velema hare ze piggul verabbi meir hi tanna divre hakkol atneuh pigul befasul michallaf leh hare ze bedivre hakkol la michallaf leh
Hadaran alach hakkometz et hammincha
Matni hakkometz et hammincha leechol davar sheen darko leechol ulhaktir davar sheen darko lehaktir kasher rabbi eliezer posel
Leechol davar sheddarko leechol ulhaktir davar sheddarko lehaktir pachot mikkezayit kasher leechol kachatzi zayit ulhaktir kachatzi zayit kasher sheen achila vehaktara mitztarfin

Gema amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan may tama derabbi eliezer amar kera veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav bishte achilot hakkatuv medabber echad achilat adam veechad achilat mizbeach lomar lach keshem shemmechashshevin baachilat adam kach mechashshevin baachilat mizbeach
Uchshem shemmechashshevin meachilat adam laachilat adam umeachilat mizbeach laachilat mizbeach kach mechashshevin meachilat adam lammizbeach umeachilat mizbeach laadam
May tama middeappekinhu rachamana lehaktara bilshon achila
Verabbanan hay deappekinhu rachamana bilshon achila
b: Dela shena ki mechashshev bilshon achila lemizbeach vela shena ki mechashshev bilshon haktara lammizbeach
I name ma achila bichzayit af haktara bichzayit ulolam achila deorcha mashma
Verabbi eliezer im ken lichtov rachamana im heachol heachol i name im yeachel yeachel may heachol yeachel shamatte minah tarte

Amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi vei tama derabbi eliezer mishshum hachi hu karet name lichayyav vechi tema hachi name veha atte hu deamratte mishshemeh derabbi yochanan mode rabbi eliezer sheen anush karet
Amar leh tannae hi alliba derabbi eliezer ika leman deamar pesula deorayeta veika leman deamar pesula derabbanan

Detanya hashshochet et hazzevach lishtot middamo lemachar lehaktir mibbesaro lemachar leechol meemurav lemachar kasher verabbi eliezer posel lehanniach middamo lemachar rabbi yehuda posel amar rabbi elazar af bazo rabbi eliezer posel vachachamim machshirin
Rabbi yehuda alliba deman ilema alliba derabbanan hashta uma hatam deka mechashshev bilshon achila machsheri rabbanan hacha lo kol shekken
Ella alliba derabbi eliezer veamar rabbi elazar af bezo rabbi eliezer posel vachachamim machshirin rabbi elazar hayenu rabbi yehuda
Ella lav karet ika benayehu derabbi yehuda detanna kamma savar lehanniach pesula bealma behanach karet name michayyav vaata rabbi elazar lememar ide veide pasul veen bo karet
La dechulle alma karet leka vehacha shalosh machloket bedavar tanna kamma savar behanach peligi lehanniach divre hakkol kasher

a: Verabbi yehuda savar behanach peligi lehanniach divre hakkol pasul may tama gezera miktzat damo attu kol damo vechol damo pesula deorayeta
Detanya amar lahem rabbi yehuda i attem modim li sheim hinnicho lemachar sheppasul chishev lehannicho lemachar name pasul
Vaata rabbi elazar lememer af bezo rabbi eliezer posel vachachamim machshirin

Vesavar rabbi yehuda lehanniach middamo lemachar divre hakkol pasul vehatanya amar rabbi keshehalachti lematztzot middotay etzel rabbi elazar ben shammua veamri lah lematztzot middotav shel rabbi elazar ben shammua matzati yosef habbavli yoshev lefanav vehaya chaviv lo beoter ad leachat amar lo rabbi hashshochet et hazzevach lehanniach middamo lemachar mahu
Amar lo kasher arvit amar lo kasher shacharit amar lo kasher tzohorayim amar lo kasher mincha amar lo kasher ella sherabbi eliezer posel tzahavu panav shel yosef habbavli

Amar lo yosef kimdumme ani shello kivannu shemuatenu ad atta amar lo rabbi hen ella sherabbi yehuda pasul shana li vechazarti al kol talmidav uvikkashti li chaver velo matzati achshav sheshshanita li pasul hechzarta li avedati

Zalgu enav demaot shel rabbi elazar ben shammua amar ashrechem talmide chachamim sheddivre tora chavivin alechem beoter kara alav hammikra hazze ma ahavti toratecha kol hayyom hi sichati vego ha mippene sherabbi yehuda beno shel rabbi ilay verabbi ilay talmido shel rabbi eliezer lefichach shana lecha mishnat rabbi eliezer
Vei salka datach divre hakkol pasul atneyeh may hechzarta li avedati ihu pelugta kaamar leh
Ella may kasher verabbi eliezer pasul posel atneyeh i hachi may ha mippene pelugta anan name pelugta ka matninan
Ella leolam divre hakkol pasul atneyeh umay hechzarta li avedati deahdar leh miha shum paslut baolam
Matni lo yatzak lo balal velo patat velo melach velo henif lo higgish o sheppetatan pittim merubbot velo meshachan keshera
Gema may lo yatzak ilema lo yatzak kelal ikuva ketav bah ella lo yatzak kohen ella zar i hachi lo balal name lo balal kohen ella zar ha lo balal kelal pesula
b: Vehatnan shishshim nivlalin shishshim veechad en nivlalin vehavenan bah ki enam nivlalin may have vehatnan lo balal keshera
Veamar rabbi zera kol harauy levila en bila meakkevet bo vechol sheeno rauy levila bila meakkevet bo
Mide irya ha kiditah veha kiditah lo yatzak lo yatzak kohen ella zar lo balal lo balal kelal
O sheppetatan pittim merubbot keshera hashta lo patat kelal keshera pittin merubbot mibaya may pittin merubbot sheriba biftitin
Veibaet ema leolam pittim merubbot mammash umahu detema hatam hu deika torat challot alehen aval hacha dela torat challot ika vela torat petitin ika ka mashma lan

Lema matnitin dela kerabbi shimon detanya rabbi shimon omer kol kohen sheeno mode baavoda en lo chelek bakkehunna shenneemar hammakriv et dam hashshelamim veet hachelev mibbene aharon lo tihye shok hayyamin lemana mode baavoda yesh lo chelek bakkehunna sheeno mode baavoda en lo chelek bakkehunna
Veen li ella zo bilvad minnayin lerabbot chamesh esre avodot

Hayetzikot vehabbelilot vehappetitot vehammelichot vehattenufot vehahaggashot vehakkemitzot vehaktarot vehammelikot vehakkabbalot vehazzaot vehashkaat sota vaarifat egla vetohorat metzora unsiut kappayim ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz minnayin
Talmud lomar mibbene aharon avoda hammesura livne aharon kol kohen sheeno mode bah en lo chelek bakkehunna

Amar rav nachman la kashya kan beminchat kohanim kan beminchat yisrael minchat yisrael devat kemitza hi mikkemitza veelach mitzvat kehunna limed al yetzika uvlila shekkeshera bezar minchat kohanim delav bat kemitza hi meikara baaya kehunna
Amar leh rava mikkede minchat kohanim mehecha itrabbay litzika mimminchat yisrael ma hatam keshera bezar af hacha name keshera bezar
Ika deamri amar rav nachman la kashya kan benikmatzot kan besheen nikmatzot
Amar leh rava mikkede sheen nikmatzot mehecha itrabbay litzika minnikmatzot kenikmatzot ma hatam keshera bezar af hacha name keshera bezar ella mechavarta matnitin dela kerabbi shimon
May tama derabbanan amar kera veyatzak aleha shemen venatan aleha levona veheviah el bene aharon hakkohen vekamatz mikkemitza veelach mitzvat kehunna limed al yetzika uvlila shekkeshera bezar
Verabbi shimon bene aharon

a: Hakkohanim mikra nidrash lefanav ulacharav

Vesavar rabbi shimon mikra nidrash lefanav ulacharav vehatanya velakach hakkohen middam hachattat beetzbao venatan al karnot hammizbeach beetzbao velakach melammed shello tehe kabbala ella beyamin beetzbao venatan melammed shello tehe netina ella beyamin
Amar rabbi shimon vechi neemar yad bekabbala hoil velo neemar yad bekabbala kibel bismol kasher
Veamar abbaye bemikra nidrash lefanav ulacharav ka mipalgi verabbi shimon savar leacharav nidrash ulfanav en nidrash
Ella hayenu tama derabbi shimon veheviah vav mosif al inyan rishon

Vesavar rabbi shimon vav mosif al inyan rishon ella meatta dichtiv veshachat et ben habbakar vehikrivu bene aharon hakkohanim et haddam vezarku et haddam mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna melammed al shechita shekkeshera bezar i lerabbi shimon vav mosif al inyan rishon shechita hachi name bezar tehe pesula
Shane hatam deamar kera vesamach veshachat ma semicha bezarim af shechita bezarim
I ma semicha bivalim af shechita bivalim hahu la matzet amarta kal vachomer uma zerika deikar kappara la baaya bealim shechita delav ikar kappara lo kol shekken
Vechi tema en danin efshar mishshei efshar galli rachamana beom hakkippurim veshachat et par hachattat asher lo mikkelal dishchita bealma la baenan bealim
Amar rav kol makom shenneemar tora vechukka eno ella leakkev ka salka datin tarte baaya kedichtiv zot chukkat hattora
Siman
Vahare nazir dela ketiva beh ella tora veamar rav tenufa benazir meakkeva shane hatam kevan dichtiv ken yaase keman dichtiva behu chukka dame
Hare toda dela ketiva beh ella tora utnan arbaa shebbattoda meakkevin ze et ze shane toda deitakkash lenazir dichtiv al zevach todat shelamav veamar mar shelamav lerabbot shalme nazir
Vahare metzora dela ketiv beh ella tora utnan arbaa minin shebbammetzora meakkevin ze et ze shane hatam kevan dichtiv zot tihye torat hammetzora keman dichtiv beh chukka dame
Vahare yom hakkippurim dela ketiv beh ella chukka utnan shene seire yom hakkippurim meakkevin ze et ze ella o tora o chukka
Vahare shear korbanot dichtiv behu tora vela meakkevi tora baaya chukka vechukka la baaya tora
Veha tora vechukka ka amar hachi kaamar af al gav dichtiv tora i ketiva chukka in vei la la
Vahare mincha dichtiv bah chukka veamar rav kol makom shehechzir hakkatuv betorat mincha eno ella leakkev hechzir in lo hechezir la
Shane hatam dechi ketiva chukka aachila ketiva
Vahare lechem happanim dechi ketiva chukka aachila ketiva utnan shene sedarim meakkevin ze et ze shene bazichin meakkevin ze et ze hassedarin vehabbazichin meakkevin ze et ze
Ella kol hecha dichtiva aachila akkolla milta ketiva
Shane hatam deamar kera miggirsah umishshamnah
b: Geres vashemen meakkevin veen davar acher meakkev
Gufa amar rav kol makom shehechzir lecha hakkatuv battora mincha eno ella leakkev ushmuel amar geres vashemen meakkevin veen davar acher meakkev velishmuel af al gav ditna beh kera la meakkeva leh
Ella kol hecha ditna beh kera vadday meakkeva vehacha bimlo kumtzo bekumtzo ka mipalgi detanya melo kumtzo bekumtzo shello yaase midda lakkometz
Rav savar ha name tena beh kera dichtiv vayyakrev et hammincha vayemalle chappo mimmenna ushmuel dorot mishshaa la yalfinan

Vela yalef shemuel dorot mishshaa vehatnan kele hallach mekaddeshin et hallach umiddot yavesh mekaddeshin et hayyavesh veen kele hallach mekaddeshin et hayyavesh velo middot yavesh mekaddeshin et hallach
Veamar shemuel lo shanu ella middot aval mizrakot mekaddeshin dichtiv shenehem meleim solet
Shane hatam ditna bah kera teresar zimnin
Amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav vahare haggasha ditna bah kera vela meakkeva man tena beh dichtiv zot torat hammincha hakrev otah bene aharon lifne Adonai
Hahu likboa lah makom hu daata detanya lifne Adonai yachol bammaarav talmud lomar el pene hammizbeach
I el pene hammizbeach yachol baddarom talmud lomar lifne Adonai ha ketzad maggishah bekeren deromit maaravit keneged chuddah shel keren vedayyo

Rabbi eliezer omer yachol yaggishenna lemaaravah shel keren o lidromah shel keren amarta kol makom sheatta motze shette mikraot echad mekayyem atzmo umkayyem chavero veechad mekayyem atzmo umvattel et chavero mannichin et shemmekayyem atzmo umvattel chavero vetofsin et shemmekayyem atzmo umkayyem chavero
Shekkesheatta omer lifne Adonai bammaarav bittalta el pene hammizbeach baddarom uchsheatta omer el pene hammizbeach baddarom kiyyamta lifne Adonai
Vehecha kiyyamta amar rav ashe kasavar hay tanna kulleh mizbeach betzafon kae
Matkef lah rav huna hare melach dela tena beh kera umakkeva beh detanya berit melach olam hi shettehe

a: Berit amura bemelach divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer neemar kan berit melach olam hi veneemar lehallan berit kehunnat olam keshem shei efshar lekorbanot belo kehunna kach i efshar lekorbanot belo melach
Amar rav yosef rav ketanna didan sevira leh deamar lo malach kasher amar leh abbaye i hachi lo yatzak name lo yatzak kelal ella lo yatzak kohen ella zar hacha name lo malach kohen ella zar
Amar leh vechi taale al datecha shezzar karev legabbe mizbeach
Vei baet ema kevan dichtiva beh berit keman ditna beh kera damya
Vela tena beh kera vehachtiv vechol korban minchatcha bammelach timlach hahu mibe leh lechidtanya ilu neemar korban bammelach shomea ani afilu etzim vadam shennikreu korban
Talmud lomar mincha ma mincha meuchedet sheacherim bain chova lah af kol sheacherim bain chova lah
I ma mincha meuchedet shemmatteret af kol shemmattir avi dam shemmattir talmud lomar meal minchatecha velo meal damecha
Yachol tehe mincha kullah teuna melach talmud lomar korban korban taun melach veen mincha kullah teuna melach
