Veen li ella kometz mincha minnayin lerabbot et hallevona merabbe ani et hallevona shekken baa immah bichli echad
Minnayin lerabbot et hallevona habbaa bifne atzmah ulvona habbaa bevazichin vehakketoret
Minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim emure chattat veemure asham veemure kodshe kadashim veemure kadashim kallim veevre ola veolat haof minnayin
Talmud lomar al kol korbancha takriv melach
Amar mar en li ella kometz mincha minnayin lerabbot et hallevona merabbe ani et hallevona shekken baa immah bichli echad veha amratte ma mincha meuchedet sheacherim bain chova lah
Hachi kaamar ema korban kalal umincha parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat mincha in mide acharina la
Hadar amar al kol korbancha chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash sheacherim bain chova lah af kol sheacherim bain chova lah
Acherim devain chova lah may nihu etzim af kol etzim
Ema acherim devain chova lah nihu levona veayeti dam deika nesachim nesachim bahade emurin hu deatu may tama achila ushtiyya adderabba kappara vesimcha
Ella levona baa immah bichli echad aval etzim ki hechi demittachshera behu mincha hachi mittachshera mittachsheri behu kullehu korbanot
Veema ma happerat meforash sheacherim bain chova lah umatteret af kol sheacherim bain chova lah umatteret umay nihu levona habbaa bevazichin desharya lechem aval mide acharina la
Middeitzterich meal minchatecha velo meal damecha mikkelal dehanach kullehu atu bechad tzad
Amar mar meal minchatecha velo meal damecha veema meal minchatecha velo meal evarecha
Mistabbera evarim hava leh lerabboye shekken siman
Acherim bain chova lah kemotah ishim kemotah bachutz kemotah notar kemotah
Tuma kemotah meila kemotah
b: Adderabba dam hava leh lerabboye shekken mattir kemotah nifsal bishkiat hachamma kemotah hanach nefishan
Amar mar shomea ani afilu etzim vadam shennikreu korban man shamatte leh deamar etzim ikro korban rabbi lerabbi mibbaya bau melach
Detanya korban mincha melammed shemmitnaddevin etzim vechamma shene gezirin vechen hu omer vehaggoralot hippalnu al kurban haetzim rabbi amar etzim korban mincha hen utunin melach utunin haggasha
Veamar rava ledivre rabbi etzim teunin kemitza veamar rav pappa ledivre rabbi etzim tzerichin etzim
Semi mikan etzim veella kera lemaote may i lemaote dam meal minchatecha nafka

a: Appek etzim veayyel nesachim detanya aval hayyayin vehaddam vehaetzim vehakketoret en teunin melach
Manni i rabbi kashya etzim i rabbanan kashya ketoret

Hay tanna hu detanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer ma happerat meforash davar shemmekabbel tuma veole laishshim veyeshno al mizbeach hachitzon af kol davar hamkabbel tuma veole laishshim veyeshno al mizbeach hachitzon
Yatzu etzim sheen mekabbelin tuma yatzu dam vayayin sheen olim laishshim yatza ketoret sheenah al mizbeach hachitzon

Ella tama demaateh kera ledam ha lav hachi hava amena dam live melach kevan demalcheh nafek leh mittorat dam deamar zeeri amar rabbi chanina dam shebbishlo eno over alav verav yehuda amar zeeri dam shemmelacho eno over alav
Verav yehuda dideh amar evarim shetztzelaan veheelan en bahem mishshum lereach nichoach
Mahu detema mishde bah mashshehu lemitzva bealma ka mashma lan
Gufa amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina dam shebbishlo eno over alav yatev rava veka amar lah leha shemata etiveh abbaye hikpa et haddam vaachalo o shehimcha et hachelev ugmao chayyav
La kashya kan shehikpa baur kan shehikpa bachamma beur la hadar bachamma hadar
Bachamma name lema hoil veidchi idchi deha bea mineh rabbi mani merabbi yochanan dam shekkarash vaachalo mahu amar leh hoil venidcha yiddache ishtik
Amar leh dilma vadday kan bechattaot hachitzoniyyot kan bechattaot happenimiyyot

Amar adkartan milta deamar rav chisda dam shekkarash bechattaot vaachalo chayyav velakach venatan amar rachamana bar lekicha untina hu bechattaot happenimiyyot vaachalo patur vetaval vehizza amar rachamana vehay lav bar tevila vehazzaa hu

Verava dideh amar afilu bechattaot happenimiyyot vaachalo chayyav hoil uchnegdo rauy bechattaot hachitzonot amar rav pappa hilkach dam chamor shekkarash vaachalo chayyav hoil uchnegdo rauy bechattaot hachitzonot
Amar rav gidel amar zeeri dam ben lach ben yavesh chotzetz metivi haddam vehaddeo vehaddevash vehechalav yeveshin chotztzin lachin enan chotztzin la kashya ha desarech ha dela sarech
Timlach lemay ata lechidtanya bammelach yachol tevonehu talmud lomar timlach i timlach yachol beme melach talmud lomar bammelach

Velo tashbit melach have melach sheenah shovetet veezo zo melach sedomit uminnayin sheim lo matza melach sedomit shemmevi melach isterokanit talmud lomar takriv takriv kol shehu takriv mikkol makom takriv vaafilu beshabbat takriv vaafilu betuma

May tevonehu amar rabba bar ulla hachi kaamar yachol yitbonennu keteven betit amar leh abbaye i hachi yitbonennu mibe leh ella amar abbaye yachol yaasennu kevinyan amar leh rava i hachi yivnennu mibe leh ella amar rava yachol tevunehu
May tevunehu amar rav ashe yachol yitten bo taam kevina talmud lomar timlach ketzad hu ose mevi haever venoten alav melach vechozer vehofcho venoten alav melach umaalehu
Amar abbaye vechen likdera
b: Tanu rabbanan melach sheal gabbe haever moalin bo sheal gabbe hakkevesh veshebberosho shel mizbeach en moalin bo amar rav matna may keraa vehikravtam lifne Adonai vehishlichu hakkohanim alehem melach veheelu otam ola la
Tenan hatam al hammelach veal haetzim sheyehu hakkohanim neotin bahen amar shemuel lo shanu ella lekorbanam aval laachila la
Ka salka datin may lekorbanam limloach korbanam leechol achilat kadashim hashta limloach orot kadashim yahavinan laachilat kodashim la yahavinan

Detanya nimtzeta atta omer bishlosha mekomot hammelach netuna belishkat hammelach veal gabbe hakkevesh uvrosho shel mizbeach belishkat hammelach sheshsham molchin orot kadashim al gabbe hakkevesh sheshsham molchim et haevarim berosho shel mizbeach sheshsham molchin hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim veolat haof
Ella may lekorbanam laachilat korbanam umay laachila achila dechullin
Chullin peshita may bau hatam af al gav deamar mar yochlu sheyyochlu immah chullin utruma kede shettehe neechelet al hassova afilu hachi melach dekadashim la yahavinan lehu
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach may lekorbanam limloach tama deatni bet din ha la atni bet din la hashta leyisrael yahavinan lechohanim la yahavinan

Detanya yachol haomer hare alay mincha yavi melach mittoch beto kederech shemmevi levona mittoch beto vedin hu neemar have mincha vehave melach veneemar have mincha vehave levona ma levona mittoch beto af melach mittoch beto
O kelach lederech zo neemar have mincha vehave melach veneemar have mincha vehave etzim ma etzim mishshel tzibur af melach mishshel tzibur
Nire lemi dome danin davar hannoheg bechol hazzevachim middavar hannoheg bechol hazzevachim veal tochiach levona sheenah noheget bechol hazzevachim
O kelach lederech zo danin davar habba immah bichli echad middavar habba immah bichli echad veal yochichu etzim sheenan bain immah bichli echad
Talmud lomar berit melach olam hi ulhallan hu omer meet bene yisrael berit olam ma lehallan mishshel tzibur af kan mishshel tzibur
Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hachi kaamar rav shisha bereh derav idi lo nitzrecha ella leven buchri

Ditnan amar rabbi yehuda heid ben buchri beyavne kol kohen sheshshokel eno chote amar lo rabban yochanan ben zakkay lo chi ella kol kohen sheeno shokel chote ella shehakkohanim dorshin mikra ze leatzman
Vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel hoil veomer ushte hallechem velechem happanim shellanu hi heach neechalin
Ulven buchri kevan dilchattechila la michayyav leetoye ki mayete name chote hu deka meayyel chullin laazara demayete umasar lehon letzibur
Salka datach amena

a: Ki zakki lehu rachamana leyisrael deit lehu lishka lechohanim delet lehu lishka la zakki lehu rachamana ka mashma lan

Veetzim difshita leh letanna demishshel tzibur menalan detanya yachol haomer hare alay ola yavi etzim mittoch beto kederech shemmevi nesachim mittoch beto talmud lomar al haetzim asher al haesh asher al hammizbeach ma mizbeach mishshel tzibur af etzim vaesh mishshel tzibur divre rabbi elazar bar rabbi shimon
Rabbi elazar ben shammua omer ma mizbeach shello nishtammesh bo hedot af etzim vaesh shello nishtammesh bahen hedot may benayehu ika benayehu chadte
Veattike la vehachtiv vayyomer aravena el david yikkach veyaal adoni hammelech hattov beenav ree habbakar laola vehammoriggim uchle habbakar leetzim hacha name bechadte

May morigim amar ulla mitta shel tarbel may mitta shel tarbel amar rav yehuda iza dekurkesa dedashu bah dishtae amar rav yosef may keraa hinne samtich lemorag charutz chadash baal pifiyyot tadush harim
Matni nitarev kumtzah bekometz chavertah beminchat kohanim beminchat kohen mashiach beminchat nesachim keshera
Rabbi yehuda omer beminchat kohen mashiach beminchat nesachim pesula shezzo belilatah ava vezo belilatah rakka vehen bolot zo mizzo

Gema tenan hatam dam shennitarev bemayim im yesh bo marit dam kasher nitarev beyayin roin oto keilu hu mayim nitarev bedam behema o bedam chayya roin oto keilu hu mayim rabbi yehuda omer en dam mevattel dam
Amar rabbi yochanan ushnehem mikra echad darshu velakach middam happar umiddam hassair haddavar yadua sheddamo shel par merubbe middamo shel sair rabbanan savri
b: Mikkan laolin sheen mevattelin ze et ze verabbi yehuda savar mikkan lemin bemino sheeno batel
Rabbanan savri mikkan laolin sheen mevattelin ze et ze vedilma mishshum demin bemino hu
I ashmeinan min bemino vela ashmeinan olin kidka amratte hashta deashmeinan olin mishshum deolin
Vedilma ad deika min bemino veolin kashya
Verabbi yehuda savar mikkan lemin bemino sheeno batel vedilma mishshum deolin hu
I ashmeinan olin min besheeno mino kidkaamratte hashta deashmeinan min bemino mishshum demin bemino hu
Vedilma ad deika min bemino veolin kashya
Tenan rabbi yehuda omer beminchat kohanim beminchat kohen mashiach uvminchat nesachim pesula shezzo belilatah ava vezo belilatah rakka vehen bolot zo mizzo vechi bolot zo mizzo ma have min bemino hu

a: Amar rava kasavar rabbi yehuda kol shehu min bemino vedavar acher sallek et mino kemi sheeno vesheeno mino rave alav umvattelo
Itmar kometz deminchat chote sheshshimmeno rabbi yochanan omer pasul veresh lakish amar hu atzmo meshachshecho bishyare hallog umaalehu
Vehachtiv lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona hahu shello yikba lah shemen kechavroteha
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish charev shennitarev bevalul yakriv rabbi yehuda omer lo yakriv may lav kometz deminchat chote deiarav bekometz deminchat nedava
Lo minchat parim veelim beminchat kevasim
Veha behedya katane lah minchat parim veelim beminchat kevasim vecharev shennitarev bevalul yikrav rabbi yehuda omer lo yikrav parushe kamfaresh lah
Bae rava kometz shemmitza shamno al gabbe etzim mahu chibure olin keolin damu o lav keolin damu amar leh ravina lerav ashe lav hayenu derabbi yochanan veresh lakish
Deitmar hammaale ever sheen bo kezayit veetzem mashlimo lichzayit rabbi yochanan amar chayyav resh lakish amar patur
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyav chibure olin keolin damu veresh lakish amar patur chibure olin lav keolin damu
Tibe lerabbi yochanan vetibe leresh lakish tibe lerabbi yochanan ad kan la ka amar rabbi yochanan hatam ella beetzem demina devasar hu aval hay delav demina dekometz hu la
O dilma afilu leresh lakish la ka amar ella beetzem devar mifrash hu vei paresh lav mitzva leahdore aval shemen delav bar mifrash hu la o dilma la shena teku
Matni shette menachot shello nikmetzu venitarvu zo bazo im yachol likmotz mizzo bifne atzmah umizzo bifne atzmah kesherot veim lav pesulot
Kometz shennitarev bemincha shello nikmetza lo yaktir veim hiktir zo shennikmetza alat labbealim vezo shello nikmetza lo alat labbealim
Nitarev kumtzah bishyareha o bishyareha shel chavertah lo yaktir veim hiktir alat labbealim
Gema amar rav chisda nevela betela bishchuta shei efshar lishchuta shettease nevela
Ushchuta enah betela binvela sheefshar linvela shettease shechuta dilchi masrecha parcha tumatah
Verabbi chanina amar kol sheefshar lo lihot kamohu eno batel vechol shei efshar lo lihot kamohu batel
Alliba deman i alliba derabbanan ha amri olin hu dela mevatteli ahadade aval min bemino batel
I alliba derabbi yehuda veha
b: Rabbi yehuda batar chazuta azel veide veide min bemino hu
Ella alliba derabbi chiyya detane rabbi chiyya nevela ushchuta betelot zo bazo
Rabbi chiyya alliba deman i alliba derabbanan ha amri olin hu dela mevatteli ahadade ha min bemino batel vei alliba derabbi yehuda kol min bemino lerabbi yehuda lo batel
Leolam alliba derabbi yehuda vechi ka amar rabbi yehuda min bemino lo batel hane mile hecha deefshar leh lemihve kevateh aval hecha dela efshar leh lemihve kevateh batel
Uvha ka mipalgi derav chisda savar batar mevattel azlinan
Verabbi chanina savar batar batel azlinan

Tenan shette menachot shello nikmetzu venitarvu zo bezo im yachol likmotz mizzo bifne atzmah umizzo bifne atzmah kesherot veim lav pesulot veha hacha kevan dekametz leh mechada idach hava leh shirayim vela ka mevatteli shirayim letivla
Manni i rabbanan ha amri olin hu dela mevatteli hadade ha min bemino batel ella peshita rabbi yehuda
Bishlama leman deamar batar batel azlinan batel have kimvattel dilchi kametz meidach hau lehu shirayim ki hane
Ella leman deamar batar mevattel azlinan shirayim mi ka hau tivla lema alliba derav chisda dela kerabbi chiyya
Hatam kidrabbi zera deamar rabbi zera neemra haktara bekometz veneemra haktara beshirayim
Ma haktara haamura bakkometz en hakkometz mevattel et chavero af haktara haamura bashshirayim en shirayim mevattelin et hakkometz
Ta shema hakkometz shennitarev bemincha shello nikmetza lo yaktir veim hiktir zo shennikmetza alta labbealim vezo shello nikmetza lo alta labbealim vela ka mevattel leh tivla lekometz
Manni i rabbanan ha amri olin hu dela mevatteli hadade ha min bemino betil ella peshita rabbi yehuda
Bishlama leman deamar batar mevattel azlinan mevattel have kevatel dechol purta chaze lemikmatz mineh vehave leh min umino umin bemino lo batel
Ella leman deamar batar batel azlinan kometz mi ka have tivla lema dela kerabbi chiyya ha name kidrabbi zera
Ta shema nitarev kumtzah beshirayim shel chavertah lo yaktir veim hiktir alta labbealim veha hacha dela have mevattel kevatel vela ka mevatteli leh shirayim lekometz
Manni i rabbanan vechu
Amar rabbi zera neemra haktara bakkometz veneemra haktara bashshirayim ma haktara haamura bakkometz en kometz mevattel et chavero af haktara haamura bashshirayim en shirayim mevattelin et hakkometz
Ta shema tiblah beketzach beshumshemin uvchol mine tavlin keshera matztza hi ella shennikret matztza metubbelet ka salka datach deappesh lah tavlin tefe mimmatztza
Bishlama leman deamar batar batel azlinan batel have kimvattel dilchi miappesha haveya lah ketavlin ella leman deamar batar mevattel azlinan tavlin mi ka hao matztza
Hacha bemay askinan dela appish lah tavlin derubbah matztza hi vela batla dayeka name dekatane matztza hi ella shennikret matztza metubbelet shema minah
Ki selek rav kahana ashkechinhu livne rabbi chiyya deyatvi vekaamri issaron shechilleko

a: Vehinnicho bevisa venaga tevul yom beechad mehen mahu ki tenan keli metzaref ma shebbetocho lakkodesh hane mile hecha denagi bahadade aval hecha dela nagi bahadade la o dilma la shena
Amar lehu ihu mi tenan keli mechabber keli metzaref tenan kol dehu hoshit echad levenehen mahu
Amar lehu tzarich lichli keli metzarfo en tzarich lichli en keli metzarfo
Hoshit tevul yom et etzbao benehen mahu amar lehu en lecha davar shemmetamme meaviro ella keli cheres bilvad
Hadar ihu bea minayehu mahu likmotz mizze al ze tzeruf deorayeta o derabbanan
Amru lo zo lo shamanu kayyotze bo shamanu ditnan shette menachot shello nikmetzu venitarvu zo bazo im yachol likmotz mizzo bifne atzmah umizzo bifne atzmah kesherot veim lav pesulot
Ki yachol likmotz miha kesherot ammay hach dimarav ha la naga
Amar rava dilma begushshin hamchullakin haasuyin kemasrek
May have alah amar rava ta shema detanya veherim mimmennu min hamchubbar shello yavi issaron bishne kelim veyikmotz ha bichli echad dumya dishne kelim kametz
Amar leh abbaye dilma shene kelim hechi dame kegon kefiza bekabba deaf al gav daarivi meilay kevan demipaskan mechitzata dikfiza mittatta
Ha keli echad dumya dishne kelim hechi dame kegon arevat tarnegolin veaf al gav demipaskan mechitzata ha negia aval hacha dela negia kelal tibe lach
Bae rabbi yirmeya tzeruf keli vechibur mayim mahu
Ki tenan keli metzaref ma shebbetocho lakkodesh hane mile degavay aval devaray la o dilma kevan dimchabbar mechabbar
Veim timtze lomar kevan dimchabbar mechabbar chibur mayim vetzeruf keli venaga tevul yom mibbachutz mahu
Ki tenan keli metzaref hane mile denaga miggavay aval mibbaray la o dilma la shena teku
Bae rava issaron shechilleko venitma echad mehen vehinnicho bevisa vechazar tevul yom venaga beoto tame mahu mi amrinan seva lo tuma o la
Amar leh abbaye umi amrinan seva leh tuma vehatnan sadin tame
b: Midras vaasao vilon tahor min hammidras aval tame magga midras
Amar rabbi yose beeze midras naga ze ella sheim naga bo hazzav tame magga hazzav
Ki naga bo hazzav miha tame vaafilu levassof ketame midras veachar kach magga hazzav ammay lema seva leh tuma
Amar leh umimmay dehay sheim naga bo hazzav levatar midras dilma mikkamme midras dehaveya tuma chamura al tuma kalla
Aval hacha deide veide tuma kalla la
Ella missefa mode rabbi yose bishne sedinin hamkuppalin umunnachin ze al ze veyashav zav alehen shehaelon tame midras vehattachton tame midras umagga midras veammay lema seva leh tuma
Hatam bevat achat hacha beze achar ze
Amar rava issaron shechilleko veavad echad mehen vehifrish acher tachtav venimtza harishon vahare shelashtan munnachin bevisa nitma avud avud verishon mitztarfin mufrash en mitztaref
Nitma mufrash mufrash verishon mitztarfin avud en mitztaref nitma rishon shenehem mitztarfin
Abbaye amar afilu nitma echad mehen name shenehem mitztarfin may tama kullehu bene vikta dahadade ninhu
Vechen leinyan kemitza kamatz min haavud sheyarav verishon neechalin mufrash eno neechal kamatz min hammufrash sheyarav verishon neechalin avud eno neechal
Kamatz min rishon shenehem enan neechalin
Abbaye amar afilu kamatz meechad mehen shenehen enan neechalin may tama kullehu name bene vikta dahadade ninhu
Matkef lah rav pappa veshirayim dideh miha neechalin ha ika danka dekometz dela karev
Matkef lah rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya vekometz gufeh hechi karev ha ika telata chullin
Rav ashe amar kometz bedata dechohen talya milta vechohen ki kametz aissaron ka kametz

a: Matni nitma hakkometz vehikrivo hatztzitz meratztze yatza vehikrivo en hatztzitz meratztze shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame veeno meratztze al hayyotze
Gema tanu rabbanan venasa aharon et aon hakkodashim vechi eze aon hu nose im tomar aon pigul hare kevar neemar lo yechashev im tomar aon notar hare kevar neemar lo yeratze
Ha eno nose ella aon tuma shehuttera mikkelalah betzibur
Matkef lah rabbi zera ema aon yotze shehuttar mikkelalo bevama
Amar leh abbaye amar kera leratzon lahem lifne Adonai aon delifne Adonai in aon deotze la
Matkef lah rabbi ila ema aon semol shehuttar mikkelalo beom hakkippurim
Amar leh abbaye amar kera aon aon shehaya bo udchitiv leappoke yom hakkippurim dehechshero bismol hu
Rav ashe amar aon hakkodashim velo aon hammakdishin

Amar leh rav sima bereh derav idi lerav ashe veamri lah rav sima bereh derav ashe lerav ashe veema aon baal mum shehuttar mikkelalo beofot deamar mar tammut vezachrut bivhema veen tammut vezachrut beofot
Amar leh alecha amar kera lo yeratze ki lo leratzon yihye lachem
Tanu rabbanan dam shennitma uzrako beshogeg hurtza bemezid lo hurtza bamme devarim amurim beyachid aval betzibur ben beshogeg ben bemezid hurtza uvgoy ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon
b: Lo hurtza
Vrminhi al ma hatztzitz meratztze al haddam veal habbasar veal hachelev shennitma ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon ben beyachid ben betzibur

Amar rav yosef la kashya ha rabbi yose ha rabbanan detanya en tormin min hattame al hattahor veim taram beshogeg terumato teruma bemezid en terumato teruma rabbi yose omer ben beshogeg ben bemezid terumato teruma
Emar deshamatte leh lerabbi yose dela kanes dimratztze tzitz al achilot mi shamatte leh vehatanya rabbi eliezer omer hatztzitz meratztze al achilot rabbi yose omer en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot
Efoch rabbi eliezer omer en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot rabbi yose omer hatztzitz meratztze al achilot
Matkef lah rav sheshet umi matzet afchatte lah vehatanya yachol basar shennitma lifne zerikat damim yehu chayyavin alehen mishshum tuma
Talmud lomar kol tahor yochal basar vehannefesh asher tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim asher la vetumato alav venichreta hannitar lithorin chayyavin alav mishshum tuma
Vesheeno nitar lithorin en chayyavin alav mishshum tuma
O eno ella neechal lithorin chayyavin alav mishshum tuma vesheeno neechal lithorin en chayyavin alav mishshum tuma otzi ani et hallan veet hayyotze sheenan neechalin lithorim
Talmud lomar asher la riba
Yachol sheani merabbe et happigulin veet hannotarot
Notarot hayenu lan ella af happigulin kannotarot talmud lomar mizzevach hashshelamim miet
Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulhotzi et ellu achar sheriba hakkatuv umiet amarta merabbe ani et ellu shehayeta lahen sheat hakkosher umotzi ani et ellu shello hayeta lahen sheat hakkosher
Veim tomar basar shennitma lifne zerikat damim vaachalo leachar zerikat damim mippene ma chayyavin alav mishshum tuma mippene shehatztzitz meratztze
Nitma in yotze la
Man shamatte leh deamar en zerika moelet layyotze rabbi eliezer vekatane dimratztze tzitz al achilot
Ella amar rav chisda la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ha rabbanan

Emar deshamatte leh lerabbi eliezer dimratztze tzitz al achilot dela kanes mi shamatte leh in ki hechi deshamatte leh lerabbi yose shamatte leh lerabbi eliezer detanya rabbi eliezer omer ben beshogeg ben bemezid terumato teruma
Emar deshamatte leh lerabbi eliezer bitruma dekila bekadashim dachamiri mi shamatte leh im ken ha amman tirmeyah
Ravina amar tumato ben beshogeg ben bemezid hurtza zerikato beshogeg hurtza bemezid lo hurtza
Verav shela amar zerikato ben beshogeg ben bemezid hurtza tumato beshogeg hurtza bemezid lo hurtza
Ulrav shela dekatane shennitma ben beshogeg ben bemezid hachi kaamar nitma beshogeg uzrako ben beshogeg ben bemezid

a: Ta shema dam shennitma uzrako beshogeg hurtza bemezid lo hurtza hachi kaamar dam shennitma uzrako ben beshogeg ben bemezid nitma beshogeg hurtza bemezid lo hurtza
Matni nitmeu sheyareha nisrefu sheyareha avdu sheyareha kemiddat rabbi eliezer keshera uchmiddat rabbi yehoshua pesula
Gema amar rav vehu shennitmeu kol sheyareha aval miktzat sheyareha la
Ka salka datach nitma in avud vesaruf la may kasavar i kasavar shiyyura milta hi afilu avud vesaruf name i kasavar shiyyura lav milta hi venitma may tama dimratztze tzitz i hachi kol sheyareha name
Leolam kasavar shiyyura milta hi venitma vehu haddin leavud vesaruf vehay dekaamar nitma reshayehu naket
Kidtanya rabbi yehoshua omer kol hazzevachim shebbetora shennishtayyer mehen kezayit basar o kezayit chelev zorek et haddam

Kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev eno zorek et haddam uvaola afilu kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev zorek et haddam mippene shekkullah kalil uvammincha afilu kullah kayyemet lo yizrok
Mincha may avidtah amar rav pappa minchat nesachim salka datach hoil uvahade zevach ka atya kegufeh dezivcha damya ka mashma lan
Menahane mile amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael umatu bah mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben chananya amar kera vehiktir hachelev lereach nichoach la chelev veaf al pi sheen basar
Veashkechan chelev yoteret ushte kelaot menalan dekatane uvammincha afilu kullah kayyemet lo yizrok mincha hu delo yizrok ha yoteret ushte kelaot yizrok
Menalan rabbi yochanan dideh amar lereach nichoach kol sheatta maale lereach nichoach

Veitzterich lemichtav chelev veitzterich lemichtav lereach nichoach dei ketav chelev hava amena chelev in yoteret ushte kelaot la ketav rachamana reach nichoach vei ketav rachamana lereach nichoach hava amena afilu mincha ketav rachamana chelev
Matni shello bichle sharet pasul verabbi shimon machshir hiktir kumtzah paamayim keshera
Gema amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya may tama derabbi shimon amar kera kodesh kadashim hi kachattat vechaasham ba leovdah bayyad kechattat ovdah beyamin kechattat bichli ovdah bismol keasham
Verabbi yannay amar kevan shekkematzo mikkele sharet maalehu umaktiro afilu behemyano vaafilu bimkida shel cheres rav nachman bar yitzchak amar hakkol modim bakkometz shettaun kidush

Metivi hekter chalavim veevarim veetzim sheheelan ben bayyad ben bichli ben beyamin uven bismol kesherin hakkometz vehakketoret vehallevona sheheelan ben bayyad ben bichli ben beyamin ben bismol kesherin teuvta derabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya
Amar lach rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya litzdadin katane bayyad beyamin bichli ben beyamin ben bismol
Ta shema kematzo shello mikkele sharet vekidsho shello bichle sharet veheelo vehiktiro shello bichli sharet pasul rabbi elazar verabbi shimon machshirin bemattan keli
Ema mimmattan keli veelach

Ta shema vachachamim omrim kometz taun keli sharet ketzad komtzo mikkeli sharet umkaddesho bichli sharet umaalo umaktiro bichli sharet rabbi shimon omer kevan shekkematzo mikkeli sharet maalo umaktiro shello bichli sharet vedayyo
Ema kevan shekkematzo vekiddesho bichli sharet maalo umaktiro vedayyo
Ta shema kamatz bimino venatan bismolo yachzir limino bismolo
b: Vechishev aleha ben chutz limkomo ben chutz lizmanno pasul veen bo karet
Lo chishev aleha chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmanno pigul vechayyavin alav karet divre rabbi elazar verabbi shimon

Vachachamim omrim kevan shennetano lismol pesalattu mattenato may tama mishshum devae kedushsha bichli vechevan shennetano lismol naasa kedam shennishpach mitztzavar behema al haritzpa vaasafo sheppasul
Mikkelal derabbi elazar verabbi shimon la bau mattan keli teuvta derav nachman teuvta
Lerabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya mesayea leh lerabbi yannay lema tehve teuvta
Amar lach rabbi yannay ana daamari ketanna dehekter velav litzdadim katane
Hiktir kumtzah paamayim keshera amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi paamayim velo paame faamayim verabbi yochanan amar paamayim vaafilu paame faamayim
May benayehu amar rabbi zera yesh kometz pachot mishshene zetim veyesh haktara pechuta mikkezayit ika benayehu
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi savar en kometz pachot mishshene zetim veen haktara pechuta mikkezayit verabbi yochanan savar yesh kometz pachot mishshene zetim veyesh haktara pechuta mikkezayit
Itmar kometz meematay mattir shirayim baachila rabbi chanina omer mishshemmashla bo et haur rabbi yochanan amar mishshettatztzit bo et haur berubbo
Amar leh rav yehuda lerabba bar rav yitzchak asberah lach tama derabbi yochanan amar kera vehinne ala kitor haaretz kekitor hakkivshan en kivshan maale kitor ad shettatztzit haur berubbo

Amar leh ravin bar rav adda lerava amri talmidecha amar rav amram tanya en li ella devarim sheddarkan likrav ballayela kegon evarim ufdarim shemmaalan umaktiran mibbo hashshemesh umitakkelin veholchin kol hallayela kullah
Devarim sheddarkan likrav bayyom kegon hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashuach uminchat nesachim shemmaalan umaktiran mibbo hashshemesh
Veha amratte darkan likrav bayyom ella im bo hashshemesh shemmitakkelin veholchin kol hallayela minnayin talmud lomar zot torat haola riba
Veha im bo hashshemesh la mashkachatte lah shettatztzit haur berubbo la kashya kan liklot kan lehattir
Rabbi elazar matne lah mibbo hashshemesh umokem lah befokin vechen ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yannay befokin

Umi amar rabbi yannay hachi veha amar rabbi yannay ketoret sheppaka meal gabbe hammizbeach afilu keratin shebbah en machazirin otan vetane rav chanina bar minome bidve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov asher tochal haesh et haola al hammizbeach ikule ola atta machzir vei atta machzir ikule ketoret semi mikan ketoret
Amar rabbi assi ki pashet rabbi elazar bimnachot bae hachi bae rabbi elazar kometz shessidro vesider alav et hammaaracha mahu derech haktara bechach o en derech haktara bechach teku

Bae chizkiyya evarin shessidran vesider alehen et hammaaracha mahu al haetzim amar rachmana daveka al haetzim o dilma kevan dichtiv kera acharina asher tochal haesh et haola al hammizbeach i bae hachi aved i bae hachi aved teku
Bae rabbi yitzchak nappacha evarin shessidran betzide hammaaracha mahu alliba deman deamar al mammash la tibe lach

a: Deal haetzim ketiv
Ki tibe lach alliba deman deamar al besamuch may hacha name al besamuch o dilma al haetzim dumya deal hammizbeach ma hatam al mammash af hacha name al mammash teku
Matni hakkometz miuto meakkev et rubbo issaron miuto meakkev et rubbo hayyayin miuto meakkev et rubbo hashshemen miuto meakkev et rubbo
Hassolet vehashshemen meakkevin ze et ze hakkometz vehallevona meakkevin ze et ze
Gema may tama amar kera melo kumtzo tere zimne
Issaron miuto meakkev et rubbo may tama amar kera missoltah sheim chasra kol shehu pesula
Hayyayin miuto meakkev et rubbo kacha
Hashshemen miuto meakkev et rubbo deminchat nesachim kacha uminchat nedava amar kera umishshamnah sheim chasar kol shehu pesula
Hashshemen vehassolet meakkevin ze et ze missoltah umishshamnah miggirsah umishshamnah
Hakkometz vehallevona meakkevin ze et ze al kol levonatah veet kol hallevona asher al hammincha
Matni shene seire yom hakkippurim meakkevin ze et ze shene kivse atzeret meakkevin ze et ze shette challot meakkevot zo et zo
Shene sedarin meakkevin ze et ze shene bazichin meakkevin ze et ze hassedarin vehabbazichin meakkevin ze et ze
Shene minim shebbannazir shelosha shebbappara vearbaa shebbattoda vearbaa shebballulav vearbaa shebbammetzora meakkevin ze et ze
Sheva hazzaot shebbappara meakkevot zo et zo sheva hazzaot sheal ben habbaddim sheal happarochet sheal mizbach hazzahav meakkevot zo et zo
Gema shene seire yom hakkippurim meakkevin ze et ze chukka
Shene kivse atzeret meakkevin ze et ze havaya shette challot havaya
Shene sedarin chukka shene bazichin chukka hassedarin vehabbazichin chukka
Shene minim shebbannazir dichtiv ken yaase shelosha shebbappara chukka
Arbaa shebbattoda deitakkash lenazir dichtiv al zevach todat shelamav veamar mar shelamav lerabbot shalme nazir
Vearbaa shebbimtzora dichtiv zot tihye torat hammetzora vearbaa shebballulav ulkachtem lekicha tamma
Amar rav chanan bar rava lo shanu ella sheen lo aval yesh lo en meakkevin

Metivi arbaa minin shebballulav shenayim mehen osin perot ushnayim mehem en osin perot haosin perot yihu zekukin lesheen osin vesheen osin perot yihu zekukin leosin perot veen adam yotze yede chovato bahen ad sheyehu kullan baagudda echat
Vechen yisrael behartzaa ad sheyehu kullan baagudda echat shenneemar habbone vashshamayim maalotav vaaguddato al eretz yesadah
Tannae hi detanya lulav ben agud ben sheeno agud kasher rabbi yehuda omer agud kasher sheeno agud pasul
May tama derabbi yehuda gamar kicha kicha meaguddat ezov
Ma lehallan baagudda af kan baagudda verabbanan la gamri kicha kicha
Keman azla ha detanya lulav mitzva leogdo veim lo agado kasher keman i kerabbi yehuda lo agado ammay kasher i rabbanan may mitzva
Leolam rabbanan umay mitzva mishshum ze eli veanvehu
Sheva hazzaot shebbappara meakkevot zo et zo chukka
Sheva hazzaot sheal ben habbaddim vesheal mizbach hazzahav vesheal happarochet meakkevot zo et zo deom hakkippurim ketiv chukka
Defar kohen mashuach udfar helem davar shel tzibur vedisire avoda zara kidtanya veasa lappar kaasher asa lefar ma talmud lomar lichpol behazzaot
b: Sheim chiser achat min hammattanot lo asa kelum
Tanu rabbanan sheva hazzaot shebbappara sheasaan ben shello lishman ben shello mechvanot el nochach pene ohel moed pesulot
Veshebbifnim veshebbimtzora shello lishman pesulot shello mechvanot kesherot
Vehatanya gabbe para shello lishman pesulot shello mechvanot kesherot amar rav chisda la kashya ha rabbi yehuda ha rabbanan
Detanya mechussere chappara shennichnesu laazara beshogeg chayyav chattat bemezid anush karet veen tzarich lomar tevul yom ushar kol hattemeim

Uthorim shennichnesu lifnim mimmechitzatan lahechal kullo bearbaim mibbet lapparochet el pene hakkapporet bemita rabbi yehuda omer kol hechal kullo umibbet lapparochet bearbaim veel pene hakkapporet bemita

Bemay ka mipalgi behay kera vayyomer Adonai el moshe dabber el aharon achicha veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh mibbet lapparochet el pene hakkapporet asher al haaron velo yamut rabbanan savri el hakkodesh belo yavo mibbet lapparochet veel pene hakkapporet belo yamut
Verabbi yehuda savar el hakkodesh umibbet lapparochet belo yavo veel pene hakkapporet belo yamut

May tama derabbanan i salka datach kidkaamar rabbi yehuda lichtov rachamana el hakkodesh veel pene hakkapporet vela bae mibbet lapparochet vaana amena hechal michayyav mibbet lapparochet mibbaya mibbet happarochet dichtav rachamana lema li shema minah bemita

Verabbi yehuda i ketav rachamana el hakkodesh vela ketav mibbet lapparochet hava amena may kodesh mibbet lapparochet aval hechal lav name la verabbanan hahu la matzet amratte dehechal kullo ikri kodesh shenneemar vehivdila happarochet lachem ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim

Verabbi yehuda may tama i salka datach kidka amri rabbanan lichtov rachamana el hakkodesh umibbet lapparochet vela bae el pene hakkapporet vaana amena mibbet lapparochet bemita el pene hakkapporet mibaya el pene hakkapporet dichtav rachamana lema li shema minah el pene hakkapporet bemita mibbet lapparochet beazhara
Verabbanan in hachi name dela tzerich vehay dichtav rachamana el pene hakkapporet lemaote derech meshuppash
Kidtana deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov el pene hakkapporet kedma ze bana av kol makom shenneemar pene eno ella pene kadim
Verabbi yehuda lema kera pene may el shema minah el daveka verabbanan el lav daveka
Verabbi yehuda deamar el pene hakkapporet daveka vehizza el nochach name daveka
Verabbanan middehatam lav daveka hacha name lav daveka
Matkef lah rav yosef lerabbi yehuda middeel daveka el nochach al name daveka ella demikdash sheni dela hao aron vechapporet hachi name dela aved hazzaot
Amar rabba bar ulla amar kera vechipper et mikdash hakkodesh mekom hamkuddash lakkodesh
Rava amar ha veha rabbanan

a: Ha dekae mizrach umaarav veaddi ha dekae tzafon vedarom veaddi
Amar mar veshebbifnim veshebbimtzora shello lishman pesulot shello mechvanot kesherot vehatanya ben shello lishman ben shello mechvanot kesherot
Amar rav yosef la kashya ha rabbi eliezer veha rabbanan rabbi eliezer demakkesh asham lechattat makkesh name log leasham rabbanan la makkeshi
Ulrabbi eliezer vechi davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh
Ella amar rava ha veha rabbanan kan lehachshir hakkorban kan lehartzot shello alu labbealim leshum chova
Matni shiva kene menora meakkevin ze et ze shiva neroteha meakkevin ze et ze shette parashiyyot shebbammezuza meakkevot zo et zo afilu ketav echad meakkevan
Arba parashiyyot shebbattefilin meakkevin zo et zo afilu ketav echad meakkevan arba tzitziyyot meakkevot zo et zo shearbatan mitzva achat rabbi yishmael omer arbatan arba mitzot
Gema may tama havaya ketiv behu

Tanu rabbanan menora hayeta baa min haeshet umin hazzahav asaah min haggerutaot pesula mishshear mine mattachot keshera may shena min haggerutaot pesula dichtiv miksha vahavaya shear mine mattachot name zahav vahavaya
Amar kera tease lerabbot shear mine mattachot veema lerabbot gerutaot la salka datach deammiksha ketiva havaya
Tease name ammiksha ketiv miksha miksha leakkev
Zahav zahav name leakkev

Hay may i amratte bishlama min haggerutaot pesula mishshear mine mattachot keshera hayenu zahav zahav miksha miksha lidrasha ella i amratte min haggerutaot keshera mishshear mine mattachot pesula zahav zahav miksha miksha may darshatte beh

May derasha detanya kikkar zahav tahor yaase otah et kol hakkelim haelle baa zahav baa kikkar enah baa zahav enah baa kikkar gevieha kaftoreha ufracheha baa zahav baa geviim kaftorim ufrachim enah baa zahav enah baa geviim kaftorim ufrachim
Veema name baa zahav baa kanim enah baa zahav enah baa kanim hahu pamot mikre
Veze maase hammenora miksha zahav baa zahav baa miksha enah baa zahav enah baa miksha
Miksha desefa lemay ata lemaote chatzotzrot detanya chatzotzrot hau baim min haeshet min hakkesef asaam min haggerutaot kesherim mishshear mine mattachot pesulim
Umay shena mishshear mine mattachot pesulim dichtiv kesef vahavaya min haggerutaot name miksha vahavaya miet rachamana gabbe menora miksha hi hi vela chatzotzrot
Tanu rabbanan kol hakkelim
b: Sheasa moshe kesherim lo uchsherim ledorot chatzotzrot kesherot lo ufsulot ledorot
Chatzotzrot may tama ilema deamar kera ase lecha lecha velo ledorot ella meatta veasita lecha aron etz hachi name dilcha velo ledorot

Ella i leman deamar lecha mishshellecha i leman deamar kivyachol beshellecha ani rotze yoter mishshellahem hay name mibe leh lehachi shane hatam deamar kera lecha lecha tere zimne ase lecha vehau lecha

Tane rav pappa bereh derav chanin kammeh derav yosef menora hayeta baa min haeshet min hazzahav asaah shel kesef keshera shel baatz veshel avar veshel gisteron rabbi posel verabbi yose berabbi yehuda machshir shel etz veshel etzem veshel zechuchit divre hakkol pesula
Amar leh may datach amar leh ben mar uven mar kelale ufrate darshi
Mihu mar savar ma happerat meforash shel mattechet af kol shel mattechet umar savar ma happerat meforash davar chashuv af kol davar chashuv amar leh semi didach mikkamme didi
Detanya kele sharet sheasaan shel etz rabbi posel verabbi yose berabbi yehuda machshir bemay ka mipalgi rabbi daresh kelale ufrate verabbi yose berabbi yehuda daresh ribuye umiute

Rabbi daresh kelale ufrate veasita menorat kalal zahav tahor parat miksha tease hammenora chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash shel mattechet af kol shel mattechet

Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda daresh ribuye umiute veasita menorat riba zahav tahor miet miksha tease hammenora chazar veriba riba umiet veriba riba hakkol umay rabbi rabbi kol mile umay maet maet shel cheres
Adderabba semi didach mikkamme didi la salka datach detanya en lo zahav mevi af shel kesef shel nechoshet shel barzel veshel bedil veshel oferet rabbi yose berabbi yehuda machshir af beshel etz

Vetanya idach lo yaase adam bayit tavnit hechal achsadra keneged ulam chatzer keneged azara shulchan keneged shulchan menora keneged menora aval ose hu shel chamishsha veshel shishsha veshel shemona veshel shiva lo yaase vaafilu mishshear mine mattachot

Rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer af shel etz lo yaase kederech sheasu malche bet chashmonay amru lo mishsham reaya shappudim shel barzel hau vechipum bevaatz heeshiru asaum shel kesef chazru veheeshiru asaum shel zahav

Amar shemuel mishshemeh desava govhah shel menora shemona asar tefachim haraglayim vehapperach shelosha tefachim vetifchayim chalak vetefach shebbo gevia vechaftor vaferach vetifchayim chalak vetefach kaftor

Ushne kanim yotzin mimmennu echad elach veechad elach venimshachin veolin keneged govhah shel menora vetefach chalak vetefach kaftor ushne kanim yotzin mimmennu echad elach veechad elach nimshachin veolin keneged govhah shel menora vetefach chalak vetefach kaftor ushne kanim yotzin mimmennu echad elach veechad elach venimshachin veolin keneged govhah shel menora vetifchayim chalak nishtayeru sham shelosha tefachim shebbahen shelosha geviin vechaftor vaferach

Ugviin lema hen domin kemin kosot alekkesanderiyyim kaftorim lema hen domin kemin tappuche hakkeretiyyim perachim lema hen domin kemin pirche haammudin venimtzeu geviin esrim ushnayim kaftorim achad asar perachim tisha
Geviim meakkevin ze et ze kaftorim meakkevin ze et ze perachim meakkevin ze et ze geviim kaftorim ufrachim meakkevin ze et ze
Bishlama geviim esrim ushnayim dichtiv uvammenora arbaa geviim vego uchtiv shelosha geviim meshukkadim bakkane haechad kaftor vaferach vego arbea didah

a: Vetamne sere dekanim ha esrin vetarten kaftorin name achad asar kaftorin tere didah veshishsha dekanim vechaftor vechaftor vechaftor ha chad sar
Ella perachim tisha menalan perachim tere didah veshishsha dekanim temanya hau amar rav shalman ketiv ad yerechah ad pirchah miksha hi
Amar rav govhah shel menora tisha tefachim etiveh rav shimi bar chiyya lerav even hayeta lifne menora uvah shalosh maalot shealeha hakkohen omed umetiv et hannerot
Amar leh shimi atte ki kaamena missefat kanim ulmala

Ketiv vehapperach vehannerot vehammelkachayim zahav hu michlot zahav may michlot zahav amar rav amme shekkilattu lechol zahav sagur shel shelomo deamar rav yehuda amar rav eser menorot asa shelomo vechol achat veachat hevi lah elef kikkar zahav vehichnisuhu elef peamim lechor veheemiduhu al kikkar
Ini vehachtiv vechol kele mashke hammelech shelomo zahav vechol kele bet yaar hallevanon zahav sagur en kesef nechshav bime shelomo limuma zahav sagur ka amrinan

Umi chasar kulle hay vehatanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer maase vehayeta menorat bet hammikdash yetera al shel moshe bedinar zahav kurdeyakeni vehichnisuha shemonim peamim lechor veheemiduha al kikkar kevan dekae kae

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan may dichtiv al hammenora hattehora sheyyardu maaseha mimmekom tohora ella meatta al hashshulchan hattahor sheyyardu maasav mimmakom tahor ella tahor mikkelal shehu tame hacha name tehora mikkelal shehi temea

May chibatchem kidrabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi nes gadol naasa belechem happanim siluko kesiduro shenneemar lasum lechem chom beom hillakcho
Ella hacha tehora mikkelal shehi temea peshita kele mattachot ninhu uchle mattachot mekabbelin tuma ella sheyyardu maaseha mimmekom tohora

Amar rav yehuda amar rav lo nitzrecha ella lekotzah shel yod veha name peshita ella lichidach derav yehuda amar rav deamar rav yehuda amar rav kol ot sheen gevil mukkaf lah mearba ruchoteha pesula

I name aha terumat maaser shel demay shechazra limkomah rabbi shimon shezuri omer af bachol shoalo veochlo al piv
Veha itmar alah amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri bimsukkan uvitrumat maaser shel demay veim ita hu name lema

Ketzad yaase tzover gorno letocho venimtza torem umasser min hechadash shebbo al hechadash shebbo umin hayyashan shebbo al hayyashan shebbo

Rabbi yose omer modim sheovi haraglayim veovi hallevizbezin nimdad uvenehen en nimdad rabbi shimon shezuri omer im hau raglayim gevohot tefach en benehen nimdad veim lav benehen nimdad

Tanya amar rabbi shimon shezuri paam achat nitarev li tevel bechullin uvati veshaalti et rabbi tarfon veamar li lech kach lecha min hashshuk veasser alav
Kasavar deorayeta berubba batel verov amme haaretz measserim hen vehave leh ketorem min happetur al happetur

Ika deamri amar leh lech kach min haggoy kasavar yesh kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lehafkia miyyad maaser vehave leh min happetur al happetur
Velema leh kach mehashshuk kasavar en rov amme haaretz measserin

Vehatanya shina pasul bitfilin vehatanya shina ben baze uven beze pasul ide veide bitfilin veha dechatvinhu akkelaf bimkom sear veha

Amar ammemar hay pitcha deakkarna chayyav bimzuza amar leh rav ashe leammemar veha let leh patztzimin amar leh ade patztzime

Rav pappa ikla leve mar shemuel chaza hahu pitcha dela hava leh ella patztzim echad chad patztzima missemala vaavida leh mezuza amar leh keman kerabbi meir emar deamar rabbi meir miyyamin missemol mi amar
May hi detanya betecha biatcha min hayyamin atta omer min hayyamin o eno ella missemol talmud lomar betecha may talmuda amar rabba derech biatcha min hayyamin dechi akar inish kareh deyammina akar

Rav shemuel bar acha kammeh derav pappa mishshemeh derava bar ulla amar mehacha vayyikkach yehoyada hakkohen aron echad vayyikkov chor bedalto vayyitten oto etzel hammizbeach miyyamin bevo ish bet Adonai venatnu shamma hakkohanim shomre hassaf et kol hakkesef hammuva vet Adonai
May rabbi meir detanya bayit sheen lo ella patztzim echad rabbi meir mechayyev bimzuza vachachamim potrin may tama derabbanan mezuzot ketiv

May tama derabbi meir detanya mezuzot shomea ani miut mezuzot shettayim keshehu omer mezuzot befarasha sheniyya sheen talmud lomar have ribuy achar ribuy veen ribuy achar ribuy ella lemaet miato hakkatuv limzuza achat divre rabbi yishmael

Rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich keshehu omer al hammashkof veal shette hammezuzot sheen talmud lomar shette ma talmud lomar shette ze bana av kol makom shenneemar mezuzot eno ella achat ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv shettayim
Tanu rabbanan uchtavtam yachol yichtevenna al haavanim neemar kan ketiva veneemar lehallan ketiva ma lehallan al hassefer af kan al hassefer
O kelach lederech zo neemar kan ketiva veneemar lehallan ketiva ma lehallan al haavanim af kan al haavanim

Nire lemi dome danin ketiva hannoheget ledorot mikketiva hannoheget ledorot veen danin ketiva hannoheget ledorot mikketiva sheenah noheget ledorot uchmo shenneemar lehallan vayyomer lahem baruch mippiv yikra elay et haddevarim haelle vaani kotev al hassefer baddeo
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe rachamana amar al mezuzot veatte amratte nelaf ketiva ketiva amar kera uchtavtam ketiva tamma vahadar al hammezuzot
Umeachar dichtiv uchtavtam hay gezera shava lema li i lav gezera shava hava amena lichtevah aavna velikbeah assipa ka mashma lan
Arba parashiyyot shebbattefilin meakkevot zo et zo vaafilu ketav echad meakkevan peshita
Amar rav yehuda amar rav lo nitzrecha ella lekotzo shel yud veha name peshita lo nitzrecha ella leidach derav yehuda deamar rav yehuda amar rav kol ot sheen gevil mukkaf lah mearba ruchoteha pesula
b: Tanu rabbanan letotefet letotefet letotafot hare kan arba divre rabbi yishmael
Rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich tat bechatpi shettayim pat beafriki shettayim

Tanu rabbanan yachol yichtevem al arbaa orot veyannichem bearbaa battim bearbaa orot talmud lomar ulzikkaron ben enecha zikkaron echad amarti lach velo shenayim ushlosha zichronot ha ketzad kotvan al arbaa orot umannichan bearbaa battim beor echad

Veim ketavan beor echad vehinnichan bearbaa battim yatza vetzarich sheyehe revach benehen divre rabbi vachachamim omrim eno tzarich veshavin shennoten chut o meshicha ben kol achat veachat veim en charitzan nikar pesulot

Tanu rabbanan ketzad kotvan tefilla shel yad kotvah al or echad veim ketavah bearba orot vehinnicha bevayit echad yatza vetzarich ledabbek shenneemar vehaya lecha leot al yadcha keshem sheot achat mibbachutz kach ot achat mibbifnim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yose omer eno tzarich

Amar rabbi yose umode li rabbi yehuda beribi sheim en lo tefilin shel yad veyesh lo shette tefilin shel rosh shettole or al achat mehen umannichah mode hayenu pelugtayehu amar rava middevarav shel rabbi yose chazar bo rabbi yehuda
Ini veha shelach rav chananya mishshemeh derabbi yochanan tefilla shel yad osin otah shel rosh veshel rosh en osin otah shel yad lefi sheen moridin mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla
La kashya ha beattikata ha bechadtata ulman deamar hazmana milta hi deatni alayehu meikara
Tanu rabbanan ketzad sidran kaddesh li vehaya ki yeviacha miyyamin shema vehaya im shamoa missemol
Vehatanya ipcha amar abbaye la kashya kan mimino shel kore kan mimino shel manniach vehakkore kore kesidran
Amar rav chananel amar rav hechlif parashiyyoteha pesulot amar abbaye la amaran

a: Ella gavayeta levarayeta uvarayeta legavayeta aval gavayeta legavayeta uvarayeta levarayeta let lan bah

Amar leh rava may shena gavayeta levarayeta uvarayeta legavayeta dela dehach devae lemichze avera la ka chazya veha dela ka vae lemichze avera ka chazya barayeta levarayeta vegavayeta legavayeta name hach devaaya lemichze avera deyamin ka chazya avera dismol vedismol ka chazya avera deyamin ella la shena
Veamar rav chananel amar rav titura ditfilin halacha lemoshe missinay amar abbaye mabarta ditfilin halacha lemoshe missinay veamar abbaye shin shel tefilin halacha lemoshe missinay
Vetzarich sheyyaggia charitz limkom hattefer rav dimi minnehardea amar kevan deminnechar la tzerich
Veamar abbaye hay kilpa ditfilin tzarich lemivdekeh dedilma it bah reuta uvaena ketiva tamma veleka rav dimi minnehardea amar la tzerich kulmosa badek lah
Amar rabbi yitzchak retzuot shechorot halacha lemoshe missinay metivi tefilin en koshrin otan ella beminan ben yerukkot ben shechorot ben levanot adummot lo yaase mippene genay vedavar acher

Amar rabbi yehuda maase betalmido shel rabbi akiva shehaya kosher tefilav bilshonot shel techelet vela amar lo davar ifshar oto tzaddik raa talmido velo micha bo amar lo hen lo raa oto veim raa oto lo haya mannicho

Maase behurkanos beno shel rabbi eliezer ben hurkanos shehaya kosher tefilav bilshonot shel argaman velo amar lo davar ifshar oto tzaddik raa beno velo micha bo amru lo hen lo raa oto veim raa oto lo haya mannicho
Katane miha ben yerukkot ben shechorot uven levanot la kashya kan mibbifnim kan mibbachutz
I mibbifnim may genay vedavar acher ika zimnin demithafchin leh
Tana tefilin merubbaot halacha lemoshe missinay amar rav pappa betifran uvaalachsonan
Lema mesayya leh haose tefilato agulla sakkana veen bah mitzva amar rav pappa matnitin daavida ki amguza
Amar rav huna tefilin kal zeman sheppene tavla kayyemet kesherot rav chisda amar nifseku shettayim kesherot shalosh pesulot
Amar rava ha deamratte shettayim kesherot la amaran ella ze shello keneged ze aval ze keneged ze pesulot veze keneged ze name la amaran ella bechadtata aval beattikata let lan bah
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef hechi damyan chadtata vehechi damyan attikata amar leh kol hecha ki mitle beh beshilcha vahadar chalem attikata veidach chadtata
b: Vei name kol hechi dechi mitle beh bemitna atyeh abbatreh chadtata veidach attikata
Abbaye hava yatev kammeh derav yosef ipsik leh retzua ditfile amar leh mahu lemiktereh amar leh ukshartam ketiv shettehe keshira tamma
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe mahu lemitpereh veayyoleh litfira legav amar pok chazi ma amma davar

Amar rav pappa gardumme retzuot kesherot velav milta hi middeamri bene rabbi chiyya gardumme techelet vegardumme ezov kesherin hatam hu detashmishe mitzva ninhu aval hacha detashmishe kedushsha ninhu la
Mikkelal deit lehu shiura vechamma shiurayehu amar rame bar chama amar resh lakish ad etzba tzereda rav kahana machve kafuf rav ashe machve pashut
Rabba katar lehu ufashet veshade lehu rav acha bar yaakov katar lehu umtallet lehu mar bereh deravna aved kedidan

Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav kesher shel tefilin halacha lemoshe missinay amar rav nachman venoyehen levar rav ashe hava yatev kammeh demar zutra ithafcha leh retzua ditfilin amar leh la savar lah mar venoyehen levar amar leh lav addatay

Verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha veyaru mimmekka tanya rabbi eliezer haggadol omer ellu tefilin shebbarosh vahasiroti et kappi veraita et achoray amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida melammed shehera lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe kesher shel tefilin
Amar rav yehuda kesher shel tefilin tzarich sheyehe lemala kede sheyehu yisrael lemala velo lematta vetzarich sheyehe kelappe panim kede sheyehu yisrael lefanim velo leachor

Amar rav shemuel bar bedare amar rav veamri lah amar rabbi acha aricha amar rav huna veamri lah amar rav menashsheya amar shemuel tefilin meematay mevarech alehen mishsheat hannachatan ini veha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol hammitzot kullan mevarech alehen over laasiyyatan abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu mishsheat hannacha vead sheat keshira

a: Amar rav chisda sach ben tefila litfila chozer umvarech

Sach in lo sach la veha shelach rav chiyya bereh derav huna mishshemeh derabbi yochanan al tefila shel yad omer baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lehanniach tefilin al tefilin shel rosh omer baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al mitzvat tefilin
Abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu lo sach mevarech achat sach mevarech shettayim
Tana sach ben tefila litfila avera hi beyado vechozer aleha meerche hammilchama

Tana keshehu manniach manniach shel yad veachar kach manniach shel rosh uchshehu choletz choletz shel rosh veachar kach choletz shel yad bishlama keshehu manniach manniach shel yad veachar kach manniach shel rosh dichtiv ukshartam leot al yadecha vahadar vehau letotafot ben enecha
Ella keshehu choletz choletz shel rosh veachar kach choletz shel yad menalan amar rabba rav huna asbera li amar kera vehau letotafot ben enecha kol zeman shebben enecha yehu shettayim
Tanu rabbanan tefilin meematay mevarech alehen mishsheat hannachatan ketzad haya mashkim latzet ladderech umityare shemma yovedu mannichan uchsheyyaggia zemannan memashmesh bahen umvarech alehen

Vead matay mannichan ad shettishka hachamma rabbi yaakov omer ad shettichle regel min hashshuk vachachamim omrim ad zeman shena umodim chachamim lerabbi yaakov sheim chalatzan latzet levet hakkisse o likanes levet hammerchatz veshaka chamma shuv eno chozer umannichan
Amar rav nachman halacha kerabbi yaakov rav chisda verabba bar rav huna metzallu behu beurta ika deamri en halacha kerabbi yaakov
b: Veha rav chisda verabba bar rav huna metzallu behu beurta hahu peliga
Umi amar rabba bar rav huna hachi veha amar rabba bar rav huna safek chashecha safek la en chashecha lo choletz velo manniach ha vadday chashecha choletz hatam beerev shabbat itmar
May kasavar i kasavar layela zeman tefilin shabbat name zeman tefilin i kasavar shabbat lav zeman tefilin layela name lav zeman tefilin demehecha demimmaata shabbat mehatam mimmaati lelot

Detanya veshamarta et hachukka hazzot lemoadah miyyamim yamima yamim velo lelot miyyamim velo kol yamim perat leshabbatot veyamim tovim divre rabbi yose haggelili rabbi akiva omer lo neemra chukka zo ella lefesach bilvad

Nafka leh mehecha denafka leh lerabbi akiva detanya rabbi akiva omer yachol yanniach adam tefilin beshabbatot uvyamim tovim talmud lomar vehaya leot al yadcha ultotafot ben enecha mi shetztzerichin ot yatzu shabbatot veyamim tovim shehen gufan ot

Amar rabbi elazar kol hammanniach tefilin achar shekiat hachamma over baase verabbi yochanan amar over belav lema berabbi avin amar rabbi ila ka mipalgi deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila kol makom shenneemar hishshamer pen veal eno ella lo taase
Demar it leh derabbi avin umar let leh derabbi avin
La dechulle alma it lehu derabbi avin amar rabbi ila vehacha beha ka mipalgi mar savar hishshamer delav lav vehishshamer daase ase umar savar hishshamer daase name lav

Veamar rabbi elazar veim leshomran muttar veamar ravina hava yatevna kammeh derav ashe vechashach vehinniach tefilin vaamari leh leshomran ka vae lehu mar vaamar li in vachazeteh ledateh delav leshomran hu bae kasavar halacha veen morin ken

Amar rabba bar rav huna chayyav adam lemashmesh battefilin bechol shaa kal vachomer mitztzitz uma tzitz sheen bo ella azkara achat amra tora vehaya al mitzcho tamid shello tassiach yassiach dato mimmennu tefilin sheyyesh bahen azkarot harbe al achat kamma vechamma

Tanu rabbanan yadcha zo semol atta omer semol o eno ella yamin talmud lomar af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim veomer yadah layyated tishlachna viminah lehalmut amelim veomer lamma tashiv yadcha viminecha mikkerev chekcha challe

a: Rabbi yose hachoram omer matzinu yamin shennikra yad shenneemar vayyar yosef ki yashit aviv yad yemino veidach yad yemino ikri yad setama la ikri

Rabbi natan omer eno tzarich hare hu omer ukshartam uchtavtam ma ketiva beyamin af keshira beyamin vechevan dikshira beyamin hannacha bismol hi verabbi yose hachoram hannacha devismol mena leh nafka leh mehecha denafka leh lerabbi natan
Rav ashe amar miyyadcha ketiv behe keha amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe veema yadcha shebbechoach amar leh mi ketiv bechet
Ketannae yadcha behe zo semol acherim omrim yadcha lerabbot et haggidem tanya idach en lo zeroa patur min hattefilin acherim omrim yadcha lerabbot et haggidem
Tanu rabbanan itter manniach tefilin bimino shehu semolo vehatanya manniach bismolo shehu semolo shel kol adam amar abbaye ki tanya hahi besholet bishte yadav
Tana deve menashshe al yadcha zo kiboret ben enecha zo kodkod hecha amri deve rabbi yannay mekom shemmocho shel tinok rofes

Bea mineh pelemo merabbi mi sheyyesh lo shene rashim beeze mehen manniach tefilin amar leh o kum geli o kabbel alach shamta addehachi ata hahu gavra amar leh ityelid li yanoka deit leh tere reshe kamma baena lemitav lechohen ata hahu sava tena leh chayyav liten lo asara selaim
Ini vehatane rame bar chama mittoch shenneemar pado tifde et bechor haadam shomea ani afilu nitraf betoch sheloshim talmud lomar
b: Ach chillek shane hacha divgulgolet tela rachamana

Amar mar yadcha zo kiboret menalan detanu rabbanan al yadcha zo govah shebbayyad atta omer zo govah shebbayyad o eno ella al yadcha mammash amra tora hannach tefilin bayyad vehannach tefilin barosh ma lehallan begovah shebbarosh af kan begovah shebbayyad

Rabbi eliezer omer eno tzarich hare hu omer vehaya lecha leot lecha leot velo laacherim leot rabbi yitzchak omer eno tzarich hare hu omer vesamtem et devaray elle al levavchem ukshartam shettehe sima keneged hallev

Rabbi chiyya verav acha bereh derav aveya mechaven umannach leh lahade libeh rav ashe hava yatev kammeh deammemar hava tzirya bideh veka mitchazyan tefilin amar leh la savar lah mar lecha leot velo laacherim leot amar leh bimkom lecha leot itmar

Govah shebbarosh menalan detanu rabbanan ben enecha zo govah shebbarosh atta omer zo govah shebbarosh o eno ella ben enecha mammash neemar kan ben enecha veneemar lehallan lo tasimu korcha ben enechem lamet ma lehallan begovah shebbarosh mekom sheose korcha af kan begovah shel rosh mekom sheose korcha
Rabbi yehuda omer eno tzarich amra tora hannach tefilin bayyad hannach tefilin barosh ma lehallan bemakom harauy litame benega echad af kan bemakom harauy litame benega echad
Leappoke ben enecha deika basar vesear deika sear lavan veika name sear tzahov
Arba tzitziyyot meakkevot zo et zo shearbatan mitzva achat may benayehu amar rav yosef sadin betzitzit ika benayehu
Rava bar ahina amar tallit baalat chamesh ika benayehu
Ravina amar derav huna ika benayehu deamar rav huna hayyotze betallit sheenah metzuyyetzet kehilchatah beshabbat chayyav chattat
Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi hay man devatztzereh liglimeh la avad velo kelum shavveyeh tallit baalat chamesh
Amar rav mesharsheya hay man detzayereh liglimeh la avad velo kelum may tama dichman desharyeh dame utnan name kol chamatot hatztzerurot tehorot chutz mishshel arviyyim
Amar rav dimi minnehardea hay man dechayeteh liglimeh la avad velo kelum im ita dela mibe leh lifsok velishdeyeh
Rabbi yishmael omer arbatan arba mitzot amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yishmael velet hilcheta kevateh
Ravina hava ka azel abbatreh demar bar rav ashe beshabbeta derigla ipsik karna dechuteh vela amar leh vela mide kad meta leveteh amar leh mehatam ipsik amar leh i amarte li mehatam shedeteh
Veha amar mar gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora
Targemah rav bar sheva kammeh derav kahana

a: Belav delo tasur

Veika deamri mehatam amar leh vaamar leh may datach lemishdeyeh vehaamar mar gadol kevod havriyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora veha targemah rav bar sheva kammeh derav kahana belav delo tasur hacha name karmelit derabbanan hi
Hadaran alach hakkometz
Matni hattechelet enah meakkevet et hallavan vehallavan eno meakkev et hattechelet tefilla shel yad enah meakkevet et shel rosh veshel rosh enah meakkevet et shel yad
Gema lema matnitin dela kerabbi detanya uritem oto melammed shemmeakkevin ze et ze divre rabbi vachachamim omrim en meakkevin
May tama derabbi dichtiv hakkanaf min kanaf uchtiv petil techelet veamar rachamana uritem oto ad deika tarvayehu bechad
Verabbanan uritem oto kol chad lechodeh mashma
Lema dela kerabbi amar rav yehuda amar rav afilu tema rabbi lo nitzrecha ella lekaddem
Detanya mitzva lehakdim lavan lattechelet veim hikdim techelet lallavan yatza ella shechiser mitzva may chiser mitzva
b: Ilema chiser mitzva delavan vekiyyem mitzva ditchelet lerabbi akkove meakkev ahadade
Amar rav yehuda amar rav shechiser mitzva veasa mitzva umay chiser mitzva dela avad mitzva min hammuvchar
Hatinach lavan deeno meakkev et hattechelet techelet deenah meakkevet et hallavan may hi
Amar rame bar chama lo nitzrecha ella letallit shekkullah techelet

Itmar name amar leh levi lishmuel aroch la titev akkarach ad dimfarshatte li leha milta hattechelet enah meakkevet et hallavan vehallavan eno meakkev et hattechelet may hi amar leh lo nitzrecha ella lesadin betzitzit demitzva leakdome lavan beresha
May tama hakkanaf min kanaf vei akdem techelet lelavan let lan bah
Tinach lavan deeno meakkev et hattechelet techelet deenah meakkevet et hallavan may hi
Amar leh rame bar chama lo nitzrecha ella letallit shekkullah techelet demitzva leakdome techelet beresha dehakkanaf min kanaf vei akdem lavan beresha let lan bah
Amar rava mide tziva ka garem ella amar rava lo nitzrecha ella legardummin dei igardam techelet vekae lavan vei igardam lavan vekae techelet let lan bah
Deamri bene rabbi chiyya gardumme techelet kesherin vegardumme ezov kesherin vechamma shiur gardummin amar bar hamdure amar shemuel kede leonvan
Ibaya lehu kede leonvan leonvan kullehu bahadade o dilma kol chad vechad lechodeh teku
Bae rav ashe allime dela mianvi vei hao kattine mianvi may amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe kol shekken deminchar mitzvatayehu
Uman tanna diflig aleh derabbi hay tanna hu detanya rabbi yitzchak omer mishshum rabbi natan sheamar mishshum rabbi yose haggelili sheamar mishshum rabbi yochanan ben nuri en lo techelet metil lavan

Amar rava shema minah tzarich likshor al kol chulya vechulya dei salka datach lo tzarich ha deamri bene rabbi chiyya gardumme techelet kesherin vegardumme ezov kesherin kevan deishteri leh ilay ishteri leh kulleh

a: Dilma deiktar
Veamar rabba shema minah kesher elon deorayeta dei salka datach derabbanan may itzterich lemishre sadin betzitzit peshita hattochef techifa achat eno chibur ella shema minah deorayeta

Amar rabba bar rav adda amar rav adda amar rav im nifsak hachut meikaro pesula yatev rav nachman veka amar leha shemata etiveh rava lerav nachman bamme devarim amurim bitchilato aval sofo sheyarav vegardummav kol shehu
May sheyarav umay gardummav may lav sheyarav deipsik minayehu veishtayyar minayehu gardummav deigardum igardome
La chada katane shayyore gardummav kol shehu velema gardummav sheyarav lema li ha ka mashma lan devaenan shiyyura legardummav kede leonvan

Yatev rabba vekaamar mishshemeh derav chut shel kerech ole min hamminyan amar leh rav yosef shemuel amrah vela rav itmar name amar rabba bar bar chana sach li rabbi yoshiyya demin usha chut shel kerech ola lah min hamminyan

Yatev rava veka amar mishshemeh dishmuel techelet shekkarach rubbah keshera amar leh rav yosef rav amrah vela shemuel itmar name amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav techelet shekkarach rubbah keshera

Rav chiyya bereh derav natan matne hachi amar rav huna amar rav sheshet amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav techelet shekkarach rubbah keshera vaafilu lo karach bah ella chulya achat keshera venoye techelet shelish gedil ushne shelishe anaf
Vechamma shiur chulya tanya rabbi omer kede sheyyichroch veyishne vishallesh tana happochet lo yifchot mishsheva vehammosif lo yosif al shelosh esre
Happochet lo yifchot mishsheva keneged shiva rekiim vehammosif lo yosif al shelosh esre keneged shiva rekiin veshishsha avirin shebbenehem
Tana keshehu matchil matchil ballavan hakkanaf min kanaf uchshehu mesayyem mesayyem ballavan maalin bakkodesh velo moridin
Rav verabba bar bar chana hao yatvi hava ka chalef veazel hahu gavra demikasse gelima dechulleh techelta urme leh techelta
b: Ugdila migdil amar rav yae gelima vela yae techelta rabba bar bar chana amar yae gelima veyae techelta
Bemay ka mipalgi rabba bar bar channa savar ketiv gedil uchtiv petil o gedil o fetil
Verav savar leolam petil baenan vehahu gedilim leminyana hu daata gedil shenayim gedilim arbaa ase gedil ufotlehu mittocho
Amar shemuel mishshemeh delevi chute tzemer potrin beshel pishtan
Ibaya lehu shel pishtan mahu sheyyifteru beshel tzemer tzemer beshel pishtim hu defatar dechevan ditchelet patra lavan name patar aval pishtim betzemer la
O dilma kevan dichtiv lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav gedilim taase lach la shena tzemer befishtim vela shena pishtim betzemer
Ta shema deamar rachava amar rav yehuda chute tzemer potrin beshel pishtan veshel pishtan potrin beshel tzemer chute tzemer ufishtim potrin bechol makom vaafilu beshirain
Ufliga derav nachman deamar rav nachman hashshirain peturin min hatztzitzit etiveh rava lerav nachman hashshirain vehakkalach vehasserikin kullan chayyavin betzitzit midderabbanan
I hachi ema sefa vechullan tzemer ufishtim potrin bahen i amratte bishlama deorayeta hayenu demishteru behu kilayim ella i amratte derabbanan hechi mishtere behu kilayim ema o tzemer o pishtim
Hachi name mistabbera dekatane sefa hen beminan potrin shello beminan en potrin i amratte bishlama derabbanan hayenu demipatru beminan ella i amratte deorayeta tzemer ufishtim hu defatar
I mishshum ha la irya kidrava derava rame ketiv hakkanaf min kanaf uchtiv tzemer ufishtim
Ha ketzad tzemer ufishtim potrin ben beminan ben shello beminan shear minin beminan potrin shello beminan en potrin
Verav nachman kidtana deve rabbi yishmael
Detana deve rabbi yishmael hoil veneemru begadim battora setam ufarat lecha hakkatuv beechad mehen tzemer ufishtim af kol tzemer ufishtim

Amar abbaye vehay tana deve rabbi yishmael mappeka meidach tana deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael beged en li ella beged tzemer minnayin lerabbot tzemer gemallim vetzemer arnavim venotza shel izzim vehakkalach vehasserikin vehashshirain minnayin talmud lomar o veged

a: Tanu rabbanan sadin betzitzit bet shammay potrin uvet hillel mechayevin vahalacha kedivre bet hillel
Amar rabbi eliezer ben rabbi tzadok vahalo kol hammetil techelet birushalayim eno ella min hammatmihin
Amar rabbi im ken lamma asaruha lefi sheen bekiin
Amar leh rava bar rav chana lerava velirmo be asra venippeku leshuka umipparsema milta kol shekken dematmehu ilavan
Velidreshah befirka gezera mishshum kala ilan
Velo yehe ella lavan kevan deefshar beminan la
Kidresh lakish deamar resh lakish kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase im atta yachol lekayyem et shenehem mutav veim lav yavo ase veyidche et lo taase
Velivdekuha ella gezera mishshum teima
Velichteva addiske addiske lekum velismoch amar rava hashta
b: Chametz befesach veom hakkippurim decharet samchinan addiske hacha daase bealma lo kol shekken
Ella amar rava ha milta amri veitmar bemareva mishshum derabbi zera kevati shemma yikkara sedino betoch shalosh veyitperennu
Vehattora amra taase velo min heasuy
Shera rabbi zera lisdineh rav zera amar gezera name mishshum kesut layela
Veamar rava ha milta amari veitmar bemareva mishshemeh derabbi zera kevati hi shel beged uchnafeha shel or chayyevet hi shel or uchnafeha shel beged petura may tama ikar beged baenan
Rav achay azel batar kanaf
Amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna hetil levaalat shalosh vehishlimah learba pesula taase velo min heasuy
Metivi chasidim harishonim kevan sheargu bah shalosh hau metilin lah techelet ema kevan sheppatzu bah shalosh hau metilin lah techelet
Umi amrinan taase velo min heasuy ini vehaamar rabbi zera hetil lemuttelet keshera
Amar rava hashta beval tosif kae maase la have
Matkef lah rav pappa mimmay degavra leosofe ka mikaven dilma levattole ka mikaven uval tosif leka maase ika
Amar rabbi zera amar rav matna amar shemuel techelet en bah mishshum kilayim vaafilu betallit petura
May tallit petura ilema delet bah shiura vehatanya tallit shehakkatan mitkasse bo rosho verubbo

a: Vehaggadol yotze bah derech aray chayyevet betzitzit en hakkatan mitkasse bo rosho verubbo af al pi shehaggadol yotze bah aray petura vechen leinyan kilayim
Vehavenan bah may vechen leinyan kilayim ilema vechen leinyan isura dechilayim veha anan tenan en aray bechilayim
Veamar rav nachman bar yitzchak vechen leinyan sadin betzitzit
Ella may petura hetil lammutelet
Veha amrah rabbi zera chada zimna chada mikkelal dachavertah itmar
Tanu rabbanan tallit kefula chayyevet betzitzit verabbi shimon poter veshavin sheim kefalah utfarah shechayyevet
Tefarah peshita la tzericha denaktah besike
Rabba bar huna ikla leve rava bar rav nachman chazyeh dahava mikasse tallit kefula urme leh chute ilave kefela ipshita vaata chuta vekam lahade resheh
Amar leh lav hayenu kanaf dichtav rachamana beorayeta ata shadyah ikassi gelima achariti
Amar leh mi savratte chovat gavra hu chovat tallit hu zil remi lah
Lema mesayya leh chasidim harishonim kevan sheargu bah shalosh hau metilin bah techelet shane chasidim demachmeri annafshayehu
Ufliga demalacha demalacha ashkecheh lerav kattina demikasse sedina amar leh kattina kattina sedina bekayeta vesarbala besitva tzitzit shel techelet ma tehe aleha
Amar leh anshitu aase amar leh bizman deika ritcha anshinan
I amratte bishlama chovat gavra hu hayenu demichayyav dela ka rame ella i amratte chovat tallit hu ha la michayeva
Ella may chovat gavra hu nehi dechayeveh rachamana ki mikasse tallit devat chiyyuva ki mikasse tallit delav bat chiyyuva hi mi chayeveh rachamana
Ella hachi kaamar leh tatzdeke lemiftar nafshach mitztzitzit
Amar rav tovi bar kisna amar shemuel kele kufsa chayyavin betzitzit umode shemuel bezaken sheasaah lichvodo sheppetura may tama asher techasse bah amar rachamana hay lav leikassoye avida
Behahi shata vadday ramenan leh mishshum loeg larash cheref osehu
Amar rachava amar rabbi yehuda tallit shennikrea chutz leshalosh yitpor toch shalosh lo yitpor
Tanya name hachi tallit shennikrea chutz leshalosh yitpor toch shalosh rabbi meir omer lo yitpor vachachamim omrim yitpor
Veshavin shello yavi afilu amma al amma mimmakom acher uvah techelet vetole bah veshavin shemmevi techelet mimmakom acher vetole bah
b: Uvilvad shello tehe mufseket shamatte minah mattirin mibbeged leveged dilma dei belay
Tanu rabbanan tallit shekkullah techelet kol mine tzivonin potrin bah chutz mikkala ilan
Metivi tallit en poter bah ella minah tallit shekkullah techelet mevi techelet vedavar acher vetole bah vekala ilan lo yavi veim hevi kasher
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak la kashya kan betallit bat arbaa chutin kan betallit bat shemona chutin
Shamatte minah mattirin mibbeged leveged dilma dei avad
Itmar rav amar en mattirin mibbeged leveged ushmuel amar mattirin mibbeged leveged
Rav amar en madlikin minner lener ushmuel amar madlikin minner lener
Rav amar en halacha kerabbi shimon bigrira ushmuel amar halacha kerabbi shimon bigrira
Amar abbaye kol mile demar aved kerav levar mehane telat deaved kishmuel mattirin mibbeged leveged umadlikin minner lener vahalacha kerabbi shimon bigrira
Detanya rabbi shimon omer gorer adam mitta kisse vesafsal uvilvad shello yitkaven laasot charitz
Rav yehuda masar leh lekatztzara rav chanina aved leh sisa ravina chayet lehu mechat
Tanu rabbanan kamma chutin hu noten bet shammay omrim arbaa uvet hillel omrim shelosha

Vechamma tehe meshulleshet bet shammay omrim arba uvet hillel omrim shalosh veshalosh shebbet hillel omrim achat mearba betefach shel kol adam amar rav pappa tefach deorayeta arba begudal shet biktanna chamesh betilta
Amar rav huna arbaa betoch arba umshulleshet arba verav yehuda amar shelosha betoch shalosh meshulleshet shalosh
Amar rav pappa hilcheta arbaa betoch shalosh meshulleshet arba

Lememra deit lehu shiura urminhu tzitzit en tzitzit ella yotze veen tzitzit ella mashshehu uchvar alu zikne bet shammay vezikne bet hillel laaliyyat yochanan ben betira veamru tzitzit en lah shiur kayyotze bo lulav en bo shiur
May lav en lah shiur kelal la

a: En lah shiur lemala aval yesh lah shiur lematta dei la tema hachi kayyotze bo lulav en lo shiur hachi name deen lo shiur kelal
Vehatnan lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim kede lenanea bo kasher ella en lo shiur lemala aval yesh lo shiur lematta hachi name en lo shiur lemala aval yesh lo shiur lematta
Tanu rabbanan tzitzit en tzitzit ella anaf vechen hu omer vayyikkacheni betzitzit roshi veamar abbaye vetzarich lefarodah ki tzutzita dearmae
Tanu rabbanan hetil al hakkeren o al haggedil keshera rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer posel bishtehen
Keman azla ha deamar rav gidel amar rav tzitzit tzericha shettehe notefet al hakkeren shenneemar al kanfe vigdehem keman kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan vetzarich sheyyarchik melo kesher gudal
Veitzterich derav pappa veitzterich derabbi yaakov dei midderav pappa hava amena toch shalosh dela larchek tefe vechamma dimkarav mealle itzterich derabbi yaakov
Vei midderabbi yaakov hava amena melo kesher gudal dela likrav tefe vechamma derachik mealle tzericha

Ravina verav samma hao yatvi kammeh derav ashe chazyeh rav samma lekarneh diglimeh deravina distar uvtzar mimmelo kesher gudal amar leh la savar lah mar leha derabbi yaakov amar leh bishat asiyya itmar
Iksif amar leh rav ashe la tittekif lach chad minayehu kitre minan
Rav acha bar yaakov rame arba veayef lehu meaf umayyel lehu biglima veavek lehu mevak kasavar baenan temanya biglima ki hechi delehve gedil gedilim bimkom petil
Rav yirmeya middifti rame temanya deinhu shitsar vela avek lehu mar bereh deravina aved kedidan
Rav nachman ashkecheh lerav adda bar ahava rame chute veka mevarech laasot tzitzit amar leh may tzitzi deka shamana hachi amar rav tzitzit en tzericha beracha

Ki nach nafsheh derav huna al rav chisda lemirme derav adderav umi amar rav tzitzit en tzarich beracha veha amar rav yehuda amar rav minnayin letzitzit begoy shehi pesula shenneemar dabber el bene yisrael veasu lahem tzitzit bene yisrael yaasu velo haggoyim yaasu
Veha may rumya amar rav yosef kasavar rav chisda kol mitzva shekkeshera begoy beyisrael en tzarich levarech kol mitzva sheppesula begoy beyisrael tzarich levarech
Uchlala hu vahare mila dichshera begoy detanya ir sheen bah rofe yisrael veyesh bah rofe armay verofe kuti yamul armay veal yamul kuti divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer kuti velo armay
Uvyisrael tzarich levarech deamar mar hammal omer baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al hammila
Mide hu tama ella lerav rav mifsal pasel deitmar minnayin lemila begoy sheppesula daru bar pappa mishshemeh derav amar veatta et beriti tishmor
Rabbi yochanan amar himmol yimmol hammal yimmol
Sukka mesayya leh tefilin have teuvteh
Hare sukka dichshera begoy detanya sukkat goyim sukkat nashim sukkat behema sukkat kutiyyim sukka mikkol makom keshera uvilvad shettehe mesukkechet kehilchatah

Uvyisrael en tzarich levarech detanya haose sukka leatzmo omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shehecheyanu vekiyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze ba leshev bah omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu leshev bassukka veilu laasot sukka la mevarech
Tefilin teuvteh vahare tefilin difsulot begoy detane rav chinana bereh derava
b: Mippashrunya sefer tora tefilin umzuzot shekketavan min kuti goy eved ishsha vekatan veyisrael meshummad pesulin shenneemar ukshartam uchtavtam kol sheyyeshno bikshira yeshno bichtiva kol sheeno bikshira eno bichtiva

Uvyisrael en tzarich levarech dishlach rav chiyya bereh derav huna mishshemeh derabbi yochanan al tefilin shel yad omer baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lehanniach tefilin al tefilin shel rosh omer baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al mitzvat tefilin veilu laasot tefilin la mevarech

Ella lav hayenu tama kol mitzva daasiyyatah gemar mitzva kegon mila af al gav dichshera begoy beyisrael tzarich levarech vechol mitzva daasiyyatah lav gemar mitzva kegon tefilin af al gav difsulot begoy beyisrael eno tzarich levarech
Uvtzitzit beha kamipalgi mar savar chovat tallit hu umar savar chovat gavra hu
Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe attun hachi matnitu lah
Anan hachi matnenan lah amar rav yehuda amar rav minnayin letzitzit begoy shekkeshera shenneemar dabber el bene yisrael veasu lahem tzitzit yaasu lahem acherim
Amar rav yehuda amar rav asaan min hakkotzim umin hannimin umin haggeradin pesula min hassisin keshera
Ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar af min hassisin pesula baenan teviyya lishmah

Ketannae tzipan zahav o shettala alehen or behema temea pesulot or behema tehora kesherot veaf al pi shello ibdan lishman rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af or behema tehora pesulot ad sheyeabbeden lishman

Amar leh abbaye lerav shemuel bar rav yehuda ha techelta hechi tzavitu lah amar leh mayetinan dam chillazon vesammanin veramenan lehu beora veshaklinan purta beveata vetaaminan lehu beudra veshadenan lah lehahu beata vekalenan leh leudra
Shema minah telat shema minah teima pesula ushma minah devaenan tzevia lishmah ushma minah teima pasla
Hayenu teima pesula hayenu tzevia lishmah amar rav ashe ma taam kaamar ma taam teima pesula mishshum devaenan tzevia lishmah
Ketannae teima pesula mishshum shenneemar kelil techelet divre rabbi chanina ben gamliel
Rabbi yochanan ben dahavay omer afilu mare sheni shebbah kasher mishshum shenneemar ushni tolaat
Tanu rabbanan techelet en lah bedika veen nikachat ella min hammumche tefilin yesh lahem bedika veen nikachin ella min hammumche sefarim umzuzot yesh lahen bedika venikachin mikkol adam
Utchelet en lah bedika veha rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda badek leh siman begeshem mayete magbeya gila umayya deshavlilta umeme raglayim

a: Ben arbaim yom vetare lah begavayehu meurta vead letzafra ipred chazutah pesula la ipred chazutah keshera
Verav adda kammeh derava mishshemeh derav avira amar mayete chamira arkesa disare veafya lah begaveyh ishtannay limalleuta keshera ligriuta pesula vesimanach shinuy sheker shinuy emet
May en lah bedika name dekaamar atteima
Mar mimmishki ayeti techelta bishne rav achay badkuha bidrav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda veipred chazutah bidrav adda veishtannay limalleuta
Sevar lemifselah amar lehu rav achay ella ha la techelta hi vela kala ilan hi ella shema minah shemuata ahadade itmar

Hecha divdakna bidrav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda la ipred chazutah keshera ipred chazutah badkinan lah bidrav adda bachamira arkesa ishtannay limalleuta keshera ligriuta pesula shelachu mittam shemuata ahadade itmar
Rabbi mani dayek vezaven kechumre matneyata amar leh hahu sava hachi avud kammae dekammach veatzlach iskayehu
Tanu rabbanan hallokeach tallit metzuyyetzet min hashshuk miyyisrael hare hi bechezkatah min haggoy min hattaggar keshera min hahedot pesula
Veaf al pi sheamru en adam rashshay limkor tallit metzuyyetzet legoy ad sheyyattir tzitziyyoteha
May tama hacha targimu mishshum zona rav yehuda amar shemma yitlave immo badderech veyahargennu
Rav yehuda rame techelta lefarzuma deinashe beteh umvarech kol tzafra lehitattef batztzitzit
Midderame kasavar mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama hu ammay mevarech kol tzafra vetzafra
Kerabbi detanya tefilin kol zeman shemmannichan mevarech alehen divre rabbi
I hachi kol shata name rav yehuda inish tzenia hava vela share leh liglimeh kulleh yoma umay shena mitztzafra ki meshanne mikkesut layela lichsut yom

Tanu rabbanan hakkol chayyavin betzitzit kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim gerim nashim vaavadim rabbi shimon poter benashim mippene shemmitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot
Amar mar hakkol chayyavin betzitzit kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim peshita dei kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim petiri man lichayyav

Kohanim itztericha leh salka datach amena hoil uchtiv lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav gedilim taase lach man dela ishteri kilayim legabbeh bilvisha hu demichayyav betzitzit hane kohanim hoil veishteri kilayim legabbayehu la lichayevu
Ka mashma lan nehi deishteri beidan avoda bela idan avoda la ishteri
Rabbi shimon poter benashim may tama derabbi shimon detanya uritem oto perat lichsut layela
Atta omer perat lichsut layela o eno ella perat lichsut some keshehu omer asher techasse bah hare kesut some amur ha ma ani mekayyem uritem oto perat lichsut layela
