Uma raita lerabbot kesut some ulhotzi kesut layela merabbe ani kesut some sheyyeshnah biriyya etzel acherim umotzi ani kesut layela sheenah biriyya etzel acherim
Verabbanan
b: Hay asher techasse bah may avdi leh mibe lehu lechidtanya al arba kanfot kesutcha arba velo shalosh
Atta omer arba velo shalosh o eno ella arba velo chamesh keshehu omer asher techasse bah hare baalat chamesh amur uma ani mekayyem al arba arba velo shalosh
Uma raita lerabbot baalat chamesh ulhotzi baalat shalosh merabbe ani baalat chamesh sheyyesh bichlal chamesh arba umotzi ani baalat shalosh sheen bichlal shalosh arba
Verabbi shimon measher nafka verabbanan asher la mashma lehu

Verabbanan hay uritem oto may avdi leh mibe lehu lechidtanya uritem oto uzchartem ree mitzva zo uzchor mitzva acheret hatteluya bo bah veezo zo zo keriyyat shema ditnan meematay korin et shema beshacharit mishsheyyakkir ben techelet lelavan
Vetanya idach uritem oto uzchartem ree mitzva zo uzchor mitzva acheret hassemucha lah veezo zo zo mitzvat kilayim dichtiv lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav gedilim taase lach
Tanya idach uritem oto uzchartem et kol mitzot Adonai kevan shennitchayyev adam bemitzva zo nitchayyev bechol mitzot kullan verabbi shimon hi deamar mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hi
Tanya idach uritem oto uzchartem et kol mitzot Adonai shekula mitzva zo keneged kol hammitzot kullan

Vetanya idach uritem oto uzchartem vaasitem reiyya mevia lide zechira zechira mevia lide asiyya verabbi shimon bar yochay omer kol hazzariz bemitzva zo zoche umkabbel pene shechina ketiv hacha uritem oto uchtiv hatam et Adonai elohecha tira veoto taavod

Tanu rabbanan chavivin yisrael shessibvan hakkadosh baruch hu bemitzot tefilin berashehen utfilin bizrootehen vetzitzit bevigdehen umzuza lefitchehen vaalehen amar david sheva bayyom hillalticha al mishpete tzidkecha

Uvshaa shennichnas david levet hammerchatz veraa atzmo omed arom amar oy li sheeemod arom belo mitzva vechevan shennizkar bammila shebbivsaro nityashva dato leachar sheyyatza amar aleha shira shenneemar lamnatztzeach al hashsheminit mizmor ledavid al mila shennitna bashshemini

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer kol sheyyesh lo tefilin berosho utfilin bizroo vetzitzit bevigdo umzuza befitcho hakkol bechizuk shello yecheta shenneemar vehachut hamshullash lo vimhera yinnatek veomer chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vayechalletzem

Tanya haya rabbi meir omer ma nishtanna techelet mikkol mine tzivonin mippene shehattechelet dome layyam veyam dome larakia verakia lechisse hakkavod shenneemar vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir uchetzem hashshamayim latohar uchtiv kemare even sappir demut kisse

Tanya haya rabbi meir omer gadol onsho shel lavan yoter meonsho shel techelet mashal lema haddavar dome lemelech basar vadam sheamar lishne avadav leechad amar have li chotam shel tit ulechad amar have li chotam shel zahav ufashu shenehem velo heviu eze mehen onsho merubbe heve omer ze sheamar lo have li chotam shel tit velo hevi
Tanya haya rabbi meir omer chayyav adam levarech mea berachot bechol yom shenneemar veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach
Rav chiyya bereh derav aveya beshabbeta uvome tave tarach ummalle lehu beisparmake umagde
Tanya haya rabbi meir omer chayyav adam levarech shalosh berachot bechol yom elu hen shello asaani goy shello asaani ishsha shello asaani bur
Rav acha bar yaakov shameh livreh dahava ka mevarech shello asaani bur amar leh kulle hay name amar leh veella may mevarech shello asaani eved hayenu ishsha eved

a: Zil tefe
Tanu rabbanan chillazon ze gufo dome layyam uvriyyato doma ledag veole echad leshivim shana uvdamo tzovin techelet lefichach damav yekarim
Tanya amar rabbi natan en lach kol mitzva kalla shekketuva betora sheen mattan secharah beolam hazze velaolam habba eni yodea kamma tze ulmad mimmitzvat tzitzit

Maase beadam echad shehaya zahir bemitzvat tzitzit shama sheyyesh zona bichrakke hayyam shennotelet arba meot zehuvim bischarah shiger lah arba meot zehuvim vekava lah zeman keshehiggia zemanno ba veyashav al happetach

Nichnesa shifchatah veamra lah oto adam sheshshiger lich arba meot zehuvim ba veyashav al happetach amra hi yikkanes nichnas hitztzia lo sheva mittot shesh shel kesef veachat shel zahav uven kol achat veachat sullam shel kesef veelona shel zahav

Alta veyashva al gabbe elona keshehi arumma veaf hu ala leshev arom kenegdah bau arba tzitziyyotav vetafchu lo al panav nishmat veyashav lo al gabbe karka veaf hi nishmeta veyashva al gabbe karka amra lo gappah shel romi sheeni mannichatcha ad shettomar li ma mum raita bi

Amar lah haavoda shello raiti ishsha yafe kemotech ella mitzva achat tzivanu Adonai elohenu vetzitzit shemah uchtiv bah ani Adonai elohechem shette feamim ani hu sheatid lipara vaani hu sheatid leshallem sachar achshav nidmu alay kearbaa edim
Amra lo eni mannichatcha ad shettomar li ma shimcha uma shem ircha uma shem rabbecha uma shem midrashcha sheatta lamed bo tora katav venatan beyadah
Amda vechilkah kol nechaseha shelish lammalchut ushlish laaniyyim ushlish natla beyadah chutz meotan matztzaot

Uvat levet midrasho shel rabbi chiyya amra lo rabbi tzave alay veyaasuni giyyoret amar lah bitti shemma enayich natatte beechad min hattalmidim hotziah ketav miyyadah venatna lo amar lah lechi zechi bemikkachich
Otan matztzaot shehitztzia lo beisur hitztzia lo beheter ze mattan secharo baolam hazze velaolam habba eni yodea kamma
Amar rav yehuda tallit sheula kol sheloshim yom petura min hatztzitzit mikan veelach chayyevet

Tanya name hachi haddar befundeki beeretz yisrael vehassocher bayit bechutz laaretz kol sheloshim yom patur min hammezuza mikan veelach chayyav aval hassocher bayit beeretz yisrael ose mezuza lealtar mishshum yishuv deeretz yisrael
Tefilla shel yad enah meakkevet amar rav chisda lo shanu ella sheyyesh lo aval en lo meakkevet
Amru lo amarta amar lehu la ella man delet leh tere mitzot chad mitzva name la lebed umeikara may sevar gezera shemma yifsha
Amar rav sheshet kol sheeno manniach tefilin over bishmona ase
Vechol sheen lo tzitzit bevigdo over bachamishsha ase
Vechol kohen sheeno ole ladduchan over bishlosha ase
Kol sheen lo mezuza befitcho over bishne ase uchtavtam uchtavtam
Veamar resh lakish kol hammanniach tefilin maarich yamim shenneemar
b: Adonai alehem yichu ulchol bahen chayye ruchi vetachalimeni vehachayeni
Matni hassolet vehashshemen en meakkevin et hayyayin velo hayyayin meakkevan hammattanot sheal hammizbeach hachitzon en meakkevot zo et zo
Gema tanu rabbanan uminchatam veniskehem have mincha veachar kach have nesachim rabbi omer zevach unsachim have zevach veachar kach have nesachim
Verabbi name hachtiv uminchatam veniskehem hahu mibe leminchatam veniskehem ballayela uminchatam veniskehem afilu lemachar
Verabbanan name hachtiv zevach unsachim hahu mibe leh lichdizeri deamar zeeri en nesachim mitkaddeshin ella bishchitat hazzevach
Verabbi name mibe leh lichdizeri verabbanan name mibe lehu leminchatam veniskehem ballayela uminchatam veniskehem afilu lemachar
Ella hayenu tamayehu derabbanan dichtiv ola umincha verabbi name hachtiv ola umincha

Ella bevaim im hazzevach dechulle alma la peligi demincha veachar kach nesachim dehachtiv ola umincha ki peligi bevain bifne atzman rabbanan savri middevain im hazzevach mincha veachar kach nesachim bifne atzman name mincha veachar kach nesachim
Verabbi hatam hu deayede deatchel baachila gamar lah lecholla milta daachila aval bifne atzman nesachim adifi hoil demitamra shira alayehu
Hammattanot sheal mizbeach hachitzon en meakkevot zo et zo
Tanu rabbanan minnayin lechol hannitanin al mizbeach hachitzon shennetanan bemattana achat shekkiper shenneemar vedam zevachecha yishshafech al mizbach Adonai elohecha

Matni happarim vehaelim vehakkevasim vehasseirim enan meakkevin ze et ze rabbi shimon omer im hau lahem parim merubbim velo hau lahem nesachim yavi par echad unsachim velo yakrivu kullam belo nesachim
Gema hane parim uchvasim dehecha ilema dechag kammishpat kemishpatam ketiv behu
Ella derosh chodesh vaatzeret dechomesh happekudim

a: Elim dehecha i dehanhu deayil hu i daatzeret detorat kohanim havaya ketiv behu
Leolam daatzeret detorat kohanim vehachi kaamar la elim detorat kohanim meakkevi leh leayil dechomesh happekudim valo ayil dechomesh happekudim meakkev lehu leelim detorat kohanim
Ella parim daafilu ahadade la meakkevi veelim dehacha udhacha hu dela meakkevi inhu meakkevi
Tanna mile mile katane
Uvom hachodesh tikkach par ben bakar tamim veshishsha kevasim vaayil temimim yihu par ma talmud lomar
Lefi shenneemar battora parim uminnayin sheim lo matza shenayim mevi echad talmud lomar par
Shishsha kevasim ma talmud lomar lefi shekkatuv battora shiva uminnayin sheim lo matza shiva yavi shishsha talmud lomar shishsha
Uminnayin sheim lo matza shishsha yavi chamishsha chamishsha yavi arbaa arbaa yavi shelosha shelosha yavi shenayim vaafilu echad talmud lomar velakkevasim kaasher tassig yado
Umeachar dichtiv hachi shishsha kevasim lema li dechamma deefshar lehaddore mehadderinan
Uminnayin leelim shebbetorat kohanim shemmeakkevin ze et ze talmud lomar yihu
Ko amar Adonai elohim barishon beechad lachodesh tikkach par ben bakar tamim vechitteta et hammikdash chattat ola hi amar rabbi yochanan parasha zo eliyyahu atid ledorshah
Rav ashe amar miluim hikrivu bime ezra kederech shehikrivu bime moshe
Tanya name hachi rabbi yehuda omer parasha zo eliyyahu atid ledorshah amar lo rabbi yose milluim hikrivu bime ezra kederech shehikrivu bime moshe amar lo tanuach datecha shehinnachta dati
Vechol nevela utrefa min haof umin habbehema lo yochlu hakkohanim kohanim hu delo yochlu ha yisrael achli amar rabbi yochanan parasha zo eliyyahu atid ledorshah
Ravina amar kohanim itzterich leh salka datach amena hoil veishteri melika legabbayehu tishtere name nevela utrefa ka mashma lan
Vechen taase beshiva vachodesh meish shoge umippeti vechippartem et habbayit shiva
Amar rabbi yochanan ellu shiva shevatim shechatu veaf al pi sheen rubbah shel kahal
Chodesh im chiddeshu veamru chelev muttar meish shoge umippeti melammed sheen chayyavin ella al helem davar im shiggat maase

Amar rav yehuda amar rav zachur oto haish lattov vachanina ben chizkiyya shemo sheilmale hu nignaz sefer yechezkel shehau devarav sotrin divre tora me asa heela shelosh meot garve shemen veyashav baaliyya udrasho
Amar rabbi shimon im hau lahem parim merubbin vechu
Tanu rabbanan veefa lappar veefa laayil yaase mincha velakkevasim kaasher tassig yado veshemen hin laefa amar rabbi shimon vechi middat parim veelim achat hi
Ella sheim hau lahem parim merubbin velo hau nesachim yaviu par echad unsachav veal yikrevu kullan belo nesachim veim hau lahem
b: Elim merubbin velo haya lahen efatan yaviu ayil echad veefato velo yikrevu kullam belo efot
Matni happar vehaelim vehakkevasim vehassair en meakkevin et hallechem velo hallechem meakkevan
Hallechem meakkev et hakkevasim veen hakkevasim meakkevin et hallechem divre rabbi akiva

Amar rabbi shimon ben nannas lo ki ella hakkevasim meakkevin et hallechem vehallechem eno meakkev hakkevasim shekken matzinu keshehau yisrael bemidbar arbaim shana karvu kevasim belo lechem af kan yikrevu kevasim belo lechem
Amar rabbi shimon halacha kedivre ben nannas aval en hattaam kidvarav
Shekkol haamur bechomesh happekudim karev bammidbar vechol haamur betorat kohanim en karev bammidbar mishshebbau laaretz karvu ellu vaellu
Mippene ma ani omer yikrevu kevasim belo lechem mippene shehakkevashim mattirin et atzman velo hallechem belo kevasim sheen lo mi yattirennu
Gema tanu rabbanan vehikravtem al hallechem chova al hallechem shivat kevasim temimim af al pi sheen lechem
Im ken ma talmud lomar al hallechem melammed shello nitchayevu bakkevasim kodem shennitchayevu ballechem divre rabbi tarfon

Rabbi akiva omer yachol hen hen kevasim haamurim kan hen hen kevasim haamurim bechomesh happekudim amarta kesheatta maggia etzel parim veelim enan hen ella hallalu bain biglal atzman vehallalu bain biglal lechem
Nimtza ma sheamur bechomesh happekudim karev bammidbar uma sheamur betorat kohanim lo karev bammidbar
Vedilma parim veelim lav inhu ha kevasim inhu ninhu middehane ishtanno hane name deacharine
Ufarim veelim mimmay deishtanno dilma hachi kaamar rachamana i bae par ushne elim likrav i bae shene parim veayil echad likrav middeishtanni sidran shema minah acharine ninhu
Hallechem meakkev et hakkevasim may tama derabbi akiva
Gamar yihu mittihyena
Ma lehallan lechem af kan lechem
Uven nannas gamar yihu yihu ma lehallan kevasim af kan kevasim
Uven nannas name nelaf mittihyena ma lehallan lechem af kan lechem danin yihu miyyihu veen danin yihu mittihyena
May nafka minah hatana deve rabbi yishmael veshav hakkohen uva hakkohen zehu shiva zehu bia
Hane mile hecha deleka dedame leh aval hecha deika dedame leh middedame leh yalfinan
Verabbi akiva name lelaf yihu miyyihu danin davar shemmattana lakkohen middavar shemmattana lakkohen leappoke hane deolot ninhu
Veibaet ema bikra gufeh ka mipalgi kodesh yihu la lakkohen rabbi akiva savar e zehu davar shekkullo lakkohen heve omer ze lechem
Uven nannas mi ketiv kodesh yihu lakkohen kodesh yihu la lakkohen ketiv ezehu davar shemmiktzato la umiktzato lakkohen heve omer ellu kevasim
Verabbi akiva mi ketiv kodesh yihu la velakkohen la lakkohen ketiv kidrav huna deamar rav huna kenao hashshem untano lakkohen
Amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim

a: Sheim huzkeku ze laze shemmeakkevin ze et ze veeze hu veezo hi zika shellahen shechita
Amar ulla bau bemareva tenufa osa zika o eno osa zika
Peshot leh midderabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan shechita osa zika mikkelal ditnufa enah osa zika
Derabbi yochanan gufa ka mibaya leh mifshat peshita leh lerabbi yochanan dishchita osa zika utnufa eno osa zika o dilma shechita peshita leh utnufa mesappeka leh teku
Amar leh rabbi yehuda bar chanina lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua veha ki ketiv kodesh yihu la lakkohen batar tenufa ketiv ufligi ben nannas verabbi akiva
Velitamach batar tenufa vela batar shechita
Ella may it lach lememra meikara kae umay kodesh yihu la lakkohen davar shessofo lakkohen hacha name davar shessofo lakkohen
Ushchita osa zika vrminhi ad shello shechatah nifras lachmah yavi lechem acher veshochet
Mishsheshshechatah nifras lachmah haddam yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel vide nidro lo yatza vehallechem pasul
Nizrak haddam torem min hashshalem al happarus
Ad shello shechatah yatza lachmah machnisah veshochet
Mishsheshshechatah yatza lachmah haddam yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel vide nidro lo yatza vehallechem pasul nizrak haddam torem mimma shebbifnim al shebbachutz
Ad shello shechatah nitma lachmah mevi lechem acher veshochet mishsheshshechatah nitma lachmah haddam yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel vide nidro yatza shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame vehallechem pasul
Nizrak haddam torem min hattahor al hattame
Vei salka datach shechita osa zika kevan dehuzkeku ze laze bishchita ipsil leh lechem tipsel name toda
Shane toda derachamana karyah shelamim ma shelamim kerevim belo lechem af toda kereva belo lechem
Amar rabbi yirmeya im timtza lomar tenufa osa zika avad hallechem
b: Avdu kevasim avdu kevasim avad hallechem
Veim timtza lomar tenufa enah osa zika hevi lechem uchvasim vehunfu veavad hallechem vehevi lechem acher oto hallechem taun tenufa o eno taun tenufa
Avdu kevasim la tibe lach devadday bae tenufa ki tibe lach avad hallechem
Vealliba deven nannas la tibe lach deamar kevasim ikar ki tibe lach alliba derabbi akiva deamar lechem ikar may
Kevan delechem ikar bae tenufa o dilma kevan demattirin dideh kevasim ninhu la tzerich tenufa teku
Amar leh abbaye lerava may shena shene kevasim dimkaddeshi lechem umakkevi umay shena shiva kevasim ufar veelim dela mekaddeshi lechem vela meakkevi
Amar leh hoil vehuzkeku ze laze bitnufa vahare toda delo huzkeku ze laze bitnufa umkaddesha umakkeva
Ella ketoda ma toda shelamim af hacha name shelamim
Mi dame hatam leka zevachim acharine bahadeh hacha deika zevachim acharine bahadeh likdeshu hane vehane
Ella keel nazir ma el nazir af al gav deika zevachim acharini shelamim hu dimkaddeshi mide acharina la hacha name la shena
Vehatam menalan detanya veet haayil yaase zevach shelamim la al sal hammatztzot melammed shehassal ba chova laayil ushchitat ayil mekaddeshan lefichach shechato shello lishmo lo kadasho hallechem
Tanu rabbanan shette hallechem habbaot bifne atzman yunfu utubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa
Ma nafshach i laachila atyan lechlinhu i lisrefa atyan lisrefinhu lealtar lema lehu ibur tzura
Amar rabba leolam laachila atyan gezera shemma yizdammenu lahen kevasim leshana habbaa veyomru eshtakad lo achalnu lechem belo kevasim achshav name nechol
Veinhu la yadi deeshtakad la hao kevasim inhu sharyan nafshayehu hashta deika kevasim kevasim hu desharu lehu
Amar rabba mena amena lah ditnan amar rabbi yehuda heid ben buchri beyavne kol kohen sheshshokel eno chote
Amar lo rabban yochanan ben zakkay lo chi ella kol kohen sheeno shokel chote ella shehakkohanim dorshin mikra ze leatzman
Vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel hoil veomer ushte hallechem velechem happanim shellanu hen heach neechalin
Hane shette hallechem hechi dame ilema bevaot im hazzevach attu toda velachmah mi la menaddevi kohanim veachli lehu
Ella lav bevaot bifne atzman vekatane heach hen neechalin alma laachila atyan
Amar leh abbaye leolam bevaot im hazzevach udka kashya lach mittoda velachmah lachme toda la ikru mincha shette hallechem ikru mincha shenneemar behakrivchem mincha chadasha la
Rav yosef amar leolam lisrefa atyan vehayenu tama dela sarfinan lefi sheen sorfin kadashim beom tov
Amar leh abbaye mi dame hatam lav mitzvatan bechach hacha demitzvatan bechach lisrefinhu mide dehave appar vesair shel yom hakkipurim
Ella amar rav yosef gezera shemma yizdammenu lahem kevasim leachar mikkan amar leh abbaye tinach kol zeman hakravatam levatar hachi lisrefinhu may teubbar tzuratan name dekatane tzurat hakravatam
Rava amar laachila atyan ugzera mishshum derabba velav mittameh ella mikkera

Veamar rava mena amena lah dichtiv mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa vego bikkurim la ma bikkurim bifne atzman af shette hallechem bifne atzman uminah ma bikkurim laachila af shette hallechem name laachila

a: Tanu rabbanan kivse atzeret en mekaddeshin et hallechem ella bishchita

Ketzad shechatan lishman vezarak daman lishman kadash hallechem shechatan shello lishman vezarak daman shello lishman lo kadash hallechem shechatan lishman vezarak daman shello lishman hallechem kadosh veeno kadosh divre rabbi rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer leolam eno kadosh ad sheyyishchot lishman veyizrok daman lishman
May tama derabbi
Dichtiv veet haayil yaase zevach shelamim la al sal hammatztzot lememra dishchita mekaddesha
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon yaase ad sheyyaase kal asiyyotav
Verabbi name hachtiv yaase i ketiv zevach yaase kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv yaase zevach bema yaase bizvicha
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon hachtiv zevach hahu mibe leh lechidrabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim shetztzarich sheyehe lechem bishat shechita
May kadosh veeno kadosh abbaye amar kadosh veeno gamur rava amar kadosh veeno nitar
May benayehu ika benayehu lemitpas pidono leabbaye la tafes pidono lerava tafes pidono
Bishlama lerava hayenu deika ben rabbi lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon ella leabbaye may ika ben rabbi lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon
Ika benayehu leipsole beotze
Bea mineh rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak merabbi chiyya bar abba kivse atzeret sheshshechatan lishman vezarak daman shello lishman oto hallechem mahu baachila
Alliba deman i alliba derabbi elazar berabbi shimon haamar zerika hi dimkaddesha i alliba derabbi ben leabbaye ben lerava kadosh veeno nitar hu

Ella alliba dehay tanna detane avuh derabbi yirmeya bar abba shette hallechem sheyyatzu ben shechita lizrika vezarak daman shel kevasim chutz lizmannan rabbi eliezer omer en ballechem mishshum pigul rabbi akiva omer yesh ballechem mishshum pigul
Amar rav sheshet hane tannae kerabbi sevira lehu deamar shechita mekaddesha
Mihu rabbi eliezer letameh deamar en zerika moelet layyotze verabbi akiva letameh deamar zerika moelet layyotze
b: Ditnan emure kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim rabbi eliezer omer en moalin bahen veen chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul venotar vetame
Rabbi akiva omer moalin bahen vechayyavin alehen mishshum pigul venotar vetame
May
Middizrikat pigul kava lelechem befigul beotze kevasar zerika shello lishmah name sharya leh lelechem o dilma lechumra amrinan lekulla la amrinan
Matkef lah rav pappa umimmay dechi itanhu abbaray peligi
Dilma biditanhu abbaray dechulle alma la peligi deen zerika moelet layyotze uvahadar ayelinhu peligi derabbi eliezer savar lah kerabbi deamar shechita mekaddesha veipsilu lehu beotze
Verabbi akiva kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon deamar shechita la mekaddesha vela mipasli beotze
Hay may i amratte bishlama rabbi akiva kerabbi sevira leh deamar shechita mekaddesha lehu hayenu dekaamar rabbi akiva dekadshi lehu bishchita veatya zerika kava lehu befigul
Ella i amratte kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon sevira leh deamar zevicha la mekaddesha zerikat pigul mi mekaddesha
Vehaamar rav gidel amar rav zerikat pigul enah mevia lide meila veenah motzia mide meila
Enah mevia lide meila beemure kadashim kallim
Veenah motzia mide meila bivsar kodshe kadashim
Lav itotav derav gidel amar rav
Bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera kivse atzeret sheshshechatan lishman veavad hallechem mahu sheyyizrok daman shello lishman lehattir basar baachila
Amar leh yesh lecha davar sheeno kasher lishmo vechasher shello lishmo vela vahare pesach kodem chatzot deeno kasher lishmo vechasher shello lishmo
Hachi ka amena yesh lach davar shennire lishmo venidche millishmo veeno kasher lishmo vechasher shello lishmo
Vela vahare pesach achar zemanno bishar yemot hashshana kodem chatzot
Hachi kaamena yesh lach davar shennire lishmo venishchat lishmo venidche millishmo veeno kasher lishmo vechasher shello lishmo
Vela vahare toda
Shane toda derachamana karyah shelamim
Tanu rabbanan shachat shene kevasim al arba challot moshech shettayim mehen umnifan

a: Vehashshear neechalot befidon amruha rabbanan kammeh derav chisda ha dela kerabbi
Dei rabbi kevan deamar shechita mekaddesha defarek lehu hecha
I defarek lehu meabbaray kevan dichtiv lifne Adonai ipsil lehu beotze i gavay ha meayyel chullin laazara
Amar lehu rav chisda leolam kerabbi ufarek lehu gavay vechullin mimmela ka haveyan
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe vehatanya keshehu podan en podan ella bachutz
Ha vadday rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi dei rabbi ha ipsilu lehu beotze

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe lema tehve teuvteh derabbi yochanan miha deitmar toda sheshshechatah al shemonim challot chizkiyya amar kadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim verabbi yochanan amar lo kadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim
Velav mi itmar alah amar rabbi zera hakkol modim hecha deamar likdeshu arbaim mittoch shemonim dekadsha hacha name deamar likdeshu tarte mittoch arba
Tane rabbi chanina tirata kammeh derabbi yochanan shachat arbaa kevasim al shette challot moshech shenayim mehen vezorek daman shello lishman
Sheim i atta omer kach hifsadta et haacharonim
Amar lo rabbi yochanan vechi omer lo leadam amod vachata bishvil shettizke
Vehatnan evre chattat shennitarvu beevre ola rabbi eliezer omer yuttenu lemala veroe ani et besar chattat lemala keilu hi etzim vachachamim omrim teubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa
Ammay lema amod vachata bishvil shettizke
Amod vachata bechattat bishvil shettizke bechattat amrinan amod vachata bechattat bishvil shettizke beola la amrinan
Uvachada milta mi amar veha tanya kivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello lishman o sheshshechatan ben lifne zemannan ben leachar zemannan haddam yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel
Veim hayeta shabbat lo yizrok veim zarak hurtza lehaktir emurin laerev
Veammay lema amod chata bishvil shettizke
Amod chata beshabbat kede shettizke beshabbat amrinan amod chata beshabbat kede shettizke bachol la amrinan
Uvtarte mile la amar vehatnan chavit shel teruma shennishbera begat haelona uvattachtona chullin temein mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora yatztzil
Veim lav rabbi eliezer omer
b: Tered vetittamme veal yetammeenna bayyad verabbi yehoshua omer af yetammeenna bayyad
Shane hatam diltuma ka azla
Ki ata rav yitzchak tane kivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello kemitzvatan pesulin utubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa
Amar rav nachman mar demakkesh lehu lechattat tane pesulin tana deve levi degamar shalme chova mishshalme nedava tane kesherim
Detane levi ushar shalme nazir sheshshechatan shello kemitzvatan kesherin velo alu labbealim leshem chova veneechalin leom valayela veen teunin lo lechem velo zeroa
Metivi asham ben shana vehevi ben shettayim ben shettayim vehevi ben shana pesulin utubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa
Aval olat nazir veolat yoledet veolat metzora shehau bene shette shanim ushchatan kesherin
Kelalo shel davar kol hakkasher beolat nedava kasher beolat chova vechol happasul bechattat pasul beasham chutz mishshello lishmo
Hay tanna tanna deve levi hu
Ta shema detane levi asham nazir vaasham metzora sheshshechatan shello lishman kesherim velo alu labbealim leshum chova
Shechatan mechussar zeman bivalim o shehau bene shette shanim ushchatan pesulin
Veim ita ligmar mishshelamim shelamim mishshelamim gamar asham mishshelamim la gamar
Vei gamar shelamim mishshelamim ligmar name asham measham asham nazir vaasham metzora measham gezelot vaasham meilot o asham gezelot vaasham meilot measham nazir vaasham metzora
Amar rav shimi bar ashe danin davar shello behechshero middavar shello behechshero veen danin davar shello behechshero middavar shebbehechshero
Vela veha tanya minnayin leotze sheim ala lo yered shehare yotze kasher bevama

a: Tena azzot torat haola riba semich leh
Tane rabba bar bar channa kammeh derav kivse atzeret sheshshechatan leshum elim kesherin velo alu labbealim leshum chova amar leh rav alu vealu
Amar rav chisda mistabbera milteh derav bichsavur elim ushchatan leshum kevasim shehare kevasim leshum kevasim nishchatu
Aval kesavur elim ushchatan leshum elim la akira betaut haveya akira verabba amar akira betaut la haveya akira
Amar rava umotvinan ashshematin hakkohanim sheppiglu bammikdash mezidin chayyavin ha shoggin peturin vetane alah pigulan pigul
Hechi dame ilema deyada dechattat hi veka mechashshev bah leshum shelamim hay shoggin mezidin hau
Ella lav dichsavur shelamim hu veka mechashshev bah leshum shelamim vekatane pigulan pigul alma akira betaut haveya akira
Amar leh abbaye leolam deyada dechattat hi veka mechashshev bah leshum shelamim uvomer muttar
Metiv rabbi zera rabbi shimon omer kol menachot shennikmetzu shello lishman kesherot vealu labbealim leshum chova
Sheen hammenachot domot lazzevachim shehakkometz machavat leshum marcheshet maaseha mochichin aleha shehi machavat chareva leshum belula maaseha mochichin aleha shehi chareva
Aval bizvachim eno ken shechita achat lechullan kabbala achat lechullan zerika achat lechullan
Hechi dame ilema deyada demachavat hi veka kametz lah leshum marcheshet ki maaseha mochichin may have ha mikar ka akar lah
Ella lav dichsavur marcheshet hi veka kametz lah leshum marcheshet uta dehacha hu demaaseha mochichin aleha ha bealma akira betaut haveya akira
Amar leh abbaye leolam deyada demachavat hi veka kametz lah leshum marcheshet
Udka amratte ki maaseha mochichin aleha may have rava letameh deamar rava machshava dela minachra pesal rachamana machshava deminachra la pesal rachamana
Matni hattemidin en meakkevin et hammusafin velo hammusafin meakkevin et hattemidin velo hammusafin meakkevin ze et ze lo hikrivu keves babboker yakrivu ben haarbayim
Amar rabbi shimon ematay bizman shehau anusin o shoggin aval im hau mezidin velo hikrivu keves babboker lo yakrivu ben haarbayim
Lo hiktiru ketoret babboker yaktiru ben haarbayim

Amar rabbi shimon vechullah hayeta kereva ben haarbayim sheen mechannechin et mizbach hazzahav ella biktoret hassammim velo mizbach haola ella betamid shel shachar velo et hashshulchan ella belechem happanim beshabbat velo et hammenora ella beshiva neroteha ben haarbayim
Gema bea mineh rabbi chiyya bar avin merav chisda tzibur sheen lahen temidin umusafin e ze mehen kodem
Hechi dame ilema temidin deomeh umusafin deomeh peshita temidin adifi dehau lehu tadir umkuddash
Ella temidin delimchar umusafin dehaidana temidin adifi shekken tadir o dilma musafin adifi dehau lehu mekuddash
Amar leh tenetuha hattemidin en meakkevin et hammusafin velo hammusafin meakkevin et hattemidin velo hammusafin meakkevin ze et ze
Hechi dame ilema deit leh ulkaddem vehatanya minnayin shello yehe davar kodem letamid shel shachar talmud lomar vearach aleha haola
Veamar rava haola ola rishona
b: Ella peshita delet leh vei deomeh ammay tadir umkuddash tadir adif
Ella lav delimchar vekatane en meakkevin ze et ze alma ki hadade ninhu
Amar leh abbaye leolam deit lehu ulkaddem udka kashya lach shello yehe davar kodem mitzva bealma hu
Ta shema en pochatin mishshishsha telaim hamvukkarin belishkat hattelaim kede lashshabbat velishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana
Hechi dame ilema deit leh temidin umusafin tuva hao
Ella lav delet leh ushma minah temidin adifi
La leolam deit leh vehachi ka amar en pochatin mishshishsha telaim hamvukkarin belishkat hattelaim arbaa yamim kodem shechita umanni ben bag bag hi
Detanya ben bag bag omer minnayin letamid shettaun bikur arbaa yamim kodem shechita talmud lomar tishmeru lehakriv li bemoado ulhallan hu omer vehaya lachem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar yom
Ma lehallan taun bikur arbaa yamim kodem shechita af kan taun bikur arbaa yamim kodem shechita
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe hane shishsha shiva hau deha ika detzafra ditlata beshabbeta
Ultamach temanya hau dehaika defanya demaale shabbeta
Ha la kashya dilvatar deakrev kaamar

a: Mikkol makom shiva hau ella tanna bealma kae umay kede lashshabbat ushne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana simana bealma
Dayeka name dekatane kede lashshabbat vela katane leshabbat velishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana shema minah
Lo hikrivu keves babboker vechu amar rabbi shimon vechullah hayeta kereva ben haarbayim sheen mechannechin et mizbach hazzahav ella biktoret hassammim chinuch man dechar shemeh
Chassore michassera vehachi katane lo hikrivu keves babboker lo yakrivu ben haarbayim bamme devarim amurim shello nitchannech hammizbeach aval nitchannech hammizbeach yakrivu ben haarbayim
Amar rabbi shimon ematay bizman shehau anusin o shoggin aval im hau mezidin lo hikrivu keves babboker lo yakrivu ben haarbayim lo hiktiru ketoret babboker yaktiru ben haarbayim
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim sheni ben haarbayim velo rishon ben haarbayim
Bamme devarim amurim shello nitchannech hammizbeach aval nitchannech hammizbeach afilu rishon ben haarbayim
Amar rabbi shimon ematay bizman shehau anusin o shoggin aval im hau mezidin lo hikrivu keves babboker lo yakrivu ben haarbayim lo hiktiru ketoret babboker yaktiru ben haarbayim
Vechi chohanim chatu mizbeach batel amar rava hachi kaamar lo yakrivu hen aval acherim yakrivu
Lo hiktiru ketoret babboker yaktiru ben haarbayim dechevan dela shechicha umattera chaviva lehu vela pashi
Amar rabbi shimon vechullah hayeta kereva ben haarbayim sheen mechannechin et mizbach hazzahav ella biktoret hassammim shel ben haarbayim vechu vehatanya biktoret hassammim shel shachar tannae hi
Amar abbaye mistabbera keman deamar biktoret hassammim shel ben haarbayim dichtiv babboker babboker behetivo et hannerot yaktirenna
I lav daavad hadlaka meurta hatava betzafra mehecha
Ulman deamar biktoret hassammim shel shachar gamar mimmizbach haola ma lehallan betamid shel shachar af kan biktoret hassammim shel shachar
Velo et hashshulchan ella belechem happanim beshabbat ella bechol ichannoche hu dela michannach ha kaddoshe mekaddesh
Hi gufah ka mashma lan dechinuch vekidush deshulchan beshabbat hu kidkatane sefa velo et hammenora ella beshiva neroteha ben haarbayim
Tanu rabbanan zehu zohi ketoret shealta leyachid al mizbeach hachitzon vehoraat shaa hayeta hecha amar rav pappa bannesiim
Ella yachid al mizbeach hachitzon hu dela ha al mizbeach happenimi makrev vetu al mizbeach hachitzon yachid hu dela ha tzibur makrevi
Vehatanya yachol yehe yachid mitnaddev umevi keotze bah nedava vekore ani bah motza sefatecha tishmor veasita talmud lomar lo taalu alav ketoret zara
Yachol lo yehe yachid mevi sheen mevi chovato keotze bah
b: Aval tzibbur yehe mevi shemmevi chova keotze bah talmud lomar lo taalu

Yachol lo yaalu al mizbeach happenimi aval yaalu al mizbeach hachitzon talmud lomar et shemen hammishcha veet ketoret hassammim lakkodesh kechol asher tziviticha yaasu en lecha ella ma sheamur bainyan

Amar rav pappa la mibaya kaamar la mibaya tzibur al mizbeach hachitzon dela ashkechan vela mibaya yachid al mizbeach happenimi dela ashkechan ella afilu yachid al mizbeach hachitzon deashkechan binsiim horaat shaa hayeta
Matni chavite kohen gadol lo hau bain chatzain ella mevi issaron shalem vechotzehu makriv mechetza babboker umechetza ben haarbayim

Kohen shemmevi mechetza shacharit vamet uminu kohen acher tachtav lo yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto vachatzi esrono shel rishon ella mevi issaron shalem mechetza vechotzehu makriv mechetza umechetza aved nimtzeu shene chatzain kerevin ushne chatzain ovdin
Gema tanu rabbanan ilu neemar mincha machatzit hayiti omer mevi chatzi issaron mibbeto shacharit umakriv chatzi issaron mibbeto arvit umakriv
Talmud lomar machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baarev mechetza mishshalem hu makriv ha ketzad mevi issaron shalem vechotzehu umakriv mechetza babboker umechetza ben haarbayim
Nitma mechetza shel ben haarbayim o sheavad yachol yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto arvit veyakriv talmud lomar machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baarev mechetza mishshalem hu mevi
Ha ketzad mevi issaron shalem mibbeto vechotzehu umakriv mechetza umechetza aved nimtzeu shene chatzain kerevin ushne chatzain ovdin
Kohen gadol shehikriv mechetza shacharit vamet uminu acher tachtav yachol yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto o chatzi esrono shel rishon talmud lomar umachatzitah baarev mechetza mishshalem hu mevi umakriv
Ha ketzad mevi issaron shalem vechotzehu umakriv umechetza aved nimtzeu shene chatzain ovdin ushne chatzain kerevin
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman mechetza rishon umechetza sheni teubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa
Amar leh rav nachman bishlama rishon ichazi lehakrava ella sheni lema leh ibur tzura meikara leibud ka ate
Daamar lach manni tanna deve rabba bar avuh hu deamar afilu pigul taun ibur tzura
Rav ashe amar afilu tema rabbanan kevan dividana defalgi behu defalginhu i bae hay makrev vei bae hay makrev michza chazu
Itmar chavite kohen gadol ketzad osin otan rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan ofah veachar kach metaggenah rabbi assi amar rabbi chanina metaggenah veachar kach ofah
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba kevateh didi mistabbera tufine tofena naa rabbi assi amar kevateh didi mistabbera tufine tofena na
Ketannae tufine tofena na rabbi omer tofena naa rabbi yose omer tofena rabba it leh na veit leh naa
Tenan hatam chavite kohen gadol lishatan vaarichatan vaafiyyatan bifnim vedochot et hashshabbat
Mena hane mile amar rav huna tufine tofena naa vei afe lah meetmol inashfa lah matkef lah rav yosef ema dechavesh leh beyarka
Deve rabbi yishmael tana tease vaafilu beshabbat tease vaafilu betuma
Abbaye amar amar kera solet mincha tamid

a: Hare hi keminchat temidin
Rava amar al machavat melammed shetteuna keli vei afe lah meetmol ipsila lah belina tanya kevateh derava al machavat melammed shetteuna keli
Bashshemen lehosif lah shemen veeni yodea kamma
Hareni dan neemar kan shemen veneemar lehallan beminchat nesachim shemen ma lehallan sheloshet luggin leissaron af kan sheloshet luggin leissaron
O kelach lederech zo neemar kan shemen veneemar beminchat nedava shemen ma lehallan log echad af kan log echad
Nire lemi dome danin tadir baa chova docha shabbat docha tuma
Veen danin mishsheeno
O kelach lederech zo danin yachid biglal atzmah yayin levona
Veen danin mishsheeno
Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer solet mincha tamid hare hi lecha keminchat temidin ma minchat temidin shelosha luggin leissaron af zo shelosha luggin leissaron
Rabbi shimon omer riba kan shemen veriba beminchat kevasim shemen ma lehallan sheloshet luggin leissaron af kan sheloshet luggin leissaron
O kelach lederech zo riba kan shemen veriba beminchat parim veelim shemen ma lehallan shene luggin leissaron af kan shene luggin leissaron
Nire lemi dome danin mincha habbaa issaron mimmincha habbaa beissaron veen danin mincha habbaa issaron mimmincha habbaa shenayim ushlosha esronim
Ha gufa kashya amratte bashshemen lehosif lah shemen vahadar tane neemar kan shemen veneemar beminchat nedava shemen
Amar abbaye man tena bashshemen lehosif rabbi shimon hi veilu lo neemar kaamar uvdina man ka mahdar rabbi yishmael
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar kullah rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi
Vehachi kaamar bashshemen lehosif lah shemen dei likboa shemen la tzerich kevan dichtiv bah al machavat keminchat machavat damya
O eno ella likboa lah shemen dei la ketav rachamana bashshemen hava amena tehve keminchat chote
Hadar amar tihve name likboa lah shemen tete middina vedan dina vela atya leh veatzrechah kera solet mincha tamid kedimsayyem rabbi yishmael milteh
Rabba amar kullah rabbi shimon veilu lo neemar kaamar
Vehachi kaamar bashshemen lehosif lah shemen dei likboa lah shemen la tzerich kevan dichtiv bah al machavat kemachavat damya vead shello yeamer bashshemen yesh li baddin
Vedan dina la atya leh veatzrechah bashshemen hadar amar tehve keminchat parim veelim
Hadar amar danin
b: Mincha habbaa issaron vechu
Matni lo minu kohen acher tachtav mishshel mi hayeta kereva rabbi shimon omer mishshel tzibur rabbi yehuda omer mishshel yorshin ushlema hayeta kereva
Gema tanu rabbanan kohen gadol shemmet velo minu kohen acher tachtav minnayin shettehe minchato kereva mishshel yorshin talmud lomar vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav yaase otah
Yachol yakrivenna chatzain talmud lomar otah kullah velo chetzyah divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi shimon omer chok olam mishshel olam kalil toktar shettehe kullah behaktara
Vehay hakkohen hammashiach lehachi hu daata

Hay mibe leh lechidtanya ze korban aharon uvanav asher yakrivu la beom himmashach oto yachol yehu aharon uvanav makrivin korban echad talmud lomar asher yakrivu la aharon bifne atzmo uvanav bifne atzman banav ellu kohanim hedotot
Atta omer kohanim hedotot o eno ella kohanim gedolim keshehu omer vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav hare kohen gadol amur ha ma ani mekayyem banav ellu kohanim hedotot
Im ken lichtov kera hakkohen hammashiach tachtav banav yaase may mibbanav shamatte minah tarte
Verabbi shimon hay otah may aved leh mibe leh lechohen gadol shemmet uminu acher tachtav shello yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto velo chatzi issaron shel rishon
Vetipok leh min umachatzitah vav la daresh
Verabbi yehuda hay chok olam may aved leh chukka leolam tehe
Kalil toktar lema li mibe leh lechidtanya en li ella elona minchat kohen gadol bechalil toktar vetachtona minchat kohen hedot belo teachel
Minnayin liten et haamur shel ze baze veet haamur shel ze baze talmud lomar kalil kalil ligzera shava neemar kan kalil veneemar lehallan kalil
Ma kan bechalil toktar af lehallan bechalil toktar uma lehallan liten lo taase al achilato af kan liten lo taase al achilatah
Vesavar rabbi shimon mishshel tzibur deorayeta
Vehatnan amar rabbi shimon shiva devarim hitkinu bet din veze echad mehen goy sheshshalach olato mimmedinat hayyam shalach immah nesachim kereva kerevin mishshello veim lav kerevin mishshel tzibur
Vechen ger shemmet vehinniach zevachim yesh lo nesachim kerevin mishshello veim lav kerevin mishshel tzibur
Utnay bet din hu kohen gadol shemmet velo minu kohen acher tachtav shettehe minchato kereva mishshel tzibur
Amar rabbi avahu shene shette takkanot hao
Deorayeta middetzibur kevan dachazo deka midachka lishka takkinu deligbe miyyorshim kevan dachazo deka fashi bah okmuha addeorayeta
Veal para shello yehu moalin beefrah deorayeta hi detanya chattat hi melammed shemmoalin bah hi bah moalin

a: Beefrah en moalin
Amar rav ashe shette takkanot havay deorayeta bah moalin beefrah en moalin kevan dachazo deka mezalzeli bah veka avdi mineh lemakkatan gezaru beh meila
Kevan dachazo deka parshi missefek hazzaot okmuha addeorayeta
Tanu rabbanan par helem davar shel tzibur usire avoda zara battechila magbin lahen divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer mitterumat hallishka hen bain
Vehatanya ipcha he minayehu achrita
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav ashe lema kammayeta achrita deshaminan leh lerabbi shimon dechayesh lifshia
Amar lehu rav ashe afilu tema batrayeta achrita ki ka chayesh rabbi shimon lifshia milta delet behu kappara begavah bemilta deit lehu kappara begavah la chayesh rabbi shimon lifshia
May have alah

Amar leh rabba zute lerav ashe ta shema detanya et korbani lachmi leishshay reach nichochi tishmeru lehakriv li bemoado lerabbot par helem davar shel tzibur usire avoda zara shebbain mitterumat hallishka divre rabbi shimon
Ushlema hayeta kereva vechu amar rabbi chiyya bar abba bae rabbi yochanan shelema shacharit ushlema ben haarbayim o dilma shelema shacharit uvtela ben haarbayim
Amar rava ta shema shemini bachavitim veim ita divtela ben haarbayim ha zimnin dela mashkach leh shemini bachavitim hechi dame demet kohen gadol velo minu acher tachtav
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derabbi yirmeya amar bavlae tafshae mishshum deyatvu deyatvi beatra dachashocha amri shematata dimchashshechan
Ella dekatane shevii bassolet teshii bayyayin hachi name dela batli
Minchatam veniskehem ballayela minchatam veniskehem afilu lemachar
Ella dei la katane hachi name dei la katane
Ahderuha kammeh derava amar mibbishutin amri kammayehu mittevutin la amri kammayehu
Vhadar amar rava hane name tevutin hi amar kera solet mincha tamid hare hi lecha keminchat temidin
May have alah amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ta shema detanya shelema shacharit ushlema ben haarbayim
Amar rabbi yochanan peligi bah abba yose ben dostay verabbanan
Abba yose ben dostay omer mafrish lah shene kematzim shel levona kometz shacharit vekometz ben haarbayim verabbanan amri mafrish lah kometz echad chatzi kometz shacharit vachatzi kometz ben haarbayim
Bemay kamipalgi abba yose ben dostay savar la ashkechan chatzi kometz dekarev verabbanan savri la ashkechan issaron devae shene kematzim
Bae rabbi yochanan kohen gadol shemmet velo minu acher tachtav
b: Lerabbanan huchpela levonato o la mi amrinan mittoch shehuchpela solto huchpela levonato o dilma may degalli galli may dela galli la galli
Veshemen ben leabba yose ben dostay uven lerabbanan mahu
Amar rava ta shema chamishsha kematzin hen veim ita zimnin demashkachatte lah shiva
Dei la katane yatev rav pappa vekaamar lah leha shemata amar leh rav yosef bar shemaya lerav pappa veha maale kometz bachutz dei hava vekatane

May have alah amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ta shema detanya kohen gadol shemmet velo minu acher tachtav shelema shacharit ushlema ben haarbayim umafrish lah shene kematzin kometz shacharit vekometz ben haarbayim umafrish lah sheloshet luggin log umechetza shacharit log umechetza ben haarbayim
Manni ilema rabbanan may shena levonatah dehuchpela umay shena shamnah delo huchpela
Ella abba yose ben dostay hi deamar chavite kohen gadol bealma shene kematzin baaya ulvona lo huchpela veshemen lo huchpal
Umiddeshemen leabba yose ben dostay lo huchpela levonatah veshamnah lerabbanan name la huchpelu
Amar rabbi yochanan halacha keabba yose ben dostay umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi veha amar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna utnan chamishsha kematzin hen
Amorae ninhu vealliba derabbi yochanan
Hadaran alach hattechelet
Matni kol hammenachot baot matztza chutz mechametz shebbattoda ushte hallechem shehen baot chametz
Rabbi meir omer hasseor bode lahen mittochan umchammetzan
Rabbi yehuda omer af hi enah min hammuvchar ella mevi et hasseor venotno letoch hammidda ummalle et hammidda amru lo af hi hayeta chasera o yetera
Gema bea mineh rabbi perida merabbi amme minnayin lechol hammenachot shehen baot matztza menalan dichtiv bah ketiv bah dela ketiv bah ketiv bah

a: Zot torat hammincha hakrev otah bene aharon lifne Adonai el pene hammizbeach vehannoteret mimmenna yochlu aharon uvanav matztzot teachel amar leh mitzva la ka mibaya li ki ka mibaya li leakkev
Amar leh leakkev name ketiv lo teafe chametz ella matztza
Matkef lah rav chisda veema lo teafe chametz ella siur
Siur deman i derabbi meir lerabbi yehuda matztza mealleya hi i derabbi yehuda lerabbi meir chametz mealleya hu
I derabbi meir lerabbi meir middelake aleh chametz hu ella derabbi yehuda lerabbi yehuda
Matkef lah rav nachman bar yitzchak veema lo teafe chametz ella chalut chalut may nihu revicha i deika revucha ketiv bah revucha veha la ketiv bah revucha
Veema dichtiv bah revucha mitzva birvucha udla ketiv bah revucha i bae revucha layete i bae matztza layete
Matkef lah ravina veema lo teafe chametz lemekam gavra belav bealma veipsole la mipasla
Ella menalan kidtanya matztza yachol mitzva talmud lomar tihye hakkatuv kevaah chova
Bea minah rabbi perida merabbi amme minnayin lechol hammenachot shenniloshot befoshrin umshammeran shello yachamitzu nilmedenna mippesach dichtiv ushmartem et hammatztzot
Amar leh begufah ketiv matztza tihye hachyeha
Veha appekteh leakkev im ken lichtov kera matztza hi may tihye shamatte minah tarte
Amri leh rabbanan lerabbi perida rabbi ezra bar bereh derabbi avtolas dehu asiri lerabbi elazar ben azarya dehu asiri leezra kae abbava amar may kulle hay
I bar oryan hu yae i bar oryan uvar avahan yae vei bar avahan vela bar oryan isha techleh amaru leh bar oryan hu amar lehu leul velete
Chazyeh dahava achira dateh petach vaamar amarte la adonay atta tovati bal alecha amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam hachazek li tova shehodaticha baolam
Amar lah tovati bal alecha eni machzik tova ella leavraham yitzchak veyaakov shehodiuni techilla baolam shenneemar likdoshim asher baaretz hemma veaddire kol cheftzi vam
Kevan deshameh dekaamar addir patach veamar yavo addir veyippara leaddirim meaddirim beaddirim

Yavo addir ze hakkadosh baruch hu dichtiv addir bammarom Adonai veyippara leaddirim ellu yisrael shenneemar veaddire kol cheftzi vam meaddirim ellu hammitzrim dichtiv tzalalu kaoferet bemayim addirim beaddirim ellu mayim shenneemar mikkolot mayim rabbim addirim mishbere yam
Yavo yadid ben yadid veyivne yadid leyadid bechelko shel yadid veyitkapperu bo yedidim
Yavo yadid ze shelomo hammelech dichtiv vayyishlach beyad natan hannavi vayyikra shemo yedidyah baavur Adonai
b: Ben yadid ze avraham dichtiv me lididi beveti veyivne yadid ze bet hammikdash dichtiv ma yedidot mishkenotecha leyadid ze hakkadosh baruch hu dichtiv ashira na lididi
Bechelko shel yadid ze binyamin shenneemar levinyamin amar yedid Adonai yishkon lavetach alav veyitkapperu bo yedidim ellu yisrael dichtiv natatti et yedidut nafshi bechaf oyeveha

Yavo tov vikabbel tov mittov lattovim yavo tov ze moshe dichtiv vattere oto ki tov hu vikabbel tov zo tora dichtiv ki lekach tov natatti lachem mittov ze hakkadosh baruch hu dichtiv tov Adonai lakkol lattovim ellu yisrael dichtiv hetiva Adonai lattovim

Yavo ze vikabbel zot mizze leam zu yavo ze ze moshe dichtiv ki ze moshe haish vikabbel zot zo hattora dichtiv vezot hattora asher sam moshe mizze ze hakkadosh baruch hu dichtiv ze eli veanvehu leam zo ellu yisrael shenneemar am zu kanita
Amar rabbi yitzchak beshaa shecharav bet hammikdash metzao hakkadosh baruch hu leavraham shehaya omed bevet hammikdash amar lo me lididi beveti
Amar lo al iske banay bati amar lo banecha chatu vegalu amar lo shemma beshogeg chatu amar lo asotah hammezimmata amar lo shemma miutan chatu amar lo harabbim
Haya lecha lizkor berit mila amar lo uvsar kodesh yaavru mealayich amar lo shemma im himtanta lahem hau chozrin bitshuva amar lo ki raatechi az taalozi

Miyyad hinniach yadav al rosho vehaya tzoek uvoche veamar lo shemma chas veshalom en lahem takkana yatzta bat kol veamra lo zayit raanan yefe feri toar kara Adonai shemech ma zayit zo ze acharito besofo af yisrael acharitan besofan

Lekol hamulla gedola hitztzit esh aleha verau daliyyotav amar rabbi chinana bar pappa lekol milehen shel meraggelim nitroau daliyyotehen shel yisrael deamar rabbi chinana bar pappa davar gadol dibberu meraggelim beotah shaa ki chazak hu mimmenu al tikre mimmenu ella mimmennu kivyachol sheafilu baal habbayit eno yachol lehotzi kelav mishsham

Matkef lah rabbi chiyya berabbi chinana hay lekol hamulla gedola lekol milla mibaya leh ella amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu leavraham kolcha shamati vechamalti alehem ani amarti yishtabedu bearba malchiyyot kol achat veachat keshiur arba malchiyyot
Hashta kol chada vachada may difsik lah veika deamri ani amarti beze achar ze achshav bevat achat

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi lamma nimshelu yisrael lezayit lomar lecha ma zayit en alav noshrin lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim af yisrael en lahem betela olamit lo baolam hazze velo baolam habba veamar rabbi yochanan lamma nimshelu yisrael lezayit lomar lecha ma zayit eno motzi shamno ella al yede ketita af yisrael en chozrin lemutav ella al yede yissurin
Rabbi meir omer hasseor bode lahen mittochan umchammetzan vechu may chasera o yetera
Amar rav chisda isat hasseor ave nimtzet yetera middat haissaron rakka nimtzet chasera
Sof sof ki ka chayel leissaron ka chayel
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu lichmot shehen hayeta meshaarinan
Velishkol purta mineh velachmetzeh meabbaray velayeteyah venilusheh bahadeh gezera dilma ate leetoye mealma
Tanu rabbanan en machmitzin

a: Betappuchim mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel amru machmitzin rav kahana matne lah berabbi chanina ben teradon
Keman azla ha ditnan tappuach sherisko untano betoch haisa vechimtza hare zo asura
Keman lema rabbi chanina ben gamliel hi vela rabbanan afilu tema rabbanan nehi dechametz gamur la have nukshe miha have
Amar rabbi ila en lecha hakkasha likmitza yoter mimminchat chote rav yitzchak bar avdimi amar minchat chote megabbelah bammayim uchshera
Lema beha ka mipalgi demar savar kemot shehen meshaarinan umar savar lichmot shehau meshaarinan
La dechulle alma kemot shehen meshaarinan uvha ka mipalgi demar savar may chareva chareva mishshemen umar savar chareva mikkol davar
Tenan hatam besar haegel shennitpach uvsar zekena shennitmaech mishtaarin lichmot shehen
Rav verabbi chiyya verabbi yochanan amri mishtaarin kemot shehen shemuel verabbi shimon bar rabbi veresh lakish amri mishtaarin lichmot shehen
Metivi besar haegel shello haya bo keshiur vetafach veamad al keshiur tahor lesheavar vetame mikan ulhabba
Midderabbanan
I hachi ema sefa vechen befigul vechen benotar i amratte bishlama deorayeta hayenu deika pigul venotar ella i amratte derabbanan pigul venotar bidrabbanan mi ika
Ema vechen betumat pigul vechen betumat notar
Salka datach amena hoil vetumat pigul vetumat notar derabbanan hi kulle hay bidrabbanan la avud rabbanan ka mashma lan
Ta shema besar zekena shehaya bo keshiur vetzamak pachot mikkeshiur tame lesheavar vetahor mikan ulhabba
Amar rabba kol hecha demeikara hava beh vehashta let beh ha let beh vechol hecha demeikara la hava beh vehashta hava beh midderabbanan
b: Ki peligi kegon shehaya bo keshiur vetzamak vechazar vetafach demar savar yesh dichuy beisura umar savar en dichuy beisura

Umi ika leman deamar deyesh dichuy beisurin vehatnan kevetza ochalin shehinnichan bachamma venitmaatu vechen kezayit min hammet kezayit min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz uchzayit pigul uchzayit notar uchzayit chelev tehorin veen chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul venotar vachelev
Hinnichan baggeshamim vetafchu temein vechayyavin alehem mishshum pigul venotar vachelev teuvta leman deamar yesh dichuy beisurin teuvta
Ta shema tormin teenim al haggerogrot beminyan
I amratte bishlama lichmot shehen meshaarinan shappir ella i amratte kemot shehen have leh marbe bemaasrot
Utnan hammarbe bemaasrot perotav metukkanim vmaserotav mekulkalin
Ella may lichmot shehen ema sefa gerogrot al hatteenim bemidda
I amratte bishlama kemot shehen shappir ella i amratte lichmot shehen marbe bemaasrot hu
Ella hacha bitruma gedola askinan veresha beayin yafa vesefa beayin yafa hi
I hachi ema sefa amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose abba haya notel eser gerogrot shebbammaktzua al tishim shebbakkalkalla vei bitruma gedola eser may avidteh

Ella hacha bitrumat maaser askinan veabba elazar ben gomel hu detanya abba elazar ben gomel omer venechshav lachem terumatchem bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber achat teruma gedola veachat terumat maaser
Keshem shetteruma gedola nitelet beomed uvmachshava kach terumat maaser nitelet beomed

a: Uvmachshava ma teruma gedola beayin yafa af terumat maaser beayin yafa

Uminah amar rabbi elazar bar rabbi yose abba haya notel eser gerogrot shebbammaktzua al tishim shebbakkalkalla i amratte bishlama lichmot shehen amrinan shappir ella i amratte kemot shehen batzar lehu
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi elazar shane gerogrot hoil veyachol lesholkan ulhachziran lichmot shehen
Tanu rabbanan tormin teenim al haggerogrot bimkom shergilin laasot teenim gerogrot velo gerogrot al teenim vaafilu bimkom shergilin laasot teenim gerogrot
Amar mar tormin teenim al haggerogrot bimkom shergilin laasot teenim gerogrot bimkom shergilin in bimkom sheen regilin la
Hechi dame i deika kohen makom sheeno ragil ammay la vehatnan mekom sheyyesh kohen torem min hayyafe

Ella peshita deleka kohen ema sefa velo gerogrot al hatteenim vaafilu bimkom sheragil laasot teenim gerogrot vei deleka kohen ammay la vehatnan mekom sheen kohen torem min hammitkayyem ella peshita deika kohen
Resha deleka kohen sefa deika kohen in resha deleka kohen sefa deika kohen
Amar rav pappa shema minah dachakinan umokminan matnitin bitre tame vela mokminan bitre tannae

Matni kol hammenachot niloshot befoshrin umshammeran shello yachmitzu veim hechmitzu sheyareha over belo taase shenneemar kol hammincha asher takrivu la lo tease chametz vechayyav al lishatah veal arichatah veal afiyyatah
Gema mena hane mile amar resh lakish deamar kera lo teafe chametz chelkam afilu chelkam lo teafe chametz
Vehay lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh lechidtanya lo
b: Teafe chametz ma talmud lomar vahalo kevar neemar lo tease chametz lefi shenneemar lo tease chametz yachol lo yehe chayyav ella achat al kullam talmud lomar lo teafe
Afiyya bakkelal hayata lamma yatzat lehakkish eleha ma afiyya meuchedet shehi maase yechidi vechayyavin aleha bifne atzmah af ani avi lishatah vaarichatah
Vechol maase yechidi shebbah leetoye kituf shehu maase yechidi vechayyavin aleha bifne atzmah
Anan mechelkam kaamrinan
Veema kulleh lehachi hu daata
Im ken lichtov chelkam lo teafe chametz may lo teafe chametz chelkam shamatte minah tarte

Veema afiyya difrat bah rachamana lichayyav chada inach lichayyav chada akkullehu mishshum dehave davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza min hakkelal lelammed lo lelammed al atzmo yatza ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza
Veema lo tease kalal lo teafe parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat afiyya in mide acharina la
Amar rabbi aftoriki mishshum dehave kelal ufrat hamruchakin ze mizze vechol kelal ufrat hamruchakin ze mizze en danin otan bichlal ufrat

Metiv rav adda bar ahava veamri lah kedi uchlal ufrat hamruchakin ze mizze en danin otan bichlal ufrat vehatanya veshachat oto bimkom asher yishchat haola lifne Adonai chattat hu hechan ola nishchetet batztzafon af ze batztzafon
Vechi anu mikkan lemedin vahalo kevar neemar bimkom asher tishshachet haola tishshachet hachattat ha lema ze yatza lekovo sheim lo shachat oto batztzafon pesalo
Atta omer lechach yatzat o eno ella shezze taun tzafon veen acher taun tzafon talmud lomar veshachat et hachattat bimkom asher yishchat et haola ze bana av lechol chattaot shetteunot tzafon
Tama dichtav rachamana veshachat et hachattat ha lav hachi hava amena shezze taun tzafon veen acher taun tzafon may tama
Lav mishshum dehave kelal ufrat veaf al gav dimruchakin ze mizze danin otan bichlal ufrat
Matkef lah rav ashe hay kelal ufrat hu perat uchlal hu venaasa kelal mosif al happerat veitrabbi veitrabbo lehu kol mile
Ella tanna oto ka kashya leh vehachi kaamar o eno ella shezze taun tzafon veen acher taun tzafon dichtav rachamana oto
Vehashta denafka leh miveshachat et hachattat oto lemaote may lemaote nachshon veshachat of bappesach siman
Oto batztzafon veen sair nachshon batztzafon
Salka datach amena hoil veitrabbi leinyan semicha litrabbe name leinyan tzafon ka mashma lan
Usmicha gufah menalan detanya vesamach yado al rosh hassair lerabbot seir nachshon lismicha divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer

a: Lerabbot seire avoda zara lismicha
Matkef lah ravina tinach lerabbi yehuda lerabbi shimon may ika lememar
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina lerabbi yehuda name may deitrabbi itrabbi may dela itrabbi la itrabbi
Vechi tema i la maateh kera hava amena tete bevinyan av semicha gufah lishtok kera mineh vetete bevinyan av ella shaa middorot la yalfinan hacha name shaa middorot la yalfinan
Ella oto taun tzafon veen hashshochet omed batztzafon
Midderabbi achiyya nafka detanya rabbi achiyya omer veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona ma talmud lomar

Lefi shemmatzinu bimkabbel sheomed batztzafon umkabbel batztzafon veim amad bedarom vekibel batztzafon pasul yachol af ze ken talmud lomar oto oto batztzafon velo hashshochet tzarich lihot omed batztzafon
Ella oto batztzafon veen ben of batztzafon salka datach amena lete bekal vachomer mibben tzon uma ben tzon shella kava lo kohen kava lo tzafon ben of shekkava lo kohen eno din shennikba lo tzafon
Ma leven tzon shekken kava lo keli
Ella oto batztzafon veen pesach batztzafon pesach midderabbi eliezer ben yaakov nafka

Detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer yachol yehe happesach taun tzafon vedin hu uma ola shella kava lah zeman bishchitatah kava lah tzafon pesach shekkava lo zeman lishchitato eno din shekkava lo tzafon
Ma leola shekken kalil
Mechattat ma lechattat shekken mechapperet al chayyave charetot
Measham ma leasham shekken kodshe kadashim mikkullehu name shekken kodshe kadashim

Ella leolam kidkaamrinan meikara oto batztzafon veen hashshochet batztzafon udka kashya lach midderabbi achiyya nafka derabbi achiyya lav lemaote shochet batztzafon hu daata ella hachi kaamar en hashshochet betzafon aval mekabbel batztzafon
Mekabbel millakach velakach nafka lakach velakach la mashma leh

Vechayyav al lishatah veal arichatah veal afiyyatah amar rav pappa afaah loke shettayim achat al arichatah veachat al afiyyatah veha amratte ma afiyya meuchedet shehi maase yechidi vechayyavin aleha bifne atzmah
La kashya ha daaracha hu vaafa hu ha daaracha chavreh vihav leh vaafa
Tanu rabbanan bechor sheachazo dam makkizin oto et haddam bimkom sheen osin bo mum veen makkizin et haddam bimkom sheosin bo mum divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim yakkiz af bimkom sheosin bo mum uvilvad shello yishchot al oto mum rabbi shimon omer
b: Af nishchat al oto mum rabbi yehuda omer afilu met en makkizin lo et haddam
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim bimchammetz achar mechammetz shehu chayyav dichtiv lo tease chametz velo teafe chametz
Bimsares acher mesares shehu chayyav dichtiv umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut im al koret hu chayyav al notek lo kol shekken ella lehavi notek achar koret shehu chayyav
Lo nechleku ella bemetil mum bevaal mum rabbi meir savar kol mum lo yihye bo verabbanan savri tamim yihye leratzon
Verabbi meir name hachtiv tamim yihye leratzon hahu lemaote baal mum meikara
Baal mum meikara dikla bealma hu
Ella lemaote pesule hammukdashim leachar pidonam salka datach amena hoil vaasiri begiza vaavoda bemumam name litasri litasru ka mashma lan

Verabbanan name hachtiv kol mum lo yihye bo hahu mibe leh lechidtanya vechol mum lo yihye bo en li ella shello yehe bo mum minnayin shello yigrom lo al yede acherim shello yanniach batzek o devela al gabbe haozen kede sheyyavo hakkelev veyittelennu talmud lomar kol mum amar mum veamar kol mum
Amar rabbi amme hinniach seor al gabbe isa vehalach veyashav lo venitchammetza meeleha chayyav aleha kemaase shabbat umaase shabbat ki hay gavena mi michayyav vehaamar rabba bar bar chana

a: Amar rabbi yochanan hinniach basar al gabbe gechalim hipech bo chayyav lo hipech bo patur
Amar rava may chayyav name dekaamar kemaase tzali shel shabbat

Gufa amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan hinniach basar al gabbe gechalim hipech bo chayyav lo hipech bo patur hechi dame ilema dei la hipech beh la beshil peshita ella dei la mehappech leh name hava beshil ammay la michayyav

La tzericha dei la happech beh hava beshil mitztzad echad kemaachal ben derosay vechi mehappech beh beshil mishshene tzedadin kemaachal ben derosay veka mashma lan dechol mitztzad echad kemaachal ben derosay la kelum hu
Amar rava veim nitzla bo kigrogeret mitztzad echad bimkom echad chayyav amar leh ravina lerav ashe bimkom echad in bishnayim o shelosha mekomot la vehatnan hakkodeach kol shehu chayyav
Hechi dame ilema bemakom echad kol shehu lemay chaze ella lav bishnayim o shelosha mekomot dachazo letzeruf la leolam bemakom echad dachazu levava deaklida

Veika deamri amar rava afilu bishnayim ushlosha mekomot amar leh ravina lerav ashe af anan name tenena hakkodeach kol shehu chayyav hechi dame ilema bemakom echad kol shehu lemay chaze ella lav bishnayim ushlosha mekomot dachaze letzeruf la leolam bemakom echad dachazu levava deaklida
Tanu rabbanan ilu neemar asher takrivu la lo tease chametz hayiti omer en li belo tease chametz ella kometz bilvad
Mincha minnayin talmud lomar mincha shear menachot minnayin talmud lomar kol hammincha
Asher takrivu la keshera velo pesula mikkan amru hamchammetz et hakkeshera chayyav veet happesula patur
Bae rav pappa chimtzah veyatzat vechazar vechimtzah mahu kevan deyatzat ipsila lah beotze vechi hadar mechammetz lah la michayyav alah mishshum mechammetz acher mechammetz
O dilma kevan dechimtzah pesul yotze la mahane bah vechi hadar mechammetz lah michayyav alah mishshum mechammetz acher mechammetz teku
Bae rav mari chimtzah berosho shel mizbeach mahu asher takrivu amar rachamana veha akrevah
O dilma mechussar haktara kimchussar maase dame teku

Vehashta denafka leh mikkol hammincha asher takrivu la lema li mibe leh lechidtanya asher takrivu lerabbot minchat nesachim lechimutz divre rabbi yose haggelili rabbi akiva omer lerabbot lechem happanim lechimutz
Minchat nesachim me ferot hem
b: Ume ferot en machmitzin amar resh lakish omer haya rabbi yose haggelili minchat nesachim megabbelah bemayim uchshera
Lechem happanim middat yavesh hi ushmana leh lerabbi akiva deamar middat yavesh lo nitkaddesha

Shelach rabbi reuven mishshemeh derabbi yochanan kach hi hatztzaa shel mishna veefoch asher takrivu lerabbot lechem happanim lechimutz divre rabbi yose haggelili rabbi akiva omer lerabbot minchat nesachim lechimutz
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi yochanan rabbi yose haggelili veechad mittalmide rabbi yishmael amru davar echad umannu rabbi yoshiyya
Detanya vayyimshachem vayekaddesh otam rabbi yoshiyya omer middat hallach nimshach ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz middat yavesh nimshechu mibbifnim veen nimshechu mibbachutz

Rabbi yonatan omer middat hallach nimshechu mibbifnim veen nimshechu mibbachutz middot yavesh lo nimshechu kol ikar teda lecha shehare en mekaddeshot dichtiv mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa shettayim shene esronim solet tihyena chametz teafena bikkurim la ematay hen la leachar shenneefu

Bemay ka mipalgi beotam rabbi yoshiyya savar otam lemaote middat yavesh bachutz verabbi yonatan savar middat yavesh chol hu vela itzterich kera lemaote ki itzterich kera lemaote middat lach mibbachutz
Lema name rabbi akiva veechad mittalmide rabbi yishmael amru davar echad umannu rabbi yonatan mishshum dela shau bemiddat lach lahadade
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veha ika bisa delach hu amar leh kegon shellash al gabbe katvulya
I hachi dekaamar leh rabbi yonatan teda lecha shehare enah mekaddeshet lema leh kegon dechayela beissaron dechol

Hachi hashta bishlama bisa la ketav rachamana deleeved bisa lemelash beh ki lash lah al gabbe katvulya let lan bah ella issaron kevan deamar rachamana aved issaron uchyel beh shavek issaron dekodesh vechayel beissaron dechol

Tanu rabbanan minnayin lemaale mibbesar chattat umibbesar asham umibbesar kodshe hakkodashim umikkodashim kallim umimmotar haomer umimmotar shette hallechem umillechem happanim umishsheyare menachot shehu belo taase
Talmud lomar ki chol seor vechol devash lo taktiru mimmennu ishshe la kol shehu mimmennu laishim hare hu beval taktiru
Ushte hallechem velechem happanim yesh mehen laishim vehatanya yatzu shette hallechem velechem happanim sheen mehem laishim
Amar rav sheshet en miggufo laishim
Itmar hammaale mikkullam al gabbe hakkevesh rabbi yochanan amar chayyav rabbi elazar amar patur
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyav detanya hammizbeach en li ella mizbeach kevesh minnayin talmud lomar veel hammizbeach lo yaalu leratzon
Verabbi elazar amar patur may tama deamar kera seor udvash korban reshit takrivu otam
Otam hu derabbi lecha kevesh kemizbeach aval mide acharina la

a: Verabbi yochanan hay otam may aved leh
Mibe leh lechidtanya yachol yehe yachid mitnaddev umevi kayyotze bah nedava vekore ani bah motza sefatecha tishmor veasita
Talmud lomar korban reshit takrivu tzibur amarti lecha velo yachid

Yachol lo yehe yachid mevi sheeno mevi chovato kayyotze bah aval yehe tzibur mevi shemmevi chovato kayyotze bah talmud lomar otam uma yesh lecha lehavi shette hallechem min hasseor uvikkurim min haddevash

Ushte hallechem lo yikrevu nedava vehatanya im neemar kol seor lamma neemar kol devash veim neemar kol devash lamma neemar kol seor mippene sheyyesh basseor ma sheen baddevash veyesh baddevash ma sheen bisor
Seor huttar mikkelalo bammikdash devash lo huttar mikkelalo bammikdash
Devash huttar bishyare menachot seor lo huttar bishyare menachot ha mippene sheyyesh basseor ma sheen baddevash veyesh baddevash ma sheen bisor hutzrach lomar kol seor vehutzrach lomar kol devash
Seor dehuttar mikkelalo bammikdash may nihu lav shette hallechem dekarva nedava amar rav amram la likrav immahem
I hachi bikkurim name ditnan haggozalot sheal gabbe hassallin hau olot vehassallim shebbeyadam nitanin lakkohanim hanhu leatter bikkurim hu deatu
Bae rame bar chama merav chisda hammaale mibbesar chattat haof al gabbe hammizbeach mahu
Kol shemmimmennu laishim amar rachamana vehay en mimmennu laishim o dilma kol sheshshemo korban vehay name shemo korban amar leh kol sheshshemo korban vehay name shemo korban
Ketannae rabbi eliezer omer kol shemmimmennu laishim rabbi akiva omer kol sheshshemo korban
May benayehu amar rav chisda besar chattat haof ika benayehu
Rav amar log shemen shel metzora ika benayehu detane levi kol korbanam lerabbot log shemen shel metzora
Tanu rabbanan seor bal taktiru en li ella kullo miktzato minnayin talmud lomar chol eruvo minnayin talmud lomar ki chol
May kaamar amar abbaye hachi kaamar seor bal taktiru en li ella kezayit chatzi zayit minnayin talmud lomar kol eruvo minnayin talmud lomar ki chol
Rava amar hachi kaamar seor bal taktiru en li ella kometz chatzi kometz minnayin talmud lomar chol eruvo minnayin talmud lomar ki chol
Bemay ka mipalgi abbaye savar yesh kometz pachot mishshene zetim
b: Veyesh haktara pechuta mikkezayit
Verava amar en kometz pachot mishshene zetim veen haktara pechuta mikkezayit
Itmar hammaale misseor umiddevash al gabbe hammizbeach amar rava loke mishshum seor veloke mishshum devash loke mishshum eruve seor umishshum eruve devash
Abbaye amar en lokin al lav shebbichlalot
Ika deamri chada miha lake
Veika deamri chada name la lake deha la meyachad laveh kelav dachasima

Matni vechayyav al hashshemen bifne atzmo vechayyav al levona bifne atzmah natan aleha shemen pesalah levona yilketenna

Uma raita lifsol bashshemen ulhachshir ballevona posel ani bashshemen shei efshar lelokto umachshir ani ballevona sheefshar leloktah
Bea rabba bar rav huna merabbi yochanan natan aleha levona shechuka mahu mishshum deefshar leloktah veha la efshar leloktah o dilma mishshum dela mibala veha name la mibala

Vetihve pach veammay pasla bemachshava dachuy hu

Detanya chanan hammitzri omer afilu dam bakkos mevi chavero shello behagrala umzaveg lo
Rav ashe amar kol shebbeyado la have dachuy
