Veika deamri amar rav yitzchak bar yosef bae rabbi yochanan natan mashshehu shemen al gabbe kezayit mincha mahu mi baenan sima kintina o la teku
Natan shemen al sheyareha tanu rabbanan lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten yachol bishne kohanim
Talmud lomar aleha begufah shel mincha hakkatuv medabber velo bechohen
Yachol lo yitten keli al gabbe keli veim natan pasal talmud lomar aleha begufah shel mincha hakkatuv medabber
Matni yesh teunot haggasha veen teunot tenufa haggasha utnufa tenufa velo haggasha lo tenufa velo haggasha
Veellu teunot haggasha veen teunot tenufa minchat hassolet vehammachavat umarcheshet vehachallot veharkikin minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach minchat goyim minchat nashim uminchat chote
Rabbi shimon omer minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach en bahen haggasha lefi sheen bahen kemitza vechol sheen bahen kemitza en bahen haggasha
Gema amar rav pappa kol hecha ditnan eser tenan may ka mashma lan
Leappoke midderabbi shimon deamar mechetza challot umechetza rekikin yavi ka mashma lan dela
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ilu neemar veheveta asher yease meelle la vehikrivah el hakkohen vehiggishah hayiti omer en li shettaun haggasha ella kometz bilvad
Mincha minnayin talmud lomar mincha minchat chote minnayin talmud lomar et hammincha
Vedin hu neemar have
b: Minchat chova veneemar have minchat nedava ma minchat nedava teuna haggasha af minchat chova teuna haggasha
Ma leminchat nedava shekken teuna shemen ulvona minchat sota tochiach
Ma leminchat sota shekken teuna tenufa minchat nedava tochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze chiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheshshau likmitza veshau lehaggasha af ani avi minchat chote sheshshava lahen likmitza tashve lahen lehaggasha
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken huchsheru lavo beashir kivani tomar beminchat chote shello huchshera lavo beashir kivani talmud lomar et hammincha

Rabbi shimon omer veheveta lerabbot minchat haomer lehaggasha vechen hu omer vahavetem et omer reshit ketzirchem el hakkohen vehikrivah lerabbot minchat sota lehaggasha vechen hu omer vehikriv otah el hammizbeach
Vedin hu uma minchat chote sheenah teuna tenufa teuna haggasha minchat sota shetteuna tenufa eno din shetteuna haggasha ma leminchat chote shekken baa chitin
Minchat haomer tochiach ma leminchat haomer shekken teuna shemen ulvona minchat chote tochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheshshau likmitza veshau lehaggasha af ani avi minchat sota sheshshaveta lahen likmitza tishve lahen lehaggasha
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken lo huchsheru lavo kemach tomar minchat sota shehuchshera lavo kemach talmud lomar vehikrivah
Rabbi yehuda omer veheveta lerabbot minchat sota lehaggasha vechen hu omer vehevi et korbanah aleha
Aval minchat haomer la tzericha kera may tama middina ka atya uma minchat chote sheenah teuna tenufa teuna haggasha minchat haomer shetteuna tenufa eno din shetteuna haggasha
Ma leminchat chote shekken baa chitin minchat sota tochiach ma leminchat sota shekken baa levarer aon demazkeret aon hi minchat chote tochiach

Vechazar haddin lo rei ze chiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken shau likmitza veshau lehaggasha af ani avi minchat haomer sheshshaveta lahen likmitza tishve lahen lehaggasha
Umay parchatte rabbi shimon parech hachi ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken metzuyin
Verabbi yehuda adderabba ha metzuya tefe hanach zimnin dela mashkachatte lah kelal
O eno omer veheveta ella sheyyachid mitnaddev umevi mincha acheret chutz meelle shebbainyan
Vedin hu tzibur mevi mincha min hachitin chova umevi mincha min hasseorin chova af yachid shemmevi mincha min hachitin nedava yachol yavi mincha min hasseorin nedava talmud lomar elle en li ella elle
O eno omer elle ella laomer hare alay mincha shemmevi chamishtan talmud lomar meelle ratza achat mevi ratza chamishtan mevi
Rabbi shimon omer et hammincha lerabbot shear menachot kegon minchat goyim minchat nashim lehaggasha yachol sheani merabbe af shette hallechem velechem happanim talmud lomar meelle
Uma raita lerabbot shear menachot ulhotzi shette hallechem velechem happanim merabbe ani shear menachot sheyyesh mehen laishim umotzi ani shette hallechem velechem happanim sheen mehen laishim
Vahalo minchat nesachim kullah laishim yachol yehe tehe teuna haggasha talmud lomar vehikrivah
Veha appekteh vehikriv vehikrivah uma raita lerabbot shear menachot ulhotzi minchat nesachim

a: Merabbe ani shear menachot shebbaot biglal atzman umotzi ani minchat nesachim sheenah baa biglal atzmah vahalo minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach baot biglal atzman yachol yehu teunot haggasha
Talmud lomar vehiggishah hay mibe leh legufah shetteuna haggasha min vehiggish vehiggishah

Uma raita lerabbot shear menachot ulhotzi minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach merabbe ani shear menachot sheyyesh mehen laishim uvaot biglal atzman veyesh mehen lakkohanim umotzi ani shette hallechem velechem happanim sheen mehen laishim uminchat nesachim sheenah baa biglal atzmah uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach sheen mehen lakkohanim
Veherim yachol bichli talmud lomar veherim mimmennu bekumtzo ma harama haamur lehallan bekumtzo af harama haamur kan bekumtzo
Matni ellu teunot tenufa veen teunot haggasha log shemen shel metzora vaashamo vehabbikkurim kedivre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov veemure shalme yachid vechaze vashok shellahen
Echad anashim veechad nashim beyisrael velo baacherim shette hallechem ushne kivse atzeret

Ketzad hu ose noten shette hallechem al gabbe shene kevasim umanniach shette yadav lematta molich umevi maale umorid shenneemar asher hunaf vaasher huram tenufa hayeta bammizrach vehaggasha bammaarav tenufot kodmot lahaggashot
Minchat haomer uminchat kenaot teunot haggasha utnufa lechem happanim uminchat nesachim en teunot lo haggasha velo tenufa
Rabbi shimon omer shelosha minin teunin shalosh mitzot shettayim bechol achat veachat ushlishit en bahen veellu hen zivche shalme yachid vezivche shalme tzibur vaasham metzora

Zivche shalme yachid teunin semicha chayyim utnufa shechutin veen bahen tenufa chayyim zivche shalme tzibur teunim tenufa chayyim ushchutin veen bahem semicha vaasham metzora taun semicha utnufa chay veen bo tenufa shachut
Gema tanu rabbanan vehikriv oto leasham veet log hashshamen vehenif otam tenufa melammed shetteunin tenufa keechad
Uminnayin sheim henif ze beatzmo veze beatzmo yatza talmud lomar vehikriv oto leasham vehenif yachol yanif veyachzir veyanif talmud lomar tenufa velo tenufot
Lifne Adonai bammizrach veha amar lifne Adonai yachol bammaarav
Amri hane mile mincha deikri chattat vechattat teuna yesod vekeren deromit mizrachit lo haya lo yesod aval hacha lifne Adonai karena beh
Vehabbikkurim kedivre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov may rabbi eliezer ben yaakov detanya velakach hakkohen limed al habbikkurim shetteunin tenufa divre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov
May tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov gamar yad yad mishshelamim ketiv hacha velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha uchtiv hatam yadav tevienna
b: Ma kan kohen af lehallan kohen uma lehallan bealim af kan bealim ha ketzad kohen manniach yado tachat yede bealim umenif
Velema name kedivre rabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer vehinnachto zo tenufa atta omer zo tenufa o eno ella hannacha
Keshehu omer vehinnicho hare hannacha amur ha ma ani mekayyem vehinnachto zo tenufa
Amar rava hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla rav nachman bar yitzchak amar hoil verav guvreh
Veemure shalme yachid vechaze vashok shellahen echad haanashim veechad hannashim beyisrael aval lo baacherim may kaamar
Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar echad anashim veechad nashim korbanan taun tenufa utnufa atzmah beyisrael aval lo bide nashim
Tanu rabbanan bene yisrael menifin veen haggoyim menifin bene yisrael menifin veen hannashim menifot
Amar rabbi yose matzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben korban yisrael lekorban goyim lekorban nashim bismicha yachol nachlok bitnufa
La ma li chillek bismicha shehassemicha bivalim
Nachlok bitnufa shehattenufa bechohanim im ken ma talmud lomar bene yisrael bene yisrael menifin veen haggoyim menifin bene yisrael menifin veen hannashim menifot
Tanya idach bene yisrael en li ella bene yisrael gerim vaavadim meshuchrarin minnayin talmud lomar hammakriv
O eno ella ze kohen hammakriv keshehu omer yadav teviena hare bealim amur ha ketzad kohen manniach yadav tachat yede habbealim umenif

a: Ketzad ose manniach emurin al pisat hayyad vechaze vashok alehen uvchol makom sheyyesh lechem hallechem millemala
Hecha amar rav pappa bemilluim
May tama ilema mishshum dichtiv shok hatteruma vachaze hattenufa al ishshe hachalavim yaviu lehanif tenufa vehachtiv et hachelev al hechaze yeviennu
Amar abbaye hahu demayete leh kohen mibbet hammitbachayim verame leh
Vehachtiv vayyasimu et hachalavim al hechazot hahu deyahev leh lechohen acharina veazel umaktar leh
Veha ka mashma lan devaenan shelosha kohanim mishshum dichtiv berov am hadrat melech
Ushte hallechem ushne kivse atzeret vechu tanu rabbanan vehenif hakkohen otam al lechem habbikurim
Yachol yanniach kevasim al gabbe hallechem talmud lomar al shene kevasim i al shene kevasim yachol lechem al gabbe kevasim talmud lomar al lechem habbikurim
Nishtakkel hakkatuv veeni yodea im lechem al gabbe kevasim veim kevasim al gabbe lechem ma matzinu bechol makom lechem lemala af kan lechem lemala hecha amar rav pappa bemiluim
Rabbi yose ben hamshullam omer kevasim lemala uma ani mekayyem al shene kevasim lehotzi shiva

Chanina ben chachinay omer manniach shette hallechem ben yarchotehen shel kevasim umenif venimtza mekayyem shene mikraot hallalu lechem al gabbe kevasim uchvasim al gabbe hallechem amar rabbi lifne melech basar vedam en osin ken lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu osin ken ella manniach ze betzad ze umenif
Veha baenan al amar leh rav chisda lerav hamnuna veamri lah rav hamnuna lerav chisda rabbi letameh deamar al besamuch
Detanya venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka rabbi omer al besamuch atta omer al besamuch o eno ella al mammash keshehu omer vesakkota al haaron et happarochet heve omer al besamuch
Molich umevi maale umorid vechu amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan molich umevi lemi sheharuchot shello maale umorid lemi shehashshamayim vehaaretz shello
Bemareva matnu hachi amar rav chama bar ukva amar rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina molich umevi kede laatzor ruchot raot maale umorid kede laatzor telalim raim
Amar rabbi yose bar rav avin zot omeret sheyare mitzva meakkevim et happuranut deha tenufa sheyare mitzva hi veotzeret ruchot raot utlalim raim amar rabba vechen lulav
Rav acha bar yaakov mamte leh umayete leh umachve hachi veamar gira beena desitna velav milta hi mishshum deate leitgaroye beh
Tanu rabbanan zivche shalme tzibbur teunin tenufa leachar shechita utnufatan kemot shehen divre rabbi vachachamim omrim bechaze vashok
Bemay ka mipalgi amar leh rav chisda lerav hamnuna veamri lah rav hamnuna lerav chisda bedun minah uminah bedun minah veoke veatrah ka mipalgi

Rabbanan savri dun minah uminah ma zivche shalme yachid teunin tenufa leachar shechita af zivche shalme tzibbur teunin tenufa leachar shechita uminah ma hatam bechaze vashok af hacha name bechaze vashok

Verabbi savar dun minah veoke veatrah ma zivche shalme yachid teunin tenufa leachar shechita af zivche shalme tzibbur teunin tenufa leachar shechita veoke beatrah hatam hu dechaze vashok aval hacha kemot shehen kemot shehen bachayyim
b: Rav pappa amar dechulle alma dun minah uminah hu vehayenu tama derabbi ki hatam ma hatam davar shemmattana lechohen af hacha davar shemmattana lakkohen
Ravina amar dechulle alma dun minah veoke veatrah vehayenu tama derabbanan shalmehem ribuya hu
Rabbi shimon omer shelosha minin teunin shalosh mitzot shettayim bechol echad ushlishit en bahen veellu hen zivche shalme yachid vezivche shalme tzibbur vaasham metzora

Zivche shalme yachid teunin semicha chayyim utnufa shechutin veen bahen tenufa chayyim zivche shalme tzibbur teunin tenufa chayyim ushchutin veen bahen semicha asham metzora taun semicha utnufa chay veen bo tenufa shachut

Veyihu zivche shalme yachid teunin tenufa chayyim mikkal vechomer uma zivche shalme tzibbur sheen teunin semicha chayyim teunin tenufa chayyim zivche shalme yachid shetteunin semicha chayyim eno din shetteunin tenufa chayyim
Miet rachamana gabbe zivche shalme tzibbur otam otam lemaote zivche shalme yachid

Veyihu zivche shalme tzibbur teunin semicha mikkal vachomer uma zivche shalme yachid sheen teunin tenufa chayyim teunin semicha zivche shalme tzibbur shetteunin tenufa chayyim eno din shetteunin semicha amar ravina gemiri shette semichot betzibbur
Vihe asham metzora taun tenufa shachut mikkal vechomer ma zivche shalme yachid sheen teunin tenufa chayyim teunin tenufa shechutin asham metzora shettaun tenufa chay eno din shettaun tenufa shachut
Miet rachamana gabbe zivche shalme yachid oto oto lemaote asham metzora
Tanu rabbanan chamishsha sheheviu korban echad echad menif al yede kullam vehaishsha kohen menif al yadah vechen hashsholeach korbenotav mimmedinat hayyam kohen menif al yado

a: Matni haomer hare alay bemachavat lo yavi bemarcheshet bemarcheshet lo yavi bemachavat ma ben machavat lemarcheshet marcheshet yesh lah kisuy machavat en lah kisuy divre rabbi yose haggelili rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer marcheshet amukka umaaseha rochashin rakkin machavat tzafa umaaseha kashin
Gema may tama derabbi yose ilema marcheshet deatya arichushe hallev kedichtiv rachash libbi davar tov umachavat deatya ammachboe happe kidamri inashe menabbach nabboche
Ema ipcha machavat deatya ammachboe hallev dichtiv lamma nachbeta livroach marcheshet deatya arichushe happe kidamri inashe hava merachashan sifvateh ella gemara gemiri lah
Rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer ku marcheshet amukka dichtiv vechol naasa vammarcheshet machavat tzafa dichtiv veal machavat
Tanu rabbanan bet shammay omrim haomer hare alay marcheshet yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu
Mesappeka lehu i al shum keli nikreu o al shum maasehen
Uvet hillel omrim keli haya bammikdash umarcheshet shemo vedome kemin kalbos amok uchshebbatzek munnach betocho dome kemin tappuche habbaratim uchmin bilvate hayevanim
Veomer vechol naasa vammarcheshet veal machavat alma al shum hakkelim nikreu velo al shum maasehem
Matni hare alay betannur lo yavi maafe chuppach velo maafe reafim umaafe yorot haarviyyim rabbi yehuda omer ratza mevi maafe chuppach
Hare alay minchat maafe lo yavi mechetza challot umechetza rekikin rabbi shimon mattir mippene shehu korban echad
Gema tanu rabbanan maafe tannur velo maafe chuppach velo maafe reafim velo maafe yorot haarviyyim
Rabbi yehuda omer tannur tannur shene peamim lehachshir maafe chuppach rabbi shimon omer tannur tannur shene peamim echad shettehe afiyyatan betannur veechad sheyehe hekdeshan battannur
Umi it leh lerabbi shimon hay sevara vehatnan rabbi shimon omer leolam heve ragil lomar shette hallechem velechem happanim kesherot baazara uchsherot bevet page
Amar rava ema sheyehe hekdeshan leshum tannur
Hare alay minchat maafe lo yavi mechetza vechu tanu rabbanan vechi takriv keshettakriv laasot devar reshut

Korban mincha amar rabbi yehuda minnayin leomer hare alay minchat maafe shello yavi mechetza challot umechetza rekikin talmud lomar korban mincha korban echad amarti lach velo shenayim ushlosha korbanot
Amar lo rabbi shimon
b: Vechi neemar korban korban shene peamim vahalo lo neemar ella korban echad veneemar bo challot urkikin
Meatta ratza lehavi challot mevi rekikin mevi mechetza challot umechetza rekikin mevi uvollan vekometz mishshenehem veim kamatz veala beyado meechad al shenehem yatza

Rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer minnayin leomer hare alay minchat maafe shello yavi mechetza challot umechetza rekikin talmud lomar vechol mincha asher teafe battannur vechol naasa vammarcheshet veal machavat lakkohen hammakriv otah lo tihye vechol mincha velula vashshemen vachareva lechol bene aharon tihye
Ma vechol haamur lematta shene minin chalukin af vechol haamur lemala shene minin chalukin
Verabbi yehuda shappir kaamar rabbi shimon amar lach kevan dichtiv bashshemen bashshemen keman dichtiv korban korban dame
Verabbi shimon i la ketiv beshemen beshemen hava amena daveka mechetza challot umechetza rekikin aval challot lechodayehu urkikin lechodayehu ema la ka mashma lan
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hayenu avuh ika benayehu dei avad

Shatak rabbi tarfon tzahavu panav shel rabbi yehuda ben nechemya amar lo rabbi akiva yehuda tzahavu panecha sheheshavta et zaken temehani im taarich yamim amar rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay oto happerek peros happesach haya keshealiti laatzeret shaalti acharav yehuda ben nechemya hechan hu veamru li niftar vehalach lo
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ledivre yehuda ben nechemya nesachim bikurim shehikrivam kodem laomer kesherin peshita
Mahu detema hatam hu dehuttar mikkelalo etzel hedot aval hacha delo huttar mikkelalo la ka mashma lan kol shekken hacha dela itsar kelal
Seder hanatza gele pil siman bae rame bar chama shette hallechem mahu sheyyattiru shello kesidran
Hechi dame kegon dezarinhu ben haomer lishte hallechem vachalef alayehu shette hallechem veomer may kesidran sharyan shello kesidran la sharyan o dilma shello kesidran name sharyan
Amar rabba ta shema veim takriv minchat bikkurim beminchat haomer hakkatuv medabber mehechan baa min hasseorin atta omer min hasseorin o eno ella min hachitin
Rabbi eliezer omer neemar aviv bemitzrayim veneemar aviv ledorot ma aviv haamur bemitzrayim seorin af aviv haamur ledorot seorin
Verabbi akiva omer matzinu yachid shemmevi chovato min hachitin vechovato min hasseorin
Vetzibur shemmeviin chovatan min hachitin meviin chovatan min hasseorin veim atta omer ba min hachitin lo matzinu tzibur shemmevi chovato min hasseorin
Davar acher im atta omer omer ba min hachitin en shette hallechem bikurim
Veim ita dishte hallechem shello kesidran sharyan mashkachatte lah demakrev omer mehanach deashrush kodem lishte hallechem uvatar haomer deeshtakad
Ushte hallechem mehanach deashrush kodem laomer dehashta uvatar shette hallechem deeshtakad
Mi savratte

a: Bikkurim lefera ka amrinan lemizbeach ka amrinan veha achel leh mizbeach mippere deha shatta
Bae rame bar chama shette hallechem hanatza sharya o chanata sharya may hanatza umay chanata ilema hanatza defera vachanata defera hashta hashrasha sharya hanatza vachanata mibaya
Ella hanatza deale vachanata deale mi have ki hashrasha o la teku
Bae rava bar rav chanan chittin shezzeraan bakkarka omer mattiran o en omer mattiran hechi dame i deashrush tenena i dela ashrush tenena
Ditnan im hishrishu kodem laomer omer mattiran veim lav asurin ad sheyyavo omer habba
La tzericha dechatzdinhu vezarinhu kodem laomer vaata omer vachalef alayehu veka mibaya leh mahu lenakkote umechal minayehu keman deshadya bechadda damya ushrinhu omer o dilma battel lehu legabbe ara
Yesh lahen onaa o en lahen onaa
Hechi dame ilema deamar leh sheday bah shita vaato sahadi veamri dela sheda bah ella chamsha vehaamar rava kol davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan afilu pachot mikkede onaa chozer
Ella daamar leh sheday bah kidvae lah vaato sahadi veamri dela sheda bah kidvae lah yesh lahen onaa dichman deshadya bechadda damya veyesh lahen onaa o dilma battel lehu legabbe ara
Nishbain alehen o en nishbain alehen kidshadya bechadda damya uchmittaltele damu venishbain alehen o dilma battel lehu aggav ara vechimkarkee damu veen nishbain alehen teku

Bae rame bar chama chittin shebbegelle vakar usorin shebbegelle vehema mahu lemay ilema letammoye tumat ochalin tenena chittin shebbiri vakar usorin shebbegelle vehema chishev alehen laachila en mittamme tumat ochalin likketan laachila metamme tumat ochalin
Ella limnachot peshita dela hakrivehu na lefechatecha hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha
La tzericha denaktinhu vezarinhu veka vae leetoye menachot minayehu may mishshum dimisuta hu vechevan dezarinhu azda meisutayehu o dilma mishshum kechishuta hu vehashta name kechusha teku
Bae rame bar chama pil shebbala kefifa mitzrit vehekiah derech bet hari mahu lemay
Ilema lemivtal tumatah tenena kol hakkelim yordin lide tumatan bemachshava veen olin mittumatan ella beshinuy maase
La tzericha divla hutzin veavdinhu kefifa mitzrit mi have ikul have leh
b: Kichle gelalim kichle adama veen mekabbelin tuma deamar mar kele avanim uchle gelalim uchle adama en mekabbelin tuma lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim o dilma la have ikul
Tifshot leh meha deamar ulla mishshum rabbi shimon bar yehotzadak maase uvalu zeevim shene tinokot beever hayyarden uva maase lifne chachamim vetiharu et habbasar
Shane basar derakkich velifshot missefa vetimmeu et haatzamot shane atzamot daakoshe tefe
Bae rabbi zera chitin sheyyardu beavim mahu lemay i limnachot ammay la ella lishte hallechem may
Mimmoshvotechem amar rachamana leappoke dechutza laaretz dela aval deavim shappir dame o dilma mimmoshvotechem daveka vaafilu deavim name la
Umi ika ki hay gavena in kedaadi tayyaa nechita leh rum kizva chite bitlata parse

Bae rabbi shimon ben pazzi shibolet shehevia shelish kodem laomer vaakarah ushtalah leachar haomer vehosifa mahu batar ikar azlinan vesharyah omer o dilma batar tosefet azlinan vead sheyyavo omer habba
Tifshot leh meha deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan yalda shessibbechah bizkena uvah perot afilu hosif bematayim asur
Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan batzal sheshshetalo bakkerem veneekar hakkerem afilu hosif bematayim asur
Hi gufah ka mibaya leh mifshat peshita lehu lerabbanan devatar ikar azlinan la shena lekulla vela shena lechumra o dilma sappoke mesappeka lehu ulchumra amrinan lekulla la amrinan teku
Bae rabba leinyan maaser may hechi dame kegon

a: Deamdinhu veasserinhu veshatlinhu vehosifa veosifa lehu
Im timtza lomar la azlinan batar ikar vetosefet bae assore ikar may amar leh abbaye may shena mikkol chite usare dealma
Amar leh davar shezzaro kale la mibaya li ella ki kamibaya li davar sheen zaro kale may
Tifshot leh meha deamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan litra batzal shettikno uzrao mitasser lefi kullo
Hatam hayenu zeriato hacha lav hayenu zeriato
Amar leh rabbi chanina bar minome leabbaye atzitz sheeno nakuv mahu i lo nakuv ha lo nakuv
Dilma chazar unkavo ka amratte
Hacha chada zeria hi ichabbore hu deka michabbera veola hatam shette zeriot ninhu
Bae rabbi avahu shibbolet shemmerchah bichri ushtalah vekara aleha shem bimchubbar mahu kevan demerchah tavla lah ki kara aleha shem kadsha lah o dilma kevan deshatlah peka leh tivla minah
Amri leh rabbanan leabbaye im ken matzinu teruma bimchubbar lakkarka utnan lo matzinu teruma bimchubbar lakkarka
Amar leh ki tanya hahi leinyan ichayyove mita vachomesh dei talesh veachel talush hu vei gachen veachel batla dato etzel kol adam
Umay shena middichtav appinaksa deilfa betze nivlat haof hattahor miktzatan bachutz umiktzatan bifnim mibbifnim metammein begadim abbet habbelia mibbachutz en metammein begadim abbet habbelia
Talush avidi inashe deachli hachi bimchubbar la avidi inashe deachli
Amar rav tavome bar kisna amar shemuel hazzorea kilayim beatzitz sheeno nakuv asur amar abbaye bishlama i ashmeinan loke makkat mardut midderabbanan shappir ella asur may ka mashma lan
Demidderabbanan haveya zeria tenena taram mishsheeno nakuv al hannakuv teruma veyachzor veyitrom

Matni hachitin vehasseorin vehakkussemin vehashshibolet shual vehashshifon hare ellu chayyavin bachalla umitztarfin ze im ze vaasurim bechadash millifne happesach umilliktzor millifne haomer im hishrishu kodem laomer haomer mattiran veim lav asurin ad sheyyavo haomer habba
Gema tana kussemin min chitim shibolet shual veshifon min seorin kussemin
b: Gulba shifon dishra shibolet shual shuvle taala hane in orez vedochan la
Mena hane mile amar resh lakish atya lechem lechem mimmatztza ketiv hacha vehaya baacholchem millechem haaretz uchtiv hatam lechem oni

Vehatam gufah menalan amar resh lakish vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael vechen tana deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov amar kera lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot lechem oni devarim habbaim lide chimutz adam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach yatzu ellu sheen bain lide chimutz ella lide serachon
Umitztarfin ze im ze tana hattevua vehakkemachim vehabbetzekot mitztarfin ze im ze lemay hilcheta
Amar rav kahana leinyan chadash rav yosef amar leinyan chametz bappesach rav pappa amar leinyan maaser sheni dei achel leh chutz lachoma lake
Rava amar leinyan tumat ochalin veha ka mashma lan ditvua ukmachin dumya divtzekot ma hatam uchla beeneh af hacha name uchla beeneh
Vehatanya chitta ben kelufa ben sheenah kelufa mitztarefet seora kelufa mitztarefet sheenah kelufa en mitztarefet
Ini veha tana deve rabbi yishmael al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea kederech shebbene adam motziin lizria chitta biklipatah usora biklipatah vaadashim biklipatan
La kashya ha belachot ha biveshot
Vaasurin bechadash millifne happesach mena hane mile amar resh lakish atya lechem lechem mimmatztza
Veliktzor lifne haomer mena hane mile amar rabbi yochanan atya reshit reshit mechalla
May kodem laomer rabbi yona amar kodem ketzirat haomer rabbi yose bar zavda amar kodem havaat haomer
Tenan asurin bechadash lifne fesach veliktzor lifne haomer bishlama leman deamar kodem havaat haomer hayenu dela ka arev lehu vetane lehu
Ella leman deamar kodem ketzirat haomer liarvinhu velitninhu asurin bechadash veliktzor lifne happesach
Ella i itmar assefa itmar im hishrishu kodem laomer haomer mattiran may kodem laomer rabbi yona amar kodem havaat haomer rabbi yose bar zavda omer kodem ketzirat haomer
Amar leh rabbi elazar

a: Lerabbi yoshiyya dedareh la tetev akkaracha ad dimfarshatte leh leha matnitin minnayin laomer shemmattir behashrasha
Menalan dichtiv aviv lav mikkelal deika delav aviv
Delav aviv ulolam deayyel shelish
Ella amar shemuel mehachel chermesh lav mikkelal deika delav bar chermesh delav bar chermesh ulolam shachat
Amar rabbi yitzchak kama lav mikkelal delav bar kama delav bar kama ulolam agam
Ella amar rava asher tizra mishsheat zeria amar leh rav pappa lerava i hachi af al gav delo hishrish name amar leh sudani bassade ketiv

Matni kotzrin bet hashshelachin shebbaamakim aval lo godshin anshe yericho kotzrin birtzon chachamim vegodshin shello birtzon chachamim velo michu beyadam kotzer leshachat maachil labbehema amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shemmatchil ad shello hevi shelish rabbi shimon omer yiktzor veyaachil af mishshehevi shelish
Vekotzrin mippene netiot mippene bet haevel mippene bitul bet hammidrash lo yaase otan kerichot aval mannichin tzevatim
Mitzvat haomer lavo min hakkama lo matza yavi min haomarim mitzvato lavo min hallach lo matza yavi yavesh mitzvato liktzor ballayela niktzar bayyom kasher vedoche et hashshabbat
Gema tanya rabbi binyamin omer katuv echad omer uktzartem et ketzirah vahavetem et omer uchtiv reshit ketzirchem el hakkohen
Ha ketzad mimmakom sheatta mevi i atta kotzer mimmakom shei atta mevi atta kotzer
Ema mimmin sheatta mevi i atta kotzer mimmin shei atta mevi atta kotzer hahu la matzet amratte midderabbi yochanan
Anshe yericho kotzrin birtzon chachamim vegodshin shello birtzon chachamim vechu man shamatte leh deamar michu velo michu rabbi yehuda
Vesavar rabbi yehuda ketzira deanshe yericho birtzon chachamim havay veha tanya shishsha devarim asu anshe yericho shelosha birtzon chachamim ushlosha shello birtzon chachamim

Veellu shebbirtzon chachamim markivin dekalim kol hayyom vechorchin et shema vekotzrin lifne haomer birtzon chachamim veellu shello birtzon chachamim godshin lifne haomer umattirin gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma ufortzin peratzot begannotehen vvfardesotehen lehaachil nesher laaniyyim bishne vatztzoret beshabbatot uvyamim tovim divre rabbi meir
Amar lo rabbi yehuda im birtzon chachamim hen osin yehu kol adam osin ken ella ellu vaellu shello birtzon chachamim veal shelosha michu beyadam veal shelosha lo michu beyadam
Veellu shello michu beyadam markivin dekalim kol hayyom vechorchin et shema vekotzrin vegodshin lifne haomer veellu shemmichu beyadam
b: Mattirin gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma ufortzin peratzot begannotehen uvfardesotehen kede lehaachil nesher laaniyyim bishne vatztzoret beshabbatot uvyamim tovim venotnin pea layyarak umichu beyadam
Velitamach shishsha shiva hau ella semi mikkan ketzira

Kotzer leshachat umaachil labbehema tenan hatam veellu mafsikin lappea hannachal vehashshelulit vederech hayyachid vederech harabbim ushvil harabbim ushvil hayyachid hakkavua bimot hachamma uvimot haggeshamim vehabbor vehannir vezera acher
Vekotzer leshachat mafsik divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim en mafsik ella im ken charash
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan rabbi meir beshitat rabbi shimon amarah deamar yiktzor veyaachil af mishshehevia shelish alma kasavar kol leshachat lav ketzira hi

Yatev rabba vekaamar lah leha shemata etiveh rav acha bar huna lerava achalah chagav karsemuha nemalim shibberattaho haruach hakkol modim charash mafsik lo charash eno mafsik hakkol modim man rabbi meir
I amratte bishlama matnitin beshello hevia shelish barayeta decharash in lo charash lo beshehevi shelish
Ella i amratte matnitin name beshehevi shelish hashta uma hatam diktzira dehatam amar rabbi meir lo shemah ketzira hacha lo kol shekken
Ella rabbi meir beshitat rabbi yehuda amarah deamar ematay bizman shehitchil ad shello hevi shelish aval im hitchil ad shehevi shelish asur
Emar deshamatte leh lerabbi yehuda livhema leadam mi shamatte leh deim ken hau lehu telata tannae
Ella ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi meir beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo amar af leadam name la haveya ketzira ditnan hamnammer sade veshiyyer bo kelachim lachim rabbi akiva omer pea lechol echad veechad
Vachachamim omrim meechad al hakkol veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo chiyyev rabbi akiva ella bimnammer liklaot aval bimnammer laotzar lo
Ini veha ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan mechayyev haya rabbi akiva af bimnammer laotzar

a: Savar lah kevateh bachada uflig aleh bachada
Kotzrin mippene hannetiot umippene bet haevel umippene bet hammidrash may tama ketzirchem amar rachamana velo ketzir mitzva
Velo yaase kerichot aval mannichan tzevatim may tama dechamma deefshar la tarchinan

Mitzvat haomer lehavi min hakkama tanu rabbanan veim takriv minchat bikkurim ma talmud lomar lefi shemmitzvat haomer lehavi min hakkama minnayin sheim lo matza min hakkama yavi min haomarin talmud lomar takriv

Davar acher takriv lefi shemmitzva lehavi min hallach uminnayin sheim lo matza min hallach yavi min hayyavesh talmud lomar takriv davar acher takriv lefi shemmitzvato liktzor ballayela minnayin sheim niktzar bayyom kasher talmud lomar takriv
Vedocha et hashshabbat talmud lomar takriv takriv kol shehu takriv mikkol makom takriv vaafilu beshabbat takriv vaafilu betuma

Niktzar bayyom kasher vehatnan kol hallayela kasher liktzirat haomer ulhaktir chalavim veevarim ze hakkelal davar shemmitzvato kol hayyom kasher kol hayyom davar shemmitzvato belayela kasher kol hallayela
Katane layela dumya deom ma deom ballayela la af delayela bayyom name la

Amar rabba la kashya ha rabbi veha rabbi elazar berabbi shimon detanya haya omed umakriv minchat haomer venitmet im yesh acheret omer lo have acheret tachteha veim lav omer lo heve pikkeach ushtok divre rabbi
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer ben kach uven kach omar lo heve pikkeach ushtok shekkol haomer shenniktzar shello kemitzvato pasul

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan rabbi elazar berabbi shimon beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo shel aviv amarah ditnan kelal amar rabbi akiva kol melacha sheefshar lo laasotah meerev shabbat enah docha et hashshabbat
Vesavar lah kerabbi yishmael deamar ketzirat haomer mitzva ditnan rabbi yishmael omer ma charish reshut af katzir reshut yatza ketzir haomer shehi mitzva
Vei salka datach niktzar shello kemitzvato kasher ammay dache shabbat niktzereh meerev shabbat ella middedache shabbat shema minah niktzar shello kemitzvato pasul
Verabbi lav talmideh derabbi shimon hu

Vehatanya amar rabbi keshehayinu lemedin tora etzel rabbi shimon bitkoa hayinu maalin lo shemen vaaluntit mechatzer legag umiggag lekarpef umikkarpef lekarpef acher ad sheanu maggiin lemayan sheanu rochatzin bo
Savar lah keidach derabbi shimon detanya amar rabbi shimon bo ure kamma chaviva mitzva bishatah shehare hekter chalavim veevarim kesherim kol hallayela velo haya mamtin lahen ad shettechshach
b: Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon la shemia leh
Ella shane hatam shehare dachata shechita et hashshabbat
Ulrabbi hachi name dachata shechita et hashshabbat ella kasavar rabbi ketzirat haomer la dachaya shabbat
Vela vehatnan vachachamim omrim echad shabbat veechad chol mishshalosh haya ba dela kerabbi
Vachachamim omrim echad shabbat veechad chol bishlosha beshalosh kuppot uvshalosh maggalot dela kerabbi
Uvshabbat yomar lahem shabbat zo dela kerabbi
Niktzar bayyom kasher vedoche et hashshabbat man shamatte leh deamar niktzar bayyom kasher rabbi vekatane vedoche et hashshabbat may lav ketzira lo lehakrava

Aval liktzira la vehatanya rabbi omer vayedabber moshe et moade Adonai ma talmud lomar lefi shello lamadnu ella letamid ufesach shenneemar bahen bemoado bemoado vaafilu beshabbat bemoado vaafilu betuma
Shear korbenot hatztzibbur minnayin talmud lomar elle taasu la bemoadechem
Minnayin lerabbot omer vehakkarev immo shette hallechem vehakkarev immahen talmud lomar vayedabber moshe et moade Adonai hakkatuv kava moed lechullan
Lemay ilema lehakrava shette hallechem bene hakrava ninhu
Ella peshita litchina veharkada vedichvatah gabbe omer liktzira veka dache et hashshabbat
Ella omer lehakrava ushte hallechem laafiyya vekasavar rabbi tannur mekaddesh i afe lah meetmol ipsila lah belina
Vesavar rabbi tannur mekaddesh vehatanya kivse atzeret en mekaddeshin et hallechem ella bishchita ketzad shechatan lishman vezarak daman lishman kadash hallechem
Shechatan shello lishman vezarak daman shello lishman lo kadash hallechem shechatan lishman vezarak daman shello lishman hallechem kadosh veeno kadosh divre rabbi
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer leolam eno kadosh ad sheyyishchot lishman veyizrok daman lishman
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hukbeu velo hukbeu ka amar
Hadaran alach rabbi yishmael

Matni veellu menachot nikmatzot ushyarehen lakkohanim minchat hassolet vehammachavat vehammarcheshet vehachallot veharkikin minchat goyim uminchat nashim uminchat haomer uminchat chote uminchat kenaot
Rabbi shimon omer minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet vekometz karev leatzmo veshirayim kerevim leatzman
Gema amar rav pappa kol hecha ditnan eser tenan may ka mashma lan
Leappoke merabbi shimon deamar mechetza challot umechetza rekikin yavi ka mashma lan dela
Ushyarehen lakkohanim menalan dichtiva ketiva udla ketiva ketiv bah vezot torat hammincha hakrev otah bene aharon vego vehannoteret mimmenna yochlu aharon uvanav
Baa chitin la kamibaya lan ki ka mibaya lan baa seorin baa seorin name middenikmetzet sheyareha lakkohanim
Alliba derabbanan la ka mibaya lan ki ka mibaya lan alliba derabbi shimon deamar ika mincha demikamtza vela mitachla
Ditnan rabbi shimon omer minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet hakkometz karev beatzmo vehashshirayim kerevin beatzman menalan

Amar chizkiyya deamar kera vechol mincha velula vashshemen vachareva lechol bene aharon tihye im eno inyan livlula shel chitin tenehu inyan livlula shel seorin veim eno inyan lachareva shel chitin tenehu inyan lachareva shel seorin
Vehay lehachi hu daata ha mibe leh lechidtanya minnayin sheen cholkin menachot keneged zevachim

a: Talmud lomar vechol hammincha asher teafe battannur lechol bene aharon tihye ish keachiv

Yachol lo yachleku menachot keneged zevachim shello kamu tachtehen bedallut aval yachleku menachot keneged ofot shehare kamu tachtehen bedallut talmud lomar vechol naasa bammarcheshet lechol bene aharon tihye

Yachol lo yachleku menachot keneged ofot shehallalu mine damim vehallalu mine kemachim yachleku ofot keneged zevachim shehallalu vehallalu mine damim talmud lomar veal machavat lechol bene aharon tihye

Yachol lo yachleku ofot keneged zevachim shehallalu asiyyatan bayyad vehallalu asiyyatan bichli aval yachleku menachot keneged menachot sheellu vaellu asiyyatan bayyad talmud lomar vechol mincha velula vashshemen lechol bene aharon tihye

Yachol lo yachleku machavat keneged marcheshet umarcheshet keneged machavat shezzo maaseha kashin vezo maaseha rakkin aval yachleku machavat keneged machavat umarcheshet keneged marcheshet talmud lomar vachareva lechol bene aharon tihye
Yachol lo yachleku bekodshe kadashim aval yachleku bekadashim kallim talmud lomar ish keachiv veim al toda keshem sheen cholkin bekodshe kadashim kach en cholkim bekadashim kallim
Ish ish cholek vaafilu baal mum veen katan cholek vaafilu tam
Hahu mikkol nafka veha appekteh lechidrabbi yose berabbi yehuda ella hahu mivechol
Ravina amar atya middetane levi detane levi lechol korbanam ulchol minchatam ulchol chattatam ulchol ashamam
Kol korbanam lerabbot log shemen shel metzora salka datach amena min haesh ketav rachamana ka mashma lan
Lechol minchatam lerabbot minchat haomer uminchat kenaot salka datach amena veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem amar rachamana vehay lehattir ka atya veidach name levarer ka atya ka mashma lan
Lechol chattotam lerabbot chattat haof salka datach amena nevela hi ka mashma lan
Lechol ashamam lerabbot asham nazir vaasham metzora asham metzora behedya ketiv beh ki kachattat haasham hu lakkohen
Ella lerabbot asham nazir kaasham metzora salka datach amena lehachshir ka ate ka mashma lan
Asher yashivu ze gezel hagger lecha hi ulvanecha shellecha hi ulvanecha afilu lekaddesh bo et haishsha
Amar rav huna
b: Shalme haggoy olot ibaet ema kera veibaet ema sevara ibaet ema sevara goy libbo lashshamayim
Veibaet ema kera asher yakrivu la leola kol dimkarvi ola leheve
Metiv rav chama bar gurya goy shehitnaddev lehavi shelamim netanan leyisrael yisrael ochlan netanan lechohen hakkohen ochlan
Amar rava hachi ka amar al menat sheyyitkapper bahen yisrael yisrael ochlan al menat sheyyitkapper bahen kohen kohen ochlan
Metiv rav shezvi ellu menachot nikmatzot ushyarehen lakkohanim minchat goyim amar rabbi yochanan la kashya ha rabbi yose haggelili ha rabbi akiva
Detanya ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot et haggoyim shennodrin nedarim undavot keyisrael
Asher yakrivu la leola en li ella ola shelamim minnayin talmud lomar nidrehem toda minnayin talmud lomar nidvotam
Minnayin lerabbot haofot vehayyayin vehallevona vehaetzim talmud lomar nidrehem lechol nidrehem nidvotam lechol nidvotam
Im ken ma talmud lomar ola ola perat linzirut divre rabbi yose haggelili rabbi akiva omer asher yakrivu la leola en li ella ola bilvad
Vehay perat linzirut mehacha nafka mehatam nafka dabber el bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir bene yisrael nodrin veen haggoyim nodrim
I mehatam hava amena korban hu dela layete aval nezirut chala alayehu ka mashma lan

Keman azla ha ditnan amar rabbi shimon shiva devarim hitkinu bet din veze echad mehen goy sheshshillach olato mimmedinat hayyam veshilach immah nesacheha kerevin mishshello veim lav kerevin mishshel tzibur
Lema rabbi yose haggelili vela rabbi akiva afilu tema rabbi akiva ola vechol chavratah avzaraha
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan ezrach ezrach mevi nesachim veen haggoy mevi nesachim yachol lo tehe olato teuna nesachim talmud lomar kacha manni la rabbi yose haggelili vela rabbi akiva
I rabbi yose haggelili ha amar afilu yayin name i rabbi akiva ha amar ola in mide acharina la
Ibaet ema rabbi yose haggelili veibaet ema rabbi akiva ibaet ema rabbi yose haggelili semi mehahi yayin veibaet ema rabbi akiva ola vechol chavratah avzaraha
Rabbi shimon omer minchat chote shel kohanim vechu mena hane mile
Detanu rabbanan vehayeta lakkohen kammincha shettehe avodatah keshera bo
Atta omer shettehe avodatah keshera bo o eno ella lehattir minchat chote shel kohanim uma ani mekayyem vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel minchat nidvato aval chovato tehe neechelet

Talmud lomar vehayeta lakkohen kammincha makkish chovato lenidvato ma nidvato enah neechelet af chovato enah neechelet amar rabbi shimon vechi neemar vehayeta lakkohen keminchato vahalo lo neemar ella kammincha ella lehakkish

a: Minchat chote shel kohanim keminchat chote shel yisrael ma minchat chote shel yisrael nikmetzet af minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet
I ma minchat chote shel yisrael nikmetzet ushyareha neechalin af minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet ushyareha neechalin
Talmud lomar lakkohen kammincha lakkohen kammincha velo laishshim kammincha ha ketzad kometz karev beatzmo veshirayim kerevin beatzman
Ha shettehe avodatah keshera bo mehacha nafka
Mehatam nafka minnayin lakkohen shebba umakriv korbenotav bechol et uvchol shaa sheyyirtze talmud lomar uva bechol avat nafsho vesheret
I mehatam hava amena hane mile davar sheen ba al chet aval davar shebba al chet ema la
Veha name mehacha nafka mehatam nafka vechipper hakkohen al hannefesh hashshogeget becheta vishgaga melammed shehakkohen mitkapper al yede atzmo
I mehahu hava amena hane mile beshogeg aval bemezid la ka mashma lan
Bemezid hechi mashkachatte lah bizdon shevua

Tanya idach rabbi shimon omer minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet vehakkometz karev bifne atzmo vehashshirayim kerevin bifne atzman rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer hakkometz karev beatzmo vehashshirayim mitpazzerin al bet haddeshen
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba have bah rabbi yochanan bet haddeshen dehecha i dilmala hayenu avuh i dilmatta yesh lecha davar shekkarev lematta
Amar leh rabbi abba dilma leibud achichu aleh vechi yesh lecha davar shekkarev leibud
Tane avuh derabbi avin kol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel laachila hikkashtiha velo ledavar acher
May ka amar amar abbaye hachi ka amar kol minchat kohen lo teachel chovato kalil tihye nidvato amar leh rava sakkina charifa mafseka kerae
Ella amar rava kol minchat kohen kalil tihye nidvato lo teachel chovato
Veefoch ana mistabbera nidvato hava leh lerabboye shekken tedira la chate besim recheh
Adderabba chovato hava leh lerabboye shekken issaron chova hanach nefishan
Verabbanan hay kol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel may avdi leh
Mibe lehu lechidtanya en li ella elona bechalil toktar vetachtona belo teachel
Minnayin liten et haamur shel ze baze veet haamur shel ze baze talmud lomar kalil kalil ligzera shava neemar kan kalil veneemar lehallan kalil
Ma lehallan bechalil toktar af kan bechalil toktar uma kan liten lo taase al achilato af lehallan liten lo taase al achilato
Bae ravina kohen sheachal min haemurin ma hu lav dezarut
b: La ka mibaya li ki ka mibbaya li lav dechalil tihye may
Amar rav aharon leravina ta shema detanya rabbi eliezer omer kol shehu bechalil tihye liten lo taase al achilato

Matni minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim lammizbeach veen bahen lakkohanim uvaze yippa koach mizbeach mikkoach hakkohanim shette hallechem velechem happanim neechalin lakkohanim veen bahem lammizbeach uvaze yippa koach hakkohanim mikkoach hammizbeach
Gema vetu leka veha ika ola ika orah lakkohanim veha ika olat haof ika mura venotza veha ika nesachim leshitin azli
Umay bazo leappoke middishmuel deamar shemuel hammitnaddev yayin mevio umzallefo al gabbe ishim ka mashma lan dilshitin azli
Mesayya leh lishmuel deamar shemuel hammitnaddev shemen komtzo ushyarav neechalin
Shette hallechem velechem happanim vetu leka veha ika chattat haof ika damah
Vehaika log shemen shel metzora ika mattenotav
Umay bazo leappoke mimman deamar shette hallechem habbaot bifne atzman lisrefa atyan kamashma lan devazo yippa koach kohanim leolam
Matni kol hammenachot hannaasot bichli teunot shelosha mattanot shemen yetzika uvlila umattan shemen bichli kodem laasiyyatan
Challot bollan divre rabbi vachachamim omrim solet hachallot teunot belila urkikin meshicha ketzad moshchan kemin ki vehashshear neechalin lakkohanim
Gema lemaote may amar rav pappa lemaote minchat maafe
Tanu rabbanan veim minchat marcheshet korbanecha solet bashshemen tease melammed shetteuna mattan shemen bichli korbanecha korbanecha ligzera shava

a: Ma kan mattan shemen bichli af lehallan mattan shemen bichli uma lehallan yetzika uvlila af kan yetzika uvlila
Challot bollan divre rabbi vachachamim omrim solet

Tanu rabbanan solet belula melammed shennivlelet solet rabbi omer challot bollan shenneemar challot belulot amru lo vahalo lachme toda neemar bahen challot vei efshar levollan keshehen challot ella solet
Ketzad ose noten shemen bichli kodem laasiyyatan venotnah venoten shemen aleha uvollah velashah veofah ufottah venoten aleha shemen vekometz

Rabbi omer challot bollan shenneemar challot belulot bashshemen ketzad ose noten shemen bichli kodem laasiyyatah venotnah velashah veofah ufottah venoten aleha shemen uvollah vechozer venoten aleha shemen vekometz
I efshar dekaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi may hi amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak reviit shemen hi heach mitchalleket lechamma challot

Hachallot teunot belila urkikin meshicha tanu rabbanan challot belulot velo rekikin belulin sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma challot sheenan teunot meshicha teunot belila rekikin shetteunin meshicha eno din shetteunin belila talmud lomar challot belulot velo rekikin belulin

Rekikin meshuchin velo challot meshuchot sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma rekikin sheenan teunin belila teunin meshicha challot shetteunot belila eno din shetteunot meshicha talmud lomar rekikin meshuchim velo challot meshuchot
May talmuda amar rava la lishtemit velichtov challot meshuchot urkikin belulin
Ketzad moshchan kemin ki vehashshear neechal vechu may kemin ki amar rav kahana kemin ki yevani
Tanu rabbanan mincha habbaa mechetza challot umechetza rekikin mevi log shemen vechotzehu chetzo lachallot vechetzo larkikin

Vechallot bollan urkikin moshchan umosheach et harakik al pene kullo ushar hashshemen machziro lachallot rabbi shimon ben yehuda mishshum rabbi shimon omer moshchan kemin ki ushar hashshemen neechal lakkohanim

Tanya idach rekikin habbaim bifne atzman mevi log shemen umoshchan vechozer umoshchan ad sheyyichle kol shemen shebballog rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon moshchan kemin ki ushar hashshemen neechal lakkohanim
Matni kol hammenachot hannaasot bichli teunot petita
Gema lemaote may amar rav pappa lemaote shette hallechem velechem happanim
Tanu rabbanan patot otah pittim mincha lerabbot kol hammenachot liftita yachol sheani merabbe af shette hallechem velechem happanim talmud lomar otah
Veyatzakta shamen mincha lerabbot kol hammenachot litzika yachol sheani merabbe af minchat maafe talmud lomar aleha shamen
Otzi et hachallot velo otzi et harkikin talmud lomar hi may talmuda ema lehotzi minchat kohanim
b: Amar rabba ezehu davar shetztzarich shene miutin heve omer zo minchat maafe

Matni minchat yisrael kofel echad lishnayim ushnayim learbaa umavdil minchat kohanim kofel echad lishnayim ushnayim learbaa veeno mavdil minchat kohen mashiach lo haya mekappela rabbi shimon omer minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach en bahen petita mippene sheen bahen kemitza vechol sheen bahen kemitza en bahen petita vechullan pottan kezetim
Gema tanu rabbanan patot yachol lishnayim talmud lomar pittim i pittim yachol yaasenna perurin talmud lomar otah otah liftitim velo petita liftitim

Ha ketzad minchat yisrael kofel echad lishnayim ushnayim learbaa umavdil minchat kohanim vechohen mashiach haya mekappela vechu veha anan tenan lo haya mekappela amar rabba eno mekappela learbaa aval mekappela lishnayim

Rabbi shimon omer minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach en bahen petita amar rav yosef hay chavitza deit bah perurin kezayit mevarchinan aleh hammotzi lechem min haaretz i let bah perurin kezayit mevarchinan aleh bore mine mezonot
Amar rav yosef mena amena lah detanya haya omed umakriv menachot birushalayim omer baruch shehecheyanu vekiyemanu netalan leochlan omer hammotzi lechem min haaretz utnan vechullan petitim bichzayit
Amar leh abbaye ultanna deve rabbi yishmael deamar mefarchan ad shemmachziran lesoltan hachi name dela mevarech hammotzi
Vechi tema hachi name vehatanya liket mikkullan kezayit vaachalo im chametz hu anush karet im matztza hu adam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach
Hacha bemay askinan besheersan
I hachi hayenu dekatane alah vehu sheachalan bichde achilat peras vei besheersan sheachalo mibe leh ella hacha bemay askinan beva millechem gadol
May have alah rav sheshet amar afilu perurin sheen bahen kezayit amar rava vehu deika torita denahma alayehu

a: Matni kol hammenachot teunot shelosh meot shifa vachamesh meot beita shifa uvita bachitin verabbi yose omer babbatzek kol hammenachot baot eser eser chutz millechem happanim vachavite kohen gadol shehem baot shettem esre divre rabbi yehuda rabbi meir omer kullam baot shettem esre chutz mechallot toda unzirut shehen baot eser eser
Gema tana shaf achat boet shettayim shaf shettayim boet shalosh bae rabbi yirmeya amtoye veetoye chad o dilma amtoye veetoye tere may teku
Shifa uvita bachitin rabbi yose omer babbatzek ibaya lehu babbatzek velo bachitin o dilma af babbatzek ta shema detanya shifa uvita bachitin rabbi yose omer shifa uvita babbatzek
Kol hammenachot baot ku shettem esre lechem happanim behedya ketiv beh
Chavite kohen gadol atya chukka chukka millechem happanim
Kol hammenachot devaot eser eser menalan gamar millachme toda ma lehallan eser af kan eser velelaf millechem happanim ma lehallan shettem esre af kan shettem esre
Mistabbera millachme toda hava leh lemelaf shekken yachid hammitnaddev shemen nifsal shello beshabbat veshello betuma
Adderabba millechem happanim hava leh lemelaf shekken hekdesh ulvona matztza vaetzem
Hanach nefishan
Vei sevira lan davar hallamed bigzera shava chozer umlammed bevinyan av nelaf mechavite kohen gadol ma lehallan shettem esre af kan shettem esre
Mistabbera millachme toda hava leh lemelaf shekken hedot shehitnaddev chatzain
Lefigul shello beshabbat veshello betuma
Adderabba mechavite kohen gadol hava leh lemelaf shekken issaron keli hekdesh ulvona
Matztza vaetzem haggasha veishim vehane nefishan
Hedot mehedot adif leh
Rabbi meir omer kullan baot shettem esre may kasavar i sevira leh dedavar hallamed bigzera shava chozer umlammed bevinyan av yalef mechavite chohen gadol dehane nefishan
I sevira leh dedavar hallamed bigzera shava eno chozer umlammed bevinyan av yalef millechem happanim hekdesh mehekdesh adif leh
Chutz millachme toda unzirut shehen baot eser eser lachme toda behedya ketiv behu
Nezirut deamar mar shelamav lerabbot shalme nazir
Amar rav tovi bar kisna amar shemuel lachme toda sheafaan arba challot yatza veha baenan arbaim lemitzva
Veha bae afroshe teruma minayehu vechi tema demafresh mikkol chada vachada echad amar rachamana shello yittol parus deafreshinhu belesha
Metivi kol hammenachot sheriba bemiddat challatan o shemmiet bemiddat challatan kesherot chutz millechem happanim vachavite kohen gadol velachme toda unzirut hu
b: Deamar ki hay tanna detanya kol hammenachot sheriba bemiddat challatan o shemmiet bemiddat challatan kesherot chutz millechem happanim vachavite kohen gadol veyesh omrim af lachme toda unzirut
Amar rav huna minchat maafe sheafaah challa achat yatza may tama matztzot matztzat ketiv
Matkef lah rav pappa tama dichtiv matztzat ha ketiv matztzot la veha gabbe lachme toda dichtiv matztzot veamar rav tovi bar kisna amar shemuel lachme toda sheafaan arba challot yatza hahi peliga
Matni haomer haya ba issaron mishshalosh sein shette hallechem shette esronim mishshalosh sein lechem happanim esrim vearba esronim meesrim vearba sein
Gema may tama kevan demechadash ate umisseorin ate issaron muvchar la ate ella mishshalosh sein
Shette hallechem shette esronot mishshalosh sein kevan demechitin atyan af al gav demechadash atyan shette esronot atu mishshalosh sein
Lechem happanim esrim vearbaa esronot meesrim vearbaa sein may tama kevan demechitin atu umiyyashan atu issaron muvchar ate missea
Tanu rabbanan kol hammenachot sheriba bemiddat esronan o shemmiet bemiddat issaron pesulot riba bemiddat sein shellahen o shemmiet bemiddat sein shellahen kesherot

Matni haomer haya menuppe bishlosh esre nafa shette hallechem bishtem esre velechem happanim beachat esre rabbi shimon omer lo haya lahen kitzva ella solet menuppa kal tzorkah haya mevi shenneemar velakachta solet veafita otah ad shettehe menuppa kal tzorkah
Gema tanu rabbanan beddakka begassa beddakka begassa rabbi shimon ben elazar omer shelosh esre nafot hau bammikdash zo lemala mizzo vezo lemala mizzo elona koletet subbin tachtona koletet solet
Rabbi shimon omer lo haya lahen kitzva tanu rabbanan solet veafita otah melammed shennikkachat solet
Uminnayin sheafilu chitin talmud lomar velakachta mikkol makom yachol af bishar menachot ken talmud lomar otah mippene hachisachon
Amar rabbi elazar may mippene hachisachon amar rabbi elazar hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael hecha remiza dichtiv vehishkita et haeda veet beiram
Hadaran alach ellu menachot nikmatzot
Matni hattoda hayeta baa chamesh sein yerushalmiyyot shehen shesh midbariyyot shette efot haefa shalosh sein esrim issaron asara lechametz vaasara lammatztza

a: Asara lechametz issaron lechalla vaasara lematztza uvmatztza shalosh minin challot rekikin urvucha nimtzeu shelosha esronim ushlish lechol min umin veshalosh challot leissaron

Uvmidda yerushalmit hau sheloshim kav chamishsha asar lechametz vachamishsha asar lematztza chamishsha asar lechametz kav umechetza lechalla chamishsha asar lematztza uvmatztza shalosh minin challot urkikin urvucha nimtzeu chameshet kabbin lechol min umin ushte challot lekav
Gema hattoda hayeta baa chamesh sein yerushalmiyyot mena hane mile amar rav chisda deamar kera haefa vehabbat tochen echad yihye lachem ma bat shalosh sein af efa shalosh sein
Uvat gufah menalan ilema middichtiv laset et masar hachomer habbat efa name hachtiv vaasirit hachomer haefa ella chomer la yadana kamma hacha name la yadana kamma
Ella mehacha vechok hashshemen habbat hashshemen umasar habbat min hakkor aseret habbattim chomer ki aseret habbattim chomer
Amar shemuel en mosifin al hammiddot yoter mishshetut velo al hammatbea yoter mishshetut vehammistakker lo yistakker yoter mishshetut
May tama ilema mishshum afkoe tara i hachi shetut name la
Ella mishshum onaa ki hechi dela leheve bitul mikkach veha amar rava kol davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan afilu pachot mikkede onaa chozer
Ella mishshum taggara ki hechi dela limteyeh deyana deyana hu dela limteyeh revacha la bae zeven vezabben taggara ikri
Ella amar rav chisda shemuel kera ashkach udrash hashshekel esrim gera esrim shekalim chamishsha veesrim shekalim asara vachamishsha shekel hammane yihye lachem mane matan vearbein hau
Ella shema minah telat shema minah mane shel kodesh kaful haya ushma minah mosifin al hammiddot veen mosifin yoter mishshetut ushma minah shetuta millevar
Amar ravina matnitin name dayeka dekatane toda hayeta baa chamesh sein yerushalmiyyot shehen shesh midbariyyot shema minah
b: Matni mikkullam haya notel echad measara teruma shenneemar vehikriv mimmennu echad mikkol korban teruma la echad shello yittol parus mikkol korban sheyehu kol hakkarbanot shavin shello yittol mikkorban al chavero lakkohen hazzorek et dam hashshelamim lo yihye vehashshear neechal labbealim

Gema tanu rabbanan vehikriv mimmennu min hamchubbar echad shello yittol parus mikkol korban sheyehu kol hakkarbanot shaot shaviyn shello yittol min hakkorban al chavero teruma la eni yodea mikkamma hi
Hareni dan neemar kan teruma veneemar bitrumat maaser teruma ma lehallan echad measara af kan echad measara
O kelach lederech zo neemar kan teruma veneemar bevikkurim teruma ma lehallan en lah shiur af kan en lah shiur
Nire lemi dome danin teruma sheen achareha teruma mitteruma sheen achareha teruma veal yochiach bikkurim sheyyesh acharehen teruma
O kelach lederech zo danin teruma hanneechelet bemakom kadosh mitteruma hanneechelet bemakom kadosh veal tochiach terumat maaser shenneechelet bechol makom
Talmud lomar mimmennu teruma la uchtiv bitrumat maaser mimmennu teruma ligzera shava
Lamadnu litruma shehi echad measara aval eni yodea mikkamma hi challa hareni dan neemar kan lechem veneemar lehallan bishte hallechem lechem ma lehallan issaron lechalla af kan issaron lechalla
O kelach lederech zo neemar kan lechem veneemar belechem happanim lechem ma lehallan shene esronot af kan shene esronot
Nire lemi dome danin mincha habbaa chametz im hazzevach mimmincha habbaa chametz im hazzevach veal yochiach lechem happanim sheeno ba chametz im hazzevach

O kelach lederech zo danin mincha habbaa mearetz vechutza laaretz min hechadash umin hayyashan mimmincha habbaa mearetz vechutza laaretz min hechadash umin hayyashan veal yochichu shette hallechem sheen baot ella min hechadash umin haaretz

Talmud lomar mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa shettayim sheen talmud lomar taviu uma talmud lomar taviu shekkol ma sheatta mevi mimmakom acher hare hu kaze ma lehallan issaron lechalla af kan issaron lechalla
I ma lehallan shene esronot af kan shene esronot talmud lomar tihyena
Lamadnu asara lechametz asara lematztza minnayin talmud lomar al challot lechem chametz
Neged chametz have matztza nimtzeu esrim esronot lachme toda asara lechametz vaasara lematztza

Yachol asara shebbematztza lo yehu kullan ella mimmin echad talmud lomar im al toda yakrivennu vehikriv al zevach hattoda challot matztzot belulot bashshemen urkike matztzot meshuchim bashshamen solet murbechet vego nimtzeu shelosha esronim ushlish lechol min umin veshalosh challot leissaron venimtzeu lachme toda arbaim notel mehen arba venoten lechohen vehashshear neechalim labbealim
Amar mar vehikriv mimmennu min hamchubbar ella meatta dichtiv veet kol chelbo yarim mimmennu hatam may mechubbar ika
Kidrav chisda amar avimi deamar rav chisda amar avimi shello yenatteach basar kodem sheyyittol emurin
Amar mar neemar kan teruma veneemar bitrumat maaser teruma
Venelaf mitterumat midyan danin teruma hannoheget ledorot mitteruma hannoheget ledorot veal tochiach terumat midyan sheenah noheget ledorot
Venelaf mitterumat challa tana deve rabbi yishmael danin davar shenneemar bo mimmennu terumat Adonai middavar shenneemar bo teruma la leappoke terumat challa delo neemar bo mimmennu teruma la
Bae rava terumat lachme toda chayyavin alehen mita vachomesh o en chayyavin alehen mita vachomesh
Kevan deitakkash litrumat maaser kitrumat maaser dame o dilma bo vachamishshito miet rachamana
Medammaat o enah medammaat teku
Amar mar talmud lomar tihyena may talmuda

a: Amar rav yitzchak bar avdimi tihyena ketiv ema asara kefize amar rava beesronot dibber hakkatuv
Lamadnu asara lechametz asara lematztza minnayin talmud lomar al challot lechem chametz keneged chametz have matztza
Vechi davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh hemennu vedavar acher hu vechol hemennu vedavar acher la have hekesh
Hanicha leman deamar la have hekesh ella leman deamar have hekesh may ika lememar taviu ribbuya hi
Matni hammiluim hau bain kammatztza shebbattoda challot urkikin urvicha urvucha
Nezirut hayeta baa shette yadot kematztza shel toda challot urkikin veen bah revucha nimtza asara kabbin yerushalmit shehen shishsha esronot veodyin

Gema mena hane mile amar rav chisda amar rav chama bar gurya deamar kera umissal hammatztzot asher lifne Adonai lakach challat matztza achat vechallat lechem shemen achat verakik echad bishlama challot challot rakik rakik shemen may ninhu lav revucha
Matkef lah rav aveya ema anta demishcha ella kiddaresh rav nachman bar rav chisda mishshemeh derabbi tavla ze korban aharon uvanav asher yakrivu la beom himmashach oto
Vechi ma lamadnu levanav beom himmashcho ella makkish chinucho lehimmashcho ma himmashcho revucha af chinucho revucha
Amar rav chisda kohen gadol hammitkarev laavoda tzarich shette esronot haefa achat lehimmashcho veachat lechinucho mar bar rav ashe amar shalosh
Vela peligi ha daavad avoda keshehu kohen hedot ha dela avad avoda keshehu kohen hedot
Nezirut hayeta baa shette yadot kammatztza shebbattoda
Tanu rabbanan shelamav lerabbot shalme nazir laaseret kabbin yerushalmiyyot velirviit shemen
Yachol lechol ma sheamur bainyan talmud lomar matztzot

May talmuda amar rav pappa davar shenneemar bo matztzot leappoke revucha delo neemar bo matztzot deve rabbi yishmael tana matztzot kalal challot urkikin parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat challot urkikin in mide acharina la
b: Matni hashshochet et hattoda lifnim velachmah chutz lachoma lo kadash hallechem shechatah ad shello karmu paneha battannur vaafilu karmu kullan chutz meechad mehen lo kadash hallechem
Gema may chutz lachoma rabbi yochanan amar chutz lechomat bet page veresh lakish amar chutz lechomat haazara
Resh lakish amar chutz lechomat haazara baenan al besamuch
Verabbi yochanan amar chutz lechomat bet page aval chutz laazara kadosh vela baenan al besamuch
Veha ipligu bah chada zimna

Ditnan hashshochet et happesach al hechametz over belo taase rabbi yehuda omer af hattamid veamar resh lakish leolam eno chayyav ad sheyehe o lashshochet o lazzorek o leechad mibbene chavura immo baazara verabbi yochanan amar af al pi sheen immo baazara
Tzericha dei itmar behahi behahi ka amar rabbi yochanan dechol hecha deiteh beisura kae aval leinyan mikdash lechem ema mode leh leresh lakish dei iteh bifnim kadosh abbaray lo kadosh
Vei itmar beha beha kaamar resh lakish aval behach ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan tzericha
Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan hashshochet et hattoda lifnim velachmah chutz lechomat bet page lo kadash hallechem
Shechatah ad shello karmu paneha battannur

Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan al challot lechem chametz yakriv korbano al zevach melammed sheen hallechem kadosh ella im ken karmu paneha battannur yakriv korbano al zevach melammed sheen hallechem kadosh ella bishchitat hazzevach zevach todat melammed sheim shachat shello lishman lo kadash hallechem
Tanu rabbanan yotzin bematztza na uvmatztza haasuya beilpas may matztza na amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol shepporsah veen chutin nimshachin hemenna
Amar rava vechen leinyan lachme toda peshita hacha lechem ketiv vehacha lechem ketiv
Mahu detema echad amar rachamana shello yittol parus veha keman difrisa damya kamashma lan
Itmar toda sheshshechatah al shemonim challot chizkiyya amar kadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim verabbi yochanan amar lo kadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim

Amar rabbi zera hakkol modim hecha deamar likdeshu arbaim mittoch shemonim kadshu al yikdeshu arbaim ella im ken yikdeshu shemonim lo kadshu ki peligi bistama mar savar leachraut ka mikaven umar savar lekorban gadol ka mikaven

Abbaye amar dechulle alma leachraut ka mikaven uvichle sharet mekaddeshin shello middaat ka mipalgi mar savar kele sharet mekaddeshin shello middaat umar savar kele sharet en mekaddeshin shello middaat

Rav pappa amar dechulle alma kele sharet mekaddeshin shello middaat vehacha besakkin ka mipalgi mar savar sakkin mekaddeshet kichli sharet umar savar sakkin kevan delet leh toch enah mekaddeshet kichli sharet

Veika deamri rav pappa amar dechulle alma kele sharet en mekaddeshin ella middaat vehacha besakkin ka mipalgi mar savar sakkin allima mikkeli sharet deaf al gav delet lah toch mekaddesha umar savar sakkin la allima lah mikkeli sharet
Matni shechatah chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah kadash hallechem shechatah venimtzet terefa lo kadash hallechem
Shechatah venimtzet baalat mum rabbi eliezer omer kadash vachachamim omrim lo kadash
Shechatah shello lishmah vechen el hammiluim vechen shene kivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello lishman lo kadash hallechem
Gema matnitin manni rabbi meir

Detanya ze hakkelal kol sheppisulo kodem shechita lo kadash hallechem pisulo achar shechita kadash hallechem shechatah chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah kadash hallechem shechatah venimtzet terefa lo kadash hallechem

a: Shechatah venimtzet baalat mum rabbi eliezer omer kadash rabbi yehoshua omer lo kadash divre rabbi meir

Amar rabbi yehuda lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al sheshshechatah venimtzet terefa shello kadash veal chutz lizmanno shekkadash veal baal mum shello kadash veal ma nechleku al chutz limkomo sherabbi eliezer omer kadash verabbi yehoshua omer lo kadash

Amar rabbi eliezer hoil vechutz lizmanno pasul vechutz limkomo pasul ma chutz lizmanno kadash af chutz limkomo kadash amar rabbi yehoshua hoil vechutz limkomo pasul uvaal mum pasul ma baal mum lo kadash af chutz limkomo lo kadash
Amar lo rabbi eliezer ani dimmitihu lechutz lizmanno veatta dimmito levaal mum nire lemi dome im dome lechutz lizmanno nedunennu mechutz lizmanno im dome levaal mum nedunennu mibbaal mum
Hitchil rabbi eliezer ladun danin pesul machshava mippesul machshava veen danin pesul machshava mippesul hagguf

Hitchil rabbi yehoshua ladun danin pesul sheen bo karet mippesul sheen bo karet veal yochiach chutz lizmanno sheppesul sheyyesh bo karet veod nedunennu mishshello lishmo sheppesul machshava veen bo karet
Veshatak rabbi eliezer
Verabbi meir may shena shechatah venimtzet terefa dehave pesulo kodem shechita umay shena shechatah venimtzet baalat mum dela have pesulo kodem shechita
Bedukkin shebbaayin vealliba derabbi akiva deamar im alu lo yerdu verabbi yehoshua ki amar rabbi akiva im alu lo yerdu bifsula degufeh aval lekaddoshe lechem la
Itmar chattat sheshshechatah chutz lizmannah im alta lo tered chutz limkomah rava amar tered rabba amar lo tered
Rava kerabbi yehoshua verabba kerabbi eliezer
Vahadar beh rabba legabbeh derava middahadar beh rabbi eliezer legabbeh derabbi yehoshua

Veika deamri af al gav dahadar beh rabbi eliezer legabbeh derabbi yehoshua rabba legabbeh derava la hadar beh hatam hu dekaamar leh nedunennu mishshello lishmo aval hacha i dayenatte leh mishshello lishmo im alta lo tered
Shechatah shello lishmah vechu amar rav pappa shevak tanna didan el nazir dishchiach venaket el hammiluim vetanna didan ikar milta naket
Matni hannesachim shekkadshu bichli venimtza zevach pasul im yesh zevach acher yakrivu immo veim lav yippaslu belina
Gema amar zeeri en hannesachim mitkaddeshin ella bishchitat hazzevach may tama amar kera zevach unsachim
Tenan hannesachim shekkadshu bichli venimtza zevach pasul im yesh zevach acher yikrevu immo veim lav yippaslu belina
May lav deipsil bishchita la deipsil bizrika
Keman kerabbi deamar shene devarim hammattirin maalin ze belo ze
Afilu tema rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hacha bemay askinan kegon shekkibel daman bechos venishpach
b: Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar lah kevateh daavuh deamar kol haomed lizrok kezaruk dame

Amar mar im yesh zevach acher yikrevu immo veha amar rav chisda shemen shehifrisho leshum mincha zo pasul leshum mincha acheret amar rabbi yannay lev bet din matne alehem im hutzrechu hutzrechu veim lav yehu lezevach acher
I hachi shemen name shemen gufah demincha hu
Velatno alehen denipku lechullin gezera shemma yomru motziin mikkele sharet lachol
Hashta name gezera shemma yomru nesachim shehifrishan leshum zevach ze kesherin leshum zevach acher
Hatane mattitya ben yehuda kegon shehaya zevach zavuach beotah shaa

Aval en zevach zavuach beotah shaa may nifsal belina addetane sefa im lav yippaslu belina liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim shehaya zevach zavuach beotah shaa aval en zevach zavuach beotah shaa lo
Hachi name ka amar bamme devarim amurim shehaya zevach zavuach beotah shaa aval en zevach zavuach beotah shaa naasa kemi shennifselu belina ufsulin
Umi it leh lerabbi shimon ben elazar lev bet din matne alehen
Veha amar rav idi bar avin amar rav amram amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan temidin shello hutzrechu latztzibur ledivre rabbi shimon en nifdin temimim ledivre chachamim nifdin temimim
Shane hatam deit lehu takkanta biriyya

Matni velad toda utmuratah hifrish toda veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha enah teuna lechem shenneemar vehikriv al zevach hattoda hattoda teuna lechem velo veladah velo chilufah velo temuratah teunin lechem

Gema tanu rabbanan mahu omer toda yakriv im al toda yakriv minnayin lemafrish todato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzet harishona vahare shettehen omdot minnayin sheeze mehen sheyyirtze yakriv velachmah immah talmud lomar hattoda yakriv

Yachol shettehe sheniyya teuna lechem talmud lomar yakrivennu echad velo shenayim achar sheriba hakkatuv umiet minnayin lerabbot veladot vachalifot utmurot lehakrava talmud lomar im al toda yachol yehu teunot lechem talmud lomar vehikriv al zevach hattoda toda teuna lechem velo veladah velo chilufah velo temuratah teunin lechem
Shelach rav chanina mishshemeh derabbi yochanan lo shanu ella leachar kappara aval lifne chappara teunin lechem
Have bah rav amram aheya ilema achalife todat chova i lifne chappara tenena i leachar kappara tenena

a: Ella achalife toda nedava ben lifne chappara ben leachar kappara teunot lechem marbe betodot hu
Ella avvelad toda nedava ben lifne chappara ben leachar kappara en teunin lechem motar detoda hi ella avvelad toda chova lifne chappara taun lechem leachar kappara en taun lechem
May ka mashma lan dekasavar rabbi yochanan adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh have bah name abbaye ki hay gavena

Itmar name amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan chilufe toda nedava ben lifne chappara ben leachar kappara teuna lechem marbe betodot hu velad toda nedava ben lifne chappara ben leachar kappara en taun lechem motar detoda hu velad toda chova lifne chappara teunin lechem leachar kappara en teunin lechem
Amar shemuel kol shebbechattat meta betoda en teuna lechem kol shebbechattat roa battoda teuna lechem

Metiv rav amram mahu omer hattoda yakriv minnayin lemafrish todato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzet harishona vahare shettehen omdot minnayin sheezo mehen sheyyirtze yakriv velachmah immah talmud lomar hattoda yakriv yachol tehe sheniyya teuna lechem talmud lomar yakrivennu echad velo shenayim

Veilu gabbe chattat ki hay gavena roa ditnan hifrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzet harishona vahare shettehen omdot mitkapper beachat mehen ushniyya tamut divre rabbi vachachamim omrim en chattat meta ella shennimtzet leachar shennitkapperu bealim ha kodem shennitkapperu bealim roa
Shemuel kerabbi sevira leh deamar avuda bishat hafrasha meta
Ella roa lerabbi hechi mashkachatte lah kidrabbi oshaya deamar rabbi oshaya hifrish shette chattaot leachraut mitkapper beeze mehen sheyyirtze vehashsheniyya tire
Veha gabbe toda ki hay gavena en teuna lechem ella shemuel kerabbi shimon sevira leh deamar chamesh chattaot metot
Veha roa lerabbi shimon let leh kelal
Shemuel name chada kaamar kol shebbechattat meta betoda en teuna lechem may ka mashma lan leappoke midderabbi yochanan deamar adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh kamashma lan dela
Amar rabbi abba zo toda vezo lachmah avad hallechem mevi lechem acher avda toda eno mevi toda acheret may tama lechem liglal toda veen toda liglal lechem
Veamar rava hifrish maot letodato
b: Venittotru mevi bahen lechem lelachme toda venittotru en mevi bahen toda

May tama ilema mishshum derav kahana deamar rav kahana minnayin lelachme toda shennikreu toda shenneemar vehikriv al zevach hattoda challot matztzot i hachi ipcha name lechem ikri toda toda la ikray lechem

Veamar rava hifrish todato veavda vechazar vehifrish acheret tachteha veavda vechazar vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzeu harishonot vahare sheloshtan omdot nitkapper barishona sheniyya enah teuna lechem shelishit teuna lechem

Nitkapper bashshelishit sheniyya enah teuna lechem rishona teuna lechem baemtzait shettehen en teunot lechem abbaye amar afilu nitkapper beachat mehen shettehen en teunot lechem kullehu chalifin dahadade ninhu

Amar rabbi zera vechen leinyan chattaot hifrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzeu harishonot vahare sheloshtan omdot nitkapper barishona sheniyya tamut shelishit tire
Nitkapper bashshelishit sheniyya tamut verishona tire nitkapper baemtzait shettehen yamutu abbaye amar afilu nitkapper beachat mehen shettehen yamutu kullehu chalifin dahadade ninhu
May vechen mahu detema hatam hu deika lememar marbe betodot hu aval hacha deleka lememar marbe bechattaot hu ema la ka mashma lan
Tane rabbi chiyya toda shennitarva bitmuratah umeta achat mehen chavertah en lah takkana hechi naaved nakrev lechem bahadah dilma temura hi la nakrev lechem bahadah dilma toda hi
Hechi dame i deamar alay la saggi dela mayete leh behema acharina velechem velema i hach dekayema temura hi ha toda veha lachmah i hach dekayema toda hi ha lachmah veha tehve achraut
La tzericha deamar hare zo
Siman lemudim midat illa sheyyesh shekken dedamah dei chalash motar temura bachutz chizkiyya hifrish chattat leachar yoter
Amru lemedin lifne rabbi velayete lechem velema i hach dekayema toda hi ha lachmah i la lipok lechullin amar lehu vechi machnisin chullin laazara
Velayete behema velechem velema i hach dekayema temura hi ha toda veha lachmah i hach dekayema toda hi ha lachmah veha tihve shelamim amar lehu mishshum deka memaet baachila dishlamim

Amar levi lerabbi velayete behema velechem velema i hach dekayema temura hi ha toda veha lachmah vei hay dekayema toda hi ha lachmah veha tehve motar detoda amar leh kimdumme ani sheen lo moach bekodkodo

a: Vechi mafrishin techilla lemotarot

Yatev rabbi yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta kammeh derav nachman veyatev vekaamar velayete behema velechem velema i hach dekayema temura hi ha toda veha lachmah vei hach dekayema toda hi ha lachmah veha tihve temura
Amar leh ani mari arbein bechatpeh vechasher

Rav ila chalash al legabbeh abbaye verabbanan veyatvi veka amri im itah lidrabbi yochanan deamar chutz lechomat haazara kadosh layete lechem velotvah chutz lechomat haazara velema i hach dekayema toda hi ha lachmah vei la lipok lechullin
Mishshum deika arba lehanif hechi lebed lanfinhu abbaray lifne Adonai ketiv gavay ka meayyel chullin laazara hilkach la efshar

Matkef lah rav shisha bereh derav idi im itah lidchizkiyya deamar kadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim layete behema velayete shemonim bahadah velema i hach dekayema toda hi ha name tehve toda veha shemonim detarvayehu i hach dekayema temura hi ha toda veha lachmah velikdeshu lehu arbaim mittoch shemonim
Mishshum deka memaet baachila dearbaim

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana im ita lidrabbi yochanan deamar hifrish chattat meubberet veyalda ratza bah mitkapper ratza biveladah mitkapper layete behema meubberet veyamtin lah ad shetteled velayete shemonim bahadah velema i hach dekayema temura hi ha uveladah toda hi veha shemonim detarvayehu vei hach dekayema toda hi ha name toda hi veha shemonim detarvayehu hu vehay leheve motar detoda
Amar leh man lema lan deamar rabbi yochanan im shiyero meshuyyar dilma im shiyero eno meshuyyar vehayenu tama derabbi yochanan deamar adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh

Ravina ikla ledamharya amar leh rav dimi bereh derav huna middamharya leravina velayete behema velema hare alay velayete behema achariti velayete shemonim bahadah velema i hach dekayema temura hi hane tarte todot veha shemonim detarvayehu vei hach dekayema toda hi veha deamri alay name leheve toda veha shemonim detarvayehu veidach tihve leachraut
Amar leh hattora amra tov asher lo tiddor mishshettiddor velo teshallem veatte amratte lekum velindor battechila
Matni haomer hare alay toda yavi hi velachmah min hachullin
b: Toda alay min hachullin velachmah min hammaaser yavi hi velachmah min hachullin toda min hammaaser velachmah min hachullin yavi hi velachmah min hammaaser yavi velo yavi mechite maaser sheni ella mimmeot maaser sheni
Gema amar rav huna haomer hare alay lachme toda mevi toda velachmah may tama mida yada hay gavra delechem belo toda la ykarev vehay toda velachmah kaamar vehay dekaamar lachme toda sof milta naket
Tenan toda min hammaaser velachmah min hachullin yavi kema shennadar veammay kevan deamar lachmah min hachullin yavi hi velachmah min hachullin
Shane hatam dechevan deamar toda min hammaaser naasa keomer hare alay lechem liftor todato shel peloni
I hachi resha dekatane toda min hachullin velachmah min hammaaser yavi hi velachmah min hachullin hacha name naasa keomer hare alay toda liftor lachmo shel peloni
Hachi hashta bishlama lechem lemiftar toda ate toda lemiftar lechem mi atya
Ta shema haomer hare alay toda belo lechem vezevach belo nesachim kofin oto umevi toda velachmah zevach unsachim
Tama deamar aval la amar toda la
Hu haddin af al gav dela amar toda veayede deka bae lemitne zevach belo nesachim dela mittene leh nesachim belo zevach tena name toda
Ammay neder ufitcho immo hu
Amar chizkiyya ha manni bet shammay hi deamri tefos lashon harishon ditnan hareni nazir min haggerogrot umin haddevela bet shammay omrim nazir uvet hillel omrim eno nazir
Rabbi yochanan amar afilu tema bet hillel beomer ilu hayiti yodea sheen nodrin kach lo hayiti noder kach ella kach umay kofin deka bae hadar beh
Ta shema haomer hare alay toda belo lechem vezevach belo nesachim veamru lo have toda velachmah vezevach unsachim veomer ilu hayiti yodea shekken lo hayiti noder kofin oto veomer lo shemor veshamata
Bishlama lechizkiyya nicha leh ella lerabbi yochanan kashya amar lach rabbi yochanan ha vadday bet shammay hi
May shemor veshamata amar abbaye shemor have toda veshamata have lachmah rava amar shemor have toda velachmah veshamata shello tehe ragil laasot ken
Toda hi velachmah min hammaaser yavi yavi la saggi dela mayete rav nachman verav chisda amri ratza mevi lo ratza lo yavi
Velo yavi mechite maaser sheni ella mimmeot maaser sheni rav nachman verav chisda deamri tarvayehu lo shanu ella mechite maaser sheni aval mechitin hallekuchot mimmeot maaser sheni yavi

Yatev rabbi yirmeya kammeh derabbi zera veyatev vekaamar lo shanu ella mechite maaser sheni aval mechitin hallekuchot bimot maaser sheni yavi amar leh rabbi atta omer ken ani omer afilu mechitin hallekuchot bimot maaser sheni lo yavi veema tama didi veema tama didach ema tama didach toda mehecha ka yalfatte lah mishshelamim

a: Ushlamim sham sham mimmaaser uminah ma shelamim en gufan maaser af toda name en gufah maaser vehane chite hallekuchot bimot maaser sheni name en gufan maaser
Ema tama didi toda mehecha ka yalefna lah mishshelamim ushlamim sham sham mimmaaser ma shelamim en min maaser af toda en min maaser leappoke chitin hallekuchot bimot maaser sheni demin maaser ninhu
Amar rabbi amme hammatpis meot maaser sheni lishlamim lo kanu shelamim may tama dela allima kedushsha dishlamim lemechal akkedushshat maaser sheni
Metivi hallokeach chayya lezivche shelamim uvhema livsar taava lo yatza haor lechullin lav lememra dekane shelamim
Ha itmar alah amar rav la kane shelamim umay lo yatza haor lechullin hachi kaamar eno betorat latzet haor lechullin may tama amar rabba naasa kelokeach shor lacharisha
Itmar hammatpis meot maaser sheni lishlamim rabbi yochanan amar kane rabbi elazar omer la kane

Vealliba derabbi yehuda deamar maaser mamon hedot hu dechulle alma la peligi dekane ki peligi alliba derabbi meir deamar maaser mamon gavoha hu man deamar la kane kerabbi meir uman deamar kane kevan demaaser karev leh shelamim ki matpesatte leh name tafes
Metivi hammatpis meot maaser sheni lishlamim keshehu podan mosif alehem shene chumshin echad lehekdesh veechad lemaaser
Mi savratte divre hakkol hi ha manni rabbi yehuda hi

Matni minnayin laomer hare alay toda shello yavi ella min hachullin talmud lomar vezavachta pesach la elohecha tzon uvakar vahalo pesach en ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim im ken ma talmud lomar tzon uvakar lehakkish kol habba min hatztzon umin habbakar lefesach ma pesach davar shebbechova veen ba ella min hachullin af kol davar shebbechova en ba ella min hachullin
Lefichach haomer hare alay toda hare alay shelamim hoil uvain chova lo yavou ella min hachullin unsachim bechol makom lo yavou ella min hachullin

Gema ufesach gufeh mena lan detanya rabbi eliezer omer neemar pesach bemitzrayim veneemar pesach ledorot ma pesach haamur bemitzrayim lo ba ella min hachullin af pesach haamur ledorot lo ba ella min hachullin
Amar lo rabbi akiva vechi danin efshar mishshei efshar amar lo af al pi shei efshar reaya gedola hi venilmad hemenna
Chazar rabbi akiva vedano din acher ma lefesach mitzrayim shekken en taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach
b: Tomar befesach dorot shettaun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach
