Amar lo hare hu omer veavadta et haavoda hazzot bachodesh hazze sheyyihu kol avodot shel chodesh hazze kaze
Verabbi akiva i savar lah deen danin efshar mishshei efshar leku bemilteh
I hadar beh vehay dela gamar mippesach mitzrayim mishshum hay pircha hu pesach midbar yochiach

Lidvarav derabbi eliezer kaamar ledidi en danin efshar mishshei efshar ledidach deamratte danin efshar mishshei efshar ma lefesach mitzrayim shekken eno taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach tomar befesach dorot shettaun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach
Vaamar leh rabbi eliezer veavadta
Verabbi eliezer lema leh pesach midbar yochiach
Lidvarav derabbi akiva kaamar leh ledidi danin efshar mishshei efshar umishshum hay pircha pesach midbar yochiach ledidach deamratte en danin efshar mishshei efshar veavadta
Vehashta name lifroch amar rav sheshet zot omeret en meshivin al hahekesh
Uvtarbitza amur vechi davar hallamed behekesh chozer umlammed behekesh bichlala itmar pesach kulleh chada milta hi
Verabbi akiva pesach deeno ba ella min hachullin mena leh nafka leh meha deamar shemuel mishshum rabbi eliezer zot hattora laola velammincha velachattat velaasham velammilluim ulzevach hashshelamim
Ola ma ola teuna keli af kol taun keli may hi ilema mizrak gabbe zivche shalme tzibur name ketiv vayyasem baagganot
Ella sakkin veola gufah menalan dichtiv vayyishlach avraham et yado vayyikkach et hammaachelet lishchot et beno vehatam ola hu dichtiv vayyaalehu leola tachat beno
Mincha ma mincha enah neechelet ella lezichre chehunna af kol en neechalin ella lezichre chehunna may i chattat veasham

a: Behedya ketiv
I zivche shalme tzibur meribbuya dikrae ate bekodesh hakkodashim tochlennu kol zachar bakkohanim yochal oto limed al zivche shalme tzibur sheen neechalim ella lezichre chehunna
Tannae hi ika demayete lah mehacha veika demayete lah mehacha
Chattat ma chattat mekaddeshet bevillua af kol mekaddesh bevillua
Asham ma asham en shafir veshilya kadosh bo af kol en shafir veshilya kadosh bo kasavar valdot kadashim bahavayatan hen kedoshim vedanin efshar mishshei efshar
Milluim ma milluim motrehen bisrefa veen baale chayyim motrehen bisrefa af kol motrehen bisrefa veen baale chayyim motrehen bisrefa
Shelamim ma shelamim mefaggelin umitpaggelin af kol mefaggelin umitpaggelin
Bematnita tana mishshemeh derabbi akiva zot hattora ku mincha ma mincha mekaddeshet bevillua af kol mekaddeshet bevillua

Veitzterich lemichtav bechattat veitzterich lemichtav bemincha dei ketav rachamana bemincha mishshum derakkicha bala aval chattat ema la vei ketav rachamana bechattat mishshum devasar aggav deshammin kadir karir aval mincha ema la tzericha
Chattat ma chattat enah baa ella min hachullin uvayyom uvyado hayemanit af kol eno ba ella min hachullin uvayyom uvyado hayemanit
Vechattat gufah menalan amar rav chisda deamar kera vehikriv aharon et par hachattat asher lo lo mishshello velo mishshel maaser
Bayyom mibbeom tzaoto nafka kedi nasvah
Beyado hayemanit midderabba bar bar chana nafka deamar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish kol makom shenneemar etzba uchhunna eno ella yamin kedi nasvah
Asham ma asham atzmotav muttarin af kol atzmotav muttarin
Verabbi akiva hay vezavachta pesach
b: May aved leh mibbee leh lechidrav nachman deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh minnayin lemotar happesach shekkarev shelamim shenneemar vezavachta pesach la elohecha tzon uvakar vahalo en pesach ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim ella motar happesach yehe ledavar habba min hatztzon umin habbakar
Veha mehacha nafka middaavuh dishmuel nafka dichtiv im min hatztzon korbano lezevach shelamim veamar avuh dishmuel davar habba min hatztzon yehe lezevach shelamim
Veakkatti mehacha nafka mehatam nafka vehatanya keves lerabbot et happesach lealya
Keshehu omer im keves lehavi pesach sheavra shenato ushlamim habbaim mechamat pesach lechol mitzvat shelamim sheyyitanu semicha unsachim utnufat chaze vashok
Keshehu omer veim ez hifsik hainyan limed al haez sheenah teuna alya
Telata kerae ketiv chad leibbera zemanno veibbera shenato vechad leibbera zemanno velo ibbera shenato vechad lelo ibbera zemanno velo ibbera shenato
Utzrichi dei ashmeinan ibbera zemanno veibbera shenato mishshum deidchi leh ligmare aval ibbera zemanno velo ibbera shenato dachaze lefesach sheni ema la
Vei ashmeinan ibbera zemanno velo ibbera shenato deidchi leh mippesach rishon aval lo ibbera zemanno velo ibbera shenato daafilu lefesach rishon name chaze ema la tzericha
Hadaran alach hattoda hayeta baa
Matni kol korbenot hatztzibur vehayyachid bain min haaretz umechutza laaretz min hechadash umin hayyashan chutz min haomer ushte hallechem sheenan bain ella min hechadash umin haaretz
Vechullan enan bain ella min hammuvchar veezehu muvchar shellahem michnes vezatcha michmas vezonecha alpa lassolet sheniyya lahen aforayim babbika
Kol haaratzot hau kesherot ella mikkan hau meviin
Gema matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya omer habba min hayyashan kasher shette hallechem habbaot min hayyashan kesherot ella shechiser mitzva
Omer dichtiv takriv et minchat bikkurecha vaafilu min haaliyya
Shette hallechem dichtiv mimmoshvotechem taviu velo min chutza laaretz mimmoshvotechem vaafilu min haaliyya
Ha appekteh amar kera taviu vaafilu min haaliyya
Vehay mibe leh shekkol sheatta mevi mimmakom acher hare hu kaze im ken lichtov kera tavi may taviu shema minah tarte
Vehachtiv reshit lemitzva
Hachtiv chadasha hay mibe leh lechidtanya rabbi natan verabbi akiva amru shette hallechem habbaot min hayyashan kesherot uma ani mekayyem chadasha shettehe chadasha lechol hammenachot
Ad kan la peligi ella bechadash

a: Aval baaretz la peligi deomer ushte hallechem mearetz in mechutza laaretz la
Keman dela ki hay tanna detanya rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer omer ba mechutza laaretz uma ani mekayyem ki tavou el haaretz shello nitchayevu baomer kodem shennichnesu laaretz
Vekasavar chadash bechutza laaretz deorayeta hi dichtiv mimmoshvotechem kol makom sheattem yoshvin mashma vechi tavou zeman bia hi vechevan deorayeta hi akrove name makrivin
Tenan hatam shomre sefichin bashsheviit notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka
Rame leh rame bar chama lerav chisda tenan shomre sefichin bashsheviit notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka urminhu leochla velo lisrefa
Amar leh rachamana amar lach ledorotechem veatte amratte tivtal
Amar leh umi kaamena ana tivtal layete middeeshtakad baena karmel veleka
Velayete mikkarmel deeshtakad amar kera karmel takriv baena karmel bishat hakrava veleka
Itmar rabbi yochanan amar karmel takriv rabbi elazar omer reshit ketzircha reshit ketzircha velo sof ketzircha
Motev rabba veim takriv minchat bikkurim beminchat haomer hakkatuv medabber mehechan hi baa min hasseorim atta omer min hasseorim o eno ella min hachitin
Rabbi eliezer omer neemar aviv bemitzrayim veneemar aviv ledorot ma aviv haamur bemitzrayim seorim af aviv haamur ledorot eno ba ella min hasseorim

Rabbi akiva omer matzinu yachid shemmevi chovato min hachitin umevi chovato min hasseorin veaf tzibur mevi chovato min hachitin umevi chovato min hasseorin im atta omer min hachitin lo matzinu tzibur shemmevi chovato min hasseorin
Davar acher im atta omer omer ba min hachitin in shette hallechem bikurim alma mishshum bikurim hu teuvta
Tenan hatam en meviin bikurim chutz mishshivat hamminin velo
b: Mittemarim shebbeharim velo mipperot shebbaamakim amar ulla im hevi lo kidesh
Yatev rabba veka amar lah leha shemata etiveh rabbi acha bar abba lerabba korban reshit shettehe reshit lechol hammenachot vechen hu omer behakrivchem mincha chadasha la beshavuotechem
En li ella chadasha shel chittim chadasha shel seorim minnayin talmud lomar chadasha chadasha im eno inyan lachadasha shel chitin tenehu inyan lachadasha shel seorim

Uminnayin shettehe kodemet levikurim talmud lomar vechag shavuot taase lecha bikkure ketzir chittim veen li ella bikkure ketzir chittim ketzir seorim minnayin talmud lomar vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha asher tizra bassade
Veen li ella shettizra alu mealehen minnayin talmud lomar bassade
Veen li ella bassade minnayin lerabbot shebbegag veshebbechurba veshebbeatzitz veshebbisfina talmud lomar bikkure kol asher beartzam
Minnayin shettehe kodemet linsachim uferot hailan neemar kan bikkure maasecha veneemar lehallan beospecha et maasecha min hassade ma lehallan nesachim uferot ilan af kan nesachim uferot ilan
Katane miha shebbegag shebbechurba shebbeatzitz veshebbisfina sefa atan limnachot
Matkef lah rav adda bar ahava i hachi hayenu dichtiv kol tahor bevetcha yochal oto vei menachot lezichre chehunna hu demitachlan
Amar rav mesharsheya tere kerae ketivi lecha yihye uchtiv kol tahor bevetcha yochal oto ha ketzad kan bevikurim kan bimnachot
Rav ashe amar kulleh bimnachot vesefa dikra atan lelachme toda
Biflugta rabbi yochanan amar im hevi lo kiddesh resh lakish amar im hevi kiddesh naasa kechachush bekadashim
Bishlama resh lakish kidamar tama ella rabbi yochanan may tama amar rabbi elazar rabbi yochanan chazay bachalom milta meallayeta amena amar kera mereshit velo kol reshit meartzecha velo kol artzecha
Veresh lakish hay artzecha may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya rabban gamliel bar rabbi omer neemar kan eretz veneemar lehallan eretz ma lehallan shevach eretz af kan shevach eretz
Veidach eretz meeretz
Veidach eretz mearetz la mashma leh
Tane chada shebbegag veshebbechurba shebbeatzitz veshebbisfina mevi vekore vetanya idach mevi veeno kore
Bishlama resh lakish gag aggag la kashya ha begag dimara ha begag devayit
Churba achurba la kashya kan bechurba avuda kan bechurba sheenah avuda
Atzitz aatzitz la kashya kan benakuv kan besheeno nakuv
Sefina assefina la kashya kan bisfina shel etz kan bisfina shel cheres

a: Ella lerabbi yochanan kashya
Tannae hi detanya shebbegag veshebbechurba mevi vekore shebbeatzitz veshebbisfina eno mevi kol ikar
Vechullan enan baot ella min hammuvchar ku amri leh yochana umamre lemoshe teven atta machnis leefrayim amar lehu amri inashe lemata yarka yarka shekol
Matni en meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim velo mibbet hashshelachim velo mibbet hailan veim hevi kasher
Ketzad hu ose narah shana rishona uvshana sheniyya zorah kodem lappesach shivim yom vehi osa solet merubba
Ketzad bodek haggizbar machnis yado letochah ala bah avak pesula ad sheyenappenna
Veim hitlia pesula
Gema ketzad ose narah shana rishona ibaya lehu hechi kaamar narah shana rishona ushniyya narah vezorah o dilma narah shana rishona ushniyya zorah belo narah

Ta shema detanya amar rabbi yose af chite karaziyyim uchfar achim ilmale semuchot lirushalayim hau meviin mehen lefi sheen meviin et haomer ella min hassadot hammudramot vehamnonarot lechach shebbahen chamma zorachat umehen chamma shokaat
Ketzad ose narah shana rishona ushniyya choresh veshone vezorah kodem lappesach shivim yom kede shettehe semucha lachamma veosa kane zeret veshibolet zirtayim

Vekotzer umammer vedash vezore uvorer vetochen umrakked umevi etzel gizbar vegizbar machnis yado letochah im alta bah avak omer lo chazor venappe otah sheniyya mishshum rabbi natan amru gizbar sach yado shemen umachnis letochah ad shemmaale kol avakah
Katane mihat choresh veshone
Ultamach matnitin la katane shone
b: Barayeta katane shone
Ha la kashya kan baavuda kan besheenah avuda
May have alah ta shema detanya nar chetzyah vezorea chetzyah nar chetzyah vezorea chetzyah
Amar rabbi yochanan en meviin et haomer ella min hassadot hammudramot shebbeeretz yisrael shebbahen chamma zorachat umehen chamma shokaat

Tanya name hachi abba shaul omer omer haya ba mibbikat bet mikla kevat shalosh sein hayeta vesade mudremet hayeta uvah chamma zorachat umimmenna chamma shokaat nar chetzyah vezorea chetzyah nar chetzyah vezorea chetzyah
Rav chilkiyya bar tovi hava leh karna deara nar chetzyah vezara chetzyah nar chetzyah vezara chetzyah vaavada al chad tere umzabben lehu lechite lismida
Veim hitlia pesula tanu rabbanan solet shehitlia rubbah pesula vechitin shehitliu rubban pesulot bae rabbi yirmeya berov chitta o berov sea teku
Bae rava hikdishan mahu sheyyilke alehen mishshum baal mum kevan defasel kevaal mum dame o dilma en baal mum ella bivhema teku
Tenan hatam kol etz shennimtza bo tolaat pasul legabbe mizbeach amar shemuel lo shanu ella lach aval yavesh gorro vechasher
Bae rava hikdisho mahu sheyyilke alav mishshum baal mum kevan defasul kevaal mum dame o dilma en baal mum ella bivhema teku
Matni tekoa alpa lashshemen abba shaul omer sheniyya lah regev beever hayyarden kol haaratzot hau kesherot ella mikan hau meviin

En meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim velo mibbet hashshelachim velo min ma shennizra benehem veim hevi kasher en meviin anpaktan veim hevi kasher en meviin min haggargerin shennishru bemayim velo min hakkevashim velo min hashshelukim veim hevi pasul
Gema vayyishlach yoav tekoa vayyikkach mishsham ishsha chachama may shena tekoa amar rabbi yochanan mittoch shergilin beshemen zayit chachma metzuya bahen

Tanu rabbanan vetovel beshemen raglo ze chelko shel asher shemmoshech shemen kemayan amru paam achat nitzrechu lahen anshe ludkiyya beshemen leshemen minu lahen pulmostus echad amru lo lech vehave lanu shemen bemea ribo

Halach lirushalayim amru lo lech letzor halach letzor amru lo lech legush chalav halach legush chalav amru lo lech etzel peloni lesade hallaz umtzao shehaya ozek tachat zetav amar lo yesh lecha shemen bemea ribo sheani tzarich amar lo hamten li ad sheasayyem melachti himtin ad shessiyyem melachto

Leachar shessiyyem melachto hifshil kelav laachorav vehaya mesakkel uva badderech amar lo yesh lecha shemen bemea ribo kimdumme ani shessechok sachaku bi hayehudim kevan shehiggia leiro hotzia lo shifchato kumkemos shel chammin verachatz bo yadav veraglav hotzia lo sefel shel zahav melea shemen vetaval bo yadav veraglav lekayyem ma shenneemar vetovel bashshemen raglo

Leachar sheachlu veshatu madad lo shemen bemea ribo amar lo kelum atta tzarich leoter amar lo hen ella sheen li damim amar lo im atta rotze likach kach vaani elech immecha veettol damav madad lo shemen bishmona asar ribo amru lo hinniach oto haish lo sus velo pered velo gamal velo chamor beeretz yisrael shello secharo

Kevan shehiggia leiro yatzu anshe iro lekalleso amar lahem lo li kallesuni ella laze shebba immi shemmadad li shemen bemea ribo vahare noshe bi bishmone esre ribo lekayyem ma shenneemar yesh mitashsher veen kol mitroshesh vehon rav
En meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim vehatanya en meviin anpaktan

a: Veim hevi pasul vehatanya veim hevi kasher mippene shehu seraf
Amar rav yosef la kashya ha rabbi chiyya ha rabbi shimon bar rabbi derabbi chiyya zarek leh verabbi shimon bar rabbi metabbel beh leh vesimanach ashirim mekammetzin
Shishsha chodashim beshemen hammor may shemen hammor rav huna bar chiyya amar setachta rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar shemen zayit shello hevi shelish
Tanya name hachi rabbi yehuda omer anpikinon shemen zayit shello hevi shelish lamma sachin oto shemmashshir et hassear umadden et habbasar
En meviin min haggargerin shennishru bemayim tanu rabbanan shemen zayit kavush shaluk sharuy veshel shemarim veshel reach ra lo yavi veim hevi pasul
Bae rabba hikdisho mahu sheyyilke alav mishshum baal mum kevan defasul kevaal mum dame o dilma en baal mum ella bivhema teku
Matni shelosha zetim hen uvahen shelosha shelosha shemanim
Hazzayit harishon megargero berosh hazzayit vechotesh venoten letoch hassal rabbi yehuda omer sevivot hassal ze rishon
Chazar vetoen bekora rabbi yehuda omer baavanim ze sheni
Chazar vetachan vetaan ze shelishi
Harishon lammenora vehashshear limnachot
Hashsheni megargero berosh haggag vechotesh venoten letoch hassal rabbi yehuda omer sevivot hassal ze rishon
Toen bekora verabbi yehuda omer baavanim ze sheni
Chazar vetachan vetaan ze shelishi
Harishon lammenora vehashshear limnachot
Shelishi otno bevet habbad ad sheyyilke umaalehu umnaggevo berosh haggag kotesh venoten letoch hassal rabbi yehuda omer sevivot hassal ze rishon
Toen bekora rabbi yehuda omer baavanim ze sheni
Chazar vetachan vetaan ze shelishi
Harishon lammenora vehashshear limnachot
Gema ibaya lehu megargero tenan o megalgelo tenan
Ta shema detanya shemen zayit mizzeto mikkan amru zayit rishon megalgelo berosh hazzayit vechonso levet habbad vetochano berechayim venotno besallin shemen hayyotze mimmennu ze haya rishon
Taan bekora shemen hayyotze mimmennu ze haya sheni vechazar ufarak tachan vetaan ze haya shelishi harishon lammenora vehashshear limnachot vechen zayit sheni

Vezayit shelishi otno bevet habbad ad sheyyilke umaale lerosh haggag veose oto kemin temara ad sheyyazuvu memav vechonso levet habbad vetochano barechayim venotno besallin vashemen hayyotze mimmennu ze haya rishon
Taan bekora shemen hayyotze mimmennu ze haya sheni parak chazar vetachan vetaan ze haya shelishi harishon lammenora vehashshear limnachot
Rabbi yehuda omer lo haya tochano barechayim ella kotsho bemachteshet velo haya toen bekora ella baavanim velo haya notno besallin ella letoch sevivot hassal
Ha gufa kashya kotesh manni rabbi yehuda hi toch hassal atan lerabbanan
Hay tanna savar lah kevateh bachada ufaleg aleh bachada

Matni harishon shebbarishon en lemala hemennu hashsheni shebbarishon veharishon shebbashsheni shavin hashshelishi shebbarishon vehashsheni shebbashsheni veharishon shebbashshelishi shavin hashshelishi shebbashsheni vehashsheni shebbashshelishi shavin hashshelishi shebbashshelishi en lematta hemennu

Af kol hammenachot hau baddin sheyyitanu shemen zayit zach ma menora sheenah laachila teuna shemen zayit zach menachot shehen laachila eno din sheyyitanu shemen zayit zach talmud lomar zach katit lemaor veen zach katit limnachot
b: Gema shavin veha amratte rishon lammenora vehashshear limnachot amar rav nachman bar yitzchak may shavin shavin limnachot
Af kol hammenachot hau baddin vechu tanu rabbanan zach en zach ella naki rabbi yehuda omer katit en katit ella katush
Yachol yehe zach katit pasul limnachot talmud lomar veissaron solet balul beshemen katit im ken ma talmud lomar lammaor ella mippene hachisachon
May chisachon amar rabbi elazar hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael
Tzav et bene yisrael veyikchu elecha shemen zayit zach amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani elecha velo li lo leora ani tzarich
Shulchan batztzafon umnora baddarom amar rabbi zerika amar rabbi elazar lo laachila ani tzarich velo leora ani tzarich
Vayyaas labbayit challone shekufim atumim tana shekufin mibbifnim vaatumim mibbachutz lo leora ani tzarich
Michutz lefarochet haedut beohel moed edut hu lechol bae olam shehashshechina shora beyisrael
Veim tomar leora ani tzarich vahalo kol arbaim shana shehalchu yisrael bemidbar lo halchu ella leoro ella edut hu lechol bae olam shehashshechina shora beyisrael
May edutah amar rava ze ner maaravi shennotnin bah shemen keneged chavroteha umimmenna haya madlik uvah haya mesayyem
Matni meayin hau meviin et hayyayin kedochayim vaatulayin alpa layyayin sheniyya lahen bet rima uvet lavan bahar uchfar signa babbika kol aratzot hau kesherot ella mikan hau meviin

En meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim velo mibbet hashshelachim velo mimma shennizra benehen veim hevi kasher en meviin hallisteon veim hevi kasher en meviin yashan divre rabbi vachachamim machshirin en meviin lo matok velo meushshan velo mevushshal veim hevi pasul veen meviin min haddaliyyot ella min haragliyyot umin hakkeramim haavudin
Velo konsin oto bachatzavin gedolim ella bechaviyyot ketannot veeno memalle et hechavit ad piha kede sheyehe recho nodef
Eno mevi mippiha mippene

a: Hakkemachin velo mishshuleha mippene hashshemarim ella mevi mishshelishah meemtzaah
Ketzad hu bodek haggizbar yoshev vehakkane beyado zarak haggir hikkish bakkane
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer sheyyesh bo kemachin pasul shenneemar temimim yihu lachem uminchatam temimim yihu lachem veniskehem
Gema en meviin lo matok velo mevushshal velo meushshan veim hevi pasul veha katane resha en meviin et helisteon veim hevi kasher
Amar ravina keroch vetane rav ashe amar chulya deshimsha la meis chulya defera meis
En meviin yashan divre rabbi vachachamim machshirin amar chizkiyya may tama derabbi amar kera lave yayin ma keves ben shenato af yayin ben shenato

I ma keves ben shette shanim pasul af yayin ben shette shanim pasul vechi tema hachi name vehatanya yayin ben shette shanim lo yavi veim hevi kasher man shamatte leh deamar lo yavi rabbi vekaamar im hevi kasher
Ella amar rava hayenu tama derabbi dichtiv al tere yayin ki yitaddam
En meviin lo min haddaliyyot ku tana keramim haavudim paamayim bashshana
Rav yosef hava leh karna defardesa derafek beh tefe rifka veaved chamra dedare mayya al chad teren
Lo hau konsin otan bachatzavin gedolim tana chaviyyot kaddiyyot ludiyyot uvenoniyyot
En mannichin otan shettayim shettayim ella achat achat
Ketzad bodek gizbar yoshev vekane beyado zarak haggir hikkish bakkane tana zarak haggir shel shemarim gizbar hikkish bakkane
Velema leh memar mesayya leh lerabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan keshem shehaddibur yafe labbesamim kach dibur ra layyayin
Rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer vechu bae rabbi yochanan hikdisho mahu sheyyilke alav mishshum baal mum kevan defasul kevaal mum dame o dilma en baal mum ella bivhema teku
Tanu rabbanan elim mimmoav kevasim mechevron agalim mishsharon gozalot mehar hammelech
Rabbi yehuda omer meviin kevasim sheggovhan kerochban amar rava bar rav shela may tama derabbi yehuda dichtiv yire miknecha bayyom hahu kar nirchav

a: Et mi avi tachtav ella midda yetera shel log umechetza hayeta sham shebbo haya moded lachavite kohen gadol log umechetza babboker log umechetza ben haarbayim

May ika ben rabbi meir lerabbi yehuda amar rabbi yochanan berutze middot ika benayehu
Leman deamar mimmatta lemala kasavar berutze hammiddot nitkaddeshu urviit yahev leh rachamana lemoshe veamar leh shaar deka ayeli lehu berutzin
Leman deamar mimmala lematta kasavar berutze middot lo nitkaddeshu vehin yahev leh rachamana lemoshe veamar leh shaar beha deka nafki berutzin
Abbaye amar dechulle alma berutze hammiddot ika lememar nitkaddeshu veika lememar lo nitkaddeshu vehacha bimleim ka mipalgi

b: Chutz hu vei nazir lechem nazir bishchitat ayil hu dekadesh

Amar leh rabbi shimon berabbi shebbo haya mechallek chatzi log shemen lechol ner vaner amar lo ner yisrael kach haya
Amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi ner shekkavta nidashshen hashshemen nidashshena happetila ketzad ose metivah venoten bah shemen umadlikah
Yatev rabbi zerika veka mibaya leh keshehu noten bah shemen kemidda rishona o kemo shechasra
Amar rabbi yirmeya peshita dichmidda rishona dei kema shechasra mena yadinan may chiser vechi tema dimshaar leh im ken sheva middot nefishi lehu middot tuva
Kare aleh vahadarcha tzelach rechav al devar emet veanva tzedek

Itmar name amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan veamri lah amar rabbi abba amar rabbi chanina amar rabbi ner shekkavta nidashshen hashshemen nidashshena happetila ketzad ose metivah venoten bah shemen kemidda rishona umadlikah
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehuda amar rav sheshet ner shebbemikdash shel perakim hava
Kasavar ki ketiv kikkar umiksha ammenora veneroteha ketiv kevan demibaya hatava i lav difrakim havay la hava mittayeva leh
Metivi ketzad ose mesallekan umannichan beohel umkannechan bisfog venoten bahen shemen umadlikan
Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya chachamim omrim lo hau mizzizin otah mimmekomah
Mikkelal dei bae leh leozozah matze mezez lah ella ema lo hayeta zaza mimmekomah
Uman chachamim rabbi elazar hu detanya rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer kemin tas shel zahav haya lah al gabbah keshehu metivah dochako kelappe piha keshehu noten bah shemen dochako kelappe roshah

Kashya derabbi nechemya adderabbi nechemya tere tannae vealliba derabbi nechemya
Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer menora baa min hakkikkar veen malkacheha umachtoteha veneroteha baa min hakkikkar veella ma ani mekayyem et kol hakkelim haelle shehau kelim shel zahav

Zahav behedya ketiv bo veasita et neroteha shiva veheela et neroteha veheir el ever paneha umalkacheha umachtoteha zahav tahor lo nitzrecha ella lefi nerot salka datach amena hoil ufi nerot ashchore mashchar hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael

Rabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer omrim afilu mincha shel shishshim esronim en lah ella luggah shenneemar lemincha velog shemen
Verabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer ben yaakov hay issaron balul velog may avdi leh hahu legufeh deka amar rachamana layete chad issaron
Veidach legufeh la tzerich middegalli rachamana gabbe metzora shelosha korbanot ushlosha esronot hacha dechad korban chad issaron
Veidach itzterich salka datach amena hoil vechas rachamana aleh leetoye bedallut ema la live mincha kelal veidach ligmare la ashkechan

Hin teresar lugge havayin dichtiv shemen zayit hin uchtiv shemen mishchat kodesh yihye ze li ledorotechem ze begimatriyya teresar havayin

Vaasitem ishshe la yachol kol haole laishim yehe taun nesachim afilu mincha talmud lomar ola shelamim minnayin talmud lomar zevach toda minnayin talmud lomar o zevach
Yachol sheani merabbe af bechor umaaser vafesach vechattat veasham talmud lomar lefalle neder o vindava ba beneder undava taun nesachim sheeno ba beneder undava en taun nesachim
Mashma lehotzi et ellu otzi et chovot habbaot mechamat haregel baregel umay ninhu olot reiyya veshalme chagiga talmud lomar o bemoadechem kol habba bemoadechem taun nesachim
Mashma lehavi et ellu avi seire chattat hoil uvain chova baregel talmud lomar vechi taase ven bakar
Ben bakar bakkelal haya velamma yatza lehakkish elav ma ben bakar meuchad ba beneder undava af kol ba beneder undava
Laasot reach nichoach la min habbakar o min hatztzon ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar ola shomea ani afilu olat haof bemashma talmud lomar min habbakar o min hatztzon divre rabbi yoshiyya

Rabbi yonatan omer eno tzarich hare hu omer zevach veof eno zevach im ken ma talmud lomar min habbakar o min hatztzon lefi shenneemar adam ki yakriv mikkem korban la min habbehema min habbakar umin hatztzon yachol haomer hare alay ola yavi mishshenehem talmud lomar min habbakar o min hatztzon ratza echad mevi ratza shenayim mevi
Verabbi yonatan lema li kera haamar ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv yachdav
Itzterich salka datach amena

a: Hoil uchtiv umin hatztzon keman dichtiv yachdav dame
Ulrabbi yoshiyya deamar af al gav dela ketiv yachdav keman dichtiv yachdav dame live kera
Hachtiv im ola korbano min habbakar veim min hatztzon korbano
Veidach itzterich salka datach amena hane mile bimfaresh aval bistama layete mittarvayehu ka mashma lan
Amar mar toda minnayin talmud lomar o zevach attu toda lav zevach hu itzterich salka datach amena hoil veika lechem bahadah la tive nesachim
Umay shena meel nazir deika bahadeh lechem uvae nesachim
Salka datach amena hatam shene minin hacha arbaat minin ka mashma lan
Velichtov rachamana lefalle neder o lindava vela bae ola

I la ketav rachamana ola hava amena vaasitem ishshe la kelal lefalle neder o lindava perat lereach nichoach chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash davar sheeno ba al chet af kol sheen ba al chet
Otzi chattat veasham shehen bain al chet avi bechor umaaser vafesach sheen bain al chet talmud lomar ola
Hashta dichtiv ola kelal ufrat ma merabbet beh ma happerat meforash sheeno mechuyyav veomed af kol sheeno mechuyyav veomed
Lehavi valdot kodashim utmuratan veola habbaa min hammotarot
Veasham shennitak liriyya vechol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman

Vehashta deamratte o lidrasha lefalle neder o lindava lema li lechelkam itzterich salka datach amena ad demayete neder undava la live nesachim ka mashma lan deayeti neder lechodeh live nesachim vei ayeti nedava lechodeh layete nesachim
Hanicha lerabbi yoshiyya ella lerabbi yonatan lema li salka datach amena ayeti neder lechodeh live nesachim ayeti nedava lechodeh live nesachim ayeti neder undava tisge binsachim dechad ka mashma lan
O bemoadechem lema li salka datach amena hane mile deka mayete ola beneder ushlamim bindava i name ipcha
Aval hecha deka mayete ola ushlamim beneder i name ola ushlamim bindava shem neder echad veshem nedava achat hi vetisge leh binsachim dechad ka mashma lan o bemoadechem
Vechi taase ven bakar ola o zavach lema li itzterich salka datach amena hane mile hecha deka mayete ola ushlamim beneder i name ola ushlamim bindava

Aval hecha deka mayete shette olot chada beneder vachada bindava i name shene shelamim echad beneder veechad bindava ema shem shelamim achat hi shem ola achat hi vetisge leh binsachim dechad ka mashma lan
Lefalle neder o shelamim lema li salka datach amena hane mile hecha demayete shette olot chada beneder vachada bindava i name shene shelamim chada beneder vachada bindava
Aval hecha deka mayete shette olot beneder ushte olot bindava i name shane shelamim beneder ushne shelamim bindava shem ola echad hu veshem neder echad hu vetisge leh binsachim dechad ka mashma lan
Verabbi yoshiyya hay min habbakar o min hatztzon lema li
Salka datach amena hane mile bitre mine aval bechad mina tisge leh binsachim dechad ka mashma lan
Kacha taasu laechad lema li salka datach amena hane mile beze achar ze aval bevat achat tisge leh binsachim dechad ka mashma lan
Ella shechattato shel metzora vaashamo taun nesachim mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ushlosha esronim solet mincha bemincha habbaa im hazzevach hakkatuv medabber
Atta omer bemincha habbaa im hazzevach o eno ella bemincha habbaa bifne atzmah keshehu omer veheela hakkohen et haola veet hammincha heve omer bemincha habbaa im hazzevach hakkatuv medabber

Vaadayin eni yodea im teuna nesachim veim lav talmud lomar veyayin lannesech reviit hahin taase al haola o lazzavach lakkeves haechad ola zo olat metzora zavach zo chattat metzora o lazzavach zo asham metzora
Vetipok leh tarvayehu mizzavach
b: Deamar mar chattat veasham minnayin talmud lomar zavach
Hane mile hecha detarvayehu ki hadade ninhu aval hecha deasham lehachshir vechattat lechapper baenan tere kerae
Zavach zo chattat metzora veema zo chattat veasham denazir
La salka datach detanya uminchatam veniskehem beolato uvishlamav hakkatuv medabber
Atta omer beolato uvishlamav o eno ella afilu chattat talmud lomar veet haayil yaase zevach shelamim uminchato venisko
Ayil bakkelal haya velamma yatza lehakkish elav ma ayil meuchad ba beneder undava af kol ba beneder undava
Ola zo olat metzora veema zo olat yoledet
Amar abbaye olat yoledet missefa dikra nafka
Detanya rabbi natan omer lakkeves zo olat yoledet haechad ze achad asar shel maaser shekkarev shelamim
Shello matzinu lah bechol hattora sheyehe tafel chamur min haikar
Rava amar ezehu davar shetztzarich shelosha ribbuyin heve omer zo metzora
Laayil lema li amar rav sheshet lerabbot elo shel aharon
Elo shel aharon mibbemoadechem nafka salka datach amena hane mile detzibbur aval deyachid la
Umay shena meolat yoledet
Salka datach amena hane mile davar sheen kavua lo zeman aval davar shekkavua lo zeman ema la ka mashma lan
O laayil lema li lerabbot et happalgas
Hanicha lerabbi yochanan deamar birya hu ditnan hikrivu mevi alav nische ayil veeno ole lo mizzivcho veamar rabbi yochanan o laayil lerabbot et happalgas
Ella levar peda deamar mayete umatne disfeka hu itzterich kera lerabboye sefeka
Vadday levar peda kashya

Kacha yease lashshor haechad o laayil haechad o lasse vakkevasim o vaizzim leshor haechad ma talmud lomar lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben nische ayil lenische cheves yachol nechallek ben nische far lenische egel talmud lomar lashshor haechad
O laayil ma talmud lomar lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben nische ben shana lenische ben shettayim yachol nechallek ben nische ben shettayim lenische ben shalosh talmud lomar o laayil haechad
O lasse bakkevasim ma talmud lomar lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben nische cheves lenische ayil yachol nechallek ben nische chivsa lenische rechela talmud lomar o lasse bakkevasim
O vaizzim ma talmud lomar lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben nische cheves lenische ayil yachol nechallek ben nische gedi lenische sair talmud lomar o vaizzim
Amar rav pappa badek lan rava

a: Nische rechela bechamma ufashtina leh mimmatnitin gedi meshammesh nische tzon shel gedolim veshel ketannim shel zecharim veshel nekevot chutz mishshel elim
Matni kol korbenot hatztzibbur en bahen semicha chutz min happar habba al kol hammitzot vesair hammishtalleach rabbi shimon omer af sair avoda zara
Kol korbenot hayyachid teunin semicha chutz min habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach
Vehayyoresh somech umevi nesachim umemer

Gema tanu rabbanan kol korbenot hatztzibbur en bahen semicha chutz mippar habba al kol hammitzot usire avoda zara divre rabbi shimon rabbi yehuda omer seire avoda zara en bahen semicha veet mi avi tachtehem sair hammishtalleach
La saggi dela meayyel amar ravina gemiri shette semichot betzibbur
Amar lo rabbi shimon vahalo en semicha ella bivalim veze aharon uvanav somchin bo amar lo af ze aharon uvanav mitkapperin bo
Amar rabbi yirmeya veazdu letamayehu

Detanya vechipper et mikdash hakkodesh ze lifnay velifnim veet ohel moed ze hechal mizbeach kemashmao yechapper ellu haazarot kohanim kemashmaan al kol am hakkahal ellu yisrael yechapper ellu halviyyim
Hushu kullan lechappara achat shemmitkapperin besair hammishtalleach divre rabbi yehuda

Rabbi shimon omer keshem sheddam sair hannaase bifnim mechapper al yisrael al tumat mikdash vekadashav kach dam happar mechapper al hakkohanim al tumat mikdash vekadashav keshem sheviduy shel sair hammishtalleach mechapper al yisrael bishar averot kach viduy shel par mechapper al hakkohanim bishar averot
Verabbi shimon ha vadday hushu in hushu divne kappara ninhu mihu kol chad vechad mechapper bidnafsheh

Lerabbi yehuda tumat mikdash vekadashav yisrael mechapperi bedam sair hannaase bifnim vechohanim befar shel aharon bishar averot ellu vaellu mechapperi beviduy sair hammishtalleach ulrabbi shimon bishar averot name kohanim beviduy defar mitkapperi

Kidkatane echad yisrael veechad kohanim veechad kohen mashiach ma ben yisrael lechohanim ulchohen mashiach ella sheddam happar mechapper al hakkohanim al tumat mikdash vekadashav zo divre rabbi yehuda

Verabbi shimon omer keshem sheddam hassair hannaase bifnim mechapper al yisrael kach dam happar mechapper al hakkohanim keshem sheviduo shel sair hammishtalleach mechapper al yisrael kach viduo shel par mechapper al hakkohanim
Tanu rabbanan vesamchu zikne haeda et yedehem al rosh happar par taun semicha veen seire avoda zara teunin semicha divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi shimon omer par taun semicha bizkenim veen seire avoda zara taun semicha bizkenim ella beaharon
Urminhu hachay hachay taun semicha veen seire avoda zara teunin semicha divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer chay taun semicha beaharon
b: Veen seire avoda zara teunin semicha beaharon ella bizkenim
Amar rav sheshet vetisbera dehach kammayeta metaratzta hi ha amar rabbi shimon semicha bivalim baenan

Ella taretz hachi happar par taun semicha veen seire avoda zara teunin semicha divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer hachay chay taun semicha beaharon veen seire avoda zara teunin semicha beaharon ella bizkenim
Vehachi ka amar leh rabbi shimon lerabbi yehuda seire avoda zara bau semicha vei shemia lach dela bau semicha beaharon hu dishmia lach umiuta mehachay hu
Verabbi yehuda lema li lemaotinhu mikkera veha amar ravina gemiri shette semichot betzibbur girsa bealma
Verabbi shimon seire avoda zara devaaya semicha menalan

Nafka lan middetanya vesamach yado al rosh hassair lerabbot seir nachshon lismicha divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer lerabbot seire avoda zara lismicha shehaya rabbi shimon omer kol chattat shennichnas damah lifnim teuna semicha
Lema li lememra shehaya simana bealma
Veema sair hannaase bifnim dumya disir nasi dimchapper al averot mitzva yedua
Ulravina deamar gemiri shette semichot betzibur kerae lema li
Itzterich hilcheta veitzterich keray
Dei mikkera hava amena zivche shalme tzibur
Ki kushya ammatnitin dehach pirka dechol hammenachot baot amar rabbi shimon shelosha minin teunin shalosh mitzot
Lete bekal vachomer vihu zivche shalme tzibur teunin semicha mikkal vechomer ma shalme yachid sheen teunin tenufa chayyim teunin semicha chayyim vechu itzterich hilcheta
Vei mehilcheta hava amena la yadinan he ninhu kamashma lan dumya disir nasi dimchapper al averot mitzva yedua
Kol korbenot hayyachid teunin semicha chutz mibbechor umaaser ufesach

Tanu rabbanan korbano velo habbechor sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma shelamim sheen kedushshatan merechem teunin semicha bechor shekkedushshato merechem eno din shettaun semicha talmud lomar korbano velo habbechor

Korbano velo maaser sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma shelamim sheen mekaddeshin lifnehem ulacharehem teunin semicha maaser shemmekaddesh lefanav ulacharav eno din shettaun semicha talmud lomar korbano velo maaser
Korbano velo pesach sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma shelamim sheeno baamod vehave teunin semicha pesach shehu baamod vehave eno din shettaun semicha talmud lomar korbano velo pesach
Ika lemifrach ma lishlamim shekken teunin nesachim utnufat chaze vashok kerae asmachta bealma
Ella

a: Kerae lema li korbano velo korban chavero korbano velo korban goy korbano lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha
Hayyoresh somech
Tane rav chananya kammeh derava yoresh eno somech yoresh eno memer veha anan tenan hayyoresh somech umevi et nesachav umemer
Amar leh efchay amar leh la matnitin manni rabbi yehuda hi detanya yoresh somech yoresh memer rabbi yehuda omer yoresh eno somech yoresh eno memer
May tama derabbi yehuda korbano velo korban aviv veyalef techillat hekdesh missof hekdesh ma sof hekdesh yoresh eno somech af techilat hekdesh yoresh eno memer
Verabbanan hamer yamir lerabbot et hayyoresh veyalef sof hekdesh mittechilat hekdesh ma techillat hekdesh yoresh memer af sof hekdesh yoresh somech
Verabbanan hay korbano may avdi leh korbano velo korban goy korbano velo korban chavero korbano lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha

Verabbi yehuda lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha let leh vei name it leh goy vachavero mechad kera nafka iyyataru leh tere kerae chad korbano velo korban aviv veidach lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha
Verabbi yehuda hay hamer yamir may aved leh mibe leh lerabbot et haishsha detanya lefi shekkol hainyan kullo eno medabber ella bilshon zachar ma sofenu lerabbot et haishsha talmud lomar hamer yamir
Verabbanan darshi mivveim verabbi yehuda veim la daresh
Matni hakkol somchin chutz mecheresh shote vekatan vesome vegoy vehaeved vehashshaliach vehaishsha
Usmicha sheyare mitzva
Al harosh bishte yadayim uvimkom shessomchin shochatin vetechef lismicha shechita
Gema bishlama cheresh shote vekatan delav bene dea ninhu goy name bene yisrael somchin veen goyim somchin ella some may tama la
Rav chisda verav yitzchak bar avdimi chad amar atya semicha semicha mizzikne eda
Vechad amar atya semicha semicha meolat reiyya
Ulman deamar meolat reiyya may tama la yalef min zikne eda
b: Danin yachid miyyachid veen danin yachid mitztzibur
Ulman deyalef mizzikne eda may tama la yalef meolat reiyya danin mide dichtiv beh semicha begufeh mimmide dichtiv beh semicha begufeh leappoke olat reiyya dehi gufah meolat nedava gamra
Detane tanna kammeh derav yitzchak bar abba vayyakrev et haola vayyaaseha kammishpat kemishpat olat nedava limed al olat chova shetteuna semicha
Vehaeved vehashshaliach vehaishsha tanu rabbanan yado velo yad avdo yado velo yad shelucho yado velo yad ishto
Kol hane lema li tzericha i ketav rachamana chad hava amena lemaote eved delav bar mitzot aval shaliach devar mitzva hu ushlucho shel adam kemoto ema lismoch
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte delav kegufeh damya aval ishto dichgufeh damya ema tismoch tzericha

Semicha sheyare mitzva tanu rabbanan vesamach venirtza vechi semicha mechapperet vahalo en kappara ella baddam shenneemar ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper ella lomar lach sheim asaah lismicha sheyare mitzva maale alav hakkatuv keilu lo kiper vechiper

Vetanya gabbe tenufa ki hay gavena litnufa lechapper vechi tenufa mechapperet vahalo en kappara ella baddam shenneemar ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper ella lomar lach sheim asaah litnufa sheyare mitzva maale alav hakkatuv keilu lo kiper vechiper
Al harosh tanu rabbanan yado al harosh velo yado al hatztzavar yado al harosh velo yado al haggabbayim yado al harosh velo yado al hechaze
Kol hane lema li tzerichi dei ketav rachamana chad lemaote tzavar dela kae bahade rosho aval gabbo dekae lahade rosho ema la tzericha
Vei ashmeinan hane tere mishshum dela itrabbi litnufa aval chaze deitrabbi litnufa ema la tzericha
Ibaya lehu yado al hatztzedadin mahu ta shema detanya abba biraa berabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer yado al rosho vela yado al hatztzedadin
Bae rabbi yirmeya matlet mahu shettachotz ta shema uvilvad shello yehe davar chotzetz beno leven hazzevach

Uvishte yadayim mena hane mile amar resh lakish deamar kera vesamach aharon et shette yadav ketiv yado uchtiv shette ze bana av kol makom shenneemar yado hare kan shettayim ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv achat

Azal rabbi elazar amrah leha shemata beve midresha vela amrah mishshemeh deresh lakish shema resh lakish veikfad amar leh i salka datach kol hecha dichtiv yado tarte ninhu lema li lemichtav yadav yadav
Akshi leh esrim vearba yadav yadav teviena yadav rav lo sikkel et yadav ishtik
Levatar denach dateh amar leh may tama la tema li yadav dismicha kaamri
Bismicha name ketiv vayyismoch et yadav alav vayetzavehu semicha divhema kaamri
Uvimkom shessomchin shochatin techef lismicha shechita may kaamar hachi kaamar bimkom shessomchin shochatin shettechef lismicha shechita

Matni chomer bassemicha mibbattenufa uvattenufa mibbassemicha sheechad menif lechol hachaverim veen echad somech lechol hachaverim chomer battenufa shehattenufa noheget bekorbenot hayyachid uvkorbenot hatztzibbur

a: Bechayyim uvishchutin uvdavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim uvdavar sheen bo ruach chayyim ma sheen ken bassemicha
Gema tanu rabbanan korbano lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha

Sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma tenufa shennitrabbeta bishchutin nitmaata bechovrin semicha shello nitrabbeta bishchutin eno din shettitmaet bechovrin talmud lomar korbano lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha
Vetitrabbe tenufa bechovrin mikkal vachomer uma semicha shello nitrabbeta bishchutin nitrabbeta bechovrin tenufa shennitrabbeta bishchutin eno din shennitrabbeta bechovrin
Mishshum dela efshar hechi lebed lanpu kullehu bahade hadade ka haveya chatzitza lanef velehdar velanef tenufa amar rachamana velo tenufot

Usmicha bishchutin letah vehatnan bizman shekkohen gadol rotze lehaktir haya ole bakkevesh vehassegan bimino higgia lemachatzit hakkevesh achaz segan bimino veheelahu vehoshit lo harishon harosh veharegel somech alehem vezorkan
Hoshit hashsheni larishon shette yadayim notno lechohen gadol somech alehem vezorkan nishmat hashsheni vehalach lo vechach hau moshitin lo shear kol haevarim somech alehem vezorkan
Uvizman shehu rotze hu somech vaacherim zorkin
Amar abbaye hatam mishshum kevodo dechohen gadol
Hadaran alach shette middot

Matni shette hallechem niloshot achat achat veneefot achat achat lechem happanim niloshot achat achat veneefot shettayim shettayim uvidfus haya ose otan keshehu rodan notnan lidfus kede shello yitkalkelu
Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan shene esronim yihye hachalla haechat melammed shenniloshot achat achat
Minnayin sheaf shette hallechem kach talmud lomar yihye uminnayin sheafiyyatan shettayim shettayim talmud lomar vesamta otam yachol af shette hallechem ken talmud lomar otam
Hay otam ha appekteh im ken lema kera vesamtam may vesamta otam shamatte minah tarte

Tanu rabbanan vesamta otam bidfus shelosha defusin hem notnah lidfus vaadayin hi batzek uchmin defus haya lah battannur uchshehu rodah notnah baddefus kede shello titkalkel velahderah lidfus kamma kevan deafe lah nafcha
Itmar lechem happanim ketzad osin oto
b: Rabbi chanina amar kemin teva perutza rabbi yochanan amar kemin sefina rokedet
Bishlama leman deamar kemin teva perutza hayenu dahao yatvi bazichin ella leman deamar kemin sefina rokedet hechi hao yatvi bazichin makom aved lehu
Bishlama leman deamar kemin teva perutza hayenu dahao yatvi kanim ella leman deamar kemin sefina rokedet kanim hechi hao yatvi mursha aved lehu
Bishlama leman deamar kemin teva perutza hayenu desamchi leh senifin lelechem ella leman deamar kemin sefina rokedet hechi semachi leh senifin lelechem deagil lehu migal
Bishlama leman deamar kemin sefina rokedet hayenu devaenan senifin ella leman deamar kemin teva perutza senifin lema li aggav yukra delechem talach

Bishlama leman deamar kemin sefina rokedet senifin al gabbe shulchan munnachin ella leman deamar kemin teva perutza senifin hecha mannach lehu aara mannach lehu in deamar rabbi abba bar memel ledivre haomer kemin sefina rokedet senifin al gabbe shulchan munnachin ledivre haomer kemin teva perutza senifin al gabbe karka munnachin
Keman azla ha deamar rabbi yehuda hallechem maamid et hassenifin vehassenifin maamidin et hallechem keman deamar kemin sefina rokedet

a: Metivi kemin kaveret haya lah battannur vedoma kemin tavla merubbaat ema ufiha dome kemin tavla merubbaat
Tanya keman deamar kemin sefina rokedet detanya arbaa senifin shel zahav hau sham mefutztzalin merashehen kemin dukranin hau shessomchin bahen et hallechem shehu dome kemin sefina rokedet
Ibaya lehu lechem happanim nifsal bammassaot o eno nifsal bammassaot rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi chad amar nifsal vechad amar eno nifsal
Man deamar nifsal dichtiv kaasher yachanu ken yissau ma bachaniyyato nifsal beotze af binsiato nifsal beotze
Man deamar eno nifsal dichtiv velechem hattamid alav yihye
Veidach name ha ketiv kaasher yachanu ken yissau leidach gisa ma bachaniyyato ki lo yatza mimmekomo la mipsel af binsiato ki lo yatza mimmekomo la mipsel
Veidach name ha ketiv velechem hattamid alav yihye ella ki ata rav dimi amar bimsuddar dechulle alma la peligi ella ki peligi bimsullak
Man deamar nifsal dichtiv kaasher yachanu ken yissau ma bachaniyyato nifsal beotze af binsiato mipsel beotze
Leman deamar eno nifsal dichtiv venasa ohel moed af al pi shennasa ohel moed hu
Veidach name hachtiv kaasher yachanu ken yissau leidach gisa ma bachaniyyato ki la mappek leh la mipsel af binsiato ki la mappek leh la mipsel
Veidach name ha ketiv venasa ohel moed hahu lidgalim hu daata
Veidach mimmachane halviyyim betoch hammachanot nafka
Metivi bishat siluk massaot kadashim nifsalin beotze vezavin umtzorain mishtallechin chutz limchitzatan may lav afilu lechem happanim la bar millechem happanim
Ma nafshach i ohel moed daveka hu afilu kodashim name i ohel moed lav daveka hu afilu lechem happanim name
Ella ki ata ravin amar mar amar bimsuddar umar amar bimsullak vela peligi
Amar abbaye shema minah yesh siluk massaot ballayela dei salka datach en siluk massaot ballayela emat middele letzafra may irya mishshum yotze tipok li deipsil leh belina
Peshita lalechet yomam valayela ketiv mahu detema hane mile hecha daakur bimama aval hecha dela akur bimama belelya la matzu akri ka mashma lan
Urminhi huglelu happarochot hutteru zavin umtzorain likanes lesham amar rav ashe la kashya ha rabbi eliezer ha rabbanan detanya
b: Rabbi eliezer omer yachol dachaku zavin umtzorain venichnesu laazara befesach habba betuma yachol yehu chayyavin talmud lomar vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanafesh beshaa shettemee metim mishtallechin zavin umtzorain mishtallechin
En temee metim mishtallechin en zavin umtzorain mishtallechin

Matni achat shette hallechem veachat lechem happanim lishatan vaarichatan bachutz vaafiyyatan bifnim veenan dochot et hashshabbat rabbi yehuda omer kol maasehem bifnim rabbi shimon omer leolam heve ragil lomar shette hallechem velechem happanim kesherot baazara uchsherot bevet page
Gema ha gufa kashya
Amarta lishatan vaarichatan bachutz alma middat yavesh lo nitkaddesha vaafiyyatan bifnim alma middat yavesh nitkaddesha amar rabba hiksha adam kashe shehu kashe kabbarzel umannu rav sheshet
May kashya dilma issaron la mekaddesh tannur mekaddesh
Ella i kashya ha kashya vaafiyyatan bifnim alma tannur mekaddesh veen dochot et hashshabbat ipasla belina ella amar rava hiksha adam kashe shehu kashe kabbarzel umannu rav sheshet
Amar rav ashe may kushya dilma may mibbifnim bimkom zerizin
Veha derav ashe beruta hi ma nafshach i afiyya baenan zerizin lisha vaaricha name baenan zerizin vei lisha vaaricha la baenan zerizin afiyya name la baenan zerizin ella derav ashe beruta hi
Rabbi yehuda omer kol maasehen bifnim vechu amar rabbi avahu bar kahana ushnehen mikra echad darshu vehu derech chol af ki hayyom yikdash bakkeli
Rabbi yehuda savar bachol ashkechinhu deka afu leh amar lehu derech chol ka afetu leh af ki hayyom yikdash bakkeli ipsil leh belina
Rabbi shimon savar beshabbat ashkechinhu deka afu leh amar lehu la derech chol baetu lemibedeh mide tannur mekaddesh shulchan hu dimkaddesh
Umi matzet amratte devishat afiyya ashkechinhu vehachtiv vayyitten lo hakkohen kodesh ki lo haya sham lechem ki im lechem happanim hammusarim millifne Adonai
Ella may derech chol deka amar lehu hachi ka amru leh leka lechem ki im lechem happanim hammusarim millifne Adonai
Amar lehu la mibaya hay dechevan dinfak leh mimmeila derech chol hu ella afilu hayeche name dehayyom yikdash bakkeli havu leh delechol

a: Mesukkan hu verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon bigmara peligi
Dayeka name dekatane rabbi shimon omer leolam heve ragil lomar shette hallechem velechem happanim kesherot baazara uchsherot abbet page shema minah

Matni chavite kohen gadol lishatan vaarichatan vaafiyyatan bifnim vedochot et hashshabbat techinatan veharkadatan enan dochot et hashshabbat kelal amar rabbi akiva kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat enah docha et hashshabbat veshei efshar lah laasotah meerev shabbat docha et hashshabbat
Kol hammenachot yesh bahen maase cheli bifnim veen bahen maase cheli bachutz
Shette hallechem orkah shiva tefachim verochbah arbaa tefachim vekarnoteha arba etzbaot lechem happanim orko asara tefachim verochbo chamishsha tefachim vekarnotav sheva etzbaot
Rabbi yehuda omer shello tite ben zoma omer venatatta al hashshulchan lechem panim lefanay tamid lechem panim sheyehu lo panim
Hashshulchan orko asara verochbo chamishsha lechem happanim orko asara verochbo chamishsha
Noten orko keneged rochbo shel shulchan vechofel tifchayim umechetza mikkan vetifchayim umechetza mikkan nimtza orko memalle rochbo shel shulchan divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi meir omer hashshulchan orko shenem asar verochbo shishsha lechem happanim orko asara verochbo chamishsha

Ka salka datach miyesod vead sovev beamma bat chamishsha begovah umay chek haamma veamma rochav hachi ka amar mechek haamma vead rochav beamma bat chamishsha

Ella hachtiv yaaroch oto aharon uvanav dematzded lehu atzdode
Detanya el mul pene hammenora yairu shivat hannerot melammed shehau metzaddedin penehem kelappe ner emtzai amar rabbi natan mikkan sheemtzai meshubbach
Bishlama leman deamar mizrach umaarav hayenu dahao yatvi asra beesrin ella leman deamar tzafon vedarom asra beesrin hechi hao yatvi
