Gema tenan hatam amar lahem hammunne tzeu uru im higgia zeman shechita im higgia haroe omer barkay mattitya ben shemuel omer heir pene kol hammizrach ad shebbechevron vehu omer hen
Velamma hutzrechu lechach sheppaam achat ala meor hallevana vedimu sheheir mizrach shachatu et hattamid vehotziuhu levet hasserefa
Vehoridu kohen gadol levet hattevila ze hakkelal haya bammikdash kal hammesech et raglav taun tevila vechol hammetil mayim taun kiddush yadayim veraglayim
Tane avuh derabbi avin lo zo bilvad ella afilu olat haof shennimleka ballayela umincha shennikmetza ballayela tetze levet hasserefa
Bishlama olat haof mishshum dela efshar leahdorah ella mincha efshar demahdar kometz leduchteh vekametz bimama
Hu tane lah vehu amar lah kele sharet mekaddeshin shello bizmannan
Metivi kol hakkarev bayyom kadosh bayyom ballayela kadosh ballayela ben bayyom uven ballayela kadosh ben bayyom uven ballayela
Kol hakkarev bayyom kadosh bayyom bayyom in ballayela la eno kadosh likrav aval kadosh lipasel

Motev rabbi zera sider et hallechem veet habbazichin achar shabbat vehiktir et habbazichin bashshabbat pesula ketzad yaase yannichenna leshabbat habbaa sheafilu hi al hashshulchan yamim rabbim en bechach kelum
Vei salka datach kele sharet mekaddeshin shello bizmannan lipasel likdosh velipsul
Amar rabba man deka motev shappir ka motev avuh derabbi avin name matnita kaamar kasavar layela en mechussar zeman ha yamim mechussarin zeman
Sof sof
b: Ki mate lelya deve shimshe likdosh velipsol amar rava beshekkadam vesilek
Mar zutra veitema rav ashe amar afilu tema beshello kadam vesilek kevan desidro shello kemitzvato naasa kemi shessiddero hakkof
Matni shette hallechem neechalot en pachot mishshenayim velo yoter al shelosha ketzad neefot meerev yom tov neechalot beom tov lishnayim chal yom tov lihot achar hashshabbat neechalot lishlosha
Lechem happanim neechal en pachot mittisha velo yoter al achad asar ketzad neefe meerev shabbat veneechal beshabbat letisha chal yom tov lihot erev shabbat neechal laasara

Shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana neechal leachad asar veeno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan doche et yom tov veeno doche et yom tzom
Gema amar ravina ledivre haomer nedarim undavot en kerevin beom tov la tema middeorayeta michza chazu verabbanan hu digzaru shello yeshahe ella middeorayeta name la chazu
Deha shette hallechem dechovat hayyom hu veleka lememar shemma yeshahe vekatane eno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov
Hadaran alach shette hallechem
Matni hammenachot vehannesachim shennitmeu ad shello kadshu bichli yesh lahem pidon mishshekkadshu bichli en lahem pidon
Haofot vehaetzim vehallevona uchle sharet mishshennitmeu en lahen pidon shello neemar pidon ella bivhema
Gema amar shemuel vaafilu hen tehorin nifdin may tama kamma dela kadshi bichli kedushshat damim ninhu ukdushshat damim nifdin
Veha nitmeu tenan hu haddin deaf al gav delo nitmeu veayede deka bae mitne sefa mishshekkadshu bichli en lahen pidon daafilu nitmeu name la tena name resha shennitmeu ad shello kadshu bichli
Peshita kedushshat hagguf ninhu

Itzterich salka datach amena hoil uvaal mum ikri tame tame name kevaal mum dame veaf al gav dekadosh kedushshat hagguf ki nafel beh mum miprik hane name lipruk kamashma lan delav ki hay tame karyeh rachamana levaal mum

a: Demikkele sharet la ashkechan demiprik
Uvaal mum hecha ikri tame detanya veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmenna korban la bevaale mumin shennifdin hakkatuv medabber

Atta omer bevaale mumin shennifdu o eno ella bivhema temea mammash keshehu omer veim babbehema hattemea ufada veerkecha hare behema temea amura ha ma ani mekayyem veim kol behema temea bevaale mumin shennifdu hakkatuv medabber
Yachol yippadu al mum over talmud lomar asher lo yakrivu mimmenna korban la mi sheenah kereva la kol ikar yatzta zo sheenah kereva hayyom ukreva lemachar
Motev rav huna bar manoach haofot vehaetzim vehallevona uchle sharet shennitmeu en lahen pidon shello neemar pidon ella bivhema bishlama ofot kedushshat hagguf ninhu velo neemar ella bivhema
Ella etzim ulvona uchle sharet liparku ella lav mishshum dithorin bealma en nifdin
Vehane name af al gav denitmeu kithorim damu deetzim ulvona lav bene ashoye uchla ninhu ella chibat hakkodesh mashve lehu uchla
Deetzim kamma dela meshappe lehu ligzirin la mitachsheri levona name kamma dela kadsha bichli sharet la mitachshera kele sharet name hoil veit lehu tohora bemikve
La leolam ema lach tehorin bealma nifdin vehane mishshum dela shechichi hu
Bishlama levona uchle sharet la shechichi ella etzim mishkach shechichi etzim name kevan deamar mar kol etz shennimtza bo tolaat pasul legabbe mizbeach hilkach la shechichi

Amar rav pappa i shemia leh lishmuel ha detanya hammatpis temimim levedek habbayit en podin otan ella lammizbeach shekkol harauy lammizbeach eno yotze mide mizbeach leolam veaf al gav dikdushshat damim ninhu en nifdin hoil uthorim hem hava hadar beh
Vela hi shemia leh vela hadar beh lav amratte hatam kevan dela shechichi la miparki
Hacha name kevan dishchichi mumin defasli bivhema daafilu bedukkin shebbaayin name pasli hilkach la shechichi
Rav kahana amar temein nifdin tehorin en nifdin vechen amar rabbi oshaya temein nifdin tehorin en nifdin ika deamri amar rabbi oshaya afilu tehorin nifdin
Rabbi elazar omer kullan temein nifdin tehorin en nifdin chutz measirit haefa shel minchat chote
Shehare amra tora mechattato al chattato
Amar rabbi oshaya shamati pigel bemincha lerabbi shimon eno metamme tumat ochalin ditnan haorla vechile hakkerem
b: Veshor hanniskal veegla arufa vetzippore metzora ufeter chamor uvasar bechalav kullam mittammein tumat ochalin
Rabbi shimon omer kullan en mittammein tumat ochalin umode rabbi shimon bevasar bechalav shemmetamme tumat ochalin hoil vehayeta lo sheat hakkosher

Veamar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan may tama derabbi shimon mikkol haochel asher yeachel ochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim karuy ochel ochel shei atta yachol lehaachilo laacherim eno karuy ochel
Veha pigel bemincha name ochel shei atta yachol lehaachilo laacherim hu
I hachi basar bechalav name tipok leh deochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim hu

Detanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon basar bechalav asur baachila umuttar bahanaa shenneemar ki am kadosh atta la elohecha lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo ulhallan hu omer veanshe kodesh tihun li uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu ma lehallan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa af kan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa
Chada veod kaamar chada deochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim hu veod ledideh name hayeta lo sheat hakkosher
Metivi rabbi shimon omer yesh notar shehu metamme tumat ochalin veyesh notar sheeno metamme tumat ochalin
Ketzad lan lifne zerika eno metamme tumat ochalin leachar zerika metamme tumat ochalin
Veha ufigul ben bekodshe kadashim ben bekadashim kallim eno metamme tumat ochalin pigel bemincha metamme tumat ochalin
La kashya kan shehayeta lah sheat hakkosher kan shello hayeta lah sheat hakkosher
Hechi dame delo hayeta lah sheat hakkosher deakdeshinhu bimchubbar
Velifrekinhu hanicha lehach lishana deamar rabbi oshaya temein nifdin tehorin en nifdin shappir
Ella lehach lishana deamar afilu tehorin nifdin lifrekinhu
Hashta miha la parek
Vechevan dei bae parek leh shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar kol haomed lifdot kefaduy dame
Detanya rabbi shimon omer para metammea tumat ochalin hoil vehayeta lah sheat hakkosher veamar resh lakish omer haya rabbi shimon para nifdet al gav maarachtah
Hachi hashta bishlama para omedet lifdot hi sheim matza acheret naa hemenna mitzva lifdotah ella hane menachot mitzva lifdotan
Veha lan lifne zerika demitzva lemizrekeh vei bae zarak vekatane deen mittamme tumat ochalin
Hacha bemay askinan shello hayeta shehut bayyom lemizrekeh
Aval hayeta lo shehut beom may metamme tumat ochalin
Addetane lan leachar zerika metamme tumat ochalin liflog bedidah bamme devarim amurim shello hayeta lo shehut beom aval hayeta lo shehut bayyom metamme tumat ochalin
Hachi name kaamar lan kodem sheyyerae lizrika eno metamme tumat ochalin leachar sheyyerae lizrika metamme tumat ochalin
Veha pigel ben bekodshe kadashim ben bekadashim kallim mitzva lemizrekeh

a: Vei bae zarek vekatane deeno metamme tumat ochalin may lav defagel bizrika la defagel bishchita
Aval pagel bizrika may hachi name dimtamme tumat ochalin
Addetane pigel bemincha metamme tumat ochalin liflog bedidah bamme devarim amurim defagel bishchita aval pagel bizrika metamme tumat ochalin
Pigel bemincha itztericha leh deaf al gav defagel bikmitza dekometz bemincha kishchita dame afilu hachi metamme tumat ochalin hoil vehayeta lo sheat hakkosher meikaro
Amar rav ashe amritah lishmata kammeh derav nachman afilu tema lan mammash vaafilu tema defagel bizrika
Dei bae parek amrinan i bae hava zarek la amrinan
Metivi kelal amar rabbi yehoshua kol shehayeta lah sheat heter lakkohanim en moalin bah vechol shello hayeta lah sheat heter lakkohanim moalin bah
Veezehu sheat heter lakkohanim shellana veshennitmet vesheyyatza
Veezo hi shello hayeta lah sheat heter lakkohanim shennishchata chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damah
Katane miha resha shellana veshennitmet vesheyyatza may lav lana mammash vehacha dei bae hava zarek hu vekatane deen moalin
La reuya latzet uruya littamme uruya lalin
Aval lina mammash may hachi name demoalin hay kol shehayeta lah sheat heter lakkohanim vechol shello hayeta lah sheat heter lakkohanim
Kol sheyyesh lah sheat heter lakkohanim en moalin bah vechol sheen lah sheat heter lakkohanim moalin bah mibe leh
Ella amar rav ashe meila attuma ka ramet
Meila mishshum kedushsha velav kedushsha hi levatar defaka lah kedushsheteh bemay hadra rachva lah

Tuma mishshum uchla velav mishshum uchla hi kol hecha dei bae zarek matze zarek leh meshave leh uchla umtamme tumat ochalin hecha dei bae matze zarek la matze zarek la meshave leh uchla vela metamme tumat ochalin
Metivi hammevi asham taluy venoda shello chata im ad shello nishchat noda lo yetze veyire baeder divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim
b: Yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava rabbi eliezer omer yakriv sheim eno ba al chet ze hare hu ba al chet acher
Mishshennishchat noda lo haddam yishshafech vehabbasar yissaref
Nizrak haddam habbasar yeachel verabbi yose omer afilu haddam bakkos yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel
Veamar rava rabbi yose beshitat rabbi shimon amarah deamar kol haomed lizrok kezaruk dame
Mide hu tama amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose bar chanina hayenu tama derabbi yose dekasavar kele sharet mekaddeshin et happesulin lechattechila likrav

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana middeamar rabbi shimon kol haomed lizrok kezaruk dame kol haomed lisrof name kesaruf dame notar ufara ammay mittammein tumat ochalin afra bealma ninhu amar leh chibat hakkodesh machshartan
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe nehi demahneya lehu chibat hakkodesh leipsole degufeh likroye tame name lemimne beh rishon vesheni
Tifshot devae resh lakish tzarid shel menachot monin bo rishon vesheni o en monin bo rishon vesheni
Ki mibaya leh leresh lakish deorayeta ki kaamrinan derabbanan
Matni haomer hare alay bemachavat vehevi bemarcheshet bemarcheshet vehevi bemachavat ma shehevi hevi vide chovato lo yatza
Zo lehavi bemachavat vehevi bemarcheshet bemarcheshet vehevi bemachavat hare zo pesula
Haomer hare alay shene esronot lehavi bichli echad vehevi bishne kelim bishne kelim vehevi bichli echad ma shehevi hevi vide chovato lo yatza
Ellu bichli echad vehevi bishne kelim bishne kelim vehevi bichli echad hare ellu pesulin
Hare alay shene esronot lehavi bichli echad vehevi bishne kelim amru lo bichli echad nadarta hikrivan bishne kelim pesulin bichli echad kesherin
Hare alay shene esronot lehavi bishne kelim vehevi bichli echad amru lo bishne kelim nadarta hikrivan bishne kelim kesherin netano lichli echad kishte menachot shennitarvu
Gema utzricha
Dei ashmeinan hach kammayeta mishshum deamar bemachavat veka mayete bemarcheshet aval hacha deide veide bemachavat veide veide bemarcheshet ema yede nidro name yatza
Vei ashmeinan hach mishshum deka paleg laho aval hatam dela paleg beh ema la tzericha
Tanu rabbanan ma shehevi hevi vide nidro lo yatza rabbi shimon omer af yede nidro name yatza
Zo lehavi bemachavat veha tanya lo kidshum kele sharet amar abbaye lo kidshum likrav aval kidshum lipasel
Veamar abbaye lo shanu

a: Ella shekkevaan bishat neder aval bishat hafrasha la
Kaasher nadarta velo kaasher hifrashta
Itmar name amar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shekkevaan bishat neder aval bishat hafrasha lo kaasher nadarta velo kaasher hifrashta
Matni haomer hare alay mincha min hasseorim yavi min hachittim kemach yavi solet belo shemen uvlo levona yavi shemen ulvona
Chatzi issaron yavi issaron shalem issaron umechetza yavi shenayim rabbi shimon poter shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevin
Gema ammay neder ufitcho immo hu
Amar chizkiyya ha manni bet shammay hi deamri tefos lashon rishon ditnan hareni nazir min haggerogrot umin haddevela bet shammay omrim nazir uvet hillel omrim eno nazir
Rabbi yochanan amar afilu tema bet hillel beomer ilu hayiti yodea sheen nodrin kach lo hayiti noder kach ella kach
Amar chizkiyya lo shanu ella deamar mincha min hasseorim aval amar mincha min haadashim la
Mikkedi chizkiyya keman amar lishmateh kevet shammay uvet shammay mishshum tefos lashon rishon hu ma li min hasseorin ma li min haadashim hadar beh
Umay tama hadar beh amar rava matnitin keshiteh may irya detane mincha min hasseorim litne min haadashim
Ella shema minah mishshum detae hu bisorim tae baadashim la tae
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu min haadashim mikkede rabbi yochanan keman amrah lishmateh kevet hillel uvet hillel mishshum detae hu bisorin tae baadashim la tae
Lidvarav dechizkiyya kaamar leh atte may tama hadratte bach mishshum dela katane min haadashim
Dilma la mibaya kaamar la mibaya min haadashim deika lememar mihdar hu dehadar beh utfos lashon rishon ella afilu min hasseorin name deika lememar mita hu deka tae afilu hachi tefos lashon rishon
b: Amar zeeri lo shanu ella deamar mincha aval la amar mincha la
Yatev rav nachman vekaamar lah leha shemata etiveh rava lerav nachman kemach yavi solet lav delo amar mincha la deamar mincha
Belo shemen ulvona yavi shemen ulvona may lav delo amar mincha la deamar mincha
Chatzi issaron yavi issaron shalem may lav delo amar mincha la deamar mincha
I hachi ema sefa issaron umechetza yavi shenayim kevan deamar mincha ichayyav leh beissaron ki amar chatzi issaron lo kelum kaamar hu
La tzericha deamar hare alay mincha chatzi issaron veissaron dechevan deamar mincha ichayyav leh beissaron ki amar chatzi issaron velo kelum kaamar ki hadar amar issaron mayete issaron acharina
I hachi rabbi shimon poter shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevin ammay amar rava rabbi shimon beshitat rabbi yose amarah deamar af bigmar devarav adam matpis

Matni mitnaddev adam mincha shel shishshim issaron umevi bichli echad im amar hare alay shishshim issaron mevi bichli echad im amar hare alay shishshim veechad mevi shishshim bichli echad veechad bichli echad shekken hatztzibur mevi beom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihot bashshabbat shishshim veechad
Dayyo layyachid shehu pachot min hatztzibur echad
Amar rabbi shimon vahalo ellu lapparim veellu lakkevasim veenam nivlalim ze im ze ella ad shishshim yecholin libalel
Amru lo shishshim nivlalin veshishshim veechad en nivlalin amar lahem kol middot chachamim ken bearbaim sea hu tovel uvarbaim sea chaser kurtov eno yachol litbol bahen
Gema sheil sheela lemala merabbi yehuda bar ilay minnayin leomer hare alay shishshim veechad mevi shishshim bichli echad veechad bichli echad

Patach rabbi yehuda bar ilay rosh hamdabberim bechol makom veamar shekken matzinu tzibur meviin beom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihot bashshabbat shishshim veechad dayyo layyachid sheyyifchot min hatztzibur echad
Amar lo rabbi shimon vahalo ellu parim veelim veellu kevasim ellu belilatan ava veellu belilatan rakka ellu belilatan shacharit veellu belilatan ben haarbayim veen nivlalin mizze al ze
Amru lo emor atta amar lahem hare hu omer vechol mincha velula vashshemen vachareva kevar amra tora have mincha sheyechola lehibalel
Amar lo beshishshim nivlalin beshishshim veechad en nivlalin amar lo kol middat chachamim ken hu bearbaim sea hu tovel bearbaim sea chaser kurtov eno yachol litbol
Kevetza metamme tumat ochalin kevetza chaser shumshum en metamme tumat ochalin shelosha al shelosha metamme midras shelosha al shelosha chaser nima achat eno metamme midras
Vechi en nivlalin may have veha tenan im lo balal kasher amar rabbi zera kol harauy levila en bila meakkevet bo vechol sheeno rauy levila bila meakkevet bo
Amar rabbi bivi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi maase befirda achat shel bet rabbi shemmeta veshiaru chachamim et damah birviit

Metiv rabbi yitzchak bar bisna heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi yehoshua ben betera al dam nevelot shehu tahor veamar rabbi yehoshua ben betera maase vehau nocharin arodyaot laaraot beistarya shel melech vehau ole regalim shokin ad rechubbotehen baddam velo amru lahem davar
Ishtik amar leh rabbi zerika may tama la ka mahdar mar amar leh hechi ahdar leh deamar rabbi chanin vehau chayyecha teluim lecha minneged ze hallokeach tevua mishshana leshana
Ufachadta layela veomam ze hallokeach tevua meerev shabbat leerev shabbat veal taamen bechayyecha ze hassomech al happalter

a: Vehahu gavra al palter samech
May have alah amar rav yosef rabbi yehuda moryana deve nesia hava veori leh kishmateh

Ditnan rabbi yehuda omer shishsha devarim mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel dam nevelot bet shammay metaharin uvet hillel metammein amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda af keshettimmeu bet hillel lo timmeu ella birviit hoil veyachol likrosh velaamod al kezayit
Matni en mitnaddevin log shenayim vachamishsha aval mitnaddevin shelosha vearbaa veshishsha umishshishsha ulmala
Gema ibaya lehu yesh keva linsachim o en keva linsachim
Hechi dame kegon deayeti chamsha i amratte en keva linsachim mashech umakrev arbea minayehu dachaze leayil veidach have nedava vei amratte yesh keva linsachim ad dimmalle lehu la korvi
May amar abbaye ta shema shishsha lindava veamrinan keneged mi keneged motar chattat umotar ashamot umotar asham nazir umotar asham metzora umotar kinin umotar minchat chote
Veim ita litakken shofar acharina keneged motar nesachim
Hanach lenidvat tzibbur azli hane shechichi efshar demitztarfi demar udmar bahade hadade vekarvi
Amar rava ta shema ezrach melammed shemmitnaddevin nesachim vechamma sheloshet luggin
Uminnayin sheim ratza lehosif yosif talmud lomar yihye yachol yifchot talmud lomar kacha
May yosif ilema arbaa veshishsha may shena shelosha dachazu lecheves arbaa veshishsha name chazu leayil ufar ella lav chamishsha ushma minah en keva linsachim shema minah
Amar rav ashe veha anan la tenan hachi en mitnaddevin log shenayim vachamishsha katane chamishsha dumya dishnayim ma shenayim dela chazu kelal af chamishsha name dela chazu kelal
Mide irya ha kiditah veha kiditah
Amar abbaye im timtza lomar en keva linsachim ha en keva linsachim im timtza lomar yesh keva linsachim ad asara peshita li achad asar
b: Mibaya li may gavra lishne parim ka mechaven vead dimmalle lehu la korvi o dilma lishne elim vecheves echad kamchaveyn tere mechad mina vechad mechad mina amrinan o la may teku
Matni mitnaddevin yayin veen mitnaddevin shemen divre rabbi akiva rabbi tarfon omer mitnaddevin shemen

Amar rabbi tarfon ma matzinu beyayin shehu ba chova uva nedava af shemen shehu ba chova ba nedava amar lo rabbi akiva lo im amarta beyayin shekken karev im chovato bifne atzmo tomar beshemen sheeno karev im chovato bifne atzmo
En shenayim mitnaddevin issaron echad aval mitnaddevin ola ushlamim veof afilu pereda achat
Gema amar rava middivre shenehem nilmod mitnaddev adam minchat nesachim bechol yom
Peshita mahu detema minchat nedava galli bah rachamana hane chamishsha menachot in tefe la ka mashma lan hane mile bistama aval hecha defaresh paresh
En shenayim mitnaddevin may tama ilema mishshum dichtiv takriv ola name ha ketiv yakriv
Ella ola may tama dichtiv leolotechem mincha name ha ketiv leminchotechem ella mishshum dichtiv bah nefesh
Tanya name hachi rabbi omer asher yakriv korbano lechol nidrehem ulchol nidvotam asher yakrivu la hakkol bain beshuttafut lo silek hakkatuv ella mincha shenneemar nefesh
Amar rabbi yitzchak mippene ma nishtannet mincha shenneemar vah nefesh amar hakkadosh baruch hu mi darko lehavi mincha ani maale ani alav keilu hikriv nafsho lefanay

Amar rabbi yitzchak ma nishtannet mincha shenneemru bah chamishsha mine tigun hallalu mashal lemelech basar vedam sheasa lo ohavo seuda veodea bo shehu ani amar lo ase li min chamishsha mine tigun kede sheehane mimmecha
Hadaran alach hammenachot vehannesachim
Matni hare alay issaron yavi echad esronot yavi shenayim perashti veeni yodea ma perashti yavi shishshim issaron
Hare alay mincha yavi ezo sheyyirtze rabbi yehuda omer yavi minchat hassolet shehi meuchedet shebbammenachot
Mincha o min hammincha yavi achat menachot o min menachot yavi shettayim perashti veeni yodea eze mehen perashti yavi chamishtan
Perashti mincha shel esronim veeni yodea kamma perashti yavi shishshim issaron rabbi omer yavi menachot shel esronot meechad vead shishshim
Gema peshita esronot yavi shettayim itztericha leh ha name peshita miut esronot shettayim itztericha leh
Perashti veeni yodea ma perashti yavi shishshim issaron man tanna
Amar chizkiyya dela kerabbi dei rabbi haamar yavi menachot shel esronot meechad vead shishshim
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu tema rabbi beomer perashti esronot aval lo kevatim bichli demayete shitin esronot beshitin mane
Hare alay mincha yavi ezehu sheyyirtze vechu tana hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla
Ella meatta haomer hare alay ola yavi ben bakar hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv

a: Techilla
Min hatztzon yavi keves hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla
Min haof yavi torim hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla
Allema tenan hare alay ola yavi keves rabbi elazar ben azarya omer tor o ben yona vela pelig rabbi yehuda
Ella may meuchedet shebbammenachot delet leh shem levay
Veha tana hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla kaamar hachi kaamar ezehu mincha meuchedet shebbammenachot delet leh shem levay zo sheppatach bo hakkatuv techilla
Peshita minchat hassolet kaamar simana bealma
Mincha min hammincha vechu bae rav pappa mine mincha mahu
Kevan deamar mine tarte kaamar umay mincha dechullah menachot name mincha mikaryan dichtiv vezot torat hammincha
O dilma kevan deamar mincha chada mincha kaamar umay mine mincha hachi kaamar mimmine mincha chada mincha alay
Ta shema mincha min mincha yavi achat ha mine mincha shettayim
Ema sefa menachot min menachot yavi shettayim ha mine mincha chada ella meha leka lemishma minah
Ta shema min menachot alay yavi shette menachot mimmin echad ha mimmine mincha chada
Dilma ha mine mincha mevi shette menachot mishshene minin
Veha la tane hachi min menachot alay mevi shette menachot mimmin echad mine menachot alay mevi shette menachot mishshene minin ha mine mincha chada
Dilma ha manni rabbi shimon hi deamar mechetza challot umechetza rekikin yavi umay mine mincha mincha deit bah tere mine
Aval rabbanan deamri mechetza challot umechetza rekikin lo yavi mevi shette menachot mishshene minin
Perashti veeni yodea ma perashti yavi chamishtan man tanna
Amar rabbi yirmeya dela kerabbi shimon dei rabbi shimon kevan deamar mechetza challot umechetza rekikin yavi
I name savar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar kol hammenachot baot eser ika lesappokah bearba esre menachot
Abbaye amar afilu tema rabbi shimon shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar mayete umatne
Detanya rabbi shimon omer lammochorat mevi ashamo veluggo
b: Immo veomer im metzora hu zehu ashamo veze luggo veim lav asham ze yehe shalme nedava
Veoto asham taun shechita batztzafon umattan behonot usmicha unsachim utnufat chaze vashok veneechal lezichre chehunna leom valayela
Veaf al gav deka mefarek mar bishchitat kadashim
Emar deamar rabbi shimon mayete umatne lechattechila letakkone gavra aval bealma diavad in lechattechila la
Hane mile gabbe shelamim deka memaet baachilatan dehau lehu kadashim levet happesul aval menachot afilu lechattechila
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye rabbi shimon deamar mechetza challot umechetza rekikin yavi ha ka mayete issaron echad mishshene issaron velog echad mishshene luggin
Shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar im hevi issaron echad mishshene esronot velog echad mishshene luggin yatza

Umikmatz hechi kamatz dematne veamar i challot lechodayehu urkikin lechodayehu amari deka kametzna mechallot leheve achallot deka kametzna merkikin leheve arkikin i mechetza rekikin umechetza challot amari deka kametzna mechallot leheve ammechetza challot umechetza rekikin udka kametzna merkikin liho ammechetza rekikin umechetza challot
Veha bae mikmatz chad kometz mechallot

a: Umerkikin veka kametz mechallot arkikin umerkikin achallot
Shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar im kamatz veala beyado meechad al shenehem yatza
Veha ika motar shemen dei mechetza challot umechetza rekikin amar motar hashshemen machziro lachallot i kullehu rekikin amar motar hashshemen neechal lakkohanim
Kerabbi shimon ben yehuda detanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon moshchan kemin ki umotar hashshemen neechal lakkohanim
Amar leh rav kahana lerav ashe veha ika lesappokah beminchat nesachim deamar rava mitnaddev adam minchat nesachim bechol yom
Ki ka mistappeka leh siman yachid biglal levona belog mekammetza
Baa biglal yachid baa biglal tzibur la mistappeka leh
Ki ka mistappeka leh baa biglal atzmah baa biglal zevach la mistappeka leh
Ki ka mistappeka leh teuna levona sheenah teuna levona la mistappeka leh
Ki ka mistappeka leh baa belog baa bishlosha luggin la mistappeka leh
Ki ka mistappeka leh teuna kemitza sheenah teuna kemitza la ka mistappeka leh
Perashti mincha shel esronim

Tanu rabbanan perashti mincha vekavati bichli echad shel esronim veeni yodea ma perashti yavi mincha shel shishshim esronim divre chachamim rabbi omer yavi menachot shel esronim meechad vead shishshim shehen elef ushmone meot ushloshim

Perashti veeni yodea ma perashti vei zo mehen perashti veeni yodea kamma perashti yavi chamesh menachot shel shishshim shishshim esronim shehen shelosh meot divre chachamim rabbi omer yavi chamesh menachot shel shishshim esronim meechad vead shishshim shehen tisha alafim umea vachamishshim
Bemay ka mipalgi amar rav chisda bemuttar lehachnis chullin laazara ka mipalgi rabbi savar asur lehachnis chullin laazara verabbanan savri muttar lehachnis chullin laazara
Rava amar dechulle alma asur lehachnis chullin laazara vehacha bemuttar learev chova bindava ka mipalgi
Rabbanan savri muttar learev chova bindava verabbi savar asur learev chova bindava
Amar leh abbaye lerava lerabbanan deamri muttar learev chova bindava ha baenan shene kematzim dekametz vahadar kametz
Veha ka kametz mechova annedava uminnedava achova
Detale leh bedaat kohen deamar kol hecha dematya yeda dechohen hashta chova ulvassof nedava
Veaktore hechi maktar laktar nedava beresha dechova hechi maktar lah dilma kullah chova hi vechasru lehu shirayim
Veamar mar shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaktara en maktir kometz alehen
Laktar chova beresha dindava hechi maktar lah
b: Vedilma kullah chova hi vechol shehu mimmennu laishim hare hu beval taktiru
Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi demassek lehu leshum etzim uchrabbi eliezer detanya rabbi eliezer omer lereach nichoach i atta maale aval atta maale leshum etzim
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe vedilma dechulle alma muttar learev chova bindava vehacha bidrabbi eliezer ka mipalgi derabbanan it lehu derabbi eliezer verabbi let leh derabbi eliezer
Amar leh i salka datach lerabbi muttar learev chova bindava udrabbi eliezer let leh efshar demayete shitin bechad mana vechad bechad mana umagga lehu vekametz
Rava amar dechulle alma muttar learev chova bindava udchulle alma it lehu derabbi eliezer vehacha biflugta derabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbanan ka mipalgi
Ditnan afilu mincha shel shishshim issaron noten lah shishshim log rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer afilu mincha shel shishshim issaron en lah ella luggah shenneemar lemincha velog shamen
Rabbanan savri kerabbanan deamri shishshim log vechol chad vechad issaron lugga ka shakel
Verabbi savar kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov deamar en lah ella luggah vela yadinan i chada mincha hi desaggi lah bechad log i shette menachot ninhu devaenan shene luggin
Rav ashe amar bekatan vehevi gadol kamipalgi rabbanan savri katan vehevi gadol yatza verabbi savar lo yatza
Veha ipligu bah chada zimna ditnan katan vehevi gadol yatza rabbi omer lo yatza
Tzericha dei itmar beha beha ka amri rabbanan mishshum deide veide kometz hu aval hatam deka nefishi emurin ema modu leh lerabbi
Vei itmar behahi behahi kaamar rabbi aval beha ema mode lehu lerabbanan tzericha
Siman etzim zahav yayin ola toda shor
Matni hare alay etzim lo yifchot mishshene gezirin levona lo yifchot mikkometz
Chamishsha kematzim hem haomer alay levona lo yifchot mikkometz hamnaddev mincha yavi immah kometz levona hammaale et hakkometz bachutz chayyav shene bazichin teunin shene kematzim
Hare alay zahav lo yifchot middinar zahav kesef lo yifchot middinar kesef nechoshet lo yifchot mimmaa kesef perashti veeni yodea ma perashti yehe mevi ad sheyyomar lo lechach nitkavanti
Gema tanu rabbanan korban melammed shemmitnaddevin etzim vechamma shene gezirin vechen hu omer vehaggoralot hippalnu al kurban haetzim rabbi omer etzim korban hem teunin melach utunin haggasha
Amar rava uldivre rabbi etzim teunin kemitza amar rav pappa ledivre rabbi etzim tzerichin etzim

Levona lo yifchot min hakkometz menalan dichtiv veherim mimmennu bekumtzo missolet hammincha umishshamnah veet kol hallevona makkish levona laharama demincha ma harama demincha kometz af levona name kometz
Tanu rabbanan hare alay lammizbeach yavi levona sheen lecha davar shekkarev legabbe mizbeach ella levona perashti veeni yodea ma perashti yavi mikkol davar shekkarev lammizbeach
Vetu leka veha ika ola ika orah lechohanim
Veha ika olat haof ika

a: Mura venotza
Vehaika nesachim lashshitin azli
Vehaika minchat nesachim kevan deika mincha deachli kohanim minah la pesika leh
Hare alay zahav lo yifchot middinar zahav vedilma nesacha amar rabbi elazar deamar matbea vedilma perite amar rav pappa perite dedahava la avdi inashe
Kesef lo yifchot middinar vedilma nesacha amar rabbi elazar deamar matbea vedilma perite amar rav sheshet beatra dela sagu perite dechaspa
Nechoshet lo yifchot mimmaa kesef tanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer lo yifchot mitztzinora ketanna shel nechoshet lemay chazya amar abbaye shemmechattetin bah petilot umkannechin bah nerot
Barzel tanya acherim omrim lo yifchot mikkalya orev vechamma amar rav yosef amma al amma
Ika deamri lo yifchot meamma al amma lemay chazya amar rav yosef lechalya orev
Matni hare alay yayin lo yifchot mishshelosha luggin shemen lo yifchot millog rabbi omer shelosha luggin
Perashti veeni yodea ma perashti yavi keom merubbe
Gema tanu rabbanan ezrach melammed shemmitnaddevin yayin vechamma shelosha luggin
Uminnayin sheim ratza lehosif yosif talmud lomar yihye yachol yifchot talmud lomar kacha
Shemen lo yifchot min hallog rabbi omer shelosha luggin bemay ka mipalgi
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa bedun minah uminah bedun minah veokem beatrah ka mipalgi
Rabbanan savri dun minah uminah ma mincha mitnaddevin af shemen name mitnaddevin uminah ma mincha belog af shemen belog
Verabbi savar dun minah veoke beatrah ma mincha mitnaddevin af shemen name mitnaddevin veoke beatrah kinsachim ma nesachim sheloshet luggin af shemen name sheloshet luggin
Amar lehu rav pappa i mimmincha gamar lah rabbi dechulle alma la peligi dun minah uminah ella rabbi meezrach gemir lah

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa umi matzet amratte hachi vehatanya korban melammed shemmitnaddevin shemen vechamma sheloshet luggin man shamatte leh deamar sheloshet luggin rabbi veka mayete lah mikkorban amar leh i tanya tanya
Perashti veeni yodea ma perashti yavi keom merubbe tena keom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihot bashshabbat
Matni hare alay ola yavi keves rabbi elazar ben azarya omer o tor o ben yona
Perashti min habbakar veeni yodea ma perashti yavi par veegel min habbehema veeni yodea ma perashti yavi par veegel ayil sair gedi vetale perashti veeni yodea ma perashti
b: Mosif alehen tor uven yona

Hare alay toda ushlamim yavi keves perashti min bakar veeni yodea ma perashti yavi par ufara egel veegla min habbehema veeni yodea ma perashti yavi par ufara egel veegla ayil urchela sair usira gedi ugdiyya tale vetalya
Hare alay shor yavi hu unsachav bemane egel yavi hu unsachav bechamesh ayil yavi hu unsachav bishtayim keves yavi hu unsachav besela
Shor bemane yavi bemane chutz minnesachav egel bechamesh yavi bechamesh chutz minnesachav ayil bishtayim yavi bishtayim chutz minnesachav keves besela yavi bassela chutz minnesachav
Shor bemane vehevi shenayim bemane lo yatza vaafilu ze bemane chaser dinar veze bemane chaser dinar
Shachor vehevi lavan lavan vehevi shachor gadol vehevi katan lo yatza katan vehevi gadol yatza rabbi omer lo yatza
Gema vela peligi mar ki atreh umar ki atreh

Tanu rabbanan hare alay ola besela lammizbeach yavi keves sheen lecha davar shekkarev besela legabbe mizbeach ella keves shekkarev besela perashti veeni yodea ma perashti yavi mikkol davar shekkarev besela legabbe mizbeach
Perashti min habbakar veeni yodea ma perashti yavi par veegel ammay velayete par mimma nafshach
Ha manni rabbi hi deamar katan vehevi gadol lo yatza
I rabbi ema sefa shor bemane vehevi shenayim bemane lo yatza vaafilu ze bemane chaser dinar veze bemane chaser dinar
Shachor vehevi lavan lavan vehevi shachor gadol vehevi katan lo yatza katan vehevi gadol yatza rabbi omer lo yatza
Resha vesefa rabbi umtziata rabbanan
In resha vesefa rabbi metziata rabbanan vehachi kaamar davar ze machloket rabbi verabbanan
Tenan hatam shishsha lindava keneged mi siman
Amar chizkiyya keneged shishsha batte avot hakkohanim shettikkenu lahem chachamim sheyehe shalom ze im ze
Rabbi yochanan amar mittoch shehannedava merubba tiknu lahem shofarot merubbin kede shello yitappeshu hammaot
Uzeri amar keneged par vaegel ayil vacheves gedi vesair verabbi hi deamar katan vehevi gadol lo yatza
Uvar peda amar keneged happarim vehaelim

a: Vehakkevasim vehasseirim vehammotarot vehammaa
Kullehu kechizkiyya la amri leinnetzoye la chayeshinan dechol chad vechad yomeh ka aved
Kerabbi yochanan la amri leiapposhe la chayeshinan
Kizeri la amri kichidaa la mokmi
Kevar peda name la amri motarot kullehu name motarot
Maa name lishkalim azla detanya lehechan kalbon ze holech lishkalim divre rabbi meir rabbi eliezer omer lindava
Ushmuel amar keneged motar chattat umotar asham umotar asham nazir umotar asham metzora umotar minchat chote umotar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol
Verabbi oshaya amar keneged motar chattat umotar asham umotar asham nazir umotar asham metzora umotar kinin umotar minchat chote
Ushmuel may tama la amar kerabbi oshaya kinin tena leh resha
Verabbi oshaya tane vela tane kinin vehatane rabbi oshaya vetane kinin chad lekinin vechad lemotar kinin
Verabbi oshaya may tama la amar kishmuel savar lah keman deamar motar shel asirit haefa shel kohen gadol yirkav detanya motar minchat nedava motar mincha yirkav
May kaamar amar rav chisda hachi kaamar motar minchat chote nedava motar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol yirkav
Rabba amar afilu motar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol name nedava ella motar lachme toda yirkav
Biflugta motar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol rabbi yochanan amar nedava rabbi elazar amar yirkav
Metivi motar shekalim chullin umotar asirit haefa umotar kine zavin vekine zavot vekine yoldot vechattaot vaashamot motrehen nedava
May lav motar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol
Lo motar minchat chote
Amar rav nachman bar rav yitzchak mistabbera keman deamar motar asirit haefa shel kohen gadol yirkav

Detanya lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona ki chattat hi amar rabbi yehuda hi keruya chattat veen acheret keruya chattat limed al asirit haefa shel kohen gadol sheenah keruya chattat utuna levona
Umiddeenah keruya chattat motarah yirkav
Matni shor ze ola venistaev im ratza yavi bedamav shenayim shene shevarim ellu ola venistaavu ratza yavi bidmehen echad verabbi oser
Ayil ze ola venistaev im ratza yavi bedamav keves keves ze ola venistaev im ratza yavi bedamav ayil verabbi oser
b: Gema veha amratte resha shor bemane vehevi shenayim bemane lo yatza
Shor ze venistaev shane
Shene shevarin ellu ola venistaavu ratza yavi bidmehen echad verabbi oser may tama
Mishshum dehave leh gadol vehevi katan veaf al gav denistaev lechitchila la share rabbi
Veliflog name beresha
Rabbi akkullah milta pelig venatar lehu lerabbanan ad demasseki miltayehu vahadar miplig alayehu
Teda dekatane ayil ze ola venistaev ratza yavi bedamav keves keves ze leola venistaev ratza yavi bedamav ayil verabbi oser shema minah
Ibaya lehu mimmina lemina may
Ta shema shor ze ola venistaev lo yavi bedamav ayil aval mevi bedamav shene elim verabbi oser lefi sheen bila shema minah
I hachi may irya tere afilu chad name deha benistaev lerabbanan la shane lehu ben gadol lekatan
Tere tannae vealliba derabbanan
Rabbi oser lefi sheen bila tama deen bila ha yesh bila shere
Vehatnan ayil ze ola venistaev ratza yavi bedamav keves keves ze ola venistaev yavi bedamav ayil verabbi oser
Tere tannae vealliba derabbi
Uvithorim egel vehevi par keves vehevi ayil yatza setama kerabbanan
Ratza yavi bedamav shenayim ku amar rav menashsheya bar zevid amar rav lo shanu ella deamar shor ze ola aval amar shor ze alay ola hukba
Vedilma alay lahavio kaamar
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav menashsheya bar zevid amar rav lo shanu ella deamar shor ze ola i name amar shor ze alay ola aval amar shor ze vedamav alay ola hukba

Matni haomer echad mikkevasay hekdesh veechad mishshevaray hekdesh vehau lo shenayim haggadol shebbahen hekdesh shelosha benoni shebbahem hekdesh perashti veeni yodea ma shepperashti o sheamar li abba veeni yodea ma haggadol shebbahen hekdesh
Gema alma makdish beayin yafa makdish ema sefa benoni shebbahen hekdesh alma makdish beayin raa makdish
Amar shemuel choshshin af levenoni dilgabbe katan ayin yafa hu
Hechi aved amar rabbi chiyya bar rav mamtin lo ad sheyyumam umachel leh likdushsheteh baggadol
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lo shanu ella deamar echad mishshevaray hekdesh aval amar shor bishvaray hekdesh haggadol shebbahen hekdesh tora betoray kaamar
Ini vehaamar rav huna amar rabbi chiyya mishshemeh deulla haomer lachavero bayit bevattay ani mocher lach marehu aliyya lav mishshum digria la meulle shebbabbattim
Metivi shor bishvaray hekdesh vechen shor shel hekdesh shennitarev baacherim haggadol shebbahen hekdesh vechullam yimmachru letzorche olot udmehen chullin
Targuma ashshor shel hekdesh shennitarev baacherim veha vechen kaamar targema aggadol
Metivi bayit bevatay ani mocher lach venafal marehu naful eved baavaday ani mocher lach vamet marehu met

a: Veammay lichze heyden nefal heyden met
Lokeach ka amratte shane lokeach deyad baal hashshetar al hattachtona
Hashta deatet lehachi afilu tema aliyya digria yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona
Matni hare alay ola yakrivenna bammikdash veim hikrivah bevet chono lo yatza hare alay ola sheakrivenna bevet chono yakrivenna bammikdash veim hikrivah bevet chono yatza rabbi shimon omer en zo ola
Hareni nazir yegallach bammikdash veim gillach bevet chono lo yatza hareni nazir sheagalleach bevet chono yegalleach bammikdash veim gillach bevet chono yatza rabbi shimon omer en ze nazir
Gema yatza ha miktal katlah
Amar rav hamnuna naasa keomer hare alay ola al menat shello etchayyev beachrautah

Amar leh rava ella meatta sefa dekatane hareni nazir sheagalleach bevet chono yegallach bammikdash veim gilach bevet chono yatza hachi name denaasa keomer hareni nazir al menat shello etchayyev beachraut korbenotav nazir kamma dela mayete korbenotav la mittachshar
Ella amar rava adam ze ledoron nitkaven amar i saggi bevet chono tarachna tefe la matzena leitztaore
Nazir name hay gavra letzaore nafsheh ka mikaven amar i saggi bevet chono tarachna tefe la matzena leitztaore
Verav hamnuna amar lach nazir kidkaamratte ola al menat shello etchayyev beachrautah kaamar
Veaf rabbi yochanan savar lah leha derav hamnuna deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan hare alay ola sheakrivenna bevet chono vehikrivah beeretz yisrael yatza veanush karet
Tanya name hachi hare alay ola sheakrivenna bammidbar vehikrivah beever hayyarden yatza veanush karet

Matni hakkohanim sheshshimmeshu bevet chono lo yeshammeshu bammikdash shebbirushalayim veen tzarich lomar ledavar acher shenneemar ach lo yaalu kohane habbamot el mizbach Adonai birushalim ki im achlu matztzot bekerev achehem hare ellu kevaale mumin cholkin veochlin velo makrivin
Gema amar rav yehuda kohen sheshshachat laavoda zara korbano reach nichoach

Amar rav yitzchak bar avdimi may keraa yaan asher yeshartu otam lifne gillulehem vehau levet yisrael lemichshol aon al ken nasati yadi alehem neum Adonai elohim venasu aonam uchtiv batreh velo yiggeshu elay lechahen li i avad sherut in shechita lav sherut hu
Itmar shagag bizrika rav nachman amar korbano reach nichoach rav sheshet amar en korbano reach nichoach
Amar rav sheshet mena amena lah dichtiv vehau levet yisrael lemichshol aon may lav o michshol o aon umichshol shogeg veaon mezid
Verav nachman michshol deaon
Amar rav nachman mena amena lah detanya vechipper hakkohen al hannefesh hashshogeget becheta vishgaga melammed shekkohen mitkapper al yede atzmo
Bemay ilema bishchita may irya shogeg afilu mezid name ella lav bizrika
Verav sheshet amar lach leolam bishchita uvmezid lo naasa komer laavoda zara
Veazdu letamayehu deittemar hezid bishchita rav nachman amar korbano reach nichoach verav sheshet amar en korbano reach nichoach
Rav nachman amar korbano reach nichoach dela avad sherut rav sheshet amar en korbano reach nichoach
b: Naasa komer laavoda zara
Amar rav nachman mena amena lah detanya kohen sheavad avoda zara veshav korbano reach nichoach
Bemay ilema beshogeg may veshav shav veomed hu ella peshita bemezid vei bizrika ki shav may have ha avad leh sherut ella lav bishchita
Verav sheshet amar lach leolam beshogeg vehachi kaamar im shav meikaro dechi avad beshogeg avad korbano reach nichoach veim lav en korbano reach nichoach

Hishtachava laavoda zara rav nachman amar korbano reach nichoach verav sheshet amar en korbano reach nichoach hoda laavoda zara rav nachman amar korbano reach nichoach verav sheshet amar en korbano reach nichoach
Utzricha dei ashmeinan hach kammayeta behahi kaamar rav sheshet mishshum daavad leh sherut aval shechita dela avad leh sherut ema mode leh lerav nachman
Vei ashmeinan shechita mishshum deaved leh avoda aval hishtachava dela avad leh avoda ema la tzericha
Vei ashmeinan hishtachavaa mishshum deaved leh maase aval hoda dedibura bealma ema la tzericha
Veen tzarich lomar davar acher vechu middekaamar en tzarich lomar davar acher mikkelal devet chono lav avoda zara hu
Tanya keman deamar bet chono lav avoda zara hu detanya otah shana shemmet shimon hatztzaddik amar lahen shana zo hu met amru lo minnayin atta yodea

Amar lahen kol yom hakkippurim nizdammen li zaken echad lavush levanim venitattef levanim venichnas immi veyatza immi shana zo nizdammen li zaken echad lavush shechorim venitattef shechorim venichnas immi velo yatza immi
Leachar haregel chala shivat yamim vamet venimneu echav hakkohanim millevarech bashshem

Bishat petirato amar lahem chono beni yeshammesh tachtay nitkanne bo shimi achiv shehaya gadol mimmennu shette shanim umechetza amar lo bo vaalammedcha seder avoda hilbisho beunkeli vachagaro betziltzol veheemido etzel hammizbeach amar lahem leechav hakkohanim reu ma nadar ze vekiyyem laahuvato oto hayyom sheeshtammesh bichhunna gedola elbosh beunkeli shellichi veechgor betziltzol shellichi

Bikkeshu echav hakkohanim lehorgo ratz mippenehem veratzu acharav halach laalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim uvana sham mizbeach veheela alav leshum avoda zara uchsheshshamu chachamim baddavar amru ma ze shello yarad lah kach hayyored lah al achat kamma vechamma divre rabbi meir

Amar lo rabbi yehuda lo kach haya maase ella lo kibel alav chono shehaya shimi achiv gadol mimmennu shette shanim umechetza veaf al pi chen nitkanne bo chono beshimi achiv amar lo bo vaalammedcha seder avoda vehilbisho beunkeli vachagaro betziltzol veheemido etzel hammizbeach amar lahem leechav hakkohanim reu ma nadar ze vekiyyem laahuvato oto hayyom sheyyishtammesh bichhunna gedola elbosh beunkeli shellichi veechgor betziltzol shellichi

Bikkeshu echav hakkohanim lehorgo sach lahem kol hamora bikkeshu laharog et chono ratz mippenehem veratzu acharav ratz levet hammelech veratzu acharav kol haroe oto omer ze hu ze hu halach laalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim uvana sham mizbeach veheela alav leshem shamayim shenneemar vehaya bayyom hahu yihye mizbeach la betoch eretz mitzrayim umatztzeva etzel gevulah la
Uchsheshshamu chachamim baddavar amru uma ze shebbarach mimmenna kach hamvakkesh lered lah al achat kamma vechamma
Tanya amar rabbi yehoshua ben perachya battechilla kol haomer ale lah ani kofto venotno lifne haari atta kol haomer li lered mimmenna ani metil alav kumkum shel chammin
Shehare shaul barach mimmenna uchsheala bikkesh laharog et david
Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda leabbaye rabbi meir hay kera derabbi yehuda may aved leh

Lechidtanya leachar mappalto shel sancheriv yatza chizkiyya umatza bene melachim shehau yoshvin bikronot shel zahav hiddiran shello laavod avoda zara shenneemar bayyom hahu yihu chamesh arim beeretz mitzrayim medabberot sefat kenaan

a: Venishbaot la tzevaot halchu laalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim uvanu mizbeach veheelu alav leshem shamayim shenneemar bayyom hahu yihye mizbeach la betoch eretz mitzrayim

Ir haheres yeamer leachat may ir haheres yeamer leechat kedimtargem rav yosef karta devet shemesh daatid lemicharav itamar dehi chada minnehon umimmay deir haheres lishana deshimsha hi dichtiv haomer lacheres velo yizrach

Havii vanay merachok uvnotay miktze haaretz havii vanay merachok amar rav huna ellu galiyyot shel bavel sheddatan meushshevet alehen kevanim uvnotay miktze haaretz ellu galiyyot shel shear aratzot sheen datan meushshevet alehen kevanot

Amar rabbi abba bar rav yitzchak amar rav chisda veamri lah amar rav yehuda amar rav mitztzor vead kartigne makkirin et yisrael veet avihem shebbashshamayim umitztzor kelappe maarav umikkartigne kelappe mizrach en makkirin et yisrael velo et avihen shebbashshamayim
Etiveh rav shimi bar chiyya lerav mimmizrach shemesh vead mevoo gadol shemi baggoyim uvchol makom muktar muggash lishmi umincha tehora amar leh shimi atte dekaru leh elaha delaha

Bechol makom muktar muggash lishmi bechol makom salka datach amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan ellu talmide chachamim haoskim battora bechol makom maale ani alehen keilu maktirin umaggishin lishmi
Umincha tehora ze hallomed tora betahora nose ishsha veachar kach lomed tora

Shir hammaalot hinne barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai haomdim bevet Adonai ballelot may ballelot amar rabbi yochanan ellu talmide chachamim haoskim betora ballayela maale alehen hakkatuv keilu asukim baavoda
Leolam zot al yisrael amar rav gidel amar rav ze mizbeach banuy umichael sar haggadol omed umakriv alav korban
Verabbi yochanan amar ellu talmide chachamim haasukin behilchot avoda maale alehem hakkatuv keilu nivna mikdash bimehem
Amar resh lakish may dichtiv zot hattora laola lammincha velachattat velaasham kol haosek battora keilu hikriv ola mincha chattat veasham
Amar rava hay laola lammincha ola umincha mibe leh ella amar rava kol haosek battora eno tzarich lo ola velo chattat velo mincha velo asham
Amar rabbi yitzchak may dichtiv zot torat hachattat vezot torat haasham kol haosek betorat chattat keilu hikriv chattat vechol haosek betorat asham keilu hikriv asham
Matni neemar beolat behema ishshe reach nichoach uvolat of ishshe reach nichoach uvmincha ishshe reach nichoach lomar lecha echad hammarbe veechad hammamit uvilvad sheyechaven libbo lashshamayim
Gema amar rabbi zera may keraa metuka shenat haoved im meat veim harbe yochel
Rav adda bar ahava amar mehacha birvot hattova rabbu ochleha uma kishron livalav
Tanya amar rabbi shimon ben azzay bo ure ma ketiv befarashat korbanot shello neemar bahen lo el velo elohim ella Adonai shello liten pitchon pe levaal din lachlok
Veneemar beshor haggas ishshe reach nichoach uvof haddak ishshe reach nichoach uvmincha ishshe reach nichoach lomar lecha echad hammarbe veechad hammamit uvilvad sheyechaven et libbo lashshamayim

Veshemma tomar laachila hu tzarich talmud lomar im erav lo omar lach ki li tevel umloah veneemar ki li chol chayeto yaar behemot beharre alef yadati kol of harim veziz saday immadi haochal besar abbirim vedam attudim eshte
Lo amarti alechem zivchu kede shettomar eese retzono veyaase retzoni lo lirtzoni attem zovchim ella lirtzonchem attem zovchim shenneemar lirtzonchem tizbachuhu
Davar acher lirtzonchem tizbachuhu lirtzonchem zivchu ledatechem zivchu
Kediva mineh shemuel merav huna minnayin lammitassek bakkodashim shehu pasul shenneemar veshachat et ben habbakar shettehe shechita leshem ben bakar
Amar lo zo beyadenu hu leakkev minnayin talmud lomar lirtzonchem tizbachuhu ledatechem zivchu
Hadaran alach hare alay issaron uslika lah massechet menachot
Matni hakkol shochatin ushchitatan keshera chutz mecheresh shote vekatan shemma yekalkelu et shechitatan vechullan sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan shechitatan keshera
Gema hakkol shochatin lechattechilla ushchitatan keshera diavad

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe vechol hakkol lechattechilla hu ella meatta hakkol memirin echad haanashim veechad hannashim hachi name dilchattechilla hu veha ketiv lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov bera o ra betov
Hatam kidkatane tama lo shehaadam rashshay lehamir ella sheim hemir mumar vesofeg et haarbaim
Ella hakkol maarichin veneerachin nodrin venidarin hachi name dilchattechilla veha ketiv vechi techdal lindor lo yihye vecha chet

Uchtiv tov asher lo tiddor mishshettiddor velo teshallem vetanya tov mizze umizze sheeno noder kol ikar divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer tov mizze umizze noder umshallem vaafilu rabbi yehuda la kaamar ella beomer hare zo
b: Aval amar hare alay lo
Vechol hakkol lav lechattechilla hu ella hakkol chayyavim besukka hakkol chayyavin betzitzit hachi name delav lechattechilla
Chayyavin la kaamena ella meatta hakkol somchin echad haanashim veechad hannashim hachi name delav lechattechilla veha ketiv vesamach yado venirtza
In ika hakkol lechattechilla veika hakkol diavad ella hakkol dehacha mimmay dilchattechilla hu detikshe lach dilma diavad hu vela tikshe lach
Amar leh ana shechitatan keshera kashya li middekatane shechitatan keshera diavad mikkelal dehakkol lechattechilla hu dei diavad tarte diavad lema li

Amar rabba bar ulla hachi katane hakkol shochatin vaafilu tame bechullin tame bechullin may lememra bechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh vekasavar chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh kekodesh damu
Ketzad hu ose mevi sakkin arukka veshochet bah kede shello yigga babbasar
Uvmukdashim lo yishchot shemma yigga babbasar veim shachat veomer bari li shello nagati shechitato keshera
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan daafilu bechullin gerede diavad name la shemma yishhu shemma yidresu veshemma yachalidu
Vechullan sheshshachatu aheya ilema acheresh shote vekatan alah kae veim shachatu mibe leh ella attame bechullin ha amratte lechattechilla name shachet
Veella attame bemukdashim bevari li saggi deleteh kamman dinshayeleh

Hay tame bemukdashim mehacha nafka mehatam nafka kol happesulin sheshshachatu shechitatan keshera shehashshechita keshera bezarim benashim uvaavadim uvitmeim vaafilu bekodshe kadashim uvilvad shello yihu temein nogin babbasar
Hacha ikar hatam ayede ditna shear pesulin tena name tame bemukdashim veibaet ema hatam ikar divkadashim kae hacha ayede ditna tame bechullin tane name tame bemukdashim
Hay tame deitamma bemay ilema deitammi bemet bachalal cherev amar rachamana

a: Cherev hare hu kechalal av hattuma hu letammeyeh lesakkin vaazal sakkin vetammiteh levasar
Ella deitammi besheretz vei baet ema leolam deitammi bemet uchgon shebbadak kerumit shel kane veshachat bah detanya bakkol shochatim ben betzor ben bizchuchit ben bikrumit shel kane
Abbaye amar hachi katane hakkol shochatin vaafilu kuti bamme devarim amurim kesheyyisrael omed al gabbav aval yotze venichnas lo yishchot
Veim shachat chotech kezayit basar venoten lo achalo muttar leechol mishshechitato lo achalo asur leechol mishshechitato
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan daafilu diavad name la shemma yishhu shemma yidresu veshemma yachalidu
Vechullan sheshshachatu aheya ilema acheresh shote vekatan alah kae veim shachatu mibbee leh
Ella akkuti ha amratte kesheyyisrael omed al gabbav shachet afilu lechattechilla kashya
Amar rava veotze venichnas lechattechilla la vehatnan hammanniach nachri bachanuto veyisrael yotze venichnas muttar hatam mi katane manniach hammanniach katane diavad
Ella mehacha en hashshomer tzarich lihot yoshev umshammer ella af al pi sheyyotze venichnas muttar

Ella amar rava hachi katane hakkol shochatin vaafilu kuti bamme devarim amurim kesheyyisrael yotze venichnas aval ba umtzao sheshshachat chotech kazzayit basar venoten lo achalo muttar leechol mishshechitato lo achalo asur leechol mishshechitato
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan daafilu diavad name la shemma yishhu veshemma yidresu veshemma yachalidu vechullan sheshshachatu aheya ilema acheresh shote vekatan alah kae veim shachatu mibbee leh
Ella akkuti ha amratte afilu yotze venichnas shachet lechattechilla kashya
Rav ashe amar hachi katane hakkol shochatin vaafilu yisrael meshummad meshummad lemay leechol nevelot leteavon vechidrava deamar rava yisrael meshummad ochel nevelot leteavon
b: Bodek sakkin venoten lo umuttar leechol mishshechitato aval lo badak venatan lo lo yishchot veim shachat bodek sakkino acharav nimtzet sakkino yafa muttar leechol mishshechitato veim lav asur leechol mishshechitato
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan daafilu diavad name la shemma yishhu shemma yidresu veshemma yachalidu vechullan sheshshachatu aheya ilema acheresh shote vekatan alah kae veim shachatu mibe leh

Ella ayyisrael meshummad i devadak sakkin venoten lo ha amratte shochet lechattechilla ella delo badak i deiteh lesakkin livdekeh hashta vei deleteh lesakkin ki acherim roin oto may have dilma besakkin peguma shachet kashya
Ravina amar hachi katane hakkol shochatin hakkol mumchin shochatin mumchin veaf al pi sheen muchzakin

Bamme devarim amurim sheyyodin bo sheyyodea lomar hilchot shechita aval en yodin bo sheyyodea lomar hilchot shechita lo yishchot veim shachat bodkin oto im yodea lomar hilchot shechita muttar leechol mishshechitato veim lav asur leechol mishshechitato
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan daafilu diavad name la shemma yishhu shemma yidresu veshemma yachalidu vechullan sheshshachatu aheya ilema acheresh shote vekatan alah kae veim shachatu mibbee leh
Ella ashsheen mumchin bevodkin oto saggi deleteh lekamman delivdekeh

Veika deamri ravina amar hachi katane hakkol shochatin hakkol muchzakin shochatin muchzakin af al pi sheen mumchin bamme devarim amurim sheshshachatu lefanenu shettayim veshalosh peamim velo nitallef aval lo shachat lefanenu shettayim veshalosh peamim lo yishchot shemma yitallef veim shachat veamar bari li shello nitallafti shechitato keshera
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan daafilu diavad name la shemma yishhu shemma yidresu veshemma yachalidu vechullan sheshshachatu aheya ilema acheresh shote vekatan alah kae veim shachatu mibe leh
Ella ashsheen muchzakin vehaamratte bevari li saggi deleteh kamman delishayeleh
Ravina verabba bar ulla keabbayye verava verav ashe la amri mishshum dekashya lehu vechullan
Kullehu kerabba bar ulla la amri lehach lishana deamratte hacha ikar adderabba hatam ikar divkadashim kae
Lehach lishana deamratte hatam ikar vehacha ayede ditna tame bechullin tena name tame bemukdashin tame bechullin gufeh la itztericha leh chullin shennaasu al tohorat kodesh lav kekodesh damu
Kullehu keravina la amri lehach lishana deamar mumchin in sheen mumchin la rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumchin hen
Lehach lishana deamar muchzakin in sheen muchzakin la leillofe la chayeshinan
Rava la amar keabbayye ki kushyeh abbaye la amar kerava hatam la naga hacha naga
Rav ashe la amar ketarvayehu kasavar kutim gere araot hen
Abbaye la amar kerav ashe la sevira leh ha derava ella rava may tama la amar kishmateh
Lidvarav deabbaye kaamar veleh la sevira leh

Tanu rabbanan shechitat kuti mutteret bamme devarim amurim kesheyyisrael omed al gabbav aval ba umtzao sheshshachat chotech kazzayit venoten lo achalo muttar leechol mishshechitato veim lav asur leechol mishshechitato
Kayyotze bo matza beyado

a: Dekurya shel tzipporim kotea rosho shel echad mehen venoten lo achalo muttar leechol mishshechitato veim lav asur leechol mishshechitato
Abbaye dayek meresha rava dayek missefa abbaye dayek meresha tama deyisrael omed al gabbav aval yotze venichnas la
Rava dayek missefa tama deva umtzao sheshshachat aval yotze venichnas shappir dame
Ulabbaye kashya sefa amar lach yotze venichnas name ba umtzao kare leh ulrava kashya resha amar lach yotze venichnas name keomed al gabbav dame
Kayyotze bo matza beyado dekurya shel tzipporin kotea rosho ku ammay lechush dilma hay hu dahava shachet shappir
Amar rav menashshe siman machnis izmel bizcharim bemachnisan tachat kenafav
Vedilma simana hava yahev leh begaveh amar rav mesharsheya dimmasmes leh masmose
Vedilma kasavri kutim en shechita laof min hattora
Ultamach shehiyya derasa chalada hagrama veikur mi ketivan
Ella kevan deachziku behu achziku behu hacha name kevan deachziku achziku
Veachzuk vela achzuk bidla ketiva tannae hi detanya matztzat kuti mutteret veadam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach
Rabbi elazar oser lefi sheen bekiin bedikduke mitzot keyisrael
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim harbe medakdekin bah yoter miyyisrael

Amar mar matztzat kuti mutteret veadam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach peshita mahu detema la bekii beshimur ka mashma lan rabbi elazar oser lefi sheen bekiin bedikduke mitzot kasavar la bekii beshimur

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim harbe medakdekin bah yoter miyyisrael hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu dichtiva vela achziku bah tanna kamma savar kevan dichtiva af al gav dela achziku bah verabban shimon ben gamliel savar i achzuk in i la achzuk la
I hachi kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim im hechziku mibe leh
Ella ika benayehu dela ketiva veachziku bah tanna kamma savar kevan dela ketiva af al gav deachziku bah name la rabban shimon ben gamliel savar kevan deachzuk achzuk
Gufa amar rava yisrael meshummad ochel nevelot leteavon bodek sakkin venoten lo umuttar leechol mishshechitato
May tama kevan deika hettera veisura la shavek hettera veachel isura
I hachi ki la bedak name mitrach la tarach
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava tanya dimsayya lach chametzan shel ovre avera achar happesach
b: Muttar miyyad mippene shehen machlifin
Savruha ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar chametz achar happesach deorayeta vekatane mippene shehen machlifin alma la shavek hettera veachel isura
Mimmay dilma rabbi shimon hi deamar chametz achar happesach derabbanan vechi mekilinan bidrabbanan bidorayeta la mekilinan
Vetihve name rabbi shimon mi katane sheani omer hechlifu mippene shemmachlifin katane devadday machlifin uma bidrabbanan la shavek hettera veachel isura bidorayeta lo kol shekken

Lema mesayya leh hakkol shochatin vaafilu kuti vaafilu arel vaafilu yisrael meshummad hay arel hechi dame ilema metu echav mechamat mila hay yisrael mealleya hu ella peshita meshummad laarelut veka savar meshummad ledavar echad la have meshummad lechol hattora kullah
Ema sefa vaafilu yisrael meshummad hay meshummad hechi dame i meshummad ledavar acher hayenu meshummad laarelut ella lav meshummad leoto davar vechidrava

La leolam ema lach meshummad leoto davar la may tama kevan dedash beh kehettera dame leh ella meshummad laavoda zara vechidrav anan deamar rav anan amar shemuel yisrael meshummad laavoda zara muttar leechol mishshechitato

Gufa amar rav anan amar shemuel yisrael meshummad laavoda zara muttar leechol mishshechitato shekken matzinu bihoshafat melech yehuda shennehena misseudat achav shenneemar vayyizbach lo achav tzon uvakar larov velaam asher immo vayesitehu laalot el ramot gilad
Vedilma mizbach zevach mechal la achal vayesitehu ketiv vedilma bidvarim en hasata bidvarim
Vela vehachtiv ki yesitcha achicha baachila uvishtiyya vehachtiv vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam lemala shane

Vedilma mishta ishti mechal la achal may shena shetiyya deamrinan meshummad laavoda zara la have meshummad lechol hattora kullah achila name meshummad laavoda zara la have meshummad lechol hattora kullah
Hachi hashta shetiyya setam yenan hu vaadayin lo neesar yenan shel goyim aval achila ema lach meshummad laavoda zara have meshummad lechol hattora kullah
Ibaet ema lav orcheh demalka mishteya bela mechla veibaet ema vayyizbach vayesitehu ketiv bamma hesito bizvicha
Vedilma ovadya zevach larov ketiv ovadya la hava safek
Vedilma shivat alafim zevuch dichtiv vehisharti veyisrael shivat alafim kol habbirkayim asher lo charu labbaal vego tammore hao mitammeri meizevel
Vedilma gavre deachav hao meallu la salka datach dichtiv moshel makshiv al devar shaker kol meshartav reshaim
Vedilma gavre dihoshafat name la hao meallu zevuch gavre deachav achul gavre dihoshafat zevuch ovadya achal yehoshafat
La salka datach middemoshel makshiv al devar shaker kol meshartav reshaim ha lidvar emet meshartav tzaddikim
Vedilma zevuch gavre deachav achal achav vegavreh zevuch gavre dihoshafat achal yehoshafat vegavreh

a: La hava mefalleg nafsheh mineh menalan ilema middichtiv kamoni chamocha keammi cheammecha ella meatta kesusay kesusecha hachi name ella ma dehave assusecha teheve assusay hachi name may dehave alach veilave ammach teheve alay veilave ammi

Ella mehacha umelech yisrael vihoshafat melech yehuda yoshvim ish al kiso melubbashim begadim begoren petach shaar shomron may goren ilema goren mammash attu shaar shomron goren hava ella ki goren ditnan sanhedrin hayeta kachatzi goren agulla kede sheyehu roin ze et ze
