Ema sefa vaafilu yisrael meshummad hechi dame i meshummad ledavar echad hayenu meshummad laarelut ella lav meshummad laavoda zara vechidrav anan
La leolam emar lach meshummad laavoda zara la deamar mar chamura avoda zara shekkol hakkofer bah kemode bechol hattora kullah
Ella meshummad leoto davar vechidrava

Metivi mikkem velo kullechem lehotzi et hamshummad mikkem bachem chillakti velo beummot min habbehema lehavi bene adam sheddomim livhema mikkan amru mekabbelin korbenot mipposhe yisrael kede sheyyachzeru bahen bitshuva chutz min hamshummad umnassech et hayyayin umchallel shabbatot befarhesya
Ha gufa kashya amratte mikkem velo kullechem lehotzi et hamshummad vahadar tane mekabbelin korbanot mipposhe yisrael
Ha la kashya resha meshummad lechol hattora kullah metziata meshummad ledavar echad
Ema sefa chutz min hamshummad umnassech et hayyayin umchallel shabbat befarhesya hay meshummad hechi dame i meshummad lechol hattora kullah hayenu resha vei meshummad ledavar echad kashya metziata
Ella lav hachi kaamar chutz min hamshummad lenassech et hayyayin ulchallel shabbatot befarhesya alma meshummad laavoda zara have meshummad lechol hattora kullah utuvta derav anan teuvta
Veha mehacha nafka mehatam nafka
b: Meam haaretz perat limshummad
Rabbi shimon ben yose omer mishshum rabbi shimon asher lo teasena bishgaga veashem hashshav midiato mevi korban al shiggato eno shav midiato eno mevi korban al shiggato
Veamrinan may benayehu veamar rav hamnuna meshummad leechol chelev vehevi korban al haddam ika benayehu

Chada bechattat vachada beola utzrichi dei ashmeinan chattat mishshum dilchappara hu aval ola dedoron hu ema lekabbel mineh vei ashmeinan ola mishshum delav chiyyuva hu aval chattat dechiyyuva hu ema lekabbel mineh tzericha

Vechol hecha dichtiv behema geriuta hi vehachtiv adam uvhema toshia Adonai veamar rav yehuda amar rav ellu bene adam shehen arumin bedaat umsimin atzman kivhema hatam ketiv adam uvhema hacha behema lechuddeh ketiv
Vechol hecha dichtiv adam uvhema mealleuta hi veha ketiv vezarati et bet yisrael zera adam vezera behema hatam ha challekeh kera zera adam lechod vezera behema lechod
Siman niklaf

Amar rabbi chanan amar rabbi yaakov bar ide amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara rabban gamliel uvet dino nimnu al shechitat kuti vaasaruha amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi yaakov bar idi shemma lo shama rabbi ella besheen yisrael omed al gabbav amar leh dame hay merabbanan kidla gemiri inashe shemata besheen yisrael omed al gabbav lememra bae

Kabbelah mineh o la kabbelah mineh ta shema deamar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar rabbi assi ani raiti et rabbi yochanan sheachal mishshechitat kuti af rabbi assi achal mishshechitat kuti vetahe bah rabbi zera la shemia lehu dei hava shemia lehu hao mekabbeli leh o dilma shemia lehu vela kabbeluha

Hadar pashet lenafsheh mistabbera dishmia lehu vela kabbeluha dei salka datach la shemia lehu vei hava shemia lehu hao mekabbeli leh hechi mistayea milta lemechal isura hashta behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadan tzaddikim atzman lo kol shekken

a: Vei salka datach la kabbelah mineh lishanne leh kan kesheyyisrael omed al gabbav kan kesheen yisrael omed al gabbav ella lav shema minah kabbelah mineh shema minah

Umay tama gezaru behu rabbanan ki ha derabbi shimon ben elazar shaddereh rabbi meir leetoye chamra mibbe chutae ashkecheh hahu sava amar leh vesamta sakkin beloecha im baal nefesh atta halach rabbi shimon ben elazar vesipper devarim lifne rabbi meir vegazar alehen

May tama amar rav nachman bar yitzchak demut yona matzu lahen berosh har gerizim shehau ovdin otah verabbi meir letameh dechayesh lemiuta vegazar rubba attu miuta verabban gamliel uvet dino name kerabbi meir sevira lehu
Peshateh dikra bemay ketiv betalmid hayyoshev lifne rabbo detane rabbi chiyya ki teshev lilchom et moshel bin tavin et asher lefanecha vesamta sakkin beloecha im baal nefesh atta
Im yodea talmid berabbo sheyyodea lehachazir lo taam bin veim lav tavin et asher lefanecha vesamta sakkin beloecha im baal nefesh atta perosh hemennu

Rabbi yitzchak ben yosef shaddereh rabbi avahu leetoye chamra mibbe chutae ashkecheh hahu sava amar leh let kan shomre tora halach rabbi yitzchak vesipper devarim lifne rabbi avahu vehalach rabbi avahu vesipper devarim lifne rabbi amme verabbi assi velo zazu mishsham ad sheasaum goyim gemurin
Lemay i lishchita veyen nesech mehatam gezaru behu rabbanan inhu gezur vela kabbilu minayehu ato rabbi amme verabbi assi gezaru vekabbilu minayehu
May goyim gemurin amar rav nachman bar yitzchak levattel reshut veliten reshut
Vechidtanya yisrael meshummad meshammer shabbatto bashshuk mevattel reshut venoten reshut vesheeno meshammer shabbatto bashshuk eno mevattel reshut venoten reshut
Mippene sheamru yisrael noten reshut umvattel reshut uvgoy ad sheyyiskor
Ketzad amar lo reshuti kenuya lach reshuti mevuttelet lach kana veeno tzarich lizkot

Rabbi zera verav assi iklau lefundeka deyae ayeto lekammayehu betzim hamtzummakot beyayin rabbi zera la achal verav assi achal amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi vela chayesh mar letaarovet demay amar leh lav addatay
Amar rabbi zera efshar gazru al hattaarovet demay umistayea milta derav assi lemechal isura hashta behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadan tzaddikim atzman lo kol shekken

Nefak rabbi zera dak veashkach ditnan hallokeach yayin latet letoch hammuryas o letoch haaluntit karshinin laasot mehen techinin adashim laasot mehen resisin chayyav mishshum demay veen tzarich lomar mishshum vadday
Vehen atzman muttarin mippene shehen taarovet
Velo gazru al taarovet demay vehatanya hannoten lishchento isa leefot ukdera levashshel eno choshesh lisor vetavlin shebbah lo mishshum sheviit velo mishshum maaser
Veim amar lah asi li mishshellichi choshesh lisor vetavlin shebbah mishshum sheviit umishshum maaser
Shane hatam dechevan dekaamar lah asi li mishshellichi keman dearev beyadayim deme rafram amar shane seor vetavlin diltama avid vetama la batel

Ulchallofe la chayeshinan vehatnan hannoten lachamoto measser et shehu noten lah veet shehu notel mimmenna mippene shechashudah machlefet hammitkalkel hatam kidtanya tama amar rabbi yehuda rotze hi betakkanat bittah uvosha mechatanah
b: Ulalma la chayeshinan vehatnan hannoten lappundakit shello measser et shehu noten lah veet shehu notel hemenna mippene shechashudah machlefet hatam name morya veamra bar be rav lechol chammima vaana echol karira
Ulchallofe la chayeshinan vehatanya eshet chaver tochenet im eshet am haaretz bizman shehi temea aval lo bizman shehi tehora
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af bizman shehi temea lo titchon mippene shechavertah notenet lah veochelet
Hashta migzal gazla challofe mibaya amar rav yosef hatam name morya veamra tora middeyasheh kaachel
Heid rabbi yehoshua ben zeruz ben chamiv shel rabbi meir lifne rabbi al rabbi meir sheachal ale shel yarak bevet shean vehittir rabbi et bet shean kullah al yado
Chavru alav echav uvet aviv amru lo makom sheavotecha vaavot avotecha nahagu bo isur atta tinhog bo heter

Derash lahen mikra ze vechittat nechash hannechoshet asher asa moshe ki ad hayyamim hahemma hau vene yisrael mekatterim lo vayyikra lo nechushtan efshar ba asa velo biaro ba yehoshafat velo biaro vahalo kol avoda zara shebbaolam asa vihoshafat biarum

a: Ella makom hinnichu lo avotav lehitgadder bo af ani makom hinnichu li avotay lehitgadder bo
Mikkan letalmid chacham sheamar devar halacha sheen mezichin oto veamri lah en maznichin oto veamri lah en mazchichin oto
Man deamar mezichin kedichtiv velo yizzach hachoshen uman deamar en maznichin dichtiv ki lo yiznach leolam Adonai uman deamar mazchichin ditnan mishsherabbu zechuche hallev rabbu machlokot beyisrael
Matkef lah yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi umi ika leman deamar devet shean lav meeretz yisrael hi vehachtiv velo horish menashshe et bet shean veet benoteha veet tanach veet benoteha
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rabbi shimon ben elyakim mishshum rabbi elazar ben pedat sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben shammua harbe kerakkim kevashum ole mitzrayim velo kevashum ole bavel
Vekasavar kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo vehinnichum kede sheyyismechu alehen aniyyim bashsheviit
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera veha rabbi meir ale bealma hu deachel amar leh meagudda achleh utnan yarak hanneegad mishsheyyeaged
Vedilma lav addateh hashta behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadan tzaddikim atzman lo kol shekken
Vedilma iser alehem mimmakom acher lo nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf vedilma natan enav betzad ze veachal betzad acher amar leh chazi man gavra rabba kamashed aleh
May behemtan shel tzaddikim derabbi pinchas ben yair hava kaazel lefidon shevuyin pega beh beginay nahara

Amar leh ginay chalok li memecha veeevor bach amar leh atta holech laasot retzon konecha vaani holech laasot retzon koni atta safek ose safek i atta ose ani vadday ose amar leh im i atta cholek gozrani alecha shello yaavru becha mayim leolam chalak leh

Hava hahu gavra dahava dare chite lefischa amar leh chalok leh name lehay divmitzva asek chalak leh hava hahu tayyaa dilva bahadayehu amar leh chalok leh name lehay dela lema kach osim livne leviyya chalak leh
Amar rav yosef kamma nefish gavra mimmoshe veshittin ribbevan deilu hatam chad zimna vehacha telata zimnin vedilma hacha name chada zimna ella kemoshe veshittin ribbevan
Ikkela lehahu ushpiza remo leh seare lechamreh la achal
b: Chavtinhu la achal nakkerinhu la achal amar lehu dilma la measseran asserinhu vaachal amar aniyya zo holechet laasot retzon konah veattem maachilin otah tevalim
Umi michayeva vehatnan hallokeach lezera velivhema vekemach leorot veshemen lanner veshemen lasuch bo et hakkelim patur mehaddemay

Hatam ha ittemar alah amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shellekachan mittechilla livhema aval lekachan mittechilla leadam venimlach alehem livhema chayyav leasser vehatanya hallokeach perot min hashshuk laachila venimlach alehen livhema hare ze lo yitten lo lifne behemto velo lifne behemat chavero ella im ken iser
Shema rabbi nefak leappeh amar leh retzoncha seod etzli amar lo hen tzahavu panav shel rabbi

Amar lo kimdumme atta shemmuddar hanaa miyyisrael ani yisrael kedoshim hen yesh rotze veen lo veyesh sheyyesh lo veeno rotze uchtiv al tilcham et lechem ra ayin veal titav lematammotav ki kemo shaar benafsho ken hu echol ushte yomar lach velibbo bal immach veatta rotze veyesh lecha
Miha hashta mesarhevna divmilleta demitzva ka tarachna ki hadarna atena ayelna legabbach
Ki ata itremi al behahu pitcha dahao kayemin beh kudanyata chivarata amar malach hammavet beveto shel ze vaani esod etzlo
Shema rabbi nefak leappeh amar leh mezabbenna lehu amar leh velifne iver lo titten michshol
Mafkarna lehu mappeshatte hezeka akarna lehu ika tzaar baale chayyim katelna lehu ika bal tashchit

Hava ka mevattesh beh tuva gevah tura benayehu bacha rabbi veamar ma bechayyehen kach bemitatan al achat kamma vechamma deamar rabbi chama bar chanina gedolim tzaddikim bemitatan yoter mibbechayyehen shenneemar vayehi hem kovrim ish vehinne rau haggedud vayyashlichu et haish bekever elisha vayyelech vayyigga haish beatzmot elisha vayechi vayyakom al raglav
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye vedilma lekayyome beh birketa deeliyyahu dichtiv vihi na pi shenayim beruchacha elay amar leh i hachi hayenu detanya al raglav amad ulveto lo halach
Ella bema ikayyam kidamar rabbi yochanan sheripe tzaraat naaman shehi shekula kemet shenneemar al na tehi kammet

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi lamma nikra sheman yemim sheematam muttelet al habberiyyot deamar rabbi chanina miyyamay lo shealani adam al makkat pirda levana vechaya veha kachazena dechaye ema vechayat veha kachazena demitasse dechivaran resh karayehu ka amrinan

En od millevaddo amar rabbi chanina vaafilu keshafim hahi itta dahavat ka mehaddera lemishkal afra mittute kareh derabbi chanina amar lah shekuli la mistayea miltich en od milvaddo ketiv vehaamar rabbi yochanan lamma nikra sheman keshafim shemmachchishin pamalya shel mala shane rabbi chanina dinfisha zechuteh

Veamar rabbi chanina en adam nokef etzbao millematta ella im ken machrizin alav millemala shenneemar me mitzade gever konanu veadam ma yavin darko amar rabbi elazar dam nikuf meratztze kedam ola amar rava begudal yamin uvnikuf sheni vehu dekaazel lidvar mitzva
Amru alav al rabbi pinchas ben yair miyyamav lo batza al perusa sheenah shello umiyyom sheamad al dato lo nehena misseudat aviv

a: Amar rabbi zera amar shemuel liben sakkin veshachat bah shechitato keshera chidudah kodem lelibunah vehaika tzedadin bet hashshechita mirvach ravach
Ibaya lehu liben shappud vehikka bo mishshum shechin niddon o mishshum michva niddon
Lemay nafka minah lechidtanya shechin umichva metammein beshavua echad bishne simanin besear lavan uvfison velamma chillekan hakkatuv lomar sheen mitztarfin ze im ze

Vetanya ezehu shechin veezehu michva laka beetz beeven begefet bechamme teverya uvchol davar shello ba mechamat haur leetoye avar meikaro zehu shechin veezehu michva nichva begachelet beremetz besid roteach begifsis roteach uvchol davar habba mechamat haur leetoye chamme haur zo hi michva
Vetanya shechin umichva im shechin kodem lammichva bittel michva et hashshechin veim michva kodemet lashshechin bittel shechin et hammichva
Vehacha hechi dame kegon dahava beh chatzi geris shechin meikara veliben shappud vehikka bo unfak beh chatzi geris acher
May chavta kadem veate havla umvattel leh lechavta vehave leh shechin umichva vela mitztarfin o dilma havla kadem veate chavta umvattel leh lehavla vehave leh shechin ushchin umitztaref
Ta shema deamar rabbi zera amar shemuel liben sakkin veshachat bah shechitato keshera chidudah kodem lelibunah alma chavta kadem chiddud shane
Ta shema liben shappud vehikka bo niddon mishshum michvat esh alma chavta kadem hatam name devarzeyh mivraz dehayenu chiddud
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh sakkin shel avoda zara muttar lishchot bah veasur lachtoch bah basar muttar lishchot bah mekalkel hu veasur lachtoch bah basar metakken hu
Amar rava peamim shehashshochet asur bimsukkenet umchattech muttar beatme dekayeman lekurbana
Vetipok leh mishshum shamnunit deisura
b: Bachadasha

Chadasha ben lerabbi yishmael ben lerabbi akiva meshammeshe avoda zara hen umshammeshe avoda zara enan asurin ad sheyyeavedu ibaet ema difsak beh gevaza laavoda zara veibaet ema bishana shellibnah baur
Ittemar hashshochet besakkin shel goyim rav amar kolef verabba bar bar chana amar mediach lema beha kamipalgi demar savar bet hashshechita tzonen umar savar bet hashshechita roteach
La dechulle alma bet hashshechita roteach hu man deamar kolef shappir uman deamar mediach ayede ditridi simanin leappoke dam la bali
Ika deamri dechulle alma bet hashshechita tzonen man deamar mediach shappir man deamar kolef aggav duchka desakkina bala
Sakkin terefa peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar bechammin vechad amar betzonen vehilcheta afilu betzonen vei ika belita difrasa lemichpereh la tzerich
Ulman deamar bechammin may tama mishshum deka vala isura dehetera name bala ever min hachay emat bala lechi chayema emat ka chayema lechi gamra shechita hahi shata hetera hava
Amar rav yehuda amar rav hattabbach tzarich shelosha sakkinin achat sheshshochet bah veechad shemmechattech bah basar veechad shemmechattech bah chalavim
Velitakken leh chada velichtoch bah basar vahadar lichtoch bah chalavim gezera shemma yachtoch chalavim veachar kach basar hashta name michallaf leh kevan deatzrechinhu tere it leh hekera

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav hattabbach tzarich shene kelim shel mayim echad shemmediach bo basar veechad shemmediach bo chalavim venitakken leh chada undiach bo basar vahadar nediach bo chalavim gezera shemma yadiach chalavim veachar kach basar hashta name michallefi leh kevan deatzrechineh tarte it leh hekera
Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav pappa la lischof inish kafle ilave bisra dedaev tarba uvala bisra
I hachi ki teritzi name daev tarba uvala bisra kerama mafsek mittattay i hachi

a: Meilay name kerama ika ayede dimmashmesha yeda detabbacha mippattat

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav talmid chacham tzarich sheyyilmod shelosha devarim ketav shechita umila verav chananya bar shelemya mishshemeh derav amar af kesher shel tefilin uvirkat chatanim vetzitzit veidach hane shechichan
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol tabbach sheeno yodea hilchot shechita asur leechol mishshechitato veellu hen hilchot shechita shehiyya derasa chalada hagrama veikur

May ka mashma lan kullehu teninhu la tzericha sheshshachat lefanenu shettayim veshalosh peamim ushchat shappir mahu detema middeidach shechat shappir hay name shechat shappir ka mashma lan kevan dela gemir zimnin deshahe vedares vela yada
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel hattabbach tzarich sheyyivdok bassimanim leachar shechita amar rav yosef af anan name tenena rabbi shimon omer im shaha kede bikur may lav kede bikur simanin
Amar leh abbaye la hachi amar rabbi yochanan kede bikur chacham im ken natatta devarecha leshiurim ella kede bikur tabbach chacham
Lo badak may rabbi eliezer ben antignos mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi yannay amar terefa vaasura baachila bematnita tana nevela umtammea bemassa
Bemay kamipalgi bidrav huna deamar behema bechayyeha bechezkat isur omedet ad sheyyivada lach bamme nishchata nishchata hare hi bechezkat heter ad sheyyivada lach bamme nitrefa
Mar savar bechezkat isur kayema vehashta meta hi umar savar bechezkat isur amrinan bechezkat tuma la amrinan

Gufa amar rav huna behema bechayyeha bechezkat isur omedet ad sheyyivada lach bamme nishchata nishchata bechezkat heter omedet ad sheyyivada lach bamme nitrefa velema nishchata huttera ha ka mashma lan deaf al gav deityelid bah reuta
Kediva mineh rabbi abba merav huna ba zeev venatal bene meayim mahu
Natal ha letanhu ella nakav bene meayim mahu nakav ha ka chazenan dehu nakvinhu ella netalan vehechziran keshehen nekuvin mahu mi chayeshinan shemma bimkom nekev nakav o la
Amar leh en choshshin shemma bimkom nekev nakav
Etiveh raa tzippor hamnakker bitena veachbar hamnakker baavattichim
b: Choshshin shemma bimkom nekev nakav
Amar leh mi ka medammet isura lesakkanta sakkana shane amar leh rava may shena sefek sakkanta lechumra sefek isura name lechumra
Amar leh abbaye vela shane ben isura lesakkanta veha ilu sefek tuma birshut harabbim sefeko tahor veilu sefek mayim megullin asurin
Amar leh hatam hilcheta gemiri lah missota ma sota birshut hayyachid af tuma birshut hayyachid
Metiv rav shimi sheretz befi chulda vechulda mehallechet al gabbe kikkarot shel teruma safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tahor veilu sefek mayim megullin asurin
Hatam name hilcheta gemiri lah missota ma sota davar sheyyesh bah daat lishael af hacha name davar sheyyesh bo daat lishael
Amar rav ashe ta shema tzelochit shehinnichah megulla uva umtzaah mechussa temea sheani omer adam tame nichnas lesham vechisah
Hinnichah mechussa uva umtzaah megulla im yechola chulda lishtot mimmenna o nachash ledivre rabban gamliel o sheyyarad bah tal ballayela pesula
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi ma taam

a: Mippene sheddarkan shel sheratzim legallot veen darkan lechassot
I name tama dehinnichah megulla uva umtzaah mechussa mechussa uva umtzaah megulla ha metzaah kema shehinnichah la tuma ika vela pesula ika
Veilu sefek mayim megullim asurin shema minah chamira sakkanta meisura shema minah

Tenan hatam shelosha mashkin asurin mishshum gilluy mayim veyayin vechalav kamma yishhu veyihu asurin kede sheyyetze harachash mimmakom karov veyishte vechamma makom karov amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda kede sheyyetze mittachat ozen keli veyishte
Yishte ha ka chaze leh ella yishte veyachazor lechoro
Itmar hashshochet besakkin venimtzet peguma amar rav huna afilu shiber bah atzamot kol hayyom pesula chayeshinan shemma baor nifgema verav chisda amar keshera shemma beetzem nifgema
Bishlama rav huna kishmateh ella rav chisda may tama amar lach etzem vadday pogem or safek pogem safek la pogem have safek uvadday veen safek motzi mide vadday

Metiv rava lesayyoeh lerav huna taval veala venimtza alav davar chotzetz af al pi shennitassek beoto hammin kol hayyom kullo lo alta lo tevila ad sheyyomar bari li shello haya alay kodem lachen veha hacha devadday taval safek hava aleh safek la hava aleh vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday
Shane hatam deika lememar haamed tame al chezkato veemar lo taval
Hacha name haamed behema al chezkatah veemar lo nishchata hare shechuta lefanecha
Hacha name hare taval lefanecha ha ityelida beh reuta
Hacha name ityelida bah reuta sakkin itreay behema la itreay
Metivi shachat et haveshet veachar kach nishmeta haggargeret keshera nishmeta haggargeret veachar kach shachat et haveshet pesula
Shachat et haveshet venimtzet haggargeret shemuta veeno yodea im kodem shechita nishmeta im leachar shechita nishmeta ze haya maase veamru kol sefek bishchita pasul
Kol safek bishchita leetoye may lav leetoye kehay gavena la leetoye safek shaha safek daras
b: Umay shena hatam ityelida bah reuta bivhema hacha sakkin itreay behema la itreay

Vehilcheta kevateh derav huna keshello shiber bah etzem vehilcheta kevateh derav chisda kesheshshiber bah etzem mikkelal derav chisda af al gav dela shiber bah etzem ella bemay ipgim ema beetzem demafreket ipgim
Hava ovada vetaraf rav yosef ad telesar chevata keman kerav huna vaafilu bekammayeta la kerav chisda ulvar mikkammayeta
Veibaet ema leolam kerav huna dei kerav chisda mikkede mitla talenan mimmay divetzem demafreket dekammayeta ipgim dilma beetzem demafreket devatrayeta ipgim
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe rav kahana matzrech bedikuta ben kol chada vachada keman kerav huna ulmifsal kammayeta la kerav chisda ulachshore batrayeta
I hachi tive name bedikat chacham ed echad neeman beisurin i hachi meikara name la haamar rabbi yochanan lo amru leharot sakkin lechacham ella mippene kevodo shel chacham
Mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan oke milta achezkeh

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan amar kera veyatza hakkohen min habbayit el petach habbayit vehisgir et habbayit shivat yamim dilma addenafek veate betzar leh shiura ella lav mishshum deamrinan oke achezkeh
Matkef lah rav acha bar yaakov vedilma kegon sheyyatza derech achorav deka chaze leh ki nafek

Amar leh abbaye shette teshuvot baddavar chada ditzia derech achorav lo shemah yetzia veod achore haddelet may ika lememar vechi tema defatach beh kavveta vehatnan bayit afel en potchin bo challonot lirot et nigo

Amar leh rava dekaamratte yetzia derech achorav lo shemah yetzia kohen gadol beom hakkippurim yochiach dichtiv beh yetzia utnan yatza uva lo derech kenisato udkaamratte bayit afel en potchin bo challonot lirot et nigo hane mile hecha dela itachzak aval hecha deitachzak itachzak
Tanya dela kerav acha bar yaakov veyatza hakkohen min habbayit yachol yelech letoch beto veyasgir talmud lomar el petach habbayit
I petach habbayit yachol yaamod tachat hammashkof veyasgir talmud lomar min habbayit ad sheyyetze min habbayit kullo ha ketzad omed betzad hammashkof umasgir
Uminnayin sheim halach letoch beto vehisgir o sheamad betoch habbayit vehisgir shehesgero musgar talmud lomar vehisgir et habbayit mikkol makom
Verav acha bar yaakov

a: Kegon dekayemi dara degavre veamri kidkae kae
Mena ha milta daamur rabbanan zil batar rubba menalan dichtiv achare rabbim lehattot
Rubba deita kamman kegon tesha chanuot vesanhedrin la ka mibaya lan
Ki ka mibaya lan rubba deleteh kamman kegon katan uktanna menalan
Amar rabbi elazar siman zeman shevach mechannesh
Atya meresha shel ola deamar kera venittach otah lintacheha otah lintacheha velo netacheha lintachim venechush shemma nikav kerum shel moach ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba
Mimmay dilma defale leh uvadek leh vei mishshum otah lintacheha velo netacheha lintachim hane mile hecha dechatech leh ligmare aval hecha delayif let lan bah
Mar bereh deravina amar atya mishshevirat etzem befesach deamar rachamana veetzem lo tishberu vo venechush shemma nikav kerum shel moach ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba
Mimmay dilma demannach gumarta aleh vekale leh uvadek leh detanya hamchattech begidim vehassoref baatzamot en bo mishshum shevirat etzem
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar atya mealya deamar rachamana chelbo haalya temima velechush shemma nifseka chut hashshidra ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba
Vechi tema demittattay pasek lah leummat heatze amar rachamana mekom shehakkelaot yoatzot
Mimmay dilma defatach lah uvadek lah vei mishshum temima hane mile hecha dechatchah ligmare aval hecha delayif let lan bah
Rav sheshet bereh derav idi amar atya meegla arufa deamar rachamana haarufa keshehi shelema tehve velechush dilma terefa hi ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba
Vechi tema may nafka minah ha amri deve rabbi yannay kappara ketiv bah kekadashim

Rabba bar rav shela amar atya mippara adumma deamar rachamana veshachat vesaraf ma shechitatah keshehi shelema af serefatah keshehi shelema velechush dilma terefa hi ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba
Vechi tema may nafka minah chattat karyah rachamana
Rav acha bar yaakov amar atya missair hammishtalleach derachamana amar velakach et shene hasseirim sheyehu shenehem shavim velechush
b: Dilma chad minayehu terefa hu ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba
Vechi tema may nafka lan minah ha en goral kovea laazazel ella bedavar harauy lashshem vechi tema devadkinan leh vehatnan lo haya maggia lemachatzit hehar ad shennaase evarim evarim
Rav mari amar atya mimmakke aviv veimmo deamar rachamana katleh velechush dilma lav aviv hu ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba verov beilot achar habbaal
Mimmay dilma kegon shehau aviv veimmo chavushim bevet haasurin afilu hachi en appotroppos laaraot
Rav kahana amar atya mehoreg et hannefesh deamar rachamana katleh velechush dilma terefa hava ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba
Vechi tema devadkinan leh ha ka minaval vechi tema mishshum ibud neshama dehay ninavveleh venechush shemma bimkom sayif nekev hava
Ravina amar atya meedim zommin deamar rachamana vaasitem lo kaasher zamam vego velechush dilma hach deashidu beh terefa hava ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba
Vechi tema devadkinan leh vehatanya berabbi omer lo hargu neheragin hargu en neheragin
Rav ashe amar atya mishshechita atzmah deamar rachamana shechot veechol velechush shemma bimkom nekev ka shachet ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba
Amar rav ashe amrita lishmata kammeh derav kahana veamri lah rav kahana kammeh derav shimi vaamar leh vedilma hecha deefshar efshar hecha dela efshar la efshar
Dei la tema hachi lerabbi meir dechayesh lemiuta hachi name dela achel bisra vechi tema hachi name

a: Pesach vekadashim may ika lememar ella hecha deefshar efshar hecha dela efshar la efshar hacha name hecha deefshar efshar hecha dela efshar la efshar
Amar rav nachman amar rav raa echad sheshshachat im raahu mittechilla vead sof muttar leechol mishshechitato veim lav asur leechol mishshechitato
Hechi dame i deyada digmir lema li raa vei deyada dela gemir peshita
Veella dela yeda i gemir i la gemir lema rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumchin hen
Mi la tanya hare shemmatza tarnegolet shechuta bashshuk o sheamar lishlucho tze shechot vehalach umatza shachut chezkato shachut
Alma amrinan rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumchin hen hacha name lema rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumchin hen
Leolam deyada dela gemir uchgon dishchat kamman chad siman shappir mahu detema middehay shappir hach name shappir ka mashma lan hay itremoye itremi leh idach shemma shaha shemma daras

Bea mineh rav dimi bar yosef merav nachman haomer lishlucho tze ushchot vehalach umatza shachut mahu amar lo chezkato shachut haomer lishlucho tze utrom vehalach umatza tarum may amar leh en chezkato tarum
Ma nafshach i chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto afilu teruma name vei en chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto afilu shechita name la

Amar leh lechi techul alah kora demilcha leolam en chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto ushchita i name dilma inash acharina shema vaazal shechat rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumchin hen teruma dilma inash acharina shema vaazal teram have leh torem shello middaat vehattorem shello middaat en terumato teruma

Lema rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumchin hen tannae hi detanya hare sheavdu lo gedayav vetarnegolav vehalach umtzaan shechutim rabbi yehuda oser rabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili mattir amar rabbi nirin devarim shel rabbi yehuda shemmetzaan beashpa vedivre rabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili shemmetzaan bevayit
May lav beha kamipalgi demar savar amrinan rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumchin hen umar savar la amrinan rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumchin hen

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak la dechulle alma rov metzuyin etzel shechita mumchin hen uvvayit dechulle alma la peligi dishre beashpa shebbashshuk dechulle alma la peligi deasur ki peligi beashpa shebbabbayit mar savar adam asuy lehattil nivlato beashpa shebbabbayit umar savar en adam asuy lehattil nivlato beashpa shebbabbayit
Amar mar amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yehuda shemmetzaan beashpa may ashpa ilema ashpa shebbeshuk ha amratte dechulle alma la peligi deasur ella lav peshita beashpa shebbabbayit

Ema sefa vedivre rabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili shemmetzaan bevayit may bayit ilema bayit mammash haamratte dechulle alma la peligi dishre ella peshita beashpa shebbabbayit kashya derabbi adderabbi
b: Hachi kaamar nirin divre rabbi yehuda lerabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili beashpa shebbashshuk sheaf rabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili lo nechlak alav ella beashpa shebbabbayit aval beashpa shebbashshuk mode leh venirin ku
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan shemma yekalkelu et shechitatan shemma kilkelu la katane ella shemma yekalkelu amar rava zot omeret en mosrin lahen chullin lechattechilla
Vechullan sheshshachatu vaacherim roim otam shechitatan keshera man tena dela baenan kavana lishchita

Amar rava rabbi natan hi detane oshaya zeera demin chavrayya zarak sakkin lenootzah bakkotel vehalcha veshachata kedarkah rabbi natan machshir vachachamim poslin hu tane lah vehu amar lah halacha kerabbi natan
Veha baenan molich umevi shehalcha uvaa kedarkah
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba bae rabbi yochanan katan yesh lo machshava o en lo machshava
Amar leh rabbi amme vetibe leh maase may shena maase dela ka mibbaya leh ditnan yesh lahen maase machshava name la tibe leh ditnan en lahen machshava
Ditnan haallon veharimmon vehaegoz shechakakum tinokot lamod bahen afar o shehitkinum lechaf moznayim temein mippene sheyyesh lahen maase

a: Veen lahen machshava
Amar leh machshava geredta la ka mibaya leh ki ka mibaya leh machshavto nikeret mittoch maasav
Kegon dahava kayema ola baddarom veatyah batztzafon veshachtah may middeatyah batztzafon veshachtah ikaven lah o dilma makom hu dela itremi leh
Ha name amrah rabbi yochanan chada zimna ditnan hammaale perotav laggag mippene hakkenima veyarad alehem tal enan bechi yuttan veim nitkaven lechach hare hen bechi yuttan
Heelum cheresh shote vekatan af al pi shennitkavvenu lechach enan bechi yuttan mippene sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machshava
Veamar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shello hipech bahen aval hipech bahen hare ze bechi yuttan
Hachi ka mibaya leh deorayeta o derabbanan
Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne hachi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba bae rabbi yochanan katan yesh lo maase o en lo maase
Amar leh rabbi amme vetibe leh machshava may shena machshava dela ka mibaya leh ditnan en lahen machshava maase name la tibe leh ditnan yesh lahen maase

Hachi ka mibaya leh deorayeta o derabbanan ufashet yesh lahen maase vaafilu middeorayeta en lahen machshava vaafilu midderabbanan machshavto nikeret mittoch maasav middeorayeta en lo midderabbanan yesh lo

Bea mineh shemuel merav huna minnayin lammitassek bekadashim shehu pasul shenneemar veshachat et ben habbakar shettehe shechita leshem ben bakar amar lo zo beyadenu hi leakkev minnayin talmud lomar lirtzonchem tizbachuhu ledatechem zevuchu
Matni shechitat nochri nevela umtammea bemassa
Gema nevela in isur hanaa la man tanna amar rabbi chiyya berabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan dela kerabbi eliezer dei rabbi eliezer haamar setam machshevet nochri laavoda zara

Rabbi amme amar hachi katane shechitat nochri nevela ha demin laavoda zara tenena leha detanu rabbanan shechitat min laavoda zara pito pat kuti yeno yen nesech sefarav sifre kosmin perotav tevalin veyesh omrim af
b: Banav mamzerin
Vetanna kamma ishto la mafkar
Amar mar shechitat nochri nevela venechush shemma min hu amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh en minin baummot
Veha kachazenan deika ema en rov ummot minin savar lah ki ha deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan goyim shebbechutza learetz lav ovde avoda zara hen ella minhag avotehen bidehen
Amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman en minin baummot lemay ilema lishchita hashta shechitat min deyisrael amratte asira degoy mibbaya ella lemoridin hashta deyisrael moridin degoyim mibbaya
Amar rav ukva bar chama lekabbel mehen korban detanya mikkem velo kullechem lehotzi et hamshummad mikkem bachem chillakti velo baummot

Mimmay dilma hachi kaamar miyyisrael mitztzaddike kabbel merashshie la tekabbel aval beummot haolam kelal kelal la la salka datach detanya ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot haggoyim shennodrim nedarim undavot keyisrael

Umtammea bemassa peshita kevan dinvela hi metammea bemassa amar rava hachi katane zo metammea bemassa veyesh lecha acheret shehi metammea afilu beohel veezo zo tikrovet avoda zara uchrabbi yehuda ben betira
Ika deamri amar rava hachi katane zo metammea bemassa veyesh lecha acheret shehi kazo shemmetammea bemassa veenah metammea beohel veezo zo tikrovet avoda zara udla kerabbi yehuda ben betira

Detanya rabbi yehuda ben betira omer minnayin letikrovet avoda zara shehi metammea beohel shenneemar vayyitztzamdu levaal peor vayyochlu zivche metim ma met metamme beohel af tikrovet avoda zara metammea beohel
Matni hashshochet ballayela vechen hassome sheshshachat shechitato keshera
Gema hashshochet diavad in lechattechilla la urminhi leolam shochatin ben bayyom uven ballayela ben berosh haggag ben berosh hassefina
Amar rav pappa besheavuka kenegdo amar rav ashe dayeka name dekatane hatam dumya deom vehacha dumya desome shema minah

a: Matni hashshochet beshabbat uvom hakkipurim af al pi shemmitchayyev benafsho shechitato keshera
Gema amar rav huna darash chiyya bar rav mishshemeh derav asura baachila leoma venasvin chavrayya lememar rabbi yehuda hi

He rabbi yehuda amar rabbi abba rabbi yehuda dahachana hi ditnan mechattechin et haddiluin lifne habbehema veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim rabbi yehuda omer im lo hayeta nevela meerev shabbat asura lefi sheenah min hammuchan alma kevan dela itchan meetmol asura hacha name kevan dela itchan meetmol asura

Amar leh abbaye mi dame hatam meikara muchan leadam vehashta muchan lichlavim hacha meikara muchan leadam vehashta muchan leadam mi savratte behema bechayyeha laachila omedet behema bechayyeha legaddel omedet
I hachi behema lerabbi yehuda beom tov hechi shachatinan amar lo omedet laachila veomedet legaddel nishchata huvrera delaachila omedet lo nishchata huvrera dilgaddel omedet
Veha let leh lerabbi yehuda berera mena lan i nema middetanya

Hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim omer shene luggin sheani atid lehafrish hare hen teruma asara maaser rishon tisha maaser sheni umechel veshote miyyad divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin
b: Hatam kidkatane tama amru lo lerabbi meir i atta mode shemma yibbaka hannod venimtza shote tevalim lemafrea amar lahen lichsheyyibbaka
Ella middetane ayyo
Detane ayyo rabbi yehuda omer en adam matne al shene devarim keechad ella im ba chacham lammizrach eruvo lammizrach lammaarav eruvo lammaarav veilu lechan ulchan la
Vehavenan bah may shena lechan ulchan dela deen berera mizrach umaarav name en berera
Veamar rabbi yochanan uchvar ba chacham

Ella amar rav yosef rabbi yehuda dechelim hi ditnan kol hakkelim hannitalin bashshabbat shivrehen nitalin uvilvad sheyehu osin meen melacha shivre areva lechassot bahen pi chavit shivre zechuchit lechassot bahen pi happach
Rabbi yehuda omer uvilvad sheyehu osin meen melachtan shivre areva latzuk letochan mikpa shivre zechuchit latzuk letochan shemen
Meen melachtan in meen melacha acheret la alma kevan dela itchan meetmol lehach melacha asiri hacha name kevan dela itchan meetmol asura
Amar leh abbaye mi dame hatam meikara keli vehashta shever keli vehave leh nolad veasur hacha meikara uchla ulvassof ochel uchla deiprat hu
Veshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda deamar uchla deiprat shappir dame ditnan en sochatin et happerot lehotzi mehen mashkin veim yatzu meatzman asurin
Rabbi yehuda omer im laochalin hayyotze mehen muttar veim lemashkin hayyotze mehen asur
Lav ittemar alah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mode haya rabbi yehuda lachachamim besalle zetim vaanavim
Alma kevan delischita kayemi yahev dateh hacha name kevan delishchita kayema yahev dateh
Mide hu tama ella lerav haamar rav chaluk haya rabbi yehuda afilu besalle zetim vaanavim
Ella amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi rabbi yehuda denerot hi detanya metaltelin ner chadash aval lo yashan divre rabbi yehuda
Emar deshamatte leh lerabbi yehuda bemuktze mechamat mius muktze mechamat isur mi shamatte leh in ditnan rabbi yehuda omer

a: Kol nerot shel mattechet mittaltelin chutz min hanner shehidliku bo beotah shabbat
Vedilma shane hatam dehu dache leh beyadayim
Ella amar rav ashe rabbi yehuda dimvashshel hi ditnan hamvashshel beshabbat beshogeg yeachel bemezid lo yeachel divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda omer beshogeg yeachel bemotzae shabbat bemezid lo yeachel olamit
Rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer beshogeg yeachel lemotzae shabbat laacherim velo lo bemezid lo yeachel olamit lo lo velo laacherim
Venokmah bemezid verabbi meir
La salka datach dekatane dumya deom hakkippurim ma yom hakkippurim la shena beshogeg vela shena bemezid la achel af hacha name la shena beshogeg vela shena bemezid la achel
Umi matzet mokmatte lah beshogeg verabbi yehuda veha af al pi shemmitchayyev benafsho katane hachi kaamar af al pi divmezid mitchayyev benafsho hu hacha divshogeg shechitato keshera

Venokmah kerabbi yochanan hassandelar deamar la shena beshogeg vela shena bemezid la achel rabbi yochanan hassandelar kamfalleg bemotzae shabbat laacherim velo lo tanna didan shechitato keshera katane la shena lo vela shena laacherim
Tane tanna kammeh derav hamvashshel beshabbat beshogeg yeachel bemezid lo yeachel umshattek leh rav
May tama meshattek leh ilema mishshum disvira leh kerabbi yehuda vetanna tane kerabbi meir mishshum disvira leh kerabbi yehuda man detane kerabbi meir meshattek leh
Veod mi savar lah kerabbi yehuda vehaamar rav chanan bar amme ki mori lehu rav letalmideh more lehu kerabbi meir vechi daresh befirka daresh kerabbi yehuda mishshum amme haaretz
Vechi tema tanna befirkeh tena kammeh attu kulle alma letanna tzayeti leamora tzayeti

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak tanna shochet tena kammeh derav hashshochet beshabbat beshogeg yeachel bemezid lo yeachel amar leh may datach kerabbi meir ad kan la kashare rabbi meir ella bimvashshel derauy lachos aval shochet deen rauy lachos la
Veha matnitin deshochet hu veamar rav huna daresh chiyya bar rav mishshemeh derav asura baachila leoma venasvin chavrayya lememer rabbi yehuda hi ha rabbi meir share
Ki share rabbi meir
b: Kegon shehaya lo chole mibbeod yom
I hachi may tama derabbi yehuda deasar kegon shehaya lo chole vehivri
Vechi ha deamar rav acha bar adda amar rav veamri lah amar rabbi yitzchak bar adda amar rav hashshochet lachole beshabbat asur labbari hamvashshel lachole beshabbat muttar labbari
May tama hay rauy lachos vehay eno rauy lachos
Amar rav pappa peamim shehashshochet muttar kegon shehaya lo chole mibbeod yom mevashshel asur kegon shekkatzatz lo dallaat

Amar rav dimi minnehardea hilcheta hashshochet lachole beshabbat muttar labbari beumtza may tama kevan dei efshar lichzayit basar belo shechita ki ka shachet addata dechole ka shachet hamvashshel lachole beshabbat asur labbari gezera shemma yarbe bishvilo
Matni hashshochet bemaggal yad betzor uvkane shechitato keshera
Hakkol shochatin ulolam shochatin uvakkol shochatin chutz mimmaggal katzir vehammegera vehashshinayim vehatztziporen mippene shehem chonkin

Gema hashshochet diavad in lechattechilla la bishlama bemaggal yad dilma ate lemebad beidach gisa ella tzor vekane lechitchilla la urminhi bakkol shochatin ben betzor ben bizchuchit ben bikrumit shel kane
La kashya kan betalush kan bimchubbar deamar rav kahana hashshochet bimchubbar lakkarka rabbi posel verabbi chiyya machshir ad kan la ka machshir rabbi chiyya ella bediavad aval lechattechilla la

Bemay okemtah kerabbi chiyya vediavad ella ha detanya bakkol shochatin ben betalush ben bimchubbar ben shehassakkin lemala vetzavar behema lematta ben shehassakkin lematta vetzavar behema lemala manni la rabbi vela rabbi chiyya i rabbi chiyya diavad in lechitchilla la i rabbi diavad name la
Leolam rabbi chiyya vaafilu lechattechilla vehay dekamipalgi bediavad lehodiacha kocho derabbi
Veella matnitin dekatane hashshochet diavad in lechattechilla la manni la rabbi vela rabbi chiyya i rabbi chiyya afilu lechattechilla i rabbi diavad name la
Leolam rabbi chiyya vaafilu lechattechilla umatnitin dekatane hashshochet rabbi hi
Kashya derabbi adderabbi la kashya kan bimchubbar meikaro kan betalush ulvassof chibro

Umna temra deshane lan ben mechubbar meikaro letalush ulvassof chibro detanya hashshochet bemuchni shechitato keshera bimchubbar lakkarka shechitato keshera naatz sakkin bakkotel veshachat bah shechitato keshera haya tzor yotze min hakkotel o kane ole meelav veshachat bo shechitato pesula

Amar mar hashshochet bemuchni shechitato keshera vehatanya shechitato pesula la kashya ha besarna defachra ha besarna demayya
Veibaet ema ha veha besarna demayya vela kashya ha bechoach rishon ha bechoach sheni
Vechi ha deamar rav pappa hay man dechafteh lechavreh veashkel aleh bidka demayya umit chayyav may tama gire dideh hu deahani beh vehane mile bechoach rishon aval bechoach sheni gerama bealma hu

Yatev rav achoreh derabbi chiyya verabbi chiyya kammeh derabbi veyatev rabbi vekaamar minnayin lishchita shehi betalush shenneemar vayyikkach et hammaachelet lishchot amar leh rav lerabbi chiyya may kaamar amar leh vav dichtiv aufta kaamar veha kera kaamar kera zerizuteh deavraham ka mashma lan
Amar rava peshita li talush ulvassof chibbero leinyan avoda zara have talush deamar mar hammishtachave levayit shello asaro vei salka datach have mechubbar elohehem al heharim velo heharim elohehem
Leinyan hechsher zeraim tannae hi ditnan hakkofe keara al hakkotel bishvil shettudach hare ze bechi yuttan bishvil shello yilke hakkotel eno bechi yuttan
Ha gufah kashya amratte bishvil shettudach hare ze bechi yuttan ha bishvil sheyyudach hakkotel en ze bechi yuttan
Vahadar tane bishvil shello yilke hakkotel eno bechi yuttan ha bishvil sheyyudach hakkotel hare ze bechi yuttan
Amar rabbi elazar tivra mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo rav pappa amar kullah chad tanna hu ha bakkotel meara ha bechotel binyan
Vehachi kaamar hakkofe keara al hakkotel bishvil shettudach hare ze bechi yuttan ha bishvil sheyyudach hakkotel en ze bechi yuttan
Bamme devarim amurim bechotel meara aval bechotel binyan bishvil shello yilke hakkotel hu deeno bechi yuttan ha bishvil sheyyudach hakkotel hare ze bechi yuttan
Bae rava
b: Talush ulvassof chibbero leinyan shechita may
Ta shema haya tzor yotze min hakkotel o shehaya kane ole meelav veshachat bo shechitato pesula
Hacha bemay askinan bechotel meara dayeka name dekatane dumya dekane ole meelav shema minah
Ta shema naatz sakkin bakkotel veshachat bah shechitato keshera shane sakkin dela mevattel leh
Ta shema bimchubbar lakkarka shechitato keshera dilma paroshe ka mefaresh lah may mechubbar lakkarka sakkin dela mevattel leh

Amar mar naatz sakkin bakkotel veshachat bah shechitato keshera amar rav anan amar shemuel lo shanu ella shehassakkin lemala vetzavar behema lematta aval sakkin lematta vetzavar behema lemala chayeshinan shemma yidros
Veha katane ben shehassakkin lematta vetzavar behema lemala ben shehassakkin lemala vetzavar behema lematta
Amar rav zevid litzdadin katane sakkin lematta vetzavar behema lemala betalush sakkin lemala vetzavar behema lematta bimchubbar rav pappa amar beofa dekallil

Amar rav chisda amar rabbi yitzchak veamri lah bematnita tana chamishsha devarim neemru bikrumit shel kane en shochatin bah veen malin bah veen mechattechin bah basar veen mechatztzetzin bah shinayim veen mekannechim bah
En shochatin bah vehatanya bakkol shochatin ben betzor ben bizchuchit ben bikrumit shel kane amar rav pappa besimona deagma
Veen mechattechin bah basar rav pappa mechattech bah kirve dagim dezigi rabba bar rav huna mechattech bah ofa derakkich
Veen mekannechin bah tipok leh mishshum deamar mar hamkanneach bedavar shehaur sholetet bo shinav noshrot amar rav pappa kinuach pi makka kaamrinan
Hakkol shochatin ulolam shochatin hakkol shochatin hakkol bishchita vaafilu of

Leolam shochatin man tanna amar rabba rabbi yishmael hi detanya ki yarchiv Adonai elohecha et gevulcha kaasher dibber lach veamarta ochla vasar vego rabbi yishmael omer lo ba hakkatuv ella lehattir lahem besar taava
Shebbattechilla neesar lahem besar taava mishshennichnesu laaretz huttar lahem besar taava
Veachshav sheggalu yachol yachzeru leisuran harishon lechach shaninu leolam shochatin
Matkef lah rav yosef hay leolam shochatin leolam shochatin veochlin mibbee leh veod meikara may tama itsar mishshum dehau mekarvi lemishkan ulvassof may tama ishtero dahao merachaki mimmishkan

a: Vechol shekken hashta dearchiku lehu tefe

Ella amar rav yosef rabbi akiva hi detanya ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha lasum shemo sham vezavachta mibbekarcha umitztzoncha rabbi akiva omer lo ba hakkatuv ella leesor lahen besar nechira shebbattechilla huttar lahen besar nechira mishshennichnesu laaretz neesar lahen besar nechira
Veachshav sheggalu yachol yachzeru lehetteran harishon lechach shaninu leolam shochatin
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi akiva savar besar taava la itsar kelal rabbi yishmael savar besar nechira la ishteri kelal
Bishlama lerabbi yishmael hayenu dichtiv veshachat et ben habbakar ella lerabbi akiva may veshachat kadashim shane
Bishlama lerabbi yishmael hayenu dichtiv hatzon uvakar yishshachet lahem ella lerabbi akiva may hatzon uvakar yishshachet lahem yinnacher lahem mibe leh nechira shellahen zo hi shechitatan
Bishlama lerabbi yishmael hayenu ditnan hashshochet venitnabbela beyado vehannocher vehamakker patur millechassot ella lerabbi akiva ammay patur millechassot
Hoil veitsar itsar
Bishlama lerabbi akiva deamar besar taava la itsar kelal hayenu dichtiv ach kaasher yeachel et hatztzevi veet haayyal ken tochlennu ella lerabbi yishmael tzevi veayyal gufeh mi have shere
Ki asar rachamana behema dechazya lehakrava aval chayya dela chazya lehakrava la asar rachamana
Bae rabbi yirmeya evre besar nechira shehichnisu yisrael immahen laaretz mahu
Emat ilema besheva shekkibbeshu hashta davar tame ishteri lehu dichtiv uvattim meleim kol tuv veamar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav kutle dachazire besar nechira mibbaya
Ella leachar mikkan veibaet ema leolam besheva shekkibbeshu ki ishteri lehu shalal shel goyim didhu la ishteri teku
Amar rabba shannet hakkol shochatin ulolam shochatin bakkol shochatim may meshannet leh
Vechi tema ben betzor ben bizchuchit ben bikrumit shel kane ha dumya dehanach katane i hanach beshochatin hay name beshochatin vei hanach benishchatin hay name benishchatin

Ella amar rava hakkol shochatin chada leetoye kuti vachada leetoye yisrael meshummad leolam shochatin ben bayyom ben ballayela ben berosh haggag ben berosh hassefina bakkol shochatin ben betzor ben bizchuchit ben bikrumit shel kane
Chutz mimmaggal katzir vehammegera avuh dishmuel pegam veshaddar pegam veshaddar shelachu leh kimgera shaninu
Tanu rabbanan
b: Sakkin sheyyesh bah pegimot harbe tidon kimgera vesheen bah ella pegima achat ogeret pesula mesuchsechet keshera hechi damya ogeret hechi damya mesuchsechet amar rabbi eliezer ogeret mishte ruchot mesuchsechet meruach achat

May shena mishte ruchot demursha kamma machlesh umursha batra baza meruach achat name churpa desakkina machlesh mursha baza dekaem aresha desakkina sof sof ki azla machlesha ki atya baza kegon sheholich velo hevi

Amar rava shalosh middot besakkin ogeret lo yishchot veim shachat shechitato pesula mesuchsechet lo yishchot bah lechitchilla veim shachat shechitato keshera ole veored besakkin shochet bah lechattechilla
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav nechemya lerav ashe amarte lan mishshemeh derava mesuchsechet pesula veha amar rava mesuchsechet keshera la kashya kan sheholich vehevi kan sheholich velo hevi
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe damya lesasa may amar leh man yahev lan mibbisreh veachlinan
Amar rav chisda minnayin livdikat sakkin min hattora shenneemar ushchattem baze vaachaltem
Peshita kevan dechi nekav terefa baaya bedika lechacham kaamrinan vehaamar rabbi yochanan lo amru leharot sakkin lechacham ella mippene kevodo shel chacham midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma hu
Bemareva badki lah beshimsha binhardea badku lah bemayya rav sheshet badek lah beresh lishaneh rav acha bar yaakov badek lah bechut hassaara
Besura amri bisra achla bisra livdekah amar rav pappa tzericha bedika abbisra veattufra veattelata ruchata

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe amar lan rav samma bereh derav mesharsheya mishshemach daamarte leh mishshemeh derava tzericha bedika abbisra veattufra veattelata ruchata amar leh abbisra veattufra amari veattelata ruchata la amari ika deamri abbisra veattufra veattelata ruchata amari mishshemeh derava la amari

Ravina verav acha bereh derava hao yatvi kammeh derav ashe ayeto sakkin lekammeh derav ashe livdekah amar leh lerav acha bereh derava bidkah badkah attufra veabbisra veattelata ruchata amar leh yishar vechen amar rav kahana

Rav yemar amar attufra veabbisra tzericha attelata ruchata la tzericha mi la amar rabbi zera amar shemuel liben sakkin veshachat bah shechitato keshera shechidudah kodem lelibunah vekashya lan haika tzedadin veamrinan bet hashshechita mirvach ravach hacha name bet hashshechita mirvach ravach
Amar rav huna bar rav kattina amar rabbi shimon ben lakish shalosh pegimot hen pegimat etzem bappesach pegimat ozen bivchor pegimat mum bekadashim
Verav chisda amar af pegimat sakkin veidach bechullin la ka mayere
Vechullan pegimatan kede pegimat hammizbeach

a: Vechamma pegimat hammizbeach kede shettachgor bah tzipporen
Metivi kamma pegimat hammizbeach rabbi shimon ben yochay omer tefach rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer kezayit la kashya ha besida ha beavna
Amar rav huna hay tabbacha dela sar sakkina kamme chacham meshammetinan leh verava amar meabberinan leh umachrezinan abbisreh ditrefa hi
Vela peligi kan beshennimtzet sakkino yafa kan beshello nimtzet sakkino yafa ravina amar hecha delo nimtzet sakkino yafa memasmes leh befarta daafilu legoyim name la mizdabban
Hahu tabbacha dela sar sakkina kammeh derava bar chinana shammeteh veabbereh veachrez abbisreh ditrefa hi ikkelau mar zutra verav ashe legabbeh amar lehu liayenu rabbanan bemilleteh ditlu beh tafle
Badkeh rav ashe lesakkineh venimtzet yafa veachshereh amar leh mar zutra vela lechush mar lesava amar leh shelichuteh ka avdinan
Amar rabba bar huna shen telusha vetzipporen telusha muttar lishchot bah lechattechilla veha anan tenan chutz mimmaggal katzir vehammegera vehashshinayim vehatztzipporen mippene shehen chonkin
Shen ashshen la kashya ha bachada ha betarte tzipporen atztzipporen la kashya ha bitlusha ha bimchubberet
Matni hashshochet bemaggal katzir badderech halichatah bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin veim hechliku shineha hare hi kesakkin

Gema amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan af keshehichshiru bet hillel lo hichshiru ella letaharah mide nevela aval baachila asura amar rav ashe dayeka name dekatane bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin vela katane bet shammay osrin uvet hillel mattirin velitamach litne bet shammay metammein uvet hillel metaharin ella poslin umachshirin veosrin umattirin chada milta hi
Matni hashshochet mittoch hattabbaat veshiyyer bah melo hachut al pene kullah shechitato keshera rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer melo chut al pene rubbah
Gema rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu halacha kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda veaf rabbi yose berabbi yehuda lo amar ella betabbaat haggedola hoil umakkefet et kol hakkane aval bishar tabbaot lo
Uvishar tabbaot lo vehatanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer
b: Hashshochet bishar tabbaot af al pi sheen makkifot et kol hakkane hoil umakkifot et rov hakkane shechitato keshera umugremet pesula heid rabbi chanina ben antignos al mugremet shehi keshera
Amar rav yosef rabbi yose bar yehuda tarte kaamar rav ushmuel savri kevateh bachada ufligi aleh bachada
Veha lo amar kaamri hachi kaamar halacha kemoto betabbaat haggedola veen halacha kemoto bishar tabbaot
Ki selek rabbi zera achal mugremet derav ushmuel amri leh lav meatreh derav ushmuel atte amar lehu man amrah yosef bar chiyya yosef bar chiyya mikkulle alma gemir

Shema rav yosef ikfad amar ana mikkulle alma gemirna ana merav yehuda gemirna daafilu sefeke degavre gares deamar rav yehuda amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba safek mishshemeh derav safek mishshemeh dishmuel shelosha mattirin et habbechor bimkom sheen mumche
Verabbi zera let leh notnin alav chumre hammakom sheyyatza mishsham vechumre hammakom shehalach lesham
Amar abbaye hane mile mibbavel levavel umeeretz yisrael leeretz yisrael i name meeretz yisrael levavel aval mibbavel leeretz yisrael kevan daanan kayefinan lehu avdinan kevatayehu
Rav ashe amar afilu tema mibbavel leeretz yisrael hane mile hecha dedato lachazor rabbi zera en dato lachazor hava
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef veha rabbanan daato mimmachoza amri amar rabbi zera mishshemeh derav nachman mugremet keshera amar leh nahara nahara ufshateh
Rabbi shimon ben lakish achshar bechudda dechovaa kare aleh rabbi yochanan gisa gisa amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava pega bechite terefa
Ibaya lehu paga venaga bahen dichtiv vayyifga bo vayyamot o dilma paga velo naga kedichtiv vayyifgeu vo malache elohim

Itmar amar rav pappa mishshemeh derava shayyar bechite keshera amar rav ammemar bar mar yanoka hava kaemna kammeh derabbi chiyya bereh derav aveya veamar li shayyar bechite keshera amar leh ravina lerav ashe amar li rav shemen missuvra ikla mar zutra leatrin udrash shayyar bechite keshera mar bar rav ashe amar pega bechite keshera shayyar bechite terefa

a: Vehilcheta mishshipuy kova ulmatta keshera vehayenu deshayyar bechite
Rav nachman achshar mishshipuy kova ulmatta amar leh rav chanan bar rav kattina lerav nachman keman la kerabbanan vela kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda

Amar leh ana la chilak yadana vela bilak yadana ana shemata yadana deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan veamri lah amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rabbi chanina veamri lah amar rabbi yaakov bar idi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshipuy kova ulmatta keshera
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mugremet derabbanan keshera lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda
Udrabbi yose berabbi yehuda keshera lerabbi chanina ben antignos
Peshita mahu detema rabbi chanina ben antignos adderabbanan kae ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name im ken heid aleha mibe leh vehilcheta kerabbi chanina ben antignos dekae rav nachman kevateh
Amar rav huna amar rav assi machloket besheshshachat shene shelish vehigrim shelish derabbanan savri kullah shechita baenan betabbaat gedola verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar rubbo kechullo
Aval higrim shelish veshachat shene shelish divre hakkol pesula dechi nafka chiyyuta baenan rubba bishchita veleka
Amar leh rav chisda adderabba lema mar ipcha machloket keshehigrim shelish veshachat shene shelish derabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar mide dehave achatzi kane pagum
Verabbanan hatam makom shechita hacha lav mekom shechita
Aval shachat shene shelish vehigrim shelish divre hakkol keshera deha tenan rubbo shel echad kamohu
Amar leh rav yosef man nema lan dehahu rubba dehatam lav rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane lah dilma rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane lah
Amar leh abbaye attu kol rubbe dealma rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane lehu amar leh ana rubba dishchita kaamena dishmana lehu difligi

Lishana acharina amri lah amar rav huna amar rav assi machloket shehigrim shelish veshachat shene shelish derabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda savar mide dehave achatzi kane pagum verabbanan hatam mekom shechita hacha lav mekom shechita
Aval shachat shene shelish vehigrim shelish divre hakkol keshera deha tenan rubbo shel echad kamohu

Matkef lah rav chisda man lema lan dehahu rubba dehatam lav rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane lah dilma rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane lah amar leh rav yosef attu kol rubbe dealma rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane lehu amar leh ana rubba dishchita kaamena dishmana lehu difligi

Vedilma bimkom shechita bimkom shechita may lememra mahu detema baenan shechita meforaat veleka ka mashma lan
Siman bakkad
Yetev rabbi abba achoreh derav kahana veyatev rav kahana kammeh derav yehuda veyatev vekaamar shachat shelish vehigrim shelish veshachat shelish mahu amar leh shechitato keshera
Higrim shelish veshachat shelish vehigrim shelish mahu amar leh shechitato pesula
Shachat bimkom nekev mahu amar leh shechitato keshera
Shachat ufaga bo nekev mahu amar leh shechitato pesula
Azal rabbi abba amrah kammeh derabbi elazar azal rabbi elazar amrah kammeh derabbi yochanan amar leh may shena
Amar leh shachat bimkom nekev naasa kemi sheshshachat goy vegamar yisrael shachat ufaga bo nekev naasa kemi sheshshachat yisrael vegamar goy kare aleh goy goy

Amar rava shappir kare aleh goy goy bishlama hatam middahava leh leyisrael lemishchat rubba vela shechat ki nafka chiyyuta bida degoy ka nafka ella hacha mikkede mishchat shachet ma li bimkom nekev ma li paga bo nekev

Matni hashshochet min hatztzedadin shechitato keshera hammolek min hatztzedadin melikato pesula hashshochet min haoref shechitato pesula hammolek min haoref melikato keshera hashshochet min hatztzavar shechitato keshera hammolek min hatztzavar melikato pesula shekkol haoref kasher limlika vechol hatztzavar kasher lishchita nimtza kasher bishchita pasul bimlika kasher bimlika pasul bishchita
Gema may oref ilema oref mammash may irya shochet afilu molek name mimmul orpo amar rachamana velo orpo ella may oref mimmul oref kidkatane sefa kol haoref kasher limlika

Menahane mile detanu rabbanan mimmul orpo mul haroe et haoref vechen hu omer vehu yoshev mimmuli veomer ki fanu elay oref velo fanim may veomer vechi tema oref gufeh la yadinan hecha denidda mul dideh hecha ta shema ki fanu elay oref velo fanim mikkelal deoref lahade panim
Amri bene rabbi chiyya mitzvat melika machazir simanim laachore haoref umolek ika deamri af machzir veika deamri machzir daveka
Umistabbera keman deamar af machzir mimmay middekatane hashshochet min haoref shechitato pesula hammolek min haoref melikato keshera

a: Vei salka datach machzir daveka may irya molek afilu shochet name ella lav shema minah af machzir umatnitin bidla ahdar
Amar rabbi yannay yekabbelu harovin et teshuvatan dekatane nimtza kasher bishchita pasul bimlika kasher bimlika pasul bishchita lemaote may lav lemaote machazir simanin laachore haoref dela
Amar rabba bar bar chana la lemaote shen vetzipporen shen vetzipporen behedya katane lehu

Ella amar rabbi yirmeya lemaote molich umevi hanicha leman deamar molich umevi bimlika pasul ella leman deamar kasher may ika lememar bene rabbi chiyya savri lah keman deamar molich umevi bimlika pasul

Amar rav kahana mitzvat melika kotzetz veored vezo hi mitzvatah savar rabbi avin lememar kotzetz veored in molich umevi la amar leh rabbi yirmeya kol shekken demolich umevi bimlika kasher umay zo hi mitzvatah ema af zo hi mitzvatah

Amar rabbi yirmeya amar shemuel kol hakkasher bishchita kenegdo baoref kasher bimlika ha pasul bishchita pasul bimlika lemaote may ilema lemaote ikur simanin veha tane rame bar yechezkel en ikur simanin baof
Amar rav pappa lemaote rosho rosho peshita mimmul orpo amar rachamana velo berosho
May rosho shipuy rosho kegon denaket mishshipuy rosho vehigrim vaazal ad dimta tattay vechidrav huna amar rav assi deamar rav huna amar rav assi higrim shelish veshachat shene shelish pesula
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe ha detane rame bar yechezkel en ikur simanin baof la amaran ella leman deamar en shechita laof min hattora
b: Aval leman deamar yesh shechita laof min hattora yesh ikur
Amar leh adderabba ipcha mistabbera leman deamar yesh shechita laof min hattora ika lememar dehachi agmereh deen ikur vaafilu leman deamar kivhema leinyan ikur la leheve kivhema
Ella leman deamar en shechita laof min hattora ella middivre sofrim mehecha gemiri lah mibbehema kullah milta kivhema

Amar ravina amar li ravin bar kisi ha detane rame bar yechezkel en ikur simanin baof la amaran ella bimlika aval bishchita yesh ikur vehaamar rabbi yirmeya amar shemuel kol hakkasher bishchita kenegdo baoref kasher bimlika ha pasul pasul hahi peliga
Amar zeeri nishbera mafreket verov basar immah nevela
Amar rav chisda af anan name tenena malak besakkin metamme begadim abbet habbelia vei amratte terefa haveya melikatah zo hi shechitatah tahane lah sakkin letaharah mide nevela
Amri hatam mishshum delav shechita hi kelal may tama rav huna amar mippene shehu machlid rava amar mippene shehu dores

Man deamar mippene shehu machlid may tama la amar mippene shehu dores kasavar molich umevi bimlika kasher uman deamar mippene shehu dores may tama la amar mippene shehu machlid amar lach chalada hechi dame kechulda haddara beikre vattim demikkasseya hacha ha migalleya
Amar rava i kashya li ha kashya li vechi meta omed umolek
Amar leh abbaye vetikshe lach olat haof devaaya shene simanin vechi meta omed umolek amar leh hatam kede lekayyem bah mitzvat havdala
I hachi or name kol hamakkev bishchita meakkev behavdala vechol sheeno meakkev bishchita eno meakkev behavdala
Veha miut simanin lerabbanan dela miakkevi bishchita umakkevi behavdala ella ema kol sheyyeshno bishchita yeshno behavdala vechol sheeno bishchita eno behavdala

a: Mikkol makom kashya amar rava ema vechen hu ose chotech shidra umafreket belo rov basar
Ki salek rabbi zera ashkecheh lerabbi amme deyatev vekaamar lah leha shemata amar leh vechi meta omed umolek eshtomam keshaa chada amar leh ema kach hu ose chotech shidra umafreket belo rov basar

Tanya name hachi ketzad molkin chattat haof chotech shidra umafreket belo rov basar ad shemmaggia laveshet o lakkane higgia laveshet o lakkane chotech siman echad o rubbo verov basar immo uvola shenayim o rov shenayim
Manni i rabbanan ha amri shenayim daveka i kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon haamar rov shenayim
Ema shenayim lerabbanan rov shenayim lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon veibaet ema ha veha rabbi elazar berabbi shimon umay shenayim sheddomin lishnayim
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel nishbera mafreket verov basar immah metamme beohel

Veim tomar oto maase deeli mafreket belo rov basar havay zikna shane dichtiv vayehi kehazkiro et aron haelohim vayyippol meal hakkisse achorannit bead yad hashshaar vattishshaver mafrakto vayyamot ki zaken haish vechaved vego
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan kerao kaddag metamme beohel amar rabbi shemuel bar yitzchak umiggabbo
Amar shemuel asaah gistera nevela amar rabbi elazar nital hayyarech vechalal shellah nikar nevela hechi dame chalal shellah nikar amar rava kol shervutza veniret chasera
Tenan hatam huttezu rashehen af al pi shemmefarkesin temeim kiznav halletaa shemmefarkeset
May huttezu resh lakish amar huttezu mammash rabbi assi amar rabbi mani kehavdalat olat haof
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi assi kehavdalat olat haof lerabbanan vela peligitu o dilma kehavdalat olat haof lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon ufligitu
Amar leh kehavdalat olat haof lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon ufliginan
Ika deamri rabbi shimon ben lakish amar huttezu mammash rabbi assi amar rabbi mani kehavdalat olat haof lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon berov shenayim
May rabbanan umay rabbi elazar berabbi shimon detanya veet hashsheni yaase ola kammishpat kemishpat chattat behema

Atta omer kemishpat chattat behema o eno ella kemishpat chattat haof keshehu omer vehikrivo chillek hakkatuv ben chattat haof leolat haof uma ani mekayyem kammishpat kemishpat chattat behema ma chattat behema enah baa
b: Ella min hachullin uvayyom uvyado hayemanit af olat haof enah baa ella min hachullin uvayyom uvyado hayemanit
I ma lehallan berov shenayim af kan berov shenayim talmud lomar umalak vehiktir ma haktara harosh beatzmo vehagguf beatzmo af melika harosh beatzmo vehagguf beatzmo
Rabbi yishmael omer kemishpat kemishpat chattat haof ma chattat haof mimmul oref af olat haof mimmul oref
I ma lehallan molek veeno mavdil besiman echad af kan molek veeno mavdil besiman echad talmud lomar vehikrivo
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer kammishpat kemishpat chattat haof ma lehallan

a: Ochez barosh uvagguf umazze af kan ochez berosh uvagguf umazze
May kaamar hachi kaamar ma lehallan keshehu achuz harosh bagguf mazze af kan keshehu achuz harosh bagguf mazze
I ma lehallan besiman echad af kan besiman echad talmud lomar vehikrivo
Vetanna kamma vechi meachar denafka lan miumalak vehiktir vehikrivo lema li
I lav vehikrivo hava amena may kammishpat kemishpat chattat haof
Vei mishshum umalak vehiktir hava amena ma haktara berosho shel mizbeach af melika berosho shel mizbeach
Hashta dichtav rachamana vehikrivo derosh beh name ha
Chattat behema deenah baa ella min hachullin menalan amar rav chisda deamar kera vehikriv aharon et par hachattat asher lo mishshello velo mishshel tzibbur velo mishshel maaser
Bayyom mibbeom tzaoto nafka kedi nasvah
Yado hayemanit midderabba bar bar chana nafka deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi shimon ben lakish kol makom shenneemar etzba o chehunna enah ella yamin
Veidach kehunna baaya etzba etzba la baaya kehunna
Vetanna kamma verabbi elazar berabbi shimon mimmul haoref mena lehu gamri melika mimmelika
Matni kasher betorin pasul bivne yona kasher bivne yona pasul betorin techillat hatztzihuv baze uvaze pasul
Gema tanu rabbanan torin gedolim kesherim ketannim pesulim bene yona ketannim kesherim gedolim pesulin nimtza kasher betorin pasul bivne yona kasher bivne yona pasul betorin
Tanu rabbanan torim gedolim velo ketannim sheyyachol vahalo din hu
b: Uma bene yona shello huchsheru bigdolim huchsheru biktannim torim shehuchsheru bigdolim eno din shehuchsheru biktannim talmud lomar torim gedolim velo ketannim

Bene yona ketannim velo gedolim sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma torim shello huchsheru biktannim huchsheru bigdolim bene yona shehuchsheru biktannim eno din shehuchsheru bigdolim talmud lomar bene yona ketannim velo gedolim
May talmuda amar rava la lishtemit kera velichtov min bene hattorim o min hayyona
Ema bene yona dichtav behu rachamana bene ketannim in gedolim la torim i bae gedolim layete i bae ketannim layete dumya divne yona ma bene yona ketannim in gedolim la af torim gedolim in ketannim la

Tanu rabbanan yachol yehu kol hattorim vechol bene hayyona kesherim talmud lomar min hattorim velo kol hattorim min bene hayyona velo kol bene yona perat litchilat hatztzihuv shebbaze veshebbaze sheppasul meematay hattorim kesherim mishsheyyazhivu meematay bene yona pesulin mishsheyyatzhivu
Tane yaakov karcha meematay bene yona kesherim mishsheyealu hu tane lah vehu amar lah efrochav yealu dam emat amar abbaye mikki shamet gadpa mineh veate dema
Bae rabbi zera haomer hare alay ola min hattorim o min bene hayyona vehevi techillat hatztzihuv shebbaze veshebbaze mahu sefeka have venafek o dilma beriyya have vela nafek
Amar rava ta shema perat litchilat hatztzihuv shebbaze veshebbaze sheppasul i amratte bishlama beriyya have shappir ella i amratte sefeka have itzterich kera lemaote sefeka

a: Ki itzterich kera lemaote nirba veneevad

Salka datach amena hoil uchtiv ki moshchatam bahem mum bam vetana deve rabbi yishmael kal makom shenneemar hashchata eno ella devar erva vaavoda zara devar erva dichtiv ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz

Avoda zara dichtiv pen tashchitun vaasitem lachem pesel kol shehammum posel bo devar erva vaavoda zara poslin bo vechol sheen hammum posel bo en devar erva vaavoda zara poslin bo vehane ofot hoil vela pasel behu muma deamar mar tammut vezachrut bivhema veen tammut vezachrut beofot ema devar erva vaavoda zara name la lifsol behu ka mashma lan
Bae rabbi zera haomer hare alay olat behema min haayil o min hakkeves vehevi palgas mahu
Alliba derabbi yochanan la tibbee lach deamar beriyya have ditnan hikrivo mevi alav niske ayil veen ole lo mizzivcho
Veamar rabbi yochanan o laayil lerabbot et happalgas
Ki tibbee lach alliba devar peda
b: Deamar mayete umatne
Mi amrinan ayil vacheves matne bivriyya la matne o dilma bivriyya name matne deamar i beriyya have leheve kulleh nedava teku
Bae rabbi zera haomer hare alay lachme toda min hechametz o min hammatztza vehevi siur mahu
Siur deman i siur derabbi meir lerabbi yehuda matztza meallayeta hi
I derabbi yehuda lerabbi meir chametz hu
Vei derabbi meir lerabbi meir middelake aleh chametz hu
Ella derabbi yehuda lerabbi yehuda may sefeka have venafek mimma nafshach o dilma beriyya hu vela nafek
Vehaamar rav huna haomer hare alay lachme toda mevi toda velachmah vechevan deichayyav leh betoda velachmah ha la yada hay gavra i chametz hu delayete matztza i matztza hu delayete chametz
La tzericha deamar hare alay challa liftor todato shel peloni
Sof sof ha la yada hay gavra i chametz hu delayete matztza i matztza hu delayete chametz la tzericha dela amar liftor mipak gavra yede nidro nafek o la nafek teku
Matni kasher bappara pasul baegla kasher baegla pasul bappara
Gema tanu rabbanan para bishchita keshera baarifa pesula egla baarifa keshera bishchita pesula nimtza kasher bappara pasul baegla kasher baegla pasul bappara
Uthe para keshera baarifa mikkal vechomer uma egla shello huchshera bishchita huchshera baarifa para shehuchshera bishchita enah din shehuchshera baarifa

a: Amar kera veshachat vechukka bishchita in baarifa la
Vechol hecha dichtiv beh chukka la darshinan kal vachomer veha gabbe yom hakkippurim dichtiv beh chukka vetanya veasahu chattat haggoral ose chattat veen hashshem ose chattat

Sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma bimkom shello kiddesh haggoral kiddesh hashshem mekom shekkiddesh haggoral eno din shekkiddesh hashshem talmud lomar veasahu chattat haggoral ose chattat veen hashshem ose chattat
Tama dichtav rachamana veasahu chattat ha lav hachi darshinan kal vachomer
Maet rachamana gabbe egla haarufa zot baarifa veen acheret baarifa
Uthe egla keshera bishchita mikkal vachomer uma para shello huchshera baarifa keshera bishchita egla shekkeshera baarifa eno din shehuchshera bishchita amar kera vearfu haegla baarifa in bishchita la
Matni kasher bakkohanim pasul balviyyim kasher balviyyim pasul bakkohanim
Gema tanu rabbanan kohanim bemumin pesulim beshanim kesherim leviyyim bemumin kesherim beshanim pesulim nimtza kasher bakkohanim pasul balviyyim kasher balviyyim pasul bakkohanim

Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan zot asher lalviyyim ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar umibben chamishshim shana yashuv lamadnu lalviyyim shehashshanim poslin bahem yachol mumin poslin bahem vedin hu uma kohanim sheen hashshanim poslin bahen mumin poslin bahen leviyyim shehashshanim poslin bahem eno din sheyehu mumin poslin bahem talmud lomar zot asher lalviyyim zot lalviyyim veen acheret lalviyyim

Yachol yehu hakkohanim pesulin beshanim vahalo din hu uma leviyyim sheen mumin poslin bahem shanim poslin bahem kohanim shehammumin poslin bahem eno din sheyehu shanim poslin bahem talmud lomar asher lalviyyim velo asher lakkohanim
Yachol af beshilo uvvet olamim ken talmud lomar laavod avodat avoda vaavodat massa lo amarti ella bizman shehaavoda bakkatef

Katuv echad omer mibben chamesh veesrim shana vamala vechatuv echad omer mibben sheloshim i efshar lomar sheloshim shekkevar neemar chamesh veesrim vei efshar lomar chamesh veesrim shekkevar neemar sheloshim ha ketzad chamesh veesrim letalmud ushloshim laavoda
Mikkan letalmid shello raa siman yafe bemishnato chamesh shanim shuv eno roe rabbi yose omer shalosh shanim shenneemar ulgaddelam shanim shalosh ullammedam sefer ulshon kasdim
Veidach shane leshon kasdim dekallil veidach shane hilchot avoda detakkifin

Tanu rabbanan kohen mishsheyyavi shette searot ad sheyyazkin kasher laavoda umumin poslin bo ben levi mibben sheloshim vead ben chamishshim kasher laavoda veshanim poslin bo bamme devarim amurim beohel moed shebbammidbar aval beshilo uvvet olamim en nifsalin ella bekol amar rabbi yose may kera
b: Vayehi cheechad lamchatztzetzorim velamshorrim lehashmia kol echad
Ad sheyyazkin ad kamma amar rabbi ila amar rabbi chanina ad sheyerattet
Tenan hatam baal keri shettaval velo hetil mayim lichsheyyatil tame rabbi yose omer bechole uvzaken tame beyeled uvvari tahor

Yeled ad kamma amar rabbi ila amar rabbi chanina kol sheomed al raglo achat vecholetz minalo venoel minalo amru alav al rabbi chanina shehaya ben shemonim shana vehaya omed al raglo achat vecholetz minalo venoel minalo amar rabbi chanina chammin vashemen shessachatni immi beyalduti hen amdu li beet ziknuti
Tanu rabbanan nitmalle zekano rauy leasot sheliach tzibur velered lifne hatteva velisa et kappav meematay kasher laavoda mishsheyyavi shette searot rabbi omer omer ani ad sheyehe ben esrim
Amar rav chisda may tama derabbi dichtiv vayyaamidu et halviyyim mibben esrim shana vamala lenatztzeach al melechet bet Adonai veidach lenatztzeach shane
Veha hay kera bilviyyim ketiv kidrabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi beesrim vearbaa mekomot nikreu kohanim leviyyim veze echad mehen vehakkohanim halviyyim bene tzadok

Tanu rabbanan ish mizzaracha ledorotam mikkan amar rabbi elazar katan pasul laavoda vaafilu tam meematay kasher laavoda mishsheyyavi shette searot aval echav hakkohanim en mannichin oto laavod ad sheyehe ben esrim
Ika deamri ha rabbi hi vaafilu pasul derabbanan let leh veika deamri rabbi it leh pasul midderabbanan veha rabbanan hi ulchattechilla hu dela aval diavad avodato keshera
Matni tahor bichli cheres tame bechol hakkelim tahor bechol hakkelim tame bichli cheres
Gema tanu rabbanan avir keli cheres tame vegabbo tahor avir kol hakkelim tahor vegabban tame nimtza tahor bichli cheres tame bechol hakkelim tahor bechol hakkelim tame bichli cheres
Menahane mile detanu rabbanan tocho veaf al pi shello naga

Atta omer af al pi shello naga o eno ella im ken naga rabbi yonatan ben avtulmos omer neemar tocho letamme veneemar tocho litamme ma tocho haamur letamme af al pi shello naga af tocho haamur litamme af al pi shello naga
Vehatam menalan amar rabbi yonatan hattora heida al keli cheres

a: Vaafilu melo chardal

Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava vihe keli cheres mitamme miggabbo mikkal vechomer uma kol hakkelim sheen mitammein meaviran mitammein miggabban keli cheres shemmitamme meaviro eno din sheyetamme miggabbo
Amar kera vechol keli fatuach asher en tzamid patil alav ezehu keli shettumato kodemet lefitcho heve omer ze keli cheres vechi en tzamid patil alav hu detame ha yesh tzemid patil alav tahor
Veyihu kol hakkelim mitammein meaviran mikkal vachomer uma keli cheres sheen mitamme miggabbo mitamme meaviro kol hakkelim shemmitammein miggabban eno din shemmitammein meaviran
Amar kera tocho tocho shel ze velo tocho shel acher
Vehane tocho ha darshinhu
Arbea tocho ketivi tocho toch tocho toch
Chad legufeh vechad ligzera shava vechad tocho shel ze velo tocho shel acher vechad tocho velo toch tocho vaafilu keli shetef

Velo yehu kol hakkelim mitammein miggabban ella mittochan uvingia mikkal vechomer uma keli cheres shemmitamme meaviro eno mitamme miggabbo kol hakkelim sheen mitammein meaviran eno din sheen mitammein miggabban

Amar kera vechol keli fatuach asher en tzamid patil alav tame hu hay hu dechi en tzamid patil alav tame ha yesh tzamid patil alav tahor ha kol hakkelim ben sheyyesh tzamid patil alehem ben sheen tzamid patil alehem mitammein
Matni tahor bichle etz tame bichle mattachot tahor bichle mattachot tame bichle etz
Gema tanu rabbanan golme keli etz temein peshutehen tehorin golme kele mattachot tehorin peshutehen temein nimtza tahor bichle etz tame bichle mattachot tahor bichle mattachot tame bichle etz
Veellu hen golme kele etz kol sheatid lashuf leshabbetz legarer lecharkev lehatiach betunas mechussar kan o ogen o ozen tame mechussar chatita tahor
Mechussar chatita peshita la tzericha dechak kefiza bekabba
Veellu hen golme kele mattachot kol sheatid
b: Lashuf leshabbetz legarer lecharker lehakkish bekurnas mechussar kan o ogen o ozen tahor mechussar kesuy tame
May shena hane umay shena hane rabbi yochanan amar hoil ulchavod asuyin rav nachman amar hoil udmehen yekarim
May benayehu ika benayehu kele etzem veazda rav nachman letameh deamar rav nachman kele etzem kichle mattachot damu

Mikkelal dichle etzem mekabbeli tuma in detanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer ma talmud lomar vechol maase izzim titchattau lehavi davar habba min haizzim min hakkarnayim umin hattelafayim shear behema vechayya minnayin talmud lomar vechol maase im ken ma talmud lomar izzim perat leofot
Matni hachayyav bishkedim hammarim patur bammetukim hachayyav bammetukim patur bammarim
Gema tanu rabbanan shekedim hammarim ketannim chayyavin gedolim peturin metukim gedolim chayyavin ketannim peturin
Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv ze vaze liftur veamri lah ze vaze lechiyyuv amar rabbi ila hora rabbi chanina betzippori kedivre haomer ze vaze liftur
Ulman deamar ze vaze lechiyyuv gedolim lemay chazu amar rabbi yochanan hoil veyachol lemattekan al yede haur
Matni hattemed ad shello hechmitz eno nikach bechesef maaser ufosel et hammikve mishshehechmitz nikach bechesef maaser veeno posel et hammikve
Haachin hashshuttafin keshechayyavin bakkalbon peturin mimmasar behema keshechayyavin bemasar behema peturin min hakkalbon
Gema manni matnitin la rabbi yehuda vela rabbanan detanya hamtammed venatan mayim bammidda umatza kede middato patur verabbi yehuda mechayyev
Manni i rabbanan af al gav dehechmitz i rabbi yehuda af al gav delo hechmitz amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh

a: Beshehechmitz machloket umatnitin rabbi yehuda vechen amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina beshehechmitz machloket
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh temed shellekacho bechesef maaser ulvassof hechmitz kana maaser may tama igallay milta lemafrea defera hu
Ella matnitin dekatane hechmitz in lo hechmitz la dilma i shavkeh hava machmitz amar rabba kesheshshiyyer mimmennu bechos velo hechmitz
Rava amar ha manni rabbi yochanan ben nuri hi ditnan shelosha luggin mayim chaser kurtov shennafal letochan kurtov yayin umarehen kemare yayin venaflu lammikve lo pesaluhu
Shelosha luggin mayim chaser kurtov shennafal letochan kurtov chalav umarehen kemare mayim venaflu lammikve lo pesaluhu
Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer hakkol holech achar hammare
Lav amar rabbi yochanan batar chazuta azlinan hacha name zil batar chazuta vetama vachazuta dehay mayya ninhu
Ufliga derabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar hakkol modim sheen mafrishin alav mimmakom acher ella im ken hechmitz
Kasavar belo hechmitz machloket vead kan la mechayyev rabbi yehuda ella mineh uveh aval mealma la dilma ate leafroshe min hachiyyuv al happetur umin happetur al hachiyyuv
Tanu rabbanan hattemed ad shello hechmitz
b: Mashshiko bammayim mishshehechmitz en mashshiko bemayim amar rava lo shanu ella shettimmedo bemayim tehorim venitmeu aval temeim meikara la
