Ella mevalbeli hacha name mevalbeli
Matni kol makom sheyyesh mecher en kenas vechol makom sheyyesh kenas en mecher

Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi meir aval chachamim amru yesh kenas bimkom mecher detanya ketanna mibbat yom echad ad shettavi shette searot yesh lah mecher veen lah kenas mishshettavi shette searot ad shettivgar yesh lah kenas veen lah mecher divre rabbi meir shehaya rabbi meir omer kol makom sheyyesh mecher en kenas vechol makom sheyyesh kenas en mecher
Vachachamim omrim ketanna mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad ad shettivgar yesh lah kenas
Kenas in mecher la ema af kenas bimkom mecher
Matni kol makom sheyyesh meun en chalitza vechol makom sheyyesh chalitza en meun

Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi meir aval chachamim omrim yesh meun bimkom chalitza detanya ad matay habbat memaenet ad shettavi shette searot divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyirbe hashshachor al hallavan
Matni kol makom sheyyesh tekia en havdala vechol makom sheyyesh havdala en tekia
Yom tov shechal lihot beerev shabbat tokin velo mavdilin bemotzae shabbat mavdilin velo tokin
Ketzad mavdilin hammavdil ben kodesh lekodesh rabbi dosa omer ben kodesh chamur lekodesh hakkal
Gema hechi tokea amar rav yehuda tokea umeria mittoch tekia verav assi amar tokea umeria binshima achat atken rav assi behutzal kishmateh

Metivi yom tov shechal lihot beerev shabbat tokin velo meriin may lav lo meriin kelal la rav yehuda metaretz letameh verav assi metaretz letameh rav yehuda metaretz letameh la meriin bifne atzmah ella mittoch tekia verav assi metaretz letameh la meriin bishte neshimot ella binshima achat
Uvmotzae shabbat ku hecha amar lah amar rav yehuda bachatimatah vechen amar rav nachman bachatimatah
Verav sheshet bereh derav idi amar af biftichatah velet hilcheta kevateh
Rabbi dosa omer ben kodesh chamur lekodesh hakkal velet hilcheta kevateh

Amar rabbi zera yom tov shechal lihot beemtza shabbat omer hammavdil ben kodesh lechol uven or lechoshech uven yisrael laggoyim uven yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase may tama seder havdalot hu mone
Hadaran alach hakkol shochatin

a: Matni hashshochet echad baof ushnayim babbehema shechitato keshera verubbo shel echad kamohu rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyishchot et havveridin chatzi echad beof veechad vachetzi bivhema shechitato pesula rov echad baof verov shenayim babbehema shechitato keshera
Gema hashshochet diavad in lechattechilla la shenayim babbehema lechitchilla la ad kamma lishchot velezil ibaet ema aechad baof veibaet ema arubbo shel echad kamohu

Amar rav kahana minnayin lishchita shehi min hatztzavar shenneemar veshachat et ben habbakar mimmakom sheshshach chattehu mimmay dehay chattehu lishana dedakkoye hu dichtiv vechitte et habbayit veibaet ema mehacha techatteeni veezov veethar
Veema mizzenavo shach mikkelal shezzakuf baenan veha shach veomed hu veema meozno baenan dam hannefesh veleka
Veema dekara veazel ad dam hannefesh vetu shehiyya derasa chalada hagrama veikur menalan ella gemara shechita min hatztzavar name gemara
Ukra lemay ata dela leshavveyah gistera

Middekaamar et harosh shekkevar huttaz mikkelal dishchita min hatztzavar
Vetanna patach berosh ufeder umsayyem berosho ufidro hachi kaamar minnayin lerabbot et harosh shekkevar huttaz talmud lomar et harosh veet happader
Verosho ufidro lema li mibe leh lechidtanya minnayin lerosh ufeder shekkodmin lechol hannetachim talmud lomar et rosho veet pidro vearach
b: Ufeder kamma dichtav rachamana lema li mibe leh lechidtanya ketzad hu ose chofe et happeder al bet hashshechita umaalehu vezehu derech kavod shel mala

Vehay tanna mayete lah mehacha detanya zot torat habbehema vehaof vechi beezo tora shaveta behema laof veof livhema behema metammea bemagga uvmassa of eno metamme bemagga uvmassa of metamme begadim abbet habbelia behema enah metammea begadim abbet habbelia
Beezo tora shaveta behema leof veof livhema lomar lach ma behema bishchita af of bishchita i ma lehallan berov shenayim af kan berov shenayim talmud lomar zot
Rabbi eliezer omer beezo tora shaveta behema leof veof livhema lomar lach ma of hechshero min hatztzavar af behema hechsherah min hatztzavar
I ma lehallan mimmul oref af kan mimmul oref talmud lomar umalak et rosho mimmul orpo velo yavdil rosho shel ze mimmul oref veen rosho shel achar mimmul oref
Verabbi eliezer hay zot may aved leh i lav zot hava amena ma of besiman echad af behema besiman echad ketav rachamana zot

Tane bar kappara zot torat habbehema vehaof hetil hakkatuv leof ben behema ledagim lechayevo bishne simanin i efshar shekkevar hukkash ledagim lefotro belo kelum i efshar shekkevar hukkash livhema ha ketzad hechshero besiman echad
Dagim delav bene shechita ninhu menalan ilema mishshum dichtiv hatzon uvakar yishshachet lahem im et kol dege hayyam yeasef lahem baasifa bealma saggi lehu

Ella meatta gabbe selav dichtiv vayyaasfu et hasselav hachi name delav bishchita veha amratte lefotro bivelo kelum i efshar shekkevar hukkash livhema hatam la ketiva asifa bimkom shechita deacharine hacha ketiva asifa bimkom shechita deacharine

Darash over galilaa behema shennivret min hayyabbasha hechsherah bishne simanim dagim shennivreu min hammayim hechsheran bivelo kelum of shennivra min harkak hechshero besiman echad amar rav shemuel kappotkaa teda shehare ofot yesh lahen kaskeset beraglehem kaddagim

Veod sheelo katuv echad omer vayyomer elohim yishretzu hammayim sheretz nefesh chayya veof yeofef alma mimmayya ibro uchtiv vayyitzer Adonai elohim min haadama kol chayyat hassade veet kol of hashshamayim alma meara ibro
Amar lo min harkak nivreu raa talmidav mistakkelim ze baze amar lahem kashe beenechem sheddachiti et oyevi bekash min hammayim nivreu velamma hevian el haadam likrot lahen shem
Veyesh omrim belashon acher amar leoto hegmon uvallashon harishon amar lahen letalmidav mishshum dichtiv al vayyitzer
Amar rav yehuda mishshum rabbi yitzchak ben pinchas en shechita laof min hattora shenneemar veshafach bishficha bealma saggi
I hachi chayya name itakkash lifsule hammukdashin of name itakkash livhema dichtiv zot torat habbehema vehaof ha ketiv veshafach et damo
Umay chazet deshadet leh al of shadyeh achayya mistabbera mishshum desalek mineh
Siman nitnabbel dam bimlika
Metivi hashshochet venitnabbela beyado hannocher vehamakker patur millechassot vei amratte en shechita laof min hattora nechirato zo hi shechitato live kissuy mi savratte beof la bechayya
Ta shema hashshochet vetzarich laddam chayyav lechassot ketzad hu ose o nocharo o okro

a: May lav beof deka vae leh lidmeh leyanicha la bechayya deka vae leh lidmeh lelakka
Ta shema malak besakkin metamme begadim abbet habbelia vei amratte en shechita laof min hattora nehi name dechi tavar leh shidra umafreket haveya lah terefa tahne lah sakkin letaharah mide nevela
Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya rabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi omer ma talmud lomar ach kaasher yeachel et hatztzevi vego vechi ma lamadnu mitztzevi veayyal meatta
Hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed makkish tzevi veayyal lifsule hammukdashin ma pesule hammukdashin bishchita af tzevi veayyal bishchita veof en lo shechita middivre tora ella middivre sofrim

Man tanna diflig aleh derabbi elazar hakkappar rabbi hi detanya rabbi omer vezavachta kaasher tziviticha melammed shennitztava moshe al haveshet veal hakkane veal rov echad baof veal rov shenayim bivhema

Echad baof itmar rav nachman amar o veshet o kane rav adda bar ahava amar veshet velo kane rav nachman amar o veshet o kane echad katane echad kol dehu rav adda bar ahava amar veshet velo kane may echad meuchad
Siman shachat chatzain gargeret pegima dechattat haof

Metivi shachat et haveshet veachar kach nishmeta haggargeret keshera nishmeta haggargeret veachar kach shachat et haveshet pesula shachat et haveshet venimtzet gargeret shemuta veeno yodea im kodem shechita nishmeta im leachar shechita nishmeta ze haya maase veamru kol safek bishchita pesula veilu shechita begargeret la katane
Mishshum degargeret avida leishtemote
Ta shema shachat shene chatzae simanin beof pesula veen tzarich lomar bivhema rabbi yehuda omer baof ad sheyyishchot et haveshet veet havveridin mishshum deveshet samuch liveridin
Ta shema shachat chatzi gargeret veshaha kede shechita acheret vegamar shechitato keshera may lav beof umay gemarah gemarah legargeret la bivhema umay gemarah gemarah lishchita kullah
Ta shema hare shehaya chatzi kane pagum vehosif alav kol shehu ugmaro shechitato keshera may lav beof umay gemaro gemaro lekane la bivhema umay gemaro gemaro leveshet

Ta shema ketzad molkin chattat haof chotech shidra umafreket belo rov basar ad shemmaggia laveshet o lakkane higgia laveshet o lakkane chotech siman echad verov basar immo uvaola shenayim o rov shenayim teuvta derav adda bar ahava teuvta
May have alah may have alah kidkaamratte dilma shane hatam deika shidra umafreket
May ta shema dehahu bar avaza dahava be rava ata ki memasmas koeh dema amar rava hechi naaved
b: Nishchateh vahadar nivdekeh dilma bimkom nekev kashachet nivdekeh vahadar nishchateh haamar rabba veshet en lo bedika mibbachutz ella mibbifnim
Amar leh rav yosef bereh nivdekeh lekane venishchateh lekane velachshereh vahadar lefcheh leveshet velivdekeh amar rava chakkim yosef beri bitrefot kerabbi yochanan alma echad dekaamar o hay o hay
Rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyishchot amar rav chisda lo amar rabbi yehuda ella beof hoil vetzolehu kullo keechad aval behema kevan dimnattechah ever ever la tzerich
Lememra detama derabbi yehuda mishshum dam hu vehatnan rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyishchot et havveridin
Ema ad sheyenakkev et havveridin umay ad sheyyishchot ad sheyyinkov bishat shechita
Ta shema veridin bishchita divre rabbi yehuda ema veridin tzarich lenakkevan bishat shechita divre rabbi yehuda
Ta shema amru lo lerabbi yehuda meachar shello huzkeru veridin ella lehotzi mehen dam ma li bishchita ma li shello bishchita mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar bishchita
Hachi kaamri lah ma li lenakkevan bishat shechita ma li lenakkevan shello bishat shechita vehu savar bishat shechita ate dam dechayem shello bishat shechita la ate dam dekarir
Bae rabbi yirmeya veridin lerabbi yehuda shaha bahen daras bahen mahu
Amar leh hahu sava hachi amar rabbi elazar veamri lah amar leh hahu sava lerabbi elazar hachi amar rabbi yochanan menakkevan bekotz vehen kesherin
Tanya kevateh derav chisda shachat shene chatzae simanin beof pasul veen tzarich lomar bivhema rabbi yehuda omer beof ad sheyyishchot et haveshet veet havveridin
Chatzi echad beof vechu ittemar rav amar mechetza al mechetza kerov rav kahana amar mechetza al mechetza eno kerov
Rav amar mechetza al mechetza kerov hachi amar leh rachamana lemoshe la teshayyar rubba rav kahana amar mechetza al mechetza eno kerov hachi amar leh rachamana lemoshe shechot rubba
Siman chatzi kattina gargeret pegima
Tenan chatzi echad beof veechad vachatzi babbehema shechitato pesula i amratte mechetza al mechetza kerov ammay pasul ha avad leh rov midderabbanan dilma la ate lemebad palga
Amar rav kattina ta shema chalako lishnayim vehen shavin shenehem temein lefi shei efshar letzamtzem
Ha efshar letzamtzem tehorin ammay tehorin zil hacha ika rubba zil hacha ika rubba
Amar rav pappa tere rubbe bechad mana leka
Ta shema shachat chatzi gargeret veshaha bah

a: Kede shechita acheret ugmarah shechitato keshera vei amratte mechetza al mechetza kerov itarfa lah
Mi savratte bivhema la beof mimma nafshach i mechetza al mechetza kerov ha aved leh rubba i mechetza al mechetza eno kerov la avad velo kelum
Ta shema hare shehaya chatzi kane pagum vehosif alav kol shehu ugmaro shechitato keshera vei amratte mechetza al mechetza kerov terefa haveya
Amar rava shane leinyan terefa devaenan rov hannire laenayim

Amar leh abbaye vela kal dechen hu uma terefa divmashshehu mitarfa hecha devaenan rubba baenan rov hannire laenayim shechita dead deika rubba la mitachshera lo kol shekken devaenan rov hannire laenayim
Ella dechulle alma mechetza al mechetza eno kerov vechi itmar derav udrav kahana leinyan pesach ittemar
Hare shehau yisrael mechetza tehorim umechetza temeim rav amar mechetza al mechetza kerov verav kahana amar mechetza al mechetza eno kerov
Vehatam may tama derav dichtiv ish ish ki yihye tame lanefesh ish nidche veen tzibur nidchin
Rov echad baof tenena chada zimna rubbo shel echad kamohu
Siman

Amar rav hoshaya chada bechullin vachada bekadashim utzricha dei ashmeinan chullin hatam hu desaggi leh berubba mishshum delav ledam hu tzarich aval kadashim dildam hu tzarich ema la tisge leh berubba ad deika kulleh
Vei ashmeinan kadashim mishshum dildam hu tzarich aval chullin dildam la tzerich ema befalga saggi leh ka mashma lan
He bechullin vehe bekadashim
Amar rav kahana mistabbera resha bechullin vesefa bekadashim mimmay middekatane hashshochet vei salka datach resha bekadashim hammolek mibe leh

Ella may sefa bekadashim shechitato keshera melikato keshera mibe leh ha la kashya ayede desalek mibbehema tena name shechitato keshera ella resha mikkede al of kae i salka datach bekadashim hammolek mibe leh
Rav shimi bar ashe amar resha bechullin mehacha dekatane echad beof vei salka datach bekadashim ha ika olat haof devae shene simanim

Ella may sefa bekadashim rov echad beof ha ika olat haof devae shene simanin may rov echad rov kol echad veechad uvdin hu delitne rov shenayim kevan deika chattat desaggi leh bechad siman mishshum hachi la pesika leh

Rav pappa amar resha bechullin mehacha dekatane rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyishchot et havveridin ufligi rabbanan aleh i amratte bishlama bechullin shappir ella i amratte bekadashim ammay peligi rabbanan aleh hu atzmo ledam hu tzarich
Rav ashe amar sefa bekadashim mehacha dekatane hashshochet shene rashin keechad shechitato keshera hashshochet diavad in lechattechilla la
I amratte bishlama bekadashim hayenu dilchattechilla la mishshum detane rav yosef tizbach shello yehe shenayim shochatim zevach echad tizbachuhu shello yehe echad shochet shene zevachim
Veamar rav kahana tizbachehu ketiv ella i amratte bechullin afilu lechattechilla name
Veaf rabbi shimon ben lakish savar resha bechullin vesefa bekadashim deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish meachar sheshshaninu rubbo shel echad kamohu lamma shaninu rov echad beof verov shenayim bivhema
Lefi sheshshaninu heviu lo et hattamid keratzo umerak acher shechitato al yado yachol lo merak yehe pasul lechach shaninu rov echad beof verov shenayim bivhema
Amar mar yachol lo merak yehe pasul
b: Im ken haveya leh avoda beacher vetanya kol avodat yom hakkippurim enan kesherot ella bo

Hachi kaamar yachol yehe pasul midderabbanan desalka datach amena ika pasul midderabbanan lechach shaninu rov echad beof verov shenayim babbehema umeachar daafilu pesula derabbanan leka lema li lemarek mitzva lemarek
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum levi sava enah lishchita ella bassof verabbi yochanan amar yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof
Amar rava hakkol modim hecha deshachat siman echad goy vesiman echad yisrael shehi pesula shehare naase bah maase terefa beyad goy
Beolat haof name hecha demalak siman echad lematta vesiman echad lemala pesula shehare asa bah maase chattat haof lematta
Lo nechleku ella kegon sheshshachat siman echad bachutz vesiman echad bifnim leman deamar yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof michayyav leman deamar enah lishchita ella bassof la michayyav
Amar leh rabba bar shimi mar la amar hachi umannu rav yosef hecha deshachat siman echad bachutz vesiman echad bifnim name pasul shehare asa bah maase chattat haof bachutz
Lo nechleku ella kegon sheshshachat miut simanin bachutz ugmaro bifnim leman deamar yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof michayyav leman deamar enah lishchita ella bassof la michayyav
Metiv rabbi zera kol haasukin bappara mittechilla vead sof metammein begadim ufoslin otah bimlacha acheret
Era bah pesul bishchitatah ben kodem pesulah ben leachar pesulah enah metammea begadim behazzaatah kodem pesulah metammea begadim leachar pesulah enah metammea begadim
Vei amratte yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof liflog name bishchitatah era bah pesul bishchita kodem pesulah metammea begadim leachar pesulah enah metammea begadim
Amar rava nitkalkela shechita kaamratte shane hatam deiggallay milleta lemafrea delav shechita hi kelal
Amar rava i kashya li ha kashya li leman deamar enah lishchita ella bassof liflog behechsherah defara kegon deshachtuha bitre gavre degavra kamma la metammea vegavra batra metammea
Amar rav yosef tere gavre bechad zivcha kaamratte bar mineh dehahu ditnena tizbach shello yehu shenayim shochatin zevach echad tizbachuhu shello yehe echad shochet shene zevachim
Veamar rav kahana tizbachehu ketiv
Amar leh abbaye lav ittemar alah amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi elazar berabbi shimon

a: Setimtaa aval chachamim omrim shenayim shochatim zevach echad
Ulrabbi elazar berabbi shimon name liflog kegon dishchat chad gavra bishne sudarim desudar kamma la metamme vesudar batra metamme ella bifsula defara ka mayere behechsherah la ka mayere
Metiv rav idi bar avin uvammoed lishmo patur shello lishmo chayyav
Vehavenan bah tama deshello lishmo ha setama patur
Veammay patur pesach bishar yemot hashshana shelamim hu shema minah pesach bishar yemot hashshana bae akira
Veamar rabbi chiyya bar gammada nizreka mippi chavura veamru hacha bemay askinan kegon shehau bealim temee metim denidchin lefesach sheni distama lishmo kae vehay hu devae akira ha acher la bae akira

I amratte bishlama yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof ipsil leh mittechillat shechita ella i amratte enah lishchita ella bassof kevan dishchat beh purta idchi leh mippesach idach ki ka shachet shelamim ka shachet
Amar leh abbaye nehi deidchi leh mippesach middeme fesach mi idchi
Vechi tema bae haamada vehaaracha vehatnan shachat bah shenayim o rov shenayim vaadayin hi mefarkeset hare hi kechayya lechol devareha
Amar rav yehuda amar rav hashshochet bishnayim ushlosha mekomot shechitato keshera ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li baenan shechita meforaat veleka
Veaf rabbi shimon ben lakish savar baenan shechita meforaat deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish minnayin lashshechita shehi meforaat shenneemar chetz shachut leshonam mirma dibber
Metiv rabbi elazar shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin afilu echad millemala veechad millematta shechitato keshera ammay veha leka shechita meforaat
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya mishnatenu besakkin echad ushne bene adam

Amar leh rabbi abba i hachi hayenu detane alah en choshshin shemma yitrefu ze al ze i amratte bishlama bishte sakkinin ushne bene adam shappir mahu detema lechush dilma samchi ahadade vehay la ate lemebad rubba vehay la ate lemebad rubba ka mashma lan deen choshshin
Ella i amratte besakkin achat ushne bene adam hay en choshshin shemma yitrefu ze al ze shemma yidrosu ze al ze mibe leh
Amar leh rabbi avin teni en choshshin
b: Shemma yidrosu ze al ze
Metiv rabbi avin shachat et haveshet lematta veet hakkane lemala o et haveshet lemala veet hakkane lematta shechitato keshera ammay veha leka shechita meforaat
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah bishchita haasuya kekulmos
Hahu tora deishchat bishnayim ushlosha mekomot al rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta shekal mishufre shufre amar leh rabbi zera limmadtanu rabbenu mishnatenu bishne sakkinin ushne bene adam
Amar rav yehuda amar rav hechlid et hassakkin ben siman lesiman ufsako pesula tachat haor keshera
May ka mashma lan tenena o shehechlid et hassakkin tachat hashsheni ufsako rabbi yeshevav omer nevela rabbi akiva omer terefa
I mimmatnitin hava amena hane mile millematta lemala dela kaaved kederech shechita aval millemala lematta dekaaved kederech shechita ema shappir dame ka mashma lan
Tachat haor keshera be rav amri tachat haor eni yodea
Ibaya lehu leve rav deamri tachat haor eni yodea tachat matlet mahu tachat tzemer mesubbach mahu teku
Bae rav pappa hechlid bemiut simanim mahu teku

Matni hashshochet shene rashin keechad shechitato keshera shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatim afilu echad lemala veechad lematta shechitato keshera hittiz et harosh bevat achat pesula haya shochet vehittiz et harosh bevat achat im yesh bassakkin melo tzavar keshera

Haya shochet vehittiz shene rashin bevat achat im yesh bassakkin melo tzavar echad keshera bamme devarim amurim bizman sheholich velo hevi o hevi velo holich aval im holich vehevi afilu kol shehu afilu beizmel keshera
Gema menahane mile amar shemuel deamar kera chetz shachut leshonam mirma dibber
Tana deve rabbi yishmael veshachat en veshachat ella umashach vechen hu omer zahav shachut veomer chetz shachut leshonam mirma dibber
May veomer vechi tema zahav shachut shennitve kechut hu ta shema chetz shachut leshonam
Rava hava badek leh gira lerabbi yona bar tachlifa veshachat beh ofa bahade defarach vedilma avid chalada chazinan

a: Gidfe demiparmi

Veha bae kissuy vechi tema dimchassu leh vehaamar rabbi zera amar rav hashshochet tzarich sheyyitten afar lematta veafar lemala shenneemar vechissahu beafar afar lo neemar ella beafar melammed shehashshochet tzarich sheyyitten afar lematta veafar lemala
Demazmen leh leafar dechullah pitka
Haya shochet vehittiz amar rabbi zera melo tzavar vechutz latztzavar
Ibaya lehu melo tzavar vechutz latztzavar kimlo tzavar dahao lah tere tzavare o dilma male tzavar vechutz latztzavar mashshehu

Ta shema haya shochet vehittiz shene rashin bevat achat im yesh lassakkin melo tzavar echad kasher may melo tzavar echad ilema melo tzavar echad vetu la hashta bivhema achat baenan melo tzavar vechutz latztzavar bishte behemot saggi lehu kimlo tzavar echad ella peshita melo tzavar chutz lishne tzavarin
Shema minah melo tzavar chutz latztzavar shema minah
Bamme devarim amurim bizman sheholich velo hevi vechu amar rav menashshe beizmel sheen lo karnayim
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav menashshe machta may amar leh machta mivza baza
Machta deushkafe may amar leh tenena afilu kol shehu may lav machta deushkafe la izmel izmel behedya katane lah paroshe ka mefaresh may kol shehu izmel

Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach machta deushkafe hashta machta deushkafe sharya izmel mibaya izmel itztericha leh salka datach amena ligzar izmel sheen lo karnayim attu izmel sheyyesh lo karnayim ka mashma lan
Matni nafla sakkin veshachata af al pi sheshshachata kedarkah pesula shenneemar vezavachta veachalta ma sheatta zoveach atta ochel
Gema tama denafla ha hippilah hu keshera veaf al gav dela mikaven

Man tanna dela baenan kavana lishchita amar rava rabbi natan hi detane oshaya zeera demin chavrayya zarak sakkin lenootzah bakkotel vehalcha veshachata kedarkah rabbi natan machshir vachachamim poslim hu tane lah vehu amar lah halacha kerabbi natan
Veha amrah rava chada zimna ditnan vechullan sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan shechitatan keshera veamrinan man tanna dela bae kavana lishchita veamar rava rabbi natan hi
Tzericha dei ashmeinan hatam mishshum deka mikaven leshum chaticha beolam aval hacha dela ka mikaven ema la
Vei ashmeinan hacha mishshum dekaate mikkoach ben daat aval hatam dela kaate mikkoach ben daat ema la tzericha
Ittemar nidda shenneensa vetavla amar rav yehuda amar rav tehora levetah vaasura leechol bitruma verabbi yochanan amar af levetah lo tahara
Amar leh rava lerav nachman lerav deamar tehora levetah vaasura leechol bitruma aon karet huttera hittarta isur mita mibaya

Amar leh balah chullin hu vechullin la bae kavana umna temra ditnan gal shennitlash uvo arbaim sea venafal al haadam veal hakkelim tehorin may lav adam dumya dechelim ma kelim dela mikavveni af adam name la bae kavana
Mimmay dilma beoshev umtzappe askinan ematay yittalesh haggal
b: Vechelim dumya deadam ma adam devaenan kavana af kelim name deka mechaven lehu adam
Vechi tema beoshev umtzappe may lememra
Mahu detema ligzar mishshum chardalit shel geshamim i name ligzar rashin attu kipin ka mashma lan dela gazrinan
Umna temra dela matbelinan bechipin ditnan matbilin berashin veen matbilin bechipin sheen matbilin baavir
Ella chullin dela bae kavana miha menalan ditnan perot shennaflu letoch ammat hammayim ufashat mi sheyyadav temeot untalan yadav tehorot uferot enan bechi yuttan
Veim bishvil sheyyudchu yadav tehorot uferot bechi yuttan
Etiveh rava lerav nachman taval lechullin vehuchzak lechullin asur lemaaser huchzak in lo huchzak la
Hachi kaamar af al pi shehuchzak lechullin asur lemaaser
Etiveh taval velo huchzak keilu lo taval may lav keilu lo taval kelal
La keilu lo taval lemaaser aval taval lechullin hu savar dachoye ka medache leh nefak dak veashkach detanya taval velo huchzak muttar lachullin veasur lammaaser
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef lema tehve teuvta derabbi yochanan meha
Amar leh rabbi yochanan hu deamar kerabbi yonatan ben yosef
Detanya rabbi yonatan ben yosef omer vechubbas ma talmud lomar shenit makkish tichboset sheniyya letichboset rishona ma tichboset rishona ledaat af tichboset sheniyya ledaat
I ma lehallan baenan daat kohen af kan baenan daat kohen talmud lomar vetaher mikkol makom
Matkef lah rav shimi bar ashe umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna

Utnan nafla sakkin veshachata af al pi sheshshachata kedarkah pesula vehavenan bah tama denafla ha hippilah hu keshera veaf al gav dela mikaven veamrinan man tanna dela bae kavana lishchita amar rava rabbi natan hi
Bishchita afilu rabbi yonatan ben yosef mode middegalli rachamana mitassek bekadashim pasul mikkelal dechullin la baenan kavana
Verabbanan nehi dela baenan kavana lizvicha lachaticha baenan
Amar rava beha zechanhu rabbi natan lerabbanan mi ketiv vechatachta vezavachta ketiv i baenan kavana lachaticha afilu lizvicha name live i la baenan kavana lizvicha lachaticha name la live
Hechi dame nidda shenneensa vetavla ilema deansah chavirtah veatbelah kavana dachavirtah kavana meallayeta hi
Veod bitruma name achla ditnan hachereshet vehashshota vehassoma veshennitrefa datah im yesh lahen pikkechot metakkenot otan ochlot bitruma
Amar rav pappa lerabbi natan shennafla min haggesher ulrabbanan sheyyarda lehaker
Amar rava shachat para veshachat behema acheret immah ledivre hakkol pesula

a: Nishchata behema acheret immah lerabbi natan para pesula behema keshera lerabbanan para keshera behema pesula

Peshita nishchata behema acheret lerabbi natan itztericha leh salka datach amena veshachat otah amar rachamana velo otah vachavertah vehechi dame kegon sheshshachat shette parot bahade hadade aval behema dechullin ema la ka mashma lan
Chatach dallaat immah divre hakkol pesula nechtecha dallaat immah divre hakkol keshera
Matni nafla sakkin vehigbihah naflu kelav vehigbihan hishchiz et hassakkin veaf ba chavero veshachat im shaha kede shechita pesula rabbi shimon omer im shaha kede vikur
Gema may kede shechita amar rav kede shechitat behema acheret
Amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav kede shechitat behema livhema veof leof o dilma af behema leof
Amar lehu la hava bedichna beh bechabbivi deeshayeleh
Ittemar amar rav kede shechitat behema livhema veof leof ushmuel amar afilu behema leof vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan afilu behema leof
Rabbi chananya amar kede sheyyavi behema acheret veyishchot yavi afilu mealma natatta devarecha leshiurin
Amar rav pappa omedet lehattil ika benayehu
Amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina kede sheyyagbihenna veyarbitzenna veyishchot dakka ledakka vegassa legassa
Amar rava hashshochet besakkin raa afilu kol hayyom kullo keshera
Bae rava shehiyyot mahu sheyyitztarfu
Vetifshot lah middideh hatam bidla sheha
Bae rav huna bereh derav natan shaha bemiut simanin mahu teku
Rabbi shimon omer im shaha kede vikur may kede vikur amar rabbi yochanan kede bikuro shel chacham im ken natatta devarecha leshiurin ella kede bikur tabbach chacham

Matni shachat et haveshet ufasak et haggargeret o fasak et haggargeret veachar kach shachat et haveshet o shachat echad mehen vehimtin lah ad shemmeta o shehechlid et hassakkin tachat hashsheni ufsako rabbi yeshevav omer nevela rabbi akiva omer terefa
Kelal amar rabbi yeshevav mishshum rabbi yehoshua kol shennifsela bishchitatah nevela kol sheshshechitatah karauy vedavar acher garam lah lipasel terefa vehoda lo rabbi akiva
Gema shachat et haveshet vechu vehoda lo rabbi akiva urminhi ellu terefot babbehema
b: Nekuvat haveshet ufsukat haggargeret
Amar rava la kashya kan sheshshachat ulvassof pasak kan sheppasak ulvassof shachat shachat ulvassof pasak nifselet bishchita hi pasak ulvassof shachat ki davar acher garam lah lipasel damya
Etiveh rav acha bar huna lerava shachat et haveshet ufasak et haggargeret pasak et haggargeret veachar kach shachat et haveshet nevela
Ema uchvar shachat et haveshet meikara
Amar leh shette teshuvot baddavar chada dehayenu kammayeta veod ha tenan veachar kach
Ella amar rava ellu asurot katane veyesh mehen nevelot veyesh mehen terefot
Velichshov name dechizkiyya deamar chizkiyya asaah gistera nevela velichshov name derabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar nittela yarech vechalal shellah nevela
Ki katane nevela dela metammea mechayyim aval nevela dimtammea mechayyim la katane

Rabbi shimon ben lakish amar kan sheshshachat bimkom chatach kan sheshshachat shello bimkom chatach shachat bimkom chatach nifsela bishchita hi shello bimkom chatach ki davar acher garam lah lipasel damya

Umi amar rabbi shimon ben lakish hachi vehaamar rabbi shimon ben lakish shachat et hakkane veachar kach nikva harea keshera alma keman demannecha bedikula damya hacha name keman demannecha bedikula damya
Ella amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan la kashya kan kodem chazara kan leachar chazara umishna lo zaza mimmekomah
Gufa amar rabbi shimon ben lakish shachat et hakkane veachar kach nikva harea keshera amar rava la amar rabbi shimon ben lakish ella berea hoil vechayye rea teluyin bakkane aval bivne meayim la
Matkef lah rabbi zera meachar shennoldu bah simane terefa hittarta ma li berea ma li bivne meayim
Vahadar beh rabbi zera devae rabbi zera nikvu bene meayim ben siman lesiman mahu mi mitztaref siman rishon lesiman sheni letaharah mide nevela o la
Veamrinan lav hayenu devae ilfa hotzi ubbar et yado ben siman lesiman mahu

a: Mi mitztaref siman rishon lesiman sheni letaharah mide nevela o la
Ad kan la ibaya lan ella letaharah mide nevela aval baachila asura
Amar leh rav acha bar rav leravina dilma leolam la hadar beh verabbi zera lidvarav derava kaamar veleh la sevira leh
Amar rav acha bar yaakov shema minah midderabbi shimon ben lakish mezammenin yisrael al bene meayin veen mezammenin goy al bene meayin
May tama yisrael devishchita talya milta kevan deika shechita meallayeta ishteri lehu goyim devinchira saggi lehu uvmita talya milta hane keever min hachay damu
Amar rav pappa hava yatevna kammeh derav acha bar yaakov uvay deema leh mi ika mide dilyisrael shere ulgoyim asur vela amari leh deamena ha tama kaamar

Tanya dela kerav acha bar yaakov harotze leechol mibbehema kodem shettetze nafshah chotech kezayit basar mibbet hashshechita umolcho yafe yafe umdicho yafe yafe umamtin lah ad shettetze nafshah veochlo echad goy veechad yisrael muttarin bo

Mesayya leh lerav idi bar avin deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan harotze sheyyavri chotech kezayit basar mibbet shechitatah shel behema umolcho yafe yafe umdicho yafe yafe umamtin lah ad shettetze nafshah echad goy veechad yisrael muttarin bo
Matni hashshochet behema chayya vaof velo yatza mehen dam kesherim veneechalin beyadayim mesoavot lefi shello huchsheru baddam rabbi shimon omer huchsheru bashshechita
Gema tama delo yatza mehen dam ha yatza mehen dam en neechalim beyadayim mesoavot ammay yadayim sheniyyot hen veen sheni ose shelishi bechullin
Umimmay divchullin askinan dekatane chayya deilu kadashim chayya bekadashim mi ika vetu i bekadashim ki lo yatza mehen dam keshera hu atzmo laddam hu tzarich

Vetu i bekadashim ki yatza mehen dam mi machshir vehaamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan minnayin ledam kadashim sheeno machshir shenneemar al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim dam shennishpach kammayim machshir sheeno nishpach kammayim eno machshir
Vetu i bekadashim ki lo yatza mehem dam la mittachsheri litachsheri litachsheru bechibat hakkodesh dekayema lan chibat hakkodesh machshartan
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh hacha bechullin shellekachan bechesef maaser askinan udla kerabbi meir ditnan
b: Kol hattaun biat mayim middivre sofrim metamme et hakkodesh ufosel et hatteruma umuttar bachullin uvammaaser divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim osrim bammaaser
Matkef lah rav shimi bar ashe mimmay dilma ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi meir ella baachilat maaser aval bingia demaaser vaachila dechullin la peligi
Veha negia hi middekatane neechalin beyadayim mesoavot mi la askinan deka safe leh chavreh

Ella amar rav pappa hacha beyadayim techillot askinan verabbi shimon ben elazar hi detanya en yadayim techillot lachullin rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir yadayim techillot lachullin ushniyyot latteruma
Techillot lechullin in litruma la hachi kaamar techillot af lechullin sheniyyot litruma in lechullin la
Umi ika yadayim techillot in detanya hichnis yadav levayit hamnugga yadav techillot divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim yadav sheniyyot
Dechulle alma bia bemiktzat lo shemah bia vehacha bigzera yadav attu gufo ka mipalgi
Mar savar yadav kegufo shavinhu rabbanan umar savar yadayim keyadayim dealma shavinhu rabbanan
Velokmah kerabbi akiva deamar yadav techillot haveyan dilma ki kaamar rabbi akiva hane mile bitruma vekadashim dachamiri aval lechullin sheniyyot haveyan
Veliheveyan name sheniyyot deha shaminan leh lerabbi akiva deamar sheni ose shelishi bechullin
Ditnan bo beom darash rabbi akiva vechol keli cheres vego yitma tame lo neemar ella yitma letamme acherim limed al kikkar sheni shehu ose shelishi bechullin
Dilma hane mile betuma deorayeta aval bidrabbanan la
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya hacha bechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh askinan udla kerabbi yehoshua detanya rabbi eliezer omer haochel ochel rishon rishon sheni sheni shelishi shelishi
Rabbi yehoshua omer haochel ochel rishon vesheni sheni shelishi sheni lakkodesh veen sheni latteruma
Bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma
Al tohorat teruma in al tohorat hakkodesh la kasavar chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh let behu shelishi
Velokmah

a: Bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma verabbi yehoshua la salka datach dekatane basar dei bitruma basar mi ika
Ella may bekadashim chayya bekadashim mi ika basar bevasar michallaf basar befere la michallaf
Amar ulla chavrayya amrin bechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh udla kerabbi yehoshua
Vaana amena rabbi yehoshua hi vela mibaya kaamar la mibaya chullin shennaasu al tohorat kodesh dachamiri deit behu shelishi ella afilu chullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma name it behu shelishi
Man chavrayya rabba bar bar chana hi deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan may ahdaru rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua lahadade
Amar lo rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua matzinu ochel chamur min haochel deilu nivlat of tahor bachutz lo metamme veilu ochlah metamme begadim abbet habbelia veanu heach lo naase ochel kammaachal
Verabbi yehoshua minnivlat of tahor la gamrinan dechidush hu ella matzinu shehammaachal chamur min haochel deilu maachal bichvetza veochel ad deachel kachatzi feras veanu heach naase ochel kammaachal
Verabbi eliezer tuma mishshiurin la gamrinan veod lidvarecha sheatta omer al rishon sheni yafe atta omer sheni sheni lema
Amar lo matzinu shehashsheni ose sheni al yede mashkin
Amar lo veha mashkin name techilla hau ditnan kol happosel bitruma metamme mashkin lihot techilla chutz mittevul yom
Veod shelishi sheni lama
Amar lo af ani lo amarti ella bitruma shettohoratah
b: Tuma hi etzel hekdesh
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi yannay haochel shelishi shel chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh naasa gufo sheni lakkodesh
Etiveh rabbi zera lerabbi assi shelishi sheni lakkodesh veen sheni latteruma bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma al tohorat teruma in al tohorat hakkodesh la
Amar leh la mibaya kaamar
Veha af ani lo amarti ella bitruma kaamar amorae ninhu vealliba derabbi yochanan
Amar ulla haochel shelishi shel chullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma nifsal gufo milleechol bitruma
May ka mashma lan tenena shelishi sheni lakkodesh veen sheni latteruma bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma sheni hu dela have ha shelishi have
I mehahi hava amena la sheni have vela shelishi have veayede deamar sheni bakkodesh amar name en sheni bitruma ka mashma lan
Etiveh rav hamnuna leulla harishon shebbachullin tame umtamme vehashsheni posel veeno metamme vehashshelishi neechal binzid haddema
Vei amratte nifsal gufo milleechol bitruma safenan leh mide defasel leh legufeh amar leh hannach linzid haddema

a: Deleka kezayit bichde achilat peras
Amar rabbi yonatan amar rabbi haochel shelishi shel teruma atzmah asur leechol umuttar liga

Veitzterich deulla veitzterich derabbi yonatan dei middeulla hava amena hane mile bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma aval teruma bingia name asur itzterich derabbi yonatan vei midderabbi yonatan hava amena hane mile teruma aval chullin baachila name shere tzerichi

Yatev rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta kammeh derav nachman veyatev vekaamar haochel shelishi shel chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh tahor leechol bakkodesh sheen lecha davar sheose revii bakkodesh ella kodesh mikkodesh bilvad
Metiv rame bar chama shelishi sheni lakkodesh veen sheni latteruma bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma ammay ha lav kodesh mikkodesh hu
Amar leh hannach litruma shettohoratah tuma hi etzel hakkodesh
Umna temra ditnan bigde am haaretz midras lifrushin bigde ferushin midras leochle teruma bigde ochle teruma midras lakkodesh
Amar rava midrasot kaamratte shane midrasot
b: Shemma teshev alehen ishto nidda aval befere la amrinan verabbi yitzchak befere name amar

Metiv rabbi yirmeya middifti umi amrinan befere vehatnan im amar hifrashti letochah reviit kodesh neeman vela ka metammeya leh teruma lekodesh vei amratte tohoratah tuma hi etzel hakkodesh tetamme teruma lekodesh
Amar leh tuma bechibburin kaamratte tuma bechibburin shane demiggo dimheman akkodesh meheman name atteruma
Metiv rav huna bar natan hashsheni shebbachullin metamme mashke chullin ufosel ochle teruma vehashshelishi metamme mashke kodesh ufosel ochle kodesh bechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh
Tannae hi detanya chullin shennaasu al tohorat kodesh hare hen kechullin
Rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer hare hen kitruma letamme shenayim velifsol echad
Rabbi shimon omer huchsheru bishchita amar rav assi omer haya rabbi shimon shechitato machsheret velo dam
Lema mesayya leh rabbi shimon omer huchsheru bishchita may lav bishchita vela bedam la af bishchita
Ta shema amar lahen rabbi shimon vechi haddam machshir vahalo shechita machsheret hachi kaamar lahen vechi dam bilvad machshir af shechita name machsheret
Ta shema rabbi shimon omer dam hammet eno machshir may lav ha dam shechita machshir la ha dam chalalim machshir aval dam shechita may la machshir
Lashmeinan dam shechita vechol shekken dam hammet dam hammet itztericha leh salka datach amena ma li katleh ihu ma li katleh malach hammavet ka mashma lan
Ta shema rabbi shimon omer dam maggefato eno machshir may lav ha dam shechita machshir la ha dam chalalim machshir aval dam shechita may la machshir
Lashmeinan dam shechita vechol shekken dam maggefato dam maggefato itztericha leh salka datach amena ma li katleh kulleh ma li katleh palga
Umay shena dam chalalim demachshar dichtiv vedam chalalim yishte
Dam shechita name ketiv al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim hahu lemishre daman difsule hammukdashin bahanaa hu daata

a: Salka datach amena hoil vaasiri begiza vaavoda daman live kevura kamashma lan
Tana deve rabbi yishmael vedam chalalim yishte perat ledam kiluach sheeno machshir et hazzeraim
Tanu rabbanan hashshochet vehittiz dam al haddallaat rabbi omer huchshar rabbi chiyya omer tolin
Amar rabbi oshaya meachar sherabbi omer huchshar verabbi chiyya omer tolin anu al mi nismoch bou venismoch al divre rabbi shimon shehaya rabbi shimon omer shechita machsheret velo dam

Amar rav pappa hakkol modim hecha deiteh ledam mittechilla vead sof kulle alma la peligi demachshar ki peligi benitkanneach haddam ben siman lesiman rabbi savar yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof vehay dam shechita hu
Rabbi chiyya savar enah lishchita ella bassof vehay dam makka hu umay tolin tolin haddavar ad gemar shechita i iteh ledam besof shechita machshir vei la lo machshir
Umay bou venismoch al divre rabbi shimon lerabbi shimon lo machshir lerabbi chiyya machshir
Benitkanneach mihu asho lahadade mar la machshir umar la machshir hava leh rabbi chad veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim
Rav ashe amar tolin leolam mashma venitkanneach lerabbi chiyya sappoke mesappeka leh i yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof o enah lishchita ella bassof umay tolin lo ochlin velo sorfin
Umay bou venismoch al divre rabbi shimon lerabbi shimon lo machshir lerabbi chiyya sefeka leinyan serefa mihu shau lahadade ulmar la sarfinan ulmar la sarfinan
Have leh rabbi chad veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim vehachi kaamar kegon zot tolin lo ochlin velo sorfin
Bae rabbi shimon ben lakish tzarid shel menachot monin bo rishon vesheni o en monin bo rishon vesheni ki mahneya chibbat hakkodesh leippesole gufeh lemimne beh rishon vesheni la o dilma la shena
Amar rabbi elazar ta shema mikkol haochel asher yeachel vego ochel habba bemayim huchshar ochel sheeno ba bemayim lo huchshar
Attu rabbi shimon ben lakish let leh ochel habba bemayim rabbi shimon ben lakish hachi kamibaya leh chibbat hakkodesh keochel habba bemayim dame o la
Rabbi elazar name miyyitture kerae kaamar mikkede ketiv vechi yuttan mayim al zera mikkol haochel asher yeachel lema li
b: Lav lemaote chibat hakkodesh la chad betumat met vechad betumat sheretz
Utzrichi dei ashmeinan tumat met hatam hu devae hechsher mishshum dela metamme bechaadasha aval sheretz dimtamme bechaadasha ema la live hechsher
Vei ashmeinan sheretz mishshum dela metamme tumat shiva aval met dimtamme tumat shiva ema la live hechsher tzericha
Metiv rav yosef rabbi shimon omer huchsheru bishchita huchsheru vaafilu lemimne behu rishon vesheni
Ammay veha lav ochel habba bemayim hu amar leh abbaye asauhu kehechsher mayim midderabbanan

Amar rabbi zera ta shema habbotzer legat shammay omer huchshar hillel omer lo huchshar ushtek leh hillel leshammay ammay veha lav ochel habba bemayim hu amar leh abbaye asauhu kehechsher mayim midderabbanan

Amar leh rav yosef amena lach ana huchsheru bishchita veatte amratte li asauhu kehechsher mayim veamar lach rabbi zera vaamarte leh asauhu kehechsher mayim lerabbi shimon ben lakish name asauhu kehechsher mayim
Amar leh attu rabbi shimon ben lakish litlot kamibaya leh ki ka mibaya leh lisrof
Mikkelal dechibat hakkodesh deorayeta mena lan ilema middichtiv vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame hay basar deittachshar bemay

Ilema deittachshar bedam vehaamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan minnayin ledam kadashim sheeno machshir shenneemar lo tochlennu al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim dam hannishpach kammayim machshir sheeno nishpach kammayim eno machshir

Ella deitachshar bemashke bet matbechayya veha amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mashke bet matbechayya lo dayyan shehen dechan ella sheen machshirin vechi tema targemah addam veha mashke kaamar ella lav deittachshar bechibbat hakkodesh
Vedilma kidrav yehuda amar shemuel deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel kegon shehayeta lo para shel zivche shelamim veheevirah bannachal shechatah vaadayin mashke tofeach aleha
Ella missefa vehabbasar lerabbot etzim ulvona etzim ulvona bene achila ninhu ella chibbat hakkodesh machshera lehu umshavveya lehu ochel hacha name chibbat hakkodesh machshartan

a: May ki mahneya chibbat hakkodesh lifsula degufeh aval lemimne beh rishon vesheni la o dilma la shena teku

Matni hashshochet et hamsukkenet rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ad shettefarkes bayyad uvaregel rabbi eliezer omer dayyah im zinka amar rabbi shimon hashshochet ballayela ulmachar hishkim umatza ketalim meleim dam keshera shezzinka uchmiddat rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim ad shettefarkes o vayyad o varegel o ad shettechashkesh biznavah

Echad behema dakka veechad behema gassa behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechzira pesula sheenah ella hotzaat nefesh bilvad bamme devarim amurim shehayeta bechezkat mesukkenet aval im hayeta bechezkat beria afilu en bah echad mikkol hassimanim hallalu keshera
Gema mesukkenet mimmay desharya umimmay tisak addatin daasira dichtiv zot hachayya asher tochlu chayya echol vesheenah chayya lo tochal veha mesukkenet enah chayya
Middeamar rachamana nevela lo tochel mikkelal dimsukkenet sharya dei salka datach mesukkenet asira hashta mechayyim asira leachar mita mibe

Vedilma hayenu nevela hayenu mesukkenet la salka datach dichtiv vechi yamut min habbehema asher hi lachem leochla hannogea benivlatah leachar mita hu dekaryah rachamana nevela mechayyim la ikkeray nevela
Vedilma leolam ema lach hayenu nevela hayenu mesukkenet mechayyim baase leachar mita belav
Ella middeamar rachamana terefa lo tochal mikkelal dimsukkenet sharya dei salka datach mesukkenet asira hashta mesukkenet dela mechassera asira terefa mibaya
Vedilma hayenu terefa hayenu mesukkenet velaavor alav baase velo taase im ken nevela dichtav rachamana lema li uma mechayyim kae alah belav vaase leachar mita mibaya
Vedilma hayenu nevela hayenu terefa hayenu mesukkenet velaavor alav bishne lavin vaase

Ella mehacha vechelev nevela vechelev terefa yease lechol melacha veachol lo tochluhu veamar mar lemay hilcheta amra hattora yavo isur nevela veyachul al isur chelev yavo isur terefa veyachul al isur chelev
b: Vei salka datach terefa hayenu mesukkenet lichtov rachamana chelev nevela yease lechol melacha vechelev terefa lo tochluhu vaana amena uma mechayyim ate isur terefa chayel aisur chelev leachar mita mibaya
Ella middichtav rachamana nevela mikkelal ditrefa lav hayenu mesukkenet

Matkef lah mar bar rav ashe vedilma leolam ema lach hayenu terefa hayenu mesukkenet udkaamratte nevela dichtav rachamana lema li lehach nevela dela atya mikkoach mesukkenet vehechi dame sheasaah gistera hatam name i efshar dela havay mesukkenet purta mikkamme delifsok lerubba
Veibaet ema im ken lema chelev nevela utrefa chelev chelev lema li zo hi sheen chelbah chaluk mibbesarah veyesh lecha acheret shechelbah chaluk mibbesarah veezo zo mesukkenet
Veibaet ema mehacha vaomar ahah Adonai elohim hinne nafshi lo metummaa unvela utrefa lo achalti minneuray vead atta velo va befi besar piggul

Hinne nafshi lo metummaa shello hirharti bayyom lavo lide tuma ballayela unvela utrefa lo achalti minneuray shello achalti besar kos kos meolam velo va befi besar piggul shello achalti mibbehema shehora bah chacham mishshum rabbi natan amru shello achalti mibbehema shello hurmu mattenoteha
I amratte bishlama sharya hayenu revuteh dichezkel ella i amratte asira may revuteh dichezkel
Hechi dame mesukkenet amar rav yehuda amar rav kol shemmaamidin otah veenah omedet rav chanina bar shelemya mishshemeh derav amar afilu ochelet bekaiyyot rame bar yechezkel amar afilu ochelet korot
Besura matne hachi befumbedita matne hachi hechi damya mesukkenet amar rav yehuda amar rav kol shemmaamidin otah veenah omedet vaafilu ochelet bekaiyyot rame bar yechezkel amar afilu ochelet korot
Ashkechinhu shemuel letalmidi derav amar lehu may amar rav bimsukkenet amaru leh hachi amar rav

a: Goa vehetila rei vechishkesha beoznah hare ze pirkus amar lehu itztericha leh leabba leozoze unne sheani omer kol sheenah osa devarim shehammeta osa
May ninhu devarim shehammeta osa amar rav anan ledidi mipparsha li mineh demar shemuel hayeta yadah kefufa ufshatatta davar shehammeta ose peshuta uchfafatta devarim sheen hammeta osa
May ka mashma lan tenena behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechzira pesula sheenah ella hotzaat nefesh ha hechzira keshera
I mimmatnitin hava amena daveka dechayefa ufashta vahadar kayefa lah aval peshuta uchfafatta la ka mashma lan

Metivi rabbi yose omer haya rabbi meir omer goa bishat shechita en ze pirkus rabbi elazar berabbi yose omer mishshemo afilu hetila rei vechishkesha biznavah en ze pirkus kashya goa aggoa kashya rei arei
Goa aggoa la kashya ha deave kalah ha deame kalah rei arei name la kashya kan beshotetet kan bematrezet
Amar rav chisda pirkus sheamru besof shechita may besof shechita beemtza shechita leappoke techillat shechita dela
Amar rav chisda mena amena lah ditnan behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechzira pesula emat ilema besof shechita kol hachi teche vetezil ella lav beemtza shechita
Amar leh rava leolam besof shechita sheani omer kol sheenah ose ken besof shechita beyadua shennishmatah netula hemenna kodem lachen
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar pirkus sheamru bitchillat shechita

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mena amena lah ditnan amar rabbi shimon hashshochet ballayela ulmachar matza ketalim meleim dam keshera shezzinka uchmiddat rabbi eliezer veamar shemuel kotle bet shechita shaninu i amratte bishlama bitchillat shechita shappir ella i amratte besof shechita lechush dilma bitchillat shechita zinka
Vedilma shane zinuk daadif
Umi adif vehatnan rabbi eliezer omer dayyah im zinka kal midderabban gamliel vaadif midderabbanan
Amar ravina amar li samma bar chilkay akshi bah avuh devar abbuvram veamri lah achuh devar abbuvram umidderabbanan mi adif veha tenan vachachamim omrim ad shettefarkes o vayyad o varegel
Rabbanan ahe kayemi ilema adderabban gamliel kevan sheppirkesa mibe leh
Ella peshita adderabbi eliezer vei adif may ad
Rava amar pirkus sheamru besof shechita amar rava mena amena lah detanya shor
b: O chesev perat lechilayim o ez perat lenidme ki yivaled perat leotze dofen shivat yamim perat limchussar zeman tachat immo perat layyatom
Hay yatom hechi dame ilema dilidteh immeh vahadar mita leolam teche vetezil ella demita vahadar yelidteh mikki yivaled nafka

Ella peshita ze perash lemita veze perash lechayyim i amratte bishlama baenan chiyyuta besof leda hayenu deitzterich kera lemaote ella i amratte la baenan chiyyuta besof leda lema leh mikki yivaled nafka
Amar rava hilcheta ki ha matnita behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechzira pesula

Bamme devarim amurim bayyad aval baregel ben pashta velo kaffa ben kaffa velo pashta keshera bamme devarim amurim bedakka aval begassa ben bayyad ben baregel ben pashta velo kaffa ben kaffa velo pashta keshera veof afilu lo rifref ella gappo velo kishkesh ella zenavo hare ze pirkus
May ka mashma lan kullehu tenanhi behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechzira pesula sheenah ella hotzaat nefesh yad in regel la dakka in gassa la of itztericha leh dela tenan
Matni hashshochet lenochri shechitato keshera verabbi eliezer posel amar rabbi eliezer afilu shechatah leechol lenochri mechatzar kaved shellah pesula shessetam machshevet nochri laavoda zara

Amar rabbi yose kal vachomer haddevarim uma bimkom shehammachshava poselet bemukdashin en hakkol holech ella achar haoved mekom sheen machshava poselet bechullin eno din shello yehe hakkol holech ella achar hashshochet
Gema hane tannae it lehu derabbi eliezer berabbi yose detanya amar rabbi eliezer berabbi yose shamati shehabbealim mefaggelin

Mihu tanna kamma savar i shamineh dechashshev in i la la setam machshevet nochri laavoda zara la amrinan rabbi eliezer savar af al gav dela shamineh dechashshev setam machshevet nochri laavoda zara amrinan vaata rabbi yose lememar af al gav deshamineh dechashshev ze mechashshev veze oved la amrinan
Ika deamri bidshamineh dechashshev peligi tanna kamma savar ki amrinan ze mechashshev veze oved hane mile bifnim aval bechutz lo chutz mippenim

a: La yalfinan vaata rabbi eliezer lememar yalfinan chutz mippenim vaata rabbi yose lememar afilu bifnim name ze mechashshev veze oved la amrinan
Ittemar hashshochet et habbehema lizrok damah laavoda zara ulhaktir chelbah laavoda zara rabbi yochanan amar pesula rabbi shimon ben lakish amar mutteret
Rabbi yochanan amar pesula mechashshevin meavoda laavoda veyalfinan chutz mippenim
Resh lakish amar mutteret en mechashshevin meavoda laavoda vela gamrinan chutz mippenim
Veazdu letamayehu deittemar shechatah lishmah lizrok damah shello lishmah rabbi yochanan amar pesula rabbi shimon ben lakish amar keshera
Rabbi yochanan amar pesula mechashshevin meavoda laavoda vegamrinan mimmachshevet pigul rabbi shimon ben lakish amar keshera en mechashshevin meavoda laavoda vela gamrinan mimmachshevet pigul
Utzricha dei itmar beha beha kaamar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum dechutz mippenim la yalfinan aval penim mippenim ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan
Vei ittemar behach behahi kaamar rabbi yochanan aval beha ema mode leh lerabbi shimon ben lakish tzericha

Metiv rav sheshet amar rabbi yose kal vachomer haddevarim uma bimkom shemmachshava poselet bemukdashin en hakkol holech ella achar haoved mekom sheen machshava poselet bechullin eno din shello yehe hakkol holech ella achar hashshochet
May en machshava poselet bechullin ilema dela pasla kelal ella zevicha daavoda zara demitasra hechi mashkachatte lah

Ella peshita meavoda laavoda vehachi kaamar uma bimkom shemmachshava poselet bemukdashin meavoda laavoda en hakkol holech ella achar haoved mekom sheen machshava poselet bechullin meavoda laavoda ella beotah avoda eno din shello yehe hakkol holech ella achar hashshochet
Penim kashya lerabbi shimon ben lakish chutz kashya lerabbi yochanan
Bishlama penim lerabbi shimon ben lakish la kashya ha mikkamme deshamah merabbi yochanan ha levatar deshamah merabbi yochanan ella chutz kashya lerabbi yochanan
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah bearba avodot vehachi kaamar uma bimkom shemmachshava poselet bemukdashin bearba avodot en hakkol holech ella achar haoved
b: Mekom sheen machshava poselet bechullin ella bishte avodot eno din shello yehe hakkol holech ella achar hashshochet

Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan hashshochet et habbehema lizrok damah laavoda zara ulhaktir chelbah laavoda zara hare ellu zivche metim shechatah veachar kach chishev aleha ze haya maase bekesari velo amru bah lo isur velo heter
Amar rav chisda lo amru bah isur mishshum kevodan derabbanan lo heter mishshum kevodo derabbi eliezer
Mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella dela shemane dechashshev aval hacha dishmane dechashshev hochiach sofo al techillato
I name ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam ella gabbe nochri distam machshevet nochri laavoda zara aval yisrael hochiach sofo al techillato la amrinan
Ella amar rav shezvi lo amru bah heter mishshum kevodo derabban shimon ben gamliel he rabban shimon ben gamliel
Ilema rabban shimon ben gamliel degitin ditnan habbari sheamar kitvu get leishti ratza lesachek bah
Umaase bevari sheamar kitvu get leishti veala laggag venafal vamet amar rabban shimon ben gamliel im meatzmo nafal hare ze get veim haruach dachattu eno get
Vehavenan bah maase listor

Chassore michassera vehachi katane im hochiach sofo al techillato hare ze get umaase name bevari sheamar kitvu get leishti veala laggag venafal vamet amar rabban shimon ben gamliel im meatzmo nafal hare ze get veim haruach dachattu eno get
Vedilma shane hatam dekaamar kitvu

Ella amar ravina mishshum kevodo derabban shimon ben gamliel dehacha detanya hakkotev nechasav laacherim vehau bahen avadim veamar halla i efshi bahen im haya rabbo sheni kohen hare ellu ochlin bitruma rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kevan sheamar halla i efshi bahen kevar zachu bahen yorshin
Vehavenan bah letanna kamma afilu omed vetzoveach
Amar rabba veitema rabbi yochanan betzoveach meikara dechulle alma la peligi dela kana beshotek uvassof tzoveach dechulle alma la peligi dikna
Ki peligi shezzika lo al yede acher veshatak ulvassof tzavach tanna kamma savar middishtek kenanhu vehay deka tzavach mihdar ka hadar beh
Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar hochiach sofo al techilato veha dela tzevach meikara savar ki la ate lidi ammay etzvach
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose

Hanhu tayyae daato letzikonya yehuv dichre letabbache yisrael amaru lehu dema vetarba ledidan mashka uvisra ledidchu shalchah rav tovi bar rav matna lekammeh derav yosef ki hay gavena may shelach leh hachi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe lerabbi eliezer yehev leh zuza letabbach yisrael may amar leh chazenan i inish allama hu dela matze medache leh asur vei la amar leh reshacha vehar
Matni hashshochet leshem harim leshem gevaot leshem yammim leshem neharot leshem midbarot shechitato pesula

a: Shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin echad leshem echad mikkol ellu veechad leshem davar kasher shechitato pesula

Gema pesula in zivche metim la urminhi hashshochet leshum harim leshum gevaot leshum neharot leshum midbarot leshum chamma ulvana leshum kochavim umazzalot leshum michael hassar haggadol leshum shilshul katan hare ellu zivche metim
Amar abbaye la kashya ha deamar lehar ha deamar legadda dehar dayeka name dekatane dumya demichael sar haggadol shema minah

Amar rav huna hayeta behemat chavero revutza lifne avoda zara kevan sheshshachat bah siman echad asarah savar lah ki ha deamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan af al pi sheamru hammishtachave levehemat chavero lo asarah asa bah maase asarah
Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna hashshochet chattat beshabbat bachutz laavoda zara chayyav shalosh chattaot vei amratte kevan sheshshachat bah siman echad asarah ashshechute chutz la lichayyav
b: Mechattech beafar hu amar rav pappa hacha bechattat haof askinan dechullehu bahade hadade kaate
Mikkede rav huna keman amrah lishmateh keulla veulla maase kol dehu kaamar
Ella beomer bigmar zevicha hu ovdah
I hachi may irya chattat lashmeinan zevach
Ella amar mar zutra mishshemeh derav pappa hacha bemay askinan kegon shehaya chatzi kane pagum vehosif alav kol shehu ugmaro dechullehu bahade hadade kaatyan
Amar rav pappa i lav deamar rav huna siman echad la haveya chattat teuvteh may maase maase rabba
Veamar rav pappa i lav deamar rav huna behemat chavero la haveya chattat teuvteh may tama dideh matze asar dechavreh la matze asar
Peshita mahu detema kevan dekane leh lechappara kedideh damya ka mashma lan
Naatz siman rav nachman verav amram verav yitzchak amri en adam oser davar sheen shello
Metivi hashshochet chattat bashshabbat bachutz laavoda zara chayyav shalosh chattaot veokimna bechattat haof uvachatzi kane pagum tama dechattat haof hu dechullehu bahade hadade kaatyan

a: Aval zevach la vei en adam oser davar sheeno shello may irya chattat haof afilu chattat behema name kevan dekanya leh lechappara kedideh damya
Ta shema shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin echad leshum echad mikkol ellu veechad leshum davar kasher shechitato pesula hacha bemay askinan deit leh shuttafut begavah
Ta shema hamtamme vehamdammea vehamnassech beshogeg patur bemezid chayyav hacha name deit leh shuttafut begavah

Ketannae goy shennisech yeno shel yisrael shello bifne avoda zara asaro rabbi yehuda ben betera verabbi yehuda ben bava mattirin oto mippene shene devarim echad sheen menassechin yayin ella bifne avoda zara veechad sheyyachol lomar lo lo kol hemennach shetteesor yeni leonsi
Verav nachman verav amram verav yitzchak amri afilu leman deamar adam oser davar sheeno shello hane mile goy aval yisrael letzaoreh ka mikaven
Ta shema shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin echad leshum echad mikkol ellu veechad leshum davar kasher shechitato pesula hacha bemay askinan beyisrael meshummad
Ta shema hamtamme vehamdammea vehamnassech beshogeg patur bemezid chayyav hacha name beyisrael meshummad
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe hitru bo vekibbel alav hatraa may amar leh hittir atzmo lemita kaamratte en lach meshummad gadol mizze

Matni en shochatin lo letoch yammim velo letoch neharot velo letoch kelim aval shochet hu letoch uga shel mayim uvisfina al gabbe chelim en shochatin laggumma kol ikar aval ose gumma betoch beto bishvil sheyyikkanes haddam letochah uvashshuk lo yaase ken shello
b: Yechakke et hamminin
Gema en shochatin lo letoch vechu may shena letoch yammim dela deamri lesara deyamma ka shachet letoch uga shel mayim name amri levavua ka shachet amar rava baachurim shanu
En shochatin laggumma vechu veha amratte en shochatin laggumma kelal amar abbaye resha begumma shebbashshuk
Amar leh rava veha middekatane sefa uvashshuk lo yaase ken mikkelal deresha lav beshuk askinan

Ella amar rava hachi kaamar en shochatin laggumma kol ikar veharotze lenakker chatzero ketzad hu ose ose makom chutz laggumma veshochet vedam shotet veored laggumma uvashshuk lo yaase ken shello yechakke et hamminin
Tanya kevateh derava haya mehallech bisfina veen lo makom bassefina lishchot motzi yado chutz lassefina veshochet vedam shotet veored al dofne hassefina veen shochet laggumma kol ikar

Veharotze lenakker chatzero ketzad hu ose ose makom chutz laggumma veshochet vedam shotet veored laggumma uvashshuk lo yaase ken mishshum shenneemar uvchukkotehem lo telechu veim asa ken tzarich bedika acharav
Matni hashshochet leshem ola leshem zevachim leshem asham taluy leshem pesach leshem toda shechitato pesula verabbi shimon machshir

Shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin echad leshum echad mikkol ellu veechad leshum davar kasher shechitato pesula hashshochet leshem chattat leshem asham vadday leshem bechor leshem maaser leshem temura shechitato keshera
Ze hakkelal kol davar shennidar venidav hashshochet lishmo asur vesheeno nidar venidav hashshochet lishmo kasher
Gema hashshochet leshem ola asham taluy bar nidar venidav hu amar rabbi yochanan ha manni rabbi elazar hi deamar mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom
Pesach bar nidav venidar hu zimna kevia leh amar rabbi oshaya shane pesach hoil vehafrashato kol hashshana kullah
Amar rabbi yannay lo shanu ella temimim aval baale mumin mida yedia verabbi yochanan amar afilu baale mumin name zimnin dirme leh mide ammuma vela yedia

Hashshochet leshem chattat amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella sheeno mechuyyav chattat aval mechuyyav chattat ema leshum chattato hu ose veha la kaamar leshem chattati amar rabbi avahu beomer leshem chattati

Leshem temura amar rabbi elazar lo shanu ella sheen lo zevach betoch beto aval yesh lo zevach betoch beto ema amore amar beh veha la kaamar leshem temurat zivchi amar rabbi avahu beomer leshem temurat zivchi
Ze hakkelal leetoye may leetoye olat nazir demahu detema ha la nedar emar neder betzina
Vesheeno nidar venidav leetoye olat yoledet
Amar rabbi elazar lo shanu ella sheen lo ishsha aval yesh lo ishsha emar lishmah hu ose veha la kaamar leshem olat ishti amar rabbi avahu beomer leshem olat ishti
Peshita

a: Mahu detema im ita deyalda kala hava leh ka mashma lan emar appole appil
Hadaran alach hashshochet

Matni ellu terefot babbehema nekuvat haveshet ufsukat haggargeret nikav kerum shel moach nikav hallev levet chalalo nishbera hashshidra venifsak hachut shellah nital hakkaved velo nishtayyer hemennu kelum

Harea shennikva o shechasra rabbi shimon omer ad shettinakev levet hassimponot nikva hakkeva nikva hammara nikvu haddakkin hakkares happenimit shennikva o shennikra rov hachitzona rabbi yehuda omer haggedola tefach vehakketanna berubbah hemses uvet hakkosot shennikvu lachutz

Nafla min haggag nishtabberu rov tzaloteha udrusat hazzeev rabbi yehuda omer derusat hazzeev baddakka udrusat ari baggassa derusat hannetz beof haddak udrusat haggas beof haggas ze hakkelal kol sheen kamoha chayya terefa

Gema amar rabbi shimon ben lakish remez litrefa min hattora minnayin minnayin uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu ella remez litrefa sheenah chayya min hattora minnayin dekatane sefa ze hakkelal kol sheen kamoha chayya terefa mikkelal ditrefa enah chayya mena lan
Dichtiv vezot hachayya asher tochlu chayya echol sheenah chayya la techul mikkelal ditrefa lo chayya
Ulman deamar terefa chayya mena leh nafka leh mizzot hachayya asher tochlu zot hachayya echol chayya acheret la techol mikkelal ditrefa chayya

Veidach hay zot may aved leh mibe leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael zot hachayya asher tochlu melammed shettafas hakkadosh baruch hu mikkol min umin vehera lo lemoshe veamar lo zot echol vezot la techol

Veidach name mibbee leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael in hachi name ella terefa chayya mena leh nafka leh meidach tana deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael ben hachayya hanneechelet uven hachayya asher lo teachel ellu shemone esre terefot shenneemru lemoshe missinay
Vetu leka veha ika veshav shematata
b: Bishlama letanna didan ditna tena udshayyar atya beze hakkelal ella letanna deve rabbi yishmael deamar shemone esre terefot vetu leka veha ika behema shennechtechu ragleha min haarkubba ulmala terefa savar leh kerabbi shimon ben elazar deamar yechola hi likoot velichot
Af al gav dichola likoot velichot leman kaamar letanna deve rabbi yishmael tanna deve rabbi yishmael terefa chayya sevira leh ella savar lah kerabbi shimon ben elazar deamar keshera hi
Vehaika chissaron bashshidra ditnan kamma chissaron bashshidra bet shammay omrim shette chulot uvet hillel omrim chulya achat veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel vechen litrefa
Hemses uvet hakkosot deka chashvatte lehu betarte chashvinhu bachada appek chada veayyel chada
Vehaika geluda savar lah kerabbi meir demachshar
Veha ika charuta mara man katane lah rabbi yose berabbi yehuda appek mara veayyel charuta

Vehaika shav shematata deamar rav matna hay buka deatma deshaf midduchteh terefa veamar rachish bar pappa mishshemeh derav lakta bechulya achat terefa utnan nital hattechol keshera veamar rav avira mishshemeh derava lo shanu ella nital aval nikav terefa

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar shemuel simanim shenniddaldelu berubban terefa veamar rabba bar rav shela amar rav matna amar shemuel neekra tzela meikarah terefa vegulgolet shennechbesa berubba uvasar hachofe et rov hakkares berubbo terefa
Nekuve temanya hau chashvinhu bechad appek shav veayyel shav
I hachi pesuke name tere hau chashshevinhu bechad batzar lehu chada veod derav avira mishshemeh derava name nekuva hi

a: Ella hanach tarte deappekte la tappek
Amar ulla shemona mine terefot neemru lo lemoshe besinay nekuva ufsuka netula vachasura kerua udrusa nefula ushvura leappoke lakuta derachish bar pappa
Amar chiyya bar rava shemona terefot yesh binkuva im tomar tesha mara rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane lah detanya nikva hakkeva nikvu haddakkim terefa rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer af nikva hammara
Hilchot chaver kezayit mara vekurkevan siman
Amar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda

Veamar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan may ahdaru leh chavreh lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda yishpoch laaretz merarati vaadayin iyyov kayyam amar lahem en mazkirin maase nissim dei la tema hachi yefallach kilotay velo yachmol mi ka chaye ella nisa shane dichtiv rak et nafsho shemor hacha name nisa shane
Veamar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan halacha kedivre haomer kezayit

Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna utnan nitla hakkaved velo nishtayyer hemenna kelum ha nishtayyer keshera af al gav dela have kezayit amorae ninhu vealliba derabbi yochanan
Deamar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan mara shennikva vechaved sotamtah keshera
Veamar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan nikav hakkurkevan vechis shello kayyam kasher

Ibaya lehu nikav hakkis vekurkevan kayyam may ta shema deamar rav nachman nikav ze belo ze kasher amar rava shene orot yesh lo laveshet chitzon adom ufnimi lavan nikav ze belo ze kasher lema li lememar chitzon adom ufnimi lavan dei challef terefa

Ibbaya lehu nikvu shenehem ze shello keneged ze mahu amar mar zutra mishshemeh derav pappa baveshet kasher bakkurkevan pasul matkef lah rav ashe adderabba veshet deachla beh ufaya beh ravach gamda leh ufashta leh zimnin demihandezin bahade hadade kurkevan demenach nayach kidkae kae amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe hachi amrinan mishshemeh demar zutra deamar mishshemeh derav pappa kevatach
Veamar rabba kerum sheala mechamat makka baveshet eno kerum veamar rabba veshet en lo bedika mibbachutz ella bifnim lemay nafka minah
b: Lisfek derusa

Hahi sefek derusa daatay lekammeh derabba hava ka badek leh rabba leveshet meabbaray amar leh abbaye veha mar hu deamar veshet en lo bedika ella mibbifnim afcheh rabba uvadkeh veishtechach aleh tere kurte dema vetarfah verabba name lechaddode leabbaye hu devae
Amar ulla yashav lo kotz baveshet en choshshin shemma hivri
Daras chatichot besakkin temea siman
Ululla may shena missefek derusa kasavar ulla en choshshin lisfek derusa
Umay shena mishshette chatichot achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman hatam itachzak isura
Umay shena mehashshochet besakkin venimtzet peguma hatam ityelid lah reuta besakkin
Umay shena missefek tuma birshut hayyachid disfeko tame velitamach nidammeyeh lisfek tuma birshut harabbim disfeko tahor ella hatam hilcheta gemiri lah missota

Yatev hahu merabbanan kammeh derav kahana veyatev vekaamar nimtzet ittemar aval yashav chayeshinan amar lehu rav kahana la tetzitu leh yashav itmar aval nimtzet la itzterich leh leulla dechullehu cheve barayata kotze achlan
Itmar turbatz haveshet rav amar bemashshehu ushmuel amar berubbo rav amar bemashshehu mekom shechita hu ushmuel amar berubbo lav mekom shechita hu

He nihu turbatz haveshet amar mari bar mar ukva amar shemuel kol shechotcho umarchiv ze hu turbatz haveshet chotcho veomed bimkomo zehu veshet atzmo amar lehu rav pappe mar la amar hachi umannu rav bivi bar abbaye ella kol shechotcho veomed bimkomo ze turbatz haveshet ella ezehu veshet atzmo kol shechotcho vechavetz yona amar zera mavlata vechamma amar rav aveya pachut missearta vaadif mechitta
Hahu tora dahava livne rav ukva deatchel beh shechita beturbatz haveshet ugmar beveshet amar rava ramena aleh chumre derav vechumre dishmuel vetarefna leh
Chumre derav deamar rav bemashshehu vehaamar rav mekom shechita hu kishmuel deamar lav mekom shechita hu i shemuel haamar berubbo kerav deamar bemashshehu
Igalgal milta metay lekammeh derabbi abba amar lehu tora ben lerav ben lishmuel shere zilu amaru leh livreh derav yosef bar chama dilshallem deme tora lemareh

Amar mar bereh deravina motvina teuvta kelappe saneh derava leolam hilcheta kedivre bet hillel veharotze laasot kedivre bet shammay ose kedivre bet hillel ose mikkulle bet shammay umikkulle bet hillel rasha

a: Mechumre bet shammay umechumre bet hillel alav hakkatuv omer hakkesil bachoshech holech ella i kevet shammay kekullehen uchchumrehen i kevet hillel kekullehen uchchumrehen
Ha gufa kashya amratte leolam halacha kedivre bet hillel vahadar tane veharotze laasot kedivre bet shammay yaase
La kashya kan kodem bat kol kan leachar bat kol
Vei baet ema af leachar bat kol verabbi yehoshua hi deamar en mashgichin bevat kol
Mikkol makom kashya

Amar rav tavut kullah kerav avdah dechi ata rame bar yechezkel amar la tetzitu lehu lehane kelale dechayel yehuda achi mishshemeh derav hachi amar rav veshet natnu bo chachamim shiur mikkelal deturbatz haveshet lav mekom shechita hu vekaamar bemashshehu
Lemala ad kamma amar rav nachman ad kede tefisat yad lematta ad kamma amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh ad kede sheyyasir
Ini vehaamar ravina amar geniva mishshemeh derav tefach baveshet samuch lakkares zehu kares happenimi ammay ki ka shachet bechares ka shachet
Ema tefach bechares samuch laveshet zehu kares happenimi ibaet ema ki kaamar rav betora demasar tefe
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel turbatz haveshet shennital kullo millechi kasher utna tuna nital lechi hattachton kasher
Matkef lah rav pappa vehaika ikur simanim
Ulrav pappa kashya matnitin nital lechi hattachton kasher
Bishlama matnitin lerav pappa la kashya ha deiakur iakore ha deigum igome meilave simanim ella lishmuel kashya
La tema kullo ella ema rubbo
Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar shemuel simanim shenniddaldelu berubban terefa amar rav shisha bereh derav idi ha deikkefal ikfole hatam deipperuk ipperoke
Ufsukat haggargeret tana kamma pesukat haggargeret berubbah vechamma rubba rav amar
b: Rov ovyah veamri lah rov chalala

Hahi pesukat haggargeret daatay lekammeh derav yatev veka badek lah berov ovyah amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav limadtanu rabbenu berov chalalah shaddereh lekammeh derabba bar bar chana badkah berov chalalah veachsherah uzvan minah bitlesar istere peshite bisra
Vehechi aved hachi vehatanya chacham shettime en chavero rashshay letaher asar en chavero rashshay lehattir shane hacha derav la asar mesar
Vechevan deori bah chacham hechi achal minah veha ketiv vaomar ahah Adonai elohim hinne nafshi lo metummaa unvela utrefa lo achalti minneuray vead atta velo va befi besar piggul

Hinne nafshi lo metummaa shello hirharti bayyom lavo lide tuma ballayela unvela utrefa lo achalti shello achalti besar kos kos meolam velo va befi besar piggul shello achalti mibbehema shehora bah chacham mishshum rabbi natan amru shello achalti mibbehema shello hurmu mattenoteha
Hane mile milta detalya bisvara rabba bar bar chana aggemareh semach
Vetipok leh mishshum chashada detanya dan et haddin zika vechayyav time vetiher asar vehittir vechen haedim sheheidu kullan rashshain likach aval amru chachamim harchek min hakkiur umin haddome lo
Hane mile mide dimzabben mishshuma hacha matkela mochach ki ha derabba shera terefta uzvan minah bisra amara leh bat rav chisda abba share buchra vela zaven mineh bisra
Amar lah hane mile buchra deashshuma mizdevan hacha matkela mochach may ika mishshum umtza meallayeta kol yoma umtza meallayeta zabbinu li
Amar rav chisda ezehu talmid chacham ze haroe terefa leatzmo veamar rav chisda ezehu sone mattanot yichye ze haroe terefa leatzmo

Daresh mar zutra mishshemeh derav chisda kol mi shekkore veshone veroe terefa leatzmo veshimesh talmide chachamim alav hakkatuv omer yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach rav zevid amar zoche venochel shene olamot haolam hazze vehaolam habba ashrecha beolam hazze vetov lach laolam habba

Rabbi elazar ki hao meshadderi leh mibbe nesia mide la shakel vechi hao mezammeni leh la azel amar la ka bae mar deeche dichtiv vesone mattanot yichye rabbi zera ki meshadderi leh la shakel ki hao mazmenin leh azel amar

a: Ityakore hu demityakru bi
Amar rav yehuda amar rav nikva kenafa mitztarfim lerubba

Metiv rav yirmeya uvgulgolet sheyyesh bah nekev echad aroch afilu yesh bah nekavim harbe mitztarfim limlo makdeach alma kevan deshiurah melo makdeach limlo makdeach mitztarfin hacha name kevan deshiureh keisar lichisar mitztarfin
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rabbi chelbo amar rav chama bar gurya amar rav nekavim sheyyesh bahen chesron mitztarfin lichisar vesheen bahen chesron mitztarfin lerubba

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi nitla hemenna retzua mitztarefet lichisar bea mineh rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani merabbi yehoshua ben levi nikva kenafa mahu amar leh hare amru nekavim sheyyesh bahen chissaron mitztarfin lichisar vesheen bahen chissaron mitztarfin lerubba
Beofa may
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani ledidi mipparsha li mineh derabbi elazar mekappelo umannicho al pi hakkane im chofe et rov hakkane terefa veim lav keshera amar rav pappa vesimanach nafya
Nifchata kedelet amar rav nachman kede sheyyikkanes isar lerochbo nisdeka amar rav afilu lo nishtayyer bah ella chulya achat lemala vechulya achat lematta keshera
Amruha kammeh derabbi yochanan amar ma chulya uma chulya dekaamar rav ella ema afilu lo nishtayyer bah ella mashshehu lemala umashshehu lematta keshera
Amruha kammeh derabbi yochanan mishshemeh derabbi yonatan hachi amar lehu yadin chavrin bavlae lefaroshe ki hay tama

Tane rabbi chiyya bar yosef kammeh derabbi yochanan kol hatztzavar kullo kasher lishchita mittabbaat haggedola ad kanfe rea hattachtona amar rava tachtona shehi elona sheani omer kol shepposhetet tzavarah veroa uvilvad shello teanes

Bae rav chanina veitema rav chananya ansa atzmah mahu teku yatev rabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish nefak milta mibbenayehu anas bassimanim veshachat pesula nikav hakkane lematta min hechaze nidon kerea
Tanu rabbanan ezehu chaze ze haroe et hakkarka lematta ad hatztzavar lemala ad hakkares chotech shette tzelaot mishshette defanot elach veelach vezehu chaze hannitan lakkohanim
Nikav kerum shel moach rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kerama ilaa af al gav dela inkiv tattaa veamri lah ad deinkiv tattaa amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani vesimanach chayeta demittenach beh mocha

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kenegdo babbetzim nikar amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara moach kol ma shebbakkedera niddon kemoach hitchil limashech niddon kechut hashshidra umehechan matchil limashech amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani ledidi miparsha li mineh derabbi yehoshua ben levi kemin shene
b: Polin yesh munnachin al pi hakkedera min happolin velifnim kelifnim min happolin velachutz kelachutz ufolin atzman eni yodea umistabbera kelifnim
Rabbi yirmeya bedak beofa veashkach kemin shene polin munnachin al pi hakkedera

Nikav hallev levet chalalo bae rabbi zera levet chalal katan o levet chalal gadol amar leh abbaye may tibe lach mi la tenan rabbi shimon omer ad shettinnakev levet hassimponot veamar rabba bar tachlifa amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav ad shettinnakev lesimpon gadol
Hachi hashta hatam levet hassimponot katane lehecha deshafchi simponot kullehu vehacha levet chalalo katane ma li chalal gadol ma li chalal katan
Kene hallev rav amar bemashshehu ushmuel amar berubbo
He nihu kene hallev amar rabba bar yitzchak amar rav chelev sheal gabbe defanot defanot salka datach ella sheal gabbe dofne rea
Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav nachman telata kene hau chad paresh leliba vechad paresh lerea vechad paresh lechavda derea kerea dechavda kechavda deliba peligi
Mar bar chiyya matni ipcha derea kechavda dechavda kerea deliba peligi
Azal rabbi chiyya bar yosef amrah lishmata derav kammeh dishmuel amar leh i hachi amar abba la yada bitrefot velo kelum
Nishbera hashshidra tanu rabbanan chut hashshidra shennifsak berubbo divre rabbi rabbi yaakov omer afilu nikav
Hora rabbi kerabbi yaakov amar rav huna en halacha kerabbi yaakov
Vechamma rubbo rav amar rov oro veamri lah rov mocho
Man deamar rov mocho kol shekken rov oro leman deamar rov oro rov mocho may
Ta shema deamar niveli amar rav huna rubbo sheamru rov oro moach ze lo maale velo morid
Rav natan bar avin hava yatev kammeh derav bedak berov oro veka badek berov mocho amar leh im rov oro kayyam moach ze eno maale veeno morid
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi nitmarech pasul nitmasmes pasul ezohi hamracha veezohi hamasmasa hamracha kol shennishpach kekiton hamasmasa kol sheeno yachol laamod
Bae rabbi yirmeya eno yachol laamod mippene kovdo may teku be rav amri nitmasmes pasul nitmazmez kasher metivi rabbi shimon ben elazar omer behema shennitmazmez mocha terefa hahi nitmasmes itmar
Ini veha levi hava yatev be massuta chazyeh lehahu gavra detaryeh leresheh amar nitmazmez mocheh deden lav dela chaye amar abbaye la lomar sheeno molid
Ad hechan chut hashshidra amar rav yehuda amar shemuel ad ben happarashot

Rav dimi bar yitzchak hava ka bae lemezal leve chozae ata lekammeh derabbi yehuda amar leh lachve li mar ben happarashot hecha amar leh zil ayeti li gedi veachvi lach ayeti leh gedi shamen amar leh belian tefe vela yedia ayeti leh kachush amar leh belitan tefe vela yedia
Amar leh ta agmerach gemara hachi amar shemuel ad achat terefa shelishit keshera sheniyya eni yodea
Bae rav huna bereh derav yehoshua

a: Ad vead bakkelal o dilma ad velo ad bakkelal
Bae rav pappa im timtze lomar ad velo ad bakkelal pi farasha mahu
Bae rabbi yirmeya im timtze lomar ad vead bakkelal parasha atzmah mahu
Ta shema happarasha tidon kevasar may lav parasha rishona ushniyya la shelishit
Beofa rabbi yannay omer lematta min haagappayim veresh lakish amar ad ben agappayim
Amar ulla hava kaemna kammeh deven pazzi veayeto lekammeh ofa uvdak ad ben agappayim ushlach leh deve nesia vekam vaazal vela yadana i mishshum dela tzerich lemivdak tefe i mishshum kevod nesia
Nitla hakkaved vechu ha nishtayyer hemenna kelum keshera af al gav dela have kezayit vehatnan nital hakkaved venishtayyer hemenna kezayit keshera
