Amar rav yosef la kashya ha rabbi chiyya ha rabbi shimon bar rabbi ki ha derabbi chiyya zarek lah verabbi shimon bar rabbi metabbel lah vesimanach ashirin mekammetzin

Hahu pulmusa daata lefumbedita araku rabba verav yosef pega behu rabbi zera amar lehu arokae kezayit sheamru bimkom mara rav adda bar ahava amar bimkom shehi chayya amar rav pappa hilkach baenan kezayit bimkom mara uvaenan kezayit bimkom shehi chayya
Bae rabbi yirmeya mitlakket mahu kirtzua mahu bae rav ashe kezayit meruddad mahu teku
Bea mineh rabbi zerika merabbi amme niddaldela kaved umora betarpesheha mahu amar leh dildul ze eni yodea mahu i leman deamar bimkom mara ha ika i leman deamar bimkom shehi chayya ha ika
Harea shennikva rav ushmuel verav assi deamri kerama ilaa veamri lah kerama tattaa amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman vesimanach kituna devarda demannecha beh rea
Peshita i inkiv ilaa vela inkiv tattaa tattaa megen kidrabba deamar rabba hay rea deiggelid
b: Kaahina summaka keshera inkiv tattaa vela inkiv ilaa maggen o la maggen

Peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar la maggen vechad amar maggen vehilcheta maggen kidrav yosef deamar rav yosef hay rea deavesha i yadinan hecha avesha motvinan alah gadpa o rukka o gila i mevatzbetza terefa vei la keshera vei la yadinan hecha avesha mayetinan meshichleta demayya pashore umotvinan lah begavah
Bechammime la dechavetzi bekarire la dimtarshi ella motvinan befashore venafchinan lah i mevatzbetza terefa vei la keshera tattaa inkiv ilaa la inkiv vehay deavesha zika devene bene hu
Ahine summaka divash gilde siman
Gufa amar rava hay rea deiglid kaahina summaka keshera veamar rava rea sheheedima miktzatah keshera kullah terefa
Amar leh ravina lerava miktzatah may tama dehadra barya kullah name hadra barya mi la tanya ushar shekatzim urmasim ad sheyyetze mehem dam
Vechi tema lishmona sheratzim medammenan lah detanya nitzrar haddam af al pi shello yatza i hachi afilu miktzatah name ella la shena
Veamar rava rea sheyyavsha miktzatah terefa vechamma amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava keday shettipparech betzipporen
Keman kerabbi yose ben hamshullam detanya ezo hi yevesha sheim tinakev veenah motzia tipat dam rabbi yose ben hamshullam omer yevesha kede shettehe nifrechet betzipporen

Afilu tema rabbanan gabbe ozen bechor deka shalet beh zika la hadra barya aval rea dela ka shalet bah avera hadra barya veamar rava hay rea dekayema gilde gilde ukkame ukkame chezvata chezvata keshera
Amar ammemar mishshemeh derava en makkifin bevue
Veamar rava hane tarte unne disrichan lahadade let lehu bedika vela amaran ella shello kesidran aval kesidran hayenu revitayehu

a: Veamar rava hane tarte bue dismichan lahadade let lehu bedikuta chada umitchazya ketarte mayetinan silva uvazinan lah i shafchan lahadade chada hi uchshera vei la tarte ninhu utrefa
Veamar rava chamesh unne it lah lerea appah kelappe gavra telata miyyammina vetarte missemala chassir o yattir o chalif terefa

Hahu yattirta daatay lekammeh demarimar hava yatev rav acha abbava amar leh may amar lach amar leh achsherah nihali amar leh hadar ayelah kammeh amar leh zil ema leh leman deyatev abbava let hilcheta kevateh derava biteret
Vehane mile dekayema bedara deunne aval bene bene terefa
Hahu bene bene daata lekammeh derav ashe savar rav ashe lemitrefah amar leh rav huna mar bar aveya kol hane cheve barayata hachi it lehu vekaru lah tabbache enunita devarda vehane mile miggavay
b: Aval aggabbah afilu ketarpa deasa terefa
Amar rafram hay rea dedamya leufta terefa ika deamri bachazuta veika deamri begishta ika deamri dinficha veika deamri difchiza veika deamri deshia delet lah chitucha deunne
Amar rava kechuchla keshera kidota terefa deamar rabbi chanina shachor adom hu ella shellaka

Yerukka keshera midderabbi natan adumma keshera midderabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer paam achat halachti lichrakke hayyam bata ishsha achat lefanay shemmala benah rishon vamet sheni vamet shelishi heviattu lefanay reitiv shehaya adom amarti lah bitti hamtini lo ad sheyyibbala bo damo himtina lo umala oto vechaya vehau korin oto natan habbavli al shemi

Veshuv paam achat halachti limdinat kappotkeya bata ishsha lefanay shemmala benah rishon vamet sheni vamet shelishi heviattu lefanay reitiv shehaya yarok hetzatzti bo velo haya bo dam berit amarti lah bitti hamtini lo ad sheyyippol bo damo himtina lo umala oto vechaya vehau korin oto natan habbavli al shemi
Amar rav kahana kechavda keshera kevisra terefa vesimanach uvasar bassade terefa
Amar rav samma bereh derava hay rea dedamya kichshuta uchmorika uchgon beata terefa ella yerukka dichshera hechi damya kecharrate
Amar ravina atum berea mayetinan sakkina vekarinan lah i it bah mugla vadday mechamat mugla hu uchshera vei la motvinan alah gadpa o rukka i mevatzbetza keshera vei la terefa

Amar rav yosef kerum sheala mechamat makka barea eno kerum veamar rav yosef hay rea deavesha i yadinan hecha avesha mannechinan alah gadpa o gila o rukka i mevatzbetza terefa vei la keshera vei la yadinan lah mayetinan meshichleta demayya pashore umotvinan lah begavah
Bechammime la dechavetzi bekarire la dimtarshi ella badkinan lah befashore i mevatzbetza terefa vei la keshera tattaa inkiv ilaa la inkiv vehay deavesha zika devene uvene hu
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan rea shennishpecha kekiton keshera alma kasavar chissaron mibbifnim la shemeh chissaron
Etiveh rabbi abba leulla harea shennikva o shechasra may chasra ilema mibbachutz hayenu nikva ella lav mibbifnim ushma minah chissaron mibbifnim shemeh chissaron

La leolam mibbachutz udka amratte hayenu nikva la tzericha lerabbi shimon deamar ad shettinnakev levet hassimponot hane mile nekev delet beh chissaron aval nekev deit beh chissaron afilu rabbi shimon mode
Rabbi chananya chalash al legabbeh rabbi natan vechol gedole haddor ayeto kammeh rea shennishpecha kekiton veachsherah
Amar rava vehu dekayemi simponot amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe mena yadinan amar leh mayetinan tzaa dekunya veshafchinan lah begaveh i it bah shuryake chivare terefa vei la keshera
Amar rav nachman rea shennimoka ukrum shellah kayyam keshera tanya name hachi rea shennimoka ukrum shellah kayyam afilu machzeket reviit keshera nitla

a: Shalpuchit shellah keshera hitlia kaved shellah ze haya maase vealu aleha bene asya shelosha regalim leyavne leregel shelishi hittiruha lahem
Amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman rea hassemucha laddofen en choshshin lah heelta tzemachim choshshin lah mar yehuda mishshemeh daavimi amar echad ze veechad ze choshshin lah

Hechi avdinan amar rava ravin bar sheva asberah li mayetinan sakkina dachalish pummeh umfarkinan lah i ika reuta bedofen talenan batar dofen vei la mechamat rea hi utrefa veaf al gav dela ka mappeka zika

Rav nechemya bereh derav yosef badek lah befashore amar leh mar zutra bereh derav huna bereh derav pappe leravina ha derav nechemya bereh derav yosef attun aha matnitu lah anan adderava matnenan lah deamar rava hane tarte unne derea disrichan lahadade let lehu bedikuta leachshore rav nechemya bereh derav yosef badek lah befashore
Matkef lah rav ashe hay may bishlama hacha talenan bedofen uchshera aval hatam i hay nekiv terefa vei hay nekiv terefa
Umi amar rav nachman hachi vehaamar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman rea shennikkeva vedofen sotamtah keshera la kashya hatam bimkom revita hacha shello bimkom revita
Vehecha mekom revita chituche deunne

Gufa amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman rea shennikkeva vedofen sotamtah keshera amar ravina vehu disvich bevisra amar leh rav yosef leravina vei la sevich may terefa alma amrinan nekuva hi i hachi ki sevich name
Deha tanya nikav pasul mippene shehu shotet nistam kasher mippene shehu molid vezehu pesul shechozer lehechshero vezehu lemaote may lav lemaote kehay gavena
La lemaote kerum sheala mechamat makka barea deeno kerum
Matkef lah rav ukva bar chama ilu inkiv dofen lahadah may terefa litne nekuvat haddofen
Velitamach ha deamar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan mara shennikva vechaved sotamtah keshera ilu inkiv kaved lahadah may terefa litne nekuvat hakkaved
Ella ki nikva delav mineh mitarfa la katane hacha name kevan delav mineh mitarfa la katane

Bea mineh rabba bar bar chana mishshemuel heelta tzemachin mahu amar leh keshera amar leh af ani omer ken ella shehattalmidim mizdannezin baddavar deamar rav matna malya mugla terefa mayim zakkim keshera amar leh hahi bechulya ittemar

Rabbi yitzchak bar yosef hava kaazel batreh derabbi yirmeya beshuka detabbache chazanhu lehanach dekayemin tzimche tzimche amar leh la bae mar umtza amar leh let li perite amar leh akkefan ana amar leh ma eeved lach dechi atu lekammeh derabbi yochanan meshaddar lehu lekammeh derabbi yehuda berabbi shimon demore bah mishshemeh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon lehetera veleh la sevira leh
Amar rava ki hava mesaggenan batreh derav nachman beshuka
b: Degildae veamri lah beshuka derabbanan chaze hanach dekayeman kande kande vela amar lehu vela mide
Rabbi amme verabbi assi hao chalfi beshuka ditverya chaze chazonhu hanach dekayemi tinare tinare vela amri lehu vela mide
Ittemar machat shennimtzet barea rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar verabbi chanina machsheri rabbi shimon ben lakish verabbi mani bar pattish verabbi shimon ben elyakim tarfi

Lema beha kamipalgi demar savar chissaron mibbifnim shemeh chissaron umar savar la shemeh chissaron la dechulle alma chissaron mibbifnim la shemeh chissaron vehacha beha kamipalgi mar savar simpona nekat vaatay umar savar nakkove nakkev vaatay

Hahi machta deishtechach bechitucha derea ayetuha lekammeh derabbi amme sevar leachshorah etiveh rabbi yirmeya veitema rabbi zerika harea shennikva o shechasra may chasra ilema mibbachutz hayenu nikva ella lav mibbifnim ushma minah chissaron mibbifnim shemeh chissaron

Hadar shadderuha lekammeh derabbi yitzchak nappacha sevar leachshorah etiveh rabbi yirmeya veitema rabbi zerika harea shennikva o shechasra may chasra ilema mibbachutz hayenu nikva ella lav mibbifnim ushma minah chissaron mibbifnim shemeh chissaron
Hadar shadderuha lekammeh derabbi amme vetarfah amri leh veha rabbanan machsheri amar lahen hen hichshiru sheyyodim meeze taam hichshiru anu meeze taam nachshir dilma i hava rea kamman minakva
Tama deletah ha itah vela minakva keshera vehaamar rav nachman hay simpona derea deinkiv terefa hahu lachavero ittemar

Vehaamar rav nachman hay hadora dechanta deinkiv lahade chavreh maggen aleh amar rav ashe terefot ka medamme lahadade en omrin bitrefot zo doma lazo shehare chotchah mikkan umeta chotchah mikkan vechayya

Hahi machta deishtechach besimpona rabba derea atuha lekamme derabbanan tarofae la amaru bah la isur vela heter heter la amri bah kishmatayehu isur name la amri bah kevan divsimpona rabba ishtechach ema simpona nekat vaatay

Hahi machta deishtechach bachaticha dechavda sevar mar bereh derav yosef lemitrefah amar leh rav ashe ilu ishtechach bevisra kehay gavena hava taref mar ella amar rav ashe chazena i kofa levar nakkove nakkev vaatay i kofa legav simpona nekat vaatay
Vehane mile beallimta aval kattinta la shena kofa legav la shena kofa levar nakkove nakkev vaatay
Umay shena mimmachat shennimtzet

a: Beovi bet hakkosot mitztzad echad keshera mishshene tzedadin terefa vela amrinan lichze i kofa levar i kofa legav
Amri hatam kevan deika ochalim umashkim ema ochalim umashkim dachkuha
Hahu machta deishtechach besimpona rabba dechavda huna mar bereh derav idi taref rav adda bar minome machshar ato shayeluh leravina amar lehu shekilu gelima detarofae
Hahi keshita deishtechach bemara amar rav ashe ki havenan be rav kahana amar ha vadday simpona nekat vaatay af al gav dela ka nafka mirbal hu deravel lah vehane mile dedikla aval dezeta mivza baza
Amar rabbi yochanan lamma nikra shemah rea shemmeira et haenayim ibaya lehu laachila o al yede sammanin
Ta shema deamar rav huna bar yehuda avaza bezuza verea didah bearbea vei salka datach laachila linkot bezuza velechol ella al yede sammanin
Inakva rea hecha dimmashmesha yedeh detabbacha talenan o la talenan rav adda bar natan amar talenan mar zutra bereh derav mari amar la talenan vehilcheta talenan
Amar rav shemuel bereh derabbi avahu abba mereshe kalle derafram hava vaamar talenan amruha kammeh leha demar zutra bereh derav mari vela kabbelah
Amar rav mesharsheya kevateh daavuh deabba mistabbera deha talenan bizev
Murna peligi bah rav yosef bar dosay verabbanan chad amar kodem shechita paresh vechad amar leachar shechita paresh vehilcheta leachar shechita paresh
Rabbi shimon omer ad shettinakev amar rabba bar tachlifa amar rav yirmeya bar abba ad shettinakev lesimpon gadol
Yatev rav acha bar abba kammeh derav huna veyatev vekaamar amar rabbi malluch amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha kerabbi shimon amar leh malluch arvaa kaamratte en halacha kerabbi shimon kaamar

Ki salek rabbi zera ashkecheh lerav bivi deyatev vekaamar amar rabbi malluch amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha kerabbi shimon amar leh chayye demar daana verabbi chiyya bar abba verav assi ikalinan leatreh derabbi malluch vaamari leh i amar mar halacha kerabbi shimon vaamar lan en halacha kerabbi shimon amari veatte ma bidach amar leh hachi amar rabbi yitzchak bar amme amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha kerabbi shimon
Veen halacha kerabbi shimon
Nikva hakkeva amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani amar rabbi oshaya chelev sheal gabbe keva kohanim nahagu bo heter kerabbi yishmael sheamar mishshum avotav vesimanach yishmael kahana mesayya kahane

May hi detanya ko tevarchu et bene yisrael rabbi yishmael omer lamadnu beracha leyisrael mippi kohanim lechohanim atzman lo lamadnu keshehu omer vaani avarchem heve omer kohanim mevarchin leyisrael vehakkadosh baruch hu mevarech lakkohanim
Rabbi akiva omer lamadnu beracha leyisrael mippi chohanim mippi gevura lo lamadnu keshehu omer vaani avarchem heve omer kohanim mevarchin leyisrael vehakkadosh baruch hu maskim al yadam
Ella rabbi akiva beracha lechohanim mena leh amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mivaavarcha mevarchecha
Umay mesayya kahane demoke leh levirkat kohanim bimkom beracha deyisrael
Rabbi yishmael sheamar mishshum avotav may hi detanya et kol hachelev asher al hakkerev
b: Vego lehavi chelev sheal gabbe haddakkin divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer lehavi chelev sheal gabbe hakkeva

Urminhi et hachelev asher al hakkerev rabbi shimon omer ma chelev hamchasse et hakkerev kerum veniklaf af kol kerum veniklaf rabbi akiva omer ma chelev hamchasse et hakkerev totav kerum veniklaf af kol totav kerum veniklaf
Shelach ravin mishshemeh derabbi yochanan kach hi hatztzaa shel mishna veefoch kammayeta
May chazet deafchatte kammayeta efoch batrayeta shane hacha kevan dekatane ma daveka
I hachi kerabbi yishmael kerabbi akiva hi amar rav nachman bar yitzchak sheamar mishshum avotav veleh la sevira leh
Amar rav chelev tahor sotem tame eno sotem verav sheshet omer echad ze veechad ze sotem
Bae rabbi zera chelev chayya may daveka amar chelev tahor sotem vehay name tahor hu o dilma mishshum dimhaddak vehay la mehaddak
Amar abbaye may tibe leh nehi dishre baachila ihaddoke la mehaddak

Hahu nekev desatmeh chelev tame daata lekammeh derava amar rava lemay nechush lah chada deha amar rav sheshet chelev tame name sotem veod hattora chasa al mamonam shel yisrael amar leh rav pappa lerava rav veisura deorayeta veatte amratte hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael

Minomin kanduka igalli leh busteka deduvsha ata lekammeh derava amar rava lemay nechush lah chada ditnan shelosha mashkim asurim mishshum giluy hayyayin vehammayim vehechalav ushar kol hammashkim muttarim veod hattora chasa al mamonam shel yisrael amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava rabbi shimon vesakkanat nefashot veatte amratte hattora chasa al mamonam shel yisrael

Rabbi shimon may hi detanya chamishsha en bahem mishshum giluy tzir vachometz shemen udvash umuryas rabbi shimon omer af hen yesh bahen mishshum giluy veamar rabbi shimon ani raiti nachash sheshshata tzir betzayeddan amru lo shatya hava veen meviin reaya min hashshotim

Amar leh odi li mihat betzir deha rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua verabbanan ki hava lehu giluya shadu leh betzir amar leh odi li miha bidvash derabbi shimon ben elazar kae kevateh detanya vechen haya rabbi shimon ben elazar oser bidvash
Amar rav nachman chelev heasuy kechova eno sotem hecha amri lah chite decharkesha veamri lah tarpesha deliba

Amar rava shemait mineh derav nachman tarte chimtza uvar chimtza chad satem vechad la satem vela yadana he minayehu rav huna bar chinana verav huna bereh derav nachman amar bar chimtza satem chimtza la satem amar rav tavut vesimanach yafe koach habben mikkoach haav
He chimtza vehe bar chimtza ta shema deamar rav nachman inhu mechal achli

a: Uldidan mistam name la satem
Deakkashta kulle alma la peligi daasir ki peligi deayyitra
Ika deamri deayyitra kulle alma la peligi dishre ki peligi deakkashta
Ki ha deamar rav aveya amar rabbi amme mekammetzin vechen amar rabbi yannay mishshum zaken echad mekammetzin amar rav aveya hava kaemna kammeh derabbi amme kematzu vehavu leh vaachal
Shammaeh derabbi chanina hava kae kammeh derabbi chanina amar leh kemotz hav li deechol chazyeh dahava kamchassem amar leh bavlaa atte gom shedi
Tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer bene meayin shennikvu velecha sotamtan keshera may lecha amar rav kahana shirka dimayya denafek aggav duchka

Gemiri chavrayya derabbi abba merabbi abba umannu rabbi zera veamri lah chavrayya derabbi zera merabbi zera umannu rabbi abba amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba hachi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefa vahalacha kerabbi shimon beevel
Halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefa ha daamaran kerabbi shimon beevel may hi ditnan kol shelosha yamim harishonim ba mimmakom karov mone immahen
Mimmakom rachok mone leatzmo mikkan veelach afilu ba mimmakom karov mone leatzmo rabbi shimon omer afilu beom hashshevii ba mimmakom karov mone immahen

Amar man dehu izke veesak veegmerah lishmata mippummeh demarah ki selek ashkecheh lerabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba amar leh amar mar halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefa amar leh ha en halacha amari
Kerabbi shimon beavel may amar leh pelugata ninhu deitmar rav chisda amar halacha vechen amar rabbi yochanan halacha verav nachman amar en halacha
Veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefa vahalacha kerabbi shimon beevel deamar shemuel halacha kedivre hammekel beevel
Amar rav shimi bar chiyya makkifim bivne meayim

Hanhu bene meayim daato lekammeh derava akkefinhu vela idmo ata rav mesharsheya bereh memashmesh behu veidmo amar leh mena lach ha amar leh kamma yede mashmishu behane mikkamme delete lekammeh demar amar leh chakkim beri bitrefot kerabbi yochanan

Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayehu makkifim barea amar rava la amaran ella beotah aruga aval mearuga laaruga la vehilcheta afilu mearuga laaruga middakka ledakka umiggassa legassa aval lo miggassa ledakka velo middakka legassa

Abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu makkifin bakkane amar rav pappa la amaran ella beotah chulya aval mechulya lechulya la vehilcheta afilu mechulya lechulya umibbar chulya levar chulya aval la mechulya levar chulya vela mibbar chulya lechulya
Amar zeeri chalcholet shennikva keshera hoil virechayim maamidot otah vechamma amar rabbi ilay amar rabbi yochanan mekom haddevek berubbo shello bimkom haddevek bemashshehu
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derava mishshemeh derav nachman amar lav mi amena lechu la titlo beh
b: Buke seriki hachi amar rav nachman mekom haddevek afilu nital kullo kasher vehu shennishtayyer bo kede tefisa vechamma amar abbaye kimle batda betora

Hakkares happenimi amar rav yehuda amar rav heid natan bar shela resh tabbachayya detzippori lifne rabbi mishshum rabbi natan e zo hi kares happenimi sanya deve vechen amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha sanya deve rabbi yishmael amar istumcha decharsa
Rav assi amar rabbi yochanan makom tzar yesh bakkares veeni yodea ezehu amar rav nachman bar yitzchak nefal keresa bevera amar rav acha bar rav ava amar rav assi min hammetzar ulmatta
Rabbi yaakov bar nachmani amar shemuel mekom sheen bo melat rabbi avina amar geniva mishshemeh derav tefach baveshet samuch lakkares zo hi kares happenimit

Amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose bar chanina kol hakkares kullo zo hi kares happenimit veezehu kares hachitzon basar hachofe et rov hakkares rabba bar rav huna amar mafrata may mafrata amar rav aveya hecha defari tabbache
Binhardea avdi kerabba bar rav huna amar leh rav ashe leammemar kol hane shematata may amar leh kullehu shayechan bidrabba bar rav huna
Udrav assi amar rabbi yochanan may amar leh kevar persha rav acha bar ava udrabbi avina vedivne mareva may amar leh hane vadday peligi

Rabbi yehuda omer bigdola ku amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar lo gedola gedola mammash velo ketanna ketanna mammash ella kol shennikra bah tefach vela have rubba zo hi sheshshaninu bigdola tefach rubba vela have tefach zo hi sheshshaninu biktanna berubba
Rubba vela have tefach peshita la tzericha dehaveya tefach bemashshehu mahu detema ad demikra bah tefach la have terefa ka mashma lan

Amar geniva amar rabbi assi nikdera kesela terefa sheim timmatach taamod al hattefach amar rabbi chiyya bar abba ledidi mipparsha li mineh digniva ammabbara dinhardea kesela keshera yater mikkesela terefa vechamma yater mikkesela amar rav yosef kegon deayelan telat kashyata betzipa beduchka bela tzipa beravecha
Hemses uvet hakkosot tanu rabbanan machat shennimtzet beovi bet hakkosot mitztzad echad keshera mishshene tzedadim terefa nimtza aleha koret dam

a: Beyadua shellifne shechita lo nimtza aleha koret dam beyadua shelleachar shechita
Higlid pi hammakka beyadua sheshshelosha yamim kodem shechita lo higlid pi hammakka hammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Umay shena mikkol nekuve dealma deaf al gav deleka dam taref mar hatam leka mide lemisrach hacha kevan deika machat i ita dekodem shechita hu misrach hava sarech

Amar leh rav safra leabbaye chazi mar hay tzurba merabbanan daata mimmareva veamar rav avira shemeni veamar maase uva lifne rabbi machat shennimtzet beovi bet hakkosot mitztzad echad utrafah shelach leh la ata legabbeh azal hu legabbeh hava kae aigara amar nechot mar venete la nachet salek hu legabbeh amar leh ema li gufa deovada hechi hava

Amar leh maftir kenesiyyot ana leela merabbi rabba vahava rav huna tziporaa verabbi yose madaa yoshvin lefanav uvat lifne rabbi machat shennimtzet beovi bet hakkosot mitztzad echad vahafachah rabbi umatza aleha koret dam utrafah veamar im en sham makka koret dam minnayin amar leh tera taryeh lehahu gavra matnitin hi hemses uvet hakkosot shennikvu lachutz
Nafla min haggag amar rav huna hinniach behema lemala uva umtzaah lematta en choshshin mishshum risuke evarim

Hahu gadya dahava leh leravina dachaza chushla beipuma degar nefal meigara leara atuh lekammeh derav ashe amar leh ha deamar rav huna hinniach behema lemala uva umtzaah lematta en choshshin mishshum risuke evarim mishshum deit lah mide lemisrach vehay let leh mide lemisrach o dilma mishshum deamda nafshah vehay name amedo nafsheh
Amar leh mishshum deamda nafshah vehay name amedo nafsheh

Hahi imarta dahava be rav chaviva dahao shadran karah batrayata amar rav yemar hay shigrona naktah matkef lah ravina vedilma chut hashshidra ipsik badkuha ashkechuha keravina vaafilu hachi hilcheta kerav yemar shigrona shechiach chut hashshidra la shechiach
Amar rav huna zecharim hamnaggechin ze et ze en choshshin mishshum risuke evarim af al gav demidu vekayemi tzimra bealma hu denaket lehu i neful leara vadday chayeshinan

Amar rav menashshe hane dichre deganvi gannave en choshshin mishshum risuk evarim may tama ki shadu lehu ammotnayehu shadu lehu ki hechi delirhatu kammayehu ahderinhu vadday chayeshinan vehane mile deahderinhu mechamat yira aval mechamat teshuva teshuva meallayeta hu deavdi

Amar rav yehuda amar rav hikkah al roshah vehalcha lah kelappe zenavah al zenavah vehalcha lah kelappe roshah keneged kol hashshidra kullah en choshshin mishshum risuke evarim vei shelem chutra appalge degabba chayeshinan vei it bah kitre chayeshinan vei machyah appaskit chayeshinan
Amar rav nachman bet harechem en bo mishshum risuke evarim amar leh rava lerav nachman tanya dimsayya lach tinok ben yom echad
b: Metamme beziva vei salka datach yesh bo mishshum risuke evarim ikri kan mibbesaro velo mechamat onso
Hacha bemay askinan kegon sheyyatza derech dofen
Ta shema egel shennolad beom tov shochatin oto beom tov hacha name kegon sheyyatza derech dofen

Ta shema veshavin sheim nolad hu umumo immo shezze min hammuchan vechi tema hacha name sheyyatza derech dofen derech dofen mi kadosh veha amar rabbi yochanan mode haya rabbi shimon leinyan kadashim sheeno kadosh
Hacha bemay askinan shehifris al gabbe karka
Veamar rav nachman bet hammitbachayim en bo mishshum risuke evarim
Hahu tora dinfal veishtema kal genichoteh al rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta shekal mishshufre shufre amri leh rabbanan mena lach ha amar lehu hachi amar rav tzippornav noetz ad shemmaggia laaretz
Amar rav yehuda amar rav amda enah tzericha meet leet bedika vadday baaya halcha enah tzericha bedika rav chiyya bar ashe amar achat zo veachat zo tzericha bedika
Amar rav yirmeya bar acha amar rav pashta yadah laamod af al pi shello amda akra raglah lehallech af al pi shello halcha verav chisda amar ninara laamod af al pi shello amda
Vehilcheta hecha denafla min haggag bidla yada veamda velo halcha tzericha bedika veenah tzericha meet leet veim halcha afilu bedika name la tzericha
Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav dimi minnehardea nefula sheamru tzericha bedika keneged bene meayim amar leh mar zutra hachi amrinan mishshemeh derav pappa tzericha bedika keneged bet hechalal kullo
Amar leh huna mar bar bereh derav nechemya lerav ashe simanin may amar leh simanin kashin hen etzel nefila

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel of shennechbat al pene hammayim kevan sheshshat melo komato dayyo vela amaran ella mimmatta lemala aval millemala lematta mayya hu deashpilu vei mayya kayemi let lan bah vei sheda tzive vekadmeh ha kadmeh
Gelima metiach chayeshinan dela metiach la chayeshinan uf umuppaf la chayeshinan izla umkarvi kitre chayeshinan la mekarvi kitre la chayeshinan

Kitana daavid betune chayeshinan dehay gisa udhay gisa la chayeshinan issuryata chayeshinan kitana didyik unfitz la chayeshinan deyik vela nefitz chayeshinan daavid bizre kevan deika beh kitre chayeshinan dakta chayeshinan dakdakta la chayeshinan
Navra chayeshinan timachta la chayeshinan kitma nehila chayeshinan la nehila la chayeshinan

a: Chol haddak la chayeshinan chol haggas chayeshinan avak derachim chayeshinan tivna vaavid bizga chayeshinan la aved bizga la chayeshinan

Chite vechol deminayehu chayeshinan seare vechol deminayehu chayeshinan kol mine kitniyyot en bahem mishshum risuke evarim levar min rubbeya chimtze en bo mishshum risuk evarim chiftze yesh bo mishshum risuk evarim kelala demilleta kol mide demashrek en bo mishshum risuk evarim la mashrek yesh bo mishshum risuk evarim
Davok rav ashe share ammemar asar bechad gappa dechulle alma la peligi dishre ki peligi bitre gappe man deasar amar lach hechi nekum uman deshare amar lach efshar denekum aikve degappe

Veika deamri bitre gappe kulle alma la peligi daasir ki peligi bechad gappa man deshare amar lach efshar defarach bechad gappa uman deasar kevan divhay la matze parach behay name la matze parach vehilcheta bitre gappe asir bechad gappa shere
Nishtabberu rov tzaloteha tanu rabbanan ellu hen rov tzelaot shesh mikkan veshesh mikkan o achat esre mikkan veachat mikkan
Amar zeeri umechetzyan kelappe shidra amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan uvitzlaot gedolot sheyyesh bahen moach
Amar ulla ben zakkay amar nekeru berov tzad echad nishtabberu berov shene tzedadin rabbi yochanan amar ben nekeru ben nishtabberu berov shene tzedadin
Amar rav neekra tzela vechulya immah terefa amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav neekra tzela mikkan vetzela mikkan vechulya kayyemet mahu amar lehu gistera kaamritu
Veha rav name gistera kaamar ki kaamar rav tzela belo chulya
Veha tzela vechulya kaamar tzela vachatzi chulya
Mikkelal derav kahana verav assi tzela belo chulya amri vaamar lehu gistera kaamritu vehaamar ulla ben zakkay amar nekeru berov tzad echad nishtabberu berov shene tzedadin
Amar lach hatam ze shello keneged ze hacha ze keneged ze
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan berov shene tzedadin uvrov shene tzedadin i efshar dela kayema chada minayehu ze keneged ze
Hatam buchna bela asita hacha buchna vaasita
I hachi hayenu derav la shemia lehu derav
Velivo mineh kidrav savri live mineh chada defaresh lan tarte dei baenan mineh chada hanicha i amar lan terefa kol shekken tarte i amar lan keshera akkatti tarte ka mibaya lan
I hachi hashta name deka bae mineh tarte hanicha i amar lehu keshera kol shekken chada vei amar lehu terefa akkatti chada mibaya lehu
Savri im ken mirtach ka ratach chada terefa tarte mibaya
Veha ka amri leh vela ratach kevan dekaamar lehu gistera kaamritu hayenu ritcheh
Amar rabba bar rav shela amar rav matna amar shemuel neekra tzela meikarah vegulgolet shennechbesa berubba uvasar hachofe et rov hakkares berubbo terefa
Neekra tzela meikarah terefa urminhu
b: Kamma chissaron beshidra bet shammay omrim shette chulot uvet hillel omrim chulya achat veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel vechen litrefa
Hacha tzela belo chulya hatam chulya belo tzela
Bishlama tzela belo chulya mashkachatte lah ella chulya belo tzela hechi mashkachatte lah beshilhe kafle
Matkef lah rav oshaya velitneyah gabbe kulle bet shammay vechumre bet hillel amar leh rav ki itshil leinyan tuma itshil dehau lehu bet shammay lechumra
Vegulgolet shennechbesa berubbah bae rabbi yirmeya rov govhah o rov hekefah teku
Uvasar hachofe rov hakkares berubbo bae rav ashe berov karua o berov natul

Tifshot leh midditnan kares happenimit shennikva o shennikra rov hachitzona veamri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina kol hakkares kullo zo hi kares happenimi vee zehu kares hachitzona basar hachofe et rov hakkares
Mide hu tama ella lishmuel hachi amar rabbi yaakov bar nachmani amar shemuel makom sheen bo melat
Udrusat hazzeev amar rav yehuda amar rav bivhema min hazzeev ulmala uvofot min hannetz ulmala
Lemaote may ilema lemaote chatul tenena udrusat hazzeev vechi tema ha ka mashma lan dizev begassa name dares veha tenan rabbi yehuda omer derusat hazzeev baddakka udrusat ari baggassa
Vechi tema rabbi yehuda miflag pelig vehaamar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi ila lo ba rabbi yehuda ella lefaresh divre chachamim
Gavra aggavra ka ramet ibaet ema leolam lemaote chatul mahu detema orcha demilleta katane ka mashma lan
Amar rav amram amar rav chisda derusat chatul unmiyya bigdayim utlaim derusat chulda beofot metivi derusat chatul netz unmiyya ad shettinakev lechalal aval derusa let lehu
Vetisbera netz la dares vehatnan udrusat hannetz ha la kashya kan beofot kan bigdayim utlaim
Mikkol makom lerav chisda kashya hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya beribi omer lo amru en derusa ella bemakom sheen matztzilin aval bimkom sheyyesh matztzilin yesh derusa

Uvimkom sheen matztzilin en derusa veha hahi tarnegolta dahavay be rav kahana dirhat chatul batrah veal leidrona veitchid dashsha beappeh umachyeh ledashsha besichufeh veishtechach alah chamsha kurte dema
Hatztzalat atzmah name kehatztzalat acherim dame verabbanan zihara it leh vela kale zihareh
Ika deamri ha manni beribi hi detanya beribi omer lo amru yesh derusa ella bimkom sheyyesh matztzilin aval bimkom sheen matztzilin in derusa

Uvimkom sheen matztzilin en derusa veha hahi tarnegolta dahavay be rav kahana dirhat chatul batrah veal leidrona veitchid dashsha beappeh umachyeh ledashsha besichufeh veishtechach aleh chamishsha kurte dema hatztzalat atzmah name kehatztzalat acherim damya
Bea mineh rav kahana merav

a: Yesh derusa lechatul o en derusa lechatul amar leh af lechulda yesh derusa yesh derusa lechulda o en derusa lechulda amar leh af lechatul en derusa
Lechatul ulchulda yesh lahen derusa o en lahen derusa amar leh lechatul yesh derusa lechulda en derusa
Vela kashya ha daamar leh af lechulda yesh derusa beofot ha daamar leh af lechatul en derusa beimre ravreve ha daamar leh lechatul yesh derusa lechulda en derusa bigdayim utlaim
Bae rav ashe shear ofot temein yesh lahen derusa o en lahen derusa amar leh rav hillel lerav ashe ki havenan be rav kahana amar shear ofot temein yesh lahen derusa
Vehaanan tenan udrusat hannetz beof haddak derusat hanetz bedichvateh veinach bidzutra minayehu veika deamri derusat hannetz bidrabbi mineh veinach bedichvatayehu

Amar rav kahana mishshemeh derav shimi bar ashe en derusa leshual ini veha ki ata rav dimi amar maase vedaras shual rachel bammerchatz shel bet hine uva maase lifne chachamim veamru yesh derusa amar rav safra hahi chatul hava

Ika deamri amar rav kahana mishshemeh derav shimi bar ashe yesh derusa leshual ini veha ki ata rav dimi amar maase vedaras shual rachel bammerchatz shel bet hine uva maase lifne chachamim veamru en derusa amar rav safra hahu kelev hava amar rav yosef naktinan en derusa lechelev

Amar abbaye naktinan en derusa ella bayyad leappoke regel dela en derusa ella betzipporen leappoke shen dela en derusa ella middaat leappoke shello middaat dela en derusa ella mechayyim leappoke leachar mita dela
Amri hashta shello middaat amratte la leachar mita mibaya la tzericha dedares ufaskuha lideh mahu detema bahade dedares shade zihareh ka mashma lan bahade deshalef shade zihareh

Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav ari shennichnas leven hashshevarim venimtza tzipporen begabbo shel echad mehen en choshshin shemma ari deraso may tama rov araot dorsin umiutan en dorsin vechol haddores en tzipporno nishmetet vezot hoil vetzipporen yoshevet lo begabbo emar bakkotel nitchakkech
Adderabba rov shevarim mitchakkechin umiutan en mitchakkechin vechol hammitchakkech en tzipporen yoshevet lo begabbo veze hoil vetzipporen yoshevet lo begabbo emar ari deraso
Ika lememar hachi veika lememar hachi oke milta tora achezkeh have leh sefek derusa verav letameh deamar en choshshin lisfek derusa
Amar abbaye la amaran ella tzipporen aval mekom tzipporen choshshin vetzipporen name la amaran ella lacha aval yevesha avda demishtamta
Velacha name la amaran ella chada aval tarte utlat chayeshinan vehu dekayema bedara desichufeh
Itmar rav amar en choshshin lisfek derusa ushmuel amar choshshin lisfek derusa

Dechulle alma safek al safek la al ema la al sefek kalba sefek shunara ema kalba al shetek veyatev benayehu emar shelama shavi keta resheh dechad minayehu nach meritcheh ihu ka meavey veinhu kamkarkeran baote ka mevaati
b: Ahadade ki peligi deihu ka shatek veinhu kamkarkeran mar savar maase ka aved behu umar savar mechamat biatuteh hu deka avdan
Amar ammemar hilcheta choshshin lisfek derusa amar leh rav ashe leammemar hay derav may amar leh la shemia li kelomar la sevira li
Vei baet ema hadar beh rav legabbe dishmuel dehahu sharkafa disfek derusot daata lekammeh derav shadderinhu lekammeh dishmuel chankinhu ushdanhu benahara vei salka datach la hadar beh lishrinhu
Ella may hadar beh lesrinhu ella atreh dishmuel hava
Lema li lemichnekinhu lishdinhu hachi benahara mefarchan vesalkan
Ulshahinhu shenem asar chodesh ate behu lide takkala velizabbeninhu legoyim atu lezabboninhu leyisrael
Velichnekinhu velishdinhu leashpa velitamach nishdinhu lichlavim ella lefarsome milleta deisura

Hahu bar avaza dahava be rav ashe al levene kenayya nefak ata ki memasmas koeh dema amar rav ashe la amrinan sefek kalba sefek shunara emar kalba hacha name sefek kanya sefek shunara emar kanya machyeh
Amri bene rabbi chiyya derusa sheamru tzericha bedika keneged bene meayim
Amar rav yosef ha divne rabbi chiyya kevar pershah shemuel deamar shemuel mishshum rabbi chanina ben antignos derusa sheamru tzericha bedika keneged bene meayim

Bae ilfa yesh derusa lesimanim o en derusa lesimanim amar rabbi zera ha devae ilfa kevar pershah rav chanan bar rava deamar rav chanan bar rava amar rav derusa sheamru tzericha bedika keneged bet hechalal kullo vaafilu besimanin
Bae ilfa simanin shenniddaldelu bechamma amar rabbi zera ha devae ilfa kevar pershah rabba bar bar chana deamar rabba bar bar chana amar shemuel simanim shenniddaldelu berubban
Bae rav amme hamasmasa mahu amar rabbi zera ha devae rav amme kevar pershah rav yehuda deamar rav yehuda amar rav bidrusa ad sheyyaadim basar keneged bene meayim nitmasmes habbasar roin oto keilu eno

Hechi dame nitmasmes amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua kol sheharofe gordo umaamido al basar chay amar rav ashe ki havenan be rav kahana ayeto kamman hahi rea dechi hao motvi lah yatva shappir vechi hao madlu lah hava talcha venafla tilche tilche vetarefna lah midderav huna bereh derav yehoshua

Rav nachman amar bekotz ad shettinakev lechalal bidrusa mishsheyyaadim basar keneged bene meayim rav zevid matne hachi bidrusa mishsheyyaadim basar keneged bene meayim besimanim ad sheyyaadimu simanim atzmam
Amar rav pappi bae rav bivi bar abbaye

a: Veshet nekuvato bemashshehu derusato bemashshehu kane nekuvato bichisar derusato bechamma batar devaya hadar pashtah echad ze veechad ze bemashshehu may tama zihareh mikla kale veazel
Yatev rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta kammeh derav nachman veyatev vekaamar derusa sheamru tzericha bedika keneged bene meayim rav nachman amar haelohim more bah rav mikkappa vead atma
May kappa ilema kappa dida hayenu keneged bene meayim ella mikkappa democha ad atma

Ki selek rav chiyya bar yosef ashkechinhu lerabbi yochanan veresh lakish deyatvi vekaamri derusa sheamru tzericha bedika keneged bene meayim amar lehu haelohim more bah rav mikkappa vead atma amar leh resh lakish mannu rav umannu rav vela yadana leh

Amar rabbi yochanan vela nehira leh leoto talmid sheshshimesh et rabbi rabba verabbi chiyya vehaelohim kol otan shanim sheshshimesh oto talmid bishiva ani shimmashti baamida uman gevar hu gevar becholla
Miyyad patach resh lakish vaamar beram zachur oto haish lattov sheamru shemua mippiv shemuta ushchuta keshera shei efshar lashshemuta shettease shechuta
Verabbi yochanan omer yavi veyakkif
Amar rav nachman lo shanu ella shello tafas besimanim aval tafas besimanim veshachat efshar lashshemuta shettease shechuta
Ze hakkelal leetoye may leetoye shav shematata
Deve yosef rishba machu begida nashya vekatli ato lekammeh derabbi yehuda ben betera amar lehu vechi lehosif al hatterefot yesh en lecha ella ma shemmanu chachamim
Rav pappa bar abba rishba machu bechulya vekatli ato lekammeh derabbi abba amar lehu vechi lehosif al hatterefot yesh en lecha ella ma shemmanu chachamim
Veha ka chazenan deka meta gemiri dei badri lah samma chayya

Matni veellu kesherot babbehema nikva haggargeret o shennisdeka ad kamma techsar rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ad keisar haitalki nifchata haggulgolet velo nikav kerum shel moach nikav hallev velo levet chalalo nishbera hashshidra velo nifsak hachut shellah nitla hakkaved venishtayyer hemenna kezayit
Hemses uvet hakkosot shennikvu ze letoch ze nital hattechol nitlu hakkelaot nital lechi hattachton nitla haem shellah vacharuta bide shamayim haggeluda rabbi meir machshir vachachamim poslin
Gema ittemar rabbi yochanan amar ellu terefot daveka verabbi shimon ben lakish amar ellu kesherot daveka
Bemay ka mipalgi bidrav matna deamar rav matna hay buka deatma deshaf midduchteh terefa rabbi yochanan amar ellu terefot daveka tena terefot utna ze hakkelal
b: Vechazyah lidrav matna deatya beze hakkelal may tama dedamya lintule tena ellu terefot hane hu ditrefa ha derav matna keshera

Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar ellu kesherot daveka tena terefot utna ze hakkelal vechazyah lidrav matna dela atya beze hakkelal may tama lav linkuve damya vela lifsuke damya velintule name la damya tena ellu kesherot hane hu dichsherot ha derav matna terefa
Gufa amar rav matna hay buka deatma deshaf midduchteh terefa verava amar keshera vei ipsik niveh terefa vehilcheta ipsik name keshera ad demitachla itachole
Ad kamma techsar amar zeeri attun dela mitchame lechon shiura shiureh bedinara kurdinaa vehave kifshita zutarti umishtachcha bene peshite defumbedita

Amar rabbi chana paturaa ila minay hava kae bar nappacha uva minay dinara kurdinaa leshaore beh terefta uvay lemekam mikkammeh vela shevakni amar li shev beni shev en baale ummaniyyot rashshain laamod mippene talmide chachamim beshaa sheasukin bimlachtam
Vela vehatnan kol baale ummaniyyot omdim mippenehem veshoalin bishloman veomrin lahem achenu anshe mekom peloni boachem beshalom
Amar rabbi yochanan mippenehem omdin mippene talmide chachamim en omdin amar rabbi yose bar avin bo ure kamma chaviva mitzva bishatah shehare mippenehem omdin mippene talmide chachamim en omdin
Mimmay dilma kede shello tehe nimtza machshilan leatid lavo
Amar rav nachman kesela keyater mikkesela keisar keyater mikkeisar
Alma kasavar rav nachman ad velo ad bakkelal
Etiveh rava lerav nachman chevel hayyotze min hammitta ad chamishsha tefachim tahor may lav chamishsha kilmatta lo chamishsha kilmala
Ta shema mechamishsha vead asara tame may lav asara kilmatta la asara kilmala
Ta shema haddakkin shebbichli cheres hen vekarkerotehen vedofnotehem yoshvin shello mesummachin

a: Shiuran bichde sichat katan vead log may lav log kilmatta lo log kilmala
Ta shema millog ad sea birviit may lav sea kilmatta la sea kilmala
Ta shema missea vead satayim bachatzi log may lav satayim kilmatta la satayim kilmala
Vehatanya log kilmatta sea kilmatta satayim kilmatta
Hatam lechumra deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan kol shiure chachamim lehachmir chutz mikkigris shel ketamim lehakel
Dayeka name dekatane alah dehahi chamishsha kilmala asara kilmatta
Nital hattechol amar rav avira mishshemeh derava lo shanu ella nital aval nikav terefa
Metiv rabbi yose bar avin veitema rabbi yose bar zevida chotech meubbar shebbemeeha muttar baachila min hattechol umin hakkelaot asur baachila ha behema gufah sharya
Hu haddin daafilu behema name asira ayede ditna resha muttar baachila tena name sefa asur baachila veibaet ema nikav lechod venechtach lechud
Nitlu hakkelaot amar rachish bar pappa mishshemeh derav lakta bechulya achat terefa amri bemareva vehu dimtay lakuta
b: Limkom charitz vehecha mekom charitz lechivara detute motne amar rav nechunya sheeltinhu lechullehu tarofae demareva veamri li hilcheta kerachish bar pappa velet hilcheta kerav avira
Derav avira name la amaran ella bekulsheh aval besumcheh terefa vei ishteyar beh keovi dinar zahav keshera
Amri bemareva kol happosel barea kasher bakkulya shehare nekev pasul barea vechasher bakkulya vechol shekken hecha dechasher barea kasher bakkulya

Matkef lah rabbi tanchuma uchlala hu hare mugla dechasher barea ufasul bakkulya vahare mayim zakkin dichsherim hacha vehacha ella amar rav ashe terefot ka medammet lahadade en omrim bitrefot zo doma lazo shehare chotchah mikkan vameta chotchah mikkan vechayeta
Umayim zakkin kesherim la amaran ella detzili aval achiri terefa vechi tzili name la amaran ella dela seriach aval seriach terefa
Hakkulya shehiktina baddakka ad kefol baggassa ad kaanava benonit
Nital lechi hattachton amar rabbi zera lo shanu ella sheyechola lichot al yede leita vehamraa aval enah yechola lichot al yede leita vehamraa terefa
Nitla haem shellah tana hi haem hi tarpachat vehi shalpuchit
Vacharuta bide shamayim keshera tanu rabbanan ezohi charuta kol shetztzamka rea shellah bide shamayim keshera bide adam terefa rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af bide kol habberiyyot
Ibaya lehu rabbi shimon ben elazar aresha kae ulkulla o assefa kae ulchumra
Ta shema detanya charuta bide adam terefa rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af bide kol habberiyyot

Rabba bar bar chana hava kaazel bemadbera ashkach hanhu dichre ditzmik rea didhu ata sheel be midresha amaru leh bekayeta ayeti meshichle chivare umallinhu mayya karire veannechinhu meet leet i hadran baryan bide shamayim hi uchshera vei la terefa besitva ayeti meshichle shichume umallinhu mayya pashore veannechinhu meet leet i hadra barya keshera vei la terefa
Haggeluda tanu rabbanan haggeluda rabbi meir machshir vachachamim poslim uchvar heid elazar safra veochanan ben gudgeda al haggeluda sheppesula amar rabbi shimon ben elazar chazar bo rabbi meir

Mikkelal dilrabbi shimon ben elazar pelig rabbi meir bigluda vehatanya amar rabbi shimon ben elazar lo nechleku rabbi meir vachachamim al haggeluda sheppesula uchvar heid rabbi oshaya beno shel rabbi yehuda habbassam lifne rabbi akiva mishshum rabbi tarfon al haggeluda sheppesula veim nishtayyer bo kesela keshera amar rav nachman bar yitzchak may lo nechleku lo amad rabbi meir bemachalokto
Amar mar im nishtayyer bo kesela keshera hecha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel al pene hashshidra kullah

Ibaya lehu daarich vekattin dechi metzaref lah have kesela o dilma berochav sela al pene hashshidra kullah ta shema defaresh rabbi nehoray mishshemeh dishmuel berochav kesela al pene kol hashshidra kullah
Rabba bar bar chana amar rashe ferakim rabbi elazar ben antignos mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi yannay amar mekom tiburo
Bae rabbi yannay berabbi yishmael nital mekom hashshidra vechullo kayyam nital mekom tiburo vechullo kayyam nitlu rashe ferakim vechullo kayyam may teku
Amar rav kol haor kullo matztzil bigluda chutz meor bet happerasot verabbi yochanan amar afilu or bet happerasot name matztzil

Bea mineh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan or bet happerasot mahu sheyyatztzil bigluda amar leh matztzil amar leh limmadtanu rabbenu ellu sheorotehen kivsaran or bet happerasot amar leh al takniteni shebbilshon yachid ani shone otah
Detanya hashshochet et haola lehaktir kezayit meor shel tachat haalya chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmanno piggul vechayyavin alav karet

Eliezer ben yehuda ish evlayim amar mishshum rabbi yaakov vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar ikus omer mishshum rabbi shimon echad or bet happerasot veechad or harosh shel egel harach veechad or shel tachat haalya vechol shemmanu chachamim gabbe tuma ellu sheorotehen kivsaran

a: Lehavi or bet habboshet chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmanno pigul vechayyavim alav karet

Matni veellu terefot baof nekuvat haveshet ufsukat haggargeret hikketa chulda al roshah makom sheose otah terefa nikav hakkurkevan nikvu haddakkin nafla laur venechmeru bene meeha im yerukkim pesulim im adummim kesherim derasah utrafah bakkotel o sheritztzatta behema umfarkeset veshahata meet leet ushchatah keshera
Gema rav ushmuel velevi deamri machnis yado lifnim uvodek im mevatzbetz veole terefa veim lav keshera
Hanicha leman deamar ad deminnekiv kerama tattaa ella leman deamar inkiv ilaa af al gav dela inkiv tattaa nechush dilma ilaa inkiv tattaa la inkiv i ita deinkiv ilaa tattaa aggav rukkecheh mifka paka
Amar zeeri en bedika lechulda mippene sheshshineha dakkot vechi shineha dakkot may have amar rav oshaya mippene sheshshineha dakkot vaakummot

Ki selek linhardea shelach lehu devarim sheamarti lifnechem taut hen beyadi beram kach amru mishshemeh derabbi shimon ben lakish bodkin lechulda bayyad aval lo bemasmer verabbi yochanan amar af bemasmer

Uviflugta derabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya chad badek bida vechad badek bemachta man devadek bida amar leh leman devadek bemachta ad matay atta mechalle mamonan shel yisrael amar leh man devadek bemachta leman devadek bida ad matay atta maachil leyisrael nevelot
Nevelot veha shechuta hi ella terefot shemma nikav kerum shel moach

Tistayyem derabbi yehuda hu devadek bida detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi yehuda bodkin lechulda bayyad aval lo bemasmer nishbar haetzem af al pi shello nikav kerum shel moach tistayyem

Ha gufa kashya amratte bodkin lechulda bayyad aval lo bemasmer alma it leh bedikuta vahadar tane nishbar haetzem af al pi shello nikav kerum shel moach alma let leh bedikuta sefa atan leof shel mayim hoil veen lo kerum en lo kerum salka datach ella hoil ukrumo rach
