Mesayya leh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol maase vereshit bekomatan nivreu bedatan nivreu betzivonam nivreu shenneemar vayechullu hashshamayim vehaaretz vechol tzevaam al tikre tzevaam ella tzivonam
Daresh rabbi chanina bar pappa yehi chevod Adonai leolam yismach Adonai bemaasav pasuk ze sar haolam amaro beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu leminehu bailanot nasu deshaim kal vachomer beatzman
Im retzono shel hakkadosh baruch hu beirbuvya lamma amar leminehu bailanot veod kal vachomer uma ilanot sheen darkan latzet beirbuvya amar hakkadosh baruch hu leminehu anu al achat kamma vechamma
Miyyad kol echad veechad yatza lemino patach sar haolam veamar yehi chevod Adonai leolam yismach Adonai bemaasav
Bae ravina hirkiv shene deshaim ze al gav ze
b: Lerabbi chanina bar pappa mahu kevan dela ketav behu leminehu la michayyav o dilma kevan dehiskim ayedayehu keman dichtiv behu leminehu damya teku

Rabbi shimon ben pazzi rame ketiv vayyaas elohim et shene hammeorot haggedolim uchtiv et hammaor haggadol veet hammaor hakkaton amra yareach lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam efshar lishne melachim sheyyishtammeshu becheter echad amar lah lechi umaati et atzmech

Amra lefanav ribbono shel olam hoil veamarti lefanecha davar hagun amit et atzmi amar lah lechi umshol bayyom uvallayela amara leh may revuteh dishraga betihara may ahani amar lah zil limno bach yisrael yamim veshanim amra leh yoma name i efshar dela manu beh tekufata dichtiv vehau leotot ulmoadim ulyamim veshanim zil likro tzaddike bishmich yaakov hakkatan shemuel hakkatan david hakkatan

Chazyah dela ka miyyatteva datah amar hakkadosh baruch hu haviu kappara alay shemmiatti et hayyareach vehayenu deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish ma nishtanna sair shel rosh chodesh shenneemar bo la amar hakkadosh baruch hu sair ze yehe kappara al shemmiatti et hayyareach

Rav assi rame ketiv vattotze haaretz deshe bitlata beshabba uchtiv vechol siach hassade terem yihye vaaretz bemaale shabbeta melammed sheyyatzu deshaim veamdu al petach karka ad shebba adam harishon uvikkesh alehem rachamim veyardu geshamim vetzamchu lelammedcha shehakkadosh baruch hu mitave litfillatan shel tzaddikim
Rav nachman bar pappa haveya leh hahi ginta shedi bah bizrane vela tzemach bea rachame ata mitra utzmach amar hayenu derav assi
Amar rav chanan bar rava hashshesua beriyya bifne atzmah hi sheyyesh lah shene gabbin ushne shidraot vechi moshe rabbenu kenigi haya o ballistari haya mikkan teshuva laomer en tora min hashshamayim
Amar leh rav chisda lerav tachlifa bar avina zil ketov kenigi uvallistari beaggadtach ufarshah

Veet chameshet sarne felishtim haazzati vehaashdodi haeshkeloni haggitti vehaekroni vehaavim amar chamsha vechashev shita amar rabbi yonatan arunke shellahen chamishsha amar leh rav chisda lerav tachlifa bar avina ketov arunke beaggadtach ufarshah ufliga derav deamar rav avim mitteman bau

Tanya name hachi avim mitteman bau velamma nikra sheman avim sheivtu et mekoman davar acher avim sheiuu leelohot harbe davar acher avim shekkol haroe otam ochazto avit amar rav yosef veit lehu shitasre dare shine lechol chad vechad
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish harbe mikraot sheruyin lisrof kesifre minin vehen hen gufe tora vehaavim hayyoshvim bachatzerim ad azza may nafka lan minah
Middeashbeeh avimelech leavraham im tishkor li ulnini ulnechdi amar hakkadosh baruch hu leto kaftorim lipku meavim dehayenu pelishtim veleto yisrael lipku mikkaftorim

Keotze baddavar atta omer ki cheshbon ir sichon melech haemori hi vehu nilcham bemelech moav vego may nafka minah daamar lehu hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael al tatzar et moav amar hakkadosh baruch hu lete sichon lipok mimmoav veleto yisrael velipku missichon vehayenu deamar rav pappa ammon umoav tiharu besichon

Tzidonim yikreu lechermon siryon tana senir vesiron mehare eretz yisrael melammed shekkol echad veechad meumot haolam halach uvana lo kerach gadol leatzmo veheela lo al shem hare eretz yisrael lelammedcha sheafilu hare eretz yisrael chavivin al umot haolam
Kayyotze bo veet haam heevir oto learim may nafka minah dela likro leechav galvata
Simane haof lo neemru vela vehatanya nesher

a: Ma nesher meuchad sheen lo etzba yetera vezefek veen kurkevano niklaf vedores veochel tame af kol kayyotze bo tame torin sheyyesh lahen etzba yetera vezefek vekurkevan niklaf veen dorsin veochlin tehorin af kol kayyotze bahen tehorin amar abbaye lo neemar perushan middivre tora ella middivre sofrim
Tane rabbi chiyya of habba besiman echad tahor lefi sheen dome lenesher nesher delet leh kelal hu dela techol ha ika deit leh chad techol
Velelaf mittorin ma torin deika kullehu arbea af hacha name ad deika kullehu arbea
Im ken shear ofot temein dichtav rachamana lema li
Venelaf minayehu ma hatam telata vela achlinan af kol telata vela nechol vechol shekken tere vechad
Im ken orev dichtav rachamana lema li hashta deit leh telata la achlinan deit leh tere mibaya
b: Velelaf meorev ma hatam tere la af kol tere la im ken peres veozniyya dichtav rachamana lema li hashta deit leh tere la achlinan deit leh chad mibaya
Venigmar mipperes veozniyya im ken nesher dichtav rachamana lema li hashta deit leh chad la achlinan delet leh kelal mibaya ella nesher delet leh kelal hu dela techol ha deit leh chad echol
Veella tama dichtav rachamana nesher ha lav hachi hava amena lelaf mipperes veozniyya have leh peres veozniyya shene chetuvin habbain keechad ushne ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Gemiri deika behay leka behay udika behay leka behay
Mikkede esrim vearbaa ofot temeim hau i efshar dechad deika behanach leka behane vehau lehu shene ketuvim habbaim keechad

Gemiri esrim vearbaa ofot temeim hau vearbaa simanin telata hadri bechullehu esrim mehem shelosha shelosha utre beorev chad beferes vechad beozniyya deiteh beha leteh beha mahu detema lelaf mineh ketav rachamana nesher nesher delet leh kelal hu dela techol ha ika deit leh chad echol
Ella torin dichtav rachamana lema li amar rav ukva bar chama lekorban amar rav nachman

a: Haya baki bahen uvishmotehen of habba besiman echad tahor lo haya baki bahen uvishmotehen besiman echad tame bishne simanin tahor vehu sheyyakkir orev

Orev vetu la vehatanya orev ze orev lemino rabbi eliezer omer lehavi et hazzarzir amru lo lerabbi eliezer vahalo anshe kefar temarta shebbihuda hau ochlim otan mippene sheyyesh lahen zefek amar lahem af hen atidin liten et haddin

Davar acher leminehu lehavi senunit levana divre rabbi eliezer amru lo vahalo anshe galil haelon ochlim oto mippene shekkurkevano niklaf amar lahem af hen atidin liten et haddin ella orev vechol min orev

Amar ammemar hilcheta of habba besiman echad tahor vehu dela dares amar leh rav ashe leammemar ha derav nachman may amar leh la shemia li kelomar la sevira li may ika mishshum peres veozniyya letanhu bayyishshuv
Amar rav yehuda of hamsaret kasher letohorat metzora vezo hi senunit levana shennechleku bah rabbi eliezer vachachamim
Amar ammemar bechivara keresah kulle alma la peligi desharya ki peligi bedirukka keresah rabbi eliezer asar verabbanan sharu vehilcheta kerabbi eliezer
Mar zutra matne hachi bedirukka keresah kulle alma la peligi daasir ki peligi bidchivara keresah rabbi eliezer asar verabbanan sharu vehilcheta kerabbanan desharu
Bishlama leman deamar bechivara keresah peligi hayenu dekatane zo hi senunit levana ella leman deamar bedirukka peligi may zo hi senunit levana leappoke devatte deukkamti

Amar rachava amar rabbi yehuda tasil pasul mishshum torin vechasher mishshum bene yona datzifi vetorin shel rechava kesherin mishshum torin ufsulin mishshum bene yona metiv rav daniel bar rav kattina kal haofot
b: Poslin beme chattat chutz min hayyona mippene shemmotzetzet veim ita litne chutz miyyona vetasil amar rabbi zera ze motzetz umeki veze motzetz veeno meki

Amar rav yehuda hane kufshane tzutzyane kesherim legabbe mizbeach vehen hen torin shel rechava metivi ezov velo ezov yon velo ezov kocholi velo ezov romi velo midbari velo kol ezov sheyyesh lo shem levay

Amar abbaye kol shennishtanna shemo kodem mattan tora vehikpida tora alav yesh lo shem levay pasul vehane lo nishtanna sheman kodem mattan tora rava amar hane kufshane tzutzyane beatrayehu setama kare lehu
Amar rav yehuda hane keraze deve chilfe sharu udve kerave asiri amar ravina umalkinan alayehu mishshum sheretz haof veamar rav yehuda tzerada shere barda asir vesimanach bar mineh marda sefeka

Amar rav assi shemona sefekot hen chova chuga suga veharnuga tushlemi umarda kochilna uvar nappacha may sefekayehu ofot tehorim kurkevanan niklaf utmein en kurkevanan niklaf vehane kurkevanan niklaf besakkina
Veha hahi bar avaza dahava be mar shemuel dela hava ka mikkelef kurkevaneh veotveh beshimsha vechevan derafe iklef hatam ki rafe iklef bida hacha af al gav derafe la mikkelef ella besakkina

Amar abbaye tarnegola deagma chad mishshemona sefekot hu vehayenu mardu amar rav pappa tarnegola deagma asira tarnegolta deagma sharya vesimanach ammoni velo ammonit derash marimar tarnegolta deagma asira chazuha dedarsa veachla vehayenu geruta
Amar rav shabbur anaddarpatta shere peruz anaddarpatta asir vesimanach peruz rashshia amar rav huna bunya shere parva asir vesimanach parvaa amgusha

Amar rav pappa mardu zaged veachel shere saged veachel asir vesimanach lo tishtachave leel acher amar shemuel shatya chamra asira vesimanach shetuye yayin pesulin laavoda veamar shemuel mazga chamra asira

a: Bat mazga chamra sharya vesimanach yafe koach habben mikkoach haav
Amar rav yehuda shekitana ariche shake vesummake sharya vesimanach murzema gutze vesummake asiri vesimanach nanus pasul ariche shake virukke asiri vesimanach yerukkin pesulin
Amar rav yehuda shalach ze hashshole dagim min hayyam duchifat shehodo kafut tanya name hachi duchifat shehodo kafut vezehu shehevi shamir levet hammikdash
Rabbi yochanan ki hava chaze shalach amar mishpatecha tehom rabba ki hava chaze nemala amar tzidkatcha keharre el

Amar ammemar lakni uvatni sharyan shaknay uvatnay mekom shennahagu leechol ochlin mekom shennahagu shello leechol en ochlin attu beminhaga talya milta in vela kashya ha beatra dishchichi peres veozniyya ha beatra dela shechichi peres veozniyya
Amar abbaye kue vekakoe asiri kakoata sharya bemareva malku ilavah vekaru lah tachvata

Tanu rabbanan tinshemet bavat shebbaofot atta omer bavat shebbaofot o eno ella bavat shebbashsheratzim amarta tze ulmad mishshelosh esre middot shehattora nidreshet bahen davar hallamed meinyano bema hakkatuv medabber beofot af kan beofot

Tanya name gabbe sheratzim kehay gavena tinshemet bavat shebbashsheratzim atta omer bavat shebbashsheratzim o eno ella bavat shebbaofot amarta tze ulmad mishshelosh esre middot shehattora nidreshet bahen davar hallamed meinyano bema hakkatuv medabber bishratzim af kan bishratzim
Amar abbaye bavat shebbaofot kifof bavat shebbashsheratzim kurpeday amar rav yehuda kaat zo hakkuk racham zo sherakrak

Amar rabbi yochanan lamma nikra shemo racham kevan shebba racham bau rachamim leolam amar rav bivi bar abbaye vehu deyatev ammide veaved sherakrak ugmiri dei yatev aara vesharek ata meshicha shenneemar eshreka lahem vaakabbetzem
Amar leh rav adda bar shimi lemar bar rav iday veha hahu deyatev be cherava ushrak vaata galal afsekeh lemocheh amar leh hahu bayyada hava
Tanu rabbanan orev ze orev et kol orev lehavi orev haimki lemino lehavi orev have berashe yonim

Amar mar orev ze orev attu kamman kae ella ema orev ze orev ukkama vechen hu omer kevutztzotav taltallim shechorot kaorev haimki chivara vechen hu omer umarehu amok min haor kemare chamma haamukka min hatztzel
Veorev habba berashe yonim amar rav pappa la tema deate beresh yone ella dedame resheh lidona
Tanu rabbanan hannetz ze hannetz leminehu lehavi et bar chirya may bar chirya amar abbaye shurinka
Amar rav yehuda hachasida zo dayya levana lamma nikra shemah chasida sheosa chasidut im chavroteha haanafa zo dayya ragzanit lamma nikra shemah anafa shemmenaafet im chavroteha

Amar rav chanan bar rav chisda amar rav chisda amar rav chanan bereh derava amar rav esrim vearbaa ofot temein hen amar leh rav chanan bar rav chisda lerav chisda dehecha i devayyikra esrim hau i demishne tora esrim vechad hau vechi tema daa dichtiva bevayyikra vela ketiva bemishne tora shidyah alayehu akkatti esrin utren hau
Amar leh hachi amar avuh deimmach mishshemeh derav leminah leminah lemino leminehu hare kan arba i hachi esrin veshet hau amar abbaye daa veraa achat hi dei salka datach tarte inun
b: Mikkede mishne tora leosofe hu daata may shena hacha dichtiv daa umay shena hacha dichtiv raa vela ketiv daa ella shema minah min raa vedaa achat hi

Veakkatti esrin vechamsha hau amar abbaye keshem sheraa vedaa achat hi kach ayya vedayya achat hi dei salka datach tarte inun mikkede mishne tora leosofe hu daata may shena hacha dichtiv leminah aayya umay shena hatam dichtiv leminah addayya ella shema minah ayya vedayya achat hi

Vechi meachar sheayya vedayya achat hi lema leh lemichtav ayya vedayya kidtanya rabbi omer ekra ani ayya dayya lamma neemra kede shello titten pitchon pe levaal din lachlok shello tehe atta kore ayya vehu kore dayya atta kore dayya vehu kore ayya lechach katav bemishne tora veharaa veet haayya vehaddayya leminah
Metivi lamma nishnu bivhema mippene hashshesua uvaofot mippene haraa may lav middivhema dehatam leosofe ofot name leosofe la hatam leosofe hacha lefaroshe
Ufliga derabbi avahu deamar rabbi avahu raa zo ayya velamma nikra shemah raa sheroa beoter vechen hu omer nativ lo yedao ayit velo shezafattu en ayya tana omedet bevavel veroa nevela beeretz yisrael
Midderaa hayenu ayya mikkelal dedaa lav hayenu raa mikkede mishne tora leosofe hu daata may shena hacha dichtiv daa umay shena hatam dela ketiv daa ella lav shema minah daa veraa veayya achat hi
Umidderaa hayenu ayya mikkelal dedayya lav hayenu ayya may shena hatam dichtiv leminehu aayya umay shena hacha dela ketiv leminehu aayya ella addayya ella shema minah daa veraa dayya veayya achat hi

Tanya isi ben yehuda omer mea ofot temein yesh bammizrach vechullan min ayya hen tane avimi bereh derabbi avahu sheva meot mine dagim hen ushmone meot mine chagavim ulofot en mispar ofot esrin vearbaa hau ella ulofot tehorim en mispar

Tanya rabbi omer galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam shebbehema temea merubba min hattehorot lefichach mana hakkatuv battehora galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam sheofot tehorin merubbin al hattemein lefichach mana hakkatuv battemein
May ka mashma lan kidrav huna amar rav veamri lah amar rav huna amar rav mishshum rabbi meir leolam yishne adam letalmido derech ketzara
Amar rabbi yitzchak of tahor neechal bemasoret neeman hatztzayyad lomar of ze tahor masar li rabbi amar rabbi yochanan vehu shebbaki bahen uvishmotehen

Bae rabbi zera rabbo chacham o rabbo tzayyad ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan vehu shebbaki bahen uvishmotehen i amratte bishlama rabbo tzayyad shappir ella i amratte rabbo chacham bishlama shemayehu gemir lehu ella inhu mi yada lehu ella lav shema minah rabbo tzayyad shema minah
Tanu rabbanan lokchin betzim min haggoyim bechol makom veen choshshin lo mishshum nevelot velo mishshum terefot
Vedilma deof tame ninhu amar avuh dishmuel beomer shel of peloni tahor velema shel of tahor i hachi it leh leishtemote
Velivdok besimanin detanya kesimane vetzim kach simane dagim simane dagim salka datach senappir vekaskeset amar rachamana ella ema kach simane

a: Ubbere dagim

Vetanya gabbe vetzim ellu hen simane vetzim kal shekkoderet vaagulgolet roshah echad kad veroshah echad chad tehora shene rasheha kaddin o shene rasheha chaddin temein chelbon mibbachutz vechelmon mibbifnim tehora chelmon mibbachutz vechelbon mibbefanim temea chelmon vechelbon meoravin ze baze beyadua shehi betzat hashsheretz
La tzericha dachatuchot velivdok bechelmon vechelbon bitrufot bikara
Uchhay gavena mi zavninan minayehu veha tanya en mochrin betzat terefa legoy ella im ken terufa bikara lefichach en lokchin mehem betzim terufot bikara
Ella amar rabbi zera simanin lav deorayeta dei la tema hachi ha deamar rav assi shemona sefekot hen livdok bevetzim didhu ella shema minah simanin lav deorayeta

Ella lemay hilcheta katane lah hachi kaamar shene rasheha kaddin o shene rasheha chaddin o chelmon mibbachutz vechelbon mibbifnim vadday temea resheh chad chad resheh chad kad vechelbon mibbachutz vechelmon mibbifnim veamar lach shel of peloni vetahor hu semoch aleh bistama la tismoch aleh deika deorva dedame lidona
Amar mar chelbon vechelmon meoravin ze baze beyadua shehi betzat hashsheretz lemay hilcheta amar rav ukva bar chama lomar sheim rikma venikva bechaadasha metamme
Matkef lah ravina vedilma denachash hi ella amar rava sheim rikma veachla loke aleha mishshum sheretz hashshoretz al haaretz
I hachi may irya ditmea afilu dithora name detanya kol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz
b: Lerabbot efrochim shello niftechu enehem midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma
Tanu rabbanan giule betzim muttarot betzim muzarot nefesh yafa tochlem nimtza aleha koret dam zorek et haddam veochel et hashshear

Amar rabbi yirmeya vehu shennimtza al kesher shellah tane dostay avuh derabbi aftoriki lo shanu ella shennimtza al chelbon shellah aval nimtza al chelmon shellah afilu betza asura may tama dishda tichla bechullah amar leh rav geviha mibbe chetil lerav ashe ipcha tane tanna kammeh deabbaye veabbaye hu detartzah nihaleh hachi

Amar chizkiyya minnayin levetzat temea shehi asura min hattora shenneemar veet bat hayyaana vechi bat yesh lah layyaana ella ezo zo betza temea vedilma hayenu shemayehu la salka datach dichtiv bat ammi leachzar kayeenim bammidbar
Vela veha ketiv eese misped kattannim veevel kivnot yaana keyaana zo shemmitabbelet al baneha veha ketiv veshachnu sham benot yaana keyaana zo sheshshochenet im baneha
Vehachtiv techabbedeni chayyat hassade tannim uvnot yaana vei salka datach betza betza bat memar shira hi ella ketiv hayyaana uchtiv bat hayyaana
Veshane hacha defasek safra lishte tevot umiddefasek lehu safra

a: Betarte tevot shema minah tere shemot ninhu
Ella meatta et kedor laomer defasek lehu safra bitre hachi name ditre sheme ninhu amri hatam bishte tevot pasek lehu bishne shitin la pasek lehu aval hacha afilu bishne shitin name pasek lehu

Aval amru chachamim kol of tanya rabban gamliel omer dores veochel beyadua shehu tame yesh lo etzba yetera vezefek vekurkevano niklaf beyadua shehu tahor rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer motchin lo chut shel meshicha im cholek et raglav shettayim lechan ushtayim lechan tame shalosh lechan veachat lechan tahor rabbi shimon ben elazar omer kol of hakkolet min haavir tame
Tziparta name miklat kalta amar abbaye kolet veochel kaamri
Acherim omrim shachen im temeim tame im tehorim tahor
Keman kerabbi eliezer detanya rabbi eliezer omer lo lechinnam halach zarzir etzel orev ella mippene shehu mino afilu tema rabbanan shachen venidme kaamrinan
Uvachagavim kol sheyyesh lo ku may rubbo amar rav yehuda amar rav rov orko veamri lah rov hekkefo amar rav pappa hilkach baenan rov orko uvaenan rov hekkefo

Tanu rabbanan en lo achshav veatid legaddel leachar zeman kegon hazzachal muttar rabbi elazar berabbi yose omer asher lo cheraayim af al pi sheen lo achshav veatid legaddel leachar zeman may zachal amar abbaye askera

Tanu rabbanan et elle mehem tochelu et haarbe vego arbe ze govay salam ze rashon chargol ze nipul chagav ze nadyan ma talmud lomar lemino leminehu leminehu leminehu arba peamim lehavi tziporet keramim veochana yerushalmit vehaartzuvya veharazbanit
Deve rabbi yishmael tana ellu kelale chelalot veellu perate feratot arbe ze govay lemino lehavi
b: Tziporet keramim
En li ella habba veen lo gabbachat habba veyesh lo gabbachat minnayin talmud lomar solam ze nipul leminehu lehavi et haushkaf
Veen li ella habba veen lo gabbachat habba veyesh lo gabbachat habba veen lo zanav habba veyesh lo zanav minnayin talmud lomar chargol ze rashon leminehu lehavi et hakkarsefet veet hashshachalanit
Veen li ella habba veen lo gabbachat habba veyesh lo gabbachat habba veen lo zanav habba veyesh lo zanav habba veen rosho aroch habba verosho aroch minnayin

Amarta hare atta dan binyan av mishsheloshtan lo rei arbe kiri chargol velo rei chargol kiri arbe velo rei shenehem kiri solam velo rei solam kiri shenehem hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheyyesh lo arba raglayim vearba kenafayim vekartzullayim uchnafav chofin et rubbo af kol sheyyesh lo arba raglayim vearba kenafayim vekartzullayim uchnafav chofin et rubbo
Vahalo hatztzartzur hazze yesh lo arba raglayim vearba kenafayim vekartzullayim uchnafav chofin et rubbo yachol yehe muttar talmud lomar chagav sheshshemo chagav
I shemo chagav yachol en bo kol hassimanin hallalu talmud lomar leminehu ad sheyehe bo kol hassimanin hallalu
Parech rav achay ma lehanach shekken en roshan aroch vechi tema kevan deshau bearba simanin mayetinan vela parchinan i hachi chargol name deshau lehu la lichtov vetete mearbe vesolam
Ella ika lemifrach ma lehanach shekken en lahen zanav hachi name ika lemifrach ma lehanach shekken en roshan aroch

Ella amar rav achay solam yattira hu la lichtov rachamana solam vetete mearbe umechargol demay parchatte ma learbe deen lo gabbachat hare chargol deyesh lo gabbachat ma lechargol deyesh lo zanav hare arbe deen lo zanav solam dichtav rachamana lema li im eno inyan legufo tenehu inyan lerosho aroch

a: Bemay kamipalgi tana deve rav vetana deve rabbi yishmael berosho aroch kamipalgi
Tana deve rav savar asher lo keraayim kalal arbe solam chargol chagav leminehu parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat demineh in delav mineh la umrabbe dedame leh mishshene tzedadin
Tana deve rabbi yishmael savar asher lo cheraayim kalal arbe solam chargol chagav parat leminehu chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella cheen happerat umrabbe kol dedame leh bechad tzad
Veha la dame kelala kamma lichlala batra kelala kamma asher lo cheraayim amar rachamana deit leh echol delet leh la techol kelala batra ad deshau bearbaa simanin
Tana deve rabbi yishmael bichlale ufrate ki hay gavena daen udamrinan name bealma dedaen tana deve rabbi yishmael bichlale ufrate ki hay gavena mehacha
Amar mar i shemo chagav yachol en bo kol hassimanin hallalu talmud lomar leminehu ad sheyehu bo kol hassimanin hallalu en bo kol hassimanin hallalu mehecha tete arbe vechargol ketiv
I la ketiv solam kidkaamratte hashta dichtiv solam lerabboye rosho aroch ema lirabbe name kol dehu ka mashma lan
May shena hatam deamratte solam ze rashon chargol ze nipul umay shena hacha deamratte solam ze nipul chargol ze rashon mar ki atreh umar ki atreh

Uvaddagim kol sheyyesh lo senappir vekaskeset tanu rabbanan en lo achshav veatid legaddel leachar zeman kegon hassultanit vehaafyan hare ze muttar yesh lo achshav veatid lehashshiran beshaa sheole min hammayim kegon
b: Akunas vaafunas keseppatyas veekkeseppatyas vaatunas hare ze muttar
Tenan hatam kol sheyyesh lo kaskeset yesh lo senappir veyesh sheyyesh lo senappir veen lo kaskeset yesh lo kaskeset veyesh lo senappir dag tahor yesh lo senappir veen lo kaskeset dag tame

Mikkede akkaskeset ka samchinan lichtov rachamana kaskeset vela lichtov senappir i ketav rachamana kaskeset vela ketav senappir hava amena may kaskeset senappir vaafilu dag tame ketav rachamana senappir vekaskeset
Vehashta dichtav rachamana senappir vekaskeset mimmay dekaskeset levusha hu dichtiv veshiron kaskassim hu lavush velichtov rachamana kaskeset vela lichtov senappir
Amar rabbi avahu vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael yagdil tora veyadir

Tanu rabbanan mimmashma shenneemar echol et sheyyesh lo shomea ani al tochal et sheen lo umimmashma shenneemar al tochal et sheen lo shomea ani echol et sheyyesh lo velamma shenaan laavor alav baase velo taase

Tochlu mikkol asher bammayim ma talmud lomar sheyyachol hoil vehittir bimforash vehittir bistam ma keshehittir bimforash lo hittir ella bechelim af keshehittir bistam lo hittir ella bechelim minnayin lerabbot borot shichin umarot sheshshoche veshote mehen veeno nimna talmud lomar tochlu mikkol asher bammayim
Hechan hittir bechelim dichtiv et ze tochlu mikkol asher bammayim vego bayyammim uvannechalim hu dechi it leh echol delet leh la techol ha bechelim af al gav delet leh echol

Ema bechelim af al gav deit leh la techol la salka datach dichtiv vechol asher en lo senappir vekaskeset bayyammim uvannechalim mikkol sheretz hammayim bayyammim uvannechalim delet leh la techol ha bechelim af al gav delet leh echol
Veema bammayim kalal bayyammim uvannechalim parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat yammim unchalim in neitzin vacharitzin lo
Bammayim chazar vechalal
Hane tere kelale dismichi lahadade ninhu amar ravina kidamri bemareva kol makom sheatta motze shene kelalot hassemuchin ze laze

a: Hattel perat benehem vedunem bichlal ufrat uchlal bammayim kalal bayyammim uvannechalim parat bammayim chazar vechalal
Kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash mayim novim af kol mayim novim may rabbi charitzin unitzin leisura umay maet borot shichin umarot lehettera
Veema ma happerat meforash mayim gedelin al gabbe karka af kol mayim gedelin al gabbe karka umay rabbi afilu borot shichin umarot leisura umay maet maet kelim
Im ken tochlu may ahani leh

Deve rabbi yishmael tana bammayim bammayim shette feamim en ze kelal ufrat ella riba umiet bammayim riba bayyammim uvannechalim miet bammayim chazar veriba riba umiet veriba riba hakkol may rabbi charitzin unitzin leisura umay maet borot shichin umarot lehettera
Ema may rabbi borot shichin umarot leisura umay maet maet kelim im ken tochlu may ahani leh

Veefoch ana kidtane mattitya detane mattitya bar yehuda may raita lerabbot borot shichin umarot lehettera ulhotzi charitzin unitzin leisura merabbe ani borot shichin umarot shehen atzurim kechelim umotzi ani charitzin unitzin sheen atzurin kechelim
He satum vehe meforash peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar yesh lo meforash veen lo satum vechad amar en lo meforash veyesh lo satum
May tama deman deamar yesh lo meforash amar lach mineh hu deka mishteru kelim
May tama deman deamar en lo meforash dehay hu dekamochach ahayeche dei mehayeche hava amena bechelim af al gav deit leh name la techul
Amar rav huna la lishpe inash shichra betzivyata beurta dilma paresh leel mitztzivyata vahadar nafel lechasa vehave veka ovar mishshum sheretz hashshoretz al haaretz
I hachi bemana name dilma paresh ledafna demana vahadar nafel lemana hatam hayenu reviteh

Umna temra detanya minnayin lerabbot borot shichin umarot sheshshoche veshote mehen veeno nimna talmud lomar tochlu mikkol asher bammayim velechush dilma paresh ledafna vahadar nafel ella hayenu reviteh hacha name hayenu reviteh
Amar leh rav chisda lerav huna tanya dimsayya lach kol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz lerabbot yavchushin shessinnan tama desinnan ha la sinnan shere
Amar shemuel kishut shehitlia
b: Beibbeha asura mishshum hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz

Lema mesayya leh detane chada al haaretz lehotzi et hazzizin shebbaadashim veet hayyattushim shebbakkallisim vetolaat shebbattemarim veshebbaggerogrot vetanya idach kol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz lerabbot tolaat shebbeikare zetim veshebbeikare gefanim
May lav ide veide befera veha beibbeh veha shella beibbeh
La idi veidi beibbeh vela kashya ha befera ha beilana gufe
Dayeka name dekatane tolaat shebbeikare zetim veshebbeikare gefanim shema minah
Bae rav yosef perashah umeta mahu miktzatah mahu laavir haolam mahu teku
Bae rav ashe legag temara mahu legag garinatah mahu mittemara litmara mahu teku
Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi kukyane asiri may tama mealma atu
Matkef lah rav ashe i mealma atu lishtachchu derech bet harei
Ika deamri amar rav shisha bereh derav idi kukyane sheru may tama mineh gavli amar rav ashe peshita dei mealma ka atu lishtachchu derech bet harei
Vehilcheta kukyane asiri may tama menam nayem veayeli leh beusyeh tolaim darne devisra asiri dechavere sharyan
Amar lah ravina leimeh avla li vaana echol amar leh rav mesharsheya bereh derav acha leravina may shena meha detanya veet nivlatam teshakketzu lerabbot et hadderanim shebbabbehema
Amar leh hachi hashta behema bishchita hu demishtarya vehane middela ka mahneya lehu shechita beisurayehu kayeman aval dagim baasifa bealma mishteru vehane ki ka gavlan behetera ka gavlan

Tanu rabbanan holech al gachon ze nachash kol lerabbot hashshilshul veet haddome leshilshul al arba ze akrav kol holech lerabbot et hachipushit veet haddome lechipushit marbe raglayim ze nadal ad kol lerabbot et haddome veet haddome laddome

Tanya rabbi yose ben dormaskit omer liveyatan dag tahor hu shenneemar gaava afike maginnim tachtav chaddude cheres afike maginnim ellu kaskassim shebbo tachtav chaddude cheres ellu senappirin shepporeach bahen
Hadaran alach ellu terefot

a: Matni behema hamkashsha leled vehotzi haubbar et yado vehechziro muttar baachila hotzi et rosho af al pi shehechziro hare ze keyalud
Chotech meubbar shebbemeeha muttar baachila min hattechol umin hakkelaot asur baachila ze hakkelal davar sheggufah asur vesheenah gufah muttar
Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav veever atzmo asur
May tama deamar kera uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu kevan sheyyatza basar chutz limchitzato neesar
Tenan behema hamkashsha leled vehotzi haubbar et yado vehechziro muttar baachila may lav aever la aubbar
I aubbar may irya hechziro afilu lo hechziro name hu haddin af al gav delo hechziro veayede deka bae mitne sefa hotzi et rosho af al pi shehechziro hare ze keyalud tena name resha hechziro
Vesefa may kamashma lan dechevan deyatza rosho haveya lah leda tenena ezehu bechor lenachala veeno bechor lechohanim habba achar nefalim af al pi sheyyatza rosho chay o ben tisha sheyyatza rosho met
Tama derosho met ha rosho chay habba acharav bechor lenachala name la have
Vechi tema ashmeinan beadam veka mashma lan bivhema
Deadam mibbehema la yalef deen perozdor livhema uvhema meadam la yalfa dachashiv partzuf panim dideh
Ha name tenena shilya sheyyatzta miktzatah asura baachila kesiman valad baishsha kach siman valad babbehema
I amratte bishlama hechziro deresha daveka tena sefa attu resha
Ella i amratte la deresha daveka vela desefa daveka lema leh lemitneyah kelal
La leolam aubbar vechidamar rav nachman bar yitzchak lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach hacha name lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach
Ta shema behema hamkashsha leled hotzi ubbar et yado vehechzirah veachar kach shachat et immo muttar baachila shachat et immo veachar kach hechzirah asur baachila
Hotzi et yado vachatacho veachar kach shachat et immo shebbachutz tame veasur veshebbifnim tahor umuttar
Shachat et immo veachar kach chatacho
b: Habbasar magga nevela divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim magga terefa shechuta
Katane miha resha hotzi ubbar et yado vehechzirah veachar kach shachat et immo muttar baachila may lav aever la aubbar
I aubbar ema sefa shachat et immo veachar kach hechziro asur baachila vei ubbar ammay asur
Kidamar rav nachman bar yitzchak lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach hacha name lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach
Ini veha ki ata avimi mibbe chozae ata veayeti matnita bideh parsa hechzir echol perasot hechzir echol may lav hechzir parsa achul parsa
Lo hechezir parsa echol ubbar i ubbar may irya hechzir afilu lo hechezir name amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach
Veha tere kerae ka nasev lah may lav chad leever vechad limkom chatach la chad limkom chatach vechad lekalut bime fara
Vealliba derabbi shimon deamar rabbi shimon kalut ben para asur hane mile hecha deyatza laavir haolam aval bime immo shere
Ulla amar rabbi yochanan veever atzmo muttar

Amar leh rav yehuda leulla veha rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu ever atzmo asur amar leh man yahev lan meafra derav ushmuel umalenan ayenin ella hachi amar rabbi yochanan hakkol hau bichlal basar bassade terefa lo tochelu
Keshepparat lecha hakkatuv gabbe chattat sheyyatzta chutz limchitzatah vechazra asur chattat hu difrat rachamana bah aval kol mile kevan dahadur shere
Metivi basar bassade terefa lo tochelu ma talmud lomar lefi shemmatzinu bemaaser sheni uvikkurim sheaf al pi sheyyatzu chutz limchitzatan vechazru muttarin yachol af ze ken talmud lomar terefa
May talmuda amar rabba kitrefa ma terefa kevan shennitrefa shuv en lah heter af basar kevan sheyyatza chutz limchitzato shuv en lo heter teuvta deulla teuvta
Amar mar lefi shemmatzinu bemaaser sheni uvikkurim hechan matzinu
Dichtiv lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar deganecha vego bisharecha hu dela techul aval yatzu chutz limchitzatan vechazru muttarin
Bemareva matnu hachi rav amar yesh leda leevarim verabbi yochanan amar en leda leevarim
May benayehu ika benayehu lemesar miut ever shebbifnim
Ibaya lehu ledivre haomer en leda leevarim hotzi haubbar et yado vehechzirah vechazar vehotzi et yado vehechzirah ad shehishlimo lerubbo mahu mi amrinan ha nefak leh rubba o dilma kevan dahadar hadar
Im timtze lomar kevan dahadar hadar hotzi ubbar et yado vachatachah vechazar vehotzi et yado vachatachah ad shehishlimo lerubbo mahu mi amrinan ha nafek leh rubba o dilma rubba bevat achat baenan
Ta shema

a: Ze hakkelal davar sheggufah asur vesheenah gufah muttar sheen gufah leetoye may lav leetoye kehay gavena
La leetoye kalut bime para vealliba derabbi shimon deaf al gav deamar rabbi shimon kalut ben para asur hane mile hecha deyatza laavir haolam aval bime immo shere
Bae rav chananya hotzi ubbar et yado baazara mahu miggo dehave mechitza legabbe kadashim have name legabbe dehay o dilma legabbe dehay lav mechitza hi dimchitzat ubbar immo hi
Amar leh abbaye vetibbee lach kadashim kallim birushalayim kadashim kallim birushalayim may tama la ka mibaya lach dimchitzat ubbar immo hi hacha name mechitzat ubbar immo hi
Bae ilfa hotzi ubbar et yado ben siman lesiman mahu
Mi mitztaref siman rishon lesiman sheni letahoreh mide nevela o la amar rava kal vachomer im hoil lo siman rishon lesiman sheni lehattiro baachila lo yoil lo letahoreh mide nevela
Bae rabbi yirmeya mahu lachosh lezaro
Hechi dame ilema daazal abbehema meallayeta may irya hay deit beh isur yotze
Afilu ben pekua dealma name deamar rav mesharsheya ledivre haomer choshshin lezera haav ben pekua habba al behema meallayeta havalad en lo takkana
La tzericha daazal abben pekua dichvateh may ever molid ever vechatech leh ushre o dilma mibbalbal zareh
Hadar amar peshita demibbalbal zareh deim ken some yivaled some vekitea yivaled kitea
Ella peshita demibbalbal zareh vehachi kamibaya lan behema bealma lav mikkoach chelev vadam kaatya vesharya hacha name la shena o dilma tere isure amrinan telata la amrinan
Ulman i lerabbi meir isur chelev vadam ika isur yotze leka
I lerabbi yehuda isur yotze ika isur chelev vadam leka
Ditnan gid hannashe noheg bashshelil vechelbo asur divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer en noheg bashshelil vechelbo muttar
Ella kol mikkoach la amrinan dishre
Vehachi kamibaya lan mahu ligmoa et chalavo chalav dealma la keever min hachay dame ushre hay name la shena
O dilma hatam it leh takkanta leisureh bishchita hacha let leh takkanta leisureh bishchita teku
Chotech meubbar vechu menalan dichtiv vechol behema mafreset parsa vego behema babbehema lerabbot et havalad
Ella meatta yamiru bo
Allema tenan en memirin lo evarin beubbarin velo ubbarin beevarin velo evarin veubbarin bishlemin velo shelemin bahen
Ella amar kera vechol behema lerabbot et havalad
I hachi afilu chotech min hattechol umin hakkelaot name allema tenan chotech min haubbar shebbemeeha muttar baachila min hattechol umin hakkelaot asur baachila amar kera otah shelema velo chasera
Ella meatta hashshochet et habbehema umatza bah demut yona tishtere allema amar rabbi yochanan hashshochet et habbehema umatza bah demut yona asura baachila
b: Baena perasot veleka
Ella meatta kalut bime para litsar ha tana deve rabbi yishmael kerabbi shimon ben yochay parsa babbehema tochelu

Rav shimi bar ashe amar leolam kidkaamratte meikara udka kashya lach en memirin ha manni rabbi shimon hi demakkesh temura lemaaser ma maaser eno noheg baevarim veubbarim af temura enah noheget baevarim veubbarim
Umna temra ditnan amar rabbi yose vahalo bemukdashim haomer raglah shel zo ola kullah ola af kesheyyomar regel shel zo tachat zo tehe kullah temura tachteha

Leman ka mahdar leh ilema lerabbi meir verabbi yehuda mi it lehu hay sevara vehatanya yachol haomer raglah shel zo ola tehe kullah ola talmud lomar kol asher yitten mimmennu la yihye kodesh mimmennu kodesh velo kullo kodesh
Yachol tetze lechullin talmud lomar yihye bahavayatah tehe ha ketzad timmacher letzorche olot vedameha chullin chutz middeme ever shebbah divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda
Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim minnayin laomer raglah shel zo ola tehe kullah ola talmud lomar yihye lerabbot et kullah
Leman i lerabbi meir verabbi yehuda mi it lehu hay sevara ella lav lerabbi shimon
La rabbi yose tama denafsheh kaamar
Matni hamvakkeret hamkashsha leled mechattech ever ever umashlich lichlavim yatza rubbo hare ze yikkaver venifteret min habbechora
Gema ittemar yatza shelish umcharo legoy vechazar veyatza shelish acher rav huna amar kadosh rabba amar eno kadosh
Rav huna amar kadosh kasavar lemafrea kadosh vechevan dinfak leh rubbeh igallay milta lemafrea demeikara hava kadosh umay dezabben lo kelum zabben
Rabba amar eno kadosh kasavar mikkan ulhabba kadosh umay dezabben shappir zabben
Veazdu letamayehu deittemar yatza shelish derech dofen ushne shelishe derech rechem rav huna amar eno kadosh rabba amar kadosh
Rav huna amar eno kadosh rav huna letameh deamar lemafrea kadosh verubba kamma leteh berechem rabba amar kadosh rabba letameh deamar mikkan ulhabba kadosh verubba derech rechem nafek
Utzricha dei ashmeinan beha beha kaamar rav huna mishshum dilkulla aval behach dilchumra ema mode leh lerabba

a: Vei ittemar beha beha kaamar rabba aval beha ema mode leh lerav huna tzericha
Tenan hamvakkeret hamkashsha leled mechattech ever ever umashlich lichlavim may lav mechattech umanniach vei amratte lemafrea hu kadosh yikkaver mibe leh
La hacha bemay askinan bimchattech umashlich

Aval mechattech umanniach may yikkaver additna sefa yatza rubbo yikkaver veniftera min habbechora liflog velitne bedideh bamme devarim amurim bimchattech umashlich ever ever aval mechattech umanniach yikkaver
Hachi name kaamar bamme devarim amurim bimchattech umashlich aval mechattech umanniach naasa kemi sheyyatza rubbo veyikkaver
Bae rava halchu beevarin achar harov o lo halchu beevarin achar harov
Hechi dame ilema kegon sheyyatza rov bemiut ever veka mibaya leh hay miut devaray batar rov deever shadenan leh o batar rubba deubbar shadenan leh
Peshita dela shavkinan rubba deubbar veazlinan batar rov ever
Ella kegon sheyyatza chetzo berov ever veka mibaya leh hahu miut divgavay mahu lemishdeyeh batar rov ever
Ta shama yatza rubbo hare ze yikkaver may rubbo ilema rubbo mammash ad hashta la ashmeinan derubbo kechullo
Ella lav kegon sheyyatza chetzo berov ever
La kegon sheyyatza rubbo bemiut ever veka mashma lan dela shavkinan rubbo deubbar divhema veazlinan batar ever
Bae rava keracho besiv mahu betallito mahu
Beshilyato mahu beshilyato orcheh hu ella beshilya acheret mahu
Kerachattu vaachazattu vehotziattu mahu hechi dame i dinfak derech resheh petarteh ella dinfak derech margelotav
Belaathu chulda vehotziattu mahu hotziattu ha appekteh ella belaattu vehotziattu vehichnisattu vehekiattu veyatza meelav mahu
Hidbik shene rechamim veyatza mizze venichnas laze mahu dideh patar delav dideh la patar o dilma delav dideh name patar teku
Bae rav acha niftechu kotle bet harechem mahu avir rechem makdish vehaika o dilma negiat rechem mekaddesha veha leka
Bae mar bar rav ashe nekeru kotle bet harechem mahu nekeru letanhu ella nekeru vetalu leh betzavvereh may bimkoman mekaddeshi shello bimkoman lo mekaddeshi o dilma shello bimkoman name mekaddeshi

Bae mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera nigmemu kotle bet harechem mahu amar leh ka nagatte bevaya deibaya lan devae rabbi zera veamri lah bea mineh rabbi zera merabbi assi omed merubbe al happarutz veyatza derech parutz parutz merubbe al haomed veyatza derech omed may
Ad kan la ibaya leh ella parutz merubbe al haomed deika omed beolam aval nigmemu la ka mibaya leh
b: Matni behema shemmet ubbarah betoch meeha vehoshit haroe et yado venaga bo ben bivhema temea ben bivhema tehora tahor rabbi yose haggelili omer bitmea tame uvithora tahor
Gema may tama detanna kamma amar rav chisda kal vachomer im hoila immo lehattiro baachila lo toil lo letahoreh mide nevela

Ashkechan behema tehora behema temea menalan amar kera vechi yamut min habbehema zo behema temea asher hi lachem leochla zo behema tehora itakkash behema temea livhema tehora ma behema tehora ubbarah tahor af behema temea ubbarah tahor
Verabbi yose haggelili may tama amar rabbi yitzchak deamar kera vechol holech al kappav bechol hachayya haholechet vego mehalleche kappayim bechayya timmeti lach
Ella meatta kalut bime fara litamme dimhalleche chappayim bechayya hu mehalleche chappayim bimhalleche arba vehay mehalleche arba bimhalleche shemone hu
Para bime gamal lo tetamme dimhalleche shemone bimhalleche arba hu holech vechol holech lerabbot para bime gamal
Kalut bime keluta litamme dimhalleche arba bimhalleche arba hu lehachi ahani kal vachomer derav chisda
Matkef lah rav achadvuy bar amme chazir bime chazirta la litamme dimhalleche shemone bimhalleche shemone hu
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mehacha nefesh ki tigga bechol tame o venivlat chayya temea o benivlat behema temea o benivlat sheretz tame
Vechi nivlat behema temea metammea uvithora lo metammea ella eze ze ze ubbar shebbitmea tame uvithora tahor
Umeachar denafka leh midderav nachman bar yitzchak derabbi yitzchak lema li i lav derabbi yitzchak hava amena kulleh lechidrabbi hu daata ka mashma lan
Tanya amar rabbi yonatan namti lo leven azzay lamadnu nivlat behema tehora shemmetammea venivlat behema temea shemmetammea nivlat chayya temea shemmetammea
Nivlat chayya tehora lo lamadnu minnayin nam li kal holech al kappav bechol hachayya haholechet

Matni haishsha shemmet veladah betoch meeha ufashta chayya et yadah venaga bo hachayya temea tumat shiva vehaishsha tehora ad sheyyetze havalad

Tuma belua menalan dichtiv vehaochel minnivlatah yechabbes begadav mi la askinan daachal samuch lishkiat hachamma vekaamar rachamana tahor

Kal vachomer uma keli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil sheeno matztzil al tuma shebbetocho milletamme deamar mar tuma retzutza bokaat veola ad larakia matztzil al tohora shebbetocho milletamme
b: Adam shemmatztzil al tuma shebbetocho milletamme eno din shemmatztzil al tohora shebbetocho millitamme

Attu anan miggabbo kaamrinan mittocho kaamrinan
Adderabba keli cheres chamur shekken metamme meaviro

Kelum ose ikul lematta ella al yede mala afilu hachi ikul dilmatta rav
Ashkechan balua deadam balua divhema menalan kal vachomer uma adam shemmittamme mechayyim matztzil bevalua behema sheenah metammea mechayyim eno din shettatztzil bevalua
Ma leadam shekken tzarich shehiyya bevayit hamnugga tomar bivhema sheenah tzericha shehiyya bevayit hamnugga
Behema deenah tzericha shehiyya bevayit hamnugga lemay hilcheta lechelim sheal gabbah adam name la bae

Ki kaamar rabba kegon shebbala shette tabbaot achat temea veachat tehora dela metammeya lah temea lithora

a: Veha ubbar vechayya dechishte tabbaot damu veka metamme lah ubbar lechayya
Amar rabba shane ubbar hoil vesofo latzet amar rava ubbar sofo latzet tabbaat en sofah latzet ella amar rava pumbeditae yadi tama deha milta umannu rav yosef

Deamar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel tuma zo enah middivre tora ella middivre sofrim may enah middivre tora ella middivre sofrim dela tema alliba derabbi akiva deamar ubbar bime ishsha tame ella afilu lerabbi yishmael deamar ubbar bime ishsha tahor gezaru bah tuma midderabbanan
May tama amar rav hoshaya gezera shemma yotzi valad rosho chutz lapperozdor
I hachi ishsha name ishsha margeshet beatzmah vetema lah lechayya terida
May rabbi yishmael umay rabbi akiva detanya vechol asher yigga al pene hassade lehotzi ubbar bime ishsha divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer lerabbot golel vedofek

Verabbi yishmael golel vedofek hilcheta gemiri lah verabbi akiva ubbar bime ishsha tame middeorayeta mena leh amar rabbi oshaya amar kera hannogea bemet benefesh ezehu met shebbenefesh shel adam heve omer ze ubbar shebbime ishsha
Verabbi yishmael hay mibe leh lirviit dam habbaa min hammet shemmetammea shenneemar hannogea bemet benefesh haadam ezehu nefesh shel adam shemmetamme heve omer zo reviit dam
Verabbi akiva letameh deamar af reviit dam habbaa mishshene metim metamme beohel detanya rabbi akiva omer minnayin lirviit dam habbaa mishshene metim shemmetammea beohel
Shenneemar veal kol nafshot met lo yavo shette nefashot veshiur echad
Matni behema hamkashsha leled vehotzi ubbar et yado vachatachah veachar kach shachat et immo habbasar tahor shachat et immo veachar kach chatachah habbasar magga nevela divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim magga terefa shechuta
b: Ma matzinu bitrefa sheshshechitatah metahartah af shechitat behema tetaher et haever
Amar lahem rabbi meir lo im tihara shechitat terefa otah davar sheggufah tetaher et haever davar sheeno gufah
Minnayin litrefa sheshshechitatah metahartah behema temea asura baachila af terefa asura baachila ma behema temea en shechitatah metahartah af terefa lo tetaharenna shechita
Lo im amarta bivhema temea shello hayeta lah sheat hakkosher tomar bitrefa shehayeta lah sheat hakkosher
Tol lecha ma sheheveta hare shennolda terefa min habbeten minnayin
Lo im amarta bivhema temea shekken en beminah shechita tomar bitrefa sheyyesh beminah shechita
Ben shemone chay en shechitato metaharto lefi sheen bemino shechita
Gema ammay tumat bet hassetarim hi vetumat bet hassetarim la metammeya lema rabbi meir letameh
Ditnan shelosha al shelosha shennechlak tahor min hammidras
Aval tame magga midras divre rabbi meir
Vetanya amar rabbi yose vechi beeze midras naga ze ella sheim naga bo zav sheyehe tame magga zav
Lav itmar alah amar ulla lo shanu ella shelosha al shelosha shennechlak
Aval shalosh al shalosh habbaot mibbeged gadol bishat perishatan meavihen mekabbelot tuma meavihen ha name bishat perishatan meever mekabbel tuma meever
Ravina amar beged lav lachaticha kae ubbar lachaticha kae vechol haomed lachtoch

a: Kechatuch dame
Keman kerabbi meir ditnan kal yedot hakkelim shehen arukkot veatid lekotztzan matbil ad makom midda divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim ad sheyyatbil et kullo
Afilu tema rabbanan chibbure ochalin keman demipparti dame ungii bahadade
Bishlama leulla hayenu dekatane chatachah ella leravina may chatachah ayede ditna resha chatachah tena name sefa chatachah
Vachachamim omrim magga terefa shechuta terefa shechuta mi metammeya in kedaavuh dishmuel deamar avuh dishmuel terefa sheshshechatah metammea bemukdashin
Ma matzinu bitrefa sheshshechitatah metahartah af shechitat behema tetaher et haubbar
Tanya amar lahen rabbi meir vechi mi tiharo leever ze mide nevela shechitat immo im ken tattirennu baachila
Amru lo harbe matztzelet al sheeno gufah yoter miggufah shehare shaninu chotech min haubbar shebbemeeha muttar baachila min hattechol umin hakkelaot asur baachila

May kaamar amar rava veamri lah kedi chassore mechassera vehachi katane amar lahen rabbi meir vechi mi tiharo leever ze mide nevela shechitat immo im ken tattirennu baachila amru lo terefa tochiach sheshshechitatah metahartah mide nevela veenah mattiratah baachila

Amru lo harbe matztzelet al sheeno gufah yoter miggufah shehare shaninu chotech min haubbar shebbemeeha muttar baachila min hattechol umin hakkelaot asur baachila

Verabbi yochanan amar machloket beever deubbar aval beever divhema divre hakkol shechita osa nipul

Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya lo hilchu bo ella al iske achila bilvad lemaote rovo vechoresh bo
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish ledivre hammattir bechelbo mattir bedamo ledivre haoser bechelbo oser bedamo verabbi yochanan amar af ledivre hammattir bechelbo oser bedamo
Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish koro umotzi et damo amar rabbi zera lomar sheen anush karet

Targema rav yosef bereh derav salla chasida kammeh derav pappa it leh lerabbi yehuda dam vechol dam kol hecha demichayyav addam hannefesh michayyav addam hattamtzit vechol hecha dela michayyav addam hannefesh la michayyav addam hattamtzit

Ki tibe lach alliba derabbanan deamri shechitat immo metaharto may kevan deamri shechitat immo metaharto kevisra bedikula hu o dilma kevan derahet veazel verahet veate se karena beh

Rabbi yose haggelili ha daamaran bet shammay ditnan dagim meematay mekabbelin tuma bet shammay omrim mishsheyyitztzodu uvet hillel omrim mishsheyyamutu rabbi akiva omer mishshaa sheen yecholin lichot

Rabbi yochanan amar chelbo kechelev behema avera garem rabbi shimon ben lakish amar chelbo kechelev chayya chodashim garmi

Amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri vechen haya rabbi shimon shezuri mattir bivno uven beno ad sof kol haddorot rabbi yochanan amar hu muttar uvno asur

Amar leh rabbi yochanan ledivre rabbi shimon shezuri kaamar
Vehaamar ravin bar chanina amar ulla amar rabbi chanina halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri velo od ella kol makom sheshshana rabbi shimon shezuri bemishnatenu halacha kemoto
Amar leh ana ki ha sevira li deamar rabbi yonatan halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri bimsukkan uvitrumat maaser shel demay
Mesukkan ditnan barishona hau omrim hayyotze bekolar veamar kitvu get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu chazru lomar af hamfaresh vehayyotze bishyara rabbi shimon ben shezuri omer af hamsukkan
Terumat maaser shel demay ditnan terumat maaser shel demay shechazra limkomah rabbi shimon ben shezuri omer af bachol shoalo veochlo al piv

a: Matni behema shennechtechu ragleha min haarkubba ulmatta keshera min haarkubba ulmala pesula vechen shennital tzomet haggidin
Nishbar haetzem im rov habbasar kayyam shechitato metaharto veim lav en shechitato metaharto
Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav amar rabbi chiyya lematta lematta min haarkubba lemala lemala min haarkubba beezo arkubba amru bearkubba hannimkeret im harosh
Ulla amar rabbi oshaya kenegdo begamal nikar
Amar leh ulla lerav yehuda bishlama ledidi deamena kenegdo begamal nikar hayenu dekatane vechen shennital tzomet haggidin ella ledidach may vechen shennital tzomet haggidin
Amar leh rechubba belo tzomet haggidim vetzomet haggidim belo rechubba veha nechtechu katane ishtik
Levatar dinfak amar may tama la amari leh lematta lematta min haarkubba lemala lemala mitztzomet haggidin
Hadar amar vela amari leh vaamar li nechtechu katane hacha name min haarkubba ulmala katane

Rav pappa matne hachi amar rav yehuda amar rav amar rabbi chiyya lematta lematta min haarkubba umitztzomet haggidin lemala lemala min haarkubba umitztzomet haggidin vechen shennital tzomet haggidin vearkubba gufah kidulla amar rabbi oshaya
Umi ika mide deilu middele pasek leh vachaya metatte pasek leh umeta
Amar rav ashe terefot ka medammet lahadade en omrin bitrefot zo doma lazo shehare chotchah mikkan vameta chotchah mikkan vechayya
Veellu hen tzomet haggidin rabba amar rav ashe deaggarma ulvar rabba bar rav huna amar rav ashe deaggarma ulgav rava bereh derabba bar rav huna amar rav assi deilave arkuma

Yatev hahu merabbanan kammeh derabbi abba veyatev vekaamar dearkuma gufah amar leh rabbi abba la tetzitu leh hachi amar rav yehuda hecha defari tabbache vehayenu rava bereh derabba bar rav huna amar rav assi

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel tzomet haggidim sheamru mekom shehaggidin tzomtin vead kamma amar leh hahu midderabbanan verav yaakov shemeh ki havenan be rav yehuda amar lan shemau manni milleta demiggavra rabba shemia li umannu shemuel tzomet haggidin sheamru mekom shehaggidin tzomtin bo umimmekom shetztzomtin ad mekom shemmitpashshetin
Vechamma amar abbaye arbaa batde betora bedakka may amar abbaye beliti hau tzomet haggidim belii la hau tzomet haggidim
Ashshune hau tzomet haggidim rakkiche la hau tzomet haggidim allime hau tzomet haggidim kattine la hau tzomet haggidim chivare hau tzomet haggidim la chivare la hau tzomet haggidim
b: Mar bar rav ashe amar kevan dezigi af al gav dela chivare

Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav zevid telata chute hau chad allima utre kattine ipsik allima azda rov binyan ipsik kattine azda rov minyan mar bar rav ashe matne lekulla ipsik allima haika rov minyan ipsik kattine haika rov binyan

Beofot shitsar chute hau ipsik chad minayehu terefa amar mar bar rav ashe hava kaemna kammeh deabba veayeto lekammeh ofa uvdak veashkach beh chamesar hava chad dahava shane mechavreh nappetzeh veashkach tere
Amar rav yehuda amar rav tzomet haggidin sheamru berubbo may rubbo rov echad mehen ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li mikkede telata hau ki mipsik chad minayehu ligmare ha ika tere
Tama deika tere ha leka tere la ufliga deravnay deamar ravnay amar shemuel tzomet haggidim afilu lo nishtayyer bah ella kechut hassarbal keshera

Veika deamri may rubbo rov kol echad veechad ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li mikkede telata hau haika telata dechol chad vechad mesayya leh leravnay deamar ravnay amar shemuel tzomet haggidin sheamru afilu lo nishtayyer bah ella kechut hassarbal keshera
Nishbar haetzem ku
Amar rav lemala min haarkubba im rov habbasar kayyam ze vaze muttar veim lav ze vaze asur lematta min haarkubba im rov habbasar kayyam ze vaze muttar im lav ever asur uvhema mutteret
Ushmuel amar ben lemala ben lematta im rov habbasar kayyam ze vaze muttar im lav ever asur uvhema mutteret
Matkef lah rav nachman lishmuel yomru ever mimmenna muttal baashpa umutteret amar leh rav acha bar rav huna lerav nachman lerav name yomru ever mimmenna muttal baashpa umutteret
Amar leh hachi kaamena ever shechaya mimmenna muttal baashpa umutteret
Shelachu mittam hilcheta kevateh derav hadur shelachu kevateh dishmuel hadur shelachu kevateh derav veever atzmo metamme bemassa
Metiv rav chisda lo im tihara shechitat terefa otah veet haever hamduldal bah davar sheggufah tetaher et haubbar davar sheeno gufah
Amar leh rabba haddore appirche lema lach otev mimmatnitin nishchata behema huchsheru bedameha divre rabbi meir rabbi shimon omer lo huchsheru
Amar leh matnitin ika ledachoye kiddachenan
Ki salek rabbi zera ashkecheh lerav yirmeya deyatev vekaamar lah leha shemata amar leh yishar vechen targemah aroch bevavel aroch mannu shemuel veha miflag pelig hadar beh shemuel legabbeh derav

Tanu rabbanan nishbar haetzem veyatza lachutz im or uvasar chofin et rubbo muttar im lav asur vechamma rubbo ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan rov ovo veamri lah rov hekkefo amar rav pappa hilkach baenan rov ovo uvaenan rov hekkefo
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan or hare hu kevasar amar leh rav nachman leulla velema mar or metzaref levasar deha or uvasar katane amar leh anan or o basar tanenan
Ika deamri amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan or mitztaref levasar amar leh rav nachman leulla velema mar or mashlim levasar lechumra
Amar leh ana ovada yadana dehahu bar gozala dahava be rabbi yitzchak deor metzaref levasar hava vaata lekammeh derabbi yochanan veachshereh amar leh bar gozala kaamratte bar gozala derakkich shane
Hanhu gidin rakkin daato lekammeh derabba amar rabba lemay lechush lehu chada deamar rabbi yochanan gidin shessofan lehakshot

a: Nimnin alehen bappesach veod hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael
Amar leh rav pappa lerabba rabbi shimon ben lakish veisura deorayeta veatte amratte may lechush lehu ishtik
Veammay ishtik vehaamar rava hilcheta kevateh derabbi shimon ben lakish behane telat
Shane hacha dahadar beh rabbi yochanan legabbeh derabbi shimon ben lakish daamar leh al takniteni bilshon yachid ani shone otah
Hahu nishbar haetzem veyatza lachutz deishtekil kurtita mineh ata lekammeh deabbaye shahayeh telata rigle
Amar leh rav adda bar matna zil kammeh derava bereh derav yosef bar chama dacharifa sakkineh ata lekammeh amar mikkede nishbar haetzem veyatza lachutz tenan ma li nefal ma li iteh
Amar leh ravina lerava mitlakket mahu mitroses mahu mitmasmes mahu hechi dame mitmasmes amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua kol sheharofe kodro
Ibaya lehu nikav mahu niklaf mahu nisdak mahu nital shelish hattachton mahu
Ta shema deamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan or hare hu kevasar dilma dikna mashka dideh

Amar rav ashe ki havenan be rav pappe ibaya lan nikdar kemin tabbaat mahu ufshatna meha deamar rav yehuda amar rav davar ze shaalti lachachamim velarofim veamru mesarto beetzem umaale arucha aval parzela mizraf zaref amar rav pappa vehu dikna garma dideh
Matni hashshochet et habbehema umatza bah shilya nefesh hayyafe tochlenna veenah metammea lo tumat ochalin velo tumat nevelot chishev aleha metammea tumat ochalin aval lo tumat nevelot
Shilya sheyyatzta miktzatah asura baachila siman valad baishsha vesiman valad babbehema
Hamvakkeret shehippila shilya yashlichenna lichlavim uvammukdashin tikkaver veen kovrin otah befarashat derachim veen tolin otah beilan mippene darche haemori
Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan kol babbehema tochelu lerabbot et hashshilya yachol afilu yatzta miktzatah talmud lomar otah otah velo shilyatah
Mikkedi en shilya belo valad lema li kera kera asmachta bealma
Veenah metammea bae rabbi yitzchak bar nappacha or chamor sheshshelako mahu lemay i letumat ochalin tenena
b: I letumat nevelot tenena
Tumat ochalin detanya haor vehashshilya en mittammein tumat ochalin or sheshshelako vehashshilya shechishev aleha metammein tumat ochalin
Tumat nevelot name tenena benivlatah velo baor velo beatzmotav velo baggidin velo bakkarnayim velo battelafayim
Veamar rabba bar rav chana lo nitzrecha ella sheasaan tzike kedera
Leolam tumat ochalin veshane or chamor dimis

Shilya sheyyatzta amar rabbi elazar lo shanu ella sheen immah valad aval yesh immah valad en choshshin levalad acher verabbi yochanan amar ben en immah valad ben yesh immah valad choshshin levalad acher
Ini veha amar rabbi yirmeya lechumra amrah rabbi elazar
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar amar rabbi elazar lo shanu ella sheenah keshura bavalad aval keshura bavalad en choshshin levalad acher

Verabbi yochanan amar anu en lanu ella shilya belo valad aval yesh immah valad ben keshura bavalad ben en keshura bavalad en choshshin levalad acher vehayenu deamar rabbi yirmeya lechumra amrah elazar
Tanya kevateh derabbi elazar hammappelet min behema chayya vaof veshilya immahen bizman shekkeshura bahen en choshshin levalad acher enah keshura bahen hareni metil aleha chomer shene veladot
Sheani omar shemma nimoach shafir shel shilya shemma nimocha shilyato shel shafir
Hamvakkeret shehippila may tama amar rav ika bereh derav amme rov behemot yoldot davar hakkadosh bivchora umiut behemot davar sheeno kadosh bivchora umay nihu nidme
Vechol hayyoldot yoldot mechetza zecharim umechetza nekevot semoch miuta denidme lemechetza dinkevot vehau lehu zecharim miuta
Uvammukdashin tikkaver may tama rubba bar mikdash hu
Veen kovrim otah abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu kol davar sheyyesh bo refua en bo mishshum darche haemori en bo refua yesh bo mishshum darche haemori
Vehatanya ilan shemmashshir perotav sokro besikra vetoano baavanim bishlama toano baavanim ki hechi

a: Denichchosh cheleh ella sokro besikra ammay ki hechi delichzeuh inashe velivuy rachame ilaveh
Kidtanya vetame tame yikra tzarich lehodia larabbim verabbim mevakkeshim alav rachamim vechen mi sheera bo davar tzarich lehodia larabbim verabbim mevakkeshim alav rachamim
Amar ravina keman talenan kuvsa bedikla keman ki hay tanna
Hadaran alach behema hamkashsha
Matni oto veet beno noheg ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit bechullin uvmukdashin
Ketzad hashshochet oto veet beno chullin bachutz shenehem kesherim vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim
Kadashim bachutz harishon chayyav karet ushnehem pesulim ushnehem sofgim et haarbaim
Chullin bifnim shenehem pesulin vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim kadashim bifnim harishon kasher ufatur vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul
Chullin vekadashim bachutz harishon kasher ufatur vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul
Kadashim vechullin bachutz harishon chayyav karet ufasul vehashsheni kasher ushnehem sofgim et haarbaim
Chullin vekadashim bifnim shenehem pesulin vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim kadashim vechullin bifnim harishon kasher ufatur vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul
Chullin bachutz uvifnim harishon kasher ufatur vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul
Kadashim bachutz uvifnim harishon chayyav karet ushnehem sofgim et haarbaim ushnehem pesulim
Chullin bifnim uvachutz harishon pasul ufatur vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim vechasher kadashim bifnim uvachutz harishon kasher ufatur vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul

Gema tanu rabbanan minnayin leoto veet beno shennoheg bemukdashin talmud lomar shor o chesev o ez ki yivaled uchtiv batreh veshor o se oto veet beno lo tishchatu beom echad limed al oto veet beno shennoheg bemukdashin
Veema bemukdashin in bechullin la shor hifsik hainyan
Veema bechullin in bemukdashin la ketiv veshor vav mosif al inyan rishon
I ma kadashim kilayim la af oto veet beno kilayim la allema tanya oto veet beno noheg bechilayim uvchoy
Veod se ketiv veamar rava
b: Ze bana av kol makom shenneemar se eno ella lehotzi et hakkilayim amar kera o lerabbot et hakkilayim
Hay o mibe leh lechallek desalka datach amena ad deshachet shor uvno se uvno la michayyav ka mashma lan lechallek mibbeno nafka
Veakkatti mibe leh lechidtanya ilu neemar shor vase uvno hayiti omer ad sheyyishchot shor vase uvno talmud lomar shor o se oto veet beno may lav meo nafka leh la meoto
Hanicha lerabbanan dimyatar lehu oto ella lachananya dela meyatar leh oto lechallek mena leh lechallek la tzerich kera desavar lah kerabbi yonatan
Detanya ish asher yekallel et aviv veet immo en li ella aviv veimmo aviv shello immo veimmo shello aviv minnayin talmud lomar aviv veimmo killel aviv killel immo killel divre rabbi yoshiyya
Rabbi yonatan omer mashma shenehem keechad umashma echad bifne atzmo ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv yachdav
May chananya umay rabbanan detanya oto veet beno noheg binkevot veeno noheg bizcharim chananya omer noheg ben bizcharim uven binkevot

May tama derabbanan detanya yachol yehe oto veet beno noheg ben bizcharim uven binkevot vedin hu chiyyev kan vechayyav beem al habbanim ma keshechiyyev beem al habbanim binkevot velo bizcharim af keshechiyyev kan binkevot velo bizcharim
Lo im amarta beem al habbanim shekken lo asa bah mezumman kesheeno mezumman tomar beoto veet beno sheasa bo mezumman kesheeno mezumman

Talmud lomar oto echad velo shenayim achar shechillek hakkatuv zachiti ledin chiyyev kan vechiyyev beem al habbanim ma keshechiyyev beem al habbanim binkevot velo bizcharim af keshechiyyev kan binkevot velo bizcharim
Veim nafshecha lomar beno mi shebbeno karuch acharav yatza zachar sheen beno karuch acharav
Ma im nafshecha lomar vechi tema oto zachar mashma hare hu omer beno mi shebbeno karuch acharav yatza zachar sheen beno karuch acharav

a: Velachananya ketiv oto demashma zachar uchtiv beno mi shebbeno karuch acharav demashma nekeva hilkach noheg ben bizcharim ben binkevot

Amar rav huna bar chiyya amar shemuel hilcheta kachananya veazda shemuel letameh ditnan rabbi yehuda omer hannoladim min hassus af al pi sheavihen chamor muttarin ze beze aval hannoladin min hachamor im hannoladin min hassus asurin
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel zo divre rabbi yehuda deamar en choshshin lezera haav aval chachamim omrim kol mine peradot achat hen
Man chachamim chananya hu deamar choshshin lezera haav vehay bar susya vachamara vehay bar chamara vesusya kullehu chada mina ninhu
Ibaya lehu mi peshit leh lerabbi yehuda deen choshshin lezera haav o dilma sappoke mesappeka leh lemay nafka minah
Lemishre peri im haem i amratte mifshat peshita leh peri im haem shere ella i amratte sappoke mesappeka leh peri im haem asur

May ta shema rabbi yehuda omer kol hannoladim min hassus af al pi sheavihen chamor muttarin ze baze hechi dame ilema daavuh dehay chamor vaavuh dehay chamor tzericha lememar ella lav daavuh dehay sus vaavuh dehay chamor
Vekatane muttarim ze im ze alma mifshat peshita leh
La leolam daavuh dehay chamor vaavuh dehay chamor udkaamratte tzericha lememar mahu detema ate tzad desus mishtammesh betzad chamor vetzad chamor mishtammesh betzad sus ka mashma lan
Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer pirda shettava en marbiin aleha lo sus velo chamor ella minah vei amratte mifshat peshita leh larba alah mina deimmah dela yadinan mina deimmah may nihu

Veha ella minah katane hachi kaamar en marbiin aleha lo min sus velo min chamor lefi sheen yodin beminah velivdok besimanin deamar abbaye ave kaleh bar chammara tzenif kaleh bar susya veamar rav pappa ravrevan udneh vezutra genuvteh bar chammara zutran udneh verabba genuvteh bar susya hacha bemay askinan beillemet vegidemet
May have alah ta shema deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hakkol modin bifri im haem sheasur shema minah sappoke mesappeka leh shema minah
Amar leh rabbi abba leshammaeh i meayelatte li kudanyata berispak ayyen lehanach dedamyan lahadade veayyel li alma kasavar en choshshin lezera haav
b: Vesimanin deorayeta

Tanu rabbanan oto veet beno noheg bechilayim uvchoy rabbi eliezer omer kilayim habba min haez umin harachel oto veet beno noheg bo koy en oto veet beno noheg bo amar rav chisda ezehu koy shennechleku bo rabbi eliezer vachachamim ze habba min hattayish umin hatztzeviyya
Hechi dame ilema betayish habba al hatztzeviyya veyalda veka shachet lah velivrah vehaamar rav chisda hakkol modim behi tzeviyya uvnah tayish sheppatur se uvno amar rachamana velo tzevi uvno
Ella bitzvi habba al hatteyasha veyalda veka shachet lah velivrah vehaamar rav chisda hakkol modim behi teyasha uvnah tzevi shechayyav se amar rachamana uvno kol dehu
Leolam betayish habba al hatztzeviyya veyalda bat uvat yalda ben veka shachet lah velivrah
Rabbanan savri choshshin lezera haav vese vaafilu miktzat se verabbi eliezer savar en choshshin lezera haav vese vaafilu miktzat se la amrinan
Veliflog bechoshshin lezera haav biflugta dachananya verabbanan
I peligi behahi hava amena beha afilu rabbanan modu dese vaafilu miktzat se la amrinan ka mashma lan
Veha ditnan koy en shochatin oto beom tov veim shechato en mechassin et damo
Bemay askinan ilema betayish habba al hatztzeviyya veyalda ben lerabbanan ben lerabbi eliezer lishchot velichasse tzevi vaafilu miktzat tzevi
Ella bitzvi habba al hatteyasha veyalda i lerabbanan lishchot velichasse i lerabbi eliezer lishchot vela lichasse
Leolam bitzvi habba al hatteyasha verabbanan sappoke mesappeka lehu i choshshin lezera haav i en choshshin
Umiddilrabbanan mesappeka lehu lerabbi eliezer peshita leh
Veha detanya hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagim bechoy uvchilayim rabbi eliezer omer kilayim habba min haez umin harachel chayyav bemattanot min hakkoy patur min hammattanot
Bemay askinan ilema betayish habba al hatztzeviyya veyalda bishlama lerabbi eliezer defatar kasavar se vaafilu miktzat se la amrinan
Ella lerabbanan nehi dekasavri se vaafilu miktzat se bishlama palga la yahev leh idach palga lema leh ayeti reaya dechoshshin lezera haav ushkol
Ella bitzvi habba al hatteyasha veyalda bishlama lerabbanan may chayyav bachatzi mattanot ella lerabbi eliezer lichayyav bechullehi mattanot
Leolam bitzvi habba al hatteyasha veyalda verabbi eliezer name sappoke mesappeka leh i choshshin lezera haav o la vechevan dilrabbanan mesappeka lehu ulrabbi eliezer mesappeka leh bemay peligi

a: Bese vaafilu miktzat se rabbanan savri se vaafilu miktzat se verabbi eliezer savar se velo miktzat se
Amar rav pappa hilkach leinyan kissuy haddam umattanot la mashkachatte ella bitzvi habba al hatteyasha
Deven lerabbanan uven lerabbi eliezer mesappeka lehu i choshshin lezera haav o la
Veka mipalgi bese vaafilu miktzat se
Leinyan oto veet beno mashkachatte lah ben betayish habba al hatztzeviyya uven bitzvi habba al hatteyasha
Betayish habba al hatztzeviyya ulisura derabbanan savri dilma choshshin lezera haav se vaafilu miktzat se amrinan veasur
Verabbi eliezer savar nehi name dechoshshin lezera haav se vaafilu miktzat se la amrinan
Bitzvi habba al hatteyasha ulmalkut rabbanan savri nehi name dechoshshin lezera haav se vaafilu miktzat se amrinan umalkenan leh verabbi eliezer savar isura ika malkut leka
Isura ika dilma en choshshin lezera haav vehay se mealleya hu malkut leka dilma choshshin lezera haav
Vese vaafilu miktzat se la amrinan
Amar rav yehuda koy beriyya bifne atzmah hi velo hichriu bah chachamim im min behema hi im min chayya hi rav nachman amar koy ze el habbar

Ketannae koy ze ayil habbar veyesh omrim ze habba min hattayish umin hatztzeviyya rabbi yose omer koy beriyya bifne atzmah hi velo hichriu bah chachamim im min chayya im min behema rabban shimon ben gamliel omer min behema hi veshel bet dushay hau megaddelin mehen adarim adarim
Amar rabbi zera amar rav safra amar rav hamnuna hane izze devala kesherot legabbe mizbeach savar lah ki ha deamar rabbi yitzchak eser behemot mana hakkatuv vetu la
Vehane middela kachashev lehu bahade chayyot shema minah deez ninhu matkef lah rav acha bar yaakov veema ayyal utzvi parat kol behema kalal
Parat vechalal naase kelal musaf al happerat ika tuva
Im ken kol hane perate lema li matkef lah rav acha bereh derav ika vedilma mina deakko ninhu
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe veamri lah rav acha bereh derav aveya lerav ashe dilma mina dito o mina dezemer ninhu amar leh rav chanan lerav ashe ammemar share tarbayehu
Bea mineh abba bereh derav minyamin bar chiyya merav huna bar chiyya hane izze devala mahu legabbe mizbeach amar leh ad kan la peligi rabbi yose verabbanan ella beshor habbar

Ditnan shor habbar min behema hu rabbi yose omer min chayya derabbanan savri middimtargeminan torbala mina divhema hu verabbi yose savar middeka chashev leh bahade chayyot mina dechayya hu aval hane divre hakkol mina deez ninhu
Matkef lah rav acha bereh derav ika vedilma mina deakko ninhu amar leh ravina lerav ashe vedilma mina detao o mina dezemer ninhu amar leh rav nachman lerav ashe ammemar share tarbayehu

Ketzad hashshochet vechu amar rabbi oshaya kullah matnitin dela kerabbi shimon mimmay middeka tane kadashim bachutz harishon chayyav karet ushnehem pesulim ushnehem sofgim et haarbaim mikkedi shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita
b: Kamma miktal katleh sheni mitkabbel bifnim hu karet name lichayyav
Chullin bifnim shenehem pesulin vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim mikkede shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita kamma miktal katleh sheni ammay sofeg et haarbaim
Kadashim bifnim harishon kasher ufatur vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul

Vehayenu deamar rabbi chiyya raa rabbi devarav shel rabbi shimon bechissuy haddam ushnao bilshon chachamim
Amar rabbi abba
b: Lo lakkol amar rabbi meir shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita mode rabbi meir sheen mattiratah baachila velo lakkol amar rabbi shimon shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita mode rabbi shimon shemmetahartah mide nevela
Amar mar lo lakkol amar rabbi meir shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita mode rabbi meir sheen mattiratah baachila peshita terefa bishchita mi mishtarya
La tzericha leshochet et hatterefa umatza bah ben tisha chay salka datach amena hoil deamar rabbi meir shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita tahane leh shechitat immo vela live shechita kamashma lan
Vetisbera vehaamar rabbi meir ben pekua taun shechita
La tzericha derabbi savar lah kerabbi meir vesavar lah kerabbanan savar lah kerabbi meir deamar shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita vesavar lah kerabbanan deamri shechitat immo metaharto
Kevan daamur rabbanan shechitat immo metaharto tahane leh shechitat immo vela live shechita ka mashma lan

Velo lakkol amar rabbi shimon shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita mode rabbi shimon shemmetahartah mide nevela peshita deamar rav yehuda amar rav veamri lah bematnita tana vechi yamut min habbehema miktzat behema metammea umiktzat behema enah metammea vee zo zo terefa sheshshechatah
La tzericha leshochet et hatterefa vehi chullin baazara detanya hashshochet et hatterefa vechen hashshochet venimtzet terefa ze vaze chullin baazara rabbi shimon mattir bahanaa vachachamim osrin
Salka datach amena hoil veamar rabbi shimon muttar bahanaa alma lav shechita hi kelal ema mide nevela name la metahara ka mashma lan

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye vesavar rabbi shimon chullin baazara deorayeta hi amar leh in vehatnan rabbi shimon omer chullin shennishchatu baazara yissarfu baesh vechen chayya shennishchata baazara i amratte bishlama deorayeta hayenu degazrinan chayya attu behema
Ella i amratte derabbanan behema may tama dilma ate lemechal kadashim bachutz hi gufah gezera vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera
Rabbi chiyya nefal leh yaniva bechitaneh ata lekammeh derabbi amar leh shekol ofa ushchot al buvita demayya demorach dema veshavek leh
Hechi aved hachi vehatanya hashshochet vetzarich laddam chayyav lechassot ketzad yaase o nocharo o okro
Ki ata rav dimi amar tze terof amar leh ki ata ravin amar tze nechor amar leh
Leman deamar tze terof may tama la amar tze nechor

Vechi tema kasavar en shechita laof min hattora unchirato zo hi shechitato vehatanya rabbi omer kaasher tziviticha melammed shennitztava moshe al haveshet veal hakkane veal rov echad baof veal rov shenayim babbehema

a: La mibaya kaamar la mibaya tze nechor delav shechita hi kelal aval tze terof ema shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita velive kissuy ka mashma lan kidrabbi chiyya bar abba

Ulman deamar tze nechor may tama la amar tze terof vechi tema kasavar shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita veha amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan raa rabbi devarav shel rabbi shimon bechissuy haddam ushnao bilshon chachamim

La mibaya kaamar la mibaya tze terof dishchita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita aval tze nechor ema en shechita laof min hattora unchirato zo hi shechitato velive kissuy ka mashma lan kaasher tzivitich

Umi nefal leh yaniva bechitaneh vehaamar ravin bar abba veamri lah amar rabbi avin bar sheva mishshealu bene haggola pasku hazzikin vehazzevaot veharuchot veharamim velo hechmitz yenam velo laka pishtanam venatnu chachamim enehem berabbi chiyya uvanav

Ki mahneya zechutayehu aalma addidhu la kidrav yehuda amar rav deamar rav yehuda amar rav bechol yom vaom bat kol yotzet veomeret kal haolam kullo nizon bishvil chanina beni vachanina beni day lo bekav charuvin meerev shabbat leerev shabbat
Matni cheresh shote vekatan sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otam chayyav lechassot benan leven atzman patur millechassot

Vechen leinyan oto veet beno sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan asur lishchot acharehem benan leven atzman rabbi meir mattir lishchot acharehen vachachamim osrim umodim sheim shachat sheeno sofeg et haarbaim
Gema verabbanan may shena resha dela peligi umay shena sefa difligi
Resha i amrinan chayyavin lechassot amri shechita meallayeta hi veate lemechal mishshechitatan
Sefa name kevan dekaamri rabbanan asur lishchot acharehem amri shechita meallayeta hi veate lemechal mishshechitatan
Sefa amri bisra dela ka mibaya leh resha name amri lenakker chatzero hu tzarich
Shachat beashpa may ika lememar ba limalech may ika lememar
Velitamach sefa name ba limalech may ika lememar
Ella rabbanan akkullah milta peligi venatri leh lerabbi meir ad demassek lah lemilta vahadar peligi ilaveh
Bishlama rabbanan lechumra ella rabbi meir may tama
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan mechayyev haya rabbi meir al shechitatan mishshum nevela may tama amar rabbi amme hoil verov maasehen mekulkalim

Amar leh rav pappa lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua veamri lah rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa may irya rov afilu miut name deha rabbi meir chayesh lemiuta semoch miuta lachazaka veittera leh rubba

Ditnan tinok shennimtza betzad haisa uvatzek beyado rabbi meir metaher vachachamim metammein mippene sheddarko shel tinok letappeach veamrinan may tama derabbi meir kasavar rov tinokot metappechin umiut en metappechin veisa zo bechezkat tohora omedet
b: Semoch miuta lachazaka veitra leh rubba
Im amru sefek tuma letaher yomru sefek isur lehattir
Hora rabbi kerabbi meir vehora rabbi kachachamim he minayehu deacharita

Ta shema derabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba verabbi zera hao kayemi beshuka dekesari appitcha deve midresha nefak rabbi amme ashkechinhu amar lehu lav amena lechu beidan be midresha la tekimu abbaray dilma ika inash demitztarcha leh shemata veate leitrode

Rabbi zera al rabbi abba la al yatvi veka mibaya lehu he minayehu achrita amar lehu rabbi zera la shevaktun li deeshayeleh lesava dilma shemia leh meavuh vaavuh mineh derabbi yochanan derabbi chiyya bar abba kol telatin yomin ka mahdar talmudeh kammeh derabbi yochanan
May have alah ta shema deshalach rabbi elazar laggola hora rabbi kerabbi meir veha kerabbanan name ori ella lav shema minah ha deacharita shema minah

Matni shachat mea chayyot bemakom echad kissuy echad lechullan mea ofot bemakom echad kissuy echad lechullan chayya vaof bemakom echad kissuy echad lechullan rabbi yehuda omer shachat chayya yechassenna veachar kach yishchot et haof

Gema tanu rabbanan chayya kol mashma chayya ben merubba uven muetet of kol mashma of ben merubbe uven muat mikkan amru shachat mea chayyot bemakom echad kissuy echad lechullan mea ofot bemakom echad kissuy echad lechullan chayya vaof bemakom echad kissuy echad lechullan
Rabbi yehuda omer shachat chayya yechassenna veachar kach yishchot et haof shenneemar chayya o of
Amru lo hare hu omer ki nefesh kol basar damo venafsho hu may ka mehadderi leh hachi kaamri leh rabbanan hay o mibe leh lechallek
Verabbi yehuda lechallek middamo nafka verabbanan damo tuva mashma dichtiv ki nefesh kol basar damo venafsho hu

Amar rabbi chanina mode haya rabbi yehuda leinyan beracha sheeno mevarech ella beracha achat amar leh ravina lerav acha bereh derava veamri lah rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe may shena mittalmide derav

Derav berona verav chananel talmide derav hao yatvi bisodta kae alayehu rav yeva sava amaru leh hav livarech hadur amaru leh hav lishte amar lehu rav yeva sava hachi amar rav kevan daamar hav livarech itsar leh lemishte chamra hacha name kevan deitappal leh lechissuy ichayyav leh livracha

a: Hachi hashta hatam mishte uvaroche bahade hadade la efshar hacha efshar deshachet bachada umchasse bachada
Matni shachat velo kissa veraahu acher chayyav lechassot kissahu venitgalla patur millechassot kissahu kissattu haruach chayyav lechassot
Gema tanu rabbanan veshafach vechissa mi sheshshafach yechasse shachat velo kissa veraahu acher minnayin shechayyav lechassot shenneemar vaomar livne yisrael azhara lechol bene yisrael

Tanya idach veshafach vechissa bamme sheshshafach bo yechasse shello yechassennu baregel shello yihu mitzot bezuot alav tanya idach veshafach vechissa mi sheshshafach hu yechassennu maase beechad sheshshachat vekadam chavero vechissa vechiyevo rabban gamliel liten lo asara zehuvim
Ibaya lehu sechar mitzva o sechar beracha lemay nafka minah levirkat hammazon i amratte sechar mitzva achat hi vei amratte sechar beracha haveyan arbaim may

Ta shema daamar leh hahu mina lerabbi mi sheyyatzar harim lo bara ruach umi shebbara ruach lo yatzar harim dichtiv ki hinne yotzer harim uvore ruach amar leh shote shefel lesefeh dikra Adonai tzevaot shemo
Amar leh nekot li zimna telata yome umahdarna lach teuvta yetev rabbi telat taaniyyata ki hava ka bae mivra amaru leh mina kae abbava amar vayyittenu bevaruti rosh vego

Amar leh rabbi mevasser tovot ani lach lo matza teshuva oyivcha venafal min haggag vamet amar lo retzoncha shettisod etzli amar lo hen leachar sheachlu veshatu amar lo kos shel beracha atta shote o arbaim zehuvim atta notel amar lo kos shel beracha ani shote yatzta bat kol veamra kos shel beracha shave arbaim zehuvim
Amar rabbi yitzchak adayin yeshnah leotah mishpacha ben gedole romi vekorin otah mishpachat bar luyanus
Kissahu venitgalla amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe may shena mehashavat aveda deamar mar hashev afilu mea peamim
Amar leh hatam la ketiv miuta hacha ketiv miuta vechissahu

Kissahu haruach amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shechazar venitgalla aval lo chazar venitgalla patur millechassot vechi chazar venitgalla may have ha idchi leh amar rav pappa zot omeret en dichuy etzel mitzot
