Umay shena meha detanya hashshochet venivla dam bakkarka chayyav lechassot hatam kesherishshumo nikar
Matni dam shennitarev bemayim im yesh bo marit dam chayyav lechassot nitarev beyayin roin oto keilu hu mayim nitarev bedam habbehema
b: O bedam hachayya roin oto keilu hen mayim rabbi yehuda omer en dam mevattel dam
Dam hannitaz vesheal hassakkin chayyav lechassot amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman sheen sham dam ella hu aval yesh sham dam shello hu patur millechassot

Gema tenan hatam dam shennitarev bemayim im yesh bo marit dam kasher nitarev beyayin roin oto keilu hu mayim nitarev bedam behema o bedam hachayya roin oto keilu hu mayim rabbi yehuda omer en dam mevattel dam
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella shennaflu mayim letoch dam aval nafal dam letoch mayim rishon rishon batel
Amar rav pappa ulinyan kissuy eno ken en dichuy etzel mitzot
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol mare addemumit mechapperin umachshirin vechayyavin bechissuy may kamashma lan mechapperin tenena chayyavin bechissuy tenena
Machshirin itztericha leh machshirin name i dam achshore machshar i mayya achshore machsheri la tzericha shettimmedo beme geshamim
Me geshamim name kevan deshakel verame achshevinhu la tzericha shennitmedu mealehen
Rabbi assi minneharbil omer bitzlalta didma rabbi yirmeya middifti amar anush karet vehu deika kezayit bematnita tana metammeim beohel vehu deika reviit
Tenan hatam kol mashke hammet tehorin chutz middamo vechol mare addemumit shebbo metammein beohel umashke hammet tehorin urminhu mashke tevul yom mashkin hayyotzin mimmennu kemashkin shennogea bahen

a: Veellu vaellu en metammein ushar kol hattemein ben kallin ben chamurin mashkin hayyotzin mehen kemashke hannogea bahen veellu vaellu techilla chutz min hammashke shehu av hattuma
May kallin umay chamurin may lav kallin sheretz vezav vachamurin met la kallin sheretz vachamurin zav
May shena zav digzaru beh rabbanan umay shena met dela gezaru beh rabbanan zav dela bedili inashe mineh gezaru beh rabbanan met divdili inashe mineh la gezaru beh rabbanan

Dam hannitaz vesheal hassakkin tanu rabbanan vechissahu melammed sheddam hannitaz vesheal hassakkin chayyav lechassot amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman sheen sham dam ella hu aval yesh sham dam shello hu patur millechassot

Tanya idach vechissahu melammed shekkol damo chayyav lechassot mikkan amru dam hannitaz vesheal agappayim chayyav lechassot amar rabban shimon ben gamliel bamme devarim amurim shello kissa dam hannefesh aval kissa dam hannefesh patur millechassot
Bemay ka mipalgi rabbanan savri damo kol damo rabbi yehuda savar damo vaafilu miktzat damo verabban shimon ben gamliel savar damo hamuchad

Matni bamme mechassin uvamme en mechassin mechassin bezevel haddak uvchol haddak besid uvcharsit uvilvena uvimgufa shekketashan aval en mechassin lo bezevel haggas velo bechol haggas velo bilvena uvimgufa shello ketashan velo yichpe alav et hakkeli kelal amar rabban shimon ben gamliel davar shemmegaddel bo tzemachim mechassin bo vesheeno megaddel tzemachim en mechassin bo

Gema hechi dame chol haddak amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol sheen hayyotzer tzarich lechotsho veika dematne lah assefa aval en mechassin lo bezevel haggas velo bechol haggas hechi dame chol haggas amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol shehayyotzer tzarich lechotsho
May benayehu ika benayehu ditzrich vela tzerich demiprich iproche

Tanu rabbanan vechissahu yachol yechassennu baavanim o yichpe alav et hakkeli talmud lomar beafar veen li ella afar minnayin lerabbot zevel haddak vechol haddak ushchikat avanim ushchikat charsit unoret pishtan dakka
b: Unsoret shel charashin dakka vesid vecharsit levana umgufa shekketashan talmud lomar vechissahu yachol sheani merabbe af zevel haggas vechol haggas ushchikat kele mattachot ulvena umgufa shello ketashan vekemach vesubbin umursan talmud lomar beafar
Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulhotzi et ellu achar sheriba hakkatuv umiet merabbe ani et ellu shehen min afar umotzi ani et ellu sheenan min afar
Ema vechissahu kalal afar parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat afar in mide acharina la
Amar rav mari mishshum dehave kelal hatztzarich lifrat vechol kelal hatztzarich lifrat en danin oto bichlal ufrat
Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda en mechassim ella bedavar shezzorin bo umatzmiach amar rava hay burcha

Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava may burchateh ana amritah nihaleh umeha matnita amritah nihaleh haya mehallech bammidbar veen lo efer lechassot shochek dinar zahav umchasse haya mehallech bisfina veen lo afar lechassot soref tallito umchasse
Bishlama soref tallito umchasse ashkechan efer deikri afar ella dinar zahav menalan amar rabbi zera veafrot zahav lo
Tanu rabbanan en mechassin ella beafar divre bet shammay uvet hillel omrim matzinu efer shekkaruy afar shenneemar velakchu lattame meafar serefat uvet shammay afar serefa ikri afar setama la ikri
Tana hosifu alehen hashshechor vehakkechol venikrat pisulin veyesh omrim af hazzarnich
Amar rava bischar sheamar avraham avinu veanochi afar vaefer zachu banav lishte mitzot efer para vaafar sota
Velichshov name afar kissuy haddam hatam hechsher mitzva ika hanaa leka
Veamar rava bischar sheamar avraham avinu

a: Im michut vead seroch naal zachu banav lishte mitzot lechut shel techelet urtzua shel tefilin
Bishlama retzua shel tefilin ketiv verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha vetanya rabbi eliezer haggadol omer ellu tefilin shebbarosh ella chut shel techelet may hi

Detanya rabbi meir omer ma nishtanna techelet mikkol hatztzivonin mippene shettechelet dome layyam veyam dome larakia verakia dome leeven sappir veeven sappir dome lechisse hakkavod dichtiv vayyiru et elohe yisrael vetachat raglav vego uchtiv kemare even sappir demut kisse
Amar rabbi abba kashe gazel hanneechal sheafilu tzaddikim gemurim enan yecholin lehachziro shenneemar biladay rak asher achlu hannearim

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon kol makom sheatta motze devarav shel rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili bahaggada ase oznecha kaafarkeset lo merubbechem mikkol haammim chashak Adonai bachem vego amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael choshkani bachem sheafilu beshaa sheani mashpia lachem gedulla attem memaatin atzmechem lefanay
Natatti gedulla leavraham amar lefanay veanochi afar vaefer lemoshe veaharon amar venachnu ma ledavid amar veanochi tolaat velo ish

Aval ummot haolam enan ken natatti gedulla lenimrod amar hava nivne lanu ir lefaro amar mi Adonai lesancheriv amar mi bechol elohe haaratzot vego linvuchadnetztzar amar eele al bamote av lechiram melech tzor amar moshav elohim yashavti belev yammim

Amar rava veitema rabbi yochanan gadol shenneemar bemoshe veaharon yoter mimma shenneemar beavraham deilu beavraham ketiv veanochi afar vaefer veilu bemoshe veaharon ketiv venachnu ma veamar rava veitema rabbi yochanan en haolam mitkayyem ella bishvil moshe veaharon ketiv hacha venachnu ma uchtiv hatam tole aretz al belima
Amar rabbi ila en haolam mitkayyem ella bishvil mi shebbolem et atzmo bishat meriva shenneemar tole eretz al belima rabbi avahu amar mi shemmesim atzmo kemi sheeno shenneemar umittachat zeroot olam

Amar rabbi yitzchak may dichtiv haumnam elem tzedek tedabberun mesharim tishpetu bene adam ma ummanuto shel adam baolam hazze yasim atzmo keillem yachol af ledivre tora talmud lomar tzedek tedabberun yachol yagis dato talmud lomar mesharim tishpetu bene adam
Amar rabbi zeera veitema rabba bar yirmeya mechassin baafar ir hanniddachat veammay isure hanaa hu
Amar zeeri lo nitzrecha ella laafar afarah dichtiv veet kol shelalah tikbotz el toch rechovah vesarafta mi sheeno mechussar ella kevitza usrefa yatza ze shemchussar telisha kevitza usrefa
Verava amar mitzot lav lehanot nitnu
Yatev ravina vekaamar lah leha shemata etiveh rav rechumi leravina shofar shel avoda zara lo yitka bo may lav im taka lo yatza la im taka yatza
Lulav shel avoda zara lo yittol may lav im natal lo yatza la im natal yatza vehatanya taka lo yatza natal lo yatza
Amar rav ashe hachi hashta hatam
b: Shiura baenan vaavoda zara kattote mechattat shiura hacha kol ma dimchattat mealle lechissuy
Hadaran alach kissuy haddam

Matni gid hannashe noheg baaretz uvchutza laaretz bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit bachullin uvammukdashin venoheg bivhema uvchayya beyarech shel yamin uvyarech shel semol veeno noheg baof mippene sheen lo kaf
Venoheg bashshelil rabbi yehuda omer eno noheg bashshelil vechelbo muttar
Veen hattabbachin neemanin al gid hannashe divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim neemanin alav veal hachelev
Gema mukdashin peshita mishshum deakdesheh peka leh isur gid mineh
Vechi tema yesh begidin benoten taam veate isur mukdashin vechayel aisur gid hay mukdashin noheg begid mibe leh ella kasavar en begidin benoten taam uvmukdashin isur gid ika isur mukdashin leka
Vesavar tanna didan en begidin benoten taam vehatnan yarech shennitbashshel bah gid hannashe im yesh bah benoten taam hare zo asura
Ella hacha bevaldot kadashim askinan vekasavar noheg bashshelil vekasavar valdot kadashim bime imman hen kedoshim deisur gid veisur mukdashin bahade hadade kaate
Umi matzet mokmatte lah bishlil veha middekatane sefa noheg bashshelil mikkelal deresha lav bishlil askinan hachi kaamar davar ze machloket derabbi yehuda verabbanan
Umi matzet amratte detarvayehu bahade hadade kaatu vehatnan al ellu tumot hannazir megalleach al hammet veal kezayit min hammet
Vekashya lan al kezayit min hammet megalleach al kullo lo kol shekken veamar rabbi yochanan lo nitzrecha ella lenefel shello nitkashsheru evarav begidin

a: Alma isur mukdashin kadem
Af al gav deisur mukdashin kadem ate isur gid chayel alayehu shekken isuro noheg bivne noach
Man shamatte leh hay sevara rabbi yehuda veha matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda dekatane noheg bivhema uvchayya beyarech shel yamin uvyarech shel semol
Hay tanna savar lah kevateh bachada uflig aleh bachada
Emar deshamatte leh lerabbi yehuda bitmea deisur lav kadashim deisur karet mi shamatte leh
Ella hacha bimvakkeret askinan devarechem kadosh
Vei baet ema valdot kadashim bahavayatan hen kedoshim

Amar rabbi chiyya bar yosef lo shanu ella kodashim hanneechalin aval kadashim sheenan neechalin en isur gid noheg bahen verabbi yochanan amar echad kadashim hanneechalin veechad kadashim sheen neechalin isur gid noheg bahen
Amar rav pappa vela peligi kan lehalkoto kan lehaaloto
Ika deamri amar rav pappa vela peligi kan lecholtzo vechan lehaaloto
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar lehaaloto peligi detanya vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha lerabbot haatzamot vehaggidin vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim
Yachol afilu pershu talmud lomar veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam
I basar vadam yachol yachlotz gidim vaatzamot veyaale basar legabbe mizbeach talmud lomar vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha ha ketzad mechubbarin yaalu pershu afilu berosho shel mizbeach yerdu
Uman tanna deshamatte leh deamar pershu yerdu rabbi hi detanya vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol lerabbot haatzamot vehaggidim vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim vaafilu pershu
Veha ma ani mekayyem veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam befokin ha ketzad ikule vasar atta machazir vei atta machazir ikule gidim vaatzamot
Rabbi omer katuv echad omer vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol riba vechatuv echad omer veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam miet ha ketzad mechubbarin yaalu pershu afilu berosho shel mizbeach yerdu
Verabbanan mechubbarin la itzterich kera lerabboye mide dehave aroshah shel ola ki itzterich kera lefershu
Verabbi mechubbarin dehetera
b: La itzterich kera lerabboye ki itzterich kera legid hannashe bimchubbar
Verabbanan mimmashke yisrael min hammuttar leyisrael
Verabbi mide dehave achelev vadam verabbanan mitzvatan bechach shane
Amar rav huna gid hannashe shel ola choltzo lattappuach amar rav chisda mari dechi mi ketiv al ken lo yochal hammizbeach al ken lo yochlu vene yisrael ketiv
Verav huna mimmashke yisrael min hammuttar leyisrael
Metivi gid hannashe shel shelamim mechabbedo laamma veshel ola maalehu may lav maalehu umaktiro
Lo maalehu vecholtzo umeachar shecholtzo lamma maalehu mishshum shenneemar hakrivehu na lefechatecha
Tanya kevateh derav huna gid hannashe shel shelamim mechabbedo laamma veshel ola choltzo lattappuach
Tenan hatam tappuach haya beemtza hammizbeach peamim haya alav kishlosh meot kor amar rava guzma
Hishku et hattamid bechos shel zahav amar rava guzma
Amar rabbi amme dibbera tora leshon havay dibberu neviim leshon havay dibberu chachamim leshon havay dibberu chachamim leshon havay ha daamaran
Dibbera tora leshon havay arim gedolot uvtzurot bashshamayim dibberu neviim leshon havay vattibbaka haaretz lekolam
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani amar shemuel bishlosha mekomot dibberu chachamim leshon havay ellu hen tappuach gefen ufarochet tappuach ha daamaran

Gefen ditnan gefen shel zahav hayeta omedet al pitcho shel hechal mudla al gabbe kelonsot vechol mi shehaya mitnaddev garger o eshkol mevi vetole bah amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok maase haya venimnu aleha shelosh meot kohanim lefannotah

Parochet ditnan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon hassegan parochet ovyah tefach veal shivim ushnayim nirim neereget veal kol nima venima esrim vearbaa chutin orkah arbaim baamma verochbah esrim beamma umishshemonim ushte ribbo naaset ushtayim osim beshana vshlosh meot kohanim matbilin otah
Beyarech shel yamin uvyarech shel semol matnitin la kerabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer eno noheg ella beachat vehaddaat machraat et shel yamin
Ibaya lehu mifshat peshita leh lerabbi yehuda umay daat daat tora o dilma sappoke mesappeka leh umay daat daat nota
Ta shema haatzamot vehaggidim vehannotar yissarfu leshishsha asar vehavenan bah hane gide may avidtayehu i gide vasar lechlinhu vei deiyyatur hayenu notar ella gide tzavar i lav basar ninhu lishdinhu
Veamar rav chisda lo nitzrecha ella legid hannashe vealliba derabbi yehuda deamar eno noheg ella beachat
I amratte bishlama sappoke mesappeka leh shappir ella i amratte mifshat peshita leh dehetera lechleh deisura lishdeyeh
Amar rav ika bar chanina leolam ema lach mifshat peshita leh vehacha bemay askinan keshehukkeru ulvassof nitarvu

a: Rav ashe amar lo nitzrecha ella leshomno detanya shomno muttar veyisrael kedoshim nahagu bo isur
Ravina amar lo nitzrecha ella lechidrav yehuda amar shemuel deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel shene gidin hen penimi samuch leetzem asur vechayyavin alav chitzon samuch levasar asur veen chayyavin alav
Ta shema achal mizze kezayit umizze kezayit sofeg shemonim rabbi yehuda omer eno sofeg ella arbaim
I amratte bishlama mifshat peshita leh shappir ella i amratte sappoke mesappeka leh haveya lah hatraat safek veshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda deamar hatraat safek lo shemah hatraa

Detanya hikka et ze vechazar vehikka et ze killel et ze vechazar vekillel et ze hikka shenehem bevat achat o shekkillel shenehem bevat achat chayyav rabbi yehuda omer bevat achat chayyav beze achar ze patur
Hay tanna savar lah keidach tanna derabbi yehuda deamar hatraat safek shemah hatraa
Detanya lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vego ba hakkatuv liten ase achar lo taase lomar sheen lokin alav divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi yaakov omer lo min hashshem hu ze ella mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav
Ta shema achal shene gidin mishshette yerechot mishshette vehemot sofeg shemonim rabbi yehuda omer eno sofeg ella arbaim
Middekaamar mishte yerechot mishshette vehemot peshita detarvayehu leisura ulrabbi yehuda itzterich shema minah mifshat peshita leh shema minah
Vei peshita leh ammay sofeg arbaim vetu la lilke shemonim hacha bemay askinan kegon delet bo kezayit detanya achalo veen bo kezayit chayyav rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyehe bo kezayit
Vetama may amar rava amar kera hayyarech hamummenet shebbayyarech
Verabbanan hahu defashet isureh bechulleh yarech leappoke chitzon dela
Verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar amar kera beheavko immo keadam shechovek et chavero veyado maggaat lechaf yemino shel chavero
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar kegoy nidma lo deamar mar yisrael shennitpal lo goy badderech toflo limino
Rav shemuel bar acha kammeh derav pappa mishshemeh derava bar ulla amar ketalmid chacham nidma lo deamar mar hamhallech limin rabbo hare ze bur
Verabbanan meachoreh ata venashsheyeh betarvayehu

Verabbanan hay beheavko immo may darshi beh mibbee leh lichidach derabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi melammed sheheelu avak margelotam ad kisse hakkavod ketiv hacha beheavko immo uchtiv hatam veanan avak raglav
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi lamma nikra shemo gid hannashe shennasha mimmekomo veala vechen hu omer nashta gevuratam hau lenashim
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina may dichtiv davar shalach beyaakov venafal beyisrael davar shalach beyaakov ze gid hannashe venafal beyisrael sheppashat isuro bechol yisrael
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina may dichtiv utvoach tevach vehachen pera lahen bet hashshechita vehachen tol gid hannashe bifnehem keman deamar gid hannashe neesar livne noach
Vayyivater yaakov levaddo amar rabbi elazar shennishtayyer al pakkin ketannim mikkan latztzaddikim shechaviv alehem mamonam yoter miggufam vechol kach lamma lefi sheen poshtin yedehen begazel
Vayyeavek ish immo ad alot hashshachar amar rabbi yitzchak mikkan letalmid chacham shello yetze yechidi ballayela rabbi abba bar kahana amar mehacha
b: Hinne hu zore et goren hasseorim
Rabbi avahu amar mehacha vayyashkem avraham babboker vayyachavosh et vego
Verabbanan amri mehacha lech na ree et shelom achecha veet shelom vego
Rav amar mehacha vayyizrach lo hashshemesh

Amar rabbi akiva shaalti et rabban gamliel veet rabbi yehoshua baitliz shel imaum shehalchu likach behema lemishte veno shel rabban gamliel ketiv vayyizrach lo hashshemesh vechi shemesh lo levad zarcha vahalo lechol haolam zarcha

Amar rabbi yitzchak shemesh habbaa baavuro zarcha baavuro dichtiv vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana uchtiv vayyifga bammakom ki meta lecharan amar efshar avarti al makom shehitpallelu avotay vaani lo hitpallalti kad yahev dateh lemihdar kefatza leh ara miyyad vayyifga bammakom
Kad tzalli bae lemehdar amar hakkadosh baruch hu tzaddik ze ba levet meloni veyippater belo lina miyyad ba hashshemesh

Ketiv vayyikkach meavne hammakom uchtiv vayyikkach et haeven amar rabbi yitzchak melammed shennitkabbetzu kol otan avanim lemakom echad vechol achat veachat omeret alay yanniach tzaddik ze rosho tana vechullan nivleu beechad

Vayyachalom vehinne sullam mutztzav artza tana kamma rochbo shel sullam shemonat alafim parsaot dichtiv vehinne malache elohim olim veordim bo olim shenayim veordim shenayim vechi fagu bahade hadade hau lehu arbaa
Uchtiv beh bemalach ugviyyato chetarshish ugmiri detarshish tere alfe parse have

Tana olin umistakkelin bidokno shel mala veordin umistakkelin bidokno shel matta beo lesakkoneh miyyad vehinne Adonai nitztzav alav amar rabbi shimon ben lakish ilmale mikra katuv i efshar leomro keadam shemmenif al beno
Haaretz asher atta shochev aleha vego may revuteh amar rabbi yitzchak melammed shekkippelah hakkadosh baruch hu lechol eretz yisrael vehinnicha tachat yaakov avinu shettehe nocha likavesh levanav
Vayyomer shallecheni ki ala hashshachar amar lo gannav atta o kuvustus atta shemmityare min hashshachar amar lo malach ani umiyyom shennivreti lo higgia zemanni lomar shira ad achshav

Mesayya leh lerav chananel amar rav deamar rav chananel amar rav shalosh kittot shel malache hashsharet omrot shira bechol yom achat omeret kadosh veachat omeret kadosh veachat omeret kadosh Adonai tzevaot

Metivi chavivin yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu yoter mimmalache hashsharet sheyyisrael omrim shira bechol shaa umalache hashsharet en omrim shira ella paam achat bayyom veamri lah paam achat beshabbat veamri lah paam achat bechodesh veamri lah paam achat bashshana veamri lah paam achat beshavua veamri lah paam achat beovel veamri lah paam achat baolam

Veyisrael mazkirin et hashshem achar shette tevot shenneemar shema yisrael Adonai vego umalache hashsharet en mazkirin et hashshem ella leachar shalosh tevot kedichtiv kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot
Veen malache hashsharet omrim shira lemala ad sheyyomru yisrael lematta shenneemar beron yachad kochve voker vahadar vayyariu kol bene elohim
Ella achat omeret kadosh veachat omeret kadosh kadosh veachat omeret kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot vehaika baruch

a: Baruch ofannim hu deamri leh veibaet ema kevan deityehiv reshuta ityehiv
Vayyasar el malach vayyuchal bacha vayyitchannen lo eni yodea mi naasa sar lemi keshehu omer ki sarita im elohim heve omer yaakov naasa sar lammalach
Bacha vayyitchannen lo eni yodea mi bacha lemi keshehu omer vayyomer shallecheni heve omer malach bacha leyaakov
Ki sarita im elohim veim anashim amar rabba remez ramaz lo sheatidim shene sarim latzet mimmennu rosh gola shebbevavel venasi shebbeeretz yisrael mikkan ramaz lo galut

Uvaggefen shelosha sarigim amar rav chiyya bar abba amar rav ellu shelosha sare geim hayyotzim miyyisrael bechol dor vador peamim sheshshenayim kan veechad beeretz yisrael peamim sheshshenayim beeretz yisrael veechad kan yehivu rabbanan enayehu berabbana ukva verabbana nechemya bene veratte derav
Rava amar ellu shelosha sare goyim shemlammedim zechut al yisrael bechol dor vador
Tanya rabbi eliezer omer gefen ze haolam shelosha serigim ze avraham yitzchak veyaakov vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah ellu haimmahot hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim ellu hashshevatim

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua vechi marin lo leadam ma shehaya vahalo en marin lo leadam ella ma sheatid lihot ella gefen ze tora shelosha sarigim ellu moshe veaharon umiryam vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah ellu sanhedrin hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim ellu hatztzaddikim shebbechal dor vador

Amar rabban gamliel adayin tzerichin anu lammodai demokem leh kulleh bechad makom rabbi elazar hammodai omer gefen ze yerushalayim shelosha sarigim ze mikdash melech vechohen gadol vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah ellu pirche chehunna hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim ellu nesachim

Rabbi yehoshua ben levi mokem lah bemattanot deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi gefen zo tora shelosha sarigim ze beer ammud anan uman vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah ellu habbikkurim hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim ellu nesachim

Rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar gefen ellu yisrael vechen hu omer gefen mimmitzrayim tassia shelosha sarigim ellu shelosha regalim sheyyisrael olin bahen bechol shana veshana vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah higgia zemannan shel yisrael lifrot velirbot vechen hu omer uvne yisrael paru vayyishretzu
Alta nitztza higgia zeman shel yisrael ligael vechen hu omer veyez nitzcham al begaday vechol malbushay egalti hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim higgia zemannah shel mitzrayim lishtot kos hattarela
Vehayenu deamar rava shelosha kosot haamurot bemitzrayim lama echad sheshshatat bime moshe veechad sheshshatat bime paro necho veechad sheatida lishtot im kol haggoyim
Amar leh rabbi abba lerabbi yirmeya bar abba ki daresh lehu rav lehane kerae beaggadta kevatach daresh lehu

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish umma zo kegefen nimshela zemorot shebbah ellu baale vattim eshkolot shebbah ellu talmide chachamim alin shebbah ellu amme haaretz kenokanot shebbah ellu rekanim shebbeyisrael
Vehayenu dishlachu mittam live rachamim itkalayya al alayya deilmale alayya la mitkayeman itkalayya
Vaekkereha li bachamishsha asar kasef amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak en kira ella leshon mechira shenneemar bekivri asher kariti li
Bachamishsha asar ze chamishsha asar benisan shebbo nigalu yisrael mimmitzrayim kasef ellu tzaddikim vechen hu omer tzeror hakkesef lakach beyado

Chomer seorim veletech seorim ellu arbaim vachamishsha tzaddikim shehaolam mitkayyem bahem veeni yodea im sheloshim kan vachamishsha asar beeretz yisrael veim sheloshim beeretz yisrael vachamishsha asar kan keshehu omer vaekcha sheloshim hakkesef vaashlich oto bet Adonai el hayyotzer heve omer sheloshim beeretz yisrael vachamishsha asar kan
Amar abbaye verubbayehu mishtachchi beve chenishta detute appeta vehayenu dichtiv vaomar alehem im tov beenechem havu sechari veim lo chadalu vayyishkelu et sechari sheloshim kasef
Rabbi yehuda omer ellu sheloshim tzaddike ummot haolam sheummot haolam mitkayemim alehem ulla amar ellu sheloshim mitzot shekkibbelu alehem bene noach veen mekayemin ella shelosha achat
b: Sheen kotvin ketubba lizcharim veachat sheen shoklin besar hammet bemakolin veachat shemmechabbedin et hattora
Veeno noheg baof veha ka chazenan deit leh it leh vela agil
Bae rabbi yirmeya it leh leof vaagil it leh livhema vela agil may batar dideh azlinan o batar mineh azlinan teku
Venoheg bashshelil amar shemuel vechelbo muttar ledivre hakkol
Chelbo demay ilema dishlil veha miflag peligi beh detanya noheg bashshelil vechelbo asur divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer eno noheg bashshelil vechelbo muttar
Veamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya machloket beven tisha chay vehalach rabbi meir leshitato verabbi yehuda leshitato
Veella chelbo degid ha miflag peligi bah detanya gid hannashe mechattet acharav bechol makom shehu vechotech shomno meikaro divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer gommo im hashshofi
Leolam chelbo degid mode shemuel dilrabbi meir midderabbanan asur detanya veshomno muttar veyisrael kedoshim nahagu bo isur may lav rabbi meir hi deamar muttar min hattora veasur midderabbanan
Mimmay dilma rabbi yehuda hi aval lerabbi meir middeorayeta name asir
La salka datach detanya gid hannashe mechattet acharav bechol makom shehu veshomno muttar man shamatte leh deit leh chatita rabbi meir vekaamar shomno muttar
Amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta amar rav lo asra tora ella kenokanot shebbo ulla amar etz hu vehattora chiyeva alav

Amar abbaye kevateh deulla mistabbera deamar rav sheshet amar rav assi chutin shebbachelev asurin veen chayyavin alehen alma chelev amar rachamana velo chutin hacha name gid amar rachamana velo kenokanot
Gufa amar rav sheshet amar rav assi chutin shebbachelev asurin veen chayyavin alehen shebbakkulya asurin veen chayyavin alehen loven kulya rabbi verabbi chiyya chad asar vechad share
Rabba memartet leh rabbi yochanan memartet leh rabbi assi gaem leh amar abbaye kevateh derabbi assi mistabbera deamar rabbi abba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel

a: Chelev shehabbasar chofe oto muttar alma sheal hakkesalim amar rachamana velo shebbetoch hakkesalim hacha name sheal hakkelaot amar rachamana velo shebbetoch hakkelaot
Gufa amar rabbi abba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel chelev shehabbasar chofe oto muttar ini vehaamar rabbi abba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hay tarba detute matne asir
Amar abbaye behema bechayyeha paroke miparka amar rabbi yochanan ana lav tabbacha ana velav bar tabbacha ana unhirna dehachi hao amri be midresha behema bechayyeha paroke miparka

Amar rabbi abba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel chelev sheal hemses uvet hakkosot asur veanush karet vezehu chelev sheal hakkerev amar rabbi abba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hay tarba diklivusta asur veanush karet vezehu chelev sheal hakkesalim

Veamar rabbi abba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel chutin shebbayyad asurin amar rav safra moshe mi amar rachamana la techol bisra amar rava moshe mi amar rachamana achol dema chatcheh umalcheh afilu likdera name shappir dame
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel resh meayya beammeta bae gerira vezehu chelev sheal haddakkin

Veamar rav yehuda chutin shebbaoketz asurin chamsha chute it beh bechafla telata miyyammina vetarte missemala telata mippatzli litre tere tere mippatzli litlata telata nafka minah dei shalef lehu ad dechammime mishtallefi vei la bae chattote batrayehu
Amar abbaye veitema rav yehuda chamsha chute hau telata mishshum tarba utren mishshum dema ditchale udchafle udchulyata mishshum tarba dida udloa mishshum dema
Lemay nafka minah hane demishshum dema i mechattech lehu umalach lehu shappir dame hanach let lehu takkanta
Amar rav kahana veitema rav yehuda chamsha kerame hau telata mishshum tarba utre mishshum dema ditchale dechafle udchulyata mishshum tarba devee udmokra mishshum dema

Rav yehuda bar oshaya hava ka kalef leh techala lelevi bereh derav huna bar chiyya hava ka gaem leh meilay amar leh chot beh tefe ata avuh ashkecheh amar leh hachi amar avuh deimmach mishshum derav umannu rav yirmeya bar abba lo asra tora ella sheal haddad bilvad
Ini vehaamar rav hamnuna tana kerum sheal hattechol asur veen chayyavim alav hechi dame ilema sheal haddad ammay en chayyavin alav ella dechulleh amar leh i tanya tanya
Gufa amar rav hamnuna tana kerum sheal hattechol asur veen chayyavin alav kerum sheal gabbe kulya asur veen chayyavin alav vehatanya chayyavin alav
Techol attechol la kashya ha keneged haddad ha shello keneged haddad
Kulya akkulya name la kashya ha beilaa ha betattaa
Bee chashilata rav amme verav assi chad asar vechad share man deasar
b: Middela ka varyan hane ever min hachay ninhu man deshare middela ka masrechan hane chiyyuta it behu
Veidach hay dela ka masrechan dela ka shalet behu avera veidach hay dela baryan kechishuta hu dinkat lehu
Amar leh rabbi yochanan lerav shemen bar abba hane bee chashilata sharyan veatte la techol mishshum veal tittosh torat immecha

Amar mar bar rav ashe hane bee degadya ad telatin yomin sharyan bela kelifa mikkan veelach i zaran asurin vei la zaran sharyan mena yadinan i it behu shuryake summake asiran let behu shuryake summake sharyan

Umtze bee umzirke peligi bah rav acha veravina bechol hattora kullah ravina lekulla verav acha lechumra vehilcheta keravina lekulla levar mehane telat derav acha lekulla veravina lechumra vehilcheta kerav acha lekulla

Umtza deasmek chatchah umalchah afilu likdera name shappir dame talyah name beshappuda daev dema aggumre peligi bah rav acha veravina chad amar mishav shayevi leh vechad amar mitzmat tzamti leh vechen bee vechen mezirke
Resha bechivsha otveh abbet hashshechita dayev dema ushre atztzedadin mikpa kafe vaasir otveh annechireh datz beh mide shere vei la asir
Ika deamri annechireh veabbet hashshechita daev atztzedadin i datz beh mide shere vei la asir
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shene gidin hen happenimi samuch laetzem asur vechayyavin alav chitzon samuch labbasar asur veen chayyavin alav
Vehatanya penimi samuch labbasar amar rav acha amar rav kahana iklode miklid
Veha tanya chitzon hassamuch laetzem amar rav yehuda hecha defari tabbache
Itmar tabbach shennimtza chelev acharav rav yehuda amar bechisora rabbi yochanan amar bichzayit
Amar rav pappa vela peligi kan lehalkoto kan leabbero
Amar mar zutra kisora bemakom echad kezayit afilu bishnayim uvishlosha mekomot vehilcheta lehalkoto bichzayit leabbero bechisora
En hattabbachin neemanin vechu amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan chazru lomar neemanin
Amar rav nachman ikkashshur dare meikara dahao savri lah kerabbi meir la hao mehemni ulvassof savri kerabbi yehuda
Ika dematne lah assefa vachachamim omrim neemanin alav veal hachelev amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan chazru lomar en neemanin amar rav nachman bizman hazze neemanin
Ikkashshur dare meikara savruha kerabbi yehuda hadar savruha kerabbi meir
Kamma dahao dechiri lah lidrabbi yehuda la mehemne vehashta deinnashuha lidrabbi yehuda mehemne
Veal hachelev chelev man dechar shemeh hachi kaamar en neemanin alav veal hachelev vachachamim omrim neemanin alav veal hachelev
Matni sholeach adam yarech legoy sheggid hannashe betochah mippene shemmekomo nikar
Gema shelema in chatucha la bemay askinan ilema bimkom sheen machrizin

a: Chatucha name lishaddar leh deha la atu lemizban mineh ella bimkom shemmachrizin shelema name la lishaddar leh dechatech leh umzabben leh
I baet ema bimkom shemmachrizin vei baet ema bimkom sheen machrizin
Ibaet ema bimkom shemmachrizin chitucha degoy mida yedia
Veibaet ema bimkom sheen machrizin gezera shemma yittenenna lo bifne yisrael acher
Vei baet ema mishshum deka ganev leh ledateh deamar shemuel asur lignov daat havriyyot vaafilu dato shel goy
Veha dishmuel lav beferush itmar ella mikkelala itmar dishmuel hava ka avar bemabbara amar leh leshammaeh payeseh lemabboroya payeseh veikfad
May tama ikfad amar abbaye tarnegolet terefa havay veyahavah nihaleh bemar dishchuta rava amar anpaka amar leh leashkoyeh veashkeyeh chamra meziga
Vechi mikkelala may leman deamar terefa havay amar leh ammay teshahe isura
Leman deamar anpaka amar leh leashkoye anpaka chayya mashma
Tanya haya rabbi meir omer al yesarhev adam lachavero lisod etzlo veodea bo sheeno soed velo yarbe lo betikrovet veodea bo sheeno mekabbel
Velo yiftach lo chaviyyot hammechurot lechenvani ella im ken hodio velo yomar lo soch shemen mippach rekan veim bishvil kevodo muttar
Ini veha ulla ikla leve rav yehuda patach lo chaviyyot hammechurot lachenvani odoe odeh veibaet ema shane ulla dechabbiv leh lerav yehuda divlav hachi name pattoche miftach hava patach leh
Tanu rabbanan lo yelech adam levet haevel uvyado lagin hammitkashkesh velo yemalleennu mayim mippene shemmatehu veim yesh sham chever ir muttar
Tanu rabbanan lo yimkor adam lachavero sandal shel meta bichlal shel chayya shechuta mippene shene devarim echad mippene shemmatehu veechad mippene hassakkana

Velo yeshagger adam lachavero chavit shel yayin veshemen tzaf al piha umaase beechad sheshshiger lachavero chavit shel yayin veshemen tzaf al piha vehalach vezimen aleha orchin venichnesu metzaah shehi shel yayin vechanak et atzmo
Veen haorchin rashshain liten mimma shellifnehem livno ulvitto shel baal habbayit ella im ken natlu reshut mibbaal habbayit

Umaase beechad shezzimmen shelosha orchin bishne vatztzoret velo haya lo lehanniach lifnehem ella keshalosh betzim ba beno shel baal habbayit natal echad mehen chelko untano lo vechen sheni vechen shelishi ba aviv shel tinok metzao sheozek echad befiv ushtayim beyado chavato bakkarka vamet kevan sheraata immo alta laggag venafla vameta af hu ala laggag venafal vamet
Amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov al davar ze nehergu shalosh nefashot miyyisrael may kamashma lan dechullah rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi

Tanu rabbanan hashsholeach yarech lachavero shelema eno tzarich sheyyittol hemenna gid hannashe chatucha tzarich litol hemenna gid hannashe uvgoy ben chatucha uven shelema en tzarich litol hemenna gid hannashe
Umippene shene devarim amru en mochrin nevelot utrefot legoy echad mippene shemmatehu veechad shemma yachzor veyimkerenna leyisrael acher
Velo yomar adam legoy kach li bedinar ze basar mippene shene devarim
b: Echad mippene haannasin veechad shemma mochrin lo nevelot utrefot

Amar mar uvgoy ben shelema ben chatucha eno tzarich litol hemenna gid hannashe bemay askinan ilema bemakom shemmachrizin chatucha ammay eno tzarich litol hemenna gid hannashe kevan dela achruz ate lemizban mineh
Ella peshita bimkom sheen machrizin ema metziata mippene shene devarim amru en mochrin nevelot utrefot legoy echad mippene shemmatehu veechad shemma yachzor veyimkerenna leyisrael acher
Vei bimkom sheen machrizin ha la ate lemizban mineh ella peshita bimkom shemmachrizin

Ema sefa lo yomar adam legoy kach li bedinar ze basar mippene shene devarim echad mippene haannasin veechad shemma mochrin lo nevelot utrefot vei bimkom shemmachrizin i ita dahava terefa achroze hao machrezi
Ella peshita bimkom sheen machrizin resha vesefa bimkom sheen machrizin metziata bimkom shemmachrizin
Amar abbaye in resha vesefa bimkom sheen machrizin metziata bimkom shemmachrizin
Rava amar kullah bimkom shemmachrizin resha vesefa shehichrizu metziata shello hichrizu
Rav ashe amar kullah bimkom sheen machrizin umtziata gezera shemma yimkerenna bifne yisrael
Hechi machrezinan amar rav yitzchak bar yosef nefal bisra livne chela
Velema nefal terefta livne chela la zavni
Veha kamate lehu inhu hu dekamatu nafshayehu

Ki ha demar zutra bereh derav nachman hava kaazel missichra leve machoza verava verav safra hao ka atu lesichra pegau ahadade hu savar leappeh hu dekaatu amar lehu lema lehu lerabbanan ditruach vaato kulle hay amar leh rav safra anan la hava yadinan dekaate mar i hava yadinan tefe hava tarchinan
Amar leh rava may tama amarte leh hachi deachleshteh ledateh amar leh veha ka matenan leh ihu hu deka mate nafsheh
Hahu tabbacha daamar leh lechavreh

a: I hava payesatte minay mi la sefayi lach mishshor shel pattam daavadi etmol amar leh achali mishufre shufre amar leh menalach amar leh dizvan peloni goy usfa li amar leh tere avadi vehahu terefa hava
Amar rabbi bishvil shote ze sheasa shello kahogen anu neesor kol hammakolin
Rabbi letameh daamar makolin vetabbache yisrael basar hannimtza beyad goy muttar
Ika deamri amar rabbi mippene shote ze deikavan letzaoreh lechavreh anu neesor kal hammakolin
Tama deikavan letzaoreh lechavreh ha lav hachi asur vehatanya rabbi omer makolin vetabbache yisrael basar hannimtza beyad goy muttar shane hacha deitachzak isura
Amar rav basar kevan shennitallem min haayin asur metivi rabbi omer makolin vetabbache yisrael basar hannimtza beyad goy muttar nimtza beyad goy shane

Ta shama tesha chanuot kullan mochrot besar shechuta veachat mocheret besar nevela velakach meachat mehen veeno yodea meeze mehen lakach sefeko asur uvnimtza hallech achar harov hacha name benimtza beyad goy
Ta shema matza bah basar im chay hallech achar rov tabbachim veim mevushshal hallech achar rov ochle vasar
Vechi tema hacha name benimtza beyad goy mevushshal hallech achar rov ochle vasar venechze i degoy naket leh i deyisrael naket leh hacha bemay askinan beomed veroehu
Ta shema nimtza baggevulin evarim nevelot chatichot muttarot vechi tema hacha name beomed veroehu evarim nevelot ammay
Mide hu tama ella lerav ha itmar alah rav amar muttarot mishshum nevela velevi amar muttarot baachila
Veha derav lav beferush ittemar ella mikkelala ittemar derav hava yatev ammabbara deishtatya chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava ka
b: Mechavar resha nefal mineh azal ayeti silta sheda assek teren amar rav avdi name hachi asrinhu nihaleh
Amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav deisura shechichi dehettera la shechichi amar lehu deisura shechichi tefe
Vechi mikkelala may parveta degoyim havay teda dekaamar lehu deisura shechichi tefe
Ella rav hechi achal bisra beshateh dela maalem eneh mineh ibaet ema betzayera vachatima vei name besimana ki ha derabba bar rav huna mechattech leh attelat karnata
Rav hava kaazel leve rav chanan chatneh chaza mabbara dekaate leappeh amar mabbara kaate leappay yoma tava lego

Azal kam abbava odek beviza dedashsha chaza cheveta detalya teraf abbava nefuk ato kulle alma leappeh ata tabbache name la allem rav eneh mineh amar lehu iko hashta sefitu lehu isura livne verat la achal rav mehahu bisra
May tama i mishshum iallome ha la iallam ella denachesh
Vehaamar rav kol nachash sheeno keeliezer eved avraham uchonatan ben shaul eno nachash ella seudat harshut havay verav la mithane misseudat harshut
Rav badek bemabbara ushmuel badek besifra rabbi yochanan badek beyanoka

Kullehu shene derav hava katav leh rabbi yochanan lakodam rabbenu shebbevavel ki nach nafsheh hava katav lishmuel lakodam chaverenu shebbevavel amar la yada li mide derabbeh ana ketav shaddar leh ibura deshitin shene amar hashta chushbana bealma yada
Ketav shaddar leh telesar gamle sefeke terefta amar it li rav bevavel ezil ichzeyeh amar leh leyanoka pesok li pesukach amar leh ushmuel met amar shema minah nach nafsheh dishmuel
Vela hi la shechev shemuel ella ki hechi dela litrach rabbi yochanan
Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer bayit tinok veishsha af al pi sheen nachash yesh siman
Amar rabbi elazar vehu deitachzak telata zimne dichtiv yosef enennu veshimon enennu veet binyamin tikkachu
Bea mineh rav huna merav bacharuzin mahu amar leh al tehi shote bacharuzin hare ze siman ika deamri amar rav huna amar rav bacharuzin hare ze siman
Rav nachman minnehardea ikla legabbe rav kahana lefum nahara bemaale yoma dechippure ato orve shadu kavde vechulyata amar leh shekol veechol haidana dehetera shechiach tefe
Rav chiyya bar avin itvad leh karkesha be dina ata lekammeh derav huna amar leh it lach simana begaveh amar leh la it lach teviut ena begaveh amar leh in im ken zil shekol
Rav chanina chozaa itvad leh gabba devisra ata lekammeh derav nachman amar leh it lach simana begaveh amar leh la it lach teviut ena begaveh amar leh in im ken zil shekol
Rav natan bar abbaye itvad leh kibura ditchelta ata lekammeh derav chisda amar leh it lach simana begaveh amar leh la it lach teviut ena begaveh amar leh in im ken zil shekol
Amar rava meresha hava amena simana adif mitteviut ena deha mahderinan avedta besimana

a: Vela mahderinan bitviut ena hashta dishmatinhu lehane shematata amena teviut ena adifa
Dei la tema hachi heach some muttar beishto uvne adam ech muttarin binshotehen ballayela ella bitviut ena dekala hacha name bitviut ena
Amar rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya teda deilu atu bitre veamri pelanya dehay simaneh vehay simaneh ketal nafsha la katlinan leh veilu amri it lan teviut ena begaveh katlinan leh
Amar rav ashe teda deilu amar leh inish lishlucheh karyeh liflanya dehay simaneh vehay simaneh safek yada leh safek la yada leh veilu it leh teviut ena begaveh ki chaze leh yada leh
Matni hannotel gid hannashe tzarich sheyyittol et kullo rabbi yehuda omer kede lekayyem bo mitzvat netila
Haochel miggid hannashe kezayit sofeg arbaim achalo veen bo kezayit chayyav achal mizze kezayit umizze kezayit sofeg shemonim rabbi yehuda omer eno sofeg ella arbaim
Gema bar paole hava kae kammeh dishmuel veka menakkar atma hava ka gaem leh amar leh chot beh tefe hashta la chazetach sefet li isura
Irtat nefal sakkina mideh amar leh la tirtat deori lach kerabbi yehuda ori lach
Amar rav sheshet may dishkal bar paole deorayeta lerabbi yehuda mikkelal deshayyar derabbanan lerabbi yehuda ella deori leh keman ori leh
Ella amar rav sheshet may dishkal bar paole deorayeta umay deshayyar derabbanan lerabbi meir dei rabbi yehuda afilu midderabbanan shere
Haochel miggid hannashe vechu amar shemuel lo asra tora ella sheal hakkaf bilvad shenneemar al kaf hayyarech
Amar rav pappa ketannae achalo veen bo kezayit chayyav rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyehe bo kezayit
May tama derabbanan beriyya bifne atzmah hi
b: Verabbi yehuda achila ketiva beh verabbanan hahi achila dechi it beh arbaa vachamishsha zetim vaachal chad kezayit michayyav
Verabbi yehuda measher al kaf hayyarech nafka
Verabbanan hahu mibe leh lichdishmuel deamar shemuel lo asra tora ella sheal kaf hayyarech verabbi yehuda hayyarech ketiv dechullah yarech
Verabbanan hahu defashet isureh bechullah yarech leappoke chitzon dela ulolam sheal hakkaf
Vehay kaf mibe leh lemaote of delet leh kaf tere kaf ketivi
Matni yarech shennitbashshel bah gid hannashe im yesh bah benoten taam hare zo asura ketzad meshaarin otah kevasar belefet
Gid hannashe shennitbashshel im haggidim bizman shemmakkiro benoten taam veim lav kullan asurin veharotev benoten taam
Vechen chaticha shel nevela vechen chaticha shel dag tame shennitbashshela im hachatichot bizman shemmakkiran benoten taam veim lav kullan asurot veharotev benoten taam
Gema amar shemuel lo shanu ella shennitbashshel bah aval nitzla bah kolef veochel ad shemmaggia laggid
Ini vehaamar rav huna gedi shetztzelao bechelbo asur leechol afilu merosh ozno

a: Shane chelev dimfapa

Uvchelev asur vehaamar rabba bar bar chana ovada hava kammeh derabbi yochanan bichnishta demaon bigdi shetztzelao bechelbo vaato veshayeluh lerabbi yochanan veamar kolef veochel ad shemmaggia lechelbo hahu kachush hava
Rav huna bar yehuda amar kulya bechelbah hava vesharya ravin bar rav adda amar kilkit beilpas hava vaato shayeluh lerabbi yochanan vaamar lehu litameh kappila arammaa
Amar rava meresh hava ka kashya li ha detanya kedera shebbishshel bah basar lo yevashshel bah chalav veim bishshel benoten taam teruma lo yevashshel bah chullin veim bishshel benoten taam
Bishlama teruma taem lah kohen ella basar bechalav man taem leh hashta deamar rabbi yochanan samchinan akkappila arammaa hacha name samchinan akkappila arammaa
Deamar rava amur rabbanan betama vaamur rabbanan bekappila
b: Vaamur rabbanan beshishshim hilkach min besheeno mino dehetera betama deisura bekappila
Umin bemino deleka lemekam attama i name min besheeno mino deisura deleka kappila beshishshim
Hanhu atmahata deimlichu be resh galuta begida nashya ravina asar rav acha bar rav ashe share ato shayeluh lemar bar rav ashe amar lehu abba share
Amar leh rav acha bar rav leravina may datach deamar shemuel maliach hare hu keroteach kavush hare hu kimvushshal
Vehaamar shemuel lo shanu ella shennitbashshel bah aval nitzla bah kolef veochel ad shemmaggia laggid
Vechi tema may keroteach dekaamar keroteach dimvushshal veha middekaamar kavush hare hu kimvushshal mikkelal deroteach detzali kaamar kashya
Amar rabbi chanina keshehen meshaarin meshaarin berotev uvakkefe uvachatichot uvikdera ika deamri bikdera atzmah veika deamri bemay devala kedera
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan kol isurin shebbattora meshaarinan meshaarin otan keilu hen batzal vekaflot
Amar leh rabbi abba leabbaye ulshaarinhu befilpelin vetavlin daafilu beelef lo betelin amar leh shiaru chachamim deen noten taam beisurin yoter mibbatzal vekaflot
Amar rav nachman gid beshishshim veen gid min hamminyan kechal beshishshim uchchal min hamminyan betza beshishshim veen betza min hamminyan
Amar rabbi yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya uchchal atzmo asur vei nafal likdera acheret oser
Amar rav ashe ki havenan be rav kahana ibaya lan ki meshaarinan bedideh meshaarinan o bemay dinfak mineh meshaarinan
Peshita divdideh meshaarinan dei bema dinfak mineh mena yadinan ella meatta nafal likdera acheret lo yeesor
Kevan deamar rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya uchchal atzmo asur shavveuh rabbanan kachaticha dinvela
Betza beshishshim veen betza min hamminyan amar leh rav idi bar avin leabbaye lememra deyahava tama veha amri inashe ki mayya devee bealma
Amar leh hacha bemay askinan

a: Bevetzat efroach aval temea la
Etiveh betzim tehorot sheshshelakan im betzim temeot im yesh bahen benoten taam kullan asurot hacha name bevetzat efroach veammay kare lah temea kevan deit bah efroach kare lah temea
Veha middekatane sefa betzim sheshshelakan venimtza efroach beachat mehen im yesh bahen benoten taam kullan asurot mikkelal deresha delet bah efroach askinan
Parushe ka mefaresh betzim tehorot sheshshelakan im betzim temeot im yesh bahen benoten taam kullan asurot ketzad kegon sheshshelakan venimtza efroach beachat mehen
Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach resha delet bah efroach hashta delet bah efroach asura deit bah efroach mibaya
I mishshum ha la irya tena sefa legalloye resha shello tomar resha deit bah efroach aval let bah efroach sharya tena sefa deit bah efroach mikkelal deresha delet bah efroach vaafilu hachi asira
Hahu kezeta tarba dinfal bedikula devisra savar rav assi leshaoreh bemay divla dikula amri leh rabbanan lerav ashe attu dehetera bala deisura la bala

Hahu palga dezeta detarba dinfal bedikula devisra savar mar bar rav ashe leshaoreh bitlatin palge dezeta amar leh avuh lav amena lach la tezalzel beshiurin derabbanan veod haamar rabbi yochanan chatzi shiur asur min hattora

Amar rav shemen bar abba amar rav idi bar idi bar gershom amar levi bar perata amar rabbi nachum amar rabbi biryam mishshum zaken echad verabbi yaakov shemeh deve nesia amru betza beshishshim asura beshishshim veachat mutteret

Amar rabbi zera lerav shemen bar abba ree sheatta metil bah gevul heter shehare shene gedole haddor lo pershu et haddavar rabbi yaakov bar idi verabbi shemuel bar nachmani tarvayehu mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi amri betza beshishshim asura beshishshim veachat mutteret
Veibaya lehu beshishshim veachat bahade didah o dilma levar minah vela peshut umar pashet lah mifshat
Ittemar amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna betza beshishshim vehi asura beshishshim veachat vehi mutteret
Hahu daata lekammeh derabban gamliel bar rabbi amar leh abba lo shier bearbaim vasheva vaani ashaer bearbaim vechamesh
Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi shimon bar rabbi amar leh abba lo shier bearbaim vechamesh vaani ashaer bearbaim veshalosh
Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi chiyya amar leh kelum yesh sheloshim
Tama deleka sheloshim ha ika sheloshim meshaarin amar rabbi chanina guzma

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara kal isurin shebbattora beshishshim amar lefanav rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak rabbi atta omer ken hachi amar rav assi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara kal isurin shebbattora bemea
Ushnehem lo lemaduha ella mizzeroa beshela dichtiv velakach hakkohen et hazzeroa beshela vego vetanya beshela
b: En beshela ella shelema rabbi shimon ben yochay omer en beshela ella shennitbashshela im haayil
Dechulle alma bahade ayil mevashshel lah mar savar mechattech lah vahadar mevashshel lah umar savar mevashshel lah vahadar mechattech lah
Vei baet ema dechulle alma mechattech lah vahadar mevashshel lah mihu mar savar bahade ayil mevashshel lah umar savar bikdera acheret mevashshel lah
Lelishana kamma alliba dedivre hakkol lelishana batra alliba derabbi shimon ben yochay
Man deamar beshishshim savar basar vaatzamot bahade basar vaatzamot meshaarinan vehave leh beshishshim man deamar bemea savar basar bahade basar meshaarinan vehave leh bemea
Umi yalfinan minah vehatanya zehu heter habba mikkelal isur zehu lemaote may lav lemaote kol isurin shebbattora
Amar abbaye lo nitzrecha ella lerabbi yehuda deamar min bemino lo batel ka mashma lan dehacha batel
Veligmar mineh galli rachamana velakach middam happar umiddam hassair tarvayehu bahade hadade ninhu vela batli
Umay chazet degamrinan mehayeche ligmar mehay chiddush hu umechiddush la gamrinan
I hachi lemea veshishshim name la ligmar
Attu anan lekulla gamrinan lechumra gamrinan demiddeorayeta berubba batel
Rava amar lo nitzrecha ella letaam keikar divkadashim asur ka mashma lan dehacha share

a: Veligmar mineh galli rachamana gabbe chattat kol asher yigga bivsarah yikdash lihot kamoha sheim pesula tippasel veim keshera teachel kechamur shebbah
Umay chazet degamrinan mehayeche ligmar mehay chiddush hu umechiddush la gamrinan
I hachi lemea veshishshim name la ligmar attu anan lekulla ka gamrinan lechumra ka gamrinan demiddeorayeta berubba batel
Ravina amar lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach deamar mekom chatach bealma asur vehacha shere
Yatev rav dimi vekaamar lah leha shemata
Amar leh abbaye vechol isurin shebbattora bemea vehatnan lama amru kol hamchammetz umtabbel umdammea lehachmir min umino lehakel ulhachmir min vesheeno mino

Vekatane sefa lehakel ulhachmir min vesheeno mino ketzad gerisin shennitbashshelu im haadashim im yesh bahem benoten taam ben yesh bahen lehaalot bemea veechad ben en bahen lehaalot bemea veechad asur
En bahen benoten taam ben sheyyesh bahen lehaalot bemea veechad ben en bahen lehaalot bemea veechad muttar
En bahen lehaalot bemea veechad ella bemay lav beshishshim
b: La bemea

Veha midderesha bemea have sefa beshishshim dekatane resha lehachmir min umino ketzad seor shel chittin shennafal leisat chittin veyesh bo kede lechammetz ben yesh bo kede lehaalot bemea veechad ben en bo kede lehaalot bemea veechad asur
En bo lehaalot bemea veechad ben sheyyesh bo kede lechammetz ben en bo kede lechammetz asur resha vesefa bima
La resha bima vechad vesefa bima
Vechi yesh bo kede lechammetz bima vechad ammay la betil ishtik

Amar leh dilma shane seor dechimutzo kashe amar leh adkartan milta deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina lo kol hashshiurin shavin shehare tzir shiuro karov lematayim ditnan dag tame tziro asur rabbi yehuda omer reviit besatayim
Vehaamar rabbi yehuda min bemino lo batel shane tzir dezea bealma hu
Ketzad meshaarinan amar rav huna kevasar berashe lefatot matnitin dela kehay tanna detanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer en begidin benoten taam
Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi chanina hava yatev rabbi yehuda bar zevina abbava ki nefak amar leh may amar lach amar leh sharya nihaleh
Amar leh hadar ayelah lekammeh amar man hay deka metzaar li zil ema leh leman deyatev abbava en begidin benoten taam
Ki ato lekammeh derabbi amme meshaddar lehu lekammeh derabbi yitzchak ben chaluv demore bah lehetera mishshum derabbi yehoshua ben levi veleh la sevira leh vehilcheta en begidin benoten taam
Gid hannashe shennitbashshel velivtol berubba

a: Beriyya shane
Vechen chaticha shel nevela vechu vetivtel berubba
Hanicha leman deamar kol sheddarko limanot shaninu ella leman deamar et sheddarko limanot shaninu may ika lememar shane chaticha hoil uruya lehitkabbed bah lifne haorchim
Utzricha dei ashmeinan gid mishshum divriyya hi aval chaticha ema la
Vei ashmeinan chaticha hoil uruya lehitkabbed bah lifne haorchim aval gid ema la tzericha
Daresh rabba bar bar chana chaticha shel nevela veshel dag tame enah oseret ad shettitten taam barotev uvakkefe uvachatichot
Oke rav amora aleh udrash kevan shennatan taam bachaticha chaticha atzmah naaset nevela veoseret kol hachatichot kullan mippene shehen minah

Amar leh rav safra leabbaye mikkede rav keman amrah lishmateh kerabbi yehuda deamar min bemino lo batel may irya ki natan taam afilu ki lo natan taam name amar leh hacha bemay askinan beshekkadam vesilleko
Rava amar
b: Afilu tema lo kadam vesilleko have min umino vedavar acher
Vechol min umino vedavar acher sallek et mino kemi sheeno vesheen mino rave alav umvattelo

Matni noheg bithora veeno noheg bitmea rabbi yehuda omer af bitmea amar rabbi yehuda vahalo mibbene yaakov neesar gid hannashe vaadayin behema temea mutteret lahen amru lo besinay neemar ella shennichtav bimkomo
Gema vesavar rabbi yehuda isur chal al isur vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer yachol tehe nivlat of tame metammea begadim bevet habbelia
Talmud lomar nevela utrefa lo yochal letoma vah mi sheisuro mishshum bal tochal nevela yatza ze sheen isuro mishshum bal tochal nevela ella mishshum bal tochal temea
Vechi tema kasavar en begidin benoten taam uvitmea name isur gid ika isur tuma leka
Vesavar rabbi yehuda en begidin benoten taam vehatanya haochel gid hannashe shel behema temea rabbi yehuda mechayyev shettayim verabbi shimon poter
Leolam kasavar yesh begidin benoten taam vekasavar noheg bashshelil deisur gid veisur tuma bahade hadade kaate
Umi matzet amratte noheg bashshelil vehatnan noheg bashshelil rabbi yehuda omer eno noheg bashshelil vechelbo muttar
Hane mile gabbe tehora derachamana amar kol babbehema tochelu aval bitmea noheg
Umi matzet amratte detarvayehu bahade hadade kaatu vehatnan al ellu tumot hannazir megalleach al hammet veal kezayit min hammet
Vekashya lan al kezayit min hammet megalleach al hammet kullo lo kol shekken veamar rabbi yochanan lo nitzrecha ella lenefel shello nitkashsheru evarav begidin alma isur tuma kadem
Af al gav deisur tuma kadem ate isur gid chayel aleh shekken isuro noheg bivne noach
Dayeka name dekatane amar rabbi yehuda vahalo mibbene yaakov neesar gid hannashe vaadayin behema temea mutteret lahem
Gufa haochel gid hannashe shel behema temea rabbi yehuda mechayyev shettayim

a: Verabbi shimon poter
Verabbi shimon ma nafshach i isur chal al isur lichayyav name mishshum gid i en isur chal al isur lichayyav mishshum tuma dikdem vei en begidin benoten taam lichayyav mishshum gid
Amar rava leolam kasavar en begidim benoten taam veshane hatam deamar kera al ken lo yochlu vene yisrael et gid hannashe mi sheggido asur uvsaro muttar yatzta zo sheggido asur uvsaro asur
Amar rav yehuda amar rav haochel gid hannashe shel nevela rabbi meir mechayyev shettayim vachachamim omrim eno chayyav ella achat
Umodim chachamim lerabbi meir beochel gid hannashe shel ola veshel shor hanniskal shechayyav shettayim
Uman hay tanna divisur kolel isur chal al isur let leh isur kolel beisur chamur it leh
Amar rava rabbi yose haggelili hi ditnan tame sheachal kodesh ben kodesh tame ben kodesh tahor chayyav
Rabbi yose haggelili omer tame sheachal et hattahor chayyav tame sheachal et hattame patur shello achal ella davar tame
Amru lo af tame sheachal et hattahor kevan shennaga bo timmeahu
Shappir ka amri leh rabbanan lerabbi yose haggelili veamar rava benitma hagguf veachar kach nitma basar kulle alma la peligi dechayyav deisur karet kadem
Ki peligi benitma basar veachar kach nitma hagguf rabbanan it lehu isur kolel demiggo demichayyav achatichot tehorot dealma michayyav name achaticha temea
Verabbi yose haggelili let leh isur kolel demiggo la amrinan
Verabbi yose haggelili nehi deisur kolel let leh beisur kal yavo isur chamur yachul al isur kal umay nihu tumat hagguf shehare tumat hagguf becharet
Amar rav ashe man lema lan detumat hagguf chamura dilma tumat basar chamura delet leh tohora bemikve
b: Verabbi yose haggelili let leh isur kolel

Vehatanya shabbat veom hakkippurim shagag veasa melacha minnayin shechayyav al ze beatzmo veal ze beatzmo talmud lomar shabbat hi yom hakkippurim hu divre rabbi yose haggelili rabbi akiva omer eno chayyav ella achat
Shelach ravin mishshum derabbi yose berabbi chanina kach hatztzaa shel mishna veefoch

Shelach rav yitzchak bar yaakov bar giyyore mishshum derabbi yochanan ledivre rabbi yose haggelili lemay daafachan shagag beshabbat vehezid beom hakkippurim chayyav hezid beshabbat veshagag beom hakkippurim patur
May tama amar abbaye shabbat kevia vekayema yom hakkippurim be dina deka kavi leh
Amar leh rava sof sof tarvayehu bahade hadade kaatu ella amar rava shemada hava ushlachu mittam deoma dechippure deha shatta shabbeta hu vechen ki ata ravin vechol nachote amruha kerava
Amar rabbi yehuda vahalo mibbene yaakov vechu

Tanya amru lo lerabbi yehuda vechi neemar al ken lo yochlu bene yaakov vahalo lo neemar ella bene yisrael velo nikreu bene yisrael ad sinay ella besinay neemar ella shennichtav bimkomo leda meeze taam neesar lahem
Metiv rava vayyisu vene yisrael et yaakov avihem leachar maase
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe mehahi shata litsar
Amar leh vechi tora peamim peamim nitna hahu shata lav sheat maase havay vela sheat mattan tora havay
Tanu rabbanan ever min hachay noheg bivhema chayya vaof ben temein uven tehorin divre rabbi yehuda verabbi elazar vachachamim omrim eno noheg ella bithorin
Amar rabbi yochanan ushnehen mikra echad darshu rak chazak levilti achol haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh

a: Lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar rabbi yehuda verabbi elazar savri kol sheatta metzve al damo atta metzve al evarav vehane temein name hoil veatta metzve al daman atta metzve al evaran
Verabbanan savri lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar ella basar lechodeh kol shebbesaro muttar atta metzve al evarav vechol sheen besaro muttar i atta metzve al evarav
Verabbi yehuda lema leh kera lete isur ever lechul al isur tuma shekken isuro noheg bivne noach
In hachi name vechi itzterich kera lerabbi elazar
Tanya name hachi ever min hachay noheg bivhema chayya vaof ben temea ben tehora shenneemar rak chazak levilti achol haddam
Kol sheatta metzve al damo atta metzve al evarav vechol shei atta metzve al damo i atta metzve al evarav divre rabbi elazar

Vachachamim omrim eno noheg ella bithorin shenneemar lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar ella basar lechodeh kol shebbesaro muttar atta metzve al evarav vechol sheen besaro muttar en atta metzve al evarav
Rabbi meir omer eno noheg ella bivhema tehora bilvad
Siman shemuel shela shimi

Amar rabba bar shemuel amar rav chisda veitema rav yosef veamri lah amar rabba bar shela amar rav chisda veitema rav yosef veamri lah rabba bar shimi amar rav chisda veitema rav yosef may tama derabbi meir
Amar kera vezavachta mibbekarcha umitztzoncha
Amar rav gidel amar rav machloket beyisrael aval beven noach divre hakkol muzhar al hattemein kattehorin
Tanya name hachi ever min hachay ben noach muzhar alav al hattemeim kattehorim veyisrael eno muzhar ella al hattehorin bilvad
Ika deamri tehora verabbi meir ika deamri tehorim verabbanan
Amar rav shezvi af anan name tenena achal ever min hachay mimmenna eno sofeg arbaim veen shechita metahartah
Bemay ilema beyisrael peshita deen shechita metahartah ella lav bivne noach mikkelal deasur
Rabbi mani bar pattish rame resha assefa umshanne resha beyisrael vesefa beven noach
Amar rav ever min hachay tzarich kezayit may tama achila ketiva beh
Metiv rav amram achal ever min hachay mimmenna eno sofeg et haarbaim veen shechita metahartah vei salka datach baenan kezayit tipok leh dekaachel kezayit
Kidamar rav nachman bemashshehu basar gidin vaatzamot hacha name bemashshehu basar gidin vaatzamot
Ta shema deamar rav
b: Achal tzippor tehora bechayyeha bechol shehu bemitatah bichzayit utmea ben bechayyeha ben bemitatah bechol shehu hacha name bemashshehu basar gidim vaatzamot

Ta shema natal tzippor sheen bo kezayit vaachalo rabbi poter verabbi elazar bar rabbi shimon mechayyev amar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon kal vachomer al ever mimmenna chayyav al kullah lo kol shekken chanakah vaachalah divre hakkol bichzayit
Ad kan la peligi ella demar savar bechayyeha leevarim omedet umar savar bechayyeha lav leevarim omedet
Dechulle alma miha la baenan kezayit amar rav nachman bemashshehu basar gidim vaatzamot
Umi ika mide divchulleh let beh kezayit basar uvchad ever it kezayit bemashshehu basar gidin vaatzamot amar rav sherevya in biklanita
Ema sefa chanakah vaachalah divre hakkol bichzayit veha kelanita of tame hu veamar rav temea ben bechayyeha ben bemitatah bemashshehu ella keen kelanita
Amar rava im timtze lomar savar rabbi machshevet ochalin shemah machshava chishev leochlah ever ever vaachalah kullah chayyav
Amar leh abbaye umi ika mide deilu achel leh acher la michayyav veachel leh hay michayyav amar leh ze lefi machshavto veze lefi machshavto
Veamar rava im timtze lomar savar rabbi elazar bar rabbi shimon machshevet ochalin shemah machshava chishev leochlah meta vaachalah chayya patur
Amar leh abbaye umi ika mide deilu achel leh acher michayyav veachel leh hay patur amar leh ze lefi machshavto veze lefi machshavto
Amar rabbi yochanan lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar ze ever min hachay uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu ze basar min hachay uvasar min hatterefa
Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar ze ever min hachay uvasar min hachay uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu ze basar min hatterefa

Achal ever min hachay uvasar min hachay lerabbi yochanan chayyav shettayim lerabbi shimon ben lakish eno chayyav ella achat achal basar min hachay uvasar min hatterefa lerabbi shimon ben lakish chayyav shettayim lerabbi yochanan eno chayyav ella achat achal ever min hachay uvasar min hatterefa ledivre hakkol chayyav shettayim
Urminhu

a: Achal ever min hachay min hatterefa rabbi yochanan amar chayyav shettayim verabbi shimon ben lakish amar eno chayyav ella achat
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan nicha ella lerabbi shimon ben lakish kashya
Amar rav yosef la kashya kan bivhema achat kan bishte behemot bishte behemot michayyav shettayim bivhema achat peligi
Bivhema achat bemay peligi amar abbaye kegon shennitrefa im yetziat rubbah mar savar behema bechayyeha leevarim omedet veisur terefa veisur ever bahade hadade kaatu
Umar savar behema bechayyeha lav leevarim omedet vela ate isur ever chayel aisur terefa

Veibaet ema dechulle alma behema bechayyeha lav leevarim omedet uvmete isur ever mechal aisur terefa ka mipalgi mar savar ate isur ever chayel aisur terefa umar savar la ate isur ever chayel aisur terefa
Ibaet ema dechulle alma behema bechayyeha leevarim omedet uchgon shennitrefa leachar mikkan uvmete isur terefa chayel aisur ever ka mipalgi
Mar savar ate vechayel umar savar la ate vechayel
Rava amar kegon shettalash mimmenna ever utrafah bo mar savar behema bechayyeha leevarim enah omedet isur ever veisur terefa bahade hadade kaatu
Umar savar behema bechayyeha leevarim omedet vela ate isur terefa chayel aisur ever

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan achal chelev min hachay min hatterefa chayyav shettayim amar leh rabbi amme velema mar shalosh sheani omer shalosh itmar name amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan achal chelev min hachay min hatterefa chayyav shalosh
Bemay kamipalgi kegon shennitrefa im yetziat rubbah man deamar shalosh kasavar behema bechayyeha leevarim omedet deisur chelev veisur ever veisur terefa bahade hadade kaatu
Uman deamar shettayim kasavar behema bechayyeha lav leevarim omedet veisur chelev veisur terefa ika isur ever la ate chayel
Vei baet ema dechulle alma behema bechayyeha lav leevarim omedet uvmete isur ever vechayel aisur chelev veaisur terefa ka mipalgi mar savar ate chayel umar savar la ate chayel
Vei baet ema dechulle alma behema bechayyeha leevarim omedet uchgon shennitrefa leachar mikkan uvmete isur terefa mechal aisur ever ka mipalgi
Mar savar ate chayel mide dehave achelev deamar mar hattora amra yavo isur nevela yachul al isur chelev veyavo isur terefa yachul al isur chelev
Veidach achelev hu dechayyav dehuttar
b: Mikkelalo aval ever delo huttar mikkelalo la
Ki ata rav dimi amar bea mineh rabbi shimon ben lakish merabbi yochanan chilleko mibbachutz mahu amar leh patur
Mibbifnim may amar leh chayyav
Ki ata ravin amar chilleko mibbachutz patur mibbefanim rabbi yochanan amar chayyav veresh lakish amar patur
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyav hare nehena gerono bichzayit veresh lakish amar patur achila bemeav baenan veleka
Ella lerabbi shimon ben lakish hechi mashkachatte lah dimchayyev amar rav kahana bigromita zeerta
Verabbi elazar amar afilu chilleko mibbachutz name chayyav mechussar keriva lav kimchussar maase dame
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish kezayit sheamru chutz mishshel ben hashshinayim verabbi yochanan amar af im ben hashshinayim
Amar rav pappa beshel ben shinayim dechulle alma la peligi ki peligi ben hachanichayim mar savar hare nehena gerono bichzayit umar savar achila bemeav baenan
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan achal chatzi zayit vehekio vechazar veachal chatzi zayit acher chayyav may tama hare nehena gerono bichzayit
Bea rabbi elazar merabbi assi achal chatzi zayit vehekio vechazar vaachalo mahu may ka mibaya leh i have ikul i la have ikul vetibe leh kezayit
Ella i batar gerono azlinan i batar meav azlinan vetifshot leh midderabbi assi

Rabbi assi gemareh iakar leh vaata rabbi elazar leadkoreh vehachi kaamar leh lema li chatzi zayit acher lema mar bedideh deika lemishma minah tarte shaminan minah dela have ikul veshaminan minah dahare nehena gerono bichzayit
Ishtik vela amar leh vela mide amar leh mofet haddor la zimnin saggiin amratte kammeh derabbi yochanan veamar lach hare nehena gerono bichzayit
Hadaran alach gid hannashe
Matni kol habbasar asur levashshel bechalav chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim veasur lehaalot im haggevina al hashshulchan chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim

a: Hannoder min habbasar muttar bivsar dagim vachagavim
Gema ha of asur middeorayeta keman dela kerabbi akiva dei rabbi akiva haamar chayya vaof eno min hattora
Ema sefa hannoder min habbasar muttar bivsar dagim vachagavim ha of asur atan lerabbi akiva deamar kol mile demimlich aleh shaliach bar mineh hu
Detanya hannoder min hayyarak muttar baddilluin verabbi akiva oser amru lo lerabbi akiva vahalo omer adam lishlucho kach lanu yarak vehu omer lo matzati ella dilluin
Amar lahen ken haddavar kelum omer lo matzati ella kitnit ella sheddilluin bichlal yarak veen kitnit bichlal yarak resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi akiva
Amar rav yosef rabbi hi venasev lah alliba detannae bindarim savar lah kerabbi akiva bevasar bechalav savar lah kerabbanan

Rav ashe amar kullah rabbi akiva hi vehachi kaamar kol habbasar asur levashshel bechalav mehen middivre tora umehen middivre sofrim chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim sheenam lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim
Veasur lehaalot vechu amar rav yosef shema minah besar of bechalav deorayeta dei salka datach derabbanan achila gufah gezera vaanan nigzar haalaa attu achila
Umna temra dela gazrinan gezera ligzera ditnan challat chutza laaretz
b: Neechelet im hazzar al hashshulchan venitenet lechol kohen sheyyirtze
Amar leh abbaye bishlama i ashmoinan challat chutza laaretz baaretz deika lemigzar mishshum challat haaretz deorayeta vela gazrinan ika lemishma minah
Ella chutza learetz mishshum deleka lemigzar hu aval hacha i sharet leh leassoke of ugvina ate leassoke basar ugvina umechal basar bechalav deorayeta
Matkef lah rav sheshet sof sof tzonen betzonen hu amar abbaye gezera shemma yaale beilpas roteach
Sof sof keli sheni hu uchli sheni eno mevashshel ella gezera shemma yaale beilpas rishon
Matni haof ole im haggevina al hashshulchan veeno neechal divre bet shammay uvet hillel omrim lo ole velo neechal amar rabbi yose zo mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel
Beeze shulchan amru beshulchan sheochel alav aval beshulchan shessoder alav et hattavshil noten ze betzad ze veeno choshesh

Gema rabbi yose hayenu tanna kamma vechi tema achila gufah ika benayehu dekaamar tanna kamma behaalaa ka mipalgi baachila la peligi vaamar leh rabbi yose achila gufah mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel

Vehatanya rabbi yose omer shishsha devarim mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel vezo achat mehen of ole im haggevina al hashshulchan veeno neechal divre bet shammay uvet hillel omrim lo ole velo neechal
Ella ha kamashma lan man tanna kamma rabbi yose kol haomer davar beshem omro mevi geulla laolam shenneemar vattomer ester lammelech beshem mordochay
Tena agra chamuh derabbi abba of ugvina neechalin beappikoran hu tane lah vehu amar lah belo netilat yadayim uvlo kinuach happe

Rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya ikla leve rav ashe ayeto leh gevina achal ayeto leh bisra achal vela mesha yedeh amri leh veha tane agra chamuh derabbi abba of ugvina neechalin beeppikoren of ugvina in basar ugvina la
Amar lehu hane mile belelya aval bimama ha chazena
Tanya bet shammay omrim mekanneach uvet hillel omrim mediach may mekanneach umay mediach

a: Ilema bet shammay omrim mekanneach vela bae mediach uvet hillel omrim mediach vela bae mekanneach ella ha deamar rabbi zera en kinuach pe ella befat keman kevet shammay
Ella bet shammay omrim mekanneach vela bae mediach uvet hillel omrim af mediach have leh mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel velitneyah gabbe kulle bet shammay vechumre bet hillel
Ella bet shammay omrim mekanneach vehu haddin lemediach uvet hillel omrim mediach vehu haddin limkanneach mar amar chada umar amar chada vela peligi
Gufa amar rabbi zera en kinuach happe ella befat vehane mile bidchite aval bedisare la
Udchite name la amaran ella bikrira aval bechammima mishtar shatri vehane mile berakkicha aval beakkosha la vehilcheta bechol mile have kinuach levar mikkimcha tamre veyarka

Bea mineh rav assi merabbi yochanan kamma yishhe ben basar ligvina amar lo velo kelum ini veha amar rav chisda achal basar asur leechol gevina gevina muttar leechol basar ella kamma yishhe ben gevina levasar amar leh velo kelum
Gufa amar rav chisda achal basar asur leechol gevina gevina muttar leechol basar amar leh rav acha bar yosef lerav chisda basar shebben hashshinayim mahu
Kare aleh habbasar odennu ben shinnehem

Amar mar ukva ana leha milleta challa bar chamra legabbe abba deilu abba ki hava achel bisra haidana la hava achel gevina ad limchar ad hashta veilu ana beha seodta hu dela achelna lisodta achrita achelna

Amar shemuel ana leha milleta challa bar chamra legabbe abba deilu abba hava sayar nichseh tere zimne beoma vaana la sayarna ella chada zimna shemuel letameh deamar shemuel man desayar nichseh kol yoma mashkach istera
Abbaye hava sayar nichseh kol yoma veoma yoma chad pega baariseh dedare pitka deufe amar leh hane lehecha amar leh leve mar amar leh kevar kadmuch rabbanan

Rav assi hava sayar nichseh kol yoma amar hecha ninhu kol hane istire demar shemuel yoma chad chaza tzinora devidka beareh shakleh liglimeh karcheh otveh begavah rema kala ato inashe sachruh amar ashkachtinhu lechullehu istere demar shemuel
Amar rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan mayim rishonim mitzva veacharonim chova
Metivi mayim rishonim veacharonim chova emtzaiyyim reshut mitzva legabbe reshut chova kare lah
Gufa mayim rishonim veacharonim chova emtzaiyyim reshut rishonim notlin ben bichli ben al gabbe karka acharonim en notlin ella bichli veamri lah en notlin al gabbe karka
May benayehu ika benayehu kinsa

Mayim rishonim notlin ben bechammin ben betzonen acharonim en notlin ella betzonen mippene shechammin mefapein et hayyadayim veen maavirin et hazzuhama mayim rishonim notlin ben bechammin ben betzonen amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yannay lo shanu ella sheen hayyad
b: Soledet bahen aval hayyad soledet bahen en notlin bahen

Veika dematne lah assefa acharonim en notlin ella betzonen aval bechammin lo amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yannay lo shanu ella shehayyad soledet bahen aval en hayyad soledet bahen notlin mikkelal derishonim af al pi shehayyad soledet bahen muttar
Emtzaiyyim reshut amar rav nachman lo shanu ella ben tavshil letavshil aval ben tavshil ligvina chova

Amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya mippene ma amru mayim acharonim chova shemmelach sedomit yesh shemmesamme et haenayim amar abbaye umishtechach ki kurta bechora amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe kal milcha may amar leh la mibbaya
Amar abbaye meresh hava amena hay dela mashu mayya batrae al ara mishshum zuhama amar li mar mishshum desharya ruach raa alayehu
Veamar abbaye meresh hava amena hay dela shakel mide mippatura ki naket inish kasa lemishte shemma yeera devar kalkala basseuda amar li mar mishshum dekashe leruach tzerada

Vela amaran ella deshakel vela mahdar aval mishkal veahdore let lan bah vela amaran ella chutz learba ammot aval toch arba ammot let lan bah vela amaran ella mide ditzrich lisodta aval mide dela tzerich lisodta let lan bah
Mar bar rav ashe kafed afilu aasita uvuchna detavle mide ditzrichi lisudta
Veamar abbaye meresh hava amena hay dechanshi nishvaraa mishshum menakkeruta amar li mar mishshum dekashe leanuta

Hahu gavra dahava mehaddar aleh sara deanuta vela hava yachel leh deka zehir annishvara tuva yoma chad kerach lifta ayyavle amar hashta vadday nafel biday batar deachel ayeti mara akrinhu leyavle shedinhu lenahara shameh dekaamar vay deappekeh hahu gavra mibbeteh

Veamar abbaye meresh hava amena hay dela shate ufya mishshum meisuta amar li mar mishshum dekashe lecharsam mishteyeh kashe lecharsam minpach beh kashya leresha midchayeh kashya leanuta may takkanteh leshakkeeh shakkoe
Lecharsam dechamra shichra deshichra mayya demayya let leh takkanta vehayenu deamri inashe batar anya azla anuta
Veamar abbaye meresh hava amena hay dela achli yarka mikkisha deasar ginaa mishshum demichaze keraavtanuta amar li mar mishshum dekashe lichshafim

Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna hao kaazli bearba amara lehu hahi matronita otvan bahadayechu la otvuha amara milleta asartah learba amaru inhu milta sharuha amara lehu may ebed lechu dela mekannach lechu bechaspa vela ketil lechu kina ammanayechu vela achil lechu yarka mikkisha deasar ginaa

Veamar abbaye meresh hava amena hay dela achli yarka dinfal attakka mittakka mishshum meisuta amar li mar mishshum dekashe lereach happe veamar abbaye meresh hava amena hay dela yatvi tute marzeva mishshum shofchim amar li mar mishshum dishchichi mazzikin

Hanhu shakolae dahao daru chavita dechamra beo leitfoche otvuha tute marzeva pekaa ato lekammeh demar bar rav ashe appek shipure shammeteh ata lekammeh amar leh ammay taaved hachi amar leh hechi eeved ki otveh beunnay

Amar leh atte beduchta dishchichi rabbim may baet atte hu deshannet zil shallem amar leh hashta name likba li mar zimna veefra keva leh zimna ki meta zimna iakkav ki ata amar leh ammay la atet bezimnach amar leh kol mile ditzyir vachatim uchyil umne let lan reshuta lemishkal mineh ad demashkechinan mide dehefkera
Veamar abbaye meresh hava amena hay deshade mayya mippumma dechatzba mishshum tzivta amar li mar mishshum deika mayim haraim
Hahu bar sheda dahava be rav pappa azal leetoye mayya minnahara iakkav ki ata amaru leh ammay iakkavte amar lehu ad dechalfi mayim haraim addehachi

a: Chazanhu deka shadu mayya mippumma dechatzba amar i hava yadana dirgilitu lemibad hachi la iakkavi
Ki ata rav dimi amar mayim harishonim heechilu besar chazir
Acharonim hotziu et haishsha mibbalah
Ki ata ravin amar rishonim heechilu besar nevela acharonim hargu et hannefesh amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vesimanach ata rav dimi appekah ata ravin katlah
Rabbi abba matne chada mehane vachada mehane lechumra

Itmar chamme haur chizkiyya amar en notlim mehen layyadayim verabbi yochanan amar notlin mehem layyadayim amar rabbi yochanan shaalti et rabban gamliel beno shel rabbi veochel teharot veamar li kol gedole galil osin ken
Chamme teverya chizkiyya amar en notlin mehem layyadayim aval matbilin bahem hayyadayim verabbi yochanan amar kol gufo tovel bahen aval lo panav yadav veraglav

Hashta kol gufo tovel bahem panav yadav veraglav lo kol shekken amar rav pappa bimkoman dechulle alma la peligi dishre mishkal minayehu bemana dechulle alma la peligi daasir ki peligi defaskinhu bevat birta mar savar gazrinan bat birta attu mana umar savar la gazrinan
Ketannae mayim shennifselu mishshetiyyat behema bechelim pesulim bakkarka kesherin rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af bakkarka tovel bahen kol gufo aval lo panav yadav veraglav
Hashta kol gufo tovel bahen yadav veraglav lo kol shekken ella lav defaskinhu bevat birta uvha peligi demar savar gazrinan bat birta attu mana umar savar la gazrinan
Amar rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan netilat yadayim lechullin mippene serech teruma

Veod mishshum mitzva may mitzva amar abbaye mitzva lishmoa divre chachamim rava amar mitzva lishmoa divre rabbi elazar ben arach dichtiv vechol asher yigga bo hazzav veyadav lo shataf bammayim amar rabbi elazar ben arach mikkan samchu chachamim lintilat yadayim min hattora
Amar leh rava lerav nachman may mashma dichtiv veyadav lo shataf bemayim ha shataf tahor ha tevila bae ella hachi kaamar veacher shello shataf tame

Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya lo amru netilat yadayim leferot ella mishshum nekiyyut sevur mina chova hu deleka ha mitzva ika amar lehu rava lo chova velo mitzva ella reshut ufliga derav nachman deamar rav nachman hannotel yadav leferot eno ella miggasse haruach

Amar rabba bar bar chana hava kaemna kammeh derabbi amme verabbi assi ayeto lekammayehu kalkalla defere vaachalu vela mashu yedayehu vela yehavu li mide uvarech chad chad lechodeh shema minah telat shema minah en netilat yadayim leferot ushma minah en mezammenin al happerot ushma minah shenayim sheachlu mitzva lechalek
Tanya name hachi shenayim sheachlu mitzva lechalek bamme devarim amurim shehau shenehem sofrim aval echad sofer veechad bur sofer mevarech uvur yotze
Tanu rabbanan netilat yadayim lechullin ad happerek litruma
b: Ad happerek kidush yadayim veraglayim bammikdash ad happerek vechol davar shechotzetz bitvila bagguf chotzetz bintilat yadayim lechullin uvkidush yadayim veraglayim bammikdash
Amar rav ad kan lechullin ad kan litruma ushmuel amar ad kan ben lechullin ben litruma lechumra verav sheshet amar ad kan ben lechullin ben litruma lekulla

Amar bar hedya hava kaemna kammeh derabbi amme veamar ad kan ben lechullin ben litruma lechumra vela tema rabbi amme mishshum dechohen hu deha rabbi meyasha bar bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi hu levay veamar ad kan ben lechullin ben litruma lechumra
Amar rav notel adam et shette yadav shacharit umatne alehen kol hayyom kullo amar lehu rabbi avina livne

a: Pakta daaravot kegon attun dela shechichi lechu mayya meshu yedayechu mitztzafra veatno alayehu lechulle yoma ika deamri bishat haddechak in shello bishat haddechak la ufliga derav veika deamri afilu shello bishat haddechak name vehayenu derav
Amar rav pappa hay arita dedallae en notlin mimmennu layyadayim dela atu mikkoach gavra vei mekarav legabbe davela dekaatu mikkoach gavra notlin mimmennu layyadayim
Vei bezia davela bechones mashke melaf layefi umtabbel bah et hayyadayim veamar rava keli shennikav bechones mashke en notlin mimmennu layyadayim
Veamar rava keli sheen bo reviit en notlin mimmennu layyadayim ini vehaamar rava keli sheen machzik reviit en notlin mimmennu layyadayim ha machzik af al gav delet beh
La kashya ha lechad ha litre detanya me reviit notlin layyadayim leechad vaafilu lishnayim
Amar leh rav sheshet leammemar kafditu ammana amar leh in achazuta amar leh in ashshiura amar leh in
Ika deamri hachi amar leh ammana veachazuta kafdinan ashshiura la kafdinan detanya me reviit notlin layyadayim leechad vaafilu lishnayim
Vela hi shane hatam mishshum dekaatu mishsheyare tohora
