Atken rav yaakov minnehar pekod natla bat revieta atken rav ashe behutzal kuza bat revieta

Veamar rava megufat chavit shettikkenah notlin mimmenna layyadayim tanya name hachi megufat chavit shettikkenah notlin mimmenna layyadayim chemet uchfisha shettikkenan notlin mehem layyadayim sak vekuppa af al pi shemmekabbelim en notlin mehem layyadayim
Ibaya lehu mahu leechol bemappa mi chayeshinan dilma naga o la
Ta shema uchshennatnu lo lerabbi tzadok ochel pachot mikkevetza notlo bemappa veochlo chutz lassukka veen mevarech acharav may lav ha kevetza bae netilat yadayim
Dilma ha kevetza bae sukka uvae beracha
Ta shema dishmuel ashkecheh lerav dekaachel bemappa amar leh
b: Avdin keden amar leh dati ketzara alay
Ki selek rabbi zera ashkechinhu lerabbi amme verabbi assi dekaachli bivlae chamatot amar tere gavre ravreve kevatayechu lito bidrav ushmuel ha dati ketzara kaamar
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rav tachlifa bar avimi amar shemuel hittiru mappa leochle teruma velo hittiru mappa leochle teharot verabbi amme verabbi assi kohanim hao
Ibaya lehu ochel mechamat maachil tzarich netilat yadayim o la ta shema derav huna bar sechora hava kae kammeh derav hamnuna belam leh umtza veachel amar leh i lav derav hamnuna atte la safena lach
May tama lav mishshum dizhir vela naga la dizriz kadem umashe yedeh meikara

Ta shema deamar rabbi zera amar rav lo yitten adam perusa letoch piv shel shammash ella im ken yodea bo shennatal yadav vehashshammash mevarech al kol kos vachos veeno mevarech al kol perusa ufrusa verabbi yochanan amar mevarech al kol perusa ufrusa
Amar rav pappa bishlama derav verabbi yochanan la kashya ha deika adam chashuv ha deleka adam chashuv
Mikkol makom ha kaamar ella im ken yodea shennatal yadav shane shammash ditrid

Tanu rabbanan lo yitten adam perusa lashshammash ben shehakkos beyado ben shehakkos beyado shel baal habbayit shemma yeera devar kalkala basseuda vehashshammash shello natal yadav asur liten perusa letoch piv
Ibaya lehu maachil tzarich netilat yadayim o eno tzarich

Ta shema detane deve menashshe rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ishsha medicha et yadah achat bammayim venotenet pat livnah katan amru alav al shammay hazzaken shello ratza lehaachil beyado achat vegazru alav sheyyaachil bishte yadav
Amar abbaye hatam mishshum shivta
Ta shema daavuh dishmuel ashkecheh lishmuel deka vache amar leh ammay ka vachet demachyan rabbay ammay deamar li ka safet livray vela meshet yedach veammay la meshet amar leh hu achel vaana mashena
Amar leh la misatyeh dela gemir mimcha name mache vehilcheta ochel mechamat maachil tzarich netilat yadayim maachil eno tzarich netilat yadayim
Matni tzorer adam basar ugvina bemitpachat achat uvilvad shello yehu nogin ze baze rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shene achsenain ochlin al shulchan echad ze basar veze gevina veen choshshin
Gema vechi nogea ze baze may have tzonen betzonen hu amar abbaye nehi diklifa la bae haddacha mi la bae
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shene achsenain ochlin al shulchan vechu amar rav chanan bar amme amar shemuel lo shanu ella sheen makkirin ze et ze aval makkirin ze et ze asur

Tanya name hachi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shene achsenaim shennitarchu lefundak echad ze ba min hatztzafon veze ba min haddarom ze ba bachatichato veze ba bigvinato ochlin al shulchan echad ze basar veze gevina veen choshshin
Velo asru ella bitfisa achat tefisa achat salka datach ella keen tefisa achat
Amar leh rav yemar bar shelemya leabbaye shene achin umakpidin ze al ze mahu
Amar leh yomru kol hasserikin asurin usrike vayetos muttarin
Ultamach ha deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan mi sheen lo ella chaluk echad muttar lechabbeso bechullo shel moed yomru

a: Kol hasserikin asurin usrike vayetos muttarin hatam ha amar mar bar rav ashe ezoro mochiach alav
Matni tipat chalav shennafla al hachaticha im yesh bah benoten taam beotah chaticha asur nier et hakkedera im yesh bah benoten taam beotah kedera asur
Gema amar abbaye tamo velo mammasho bealma deorayeta
Dei salka datach derabbanan mibbasar bechalav may tama la gamrinan dechiddush hu i chiddush hu af al gav deleka noten taam name
Amar leh rava derech bishshul asra tora
Amar rav kevan shennatan taam bachaticha chaticha atzmah naaset nevela veoseret kol hachatichot kullan mippene shehen minah
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina mikkede rav keman amar lishmateh kerabbi yehuda deamar min bemino lo batel lema peliga adderava
Deamar rava kasavar rabbi yehuda kol shehu min umino vedavar acher sallek et mino kemi sheeno vesheeno mino rave alav umvattelo
Amar leh i dinfal berotev rakka hachi name hacha bemay askinan dinfal berotev ava
Umay kasavar i kasavar efshar lesochoto muttar chaticha ammay naaset nevela ella kasavar efshar lesochoto asur
Deitmar rav verabbi chanina verabbi yochanan deamri efshar lesochoto asur shemuel verabbi shimon bar rabbi veresh lakish deamri efshar lesochoto muttar
Vesavar rav efshar lesochoto asur vehaitmar kezayit basar shennafal letoch yora shel chalav amar rav basar asur vechalav muttar vei salka datach efshar lesochoto asur
b: Chalav ammay muttar chalav nevela hu
Leolam kasavar rav efshar lesochoto asur veshane hatam deamar kera lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo gedi asra tora velo chalav

Vesavar rav gedi asra tora velo chalav veha itmar chatzi zayit basar vachatzi zayit chalav shebbishshelan ze im ze amar rav loke al achilato veeno loke al bishshulo vei salka datach gedi asra tora velo chalav aachila ammay loke chatzi shiur hu
Ella leolam kasavar rav chalav name asur vehacha bemay askinan kegon shennafal letoch yora rotachat demivla bala miflat la palet
Sof sof ki nayach hadar palet keshekkadam vesilko

Gufa chatzi zayit basar vachatzi zayit chalav shebbishshelan ze im ze amar rav loke al achilato veeno loke al bishshulo ma nafshach i mitztarfin abbishshul name lilke i lo mitztarfin aachila name la lilke
Leolam la mitztarfi uvva miyyora gedola
Velevi amar af loke al bishshulo vechen tane levi bematnitin keshem shelloke al achilato kach loke al bishshulo uve ze bishshul amru bevishshul sheacherim ochlin oto mechamat bishshulo

Veefshar lesochoto atzmo tannae hi detanya tippat chalav shennafla al hachaticha kevan shennatna taam bachaticha hachaticha atzmah naaset nevela veoseret kol hachatichot kullan mippene shehen minah divre rabbi yehuda
Vachachamim omrim ad shettitten taam barotev uvakkefe uvachatichot
Amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yehuda beshello nier veshello kissa vedivre chachamim beshennier vechissa
May lo nier velo kissa ilema lo nier kelal velo kissa kelal mivla bala miflat la palet
Veella lo nier battechilla ella bassof velo kissa battechilla ella bassof ammay ha bala veha palet
Kasavar efshar lesochoto asur

a: Mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar ki nier mittechilla vead sof vechissa mittechilla vead sof asur ammay ha la bala kelal
Ema lo nier yafe yafe velo kissa yafe yafe

Amar mar vedivre chachamim keshennier vechissa may nier umay kissa ilema nier bassof velo nier battechilla vechissa bassof velo kissa battechilla haamratte nirin divre rabbi yehuda beha ella nier mittechilla vead sof vechissa mittechilla vead sof
Mikkelal derabbanan savri nier bassof velo nier battechilla kissa bassof velo kissa battechilla muttar
Alma kasavri efshar lesochoto muttar

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina mimmay divefshar lesochoto peligi dilma efshar lesochoto divre hakkol asur vehacha bemin bemino ka mipalgi verabbi yehuda letameh deamar min bemino lo batel verabbanan letamayehu deamri min bemino batel
Hay may i amratte bishlama derabbanan bemin bemino hacha kerabbi yehuda sevira lehu uvefshar lesochoto peligi hayenu dekaamar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yehuda beha vedivre chachamim beha
Ella i amratte efshar lesochoto divre hakkol asur vehacha bemin bemino kamipalgi hay nirin divre rabbi yehuda veen nirin mibbee leh vetu la midi
Matni hakkechal koro umotzi et chelbo lo kerao eno over alav hallev koro umotzi et damo lo kerao eno over alav
b: Gema amar rabbi zera amar rav eno over alav umuttar veha anan tenan eno over alav mibar hu dela avar ha isura ika
Bedin hu deisura name leka veayede diva lemitne sefa hallev koro umotzi et damo lo kerao eno over alav hatam mibar hu dela avar ha isura ika tena name resha eno over alav
Lema mesayya leh hakkechal koro umotzi et chelbo lo kerao eno over alav hallev koro umotzi et damo lo kerao koro leachar bishshulo umuttar lev hu devae keria aval kechal la bae keria
Dilma lev hu desaggi leh bikria aval kechal la saggi leh bikria
Veika deamri amar rabbi zera amar rav eno over alav veasur lema mesayya leh eno over alav mibar hu dela avar ha isura ika
Bedin hu deisura name leka veayede diva lemitne sefa hallev koro umotzi et damo lo kerao eno over alav dehatam mibar hu dela avar ha isura ika tena name resha eno over alav
Ta shema hakkechal koro umotzi et chelbo lo kerao eno over alav hallev koro umotzi et damo lo kerao koro leachar bishshulo umuttar lev hu devae keria aval kechal la bae keria
Dilma lev hu desaggi leh bikria aval kechal la saggi leh bikria
Tanya kelishna kamma derav kechal shebbishshelo bachalavo muttar keva shebbishshelah bachalavah asur
Uma hefresh ben ze laze ze kanus bemeav veze en kanus bemeav

Ketzad koro amar rav yehuda koro sheti vaerev vetacho bakkotel amar leh rabbi elazar leshammaeh kera li vaana echol may ka mashma lan matnitin hi ha ka mashma lan dela baenan sheti vaerev vetacho bakkotel
Amara leh yalta lerav nachman mikkede kol daasar lan rachamana shera lan kevateh asar lan dema shera lan kavda nidda dam tohar
Chelev behema chelev chayya chazir mocha deshibuta geruta lishana dichvara
Eshet ish gerusha bechayye valah eshet ach yevama goya yefat toar baenan lemechal bisra bachalava
Amar lehu rav nachman letabbache zaviku lah kachle vehaanan tenan koro hahu likdera
Veha katane shebbishshelo diavad in lechattechilla la hu haddin daafilu lechattechilla veayede deka vae lemitne sefa keva

a: Shebbishshelah bachalavah asura daafilu diavad name la tena name resha shebbishshelah
Ki selek rabbi elazar ashkecheh lizeri amar leh ika tanna deatneyeh lerav kechal achveyeh lerav yitzchak bar avudimi amar leh ani lo shaniti lo kechal kol ikar verav bika matza vegadar bah gader
Derav ikla letatlefush shamah lehahi itta dekaamra lachavirtah riva devisra kamma chalava bae levashshole amar la gemiri devasar bechalav asur iakkav vekaasar vaasar lehu kachle
Rav kahana matne hachi rabbi yose bar abba matne ana kechal shel menika shaniti lo umippilpulo shel rav chiyya shena leh kechal setam

Ravin verav yitzchak bar yosef iklau leve rav pappe ayeto lekammayehu tavshila dichchal rav yitzchak bar yosef achal ravin la achal amar abbaye ravin takkala ammay la achal mikkede devethu derav pappe beratte derabbi yitzchak nappacha havay verabbi yitzchak nappacha mareh deovada hava i lav dishmia lah mibbe nasha la hava avda

Besura la achli kachle befumbedita achli kachle rame bar tamre dehu rame bar dikule mippumbedita ikla lesura bemaale yoma dechippure appekinhu kulle alma lechachlinhu shedinhu azal ihu naktinhu achlinhu

Ayetuh lekammeh derav chisda amar leh ammay taaved hachi amar leh meatra derav yehuda ana deachel amar leh velet lach notnin alav chumre hammakom sheyyatza mishsham vechumre hammakom shehalach lesham amar leh chutz lattechum achaltinhu
Uvma tevitinhu amar leh befurtzane vedilma miyyen nesech haveya hao amar leh leachar shenem asar chodesh hao
Vedilma degazel hava amar leh yeush bealim hava dikdachu behu chilfe
Chazyeh dela hava mannach tefilin amar leh may tama la mannechatte tefilin amar leh chole meayin hu veamar rav yehuda chole meayin patur min hattefilin
Chazyeh dela hava ka rame chute amar leh may tama let lach chute amar leh tallit sheula hi veamar rav yehuda
b: Tallit sheula kol sheloshim yom petura min hatztzitzit
Addehachi ayetuh lehahu gavra dela hava mokar avuh veimmeh kaftuh

Amar lehu shivkuh detanya kol mitzvat ase shemmattan secharah betziddah en bet din shellematta muzharin aleha amar leh chazena lach decharifatte tuva amar leh i havet beatreh derav yehuda achvina lach churpay
Amar leh abbaye lerav safra ki salkatte lehatam bei minayehu kavda ma attun beh ki selek ashkecheh lerav zerika amar leh ana shelaki leh lerabbi amme vaachal
Ki ata legabbeh amar leh lemesar nafshah la ka mibaya li ki kamibbaya li lemesar chavirtah

May shena lemesar nafshah dela mibaya lach ditnan enah neeseret lemesar chavirtah name la tibbee lach ditnan hakkaved oseret veenah neeseret mippene shehi poletet veenah bolaat amar leh dilma hatam bechavda deisura

a: Umishshum shamnunita mishshum dema may
Ki hadar selek ashkecheh lerabbi zerika amar leh hay name la tibbee lach daana veyannay bereh derabbi amme ikalan leve yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi vekarivu lan kanya bekofeh vaachalna

Matkef lah rav ashe veitema rabbi shemuel mizzerukinya vedilma pi kane chutz likdera hava i name michlat hava chalet leh meikara ki ha derav huna chalti leh bechalla verav nachman chalti leh berotchin
Usvar rav pappa kammeh derava lememar challa asir amar leh i challa asir ihu name asir ki hechi defalet hadar bala
Rav bar sheva ikla leve rav nachman ayeto leh kavda shelika vela achal amaru leh bar be rav dilgav la achel umannu rav bar shabba amar lehu rav nachman gamu leshabba

Ketannae rabbi eliezer omer hakkaved oseret veenah neeseret mippene sheppoletet veenah bolaat rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer metubbelet oseret veneeseret sheluka oseret veneeseret
Rabba bar rav huna ikkela leve rabba bar rav nachman ayeti lekammeh telat save tache amar lehu mi hava yaditu deatena amaru leh mi adifatte lan minah dichtiv vekarata lashshabbat oneg
Addehachi ashkach hahu kavda dahava bah simpona divlia dema amar lehu ammay avditu hachi amaru leh ella hechi naaved amar lehu kerau sheti vaerev vechitucha letachat
Vehane mile kavda aval techala shumna bealma hu ki ha dishmuel avdi leh tavshila ditchale beoma deaved milleta
Ittemar kavda ilave bisra shere dema mishrak sharek kachla ilave bisra asur may tama chalav saroche mesarech
Rav dimi minnehardea matne ifka kachla ilave bisra shere may tama chelev shechuta derabbanan kavda ilave bisra asir dam deorayeta
Daresh marimar hilcheta ben kavda ben kachla tute bisra shere ilave bisra diavad in lechattechilla la
Rav ashe ikla leve rame bar abba chamuh chazyeh livreh derame bar abba deka
b: Shafed kavda ilave bisra amar kamma yehir hay merabbanan emar daamur rabbanan diavad lechattechilla mi amur
Vei ika be duge bisra ilave kavda name asir
Umay shena middema devisra dema devisra shachen dema dechavda kafe
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel sakkin sheshshachat bah asur lachtoch bah roteach tzonen amri lah baaya haddacha veamri lah la baaya haddacha
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel keara shemmalach bah basar asur leechol bah roteach ushmuel letameh deamar shemuel maliach hare hu keroteach vechavush hare hu kimvushshal

Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan maliach eno keroteach vechavush eno kimvushshal amar abbaye ha deravin letah dehahi pinka dahava be rabbi amme demalach beh bisra vetavreh mikkede rabbi amme talmid derabbi yochanan hava may tama tavreh lav mishshum dishmia leh mineh derabbi yochanan deamar maliach hare hu keroteach
Yatev rav kahana achuh derav yehuda kammeh derav huna veyatev vekaamar keara shemmalach bah basar asur leechol bah roteach utznon shechatacho besakkin muttar leochlo bechuttach
May tama amar abbaye hay hetera bala vehay isura bala
Amar leh rava ki bala hetera may have sof sof hay hetera deate lide isura hu deisura kaachel ella amar rava hay efshar lemitameh vehay la efshar lemitameh

Amar leh rav pappa lerava velitameh kappila arammaa mi la tenan kedera shebbishel bah basar lo yevashshel bah chalav veim bishshel benoten taam bishshel bah teruma lo yevashshel bah chullin veim bishshel benoten taam
Veamrinan bishlama teruma taem lah kohen ella basar bechalav man taem lah vaamar lan litameh kappila hachi name litameh kappila hachi name ki kaamena deleka kappila
Itmar dagim shealu bakkeara rav amar asur leachlan bechuttach ushmuel amar muttar leachlan bechuttach
Rav amar asur noten taam hu ushmuel amar muttar noten taam bar noten taam hu

Veha derav lav beferush itmar ella mikkelala itmar derav ikla leve rav shimi bar chiyya bar bereh chash beenav beeneh avadu leh sheyafa betzaa batar hachi remo leh bishshula begavah taem leh tama dishyafa amar yahev tama kulle hay vela hi shane hatam dinfish merareh tefe

Rabbi elazar hava kaem kammeh demar shemuel ayeto lekammeh dagim shealu bakkeara veka achel bechuttach yahev leh vela achal amar leh lerabbach yehavi leh vaachal veatte la achlatte ata lekammeh derav amar leh hadar beh mar mishshemateh amar leh chas leh lezareh deabba bar abba delispe li mide vela sevira li

Rav huna verav chiyya bar ashe hao yatvi chad behay gisa demabbara desura vechad behay gisa demabbara lemar ayeto leh dagim shealu bakkeara vaachal bechuttach lemar ayeto leh teenim vaanavim betoch hasseuda vaachal vela barech

Mar amar leh lechavreh yatma avad rabbach hachi umar amar leh lechavreh yatma avad rabbach hachi mar amar leh lechavreh ana kishmuel sevira li umar amar leh lechavreh ana kerabbi chiyya sevira li detane rabbi chiyya pat poteret kol mine maachal veyayin poter kol mine mashkin
Amar chizkiyya mishshum abbaye hilcheta dagim shealu bakkeara muttar leochlan bechuttach tzenon shechatacho besakkin shechatach bah basar asur leochlo bechuttach
Vehane mile tzenon

a: Deaggav churpeh bala aval kishut garer leve fesakeh veachel
Kilche delifta shere desilka asiroy vei petach behu delifta shappir dame
Bea mineh rav dimi merav nachman mahu leannoche kadda demilcha gabbe kadda dechamka amar leh asur dechalla may amar leh shere
Umay shena lechi techul alah kora demilcha may tama hay iteh leisura beeneh vehay leteh leisura beeneh

Hahu bar gozala dinfal lechadda dechamka sharyeh rav chinana bereh derava mippashrunya amar rava man chakkim lemishre ki hay gavena i lav rav chinana bereh derava mippashrunya kasavar ki amar shemuel maliach hare hu keroteach hane mile hecha deeno neechal mechamat milcho aval hay kuttacha hare neechal mechamat milcho
Vehane mile chay aval tzali bae kelifa vei it beh pile kulleh asur vei metabbal betavlin kulleh asur
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel kikkar shechatach aleha basar asur leochlah vehane mile deasmek vehane mile deavreyeh vehane mile deasmecheh aval kelishta let lan bah
Shemuel shade leh lechalbeh rav huna yahev leh leshammaeh ma nafshach i shere lechulle alma shere i asir lechulle alma asir shane rav huna daanina dateh rava achel leh vekare leh chamar basar
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel en mannichin keli tachat basar ad sheyyichle kol mare admumit shebbo mena yadinan mar zutra mishshemeh derav pappa amar mishshettaale timrato
Matkef lah rav ashe vedilma tattaa meta ilaa la meta ella amar rav ashe let leh takkanta ella mishde beh tarte galle milcha
b: Umishpeyeh
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav ika lerav ashe umi amar shemuel hachi vehaamar shemuel kikkar shechatach aleha basar asur leochlah shane hatam deaggav duchka desakkina palet
Amar rav nachman dagim veofot shemmelachan ze im ze asurin hechi dame i bichli sheeno menukkav afilu ofot veofot name asiri i bichli menukkav afilu dagim veofot name shere
Leolam bichli menukkav vedagim mishshum dirfu keramayehu kadmi ufalti veofot kemiti batar denayechi dagim palti ofot vahadar bali mineh
Rav mari bar rachel imlach leh besar shechuta bahade besar terefa ata lekammeh derava
Amar leh hattemeim leesor tziran verotvan vekefe shellahen

a: Velema leh middishmuel deamar shemuel maliach hare hu keroteach vechavush hare hu kimvushshal
I middishmuel hava amena hane mile daman aval tziran verotvan la kamashma lan
Metivi dag tahor shemmelacho im dag tame muttar may lav shehau shenehen meluchin la kegon shehaya tahor maliach vetame tafel

Veha middekatane sefa aval im haya tahor maliach vetame tafel mikkelal deresha besheshshenehem meluchin askinan paroshe ka mefaresh tahor shemmelacho im dag tame muttar ketzad shehaya tahor maliach vetame tafel
Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach resha shenehem meluchim hashta shenehem meluchim shere tahor maliach vetame tafel mibaya

I mishshum ha la irya tena sefa legalloye resha dela tema resha tahor maliach vetame tafel aval shenehem meluchin asur tena sefa tahor maliach vetame tafel mikkelal deresha shenehen meluchin vaafilu hachi shere
Ta shema missefa desefa aval im haya tame maliach vetahor tafel asur tame maliach vetahor tafel hu deasur ha shenehen meluchin shere
Ayede ditna resha tahor maliach vetame tafel tena name sefa tame maliach vetahor tafel
Siman bisra demannach nafkuta

Amar shemuel en habbasar yotze mide damo ella im ken molcho yafe yafe umdicho yafe yafe ittemar rav huna amar moleach umediach bematnita tena mediach umoleach umediach vela peligi ha dechalleh be tabbacha ha dela challeh be tabbacha rav dimi minnehardea malach leh bemilcha gelalnita umnappetz leh
Amar rav mesharsheya en machazikin dam bivne meayim targema akkarkesha umayya vehadra dechanta
Amar shemuel en mannichin basar maliach ella al gabbe keli menukkav
Rav sheshet malach leh garma garma tere may tama la mishshum defaresh mehay uvala hay chad name paresh mehay gisa uvala hay gisa ella la shena
Amar shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyya hashshover mafraktah shel behema kodem shettetze nafshah hare ze machbid et habbasar vegozel et habberiyyot umavlia dam baevarim
Ibaya lehu hechi kaamar machbid et habbasar vegozel et habberiyyot mishshum demavlia dam baevarim ha ledideh shappir dame o dilma ledideh name asir teku
Matni hammaale et haof im haggevina al hashshulchan eno over belo taase
Gema ha ochlo over belo taase shema minah besar of bechalav deorayeta ema hammaale et haof im haggevina al hashshulchan eno ba lide lo taase

Matni besar behema tehora bachalev behema tehora asur levashshel veasur bahanaa besar behema tehora bachalev behema temea besar behema temea bachalev behema tehora muttar levashshel umuttar bahanaa rabbi akiva omer chayya vaof enam min hattora shenneemar lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo shalosh peamim perat lechayya ulof uvhema temea

Rabbi yose haggelili omer neemar lo tochlu chol nevela veneemar lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo et sheasur mishshum nevela asur levashshel bechalav of sheasur mishshum nevela yachol yehe asur levashshel bechalav talmud lomar bachalev immo yatza of sheen lo chalev em
Gema mena hane mile amar rabbi elazar amar kera vayyishlach yehuda et gedi haizzim
b: Kan gedi izzim ha kol makom shenneemar gedi setam afilu para verachel bammashma
Velelaf mineh ketiv kera acharina veet orot gedaye haizzim kan gedaye haizzim ha kol makom shenneemar gedi setam afilu para verachel bammashma
Velelaf mineh hau lehu shene ketuvin habbain keechad vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar tere miute ketivi izzim haizzim
Amar shemuel gedi lerabbot et hachelev gedi lerabbot et hammeta gedi lerabbot et hashshelil
Gedi lehotzi et haddam gedi lehotzi et hashshilya gedi lehotzi et hattemea
Bachalev immo velo bachalev zachar bachalev immo velo bachalev shechuta bachalev immo velo bachalev temea

Ha telata gedi ketivi vaanan shita darshinan kasavar shemuel isur chal al isur veisur chelev umeta mechad kera nafki dam name lav gedi hu veshilya name pirsha bealma hu pashu lehu tere chad lerabbot et hashshelil vechad lemaote behema temea

Vesavar shemuel isur chal al isur vehaamar shemuel mishshum rabbi elazar minnayin lechohen tame sheachal teruma temea sheeno bemita shenneemar umetu vo ki yechalleluhu perat lazo shemmechullelet veomedet
Ibaet ema bealma isur chal al isur veshane hatam demiet rachamana umetu vo ibaet ema bealma kasavar shemuel en isur chal al isur veshane hacha derabbi rachamana gedi
Veibaet ema ha dideh ha derabbeh

Bea mineh rav achadvuy bar amme merav hamvashshel bachalev gedi shello henika mahu amar leh middeitztericha lishmuel lememar bachalev immo velo bachalev zachar zachar hu dela ate lichlal em aval hay kevan deva lichlal em asur

Ittemar hamvashshel chelev bechalav rabbi amme verabbi assi chad amar loke vechad amar eno loke lema beha kamipalgi deman deamar loke kasavar isur chal al isur uman deamar eno loke kasavar en isur chal al isur

La dechulle alma en isur chal al isur aachila dechulle alma la peligi dela lake ki peligi abbishshul man deamar loke chad isura hu uman deamar eno loke lehachi appekah rachamana laachila bilshon bishul

a: Kevan deal achila la lake abbishul name la lake

Veika deamri abbishul kulle alma la peligi delake ki peligi aachila man deamar eno loke deha en isur chal al isur uman deamar loke lehachi appekah rachamana laachila bilshon bishul kevan deabbishul lake aachila name lake
Veibaet ema mar amar chada umar amar chada vela peligi
Metivi hamvashshel beme chalav patur dam shebbishshelo bechalav patur haatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim shebbishshelan bechalav patur
Happiggul vehannotar vehattame shebbishshelan bechalav chayyav
Hay tanna savar isur chal al isur

Hamvashshel beme chalav patur mesayya leh leresh lakish ditnan me chalav hare hen kechalav vehammochal hare hu keshemen amar resh lakish lo shanu ella lehachshir et hazzeraim aval leinyan bishul basar bechalav me chalav eno kechalav
Tanu rabbanan bachalev immo en li ella bachalev immo bachalev para verachel minnayin
Amarta kal vachomer uma immo shello neesra immo beharbaa neesra immo bevishshulo para verachel shenneesru immo beharbaa eno din shenneesru immo bevishshulo talmud lomar bachalev immo
Veha lema li kera ha atya leh
Amar rav ashe mishshum deika lememar meikara dedina pircha mehecha ka mayetet lah meimmo ma leimmo shekken neesra immo bishchita tomar befara shello neesra immo bishchita talmud lomar bachalev immo
Tanya idach bachalev immo en li ella bachalev immo bachalev achoto gedola minnayin
Amarta kal vachomer uma immo shennichnesa immo ledir lehitasser neesra immo bevishshul achoto shello nichnesa immo ledir lehitasser eno din shenneesra immo bevishshul talmud lomar bachalev immo

Veha lema li kera ha atya lah amar rav ashe mishshum deika lememar meikara dedina pircha mehecha ka mayetet lah meimmo ma leimmo shekken neesra immo bishchita tomar baachoto gedola shello neesra immo bishchita talmud lomar bachalev immo
Ashkechan achoto gedola achoto ketanna minnayin atya mibbenayya
Mehe tete tete meimmo ma leimmo shekken neesra immo bishchita achoto gedola tochiach ma laachoto gedola shello nichnesa immo ledir lehitasser immo tochiach
Vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shehu basar veasur levashshel bechalav af ani avi achoto ketanna shehu basar veasur levashshel bechalav
I hachi achoto gedola name tete mibbenayya
In hachi name ella bachalev immo lema li mibbee leh lechidtanya bachalev immo en li ella bachalev immo
b: Hi atzmah bachalavah minnayin amarta kal vechomer uma bimkom shello neesar peri im peri bishchita neesar peri im haem bishchita mekom shenneesar peri im peri bevishshul eno din shenneesar peri im haem bevishshul talmud lomar bachalev immo
Ha lema li kera ha atya lah amar rav achadvuy bar amme mishshum deika lememar sus ben susya achi pirda yochiach sheasur peri im peri umuttar peri im haem
Hatam zera haav hu deka garem
Deha pered ben susya achi pirda yochiach shemmuttar peri im peri veasur peri im haem
Ella amar mar bereh deravina mishshum deika lememar eved ben shifcha achi meshuchreret yochiach sheasur peri im peri umuttar peri im haem
Hatam get shichrur hu deka garem deha eved ben meshuchreret achi shifcha yochiach shemmuttar peri im peri veasur peri im haem
Ella amar rav idi bar avin mishshum deika lememar kile zeraim yochichu sheasur peri im peri umuttar peri im haem kelum neesar peri im peri ella al yede haem deha chite usare bechadda vela mitasru
Ella amar rav ashe mishshum deika lememar ma lifri im peri shekken shene gufim tomar bifri im haem shekken guf echad mishshum hachi itzterich kera
Amar rav ashe minnayin levasar bechalav sheasur baachila shenneemar lo tochal kol toeva kol shettiavti lach hare hu beval tochal

Veen li ella baachila bahanaa minnayin kidrabbi avahu deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar kol makom shenneemar lo yochal lo tochal lo tochlu echad isur achila veechad isur hanaa bammashma ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv kederech shepparat lecha binvela lagger bintina velaggoy bimchira
Detanya lo tochlu kol nevela lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenochri en li ella leger bintina ulgoy bimchira leger bimchira minnayin talmud lomar lagger tittenenna o machor

Legoy bintina minnayin talmud lomar tittenenna o machor lenochri nimtza echad ger veechad goy ben bimchira ben bintina divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer devarim kichtavan leger bintina velaggoy bimchira

May tama derabbi yehuda i salka datach kidkaamar rabbi meir lichtov rachamana lo tochlu chol nevela lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah umachor o lema li shema minah lidvarim kichtavan hu daata leger bintina velaggoy bimchira
Verabbi meir amar lach hay o lehakdim netina deger limchira degoy verabbi yehuda lehakdim netina deger limchira degoy la tzerich kera sevara hu ze atta metzve lehachoto veze i atta metzve lehachaoto
Siman shabbat choresh vechile zeraim oto veet beno veshiluach hakken
Ella meatta

a: Maase shabbat litasru deha tiavti lecha hu
Amar kera ki kodesh hi lachem hi kodesh veen maaseha kodesh
Choresh beshor uvachamor vechosem pi fara vedash bah litasru deha tiavti lecha hu
Hashta uma shabbat dachamira maaseha muttarim hane lo kol shekken
Kile zeraim litasru deha tiavti lecha hu middegalli rachamana gabbe kile hakkerem pen tikdash pen tukad esh mikkelal dechile zeraim sheru

Veema kile cherem asurin ben baachila ben bahanaa kile zeraim baachila asiri bahanaa sheru itakkush lechile vehema dichtiv behemtecha lo tarbia kilayim sadcha lo tizra kilayim ma behemtecha hayyotze mimmenna mutteret af sadcha hayyotze mimmennu muttar
Vechile vehema gufayehu mena lan middaasar rachamana kilayim laggavoha mikkelal dilhedot shere
Oto veet beno litsar middaasar rachamana mechussar zeman laggavoha mikkelal dilhedot shere
Shiluach hakken litsar lo amra tora shallach letakkala

Amar resh lakish minnayin levasar bechalav sheasur talmud lomar al tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal sheen talmud lomar mevushshal ma talmud lomar mevushshal lomar lecha yesh lecha bishshul acher shehu kaze vee ze ze basar bechalav
Amar lo rabbi yochanan
b: Keura zo sheshshana rabbi lo tochlennu bevasar bechalav hakkatuv medabber

Atta omer bevasar bechalav hakkatuv medabber o eno ella beechad mikkol haisurin shebbattora amarta tze ulmad mishshelosh esre middot shehattora nidreshet bahen davar hallamed meinyano bamme hakkatuv medabber bishne minin af kan bishne minin
I mehahi hava amena hane mile baachila aval bahanaa la kamashma lan
Verabbi bahanaa mena leh nafka leh mehacha neemar kan ki am kadosh atta la veneemar lehallan velo yihye kadesh bivne yisrael ma lehallan bahanaa af kan bahanaa
Deve rabbi eliezer tana lo tochlu chol nevela vego amra tora keshettimkerenna lo tevashshelenna vetimkerenna
Deve rabbi yishmael tana lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo shalosh peamim echad leisur achila veechad leisur hanaa veechad leisur bishshul
Tanya isi ben yehuda omer minnayin levasar bechalav sheasur neemar kan ki am kadosh atta veneemar lehallan veanshe kodesh tihun li uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu ma lehallan asur af kan asur
Veen li ella baachila bahanaa minnayin amarta kal vechomer uma orla shello neevda bah avera asura bahanaa basar bechalav shenneevda bo avera eno din sheasur bahanaa
Ma leorla shekken lo hayeta lah sheat hakkosher
Chametz bappesach yochiach shehayeta lo sheat hakkosher veasur bahanaa ma lechametz bappesach shekken anush karet
Kile hakkerem yochichu sheen anush karet veasur bahanaa
Lema li gezera shava layete kullah bekal vachomer meorla uma orla shello neevda bah avera asura ben baachila ben bahanaa basar bechalav shenneevda bo avera eno din sheasur ben baachila ben bahanaa
Mishshum deika lememar choresh beshor uvachamor vechosem pi fara vedash bah yochiach shenneevda bahem avera ushru
Lema li lememar kile hakkerem yochichu lema orla tochiach velihdar dina velete bema hatztzad
Amar rav ashe mishshum deika lememar nevela tochiach sheasura baachila umutteret bahanaa
Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hachi amrinan mishshemeh deresh lakish kol ma hatztzad miggufo parchinan mealma la parchinan
I hachi tete bema hatztzad mishshum deika lemifrach ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken giddule karka
I hachi hashta name ika lemifrach ma lechile hakkerem shekken giddule karka
Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hachi amrinan mishshemeh deresh lakish kol ma hatztzad parchinan kol dehu lo im amarta chada mechada kal vachomer parchinan kol dehu la parchinan
Velifroch lechullehu ma lechullehu shekken giddule karka
Ella amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hachi amrinan mishshemeh deresh lakish

a: Chada mechada kulla vechumra parchinan kol dehu la parchinan chada mittarte afilu kol dehu parchinan
Chada mittelat i hadar dina veate bema hatztzad parchinan kol dehu vei la kulla vechumra parchinan kol dehu la parchinan
Velifroch ma lechile hakkerem shekken lo hayeta lahen sheat hakkosher amar rav adda bar ahava zot omeret kile hakkerem ikaran neesar vehayeta lahen sheat hakkosher kodem hashrasha
Metiv rav shemaya bar zeera hammaavir atzitz nakuv bakkerem im hosif matayim asur hosif in lo hosif la
Amar abbaye tere kerae ketivi ketiv pen tikdash hammelea uchtiv hazzera
Ha ketzad zarua meikaro behashrasha zarua uva hosif in lo hosif la

Matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon basar bechalav asur baachila umuttar bahanaa shenneemar ki am kadosh atta veneemar lehallan veanshe kodesh tihun li
Ma lehallan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa af kan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa
Rabbi akiva omer chayya vaof vechu hane ha appekinhu lichdishmuel
Kasavar rabbi akiva isur chal al isur chelev umeta la tzerichi kera shelil gedi mealleya hu iyyataru lehu kullehu perat lechayya veof velivhema temea
Rabbi yose haggelili omer neemar lo tochlu may ika ben rabbi yose haggelili lerabbi akiva
Ika benayehu chayya rabbi yose haggelili savar chayya deorayeta verabbi akiva savar chayya derabbanan
Ibaet ema of ika benayehu rabbi akiva savar chayya vaof enan min hattora ha midderabbanan asiri verabbi yose haggelili savar of afilu midderabbanan name la asir
Tanya name hachi bimkomo shel rabbi eliezer hau kortin etzim laasot pechamin laasot barzel bimkomo shel rabbi yose haggelili hau ochlin besar of bechalav
Levi ikla leve yosef rishba ayeto lekammeh resha detavasa bachalava vela amar lehu vela mide ki ata lekammeh derabbi amar leh ammay la teshammetinhu
Amar leh atreh derabbi yehuda ben betera hu veamena derash lehu kerabbi yose haggelili deamar yatza of sheen lo chalev em
Matni kevat goy veshel nevela hare zo asura hammaamid beor shel keva keshera
b: Im yesh benoten taam hare zo asura keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa kevatah asura terefa sheyyanka min hechsherah kevatah mutteret mippene shekkanus bemeeha
Gema attu kevat goy lav nevela hi amar rav huna hacha belokeach gedi min haggoy askinan vechayeshinan shemma yanak min hatterefa
Umi chayeshinan shemma yanak min hatterefa vehatnan lokchim betzim min haggoyim veen choshshin lo mishshum nevela velo mishshum terefa ella ema chayeshinan shemma yanak min hattemea
Umay shena terefa dela chayeshinan umay shena temea dechayeshinan terefa la shechicha temea shechicha

I shechicha afilu gabbe didan nechush anan devadlinan minayehu vechi chazenan lehu mafreshinan lehu la gezaru behu rabbanan inhu dela bedili minayehu vechi chazu lehu la mafreshi lehu gezaru behu rabbanan
Ushmuel amar chada katane kevat shechitat goy nevela
Umi amar shemuel hachi vehaamar shemuel mippene ma asru gevinat haggoyim mippene shemmaamidin otah beor kevat nevela ha keva gufah sharya
La kashya kan kodem chazara kan leachar chazara

Amar rav chisda resha nire keochel nevelot hacha ika shechita
Amar leh rava velav kol dechen hu uma nevela dimisa dei sharet leh kevatah la ate lemechal minah amratte la terefa shechuta dei sharet ate lemechal minah lo kol shekken
Ella amar rav yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan la kashya kan kodem chazara kan leachar chazara umishna lo zaza mimmekomah

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan maamidin bekevat nevelot veen maamidin bekevat shechitat goy amar lefanav rabbi shimon bar abba keman kerabbi eliezer deamar setam machshevet goy laavoda zara
Amar leh veella keman
Ki ata rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan maamidin ben bekevat nevela ben bekevat shechitat goy shello lachosh ledivre rabbi eliezer

a: Moalin bo vechayyavin alav mishshum pigul venotar vetame ma sheen ken baddam
Vechomer baddam shehaddam noheg bivhema vechayya vaof ben temeim uven tehorim vechelev eno noheg ella bivhema tehora bilvad
Gema mena hane mile amar rabbi yannay deamar kera kaasher yuram mishshor zevach hashshelamim vechi ma lamadnu mishshor zevach hashshelamim meatta
Hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed makkish shor zevach hashshelamim lefar kohen mashiach ma par kohen mashiach yesh bo meila af shor zevach hashshelamim yesh bo meila
Amar leh rabbi chanina keura zo sheshshana rabbi kol chelev la lerabbot emure kadashim kallim limila
Amar abbaye itzterich dei ketav rachamana chelev hava amena chelev in yoteret ushte chelaot la ketav rachamana kaasher yuram
Vei ketav rachamana kaasher yuram hava amena chelev alya deletah beshor la ketav rachamana kol chelev
Amar leh rav mari lerav zevid i alya ikray chelev titsar baachila amar leh alecha amar kera kol chelev shor vechesev vaez davar hashshave beshor vechesev vaez
Rav ashe amar chelbo haalya ikray chelev setama la ikray ella meatta lo yimalu bah ella mechavarta kidrav zevid
Ma sheen ken baddam mena hane mile amar ulla deamar kera lachem shellachem yehe deve rabbi yishmael tana lechapper lechappara netattiv velo limila
Verabbi yochanan amar amar kera hu hu lifne kappara kilachar kappara ma leachar kappara en bo meila af lifne kappara en bo meila
Veema hu leachar kappara kelifne kappara ma lifne kappara yesh bo meila af leachar kappara yesh bo meila en lecha davar shennaasa mitzvato umoalin bo
Vela vahare terumat haddeshen denaasa mitzvato umoalin bo dichtiv vesamo etzel hammizbeach
Mishshum dehavey terumat haddeshen uvigde chehunna shene ketuvin habbain keechad vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Hanicha lerabbanan deamri vehinnicham sham melammed shetteunin geniza ella lerabbi dosa deamar shello yishtammesh bahen leom hakkippurim acher may ika lememar
Ella mishshum dehavey terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene chetuvim habbain keechad vechol shene ketuvim habbain keechad en melammedin
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar tere

Mitztarfin letamme tumat ochalin aval lo tumat nevelot

Rabbi yehuda omer haalal hamchunnas im yesh bo kezayit bemakom echad chayyav alav
Gema tenena leha detanu rabbanan shomrim letuma kalla velo shomrim letuma chamura
Shomrim letuma kalla menalan detana deve rabbi yishmael al kol zera zerua kederech shebbene adam motziin lizria chitta biklipatah usora biklipatah vaadashim biklipatan

a: Yachol hannogea keneged basar meachorav lo yehe tame talmud lomar yitma
May kaamar amar rava veamri lah kedi chassore michassera vehachi katane benivlatah velo beor sheen alav kezayit basar veor mashlimo lichzayit
Yachol sheani motzi af or sheyyesh alav kezayit basar hannogea keneged basar meachorav yachol lo yehe tame vaafilu maase yad name la aved
Talmud lomar yitma
Tenan hatam kol shehu yad velo shomer tame umtamme veeno mitztaref
Shomer veaf al pi sheeno yad tame umtamme umitztaref lo yad velo shomer lo tame velo metamme
Yadot hecha ketivi dichtiv vechi yuttan mayim al zera venafal minnivlatam alav tame hu lachem lachem lechol shebbetzorchechem lerabbot et hayyadot
Uchtiv vechi yamut min habbehema asher hi lachem lachem lechol shebbetzorchechem lerabbot et hayyadot yad lehachnis ulhotzi
Shomer lehachnis ulhotzi la tzerich kera kal vachomer miyyad ate uma yad sheenah megina machneset umotzia shomer lo kol shekken
Shomer dichtav rachamana lema li shema minah letzaref
Veema yad lehachnis velo lehotzi shomer lehachnis ulhotzi aval yad lehotzi veshomer letzaref la
Yad lehachnis velo lehotzi la matzet amratte hashta ayyole meayela appoke mibaya
Veema yad lehotzi velo lehachnis shomer lehotzi ulhachnis aval yad lehachnis veshomer letzaref la
Yad yattira ketiv tannur vechirayim yuttatz vego
Lachem lechol shebbetzorchechem lerabbot et hayyadot
He minayehu meyatar
Lichtov rachamana bizraim veleto hanach minayehu ma lizraim shekken tumatan merubba
Lichtov rachamana betannur velete hanach mineh ma letannur shekken metamme meaviro
Lichtov rachamana binvela velete hanach minah ma linvela shekken metammea adam umtammea bemassa vetuma yotza miggufah
Chada mechada la atya tete chada mittarte
He tete la lichtov rachamana bizraim vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken mittammein shello behechsher tomar bizraim sheen mittammein ella behechsher
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua perot shello huchsheru ketannur shello nigmera melachto dame
Ella parech hachi ma lehanach shekken mittammein shello bingia tomar bizraim sheen mittammein ella bingia
La lichtov rachamana betannur vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken ochel
La lichtov rachamana binvela vetete mehanach in hachi name ella yad dinvela lema li im eno inyan leyad nevela tenehu inyan leyad dealma
Yad lehachnis yad lehotzi shomer letzaref
Veakkatti yad dinvela itzterich dei la ketav rachamana binvela hava amena dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon ma hanach la metammu adam af nevela la metammea adam
Ella yad dinvela mitzrach tzerich veshomer dinvela hu dela tzerich lemay hilcheta katveh rachamana i leitzterofe amratte la mitztaref ulhotzi kal vachomer miyyad ate
Ella im en inyan leshomer dinvela tenehu inyan leyad dinvela veim eno inyan leyad dinvela tenehu inyan leyad dealma yad lehotzi yad lehachnis veshomer letzaref
b: Veema im eno inyan leshomer dinvela tenehu inyan leshomer dealma shomer lehachnis veshomer letzaref aval yad lehachnis lo
Ella meikara ki ketiva yad ahachnasa ketiva
Ella shomer dinvela lema li legufeh
Ulmay i leitzterofe amratte la mitztaref i lehachnis ulhotzi kal vachomer miyyad atya milta deatya bekal vechomer tarach vechatav lah kera
I hachi shomer dealma ema lach lehachnis umilleta deate bekal vachomer tarach vechatav lah kera
Hecha deika lemidrash darshinan
Rav chaviva amar shane shomer dinvela kevan demaase yad ka aved ayyad shadenan leh
Matkef lah rav yehuda bar yishmael ha ditnan happitma shel rimmon mitztarefet vehannetz shello en mitztaref
Veammay keri kan al kol zera zerua veleka
Vetu ha ditnan haor veharotev vehakkefe vechu mitztaref letamme tumat ochalim menalan
Ella telata kerae ketivi al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea chad leshomer dizraim vechad leshomer deilanot idach leshomer basar uvetzim vedagim
Amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav yesh yad letuma veen yad lehechsher
Verabbi yochanan amar yesh yad letuma ulhechsher
Bemay kamipalgi ibaet ema sevara ibaet ema kera
Ibaet ema kera mar savar mikra nidrash lefanav velo lifne fanav
Umar savar mikra nidrash lefanav velifne fanav
Ibaet ema sevara mar savar hechsher techillat tuma hu umar savar hechsher lav techillat tuma hu
Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan keshem sheyyesh yad letuma kach yesh yad lehechsher uchshem sheen mekabbelin tuma ella lichsheyyittalshu kach en mekabbelin hechsher ella ad sheyyittalshu
Amar rav en yad lefachot mikkezayit veen shomer lefachot mikkefol
Verabbi yochanan amar yesh yad lefachot mikkezayit veyesh shomer lefachot mikkefol
Metivi shette atzamot vaalehen shene chatzae zetim vehichnis rashehen hashshenayim levayit vehabbayit maahil alehen habbayit tame
Yehuda ben nakosa omer mishshum rabbi yaakov heach shene atzamot mitztarfin lichzayit

a: Verav hay bemay mokem lah i beyad kashya resha
I beshomer kashya sefa
Ibaet ema beshomer ibaet ema beyad
Ibaet ema beyad vehu deamar kerabbi yehuda ben nakosa veibaet ema beshomer vehu deamar ketanna kamma
Verabbi yochanan amar kullah beyad vehu deamar ketanna kamma
Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer kulit sheyyesh aleha kezayit basar goreret kullah letuma acherim omrim afilu en aleha ella kefol goreret kullah letuma
Verav hay bemay mokem lah i beyad kashya sefa i beshomer kashya resha
Ibaet ema beyad vehu deamar kerabbi yehuda veibaet ema beshomer kaacherim
Verabbi yochanan amar kullah beshomer vehu deamar kaacherim
Acherim ha kefol ka amri
Ayede dekaamar tanna kamma shiura kaamri inhu name shiura
Amar rava dayeka name divshomer askinan dekatane kulit shema minah
Itmar rabbi chanina amar zehu shiur verabbi yochanan amar en ze shiur
En ze shiur veha katane kefol ayede dekaamar tanna kamma shiura kaamri inhu name shiura
Ta shema rabbi elazar ben azarya metaher beshel pol umtamme beshel kitnit mippene sherotze bemishmushan
Kidamar rav acha bereh derava bekulcha umishshum yad
Hacha name bekulcha umishshum yad umay bemishmushan betashmishan
Ta shema detana deve rabbi yishmael al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea kederech shebbene adam motziin chitta biklipatah usora biklipatah vaadashim biklipatan
Beriyya shane
Bae rav oshaya
b: Shene shomrin mahu sheyyitztarfu
Hechi dame ilema beze al gav ze umi ika shomer al gav shomer
Vehatnan rabbi yehuda omer shalosh kelipot bevatzal penimit ben shelema ben kedura mitztarefet emtzait shelema mitztarefet kedura en mitztarefet chitzona ben kach uven kach tehora
Rav oshaya shomer ochel shechilleko kamibaya leh
Kevan dehay la maggen ahay vehay la maggen ahay la mitztaref
O dilma kevan dehay maggen addideh vehay maggen addideh mitztarfin
Ta shema rabbi elazar ben azarya metaher beshel pol umtamme beshel kitnit mippene sherotze bemishmushan
Amar rav acha bereh derava bekulcha umishshum yad umay bemishmushan betashmishan
Ta shema detana deve rabbi yishmael al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea kederech shebbene adam motziin lizria chitta biklipatah usora biklipatah vaadashim biklipatan
Kidamar rav acha bereh derava bekulcha umishshum yad
Hacha name beshidra umishshum shomer
Bishlama iliyyata tzerichi letattayata ella tettayyata may tzerichi leiliyyata bechad dara
Umi ika kevetza ochalin bechad dara bechitte deshimon ben shatach
Hashta deatet lehachi chada chitta name bechitte deshimon ben shatach
Gufa shene atzamot vaalehen shene chatzae zetim vehichnis rashehen shenayim levayit vehabbayit maahil alehen habbayit tame
Yehuda ben nakosa omer mishshum rabbi yaakov heach shene atzamot mitztarfin lichzayit
Amar resh lakish lo shanu ella etzem dehave yad aval nima la haveya yad verabbi yochanan amar afilu nima name haveya yad
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish or sheyyesh alav kezayit basar hannogea betziv hayyotze mimmennu uvisara shekkenegdo tame may lav mishshum yad
La mishshum shomer umi ika shomer al gabbe shomer chalchule mechalchel
Matkef lah rav acha bar yaakov ella meatta tefilin hechi katvinan ha baenan ketiva tamma veleka
Ishtemitteh ha deamri bemareva kol nekev shehaddeo over alav eno nekev
Veibaet ema kulleh mishshum yad kidamar rabbi ila bimlay shebben hammelaim
Hachi name benima shebben hannimin
Vehecha ittemar derabbi ila aha melay shebbashshibbolim mitammein umtammein veenan mitztarfin melay lemay chaze amar rabbi ilay bimlay shebben hammelaim
Lishana acharina amri lah
Hachi name mistabbera demishshum shomer dei salka datach mishshum yad nima achat lemay chaze
Kidamar rabbi ila bimlay shebben hammelain hacha name benima shebben hannimin
Vehecha itmar derabbi ilay aha ditnan hammelay shebbashshibbolim mitammein umtammein veen mitztarfin melay lemay chaze amar rabbi ilay bimlay shebben hammelaim
Veika dematne lah

a: Ammatnitin haor veharotev vehakkefe vechu mitztarfin letamme tumat ochalin
Amar resh lakish lo shanu ella etzem dehave shomer aval nima la haveya shomer verabbi yochanan amar afilu nima name haveya shomer
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan umi ika shomer al gabbe shomer chalchule mechalchel
Matkef lah rav acha ella meatta tefilin hechi katvinan ha baenan ketiva tamma veleka
Ishtemitteh ha deamri bemareva kol nekev shehaddeo over alav eno nekev
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish or sheyyesh alav kezayit basar hannogea betziv hayyotze mimmennu uvsaara shekkenegdo tame may lav mishshum shomer la mishshum yad
Nima achat lemay chazya kidamar rabbi ila bimlay shebben hammelain hachi name benima shebben hannimin
Vehecha itmar derabbi ila aha ditnan hammelay shebbashshibbolin metammein umitammein veen mitztarfin melay lemay chaze amar rabbi ila bimlay shebben hammelain
Veharotev may rotev amar rava shumna
Amar leh abbaye hu atzmo yetamme tumat ochalin ella chelev dikrish
May irya kerish ki la kerish name deamar resh lakish tzir sheal gabbe yarak mitztaref lichchotevet beom hakkippurim
Hatam mishshum yattove data hu bechol dehu meyatteva dateh
Hacha mishshum itzterofe hu i kerish mitztaref i la kerish la mitztaref
Vehakkefe may kefe amar rabba pirma
Amar leh abbaye hu atzmo yetamme tumat ochalin ella amar rav pappa tavlin
Tenan hatam hikpa et haddam vaachalo o shehimcha et hachelev ugmao chayyav
Bishlama hikpa et haddam vaachalo kevan deakpeyeh achshove achsheveh ella himcha et hachelev ugmao achila ketiva beh veha lav achila hi
Amar resh lakish amar kera nefesh lerabbot et hashshote
Tanya name gabbe chametz kehay gavena himchahu ugmao im chametz hu anush karet im matztza hi en adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach
Bishlama im matztza hi en adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach lechem oni amar rachamana vehay lav lechem oni hu ella im chametz hu anush karet achila ketiva beh
Amar resh lakish amar kera nefesh lerabbot et hashshote
Vetanya name gabbe nivlat of tahor kehay gavena himchahu baur tame bachamma tahor vehavenan bah achila ketiv beh
Amar resh lakish amar kera nefesh lerabbot et hashshote i hachi bachamma name bachamma asroche masrach
Utzrichi dei ketav rachamana chelev chametz la ate mineh shekken lo hayeta lo sheat hakkosher nevela la ate mineh shekken anush karet
Vei ketav rachamana chametz chelev la ate mineh shekken lo huttar mikkelalo unvela la atya mineh shekken anush karet
Vei ketav rachamana binvela hanach la atya minah shekken metammea
Chada mechada la atya tete chada mittarte he tete la lichtov rachamana binvela vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken anush karet
La lichtov rachamana bechametz vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken lo hayeta lahen sheat hakkosher
La lichtov rachamana bechelev vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken lo huttar mikkelalan tomar bechelev shehuttar mikkelalo
Umay nihu ilema chelev behema laggavoha nevela name ishteray melikat of laggavoha
Veella chelev chayya lehedot nevela name ishteray melika dechattat haof lakkohanim
Leolam chelev chayya lehedot udka kashya lach kohanim kohanim mishshulchan gavoha ka zachu
Veha detanya hattemeim leesor tziran verotvan vekefe shellahen lema li ligmar mehane
Tzerichi dei la ketav rachamana hava amena dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon ma hatam ad deika kezayit af hacha name ad deika kezayit
b: Velichtov rachamana bishratzim veleto hanach veligmeru minayehu
Mishshum deika lemifrach ma lishratzim shekken tumatan bemashshehu
Veha detanya hattevel vehechadash vehahekdesh vehashsheviit vehakkilayim kullan mashkin hayyotzin mehen kemotan menalan
Vechi tema ligmar mehanach ma lehanach shekken isur habba meelav hau
Tinach hecha deisur ba meelav hecha delav isur habba meelav menalan
Gamrinan mibbikkurim uvikkurim gufayehu menalan
Detane rabbi yose peri peri atta mevi vei atta mevi mashke hevi anavim udrachan minnayin talmud lomar tavi
Ika lemifrach ma levikkurim shekken teunin keriyya vehannacha
Ella gamar mitteruma
Utruma gufah menalan deitakkash levikkurim deamar mar utrumat yadecha ellu bikkurim
Ma litruma shekken chayyavin aleha mita vachomesh
Ella gamar mittarvayehu mitteruma uvikkurim ma litruma uvikkurim shekken chayyavin alehem mita vachomesh
Ella atya mitteruma vechad mehanach o mibbikkurim vechad mehanach
Veha ditnan devash temarim veyen tappuchim vechometz sitvaniyyot ushar mine ferot shel teruma rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vachomesh verabbi yehoshua poter
Bemay peligi bedun minah uminah uvdun minah veoke beatrah kamipalgi
Derabbi eliezer savar dun minah uminah ma bikkurim mashkin hayyotze mehen kemotan af teruma name mashkin hayyotze mehen kemotan uminah ma bikkurim afilu shear minin af teruma name afilu shear minin

Verabbi yehoshua savar dun minah ma bikkurim mashkin hayyotzin mehen kemotan af teruma mashkin hayyotzin mehen kemotan veoke beatrah ma mashkin dekadashim bitruma tirosh veyitzhar in mide acharina la af mashkin hayyotzin mehen kemotan tirosh veyitzhar in mide acharina la
Veha ditnan en meviin bikkurim mashke ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim manni
Rabbi yehoshua hi deamar dun minah veoke veatrah vegamar lehu levikkurim mitteruma
Veha ditnan en sofgin et haarbaim mishshum orla ella al hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim manni
Rabbi yehoshua hi deamar dun minah veoke beatrah vegamar lehu levikkurim mitteruma

a: Vahadar mayete lah leorla peri peri mibbikkurim
Vehaalal may alal rabbi yochanan amar marteka veresh lakish amar basar sheppelatattu sakkin
Metivi veulam attem tofle shaker rofe elil kullechem bishlama leman deamar marteka hayenu delav bar refua hu ella leman deamar basar sheppelatattu sakkin bar refua hu
Baalal dikra dechulle alma la feligi ki peligi baalal dematnitin
Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer haalal hamchunnas im yesh kezayit bemakom echad chayyavin alav veamar rav huna vehu shekkinneso
Bishlama leman deamar basar sheppelatattu sakkin hayenu dechi ika kezayit michayyav ella leman deamar marteka ki ika kezayit may have etz bealma hu
Alliba derabbi yehuda la peligi ki peligi alliba derabbanan rabbi yochanan amar marteka name mitztaref veresh lakish amar daveka basar sheppelatattu sakkin aval marteka la mitztaref
Hay basar sheppelatattu sakkin hechi dame i dechashshev aleh afilu beanpe nafsheh mitamme vei dela chashshev aleh battole batteleh
Rabbi avin verabbi meyasha chad amar miktzato chishev alav
Vechad amar miktzato pelatattu chayya umiktzato pelatattu sakkin
Tenan hatam hachartom vehatztzippornayim mitammein umtammein umitztarfin chartom etz bealma hu

Karnayim amar rav pappa bimkom shechotchin veotze mehen dam
Keotze bo hashshochet behema
Amar rabbi assi shonin yisrael bitmea vegoy bithora tzerichin machshava vehechsher mayim mimmakom acher

Vetanya amar rabbi yose mippene ma amru nivlat of tahor tzericha machshava veenah tzericha hechsher mippene

Chizkiyya amar enah leevarim meta hi rabbi yochanan amar yeshnah leevarim lav meta hi
Amar leh yatzta mikkelal chayya velichlal meta lo bat

Gufa shachat bah shenayim o rov shenayim vaadayin hi mefarkeset chizkiyya amar enah leevarim rabbi yochanan amar yeshnah leevarim amar rabbi elazar nekot leha derabbi yochanan beyadcha detane rav oshaya kevateh
Detane rav oshaya yisrael sheshshachat behema temea legoy shachat bah shenayim o rov shenayim umfarkeset metammea tumat ochalin aval lo tumat nevelot
Ever happoresh mimmenna keforesh min hachay uvasar happoresh mimmenna kevasar happoresh min hachay veasur livne noach vaafilu leachar shettetze nafshah
Shachat bah echad o rov echad enah metammea tumat ochalin necharah en bah tuma shel kelum
Vegoy sheshshachat behema tehora leyisrael umfarkeset metammea tumat ochalin aval lo tumat nevela
Ever happoresh mimmenna keforesh min hachay uvasar happoresh mimmenna keforesh min hachay veasur livne noach vaafilu leachar shettetze nafshah
Shachat bah echad o rov echad enah metammea tumat ochalin necharah en bah tuma shel kelum
Shachat goy bimkom sheen ose otah terefa uva yisrael ugmarah keshera
Shachat yisrael ben bimkom sheose otah terefa uven bimkom sheen ose otah terefa uva goy vegamar shechitato pesula

Harotze sheyyochal mibbehema kodem shettetze nafshah chotech kezayit basar mibbet shechitatah umolcho yafe yafe umdicho yafe yafe umamtin lah ad shettetze nafshah veochlo echad goy veechad yisrael muttarin bo

Mesayya leh lerav idi bar avin deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan harotze sheyyavri chotech kezayit basar mibbet shechita umolcho yafe yafe umdicho yafe yafe umamtin lah ad shettetze nafshah echad goy veechad yisrael muttarim bo
Bae rabbi elazar shaha bah daras bah mahu
Amar leh hahu sava hachi amar rabbi yochanan tzericha hechsher shechita kivhema tehora hechsher lemay amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak bedikat sakkin
Bea mineh rabbi zera merav sheshet mahu shettatztzil al habbeluin shebbetochah
Amar leh metammea tumat ochalin umatztzelet amar leh enah metammea tumat nevelot velo tatztzil
Amar abbaye enah matztzelet al habbeluim shebbetochah deha metammea tumat ochalin veharovah chayyav deha enah metammea tumat nevela
Rabbi yehuda omer haalal vechu amar rav huna vehu shekkinneso
Veamar rav huna shene chatzae zetim sheyyeshnan al gabbe haor haor mevattelan

a: Alliba deman
I alliba derabbi yishmael haamar lo mevattel or vei alliba derabbi akiva peshita haamar mevattel or
Leolam alliba derabbi yishmael vechi amar rabbi yishmael lo mevattel or hane mile sheppelatattu chaya aval pelatattu sakkin batel
Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer haalal hamchunnas im yesh kezayit bemakom echad chayyavin alav veamar rav huna vehu shekkinneso
I amratte bishlama pelatattu sakkin lerabbi yishmael name la batel rav huna deamar kerabbi yishmael
Ella i amratte pelatattu sakkin lerabbi yishmael batel rav huna deamar keman
Ella leolam pelatattu sakkin lerabbi yishmael lo batel verav huna deamar kerabbi akiva
Peshita mahu detema ki kaamar rabbi akiva hane mile pelatattu sakkin aval pelatattu chayya la batel
Ka mashma lan tama derabbi akiva mippene shehaor mevattelan la shena pelatattu chayya vela shena pelatattu sakkin kidkatane sefa mippene ma rabbi akiva metaher beor mippene shehaor mevattelan
Matni ellu sheorotehen kivsaran or haadam vaor chazir shel yishshuv rabbi yehuda omer af or chazir habbar

Vaor chateret shel gamal harakka veor harosh shel egel harach vaor happerasot veor bet habboshet vaor hashshelil veor shel tachat haalya vaor haanaka vehakkoach vehalletaa vehachomet rabbi yehuda omer halletaa kechulda
Vechullan sheibbedan o shehilech bahen kede avoda tehorin chutz meor haadam rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer shemona sheratzim yesh lahen orot
Gema amar ulla devar tora or adam tahor uma taam amru tame gezera shemma yaase adam orot aviv veimmo shetichin

Veika dematne lah assefa vechullan sheibdan o shehilech bahen kede avoda tehorin chutz meor adam amar ulla devar tora or adam sheibbedo tahor uma taam amru tame gezera shemma yaase adam orot aviv veimmo shetichin
Man dematne lah aresha kol shekken assefa uman dematne assefa aval aresha tuma deorayeta
Veor chazir vechu bemay kamipalgi mar savar hay ashshun vehay rakkich umar savar hay name rakkich
Or chateret shel gamal harakka vechamma gamal harakka amar ulla amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol zeman shello taana
Bae rabbi yirmeya higgia zemannah liton velo taana mahu bae abbaye lo higgia zemannah liton vetaana mahu teku
Yatev resh lakish vekamibaya leh kamma gamal harakka amar leh rabbi yishmael bar abba hachi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol zeman shello taana amar leh tiv lekivli
Yatev rabbi zera vekamibaya leh kamma gamal harakka amar leh ravin bar chinana hachi amar ulla amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol zeman shello taana hava katane lah amar leh chada haveya lach amarte
Ta chazi ma ben takkife ara deyisrael lachaside devavel
Veor harosh vechu vechamma egel harach ulla amar ben shenato rabbi yochanan amar kol zeman sheyyonek ibaya lehu hechi kaamar ulla ben shenato vehu sheyyonek
b: Vaamar leh rabbi yochanan kol zeman sheyyonek
O dilma ulla ben shenato kaamar ben yonek uven sheeno yonek vaamar leh rabbi yochanan ben shenato vehu sheyyonek
Ta shema rabbi yochanan amar kol zeman sheyyonek veim itah vehu sheyyonek mibe leh shema minah
Bea mineh resh lakish merabbi yochanan or harosh shel egel harach mahu sheyetamme amar leh eno metamme
Amar leh limadtanu rabbenu ellu sheorotehen kivsaran veor harosh shel egel harach amar leh al takniteni bilshon yachid ani shone otah
Detanya hashshochet et haola lehaktir kezayit meor shettachat haalya chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmanno pigul vechayyavin alav karet

Elazar ben yehuda ish evlayim omer mishshum rabbi yaakov vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar ikum omer mishshum rabbi shimon echad or perasot veechad or harosh shel egel harach veechad or shel tachat haalya vechol shemmanu chachamim gabbe tuma sheorotehen kivsaran lehavi or shel bet habboshet
Chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmanno pigul vechayyavin alav karet
Veor bet happerasot may bet happerasot rav amar bet happerasot mammash rabbi chanina amar rechubba hannimkeret im harosh
Vaor haanaka tanu rabbanan hattemeim lerabbot orotehen kivsaran
Yachol afilu kullan talmud lomar elle
Veha elle akkullehu ketivi amar rav leminehu hifsik hainyan
Velichshov name tinshemet amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak rav tena hu vetane tinshemet
Veha tanna didan la tane tinshemet
Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi tanna didan savar lah kerabbi yehuda deazel batar gishta
Uvgishta dehalletaa kamipalgi
Vechullan sheibdan vechu hilech in lo hilech la veha tane rabbi chiyya ozen chamor shettelaah lekuppato tehora telaah af al gav dela hilech
Lo telaah hilech in lo hilech la
Kamma kede ibbud amar rav huna amar rabbi yannay arbaat milin
Rabbi avahu mishshum deresh lakish amar legabbal
Velitfilla velintilat yadayim arbaat milin
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak

a: Ayevu amrah vearbee amar bah vachada minayehu avoda
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina lo shanu ella lefanav aval leacharav afilu mil echad eno chozer rav acha bar yaakov amar uminah mil hu deeno chozer ha pachot mimmil chozer

Tanu rabbanan ligon haover mimmakom lemakom venichnas levayit habbayit tame sheen lach kol ligon veligon sheen lo kamma karkiflin veal titmah shehare karkiflo shel rabbi yishmael munnach berosh melachim
Matni hammafshit babbehema uvachayya battehora uvattemea baddakka uvaggassa
Leshatiach kede achiza
Ulchemet ad sheyyafshit et hechaze
Hammargil kullo chibbur lattuma litamme ultamme or sheal hatztzavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer eno chibbur vachachamim omrim chibbur ad sheyyafshit et kullo
Gema mikkan veelach may
Amar rav tahor hammufshat rabbi assi amar tefach hassamuch labbasar tame
Metivi hammafshit keshiur hazze mikkan veelach hannogea bammufshat tahor may lav afilu betefach hassamuch labbasar la levar mittefach hassamuch labbasar
Ta shema beor shekkeneged habbasar tame or shekkeneged habbasar tame ha betefach hassamuch labbasar tahor tana kol tefach hassamuch labbasar or shekkeneged habbasar kare leh
Ta shema hammafshit babbehema uvachayya battehora uvattemea baddakka uvaggassa leshatiach kede achiza vetefach hassamuch labbasar tahor
Hacha bemay askinan betefach rishon
Tana kamma kede achiza tefach veha tanya tifchayim
Amar abbaye tefach kaful tanya name hachi kamma kede achiza tefach kaful
Tenan hatam tallit shehitchil bah lekorah kevan shennikra rubbah shuv eno chibbur uthora
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lo shanu ella betallit tevulat yom
Demigo dela chas alah veatbelah la chayes alah vekara lah rubbah aval tallit sheenah tevulat yom la gezera dilma la ate lemikreah rubbah
Amar rabba shette teshuvot baddavar chada shemma yomru tevila bat yoma ola veod
b: Olat haof lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon ligzar dilma la ate lemebad rov shenayim
Amar leh rav yosef deka amratte gezera shemma yomru tevila bat yoma ola kirah mochiach aleha
Udka amratte olat haof lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon ligzar kohanim zerizim hen
Ta shema hammafshit babbehema uvachayya battemea uvithora baddakka uvaggassa leshatiach kede achiza
Ha yater mikkede achiza tahor ammay ligzar dilma la ate lemebad ella kede achiza veka nega betuma veka metaharinan leh
I betuma deorayeta hachi name hacha bemay askinan betuma derabbanan
Tinach tame battehora tahor bitmea tuma deorayeta hi bitrefa
Terefa bat tammoye hi in kedaavuh dishmuel deamar avuh dishmuel terefa sheshshechatah metammea bemukdashin
Ta shema rabbi dostay ben yehuda mishshum rabbi shimon omer hammafshit bishratzim chibbur ad sheyyafshit et kullo
Ha begamal eno chibbur
La tema ha begamal eno chibbur ella ema beor sheal hatztzavar eno chibbur verabbi yochanan ben nuri hi
Amar rav huna mishshum rabbi shimon berabbi yose lo shanu ella shello shiyyer bah kede maporet aval shiyyer bah kede maporet chibbur
Amar resh lakish lo shanu ella tallit aval or chalim verabbi yochanan amar afilu or name la chalim

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish or tame midras chishev alav lirtzuot vesandalim kevan shennatan bo izmel tahor divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim ad sheyyamitennu mechamishsha tefachim ki memaet leh miha tahor ammay lema chalim
Ki kaamri dachalim hecha deka tzare leh lehedya hacha bemay askinan bimkatztzea uva lo derech sevivotav

Metiv rabbi yirmeya hammafshit babbehema uvachayya battehora uvattemea baddakka uvaggassa leshatiach kede achiza ha yater mikkede achiza tahor veammay lema chalim targemah rabbi avin rishon rishon ose nipul
Metiv rav yosef or sheal hatztzavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer eno chibbur ammay ha chalim vekae
Amar leh abbaye ema sefa vachachamim omrim chibbur
Ella amar abbaye beshomer heasuy linnatek meelav ka mipalgi mar savar have shomer umar savar la have shomer
Metiv rabbi yirmeya tannur shennitma ketzad metaharin oto cholko lishlosha vegorer et hattefela

a: Ad sheyehe baaretz rabbi meir omer eno tzarich lo ligror et hattefela velo ad sheyehe baaretz ella memaato mibbifnim mearbaa tefachim
Ki memaet lah mearbaa miha tahor ammay lema ha chalim vekae
Amar leh rava veema midderabbanan gorer et hattefela ad sheyehe baaretz
Ella amar rava hachi kaamar tannur shennitma ketzad metaharin oto divre hakkol cholko lishlosha vegorer et hattefela ad sheyehe baaretz

Veharotze shello yavo tannuro lide tuma ketzad hu ose cholko lishlosha vegorer et hattefela ad sheyehe baaretz rabbi meir omer eno tzarich lo ligror et hattefela velo ad sheyehe baaretz ella memaato mibbifnim mearbaa tefachim
Amar mar cholko lishlosha
Urminhu tannur techillato arbaa ushyarav arbaa divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim bamme devarim amurim begadol aval bekatan techillato kol shehu mishshettiggamer melachto sheyarav berubbo
Vechamma kol shehu amri deve rabbi yannay tefach shekken osim tannure banot tefach
Tama deika sheyarav arba ha leka sheyarav arba tahor
Amri hatam detzalkeh mitzlak hacha deavdeh gistera
Amar mar sheyarav berubbo rubbo detefach lemay have
Amar abbaye sheyare gadol berubbo vehaamri rabbanan arbaa la kashya ha betannura bar tisha ha betannura bar shiva
Lishana acharina amri lah amar rav huna mishshum rabbi yishmael berabbi yose vaafilu shiyyer bah kede maporet
Amar resh lakish lo shanu ella tallit aval or chashiv verabbi yochanan amar afilu or name la chashiv
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish or tame midras chishev alav lirtzua vesandalin kevan shennatan bo izmel tahor divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim ad sheyyamitennu mechamishsha tefachim
Ki memaet miha tahor ammay lema chashiv hacha bemay askinan deka vae leh lemoshav zav
Matni or sheyyesh alav kezayit basar hannogea betziv hayyotze mimmennu uvsaara shekkenegdo tame

Hau alav kishne chatzae zetim metamme bemassa velo bemagga divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer lo bemagga velo bemassa umode rabbi akiva bishne chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam vehesitan shehu tame umippene ma rabbi akiva metaher baor mippene shehaor mevattelan
Gema amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella pelatattu chayya aval pelatattu sakkin batel
Amar leh rav nachman leulla amar rabbi yochanan afilu ketarta amar leh in vaafilu kenafya amar leh in amar leh haelohim im amar li rabbi yochanan mippummeh la tzayetna leh

Ki selek rav oshaya ashkecheh leh lerabbi amme amrah lishmata kammeh hachi amar ulla vehachi ahdar leh rav nachman amar leh umishshum derav nachman chatneh deve nesia hu mezalzel bishmateh derabbi yochanan
Zimnin ashkecheh deyatev vekaamar lah assefa hau alav shene chatzae zetim metammeim bemassa velo bemagga divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer lo bemagga velo bemassa
Amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella pelatattu chayya aval pelatattu sakkin batel
Amar leh mar assefa matne lah amar leh in veella ulla aresha amrah nihalayechu amar leh in amar leh haelohim i amar li yehoshua bin nun mishshemeh la tzayetna leh
Ki ata ravin vechol nachote amruha aresha veella kashya kidamar rav pappa
b: Bimruddad hacha name bimruddad
Hau alav
Amar bar peda lo shanu ella meacharav aval millefanav yesh nogea vechozer venogea
Verabbi yochanan amar en nogea vechozer venogea veazda rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi yochanan rabbi yishmael verabbi dosa ben harkinas amru davar echad
Rabbi yishmael ha daamaran rabbi dosa ben harkinas ditnan kal hamtammein beohel shennechleku vehichnisan letoch habbayit rabbi dosa ben harkinas metaher vachachamim metammeim
Lav amar rabbi dosa ben harkinas hatam en maahil vechozer umaahil hacha name en nogea vechozer venogea
Umidderabbi dosa ben harkinas kerabbi yishmael rabbanan kerabbi akiva veha rabbi akiva tahore ka metahar

Ad kan la ka metahar rabbi akiva ella beor aval bealma metamme kidkatane sefa umode rabbi akiva bishne chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam vehesitan shehu tame umippene ma rabbi akiva metaher baor mippene shehaor mevattelan
Metiv rav ukva bar chama benivlatam velo beor sheyyesh alav shene chatzae zetim
Yachol af bemassa talmud lomar vehannose yitma divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer hannogea vehannose et shebba lichlal magga ba lichlal massa lo ba lichlal magga lo ba lichlal massa
Veim ita hare ba lichlal magga millefanav
Amar rava hachi kaamar et shebba lichlal magga bechol tzad ba lichlal massa lo ba lichlal magga bechol tzad lo ba lichlal massa
Bea mineh rav aveya sava merabba bar rav huna kulit setuma lerabbi yishmael mahu shettetamme
It leh lerabbi yishmael et shebba lichlal magga ba lichlal massa lo ba lichlal magga lo ba lichlal massa vehacha hayenu tama mishshum deva lichlal magga millefanav
O dilma let leh
Amar leh orva parach
Amar leh rava bereh velav hayenu rav aveya sava mippumbedita dimshabbach lan mar begaveh degavra rabba hu amar leh ani hayyom sammechuni baashishot uva minay milta devae tama
Amar ulla shene chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam afilu molich umevi kol hayyom kullo tahor
May tama ketiv venissa vekarenan nose baenan nose vehu denisa bevat achat
Tenan hau alav shene chatzae zetim metammein bemassa velo bemagga divre rabbi yishmael ammay veha lav nisa hu
Amar rav pappa bimruddad
Ta shema mode rabbi akiva bishne chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam vehesitan shehu tame ammay veha lav nisa hu hachi name bimruddad
Ketannae echad hannogea veechad hammesit rabbi eliezer omer af hannose attu nose lav mesit hu
Ella lav hachi kaamar echad hannogea veechad hammesit belo nisa vaata rabbi eliezer lememar vehu denisa umay af ema vehu denisa
Matni kulit hammet

a: Vekulit hammukdashin hannogea bahen ben setumim ben nekuvim tame

Kulit nevela vekulit hashsheretz hannogea bahem setumim tehorim nekuvim kol shehu metamme bemagga minnayin sheaf bemassa talmud lomar hannogea vehannose et shebba lichlal magga ba lichlal massa lo ba lichlal magga lo ba lichlal massa
Gema nogea in aval maahil la
Hechi dame i deika kezayit basar beohel name litamme deleka kezayit basar
Vei deika kezayit moach mibbifnim tuma bokaat veola beohel name litamme deleka kezayit moach bifnim
Vei moach mibbifnim maale arucha mibbachutz ever mealleya hi beohel name litamme amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyya zot omeret moach bifnim eno maale arucha mibbachutz
Bemay okemtah deleka kezayit i hachi bemukdashim ammay metamme
Vetu kulit nevela vekulit hashsheretz ki nikvu ammay metammeu
Ha la kashya resha deleka kezayit sefa deika kezayit umay ka mashma lan mile mile ka mashma lan

Resha ka mashma lan demoach mibbifnim eno maale arucha mibbachutz mukdashin may ka mashma lan shimush notar milta hi deamar mari bar avuh amar rabbi yitzchak atzmot kadashim sheshshimshu notar metammein et hayyadayim hoil venaasa basis ledavar haasur
Nevela af al gav deika kezayit nikva in lo nikva la
Abbaye amar leolam moach mibbifnim maale arucha mibbachutz vehacha bemay askinan besheshshippah
Vechidrabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar kulit sheshshippah leorkah temea lerochbah tehora vesimanach dikla
Verabbi yochanan amar leolam deika kezayit umoach mibbifnim maale arucha mibbachutz umay nogea dekatane maahil
Vei moach mibbifnim maale arucha mibbachutz kulit nevela vekulit hashsheretz ki lo nikkevu ammay tehorim
Amar rabbi binyamin bar gidel amar rabbi yochanan hacha bemay askinan kegon deika kezayit moach hammitkashkesh gabbe met tuma bokaat veola nevela kevan demitkashkesh hu nikva in lo nikva la
Amar rabbi avin veitema rabbi yose bar avin af anan name tenena hannogea bechachatzi zayit umaahil al chatzi zayit o chatzi zayit maahil alav tame
I amratte bishlama chad shema hu mishshum hachi mitztaref
Ella i amratte tere sheme ninhu mi mitztaref vehatnan ze hakkelal kol shehu mishshem echad mitztaref vetame mishshene shemot tahor
Ella may chad shema hu ema sefa aval
b: Hannogea bechachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit tahor
Vei chad shema hu ammay tahor ella kashya resha
Amar rabbi zera betuma retzutza ben shene migdalim askinan veen benehen poteach tefach dechullah negia hi
Uman tanna dekare leohel nogea rabbi yose hi detanya rabbi yose omer melo tarvad rakav metamme bemagga uvmassa uvohel
Bishlama bemassa uvohel ha ka taen leh lechulleh veha ka maahel akkulleh ella nogea ha la naga bechulleh ella lav shema minah may nogea maahil
Veha katane nogea veha katane maahil amar abbaye lematta mittefach ohel negia lemala mittefach ohel gereda
Rava amar afilu lemala mittefach name ohel negia hu vehechi dame ohel gereda behamshacha
Amar rava mena amena lah ditnan rabbi yose omer chavile mitta usrige challonot chotztzin ben habbayit laaliyya shello lehachnis tuma letzad sheni
Perasan al pene hammet baavir hannogea keneged hannekev tame shello keneged hannekev tahor
Hechi dame ilema lematta mittefach shello keneged hannekev ammay tahor met bichsuto hi umet bichsuto metamme
Ella lav lemala mittefach veka kare leh nogea
Amar abbaye leolam lematta mittefach udkaamratte met bichsuto hu met bichsuto mevattel leh hay la mevattel leh
Veteheve ketuma temuna bokaat veola kasavar rabbi yose tuma temuna enah bokaat
Umna temra ditnan tevat hammigdal sheyyesh bah poteach tefach veen bitziatah poteach tefach tuma betochah habbayit tame tuma babbayit ma shebbetochah tahor
Mippene shedderech tuma latzet veen derech tuma likanes
Verabbi yose metaher mippene sheyyachol hu lehotziah lachatzain o lesorfah bimkomah
Vekatane sefa heemidah bappetach ufitchah lachutz tuma betochah habbayit tahor tuma babbayit ma shebbetochah tahor

a: Vetane alah rabbi yose metaher aheya ilema assefa tanna kamma name tahore ka metahar

Ella dekaamar tanna kamma tuma betochah habbayit tame i mishshum dederech tuma latzet vei mishshum detuma temuna bokaat vekaamar leh rabbi yose udkaamratte derech tuma latzet yachol hu lehotziah lachatzain o lesorfah bimkomah udkaamratte tuma temuna bokaat tuma temuna enah bokaat
Verame derabbi yose adderabbi yose
Ditnan hakkelev sheachal basar met umet hakkelev umuttal al haiskuppa rabbi meir omer im yesh betzavaro poteach tefach mevi et hattuma veim lav eno mevi et hattuma
Rabbi yose omer roin mikkeneged hashshakof velifnim habbayit tame mikkeneged hashshekof velachutz habbayit tahor
Rabbi elazar omer piv lifnim habbayit tahor piv lachutz habbayit tame mippene shettuma yotza derech shulav
Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer ben kach uven kach habbayit tame
May lav aen betzavaro poteach tefach kae rabbi yose
Ushma minah tuma temuna bokaat
Amar rava roin et chalal hattuma katane verabbi yose betarte pelig vekaamar leh lerabbi meir dekaamratte ki yesh betzavaro poteach tefach mevi et hattuma anan batar chalalah azlinan
Udka amratte habbayit kullo tame mikkeneged hashshekof velifnim habbayit tame mikkeneged hashshekof velachutz habbayit tahor
Rav acha bereh derava matne lah behedya rabbi yose omer roin et chalal hattuma
Uman tanna diflig aleh rabbi shimon hu detanya rabbi shimon omer
b: Shalosh tumot porshot min hammet shettayim bechol achat ushlishit en bahen veellu hen melo tarvad rakav veetzem kisora vegolel vedofek
Melo tarvad rakav metamme bemassa uvohel veeno metamme bemagga vehechan maggao im achat mehen
Etzem kisora metamme bemassa uvmagga veeno metamme beohel vehechan oholo im achat mehen
Haggolel vedofek metamme bemagga uvohel veeno metamme bemassa vehechan massao im echad mehen
Kulit nevela vekulit hashsheretz vechu tanu rabbanan benivlatah velo bekulit setuma
Yachol afilu nikva talmud lomar hannogea yitma et sheefshar liga tame veet shei efshar liga tahor
Amar leh rabbi zera leabbaye ella meatta behema beorah lo tetamme pok chazi kamma nekavim yesh bah
Amar leh rav pappa lerava ella meatta kulya bechelbah lo tetamme ta chazi kamma chutin nimshachin hemenna
Bae rav oshaya chishev aleha lenokvah velo nikva mahu mechussar nekiva kimchussar maase dame o la
Hadar pashtah mechussar nekiva lav kimchussar maase dame

Matni betzat hashsheretz hamrukkemet tehora nikva kol shehu tame achbar shechetzo basar vechetzo adama hannogea babbasar tame baadama tahor rabbi yehuda omer af hannogea baadama shekkeneged habbasar tame
Gema tanu rabbanan hattemeim lerabbot betzat hashsheretz vekulit hashsheretz
Yachol afilu lo rikma talmud lomar hashsheretz ma sheretz sherikkem af betzat hashsheretz sherikkema
Yachol afilu lo nikvu talmud lomar hannogea yitma et sheefshar liga tame veet shei efshar liga tahor
Vechamma nekivatah kechut hassaara sheefshar liga kechut hassaara

Achbar shechetzo vechu amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi vehu shehishritz al pene kullo ika dematne lah assefa rabbi yehuda omer af hannogea baadama shekkeneged basar tame amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi vehu shehishritz al pene kullo
Man dematne lah aresha kol shekken assefa uman dematne lah assefa aval resha af al gav dela hishritz
Tanu rabbanan mittoch shenneemar achbar shomea ani afilu achbar shebbayyam sheshshemo achbar vedin hu time bechulda vetime beachbar ma chulda min haggadel al haaretz af achbar min haggadel al haaretz
O kelach lederech zo time bechulda vetime beachbar ma chulda kol sheshshemah chulda af achbar kol sheshshemo achbar afilu achbar shebbayyam sheshshemo achbar talmud lomar al haaretz
I al haaretz yachol al haaretz yetamme yarad leyam lo yetamme

a: Talmud lomar hashshoretz kol makom sheshshoretz
O eno ella hashshoretz yachol kol hammashritz yetamme sheen mashritz lo yetamme otzi achbar shechetzo basar vechetzo adama sheen pare verave
Vedin hu time bechulda vetime beachbar ma chulda kol sheshshemah chulda af achbar kol sheshshemo achbar avi achbar shechetzo basar vechetzo adama
O kelach lederech zo ma chulda para verava af achbar pare verave talmud lomar bashsheretz

Amar leh hahu midderabbanan lerava ema bashsheretz leetoye achbar shechetzo basar vechetzo adama hashshoretz kol shehu shoretz vaafilu achbar shebbayyam vei mishshum al haaretz al haaretz yetamme yarad layyam lo yetamme
