Tarte al haaretz ketivi
Tanu rabbanan hatztzav leminehu lehavi hearod vechen hannefilim vesalamandera

Uchshehaya rabbi akiva maggia lefasuk ze omer ma rabbu maasecha Adonai yesh lecha beriyyot gedelot bayyam veyesh lecha beriyyot gedelot bayyabbasha shebbayyam ilmale olot bayyabbasha layyabbasha miyyad metot shebbayyabbasha ilmale yordot layyam miyyad metot
Yesh lecha beriyyot gedelot baur veyesh lecha beriyyot gedelot baavir shebbaur ilmale olot laavir miyyad metot shebbaavir ilmale yordot laur miyyad metot ma rabbu maasecha Adonai
Tanu rabbanan kol sheyyesh bayyabbasha yesh bayyam chutz min hachulda amar rabbi zera may keraa haazinu kol yoshve chaled
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua bivre denaresh enan min hayyishshuv
Amar rav pappa beshamta naresh tarbeh mashkeh vealyeteh eretz eretz aretz shimi devar Adonai amar rav pappa lo ava naresh shemoa devar Adonai
Amar rav gidel amar rav narshaa nashshekach mane kakkach nehar pekodaa laveyach miggelima shappira dechaze alach pumbeditaa laveyach ashni ushpizach
Amar rav huna bar torta paam achat halachti lavaad veraiti nachash shehu karuch al hatztzav leyamim yatza arvad mibbenehem
Uchshebbati lifne rabbi shimon hechasid amar li amar hakkadosh baruch hu hem heviu beriyya shello barati beolami af ani avi alehem beriyya shello barati beolami
Vehaamar mar kol shettashmishan veiburan shave yoldin umgaddelin ze mizze vechol sheen tashmishan veiburan shave en yoldin umgaddelin ze mizze
Amar rav nes betoch nes hay puranuta hu may nes betoch nes lefuranut
Matni haever vehabbasar hamduldalin babbehema metammein tumat ochalin bimkoman utzrichin hechsher
b: Nishchata habbehema huchsheru bedameha divre rabbi meir rabbi shimon omer lo huchsheru
Meta habbehema habbasar tzarich hechsher haever metamme mishshum ever min hachay veeno metamme mishshum ever nevela divre rabbi meir verabbi shimon metaher
Gema tumat ochalin in tumat nevela la
Hechi dame i demaalin arucha afilu tumat ochalin name la litammu vei deen maalin arucha tumat nevela name litammu
Leolam deen maalin arucha veshane tumat nevela derachamana amar ki yippol ad sheyyippol
Tanya name hachi haever vehabbasar hamduldalin bivhema umorin bechut hassaara yachol yetammeu tumat nevela talmud lomar yippol ad sheyyippol vaafilu hachi tumat ochalin metammu
Mesayya leh lerav chiyya bar ashe deamar rav chiyya bar ashe amar shemuel teenim shetztzamku beibehen metammeot tumat ochalin vehattolesh mehen beshabbat chayyav chattat
Lema mesayya leh yerakot shetztzamku beibehen kegon hakkeruv vehaddallaat en metammein tumat ochalin ketzatzan veyibbeshan metammein tumat ochalin
Ketzatzan veyibbeshan salka datach etz bealma hu veamar rabbi yitzchak beal menat leyabbeshan
Tama dichruv vedallaat hu kevan deyibbeshan lav bene achila ninhu ha shear perot metammei
Hechi dame i deyibbeshan hen veuktzehen peshita ella lav belo uktzehen
Leolam hen veuktzehen uktzatzan al menat leyabbeshan itztericha leh
Ta shema ilan shennifshach uvo perot hare hen kitlushin yavshu hare hen kimchubbarin may lav ma telushin lechol divrehen af mechubbarin lechol divrehen
Mide irya ha kidita veha kidita
Nishchata habbehema vechu bemay ka mipalgi
Amar rabba bivhema naaset yad leever kamipalgi mar savar en behema naaset yad leever umar savar behema naaset yad leever
Abbaye amar beochez bekatan veen gadol ole immo kamipalgi
Mar savar ochez bekatan veen gadol ole immo hare hu kamohu umar savar eno kamohu
Veaf rabbi yochanan savar beochez bekatan veen gadol ole immo ka mipalgi
Derabbi yochanan rame derabbi meir adderabbi meir mi amar rabbi meir ochez bekatan veen gadol ole immo hare hu kamohu
Urminhu ochel shennifras umore bemiktzat

a: Rabbi meir omer im ochez bakkatan vegadol ole immo hare hu kamohu veim lav eno kamohu
Veamar rabbi yochanan muchlefet hashshita
Umay kushya dilma shane leh lerabbi meir ben tevul yom lishar tumot
Tanya rabbi omer echad tevul yom veechad shear tumot
Vedilma lerabbi la shane leh ulrabbi meir shane leh
Amar rabbi yoshiyya hachi amar rabbi yochanan ledivre rabbi muchlefet hashshita
Rava amar beyesh yad letuma veen yad lehechsher kamipalgi
Mar savar yesh yad letuma veen yad lehechsher umar savar yesh yad letuma ulhechsher
Rav pappa amar behechsher kodem machshava kamipalgi
Ditnan amar rabbi yehuda kach haya rabbi akiva shone chelev shechuta bakkefarim tzarich machshava veen tzarich hechsher shekkevar huchshar bashshechita
Amarti lefanav limmadtanu rabbenu ulshin shellikketan vehiddichan labbehema venimlach alehen laadam tzerichot hechsher sheni vechazar rabbi akiva lihot shone kerabbi yehuda

Rav acha bereh derav ika amar benitkanneach haddam ben siman lesiman kamipalgi
Mar savar yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof vehay dam shechita hu umar savar enah lishchita ella lesof vehay dam makka hu
Rav ashe amar bishchita machsheret velo dam kamipalgi
Bae rabba behema bechayyeha mahu shettease yad leever teku
Amar abbaye hare amru kishut shennetaah beatzitz vehigdila veyatzat chutz leatzitz tehora
Amar rabbi shimon vechi ma tivah letaher ella hattame betumato vetahor betohorato
Bae abbaye mahu shettease yad lachavertah teku

b: Mahu shettease yad lachavertah teku

Bae rav pappa mahu sheyyease yad lachavero teku
Amar rabbi zera hare amru even shebbazzavit keshehu choletz choletz et kullah uchshehu notetz notetz et shello umanniach et shel chavero
Bae rabbi zera mahu shettease yad lachavertah teku
Meta habbehema may ika ben ever min hachay leever shel min hannevela
Ika benayehu basar happoresh mimmennu meever behema deilu basar happoresh meever min hachay lo metamme meever min hannevela metamme
Ever min hachay dimtamme may kera amar rav yehuda amar rav vechi yamut min habbehema

Vehay mibe leh lichidach derav yehuda amar rav deamar rav yehuda amar rav veamri lah bematnita tana vechi yamut min habbehema miktzat behema metammea umiktzat behema enah metammea veezo zo zo terefa sheshshechatah
Im ken lichtov rachamana mibbehema may min habbehema shema minah tarte

I hachi afilu basar name la salka datach detanya yachol yehe basar happoresh min hachay tame talmud lomar vechi yamut min habbehema ma mita sheenah osa chalifin af kol sheeno ose chalifin divre rabbi yose
Rabbi akiva omer behema ma behema gidim vaatzamot af kol gidim vaatzamot rabbi omer behema ma behema basar gidim vaatzamot af kol basar gidim vaatzamot
May ika ben rabbi lerabbi akiva ika benayehu archubba
Ben rabbi akiva lerabbi yose haggelili may ika benayehu amar rav pappa kulya veniv sefatayim ika benayehu
Tanya name gabbe sheratzim kehay gavena yachol basar happoresh min hashsheratzim yehe tame talmud lomar bemotam ma mita sheenah osa chalifin af kol sheenah osa chalifin divre rabbi yose haggelili
Rabbi akiva omer sheretz ma sheretz gidim vaatzamot af kol gidim vaatzamot rabbi omer sheretz ma sheretz basar gidim vaatzamot af kol basar gidim vaatzamot
Ben rabbi lerabbi akiva ika benayehu archubba ben rabbi akiva lerabbi yose haggelili may ika benayehu amar rav pappa kulya veniv sefatayim ika benayehu
Utzricha dei ashmeinan behema hayenu tama delo metamme mechayyim mishshum delo metamme bechaadasha aval sheretz dimtamme bechaadasha ema letamme mechayyim
Vei ashmeinan sheretz mishshum dela metamme bemassa lo metamme mechayyim aval behema dimtamme bemassa ema tetamme mechayyim tzericha
Tanu rabbanan hachotech kezayit basar meever min hachay chatacho veachar kach chishev alav tahor
Chishev alav veachar kach chatacho tame
Rabbi assi la al leve midresha ashkecheh lerabbi zera amar leh may amur beve midresha amar leh may kashya lach amar leh dekatane chishev veachar kach chatacho tame

a: Tumat bet hassetarim hi vetumat bet hassetarim la metammeya
Amar leh af ledidi kashya li ushelteh lerabbi abba bar memel veamar li ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar tumat bet hassetarim metammeya
Amar leh velav zimnin saggiin amrah kammay vaamari leh shane leh lerabbi meir ben tuma devaaya hechsher uven tuma dela baaya hechsher
Amar rava umay kushya dilma beshehuchshar

Amar leh kesheshshimesh maase etz shimesh
Amar abbaye hare amru kofet seor sheyyichadah lishiva batla
Tumatah lav deorayeta dei salka datach deorayeta matzinu laochalin shemmetammein tuma chamura kesheshshimesh maase etz shimesh
Amar abbaye hare amru tikrovet avoda zara shel ochalin metammein beohel tumatah lav deorayeta dei salka datach deorayeta matzinu laochalin shemmetammein tuma chamura kesheshshimesh maase etz shimesh
Amar abbaye hare amru chibbure ochalin kechelim damu tumatan lav deorayeta dei salka datach deorayeta matzinu leochel shemmetamme tuma chamura kesheshshimesh maase etz shimesh
Amar leh rav pappa lerava ha detanya chelev nevela bakkefarim tzarich machshava vehechsher tumato aggav kulya lav deorayeta dei salka datach deorayeta matzinu leochel shemmetamme tuma chamura
Kesheshshimesh maase etz shimesh
Amar rav matna hare amru bayit shessikkecho bizraim taheru tumato lav deorayeta dei salka datach deorayeta matzinu lizraim shemmetammein tuma chamura kesheshshimesh maase etz shimesh
Rabbi shimon metaher
Ma nafshach i mita osa nipul litamme mishshum ever min hachay i en mita osa nipul litamme mishshum ever min hannevela
Rabbi shimon aresha kae haever vehabbasar hamduldalin bivhema metamme tumat ochalin bimkoman utzrichin hechsher verabbi shimon metaher
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan may tama derabbi shimon amar kera mikkol haochel asher yeachel ochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim karuy ochel ochel shei atta yachol lehaachilo
b: Laacherim en karuy ochel
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi dilma tama derabbi shimon hatam hoil umore meore

Detanya yichur shel teena shennifshach umore bakkelipa rabbi yehuda metaher vachachamim omrim im yachol lichot tahor veim lav tame veamrinan lach may tama derabbi yehuda veamratte lan hoil umore meore
Amar leh ammetziata nishchata habbehema huchshera bedameha divre rabbi meir rabbi shimon omer lo huchsheru

Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan may tama derabbi shimon amar kera mikkol haochel asher yeachel ochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim karuy ochel ochel sheen atta yachol lehaachilo laacherim en karuy ochel
Vedilma tama derabbi shimon behahi
I kidrava i kidrabbi yochanan
Ella leolam assefa velav aever ella abbasar meta habbehema habbasar tzarich hechsher verabbi shimon metaher
Amar rabbi yochanan may tama derabbi shimon amar kera mikkol haochel asher yeachel ochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim karuy ochel ochel shei atta yachol lehaachilo laacherim en karuy ochel
Matni haever vehabbasar hamduldalin beadam tehorim met haadam habbasar tahor haever metamme mishshum ever min hachay veeno metamme mishshum ever min hammet divre rabbi meir verabbi shimon metaher
Gema verabbi shimon ma nafshach i mita osa nipul litamme mishshum ever min hachay vei en mita osa nipul litamme mishshum ever min hammet

Rabbi shimon bealma kae dekaamar tanna kamma haever metamme mishshum ever min hachay veen metamme mishshum ever min hammet alma ever hammet bealma metamme vaamar leh rabbi shimon ever hammet bealma lo metamme

Detanya amar rabbi eliezer shamati sheever min hachay metamme amar lo rabbi yehoshua min hachay velo min hammet vekal vachomer uma chay shehu tahor ever happoresh mimmennu tame met shehu tame lo kol shekken
Katuv bimgilat taanit pischa zeira dela lemispad ha rabba lemispad ella kal dechen hacha name kol dechen amar leh kach shamati
Umay ika ben ever min hachay leever min hammet kezayit basar veetzem kisora happoresh meever min hachay ika benayehu

Ditnan kezayit basar happoresh meever min hachay rabbi eliezer metamme verabbi nechunya ben hakkana verabbi yehoshua metaharin etzem kisora happoresh meever min hachay rabbi nechunya metamme rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua metaharin
Hashta deatet lehachi ben tanna kamma lerabbi shimon name kezayit basar veetzem kisora ika benayehu
Hadaran alach haor veharotev

a: Matni hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagin baaretz uvchutza laaretz bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit bachullin aval lo bammukdashin
Shehaya baddin uma im hachullin sheenan chayyavim bechaze vashok chayyavim bemattanot kadashim shechayyavim bechaze vashok eno din shechayyavim bemattanot
Talmud lomar vaetten otam leaharon hakkohen ulvanav lechok olam en lo ella ma sheamur bainyan
Kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin babbechora uvammattanot veotzin lechullin lehiggazez ulheaved uveladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidonan
Vehashshochatan bachutz patur veen osin temura veim metu yippadu chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser
Kol shekkadam hekdeshan et muman o mum over kodem lehekdeshan ulachar mikkan nolad lahem mum kavua venifdu peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot veenan yotzin lechullin lehiggazez ulheaved
Uveladan vachalavan asur leachar pidonan vehashshochatan bachutz chayyav veosin temura veim metu yikkaveru
Gema tama dichtav rachamana otam ha lav hachi hava amena kadashim chayyavin bemattanot
Ika lemifrach ma lechullin shekken chayyavin bivchora
Tete mizzecharim ma lizcharim shekken chayyavin bereshit haggez
Mitteyashim ma lityashim shekken nichnasin laddir lehitasser
Mizzekenim ma lizkenim shekken nichnesu ledir lehitasser
Millakuach veyatom ma lelakuach veyatom shekken nichnasin beminan laddir lehitasser
Beminan kaamratte kodashim name beminan nichnasin laddir lehitasser
Veyihu chullin chayyavin bechaze vashok mikkal vachomer uma kadashim sheen chayyavim bemattanot chayyavin bechaze vashok chullin shechayyavin bemattanot eno din shechayyavin bechaze vashok
Amar kera veze yihye mishpat hakkohanim ze in mide acharina la
Ella tama dichtav rachamana ze ha lav hachi hava amena chullin chayyavin bechaze vashok veha bae tenufa hecha linufinhu i abbaray lifne Adonai ketiv
b: I aggavay ka meayyel chullin laazara hilkach la efshar
Ella ze lema li lechidrav chisda deamar rav chisda hammazzik mattenot kehunna o sheachalan patur milleshallem
Gufa amar rav chisda hammazzik mattenot kehunna o sheachalan patur milleshallem may tama ibaet ema dichtiv ze veibaet ema mishshum dehave leh mamon sheen lo tovim
Metivi veze yihye mishpat hakkohanim melammed shehammattanot din lemay hilcheta lav lehotzian bedayyanin la lecholkan bedayyanin

Vechidrav shemuel bar nachmani deamar rav shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan minnayin sheen notnin mattana lechohen am haaretz shenneemar vayyomer laam leoshve yerushalim latet menat lakkohanim velalviyyim lemaan yechezku betorat Adonai kol hammachzik betorat Adonai yesh lo menat vesheeno machazik betorat Adonai en lo menat
Ta shema rabbi yehuda ben betera omer mishpat melammed shehammattanot din yachol afilu chaze vashok din talmud lomar ze
Lemay ilema lecholko bedayyanin attu chaze vashok lav bedayyanin michalleku ella lav lehotzio bedayyanin
Hacha bemay askinan daato lideh i daato lideh may lememra daato lideh betivlayehu vekasavar hay tanna mattanot shello hurmu kemi shehurmu damyan
Ta shema baal habbayit shehaya over mimmakom lemakom vetzarich litol leket shichcha ufea umasar ani notel velichsheyyachzor yeshallem divre rabbi eliezer
Amar rav chisda middat chasidut shanu kan amar rava tanna tane yeshallem veatte amratte middat chasidut shanu kan veod midderabbi eliezer lekum velotev
Ella missefa vachachamim omrim ani haya beotah shaa tama deani ha ashir meshallem
Ammay leheve kemazzik mattenot kehunna o sheachalan amar rav chisda middat chasidut shanu kan

Ta shema minnayin levaal habbayit sheachal perotav tevalin vechen levi sheachal maserotav tevalim minnayin sheppatur min hattashlumin talmud lomar velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael asher yarimu en lecha bahen ella mishsheat harama veelach
Ha mishsheat harama veelach miha meshallem ammay leheve kemazzik mattenot kehunna o sheachalan hacha name

a: Daato lideh betivlayehu vekasavar hay tanna mattanot shello hurmu kemi shehurmu damyan
Ta shema hare sheansu bet hammelech gorno im bechovo chayyav leasser im beanparut patur milleasser
Shane hatam deka mishtarshi leh
Ta shema amar lo mechor li bene meeha shel para vehaya bahen mattenot kehunna notnan lakkohen veeno menakke lo min haddamim lakach hemennu bemishkal notnan lakkohen umnakke lo min haddamim
Ammay leheve kemazzik mattenot kehunna o sheachalan shane hatam deitanhu beenayehu
Ta shema tisha nichse chohen teruma utrumat maaser vechalla reshit haggez umattanot vehaddemay vehabbikkurim vehakkeren vehachomesh
Lemay lav lehotzian bedayyanin la lichditnan lama amru nichse chohen shekkone bahen avadim vekarkaot uvhema temea uvaal chov notlan bechovo veishsha bichtubbatah vesefer tora
Hahu levaa dahava chatef mattenata ato amaru leh lerav amar lehu la missatyeh dela shaklinan mineh ella michtaf name chatef
Verav i ikro am mishkal name lishkol minayehu i la ikro am rachamana patrinhu
Mesappeka leh i ikro am i la ikro am

Yatev rav pappa vekaamar lah leha shemata etiveh rav idi bar avin lerav pappa arba mattenot aniyyim shebbakkerem happeret vehaolelot vehashshichcha vehappea veshalosh shebbattevua halleket vehashshichcha vehappea shenayim shebbailan hashshichcha vehappea
Kullan en bahem tovat hanaa labbealim vaafilu ani shebbeyisrael motziin miyyado

Masar ani hammitchallek betoch beto yesh bo tovat hanaa labbealim vaafilu ani shebbeyisrael motziin oto miyyado ushar mattenot kehunna kegon hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva en motziin otan miyyado lo mikkohen lechohen velo millevi lelevi
Arba mattanot shebbakkerem happeret vehaolelot vehashshichcha vehappea dichtiv vecharmecha lo teolel uferet karmecha lo telakket
Uchtiv ki tivtzor karmecha lo teolel acharecha amar rabbi levi acharecha zo shichcha
Pea gamar acharecha acharecha mizzayit dichtiv ki tachbot zetcha lo tefaer acharecha vetana deve rabbi yishmael shello tittol tifarto mimmennu
Shelosha shebbattevua halleket
b: Hashshichcha vehappea dichtiv uvkutzrechem et ketzir artzechem lo techalle peat sadcha bekutzrecha veleket ketzircha vego ki tiktzor ketzircha vesadecha veshachachta omer bassade
Shenayim shebbailan hashshichcha vehappea dichtiv ki tachbot zetcha lo tefaer acharecha vetana deve rabbi yishmael shello tittol tifarto mimmennu acharecha zo shichcha
Vechullan en bahen tovat hanaa livalim may tama aziva ketiva behu
Vaafilu ani shebbeyisrael motziin oto miyyado dichtiv veleket ketzircha lo telakket leani velagger taazov otam lehazhir ani al shello
Umasar ani hammitchallek betoch habbayit yesh bo tovat hanaa labbealim may tama netina ketiva beh
Vaafilu ani shebbeyisrael motziin oto miyyado deamar rabbi ila gamar lagger lagger mehatam ma lehallan muzhar ani al shello af kan muzhar ani al shello
Ushar mattenot kehunna kegon hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva en motziin otan lo mikkohen lechohen velo millevi lelevi ha millevi lechohen motziin alma ikru am
Kegon hazzeroa velo zeroa umay nihu maaser rishon
Maaser rishon delevi hu kerabbi elazar ben azarya detanya teruma lakkohen maaser rishon lallevi divre rabbi akiva rabbi elazar ben azarya omer af lakkohen
Emar deamar rabbi elazar ben azarya af lakkohen lakkohen velo lallevi mi amar in levatar dekansinhu ezra
Emar dekansinhu ezra dela yahavinan lehu mishkal minayehu mi amar ella kegon zeroa velo zeroa umay nihu reshit haggez

Ta shema ze hakkelal kol davar shehu bikdushsha kegon teruma utrumat maaser vechalla motziin otan miyyadam vechol davar sheeno bikdushsha kegon hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva en motziin oto miyyadam
Kegon zeroa velo zeroa umay nihu maaser rishon ulvatar dekansinhu ezra
Ta shema hashshochet lechohen ulgoy patur min hammattanot ha lelevi ulyisrael chayyav la tema ha lelevi ulyisrael chayyav ella ema ha leyisrael chayyav
Aval lelevi may patur i hachi litne hashshochet lallevi velaggoy patur min hammattanot veod ha tanya hashshochet lakkohen velaggoy patur min hammattanot lallevi ulyisrael chayyav teuvta derav
Amar lecha rav tannae hi detanya vechipper et mikdash hakkodesh ze lifnay velifnim
Ohel moed ze hechal mizbeach kemashmao yechapper ellu azarot kohanim kemashmao am hakkahal ellu yisrael yechapper ellu halviyyim
Vetanya idach yechapper ellu avadim may lav beha kamipalgi demar savar ikro am umar savar la ikro am
Verav i sevira leh kehay tanna lema vei sevira leh kehay tanna lema mesappeka leh i kehay tanna i kehay tanna
Derash marimar hilcheta kevateh derav vehilcheta kevateh derav chisda
Ulla hava yahev mattenata lechahanta etiveh rava leulla minchat kohenet neechelet minchat kohen enah neechelet
Vei amratte kohen vaafilu kohenet vehachtiv vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel amar leh rabbi

a: Mittunach aharon uvanav ketuvin bapparasha
Deve rabbi yishmael tana kohen velo kohenet veyilmod satum min hamforash
Deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov tana kohen vaafilu kohenet have miut achar miut veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot
Rav kahana achal bishvil ishto rav pappa achal bishvil ishto rav yemar achal bishvil ishto rav idi bar avin achal bishvil ishto
Amar ravina amar li marimar hilcheta kevateh derav vehilcheta kevateh derav chisda vehilcheta kevateh deulla
Vehilcheta kevateh derav adda bar ahava leviyya sheyyalda benah patur mechamesh selaim

Tanu rabbanan hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagim bechilayim uvchoy rabbi eliezer omer kilayim habba min haez umin harachel chayyav bemattanot min hattayish umin hatztzeviyya patur min hammattanot
Mikkede kayema lan dilinyan kissuy haddam umattanot la mashkachatte leh ella bitzvi habba al hatteyasha uven lerabbi eliezer ben lerabbanan mesappeka lehu i choshshin lezera haav i en choshshin
Uvse vaafilu miktzat se kamipalgi mar savar se vaafilu miktzat se umar savar se vaafilu miktzat se la amrinan

Bishlama rabbi eliezer defatar kasavar se velo miktzat se ella lerabbanan nehi name dekasavri se vaafilu miktzat se palga lishkol veidach palga lema leh ayeti reaya deen choshshin lezera haav ushkol amar rav huna bar chiyya may chayyav name deka amar chayyav bachatzi mattanot
Metiv rabbi zera koy yesh bo derachim shavin labbehema veyesh bo derachim shavin lachayya veyesh bo derachim shavin lachayya velabbehema

Ketzad chelbo asur kachalev behema vedamo chayyav lechassot kedam hachayya derachim shavin labbehema velachayya sheddamo vegido asurin kivhema vechayya vechayyav bizroa ulchayayim vehakkeva verabbi eliezer poter
Veim ita chayyav bachatzi mattanot mibbee leh ayede ditna chelbo vedamo dela mittene chatzi chatzi mishshum hachi la ka tane chatzi
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan koy lerabbanan chayyav bechullehu mattanot detanya shor ma talmud lomar im shor lerabbot et hakkilayim se ma talmud lomar im se lerabbot et hakkoy
Verabbi eliezer hay im lema li mibe leh lechallek verabbanan lechallek mena lehu nafka lehu meet zovche hazzevach
Verabbi eliezer hay meet zovche hazzevach may aved leh mibbee leh lechidrava deamar rava haddin im hattabbach
Matni bechor shennitarev bemea bizman shemmea shochatin et kullan potrim et kullan echad shochet et kullan potrim lo echad
Hashshochet lakkohen velaggoy patur min hammattanot vehammishtattef immahen tzarich sheyyirshom veim amar chutz min hammattanot patur min hammattanot
Amar mechor li bene meeha shel para vehau bahen mattanot notnan lakkohen veeno menakke lo min haddamim lekachan hemennu bemishkal notnan lakkohen umnakke lo min haddamim
Gema veammay yavo alav kohen mishshene tzedadin velema leh i bechor hu kulleh didi hu vei lav bechor hu hav li mattenatay
b: Amar rav oshaya beva lide kohen umcharo leyisrael bemumo
Hashshochet lakkohen velaggoy patur min hammattanot velitne kohen vegoy peturin min hammattanot amar rava zot omeret haddin im hattabbach
Daresh rava meet haam velo meet hakkohanim keshehu omer meet zovche hazzevach heve omer afilu tabbach kohen bammashma
Ushpizchaneh derabbi tavla kohen hava vahava dechik leh milleta ata lekammeh derabbi tavla amar leh zil ishtattaf bahade tabbache yisrael demiggo demippatri mimmattenata mishtattefi bahadach
Chayeveh rav nachman amar leh veha rabbi tavla patran amar leh zil appek vei la mappekna lach rabbi tavla meunnach

Azal rabbi tavla kammeh derav nachman amar leh may tama aved mar hachi amar leh dechi ata rabbi acha bar chanina middaroma amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi zikne darom amru kohen tabbach shettayim veshalosh shabbatot patur min hammattanot mikkan veelach chayyav bemattanot
Amar leh velaaved leh mar mihat kerabbi acha bar chanina amar leh hane mile dela keva mesachta aval hacha ha keva mesachta
Amar rav chisda hay kahana dela mafresh mattenata leheve beshamta deelahe yisrael amar rabba bar rav shela hane tabbache dehutzal kayemi beshamta derav chisda ha esrim vetarte shenin

Lemay hilcheta ilema detu la meshammetinan lehu veha tanya bamme devarim amurim bemitzvat lo taase aval bemitzvat ase kegon omrim lo ase sukka veeno ose lulav veeno ose ase tzitzit veeno ose makkin oto ad shettetze nafsho
Ella dekansinan lehu bela atrayeta ki ha derava kanes atma rav nachman bar yitzchak kanes gelima
Veamar rav chisda zeroa leechad vekeva leechad lechayayim lishnayim ini veha ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef amar bemareva palginan lehu garma garma
Hatam bidtora

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan asur leechol mibbehema shello hurma mattenoteha amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol haochel mibbehema shello hurma mattenoteha keilu ochel tevalim velet hilcheta kevateh
Amar rav chisda mattenot kehunna en neechalot ella tzali veen neechalot ella bechardal may tama amar kera lemoshcha ligdulla kederech shehammelachim ochlim

Veamar rav chisda esrim vearba mattenot kehunna kol kohen sheeno baki bahen en notnin lo mattana velav milta hi detanya rabbi shimon omer kol kohen sheeno mode baavoda en lo chelek bakkehunna shenneemar hammakriv et dam hashshelamim veet hachelev mibbene aharon lo tihye shok hayyamin lemana
En li ella ze bilvad minnayin lerabbot chamesh esre avodot kegon hayetzikot vehabbelilot vehappetitot vehammelichot tenufot vehaggashot vehakkemitzot haktarot vehammetziyyot vehammelikot

a: Vekabbalot hazzaot vehashkaat sota vaarifat egla arufa vetohorat metzora unsiut kappayim ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz talmud lomar mibbene aharon avoda haamura livne aharon
Vechol kohen sheeno mode bah en lo chelek bakkehunna tama deeno mode bah ha mode bah af al gav deeno baki bahen
Amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav chutin shebballechi asurim vechol kohen sheeno yodea litlan en notnin lo mattana
Vela hi i betaveya medav dayevi vei lekidra i dimchattech lehu umalach lehu medav dayevi
Amar rava badak lan rav yosef hay kahana dechatef mattenata chabbove ka mechabbev mitzva o zalzole ka mezalzel bemitzva ufshatna leh venatan velo sheyyittol meatzmo

Amar abbaye meresh hava chatefna mattenata amena chabbove ka mechabbevna mitzva kevan dishmana leha venatan velo sheyyittol meatzmo michtaf la chatefna memar amari amena havu li vechevan dishmana leha detanya vayyittu achare habbatza rabbi meir omer bene shemuel chelkam shaalu befihem memar name la amena vei yahavu li shakelna
Kevan dishmana leha detanya hatztzenuim moshchin et yedehem vehaggargeranim cholkim mishkal name la shakelna levar mimmaale yoma dechipure leachzoke nafshay bechahane
Velifros yedeh anseh leh idaneh
Amar rav yosef hay kahana deit leh tzurba merabbanan beshivavuteh udchika leh milta lizakke leh mattenata veaf al gav dela ate lideh bemakkare kehunna ulviyya

Rava verav safra iklau leve mar yochana bereh derav chana bar adda veamri lah leve mar yochana bereh derav chana bar bizna aved lehu igla tilta amar leh rava leshammaeh zakki lan mattenata divena lemechal lishana bechardela
Zakki leh rava achal verav safra la achal akreuh lerav safra bechelma maade beged beom kara chometz al nater veshar bashshirim al lev ra
Ata lekammeh derav yosef amar leh dilma mishshum daavari ashshemata demar akreyun hachi amar leh ki amari ana beacher shammaa beal kurcheh mezakke vechi amari ana leman dela efshar leh ha efshar leh
Veella may tama akreyun hachi kelappe rava velakreuh lerava rava nazuf hava
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi ufshateh dikra bemay ketiv amar leh beshone letalmid sheeno hagun

Deamar rav yehuda amar rav kol hashshone letalmid sheeno hagun nofel begehinnam shenneemar kol choshech tamun litzpunav teochlehu esh lo nuppach yera sarid beoholo veen sarid ella talmid chacham shenneemar uvasseridim asher Adonai kore
Amar rabbi zera amar rav kol hashshone letalmid sheeno hagun kezorek even lemerkulis shenneemar kitzror even bemargema ken noten lichsil kavod uchtiv lo nave lichsil taanug
Vehammishtattef immahen tzarich lirshom vaafilu im haggoy urminhu hammishtattef im kohen tzarich lirshom vehammishtattef im haggoy ufsule hammukdashim en tzarich lirshom
b: Hacha bemay askinan deyatev goy ammesachta
Dichvatah gabbe chohen deyatev ammesachta ammay tzarich lirshom deamri bisra ka zaven i hachi goy name amri bisra ka zaven
Ella hacha bemay askinan deyatev goy akkaspeta dichvatah gabbe kohen deyatev akkaspeta ammay tzarich lirshom amri hemone hemneh goy name amri hemone hemneh
En emuna begoy ibaet ema setam goy mippea pae
Amar mar ufsule hammukdashin en tzarich lirshom alma mochcha milleta veha anan tenan pesule hammukdashin nimkarim baitliz venishchatim baitliz venishkalim belitra
Targema rav adda bar ahava kammeh derav pappa beotan hannimkarim betoch habbayit
Amar rav huna shuttaf barosh patur min hallechi shuttaf bayyad patur min hazzeroa shuttaf bivne meayin patur min hakkeva vechiyya bar rav amar afilu shuttaf beachat mehen patur mikkullan

Metivi harosh shelli vechullah shellach vaafilu echad mimmea barosh patur hayyad shelli vechullah shellach afilu echad mimmea bayyad patur bene meayin shelli vechullah shellach afilu echad mimmea bahen patur
May lav patur min hallechi vechayyav bechullan patur min hazzeroa vechayyav bechullan patur min hakkeva vechayyav bechullan la patur mikkullan
Velitne patur mikkullan veod tanya harosh shelli vechullah shellach afilu echad mimmea barosh patur min hallechi vechayyav bechullan teuvta dechiyya bar rav teuvta
Amar rav chisda ha matnita atiteh lechiyya bar rav detanya esrim vearba mattenot kehunna hen vechullan nitnu leaharon ulvanav bichlal ufrat uvrit melach
Kal hamkayeman keilu kiyyem bichlal ufrat uvrit melach vechol haover alehen keilu over al bichlal ufrat uvrit melach

Veellu hen eser bammikdash vearba birushalayim veeser baggevulim eser bammikdash chattat vechattat haof asham vadday veasham taluy vezivche shalme tzibbur velog shemen shel metzora ushte hallechem velechem happanim ushyare menachot uminchat haomer
Vearba birushalayim habbechora vehabbikkurim umuram min hattoda umeel nazir veorot kadashim
Veeser baggevulim teruma utrumat maaser vechalla vereshit haggez umattanot ufidon habben ufidon peter chamor
Usde achuzza usde charamim vegezel hagger

Hu savar middeka chashev lehu lemattanot bachada chada ninhu vela hi attu muram mittoda veel nazir deka chashev lehu kachada mishshum dachada ninhu ella kevan dedamyan lahadade chashev lehu kachada hachi name kevan dedamyan lahadade chashiv lehu kachada
Ibaya lehu harosh shellecha vechullah shelli mahu batar chiyyuva azlinan vechiyyuva gabbe yisrael hu o dilma batar ikar behema azlinan veikar behema dechohen hu
Ta shema goy vechohen shemmasru tzonam leyisrael ligzoz patur hallokeach gez tzono shel goy patur mereshit haggez
Veze chomer bizroa uvallechayayim uvkeva yoter mereshit haggez shema minah batar chiyyuva azlinan shema minah
Veim amar lo chutz min hammattanot patur min hammattanot

a: Urminhu al menat shehammattanot shelli noten lechol kohen sheyyirtze
Al menat achutz ka ramet chutz shiyyura al menat lav shiyyura
Urminhu al menat shehammattanot shelli hammattanot shello beha peligi mar savar al menat shiyyura hu umar savar al menat lav shiyyura hu
Amar lo mechor li bene meeha vechu amar rav lo shanu ella sheshshakal leatzmo aval shakal lo tabbach haddin im hattabbach verav assi amar afilu shakal lo tabbach haddin immo
Lema bidrav chisda ka mipalgi deamar rav chisda gazal velo nityaashu habbealim uva acher vaachalo ratza mizze gove ratza mizze gove demar it leh derav chisda umar let leh derav chisda
La dechulle alma it lehu derav chisda vehacha bemattenot kehunna nigzalot ka mipalgi demar savar nigzalot umar savar en nigzalot
Ika dematne lah leha shemata bifne atzmah rav amar mattenot kehunna nigzalot verav assi amar mattenot kehunna en nigzalot
Matni ger shennitgayyer vehayeta lo para nishchata ad shello nitgayyer patur mishshennitgayyer chayyav safek patur shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Gema ki ata rav dimi amar rame leh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan tenan safek patur alma sefeka lekulla
Urminhu chore hannemalim shebbetoch hakkama hare ellu shel baal habbayit veshelleachar hakkotzrim haelonim laaniyyim vehattachtonim shel baal habbayit
Rabbi meir omer hakkol laaniyyim shessefek leket leket
Amar leh al takniteni shebbilshon yachid ani shone otah detanya rabbi yehuda ben agra omer mishshum rabbi meir sefek leket leket sefek shichcha shichcha sefek pea pea
Amar lo al tishne otah ella bilshon ben taddal veha tama kaamar deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish may dichtiv ani varash hatzdiku may hatzdiku
Ilema bedinim veha ketiv vedal lo tehdar berivo ella tzaddek mishshellecha veten lo
Amar rava hacha para bechezkat petura kayema kama bechezkat chiyyuva kayema
Amar leh abbaye vahare isa naaset ad shello nitgayyer patur min hachalla mishshennitgayyer chayyav safek chayyav
Amar leh sefek isura lechumra sefek mamona lekulla
Daamar rav chisda vechen tane rabbi chiyya shemona sefekot neemru bagger arba lechiyyuv vearba liftur
Korban ishto vechalla uvchor behema temea uvchor behema tehora lechiyyuv
b: Reshit haggez vehammattanot ufidon habben ufidon peter chamor liftur
Ki ata ravin amar kama akkama remi leh
Levi zera bechishar vela hao aniyyim lemishkal leket ata lekammeh derav sheshet amar leh leani velagger taazov otam velo leorvim velo laatallefim
Metivi en meviin teruma lo miggoren lair velo mimmidbar layyishshuv veim en sham kohen socher para umviah mippene hefsed teruma
Shane teruma detavla vela saggi dela mafresh lah
Vahare mattanot dela tavli vetanya makom shennahagu limlog baagalim lo yafshit et hazzeroa
Lehafshit et harosh lo yafshit et hallechi veim en sham kohen maalin otan bedamim veochlan mippene hefsed kohen
Shane mattenot kehunna dintina ketiva beh hashta deatet lehachi teruma name netina ketiva beh
Veella taazov yattira lema li
Lechidtanya hammafkir et karmo velashshachar hishkim uvtzaro chayyav beferet uvolelot uvshichcha uvfea ufatur min hammaasrot
Hahu sakka dedinare daata leve midresha kadem rabbi amme uzcha bahen vehechi aved hachi veha ketiv venatan velo sheyyittol meatzmo rabbi amme name laaniyyim zacha bahen
Veibaet ema adam chashuv shane detanya vehakkohen haggadol meechav sheyehe gadol meechav benoy bechachma uvosher
Acherim omrim minnayin sheim en lo sheechav hakkohanim megaddelin oto talmud lomar vehakkohen haggadol meechav gaddelehu mishshel echav

Matni ezehu hazzeroa min happerek shel archubba ad kaf shel yad vehu shel nazir uchnegdo baregel shok rabbi yehuda omer shok min happerek shel archubba ad sovech shel regel e zehu lechi min happerek shel lechi ad pika shel gargeret
Gema tanu rabbanan hazzeroa ze zeroa yamin atta omer ze zeroa yamin o eno ella zeroa semol talmud lomar hazzeroa
May talmuda kidamar rava hayyarech hamummenet shebbayyarech hacha name hazzeroa hamumman shebbazzeroa

Vehallechayayim lemay ata lehavi tzemer shebberosh kevasim vesear shebbizkan teyashim vehakkeva lemay ata lehavi chelev sheal gabbe hakkeva vechelev shebbetoch hakkeva deamar rabbi yehoshua kohanim nahagu bo ayin yafa untanuhu labbealim tama denahagu ha lo nahagu dideh hu
Dorshe chamurot hau omrim hazzeroa keneged hayyad vechen hu omer vayyikkach romach beyado
Ulchayayim keneged tefilla vechen hu omer vayyaamod pinchas vayefallel keva kemishmaah vechen hu omer veet haishsha el kovatah
Vetanna mayete lah mehacha shok hayyamin en li ella shok hayyamin zeroa mukdashin minnayin talmud lomar teruma zeroa chullin minnayin talmud lomar tittenu
Ezehu lechi min happerek shel lechi vead pika shel gargeret vehatanya notlah uvet shechita immah
La kashya ha rabbanan veha rabbi chanina ben antignos
Detanya mugremet pesula heid rabbi chanina ben antignos al mugremet shehi keshera
Ibaet ema ha veha rabbanan umay immah immah divhema
Hadaran alach hazzeroa vehallechayayim

a: Matni reshit haggez noheg baaretz uvchutza laaretz bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit bachullin aval lo bammukdashim
Chomer bazzeroa ulchayayim uvakkeva mereshit haggez shehazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagin babbakar uvatztzon bimrubbe uvmuat vereshit haggez eno noheg ella birchelot veeno noheg ella bimrubbe
Vechamma hu merubbe bet shammay omrim shette rechelot shenneemar yechayye ish eglat bakar ushte tzon uvet hillel omrim chamesh shenneemar chamesh tzon asuot
Rabbi dosa ben harkinas omer chamesh rechelot gozzot mane mane ufras chayyavot bereshit haggez vachachamim omrim chamesh rechelot gozzot kol shehen
Vechamma notnin lo mishkal chamesh selaim bihuda shehen eser selaim baggalil melubban velo tzoi kede laasot mimmennu beged katan shenneemar titten lo sheyehe bo kede mattana
Lo hispik litno lo ad shetztzevao patur libbeno velo tzevao chayyav

Hallokeach gez tzono shel goy patur mereshit haggez hallokeach gez tzono shel chavero im shiyyer hammocher chayyav lo shiyyer hallokeach chayyav hau lo shene minim shechufot ulvanot machar lo shechufot aval lo levanot zecharim aval lo nekevot ze noten leatzmo veze noten leatzmo
Gema bemukdashin may tama la amar kera tzoncha velo tzon hekdesh
Tama dichtav rachamana tzoncha ha lav hachi hava amena kadashim chayyavim bereshit haggez ha lav bene giza ninhu dichtiv velo tagoz bechor tzonecha
I bekodshe mizbeach hachi name hacha bemay askinan bekodshe bedek habbayit
Vehaamar rabbi elazar kodshe bedek habbayit asurim begiza vaavoda midderabbanan salka datach amena hoil umiddeorayeta bene giza ninhu hecha digzaz leh litev leh
Veha kaddesh lah salka datach amena lifrok velitev leh
Veha bae haamada vehaaracha hanicha leman deamar kodshe bedek habbayit lo hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha ella leman deamar hau may ika lememar
Amar rabbi mani bar pattish mishshum rabbi yannay hacha bemakdish behemto levedek habbayit chutz miggizoteha salka datach amena ligzoz velitev leh amar kera tzoncha velo tzon shel hekdesh
I hachi kodshe mizbeach name kachashi
Kodshe bedek habbayit name kachashi deamar chutz miggiza uchchisha
Kodshe mizbeach name deamar chutz miggiza uchchisha afilu hachi pashta kedushsha bechullah

Umna temra deamar rabbi yose vahalo bemukdashin haomer raglah shel zo ola kullah ola vaafilu lerabbi meir deamar en kullah ola hane mile deakdesh davar sheen hanneshama teluya bo aval hikdish davar shehanneshama teluya bo kadsha
Rava amar bemakdish giza atzmah salka datach amena ligzoz velifrok velitev leh
Amar kera gez tzoncha titten lo mi sheen mechussar ella geziza untina yatza ze shemchussar geziza pediyya untina
Ella tzoncha lemay ata lechidtanya behemat hashshuttafim chayyav bereshit haggez verabbi ilay poter may tama derabbi ilay amar kera tzoncha velo shel shuttafut
Verabbanan lemaote shuttafut goy verabbi ilay shuttafut goy mena leh
Nafka leh meresha dikra reshit degancha velo shuttafut goy
Verabbanan reshit haggez hifsik hainyan
Verabbi ilay vav hadar arveh
b: Verabbanan la nichtov rachamana la vav vela reshit
Verabbi ilay ayede dehay kedushshat damim vehay kedushshat hagguf pasek lehu vahadar arvi lehu

Veibaet ema shuttafut goy bitruma rabbanan chayyove mechayevi detanya yisrael vegoy shellakchu sade beshuttafut tevel vechullin meoravim ze baze divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shel yisrael chayyav veshel goy patur
Ad kan la peligi ella demar savar yesh berera umar savar en berera aval shuttafut degoy divre hakkol chayyevet
Vei baet ema tarvayehu lerabbi ilay mitztzoncha nafka
Shuttafut degoy may tama dela meyachada leh leyisrael name la meyachada leh verabbanan goy lav bar chiyyuva hu yisrael bar chiyyuva hu
Amar rava mode rabbi ilay bitruma af al gav dichtiv degancha didach in deshuttafut la
Ketav rachamana terumotechem ella degancha lema li lemaote shuttafut goy
Challa af al gav dichtiv reshit veika lememar nelaf reshit reshit mereshit haggez ma lehallan deshuttafut la af kan deshuttafut la ketav rachamana arisotechem
Ella tama dichtiv arisotechem ha lav hachi hava amena nelaf reshit reshit mereshit haggez adderabba nelaf mitteruma
Hachi name ella arisotechem lema li kede arisotechem
Pea af al gav dichtiv sadcha didach in shuttafut la ketav rachamana uvkutzrechem et ketzir artzechem ella sadcha lema li lemaote shuttafut goy
Bechora af al gav dichtiv kol habbechor asher yivaled bivkarcha uvtzoncha didach in deshuttafut la
Ketav rachamana uvchorot bekarchem vetzonchem ella bekarcha vetzoncha lema li lemaote shuttafut goy
Mezuza af al gav dichtiv betecha didach in shuttafut la ketav rachamana lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem veella betecha lemay ata lechidrabba deamar rabba

a: Derech biatcha min hayyamin
Maaser af al gav dichtiv masar degancha dilach in deshuttafut la ketav rachamana maserotechem ella masar degancha lemay ata lemaote shuttafut degoy
Mattanot af al gav dichtav rachamana venatan
Ika lememar yalef netina netina mereshit haggez ma lehallan deshuttafut la af kan deshuttafut la ketav rachamana meet zovche hazzevach
Ella tama dichtav rachamana meet zovche hazzevach ha lav hachi hava amena lelaf mereshit haggez adderabba nelaf mitteruma
In hachi name meet zovche hazzevach lema li lechidrava deamar rava haddin im hattabbach
Bikkurim af al gav dichtiv artzecha didach in deshuttafut la
Ketav rachamana bikkure kol asher beartzecha beartzam ella artzecha lema li lemaote chutza laaretz
Tzitzit af al gav dichtav rachamana kesutcha didach in deshuttafut la
Ketav rachamana al kanfe vigdehem ledorotam veella kesutcha lema li lechidrav yehuda deamar rav yehuda tallit sheula petura min hatztzitzit kol sheloshim yom
Maake af al gav dichtav rachamana legaggecha didach in deshuttafut la
Ketav rachamana ki yippol hannofel mimmennu ella gaggecha lemay ata lemaote batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot
Amar rav bivi bar abbaye letanhu lehane kelale detanya behemat hashshuttafin chayyevet bivchora verabbi ilay potrah
May tama derabbi ilay dichtiv bekarcha vetzoncha veha ketiv bekarchem vetzonchem dechullehu yisrael

Amar rav chanina missura letanhu lehane kelale detanya behemat hashshuttafin chayyevet bemattanot verabbi ilay poter may tama yalef netina netina mereshit haggez ma lehallan deshuttafut la af kan deshuttafut la
Vei salka datach bitruma michayyav nelaf netina netina mitteruma ella shema minah bitruma name poter

I ma teruma baaretz in bechutza laaretz la af mattanot baaretz in bechutza laaretz la amar rabbi yose minneharbil in vehatanya rabbi ilay omer mattanot in nohagin ella baaretz vechen haya rabbi ilay omer reshit haggez in noheg ella baaretz
May tama derabbi ilay amar rava yalef netina netina mitteruma ma teruma baaretz in bechutza laaretz la af reshit haggez baaretz in bechutza laaretz la
Amar leh abbaye i ma teruma tovelet af reshit haggez tovelet amar leh amar kera vereshit gez tzoncha titten lo en lecha bo ella mereshito veelach
I ma teruma chayyavim aleha mita vachomesh af reshit haggez chayyavim alav mita vachomesh
Amar kera umetu vo veyasaf alav alav velo al reshit haggez bo velo bereshit haggez
I ma teruma rishon vesheni achareha af reshit haggez rishon vesheni achareha amar kera reshit en lecha bo ella reshit bilvad
I ma teruma mechadash al hayyashan la af reshit haggez mechadash al hayyashan la in
Vehatanya hau lo shette rechelot gazaz vehinniach gazaz vehinniach shettayim veshalosh shanim en mitztarfot ha chamesh mitztarfot
Vehatanya en mitztarfot ella shema minah ha derabbi ilay veha derabbanan
I ma teruma gadel bechiyyuv chayyav gadel biftur patur af reshit haggez name gadel bechiyyuv chayyav biftur patur
Vegabbe teruma menalan detanya yisrael shellakach sade besurya miggoy ad shello hevia shelish chayyav mishshehevia shelish rabbi akiva mechayyev betosefet vachachamim potrin
Vechi tema hachi name vehatnan hallokeach gez tzon goy patur mereshit haggez ha tzono ligzoz chayyav matnitin
b: Dela kerabbi ilay
I ma teruma mimmin al sheeno mino lo af reshit haggez mimmin al sheeno mino lo

Vegabbe teruma menalan detanya hau lo shene mine teenim shechorot ulvanot vechen shene mine chittin en tormim umasserim mizze al ze rabbi yitzchak omer mishshum rabbi ilay bet shammay omrim en tormin uvet hillel omrim tormin af reshit haggez mimmin al sheeno mino lo
In vehatnan hau lo shene minim shechufot ulvanot machar lo shechufot aval lo levanot ze noten leatzmo veze noten leatzmo
Ella meatta sefa dekatane zecharim aval lo nekevot ze noten leatzmo veze noten leatzmo hachi name mishshum ditre mine ninhu
Ella etza tova ka mashma lan delitev leh mehay derakkich umehay deashshun hacha name etza tova ka mashma lan delitev lehu mittarvayehu
Ha okemna lematnitin dela kerabbi ilay
I ma teruma baenan reshit sheshsheyareha nikarin af reshit haggez sheshsheyareha nikarin in
Vehatnan haomer kol gorni teruma vechol isati challa lo amar kelum ha kol gizzay reshit devarav kayyamin vetanya idach lo amar kelum
Ella lav shema minah ha rabbi ilay veha rabbanan shema minah
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak haidana nehug alma kehane telat save kerabbi ilay bereshit haggez detanya rabbi ilay omer reshit haggez eno noheg ella baaretz
Uchrabbi yehuda ben betira bedivre tora detanya rabbi yehuda ben betira omer en divre tora mekabbelin tuma
Uchrabbi yoshiyya bechilayim detanya rabbi yoshiyya omer leolam en chayyav ad sheyyizra chitta usora vechartzan bemappolet yad
Chomer bizroa vechu velitne chomer bereshit haggez shennoheg bitrefot ma sheen ken bemattanot

Amar ravina ha manni rabbi shimon hi detanya rabbi shimon poter et hatterefot mereshit haggez may tama derabbi shimon yalef netina netina mimmattanot ma mattanot terefa la af reshit haggez name terefa la

Vei yalef netina netina mimmattanot lelaf netina netina mitteruma ma teruma baaretz in bechutza laaretz la af reshit haggez name baaretz in bechutza laaretz la allema tenan reshit haggez noheg baaretz uvchutza laaretz
Ella hayenu tama derabbi shimon deyalef tzon tzon mimmaaser ma maaser terefa la af reshit haggez terefa la
Vehatam menalan dichtiv kol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet perat litrefa sheenah overet velelaf tzon tzon mibbechor ma bechor afilu terefa af reshit haggez afilu terefa
Mistabbera mimmaaser hava leh lemelaf shekken zecharim temein
Bimrubbin merechem
Adam pashut lifne haddibbur
Adderabba mibbechor hava leh lemelaf shekken yatom shellakchu
Beshuttafut natnu bifne kohen

a: Bikdushsha umchira vehanach nefishin
Pashut mippashut adif leh

Reshit haggez eno noheg ella birchelim mena hane mile amar rav chisda atya giza giza ketiv hacha reshit gez tzoncha titten lo uchtiv hatam umiggez kevasay yitchammam ma lehallan kevasim af kan kevasim
Venelaf giza giza mibbechor detanya lo taavod bivchor shorecha velo tagoz bechor tzonecha en li ella shor baavoda vetzon begiza
Minnayin liten haamur shel ze baze veet haamur shel ze baze talmud lomar lo taavod velo tagoz
Amar kera titten lo velo lesakko
Ella meatta notza shel izzim lichayyav baenan giza veleka
Man shamatte leh hay sevara rabbi yose ha mode rabbi yose bemide deorcheh
Ella kidamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi laamod lesharet davar harauy lesherut hacha name davar harauy lesherut
Ella giza giza lemay ata lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael kevasim shetztzamran kashe peturim mereshit haggez shenneemar umiggez kevasay yitchammam
Tane chada gozez et haizzim veshotef et harchelim patur vetanya idach haggozez et haizzim patur veshotef et harchelim chayyav la kashya ha rabbanan veha rabbi yose
Detanya leket ketzircha velo leket kituf rabbi yose omer en leket ella habba mechamat katzir
Rabbi yose hayenu tanna kamma kullah rabbi yose hi vehachi katane sherabbi yose omer en leket ella habba mechamat katzir
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe mode rabbi yose bemide deorcheh detanya rabbi yose omer katzir en li ella katzir oker minnayin
Talmud lomar liktzor tolesh minnayin talmud lomar bekutzrecha
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe af anan name tenena malbenot betzalim shebben hayyarak rabbi yose omer pea mikkol echad veechad vachachamim omrim meachat al hakkol
Vechamma hu merubbe bishlama levet shammay tarte name ikro tzon ella levet hillel may tama
Amar rav kahana amar kera asuot sheosot shette mitzot reshit haggez umattanot ema bechora umattanot
Bechora chada mi la michayeva ultamach mattanot chada mi la michayeva ella amar rav ashe asuot shemmeassot et baalehen veomrot lo kum ase mitzva
Tanya deve rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv arba shenneemar vearba tzon tachat hasse
Tanya amar rabbi ilmale divrehen divre tora vedivre beribi kabbala anan divre beribi shomin vechol shekken sheddivrehem divre kabbala vedivre beribi divre tora
Vehaamar mar en hachraa shelishit machraat
b: Amar rabbi yochanan mippi shemua amra mippi chaggay zecharya umalachi
Rabbi dosa ben harkinas omer vechu vechamma kol shehen amar rav mane ufras uvilvad sheyehu mechummashot ushmuel amar shishshim venoten sela achat lechohen
Rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan shesh lechohen chamesh veachat lo ulla amar rabbi elazar kol shehen shaninu
Tenan vechamma noten lo mishkal chamesh selaim bihuda shehen eser selaim baggalil bishlama lerav verabbi yochanan nicha ella lishmuel verabbi elazar kashya
Velitamach ulrav mi nicha veha rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu reshit haggez beshishshim
Ha itmar alah dehahi rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu beyisrael sheyyesh lo gizin harbe askinan umvakkesh litnan lechohen veamrinan leh kol chad vechad la tevatztzar leh mechameshet selaim
Gufa rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu reshit haggez beshishshim teruma beshishshim pea beshishshim
Teruma beshishshim veha anan tenan teruma ayin yafa echad mearbaim deorayeta beshishshim derabbanan bearbaim
Deorayeta beshishshim vehaamar shemuel chitta achat poteret et hakkeri deorayeta kedishmuel derabbanan bidorayeta achat mearbaim derabbanan bidrabbanan beshishshim
Pea beshishshim vehatnan ellu devarim sheen lahen shiur happea vehabbikkurim vehareaon deorayeta en lah shiur derabbanan beshishshim
May ka mashma lan tenena en pochatin lappea mishshishshim af al pi sheamru happea en lah shiur hatam baaretz hacha bechutza laaretz

Ki selek isi bar hini ashkecheh lerabbi rabbi yochanan deka matne leh livreh rechelim amar leh atneyeh rechelot amar leh kedichtiv rechelim matayim amar leh leshon tora leatzmah leshon chachamim leatzman

Amar leh man resh sidra bevavel amar leh abba aricha amar leh abba aricha karet leh dechirna kad hava yatevna achar sheva esre shuran achoreh derav kammeh derabbi venafki zikukin denur mippummeh derav lefummeh derabbi umippummeh derabbi lefummeh derav velet ana yada ma hen amrin veatte abba aricha karet leh
Amar leh ihu reshit haggez bechamma amar leh rabbi yochanan beshishshim vehaanan bechol shehen tenan amar leh im ken ma ben li velach
Ki ata rav dimi amar reshit haggez rav amar beshishshim verabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yannay amar beshesh amar leh abbaye lerav dimi annachte lan chada veakshet lan chada
Bishlama derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan la kashya ha dideh ha derabbeh
Ella derav adderav kashya deha amar rav mane ufras derav adderav name la kashya may mane dekaamar ben arbaim selaim dahava leh

a: Beshishshim vetane tanna mane ben arbaim selaim in vehatnan chemet chadasha af al pi shemmekabbelet rimmonim tehora
Tefarah venikrea shiurah kemotzi rimmonim rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer kefakiyyot shel sheti achat mearba bemane ben arbaim selaim
Vechamma noten lo ku tana lo sheyelabbenennu veyittenennu lo ella sheyelabbenennu kohen veyaamod al chamesh selaim
Kede laasot beged katan menahane mile amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar kera laamod lesharet davar shehu rauy lesherut may nihu avnet
Ema meil tafasta merubbe lo tafasta tafasta muat tafasta
Veema kipa shel tzemer detanya kipa shel tzemer hayeta munnachat berosh kohen gadol vealeha tzitz natun lekayyem ma shenneemar vesamta oto al petil techelet
Amar kera hu uvanav davar hashshave leaharon ulvanav
Avnet name la shave hanicha leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol lo zehu avneto shel kohen hedot shappir
Ella leman deamar zehu avneto shel kohen hedot may ika lememar shem avnet baolam
Lo hispik litno vechu itmar gazaz umachar rishona rav chisda amar chayyav rabbi natan bar hoshaya amar patur
Rav chisda amar chayyav deha gazaz rabbi natan bar hoshaya amar patur beidana deka male shiura baenan tzoncha veleka
Tenan hallokeach gez tzono shel goy patur mereshit haggez ha tzono ligzoz chayyav ammay kol chad vechad batar giza nafka lah mershuteh
Targema rav chisda alliba derabbi natan bar hoshaya kegon shehiknan lo kol sheloshim yom
Hallokeach gez tzono shel chavero ku man tanna dehecha deika shiyyura gabbe mocher batar mocher azlinan
Amar rav chisda rabbi yehuda hi ditnan hammocher kilche ilan betoch sadehu noten pea lechol echad veechad
Amar rabbi yehuda ematay bizman shello shiyyer baal hassade aval shiyyer baal hassade noten pea al hakkol
Amar leh rava veha mar hu deamar vehu shehitchil baal hassade liktzor

Vechi tema hachi name vehu shehitchil ligzoz bishlama hatam uvkutzrechem et ketzir artzechem ketiv meidana deatchel liktzor michayyav bechullah sade ella hacha meidana deatchel lemegaz la michayyav bechulleh edreh

Ella amar rava hay tanna hu ditnan amar lo mechor li bene meeha shel para zo vehau bahen mattanot notnan lakkohen veen menakke lo min haddamim lakach mimmennu bemishkal notnan lakkohen umnakke lo min haddamim

Ezehu sheeno mezumman kegon avazin vetarnegolim shekkinnenu bappardes aval im kinnenu babbayit vechen yone hardasiyyaot patur mishshiluach of tame patur milleshalleach of tame rovetz al betze of tahor vetahor rovetz al betze of tame patur milleshalleach kore zachar rabbi eliezer mechayyev vachachamim potrin
Gema rabbi avin verabbi meyasha chad amar kol hecha ditnan baaretz uvchutza laaretz shello letzorech levad mereshit haggez leappoke midderabbi ilay deamar reshit haggez eno noheg ella baaretz

Vechad amar kol hecha ditnan bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit shello letzorech levad meoto veet beno salka datach amena hoil uvinyana dekadashim ketiv bizman deika kadashim ninhog bizman deleka kodashim la ninhog ka mashma lan
Vetarvayehu amri kol hecha ditnan bechullin uvmukdashim letzorech levad miggid hannashe peshita mishshum deikaddash peka leh isur gid hannashe mineh
Velav okemna bevaldot kadashim
Umay tama okemna lav mishshum dekashya lan la litne meikara name la tikshe lach ayede ditna letzorech tena name shello letzorech
Bechullin aval lo bemukdashim ammay la deamar kera shalleach teshallach et haem bemi sheatta metzve leshallecho yatza ze shei atta metzve leshallecho ella lahavio lide gizbar

a: Bar ketala hu ella dela gemar dineh uvae leetoyeh leve dina vekayyome beh uviarta hara mikkirbecha
Hane mukdashin hechi dame ilema dahava leh ken betoch beto veakdesheh mi michayyav ki yikkare kan tzippor perat limzumman
Ella dachaza ken bealma veakdesheh umi kadosh ish ki yakdish et beto kodesh amar rachamana ma beto birshuto af kol birshuto
Ella deagbehinhu leefrochim veakdeshinhu vahadar ahderinhu hay afilu bechullin name la michayyav ditna natal et habbanim vehechziran lakken veachar kach chazra haem alehen patur milleshalleach

Ella deagbehah leem veakdeshah vahadara meikara ichayyav leh beshiluach mikkamme deakdeshah detanya rabbi yochanan ben yosef omer hikdish chayya veachar kach shechatah patur millechassot shechatah veachar kach hikdishah chayyav lechassot shekkevar nitchayyev bechissuy kodem sheyyavo lide hekdesh

Urmi derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan urmi derabbi shimon ben lakish adderabbi shimon ben lakish
