Deresh lakish adderesh lakish la kashya ha mikkamme deshameh merabbi yochanan rabbeh ha levatar deshameh merabbi yochanan rabbeh
Ella derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan kashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan name la kashya ha deamar alay ha deamar hare zo
Mikkelal derabbi shimon ben lakish af al gav deamar alay la mechayyev

Vehatanya ezehu neder veezo hi nedava neder haomer hare alay ola nedava haomer hare zo ola uma ben neder lindava neder meta o nigneva o sheavda chayyav beachrautah nedava meta o nigneva o sheavda eno chayyav beachrautah
Amar lach resh lakish hane mile kodshe mizbeach dimchussar hakrava aval kodshe bedek habbayit delav mechussar hakrava af al gav deamar alay la mechayyev
Vehatnan haomer shor ze ola bayit ze korban met hashshor nafal habbayit eno chayyav beachrautan shor ze alay ola bayit ze alay korban met hashshor venafal habbayit chayyav leshallem
Hane mile hecha demet hashshor venafal habbayit chayyav leshallem deletanhu aval hecha deitanhu kol hecha deiteh beve gazza derachamana iteh dichtiv la haaretz umloah
Amar rav hamnuna hakkol modim baarachin af al gav deamar alay la michayyav may tama dela mitmar leh bela alay
Hechi lema lema erki amman lema erech peloni amman

Matkef lah rava lema hareni beerki hareni beerech peloni veod tanya rabbi natan omer venatan et haerkecha bayyom hahu kodesh la ma talmud lomar lefi shemmatzinu behekdeshot umaasrot shemmitchallelin al maot shebbachullin nignevu o sheavdu enan chayyavin beachrautan
b: Yachol af ze ken talmud lomar venatan et haerkecha vego chullin ad sheyyavou lide gizbar
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav hamnuna hakkol modim baarachin deaf al gav dela amar alay michayyav dichtiv venatan et haerkecha chullin hen beyadcha ad sheyyavou lide gizbar
Chomer bechissuy vechu tanu rabbanan ki yikkare kan tzippor lefanecha ma talmud lomar
Lefi shenneemar shalleach teshallach et haem veet habbanim tikkach lach yachol yachzor beharim ugvaot kede sheyyimtza ken talmud lomar ki yikkare bimora lefanecha

Kan ken mikkol makom tzippor tehora velo temea lefanecha birshut hayyachid badderech birshut harabbim bailanot minnayin talmud lomar bechol etz bevorot shichin umarot minnayin talmud lomar o al haaretz

Vechi meachar shessofenu lerabbot kol davar lefanecha badderech lema li lomar lach ma derech sheen kinno beyadecha af kol sheen kinno beyadecha mikkan amru yone shovach veone aliyya shekkinnenu bitfichin uvvirot vaavazin vetarnegolin shekkinnenu bappardes chayyav beshiluach aval kinnenu betoch habbayit vechen yone hardasiyyaot patur mishshiluach
Amar mar ma derech sheen kinno beyadcha af kol sheen kinno beyadcha ha lema li mikki yikkare nafka ki yikkare perat limzumman veod lefanecha lema li
Ella lefanecha leetoye shehau lefanecha umardu badderech kidrav yehuda amar rav deamar rav yehuda amar rav matza ken bayyam chayyav beshiluach shenneemar ko amar Adonai hannoten bayyam darech vego
Ella meatta matza ken bashshamayim dichtiv derech nesher bashshamayim hachi name demichayyav beshiluach hakken derech nesher ikri derech setama la ikri
Amri leh pappunae lerav matna matza ken berosho shel adam mahu amar lehu vaadama al rosho moshe min hattora minnayin beshaggam hu basar
Haman min hattora minnayin hamin haetz
Ester min hattora minnayin veanochi haster astir mordochay min hattora minnayin dichtiv mor deror umtargeminan mera dachya
Veezehu sheeno mezumman vechu rabbi chiyya verabbi shimon chad tane hadderasiyyaot vechad tane hardasiyyaot man detane hardasiyyaot al shem hordos uman detane hadderasiyyaot al shem mekoman

Amar rav kahana ledidi chazyan li vekayeman shitsar dare bifte mila vahava kara veamran kiri kiri hava chad minayehu dela hava kare kiri kiri havat chada dela havat yada lememar amara lah chavertah soma emari kiri kiri amara soma emari kiri kiri atuha veshachtuha
Amar rav ashe amar li rabbi chanina milin milin salka datach ella ema bemilin

Of tame patur milleshalleach menahane mile amar rabbi yitzchak deamar kera ki yikkare ken tzippor lefanecha of mashma lan ben tahor ben tame tzippor tahor ashkechan deikri tzippor tame la ashkechan deikri tzippor
Ta shema tavnit kol tzippor kanaf may lav tzippor ben tahor ben tame kanaf chagavim la tzippor tahor kanaf tame vachagavim
Ta shema hachayya vechol behema remes vetzippor kanaf may lav tzippor ben tahor ben tame vechanaf chagavim la tzippor tahor kanaf tame vachagavim
Ta shema kol tzippor kol kanaf may lav kidmakshinan la kedimshannenan
Ta shema veatta ven adam emor letzippor kol kanaf may lav kidakshinan la kidshannenan
Ta shema

a: Uvanfohi yeduran tzippere shemayya tzippere shemayya ikro tzippere setama la ikro
Ta shema kol tzippor tehora mikkelal deika temea la mikkelal deika asura
May hi i terefa behedya ketiv vei bishchuta dimtzora missefa dikra nafka veze asher lo tochlu mehem lerabbot shechutat metzora
Leolam bishchuta dimtzora velaavor alav baase uvlo taase velokmah bitrefa velaavor alav baase velo taase davar hallamed meinyano uvinyana dishchuta ketiv
Ta shema shette tzipporim chayyot may chayyot lav shechayyot befich mikkelal deika lav shechayyot befich la may chayyot shechayyin rashe evarim shellahen
Ta shema missefa tehorot mikkelal deika temeot la mikkelal deika terefot

Terefot mechayyot nafka hanicha leman deamar terefa chayya ella leman deamar terefa enah chayya may ika lememar veod ben leman deamar terefa chayya ben leman deamar enah chayya middetana deve rabbi yishmael nafka
Detana deve rabbi yishmael neemar machshir umchapper bifnim veneemar machshir umchapper bachutz
Ma machshir umchapper haamur bifnim asa bo machshir kimchapper af machshir umchapper haamur bachutz asa bo machshir kimchapper
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lemaote tzippore ir hanniddachat lemay i leshiluach lo amra tora shallach letakkala ella lishchita
Rava amar lemaote shello lezaveg lah acheret kodem shillucheha lemay i lishchita ha baaya shiluach ella leshiluach

Rav pappa amar letzipporim shehechlifu shehechlifan betzippore avoda zara dichtiv vehayita cherem kamohu kol ma sheatta mehayye hemennu kamohu lemay i leshiluach lo amra tora shallach letakkala ella lishchita

Ravina amar hacha bemay askinan beof sheharag et hannefesh hechi dame i digmar dineh bar ketala hu ella kodem gemar dine ulmay i leshiluach bae leetoye leve dina vekayyome uviarta hara mikkirbecha ella lishchita
Of tame rovetz al betze of tahor bishlama of tame rovetz al betze tahor baenan tzippor veleka ella of tahor rovetz al betze of tame ha tzippor hu
Kidamar rav kahana tikkach lach velo lichlavecha hacha name tikkach lach velo lichlavecha
Vehecha itmar derav kahana aha detanya im terefa chayyav beshiluach efrochim terefot patur mishshiluach mena hane mile amar rav kahana deamar kera tikkach lach velo lichlavecha
Ulhakkish em terefa leefrochim ma efrochim terefot patur mishshiluach af em terefa name patur milleshalleach
b: Im ken tzippor lemaote of tame lema li
Vehatanya em efrochin terefa chayyav beshiluach amar abbaye hachi kaamar efroach sheimman terefa chayyav beshiluach
Bae rav hoshaya hoshit yado lakken veshachat miut simanim mahu
Mi amrinan kevan deilu shavek lehu mittarfi baenan lach velo lichlavecha o dilma kevan divyado lemigmar shechita tikkach lach karena beh vechayyav beshiluach teku
Bae rabbi yirmeya matlet mahu shettachotz kenafayim mahu sheyyachotztzu
Betzim muzarot mahu shene sidre vetzim zo al gav zo mahu zachar al gabbe vetzim unkeva al gabbe zachar mahu teku
Bae rabbi zera yona al betze tasil mahu tasil al betze yona mahu
Amar abbaye ta shema of tame rovetz al betze of tahor vetahor rovetz al betze of tame patur mishshiluach ha tahor vetahor chayyav dilma bekore
Kore zachar rabbi eliezer mechayyev vachachamim potrin amar rabbi avahu may tama derabbi eliezer atya degira degira ketiv hacha kore dagar velo yalad uchtiv hatam uvaka vedagra vetzillah

Amar rabbi elazar machloket bekore zachar aval bekore nekeva divre hakkol chayyav peshita kore zachar tenan mahu detema rabbanan afilu kore nekeva patri veha dekatane zachar lehodiacha kocho derabbi eliezer kamashma lan

Veamar rabbi elazar machloket bekore zachar aval bezachar dealma divre hakkol patur peshita kore zachar tenan mahu detema rabbi eliezer afilu zachar dealma mechayyev vehay dekatane kore zachar lehodiacha kochan derabbanan ka mashma lan
Tanya name hachi zachar dealma patur kore zachar rabbi eliezer mechayyev vachachamim potrin

Matni hayeta meofefet bizman shekkenafeha nogot bakken chayyav leshalleach en kenafeha nogot bakken patur milleshalleach en sham ella efroach echad o betza achat chayyav leshalleach shenneemar kan ken mikkol makom

Hau sham efrochim mafrichim o betzim muzarot patur milleshalleach shenneemar vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim o al habbetzim ma efrochim bene kayyama af betzim bene kayyama yatzu muzarot uma habbetzim tzerichin leimman af haefrochin tzerichin leimman yatzu mafrichin
Gema tanu rabbanan rovetzet velo meofefet yachol afilu kenafeha nogot bakken talmud lomar rovetzet may talmuda middela ketiv yoshevet
Amar rav yehuda amar rav hayeta yoshevet ben shene rovde ilan roim kol sheim tishshamet nofelet alehem chayyav leshalleach veim lav patur
Metivi hayeta yoshevet benehen patur milleshalleach al gabbehen chayyav leshalleach hayeta meofefet afilu kenafeha nogot bakken patur milleshalleach
May lav al gabbehen dumya devenehen ma benehen denaga behu af al gabbehen denaga behu aval rovde ilan patur
Lo al gabbehen dumya devenehen ma benehen delo naga alayehu af al gabbehen delo naga alayehu vehayenu rovde ilan
Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach rovde ilan patur addetane hayeta meofefet afilu kenafeha nogot bakken patur milleshalleach litne rovde ilan vechol shekken meofefet
Meofefet itzterich leh daafilu kenafeha nogot bakken patur milleshalleach
Vehaanan tenan bizman shekkenafeha nogot bakken chayyav leshalleach amar rabbi yirmeya ki katane matnita benogea min hatztzad
Ika deamri lema mesayya leh hayeta yoshevet benehen patur milleshalleach al gabbehen chayyav leshalleach hayeta meofefet afilu kenafeha nogot bakken patur milleshalleach
May lav al gabbehen dumya devenehen ma benehen dela naga alayehu af al gabbehen dela naga alayehu vehayenu rovde ilan
La al gabbehen dumya devenehen ma benehen denaga behu af al gabbehen denaga behu aval rovde ilan patur i hachi addekatane sefa hayeta meofefet afilu kenafeha nogot bakken patur

a: Litne rovde ilan vechol shekken meofefet meofefet itzterich leh daafilu kenafeha nogot bakken patur milleshalleach
Vehaanan tenan bizman shekkenafeha nogot bakken chayyav leshalleach amar rav yehuda ki katane matnitin benogea min hatztzad
En sham efroach vechu amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava ema ipcha en sham efroach ella echad o betza achat patur milleshalleach devaenan efrochim o vetzim veleka

Hau sham efrochim mafrichim o betzim muzarot chayyav leshalleach shenneemar kan ken mikkol makom im ken nichtov kera vehaem rovetzet alehem may vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim o al habbetzim leakkoshe efrochim levetzim uvetzim leefrochim

Matni shillechah vechazra afilu arbaa vachamishsha peamim chayyav shenneemar shalleach teshallach et haem amar hareni notel et haem umshalleach et habbanim chayyav shenneemar shalleach teshallach et haem natal et habbanim vehechziran lah veachar kach chazra haem alehen patur milleshalleach
Gema amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava veema shalleach chada zimna teshallach tere zimnin
Amar leh shalleach afilu mea peamim teshallach en li ella lidvar harshut lidvar mitzva minnayin talmud lomar teshallach mikkol makom
Amar leh rabbi abba bereh derav yosef bar rava lerav kahana ella tama dichtav rachamana teshallach ha lav hachi have amena lidvar mitzva la ase velo taase hu veen ase doche lo taase vaase
La tzericha daavar veshaklah leem delav avreh ase hu deika lete ase velidche ase ka mashma lan
Hanicha leman detane kiyemo velo kiyemo
Ella leman detane bittelo velo bittelo kamma dela shachtah la avreh lelav
Vetu lerabbi yehuda deamar shalleach meikara mashma afilu ase name leka
Ella amar mar bar rav ashe kegon shennetalah al menat leshalleach delav leka ase hu deika velete ase velidche ase
May ulmeh dehay ase mehay ase salka datach hoil veamar mar gadol shalom shebben ish leishto shehare amra tora shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu shennichtav bikdushsha yimmache al hammayim

Vehay metzora kevan dechamma dela mittahar asur betashmish hammitta dichtiv veyashav michutz leoholo shivat yamim oholo zo ishto mikkan sheasur betashmish hammitta mahu detema kevan deasur betashmish hammitta lete ase dideh velidche ase deshilluach hakken ka mashma lan
Matni hannotel em al habbanim rabbi yehuda omer loke veeno meshalleach vachachamim omrim meshalleach veeno loke ze hakkelal kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase en lokin aleha
Gema bae rabbi abba bar memel tama derabbi yehuda mishshum desavar lav shennitak laase lokin alav
O dilma bealma savar lav shennitak laase en lokin alav vehacha hayenu tama mishshum dekasavar shalleach meikara mashma

Ta shema gannav vegazlan yeshnan bichlal malkot divre rabbi yehuda veha hacha delav shennitak laase hu derachamana amar lo tigzol veheshiv et haggezela shema minah tama derabbi yehuda mishshum dekasavar lav shennitak laase lokin alav
Amar leh rabbi zera lav amena lechu kol matnita dela tanya be
b: Rabbi chiyya uve rabbi oshaya meshabbashta hi vela totvu minah be midresha dilma enah bichlal malkot arbaim tanya
Ta shema detane rabbi oshaya verabbi chiyya lo tashuv veshav lo techalle vechilla yeshnan bichlal malkot arbaim divre rabbi yehuda
Shema minah tameh derabbi yehuda mishshum dekasavar lav shennitak laase lokin alav
Dilma hatam hayenu taam dekasavar taazov meikara mashma
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe ta shema lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vego baesh tisrofu ba hakkatuv liten ase achar lo taase lomar lach sheen lokin alav divre rabbi yehuda
Shema minah tama derabbi yehuda mishshum dekasavar shalleach meikara mashma shema minah

Amar leh rav idi lerav ashe matnitin name dayeka dekatane hannotel em al habbanim rabbi yehuda omer loke veen meshalleach vei salka datach tama derabbi yehuda lav shennitak laase lokin alav loke umshalleach mibbee leh
Vedilma hachi kaamar bematnitin en niftar ad demalkin leh

Ad kamma meshallechah amar rav yehuda kede shettetze mittachat yado bamme meshallechah rav huna amar beragleha rav yehuda amar baagappeha rav huna amar beragleha dichtiv meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor rav yehuda amar baagappeha deha kenafeha ninhu
Hahu degazzinhu legappah veshallechah veachar kach tafsah naggedeh rav yehuda amar leh zil rabbi lah gadfah veshallechah
Keman i kerabbi yehuda loke veen meshalleach i kerabbanan meshalleach veen loke leolam kerabbanan umakkat mardut midderabbanan

Hahu daata lekammeh derava amar leh tema mahu amar la yada hay gavra deof tahor chayyav leshalloche amar leh dilma chada beata hu deramya amar leh hay yadi in amar leh may tibe lach matnitin hi en sham ella efroach echad o vetza achat chayyav leshalleach
Shalchah veahdar lah rava peristake vetafsah velechush lachashada kilachar yad
Tanu rabbanan yone shovach veone aliyya chayyavot beshilluach vaasurot mishshum gazel mippene darche shalom
Vei ita leha deamar rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato keri kan ki yikkare perat limzumman
Amar rabba betza im yetziat rubbah hu deichayyav beshilluach mikna la kane ad detippol lachatzero vechi katane chayyavot beshilluach mikkamme detippol lachatzero
I hachi ammay asurot mishshum gazel aimmam veibaet ema leolam abbetza uvetza kevan dinfak leh rubba dateh aleh

Vehashta deamar rav yehuda amar rav asur lizkot bevetzim shehaem rovetzet alehen shenneemar shalleach et haem vahadar habbanim tikkach lach afilu tema af al gav dinfal lachatzero kol hecha deihu matze zache chatzero name zachya vechol hecha deihu la matze zache chatzero name la zachya leh
I hachi ammay asurot mippene darche shalom i deshallechah gazel mealleya hu i dela shallechah shalloche bae
Bekatan katan bar darche shalom hu hachi kaamar aviv shel katan chayyav lehachzir lo mippene darche shalom
Levi bar simon akni perot shovacho lerav yehuda ata lekammeh dishmuel amar leh zil terof akkan delitgavhu ukninhu
Lemay i lemikne lakninhu leh besudar i beom tov

a: Beomed veomer ze veze ani notel saggi hanhu pere chadte hao delevi bar simon gufeh la hava kane lehu vehachi kaamar leh zil utrof akkan delitgavhu venikninhu levi bar simon vahadar lakninhu nihalach besudar
Matni lo yittol adam em al banim afilu letaher et hamtzora uma im mitzva kalla shehi keisar amra tora lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim kal vachomer al mitzot chamurot shebbattora

Gema tanya rabbi yaakov omer en lecha kol mitzva umitzva shebbattora shemmattan secharah betziddah sheen techiyyat hammetim teluya bah bechibbud av vaem ketiv lemaan yaarichun yamecha ulmaan yitav lach beshiluach hakken ketiv lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim

Hare sheamar lo aviv ale labbira vehave li gozalot veala veshillach et haem velakach et habbanim uvachazarato nafal vamet hechan arichut yamav shel ze vehechan tovato shel ze ella lemaan yaarichun yamecha beolam shekkullo aroch ulmaan yitav lach leolam shekkullo tov
Vedilma la hava hachi rabbi yaakov maase chaza vedilma meharher baavera hava machshava raa en hakkadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase
Vedilma meharher baavoda zara hava dichtiv lemaan tefos et bet yisrael belibbam veamar rav acha bar yaakov zo machshevet avoda zara

Hachi kaamar im ita deika sechar mitzot behay alma tahane leh vetaggen aleh dela lete lide hirhur velitazzak ella sechar mitzot behay alma leka vehaamar rabbi elazar sheluche mitzva enan nizzokim bachazaratam shane
Vehaamar rabbi elazar sheluche mitzva enan nizzokim lo bahalichatan velo bachazaratan sullam raua hava umakom dekavua hezeka shane dichtiv vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani

Amar rav yosef ilmale darsheh acher lehay kera kerabbi yaakov bar beratte la chata may chaza ika deamri ki hay maase chaza veika deamri lishana derabbi chutzpit hamturgeman chaza dahava muttelet baashpa amar pe shehefik margaliyyot yilchoch afar vehu la yada lemaan yitav lecha beolam shekkullo tov ulmaan yaarichun yamecha beolam shekkullo aroch
Hadaran alach shiluach hakken uslika lah massechet chullin

Matni hallokeach ubbar chamoro shel nachri vehammocher lo af al pi sheeno rashshay hammishtattef lo vehamkabbel hemennu vehannoten lo bekabbala patur min habbechora shenneemar beyisrael aval lo baacherim
Gema kol hane lema li
Tzerichi dei tena lokeach hava amena mishshum deka mayete lah likdushsha aval mocher deka mafka lah mikkedushsha ema likneseh ka mashma lan
Vehammishtattef lo lema li leappoke midderabbi yehuda deamar shuttafut goyi chayyevet bivchora kamashma lan diftura min habbechora
Vehamkabbel lema li mishshum deka bae lemitne vehannoten lo bekabbala
Vehannoten lo bekabbala lema li itzterich salka datach amena hoil veikar behema deyisrael hi likneseh dilma ate leichallofe bivhema achariti kamashma lan
Tenan hatam rabbi yehuda mattir bashshevura ben betira mattir bassus
Ibaya lehu ubbar ma li amar rabbi yehuda tama derabbi yehuda hatam deshare mishshum dishvura ubbar name shavur hu o dilma shevura lav hayenu orcheh aval ubbar kevan dehayenu orcheh lav shavur hu
Ta shema vehammocher lo af al pi sheeno rashshay vela pelig rabbi yehuda
Velitamach hammishtattef lo vehamkabbel mimmennu vehannoten lo bekabbala dela katane hachi name dela pelig
Ella pelig vela katane hacha name pelig vela katane

Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer hamkabbel behema min haggoy veyalda maalin oto beshoveyo venoten chatzi damav lakkohen vehannoten lo bekabbala af al pi sheeno rashshay konsim oto ad asara bedamav venoten kol damav lakkohen
b: May lav aubbar la abbehema

Veha damav katane teni dameha veha noten kol damav lakkohen katane vei behema kohen may avidteh hacha bemay askinan kegon deyahev leh behema meabbarta lefattomah demigo dekansinan leh abbehema kansinan leh aubbar
Amar rav ashe ta shema rabbi yehuda mattir bashshevura mippene sheenah yechola lehitrappeot ha yechola lehitrappeot asar veha ubbar name keyachol lehitrappeot dame shema minah
Veika dematne lah ammatnitin vehammocher lo af al pi sheeno rashshay lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda ditnan rabbi yehuda mattir bashshevura
Afilu tema rabbi yehuda shevura lav hayenu orcheh ubbar hayenu orcheh

Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer hamkabbel behema min haggoy veyalda maalin oto beshoveo venoten chatzi damav lakkohen vehannoten lo bekabbala af al pi sheeno rashshay konsin oto ad asara bedamav venoten kol damav lakkohen may lav aubbar la abbehema

Veha damav katane teni dameha veha noten kal damav lakkohen katane vei behema kohen may avidteh hacha bemay askinan kegon deyahev behema meabbarta lefattomah demigo dekansinan leh abbehema kansinan leh aubbar
Amar rav ashe ta shema rabbi yehuda mattir bashshevura mippene sheenah yechola lehitrappeot ha yechola lehitrappeot asur vehay name keyachol lehitrappeot dame shema minah
Ibaya lehu machar behema leubbareha may tibe lerabbi yehuda tibe lerabbanan
Tibe lerabbi yehuda ad kan la ka share rabbi yehuda ella bishvura dela atya leichallofe aval shelema deatya leichallofe asar
O dilma uma shevura difsaka mineh vechol shekken shelema dela pesaka mineh
Tibe lerabbanan ad kan la kaasri rabbanan ella bishvura difsaka mineh aval shelema dela pesaka mineh sharu
O dilma uma shevura dela atya leichallofe asri vechol shekken shelema deatya leichallofe
Vetama derabbanan mishshum hachi hu vehatanya amru lo lerabbi yehuda vahalo marbiin aleha veoledet alma mishshum ubbareha hu
Hachi kaamri leh tama didan mishshum deatya leichallofe bivhema ella atte may tama sharet mishshum deen yechola lehitrappeot keman dezabbenah lishchita dame
Vahalo marbiin aleha veoledet vechevan demarbiin aleha veoledet meshahe lah
Vaamar lehu lichshetteled delo mekabbelet zachar
Ta shema vehannoten lo bekabbala vela katane af al pi sheeno rashshay

Velitamach hammishtattef lo dela katane hachi name derashshay veha amar avuh dishmuel asur leadam sheyyaase shuttafut im haggoy shemma yitchayyev lo shevua venishba lo beshem avoda zara shello vehattora amra lo yishshama al picha
Ella tena mechira vehu haddin leshuttafut hachi name tena mechira vehu haddin lekabbelanut umay shena mechira denaket deikar mechira hi

Ta shema rabbi yehuda omer hamkabbel behema min haggoy veyalda maalin oto beshoveyo venoten chatzi damav lakkohen vehannoten bekabbala af al pi sheeno rashshay konsin oto ad asara bedamav venoten kal damav lakkohen
Vachachamim omrim kol zeman sheyyad haggoy baemtza petura min habbechora

a: May lav abbehema la aubbar
Dayeka name dekatane konsin oto ad asara bedamav shema minah
Mesayea leh leresh lakish deamar resh lakish hammocher behema gassa legoy konsin oto ad asara bedameha
Daveka o lav daveka ta shema deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hammocher avdo legoy konsin oto ad mea bedamav shane eved dechol yoma veoma mafka leh mimmitzot
Veika deamri amar resh lakish hammocher behema gassa legoy konsin oto ad mea bedameha tenan vehannoten lo bekabbala af al pi sheeno rashshay konsin oto ad asara bedameha
Mechira paska mineh kabbelanut la paska mineh
Daveka o lav daveka ta shema deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hammocher avdo legoy konsin oto ad asara bedamav shane eved dela hadar leh
Behema may tama mishshum deka hadra leh nikneseh tefe chad ella eved milta dela shechicha hi vechol milta dela shechicha la gezaru beh rabbanan
Vachachamim omrim kol zeman sheyyad haggoy ku amar rabbi yehoshua ushnehem mikra echad darshu kol bechor
Rabbanan savri bechor miktzat bechor mashma ketav rachamana kol ad deika kulleh verabbi yehuda savar bechor kulleh bechor mashma ketav rachamana kol daafilu kol dehu
Ibaet ema dechulle alma bechor rubba mashma mar savar kol mashma lemalloye ata umar savar legaroe ata
Vechamma tehe shuttafut shel goy uthe petura min habbechora amar rav huna afilu ozno matkef lah rav nachman velema leh shekel oznach vezil
Itmar rav chisda amar davar sheose oto nevela verava amar davar sheose oto terefa
Bemay kamipalgi bitrefa chayya leman deamar davar sheose oto terefa kasavar terefa enah chayya ulman deamar davar sheose oto nevela aval terefa chayya
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa ha derav huna verav chisda verava la peligi ha bo ha beimmo
Amar lehu rav pappa may shena bo devaenan kol bechor veleka immo name baenan kol miknecha tizzachar veleka ella la shena
Matkef lah mar bar rav ashe may shena minnefalim deaf al gav delav bene chiyyuta ninhu kadshi deamar mar peter sheger behema sheger bivhema
Hatam kevan dela arivu behu chullin karena behu bivhema kal bechor hacha kevan dearivu behu chullin la karena behu kol bechor
Rabbi elazar la al leve midresha ashkecheh lerabbi assi amar leh may amur rabbanan be midresha amar leh
b: Hachi amar rabbi yochanan afilu mum kal vehaditnan rachel sheyyalda min ez veez sheyyalda min rachel petura min habbechora veim yesh bo miktzat simanin chayyav mum kavua have lishchot alav
Bishlama mum kal ka mashma lan kidrav huna ulappoke midderav chisda verava
Ella mum kavua may ka mashma lan dechevan deishtanni have leh muma tenena ufiv dome keshel chazir hare ze mum
Vechi tema hatam nishtanna bedavar sheen bemino kadosh bivchora hacha nishtanna bedavar shebbemino kadosh bivchora ha name tenena eno achat gedola veachat ketanna

Vetanna gedola gedola keshel egel uktanna ketanna keshel avaz bishlama ketanna keshel avaz en bemino kadosh bivchora ella gedola keshel egel yesh bemino kadosh bivchora ella lav mishshum deamrinan kevan deishtanni have leh muma
La mishshum dehave leh sarua hachi name mistabbera ditnan mumin ellu ben kevuin ben ovrin poslin yater alehen adam enav shettehen gedolot shettehen ketannot
Gabbe adam hu dichtiv ish ish mizzera aharon devaenan ish shave bezaro shel aharon aval behema shettehen gedolot shettehen ketannot name la have muma
Achat gedola veachat ketanna may tama i mishshum shinuy afilu shettehen gedolot shettehen ketannot name ella lav mishshum dehave leh sarua

La leolam ema lach mishshum shinuy shinuy have muma udka kashya lach afilu shettehen gedolot shettehen ketannot hatam i mechamat beriyyuta yattira tarvayehu bae lemivra i mechamat kechishuta yattira tarvayehu bae michchash
Hahi giyyorta dahao masrin lah ache cheveta lefattomah atay lekammeh derava amar lah let dechash lah leha derabbi yehuda deamar shuttafut goy chayyevet bivchora
Rav mari bar rachel haveya leh hahi chevata hava makne leudnayehu legoy veasar lehu begiza vaavoda veyahev lehu lechohanim uchlay chevata derav mari bar rachel

Vechi meachar deasar lehu begiza vaavoda veyahev lehu lechohanim ammay makne lehu leudnayehu legoy dilma ate behu lide takkala i hachi may tama kelo chevata derav mari mishshum demafka lehu mikkedushtayehu

Vehaamar rav yehuda muttar laadam lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyatza laavir haolam hatam mikkedushshat mizbeach ka mafka leh mikkedushshat kohen la mafka leh hacha afilu mikkedushshat kohen ka mafka leh
Veibaet ema rav mari bar rachel yada leaknoye kinyan gamur vechaze leh inish acharina veazel veaved vesavar rav mari milta hu daavad veate bah lide takkala
Matni kohanim ulviyyim peturin mikkal vachomer im patru et shel yisrael bammidbar din hu sheyyifteru et shel atzman

a: Gema inhu patri adam adam patar behema behema patra dichtiv kach et halviyyim tachat bechor bivne yisrael veet behemat halviyyim tachat behemtam
Amar abbaye hachi kaamar kohanim ulviyyim peturin behemtam mikkal vechomer im hifkia behemtam shel leviyyim behema shel yisrael bammidbar din hu shettafkia et shel atzman
Amar leh rava veha patru inhu katane
Veod im ita afilu mibbechor behema tehora nippatru allema tenan lo nifteru mibbechor behema tehora ella mippidon habben ufeter chamor
Ella amar rava hachi katane kohanim ulviyyim patru hen atzman mikkal vachomer im hifkia kedushshatan shel leviyyim kedushshat shel yisrael bammidbar lo yafkia et shel atzman

Ashkechan adam behema temea menalan amar kera ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde kol sheyyeshno bivchor adam yeshno bivchor behema temea vechol sheeno bivchor adam eno bivchor behema temea
Amar leh rav safra leabbaye ledidach deamratte behemtam ben levi dahava leh se deafka lafka dela hava leh se delafka la lafka
Ben ledidach ben lerava ben chodesh deafka lafka pachot mibben chodesh dela afka la lafka
Leviyya la tafka allema amar rav adda bar ahava leviyya sheyyalda benah patur mechamesh selaim
Ha la kashya kidmar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava deamar peter rechem befeter rechem tela rachamana
Veaharon shello haya beoto minyan la lafka detanya lamma nakud al aharon shebbechomesh happekudim shello haya beoto minyan
Amar kera halviyyim hukshu kol halviyyim ze laze
Kohanim menalan kidrabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi beesrim vearbaa mekomot nikreu kohanim leviyyim veze echad mehen vehakkohanim halviyyim bene tzadok
b: Uldorot menalan amar kera vehau li halviyyim vehau bahavayatan yehu
Umimmay divse amar rav chisda neemar kesef ledorot veneemar se ledorot
Ma kesef haamur ledorot bo padu ledorot bo padu leotah shaa af se haamur ledorot bo padu ledorot bo padu beotah shaa
Ma lechesef shachen podin bo hekdeshot umaaser sheni

Ella amar kera ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde ma bechor adam lo chillakta ben ledorot ben leotah shaa bechesef af behema temea lo tachlok bo ben ledorot ben leotah shaa bese
Amar rabbi chanina se echad shel ben levi patar kamma pitre chamorim miyyisrael amar abbaye teda shehare mana hakkatuv odfim beadam velo mana odfin bivhema
Mimmay dilma la have nefishi lehu behemot tuva la salka datach dichtiv umikne rav haya livne reuven velivne gad
Dilma afilu hachi peshutim dilviyyim hao kayemi levahade bechore yisrael amar kera veet behemat halviyyim tachat behemtam behema achat tachat behemot harbe
Veema behema rabba im ken lichtov kera o behema tachat behema o behemtam tachat behemtam may behemat techat behemtam shema minah chad patar tuva

Amar rava af anan name tenena ufode bo peamim harbe verabbi chanina tama dematnitin mefaresh vehachi kaamar may tama pode bo peamim harbe mishshum dese echad shel ben levi poter kamma pitre chamorim shel yisrael
Itmar rabbi yochanan amar kadshu bechorot bammidbar veresh lakish amar lo kadshu bechorot bammidbar
Rabbi yochanan amar kadshu bechorot bammidbar derachamana amar likdeshu dichtiv kaddesh li chol bechor
Veresh lakish amar lo kadshu bechorot bammidbar middichtiv vehaya ki yeviacha uchtiv batreh vehaavarta mikkelal demeikara la kedush
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish ad shello hukam hammishkan hau bamot muttarot vaavoda bivchorot amar leh beotan sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim
Hachi name mistabbera dei la tema hachi ben shana bar mebad avoda hu
Udkaare lah may kaare lah
Hachi ka kashya leh i amratte bishlama dela pasek kedushtayehu hanach demeikara name la paka kedushtayehu ella i amratte defasek kedushtayehu hanach demeikara name paka leh kedushtayehu
Veidach dikdush kedush dela kedush la kedush

Etiveh oto hayyom shehukam hammishkan karvu bo lahem beyisrael nedarim undavot chattaot vaashamot bechorot umaasrot hachi name beotan sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim uminah oto hayyom hu dikruv mikan veelach la keruv

Ika deamri etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan oto hayyom shehukam hammishkan karvu lahem yisrael nedarim undavot chattaot vaashamot bechorot umaasrot oto hayyom in mikan veelach la ema meoto hayyom veelach
Umay kamashma lan meoto hayyom in meikara la alma chovot bevama la keruv

Ta shema nimtzeta atta omer bishlosha mekomot kadshu bechorot leyisrael bemitzrayim uvammidbar uvichnisatan yisrael leeretz bemitzrayim mahu omer kaddesh li chol bechor bammidbar hu omer ki li chol bechor bivne yisrael bichnisatam laaretz hu omer vehaya ki yeviacha vehaavarta
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak bishlosha mekomot huzharu al habbechorot likdash velo kadshu uvmitzrayim name la kedush ha kaamrinan dikdush hachi amar mehen kadshu umehen lo kadshu
Matkef lah rav pappa uvammidbar lo kadshu vehachtiv pekod kol bechor zachar livne yisrael ella i itmar hachi itmar rabbi yochanan amar kadshu velo pasku veresh lakish amar kadshu

a: Ufasku
Bishlama resh lakish kidamar taam ella lerabbi yochanan may tama
Amar rabbi elazar rabbi yochanan chazay bechelma demilta meallayeta amena amar kera li yihu bahavayatan yehu
Verabbi yochanan vehaya ki yeviacha vehaavarta may aved leh hahu mibe leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael ase mitzva zo shebbishvilah tikanes laaretz
Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe attun hachi matnitu lah anan ipcha matninan lah rabbi yochanan amar lo kadshu bechorot bammidbar veresh lakish amar kadshu bechorot bammidbar
Amar leh veafchit name teuvata veafchitu lah leha derabbi elazar amar leh lo kadshu lehu lo hutzrechu likdash
I hachi hayenu didan ka mashma lan chayyav adam lomar bilshon rabbo
Shaal kunterukus hassar et rabban yochanan ben zakkay bifratan shel leviyyim atta motze esrim ushnayim elef ushlosh meot bichlalan atta motze esrim ushnayim elef ushlosh meot lehechan halchu
Amar lo otan shelosh meot bechorot hau veen bechor mafkia bechor may tama amar abbaye dayyo labbechor sheyyafkia kedushshat atzmo
Veod shealo begibuy kesef atta motze matayim veachat kikkar veachat esre mane dichtiv beka laggulgolet machatzit hashshekel beshekel hakkodesh vego

Uvintinat hakkesef atta motze meat kikkar dichtiv vayehi meat kikkar hakkesef latzeket vego moshe rabbechem gannav haya o kuvustus haya o eno baki becheshbonot natan mechetza venatal mechetza umechetza shalem lo hechezir
Amar lo moshe rabbenu gizbar neeman haya uvaki becheshbonot haya umane shel kodesh kaful haya
Have bah rav achay may ka kashya leh vayehi meat kikkar hakkesef latzeket vego hanach latzeket veinach be gazza ketav kera acharina vechesef pekude haeda meat kikkar vego
Udkaamar leh mane shel kodesh kaful haya mena leh
Ilema mineh shehare kan shivim veechad mane veet haalef ushva meot vachamishsha veshivim asa vavim laammudim velo menaan hakkatuv ella bifrotrot veim ita mea veechad kikkar veachat esre mane mibe leh
Ella middelo menaan hakkatuv ella bifrotrot shema minah mane shel kodesh kaful haya
Vedilma kelale kachashev bechakkere perati la ka chashev bechakkere
Ella mehacha unchoshet hattenufa shivim kikkar vealpayim vearba meot shakel shehare kan tishim veshishsha mane velo menaan hakkatuv ella bifrotrot shema minah mane shel kodesh kaful haya
Vedilma perata rabba ka chashev bechakkere perata zuta la kachashev bechakkere
Ella amar rav chisda mehacha vehashshekel esrim gera esrim shekalim chamishsha veesrim shekalim asara vachamishsha shekel hammane yihye lachem
b: Veha matan vearbein haveyan ella shema minah mane shel kodesh mane kaful haya
Ushma minah mosifin al hammiddot veen mosifin yater al shetut ushma minah shetuta millevar

Amar rabbi chanina shaalti et rabbi eliezer bevet motva rabba ma nishtannu pitre chamorim mippitre susim ugmallim amar li gezerat hakkatuv hi veod shessiyeu yisrael bishat yetziatam mimmitzrayim sheen lach kol echad veechad miyyisrael shello hau immo tishim chamorim luvim teunim mikkaspah uzhavah shel mitzrayim

Veod sheiltiv may leshon refidim veamar li refidim shemah ketannae rabbi eliezer omer refidim shemah rabbi yehoshua omer sheripu atzman middivre tora vechen hu omer lo hifnu avot el banim merifon yadayim
Veod sheiltiv may leshon shittim veamar li shittim shemah ketannae rabbi eliezer omer shittim shemah rabbi yehoshua omer shennitasku bedivre shetut
Vattikrena laam lezivche elohehen rabbi eliezer omer arummot pagu bahen rabbi yehoshua omer shennaasu kullan baale kerayin
Matni para sheyyalda min chamor vachamor sheyyalda kemin sus petura min habbechora shenneemar peter chamor peter chamor shene peamim ad sheyehe hayyoled chamor vehannolad chamor
Uma hem baachila behema tehora sheyyalda kemin behema temea muttar baachila utmea sheyyalda kemin behema tehora asur baachila shehayyotze min hattame tame vehayyotze min hattahor tahor
Gema tenan hatam rachel sheyyalda min ez veez sheyyalda min rachel patur min habbechora veim yesh bo miktzat simanin chayyav
Mena hane mile amar rav yehuda deamar kera ach bechor shor sheyehe hu shor uvchoro shor bechor kesev sheyehe hu kesev uvchoro kesev bechor ez sheyehe hu ez uvchoro ez
Yachol afilu yesh bo miktzat simanin talmud lomar ach chillek
Veha tanna peter peter kanasev lah lefara

Hu deamar kerabbi yose haggelili detanya rabbi yose haggelili omer ach bechor shor ad sheyehe hu shor uvchoro shor bechor kesev ad sheyehe hu kesev uvchoro kesev o vechor ez ad sheyehe hu ez uvchoro ez
Yachol afilu yesh bo miktzat simanin talmud lomar ach chillek
Bemay kamipalgi tanna didan savar galli rachamana bikdushshat damim vehu haddin bikdushshat hagguf
Verabbi yose savar galli rachamana bikdushshat hagguf vehu haddin bikdushshat damim vegamar kedushshat damim mikkedushshat hagguf
Vetanna didan hay bechor bechor may aved leh mibe leh lechidrabbi yose berabbi chanina
Deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina lamma neemru emurin bivchor shor emurin bivchor kesev emurin bivchor ez
Tzericha dei ketav rachamana bivchor shor shekken nitrabba binsachim
Kesev shekken nitrabba bealya
Beez shekken nitrabba etzel avoda zara beyachid
Chada mechada la atya tete chada mittarte
Behe la lichtov la lichtov rachamana beshor vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken nitrabbu etzel pesachim
La lichtov bechesev vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken nitrabbu etzel avoda zara betzibur
La nichtov rachamana beez vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken yesh bahen tzad ribbuy etzel mizbeach hilkach tzerichi
Verabbi yose haggelili im ken lichtov kera ach bechor shor kesev veez bechor bechor lema li ella lav shema minah ad sheyehe hu shor uvchoro shor
Verabbi yose haggelili hay peter chamor peter chamor may aved leh

Mibe leh lechidtanya rabbi yose haggelili omer mittoch shenneemar ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde shomea ani afilu pitre susim ugmallim talmud lomar peter chamor peter chamor amarti lecha velo pitre susim ugmallim
Vaadayin ani omer pitre chamor bese pitre susim ugmallim bechol davar

a: Talmud lomar peter chamor peter chamor shene peamim pitre chamorim amarti lecha velo pitre susim ugmallim
Parech rav achay i ketav rachamana chad hava amena davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza min hakkelal lelammed lo lelammed al atzmo yatza ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza ulolam bese
Ketav rachamana peter chamor acharina pitre chamorim velo pitre susim ugmallim veema maatinhu moshe ulolam bechol davar
Im ken lichtov rachamana peter chamor tifde vese vachamor tifde vese peter chamor tifde vese peter chamor tifde vese lema li pitre chamorim amarti lecha velo pitre susim ugmallim
Vetanna didan lemaote susim ugmallim mena leh
Amar rav pappa kol miknecha tizzachar kalal shor vase vachamor parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat shor vase vachamor in mide acharina la
Verabbi yose haggelili peter hifsik hainyan verabbanan vav hadar arveh kera
Verabbi yose haggelili la lichtov la vav vela peter
Verabbanan ayede deha kedushshat damim veha kedushshat hagguf pasek lehu vahadar arev lehu
Ibaya lehu para sheyyalda min chamor veyesh bo miktzat simanin mahu
Ez sheyyalda min rachel verachel sheyyalda min ez dechi yesh miktzat simanin chayyevet bivchora deha tehora veha tehora ha kedushshat hagguf veha kedushshat hagguf
Hacha deha temea veha tehora ha kedushshat hagguf veha kedushshat damim la o dilma kevan deide veide bene mikdash bivchora kadosh
Veim timtze lomar kevan deide veide mikdash bivchora kadosh chamor sheyyalda min sus mahu hacha vadday la bat mikdash bivchora hu o dilma kevan demin temea hu kadosh
Im timtza lomar kevan demin temea hu kadosh para sheyyalda min sus mahu hacha vadday ha tehora veha temea ha bat mikdash bivchora veha la bat mikdash bivchora o dilma simanin milta hi
Ta shema behema tehora sheyyalda min behema temea petura min habbechora im yesh bo miktzat simanin chayyevet bivchora may lav afilu para sheyyalda min sus lo para sheyyalda min chamor
Ta shema para sheyyalda min chamor vachamor sheyyalda min sus petura min habbechora im yesh bo miktzat simanin chayyevet bivchora may lav attarvayehu la appara sheyyalda min chamor

Aval chamor sheyyalda min sus lemay katane lah liftura peshita hashta uma para sheyyalda min chamor deide veide bene mikdash bivchora ninhu amratte im yesh bo miktzat simanin in vei la la chamor sheyyalda min sus mibaya
Itzterich salka datach hatam hu deyesh lah karnayim veha en lah karnayim ha parsoteha sedukot veha parsoteha kelutot
Aval hacha deide veide en lah karnayim ide veide parsoteha kelutot ema chamor adom bealma hu kamashma lan
Uma hen baachila ku lema li lemitne shehayyotze
Simana bealma hu dela tichallaf lach dela tema zil batreh dideh vehay tahor mealleya hu vehay tame mealleya hu ella zil batar imeh

Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ach et ze lo tochlu mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa yesh lecha shehu maale gera umafris parsa vei atta ochlo veeze ze tahor shennolad min hattame o eno ella tame hannolad min hattahor umay mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa
b: Hachi kaamar davar habba mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa la techul talmud lomar gamal tame hu hu tame veen tame hannolad min hattahor tame ella tahor
Rabbi shimon omer gamal gamal shene peamim echad gamal hannolad min haggemalla veechad gamal hannolad min happara
Verabbanan hay gamal gamal may avdi leh chad leesor atzmo vechad leesor chalavo verabbi shimon leesor chalavo mena leh nafka leh meet haggamal verabbanan ettim la darshi

Kidtanya shimon haamsoni haya doresh kol et vaet shebbattora kevan shehiggia leet Adonai elohecha tira perash amru lo talmidav rabbi kol ettin sheddarashta ma tehe alehem amar lahem keshem shekkibbolti sachar al hadderisha kach ani mekabbel sachar al happerisha
Ad shebba rabbi akiva velimed et Adonai elohecha tira lerabbot talmide chachamim
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe ella meatta tama derabbanan miggamal gamal verabbi shimon meet haggamal ha lav hachi hava amena chalav divhema temea shere
May shena meha detanya hattemeim leesor tziran verotvan vekefe shellahen
Itzterich salka datach amena hoil divhema tehora name chidush hu deamar mar dam nekar venaase chalav vechevan dechidush hu bivhema temea name lishtere ka mashma lan
Hanicha leman deamar dam nekar venaase chalav ella leman deamar evareha mitparkin hemenna veen nafshah chozeret aleha ad esrim vearbaa chodesh may ika lememar
Itzterich salka datach amena hoil veleka mide deate mechay vesharyeh rachamana vehay chalav ki ever min hachay hu ushre vehilkach afilu bivhema temea lishtere ka mashma lan
Vechalav divhema tehora menalan dishre ilema middaasar rachamana basar bechalav ha lechudeh shere veema chalav lechudeh asur baachila umuttar bahanaa basar bechalav bahanaa name asur
Ulrabbi shimon deshare bahanaa mashkachatte lah lemilke al bishuleh
Ella middegalli rachamana devifsule hammukdashin tizbach velo giza basar velo chalav ha dechullin shere
Veema dechullin asur baachila ushre bahanaa dekadashim bahanaa name asur
Ella middichtiv vede chalev izzim lelachmecha lelechem betecha vechayyim lenaarotecha
Vedilma lischora ella middichtiv veet aseret charitze hechalav
Vedilma lischora attu darkah shel milchama lischora
Veibaet ema mehacha eretz zavat chalav udvash vei la dishre mishtabbach lan kera bemide dela chaze veibaet ema mehacha lechu shivru veecholu ulchu shivru belo chesef uvlo mechir yayin vechalav
Ella meatta shafan shafan arnevet arnevet chazir chazir lehane hu deatu
Ella lechidtanya lamma nishnu babbehema mippene hashshesua uvaofot mippene haraa
Gamal gamal name lehachi hu daata kol hecha deika lemidrash darshinan
Tanu rabbanan rachel sheyyalda min ez veez sheyyalda min rachel petura min habbechora veim yesh bo miktzat simanim chayyevet rabbi shimon omer ad sheyehe rosho verubbo dome leimmo
Ibaya lehu laachila mi bae rabbi shimon rosho verubbo o la
Leinyan bechora ketiv ach bechor shor ad sheyehe hu shor uvchoro shor aval laachila gamal hu deamar rachamana daasir ha

a: Ishtanni miggamal shappir dame o dilma la shena
Ta shema behema tehora sheyyalda min behema temea asur baachila veim dome rosho verubbo leimmo chayyav bivchora shema minah laachila name bae rabbi shimon rosho verubbo
La livchora daveka dayeka name deka shavkah laachila vekam leh abbechor shema minah livchora hu devae rabbi shimon rosho verubbo aval laachila la
Leolam ema lach laachila name bae uvchora itzterich salka datach amena hoil uchtiv ach bechor shor ad sheyehe hu shor uvchoro shor velo tisge leh berosho verubbo ad deika kulleh kamashma lan
Ta shema ach et ze lo tochlu mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa ze i atta ochel aval atta ochel habba besiman echad
Vei ze ze habba besiman echad ze tame hannolad min hattahor veibburo min hattahor
Yachol afilu ibburo min hattame talmud lomar se chesavim vese izzim ad sheyehe aviv keves veimmo kivsa divre rabbi yehoshua

Rabbi eliezer omer lo ba hakkatuv lehattir et hammuttar ella lehosif al hammuttar veeze ze tame hannolad min hattahor veibburo min hattame o eno ella ibburo min hattahor talmud lomar shor se chesavim vese izzim mikkol makom
Kare leh tame kerabbi shimon vekaamar aval atta ochel habba besiman echad
Hay tanna savar leh kevateh bachada uflig aleh bachada
Veika demakshe umotev ibburo min hattame mi miabbera
Vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi leolam en mitabberet lo temea min hattahor velo tehora min hattame velo gassa min haddakka velo dakka min haggassa velo behema min chayya velo chayya min behema
Chutz merabbi eliezer umachlukto shehau omrim chayya mitabberet mibbehema
Veamar rabbi yirmeya deiabbar mikkalut ben para vealliba derabbi shimon kaamar vekaamar aval atta ochel habba besiman echad
Hay tanna savar lah kevateh bachada uflig aleh bachada
Lememra derabbi eliezer savar ze vaze gorem muttar verabbi yehoshua savar ze vaze gorem asur
Veha ipcha shaminan lehu velad terefa rabbi eliezer omer lo yikrav legabbe mizbeach verabbi yehoshua omer yikrav legabbe mizbeach
Bealma savar rabbi eliezer ze vaze gorem asur veshane hacha deim ken nichtov kera se chesavim veizzim se vese lema li shema minah se mikkol makom
Verabbi yehoshua amar lecha bealma ze vaze gorem muttar vehacha im ken lichtov kera shor kesev vaez kesavim veizzim lema li shema minah ad sheyehe aviv keves veimmo kivsa
Ta shema rabbi shimon omer gamal gamal shene peamim echad gamal hannolad min haggamal veechad gamal hannolad min happara veim rosho verubbo dome leimmo muttar baachila
Shema minah laachila name bae rabbi shimon rosho verubbo shema minah
Shehayyotze min hattame vechu beo minah merav sheshet me raglayim shel chamor mahu

Vetibe leh desusim ugmallim desusim ugmallim la mibaya lehu dela achiri vela damu lechalav mayya ul mayya nefuk ki kamibaya lehu dachamor daachiri vedamu lechalav may miggufeh ka mimatztzi vaasiri o dilma mayya ul mayya nefuk vehay daachiri havla devisra hu

Metivi mippene ma amru devash devorim muttar mippene shemmachnisot oto legufan veen mematztzot oto miggufan
Hu deamar kerabbi yaakov deamar duvsha rachamana sharyeh
Detanya rabbi yaakov omer ach et ze tochlu mikkol sheretz haof ze atta ochel vei atta ochel sheretz of tame
Sheretz of tame behedya ketiv ella sheretz of tame i atta ochel aval atta ochel ma sheof tame mashritz veeze ze ze devash devorim

Yachol af devash haggazzin vehatztzirin amarta lo uma raita lerabbot devorim ulhotzi haggazzin vehatztzirin merabbe ani devash devorim sheen lo shem levay umotzi ani devash haggazzin vehatztzirin sheyyesh lo shem levay
Keman azla ha detanya devash haggazzin vehatztzirin tahor umuttar baachila dela kerabbi yaakov
Tahor alma bae machshava tanya name hachi devash bechavarto metamme tumat ochalin shello bemachshava
Chale deyachmurta sevur rabbanan lememar bee ninhu vaasiran amar rav safra zara deayyala hu deazel batar ayyalta veayede derachmah tzar la mizdakka veazel batar yachmurta venatri

Amar leh rav chisda tanya dimsayya lach or habba keneged panav shel adam ben chay ben met tahor may lav ben hu chay veimmo chayya ben hu met veimmo meta
La ben hu chay veimmo meta ben hu met veimmo chayya vehatanya ben hu chay veimmo chayya ben hu met veimmo meta i tanya tanya
Matni dag tame shebbala dag tahor muttar baachila vetahor shebbala dag tame asur baachila lefi sheeno gidulo
Gema tama dachazeneh divla ha la chazeneh divla amri ashrotze ashretz

Tana gamal achor keneged achor

Efe leshivim shana uchnegdo bailan charuv charuv ze mishsheat netiato ad sheat gemar perotav shivim shana vime iburo shalosh shanim nachash lesheva shanim uloto rasha lo matzinu chaver veyesh omrim mochsasim
Mena hane mile amar rav yehuda amar rav umatu bah mishshum derabbi yehoshua ben chananya shenneemar arur atta mikkol habbehema umikkol chayyat hassade im mibbehema nitkallela mechayya lo kol shekken
Ella lomar lach keshem shennitkallela habbehema mechayya echad leshiva umay nihu chamor mechatul kach nitkallel hu mibbehema achat lesheva dehave leh shav shene
Ema keshem shennitkallela chayya mibbehema achat leshalosh shanim umay nihu ari mechamor kach nitkallel hu mechayya achat leshalosh shanim dehave leh tesha shanim

Veema keshem shennitkallela behema mechayya echad leshalosh umay nihu ez mechatul kach nitkallel hu mibbehema echad leshalosh dehave leh chamesar yarche
Ibaet ema mikkol habbehema ketiv i baet ema kelala hu kelala shedi ilaveh

Veha chakkime inhu anan chachiminan minayehu i chachimatte zil zakkinhu veayetinhu li amar leh kamma hau shitin gavre

Ika deamri lema dela kerabbi yose haggelili dei rabbi yose haggelili haamar efshar letzamtzem amar abbaye afilu tema rabbi yose haggelili shane hatam dichtiv hazzecharim la
Bishlama lerabbi yirmeya dela moke lah kerabbi yose haggelili hayenu dela katane veyatzu shene rashehen keechad ella leabbaye litne veyatzu shene rashehen keechad
Veod tanya chamoro shello bikra veyalda shene zecharim veyatzu shene rashehen keechad rabbi yose haggelili omer shenehen lakkohen shenneemar hazzecharim la

b: Verabbanan lema kasavri rabbanan miktzat rechem makdesh dei kulleh rechem makdesh nehi dei efshar letzamtzem chatzitza miha ika

Alma kevan dela mafka leisureh asur bahanaa matnitin manni rabbi yehuda hi detanya peter chamor asur bahanaa verabbi shimon mattir
May tama derabbi yehuda amar ulla yesh lecha davar shetztzarich pediyya umuttar vela vahare bechor adam shetztzarich pediyya umuttar ella yesh lecha davar shehikpida alav tora bese umuttar

Vahare maaser shehikpida alav tora bechesef tzori utnan rabbi yehuda omer bemezid kidesh
Befeter chamor name mikaddesha kidrabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar ishsha yodaat sheen maaser sheni mitchallel al yadah veola veochalto birushalayim
Hacha name ishsha yodaat defeter chamor isura it beh ufarka leh bese umakdesha behach devene uvene
Verabbi shimon may tame amar ulla yesh lecha davar sheppidono muttar vehu asur
Vela vahare sheviit defidonah muttar vehi asura
Sheviit name pidonah asur deamar mar haacharon acharon asur

Veibaet ema rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon behay kera kamipalgi detanya lo taavod bivchor shorecha aval atta oved beshellecha uvshel acherim velo tagoz bechor tzonecha aval atta gozez shellecha veshel acherim divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi shimon omer lo taavod bivchor shorecha aval atta oved bivchor adam lo tagoz bechor tzonecha aval atta gozez bechor chamor
Bishlama lerabbi shimon hayenu dichtiv tere kerae ella lerabbi yehuda tere kerae lemaote shellecha veshel acherim lema li vetu lerabbi yehuda bechor adam name nema daasir
Ella dechulle alma shorecha lemaote bechor adam hu daata ki peligi betzonecha derabbi yehuda letameh deamar shuttafut goy chayyevet bivchora vechi itzterich kera lemishre begizza vaavoda
Verabbi shimon savar shuttafut goy petura min habbechora ulinyan gizza vaavoda la itzterich kera ki itzterich kera lefeter chamor
Bishlama lerabbi yehuda hayenu dichtiv tzonecha veshorecha attu tzonecha ella lerabbi shimon shorecha vetzonecha lema li kashya
Amar rabba umode rabbi shimon leachar arifa shehu asur
May tama gamar arifa arifa meegla arufa
Amar rava mena amena leh detanya haorla vechile hakkerem veshor hanniskal veegla arufa vetzipore metzora ufeter chamor uvasar bechalav kullan mittammein tumat ochalin
Rabbi shimon omer kullan en mittammein tumat ochalin umode rabbi shimon bevasar bechalav shemmetamme tumat ochalin hoil vehayeta lo sheat hakkosher

Veamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan may tama derabbi shimon dichtiv mikkol haochel asher yeachel ochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim karuy ochel shei atta yachol lehaachilo laacherim eno karuy ochel

a: I hachi basar bechalav may irya dehayeta lah sheat hakkosher tipok li deochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim hu

Detanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon basar bechalav asur baachila umuttar bahanaa shenneemar ki am kadosh atta la elohecha ulhallan hu omer veanshe kodesh tihun li ma lehallan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa af kan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa
Chada veod kaamar chada deochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim hu veod ledideh name hare hayeta lo sheat hakkosher
Veim ita dilachar arifa share rabbi shimon litne umode rabbi shimon befeter chamor uvasar bechalav shemmittammein tumat ochalin
I dechashshev aleh hachi name hacha bemay askinan dela chashshev aleh
Vetama may metammei rabbanan amruha rabbanan kammeh derav sheshet hoil veisuro chishuvo
Ulrabbanan mi amar hoil veisuro chishuvo veha tenan shelosha asar devarim amru benivlat of tahor vezo achat mehen tzericha machshava veenah tzericha hechsher
Vei isuro chishuvo lema li machshava ha manni rabbi shimon hi
Ta shema nivlat behema temea bechol makom venivlat of tahor vehachelev bakkefarim tzerichim machshava veenam tzerichim hechsher vei amratte isuro chishuvo lema li machshava ha manni rabbi shimon hi
Ta shema nivlat behema tehora bechol makom venivlat of hattahor vehachelev bashshevakim enan tzerichin machshava velo hechsher ha temea baaya machshava

Vechi tema ha manni rabbi shimon hi ha middesefa rabbi shimon have resha lav rabbi shimon dekatane sefa rabbi shimon omer af haggamal vehaarnevet vehashshafan vehachazir enan tzerichin lo machshava velo hechsher veamar rabbi shimon ma taam hoil veyesh bahen simane tohora
Ella amar rava dechulle alma la amrinan isuro chishuvo vei dearfeh miraf hachi name
b: Hacha bemay askinan kegon sheshshechato lehitlammed bo uviflugta denimos verabbi eliezer
Detanya amar rabbi yose sach li nimos achiv shel rabbi yehoshua haggarsi shehashshochet et haorev lehitlammed bo damo machshir rabbi eliezer omer dam shechita leolam machshir
Rabbi eliezer hayenu tanna kamma ella lav isuro chishuvo ika benayehu
Tanna kamma savar damo machshir lealma aval legufeh bae machshava
Vaata rabbi eliezer lememar dam shechita leolam machshir vaafilu legufeh name la bae machshava
Mimmay dilma tama derabbi eliezer hatam deshane orev hoil veyesh bo simane tohora
Umnalan desimane tohora milta hi dekatane alah dehahi amar rabbi shimon ma taam hoil veyesh bo simane tohora
Vechi tema i mishshum simane tohora may irya lehitlammed afilu lehitassek name in hachi name umishshum nimos
Etiveh lo ratza lifdoto orfo bekofitz meachorav vekovro veasur bahanaa divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon mattir
Ema umechayyim asur bahanaa verabbi shimon mattir
Veha middesefa mechayyim have resha lav mechayyim

Dekatane sefa lo yemitennu lo bekane velo bemaggal velo bekardom velo bimgera velo yachnisennu lacheder veyinol delet lefanav bishvil sheyyamut veasur begiza vaavoda divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon mattir
Resha vesefa mechayyim resha bahanaat damav sefa bahanaat gufo

Utzricha dei tena hanaat damav behahu ka share rabbi shimon aval bahanaat gufo ema mode leh lerabbi yehuda vei tena bahanaat gufo behahi kaasar rabbi yehuda aval bahanaat damav ema mode lerabbi shimon tzericha
Vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh mode rabbi shimon leachar arifa shehu asur
Veamar rav nachman mena amena lah detanya vaarafto neemar kan arifa veneemar lehallan arifa ma lehallan asur af kan asur
Manni ilema rabbi yehuda mechayyim mesar asar ella lav rabbi shimon hi
Amar leh rav sheshet safra chavrach targumah leolam rabbi yehuda veitzterich salka datach amena arifa bimkom pediyya omedet ma pediyya matteret af arifa matteret ka mashma lan
Amar rav nachman mena amena lah middetane levi hu hifsid mamono shel kohen lefichach yufsad mamono
Manni ilema rabbi yehuda ha mafsad vekae ella lav rabbi shimon hi
Ibaet ema rabbi yehuda veibaet ema rabbi shimon
Ibaet ema rabbi yehuda appeseda devene bene
Veibaet ema rabbi shimon lifchat mita
Vechen amar resh lakish mode rabbi shimon leachar arifa shehu asur verabbi yochanan vei tema rabbi elazar amar adayin hi machloket
Ika dematne lah leha derav nachman aha hamkaddesh befeter chamor enah mekuddeshet lema matnitin dela kerabbi shimon amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh leachar arifa vedivre hakkol
Ika deamri ha manni la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi shimon i rabbi shimon tikdash bechulleh i rabbi yehuda tikdash behach devene bene

Amar rabba bar avuh amar rav leolam rabbi yehuda uchgon sheeno shave ella shekel vesavar lah kerabbi yose bar yehuda detanya tifde tifde tifde miyyad tifde kol shehu rabbi yose bar yehuda omer en pediyya pechuta mishshekel
Amar mar tifde tifde tifde miyyad tifde kol shehu peshita
Itzterich salka datach amena hoil veitakkash livchor adam ma bechor adam achar sheloshim vechamesh hay name achar sheloshim vechamesh
Ka mashma lan tifde miyyad tifde kol shehu
Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer en pediyya pechuta mishshekel mimma nafshach i makkesh livchor adam chamesh live vei la makkesh shekel mena leh
Leolam la makkesh amar rava amar kera vechol erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh kol arachin sheatta maarich lo yehu pechutin mishshekel
Verabbanan hahu

a: Behesseg yad ketiv
Amar rav nachman halacha kedivre chachamim vechamma amar rav yosef afilu patroza bar danka amar rava af anan name tenena gadol vekatan
Peshita mahu detema kulle hay la i name patroza la ka mashma lan
Rabbi yehuda nesia hava leh peter chamor shaddereh lekammeh derabbi tarfon amar leh kamma baena lemitav lechohen amar leh hare amru ayin yafa besela ayin raa beshekel benonit berigya
Amar rava hilcheta berigya vechamma telata zuze regil hacha veragil hacha
Kashya hilcheta ahilcheta la kashya kan beva limalech kan beose meatzmo
Amar rabbi yitzchak amar resh lakish mi sheyyesh lo peter chamor veen lo se lifdoto podehu beshoveo leman ilema lerabbi yehuda ha amar hikpida alav tora bese ella lerabbi shimon
Rav acha matni hachi ravina kashya leh rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon halacha kerabbi yehuda
Ustam lan tanna kerabbi yehuda veatte amratte halacha kerabbi shimon
Ella afilu tema rabbi yehuda lo yehe chamur min hahekdesh velo amra tora bese lehachmir alav ella lehakel alav rav nachman bereh derav yosef parek leh beshilke beshoveo
Amar rav shezvi amar rav huna happode peter chamor shel chavero pidono paduy ibaya lehu pidono lappode o dilma pidono labbealim
Alliba derabbi shimon la tibe lach kevan deamar muttar bahanaa mamona divalim hu ki tibe alliba derabbi yehuda deamar asur bahanaa
Lehekdesh medamme leh verachamana amar venatan hakkesef vekam lo o dilma kevan dekane lehu bevene uvene la dame lehekdesh
Amar rav nachman ta shema haggonev peter chamor shel chavero meshallem tashlume chefel labbealim veaf al pi sheen lo achshav yesh lo leachar mikkan
Manni ilema rabbi shimon ammay en lo achshav ella peshita rabbi yehuda
Vei salka datach lehekdesh medammenan leh vegunnav mibbet haish amar rachamana velo mibbet hekdesh vetu la mide
Achat bikra veachat shello bikra ku tanu rabbanan ketzad amru nichnas ledir lehitasser

I atta yachol lomar beva leyad kohen shehare shaninu hallakuach veshennitan lo bemattana patur mimmasar behema ella beyisrael shehau lo asara sefek pitre chamorim betoch beto shemmafrish alehen asara seyin umasseran vehen shello
Mesayya leh lerav nachman deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh yisrael shehau lo asara sefek pitre chamorim mafrish alehen asara seyin umasseran vehen shello
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh yisrael shehau lo asara pitre chamorim vaddain betoch beto shennaflu mibbet avi immo kohen veoto avi immo kohen naflu lo mibbet avi immo yisrael
Mafrish alehen asara seyin umasseran vehen shello
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh yisrael shehau lo tevalim memorachin betoch beto shennaflu mibbet avi immo kohen veoto avi immo kohen naflu lo mibbet avi immo yisrael measseran vehen shello
Utzricha dei ashmeinan kammayeta mishshum deka mafrash vekae
Aval hacha mattanot shello hurmu kemi shello hurmu damyan ema la
Vei ashmeinan hacha deefshar leassore mineh uveh deha mannach aval hatam kevan dese mealma bae etoye umafrash vekae ema la tzericha
Amar rabbi shemuel bar natan amar rabbi chanina hallokeach tevalim
b: Memorachin min haggoy measseran vehen shello
Demarchinhu man ilema demarchinhu goy degancha amar rachamana velo degan goy
Ella demarchinhu yisrael mershut goy measseran deen kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lehafkia miyyad maaser vehen shello deamar leh kaatena mikkoach gavra dela matzet ishtaet ishtaoye dina bahadeh
Tenan hatam hammafkid perotav etzel hakkuti veetzel am haaretz bechezkatan lammaaser velashsheviit
Etzel haggoy keferotav rabbi shimon omer demay
Amar rabbi elazar lehafrish kulle alma la peligi ki peligi litnan lechohen tanna kamma savar vadday challefinhu uvae mitnanhu lechohen verabbi shimon savar demay

Yatev rav dimi vekaamar leha shemata amar leh abbaye tama dimsappeka lan i challefinhu i la challefinhu ha vadday challefinhu dechulle alma bae lemitvinhu lechohen vehaamar rabbi shemuel amar rabbi chanina hallokeach tevalim min haggoy memorachin measseran vehen shello
Dilma kan bitruma gedola kan bitrumat maaser

Azkartan milta deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi minnayin lallokeach tevalim memorachin min haggoy shehu patur mitterumat maaser shenneemar veel halviyyim tedabber veamarta alehem ki tikchu meet bene yisrael tevalim sheatta lokeach mibbene yisrael atta mafrish mehen terumat maaser venotnah lakkohen tevalim sheatta lokeach min haggoy i atta mafrish mehen terumat maaser venotnah lakkohen
Veim met nehenim bo demit hecha ilema demit be chohen venehene bo kohen peshita mamona dideh hu ella demit be vealim venehene bo kohen ha name peshita
Salka datach amena kol kamma dela meta lideh la zecha beh ka mashma lan demeidana deafresheh birshuteh dechohen kae

a: Matni en podin lo beegel velo bechayya lo bishchuta velo bitrefa velo bechilayim velo bechoy verabbi eliezer mattir bakkilayim mippene shehu se veoser bakkoy mippene shehu safek netano lechohen en hakkohen rashshay lekayemo ad sheyyafrish se tachtav
Gema matnitin manni ben bag bag hi detanya ben bag bag omer neemar kan se veneemar lehallan se ma lehallan perat lechol hashshemot hallalu af kan perat lechol hashshemot hallalu
I ma lehallan zachar tamim uven shana af kan zachar tamim uven shana talmud lomar tifde tifde riba
I tifde tifde riba afilu kol hane name im ken se se may ahani leh

Ibaya lehu mahu lifdot beven pekua alliba derabbi meir la tibe lach dechevan deamar rabbi meir ben pekua taun shechita se mealleya hu ella ki tibbee lach alliba derabbanan deamri shechitat immo metaharto
Kevisra bedikula dame o dilma kevan dehashta miha rahet veazel se karena beh
Mar zutra amar en podin verav ashe amar podin
Amar leh rav ashe lemar zutra may datach deyalfatte mippesach i ma lehallan zachar tamim uven shana af kan zachar tamim uven shana tifde tifde riba
I tifde tifde riba afilu ben pekua name im ken se se may ahani leh
Ibaya lehu mahu lifdot benidma alliba derabbi eliezer la tibe lach hashta bechilayim parkinan benidma mibaya
Ki tibe lach alliba derabbanan bechilayim hu dela parkinan benidma parkinan o dilma la shena
Ta shema para sheyyalda min ez en podin ha rachel sheyyalda min ez podin manni ilema rabbi eliezer ha bechilayim name parkinan ella lav rabbanan hi
La leolam rabbi eliezer hi gufah ka mashma lan defara sheyyalda min ez en podin la tema zil abbatreh dideh vehay ez mealleya hu ella zil batar imeh vehay egel hu

Ta shema detane rabba bar shemuel ezehu kilayim rachel sheyyalda min ez veaviv se aviv se kilayim hu nidme hu ella ezehu dame lechilayim deshavveuh rabbanan ki chilayim rachel sheyyalda min ez veaviv se
Lemay i lekadashim mehecha dimmaet kilayim mehatam memaet nidme detanya shor o chesev perat lechilayim o ez perat lenidme
I livchor ach bechor shor amar rachamana ad sheyehe hu shor uvchoro shor
Ella lemaaser tachat tachat mikkodashim gamar ella lefeter chamor
La leolam lemaaser uchgon sheyyesh bo miktzat simanin mahu detema haavara haavara mibbechor gamar
Ka mashma lan tachat tachat mikkodashim gamar
Ibaya lehu mahu lifdot bifsule hammukdashin
Alliba derabbi shimon la tibe lach kevan deamar muttar bahanaa chullin hu ki tibe lach alliba derabbi yehuda deamar asur bahanaa
May kevan deasur bahanaa en isur chal al isur
O dilma kevan dela tafes pidono afkoe isura bealma hu
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana mi zutar may dichtiv behu katztzevi vechaayyal ma tzevi veayyal en podin af pesule hammukdashin en podin
Hashta deatet lehachi
b: Lerabbi shimon name tzevi veayyal ketiv behu
Ibaya lehu mahu lifdot bevehemat sheviit
Vadday la tibe lach laachila amar rachamana velo lischora ki tibe lach safek
Vealliba derabbi shimon la tibe lach delet leh safek ki tibe lach alliba derabbi yehuda
May kevan demafresh tale vehu leatzmo leochla karena beh o dilma kevan dechamma dela mafka isureh la mishtere kischora dame
Ta shema deamar rav chisda behemat sheviit en podin bah et havadday aval podin bah et hassafek
Veamar rav chisda behemat sheviit petura min habbechora vechayyevet bammattanot
Petura min habbechora leochla amar rachamana velo lisrefa vechayyevet bammattanot dilachla karena bah
Metivi haochel meisat sheviit ad shello hurma challatah chayyav mita
Veammay kevan deilu mittammeya bat serefa hi leochla amar rachamana velo lisrefa
Shane hacha dichtiv ledorotechem
Tanya name hachi minnayin laochel meisat sheviit ad shello hurma challatah shechayyav mita shenneemar ledorotechem
Veligmar minah hatam ikar laachila hacha ikar lisrefa
Netano lechohen ku tenena leha detanu rabbanan yisrael shehaya lo peter chamor betoch beto veamar lo hakkohen tenehu li vaani efdehu hare ze lo yittenu lo ella im ken pedao befanav
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh zot omeret nechshedu hakkohanim al pitre chamorim peshita mahu detema hane mile hecha demachzak lan demikre aval bistama la ka mashma lan demore bah hetera
Matni hammafrish pidon peter chamor vamet rabbi eliezer omer chayyavin beachrauto kachamesh selaim shel ben vachachamim omrim en chayyavin beachrauto kefidon maaser sheni

Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi tzadok al pidon peter chamor shemmet sheen kan lakkohen kelum met peter chamor rabbi eliezer omer yikkaver umuttar bahanaato shel tale vachachamim omrim en tzarich lehikkaver vetale lakkohen
Gema amar rav yosef may tama derabbi eliezer dichtiv ach pado tifde vego ma bechor adam chayyav beachrauto af bechor behema temea chayyav beachrauto
Amar leh abbaye i ma bechor adam muttar bahanaa af bechor behema temea muttar vechi tema hachi name vehatnan met peter chamor rabbi eliezer omer yikkaver may yikkaver lav deasur bahanaa
La yikkaver kivchor adam ella adam bechor hu devae kevura pashut la bae kevura
Veod tanya mode rabbi eliezer beyisrael sheyyesh lo sefek peter chamor betoch beto shemmafrish tale alav vehu shello
Ella amar rava amar kera ach pado tifde lifdiyya hikkashtiv velo ledavar acher
Tenan hatam haarachin bishatan ufidon habben achar sheloshim yom pidon peter chamor lealtar
Ufidon peter chamor lealtar urminhi en baarachin uvfidon habben uvinzirut uvfeter chamor pachot mishsheloshim
Umosifin ad olam
Amar rav nachman lomar sheim pedao paduy mikkelal divno im pedao eno paduy vehaitmar happode et beno betoch sheloshim yom rav amar beno paduy
Lav itmar alah amar rava dechulle alma meachshav en beno paduy

a: Rav sheshet amar lomar sheeno over alav
Metiv rame bar chama mitzvato kol sheloshim yom mikkan veelach o podehu o orfo may lav mitzva leshahoto kol sheloshim yom la mitzva lifdoto kol sheloshim yom
I hachi mikkan veelach o podehu o over alav mibe leh ella amar rava la kashya ha rabbi eliezer demakkeshoy ha rabbanan dela makkeshi
Matni lo ratza lifdoto orfo meachorav vekovro mitzvat happediyya kodemet lemitzvat arifa shenneemar im lo tifde vaarafto
Mitzvat yeida kodemet lemitzvat happediyya shenneemar asher lo yeadah vehefdah
Mitzvat hayyibum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza barishona shehau mitkavvenin leshem mitzva veachshav sheen mitkavvenin leshem mitzva amru mitzvat chalitza kodemet lemitzvat yibbum
Mitzvat haggeulla baadon hu kodem lechol adam shenneemar veim lo yiggael venimkar beerkecha
Hadaran alach hallokeach ubbar chamoro

Matni hallokeach ubbar parato shel nochri vehammocher lo af al pi sheeno rashshay vehammishtattef lo vehamkabbel mimmennu vehannoten lo bekabbala patur min habbechora shenneemar beyisrael aval lo baacherim
Hakkohanim vehalviyyim chayyavim shello nifteru mibbechor behema tehora ella mippidon habben umippeter chamor
Gema may irya detane ubbar chamoro beresha vahadar tane ubbar parato litne beresha ubbar parato dikdushshat hagguf hu vahadar litne ubbar chamoro dikdushshat damim hu
Amri bemareva ibaet ema ayede dachaviva leh kidrabbi chanina vei baet ema ayede dezutran mileh divhema temea pasek veshade lah

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi oshaya yisrael shennatan maot legoy bivhemto bedinehem af al pi shello mashach kana vechayyevet bivchora vegoy shennatan maot leyisrael bivhemto bedinehem af al pi shello mashach kana ufatur min habbechora
Amar mar yisrael shennatan maot legoy bedinehem af al pi shello mashach kana vechayyevet bivchora
May bedinehem i nema bedinehem degufeh deate bekal vachomer im gufeh kane leh yisrael bechesef dichtiv lareshet achuzza
Hikkisho hakkatuv laachuzza ma achuzza niknet bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka af eved kenaani nikne bechesef mamono lo kol shekken hu
Im ken afilu bishtar uvachazaka name veod yisrael miyyisrael yochichav degufeh kane leh bechesef mamono bimshicha
Ella amar abbaye bedinehem sheppaska lahem tora o kano miyyad amitecha miyyad amitecha hu devimshicha ha miyyad goy bechesef
Veema miyyad goy kelal kelal la amri la salka datach kal vachomer hu im gufo kone mamono lo kol shekken
Veema miyyad goy ad deika tarte amri velav kal vachomer hu gufo beachat mamono bishtayim veema o beha o beha dumya daamitecha
Ma amitecha bachada af goy name bachada

Amar mar vegoy shennatan maot leyisrael bivhemto bedinehen af al pi shello mashach kana ufatur min habbechora may bedinehen ilema bedinehen degufeh mishshum deate bekal vachomer im gufo yisrael kane leh bechesef dichtiv mikkesef miknato mamono lo kol shekken
Yisrael miyyisrael yochichav degufo kane bechesef mamono bimshicha ella amar abbaye bedinehem sheppaska lahem tora vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha laamitecha bimshicha ha legoy bechesef
Veema legoy kelal kelal la amri lav kal vachomer hu im gufo kana mamono lo kol shekken
Ema legoy ad deika tarte lav kal vachomer hu gufo beechad mamono bishtayim
Veema o beha o beha dumya daamitecha
b: Ma amitecha beachat af goy name beachat
Amri ulamemar deamar meshicha begoy kona hanicha i savar lah kerabbi yochanan deamar devar tora maot konot meshicha lo ahani laamitecha laamitecha bechesef legoy bimshicha
Ella i savar lah keresh lakish deamar meshicha meforeshet min hattora laamitecha bimshicha ulgoy bimshicha laamitecha lema li
Amri laamitecha atta machzir onaa vei atta machazir onaa legoy legoy meal tonu ish et achiv nafka
Chad begoy vechad behekdesh utzrichi dei ketav rachamana chad hava amena legoy hu deen lo onaa aval hekdesh yesh lo onaa ka mashma lan

Hanicha leman deamar gezelo asur hayenu deitzterich kera lemishre onaa ella i savar lah keman deamar gezelo shel goy muttar onaa mibaya amri i savar lah keman deamar gezelo muttar al kurchach kerabbi yochanan sevira leh
Metivi hallokeach gerutaot min haggoyim umatza bahen avoda zara im ad shello natan maot mashach yachazir veim mishshennatan maot mashach yolich hanaa leyam hammelach
Vei amratte maot konot meshicha lema li hacha bemay askinan shekkibel alav ladun bedine yisrael i hachi maot lema li hachi kaamar af al pi shennatan maot i mashech in vei la la
I hachi kashya resha amar abbaye resha mishshum deika mikkach taut amar leh rava resha mishshum deika mikkach taut sefa leka mikkach taut
Ella amar rava resha vesefa mikkach taut resha dela yahev zuze la michze kaavoda zara beyad yisrael sefa deyahev zuze michze kaavoda zara beyad yisrael
Veabbayye amar lach resha mikkach taut dela yada deha la yehav leh zuze sefa lav mikkach taut hu dechevan dihav zuze ki ka mashech ibi leayyone vahadar mimshach
Rav ashe amar midderesha meshicha enah kona sefa name meshicha enah kona veayede ditna resha mashach tena sefa name mashach
Ravina amar middesefa meshicha kona resha name meshicha kona veresha hachi kaamar im lo natan velo mashach yachzor may yachzor yachzor bidvarim
Kasavar devarim yesh bahem mishshum mechussere amana vehane mile yisrael miyyisrael dekayemi bedibburayehu aval yisrael miggoyim deinhu la kayemi bedibburayehu la

a: Matni kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin babbechora uvammattanot veotzin lechullin ligazez veleaved veladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidonan
Vehashshochatan bachutz patur veen osin temura veim metu yippadu chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser
Vechol shekkadam hekdeshan et muman o mum over lehekdeshan ulachar mikkan nolad lahen mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot veenan yotzin lechullin ligazez veleaved
Veladan vachalavan asur leachar pidonan vehashshochatan bachutz chayyav veosin temura veim metu yikkaveru
Gema tama denifdu ha lo nifdu peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot kasavar kedushshat damim medacha min habbechora umin hammattanot
Veotzin lechullin vechu tama denifdu ha lo nifdu asiri begiza vaavoda mesayya leh lerabbi eliezer deamar kodshe bedek habbayit asurin begiza vaavoda
Amri la kedushshat damim lammizbeach hu demichallefa bikdushshat hagguf lammizbeach gezaru behu rabbanan aval kodshe bedek habbayit la
Veladan vachalavan muttar ku hechi dame ilema deiabbar veityelid leachar pidonan peshita chullin ninhu ella deiabbar lifne pidonan veityelid leachar pidonan
Ha lifne pidonan asiri
b: Nifdin temimim o en nifdin temimin
Ta shema hammatpis baale mumin kevuin legabbe mizbeach veyaldu yimmachru veen tzerichin mum sheen kedushsha chala alehen shello yehe tafel chamur min haikar
Tama shello yehe tafel chamur min haikar aval hikdish zachar ledamav kadosh kedushshat hagguf mesayya leh lerava deamar rava hikdish zachar ledamav kadosh kedushshat hagguf
Vehashshochatan bachutz patur rabbi elazar matne chayyav umoke lah bevamat yachid

Deamar rabbi elazar minnayin lazzoveach behema baalat mum bevamat yachid bishat heter habbamot shehu belo taase shenneemar lo tizbach la elohecha shor vase im eno inyan levama gedola dichtiv averet o shavur vego tenehu inyan levamat yachid
Ema im eno inyan lekadashim tenehu inyan livchor salka datach amena hoil vekadosh keshehu baal mum likrav name keshehu baal mum ka mashma lan dela
Amri bechor behedya ketiv beh pisseach o iver lo tizbachennu
Veema im eno inyan lekadashim tenehu inyan lemaaser desalka datach amena hoil vekadosh bemumo dichtiv lo yevakker ben tov lara nikrav name bemumeh ka mashma lan dela
Amri maaser name gamar haavara haavara mibbechor
Ema tenehu inyan litmurat kadashim desalka datach amena hoil ukdosha keshehi baalat mum dichtiv lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto vego kareva name keshehi baalat mum ka mashma lan dela
Amar kera vehaya hu utmurato makkish temurato lo ma hu baal mum lo af temurato baal mum lo
Matkef lah rabbi zera ema tenehu inyan levaldot kadashim desalka datach amena hoil ukdoshin keshehen baale mumin aggav imman keshehen baale mumin name karvi ka mashma lan dela

Amar rava kevar paskah tanna deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael rak kadashecha asher yihu lecha undarecha rak kadashecha ellu hattemurot asher yihu lecha ellu havveladot undarecha hikkishan hakkatuv leneder ma neder baal mum lo af hane name baal mum lo
Veen osin temura may tama deamar kera lo yachalifennu velo yamir vego hashta ra betov amratte lo tov bera mibaya ella tov meikaro ose temura ra meikaro en ose temura
Im metu yippadu amar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi shimon deamar kodshe mizbeach hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha kodshe bedek habbayit lo hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha
Ditnan rabbi shimon omer kodshe bedek habbayit im metu yippadu umode rabbi shimon bevaal mum meikaro shennifde may tama deamar kera otah otah lemaote baal mum meikara
Aval chachamim omrim im metu yikkaveru man chachamim tana deve levi hu detana deve levi hakkol hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha vaafilu baal mum meikaro
Vechen tana deve levi bematniteh afilu chayya afilu of vehachtiv otah otah letana deve levi kashya
Aval rabbanan difligi aleh derabbi shimon may hachi name deim metu yippadu i hachi

a: Zo divre rabbi shimon umachlukto mibaya leh

Amri rav kerabbi shimon ben lakish deamar lerabbanan kodshe bedek habbayit hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha kodshe mizbeach lo hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha vela mitokma matnitin kerabbanan dekatane sefa veim metu yikkaveru
Amar mimmay deha metu yikkaveru mishshum devae haamada vehaaracha hu dilma mishshum deen podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim hu amri im ken nitne im naasu terefa yikkaveru
Veibaet ema leolam rav kerabbi yochanan sevira leh utni zo divre rabbi shimon umachlukto
Aval kadam hekdeshan vechu mena hane mile detanu rabbanan tzevi ma tzevi patur min habbechora af pesule hammukdashin peturin min habbechora
Otzi ani et habbechora velo otzi et hammattanot talmud lomar ayyal ma ayyal patur min habbechora umin hammattanot af pesule hammukdashin peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot
I ma tzevi veayyal chelban muttar af pesule hammukdashin chelban muttar talmud lomar ach chillek
Amar mar otzi et habbechor velo otzi et hammattanot may shena otzi et habbechor sheen shave bakkol velo otzi et hammattanot sheshshaot bakkol talmud lomar ayyal
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye i ma tzevi veayyal en oto veet beno noheg bahen af pesule hammukdashin en oto veet beno noheg bo
Amar leh lemay medammet lehu i lechullin oto veet beno noheg bo vei lekadashim oto veet beno noheg bo
Amar leh i hachi gabbe chelbo name nema hachi lemay medammet lehu i lechullin chelban asur vei lekadashim chelban asur
Ella lav mi amratte ach velo chelban emar name ach velo oto veet beno
Rava amar ach leoto veet beno hu daata vechelbo middamo nafka dichtiv rak et damo lo tochel
May damo ilema damo mammash la yehe ella daman ditzvi veayyal attu daman ditzvi veayyal mi shere ella damo chelbo
Velichtov rachamana chelbo i ketav rachamana chelev hava amena ahani hekesha veahani kera
Ahani hekesha lemaote mikkaret dechi ketav karet aochel chelev behema hu dichtiv shenneemar ki chol ochel chelev min habbehema
Veahani kera lemekam aleh belav bealma lehachi appekeh rachamana bilshon damo lomar lach ma damo becharet af chelbo becharet
Veha tana ach velo chelbo kaamar
Hachi kaamar ilu lo neemar damo hayiti omer ach velo chelbo achshav shenneemar damo leoto veet beno hu daata
Veenan yotzin lechullin mena hane mile detanu rabbanan tizbach velo giza basar velo chalav veachalta velo lichlavecha mikkan sheen podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim
b: Ika deamri tizbach veachalta en lach bahen heter achila ella mishsheat zevicha veelach aval podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim hachi name deamar

Uveladan vachalavan asur leachar pidonan hechi dame ilema deiabbar veityelid leachar pidonan ammay velad tzevi veayyal ninhu ella deiabbar lifne pidonan veityelid leachar pidonan ha lifne pidonan mikdash name kadshi
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan zachar lerabbot et havalad unkeva lerabbot et hattemura
Veen li ella velad temimin utmurat temimim veladoy baale mumin utmurat baale mumin minnayin keshehu omer im zachar lerabbot velad baale mumin im nekeva lerabbot temurat baale mumin
Otan veladot shelleachar pidonan ma tehe alehen lifne pidonan miflag peligi behu ika leman deamar kadshi likrav veika leman deamar kadshi liriyya
Dilachar pidonan ma tehe alehen amar rav huna konsan lakkipa vehen metin dehechi lebed likrevinhu mikkoach kedushsha dechuya kaatu lifrekinhu la allimi lemitpas pidonan
