Amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi chanina samuch lefidonan matpisan leshem oto zevach samuch lefidonan lememra divne pediyya ninhu ella ema samuch lefidon imman matpisan leshem oto zevach tama may amar rabbi levi gezera shemma yegaddel mehen adarim adarim

Bea mineh ravina merav sheshet mahu shemmatpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze amar leh en matpisan may tama amar leh gamar bisharecha bisharecha mibbechor ma bechor en matpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze dichtiv ach bechor asher yevukkar la bivhema vego lo yakdish ish oto af hane en matpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze

Tanya kevateh derav sheshet kodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin babbechora uvammattanot ben lifne pidonan ben leachar pidonan haggozez vehaoved bahen eno sofeg et haarbaim ben lifne pidonan ben leachar pidonan en osin temura

Velifne pidonan moalin bahen ulachar pidonan en moalin bahen uvaldotehen chol venifdin temimim umatpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze kelalo shel davar hare hen kechullin lechol divrehem en lecha bahem ella mitzvat illuy bilvad

Aval kadam hekdeshan et muman o mum over lehekdeshan ulachar mikkan nolad mum kavua venifdu peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot ben lifne pidonan ben leachar pidonan haggozez vehaoved bahen sofeg et haarbaim uven lifne pidonan ben leachar pidonan osin temura

Lifne pidonan moalin bahen ulachar pidonan en moalin bahen uvaldotehen kodesh veen nifdin temimin veen matpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze kelalo shel davar hare hen kehekdesh lechol divrehem veen lach bahen ella heter achila bilvad
Kelalo shel davar deresha leetoye shochatan bechutz defatur kelalo shel davar desefa

a: Leetoye chalavo
Amar mar en nifdin temimin veen matpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze temimim hu dela miparki ha baale mumin miparki lechol sheyyirtze hu deen matpisan ha leoto zevach matpisan
Hechi mashkachatte lah dematpisan leoto zevach venifdin bemuman nema tehve teuvta derav huna

Amar lecha rav huna hu haddin daafilu baale mumin en nifdin veayede ditna resha nifdin temimim tena name sefa en nifdin temimim veayede ditna resha lechol zevach sheyyirtze tena name sefa lechol zevach sheyyirtze
Vehashshochatan bachutz patur rav huna matne chayyav umokem lah bedukin shebbeayin vealliba derabbi akiva deamar im alu lo yerdu

Ben lifne pidono ben leachar pidono ose temura amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh utmurato leachar pidono meta may tama hechi lebed lakrevah mikkoach kedushsha dechuya kaatya lifrekah la allima lemitpas pidonah hilkach meta

Matkef lah rav amram vetitchil bemumah labbealim vechi ma ben zo litmurat bechor umaaser ditnan temurat bechor umaaser hen uveladan uvelad veladan ad sof kol haolam hare hen kivchor umaaser veyeachlu bemuman labbealim
Amar leh abbaye ze shem immo alav veze shem immo alav ze kullo temurat bechor umaaser mikarya ma bechor umaaser bemuman mitachlan labbealim af temuratan mitachla
Veze shem immo alav temurat kadashim mikarya ma kadashim la mitachli ella befidon af temuratan name la mitachli ella befidon veha la allima lemitpas pidonah
Tanya kevateh derav nachman minnayin litmurat pesule hammukdashin shemmeta talmud lomar mimmaale haggera tame hay mibe leh lechamesh chattaot metot hahu mimmafrise happarsa tame nafka
Tanya name hachi minnayin lechamesh chattaot metot talmud lomar mimmafrise happarsa tame chamesh chattaot metot hilcheta gemiri lah ella ki ata kera litmurat asham
Temurat asham name hilcheta hi kol shebbachattat meta baasham roe

Ella leolam chamesh chattaot metot veitzterich kera veitzterich hilcheta dei mikkera hava amena liriyya ka mashma lan hilcheta lemita vei mehilcheta hava amena hecha daavad ikri vaachal mehane chamesh chattaot isura ika lav leka kamashma lan deika lav
Veibaet ema leakkoshe davar habba mimmaale gera ledavar habba mimmafrise happarsa ma lehallan bemita af kan bemita
Matni hamkabbel tzon barzel min haggoy
b: Valdotehen peturin valde valdotehen chayyavin heemid valdotehen tachat immotehen valde veladot peturin uvalde valde veladot chayyavim rabban shimon ben gamliel omer afilu ad asara peturim sheachrautan lannochri
Rachel sheyyalda min ez veez sheyyalda min rachel petura min habbechora veim yesh bo miktzat simanin chayyav
Gema lememra dechevan dela naket mara zuze birshuta demara kayema
Urminhu en mekabbelin tzon barzel miyyisrael mippene shehu ribbit alma birshuta dimkabbel kayema
Amar abbaye la kashya ha dekabbel aleh unsa vezola veha dela kabbel aleh unsa vezola
Amar leh rava dekabbel aleh unsa vezola tzon barzel karet leh veod may paska
Veod addetane sefa aval mekabbelin tzon barzel min haggoy liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim dela kabbel aleh unsa vezola aval kabbel aleh unsa vezola shappir dame

Ella amar rava ide veide dela kabbel aleh unsa vezola vehacha gabbe bechora hayenu tama deilu ate goy bae zuze vela yahev leh tafes lah livhema vei la mashkach lah livhema tafes veladot didah vahare yad goy baemtza vechol yad goy baemtza petura min habbechora
Heemid valdotehen tachat immotehen valde veladot peturim amar rav huna veladot peturin valde veladot chayyavin verav yehuda amar valde veladot name peturin valde valde veladot chayyavin
Tenan heemid veladot tachat immotehen valde veladot peturin tama deheemid ha lo heemid la teuvta derav yehuda
Amar lach rav yehuda hu haddin af al gav delo heemid veha ka mashma lan afilu heemid name
Deorcheh degoy lemitpas benah vehave kemi delo heemid valde veladot peturin valde valde veladot chayyavin
Tenan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer afilu ad asara dorot peturin sheachrautan lannochri bishlama lerav yehuda deamar nachet tanna kamma ledare

a: Hayenu daamar leh rabban shimon ben gamliel afilu ad asara dorot peturin ella lerav huna deamar la nachet tanna kamma ledare may afilu ad asara dorot amar lecha rav huna rabban shimon ben gamliel aheemid kae denachet ledare
Ta shema hamkabbel tzon barzel min haggoy veladot peturin valde veladot lo teuvta derav yehuda amar lach rav yehuda ema hen uvaldotehen
Ika deamri hen uvaldotehen peturin teuvta derav huna amar lecha rav huna ema hen veladot patur valde veladot chayyav
Rachel sheyyalda min ez ku ata rav oshaya minnehardea veayeti matnita bideh rachel bat ez veez bat rachel rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrin
Amar leh rav hoshaya lerabba ki ayelatte lekammeh derav huna bei mineh rabbi meir mechayyev lemay ilema livchora velet leh lerabbi meir ach bechor shor ad sheyehe hu shor uvchoro shor
Ella lereshit haggez velet leh ha detana deve rabbi yishmael kevasim shetztzamran kashe peturin mereshit haggez shenneemar umiggez kevasay yitchammam

Amar leh nichze anan hacha bemay askinan berachel sheyyalda min ez veaviv tayish uvchoshshin lezera haav leinyan oto veet beno kamipalgi derabbi meir savar choshshin lezera haav verabbanan savri en choshshin lezera haav
I hachi lipalgu bechoshshin lezera haav bealma biflugta dachananya verabbanan
Ella leolam livchora vehacha bemay askinan berachel bat rachel bat ez mar savar zil batar imeh vehay lav nidme hu
Umar savar zil batar imah deimeh vehay nidme hu
Veibaet ema berachel bat ez bat rachel mar savar chazru seyuot limkoman umar savar lo chazru seyuot limkoman
Rav ashe amar kegon sheyyesh bo miktzat simanin uman chachamim rabbi shimon deamar ad sheyehe rosho verubbo dome leimmo
Amar rabbi yochanan mode rabbi meir besair shel rosh chodesh devaenan ben seira may tama amar kera echad hamuchad uva mishsheshet yeme bereshit
Veha mehacha nafka mehatam nafka shor o chesev perat lechilayim o ez perat lenidme
Tzericha dei mehatam hava amena hane mile hecha dela nechat ledare aval hecha dinchat ema la vei mehacha hava amena hane mile legabbe korban chova aval nedava la tzericha
Amar rabbi acha bar yaakov hakkol modim deen lokin al tzamro mishshum kilayim shenneemar lo tilbash shaatnez ma pishtan shello nishtanna af tzemer shello nishtanna
Amar rav pappa hakkol modim shetztzamro pasul litchelet shenneemar lo tilbash shaatnez gedilim taase lach ma pishtan shello nishtanna af tzemer shello nishtanna
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hakkol modim sheen tzamro mittamme bingaim shenneemar beveged tzemer o beveged pishtim ma pishtim shello nishtanna af tzemer shello nishtanna
Amar rav ashe af anu nomar hidla haggefen al gabbe teena yeno pasul linsachim may tama zevach unsachim ma zevach shello nishtanna af nesachim shello nishtannu

Matkef lah ravina hidla pishtan al gabbe higa hachi name delishtanne im ken la matzet amratte ma pishtan shello nishtanna deha pishtan name mishtanne amar leh ze nishtanna recho veze lo nishtanna recho

Matni rachel shello bikra veyalda shene zecharim veyatzu shene rashehen keachat rabbi yose haggelili omer shenehen lakkohen shenneemar hazzecharim la vachachamim omrim i efshar letzamtzem ella echad lo veechad lakkohen
Rabbi tarfon omer hakkohen borer lo et hayyafe rabbi akiva omer meshammenin benehen vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev
b: Vechayyav bammattanot verabbi yose poter met echad mehen rabbi tarfon omer yachloku rabbi akiva omer hammotzi mechavero alav haraya zachar unkeva en kan lakkohen kelum
Gema amri deve rabbi yannay lerabbi yose haggelili shaminan leh deamar efshar letzamtzem bide shamayim vechol shekken bide adam verabbanan bide shamayim i efshar letzamtzem bide adam may

Ta shema chut shel sikra chogro baemtza lehavdil ben damim haelonim uven damim hattachtonim vei amratte i efshar letzamtzem bide adam zimnin deka yahev elonim lematta vetachtonim lemala demarvach bah purta
Ta shema mimmiddat kelim mimmiddat mizbeach shane hatam derachamana amar aved uvchol hechi dematzet lemibad nicha leh hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil
Amar rav kattina ta shema chilleko lishnayim vehen shavin shenehen temeim lefi shei efshar letzamtzem amar rav kahana shane keli cheres hoil veyesh bo gummot
Ta shema nimtza mechvan ben shette ayarot shettehen meviot shette agalot divre rabbi eliezer may tama
Lav mishshum dekasavar bide adam efshar letzamtzem ukrova vaafilu kerovot
La rabbi eliezer

a: Savar lah kerabbi yose haggelili deamar efshar letzamtzem bide shamayim vechol shekken bide adam

Nema ketannae nimtza mechvan ben shette ayarot lo hau orfin rabbi eliezer omer shettehen meviot shette agalot may lav beha kamipalgi detanna kamma savar i efshar letzamtzem verabbi eliezer savar efshar letzamtzem
Vetisbera i kasavar tanna kamma i efshar letzamtzem ammay lo hau orfim yaviu egla achat beshuttafut veyittenu
Ella lehane tannae dechulle alma efshar letzamtzem vehacha bikrova velo kerovot kamipalgi detanna kamma savar kerova velo kerovot verabbi eliezer savar kerova vaafilu kerovot
May have alah amar rav chiyya bar avin amar rav amram tana nimtza mechvan ben shette ayarot rabbi eliezer omer shettehen meviot shette agalot vachachamim omrim yaviu egla achat beshuttafut veyatnu

May kasavri rabbanan i kasavri rabbanan deefshar letzamtzem ukrova vaafilu kerovot layete tarte vei kerova velo kerovot afilu chada la layete ella lav shema minah kasavri rabbanan i efshar letzamtzem vaafilu bide adam shema minah
Rabbi tarfon omer borer lo et hayyafe may tama derabbi tarfon ka savar hahu devari nafek beresha

Rabbi akiva omer meshammenin ku amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hakkohen notel kechusha amar leh rabbi chiyya bar abba lerabbi yochanan veha anan meshammenin benehen tenan amar leh ad daachalte kafneyata bevavel targemna missefa

Dekatane sefa met echad mehen rabbi tarfon omer yachloku rabbi akiva omer hammotzi mechavero alav haraya vei salka datach meshammenin benehen dechi hadade peligi hachi name lipalgi liflog gabbe hadade ella may meshammenin shomen yehe benehen deamar leh lechohen ayeti reaya divchor hu ushkol

Vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev vechayyav bemattanot verabbi yose poter may tama derabbi meir amar rabbi yochanan hoil vechohen ba alav mishshene tzedadin deamar leh i bechor hu kulleh didi hu i la bechor hu hav li mattanot mineh
Verabbi yose may tama amar rava asu sheeno zoche kezoche veaf al gav dela meta lideh keman dimta lideh vezabbeneh leyisrael bemumeh
Amar rabbi elazar hakkol modim bisfek bechor sheen chalifin beyad kohen shechayyav bemattanot
Hakkol modim man rabbi yose peshita ad kan la ka fatar rabbi yose hatam ella dachalifin beyad kohen deasu sheeno zoche kezoche aval en chalifin beyad kohen la
Mahu detema tama derabbi yose dekasavar dei mechayevatte leh bemattanot ate leh lide giza vaavoda af al gav deen chalifin beyad kohen ka mashma lan
Umi matzet amratte hachi vehatane sefa shehaya rabbi yose omer
b: Kol shechalifav beyad kohen patur min hammattanot verabbi meir mechayyev chalifin beyad kohen in en chalifin beyad kohen la

Mahu detema rabbi yose lidvarav derabbi meir kaamar leh ledidi afilu en chalifin beyad kohen dei mechayevatte leh bemattanot ate leh lide giza vaavoda ledidach odi li miha hecha dachalifin beyad kohen deasu sheeno zoche kezoche veamar leh rabbi meir la

Veamar rav pappa hakkol modim bisfek maaser sheppatur min hammattanot hakkol modim man rabbi meir peshita ad kan la kamchayyev rabbi meir hatam ella bisfek bechor hoil uva alav kohen mishshene tzedadin aval safek maaser la
Mahu detema tama derabbi meir delo tishtakkach torat mattanot afilu sefek maaser name ka mashma lan
Umi matzet amratte hachi vehakatane sefa shehaya rabbi yose omer kol shechalifav beyad kohen patur min hammattanot verabbi meir mechayyev
Mahu detema rabbi meir afilu sefek maaser mechayyav veha demipalgi bachalifin lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose defatar afilu hecha dechohen ba alav mishshene tzedadin ka mashma lan

Met echad mehen rabbi tarfon omer yachloku ammay yachloku nichze i shamen mit dechohen hu vehay deika devaal habbayit vei kachush mit devaal habbayit mit vehay deika dechohen hu amar rabbi amme chazar bo rabbi tarfon
Rabbi akiva omer hammotzi mechavero alav haraya amar rabbi chiyya mashal derabbi tarfon lema haddavar dome lishnayim shehifkidu etzel roe shemmanniach roe benehem umistallek
Umashal derabbi akiva lema haddavar dome leechad shehifkid etzel baal habbayit shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya

Ella bemay peligi rabbi akiva pelig bishnayim shehifkidu etzel roe shemmanniach roe umistallek verabbi tarfon pelig beechad shehifkid etzel baal habbayit amar rava veitema rav pappa hakkol modim bishnayim shehifkidu etzel roe shemmanniach roe benehem umistallek uvechad shehifkid etzel baal habbayit shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya

Lo nechleku ella bachatzar baal habbayit veroe kohen rabbi tarfon savar aknoye ka makne leh bachatzero venicha leh delitavid mitzva bemamoneh vehave leh kishnayim shehifkidu etzel roe shemmanniach roe benehen umistallek
Verabbi akiva savar kevan deit leh peseda la makne leh midaam vehave leh keechad shehifkid etzel baal habbayit shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya

Matni shette rechelav shello bikru veyaldu shene zecharim shenehem lakkohen zachar unkeva hazzachar lakkohen shene zecharim unkeva echad lo veechad lakkohen rabbi tarfon omer hakkohen borer lo et hayyafe rabbi akiva omer meshammenin benehen vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev

Vechayyav bammattanot rabbi yose poter met echad mehen rabbi tarfon omer yachloku rabbi akiva omer hammotzi mechavero alav haraya shette nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushte nekevot en kan lakkohen kelum
Achat bikra veachat lo bikra veyalda shene zecharim echad lo veechad lakkohen rabbi tarfon omer hakkohen borer et hayyafe rabbi akiva omer meshammenin benehen vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev

Vechayyav bammattanot rabbi yose poter sherabbi yose omer kol shechalifav beyad kohen patur min hammattanot verabbi meir mechayyev met echad mehen rabbi tarfon omer yachloku rabbi akiva omer hammotzi mechavero alav haraya zachar unkeva en kan lakkohen kelum
Gema tzericha dei ashmoinan kammayeta behahi kaamar rabbi akiva ditre mechada
Aval rechelav shello bikru ditre mechada vechad mechada ema mode leh lerabbi tarfon dehach dilida chad sheviach tefe
Vei ashmoinan ha beha kaamar rabbi akiva detarvayehu lo bikru aval achat bikra veachat shello bikra veyaldu shene zecharim ema mode leh lerabbi tarfon

a: Dehach dela bikra sheviach tefe tzericha

Matni yotze dofen vehabba acharav rabbi tarfon omer shenehem yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyeachlu bemuman labbealim rabbi akiva omer shenehen enan bechor harishon mippene sheeno peter rechem vehashsheni mippene shekkedamo acher
Gema bemay kamipalgi rabbi tarfon mesappeka leh bechor ledavar echad i have bechor i la have bechor verabbi akiva peshita leh bechor ledavar echad la have bechor
Tanu rabbanan mikkelal hatztzarich lifrat umipperat hatztzarich lichlal ketzad kaddesh li chol bechor yachol afilu nekeva bammashma talmud lomar zachar
I zachar yachol afilu yatzta nekeva lefanav talmud lomar peter rechem i peter rechem yachol afilu yatza achar yotze dofen talmud lomar bechor
Amar leh rav sherevya leabbaye resha la kanasev lah talmuda bechor alma bechor ledavar echad have bechor sefa kanasev lah talmuda bechor alma bechor ledavar echad la have bechor
Amar leh leolam bechor ledavar echad la have bechor veresha hachi kaamar i zachar yachol afilu yotze dofen talmud lomar peter rechem
Ravina amar leolam bechor ledavar echad have bechor vesefa hachi kaamar i salka datach yatza acher yotze dofen kadosh bechor dichtav rachamana lema li
b: I lemaote hecha deyatzta nekeva lefanav mippeter rechem nafka ella shema minah bechor lemaote hecha deotze achar yotze dofen

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina i salka datach bechor ledavar echad have bechor tinach hecha deyatza zachar yotze dofen vezachar derech rechem dela kadosh deimaut leda mibbechor divchor lirchamim ika bechor lizcharim leka
Ella hecha deyatzta nekeva derech dofen vezachar derech rechem likdash deha ika bechor lizcharim uvchor lerechem ella mechavarta kidabbaye
Hadaran alach hallokeach ubbar parato

Matni hallokeach behema min haggoy veeno yodea im bikra im lo bikra rabbi yishmael omer ez bat shenatah vadday lakkohen mikkan veelach safek rachel bat shettayim vadday lakkohen mikkan veelach safek para vachamor benot shalosh vadday lakkohen mikkan veelach safek
Amar lo rabbi akiva ilu bevalad bilvad habbehema nifteret kidvarecha ella amru siman havalad bivhema dakka tinuf uvaggassa shilya uvaishsha shafir veshilya
Ze hakkelal kol sheyyadua shebbikra en kan lakkohen kelum vechol shello bikra hare ze lakkohen veim safek yeachel bemumo labbealim
Gema mikan veelach ammay safek hallech achar rov behemot verov behemot mitabberot veoldot betoch shenatan ninhu veha vadday melad oled lema rabbi yishmael kerabbi meir sevira leh dechayesh lemiuta
Afilu tema rabbanan ki azli batar rubba berubba deiteh kamman kegon tesha chanuot vesanhedrin aval rubba deleteh kamman la azli rabbanan batar rubba

Veha katan uktanna derubba deleteh kamman vekaazli rabbanan batar rubba ditnan katan uktanna lo choltzin velo meyabmin divre rabbi meir amru lo yafe amarta sheen choltzin ish katuv bapparasha umakkeshinan ishsha leish
Ma taam en meyabmin amar lahem katan shemma yimmatze saris ketanna shemma timmatze ayelonit venimtzeu pogin beerva
Verabbanan zil batar rubba ketannim verov ketannim lav sarisim ninhu zil batar ketannot verov ketannot lav ayelonit ninhu
Ella amar rava

a: Mechavarta rabbi yishmael kerabbi meir sevira leh dechayesh lemiuta
Ravina amar afilu tema rabbanan ki azli rabbanan batar rubba berubba dela tele bemaase aval rubba ditle bemaase la

Tanu rabbanan ez bat shenatah vadday lakkohen mikan ulhallan safek rachel bat shettayim vadday lakkohen mikan ulhallan safek para bat shalosh vadday lakkohen mikan ulhallan safek chamora kefara rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer chamora bat arba shanim ad kan divre rabbi yishmael

Keshennemeru devarim lifne rabbi yehoshua amar lahen tzeu imru lo lerabbi yishmael taita ilu bevalad bilvad habbehema nifteret haya kidvarecha ella siman havalad bivhema dakka tinuf uvaggassa shilya uvaishsha shafir veshilya

Vaani en ani omer ken ella ez shettinfa bat shishsha yoledet betoch shenatah rachel shettinfa bat shenatah yoledet betoch shettayim amar rabbi akiva ani lo bati lide midda zo ella kol sheyyadua shebbikra en kan lakkohen kelum vechol shello bikra hare zo lakkohen safek yeachel bemumo labbealim
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi yishmael verabbi yehoshua lema betinuf poter kamipalgi rabbi yishmael savar tinuf eno poter verabbi yehoshua savar tinuf poter
I dachazena detanif dechulle alma la peligi detinuf poter vehacha bechoshshin letinuf ka mipalgi rabbi yishmael savar en choshshin letinuf verabbi yehoshua savar choshshin letinuf
Vela chayesh vehaamar rava mechavarta rabbi yishmael kerabbi meir sevira leh dechayesh lemiut ki chayesh lechumra lekulla la chayesh

Veibaet ema ben lekulla ben lechumra chayesh vehacha bimtannefet vechozeret veoledet betoch shenatah kamipalgi derabbi yishmael savar metannefet enah chozeret veoledet betoch shenatah veha middeolid vadday la tannif verabbi yehoshua savar metannefet chozeret veoledet betoch shenatah
Vaani eni omer ken ella ez shettinfa bat shishsha yoledet toch shenatah rachel shettinfa bat shenatah yoledet betoch shettayim may ika ben gemareh lisvareh
Shettinfa besof shishsha veika benayehu dizeri deamar zeeri en tinuf pachot mishsheloshim yom
Ligmareh it leh dizeri lisvareh let leh dizeri
Veibaet ema dechulle alma it lehu dizeri vehacha beoledet limkuttain kamipalgi
b: Ligmareh la amrinan yoledet limkuttain lisvareh amrinan yoledet limkuttain
Veibaet ema la amrinan yoledet vehacha bemiktzat hayyom kechullo kamipalgi lisvareh amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo ligmareh la amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo
Amar rabbi akiva ani lo bati lide midda zo ella kol sheyyadua ku may ika ben rabbi akiva lerabbi yehoshua

Amar rabbi chanina missura chalav poter ika benayehu rabbi akiva savar chalav poter hallech achar rov behemot verov behemot en cholvot ella im ken yoldot verabbi yehoshua savar ha ika miuta decholvot af al pi sheen yoldot
Umi chayesh rabbi yehoshua lemiut vehatnan hayeta lah chamot enah chosheshet yatza melea chosheshet rabbi yehoshua omer enah chosheshet

Veamrinan may tama derabbi yehoshua kasavar rov meubbarot yoldot umiut mappilot vechol hayyoldot mechetza zecharim umechetza nekevot semoch miuta demappilot lemechetza dinkevot vehau lehu zecharim miuta ulmiuta la chayeshinan
Ella efoch vehatanya chalav poter divre rabbi yehoshua rabbi akiva omer chalav eno poter

Tanu rabbanan gediyya sheyyalda shalosh banot vechol benoteha yaldu shalosh shalosh kullan nichnasot laddir lehitasser amar rabbi shimon ani raiti sheisra betoch shenatah lema li lemitne shalosh shalosh toled chad minayehu telat veinach tarte tarte
Ayede deika chada dela saggi bela shalosh tena kullehu deyaldu shalosh shalosh ulma li lemitne shalosh kelal leldu kullehu tarte vetihdar ihi vetoled bahadayehi

a: Lema kasavar metannefet enah chozeret veoledet betoch shenatah im timtze lomar metannefet chozeret veoledet betoch shenatah yoledet vadday enah chozeret veoledet betoch shenatah
Amar rabbi shimon ani raiti gediyya ku may ika ben tanna kamma lerabbi shimon ika benayehu dizeri
Tanna kamma it leh dizeri verabbi shimon let leh dizeri veibaet ema dechulle alma it lehu dizeri vehacha beoledet limkuttain ka mipalgi letanna kamma enah yoledet limkuttain lerabbi shimon yoledet
Veibaet ema dechulle alma enah yoledet limkuttain vehacha bemiktzat hayyom kechullo kamipalgi letanna kamma la amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo lerabbi shimon amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo
Veibaet ema dechulle alma amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo vehacha bimchussar zeman nichnas laddir lehitasser kamipalgi
b: Vehatanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon mechussar zeman nichnas laddir lehitasser vahare hen kivchor ma bechor kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno af mechussar zeman kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno
Veaddeyalef mibbechor nelaf mikkodashim mistabbera mibbechor hava leh lemelaf shekken goel mum temurat achila
Adderabba mikkodashim hava leh lemelaf shekken zachar kadosh bemattanot pashut ella rabbi shimon haavara haavara gemir
Hechi dame tinuf amar rava kidamri raavata detzalta atzar cheveta ushmuel amar babue didma vetzarich leharoto lechacham chacham mena yada amar rav pappa roe chacham

Amar rav chisda hare amru yetzirat havalad baishsha arbaim yom bae rav chisda bivhema bechamma amar leh rav pappa leabbaye lav hayenu dizeri deamar zeeri en tinuf pachot mishsheloshim yom hahu lekabbel itmar
Matzinu lokeach miggoy lokeach miyyisrael may amar rav bechor vadday deim ita devikkera ishtabboche hava mishtabbach leh
Ushmuel amar bechor safek savar lishchita ka vae leh verabbi yochanan amar chullin vaddain may tama im ita delo bikkera kevan deika isura odoe hava moda leh
Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan deamar chullin im lo hodio holech veshochet veeno nimna lema tehve teuvta derav ushmuel hatam bemocher talya milta hacha belokeach talya milta
Matni rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer behema gassa sheshshafa chararat dam hare zo tikkaver uftura min habbechora
Gema tane rabbi chiyya enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa umeachar deenah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa ammay tikkaver

a: Kede lefarsemah shenniftera min habbechora
Lememra devalad mealleya hu veammay en metamme lo bemagga velo bemassa amar rabbi yochanan mishshum bitul berov nagu bah
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi yochanan rabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbi shimon amru davar echad rabbi eliezer ben yaakov ha daamaran
Rabbi shimon may hi ditnan hashshilya babbayit habbayit tame lo shehashshilya valad ella sheen shilya belo valad rabbi shimon omer valad nimok ad shello yatza
Tenan hatam en linfalim petichat hakkever ad sheyyaagilu rosh kefika may kefika amar rav huna kefika shel tzemer amar leh chiyya bar rav lerav huna rabbi paresh shel sheti o shel erev

Amar leh tanya pika shel sheti divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer shel erev rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer mishsheyyerau tefifiyyot may tefifiyyot amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok kach hau mefarshin birushalayim kifreda shekkoraat lehattil memeha veniret pika mittoch pika

Amar rav huna shamati shette pikot achat shel sheti veachat shel erev veen li lefaresh ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan shalosh pikot shamati achat shel sheti veachat shel erev veachat shel pika gedola shel sakkain veen li lefaresh ki ata ravin pershah mishshemeh derabbi yochanan shel ishsha keshel sheti shel behema keshel erev
Pika gedola shel sakkain keditnan gush habba mibbet happeras meeretz haammim shiuro kefika gedola shel sakkain shehu kechotam hammartzufin veyeshno betzad haelon shel megufat hechavit hallachmit
Amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia hallokeach tzir meam haaretz mashshiko bemayim vetahor
Mimma nafshach i mayya rubba ninhu kevan deaved lehu hashshaka tahari lehu vei rubba tzir ninhu tzir la bar kabbole tuma hu may ika mishshum hanach miuta demayya hanach batlu lehu berubba

Amar rabbi yirmeya lo shanu ella litbol bahen pito aval likdera lo matza min et mino veneor yatev rav dimi vekaamar leha shemata amar leh abbaye vechi tuma shebbatla chazra veneora amar leh veatte la tisberah vehatnan sea teruma temea shennafla
b: Lemea chullin tehorin rabbi eliezer omer terom veterakev sheani omer hi sea shennafla hi sea shealta
Vachachamim omrim taale veteachel nikudim o kelaot o tilosh beme ferot o titchallek leisot uvilvad shello yehe bemakom echad kevetza
Vetane alah otan chullin

a: Lerabbi eliezer ma tehe alehen yochlu nikkudin o kelaot o yilloshu beme ferot o titchallek leisot uvilvad shello yehe kevetza bemakom echad veamar ulla ma taam gezera shemma yavi kav chullin temeim mimmakom acher vekav veod mimmin ze savar evattelinhu berubba vechevan deika hay mashshehu matza min et mino veneor
Amar leh im tuma oreret tuma tohora oreret tuma
Etiveh efer kasher shennitarev beefer mikle holchin achar harov letamme vei rubba efer mikle hu la metamme vei amratte tuma keman deiteh dame nehi divmagga la metamme letamme bemassa
Ha itmar alah amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina tahor milletamme bemagga aval metamme bemassa
Vehaamar rav chisda nevela betela bishchuta shei efshar linvela shettease shechuta nehi divmagga la metamme letamme bemassa

Amar leh attun bidrav chisda matnitu lah anan bidrabbi chiyya matnenan lah tane rabbi chiyya nevela ushchuta betelot zo bazo veitmar alah amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina tahor milletamme bemagga aval metamme bemassa

Veha ditnan rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer behema gassa sheshshafa chararat dam hare zo tikkaver veniftera min habbechora vetane rabbi chiyya enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa ammay dinhi bemagga la metamme tetamme bemassa ishtik
Dilma vadday shane hacha dehaveya lah tuma serucha hanicha levar peda deamar tuma chamura ad leger vetuma kalla ad lechelev ha la chazya leger ella lerabbi yochanan deamar
b: Achat zo veachat zo ad lechelev ha chazya lechelev kashya

Gufa bar peda amar tuma chamura ad leger vetuma kalla ad lechelev verabbi yochanan amar achat zo veachat zo ad lechelev may tama devar peda dichtiv lo tochlu chol nevela leger vego haruya lagger keruya nevela vesheenah reuya lagger enah keruya nevela
Veidach lemaote hecha dehisricha meikara veidach hisricha meikara la tzericha kera lemaote afra bealma hu

Tenan rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer behema gassa sheshshafa chararat dam hare zo tikkaver venifteret min habbechora vetane rabbi chiyya enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum bitul berov nagu bah
May irya mishshum bitul berov tipok li dela itchazi kelal ha name itchazi meikara aggav imeh

Tenan hatam rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer tzir tahor shennafal letocho mayim kol shehu tame amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh zot omeret nechshedu amme haaretz learev mechetza batztzir ulma li mechetza afilu betzir mimmechetza name vehane mashshehu have leh palga ufalga la betil
Ema ad mechetza ibaet ema tumat am haaretz derabbanan tumat mashkin derabbanan berubba gezaru rabbanan befalga ufalga la gezaru bah rabbanan

Matni rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hallokeach behema menika min haggoy en choshshin shemma benah shel acheret haya nichnas letoch edro veraa et hammavkirot menikot vesheenan mavkirot menikot en choshshin shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo o shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo

Gema amar rav nachman mishshemeh derav hilcheta bechulleh pirkin bar mippelugta amar rav sheshet amena ki nayem veshachev rav amar leha shemata aheya ilema aresha miflag peligi rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva
Ella adderabbi eliezer ben yaakov mishnat rabbi eliezer ben yaakov kav venaki

Ella adderabban shimon ben gamliel miflag pelig bevarayeta ella adderabbi yose ben hamshullam ha amar rav chada zimna deamar rav hilcheta kerabbi yose ben hamshullam ella assear baal mum miflag peligi akavya ben mahalalel verabbanan
Leolam adderabban shimon ben gamliel veha ka mashma lan devarayeta la pelugta hi
Vechevan deamar rav hilcheta bechulleh pirkin bar mippelugta

a: Halacha kerabbi yose ben hamshullam lema li

I amar hilcheta dechulleh pirkin vela amar hilcheta kerabbi yose ben hamshullam hava amena adderabbi yose ben hamshullam kae umay bechulleh pirkin derabbi yose tarte amar uflugta devarayeta pelugta hi
Ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yose leashmoinan deadderabban shimon ben gamliel kae uflugta devarayeta lav pelugta hi
May barayeta detanya hallokeach behema menika min haggoy habba acharav bechor missafek mippene shemmerachemet af al pi sheenah yoledet rabban shimon ben gamliel omer davar bechezkato

Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hannichnas letoch edro ballayela veraa keeser kachamesh esre mavkirot vesheenan mavkirot yoldot lemachar hishkim umatza zecharim teluot teluyin besheen mavkirot unkevot teluot bemavkirot eno choshesh shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo
Ibaya lehu davar bechezkato dekaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel deenah merachemet ella im ken yoledet ha hecha deolid chayeshinan lerachome o dilma didah merachama dela didah la merachama leh
Lemay nafka minah lemilke alah mishshum oto veet beno i amratte didah merachama dela didah la merachama lake vei amratte dela didah name merachama la lake

May ta shema rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hallokeach behema min haggoy eno choshesh shemma benah shel acheret haya mi katane hu haya katane hachi kaamar eno choshesh shemma benah shel acheret ella im ken haya lah valad meikara
Ta shema nichnas betoch edro veraa et hammavkirot menikot veet sheenan mavkirot menikot eno choshesh shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo o shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo
Ammay lechush dilma rachome rachem bimkom didah la shavka didah umrachama dela didah
Ta shema davar bechezkato ku may lav resha dumya desefa ma sefa vadday didah af resha vadday didah
Mide irya hay kidite vehay kidite umay vechen appetura divchora
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan raa chazir shekkaruch achar rachel petura min habbechora veasur baachila ad yavo veore tzedek lachem
Patur min habbechora keman kerabban shimon ben gamliel veasur baachila kerabbanan
Vetu i kerabbanan may ad yavo veore tzedek lachem ad sheyyivada lecha davar mibe leh

Vechi tema mesappeka leh i halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel i kerabbanan i mesappeka leh ammay petura min habbechora vetu mi mesappeka leh vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu halacha kemoto chutz mearev vetzayedan uraya acharona

Leolam peshita leh halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel mihu mesappeka leh i savar rabban shimon ben gamliel yoledet merachemet o enah merachemet i hachi ad deashmeinan chazir lashmeinan tale ulmilke aleh mishshum oto veet beno
Chazir itztericha leh dei ashmeinan tale hava amena im timtza lomar desavar yoledet merachama deminah dela minah la ashmeinan chazir dimrachemet vaafilu delav minah name deika lememar dilma merachama
Vehayenu deamar rabbi yochanan bae
b: Achay beribi raa chazir shekkaruch achar rachel mahu may kamibaya leh ilema livchora vekamibaya leh i hilcheta kerabban shimon ben gamliel i hilcheta kerabbanan tibe leh tale
Ki kamibaya leh livchora vealliba derabbanan laachila vealliba derabban shimon ben gamliel
Livchora vaafilu lerabbanan deamri merachama ki merachama deminah dela minah la o dilma dela minah name merachama
Laachila vaafilu lerabban shimon ben gamliel im timtza lomar savar yoledet merachama deminah delav minah la o dilma delav minah name merachama teku
Matni rabbi yose ben hamshullam omer hashshochet et habbechor ose makom bekofitz mikan umikan vetolesh et hassear uvilvad shello yezizennu mimmekomo vechen tolesh et hassear lirot mekom mum

Gema amar rav halacha kerabbi yose ben hamshullam beo mineh merav huna kenegdo beom tov mahu tama derabbi yose ben hamshullam mishshum dekasavar tolesh lav hayenu gozez uvom tov asur dehave leh oker davar miggidulo
O dilma bealma savar rabbi yose ben hamshullam tolesh hayenu gozez vehayenu tama dishre dehave leh davar sheen mitkaven uvom tov davar sheen mitkaven muttar

Amar lehu zilu shayeluh lerav chananel i amar halacha kerabbi yose ben hamshullam efshot lechu ato shayeluh amar lehu hachi amar rav halacha kerabbi yose ben hamshullam ato lekammeh derav huna amar lehu kenegdo beom tov muttar itmar name amar rav chananya bar shelemya mishshemeh derav kenegdo beom tov

a: Muttar
Umi amar rav hachi veha amar rav chiyya bar ashe mishshemeh derav mesocharya denazyata asur lehaddokah beoma tava
Behahi afilu rabbi shimon mode deabbaye verava deamri tarvayehu mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut

Veha amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav halacha kerabbi yehuda verav chanan bar amme amar shemuel halacha kerabbi shimon verav chiyya bar avin matne bela gavre rav amar halacha kerabbi yehuda ushmuel amar halacha kerabbi shimon
Ella leolam savar rav davar sheen mitkaven asur vetolesh lav hayenu gozez uvom tov hayenu tama dishre dehave leh oker davar miggidulo kilachar yad

Vetolesh lav hayenu gozez vehatanya hattolesh et hakkanaf vehakkotmo vehammorto chayyav shalosh chattaot veamar resh lakish tolesh chayyav mishshum gozez kotem chayyav mishshum mechattech memaret chayyav mishshum memachek shane kanaf dehayenu orcheh
Umidderav savar kerabbi yose ben hamshullam rabbi yose ben hamshullam savar lah kerav vesavar rabbi yose ben hamshullam davar sheen mitkaven asur
Vehatanya shette searot ikaran maadim veroshan mashchir rabbi yose ben hamshullam omer gozez bemisparayim veeno choshesh

Shane para delav bat giza hi vehatanya lo taavod bivchor shorecha velo tagoz bechor tzonecha veen li ella shor baavoda vetzon begiza minnayin liten et haamur shel ze baze veet haamur shel ze baze talmud lomar lo taavod velo tagoz
Ella shane para dekodshe bedek habbayit hi vehaamar rabbi elazar kodshe bedek habbayit asurin begiza vaavoda midderabbanan vehaika isura derabbanan ella shane para dela shechicha

Velichallah velappekah lechullin veliguzzah vahadar lakdeshah dameha yekarin velebad lah kedishmuel deamar shemuel hekdesh shave mane shechillo al shave peruta mechullal emor deamar shemuel shechillo lechitchilla mi amar
Ibaet ema rav savar lah kerabbi yose ben hamshullam verabbi yose ben hamshullam la savar lah kerav
Vetolesh et hassear uvilvad shello yezizennu mimmekomo amar rav ashe amar resh lakish lo shanu ella bayyad aval bichli asur vehakatane ose makom bekofitz mikan umikan teni lekofitz

Vechen tolesh et hassear lirot mum ibaya lehu lechattechilla o diavad amar rabbi yirmeya ta shema tzemer hamsubbach baozen rabbi yose ben hamshullam omer tolsho umare et mumo shema minah lechattechilla shema minah

Amar rav mari af anan name tenena vechen hattolesh et hassear lirot mekom mum may vechen ilema shello yazizu et yezizennu mimmekomo hashta uma shochet dishchitato mochachat alav lo yezizennu lirot mekom mum mibaya
Ella lav attolesh shema minah lechattechilla shema minah
Matni sear bechor baal mum shennashar vehinnicho bachallon veachar kach shechato akavya ben mahalalel mattir
b: Vachachamim osrin divre rabbi yehuda amar lo rabbi yose lo baze hittir akavya ben mahalalel ella sear baal mum shennashar vehinnicho bachallon veachar kach met baze akavya ben mahalalel mattir vachachamim osrin
Tzemer hamduldal babbechor et shennire im haggiza muttar veet sheeno nire im haggiza asur
Gema mikkelal deasar hashta bemet share shechato mibaya
Ella lo baze hittir akavya vachachamim osrin shechato divre hakkol shere ki peligi bemet
Amar rabbi assi amar resh lakish machloket beshehittiro mumche demar savar gazrinan dilma ate leshahoyeh umar savar la gazrinan aval lo hittiro mumche divre hakkol asur
Metiv rav sheshet baale mumin osrin bechol shehu verabbi yose omer yevakker
Vehavenan bah may yevakker illema devaal mum hu velishkeleh mikkelal detanna kamma amar lav

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh hacha begizat bechor baal mum askinan shennitarvu begize chullin uman tanna kamma rabbi yehuda hi deamar nishchatu asri rabbanan verabbi yose letameh deamar nishchatu sharu rabbanan
Vekatane yevukkar may yevukkar lav i mum kavua i mum over hu af al gav shello hittiro mumche
Amar rava lo yevukkar i hittiro mumche in vei la la

Ki selek ravin amrah lishmata kammeh derabbi yirmeya amar bavlae tafshae mishshum deyatvi beara dachashocha amri shemata dimchashshechan la shemia lehu ha deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan machloket beshebbadak velo matza
Vekamipalgi biflugta derabbi meir verabbanan ditnan shehaya rabbi meir omer kol davar shehaya bechezkat tuma leolam hu betumato ad shettivada hattuma
Vachachamim omrim chofer ad shemmaggia lesela o livtula
Rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan machloket keshebbadak umatza vekamipalgi biflugta derabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel

Detanya sade sheavad bah kever nichnas betochah tame nimtza betochah kever nichnas letochah tahor sheani omer hu kever sheavad hu kever shennimtza divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer tibadek kol hassade kullah
Verabbi assi may tama la amar kerabbi chiyya bar abba amar lach bishlama gabbe tuma emar ba orev untalah ba achbar untalah ella hacha baal mum lehecha azel veidach emar mum over hava veitassi

Verabbi chiyya bar abba may tama la amar kerabbi assi amar lach bishlama sade dirkah lemikbar bah ki hechi dikvar bah hay kevar inash acharina ella kadashim kevan divdiki lan vekayemi dirkayehu lemipal behu muma veidach aggav dimnaggechi ahadade shechiach behu muma
Metivi hattolesh tzemer mibbechor tam af al pi shennolad bo mum ushchato asur tama detam

a: Ha baal mum shere af al pi shello hittiru mumche tanna kol hecha delo hittiro mumche tam kare leh

Lema ketannae hattolesh tzemer mibbechor tam af al pi shennolad bo mum ushchato asur bechor baal mum shettalash mimmennu veachar kach met akavya ben mahalalel mattir vachachamim osrim amar rabbi yehuda lo baze hittir akavya ben mahalalel ella bisar bechor baal mum shennashar vehinnicho bachallon veachar kach shechato baze akavya ben mahalalel mattir vachachamim osrin

Amar rabbi yose mode abba chalafta beze shehu muttar aval beyichud amru chachamim yannichennu bachallon shemma yesh tikva shechato divre hakkol muttar met akavya ben mahalalel mattir vachachamim osrim
Rabbi yose hayenu tanna kamma ella lav hittiro mumche ika benayehu
Detanna kamma savar hittiro mumche in vei la la vaata rabbi yose lememar af al gav delo hittiro mumche
Amar rava la dechulle alma i hittiro mumche in i lo hittiro la veshalosh machlokot baddavar detanna kamma savar peligi bemet vehu haddin lishchato vehay dekamipalgi bemet lehodiacha kocho daakavya
Verabbi yehuda savar bemet divre hakkol asur ki peligi bishchato vaata rabbi yose lememar bishchato divre hakkol muttar ki peligi bemet
Amar rav nachman halacha kerabbi yehuda hoil utnan bivchirata kevateh ditnan sear bechor baal mum shennashar vehinnicho bachallon veachar kach shechato akavya ben mahalalel mattir vachachamim osrin
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak matnitin name dayeka ditnan tzemer hamduldal babbechor et shennire im haggiza muttar veet sheeno nire asur
Manni ilema rabbi yose uvmay ilema bishchato ben akavya ben rabbanan ide veide mishra share
Veella bemet vei rabbanan ide veide mesar asri vei akavya ipcha mibaya leh nire im haggiza asur demita kaasra leh eno nire im haggiza muttar demeikara telish
Ella peshita rabbi yehuda uvmay ilema bemet ben laakavya ben lerabbanan ide veide mesar asri
Ella lav bishchato vei akavya ide veide mishra share ella lav rabbanan hi ushma minah bishchato peligi shema minah
Bae rabbi yannay hattolesh tzemer meola temima mahu tolesh mi ika man deshare ella tzemer shennitlash meola temima mahu
Dechattat veasham la tibe lach dechevan dilchappara atu la meshahu lehu divchor umaaser name dechevan delav lechappara atu meshahu lehu ki tibe lach deola may kevan
b: Deikar lav lechappara ate meshahe lah o dilma kevan deola name mechappera aase la meshahe lah
Ta shema hattolesh tzemer mibbechor tam af al pi shennolad bo mum shechato asur tama detolesh ha nitlash share vechol shekken ola dela meshahe lah
Hu haddin afilu nitlash name asur vehay dekatane tolesh lehodiacha kocho daakavya divvaal mum afilu betolesh name share
Vehaanan nashar tenan tena nashar lehodiacha kochan derabbanan tena tolesh lehodiacha kocho daakavya
Tzemer hamduldal ku hechi dame eno nire im haggiza amar rabbi elazar amar resh lakish kol sheikaro hafuch kelappe rosho rav natan bar oshaya amar kol sheeno mitmaech im haggiza
Veresh lakish may tama la amar kerav natan bar oshaya amar rabbi ila kasavar resh lakish lefi shei efshar laggiza belo nimin hamduldalot
Hadaran alach hallokeach behema

Matni ad kamma yisrael chayyavin litappel bivchor baddakka sheloshim yom uvaggassa chamishshim yom rabbi yose omer baddakka shelosha chodashim amar lo hakkohen betoch hazzeman tenehu li hare ze lo yittenennu lo veim baal mum hu veamar lo tenehu li sheochlennu muttar uvishat hammikdash im haya tamim amar lo ten li veakrivennu muttar

Habbechor neechal shana beshana ben tam ben baal mum shenneemar lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana nolad lo mum betoch shenato rashshay lekayemo kol shenem asar chodesh leachar shenem asar chodesh eno rashshay lekayemo ella sheloshim yom
Gema menahane mile amar rav kahana deamar kera bechor banecha titten li ken taase letzonecha
Meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher ken taase leshorcha
Efoch ana mistabbera demakdam lemakdam dimachar ledimachar adderabba dismich leh ledismich leh
Ella amar rava amar kera taase hosif lecha hakkatuv asiyya acheret beshorcha
Veema shitin lo mesarcha hakkatuv ella lachachamim
Tanya name hachi bechor banecha titten li ken taase letzonecha yachol af leshorcha talmud lomar taase hosif lecha hakkatuv asiyya acheret beshorcha lo mesarcha hakkatuv ella lachachamim

Mikkan amru ad kamma yisrael chayyavin lehittappel bivchor bivhema dakka sheloshim yom begassa chamishshim yom rabbi yose omer baddakka shelosha chodashim mippene shettippulah merubba tana mippene sheshshineha dakkot
Im amar lo hakkohen betoch hazzeman tenehu li hare ze lo yitten lo may tama amar rav sheshet mippene shennire kechohen hamsayyea bevet haggoranot

Tanu rabbanan hakkohanim vehalviyyim vehaaniyyim hamsayeim bevet haroim uvvet haggoranot uvvet hammitbachayim en notnin lahem teruma umaaser bischaran veim osin ken chilelu vaalehen hakkatuv omer shichattem berit hallevi veomer veet kodshe vene yisrael lo techallelu velo tamutu
May veomer vechi tema mita la ta shema veet kodshe vene yisrael lo techallelu velo tamutu
Uvikkeshu chachamim lekonsan velihot mafrishin alehen teruma mishshalem umippene ma lo kenasum dilma ate leafroshe min happetur al hachiyyuv
Uvchullan yesh bahen

a: Tovat hanaa labbealim
Ketzad yisrael shehifrish teruma mikkiro umtzao yisrael acher veamar lo he lecha sela ze utnehu leven bitti kohen muttar im haya kohen lechohen asur
Vetanna may tama la kaamar mattenot kehunna amar lach teruma dikdushshat hagguf hi dechevan dela mittachala la ate lemite bah
Hane kevan dikdushshat damim ninhu ate lemite behon devar mitachal kedushtayehu aarbea zuze veate leminhag behon minhag dechullin
Amar rava terumat chutza laaretz en bah mishshum kohen hamsayyea bevet haggeranot rav chama yahev leh leshammaeh
Amar shemuel terumat chutza laaretz betela berov rabba mevattelah berov veochel lah bime tumato
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua ki mitreme leh chamra ditruma hava rame tere natle dechullin vachada natla ditruma veshakel chad mikan veelach rame chada veshakel chada
Veamar shemuel terumat chutza laaretz ochel veholech veachar kach mafrish
Veamar shemuel en terumat chutza laaretz asura ella bemi shehattuma yotza alav miggufo vehane mile baachila aval bingia let lan bah

Amar ravina hilkach nidda kotza challa veochel lah kohen katan vei leka kohen katan shakla lah beresh massa veshadya betannura vahadar mafresha challa achariti ki hechi delo tishtakkach torat challa veochel lah kohen gadol

Rav nachman verav amram verame bar chama hao kaazli bearba selek rav amram leippenoye atay hahi itta allat kammayehu amara lehu teme met mahu sheyyitbol veochel terumat chutza laaretz amar leh rav nachman lerame bar chama
b: Vechi hazzaa yesh lanu amar leh rame bar chama la lechush leh lesava addehachi ata rav amram amar lehu hachi amar rav teme met tovel veochel bitrumat chutza laaretz
Velet hilcheta kevateh deamar mar zutra mishshemeh derav sheshet teme sheretz tovel veochel bitrumat chutza laaretz velet hilcheta kevateh
Bechor neechal shana beshana ku middekaamar nolad bo mum betoch shenato lememra dilshana dideh manenan mena hane mile
Deamar rav yehuda amar rav deamar kera lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana ezohi shana shennichneset bachavertah heve omer shana shel bechor
Deve rav tana shana beshana yom echad beshana zo veom echad beshana zo limed al habbechor shenneechal lishne yamim velayela echad
Deve rav mena lehu yalfi mikkodashim vekadashim gufayehu menalan amar rav acha bar yaakov amar kera keves ben shenato shenato shello velo shana shel minyan olam

Verav neechal lishne yamim velayela echad mena leh nafka leh meuvsaram yihye lach kachaze hattenufa uchshok hayyamin hikkisho hakkatuv lechaze vashok shel shelamim ma lehallan shene yamim velayela echad af kan shene yamim velayela echad

a: Veidach i mehatam ika lememar chaze vashok shel toda
Veidach amar kera lecha yihye hosif lecha hakkatuv havaya acheret bivchor
Veidach ha mehatam ika lememar hay yihye lach limed al bechor baal mum shennotno lechohen shello matzinu lo bechol hattora kullah
Veidach amar uvsaram echad tam veechad baal mum veidach uvsaram dehane bechorot dechullehu yisrael kaamar

Nolad lo mum betoch shenato rashshay lekayemo kol shenem asar chodesh ibaya lehu hechi kaamar nolad lo betoch shenato rashshay lekayemo kol shenem asar chodesh ulachar shenato name sheloshim o dilma hecha denolad bo mum betoch shenato rashshay lekayemo kol shenem asar chodesh vetu la vehecha denolad lo achar shenato eno rashshay lekayemo ella sheloshim

Ta shema detanya bechor bizman hazze ad shello nira leharoto lechacham rashshay lekayemo shettayim veshalosh shanim umishshennira leharoto lechacham nolad lo mum betoch shenato rashshay lekayemo kol shenem asar chodesh
Achar shenato eno rashshay lekayemo afilu yom echad vaafilu shaa achat aval mippene hashavat aveda labbealim amru rashshay lekayemo sheloshim yom
Vaadayin tibe li sheloshim yom achar shenato o dilma kodem shenato

Ta shema nolad lo mum bachamishsha asar yom betoch shenato mashlimin lo chamishsha asar yom achar shenato shema minah mesayya lerabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar notnin lo sheloshim yom mishshaa shennolad bo mum

Ika deamri amar rabbi elazar minnayin livchor shennolad bo mum betoch shenato shennotnin lo sheloshim yom achar shenato shenneemar lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana ezo elu hen yamim hachashuvin shana heve omer ellu sheloshim yom
Metivi nolad lo mum bachamishsha asar yom betoch shenato mashlimin lo chamishsha asar yom achar shenato hashlama in mehava la teuvta derabbi elazar teuvta

Matni hashshochet et habbechor umare et mumo rabbi yehuda mattir rabbi meir omer hoil venishchat shello al pi mumche asur mi sheeno mumche veroe et habbechor venishchat al piv hare ze yikkaver vishallem mibbeto

Gema amar rabba bar bar chana bedukkin shebbaayin dechulle alma la peligi deasur mippene shehen mishtannin lo nechleku ella bemumin shebbagguf derabbi meir savar gazrinan mumin shebbagguf attu dukkin shebbaayin verabbi yehuda savar la gazrinan mumin shebbagguf attu dukkin shebbaayin

Tanya name hachi hashshochet et habbechor umare et mumav rabbi yehuda omer bedukkin shebbeayin asur mippene shehen mishtannin bemumin shebbagguf muttar mippene sheen mishtannin rabbi meir omer echad ze veechad ze asur mippene shehen mishtannin mippene shehen mishtannin salka datach mumin shebbagguf mi mishtannin ella mippene hammishtannin
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak
b: Matnitin name dayeka rabbi meir omer hoil venishchat shello al pi mumche asur shema minah kenasa ka kanes rabbi meir shema minah
Ibaya lehu mippene hammishtannin dechullehu mishtanni o dilma ika demishtanne veika dela mishtanne
Lemay nafka minah leachchoshe sahadi i amratte kullehu mishtanni shakkare ninhu vei amratte ika demishtanne veika dela mishtanne samchinan alayehu may
Ta shema deamar rabba bar bar chana sach li rabbi yoshiyya demin usha bo vearekka bedukkin shehen mishtannim middekaamar leh bo vearekka mikkelal deika demishtanne veika dela mishtanne
Mi sheeno mumche veraa et habbechor venishchat al piv hare ze yikkaver vishallem mibbeto lema tenan setama kerabbi meir dilma bedukkin shebbaayin vedivre hakkol
Tana keshehu meshallem meshallem revia laddakka umechetza laggassa may tama amar rav pappa ze hefsed merubbe veze hefsed muat
I hachi lefum peseda lishallem amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bar ika mishshum gezerat megaddele behema dakka nagu bah
Matni dan et haddin zika et hachayyav vechiyyev et hazzakkay time et hattahor vetiher et hattame ma sheasa asuy vishallem mibbeto veim haya mumche levet din patur milleshallem
Gema lema tenan setama kerabbi meir dedaen dina digrame amar rabbi ila amar rav kegon shennasa venatan bayyad
Bishlama chiyyev et hazzakkay kegon shennasa venatan bayyad ella zika et hachayyav hechi dame i daamar leh patur atta veha lo nasa venatan bayyad amar ravina kegon shehaya lo mashkon untalo hemennu
Time et hattahor deagga behu sheretz tiher et hattame sheervan im perotav
Matni umaase befara shennitla haem shellah veheechilah rabbi tarfon lichlavim uva maase lifne chachamim beyavne vehittiruha
Veamar todos harofe en para vachazira yotza mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim sheen chotchin haem shellah bishvil shello teled
Amar rabbi tarfon halcha chamorcha tarfon amar lo rabbi akiva rabbi tarfon atta mumche levet din vechol hammumche levet din patur milleshallem
Gema vetipok leh detaa bidvar mishna vetaa bidvar mishna chozer
Chada veod kaamar chada detaa bidvar mishna chozer veod i name beshikul haddaat taita mumche levet din atta vechol hammumche levet din patur milleshallem
Matni hannotel sachar lihot roe et habbechorot en shochatin al piv ella im ken haya mumche

a: Keila beyavne shehittiru lo beyavne chachamim lihot notel arba isarot livhema dakka veshishsha legassa ben tam uven baal mum
Gema may tama hay nefish tircheh vehay la nefish tircheh
Ben tam uven baal mum bishlama baal mum mishshum deka share leh ella tam ammay deim ken ate lemichshedeh veamri hay baal mum tam hu vehay deka share leh mishshum agra
I hachi tam name amri baal mum hu vehay dela kashare leh savar ki hechi delishkol agreh zimna achariti chad zimna takkinu le rabbanan tere zimne la takkinu le rabbanan
Matni hannotel secharo ladun dinav betelim lehaid edotav betelin lehazzot ulkaddesh memav me meara efro efer mikle
Im haya kohen metammeehu mitterumato maachilo umashko vesacho veim haya zaken markivo al hachamor venoten lo secharo kefoel
Gema menahane mile amar rav yehuda amar rav deamar kera ree limmadti etchem vego ma ani bechinnam af attem bechinnam

Tanya name hachi kaasher tzivani Adonai elohay ma ani bechinnam af attem bechinnam uminnayin sheim lo matza bechinnam sheyelammed besachar talmud lomar emet kene uminnayin shello yomar keshem shellemadtiha besachar kach alammedenna besachar talmud lomar emet kene veal timkor
Lehazzot ulkaddesh memav me meara efro efer mikle urminhu hamkaddesh beme chattat beefer chattat hare zo mekuddeshet af al pi shehu yisrael
Amar abbaye la kashya kan bischar havaa umilluy kan bischar hazzaa vekidush
Dayeka name dekatane hacha lehazzot ulkaddesh vehatam katane hamkaddesh beme chattat uvefer chattat shema minah
Im haya kohen metammeehu mitterumato ku ihu gufeh hechi azel
Levet happeras derabbanan deamar rav yehuda amar rav menappeach adam bet happeras veholech
b: Verav yehuda bar amme mishshemeh derav yehuda amar bet happeras shennidash tahor
I name bishar tumot dela mazhar alayehu
Im haya zaken markivo al hachamor tena kefoel batel amar abbaye kefoel batel shel otah melacha

Matni hechashud al habbechorot en lokchin mimmennu besar tzevaim velo orot sheenan avudim rabbi eliezer omer lokchin mimmennu orot shel nekeva veen lokchin mimmennu tzemer melubban vetzoi aval lokchin mimmennu tevi uvgadim
Gema besar tzevaim demichallaf bidegla
Velo orot sheenan avudim ha avudim zavninan im ita divchor hava la hava tarach beh savar i shamu beh rabbanan mafsedu leh minay
Rabbi eliezer omer lokchin mimmennu orot shel nekeva may tama mida yedia
Vetanna kamma im ken zachar name chayek lezachruteh veamar achbarim achluh veidach be achbarim mida yedia
Veen lokchin mimmennu tzemer melubban vetzoi hashta tzemer melubban la zavninan tzoi mibaya ella chada katane tzemer melubban mitztzoato
Aval lokchin mimmennu tevi uvgadim hashta tevi zavninan begadim mibaya may begadim namte
Matni hechashud al hashsheviit en lokchin mimmennu pishtan vaafilu serak aval lokchin mehem tevi vearig
Gema hashta tevi zavninan arig mibaya may arig tike
Matni hechashud lihot mocher teruma leshum chullin en lokchin mimmennu afilu mayim vamelach divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer kol sheyyesh bo zikat teruma umaasrot en lokchin mimmennu
Gema leetoye may leetoye kirve dagim dimarvi behu shemen zayit
Hahu tabbacha dahava chashud lezabbone

a: Tarba deatma bemar dechanta kanseh rava lezabbone afilu amgoze amar leh rav pappa lerava keman kerabbi yehuda i kerabbi yehuda afilu mayim vamelach name
Leolam rabbi shimon uvisura degufeh kansinan leh setam dardeke geru beamgoze veazel umshabbesh livne tabbache vegare lehu beamgoze umayetu leh tarba deatma umzabben leh bemar dechanta

Matni hechashud al hashsheviit eno chashud al hammaasrot hechashud al hammaasrot eno chashud al hashsheviit hechashud al ze veal ze chashud al hatteharot veyesh shehu chashud al hatteharot veeno chashud lo al ze velo al ze ze hakkelal hechashud al davar lo dano velo meido
Gema may tama sheviit la baaya choma maaser kevan devae choma chamir leh
Hechashud al hammaaser may tama maaser it leh pidon sheviit kevan deka mitasra leh velet leh pidon chamira leh
Hechashud al ze veal ze kevan dachashid addeorayeta kol shekken adderabbanan
Veyesh chashud al hatteharot may tama nehi adderabbanan chashid addeorayeta la chashid urminhi neeman al hatteharot neeman al sheviit ha chashid chashid
Amar rabbi ilay matnitin kesherinuhu shennoheg betzina betoch beto
Rabbi yannay berabbi yishmael amar kegon dahava chashid letarvayehu vaata kamme rabbanan vekabbel attarvayehu vahadar ichashad achad minayehu deamrinan migo dachashid aha chashid name aidach
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi akiva setimtaa aval chachamim omrim chashud al hashsheviit chashud al hammaaser
Man chachamim rabbi yehuda divatreh derabbi yehuda sheviit chamira lehu dehahu dahava kare leh lechavreh dayyara bar dayyarta amar leh tete li dela achali perot sheviit kevatach

Ika deamri amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi akiva setimtaa aval chachamim omrim chashud al hammaaser chashud al hashsheviit uman chachamim rabbi meir hi deamar chashud ledavar echad have chashud lechol hattora kullah
Rabbi yona verabbi yirmeya talmide rabbi zeera veamri lah rabbi yona verabbi zeera talmide rabbi yochanan chad amar aval chachamim omrim chashud al hashsheviit
b: Chashud al hammaaser uman chachamim rabbi yehuda vechad amar hechashud al hammaaser chashud al hashsheviit uman chachamim rabbi meir
Detanya am haaretz shekkibel alav divre chaverut venechshad ledavar echad nechshad lechol hattora kullah divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim eno nechshad ella leoto davar bilvad
Hagger shekkibel alav divre tora afilu nechshad ledavar echad have chashud lechol hattora kullah vahare hu keyisrael meshummad nafka minah dei kaddesh kidushav kidushin

Tanu rabbanan habba lekabbel divre chaverut chutz middavar echad en mekabbelin oto goy shebba lekabbel divre tora chutz middavar echad en mekabbelin oto rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer afilu dikduk echad middivre sofrim

Vechen ben levi shebba lekabbel divre leviyya vechohen shebba lekabbel divre chehunna chutz middavar echad en mekabbelin oto shenneemar hammakriv et dam hashshelamim vego haavoda hammesura livne aharon kol kohen sheeno mode bah en lo chelek bakkehunna

Tanu rabbanan habba lekabbel divre chaverut im reinuhu shennoheg betzina betoch beto mekabbelin oto veachar kach melammedin oto veim lav melammedin oto veachar kach mekabbelin oto rabbi shimon ben yochay omer ben kach uven kach mekabbelin oto vehu lamed kedarko veholech
Tanu rabbanan mekabbelin lichnafayim veachar kach mekabbelin litharot veim amar eni mekabbel ella lichnafayim mekabbelin oto kibel latteharot velo kibel lakkenafayim af latteharot lo kibel
Tanu rabbanan ad kamma mekabbelin oto bet shammay omrim lemashkin sheloshim yom lichsut shenem asar chodesh uvet hillel omrim echad ze veechad ze lishnem asar chodesh
Im ken have leh mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel ella bet hillel omrim echad ze veechad ze lishloshim
Siman chaver talmid techelet meches chazar gabbay beatzmo

Tanu rabbanan habba lekabbel divre chaverut tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim uvanav uvne beto enan tzerichin lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim rabban shimon ben gamliel omer af banav uvne veto tzerichin lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim lefi sheeno dome chaver shekkibel leven chaver shekkibel

Tanu rabbanan habba lekabbel divre chaverut tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim vaafilu talmid chacham tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim zaken veoshev bishiva eno tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim shekkevar kibel alav mishshaa sheyyashav abba shaul omer af talmid chacham eno tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim velo od ella sheacherim mekabbelin lefanav

Amar rabbi yochanan bime beno shel rabbi chanina ben antignos nishnet mishna zo rabbi yehuda verabbi yose istappak lehu milta bitharot shaddaru rabbanan legabbe beno shel rabbi chanina ben antignos ezilu emaru leh leayyen bah ashkechuh deka taen teharot otev rabbanan middideh legabbayehu vekae ihu leayyone bah
Ato amri leh lerabbi yehuda verabbi yose amar lehu rabbi yehuda aviv shel ze biza talmide chachamim af hu mevazze talmide chachamim
Amar lo rabbi yose kevod zaken yehe munnach bimkomo ella miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash nahagu kohanim silsul beatzman sheen mosrin et hatteharot lechol adam
Tanu rabbanan chaver shemmet ishto uvanav uvne beto hare hen bechezkatan ad sheyyechashedu vechen chatzer shemmochrin bah techelet hare hi bechezkatah ad shettipasel

Tanu rabbanan eshet am haaretz shennisset lechaver vechen bitto shel am haaretz shennisset lechaver vechen avdo shel am haaretz shennimkar lechaver kullan tzerichin lekabbel divre chaverut battechilla aval eshet chaver shennisset leam haaretz vechen bitto shel chaver shennisset leam haaretz vechen avdo shel chaver shennimkar leam haaretz en tzerichin lekabbel divre chaverut battechilla

Rabbi meir omer af hen tzerichin lekabbel alehen divre chaverut lechattechilla rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir maase beishsha achat shennisset lechaver vehayeta komaat lo tefilin al yado nisset leam haaretz vehayeta kosheret lo kishre moches al yado

a: Tanu rabbanan vechullan shechazru bahen en mekabbelin otan olamit divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer chazru bematmoniyyot en mekabbelin otan befarhesya mekabbelin otan
Ika deamri im asu divrehen bematmoniyyot mekabbelin otan befarhesya en mekabbelin otan
Rabbi shimon verabbi yehoshua ben korcha omrim ben kach uven kach mekabbelin otan mishshum shenneemar shuvu banim shovavim amar rabbi yitzchak ish kefar akko amar rabbi yochanan halacha keoto hazzug
Tanu rabbanan barishona hau omrim chaver venaasa gabbay dochin oto mechaverato perash en mekabbelin oto chazru lomar perash hare hu kechol adam

Rav huna bar chiyya itztericha leh shata hava ayel gabbeh rabba verav yosef vearba mea zuge derabbanan shema deatu ketar lehu arba mea tachtake lesof shemau denaasa gabbay shelachu leh zil lachashivuteh zil lekadmuteh shelach lehu hadari bi rav yosef la azal rabba azal
Rav yosef amar tenena perash en mekabbelin oto rabba amar tenena chazru lomar perash hare hu kechol adam
Tanu rabbanan kol habbechorot adam roe chutz mishshel atzmo veroe et kodashav veet maserotav venishal al tohorotav
Amar mar kol habbechorot adam roe chutz mishshel atzmo bemay askinan ilema bechad mi meheman ella bitlata umi chashidi vehatnan meana o shechaltza befanav yissaenna mippene shehu bet din
Leolam bechad vechidamar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan beyachid mumche hacha name beyachid mumche
Veroe et kodashav dei bae mitshil alayehu
Umaserotav dei bae shade beh muma bechulleh edreh
Venishal al tohorotav deha chazu leh bime tumato
Hadaran alach ad kamma yisrael chayyavin
Matni kal pesule hammukdashin hanaatan lahekdesh nimkarin baitliz venishchatin baitliz venishkalin belitra
Chutz min habbechor vehammaaser shehanayatan labbealim pesule hammukdashin hanayatan lahekdesh
Veshoklin mana keneged mana babbechor
b: Gema kal pesule hammukdashin hanaatan lahekdesh emat ilema leachar pidono hanaatan lahekdesh hanaatan divalim hu
Ella lifne pidono nishchatin ha bae haamada vehaaracha
Hanicha leman deamar kodshe mizbeach lo hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha ella leman deamar hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha may ika lememar
Ella leolam leachar pidon umay hanaatan lahekdesh addemeikara
Dechevan deshare lehu mar nimkarin baitliz venishchatin baitliz venishkalin belitra tafe ufarek meikara
Chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser shehanayatan labbealim bishlama bechor baitliz hu dela mizdabban ha beveteh mizdabban ella maaser beveteh mi mizdabban
Vehatanya bivchor neemar lo tifde venimkar chay bemaaser neemar lo yiggael veeno nimkar lo chay velo shachut lo tam velo baal mum
Ha milta ikashya leh lerav sheshet beurta veshanneyah bekadmuta mibbarayeta bemasar behema shel yetomim askinan umishshum hashavat aveda nagu bah

Rabbi idi sarseyeh derav sheshet hava shamah mineh azal amrah be midresha vela amrah mishshemeh shema rav sheshet ikfad amar man deaketz liketzeh akrabba verav sheshet may nafka leh minah deamar rav yehuda amar rav may dichtiv agura beoholcha olamim vechi ifshar leadam lagur bishne olamim

Ella amar david ribbono shel olam yomru devar shemua mippi beolam hazze deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay kol talmid chacham sheomrim devar shemua mippiv beolam hazze siftotav dovvot bakkever

Veamar rabbi yitzchak bar zeeri may keraa vechikkech keyen hattov holech ledodi lemesharim dovev sifte yeshenim kechomer shel anavim ma komer shel anavim kevan deadam nogea bo dovev af talmide chachamim kevan sheadam omer devar shemua mippiv dovvot sefatav bakkever
May barayeta detanya masar behema shel yetomim mochrin oto umasar behema sheshshechato mavlio beoro bechelbo uvgido uvkarnav
May kaamar amar abbaye hachi kaamar masar behema shel yetomim mochrin oto behavlaa
Mikkelal degadol behavlaa la may shena meha detanya hallokeach lulav mechavero bishviit noten lo etrog bemattana lefi sheeno rashshay lelokcho bashsheviit
Vehavenan bah lo ratza liten lo bemattana may veamar rav huna mavlia lo deme etrog ballulav
Hatam la mochcha milta hacha mochcha milta
Amar rava im ken masar behema tere zimne lema li ella amar rava hachi kaamar masar behema shel yetomim mochrin oto kedarko umasar behema degadol sheshshechato mavlio beoro bechelbo begido uvkarnav
Amar rava mena amena lah dichtiv vehaya hu utmurato yihye kodesh lo yiggael
Ematay ose temura mechayyim ematay eno nigal mechayyim ha leachar shechita nigal verabbanan hu digzaru leachar shechita attu lifne shechita
Davar hannishom mechayyim gezur rabbanan leachar shechita attu lifne shechita

a: Davar sheeno nishom mechayyim la gezur rabbanan uvyatme okmuha rabbanan addeorayeta
Veaf rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak savar lah leha derava deamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak minnayin lemasar behema shel yetomim shemmochrim oto kedarko
Shenneemar rak bechol avat nafshecha tizbach veachalta vasar ezehu davar sheen bo beracha mechayyim ella leachar shechita heve omer ze masar behema
Ibaya lehu mahu lehavlio baatzamot rabbi chiyya verabbi shimon berabbi chad amar mavlio vechad amar en mavlio
Vela peligi ha bedakka ha begassa
Veibaet ema ide veide begassa vela peligi mar ki atreh umar ki atreh
Gufa bivchor hu omer lo yifde venimkar bemaaser neemar lo yiggael veeno nimkar lo chay velo shachut velo tam velo baal mum mena hane mile
Amar rav chinana amar rav vechen amar rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan neemar lo yiggael bemaaser veneemar velo yiggael bacharamim ma lehallan mechira immo af kan mechira immo
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua mafne dei la mafne ika lemifrach ma lacharamim shekken chalim al hakkol
Laye afnoye mafne lo yeamer velo yiggael bacharamim veyigmar mimmaaser ma maaser kadosh veeno nigal af charamim kedoshim veenam nigalin velo yiggael dichtav rachamana lema li leafnoye
Ika lemifrach ma lemaaser shekken kadosh lefanav ulacharav
Ella lo yeamer lo yiggael bacharamim veyigmar mibbechor ma bechor kadosh veeno nigal af charamim kedoshin veenan nigalin lo yiggael dichtav rachamana lema li leafnoye
Ika lemifrach ma livchor shekken kedushshato merechem
Ella lo yeamer lo yiggael bemaaser veyigmar haavara haavara mibbechor ma bechor kadosh veeno nigal af maaser kadosh veeno nigal lo yiggael dichtav rachamana bemaaser lema li leafnoye
Veakkatti bemaaser name la mafne deika lemifrach kidfarchinan
Vehaavarta kera yattira hu
Bechor name nelaf geulla geulla mecharamim demaaser mafne divchor la mafne
Umay chazet delo tifde divchor legufeh udmaaser leafnoye veema demaaser legufeh divchor leafnoye
Danin geulla miggeulla veen danin pediyya miggeulla
May nafka minah ha tana deve rabbi yishmael veshav hakkohen uva hakkohen zo hi shiva zo hi bia
Hane mile hecha deleka dedame leh aval ika dedame leh middedame leh yalfinan
Velelaf bechor haavara haavara mimmaaser deha maaser name gamar geulla geulla mecharamim
Miet rachamana gabbe charamim hu hu velo bechor veema hu velo maaser maaser geulla kemoto
Rava amar lo yiggael dacharamim la tzerich deitanhu hecha i be vealim hekdesh ninhu i be chohen chullin ninhu

Detanya charamim kol zeman shehen bevet bealim hare hen kehekdesh lechol divrehem shenneemar kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu la netanan lechohen hare hen kechullin lechol divrehem shenneemar kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye lo
b: Yiggael dichtav rachamana lema li im eno inyan lacharamim tenehu inyan lemaaser ema tenehu inyan livchor maaser geulla kemoto
Rav ashe amar lo yiggael demaaser lo yimmacher hu amar rav ashe mena amena lah dichtiv vehaya hu utmurato yihye kodesh lo yiggael
Ematay ose temura mechayyim ematay eno nigal mechayyim ha leachar shechita nigal ha bae haamada vehaaracha
Ella shema minah lo yiggael lo yimmacher hu
Hanicha leman deamar kodshe mizbeach hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha ella leman deamar kodshe mizbeach lo hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha may ika lememar
Anan hachi kaamrinan mi ika demechayyim la miprik ulachar shechita miprik allema la mechayyim deallima kedushteh la miprik leachar shechita deakkel leh kedushteh miprik
Vela kol dechen hu uma mechayyim deallim lemitpas pidono la miprik leachar shechita dela allim lemitpas pidono miprik ella shema minah lo yiggael lo yimmacher hu

Velichtov rachamana lo yimmacher i ketav rachamana lo yimmacher hava amena izdabbone hu dela mizdabban deka aved ovadin dechol aval iproke miprik deha ayeli damav lehekdesh lehachi ketav rachamana lo yiggael dela izdabbone mizdabban vela iproke miprik
Matni bet shammay omrim lo yimmane yisrael im hakkohen labbechor uvet hillel mattirin vaafilu goy
Gema matnitin manni rabbi akiva hi detanya bechor en nimnin alav ella chavura shekkullah kohanim divre bet shammay uvet hillel omrim afilu zarim rabbi akiva mattir afilu goy
May tama devet shammay dichtiv uvsaram yihye lach vego ma hatam kohanim in yisrael la af hacha kohanim in yisrael la

a: Uvet hillel hane mile tam aval baal mum ketiv hattame vehattahor yachdav yochlennu uma tame sheeno ochel bekadashim kallim ochel bivchor zar sheochel bekadashim kallim eno din sheyyochal bivchor
Ika lemifrach ma letame shekken huttar mikkelalo baavodat tzibbur
Uvet hillel attu baavoda kaamar baachila kaamrinan achilat zar adif
Verabbi akiva mattir vaafilu goy may tama derabbi akiva katztzevi vechaayyal ma tzevi veayyal muttar legoy af pesulin muttar legoy
Veidach telata tzevi veayyal ketivi chad lechidrabbi yitzchak vechad lechidrabbi oshaya vechad lechidrabbi elazar hakkappar
Veidach ma tzevi veayyal peturim min habbechora af pesule hammukdashin peturin min habbechora
Tanu rabbanan bechor en maachilin oto leniddot divre bet shammay uvet hillel omrim maachilin oto leniddot may tama devet shammay dichtiv uvsaram yihye lach ma hatam niddot la af hacha niddot la
Uvet hillel hane mile tam aval baal mum hattame vehattahor yochlennu
Uvet shammay hane mile hecha deen tuma yotza alav miggufo aval hecha detuma yotza alav miggufo la
Deashkechan defalleg rachamana ben tuma yotza alav miggufo leven sheen tuma yotza alav miggufo ditnan happesach shebba betuma lo yochlu mimmennu zavim umtzorain vezavot veniddot veoldot
Uvet hillel hatam hu degalli rachamana teme nefesh aval hacha tame setama ketiv la shena
Tanu rabbanan en margilin beom tov kayyotze bo en margilin babbechor velo bifsule hammukdashin
Bishlama yom tov deka tarach tircha dela chaze leh ella bechor man tanna amar rav chisda bet shammay hi deamar en maachilin oto leniddot
Velo bifsule hammukdashin man tanna amar rav chisda rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi ditnan hau lefanav shette chattaot achat temima veachat baalat mum temima tikrav baalat mum tipade
Nishchata baalat mum im ad shello nizrak damah shel temima mutteret im mishshennizrak damah shel temima asura
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer afilu basar bikdera venizrak damah shel temima asura
Verav chisda lokmah kullah kevet shammay dilma ad kan la kaamri bet shammay ella bivchor dikdushshato merechem aval pesule hammukdashin deen kedushshato merechem la
b: Velokmah kullah kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hatam ella pesule hammukdashin deallimi lemitpas pidono aval bechor dela allim lemitpas pidono la
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon let leh kol pesule hammukdashin nimkarin baitliz venishkalin belitra alma dechevan deika ravecha lehekdesh share leh
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana ma shemmashbiach baor pogem babbasar bemareva mishshemeh deravina amri mippene shennire keoved avoda bekadashim
Rabbi yose bar avin omer gezera shemma yegaddel mehen adarim adarim

Matni bechor sheachazo dam afilu met en makkizin lo dam divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim yakkiz uvilvad shello yaase bo mum veim asa bo mum hare ze lo yishchat alav rabbi shimon omer yakkiz af al pi shehu ose bo mum
Gema tanu rabbanan bechor sheachazo dam makkizin lo et haddam bimkom sheen osim bo mum veen makkizin lo et haddam bimkom sheosin bo mum divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim af bimkom sheose bo mum uvilvad shello yishchat al oto hammum rabbi shimon omer af nishchat al oto hammum rabbi yehuda omer afilu met en makkizin lo et haddam

Matne leh rabbi elazar livreh veamri lah rabbi chiyya livreh kammachloket kan kach machloket bechavit shel teruma ditnan chavit shel teruma shennolad bah sefek tuma rabbi eliezer omer im hayeta bimkom hatturpa yannichenna bemakom hammutzna im hayeta megulla yechassenna
Rabbi yehoshua omer im hayeta munnachat bemakom hammutzna yannichenna bimkom hatturpa im hayeta mechussa yegallenna rabban gamliel omer lo yechaddesh bah davar
Rabbi meir kerabbi eliezer verabbanan kerabbi yehoshua verabbi yehuda kerabban gamliel
Mimmay dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam deka aved beyadayim aval hacha digrama kerabbi yehoshua sevira leh
Vead kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam ella shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna aval hacha dei shavek leh mayet kerabbanan sevira leh

Vead kan la kaamri rabbanan hacha dei shavek leh mayet aval hatam shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna kerabbi eliezer sevira lehu vead kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hacha deka aved beyadayim aval hatam digrama kerabbi yehoshua sevira leh
Vead kan la kaamar rabban gamliel hatam deshemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna aval hacha dei shavek leh mayet kerabbanan sevira leh
Veod hacha bikrae peligi vehacha bikrae peligi deamar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim bimchammetz achar mechammetz shehu chayyav dichtiv lo teafe chametz velo tease
Bimsares acher mesares shehu chayyav dichtiv umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut im al koret chayyav al notek lo kol shekken ella lehavi notek achar koret shehu chayyav
Lo nechleku ella bemetil mum bevaal mum derabbi meir savar kol mum lo yihye bo verabbanan savri tamim yihye leratzon
Verabbi meir hay tamim yihye leratzon may aved leh mibe leh lemaote baal mum meikaro
Baal mum meikaro peshita dikla bealma hu
Ella lemaote pesule hammukdashin leachar pidonan salka datach amena hoil vaasiri begiza vaavoda bemumin name litasru ka mashma lan
Verabbanan name hachtiv kol mum lo yihye bo ligrama hu deate detanya mum lo yihye bo en li

a: Ella shello yitten bo mum minnayin shello yavi devela uvatzek veyannichenna al haozen kede sheyyavo kelev veyochlenna talmud lomar kol mum echad mum veechad kol mum
Hacha bikrae peligi deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel vechen amar resh lakish vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh vaani hinne natatti lecha et mishmeret terumotay
Rabbi eliezer savar bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber achat teruma tehora veachat teruma teluya veamar rachamana aved lah shimur verabbi yehoshua terumati ketiv
Lememra derabbi eliezer savar yesh em lammikra urminhi bevigdo bah kevan shepperas tallito aleha shuv eno rashshay lemochrah divre rabbi akiva
Rabbi eliezer omer kevan shebbagad bah shuv eno rashshay lemochrah
Ella hacha beha kamipalgi rabbi yehoshua savar haruya lach shemor vesheenah reuya lach la tishmor verabbi eliezer ha name reuya hi shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi shimon matkef lah rav nachman bar yitzchak he rabbi shimon ilema rabbi shimon dematnitin ad hashta la ashmeinan shemuel davar sheen mitkaven muttar

Veha rabbi chiyya bar ashe amar rav halacha kerabbi yehuda verav chanin bar ashe amar shemuel halacha kerabbi shimon verav chiyya bar avin matne bela gavre rav amar halacha kerabbi yehuda ushmuel amar halacha kerabbi shimon
Ella rabbi shimon devarayeta verav shisha bereh derav idi matne lah behedya amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi shimon devarayeta
Matni hatztzorem ozen babbechor hare ze lo yishchot olamit divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim nolad bo mum acher yishchot alav
Gema umi kanes rabbi eliezer leolam urminhi mi shehayeta lo baheret
b: Veniktzetza tahor ketzatza mitkaven rabbi eliezer omer lichsheyyivaled lo nega acher yithar hemennu
Vachachamim omrim ad shettifrach bechullo o ad shettimat baharto mikkigris
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayehu ki kanes rabbi eliezer bemamono begufo la kanes
Mamono ika lememar deate lemebad gufo mi ika lememar deate lemebad
Amar rava derabbi eliezer adderabbi eliezer kashya derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya
Ella derabbi eliezer adderabbi eliezer la kashya kidshanninan rabbanan adderabbanan name la kashya hacha bemay daavad kansuh hacha bemay daavad kansuh
Bemay ikaven lemishreyeh behay muma behay muma kansuh rabbanan divhay muma la lishtere leh vehacha bemay daavad kansuh ikaven letahore nafsheh behay ketzitza behay ketzitza kansuh rabbanan
Bae rav pappa yithar tenan o veyithar tenan
Lemay nafka minah lechatan shennira bo nega
Ditnan chatan shennira bo nega notnin lo shiva yamim lo ulitztelito velichsuto vechen baregel notnin lo kol yeme haregel
I amratte yithar tenan mikkammayeta tehar leh levatrayeta natrin leh shiva yeme mishte
Ella i amratte veyithar tenan sof sof ki la metammet levatrayeta ha mitamme vekae mikkammayeta may teku
Bae mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera tzorem ozen babbechor vamet mahu liknos beno acharav
Im timtze lomar mocher avdo laggoyim vamet kansu beno acharav dechol yoma veoma mafka leh mimmitzot
Im timtze lomar kiven melachto bammoed vamet lo kansu beno acharav mishshum dela avdeh leisura
Hacha may ledideh kenasu rabbanan veha leteh o dilma lemamoneh kenasu rabbanan veha iteh

Amar leh tenetuha sade shennitkavvetza bishviit tizzara lemotzae sheviit nitayeva nidayera lo tizzara lemotzae sheviit veamar rav assi berabbi chanina naktinan hetivah vamet beno zorah alma ledideh kenasu rabbanan livreh la kenasu rabbanan
Amar abbaye naktinan

a: Time teharot vamet lo kansu beno acharav may tama hezek sheeno nikar la shemeh hezek kenasa derabbanan ledideh kenasu rabbanan livreh la kenasu rabbanan

Matni maase bezachar shel rechelim zaken usaro meduldal veraahu kastor echad veamar ma tivo shel ze amru lo bechor hu veeno nishchat ella im ken haya bo mum natal pigom vetzaram ozno uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiru veachar shehittiru halach vetzerem beozne vechorot acherim veasru

Paam achat hau tinokot mesachakin bassade vekashru zanve telaim ze baze venifseka zenavo shel echad mehem vahare hu bechor uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiru rau shehittiru halchu vekashru zanvot bechorot acherim veasru ze hakkelal kol shehu ledato asur shello ledato muttar
Gema paam acheret haya ku utzricha dei ashmeinan goy dela ate lemisrach aval katan deate lemisrach ema la
Vei ashmoinan katan mishshum dela ate leichallofe begadol aval goy deate leichallofe begadol ema la tzericha
Amar rav chisda amar rav kattina lo shanu ella daamaru leh ella im ken haya bo mum aval im amaru leh im naasa bo mum keman daamaru leh zil aved beh muma dame
Amar rava mikkede mimmela hu ma li haya ma li naasa ella naasa name mimmela hu vela shena
