Ze hakkelal kol shehu ledaat asur leetoye may leetoye gerama
Shello ledaat leetoye mesiach lefi tummo
Matni haya bechor rodfo beato veasa bo mum hare ze shochatin alav
Gema amar rav pappa lo shanu ella shebbeato bishat redifa aval leachar redifa la peshita
Mahu detema tzareh hu demiddechar ka mashma lan
Ika deamri amar rav pappa la tema bishat redifa in aval shello bishat redifa la ella afilu leachar redifa name may tama tzaareh hu demiddechar
Amar rav yehuda muttar lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyatza laavir haolam amar rava gadya beudneh imra besifvateh ika deamri imra name beudneh emor derech tzedaav nefak
Amar rava achel vela michaze pae umichaze have muma may ka mashma lan tenena hachutin hachitzonot shennifgemu veshennigmemu happenimiyyot shenneekru may tama lav mishshum dechi pae michze
Amar rav pappa rava name tama dematnitin mefaresh may tama nekeru have muma mishshum dechi pae michze

Matni kol hammumin haruyin lavo bide adam roe yisrael neemanin roim kohanim enan neemanin rabban shimon ben gamliel omer neeman hu al shel chavero veen neeman al shel atzmo rabbi meir omer hechashud al haddever lo dano velo meido
Gema rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar chad amar roe yisrael be chohanim neemanin lilgima la chayeshinan
Roe kohanim be yisrael en neemanin memar amar kevan deka tarachna beh la shavek ledidi veyahev leacharine
Vehu haddin kohen lechohen dechayeshinan legomlin
Vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar neeman hu al shel chavero veeno neeman al shel atzmo vaata rabbi meir lememar hechashud al haddever lo dano velo meido
Vechad amar roe yisrael vehen kohanim neemanin
b: Memar amar la shavek tzurba merabbanan veyahev ledidi roe chohanim vehen yisrael enan neemanin dechayeshinan lilgima

Vechol shekken kohen lechohen dechayeshinan legomlin vechayeshinan lilgima vaata rabban shimon lememar neeman al shel chavero veeno neeman al shel atzmo vaata rabbi meir lememar hechashud al haddavar lo dano velo meido
Bishlama leman deamar roe yisrael vehen kohanim neemanin hayenu daata rabbi meir lememar hechashud al haddavar lo dano velo meido
Ella leman deamar roe chohanim be yisrael en neemanin may ata rabbi meir leashmoinan hayenu tanna kamma
Ika benayehu derabbi yehoshua ben kapposay detanya rabbi yehoshua ben kapposay omer bechor be chohen tzarich shenayim min hashshuk lehaid alav
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer afilu beno afilu bitto rabbi yose omer afilu asara vehen bene veto en meidin alav
Keman azla ha deamar rav chisda amar rav kattina sefek bechor shennolad be yisrael tzarich shenayim min hashshuk lehaid alav
Keman kerabbi yehoshua ben kapposay
Rav nachman amar bealim meidin alav dei la tema hachi maaser lerabbi meir mi meid alav
Maaser vadday meheman dei bae shade beh muma bechulleh edreh ella sefek bechor lerabbi meir mi meid alav
Vechi tema hachi name delet leh takkanta vehatnan shehaya rabbi yose omer kol shechalifav beyad kohen patur min hammattanot verabbi meir mechayyev
Ella shema minah bealim meidin alav kohanim hu dachashidi ammume yisrael la chashidi ammume
Itmar rav nachman amar halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel rava amar halacha kerabbi yose
Umi amar rava hachi vehaamar rava bealim omdim immanu bachutz nichnas shalem veyatza chavul meidin alav ema kol bealim omdim vela chayeshinan
I hachi may lememra mahu detema nechush lachashada ka mashma lan vehilcheta kerabban shimon ben gamliel vedaveka beno uvitto aval ishto la may tama ishto kegufo dame

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye lerabbi meir deamar hechashud al haddavar lo dano velo meido vekaamar rabbi meir hechashud ledavar echad chashud lechol hattora kullah kohanim hachi name dela dayeni dina vehachtiv veal pihem yihye kol riv vechol naga

a: Emar deamar rabbi meir lachashasha leachzokinhu mi amar
Ibaya lehu ed mippi ed mahu leedut bechor rav assi asar verav ashe share amar leh rav assi lerav ashe veha tana deve menashshe en ed mippi ed kasher ella leedut haishsha
Teni ella leedut shehaishsha keshera lah bilvad
Rav yemar achshar ed mippi ed bivchor kare aleh marimar yemar share buchra vehilcheta ed mippi ed kasher leedut bechor
Amar rabbi ila lo hau muchzakin bo shehu bechor uva echad veamar shehu bechor umumo immo neeman
May ka mashma lan shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir tenena haishsha sheamra eshet ish hayiti ugrusha ani neemenet shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir
Mahu detema hatam hu dei baaya la amra aval hacha dela saggi dela amra dekadashim bechutz la achel
Ema la happe sheasar hu ka mashma lan dei mishshum hachi hava shade beh muma denikar veachel leh

Matkef lah mar bar rav ashe may shena mehahu gavra deogar leh chamara lechavreh vaamar leh la tezil beorcha dinhar pekod deika mayya zil beorcha denaresh deleka mayya azal beorcha dinhar pekod umit chamara vaata vaamar leh beorcha dinhar pekod azli umihu mayya la hao
Vaamar rava ma lo leshakker i bae amar beorcha denaresh azali vaamar abbaye ma lo leshakker bimkom edim la amrinan

Hachi hashta hatam vadday ika mayya hacha vadday shade beh muma chashasha hu uvimkom chashasha amrinan ma lo leshakker yatev ravina vekaamar lehay shemata bela gavra amar leh rava zute leravina anan mishshemeh derabbi ila matninan lah
Rabbi tzadok hava leh buchra rema leh seare besalle bahade dekaachel ibza sifteh ata lekammeh derabbi yehoshua amar lo kelum chilaknu ben chaver leam haaretz amar lo rabbi yehoshua hen
Ata lekammeh derabban gamliel amar lo chilaknu ben chaver leam haaretz amar lo rabban gamliel la amar lo vahalo rabbi yehoshua amar li hen amar lo hamten ad sheyyaalu baale terisin levet hammidrash
Kevan shennichnesu levet hammidrash amad hashshoel veshaal kelum chilaknu ben chaver leam haaretz amar lo rabbi yehoshua lav amar lo rabban gamliel vahalo mishshimcha amru li hen

Yehoshua amod al raglecha veyaidu becha amad rabbi yehoshua al raglav veamar heach eese ilmale ani chay vehu met yachol hachay lehachchish et hammet achshav sheani chay vehu chay heach chay yachol lehachchish et hachay
Vehaya rabban gamliel omed vedoresh verabbi yehoshua omed al raglav ad sherinnu kol haam veamru lechutzpit hamturgeman amod veamad
Matni neeman hakkohen lomar hereti bechor ze uvaal mum hu

Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav neeman hakkohen lomar bechor ze natan li yisrael bemumo may tama kol milta daavida leigalloye la meshakkeri bah inashe amar rav ashe af anan name tenena neeman hakkohen lomar hereti bechor ze uvaal mum hu may tama lav mishshum deamrinan kol milta daavida leigalloye la meshakkeri bah inashe
Hatam hu dekadashim bechutz la achel aval hacha kevan dachashidi chashidi
Metiv rav shezvi haomer lemi sheen neeman al hammaaser kach li mimmi shehu neeman o mimmi shehu measser eno neeman ammay nema kol milta daavida leigalloye la meshakkeri bah inashe
Shane hatam
b: Deit leh leishtemote
Sefa vadday mesayea leh meish peloni hare ze neeman
Hatam kevan deit leh tovea mirtat
Amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba mena leh lihuda ha ana begidul kevatah vegidul keva bedideh vehachi amri leh neeman yisrael lomar bechor ze natatti lechohen bemumo
Yisrael peshita la tzericha bekatan vehigdil mahu detema la kim leh ka mashma lan
Besura matnu kelishshana vatra befumbedita kelishshana kamma vehilcheta afilu kelishshana kamma

Rafram befumbedita hava leh buchra veyahaveh leh lechohen bela muma azal sheda beh muma yoma chad chalash beeneh ayetyeh lekammeh amar leh bechor ze natan li yisrael bemumo arpesineh leeneh chazyeh beshikreh amar leh lav ana dihevteh lach
Vaafilu hachi la chash lah lemilta hay hu dachatzif kulle alma la chatzifi
Hahu sarua daata lekammeh derav ashe amar lemay nechush leh i kohen hu i yisrael hu hare bechor umumo immo
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe vedilma yisrael hu veamar rav yehuda en roin bechor yisrael ella im ken kohen immo
Amar leh hachi hashta hatam nehi dekadashim bechutz la achel ammamoneh dechohen chashid
Hacha mikkede yada dehay mum muvhak hu may tama atuh kammeh rabbanan mishshum kevodo dechacham al kevodo dechacham la aved isura aved
Matni hakkol neemanin al mume maaser
Gema may tama dei bae shade beh muma meikara mi yada he nafek
Vechi tema mappek leh beresh asra lo yevakker ben tov lara amar rachamana ella dei bae shade beh muma bechulleh edreh
Matni bechor shennismet eno veshenniktea yado veshennishbera raglo hare ze yishshachet al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset rabbi yose omer afilu yesh sham esrim ushlosha eno nishchat ella al pi mumche

Gema rabbi simlay verabbi yehuda nesia tarvayehu mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi amri veamri lah rabbi simlay verabbi yehoshua ben levi tarvayehu mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia amri hattarat bechor bechutza laaretz al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset amar rava uvmumin muvhakin
May ka mashma lan tenena bechor shennismet eno veshenniktea yado veshennishtabbera raglo hare ze yishshachet al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset
I mimmatnitin hava amena bechutza laaretz afilu mumin sheen muvhakin vehay dekatane muvhakin lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose ka mashma lan

Amar rav yehuda amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba safek mishshemeh derav safek mishshemeh dishmuel shelosha mattirin et habbechor bimkom sheen mumche may ka mashma lan tenena hare ze yishshachet al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset
I mimmatnitin hava amena bimkom mumche ka mashma lan bimkom sheen mumche in bimkom sheyyesh mumche la
Amar rav chiyya bar amram shelosha mattirin et habbechor bimkom sheen mumche shelosha mattirin et hanneder bimkom sheen chacham shelosha mattirin et habbechor bimkom sheen mumche

a: Leappoke midderabbi yose shelosha mefirin et hanneder bimkom sheen chacham leappoke midderabbi yehuda detanya hafarat nedarim bishlosha rabbi yehuda omer echad mehem chacham
Bimkom sheen chacham kegon man amar rav nachman kegon ana rabbi yehuda omer echad mehen chacham mikkelal dehanach kol dehu amar ravina demasberi leh vesavar
Rabbi yose omer afilu yesh sham esrim ushlosha ku amar rav chananel amar rav en halacha kerabbi yose peshita yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim mahu detema nimmuko immo ka mashma lan
Tifshot meha dehach kammayeta mishshemeh dishmuel itmar dei mishshemeh derav tarte lema li
Chada mikkelala dachavirtah itmar
Matni hashshochet et habbechor venoda shello herahu ma sheachlu achlu veyachzir lahem haddamim uma shello achlu habbasar yikkaver veyachzir et haddamim

Vechen hashshochet et happara umcharah venoda shehi terefa ma sheachlu achlu uma shello achlu hem yachaziru lo et habbasar vehu yachazir lahem et haddamim mecharuhu legoyim o hittiluhu lichlavim yeshallemu deme terefa
Gema tanu rabbanan hammocher basar lachavero venimtza besar bechor perot venimtza tevalim yayin venimtza yen nesech ma sheachlu achlu veyachzir lahem et haddamim

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer devarim shehannefesh katza bahen yachazir lahen et haddamim vesheen hannefesh katza bahem yenakke lahem et haddamim veellu hen devarim shehannefesh katza bahen nevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim veellu hen devarim sheen hannefesh katza bahen bechorot tevalim veyen nesech
Bechor velema leh may afsedtach
La tzericha kegon dezabben leh mimmekom muma daamar leh i lav deachlatte hava machzena leh veshare nihaleh kerabbi yehuda
Tevalim hava matkenna lehu veachelna lehu yen nesech al yede taarovet uchrabban shimon ben gamliel
Ditnan yen nesech shennafal labbor kullo asur bahanaa rabban shimon ben gamliel omer yimmacher kullo legoyim chutz middeme yen nesech shebbo
Hadaran alach kol pesule hammukdashin

Matni al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor nifgema ozno min hachaschus aval lo haor nisdeka af al pi shello chasra nikva melo charshina o sheyyavsha ezehu yevesha kol shettinnakev veenah motzia tipat dam rabbi yose ben hamshullam omer yevesha shettehe nifrechet
Gema ammay pisseach veiver ketiv
Ketiv name ki yihye vo mum veema ki yihye bo mum kalal pisseach o iver parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat pisseach veiver in mide acharina la
Kol mum ra chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash mumin shebbaggaluy veenan chozrin af kol mumin shebbaggaluy veenan chozrin
Veema ma happerat meforash mumin shebbaggaluy uvotel mimmelachto veeno chozer af kol mumin shebbaggaluy uvotel mimmelachto veeno chozer allema tenan nifgema ozno min hachaschus velo min haor
Kol mum ra ribuya hu i hachi mumin shebbasseter name allema tenan chutin hachitzonot shennifgemu veshennigmemu vehappenimiyyot shenneekru
b: Nekeru in nifgemu venigmemu la baena mum ra veleka i hachi mum over name allema tenan velo min haor
Mum over sevara hu hashta mifrak la parkinan illaveh mishchat shachatinan illaveh detanya veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmenna korban la bevaale mumin hakkatuv medabber

Atta omer bevaale mumin shennifdu hakkatuv medabber o eno ella bivhema temea mammash keshehu omer veim bivhema hattemea hare behema temea amur ha ma ani mekayyem asher lo yakrivu mimmenna heve omer ze baale mumin shennifdu
Yachol yippadu al mum over talmud lomar asher lo yakrivu mimmenna korban la mi sheenah kereva kol ikar yatzta zo sheenah kereva hayyom ella lemachar
Ibaet ema im ken pisseach veiver lema li
Nisdeka af al pi shello chasra tanu rabbanan hassedek kol shehu happegima ben bide adam ben bide shamayim mikkelal desedek bide shamayim la
Ella sedek ufgima ben bide shamayim ben bide adam vechamma shiur pegima kede shettachgor bah tziporen

Nikkeva melo vechu tanu rabbanan kamma nekivat haozen melo charshina rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer bechaadasha veezo hi yevesha sheim tinakev veenah motzia tipat dam rabbi yose ben hamshullam omer yevesha kede shettehe nifrechet
Tana kerovin divrehen lihot shavin divrehen deman ilema detanna kamma verabbi yose ben hamshullam tuva ika ella detanna kamma verabbi yose berabbi yehuda
Kaadasha in betzir mikkaadasha la urminhi martzea en li ella martzea minnayin lerabbot hassol vehassira vehammachat vehammakdeach vehammachtev
Talmud lomar velakachta kol davar shennilkach bayyad divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda rabbi omer martzea ma martzea meuchad shel mattechet af kol shel mattechet
Vekatane sefa amar rabbi yudan beribbi haya doresh keshehen rotzin en rotzin ella bammilat
Vachachamim omrim en eved ivri kohen nirtza mippene shennaasa baal mum veim tomar bammilat hau rotzin heach eved kohen naase baal mum ha en rotzin ella begovah shel ozen
Amar rav chana bar kattina la kashya kan lishchot kan lifsol
May karshina amar rav sherevya hinda
Bea mineh rav hoshaya merav huna rabba karshina hannichneset veotza o charshina haomedet amar lo zo lo shamati kayyotze bah shamati

Ditnan hashshidra vehaggulgolet shechasru kamma chesron bashshidra velo yehe metamme beohel bet shammay omrim shette chulot uvet hillel omrim chulya achat uvaggulgolet bet shammay omrim kimlo makdeach uvet hillel omrim kede sheyyinnatel min hachay veyamut
Veyatev rav chisda vekamibaya leh kede sheyyinnatel min hachay vechamma amar leh rav tachlifa bar avudimi hachi amar shemuel kesela
Veitmar rav safra amar shemateta amar leh verav shemuel bar yehuda amar matnita amar leh vesimanach tane rav shemuel bar yehuda

Vaamar leh im ken asita divre bet shammay vedivre bet hillel echad ditnan maor shello naasa bide adam shiuro melo egrof gadol vezehu egrofo shel ben avattiach amar rabbi yose veyeshno kerosh gadol shel adam
Naasa bide adam shiaruhu kimlo makdeach gadol shel lishka shehu kefundeon shel haitalki uchsela nironit veyeshno

a: Kimlo nekev shel ol ishtik veamar leh rav chisda shemma makdeach vechisumo shaninu
Vaamar leh rav tachlifa la tema shemma ella vadday makdeach vechisumo tzarich lehittalot aleha kechizkiyya avi ikkesh

Ditnan zo edut heid chizkiyya avi ikkesh lifne rabban gamliel beyavne sheamar mishshum rabban gamliel hazzaken kol sheen lo toch bichli cheres en lo achorayim lachalika nitma tocho nitma gabbo nitma gabbo nitma tocho
Keli cheres betocho tela rachamana it leh toch itammi leh let leh toch la itammi leh
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar avin hachi kaamar kol sheen lo toch bichli cheres kenegdo bichli shetef en lo achorayim lachalika nitma tocho nitma gabbo nitma gabbo nitma tocho
Lema li lemitleyeh bichli cheres nema kol sheen lo toch bichli shetef en lo achorayim lachalika
Ha ka mashma lan deyesh lo toch hare hu kichli cheres ma keli cheres nitma tocho nitma gabbo lo nitma tocho lo nitma gabbo af keli shetef nitma tocho nitma gabbo lo nitma tocho lo nitma gabbo
Bishlama keli cheres galli beh rachamana tocho ella keli shetef mi galli beh rachamana tocho
I betuma deorayeta hachi name hacha bemay askinan betumat mashkin derabbanan ditnan keli shennitma achorav bemashkin achorav temein tocho ogno ozno veyadav tehorin nitma tocho kullo tame
Middeorayeta en ochel metamme keli veen mashke metamme keli verabbanan hu digzur mishshum mashke zav vezava
Hilkach shavveuh rabbanan ketuma dichli cheres vela shavveuh rabbanan ketuma deorayeta denafsheh
Avadu rabbanan hekera ki hechi dela lisrof aleh teruma vekadashim i hachi en lo toch name lebed name hekera
Kevan daavadu hekera beyesh lo toch yedia deen lo toch derabbanan
Veen lo toch bichli shetef deorayeta bar kabbole tuma hu dumya desak baenan ma sak mitaltel male verekan af kol mitaltel male verekan
Behanach dachazu lemidrasot i hachi cheres name en midras bichli cheres
Rav pappa amar makdeach gadol shaninu
Mikkelal demakdeach setam zutaro name mikkesela hanicha lerabbi meir ella lerabbanan may ika lememar
Ditnan beeze makdeach amru bekatan shel rofim divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim begadol shel lishka
Ulrabbi meir mi nicha have leh mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel vaanan ditnan tenan dela tenan la tenan
Amar rav nachman sela nironit shaninu kemakdeach gadol sela setam zutaro mimmakdeach setam
Matni haris shel ayin shennikav shennifgam shennisdak hare beeno dak tevallul chillazon nachash atzav ezehu tevallul lavan happosek bassira venichnas bashshachor shachor nichnas ballavan eno mum
b: Gema may haris amar rav pappa tora bara deena dak tevallul tanu rabbanan dak meshukka hare ze mum tzaf eno mum
Vehatanya ipcha la kashya ha bashshachor ha ballavan veha en mumin ballavan ella ha beduk lavan ha beduk shachor
Deamar rabba bar bar chana sach li yoshiyya demin usha dak shachor meshukka hare ze mum tzaf eno mum dak lavan meshukka eno mum tzaf hare ze mum vesimanach barka
Chillazon nachash veatzav ibaya lehu chillazon hu nachash o dilma chillazon o nachash

Ta shema deamar rabba bar bar chana sach li rabbi yochanan ben elazar zaken echad haya bishchunatenu verabbi shimon ben yose lakonya shemo umiyyamay lo avarti lefanav paam achat avarti lefanav amar li shev beni shev chillazon ze mum kavua lishchot alav vezehu nachash sheamru chachamim
Veaf al pi sheamru en adam roe mumin leatzmo aval more halacha lattalmidim vetalmidim morin lo
Vehaamar rabbi abba amar rav huna kol talmid chacham shemmore halacha uva im kodem maase amarah shomin lo veim lav en shomin lo ihu name more uva hava meikara

Ezehu tevallul lavan happosek et hassira matnitin manni rabbi yose hi detanya lavan venichnas bashshachor shachor venichnas ballavan hare ze mum divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer lavan venichnas bashshachor hare ze mum shachor venichnas ballavan eno mum sheen mumin ballavan
Amar rav may tama derabbi yose dichtiv yatza mechelev enemo tarba deena ikri enemo setama la ikri verabbi meir may tameh ma leshon tevallul davar hamvalbel et haenayim
Matni chavarvar vehammayim hakkevuin ezehu chavarvar hakkavua kol sheshshaha shemonim yom rabbi chananya ben antignos omer bodkin oto shalosh peamim betoch shemonim yom
Veellu hen mayim hakkevuin achal lach veyavesh shel geshamim lach veyavesh shel shelachim o achal hayyavesh veachar kach hallach eno mum ad sheyyochal hallach veachar kach hayyavesh
Gema matnitin manni rabbi yehuda hi detanya chavarvar kavua arbaim yom umayim hakkevuim shemonim yom divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omer chavarvar shemonim yom
Veellu hen mayim hakkevuim achal lach veyavesh shel bet hashshelachin o sheachal yavesh veachar kach achal hallach en mum ad sheyyochal yavesh achar hallach veyeshno shelosha chodashim
Veha tarvayehu tenanhi achal lach veyavesh shel geshamim lach veyavesh shel bet hashshelachin

Chassore michassera vehachi katane achal lach veyavesh shel geshamim hare ze mum bet hashshelachin eno mum vehaggeshamim name achal yavesh veachar kach achal lach eno mum ad sheyyochal yavesh achar hallach
Veyeshno shelosha chodashim ini vehatanya veha rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan adar venisan lach elul vetishri yavesh ema adar vachatzi nisan lach elul vachatzi tishre yavesh
Ibaya lehu lach bizman lach veyavesh bizman hayyavesh o dilma lach veyavesh bizman hallach
Ta shema deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan adar venisan lach elul vetishri yavesh dilma pere deelul vetishri maachilinan leh baadar venisan
Vechamma maachilin oto amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi pinchas ben arova kigrogeret amar rava bae baan bemareva kigrogrot bisuda rishona

a: O dilma bechol seuda usuda im timtze lomar bisuda rishona kodem achila o leachar achila kodem achila vadday mealle leh kesamma leachar achila may kodem shetiyya o leachar shetiyya vekodem shetiyya vadday mealle leh kisare leachar shetiyya may
Kashur o muttar muttar vadday mealle leh kashur may levaddo o im chavero im chavero vadday mealle leh levaddo may
Bair uvassade o bassade bassade vadday mealle leh bair may bae rav ashe im timtze lomar bassade gina hassemucha lair may teku
Rabbi chananya ben antignos omer amar rav nachman bar yitzchak uvilvad sheyehu meshullashim
Bae mineh pinchas achuh demar shemuel mishshemuel achal vela itassi lemafrea have muma o mikan ulhabba have muma
Lemay nafka minah lemimal befidono i amratte lemafrea have muma mael
Vei mikan ulhabba have muma la mael may kare shemuel aleh pischim bazzu vaz
Matni chotmo shennikav veshennifgam veshennisdak sefamo shennikva shennifgema shennisdeka
Gema tanu rabbanan nikvu chotamin ze letoch ze mibbachutz hare ze mum mibbifnim eno mum sefato shennikva veshennifgema veshennisdeka amar rav pappa tora bara desifteh
Matni chutin hachitzonot shennifgemu veshennigmemu happenimiyyim shenneekru rabbi chanina ben antignos omer en bodkin min hatteomet velifnim veaf lo et hatteomet

Gema tanu rabbanan hatteomet ezehu teomet min hatteomet velifnim utomet atzmah kelifnim rabbi yehoshua ben kappotzay omer en shochatin ella al hachitzonot bilvad rabbi chanina ben antignos omer en mashgichin al hatteomet kol ikar
May kaamar vetu rabbi yehoshua ben kappotzay hayenu tanna kamma
Chassore michassera vehachi katane ezehu happenimit min hatteomet velifnim utomet atzmah kelifnim bamme devarim amurim shennifgemu veshennigmemu aval nekeru shochatin

Rabbi yehoshua ben kappotzay omer en shochatin ella al hachitzonot aval penimiyyot shenneekru mishchat alayehu la shachatinan aval ippesole mipsel rabbi chanina ben antignos omer en mashgichin al hatteomet kol ikar vaafilu ipsole la ipsil
Bae rav achadvuy bar amme yesh mechussar ever mibbifnim o en mechussar ever mibbifnim lemay i livchor pisseach o iver ketiv
I lekadashim averet o shavur ketiv leishchote uliproke la ibaya lan ki mibaya lan leipsole may
Tamim yihye leratzon amar rachamana tamim in chesron lo o dilma tamim yihye leratzon kol mum lo yihye bo ma mum meabbaray af chesron meabbaray
Ta shema veet shette hakkelaot velo baal kulya achat velo baal shalosh kulot vetanya idach yesirenna lerabbot baal kulya achat
Savruha dechulle alma en beriyya beachat deha michsar chasar lema beha kamipalgi demar savar chesron mibbifnim shemeh chesron umar savar chesron mibbifnim la shemeh chesron
Amar rav chiyya bar yosef dechulle alma yesh beriyya beachat vechesron mibbifnim shemeh chesron vela kashya kan keshennivrea bishtayim vechasru kan keshennivrea beachat meikara
Veha dumya deshalosh katane ma shalosh meikara af achat meikara
Ella hacha beyesh beriyya meikara kamipalgi mar savar yesh beriyya beachat umar savar en beriyya beachat

Verabbi yochanan amar dechulle alma en beriyya beachat vechesron mibbifnim shemeh chesron vela kashya kan shechasra kodem shechita kan shechasra leachar shechita ulachar shechita kodem kabbala mi shere
b: Vehaamar rabbi zera amar rav hatztzorem ozen happar veachar kach kibel damo pasul shenneemar velakach middam happar happar shehaya kevar ella kan shechasra kodem kabbala kan shechasra leachar kabbala
Ulachar kabbala kodem zerika mi shere vehatanya se tamim zachar ben shana yihye lachem sheyehe tamim ben shana bishat shechita
Uminnayin bekabbala veholacha vehazzaya talmud lomar yihye sheyehu kol havaotav tam uven shana
Targemah abben shana hachi name mistabbera detanya rabbi yehoshua omer kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer mehen kezayit basar o kezayit chelev zorek et haddam shema minah
Umi ika mide devishat shechita have ben shana uvishat kabbala veholacha have ben shette shanim amar rava zot omeret shaot poslot bekadashim
Lema ketannae umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut kullan babbetzim divre rabbi yehuda
Babbetzim velo baggid ema af babbetzim divre rabbi yehuda rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer kullan baggid rabbi yose omer mauch vechatut af babbetzim natuk vecharut baggid in babbetzim la
May lav beha kamipalgi demar savar chesron mibbifnim shemeh chesron umar savar la shemeh chesron
Vetisbera rabbi yose may kasavar i kasavar chesron mibbifnim shemeh chesron afilu natuk vecharut name vei kasavar la shemeh chesron afilu mauch vechatut name la

Ella hacha bemumim shebbaggaluy kamipalgi rabbi yehuda savar mauch vechatut have muma demikavetzan natuk vecharut have muma deha talyan rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar mauch vechatut la have muma demeikara name zimnin demikavetzan natuk vecharut la have muma demeikara name zimnin detalyan
Verabbi yose savar mauch vechatut have muma deha letanhu natuk vecharut la have muma deha itanhu

Matni nifgam hazzovan haerya shel nekeva bammukdashin nifgam hazzanav min haetzem aval lo min happerek o sherosh zanav mefatztzel niklefa haor vehabbasar vehaetzem nishar o sheyyesh basar mechulya lechulya melo etzba
Gema amar rabbi elazar nifgam velo nital kis velo zachrut tanya name hachi nifgam velo nital kis velo zachrut amar rabbi yose ben hamshullam maase beinbal echad shennetalo zeev vechazar leetano

Nifgema hazzanav min haetzem vechu tana etzba sheamru echad mearbaa betefach shel kol haadam lemay hilcheta amar rabba leinyan techelet detanya kamma chutin hu noten bet shammay omrim arbaa uvet hillel omrim shelosha
Vechamma tehe meshulleshet bet shammay omrim arbaa uvet hillel omrim shelosha ushlish shebbet hillel omrim echad mearba betefach shel kol adam
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar lishte ammot ditnan shette ammot hau

a: Beshushan habbira achat al keren mizrachit tzefonit veachat al keren mizrachit deromit sheal keren mizrachit tzefonit hayeta yetera al shel moshe chatzi etzba vesheal keren mizrachit deromit hayeta yetera aleha chatzi etzba nimtzet yetera al shel moshe etzba
Velama hau achat gedola veachat ketanna shehau ummanin notlin bakketanna umachzirin baggedola shello yavou lide meila
Tarte lema li chada dechaspa vezahava vachada devinyana
Rav nachman bar yitzchak vei tema rav huna bar natan leotah sheshshaninu sheyyesh basar ben chulya lechulya melo etzba

Matni en lo betzim o en lo ella betza achat rabbi yishmael omer im yesh lo shene kisin yesh lo shette betzim en lo shene kisin en lo ella betza achat rabbi akiva omer moshivo al akkuzo ummaech im yesh betza sofah latzet maase shemmiech velo yatza nishchata venimtzet devuka bakkesalim vehittir rabbi akiva veasar rabbi yochanan ben nuri

Gema hashta en lo ella betza achat amratte have muma en lo kelal mibaya chassore michassera vehachi katane en lo shette betzim bishte kisin ella bechis echad i name shette kisin uvetza achat hare ze mum

Rabbi yishmael omer yesh lo shette kisim beyadua sheyyesh lo shette betzim en lo ella kis echad kemi sheen lo ella betza achat dame vaata rabbi akiva lememar beyadua la amrinan ella moshivo al akkuzo ummaech im yesh betza sofo latzet

Umaase shemmiech velo yatza vechu tanya amar rabbi yose maase befaran shel bet menachem shemmiech velo yatzat venishchata venimtzet devuka bakkesalim vehittir rabbi akiva veasar rabbi yochanan ben nuri
Amar lo rabbi akiva lerabbi yochanan ben nuri ad matay atta mechalle mamonan shel yisrael amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri lerabbi akiva ad matay atta maachil yisrael nevelot lav mishchat shachteh
Ella terefot la isur terefot hu ella ad matay atta maachil yisrael kadashim bachutz
Matni baal chamesh raglayim o sheen lo ella shalosh vesheraglav kelutot keshel chamor vehashshachul vehakkasul ezehu shachul shennishmeta yerecho vechasul sheachat mirechotav gevohot
Gema amar rav huna lo shanu ella shechaser veyater bayyad aval baregel terefa name have dechol yater kenatul dame
Amar rav pappa la tema daagilan vela sedikan ella kevan daagilan af al gav disdikan

Vehashshachul vehakkasul vechu tanu rabbanan ezehu kasul veezehu shachul shachul shennishmeta yerecho kasul sheraglo echad betoch hakkesel veraglo echad al gabbe hakkesel tana hassarua vehakkalut sarua shennishtarbev lo yerecho kalut sheraglav kelutot keshel chamor uchshel sus
Matni nishbar etzem yado veetzem raglo af al pi sheeno nikar mumin ellu mana ila beyavne vehodu lo chachamim
Veod shelosha hosif amru lo lo shamanu et ellu sheggalgal eno agol keshel adam ufiv dome keshel chazir veshennital rov hamdabber bilshono bet din shel acharehen amru hare ze mum
Gema eno nikar mi ka have muma amar rav pappa eno nikar mechamat atzmo aval nikar mechamat melacha
Mumin ellu mana vechu lememra delav hayenu orcheh urminhu hammappelet min behema vechayya vaof ben temein ben tehorin im zachar teshev lezachar
Im nekeva teshev linkeva eno yadua teshev lezachar velinkeva divre rabbi meir
Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan may tameh derabbi meir hoil vegalgal eno agol keshel adam amar rav yosef la kashya ha beukkama ha bechivara
Ufiv dome keshel chazir amar rav pappa la tema dishfid ufris ella kevan difris af al gav dela shefid
Veshennital rov hamdabber shebbilshono matnitin manni rabbi yehuda hi detanya veet shennital rov hallashon rabbi yehuda omer rov hamdabber shel leshono
Matni umaase shehallechi hattachton odef al haelon veshaal rabban gamliel lachachamim veamru hare ze mum

Gema may tanna dekatane umaase mishshum ditnan piv dome lachazir ufligi rabbanan aleh derabbi vekaamrinan ki peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi bisfato elona odefet al hattachtona aval shehattachtona odefet al haelona hare ze mum
b: Umaase name shellechi hattachton odef al haelon shaal rabban shimon ben gamliel lachachamim veamru hare ze mum

Veha gabbe adam hu ditnan sefato haelona odefet al hattachtona o shettachtona odefet al haelona hare ze mum gabbe adam hu dichtiv ish ish mizzera aharon ish sheshshave bezaro shel aharon aval bivhema la
Amar rav pappa la kashya ha deit bah etzem ha delet bah etzem

Matni ozen haggedi hayeta kefula amru chachamim bizman shehu etzem echad mum bizman sheen bo etzem eno mum rabbi chananya ben gamliel omer zenav haggedi shehu dome leshel chazir vesheen bah shelosh chulot hare ze mum
Gema tanu rabbanan piv balum veraglav mevullamot mechamat haruach eno mum mechamat haetzem hare ze mum oznav kefulot bechaschasut achat hare ze mum bishte chaschasuot eno mum
Rabban gamliel omer zenav haggedi shehu dome leshel chazir amar rav pappa la tema dekattina ella dichricha af al gav daalima

O sheen bah shalosh chulot vechu amar rav huna baggedi shettayim hare ze mum shalosh eno mum battale shalosh hare ze mum arba eno mum metivi baggedi achat hare ze mum shettayim eno mum battale shettayim hare ze mum shalosh eno mum teuvta derav huna
Verav huna matnitin atiteh ihu savar midderesha bigdi sefa name bigdi vela hi resha bigdi vesefa betale

Matni rabbi chanina ben antignos omer et sheyyabbelet beenav veshennifgam etzem yado veraglo veshennifrak atzmo shel piv eno achat gedola veachat ketanna ozno achat gedola veachat ketanna bammare aval lo bammidda rabbi yehuda omer shette betzav achat gedola kishtayim shebbachavertah velo hodu lo chachamim
Gema lememra deyabbelet have muma urminhu veellu sheen shochatin alehen lo bemikdash velo bammedina baal garav uvaal yabbelet
Vetisbera ha ketiva yabbelet beorayeta ella la kashya ha begufo ha beeno
Mikkede kera setama ma li begufo uma li beeno ella la kashya ha deit bah etzem ha delet bah etzem
Dikra deit bah etzem matnitin delet bah etzem beeno have muma begufa la have muma
Velet lah etzem begufa pesula hare tiltul bealma hu ditnan rabbi eliezer omer baale hattilulin pesulin baadam uchsherin babbehema ella ide veide beeno vela kashya ha bashshachor ha ballavan
Veha en mumin ballavan ella ide veide ballavan veamar resh lakish la kashya ha deit bah sear ha delet bah sear
Eno achat gedola vechu tana gedola keshel egel ketanna keshel avaz
Ozno achat gedola vechu verabbanan ad kamma tanya acherim omrim afilu enah lashsheniyya ella kefol keshera

Matni zenav haegel sheenah maggaat laarkov amru chachamim kol marbit agalim ken kol zeman sheyehu megaddelin hen nimtachot ezehu arkov sheamru rabbi chanina ben antignos omer bearkov shebbeemtza hayyarech

a: Gema tana kefetz haelon velo kefetz hattachton uchnegdo begamal nikar
Matni al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor ufsule hammukdashin nifdin alehen
Gema ha tu lema li ha tena leh resha al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor sefa itztericha pesule hammukdashin nifdin alehen ha name peshita mishchat shachatinan mifrak mibaya
Ella ayede ditna shelosha hosif veamru lo lo shamanu et ellu vekatane veate dichidaa veka satem lah bechullehu al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor ufsule hammukdashin nifdin alehen

Matni veellu sheen shochatin alehen lo bammikdash velo bammedina chavarvar vehammayim sheen kevuin vechutin happenimiyyot shennifgemu aval lo shenneekru uvaal garav uvaal yabbelet uvaal chazazit zaken vechole umzoham veshenneevda bo avera veshehemit adam al pi ed echad o al pi habbealim
Vetumtum veanderoginos lo bammikdash velo bammedina rabbi shimon omer en lecha mum gadol mizze vachachamim omrim eno bechor ella nigzaz veneevad

Gema vegarav la vehachtiv garav beorayeta vachazazit la vehachtiv yallefet beorayeta vetanya garav ze hacheres yallefet zo chazazit hammitzrit veamar resh lakish lamma nikra shemah yallefet shemmelappefet veholechet ad yom hammita
Bishlama chazazit achazazit la kashya kan bachazazit hammitzrit kan bachazazit dealma ella garav aggarav kashya garav aggarav name la kashya ha belach ha beyavesh lach itassi yavesh la mitasse
Velach mitasse vehachtiv yakkecha Adonai bishchin mitzrayim vego umiddichtiv uvcheres hare garav lach amur vekaamar asher lo tuchal leherafe
Ella telata hao dikra yavesh ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz dematnitin lach mibbachutz umibbifnim demitzrayim yavesh mibbifnim velach mibbachutz dichtiv vayehi shechin poreach avabuot baadam
Vehazzaken vehachole vehamzoham menahane mile detanu rabbanan min hatztzon umin hakkesavim umin haizzim perat lazzaken velachole velamzoham
Utzrichi dei ketav rachamana lemaote zaken dela hadar bare aval chole dahadar bare ema la vei ketav lemaote chole delav orcheh aval zaken dehayenu orcheh ema la
Vei ketav rachamana tere lemaote hane dichchishi aval mezoham dela kechish ema la vei name lemaote mezoham mishshum dimis aval hane dela meisi ema la tzerichi
Veshenneevda bo avera vechu mena hane mile
Detanu rabbanan min habbehema lehotzi rovea venirba min habbakar lehotzi et hanneevad min hatztzon lehotzi et hammuktze umin hatztzon lehotzi et hannogeach
Hane bene ketala ninhu al pi ed echad o al pi habbealim
Bishlama tumtum bammikdash la dilma nekeva hi bammedina la dilma zachar hu velet beh muma
Ella anderoginos bishlama bammikdash la dilma nekeva hi ella bammedina name nehi dezachar hu tease nakvut charitz veyishchot aleha
Amar abbaye amar kera o charutz o shavur charutz dumya deshavur ma shavur bimkom etzem af charutz bimkom etzem

Rava amar bela shavur name la matzet amratte charutz bimkom basar have muma dei salka datach have muma kevan deamar garav zehu cheres michratz charitz dichtiv umarehu amok min haor kemare chamma haamukka min hatztzel
Velichtov rachamana charutz vela bae garav veamena charutz dela meis have muma garav dimis lo kol shekken ketav rachamana garav lememar decharutz bimkom basar la have muma
Rabbi yishmael omer en lecha mum gadol mizze keabbaye la amar charutz dumya deshavur la amrinan
Kerava name la amar dilma hecha dela minachra aval hecha deminchar mum ra karena beh
b: Bae rava may tama derabbi yishmael mifshat peshita leh anderoginos bechor hu umumo immo o dilma sappoke mesappeka leh veim timtza lomar kaamar im timtza lomar bechor hu hare mumo immo
Lemay nafka minah lemilke aleh mishshum giza vaavoda i name lemitveh lechohen
Ta shema rabbi ilay omer mishshum rabbi yishmael anderoginos bechor hu umumo immo shema minah mifshat peshita leh vedilma im timtza lomar kaamar
Ta shema zachar velo nekeva keshehu omer lematta zachar sheen talmud lomar ma talmud lomar lehotzi tumtum veanderoginos
Manni ilema tanna kamma sefeka hu veate kera lemaote sefeka
Ella rabbanan batrae mechad kera nafki deha gabbe bechor chad zachar hu dichtiv veka memaati kullehu minayehu
Ella peshita rabbi yishmael vei amratte bishlama rabbi yishmael mifshat peshita leh hayenu deitzterich kera lemaote ella i amratte mesappeka leh itzterich kera lemaote sefeka
Leolam rabbanan batrae vegabbe bechor tarte kerae ketiv hazzachar vehazzecharim
Vachachamim omrim eno bechor ku amar rav chisda machloket beanderoginos aval betumtum divre hakkol sefeka hu vekadosh missefeka
Amar leh rava ella meatta baarachin yearech

a: Allema tanya hazzachar velo tumtum veanderoginos semi mikan tumtum
Ta shema yachol lo yehe beerech ish aval yehe beerech ishsha talmud lomar hazzachar im nekeva velo tumtum veanderoginos semi mikan tumtum
Ta shema im zachar im nekeva zachar vadday nekeva vaddait velo tumtum veanderoginos semi mikan tumtum
Ta shema hazzachar velo nekeva keshehu omer lemattah zachar sheen talmud lomar ma talmud lomar lehotzi tumtum veanderoginos semi mikan tumtum
Ta shema hanneevad vehammuktze vehaetnan vehammechir vetumtum veanderoginos kullan metammein begadim abbet habbelia
Rabbi eliezer omer tumtum veanderoginos en metammein begadim abbet habbelia shehaya rabbi eliezer omer kol makom shenneemar zachar unkeva atta motzi tumtum veanderoginos mibbenehem
Veof hoil velo neemar bo zachar unkeva en atta motzi tumtum veanderoginos mibbenehem semi mikan tumtum
Ta shema rabbi elazar omer hatterefa vehakkilayim veotze dofen tumtum veanderoginos lo kedoshim velo makdishin
Veamar shemuel lo kedoshim bitmura velo makdishin laasot temura semi mikan tumtum

Ta shema rabbi elazar omer chamishsha lo kedoshim velo makdishin veellu hen hatterefa vehakkilayim veotze dofen vetumtum veanderoginos vechi tema hacha name semi mikan tumtum hau lehu arbaa appek tumtum veayel yatom

Lema ketannae rabbi ilay omer mishshum rabbi yishmael anderoginos bechor hu umumo immo vachachamim omrim en kedushsha chala alav rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon hare hu omer hazzachar vechol makom shenneemar zachar eno ella lehotzi tumtum veanderoginos

Vechi tema semi mikan tumtum rabbi shimon ben yehuda hayenu rabbanan ella lav tumtum ika benayehu detanna kamma savar en kedushsha chala alav aanderoginos aval tumtum sefeka hu vekadosh missefeka vaata rabbi shimon
b: Ben yehuda lememar tumtum beriyya hu velo kadosh la dechulle alma tumtum bivriyya la mesappeka zachar unkeva hu dimsappeka

Metil mayim bimkom zachrut dechulle alma la peligi dezachar hu ki peligi bemetil mayim bemakom nakvut mar savar chayeshinan shemma nehefcha zachruto lenakvuto umar savar la chayeshinan ki ha dehora rabbi elazar bivhema metil mayim bemakom nakvut chullin

Tahe bah rabbi yochanan man dela chash letanna kamma ulrabbi yishmael velema rabbi yochanan name man dela chash lerabbanan batrae deamar rav chisda machaloket beanderoginos aval betumtum divre hakkol sefeka
Rabbi yochanan la sevira leh derav chisda i la sevira leh lema hu deamar kerabbanan batrae hachi name kaamar man shavek tere veaved kechad

Verabbi elazar keman savrah ki ha deamar resh lakish lo amru tumtum safek ella beadam hoil vezachruto venakvuto bemakom echad aval behema metil mayim bemakom zachrut zachar metil mayim bemakom nakvut nekeva
Matkef lah rav oshaya velechush shemma nehefcha zachruto lenakvuto amar leh keman kerabbi meir dechayesh lemiuta
Abbaye bar avin verav chananya bar avin deamri tarvayehu afilu tema rabbanan hoil veishtanni ishtanni it deamar ishtanni veit deamar la ishtanni
Lema ishtanni vela ishtanni tannae detanya tumtum shekkidesh kiddushav kiddushin nitkaddesh kiddushav kiddushin
Vecholetz vecholtzin leishto umyabbemim leishto vetanya idach eshet tumtum choletzet velo mityabemet
Savruha dechulle alma kerabbi akiva deamar seris chamma lo choletz velo meyabem
May lav beha kamipalgi deman deamar choletz vecholtzin leishto umyabbemim et ishto la amrinan hoil veishtanni ishtanni
Uman deamar choletzet velo mityabemet amrinan hoil veishtanni ishtanni
La dechulle alma amrinan hoil veishtanni ishtanni ha rabbi eliezer veha rabbi akiva
Uman tanna alliba derabbi akiva ilema rabbi yehuda ha vadday saris meshave leh
Ditnan rabbi yehuda omer tumtum shennikra venimtza zachar hare ze lo yachlotz mippene shehu kesaris
Ella rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi detanya rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer tumtum lo choletz shemma yikkara veyimmatze saris chamma
Attu kol demikra zachar mishtechach nekeva la mishtechach shemma kaamar shemma yikkara veyimmatze nekeva
I name zachar name shemma yimmatze saris chamma may benayehu amar rava

a: Lifsol bimkom achim
Velachlotz shello bimkom achim ika benayehu
Hadaran alach al ellu mumin
Matni mumin ellu ben kevuin ben ovrim poslin baadam veyater alehen hakkilon vehallaftan vehammakkavan vesherosho shakut uskifat
Uvaale chatarot rabbi yehuda machshir vachachamim poslin hakkereach pasul ezehu kereach kol sheen lo shita shel sear mukkefet meozen leozen im yesh lo hare ze kasher
Gema ammay vehaika yabbelet dela ketiv beorayeta beadam vetu dak tevallul dela ketivi bivhema

Melaf yalfi mehadade detanya baadam lo neemar bo yabbelet babbehema lo neemar dak tevallul minnayin liten et haamur shel ze baze veet haamur shel ze baze talmud lomar garav garav yallefet yallefet ligzera shava
Mafne dei la mafne ika lemifrach adam mibbehema la yalef shekken hi atzmah kereva legabbe mizbeach behema meadam la yalfa shekken nitrabba bemitzot
Laye afnoye mafne lichtov rachamana yallefet vela bae garav vaana amena uma yallefet dela meisa have muma garav dimis lo kol shekken garav garav dichtav rachamana lema li leafnoye
Velichtevinhu rachamana kullehu bechad vegarav veyallefet hacha vehacha velelfu mechada
Aheya behe lichtov rachamana i ketav beadam hava amena kol defasul beadam pasul bivhema kalut vechutin deletanhu beadam bivhema name la lipaslu
Velichtov rachamana kullehu bivhema have amena kol defasul bivhema pasul beadam gibben vecharum deletanhu bivhema beadam name la lipaslu
Velichtevinhu rachamana kullehu bechad vehanach deletanhu beidach lichtov rachamana bivhema vehanach deletanhu beidach lichtov beadam vegarav veyallefet hacha vehacha velelfi mehadade
Ella ketanna deve rabbi yishmael detana deve rabbi yishmael kol parasha shenneemra venishnet lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah
Amar rava lema li dichtav rachamana mum beadam mum bekadashim mum bivchor
Tzericha dei ketav rachamana mum beadam shekken nitrabba bemitzot adam mibbechor behema la ate shekken hu atzmo karev legabbe mizbeach
Kadashim mibbechor la ate shekken kedushshato merechem
Adam mikkodashim la ate shekken hen atzman kerevin bechor mikkodashim la ate shekken kedushshato merubba
Chada mechada la atya tete chada mittarte mehe tete la lichtov rachamana bivchor vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken kedushshatan merubba venohagin bifshutin
Bekadashim vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken kedushshatan mealehen
Beadam vetete mehanach ma lehanach shekken hen atzman kerevin legabbe mizbeach tzerichi
Yater alehen beadam mena hane mile amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera kol ish asher bo mum mizzera aharon ish sheshshave bezaro shel aharon
b: May ika ben muma lesheeno shave bezaro shel aharon ika mishshum achole avoda muma machel avoda dichtiv mum bo velo yechallel sheeno shave bezaro shel aharon la machel avoda
May ika ben sheeno shave bezaro shel aharon umishshum marit haayin ika benayehu ase
Kilon dedame resheh leachla lafta dedame resheh legadgalida delifta tana vetzavaro omed beemtza rosho
Makkavan dedame resheh lemakkavan vesherosho shakut millefanav uskifat meachorav kidamri inashe shekil pisa tana vetzavaro shakut veshamut shakut dachavis michbas shamut daarich ushmit
Uvaale chatarot rabbi yehuda ku deit beh etzem kulle alma la peligi defasla ki peligi delet beh etzem mar savar ha eno shave bezaro shel aharon umar savar kirkura devisra bealma hu
Hakkereach pasul amar rava lo shanu ella sheen lo leacharav veyesh lo lefanav aval yesh lo leacharav kasher vechol shekken sheyyesh lo leacharav veen lo lefanav

Veika dematne assefa veim yesh lo hare ze kasher amar rava lo shanu ella sheyyesh lo leacharav veen lo lefanav aval yesh lo ben leacharav ben lefanav pasul vechol shekken sheyyesh lo lefanav veen lo leacharav uden lo kelal defasul
Amar rabbi yochanan hakkarchanin vehannannasin vehazzavleganin pesulin lefi sheenan shave bezaro shel aharon karchanin tenena nannasin tenena
Zavleganin itzterich leh leashmoinan umahu detema mishshum marit haayin
Veha kol hecha deika mishshum marit haayin itna mitna katane veshennashru rise enav pasul mippene marit haayin mahu detema tane chada vehu haddin lechullehu

Veha kol hecha deika mihdar umitna ka hadar vetane veshennitlu shinav pasul mishshum marit haayin ella leappoke meha detanya detanya hakkarchanin vehannannasin vehazzavleganin kesherim velo amru pasul ella mishshum marit haayin
Man hay tanna rabbi yehuda hi detanya rabbi yehuda omer hakkohanim lerabbot hakkarchanin
Matni en lo gevinin o en lo ella gevin echad zehu gibben haamur betora rabbi dosa omer sheggevinin sheggevinav shochvin rabbi chanina ben antignos omer sheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushte shidraot
Gema vegibben deen lo mashma urminhu gibben sheyyesh lo gevinin harbe en lo gevinin o en lo ella gevin achad minnayin talmud lomar o gibben amar rava zehu midrash o gibben
Rabbi dosa omer ku lememra dechaye veha itmar hammappelet beriyya sheyyesh lah shene gabbin ushte shidraot veamar rav baishsha eno valad babbehema asur baachila
Kevar rema nihaleh rav shimi bar chiyya lerav vaamar leh shimi et ella besheshshidrato akumma

Matni hecharum pasul ezehu charum hakkochel shette enav keachat shette enav lemala ushte enav lematta eno achat lemala veeno achat lematta roe et hacheder veet haaliyya keechad sache shemesh vehazzagdan vehatztzayeran veshennashru rise enav pasul mippene marit haayin
Gema tanu rabbanan charum shechotmo shakua chotmo soled chotmo bolem chotmo notef minnayin talmud lomar o charum rabbi yose omer en charum ella hakkochel shette enav keachat amru lo hiflagta

a: Af al pi sheeno kochel shette enav keachat

Shette enav lematta ma shette enav lemala shette enav lematta ilema shette enav lemala dechaze lemala shette enav lematta dechaze lematta eno achat lemala veeno achat lematta dachazay eno achat lematta veeno achat lemala hayenu roe et hacheder veet haaliyya keechat

Ella shette enav lemala dekayeman lemala shette enav lematta dekayeman lematta eno achat lemala veeno achat lematta dekayemi eno achat lemala veeno achat lematta vekayemi kesidran name veroe et hacheder veet haaliyya keachat

Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan beeno kol ma shebbeeno mikkan amru shette enav lematta shette enav lemala eno achat lemala veeno achat lematta veroe et hacheder veet haaliyya keechat o shemmedabber im chavero veacher omer li roe
Tanu rabbanan iver ben some bishte enav ben some beachat meenav chavarvar vehammayim hakkevuin minnayin talmud lomar ish iver
Amar rava lema li dichtav rachamana ish iver dak tevallul beeno tzerichi dei ketav rachamana iver mishshum deletanhu kelal aval chavarvar vehammayim hakkevuin deitanhu beh la ketav rachamana ish
Vei ketav rachamana ish mishshum dela ka chaze kelal aval machsorayeta la ketav rachamana dak vei ketav rachamana dak mishshum dimchasseran aval mevalbelita la ketav rachamana tevallul
Vei ketav rachamana tevallul mishshum dimvalbelan aval mishshum meshanneuta la ketav rachamana beeno
Amar rava hilkach kol mechamat kahuta atya meish machsorayeta middak mevalbelita mittevallul meshanneuta mibbeeno
Sache shemesh tane rav yosef sane shemesh zagdeyan machve rav huna chad middidan vechad middidhu veikfad rav yehuda
Metivi shachvana sheggevinav shochvim zagdom echad shachor veechad lavan tanna kol zuga dela shave lahadade zagdom kare leh
Hatztzayeran enav terutot vetziraniyyot domot dolfot tordot

Tanna hazzidder vehallufyan vehattamir vehattimyan ziver dimzavar eneh lufyan dinfishin zifeh tamir timyan shettammu zifin zifav vehane gabbe mumin tanu lehu vehatnan shennashru rise enav pasul mippene marit haayin la kashya ha deishteur gardume ha dela ishteur gardume

Matni enav gedolot keshel egel o ketannot keshel avaz gufo gadol meevarav o katan meevarav chotmo gadol meevarav o katan meevarav hatzimem vehatztzimea ezehu tzimea kol sheoznav ketannot vehatztzimem kol sheoznav domot lisfog sefato haelona odefet al hattachtona hattachtona odefet al haelona hare ze mum veshennashru shinav pasul mippene marit haayin
Gema amar rav moshe rabbenu eser ammot haya shenneemar vayyifros et haohel al hammishkan mi peraso moshe rabbenu peraso uchtiv eser ammot orech hakkaresh
Amar leh rav shimi bar chiyya lerav im ken asito lemoshe rabbenu baal mum ditnan gufo gadol meevarav o katan meevarav amar leh shimi beamma shel kodesh kaamena
Chotmo gadol tana keetzba ketanna
Hatztzimem vehatztzimea tana af hatztzimeach la hao yadi rabbanan may tzimeach shemau lehahu tayyaa dahava kaamar man devae tzimeach veishtechach gadya chaziza
Amar rav chisda ez sheen lah karnayim verachel sheyyesh lah karnayim kesherim legabbe mizbeach

Tanya name hachi yesh devarim shehen kemumin veenan kemumin veshochatin alehem bemikdash aval lo bammedina veellu hen ez sheen lo lah karnayim verachel sheyyesh lo lah karnayim vehatztzimeach vehatztzimem vehatztzimea
Amar rav chisda amar ammemar nittelu karnotan vezachrutan immahen pesula veen podin alehem nittelu telafayim vezachrutam immahen pesulin venifdin alehem
Metivi nittelu karnayin utlafayin vezachrutan immahen pesulin venifdin alehen la kashya ha deitakur itakore ha deigum igome
Udigum igome pasul urminhu para shekkarneha utlafeha shechorim yagod targemah zeeri meilave zachrut
b: Matni daddin shochvin keshel ishsha kereso tzava tiburo yotze nichpe afilu achat leyamim ruach ketzara baa alav hamushban uvaal gever

Gema amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba mashtinin mayim bifne rabbim veen shotin mayim bifne rabbim vetanya name hachi mashtinin mayim bifne rabbim veen shotin mayim bifne rabbim umaase beechad shebbikesh lehashtin mayim velo hishtin venimtza kereso tzava
Shemuel itzterich leh beshabbeta derigla negadu leh gelima ata lekammeh daavuh amar leh etten lach arba mea zuze vezil ahdar ovada atte deefshar lach dela efshar leh listakkan
Mar bar rav ashe itzterich aggudda gamla ashten amaru leh chamatach kaatya amar lehu beudnah
Vetipok li mishshum alka beshotet
Tanu rabbanan shene nekavim yesh bo baadam echad motzi sheten veechad motzi shichvat zera veen ben ze laze ella kiklipat hashshum beshaa sheadam nitzrach im nikkevu ze letoch ze nimtza akar
Amar resh lakish may dichtiv lo yihye vecha akar vaakara uvivhemtecha ematay lo yihye vecha akar bizman shebbivhemtecha
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi lo yihye vecha akar min hattalmidim vaakara shello tehe tefillatecha akura lifne hammakom ematay bizman sheatta mesim atzmecha kivhema

Amar rav pappa lo yashtin adam mayim lo al kele cheres velo al mekom kashe deamar rav hane medore devavel mehadderi mayya leen etam amar abbaye ha itta la tekum lehedya beanpe yanoka aggisa let lan bah

Tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ammud hachozer mevi adam lide hidrokan silon hachozer mevi adam lide yerakon amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav kattina amar resh lakish dam rave shechin rave shichvat zera rava tzaraat rava tzoa rava hidrokan rave me raglayim ravin yerakon rave
Ruach katzrit baa alav may ninhu tana ruach ben nefalim baa alav
Hamushban uvaal gever tana meshubban babbetzim uvaal gever baggid tana meshubban ze hakkayyan hagravtan ze baal kik kayyan babbetzim geravta baggid
Vead kamma machve rav yehuda ad rechubba tanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer ad rechubba pasul lemala min rechubba kasher ika deamri ad rechubba kasher lematta min harchubba pasul

Matni en lo betzim o en lo ella betza achat hare ze meroach ashech haamur betora rabbi yishmael omer kol shennimochu ashachav rabbi akiva omer kol sheruach baashachav rabbi chanina ben antignos omer kol shemmarav chashuchin
Gema kashya leh lerabbi yishmael ha chasar ashech mibe leh teni shennimrechu ashachav kashya leh lerabbi akiva hay mamroach ashech mibe leh teni sheharuach baashachav
Kashya leh lerabbi chanina ben antignos hay ruach ashech mibe leh teni shemmarav chashuchin kasavar gorin umosifin vedorshin
Hayenu kushi rabbi chanina ben antignos la tane kushi
Matni makkish bekarsullav uvarchubbotav

a: Uvaal happikim haikel ezehu haikel kol shehu makkif parsotav veen arkubbotav nokshot zo lazo pika yotze migguddalo akevo yotze laachorav parsotav rechavot keshel avaz
Etzbeotav murkavot zo al zo o kelutot lemala ad happerek kasher lematta min happerek vachatachah kasher hayeta bah yeteret vachatachah im yesh bah etzem pasul veim lav kasher
Yater beyadav uvraglav shesh vashesh esrim vearba rabbi yehuda machshir vachachamim poslin hashsholet bishte yadav rabbi posel vachachamim machshirin

Gema tanu rabbanan shever ragel en li ella shever regel minnayin lerabbot hakkishan vehaikel vehakkilban talmud lomar o shever ragel tana baal hakkipin vehashshufnar amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan baal happikin sheyyesh lo kesatot harbe shufnar sheen lo kesatot kol ikar
Pika yotza migguddalo vaakevo yotze laachorav amar rabbi elazar shoko yotze baemtza raglo parsotav rechavot keshel avaz amar rav pappa la tema ditrifa vela sedika ella kevan ditrifa af al gav disdika
Etzbeotav murkavot zo al gav zo o kelutot tanu rabbanan shever yad en li ella shever yad
Etzbaot murkavot lemala o kelutot lemala min happerek vehaamratte kasher ella velo chatachan minnayin talmud lomar o shever yad
Hayeta bo yeteret vachatachah im yesh bah etzem pasul veim lav kasher amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan vehu shennisperet al gabbe hayyad

Tanu rabbanan yetera sheyyesh bah etzem veen bah tzipporen metamma bemagga uvmassa umtamma beohel veola leminyan mea veesrim vachamishsha amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan uvnisperet al gav hayyad

Amar rav chisda davar ze rabbenu haggadol amaro hammakom yihye beezro yeteret sheyyesh bah etzem veen bah tzipporen metamma bemagga uvmassa veen metamma beohel amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan uvsheenah nisperet al gav hayyad
Amar rabbi yochanan asu divrehem kedivre neviut ma nafshach i ever hu beohel name tetamme vei lav ever hu bemagga uvmassa name la litamme
Amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika mishshum etzem kisora nagu bah
Rav pappa amar gezera sheenah nisperet attu nisperet i hachi sheenah nisperet beohel name tetamme
Avadu rabbanan hekera ki hechi dela lisrefu alayehu teruma vekadashim

Tenan hatam rov binyano verov minyano shel met af al pi sheen bo rova temein tanu rabbanan ezehu rov binyano shene shokayim veyarech echad hoil verov govho begadol ezehu rov minyano mea veesrim vachamishsha

Amar leh ravina lerava tanna minyana ata leashmoinan ka mashma lan kidtanya chaser sheen bo ella matayim veyater sheyyesh bo matayim ushmonim veechad kullan olin leminyan mea veesrim vachamishsha zil batar rubba deinashe

Amar rabbi yehuda amar shemuel maase betalmidav shel rabbi yishmael sheshshalku zona achat shennitchayeva serefa lammelech badku umatzu bah matayim vachamishshim ushnayim amar lahem shemma beishsha bedaktem shehosif lah hakkatuv shene tzirim ushne delatot

Tanya rabbi elazar omer keshem shetztzirim labbayit kach tzirim laishsha shenneemar vattichra vatteled ki nehefchu aleha tzireha rabbi yehoshua omer keshem sheddelatot labbayit kach delatot laishsha shenneemar ki lo sagar dalte vitni
Rabbi akiva omer keshem shemmafteach labbayit kach mafteach laishsha shenneemar vayyiftach et rachmah lerabbi akiva kashya detalmide rabbi yishmael dilma ayede dezutar ittemoche mittemach
Amar rav vechullan en metammein beohel shenneemar zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel davar hashshave lechol adam

Amar leh abbaye uvish leka vehachtiv tzirim achazuni ketzire yoleda tzire vasar vehachtiv adoni bammara nehefchu tziray hacha name tzire vasar hachi name mistabbera dei la tema hachi matayim vearbaim ushmone hechi mashkachatte lah la beish vela beishsha
b: Yater beyadav uvraglav amar rabbi yitzchak ushnehem mikra echad darshu vattehi od milchama uchtiv vayehi ish madon etzba yadav veetzba raglav shesh vashesh mar savar bignuteh mishtae umar savar bishvacheh mishtae

Amar rabba ma li dichtiv shesh vashesh esrim vearba mispar tzerichi dei ketav rachamana shesh vashesh hava amena shet dideh veshet dechareh ketav esrim vearba vei ketav esrim vearba hava amena hu chamesh mehay gisa ushva mehay gisa ketav shesh vashesh mispar benisperet al gabbe hayyad

Tanya amar rabbi yehuda maase beadam echad shebba lifne rabbi tarfon yater beyadav uvraglav shesh vashesh esrim vearba amar lo kemotcha yirbu beyisrael amar lo rabbi yose mishsham reaya kach amar lo kemotcha yitmaatu mamzere untine miyyisrael

Hashsholet bishte yadav tanu rabbanan iter ben bayyad ben baregel pasul hashsholet bishte yadav rabbi posel vachachamim machshirin mar savar kechishuta atchila beyamin umar savar beriyyuta atchila bismol

Matni hakkushi haggichor vehallavkan vehakkippeach vehannannas vehacheresh vehashshote vehashshikor uvaale negaim tehorim pesulin beadam uchsherim babbehema rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shota min habbehema enah min hammuvchar rabbi elazar omer af baale haddildulin pesulin baadam uchsherin babbehema

Gema kushi ukkama gichor chivara lavkan summaka ini veha hahu daamar lehu man bae lukyane veishtechach chivara ella kushi ukkama gichor summaka kidamri inashe summaka gichya lavkan chivara kehahu daamar lehu man bae lukyane veishtechach chivare

Kippeach tane rav zevid gavoha ini vehatane rabbi avahu minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu mishtabbeach bevaale koma shenneemar veanochi hishmadti et haemori mippenehem asher kegovah arazim govho amar rav pappa baaricha shemita sanya

Amar resh lakish gavoha lo yissa gevohit shemma yetze mehen toren nannas lo yissa nanneset shemma yetze mehem etzbai lavan lo yissa levana shemma yetze mehem bohek shachor lo yissa shechora shemma yetze mehen tafuach
Hacheresh hashshote vehashshikkor shikkor machel avoda bahade mume demachali avoda bae lemichshav
Bishar devarim hamshakkerim udla kerabbi yehuda detanya achal devela keilit veshata chalav o devash nichnas lammikdash chayyav
Matni ellu kesherin baadam ufsulin babbehema oto veet beno terefa veotze dofen veshenneevda bahen avera veshehemit et haadam
Vehannose nashim baavera pasul ad sheyyaddirenna hanaa vehammittamme lemetim pasul ad sheyekabbel alav shello yehe mittamme lemetim
Gema veellu kesherin baadam may oto veet beno
Ilema aharon uvanav dichvateh tayish uvno mi naheg vehatanya oto veet beno noheg binkevot veeno noheg bizcharim ella teyasha uvnah dichvatah hacha kohenet uvnah kohenet bat avoda hi

Leolam aharon uvanav dichvatah hacha tayish uvno amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose bar avin ada amra chananya hi detanya oto veet beno noheg binkevot veeno noheg bizcharim chananya omer noheg bizcharim uvinkevot
Vehannose nashim ku tana noder veoved yored umgaresh
Velechush dilma azel legabbe chacham veshare leh kasavar tzarich lefaret et hanneder
Hanicha leman deamar tzarich lefaret et hanneder ella leman deamar en tzarich lefaret et hanneder may ika lememar demadderinan leh berabbim
Hanicha leman deamar neder shehuddar berabbim en lo hafara ella leman deamar yesh lo hafara may ika lememar demadderinan

a: Leh addaat rabbim

Amar ammemar hilcheta afilu leman deamar neder shehuddar barabbim yesh lo hafara al daat harabbim en lo hafara vehane mile lidvar harshut aval lidvar mitzva yesh lo hafara ki hahu demakre dardeke addereh rav acha deka fasha beyanoke veahdereh ravina dela ashkach dahava dayek kevateh
Vehammittamme lemetim ku may shena hacha desaggi leh bekabbala umay shena hatam demadderinan leh hatam yitzro tekafo
Hadaran alach mumin ellu
Matni yesh bechor lannachala veeno bechor lakkohen bechor lichhen veeno bechor lannachala bechor lannachala velakkohen veyesh sheeno bechor lo lannachala velo lakkohen
Ezehu bechor lannachala veeno bechor lakkohen habba achar nefalim af al pi sheyyatza et rosho chay uven tisha sheyyatza rosho met hammappelet kemin behema chayya vaof divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim ad sheyehe bo mitztzurat adam hammappelet sandal o shilya o shappir merukkam vehayyotze mechuttach habba acharehem bechor lannachala veen bechor lakkohen
Mi shello hau lo banim venasa ishsha shekkevar yalda odah shifcha venishtachrera odah nochrit venitgayera mishshebbat leyisrael yalda bechor lannachala veen bechor lakkohen
Rabbi yose haggelili omer bechor lannachala velakkohen shenneemar peter rechem beyisrael ad sheyyifteru rechem miyyisrael
Mi shehau lo banim venasa ishsha shello yalda nitgayera meubberet nishtachrera meubberet

Veyalda hi vechohenet hi ulviyya hi veishsha shekkevar yalda vechen mi shello shahata leachar balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda veeno yadua im ben tisha larishon im bin shiva laacharon bechor lakkohen veeno bechor lannachala
b: Gema amar shemuel en harosh poter binfalim
May tama kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav kol hecha denishmat ruach chayyim beappav hu dachashiv resheh idach la chashiv resheh
Tenan habba achar nefalim sheyyatza rosho chay uven tisha sheyyatza rosho met katane miha rosho may rosho rubbo

Velitne rubbo bedin hu deibi leh lemitne rubbo veayede deka vae lemitne sefa ben tisha sheyyatza rosho met tama derosho met ha rosho chay habba acharav bechor lannachala name la have tena resha name rosho
Umay ka mashma lan dechevan demappek leh resheh have leh leda tenena hotzi rosho af al pi shehechziro hare ze keyalud
Vechi tema ashmoinan behema veka mashma lan beadam deadam mibbehema la yalef delet lah perozdor
Behema meadam la yalfa mishshum dachashiv partzuf panim dideh
Ha name tenena yatza kedarko mishsheyyatza rov rosho veezehu rov rosho mishshettetze paddachto teuvta dishmuel teuvta
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish paddachat poteret bechol makom chutz min hannachala may tama yakkir amar rachamana verabbi yochanan amar afilu lannachala
Bechol makom leetoye may leetoye ha detanu rabbanan giyyoret sheyyatza paddachat veladah begayyutah veachar kach nitgayera en notnin lah yeme tuma vime tohora veenah mevia korban leda
Metivi yakkir zo hakkarat panim veezo hi hakkarat panim partzuf panim im hachotem tane ad hachotem ta shema en meidim ella al partzuf panim im hachotem teni ad hachotem

Ta shema paddachat belo partzuf panim partzuf panim belo paddachat en meidin ad sheyehu shenehem im hachotem veamar abbaye veitema rav kahana may keraa hakkarat penehem anta bam shane edut ishsha deachmiru bah rabbanan
Umi achmiru veha tenan huchzeku lihot massiim ed mippi ed mippi ishsha mippi eved mippi shifcha ki akkilu rabbanan besofah bitchillatah la akkilu rabbanan
Veibaet ema

a: Yakkir lechud vehakkarat panim lechud

Itmar hau lo banim begayyuto venitgayyer rabbi yochanan omer en lo bechor lannachala verabbi shimon ben lakish omer yesh lo bechor lannachala rabbi yochanan omer en lo bechor lannachala deha hava leh reshit ono verabbi shimon ben lakish omer yesh lo bechor lannachala ger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame

Veazdu letamayehu deitmar hau lo banim begayyuto venitgayyer rabbi yochanan amar kiyyem periyya urviyya verabbi shimon ben lakish amar lo kiyyem rabbi yochanan amar kiyyem lo tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah verabbi shimon ben lakish amar lo kiyyem periyya urviyya ger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame

Utzricha dei itmar beha kammayeta beha kaamar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum divgayyutan lav bene nachala ninhu aval beha ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan delo tohu beraah lashevet yetzarah veha avad leh shevet
Vei itmar beha beha kaamar rabbi yochanan aval beha ema mode leh lerabbi shimon ben lakish tzericha
Tenan mi shello hau lo banim venasa ishsha shekkevar yalda odah shifcha venishtachrera odah goya venitgayera umishshebbata leyisrael yalada veladah bechor lannachala veeno bechor lakkohen
Yalda mimman ilema miyyisrael shello hau lo banim may irya giyyoret veshifcha afilu bat yisrael name
Ella lav migger shehau lo banim venitgayyer vekatane bechor lannachala
La leolam miyyisrael shello hau lo banim veeno bechor lakkohen itztericha leh
Leappoke midderabbi yose haggelili deamar bechor lannachala velakkohen shenneemar peter rechem beyisrael ad sheyyifteru rechem miyyisrael ka mashma lan dela

Ta shema hau lo banim begayyuto venitgayyer yesh lo bechor lannachala amar ravina veitema rav acha ha vadday rabbi yose haggelili hi deamar peter rechem beyisrael ad sheyyifteru rechem miyyisrael veyalef ihu minah didah
Amar rav adda bar ahava leviyya sheyyalda benah patur mechamesh selaim deiabbar mimman ilema deiabbar mikkohen umillevi may irya leviyya afilu yisreelit name
Ella deiabbar miyyisrael lemishpechotam levet avotam ketiv
Amar rav pappa deiabbar miggoy vela tema alliba deman deamar en mezahamin et havalad ella afilu leman deamar mezahamin et havalad levi pasul mikre
Mar bereh derav yosef amar mishshemeh derava leolam deiabbar miyyisrael veshane hatam deamar kera peter rechem befeter rechem tela rachmana
Tenan mi shehau lo banim venasa ishsha shello yalada nitgayera meubberet nishtachrera meubberet

Veyalda hi vechohenet hi ulviyya hi veishsha shekkevar yalada vechen mi shello shahata achare balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalada veen yadua im ben tisha larishon im ben shiva laacharon bechor lakkohen veeno bechor lannachala
Mikkelal dichhunna dechohenet ulviyya peturin deiabbar mimman ilema deiabbar mikkohen velevi i hachi may irya kohenet ulviyya afilu bat yisrael name

Ella deiabbar miggoy kohenet petura vehaamar rav pappa badek lan rabba kohenet shennitabbera miggoy mahu veamena leh lav hayenu derav adda bar ahava deamar leviyya sheyyalda benah patur mechamesh selaim
Vaamar li hachi hashta bishlama leviyya bikdushtah kayema detanya leviyya shennishbet o shennivala beilat zenut notnin lah min hammaaser veochelet
Ella kohenet kevan dei bael lah haveya zara
Hanicha lemar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava deamar deiabbar miyyisrael moke lah bidiabbar miyyisrael ella lerav pappa bemay moke lah
Leolam deiabbar mikkohen vehi bat yisrael veammay kare lah kohenet divna kohen
b: Itmar kohen shemmet vehinniach ben chalal rav chisda amar habben chayyav lifdot et atzmo rabba bar rav huna amar en chayyav lifdot et atzmo kol hecha demet haav leachar sheloshim dechulle alma la peligi deen habben chayyav lifdot et atzmo shehare zacha aviv befidono

Ki peligi hecha demet haav betoch sheloshim yom rav chisda amar habben chayyav lifdot et atzmo deha lo zacha aviv lefidono befidono rabba bar rav huna amar en habben chayyav lifdot atzmo daamar leh atena mikkoach gavra dela matzet leishtaoye dina bahadeh
Tenan nitgayera meubberet bechor lakkohen veammay lema leh atena mikkoach gavra dela matzet leishtaoye dina bahadeh shane goy delet leh chayis

Amar rabbi shimon yasinya amar rabbi shimon ben lakish kohen shemmet betoch sheloshim vehinniach ben chalal habben chayyav lifdot et atzmo shello zacha haav befidono met leachar sheloshim yom en habben chayyav lifdot atzmo shehare zacha haav befidono
Vechen mi shello shahata achare balah shelosha chodashim vechu
Bechor lannachala hu dela have ha kefashut shakel veammay lezil legabbay hay velidchayeh ulgabbay hay velidchayeh
Amar rabbi yirmeya lo nitzrecha ella labba acharav vehachi kaamar bechor lakkohen vehabba acharav en bechor lannachala
Velichtevu harshaa lahadade vechi tema matnitin shello beharshaa ha mokminan lah kamman divharshaa
Mesayya leh lerabbi yannay deamar rabbi yannay hukkeru ulvassof nitarvu kotvin harshaa ze laze
Lo hukkeru uvsof nitarvu en kotvin harshaa ze laze

Matni e zehu bechor lannachala velakkohen hammappelet shappir male mayim male dam mele geninin hammappelet kemin dagim vachagavim shekatzim urmasim vehammappelet leom arbaim habba acharehem bechor lannachala ulchohen
Yotze dofen vehabba acharav shenehen enan bechor lo lannachala velo lakkohen rabbi shimon omer harishon lannachala vehashsheni lechamesh selaim
Gema rishon lannachala lo veyaldu lo baenan lechamesh selaim name la patar rechem baenan
Sheni lannachala lo reshit ono baenan lechamesh selaim name la kasavar bechor ledavar echad la have bechor
Rabbi shimon omer harishon lannachala vehashsheni lechamesh selaim rabbi shimon letameh deamar teled lerabbot yotze dofen
Vehashsheni lechamesh selaim kasavar bechor ledavar echad have bechor

a: Matni mi shello bikkera ishto veyalda shene zecharim noten chamesh selaim lechohen met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom haav patur
Met haav vehabbanim kayyamim rabbi meir omer im natnu ad shello chalku natanu veim lav peturin rabbi yehuda omer nitchayevu nechasim zachar unkeva en kan lakkohen kelum
Gema demit haav emat ilema demit leachar sheloshim yom beha amar rabbi meir ki chalku peturin veha ishtabadu lehu nichse
Ella demit betoch sheloshim yom may shena ki chalku deazel legabbe hay umdache leh deazel legabbe hay umdache leh ki lo chalku name lezil legabbe hay velidachayeh velezil legabbe hay velidachayeh

Amar rabbi yirmeya zot omeret shene yosef ben shimon shehau beir achat velakchu sade beshuttafut baal chov gove otah mehem deamar leh i bedidach massekna menata didach ka shakelna vei bechavrach massekna menata dechavrach ka shakelna

Amar rava mikkede nichse devar inish inun arvin beh mi ika mide dildideh la matze tava leh ularev matze tava leh vehatnan hammalve et chavero al yede arev lo yippara min hearev vekayema lan delo yitba min hearev techilla
Ella amar rava leolam shemmet leachar sheloshim yom vei deika nichse tuva hachi name deshakel vehacha bemay askinan kegon deleka ella chamesh selaim
Udchulle alma it lehu derav assi deamar rav assi haachin shechalku mechetza yorshin umechetza lakochot udchulle alma milve hakketuva battora
b: Lav kichtuva bishtar damya udchulle alma it lehu derav pappa deamar rav pappa milva al pe gove min hayyorshin veeno gove min hallakochot
Vehacha bechamesh velo bachatzi chamesh kamipalgi derabbi meir savar chamesh velo chatzi chamesh verabbi yehuda savar chamesh vaafilu chatzi chamesh
I hachi rabbi yehuda omer nitchayevu nechasim nitchayyev gavra mibe leh veod tanya rabbi yehuda omer haachin shechalku im yesh asara zuz laze vaasara zuz laze chayyavin veim lav peturin
May asara zuz laze vaasara zuz laze ilema ben dirushsha ben delakochot vechamesh vaafilu chatzi chamesh i hachi may irya asara afilu betzir measara name
Ella peshita asara zuz dirushsha laze vaasara zuz dirushsha laze alma chamesh velo chatzi chamesh sevira leh
Ella dechulle alma chamesh velo chatzi chamesh vehacha bidrav assi verav pappa kamipalgi
Veika dematne leh assefa nitchayevu hannechasim demit haav emat ilema demit leachar sheloshim mikkelal derabbi meir savar ki chalku peturin ha ishtabadu lehu nichse
Ella betoch sheloshim ki chalku ammay mechayyev rabbi yehuda lezil legabbe hay lidachayeh vegabbe hay velidchayeh

Amar rabbi yirmeya zot omeret shene yosef ben shimon shehau beir achat velakach echad mehem sade mechavero baal chov gove mimmennu daamar leh i bedidach massekna menata didach ka shakelna vei bechavrach massekna mishtabeda li mikkamme didach
Amar rava mikkede nichsohi devar inish inun arvin beh vechullah kelishana kamma

Matni shette nashim shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim noten asara selaim lakkohen met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom im lechohen echad natan yachazir lo chamesh selaim veim lishne kohanim natan eno yachol lehotzi miyyadam
Zachar unkeva o shene zecharim unkeva noten chamesh selaim lakkohen shette nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushte nekevot en kan lakkohen kelum
Achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera veyaldu shene zecharim noten chamesh selaim lakkohen met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom haav patur
Met haav vehabbanim kayyamim rabbi meir omer im natnu ad shello chalku natnu veim lav peturin rabbi yehuda omer nitchayevu nechasim zachar unkeva en lakkohen kelum

Shette nashim shel shene anashim shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim ze noten chamesh selaim lakkohen veze noten chamesh selaim met echad mehem betoch sheloshim im lakkohen echad natanu yachazir lahem chamesh selaim im lishne kohanim natanu enan yecholin lehotzi miyyadam
Zachar unkeva haavot peturin vehabben chayyav lifdot et atzmo shette nekevot vezachar o shette nekevot ushne zecharim en kan lakkohen kelum
Achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera shel shene anashim veyaldu shene zecharim ze shello bikkera ishto noten chamesh selaim lakkohen zachar unkeva en kan lakkohen kelum
Gema may shena shene kohanim deazel legabbe hay umdache leh veazel legabbe hay umdache leh
Kohen echad name lezil legabbe hay velidachayeh velezil legabbe hay velidachayeh amar shemuel

a: Beva beharshaa
Vehaamri nehardae la katvinan adrachta ammittalteli hane mile hecha dechafreh aval hecha dela kafreh katvinan
Zachar unkeva en kan lakkohen kelum tana rav huna shene zecharim unkeva en kan lakkohen kelum
Vetanna didan kevan devishne anashim hu demashkachatte lah beish echad ushte nashim la mashkachatte lah la mittene leh

Matni met habben betoch sheloshim yom af al pi shennatan lakkohen yachzir leachar sheloshim yom af al pi shello natan yitten met beom sheloshim keom shellefanav rabbi akiva omer im natan lo yittol veim lo natan lo yitten
Gema may tamayehu derabbanan gamri chodesh chodesh mimmidbar ma hatam vamala af hacha name vamala
Verabbi akiva mesappeka leh middeitzterich lemichtav vamala gabbe arachin vela gamri mimmidbar hau lehu shene ketuvim habbaim keechad
Vechol shene ketuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin
O dilma ki en melammedin lealma aval legufayehu melammedin umishshum hachi mesappeka leh
Amar rav ashe hakkol modim leinyan avelut yom sheloshim keom shellefanav veamar shemuel halacha kedivre hammekel beevel

Matni met haav betoch sheloshim bechezkat shello nifda ad sheyyavi reaya shennifda leachar sheloshim yom bechezkat shennifda ad sheyyomru lo shello nifda hu lifdot uvno lifdot hu kodem livno rabbi yehuda omer beno kodmo shemmitzvato al aviv umitzvat beno alav
Gema itmar happode et beno betoch sheloshim yom rav amar beno paduy ushmuel amar en beno paduy dechulle alma meachshav en beno paduy leachar sheloshim yom veitanhu lemaot vadday beno paduy
Ki peligi leachar sheloshim yom venitakkelu hammaot rav amar beno paduy mide dehave akkidushe ishsha hatam lav af al gav denitakkelu hammaot hau kidushe
b: Hacha name la shena

Ushmuel amar lach hatam beyado lekaddeshah meachshav hacha en beyado lifdoto meachshav veaf al gav dekayema lan dechol hecha difligi rav ushmuel hilcheta kerav beisure vechishmuel bedine hacha hilcheta kevateh dishmuel
Tenan met betoch sheloshim yom af al pi shennatan lakkohen yachzir lo chamesh selaim tama demet ha lo met beno paduy hacha bemay askinan deitanhu lemaot
Ta shema bechezkat shello nifda ad sheyyomru lo shennifda hatam name deitanhu lemaot beenayehu

Tane tanna kammeh derav yehuda happode et beno betoch sheloshim yom beno paduy amar leh shemuel amar en beno paduy veatte amratte beno paduy veaf al gav dekayema lan kerav beisure vechishmuel bedine hacha hilcheta kevateh dishmuel
Hu lifdot uvno lifdot hu kodem livno vechu tanu rabbanan hu lifdot uvno lifdot hu kodem livno rabbi yehuda omer beno kodmo shemmitzvato al aviv umitzvat beno alav
Amar rabbi yirmeya hakkol modim hecha deleka ella chamesh selaim hu kodem livno may tama demitzva dideh adif ki peligi hecha deika chamesh meshubadot vechamesh bene chorin
Rabbi yehuda savar milva hakketuva battora kichtuva bishtar damya vedideh azel vetaref mimmeshabedi uvhane chamesh bene chorin parek leh livreh
Verabbanan savri milva hakketuva battora lav kichtuva bishtar damya hilkach mitzva dideh adif
Matni chamesh selaim shel ben bemane tzori
Sheloshim shel eved chamishshim shel ones veshel mefatte umea shel motzi shem ra kullam beshekel hakkodesh bemane tzori vechullan nifdin bechesef uvshave kesef chutz mishshekalim
Gema mane tzori amar rabbi assi mane shel tzor rabbi amme amar dinara arvaya rabbi chanina omer istera surseya demizdabbena temanya bedinara chamesh minayehu lefidon habben

a: Rabbi yochanan omer dinara hadriyyana tiryana sheyafa dimzabbena beesrim vechamsha zuze dal minayehu shetuta vehanach lefidon habben hane esrin vechad neche danka have

Ella dal shetuta vezuza vehanach lefidon habben akkatti esrin neche danka have ella dal zuza ushtuta vehanach lefidon habben dehave lehu esrin matkale bematkale dinara deinun esrin utmanya zuze ufalge ufalga danka
Amar rava silim deorayeta telata vetilta have dichtiv esrim gera hashshekel umtargeminan esrin main vetanya shesh maa kesef dinar
Metivi vahalo sela shel kodesh arbaim ushmone pundeonin
Pundeon ze ma tivo kilbon lapperotrot
Batar deosifu ilavayehu detanya esrim gera hashshekel lamadnu lashshekel shehu esrim gera uminnayin sheim ratza lehosif yosif talmud lomar yihye yachol yifchot talmud lomar hu
Rav ashe shaddar leh shivsar zuze lerav acha bereh deravina befidon habben shelach leh lishaddar li mar tilta yattirta deika illavayehu shelach leh leshaddar li mar telata acharina deosifu ilavayehu

Amar rabbi chanina kol kesef haamur battora setam sela dinviim litrin dichtuvin kinterin chutz min kaspo shel efron sheaf al pi shekkatuv battora setam kintarin dichtiv arba meot shekel kesef over lassocher veika duchta deka karu lekintara tikla
Amar rabbi oshaya bikshu lignoz kol kesef vezahav shebbaolam mippene kaspah uzhavah shel yerushalayim ad shemmatzu lo mikra min hattora shehu muttar shenneemar uvau vah paritzim vechilleluha

Virushalayim haveya rubba dealma ella amar abbaye bikkeshu lignoz dinara hadriyyana tiryana sheyafa mippene tivah shel yerushalayim ad shemmatzu lah mikra min hattora shehu muttar shenneemar uvau vah paritzim vechilleluha
b: Rav yehuda amar rav assi kol kesef haamur battora setam kesef tzori veshel divrehem kesef medina
Uchlala hu vahare taana dichtiv ki yitten ish el reehu kesef o chelim lishmor
Utnan shevuat haddayyanin hattaana shette chesef
Shane hatam dichtiv kesef o chelim ma kelim shenayim af kesef shenayim uma kesef davar chashuv af kelim davar chashuv
Vahare maaser dichtiv vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha utnan happoret sela bimot maaser sheni kesef kesef riba
Vahare hekdesh dichtiv venatan hakkesef vekam lo veamar shemuel hekdesh shave mane shechillo al shave peruta mechullal hekdesh name yalef kodesh kodesh mimmaaser
Vahare kidushe ishsha dichtiv veyatza chinnam en kasef utnan bet shammay omrim bedinar uvshave dinar uvet hillel omrim bifruta uvshave peruta lema rav assi deamar kevet shammay
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav yehuda amar rav assi kol kesef katzuv haamur battora kesef tzori veshel divrehem kesef medina
May kamashma lan tenena chamesh selaim shel ben vechu
Veshel divrehem kesef medina itztericha leh ditnan hattokea lachavero noten lo sela vela tema sela arba zuze ella palga dezuza dekaru inashe sela palga dezuza
Chanan bisha teka leh lehahu gavra ata lekammeh derav huna amar leh hav leh palga dezuza hava ika

a: Zuza macha bahadeh dela nafek teka leh acharina veyahaveh nihaleh
Sheloshim shel eved chamishshim shel ones veshel mefatte vechu ha tu lema li ha tena leh resha
Ones umotzi shem ra itzterich salka datach amena kevan dela ketiv behu shekalim ema zuze bealma ka mashma lan demelaf ka yalfi mehadade
Chutz min hashshekalim tana chutz min hashshekalim umaaser vehareaon
Shekalim ditnan metzarfin shekalim ledarbonot mippene massooy hadderech
Maaser dichtiv vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha vehareaon tane rav yosef shello yavi siga laazara
