Matni en podin lo baavadim velo bishtarot velo bekarkaot velo behekdeshot katav lechohen shehu chayyav liten chamishsha selaim chayyav liten lo uvno eno paduy lefichach im ratza hakkohen liten lo bemattana rashshay
Hammafrish pidon beno veavad chayyav beachrauto shenneemar yihye lach ufado tifde
Gm matnitin dela kerabbi detanya rabbi omer bakkol podin bechor adam chutz min hashshetarot may tama derabbi
Daresh ribuye umiute ufduyav mibben chodesh tifde riba beerkecha kesef chameshet shekalim miet tifde riba
Riba umiet veriba riba hakkol may rabbi rabbi kol mile umay maet maet shetarot
Verabbanan darshi kelal ufrat vfduyav mibben chodesh kalal beerkecha kesef chameshet shekalim parat tifde chazar vechalal

Kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon yatzu karkaot sheen mittaltelin yatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot yatzu shetarot sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin en gufan mamon
Amar leh ravina lemarimar verabbi ribuye umiute daresh veha rabbi kelale ufrate daresh bemartzea

Detanya martzea en li ella martzea minnayin lerabbot hassol vehassira vehammachat vehammakdeach vehammachtev talmud lomar velakachta lerabbot kol davar shennilkach bayyad divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda rabbi omer martzea ma martzea meuchad shel mattechet af kol shel mattechet
Veamrinan bemay ka mipalgi rabbi daresh kelale ufrate yose berabbi yehuda daresh ribuye umiute
In bealma rabbi kelale ufrate daresh vehacha kidtana deve rabbi yishmael
Detana deve rabbi yishmael bemayim bammayim shette feamim en ze kelal ufrat ella riba umiet
Verabbanan amri kidamrinan bemareva kol makom sheatta motze shette chelalot hassemuchim ze laze hattel perat benehem vedunem bichlal ufrat
Velo behekdeshot peshita lav dideh ninhu ema
b: Velo hekdeshot bechol ellu
Katav lechohen shehu chayyav lo chamishsha selaim chayyav liten lo ku amar ulla devar tora beno paduy may tama en beno paduy gezera shemma yomru podin bishtar

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman beno paduy lichsheyyitten amar leh rav nachman zo divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda setimtaa veamri lah zo divre rabbi elazar berabbi shimon setimtaa aval chachamim omrim en beno paduy vehilcheta en beno paduy
Lefichach im ratza hakkohen liten lo bemattana rashshay tenena leha detanu rabbanan netano laasara kohanim bevat achat yatza beze achar ze yatza netalo vehechziro lo yatza
Vechach haya minhago shel rabbi tarfon shehaya notel umachzir uchsheshshamu chachamim baddavar amru kiyyem ze halacha zo halacha zo vetu la ella kiyyem ze af halacha zo
Rabbi chanina hava regil deshakel umahdar chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava ka azel veate kammeh amar leh la gemarte vihevte midaam bish hilkach en beno paduy
Hammafrish pidon beno veavad chayyav beachrauto menalan amar rabbi shimon ben lakish atya erech erech mearachin
Rav dimi amar rabbi yonatan vechol bechor banecha tifde velo yerau fanay rekam veyalef rekam rekam meolat reiyya ma olat reiyya chayyav beachrauto af pidon habben chayyav beachrauto
Matkef lah rav pappa kera likra ella amar rav pappa ha kidkatane tama yihye lach ach pado tifde
Vechi itmar deresh lakish aresha itmar met leachar sheloshim yom af al pi shello natan yitten mena lan amar rabbi shimon ben lakish atya erech erech mearachin
Rav dimi amar rabbi yonatan vechol bechor banecha tifde velo yerau fanay rekam ma lehallan yorshin chayyavin af kan yorshin chayyavin
Matni habbechor notel pi shenayim benichse haav veeno notel pi shenayim benichse haem veeno notel bashshevach velo berauy kivmuchzak

a: Velo haishsha bichtubbatah velo habbanot bimzonotehen velo et hayyavam vechullam en notlin bashshevach velo barauy kevammuchzak
Gema may tama amar kera velo mishpat habbechora mishpat habbechora laish veen mishpat habbechora laishsha
Veeno notel bashshevach dichtiv bechol asher yimmatze lo velo barauy kevammuchzak dichtiv bechol asher yimmatze lo
Velo haishsha bichtubbatah ini vehaamar shemuel baal chov gove et hashshevach amar rabbi abba mikkulle chetubba shanu kan
Velo habbanot bimzonotehen may tama tenay ketubba kichtubba dame

Velo et hayyavam may tama bechor karyeh rachamana amar abbaye lo shanu ella beshevach sheshshavchu nechasim ben mita leyibbum aval deven yibbum lachalukka shakel may tama yakum al shem achiv hammet amar rachamana vahare kam
Rava amar afilu deven yibbum lachalukka name la shakel may tama kivchor ma bechor en lo kodem chalukka af yavam name en lo kodem chalukka
Vechullam en notlin bashshevach
b: Leetoye shevacha demimmela chafura vahao shuvle shalpufe vahao tamre
Velo barauy kevammuchzak leetoye nichse daavi abba
Matni veellu sheen chozrin bayyovel habbechora vehayyoresh et ishto vehamyabem et eshet achiv

Vehammattana divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim hammattana kammecher rabbi elazar omer kullam chozrin bayyovel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer af hayyoresh et ishto yachzir livne mishpacha vinakke mehen et haddamim
Gema may tama derabbi meir mecher hu deamar rachamana lehdar bayyovel mattana virushsha la vehane miyerushsha yerushsha demattana mattana bechor latet lo pi shenayim mattana karyeh rachamana
Vehayyoresh et ishto yerushshat habbaal deorayeta vehamyabem et eshet achiv bechor karyeh rachamana
Vachachamim omrim mattana kemecher may tamayehu derabbanan tashuvu lerabbot et hammattana
Vehane kullehu yerushsha ninhu
Bechor amar kera latet lo pi shenayim makkish chelek bechora lechelek pashut ma chelek pashut yerushsha af chelek bechora yerushsha
Rabbi elazar omer kullam chozrim bayyovel savar lah kerabbanan deamri tashuvu lerabbot et hammattana vehane kullehu mattana ninhu bechor latet lo pi shenayim mattana karyeh rachamana
Vehayyoresh et ishto yerushshat habbaal derabbanan vehamyabem et eshet achiv bechor karyeh rachamana
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan haachin shechalku lakochot hen umachzirin ze laze bayyovel motev rav hoshaya veellu sheen chozrin bayyovel habbechora
Amar leh rabbi elazar may en chozrin en chozrin levattala matkef lah rav sheshet mikkelal deman deamar chozrin chozrin levattala kaamar

Kare rav chama aleh derav sheshet tova chochma im nachala vela shemia lehu ha dechi ate ravin amar rabbi yochanan veamri lah rabbi elazar amar mishshum rabbi elazar ben shammua may chozrin chozrin levattala

Rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer af hayyoresh et ishto yachzir livne vechu may kasavar i kasavar yerushshat habbaal deorayeta ammay yachzir livne mishpacha vei kasavar yerushshat habbaal derabbanan damim may avidtayehu
Leolam kasavar yerushshat habbaal deorayeta vehacha bemay askinan kegon shehorishattu ishto bet hakkevarot umishshum pegam mishpacha amur rabbanan lishkol deme velahdar
Vechidtanya hammocher kivro vederech kivro mekom maamado uvet hespedo baim bene mishpacha vekovrim oto beal korcho mishshum pegam mishpacha umay yenakke lahem min haddamim deme kever ishto
Hadaran alach yesh bechor

a: Matni masar behema noheg baaretz uvchutza laaretz bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit bachullin aval lo bammukdashin venoheg babbakar uvatztzon veenan mitasserim mizze al ze bakkevasim uvaizzim umitasserin mizze al ze

Bechadash uvayyashan veenan mitasserin mizze al ze shehaya baddin uma im hechadash vehayyashan sheenan kilayim ze baze enam mitasserin mizze al ze kevasim veizzim shehen kilayim ze baze eno din shello yehu mitasserin mizze al ze talmud lomar vetzon mashma kol tzon echad
Gema lema matnitin dela kerabbi akiva detanya rabbi akiva omer yachol yaale adam masar behema mechutza laaretz veyakrivennu talmud lomar vahavetem shamma olotechem vezivchechem veet maserotechem
Bishte maasrot hakkatuv medabber echad masar behema veechad masar dagan mimmakom sheatta maale masar dagan atta maale masar behema umimmekom shei atta maale masar dagan i atta maale masar behema
Afilu tema rabbi akiva kan likrav kan likdash dayeka name deka nasev lah talmuda vahavetem shamma shema minah
I hachi meachar sheeno karev ammay kadosh leneechal bemumo labbealim
Bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit i hachi afilu haidana name kidrav huna deamar rav huna gezera mishshum yatom
I hachi meikara name la ella efshar behachraza hacha name efshar behachraza
Ella amar rabba mishshum takkala umna temra dechayeshinan letakkala ditnan en makdishin veen maarichin veen machrimin bazzeman hazze
Veim hikdish veheerich vehechrim behema teaker perot kesut vechelim yerakvu maot uchle mattachot yolich leyam hammelach veezehu ikur noel delet befaneha vehi meta meeleha
I hachi bechor name la likdosh bechor bedidan talya milta berechem kadosh hachi kaamar likninhu leudnayehu legoyim dela likdosh meikara
b: Efshar kidrav yehuda deamar rav yehuda muttar lo laadam lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyatza laavir haolam hacha name efshar deshade beh muma meikara
Mi yada he nafek vechi tema demappek leh beresh asra lo yevakker ben tov lara amar rachamana
Vechi tema efshar deshade beh muma bechulleh edreh mehera yibbane bet hammikdash uvaenan behema lehakrava veleka
Hachi name bivchor behema mehera yibbane bet hammikdash uvaenan behema lehakrava veleka efshar bifshutin
Hacha name efshar bilkuchin kevan deihu shade beh muma bechulleh edreh ushchichi mume defasli bekadashim daafilu dukkin shebbaayin name pasli la shechichi
Bachullin aval lo bammukdashin mukdashin peshita lav dideh ninhu

Bekadashim kallim vealliba derabbi yose haggelili deamar kadashim kallim mamon bealim hem detanya umaala maal ba lerabbot kodashim kallim shehen mamon bealim divre rabbi yose haggelili salka datach amena liasseru ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name yihye kodesh amar rachamana velo shekkevar kadosh
Tama dichtav rachamana yihye kodesh ha lav hachi hava amena chayela kedushshat maaser ilavayehu hashta kedushsha chamura akkedushsha kalla la chayela kedushsha kalla akkedushsha kalla mibaya
May hi ditnan echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit en meshannin otam mikkedushsha likdushsha aval makdishin otan hekdesh iluy umachrimin otan
Mahu detema hatam dechol behema lav leola kayema aval hacha dechol behema lemaaser kayema af al gav deakdeshah la paka isura demaaser minah
Lemay nafka minah belo yiggael uvlo yimmacher ka mashma lan

Venoheg babbakar uvatztzon veen mitasserin mizze al ze bakkevasim uvaizzim vechu veyihu chadash veyashan mitasserin mizze al ze mikkal vechomer uma kevasim veizzim shehem kilayim ze baze mitasserin mizze al ze chadash veyashan sheenan kilayim ze baze eno din sheyyitasseru mizze al ze

Talmud lomar asser teasser bishte maasrot hakkatuv medabber echad masar behema veechad masar dagan umakkish masar behema lemaaser dagan ma masar dagan mechadash al hayyashan lo af masar behema mechadash al hayyashan lo
I hachi kevasim veizzim name lema makkish masar behema lemaaser dagan ma masar dagan mimmin al sheeno mino lo af masar behema mimmin al sheeno mino lo rabbi rachamana tzon
I hachi chadash veyashan name ha ketiv asser teasser uma raita amar rava amar kera shana shana leshana hikkashtiv velo ledavar acher

Tenan hatam en tormin mimmin al sheeno mino veim taram en terumato teruma mena hane mile amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yannay veamri lah amar rabbi amme amar rabbi shimon ben lakish kol chelev yitzhar vechol chelev tirosh vedagan amra tora ten chelev laze vechelev laze

a: Ashkechan tirosh veyitzhar tirosh vedagan dagan vedagan minnayin kal vachomer uma tirosh veyitzhar sheenan kilayim ze baze en mitasserin mizze al ze tirosh vedagan dagan vedagan shehem kilayim ze baze eno din shello yitasseru mizze al ze
Ulrabbi yoshiyya deamar ad sheyyizra chitta usora vechartzan bemappolet yad hechi mayete lah

Mayete lah hachi uma tirosh veyitzhar sheenan kilayim ze baze afilu al yede davar acher en mitasserin mizze al ze tirosh vedagan dagan vedagan shehen kilayim ze baze al yede davar acher eno din shello yitasseru mizze al ze
Ushne minin bealma menalan hane derabbanan ninhu vechol detakkinu rabbanan keen deorayeta takkinu ma deorayeta shene minin enan mitasserin mizze al ze derabbanan name
Amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye ella meatta gabbe maasar behema dela ketiv vechol masar bakar umaaser tzon
b: Yitasseru mizze al ze amar leh amar kera haasiri ten asiri laze veten asiri laze i hachi kevasim veizzim name vatzon mashma kol tzon echad
Hacha name lema mashma kol dagan echad amar abbaye reshitam vechen amar rabbi ila reshitam
Rava amar bela reshitam name mashma kol dagan echad la matzet amratte bishlama hatam amrinan vatzon mashma kol tzon echad dei salka datach kevasim veizzim name lichtov vechol masar behema
Vechi tema i ketiv kol masar behema have amena afilu chayya tachat tachat mikkodashim gamar
Veate bekal vachomer mechadash veyashan bakar vatzon lema li bakar vatzon hu deen mitasserin mizze al ze aval kevasim veizzim mitasserin
Aval hacha mi saggi dela ketiv dagan lemaote shear minin
Matkef lah rav huna bereh derav nachman ema learvu levakar betzon amar leh mar zutra bereh derav nachman lerava it leh name haasiri

Ika deamri amar rava belo asiri name la matzet amratte bakar vatzon mitasserin mizze al ze deitakkash masar behema lemaaser dagan ma masar dagan mimmin al sheeno mino la af masar behema mimmin al sheeno mino la
Veha rava hu deamar shana leshana hikkashtiv velo ledavar acher hadar beh rava mehahi veibaet ema chada minayehi rav pappa amrah

Matni masar behema mitztaref kimlo regel behema roa vechamma hi regel behema roa shishsha asar mil hau ben ellu leellu sheloshim ushnayim mil en mitztarfin hau lo baemtza mevi umasseran baemtza rabbi meir omer hayyarden mafsik lemasar behema
Gema mena hane mile
Amar rabba bar shela deamar kera od taavorna hatztzon al yede mone vekim lehu lerabbanan deshitsar mil ka shalta beh ena deroe

Hau ben ellu leellu sheloshim ushnayim mil en mitztarfin vechu sheloshim ushnayim hu deen mitztarfin ha betzir mehachi mitztarfin veha katane shishsha asar mil tefe la mishshum deka vae lemitne sefa hau lo baemtza mevi umasseran baemtza
Vechamma amar rav chamesh mikkan vechamesh mikkan vechamesh meemtza dehane chamesh chazya lehacha vechazya lehacha
Ushmuel amar afilu chamesh mikkan vechamesh mikkan veechad baemtza chazenan leroe keman dekae hacha vekarenan beh mone

a: Metivi haya lo chamesh bichfar chananya vechamesh bichfar otnay en mitztarfot ad sheyehe lo achat betzipori teuvta derav
Targemah shemuel alliba derav kegon shehau tesha mikkan vetesha mikkan veachat baemtza dehahi chazya lehacha vechazya lehacha
Amar rav pappa velishmuel afilu roe metzarfan vaafilu kilo shel roe metzarfan
Bae rav ashe kalba deroe may kevan dekare leh veate la mitztarfi o dilma zimnin dela ate umitztarech ihu lemezal veetoyeh teku
Rabbi meir omer hayyarden mafsik lemasar behema amar rabbi amme lo shanu ella sheen sham gesher aval yesh sham gesher gesher metzarfan
Alma mishshum dela mekarvan hu metivi hau lo bishne evre hayyarden elach veelach o bishne avtilaot kegon shel namer venamori en mitztarfin veen tzarich lomar chutza laaretz vaaretz
Veha chutza laaretz vaaretz kimkom sheyyesh gesher dame vekatane lo mitztarfin
Ella amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hayenu tameh derabbi meir deamar kera vehayyarden yigbol oto lifat kedma hakkatuv asao gevul bifne atzmo
Ella meatta vetaar haggevul veala haggevul hachi name hakkatuv asao gevul bifne atzmo
Shane hatam deamar kera zot tihye lachem haaretz ligvuloteha saviv kullah eretz yisrael gevul echad hi
I hachi yarden name eretz velo yarden
Bishlama lerabbi chiyya bar abba hayenu dekatane yarden ella lerabbi amme litninhu lechullehu neharot kashya
Lema ketannae ki attem ovrim et hayyarden artza kenaan artza eretz kenaan velo hayyarden eretz kenaan divre rabbi yehuda ben betira
Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer hare hu omer meever leyarden yerecho kedma mizracha ma yerecho eretz kenaan af yarden eretz kenaan

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan en yarden ella mibbet yerecho ulmatta lemay hilcheta ilema lenoder hallech achar leshon bene adam vechol hecha dekaru leh yarden itsar leh ella lemasar behema
Tanya name hachi yarden yotze mimmearat pamyas umhallech beyammah shel sivchi uvyammah shel teverya uvyammah shel sedom veholech venofel layyam haggadol veen yarden ella mibbet yericho ulmatta

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan lamma nikra shemo yarden sheyyored middan amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe attun mehatam matnitu lah anan mehacha matnenan lah vayyikreu lo leleshem dan beshem dan avihem veamar rabbi yitzchak leshem zo pamyas vetanya yotze yarden mimmearat pamyas
Amar rav kahana zachruteh deyardena mimmearat pamyas hecha deamar la shatena mayim mimmearat pamyas itsar leh bechulleh yardena
Zachruta didma kavda kidrabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak kaved shennimoach metamme birviit
Zachruta demayya perat deamar rav yehuda amar rav hannoder mimmeme perat asur bechol memot shebbaolam
Hechi dame ilema deamar la shatena mimmeme difrat me ferat hu dela shatena ha minnahara acharina shatena
Ella deamar la shatena mimmayim deatu mipperat deamar rav yehuda amar rav kol hanneharot lematta mishshelosha neharot ushlosha neharot lematta mipperat vehaika
b: Enata demidalleyan amar rav mesharsheya hanhu sullame difrat ninhu
Veha ketiv vehannahar harvii hu ferat
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak veitema rav acha bar yaakov hu perat demeikara
Tanya rabbi meir omer yuval shemo shenneemar vehaya keetz shatul al mayim veal yuval yeshallach shorashav velamma nikra shemo perat shemmemav parim veravim
Mesayya leh lishmuel deamar shemuel nahra mikkefeh mibrich ufliga derav deamar rav amme amar rav mitra bemareva sahada rabba perat

Avuh dishmuel aved lehu livnateh mikve beome nisan umappatze beome tishre mikve beome nisan savar lah kerav deamar rav amme amar rav mitra bemareva sahada rabba perat shemma yirbu notfin al hazzochalin vehau lehu me geshamim rubba
Umappatze beome tishre
Ufliga dideh addideh deamar shemuel en hammayim nitharim bezochalin ella perat beome tishre
Matni hallokeach o shennitan lo bemattana patur mimmasar behema
Gema mena hane mile amar rav kahana deamar kera bechor banecha titten li ken taase leshorcha letzonecha

a: Ma banecha en belakuach uvmattana af tzoncha uvkarcha eno belakuach uvmattana
Vehay bivchor ketiv amar kera ken taase im eno inyan livchor dela iteh baasiyya divrechem kadosh tenehu inyan lemasar behema
Veema tenehu inyan lechattat ulasham dumya devincha ma bincha sheeno ba al chet af tzoncha veshorcha sheeno ba al chet
Veema tenehu inyan leola velishlamim dumya devincha ma bincha sheeno ba beneder undava af tzoncha veshorcha ku
Veema tenehu inyan leolat reiyya dumya devincha ma bincha sheen kavua lo zeman af shorcha vetzoncha sheen kavua lo zeman
I ma bincha eno belakuach kelal af shorcha vetzoncha eno belakuach kelal allema amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan lakach asara ubbarin bime imman kullam nichnasin laddir lehitasser
Amar rava amar kera taase bishat asiyya miet hakkatuv
Gufa amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan lakach asara ubbarim bime imman kullan nichnasin laddir lehitasser veha anan tenan hallokeach o shennitan lo bemattana patur min masar behema
Amar rabbi elazar rabbi yochanan chazay bechelma milta mealleya amena amar kera taase bishat asiyya miet hakkatuv etiveh rabbi shimon ben elyakim lerabbi elazar hallakuach chal al mechussar zeman

Amar leh zo enah mishna veim timtza lomar mishna rabbi shimon ben yehuda hi mishshum rabbi shimon deamar mechussar zeman nichnas laddir lehitasser vahare hu kivchor ma bechor kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno af mechussar zeman kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno
Tane tanna kammeh derav ezehu etnan shennichnas laddir lehitasser kol shennetano lah vechazar ulkacho hemenna veha ipsil leh belokeach
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan lakach asara ubbarin bime imman kullam nichnasin laddir lehitasser
b: Vetiassereh ihi bezona goya
Velokmah bezona yisreelit vetiassereh ihi ka mashma lan dezona yisreelit la have etnan
Kidabbaye deamar abbaye zona goya etnannah asur vechohen habba aleha eno loke mishshum lo yechallel zaro zona yisreelit etnannah muttar vechohen habba aleha loke mishshum lo yechallel zaro
Zona goya etnannah asur gamar toeva toeva mearaot
Ma araot dela tafsi behu kiddushe af zona behach dela tafsi bah kiddushe
Vechohen habba aleha eno loke mishshum lo yechallel zaro delo yechallel zaro amar rachamana vehay lav zareh hu
Matni haachin vehashshuttafin shechayyavin bakkalbon peturin mimmasar behema chayyavin bemasar behema peturin min hakkalbon
Kanu mittefisat habbayit chayyavin veim lav peturin chalku chazru venishtattefu chayyavin bakkalbon ufturin mimmasar behema
Gema tanu rabbanan yihye lecha velo shel shuttafut yachol afilu kanu bitfisat habbayit talmud lomar yihye
Vehay bivchor ketiv im eno inyan livchor deha iteh beshuttafut dichtiv uvchorot bekarchem vetzonchem tenehu inyan lemasar behema
Amar rabbi yirmeya peamim shechayyavin baze uvaze ufamim sheppeturin mizze umizze peamim shechayyavin bakkalbon ufturin mimmasar behema ufamim shechayyavin bemasar behema ufturin min hakkalbon
Chayyavin baze uvaze shechalku bakkesafim velo chalku babbehema peturin mizze umizze shechalku babbehema velo chalku bakkesafim
Chayyavin bakkalbon ufturin mimmasar behema shechalku baze uvaze
Chayyavin bemasar behema ufturin min hakkalbon shello chalku beze uvaze
Peshita chalku babbehema velo chalku bakkesafim itztericha leh salka datach amena kevan dechalku babbehema gallo datayehu dilmiflag kayemi velichayevu bekalbon ka mashma lan
Amar rav anan lo shanu ella shechalku gedayim keneged teyashim utyashim keneged gedayim
Aval chalku gedayim keneged gedayim utyashim keneged teyashim omer ze chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach
Verav nachman amar afilu chalku gedayim keneged gedayim utyashim keneged teyashim en omrim ze hu chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach
Verabbi elazar amar lo shanu ella shechalku tisha keneged asara vaasara keneged tisha
Aval chalku tisha keneged tisha vaasara keneged asara omer ze chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu chalku tisha keneged tisha vaasara keneged asara en omer ze chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach

a: Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan haachin shechalku lakochot hen umachzirin ze laze bayyovel

Utzrichi dei ashmeinan hacha beha kaamar rabbi yochanan dumya devincha ma bincha bevarur lach af shorcha vetzoncha bevarur lach aval sade mecher hu deamar rachamana lehdar beovel yerushsha umattana la
Vei ashmeinan sade lechumra i name lechattechilla aval hacha ema la tzericha

Metivi vechen hashshuttafin shechalku echad natal asara veechad natal tisha vachelev shekkeneged hakkelev asurin sheim hakkelev muttarim veim amratte yesh berera livror chad minayehu levahade chelev velishkol vehanach lishtero
Amar rav ashe i deshau kullehu lahadade hachi name hacha bemay askinan dela shau kullehu lahadade veshave hay kalba chad umashshehu vehay mashshehu mashech veate bechullehu

Matni hakkol nichnasin laddir lehitasser chutz min kilayim utrefa veotze dofen umchussar zeman vehayyatom veezehu yatom kol shemmeta immah shennishchata veachar kach yalda rabbi yehoshua omer afilu nishchata immah vehashshelach kayyam en ze yatom
Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan shor o chesev perat lechilayim o ez perat lenidme ki yivaled perat leotze dofen vehaya shivat yamim perat limchussar zeman tachat immo perat leyatom

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer neemar kan tachat hashshavet veneemar lehallan tachat immo ma lehallan perat lechol hashshemot hallalu af kan perat lechol hashshemot hallalu uma kan perat litrefa af lehallan perat litrefa

Hakkol leetoye may leetoye ha detanu rabbanan harovea vehannirba vehammuktze vehanneevad vehaetnan vehamchir vetumtum veanderoginos kullan nichnasin laddir lehitasser rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon tumtum veanderoginos en nichnasin laddir lehitasser
Vetanna didan i gamar tachat tachat mikkodashim hane name la vei la yalef hane mena leh
Leolam gamar vehane rachamana rabbinhu dichtiv ki moshchatam bahem mum bam lo yeratzu lachem vetana deve rabbi yishmael kol makom shenneemar bo hashchata eno ella devar erva vaavoda zara
Devar erva dichtiv ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz avoda zara dichtiv pen tashchitun vaasitem lachem pesel temunat kol samel tavnit zachar o nekeva

Vechol shehammum posel bo devar erva vaavoda zara poslin bo vechol sheen hammum posel bo en devar erva vaavoda zara poslin bo vehay maaser hoil vela pasel beh muma dichtiv lo yevakker ben tov lara velo yemirennu devar erva vaavoda zara name la pasel beh
Rovea venirba devar erva muktze veneevad avoda zara veetnan devar erva umchir itakkash leetnan
Tumtum veanderoginos kasavar sefeka hu
Rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer kasavar sefeka hu miet rachamana gabbe kadashim zachar vadday unkeva vaddait velo tumtum veanderoginos maaser name gemar tachat tachat mikkodashim

Tanu rabbanan hakkol nichnasin laddir lehitasser chutz min hakkilayim vehatterefa divre rabbi elazar berabbi yehuda ish kefar bartota sheamar mishshum rabbi yehoshua amar rabbi akiva ani shamati hemennu af yotze dofen umchussar zeman veyatom
Vetanna kamma i gamar tachat tachat mikkodashim hane name la vei la gamar bishlama terefa kol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet ketiv perat litrefa sheenah overet ella kilayim mena leh
Leolam gamar uvotze dofen
b: Savar lah kerabbi shimon deamar yotze dofen valad mealleya hu udla kerabbi yochanan
Bimchussar zeman savar lah kerabbi shimon ben yehuda yatom kegon shehashshelach kayyam verabbi yehoshua letameh deamar afilu shachat et immo vehashshelach kayyam en ze yatom
Heid rabbi yishmael ben satriel mearkat livna lifne rabbi bimkomenu mafshitin et hammeta umalbishin et hachay amar rabbi nitgalla tamah shel mishnatenu
Chazerin shebbimkomenu yesh lahem shishshim ribbo kelafim bevet hemses shello paam achat nafal erez echad shebbimkomenu veavru shesh esre keronot al chuddo achat
Paam achat nafla betzat bar yochani vetibbea shishshim kerakkim veshibbera shelosh meot arazim umi shadya leh veha ketiv kenaf renanim neelasa amar rav ashe hahu muzarta havay
Matni shalosh goranot lemasar behema bifras happesach uvifras haatzeret uvifras hechag vehen goranot shel masar behema divre rabbi akiva

Ben azzay omer beesrim vetisha baadar beechad besivan beesrim vetisha beav rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim beechad benisan beechad besivan beesrim vetisha beelul velama amru beesrim vetisha beelul velo amru beechad betishri mippene shehu yom tov vei efshar leasser beom tov lefichach hikdimuhu beesrim vetisha beelul
Rabbi meir omer beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema ben azzay omer haelulim mitasserim bifne atzman

Kol hannoladim meechad betishri ad esrim vetisha beelul hare ellu mitztarfin chamishsha lifne rosh hashshana vachamishsha leachar rosh hashshana enan mitztarfin chamishsha lifne haggoren vachamishsha leachar haggoren hare ellu mitztarfin im ken lamma neemru shalosh goranot lemasar behema shead shello higgia haggoren muttar limkor velishchot higgia haggoren lo yishchot veim shachat patur
Gema may shena telat amar rabba bar shela lakovel churfe veafle vekayete
Umay shena behane zimne amar rabbi tanchum bereh derav chiyya ish kefar akko

a: Kede shettehe behema metzuya leole regalim
Veaf al gav ditnan ad shello higgia haggoren muttar limkor velishchot nicha leh delitavid mitzva bemamoneh vahadar lizbon velechol
Veammay kare leh goren detavla kegoren
Vechamma peras peresh rabbi yose berabbi yehuda en peras pachot mechamishsha asar yom

May mashma amar rabbi avahu peros palga palga demay palga dehilchot pesach ki ha detanya shoalin vedorshin behilchot pesach kodem lefesach sheloshim yom rabban shimon ben gamliel omer shette shabbatot

Ben azzay omer beesrim vetisha baadar beechad besivan bemay kamipalgi rabbi akiva uven azzay rabbi akiva savar adar hassamuch lenisan zimnin male vezimnin chaser zimnin demikla beom sheloshim vezimnin demikla beesrim vetisha umishshum hachi la kevia leh zeman uven azzay savar adar hassamuch lenisan leolam chaser hilkach kevia leh zeman beesrim vetisha baadar
Beechad besivan ayede dela nefishi i amratte likaddem liassar ad demate regel shalmi lehu
Beesrim vetisha beav vechu ben azzay letameh deamar haelulin mitasserin bifne atzman
Veliasserinhu beom sheloshim zimnin dimchasserin leh leav uvaenan lemibad hekkera bechadash veyashan
Rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim beechad benisan beechad besivan vechu beechad benisan kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar shette shabbatot beechad besivan kedaamaran
Beesrim vetisha beelul rabbi elazar verabbi shimon letamayehu deamri beechad betishri rosh hashshana lemasar behema
Velama amru beesrim vetisha beelul velo amru beechad betishri mippene shehu yom tov vechu vetipok leh devaenan lemebad hekkera bechadash veyashan
Chada veod kaamar chada devaenan lemibad hekkera bechadash veyashan veod mippene shehu yom tov vei efshar leasser beom tov mishshum sekarta
Rabbi meir omer beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema ben azzay omer vechu tanya amar ben azzay hoil vehallalu omrim kach vehallalu omrim kach haelulin mitasserin leatzman
Velichze tameh deman mistabbar vechi tema la matze kae attamayehu vehatanya ben azzay omer kol chachme yisrael domin alay kiklipat hashshum chutz min hakkereach hazze
Amar rabbi yochanan mippi hashshemua amaruha mippi chaggay zecharya umalachi

Tanya beeze tzad amar ben azzay haelulim mitasserin leatzman noldu lo chamishsha beav vachamishsha beelul en mitztarfin chamishsha beelul vachamishsha betishri en mitztarfin chamishsha betishri vachamishsha beav mitztarfin
Peshita mahu detema ki hechi demafseki shanim mafseki goranot ka mashma lan
Keditnan chamishsha lifne rosh hashshana vachamishsha leachar rosh hashshana en mitztarfin chamishsha lifne haggoren vachamishsha leachar haggoren hare ellu mitztarfin
Amar rava ledivre ben azzay noldu lo chamishsha beav vachamishsha beelul vachamishsha betishri konsan laddir lehitasser
b: Venotel echad min haelulin vehashshear peturin mimma nafshach i beechad beelul rosh hashshana deelul vetishri mitztarfin udav peturim vei beechad betishri rosh hashshana deav veelul mitztarfin detishri peturin
May amratte litztarfu legoren acher asiri vadday amar rachamana velo safek
Peshita mahu detema ligzor dilma ate lemishkal mehanach ka mashma lan

Matni bee ze tzad measserin konsan laddir veose lahem petach katan kede shello yehu shenayim yecholin latzet keechat umonin echad shenayim shelosha arbaa chamishsha shishsha shiva shemona tisha vehayyotze asiri soker besikra veomer hare ze maaser lo sekaro besikra velo menaan bashshevet o shemmenaan revutzim o omdim hare ellu mitasserin

Haya lo mea venatal asara asara venatal echad en ze maaser rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer maaser kafatz echad min hammenuyin letochan hare ellu peturin min hamussarin letochan kullam yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyeachlu bemuman labbealim
Gema tanu rabbanan bee ze tzad measser konsan laddir veose lahem petach katan kede shello yehu shenayim yecholin latzet keechad imotehem mibbachutz vehem mibbifnim vegoot veotzot likrat imman
Velappekinhu inhu yaavor ketiv velo sheyyaaviruhu
Velishde lehu yarka velipku levateh amar rav huna gezera mishshum lakuach umishshum yatom

Tanu rabbanan kol asher yaavor tachat perat latterefa sheenah overet tachat hashshavet mitzva limnotan beshevet lo menaan beshevet o shemmenaan revutzim o omdim minnayin talmud lomar haasiri kodesh mikkol makom

Veen li ella shekkera shemo asiri lo kera shemo asiri minnayin talmud lomar yihye kodesh mikkol makom yachol hau lo mea venatal asara asara venatal echad yachol yihu meussarin talmud lomar asiri veen ze asiri rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer maaser

May tameh derabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar leh keabba elazar ben gomel detanya abba elazar ben gomel omer venechshav lachem terumatchem bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber achat teruma gedola veachat terumat maaser
Keshem shehatteruma gedola nitelet beomed uvmachshava

a: Af terumat maaser nittelet beomed uvmachshava umaaser karyeh rachamana teruma dichtiv ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu la teruma natatti lalviyyim lenachala veitakkash masar behema lemaaser dagan ma masar dagan nital beomed uvmachshava af masar behema nital beomed uvmachshava
Amar rava asiri meelav hu kadosh mena leh lerava ha ilema meha detanya en li ella shekkara shemo asiri lo kara shemo asiri minnayin talmud lomar asiri yihye kodesh mikkol makom
Vedilma asiri hu dela karyeh kodesh karyeh ella meha detanya kara latteshii asiri veyatza haasiri velo dibber hatteshii neechal bemumo vehaasiri maaser
Vedilma shane hatam deibarar leh asiri i name deachvi ilaveh
Ella meha detanya kara latteshii asiri umet asiri baddir teshii neechal bemumo vechullam peturin may tama kullam peturin lav mishshum dikdash leh asiri
Vedilma deiptaru beminyan harauy dehaamar rava minyan harauy poter
Ella meha detanya kara latteshii asiri venishtayyer asiri baddir hatteshii neechal bemumo vehaasiri maaser vehatanya teshii chullin
Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet ha manni rabbi shimon ben yehuda hi detanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon
b: Af hatteshii eno kadosh ella im ken neekar shem asiri hemennu vehaddin noten
Uma achad asar shehu ose kedushsha likrav eno kadosh ella im ken neekar shem asiri hemennu teshii sheen ose kedushsha likrav eno din sheim neekar shem asiri hemennu in i la la
Hi hannotenet achad asar shehu ose kedushsha likrav i neekar shem asiri hemennu in i la la teshii sheeno ose kedushsha likrav af al gav dela neekar shem asiri hemennu
I name achad asar deibarar leh asiri i neekar shem asiri hemennu in i la la
Teshii deakkatti la ibarar leh asiri veaf al gav dela neekar shem asiri hemennu tu la midi
Amar rava minyan harauy poter mena leh lerava ha ilema meha ditnan kafatz echad min hammenuyin letochan kullan peturin menuyin gufayehu deiptaru lav beminyan harauy
Vedilma deassar ilavayehu
Hahi la matzet amratte ha tane min hamussarin letochan
Vedilma may meussarin maaser daveka dayeka name dekatane yiru
Ella amar rava amar kera yaavor velo shekkevar avar may shekkevar avar i deassar ilavayehu tzericha lememra ella lav deiptaru lehu beminyan harauy shema minah

Tanya kevateh derava hau lo asara telaim vehichnisan laddir umane chamishsha umet echad mehem im min hammenuyim met mone umashlim alehem veim mishsheenan menuyim met menuyim peturin vesheenan menuyim mitztarfin laggoren acher

Veamar rava hau lo arbaa asar telaim vehichnisan ledir veyatzu shishsha befetach ze vearbaa befetach ze vearbaa nishtayeru sham otam arbaa im befetach hashshishsha yatzu notel echad mehem vehashshear mitztarfin legoren acher
Veim lav shishsha peturin vearbaa arbea mitztarfin legoren acher

Yatzu arbaa befetach ze veshishsha befetach ze venishtayeru sham arbaa im otam arbaa befetach hashshishsha yatzu notel mehem echad vehashshear peturim veim lav arbaa veshishsha peturim vearbaa mitztarfin legoren acher

Yatzu arbaa befetach ze vearbaa befetach ze venishtayeru sham shishsha im otan shishsha yatzu befetach echad notel mehem echad vehashshear peturim veim lav arbaa peturim veshishsha mitztarfin legoren acher
May ka mashma lan deminyan harauy poter vehaamrah rava chada zimna mahu detema vadday minyan harauy amrinan sefek minyan harauy dachaze lehacha vedachaze lehacha la amrinan ka mashma lan

Veamar rava hau lo chamishsha asar telaim lo yomar evror asara veachnisem laddir veettol mehem echad vehashshear peturim ella konsan laddir umotzi asara venotel mehem echad vehashshear mitztarfin legoren acher tanya name hachi hau lo chamishsha asar telaim

a: Lo yomar evror asara veettol mehen echad vehashshear peturim ella konsan laddir umotzi asara venotel mehen echad vehashshear mitztarfin legoren acher
Vehatanya tisha asar telaim lo yomar evror asara veettol mehen echad vehashshear peturin ella konsan laddir umotzi asara venotel mehen echad vehashshear peturin
Targemah rav huna bar sechora kammeh derava berigla bedir sheyyesh lo shene fetachim askinan veyatzu tisha befetach ze vetisha befetach ze dehayeche chad chaze lehacha ulhacha
Velishanne leh kegon shemmana tisha vechi meta asara kare chad meresha kasavar asiri meelav kadosh
Velishanne leh begoren umnaan zugot zugot kasavar asiri leminyan behemot hu kadosh
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak zechay imeh derav huna bar sechora deshanni leh shemata berigla kishmateh
Matni yatzu shenayim keachat mone otam shenayim shenayim menaan echad teshii vaasiri mekulkalin
Kara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri shelashtan mekuddashin hatteshii neechal bemumo vehaasiri maaser veachad asar karev shelamim veose temura divre rabbi meir

Amar rabbi yehuda vechi yesh temura osa temura amru mishshum rabbi meir ilu haya temura lo haya karev kara latteshii asiri velaasiri asiri velaachad asar asiri en achad asar mekuddash ze hakkelal kol shello neekar shem asiri mimmennu en achad asar mekuddash
Gema amar rabbi yochanan menaan zugot zugot kintarin kintarin asiri leminyano hu kadosh
Leminyano may rav mari amar lamminyan shello hu kadosh rav kahana amar leminyan behemot hu kadosh
Tenan yatzu shenayim keachat mone otan shenayim shenayim menaan echad teshii vaasiri mekulkalin

Bishlama leman deamar lamminyan shello hu kadosh mishshum hachi hau teshii vaasiri mekulkalin velaasiri ka kare leh teshii velaachad asar asiri ella leman deamar leminyan behemot hu kadosh latteshii teshii ka kare leh velaasiri asiri ka kare leh
Amar lach rabbi yochanan ki amena ana hechi deikaven leappoke zugot zugot hecha dinfak mimmela la
Ta shema menaan lemafrea asiri shebbeminyan hu kadosh bishlama leman deamar leminyan behemot hu kadosh shappir ella leman deamar lamminyan shello hu kadosh asiri chad kare leh
Amar rava hoil veiteh beminyana parsaa dekaru leasra chad
b: Kara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri tanu rabbanan minnayin sheim kara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri sheshshelashtan mekuddashin
Talmud lomar vechol masar bakar vatzon kol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet haasiri yihye kodesh yachol sheani merabbe af shemini ushnem asar
Amratte hoil vehu kadosh vetauto mitkaddeshet ma hu eno mekuddash ella besamuch af tauto enah mitkaddeshet ella besamuch
Vehatanya ma hu meuchad af tauto meuchedet

Tane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan ha manni rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi detanya rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer leolam en achad asar kadosh ad sheyyishtok batteshii veyikra laasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri
Savar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar taut maaser temura have vesavar lah kaavuh deamar en memer chozer umemer
Amar rava yatzu shenayim batteshii keraan teshii asiri vechullin meoravin ze baze asiri meelav kadosh latteshii teshii ka kare leh
Keraan asiri asiri utshii meoravin ze baze may tama asiri ka kare lehu letarvayehu
Yatzu shenayim baasiri ukraan asiri asiri veachad asar meoravin ze baze keraan achad asar asiri vechullin meoravin ze baze
Ha tu lema li hayenu hach ha ka mashma lan dechol bat achat tarvayehu ka kadshi veaf al gav delo neekar shem asiri hemennu

Yatev rav kahana vekaamar leh leha shemata amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana vahalo lo neekar shem asiri hemennu utnan ze hakkelal kol zeman shello neekar shem asiri hemennu en achad asar mekuddash hane mile beze achar ze aval bevat achat tarvayehu ka kadshi
Ze achar ze behedya katane lah kara latteshii asiri velaasiri asiri velaachad asar asiri en achad asar mekuddash ze hakkelal leetoye may lav leetoye bevat achat
La leetoye yatza asiri velo dibber deha lo neekar shem asiri hemennu

Dei la tema hachi ha detanya yatzu shenayim baasiri velo kadam echad mehen et chavero ukraan asiri asiri veachad asar meoravin ze baze vahalo lo neekar shem asiri hemennu ella lav mishshum deamrinan kol bevat achat tarvayehu ka kadshi
I mishshum ha la irya hacha bemay askinan dikdem chad minayehu veappek leresheh vekaryeh achad asar vahadar iaruv unfuk bahadade ukrinhu asiri deha neekar shem asiri hemennu
Veha lo kadam katane may lo kadam dahadar iaruv
Uchman dela kerabbi dei rabbi haamar achad asar la have akira
Afilu tema rabbi ki amar rabbi hecha deit leh behemot tuva deamrinan chad isura kaamar hacha delet leh behemot tefe

May rabbi detanya kara laasiri achad asar velaachad asar asiri en achad asar kadosh divre rabbi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer achad asar kadosh kelal amar rabbi kol zeman shello neekar shem asiri hemennu en achad asar kadosh amar rava hacha bemay askinan kegon deit leh behemot tuva deamrinan chad isura kaamar
Yatzu shenayim baasiri tane chada yiru vetanya idach yikrevu vetanya idach yamutu
La kashya ha detanya yiru rabbanan hi deamri en meviin kadashim levet happesul

a: Veha detane yikrevu rabbi shimon hi deamar meviin kadashim levet happesul
Veha detane yamutu rabbi yehuda hi deamar taut maaser temura haveya kasavar rabbi yehuda temurat maaser meta
Vekasavar rabbi yehuda temurat maaser meta vehatnan amru mishshum rabbi meir ilu haya temura lo haya karev mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar karev

Vechi tema rabbi meir lemay disvira leh kaamar vehatanya en ben achad asar lishlamim ella shezze ose kedushsha likrav veze en ose kedushsha likrav divre rabbi yehuda kadosh likrav hu dela hu aved ha ihu gufeh karev
Veod detanya im min habbakar lerabbot achad asar lishlamim
Yachol sheani merabbe af hatteshii amarta vechi hekdesh lefanav mekaddesh o leacharav mekaddesh heve omer leacharav mekaddesh
Setam sifra manni rabbi yehuda vekatane min habbakar lerabbot achad asar lishlamim
Ella targemah rabbi shimon berabbi abba kammeh derabbi yochanan bemaaser bizman hazze askinan umishshum takkala
I hachi may irya tere afilu chad name la mibaya kaamar la mibaya chad delet leh peseda aval tere kevan dinfishi peseda lishahinhu ad denipol behu muma velechlinhu ka mashma lan

Itmar haomer lishlucho tze veasser alay rav pappi mishshemeh derava amar kara latteshii asiri kadosh velaachad asar asiri eno kadosh verav pappa amar afilu kara latteshii asiri eno kadosh deamar leh letakkone shaddartacha vela leauote
Umay shena meha ditnan haomer lishlucho tze utrom torem kedaat baal habbayit
Im eno yodea dato shel baal habbayit torem bevenonit echad mechamishshim pichet asara o hosif asara terumato teruma
Amri hatam kevan deika detarem beayin yafa veika detarem beayin raa amar lehachi amadtich hacha tauta hi amar la ibi lach lemite
Hadaran alach masar behema uslika lah massechet bechorot
Matni hakkol maarichin veneerachin nodrin venidarin kohanim lovim veyisreelim nashim vaavadim
Tumtum veanderoginos nodrin venidarin umaarichin aval lo neerachin sheeno neerach ella hazzachar vadday unkeva vaddait
Cheresh shote vekatan nidarin veneerachin aval lo nodrin velo maarichin mippene sheen bahem daat
Gema hakkol maarichin leetoye may leetoye mufla samuch leish
Neerachin leetoye may leetoye menval umukke shechin
Salka datach amena neder beerkecha ketiv kol sheyyeshno bedamim yeshno baarachin vechol sheeno bedamim eno baarachin
Ka mashma lan nefashot kal dehu
Nodrin leetoye may nidarin itzterich leh
Nidarin leetoye may i leetoye tumtum veanderoginos behedya katane lehu vei leetoye cheresh shote vekatan behedya katane lehu
I leetoye pachot mibben chodesh behedya katane lehu vei leetoye nachri behedya katane lehu leolam leetoye pachot mibben chodesh vetane vahadar mefaresh
Hakkol somchin leetoye may leetoye yoresh udla kerabbi yehuda
Hakkol memirin leetoye may leetoye yoresh udla kerabbi yehuda
Detanya yoresh somech yoresh memer rabbi yehuda omer yoresh eno somech yoresh eno memer
May tama derabbi yehuda korbano velo korban aviv veyalef techillat hekdesh missof hekdesh ma sof hekdesh yoresh eno somech af techillat hekdesh yoresh eno memer
Verabbanan hamer yamir lerabbot et hayyoresh veyalfinan sof hekdesh mittechillat hekdesh ma techillat hekdesh yoresh memer af sof hekdesh yoresh somech
Verabbanan hay korbano may avdi leh mibe leh korbano velo korban goy korbano velo korban chavero korbano lerabbot kol baale chovrin lismicha
Verabbi yehuda lerabbot kol baale chovrin lismicha let leh vei name it leh
b: Goy vachavero mechad kera nafki iyyatari lehu tere chad korbano velo korban aviv veidach lerabbot kol baale chovrin lismicha
Verabbi yehuda hay hamer yamir may aved leh mibe leh lerabbot et haishsha detanya lefi shekkol hainyan eno medabber ella bilshon zachar ma sofenu lerabbot et haishsha talmud lomar veim hamer yamir
Verabbanan mivveim verabbi yehuda veim la daresh
Hakkol chayyavin besukka leetoye may leetoye katan sheeno tzarich leimmo ditnan katan sheeno tzarich leimmo chayyav besukka
Hakkol chayyavin belulav leetoye may leetoye katan hayyodea lenanea ditnan katan hayyodea lenanea chayyav belulav
Hakkol chayyavin betzitzit leetoye may leetoye katan hayyodea lehitattef detanya katan hayyodea lehitattef chayyav betzitzit
Hakkol chayyavin bitfilin leetoye may leetoye katan hayyodea lishmor tefillin detanya katan hayyodea lishmor tefillin aviv lokeach lo tefillin
Hakkol chayyavin biriyya leetoye may leetoye mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin
Ulravina deamar mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin patur min hariyya leetoye chiger beom rishon venitpashshet beom sheni
Hanicha leman deamar kullan tashlumin ze laze ella leman deamar kullan tashlumin larishon leetoye may
Leetoye suma beachat meenav udla ki hay tanna
Detanya yochanan ben dahavay omer mishshum rabbi yehuda suma beachat meenav patur min hariyya shenneemar yire yerae kederech shebba lirot kach ba leraot ma lirot bishte enav af leraot bishte enav
Veibaet ema leolam leetoye mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin udka kashya lach deravina la kashya kan bemishna rishona kan bemishna acharona
Ditnan mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin oved et rabbo yom echad veet atzmo yom echad divre bet hillel

Amru lahem bet shammay tikantem et rabbo veet atzmo lo tikantem lisa shifcha eno yachol bat chorin eno yachol yibbatel vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya urviyya shenneemar lo tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah
Ella mippene tikun haolam kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin vechotev shetar al chatzi damav vechazru bet hillel lehorot kedivre bet shammay
Hakkol chayyavin bitkiat shofar leetoye may leetoye katan shehiggia lechinuch ditnan en meakkevin et hakkatan millitkoa beom tov
Hakkol chayyavin bemikra megila hakkol kesherin likrot et hammegila leetoye

a: May leetoye nashim vechidrabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi nashim chayyavot bemikra megila sheaf hen hau beoto hannes
Hakkol chayyavin bezimun leetoye may leetoye nashim vaavadim detanya nashim mezammenot leatzman vaavadim mezammenin leatzman
Hakkol mitztarfin lezimun leetoye may leetoye katan hayyodea lemi mevarchin deamar rav nachman yodea lemi mevarchin mezammenin alav
Hakkol mittammein beziva leetoye may leetoye tinok ben yomo detanya ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot tinok ben yom echad shemtamme beziva divre rabbi yehuda

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer eno tzarich hare hu omer vehazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva lazzachar kol shehu zachar ben katan ben gadol lannekeva kol shehi nekeva ben ketanna ben gedola im ken ma talmud lomar ish ish dibbera tora chilshon bene adam
Hakkol mittammein bitme met leetoye may leetoye katan salka datach amena ish asher yitma velo yitchatta ish in katan la ka mashma lan veal hannefashot asher hau sham
Ella ish lemaote may lemaote katan mikkaret
Hakkol mittammein bingaim leetoye may leetoye katan salka datach amena ish tzarua ketiv ish in katan la ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name adam ki yihye veor besaro mikkol makom
Veella ish lema li lechidtanya ish en li ella ish ishsha minnayin keshehu omer vehatztzarua hare kan shenayim
Im ken ma talmud lomar ish lainyan shel matta ish porea uforem veen haishsha poraat uforemet
Hakkol roin et hannegaim hakkol kesherin lirot et hannegaim leetoye may leetoye sheeno baki bahen uvishmotehen
Vehaamar mar eno baki bahen uvishmotehen eno roe et hannegaim amar ravina la kashya ha demasberi leh vesavar ha demasberi leh vela savar

Hakkol kesherin lekaddesh leetoye may lerabbi yehuda leetoye katan ulrabbanan leetoye ishsha ditnan hakkol kesherin lekaddesh chutz mecheresh shote vekatan rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan ufosel beishsha uvanderoginos
Hakkol kesherin lehazzot leetoye may leetoye arel vechidrabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar arel shehizza hazzaato keshera
Hakkol shochatin leetoye may chada leetoye kuti vachada leetoye yisrael meshummad
Hakkol maalin leeretz yisrael leetoye may
b: Leetoye avadim ulman detane avadim behedya leetoye may leetoye minnave hayyafa lenave haraa
Veen hakkol motziin leetoye eved shebbarach mechutza laaretz laaretz
Hakkol maalin lirushalayim leetoye minnave hayyafa lenave haraa veen hakkol motziin leetoye may leetoye minnave haraa lenave hayyafa
Hakkol chayyavin besukka kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim peshita i hane la michayevi man michayevi

Kohanim itztericha leh salka datach amena hoil uchtiv bassukkot teshvu veamar mar teshvu shivat yamim keen taduru ma dira ish veishto af sukka ish veishto vehane kohanim hoil uvne avoda ninhu la lichayevu
Ka mashma lan nehi diftiri bishat avoda belo sheat avoda chayyove michayevi mide dehave aholche derachim deamar mar holche derachim bayyom peturin min hassukka bayyom vechayyavim ballayela
Hakkol chayyavin betzitzit kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim peshita

Kohanim itzterich leh salka datach amena hoil uchtiv lo tilbash shaatnez gedilim taase lach man dela ishteri kilayim legabbeh bilvisha hu dimchayyav bemitzvat tzitzit vehane kohanim hoil veishteri kilayim legabbayehu la lichayevu
Ka mashma lan nehi deishteri beidan avoda bela idan avoda la ishteri

Hakkol chayyavin bitfilin kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim peshita kohanim itzterich leh salka datach amena hoil uchtiv ukshartam leot al yadecha vehau letotafot ben enecha kol deiteh bemitzva deyad iteh bemitzva derosh
Vehane kohanim hoil veletanhu bemitzva deyad dichtiv yilbash al besaro shello yehe davar chotzetz beno uven besaro ema bemitzva derosh name la lichayevu
Ka mashma lan dela meakkevi ahadade keditnan tefilla shel yad enah meakkevet shel rosh veshel rosh enah meakkevet shel yad
Umay shena deyad dichtiv yilbash al besaro rosh name ketiv vesamta hammitznefet al rosho
Tana searo haya nire ben tzitz lemitznefet sheshsham manniach tefilin
Hakkol chayyavin bitkiat shofar kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim peshita kohanim itztericha leh salka datach amena hoil uchtiv yom terua yihye lachem man deleteh ella bitkia dechad yoma chayyav
Vehane kohanim hoil veitanhu bitkia kullah shatta dichtiv utkatem bachatzotzrot al olotechem ema la lichayevu mi dame hatam chatzotzrot hacha shofar

Itzterich salka datach amena hoil utnan shave hayyovel lerosh hashshana lattekia velabberachot deiteh bemitzvat yovel iteh bemitzvat rosh hashshana deleteh bemitzvat yovel leteh bemitzvat rosh hashshana vehane kahane hoil veletanhu bemitzvat deovel ditnan kohanim ulviyyim mochrin leolam

a: Vegoalin leolam ema bemitzvat rosh hashshana name la lichayevu kamashma lan nehi deletanhu behashmatat karka behashmatat kesafim beshiluach avadim miha itanhu

Hakkol chayyavim bemikra megila kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim peshita la tzericha livattel avodatam vechidrav yehuda amar shemuel deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel kohanim baavodatam ulviyyim beduchanan veyisrael bemaamadan mevattelin avodatam uvain lishmoa mikra megila
Hakkol chayyavin bezimun kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim peshita la tzericha dekaachli kodashim salka datach amena veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem amar rachamana veha kappara hi
Ka mashma lan veachalta vesavata amar rachamana veha itanhu
Hakkol mitztarfin lezimun kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim peshita la tzericha dekaachli kohanim teruma o kodashim vezar kaachel chullin
Salka datach amena hoil vei bae zar lemechal bahade kohen la matze achel ema la litztaref ka mashma lan nehi dezar bahade kohen la matze achel kohen bahade zar matze achel
Hakkol maarichin kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim peshita amar rava lo nitzrecha ella leven buchri ditnan amar rabbi yehuda heid ben buchri beyavne kol kohen sheshshokel eno chote
Amar lo rabban yochanan ben zakkay lo ken ella kol kohen sheeno shokel chote ella shehakkohanim dorshin mikra ze leatzman vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel
Hoil veomer ushte hallechem velechem happanim shellanu hem heach hem neechalin
Ulven buchri name kevan dilchattechila la michayevi leetoye ki mayete name chote hu deka meayyel chullin laazara demayete lehu umasar latztzibbur
Salka datach amena hoil uchtiv vechol erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh kol deiteh bishkalim iteh baarachin vehane kohanim hoil veletanhu bishkalim letanhu baarachin ka mashma lan
Amar leh abbaye hay vechol erkecha lechol arachin sheatta maarich lo yehu pechutin missela hu daata

Ella amar abbaye itzterich salka datach amena hoil uchtiv ufduyav mibben chodesh tifde beerkecha kol deiteh befidon habben iteh baarachin vehane kohanim hoil veletanhu befidon habben letanhu baarachin ka mashma lan

Amar leh rava ella meatta gabbe el asham dichtiv veet ashamo yavi la ayil tamim min hatztzon beerkecha hachi name dechol deiteh baarachin iteh beel haasham tumtum veanderoginos deletanhu baarachin letanhu beel haasham
Ella amar rava veitema rav ashe itzterich salka datach amena hoil uchtiv veheemido lifne hakkohen velo kohen lifne kohen ka mashma lan
Neerachin leetoye menval umukke shechin mena hane mile
Detanu rabbanan beerkecha lehavi erech satum davar acher beerkecha erech kullo hu noten velo erech evarim
Yachol sheani motzi af davar shehanneshama teluya bo talmud lomar nefashot nefashot velo hammet
Otzi et hammet velo otzi et haggoses talmud lomar veheemid veheerich kol sheyyeshno behaamada yeshno behaaracha vechol sheeno behaamada eno behaaracha
Davar acher nefashot en li ella echad sheheerich echad echad sheheerich mea minnayin talmud lomar nefashot davar acher nefashot
b: En li ella ish sheheerich ben ish ben ishsha ishsha sheheericha ish ishsha sheheericha ishsha minnayin talmud lomar nefashot
Davar acher nefashot lerabbot menval umukke shechin
Sheyyachol neder beerkecha kol sheyyeshno bedamim yeshno baarachin vechol sheeno bedamim eno baarachin talmud lomar nefashot
Vehaya erkecha lerabbot tumtum veanderoginos ledamim sheyyachol neder beerkecha kol sheyyeshno baarachin yeshno bedamim vechol sheeno baarachin eno bedamim talmud lomar vehaya erkecha

Hazzachar zachar velo tumtum veanderoginos yachol lo yehu beerech ish aval yihu beerech ishsha talmud lomar vehaya erkecha hazzachar veim nekeva hi zachar vadday nekeva vaddait velo tumtum veanderoginos
Amar mar beerkecha lerabbot erech satum may erech satum
Detanya haomer erech satum alay noten kappachot shebbaarachin vechamma pachot shebbaarachin sheloshet shekalim
Veema chamishshim tafasta merubbe lo tafasta tafasta muat tafasta
Veema shekel dichtiv vechol erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh hahu behesseg yad hu dichtiv
Veella kara lema li amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lomar sheeno nidon behesseg yad may tama kimfaresh dame
Ika deamri amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh nidon behesseg yad peshita mahu detema kimfaresh dame kamashma lan
Davar acher beerkecha erech kullo hu noten veeno noten erech deme evarim veha appekteh leerech setam keri beh erech beerkecha
Yachol sheani motzi davar shehanneshama teluya bo talmud lomar nefashot nefashot velo et hammet
Veha appekteh keri beh nefesh nefashot
Otzi et hammet velo otzi et haggoses talmud lomar vehaamid veheerich
I hachi met name tipok li mivveheemid veheerich hachi name veella nefesh nefashot lema li kidvaenan lememar kamman
Davar acher nefashot en li ella echad sheheerich echad echad sheheerich mea minnayin talmud lomar nefashot
Davar acher nefashot en li ella ish sheheerich ben ish ben ishsha ishsha sheheericha ish veishsha sheheericha ishsha minnayin talmud lomar nefashot
Davar acher nefashot lehavi menval umukke shechin veha appekteh lehanach
Hanach la tzerichi kera may tama ki shakul hu veyavou kullam ki itzterich kera limnval umukke shechin hu deitzterich
Vehaya erkecha lerabbot tumtum veanderoginos ledamim damim lema li kera lo yehe ella deme dikla ilu amar deme dikla mi la yahev
Amar rava lomar shennidon bichvodo
Salka datach amena neder beerkecha ketiv kol sheyyeshno baarachin nidon bichvodo vechol sheeno baarachin eno nidon bichvodo

Amar leh abbaye udla iteh baarachin mi nidon bichvodo vehatanya rosh eved ze hekdesh hu vehekdesh shuttafin bo rosh eved machur lecha meshammenin benehem rosh chamor ze hekdesh hu vehekdesh shuttafin bo rosh chamor machur lach meshammenin benehem
Rosh para machur lecha lo machar ella roshah shel para velo od ella afilu rosh para hekdesh en lahekdesh ella roshah veamar rav pappa deha mizdabban resha detora beve tabbacha
Veha chamor ufara letanhu baarachin veen nidon bichvodo velitamach tikshe lach eved deiteh baarachin veen nidon bichvodo
Ella la kashya ha bekodshe mizbeach ha bekodshe bedek habbayit
Bemay okemtah bekodshe mizbach ema sefa velo od ella afilu amar rosh para zo hekdesh en lahekdesh ella roshah ammay tifshot kedushsha bechullah mi la tanya haomer

a: Raglah shel zo ola yachol tehe kullah ola talmud lomar kol asher yitten mimmennu la yihye kodesh mimmennu kodesh velo kullah kodesh
Yachol tetze lechullin talmud lomar yihye bahavayatah tehe ha ketzad timmacher letzorche olot vedameha chullin chutz middeme oto ever shebbah divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim minnayin laomer raglah shel zo ola shekkullah ola talmud lomar kol asher yitten mimmennu la yihye kodesh lerabbot et kullah
Vaafilu leman deamar en kullah ola hane mile deakdesh davar sheen hanneshama teluya bo aval davar shehanneshama teluya bo kadsha kullah
Ella la kashya ha bikdushshat hagguf ha bikdushshat damim
Veha mar hu deamar makdish zachar ledamav kadosh kedushshat hagguf
La kashya ha deakdesh kullah ha deakdesh chad ever
Chad ever name iboye ibaya lan devae rabba hikdish ever ledamav mahu
Ki ibi lan betam hacha bevaal mum dumya dachamor
Baal mum name iboye ibaya lan devae rabba deme roshi legabbe mizbeach mahu ki ibbaya lan mikkamme deeshmeah leha matnita hashta deshamah ha matnita la mibaya lan
Gufa bae rabba deme roshi legabbe mizbeach mahu nidon bichvodo o eno nidon bichvodo
La ashkechan bedamim deeno nidon bichvodo o dilma la ashkechan legabbe mizbeach denidon bichvodo teku
Bae rava erki alay legabbe mizbeach mahu nidon behesseg yad o en nidon behesseg yad
La ashkechan baarachin deen nidon behesseg yad o dilma la ashkechan legabbe mizbeach demiprik ella beshoveo teku

Bae rav ashe hikdish sede achuzza legabbe mizbeach mahu mi amrinan la ashkechan sede achuzza demiparka ella bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef o dilma la ashkechan legabbe mizbeach demiprik ella beshoveo teku
Matni pachot mibben chodesh nidar aval lo neerach
Gema tanu rabbanan hammaarich pachot mibben chodesh rabbi meir omer noten damav vachachamim omrim lo amar kelum
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi meir savar en adam motzi devarav levattala yodea sheen arachin lefachot mibben chodesh vegamar veamar leshem damim verabbanan savri adam motzi devarav levattala
Keman azla ha deamar rav gidel amar rav haomer erech keli alay noten damim kerabbi meir peshita dichrabbi meir atya
Mahu detema afilu kerabbanan hatam hu detae savar ki hechi deika arachin leven chodesh ika name lefachot mibben chodesh
Aval hacha deleka lemite vadday adam yodea sheen erech lichli vegamar veamar leshem damim kamashma lan
b: Ulrabbi meir lemay itzterich

Mahu detema tama derabbi meir hatam degazar pachot mibben chodesh attu ben chodesh aval hacha deleka lemigzar ema la ka mashma lan tama derabbi meir deen adam motzi devarav levattala la shena hacha vela shena hacha
Keman azla ha deamar rabba bar yosef amar rav veamri lah amar rav yeva bar yose amar rav hammakdish behemat chavero noten dameha keman kerabbi meir
Ha amrah rav chada zimna deamar rav gidel amar rav haomer erech keli alay noten damav mahu detema hatam hu deodea sheen erech lichli vegamar veamar leshem damim
Aval behema devat mikdash hi ika lememar dehachi kaamar i amena leh lemarrah mezabben lah nihali tikdosh lah mehashta veakrevah aval deme la kaamar ka mashma lan
Amar rav ashe vehu deamar alay aval amar hare zo lo
Matni nachri rabbi meir omer neerach aval lo maarich rabbi yehuda omer maarich aval lo neerach veze vaze modim shennodrin venidarin
Gema tanu rabbanan bene yisrael maarichin veen haggoyim maarichin
Yachol lo yehu neerachin talmud lomar ish divre rabbi meir
Amar rabbi meir vechi meachar shemmikra echad merabbe umikra echad memaet mippene ma ani omer neerach velo maarich
Mippene sheriba hakkatuv banneerachin yoter mibbammaarichin shehare cheresh shote vekatan neerach aval lo maarichin
Rabbi yehuda omer bene yisrael neerachin veen haggoyim neerachin yachol lo yehu maarichin talmud lomar ish

Amar rabbi yehuda vechi meachar shemmikra echad merabbe umikra echad memaet mippene ma ani omer nachri maarich velo neerach mippene sheriba hakkatuv bammaarichin yoter mibbannerachin shehare tumtum veanderoginos maarichin aval lo neerachin
Amar rava hilcheteh derabbi meir mistabbera tameh la mistabbera tama derabbi yehuda mistabbera hilcheteh la mistabbera
Hilcheteh derabbi meir mistabbera dichtiv lo lachem valanu livnot et bet elohenu tameh la mistabbera deka mayete leh mecheresh shote vekatan shane cheresh shote vekatan delav bene dea ninhu
Tama derabbi yehuda mistabbera deka mayete leh mittumtum veanderoginos deaf al gav divne dea ninhu maatinhu rachamana hilcheteh la mistabbera dichtiv lo lachem valanu livnot et bet elohenu
Verabbi yehuda hay la lachem velanu may aved leh amar rav chisda amar avimi veerko nignaz
Ella meatta lo yimalu bo ditnan chamesh chattaot hammetot umaot haholchot leyam hammelach lo nehenin velo moalin
Allema tanya gabbe kodshe goyim bamme devarim amurim bekodshe mizbeach aval bekodshe bedek habbayit moalin bahen
Ella amar rava mishshum rifon yadayim hu dichtiv vayehi am haaretz merappin yede am yehuda umvahalim otam livnot

a: Tana chada goy shehitnaddev nedava levedek habbayit mekabbelim hemennu vetanya idach en mekabbelin
Amar rabbi ila amar rabbi yochanan la kashya ha battechila ha bassof

Deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan bitchila afilu mayim umelach en mekabbelin mehem bassof davar hamsuyyam en mekabbelin davar sheeno mesuyyam mekabbelin hechi dame davar hamsuyyam amar rav yosef kegon amma kalya orev
Metiv rav yosef veigeret el asaf shomer happardes asher lammelech vego amar leh abbayye shane malchuta dela hadra bah deamar shemuel i amar malchuta akarna ture akar ture vela hadar beh
Amar rav yehuda amar rav goy shehifrish teruma mikkiro bodkin oto i bedaat yisrael hifrishah tinaten lakkohen veim lav teuna geniza chayeshinan shemma belibbo lashshamayim
Metivi goy shehitnaddev kora veshem katuv aleha bodkin oto im amar bedaat yisrael hifrashtiha yagod veyishtammesh bammotar veim lav teuna geniza chayeshinan shemma belibbo lashshamayim
Tama deshem katuv aleha devaaya geniza ha en shem katuv aleha la baaya geniza
Hu haddin deaf al gav deen shem katuv aleha name baaya geniza veha ka mashma lan deaf al gav deshem katuv aleha yagod veyishtammesh bammotar deshem shello bimkomo lav kadosh
Ditnan haya katuv al yedot hakkelim veal kare hammitta hare ze yagod veyignoz
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avahu haomer sela zo litzdaka muttar leshannotah sevur minah leatzmo in leacher la itmar amar rav amme amar rabbi yochanan ben leatzmo ben leacher
Amar rabbi zeera lo shanu ella deamar alay aval amar hare zo beena bae lemitvah
Matkef lah rava adderabba ipcha mistabbera amar zo mishtammesh bah ki hechi delichayyav beachrautah aval amar alay la ella la shena
Tanya kevateh derava neder tzedaka veen hekdesh tzedaka may kaamar la neder vela hekdesh tzedaka
Ella lav hachi kaamar tzedaka hare hi beval teacher veenah kehekdesh deilu hekdesh asir leishtammoshe beh veilu tzedaka shere leishtammoshe beh

Amar rav kahana amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea amar attun hachi matnitu lah anan hachi matnenan lah amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh amar rav haomer sela zo litzdaka muttar leshannotah ben leatzmo ben leacher ben amar alay ben amar hare zo
Tanu rabbanan sela zo litzdaka ad shello bata leyad gabbay muttar leshannotah mishshebbata leyad gabbay asur leshannotah
b: Ini veha rabbi yannay yazef ufara shane rabbi yannay denicha lehu laaniyyim dechamma dimshahe measse umayete lehu

Tanu rabbanan yisrael shehitnaddev menora o ner levet hakkeneset asur leshannotah savar rabbi chiyya bar abba lememar la shena lidvar harshut vela shena lidvar mitzva amar leh rav amme hachi amar rabbi yochanan lo shanu ella lidvar harshut aval lidvar mitzva muttar leshannotah
Middeamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan goy shehitnaddev menora o ner levet hakkeneset ad shello nishtakka shem bealeha asur leshannotah mishshennishtakka shem bealeha muttar leshannotah
Lemay ilema lidvar harshut may irya goy afilu yisrael name
Ella lidvar mitzva vetama degoy hu defae aval yisrael dela pae shappir dame

Shaazrak tayyaa inaddav sheraga leve chenishta derav yehuda shanneyeh rachava veikfed rava ika deamri shanneyeh rava veikfed rachava veika deamri shanneyuh chazzane defumbedita veikfed rachava veikfed rabba
Man deshanneyeh savar dela shechiach uman deikfed savar zimnin demikkere veate
Matni haggoses vehayyotze lehareg lo nidar velo neerach rabbi chanina ben akavya omer neerach mippene sheddamav ketzuvin rabbi yose omer noder umaarich umakdish veim hizzik chayyav
Gema bishlama goses lo nidar delav bar damim hu velo neerach delav bar haamada vehaaracha hu ella yotze lehareg bishlama lo nidar delav bar damim hu ella lo neerach ammay la
Detanya minnayin hayyotze lehareg veamar erki alay shello amar kelum talmud lomar kol cherem lo yippade yachol afilu kodem shennigmar dino talmud lomar min haadam velo kol haadam
Ulrabbi chanina ben akavya deamar neerach mippene sheddamav ketzuvin hay kol cherem may aved leh

Lechidtanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer lefi shemmatzinu lammumatim bide shamayim shennotnin mamon umitkapper lahem shenneemar im kofer yushat alav yachol af bide adam ken talmud lomar kol cherem lo yippade
En li ella mitot chamurot shello nitna shiggatan lechappara mitot kallot shennitna shiggatan lechappara minnayin talmud lomar kol cherem
Rabbi yose omer noder umaarich ku vetanna kamma mi kaamar dela
Ella benoder umaarich umikkaddish kulle alma la peligi ki feligi beim hizzik tanna kamma savar im hizzik eno chayyav betashlumin verabbi yose savar im hizzik chayyav betashlumin
Bemay kamipalgi amar rav yosef bemilva al pe gove min hayyorshin kamipalgi tanna kamma savar milva al pe eno gove min hayyorshin verabbi yose savar milva al pe gove min hayyorshin

Rava amar dechulle alma milva al pe eno gove min hayyorshin vehacha bemilva ketuva battora kamipalgi tanna kamma savar milva ketuva battora lav kichtuva bishtar damya verabbi yose savar kichtuva bishtar damya
Veika dematne lah aha hayyotze lehareg hu shechaval baacherim chayyav acherim shechavlu bo peturin rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af hu im chaval baacherim patur shello nitan lachazarat amidat bet din

a: Mikkelal detanna kamma savar nitan lachazarat amidat bet din
Amar rav yosef bemilva al pe gove min hayyorshin kamipalgi tanna kamma savar milva al pe gove min hayyorshin verabbi shimon ben elazar savar eno gove min hayyorshin

Rabba amar dechulle alma milva al pe eno gove min hayyorshin vehacha bemilva hakketuva battora kichtuva bishtar kamipalgi tanna kamma savar kichtuva bishtar damya verabbi shimon ben elazar savar lav kichtuva bishtar damya
Metivi hachofer bor birshut harabbim venafal alav shor vaharago patur velo od ella sheim met hashshor yorshe baal habbor chayyavin leshallem deme shor livalav
Amar rabbi ila amar rav kesheamad baddin veha harago katane amar rav adda bar ahava kesheasao terefa
Vehaamar rav nachman tane chagga met ukvaro vehilcheta deyatvi dayyane appumma devera
Tanu rabbanan hayyotze lehareg mazzin alav middam chattato umiddam ashamo chata beotah shaa en nizkakin lo may tama amar rav yosef mippene sheen meannin et dino
Amar leh abbaye i hachi afilu resha name kegon shehaya zivcho zavuach beotah shaa
Aval en zivcho zavuach may la addetane chata beotah shaa en nizkakin lo liflog velitne bedidah bamme devarim amurim shehaya zevach zavuach beotah shaa aval en zevach zavuach lo
Hachi name kaamar bamme devarim amurim shehaya zevach zavuach beotah shaa aval en zevach zavuach naasa kemi shechata beotah shaa veen nizkakin lo
Matni haishsha sheyyatza lehareg en mamtinin lah ad shetteled haishsha sheyyashva al hammashber mamtinin lah ad shetteled haishsha shenneherga nehenin bisarah behema shenneherga asura bahanaa
Gema peshita gufah hi itzterich salka datach amena hoil uchtiv kaasher yashit alav baal haishsha mamona devaal hu vela lafsedeh mineh ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan amar kera umetu gam shenehem lerabbot et havalad
Vehay mibe leh ad sheyehu shenehen shavin divre rabbi yoshiyya ki kaamrinan miggam
Yashva al hammashber vechu may tama kevan deakar gufa acharina hu

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel haishsha hayyotza lehareg makkin otah keneged bet heraon kede sheyyamut havalad techila kede shello tavo lide niuul lememra dehi kadma umeta beresha veha kayema lan devalad mayet beresha
Ditnan tinok ben yomo nochel umanchil veamar rav sheshet nochel benichse haem lehanchil laachin min haav
Daveka ben yom echad aval ubbar la dehu mayet beresha veen habben yoresh et immo bekever lehanchil laachin min haav
Hane mile legabbe mita ayede devalad zutra chayyuteh ayela tipa demalach hammavet umchattech lehu lesimanin aval neherga hi meta beresha
Veha hava ovada ufarkes ad telat pirkuse mide dehave azzenav halletaa dimfarkeset
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel haishsha sheyyashva al hammashber umeta beshabbat meviin sakkin umkarim et keresah umotziin et havalad peshita may aved
b: Mechattech bevasar hu amar rabba lo nitzrecha lehavi sakkin derech reshut harabbim
Umay kamashma lan demissefeka mechallelinan shabbeta tenena mi shennafla alav mappolet safek hu sham safek eno sham safek chay safek met safek nochri safek yisrael mefakkechin alav et haggal
Mahu detema hatam hu dahava leh chazaka dechayyuta aval hacha dela hava leh chazaka dechayyuta meikara ema la ka mashma lan
Haishsha shenneherga vechu veammay isure hanaa ninhu amar rav beomeret tenu seari levitti ilu amra tenu yadi levitti mi yahavinan lah
Amar rav befea nochrit tama deamra tenu ha lo amra tenu gufah hu umitsar
Veha mibaya leh lerabbi yose berabbi chanina devae rabbi yose berabbi chanina sear nashim tzidkaniyyot mahu
Veamar rava befea nochrit la kamibaya leh ki kamibaya leh lerabbi yose berabbi chanina ditle besikta
Hacha dimchabbar bah tama deamra tenu ha lo amra tenu gufah hu umitsar
Kashya leh lerav nachman bar yitzchak veha dumya divhema katane ma hatam gufah af hacha name gufah
Ella amar rav nachman zo mitatah osartah vezo gemar dina osartah
Tane levi kevateh derav tane levi kevateh derav nachman bar yitzchak tane levi kevateh derav haishsha sheyyotza lehareg veamra tenu seari levitti notnin meta en notnin mippene shehammet asur bahanaa
Peshita ella shennoye hammet asur bahanaa
Tanya kevateh derav nachman bar yitzchak haishsha shemmeta nehenin bisarah behema shenneherga asura bahanaa uma hefresh ben ze laze zo mitatah osartah vezo gamar dina osartah
Hadaran alach hakkol maarichin
Matni en neerachin pachot missela velo yater al chamishshim sela ketzad natan sela veheeshir eno noten kelum pachot missela veheeshir noten chamishshim sela
Hau beyadav chamesh selaim rabbi meir omer eno noten ella achat vachachamim omrim noten et kullan en neerachin pachot missela velo yater al chamishshim sela
Gm en neerachin pachot missela menalan dichtiv vechol erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh kol arachin sheatta maarich lo yehu pechutin mishkal
Velo yater al chamishshim selaim dichtiv chamishshim
Hau beyadav chamishsha ku may tama derabbi meir ketiv chamishshim uchtiv shekel o chamishshim o shekel
Verabbanan hahu lechol arachin sheatta maarich lo yehu pechutim mishkal hu daata hecha deit leh amar kera asher tassig yad hannoder vahare yado masseget
Verabbi meir hahu yad hannoder velo yad hannidar hu daata verabbanan lav mimmela shamatte minah dehecha deyado masseget shekol mineh
Amar rav adda bar ahava hau beyadav chamesh selaim veamar erki alay vechazar veamar erki alay venatan arba lashsheniyya veechad larishona yatza yede shettehen
May tama baal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava ma sheggava gava
Beidana deyahev lashsheniyya meshabad lerishona beidana deyahev larishona tu let leh

a: Natan arba larishona veachat lashsheniyya yede sheniyya yatza yede rishona lo yatza kullehu meshabedan lerishona

Bae rav adda bar ahava hau beyado chamesh selaim veamar sheni erki alay bevat achat mahu kevan divvat achat nadar ki hadade tafsan yahev tarte ufalga lehay vetarte ufalga lehay o dilma kullehu chazya lehay vechullehu chazya lehay teku
En baarachin pachot missela velo yater ku ha tu lema li
Ha kamashma lan pachot missela hu deleka ha yater al sela ika yater al chamishshim hu deleka ha pachot mechamishshim ika ustama kerabbanan
Matni en petach betoa pachot mishshiva velo yater al shiva asar
Gema tanu rabbanan toa sheamra yom echad tame raiti pitchah shiva asar
Shene yamim tame raiti pitchah shiva asar
Shelosha yamim tame raiti pitchah shiva asar
Arbaa yamim tame raiti pitchah shishsha asar
Chamishsha yamim tame raiti pitchah chamishsha asar shishsha yamim tame raiti pitchah arbaa asar
Shiva yamim tame raiti pitchah shelosha asar
Shemona yamim tame raiti pitchah shenem asar
Tisha yamim tame raiti pitchah achad asar
Asara yamim tame raiti pitchah asara achad asar pitchah tisha
b: Shenem asar pitchah shemona
Shelosha asar pitchah shiva
Sheen petach betoa pachot mishshiva velo yater al shiva asar
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerabba lema li kulle hay timne shiva vetishtere
Amar leh letakkonah lide nidda ufitchah kaamrinan
Tanu rabbanan kol hattoot zavot meviot korban veeno neechal chutz mippitchah shiva ufitchah shemona shemmeviot korban veneechal
Attu kol hattoot zavot vetu yom echad ushne yamim bat etoye korban hi
Ella kol zavot hattoot meviot korban veeno neechal chutz mippitchah shiva ufitchah shemona shemmeviot korban veneechal
Matni en bingaim pachot mishshavua echad velo yater al shelosha shevuot
Gema pachot mishshavua nige adam velo yater al shelosha shevuot nige vattim
Amar rav pappa tzidkatcha keharre el ellu nige adam mishpatecha tehom rabba ellu nige vattim
Peshateh dikra bemay ketiv amar rav yehuda ilmale tzidkatcha keharre el mi yuchal laamod lifne mishpatecha tehom rabba rabba amar tzidkatcha keharre el mippene shemmishpatecha tehom rabba
Bemay kamipalgi bidrabbi elazar verabbi yose berabbi chanina deitmar rabbi elazar amar kovesh rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar nose
Rabba kerabbi elazar verav yehuda kerabbi yose berabbi chanina

Matni en pochatin mearbaa chodashim hamubbarim beshana velo nira yater al shemona shette hallechem en neechalin pachot mishshenayim velo yater al shelosha lechem happanim en neechal pachot mittisha velo yater al achad asar
In katan nimol pachot mishshemona velo yater al shenem asar
Gema may lo nira yater al shemona amar rav huna lo nira lachachamim leabber yater al shemona may shena tisha dela im ken

a: Kadem ate sehara telata yome hashta name ka kadem ate tere yome

Kidamar rav mesharsheya kegon shehayeta shana meubberet hacha name kegon shehayeta shana shellefaneha meubberet veibur shana chodesh dal yarcha malya bahade yarcha chassira veakkatti chad yoma la addatayehu deinashe
Ulla amar lo nira lachachamim lechasser yater al shemona umay tama kaamar ma taam en pochatim mearbaa chodashim hamubbarim beshana mishshum delo nira lachachamim lechasser yater al shemone
May shena tisha dela deim ken meyatra sehara telata yome hashta name ka meyatra tere yome
Kidamar rav mesharsheya kegon shehayeta shana meubberet hacha name kegon shehayeta shana shellefaneha meubberet dal yarcha chassira bahade yarcha malya
Veakkatti ika chad yoma savri itchazoye itchazi vaanan lav addatin
b: Bemay kamipalgi beibur shana detanya kamma ibur shana sheloshim rabban shimon ben gamliel omer chodesh
Metivi in atzeret chala ella beom hanef veen rosh hashshana chala ella o beom hanef o leor iburo bishlama leulla dishmona chaserin avdinan meubbarin la avdinan mashkachatte lah
Shenehen chaser beom hanef
Echad male veechad chaser leor iburo
Ella lerav huna deamar avdinan meubbarin ha zimnin demashkachatte leor or iburo
Amar lecha rav huna ululla mi nicha shemona hu dela avdinan ha shiva avdinan shiva zimnin dela avdinan besitva veavdinan bekayeta veha hava leor or iburo
Ella ha manni acherim hi detanya acherim omrim en ben atzeret laatzeret veen ben rosh hashshana lerosh hashshana ella arbaa yamim bilvad veim hayeta shana meubberet chamishsha
Sof sof laacherim beom hanef la mashkachatte lah
Amar rav mesharsheya kegon shehayeta shana meubberet veibur shana sheloshim yom dal yarcha levahade yarcha demashkachatte lah beom hanef
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava acherim minyana ata leashmoinan ha ka mashma lan dela baenan mitzva lekaddesh al pi haraya
Matkef lah ravina vehaika yoma deshae veoma ditlatin shene kevan deleteh bechol shatta la ka chashev
Veaf shemuel savar lah kerav huna deamar shemuel en shenat levana pechuta mishshelosh meot vachamishshim ushtayim yom velo yetera al shelosh meot vachamishshim veshishsha yom
Ha ketzad shenehem melein shishsha shenehem chaserin shenayim echad male veechad chaser arbaa

Metivi hareni nazir kimot hachamma mone nezirut shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha yamim keminyan yemot hachamma kimot hallevana mone nezirut shelosh meot vachamishshim vearbaa yamim keminyan yemot hallevana veim ita zimnin demashkachatte lah shishsha
Bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam verov shanim

Veaf rabbi savar lah kerav huna detanya maase veasa rabbi kerav huna tisha chaserim venira chodesh bizmanno vehaya rabbi tameha veomer asinu tisha chaserin venire chodesh bizmanno amar lefanav rabbi shimon bar rabbi shemma shana meubberet hayeta

a: Veibur shana sheloshim veishtakad asinu shenehem melein dal telata levahade telata vekam leh beduchteh amar leh ner yisrael ken have
Matni en pochatin meesrim veachat tekiot bammikdash velo mosifin al arbaim ushmone

En pochatin mishshene nevalim velo mosifin al shishsha en pochatin mishshene chalilin velo mosifin al shenem asar uvishnem asar yom bashshana hechalil makke lifne hammizbeach bishchitat pesach rishon uvishchitat pesach sheni veom tov harishon shel pesach uvom tov shel atzeret uvishmonat yeme hechag velo haya makke beabbuv shel nechoshet ella beabbuv shel kane mippene shekkolo arev velo haya mechallek ella beabbuv yechidi mippene shehu mechallek yafe
Veavde kohanim hau divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer mishpachat bet pegarim uvet tzipra meemmaum hau massiin lakkehunna rabbi chanina ben antignos omer leviyyim hau
Gm matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer lo yifchot mishsheva velo yosif al shesh esre
Bemay kamipalgi rabbi yehuda savar tekia terua utkia chada hi verabbanan savri tekia lechud utrua lechud utkia lechud
May tama derabbi yehuda ketiv utkatem terua uchtiv terua yitkeu lachem shema minah tekia terua utkia chada hi verabbanan hahu lifshuta lefaneha ufshuta leachareha hu daata
Verabbanan may tama dichtiv uvhakhil et hakkahal titkeu velo tariu vei salka datach tekia terua utkia chada hi amar rachamana aved palga demitzva verabbi yehuda simana bealma hu
Keman azla ha deamar rav kahana en ben tekia litrua velo kelum keman kerabbi yehuda peshita
Mahu detema afilu kerabbanan atya ulappoke midderabbi yochanan deamar shama tesha tekiot betesha shaot bayyom yatza ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name im ken may velo kelum
Shenem asar yom bashshana makke bechalil vechu may shena hane hoil veyachid gomer bahen et hahallel

Deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak shemona asar yamim shehayyachid gomer bahen et hahallel shemona yeme hachag ushmona yeme chanukka veom tov harishon shel pesach veom tov harishon shel atzeret uvaggola esrim veechad tisha yeme hachag ushmona yeme chanukka ushne yamim tovim shel pesach ushne yamim tovim shel atzeret
May shena bechag deamrinan kol yoma umay shena befesach dela amrinan
b: Kol yoma dechag chalukin bekorbenotehen defesach en chalukin bekorbenotehen
Shabbat dachaluka bekarbenoteha lema la ikri moed
