Rosh chodesh deikri moed lema la ikaddash baasiyyat melacha dichtiv hashshir yihye lachem kelel hitkaddesh chag layela hamkuddash lechag taun shira vesheen mekuddash lechag en taun shira
Rosh hashshana veom hakkipurim deikro moed veikaddush baasiyyat melacha lema mishshum derabbi avahu

Deamar rabbi avahu amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam mippene ma en yisrael omrim shira lefanecha berosh hashshana uvom hakkippurim amar lahen efshar melech yoshev al kisse haddin vesifre chayyim vesifre metim petuchin lefanav veyisrael omrim shira lefanay
Veha chanukka dela hachi vela hachi vekaamar mishshum nisa purim deika nisa lema amar rabbi yitzchak lefi sheen omrim shira al nes shebbechutza laaretz

Matkef lah rav nachman bar yitzchak vahare yetziat mitzrayim denes shebbechutza laaretz hu veamrinan hallel kidtanya ad shello nichnesu yisrael laaretz huchsheru kol haaratzot lomar shira mishshennichnesu learetz lo huchsheru kol aratzot lomar shira
Rav nachman amar keriyyatah zo hi hallela rava amar bishlama hatam hallu avde Adonai velo avde faro hacha hallu avde Adonai velo avde achashverosh akkatti avde achashverosh anan
Ulrav nachman deamar keriyyatah zo hi hallela hatanya mishshennichnesu learetz lo huchsheru kol aratzot lomar shira kevan sheggalu chazru leheteran harishon
Lo haya makke beabbuv shel nechoshet vechu patach bechalil umsayyem beabbuv amar rav pappa hayenu chalil hayenu abbuv veammay kare leh chalil dachale kaleh

Tanu rabbanan abbuv haya bammikdash chalak haya dak haya shel kane haya umimot moshe haya tziva hammelech vetzipuhu zahav velo haya kolo arev natlu et tzippuo vehaya kolo arev kemot shehaya tziltzol haya bammikdash shel nechoshet haya vehaya kolo arev venifgam veshalchu chachamim veheviu ummanin mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim vetikkenuhu velo haya kolo arev natlu et tikuno vehaya kolo arev kemot shehaya

Machteshet hayeta bemikdash shel nechoshet hayeta umimot moshe hayeta vehayeta mefattemet et habbesamim nitpaggema veheviu ummanin mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim vetiknuha velo hayeta mefattemet kemo shehayeta natlu et tikunah vehayeta mefattemet kemo shehayeta

Ellu shene chelim nishtayeru mimmikdash rishon venitpaggemu velo haya lahem arucha vaalehem amar david nechoshet memorat nechoshet memorak vaalehem hu omer uchle nechoshet mutzhav shenayim chamudot mizzahav
Rav ushmuel chad amar kol echad veechad shakul kishnayim shel zahav vechad amar shenehem shekulin keechad shel zahav tane rav yosef shenehem shekulin keechad shel zahav
Tanya rabbi natan omer sheniyyim hau shenneemar shenayim al tikre shenayim ella sheniyyim

Tane rabban shimon ben gamliel shiloach haya mekalleach mayim bichisar tziva hammelech vehirchivuhu kede sheyyitrabbu memav venitmaatu vechazru umiatuhu vehaya mekalleach mayim lekayyem ma shenneemar al yithallel chacham bechochmato veal yithallel gibbor bigvurato
Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hirdavelim lo haya bemikdash may hirdavelim amar abbaye tavla gurgedana mippene shekkolo arev umarbev et hanneima
Amar rava bar shela amar rav matna amar shemuel magrefa hayeta bammikdash

a: Asara nekavim hau bah kol echad veechad motzi asara mine zemer nimtzet kullah motzia mea mine zemer bematnita tana hi amma ugvoha amma vekatta yotza hemenna vaasara nekavim hau bah kol echad motzi mea mine zemer nimtzet kullah motzia elef mine zemer amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vesimanach matnita guzma
Veavde chohanim hau ku lema beha kamipalgi deman deamar avadim hau kasavar ikar shira bappe uchli levassome kala hu daavida uman deamar leviyyim hau kasavar ikar shira bichli
Vetisbera rabbi yose may kasavar i kasavar ikar shira bappe avadim saggi i kasavar ikar shira bichli leviyyim baenan
Leolam kasavar ikar shira bappe vehacha bemaalin midduchan leuchasin ulmaasrot kamipalgi

Man deamar avadim hau kasavar en maalin midduchan lo leuchasin velo lemaasrot man deamar leviyyim hau kasavar maalin midduchan ben leuchasin ben lemaasrot ulman deamar yisreelim hau kasavar maalin midduchan leuchasin velo lemaasrot
Tanu rabbanan hashshir meakkev et hakkorban divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim eno meakkev
May tama derabbi meir deamar kera vaettena et halviyyim netunim leaharon ulvanav mittoch bene yisrael ulchapper al bene yisrael ma kappara meakkevet af shira meakkevet
Verabbanan hahu leidach derabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar ma kappara bayyom af shira bayyom
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel minnayin leikar shira min hattora shenneemar vesheret beshem Adonai elohav ezehu sherut shebbeshem heve omer zo shira
Veema nesiut kappayim middichtiv lesharto ulvarech bishmo mikkelal devirkat kohanim lav sherut hi

Rav matna amar mehacha tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvtuv levav ezo hi avoda shebbesimcha uvtuv levav heve omer zo shira veema divre tora dichtiv pikkude Adonai yesharim mesammeche lev mesammeche lev ikri tov la ikri
Veema bikkurim dichtiv vesamachta vechol hattov tov ikri tuv levav la ikri
Amar rav matna minnayin labbikurim shetteunin shira atya tov tov mehacha

Ini veha amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan minnayin sheen omrim shira ella al hayyayin shenneemar vattomer lahem haggefen hechodalti et tiroshi hamsammeach elohim vaanashim im anashim mesammeach elohim bamme mesammeach mikkan sheen omrim shira ella al hayyayin
Mashkachatte lah kidtane rabbi yose peri atta mevi vei atta mevi mashkin hevi anavim udrachan minnayin talmud lomar tavi
Chizkiyya amar mehacha uchnanyahu sar halviyyim yasor bammassa ki mevin hu al tikre yasor ella yashir
Bilvate amar rabbi yochanan mehacha laavod avodat avoda ezehu avoda shetztzericha avoda heve omer zo shira
Rabbi yitzchak amar mehacha seu zimra utnu tof kinnor naim im navel rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha hem yisu kolam yaronnu bigon Adonai tzahalu miyyam

Vetanna mayete lah mehacha velivne kehat lo natan ki avodat hakkodesh alehem bakkatef yissau mimmashma shenneemar bakkatef eni yodea sheyyisu ma talmud lomar yissau en yissau ella leshon shira vechen hu omer seu zimra utnu tof veomer yisseu kolam yaronnu vego
Chananya ben achi rabbi yehoshua amar mehacha moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol
b: Al iske kol rav ashe amar mehacha vayehi cheechad lamchatztzetzorim velamshorrim lehashmia kol echad
Rabbi yonatan amar mehacha velo yamutu gam hem gam attem ma attem baavodat mizbeach af hem baavodat mizbeach
Tanya name hachi velo yamutu gam hem gam attem attem beshellahem vehem beshellachem bemita hem beshellahem enan bemita ella beazhara

Amar abbaye nekitinan meshorer sheshshier beshel chavero bemita shenneemar vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma lifne ohel moed vego vehazzar hakkarev yumat may zar ilema zar mammash hachtiv chada zimna ella lav zar deotah avoda
Metivi meshorer sheshshier umshoer sheshshorer enan bemita ella beazhara
Tannae hi detanya maase berabbi yehoshua bar chananya shehalach lesayyea behaggafat delatot etzel rabbi yochanan ben gudgeda amar lo beni chazor laachorecha sheatta min hamshorrim velo min hamshoarim
May lav beha kamipalgi demar savar mita hi ugzaru bah rabbanan umar savar azhara hi vela gezaru bah
Dechulle alma azhara hi mar savar mesayyea gezaru beh rabbanan umar savar la gezaru beh rabbanan
Bae rabbi avin olat nidvat tzibur teuna shira o enah teuna shira olotechem amar rachamana achat olat chova veachat olat nedava o dilma olotechem dechullehu yisrael kaamar rachamana

Ta shema vayyomer chizkiyyahu lehaalot haola al hammizbeach uvet hechel haola hechel shir Adonai vehachatzotzrot al yede kele shir david melech yisrael hay shira may avidtah ilema deolat chova lema leh imloche ella lav deolat nedava
Amar rav yosef lo olat rosh chodesh hava veka mibaya lehu mi hukba rosh chodesh bizmanno delikrav o la
Amar leh abbaye umi matzet amratte hachi vehachtiv bayyom shishsha asar lachodesh harishon vego vayyomer chizkiyyahu lehaalot haola al hammizbeach
Ella amar rame bereh derav yeva keves habba im haomer kamibaya lehu mi kava rosh chodesh bizmanno delikrav o la
Matkef lah rav aveya velichze pesach hechi aved matztza hechi achel
Ella amar rav ashe mide dehave ashshelicha detzibura demimmelich hashta deatet lehachi afilu tema olat chova mide dehave ashshelicha detzibura demimmelich
Ta shema rabbi yose omer megalgelin zechut leom zakkay vechova leom chayyav

Amru keshecharav habbayit barishona oto hayyom tisha beav haya umotzae shabbat haya umotzae sheviit hayeta umishmarto shel yehoyariv hayeta vehau kohanim ulviyyim omdim al duchanan veomrim shira uma shira amru vayyashev alehem et onam uvraatam yatzmitem velo hispiku lomar yatzmitem Adonai elohenu ad shebbau goyim uchvashum vechen bashsheniyya
Hay shira may avidtah ilema deolat chova mi havay beshiva asar betammuz batal hattamid ella lav deolat nedava
Vetisbera may shena deolat chova dela havay umay shena deolat nedava dahavay ha la kashya ben bakar akray bealma hu deitremi lehu
Amar rava veitema rav ashe vetisbera shira deomeh la haaretz umloah vayyashev alehem et onam beshir dearbea beshabbat hu ella ilya bealma hu dinfal lehu befummayehu
Veha omdin al duchanan katane kidresh lakish deamar omer shello al hakkorban i hachi beolat nedava name lema nafek minah churba
May hava alah ta shema detane rav mari bereh derav kahana al olotechem veal zivche shalmechem
Ma ola kodesh kadashim af shelamim kodesh kodashim uma shelamim kavua lahem zeman af ola kavua lah zeman

a: Ibaya lehu nesachim habbaim bifne atzman teunin shira o en teunin shira kevan deamar shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan minnayin sheen omrim shira ella al hayyayin amrinan o dilma al achila ushtiyya amrinan ashshetiyya lechodah la amrinan
Ta shema rabbi yose omer megalgelin zechut leom zakkay vechu
Hay shira may avidtah ilema deolat chova mi hava beshiva asar betammuz batal hattamid veella deolat nedava veha tane rav mari bereh derav kahana dela tzericha ella lav dinsachin
Amar rava veitema rav ashe vetisbera shira deomeh la haaretz umloah vayyashev alehem et onam beshira dearbea beshabba hu ella ilya bealma hu dinfal lehu befummayehu
Veha omdim al duchanan katane kidresh lakish deamar resh lakish omer shira shello al hakkorban i hachi binsachim name lema nafek mineh churba
Gufa rabbi yose omer megalgelin zechut leom zakkay vechu

Barishona bemotzae sheviit mi mashkachatte lah vehachtiv beesrim vechamesh shana legalutenu berosh hashshana beasor lachodesh bearba esre shana achar asher hukketa hair ezo hi shana sherosh hashshana beasor lachodesh heve omer ze yovel
Vei salka datach bechad beshavua charuv mechad beshavua lechad beshavua tamne lechad beshavua acharina chamesh esre haveyan
Amar ravina bearba esre shana achar shana shehukketa hair
I hachi beesrim vechamesh shana esrim vashesh haveyan deamar mar galu besheva galu bishmone
Galu bishmone esre galu bitsha esre
Mishshav vead tamne sere chad sere vachamesh esre esrim veshet haveya

Amar lach ravina uldidach mi nicha mikkede galu name bitsha esre mishshav vead teshasre tarte sere vearba sere esrim veshet haveyan ella may it lach lememar levar mishshatta diglo bah ledidi name levar mishshatta diglo bah
Mikkol makom teshasre leravina kashya
Mi savratte shalosh galiyyot havay galu besheva lechibush yehoyakim shehi shemone linvuchadnetztzar galu bishmone esre lechibush yehoyakim shehi tesha esre linvuchadnetztzar
Deamar mar shana rishona kibesh ninve
b: Sheniyya ala vechibesh yehoyakim
Vechen bashsheniyya
Ushniyya bemotzae sheviit mi mashkachatte lah mikkedi bayit sheni kamma kam arba mea veesrim arba mea temanya yovele arbesre tere shavua pashu lehu shet have leh beshita bashshavua
Ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar shenat chamishshim ola lechan ulchan ayeti temanya mittemanya yovele vehane shet have arbesar ishtechach divmotzae sheviit charuv

I rabbi yehuda barishona la mashkachatte lah detanya shiva asar yovelot manu yisrael mishshennichnesu laaretz vead sheyyatzu vei atta yachol lomar mishshaa shennichnesu manu sheim atta omer ken nimtza bayit charev bitchilat yovel vei atta motze bearba esre shana achar asher hukketa hair
Ella tze mehem sheva shekkibshu vesheva shechilku veatta motze bearba esre shana achar asher hukketa hair
Vei rabbi yehuda ayeti shavsere mishshavsere yovele shedi ahane hava leh bitlata bashshavua
Hanach shene deaglinhu sancheriv ad daata yirmeya ahderinhu la kachashev lehu
Ibaet ema leolam rabbanan vechi katane vechen bashsheniyya ashsheara
Hachi name mistabbera dei la tema hachi mishmarto shel yehoyariv bashsheniyya mi havay

Vehatanya arba mishmarot alu min haggola yedaya vecharim pashchur veimer amdu neviim shebbenehem vechillekum leesrim vearba mishmarot belalum untanum bakkalpi ba yedaya venatal chelko vechelek chaverav shesh

a: Ba charim venatal chelko vechelek chaverav shesh vechen pashchur vechen imer hitkinu neviim shebbenehem sheafilu yehoyariv rosh mishmarot ole lo yiddache yedaya mimmekomo ella yedaya ikar vihoyariv tafel lo ella ashsheara
Rav ashe amar hanach shet shene ad desalek ezra umkaddesh la ka chashev lehu
Dichtiv bedayin betelat avidat bet elaha di birushlem uchtiv veshetzi bayeta dena ad yom telata lirach adar dehi shenat shet lemalchut daryavesh malka
Vetana beoto zeman leshana habbaa ala ezra vegaluto immo dichtiv vayyavo yerushalam bachodesh hachamishi hi hashshana hashsheviit lammelech

Gufa shiva asar yovelot manu yisrael mishshennichnesu laaretz vead sheyyatzu vei atta yachol lomar mishshennichnesu manu sheim atta omer mishshennichnesu manu nimtza bayit charev bitchillat yovel vei atta motze bearba esre shana achar asher hukketa hair vechu
Sheva shekkibshu menalan dekaamar kalev ben arbaim shana anochi bishloach oti moshe eved Adonai mikkadesh barnea leraggel et haaretz veatta anochi hayyom ben chamesh ushmonim

Veamar mar shana rishona asa moshe mishkan sheniyya hukam hammishkan veshalach meraggelim ki avur yarden kalev bar kamma have bar temanan neche tarten ki ka mefalleg nachalot kaamar ben chamesh ushmonim shana anochi ishtechach desheva kibshu
Vesheva shechilku menalan ibaet ema middesheva kibshu sheva chilku veibaet ema middela mashkachatte lehu arba esre shana achar asher hukketa hair

Matni en pochatin mishshishsha telaim hamvukkarin belishkat hattelaim kede lashshabbat ulyamim tovim shel rosh hashshana umosifin ad olam en pochatin mishshette chatzotzrot mittisha kinnorot umosifin ad olam vehatztziltzal levad
Gema temidin umusafin tuva hao
Tanna bealma kae veattemidin lechodeh kae umay kede lashshabbat ulyamim tovim simana bealma vehachi kaamar en pochatin mishshishsha telaim
b: Hamvukkarim belishkat hattelaim arbaa yamim kodem shechita umanni ben bag bag hi detanya ben bag bag omer minnayin lattamid shettaun bikur arbaa yamim kodem shechita

Talmud lomar tishmeru lehakriv li bemoado ulhallan hu omer vehaya lachem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar yom lachodesh harishon ma lehallan taun bikur arbaa yamim kodem shechita af kan taun bikur arbaa yamim kodem shechita
Dayeka name dekatane kede lashshabbat vela katane lashshabbat shema minah
Mishshette chatzotzrot umosifin vechu vead kamma amar rav huna veamri lah amar rav zavdi amar rav huna ad mea veesrim shenneemar veimmahem kohanim lemea veesrim machtzerim bachatzotzrot
Mittisha kinnorot vechu vetziltzal levad mena hane mile amar rav assi deamar kera veasaf bamtziltayim lehashmia metziltayim tere hau kevan dachada avidta avdi vechad gavra aved behu kare lehu chad

Matni en pochatin mishshenem asar leviyyim omdin al hadduchan umosifin ad olam en hakkatan nichnas laazara laavoda ella beshaa shehalleviyyim omrim bashshir velo hau omrim benevel uvchinnor ella bappe kede liten tevel banneima
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer en olin lamminyan veen olin ladduchan ella baaretz hau omdin verashehen ben ragle halviyyim vetzoare halviyyim hau nikrain
Gema hane keneged mi amar rav pappa keneged tisha kinnorot ushne nevalim vetziltzal echad shenneemar hu uvanav veechav shenem asar

En hakkatan nichnas laazara laavoda ella beshaa shehalleviyyim ku mena hane mile amar rabbi yochanan deamar kera vayyaamod yeshua banav veechav kadmiel uvanav bene yehuda keechad lenatztzeach al ose hammelacha bevet haelohim vego

Lo hau omrim lo benevel velo bechinnor ella bappe ku lememra denevel lechud vechinnor lechud lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer kinnor shel mikdash shel shivat nimin haya shenneemar sva semachot panecha al tikre sova ella sheva
Veshel yemot hammashiach shemona shenneemar limnatztzeach al hashsheminit al nima sheminit
Shel olam habba eser shenneemar ale asor vaale navel ale higgaon bechinnor
Veomer hodu la bechinnor benevel asor zammeru lo shiru lo shir chadash
Afilu tema rabbi yehuda laolam habba ayede dinfishi nimin dideh nefish kaleh ki nevel kare leh nevel

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer en olin min hamminyan ku tana vesoade halviyyim hau nikrain vetanna didan kevan dehanne katin kalayehu vehane av kalayehu hane mekatteti vehane la mekatteti kare lehu tzoare
Hadaran alach en neerachin
Matni yesh baarachin lehakel ulhachmir uvisde achuzza lehakel ulhachmir uvshor hammuad shehemit haeved lehakel ulhachmir baones uvamfatte uvammotzi shem ra lehakel ulhachmir
Yesh baarachin lehakel ulhachmir ketzad echad sheheerich et hannae shebbeyisrael veet hakkaur shebbeyisrael noten chamishshim sela veim amar hare damav alay noten et shoveyo
Gema yesh baarachin lehakel vechu ulhachmir ketzad echad sheheerich ku beyisrael in baggoyim la
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi meir ditnan goy rabbi meir omer neerach aval lo maarich
Afilu tema rabbi meir hu haddin daafilu goy name ella

a: Milleta aggav orcheh kamashma lan kidrav yehuda amar rav deamar rav yehuda amar rav asur laadam sheyyomar kamma nae goy ze
Velitne et hannae shebbeyisrael veet hakkaur shebbaggoyim bechad umma kamayere bitre umme la mayere
Vela veha katane haggedola shebbakkehunna veet hakketanna shebbeyisrael hatam chad umma hu ella mikdash hu dekaddishi kohanim tefe
Veibaet ema ayede deka bae lemitne sefa sede achuzza divyisrael hu demashkachatte lah begoy la mashkachatte lah delav bene achuzza ninhu mishshum hachi katane lah beyisrael

Matni bisde achuzza lehakel ulhachamir ketzad echad hammakdish becholat hammachoz veechad hammakdish bappardesot sevaste noten zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef uvisde mikna noten et shoveyo
Rabbi eliezer omer echad sede mikna veechad sede achuzza ma ben sede achuzza lisde mikna shebbisde achuzza hu noten chomesh uvisde mikna eno noten chomesh

Gema amar rav huna hikdish sade melea ilanot keshehu podan pode ilanot beshoveyan vechozer ufode karka bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef alma kasavar rav huna adam makdish beayin yafa makdish
Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna echad hammakdish becholat hammachoz veechad hammakdish befardesot sevaste noten bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef amar leh reuya lefardesot kaamena
Etiveh bet zera en li ella bet zera sede gefanim usde kanim usde ilanot minnayin
Talmud lomar sade mikkol makom amar leh hacha name pode vechozer ufode
Etiveh hikdish shelosha ilanot mimmatta asara levet sea hare ze hikdish et hakkarka veet hailanot shebbenehem keshehu pode pode bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef
Pachot miken o yater al ken o shehikdishan beze achar ze hare ze lo hikdish lo et hakkarka velo et hailanot shebbenehem
Velo od ella afilu hikdish ilanotav veachar kach hikdish karka keshehu pode pode et hailanot beshoveyehen vechozer ufode karka bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef
Vechi tema hacha name pode vechozer ufode ha middesefa pode vechozer ufode mikkelal deresha la
Ella ha manni rabbi shimon hi deamar makdish beayin raa makdish detanya hammakdish et hassade hikdish et kullah rabbi shimon omer lo hikdish ella charuv hammurkav vesaddan hashshikma
I rabbi shimon ema sefa velo od ella afilu hikdish ilanotav veachar kach hikdish karka keshehu pode pode et hailanot beshoveyehen vechozer ufode bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef
Vei rabbi shimon lezil batar pidon velifreku aggav arayehu deha shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deazel batar pidon
Detanya minnayin lelokeach sade meaviv vehikdishah veachar kach met aviv minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza talmud lomar im et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato
Sade sheenah reuya lihot sede achuzza yatzta zo sheruya lihot sede achuzza divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon
Rabbi meir omer minnayin lallokeach sade meaviv umet aviv veachar kach hikdishah minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza
b: Talmud lomar im et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato sade sheenah sede achuzza yatzta zo shehi sede achuzza
Ilu lerabbi yehuda ulrabbi shimon afilu hikdishah veachar kach met av sede achuzza haveya may tama i mishshum kera kera lechidrabbi meir hu daata
Ella lav mishshum deazel batar pidon
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon kera ashkachu udrush
Im ken lichtov rachamana im et sede miknato asher lo achuzzato may missede sade sheenah reuya lihot sede achuzza
Amar rav pappa hikdish terashin podan beshoveyan may tama bet zera amar rachamana vehane lav bene zeria ninhu
Lo gealan yotzin lakkohanim bayyovel may tama sade amar rachamana kol dehu

Machar terashin nigalin pachot mishte shanim may tama mispar shene tevuot amar rachamana vehay lav bene tevua ninhu lo gealan chozeret chozrin labbealim bayyovel may tama veshav laachuzzato amar rachamana vehay name achuzza hi
Hikdish ilanot pode podan beshoveyehen may tama bet zera amar rachamana velo ilanot lo gealan en yotzin lakkohanim bayyovel vehaya hassade amar rachamana velo ilanot

Machar ilanot en nigalin pachot mishte shanim may tama shene tevuot amar rachamana vehane bene tevuot ninhu lo gealan en chozeret labbealim beovel may tama veshav laachuzzato amar rachamana velo ilanot
Amar mar hikdish ilanot pode podan beshoveyan ammay velikdeshu aggav arayehu velifrekuha aggav arayehu
Vechi tema ilanot akdesh ara la akdesh vehaamri nehardae man dimzabben leh dikla lechavreh kane leh mishshipula vead tehoma lav mi itmar alah beva mechamat taana
Sede mikna noten shoveyo tanu rabbanan bemichsat ma ba lilmod lefi shenneemar zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef yachol af sede mikna ken talmud lomar michsat
Rabbi eliezer omer neemar kan vechishshav veneemar lehallan vechishshav ma lehallan davar katzuv af kan davar katzuv
Ibaya lehu rabbanan it lehu gezera shava umappekin leh lechomesh o dilma let lehu gezera shava velet lehu lechomesh

Amar rava mistabbera let lehu gezera shava middegalli rachamana chomesh gabbe sede achuzza vegabbe makdish beto hau leh shene ketuvin habbain keechad vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Ulman deamar melammedin middegalli rachamana chomesh bemaaser bivhema tehora uvivhema temea have leh tuva veen melammedin
Tanya kevateh derava vela mittameh tanya bemichsat haerkecha hikkisho hakkatuv laarachin ma arachin en mosif chomesh af sede mikna en mosif chomesh

Matni beshor hammuad shehemit et haeved lehakel ulhachamir ketzad echad shehemit et hannae shebbaavadim veet hakkaur shebbaavadim noten sheloshim sela hemit ben chorin noten shoveyo chaval baze uvaze noten nezek shalem
Gema bemuad in betam la lema matnitin dela kerabbi akiva ditnan rabbi akiva omer af tam shechaval baadam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem
Afilu tema rabbi akiva hu haddin daafilu tam name veayede deka bae lemitne sefa hemit eved hemit ben chorin divmuad hu demashkachatte lah betam la mashkachatte lah mishshum hachi katane muad

Matni baones uvamfatte lehakel ulhachamir ketzad echad sheanas ufita et gedola shebbakkehunna veet hakketanna shebbeyisrael noten chamishshim selaim vehabboshet vehappegam hakkol lefi hamvayyesh vehammitbayyesh
Gema ammay ema chamishshim selaim amar rachamana mikkol mile
Amar rav zeera yomru baal bat melachim chamishshim baal bat hedotot chamishshim
Amar leh abbaye i hachi gabbe eved name yomru eved nokev margalit sheloshim eved ose maase machat sheloshim ella amar rav zeera

a: Ilu bau aleha shenayim echad shello kedarkah veechad kedarkah yomru baal peguma chamishshim baal shelema chamishshim
Amar leh abbaye i hachi gabbe eved name yomru eved bari sheloshim eved mukke shechin sheloshim
Ella amar abbaye amar kera tachat asher innah mikkelal deika boshet ufgam
Rava amar deamar kera venatan haish hashshochev immah vego hanaat shechiva chamishshim mikkelal deika milta achariti umay nihu boshet ufgam
Matni bemotzi shem ra lehakel ulhachamir ketzad echad shehotzi shem ra al gedola shebbakkehunna veal ketanna shebbeyisrael noten mea sela
Nimtza haomer befiv chamur min haose maase shekken matzinu shello nitchattem gezar din al avotenu bammidbar ella al lashon hara shenneemar vayenassu oti ze eser peamim vego
Gema mimmay dilma mishshum deka garem lah ketala dichtiv veim emet haya haddavar vego vehotziu et hannaara vego
Amar rava amar kera ki hotzi shem ra al shem ra shehotzi

Vechen matzinu shello nitchattem gezar din vechu mimmay dilma deakkatti la mela seatan deamar rav hamnuna en hakkadosh baruch hu nifra min haadam ad shettitmalle seato shenneemar bimlot sifko yetzer lo
Amar resh lakish amar kera vayenassu oti ze eser peamim al ze nitchattem gezar din
Tanya amar rabbi elazar ben parta bo ure kamma gadol koach shel lashon hara menalan mimmeraggelim uma hammotzi shem ra al etzim vaavanim kach hammotzi shem ra al chavero al achat kamma vechamma

Mimmay dilma mishshum derabbi chanina bar pappa deamar rabbi chanina bar pappa davar gadol dibberu meraggelim beotah shaa dichtiv ki chazak hu mimmenu al tikre ki chazak hu mimmenu ella mimmennu kivyachol baal habbayit en yachol lehotzi kelav mishsham
Ella amar rabba amar resh lakish amar kera vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat haaretz raa al dibbat haaretz shehotziu
Tanya amar rabbi yehuda eser nisonot nisu avotenu lehakkadosh baruch hu shenayim bayyam ushnayim bammayim shenayim bamman shenayim basselav achat baegel veachat bemidbar paran
Shenayim bayyam achat bayerida veachat baaliyya bayerida dichtiv hamibbeli en kevarim bemitzrayim

Baaliyya kidrav huna deamar rav huna yisrael shebbeoto haddor mikketanne amana hau kidrabba bar mari deamar rabba bar mari may dichtiv vayyamru al yam beyam suf vayyoshiem lemaan shemo melammed shehau yisrael mamrim beotah shaa veomrim keshem sheanu olim mitztzad ze kach mitzrayim olim mitztzad acher

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lesar shel yam pelot otam layyabbasha amar lefanav ribbono shel olam kelum yesh eved shennoten lo rabbo mattana vechozer venotlah hemennu amar lo ani noten lecha echad umechetza shebbahem
Amar lefanav ribbono shel olam kelum yesh eved shettovea et rabbo amar lo nachal kishon yihye arev miyyad pelatan layyabbasha dichtiv vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met al vego
Shenayim bammayim bemara uvirfidim bemara dichtiv vayyavou marata velo yachlu lishtot uchtiv vayyalen haam al moshe
Birfidim dichtiv vayyachanu birfidim veen mayim lishtot uchtiv vayyarev haam im moshe
Shenayim bamman dichtiv
b: Al tetzeu vayyetzu al totiru vayyotiru
Shenayim basselav bislav rishon uvislav sheni bislav rishon beshivtechem al sir habbasar
Bislav sheni vehasafsuf asher bekirbo
Baegel kiditeh bemidbar paran kiditeh

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra may dichtiv ma yitten lecha uma yosif lach lashon remiyya amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lallashon kol evarav shel adam zekufim veatta mutal kol evarav shel adam mibbachutz veatta mibbifnim velo od ella shehikkafti lecha shette chomot achat shel etzem veachat shel basar ma yitten lecha uma yosif lach lashon remiyya
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra kol hamsapper lashon hara keilu kafar baikar shenneemar asher amru lilshonenu nagbir sefatenu ittanu mi adon lanu
Veamar rabbi yose ben zimra kol hamsapper lashon hara negaim baim alav shenneemar meloshni vasseter reehu oto atzmit uchtiv hatam latztzemitut umtargeminan lachalutin
Utnan en ben metzora musgar limtzora muchlat ella peria ufrima
Amar resh lakish may dichtiv zot tihye torat hammetzora zot tihye torato shel motzi shem ra

Veamar resh lakish may dichtiv im yishshoch hannachash belo lachash veen yitron levaal hallashon leatid lavo mitkabbetzot kol hachayyot uvaot etzel nachash veomrot ari dores veochel zeev toref veochel atta ma hanaa yesh lecha omer lahem vechi ma yitron levaal hallashon
Veamar resh lakish kol hamsapper lashon hara magdil aonot ad lashshamayim shenneemar shattu vashshamayim pihem ulshonam tihalach baaretz
Amar rav chisda amar mar ukva kol hamsapper lashon hara rauy lesoklo beeven ketiv hacha oto atzmit uchtiv hatam tzamtu vabbor chayyay vayyaddu even bi

Veamar rav chisda amar mar ukva kol hamsapper lashon hara omer hakkadosh baruch hu en ani vehu yecholin ladur baolam shenneemar meloshni vasseter reehu oto atzmit gevah enayim urchav levav oto lo uchal al tikre oto lo uchal ella itto lo uchal veika dematne lah al gasse haruach

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukva kol hamsapper lashon hara omer hakkadosh baruch hu legehinnam ani alav millemala veatta alav millematta nedunennu shenneemar chitztze gibbor shenunim im gachale retamim en chetz ella lashon shenneemar chetz shachut leshonam mirma dibber
Veen gibbor ella hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar Adonai kegibbor yetze gachale retamim hayenu gehinnam

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina ma takkanato shel mesapperoy lashon hara im talmid chacham hu yaasok battora shenneemar marpe lashon etz chayyim veen lashon ella lashon hara shenneemar chetz shachut leshonam veen etz ella tora shenneemar etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah veim am haaretz hu yashpil dato shenneemar veselef bah shever beruach

Rabbi acha berabbi chanina omer siper en lo takkana shekkevar kerato david beruach hakkodesh shenneemar yachret Adonai kol sifte chalakot lashon medabberet gedolot ella ma takkanato shello yavo lide lashon hara im talmid chacham hu yaasok battora veim am haaretz hu yashpil dato shenneemar veselef bah shever beruach

Tana deve rabbi yishmael kol hamsapper lashon hara magdil aonot keneged shalosh averot avoda zara vegiluy araot ushfichut damim ketiv hacha lashon medabberet gedolot uchtiv baavoda zara anna chata haam hazze chataa gedola
Begiluy araot ketiv veech eese haraa haggedola hazzot bishfichut damim ketiv gadol aoni minneso
Gedolot ema tarte he minayehu mappeka
Bemareva amri lashon telitay katel telitay horeg lamsappero velamkabbelo velaomrin alav

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina may dichtiv mavet vechayyim beyad lashon vechi yesh yad lallashon lomar lach ma yad memita af lashon memita i ma yad enah memita ella besamuch lah af lashon enah memita ella besamuch lah talmud lomar chetz shachut leshonam
I ma chetz ad arbaim vachamishshim amma af lashon ad arbaim vachamishshim amma talmud lomar shattu vashshamayim pihem ulshonam tihalach baaretz
Vechi meachar dichtiv shattu bashshamayim pihem chetz shachut leshonam lema li ha kamashma lan dekatel kechetz
Vechi meachar dichtiv chetz shachut leshonam mavet vechayyim beyad lashon lema li lechidrava deamar rava devae chayyim belishaneh devae mita belishaneh
Hechi dame lishana bisha rava amar kegon deamar ika nura be felanya amar leh abbaye may ka aved galloye milta bealma hu ella demappek belishana bisha deamar hecha mishtechach nura ella be felanya

Leman deamar ad hakkaa dichtiv lehakkoto ulman deamar ad kelala dichtiv levoshtecha ulvoshet ervat immecha ulman deamar ad nezifa dichtiv vayyichar af shaul

Matni hesseg yad bannoder vehashshanim bannidar vehaarachin banneerach vehaerech bizman haerech

Amar abbaye omdin kamma adam rotze liten beeved haose melacha beyado achat laose bishte yadav yado achat may nihu veidach pesika hayenu hach ella yado muchtevet lerabbo rishon
Bae rava amaduhu omed shel nizzakin veamar deme alay mahu mi amar ha amaduhu chada zimna o dilma shane umdana deve asra meumdana deve telata
Im timtza lomar shane umdana deve asara meumdana deve telata amar deme alay vaamaduhu vechazar veamar deme alay mahu hacha vadday amaduhu be asara o dilma shavach bene uvene
Amar deme alay velo amaduhu vechazar veamar deme alay mahu hacha vadday

a: Bechad zimna amdinan leh o dilma kevan divze achar ze nadar tere zimne amdinan leh

Veim timtza lomar kevan divze achar ze nadar tere zimne amdinan leh amar shene damay alay bevat achat mahu hacha vadday bevat achat nadar bevat achat amdinan leh o dilma kevan dekaamar shene keze achar ze dame
Im timtze lomar kevan dekaamar shene keze achar ze dame amaduhu meelav mahu mi amrinan ha amid meelav vekae o dilma baenan kavana leumdana
Peshot miha chada ditnan deme alay umet lo yittenu yorshin sheen damim lammetim
Vei salka datach amaduhu meelav have umdana ha amid vekae mi ika gavra dela shave arbea zuze
Amaduhu meelav nechet leumdana damay alay la nechet leumdana
Matni chomer baarachin mibbannedarim ketzad haomer erki alay vamet yittenu hayyorshim damay alay vamet lo yittenu hayyorshim sheen damim lammetim
Erech yadi veerech ragli alay la amar kelum erech roshi veerech kevedi alay noten erech kullo ze hakkelal davar shehanneshama teluya bo noten erech kullo

Chatzi erki alay noten chatzi erko erech chetzyi alay noten erech kullo chatzi damay alay noten chatzi damav deme chetzyi alay noten deme chullo ze hakkelal davar shehanneshama teluya bo noten deme chullo
Haomer erko shel peloni alay met hannoder vehannidar yittenu hayyorshin damav shel peloni alay umet hannoder yittenu hayyorshin met hannidar lo yittenu hayyorshin sheen damim lammetim
Gema tanu rabbanan chomer bannedarim mibbaarachin shehannedarim chalin al behema chayya vaof veen niddonim behesseg yad ma sheen ken baarachin
Chomer baarachin mibbannedarim ketzad amar erki alay vamet yittenu yorshin damay alay vamet lo yittenu yorshin sheen damim lammetim
Amar erki alay vamet yittenu yorshin shema minah milva al pe gove min hayyorshin shane hacha demilva ketuva battora hi
Shema minah milva hakketuva battora kichtuva bishtar damya hacha bemay askinan kesheamad baddin
Dichvatah gabbe damay alay sheamad baddin ammay lo yittenu yorshin damay alay mechussar umdana erki alay lo mechussar velo chelum
Erech yadi veragli alay vechu amar rav gidel amar rav venoten dameha
Veha lo amar kelum katane lo amar kelum lerabbanan venoten dameha lerabbi meir
Ha amrah chada zimna deamar rav gidel amar rav haomer erech keli ze alay noten damav

Mahu detema hatam hu deadam yodea sheen erech lichli vegamar veamar leshem damim aval hacha mita katae desavar ki hechi deika erech roshi veerech kevedi ika name erech yadi veerech ragli aval deme la kaamar ka mashma lan
Erech roshi veerech kevedi noten erech kullo may tama nefashot kaamar rachamana
Ze hakkelal davar shehanneshama teluya bo leetoye min haarkubba ulmala
Chatzi erki alay noten ku tanu rabbanan chatzi erki alay noten chatzi erko rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer loke venoten erech shalem
Loke ammay amar rav pappa loke beerech shalem may tama gezera chatzi erki erko attu erech chetzo veerech chetzo have davar shehanneshama teluya bo
Chatzi damay alay noten ku deme chetzyi alay noten deme kullo may tama
Neder beerkecha nefashot ketiv
Ze hakkelal davar shehanneshama teluya bo leetoye min haarkubba ulmala

Tanu rabbanan hammaarich chatzi erech keli rabbi meir omer noten damav vachachamim omrim lo amar kelum rava chalash ul legabbeh abbaye verabbanan veyatvi vekaamri bishlama rabbi meir kasavar en adam motzi devarav levattala la shena kullo vela shena chetzo
Ella rabbanan may kasavri i adam motzi devarav levattala afilu kullo name vei en adam motzi devarav levattala afilu chetzo name
Amar lehu rava veabbaye rabbanan dehacha kerabbi meir savri lah vesavri lah kerabbi shimon savri lah kerabbi meir deamar en adam motzi devarav levattala
Vesavri lah kerabbi shimon deamar shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevim kulleh orcheh leitnaddove palgeh lav orcheh leitnaddove
Haomer erko shel peloni alay umet hannoder ku may nihu sheamad baddin
Hayenu hach sefa itzterich leh damav shel peloni alav umet hannoder yittenu hayyorshim
b: Mahu detema kevan dela amaduhu la ishtabud nichse ka mashma lan kevan deamad baddin ishtabode ishtabud nichse veumdana galloye milta vealma hu
Matni shor ze ola uvayit ze korban umet hashshor venafal habbayit patur milleshallem shor ze alay ola uvayit ze alay korban met hashshor venafal habbayit chayyav leshallem
Gema amar rabbi chiyya bar rav lo shanu ella deamar deme shor ze alay ola aval amar shor ze alay ola kevan deamar ze vamet eno chayyav beachrauto alay lahavio kaamar
Metivi shor ze ola hashshor hekdesh umoalin bo met o nignav eno chayyav beachrauto shor ze alay ola hashshor hekdesh umoalin bo met o nignav chayyav beachrauto
Mi allima mimmatnitin deokemna dekaamar deme hacha name dekaamar deme
Veha middesefa dekaamar deme resha dela kaamar deme dekatane sefa deme shor ola hashshor chullin veen moalin bo met o nignav eno chayyav beachrauto avel chayyav beachraut damav
Resha vesefa dekaamar deme resha deamar yikdash hashshor ledamav vesefa dekaamar lichsheyyavou damav yikdeshu
Veha en adam makdish davar shello ba laolam amar rav yehuda amar rav ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar adam makdish davar shello ba laolam
Ika deamri amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veamri lah rame bar chama lerav chisda keman kerabbi meir deamar adam makdish davar shello ba laolam amar leh veella keman
Veika dematne lah aha hammaskir bayit lachavero venitnaggea af al pi shechalato kohen omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha netatzo chayyav lehaamid lo bayit

a: Hikdisho haddar bo maale sachar lahekdesh hikdisho haddar bo hechi matze makdesh leh ish ki yakdish beto kodesh amar rachamana ma beto birshuto af kol birshuto hachi kaamar hikdisho maskir haddar bo maale sachar lahekdesh
Hikdisho maskir hechi dayar beh bimila kae vetu maale sachar lahekdesh kevan dimal beh nafek leh sachar lechullin
Deamar lichsheyyavo secharo yikdash veha en adam makdish davar shello ba laolam

Amar rav yehuda amar rav ha manni rabbi meir hi deamar adam makdish davar shello ba laolam ika deamri amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veamri lah rav mari bar chama lerav chisda keman kerabbi meir deamar adam makdish davar shello ba laolam amar leh veella keman
Matni chayyave arachin memashkenin otan chayyave chattaot vaashamot en memashkenin otan chayyave olot ushlamim memashkenin otan
Af al pi sheen mitkapper lo ad sheyyitratztze shenneemar lirtzono kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani vechen atta omer begite nashim kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani
Gema amar rav pappa peamim shechayyave chattaot memashkenin otan chayyave olot en memashkenin otan

Chayyave chattaot memashkenin otan bechattat nazir dechevan deamar mar im gilach al echad mishsheloshtan yatza veim nizrak alav echad min haddamim huttar hannazir lishtot yayin velitamme lemetim pasha bah vela mayete
Chayyave olot en memashkenin otan beolat yoledet
May nihu deakdemah kera vehaamar rava lemikraah hikdimah hakkatuv
Ella beolat metzora detanya rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yehuda ben beroka omer keshem shechattato vaashamo ochavto kach olato ochavto
Veaf al pi sheen mitkapper lo ad sheyyitratztze tanu rabbanan yakriv oto melammed shekkofin oto yachol beal korcho talmud lomar lirtzono ha ketzad kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani
Amar shemuel ola tzericha daat shenneemar lirtzono may ka mashma lan tenena af al pi sheen mitkapper lo ad sheyyitratztze shenneemar lirtzono
La tzericha defaresh leh chavreh mahu detema ki baenan daat middideh aval middechavreh la ka mashma lan zimnin dela nicha leh delikappar bemide dela dideh
Metivi chattato vaashamo shel peloni alay
b: Ledaat yatza shello ledaat lo yatza
Olato ushlamav shel peloni alay ben ledaat ben shello ledaat yatza
Amar lecha shemuel ki tanya hahi bishat kappara deiratztzi bishat hafrasha ki kaamena ana bishat hafrasha

Ufliga deulla deamar ulla lo chilku ben chattat leola ella shechattat tzericha daat bishat hafrasha veola en tzericha daat bishat hafrasha aval bishat kappara ide veide ledaat yatza shello ledaat lo yatza
Metivi chattato vaashamo olato ushlamav shel peloni alay ledaat yatza shello ledaat lo yatza
Shemuel moke lah bishat hafrasha ulla moke lah bishat kappara amar rav pappa matneyata ahadade la kashyan ha bishat kappara ha bishat hafrasha
Veamorae leamorae name la kashya shemuel moke kammayeta bishat kappara batrayeta bishat hafrasha ulla moke ipcha amorae vadday peligi peshita
Mahu detema may bishat hafrasha dekaamar shemuel af bishat hafrasha veaf al gav dehach kammayeta teuvteh ka mashma lan
Vechen begite nashim kofin vechu amar rav sheshet hay man demasar modaa aggita modaeh modaa peshita
La tzericha deasseuh veiratztzi mahu detema battole batteleh ka mashma lan
Deim ken litne ad sheyyitten may ad sheyyomar ad dimvattel leh lemodaeh
Hadaran alach haomer mishkali
Matni shum hayetomim sheloshim yom veshum hahekdesh shishshim yom umachrizin babboker uvaerev

Gema may shena babboker uvaerev amar rav yehuda amar rav bishat hotzaat poalim uvishat hachnasat poalim bishat hotzaat poalim deika denicha lemizban amar lehu lefoalim ezilu sayeru lah nihalay bishat hachnasat poalim denidchar deamar lehu nezil nishayelinhu
Tanya name hachi shum hayetomim sheloshim yom veshum hahekdesh shishshim yom umachrizin babboker uvarev bishat hotzaat poalim uvishat hachnasat poalim
Omer sede feloni besimaneha uvimtzareha kach hi yafa vechach hi shuma kol harotze likach yavo veyikkach al menat liten leishsha bichtubbatah ulvaal chov bechovo
Lema li lememar al menat liten leishsha ketubbatah ulvaal chov chovo deika denicha leh bevaal chov demekel bezuze veika denicha leh beishsha deshakla al yad al yad

a: Tanu rabbanan shum hayetomim sheloshim yom veshum hahekdesh shishshim yom divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer shum hayetomim shishshim yom veshum hahekdesh tishim yom vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze shishshim yom amar rav chisda amar avimi halacha shum hayetomim shishshim yom

Yatev rabbi chiyya bar avin vekaamar leha shemata amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerabbi chiyya bar avin shishshim kaamratte o sheloshim kaamratte amar leh shishshim ditomim o dehekdesh amar leh ditomim
Kerabbi meir o kerabbi yehuda amar leh kerabbi meir veha rabbi meir sheloshim kaamar
Amar leh hachi amar rav chisda meavimi kulfe tave belai alah deha shemata ba lehachriz retzufim sheloshim
Besheni uvachamishi shishshim veaf al gav dechi chashev lehu mar leome hachraza la hau ella temanesar yome kevan demashcha milta shami inashe
Amar rav yehuda amar rav assi en nizkakin lenichse yetomim ella im ken hayeta ribbit ochelet bahen verabbi yochanan omer o lishtar sheyyesh bo ribbit o lichtubbat ishsha mishshum mezone
Verav assi may tama la amar lichtubbat ishsha deha takkinu le rabbanan maase yadeha veidach zimnin dela safka

Tenan shum hayetomim sheloshim yom veshum hahekdesh shishshim yom umachrizin babboker uvaerev bemay askinan ilema bevaal chov goy mi tzayet ella peshita bevaal chov yisrael i dekaachel ribita mi shavkinan leh veella dela kaachel ribita vekatane nizkakin

Bishlama lerabbi yochanan moke lah bichtubbat ishsha ella lerav assi kashya amar lecha rav assi ulrabbi yochanan mi nicha mi shavkinan mezone devadday ka mafseda venaktinan hachraza dela yadinan i marvechinan i la marvechinan
Ha la kashya betovaat ketubbatah bevet din kidrav yehuda amar shemuel deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel hattovaat ketubbatah bevet din en lah mezonot
I hachi izdekoke la mizdakkinan lah ella kevan deizdakkinan lah meikara mizdakkinan lah levassof
Mikkol makom lerav assi kashya leolam bevaal chov goy shekkibel alav ladun bedine yisrael
I hachi ribbit name la lishkol shekkibel alav lazo velo kibel alav lazo

Ta shema en nifrain minnichse yetomim ella min hazziburit bemay askinan ilema bevaal chov goy mi tzaet ella peshita bevaal chov yisrael i achel ribita mi shavkinan leh ella dela achel ribita vekatane nizkakin
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan moke lah bichtubbat ishsha ella lerav assi kashya amar lecha rav assi ulrabbi yochanan mi nicha i ketubba may irya miyyatme afilu mineh dideh name beziburit
Ha la kashya rabbi meir hi deamar ketubbat ishsha bevenonit umiyyatme beziburit
Mikkol makom lerav assi kashya leolam bevaal chov goy shekkibel alav ladun bedine yisrael i hachi ribbit name la nishkol shekkibel lezo velo kibel alav lazo
Ta shema al menat liten laishsha ketubbatah ulvaal chov chovo bishlama baal chov ben mar uven mar kidshannin
Ella ketubbatah bishlama lerabbi yochanan nicha ella lerav assi kashya
Hacha bemay askinan keshechayyav mode hashta deatet lehachi kullehu name keshechayyav mode

Marimar agbe ketubba ligrusha minnichse deyatme amar leh ravina leammemar vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav assi en nizkakin lenichse yetomin ella im ken hayeta ribbit ochelet bahen rabbi yochanan omer o lishtar sheyyesh bo ribbit o lichtubbat ishsha mishshum mezone
Vaafilu rabbi yochanan la kaamar ella bealmana dekamafseda mezone aval gerusha la
Amar leh ha anan derabbi yochanan mishshum china matninan lah
Amar rav nachman meresha la hava mizdekikna lenichse yatme kevan dishmana leha derav huna chavrin mishshemeh derav yatme deachli dela didhu lezlu batar shivkayehu mikkan veelach mizdekikna
Meikara may tama la amar rav pappa periat baal chov mitzva veyatme la bene mebad mitzva ninhu rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar emar tzerare atpeseh
May benayehu ika benayehu beshechayyav mode i name shammetuh umit beshamteh
Shelachu mittam deshammetuh umit beshamteh vehilcheta kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua
b: Tenan shum hayetomim sheloshim yom veshum hahekdesh shishshim yom umachrizin babboker uvaerev bemay askinan ilema bevaal chov goy mi tzaet ella peshita bevaal chov yisrael
Bishlama lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua moke lah beshechayyav mode ella lerav pappa kashya
Amar lecha rav pappa i baet ema ketubba mishshum china vei baet ema bevaal chov goy shekkibel alav ladun bedine yisrael
I kibel alav lintar lehu ad degadli shekkibel alav lazo velo kibel alav lazo
Ta shema al menat liten laishsha ketubbatah ulvaal chov chovo bemay askinan ilema bevaal chov goy mi tzayet ella peshita bevaal chov yisrael
Bishlama lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua moke lah beshechayyav mode ella lerav pappa bishlama ketubba mishshum china ella baal chov kashya
Leolam bevaal chov goy uchgon shekkibel alav ladun bedine yisrael i kibel alav lintar lehu ad degadli shekkibel alav lazo velo kibel alav lazo
Rava amar mishshum shovar amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava umi chayeshinan leshovar vehatnan hannifraat shello befanav lo tippara ella bishvua
Veamar rabbi acha sar habbira maase ba lifne rabbi yitzchak nappacha leantochya veamar lo shanu ella ketubbat ishsha mishshum china aval baal chov la verabba amar rav nachman afilu baal chov name
Vei chayeshatte leshovar hatam name nechush amar leh hatam kidamrinan tama shello yehe kol echad notel meotav shel chavero veholech veoshev lo bimdinat hayyam
Amar rava hilcheta en nizkakin lenichse yetomin veim amar tenu nizkakin sade zo umane zo nizkakin veen maamidin appotroppos sade setam umane setam nizkakin umaamidin appotroppos
Amri nehardae bechullehu nizkakin umaamidin appotroppos levad minnimtzet sade sheenah shello deachzoke sahade beshakkare la machzekinan

Amar rav ashe hilkach izdekoke la mizdakkinan deha amar rava hilcheta en nizkakin vei mizdakkinan mokminan appotroppos deamri nehardae bechullehu nizkakin umaamidin appotroppos levad minnimtzet sade sheenah shello deachzoke sahade beshakkare la machzekinan

a: Matni hammakdish nechasav vehayeta alav ketubbat ishsha rabbi eliezer omer kesheyegarshenna yiddor hanaa rabbi yehoshua omer eno tzarich kayyotze bedavar amar rabban shimon ben gamliel af hearev laishsha bichtubbatah vehaya balah megarshah yaddirenna hanaa shemma yaase kinunya al nechasim shel ze veyachzir et ishto
Gema bemay kamipalgi rabbi eliezer savar adam ose kinunya al hahekdesh verabbi yehoshua savar en adam ose kinunya al hahekdesh
Veella ha deamar rav huna shechiv mera shehikdish kol nechasav veamar mane lifloni beyadi neeman chazaka en ose kinunya al hekdesh lema ketannae amrah lishmateh
La ad kan la peligi ella bevari aval bishchiv mera divre hakkol en adam ose kinunya al hahekdesh may tama en adam chote velo lo
Ika deamri bevari dechulle alma la peligi deen adam ose kinunya al hekdesh vehacha beneder shehuddar berabbim kamipalgi mar savar yesh lo hafara umar savar en lo hafara
Veibaet ema dechulle alma neder shehuddar barabbim yesh lo hafara vehacha beneder shehuddar al daat rabbim kamipalgi
Veella ha deamar ammemar neder shehuddar barabbim yesh lo hafara al daat rabbim en lo hafara lema ketannae amrah lishmateh vetu rabbi yehoshua omer eno tzarich eno moil mibe leh
Ella hacha bishela dehekdesh kamipalgi

Vehatanya hammakdish nechasav vehayeta alav ketubbat ishsha rabbi eliezer omer keshehu megarshah yiddor hanaa rabbi yehoshua omer eno tzarich veamar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hen hen divre bet shammay hen hen divre bet hillel
Shebbet shammay omrim hekdesh taut hekdesh uvet hillel omrim hekdesh taut eno hekdesh

Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechu moshe bar atzri arva dechalleteh hava verav huna bereh tzurba merabbanan hava udchika leh milta amar abbaye leka denasseveh etza lerav huna deligaresh lidvethu vetitba ketubbetah meavuh velahderah mihadaroy
Amar leh rava vehaanan yiddor hanaa tenan veabbaye attu kol dimgaresh beve dina megaresh lesof igallay milleta dechohen hava amar abbaye batar anya azla anuta
Umi amar abbaye hachi vehaamar abbaye ezehu rasha arum ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim kerabban gamliel
Bereh shane vetzurba merabbanan shane
Vetipok leh dearev dichtubba la mishtabad
b: Kabbelan hava hanicha leman deamar kabbelan af al gav delet leh nechasim lelove mishtabad ella leman deamar it leh mishtabad let leh la mishtabad may ika lememar
Ibaet ema rav huna hava leh veishteduf veibaet ema abba legabbeh bereh shabode meshabed nafsheh

Deitmar arev dichtubba divre hakkol la mishtabad kabbelan devaal chov divre hakkol mishtabad arev devaal chov vekabbelan dichtubba peligi ika leman deamar it leh nichse lelove mishtabad let leh la mishtabad veika leman deamar af al gav delet leh mishtabad
Vehilcheta bechullehu af al gav delet leh name mishtabad levar mearev dichtubba deaf al gav deit leh la mishtabad may tama mitzva kaaved vela mide chassereh
Hahu gavra dezabbeninhu lenichseh veka megarshah lidvethu shalchah rav yosef bereh derava lekammeh derav pappa arev tenan hekdesh tenan lokeach mahu amar leh tanna ki rochla nichashshev venezil
Nehardae amri ditnan tenan dela tenan la tenan amar rav mesharsheya may tama dinhardae bishlama hekdesh mishshum revach dehekdesh arev name mitzva hu daavad velav mide chassereh
Ella lokeach mikkede mida yada dechol chad vechad ika aleh ketubba ammay nezil venizbon ihu hu deafsed annafsheh

Matni hammakdish nechasav vehayeta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov en haishsha yechola ligbot ketubbatah min hahekdesh velo baal chov et chovo ella happode pode al menat liten leishsha bichtubbatah ulvaal chov et chovo hikdish tishim mane vehaya chovo mea mane mosif od dinar ufode et hannechasim haellu al menat liten laishsha ketubbatah ulvaal chov et chovo
Gema lema li lememar happode pode mishshum derabbi avahu deamar rabbi avahu shello yomru hekdesh yotze belo pidon
Matnitin dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel detanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im haya chovo keneged hekdesho pode
Veim lav eno pode verabbanan ad kamma amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet ad palga
Matni af al pi sheamru chayyave arachin memashkenin oto otan notnin lo mezon sheloshim yom uchsut shenem asar chodesh mitta mutztzaat vesandalav utfillav lo aval lo leishto ulvanav
Im haya umman noten lo shene kele ummanut mikkol min umin charash notnin lo shene maatzadin ushne megerot rabbi eliezer omer im haya ikar noten lo tzimdo chammar noten lo chamoro
Haya lo min echad merubbe umin echad muat en omer limkor et hamrubbe velikach min hammuat ella notnin lo shene minin min hamrubbe vechol sheyyesh lo min hammuat hammakdish nechasav maalin lo tefilav
Gema may tama deamar kera

a: Veim mach hu meerkecha hachayehu meerkecha
Aval lo leishto uvanav vechu may tama hu meerkecha velo ishto uvanav meerkecha
Rabbi eliezer omer im haya ikar noten lo tzimdo verabbanan hanhu lav kele ummanut ninhu ella nechasim ninhu
Haya lo min echad peshita ki hechi desaggi leh ad hashta hashta name saggi leh
Mahu detema ad haidana dahava leh leoshole hava moshli leh hashta deleka demoshel leh la ka mashma lan
Hammakdish et nechasav maalin lo tefilin hahu gavra dezabbeninhu lenichseh ata lekammeh derav yemar amar lehu salliku leh tefilin may ka mashma lan matnitin hi hammakdish nechasav maalin lo tefilav
Mahu detema hatam hu desavar mitzva ka avedna aval leinyan zabbone mitzva degufeh la mezabben inish ka mashma lan
Matni echad hammakdish nechasav veechad hammaarich atzmo en lo bichsut ishto velo bichsut banav velo betzeva shetztzava lishman velo besandalim chadashim shellekachan lishman

Af al pi sheamru avadim nimkarin bichsutan leshevach sheim tillakach lo kesut bishloshim dinar meshubbach mane vechen para im mamtinin otah laitles meshubbachat hi vechen margalit im maalin otah lakkerach meshubbachat hi en lahekdesh ella mekomo ushato
Gema tanu rabbanan venatan et haerkecha bayyom hahu shello yeshahe margalit lekallim kodesh la setam hahekdeshot levedek habbayit
Hadaran alach shum hayetomim
Matni en makdishin lifne hayyovel pachot mishte shanim velo goalin achar hayyovel pachot mishshana achat en mechashshevin chodashim lahekdesh aval hekdesh mechashshev chodashim
Gema urminhu makdishin ben lifne hayyovel ben leachar hayyovel uvishnat hayyovel atzmah lo yakdish veim hikdish enah kedosha
Rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu en makdishin ligael begerua pachot mishte shanim vechevan deen makdishin ligael begerua pachot mishte shanim yehe adam chas al nechasav veal yakdish pachot mishte shanim
Itmar hammakdish sadehu bishnat hayyovel atzmah rav amar kedosha venoten chamishshim ushmuel amar enah kedosha kol ikar
Matkef lah rav yosef bishlama leinyan mechira diflig shemuel aleh derav ika lememar kal vachomer uma mechura kevar yotza achshav sheenah mechura eno din shello timacher
Ella hacha mi ika lememar kal vachomer veha tenan higgia yovel velo nigala kohanim nichnasin letochah venotnin dameha divre rabbi yehuda
Shemuel kerabbi shimon sevira leh deamar nichnasin velo notnin
b: Verav savar sof sof labbealim mi kahadra lechohanim hu denafka vechohanim mishshulchan gavoha ka zachu
May tama derav deamar kera veim mishshenat hayyovel ushnat hayyovel bakkelal
Ushmuel mi ketiv veim bishnat hayyovel mishshenat hayyovel ketiv mishshana sheachar hayyovel
Bishlama lerav hayenu dichtiv im mishshenat hayyovel veim achar hayyovel ella lishmuel may achar hayyovel achar achar
Metivi makdishin ben lifne hayyovel ben leachar hayyovel uvishnat hayyovel atzmah lo yakdish veim hikdish enah kedosha amar lecha rav enah kedosha begerua aval kedosha venotnin chamishshim
Mikkelal delifne hayyovel kedosha ligael begerua veha rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu en makdishin ligael begerua pachot mishte shanim
Amar lecha rav ha manni rabbanan hi vaana deamri kerabbi deamar rishon verishon bakkelal shevii ushvii bakkelal hacha name bishnat ushnat hayyovel bakkelal
I kerabbi pundeon may avidteh
Vechi tema let leh vehatnan hikdish shettayim veshalosh shanim lifne hayyovel rabbi omer omer ani noten sela ufundeon rabbi kerabbi yehuda sevira leh deamar shenat chamishshim ola lechan ulchan
Lishmuel lema rabbi kerabbanan sevira leh dei kerabbi yehuda sela ushte fundeonot mibe leh al korchach lishmuel rabbi kerabbanan sevira leh
Ta shema velo goalin achar hayyovel pachot mishshana bishlama lishmuel lo goalin leachar yovel pachot mishshana ella lerav may achar yovel shana
Mi savratte achar yovel mammash may achar yovel

a: Beemtza yovel dechol kamma dela malya leh shana la megara leh

May ka mashma lan deen mechashshevin chodashim im hahekdesh ha behedya katane en mechashshevin chodashim im hahekdesh ma taam kaamar ma taam lo goalin leachar yovel pachot mishshana mishshum deen mechashshevin chodashim im hahekdesh

En mechashshevin chodashim vechu tanu rabbanan minnayin sheen mechashshevin chodashim im hahekdesh talmud lomar vechishshav lo hakkohen et hakkesef al pi hashshanim hannotarot shanim atta mechashshev vei atta mechashshev chodashim
Minnayin sheim atta rotze laasot chodashim lashshana ose hechi dame kegon deakdesheh befalga dearbein vetamne
Talmud lomar vechishshav lo hakkohen mikkol makom

Matni hammakdish sadehu bishat hayyovel noten bezera chomer seorim chamishshim shekel kasef hau sham nekaim amukkim asara tefachim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim enan nimdadin immah pachot mikkan nimdadin immah

Hikdishah shettayim veshalosh shanim lifne hayyovel noten sela ufundeon leshana veim amar hareni noten devar shana beshana en shomin lo ella noten et kullo keechad echad bealim veechad kol haadam ma ben bealim lechol adam ella shebbealim notnin chomesh vechol adam en notnin chomesh
Gema tana kor zera velo kor tevua mappolet yad velo mappolet shevarim tane levi lo meubbe vela medek ella benoni
Hau sham nekaim amukkim ku velikdeshu beanpe nafshayehu

Vechi tema kevan dela hau bet kor la hao kadshi vehatanya sede ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef en li ella shehikdish kainyan hazze minnayin lerabbot letech vachatzi letech sea vetarkav vachatzi tarkav talmud lomar sade mikkol makom
Amar mar ukva bar chama hacha binkaim meleim mayim delav bene zeria ninhu dayeka name dekatane dumya dislaim shema minah
I hachi pachot mikkan name hanhu negane deara mikru shidre deara mikru
Hikdishah shettayim veshalosh vechu tanu rabbanan
Venigra meerkecha af min hahekdesh sheim achalah hekdesh shana o shettayim i name lo achalah ella shehayeta lefanav noten sela ufundeon leshana

Veim amar hareni noten ku tanu rabbanan minnayin sheim amru bealim harenu notnin devar shana beshana sheen shomin lahem talmud lomar vechishshav lo hakkohen et hakkesef ad sheyehe kesef kullo keechad echad bealim veechad kol adam ma ben bealim lechol adam shehabbealim notnin chomesh vechol adam en notnin chomesh
Matni hikdishah ugalah enah yotza miyyado bayyovel gealah beno yotza leaviv beovel gealah acher o echad mehakkerovim ugalah miyyado yotza lakkohanim bayyovel
Gealah echad min hakkohanim vahare hi tachat yado lo yomar hoil vehi yotza lakkohanim bayyovel vahare hi tachat yede hare hi shelli ella yotza mittachat yado umitchalleket lechol echav hakkohanim
b: Gema tanu rabbanan
Im lo yigal et hassade bealim veim machar et hassade gizbar
Leish acher leacher velo labben atta omer leacher velo labben o eno ella leacher velo laach keshehu omer ish hare ach amur ha ma ani mekayyem acher velo labben
Uma raita lerabbot et habben ulhotzi et haach merabbe ani habben shekken kam tachat aviv liida uleved ivri
Adderabba merabbe ani et haach shekken kam tachat achiv leyibum kelum yesh yibbum ella bimkom sheen ben ha yesh ben en yibbum
Vetipok leh dehacha tarte vehacha chada
Mishshum deeved ivri mehay pircha name hu denafka leh kelum yesh yibbum ella bimkom sheen ben
Bae rabba bar avuh bat mahu shettaamid sade leaviha kevan dilinyan yibbum ben uvat ki hadade patri mokma o dilma kevan dilinyan nachala bat bimkom ben ki acher damya la mokma
Ta shema detana deve rabbi yishmael kol shehu acher bimkom ben veha name bimkom ben ki acher damya
Bae rabbi zera ishsha mi maamid lah sade baal mokem lah shekken yorshah o dilma ben mokem lah shekken notel barauy kevammuchzak teku
Bea mineh rame bar chama merav chisda hikdishah pachot mishte shanim lifne hayyovel mahu shettetze lakkohanim
Amar leh may datach venigra meerkecha vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel devat geraon in delav bat geraon la
Adderabba im lo yigal hassade vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel vehay name bat geulla hi
Gealah echad min hakkohanim ku tanu rabbanan lakkohen tihye achuzzato ma talmud lomar

Minnayin lesade sheyyotza lakkohanim bayyovel ugalah echad min hakkohanim minnayin shello yomar hoil veotza lakkohen hare tachat yadi uthe shelli vedin hu beshel acherim ani zoche beshel atzmi lo kol shekken
Talmud lomar achuzzato achuzza shello veen ze shello ha ketzad yotza mittachat yado umitchalleket leechav hakkohanim
Matni higgia yovel velo nigala hakkohanim nichnasin letochah venotnin et dameha divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer nichnasin velo notnin

Rabbi eliezer omer lo nichnasin velo notnin ella nikret sede retushin ad hayyovel hashsheni higgia hayyovel hashsheni velo nigala nikret retushe retushin ad hayyovel hashshelishi leolam en hakkohanim nichnasin letochah ad sheyyigalenna acher
Gema may tama derabbi yehuda gamar kodesh kodesh mimmakdish bayit
Ma lehallan bedamim af kan bedamim
Verabbi shimon gamar kodesh kodesh mikkivse atzeret ma lehallan bechinnam af kan bechinnam
Verabbi yehuda name nelaf mikkivse atzeret danin kodshe bedek habbayit

a: Mikkodshe bedek habbayit veen danin kodshe bedek habbayit mikkodshe mizbeach
Verabbi shimon name nelaf mimmakdish bayit danin davar shemmattana lakkohanim middavar shemmattana lakkohanim veen danin davar shemmattana lakkohanim middavar sheeno mattana lakkohanim
Rabbi eliezer omer lo nichnasin velo notnin
Amar rabba may tama derabbi eliezer amar kera veim lo yigal et hassade lo yiggael od veim machar et hassade vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel

Amar abbaye sakkina charifa mafseka kerae ella amar abbaye tama derabbi eliezer kidtanya lo yiggael yachol lo tehe nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna talmud lomar od lichmot shehayeta enah nigelet aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna
Emat ilema beovel rishon ammay enah nigelet sede achuzza name haveya ella peshita beovel sheni
Ulman ilema lerabbi yehuda verabbi shimon lechohanim nafka ella lav rabbi eliezer ushma minah tama derabbi eliezer mehacha
Vetisbera rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hay od may darshi beh ella hacha bemay askinan besade sheyyatza lakkohanim vehikdishah kohen veatu bealim lemifrekah
Salka datach amena la tifrok shettehe lefanav kisde mikna talmud lomar od lichmot shehayeta enah nigelet aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna
Vehatanya bishnat hayyovel yashuv hassade laasher kanahu meitto yachol yachzor laggizbar shellekacho mimmennu talmud lomar laasher lo achuzzat haaretz

Yeamer laasher lo achuzzat haaretz ma talmud lomar laasher kanahu meitto sade sheyyatzat lakkohanim umcharah kohen vehikdishah lokeach ugalah acher yachol tachzor labbealim harishonim talmud lomar laasher kanahu
Veitzterich lo yiggael veitztericha lemichtav laasher kanahu
Dei ketav rachamana lo yiggael dela ka hadra kelal aval hacha deka hadra tihdar lemarah kamma ketav rachamana laasher kanahu
Vei ketav rachamana laasher kanahu dela ka yahavi bealim dame aval hacha deka yahavi deme tekum bidayehu ketav rachamana lo yiggael
Vei ketav rachamana lo yiggael vela ketav od hava amena la tifrok kelal ketav rachamana od lichmot shehayeta enah nigelet aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna
May have alah amar rava amar kera vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel betzeto miyyad acher
b: Ibaya lehu bealim beovel sheni keacher damu o la
Ta shema lo yiggael yachol lo tehe nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna talmud lomar od lichmot shehayeta enah nigelet aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna
Emat ilema beovel rishon ammay enah nigelet achuzza name haveya ella peshita beovel sheni
Ulman i lerabbi yehuda verabbi shimon lechohanim nafka ella lav lerabbi eliezer ushma minah bealim beovel sheni keacher damu

Vetisbera rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hay od may darshi beh ella hacha bemay askinan besade sheyyatza lakkohanim vehikdishah kohen vaato bealim lemifrekah salka datach amena la tifrok shettehe kisde mikna talmud lomar od lichmot shehayeta enah nigelet aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna
Vehatanya yashuv hassade laasher kanahu meitto yachol yachzor laggizbar shellekachah hemennu talmud lomar laasher lo achuzzat haaretz
Ma talmud lomar laasher kanahu sade sheyyatza lakkohanim umcharah kohen vehikdishah lokeach ugalah acher yachol tachzor labbealim harishonim talmud lomar laasher kanahu
Veitzterich lemichtav lo yiggael veitzterich lemichtav laasher kanahu dei ketav rachamana lo yiggael dela ka hadra kelal ketav rachamana laasher kanahu
Vei ketav rachamana laasher kanahu dela kayahavi bealim deme aval hacha deyahavi bealim deme detekum bidayehu ketav rachamana lo yiggael
Vei ketav rachamana lo yiggael vela ketav od hava amena la tifrok kelal ketav rachamana od lichmot shehayeta enah nigelet aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna
May have alah ta shema rabbi eliezer omer gealah bealim beovel sheni yotza lakkohanim bayyovel
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe haanan la tenan hachi rabbi eliezer omer en hakkohanim nichnasin letochah ad sheyyigalenna acher amar leh bealim beovel sheni keacher damu

Ika deamri rabbi eliezer omer gealah beovel sheni enah yotza lakkohanim bayyovel amar leh ravina lerav ashe af anan name tenena rabbi eliezer omer en hakkohanim nichnasin letochah ad sheyyigalenna acher amar leh i mimmatnitin hava amena bealim beovel sheni keacher damu ka mashma lan
Matni hallokeach sade meaviv umet aviv veachar kach hikdishah hare hi kisde achuzza hikdishah veachar kach met aviv hare hi kesade mikna divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim hare hi kisde achuzza shenneemar im missede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato sade sheenah reuya lihot sede achuzza yatzta zo shehi reuya lihot sede achuzza
Sede mikna enah yotza lakkohanim bayyovel sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello hakkohanim vehalviyyim makdishin leolam vegoalin leolam ben lifne hayyovel ben leachar hayyovel

Gema tanu rabbanan minnayin lelokeach sade meaviv vehikdishah veachar kach met aviv minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza talmud lomar veim missede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato sade sheenah reuya lihot sede achuzza yatzta zo sheruya lihot sede achuzza divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon

Rabbi meir omer minnayin lelokeach sade meaviv umet aviv veachar kach hikdishah minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza talmud lomar veim missede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato sade sheenah sede achuzza yatzat zo shehi sede achuzza
Lema beha ka mipalgi derabbi meir savar kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame
Rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon savri kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak bealma lerabbi shimon verabbi yehuda kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame

a: Vehacha kera ashkuach udrushoy lichtov rachamana im missede miknato asher lo sede achuzzato i name asher lo sede achuzza may missede achuzzato sade sheenah reuya lihot sede achuzza yatzta zo sheruya lihot sede achuzza

Hakkohanim vehalviyyim makdishin leolam vechu bishlama goalin itzterich leappoke middeyisrael dela parki ella ad yovel ka mashma lan dechohanim ulviyyim goalin leolam ella makdishin may irya kohanim ulviyyim afilu yisrael name
Vechi tema bishnat hayyovel atzmah hanicha lishmuel deamar bishnat hayyovel atzmah la kadsha ka mashma lan dechohanim ulviyyim makdishin leolam ella lerav may irya kohanim ulviyyim afilu yisrael name
Ultamach ben lifne hayyovel ben leachar hayyovel lema li ella ayede ditna resha lifne hayyovel ulachar hayyovel tena sefa name ben leachar hayyovel ben lifne hayyovel
Veayede ditna resha en makdishin velo goalin tena name sefa makdishin vegoalin
Hadaran alach en makdishin
Matni hammakdish et sadehu beshaa sheen hayyovel omer lo petach atta rishon shehabbealim notnin chomesh vechol adam en notnin chomesh

Maase beechad shehikdish sadehu mippene raatah amru lo petach atta rishon amar hare hi shelli beisar amar rabbi yose lo amar ze beisar ella bevetza shehekdesh nifde bechesef uvshave kesef amar lo higgaticha nimtza mafsid isar vesadehu lefanav
Gema hammakdish sadehu beshaa ku omrin vehatanya kofin may omrin name kofin veibaet ema meikara omrin i tzaet tzaet vei la kofin
Shehabbealim notnin chomesh vechu may irya shehabbealim notnin chomesh tipok leh deayede dachaviva aleh tafe ufarek lah veod mitzvat geulla baadon
Chada veod kaamar chada deayede dachaviva aleh tafe ufarek lah veod mitzvat geulla baadon hi veod shehabbealim notnin chomesh ku
Maase beechad shehikdish sadehu vechu lema beha kamipalgi derabbi yose savar shave kesef kechesef verabbanan savri shave kesef eno kechesef

Veha kayema lan deshave kesef kechesef dechulle alma shave kesef kechesef vehacha befodin bedavar sheen bechumsho shave peruta kamipalgi tanna kamma savar isar deika bechumsho shave peruta parkinan verabbi yose kevetza name parkinan
Amar lo higgaticha nimtza mafsid isar vesadehu lefanav setama kerabbanan

Matni amar echad hare hi shelli beeser selaim veechad omer beesrim veechad omer bishloshim veechad omer bearbaim veechad omer bachamishshim chazar bo shel chamishshim memashkenin minnechasav ad eser chazar bo shel arbaim memashkenin minnechasav ad eser
Chazar bo shel sheloshim memashkenin minnechasav ad eser chazar bo shel esrim memashkenin minnechasav ad eser chazar bo shel eser mochrin oto beshoveyo venifrain mishshel eser et hammotar
Habbealim omrim beesrim vechol adam omrim beesrim habbealim kodmin mippene shehem mosifin chomesh amar echad hare hi shelli beesrim veachat
b: Habbealim notnin esrim vashesh beesrim ushtayim habbealim notnin esrim vasheva
Beesrim veshalosh habbealim notnin esrim ushmone beesrim vearba habbealim notnin esrim vatesha beesrim vechamesh habbealim notnin sheloshim sheen mosifin chomesh al illuo shel ze
Amar echad hare shelli beesrim vashesh im ratzu habbealim liten sheloshim veechad vedinar habbealim kodmin veim lav omer lo higgaticha
Gema amar rav chisda lo shanu ella shebben arbaim omed bimkomo
Aval en ben arbaim omed bimkomo meshalleshin benehen
Tenan chazar bo shel arbaim memashkenin ad eser ammay liten bar chamshin bahadeh deleka ben chamishshim

Chazar bo ben sheloshim memashkenin minnechasav ad eser ammay veliten deven arbaim bahadeh deleka ben arbaim chazar bo ben esrim memashkenin minnechasav ad eser ammay liten deven sheloshim bahadeh deleka ben sheloshim

I hachi ema sefa chazar bo shel eser mochrin otah beshoveyah venifrain mishshel eser et hammotar litev deven esrim bahadeh vechi tema hacha name deleka ben esrim i hachi nifrain mishshel asara nifrain mimmennu mibe leh

Ella amar rav chisda la kashya kan bevat achat kan beze achar ze tanya name hachi chazru kullan keechad meshalleshin benehem veha anan tenan memashkenin minnechasav ad eser ella lav shema minah kidrav chisda shema minah
Ika derame lehu mirma tenan chazar bo shel eser mochrin otah beshoveyah venifrain mishshel eser et hammotar vehatanya meshalleshin benehem amar rav chisda la kashya kan bevat achat kan beze achar ze
Habbealim omrim beesrim vechol adam beesrim vechu lememra dechomesh adif urminhu baal habbayit omer besela veechad omer besela veisar shel sela veisar kodem mippene shemmosif al hakkeren
Hacha dechumsha ravecha dehekdesh hu chomesh adif hatam dechumsha ravecha devaal habbayit karna tifrok shappir chumsha la ichpat lan
Amar echad hare hu shelli ku beesrim vechamesh notnin sheloshim velemru habbealim ata gavra bacharikin daamur bealim dinar
Velitne dinar la dak vela veha katane im ratzu habbealim liten sheloshim veechad vedinar bealim kodmin ella amar rava daamur bealim peruta vela dak
Sheen mosifin chomesh al illuo ku amar rav chisda lo shanu ella shello nishom hekdesh bishlosha aval nishom hekdesh bishlosha mosifin
Tanya name hachi bet shammay omrim mosifin uvet hillel omrim en mosifin hechi dame i la nishom may tama devet shammay ella denishom
Lema rav chisda deamar kevet shammay leolam dela nishom uvet shammay machmirin
I baet ema leolam denishom veefoch bet shammay omrim en mosif velitneyah gabbe kulle bet shammay vechumre bet hillel ella leolam delo nishom uvet shammay machmirin
Amar echad hare hi shelli beesrim vashesh ku ratzu in lo ratzu la
Amri ata gavra bacharikin
Vedinar may avidteh amar rav sheshet hachi kaamar im ratzu bealim meikara liten cheshbon hammaggia leechad ushloshim vedinar

a: Hechi dame daamur beesrim veechad habbealim kodmin veim lav omer lo higgaticha

Matni macharim adam mitztzono umibbekaro umeavadav umishshifchotav hakkenaanim umissede achuzzato veim hechrim et kullam enam muchramim divre rabbi eliezer amar rabbi elazar ben azarya ma im laggavoha en adam rashshay lehachrim kol nechasav al achat kamma vechamma sheyehe adam chas al nechasav
Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan mikkol asher lo velo kol asher lo meadam velo kol adam mibbehema velo kol behema missede achuzza velo kol sede achuzza

Yachol lo yachrim veim hechrim yehu muchramin talmud lomar ach divre rabbi eliezer amar rabbi elazar ben azarya ma im laggavoha en adam rashshay lehachrim kol nechasav al achat kamma vechamma sheyehe adam chas al nechasav
Utzricha dei ketav rachamana mikkol asher lo hava amena kol deit leh la lachrem aval min echad lachremeh kulleh ketav rachamana meadam velo kol adam
Vei ketav rachamana meadam dela saggi leh bela avoda aval sade saggi leh bedisturan vei ashmeinan hane tarte mishshum dehacha chiyyuta vehacha chiyyuta aval metaltelin lachreminhu kullehu tzerichi
Behema lema li lechidtanya yachol yachrim adam beno uvitto avdo veshifchato haivriyyim usde miknato talmud lomar behema ma behema yesh lo reshut lemochrah af kol sheyyesh lo reshut lemochrah
Vahalo bitto ketanna yesh lo reshut lemochrah yachol yachrimenna talmud lomar behema ma behema yesh lo reshut lemochrah leolam af kol sheyyesh lo reshut lemochrah leolam
Amar rabbi elazar ben azarya im laggavoha en adam rashshay ku hayenu tanna kamma
Ika benayehu derabbi ila deamar rabbi ila beusha hitkinu hamvazbez al yevazbez yoter mechomesh
Maase beechad shebbikkesh levazbez yoter mechomesh velo hinnichu lo chaverav umannu rabbi yeshevav veamri lah rabbi yeshevav velo hinnichu lo chaverav umannu rabbi akiva

Matni hammachrim beno uvitto veavdo veshifchato haivrim usde miknato en muchramin sheen adam machrim davar sheeno shello hakkohanim vehalviyyim en machrimin divre rabbi yehuda rabbi shimon omer hakkohanim en machrimin shehacharamin shellahen vehalviyyim machrimin sheen hacharamin shellahen
Amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yehuda bekarkaot shenneemar ki achuzzat olam hi lahem vedivre rabbi shimon bemittaltelin sheen hacharamin shellahen

Gema verabbi yehuda bishlama kohanim en machrimin shecharamin shellahen ella leviyyim bishlama mekarkee la machremi dichtiv ki achuzzat olam hi lahem ella mittaltele lachremuy amar kera mikkol asher lo umissede achuzzato makkish mittaltelin lekarkaot
Verabbi shimon bishlama kohanim kedaamaran ella leviyyim bishlama metaltelim lachrem dela makkesh ella mekarkee ammay hachtiv achuzzat olam hi lahem may machrimin name dekaamar mittaltele

Veha middekatane sefa amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yehuda bimkarkee vedivre rabbi shimon bemittaltele mikkelal derabbi shimon mekarkee name kaamar hachi kaamar amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yehuda lerabbi shimon bekarkaot sheaf rabbi shimon lo nechlak ella bemittaltelin aval bekarkaot mode leh
Amar rabbi chiyya bar avin hechrim metaltelin notnan lechol kohen sheyyirtze shenneemar kol cherem beyisrael
b: Lecha yihye hechrim sedotav notnan lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar shenneemar kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato vegamar lakkohen lakkohen miggezel hagger
Vehatam menalan detanya la lakkohen kenao hashshem untano lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar
Atta omer lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar o eno ella lechol kohen sheyyirtze keshehu omer millevad el hakkipurim asher yechapper bo alav hare bechohen shebbeoto mishmar hakkatuv medabber
Sade hayyotza lakkohanim bayyovel notnah lammishmar sheppaga bo yovel ibaya lehu paga bo beshabbat may amar rav chiyya bar amme mishshemeh dechulpana notnah lammishmar hayyotze
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak tanya nimtzeta atta omer echad yovel veechad sheviit meshammetin keechad ella sheyyovel bitchilato vehashshemitta besofah
Adderabba mishshum hachi havay ema mippene shehayyovel ku

Bishlama sheviit besofah dichtiv mikketz sheva shanim taase shemitta ella yovel bitchilato beom hakkipurim hu dichtiv bayyom hakkipurim taaviru shofar bechol artzechem ha manni rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi deamar merosh hashshana hu dechayel yovel
Shamah chizkiyya bar bilvati vaazal amar kammeh derabbi avahu velakesh mittaltele lekarkaot
Lav tannae hi deika demakkesh veika dela makkesh keman deamar la makkeshinan
Matni cherme kohanim en lahem pidon ella nitanim lakkohanim kitruma rabbi yehuda ben betera omer setam charamim levedek habbayit shenneemar kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu la
Vachachamim omrim setam charamim lakkohanim shenneemar kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato im ken lamma neemar kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu la shechal al kodshe kadashim veal kadashim kallim
Machrim adam et kodashav ben kodshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim im neder noten demehen
Veim nedava noten et tovatan shor ze ola omdin kamma adam rotze liten beshor ze lehaaloto ola af al pi sheeno rashshay
Habbechor ben tam ben baal mum machrimin oto vechetzad podim oto omdin kamma adam rotze liten bivchor ze litno leven bitto o leven achoto

a: Gema tanu rabbanan cherme chohanim en lahen pidon venitanin lakkohen charamim kol zeman shehen bevet bealim hare hen kehekdesh lechol divrehen shenneemar kol cherem beyisrael kodesh kadashim hu la netanan lechohen hare hen lechol divrehen kechullin shenneemar kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye
Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer setam charamim levedek habbayit ku bishlama rabbanan kidka mefarshi tamayehu vetama derabbi yehuda ben betira ella rabbi yehuda ben betira hay kisde hacherem may aved leh
Mibaya leh lechidtanya kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato ma talmud lomar minnayin lechohen shehikdish sede chermo shello yomar hoil veotza lakkohanim vahare hi tachat yadi tehe shelli
Vedin hu beshel acherim ani zoche beshel atzmi lo kol shekken talmud lomar kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato
Vechi ma lamadnu missede cherem meatta hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed makkish sede chermo lisde achuzza shel yisrael
Ma sede achuzza shel yisrael yotza mittachat yado umitchalleket lakkohanim af sade chermo yotza mittachat yado umitchalleket leechav hakkohanim
Veidach mecherem hacherem veidach cherem hacherem la mashma leh
Verabbi yehuda ben betira dechal al kodshe kadashim veal kadashim kallim mena leh savar leh kerabbi yishmael
Amar rav halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira verav shavek rabbanan veaved kerabbi yehuda ben betira barayeta ipcha tanya shavek matnitin veaved kevarayeta rav matnitin name ipcha tane

May chazet deafchatte matnitin mikkamme barayeta nefech barayeta mikkamme matnitin rav gemareh gemir i hachi kerabbi yehuda ben betira kerabbanan mibe leh hachi kaamar lemay deafchitu vetanetu halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira
Hahu gavra deachreminhu lenichseh befumbedita ata lekammeh derav yehuda amar leh shekol arbea zuze veachel alayehu ushdinhu benahara velishtero lach alma kasavar setam charamim levedek habbayit
Keman kishmuel deamar hekdesh shave mane shechillo al shave peruta mechullal emar deamar shemuel shechillo lechattechilla mi amar
Hane mile bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam deika peseda aval bizman hazze afilu lechattechilla i hachi afilu peruta name parsome milleta
Amar ulla i havay hatam hava yahevna kullehu lechohanim alma kasavar ulla setam charamim lakkohanim
Metivi en eved ivri noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg shenneemar ad shenat hayyovel yaavod immach
Veen sede hacherem noheget ella bizman shehayyovel noheg shenneemar veyatza bayyovel veshav laachuzzato en batte are choma nohagin ella bizman shehayyovel noheg shenneemar lo yetze bayyovel

Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer en sede charamin nohagin ella bizman shehayyovel noheg shenneemar vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel kodesh la kisde hacherem rabbi shimon ben elazar omer en ger toshav noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg
Amar rav bivi may tama atya tov tov ketiv hacha ki tov lo immach uchtiv hatam battov lo lo tonennu
La kashya ha bimkarkee ha bemittaltele veha maase defumbedita bimkarkee name hava mekarkee dechutza laaretz kemittaltele deeretz yisrael dame
Matni rabbi yishmael omer katuv echad omer takdish vechatuv echad omer lo yakdish i efshar lomar takdish shehare kevar neemar lo yakdish i efshar lomar lo yakdish shehare kevar neemar takdish
Ha ketzad makdisho atta hekdesh illuy vei atta makdisho hekdesh mizbeach
Gm verabbanan al takdish mibe leh lelav takdish mibe leh lechidtanya minnayin lenolad bechor beedro shemmitzva lehakdisho shenneemar hazzachar takdish
Verabbi yishmael i la makdesh leh la kadesh kedushshato merechem hu vechevan dechi la makdesh leh kadosh la tzerich leakdosheh
Hadaran alach hammakdish sadehu
