b: Matni hammocher et sadehu bishat hayyovel eno muttar ligol pachot mishte shanim shenneemar bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach

Hayeta shenat shiddafon veyerakon o shenat sheviit enav ola min hamminyan narah o hovirah ola lo min hamminyan rabbi eliezer omer mecharah lo lifne rosh hashshana vehi melea perot hare ze ochel mimmenna shalosh tevuot bishte shanim
Gema hammocher sadehu bishat hayyovel vechu eno goel la katane ella eno muttar ligol alma kasavar isura name ika daafilu karkoshe zuze name asur
Vela mibaya mocher dekae baase dichtiv bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach ella afilu lokeach name kae baase devaenan shanim tikne veleka

Itmar hammocher sadehu bishnat hayyovel atzmah rav amar mechura veotza ushmuel amar enah mechura kol ikar may tama dishmuel kal vachomer uma mechura kevar yotza sheenah mechura eno din shello timacher
Ulrav la amrinan kal vachomer ki hay gavena vehatanya yachol yimkor adam et bitto keshehi naara amarta kal vachomer uma mechura kevar yotza achshav sheenah mechura eno din shello timacher
Hatam la hadra mizdabbena hacha hadra mizdabbena
Metivi achar hayyovel shanim tikne melammed shemmochrin samuch layyovel muflag min hayyovel minnayin talmud lomar lefi rov hashshanim ulfi meot hashshanim
Uvishnat hayyovel atzmah lo yimkor veim machar enah mechura amar lecha rav enah mechura lemispar shene tevuot aval mechura hi veotza

Vei izdabbone mizdabbena tekum birshuteh ad batar yovel uvatar yovel nechlah shene tevuot venahderah mi la tanya achalah shana achat lifne hayyovel mashlimin lo shana acheret achar hayyovel hatam nachet laachila hacha la nachet laachila
Amar rav anan shemait mineh demar shemuel tarte chada hach veidach hammocher avdo legoyim o bechutza laaretz yatza lecherut
Chada hadri zevine vachada la hadri zevine vela yadana he minayehu

Amar rav yosef nichze anan middetanya bevarayeta hammocher avdo bechutza laaretz yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur merabbo sheni shema minah middekare leh lesheni rabbo alma la hadri zevine vechi kaamar shemuel hacha enah mechura umaot chozrin

a: Verav anan barayeta la shemia leh vedishmuel mimmay deenah mechura umaot chozrin dilma enah mechura umaot mattana mide dehave ammekaddesh achoto deitmar hamkaddesh achoto rav amar maot chozrin ushmuel amar maot mattana
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef may chazet dekansinan leh lelokeach nikneseh lemocher
Amar leh lav achbera gannav ella chora gannav i lav achbera chora mena leh mistabbera hecha deiteh leisura kansinan
Hayeta shenat shiddafon ku hashta hovirah ola lo narah mibaya
Narah itzterich leh salka datach amena amrinan leh hav leh demeh velisak ka mashma lan

Rabbi eliezer omer mecharah lo ku tanya rabbi eliezer omer minnayin sheim mecharah lo lifne rosh hashshana melea perot shello yomar lo hannach lefanay kederech shehinnachti lefanecha talmud lomar bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach peamim sheadam ochel shalosh tevuot bishte shanim
Matni mecharah larishon bemane umachar rishon lashsheni bematayim eno mechashshev ella im harishon shenneemar asher machar lo
Mecharah larishon bematayim umachar harishon lashsheni bemane eno mechashshev ella im haacharon shenneemar vechishshav et shene mimkaro veheshiv et haodef laish asher machar lo laish asher betocho
Lo yimkor berachok veyigal bekarov beraa veyigal beyafa velo yilve veyigal velo yigal lachatzain uvahekdesh muttar bechullan ze chomer bahedot mibbahekdesh
Gema tanu rabbanan mecharah larishon bemane umcharah rishon lashsheni bematayim minnayin sheeno mechashshev ella im harishon talmud lomar laish asher machar lo
Mecharah larishon bematayim umachar harishon lashsheni bemane minnayin sheen mechashshevin ella im hashsheni talmud lomar laish laish asher betocho divre rabbi
Rabbi dostay ben yehuda omer mecharah lo bemane vehishbichah veamda al matayim minnayin sheeno mechashshev ella bemane shenneemar veheshiv et haodef haodef shebbeyado
Mecharah lo bematayim vehichsifa veamda al mane minnayin sheen mechashshevin ella bemane shenneemar veheshiv et haodef haodef shebbakkarka
May benayehu deiyyakar vezal veiyyakar
Umimmay dilkulla dilma lechumra
La salka datach degamar geulla geulla meeved ivri
Vehatam menalan detanya nimkar bemane vehishbiach veamad al matayim minnayin sheen mechashshevin ella mimmane shenneemar mikkesef miknato
Nimkar bematayim vehichsif veamad al mane minnayin sheen mechashshevin ella mimmane shenneemar kefi shanav
Veen li ella eved ivri hannimkar legoy shennigal veyado al haelona nimkar leyisrael minnayin talmud lomar sachir sachir ligzera shava
Amar abbaye
b: Hareni keven azzay beshuke teverya amar leh hahu merabbanan leabbaye ika lemidreshinhu lekulla veika lemidreshinhu lechumra mimmay dilkulla ema lechumra

La salka datach middeakkel rachamana gabbeh detanya ki tov lo immach immach bammaachal immecha bammishte shello tehe ochel pat nekiyya vehu ochel pat kibar atta shote yayin yashan vehu shote yayin chadash atta yashen al gabbe mochin vehu yashen al gabbe karka mikan amru hakkone eved ivri kekone adon leatzmo
Adderabba nachmir aleh midderabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina bo ure kamma kashe avakah shel sheviit

Adam nose venoten beferot sheviit lesof mocher et mittaltelav shenneemar bishnat hayyovel hazzot tashuvu ish el achuzzato uchtiv vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha davar hannikne miyyad leyad
Lo hirgish lassof mocher et sedotav shenneemar vechi yamuch achicha umachar meachuzzato

Lo bat leyado lassof mocher et beto shenneemar veish ki yimkor bet moshav ir choma may shena hatam dekaamar lo hirgish umay shena hacha dekaamar lo bat leyado kidrav huna deamar rav huna kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah huttera lo
Huttera lo salka datach ella ema naaset lo keheter
Lo bat leyado lassof shellove beribbit shenneemar vechi yamuch achicha vego uchtiv al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit

Lo bat leyado ad shemmocher et bitto shenneemar vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama veaf al gav devitto behay inyana letah nicha leinish delizabben beratte vela lezif beribita deilu hatam megara veazla veilu hacha ka mosfa veazla
Lo bat leyado lassof shemmocher et atzmo shenneemar ki yamuch achicha immach venimkar lach lo lach ella leger shenneemar leger velo leger tzedek ella leger toshav shenneemar leger toshav
Mishpachat ger ze haggoy keshehu omer o leeker mishpachat ger ze hannimkar venaase mesharet laavoda zara atzmah

Amar leh ha ahdereh kera vetana deve rabbi yishmael hoil vehalach umachar atzmo laavoda zara edche even acher hannofel talmud lomar geullat olam tihye lo uvayyovel yetze ema geulla tihye lo dela litamma baggoyim ulolam leinyan pidono nachmir
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ketiv im od rabbot bashshanim uchtiv im meat nishar bashshanim
Vechi yesh shanim merubbot veyesh shanim muatot ella nitrabba kaspo mikkesef miknato nitmaet kaspo kefi shanav
Veema hecha daavad tarte ufayeshi arbee litev leh arba mikkesef miknato vehecha daavad arba ufayeshi tarte litev leh tarte kefi shanav
Im ken nichtov im od rabbot shanim may bashshanim nitrabba kaspo bashshanim mikkesef miknato nitmaet kaspo bashshanim kefi shanav amar rav yosef darshinhu rav nachman lehane kerae kesinay
Lo yimkor berachok ku mena hane mile detanu rabbanan vehissiga yado yad atzmo shello yilve veyigal
Umatza perat lematzuy shello yimkor berachok veyigol bekarov bera veyigol beyafe kede geullato kede geulla hu goel veeno goel lachatzain

Lememra dematza hashta mashma urminhu umatza perat lemamtzi atzmo mikan amar rabbi eliezer im mishsheyyatza even mittachat yado hotzi halla et rosho vekiblah patur alma matza mide deiteh meikara mashma

Amar rava hacha meinyana dikra vehacha meinyana dikra hacha dumya dehissiga yado ma hissiga yado dehashta af matza name dehashta vehacha dumya deyaar ma yaar milta deiteh meikara af matza milta deiteh meikara
Uvhekdesh ku mena hane mile detanu rabbanan veim gaol yigal melammed shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain
Amar rabbi shimon ma taam lefi shemmatzinu bemocher sede achuzza sheyyippa kocho sheim higgia yovel velo nigala chozeret labbealim bayyovel hora kocho sheeno love vegoel veeno goel lachatzain
Aval makdish sede achuzza hoil shehora kocho sheim higgia yovel velo nigala yotza lakkohanim yippa kocho shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain

a: Tane chada love vegoel vegoel lachatzain vetanya idach eno love vegoel veeno goel lachatzain la kashya ha rabbanan veha rabbi shimon
Matni hammocher bet bevatte are choma hare ze goel miyyad vegoel kol shenem asar chodesh hare ze kemin ribbit veeno ribbit
Met hammocher yigal beno met hallokeach yigal miyyad beno en monin shana ella mishshaa shemmachar shenneemar ad melot lo shana

Keshehu omer temima lehavi et chodesh haibur rabbi omer liten lo shana veiburah higgia yom shenem asar chodesh velo nigala hayeta chaluta lo echad hallokeach veechad hannitan lo bemattana shenneemar latztzemitut
Gema matnitin dela kerabbi detanya rabbi omer yamim en yamim pachot mishshenayim
Verabbanan hay yamim may avdi leh mibe leh miyyom leom verabbi miyyom leom mena leh nafka leh mead tom shenat mimkaro

Verabbanan hahu mibe leh shenat mimkaro shello velo shenat shana shel minyan olam veyamim mibe lehu lemeet leet dei mead tom shenat mimkaro hava amena miyyom leom in meet leet la ketav rachamana yamim
Verabbi meet leet mena leh nafka leh mittemima verabbanan hahu mibe leh leiburah
Verabbi name ha mibe leh leiburah hachi name miyyom leom umeet leet mead tom shenat mimkaro nafka
Hare zo kemin ribbit vechu vehatanya hare zo ribbit gemura ella shehattora hittirattu
Amar rabbi yochanan la kashya ha rabbi yehuda veha rabbanan detanya hare shehaya noshe bachavero mane veasa lo sadehu mecher bizman shehammocher ochel perot muttar lokeach ochel perot asur

Rabbi yehuda omer af bizman shehallokeach ochel perot muttar amar rabbi yehuda maase bevayetos ben zonin sheasa sadehu mecher al pi rabbi elazar ben azarya velokeach ochel perot haya amru lo mishsham reaya mocher ochel perot haya velo lokeach
May benayehu tzad echad beribbit ika benayehu tanna kamma savar tzad echad beribbit asur verabbi yehuda savar tzad echad beribbit muttar
b: Rava amar dechulle alma tzad echad beribbit asur vehacha beribbit al menat lehachzir ika benayehu mar savar asur umar savar muttar
Met hammocher yigal beno peshita mahu detema veish ki yimkor bet moshav amar rachamana vehay lav mechar kamashma lan vehayeta geullato mikkol makom
Met hallokeach yigal miyyad beno vechu peshita mahu detema lakkone oto amar rachamana veha la kena ka mashma lan vehayeta geullato mikkol makom
En monin lo shana ella mishshaa shemmachar ku tanu rabbanan shana eni yodea im shana larishon im shana lashsheni keshehu omer ad melot lo shana temima heve shana larishon

Lemi chalut rabbi elazar omer larishon chalut rabbi yochanan amar lashsheni chalut bishlama lerabbi elazar dildideh ka manenan ella lerabbi yochanan may tama amar rabbi abba bar memel ma machar lo rishon lesheni kol zechut shettavo leyado

Amar rabbi abba bar memel machar shene batte are choma echad bachamishsha asar baadar harishon veechad beechad baadar hashsheni ze shemmachar lo baadar hashsheni kevan shehiggia yom echad baadar shel shana habbaa alta lo shana ze shemmachar lo bachamishsha asar shel adar harishon lo alta lo shana ad chamishsha asar baadar shel shana habbaa
Matkef lah ravina velema leh ana kadem shachen nura mikkamme didach mishshum daamar leh atte nechet leibura

Veamar rabbi abba bar memel noldu lo shene telaim echad bachamishsha asar shel adar harishon veechad beechad baadar hashsheni ze shennolad baadar hashsheni kevan shehiggia yom echad baadar shel shana habbaa alta lo shana ze shennolad lo bachamishsha asar baadar harishon lo alta lo shana ad chamishsha asar baadar shel shana habbaa
Matkef lah ravina velema leh ana kadem achel yerukka mikkammach didach mishshum daamar leh atte nechette leibura ana la nechetna leibura
Ha tu lema li hayenu hach mahu detema hatam dichtiv temima hacha dela ketiv temima la ka mashma lan deshana shana mehadade gamri

Keshehu omer temima ku rabbi omer liten shenat iburah tanu rabbanan shana temima rabbi omer mone shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha yamim keminyan yemot hachamma vachachamim omrim mone shenem asar chodesh miyyom leom veim nitabbera nitabbera lo
Higgia yom shenem asar chodesh velo nigal ku tanu rabbanan latztzemitut lachalutin davar acher latztzemitut lerabbot et hammattana may tama tzemit tzemitut
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa keman dela kerabbi meir dei kerabbi meir haamar mattana enah kemecher amar rav pappa afilu tema rabbi meir shane hacha derabbi rachamana latztzemitut
Amaru rabbanan lerav pappa vaamar lah rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa veha gabbe yovel dichtiv tashuvu lerabbot et hammattana verabbi meir la ka merabbe ella ha vadday dela kerabbi meir
Tanu rabbanan hammakdish bayit bevatte are choma hare ze goel vegoel leolam gealo acher miyyad hekdesh higgia yom shenem asar chodesh velo nigal haya chalut lo
Mena hane mile amar shemuel deamar kera lakkone oto vaafilu miyyad hekdesh velachleteh hekdesh amar kera ledorotav yatza hekdesh sheen lo dorot
Lo yetze bayyovel lema li amar rav safra lo nitzrecha ella lemocher bayit bevatte are choma ufaga bo yovel betoch shenato salka datach amena lipok beovel ka mashma lan lo yetze bayyovel

Matni barishona haya nitman yom shenem asar chodesh kede sheyehe chalut lo hitkin hillel sheyehe cholesh meotav lallishka vihe shover et haddelet venichnas ematay sheyyirtze hallaz yavo veyittol et meotav
Gema amar rava mittakkanato shel hallel hare ze gitich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz untanah lo middato megoreshet beal korcho enah megoreshet

a: Middeitzterich leh lehillel letakkone netina beal korcho haveya netina ha bealma netina beal korcho la haveya netina
Matkef lah rav pappa veitema rav ashe vedilma ki itztericha leh lehillel letakkone shello befanav aval befanav ben middato ben beal korcho haveya mattana

Ika deamri amar rava mittakkanato shel hillel hare ze gitich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz untanah lo ben middato ben beal korcho haveya netina vechi itzterich leh lehillel letakkone shello befanav aval befanav ben middato ben beal korcho haveya netina
Matkef lah rav pappa veitema rav shimi bar ashe vedilma ben befanav ben shello befanav middato in beal korcho la vehillel may deitzterich leh takken

Matni kol shehu lifnim min hachoma hare hu kevatte are choma chutz min hassadot rabbi meir omer af hassadot bayit habbanuy bachoma rabbi yehuda omer eno kevatte are choma rabbi shimon omer kotel hachitzon hi chomato

Gema tanu rabbanan bayit en li ella bayit minnayin lerabbot batte vaddim uvatte merchatzaot umigdalot veshovachin uvorot veshichin umarot talmud lomar asher bair yachol sheani merabbe af hassadot talmud lomar bayit divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi meir omer neemar bayit en li ella bayit minnayin lerabbot batte vaddim uvatte merchatzaot umigdalot veshovachin uvorot shichin umarot vaafilu sadot talmud lomar asher bair
Veella ha ketiv bayit amar rav chisda amar rav kattina cholsit umtzula ika benayehu vehatanya cholsit umtzula rabbi meir omer kevattim rabbi yehuda omer kesadot

Bayit habbanuy bachoma rabbi yehuda omer eno kevatte are choma amar rabbi yochanan ushnehem mikra echad darshu vattoridem bachevel bead hachallon ki vetah bekir hachoma uvachoma hi yoshavet rabbi shimon savar kifshateh dikra verabbi yehuda savar bachoma hi yoshavet velo beir choma

Matni ir sheggaggoteha chomatah vesheenah mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun enah kevatte are choma veellu hen batte are choma shalosh chatzerot shel shene vattim mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun kegon katzra hayeshana shel tzipori vechakra shel gush chalav veodfat hayeshana vegamla ugdod vechadid veono virushalayim vechen keotze bahen
Gema tanu rabbanan choma velo shur igar saviv perat litverya sheyyammah chomatah
Rabbi eliezer bar yose omer asher lo choma af al pi sheen lo achshav vehaya lo kodem lachen
Veellu hen batte are choma ku tana gamla baggalil ugdod beever hayyarden vechadid veono virushalayim bihuda may kaamar
b: Amar abbaye hachi kaamar ad gamla baggalil ad gedod beever hayyarden vechadid veono virushalayim bihuda
Rava amar gamla baggalil leappoke gamla dishar aratzot gedod beever hayyarden leappoke gedod dishar aratzot inach dela ika dichvatayehu la itzterich leh
Virushalayim mi michalat bah vehatanya asara devarim neemru birushalayim en habbayit chalut bah

Amar rabbi yochanan kirushalayim demukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun velo kirushalayim deilu yerushalayim en habbayit chalut bah veilu hacha habbayit chalut bah rav ashe amar lav amar rav yosef tere kadesh hao hacha name tere yerushalayim hao

Tanya rabbi yishmael berabbi yose lamma manu chachamim et ellu shekkeshealu bene haggola matzu ellu vekidshum aval rishonot batlu mishshebbatla kedushshat haaretz kasavar kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah velo kidsha leatid lavo

Urminhi amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose vechi ellu bilvad hau vahalo kevar neemar shishshim ir kol chevel argov kol elle arim betzurot ella lamma manu chachamim et ellu shekkeshealu bene haggola matzu ellu vekidshum kidshum ha amrinan dela tzerich lekaddoshinhu ella menaum

Velo ellu bilvad ella kol shettaale lecha masoret beyadcha meavotecha shemmukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun kol mitzot hallalu nohagot bah mippene shekkedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah vekidsha leatid lavo

Ibaet ema tere tannae vealliba derabbi yishmael veibaet ema chad minayehu rabbi elazar bar yose amrah detanya rabbi elazar bar yose omer asher lo choma af al pi sheen lo achshav vehaya lo kodem lachen

May tama deman deamar kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah velo kidsha leatid lavo dichtiv vayyaasu bene haggola hashshavim min hashshevi sukkot vayyeshvu vassukkot ki lo asu mime yeshua bin nun ken bene yisrael vego vattehi simcha gedola meod efshar ba david velo asu sukkot ad shebba ezra
Ella makkish biatam bime ezra leviatam bime yehoshua ma biatam bime yehoshua manu shemitin veovlot vekiddeshu are choma af biatan bime ezra manu shemitin veovlot vekiddeshu are choma

Veomer veheviacha Adonai elohecha el haaretz asher yarshu avotecha virishtah makkish yerushshatcha lirushshat avotecha ma yerushshat avotecha bechidush kol devarim hallalu af yerushshatcha bechidush kol devarim hallalu
Veidach divo rachame al yetzer daavoda zara uvatteleh veaggen zechuta alayehu ki sukka

Vehayenu deka kafed kera ilaveh dihoshua divchol duchta ketiv yehoshua vehacha ketiv yeshua bishlama moshe la bea rachame dela hava zechuta deeretz yisrael ella yehoshua dahava leh zechuta deeretz yisrael ammay la live rachame
Veha chetiv asher yarshu avotecha virishtah hachi kaamar kevan deyarshu avotecha yarashta atte

Umi manu shemitin veovlot hashta mishsheggalu shevet reuven veshevet gad vachatzi shevet menashshe batlu yovlot ezra dichtiv beh kol hakkahal keechad arba ribbo alpayim veshesh meot veshishshim hava mane
Detanya mishsheggalu shevet reuven veshevet gad vachatzi shevet hamnashshe batlu yovlot shenneemar ukratem deror baaretz lechol yoshveha bizman shekkol yoshveha aleha velo bizman sheggalu miktzatan
Yachol hau aleha vehen meoravin shevet binyamin bihuda veshevet yehuda bevinyamin yehe yovel noheg talmud lomar lechol yoshveha bizman sheyyoshveha ketikunan velo bizman shehen meoravin
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak manu yovlot lekaddesh shemitin

a: Hanicha lerabbanan deamri shenat chamishshim enah min hamminyan ella lerabbi yehuda deamar shenat chamishshim ola lechan ulchan lema li bishmitin saggi ha vadday dela kerabbi yehuda
Velo manu shemitin veovlot vehachtiv mikketz sheva shanim teshallechu ish et achiv haivri asher yimmacher lecha
Vehavenan behu mikketz sheva shanim vehachtiv vaavadcha shesh shanim veamar rav nachman bar yitzchak shesh lannimkar vesheva lannirtza
Hahu betochacha ketiv vekaamar navi hashillachtem vehachtiv vayyishmeu vayeshallechu

Ella amar rabbi yochanan yirmeya hechziran veyoshiyya ben amon malach alehen umna lan dahadur dichtiv ki hammocher el hammimkar lo yashuv efshar yovel batel venavi mitnabbe alav sheyyivtal ella melammed shehechziran yirmeya
Umnalan deyoshiyya malach alehen dichtiv vayyomer ma hatztziyyun hallaz asher ani roe vayyomru elav anshe hair hakkever ish haelohim asher ba mihuda vayyikra et haddevarim al hammizbeach bet el
Vechi ma tivo shel yoshiyyahu bevet el ella keshehechziran yirmeyahu yoshiyyahu malach alehem rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha gam yehuda shat katzir lach beshuvi shevut ammi
Matni batte hachatzerim notnin lahem koach yafe shebbevatte are choma vechoach yafe shebbassadot venigalin miyyad vechol shenem asar chodesh kevattim veotzin bayyovel uvgiron kesef kesadot
Gema tanu rabbanan al sede haaretz yechashev hikkisho hakkatuv lisde achuzza ma sede achuzza yotze bayyovel uvgiron kesef af batte hachatzerim yotzin bayyovel uvgiron kesef

I ma sede achuzza enah nigelet befachot mishte shanim af batte hachatzerim enam nigalim pachot mishte shanim talmud lomar geulla tihye lo miyyad hoil venatatta lahem koach yafe shebbassadot vechoach yafe shebbabbattim yachol lo yetzu bayyovel talmud lomar uvayyovel yetze
May kaamar amar rav huna lo nitzrecha ella lemakdish bayit bevatte hachatzerim ugalo acher miyyad hekdesh ufaga bo yovel beshana sheniyya
Lemay medammet leh i levatte are choma medammet leh ichalet leh lelokeach i lisde achuzza medammet lechohanim nafka lehachi itzterich uvyovel yetze
Matkef lah rav zeera may irya gealo acher afilu lo gealo name amar leh abbaye shello yomru hekdesh yotze belo pidon
Menalan mibben levi ma ben levi sheyyippa kocho bemimkaro hora kocho behekdesho yisrael shehora kocho bemimkaro en din shehora kocho behekdesho
Vehatam menalan detanya veyatza mimkar shomea ani afilu avadav mittaltelav ushtarav talmud lomar bayit veir achuzzato
Ma talmud lomar mimkar mimkaroo yotze bechinnam veen hekdesh yotze bechinnam ella befidon
Ufliga derabbi oshaya deamar rabbi oshaya hakkol hau bichlal venatan hakkesef vekam lo
Keshepparat hakkatuv bisde achuzza vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel kodesh la sade hu difrak leh venafka lechohanim aval hanach kidkayemi kayemi
Uvayyovel yetze lema li amar rav pappa lo nitzrecha ella lemocher bayit bevatte hachatzerim ufaga bo yovel beshana sheniyya
Lemay medammet leh i levatte are choma medammet leh ichalet leh lelokeach i lisde achuzza medammet leh hashlama bae lehachi itzterich uvayyovel yetze
Tanya kevateh derav huna utuvta derabbi oshaya hammakdish bayit bevatte hachatzerim hare ze goel miyyad vegoalo leolam gealo acher miyyad hekdesh higgia yovel velo nigal chozer labbealim bayyovel
b: Matni veellu hen batte hachatzerim shene chatzerim shel shene vattim af al pi shemmukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun hare hen kevatte chatzerim

Gema tanu rabbanan mimmashma shenneemar batte hachatzerim eni yodea sheen lahem choma ma talmud lomar asher en lahem choma af al pi sheyyesh lahem choma kemi sheen lahem choma vechamma battim shenayim chatzerot shenayim shette chatzerot shel shene vattim
Veema bayit vechatzer im ken lichtov rachamana chatzerim vechi tema i ketav rachamana chatzerim chatzer belo bayit mashma hahu karpef ikri
Matni yisrael sheyyarash avi immo levi eno goel kasseder hazze vechen levi sheyyarash et avi immo yisrael eno goel kasseder hazze
Shenneemar ki vatte are halviyyim hi achuzzatam ad sheyehe levi veare halviyyim divre rabbi vachachamim omrim en devarim hallalu amurim ella beare halviyyim
Gema veella keman keven levi vahadar tane ad sheyehe levi veare halviyyim
Ema eno goel ella kasseder hazze ad sheyehe levi veare halviyyim divre rabbi
Bishlama are halviyyim dichtiv ki batte are halviyyim ella levi menalan dichtiv vaasher yigal min halviyyim
Tanya vaasher yigal min halviyyim yachol levi miyyisrael yigal shezze yippa kocho veze hora kocho aval levi millevi lo shezze yippa kocho veze yippa kocho talmud lomar min halviyyim
Min halviyyim velo kol halviyyim perat leven levi mamzer venatin
Vachachamim omrim en devarim hallalu amurim ella beare halviyyim aval ad sheyehe levi la amrinan
Matni en osin sade migrash velo migrash sade velo migrash ir velo ir migrash

Amar rabbi elazar bamme devarim amurim beare halviyyim aval beare yisrael osin sade migrash velo migrash sade migrash ir velo ir migrash shello yachrivu et are yisrael hakkohanim vehalviyyim mochrin leolam vegoalin leolam shenneemar geullat olam tihye lalviyyim
Gema amar rabbi elazar bamme devarim amurim beare halviyyim aval beare yisrael osin vechu dechulle alma miha bedilviyyim la meshannenan mena hane mile

Amar rabbi elazar deamar kera usde migrash arehem lo yimmacher may lo yimmacher ilema lo yimmacher kelal veha middichtiv geullat olam tihye lalviyyim mikkelal dimzabbeni ella may lo yimmacher lo yeshanne

Hakkohanim vehalviyyim mochrin leolam vegoalin leolam tanu rabbanan geullat olam tihye lalviyyim ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach yachol af ze ken talmud lomar geullat olam tihye lalviyyim
Lefi shenneemar vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel kodesh la yachol af ze ken talmud lomar geullat olam tihye lalviyyim
Lefi shenneemar vekam habbayit asher bair asher lo choma latztzemitut yachol af ze ken talmud lomar geullat olam tihye lalviyyim
Bishlama hane tarte lechayye ella batte are choma lilviyyim mi it lehu vehatanya arim hallalu en osin otan lo kefarim ketannim velo kerakkim gedolim ella ayarot benoniyyot
Amar rav kahana la kashya kan shehukkaf ulvassof yashav kan sheyyashav ulvassof hukkaf
Vechi hay gavena mi haveya choma vehatanya veish ki yimkor bet moshav ir choma shehukkaf ulvassof yashav velo sheyyashav ulvassof hukkaf
Yachol afilu hikkifuha yisrael neemar kan choma veneemar lehallan choma ma lehallan goyim af kan goyim
Yachol afilu hikkifuha goyim leachar mikken neemar lehallan choma veneemar kan choma ma lehallan goyim kodem lachen af kan goyim kodem lachen
Targemah rav yosef bereh derav salla chasida kammeh derav pappa kegon shennaflu lahen

a: Hen umigreshehen hen umigreshehen lemisterinhu kayemi amar rav ashe itzterich salka datach amena addemistatteri mistatteri i mizdabbeni lichaltu ka mashma lan
Tanu rabbanan kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato ma talmud lomar minnayin lechohen shehikdish sede chermo shello yomar hoil veotza lakkohanim vahare hi tachat yadi tehe shelli
Vedin hu beshel acherim ani zoche beshel atzmi lo kol shekken talmud lomar vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel kodesh la kisde hacherem

Vechi ma lamadnu missede hacherem meatta hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed makkish sede chermo lisde achuzza shel yisrael ma sede achuzza shel yisrael yotza mittachat yado umitchalleket lakkohanim af sede chermo yotza mittachat yado umitchalleket leechav hakkohanim
Amar mar beshel acherim ani zoche mi dame hatam zoche bealma hacha ka shakel leh
Amar rame bar chama itzterich salka datach amena hoil uchtiv veish et kodashav lo yihu ha name ki kodashav damya
Mi dame kodashav lav birshuto hacha birshuto
Ella amar rav nachman itzterich salka datach amena hoil uchtiv ki achuzzat olam hu lahem ha name achuzzato hi ka mashma lan achuzzato achuzzato in chermo la
Hadaran alach hammocher sadehu uslika lah massechet arachin
Matni hakkol memirin echad anashim veechad nashim lo sheadam rashshay lehamir ella sheim hemir mumar vesofeg et haarbaim
Gema ha gufa kashya amratte hakkol memirin lechattechila vahadar tane lo sheadam rashshay lehamir ella sheim hemir mumar diavad
Vetisbera hakkol memirin lechattechila addekashya lach mimmatnitin tikshe lach kera dichtiv lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto
Ella amar rav yehuda hachi katane hakkol matpisin bitmura echad anashim veechad nashim lo sheadam rashshay lehamir sheim hemir mumar vesofeg et haarbaim
Hakkol leetoye may leetoye yoresh udla kerabbi yehuda
Ditnan yoresh somech yoresh memir divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer yoresh eno somech veoresh eno memir
May tama derabbi yehuda yalef techilat hekdesh missof hekdesh ma sof hekdesh yoresh eno somech af techilat hekdesh yoresh eno memir
Usmicha gufah menalan telat korbano ketivi chad korbano velo korban goy vechad korbano velo korban chavero vechad korbano velo korban aviv
Ulrabbi meir deamar yoresh somech vehachtiv korbano hahu mibe leh lerabbot kol baale chovrin lismicha

Verabbi yehuda baale chovrin lismicha let leh may tama deha la meyachad korban didhu veibaet ema leolam it leh vekorban goy vekorban chavero mechad kera nafka deiyyatar leh chad levaale chovrin lismicha
Verabbi meir deamar yoresh memir may tama amar lach im hamer yamir lerabbot hayyoresh
b: Veyalef sof hekdesh mittechilat hekdesh ma techilat hekdesh yoresh memir af sof hekdesh yoresh somech

Rabbi yehuda hay veim hamer yamir may aved leh lerabbot et haishsha vechidtanya lefi shekkol hainyan kullo eno medabber ella leshon zachar shenneemar lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto ishsha minnayin talmud lomar veim hamer yamir lerabbot et haishsha
Ulrabbi meir ishsha mena leh nafka leh mivveim verabbi yehuda veim la daresh

Uven rabbi meir uven rabbi yehuda tama derabbi kera leishsha ha la rabbeyah kera hava amena ki avda temura la lakya vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashin shebbattora

Itzterich mahu detema hane mile onesh deshave ben beyachid ben betzibbur aval hacha kevan deonesh sheeno shave bakkol hu ditnan en hatztzibbur vehashshuttafin osin temura ishsha name ki avda la lakya ka mashma lan

Bae rame bar chama katan mahu sheyyamir hechi dame ilema bekatan shello higgia leonat nedarim la tibe lach dechevan akdoshe la akdesh amore memar ella ki kamibbaya leh bekatan shehiggia leonat nedarim
Mi amrinan kevan deamar mar ish ma talmud lomar ki yafli neder lerabbot mufla hassamuch leish dekodsho kadosh middeakdoshe makdesh amore name memar o dilma kevan delav bar unshin hu bitmura la mitfis

Im timtze lomar katan aved temura deha ate lichlal onashin goy mahu sheyyamir mi amratte middeakdoshe makdesh detanya ish ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot et haggoyim shennodrim nedarim undavot keyisrael amore name memar o dilma kevan dela ate lichlal onashin ki aved temura la kadsha

Amar rava ta shema detanya kodshe goyim lo nehenin velo moalin veen chayyavin alehem mishshum pigul notar vetame en osin temura veen meviin alehem nesachim aval korbano taun nesachim divre rabbi shimon
Amar rabbi yose bechullan ani roe lehachmir bamme devarim amurim bekodshe mizbeach aval bekodshe bedek habbayit moalin bahen katane miha en osin temura
Verame bar chama behikdish goy lehitkapper goy la kamibaya li ki kamibaya li behikdish goy umitkapper beyisrael batar makdish azlinan o batar mitkapper azlinan
Tifshot leh midderabbi avahu deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan hammakdish mosif chomesh umitkapper ose temura vehattorem mishshello

a: Al shel chavero tovat hanaa shello

Amar leh hatam hu dekaate mikkoach yisrael mishshum hachi azlinan batar mitkapper vehave leh techilato vesofo beyad yisrael aval hacha hachi ka mibaya leh mi baenan mittechila vead sof deteku birshut man deaved temura teku
Amar mar mukdeshe goyim lo nehenin velo moalin lo nehenin midderabbanan velo moalin middeorayeta
May tama dichtiv nefesh ki timol maal vechata bishgaga veyalfinan chet chet mitteruma uvitruma ketiv bene yisrael velo goyim
Veen chayyavin alehem mishshum pigul notar vetame dichtiv bah betuma dabber el aharon veel banav veyinnazru mikkodshe vene yisrael velo yechallelu et shem vego
Veyalef notar chilul chilul mittuma dichtiv gabbe tuma vene yisrael velo yechalleluvego uchtiv gabbe notar veochlav aono yissa ki et kodesh Adonai chillel
Veyalef pigul aon aon minnotar dichtiv gabbe pigul vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu aonah tissa uchtiv gabbe notar veochlav aono yissa ki et kodesh Adonai chillel vechullehu bene yisrael velo goyim
Veen osin temura dichtiv lo yachalifennu velo yamir uchtiv beresh inyan dabber el bene yisrael lemor ish ki yafli neder beerkecha

Lishana acharina veen osin temura may tama deitakkasha temurat behema lemasar behema umasar behema lemaaser dagan vegabbe masar dagan ketiv kol ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu la bene yisrael velo goyim

Veen mevi alehen nesachim aval korbano taun nesachim divre rabbi shimon mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ezrach ezrach mevi nesachim veen haggoy mevi nesachim yachol lo tehe olato teuna nesachim talmud lomar kacha
Amar rabbi yose roe ani bechullan lehachmir may tama la ketiv beh

Bamme devarim amurim bekodshe mizbeach aval bekodshe bedek habbayit moalin bahen may tama dechi gamrinan meila chet chet mitteruma dumya ditruma dikdosha kedushshat hagguf aval bedek habbayit dikdushshat damim la
Amar rav yehuda amar rav kol lo taase battora asa bah maase chayyav lo asa bah maase patur
Uchlala hu delav sheen bo maase patur vahare memer delav sheen bo maase hu velake ditnan lo shehu rashshay lehamir ella sheim hemir mumar vesofeg et haarbaim
Amar lecha rav ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar lav sheen bo maase lokin alav
Umi matzet mokmatte lematnitin kerabbi yehuda veha okemta leresha dela kerabbi yehuda dekatane hakkol memirin hakkol leetoye may leetoye yoresh udla kerabbi yehuda
Hay tanna savar lah kevateh bachada delav sheen bo maase lokin alav uflig aleh bachada deilu rabbi yehuda savar yoresh eno somech yoresh eno memir vetanna didan savar yoresh somech yoresh memir

Amar rav idi bar avin amar rav amram amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose haggelili kol lo taase shebbattora asa bo maase loke lo asa bo maase patur chutz minnishba umemer umkallel chavero bashshem af al pi shello asa maase chayyav mishshum rabbi yose berabbi chanina amru af hammakdim teruma levikurim
Nishba menalan amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir amar kera ki lo yenakke Adonai et asher yissa et shemo lashshave bet din shel mala
b: En menakkin oto aval bet din shel matta malkin oto umnakkin oto

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veema la tihve leh nekiyyut kelal amar leh im ken lichtov kera lo yinnake velishtok Adonai lema li bet din shel mala hu deen menakkin oto aval bet din shel matta malkin umnakkin oto
Ashkechan shevuat shave shevuat sheker menalan rabbi yochanan dideh amar lashshave lashshave shene peamim im eno inyan lishvuat shave tenehu inyan lishvuat sheker deloke

Matkef lah rabbi avahu shevuat sheker hechi dame i nema daamar shello ochal vaachal hatam hu maase avad veella deamar sheochal vela achal hahu mi lake vehaitmar shevua sheochal kikkar ze hayyom veavar hayyom velo achal rabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish amri eno loke
Rabbi yochanan omer eno loke delav sheen bo maase hu vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav veresh lakish amar eno loke mishshum dehave leh hatraat safek vechol hatraat safek en lokin alav
Ella amar rabbi avahu tehe beachalti velo achalti
Umay shena deka merabbe achalti velo achalti meochal velo achal amar rava beferush ribta tora sheker dome leshave ma shave lesheavar af sheker lesheavar

Etiveh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi avahu shevua shello ochal kikkar zo shevua shello ochlenna shevua shello ochlenna vaachalah eno chayyav ella achat vezohi shevuat bituy shechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah korban ole veored zohi lemaote may lav lemaote achalti velo achalti dela lake
Lo zo hi deal shiggatah mayete korban aval achalti velo achalti la mayete korban umanni rabbi yishmael hi deamar eno chayyav ella al heatid lavo aval milka lake
Ema sefa zohi shevuat shave shechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah patur zohi lemaote may lav lemaote achalti velo achalti dela lake
Lo zohi deal shiggatah patur mikkorban aval achalti velo achalti mayete korban umanni rabbi akiva hi deamar meviin korban lesheavar
Veha amratte resha rabbi yishmael ella middesefa rabbi akiva resha name rabbi akiva veresha lav lemaote achalti velo achalti ella lemaote ochal velo achal
Umay shena mishshum dekae bilhabba memaet lehabba kae bilhabba memaet lesheavar
Umemer amar leh rabbi yochanan letanna la titni umemer mishshum divdiburo asa maase

Hamkallel et chavero bashshem menalan amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya amar kera im lo tishmor uchtiv vehifla Adonai et makkotcha haflaa zo eni yodea mahu keshehu omer vehippilo hashshofet vehikkahu lefanav heve omer haflaa zo malkot
Emar afilu shevuat emet behedya ketiv shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem
Emar hane mile lefayyes et chavero aval milka lilke la matzet amratte dehachtiv uvishmo tishshavea

Hahu mibe leh lechidrav deamar rav gidel amar rav minnayin shennishbain lekayyem et hammitzot shenneemar nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha hachtiv kera acharina uvo tidbak uvishmo tishshavea
Ella lemay ata limkallel et chavero bashshem veema lemotzi shem shamayim levattala mi gara mekallel et chavero bashshem mimmotzi shem shamayim levattala

Anan hachi ka kashya lan ema motzi shem shamayim levattala tisge leh bemalkot aval mekallel chavero bashshem kevan dekaaved tarte deka mappek shem shamayim levattala vekamtzaar leh lechavreh la tisge leh bemalkot

a: La matzet amratte dichtiv lo tekallel cheresh vei amratte bishlama lekallel et chavero azharteh mehacha dichtiv lo tekallel cheresh ella i amratte motzi shem shamayim levattala azharteh mehecha
Allema la vehachtiv et Adonai elohecha tira veoto taavod hahu azharat ase hu

Mishshum rabbi yose berabbi chanina amru af hammakdim teruma levikurim may tama derabbi yose berabbi chanina amar kera meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher melea ellu bikurim vedimacha ellu teruma veamratte lo teacher

Itmar hikdim teruma levikurim rabbi elazar verabbi yose berabbi chanina chad amar loke vechad amar eno loke tistayyem derabbi yose berabbi chanina hu deamar loke middeamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina af hammakdim teruma levikurim loke
Adderabba tistayyem derabbi elazar hu deamar loke ditnan hau lefanav shette kalkallot shel tevel veamar maaser shel zo bazo harishona meusseret
Shel zo bazo veshel zo bazo harishona meusseret vehashsheniyya enah meusseret maasrotehem masar kalkalla bachavertah kera et hashshem
Veittemar rabbi elazar amar loke mippene shehikdim maaser sheni shebbah lemaaser rishon shebbachavertah tistayyem
Ella rabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar eno loke lema kashya derabbi yose berabbi chanina adderabbi yose berabbi chanina
La rabbi yose berabbi chanina
b: Appetura kae vehachi kaamar lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav mishshum rabbi yose berabbi chanina amru af hammakdim teruma levikurim
Umay shena memer delake mishshum divdiburo asa maase makdim teruma levikurim name lilke mishshum divdiburo asa maase
Amar rabbi avin shane hatam delav shennitak laase hu dichtiv mikkol maserotechem tarimu
Yatev rav dimi vekaamar lah leha shemata amar leh abbaye vechol lav shennitak laase la lake
Veha memer delav shennitak laase hu velake ditnan lo sheadam rashshay lehamir ella sheim hemir mumar vesofeg et haarbaim
Have lehu tere lave vechad ase vela ate chad ase veakar tere lave
Vahare ones dechad lav vechad ase vela ate chad ase veakar lav detanya ones sheggerash im yisrael hu machzir veeno loke veim kohen hu loke veeno machzir
Kohanim kaamratte kohanim tama achrina hu derabbi rachamana kedushsha yattira
Ketannae lo yashiru mimmennu ad boker ba hakkatuv liten ase achar lo taase lomar sheen lokin alav divre rabbi yehuda
Rabbi yaakov omer lo min hashshem hu ze ella mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar lokin alav
Verabbi yaakov hay vehannotar mimmennu ad boker baesh tisrofu lemay ata
Mibe leh lichditnan haatzamot vehaggidin vehannotar yissarfu beshishsha asar chal shishsha asar lihot bashshabbat yissarfu beshiva asar lefi sheen dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov
Veamar chizkiyya vechen tana deve chizkiyya may tama amar kera vehannotar mimmennu ad boker baesh tisrofu ba hakkatuv liten boker sheni lisrefato
Amar abbaye kol milta deamar rachamana la taaved im aved mahane dei salka datach la mahane ammay lake rava amar la mahane mide vehay delake mishshum daavar ammemra derachamana hu

a: Metivi ones sheggeresh im yisrael hu machzir veeno loke vei amratte kevan daavar ammemra derachamana lake ha name lilke teuvta derava
Amar lach shane hatam deamar kera kol yamav kol yamav baamod vehachzer
Ulabbaye i lav daamar rachamana kol yamav hava amena isura hu daavad leh i bae lehdar vei bae la lehdar ka mashma lan
Lishana acharina metivi ones sheggeresh im yisrael hu machzir veeno loke veim kohen hu loke veeno machzir katane im yisrael hu machzir teuvta deabbaye
Shane hatam derachamana amar kol yamav kol yamav baamod vehachzer

Verava amar lach i la ketav rachamana kol yamav hava amena lilke velehdar dehave leh lav gereda dichtiv lo yuchal leshallechah ahachi ketav kera kol yamav leshauoyeh leones lelo taase shennitak laase deen lokin alav
Vahare torem min haraa al hayyafa derachamana amar mikkol chelbo
Chelbo in geruin la utnan en tormin min haraa al hayyafa veim taram terumato teruma alma mahane teuvta derava

Amar lach rava shane hatam kerabbi ila deamar rabbi ila minnayin letorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma shenneemar velo tisu alav chet baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu im eno kadosh nesiut chet lamma mikan lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma
Ulabbaye i lav deamar rachamana velo tisu alav chet hava amena hachi amar rachamana aved mitzva min hammuvchar vei la aved chote la mikre ka mashma lan
Vahare mimmin al sheeno mino deamar rachamana kol chelev yitzhar liten chelev laze vechelev laze utnan en tormin mimmin al sheeno mino veim taram en terumato teruma alma la mahane teuvta deabbaye
Amar lach abbayye shane hatam deamar kera reshitam reshit laze vereshit laze vechen amar rabbi ila reshit
Ulrava i lav deamar rachamana reshit hava amena tirosh veyitzhar dichtiv behu chelev chelev deen tormin mizze al ze
Aval tirosh vedagan dagan vedagan dechad chelev ketiv behu ki tarem mehay ahay la lake ketav rachamana reshit liten chelev laze vechelev laze
Lishana acharina ha tirosh vedagan dechad chelev ketiv behu tarem mehay ahay ketav rachamana reshit
Vahare charamim deamar rachamana lo yimmacher velo yiggael utnan cherme chohanim en podin otam ella notnan lakkohen alma la mahane teuvta deabbaye
Amar lach shane hatam deamar rachamana kodesh kadashim hu bahavayato yehe
b: Ulrava hay hu lemaote bechor detanya bivchor neemar lo tifde venimkar hu bemaaser neemar lo yiggael veeno nimkar lo chay velo shachut lo tam velo baal mum
Vahare temura deamar rachamana lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto vetana lo sheadam rashshay lehamir ella sheim hemir mumar vesofeg et haarbaim alma mahane teuvta derava
Amar lach shane hatam deamar kera vehaya hu utmurato yihye kodesh
Ulabbaye i lav deamar rachamana vehaya hu utmurato hava amena tetze zo vetikkanes zo kamashma lan
Vahare bechor deamar rachamana lo tifde utnan yesh lahen pidon velitmurotehen pidon chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser alma la mahane teuvta deabbaye
Amar lach shane hatam deamar kera hem bahavayatan yehu
Ulrava hay hem lema leh hen kerevin veen temuratan kerevin
Ulabbaye hay sevara mena leh im shor im se la hu la karev veen temurato kereva
Verava in hachi name demehahu kera ella hem lema li limed al bechor umaaser shennitarev daman bechol haolin shekkerevin legabbe mizbeach

Veabbaye hay sevara mena leh mivvelakach middam happar umiddam hassair vahalo dam happar merubbe mishshel sair mikan laolin sheen mevattelin ze et ze detanya velakach middam happar umiddam hassair sheyehu meoravin divre rabbi yoshiyya
Verava hatam mizze bifne atzmo umizze bifne atzmo vesavar lah kerabbi yonatan
Vahare maaser deamar rachamana lo yiggael utnan yesh lahen pidon velitmurotehen chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser alma la mahane teuvta deabbaye
Amar lach shane hatam deyalef avara avara mibbechor
Hare hikdimah teruma labbikurim deamar rachamana meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher utnan hammakdim af al pi shehu belo taase ma sheasa asuy
Amar lach rava shane hatam deamar kera mikkol maserotechem tarimu teruma
Ulabbaye mibaya leh kidamar rav pappa leabbaye ella meatta afilu hikdimo bichri name niptar
Amar leh alecha amar kera mikkol maserotechem tarimu
Ma raita lerabbot et hakkeri ulhotzi et hashshibolin merabbe ani et hakkeri sheyyeshno bichlal digun umotzi ani et hashshibolin sheenan bichlal digun
Vahare almana lechohen gadol derachamana amar almana ugrusha lo yikkach utnan kol makom sheyyesh kiddushin veyesh avera havalad holech achar happagum
Shane hacha deamar kera lo yechallel zaro
Ulabbaye nema kera lo yachel may lo yechallel echad lo veechad lah
Vahare hikdish baale mumin lammizbeach derachamana amar kol asher bo mum lo takrivu utnan hammakdish baale mumin legabbe mizbeach af al pi shehu belo taase ma sheasa asuy teuvta derava
Amar lach rava shane hatam deamar kera ulneder lo yeratze ritztzuy hu dela meratztze ha mikdash kadshi
Ulabbaye i dela amar rachamana ulneder lo yeratze hava amena keover mitzva vechasher kamashma lan
Vahare makdish temimin levedek habbayit deamar rachamana

a: Nedava taase oto ze kodshe bedek habbayit utnan hammakdish temimin levedek habbayit af al pi shehu belo taase ma sheasa asuy teuvta derava
Amar lach rava mimmakom shennitrabbu baale mumin legabbe mizbeach nitrabbu temimin levedek habbayit
Vahare gazel derachamana amar lo tigzol utnan haggozel etzim vaasaan kelim tzemer vaasaan begadim meshallem kishat haggezela teuvta derava
Amar lach rava shane hatam deamar kera asher gazal kema sheggazal
Ulabbaye hay asher gazal mibe leh al gezelo shello mosif chomesh al gezelo shel aviv eno mosif chomesh
Vahare mashkon derachamana amar lo tavo el beto laavot avoto utnan machazir et hakkar ballayela veet hammacharesha bayyom teuvta derava
Amar lach rava shane hatam deamar kera hashev tashiv
Ulabbaye i lav deamar rachamana hashev tashiv hava amena isura avad i bae nahdar vei bae la nahdar ka mashma lan

Vahare pea derachamana amar lo techalle peat sadcha bekutzrecha utnan mitzvat pea lehafrish min hakkama lo hifrish min hakkama yafrish min haomarim lo hifrish min haomarim yafrish min hakkeri ad shello mercho
Mercho meassero venoten lo mishshum rabbi yishmael amru af mafrish min haisa teuvta deabbaye
Amar lach abbayye shane hatam deamar kera taazov taazov yattira
Verava amar lach yesh lecha aziva acheret shekkazo veezo ze hammafkir karmo
Detanya hammafkir karmo vehishkim lashshachar uvtzaro chayyav beferet veolelot beshichcha uvfea ufatur min hammaaser
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe vehashta deshanninan kol hane shinuye deabbaye verava bemay peligi
Beribbit ketzutza kamipalgi vechidrabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar ribbit ketzutza yotza bedayyanin
b: Avak ribbit enah yotza bedayyanin verabbi yochanan amar afilu ribbit ketzutza enah yotza bedayyanin
Amar leh hatam bisvara peligi hatam bikrae peligi deamar rabbi yitzchak may tama derabbi yochanan amar kera banneshech natan vetarbit lakach vachay lo yichye lechayyim nitan velo lehishavon
Rav acha bar adda amar mehacha veyareta meelohecha ani Adonai lemora netattiv velo lehishavon

Rava amar mehacha hattoevot hael asa mot yumat damav bo yihye veholid ben paritz shofech dam hukkeshu malve ribbit leshofche damim ma shofche damim lo nitnu lehishavon af malve ribbit lo nitnu lehishavon
Veamar rav nachman bar yitzchak may tama derabbi elazar deamar kera veche achicha immach ahdar leh ki hechi deneche immach
Veella bemay kamipalgi abbaye verava beshinuy kone
Lishana acharina behane shinuye deshanninan beribbit ketzutza leabbaye la mahdar ribbit lerava mahdar ribbit

Veha abbaye name savar mappekinan ribit ketzutza bedayyanin deamar abbaye haden demassek bechavreh arba zuze beribita vihavo leh lemalve bechanuteh begavayehu gelima deshave chamsha bearbea ki mappekinan mineh arbea mappekinan mineh vehay zuza bemattana hu dihav leh verava amar chamsha mappekinan mineh may tama kullah betorat ribita kaate lideh
Ella ki ka mipalgi abbaye verava beshinuy kone

Tanu rabbanan kol asher bo mum lo takrivu ma talmud lomar im belo tishchatu hare kevar amur lematta ella ma talmud lomar bal takrivu bal takdishu mikkan amru hammakdish baale mumin legabbe mizbeach over mishshum chamishsha shemot
Mishshum bal takrivu bal takdishu bal tishchatu umishshum bal tizreku umishshum bal taktiru kullo umishshum bal taktiru miktzato mishshum rabbi yose berabbi yehuda amru af kabbalat haddam

Amar mar im bal tishchatu hare amur lematta hechan amur detanya averet o shavur o charutz o yabbelet lo takrivu ma talmud lomar im bal takdishu hare kevar amur lemala ella ma talmud lomar bal takrivu bal tishchatu
Veishshe lo tittenu mehem ellu ishshim en li ella kullan miktzatan minnayin talmud lomar mehem
Zerikat damim minnayin talmud lomar al hammizbeach la lerabbot sair hammishtalleach
Vela lerabbot hu vehatanya i korban shomea ani af kodshe bedek habbayit shennikreu korban keinyan shenneemar vannakrev et korban Adonai
Talmud lomar veel petach ohel moed vego harauy lefetach ohel moed chayyavin alav mishshum shochate chutz sheen rauy lefetach ohel moed en chayyavin alav mishshum shochate chutz
Otzi ani et ellu velo otzi parat chattat vesair hammishtalleach shehen reuyin lefetach ohel moed talmud lomar la mi shemmeuchadin la yatzu ellu sheen meuchadin la
Amar rava hatam meinyana dikra veel petach lerabbot la lehotzi hacha deishshe lehotzi la lerabbot
Tama dichtav kera la hu dela mayete sair hammishtalleach ha la rabbi kera la hava amena sair hammishtalleach baal mum shappir dame mikkedi en haggoral kovea ella bedavar harauy
Amar rav yosef ha manni chanan hammitzri hi deamar afilu dam bechos mevi chavero umzaveg lo
Nehi deshamatte leh lechanan hammitzri dela have dichuy dela tzerich hagrala mi shamatte leh dilma mayete umagril
Ella amar rav yosef ha manni rabbi shimon hi detanya met echad mehen mevi chavero belo hagrala divre rabbi shimon
Rava amar lo nitzrecha kegon shehumam bo bayyom vechillo al chavero

a: Salka datach amena bishlama meikara la yadana i hay mikva lashshem aval hacha kevan deinchar shem la lake ka mashma lan

Amar mar mishshum rabbi yose berabbi yehuda af kabbalat haddam may tama derabbi yose berabbi yehuda amar kera umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut vego zo kabbalat haddam sheamar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda
Ultanna kamma hay lo takrivu lema li mibe leh lizrikat damim veha nafka leh meal hammizbeach orcheh dikra demishtae hachi
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda name orcheh dikra hu in hachi name ella kabbalat haddam mena leh nafka leh meha umiyyad ben nechar lo takrivu zo hi kabbalat haddam sheamar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda
Ultanna kamma hay lo takrivu lema li mibe leh lehay salka datach amena hoil velo nitztauu bene noach ella al mechussar evarim la shena bemizbeach didhu vela shena bemizbeach didan ka mashma lan
Lishana acharina rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer af al kabbalat haddam may tama dichtiv umauch vechatut lo takrivu zo kabbalat haddam uzrika nafka leh meal hammizbeach
Ulrabbanan name tipok lehu zerika min al hammizbeach hachi name veella lo takrivu demauch lemay ata mappekinan leh levamat yachid
Ulrabbi yose berabbi yehuda hay mibe leh levamat yachid in hachi name ella takrivu dekabbala mena leh miyyad ben nechar lo takrivu zo kabbalat haddam
Verabbanan itzterich salka datach amena hoil uvne noach en metzviyn ella al mechussar ever bevama dilhon dilma anan name nekabbel minhon ka mashma lan mikkol elle dela mekabbelinan
Matkef lah resh lakish shemma lo shaninu ella betam shennaasa baal mum veover dei baal mum meikara dikla bealma hu
Amar leh rabbi chiyya bar yosef sarua vekalut ketiv bapparasha vehane baale mumin meikara ninhu
Amar leh shemma lo shaninu ella bitmura ditnan chomer battemura mibbazzevach shekken kedushsha chala aleha al baal mum kavua

Amar leh rabbi yochanan la shemia lach ha deamar rabbi yannay bachavura nimnu vegamru hammakdish baal mum legabbe mizbeach over mishshum chamishsha shemot vei bitmura name shishsha haveyan deika name lav ditmura ella may bevaal mum meikaro ammay lake dikla bealma hu
Amar leh dikla lav zila milta min etzim hu baal mum meikara zila milta kevan dishvek temimim veakdesh baale mumin michayyav
Lishana acharina amar leh afilu hachi bazya milta dedekel leka bemino la lake leappoke baal mum kevan deika bemino lake
Amar rava hashta daamur tama devaal mum delake mishshum devazya miltayehu afilu makdesh leh lidme nesachim name lake
Tanya kevateh derava
b: Nedava taase oto ze kodshe bedek habbayit veen li ella nedava neder minnayin talmud lomar ulneder
Yachol afilu kodshe mizbeach talmud lomar ulneder lo yeratze ze kodshe mizbeach veen li ella neder nedava minnayin talmud lomar nedava rabbi omer lo yeratze behartzaat gufo hakkatuv medabber
Hayenu tanna kamma may lav beha kamipalgi detanna kamma savar afilu akdesheh lidme nesachim name lake verabbi savar behartzaat gufo name lake aval bidme nesachim la lake shema minah
Veella oto lema li lechidtanya nedava taase oto oto taase nedava vei atta ose tamim nedava levedek habbayit mikan amru hammakdish temimim levedek habbayit over baase
Uminnayin af belo taase shenneemar vayedabber Adonai el moshe lemor limed al happarasha shehi belav divre rabbi yehuda
Amar leh rabbi levar kappara may mashma amar leh dichtiv lemor lo neemar baddevarim be rabbi amri lo emor
Itmar hammaale evre baale mumin legabbe mizbeach amar rava over mishshum bal taktiru kullo umishshum bal taktiru miktzato amar abbaye en lokin al lav shebbichlalot
Metivi hammakdish baale mumin legabbe mizbeach over mishshum chamishsha shemot teuvta deabbaye
Amar abbaye begavre katane i begavre over ovrin mibe leh ella peshita bechad gavra utuvta deabbaye
Amar abbaye appek haktarat miktzato veayyel kabbalat haddam kabbalat dam lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda it leh letanna kamma let leh kashya
Lishana acharina veha middesefa rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi resha rabbanan teuvta deabbaye teuvta

Matni hakkohanim memirin beshellahen veyisrael memirin beshellahen en hakkohanim memirin lo bechattat velo beasham velo bivchor amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri mippene ma en memirin bivchor amar lo rabbi akiva chattat veasham mattana lakkohen uvchor mattana lakkohen ma chattat veasham en memirin bo af bechor en memirin bo

Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri ma lo im eno memir bechattat veasham sheen zachin bahen bechayyehen tomar bivchor shezzachin bo bechayyav amar lo rabbi akiva vahalo kevar neemar vehaya hu utmurato yihye kodesh hechan kedushsha chala alav bevet habbealim af temura bevet habbealim

Gema tenan hatam bechor mochrin oto tam chay uvaal mum chay veshachut umkaddeshin bo haishsha amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lo shanu ella bizman hazze hoil veit leh lechohen zechiyya begaveyh hoil veyesh lakkohen shuttafut bo aval bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam kevan detam lehakrava hu dekae en mochrin oto tamim chay

Etiveh rava lerav nachman mochrin oto tamim chay chay in shachut la emat ilema bizman hazze mi ika tam shachut ella peshita bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam vekatane name mochrin oto tamim chay alma it leh lechohen zechiyya begaveyh
La leolam bizman hazze mi katane mochrin oto tamim chay in shachut la hi gufa ata leashmoinan devizman hazze name mochrin oto tamim chay

a: Etiveh bivchor neemar lo tifde venimkar hu bemay askinan ilema bizman hazze ema sefa veet damam tizrok al hammizbeach bizman hazze mi ika mizbeach ella peshita bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam
Uvmay ilema bevaal mum ema sefa veet damam tizrok al hammizbeach veet chelbam taktir mi chaze lehakrava ella lav betam vekatane nimkar hu alma it lehu lechohen zechiyya begaveh
Mide irya resha bevaal mum sefa betam

Metiv rav mesharsheya kohenet shennitarevo veladah bivelad shifchatah higdilu hattaarovot meshachrerin ze et ze ushnehem ochlin bitruma vecholkin chelek echad al haggoren bechoran yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyeachlu bemuman

Bemay askinan ilema bizman hazze may shena didan umay shena didhu didan name mumin baenan ella lav bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam i amratte bishlama it lehu lechohen zechiyya begaveyh shappir ella i amratte let leh lete gizbar velishkeleh
Leolam bizman hazze udka kashya lach may shena didan umay shena didhu anan yahavinan leh lechohen bemumayehu inhu kevan deika behu miktzat kohen mafka leh lechohanim

Lishana acharina bizman hazze may irya bechorot dehalen sefekot afilu didan name yiru ella peshita bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam vei bevaal mum yiru ad sheyyistaavu ha mesoavin vekayemin ella peshita betammin vehachi hu dela mezabbeni vadday

Leolam bizman hazze may kashya lach afilu dilan name yiru la matzinu matzenan medachenan leh lechohen dela it kan sefek kehunna hane sefekot medachu lechohen kol chad vechad amar leh lechohen daana kohen vaana kohen
Metivi rabbi shimon omer behemtah perat levehemat bechor umaaser shebbah shelalah perat lechesef maaser sheni shebbah
Bemay askinan ilema bizman hazze mi ika ir hanniddachat vehatnan en osin ir hanniddachat ella bevet din shel shivim veechad ella peshita bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam
Uvmay i nema bevaal mum hayenu behemtah ella peshita betam vei amratte bishlama it leh zechiyya begaveh shappir ella i amratte let leh lema li mibbehema tipok leh mishshelalah velo shelal shamayim
Leolam bevaal mum udka kashya lach hayenu behemtah mi shenneechal betorat behemtah yatzu bechor umaaser sheeno bichlal sheen neechalin betorat behemtah
Ditnan kol pesule hammukdashin nimkarin baitliz venishchatin baitliz venishkalin belitra chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser shehanaatan labbealim
Metivi umaala maal ba lerabbot kodashim kallim shehen mamon bealim divre rabbi yose haggelili
Ben azzay omer lerabbot shelamim abba yose ben dosay omer lo amar ben azzay ella bivchor bilvad
Bemay askinan ilema bizman hazze ha dumya dishlamim katane ella peshita bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam
Uvmay askinan ilema bevaal mum ha dumya dishlamim katane ella lav betam ushma minah it leh lechohen zechiyya begaveyh
b: Amar abbaye la leolam betam uvivchor bechutza laaretz verabbi shimon hi deamar im bau temimin yikrevu

Metivi amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri ma li im eno memer bechattat veasham shehare en zachin bahen bechayyehen tomar bivchor shezzachin bechayyav bemay askinan ilema bevaal mum ha dumya dechattat veasham kaamar ella lav betam vekatane zachin bo bechayyav
Amar ravina ha name bivchor bechutza laaretz verabbi shimon hi deamar im bau temimim yikrevu
Lema ketannae bechor bevet habbealim osin temura bevet hakkohen en osin temura rabbi shimon ben elazar omer kevan shebba lide chohen en osin temura
Hayenu tanna kamma may lav hachi kaamar bevet kohen hu ose temura veen baal ose temura alma it leh lechohen zechiyya begaveyh
La kashya ha rabbi yochanan ben nuri ha rabbi akiva
Amar rav chisda lo shanu ella kohen lechohen aval kohen leyisrael asur may tama dilma azel yisrael veshade beh muma umamte lechacham veomer lo bechor ze natan li kohen bemumo
Umi share chacham hachi veha amar rav en roin bechor leyisrael ella im ken kohen immo
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua hayenu tama deyisrael asur mippene shennire kechohen hamsayyea bevet haggoranot
Mar zutra ikla leve rav ashe amaru leh litom mar mide ayeto lekammeh bisra amar leh lechol mar demavre mishshum devuchra hu mena lechu ha amaru leh dezabben lan peloni kohen
Amar lehu la sevira lechu ha deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua mippene shennire kechohen hamsayyea bevet haggoranot amaru leh la sevira lan daanan mizban ka zavninan

Amar lehu vela sevira lechu haditnan ad kamma yisrael chayyav litappel babbechor baddakka sheloshim yom veim amar lo tenehu li betoch zemanno hare ze lo yittenennu lo veamar rav sheshet ma taam mippene shennire kechohen hamsayyea bevet haggoranot
Amaru leh hatam mochcha milta hacha mizban ka zavninan
Lashon acher amaru leh hacha la yahev deme hacha ka yahev deme may amratte mozel kohen gabbeh desavar kohen dechi have leh bechor acharina yahev nihaleh la demassek addateh

a: Butzina tav mikkara

Matni memirin min hatztzon al habbakar umin habbakar al hatztzon umin hakkevasim al haizzim umin haizzim al hakkevasim min hazzecharim al hannekevot umin hannekevot al hazzecharim min hattemimim al baale mumin min baale mumin al hattemimim
Shenneemar lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov bera o ra betov veezehu tov bera baale mumin shekkadam hekdeshan et muman

Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan behema bivhema mikkan shemmemirin min hatztzon al habbakar umin habbakar al hatztzon min hakkevasim al haizzim umin haizzim al hakkevasim umin hazzecharim al hannekevot umin hannekevot al hazzecharim umin baale mumin al hattemimim umin hattemimim al baale mumin
Yachol afilu kadam mum lehekdeshan talmud lomar lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov bera o ra betov veezehu tov bera baale mumin shekkadam hekdeshan et muman
May talmuda amar abbaye nema kera lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov bera o ra bo betov achrina lema li shema minah tov meikaro ose temura ra meikaro en ose temura

Rava amar tarvayehu tov yatore meyatri im ken nichtov kera lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto bera o ra bo lema li lemichtav tarvayehu tov chad tov afilu betov name ki memir lake veidach tov meikaro ose temura ra meikaro en ose temura
Veabbaye amar kal vachomer hu uma tov bera dealloye ka mealle leh lake tov betov dechi hadade ninhu lo kol shekken delake
Verava en onshin min haddin veabbayye amar lach ha lav dina hu mi gara tov mera
Tanu rabbanan lo yachalifennu beshel acherim velo yamir oto beshel atzmo velichtov lo yachalifennu vela bae lo yamir oto
I ketav hachi hava amena tetze zo vetikkanes zo hu detilke aval memir detarvayehu ka makdesh lehu ema la lake ka mashma lan

Hay beshel acherim hechi dame i nema behema dehekdesh dideh vechullin dealma mi matze makdesh ish ki yakdish et beto kodesh la amar rachamana ma beto birshuto af kol birshuto veella behema dehekdesh dealma vechullin dideh mi matpes bedavar sheeno shello
Leolam bivhema dehekdesh dealma vechullin dideh kegon deamar mareh divhema dehekdesh kol harotze lehamir bivhemto yavo veyamir
Matni memirin echad bishnayim ushnayim beechad echad bemea umea beechad rabbi shimon omer en memirin ella echad beechad shenneemar vehaya hu utmurato yihye kodesh ma hu meuchad af hi meuchedet

Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan behema bivhema mikkan shemmemirin echad bishnayim ushnayim beechad echad bemea umea beechad rabbi shimon omer en memirin ella echad beechad shenneemar behema bivhema velo behema bivhemot velo behemot bivhema
Amar lo matzinu behemot shekkeruya behema shenneemar uvhema rabba verabbi shimon behema rabba ikri behema setam la ikri
Vetama derabbi shimon mishshum behema hu veha tama derabbi shimon mishshum hu ma hu meuchad af temura meuchedet
Meikara amar lahen rabbi shimon min vehaya hu utmurato vechi chaza dedarshi rabbanan mibbehema bivhema amar lahem ihu mehatam name matzenan lemelaf tama didi

Amar resh lakish mode rabbi shimon shemmemirin vechozrin ummirin may tama kedushsha rishona dehekdesh lehechan halcha verabbi yochanan amar keshem sheen memirin shenayim beechad ken en memirin vechozrin ummirin

Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan tanya kevateh deresh lakish tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan keshem sheen memirin echad bishnayim kach en memirin vechozrin ummirin tanya kevateh deresh lakish yachol keshem sheamar rabbi shimon sheen memirin shenayim beechad kach en memirin vechozrin ummirin talmud lomar vehaya hu utmurato afilu bemea
Bae rabbi avin ledivre haomer en memirin vechozrin ummirin hifrish asham lehitkapper bo vehemir bo
b: Vehumam vechillelo al acher venitkapper beasham acher venitak leola mahu sheyyamir bo
Amar abbaye may ka mibaya leh i shene gufim ukdushsha achat tibe leh belo mitkapper
I shette kedushshot veguf echad tibe leh belo humam
Verabbi avin chada miggo chada kamibaya leh veim timtze lomar shene gufin ukdushsha achat la mishshum divhahi kedushsha ha itmar bah chada zimna shene gufin ushte kedushshot mahu teku
Lishana acharina bae rabbi avin lerabbi yochanan deamar en memirin vechozrin ummirin hifrish asham lehitkapper bo vehemir bo vehumam vechillelo al acher mahu sheyyachzor veyamir
Nitkapper beasham acher venitak ze leola mahu sheyyachazir veyamir
Amar abbaye he ka mibaya leh kedushsha acheret beoto hagguf la nive humam vechillelo beacher i guf echad acher beotah kedushsha la nive nitkapper beasham acher

Verabbi avin chada miggo chada ka mibaya leh humam vechillelo al acher mahu sheyyachazor veyamir mi amrinan beasham rishon hu deen chozer umemir aval beguf echad acher af al gav dekaddish otah kedushsha chozer umemir o dilma kol beotah kedushsha en chozer umemir
Veim timtza lomar haddin guf echad acher kevan divotah kedushsha kaem en chozer umemir ella nitkapper beasham acher venitak ze rishon leola mahu sheyyachazir veyamir bo

Mi amrinan ki en memir vechozer umemir hane mile oto hagguf beotah kedushsha aval oto hagguf bikdushsha acheret chozer umemir o dilma af al kedushsha acheret kevan deoto hagguf hu en chozer umemir teku
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hekdesh rishon mosif chomesh veen hekdesh sheni mosif chomesh
Amar rav pappa may tama derabbi yehoshua ben levi amar kera veim hammakdish yigal et beto veyasaf chamishit makdish velo hammatpis
Bae rabbi avin hifrish asham lehitkapper bo vehumam vehosif alav chomesh vechillelo chavero venitkapper beasham acher venitak ze leola mahu sheyyosif alav chomesh
Amar abbaye may ka mibaya leh i shene gufin ukdushsha achat ka mibaya leh tibe leh belo nitkapper
I shette kedushshot veguf echad ka mibaya leh tibe belo humam
Verabbi avin chada miggo chada kamibaya leh im timtza lomar shene gufin ukdushsha achat la mishshum divhahi kedushsha itosaf bah chada zimna chomesh shene gufin ushte kedushshot may teku
Lishana acharina bae rabbi avin hifrish asham lehitkapper bo vehumam vechillelo al acher vehosif chomesh nitkapperu beasham acher venitak ze leola mahu sheyyosif alav chomesh
Amar abbaye haden ka mibaya leh i kedushsha acheret beoto hagguf ka mibaya leh la nibe leh humam i guf echad acher beotah kedushsha ku
Vechillelo al acher mahu sheyyosif alav chomesh mi amrinan beasham kamma hu demosef aval beguf echad acher af al gav dekaem beotah kedushsha en mosif chomesh

a: O dilma kol otah kedushsha eno mosif chomesh

Veim timatze lomar haden guf echad acher kevan divotah kedushsha kaem eno mosif chomesh ella nitkapper beacher venitak ze leola mahu ki eno mosif chomesh beoto hagguf beotah kedushsha aval bikdushsha acheret la o dilma kevan deoto hagguf hu eno mosif chomesh teku
Bae rame bar chama makdish mosif chomesh o mitkapper mosif chomesh amar rava amar kera veim hammakdish yigal et beto makdish velo mitkapper
Bae rame bar chama makdish ose temura o mitkapper ose temura amar rava im ken matzinu tzibur veshuttafin osin temura kegon deshauo shaliach leakdoshe

Veod deamar rav nachman amar rav huna tana korbano la al nizro millevad asher tassig yado vechi nazir nidon behesseg yad ha ketzad korbano la al nizro shehifrish mishshello millevad asher tassig yado shehifrishu lo acherim
Lemay hilcheta ilema leinyan kappara peshita demikkappar leh ella leinyan temura vehachi kaamar af keshehifrishu lo acherim ose temura shema minah batar mitkapper azlinan

La leinyan temura udka kashya lach mattana deka yahavin leh i lav derabbi rachamana millevad asher tassig yado hava amena gezerat hakkatuv hu korbano middideh hu demikkappar middaacherim la ka mashma lan
May have alah ta shema deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan makdish mosif chomesh umitkapper ose temura
Torem mishshello al shel acherim tovat hanaa shello may tama amar kera et kol masar tevuatcha venatatta vego
Matni en memirin lo evarin beubbarin velo ubbarin beevarim velo ubbarin veevarim bishlemim velo shelemim bahen

Rabbi yose omer memirin evarim bishlemim aval lo shelemim bahen amar rabbi yose vahalo bemukdashin haomer raglah shel zo ola kullah ola af kesheyyomar raglah shel zo tachat zo tehe kullah temura tachteha

Gema ittemar bar peda amar en kedushsha chala al ubbarin rabbi yochanan amar kedushsha chala al ubbarin veazda rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi yochanan hikdish chattat meubberet veyalda ratza bah mitkapper ratza biveladah mitkapper
Utzricha dei ashmeinan behach kammayeta hatam hu deakdesheh
b: Leubbara gufeh aval hacha deakdeshah leimeh ha bichlal imeh la kadosh
Vei ashmeinan batrayeta hatam hu deakdesh lah vechol deit bah aval hacha deakdesheh leh kevan deleteh abbaray la kadesh tzericha
Lishana acharina may ka mashma lan im shiyero meshuyyar veubbar lav yerech immo hu vetarte lema li
Tzericha dei ittemar beha mishshum deimeh chazya legufeh miggo denachata kedushsha lah nachata name levalad aval idach la ka mashma lan hada
Vei ittemar beha mishshum deka mefaresh kedushsha al haem havalad aval hahi la tzericha

Yatev rabbi zera vekaamar leha shemata etiveh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera ketzad maarimin al habbechor hamvakkeret shehayeta meubberet omer ma shebbemeeha shel zo ola yalda zachar hare zo ola alma kadosh ubbar
Amar leh ki mittanya hahi bikdushshat damim mi allima kedushshat damim deka mafkea leh min habbechora

Amar leh in vehatnan kol kadashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin babbechora uvammattanot tama dilachar shennifdu dechayyavin aval kodem shennifdu peturin alma deallima kedushshat damim demafka leh mibbechora
Etiveh haomer ma shebbemeeha shel zo ola mutteret begiza vaasura baavoda mishshum kichush ubbar shebbah amar leh ha name kedushshat damim
Umi allima kedushshat damim deasra leh baavoda amar leh in vehatnan yotzin lechullin ligazez veleaved tama mishshum denifdu ha kodem shennifdu asurin baavoda alma kedushshat damim asrin leh baavoda
Etiveh en memirin lo evarin beubbarin velo ubbarin beevarin emure hu dela memar ha mikdash kadshi
Amar leh bevalde kadashim hu dekaddishi vekayemi
I velad kadashim bime imman hu dela avdin ha abbaray avdin veha tanya en havalad ose temura
Ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar havalad ose temura
I rabbi yehuda temura hu dela avdi ha mikdash kadshi haamar rabbi yehuda evarin la kadshi amar leh hacha bemay askinan beevar shehanneshama teluya bo
Etiveh makdishin evarin veubbarin aval lo memirin hacha name bevalde kadashim
I bevalde kadashim may makdishin ha kaddishi vekayemi

a: Hachi kaamar makdishin evarin ummirin bahen aval lo memirin bahen veubbarim shekkadshu bime imman en memirin bahen
Bevalde kadashim bime imman hu dela avdin temura ha abbaray avdi veha tenan en havveladot osin temura ha manni rabbi yehuda hi
I rabbi yehuda evarin mi kadshi ha lerabbi yehuda let leh haomer raglah shel zo ola kullah ola
Amar leh hacha bemay askinan bedavar haose otah terefa
Lema ketannae hashshochet et hachattat umatza bah ben arba chay katane chada enah neechelet ella lezichre chehunna veenah neechelet ella lifnim min hakkelaim veenah neechelet ella leom echad
Vetanya idach neechelet lechol adam veneechalin bechol makom veenan neechalin baazara may lav tannae hi demar savar kedushsha chala al ubbarin umar savar en kedushsha chala al ubbarin
La hane tannae beha ka mipalgi demar savar valdot kadashim bahavayatan hen kedoshim umar savar valde kadashim bime imman hen kedoshim
Veibaet ema chad tanna hu chada mehalen matneyata bemakdish behema veachar kach nitabbera vachada minnehon shehikdishah meubberet
Tanya rabbi eliezer omer kilayim utrefa veotze dofen tumtum veanderoginos lo kedoshin velo makdishin veamar shemuel lo kedoshin bitmura velo makdishin laasot temura
Vetanya amar rabbi meir meachar sheenan kedoshin heach makdishin i atta motze ella bemakdish behema veachar kach nitrefa bemakdish valad veyatza derech dofen alma kadesh valad

Amri betam bime temima afilu bar peda name mode dekadesh lo nechleku ella betam bime baalat mum bar peda savar kevan deimeh la mikkaddesha kedushshat hagguf hu name la kadesh verabbi yochanan savar hane kishte vehemot ninhu imeh hi dela mikaddesha aval hu kadosh
Lishana acharina aval kilayim vetumtum veanderoginos i atta motze ella bevalde kodashim
Uchrabbi yehuda shehaya omer havalad ose temura halen hu dela kadshi gufayehu aval ubbarin acherim kedoshin

Amar abbaye tam bime temima divre hakkol kadesh gufeh ella ki peligi bime baalat mum devar peda savar kevan deimeh name la kadesh gufah ihu name la kadesh ella lidme rabbi yochanan savar ubbar lav yerech immo hu veaf al gav deimeh la kadsha legufah valad miha kadesh legufeh
Amar rabbi yose vahalo bemukdashin haomer raglah shel zo ku
b: Tanu rabbanan yachol haomer raglah shel zo ola tehe kullah ola talmud lomar kol asher yitten mimmennu la yihye kodesh mimmennu la velo kullo la
Yachol tetze lechullin talmud lomar yihye kodesh ha ketzad timmacher letzorche olot vedameha chullin chutz middeme ever shebbah divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda
Verabbi yose verabbi shimon omer minnayin laomer raglah shel zo ola shekkullah ola shenneemar kol asher yitten mimmennu la keshehu omer yihye kodesh lerabbot et kullah
Amar mar timmacher letzorche olot veha kamayete behema mechusseret ever amar rava beomer hare alay ola bechayyeha
Amar rav chisda mode rabbi yehuda bedavar sheose otah terefa rava amar bedavar sheose otah nevela verav sheshet amar bedavar shehi meta
May ika ben rav chisda lerava ika benayehu terefa chayya rav chisda savar lah keman deamar terefa enah chayya verava savar lah keman deamar terefa chayya
Umay ika ben rava lerav sheshet ika benayehu derabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar nitla yarech vechalal shellah nevela rava savar lah kerabbi elazar rav sheshet la savar lah kerabbi elazar
Metivi amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yehuda bedavar sheen hanneshama teluya bo vedivre rabbi yose bedavar shehanneshama teluya bo lav mikkelal diflig aleh derabbi yehuda

Bishlama nirin divre rabbi yehuda bedavar sheen hanneshama teluya bo mikkelal diflig aleh derabbi yose ella nirin divre rabbi yose bedavar shehanneshama teluya bo lav mikkelal diflig aleh derabbi yehuda utuvta dechullehu

La chassore michassera vehachi katane nirin divre rabbi yose lerabbi yehuda bedavar shehanneshama teluya bo sheaf rabbi yehuda lo nechlak alav ella bedavar sheen hanneshama teluya bo aval bedavar shehanneshama teluya bo mode leh
Bae rava baof mahu behema amar rachamana veha lav behema hi o dilma korban amar rachamana vehay name korban hu teku

Bae rava hikdish ever ledamav mahu detechot leh kedushshat hagguf mi amar kevan denachata leh kedushshat damim nachata leh name kedushshat hagguf umiddeakdesheh lechad ever akdeshah lechullah o dilma chad miggo amar tere miggo la amar
Tifshot leh middideh dehaamar rava hikdish zachar ledamav kadosh kedushshat hagguf
Hatam deakdesheh lechulleh hacha deakdesheh chad ever may teku
Bae mineh abbaye merava hikdish chad ever mahu begiza tifshot lach meha detanya lo tagoz bechor tzoncha aval atta gozez beshellecha veshel acherim
Hatam la nachata leh kedushsha kelal hacha nachata leh kedushsha lishana acharina hatam en beyado lehakdisho hacha beyado lehakdisho
Bea mineh abbaye merava hikdish orah mahu baavoda ta shema haomer ma shebbemeeha shel zo ola mutteret begiza vaasura baavoda mippene kichush ubbar shebbah
Amar leh ki katane asura baavoda midderabbanan i hachi afilu begiza name titsar amar leh avoda demachchasha gazri bah rabbanan giza la gazri bah rabbanan
Bea mineh abbaye merav yosef hi shelamim uveladah chullin ushchatah bifnim mahu leman deamar valde kadashim bahavayatan hen kedoshin mi have chullin baazara o la

a: Amar leh mi karena beh ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom vezavachta
Bae mineh abbaye merav yosef hi chullin uveladah shelamim ushchatah bechutz mahu mi michayyav aleh mishshum shechute chutz o la
Amar leh mi karena beh veheviam la
Lishana acharina amar leh rauy lefetach ohel moed chayyavin alav bachutz
Matni en hamdumma medammea ella lefi cheshbon
Veen hamchummatz mechammetz ella lefi cheshbon veen hammayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve ella lefi cheshbon
Veen me chattat osin me chattat ella im mattan efer veen bet happeras osin bet happeras veen teruma achar teruma
Veen temura osa temura velo havalad ose temura rabbi yehuda omer havalad ose temura amru lo hekdesh ose temura veen havalad ose temura
Gema man tanna amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan dela kerabbi eliezer
Ditnan sea shel teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea chullin venidmeu venafal min hamdumma lemakom acher rabbi eliezer omer medammea kitruma vadday sheani omer sea shennafla hi shealta
Vachachamim omrim enah medammaat ella lefi cheshbon shebbah
Veen hamchummatz mechammetz ku amar rabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer

Ditnan seor shel chullin veshel teruma shennaflu letoch haisa velo baze kede lehachmitz velo baze kede lehachmitz venitztarfu vechimtzu rabbi eliezer omer achar acharon ani ba vachachamim omrim ben shennafal isur lechattechila uven shennafal isur bassof leolam en asur ad sheyehe bo kede lehachmitz

Veen hammayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve man tana amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi ditnan rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer mikve sheyyesh bo esrim veachat sea me geshamim memalle bakkatef tesha esre sea ufotkan lammikve
b: Vehen tehorin shehashsheiva metaheret birviyya uvhamshacha
Mikkelal derabbanan savri devirviyya uvhamshacha la ella dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan sheuva shehimshichuha kullah tehora manni la rabbanan vela rabbi eliezer
Ella amar rabba lefi cheshbon kelim veosef ben choni hi

Detanya sheloshet luggin mayim sheuvin shennaflu lammayim bishnayim ushlosha kelim vaafilu bearbaa vachamishsha kelim poslim et hammikve yosef ben choni omer bishnayim ushlosha kelim poslin et hammikve bearbaa vachamishsha en poslin et hammikve
Veen me chattat naase naasin me chattat ku man tanna amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan dela kerabbi shimon
Detanya hikdim afar lammayim pasul verabbi shimon machshir
May tama derabbi shimon dichtiv velakchu lattame meafar serefat hachattat venatan alav mayim chayyim vetanya rabbi shimon omer vechi afar hu vahalo efer hu

Shina hakkatuv mimmashmao ladun hemennu gezera shava neemar kan afar veneemar lehallan afar ma lehallan afar al gabbe hammayim af kan afar al gabbe hammayim uma kan hikdim afar lammayim kasher af kan hikdim afar lammayim kasher
Vehacha menalan tere kerae ketivi venatan alav alma efer beresha vahadar ketiv mayim chayyim el keli ha ketzad ratza afar lematta ratza afar lemala
Vetanna didan may tama amar lach sefeh dikra daveka venatan alav learvan
May chazet deamratte sefeh dikra daveka dilma resha daveka la matzet amratte ma matzinu bechol makom machshir lemala af kan machshir lemala
Veen bet happeras ose bet happeras ku matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer ditnan rabbi eliezer omer bet happeras ose bet happeras
Verabbanan ad kamma ki ata rav dimi amar resh lakish amar rabbi shimon bar abba

a: Shalosh sadot ushte maanot vechamma melo maane mea amma kidtanya hachoresh et hakkever ose bet happeras melo maane mea amma
Veen teruma achar teruma ku matnitin manni rabbi akiva hi ditnan hashshuttafin shettarmu ze achar ze rabbi eliezer omer terumat shenehem teruma
Rabbi akiva omer en terumat shenehem teruma vachachamim omrim im taram harishon kashshiur en terumat hashsheni teruma veim lo taram kashshiur terumat hashsheni teruma
Veen temura osa temura ku may tama amar kera utmurato velo temurat temurato
Veen havalad ose temura deamar kera hu hu velo valad
Rabbi yehuda omer havalad ose temura deamar kera yihye lerabbot et havalad verabbanan lerabbot shogeg kemezid

Matni haofot vehammenachot en osin temura shello neemar ella behema hatztzibur vehashshuttafin en osin temura shenneemar lo yachalifennu velo yamir yachid ose temura veen hatztzibbur vehashshuttafin osin temura kodshe bedek habbayit en osin temura
Amar rabbi shimon vahare maaser bakkelal haya velamma yatza
Lomar lach ma maaser korban yachid yatzu korbenot tzibbur uma maaser korban mizbeach yatzu korbanot bedek habbayit
Gema tanu rabbanan yachol yehu kodshe bedek habbayit osin temura talmud lomar korban mi shennikreu korban yatzu kodshe bedek habbayit shello nikreu korban
Vela vehatanya i korban shomea ani afilu kodshe bedek habbayit shennikreu korban kainyan shenneemar vannakrev et korban Adonai vego

Talmud lomar veel petach ohel moed lo hevio kol habba el petach ohel moed chayyavin alav mishshum shechute chutz vechol sheeno ba lefetach ohel moed en chayyavin alav mishshum shechute chutz alma ikru korban
Amar rabbi chanina la kashya ha rabbi shimon ha rabbanan lerabbi shimon ikri korban lerabbanan la ikri korban
Vela vehachtiv vannakrev et korban Adonai korban Adonai ikri korban la la ikri
Tanu rabbanan lo yevakker ben tov lara velo yemirennu lamma neemar vahalo kevar neemar lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov beravego
