Lefi shenneemar lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto mashma korban yachid korban tzibbur vekorban mizbeach vekorban bedek habbayit talmud lomar lo yevakker

Amar rabbi shimon vahare maaser bakkelal haya velamma yatza lomar lach ma maaser korban yachid vekorban mizbeach vedavar shebba bechova vedavar sheeno beshuttafut af kol korban yachid vekorban mizbeach vedavar shebba bechova
b: Vedavar sheeno ba beshuttafut
Rabbi omer lamma yatza maaser meatta lidon bitmurat shemo uvitmurat gufo
Lomar lach temurat shemo kereva temurat gufo enah kereva temurat shemo nigelet temurat gufo enah nigelet
Temurat gufo chala al davar harauy veal davar sheeno rauy utmurat shemo enah chala ella al davar harauy bilvad
Amri mishshum derabbi rachamana deit beh temurat shemo igroe igra in deamrinan may derabbi rabbi umay dela rabbi la rabbi
Veha mehecha tete amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua mishshum dehave davar habba lidon bedavar hechadash veen bo ella chidusho bilvad
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava lerabbi shimon deamar davar habba bechova olat chova hi deavda temura ha olat nedava la amar leh olat nedava name kevan dekabbelah aleh avdah temura
Velo nitzrecha ella leola habbaa min hammotarot
May kasavar i kasavar lah keman deamar motarot lenidvat tzibbur azli peshita dela avda temura ha en temura betzibbur

Ella rabbi shimon sevira leh keman deamar motarot lenidvat yachid azli man shamatte leh hay sevara rabbi eliezer ha shaminan leh behedya deavda temura detanya ola habbaa min hammotarot osa temura divre rabbi eliezer
Rabbi shimon savar lah kevateh bachada uflig aleh bachada derabbi eliezer savar ola habbaa min hammotarot osa temura veihu savar en osa temura
I hachi devae rabbi avin hifrish asham lehitkapper bo vehemir bo venitkapper beasham acher venitak ze leola mahu sheyyachzor veyamir bo
Alliba deman ilema alliba derabbi shimon ha amratte rabbi shimon sevira leh ola habbaa min hammotarot en osa temura

Rabbi avin hachi kamibaya leh i mashkachatte tanna dekae kerabbi shimon deamar en memirin vechozrin ummirin usvira leh kerabbi eliezer deamar ola habbaa min hammotarot osa temura mahu sheyyachzor veyamir bo
Bishne gufin ukdushsha achat may
Veim timtza lomar kedushsha achat o la ella shette kedushshot veguf echad may tibe
Hadaran alach hakkol memirin

a: Matni yesh bekorbenot yachid sheen bekorbenot hatztzibur veyesh bekorbenot hatztzibur sheen bekorbenot hayyachid shekkorbenot hayyachid osin temura veen korbenot hatztzibur osin temura

Korbenot hayyachid nohagot ben bizcharim ben binkevot vekorbenot hatztzibur en nohagin ella bizcharim korbenot hayyachid chayyavin beachrautan uvachraut niskehem vekorbenot hatztzibur en chayyavin beachrautan velo beachraut niskehen aval chayyavin beachraut niskehen mishshekkarav hazzevach
Yesh bekorbenot hatztzibur ma sheen bekorbenot yachid shekkorbenot hatztzibur dochin et hashshabbat veet hattuma vekorbenot yachid enan dochot lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma
Amar rabbi meir vahalo chavite kohen gadol ufar shel yom hakkippurim korbenot hayyachid hen vedochin et hashshabbat veet hattuma ella shezzemanno kavua
Gema korban yachid ose temura ku uchlala hu vahare ofot dekorban yachid veen ose temura ki katane bivhema katane
Vahare valad dekarban yachid hu veen ose temura ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar havalad ose temura
Vahare temura atzmah dekorban yachid hi veen temura osa temura ki katane beikar zivcha katane
Hashta deatet lehachi afilu tema rabbanan beikar zivcha katane
Korbenot hayyachid nohagot ben bizcharim ben binkevot uchlala hu vahare ola dekorban yachid vezachar atya nekeva la atya
Haika olat haof detanya tammut vezachrut bivhema veen tammut vezachrut baofot
Vahare chattat dekorban yachid hi unkeva atya zachar la atya haika seir nasi demayete zachar

Vehaika asham yachid dezachar ate nekeva la ate ki kaamri rabbanan korban deshave ben beyachid ben betzibur asham beyachid iteh betzibbur leteh veibaet ema mi katane kol korbenot yesh bekorbenot katane umay nihu shelamim vei bae nekeva mayete vei bae zachar mayete
Korbenot yachid chayyavin beachrautan ku mena lan
Detanu rabbanan devar yom melammed shekkol hayyom kasher lemusafin beomo melammed sheim avar hayyom velo hevian eno chayyav beachrautan
Yachol lo yehe chayyav beachraut niskehem veaf al pi shekkarav hazzevach talmud lomar minchatam veniskehem ballayela minchatam veniskehem lemachar
Resh lakish amar mehacha millevad shabbatot Adonai

Utzricha dei ketav rachamana millevad shabbetot Adonai hava amena bayyom in uvallayela la amar kera uminchatam veniskehem vei ketav rachamana minchatam veniskehem vela ketav millevad shabbetot Adonai hava amena belelya in bimama la
Umay shena mishshum divkadashim layela holech achar hayyom tzerichi
Unsachim mi karvi ballayela vehatnan en li ella devarim sheddarkan likrav ballayela kegon evarim ufdarim shemmakrivin mibbo hashshemesh umitakkelin veholchin kol hallayela kullo

Devarim sheddarkan likrav bayyom kegon hakkometz hallevona uminchat nesachim shemmaalan mibbo hashshemesh mibbo hashshemesh salka datach vehaamratte devarim sheddarkan likrav bayyom ninhu ella im bo hashshemesh shemmitakkelin veholchin kol hallayela minnayin talmud lomar zot torat haola riba
Katane miha nesachim bayyom amar rame bar chama la kashya kan likdash kan likrav

Amar leh rava i mikdash kadshi karove mikarvi veha tanya ze hakkelal kol hakkarev bayyom en kadosh ella bayyom vechol hakkarev ballayela kadosh ballayela ben bayyom ben belayela kadosh ben bayyom ben ballayela ella amar rav yosef semi minchat nesachim meha matnita

Ki selek rav dimi ashkecheh lerav yirmeya deyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi minnayin linsachim habbaim im hazzevach sheen kerevin ella bayyom talmud lomar ulniskechem ulshalmechem ma shelamim bayyom af nesachim bayyom
Amar i ashkecheh dechatev igarta shelachi leh lerav yosef
b: Vela tisme minchat nesachim mimmatnita vela kashya kan binsachim habbain im hazzevach kan binsachim habbain bifne atzman
Vei hava leh igarta mi efshar lemishlechah veha amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan kotve halachot kesoref kesorfe tora vehallamed mehen eno notel sachar

Daresh rabbi yehuda bar nachmani meturgemaneh deresh lakish katuv echad omer ketov lecha et haddevarim haelle vechatuv echad omer ki al pi haddevarim haelle lomar lach devarim sheal pe i atta rashshay leomran bichtav veshebbichtav i atta rashshay leomran al pe
Vetana deve rabbi yishmael ketov lecha et haddevarim haelle elle atta kotev aval en atta kotev halachot

Amri dilma milta chadta shane deha rabbi yochanan veresh lakish meayeni besifra deaggadta beshabbeta vedarshi hachi et laasot la heferu toratecha amri mutav teaker tora veal tishtakkach tora miyyisrael
Amar rav pappa hashta deamratte nesachim habbain bifne atzman kerevin afilu ballayela nizdammenu nesachim ballayela makdishin ballayela umakrivin
Amar leh rav yosef bereh derav shemaya lerav pappa tanya dimsayya lach ze hakkelal kol hakkarev bayyom eno kadosh ella bayyom vechol hakkarev ballayela kadosh ben bayyom ben ballayela
Amar rav adda bar ahava vaalot hashshachar poselet bahen keevarin
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak elle taasu la bemoadechem ellu chovot habbaot chova baregel
Levad minnidrechem venidvotechem limed al nedarim undavot shekkerevin bechullo shel moed
Ulolotechem bema hakkatuv medabber i beolat neder hare kevar amur nidrechem vei beolat nedava hare kevar amur venidvotechem ha eno medabber ella beolat yoledet veolat metzora
Ulminchotechem bema hakkatuv medabber i beminchat neder hare kevar amur i beminchat nedava hare kevar amur ha eno medabber ella beminchat sota uvminchat kenaot
Ulniskechem ulshalmechem makkish nesachim lishlamim ma shelamim bayyom af nesachim bayyom ulshalmechem lerabbot shalme nazir
Amar leh abbaye velema mar shalme fesach dei shalme nazir nidar venidav hu
Dehatanya ze hakkelal kol shehu nidav venidar karev bevamat yachid vesheeno nidav venidar eno karev bevamat yachid
Utnan hammenachot vehannezirot kerevin bevamat yachid divre rabbi meir semi mikkan nezirot

Mi ika leman deamar denazir lav nidar venidav hu vehachtiv mikketz arbaim shana vayyomer avshalom el hammelech elcha na vaashallem et nidri asher nadarti la bechevron ki neder nadar avdecha vego may lav akkorban
La aikar nidro amri ikar nidro bechevron hava vahalo bigshur hava
Amar rav acha veitema rabba bar rav chanan lo halach avshalom ella lehavi kevasim mechevron hachi name mistabbera dei tema leakrove hu deazel shavek yerushalayim veazel umakrev bechevron
Veella may lehavi kevasim mechevron hay asher nadarti la bechevron mechevron mibe leh
Ella leolam leakrove udka kashya lach ammay shavek yerushalayim umakrev bechevron tikshe lach givon demakom kadosh hu ella kevan shehutteru habbamot kol hecha devae makrev
Arbaim shana leman tanya rabbi nehoray omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua mikketz arbaim shana sheshshaalu lahem melech detanya otah shana sheshshaalu lahem melech otah shana asirit shel shemuel hayeta

a: Eser shanim malach shemuel beatzmo shana achat shemmalach shaul ushmuel ushtayim shemmalach shaul beatzmo ushloshim vasheva shemmalach david
Matni chattat hayyachid shekkipperu bealeha meta veshel tzibbur enah meta

Rabbi yehuda omer tamut rabbi shimon omer ma matzinu bivelad chattat uvitmurat chattat uvchattat shemmetu bealeha devarim amurim beyachid velo betzibbur af shekkipperu bealeha veibra shenatah beyachid devarim amurim velo betzibur

Gema tanu rabbanan mahu omer chattat yavi minnayin lemakdish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzet harishona kayyemet vahare shettehen omdot minnayin sheezo mehen sheyyirtze yavi talmud lomar chattat yachol yavi shettehen talmud lomar yevienna achat velo shettayim
Veotah sheniyya ma tehe aleha amar rav hamnuna tanya rabbi yehuda omer tire rabbi shimon omer tamut
Umi amar rabbi yehuda tire veha rabbi yehuda tamut shaminan leh efoch rabbi yehuda omer tamut rabbi shimon omer tire umi amar rabbi shimon tire veha amar rabbi shimon chamesh chattaot metot
Ella amar leh leolam la tefoch vela kashya kan baavuda bishat hafrasha kan baavuda bishat kappara
Veibaet ema ide veide bishat hafrasha vela kashya ha rabbi yehuda alliba derabbi ha rabbi yehuda alliba derabbanan
Umi ika leman deamar chattat tzibur shekkipperu bealim meta
b: Vehatanya kayyotze bo amar rabbi yose vehabbaim mehashshevi vene haggola hikrivu olot parim bene vakar shenem asar elim tishim vetisha kevasim shivim veshiva seire chattat shenem asar hakkol ola la

Vechattat mi karva ola amar rava ki ola ma ola enah neechelet af chattat enah neechelet shehaya rabbi yose omer al avoda zara hevium veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel al avoda zara sheasu bime tzidkiyyahu
Ka salka datin leman deit leh chattat tzibbur shennitkapperu bealeha meta it leh name chattat tzibbur shemmetu bealeha meta veha hacha deika demetu baaleh veka karva
Amar rav pappa afilu leman deamar chattat tzibbur shekkipperu bealeha meta chattat tzibbur shemmetu bealeha enah meta lefi sheen hatztzibbur metim
Mena leh lerav pappa ha i nema mishshum dichtiv tachat avotecha yihu vanecha i hachi afilu yachid name
Ella hayenu tama sheen hatztzibur metim misseire regalim verashe chodashim deamar rachamana ayetinhu mitterumat hallishka vedilma mitu marayehu dehane zuze ella lav shema minah en hatztzibbur metim

Veibaet ema ki akruvinhu lehane chattaot achayye akruvinhu dichtiv verabbim mehakkohanim halviyyim verashe haavot hazzekenim asher rau et habbayit harishon beyosdo ze habbayit bochim bekol gadol verabbim bitrua
Vedilma hanach miuta la matzet amratte dichtiv velo hikkiru haam batterua vesimcha lekol bechi haam
Vehechi makrevi lehu vahare mezidin hao amar rabbi yochanan horaat shaa hayeta
Hachi name mistabbera dei la tema hachi bishlama parim usirim keneged shenem asar shevatim ella kevasim keneged mi ella horaat shaa hayeta
Tenan hatam mishshemmet yosef ben yoezer ish tzereda veosef ben yochanan ish yerushalayim batlu haeshkolot ish shehakkol bo
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol eshkolot sheamdu lahen leyisrael mimot moshe ad shemmet yosef ben yoezer hau lemedin tora kemoshe rabbenu mikkan veelach lo hau lemedin tora kemoshe rabbenu
Vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel sheloshet alafim halachot nishtakkechu bime evlo shel moshe deishtechuch lehu ishtechuch vedigmiran lehu hao gemiri kemoshe rabbenu
Veha tanya mishshemmet moshe im rabbu metammein timmeu im rabbu tehorin tiheru
Liba deimit migmar hao gemiri lehu kemoshe rabbenu
Bematnita tana kol eshkolot sheamdu leyisrael mimot moshe ad shemmet yosef ben yoezer ish tzereda lo haya bahem shum dofi mikkan veelach haya bahen shum dofi
Vehatanya maase bechasid echad shehaya goneach millibbo veshaalu larofim veamru en lo takkana ad sheyyinak chalav roteach shacharit veheviu ez vekashru lo bechare mitato vehaya yonek mimmenna chelev
Lemachar nichnesu chaverav levakkero kevan sherau haez amru listim mezuyyan betoch beto veanu nichnasim levakkero yashvu uvadku velo matzu bo aon ella shel otah haez bilvad
Veaf hu bishat mitato amar yodea ani beatzmi sheen bi aon ella shel otah haez bilvad sheavarti al divre chaveray shehare amru chachamim en megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael
Vekayema lan kol hecha deamar maase bechasid echad o rabbi yehuda ben bava o rabbi yehuda bar ilay verabbanan batar yosef ben yoezer ish tzereda dare dare hao

a: Amar rav yosef dofi shel semicha katane
Veha yosef ben yoezer gufeh miflag pelig bismicha ki iplig bah besof sheneh divtzar liba
Gufa amar rav yehuda amar shemuel sheloshet alafim halachot nishtakkechu bime evlo shel moshe amru lo lihoshua sheal amar lahem lo vashshamayim hi
Amru lo lishmuel sheal amar lahem elle hammitzot sheen hannavi rashshay lechaddesh davar meatta amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha af chattat shemmetu bealeha nishtakkecha bime evlo shel moshe
Amru lefinchas sheal amar lahem lo vashshamayim hi amru lo leelazar sheal amar lahem elle hammitzot sheen navi rashshay lechaddesh davar meatta

Amar rav yehuda amar rav beshaa shenniftar moshe rabbenu legan eden amar lo lihoshua sheal mimmenni kal sefekot sheyyesh lach amar lo rabbi kelum hinnachticha shaa achat vehalachti lemakom acher lo kach katavta bi umsharto yehoshua bin nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel miyyad tashash kocho shel yehoshua venishtakkechu mimmennu shelosh meot halachot venoldu lo sheva meot sefekot veamdu kol yisrael lehorgo
Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lomar lach i efshar lech vetorden bemilchama shenneemar vayehi achare mot moshe eved Adonai vayyomer Adonai vego
Bematnitin tana elef ushva meot kallin vachamurin ugzerot shaot vedikidduke sofrim nishtakkechu bime evlo shel moshe

Amar rabbi avahu af al pi chen hechziran otniel ben kenaz mittoch pilpulo shenneemar vayyilkedah otniel ben kenaz achi chalev vayyitten lo et achsa vitto leishsha velamma nikra shemah achsa shekkol haroe otah koes al ishto

Vayehi bevoa vattesitehu lishol meet aviha sade vattitznach meal hachamor may vattitznach amar rava amar rabbi yitzchak amra lo ma chamor ze kevan sheen lo maachal baavuso miyyad tzoek kach ishsha kevan sheen lah tevua betoch betah miyyad tzoeket

Vattomer tena li veracha ki eretz hannegev netattani bayit shemmenuggav mikkol tova venatatta li gullot mayim adam sheen bo ella tora bilvad vayyitten lah kalev et gullot illiyyot veet gullot tachtiyyot amar lah mi sheddar elonim vetachtonim yevakkesh mimmennu mezonot
Vechalev ben kenaz hu vahalo kalev ben yefunne hu may yefunne sheppana meatzat meraggelim
Veakkatti ben kenaz hu ben chetzron hu dichtiv vechalev ben chetzron holid et azuva amar rava chorgeh diknaz hu
Tanna hu otniel hu yabetz uma shemo yehuda achi shimon shemo otniel sheanao el yabetz sheyyaatz veribetz tora beyisrael
Umnalan sheanao el dichtiv vayyikra yabetz lelohe yisrael lemor im barech tevarcheni vehirbita et gevuli vehayeta yadcha immadi vaase meraati levilti otzbi vayyave elohim et asher shaal

Im berach tevarcheni battora vehirbita et gevuli betalmidim vehayeta yadcha immadi shello yishtakkeach talmudi millibbi vaase meraati sheyyizdammenu li reim kemoti levilti otzbi shello yesaggeveni yetzer hara millishnot im atta ose ken mutav veim lav hareni holech linsisi binsisi lashsheol miyyad vayyave elohim et asher shaal

Keotze baddavar atta omer rash veish techachim nifgashu meir ene shenehem Adonai beshaa shehattalmid holech etzel rabbo veomer lo lammedeni tora im melammedo meir ene shenehem Adonai veim lav ashir varash nifgashu ose chullam Adonai mi sheasao chacham laze ose oto tipesh tipesh laze ose oto chacham zo mishnat rabbi natan

Rabbi yehuda hannasi omer im barech tevarcheni bifriyya urviyya vehirbita et gevuli bevanim uvvanot vehayeta yadcha immadi bemassa uvmattan veasita meraati shello yehe bi mechosh rosh umechosh oznayim umechosh enayim levilti otzbi shello yesaggeveni yetzer hara millishnot im atta ose ken mutav veim lav hareni holech binsisi lashsheol vayyave lo elohim et asher shaal

Keotze baddavar atta omer rash veish techachim nifgashu meir ene shenehem Adonai beshaa sheani holech etzel baal habbayit veamar parneseni im mefarneso mutav veim lav ashir varash nifgashu ose chullam Adonai mi sheasao ashir laze ose oto ani ani laze ose oto ashir
Amar rabbi shimon ma matzinu ku
Tanu rabbanan rabbi shimon omer chamesh chattaot metot velad chattat utmurat chattat vechattat shemmetu bealeha vechattat shekkipperu bealeha vechattat sheibra shenatah

I atta yachol lomar velad chattat betzibur lefi sheen chattat nekeva betzibur vei atta yachol lomar temurat chattat betzibur lefi sheen tzibur osin temura vei atta yachol lomar chattat shemmetu bealeha betzibur lefi sheen hatztzibur metim
Shekkipru bealeha vesheibra shenatah lo matzinu yachol yehu nohagot ben beyachid ben betzibur
Amarta yilmad adam satum mimmeforash ma meforash beyachid velo betzibbur af beshekkipru bealeha vesheibra shenatah beyachid devarim amurim velo betzibur
b: Vechi danin efshar mishshei efshar rabbi shimon bechad makom gemir lehu
Amar resh lakish arbaa nittenu lahen veheemidum al chamesh vei salka datach betzibbur hanach mi itanhu betzibbur ella al korchach yilmad satum mimmeforash
Rabbi natan omer achat nittena lahen veheemiduha al chamesh
Velichze behe sidra gemiri lehu i beyachid i betzibbur
Shette shichchaot shachchu vekashya lehu
Vei salka datach betzibbur hanach mi itanhu betzibbur ella shema minah yilmad satum mimmeforash ma meforash beyachid velo betzibbur af satum beyachid velo betzibbur

Matni chomer bakkodashim mibbattemura vechomer battemura mibbakkodashim chomer bekadashim mibbattemura shehakkodashim osin temura veen temura osa temura hatztzibbur vehashshuttafin makdishin aval lo memirin umakdishin ubbarin veevarim aval lo memirin
Chomer battemura mibbakkodashim shehakkedushsha chala al baalat mum kavua veen yotza lechullin

a: Ligazez veleaved rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer asa shogeg kemezid battemura velo asa shogeg kemezid bammukdashin
Rabbi elazar omer hakkilayim vehatterefa vehayyotze dofen vetumtum veanderoginos lo kedoshin velo makdishin
Gema may tama derabbi yose berabbi yehuda amar kera yihye kodesh lerabbot shogeg kemezid
Hechi dame shogeg kemezid amar chizkiyya kesavur shehu muttar lehamir gabbe temura lake gabbe kadashim la lake
Lishana acharina gabbe temura kadesh gabbe kadashim la kadesh
Resh lakish verabbi yochanan amri kesavur lomar temurat ola veamar temurat shelamim lishana acharina gabbe temurat shelamim kadesh gabbe kadashim la kadesh
Lishana achrina kesavur lomar shachor veamar lavan gabbe temura lake gabbe kadashim la lake
Rabbi yochanan amar beomer tetze zo vetikanes zo gabbe kadashim beomer shennolad bahem mum neechalin belo pidon la lake gabbe temura lake
Rav sheshet amar beomer ekkanes labbayit ze veakdish veamir middati venichnas vehemir vehikdish shello middato gabbe temura lake gabbe kadashim la lake
Rabbi elazar omer hakkilayim vehatterefa vechu amar shemuel lo kedoshin bitmura velo makdishin laasot temura

Tanya amar rabbi meir umeachar sheen kedoshin mehechan makdishin ella i atta motze ella bemakdish behema veachar kach nitrefa bemakdish valad veyatza derech dofen aval kilayim vetumtum veanderoginos i atta motze ella bevalde kadashim vealliba derabbi yehuda deamar havalad ose temura
Amar rav pappa may tama derabbi elazar kivhema temea ma behema temea la karva vela nachata lah kedushshat hagguf af hanach la karvi vela nachata lehu kedushshat hagguf
Amar leh rav pappa lerava vahare baal mum dela karev venachata leh kedushshat hagguf amar leh baal mum karev bemino i hachi terefa name ka karva beminah
Ella amar rava kivhema temea ma behema temea pesul hagguf af kol pesul hagguf leappoke baal mum difsul chissaron ninhu
Amar leh rav adda lerava vahalo sarua vekalut ketiv bapparasha veha hane pesul hagguf ninhu
Ella amar rava kivhema temea ma behema temea deleka beminah af kol deleka beminah leappoke baal mum deha ika beminah
May amratte terefa ika beminah la damya levaal mum behema temea asura baachila utrefa asura baachila leappoke baal mum demuttar baachila
Amar shemuel hammakdish et hatterefa tzericha mum kavua lifdot alav shema minah podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim
Ella ema osa kedushsha lemita kesavur muttar lehakdish baale mumin legabbe mizbeach gabbe temura kadesh gabbe kadashim la kadesh lamut verabbi oshaya omer enah ella kemakdish etzim vaavanim bilvad

Tenan kal hakkodashim shennaasu terefa en podin otan lefi sheen podin hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim tama shennaasu ha hau meikara podin otan dilma hay tanna savar kol hecha dela chaze legufah la nachata lah kedushshat hagguf
Ta shema rabbi elazar omer hakkilayim veotze dofen utrefa vetumtum veanderoginos lo kedoshin velo makdishin veamar shemuel lo kedoshin bitmura velo makdishin laasot temura
Vetanya amar rabbi meir vechi meachar sheen kedoshin mehechan makdishin ella i atta motze ella bemakdish behema veachar kach nitrefa ha hayeta terefa meikara la nachata leh kedushshat hagguf
b: Amar lecha shemuel dilma hach tanna name savar kol hecha dela chazya legufah la nachata lah kedushshat hagguf
Hadaran alach yesh bekorbenot
Matni ellu kadashim shevaldotehen utmurotehen kayyotze bahen velad shelamim utmuratan veladan uvelad veladan ad sof kol haolam hare hen shelamim utunin semicha unsachim utnufat chaze vashok

Gema kevan ditna veladan uvelad veladan ad sof kol haolam lema li tanna didan shameh lerabbi elazar deamar velad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim vaamar leh tanna didan la mibaya biveladan dela modena ella afilu ad sof haolam la modena lach
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan zachar lerabbot et havalad
Vahalo din hu uma temura sheen gidule hekdesh kereva valad sheggidule hekdesh eno din sheyyikrav

Ma litmura shekken noheget bechol hakkodashim tomar bevalad sheeno noheg bechol hakkodashim eno karev hoil veeno noheg bechol hakkodashim talmud lomar zachar lerabbot et havalad nekeva lerabbot hattemura
En li ella temurat temimin uvelad temimin velad baale mumin utmurat baale mumin minnayin talmud lomar im zachar lerabbot velad baale mumin im nekeva lerabbot temurat baale mumin
Amar leh rav safra leabbaye veefoch ana mistabbera mimmakom shennitrabbeta temurat temimin nitrabbeta temurat baale mumin
Amar leh mi kaamena lach lefoch im zachar im nekeva ana kulleh kera kaamena ema zachar lerabbot et hattemura nekeva lerabbot et havalad amar leh valad leshon zachar mashma temura leshon nekeva mashma
Lemay hilcheta amar shemuel likrav vealliba derabbi elazar
Demahu detema ki kaamar rabbi elazar ola deika shem ola al immo aval hane veladot la karvi kamashma lan
Bar peda amar liriyya vealliba dedivre hakkol deittemar rava amar likrav vealliba derabbi elazar rav pappa amar liriyya vealliba dedivre hakkol
Vehay tanna mayete lah mehacha
Rak kodashecha ellu temurot asher yihu lach ellu havveladot tissa uvat

Yachol yachnisennu levet habbechira veyimna mehem mayim umazon kede sheyyamutu talmud lomar veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam kederech sheatta noheg beola atta noheg bitmura kederech sheatta noheg bishlamim atta noheg bevalde shelamim uvitmura
Yachol kol kadashim ken talmud lomar rak divre rabbi yishmael rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich hare hu omer asham hu ashom asham la hu karev veen temurato kereva
Amar mar tissa uvat yachol yachnisennu levet habbechira
Mena tete ha kevan degamri chamesh chattaot hanach mikrav karvi
Mahu detema chamesh chattaot metot bechol makom vehanach yamutu bevet habbechira kamashma lan
Amar mar yachol af kal hakkodashim ken talmud lomar rak kadashecha valad deman i deola zachar hu velav bar olode hu vei dechattat gemiri lah dilmita kayemi

a: I deasham gemiri lah deliriyya azla dechol shebbachattat meta baasham roe leolam bechattat vehilcheta gemiri lah lemita ukra lemaote lehakrava
Veha beha talya kevan dilmita azla mimmela la karva ella hilcheta lechattat vekara lemaote temurat asham
Ha name hilcheta gemiri lah deamri kol shebbachattat meta baasham roe ella kera mibe leh dei avar umakrev kae baase
Rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich ku hu karev veen temurato kereva lema li kera veha hilcheta gemiri lah
In hachi name ella kera lema li mibe leh lechidrav huna deamar rav huna asham shennitak liriyya ushchato setam kasher leshem ola
Nitak in lo nitak la may tama hu bahavayato yehe
Ulhay tanna deka yalef mehane kerae tipok li mizzachar unkeva hahu mibe leh livelad baale mumin velitmurat baale mumin
Vetipok li kullehu mehay kera im la mashma leh
Ulhay tanna denafka leh mizzachar im nekeva tissa uvata ma aved lehu afilu mimmirayehu lishana achrina mimmoriggayehu
Matni rabbi eliezer omer velad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim vachachamim omrim yikrav
Amar rabbi shimon lo nechleku al velad velad shelamim veal velad velad temura shello yikrav al ma nechleku al havalad rabbi eliezer omer lo yikrav vachachamim omrim yikrav

Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi pappeyas al velad shelamim sheyyikrav shelamim amar rabbi pappeyas ani meid shehayeta lanu para shel zivche shelamim vaachalnuha bappesach veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag
Gema amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan may tama derabbi eliezer amar kera veim zevach shelamim korbano la veem velo valad

Amar leh rabbi chiyya bar abba lerabbi amme ella meatta im al toda yakrivennu hachi name deem velo valad vechi tema hachi name vehatanya veladah utmuratah vechilufeha minnayin talmud lomar im al toda mikkol makom
Ella amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hayenu tama derabbi eliezer gezera shemma yegaddel mehem adarim adarim
Amar rabbi shimon lo nechleku ku
Ibaya lehu hechi tane lo nechleku shello yikrevu ella yikrevu o dilma lo nechleku sheyyikrevu ella lo yikrevu
Amar rabba mistabbera lo nechleku shello yikrevu ella yikrevu may tama ad kan la pelig rabbi eliezer aleh derabbanan ella bevalad aval velad valad akray bealma hu

Verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar lo nechleku sheyyikrevu ella lo yikrevu may tama ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ella bevalad aval velad valad mittoch maaseha maasav nikeret machshavto dilgaddel ka vae leh
b: Tane rabbi chiyya lesayyoe lerabbi yehoshua ben levi im kesev hu makriv valad rishon karev valad sheni eno karev
Hu karev veen velad kol hakkodashim karev
Valad demay i deola veasham zecharim hem vela bene valad hem i dechattat hilcheta gemiri lah dilmita azla
Amar ravina leetoye velad hamusseret velad hamusseret lema li kera avara avara mibbechor ka gamar lah
Itzterich salka datach amina en danin efshar mishshei efshar ka mashma lan
Heid rabbi shimon verabbi pappeyas ku
Ulrava deamar kadashim kevan sheavar alehem regel echad kal yom vaom over alehem beval teacher meatzeret bae mechleh amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava kegon shehaya chole baatzeret
Rav ashe amar may chag name dekatane chag shavuot veidach kol hechi dekatane pesach tane atzeret
I hachi may ashaduteh leappoke midderabbi eliezer deamar velad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim kamashed hu dekarev
Matni velad toda utmuratah veladan velad veladan ad sof kol haddorot hare ellu ketoda uvilvad sheen teunin lechem
Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan mahu omer yakrivennu
Mafrish toda veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha venimtzet harishona vahare shettehen omdot minnayin sheezo sheyyirtze yakriv velachmah immah talmud lomar toda yakriv

Yachol tehe sheniyya teuna lechem talmud lomar yakrivennu achat velo shettayim minnayin lerabbot veladot temurot vachalifot talmud lomar veim al toda yachol yehu kullan teunot lechem talmud lomar al zevach hattoda toda teuna lechem velo veladah utmuratah vachalifatah teuna lechem

Matni temurat ola velad temura velad velad veladah ad sof kol haolam hare ellu keola utunin hefshet venituach vechalil laishshim hammafrish nekeva leola veyalda zachar yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyavi bedamav ola rabbi elazar omer hu atzmo yikrav ola
Gema may shena resha dela peligi umay shena sefa difligi

Amar rabba bar bar channa bemachloket shenuya verabbi elazar hi verava amar afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la feligi aleh derabbi elazar ella gabbe mafrish nekeva leola deimeh la kereva aval temura deimeh name kereva afilu rabbanan modu
Umi amar rabbi elazar yikrav ola hu atzmo urminhu temurat asham velad temura veladan velad veladan ad sof kol haolam yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava
Rabbi eliezer omer yamutu rabbi elazar omer yavi bidmehen ola baddamim in hu atzmo la

Amar rav chisda rabbi elazar ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi sevira li daafilu valad name karev ola ledidchu deamritu roe odo li mihat demotarot lenidvat yachid azli veamri leh motarot lenidvat tzibur azli
Rava amar ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar hu atzmo yikrav ola ella bemafrish nekeva leola deika shem ola al immo

a: Aval gabbe temurat velad asham deleka shem ola al immo mode rabbi elazar divdamav in hu atzmo la karev

Etiveh abbaye vechi bae rabbi elazar shem ola al immo veha tanya hammafrish nekeva lefischo tire ad sheyyistaev shettistaev vetimmacher veyavi bedameha pesach yalda yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyavi bedamav pesach
Nishtayera achar happesach tire ad sheyyistaev shettistaev veyavi bedameha shelamim yalda yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyavi bedamav shelamim rabbi elazar omer hu atzmo yikrav shelamim
Veha hacha deleka shem shelamim al immo veamar rabbi elazar yikrav shelamim amar leh rabbi elazar rava achar happesach ka amratte shane achar happesach demotar pesach gufeh karev shelamim
I hachi niflog name beresha amar leh in hachi name ufligi
Abbaye amar la pelig mide digmiri limkom shehammotar holech havalad holech leachar happesach demotar karev shelamim valad name karev shelamim
Aval lifne happesach imeh lemay akdeshah lidme fesach valad name lidme fesach

Metiv rav ukva bar chama umi amrinan middeimeh lidme valad name lidme vehatanya hammafrish nekeva lappesach hi uvaldoteha yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyavi bidmehem pesach rabbi elazar omer hu atzmo yikrav pesach
Veha hacha deimeh lidme veamar rabbi elazar hu atzmo karev pesach vela mokminan leh beimeh
Amar ravina bemafrish behema meubberet askinan rabbi elazar savar kerabbi yochanan deamar im shiyero meshuyyar deubbar lav yerech immo hu veimmo hi dela kadsha kedushshat hagguf aval hi kadsha
Amar leh mar zutra bereh derav mari leravina hachi name mistabbera devivhema meubberet askinan middekatane hi uvaldoteha shema minah
b: Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina umode rabbi elazar bemafrish nekeva leasham deen benah karev asham peshita ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar ella bemafrish nekeva leola deika shem ola al immo aval gabbe mafrish nekeva leasham deleka shem asham al immo afilu rabbi elazar mode delo karev asham
I lav deashmeinan hava amena tama derabbi elazar lav mishshum deshem ola al immo ella mishshum dachaze valad lehakrava vehay name ha chaze lehakrava ka mashma lan
I hachi addemashma lan deen benah karev asham nashmeinan deen benah karev ola vehu haddin leasham
I ashmeinan ola hava amena ola hu dela karva dela akdeshah leimmah kedushsha ubbarah kedushshat ola aval asham kevan deakdeshah leimeh leasham ema valad karev asham ka mashma lan
Matni hammafrish nekeva leasham tire ad shettistaev vetimacher veyavi bedameha asham veim karav ashamo yippelu damav lindava
Rabbi shimon omer timacher shello bemum
Gema ulma li tistaev timacher kevan dela chazya lemilta hayenu muma
Amar rav yehuda amar rav hayenu taam deamrinan migo denachata lah kedushshat damim nachata name kedushshat hagguf amar rava zot omeret hikdish zachar ledamav kadosh kedushshat hagguf
Itmar hikdish zachar ledamav rav kahana amar kadosh kedushshat hagguf rava amar eno kadosh kedushshat hagguf vahadar beh rava lidrav kahana midderav yehuda amar rav
Rabbi shimon omer timacher shello bemum amar leh rav chiyya bar avin lerabbi yochanan migo denachata leh kedushshat damim techot leh name kedushshat hagguf

Amar leh rabbi shimon letameh deamar kol mide dela chaze leh legufeh la nachata leh kedushshat hagguf detanya asham ben shana vehevio ben shettayim ben shettayim vehevio ben shana keshera velo alu labbealim leshem chova
Rabbi shimon omer kol atzman enan kedoshin
Vahare mechussar zeman dela chaze veamar rabbi shimon dekadosh shane mechussar zeman dachaze limchar
I hachi asham ben shettayim vehevio ben shana ha chaze leshana ella hayenu tama derabbi shimon bimchussar zeman deyalef leh mibbechor

Kidtanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda amar mishshum rabbi shimon mechussar zeman nichnas laddir lehitasser vahare hu kivchor ma bechor kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno af mechussar zeman kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno
Tanu rabbanan hammakdish nekeva leolato

a: Ulfischo velaashamo osa temura
Rabbi shimon omer leolato osa temura lefischo velaashamo en osa temura
Sheen lecha davar ose temura ella haroe lehistaev
Amar rabbi en ani roe devarav shel rabbi shimon bappesach hoil umotar happesach karev shelamim
Velema en ani roe devarav shel rabbi shimon beasham hoil umotar asham karev ola rabbi savar lah kerabbanan deamri motarot lenidvat tzibur azli veen temura betzibbur
Ka salka datach hayenu tama derabbi shimon gabbe mafrish nekeva leolato mishshum hachi osa temura dehaika shem ole aleha gabbe olat haof
Ella meatta bechohen gadol shehifrish para lefaro tikdosh dehaika parat chattat kodshe bedek habbayit hu vekodshe bedek habbayit la avdi temura
Yachid shehifrish sair lisirato tikdosh dehaika seir nasi i name nasi shehifrish seira lisiro tikdosh deha yachid mafrish seira
Hane tere gufe ninhu
Chatu ad shello nitmannu ki mafresh sair lisirato tikdosh deha ilu chata hashta bar etoye sair hu ha la chata la ichayyav besair
I hachi hacha name ha lav olat haof kamayete
Rabbi shimon savar lah kerabbi elazar ben azarya ditnan hare alay ola yavi keves rabbi elazar ben azarya omer o tor o bene yona
Tenan hatam hammakdish nechasav vehaya bahen behema reuya legabbe mizbeach zecharim unkevot
Rabbi eliezer omer zecharim yimmachru letzorche olot unkevot yimmachru letzorche shelamim udmehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit
Rabbi yehoshua omer zecharim atzman yikrevu olot unkevot yimmachru letzorche shelamim veyavi bidmehen olot ushar nechasim yippelu levedek habbayit
Amar leh rabbi chiyya bar abba lerabbi yochanan lerabbi yehoshua deamar zecharim atzman yikrevu olot unkevot hechi karvan shelamim ha mikkoach kedushsha dechuyya kaatyan

Lishana achrina amar leh rabbi chiyya bar abba lerabbi yochanan middekaamar rabbi yehoshua zecharim atzman yikrevu olot lememra dikdushshat hagguf akdeshinhu i hachi nekevot ammay yimmachru letzorche shelamim baaya reiyya

Amar leh rabbi yehoshua savar lah kerabbi shimon deamar kol mide dela chaze leh legufeh la nachata leh kedushshat hagguf ditnan rabbi shimon omer timmacher shello bemum veamrinan detama derabbi shimon kevan dela chazya nekeva leasham la nachata leh kedushshat hagguf
Emor deamar rabbi shimon gabbe nekeva leasham
b: Deleka shem asham al immo aval gabbe nekeva leola deika shem ola al immo afilu rabbi shimon mode
Veod ha shaminan leh lerabbi shimon leolato ose temura
Amar leh rabbi yehoshua savar leh keidach tanna alliba derabbi shimon detanya rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon af leolato en ose temura

Matni temurat asham velad temura veladan velad veladan ad sof kol haolam yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu damav demehen lindava rabbi eliezer omer yamutu verabbi elazar omer yavi bidmeh olot
Asham shemmetu bealav veshekkipru bealav yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu damav lindava rabbi eliezer omer yamutu rabbi elazar omer yavi bedameha ola
Vahalo af nedava ola hi uma ben divre rabbi elazar ledivre chachamim ella bizman shehi baa ola somech aleha umevi nesachim unsacheha mishshello im haya kohen avodatah veorah shello
Uvizman shehi nedava eno somech aleha veeno mevi aleha nesachim unsacheha mishshel tzibur af al pi shehu kohen avodatah veorah mishshel anshe mishmar
Gema utzricha
Dei ashmeinan asham beha kaamar rabbi eliezer yamutu mishshum degazar leachar kappara attu lifne kappara
Aval gabbe temurat asham velad temuratah ema mode lehu lerabbanan
Vei ashmeinan hatam beha kaamri rabbanan aval gabbe asham modu leh lerabbi eliezer tzericha
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh machloket leachar kappara aval lifne kappara divre hakkol hu atzmo yikrav asham
Amar rava shette teshuvot baddavar chada deen adam mitkapper bedavar habba baavera veod hatane rav chananya lesayyoe lerabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar valad rishon karev velad sheni eno karev
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh machloket kodem kappara aval leachar kappara hu atzmo karev ola
Vehatane rav chananya lesayyoe lerabbi yehoshua ben levi kashya
Bea mineh rabbi avin bar chiyya merabbi avin bar kahana hifrish nekeva leasham benah mahu sheyyikrav leola vetifshot leh midderabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar mode rabbi elazar la shemia leh
May amar leh benah karev ola hay may ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar ella mafrish nekeva leola deika shem ola al immo aval gabbe asham deleka shem ola al immo afilu rabbi eliezer mode
Amar leh tama derabbi elazar lav mishshum deshem ole al immo ella mishshum dachaze lehakrava veha name chaze lehakrava
Etiveh veladan velad veladan ad sof kol haolam yavi bidmehen ola bidmehen in

a: Atzmo lo hacha vemay askinan kegon sheyyalda nekeva vead sof haolam lo olid chad zachar amar leh meshannena lach shinuye dechiki bavlae kegon sheyyalda nekevot ad sof haolam
Matni temurat habbechor vehammaaser veladan velad veladan ad sof haolam hare ellu kivchor uchmaaser veyeachlu bemuman labbealim
Ma ben bechor umaaser leven kol hakkodashim shekkol hakkodashim nimkarim baitlez venishchatin baitlez venishkalin belitra chutz min habbechor vehammaaser
Veyesh lahen pidon velitmurotehen pidon chutz min habbechor vehammaaser uvain mechutza laaretz chutz min habbechor vehammaaser sheim bau temimim yikrevu veim baale mumin yeachlu bemuman labbealim
Amar rabbi shimon ma taam shehabbechor vehammaaser yesh lahen parnasa mimmekoman ushar kol hakkodashim af al pi shennolad bahem mum hare ellu bikdushshatan
Gema amar rava bar rav azza baan bemareva hammetil mum bitmurat bechor umaaser mahu mi amrinan kevan dela kerivan la michayyav o dilma kevan dekadshu michayyav
Amar leh abbaye vetibe lach hammetil mum bitshii shel maaser
Ella may shena teshii dela kamibaya lach derachamana maateh asiri lehotzi hatteshii
Hachi name rachamana maatinhu lo tifde kodesh hem hem kerevin veen temuratan kereva
Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne lah hachi amar rav acha bereh derav azza baan bemareva hammetil mum bitshii shel maaser mahu amar leh vetibe lach hammetil mum bitmurat bechor umaaser
Ella may shena temurat bechor umaaser dela mibaya lach derachamana maatinhu kodesh hem hen kerevin veen temuratan kereva teshii shel maaser name rachamana maateh haasiri lehotzi et hatteshii
Veim bau temimin ku urminhu ben antignos heela bechorot mibbavel velo kibbelu mimmennu amar rav chisda la kashya ha rabbi yishmael ha rabbi akiva
Detanya rabbi yose omer shelosha devarim mishshum shelosha zekenim rabbi yishmael omer yachol yaale adam maaser sheni bizman hazze veyochlennu birushalayim

Vedin hu bechor taun havaat makom umaaser taun havaat makom ma bechor eno neechal ella bifne habbayit af maaser eno neechal ella bifne habbayit lo im amarta bivchor shekken taun mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach tomar bemaaser dela
Amarta bikurim teunin havaat makom umaaser taun havaat makom ma bikurim en neechalin ella bifne habbayit af maaser en neechal ella bifne habbayit
Ma levikurim shekken teunin hannacha tomar bemaaser dela

Talmud lomar veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha uvchorot bekarcha vetzonecha hikkish maaser livchor ma bechor eno neechal ella bifne habbayit af maaser en neechal ella bifne habbayit
Velehdar dina velete bema hatztzad
Amar rav ashe mishshum deika lememar ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahen tzad mizbeach

Umay kasavar i kasavar kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah vekidsha leatid lavo la shena bechor vela shena maaser bene havaa ninhu vei kasavar kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah velo kidsha leatid lavo afilu bechor name tibe lach
Leolam kasavar kedushsha rishona kidsha lishatah velo kidsha leatid lavo vehacha bemay askinan kegon shennizrak damo shel bechor bifne habbayit vecharav habbayit vaadayin besaro kayyam
Kevan dei iteh ledam lav bar zerika hu ate basar yalef middam
b: Veate maaser veyalef mibbechor umi yalfinan kodesh bekadashim mehadade vehaamar rabbi yochanan kol hattora kullah lemedin lamed min hallamed chutz min hakkodashim sheen lemedin lamed min hallamed
Maaser chullin hu hanicha leman deamar batar lamed azlinan ella leman deamar batar melammed azlinan may ika lememar basar vadam chada milta hi

Rabbi akiva omer yachol yaale adam bechor mechutza laaretz laaretz bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam veyakrivennu talmud lomar veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha uvchorot bekarcha vetzonecha mimmekom sheatta maale masar dagan atta maale bechor
Umimmekom shei atta maale masar dagan i atta maale bechor

Ben azzay omer yachol maale et yaale adam maaser sheni veyochlennu bechol haroe vedin hu bechor taun havaat makom umaaser taun havaat makom ma bechor eno neechal ella lifnim min hachoma af maaser eno neechal ella lifnim min hachoma

Ma livchor shekken taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach tomar bemaaser dela talmud lomar veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha uvchorot bekarcha vetzonecha makkish maaser livchor ma bechor eno neechal ella lifnim min hachoma af maaser eno neechal ella lifnim min hachoma
May kashya leh dekaamar yachol amarta hoil utnan en ben shilo lirushalayim ella shebbeshilo ochlin kadashim kallim umaaser sheni bechol haroe uvirushalayim lifnim min hachoma
Vechen kodshe kadashim lifnim min hakkelaim mahu detema birushalayim layete maaser sheni bechol haroe ka mashma lan
Acherim omrim yachol yehe bechor sheibbera shenato kifsule hammukdashin veyippasel
Talmud lomar masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha makkish bechor lemaaser ma maaser eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah af bechor eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah
Ulrabbanan demappeki lehu letama acharina mishshana lachavertah mena lehu nafka lehu millifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana limed al habbechor sheeno nifsal mishshana lachavertah

Velaacherim lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana may darshi beh mibe leh lechidtanya yom echad mishshana zo veom echad mishshana acheret limed al habbechor shenneechal lishne yamim valayela echad
Verabbanan deneechal lishne yamim valayela echad mena lehu amar kera yihye lach kachaze hattenufa
Hadaran alach ellu kadashim
Matni velad chattat utmurat chattat vechattat shemmetu bealeha yamutu vesheibra shenatah vesheavda venimtzet baalat mum im mishshekkipperu habbealim tamut veenah osa temura

a: Lo nehenin velo moalin veim ad shello kipru habbealim tire ad shettistaev vetimmacher veyavi bedameha acheret veosa temura umoalin bah
Gema may tama la tane lehu gabbe hadade resha pesika leh vesefa la pesika leh
Lema li lemitneyah gabbe meila lema li lemitneyah gabbe temura tena hacha temura veayede ditna temura tena name meila veayede ditna gabbe meila meila tena name temura
Amar resh lakish chattat sheibra shenatah roin otah keilu omedet bevet hakkevarot veroa
Tenan sheibra shenatah veavda venimtzet baalat mum im achar shekkipru bealim meta teuvta deresh lakish
Amar lach resh lakish ki katane resha meta aavda venimtzet baalat mum im achar shekkipru bealim tamut
I hachi ema sefa im ad shello kipru habbealim tire ad shettistaev vei baalat mum ha mesaava vekayema
Amar rabba hachi kaamar tanna sheavda venimtzet baalat mum over im achar shekkipperu bealim meta im kodem shekkipru bealim tire ad shettistaev bemum kavua vetimacher
Amar rava shette teshuvot baddavar chada deim ken yishmor mibe leh lemitne veod sheibra shenatah lemay hilcheta katane
Ella amar rava hachi katane ibbera shenatah veavda o avda venimtzet baalat mum achar shekkipru habbealim meta kodem shekkipru habbealim tire ad shettistaev vetimacher

Vetzarich lemitne im avda gabbe baalat mum vegabbe ibbera shenatah dei tena gabbe sheibra shenatah hava amena hatam hu demahneya lah aveda mishshum dela chazya lemiltah aval baalat mum dei la muma chazya ema la tahane leh aveda
Vei tane gabbe baalat mum hatam hu demahneya lah aveda mishshum dela chazya lehakrava aval ibra shenatah dechazya lehakrava ema la tahane lah aveda tzericha
Umi amar rava hachi vehaamar rava aveda delayela la shemah aveda
La dame aveda delelya la chazya la legufah vela lidme aval ha nehi dilgufah la chazya lidme chazya
Tenan hashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava lefi sheen chattat hatztzibur meta ha deyachid meta
Veamar rabbi yochanan baale chayyim nidchin uchshehu mitkapper besheni shebbezug sheni mitkapper
Veidach kamma have leh ki ibra shenatah vetama detzibur ha deyachid meta
Amar lach dechuyin lechud vaavudin lechud may tama avudin dateh alehon dilma mishtachchin dechuyin la hadari mitchazayin
b: Gufa amar rava avuda delayela la shemah avuda alliba deman ilema alliba derabbanan may irya avuda delayela afilu avuda deom name deamri rabbanan avuda bishat hafrasha roa
Veella alliba derabbi ad kan la kaamar rabbi ella aveda deom aval aveda delayela afilu rabbi mode deliriyya azla

Ibaet ema leolam alliba derabbanan vehacha vemay askinan beavda bishat kappara ad kan la kaamri rabbanan avda bishat kappara meta ella hecha deikar avedatah bayyom aval hecha deikar avedatah ballayela la
Amar abbaye naktinan aveda velo genuva aveda velo gezula
Hechi dame aveda amar rabbi oshaya afilu achat beedro vaafilu achat beachat verabbi yochanan amar achore haddelet

Ibaya lehu hechi kaamar achore haddelet hu deleka deka chaze lah aval abbaray deika dachaze lah la haveya avuda o dilma achore haddelet dei mahdar appeh chaze lah haveya avuda vechol shekken abbaray dela kachaze lah teku
Amar rav pappa gamrinan avuda mimmennu velo meroah la haveya avuda vechol shekken avuda meroah velo avuda mimmennu avuda mimmennu umeroah veechad besof haolam makkir bah may teku
Bae rav pappa avuda bakkos mahu alliba deman ilema alliba derabbi haamar avuda bishat hafrasha meta
Ella ki kamibaya leh alliba derabbanan mi amrinan ki amri rabbanan bishat hafrasha roa kodem sheyekabbel damah bakkos aval hacha sevira lehu kal haomed lizarek kezaruk dame
O dilma kema dela izderik dam ki avda bishat hafrasha damya veraaya
Veika deamri leolam alliba derabbi ki kamibaya leh kegon shekkibel damah bishte chosot veavad echad mehen
Vealliba deman deamar kos ose chavero dachuy la tibe lach ki tibe lach alliba deman deamar kos ose chavero shirayim
Hane mile hecha deitanhu letarvayehu dechol hecha devae zarek aval hacha ha leka o dilma la shena teku
Matni hammafrish chattat veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veachar kach nimtzet harishona tamut
Hammafrish maot lechattato veavdu vehifrish chattat tachtehem veachar kach nimtzeu hammaot yolichem leyam hammelach
Hammafrish maot lechattat veavdu vehifrish maot acherot tachtehen velo hispik likach chattat mehen ad shennimtzeu harishonot yavi meellu umeellu chattat vehashshear yippelu lindava
Hammafrish maot lechattato veavdu vehifrish chattat tachtehen lo hispik lehakrivah ad shennimtzeu hammaot vahare chattat baal mum timmacher veyavi meellu umeellu chattat vehashshear yippelu lindava
Hammafrish chattat veavda vehifrish maot tachteha velo hispik likach mehen chattat ad shennimtza chattato vahare hi baalat mum timacher veyavi meellu umeellu chattat vehashshear yippelu lindava
Hammafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha lo hispik lehakrivah ad shennimtzet harishona vahare shettehen baalat mum yimmachru veyavi meellu umeellu chattat vehashshear yippelu lindava

Hammafrish chattat veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha lo hispik lehakrivah ad shennimtzet harishona hau shettehen temimot achat mehen tikrav chattat vehashsheniyya tamut divre rabbi vachachamim omrim en chattat meta ella shennimtzet meachar shekkipru habbealim veen hammaot holchim leyam hammelach ella shennimtzeu meachar shekkipru habbealim
Hammafrish chattat vahare hi baalat mum mochrah veyavi bedameha acheret rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer im karva sheniyya ad shello nishchata tamut shekkevar kipru habbealim
Gema tama dehikriv acheret tachteha ha lo hikriv acheret tachteha roa manni rabbanan hi deamri avuda bishat hafrasha roa

Ema sefa hammafrish maot lechattat veavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehem yavi meellu umeellu vehashshear yippelu lindava tama meellu umeellu ha hevi meechad mehen hashsheni yolicho leyam hammelach atan lerabbi deamar avuda bishat hafrasha meta
Resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi hanicha lerav huna deamar rav huna amar rav

a: Hakkol modim sheim mashach achat vehikrivah shehashsheniyya meta mashkachatte lah kegon shemmashach achat mehen vehikriv vedivre hakkol
Ella lerabbi abba amar rav deamar hakkol modim bemitkapper besheenah avuda sheavuda meta al ma nechleku bemitkapper baavuda derabbi savar mafrish leibud keibud dame verabbanan savri lav keibud dame
Resha setam lan kerabbanan sefa setam lan kerabbi

Umay kamashma lan difligi rabbi verabbanan behedya katane lah machloket rabbi verabbanan besefa hammafrish chattat veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veachar kach nimtzet harishona vahare shettehen omdot achat mehen tikrav ushniyya tamut divre rabbi vachachamim omrim en chattat meta ella shennimtzet meachar shekkipru bealim veen maot holchot leyam hammelach ella shennimtzeu meachar shekkipru bealim
Ha kamashma lan davar ze machloket rabbi verabbanan

Gufa amar rav huna amar rav hakkol modim sheim mashach achat vehikrivah shehashsheniyya meta lo nechleku ella beva limalech derabbi savar lo asu takkana bekadashim veamrinan lach hitkapper besheenah avuda vaavuda meta verabbanan savri asu takkana bakkodashim veamrinan lach hitkapper baavuda vesheenah avuda tire
Motev rav mesharsheya velo asu takkana bakkodashim vehatanya yochlu ma talmud lomar melammed sheim hayeta achila muetet ochlin immah chullin utruma kede shettehe neechelet al hassava
Yochluha ma talmud lomar sheim hayeta achila merubba en ochlin immah chullin utruma kede shello tehe neechelet al haggassa
May lav afilu rabbi la rabbanan
Verabbi abba amar rav hakkol modim bemitkapper besheenah avuda sheavuda meta al ma nechleku demitkapper baavuda derabbi savar mafrish leibud keibud dame verabbanan savri lav keibud dame
Tenan hashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava sheen chattat tzibur meta ha deyachid meta
Veamar rav baale chayyim enan nidchin keshehu mitkapper besheni shebbezug rishon mitkapper veidach batra hava leh kemafrish leibud vetama detzibur ha deyachid meta
b: May lav afilu rabbanan la rabbi hi
Tenan hammafrish chattat veavda vehikriv acheret tachteha tamut
Tama dikreva mishshum dehikrivah ha lo hikrivah tire la shena mitkapper baavuda la shena mitkapper besheenah avuda la shena mashach vela shena lo mashach
Teuvta detarvayehu
Milta difsika leh katane milta dela pesika leh la katane
Tenan hammafrish maot lechattat veavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehem veachar kach nimtzeu hammaot yavi meellu umeellu chattat vehashshear yippelu lindava
Tama demitkapper meellu umeellu ha meechad yolichem leyam hammelach
La shena mitkapper baavuda vela shena mitkapper besheenah avuda vela shena mashach vela shena lo mashach teuvta detarvayehu hacha name milta difsika leh katane umilta dela pesika leh la katane
Amar rabbi amme hammafrish shene tzibure maot leachraut mitkapper beechad mehen vesheni yippelu lindava
Alliba deman ilema alliba derabbi peshita deyippelu lindava ad kan la kaamar rabbi ella bemafrish leibbud aval leachraut mode
Veella alliba derabbanan peshita leh deyippelu lindava kal vachomer hashta mafrish leibud amur rabbanan lav keibud dame leachraut mibaya
Veella alliba derabbi shimon itztericha leh mahu detema let leh lerabbi shimon nedava ka mashma lan deit leh nedava

Umi matzet amratte delet leh nedava lerabbi shimon vehatanya shelosha asar shofarot hau bammikdash vehaya katuv alehen tiklin chadtin veattikin kinin vegozle ola etzim ulvona vezahav lechapporet veshishsha lindava
Vetane alah shishsha lindava leola habbaa min hammotarot sheen orah lakkohanim divre rabbi yehuda

Amar lo rabbi nechemya veamri lah rabbi shimon im ken batla midrasho shel yehoyada hakkohen detanya ze midderash darash yehoyada hakkohen asham hu kullo lehavi kol davar habba mimmotar chattaot vaashamot likach bedamav olot habbasar lashshem veorot lakkohanim
Alma it leh nedava lerabbi shimon itzterich salka datach amena ki it leh nedava lerabbi shimon bechad sidra

a: Aval bitre sidre la ka mashma lan
Amar rabbi hoshaya hammafrish shette chattaot leachraut mitkapper beachat mehen vachavertah roa
Alliba deman ilema alliba derabbanan hashta hammafrish leibud amri rabbanan lav keibud dame leachraut mibaya
Ella alliba derabbi shimon haamar rabbi shimon chamesh chattaot metot
Ella alliba derabbi ki amar rabbi beibud aval achraut la
Tenan hammafrish chattat vahare hi baalat mum mochrah umevi acheret tachteha rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer im karva sheniyya kodem shennishchata rishona tamut shekkevar kipru bealeha
Ka salka datach derabbi elazar berabbi shimon kerabbi sevira leh vaafilu beachraut name
La dilma rabbi elazar berabbi shimon kaavuh sevira leh deamar chamesh chattaot metot
Tenan lefi sheen chattat tzibbur meta ha deyachid meta
Amar rav baale chayyin enan nidchin keshehu mitkapper besheni shebbezug rishon mitkapper veidach have leh achraut vekatane deyachid meta
Rav letameh deamar mitzva barishon
Tane rav shimi bar zeri kammeh derav pappa avda bishat hafrasha lerabbi meta lerabbanan tire avda bishat kappara lerabbanan meta lerabbi roe
Kal vachomer uma avuda bishat hafrasha deamri rabbanan roa amar rabbi meta avuda bishat kappara dilrabbanan meta lerabbi lo kol shekken
Ella tane hachi avuda bishat hafrasha lerabbi meta lerabbanan roa bishat kappara divre hakkol meta
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer vechu
Tanu rabbanan en margilin beom tov keotze vo en margilin bivchor velo bifsule hammukdashin
Bishlama beom tov deka tarach tircha dela chaze leh ella bechor man tena
Amar rav chisda bet shammay hi deamar bechor bikdushsheteh kae ditnan bet shammay omrim lo yimmane yisrael im hakkohen al habbechor
Pesule hammukdashin man tanna amar rav chisda rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi detanya hau lefanav shette chattaot achat temima veachat baalat mum temima tikrav baalat mum tippade
Nishchata baalat mum ad shello nizrak damah shel temima mutteret mishshennizrak damah shel temima asura
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer afilu besar baalat mum bakkedera venizrak damah shel temima yotze levet hasrefa
Verav chisda lokmah ide veide kevet shammay
Dilma ki amri bet shammay bivchor dikdushsheteh merechem aval pesule hammukdashin la
Velokma ide veide kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon
Dilma ki amar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon bifsule mukdashin deallimi lemitpas pidonan aval bivchor la
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon let leh ha ditnan kol pesule hammukdashin nishchatin baitliz venimkarin baitliz venishkalin belitra alma kevan desharet leh tafe vezaven
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana ma shemmashbiach baor pogem bevasar
Amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi avin mippene shennire keoved avoda bekadashim
Rabbi yose bar avin amar gezera shemma yegaddel mehem adarim adarim
Hadaran alach velad chattat
b: Matni ketzad maarimin al habbechor mevakkeret shehayeta meubberet omer ma shebbemeeha shel zo im zachar ola yalda zachar yikrav ola veim nekeva zivche shelamim yalda nekeva tikrav shelamim

Im zachar ola veim nekeva zivche shelamim yalda zachar unkeva hazzachar yikrav ola vehannekeva tikrav shelamim yalda shene zecharim echad mehem yikrav ola vehashsheni yimmacher lechayyave ola vedamav chullin
Yalda shette nekevot achat mehem tikrav shelamim vehashsheniyya timacher lechayyave shelamim vedameha chullin yalda tumtum veanderoginos rabban shimon ben gamliel omer en kedushsha chala alehen
Gema amar rav yehuda muttar lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyetze laavir haolam tenan omer adam ma shebbemeeha shel zo ola ola in shelamim la veatte amratte dematzet mafkeatte leh mikkedushshetah
Amar lach rav yehuda hane mile bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam ki kaamena ana bizman hazze dela chaze lehakrava
I bizman hazze may lememra mahu detema nigzar dilma nafek rov rosho vekashade beh muma
Veema hachi name afilu hachi ha adifa yattira middeate beh lide giza vaavoda
Im nekeva zivche shelamim nekeva mi ka kadsha bivchora sefa atya livhema dehekdesh
Yalda shene zecharim ku amri i behema dehekdesh hayech deakdesh ola lehdar ola idach neheve bikdushshetah deimeh sefa atan levehemat chullin
Yalda tumtum veanderoginos ku

a: Ammay en kedushsha chala alehen kasavar rabban shimon ben gamliel valdot kadashim bahavayatan hen kedoshin dei salka datach mimmee imman hen kedoshin ammay en kedushsha chala alehen ha tefastinhu kedushsha deimayehu ella shema mina valde kadashim bahavayatan hen kedoshim

Vehay tanna savar valde kadashim mimmee imman hen kedoshim detanu rabbanan ilu lo neemar bechor lo yakdish hayiti omer bechor lo yakdish hekdeshot talmud lomar ish oto oto i atta makdish aval makdish adam bechor hekdeshot
Vaadayin ani omer hu lo yakdish aval yakdishuhu acherim talmud lomar bivhema bivhema asakti
Yachol lo yakdishennu babbeten talmud lomar asher yevukkar la mishsheyevukkar la i atta makdish aval atta makdish babbeten
Yachol af valde kol hakkodashim ken talmud lomar ach chalak alma sevira leh valde kadashim mimmee imman hen kedoshin
Amar leh rav amram lerav sheshet amar al habbechor im yetziat rubbo ola ola have o bechor have
Ola have dechol purta ufurta deka nafek have kalil o bechor have dechol purta ufurta deka nafek bemilteh hu
Lishana achrina shekken kedushsha chayela aleh o dilma bechor have shekken kedushshato merechem
Amar leh may tibe lach hayenu devae ilfa amar al halleket im neshirat rubbo yehe hefker leket have o hefker have
Leket have shekken kedushshato bide shamayim o dilma hefker have shekken zochin bo aniyyim vaashirim
Veamar abbaye may tibe leh divre harav vedivre talmid divre mi shomim hachi name divre mi shomim
Matni haomer veladah shel zo ola vehi shelamim devarav kayyamim hi shelamim uveladah ola hare ze velad zivche shelamim divre rabbi meir
Amar rabbi yose im lechen nitkaven techilla hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keachat devarav kayyamin veim mishsheamar hare zo shelamim nimlach veamar veladah ola hare zo veladah shelamim
Gema amar rabbi yochanan hifrish chattat meubberet veyalda ratza bah mitkapper ratza biveladah mitkapper
May tama kasavar rabbi yochanan im shiyero meshuyyar
Ubbar lav yerech immo hu dehave leh kemafrish shette chattaot leachraut ratza mitkapper bah ratza mitkapper bachavertah
Motev rabbi elazar hi shelamim uveladah ola hare ze velad shelamim vei salka datach shiyero meshuyyar hare ze velad shelamim hare zo shelamim bae mitna
Amar rav tavla bar minah dehahi ha amar rav letanna teni hare zo shelamim
Metivi haomer leshifchato hare et shifcha uveladech ben chorin im hayeta ubbara zachta lo
I amratte bishlama im shiyero eno meshuyyar ubbar yerech immo mishshum hachi zachta lo vehave leh kimshachrer chatzi avdo umanni rabbi meir hi kidtanya
b: Hamshachrer chatzi avdo yatza lecherut gito veyado bain keechat

Vei amratte shiyero meshuyyar ubbar lav yerech immo hu ammay zachta lo veha tanya nirin shehaeved zoche lekabbel get shichrur shel chavero miyyad rabbo sheeno shello velo miyyad rabbo shello ella shema mina im shiyero eno meshuyyar utuvta derabbi yochanan teuvta

Lema im shiyero meshuyyar tannae hi detanya haomer leshifchato hare atte bat chorin uveladech eved veladah kamoha divre rabbi yose haggelili vachachamim omrim devarav kayyamin mishshum shenneemar haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha
Kera may talmuda lerabbanan amar rava amar kera lerabbi yose haggelili dekatane veladah kamoha shenneemar haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha bizman shehaishsha laadoneha veladah laadoneha
May lav beha kamipalgi derabbi yose savar shiyero eno meshuyyar verabbanan savri meshuyyar
Amar lach rabbi yochanan dechulle alma shiyero meshuyyar vehacha hayenu tama deamar kera haishsha viladeha tihye laadoneha

Ella vadday lema ki hane tannae detanya hashshochet et hachattat umatza bah ben arbaa chay tane chada en neechelet ella lezichre chehunna veenah neechelet ella leom echad veenah neechelet ella lifnim min hakkelaim
Vetanya idach neechelet lechol adam veneechelet bechol makom veneechelet leolam
May lav tannae detanna kamma savar shiyero eno meshuyyar umar savar shiyero meshuyyar
Amar lach rabbi yochanan dechulle alma im shiyero meshuyyar vehane tannae beha kamipalgi demar savar valde kadashim bahavayatan hen kedoshim umar savar valde kadashim bime imman hen kedoshim
Veibaet ema la kashya kan beshehikdishah ulvassof nitabbera
Kan beshennitabbera ulvassof hikdishah
Matkef lah rava mimmay detama derabbi yochanan im shiyero meshuyyar dilma hayenu tama derabbi yochanan deadam mitkapper beshevach hekdesh

Amar leh rav hamnuna rabbi elazar talmideh derabbi yochanan veyatev lekammeh derabbi yochanan vela ahdar leh hay shinuya veatte amratte tama derabbi yochanan mishshum deadam mitkapper beshevach hekdesh
Im mishsheamar hare zo shelamim nimlach ku peshita veladan shelamim ella kol emat devae mimlech
Amar rav pappa lo nitzrecha ella sheamar betoch kede dibur mahu detema toch kede dibur kedibur vehay ayyone hu dekamayyen ka mashma lan
Matni hare zo temurat ola temurat shelamim hare zo temurat ola divre rabbi meir
Amar rabbi yose im lechen nitkaven techilla hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keachat devarav kayyamim veim mishsheamar temurat ola nimlach veamar temurat shelamim hare zo temurat ola

a: Gema amar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yose amar rabbi yochanan hakkol modim beomer tachul zo veachar kach tachul zo divre hakkol tefos lashon rishon
Lo tachul zo ella im ken chalta zo tarvayehu kadshi

Lo nechleku ella kegon mishnatenu deamar temurat ola temurat shelamim derabbi meir savar middahava leh lememar temurat ola ushlamim veamar temurat ola temurat shelamim haveya leh keomer tachul zo veachar kach tachul zo
Verabbi yose savar i amar temurat ola ushlamim hava amena kedosha veenah kereva ka mashma lan

Tanu rabbanan haomer behema zo chetzyah temurat ola vechetzyah temurat shelamim kullah tikrav ola divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim tire ad shettistaev vetimacher veyavi bidme chetzyah temurat ola uvidme chetzyah temurat shelamim
Amar rabbi yose im lechach nitkaven mittechilla hoil vei efshar lehotzi shene shemot keachat devarav kayyamin rabbi yose hayenu rabbanan kullah rabbi yose katane lah
Tanya idach behema chetzyah ola vechetzyah chattat kullah tikrav ola divre rabbi meir
Rabbi yose omer tamut veshavin beomer chetzyah chattat vechetzyah ola shettamut
Shavin manni rabbi meir peshita
Mahu detema i lav deashmeinan hava amena tama derabbi meir lav mishshum tefos lashon rishon ella hayenu tama chattat meorevet kereva
Vaafilu ki amar chetzyah chattat vahadar amar chetzyah ola kereva ka mashma lan dela
Tanya idach amar behema zo chetzyah ola vechetzyah shelamim kedosha veenah kereva osa temura utmuratah kayyotze bah
Manni rabbi yose hi peshita dikdosha veenah kereva
Temuratah itzterich leh demahu detema nehi dehi la karva temuratah tikrav ka mashma lan may shena hi dela karva dehaveya lah kedushsha dechuya temuratah name mikkoach kedushsha dechuya kaatya
Amar rabbi yochanan behema shel shene shuttafim hikdish chetzyah shello vechazar velakach chetzyah acheret vehikdishah kedosha veenah kereva veose temura utmuratah
b: Kayyotze bah shema mina telat shema mina kedushshat damim nidcha medacha
Ushma mina baale mumin chayyim nidchin ushma minah dichuy meikaro have dichuy
Amar abbaye hakkol modim hecha deamar chetzyah ola vechetzyah maaser divre hakkol ola kereva
Hecha deamar chetzyah temura vechetzyah maaser may
Temura kereva shekken noheget bechol hakkodashim o dilma maaser kereva shekken makdish lefanav ulacharav teku
Matni hare zo tachat zo temurat zo chalifat zo hare zo temura zo mechullelet al zo en zo temura
Veim haya hekdesh baal mum yotze lechullin vetzarich laasot damim
Gema lememra detachat lishana deatpose hu urminhu kodshe bedek habbayit amar chalifat zo temurat zo lo amar kelum
Tachat zo mechullelet al zo devarav kayyamin
Vei salka datach lishana deitfose hi may shena resha umay shena sefa
Amar abbaye tachat mashkachatte lah lishana deitfose velishana deachole lishana deatpose dichtiv

a: Veim tachteha taamod habbaheret
Deachole dichtiv tachat hannechoshet avi zahav vehilkach gabbe kodshe mizbeach deavdin temura lishana deatpose hu gabbe kodshe bedek habbayit dela avdin temura lishana deachole hu
Amar rava afilu bekodshe mizbeach mashkachatte lah lishana deachole hu kegon shehaya hekdesh baal mum
Amar rabbi ashe afilu bevaal mum name mashkachatte lah lishana deachole umashkachat lishana deatpose yado akkodesh chol have yado achol kodesh have
Bae abbaye hau lefanav shette behemot shel kodesh baalot mum ushte behemot shel chullin temimot veamar hare ellu tachat ellu mahu
Mi amar leatpose velake o dilma kol hecha deika hetera la shavek inish hetera veaved isura

Veim timtze lomar kol hecha deika hetera la shavek inish veaved isura hau lefanav shette behemot shel kodesh veachat mehen baalat mum ushte behemot shel chullin veachat mehen baalat mum veamar hare ellu tachat ellu mahu
Mi amar temima tachat temima leatpose baalat mum tachat baalat mum leachole
O dilma temima dechullin tachat baalat mum dehekdesh baalat mum dechullin tachat temima dehekdesh vetarvayehu lake

Veim timtze lomar kol hecha deika hetera la aved isura ulachole hu vela lake hau lefanav shalosh behemot shel kodesh veachat mehen baalat mum veshalosh behemot shel chullin temimot veamar hare ellu tachat ellu
Mi amrinan midditmimot tachat temimot leatpose temimot name tachat baalat mum leatpose o dilma hacha name kol hecha deika hetera la aved isura vehahi batrayeta leachole have

Veim timtze lomar hacha name kevan deakkatti gavra la itachzak beisure la shavek hettera veaved isura bae rav ashe hau lefanav arba behemot shel kodesh veachat mehen baalat mum vearba behemot shel chullin veamar hare ellu tachat ellu mahu
Hacha vadday kevan deitachzak gavra beisure bechullan lake bearba malkiyyot
O dilma af al gav deitachzak beisura la shavek inish hetera veaved isura vehave batrayeta leachole have teku
Im haya hekdesh baal mum yotze lechullin ku
Amar rabbi yochanan yotze lechullin devar tora vetzarich laasot damim middivrehem veresh lakish amar af tzarich laasot damim devar tora
Bemay askinan i nema aonaa beha nema resh lakish af tzarich laasot damim devar tora
Veha tenan ellu devarim sheen lahem onaa haavadim vehashshetarot vehakkarkaot vehahekdeshot
Ella abbittul mikkach beha nema rabbi yochanan tzarich laasot damim middivrehem
b: Vehaamar rabbi yirmeya akkarkaot dechullin verabbi yona amar ahekdeshot tarvayehu mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amri onaa en lahen bitul mikkach yesh lahem
Leolam abbitul mikkach veefoch
Umi matzet amratte efoch hanicha leman deamar ahekdeshot vechol shekken akkarkaot
Ella leman deamar akkarkaot aval hekdeshot en lahen bitul mikkach hechi efoch leha
Amar rabbi yirmeya la tefoch
Lema bedishmuel ka mipalgi deamar shemuel hekdesh shave mane shechillo al shave peruta mechullal derabbi yona let leh dishmuel verabbi yirmeya it leh dishmuel
La ben demar uven demar it leh dishmuel derabbi yona savar ki amar shemuel diavad aval lechattechilla la amar verabbi yirmeya savar afilu lechattechilla
Veibaet ema leolam la tefoch udka kashya lach matnitin ellu devarim hekdeshot kidrav chisda
Deamar rav chisda en lahen onaa enan betorat onaa daafilu pachot mikkede onaa chozer
Amar ulla la amru ella beshamuy bitre aval beshamuy bitlata veaf al gav deate bemea la hadar
Ini vehaamar rav safra hecha amrinan mea kitre utre kima leinyan edut aval leinyan umdana batar deot azlinan
Vetu telata utlata la azlinan batar batra deyad hekdesh al haelona
Kasavar ulla tzarich laasot damim middivrehem vechol derabbanan akkilu beh rabbanan
Matni hare zo tachat ola tachat chattat lo amar kelum tachat chattat zo vetachat ola zo tachat chattat vetachat ola sheyyesh li babbayit haya lo devarav kayyamim
Amar al habbehema temea veal baalat mum hare ellu ola lo amar kelum hare ellu leola yimmachru veyavi bidmehem ola
Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav matnitin dela kerabbi meir dei kerabbi meir ha en adam motzi devarav levattala
Hare ellu leola yimmachru veyavi bidmehen ola tama divhema temea uvaalat mum dela chazyan la baayan muma aval mafrish nekeva leasham o leola baayan muma
Amar rav yehuda amar rav matnitin dela kerabbi shimon ditnan rabbi shimon omer timacher shello bemum
Hadaran alach ketzad maarimin

a: Matni kal haasurin legabbe mizbeach osrin bechol shehen harovea vehannirba vehammuktze vehanneevad vehaetnan vehammechir vehakkilayim vehatterefa veotze dofen
Ezehu muktze hammuktze laavoda zara hu asur uma shealav muttar veezehu hanneevad kol sheovdin oto hu uma shealav asur veze vaze muttar baachila
Gema amar mar osrin bechol shehen dela batli berubba tenena kol hakkodashim shennitarvu bechattaot metot o beshor hanniskal afilu echad beribbo yamutu
Vekashya lan may kaamar
Hachi katane nitarvu bahen mechattaot metot o shor hanniskal afilu beribbo yamutu
Itzterich salka datach amena hatam hu deisure hanaa aval hacha delav isure hanaa ema livtel berubba ka mashma lan
Verova venirba name tenena nitarvu rovea venirba yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyavi bidme yafe shebbahen meoto hammin
Amar rav kahana amritah lishmata kammeh derav shimi bar ashe amar li chada bechullin vachada bekadashim
Utzrichi dei ashmoinan gabbe kadashim mishshum dimisi aval gabbe chullin ema livtelu
Uvchullin name tenena veellu asurin veosrin bechol shehen yen nesech vaavoda zara vetzipore metzora veorot levuvin
Vesear nazir ufeter chamor uvasar bechalav veshor hanniskal veegla arufa vechullin shennishchatu baazara vesair hammishtalleach hare ellu asurin veosrin bechol shehen
Tzerichi dei ashmeinan hatam deisure hanaa dela batli aval hacha livteli
Vei ashmoinan hacha dilgavoha dimis aval lehedot ema isure hanaa livtelu berubba ka mashma lan
Verovea venirba menalan daasiri legavoha detanu rabbanan min habbehema lehotzi rovea venirba
Vahalo din hu uma baal mum shello neevda bo avera pasul legabbe mizbeach rovea venirba shenneevda bahen avera eno din sheasurin legabbe mizbeach
Choresh beshor vachamor yochiach shenneevda bo avera umuttar legabbe mizbeach
Ma lechoresh beshor vachamor sheen chayyavin mita tomar berovea venirba shechayyavin mita
Tol lach ma sheheveta hare shenneevda bahen avera bishne edim
Neevda bahen avera al pi ed echad o al pi habbealim minnayin

Amar rabbi shimon ani dan uma baal mum sheen hatraat shene edim posalto meachila hodaat ed echad posalto mehakrava berovea venirba shehodaat shene edim posalto meachila eno din shehodaat ed echad posalto mehakrava
Talmud lomar min habbehema lehotzi rovea venirba veha atya middina la atya
b: Amar rav ashe mishshum deika lememar meikara dedina pircha ma levaal mum shekken mumo nikar
Tomar berovea venirba sheen mumo nikar hoil veen mumo nikar yehe kasher legabbe mizbeach talmud lomar min habbehema lehotzi rovea venirba
Min habbakar lehotzi et hanneevad vahalo din hu uma etnan umchir shetztzipuyan muttarin hen asurin neevad shetztzipuo asur eno din shehu asur
O chiluf uma etnan umchir shehen asurin tzipuyehen muttarin neevad shemmuttar yehe tzipuo muttar
Im ken bitalta lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem velakachta lach

Ani akayemennu lo tachamod kesef vezahav bedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim aval bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim hoil vehen vehu muttar yachol yehe tzipuy muttar talmud lomar min habbakar lehotzi et hanneevad
Matkef lah rav chananya tama demaateh kera ha la maateh kera tzipuy muttar vehachtiv veibbadtem et shemam kol heasuy lishmam
Hahu lechannot lahem shem hu daata levet galya korin oto bet karya pene melech pene chelev en kol en kotz
Veefoch ana min habbehema lehotzi et hanneevad min habbakar lehotzi rovea venirba
Hatam meinyana dikra ketiv gabbe behema veish ki yitten shechovto bivhema mot yumat gabbe bakar ketiv vayyamiru et kevodam betavnit shor ochel esev
Min hatztzon lehotzi et hammuktze umin hatztzon lehotzi et hannogeach amar rabbi shimon im neemar rovea lamma neemar nogeach veim neemar nogeach lamma neemar rovea
Lefi sheyyeshno barovea ma sheen ken bannogeach yesh barovea sheharovea ose ones keratzon ma sheen ken bannogeach
Yesh bannogeach shehannogeach meshallem et hakkofer ma sheen ken barovea hutzrach lomar rovea vehutzrach lomar nogeach
Vehay tanna mayete lah mehacha detanya harovea vehannirba vechullam vechu hem kekadashim shekkadam mum over lehekdeshan
Utzrichin mum kavua lifdot alehen shenneemar ki moshchatam bahem mum bam

May talmuda chassore michassera vehachi katane minnayin shehen asurin talmud lomar ki moshchatam bahem mum bam vetana deve rabbi yishmael kal makom shenneemar hashchata eno ella devar erva vaavoda zara
Devar erva dichtiv ki hishchit kol basarvego avoda zara dichtiv pen tashchitun vaasitem lachem pesel temunat kol samel kal shehammum posel bahen devar erva vaavoda zara poslin bahen
Vetana deve rabbi yishmael min habbehema min habbakar umin hatztzon may daresh behu mibe leh perat lechole zaken umzoham
Vetanna kamma deappekinhu lehane kerae lerovea venirba chole zaken umzoham mena leh nafka leh min hatztzon min hakkevasim umin haizzim ultanna deve rabbi yishmael orcheh dikra leishtaoye hachi
Ezehu muktze laavoda zara vechu amar resh lakish en asur ella muktze lesheva shenayim
Shenneemar vayehi ballayela hahu vayyomer lo Adonai kach et par hashshor asher leavicha ufar hashsheni sheva shanim

Vehatam muktze bilchud hava neevad name hava amar rav acha bar yaakov muktze laavod velo avaduhu rava amar leolam avaduhu vechidush hu kidrabbi abba bar kahana deamar rabbi abba bar kahana shemona devarim hittiru beoto layela chutz velayela vezarut

a: Uchli sharet uchli ashera vaatze ashera umuktze veneevad
Amar rav tovi bar matna amar rabbi yoshiyya minnayin lemuktze min hattora shenneemar tishmeru lehakriv li bemoado kol sheosin lo shimur

Matkef lah abbaye ella meatta ayeti imra detzoma vela aved leh shimur hachi name dela chaze lehakrava amar leh ana tishmeru lehakriv li bemoado kaamena li velo leadon acher veezehu acher shemmakrivin lo heve omer zo avoda zara
Amar rava bar rav adda amar rav yitzchak en muktze asur ella ad sheyyaavdu bo ulla amar rabbi yochanan ad sheyyimseruhu lechumre avoda zara
Baha amar rabbi yochanan ad sheyyaachiluhu karshine avoda zara amar leh rabbi abba levaha mippalgitu attun aulla amar leh la ulla name ki kaamar hu deshafe leh karshine avoda zara
Amar rabbi abba yada beha leshannoye shemata vei la desalek hatam la hava yada deeretz yisrael gerama leh amar leh rav yitzchak baha mikan umikan hava
Detane rav chananya teritaa kammeh derabbi yochanan en muktze asur ella ad sheyyaasu bo maase hu tane lah vahadar vehu amar lah may maase ad sheyyiggazez veyaavdu bo
Ezehu neevad ku mena hane mile
Amar rav pappa deamar kera mimmashke yisrael min hammuttar leyisrael vei salka datach asiri lehedot lema li kera lemaotinhu miggavoha
Vechol hecha daasiri lehedot la bae kera veha terefa daasira lehedot umaateh kara miggavoha
Detanya keshehu omer min habbakar lematta sheen talmud lomar ella lehotzi et hatterefa
Itzterich salka datach amina hane mile denitrefa veachar kach nitkaddesha aval nitkaddesha veachar kach nitrefa ema detishtere legavoha
Veha mehacha nafka kol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet perat litrefa sheenah overet

Hahu name itzterich salka datach amena hane mile hecha delo hayeta lah sheat hakkosher denolda terefa mimmee immah aval hecha dehayeta lah sheat hakkosher veyatzat laavir haolam veachar kach nitrefa ema tishtere legavoha ka mashma lan

Matni veezehu etnan haomer lezona helich tale ze bischarech afilu hen mea kullan asurin vechen haomer lachavero helach tale ze vetalin shifchatcha etzel avdi rabbi meir omer eno etnan vachachamim omrim etnan
Gema amar mar vaafilu hen mea kullan asurin hechi dame ilema deshakla agra mea behemot peshita dechullehu asiri ma li chad ma li mea
La tzericha deshakla agra chada veyahev lah mea dechullehu mikkoach etnan kaatu
Tanu rabbanan natan lah velo ba aleha ba aleha velo natan lah etnanna muttar natan lah velo ba aleha etnanna karet leh vetu ba aleha velo natan lah may yahev lah
Ella hachi katane natan lah veachar kach ba aleha ba aleha veachar kach natan lah etnanna muttar velechul aleh etnan lemafrea amar rabbi elazar
b: Shekkadma vehikrivattu hechi dame i nema deakneyeh nihalah lealtar peshita demuttar dead kan lo ba aleha
Veella daamar lah la nikne lich ad sheat bia mi matzya makreva leh ish ki yakdish et beto kodesh la amar rachamana ma beto birshuto af kol birshuto
La tzericha daamar lah la mikkanya nikne lach ad sheat bia vei mitzterich lach nikne lach meachshav
Bae rav oshaya kadma vehikdishattu may tifshot leh midderabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar kadma vehikrivattu hikrivattu hi deha leteh bishat bia aval hikdishattu asur
Hi gufah kamibaya leh hikrivattu veha deha leteh bishat bia muttar aval hikdishattu bishat bia asur
O dilma kevan ditnan amirato laggavoha kimsirato lehedot hikdishattu muttar vechol shekken hikrivattu teku
Ba aleha veachar kach natan lah etnanna muttar vehatanya ba aleha venatan lah vaafilu ad shenem asar chodesh etnanna asur
Amar rav chanan bar rav chisda la kashya ha deamar lah hibbaali li betale ze ha deamar lah hibbaali li betale setam
Tale ze veha mechussar meshicha bezona goya dela kanya bimshicha veibaet ema afilu bezona yisreelit kegon dekae bachatzerah
Ha yahaveh lah meikara deshavveyeh lah appoteke vaamar lah im ad yom peloni yahevna lach zuze mutav veim lav tale beetnannich
Amar rav echad etnan zachar veechad etnan kol araot asur chutz meetnan ishto nidda
May tama zona ketiv veha lav zona hi
Velevi amar afilu ishto nidda may tama toeva ketiv veha toeva hi
Velevi name vehachtiv zona amar lach hahi zona velo zone verav hahi zona velo zone mena leh
Nafka leh midderabbi detanya rabbi omer en etnan asur ella kol etnan kol araot habbaot lo baavera aval etnan ishto nidda veshennatan lah sachar lehafkaatah veshennatna lo hi beetnanno muttarin
Af al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar uvtittech etnan veetnan lo nitan lach lah vattehi lehefech
Verav hay toeva may aved leh mibe leh kidabbaye deamar abbaye zona goya etnanna asur
May tama ketiv hacha toeva uchtiv hatam ki kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot hael ma lehallan araot sheen kiddushin tofsin bah hachi name en kiddushin tofsin bah
Vechohen shebba aleha en loke aleha mishshum zona may tama deamar kera lo yechallel zaro mi shezzaro meuchas acharav yatza goya deen zaro meuchas acharav
Zona yisreelit etnanna muttar ma taam deha kiddushin tofsin bah vechohen shebba aleha loke mishshum zona may tama deha zaro meuchas acharav

Verava amar echad ze veechad ze etnanna asur vechohen habba aleha loke mishshum zona may tama yalfi mehadade ma zona yisreelit belav af zona goya belav uma etnan zona goya asur af etnan zona yisreelit asur
Metivi echad zona goya veechad zona yisreelit etnanna asur teuvta deabbaye amar lach abbaye ha manni rabbi akiva hi deamar en kiddushin tofsin bechayyave lavin
Veha kamashma lan dechol zona la tafsi bah kiddushin dumya dealmana dela tafsi bah kidushin
Ulrava may shena dekatane kegon almana lechohen gadol dumya dealmana ma almana la lake ad dematri beh af zona ad deamar he licha
