Leappoke midderabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar panuy habba al penuya shello leshem ishut asaah zona aval hecha dezona meikara hachi name deasur
Lishana achrina ki katane ha baaraot sheen kiddushin tofsin bah
Veha katane sefa almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot etnanna asur veha hane kiddushin tofsin bahen ha manni

a: Rabbi elazar hi deamar panuy habba al happenuya shello leshum ishut asaah zona i rabbi elazar may irya almana nitne penuya
Almana itzterich salka datach amena hoil uvinyan av hu la nitasru ka mashma lan
Haomer lachavero he lach tale ze ku veha shifcha leeved mishra sharya amar rav huna etzlo kaamar veha dekatane eved lishana mealleya kaamar
I hachi may tama derabbi amar shemuel bar rav yitzchak leolam avdi vechi katane beeved ivri

I hachi may tama derabbanan shifcha leeved ivri mishra sharya hacha vemay askinan kegon delet leh ishsha uvanim detanya en lo ishsha uvanim en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit yesh lo ishsha uvanim rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit
Matni veezehu mechir kelev haomer lachavero helach tale ze tachat kelev
Vechen shene shuttafin shechalku echad natal asara veechad tisha vachelev shekkeneged hakkelev asur vesheim hakkelev muttar
Etnan hakkelev umchir zona hare ellu muttarin shenneemar shenayim velo arbaa valdotehen muttarin hen velo valdotehen
Gema tanu rabbanan mechir kelev zehu chalife chelev vechen hu omer timkor ammecha velo hon velo ribbita bimchirehem
Ema etnan mammash im ken hau telata gam shenehem velo shelosha
Mi kaamrinan anan etnan umchir etnan velo mechir kaamrinan
Im ken nema kera lo tavi etnan zona vachelev middichtiv etnan zona umchir kelev shema minah
Hashshuttafin shechalku echad natal ku ammay nipok chado lahade kalba vehanach kullehu lishtero hacha vemay askinan kegon ditfe deme chelev mechad minayehu vehahu tufyana dechelev shede bechullehu
Etnan kelev umchir zona muttar ku amar leh rava mipparzakya lerav ashe
b: Mena ha milta daamur rabbanan en zenut livhemot amar leh la nishmot lishtemit kera lichtov etnan zona vachelev
Tanya name hachi minnayin leetnan kelev umchir zona shemmuttarin shenneemar shenayim velo arbaa valdotehen muttarin shenneemar gam shenehem hem velo valdotehen
Amar rava velad hannirbaat asura hi uveladah nirbeu nogachat asura hi uveladah nagchu
Velad muktze veneevad muttar may tama leimeh aktzeyah leimeh palchi lah ika deamri velad muktze veneevad asur may tama denicha leh benifcheh
Amar rav achadvuy bar amme amar rav hamkaddesh beferesh shor hanniskal mekuddeshet beferesh egle avoda zara enah mekuddeshet may tama i baet ema kera vei baet ema sevara
I baet ema sevara nicha leh gabbe avoda zara benifcheh gabbe shor hanniskal la nicha leh benifcheh
I baet ema kera gabbe avoda zara ketiv vehayita cherem kamohu kol sheatta mehayye mimmennu hare hu kamohu gabbe shor hanniskal ketiv lo yeachel et besaro besaro asur pirsho muttar
Matni natan lah maot hare ellu muttarin yenot ushmanim uslatot vechol davar shekkayyotze bo karev al gabbe hammizbeach asur natan lah mukdashin hare ellu muttarin

Ofot hare ellu asurin shehaya baddin ma im hammukdashin shehammum posel bahen en etnan umchir chal alehen of sheen hammum posel bo eno din shello yehe etnan umchir chal alav talmud lomar lechol neder lehavi et haof

Kol haasurin legabbe mizbeach valdotehen muttarin rabbi eliezer omer velad terefa lo yikrav al gabbe hammizbeach rabbi chanina ben antignos omer keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa pesula meal gabbe hammizbeach kol hakkodashim shennaasu terefa en podin otan sheen podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim

Gema tanu rabbanan natan lah chitin vaasaatan solet zetim vaasaatan shemen anavim vaasaatan yayin tane chada asurim vetanya idach muttarin amar rav yosef tane guron demin asporak bet shammay osrin uvet hillel mattirin
Bet hillel savri hem velo valdotehen hem velo shinuyehen
Bet shammay savri hem velo valdotehen gam lerabbot shinuyehen ulvet hillel hachtiv gam gam levet hillel kashya
Tanu rabbanan bet Adonai elohecha perat lefara sheen baa labbayit divre rabbi elazar vachachamim omrim lerabbot et harikuin
Man chachamim amar rav chisda rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi detanya natan lah zahav rabbi yose bar yehuda omer en osin rikuin afilu achore bet hakkapporet
Natan lah mukdashin hare ellu muttarin ku

Veyihu mukdashin etnan umchir chal alehen mikkal vachomer uma ofot sheen hammum posel bahen etnan umchir chal alehen mukdashim shehammum posel bahen eno din sheetnan umchir chal alehen talmud lomar lechol neder lehotzi et hannadur
Tama demaatinhu kera ha la maatinhu kera hava amina ki yahev lah mukdashin chal alehen etnan umchir veha lav mamona hu
Amar rav hoshaya bemamne al pischo verabbi hi detanya veim yimat habbayit mihot misse
Hachayehu misse mikkede achila velo mikkede mikkach
Rabbi omer af mikkede mikkach sheim en lo mamne acherim immo al pischo veal chagigato umotav chullin sheal menat ken hikdishu yisrael pischehen
Kal haasurim legabbe mizbeach vechu amar rav kal haasurim legabbe mizbeach valdotehen muttarim vetane alah verabbi eliezer oser

Amar rav huna bar chinana amar rav nachman machloket sheibru ulvassof nirbeu derabbi eliezer savar ubbar yerech immo hu verabbanan savri lav yerech immo hu aval nirbeu ulvassof ibru divre hakkol muttarin
Rava amar machloket shennirbeu ulvassof ibru derabbi eliezer savar ze vaze gorem asur verabbanan savri ze vaze gorem muttar
Aval ibru ulvassof nirbeu divre hakkol asurin verava letameh deamar rava velad nirbaat asur hi uveladah nirbeu velad nogachat asur hi uveladah nagchu

Lishana acharina amri lah amar rav huna bar chinana amar rav nachman machloket shennirbeu keshehen mukdashin derabbi eliezer savar bizuy milta verabbanan savri la aval nirbeu keshehen chullin hoil vehishtannu divre hakkol muttarin
Rava amar rav nachman machloket keshennirbeu keshehen chullin derabbi eliezer savar bizuy milta verabbanan savri hoil vehishtannu muttarin aval nirbeu keshehen mukdashin divre hakkol asurin

a: Velad terefa ku leman deamar terefa yalda mashkachatte lah kegon shennitrefa ulvassof ibra
Uvha peligi derabbi eliezer savar ze vaze gorem asur verabbanan savri ze vaze gorem muttar
Leman deamar terefa enah chayya mashkachatte lah kegon sheibra ulvassof nitrefa uvha peligi derabbi eliezer savar ubbar yerech immo hu verabbanan savri ubbar lav yerech immo hu

Amar rav huna modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer beefroach betzat terefa sheasur may tama ad kan la peligi aleh derabbi eliezer ella bivelad behema demeavera ka ravya aval betzat terefa demiggufah detarnegolta ka ravya afilu rabbanan modu

Amar leh rava lerav huna tanya dimsayya lach melo tarvad rima habbaa meadam chay rabbi eliezer metamme vachachamim metaharin ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh ella berima defirsha bealma hu aval betza demiggufah detarnegolet hu afilu rabbanan modu
Amar leh abbaye adderabba ipcha mistabbera ad kan la pelig rabbi eliezer alayehu derabbanan ella berima deikri adam mechayyim rima dichtiv vetikvat enosh rimma uven adam tolea

Aval gabbe betza emat gadla lechi masrecha vechi asracha afra bealma hu afilu rabbi eliezer mode veod tanya behedya mode rabbi eliezer lachachamim beefroach betzat terefa shemmuttar amar leh i tanya tanya
Rabbi chanina ben antignos omer keshera ku may tama ilema demippatma minah ella meatta heechilah karshine avoda zara hachi name daasira
Ella tane rabbi chanina teritaa kammeh derabbi yochanan kegon shehenikah chalav roteach mishshacharit leshacharit hoil vichola laamod aleha meet leet
Kal hakkodashim shennaasu terefa en podin ku mena hane mile detanu rabbanan tizbach velo giza veachalta velo lichlavecha basar velo chalav mikkan sheen podim et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim
Ika deamri tizbach veachalta en lecha bahen heter ella mishsheat zevicha veelach kasavar podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim
Hadaran alach kal haasurin
Matni yesh bekodshe mizbeach sheen bekodshe bedek habbayit veyesh bekodshe bedek habbayit sheen bekodshe mizbeach
Shekkodshe mizbeach osin temura vekodshe bedek habbayit en osin temura kodshe mizbeach chayyavin alav alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame
b: Veladan vachalavan asur leachar pidonan vehashshochatan bachutz chayyav en notnin mehen laummanin bischaran ma sheen ken bekodshe bedek habbayit
Yesh bekodshe bedek habbayit shessetam hekdeshot levedek habbayit hekdesh bedek habbayit chal al hakkol umoalin begidulehen veen bahen hanaa labbealim
Gema uchlala hu dechol kodshe mizbeach osin temura vahare ofot dekodshe mizbeach hen utnan hammenachot vehaofot en osin temura ki katane abbehema
Vahare valad kodshe mizbeach hu utnan en havalad ose temura ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar valad ose temura
Vahare temura atzmah dekodshe mizbeach utnan en temura osa temura ki katane aikar zivcha
Hashta daatet lehachi afilu tema rabbanan ki katane aikar zivcha
Veen notnin mehen laummanin ku ha kodshe bedek habbayit notnin amar rabbi avahu deamar kera veasu li mishshelli
Yesh bekodshe bedek habbayit ku amar mar setam hekdeshot levedek habbayit vechal al hakkol man tanna amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan dela kerabbi yehoshua

Detanya hammakdish nechasav vehaya bahen behema reuya legabbe mizbeach zecharim unkevot rabbi eliezer omer zecharim yimmachru letzorche olot unkevot yimmachru letzorche shelamim udmehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit
Rabbi yehoshua omer zecharim hen atzman yikrevu olot unkevot yimmachru letzorche shelamim veyavi bidmehen olot ushar nechasim levedek habbayit
Ufliga derav adda bar ahava deamar rav adda bar ahava amar rav beeder shekkullo zecharim afilu rabbi eliezer mode dela shavek inish kodshe mizbeach umakdish levedek habbayit
Lo nechleku ella beeder sheyyesh bo mechetza zecharim umechetza nekevot verabbi eliezer savar en cholek et nidro umiddinkevot lav olot zecharim name lav olot
Verabbi yehoshua savar cholek et nidro
Lishana achrina amri lah amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav beshello hikdish ella behema afilu rabbi eliezer mode dela shavek inish kodshe mizbeach umakdesh levedek habbayit

Lo nechleku ella kesheyyesh shear nechasim immahen verabbi eliezer savar en adam cholek et nidro middishar nechasim la lekodshe mizbach behema name la lekodshe mizbeach verabbi yehoshua savar adam cholek et nidro
Udmehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit bishlama lelishana batra hayenu dekatane im shear nechasim levedek habbayit
Ella lelishana kamma litne yippelu levedek habbayit tanya name hachi udmehen yippelu levedek habbayit
Hekdesh bedek habbayit chal al hakkol leetoye may amar ravina leetoye shippuye veniva
Umoalin begidulehen leetoye may amar rav pappa leetoye bikdushshat mizbeach chalev hammukdashin uvetze torin
Kidtanya chalev hammukdashin uvetze torin lo nehenin velo moalin bamme devarim amurim bekodshe mizbeach aval bekodshe bedek habbayit hikdish tarnegolet moalin bevetzatah chamorah moalin bachalavah
Vaafilu leman deamar moalin begidule mizbeach hane mile gidulin dachazu lammizbeach aval gidulin dela chazu lammizbeach en moalin bahen

a: Matni echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit en meshannin otan mikkedushsha likdushsha umakdishin otan hekdesh iluy umachrimin otan veim metu yikkaveru rabbi shimon omer kodshe bedek habbayit im metu yippadu
Gema amar rav huna kodshe mizbeach shehitpisan lecherme chohanim lo asa kelum may tama amar kera kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu la kol cherem dekodesh kadashim have hahu la leheve
Metivi kodshe bedek habbayit shehitpisan ben lekodshe mizbeach ben lecherme chohanim lo asa kelum
Cherme chohanim shehitpisan ben lekodshe mizbeach ben lekodshe bedek habbayit lo asa kelum
Ha kodshe mizbeach shehitpis lecherme chohanim ma sheasa asuy teuvta derav huna
Amar lecha rav huna ki shayerah ahada shayerah dekadshe mizbeach shehitpisan levedek habbayit ma sheasa asuy aval lecherme chohanim lo asa kelum
Velitneyah gabbe hanach tanna deit beh tarte katane delet beh tarte la katane
Tenan makdish otan hekdesh iluy may lav hekdesh iluy levedek habbayit umachrimin lecherme chohen
La idi veidi kodshe bedek habbayit vela shena mappek lehu bilshon hakkodesh levedek habbayit vela shena mappek lehu bilshon cherme cherem levedek habbayit

Veha la tane hachi detanya bevarayeta hekdesh iluy kodshe bedek habbayit machrimin otam cherme chohanim veod ha tanya kodshe mizbeach shehikdishan lecherme chohanim ma sheasa asuy teuvta derav huna teuvta
Veha rav huna kera kaamar amar ulla amar kera cherem kol cherem
Umi amar ulla hachi veha amar ulla hammatpis ola levedek habbayit en bah ella ikuv
b: Gizbarin bilvad
Leolam rabbanan vekara limila hu daata
Limila lema leh kera kodshe kadashim ketiv beh

Velitamach ha deamar rabbi yannay en meila meforeshet min hattora ella beola bilvad shenneemar nefesh ki timol maal vechata bishgaga mikkodshe Adonai hamuchadin la aval chattat veasham la nafka ella midderabbi
Detanya rabbi omer kol chelev la lerabbot emure kadashim kallim limila
Lema li kera kodshe kadashim ketiv behu ella af al gav dekodshe kadashim ketiv behu bae kera lerabboyinhu limila charamim name af al gav dekodshe kadashim ketiv behu bae kera lerabboyinhu limila
Gufa hammakdish ola levedek habbayit en bah ella ikuv gizbarin bilvad metivi hammakdish ola levedek habbayit asur leshochotah ad shettippade
Midderabbanan hachi name mistabbera middekatane sefa im avar ushchatah ma sheasa asuy
Ella may midderabbanan i hachi ema sefa umoalin shette meilot vei midderabbanan ammay shette meilot hachi kaamar uruya limol bah shette meilot
Veim metu yikkaveru ku
Amar rabbi yochanan lerabbanan echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha
Veresh lakish amar lerabbanan kodshe bedek habbayit hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha kodshe mizbeach lo hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha

Veze vaze mode lerabbi shimon dekodshe bedek habbayit lo hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha vekodshe mizbeach hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha vedivre hakkol baal mum meikaro lo haya bichlal haamada vehaaracha

Tenan rabbi shimon omer kodshe bedek habbayit shemmetu yippadu bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar lerabbanan echad ze veechad ze hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha hayenu deitzterich rabbi shimon lefaroshe kodshe bedek habbayit shemmetu yippadu
Ella leresh lakish lema leh lefaroshe lema im metu yippadu
Amar lach resh lakish rabbi shimon la hava yada may deamar tanna kamma vehachi kaamar leh i bekodshe mizbeach modena lach bekodshe bedek habbayit im metu yippadu
Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan im behema asher yakrivu mimmenna bevaale mumin sheyyippadu hakkatuv medabber
Atta omer bevaale mumin o eno ella bivhema temea keshehu omer im bivhema temea ufada veerkecha hare behema temea amur

a: Ha ma ani mekayyem veim kol behema asher lo yakrivu mimmenna korban la bevaale mumin sheyyippadu
Yachol yippadu al mum over talmud lomar asher lo yakrivu mimmenna sheenah kereva kol ikar yatzta zo sheenah kereva hayyom ella lemachar
Veamar rachamana aved lah haamada vehaaracha

Amar rav gidel amar rav may tama deresh lakish deamar lerabbanan kodshe bedek habbayit hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha kodshe mizbeach lo hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha deamar kera veheerich hakkohen otah ben tov uven ra
Ezehu davar sheeno chaluk ben tov lera heve omer ze kodshe bedek habbayit veamar kera otah lemaote kodshe mizbeach
Verabbi yochanan otah lemaote may lemaote baal mum meikaro

Ultanna deve levi deamar daafilu baal mum meikaro bichlal haamada vehaaracha detane levi hakkol hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha vaafilu baal mum meikaro vechen tane levi bematniteh vaafilu chayya vaafilu ofot vehachtiv otah kashya

Amar rav yehuda amar rav may tama derabbi shimon deamar kodshe mizbeach hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha kodshe bedek habbayit lo hau deamar kera veheerich hakkohen otah ben tov uven ra ezehu davar shechaluk ben tov uven ra heve omer ze kodshe mizbeach veamar kera otah lemaote bedek habbayit
I hachi ben tov lera mibe leh kashya
Metivi metu temimin yikkavru uvaale mumin yippadu bamme devarim amurim bekodshe mizbeach aval bekodshe bedek habbayit ben temimin ben baale mumim yikkaveru
Rabbi shimon omer echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit temimim yikkavru baale mumin yippadu teuvta derabbi yochanan meresha
Amar lach rabbi yochanan hacha vemay askinan bevaal mum meikaro
Hachi name mistabbera dei tema shekkadam hekdeshan et muman liflog rabbi shimon alah ella lav shema mina bevaal mum meikaro
Ella lema tehve teuvteh deresh lakish
Resh lakish mokem lah beshekkadam hekdeshan et muman i hachi niflog rabbi shimon alah
Resh lakish mefach afech vehachi motev mimmechilta achariti metu ben temimin ben baale mumin yikkaveru bamme devarim amurim bekodshe mizbeach aval bekodshe bedek habbayit yippadu
Rabbi shimon omer temimim yikkavru uvaale mumin yippadu teuvta derabbi yochanan missefa
Amar lach rabbi yochanan hacha vemay askinan bevaal mum meikaro hachi name mistabbera dei tema beshekkadam hekdeshan et muman niflog rabbi shimon alah
Ella lema tehve teuvteh deresh lakish amar lach resh lakish hacha vemay askinan beshekkadam hekdeshan et muman veniflog rabbi shimon alah amar lach resh lakish hachi name diflig rabbi shimon
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera leresh lakish deamar lerabbanan kodshe mizbeach lo hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha vekatane kodshe mizbeach
b: Baale mumin yippadu umokminan lah beshekkadam hekdeshan et muman shema minah podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim
Hacha bemay askinan besheavar ushchatan
Kidtanya kol hakkodashim shennafal bahen mum ushchatan rabbi meir omer yikkaveru vachachamim omrim yippadu
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera lerabbi shimon deamar kodshe bedek habbayit lo hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha ammay temimim yikkaveru mishshum dachazu lehakrava
Kidtanya hammatpis temimim levedek habbayit keshehen nifdin enan nifdin ella lammizbeach shekkol harauy lammizbeach eno yotze mide mizbeach leolam
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye veamri lah rava lerabbi yochanan demokem lah bevaal mum meikaro vechulle alma sevira lehu devaal mum meikaro dela have bichlal haamada vehaaracha vela
Vehatnan kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin babbechora uvammattanot veotzin lechullin ligazez veleaved
Veladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidonan vehashshochatan bachutz patur veen osin temura veim metu yippadu
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav zo divre rabbi shimon deamar kodshe mizbeach hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha kodshe bedek habbayit lo hau keditnan rabbi shimon omer kodshe bedek habbayit im metu yippadu
Umode rabbi shimon bevaal mum meikaro shennifde may tama daamar kera otah otah lemaote baal mum meikaro aval chachamim omrim afilu baal mum meikaro haya bichlal haamada vehaaracha
Amar leh man chachamim tanna deve levi i hachi zo divre rabbi shimon vetu la zo divre rabbi shimon umachlukto mibe leh
Amar leh hay dela katane hachi mishshum derav savar lah keresh lakish deamar lerabbanan kodshe bedek habbayit hau bichlal haamada vehaaracha kodshe mizbeach lo hau
Veresha katane veim metu yippadu vesefa katane im metu yikkaveru
Veibaet ema rav kerabbi yochanan sevira leh udka kashya lach zo divre rabbi shimon umachlukto mibe leh ema hachi name
Matni veellu hen hannikbarin kadashim shehippilu yikkaveru hippila shilya tikkaver veshor hanniskal veegla arufa vetzippore metzora vesear nazir
Ufeter chamor uvasar bechalav vechullin shennishchatu baazara rabbi shimon omer chullin shennishchatu baazara yissarefu vechen chayya shennishchata baazara

Veellu hen hannisrafin chametz bappesach yissaref utruma temea vehaorla vechile hakkerem et sheddarkan lissaref veet sheddarkan lehikkaver yikkaver umadlikin befat uvshemen shel teruma kol hakkodashim shennishchatu chutz lizmannan vechutz limkoman hare ellu yissarefu

a: Asham taluy yissaref rabbi yehuda omer yikkaver chattat haof habbaa al hassafek tissaref rabbi yehuda omer yetilenna laamma
Kal hannikbarin lo yissarefu vechol hannisrafin lo yikkaveru rabbi yehuda omer im ratza lehachmir al atzmo lisrof et hannikbarin rashshay amru lo eno muttar leshannot

Gema sear hannazir yikkaver rame leh tavi lerav nachman tenan sear hannazir yikkaver urminhu haoreg melo hassit mitztzemer bechor beveged yiddalek habbeged missear hannazir ufeter chamor besak yiddalek hassak
Amar leh kan benazir tame kan benazir tahor
Amar leh shannet nazir annazir peter chamor appeter chamor kashya ishtik vela amar leh vela mide amar leh mide shemia lach beha amar leh hachi amar rav sheshet kan besak kan besear
Itmar name amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina kan besak kan besear rabbi elazar amar kan benazir tahor kan benazir tame
Amar leh livtel sak berubba amar rav pappa betzipurta tzipurta lishallofinhu
Amar rabbi yirmeya ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar im ratza lehachmir al atzmo lisrof et hannikbarim rashshay amar leh ka kashya lan leshallofinhu veatte mokmatte lah kerabbi yehuda
Hachi kaamena im efshar leshallofinhu mutav veim lav okmah kerabbi yehuda deamar im ratza lehachmir al atzmo lisrof et hannikbarin rashshay
Veellu hen hannisrafin amar mar chametz bappesach yissaref setam lan tanna kerabbi yehuda deamar en biur chametz ella serefa
Teruma temea vehaorla ku ha chetzad ochalin bisrefa mashkin bikvura
Chattat haof ku tanya amar rabbi yehuda chattat haof habbaa al hassafek yetilenna laamma umnattecha ever ever vezorkan laamma umitgalgelet veholechet lenachal kidron
Kol hannikbarin lo yissarefu ku may tama mishshum denikbarin efran asur venisrafin efran muttar
Venikbarin efran asur vehatanya dam hannidda uvsar hammet shennifrechu tehorin may lav tehorin umuttarin la tehorin vaasurin
Metiv rav pinchas olat haof shennitmatztza damah muratah venotza shellah yatzu mide meila may lav yatzu mide meila umuttarin la yatzu mide meila vaasurin
Venisrafin dehekdesh efran muttar veha tanya kol hannisrafin efram muttar chutz meefer ashera veefer dehekdesh leolam asur
Umirav hu dela kaarev lehu vetane lehu mishshum daashera yesh lah betila begoy hekdesh en lo betila olamit katane miha efer hekdesh leolam asur
Amar rame bar chama kegon denafla deleka baatze hekdesh meeleha kevan dela yedia man dela have inish delimol delipok efran lechullin
Rav shemaya amar ki tanya ha matnita bitrumat haddeshen tanya dilolam asur
Detanya vesamo benachat vesamo kullo vesamo shello yefazzer
Hadaran alach yesh bekodshe mizbeach uslika lah massechet temura

Matni sheloshim vashesh karetot betora habba al haem veal eshet av veal hakkalla habba al hazzachur veal habbehema veishsha hammevia habbehema aleha habba al ishsha uvittah veeshet ish habba al achoto veal achot aviv veal achot immo veal achot ishto veal eshet achiv veal eshet achi aviv veal eshet achi immo veal hannidda

Vehamgaddef veoved avoda zara vehannoten mizzaro lammolech uvaal ov umchallel shabbat vetame sheachal kodesh vehabba el hammikdash tame vehaochel chelev vadam venotar ufigul vehashshochet umaale bachutz
Vehaochel chametz bappesach vehaochel vehaose melacha beom hakkippurim vehamfattem et hashshemen vehamfattem et hakketoret vehassach et hashshemen hammishcha vehappesach vehammila mitzvat ase
Al ellu chayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat veal lo hoda shellahem asham taluy chutz min hamtamme mikdash vekadashav mippene shehu beole veored divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim af hamgaddef shenneemar tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga yatza megaddef sheeno ose maase
b: Gema minyana lema li amar rabbi yochanan sheim asaan kullan behelem achat chayyav al kol achat veachat
Vetu ha ditnan avot melachot arbaim chaser achat minyana lema li sheim asaan kullan behelem achat chayyav al kol achat veachat
Tu ha ditnan arbaa mechussere kappara minyana lema li
Leappoke midderabbi eliezer ben yaakov deamar chamishsha have detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer ger mechussar kappara ad sheyyizzarek dam alav ahachi tena arbaa
Tu ha ditnan arbaa meviin al hazzadon kishgaga minyana lema li
Leappoke midderabbi shimon detanya rabbi shimon omer shevuat happikkadon lo nitan zedonah lechappara ahachi tena arbaa
Tu ha ditnan chamishsha meviin korban echad al averot harbe minyana lema li

Mishshum deka bae lemitna sefa nazir im nitma tumot harbe umashkachatte lah kegon deitammi bishvii vechazar venitma bashshevii umanni rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi deamar nezirut detahara min shevii hu dechayel aleh
Dei temar rabbi hi kevan dinzirut detohora ad shemini la chayela aleh hechi mashkachatte lah
I denitma bishvii vechazar venitma bishvii kullah chada tuma arichta hi
Vei denitma bashshemini vechazar venitma bashshemini kevan deyatza beshaa haruya lehavi bah korban chayyav al kol achat veachat ella shema minah rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi
May rabbi umay rabbi yose berabbi yehuda detanya vekiddash et rosho bayyom hahu beom havaat korbenotav divre rabbi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer beom tiglachto
Tu ha ditnan chamishsha meviin korban ole veored minyana lema li
Mishshum dekatane sefa nasi kayyotze bahen chamishsha leappoke midderabbi eliezer deamar nasi mevi sair
Tu ha ditnan arbaa avot nezikin minyana lema li

Leappoke midderabbi oshaya deamar shelosha asar avot nezikin hen ulrabbi oshaya minyana lema li leappoke midderabbi chiyya deamar esrim vearbaa avot nezikin ulrabbi chiyya minyana lema li leappoke masor umfaggel
Amar mar sheim asaan kullan behelem achat chayyav al kol achat veachat
Bishlama patur ligmare la matzet amratte dichtiv ki kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot haelle venichretu ella ema avar chada nitchayyev chada avar kullehu behelem achat eno chayyav ella achat
Amar rabbi yochanan lechach yatza karet baachoto lechallek
Matkef lah rav bivi bar abbaye ema achoto difrat kera nichayyav chada alah vechullan kevan divhelem achat la nichayyav ella achat
Ulrav bivi bar abbaye mi let leh hada detanya kol davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza min hakkelal lelammed lo lelammed al atzmo yatza ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza
Ketzad vehannefesh asher tochal basar vego vahalo shelamim bichlal hakkodashim hau lamma yatzu
Lehakkish alehen ma shelamim shehen kodshe mizbeach vechayyavin alehen af kol shehen kodshe mizbeach chayyavin alehen yatzu kodshe bedek habbayit
Amar leh rav bivi bar minah lav mi amratte hatam yatzu kodshe bedek habbayit
Hacha name ma achoto meuchedet shehi erva veen lah heter bechayye osrah af kol sheen lah heter bechayye osrah yatza eshet ish sheyyesh lah heter bechayye vaalah

Amar rabbi yona veitema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar kera ki kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot vego hoil vechach hikkish hu hukshu kol haaraot kullan laachoto ma achoto chayyavin aleha bifne atzmah af kol chayyavin aleha bifne atzmah
Ulrabbi yitzchak deamar chayyave charetot bichlal hau velamma yatza karet baachoto ledunah becharet velo bemalkot
Lechallek mena leh nafka leh mivveel ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tikrav lechallek al kol ishsha veishsha
Verabbanan name tipok lehu mivveel ishsha beniddat tumatah in hachi name ella karet daachoto lemay ata mibe leh lechallek al achoto veal achot aviv veal achot immo
Hane lema lehu lechallek hare shemot muchlakin vahare gufim muchlakim ella ema lechallek al achoto shehi achot aviv veshehi achot immo
Verabbi yitzchak ha milta mena leh nafka leh min sefa dikra dichtiv ervat achoto gilla
Verabbanan achoto desefa dikra may avdi leh mibe leh

a: Laachoto shehi bat aviv uvat immo lomar sheen onshin min haddin
Verabbi yitzchak savar onshin min haddin veibaet ema yalef onesh meazhara

Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya kol makom sheatta motze shene lavin vecharet echad challek chattat benehen umay hi mefattem vesach dichtiv al besar adam lo yisach uvmatkunto vego karet echad dichtiv asher yirkach kamohu vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar venichrat meammav
Vechi meachar delavin muchlakim karet daachoto dichtav rachamana lema li
Lerabbi yitzchak kidit leh lerabbanan mibaya lehu lomar sheen onshin min haddin lerabbi yitzchak mappek leh lechayyev al achoto shehi achot aviv veshehi achot immo
Verabbanan denafka lehon min achoto deresha verabbi yitzchak savar achoto deresha orcheh dikra hi umappek lechallek meachoto desefeh dikra lechallek al achoto shehi achot aviv veshehi achot immo
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak af anan name tenena hamfattem et hashshemen hamfattem et hakketoret vehassach beshemen hammishcha

Lema li detanya hamfattem et hakketoret bemitza lav ha ka mashma lan ma ketoret lav bifne atzmo vechayyavim aleha karet bifne atzmo af mefattem shemen vesach name kevan delav bifne atzmo chayyavim alav bifne atzmah

Vechi tema deka bae lemitna pitumin bahade hadade nitnihu efoch hamfattem et hakketoret vehamfattem et hashshemen vehassach shemen hammishcha ammay pallegeh leshemen lav ha kamashma lan deyesh chiluk chattaot benehen shema minah
Habba al hazzachur tanna bemay ka chashev
I begavre dal haishsha hannirbaat uvatzra lah chada i binshe kachashev dal minhon habba al hazzachur veal habbehema uvatzri lehu tarte
Amar rabbi yochanan leolam tanna gavre kachashev vetane hachi habba al hazzachur vehevi zachur alav verabbi yishmael hi deamar chayyav shettayim
Veha middekatane megaddef besefeh umokminan lah kerabbi akiva resha name rabbi akiva

Vechi tema rabbi akiva hi uvresha savar lah kerabbi yishmael vehaamar rabbi avahu habba al hazzachur vehevi zachur alav lerabbi yishmael demappek leh mittarte kerae mivveet zachar lo tishkav umivvelo yihye kadesh mibbene yisrael chayyav shettayim
Lerabbi akiva eno chayyav ella achat demechad kera nafek leh et zachar lo tishkav keri beh lo tishshachev
Ella resha rabbi yishmael uvimgaddef savar lah kerabbi akiva i hachi nitne name habba al habbehema vehevi behema alav
Ha amar abbaye habba al habbehema vehevi behema alav af lerabbi yishmael eno chayyav ella achat dechi ketiv kera begavre ketiv
Rabbi elazar mishshemeh derav amar tanna teni sheloshim veshalosh chattaot utni shalosh karetot lesayyominhu becharetot
Dekatane sefa pesach umila bemitzvat ase pesach umila ammay katane lehu
Veitema leetoye korban alehon mi mayete vehatanya hukkesha kal hattora kullah laavoda zara dichtiv tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama
Ma avoda zara shev veal taase af kol shev veal taase
Ella lav shema minah tena sheloshim veshalosh chattaot man deavdi beshogeg vahadar tena shalosh karetot lesayyominhu lecharetot shema minah
Hamchallel et hashshabbat amri shabbat arbaim chaser achat haveyan amar rabbi yochanan tanna shiggat shabbat uzdon melachot dela michayyav ella chada
Detanya henna shehi achat shiggat shabbat uzdon melachot
Venitne zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot demichayyav arbaim chaser achat
Detanya veasa meachat mehenna peamim shechayyav achat al kullan ufamim shechayyav al kol achat veachat detanya achat shehi henna zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot
Tena shiggat shabbat uzdon melachot adifa leh demechattat miha la miptar
Vechen atta motze gabbe avoda zara dekatane shiggat avoda zara uzdon avodot
Shiggat avoda zara hechi dame ilema deamad bevet avoda zara vesavar bet hakkeneset hi vehishtachava hare libbo lashshamayim
Veella dachaza inderata usged leh i dekabbeleh aleh beeloha bar sekila hu vei dela kabbeleh beeloha lav mide hu
Ella meahava umiyyira
Hanicha leabbayye deamar chayyav ella lerava deamar patur may ika lememar
b: Ella beomer muttar dead kan la kavae mineh rava merav nachman ella i chada michayyav i tarte michayyav avel miptar ligmare la bea mineh
Rav pappa amar mashkachatte lah betinok shennishba leven haggoyim deyada daasira avoda zara vehane avoda zara la yada daasiran

Vei baet ema afilu tema begadol kegon deka tae behaden kera lo taasun itti elohe chesef velohe zahav vego savar ki asira hishtachavaa laavoda zara dechesef vezahav aval demine acharine sharya dehayenu shiggat avoda zara uzdon avodot
Rav acha bereh derav ika mishshemeh derav bivi amar tanna shem shabbat veshem avoda zara katane mimmay middekatane habba al ishsha uvittah veal eshet ish veha yesh bitto meanusato dela katane lah
Amri dichtivan katane dela ketivan la katane
Vehaika bat ishto uvat bittah uvat benah dichtiva vela katane ella shem ishsha uvittah katane hachi name shem shabbat veshem avoda zara katane
Rav acha bereh derav ika rame dileh addileh mi amar rav bivi bar abbaye hachi shem shabbat katane veshem avoda zara katane vehaitmar hammaale evre penim bachutz chayyav evre chutz bachutz chayyav
Vekashya leh lerav bivi bar abbaye i hachi ha ditnan sheloshim vashesh karetot betora telatin ushva ninhu deika hammaale vehammaale may kashya leh nishne shem haalaa katane
Mi dame shabbat vaavoda zara tena yathon abbinchehon gabbay karetot deirya meshanne shem shabbat katane shem avoda zara katane gabbe haalaa mi tena yathon binchehon deshanni hachi
Bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera shette karetot velav echad mahu amar leh shochet veheela kaamratte hane shene lavin ninhu
I leman degamar miggezera shava neemar kan havaa veneemar lehallan havaa
Ma lehallan lo anash ella im ken hizhir af kan lo anash ella im ken hizhir
Leman demayete lah behekesh amar kera sham taale vesham taase makkish shechita lehaalaa ma haalaa lo anash ella im ken hizhir af shechita lo anash ella im ken hizhir
Dilma shette mitot velav echad kaamratte ma hi ov veyiddeoni
Amar leh deha pelugta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish detanu gabbe sanhedrin baal ov veyiddeoni vekashya lan umay shena gabbe sekilot tane yiddeoni vegabbe karetot la tane yiddeoni
Amar rabbi yochanan hoil ushnehem belav echad neemru venema yiddeoni vela nema baal ov kasavar hoil ufatach hakkatuv bevaal ov
Veresh lakish amar hoil veen bo maase veresh lakish may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan
Amar rav pappa deha chalukin hen bemitot verabbi yochanan amar lecha chalukka delav have chalukka chalukka demita la haveya chalukka
Verabbi yochanan may tama la amar keresh lakish kasavar man tanna karetot rabbi akiva hi deamar la bainan maase
Veresh lakish nehi derabbi akiva la bae maase rabba maase zuta bae
Baal ov may maase it beh hakashat zerootav have maase megaddef may maase it beh akimat sefatav have maase

Ka salka datin hakashat zerootav have maase zuta afilu lerabbanan metivi baavoda zara eno chayyav ella al davar sheyyesh bo maase kegon shezzibach vekiter venisech vehishtachava vekashya lan hishtachavaa let bah maase

Veamar resh lakish ha manni rabbi akiva hi deamar la bainan maase verabbi yochanan amar afilu tema rabbanan kefifat komato have maase mikkelal disvira leh leresh lakish alliba derabbanan kefifat komato lerabbanan la have maase hakashat zerootav have maase
Veella ki kaamar resh lakish hakashat zerootav have maase zuta alliba derabbi akiva aval lerabbanan la have maase
I hachi ammay tane yatza megaddef sheen bo maase nitne yatza megaddef uvaal ov chada mittarte katane
Velitne baal ov vela litne megaddef megaddef itzterich leh salka datach amena hoil uchtiv karet dileh bimkom korban ema mode leh lerabbi akiva ka mashma lan dela
Ulla amar baal ov dekatane bimkatter lashshed matkef lah rava im ken hayenu oved avoda zara ella amar rava mekatter lashshed al menat lechabbero
Amar leh abbaye im ken hayinu chover chaver amar leh hattora amra chover chaver kegon ze biskila veella chover chever divlav heden hu
Amar leh kidtanya vechover chaver echad chover gadol veechad chover katan vaafilu chover linchashim veakrabbim chayyav amar abbaye hay man devae lemitzmad zibura veakrabba asur vei kaatu batreh shere
Lerabbi yochanan deamar kefifat komato have maase akimat

a: Sefatav neheve maase gabbe megaddef amar rava shane megaddef hoil veyeshno ballev aval bealma akimat sefatav have maase
Metiv rabbi zera yatzu edim zommin sheen bo maase veammay ha al pi ketiv bahen amar rava shane edim zommin hoil veyeshnan biriyya
Haochel chelev tanu rabbanan kol chelev shor vechesev vaez lo tochelu lechayyev al kol achat veachat divre rabbi yishmael vachachamim omrim eno chayyav ella achat
Nema beha kamipalgi derabbi yishmael savar lokin al lav shebbichlalot verabbanan savri en lokin al lav shebbichlalot
Leolam savar rabbi yishmael en lokin al lav shebbichlalot veshane hacha dimyatri leh kerae nichtov kera kol chelev lo tochelu shor vechesev vaez lema li shema minah lechallek
Verabbanan i la ketiv shor vechesev vaez hava amena afilu chelev chayya bammashma lehachi ketav shor kesev vaez lememra dechelev shor vechesev vaez hu deasur aval dechayya shere
Shappir kaamri leh ella hayenu tama derabbi yishmael dekasavar im ken lichtov kol chelev shor lo tochlu kesev vaez lema li shema minah lechallek
Verabbanan savri i ketav rachamana kol chelev shor hava amena nelaf shor shor missinay
Ma gabbe sinay chayya vaof kayyotze bahen af gabbe achila chayya vaof kayyotze bahen lehachi ketav rachamana shor vechesev vaez lememra dehane deasur aval chayya vaof shere
Shappir ka amri leh ella hayenu tama dekasavar nichtov kol chelev kesev lo tochelu i name kol chelev ez lo tochelu shor vechesev vaez lema li shema minah lechallek
Verabbanan savri i ketav kal chelev kesev hava amena chelev kesev asur veshor vaez shere vechi tema may ulmeh dechesev mishshum denitrabba bealya
Vechidtana rabbi chananya lamma mana hakkatuv emurin beshor veemurim bechesev veemurim beez dichtiv ach bechor shor vego
Tzerichi dei ketav shor hava amena kesev vaez la yalfinan mineh deika lemifrach ma leshor shekken nitrabba binsachim
Nichtov rachamana bechesev venelaf shor vaez mikkesev ika lemifrach ma lechesev shekken nitrabba bealya
Nichtov rachamana ez venelaf shor vechesev mineh ika lemifrach ma leez shekken nitrabba etzel avoda zara
Min chad la yalfinan nichtov tarte venelaf chada mittarte he den nelaf shor mikkesev vaez it lehon pircha ma lechesev vaez shekken nitrabbu etzel happesach
La nichtov kesev venelaf mishshor vaez it lehon pircha ma leshor vaez shekken nitrabba etzel avoda zara
La nichtov ez venelaf mishshor vechesev it lehon pircha ma leshor vechesev shekken yesh bo tzad ribuy hilkach la yalfi mehadade
Shappir ka amri leh ella leolam tama derabbi yishmael kidamrinan meikara deim ken nichtov kol chelev velishtok may amratte hay dichtav shor vechesev vaez lemishre chelev chayya
Ha ki ketav kera beinyana dekadashim vedavar lamed meinyano

Mikkelal derabbanan savri la yalfinan davar lamed meinyano la dechulle alma yalfinan davar hallamed meinyano vehacha beha peligi rabbi yishmael savar lemedin lav millav ben millav uven millav decharet

Dechol chelev shor vechesev vaez millav dechukkat olam ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu dichtiv beinyana dekadashim uvkadashim la it behon chayya af kol chelev shor ki ketiv leh setama leka lesappoke bechayya hilkach shor vechesev vaez lechallek hu daata lechayyev al kol achat veachat
Veyalfinan lav dechol chelev velav dechukkat olam mikkaret dechi kol ochel chelev min habbehema asher yakrivu mimmenna ma hahu lechallek af haddin lechallek
Verabbanan lav millav yalfinan lav mikkaret la yalfinan

Veibaet ema hayenu tamayehu derabbanan kedaamar leh rav mari lerav zevid ella meatta alya dechullin titsar amar leh alecha amar kera kol chelev shor vechesev vaez davar hashshave bishloshtan bainan veleka
Hilkach ki ata shor vechesev vaez lemishre alya dechullin hu daata verabbi yishmael amar lach im ken lema kera kol chelev shor vechesev ez lema li shema minah lechallek
Amar rabbi chanina mode rabbi yishmael leinyan korban sheen mevi ella chattat achat may tama dela dame haden lav lelav daaraot
Tanu rabbanan veasa achat veasa henna lechayyev al kol achat veachat
Sheim achal chelev vechelev shem echad bishne helemot chayyav shettayim shette shemot behelem achat chayyav shettayim

Amar leh rame bar chama lerav chisda bishlama shem echad bishne helemot chayyav shettayim mishshum dehelemot mechallekin ella shene shemot behelem achat ammay chayyav shettayim ha bainan helemot mechallekin veleka
Amar leh hacha bemay askinan kegon daachal chelev denotar demichayyav mishshum notar umishshum chelev amar leh im ken nichayyav name mishshum kodesh
Ella amar rav sheshet kegon daachal chelev dehekdesh verabbi yehuda hi detanya achal chelev nevela achal chelev mukdashin chayyav shettayim rabbi yehuda omer chelev mukdashin loke shalosh
Mechayechu alah bemareva venokmah kegon chelev deshor vechesev vaez verabbi yishmael hi deamar loke shelosh
b: Alma la okmah kerabbi yishmael deamar rabbi chanina mode haya rabbi yishmael leinyan korban sheeno chayyav ella chattat achat hashta name kerabbi yehuda la mittokma deha amar rabbi eliezer mode haya rabbi yehuda leinyan korban sheen mevi ella chattat achat
Ella amar resh lakish mishshum bar touteni hacha bemay askinan kegon sheachalan bishne tamchuyin vealliba derabbi yehoshua deamar tamchuyin mechallekim
Gufa achal chelev nevela loke shettayim chelev mukdashin loke shettayim rabbi yehuda omer chelev mukdashin loke shalosh
Amar leh rav shezvi lerava bishlama lerabbi yehuda hayenu dichtivi kerae chukkat olam kol chelev shor vechesev vaez lo tochelu vechol zar lo yochal kodesh ha telata lavin ella lerabbanan may tamayehu
Kasavri lav dechukkat olam bekadashim velav dechelev shor bechullin utzrichi
Dei ketav rachamana bekadashim hava amena kadashim hu dachamiri deasur chelbo aval chullin ema la mishshum hachi ketav rachamana kol chelev shor
Vei ketav kol chelev shor hava amena chelev dechullin hu deasur mishshum delo huttar mikkelalo aval chelev mukdashin dehuttar mikkelalo hava amena middehuttar besaran ishteri name chelban tzerichi
Verabbi yehuda savar ki ketiv chelev shor bainyana dekadashim ketiv
Ella mikkelal derabbanan savri la yalfinan davar hallamed meinyano
La dechulle alma davar hallamed meinyano uvha kamipalgi rabbi yehuda savar lemedin lav millav velav mikkaret verabbanan savri lav millav yalfinan lav mikkaret la yalfinan

Ella lerabbi yehuda kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu lemay ata mibe leh lehakkish detanya kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu ma chelev loke shettayim af dam loke shettayim divre rabbi yehuda vachachamim omrim en bo ella azhara echat

Umay shena chelev deloke shettayim bela hekesha dichtav beh tere kerae kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu kol chelev shor vechesev dam name belav hekesha nilke shettayim dichtiv beh tere lavin kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu vechol dam lo tochlu bechol moshvotechem laof velabbehema
Ella ema ma chelev loke shalosh af dam loke shalosh
Umay shena chelev deloke shalosh dichtiv beh halen tere lavin velav dezarut ha telata dam name
Itzterich salka datach amena hoil veitmeit dam mittuma litmeit mizzarut ka mashma lan hekesha
Veella lerabbanan hekkesha lemay ata
Mibe leh lechidtanya kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu ma chelev meuchad shechelbo chaluk mibbesaro veen mitztarfin ze im ze af dam sheddamo chaluk mibbesaro
Otzi dam sheratzim hoil deen daman chaluk mibbesaran mitztarfin
Veha mehacha nafka mehatam nafka veze lachem hattame limed al dam hashsheretz vehashsheretz shemmitztarfin ze im ze
I lav hekesha salka datach amena hane mile letuma aval laachila ema la ashmeinan hekesha laachila

Amar ravina hilkach dam nachash uvsaro mitztarfin may ka mashma lan hayenu hekesha salka datach amena sheretz deitrabbi letuma itrabbi laachila nachash dela itrabbi letuma la itrabbi laachila ka mashma lan hekesha kol mile deen damo chaluk mibbesaro mashma
Amar rava shalosh karetot haamurot baddam lemay achat ledam chullin veachat ledam kadashim veachat ledam hattamtzit
Hanicha lerabbi yehuda detanya dam hattamtzit beazhara rabbi yehuda omer becharet
Ella lerabbanan hahi lemay ata vaafilu lerabbi yehuda karet nafka leh min kol dam
Detanya rabbi yehuda omer dam ma talmud lomar kol dam
En li ella dam kadashim shehannefesh yotze bo dam chullin vedam hattamtzit minnayin talmud lomar kol dam
Ella ema echad ledam chullin veechad ledam kadashim veechad ledam kisuy
Veamar rava chamishsha lavin haamurin bedam lamma achat ledam chullin veachat ledam kadashim veachat ledam kisuy veachat ledam evarin veachat ledam hattamtzit
Amar rabbi ila achal maaser dagan vetirosh veyitzhar loke shalosh veha en lokin al lav shebbichlalot shane hacha dimyatri kerae

Mikkedi ketav rachamana veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha bifnim in bachutz la lema li dichtav rachamana lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha lechallek
I mehahu hava amena hane mile baase aval belav ema la ammetu lehachi

a: Ketav rachamana lo tuchal leokomah belav
Vaadayin lav shebbichlalot hu im ken nema kera lo tuchal leochlam bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha lema li leyachode achila dechol chad vechad
Amar rabbi yitzchak haochel lechem kali vecharmel loke shalosh veha en lokin al lav shebbichlalot shane hacha dimyatar kerae
Lema kera lechem venelaf kali vecharmel mineh ika lemifrach ma lelechem shekken nitrabba etzel challa

Nichtov kali vela lichtov lechem venelaf mikkali lechem mikkali la ate mishshum dekale iteh beeneh lechem la iteh beeneh karmel mikkali la ate mishshum dekali nitrabba etzel menachot karmel lo nitrabba etzel menachot
Nichtov karmel venelaf lechem vekali mineh ika lemifrach ma lecharmel shekken lo nishtanna mibberiyyato min chad la yalfi nelaf chada min teren

La nichtov kera lechem venelaf mikkali vecharmel ika lemifrach ma lekali vecharmel deitanhon beenehon la nichtov kera karmel venelaf millechem vekali ika lemifrach ma lelechem vekali shekken nitrabbu etzel menachot

Amar lach rabbi yitzchak la nichtov kera kali venelaf millechem vecharmel may parchatte i parchatte ma lelechem shekken nitrabba etzel challa karmel yochiach vei mishshum decharmel lo nishtanna mibberiyyato lechem yochiach hilkach loke dimyatar

Veema kali dimyatar michayyav chada akkullehon michayyav chada im ken nichtov kera lechem karmel vekali i name nichtov kali velechem vecharmel ammay ketav lekali baemtza hachi kaamar lechem bekali nichayyav vecharmel nichayyav bekali
Amar rabbi yannay leolam al tehi gezera shava kalla beenecha shehare pigul echad miggufe tora velo limdo hakkatuv ella miggezera shava
Deamar rabbi yochanan tane zavda bar levi neemar lehallan veochlav aono yissa veneemar kan vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu aonah tissa ma lehallan karet af kan karet
Amar rabbi simay leolam al tehi gezera shava kalla beenecha shehare notar echad miggufe tora velo limdo hakkatuv ella miggezera shava
May hi yalef kodesh kodesh veochlav aono yissa ki et kodesh Adonai chillel uchtiv vesarafta et hannotar baesh ki kodesh vego
Amar abbaye leolam al tehi gezera shava kalla beenecha shehare bitto meanusato hen hen gufe tora velo limdah hakkatuv ella miggezera shava
Deamar rava amar li rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi atya henna henna leisura
Atya zimma zimma lisrefa
Amar rav ashe al tehi gezera shava kalla beenecha shehare niskalim hen hen gufe tora velo limdah hakkatuv ella miggezera shava
Detanya neemar kan demehem bam veneemar beov veyiddeoni demehem bam ma lehallan biskila af kan biskila

Hammefattem et hashshemen ku tanu rabbanan hammefattem et hashshemen lilmod bo lemosro latztzibur patur lasuch chayyav vehassach mimmennu patur lefi sheen chayyavin ella al sichat shemen hammishcha sheasa moshe bilvad

Amar mar lilmod bo al menat lemosro latztzibur patur menalan atya matkunto min bematkuntah diktoret uchtiv legabbe ketoret lo taasu lachem lachem hu deasur aval lemosro latztzibur patur gabbe shemen name lemosro latztzibur patur

Vetihdar ketoret venelaf mishshemen ma shemen ki mefattem lachatzayin patur af ketoret name ki mefattem lachatzayin patur allema amar rava ketoret sheppittemah lachatzayin chayyav shemen sheppittemo lachatzayin patur

Amar lach rava gabbe shemen ketiv uvmatkunto lo taasu kamohu kamohu hu deasur aval chetzo shappir dame gabbe ketoret dichtiv vehakketoret asher taase kol asiyya diktoret efshar demakter peras shacharit ufras ben haarbayim
Tanu rabbanan shemen hammishcha mor deror chamesh meot kidda chamesh meot kinneman besem chamesh meot ukne vosem chamishshim umatayim nimtzeu kullam elef veshiva meot vachamishshim

Tanna minyana ka mashma lan tanna ha ka kashya leh ema kene vosem kekinnemon besem ma kinnemon besem machatzito bachamishshim umatayim af kene vosem machatzito chamishshim umatayim dehau lehu teren alafim
Veema hachi name im ken nichtov kera kinnemon besem ukne vosem mechetza umechetza chamishshim umatayim

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye keshehu shokel behechrea hu shokel o ayin beayin hu shokel amar leh rachamana ketav bad bevad veatte amratte behechrea vehaamar rav yehuda hakkadosh baruch hu yodea hachraot alma deit behu hechrea

Ella amar rav yehuda dekinnemon besem ammay mayete machatzito dachamesh meot chamishshim umatayim bechad zimna vachamishshim umatayim bechad zimna kevan dechullehon chamesh meot havayin nayete chamesh meot bevat achat shema minah middekamayete lah lekinnemon besem bitre zimne hechrea it beh vehakkadosh baruch hu yodea behechreot
Umay bad bevad amar ravina shello yanniach mishkal bemishkal veyishkol

Tanu rabbanan shemen hammishcha sheasa moshe vemidbar meshalleko haikarin divre rabbi yehuda amar lo rabbi yose vahalo lasuch haikarin eno sipek ketzad ose heviu haikarin ushlakum bemayim vehetzif alehen shemen hammishcha vekalat et hareach vekipcho
Amar lo rabbi yehuda
b: Vechi nes echad naasa bashshemen hammishcha vahalo nissim harbe naasu bo mittechillato vead sofo techillato lo haya ella shenem asar log uvo nimshach hammishkan vechelav veaharon uvanav kol shivat yeme hammilluim uvo nimshechu kohanim gedolim umlachim vechullo kayyam leatid lavo
Shenneemar shemen mishchat kodesh yihye ze li ledorotechem ze begimatriyya shenem asar luggin haveyan

Tanu rabbanan vayyikkach moshe et shemen hammishcha vayyimshach et hammishkan vego rabbi yehuda omer shemen hammishcha sheasa moshe bammidbar harbe nissim naasu bo mittechillato vead sofo techillato lo haya ella shenem asar luggin kamma yora bolaat kamma ikarin bolin kamma haur soref uvo nimshach mishkan vechelav aharon uvanav kal shivat yeme hammeluim

Uvo nimshechu kohanim gedolim umlachim vaafilu kohen gadol ben kohen gadol taun meshicha veen moshchin melech ben melech veem tomar mippene ma mashchu et shelomo mippene machloket adoniyya veet yehoash mippene atalya veet yehoachaz mippene yehoyakim achiv shehaya gadol meechav shette shanim

Amar mar vaafilu kohen gadol ben kohen gadol taun meshicha menalan dichtiv vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav nema kera vehakkohen shettachtav mibbanav may hammashiach ha ka mashma lan daafilu mibbanav hahu dimshach have kohen gadol vei la meshach la have kohen gadol
Amar mar en moshchin melech ben melech menalan amar rav acha bar yaakov dichtiv lemaan yaarich yamim al mamlachto hu uvanav kol hayyamim yerushsha hi

Umippene ma mashchu et shelomo mippene machloket adoniyya menalan dechi ate machloket bae meshicha vela kol devae malka moret leh malchuta amar rav pappa amar kera bekerev yisrael bizman sheshshalom beyisrael

Tana af yehu ben nimshi lo nimshach ella mippene machloket yoram ben achav ammay tipok leh demelech rishon hu chassore michassera vehachi katane malche bet david moshchin malche yisrael en moshchin veim tomar mippene ma mashchu yehu ben nimshi mippene machloket yoram ben achav
Amar mar malche bet david moshchin veen malche yisrael moshchin menalan dichtiv kum meshachehu ki ze hu ze taun meshicha veen acher taun meshicha
Amar mar mippene machloket yoram umishshum machloket yoram ben achav nimal beshemen hammishcha kidamar rav pappa baafarsema dachya hacha name baafarsema dachya

Veet yehoachaz mippene yehoyakim shehaya gadol mimmennu shette shanim umi kashshish vehachtiv uvne yoshiyya habbechor yochanan vehashsheni yehoyakim vehashshelishi tzidkiyyahu veharvii shallum veamar rabbi yochanan hu yehoachaz hu tzidkiyyahu hu shallum

Ella leolam yehoyakim kashshish veammay kare leh bechor shehu bechor lammalchut umi mokminan zuta kamme kashshisha vehachtiv veet hammamlacha natan lihoram ki hu habbechor hahu memalle mekom avotav hava

Amar mar hu shallum hu tzidkiyya veha bedare kachashev umay kare leh shelishi shehu shelishi labbanim umay kare leh revii shehu revii lammalchut mishshum dimlach yechanya kammeh bitchilla melach yehoachaz vesof melach yehoyakim vesof melach yechanya vesof melach tzidkiyya

Tanu rabbanan hu shallum hu tzidkiyya velamma nikra shemo shallum shehaya shalem bemaasav davar acher shallum sheshshalem malchut bet david beyamav uma shemo mattanya shemo shenneemar vayyamlech et mattanya dodo tachtav vayyassev shemo tzidkiyya
Deamar lo yah yatzdik alecha et haddin im timrod bi shenneemar vayeviehu vavela uchtiv vegam bammelech nevuchad netzar melech bavel marad asher hishbio belohim
Umi hava shemen hammishcha vehatanya mishshennignaz aron nignaz tzintzenet hamman utzlochit shemen hammishcha umaklo shel aharon shekedim ufrachim

Veargaz sheshshiggeru pelishtim doron lelohe yisrael shenneemar veet kele hazzahav asher hashevotem lo asham tasimu vaargaz mitztziddo umi genazo yoshiyya melech yehuda genazo shenneemar vayyomer hammelech el hakkohanim tenu et aron hakkodesh
Veamar rabbi elazar atya sham sham
Atya dorot dorot
Atya mishmeret mishmeret amar rav pappa baafarsema dachya

Tanu rabbanan moshchin et hammelachim kemin nezer veet hakkohanim kemin ki amar rav menashsheya kemin ki yevani tane chada battechilla matztzik shemen al rosho veachar kach noten lo shemen ben rise enav vetane achariti battechilla noten lo shemen ben rise enav veachar kach matztzik lo shemen al rosho

Tannae hi ika leman deamar meshicha adifa veika leman deamar yetzika adifa may tama deman deamar yetzika adifa shenneemar vayyitzok mishshemen hammishcha al rosh aharon uman deamar meshicha adifa kasavar shekken nitrabba etzel kele sharet
Vehachtiv vayyitzok ulvassof vayyimshach hachi kaamar ma taam vayyitzok mishshum vayyimshach oto lekaddesho

Tanu rabbanan kashshemen hattov hayyored al harosh vego kemin shette tipin margaliyyot hau teluot leaharon bizkano amar rav kahana tana keshehu mesapper olot veoshvot beikare zekano veal davar ze haya moshe rabbenu doeg shemma chas veshalom maalti beshemen hammishcha
Yatzta bat kol veamra ketal chermon sheyyored al harre tziyyon ma tal en bo meila af shemen sheyyored al zekan aharon en bo meila
Vaadayin aharon haya doeg shemma moshe lo maal vaani maalti yatzta bat kol veamra lo hinne ma tov uma naim shevet achim gam yachad ma moshe lo maal af atta lo maalta
Tanu rabbanan en moshchin et hammelachim ella al hammayan kede shettimashech malchutan shenneemar vayyomer hammelech el benayahu vego vehoradtem oto al gichon vego umashach oto sham
Amar rav amme hay man devae lida i mashcha shatta i la mayete sheraga behalen asra yomin deven resh shatta leoma dechipure venitle beveta dela nashev zika i meshich nehoreh nida demassek shatteh
Uman devae naaved iske uvae denida i matzlach iskeh i la nirabbe tarnegola i shamen veshafar nida dematzlach
Hay man devae nipok beorcha uvae denida i hadar leveteh niol nekum beveta devahata im chaze

a: Bavua levavua devavua nida deate leveteh velav milta hi dilma chalsha dateh umittera mazzaleh
Amar abbaye hashta deamratte simana milta hi yehe regil inish lemechal resh shatta kara verubbeya karrate silka vetamre

Amar lehu rav mesharsheya livneh ki baetu lemezel lemigmar kamme rabbechon gerusu meikara matnitin vahadar ulu kamme rabbechon vechi yatvitu kamme rabbechon chazo lefummeh derabbechon shenneemar vehau enecha root et morecha vechi garsitu shemata gerusu al mayya dechi hechi demashchi mayya timshoch shematechon
Akkilke demata machseya vela appadne defumbedita tav gildana sarya lemechal mikkuttacha derame kefe
Vattitpallel channa vattomar alatz libbi ba rama karni rama karni velo rama pakki david ushlomo shennimshechu bekeren nimshecha malchutam shaul veyehu shennimshechu min happach lo nimshecha malchutam
Hamfattem et hakketoret tanu rabbanan hamfattem et hakketoret lelammed bah o lemosrah latztzibur patur lehariach bah chayyav vehammeriach bah patur ella shemmaal
Umi ika meila vehaamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara kol umare vareach en bahen mishshum meila
Reach achar shettaale timrato en bo mishshum meila en lecha davar acher shennaasa mitzvato umoalin bo
Allema la vahare terumat haddeshen denaaset mitzvatah umoalin bah
Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen uvigde chehunna shene chetuvim habbaim keechad vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedim
Hanicha lerabbanan ella lerabbi dosa may ika lememar detanya vehinnicham sham melammed shetteunin geniza
Rabbi dosa omer kesherin hen lechohen hedot uma talmud lomar vehinnicham sham shello yishtammesh bahen beom hakkippurim acher

Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene chetuvin habbain keechad vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin terumat haddeshen may hi detanya vesamo etzel hammizbeach melammed shetteunin geniza egla arufa may hi detanya vearfu sham et haegla bannachal melammed shetteunin geniza

Ulman deamar shene chetuvin habbaim keechad melammedin hacha vadday en melammedin mishshum dehave tere miute bitrumat haddeshen ketiv vesamo haden in mide acharina la gabbe egla arufa ketiv haarufa arufa in mide acharina la

Tanu rabbanan pitum hakketoret hatztzori vehatztziporen vehachelbena vehallevona mishkal shivim shel shivim mana mor uktzia shibolet nerde vecharkom mishkal shishsha asar shel shishsha asar mane hakkoshte shenem asar kilufa shelosha vekinnamon tisha borit karshina tisha kabbin yen kafrisin sein telata kabbin telata im en lo yen kafrisin mevi chamar chivaryan attik melach sedomit rova maale ashan kol shehu rabbi natan omer af kipat hayyarden kol shehu

Veim natan bah devash pesalah chisar achat mikkol sammaneha chayyav mita rabbi shimon omer hatztzori eno ella seraf meatze hakketaf borit karshina sheshshafin bah et hatztziporen kede shettehe naa yen kafrisin sheshshorin bo et hatztziporen kede shettehe azza vahalo me raglayim yafin lah ella sheen machnisin me raglayim lammikdash
Mesayya leh lerabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar kodesh hi kodesh tihye lachem kol maaseha lo yehu ella bakkodesh
Metivi hammakdish nechasav vehau bah devarim haruyin lekorbenot hatztzibur yinnatnu laummanin bischaran
Hane devarim haruyin may ninhu i behema vechayya tena leh i yenot shemanim uslatot tena leh ella lav ketoret

Amar rabbi oshaya beotah hannitenet leummanim bischaran detanya motar hakketoret ma hau osin bah hau mafrishin mimmenna sechar haummanin umchallelin otah al meot haummanin venotnin otan laummanin bischaran vechozrim velokchin otah mitteruma chadasha
Matkef lah rav yosef ha bechullehu motarot tane chozrin velokchin otah mitteruma chadasha vehacha la tane
Ella amar rav yosef beechad missammane hakketoret

Tanu rabbanan ketoret hayeta naaset shelosh meot shishshim ushmona mane shelosh meot shishshim vachamishsha keneged yemot hachamma shelosha manin yeterin shemmehen machnis kohen gadol melo chofnav beom hakkipurim vehashshear nitenet laummanin bischaran
Kidtanya motar hakketoret ma hau osin bah mafrishin mimmenna sechar haummanin umchallelin otah al meot haummanin venotnin otan laummanin bischaran vechozrin velokchin otah mitterumat hallishka
b: Tanu rabbanan motar hakketoret achat leshishshim o leshivim shana hau mefattemin otah lachatzain lefichach yachid sheppitem lachatzain chayyav divre rabban shimon ben gamliel sheamar mishshum hassegan
Aval shelish urvia lo shamati vachachamim omrim bechol yom metakken bematkuntah vehaya machnis
Mesayya leh lerava deamar rava shemen hammishcha sheppittemo lachatzain chayyav dichtiv vehakketoret asher taase kol shettaase veha efshar deavdah peras beshacharit ufras ben haarbayim

Tanu rabbanan hau machazirin otah lemachteshet paamayim beshana bimot hachamma pezura shello titappesh bimot haggeshamim tzevura kede shello tafug rechah uchshehu shochek omer hadek hetev hetev hadek divre abba yose ben yochanan

Veshalosh manin yeterin shemmehen kohen gadol machnis melo chofnav beom hakkippurim noten otah lemachteshet beerev yom hakkippurim veshochakan yafe yafe kede shettehe dakka min haddakka kidtanya dakka ma talmud lomar vahalo kevar neemar veshachakta mimmennu hadek ma talmud lomar dakka kede shettehe dakka min haddakka
Amar mar keshehu shochek omer hetev hadek hadek hetev mesayya leh lerabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan keshem shehaddibur ra layyayin ken haddibur yafe labbesamim

Amar rabbi yochanan achad asar sammanin neemru lo lemoshe besinay amar rav huna may keraa kach lecha sammim tere nataf ushchelet vechelbena ha chamsha vesammim acharine chamsha ha asra ulvona zakka chad ha chad sere

Veema sammim kalal nataf ushchelet vechelbena parat sammim chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash davar shekkiter veole verecho nodef af kol davar shekkiter veole verecho nodef

Vechi tema im ken lichtov kera chad perata laye mitzrach tzerichi dei ketav nataf hava amena min ilan in aval gidule karka la mishshum hachi ketav ushchelet vei ketav ushchelet hava amena gidule karka in aval min ilan ema la mishshum hachi ketav nataf
Vechelbena legufeh ata mippene sherechah ra im ken mikkach lecha nafka leh
Veema sammim batrae teren ninhu kesammim kadmae im ken nichtov sammim sammim bahade hadade vesof nichtov nataf ushchelet vechelbena

Deve rabbi yishmael tane sammim kalal nataf shechelet vechelbena parat sammim chazar vechalal kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella keen happerat ma happerat meforash davar shekkiter veole verecho nodef af kol davar shekkiter veole verecho nodef
O eno ella kelal bichlal rishon ufrat bifrat rishon amratte lav ha en lecha alecha ladun belashon acharon ella belashon rishon

Amar mar o eno ella kelal bichlal rishon ufrat bifrat rishon amratte lav ha en alecha ladun may kushya hachi ka kashya leh sammim batrae tere ki sammim kadmae teren hadar veshanni kidshannin deim ken nichtov kera sammim sammim nataf ushchelet vechelbena

Umay perat bifrat rishon hachi ka kashya leh mine ilanot yalfi min nataf vegidule karka yalfi mishshechelet velelfi name millevona zakka deayete bechad tzad denete davar sherecho nodef veaf al pi sheen koter veole
Hadar amar im ken nichtov kera lilvona zakka bemitze vetelaf minah
I katvah levona zakka bemitze havayin tere asar im ken nichtov kera levona zakka bemitze vechelbena levassof resh lakish amar miggufah ma leshon ketoret davar shekkoter veole

Amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida kol taanit sheen bah mipposhe yisrael enah taanit shehare chelbena rechah ra umnaah hakkatuv im sammane ketoret abbaye amar mehacha vaaguddato al eretz yesadah

Vehassach beshemen hammishcha tanu rabbanan hassach beshemen hammishcha livhema vechelim patur legoyim ulmetim patur bishlama behema vechelim dichtiv al besar adam lo yisach uvhema vechelim lav adam hu metim name patur dechevan demit leh met mikre velav adam ella goyim ammay patur ha adam ninhu
Laye dichtiv veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem attem keruyin adam veen haggoyim keruyin adam
Vehachtiv venefesh adam shishsha asar alef amar leh hahu leappoke behema
Vehachtiv vaani lo achus al ninve vego hahu leappoke behema
Veibaet ema kidkatane tanna kammeh derabbi elazar kol sheyyeshno besach yeshno beval yisach vechol sheeno besach eno beval yisach

Tanya idach hassach beshemen hammishcha livhema vechelim legoyim umetim patur limlachim ulchohanim rabbi meir mechayyev verabbi yehuda poter vechamma yasuch vihe chayyav rabbi meir omer kol shehu rabbi yehuda omer kezayit vehaamar rabbi yehuda patur ki patar rabbi yehuda gabbe melachim vechohanim gabbe hedot mechayyev
Rabbi meir verabbi yehuda bemay peligi amar rav yosef beha peligi rabbi meir savar al besar adam lo yisach ketiv uchtiv vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar ma sicha kol shehu af netina kol shehu
Verabbi yehuda savar yalfinan netina deal zar minnetina dealma ma netina dealma kezayit af netina deal zar kezayit aval sicha lemimshach melachim vechohanim divre hakkol kol shehu

Veamar rav yosef bemay peligi rabbi meir verabbi yehuda gabbe melachim vechohanim rabbi meir savar vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar ketiv umelech vechohen hashta zarim ninhu verabbi yehuda savar baenan ad deika zar mittechillato vead sofo umelech vechohen meikara lav zarim hau
Amar rav ika bereh derav amme veazdu letamayehu detanya

a: Bat kohen shenniset leyisrael veachla bitruma meshallemet et hakkeren veenah meshallemet et hachomesh umitatah bisrefa
Niset leechad min happesulin meshallemet keren vachomesh umitatah bechenek divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim achat zo veachat zo meshallemet et hakkeren veenah meshallemet et hachomesh umitatah bisrefa
Amar rav yosef machloket bintinat shemen hammishcha uvshinuye deshanninan aval netina dealma divre hakkol kezayit
Gufa tane tanna kammeh derabbi elazar kol sheyyeshno besach yeshno beval yisach vechol sheeno besach eno beval yisach amar leh shappir kaamratte lo yisach ketiv ukri beh lo yassich

Tane rav chananya kammeh derava minnayin lechohen gadol shennatal mishshemen hammishcha sheal rosho venatan al bene meav minnayin shehu chayyav shenneemar al besar adam lo yisach amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe may shena meha detanya kohen shessach beshemen shel teruma ben bitto yisrael mitaggel bo veeno choshesh

Amar leh hatam umetu vo ki yechalleluhu ketiv kevan dechalleleh ha itachal aval gabbe shemen hammishcha ketiv ki nezer shemen mishchat elohav alav shemen mishcha karyeh rachamana deaf al gav deiteh alav la itachal
Al ellu chayyavin al zedono ku katane chutz mimmetamme mikdash vekadashav mimmay mappek leh hachi katane chutz mimmittamme mikdash vekadashav sheen mevi asham taluy

Venitne name chutz mimmi sheavar alav yom hakkipurim sheen mevi asham taluy amar resh lakish ki katane hecha deiteh lachataeh verachamana patreh avar alav yom hakkipurim leteh lachataeh deka chappar leh
Rabbi yochanan amar bimvaet dekaamar en yom hakkippurim mechapper dei hadar beh batar yom hakkipurim bae leetoye asham taluy veresh lakish savar mevaet name mechappar aleh yom hakkipurim

Uviflugta haomer lo yitkapper li chattati abbaye amar enah mechapperet rava amar mechapperet hecha deamar lo tikrav dechulle alma la peligi dela mechappera dichtiv yakriv oto lirtzono ki peligi deamar tikrav velo techapper abbaye amar en mechapperet deha amar lo techapper rava amar mechapperet kevan deamar tikrav kappara mimmela ate

Vahadar beh rava kidtanya yachol yehe yom hakkipurim mechapper al shavin veal sheen shavin vedin hu uma chattat veasham mechapperin veom hakkippurim mechapper ma chattat veasham en mechapperin ella al hashshavin af yom hakkippurim en mechapper ella al hashshavin

Lo im amarta bechattat veasham sheen mechapperin al hammezid kashshogeg tomar beom hakkippurim shemmechapper al hammezid kashshogeg vehoil umchapper al hammezid kashshogeg mechapper al shavin veal sheen shavin talmud lomar ach chalak
May shavin vesheen shavin illema shavin shogeg lo shavin mezid ha katane lo im amarta bechattat veasham ku
Ella ki ha deulla amar rabbi yochanan achal chelev vehifrish korban venishtammed vechazar bo hoil venidcha yiddache
Nehi deidchi korban gavra bar kappara hu ella shavin deamar yechapper alay chattati sheen shavin deamar lo techapper alay chattati shema minah

Urminhi yachol lo yehe yom hakkippurim mechapper ella al shennitanna bo velo asa bo melacha ukrao mikra kodesh lo nitanna bo veasa bo melacha velo kerao mikra kodesh yachol lo yehe yom kipurim mechapper talmud lomar yom hakkippurim hu mikkol makom vetarvayehu setam sifra hu kashyan ahadade
Amar abbaye la kashya ha rabbi alliba derabbi yehuda ha rabbi alliba dideh detanya rabbi omer kol averot shebbattora ben asa teshuva uven lo asa teshuva yom hakkippurim mechapper
Chutz mipporek ol umgalle panim battora umefer berit basar sheim asa teshuva yom hakkippurim mechapper veim lav en yom hakkippurim mechapper

Rava amar ha veha rabbi alliba denafsheh umode rabbi baaverot deom hakkippurim gufeh dela mechappar dei la tema hachi karet deom hakkippurim lerabbi kevan divchol shata veshata mechappar hechi mashkachatte lah
Umay kushya dilma daavad avidta kulle lelya uvahade ammud hashshachar mit dela hava yemama dilchappar leh tinach karet delelya karet dimama hechi mashkachatte lah

Umay kushya dilma bahade dekaachal nahama chanakteh umtza dela hava leh shehut bimama dilchappar leh i name daavad avidteh samuch lishkiat hachamma i name bahade deaved avidteh paskeh mara leshakeh umit dela hava leh shehut bimama dilchappar leh
Vachachamim omrim af hamgaddef ku may af hamgaddef sheen bo maase
Rabbanan shemau lerabbi akiva detane baal ov vela tane yiddeoni amaru leh may shena dela mayete korban mishshum delet beh maase megaddef name let beh maase

Tanu rabbanan megaddef mevi korban hoil veneemar bo karet divre rabbi akiva veomer venasa cheto uchlala hu kol hecha dichtiv beh karet mayete korban veha pesach umila dichtiv behu karet vela mayete korban
b: Hachi kaamar megaddef mevi korban hoil uva bo karet bimkom korban divre rabbi akiva kasavar migo devae michtav karet bealma uchtiv karet bimkom korban shema minah mayete korban
Veomer cheto yissa atan lerabbanan vehachi kaamar rabbi akiva lerabbanan amritu megaddef let beh maase mahu megaddef mevarech et hashshem ella karet dichtiv lemay ata
Amri leh liten karet limkallel dichtiv bimkallel cheto yissa haish hahu venasa cheto uchtiv befesach sheni cheto yissa ma lehallan karet af kan karet
Tanu rabbanan et hu megaddef isi ben yehuda omer keadam haomer lachavero gerafta hakkeara vechisartah kasavar megaddef mevarech et hashshem hu
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer keadam haomer lachavero gerafta hakkeara velo chisartah kasavar megaddef hayenu oved avoda zara
Tanya idach et Adonai rabbi elazar ben azarya omer beoved avoda zara hakkatuv medabber vachachamim omrim lo ba hakkatuv ella liten karet limvarech hashshem
Matni yesh meviot korban veneechal veyesh meviot korban veeno neechal veyesh sheenam meviot
Meviot korban veneechal hammappelet kemin behema chayya vaof divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim ad sheyehe bo mitztzurat adam
Hammappelet sandal o shilya o shappir merukkam vehayyotze mechuttach vechen shifcha shehippila mevia korban veneechal

Veellu meviot veenan neechalot hammappelet veen yodea ma hippila ushte nashim shehippilu achat mimmin petur veachat mimmin chova amar rabbi yose ematay bizman shehalchu ze lammizrach veze lammaarav aval im hau shettehen omdot shettehen meviot korban veneechal
Ellu sheen meviot hammappelet shappir male mayim male dam male geninim hammappelet kemin dagim vachagavim ushkatzim urmasim hammappelet yom arbaim veotze dofen rabbi shimon mechayyev beotze dofen
Gema shifcha menalan detanu rabbanan bene yisrael en li ella bene yisrael giyyoret veshifcha minnayin talmud lomar ishsha

May vechen shifcha salka datach amena ki amrinan kol mitzva shehaishsha chayyevet bah eved chayyav bah hane mile bedavar sheshshave ben ish uven ishsha aval yoledet divnashim itah baanashim letah ema la tichayyav shifcha ahachi tena shifcha
Ellu meviin korban ku may avdin maytyan tarvayehu chad korban vadday vechattat of safek umatne
Umi it leh lerabbi yose tenaa vehatnan rabbi shimon omer meviot shenehen chattat achat rabbi yose omer en shenehen meviot chattat achat alma lerabbi yose let leh tenaa
Amar rava mode rabbi yose bimchussar kappara vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan mode rabbi yose bimchussar kappara
May tama hatam bae gavra yedia dichtiv o hoda elav chattato hilkach la matyan umatneyan aval hacha ki matyan nashim korban leishteroye baachilat kadashim
Kidtane sefa dehahi rabbi yose omer kol chattat shehi baa al chet en shettayim meviot otah
Ellu sheen meviot ku rabbi shimon mechayyev beotze dofen may tama derabbi shimon amar resh lakish amar kera veim nekeva teled lerabbot leda acheret may hi yotze dofen
Verabbanan may tama amar rabbi manni bar pattish ishsha ki tazria veyalda ad shetteled mimmakom shemmazraat
Matni hammappelet leor shemonim veechad bet shammay potrin min hakkorban uvet hillel mechayevin
Amru bet hillel levet shammay may shena or shemonim veechad miyyom shemonim veechad im shava lo letuma lo yishve lo lekorban

Amru lahem bet shammay lo im amartem bemappelet yom shemonim veechad shekken yatza leshaa shehi reuya lehavi bah korban tomar bemappelet leor shemonim veechad shello yatza leshaa shehi reuya lehavi bah korban
Amru lahen bet hillel vahalo hammappelet yom shemonim veechad shechal lihot beshabbat tochiach shello yatza leshaa shehi reuya lehavi bah korban vechayyevet korban

Amru lahen bet shammay lo im amartem yom shemonim veechad shechal lihot bashshabbat sheaf al pi sheeno rauy lekorban yachid rauy lekorban tzibur tomar bemappelet leor shemonim yom veechad sheen hallayela rauy lo lekorban yachid velo lekorban tzibur
Vehaddamim enan mochichim shehammappelet betoch melot dameha temeim uftura min hakkorban

a: Gema tanya amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay hare hu omer levat lerabbot or shemonim veechad
Rabbi hoshaya hava shechiach kammeh devar kappara shavkeh vaata kammeh derabbi chiyya yoma chad pega beh bea mineh zav sheraa shalosh reiyyot belel shemini ma bet hillel omrim bedavar ze
Tamayehu devet hillel bemappelet ballayela mishshum dichtiv levat aval zav sheraa shalosh reiyyot belel shemini patri dela meyatri kerae o dilma la shena
Amar leh bar kappara ma bavli omer bedavar ze ishtik rabbi hoshaya la amar kelum amar leh bar kappara tzerichin ledivre iyya nachzor al harishonot hare hu omer levat lerabbot or shemonim veechad

Nema ketannae zav sheraa shalosh reiyyot belel shemini tane chada mevi vetanya idach eno mevi may lav tannae hi deha detanya mevi kasavar layela en mechussar zeman vehadtane en mevi kasavar layela mechussar zeman
Amar rav huna bar acha amar rabbi elazar hane tannae savri layela mechussar zeman veha detanya mevi bezav baal shette reiyyot vehadtanya en mevi bezav baal shalosh reiyyot
Zav baal shette reiyyot may lememra ha ka mashma lan daveka raa belel shemini aval bimama dishvii la kasavar kol reiyya shessoteret en mevia lide korban

Amar rava ammay okemta leha detanya en mevi bezav baal shalosh reiyyot litneyah gabbe chamishsha meviin korban echad al averot harbe la pesika deamar rabbi yochanan raa achat ballayela ushtayim bayyom mevi shettayim ballayela veachat bayyom en mevi
Amar rav yosef teda deachat ballayela ushtayim bayyom mevi deha reiyya rishona shichvat zera bealma veilu chaze tarten achranyata mitztarfi lehu

Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi mide irya reiyya rishona shel zav chazyah bizman chiyyuva achat ballayela kevan delav bizman chiyyuva chazyah i lav deashmeinan rabbi yochanan demitztarfa hava amena la titzteref
Umi amar rabbi yochanan layela mechussar zeman
Vehaamar chizkiyya nitma bayyom mevi ballayela en mevi verabbi yochanan amar afilu ballayela mevi
Ki kaamar rabbi yochanan shettayim ballayela veachat bayyom en mevi ledivre haomer mechussar zeman
Ledivre haomer peshita raa achat ballayela ushtayim bayyom itztericha leh mahu detema kevan delav bizman chiyyuva kachaze leh la titzteref ka mashma lan

Matni haishsha sheyyesh aleha sefek chamesh ledot usfek chamesh zivot mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim veen hashshear aleha chova chamesh zivot vaddaot vechamesh ledot vaddaot mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim vehashshear aleha chova

Maase sheamdu kinin birushalayim bedinar zahav amar rabban shimon ben gamliel hammaon hazze lo alin hallayela ad sheyyihye bedinarin bassof kesef nichnas levet din velimmed haishsha sheyyesh aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot chamesh zivot vaddaot mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim veen hashshear aleha chova veamdu kinin bayyom hahu berivatayim

Gema tanu rabbanan chamesh ledot vadday chamesh zivot safek o chamesh ledot vadday vechamesh ledot safek mevia shette kinin achat al havadday veachat al hassafek shel vadday neechelet vehashshear aleha chova shel safek en neechelet veen hashshear aleha chova

Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer al vadday tomar al haacharona vetippater shel safek im yesh vadday benehen tomar al havadday vetippater veim lav tomar al echad mehen vetippater rabbi akiva omer ben al havadday ben al hassafek tomar al achat mehen vetippater

Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav pappa ema lach mishshemeh derava hane tannae bemay peligi derabbi yochanan ben nuri medamme lehon lechattat deman dechayyav chamesh chattaot ad demayete kullehon vesof mikkappar leh hacha name la shena
Verabbi akiva medamme lehon litvilot deman dimchayyav chamesh tevilot kevan detavel chada zimna ithar hacha name la shena
Amar leh rav pappa i salka datach rabbi yochanan ben nuri lechattat medamme lehon ammay shel safek tomar al achat mehen vetippater ilu man dimchayyav
b: Chamesh ashamot teluyin ki mayete chad mi miptar vehatanya ze hakkelal kol shechalukin bechattaot chalukin baashamot
Ella dechulle alma litvilot medamme lehon uvchoshshin lifshia kamipalgi rabbi yochanan ben nuri savar chayeshinan lifshia verabbi akiva savar la chayeshinan lifshia
Hadaran alach sheloshim vashesh
Matni arbaa mechussere kappara vearbaa meviin al hazzadon kashshogeg
Veellu hen mechussere kappara hazzav vehazzava vehayyoledet vehamtzora
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer ger mechussar kappara ad sheyyizzarek alav haddam nazir leyeno vetiglachto vetumato
Gema may shena zav vezava demane lehon bitren mishshum dachalukah tumato dezav la metamme beones vezava la metammea biriyyot veyamim
Detanya mibbesaro velo mechamat onso umi tame umitamme biriyyot kivyamim detanya tala hakkatuv et hazzachar biriyyot veet hannekeva beyamim vezava mittammea beones velo mittammea biriyyot kivyamim
Metzora umtzoraat name chaluka tumatan dimtzora taun peria ufrima dichtiv begadav yihu ferumim verosho yihye farua veasur betashmish hammitta
Umtzoraat enah teuna peria ufrima detanya en li ella ish ishsha minnayin keshehu omer vehatztzarua hare kan shenayim

Im ken ma talmud lomar ish nitteko hakkatuv meinyan shel mala leinyan shel matta lomar ish porea uforem veen haishsha poraat uforemet umutteret betashmish hammitta shenneemar veyashav michutz leoholo shivat yamim velo michutz leoholah
Hilkach namninhu bitren zav vezava ikar tumatan chaluka metzora umtzoraat en ikar tumatan chaluka hay vehay kigris hu
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer ger mechussar ku vetanna kamma may tama la tane ger ki katane middaam demishtere lemechal bekadashim ger ki ka mayete korban leachshore nafsheh lemeal bekahal
Venazir may tama la tane sof sof nazir name ki mayete korban leishteroye lemishte yayin dechullin hu
Verabbi eliezer dekatane nazir lemishre nafsheh nitne name nazir tame ki ka mayete korban lemechal aleh nezirut betahora hu
Tanu rabbanan ger meukkav leechol bekadashim ad sheyyavi kino hevi perida achat shacharit ochel bekadashim laerev kol hakkinin shebbattora echad chattat veechad ola kan shettehen olot
Hevi chovato min habbehema yatza ola ushlamim yatza mincha ushlamim lo yatza lo amru ken ella lehakel
May shena mincha ushlamim delo yatza dichtiv kaasher taasu ken yaase ma attem ola ushlamim af ger ola ushlamim
Im ken chovato achat min habbehema la tisge aleh begaveyh dehachtiv kaasher taasu ken yaase amar rav pappa yesh lomar leof itrabbi leolat behema lo kol shekken
I hachi afilu mincha name maet kera ken

Vaof hecha itrabbi detanu rabbanan kaasher taasu ken yaase ma attem ola ushlamim af hu ola ushlamim shenneemar kachem kagger minnayin lerabbot et haof talmud lomar ishshe reach nichoach la eze davar shekkullo la heve omer zo olat haof

a: Yachol sheani merabbe afilu mincha talmud lomar ken
Tanya idach veasa ishshe reach nichoach la shomea ani kol sheole laishshim afilu mincha talmud lomar kaasher taasu ken yaase ma attem mine damim af hem mine damim
I ma attem ola ushlamim af hem ola ushlamim talmud lomar kachem kagger yihye lachem hikkashtiv velo ledavar acher lekorbenotechem
Rabbi omer kachem kaavotechem ma avotechem lo nichnesu labberit ella bemila utvila vehartzaat dam af hem lo yikkansu labberit ella bemila utvila vehartzaat damim
Lehavi perida achat i efshar shello matzinu bechol hattora kullah lo amru ken ella lehakel alav

Vela vehatanya vehikrivo ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar betorim vehikriv shomea ani haomer hare alay olat haof lo yifchot mishshene feridin talmud lomar vehikrivo afilu perida achat chova miha la ashkechan
Vehaika yoledet dematya ben yona o tor lechattat mishshum deika keves bahadah
Amar mar ma avotechem lo nichnesu labberit ella ku bishlama mila dichtiv ki mulim hau kol haam hayyotzim i name mehacha veeevor alayich vaerech mitboseset bedamayich vaomar lach bedamayich chayi vego
Hartzaat damim dichtiv vayyishlach et naare bene yisrael ella tevila menalan dichtiv vayyikkach moshe chatzi haddam veyizrok al haam veen hazzaa belo tevila
Ella meatta haidana deleka korban la nekabbel gerim amar rav acha bar yaakov vechi yagur ittechem ger asher betochchem vego
