Tanu rabbanan ger bizman hazze tzarich sheyyafrish rova lekino amar rabbi shimon kevar nimna alav aleha rabban yochanan ben zakkay uvittelah mippene hattakkala amar rav idi bar gershom amar rav adda bar ahava halacha kerabbi shimon
Veika dematne lah al hada detanu rabbanan ger toshav muttar laasot melacha beshabbat leatzmo keyisrael bechullo shel moed

Rabbi akiva omer keyisrael beom tov rabbi yose omer ger toshav ose bashshabbat leatzmo keyisrael bachol rabbi shimon omer echad ger toshav veechad eved veama hattoshavim osin melacha bashshabbat leatzman keyisrael bachol
Matni ellu meviin al hazzadon kashshogeg habba al shifcha venazir shennitma ushvuat haedut ushvuat happikkadon
Chamishsha meviin korban echad al averot harbe vachamishsha meviin korban ole veored ellu meviin korban echad al averot harbe habba al shifcha biot harbe venazir shennitma tumot harbe
Gema habba al hashshifcha menalan
Detanu rabbanan vechipper alav hakkohen beel haasham al chattato asher chata melammed shemmevi korban echad al averot harbe beel haasham venislach lo mechattato asher chata laasot shogeg kemezid
Nazir shennitma menalan
Dichtiv vechi yamut met alav befeta pitom peta ze shogeg vechen hu omer im befeta belo eva hadafo pitom ze ones vechen hu omer vayyomer Adonai pitom el moshe
Tanya idach pitom ze mezid vechen hu omer arum raa raa venistar uftaim avru veneenashu
Nichtov kera pitom demashma shogeg umashma mezid umashma ones mezid veones kedaamaran umashma name shogeg dichtiv peti yaamin lechol davar vela nichtov kera peta
I ketav kera pitom demashma shogeg umashma mezid umashma ones hava amena ki mayete korban beshogeg mide dehave attora kullah aval ones umezid ema la
Ketav rachamana peta deshogeg hu legalloye aleh defitom deones umezid hu daafilu hachi chayyev rachamana
Shevuat haedut menalan detanu rabbanan bechullan neemar venelam kan lo neemar venelam lechayyev al hashshogeg kemezid
Shevuat happikkadon menalan yalef techta techta mishshevuat haedut
Chamishsha meviin korban echad al averot harbe katane habba al hashshifcha biot harbe menalan
Detanu rabbanan vechipper alav hakkohen beel haasham al chattato asher chata melammed shemmevi korban echad al averot harbe beel haasham venislach lo mechattato asher chata laasot mezid keshogeg
Veha kera ki ketiv bemezid ketiv ella ema laasot shogeg kemezid
Bea mineh rabbi chanina tirnaa merabbi yochanan habba al chamesh shefachot charufot behelem echad mahu chayyav al kal achat veachat o eno chayyav ella achat amar leh chayyav al kal achat veachat
May shena mechamishsha helemot beshifcha achat amar leh en shifcha achat en gufin muchlakin chamesh shefachot gufin muchlakin
Umnalan degabbe shifcha gufin muchlakin amar leh lav amratte gabbe araot veishsha lechallek al kol ishsha veishsha gabbe shifcha name ketiv asher yishkav et ishsha shichvat zera
b: Vehi shifcha lechallek al kol shifcha veshifcha
Nazir shennitma tumot harbe man tanna

Amar rav chisda rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi deamar nezirut detohora mishshevii hu dechayela aleh umashkachat lah kegon shennitma bashshevii vechazar venitma bashshevii vechevan delo yatza shaa haruya lehakriv bah korban eno chayyav ella korban echad
Dei rabbi kevan deamar rabbi nezirut detohora ad shemini la chayela aleh i denitma bashshevii vechazar venitma bashshevii kullah tuma arichta hi
I denitma bashshemini vechazar venitma bashshemini kevan deyatzat shaa sheruya lehakriv korban mechayyev al kol achat veachat ella shema mina rabbi yose berabbi yehuda
Umay derabbi yose berabbi yehuda detanya vekiddash et rosho bayyom hahu beom havaat korbenotav divre rabbi
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer beom tiglachto
Matni hamkanne leishto al yede anashim harbe umtzora shennitnagga negaim harbe
Hevi tziporin venitnaggea lo alu lo ad sheyyavi chattato rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyavi ashamo
Gema menalan dichtiv zot torat hakkenaot tora achat lekinnuyin harbe
Metzora shennitnaggea negaim harbe ku menalan dichtiv zot torat hammetzora tora achat limtzoraim harbe
Hevi tziporin venitnaggea lo alu lo ad sheyyavi chattato rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyavi ashamo

Vehaamratte en mevi ella korban echad chassore michassera vehachi katane hevi tziporin venitnaggea en mevi ella korban echad ulakboe baaniyyut uvaashirut la mikva ad sheyyavi chattat rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyavi ashamo

Tenan hatam metzora shehevi ashamo veheeshir hakkol holech achar chattat divre rabbi shimon rabbi yehuda omer hakkol holech achar asham tanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer hakkol holech achar tziporin

Amar rav yehuda amar rav shelashtan mikra echad darshu asher lo tassig yado betohorato rabbi shimon savar davar hamchappero rabbi yehuda savar davar hammachshiro rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer davar haggorem lo tohora umay ninhu tziporin
Matni haishsha sheyyalda veladot harbe vehippila betoch shemonim nekeva chazra vehippila betoch shemonim nekeva
Vehammappelet teomim
Rabbi yehuda omer mevia al harishon veenah mevia al hashsheni mevia al hashshelishi veenah mevia al harvii
Gema menalan detane tanna kammeh derav sheshet zot torat hayyoledet lazzachar velannekeva melammed shemmevia korban echad al veladot harbe yachol af al halleda veal hazziva talmud lomar zot
Katane yachol al halleda veal hazziva enah mevia ella korban echad ella meatta achla dam veyalda hachi name deen mevia ella korban echad
Ema hachi yachol al halleda shellifne melot veal halleda shelleachar melot talmud lomar zot
Hippila betoch shemonim ku keshettimmetze lomar ledivre rabbi yehuda valad rishon gorem umivalad rishon mona ledivre chachamim valad sheni gorem umivalad sheni mona
Keshettimtze lomar peshita hachi ita mappelet teomim itzterich leh salka datach amena bemappelet teomim mode rabbi yehuda lerabbanan ka mashma lan
Ibaya lehu

a: Betuma ma li amar rabbi yehuda mi amrinan ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda valad sheni keman deleteh dame ella leinyan korban kevan delo yatza shaa sheruya lehakriv bah korban hoil vechen valad sheni keman deleteh dame aval leinyan tuma vetohora ema sevira leh keman deiteh dame umafseka tuma desheni ummalle yome tohora derishon vahadar mone mane leh yome
O dilma lerabbi yehuda chumra hu deit leh aval hacha kulla hu vekulla let leh
Amar rav huna missura ta shema yoledet shochatin vezorkin aleha beom arbaim lazzachar uvom shemonim lannekeva
Ad kan temea hi veamar rav chisda ha manni rabbi yehuda hi deamar valad sheni keman deleteh dame

Vei amratte betuma sevira leh lerabbi yehuda valad sheni keman deiteh dame hechi shachatinan alah beom arbaim leurta name la matzya achla ella lav shema mina letohora ultuma sevira leh lerabbi yehuda valad sheni keman deleteh dame
Leolam ema lach letuma ultohora sevira leh lerabbi yehuda devalad sheni keman deiteh dame vechi tanya hahi befesach habba betuma
Umi achla vehatnan pesach habba betuma lo yochlu mimmennu zavim vezavot niddot veoldot
Hahi la achlan ki la tevilan ki tanya hahi deshochatin vezorkin aleha deha tavla i hachi mishshemini dilah hu dechazya
Mishshemini la chazya kasavar tevul yom dezav kezav dame
I hachi beom arbaim name la chazya laye beom arbaim chazya kasavar mechussar kippurim dezav lav kezav dame

Ulrava deamar mechussar kippurim dezav kezav dame ha matniyta hechi metaretz lah amar rav ashe rava metaretz lah beom arbaim litzirat zachar uvom shemonim litzirat nekeva verabbi yishmael hi deamar lezachar arbaim veechad linkeva shemonim veechad
Sof sof tipok li ditmea hi mishshum nidda beleda yabbishta i hachi may lememra mahu detema i efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam ka mashma lan deefshar liftichat hakkever belo dam
Amar rabbi shemaya ta shema shishshim yachol ben retzufin ben mefuzzarin talmud lomar yom ma yom ratzuf af shishshim kullan retzufin manni illema rabbanan mi it lehu lerabbanan mefuzzarin
Ella lav rabbi yehuda hi umiddeka yahev lah shishshim retzufim bahade hadade shema mina chumra it leh lerabbi yehuda kulla let leh
La leolam rabbanan hi vehacha vemay askinan leoledet zachar mittoch shemonim shel nekeva

Sof sof shalmin yome dekadmaa vead kan devatraa la shalmin deha rabbanan levalad sheni manu ella mashkachatte lah lerabbanan beoledet teomim nekeva kadmayeta vezachar batraa uchgon diledteh lezachar batraa beesrim leome tohora devaaya minkat leh shiva yome tuma deleda

Vehachi kaamar yachol hecha deyalda teomim nekeva meikara vezachar levassof tafsek tuma deleda bemitze venimne lah shishsha veshishshim mefuzzarin talmud lomar yom ma yom kullo ratzuf af shishshim kullam retzufin
Amar abbaye ta shema sheloshim yachol ben retzufin ben mefuzzarin talmud lomar yom ma yom kullo ratzuf af sheloshim retzufin manni ha illema rabbanan umi it lehu lerabbanan
b: Mefuzzarin ha amri rabbanan levalad sheni manya ella lav rabbi yehuda hi ushma minah chumra it leh kulla let leh

Veod amar rav ashe ta shema vesheshet yamim yachol ben retzufin uven mefuzzarin talmud lomar shishshim ma shishshim kullan retzufin af shishsha kullan retzufin manni illema rabbanan mi it lehu lerabbanan mefuzzarin haamri rabbanan levalad sheni manya
Ella lav rabbi yehuda hi ushma minah chumra it leh kulla let leh shema mina
Matni ellu meviin korban ole veored al shemiat kol veal bittuy sefatayim veal tumat mikdash vekadashav vehayyoledet vehamtzora
Gema tanu rabbanan yesh mevi bedallut vaashirut veyesh mevi bedallut veyesh mevi bedalle dallut
Yoledet mevia bedallut vaashirut metzora mevi bedallut shemiat hakkol uvittuy sefatayim vetumat mikdash vekadashav meviin bedallut vedalle dallut
Tanya idach yesh mevi echad tachat echad yesh mevi shenayim tachat shenayim yesh mevi shenayim tachat echad yesh mevi echad tachat shenayim mikkan atta lamed laasirit haefa bifruta

Yoledet mevia achat tachat achat perida achat vaof tachat keves metzora shette feridin tachat shene chevasim shemiat hakkol uvittuy sefatayim vetumat mikdash vekadashav meviin shette feridin tachat kivsa achat umviin bedalle dallut asirit haefa tachat shette feridin
Katane mikkan atta lamed laasirit haefa shehi bifruta menalan detanu rabbanan haomer hare alay besela lammizbeach mevi keves sheen davar karev besela ella keves
Mimmay middeamar rachamana el asham bechesef shekalim mikkelal decheves ben shana besela middichtiv keves ben shenato utnan amdu kinin bo bayyom berivatayim
Umiddechas rachamana aleh dedallut lemihve chad mishshet asar baashirut chas rachamana aleh dedalle dallut lemihve chad mishshet asar bedallut
Im ken dallut kema haveya riva uchma perite beriva arbaim utmanya perite chad mishshet asar kema have dedallut telata perite
Dekatane mikkan atta lamed laasirit haefa bifruta ammay peruta haamratte asirit haefa dalle dallut hu veamratte chad mishshet sere dedallut hu dechashvinan ditlata perite havayin

Tanna miyyoledet yalef dematya perida achat tachat keves dehave chad mittelatin utren decheves vead kan dalle dallut kema have chad mishshet asar bedallut demehecha yalef mikkeves veayil ad kan peruta ufalga have

Amar rava kullah milta miyyoledet yalef vehachi kaamar middechas rachamana aleh dedallut lemihve chad mittelatin utren baashirut umay hi yoledet hachi chas rachamana aleh dedalle dallut lemihve chad min telatin utren bedallut
I hachi neche riva difruta have hachi name ella delav orach ara leetoye pachot mipperuta lammakom
Matni ma ben shifcha leven kol haaraot shello shaveta lahen lo baonesh velo bakkorban shekkol haaraot bechattat veshifcha beasham kol haaraot binkeva veshifcha bezachar
Kol haaraot echad haish veechad haishsha shavin bammakkot uvakkorban uvashshifcha lo hishva lo haish laishsha bammakkot velo hishva ishsha laish bakkorban
Kol haaraot asa bahen et hamare kegomer vechayyav al kol bia uvia
Zo chomer hechmir beshifcha

a: Sheasa bah et hammezid kashshogeg

Ezo shifcha kol shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shenneemar vehofde lo nifdata divre rabbi yehuda rabbi yishmael omer zo hi shifcha vaddait rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer kol araot meforashot veshiyyur en lanu ella chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin
Gema menalan dehi lakya vehu la lake detanu rabbanan bikkoret tihye melammed shehi loka yachol shenehen lokin talmud lomar tihye hi loke vehu eno loke

Uminnayin dehaden bikkoret lishana demalkut hu amar rabbi yitzchak tehe bekarae kidtanya gedol haddayyanin makri sheni mone shelishi omer hakkehu rav ashe omar bevikur tihye keditnan en omdin oto ella makkot haruot lehishtallesh

Tanu rabbanan bizman shehaishsha loka haish mevi korban en haishsha loka en haish mevi korban menalan amar rava dichtiv veish ki yishkav et ishsha shichvat zera vehi shifcha necherefet leish vehofde lo nifdata o chufsha lo nittan lah

Mikkedi ad hacha beish ka mishtae kera nichtov vehevi et ashamo la ulvassof lichtov bikkoret tihye ammay ketav rachamana beresha bikkoret tihye ulvassof ketav vehevi et ashamo la hachi kaamar im bikkoret tihye hi vehevi et ashamo la veim lo tihye bikkoret lo yavi hu et ashamo
Ema hu maateh kera aval hi tilke vetayete korban vehevi et ashamo la ketiv

Amar rabbi yitzchak leolam eno chayyav ella al shifcha beula bilvad shenneemar vehi shifcha necherefet leish umay mashma dehay necherefet lishana deshannoye hu dichtiv vattishtach alav harifot vei baet ema im tichtosh haevil bammachtesh betoch harifot baeli
Vayyittenu yadam lehotzi neshehem vaashemim el tzon al ashmatam amar rav chisda melammed shekkullan shefachot charufot baalu
Ezohi shifcha ku tanu rabbanan vehofde yachol kullah talmud lomar lo nifdata yachol lo nifdata talmud lomar vehofde

Ha chetzad peduya veenah peduya chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin umoreset leeved ivri divre rabbi akiva rabbi yishmael omer beshifcha kenaanit hakkatuv medabber umoreset leeved ivri im ken ma talmud lomar vehofde lo nifdata dibbera tora chilshon bene adam

Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer kol araot meforashot lanu meshuyyar lanu chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin umoreset leeved ivri acherim omrim lo yumtu ki lo chuppasha beshifcha kenaanit hakkatuv medabber umoreset leeved kenaani
Lerabbi yishmael bishlama vehofde lo nifdata kidkatane dibbera tora chilshon bene adam ella dekatane meoreset leeved ivri menalan dichtiv ki lo chuppasha mikkelal dehu chuppash

Rabbi elazar ben azarya hayenu rabbi akiva lerabbi yishmael kaamar ledidi bealma keotach sevira leh dedibbera tora chilshon bene adam vehacha shane mikkede ketiv leh kera ki lo chuppasha vehofde lo nifdata lema li shema mina lehachi ata lechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin
Laacherim bishlama vehofde lo nifdata kasavar dibbera tora chilshon bene adam ella ha deeved kenaani menalan amar kera ki lo chuppasha im eno inyan ledidah tenehu inyan ledideh
Matni kol araot echad gadol veechad katan katan patur echad er veechad yashen yashen patur echad shogeg veechad mezid shogeg bechattat umezid behikkaret
Gema vehacha chayyav katan amar rav yehuda hachi katane kol araot echad gadol veechad katan katan patur vegadol chayyav vehacha gadol name patur may tama deha mikkashyan ahadade

Kol araot echad neor veechad yashen patur vechan yashen name chayyav amar rav yehuda amar rav hachi katane kol araot echad neor veechad yashen yashen patur veneor chayyav vechan afilu neor patur may tama demikkashyan ahadade
Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet asu gomer kimare mitkaven kesheen mitkaven kedarkah keshello kedarkah neor keyashen
Amar leh may kaamratte i beshifcha charufa katane ammay asu gomer kimare gomer beshifcha charufa michayyav meare la michayyav vetu mitkaven kesheeno mitkaven i mikkavvena michayeva i la la michayeva
Uchdarkah keshello kedarkah name kedarkah beshifcha charufa michayyav veshello kedarkah la michayyav may tama shichvat zera ketiv umay neor keyashen
Vei bishar araot ka tane asu gomer kimare
b: Ipcha ibi leh lemitne
Amar leh ismeyah amar leh la hachi katane asu gomer shello kedarkah beshifcha charufa dela michayevi kimare kedarkah deshichvat zera ketiv
Mitkaven shello kedarkah beshifcha difturin keeno mitkaven deshichvat zera ketiv neor shello kedarkah beshifcha difturin keyashen may tama deshichvat zera ketiv
Nimtza mitkaven vehamare beshifcha kesheen mitkaven bechol araot yashen kedarkah keyashen daaraot nimtza neor shello kedarkah beshifcha keyashen dechol araot
Hadaran alach arbaa mechussere kappara
Matni amru lo achalta chelev mevi chattat ed omer achal veed omer lo achal ishsha omeret achal veishsha omeret lo achal mevi asham taluy ed omer achal vehu omer lo achalti patur
Shenayim omrim achal vehu omer lo achalti rabbi meir mechayyev amar rabbi meir im heviuhu shenayim lide mita chamura lo yeviuhu lide korban hakkal amru lo ma im yirtze lomar mezid hayiti patur
Achal chelev vechelev behelem achat echad eno chayyav ella achat achal chelev vadam ufigul venotar behelem achat echad chayyav al kol achat veachat ze chomer beminin harbe mimmin echad
Vechomer bemin echad mimminin harbe sheim achal kachatzi zayit vechazar veachal kachatzi zayit acher behelem echad mimmin echad chayyav mishshene minin patur
Gema katane amru lo achalta chelev mevi chattat amru kema haveyan teren vehu ma amar lehon illema deshatek vela kamachchesh lehu ella shetika ditren hu demevi chattat al shetika dechad la
Ema metziata ed omer achal vehu omer lo achalti tama demachchish leh aval shatek michayyav vechol shekken tere
Ella dekamachchesh lehu manni rabbi meir hi deamar hachchasha deve tere lav hachchasha hi aval lerabbanan patur
Umay kamashma lan missefa shamatte minah ha kamashma lan davar ze machloket rabbi meir verabbanan vehu dekamachchesh lehu
Ika deamri amru lo name chad kare leh ditnan haishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam uvau veamru lah met baalich veniset veachar kach ba balah tetze mizze umizze dekayema lan daafilu bechad
Mimmay middekatane sefa niset shello birshut mutteret lachzor lo may shello birshut shello birshut bet din veed echad
Mikkelal deresha birshut bet din uved echad alma gabbe ed echad katane amru vehacha name dekatane amru lo mashma afilu ed echad
Vehu may kaamar illema deka machchesh leh mi mayete veha katane metziata ed echad omer achal vehu omer lo achalti patur
Ella deshatek mimmetziata shema minah ed echad omer ku tama deka machchesh leh aval shatek mishtak chayyav
Leolam dela machchesh leh vehachi katane amru lo achalta chelev mevi chattat bamme devarim amurim deshatek aval machchesh leh patur
Umiddeorayeta menalan dela machchesh leh chayyav detanu rabbanan o hoda elav chattato velo sheyyodiuhu acherim yachol afilu en machchishan talmud lomar o hoda elav mikkol makom
Bemay askinan illema bitren teren veen machchishan kera bae

a: Ella lav bechad vekatane ki en machchishan meheman shema mina
Amar rabbi meir kal vachomer
Ibbaya lehu may tamayehu derabbanan mishshum deadam neeman al atzmo yoter mimmea ish o dilma mishshum deamrinan migo dei bae amar mezid hayiti patur ki amar name lo achalti meheman ufatur
Umay nafka mina lemifshat minah letuma dei amratte tamayehu derabbanan mishshum deadam neeman al atzmo yoter mimmea ish la shena tuma chadasha vela shena tuma yeshana

Vei amratte tamehon derabbanan mishshum deamar migo hi patri leh rabbanan mittuma yeshana aval mittuma chadasha michayyav may tama tuma yeshana migo dei bae amar tavalti patur ki amar name lo nitmeti patur deika lememar may lo nitmeti dekaamar lo amadti betumati ella tavalti
Aval tuma chadasha michayyav may tama dechiy amar name tavalti michayyav deamru leh edim hashta nitmeta

May ta shema amar lo ed echad nitmeta vehu omer lo nitmeti patur yachol afilu shenayim amar rabbi meir kal vachomer im heviuhu shenayim lemita chamura lo yeviuhu lide korban hakkal vachachamim omrim adam neeman al atzmo yoter mimmea ish shema minah tamayehu derabbanan mishshum deamri adam neeman al atzmo yoter mimmea ish
Amar rabbi amme leolam tama derabbanan mishshum deamrinan migo vehachi katane mittoch sheim ratza lomar lo amadti betumati patur hilkach adam neeman al atzmo yoter mimmea ish i hachi hayenu chelev
Mahu detema achalti chelev kamtaretz dibureh la achalti shogeg ella mezid aval nitmeta vehu omer lo nitmeti ema la kamtaretz dibbureh ka mashma lan hacha name lo amadti betumati aval tavalti
Ta shema vehitvadda mode baddevarim chayyav en mode baddevarim patur amar lo ed echad nitmeta vehu omer lo nitmeti patur
Yachol afilu shenayim machchishin amar rabbi meir im heviuhu shenayim lide mita chamura lo yeviuhu lide korban hakkal rabbi yehuda omer neeman adam al atzmo yoter mimmea ish
Umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bachalavin uvviat mikdash aval betuma la modu leh
Bemay askinan ilema
b: Betuma yeshana may shena chalavin uviat mikdash demodu leh deim ratza yomar mezid hayiti tuma yeshana name metaretz dibureh deim ratza yomar lo amadti betumati ella tavalti
Amar ravina leolam betuma yeshana uchgon deamri leh edim achalta kadashim betumat hagguf vehu amar lehon lo nitmeti dehacha la metaretz dibureh deleka lememar lo amadti betuma aval tavalti
May amar lehon tavalti veachalti ki amar lehon hachi itachchash leh dibbureh kamma miha betumat maggao
Amar rav nachman halacha kerabbi yehuda amar rav yosef lo amarah rabbi yehuda ella beno leven atzmo ulatzmo
Amar resh lakish mode rabbi meir lachachamim sheim amru lo shenayim baalta shifcha charufa vehu omer lo baalti meheman dei bae amar lehon lo gamarti biati
Amar rav sheshet mode rabbi meir lachachamim benazir tame sheamru lo shenayim nitmeta vehu omer lo nitmeti patur dei bae amar nishalti al nizri
Amar abbaye mode rabbi meir lachachamim sheim amru lo shenayim yodea atta beedut peloni vehu omer lo yadati patur dei bae amar lo nitkavanti leedut
Achal chelev vachelev behelem achat echad matkef lah rabbi zera ammay eno chayyav ella chattat achat veha shene zete chelev achal
Amar leh abbaye helemot mechullakot vehacha helem echad hu deika
Ika demakshe leh hachi tama dehelem echad ha bishte helemot chayyav shettayim ammay shem chelev echad hu amar leh abbaye helemot mechullakin
Achal chelev vadam pigul venotar chayyav ku
Mimmin echad chayyav peshita amar resh lakish mishshum bar tuteni kegon sheachalo bishne tamchuyin vealliba derabbi yehoshua deamar tamchuyin mechullakin
Mahu detema ki amar rabbi yehoshua la shena lekulla vela shena lechumra ka mashma lan dechayyav alma lechumra amar lekulla la amar
Ika deamar al sefa mishshene minin patur peshita amar resh lakish mishshum bar tuteni kegon sheachalo bishne tamchuyin vealliba derabbi yehoshua deamar tamchuyin mechullakin
Demahu detema ki amar rabbi yehoshua lechumra amar lekulla la amar ka mashma lan mishshene minin patur
May mishshene minin mimmin echad hu veammay kare leh shene minim mishshum daachalo bishne tamchuyin vekatane patur alma la shena lekulla vela shena lechumra kaamar rabbi yehoshua
Middesefa min echad ushne tamchuyin resha min echad vetamchuy echad peshita
Amar ravina kegon shehayeta lo yedia bentayim vealliba derabban gamliel deamar en yedia lachatzi shiur
Ditnan hakkotev shette otiyyot bishte helemot achat shacharit veachat arvit rabban gamliel michayyav vachachamim potrin
Rabban gamliel savar en yedia lachatzi shiur verabbanan savri yesh yedia lachatzi shiur
Matni kamma yishhe baochalin keilu ochel kelaot divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim ad sheyyishhe mittechilla vead sof kede achilat peras chayyav
Achal ochalin temein veshata mashkin temein shata reviit yayin venichnas lammikdash veshaha kede achilat peras chayyav rabbi elazar omer im pasek bah o im natan bo mayim kol shehu patur

Gema ibaya lehu rabbi meir lechumra kaamar o lekulla kaamar lechumra kaamar vehachi katane keilu ochel kelaot daafilu kulleh yoma veaf al gav demittechilla vead sof yoter mikkede achilat peras kevan dimshicha achilteh michayyav vaamaru leh rabbanan dead sheyyishhe bichde achilat peras hu dechayyav yoter mikkede achilat peras patur

O dilma lekulla kaamar dehachi katane keilu ochel kelaot vehu dela afsek bene uvene aval deafsek bene uvene af al gav demittechilla vead sof bichde achilat peras patur veamru leh rabbanan kevan demittechilla vead sof bichde achilat peras hu chayyav
Ta shema vachachamim omrim ed sheyyishhe bichde achilat peras mittechilla vead sof

a: I amratte bishlama rabbi meir lechumra hayenu dekatane ad sheyyishhe ad dishhiyya dileh kede achilat peras
Ella i amratte rabbi meir lekulla vachachamim omrim im shaha mibe leh ella lav shema mina rabbi meir lechumra shema mina
Amar ravnay amar shemuel bachalavim uvinvela ad sheyyishhe mittechilla vead sof bichde achilat peras ochalim temeim shekatzim urmasim umashkin afilu kol hayyom kullo bichde achilat peras
May kaamar amar rav pappa hachi kaamar afilu kol hayyom kullo vehu sheachal kezayit bichde achilat peras
Metivi kol haochalin mitztarfin lifsol haggeviyya bechachatzi feras may lav deachleh lachatzi feras bichde achilat peras la daachal kezayit kezayit bichde achilat peras

Metivi kol haochalin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviyya bechachatzi feras bichde achilat peras ketzad achal vechazar veachal im yesh mittechillat achila rishona vead sof achila acharona kede achilat peras mitztarfin yoter mikkan en mitztarfin
Lo hittiru leechol pachot mikkeshiur lered velitbol yarad vetaval veala vehishlimo mitztaref hittiru lah laubbara leechol pachot mikkeshiur mippene hassakkana

Kol hammashkin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviyya birviit bichde achilat peras ketzad shata vechazar veshata im yesh mittechillat shetiyya rishona vead sof shetiyya acharona kede achilat peras mitztarfin yoter mikkan en mitztarfin
Hittiru lah lemagga teme met lehanik benah uvnah tahor
Katane mihat im yesh mittechillat achila rishona vead sof achila bichde achilat peras mitztaref teuvta deravnay teuvta
Amar mar lo hittiru lo leechol pachot mikkeshiur lered velitbol may kaamar

Amar rav yehuda hachi kaamar achal pachot mikkeshiur lo hittiru lo lered velitbol sheim yarad vetaval veala vehishlimo mitztaref veate lememar ahani li tevila kammayeta veen yodea sheen tevila ella baacharona

Katane hittiru lah laubbara leechol pachot mikkeshiur mippene hassakkana mippene hassakkana afilu tuva name techol amar rav pappa hachi katane hittiru lah laubbara pachot mikkeshiur afilu tuva mippene hassakkana
Katane hittiru lemagga teme met lehanik et benah uvnah tahor ammay tahor kevan diynak chalav itammi leh mechalav
Vechi tema la itachshar nittachshar betipa meluchlechet al pi haddad amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh bitkifa achat lo hinniach tipa meluchlechet al pi haddad
Amar rava shette teshuvot baddavar chada dekachazena lefummeh deyanoka dimle chalav veod mekom chalav mayan hu
Dekatane chalev ishsha metamme ben leratzon uven shello leratzon behema enah metamme ella leratzon
May lav shello leratzon dela nicha leh vekatane metamme
Ella amar rava hayenu tama divnah tahor desafek yanak kashshiur vesafek lo yanak veim timtza lomar yanak safek yenako baachilat peras sefek yenako beoter mikkede achilat peras
Ulrava mekom chalav mayan hu velo tzarich hechsher
Vehatnan haishsha shennataf chalav middaddeha venafal laavir tannur tannur tame vekashya lan bemay itachshar veamar rabbi yochanan betipa meluchlechet al pi haddad
Vechi tema rava la savar lah kerabbi yochanan vehatanya nimtzeta atta omer tisha mashkin bezov hazzea velecha serucha verei tehorin mikkelum dimat eno vedam maggefato
b: Vachalev ishsha metammein tumat mashkin birviit rukko zovo umeme raglav metammein tuma chamura bechol shehu
Vei amratte mekom chalav meayyen hu chalav name netamme tuma chamura bechol shehu kezovo verukko ella shema minah mekom chalev ishsha lav mayan hu
I hachi kashya ha matnita veamar rava metamme ben leratzon uven shello leratzon
Mi savratte shello leratzon deamar dela nicha leh la may shello leratzon deamar dedateh detinok kariva legabbe chalav aval amar la nicha leh tahor

Achal ochalin temein vechu lema li shehiyya dekatane veshaha amar rav yehuda hachi katane achal ochalin temein veshata mashkin temein veshata reviit yayin veshaha baachilatan uvishtiyyatan kede achilat peras venichnas lammikdash chayyav
Rabbi elazar omer ku tanu rabbanan yayin veshechar al teshte yachol afilu kol shehu afilu miggitto
Talmud lomar veshechar en asur ella kede leshakker vechamma kede leshakker reviit yayin ben arbaim yom
Im ken ma talmud lomar yayin lomar lecha shemmuzharin alav kol shehu umuzharin alav miggitto
Rabbi yehuda omer yayin en li ella yayin shear meshakkerin minnayin talmud lomar veshechar im ken ma talmud lomar yayin al hayyayin bemita veal shear mashkin beazhara
Rabbi elazar omer yayin al teshte veshechar al tishtehu kederech shichruto ha im hifsik bo o natan letocho mayim kol shehu patur
Bemay feligi tanna kamma savar gamrinan shechar shechar minnazir
Verabbi yehuda la yalef shechar shechar minnazir verabbi elazar savar may shechar mide dehu meshakker

Keman azla ha detanya achal devela keilit veshata devash o chalav venichnas lammikdash veshimesh loke keman kerabbi yehuda amar rav yehuda bar achotay halacha kerabbi elazar vekare rav aleh derabbi elazar tuvyana dechakkime
Rav acha dehutzal hava nidra alah devethu ata lekammeh derav ashe amar leh zil haidana veta limchar derav la moke amora aleh miyyoma tava lechavreh mishshum shichrut
Amar leh vehaamar rav halacha kerabbi elazar umar hu deka rame beh mayya amar leh ha la kashya ha birviit ha beoter mikkede reviit
Tanu rabbanan ulhavdil ben hakkodesh uven hachol ellu damin vaarachin charamin vehekdeshot
Ben hattame uven hattahor ellu temaot utharot ulhorot zo horaa et kol hachukkim ellu midrashot asher devar Adonai zo halacha beyad moshe ze talmud
Yachol af hammishna talmud lomar ulhorot rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer yachol af talmud talmud lomar ulhorot
Keman azla ha detanya yatza sheretz tame utzfardea tahor sheshshetuye yayin morin bahen horaa nema rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi vela rabbanan afilu tema rabbanan veshane hacha dezil keri be rav hu
Amar rav halacha kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda veha rav la mokem amora miyyoma tava lechavreh mishshum shichrut shane rav deori more venokem dela vela lore kol hecha deyatev rav la saggi leh bela horaa
Matni yesh ochel achila achat vechayyavin aleha arbaa chattaot veasham echad tame sheachal chelev vehaya notar min hammukdashin beom hakkippurim
Rabbi meir omer im haya shabbat vehotzio chayyav amru lo eno min hashshem

a: Gema nema it leh lerabbi meir isur chal al isur nehi deisur chal al isur let leh isur kolel veisur mosif it leh
Tahor meikara la asir ella bechelev hava leh tame migo daasir bachatichot tehorot itosaf beh name isura ilave chelev
Vechelev meikara la asir ella baachila akdesheh migo deitosaf beh isura dahanaa itosaf beh legabbe chelev

Veakkatti lehedot hu daasir aval legavoha shere hava leh notar migo deitosaf isura legabbe gavoha itosaf beh legabbe hedot chal aleh yom hakkippurim migo deitosaf beh isur legabbe chullin itosaf beh legabbe gavoha
Venitne chamesh chattaot venokmah kegon daachal kezayit pigul bachada behema kamayere bishte behemot la kamayere venotar ufigul bachada behema la mashkachatte lah
Allema la mashkachatte lah kegon sheheela ever pigul legabbe mizbeach defaka piguleh mineh vehave leh notar
Vechidamar ulla kometz pigul sheheela legabbe mizbeach paka pigulo mimmennu vehave leh notar beever echad ka mayere bishne evarim la kamayere venotar ufigul bechad ever la mashkachatte lah

Allema la mashkachatte lah kegon sheheela ever pigul legabbe mizbeach defalgeh annecheh al gabbe mizbeach ufalgeh meabbaray demizbeach dehahu demizbeach paka pigul vahava leh notar vechidamar ulla kometz pigul sheheela al hammizbeach paka pigulo mimmennu vehave leh notar
Amar leh la i rubba demizbeach shidyeh lammizbeach rubba devaray shidyeh levaray
Tifshot devae rame bar chama halchu beevarim achar harov o lo ella bichzayit echad kamayere bishne zetim la ka mayere
Vela vehakatane yom hakkippurim uvom hakkippurim kotevet hu demichayyav vechotevet it bah shene zetim
Amar rabbi zera kegon sheachal kulya bechelbah rav pappa amar kegon demalleyeh betamre
Rav adda bar acha matne chamesh chattaot umtaretz lah kegon daachal kezayit pigul vela meshanne kehane shinuye deka meshannenan
Venitne shesh chattaot venokmah kegon daachal kezayit dam bachada achila ka mayere bishte achilot lo ka mayere veshiaru chachamim deen bet habbelia machazik yoter mishshene zetim
Rabbi meir omer vechu venitne im hotzio chayyav may tama katane im hayeta shabbat amar rafram zot omeret eruv vehotzaa leshabbat veen eruv vehotzaa leom hakkippurim
Mimmay dilma yesh eruv vehotzaa leom hakkippurim vehachi katane im hayeta shabbat vehotzio chayyav af mishshum shabbat veom hakkippurim
Ella i itmar derafram al hada itmar detanya veshillach beyad ish itti ish lehachshir et hazzar itti afilu betuma vaafilu beshabbat itti bimzumman
Katane itti afilu beshabbat amar rafram zot omeret eruv vehotzaa leshabbat veen eruv vehotzaa leom hakkippurim
Mimmay shane sair hammishtalleach dehechshero beom hakkippurim bechach ella derafram beruta hi
Matni yesh ba bia achat vechayyav aleha shesh chattaot ketzad habba al bitto chayyav aleha mishshum bitto vaachoto eshet achiv veeshet achi aviv veeshet ish venidda
b: Gema veha let leh lerabbi meir isur chal al isur nehi deisur chal al isur let leh isur mosif veisur kolel it leh
Kegon shebba al immo veholid bat deisur bitto vaachoto bahade hadade ate nisset leachiv migo deitosaf isur legabbe achin itosaf isura legabbe dideh

Nisset laachi aviv migo deitosaf isura legabbe shear ache aviv itosaf legabbe dideh haveya lah eshet ish migo deitosaf isur legabbe alma itosaf name legabbe dideh haveya lah nidda migo deitosaf isur legabbe baalah itosaf name legabbe dideh

Matni habba al bat bitto chayyav aleha mishshum bat bitto vechallato veeshet achiv veeshet achi aviv vaachot ishto veeshet ish venidda rabbi yose omer im avar zaken unsaah chayyav aleha mishshum eshet av
Vechen habba al bat ishto veal bat bittah
Gema katane chayyav aleha mishshum eshet av mi sharya leh amar rabbi yochanan kegon shennafla lo leyibbum
I hachi may avar amar rabbi yaakov sheavar mishshum kallat beno sheniyya
Kidtanya kallato erva kallat beno sheniyya vechen atta motze bevat beno uvvat ben beno ad sof kol haddorot
Umi it leh lerabbi yose isur chal al isur veha tenan avar avera sheyyesh bah shette mitot nidon bachamura rabbi yose omer nidon bezika rishona shebbaa alav
Vetanya ketzad amar rabbi yose nidon bezika rishona chamoto venaaset eshet ish nidon mishshum chamoto
Eshet ish venaaset chamoto nidon mishshum eshet ish
Amar rabbi avahu mode rabbi yose beisur mosif vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan mode rabbi yose beisur mosif
May isur mosif ika hacha deika bera lesava migo deitosaf isura legabbe bereh itosaf isura legabbe dideh
Matni habba al chamoto chayyav aleha mishshum chamoto vechallato veeshet achiv veeshet achi aviv vaachot ishto veeshet ish venidda vechen habba al em chamiv veal em chamoto
Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer habba al chamoto chayyav aleha mishshum chamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv amru lo sheloshtan shem echad hen
Gema amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya rabbi yochanan ben nuri vesomchos amru davar echad rabbi yochanan ben nuri ha daamaran somchos may hi ditnan

a: Shechatah veet bat bittah veachar kach shachat et bittah sofeg et haarbaim somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir sofeg shemonim
Amar rava dilma la hi ad kan la kaamar rabbi yochanan ben nuri hacha ella mishshum shemot muchlakin demikarya chamoto umikarya em chamoto umikarya em chamiv
Aval gabbe oto veet beno dechullehu oto veet beno mikaryan deen shemot muchlakin la
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak dilma ad kan la kaamar somchos ella gabbe oto veet beno degufin muchlakin
Aval hacha deen gufin muchlakin ema kerabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan sevira leh deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan shaara henna zimma hi hakkatuv asaan lechullan zimma achat

Matni amar rabbi akiva shaalti et rabban gamliel veet rabbi yehoshua baitles shel emaum shehalchu likach behema lemishte veno shel rabban gamliel habba al achoto veal achot aviv veal achot immo mahu chayyav achat al kullan o chayyav al kal achat veechat
Amru lo lo shamanu aval shamanu habba al chamesh nashav niddot behelem achat echad shehu chayyav al kol achat veechat veroe ani veroin anu shehaddevarim kal vachomer
Gema hechi dame ilema kidkatane may tibe leh hare shemot muchlakin hare gufin muchlakin
Ella hachi katane habba al achot aviv shehi achot immo chayyav achat al kullan o chayyav al kol achat veechat mahu mi amrinan hare shemot muchlakin o dilma hare en gufin muchlakin
Amru lo lo shamanu aval shamanu habba al chamesh nashav niddot bevat achat shehu shem echad shechayyav al kol achat veachat mishshum nidda

Verainu shehaddevarim kal vachomer uma habba al chamesh nashav niddot bevat achat shehi shem achat chayyav al kol achat veachat achoto shehi achot aviv shehi achot immo shehen shelosha shemot eno din sheyehe chayyav al kol achat veachat
Ika lemifrach ma lechamesh niddot shekken gufin muchlakin
Ella amar kera ervat achoto gilla lechayyev al achoto shehi achot aviv shehi achot immo

Amar rav adda bar ahava mashkachatte lah berashshia bar rashshia shebba al immo veholid shette banot vechazar uva al achat mehen veholid ben uva beno al achot immo shehi achoto shehi achot aviv dehave leh rashshia bar rashshia
Tanu rabbanan ba aleha vechazar uva aleha vechazar uva aleha chayyav al kol achat veechat divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim eno chayyav ella echat
Umodim chachamim lerabbi eliezer beva al chamesh nashav niddot bevat achat shehu chayyav al kol achat veachat hoil vehu garam lahen
Amar rava lerav nachman mi amrinan hoil vehu garam lahen vehatanya hu behelem achat echad vehi bachamishsha helemot hu eno chayyav ella achat vehi chayyevet al kol achat veechat
Ella ema hoil vegufin muchlakin
Ibaya lehu katzar vekatzar ma li amar rabbi eliezer
Tama derabbi eliezer hatam mishshum dehu daavad tarten veammetul lhachi amar chayyav al kol achat veachat vehacha name daavad tarten

O dilma tameh derabbi eliezer hatam mishshum dei efshar lo learvan leviot zo bazo ammetul lehachi amar rabbi eliezer chayyav al kol achat veachat aval katzar kigrogeret vechazar vekatzar kigrogeret behelem achat echad kevan deefshar lo learev shette gerogrot bevat achat eno chayyav ella echat may
Amar rabba tama derabbi eliezer hatam mishshum daavad tarte hacha name ha avad tarte verav yosef amar tama derabbi eliezer hatam dei efshar lo learvan aval efshar lo learvan eno chayyav ella echat
Etiveh abbaye lerabba rabbi eliezer mechayyev al valde melachot bimkom avot melachot
Ha av veav bevat achat patur vei amratte tama derabbi eliezer mishshum dekaaved tarte ammay patur
Amar mar bereh derabbanan ana verav nechumi bar zecharya targemna hacha vemay askinan
Bedalit hammudlet al gabbe teena uktzatzan bevat achat mishshum hachi mechayyev rabbi eliezer hoil veshemot muchlakin vegufin muchlakin
Dichotah katzar vekatzar hechi mashkachatte lah demiptar kegon shekkatzar shette gerogrot bevat achat aval katzar kigrogeret vechazar vekatzar kigrogeret chayyav
Matni veod shaal rabbi akiva ever hamduldal babbehema mahu amru lo lo shamanu aval shamanu ever hamduldal baadam shehu tahor vechach hau
b: Mukke shechin osin birushalayim holech lo erev pesach etzel harofe vechotcho ad shemmanniach bo kesaara vetochavo besira venimshach mimmennu
Vehalla ose pischo veharofe ose pischo veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer
Gema tenan hatam hammochek et hakkeresha vehassochet bisaro uvichsuto mashkin shebbetocho enam bechi yuttan vehayyotzin mimmennu hare hen bechi yuttan
Amar shemuel uchresha atzmah huchshera may tama bishat perisha mimmennu huchshera
Vehatnan erev pesach holech lo etzel ku vei amratte bishat perishatan huchshar ha ika name hahu ever hamduldal bishat perishato meadam netammeyeh leadam
Kidkaamar rav yosef benitazin bechol kochan hacha name benitazin bechol kochan

Vehecha itmar derav yosef aha zav utme met shehau mehallechim veyardu alehem geshamim af al pi shessochatin ze et ze mashkin hayyordin mitztzad haelon letzad hattachton tehorim sheen mechashshevin ella sheyyatzu mikkullan
Yatzu mikkullan hare machshirin sheen nechshavin ella leachar sheyyatzu miggufo amar rav yosef benitazin bechol kochan
Matni veod shaalu sheelan rabbi akiva hashshochet chamishsha zevachim bachutz behelem achat echad mahu chayyav al kol achat veachat o achat al kullan amru lo lo shamanu
Amar rabbi yehoshua shamati beochel mizzevach echad mechamishsha tamchuyin behelem achat shehu chayyav al kol achat veachat mishshum meila veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer
Amar rabbi shimon lo kach shaalv rabbi akiva ella beochel notar mechamishsha zevachim behelem achat echad mahu chayyav achat al kullan o chayyav al kol achat veechat amru lo lo shamanu
Amar rabbi yehoshua shamati beochel mizzevach echad bachamishsha tamchuyin behelem achat echad shehu chayyav al kol achat veachat mishshum meila veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer
Amar lo rabbi akiva im halacha nekabbel im ladin yesh teshuva amar lo hashev
Amar velo im amarta bimila sheasa bah et hammaachil kaochel veet hamhanne kannehene
Tzeref et hammeila lizman merubbe tomar benotar sheen bo achat meellu
Gema may kashya leh lerabbi shimon hachi ka kashya leh ma reaya leshochet meochel ma leochel shekken nehene
Ella kach shaalu sheelan haochel notar mechamishsha zevachim behelem achat echad mahu chayyav bechol achat veachat o achat al kullan amru lo lo shamanu

Amar rabbi yehoshua shamati beochel mizzevach echad mechamishsha tamchuyin behelem achat echad shechayyav al kol achat veachat mishshum meila veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer ma mizzevach echad sheen gufin muchlakin chayyav al kol achat veachat mishshum tamchuyin muchlakin chamishsha zevachim degufin muchlakin lo kol shekken
Amar rabbi shimon lo kach shaalv ella beochel notar mechamishsha zevachim behelem achat echad mahu chayyav achat al kullan o chayyav al kol achat veechat amru lo lo shamanu

Rabbi yehoshua omer shamati beochel mizzevach echad bachamishsha tamchuyin shehu chayyav al kol achat veachat mishshum meila veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer amar lo rabbi akiva im halacha nekabbel ku

Kablah rabbi yehoshua leha teshuva merabbi akiva o la ta shema detanya achal chamesh chatichot notar mizzevach echad behelem achat echad bachamishsha tamchuyin eno mevi ella chattat achat veal lo hoda shellahen eno mevi ella asham taluy
Mechamishsha tamchuyin bachamishsha helemot mevi chattat al kol achat veechat veal lo hoda shellahen mevi asham taluy al kol achat veachat mechamishsha zevachim behelem achat echad chayyav

Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer afilu achal chamesh chatichot mechamishsha zevachim behelem achat echad eno mevi ella chattat echat veal sefekan en mevi ella asham taluy echad kelalo shel davar kol shechalukin bechattaot chalukin baashamot
Achal chamesh chatichot bachamishsha tamchuyin mizzevach echad lifne zerikat damim afilu behelem achat echad chayyav al kol achat veachat mishshum meila

a: Veilu al sefeko mevi asham taluy la katane manni ha ilema rabbi akiva litne name sefa veal sefekan mevi asham taluy dehatnan rabbi akiva mechayyev al sefek meila asham taluy
Ella lav rabbi yehoshua hi vekatane bachamishsha helemot mevi chamesh chattaot ushma minah kablah mineh
Ella adderabba missefa dekatane mechamishsha zevachim afilu behelem achat echad chayyav al kol achat veechat shema minah la kablah mineh
Veella may it lach lememar tannae hi deika tanna dekablah veika tanna dela kablah
Afilu tema rabbi akiva hi vehay tanna savar lah kevateh bachada uflig aleh bachada savar lah kevateh behaalama uflig aleh bimilot
Hechi dame chamesh meilot amar shemuel keotah sheshshaninu chamishsha devarim baola mitztarfin habbasar vehechalav vehayyayin vehassolet vehashshemen

Chizkiyya amar kegon sheachal mechamishsha evarim resh lakish amar afilu tema beever echad mashkachatte lah bechatef rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar kegon sheachal bachamishsha mine kedera rabbi yochanan amar kegon sheachal bachamishsha teamim
Matni amar rabbi akiva shaalti et rabbi eliezer beose melachot harbe beshabbatot harbe meen melacha achat behelem achat echad mahu chayyav achat al kullan o chayyav al kol achat veechat

Amar lo chayyav al kol achat veachat mikkal vachomer uma nidda sheen bah totzaot harbe vechattaot harbe chayyav al kol achat veechat shabbat sheyyesh bah totzaot harbe umitot harbe eno din sheyehe chayyav al kol achat veechat
Amarti lo im amarta bannidda sheyyesh bah shette azharot shehu muzhar al hannidda vehannidda muzheret alav tomar bashshabbat sheen bah ella azhara echat
Amar li habba al hakketannot yochiach sheen bah ella azhara achat vechayyav al kol achat veechat
Amarti lo im amarta bakketannot sheaf al pi sheen bahen achshav yesh bahen leachar zeman tomar bashshabbat sheen bah achshav velo leachar zeman
Amar li habba al habbehema yochiach amarti lo habbehema kashshabbat
Gema may kavae mineh i shabbatot kegufin damyan vei la bae mineh nive haose melacha achat beshabbatot harbe
Ella valde melachot i keavot damyan vei la bae mineh nive mineh haose melachot harbe meen melacha achat bashshabbat
Amar rava amri be rav tarte bea mineh shabbatot kegufin damyan vei la bea mineh valde melachot kimlachot damyan i la
Veshabbatot hechi mibe leh shiggat shabbat uzdon melachot peshita leh deyamim shebbentayim haveyan yedia lechallek
Uzdon shabbat veshiggat melachot hu devae mineh i kegufin damyan i la
O dilma zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot peshita leh dichgufin damyan veshiggat shabbat uzdon melachot hu devae mineh deyamim shebbenatayim i haveyan yedia lechallek i la
Amar rabba
b: Mistabbera shiggat shabbat uzdon melachot peshita leh deyamim shebbentayim havayin yedia lechallek uzdon shabbat veshiggat melachot hu devae mineh kegufin damyan o lav
Ufshat leh dizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot kegufin damyan vela kabbel mineh ufshat leh devalde melachot kimlachot damyan vela kabbel mineh
Amar rabba mena amena lah ditnan kelal gadol amru bashshabbat kol hashshocheach ikar shabbat veasa melachot harbe beshabbatot harbe eno chayyav ella achat
Hayyodea ikar shabbat veasa melachot harbe beshabbatot harbe chayyav al kol shabbat veshabbat hayyodea shehu shabbat veasa melachot harbe beshabbatot harbe chayyav al kol av melacha umlacha
Veilu chayyav al kol av melacha shel kol shabbat veshabbat la katane
Manni ha ilema rabbi eliezer ema sefa haose melachot harbe meen melacha achat en chayyav ella echat vei rabbi eliezer chayyav al kol valde melachot kimlachot
Ella peshita rabbi akiva hi ushma minah shiggat shabbat uzdon melachot peshita leh deyamim shebbentayim havayin yedia lechallek
Zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot hu devae i kegufin damyan ufshat leh dichgufin damyan valde melachot kimlachot damyan vetarvayehu la kabbel mineh

Amar leh abbaye leolam ema lach zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot peshita leh lerabbi akiva deshabbatot lav kegufin damyan veshiggat shabbat uzdon melachot hu devae mineh deyamim shebbentayim mi havayin yedia lechallek o la
Ufshat leh deyamim shebbentayim havayin yedia lechallek vekabbel mineh ufshat leh valde melachot kimlachot damayin vela kabbel mineh

Rav chisda amar zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot afilu rabbi akiva sevira leh dichgufin damyan vechi bae mineh shiggat shabbat uzdon melachot hu devae mineh deyamim shebbentayim i haveyan yedia lechallek
Ufshat leh yamim shebbentayim havayin yedia lechallek vekabbel mineh
Ufshat leh devalde melachot kimlachot damayin vela kabbel mineh

Amar rav chisda mena amena lah detanya hakkotev shette otiyyot behelem echad chayyav bishte helemot rabban gamliel mechayyev vachachamim potrin umode rabban gamliel sheim katav ot achat beshabbat zo veot achat beshabbat acheret patur
Vetanya achariti hakkotev shette otiyyot bishte shabbatot echad beshabbat zo veechad beshabbat zo rabban gamliel mechayyev vachachamim potrin ka salka datach derabban gamliel kerabbi akiva sevira leh
Bishlama ledidi deamena zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot afilu rabbi akiva omer deshabbatot kegufin damyan ha detanya patur bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot deshabbatot kegufin damyan

a: Veha detanya chayyav beshiggat shabbat uzdon melachot deshabbatot kegufin damyan dekasavar en yedia lachatzi shiur
Ella lerava deamar sevira leh lerabbi akiva deshabbatot keguf echad hen
Bishlama ha detanya chayyav mashkachatte lah ben bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot deshabbatot keguf echad hen uven beshiggat shabbat uzdon melachot dekasavar en yedia lachatzi shiur
Veella hadtanya patur bemay mokmatte lah la bachada vela bachada
Amar lach rava rabban gamliel sevira leh kerabbi eliezer deamar shabbatot kegufin damyan

Veha middekatane umode rabban gamliel mikkelal difligi aachranyata i amratte bishlama kerabbi akiva sevira leh hayenu difligi beshiggat shabbat uzdon melachot derabban gamliel savar en yedia lachatzi shiur
Umode rabban gamliel bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot shehu patur alma shabbatot kegufin damyan ella i amratte rabban gamliel kerabbi eliezer sevira leh mikkelal difligi bemay

I beshiggat shabbat uzdon melachot afilu rabbi eliezer kerabban gamliel sevira leh deen yedia lachatzi shiur detanya hakkotev shette otiyyot bishte shabbatot ot achat beshabbat zo veot achat beshabbat zo rabbi eliezer mechayyev
Veella beachat al haarig chayyove mechayyev ditnan rabbi eliezer omer haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla veechad al haarig chayyav

Amar rava mikkelal diflig bachada detanya hotzi chatzi gerogeret vechazar vehotzi chatzi gerogeret behelem achat echad chayyav bishte helemot patur rabbi yose omer behelem echad birshut echad achat chayyav bishte reshuot patur
Derabban gamliel ketanna kamma verabbi eliezer kerabbi yose
Ta shema amar lo chayyav al kol achat veachat mikkal vachomer uma nidda sheen bah totzaot harbe
Bishlama lerav chisda deamar shiggat shabbat uzdon melachot bae mineh deyamim shebbentayim mi haveyan yedia lechallek o la hayenu dekaamar leh uma nidda
Ella lerava deamar zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot hu devae mineh deshabbatot i kegufin damyan vei la litne niddot
Amar lach rava teni niddot shemuel tane nidda rav adda bar ahava tane nidda rav natan bar oshaya amar tane niddot
Ulrav chisda deamar shiggat shabbat uzdon melachot hu devae mineh deyamim shebbentayim mi havayin yedia lechallek vei la nidda may yamim shebbentayim havayin yedia lechallek it bah
Amar rava kegon shebba aleha vetavla veraata vechazar uva aleha vetavla vechazar uva aleha ditvilot haveyan keyamim shebbentayim
Ta shema habba al hakketannot yochiach bishlama lerava hayenu dekatane ketannot
Ella lerav chisda may ketannot ketannot dealma

Dela kehaden tanna detanya amar rabbi shimon ben elazar lo kach sheelo rabbi akiva lerabbi elazar ella kach sheelo habba al ishto nidda vechazar uva al ishto nidda behelem echad mahu chayyav achat al kullan o chayyav al kol achat veachat

Amar lo chayyav al kol achat veachat mikkal vachomer uma shabbat sheen bah ella azhara achat shehu muzhar al hashshabbat vehashshabbat enah muzheret alav chayyav al kol achat veechat nidda sheyyesh bah shette azharot shehu muzhar al hannidda venidda muzheret alav eno din shehu chayyav al kol achat veechat
Amru lo lo im amarta bashshabbat sheyyesh bah totzaot harbe lechattaot harbe tomar bannidda sheen bah totzaot harbe lechattaot harbe
Amru lo habba al hakketannot yochiach sheen bah totzaot harbe lechattaot harbe vechayyav al kol achat veechat
Amru lo lo im amarta bakketannot shekken gufin muchlakin amru lo habba al habbehema yochiach sheen gufin muchlakin vechayyav al kol achat veechat amru lo habbehema kannidda
Hadaran alach amru lo
Matni safek achal chelev safek lo achal vaafilu achal safek yesh bo kashshiur vesafek

Shumman vachelev lefanav veachal echad mehen veeno yodea eze mehen achal ishto vaachoto immo babbayit shagag beachat mehen veeno yodea beezo mehen shagag shabbat veom chol veasa melacha beechad mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen asa mevi asham taluy
Keshem sheim achal chelev vachelev behelem achat echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat ken al lo hoda shellahen eno mevi ella asham taluy echad
Im hayeta yedia benatayim keshem shehu mevi chattat al kol achat veechat kach mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat
Keshem sheachal chelev vadam ufigul venotar behelem achat chayyav al kol achat veechat kach al lo hoda shellahen mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat
Gema itmar rav assi amar chaticha achat shaninu safek shel chelev safek shel shumman chiyya bar rav amar chaticha mishte chatichot shaninu
Bemay ka mipalgi rav assi savar yesh em lammasoret mitzvat ketiv
Vechiyya bar rav amar yesh em lammikra mitzot karenan
Etiveh rav huna lerav assi veamri lah chiyya bar rav lerav assi chelev veshumman lefanav veachal achat mehen may lav middesefa shette chatichot resha name shette chatichot

Amar lehu rav la tezlu batar ipcha deyachol leshannoye lechu sefa bishte chatichot resha bachaticha achat i hachi yesh lomar chaticha achat michayyav shette chatichot tzericha lememar zo veen tzarich lememar lomar zo

Ulchiyya bar rav deamar middesefa bishte chatichot resha name bishte chatichot mitna tarte lema li paroshe ka mefaresh safek achal safek lo achal chelev mevi asham taluy ketzad kegon shehaya chelev veshumman lefanav

Amar rav yehuda amar rav hau lefanav shette chatichot achat shel shumman veachat shel chelev achal achat mehen veeno yodea ezo mehen achal chayyav chaticha achat safek shel chelev safek shel shumman vaachalah patur
Amar rava may tama derav deamar kera veasa achat mikkol mitzot Adonai bishgaga ad sheyyishgog bishtayim mitzvat ketiv mitzot karenan

Amar lo rabbi eliezer savar yesh em lammasoret mitzvat ketiv

Vechayyav beasham taluy ha manni rabbi eliezer hi

Al shellah otom temein vechayyavin bakkorban nimtza al shellah leachar zeman temein missafek ufturin min hakkorban vetane alah chayyav mishshum asham taluy ha manni rabbi eliezer hi

Amar rabbi chiyya amar rav hau lefanav shette chatichot achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman veachal achat mehen veeno yodea eze mehen achal chayyav chaticha safek shel shumman safek shel chelev vaachalah patur
Amar rabbi zera may tama derav kasavar shette chatichot efshar levarer isuran chaticha achat i efshar levarer isurah
May ika ben tama derava letama derabbi zera ika venayehu kezayit umechetza
Lerava leka mitzot ufatur lerabbi zera efshar levarer isuro
Etiveh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera rabbi eliezer omer koy chayyavin al chelbo asham taluy amar leh rabbi eliezer savar la baenan levarer isuro

Amar rav nachman may tama derav kasavar shette chatichot ikva isura chaticha achat la kava ikva isura
May ika ben ikva isura leshei efshar levarer isureh

Etiveh rava lerav nachman rabbi eliezer omer koy chayyavin al chelbo asham taluy rabbi eliezer la bae keviuta leisura
Etiveh safek ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon yotzi vehavalad kasher vechayyavin beasham taluy ha manni rabbi eliezer hi

Ishtik levatar dinfak amar may tama la amari leh deha manni rabbi meir hi dela bae keviuta leisura
Detanya hashshochet asham taluy bachutz rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrin
Veammay lema leh derabbi eliezer hi ha ka mashma lan derabbi meir beshitat rabbi eliezer kae
Amar rabba bar avuh amar rav chaticha safek shel chelev safek shel shumman vaachalah banu lemachaloket rabbi eliezer vachachamim
Lerabbi eliezer may irya ki achlah afilu la achlah name dehatnan rabbi eliezer omer mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom
Amar rav ashe rabbi eliezer alliba devava ben buta ditnan ella omrim lo hamten ad shettikkanes levet safek

Tanu rabbanan hau lefanav shette chatichot achat shel shumman veachat shel chelev ba yisrael veachal et harishona ba goy veachal et hashsheniyya chayyav vechen kelev vechen orev ba goy veachal et harishona ba yisrael veachal et hashsheniyya patur verabbi mechayyev
Achal et harishona beshogeg vehashsheniyya bemezid chayyav harishona bemezid vehashsheniyya beshogeg patur verabbi mechayyev achal shettehen bemezid patur mikkelum
Shettehen beshogeg shenehen chayyavin hashsheni lo min haddin ella sheim atta omer patur kavata et harishona bechattat
Umannu i rabbi min haddin umin haddin hu i rabbanan mishshum delo nikba rishon bechattat nema leh lesheni ayeti chullin laazara amar rav ashe
b: Rabbi eliezer hi deamar mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom hilkach amrinan leh ayeti asham taluy veatni i achal rishon shumman hu achal chelev leheve kappara vei la leheve nedava
Tanu rabbanan achal sefek chelev venoda lo sefek chelev venoda lo rabbi omer omer ani keshem shemmevi chattat al kol achat veechat kach mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim en mevi ella asham taluy echad shenneemar al shiggato asher shagag afilu al shegagot harbe eno chayyav ella echat
Amar rabbi zera kan shana rabbi yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot

Rava amar en yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot ella hachi katane keshem sheim hayeta lo yedia vadday mevi chattat al kol achat veachat kach im hayeta lo yediat safek mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat
Amar leh abbaye veatte la tisbera didiot safek mechallekot lechattaot dei salka datach yediot en mechallekot lechattaot vechattat achat mevi ammay mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat
Vehatanya kelalo shel davar kol shechalukin bechattaot chalukin baashamot

Amar leh rava bar chanan leabbaye uldidach deamratte yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot ella meatta achal kezayit chelev lifne yom hakkipurim uchzayit chelev achar yom hakkipurim veom hakkippurim bimkom asham taluy kae hachi name demevi shette chattaot
Ha behelem achat echad achlinun amar leh abbaye uman lema lan deom hakkipurim mechappar al dela mityeda leh dilma vehu demityeda leh amar leh rava hoda velo hoda tenan
Ika deamri amar leh rava bar chanan leabbaye ma ilu achal kezayit chelev shacharit beom hakkipurim uchzayit chelev bemincha beom hakkippurim hachi name demichayyav shette chattaot

Amar leh abbaye uman lema lan deom hakkippurim kol shata mechappar dilma kulleh yoma meurta amar leh rabba bar bar channa terada tanya hare shebba leyado sefek avera beom hakkippurim afilu im chashecha patur shekkol hayyom mechapper

Metiv rav idi bar avin achal veshata behelem achat echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat veha ben achila lishtiyya i efshar delo hava shehut bayyom demityeda leh vechappar leh deom hakkippurim bimkom asham taluy kae vekatane eno chayyav ella chattat echat
Vei salka datach yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot lichayyav shette chattaot amri ki amar rabbi zera lerabbi ha rabbanan hi
Veha middesefa rabbi hi dekatane shata tzir o muryas patur ha chometz chayyav
Umanni rabbi hi detanya chometz en meshiv et hannefesh rabbi omer omer ani chometz meshiv et hannefesh umiddesefa rabbi resha name rabbi amri sefa rabbi resha rabbanan
Etiveh rava achal hayyom achal lemachar nehena hayyom nehena lemachar achal hayyom nehena lemachar nehena hayyom achal lemachar vaafilu mikkan vead shalosh shanim minnayin shehen mitztarfin ze im ze
Talmud lomar timol maal riba veammay ha kapar aleh yom hakkippurim
Amri ki mechappar yom hakkippurim al isura al mamona la mechappar
Veibaet ema ki mechappar yom hakkippurim al kulleh shiura al palga deshiura la mechappar
Vechen amar resh lakish kan shana rabbi yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot rabbi yochanan amar en yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot
Ella hachi katane keshem sheim hayeta lo yedia vadday mevi al kol achat veachat kach im hayeta lo yediat safek mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan hayenu deka tale leasham bechattat ella leresh lakish chattat beasham mibaya leh kashya
Verame derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan verame deresh lakish adderesh lakish detanya shene shevilin echad tame veechad tahor vehalach barishon velo nichnas bashsheni venichnas chayyav
Halach barishon venichnas patur bashsheni venichnas chayyav halach barishon venichnas vehizza veshana vetaval vehalach bashsheni venichnas chayyav

a: Rabbi shimon poter bazo rabbi shimon ben yehuda poter bechullan mishshum rabbi shimon

Vaafilu bekammayeta amar rava hacha vemay askinan kegon shehalach barishon uvishat hilucho bashsheni shachach shehalach barishon uvha peligi tanna kamma savar miktzat yedia kidia damya verabbi shimon savar miktzat yedia lav kidia damya
Amar mar halach barishon venichnas vehiza vetaval vehalach bashsheni venichnas chayyav ammay chayyav ha la havay leh yedia
Amar resh lakish ha manni rabbi yishmael hi dela bae yedia battechilla rabbi yochanan amar afilu tema rabbanan kan asu sefek yedia kidia
Salka datach kan asu vehu haddin lechol hattora kullah kashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan
Kashya deresh lakish adderesh lakish
Bishlama derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan la kashya kan asu aval bechol hattora kullah la
May tama hacha gabbe tuma ketiv venelam mimmennu vehu tame yedia deit bah name safek chayyav kera aval bechol hattora kullah ketiv o hoda elav chattato i it leh yedia hu demichayyav
Ella leresh lakish kashya addemokem lah kerabbi yishmael lokmah kerabbi ha ka mashma lan derabbi yishmael name la bae yedia battechilla
Ha matnitin hi ditnan rabbi yishmael omer venelam mimmennu shette peamim lechayyev al helem tuma veal helem mikdash
Itzterich salka datach amina mikra let leh miggemara it leh ka mashma lan

Matni chelev venotar lefanav veachal echad mehen veeno yodea eze mehen achal ishto nidda vaachoto immo babbayit shagag beachat mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen shagag shabbat veom hakkipurim veasa melacha ben hashshemashot veeno yodea beeze mehen asa rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter
Amar rabbi yose lo nechleku al haose melacha ben hashshemashot shehu patur sheani omer miktzat asa hayyom umiktzat asa lemachar

Al ma nechleku al haose melacha betoch hayyom veeno yodea im beshabbat asa im beom hakkippurim asa o al haose veeno yodea meen ezo melacha asa sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter amar rabbi yehuda potro haya rabbi yehoshua af measham taluy

Rabbi shimon verabbi shimon shezuri omrim lo nechleku al davar shehu mishshem echad shehu chayyav al ma nechleku al davar shehu mishshum shene shemot sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter

Amar rabbi yehuda afilu nitkaven lilkot teenim veliket anavim anavim veliket teenim shechorot veliket levanot levanot veliket shechorot rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter temehani im patar bah rabbi yehoshua im ken lamma neemar asher chata bah perat lammitassek

Gema tanya amar rabbi eliezer ma nafshach i chelev achal chayyav i notar achal chayyav i ishto nidda baal chayyav i achoto baal chayyav i beshabbat asa melacha chayyav i beom hakkippurim asa melacha chayyav
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua hare hu omer asher chata bah ad sheyyivada lo bamme chata verabbi eliezer hay bah may aved leh mibe leh perat lammitassek
b: Mitassek demay i dachalavim vaaraot chayyav deamar rav nachman amar shemuel hammitassek bachalavim vaaraot chayyav shekken nehena
Vei mitassek beshabbat patur may tama melechet machshevet asra tora
Lerava mashkachatte lah kegon shennitkaven lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamchubbar leabbaye mashkachatte lah kegon denitkaven lehagbiha et hattalush vechatach et hamchubbar

Deitmar nitkaven lehagbiha et hattalush vechatach et hamchubbar patur may tama deha la ikavan leshum chaticha lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamchubbar abbaye amar chayyav deha ikavan leshum chaticha rava amar patur deha la ikavan lachaticha deisura
Rabbi yose omer lo nechleku ku tanya amar lahen rabbi yose dikdaktem acharay
May amri leh daamar lehu dikdaktem acharay hachi amaru leh higbiha ben hashshemashot mahu amar lehu dikdaktem acharay
Venema lehu miktzat hagbaha hayeta mehayyom umiktzatah lemachar hachi name kaamar lehu dikdaktem acharay velo heelitem beyedchem kelum
Ulrabbi yose gemar melacha lerabbi eliezer patur ha shamana leh dimchayyev ditnan rabbi eliezer omer haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla veechad al haarig chayyav
Amar rav yosef rabbi yose alliba derabbi eliezer hachi matne rabbi eliezer omer haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla ushnayim al haarig chayyav

Amar rabbi yehuda potro haya rabbi yehoshua af measham taluy tanya amar rabbi yehuda potro haya rabbi yehoshua af measham taluy shenneemar ki techeta velo yada perat laze sheyyada shechata amar lo rabbi shimon zehu shemmevi asham taluy shenneemar veasa velo yada veze lo yada bamme asa
Aval safek achal chelev safek lo achal tze ushal alav im mevi asham taluy im lav may have alah

Ta shema chata velo yada bamme chata o safek chata safek lo chata mevi asham taluy man shemana leh deamar chata veen yadua bemay chata mevi asham taluy rabbi shimon veka tane safek chata safek lo chata mevi asham taluy shema minah sevira leh lerabbi shimon safek chata safek lo chata mevi asham taluy
Rabbi shimon shezuri verabbi shimon omer lo nechleku ku im ken ma talmud lomar asher chata bah perat lammitassek
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel mitassek bachalavim vaaraot chayyav shekken nehena mitassek bashshabbat patur melechet machshevet asra tora

Amar leh rava lerav nachman veha tinokot dechi mitassek dame utnan mi shehau lo shene tinokot echad lamul bashshabbat veechad lamul achar hashshabbat veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter
Ad kan la patar rabbi yehoshua ella mishshum dekasavar taa bidvar mitzva velo asa mitzva patur aval mitassek bedavar delav mitzva afilu rabbi yehoshua mechayyav
Amar lo hannach lattinokot hoil umkalkel bechabbura chayyav mitassek bechabbura chayyav

Etiveh rav yehuda lishmuel rabbi yehuda omer afilu mitkaven lelakket teenim veliket anavim anavim veliket teenim shechorot veliket levanot levanot veliket shechorot rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter
Veha hacha mitassek hu verabbi yehoshua name la ka fatar ella min mina lemina aval bechad mina afilu rabbi yehoshua mechayyav

Amar leh shinana shevok matnitin veta batray hacha vemay askinan kegon sheavad melakket millibbo nitkaven lelakket anavim veshachach vesavur teenim baena vehalcha yado al haanavim derabbi eliezer savar hare neesta kauonato verabbi yehoshua savar hare lo neesta kauonato umachshavto

a: Metiv rav oshaya rabbi shimon shezuri verabbi shimon omrim lo nechleku al davar shehu mishshem echad shehu chayyav ella al davar shehu mishshum shene shemot sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter

Verabbi yehuda may kaamar difligi benitkaven lelakket anavim velikket teenim shechorot velikket levanot anavim utenim shechorot ulvanot may nihu shene shemot hayenu rabbi shimon verabbi shimon shezuri rabbi yehuda may ata leashmoinan
Ella lav mitassek ika benayehu derabbi yehuda savar mitassek chayyav verabbi shimon shezuri savri mitassek patur
La mitassek divre hakkol patur vehacha beha ka mipalgi derabbi shimon shezuri savar shachach melakket millibbo beshem echad divre hakkol chayyav
Ki peligi bishne shemot rabbi yehuda savar la shena beshem echad vela shena bishne shemot peligi
Rava amar likdom ika venayehu
Vehatanya hau lefanav shette nerot dolkot arukkot venitkaven lechabbot et zo vechiba et zo lehadlik et zo vehidlik et zo patur lehadlik ulchabbot vechiba vehidlik binshima achat chayyav

Peshita mahu detema la itavid machshavteh deha lehadlik meikara bae ulvassof lechabbot vechi avad maase kiba uvassof hidlik hu veema patur ka mashma lan nehi deakdome name la makdem achore name la meachar

Tanu rabbanan hachote gechalim bashshabbat chayyav chattat rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok chayyav shettayim mippene shehu mechabbe et haelonot umavir et hattachtonot bemay askinan i deka mikaven lechabbot ulhavir may tama deman defatar ella dela ka mikkaven lehavir may tama deman dimchayyev tarte

Rabbi elazar verabbi chanina deamri tarvayehu kegon shennitkaven lechabbot haelonot kede lehavir et hattachtonot detanna kamma kasavar mekalkel behavara patur verabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok amar chayyav vechen amar rabbi yochanan benappach shanu amar rabbi yochanan ad kan lo nitgalleta tamah shel halacha zo
Amme bar avin verav chananya bar avin deamri tarvayehu
b: Kegon shennitkaven lechabbot ulhavir detanna kamma savar lah kerabbi yose deamar havara lelav yatzat
Verabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok savar lah kerabbi natan deamar havara lechallek yatzat
Rava amar lehakdim ika venayehu

Rav ashe amar kegon shennitkaven lechabbot vehuvaru meelehen vetanna kamma savar lah kerabbi shimon deamar davar sheen mitkaven patur verabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok savar lah kerabbi yehuda deamar davar sheen mitkaven chayyav

Tanu rabbanan hachote gechalim beshabbat lehitchammem bahem vehuvaru meelehen tane chada chayyav vetane idach patur hadtanya chayyav kasavar melacha sheenah tzericha legufah chayyav aleha veha ditna patur kasavar melacha sheenah tzericha legufah patur aleha
Hadaran alach safek achal chelev
Matni achal dam shechita babbehema bechayya uvaof ben temein ben tehorin dam nechira dam ikur dam hakkaza shehanneshama yotza bo chayyavin alav
Dam hattechol dam hallev dam betzim dam chagavim dam hattamtzit en chayyavin alav rabbi yehuda mechayyev bedam hattamtzit
Gema tanu rabbanan kal dam lo tochlu shomea ani afilu dam mehalleche shettayim dam betzim dam chagavim dam dagim hakkol bakkelal talmud lomar leof velivhema
Ma of uvhema meuchadin sheyyesh bahen tuma kalla vetuma chamura veyesh bahen isur veheter vehen min basar af kol sheyyesh bahen tuma kalla
Otzi dam mehalleche shettayim sheyyesh bahen tuma chamura veen bahen tuma kalla

a: Otzi dam sheratzim sheen bahem tuma chamura otzi dam betzim sheen min basar dam dagim dam chagavim shekkullo heter
Laof velabbehema i ma of sheen bah kilayim af behema sheen bah kilayim talmud lomar velabbehema
I ma behema sheenah beem al habbanim af of sheeno beem al habbanim talmud lomar laof velabbehema
Veema kol dam kalal of uvhema parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat of uvhema in midi acharina la
Nefesh asher tochal kol dam chazar vechalal kelal ufrat vechalal i atta dan ella keen happerat
Veha la dame kelala batra lichlala kamma kelala kamma lav kelala batra karet
Hay tanna deve rabbi yishmael beribuye umiute uchlale ufrate darshinan min haden gavena veaf al gav dela dame kelala batra lichlala kamma

Amar mar kelal ufrat uchlal i atta dan ella cheen happerat ma happerat meforash davar sheyyesh bo tuma kalla vetuma chamura veyesh bahen isur veheter veyesh bahen min basar af kol davar sheyyesh bo tuma kalla vetuma chamura vechu
Af kol dekatane leetoye may
Amar rav adda bar avin leetoye damo shel koy may kasavar i kasavar koy sefeka hu itzterich kera lemesar sefeka ella kasavar koy beriyya bifne atzmo hu
Ashkechan damo chelbo menalan mikkol chelev nivlato menalan mikkol nevela
Gid hannashe menalan bechaf hayyarech talyeh rachamana veha it leh kaf hayyarech
Tumato ushchita menalan sevara middilchol mile rabbeyeh rachamana kivhema tumato ushchitato name kivhema
Amar mar otzi dam mehalleche shettayim sheyyesh bahen tuma chamura veen bahen tuma kalla urminhi hachotech min haadam tzarich machshava vehechsher
Vekashya lan machshava lema li tease chaticha shello machshava veamar resh lakish bechotcho lakkelev umachshava lakkelev lav machshava hi
Vela vehatnan kelal amru betuma kol hamuchad leechol adam tame ad sheyyippasel meachilat kelev

Hahu leassoke tuma mineh dechevan demeikara hava chaze leadam leassoke mittuma ad sheyyippasel meachilat kelev hacha leachote leh tuma i chaze leadam chaze lechelev i la chaze leadam la chaze lechelev
Mikkol makom katane machshava umachshava letuma kalla hi hane mile mechayyim aval leachar mita tame hu tuma chamura
Dichotah gabbe behema leachar mita i basar metamme tuma chamura veim dam metamme tuma chamura
Ditnan dam nevelot bet shammay metaharin uvet hillel metammein
Lo nitzrecha ella lichditnan nivlat behema temea bechol makom nivlat haof hattahor bakkefarim tzarich machshava veen tzarich hechsher
Nivlat behema tehora bechol makom venivlat of tahor vechelev bashshevakim en tzerichin lo machshava velo hechsher
Vaamar leh rav lerabbi chiyya machshava lema li letuma kalla hi gufah tuma hi amar leh kegon deika pachot mikkezayit nevela vetzerfah lefachot mikkevetza ochalin dehay vehay have kevetza

I hachi live name hechsher deha tana deve rabbi yishmael al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea ma zeraim meuchadin sheen sofan letamme tuma chamura vetzarich hechsher af kol sheen sofan letamme tuma chamura tzarich hechsher
Amar leh hane mile baochalin dealma delet behu pachot mikkezayit nevela aval hacha deika begaveh pachot mikkezayit nevela kevan deilu metzaref leh kezayit la bae hechsher
b: Leappoke met af al gav dimmalle leh la metamme tumat ochalin mishshum devatla dato etzel kol adam
Rav chananya amar afilu tema dehave kezayit hacha vemay askinan kegon shechipahu bevatzek
I hachi hechsher name nive hane mile baochalin acharine dela metammu la bemagga vela bemassa aval hacha nehi dela metamme bemagga dekamchappe bevatzek bemassa mihat litamme deha taen leh
Leappoke met deaf al gav dechipahu bevatzek metamme tuma chamura detuma bokaat veola bokaat veoredet
Amar mar yatzu sheratzim sheen bahen tuma vela sheretz metamme bemagga bemassa la metamme

Amar mar yatza dam dagim vedam chagavim shekkullo heter may kullo heter ilema dechelbo muttar hare chayya dechelbah muttar vedamah asur veella mishshum delet behu isur gid hannashe vahare of delet beh isur gid hannashe vedamo asur
Ella may kullo heter dela bae shechita
Amar mar ma of sheen bo kilayim af behema talmud lomar behema
Kilayim demay ilema kilayim deharbaa vechilayim dacharisha vehatnan chayya vaof kayyotze bahen
Ella amar abbaye shetztzimro en chayyavin alav mishshum kilayim

Amar rav yehuda amar rav dam sheratzim lokin alav bichzayit metivi dam hattechol dam hallev dam hakkelaot dam evarim hare ellu belo taase dam mehalleche shettayim dam sheratzim urmasim asur veen chayyavin alav
May en chayyavin alav karet aval lav michayyav
Chada dehayenu resha veod tanna millav name ka memaet leh dekatane yatza dam sheratzim sheen bahen tuma chamura
Amar rabbi zera hitru bo mishshum sheretz loke mishshum dam eno loke
Amar rav dam dagim shekkinso asur metivi dam dagim dam chagavim muttar vaafilu lechattechilla hahi beshello kinso ki ka amar rav beshekkinso
Dichotah gabbe mehalleche shettayim beshello kinso mi asur veha tanya dam sheal gabbe kikkar gorro veochlo shel ben hashshinayim motztzo uvolo veeno choshesh
Ella ki tanya hahi matnita deit beh kaskassim ki kaamar rav asur delet beh kaskassim

Amar rav sheshet dam mehalleche shettayim afilu mitzvat perosh en bo metivi dam hattechol dam hallev dam hakkelaot dam evarim hare ellu belo taase dam mehalleche shettayim dam sheratzim urmasim asur veen chayyavin alav ki tanya asur

a: Deferash ki kaamar rav bidla perash kidtanya dam sheal gabbe kikkar gorro veochlo shel ben hashshinayim motzetz uvolea veeno choshesh

Ika dematne lah leha derav sheshet al hada detanya yachol chalev mehalleche shettayim yehe ochlo over belav vedin hu ma behema temea shehekalta bemaggaah hechmarta bachalavah mehalleche shettayim shehechmarta bemaggaan eno din shettachmir bachalavan
Talmud lomar veze lachem hattame ze tame veen chalev mehalleche shettayim tame ella tahor

Otzi et hechalav sheen shave bakkol velo otzi haddam sheshshave bakkol talmud lomar veze lachem hattame ze tame veen dam mehalleche shettayim tame ella tahor amar rav sheshet afilu mitzvat perosh en bo
Tenan hatam hallev koro umotzi et damo lo kerao eno over alav amar rabbi zera amar rav lo shanu ella belev of hoil veen bo kezayit aval lev behema deyesh bo kezayit asur vechayyavin alav karet
Metivi dam hattechol dam hallev dam hakkelaot dam evarim hare ellu belo taase dam mehalleche shettayim dam shekatzim urmasim asur veen chayyavin alav
Ki katane en chayyavin alav al dam dileh ki kaamar rav deate leh mealma
Dam dileh hayenu dam evarim velitamach mi la katane dam kelaot vekatane dam evarim ella tane vahadar tane hacha name tane vahadar tane
Mealma mehecha ate leh amar rabbi zera beshaa shehanneshama yotza misraf saref
Dam shehanneshama yotza bo chayyavin alav itmar ezehu dam hakkaza shehanneshama teluya bo rabbi yochanan amar kol zeman shemmekalleach resh lakish amar mittipa hammashcheret veelach

Metivi ezehu dam hakkaza shehanneshama yotza bo kol zeman shemmekalleach yatza dam hattamtzit mippene shehu shotet may lav afilu rishon veacharon deshotet hu kedam hattamtzit dame teuvta deresh lakish
La lemaote dam hammashchir aval dam rishon veacharon af al gav dehu shotet hayenu dam hannefesh

Metivi ezehu dam rishon kol zeman shemmekalleach yatza rishon veacharon mippene shehu shotet teuvteh deresh lakish amar lach tannae hi detanya ezehu dam hannefesh kol zeman shemmekalleach divre rabbi elazar rabbi shimon omer mittipa hammashcheret veelach
Tana deve rabbi yishmael vedam chalalim yishte perat ledam kiluach sheeno machshir et hazzeraim
Bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera hikkiz dam livhema vekibel damah bishne chosot mahu al harishon divre hakkol chayyav al haacharon mi michayyav o la
Amar leh pelugta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish deitmar hikkiz dam livhema vekibel damah bishne chosot resh lakish amar chayyav shette chattaot verabbi yochanan amar eno chayyav ella achat

Rabbi yehuda mechayyev bedam hattamtzit amar rabbi elazar mode rabbi yehuda leinyan kappara shenneemar ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper dam shehannefesh yotza bo mechapper vesheen hannefesh yotza bo eno mechapper
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak af anan name tenena detanya dam ma talmud lomar kol dam

Lefi shenneemar ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper en li ella dam kadashim shehannefesh yotza bo shehu mechapper dam chullin vedam hattamtzit minnayin talmud lomar kol dam setam sifra manni rabbi yehuda hi
Matni rabbi akiva mechayyev al sefek meila asham taluy vachachamim potrim umode rabbi akiva sheeno mevi et meilato ad sheyyitvadda lo sheyyavi immo asham vadday

Amar rabbi tarfon ma laze mevi shette ashamot ella mevi meila vechumshah veyavi asham bishne selaim veyomar im vadday maalti zo meilati vezo ashami veim safek maalti hammaot nedava veasham taluy shemmimmin shehu mevi al hoda mevi al lo hoda

Amar rabbi akiva nirin devarav bimila meuta hare sheyyavo leyado sefek meila bemea mane lo yafe lo sheyyavi asham bishte selaim velo yavi sefek meila bemea mane mode rabbi akiva lerabbi tarfon bimila meuta
b: Gema tanu rabbanan veim nefesh lechayyev al sefek meilot asham taluy divre rabbi akiva vachachamim potrim
Lema beha ka mipalgi derabbi akiva savar lemedin elon mittachton verabbanan savri en lemedin elon mittachton
Amar rav pappa dechulle alma lemedin elon mittachton deim ken tzafon beven bakar la mashkachatte lehu
Ella hacha hayenu tama derabbanan defatri digmiri mitzot mitzot mechattat
Ma lehallan davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat veal sefeko asham taluy af kol shechayyavin al zedono karet veal sefeko chattat veal shiggato asham taluy
Leappoke meila deen chayyavin al zedono karet detanya hezid bimila rabbi omer bemita vachachamim omrim beazhara
Verabbi akiva savar ki yalfinan mitzot mitzot mechattat chelev lehachi hu deyalfinan ma lehallan bikvua af kan bikvua
Leappoke ole veored dela
Verabbanan savri en gezera shava lemechetza mikkelal derabbi akiva savar yesh gezera shava lemechetza ella dechulle alma en gezera shava lemechetza
Ella hayenu tama derabbi akiva daamar kera veim nefesh vav mosif al inyan rishon veyilmad elon mittachton
Verabbanan savri tachton hu degamar meelon leasham bechesef shekalim
Verabbi akiva savar en hekesh lemechetza mikkelal derabbanan savri yesh hekesh lemechetza veha kayema lan deen hekesh lemechetza
Dechulle alma en hekesh lemechetza vehacha hayenu tama derabbanan digmiri mitzot mitzot appekeh mehekkesha
Verabbi akiva asham bechesef shekalim nafka leh mizzot torat haasham tora achat lechol haashamot leasham divchesef shekalim
Verabbanan af al gav dichtiv zot torat haasham itzterich lemichtav veim nefesh vav mosif al inyan rishon veyilmad tachton meelon
Vei mizzot torat haasham hava amena ki amena tora achat lechol ashamot hane mile bishar ashamot vaddain
Aval asham taluy kevan deal sefek chelev kaate ema la yehe sefeko chamur mivaddao ma vaddao chattat bat danka af sefeko asham bar danka ahachi ketav rachamana veim nefesh vav mosif al inyan rishon
Nicha leman dedaresh zot torat haasham ella leman dela daresh zot torat haasham may ika lememar yalef beerkecha beerkecha measham meilot
Asham shifcha charufa la ketiv beh beerkecha yalfinan beel
Mode rabbi akiva ku veim safek
May kaamar amar rava teni im bisfeko omed leolam yehe asham taluy shemmimmin shehevi al hoda mevio al shello hoda
Sof sof ki mityeda leh bae leetoye asham vadday
Amar rava middivre shenehem nilmad asham vadday la bae yedia lechattechilla
