Matni haishsha shehevia chattat haof ad shello nimleka noda lah sheyyalda vadday taasena vadday shemmimmin shehi mevia al hoda mevia al lo hoda
Chaticha shel chullin vachaticha shel hekdesh achal achat mehen veen yodea eze mehen achal patur rabbi akiva mechayyev asham taluy achal et hashsheniyya mevi asham vadday
Achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy divre rabbi akiva rabbi shimon omer shenehen meviin asham echad rabbi yose omer

a: En shenayim meviin asham echad

Chatichat chelev vachatichat chullin achal achat mehen veeno yodea eze mehen achal mevi asham taluy achal et hashsheniyya mevi chattat achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy divre rabbi akiva rabbi shimon omer shenehem meviin chattat achat rabbi yose omer en shenayim meviin chattat achat

Chatichat chelev vachatichat kodesh achal achat mehen veeno yodea eze mehen achal mevi asham taluy achal et hashsheniyya mevi chattat veasham vadday achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy rabbi shimon omer shenehen meviin chattat veasham rabbi yose omer en shenayim meviin chattat veasham echad
Chatichat chelev vachatichat chelev kodesh achal achat mehen veen yodea ezo mehen achal mevi chattat rabbi akiva omer af asham taluy achal et hashsheniyya mevi shene chattaot veasham vadday

Achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya ze mevi chattat veze mevi chattat rabbi akiva omer ze vaze meviin asham taluy rabbi shimon omer ze mevi chattat veze mevi chattat ushnehen meviin asham echad rabbi yose omer en shenehen meviin asham echad
Chatichat chelev vachatichat chelev notar achal achat mehen veen yodea eze mehen achal mevi chattat veasham taluy achal et hashsheniyya mevi shalosh chattaot

Achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya ze mevi chattat veasham taluy veze mevi chattat veasham taluy rabbi shimon omer ze mevi chattat veze mevi chattat ushnehen meviin chattat achat rabbi yose omer kol chattat shehi baa al chet en shenayim meviin otah
Gema amar leh rava lerav nachman lerabbi yose chattat hu dela mayetu shenehen ha asham taluy mayetu shenehem hayenu tanna kamma
Vechi tema chaticha mishte chatichot ika benayehu vehatanya rabbi yose omer ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy amar leh ha ka mashma lan deman tanna kamma rabbi yose

Chatichat chelev vachatichat kodesh chatichat chelev vachatichat chelev kodesh ku chatichat chelev vachatichat chelev notar ku amar leh rava lerav nachman velayete name asham vadday denotar dekodesh hu amar leh delet beh shave peruta
Veha meikara deit beh shave peruta askinan dekatane asham vadday amar leh hahi chaticha dela notar hi shaveya peruta
Veha yesh ochel achila achat dekatane beh notar vekatane mevi arba chattaot veasham echad
Amar leh hahi begassa vehahi bedakka vela kashya hahi bimot haggeshamim hacha bimot hachamma
Achal echad et harishona ku amar leh rava lerav nachman umi amar rabbi shimon isur chal isur
Veha tanya rabbi shimon omer haochel nevela beom hakkipurim patur
Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi kegon daachal kulya bechelbah vechulya bechelbah name ha kae alah beisur olin hechi ate isur notar chayel alah

Vechi tema sevira leh lerabbi shimon denotar isur chamur hu vechayel al isur kal deolin veha nevela deisur kal hu veom hakkipurim deisur chamur hu vela kaate isur yom kipurim dechamur vechayel al nevela dekal hu
Ella bekadashim galli rachamana deate isur chal al isur
b: Detanya asher la lerabbot et haemurin
Veemurin kae alayehu beisur olin vechelev kae aleyhv beisur karet vekaate isur tuma chayel aleh

Teda shekken hu deha rabbi sevira leh isur chal al isur veema vehane mile isur chamur al isur kal aval isur kal chal al isur vehu isur chamur la uvkodashim shaminan leh deamar isur kal al isur chamur name chayel
Deha isur meila kal hu mita veisur kadashim isur chamur karet veate isur mita chayel al isur karet
Detanya rabbi omer kol chelev la lerabbot emure kadashim kallim limila
Umila isur mita veka chayel al isur chelev deisur karet hu shema minah bekadashim galli kera
Veha tanya rabbi shimon omer en pigul baolin veen notar baolin
Ella tannae hi vealliba derabbi shimon deika deamri bekadashim isur chal al isur veika deamri bekadashim name en isur chal al isur
Ulman deamar bekadashim name en isur chal al isur kol chelev la may aved leh
Mokem leh bevalde kadashim dekasavri valde kadashim bahavayatan yehu kedoshim detarvayehu bahadade atu
Hadaran alach dam shechita
Matni hammevi asham taluy venoda lo shello chata im ad shello nishchat yetze veyire baeder divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava rabbi eliezer omer yikrav sheim eno ba al chet ze hare hu ba al chet acher
Im mishshennishchat noda lo yishshafech haddam vehabbasar yetze levet hasserefa nizrak haddam vehabbasar kayyam yeachel rabbi yose omer afilu haddam bakkos yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel
Asham vadday eno ken ad shello nishchat yetze veyire baeder mishshennishchat hare ze yikkaver nizrak haddam habbasar yetze levet hasserefa
Shor hanniskal eno ken ad shello niskal yetze veyire baeder mishshenniskal muttar bahanaa
Egla arufa eno ken ad shello neerfa tetze vetire baeder mishshenneerfa tikkaver bimkomah sheal safek baa mittechilla kipra sefekah vehalcha lah
Gema bemay peligi rabbi meir savar kevan dela tzerich leh la makdesh leh verabbanan savri mittoch shellibbo nokfo gomer umakdish

Tana ben shennoda lo shechata uven noda lo shello chata peligi rabbi meir verabbanan benoda lo shechata lehodiacha kocho derabbi meir deaf al gav deyada dachata kevan dividana deafresheh la yeda tetze vetire baeder
Uvnoda lo shello chata lehodiacha kochan derabbanan deaf al gav dela chata kevan dividana deafresheh la yeda libbo nokfo hava hilkach gamar umakdesh
Amar rav sheshet mode rabbi meir lachachamim

a: Bemafrish shene ashamot leachraut venitkapper beachat mehen desheni yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava

May tama ad kan la peligi rabbi meir alehon derabbanan ella mishshum dela galli dateh delibbo nokfo aval hacha mikkedi chad hu deibi leh leafroshe may tama afresh tere desavar i mirchas chada mikapparna beidach chavreh vechevan degalli dateh delibbo nokfo haya hoil vechach haya gamar vehikdisho
Amar rav yehuda amar rav modim chachamim lerabbi meir beasham taluy shehuzzammu edav deyetze veyire baeder
May tama ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh ella hecha deafresheh al pi atzmo veamrinan libbo nokfo aval hecha deal pi edim afresheh la hava samech ilave edim desavar dilma atu acherim umazzemi lehu
Metiv rava shor hanniskal eno ken im ad shello niskal yetze veyire baeder hechi dame ilema deatu be tere amri harag uve tere amri lo harag may chazet detzayetatte levatrae tziyt lehu lekammae
Ella lav beede hazama vedichoteh gabbe asham taluy beede hazama ufligi
Amar leh abbaye vedilma shor hanniskal hechi dame kegon shebba harug beraglav
Vedichoteh gabbe asham taluy kegon dehukkera chaticha aval hecha deafresheh leasham taluy al pi edim la
Biflugta asham taluy shehuzzammu edav rabbi elazar omer hare hi keminchat kenaot detanya nimtzeu edeha zommin minchatah tetze lechullin

Rabbi yochanan amar yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava verabbi yochanan nedammeyeh leminchat kenaot la dame minchat kenaot la lechappara kaatya ella levarer aon aval asham taluy dilchappara ate mittoch shellibbo nokfo gomer umakdisho
Amar rabbi keruspaday amar rabbi yochanan shor hanniskal shehuzzammu edav kol hammachazik bo zacha bo
Amar rava mistabbera tama derabbi yochanan kegon deamri leh nirba shoro aval amru rava shoro hu beatzmo mida yada dela reva vela mafkar leh vetarach umayete edim
Umay shena meha deamar rabba bar itay amar resh lakish ir hanniddachat shehuzzammu edeha kol hammachazik bah zacha bah
Ir hanniddachat derabbim ninhu kol chad amar bedateh ana la chatay acharina chata umafkar mamoneh aval hacha divdideh talya milta hu beatzmo mida yada dela reva vela mafkar leh vetarach umayete edim
Amar resh lakish hannoten mattana lachavero veamar halla i efshi bah kol hammachazik bah zacha bah

Umay shena meha deamar rabba bar avuh amar rav sheshet veamri lah amar rabbi avahu amar rav sheshet mekabbel mattana sheamar leachar shebbat mattana leyado mattana zo tibatel mevuttelet i efshi bah devarav kayyamin betela enah mattana lo amar kelum
b: May lav devarav kayyamin dehadra lemarah la devarav kayyamin vehu name la kane lah vechol hammachazik bah zacha bah
Metivi haomer lachavero din udvarim en li al sade zo en li esek bah veyadi mesulleket hemenna lo amar kelum veha yadi mesulleket hemenna kei efshi dame vekatane lo amar kelum
Shane hatam deamar ki sallek nafsheh middin udvarim miggufah desade la sallek nafsheh

Metivi hakkotev nechasav laacherim vehau bahen avadim veamar halla i efshi bahen im haya rabbo sheni kohen ochlin bitruma rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kevan sheamar i efshi bahen kevar zachu bahen yorshin
Bishlama lerabban shimon ben gamliel kasavar ki yahev inish mattana addata dimkabbelin lah mineh ki la mekabbelin lah mineh hadra lemarah

Ella letanna kamma i ki amar i efshi bahen kol hammachazik bahen zacha bahen hacha deamar sheni i efshi bahen hau lehu zarim vekaachli zarim teruma kasavar hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur merabbo vekasavar meukkav leget shichrur ochel bitruma
Rabbi eliezer omer yikrav ku lerabbi eliezer lema li chet ha amar rabbi eliezer asham taluy bindava ate ditnan rabbi eliezer omer mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom
Amar rav ashe rabbi eliezer deamru lo hu ditnan ella omrim lo hamten ad shettikkanes levet hassafek
Im mishshennishchat noda ku katane habbasar yetze levet hasserefa alma chullin shennishchatu baazara bisrefa
Urminhi asham vadday eno ken im ad shello nishchat yetze veyire baeder mishshennishchat hare ze yikkaver amar rabbi elazar tivra mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo
Amar rabba asham vadday al asham taluy karamet asham vadday kevan dela tzerich leh la makdesh leh asham taluy mittoch shellibbo nokfo gomer umakdisho
Ella i kashya asham vadday al asham vadday kashya dekatane hare ze yikkaver ema sefa vehabbasar yetze levet hasserefa ha vadday tivra mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo
Rav ashe amar resha dekatane beasham taluy vehabbasar yetze levet hasserefa la kashya mishshum demitchaze kezevach pasul
Nizrak haddam habbasar yeachel veammay ha haveya leh yedia amar rava amar kera vehu lo yada venislach lo veha la haveya leh yedia bishat selicha
Rabbi yose omer afilu haddam bakkos ku lerabbi yose ammay yizzarek ha haveya leh yedia bishat selicha amar rava rabbi yose savar lah kerabbi shimon deamar kol haomed lizarek kezaruk dame
Emar deamar rabbi shimon bemide deomed lizarek aval hay en omed lizarek amri bemareva kasavar rabbi yose kele sharet mekaddeshin bo et happasul battechilla likrav
Asham vadday eno ken ku itmar egla arufa ematay neeseret rav hamnuna amar mechayyim rava amar leachar arifa
Bishlama lerava meidana deitavid bah maase ella lerav hamnuna meematay

a: Amar rabbi yannay gevul shamati bah veshachachti venasvin chavrayya lememar yeridatah lenachal etan osartah
Amar rav hamnuna mena amena lah ditnan hashshochet parat chattat veshor hanniskal veegla arufa rabbi shimon poter vachachamim mechayevin
Bishlama ledidi deamena mechayyim beha peligi rabbi shimon verabbanan derabbi shimon savar shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita
Verabbanan amri shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita ella i amratte leachar arifa ammay patar rabbi shimon shechita reuya hi

Vechi tema savar rabbi shimon egla bishchita keshera vehatnan kasher bappara pasul beegla arufa pasul bappara kasher beegla arufa para bishchita keshera baarifa pesula egla baarifa keshera bishchita pesula
Ishtik levatar dinfak amar may tama la amena leh derabbi shimon savar egla bishchita keshera
Verav hamnuna amar lach la nishtemit tanna denashmeinan egla bishchita keshera detema rabbi shimon hi
Amar rava mena amena lah midditnan egla arufa enah ken ad shello neerfa tetze vetire baeder vei amratte mechayyim ammay tetze vetire baeder ha itasra lah mechayyim
Teni ad shello niret laarifa ema sefa mishshenneerfa tikkaver bimkomah teni mishshenniret laarifa
Im ken ema sefa sheal hassafek baa mittechilla kipra sefekah vehalcha lah vei mechayyim adayin lo kipra sefekah
Tannae hi detanya neemar machshir umchapper bifnim veneemar machshir umchapper bachutz
Ma machshir umchapper haamur bifnim asa bo machshir kimchapper af machshir umchapper haamur bachutz asa machshir kimchapper

Matni rabbi eliezer omer mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom uvchol et sheyyirtze hu haya nikra asham chasidim amru alav al bava ben buta shehaya mitnaddev asham taluy bechol yom chutz meachar yom kipurim yom echad
Amar hammaon hazze ilu hau mannichin li hayiti mevi ella omrim li hamten ad shettikkanes lesafek vachachamim omrim en mevi asham taluy ella al shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat

Chayyave chattaot vaashamot vaddain sheavar alehen yom hakkipurim chayyavin lehavi leachar yom hakkipurim vechayyave ashamot teluyin peturin mi shebba beyado sefek avera beom hakkippurim afilu im chashecha patur shekkol hayyom mechapper

Haishsha sheyyesh aleha chattat haof safek veavar aleha yom hakkippurim chayyevet lehavi leachar yom hakkipurim mippene shehi machsheret leechol bizvachim chattat haof habbaa al hassafek im mishshennimleka noda tikkaver
Gema may tama derabbi eliezer i salka datach chova hi ki mityeda leh ammay mayete chattat ella shema mina nedava hi
Verabbanan ola ushlamim hu deatu beneder undava aval chattat veasham chova ninhu veasham taluy hayenu tama demayete mikkamme demityeda leh lehagen alav dehattora chasa al gufan shel yisrael
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe dilma asham taluy keola ushlamim ma ola ushlamim deatu bechova veatu bindava asham taluy name deate bechova ate name bindava
Amar leh ola ushlamim ikar bindava ketivi asham taluy ikar bechova ketiv
Tane rabbi chiyya kammeh derava
b: Asham taluy ba al hannevela amar leh vehaanan tenan vachachamim omrim eno mevi asham taluy ella al davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat vei rabbi eliezer bindava name ate
Amar leh may tama la matnet zimnin saggiin tenetah kamme mar umannu rabba veamar li ha manni rabbi eliezer hi deamru lo ditnan ella omrim lo hamten ad shettikkanes levet hassafek
Amar rava may tama deamru lo amar kera asher lo teasena bishgaga veashem
Amar rava may tama derabbanan deamri en meviin asham taluy ella al davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat mitzot mitzot mechattat chelev
Ma lehallan shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat af kan davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat

Tanu rabbanan chamishsha ashamot mechapperin asham taluy en mechapper kappara gemura may kaamar amar rav yosef hachi kaamar chamishsha ashamot mechapperin kappara gemura veasham taluy en mechapper kappara gemura
Udla kerabbi eliezer deamar asham taluy ba al hannevela

Ravina amar hachi katane chamishsha ashamot en acher mechapper kapparatan dechi mityeda leh mayete asham taluy acher mechapper kapparato dilchi mityeda leh la mayete keditnan chayyave chattaot vaashamot vaddain sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim chayyavin lehavi achar yom hakkippurim chayyave ashamot teluyin peturin

Chayyave chattaot vaashamot vaddain ku katane chayyave chattaot vaashamot vaddain sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim chayyavin lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim chayyave ashamot teluyin peturin menahane mile

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi amme amar rabbi chanina amar kera vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot bene yisrael umippishehem lechol chattotam chataim dumya difshaim ma peshaim delav bene korban af chataim delav bene korban mechapper aval chataim bene korban la mechappar

Amar leh abbaye veha ki ketiv haden kara besair hannaase bifnim hu dichtiv dela mechappar al averot demitzva yedua aval sair hammishtalleach dimchappar al averot demitzva yedua ema lach afilu al chataim divne korban ninhu mechappar

Ella amar abbaye mehacha vehitvadda alav et kol aonot bene yisrael veet kol pishehem lechol chattotam chataim dumya difshaim ma peshaim delav bene korban af chataim delav bene korban aval chataim divne korban ninhu la mechappar umaateh kera besair hammishtalleach lememra deal chataim divne korban ninhu la mechappar
Amar leh rav dimi mimmay dehane peshaim lav bene korban ninhu dilma hane divne korban ninhu keditnan arbaa meviin al hazzadon kishgaga

Itmar name ki ata ravin amar rabbi yose amar resh lakish vehitvadda alav et kol aonot bene yisrael veet kol pishehem lechol chattotam chataim dumya difshaim ma peshaim delav bene korban mechapper af chataim delav bene korban mechapper aval chataim divne korban la mechappar

Amar abbaye ana name mehaden kera amri veakshi li rav dimi mimmay dehane peshaim delav bene korban ninhu dilma hanach divne korban ninhu keditnan arbaa meviin al hazzadon kishgaga amar leh ravin rov peshaim lav bene korban amar leh mide rov ketiv
Ella amar abbaye meresheh dikra vehitvadda alav et kol aonot bene yisrael vetanya aonot ellu zedonot vechen hu omer aonah bah
Veet kol pishehem lechol chattotam kol lema li leakshoye lifshaim ma peshaim delav bene korban af chataim delav bene korban aval chataim divne korban ninhu la mechappar
Chayyave ashamot teluyin ku menahane mile amar rabbi elazar amar kera mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai vego chet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom yom hakkippurim mechapper
Amar rav tachlifa avuh derav huna bar tachlifa mishshemeh derava kadmayeta name la tete

a: Lemifshetah la midderav dimi vela middeabbayye
Ella meha chet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom yom hakkippurim mechapper uminah chet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom hu deom hakkippurim mechapper aval deyada beh la mechappar
Veamar rav tachlifa avuh derav huna mishshemeh derava chayyave malkiyyot sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim chayyav peshita may shena mechayyave chattaot vaashamot vaddain
Salka datach amena hatam mamona hu aval hacha degufa hu ema la ka mashma lan
Veha anan tenan hoda velo hoda ase velo taase
La kashya ha deatro beh ha dela atro beh
Ella meatta siman yoledet metzora nazir sota beegla
Safek yoledet sheavar aleha yom hakkippurim la tayete deha kappar aleh yom hakkippurim dechet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom hu amar rav hoshaya lechol chattotam velo lechol tumotam
Ulrabbi shimon ben yochay deamar yoledet chotet hi may ika lememar yoledet ki ka mayete korban leishteroye baachilat kadashim hu vela lechappara metya
Amar rav ashe af anan name tenena haishsha sheyyesh aleha chattat haof safek veavar aleha yom hakkippurim chayyevet lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim mippene shemachshartah leechol bizvachim
Ella meatta sefek metzora sheavar yom hakkippurim la mayete deha avar aleh yom hakkippurim dechet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom hu amar rabbi oshaya lechol chattotam velo lechol tumotam
Veha amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan al shiva devarim negaim baim siman metzora ki mayete lav lechappara mayete ella leishteroye baachilat kadashim hu
Ella meatta sefek nazir sheavar alav yom hakkippurim la mayete korban deha kappar yom hakkippurim dechet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom hu amar rabbi oshaya lechol chattat velo lechol tuma
Ulrabbi elazar ben hakkappar deamar nazir chote hu may ika lememar nazir ki ka mayete korban lav lechappara mayete leishteroye baachilat kadashim hu
Ella meatta sefek sota sheavar aleha yom hakkippurim la tayete deha kappar alah yom hakkippurim dechet sheeno makkir bo ella hammakom amar rabbi hoshaya lechol chattotam velo lechol tumotam
Amar abbaye boel makkir bo rava amar sota ki metya levarer aon ka atya
Ella meatta egla arufa sheavar aleha yom hakkippurim vechu amar abbaye horeg makkir rava amar amar kera velaaretz lo yechuppar laddam asher shuppach bah vego
Rav pappa amar amar kera kapper leammecha yisrael vego reuya kappara zo shettechapper al yotze mitzrayim

Hashta deamratte chet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom yom hakkippurim mechapper ema ki mityeda leh batar yom hakkippurim name la mayete chattat amar rabbi zeera la matzet amratte dichtiv kera yedia gabbe chattat vegabbe nesi vegabbe tzibbur
Tzerichi dei ketav kera gabbe yachid hava amena kullehon miyyachid la atan deika lemifrach ma leyachid shekkol korbano nekeva
Nichtov gabbe nasi venayete hanach minnasi
Yachid minnasi la ate deika lemifrach ma lenasi shekken en bishmiat kol tomar beyachid shekken yeshno bishmiat kol
Vetzibbur minnasi la ate deika lemifrach ma lenasi shekken bekorbano nekeva
Nichtov gabbe tzibbur venayete yachid venasi minah ika lemifrach ma letzibbur shekken en chayyavin ella al heelem davar im shiggat maase
Mechada yedia la atya tete chada yedia mittarte la nichtov yedia gabbe yachid vetete minnasi vetzibbur
Ika lemifrach ma lenasi vetzibbur shekken enan bishmiat kol tomar beyachid sheyyeshno bishmiat kol
La nichtov kera yedia gabbe tzibbur vetete midia deyachid venasi ika lemifrach ma leyachid venasi shekken yesh bekorbanan nekeva tomar betzibbur sheen bekorbanan nekeva
La nichtov gabbe nasi vetete midia deyachid vetzibbur may parchatte i mishshum deenan bishmiat hakkol yachid yochiach deeno bishmiat hakkol
Vei mishshum deyesh bechol korbano nekeva tzibbur yochiach deen bekorbanan nekeva ad deit lehon yedia la michayyav lema li dichtiv yedia gabbe nasi
Im eno inyan legufeh deha atya miyyachid vetzibbur tenehu inyan lehecha demityeda leh batar yom hakkippurim demayete chattat
Abbaye amar i dela ketiv yedia gabbe nasi miyyachid vetzibbur la ate mishshum deika lemifrach ma leyachid vetzibbur shekken en asuyin lehishtannot tomar
b: Benasi sheasuy lehishtannot
Ella amar abbaye mehacha mikkede mitzot mitzot yalfi mehadade

Kevan deyalfi mehadade lema li dichtiv shalosh yediot gabbe yachid vegabbe nasi vegabbe tzibbur im eno inyan legufehen deha gamri lehon mitzot mitzot tenehu inyan hecha demityeda leh batar yom hakkipurim hu demayete chattat

Ema ki mityeda leh batar yom kippurim hu demayete chattat mishshum deom hakkippurim lav al haden chet ka ate aval asham taluy deal haden chet kaate ema hachi name demikappar dechi mityeda leh levatar deka mayete asham taluy la mayete chattat

Amar rava amar kera o hoda elav mikkol makom hashta deamar ki mityeda leh mayete chattat asham taluy lamma ba amar rabbi zera sheim met met belo aon matkef lah rava met mita memareket ella amar rava lehagen alav min hayyisurim
Chattat haof habba al hassafek amar rav vechiper i hachi ammay tikkaver
Lefi sheenah mishtammeret emat lo mishtammeret i meikara chayya haveya i levassof kamnattar lah
Ella matnitin benoda lah delo yalda uvdin hu demutteret bahanaa umay tikkaver midderabbanan
Vechi itmar derav al haishsha shehevia chattat haof besafek im ad shello nimleka noda lah sheyyalda vadday taase vadday shemmimmin shehevia al lo hoda mevia al hoda
Im mishshennimleka noda sheyyalda amar rav mazze damah umotze damah vechippera umutteret baachila rabbi yochanan amar asura baachila gezera shemma yomru chattat haof habbaa al hassafek neechelet
Tane levi kevateh derav chattat haof habbaa al hassafek im mishshennimleka noda sheyyalda vadday mazze damah umotze damah vechippera umutteret baachila

Tanya keoteh derabbi yochanan chattat haof habbaa al hassafek im ad shello nimleka noda lah shello yalda tetze lechullin o timmacher lachavertah im ad shello nimleka noda lah sheyyalda vadday taase vadday shemmimmin shemmevia al lo hoda mevia al hoda
Im mishshennimleka noda sheyyalda asura afilu bahanaa sheal hassafek baa mittechillatah kippera sefekah vehalcha lah
Matni hammafrish shene selaim leasham velakach bahen shene elim leasham im haya echad mehen yafe shette selaim yikrav laashamo vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava
Lakach bahen shene elim lechullin echad yafe shette selaim veechad yafe asara zuz hayyafe shette selaim yikrav laashamo vehashsheni limilato
Echad leasham veechad lechullin im haya shel asham yafe shette selaim yikrav laashamo vehashsheni limilato veyavi immah sela vechumshah
Gema may meilato dekatane resha vehashsheni limilato
Ilema el asham lememra dechomesh bahade ayil mayete leh vehachtiv veet asher chata min hakkodesh yeshallem veet chamishito yosef alav alma bahade gezelo mayete leh
Veod katane sefa echad leasham veechad lechullin im haya shel asham yafe shette selaim yikrav laashamo vehashsheni limilato veyavi immah sela vechumshah alma chomesh bahade gezelo mayete leh

Ella meilato may deithani mehekdesh veyeshno mishte selaim deafreshinnun leasham velakach bahen shene elim lechullin deyafe shette selaim makrev leh el asham veyafe asara zuz yahev leh lemay deithani mehekdesh dehave leh gezelo vechumsho umay meilato gezelo
Bemay okemta limilato deresha gezelo ema sefa echad leasham veechad lechullin im haya shel asham yafe shette selaim yikrav laashamo vehashsheni limila veyavi immah sela vechumshah
Alma meilato el asham resha kare leh limilato gezelo

a: Sefa kare leh limilato el asham
Resha dehave leh ayil rubban keren vechumsho karu leh limilato gezelo sefa dela have ayil dizvan keren vachomesh kare leh el asham meilato veyavi immah sela vechumshah
Bae rav menashsheya bar gadda bechinus chumshin mahu sheyyitkapper
Mi amrinan im timtze lomar adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh mishshum dekatarach kammeh aval hacha dela katarach la mitkapper
O dilma im timtze lomar en adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh mishshum dela afresheh aval haden kinus chumshin deafresheh ika lememar mitkapper deibi lehu adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh o la
Ta shema hammafrish shene selaim leasham velakach bahen shene elim leasham haya echad mehen yafe shette selaim yikrav laashamo vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava
May lav dizvan bearbea ayil ushvach deshave temanya ushma minah adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh la hacha vemay askinan deozel roe gabbeh
Ta shema lakach ayil besela ufittemo veheemido al shettayim kasher shema minah adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh la pittemo shane deha chasar leh temanya
Ta shema lakach ayil besela vahare hu bishtayim kasher hacha name kesheppittemo
I hachi hayenu resha resha dizvan bearbea veashbecheh bearbea acharine dechasar leh temanya sefa dizvan ayil bearbea veashbecheh bitlata veshave temanya
I hachi ema sefa yeshallem sela ha chasar leh shiva may yeshallem tashlum desela
Vei sevira leh deen adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh ki yahev tashlum desela may have ayil ben shette selaim baenan veleka leolam kasavar adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh
I hachi tashlum desela lo yitten hayenu tama dekayahev tashlumin desela gezera shemma yomru ayil pachut mishte selaim mechapper
May have alah ta shema bishat hafrasha yafe sela bishat kappara yafe shette selaim lo yatza
Bae rabbi elazar adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh o lo amar rabbi yochanan kamma shanim gadal ze benenu velo shama halacha zo mimmenni
Mikkelal deamrah rabbi yochanan in veal hada amrah ditnan velad toda utmuratah vechen hammafrish todato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha en teuna lechem
Rav chananya mishshemeh derabbi yochanan lo shanu ella leachar kappara devalad en taun lechem
Aval lifne kappara taun lechem alma kasavar mitkapper bishvach hekdesh
Bae rabbi elazar baale chayyim nidchin o lo amar rabbi yochanan hare kamma shanim gadal ze benenu velo shama halacha zo mimmenni
Mikkelal derabbi yochanan amrah in deamar rabbi yochanan behema shel shene shuttafin hikdish chetzyah vechazar velakach chetzyah vehikdishah kedosha veenah kereva veosa temura utmuratah kayyotze bah
Shema minah telat shema minah baale chayyim nidchin ushma minah kedushshat damim medacha ushma minah yesh dichuy bedamim
Bae rabbi elazar huzlu telaim baolam mahu mi amrinan mivchar nidrechem baenan veha ika o dilma kesef shekalim baenan veleka

Amar rabbi yochanan kamma shanim gadalnu bevet hammidrash velo shamanu halacha zo vela vehaamar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi shimon ben yochay mippene ma lo natna tora kitzva bimchussere chappara shemma yuzlu telaim veen lahen takkana leechol bekadashim ema lo limadnu halacha zo
Veha rabbi zera bar adda mahdar talmudeh kol telatin yomin kammeh ema lo nitbakkesha halacha zo mimmennu bevet hammidrash
Gufa amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay mippene ma lo nittena kitzva bimchussere kappara shemma yuzlu telaim veen lahem takkana leechol bekadashim

Matkef lah abbaye ella meatta chattat chelev yinnaten lah kitzva dilchappara atya velav leishteroye baachilat kadashim hu matkef lah rava ella meatta asham nazir leheve leh kitzva dilvattala hu deate deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay en lecha davar shehu ba levattala ella asham nazir bilvad kashya
b: Matni hammafrish chattato vamet lo yeviennu beno tachtav lo yeviennu mechet el chet afilu hifrish al chelev sheachal emesh lo yevienna al chelev sheachal hayyom shenneemar korbano al chattato ad sheyehe korbano leshem chattato
Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan korbano bekorbano hu yotze veeno yotze bekorban aviv

Yachol lo yetze bekorban aviv bivhema shehifrish aviv min hakkalla al hachamura o min hachamura al hakkalla aval yotze bekorban shehifrish aviv min hakkalla al hakkalla o min hachamura al hachamura talmud lomar korbano bekorbano hu yotze veeno yotze bekorbano shel aviv
Yachol lo yetze bekorban aviv bivhema shehifrish afilu min hakkalla al hakkalla o min hachamura al hachamura shehare en megalleach neziruto al behema shehifrish aviv

Aval yotze bemaot shehifrish aviv afilu min hakkalla al hachamura o min hachamura al hakkalla shehare adam megalleach nezirotav al maot shehifrish aviv bizman shehen setumim velo bizman shehen meforashin talmud lomar korbano bekorbano hu yotze veen yotze bekorban aviv

Yachol lo yetze afilu bemaot shehifrish afilu min hakkalla al hakkalla o min hachamura al hachamura aval yotze bekorban shehifrish leatzmo afilu min hachamura al hakkalla o min hakkalla al hachamura talmud lomar korbano al chattato ad sheyehe leshem chattat

Yachol lo yetze bekorban atzmo bivhema shehifrish leatzmo afilu min hakkalla al hakkalla o min hachamura al hachamura shekken im hifrish behema al hachelev veheviah al haddam al haddam veheviah al hachelev shehare lo maal velo kiper
Aval yotze bemaot shehifrish leatzmo min hakkalla al hakkalla umin hachamura al hachamura o min hachamura al hakkalla umin hakkalla al hachamura
Shekken im hifrish leatzmo maot al hachelev vehevian al haddam al haddam vehevian al hachelev shehare maal vechiper talmud lomar korbano al chattato ad sheyehe korbano leshem cheto
May lo maal velo kiper targemah rav shemuel bar shimi kammeh derav pappa hachi kaamar kevan dela matze mael kappore name la mechappar hoil vechach la matze meshanne
Aval maot kevan dei meshanne mael umayete korban meila ema battechilla name mayete ka mashma lan
Matni meviin mehekdesh kisba seira mehekdesh seira kisba umehekdesh kisba usira torin uvne yona umehekdesh torin uvne yona asirit haefa
Ketzad hifrish lechisba o lisira heeni yavi of heeni yavi asirit haefa hifrish laasirit haefa heeshir yavi of heeshir yavi kisba usira
Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan mechattato mechattato al chattato ma talmud lomar
Minnayin atta omer shemmeviin mehekdesh kisba seira umehekdesh seira kisba umehekdesh kisba usira torim uvne yona umehekdesh torin uvne yona asirit haefa
Ketzad hifrish lechisba velisira veheeni yavi of heeni yavi asirit haefa hifrish asirit haefa veheeshir yavi of heeshir yavi kisba o seira
Hifrish kisba o seira venistaavu yavi bidmehen of hifrish of venistaev lo yavi bedamav asirit haefa sheen laof pidon
Lachen neemar mechattato al chattato

Veitzterich lemichtav mechattato gabbe kisba o seira veitzterich lemichtav gabbe of dei ketiv kera gabbe hekdesh kisba o seira hava amena hifrish kisba ki miane mehalen maot nachalinun al of denayete of dechisba vaof tarvayehu mine damim ninhu

Aval asirit haefa delav mine dedamim ninhu i la ketiv kera mechattato gabbe of hava amena ki mafresh maot lekino umiane la mayete asirit haefa delav mine dedamim hu ella mayete asirit haefa min beteh vehalen maot deafresh yippelu lindava ahachi hadar ketiv kera mechattato gabbe of lememra demehekdesh deof name mayete asirit haefa
Vehachi kaamar ki mafrish laasirit haefa veaddemayete heeshir nosef alehon venayete of heeshir nosef alehon venayete kisba o seira
Umay tama ketiv al chattato gabbe asirit haefa dei ketav al chattato gabbe of hava amena ki mafresh maot lekino veheeshir hu demosef alehon umayete kisba o seira detarvayehu mine damim ninhu

Aval hifrish maot laasirit haefa veheeshir halen demafresh i la heeshir tuva nayete of veim heeshir tuva nayete kisba o seira vehalen maot deafresh yippelu lindava ahachi ketiv kera behaden chattat baashirut vedallut mechattato vegabbe dalle dallut al chattato lemidrash kidamrinan
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya metamme mikdash ashir shehifrish ken

a: Lechivsato veheeni hoil venidcha yiddache
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua shema mina telat shema minah baale chayyim nidchim ukdushshat damim nidcha
Vedachuy meikara have dachuy
Metiv rav ukva bar chama hammafrish nekeva lefischo kodem happesach tire ad shettistaev vetimmacher veyavi bedameha pesach yalda zachar yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyavi bedamav pesach
Rabbi shimon omer hu atzmo yikrav pesach shema minah baale chayyim enam nidchim
Amri deve rabbi oshaya ki amrinan lerabbanan derabbi shimon sevira leh baale chayyim enan nidchin
Vehagrala enah meakkevet detanya met echad mehen mevi chavero shello behagrala divre rabbi shimon
Alma kasavar baale chayyim enan nidchin vehagrala enah meakkevet
Amar rav chisda en hakkinin mitparshot ella i bilkichat bealim i baasiyyat kohen
Amar rav shimi bar ashe may tama derav chisda dichtiv velakcha shette torim vego veasa hakkohen vego o bilkichat bealim o baasiyyat kohen
Metivi veasahu chattat haggoral osehu chattat veen hashshem osehu chattat veen kohen ose chattat
Sheyyachol vahalo din hu uma bimkom shello kidesh haggoral kidesh hashshem mekom shekiddesh haggoral eno din sheyekaddesh hashshem
Talmud lomar veasahu chattat haggoral osehu chattat veen hashshem osehu chattat
Katane shem dumya degoral ma goral lav bilkicha velav baasiyya af hashshem name lav bilkicha velav baasiyya

Amar rav hachi kaamar uma bimkom shello kidesh haggoral bilkichat bealim uvaasiyyat hakkohen kidesh hashshem i bilkichat bealim i baasiyyat kohen kan shekkiddesh haggoral shello bilkicha veshello baasiyya eno din shekiddesh hashshem i bilkicha i baasiyya
Talmud lomar veasahu chattat haggoral osehu chattat veen hashshem osehu chattat
Metivi metamme mikdash ani shehifrish maot lekino veheeshir
Amar ellu lechattati veellu leolati mosif umevi chovato middeme chattato veen mosif umevi middeme olato
Veha hacha deleka la lekicha vela asiyya vekatane mevi chovato middeme chattato vela middeme olato
Amar rav sheshet vetisbera matnita metakkanta hi dekatane veheeshir vehaamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya metamme mikdash ashir shehevi korban ani lo yatza
Ella may it lach lememar shekkevar amar mishsheat aniyyuto hachi name shekkevar amar mishsheat hafrashato
Ulrabbi chagga amar rabbi oshaya deamar yatza may ika lememar teni veachar kach lakach veamar
Metivi metzora ani shehevi korban ashir yatza ashir shehevi korban ani lo yatza teuvta derabbi chagga amar rabbi oshaya
Amar lach shane gabbe metzora demaet rachamana zot

I hachi afilu metzora ani name shehevi korban ashir lo yatza laye ha ahdereh kera torat vehatanya torat lerabbot metzora ani shehevi korban ashir yatza yachol afilu ashir shehevi korban ani sheyyatza talmud lomar zot
Velelaf mineh amar kera veim dal hu veen yado masseget metzora hu deashir shehevi korban ani hu delo yatza aval metamme mikdash ashir shehevi korban ani yatza
Matni rabbi shimon omer kevasim kodmin et haizzim bechol makom yachol mippene shehen muvcharim mehem talmud lomar veim keves yavi korbano lechattat melammed sheshshenehem shekulin
Torin kodmin livne yona bechol makom yachol mippene shehen muvcharim mehen talmud lomar tor uvne uven yona o tor lechattat melammed sheshshenehem shekulin

Haav kodem laem bechol makom yachol mippene shekkibud haav kodem al kibud haem talmud lomar ish immo veaviv tirau melammed sheshshenehem shekulin aval amru chachamim haav kodem laem bechol makom mippene shehu veimmo chayyavin bichvod aviv
Vechen betalmud tora im zacha habben lifne harav harav kodem et haav bechol makom mippene shehu veaviv chayyavin bichvod rabbo
Gema tanu rabbanan arba tzeochot tzavecha azara tzeocha rishona hotziu mikan vene eli chofni ufinchas shettimu et hahechal
Tzeocha sheniyya pitchu shearim veyikkanes yochanan ben nidbay talmido shel pinkay vimalle kereso mikkodshe shamayim amru al ben nidbay shehaya ochel arbaim sea gozalot
b: Bekinuach seuda amru kol yamav lo haya notar baazara
Tzeocha shelishit seu shearim rashechem veyikkanes elishama ben pichay talmido shel pinchas vishammesh bichhunna gedola
Tzeocha reviit pitchu shearim vehotziu yissashchar ish kefar barkay shemmechabbed atzmo umvazze kodshe shamayim may have aved hava karech shirae al yedeh vehave aved avoda
May selika leh yannay malka umalketa hao yatvin malka amar gadya yae umalketa amra imra yae amaru neshayeleh leyissasochar ish kefar barkay dechohen gadol hu vekim leh kedera

Shayeluhu amar lehu i gadya yae yisak litmida bahade deamar achvi bideh amar lehon malka hoil veachvi bideh kutzu lideh deyammina yehev shuchda katzuh lideh semala shema malka amar liktzeuh name lideh deyammina amar rav yosef berich rachamana deshakleh leyissaschar ish kefar barkay lematrafseh
Amar rav ashe vela hava tene leh ditnan kevasim kodmin laizzim bechol makom yachol mippene shemmuvcharin talmud lomar veim keves melammed sheshshenehen shekulin keachat
Ravina amar afilu mikra name la kera dichtiv im keves im ez
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam shenneemar vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich al tikre banecha ella bonayich
Hadaran alach hammevi asham uslika lah massechet keritut

a: Kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom moalin bahen shechatan baddarom vekibel daman batztzafon batztzafon vekibel daman baddarom
Shachat bayyom vezarak ballayela ballayela vezarak bayyom o sheshshechatan chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo moalin bahen
Kelal amar rabbi yehoshua kol shehaya lah sheat heter lakkohanim en moalin bah vechol shello haya lah sheat heter lakkohanim moalin bah
Ezo hi shehaya lah sheat heter lakkohanim shellana veshennitmea vesheyyatza
Veezo hi shello haya lah sheat heter lakkohanim shennishchata chutz lizmannah chutz limkomah veshekkiblu pesulin vezarku et dama
Gema katane kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom moalin bahen peshita mishshum dishchitatan baddarom appekinun mide meila
Itzterich salka datach amena hoil veamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan kadashim shemmetu yatzu mide meila devar tora hachi name kodshe kadashim legabbe darom kema dechankinun dame
Ka mashma lan kadashim shemmetu la chazu kelal aval darom nehi deeno rauy lekodshe kadashim aval rauy hu lekadashim kallim
Lema li lemitne kol hane

Tzerichi i tena shechatan baddarom vekibel daman batztzafon hacha deit behu meila mishshum dekabbala batztzafon hu aval shechatan batztzafon vekibel daman baddarom hoil vekibel baddarom hu nafek mide meila
Vei tena hay hava amena yemama zeman hakrava hu aval shechatah ballayela vezarak bayyom layela lav zeman hakrava vehay deshachet ballayela denafek mide meila

Vei tena shechatah ballayela hava amena hoil vekibbel dama bayyom it bah meila aval shechatan bayyom vezarak daman ballayela hoil velav zeman hakrava hu keman dechankinun dame vela it behu meila kamashma lan
Chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo lemay chazu
Hoil umratztzin lefigulin
b: Ibaya lehu i alu mahu sheyyerdu rabba amar im alu yerdu rav yosef amar im alu lo yerdu
Alliba derabbi yehuda la tibe lach dechulle alma la peligi deim alu yerdu ki peligi alliba derabbi shimon
Rav yosef kerabbi shimon rabba amar lach ad kan la kaamar rabbi shimon ella bannitanin lematta shennetanan lemala o bannitanin lemala shennetanan lematta
Ulolam dishchatan vekibbel daman batztzafon aval hacha kevan dishchatan baddarom keman dechankinun dame
Tenan kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom moalin bahen bishlama lerav yosef nicha ella lerabba kashya may moalin bahen midderabbanan
May ika ben deorayeta lerabbanan deorayeta meshallemin chomesh derabbanan la
Umi ika meila midderabbanan in deamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan kadashim shemmetu yatzu mide meila devar tora alma middeorayeta la it lehon bidrabbanan it behon hachi name midderabbanan
Lema tenena leha deulla amar rabbi yochanan af al gav ditnena itzterich deulla salka datach amena hacha la bedilin minnehon
Aval kadashim shemmetu hoil uvdilin minnehon ema afilu meila midderabbanan la ka mashma lan
Metu name tenena hannehene min hachattat keshehi chayya lo maal ad sheyyifgom uchshehi meta kevan denehena kol shehu maal
Salka datach

a: Amena chattat hoil ulchappara ka atya la bedilin minah aval kadashim hoil velav lechappara kaate bedili minnehon velet behu meila ka mashma lan
Vechattat shemmeta mi it bah meila vehatnan chattaot hammetot umaot haholchot leyam hammelach lo nehenin velo moalin
Amri chattaot hammetot bechayyehen bedilin minnehon leappoke hecha demechayyim dela bedilin mineh
Etiveh rav yosef lerabba chada miggo chada vachada miggo chada
Vechullan en metammeim begadim abbet habbelia umoalin bahen
Chutz mechattat haof sheasa lematta kemaase chattat haof leshem chattat
Vekatane ilaveh kol shehaya pesulo bakkodesh eno metamme begadim abbet habbelia vechol shello haya pesulo bakkodesh metamme begadim abbet habbelia
Vekatane kol shehaya pesulo bakkodesh im alu lo yerdu teuvta derabba teuvta
Veha difligi bah rabba verav yosef peshita leh lerabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar olat bamat yachid shehichnisah lifnim
b: Kelatuha mechitzot lechol davar
Bae rabbi elazar olat bamat yachid shehichnisah shennifsela alu mahu sheyyerdu
Middekamibaya leh lachada mikkelal deidach peshita leh i kerabba i kidrav yosef
Chada miggo chada kamibaya leh
Ad kan la kaamar rabba hatam im alu yerdu mechitza ketiknah
Pasla shello ketiknah lo pasla
O dilma afilu lerav yosef deamar im alta lo tered mechitza ketiknah kalta shello ketiknah la kalta teku
Amar rav gidel amar rav zerikat pigul eno motzi mide meila bekodshe kadashim veeno mevi lide meila bekadashim kallim
Yetev abbaye vekaamar lah leha shemata etiveh rav pappa leabbaye hashshochet et hattoda lifnim velachmah chutz lachoma lo kiddesh et hallechem
Shechatah ad shello karmu paneha battannur vaafilu karmu kullan chutz meachat mehen lo kadash hallechem shechatah chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah kadash hallechem
Alma pigul mayete lah lide meila ishtik
Ki ata lekammeh derabbi abba amar leh bizrika
Amar leh rav ashe lerava veha amar ulla kometz pigul sheheelo legabbe mizbeach paka pigulo mimmennu
Ukmitza hayenu shechita
Amar leh isura demayete lide figul

a: Veha katane im acherim mevi lide pigul hu atzmo lo kol shekken
Ha name isura demayete lide pigul
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe vehaamar ilfa machaloket bishte avodot
Kegon deamar hareni shochet siman rishon chutz lizmanno vesiman sheni chutz limkomo aval baavoda achat dechulle alma eruve machshavot havay
Hachi name lechi zarek tigalle milta i baavoda achat i bishte avodot
I hachi gabbe toda name ad dezarek
May kadash lipasel devae serefa
Lema mesayya leh happigul leolam moalin bo lav af al gav deizrik dam umsayya leh
La delo zarak haddam i delo zarak haddam may lememra
Ella leolam dezarek vechi tanya hahi beola i beola peshita degavoha hi kullah
b: Veod dekatane sefa lan damah af al pi shechazar uzrako moalin bo
I amratte bishlama bechattat shappir
Ella i amratte beola tzericha lememar
Sefa vadday mesayya leh resha may hoil umsayya leh sefa mesayya leh name resha
Sefa lav vadday mesayya leh may shena halana dekaaved beyadayim la mahne zerika leappoke mide meila
Machshava la ka aved beyadayim mahne leh zerika leappoke mide meila
Lema ha mesayya leh happigul bekodshe kadashim moalin bo lav af al gav dezarak umsayya leh la delo zarak
Aval zarak may hachi name deen moalin bo ammay katane sefa bekadashim kallim en moalin bo
Liflog beresha velitne lifne zerika moalin bo leachar zerika en moalin bo hahu vadday mesayya leh
Lema hoil umsayya leh sefa mesayya leh name resha kadashim kallim pesika leh hacha la pesika leh
Kelal amar rabbi yehoshua kol shehayeta lah sheat heter lakkohanim en moalin bah vechol shello hayeta lah sheat heter lakkohanim moalin bah
Ezohi shehayeta lah sheat heter lakkohanim shellana veshennitmet vesheyyatzat
Veezohi shello hayeta lah sheat heter lakkohanim shennishchata chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damah
Amar leh bar kappara levar pedat ben achoti ree ma atta shoaleni lemachar bevet hammidrash heter shechita shaninu

a: O heter zerika shaninu o heter achila shaninu chizkiyya amar heter shechita shaninu rabbi yochanan amar heter achila shaninu
Amar rabbi zera la dayeka matnitin dela kechizkiyya udla kerabbi yochanan
Tenan shellana veshennitmet vesheyyatzat lav delan dam vekatane en moalin bo
Ushma minah heter zerika shaninu
La delan basar aval dam izderik mishshum hachi katane en moalin bo
Tenan veezo hi shello hayeta lah sheat hakkosher lakkohanim shennishchata chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damah
Hechi dame ilema dizrakuhu pesulin vekibbeluhu pesulin lema li ad deika tarte
Ella lav dekibbeluhu pesulin uzrakuhu kesherim vekatane moalin bo
Shema minah heter zerika shaninu
Matkef lah rav yosef vei salka datach ika lefalloge hachi ha ditnan hatam
Chattat pesula en damah taun kibus ben shehayeta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela uven shello hayeta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela
I zo hi shehayeta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela shellana veshennitmet o sheyyatza
Ezohi shello hayeta lah sheat hakkosher shennishchata chutz limkomah chutz lizmannah veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damah
Hechi dame ilema dekibbeluhu pesulin vezarku pesulin hu deen damah taun kibus ha kibbeluhu vezarku kesherim damah taun kibus
Keri kan asher yizze middamah velo shekkevar huzza ella lav daveka
b: Hachi name lav daveka amar rav assi im ken lema li lemitne tarte
Ella leolam dimila daveka
Veha ka mashma lan defasul ose shirayim
Af al gav dekibel pasul vezarak vekibel kasher vezarak lav kelum hi may tama deshirayim ninhu
Veha bea mineh resh lakish merabbi yochanan pasul mahu sheyyaase shirayim
Vaamar leh en lecha davar sheyyaase shirayim ella chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo hoil umratztzin lefigulan
May lav bar mippasul la afilu pasul
Veha en lecha katane
Hachi katane en lecha davar sheeno meratztze betzibur veose shirayim ella chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo aval tame deiteh betzibur meshave shirayim
Shear pesulin dela itannun betzibur la meshavin shirayim
Ta shema happigul leolam moalin bo
Lav delo zarak ushma minah heter zerika shaninu
La zarkeh
Umay leolam ha ka mashma lan kidrav gidel deamar rav gidel amar rav zerikat pigul eno motzi mide meila veeno mevi lide meila

a: Ta shema rabbi shimon omer yesh notar shemmoalin bo veyesh notar sheen moalin bo
Ketzad lan lifne zerika moalin leachar zerika en moalin
Katane mihat moalin bo lav dahava shehut lemizrekeh dei bae zarek
Ushma minah heter achila shaninu
La dekabbeleh samuch lishkiat hachamma delo haya shehut lemizrak
Aval haya shehut may hachi name deen moalin
May irya detane lifne zerika litne kodem shekia ulachar shekia
Hachi name katane kodem sheyyerae lizrika ulachar sheyyerae lizrika
Ta shema rabbi shimon omer yesh pigul shemmoalin bo veyesh pigul sheen moalin bo
Ketzad lifne zerika moalin leachar zerika en moalin
Katane mihat lifne zerika moalin bo lav dahava shehut lemizrekeh dei bae zarek vekatane moalin bo ushma minah heter achila shaninu
La dela hava shehut lemizrekeh aval hava shehut lemizrekeh may hachi name dinfak mide meila
May irya detane leachar zerika litne kodem shekia ulachar shekiat hachamma
Hachi name kaamar kodem sheyyerae lizrika leachar sheyyerae lizrika
Ta shema happigul bekodshe kadashim moalin may lav dezarak ushma minah heter achila shaninu la delo zarak
Aval zarak may hachi name deen moalin bo may irya detane bekadashim kallim en moalin bo
Litne kan lifne zerika kan leachar zerika
Ha atya leashmoinan kol leetoye lide meila zerika ketiknah mayete lide meila
Kol leappoke mide meila afilu shello ketiknah name mafka mide meila
b: Matni besar kodshe kadashim sheyyatza lifne zerikat damim
Rabbi eliezer omer moalin bo veen chayyavin alav mishshum pigul venotar vetame
Rabbi akiva omer en moalin bo vechayyavin alav mishshum pigul venotar vetame
Amar rabbi akiva vahare hammafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veachar kach nimtzet harishona vahare shettehen omdot
Lo keshem sheddamah poter et besarah kach hu poter et besar chavertah
Im patar damah et besar chavertah min hammeila din hu sheyyiftor et besar atzmah
Emuray kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim
Rabbi eliezer omer en moalin bahen veen chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame rabbi akiva omer moalin bahen vechayyavin alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame
Gema vehane tarte lema li
Tzerichi dei itmar bekodshe kadashim hava amena beha ka amar rabbi eliezer moalin bo mishshum dizrika ketiknah mappeka mide meila shello ketiknah la mappeka mide meila
Aval leetoye lide meila mode lerabbi akiva daafilu shello ketiknah mayeta lide meila
Vei itmar gabbe kadashim kallim hava amena gabbe kadashim kallim hu deamar rabbi akiva moalin bahen daafilu zerika shello ketiknah mayeta lide meila
Aval kodshe kadashim dilappoke hu shello ketiknah la mappeka mide meila ka mashma lan
Ittemar amar rabbi yochanan ki amar rabbi akiva zerika moelet layyotze sheyyatza miktzato aval yotze kullo lo amar rabbi akiva
Amar leh rav assi lerabbi yochanan kevar limduni chaveray shebbaggola

a: Mechashshevin al haavud veal hassaruf
Veha avud vesaruf la itinun baolam vaafilu hachi katane mechashshevin
Umi amar rav assi hachi ha bea mineh rav assi merabbi yochanan chishev lannishpachin lemachar mahu
Amar leh rabbi zera kevar shanita lanu alal alma hay alal kevan delet beh meshasha lo kibel tuma
Hane nishpachin name kevan dilibud azli behu machshava la mahneya
Ella dekatane al haavud veal hassaruf kashya amar rava ema al haomed leibud veal haomed lisaref
Amar rav pappa la amar rabbi akiva zerika moelet layyotze ella sheyyatza basar aval dam en zerika moelet layyotze
Tanya name hachi shachat bishtika veyatza dam af al pi shechazar uzrako lo asa velo chelum bekodshe kadashim moalin bo bekadashim kallim en moalin bo
Amar rabbi akiva ha ze lema dome
Amar rabbi elazar ki amar rabbi akiva bevat achat aval beze achar ze lo amar rabbi akiva

Tanya amar rabbi shimon keshehalachti lichfar pani metzaani zaken echad veamar li omer haya rabbi akiva zerika moelet layyotze amarti lo hen uchshebbati vehirtzeti devarim lifne chaveray shebbaggalil amru li halo pasul hu heach meratztze al happasul

Uchsheyyatzati vehirtzeti devarim lifne rabbi akiva amar li beni i atta omer ken vahare hammafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veachar kach nimtzet harishona vahare shettehen omdot moalin bishtehen shechatan vahare daman munnach bechosot moalin bishtehen
b: Nizrak dam shel echad mehem i atta mode shekkeshem sheddamah poter et besarah min hammeila af yiftor besar chavertah min hammeila
Im hitztzil besar chavertah min hammeila af al pi shehu pasul din hu sheyyatztzil et besarah
Amar resh lakish mishshum rav oshaya teshuva genuva heshivo rabbi akiva leoto talmid bevat achat in beze achar ze la
Dechevan defasul hu ma li bevat achat ma li beze achar ze
Amar leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish veatta i atta omer ken
Ilu hifrish shette ashamot leachraut veshachat et shenehen vekadam veheela emurin shel echad mehen kodem zerika i atta mode sheim alu yerdu
Vei salka datach chad gufa hu ammay im alu yerdu haamar ulla emure kadashim kallim sheheelan lifne zerikat dam lo yerdu naasa lachmo shel mizbeach
Ishtik amar rabbi yochanan katztzetztinun leraglohi deyanoka
Matni yesh maase damim bekodshe kadashim lehakel ulhachamir uvkadashim kallim kullehu lehachamir
Ketzad kodshe kadashim lifne zerikat damim moalin beemurehen uvabbasar leachar zerikat damim moalin beemurehen veen moalin babbasar
Veal ze veal ze chayyav mishshum pigul notar vetame nimtza maase damim bekodshe kadashim lehakel ulhachamir
Uvkadashim kallim kullan lehachamir ketzad kadashim kallim lifne zerikat damim en moalin lo baemurin velo babbasar leachar zerikat damim moalin baemurin veen moalin babbasar
Al ze veal ze chayyavin alav mishshum pigul notar vetame nimtza maase damim bekadashim kallim kullan lehachamir
Gema katane en moalin babbasar meila hu deleka ha isura ika veammay ha mamona dechohen hu
La kashya mishshum denasev resha moalin nasev sefa en moalin

Ema sefa bekadashim kallim kullehu lehachamir ketzad besar kadashim kallim lifne zerikat damim en moalin bahen uvemurehen veen chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame leachar zerikat damim moalin beemurehen veen moalin babbasar
Meila hu deleka ha isura ika veammay ha mamona divalim hu
Amar rabbi chanina layyotzin verabbi akiva hi
Ki amar rabbi akiva zerika moelet layyotze lisrefa

a: Aval laachila hu delo meratztza
Hadran alach kodshe kadashim
Chattat haof moalin bah mishshehukdesha nimleka huchshera lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvlina
Huzza damah chayyavin alav mishshum pigul notar vetame veen bah meila
Gema katane huchshera lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvlina lipasel in aval letammoye la
Matnitin manni rabbanan hi detanya abba shaul omer tevul yom
b: Techilla lakkodesh
Rabbi meir omer metamme et hakkodesh ufosel et hatteruma vachachamim omrim keshem shehu posel mashke teruma veochle teruma kach hu posel mashke kodesh veochle kodesh
Amar rava leabba shaul maala asu bakkodashim shavinhu rabbanan litvul yom karishon
Lerabbi meir keochel sheni lerabbanan kevan ditval kelash tuma pasul meshave tame la meshave
Huzza damah chayyavin ku meila hu deleka aval isura ika veammay ha mamona dechohanim hu
Amar rabbi chanina layyotzin verabbi akiva hi deamar zerika moelet layyotze delav bat achila hi
Amar rav huna amar rav mitzuy chattat haof eno meakkev detane rav huzza damah
Rav adda bar ahava amar rav mitzuy chattat haof meakkev vetane rav mitza damah
Ta shema vehannishar baddam yimmatze el yesod hammizbeach chattat hi bishlama lerav adda bar ahava hayenu dichtiv vehannishar baddam yimmatze chattat hi ella lerav huna may vehannishar
Kidtanya deve rabbi yishmael sheim nishar umay chattat hi aresha
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe ella meatta gabbe mincha dichtiv vehannoteret hachi name sheim nitotar vechi tema hachi name

a: Vehatanya missoltah umishshamnah al kol levonatah perat shechasra soltah vechasra shamnah vechasra levonatah
Amri hatam ketiv vehannoteret kera yattira ketiv
Metiv avuh dishmuel lerav huna echad chattat haof veechad olat haof shemmelakan umitza daman chutz limkoman pasul veen bo karet chutz lizmannan pigul vechayyavin alav karet katane mihat mitza daman
Hu motev lah vehu mefarek lah litzdadin katane
Gufa tana deve rabbi yishmael sheim nishar baddam
Veha tana deve rabbi yishmael hatam shirayim meakkevin veamar rav pappa mitzuy chattat haof ika benayehu tere tannae vealliba derabbi yishmael

Matni olat haof moalin bah mishshehukdesha nimleka huchshera lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvlina mitza damah chayyavin alav mishshum pigul notar vetame umoalin bah ad shettetze levet haddeshen

Parim hannisrafim usirim hannisrafim moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu nishchatu huchsheru lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvlina huzza daman chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame umoalin bahen bevet haddeshen ad sheyyattich habbasar

Haola moalin bah mishshehukdesha nishchata huchshera lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvlina mishshennizrak damah chayyavin aleha mishshum pigul notar vetame veen moalin baorot aval moalin babbasar ad shettetze levet haddeshen

Chattat veasham vezivche shalme tzibur moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu nishchatu huchsheru lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvlina nizrak daman chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame en moalin babbasar aval moalin beemurehen ad sheyyetzu levet haddeshen

Shette hallechem moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu karmu battannur huchsheru lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvlina velishchot alehen et hazzevach nizrak daman shel kevasim chayyavin alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame veen bahen meila
Lechem happanim moalin bo mishshehukdesha karam battannur huchshar lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim ulhissader al gabbe hashshulchan
Karvu habbazikin chayyavin alav mishshum pigul notar vetame veen bo meila
Hammenachot moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu kadshu bichli huchsheru lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvlina
Karav hakkometz chayyavin alav mishshum pigul notar vetame veen moalin bashshirayim aval moalin bakkometz ad sheyyetze levet haddeshen
Gema itmar hannehene meefer tappuach sheal gabbe hammizbeach rav amar en moalin bo verabbi yochanan amar moalin bo
Lifne terumat haddeshen kulle alma la peligi demoalin bo ki peligi leachar terumat haddeshen
Rav amar en moalin bo hare naasa mitzvato verabbi yochanan amar kevan dichtiv velavash hakkohen middo vad vego kevan ditzrich levigde chehunna bikdushsheteh kae
Tenan moalin bahen ad shettetze levet haddeshen kashya lerav amar lecha rav ad shetterae levet haddeshen
b: Metivi vechullan sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach lo yachazir vechen gachelet sheppaka meal gabbe hammizbeach lo yachazir ha al gabbe hammizbeach yachazir
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan nicha ella lerav kashya amar lecha rav shane gachelet deit bah meshasha
Ika deamar lah lehach gisa tama mishshum gachelet deit bah meshasha ha efer delet beh meshasha afilu legabbe mizbeach en moalin bo bishlama lerav nicha ella lerabbi yochanan kashya
Amar lach rabbi yochanan hu haddin daafilu efer vehayenu tama dekatane gachelet kaate leashmoinan daafilu gachelet deit bah meshasha ki paka meal gabbe hammizbeach lo yachazir
Itmar hannehene mibbesar kodshe kadashim lifne zerikat damim veemure kadashim kallim leachar zerikat damim rav amar ma shennehena yippelu lindava velevi amar yavi davar shekkullo lammizbeach
Tanya keoteh delevi meila zo lehechan holechet hallemedin lifne chachamim omrim yavi davar shekkullo lammizbeach may nihu ketoret

Tanya keoteh derav hannehene middeme chattat umiddeme asham ad shello karva chattato yosif veyavi chattato vead shello karva ashamo yosif veyavi ashamo karav chattato yelchu leyam hammelach kevar karav ashamo yippelu lindava

Hannehene mikkodshe kadashim lifne zerikat damim veemure kadashim kallim leachar zerikat damim ma shennehena yippelu lindava kol korbenot hammizbeach lammizbeach korbenot kodshe bedek habbayit levedek habbayit korbenot tzibbur lenidvat tzibbur

Ha gufah kashya ad shello karva chattato yosif veyavi chattato mishshekkarva chattato yelchu leyam hammelach vekatane kol korbenot hammizbeach lammizbeach vela shena deikappur bealim vela shena hecha dela ikappur
Resha rabbi shimon hi deamar kol chattat shekkipru bealeha tamut

a: Vesefa rabbanan amar rav geviha deve chetil lerav ashe hachi amar abbaye resha rabbi shimon vesefa rabbanan
Amar rava hakkol modim sheim nehena mibbesar kodshe kadashim shennitma kodem zerika umeemuray kadashim kallin leachar sheheelan defatur
Peshita may ka mafsed
Mahu detema besar kodshe kadashim shennitma it leh mitzvat serefa lechohanim emure kadashim kallin ika mitzva lehappoche betzinora ka mashma lan dela
Amar rava ha deamratte kevar karva chattat yelchu leyam hammelach hane mile deityeda leh kamme kappara aval leachar kappara yippelu lindava may tama en mafrishin mittechilla leibud
Matni hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim moalin bahem mishshehukdeshu
Kiddeshan bichli huchshar lipasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvlina vechayyavin alav mishshum notar umishshum tame ufigul en bah
Ze hakkelal kol sheyyesh lo mattirin en chayyavin alav mishshum pigul venotar vetame ad sheyyakrivu mattirin
Vechol sheen lo mattirin kevan shekkidesh bichli chayyavin alav mishshum notar vetame ufigul en bah
b: Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan yachol en chayyavin mishshum tuma ella bedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin
Vedin hu uma pigul shehu bidia achat vekorbano kavua velo huttar mikkelalo en chayyavin ella al davar sheyyesh lo mattirin
Tuma shehi bishte yediot vekorbano ole veored vehuttera mikkelalah eno din shello yehe chayyav ella al davar sheyyesh lo mattirin
Talmud lomar emor alehem ledorotechem kol ish asher yikrav mikkol zarachem vego bechol hakkodashim hakkatuv medabber yachol yehu chayyavin alehen miyyad talmud lomar asher yikrav
Amar rabbi elazar vechi yesh nogea shehu chayyav ha ketzad kol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin eno chayyav ad sheyyikrevu mattirin vechol davar sheen lo mattirin eno chayyav ad sheyyikdash bichli
Hadran alach chattat haof
Velad chattat utmurat chattat vechattat shemmetu bealeha yamutu
Vesheibra shenatah vesheavda venimtzet baalat mum im mishshekkipru habbealim tamut veenah osa temura velo nehenin velo moalin

a: Veim ad shello kipru habbealim tire ad shettistaev vetimmacher veyikchu bedameha acheret veose temura umoalin bah
Gema may shena resha dela ka mipalgi umay shena sefa deka mipalgi
Resha pesika leh sefa la pesika leh
Ha tena leh gabbe temura tena hatam mishshum temura tena hacha mishshum meila
Matni hammafrish maot linziruto lo nehenin velo moalin mippene shehen reuyin lavo kullan shelamim
Met vehau lo maot setumin yippelu lindava maot meforashim deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach lo nehenin velo moalin
Deme ola yaviu ola umoalin bahen deme shelamim yaviu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veen teunin lechem
Gema matkef lah resh lakish velitne name hammafrish maot lekinim
Lo nehenin velo moalin mippene shehen reuyin lehavi torin shello higgia zemannan uvne yona sheavar zemannan
Amar rava amra tora bemaot setumin have shelamim amra tora have torin shello higgia zemannan enan reuyin lammizbeach
Matni rabbi shimon omer haddam kal battechilla vechamur besofo nesachin chomer bitchillatan vekal besofan
Dam bitchillato en moalin yatza lenachal kidron moalin bo nesachin bitchillatan moalin bahen yardu lashshitin en moalin bahen
Gema tanu rabbanan moalin bedamim divre rabbi meir verabbi shimon vachachamim omrim en moalin
May tama deman deamar en moalin amar ulla amar kera vaani netattiv lachem shellachem hu deve rabbi yishmael tana lechapper lechappara netattiv velo limila
Rabbi yochanan amar amar kera ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper lifne chappara kilachar kappara hu ma leachar kappara en bo meila af lifne chappara en bo meila
Veema ma lifne chappara yesh bo meila af leachar kappara yesh bo meila
Vechi yesh lecha davar shennaaset mitzvato veyesh bo meila ammay la
b: Hare terumat haddeshen shennaasa mitzvato veyesh bo meila
Mishshum dehave leh terumat haddeshen veevre sair hammishtalleach shene ketuvin habbain keechad vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Hanicha leman deamar evre sair hammishtalleach en nehenin mehen ella leman deamar nehenin mehen may ika lememar
Mishshum dehave leh terumat haddeshen uvigde chehunna shene chetuvin habbain keechad vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin
Hanicha lerabbanan deamri vehinnicham sham melammed shehen teunin geniza shappir
Ella lerabbi dosa deamar muttar lehishtammesh bahen kohen hedot may ika lememar
Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene chetuvin habbain keechad
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin ella leman deamar melammedin may ika lememar
Tere miute ketivi ketiv hatam haarufa
Uchtiv hatam vesamo etzel hammizbeach hane in mide acharina la
Nesachim battechila moalin bahen vechu lema matnitin dela kerabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok

Detanya rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok omer lul katan haya ben kevesh lammizbeach bemaaravo shel kevesh achat leshivim shana pirche chehunna yordin bo umviin yayin karush shehu dome leiggule devela vesorfin otah bikdushsha shenneemar bakkodesh hassech nesech shechar la keshem shennisuchah bikdushsha kach serefatah bikdushsha
May mashma veamar ravina atya kodesh kodesh ketiv hacha bakkodesh uchtiv hatam vesarafta et hannotar baesh velo yochal ki kodesh hem
Ma notar serefato bikdushsha af hay name bikdushsha
Afilu tema rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok dei kelat
Ika deamri lema matnitin kerabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok dei kelat
Amri la umidderabbanan veha kera kanasev lah asmachta
Matni dishun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora lo nehenin velo moalin hammakdish dishun battechilla moalin bah torin shello higgia zemannan uvne yona sheavar zemannan lo nehenin velo moalin
Gema bishlama

a: Mizbeach hachitzon dichtiv beh vesamo etzel hammizbeach mizbeach happenimi menalan
Amar rabbi elazar deamar kera vehesir et murato benotzatah im eno inyan lemizbeach hachitzon tenehu inyan lemizbeach happenimi
Ema ide veide bemizbeach hachitzon velikboa lo makom
Im ken lema kera etzel hammizbeach may haddashen daafilu mizbeach happenimi
Menora menalan dashen haddashen
Matni rabbi shimon omer torin shello higgia zemannan moalin bahen bene yona sheavar zemannan lo nehenin velo moalin bahen
Gema bishlama rabbi shimon kidkatane tama shehaya rabbi shimon omer kol harauy leachar zeman vehikdisho betoch zemanno hare hu belo taase veen bo karet
Ella rabbanan may shena mimmechussar zeman
Amri mechussar zeman mide dehave abbaal mum devar pidon hu aval hane ofot kevan deen mum posel beofot en laofot pidon
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan kadashim shemmetu yatzu mide meila devar tora
Yatev ulla vekaamar leha shemata amar leh rav chisda man shama lach ulrabbi yochanan rabbach vechi kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha
Amar leh tikshe matnitin torin shello higgia zemannan uvne yona sheavar zemannan lo nehenin velo moalin hacha name nema kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha
Amar leh modena lach deika meila midderabbanan vekashya li mi ika mide demeikara la it beh meila ulvassof it beh meila
Vela veha ika dam demeikara let bah meila ulvassof it bah meila ditnan dam battechilla en moalin bo yatza lenachal kidron moalin bo
Amri hatam name ika meila meikara
b: Deamar rav hammakkiz dam levehemat kadashim asur bahanaa umoalin bo
Gufa amar rav huna amar rav hammakkiz dam levehemat kadashim asur bahanaa umoalin bo metiv rav hamnuna chalev hammukdashin uvetze torin lo nehenin velo moalin
Amar leh ki kaamrinan legabbe dam delo mitkayyemet bela dam aval chelev deka mikkayema belo chelev la
Metiv rav mesharsheya hazzevel vehapperesh shebbechatzer en nehenin veen moalin veyippelu dameha lallishka
Ammay hacha name la mekayyem belo peresh amri may irya haden peresh demin alma kaate lah azel hay ate acharina leappoke dam miggufah
Ha katane lo nehenin velo moalin vedamav lallishka mesayea leh lerabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar kol makom sheamru chachamim kadosh veeno kadosh damav yippelu lallishka
Matni chalev hammukdashin uvetze torin lo nehenin velo moalin
Bamme devarim amurim bekodshe mizbeach aval bekodshe bedek habbayit hikdish tarnegolet moalin bah uvvetzatah chamora moalin bah uvachalavah
Gema ella gabbe mizbeach ki akdeshah kedushshat damim la it bah meila

Amar rav pappa chassore michassera vehachi katane bamme devarim amurim keshehikdish kedushshat hagguf legabbe mizbeach aval hikdisho kedushshat damim legabbe mizbeach naasa kemi shehikdisho levedek habbayit hikdish tarnegolet moalin bah uvvetzatah chamora moalin bah uvachalavah
Matni kol harauy lammizbeach

a: Velo levedek habbayit levedek habbayit velo lammizbeach lo lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit moalin bah ketzad
Hikdish bor male mayim ashpot meleot zevel shovach male yonim
Ilan male perot sade melea asavim
Moalin bahem uvma shebbetochah

Aval im hikdish bor veachar kach nitmalle mayim ashpa veachar kach nitmalla zevel shovach veachar kach nitmalle yonim ilan veachar kach nitmalle perot sade veachar kach nitmallea asavim moalin bahem veen moalin bema shebbetochah
Rabbi yose omer hammakdish et hassade vehailan moalin bahen uvgidulah mippene shehen gidule hekdesh
Velad hamusseret lo yinak min hamusseret vaacherim mitnaddevim ken velad hammukdashin lo yinak min hammukdashin vaacherim mitnaddevim ken
Happoalim lo yochlu min gerogrot hekdesh vechen para mikkarshine hekdesh
Gema katane velad hamusseret lo yinak min hamusseret menahane mile
Amar rav achadvuy bar amme atya haavara haavara mibbechor ma bechor moalin bo af chalev hamusseret moalin bo
Chalev hammukdash name atya immo immo mibbechor
Happoalin lo yochlu ku may tama amar rav achadvuy bar amme deamar kera lo tachsom shor bedisho disho shellecha velo disho shel hekdesh
Haddash kalilin bisde hekdesh maal veha betalush bainan amar ravina shema minah avkah mealle lah
b: Matni shorshe ilan shel hedot habbain beshel hekdesh veshel hekdesh shebbain beshel hedot lo nehenin velo moalin mayan shehu yotze mittoch hassade shel hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin yatza chutz lassade nehenin mimmennu
Hammayim shebbakkad shel zahav lo nehenin velo moalin netanan bitzlochit moalin bahen
Arava lo nehenin velo moalin rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer nohagin hau hazzekenim shennehenim mimmennu belulvehen
Gema amar resh lakish en moalin bechullan aval moalin beshalosh luggin
Vehakatane sefa netano litzlochit moalin bahen mikkelal deresha afilu bishloshet luggin name la
Ella i itmar assefa itmar moalin bahen amar resh lakish en moalin ella bishlosha luggin
Verabbi yochanan amar moalin bechullan lememra dekasavar resh lakish yesh shiur lammayim vehatnan amar rabbi eliezer hamnassech me chag bechag bachutz chayyav
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum menachem yodafa rabbi elazar beshitat rabbi akiva amar dedaresh niskehem echad nisuch hammayim veechad nisuch hayyayin
Veamar resh lakish i ma yayin shalosh luggin af mayim shalosh luggin mikkelal desavar resh lakish en shiur lammayim letama dimnachem yodafa kaamar
Matni hakken shebberosh hailan shel hekdesh la nehenin velo moalin shebbaashera yattiz bekane hammakdish et hachoresh moalin bechullo

a: Gema itmar avoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha rabbi yochanan amar asura veresh lakish amar mutteret
Rabbi yochanan amar asura dela battelah goy veresh lakish amar mutteret memar amar hi gufah la matztzela ledidi matztzela li
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan hakken shebberosh hailan shel hekdesh en nehenin veen moalin shebbaashera yattiz bekane
May lav deitvar miggufah vekatane yattiz bekane la deayeti etzim mealma
I hachi ammay shel hekdesh en nehenin veen moalin
Ella begidulin habbain leachar mikkan vekasavar en moalin begidulin
Hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach deayeti mealma ammay yattiz bekane lishkeleh mishkal
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan leolam deayeti mealma umay yattiz yattiz efrochim
Amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya efrochim kan vechan muttarin betzim kan vechan asurin amar rav ashe im efrochim tzerichin leimman kevetzim damu
Matni haggizbarim shellakchu etzim moalin baetzim veen moalin lo bashshipuy velo banneviyya
Gema amar shemuel bonin bachol veachar kach makdishin
May tama man demitnaddev maot makdesh lehu deamar techul kedushshat maot abbinyan
Vihev lehon leummanin bischaran
b: Metivi motar hakketoret ma hau osin bo hau mafrishin mimmenna sechar haummanin
Umchallelin otah al meot haummanin venotnin otah laummanin vechozrin venotlin otah mitteruma chadasha
Veammay lachalah abbinyan
Dela ika binyan veha meot haummanin katane deleka binyan keshiur maot
Vehaamar shemuel hekdesh shave mane shechillo al shave peruta mechullal hane mile dei avad lechattechilla la
Rav pappa amar hayenu tama devonin bachol lo nittena tora lemalache hashsharet imre dilma bae lemizga uzga alayehu i bena bekudsha ishtechach dekamael bekudsha
Tenan haggizbarin shellakchu et haetzim moalin bahen veen moalin lo bashshipuy velo banneviyya
Veammay moalin bahen hacha name lebad bachol amri dedilma bae lemizga uzga alehen veishtechach deka moel bekadashim
Amar rav pappa i beetzim demikkan veelach hachi name ella ki tenan bematnitin beetzim deomeh
Hadran alach velad chattat

a: Kodshe mizbeach mitztarfin ze im ze limila ulchayyev alehem mishshum pigul venotar vetame kodshe bedek habbayit mitztarfin ze im ze echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit mitztarfin ze im ze limila

Gema hashta yesh lomar dekatane echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit dehay kedushshat hagguf vehay kedushshat damim afilu hachi katane mitztarfin ze im ze kodshe mizbeach im kodshe mizbeach mibaya
Mishshum dekatane alah lechayyev alehen mishshum pigul notar vetame dekodshe bedek habbayit la ika hachi mishshum hachi ka pelig leh
Amar rabbi yannay mechavarta en chayyavin mishshum meila ella al kodshe bedek habbayit veola bilvad may tama deamar kera nefesh ki timol maal mikkodshe Adonai
Kodashim hamuchadin la yesh bahen meila aval kodshe mizbeach it behu lakkohanim veit behu labbealim
Tenan kodshe mizbeach mitztarfin ze im ze limila midderabbanan
Kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom moalim bahen midderabbanan
Tenan hannehene min hachattat keshehi chayya lo maal ad sheyyifgom keshehi meta kevan shennehena kol shehu maal midderabbanan
Umiddeorayeta la vehatanya rabbi omer kol chelev la lerabbot emure kadashim kallim limila
Midderabbanan veha kera ka nasev lah asmachta bealma
Veha amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan kadashim shemmetu yatzu mide meila devar tora bemay ilema bekodshe bedek habbayit afilu ki metu name la yehe ella deakdesh ashpa levedek habbayit lav it bah meila
Ella kodshe mizbeach deorayeta mi it behu meila
Ella hachi ka amri deve rabbi yannay mehay kera kodshe bedek habbayit shamin minah kodshe mizbeach la shamin minah
b: Matni chamishsha devarim baola mitztarfin ze im ze habbasar vehachelev vehassolet vehayyayin vehashshemen veshishsha battoda habbasar vehachelev vehassolet vehayyayin vehashshemen vehallechem

Gema matne leh rav huna lerava chamishsha devarim baolam mitztarfin ze im ze amar leh baolam ka amratte veha katane battoda shishsha devarim shebbattoda habbasar vehachelev vehassolet vehayyayin vehashshemen velachme toda amar leh teni baola
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan olot veemurim mitztarfin lichzayit lehaalotan bachutz ulchayyev alehen mishshum pigul venotar vetame
Katane beola in bishlamim la bishlama lehaalotan bachutz ola dechalil hi mitztarfin shelamim la mitztarfin ella lechayyev alehen mishshum pigul venotar vetame shelamim ammay la mechayyev
Vehatnan kol happigulim mitztarfin ze im ze vechol hannotarot mitztarfot zo im zo
Ella ema ola veemureha mitztarfin ze im ze lichzayit lizrok alehen et haddam
Vechevan demitztarfin lizrok et haddam chayyav vechu

Uman katane lah rabbi yehoshua hi detanya rabbi yehoshua omer kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer mehen kezayit basar uchzayit chelev zorek et haddam kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev eno zorek et haddam
Uvaola afilu kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev zorek et haddam mippene shekkullah kalil uvammincha afilu kullah kayyemet lo yizrok
Mincha may avidtah amar rav pappa minchat nesachim

Matni hatteruma utrumat maaser utrumat maaser shel demay vehachalla vehabbikurim mitztarfin ze im ze leesor ulchayyev alehen et hachomesh kol happigulim mitztarfin ze im ze vechol hannotarim mitztarfin ze im ze
Gema may tama kullehu ikru teruma gabbe challa ketiv reshit arisotechem challa tarimu teruma
Gabbe bikurim name ikru teruma detanya utrumat yadecha ellu bikurim aval inach la tzericha
Matni kol hannevelot mitztarfin zo im zo vechol hashshekatzim mitztarfin ze im ze
Gema amar rav

a: Lo shanu ella leinyan tuma aval leinyan achila tehorin bifne atzman utmeim bifne atzman velevi amar afilu laachila name mitztarfin
Verav assi amar tehorim leatzman utmein leatzman ika deamri peliga adderav veika deamri la peliga
Metivi mitat para vechayye gamal en mitztarfin ze im ze ha mitat shenehem mitztarfin vekashya lerav assi
Ema ha chayye shenehem mitztarfin umanni rabbi yehuda hi deamar ever min hachay noheg battemea
Aval mitat shenehem may la mitztarfi im ken may irya derahet vetane mitat para vechayye gamal ha afilu mitat shenehem la mitztarfi

Veod tanya chatzi zayit para bechayyeha vachatzi zayit gamal bemitatah en mitztarfin aval chatzi zayit mippara vachatzi zayit miggamal ben bechayyeha ben bemitatah mitztarfin kashya resha assefa ella lav shema minah mitat shenehem mitztarfin
Amar lecha rav assi hay tanna savar isur chal al isur
b: Amar rav yehuda amar rav achilat sheratzim loke alav bichzayit may tama achila ketiv behu

Vehatane rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina kammeh derabbi yochanan vehivdaltem ben habbehema hattehora lattemea uven haof hattame lattahor velo teshakketzu et nafshotechem babbehema uvaof uvchol asher tirmos haadama asher hivdalti lachem letamme patach hakkatuv baachila vesiyyem betuma
Ma tuma bechaadasha af achila bechaadasha vekalleseh rabbi yochanan vekashya lidrav
La kashya kan bemitatan kan bechayyehen
Amar leh abbaye veha rav ammatnitin kae umatnitin kol hashsheratzim katane afilu bemitatan lav deika purta mehay ufurta mehay amar leh rav yosef hahi diyyuka dilach hu rav shemata bealma kaamar
Vekalleseh rabbi yochanan metivi haevarin en lahen shiur afilu pachot mikkezayit nevela ufachot mikkaadasha min hashsheretz metammein veamar rabbi yochanan en lokin alehen ella bichzayit
Amar rava bemuvdalin dibber hakkatuv
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava ella meatta behema name liflegi ben muvdelet lesheenah muvdelet

a: Amar leh ki ka makkesh rachamana leval teshakketzu aval leshiurin la
Matni dam hashsheretz vehabbasar mitztarfin ze im ze kelal amar rabbi yehoshua kol shettumato veshiuro shavin mitztarfin
Tumato velo shiuro shiuro velo tumato lo tumato velo shiuro en mitztarfin
Gema amar rav chanin amar rav zeera
Vechen amar rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina hattemein melammed shehen mitztarfin vaafilu sheretz vasheretz sheretz vadam ben mishshem echad ben mishshene shemot
Amar rav yosef la kashya kan bechullo kan bemiktzato
Umna temra middetanya nishpach al haritzpa vehaya mekomah katafres ihel al miktzato tahor ihel al kullo tame
May miktzato ilema miktzat dam veha amar rabbi chanina amar rabbi reviit dam shehegis bah tehora
Ella lav shema minah kan bechullo kan bemiktzato shema minah
Shaal rabbi matya ben charash et rabbi shimon ben yochay bair romi minnayin ledam sheratzim shehu tame amar leh deamar kera veze lachem hattame

Amru lo talmidav chachem leh ben yochay amar lahem talmud aruch befiv shel rabbi elazar bar rabbi yose sheppaam achat gazra hammalchut gezera shello yishmeru et hashshabbat veshello yamulu et benehem vesheyyivalu et niddot

Halach rabbi reuven ben isterobbali vesiper kome vehalach veyashav immahem amar lahem mi sheyyesh lo oyev yaani o yaashir amru lo yaani amar lahem im ken lo yaasu melacha bashshabbat kede sheyyaanu amru tavet amar livtal uvitteluha
Chazar veamar lahem mi sheyyesh lo oyev yachchish o yavri amru lo yachchish amar lahem im ken yamulu benehem lishmona yamim veyachchishu amru tavet amar uvitteluha
Chazar veamar lahem mi sheyyesh lo oyev yirbe o yitmaet amru lo yitmaet im ken lo yivalu niddot amru tavet amar uvitteluha
Hikkiru bo shehu yehudi hechezirum amru mi yelech vivattel haggezerot
b: Yelech rabbi shimon ben yochay shehu melummad benissim veacharav mi yelech rabbi elazar bar rabbi yose
Amar lahem rabbi yose veilu haya abba chalafta kayyam yecholin attem lomar lo ten bincha lahariga amar lahem shimon ilu haya yochay abba kayyam yecholin attem lomar lo ten bincha lahariga
Amar lehu rabbi yose ana azlin dilma anesh leh rabbi shimon deka mistefena kabbel aleh dela linesheh afilu hachi ansheh

Keshehau mehallechin badderech nishala sheela zo bifnehem minnayin ledam hashsheretz shehu tame ikkem piv rabbi elazar bar rabbi yose veamar veze lachem hattame amar leh rabbi shimon meakimat sefatecha atta nikar shettalmid chacham atta al yachzor habben etzel aviv
Yatza likrato ben temalon retzonchem avo immachem bacha rabbi shimon veamar ma shifcha shel bet abba nizdammen lah malach shalosh peamim vaani lo paam achat yavo hannes mikkol makom

Kedem hu al bivratteh dekesar ki meta hatam amar ben temalon tze ben temalon tze vechevan dikro leh nefak azal amar lehon sheilu kol ma deit lechon lemishal veayelinhu leginzeh lishkol kol devau ashkachu hahu igra shakluha ukrauha
Vehayenu deamar rabbi elazar bar rabbi yose ani reitiha bair romi vahao aleha kamma tipe damim
