Matni happigul vehannotar en mitztarfin mippene shehen shene shemot hashsheretz vehannevela vechen hannevela uvsar hammet en mitztarfin ze im ze letamme afilu bakkal shebbishnehen

Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella letumat hayyadayim demidderabbanan hi aval leinyan achila mitztarfin detanya rabbi eliezer omer lo yeachel ki kodesh hu kol shebbakkodesh pasul ba hakkatuv liten lo taase al achilato
Matni haochel shennitma beav hattuma veshennitma bivelad hattuma mitztarfin ze im ze letamme bakkal shebbishnehem kol haochalim mitztarfin ze im ze lifsol haggeviyya kevachatzi feras

Kevimzon shette seudot leeruv uchvetza letamme tumat ochalin vechigrogeret lehotzaat shabbat uchchotevet beom hakkippurim kol hammashkin mitztarfin zo im zo lifsol et haggeviyya birviit vechimlo lugma beom hakkippurim
Gema tanya rabbi shimon omer ma taam sheefshar lashsheni sheyyease rishon umi ka aved sheni rishon ha la efshar
Amar rava hachi kaamar mi garam lashsheni lav rishon rav ashe amar rishon vesheni legabbe shelishi bene chada bikta inun

a: Matni haorla vechile hakkerem mitztarfin ze im ze rabbi shimon omer en mitztarfin
Gema umi tzarich rabbi shimon letzarofe vehatanya rabbi shimon omer kol shehu lemakkot teni en tzerichin letzaref
Matni habbeged vehassak hassak vehaor haor vehammappatz kullan mitztarfin ze im ze
Amar rabbi shimon ma taam mippene shehen reuyin litame bemoshav
Gema tana kitza mikkullan shelosha veasa mehen beged lemishkav shelosha lemoshav tefach laachiza kol shehu
May laachiza amar resh lakish amar rabbi yannay shekken omed lenavela bematnita tana hoil verauy lekotztze teenim
Hadran alach kodshe mizbeach
Hannehene min hahekdesh shave peruta af al pi shello pagam maal divre rabbi akiva vachachamim omrim kol davar sheyyesh bo pegam lo maal ad sheyyifgom vesheen bo pegam kevan shennehena maal
Ketzad natna katla betzavarah tabbaat beyadah shata bechos shel zahav kevan shennehena maal lavash bechaluk kissa betallit bika bekardom lo maal ad sheyyifgom
Hannehene min hachattat keshehi chayya lo maal ad sheyyifgom keshehi meta kevan shennehena maal
Gema tana mode rabbi akiva lachachamim bedavar sheyyesh bo pegam bemay ka mipalgi
Amar rava bilvush metziaa umalmela
Tanu rabbanan nefesh echad hayyachid veechad hannasi veechad hammashiach
Ki timol maal en maal ella shinnuy vechen hu omer ish ish ki tiste ishto umaala vo maal veomer vayyimalu belohe
b: Avotehem vayyiznu achare habbealim
Yachol pagam velo nehena o nehena velo pagam
Uvimchubbar lakkarka uvshaliach sheasa shelichuto
Talmud lomar vechata neemar chet bitruma veneemar chet bimila
Ma chet haamur bitruma pogem venehene umi sheppagam nehene uvaddavar sheppogem bo nehene ufgimato vahanaato keechad uvtalush min hakkarka uvshaliach sheasa shelichuto
Af chet haamur bimila pogem venehene umi sheppagam nehene uvaddavar sheppogem bo nehene ufgimato vahanaato keechad uvtalush min hakkarka uvshaliach sheasa shelichuto
En li ella ochel venehene bedavar sheen bo pegam minnayin
Achilato vaachilat chavero hanayato vahanayat chavero hanaato vaachilat chavero achilato vahanayat chavero shemmitztarfin ze im ze afilu lizman merubbe minnayin
Talmud lomar timol maal mikkol makom

I ma chet haamur bitruma lo tzeraf shette achilot keechad af chet haamur bimila lo tzeraf shette achilot keachad minnayin achal hayyom veachal lemachar vaafilu lizman merubbe talmud lomar timol maal mikkol makom
I ma chet haamur bitruma pegimato vahanaato keechad minnayin laachilato vaachilat chavero vaafilu mikkan vead shalosh shanim minnayin talmud lomar timol maal mikkol makom
I ma chet haamur bitruma

a: Ed sheyyetze min hakkodesh lachol
Min hakkodesh lakkodesh kegon lakach kine zavim vekine zavot vekine yoldot
Veshakal shiklo vehevi chattato vaashamo min hahekdesh kevan shehotzi maal divre rabbi shimon rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyizrok haddam minnayin talmud lomar timol maal mikkol makom
Amar mar nefesh echad hayyachid veechad hannasi veechad hammashuach bammashma sheyyachol may peshita nefesh ketiv
Mahu detema amar rachamana vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar vehay lav zar hu deha imshach begaveyh ka mashma lan
Veakkeshah rachamana lesota velaavoda zara velitruma lesota deaf al gav delo pagam gabbe hekdesh name natna tabbaat beyadah maala
Ki akkeshah rachamana laavoda zara dead deit bah shinuy gabbe hekdesh name ad devika bekardom veyifgom ufagum
Akkeshah rachamana litruma ma teruma ki yochal perat lemazzik gabbe hekdesh name kol devar achila ki mazzek leh patur
Ketzad natna katla ku amar leh rav kahana lerav zevid vedahava lav bar ipgome hu veha dahava dechalleteh denun lehecha azal
Amar leh dilma dahava deramyan kallatach hu veod nehi dela ika nehena ufagam lealtar leolam mi la ika pegima
Hannehene min hachattat vechu mikkede i bivhema temima hayenu kos shel zahav amar rav pappa bevaalat mum askinan
b: Matni nehena kevachatzi feruta ufagam kachatzi feruta o shennehena beshave peruta bedavar echad ufagam beshave peruta bedavar acher lo maal ed sheyyehane beshave peruta veyifgom beshave peruta bedavar echad

En moel achar moel bemukdashin ella behema uchli sharet bilvad ketzad rachav al gabbe behema uva chavero verachav uva chavero verachav kullan maalu shata bechos shel zahav uva chavero veshata uva chavero veshata kullan maalu talash min hachattat uva chavero vetalash uva chavero vetalash kullan maalu rabbi omer kol davar sheen lo pidon yesh bo moel achar moel
Gema manni matnitin rabbi nechemya hi detanya en moel achar moel ella bivhema bilvad rabbi nechemya omer behema uchli sharet
May tama detanna kamma kasavar beinyana divhema ketiv dichtiv beel haasham
Verabbi nechemya amar lach kal vachomer im acherim mevi likdushshatan hu atzmo lo kol shekken
Rabbi omer kol davar sheen lo pidon yesh ku hayenu tanna kamma amar rava ika benayehu etzim
Detanu rabbanan haomer hare alay etzim lo yifchot mishshene gezirin rabbi omer etzim korban hen utunin melach utunin tenufa
Amar rava ledivre rabbi etzim teunin etzim veamar rav pappa ledivre rabbi etzim tzerichin kemitza
Rav pappa amar kodshe mizbeach temimin venaasu baale mumin veavar ushchatan ika benayehu
Vehatanya kodshe mizbeach temimin venaasu baale mumin veavar ushchatan rabbi omer yikkavru
Vachachamim omrim yippadu
Matni natal even o kora shel hekdesh hare ze lo maal

a: Netanah lachavero hu maal vachavero lo maal benaah betoch beto hare ze lo maal ad sheyyadur tachteha beshave peruta
Natal peruta shel hekdesh hare ze lo maal netanah lachavero hu maal vachavero lo maal netanah levallan af al pi shello rachatz maal shehu omer lo hare hammerchatz patuach lefanecha hikkanes urchotz
Achilato vaachilat chavero hanayato vahanayat chavero achilato vahanayat chavero hanayato vaachilat chavero mitztarfin ze im ze vaafilu lizman merubbe
Gema may shena hu umay shena chavero amar shemuel begizbar hammesurot lo askinan
Benaah betoch beto eno chayyav ku lema li ad sheyyadur tachteha kevan deshanneyah maal amar rav kegon shehinnichah al pi arubba
Vechevan devane lah mihat maal lema mesayya leh lerav deamar rav hammishtachave levayit asaro
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika hanaa hanniret laenayim asra tora
Lema mesayya leh haddar bevayit shel hekdesh kevan shennehena mimmenna maal amar resh lakish hatam beshehikdisho ulvassof benao
Aval benao ulvassof hikdisho may lo maal may irya rahet vetane haddar bevayit shel meara lo maal lema haddar bevayit shel avanim shebbenao ulvassof hikdisho lo maal
Amri ha pesika leh ha la pesika leh
Hadaran alach hannehene
Hashshaliach sheasa shelichuto baal habbayit maal lo asa shelichuto hashshaliach maal
Ketzad amar lo ten basar laorchim venatan lahem kaved kaved venatan lahem basar hashshaliach maal amar lo ten lahem chaticha chaticha vehu omer telu shettayim vehem natlu shalosh kullam maalu
b: Gema man tanna dechol milta demimlach alah shaliach tarte mile haveyan
Amar rav chisda dela kerabbi akiva ditnan hannoder min hayyarak muttar bediluin verabbi akiva oser
Abbaye amar afilu tema rabbi akiva mi la bae leimloche ki amaru rabbanan kammeh derava amar lehu shappir kaamar nachmani

Man tanna diflig aleh derabbi akiva rabban shimon ben gamliel hi detanya hannoder min habbasar asur bechol mine basar veasur barosh uvaraglayim bakkane uvakkaved uvallev veasur bivsar ofot umuttar bivsar dagim vachagavim rabban shimon ben gamliel mattir barosh uvaraglayim bakkane uvakkaved uvaofot uvaddagim uvachagavim
Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer keravayim lav basar hen veochlehen lav bar inish
Ultanna kamma may shena bivsar ofot mishshum dirgil inish deamar la ashkachi bisra decheveta vaatay bisra detzipra i hachi hachi name avid inish lememra la ashkachi bisra decheveta vaatay dagim
Amar rav pappa beom hakkaza askinan dela achel inish dagim
I hachi tzipra name la nechol deamar shemuel dimsochar veachel tzipra parach libeh ketzipra veod tanya en makkizin dam lo al haddagim velo al haofot velo al basar maliach
Ella amar rav pappa beoma dechayevin leh eneh askinan dela achel dagim
Amar lo ten lo chaticha ku shema minah mosif al shelichuto have shaliach
Amar rav sheshet deamar shaliach tol achat middato veachat middati

a: Mahu detema akar shaliach shelichuteh devaal habbayit vela limol ka mashma lan

Matni amar lo have li min hachallon o min haddeloskama vehevi lo af al pi sheamar baal habbayit lo haya belibbi ella mizze vehevi mizze baal habbayit maal aval im amar lo have li min hachallon vehevi lo min haddeloskama o min haddeloskama vehevi lo min hachallon hashshaliach maal
Shillach beyad cheresh shote vekatan im asu shelichuto baal habbayit maal lo asu shelichuto chenoni meal
Shillach beyad pikkeach venizkar ad shello higgia etzel chenoni chenoni maal lichsheyyotzi
Ketzad yaase notel peruta o cheli veomer peruta shel hekdesh bechol makom shehu mechullal al ze shehahekdesh nifde bechesef uvshave kesef
Gema may ka mashma lan devarim shebballev enam devarim
Shilach beyad cheresh shote vekatan im asu vechu veha lav bene shelichuta ninhu
Amar rabbi elazar asaum kemaatan shel zetim
Ditnan hazzetim meematay mekabbelin tuma mishsheyyazziu zeat hammaatan velo zeat hakkuppa

Rabbi yochanan amar keotah sheshshaninu netano al gabbe hakkof veholicho o al gabbe happil veholicho veamar leacher lekabbelo mimmennu hare ze eruv alma ka avda shelichuteh hachi name itavid shelichuteh
Shillach beyad pikkeach vechu veaf al gav dela idchar shaliach urminhi nizkar baal habbayit velo nizkar shaliach hashshaliach maal nizkeru shenehem chenvani maal
Amar rav sheshet matnitin name keshennizkeru shenehem

Matni natan lo peruta amar lo have li bechetzyah nerot uvchetzyah petilot vehalach vehevi lo bechullah petilot o bechullah nerot o sheamar lo have li bechullah nerot o bechullah petilot vehalach vehevi bechetzyah nerot uvchetzyah petilot shenehem lo maalu
Aval im amar lo have li bechetzyah nerot mimmakom peloni uvchetzyah petilot mimmakom peloni vehalach vehevi lo nerot mimmekom petilot uftilot mimmekom nerot hashshaliach maal

Natan lo shette ferutot veamar lo lech vehave li etrog vehalach vehevi lo beachat etrog uvachat rimon shenehem maalu rabbi yehuda omer baal habbayit lo maal shehu omer lo etrog gadol hayiti mevakkesh veheveta li katan vera
Natan lo dinar zahav veamar lo lech vehave li chaluk

Sider et hammaaracha gedola mizracha vachazitah mizracha verashe gezirin happenimim hau nogin battappuach verevach haya ben haggezirim shehau matztzitim et haalita mishsham
Berru mishsham atze teena yafim sider et hammaaracha sheniyya liktoret keneged maaravit deromit mashuch min hakkeren kelappe tzafon arba ammot

Amar rabbi amme dibbera tora leshon havay dibberu neviim leshon havay dibberu chachamim leshon havay

Amar rabbi yannay bar nachmani amar shemuel bishlosha mekomot dibberu chachamim bilshon havay veellu hen tappuach gefen ufarochet
Leappoke midderava ditnan hishku et hattamid bechos shel zahav veamar rava guzma ka mashma lan hane in hatam la en aniyyut bimkom ashirut
Tappuach ha daamaran gefen detanya gefen zahav hayeta omedet al petach hahechal umudla al gabbe kelonsot vechol mi shemmitnaddev ale

Metivi al haetzim asher al haesh etzim hannittochim lihot esh umay nihu dukre shappud dela ketiri veazli mikketar mittocho

Vechi kol haetzim kesherim lammaaracha hen kol haetzim kesherim chutz min zayit vegefen aval beellu hau regilin bemurbiyyot shel teena veshel egoz veshel etz shemen rabbi eliezer mosif af shel mayish veshel allon veshel dekel veshel charuv veshel shikma

Ella leman deamar mishshum yishshuv deeretz yisrael dekel mi let beh mishshum yishshuv deeretz yisrael
Amar lach velitamach teena let bah mishshum yishshuv deeretz yisrael ella may it lach lememar bitena dela avida pera dekel name bidla aved pera

a: Veshayefi lehu bechavla detzavta disrich aleh bizra vekavri hecha demassek yamma sirton kora avda pere la avda utlat beriche minayehu la machzeka lehu gamla
Sider et hammaaracha gedola vechu may tama rav huna verav chisda chad amar kede shettehe haruach menashshevet bah vechad amar kede sheyehu matztzitin haalita mishsham
Metivi revach haya bahen ben haggezirin shehau matztzitin haalita mishsham amar lach mekomot mekomot avdi
Hadaran alach rauhu echav
Amar lahen hammunne bou vehafisu mi hashshochet umi hazzorek mi medashshen mizbeach happenimi mi medashshen et hammenora mi maale evarim lakkevesh
Harosh veharegel shel yamin ushte hayyadayim haoketz veharegel shel semol hechaze vehaggera ushte defanot hakkeravayim vehassolet vehachavitin vehayyayin
Hefisu zacha mi shezzacha
Amar lahen tzeu uru im higgia zeman shechita im higgia haroe omer barkay matya ben shemuel omer heir pene kol hammizrach ad shehu bechevron vehu omer hen

Amar lahen tzeu vehaviu li vehotziu tale millishkat hattelaim vahare lishkat hattelaim netuna bemiktzoa tzefonit maaravit arba leshachot hau sham achat lishkat hattelaim veachat lishkat hachotamot veachat lishkat bet hammoked veachat lishka sheosin bah lechem happanim
Nichnesu lelishkat hakkelim hotziu mishsham tishim ushlosha kele chesef uchle zahav hishku et hattamid bakkos
b: Shel zahav af al pi shehu mevukkar mibbaerev mevakkerin oto leor avukot

Mi shezzacha bedishun mizbeach happenimi uvdishun hammenora hau makdimin vearbaa kelim beyadam hatteni vehakkuz ushne maftechot hatteni dome letarkav shel zahav machazik kabbayim vachetzi vehakkuz dome lekiton gadol shel zahav ushte maftechot echad shehu yored beammat hashshechi veechad shehu poteach kevan

Ba lo lappishpash hatztzefoni shene pishpashin hau lo lashshaar haggadol achat batztzafon veachat baddarom shebbaddarom lo nichnas bo adam alav hu meforash al yede yechezkel shenneemar vayyomer elay Adonai hashshaar hazze sagur yihye lo yippateach veish al yavo vo ki Adonai elohe yisrael ba vo vehaya sagur

Natal et hammafteach ufatach et happishpash venichnas lehatta umehatta lahechal ad shemmaggia leshaar haggadol higgia leshaar haggadol heevir et hanneger veet happotchot uftacho lo haya shochet hashshochet ad sheshshomea shaar gadol shenniftach
Miricho hau shomin kol shaar gadol shenniftach miricho hau shomin kol magrefa miricho hau shomin kol hashshir miricho hau shomin kol ben arza makkish batztziltzel miricho hau shomin kol hechalil

Miricho hau shomin kol gevini karoz miricho hau shomin kol haetz sheasa ben katin muchni lakkiyyor miricho hau shomin kol hashshir miricho hau shomin kol hashshofar veyesh omrim af kolo shel kohen gadol beshaa shehu mazkir et hashshem beom hakkippurim
Miricho hau merechin reach pitum hakketoret amar rabbi elazar ben diglay izzim hau leabba beare behare hammichor vehau mitatteshot mereach pitum hakketoret

Mi shezzacha battamid meshacho veholech bevet hammitbachayim umi shezzachu baevarim holchin immo bet hammitbachayim haya litzfono shel mizbeach vealav shemona ammudim nannasim urvaim shel erez al gabbehen veunkelaot shel barzel hau kevuin bahen ushlosha sedarim lechol echad veechad shebbahen tolin umafshitin al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim
Mi shezzacha bedishun mizbeach happenimi nichnas venatal et hatteni vehinnicho lefanav vehaya chofen venoten letocho uvaacharona kibed et hashshear letocho vehinnicho veyatza

Mi shezzacha bedishun hammenora nichnas umatza shene nerot mizrachit maaravit dolkin medashshen et hashshear umanniach et ellu dolkin bimkoman metzaan shekkavu medashshenan umadlikan min haddolkin veachar kach medashshen et hashshear
Veeven hayeta lifne hammenora uvah shalosh maalot shealeha kohen omed umetiv et hannerot umanniach hinniach et hakkuz al maala sheniyya veyatza
Hadaran alach amar lahem hammunne
Matni lo hau koftin et hattale ella maakidin oto mi shezzachu baevarim ochazin bo vechach haya akedato rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav vehashshochet omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav
Shel shachar haya nishchat al keren tzefonit maaravit al tabbaat sheniyya shel ben haarbayim haya nishchat al keren mizrachit tzefonit al tabbaat sheniyya
Shachat hashshochet vekibbel hamkabbel ba lo lekeren mizrachit tzefonit venoten mizracha tzafona maaravit deromit venoten maarava daroma sheyare haddam haya shofech el yesod deromit

a: Lo haya shover bo et haregel ella nokvo mittoch arkubbo vetole bo

Haya mafshit veored ad shemmaggia lechaze higgia lechaze chatach et harosh untano lemi shezzacha bo chatach et hakkeraayim untanan lemi shezzacha bahen merak et hahefshet kara et hallev vehotzi et damo
Chatach et hayyadayim untanan lemi shezzacha bahen ala laregel hayemanit chatachah untanah lemi shezzacha bah ushte betzim immah kerao venimtza kullo galuy lefanav

Natal et happeder untano al bet shechitat harosh millemala natal et hakkeravayim untanan lemi shezzacha bahen lahadichan vehakkares medichin otah bevet hammedichin umdichin otah kol tzorkah vehakkeravayim medichin otan shalosh peamim bemiutan al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim
Natal et hassakkin vehifrish et harea min hakkaved veetzba hakkaved min hakkaved velo haya mezizah mimmekomah nokav et hechaze untano lemi shezzacha
Ala laddofen hayemanit haya chotech veored ad hashshidra velo haya nogea bashshidra ad shemmaggia leven shette tzelaot dakkot chatachah untanah lemi shezzacha bah vehakkaved teluya bah
Ba lo laggera hinniach bah shette tzelaot mikkan ushte tzelaot mikkan chatachah untanah lemi shezzacha bah hakkane vehallev veharea teluyim bah

Ba lo laddofen hassemalit hinniach bah shette tzelaot dakkot millemalan ushte tzelaot dakkot millemattan vechach haya manniach bachavertah nimtza manniach shettayim shettayim millemalan shettayim shettayim millemattan

Chatachah venatna lemi shezzacha bah vehashshidra immah vehattechol taluy bah vehi hayeta gedola ella shel yamin korin gedola shehakkaved teluya bah ba lo laoketz chatacho untano lemi shezzacha bo haalya veetzba hakkaved ushte kelaot immo natal et haregel hassemalit chatachah untanah lemi shezzacha bah nimtzeu kullan omdim beshura vehaevarim beyadam
b: Harishon barosh uvaregel harosh bimino vechotmo kelappe zeroo karnav ben etzbeotav bet shechitato millemalan vehappeder natun aleha haregel shel yamin bismolo uvet oran lachutz hashsheni bishte yadayim shel yamin bimino veshel semol bismolo uvet oran lachutz

Hashshelishi baoketz uvaregel haoketz bimino vehaalya meduldelet ben etzbeotav veetzba hakkaved ushte kelaot immo haregel shel semol bismolo uvet oran lachutz harvii bechaze uvaggera hechaze bimino vehaggera bismolo vetzalotav ben shene etzbeotav hachamishi bishte defanot shel yamin bimino veshel semol bismolo uvet oran lachutz hashshishshi bakkeravayim hannetunim bevazech uchraayim al gabbehen millemala

May benayehu ika venayehu dechafteh beshirae i name behutza dedahava
Tenan hatam shelosh esre shulchanot hau bammikdash shemona shel shayish bevet hammitbachayim shealehem medichin et hakkeravayim
Shenayim bammaarav shel kevesh echad shel shayish veechad shel kesef al shel shayish notnin et haevarim veal shel kesef kele sharet
Uvaulam shenayim mibbifnim al petach habbayit echad shel kesef veechad shel zahav al shel kesef notnin lechem happanim bichnisato veal shel zahav bitziato
Shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin veechad shel zahav bifnim shealav lechem happanim tamid
Mikkede en aniyyut bimkom ashirut ammay avdi deshayish nabedu dechesef nabedu dezahav amar rav chinana beshem rabbi assi verabbi assi beshem rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak mippene shehu martiach

Savri dilma ate leshayyole ma lemala uma lematta ma lefanim uma leachor

Amar lahen eden minnechon chakkim yattir amru lo kullana kachada shavayin deha kol milta daamarte lana bechad petarna lach amar lahen ma den atrestun lekivli amaru leh sitna natzach
Amar lehon ha ana mekattelna yatchon bigzerat malchin amaru leh sholtan beyad malka vela yae lemalka kazav miyyad albesh yathon levushin deargeon ushdi menicha dedahava al tzavverehon

Amaru leh ayeti chamare luvae defarshi behavra veayeti kibure dematne uktar behay gisa dechi atet beorcha naktatte begavayehu veatet leatrach

b: Amar lehu mi achli inashe nahama dedahava amaru leh ella i nahama baet la hava lach beatrach nahama lemechal dishkalte vaatet lehacha ki nafek veate ketav abbava demachoza ana alekkesanderos mokdon haveti shatya ad daateti limdinat afrike dinshayya vilefit etza min neshayya

Amar lehon lerabbanan may hay amri gulgulta deena devisra udma hu dela ka sava amar lehu mimmay dehachi hu shakli kallil afra vechasseuh lealtar tekala dichtiv sheol vaavaddon lo tisbana vego
Tana deve eliyyahu gehinnam lemala min harakia veyesh omrim laachore hare choshech

Tana rabbi chiyya kol haosek battora ballayela shechina kenegdo shenneemar kumi ronni vallayela lerosh ashmurot shifchi chammayim libbech nochach pene Adonai vego amar rabbi elazar ben azarya talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam shenneemar vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich
Hadaran alach lo hau koftin
Amar lahem hammunne barchu beracha achat vehem berchu karu aseret haddibberot shema vehaya im shamoa vayyomer
Berchu et haam shalosh berachot emet veyatztziv vaavoda uvirkat kohanim uvashshabbat mosifin beracha achat lammishmar hayyotze

Amar lahem chadashim liktoret bou vehafisu zacha mi shezzacha amar lahem chadashim im yeshanim bou vehafisu mi maale evarim min hakkevesh lammizbeach rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer hammaale evarim lakkevesh hu maale otan al gabbe hammizbeach
Mesarum lachazzanim hau mafshitin otam et bigdehem velo hau mannichin alehem ella michnasayim bilvad vechallonot hau sham vechatuv alehem tashmish hakkelim
Mi shezzacha bakketoret haya notel et hakkaf vehakkaf dome letarkav gadol shel zahav machzeket shelosha kabbin vehabbazech haya betocho

Uvashshabbat haya kofe alehen pesachter ufsachter hayeta keli gadol machzeket letech ushte sharsherot hau bah achat shehu moshech bah veored veachat shehu ochez bah millemalan bishvil shello titgalgel
Ushlosha devarim hayeta meshammeshet kofin otah al gabbe gechalim veal hashsheretz bashshabbat umoridin bah et haddeshen meal gabbe hammizbeach
Higgiu ben haulam velammizbeach natal echad et hammagrefa uzrakah ben haulam velammizbeach en adam shomea kol chavero birushalayim mikkol hammagrefa

Hitchil meraddedan veotze lo haya hammaktir maktir ad shehammunne omer lo hakter veim haya kohen gadol hammunne omer lo ishi kohen gadol hakter
Parshu haam vehiktir vehishtachava veyatza

b: Bizman shekkohen gadol nichnas lehishtachaot shelosha ochazin bo echad bimino veechad bismolo veechad baavanim tovot
Vechevan sheshshama hammunne kol raglav shel kohen gadol shehu yotze higbiha lo et happarochet nichnas vehishtachava veyatza nichnesu echav hakkohanim hishtachau veyatzu

Bau veamdu al maalot haulam amdu harishonim lidrom achehem hakkohanim vachamishsha kelim beyadam hatteni beyad echad vehakkuz beyad echad vehammachta beyad echad vehabbazech beyad echad vechaf vechissuo beyad echad

Bizman shekkohen gadol rotze lehaktir haya ole bakkevesh vehassegan bimino higgia lemachatzit hakkevesh achaz hassegan bimino veheelahu

Ba lo lehakkif et hammizbeach mehechan hu matchil mikkeren deromit mizrachit mizrachit tzefonit tzefonit maaravit maaravit deromit natnu lo yayin lenassech

Uman detane hay lishana ha tanya ki hayeche lishana deim ita dahava dam meikara hava ate hatam hillel hu dekatae hu savar tama deshammay deim ita dahava dam meikara hava ate veka makshe leh kuppa
Veamar leh shammay tama didi mishshum bittul periyya urviyya ulmay dekataet name dekamakshet kuppa lazo yesh lah shulayim ulazo en lah shulayim

En lah shulayim may tama derabbi yochanan en lah shulayim veyesh lah oganim

Veod tenan matza sheretz saruf al gabbe hazzetim vechen matlit hamhumham tahor shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan
Vechi tema kishat metziatan ben lekulla ben lechumra uvimkom metziatan aval shello bimkom metziatan misraf la sarfinan mitle talenan

Amar rabba may tamayehu derabbanan ishsha margeshet beatzmah amar leh abbaye im ken tehe dayya sheatah verabba lechaddode leabbaye hu devae ella may tamayehu derabbanan
Ki ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel chachamim tikkenu lahen livnot yisrael sheyehu bodkot atzman shacharit vearvit shacharit lehachshir teharot shel layela vearvit lehachshir teharot shel yom

Afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi dosa ella shello bishat vistah aval bishat vistah modu leh umatnitin bishat vistah vedivre hakkol
Mikkelal derabbi dosa afilu shello bishat vistah amar man tena leha detanu rabbanan ishsha sheyyesh lah veset kitmah tame lemafrea sheim tire shello bishat vistah metammea meet leet
Nema rabbanan hi vela rabbi dosa afilu tema rabbi dosa ad kan la pelig rabbi dosa alayehu derabbanan ella bishat vistah aval shello bishat vistah mode lehu umatnitin bishat vistah verabbi dosa hi

Velokma ipcha

Ha shear nashim sheamru chachamim dayyan sheatan kitman kiriyyatan

Manni rabbi chanina ben antignos hi deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi chanina ben antignos kol hannashim kitman tame lemafrea venashim sheamru chachamim dayyan sheatan kitman kiriyyatan chutz mittinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot sheafilu sedinin shellah meluchlachin bedam en choshshin lah

Vehamshammeshet beedim ku amar rav yehuda amar shemuel ed shellifne tashmish eno memaet kifkida
May tama amar rav kattina mittoch shemmehumma levetah vechi mehumma levetah may have mittoch shemmehumma levetah enah machneset lechorin velisdakin

Tenan hamshammeshet beedim hare zo kifkida may lav chad lifne tashmish vechad leachar tashmish la ide veide leachar tashmish veechad lo veechad lah keditnan derech benot yisrael meshammeshot bishne edim echad lo veechad lah

Hay may i amratte bishlama chad lifne tashmish vechad leachar tashmish itzterich salka datach amena mittoch shemmehumma levetah la badka shappir ka mashma lan hare zo kifkida ella i amratte ide veide leachar tashmish peshita
Mahu detema shemma tire tippat dam kechardal utchappenna shichvat zera ka mashma lan
Veibaet ema shette vedikot atzrechuha rabbanan chad lifne tashmish vechad leachar tashmish vechi katane hare zo kifkida alleachar tashmish veha hamshammeshet katane teni umshammeshet
Memaetet al yad meet leet hashta meet leet memaetet
b: Mippekida lifkida mibaya
Mahu detema meet leet chashshu bah rabbanan lifseda ditharot aval mippekida lifkida la ka mashma lan
Ketzad dayya sheatah vechu lema li lemitne hayeta yoshevet bammitta vaasuka bitharot litne hayeta asuka bitharot ufarsha veraata
Ha ka mashma lan tama dedayyah sheatah ha meet leet mitta name metammeya mesayya leh lizeri deamar zeeri meet leet shebbenidda osa mishkav umoshav letamme adam letamme begadim
Mikkedi hay mitta davar sheen bo daat lishael hu vechol davar sheen bo daat lishael sefeko tahor targemah zeeri keshechavroteha nosot otah bammitta dehaveya lah yad chavroteha
Vehashta deamar rabbi yochanan sefek tuma habbaa bide adam nishalin aleha afilu bichli munnach al gabbe karka kemi sheyyesh bo daat lishael af al pi sheen chavroteha nosot otah bammitta
Gufa amar rabbi yochanan sefek tuma habbaa bide adam nishalim aleha afilu bichli hammunnach al gabbe karka kemi sheyyesh bo daat lishael
Metivi haya mitattef betallito utharot vetumot betziddo utharot vetumot lemala merosho safek naga safek lo naga tahor veim i efshar ella im ken naga tame
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer omrim lo shene veshone amru lo en shonim bitharot
Ammay ha sefek tuma habbaa bide adam hu
Bar mineh dehahi detane rav hoshaya birshut hayyachid sefeko tame birshut harabbim tahor

Ini veha ki ata avimi mibbe chozae ata veayeti matnita bideh meet leet shebbenidda mishkavah umoshavah kemaggaah may lav ma maggaah lo metamme adam af mishkavah lo metamme adam

Kidulla deamar ulla chavrayya medakkan begalila hacha name bime rabbi

Ta shema maase beshifchato shel rabban gamliel shehayeta ofa kikkarot shel teruma uven kol achat veachat medicha yadah bemayim uvodeket baacharona badka umatza temea uvat veshaala et rabban gamliel veamar lah kullan temeot amra lo rabbi vahalo bedika hayeta li ben kol achat veachat amar lah im ken hi temea vechullan tehorot
Katane mihat kikkarot shel teruma may teruma terumat lachme toda terumat lachme toda baafiyya may baaya
Deafreshinhu beleshayehu vechi ha deamar rav tovi bar rav kattina lachme toda sheafaan arba challot yatza vehavenan bah veha baenan arbaim lemitzva
Veha baenan afroshe teruma minayehu vechi tema demafresh perusa mikkol chad vechad echad amar rachamana shello yittol perusa veamrinan deafreshinhu beleshayehu hacha name deafreshinhu beleshayehu

Ta shema shuv maase beshifcha shel rabban gamliel shehayeta gafa chaviyyot shel yayin uven kol achat veachat medicha yadeha bemayim uvodeket uvaacharona badka umatza temea uvat veshaala lerabban gamliel veamar lah kullan temeot amra lo vahalo bedika hayeta li ben kol achat veachat amar lah im ken hi temea vechullan tehorot
I amratte bishlama chada dekodesh vachada ditruma hi hayenu dehadra veshayela ella i amratte ide veide dekodesh lema lah lemehdar ulshayyoleh maase shehaya bishte shefachot haya

Kabbelah mineh rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak bechullin shennaasu al tohorat kodesh velo bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma
Tenan hatam nolad lah sefek tuma ad shello gilgela tease betuma mishsheggilgela tease betohora
Ad shello gilgelah tease betuma chullin ninhu umuttar ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael mishsheggilgela tease betohora chullin hattevulin lechalla kechala damu veasur ligrom tuma lechalla

a: Vechallatah teluya lo ochlin velo sorfin beeze safek amru bisfek challa may sefek challa

Ella benishan ditnan zav vetahor shehau porkin min hachamor o toanin bizman shemmassaan kaved tame massaan kal tahor vechullan tehorin livne hakkeneset utmein litruma
Vechullin hattevulin lechalla kechalla damu vehatanya ishsha shehi tevulat yom lasha et haisa vekotza hemenna challatah umannichatah bichfisha o beanchuta umakkefet vekora lah shem
Mippene shehu shelishi ushlishi tahor bechullin vei amratte chullin hattevulin lechalla kechalla damu ha tammetinhu
Amar abbaye kol shevadday metamme chullin gazru al sefeko mishshum chullin hattevulin lechalla vehay tevul yom kevan delo metamme vadday chullin lo gazru alav mishshum chullin hattevulin lechalla

Matni rabbi eliezer omer arba nashim dayyan sheatan betula meubberet menika uzkena amar rabbi yehoshua ani lo shamati ella betula
b: Aval halacha kerabbi eliezer

Ezo hi betula kol shello raata dam miyyameha af al pi shennesua meubberet mishsheyyivada ubbarah menika ad shettigmol et benah natna benah limnika gemalattu o met rabbi meir omer metammea meet leet vachachamim omrim dayyah sheatah

Ezohi zekena kol sheavru aleha shalosh onot samuch leziknatah rabbi eliezer omer kol ishsha sheavru aleha shalosh onot dayyah sheatah rabbi yose omer meubberet umnika sheavru alehen shalosh onot dayyan sheatan
Uvamma amar dayyah sheatah biriyya rishona aval bashsheniyya metammea meet leet veim raata harishona meones af hashsheniyya dayyah sheatah
Gema tanya amar lo rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua atta lo shamata ani shamati atta lo shamata ella achat vaani shamati harbe

En omrim lemi shello raa et hachodesh yavo veyaid ella lemi sheraahu kol yamav shel rabbi eliezer hau osin kerabbi yehoshua leachar petirato shel rabbi eliezer hechzir rabbi yehoshua et haddavar leoshno
Kerabbi eliezer bechayyav may tama la mishshum derabbi eliezer shammuti hu vesavar i avdinan kevateh bachada avdinan kevateh beachranyata
Umishshum kevodo derabbi eliezer la matzenan machenan behu leachar petirato shel rabbi eliezer dematzinu dematzenan machenan behu hechzir et haddavar leoshno
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi eliezer bearba chada daamaran
Veidach hamkashsha kamma tishpe uthe zava meet leet divre rabbi eliezer vahalacha kidvarav

Veidach hazzav vehazzava shebbadku atzman yom rishon umatzu tahor yom shevii umatzu tahor ushar hayyamim lo badku rabbi eliezer omer hare ellu bechezkat tohora rabbi yehoshua omer en lahen ella yom harishon veom hashshevii bilvad

Veidach ditnan achore chelim shennitmeu bemashkin rabbi eliezer omer metammein et hammashkin veen poslin et haochalin metammein et hammashkin vaafilu dechullin veen poslin et haochalin vaafilu ditruma rabbi yehoshua omer metammein et hammashkin ufoslin et haochalin
Amar rabbi yehoshua kal vachomer uma tevul yom sheen metamme mashke chullin posel ochle teruma achore chelim shemmetamme mashke chullin eno din shepposel ochle teruma
Verabbi eliezer achore chelim derabbanan utvul yom deorayeta verabbanan middeorayeta la avdinan kal vachomer demiddeorayeta en ochel metamme keli veen mashke metamme keli
Verabbanan hu digzur gezera mishshum mashkin dezav vezava mashkin daalulin lekabbel tuma gezaru behu rabbanan ochalin deen alulin lekabbel tuma la gezaru behu rabbanan
Umay shena achore chelim denaket mishshum dekili ditnan keli shennitma meachorav bemashkin achorav tame tocho ozno ogno yadav tehorin nitma tocho kullo tame
May ka mashma lan shemuel bechullehu tenan hilcheta
Vechi tema achore chelim ka mashma lan dela tenan velema halacha kerabbi eliezer baachore chelim ella ha ka mashma lan sheen lemedin halacha mippi talmud
Vetu leka vehaika ditnan rabbi eliezer omer

Vehachi name mistabbera ditnan rabbi eliezer omer af harode venoten lassal hassal metzarfan lachalla veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi eliezer shema minah

Ditnan rabbi elazar omer melammedin et hakketanna shettemaen bo

Vechen amar rabbi elazar halacha kerabbi eliezer bearbaa vetu leka vehatnan rabbi eliezer omer melammedin et hakketanna shettemaen bo veamar rabbi elazar halacha kerabbi eliezer vechi tema ki amar rabbi elazar halacha kerabbi eliezer bearbaa beseder teharot aval bishar sidre ika umi ika
Vehatnan havered vehakkofer vehalletom vehakketaf yesh lahen sheviit velidmehen sheviit yesh lahen biur velidmehen biur veamar rabbi pedat man tena kitfa pera rabbi eliezer
Veamar rabbi zera chazi deminach umeavuch kasharetu kitfa lealma atte amratte man tanna kitfa pera rabbi eliezer vaavuch amar halacha kerabbi eliezer bearbaa
Veim ita lema leh ki amar abba halacha kerabbi eliezer bearbaa beseder teharot aval bishar sidre ika
Ella kashya hahi mishshum dekae rabbi elazar kevateh ditnan rabbi elazar omer melammedim et hakketanna shettemaen bo
Umi kae veha atzroche matzrechinan lehu vela damyan lahadade ella mishshum dekae rabbi yehuda ben bava kevateh
Vetu leka vehatnan rabbi akiva omer omrah beracha reviit bifne atzmah rabbi eliezer omer omrah bahodaa veamar rabbi elazar halacha kerabbi eliezer
Amar rabbi abba hahu deamar mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel detanya rabbi akiva omer omrah beracha reviit bifne atzmah rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer omrah bahodaa
b: Veha kashshish mineh tuva ella mishshum dekae rabbi chanina ben gamliel beshitteh

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera veatte la tisbera deman tena kitfa pera rabbi eliezer hu vehatnan rabbi eliezer omer hammaamid bisraf arla asur

Afilu tema rabbanan ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ella bekitfa digvaza aval bekitfa defera modu leh ditnan amar rabbi yehoshua shamati beferush shehammaamid bisraf healin bisraf haikarin muttar bisraf happaggin asur mippene shehu peri

Man chachamim lav rabbanan difligi aleh derabbi eliezer amar leh hahu sava hachi amar rabbi yochanan man chachamim rabbi eliezer deamar ketafo zehu piro

I rabbi eliezer may irya ilan sheeno ose peri afilu ilan haose peri ketafo zehu piro ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi afilu ilan haose perot name ketafo zehu piro ledidchu odo li mihat beilan sheeno ose perot diktafo zehu piro verabbanan amri leh la shena

Veaf al gav sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar shenneemar harinu chalnu kemo yaladnu ruach may zecher laddavar hare reaya gedola hi ki ketiv hay kera bizcharim ketiv
Urminhi kishsheta shenayim velashshelishi hippila ruach o kol davar sheeno shel keyama hare zo yoledet bezov vei amratte leda meallayeta hi

Amar leh midi hu tama ella mishshum deroshah kaved aleha veevareha kevedin aleha beidana dachazay en roshah kaved aleha veen evareha kevedin aleha

Amar leh tenetuha rabbi meir omer im hayeta bemachave vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka tehora shecharada mesalleket et haddamim tama deika charada ha leka charada vehiggia vistah velo badka temea
Alma vesatot deorayeta vechevan deika charada dameha mesullakin vela baaya bedika hacha name dameha mesullakin vela baaya bedika

Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim dayyan sheatan kol esrim vearba chodesh lefichach im hayeta menikato arba vechamesh shanim metammea meet leet umippekida lifkida
Keshettimmatze lomar ledivre rabbi meir dam nekar venaasa chalav ledivre rabbi yose verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon evareha mitparkin veen nafshah chozeret ad esrim vearba chodesh
Lefichach derabbi meir lema li mishshum lefichach derabbi yose
Ulfichach derabbi yose lema li mahu detema rabbi yose tarte it leh ka mashma lan

Tanya name hachi dam nekar venaasa chalav divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer evareha mitparkin veen nafshah chozeret aleha ad esrim vearba chodesh amar rabbi ilay may tama derabbi meir dichtiv mi yitten tahor mittame lo echad
Verabbanan amar rabbi yochanan zo shichvat zera shehu tame veadam hannotzer mimmennu tahor
Verabbi elazar omer ellu me hannidda shehammazze umazzin alav tahor venogea tame umazze tahor vehachtiv umazze me hannidda yechabbes begadav may mazze nogea
Vehachtiv mazze vehachtiv nogea veod mazze bae kibbus nogea la bae kibbus ella may mazze nose
Velichtov nose ka mashma lan dead dedare keshiur hazzaa hanicha leman deamar hazzaa tzericha shiur ella leman deamar en tzericha shiur may ika lememar
Afilu leman deamar enah tzericha shiur hane mile aggabba degavra aval bemana baenan shiur keditnan kamma yihu bammayim vihe bahen kede hazzaa kede sheyyitbol rashe givolin veyazze

b: Kol shekkorin lah imma imma veenah bosha rabbi zera verabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak chad amar kol sheenah makpedet vechad amar kol sheenah bosha may venayehu ika venayehu bosha veenah makpedet

Vela mibaya shekkivvena ella afilu pichata vaafilu hotira
Afilu pichata vela mibbaaya kivvena adderabba ki kivvena kava lah vistah vedayya sheatah
Vechi tema rabbanan hi difligi aleh derabbi dosa deamri ishsha sheyyesh lah veset metammea meet leet ipcha mibbee leh velema velo sheppichata vehotira ella afilu kivvena
Teni lo sheppichata vehotira ella afilu kivvena veibaet ema hachi kaamar velo shekkivvena ella sheppichata vehotira aval kivvena kava lah veset vedayya sheatah umanni rabbi dosa hi
Rabbi eliezer omer kal ishsha sheavru aleha vechu tanya amar lahem rabbi eliezer lachachamim maase beriva achat behayetalo shehifsika shalosh onot uva maase lifne chachamim veamru dayyah sheatah
Amru lo en sheat haddechak reaya may sheat haddechak ika deamri shene vatztzoret hao ika deamri teharot appesh laavida vaavada vechashshu rabbanan lehefsed ditharot

Ella dela itmar hilcheta la kemar valo kemar umay leachar shennizkar leachar shennizkar delav yachid pelig aleh ella rabbim peligi aleh amar keday hu rabbi eliezer lismoch alav bishat haddechak
Tanu rabbanan tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot veraata paam rishona dayyah sheatah sheniyya dayyah sheatah shelishit hare hi kechol hannashim umtammea meet leet umippekida lifkida
Avru aleha shalosh onot veraata dayyah sheatah veod avru aleha shalosh onot veraata dayyah sheatah veod avru aleha shalosh onot veraata hare hi kechol hannashim umtammea meet leet umippekida lifkida
Uchshehiggia zemannah lirot paam rishona dayyah sheatah sheniyya metammea meet leet umippekida lifkida avru aleha shalosh onot veraata dayyah sheatah
Amar mar avru aleha shalosh onot dayyah sheatah

Amar rav chilkiyya bar tove tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot afilu shofaat kol shiva enah ella reaya achat afilu shofaat vela mibbaya poseket adderabba poseket haveya lah kishte reiyyot
Ella tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot veshofaat kol shiva enah ella reaya achat
Amar rav shimi bar chiyya madlefet enah keroa veha kachazya ema enah keshofaat ella kefoseket
Mikkelal deshofaat name ki nahara ella ema enah ella keshofaat
Tanu rabbanan chazaka benot yisrael ad shello higgiu lefirkan hare hen bechezkat tohora veen hannashim bodkot otan mishshehiggiu lefirkan hare hen bechezkat tuma venashim bodkot otan
Rabbi yehuda omer en bodkin otan bayyad mippene shemmeavvetot otan ella sachot otan beshemen mibbifnim umkannechot otan mibbachutz vehen nivdakot meelehen
Rabbi yose omer meubberet vechu tane tanna kammeh derabbi elazar rabbi yose omer meubberet umnika sheavru aleha shalosh onot dayyah sheatah amar leh petachte bitre vesayyemte bachada

Dilma meubberet vehi menika kaamratte umilta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan dime iburah olin lah lime menikutah vime menikutah olin lah lime iburah kidtanya yeme iburah olin lah lime menikutah vime menikutah olin lah lime iburah
Ketzad hifsika shettayim bime iburah veachat bime menikutah shettayim bime menikutah veachat bime iburah achat umechetza bime iburah veachat umechetza bime menikutah mitztarfot leshalosh onot
Bishlama yeme iburah olin lah lime menikutah mashkachatte lah dekamnika veazla umiabbera ella yeme menikutah olin lah lime iburah hechi mashkachatte lah
Ibaet ema beleda yabbishta veibaet ema dam nidda lechod vedam leda lechod veibaet ema teni chada

Vechen amar rabbi shimon ben lakish akkullehu verabbi yochanan amar lo shanu ella betula uzkena aval meubberet umnika dayyan kol yeme iburan dayyan kol yeme menikutan ketannae meubberet umnika shehau

Veim raata rishona vechu amar rav huna kaftza veraata kaftza veraata kaftza veraata kava lah veset lemay ilema leyamim ha kol yoma dela kefitz la chazay
Ella likfitzot vehatanya kol shettikbaenna mechamat ones afilu kamma peamim lo kava veset may lav lo kava veset kelal

Mahu detema igallay milta lemafrea deoma hu dekagarem vela kefitza ka mashma lan dikfitza name deetmol gerama vehay dela chazay mishshum deakkatti la meta zeman kefitza

Lishana acharina amar rav huna kaftza veraata kaftza veraata kaftza veraata kava lah veset leyamim velo likfitzot hechi dame amar rav ashe dikfitz bechad beshabbat vachazay ukfitz bechad beshabbat vachazay uvshabbat kefatza vela chazay ulchad beshabbat acharina chazay bela kefitza dehatam igallay milta deoma hu deka garem
Matni af al pi sheamru dayyah sheatah tzericha lihot bodeket chutz min hannidda vehayyoshevet al dam tohar
Umshammeshet beedim chutz miyyoshevet al dam tohar uvtula sheddameha tehorim

Ufamim tzericha lihot bodeket shacharit uven hashshemashot uvshaa shehi overet leshammesh et betah yeterot alehen kohanot beshaa shehen ochlot bitruma rabbi yehuda omer af bishat avaratan milleechol bitruma
Gema chutz min hannidda divtoch yeme niddatah la bae bedika

Hanicha lerabbi shimon ben lakish deamar ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme zivatah veen ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddatah shappir ella lerabbi yochanan deamar ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddatah tivdok dilma kava lah veset
Amar lach rabbi yochanan ki amena ana hecha dachazeteh mimmayan satum aval chazeteh mimmayan patuach la amari
Vehayyoshevet al dam tohar ka salka datach mevakkeshet leshev al dam tohar
Hanicha lerav deamar mayan echad hu hattora timmeattu vehattora tiharattu shappir
Ella lelevi deamar shene mayanot hem tivdok dilma akkatti la pesak hahu mayan tame amar lach levi ha manni
b: Bet shammay hi deamri mayan echad hu ustam lan tanna kevet shammay setam veachar kach machloket hu vechol setam veachar kach machloket en halacha kistam
Vei baet ema mi katane mevakkeshet leshev yoshevet katane i yoshevet may lememra mahu detema tivdok dedilma kava lah veset ka mashma lan demayan tahor lemayan tame la kava
Hanicha lelevi deamar shene mayanot hem ella lerav deamar mayan echad hu tivdok dilma kava lah veset afilu hachi mime tohora lime tuma la kava
Umshammeshet beedim vechu tenan hatam tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot venisset bet shammay omrim notnin lah arba lelot uvet hillel omrim ad shettichye hammakka
Amar rav gidel amar shemuel lo shanu ella shello paska mechamat tashmish veraata shello mechamat tashmish aval paska mechamat tashmish veraata temea
Avar layela achat belo tashmish veraata temea nishtannu mare damim shellah temea metiv rabbi yona uvtula sheddameha tehorim ammay teshammesh beedim dedilma nishtannu mare damim shellah
Amar rava ema resha chutz min hannidda vehayyoshevet al dam tohar hu dela baaya bedika aval betula sheddameha tehorin baaya bedika ella kashyan ahadade
Kan sheshshimmesha deema shammash acharan kan shello shimmesha
Tanya name hachi bamme devarim amurim shello paska mechamat tashmish veraata shello mechamat tashmish
Aval paska mechamat tashmish veraata temea avar layela achat belo tashmish veraata temea nishtannu mare damim shellah temea
Paamayim hi tzericha vechu amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella litharot aval levalah mutteret peshita shacharit tenan

Ella i ittemar assefa ittemar uvshaa shehi overet leshammesh et betah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo shanu ella beishsha asuka bitharot demiggo devaaya bedika litharot baaya name bedika levalah aval enah asuka bitharot la baaya bedika
May ka mashma lan tenena kol hannashim bechezkat tohora levaalehen i mimmatnitin hava amena hane mile beishsha sheyyesh lah veset aval ishsha sheen lah veset baaya bedika

Veha matnitin beishsha sheyyesh lah veset askinan matnitin ben sheyyesh lah veset ben en lah veset veha ka mashma lan deaf al gav deyesh lah veset miggo devaaya bedika litharot baaya name bedika levalah

Veha amrah shemuel chada zimna deamar rabbi zera amar rabbi abba bar yirmeya amar shemuel ishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh ad shettivdok veokimna baasuka bitharot chada mikkelal chavertah ittemar
Tanya name hachi bamme devarim amurim litharot aval levalah mutteret bamme devarim amurim shehinnichah bechezkat tehora aval hinnichah bechezkat temea leolam hi betumatah ad shettomar lo tehora ani

a: Bea mineh rabbi zera merav yehuda ishsha mahu shettivdok atzmah levalah amar leh lo tivdok vetivdok uma bechach im ken libbo nokfo uforesh
Bea mineh rabbi abba merav huna ishsha mahu shettivdok atzmah keshiur veset kede lechayyev balah chattat
Amar leh mi mashkachatte lah livdika keshiur veset vehatanya ezehu shiur veset mashal leshammash vaed sheomdim betzad hammashkof bitziat hashshammash nichnas ed

Ika deamri hachi bea mineh ishsha mahu shettivdok atzmah kede lechayyev balah asham taluy amar lo lo tivdok vetivdok uma bechach im ken libbo nokfo uforesh

Uvshaa shehi overet vechu amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yannay vezehu iddan shel tzenuot amar leh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi amme tanna tane tzerichot veatte tane tzenuot amar leh sheani omer kol hamkayyem divre chachamim nikra tzanua

Amar leh yesh lah veset era baaya bedika yeshena la baaya bedika en lah veset ben era ben yeshena baaya bedika

Tanu rabbanan chammarin ufoalin vehabbain mibbet haevel umibbet hammishte neshehem lahem bechezkat tohora uvain veshohin immahem ben yeshenot ben erot bamme devarim amurim shehinnichan bechezkat tohora aval hinnichan bechezkat tuma leolam hi temea ad shettomar lo tehora ani
Veha shemuel bemay moke lah i besheyyesh lah veset kashya era vei besheen lah veset kashya ben era ben yeshena
Leolam besheyyesh lah veset vechevan shettevaah en lecha bedika gedola mizzo amar leh rav pappa lerava mahu lemebad ki ha matnita
b: Amar leh sudani la demigganya beappeh amar rav kahana sheeltinhu leinashe beteh derav pappa udrav huna bereh derav yehoshua ki ato rabbanan mibbe rav matzrechi lechu bedika vaamaru li la velishayelinhu ledidhu dilma inhu ka machmeri annafshayehu
Tanu rabbanan ishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh veen lah lo ketubba velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot umotzi velo machzir olamit divre rabbi meir
Rabbi chanina ben antignos omer meshammeshet bishne iddim hen ivvetuha hen tikkenuha mishshum abba chanan amru oy lo levalah
Asura leshammesh dilma mekalkela leh veen lah ketubba kevan dela chazya levia let lah ketubba
Velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot tenae ketubba kichtubba damu
Veotzi velo yachzir olamit peshita la tzericha dahadara veittakkana mahu detema lahderah ka mashma lan dezimnin deazla uminnasva umittakna
Veamar ilu hayiti yodea shekkach haya afilu heyitem notnin li mea mane lo hayiti megarshah venimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerin
Mishshum abba chanan amru oy lo levalah ika deamri lerabbi meir amar leh devae leagboyah ketubbetah ika deamri lerabbi chanina ben antignos kaamar leh dimkalkela leh
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi chanina ben antignos uvmay i baasuka bitharot ha amrah shemuel chada zimna

Vei besheenah asuka bitharot ha amar kol levalah la baaya bedika deamar rabbi zera amar rabbi abba bar yirmeya amar shemuel ishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh ad shettivdok veokimna lah baasuka bitharot man dematne ha la matne ha
Hadaran alach shammay omer

a: Matni kol hayyad hammarba livdok bannashim meshubbachat uvaanashim tikkatzetz
Gema may shena nashim umay shena anashim nashim lav benot hargasha ninhu meshubbachot anashim divne hargasha ninhu tikkatzetz
I hachi may irya marba ki lo marba name ki katane marba anashim
Tana bamme devarim amurim leinyan shichvat zera aval leinyan zov af hu meshubbach kannashim
Vaafilu leinyan shichvat zera im ba livdok bitzror o becheres bodek
Uvmatlet la vehatanya bodek atzmo bematlet uvchol davar sherotze kidamar abbaye bematlet ava hacha name bematlet ava
Vehecha itmar deabbaye aha ditnan haya ochel bitruma vehirgish shennizdazeu evarav ochez beammato uvolea et hatteruma
Ochez vehatanya rabbi eliezer omer kol haochez beammato umashtin keilu mevi mabbul laolam amar abbaye bematlet ava
Rava amar afilu tema bematlet rakka kevan daakar akar veabbaye chayesh dilma ate leosofe verava la chayesh dilma ate leosofe
Vela vehatanya ha lema ze dome lenoten etzba baayin shekkol zeman sheetzba baayin ayin madmaat vechozeret umadmaat
Verava kol ichammome vahadar ichammome beshateh la shechiach

Gufa rabbi eliezer omer kol haochez baamma umashtin keilu mevi mabbul laolam amru lo lerabbi eliezer vahalo nitztzotzot nittazin al raglav venire kichrut shofcha venimtza motzi laaz al banav shehen mamzerim
Amar lahen mutav sheyyotzi laaz al banav shehen mamzerim veal yaase atzmo rasha shaa achat lifne hammakom
Tanya idach amar lahen rabbi eliezer lachachamim efshar yaamod adam bemakom gavoha veyashtin o yashtin beafar tichuach veal yaase atzmo rasha shaa achat lifne hammakom
He amar lehu beresha ilema kammayeta amar lehu beresha batar deamar lehu isura hadar amar lehu takkanta
Ella ha amar lehu beresha vaamaru leh en lo makom gavoha veafar tichuach may amar lahen mutav sheyyotzi laaz al banav veal yaase atzmo rasha shaa achat lifne hammakom
Vechol kach lamma mippene shemmotzi shichvat zera levattala deamar rabbi yochanan kol hammotzi shichvat zera levattala chayyav mita shenneemar vayyera beene Adonai et asher asa vayyamet gam oto
Rabbi yitzchak verabbi amme amri keilu shofech damim shenneemar hannechamim baelim tachat kol etz raanan shochate hayeladim bannechalim tachat seife hasselaim al tikre shochate ella sochate
Rav assi amar keilu oved avoda zara ketiv hacha tachat kol etz raanan uchtiv hatam al heharim haramim vetachat kol etz raanan
Rav yehuda ushmuel hao kayemi aigara deve kenishta deshaf vitev binhardea amar leh rav yehuda lishmuel tzarich ani lehashtin amar leh shinana echoz baamatcha vehashten lachutz
Hechi aved hachi vehatanya rabbi eliezer omer kol haochez beammato umashtin keilu mevi mabbul laolam

Amar abbaye asao kevoleshet ditnan boleshet shennichnesa lair bishat shalom chaviyyot petuchot asurot setumot muttarot bishat milchama ellu veellu muttarot lefi sheen lahen penay lenassech alma dechevan diviti la ate lenassoche hacha name kevan diviti la ate leharhore
Vehacha may beituta ika ibaet ema biatuta delelya udigara veibaet ema biatuta derabbeh veibaet ema biatuta dishchina veibaet ema emta demareh aleh dekare shemuel aleh en ze yelud ishsha
Veibaet ema nasuy hava deamar rav nachman im haya nasuy muttar

Veibaet ema ki ha ori leh detane abba bereh derabbi binyamin bar chiyya aval mesayyea babbetzim millematta veibaet ema ki ha ori leh deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan gevul yesh lo meatara ulmatta muttar
b: Meatara ulmala asur

Amar rav hamkashshe atzmo ledaat yehe benidduy velema asur dekamgare yetzer hara annafsheh verabbi amme amar nikra avaryan shekkach ummanuto shel yetzer hara hayyom omer lo ase kach ulmachar omer lo ase kach ulmachar omer lo lech avod avoda zara veholech veoved
Ika deamri amar rabbi amme kol hammevi atzmo lide hirhur en machnisin oto bimchitzato shel hakkadosh baruch hu ketiv hacha vayyera beene Adonai uchtiv hatam ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurcha ra
Veamar rabbi elazar may dichtiv yedechem damim maleu ellu hamnaafim bayyad tana deve rabbi yishmael lo tinaf lo tehe becha niuf noef ben bayyad ben baregel
Tanu rabbanan haggerim vehamsachakin betinokot meakkevin et hammashiach bishlama gerim kidrabbi chelbo deamar rabbi chelbo kashin gerim leyisrael kesappachat ella mesachakin battinokot may hi
Ilema mishkav zechur bene sekila ninhu ella derech evarim bene mabbul ninhu
Ella denasvi ketannot delav benot olode ninhu deamar rabbi yose en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu kol hanneshamot shebbagguf shenneemar ki ruach millefanay yaatof unshamot ani asiti
Baanashim tikkatzetz ibaya lehu dina tenan o latuta tenan dina tenan ki ha derav huna katz yeda o latuta tenan

Ta shema detanya rabbi tarfon omer yad laamma tikkatzetz yado al tabburo amru lo yashav lo kotz bichreso lo yittelennu amar lahen lo vahalo kereso nivkaat amar lahen mutav tibbaka kereso veal yered liver shachat
I amratte bishlama dina tenan hayenu deamri vahalo kereso nivkaat ella i amratte latuta tenan may kereso nivkaat ella may dina tenan la saggi delav al tabburo

Ella hachi kaamar rabbi tarfon kol hammachnis yado lematta mittabburo tikkatzetz amru lo lerabbi tarfon yashav lo kotz bichreso lo yittelennu amar lahen lo vahalo kereso nivkaat amar lahen mutav tibbaka kereso veal yered liver shachat
Matni hachereshet vehashshota vehassoma veshennitrefa datah im yesh lahem pikkechot metakkenot otan vehen ochlot bitruma
Gema chereshet ihi tivdok lenafshah detanya amar rabbi chereshet hayeta bishchunatenu lo dayya shebbodeket leatzmah ella shechavroteha root umarot lah
Hatam bimdabberet veenah shomaat hacha besheenah medabberet veenah shomaat keditnan cheresh sheddibberu chachamim bechol makom eno shomea veeno medabber
Hassoma ihi tivdok lenafshah vetachze lachavirtah amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina soma enah mishna
Veshennitrefa datah hayenu shota shennitrefa datah mechamat choli
Tanu rabbanan kohen shote matbilin oto umaachilin oto teruma laerev umshammerin oto shello yishan yashan tame lo yashan tahor
Rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer osin lo kis shel or amru lo kol shekken shemmevi lide chimum amar lahen ledivrechem shote en lo takkana
Amru lo lidvarenu yashan tame lo yashan tahor lidvarecha shemma yire tippa kechardal vetibbala bakkis
Tana mishshum rabbi elazar amru osin lo kis shel mattechet
Amar abbaye veshel nechoshet kidtanya rabbi yehuda omer roin otan givolin shel ezov keilu hen shel nechoshet
Amar rav pappa shema minah michnasayim asurim vehachtiv vaase lahem michnese vad lechassot besar erva
Hahu kidtanya michnese chohanim lema hen domin kemin pemalanya shel parashim lemala ad motnayim lematta ad yerechayim veyesh lahem shenatzim veen lahem lo bet hannekev velo bet haerva
Amar abbaye

a: Rochve gemallim asurin leechol bitruma tanya name hachi rochve gemallim kullam reshaim hassappanim kullam tzaddikim
Hachammarim mehen reshaim mehen tzaddikim ika deamri ha demikkaf ha dela mikkaf veika deamri ha dimtarten ha dela metarten
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi layet amman degane apparkid ini vehaamar rav yosef perakdan lo yikra keriyyat shema keriyyat shema hu delo yikra ha migna shappir dame
Leinyan migna ki matzle shappir dame leinyan keriat shema ki matzle asur veha rabbi yochanan matzle vekare keriat shema shane rabbi yochanan devaal basar hava
Matni derech benot yisrael meshammeshot bishne edim echad lo veechad lah vehatztzenuot metakkenot shelishi letakken et habbayit
Nimtza al shello temein vechayyavin korban nimtza al shellah otom temein vechayyavin bekorban nimtza al shellah leachar zeman temein missafek ufturin min hakkorban
Ezehu achar zeman kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach paneha veachar kach metammea meet leet veenah metammea et boalah rabbi akiva omer af metammea et boalah
Modim chachamim lerabbi akiva beroa ketem shemmetammea et boalah
Gema venechush dilma dam maacholet hu amar rabbi zera oto makom baduk hu etzel maacholet veika deamri dachuk hu etzel maacholet
May benayehu ika benayehu deishtechach maacholet retzufa lehach lishana deamar baduk hu ha mealma atay lehach lishana deamar dachuk hu ema shammash retzafah
Ittemar badka beed habbaduk lah vetachattu birechah ulmachar matzata alav dam amar rav temea nidda amar leh rav shimi bar chiyya veha chosheshet amarte lan
Itmar name amar shemuel temea nidda vechen morin be midresha temea nidda
Ittemar badka beed sheeno baduk lah vehinnichattu bekufsa ulmachar matza alav dam amar rav yosef kol yamav shel rabbi chiyya time ulet ziknato tiher
Ibaya lehu hechi kaamar kol yamav time mishshum nidda ulet ziknato tiher mishshum nidda vetime mishshum ketem
O dilma kol yamav time mishshum ketem ulet ziknato tiher mivvelo kelum
Ta shema detanya badka beed sheeno baduk lah vehinnichattu bekufsa ulmachar matza alav dam rabbi omer temea mishshum nidda verabbi chiyya amar temea mishshum ketem
b: Amar lo rabbi chiyya i atta mode shetztzericha kigris veod amar lo aval amar lo im ken af atta asito ketem
Verabbi savar baenan kigris veod leappoke middam maacholet vechevan dinfak lah middam maacholet vadday miggufah ata
May lav beziknuto kae ha beyalduto time mishshum nidda shema minah
Mishtabbach leh rabbi lerabbi yishmael berabbi yose berabbi chama bar besa deadam gadol hu amar lo lichsheyyavo leyadcha haviehu leyadi
Ki ata amar leh bei minay milta bea mineh badka beed sheeno baduk lah vehinnichattu bekufsa ulmachar matza alav dam mahu
Amar lo kedivre abba ema lach o kedivre rabbi ema lach amar leh kedivre rabbi ema li
Amar rabbi yishmael zehu sheomrin alav deadam gadol hu heach mannichin divre harav veshomin divre hattalmid
Verabbi chama bar besa savar rabbi resh metivta hu ushchichi rabbanan kammeh umchaddedi shematateh
May rabbi umay rabbi yose amar rav adda bar matna tana rabbi metamme verabbi yose metaher
Veamar rabbi zera keshettime rabbi kerabbi meir uchshettiher rabbi yose leatzmo tiher
Detanya haishsha shehayeta osa tzeracheha veraata dam rabbi meir omer im omedet temea im yoshevet tehora
Rabbi yose omer ben kach uven kach tehora

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe veha amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina keshettime rabbi meir lo time ella mishshum ketem veilu rabbi mishshum nidda kaamar amar leh anan hachi kaamrinan ki itmar hahi mishshum nidda itmar
Nimtza al shellah otom temein vechu tanu rabbanan ezehu shiur veset mashal leshammash vaed sheomdin betzad hammashkof bitziat shammash nichnas ed
Heve veset sheamru lekinuach aval lo livdika
Nimtza al shellah leachar zeman vechu tana vechayyavin asham taluy vetanna didan may tama
Baenan chaticha mishte chatichot
Ezehu achar zeman vechu urminhi ezehu acher zeman peresh rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok kede shettoshit yadah tachat hakkar o tachat hakkeset vetittol ed vetivdok bo
Amar rav chisda may achar achar achar
Veha katane alah nimtza al shellah leachar zeman temein missafek ufturin min hakkorban ezehu achar zeman kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach paneha
Hachi kaamar ezehu achar zeman kede shettoshit yadah letachat hakkar o letachat hakkeset vetittol ed vetivdok bo uchde shettered min hammitta vetadiach et paneha machloket rabbi akiva vachachamim
Veha achar kach katane hachi kaamar vezehu achar kach shennechleku rabbi akiva vachachamim
Rav ashe amar ide veide chad shiura hu ed beyadah kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach et paneha en ed beyadah kede shettoshit yadah letachat hakkar o letachat hakkeset vetittol ed vetivdok bo
Metivi ezehu achar zeman davar ze shaal rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok lifne chachamim beusha veamar lahem

a: Shemma kerabbi akiva attem omrim shemmetammea et boalah amru lo lo shamanu
Amar lahem kach pershu chachamim beyavne lo shahata kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach et paneha toch zeman hu ze utmein missafek ufturin mikkorban vechayyavin beasham taluy
Shahata kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach et paneha achar hazzeman hu ze

Vechen kesheshshahata meet leet umippekida lifkida boalah metamme mishshum magga veeno metamme mishshum boel rabbi akiva omer af metamme mishshum boel rabbi yehuda beno shel rabban yochanan ben zakkay omer balah nichnas lahechal umaktir ketoret
Bishlama lerav chisda hayenu dimtahari rabbanan
Ella lerav ashe ammay metahari rabbanan
Vechi tema deen ed beyadah hay ed beyadah veen ed beyadah mibe leh kashya
Rabbi yehuda beno shel rabban yochanan ben zakkay omer balah nichnas lahechal umaktir ketoret vetipok leh dehave nogea bemeet leet shebbenidda
Hu deamar keshammay deamar kol hannashim dayyan sheatan
Vetipok leh dehave baal keri beshello gamar biato
Umodim chachamim lerabbi akiva beroa ketem amar rav lemafrea verabbi meir hi
Ushmuel amar mikkan ulhabba verabbanan hi mikkan ulhabba peshita
Mahu detema hoil umeet leet derabbanan uchtamim derabbanan ma meet leet lo metammea et boalah af ketamim lo metammea et boalah ka mashma lan
Veema hachi name hatam en shor shachut lefanecha hacha yesh shor shachut lefanecha
Vechen amar resh lakish lemafrea verabbi meir hi rabbi yochanan amar mikkan ulhabba verabbanan hi
Matni kol hannashim bechezkat tohora levalehen habbain min hadderech neshehen lahen bechezkat tohora
Gema lema leh lemitne habbain min hadderech salka datach amena hane mile hecha deiteh bemata deramya annafshah uvadka aval hecha deleteh bemata dela ramya annafshah la ka mashma lan
Amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia vehu shebba umtzaah betoch yeme onatah
Amar rav huna lo shanu ella sheen lah veset aval yesh lah veset asur leshammesh
Kelappe leya adderabba ipcha mistabbera en lah veset ema chazay yesh lah veset veset kevia lah
Ella i itmar hachi itmar amar rav huna lo shanu ella shello higgia et vistah aval higgia et vistah asura kasavar vesatot deorayeta
Rabba bar bar channa amar afilu higgia sheat vistah name mutteret kasavar vesatot derabbanan
Rav ashe matne hachi amar rav huna
b: Lo shanu ella sheen lah veset leyamim ella yesh lah veset leyamim velikfitzot kevan divmaase talya milta ema la kefitz vela chazay aval yesh lah veset leyamim asura leshammesh
Kasavar vesatot deorayeta
Rabba bar bar chana amar afilu yesh lah veset leyamim mutteret kasavar vesatot derabbanan
Amar rav shemuel mishshemeh derabbi yochanan ishsha sheyyesh lah veset balah mechashshev yeme vistah uva aleha
Amar leh rav shemuel bar yeva lerabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan afilu yalda divziza lemitbal
Amar leh attu vadday raata mi amar rabbi yochanan emar deamar rabbi yochanan safek raata safek lo raata veim timtza lomar raata ema tavla
Aval vadday raata mi yemar detavla have leh safek uvadday veen safek motzi mide vadday
Vela vehatanya chaver shemmet vehinniach megura melea perot afilu hen bene yoman hare hen bechezkat metukkanin veha hacha vadday tevel safek meussar safek eno meussar vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday
Hatam vadday uvadday hu kidrav chanina chozaa deamar rav chanina chozaa chazaka al chaver sheeno motzi mittachat yado davar sheeno metukkan
Veibaet ema safek vesafek hu vechidrabbi oshaya deamar rabbi oshaya maarim adam al tevuato umachnisah bammotz shellah kede shettehe behemto ochelet uftura min hammaaser
Veakkatti en safek motzi mide vadday vehatanya maase beshifchato shel massik echad berimon shehetila nefel levor uva kohen vehetzitz bo leda im zachar im nekeva
Uva maase lifne chachamim vetiharuhu mippene shechulda uvardelas metzuyim sham
Veha hacha devadday hetila nefel safek geraruhu safek lo geraruhu vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday
La tema hetila nefel levor ella ema

a: Kemin nefel
Veha leda im zachar im nekeva katane
Hachi kaamar uva kohen vehetzitz bo leda im nefel hippila im ruach hippila veim timtze lomar nefel hippila leda im zachar im nekeva
Veibaet ema kevan dechulda uvardelas metzuyim sham vadday geraruhu
Beo mineh merav nachman vesatot deorayeta o derabbanan
Amar lehu middeamar huna chavrin mishshemeh derav ishsha sheyyesh lah veset vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka ulvassof raata chosheshet levistah vechosheshet liriyyatah alma vesatot deorayeta
Ika deamri hachi kaamar lehu tama deraata ha lo raata en choshshin alma vesatot derabbanan

Itmar ishsha sheyyesh lah veset vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka ulvassof badka amar rav badka umatzat temea temea tehora tehora ushmuel amar afilu badka umatzat tehora name temea mippene sheorach bizmanno ba
Lema bivesatot kamipalgi demar savar deorayeta umar savar derabbanan
Amar rabbi zera dechulle alma vesatot deorayeta kan shebbadka atzmah keshiur veset kan shello badka atzmah keshiur veset
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar bivesatot gufayehu kamipalgi demar savar vesatot deorayeta umar savar vesatot derabbanan
Amar rav sheshet ketannae rabbi eliezer omer temea nidda
Verabbi yehoshua omer tibbadek vehane tannae ki hane tannae detanya rabbi meir omer temea nidda vachachamim omrim tibbadek

Amar abbaye af anan name tenena ditnan rabbi meir omer im hayeta bemachave vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka tehora shecharada mesalleket et haddamim tama deika charada ha leka charada temea alma vesatot deorayeta
Lema hane tannae beha name peligi detanya haroa dam mechamat makka afilu betoch yeme niddatah tehora divre rabban shimon ben gamliel
Rabbi omer im yesh lah veset chosheshet levistah
May lav beha kamipalgi demar savar vesatot deorayeta umar savar vesatot derabbanan
Amar ravina la dechulle alma vesatot derabbanan vehacha bemakor mekomo tame kamipalgi
Rabban shimon ben gamliel savar ishsha tehora vedam tame dekaate derech makor
Vaamar leh rabbi i chayeshatte leveset ishsha name temea vei la chayeshatte leveset makor mekomo tahor hu
Matni bet shammay omrim tzericha shene edim al kol tashmish vetashmish o teshammesh leor hanner bet hillel omrim dayyah bishne edim kol hallayela
b: Gema tanu rabbanan af al pi sheamru hamshammesh mittato leor hanner hare ze megunne bet shammay omrim tzericha shene edim al kol tashmish o teshammesh leor hanner uvet hillel omrim dayyah bishne edim kol hallayela
Tanya amru lahem bet shammay levet hillel ledivrechem lechush shemma tire tipat dam kechardal bevia rishona utchappenna shichvat zera bevia sheniyya
Amru lahem bet hillel af ledivrechem lechush ad sheharok betoch happe shemma nimok veholech lo
Amru lahem lefi sheeno dome nimok paam achat lenimok shette peamim
Tanya amar rabbi yehoshua roe ani et divre bet shammay amru lo talmidav rabbi kamma heerachta alenu amar lahem mutav sheaarich alechem baolam hazze kede sheyyaarichu yemechem laolam habba
Amar rabbi zera middivre kullam nilmad baal nefesh lo yivol veyishne
Rava amar boel veshona ki tanya hahi litharot

Tanya name hachi bamme devarim amurim litharot aval levalah mutteret uvamme devarim amurim shehinnichah bechezkat tohora aval hinnichah bechezkat temea leolam hi bechezkatah ad shettomar lo tehora ani
Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi chiyya bar ashe amar rav badka beed veavad asura leshammesh ad shettivdok matkef lah rabbi ila ilu ite mi la meshammesha veaf al gav dela yada hashta name teshammesh
Amar leh rava zo mochichah kayyam vezo en mochichah kayyam

Amar rabbi yochanan asur laadam sheyeshammesh mittato bayyom amar rav hamnuna may kera shenneemar yovad yom ivaled bo vehallayela amar hora gaver layela nitan leheraon veom lo nitan leheraon resh lakish amar mehacha boze derachav yamut

Veresh lakish hay kera derabbi yochanan may daresh beh mibbae leh lechiddaresh rabbi chanina bar pappa dedaresh rabbi chanina bar pappa oto malach hammunne al haheraon layela shemo venotel tippa umaamidah lifne hakkadosh baruch hu veomer lefanav ribbono shel olam tippa zo ma tehe aleha gibbor o challash chacham o tipesh ashir o ani
Veilu rasha o tzaddik la kaamar kidrabbi chanina deamar rabbi chanina hakkol bide shamayim chutz miyyirat shamayim shenneemar veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach ki im leyira vego
Verabbi yochanan im ken nichtov kera gever hora may hora gever layela nitan leheraon veom lo nitan leheraon

Verabbi yochanan hay kera deresh lakish may daresh beh mibbee leh lichdichtiv besefer ben sira shelosha saneti vearbaa lo ahavti sar hannirgal bevet hammishtaot veamri lah sar hannirgan veamri lah sar hannirgaz
Vehammoshiv shabbat bimrome keret vehaochez baamma umashtin mayim vehannichnas levet chavero pitom amar rabbi yochanan vaafilu leveto
Amar rabbi shimon ben yochay arbaa devarim hakkadosh baruch hu sonan vaani eni ohavan hannichnas leveto pitom veen tzarich lomar levet chavero vehaochez baamma umashtin mayim

a: Umashtin mayim arum lifne mittato vehamshammesh mittato bifne kal chay amar leh rav yehuda lishmuel vaafilu lifne achbarim amar leh shinana la ella kegon shel bet peloni shemmeshammeshin mittotehen bifne avdehem veshifchotehem
Veinhu may derush shevu lachem po im hachamor am haddome lachamor
Rabba bar rav huna mekarkesh zage dechilta abbaye bale didve rava bale paroche

Amar rabbi shimon ben yochay chamisha devarim hen shehaose otan mitchayyev benafsho vedamo berosho haochel shum kaluf uvatzal kaluf uvetza kelufa vehashshote mashkin mezugin sheavar alehen hallayela vehallan bevet hakkevarot vehannotel tzippornav vezorkan lirshut harabbim vehammakkiz dam umshammesh mittato

Haochel shum kaluf ku veaf al gav demannechi besilta umtzayeri vachatimi ruach raa shora alehen vela amaran ella dela shiyyer bahen ikaran o kelipatan aval shiyyer bahen ikaran o kelipatan let lan bah

Vehashshote mashkin mezugin sheavar alehen hallayela amar rav yehuda amar shemuel vehu shellanu bichle mattachot amar rav pappa uchle neter kichle mattachot damu vechen amar rabbi yochanan vehu shellanu bichle mattachot uchle neter kichle mattachot damu
Vehallan bevet hakkevarot kede shettishre alav ruach tuma zimnin dimsakkenin leh

Vehannotel tzippornav vezorkan lirshut harabbim mippene sheishsha meubberet overet alehen umappelet vela amaran ella deshakel bignustere vela amaran ella deshakel dideh udchareh vela amaran ella dela gaz mide batrayehu aval gaz mide batrayehu let lan bah vela hi lechullah milta chayeshinan
Tanu rabbanan shelosha devarim neemru batztzippornayim sorfan chasid kovran tzaddik zorkan rasha

Vehammakkiz dam umshammesh mittato deamar mar makkiz dam umshammesh mittato hoviyn lo banim vitkin hikkizu shenehem veshimmeshu hoviyn lo banim baale ratan amar rav vela amaran ella dela teem mide aval teem mide let lan bah

Amar rav chisda asur lo laadam sheyeshammesh mittato bayyom shenneemar veahavta lereacha kamocha may mashma amar abbaye shemma yire bah davar megunne vetitganne alav amar rav huna yisrael kedoshim hem veen meshammeshin mittotehen bayyom
Amar rava veim haya bayit afel muttar vetalmid chacham maafil bichsuto umshammesh
Tenan o teshammesh leor hanner ema tivdok leor hanner
Ta shema af al pi sheamru hamshammesh mittato leor hanner hare ze megunne ema habbodek mittato leor hanner hare ze megunne

Ta shema veshel bet monbaz hammelech hau osin shelosha devarim umazkirin otan leshevach hau meshammeshin mittotehem bayyom uvodkin mittotehem bemela parhava venohagin tuma vetohora bishlagim katane miha meshammeshin mittotehen bayyom
Ema bodkin mittotehem bayyom hachi name mistabbera dei salka datach meshammeshin mazkirin otan leshevach in hachi name deaggav deika ones shena migganneya beappeh

Uvodkin mittotehen bemela parhava mesayya leh lishmuel deamar shemuel en bodkin et hammitta ella befakolin o betzemer naki verach amar rav hayenu dechi havay hatam bearve shabbatot hao amri man bae pakole benahama vela yadana may kaamri
Amar rava hane shachake dechitana meallu livdika ini veha tana deve menashshe en bodkin et hammitta lo beed edom velo beed shachor velo befishtan ella befakolin o betzemer naki verach
La kashya ha bechitana ha bemane dechitana veibaet ema ha veha bemane dechitana ha bechadte ha beshachake
Nohagin tuma vetohora bishlagin tenan hatam sheleg eno lo ochel velo mashke chishev alav laachila eno metamme tumat ochalin lemashke metamme tumat mashkin
Nitma miktzato lo nitma kullo nithar miktzato nithar kullo
Ha gufa kashya amratte nitma miktzato lo nitma kullo vahadar tane amratte nithar miktzato nithar kullo lememra denitma kullo
Amar abbaye kegon sheheeviro al avir tannur dehattora heida al keli cheres
b: Afilu male chardal
Matni mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha hacheder vehapperozdor vehaaliyya
Dam hacheder tame dam haaliyya tahor nimtza bapperozdor sefeko tame lefi shechezkato min hammakor

Gema rame bar shemuel verav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda teno nidda be rav huna ashkechinhu rabba bar rav huna deyatvi vekaamri hacheder mibbifnim vehapperozdor mibbachutz vaaliyya benuya al shettehen velul patuach ben aliyya lapperozdor
Nimtza min hallul velifnim sefeko tame min hillul velachutz sefeko tahor
Ata vaamar leh laavuh sefeko tame amarte lan mar veha anan shechezkato min hammakor tenan
Amar leh ana hachi kaamena min hallul velifnim vadday tame min hallul velachutz sefeko tame
Amar abbaye may shena min hallul velachutz disfeko tame dedilma shachata umecheder ata min hallul velifnim name ema izdekara umealiyya ata
Ella amar abbaye i batar chashasha azlatte ide veide safek hu vei batar chazaka azlatte min hallul velifnim vadday tame min hallul velachutz vadday tahor
Tane rabbi chiyya dam hannimtza bapperozdor chayyavin alav al biat mikdash vesorfin alav et hatteruma verav kattina amar en chayyavin alav al biat mikdash veen sorfin alav et hatteruma
Lehach lishana deamar abbaye i batar chashasha azlatte mesayya leh lerav kattina ufliga derabbi chiyya
Lehach lishana deamratte i batar chazaka azlatte mesayya leh lerabbi chiyya

a: Ufliga derav kattina
Lerav huna la peligi kan min hallul velifnim kan min hallul velachutz
Ella lerame bar shemuel ulrav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda deamri min hallul velachutz sefeko tahor min hallul velifnim sefeko tame hane bemay mittokma min hallul velifnim
Lema peliga derabbi chiyya
La kashya kan keshennimtza bakkarka perozdor vechan shennimtza begag perozdor
Amar rabbi yochanan bishlosha mekomot halchu bo chachamim achar harov vaasaum kevadday makor shilya chaticha makor ha daamaran
Shilya ditnan shilya bevayit habbayit tame velo shehashshilya valad ella sheen shilya belo valad rabbi shimon omer nimmok havalad ad shello yatza
Chaticha ditnan hammappelet yad chatucha veregel chatucha immo temea leda veen choshshin shemma migguf atum bat
Vetu leka vehaika tesha chanuot
Detanya tesha chanuot kullan mochrot besar shechuta veachat mocheret besar nevela velakach meachat mehen veeno yodea meeze mehen lakach sefeko asur
Uvannimtza hallech achar harov
Tuma kaamrinan isur la kaamrinan
Vehaika tesha tzefardein vesheretz echad benehem venaga beechad mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen naga birshut hayyachid sefeko tame birshut harabbim sefeko tahor
Uvannimtza hallech achar harov
Tuma deishsha kaamrinan tuma bealma la kaamrinan
Vehaika ha deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi avra bannahar
b: Vehippila mevia korban veneechal
Hallech achar rov nashim verov nashim valad mealleya yaldan
Matnitin kaamrinan shematata la kaamrinan
Veha ki ata ravin amar metiv rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina toa vela yadana may teuvteh
May lav la teuvta ella siyyata
La dilma la teuvta velo siyyata
Lemaote may
Ilema lemaote rubba deika chazaka bahadeh dela sarfinan aleh et hatteruma veha amrah rabbi yochanan chada zimna
Ditnan tinok hannimtza betzad haisa uvatzek beyado rabbi meir metaher vachachamim metammein sheddarko shel tinok letappeach
Veamrinan may tama derabbi meir kasavar rov tinokot metappechin umiut en metappechin veisa zo bechezkat tehora omedet semoch miuta lachazaka veitra leh rubba
Verabbanan miuta keman deleteh dame verubba vachazaka rubba adif
Veamar resh lakish mishshum rabbi oshaya zo hi chazaka shessorfin aleha et hatteruma verabbi yochanan amar en zo chazaka shessorfin aleha et hatteruma
Ella lemaote rubba derabbi yehuda ditnan hammappelet chaticha im yesh immah dam temea veim lav tehora rabbi yehuda omer ben kach uven kach temea

Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo time rabbi yehuda ella bachaticha shel arba mine damim aval shear mine damim tehora verabbi yochanan amar shel arba mine damim divre hakkol temea veshel shear damim divre hakkol tehora lo nechleku ella keshehippila

a: Veenah yodaat ma hippila rabbi yehuda savar zil batar rov chatichot verov chatichot shel arba mine damim haveyan verabbanan savri zil batar rov chatichot la amrinan

Matni chamishsha damim temeim baishsha haadom vehashshachor uchkeren karkom uchmeme adama vechammazug bet shammay omrim af kememe tiltan uchmeme basar tzali uvet hillel metaharim hayyarok akavya ben mahalalel metamme vachachamim metaharin
Amar rabbi meir im eno metamme mishshum ketem metamme mishshum mashke rabbi yose omer lo kach velo kach
Ezehu adom kedam hammakka shachor kecheret amok mikken tame dehe mikken tahor uchkeren karkom kabbarur shebbo
Uchmeme adama mibbikat bet kerem umetzef mayim vechammazug shene chalakim mayim veechad yayin min hayyayin hashsharoni
Gema menalan deika dam tahor baishsha dilma kol dam deate minah tame
Amar rabbi chama bar yosef amar rabbi oshaya amar kera ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat ben dam ledam ben dam tahor ledam tame
Ella meatta ben nega lanega hachi name ben nega tame lenega tahor vechi tema hachi name nega tahor mi ika vechi tema kullo hafach lavan tahor hu hahu bohak mikkere
Ella ben nige adam lenige vattim ulnige vegadim vechullan temein hacha name ben dam nidda ledam ziva vechullan temein
Hay may bishlama hatam ika leippeloge zaken mamre verabbanan benige adam uviflugta derabbi yehoshua verabbanan
Ditnan im baheret kodem lesear lavan tame veim sear lavan kodem labbaheret tahor safek tame verabbi yehoshua omer keha veamar rabba keha vetahor

Benige vattim ki ha pelugta derabbi elazar berabbi shimon verabbanan ditnan rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer leolam en habbayit tame ad sheyyerae kishne gerisin al shene avanim bishne ketalim bekeren zavit orko kishne gerisin verochbo kigris
May tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon ketiv kir uchtiv kirot ezehu kir shehu kishne kirot heve omer ze keren zavit
Benige vegadim biflugta derabbi yonatan ben avtulmos verabbanan detanya rabbi yonatan ben avtulmos omer minnayin lifrichat begadim shehi tehora
Neemar karachat vegabbachat babbegadim veneemar kerachat vegabbachat baadam
Ma lehallan parach bechullo tahor af kan name parach bechullo tahor
Ella hacha i dam tahor leka bemay peligi
Umimmay dehane tehorin vehane temein amar rabbi avahu deamar kera vayyiru moav et hammayim adummim kaddam lememra dedam adom hu ema adom vetu la
Amar rabbi avahu amar kera dameha dameha hare kan arbaa
Veha anan chamishsha tenan amar rabbi chanina shachor adom hu ella shellaka
Tanya name hachi shachor kecheret amok mikken tame dehe afilu kichchol tahor veshachor ze lo mittechillato hu mashchir ella keshenneekar hu mashchir mashal ledam makka lichshenneekar hu mashchir
Bet shammay omrim af kememe tiltan velet lehu levet shammay dameha dameha hare kan arbaa
Ibaet ema let lehu veibaet ema it lehu mi la amar rabbi chanina shachor adom hu ella shellaka hachi name milka hu delake
Uvet hillel metaharin hayenu tanna kamma
Ika venayehu
b: Litlot
Hayyarok akavya ben mahalalel metamme velet leh laakavya dameha dameha hare kan arbaa
