Ibaet ema let leh veibaet ema it leh mi la amar rabbi chanina shachor adom hu ella shellaka hacha name milka hu delake
Vachachamim metaharin hayenu tanna kamma ika venayehu litlot
Amar rabbi meir im eno metamme mishshum ketem ku

Amar rabbi yochanan yarad rabbi meir leshitat akavya ben mahalalel vetime vehachi kaamar lehu lerabbanan nehi dehecha deka mashkachatte ketem yarok ammana la metammeitu hecha dekachazya dam yarok miggufah tetamme
I hachi im eno metamme mishshum ketem metamme mishshum mashke mishshum roa mibbaya leh
Ella hachi kaamar lehu nehi hecha deka chazya dam yarok meikara la metammeitu hecha dechazya dam adom vahadar chazya dam yarok tetamme mide dehave ammashke zav vezava
Verabbanan dumya derok ma rok shemmitaggel veotze af kol shemmitaggel veotze leappoke hay deen mitaggel veotze i hachi shappir kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi meir
Ella hachi kaamar lehu leheve kemashke lehachshir et hazzeraim verabbanan bae dam chalalim veleka i hachi shappir kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi meir
Ella hachi kaamar lehu allefuha bigzera shava ketiv hacha shelachayich pardes rimmonim uchtiv hatam vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot
Verabbanan adam dan kal vachomer meatzmo veen adam dan gezera shava meatzmo
Rabbi yose omer lo kach vechu hayenu tanna kamma ha ka mashma lan man tanna kamma rabbi yose vechol haomer davar beshem omro mevi geulla laolam
Ezehu adom kedam hammakka may kedam hammakka amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kedam shor shachut
Velema kedam shechita i amar kedam shechita hava amena kechullah shechita ka mashma lan kedam hammakka kitchilat hakkaa shel sakkin
Ulla amar kedam tzippor chayya ibaya lehu chayya leappoke shachut o dilma leappoke kachush teku
Zeeri amar rabbi chanina kedam maacholet shel rosh metivi harga maacholet hare zo tola bah may lav dechulleh gufah la dereshah
Amme vardinaa amar rabbi avahu kedam etzba ketanna shel yad shenniggefa vechayeta vechazra veniggefa velo shel kol adam ella shel bachur shello nasa ishsha vead kamma ad ben esrim
Metivi tole bivnah uvvalah bishlama bivnah mashkachatte lah ella balah hechi mashkachatte lah
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak kegon shennichnesa lachuppa velo nivala
Rav nachman amar kedam hakkaza metivi maase vetala rabbi meir

a: Bekilor verabbi tala bisraf shikma may lav aadom
La ashshear damim

Ammemar umar zutra verav ashe hao yatvi kammeh ummana shakli leh karna kammayeta leammemar chazyeh amar lehu adom ditnan ki hay shakli leh achariti amar lehu ishtanni amar rav ashe kegon ana dela yadana ben hay lehay la mibbee li lemichze dema

Shachor kecheret amar rabba bar rav huna cheret sheamru deo tanya name hachi shachor kecheret veshachor sheamru deo velema deo i amar deo hava amena ki fichchuta didota ka mashma lan ki charuta didota
Ibaya lehu belacha o beyabbishta ta shema derabbi amme pale kurta didota uvadek beh
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kekir kido uchenav temea vezohi sheshshaninu amok mikken temea amar rabbi elazar kezayit kezefet uchorev tahor vezohi sheshshaninu dehe mikken tahor
Ulla amar kilvusha siyyua ulla ikkela lefumbedita chazyeh lehahu tayyaa dilvish levusha ukkama amar lehu shachor ditnan ki hay meratu mineh purta purta yehavu beh arba mea zuze

Rabbi yochanan amar ellu kelim haolyarin habbaim mimmedinat hayyam lememra deukkame ninhu vehaamar lehu rabbi yannay levanav banay al tikberuni lo bechelim shechorim velo bechelim levanim shechorim shema ezke veehye keavel ben hachatanim levanim shemma lo ezke veehye kechatan ben haavelim ella bechelim haolyarin habbaim mimmedinat hayyam
Alma lav ukkame ninhu la kashya ha biglima ha befatura
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel vechullam en bodkin ella al gabbe matlet levana amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi veshachor al gabbe adom
Amar rav yirmeya middifti vela peligi ha beshachor ha bishar damim matkef lah rav ashe i hachi lema shemuel chutz mishshachor ella amar rav ashe beshachor gufeh kamipalgi
Amar ulla kullan amok mikken tame dehe mikken tahor kashshachor
Veella may shena shachor denaket salka datach amina hoil veamar rabbi chanina shachor adom hu ella shellaka hilkach afilu dehe mikken name litamme kamashma lan
Rabbi amme bar abba amar vechullan amok mikken tame dehe mikken name tame chutz mishshachor ella may ahani shiure derabbanan leappoke dehe dedeha
Veika deamri rame bar abba amar vechullan amok mikken tahor dehe mikken tahor chutz mishshachor ulhachi mahane shiure derabbanan

Bar kappara amar vechullan amok mikken tame dehe mikken tahor chutz mimmezeg sheamok mikken tahor dehe mikken tahor bar kappara adihu leh vedakki aamiku leh vedakki amar rabbi chanina kamma nefish gavra delibbeh kishmateh
Uchkeren karkom tana lach velo yavesh
Tane chada kattachton lo kaelon vetanya idach kaelon velo kattachton vetanya idach kaelon vechol shekken kattachton vetanya idach kattachton vechol shekken kaelon
Amar abbaye telata dare utlata tarfe haveyan
Nekot dara metziaa vetarpa metzia bidach
Ki atu lekammeh derabbi avahu amar lehu begushayehu shaninu

Uchmeme adama tanu rabbanan kememe adama mevi adama shemena mibbikat bet kerem umetzif aleha mayim divre rabbi meir rabbi akiva omer mibbikat yodfat rabbi yose omer mibbikat sichni rabbi shimon omer af mibbikat ginnosar vechayyotze bahen

Tanya idach uchmeme adama mevi adama shemena mibbikat bet kerem umetzif aleha mayim kiklipat hashshum veen shiur lammayim mishshum deen shiur leafar veen bodkin otan tzelulin ella achurin tzallu chozer veochran uchshehu ochran en ochran bayyad ella bichli
Ibaya lehu en ochrin otan bayyad ella bichli dela lirmeyeh bideh velakerinhu aval bemana ki achar leh bideh shappir dame o dilma dela lakerinhu bideh ella bemana
Ta shema keshehu bodkan en bodkan ella bechos vaadayin tibbee lach bedika bechos achira bemay teku
Ki atu lekammeh derabba bar avuh amar lehu bimkomah shaninu rabbi chanina pale kurta degargishta uvadek beh layet aleh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose beaskara
b: Rabbi chanina hu dechakkim kulle alma lav chakkimi hachi

Amar rabbi yochanan chuchmeta derabbi chanina gerama li dela echze dema metammena metahar metaharna metamme amar rabbi elazar invetanuta derabbi chanina gerama li dachazay dema uma rabbi chanina deinvetan hu machet nafsheh lesafek vechaze ana la echze
Amar rabbi zera tiva devavel gerama li dela chazay dema deamena betiva la yadana bidma yadana
Lememra divtiva talya milleta veha rabba hu deyada betiva vela yada bidma kol shekken kaamar uma rabba deyada betiva la chaza dema vaana echze
Ulla ikkela lefumbedita ayeto lekammeh dema vela chaza amar uma rabbi elazar demara deara deyisrael hava ki mikkela leatra derabbi yehuda la chaze dema ana echze

Veammay karu leh mara deara deyisrael dehahi itteta deayetay dema lekammeh derabbi elazar hava yatev rabbi amme kammeh archeh amar lah hay dam chimud hu batar denafka ittefal lah rabbi amme amara leh baali haya badderech vachamadtiv kare aleh sod Adonai lireav

Ifra hormiz immeh deshabbur malka shaddara dema lekammeh derava hava yatev rav ovadya kammeh archeh amar lah hay dam chimud hu amara leh livreh ta chazi kamma chakkime yehudae amar lah dilma kesome baarubba
Hadar shaddara leh shittin mine dema vechullehu amrinhu hahu batra dam kinnim hava vela yeda istayya milta veshaddar lah serikuta dimkattela kalme amara yehudae bitvane delibba yatvitu
Amar rav yehuda meresha hava chazena dema kevan deamra li immeh deyitzchak beri hay tipta kammayeta la mayetinan lah kammayehu derabbanan mishshum dizhima la chazena
Ben temea lithora vadday chazena
Yalta ayetay dema lekammeh derabba bar bar channa vetammi lah hadar ayetay lekammeh derav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda vedakki lah
Vehechi aved hachi vehatanya chacham shettime en chavero rashshay letaher asar en chavero rashshay lehattir
Meikara tammoye hava metamme lah kevan daamara leh dechol yoma hava medakke li ki hay gavena vehaidana hu dechash beeneh dakki lah
Umi mehemna in vehatanya neemenet ishsha lomar kaze raiti veibbadtiv
Ibaya lehu kaze tiher ish peloni chacham mahu
Ta shema neemenet ishsha lomar kaze raiti veibbadtiv shane hatam deleteh lekammeh

Ta shema deyalta ayetay dema lekammeh derabba bar bar channa vetammi lah lekammeh derav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda vedakki lah vehechi aved hachi vehatanya chacham shettime en chavero rashshay letaher vechu
Veamrinan tammoye hava metamme lah kevan daamara leh dechol yoma medakke lah ki hay gavena vehaidana hu dechash beeneh hadar dakki lah alma mehemna leh
Rav yitzchak bar yehuda aggemareh semach
Rabbi raa dam ballayela vetime raa bayyom vetiher himtin shaa achat chazar vetime amar oy li shemma taiti
Shemma taiti vadday taa detanya lo yomar chacham ilu haya lach haya vadday tame

Ella en lo laddayyan ella ma sheenav root meikara achzekeh betame kevan dachaza letzafra deishtanni amar vadday tahor hava uvallayela hu dela itchazi shappir kevan dachaza dahadar ishtanni amar hay tame hu umifkach hu deka fachach veazel

Rabbi badek leor hanner rabbi yishmael berabbi yosef badek beom hamunnan bene ammude amar rav amme bar shemuel vechullan en bodkin otan ella ben chamma letzel rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh bechamma uvtzel yado
Vechammazug shene chalakim ku tana

a: Hashsharoni nidon kakkarmeli chay velo mazug chadash velo yashan

Amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi vechullan en bodkin otan ella bechos teverya pashut may tama amar abbaye shel kol haolam kullo machzik log osin oto mimmane shene luggin osin oto mimmatayim kos teverya pashut afilu machazik shene luggin osin oto mimmane veayede diklish yedia beh tefe
Hadaran alach kal hayyad
Matni hammappelet chaticha im yesh immah dam temea veim lav tehora rabbi yehuda omer ben kach uven kach temea
Hammappelet kemin kelipa kemin saara kemin afar kemin yavchushin adummim tatil lammayim im nimmochu temea veim lav tehora
Hammappelet kemin dagim chagavim shekatzim urmasim im yesh immahem dam temea veim lav tehora
Hammappelet min behema chayya vaof ben temein ben tehorin im zachar teshev lezachar veim nekeva teshev linkeva
Veim en yadua teshev lezachar velannekeva divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim kol sheen bo mitztzurat adam eno valad
Gema amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo time rabbi yehuda ella bachaticha shel arbaat mine damim aval shel shear mine damim tehora
Verabbi yochanan amar shel arbaat mine damim divre hakkol temea shel shear mine damim divre hakkol tehora

Lo nechleku ella shehippila veenah yodaat ma hippila rabbi yehuda savar zil batar rov chatichot verov chatichot shel mine arbaat mine damim haveyan verabbanan savri la amrinan rov chatichot shel arbaat mine damim

Ini veha ki ata rav hoshaya minnehardea ata veayeti matnita bideh hammappelet chaticha adumma shechora yerukka ulvana im yesh immah dam temea veim lav tehora rabbi yehuda omer ben kach uven kach temea kashya lishmuel bachada ulrabbi yochanan betarte
Lishmuel bachada deamar shemuel lo time rabbi yehuda ella bachaticha shel arbaat mine damim veha katane yerukka ulvana uflig rabbi yehuda
Vechi tema ki pelig rabbi yehuda aadumma ushchora veayerukka ulvana la ella yerukka ulvana leman katane lah
Ilema rabbanan hashta adumma ushchora metahari rabbanan yerukka ulvana mibaya ella lav lerabbi yehuda uflig
Vetu lerabbi yochanan deamar shel arbaat mine damim divre hakkol temea ha katane adumma ushchora ufligi rabbanan
Vechi tema ki peligi rabbanan ayerukka ulvana aval aadumma ushchora la ella adumma ushchora leman katane lah
Ilema rabbi yehuda hashta yerukka ulvana temea adumma ushchora mibaya ella lav rabbanan ufligi
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak beefshar liftichat hakkever belo dam kamipalgi uviflugta dehane tannae detanya kishsheta shenayim velashshelishi hippila veenah yodaat ma hippila
b: Hare zo sefek leda sefek ziva mevia korban veeno neechal
Rabbi yehoshua omer mevia korban veneechal shei efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam
Lishana achrina amri lah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel lo time rabbi yehuda ella bachaticha shel arbaa mine damim aval shel shear mine damim tehora

Ini veha ki ata rav hoshaya minnehardea ata veayeti matnita bideh hammappelet chaticha adumma ushchora yerukka ulvana im yesh immah dam temea veim lav tehora verabbi yehuda omer ben kach uven kach temea
Katane adumma ushchora yerukka ulvana uflig rabbi yehuda
Vechi tema ki pelig rabbi yehuda aadumma ushchora aval yerukka ulvana la ella yerukka ulvana man katane lah
Ilema lerabbanan hashta adumma ushchora ka metahari rabbanan yerukka ulvana mibaya ella lav lerabbi yehuda uflig

Ella amar rav yehuda beefshar liftichat hakkever belo dam kamipalgi uviflugta dehane tannae detanya kishsheta shenayim velashshelishi hippila veenah yodaat ma hippila hare zo sefek leda sefek ziva mevia korban veeno neechal
Rabbi yehoshua omer mevia korban veneechal lefi shei efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam
Tanu rabbanan hammappelet chaticha somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir vechen haya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer kidvarav korah im yesh dam betochah temea veim lav tehora
Kerabbanan vaadifa midderabbanan kerabbanan deamri efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam vaadifa midderabbanan deinhu savri immah in betochah la vesomchos savar afilu betochah
Vetanya idach hammappelet chaticha rabbi acha omer korah im tochah maadim temea veim lav tehora
Kesomchos vaadifa missomchos

Vetanya idach hammappelet chaticha rabbi binyamin omer korah im yesh bah etzem immo temea leda amar rav chisda uvachaticha levana vechen ki ata zuga demin chadyav ata veayeti matnita bideh hammappelet chaticha levana korah im yesh bah etzem immo temea leda
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay hammappelet chaticha korah im yesh bah dam agur temea veim lav tehora kesomchos vekila mikkullehu
Bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera haroa dam bishfoferet mahu bivsarah amar rachamana velo bishfoferet o dilma hay bivsarah mibe leh shemmetammea mibbifnim kevachutz
Amar leh bivsarah amar rachamana velo bishfoferet dei bivsarah mibbae leh shemmetammea mibbifnim kevachutz im ken nema kera babbasar may bivsarah shema mina tarte
Veha amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay hammappelet chaticha korah im yesh bah dam agur temea veim lav tehora
Hachi hashta hatam darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bachaticha hacha en darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bishfoferet
Lema shefoferet tannae hi detanya hammappelet chaticha af al pi shemmelea dam im yesh immah dam temea veim lav tehora rabbi eliezer omer bivsarah velo bashshafir velo bachaticha
Rabbi eliezer hayenu tanna kamma ema sherabbi eliezer omer bivsarah velo bashshafir velo bachaticha
Vachachamim omrim en ze dam nidda ella dam chaticha tanna kamma name tahore metaher ella defallay palloye ika venayehu
Tanna kamma savar bivsarah velo bashshafir velo bachaticha vehu haddin lishfoferet vehane mile hecha deshia aval pallay palloye temea may tameh bivsarah karena beh
Veatu rabbanan lememar af al gav defallay palloye en ze dam nidda ella dam chaticha ha dam nidda vadday tame vaafilu bishfoferet name
Amar abbaye bishfoferet kulle alma la peligi dithora

a: Ki peligi bachaticha mar savar darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bachaticha umar savar en darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bachaticha
Rava amar dechulle alma en darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bachaticha
Vehacha beishsha tehora umkor mekomo tame kamipalgi derabbi eliezer savar ishsha tehora vedam tame deha ate derech makor verabbanan savri ishsha tehora umakor mekomo tahor
Bea mineh rabba merav huna haroe keri bekesam mahu mimmennu amar rachamana ad denafek mibbesaro velo bekesam o dilma hay mimmennu ad shettetze tumato lachutz vaafilu bekesam name
Amar leh tipok leh dehu atzmo eno metamme ella bachatimat pi haamma
Lememra denogea have ella meatta al yistor beziva
Allema tanya zot torat hazzav vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara ma ziva soteret af shichvat zera name soter
Amar leh setira hayenu tama desoter lefi shei efshar lah belo tzichtzuche ziva
Ella meatta tistor kol shiva allema tanya zot torat hazzav vego ma ziva soteret af shichvat zera soteret
I ma ziva soteret kol shiva af shichvat zera name soteret kol shiva talmud lomar letoma vah en lecha bah ella ma sheamur bah soteret yom echad
Amar leh gezerat hakkatuv hi ziva gemura dela ariva bah shichvat zera satra kol shiva tzichtzuche ziva daariva bah shichvat zera la satra ella yom echad

Bea mineh rabbi yose berabbi chanina merabbi elazar dam yavesh mahu ki yazuv zov damah amar rachamana ad demedav dayev leh lach in yavesh la o dilma hay ki yazuv zav dama orcha demilta hi ulolam afilu yavesh name
Amar leh tenetuha dam hannidda uvsar hammet metammein lachim viveshim amar leh lach venaasa yavesh la ka mibaya li ki mibaya li yavesh meikara
Ha name tenetuha hammappelet kemin kelipa kemin searah kemin afar kemin yavchushin adummin tatil lammayim
b: Im nimmochu temea i hachi belo nimmochu name amar rabba ki lo nimmochu beriyya bifne atzmah hi
Umi ika ki hay gavena in vehatanya amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok shene maasim heela abba mittivin leyavne

Maase beishsha shehayeta mappelet kemin kelipot adummot uvau veshaalu et abba veabba shaal lachachamim vachachamim shaalu larofim veamru lahem ishsha zo makka yesh lah betoch meeha shemmimmenna mappelet kemin kelipot tatil lammayim im nimmochu temea

Veshuv maase beishsha shehayeta mappelet kemin searot adummot uvaa veshaala et abba veabba shaal lachachamim vachachamim larofim veamru lahem shuma yesh lah betoch meeha shemmimmenna mappelet kemin searot adummot tatil lammayim im nimmochu temea
Amar resh lakish uvfoshrin tanya name hachi tatil lemayim uvfoshrin rabban shimon ben gamliel omer memaachto berok al gabbe hatztzipporen may benayehu amar ravina mauch al yede haddechak ika venayehu
Hatam tenan kamma hi sheriyyatan befoshrin meet leet hacha may mi baena meet leet o la
Sheretz unvela daakoshe baenan meet leet aval dam derakkich la o dilma la shena teku
Hammappelet kemin dagim veliflog name rabbi yehuda beha

Amar resh lakish bemachloket shenuya verabbanan hi verabbi yochanan amar afilu tema rabbi yehuda ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam ella gabbe chaticha deaved dam dekaresh vehave chaticha aval beriyya la have
Ulhach lishana deamar rabbi yochanan bei efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam kamipalgi liflog name rabbi yehuda beha
Man dematne hach lishana matne hachi rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu bemachloket shenuya verabbanan hi
Hammappelet kemin behema vechu
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel may tama derabbi meir hoil veneemra bo yetzira keadam
Ella meatta hammappelet demut tannin tehe immo temea leda hoil veneemra bo yetzira keadam shenneemar vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim
Amri danin yetzira mitzira veen danin beria mitzira
May nafka minah ha tana deve rabbi yishmael veshav hakkohen uva hakkohen zo hi shiva zo hi bia
Veod nigmar beria mibberia dichtiv vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo
Amri vayyivra legufeh vayyitzer leafnoye vedanin yetzira mitzira
Adderabba vayyitzer legufeh vayyivra leafnoye vedanin beria mibberia
Ella vayyitzer mufne mishshene tzedadin mufne gabbe adam umufne gabbe behema vayyivra gabbe adam mufne gabbe tanninim eno mufne

May mufne gabbe behema ilema middichtiv vayyaas elohim et chayyat haaretz uchtiv vayyitzer Adonai elohim min haadama kol chayyat hassade gabbe tannin name ippenoye mufne dichtiv veet kol remes haadama uchtiv vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim
Remes dichtiv hatam deyabbasha hu umay nafka minah ben mufne mitztzad echad lemufne mishshene tzedadin

Nafka minah deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi yishmael kol gezera shava sheenah mufna kol ikar en lemedin hemenna mufna mitztzad echad lerabbi yishmael lemedin veen meshivin lerabbanan lemedin umshivin mufna mishshene tzedadin divre hakkol lemedin veen meshivin
Verabbi yishmael may ika ben mufna mitztzad echad lemufna mishshene tzedadin nafka minah dehecha deika mufna mitztzad echad umufna mishshene tzedadin shavkinan mufna mitztzad echad

a: Veyalfinan mufna mishshene tzedadin ulhachi afneyeh rachamana livhema mishshene tzedadin ki hechi dela nigmar min mufna mitztzad echad

Rav acha bereh derava matne lah mishshemeh derabbi elazar lekulla kol gezera shava sheenah mufna kol ikar lemedin umshivin mufna mitztzad echad lerabbi yishmael lemedin veen meshivin lerabbanan lemedin umshivin mufna mishshene tzedadin divre hakkol lemedin veen meshivin
Ulrabbanan may ika ben mufna mitztzad echad lesheenah mufna kol ikar

Nafka minah hecha demashkachatte lah mufna mitztzad echad vesheenah mufna kol ikar velav lehay it leh pircha velav lehay it leh pircha shavkinan sheenah mufna kol ikar vegamrinan mimmufna mitztzad echad
Vehacha may pircha ika mishshum deika lemifrach ma leadam shekken mittamme mechayyim
Vechen amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan hayenu tama derabbi meir hoil veneemra bo yetzira keadam
Amar leh rabbi amme ella meatta hammappelet demut har immo temea leda shenneemar ki hinne yotzer harim uvore ruach amar leh har mi ka mappela even hi deka mappela hahu gush ikri

Ella meatta hammappelet ruach tehe immo temea leda hoil veneemra bo beria keadam dichtiv uvore ruach vechi tema lo mufne middahava leh lemichtav yotzer harim veruach uchtiv uvore ruach shema minah leafnoye
Amar leh danin divre tora middivre tora veen danin divre tora middivre kabbala
Amar rabba bar bar channa amar rabbi yochanan hayenu tama derabbi meir hoil veenehem domot keshel adam
Ella meatta hammappelet demut nachash tehe immo temea leda hoil vegalgal eno agolo keshel adam vechi tema hachi name litne nachash
I tena nachash hava amena benachash hu difligi rabbanan aleh derabbi meir dela ketiv beh yetzira aval behema vechayya la peligi dichtiva behu yetzira
Veha gabbe mumin katane lah et sheggalgal eno agol keshel adam la kashya ha beukkama ha betzirya
Rabbi yannay amar hayenu tama derabbi meir hoil veenehem holchot lifnehem keshel adam vahare of deen enav holchot lefanav vekaamar rabbi meir detame amar abbaye bekarya vekifofa uvishar ofot la
Metivi rabbi chanina ben antignos omer nirin divre rabbi meir bivhema vechayya vedivre chachamim beofot
May ofot ilema bekarya vekifofa may shena behema vechayya deenehen holchot lifnehen keshel adam karya vekifofa name
Ella peshita bishar ofot mikkelal derabbi meir pelig bishar ofot

Chassore michassera vehachi katane rabbi chanina ben antignos omer nirin divre rabbi meir bivhema vechayya vehu haddin lekarya vekifofa vedivre chachamim bishar ofot sheaf rabbi meir lo nechlak immahem ella bekarya vekifofa aval bishar ofot mode lehu
Vehatanya amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok hammappelet min behema vechayya ledivre rabbi meir valad uldivre chachamim eno valad beofot tibadek
Leman tibadek lav ledivre rabbi meir deamar karya vekifofa in shear ofot la
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika la tibadek lerabbanan deamri karya vekifofa in shear ofot la
Umay shena karya vekifofa mibbehema vechayya hoil veyesh lahen lesatot keadam
Bea mineh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera lerabbi meir deamar behema bime ishsha valad mealleya hu kibbel bah aviha kidushin mahu lemay nafka minah leitsore baachotah
Lememra dechaye vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav lo amarah rabbi meir ella hoil uvmino mitkayyem amar rav acha bar yaakov ad kan hevio rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera lide gichuch velo gichech
Gufa amar rav yehuda amar rav lo amarah rabbi meir ella hoil uvmino mitkayyem amar rav yirmeya middifti
b: Af anan name tenena hammappelet kemin behema chayya veof valad mealleya hu divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim ad sheyehe bo mitztzurat adam
Vehammappelet sandal o shilya o shafir merukkam vehayyotze mechuttach habba acharav bechor lenachala veeno bechor lechohen vei salka datach dechaye habba acharav bechor lenachala mi have
Amar rava leolam dechaye veshane hatam deamar kera reshit ono mi shellibbo dave alav yatza ze sheen libbo dave alav
Bea mineh rav adda bar ahava meabbaye lerabbi meir deamar behema bime ishsha valad mealleya hu adam bime vehema may lemay nafka mineh leishteroye baachila
Vetifshot leh meha derabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan hashshochet et habbehema umatza bah demut yona asura baachila
Hachi hashta hatam la perasot ika vela parsa ika hacha nehi difrasot leka parsa miha ika
Vachachamim omrim kol sheen bo ku amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav hakkol modim gufo tayish ufanav adam adam gufo adam ufanav tayish velo chelum
Lo nechleku ella sheppanav adam venivra beayin achat kivhema sherabbi meir omer mitztzurat adam vachachamim omrim kol tzurat adam
Amar lo amaru leh rabbanan lerav yirmeya bar abba veha ipcha tanya rabbi meir omer kol tzurat vachachamim omrim mitztzurat amar lehu i tanya tanya

Amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan metzach vehaggevinim vehaenayim vehallesatot vegabbot hazzakan ad sheyehu kullam keechat rava amar chassa metzach vehaggavin vehaayin vehalleset vegabbat hazzakan ad sheyehu kullam keechat
Vela feligi ha keman deamar kol tzurat ha keman deamar mitztzurat
Metivi tzurat panim sheamru afilu partzuf echad min happartzufin chutz min haozen lememra demechad name saggi
Amar abbaye ki tanya hahi leakkev tanya uchman deamar kol tzurat veibaet ema leolam keman deamar mitztzurat umay echad echad echad
Amar rava nivra beayin achat uvyarech echad min hatztzad immo temea baemtza immo tehora
Amar rava vishto nakuv immo temea vishto atum immo tehora
Tanu rabbanan hammappelet guf atum en immo temea leda veezehu guf atum rabbi omer kede sheyyinnatel min hachay veyamut
Vechamma yinnatel min hachay veyamut rabbi zakkay omer

a: Ad haarkubba rabbi yannay omer ad linkavav rabbi yochanan omer mishshum rabbi yose ben yehoshua ad mekom tabburo
Ben rabbi zakkay lerabbi yannay ika venayehu terefa chayya mar savar terefa chayya umar savar terefa enah chayya
Ben rabbi yannay lerabbi yochanan ika venayehu derabbi elazar deamar rabbi elazar nitla yarech vechalal shellah nevela
Amar rav pappa machloket millematta lemala aval millemala lematta afilu kol dehu tehora vechen amar rav gidel amar rabbi yochanan hammappelet et sheggulgolto atuma immo tehora
Veamar rav gidel amar rabbi yochanan hammappelet kemin appakuta dedikla immo tehora
Itmar hammappelet mi sheppanav musmasim rabbi yochanan amar immo temea resh lakish amar immo tehora
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish hammappelet yad chatucha veregel chatucha immo temea leda veen choshshin shemma migguf atum bata veim ita litne shemma migguf atum o mimmi sheppanav musmasin
Amar rav pappe befanav musmasin kulle alma la peligi ditmea ki peligi befanav tuchot veipcha itmar rabbi yochanan amar immo tehora veresh lakish amar immo temea
Velotveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan meha mishshum deshanni leh hayenu guf atum hayenu mi sheppanav tuchot
Bene rabbi chiyya nefuk lekiryata ato lekammeh daavuhon amar lahem kelum ba maase leyedchem amru lo panim tuchot ba leyadenu vetimenuha
Amar lahem tzeu vetaharu ma shettimmetem may datayechu lechumra chumra deatya lide kulla hi dekayahavitu lah yeme tohar
Itmar hammappelet beriyya sheyyesh lah shene gabbim ushne shidraot amar rav beishsha eno valad bivhema asur baachila ushmuel amar beishsha valad bivhema muttar baachila
Bemay kamipalgi bidrav chanin bar abba deamar rav chanin bar abba hashshesua beriyya sheyyesh lah shene gabbin ushne shidraot
Rav amar beriyya bealma letah vechi agmereh rachamana lemoshe bime immah agmereh ushmuel amar bereh bealma ita vechi agmereh rachamana lemoshe bealma agmereh aval bime immah sharya
Etiveh rav shimi bar chiyya lerav rabbi chanina ben antignos omer kol sheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushne shidraot pasul laavoda alma dechaye vekashya lerav amar leh shimi atte sheshshidrato akumma
Metivi yesh beubbarin shehen asurin ben arbaa ledakka ben shemona legassa hemennu ulmatta asur yatza mi sheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushne shidraot
May yatza lav yatza mikkelal ubbarin sheafilu bime imman asurin
Rav metaretz letameh ushmuel metaretz letameh rav metaretz letameh ben arbaa ledakka ben shemone legassa hemennu ulmatta asur
Bamme devarim amurim kesheyyatza laavir haolam aval bime immo shere yatza mi sheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushne shidraot daafilu bime immo name asur
b: Ushmuel metaretz letameh ben arbaa ledakka ben shemone legassa hemennu ulmatta asur bamme devarim amurim beshello kalu lo chodashav aval kalu lo chodashav muttar yatza mi sheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushne shidraot deaf al gav dechalu lo chodashav im yatza laavir haolam asur bime immo shere

Tane tanna kammeh derav hammappelet beriyyat guf sheeno chatuch uvriyyat rosh sheeno chatuch yachol tehe immo temea leda talmud lomar ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vego uvayyom hashshemini yimmol vego
Mi sherauy livrit shemona yatzu ellu sheenan reuyin livrit shemona amar leh rav vesayyem bah hachi vesheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushne shidraot

Rabbi yirmeya bar abba savar lemebad ovada kevateh dishmuel amar leh rav huna may datach lechumra chumra deate lide kulla hu dekayahavatte lah deme tohar aved miha kevateh derav dekayema lan hilcheta kerav beisure ben lekulla ben lechumra
Amar rava hare amru ishsha yoledet letisha veoledet leshiva behema gassa yoledet letisha yoledet leshiva o lo yalda
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ta shema hemennu ulmatta asur may lav aggassa la addakka
Hay may i amratte bishlama aggassa itzterich salka datach amena hoil uvishsha chaye bivhema name chaye ka mashma lan dela chaye
Ella i amratte addakka itmar peshita bat telata yarche mi ka chaye
Itzterich salka datach amina kol betzir tere yarche chaye ka mashma lan

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel hammappelet demut lilit immo temea leda valad hu ella sheyyesh lo kenafayim tanya name hachi amar rabbi yose maase besimonya beachat shehippila demut lilit uva maase lifne chachamim veamru valad hu ella sheyyesh lo kenafayim
Hammappelet demut nachash hora chanina ben achiv shel rabbi yehoshua immo temea leda halach rabbi yosef vesipper devarim lifne rabban gamliel shalach lo rabbi yehoshua hanheg ben achicha vavo

Bahalichatan yatzta kallat rabbi chanina likrato amra lo rabbi hammappelet kemin nachash mahu amar lah immo tehora amra lo vahalo mishshimcha amra li chamoti immo temea veamar lah meeze taam hoil vegalgal eno agol keshel adam mittoch devareha nizkar rabbi yehoshua shalach lo lerabban gamliel mippi hora chanina
Amar abbaye shema minah tzurba merabbanan deamar milta lema bah tama dechi madkeru leh middechar
Matni hammappelet shafir male mayim male dam male geninim enah chosheshet levalad veim haya merukkam teshev lezachar velinkeva hammappelet sandal o shilya teshev lezachar velinkeva
Gema bishlama dam umayim lo kelum hi ella geninim nechush shemma valad hava venimoach amar abbaye kamma yayin chay shatat immo shel ze shennimmoach ubbarah betoch meeha
Rava amar male tenan veim ita deittemoche ittemach michsar hava chasar rav adda bar ahava amar gevanim tenan veim ita deittemoche ittemach kulleh bechad gavena have kae

Tanya abba shaul omer kover metim hayiti vehayiti mistakkel baatzamot shel metim hashshote yayin chay atzmotav serufin mazug atzmotav sechuyin karauy atzmotav meshuchin vechol mi sheshshetiyyato merubba maachilato atzmotav serufin achilato merubba mishshetiyyato atzmotav sechuyin karauy atzmotav meshuchin

Tanya abba shaul omer veitema rabbi yochanan kover metim hayiti paam achat ratzti achar tzevi venichnasti bekulit shel met veratzti acharav shalosh parsaot utzvi lo higgati vekulit lo kalta keshechazarti laachoray amru li shel og melech habbashan hayeta
Tanya abba shaul omer kover metim hayiti paam achat niftecha meara tachtay veamadti begalgal eno shel met ad chotmi keshechazarti laachoray amru ayin shel avshalom hayeta

Veshemma tomar abba shaul nannas hava abba shaul aroch bedoro hava verabbi tarfon maggia lichtefo verabbi tarfon aroch bedoro hava verabbi meir maggia lichtefo rabbi meir aroch bedoro hava verabbi maggia lichtefo rabbi aroch bedoro hava
Verabbi chiyya maggia lichtefo verabbi chiyya aroch bedoro hava verav maggia lichtefo rav aroch bedoro hava verav yehuda maggia lichtefo verav yehuda aroch bedoro hava veadda dayyala maggia lichtefo

a: Perashtevina defumbedita kae leh leadda dayyala ad palgeh vechulle alma kae lifrashtevina defumbedita ad chartzeh
Shaalu lifne rabbi hammappelet shafir male basar mahu amar lahem lo shamati
Amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose kach amar abba male dam temea nidda male basar temea leda
Amar lo ilmale devar chadash amarta lanu mishshum avicha shemanucha achshav
Middeha kammayeta kichidaa kaamar kesomchos sheamar mishshum rabbi meir ha name shemma kerabbi yehoshua amarah veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua
Detanya hammappelet shafir sheeno merukkam rabbi yehoshua omer valad vachachamim omrim eno valad
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi oshaya machloket beachur aval betzalul divre hakkol eno valad verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar betzalul machloket
Ibaya lehu betzalul machloket aval beachur divre hakkol valad o dilma ben baze uven baze machloket teku
Metivi et zo darash rabbi yehoshua ben chananya vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam ulishto kotnot or vayyalbishem melammed sheen hakkadosh baruch hu ose or laadam ella im ken notzar
Alma beor talya milta la shena achur vela shena tzalul
I amratte bishlama betzalul machloket hayenu deitzterich kera ella i amratte beachur machloket lema li kera sevara bealma hu ella shema minah betzalul machloket shema minah
Vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh machloket beachur aval betzalul divre hakkol eno valad
Etiveh rava lerav nachman ella amru siman valad bivhema dakka tinuf begassa shilya beishsha shafir veshilya
Veilu shafir bivhema la patar i amratte bishlama betzalul machloket mishshum hachi
Ishsha derabbi bah kera petar bah shafir bivhema dela rabbi kera la petar bah shafir
Ella i amratte beachur machloket mikkede sevara hu may shena ishsha umay shena behema
Mi savratte rabbi yehoshua mifshat peshit leh rabbi yehoshua sappoke mesappeka leh veazel hacha lechumra vehacha lechumra
Gabbe ishsha demamona hu sefek mamona lekulla
Gabbe behema deisura hu deika legabbe giza vaavoda sefek isura lechumra hachi name gabbe ishsha sefek tuma lechumra
Umi mesappeka leh veha kera kaamar midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma hu
Amar leh rav chanina bar shelemya lerav ha rabbi ha rabbi yishmael berabbi yose veha rabbi oshaya veha rabbi yehoshua ben levi mar keman sevira leh
Amar leh ani omer echad ze veechad ze enah chosheshet

Ushmuel amar echad ze veechad ze chosheshet veazda shemuel letameh dechi ata rav dimi amar meolam la dachu shafir binhardea levar mehahu shefira daata lekammeh dishmuel demannach aleh chut hassaara mehay gisa vechazyeh mehay gisa amar im ita devalad huy la hava zig kulle hay

Veim haya merukkam vechu tanu rabbanan ezehu shafir merukkam abba shaul omer techillat beriyyato merosho ushte enav kishte tipin shel zevuv tane rabbi chiyya meruchakin ze mizze shene chotamin kishte tipim shel zevuv
Tane rabbi chiyya umkoravin ze laze ufiv matuach kechut hassaara ugviyyato kaadasha veim hayeta nekeva niddona kisora leorkah

Vechittuch yadayim veraglayim en lo vealav meforash bakkabbala halo chechalav tatticheni vechaggevina takpieni or uvasar talbisheni vaatzamot vegidim tesochcheni chayyim vachesed asita immadi ufkuddatcha shamra ruchi
Veen bodkin oto bemayim shehammayim azzin
b: Vetordin oto ella bodkin oto beshemen shehashshemen rach umtzachtzecho veen roin ella bachamma
Ketzad bodkin oto ketzad bodkin oto kidamrinan ella bamme bodkin oto leda im zachar hu im nekeva hi
Abba shaul bar nash veamri lah abba shaul bar remes omer mevi kesam sherosho chalak umnanea beoto makom im mesachsech beyadua shezzachar hu veim lav beyadua shennekeva hi
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh lo shanu ella millematta lemala aval min hatztzedadin ema kotle bet harechem ninhu
Amar rav adda bar ahava tana im hayeta nekeva nedona kisora seduka matkef lah rav nachman vedilma chut shel betzim ninhu amar abbaye hashta betzim gufayehu la yedii chut shel betzim yedia
Amar rabbi amram tana shette yarchotav kishne chutin shel zehorit veamar rabbi amram alah keshel erev ushne zerootav kishne chutin shel zehorit veamar rabbi amram alah keshel sheti
Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana la taaved ovada ad sheyyasir umi amar shemuel hachi vehaamar shemuel achat zo veachat zo chosheshet
Amar rav amme bar shemuel ledidi mipparsha li mineh demar shemuel lachosh chosheshet yeme tohora la yahavinan lah ad sheyyasir
Lememra dimsappeka leh lishmuel veha hahu shefira daatay lekammeh demar shemuel amar ha bar arbein vechad yoma vechashshev miyyoma deazla litvila ad hahu yoma vela hava ella arbein yomin
Vaamar lehu hay benidda beal kafteh veodi shane shemuel derav guvreh

Hammappelet sandal vechu tanu rabbanan sandal dome laddag shel yam mittechillato valad hu ella shennirtzaf rabban shimon ben gamliel omer sandal dome lallashon shel shor haggadol mishshum rabbotenu heidu sandal tzarich tzurat panim

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha sandal tzarich tzurat panim amar rav adda amar rav yosef amar rabbi yitzchak sandal tzarich tzurat panim vaafilu meachorav mashal leadam shessatar et chavero vehechzir panav laachorav
Bime rabbi yannay bikkeshu letaher et hassandal sheen lo tzurat panim amar lahem rabbi yannay tihartem et havveladot

Vehatanya mishshum rabbotenu heidu sandal tzarich tzurat panim amar rav bivi bar abbaye amar rabbi yochanan meeduto shel rabbi nechunya nishnet mishna zo amar rabbi zeera zecha bah rav bivi bishmateh daana vehu havena yatvin kammeh derabbi yochanan ki amrah leha shemata ukdam ihu vaamar uzcha bah
Lamma hizkiru sandal vahalo en sandal sheen immo valad
I deityelida nekeva bahadeh hachi name hacha bemay askinan deityelid zachar bahadeh
Mahu detema hoil veamar rav yitzchak bar amme ishsha mazraat techila yoledet zachar ish mazria techilla yoledet nekeva middeha zachar ha name zachar
Ka mashma lan ema shenehem hizriu bevat achat hay zachar vehay nekeva
Davar acher sheim teled nekeva lifne shekiat hachamma vesandal leachar shekiat hachamma
Mone techillat nidda larishon utchillat nidda laacharon
Sandal ditnan

a: Gabbe bechorot lemay hilcheta
Labba acharav bechor lenachala veen bechor lechohen
Sandal ditnan gabbe karetot lemay hilcheta
Sheim teled valad derech dofen vesandal derech rechem demayeta korban assandal
Ulrabbi shimon deamar yotze derech dofen valad mealleya hu may ika lememar
Amar rabbi yirmeya sheim teled valad begayyutah vesandal leachar shennitgayera demayeta korban assandal
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa umi itanhu lehane shinuye veha tanya keshehen yotzin en yotzin ella keruchin

Amar rav pappa shema mina michrach karech leh valad lesandal appalgeh umshalchef leh kelappe resheh gabbe bechorot kegon sheyyatzu derech rashehem desandal kadem venafek gabbe karetot sheyyatzu derech margelotehem devalad kadem venafek

Rav huna bar tachlifa mishshemeh derava amar afilu tema metzumtzamin veefoch shematata gabbe bechorot sheyyatzu derech margelotehem valad deit beh chiyyuta sarech vela nafek sandal delet beh chiyyuta sharek venafek gabbe karetot sheyyatzu derech rashehen valad deit beh chiyyuta middenafek resheh haveya leda sandal ad denafek rubbeh
Matni shilya babbayit habbayit tame lo shehashshilya valad ella sheen shilya belo valad
Rabbi shimon omer nimok havalad ad shello yatza

Gema tanu rabbanan shilya techillatah doma lechut shel erev vesofah doma ketormos vachalula kachatzotzeret veen shilya pechuta mittefach rabbi shimon ben gamliel omer shilya dome lekurkevan shel tarnegolin shehaddakkin yotzin mimmenna
Tanya rabbi oshaya zeera demin chavrayya chamishsha shiuran tefach veellu hen shilya shofar shidra dofen sukka vehaezov
Shilya ha daamaran shofar detanya kamma yehe shiur shofar peresh rabbi shimon ben gamliel kede sheyyochazennu beyado veyerae lechan ulchan tefach

Shidra ma hi deamar rabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan shidro shel lulav tzarich sheyehe yotze min hahadas tefach dofen sukka detanya shettayim kehilchatan shelishit afilu tefach ezov detane rabbi chiyya ezov tefach
Amar rabbi chanina bar pappa daresh shela ish kefar temarta telat matneyata vetarte shematata shiura tefach tarte chada hi amar abbaye ema amar rabbi chiyya ezov tefach
Vetu leka vehaika tefach al tefach al rum tefach merubba mevi et hattuma vechotzetz bifne hattuma
Tefach kaamrinan tefach al tefach la kaamrinan
Veha ika even hayyotze min hattannur tefach umin hakkira shalosh etzbaot chibbur
Ki kaamrinan hecha divtzir mittefach la chaze aval hacha kol shekken divtzir mittefach yad tannur hu
Vehaika
b: Tannure banot tefach detanya tannur techillato arbaa ushyarav arbaa divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim bamme devarim amurim begadol aval bekatan techillato kol shehu mishshettiggamer melachto ushyarav berubbo
Vechamma kol shehu amar rabbi yannay tefach shekken osin tannure banot tefach biflugta la kamayere
Hashta daatet lehachi ha name pelugta hi dekatane sefa amar rabbi yehuda lo amru tefach ella min hattannur velakkotel
Vehaika misgeret tefach bedichtivan la ka mayere vehaika kapporet tefach bekadashim la kamayere
Vehaika dayyah lakkora shehi rechava tefach bidrabbanan la kamayere ella bedichtivan vela mefarshi shiurayehu
Yatev rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta kammeh derav kahana veyatev vekaamar amar rav yehuda amar rav kol shelosha yamim harishonim tolin et hashshilya bavalad mikkan veelach choshshin levalad acher
Amar leh umi amar rav hachi vehaamar rav en havalad mitakkev achar chavero kelum ishtik amar leh dilma kan benefel kan beven kayyama

Amar leh atte amratte lishmateteh derav beferush amar rav hachi hippila nefel veachar kach hippila shilya kal shelosha yamim tolin et hashshilya bavalad mikkan veelach choshshin levalad acher yalda veachar kach hippila shilya afilu mikkan vead asara yamim en choshshin levalad acher
Shemuel vetalmidi derav verav yehuda hao yatvi chalef veazel rav yosef bereh derav menashsheya middevil leappayehu balay veate amar ate lan gavra deramenan leh begila dechitteta umirme umidche

Addehachi ata amar leh shemuel may amar rav beshilya amar leh hachi amar rav en tolin et hashshilya ella bedavar shel keyama shayelinhu shemuel lechol talmide derav veamri leh hachi hadar chazyeh lerav yehuda bishut
Bea mineh rabbi yose ben shaul merabbi hammappelet demut orev veshilya mahu amar leh en tolin ella bedavar sheyyesh bemino shilya

Keshura bo mahu amar leh davar sheeno shaalta etiveh hammappelet min behema chayya vaof veshilya immahen bizman shehashshilya keshura immahen en choshshin levalad acher en shilya keshura immahen choshshin levalad acher hareni metil alehen

a: Chomer shene veladot sheani omer shemma nimmoach shafir shel shilya venimmocha shilya shel shafir teuvta
Amar rabba bar shela amar rav matna amar shemuel maase vetalu et hashshilya bavalad ad asara yamim velo amru tolin ella beshilya habbaa achar havalad
Amar rabba bar bar channa amar rabbi yochanan maase vetalu et hashshilya bavalad ad esrim ushlosha yamim amar leh rav yosef ad esrim vearbaa amratte lan
Amar rav acha bereh derav avira amar rabbi yitzchak maase venishtaha havalad achar chavero sheloshim ushlosha yom amar leh rav yosef sheloshim vearbaa amratte lan

Hanicha leman deamar yoledet letisha yoledet limkuttain mashkachatte lah echad nigmera tzurato lesof shiva veechad nigmera tzurato litchillat tisha ella leman deamar yoledet letisha enah yoledet limkuttain may ika lememar
Efoch shematata sheloshim ushlosha leshilya esrim ushlosha levalad

Amar rabbi avin bar rav adda amar rav menachem ish kefar shearim veamri lah bet shearim maase venishtaha valad echad achar chavero shelosha chodashim vahare hem yoshvim lefanenu bevet hammidrash uman ninhu yehuda vechizkiyya bene rabbi chiyya
Veha amar mar en ishsha mitabberet vechozeret umitabberet amar abbaye tipa achat hayeta venitchalleka lishtayim echad nigmera tzurato bitchillat shiva veechad besof tisha

Shilya babbayit habbayit tame tanu rabbanan shilya babbayit habbayit tame lo shehashshilya valad ella sheen shilya sheen valad immah divre rabbi meir rabbi yose verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon metaharin
Amru lo lerabbi meir i atta mode sheim hotziuhu besefel labbayit hachitzon shehu tahor amar lahen aval velamma lefi sheeno
Amru lo keshem sheeno babbayit hachitzon kach eno babbayit happenimi amar lahen eno dome nimmok paam achat lenimmok shette peamim
Yatev rav pappa achore derav bivi kammeh derav hamnuna veyatev vekaamar may tama derabbi shimon kasavar kol tuma shennitarev bah mimmin acher betela
Amar lehu rav pappa hayenu name tamayehu derabbi yehuda verabbi yose achichu aleh may shena peshita
Amar rav pappa afilu ki ha milta lema inish vela nishtok kammeh rabbeh mishshum shenneemar im navalta vehitnasse veim zammota yad lefe
Veazda rabbi shimon letameh detanya melo tarvad rakav shennafal letocho afar kol shehu tame verabbi shimon metaher
May tama derabbi shimon amar rabba ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi vekaamri i efshar shello yirbu shette peridot afar al perida achat shel rakav vechasar leh
Veamena lehu adderabba i efshar shello yirbu shette peridot rakav al
b: Perida achat afar venafel leh shiura
Ella amar rabba hayenu tama derabbi shimon sofo kitchillato ma techillato naase lo davar acher gangilon af sofo naase lo davar acher gangilon
May hi detanya ezehu met sheyyesh lo rakav veezehu met sheen lo rakav nikbar arom bearon shel shayish o al gabbe ritzpa shel avanim zehu met sheyyesh lo rakav
Veezehu met sheen lo rakav nikbar bichsuto o bearon shel etz o al gabbe ritzpa shel levenim zehu met sheen lo rakav velo amru rakav ella lemet bilvad lemaote harug dela
Gufa melo tarvad rakav shennafal letocho afar kol shehu tame verabbi shimon metaher melo tarvad rakav shennitpazzer babbayit habbayit tame verabbi shimon metaher
Utzricha dei ashmeinan kammayeta behahi kaamri rabbanan mishshum demikkenif aval nitpazzer ema modu leh lerabbi shimon deen maahil vechozer umaahil
Vei ashmeinan beha beha amar rabbi shimon deen maahil vechozer umaahil aval beha ema mode lehu lerabbanan tzericha
Tanya idach melo tarvad veod afar bet hakkevarot tame verabbi shimon metaher may tamayehu derabbanan lefi shei efshar limlo tarvad veod afar bet hakkevarot sheen bo melo tarvad rakav
Hashta deamratte tama derabbi shimon mishshum sofo kitchillato gabbe shilya may tama amar rabbi yochanan mishshum bittul berov nagu bah

Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi yochanan rabbi shimon verabbi eliezer ben yaakov amru davar echad rabbi shimon ha daamaran rabbi eliezer detanya rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer behema gassa sheshshafa chararat dam hare zo tikkaver uftura min habbechora
Vetane rabbi chiyya alah enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa umeachar sheenah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa ammay tikkaver kede lefarsemah shehi petura min habbechora
Alma valad mealleya hu veammay tane rabbi chiyya enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa amar rabbi yochanan mishshum bittul berov nagu bah
Amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan umode rabbi shimon sheimmo temea leda
Amar hahu sava lerabbi amme asberah lach tama derabbi yochanan deamar kera ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vego afilu lo yalda ella keen shehizria temea leda
Resh lakish amar shafir shetterafuhu bememav naase kemet shennitbalbela tzurato

Amar leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish met shennitbalbela tzurato menalan detahor ilema meha deamar rabbi shabbetay amar rabbi yitzchak magdelaa veamri lah amar rabbi yitzchak magdelaa amar rabbi shabbetay met shennisraf veshildo kayyemet tame maase haya vetimmeu lo petachim gedolim

a: Vetiharu lo petachim ketannim veka dayekatte minah tama deshildo kayyemet ha lav hachi tahor
Adderabba dok minah lehay gisa shildo kayyemet hu detiharu lo petachim ketannim ha lav hachi petachim ketannim name temein dechol chad vechad chaze leappoke chad chad ever
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe rabbi yochanan deamar keman kerabbi eliezer ditnan efer serufin rabbi eliezer omer shiuran berova
Hechi dame met shennisraf veshildo kayyemet amar abbaye kegon shesserafo al gabbe katvulya rava amar kegon shesserafo al gabbe appudrim ravina amar kegon deicharach icharoche
Tanu rabbanan hammappelet yad chatucha veregel chatucha immo temea leda veen choshshin shemma migguf atum bau
Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna deamri tarvayehu en notnin lah yeme tohar may tama ema hirchika ledatah
Metiv rav yosef hammappelet veen yadua ma hippila teshev lezachar velinkeva vei salka datach kol kehay gavena ema hirchika ledatah litne ulnidda
Amar abbaye i tena lenidda hava amena mevia korban veeno neechal ka mashma lan deneechal
Amar rav huna hotzi ubbar et yado vehechzirah immo temea leda shenneemar vayehi velidtah vayyitten yad
Metiv rav yehuda hotzi ubbar et yado en immo chosheshet lechol davar amar rav nachman ledidi miparsha li mineh derav huna lachosh chosheshet yeme tohar la yahavinan lah ad denafek rubbeh
Veha en immo chosheshet lechol davar kaamar amar abbaye enah chosheshet lechol davar middeorayeta aval midderabbanan chosheshet veha kera kaamar midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma
Matni hammappelet tumtum veanderoginos teshev lezachar velinkeva
Tumtum vezachar anderoginos vezachar teshev lezachar velinkeva tumtum unkeva anderoginos unkeva teshev linkeva bilvad
Yatza mechuttach o mesoras mishsheyyetze rubbo hare hu keyalud yatza kedarko ad sheyyetze rov rosho veezehu rov rosho mishsheyyetze paddachto
Gema hashta tumtum lechodeh veanderoginos lechodeh amratte teshev lezachar velinkeva tumtum vezachar anderoginos vezachar mibaya

Itzterich mahu detema hoil veamar rabbi yitzchak ishsha mazraat techilla yoledet zachar ish mazria techilla yoledet nekeva ema middehay zachar hay name zachar ka mashma lan ema shenehem hizriu bevat achat zo zachar veze nekeva
Amar rav nachman amar rav tumtum veanderoginos sherau loven o odem en chayyavin al biat mikdash veen sorfin alehem et hatteruma
Rau loven veodem keechad en chayyavin al biat mikdash aval sorfin alehem et hatteruma shenneemar mizzachar vead nekeva
b: Teshallechu zachar vadday nekeva vaddait velo tumtum veanderoginos

Lema mesayya leh tumtum veanderoginos sherau loven o odem en chayyavin al biat mikdash veen sorfin alehem et hatteruma rau loven veodem keachat en chayyavin al biat mikdash aval sorfin alehem et hatteruma
May tama lav mishshum shenneemar mizzachar vead nekeva teshallechu zachar vadday nekeva vaddait velo tumtum veanderoginos amar ulla la ha manni rabbi eliezer hi
Ditnan rabbi eliezer omer hashsheretz venelam mimmennu al helem sheretz hu chayyav veeno chayyav al helem mikdash
Rabbi akiva omer venelam mimmennu vehu tame al helem tuma hu chayyav veeno chayyav al helem mikdash
Veamrinan may benayehu veamar chizkiyya sheretz unvela ika benayehu derabbi eliezer savar baenan ad deyada i besheretz itammi i binvela itammi verabbi akiva savar la baenan
Lav amar rabbi eliezer hatam baenan deyada i besheretz itammi i binvela itammi hacha name baenan deyada i beloven itammi i beodem itammi
Aval lerabbi akiva deamar mishshum tuma michayyav hacha name mishshum tuma michayyav
Verav may shena biat mikdash dela dichtiv mizzachar vead nekeva teshallechu zachar vadday nekeva vaddait velo tumtum veanderoginos
I hachi teruma name la nisrof dichtiv vehazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva zachar vadday nekeva vaddait velo tumtum veanderoginos
Hahu mibbae leh lechidrabbi yitzchak deamar rabbi yitzchak lazzachar lerabbot et hammetzora lemayenotav velinkeva lerabbot et hamtzoraat lemayenoteha
Hay name mibbee leh bemi sheyyesh lo tohora bammikve perat lichli cheres divre rabbi yose
Im ken nichtov rachamana adam
Vechi tema i ketav rachamana adam hava amena kele mattachot la mikkol tame lanafesh nafka zachar unkeva lema li lechidrav
Veema kulleh lechidrav hu daata im ken nichtov zachar unkeva may mizzachar vead nekeva ad kol davar sheyyesh lo tohora bammikve
I hachi ki itammi bishar tumot la lishallechu amar kera mizzachar mittuma happoreshet min hazzachar
Vechol hecha dichtiv mizzachar ad nekeva lemaote tumtum veanderoginos hu daata veha gabbe arachin dichtiv hazzachar
Vetanya hazzachar velo tumtum veanderoginos yachol lo yehe beerech ish aval yehe beerech ishsha talmud lomar hazzachar veim nekeva zachar vadday nekeva vaddait velo tumtum veanderoginos
Tama dichtiv hazzachar veim nekeva ha mizzachar unkeva la memaet hahu mibbae leh

a: Lechallek ben erech ish leerech ishsha
Yatza mechuttach o mesoras vechu amar rabbi elazar afilu harosh immahen
Verabbi yochanan amar lo shanu ella sheen harosh immahen aval harosh immahen harosh poter
Lema bedishmuel kamipalgi deamar shemuel en harosh poter binfalim
Beshalem dechulle alma la peligi ki peligi bimchuttach demar savar beshalem hu dekachashev bimchuttach la kachashev umar savar bamchuttach name chashev
Lishana acharina tama deyatza mechuttach o mesoras ha ketikno harosh poter tarvayehu let lehu dishmuel deamar shemuel en harosh poter binfalim
Ika dematne lah leha shemateta beappe nafshah amar rabbi elazar en harosh kerov evarim verabbi yochanan amar harosh kerov evarim vekamipalgi bedishmuel
Tenan yatza mechuttach o mesoras mishsheyyetze rubbo hare hu keyalud middekaamar mesoras mikkelal dimchuttach ketikno vekaamar mishsheyyetze rubbo hare ze keyalud kashya lerabbi yochanan
Amar lach rabbi yochanan ema yatza mechuttach umsoras
Veha o katane hachi kaamar yatza mechuttach o shalem veze vaze mesoras mishsheyyetze rubbo hare ze keyalud
Amar rav pappa ketannae yatza mechuttach o mesoras mishsheyyetze rubbo hare hu keyalud rabbi yose omer mishsheyyetze ketikno may kaamar
Amar rav pappa hachi kaamar yatza mechuttach umsoras mishsheyyetze rubbo hare hu keyalud ha ketikno harosh poter rabbi yose omer mishsheyyetze rubbo ketikno
Matkef lah rav zevid mikkelal devimsoras rubbo name lo poter ha kayema lan derubbo kechullo
Ella amar rav zevid hachi kaamar yatza mechuttach umsoras mishsheyyetze rubbo hare ze keyalud ha ketikno harosh poter rabbi yose omer mishsheyyetze ketikno lechayyim
Tanya name hachi yatza mechuttach o mesoras mishsheyyetze rubbo hare ze keyalud ha ketikno harosh poter rabbi yose omer mishsheyyetze ketikno lechayyim

Veezehu ketikno lechayyim mishsheyyetze rov rosho veezehu rov rosho rabbi yose omer mishsheyyetzu tzedaav abba chanan mishshum rabbi yehoshua omer mishsheyyetze mishshettetze paddachto veyesh omrim mishsheyyerau karne rosho
Matni hammappelet veen yadua mahu teshev lezachar velinkeva en yadua im valad haya im lav teshev lezachar velinkeva ulnidda
Gema amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi avra nahar vehippila mevia korban veneechal hallech achar rov nashim verov nashim valad mealleya yaldan
Tenan en yadua im valad haya teshev lezachar velinkeva ulnidda ammay teshev lenidda lema hallech achar rov nashim verov nashim valad mealleya yaldan
Matnitin beshello huchzeka ubbara vechi kaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi keshehuchzeka ubbara
Ta shema behema sheyyatza melea uvaa rekanit habba acharav bechor missafek
Veammay hallech achar rov behemot verov behemot valad mealleya yaldan vehay pashut hu
Amar ravina mishshum deika lememar rov behemot yoldot davar happoter mibbechora umiutan yoldot davar sheeno poter mibbechora vechol hayyoldot metannefot vezo hoil velo tinnefa ittera leh rubba
I kol hayyoldot metannefot ha middela metannefa bechor mealleya hu ella ema rov yoldot metannefot vezo hoil velo tinnefa ittera leh rubba
Ki ata rabbin amar metiv rabbi yose berabbi chanina toa vela yadana may teuvta may hi detanya
b: Ishsha sheyyatzta melea uvaa rekanit vehevia lefanenu shelosha shavuin tehorin vaasara shevuot echad tame veechad tahor

Meshammeshet leor sheloshim vechamesh umatbilin otah tishim vechamesh tevilot divre bet shammay uvet hillel omrim sheloshim vechamesh rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer dayyah lattevila shettehe baacharona
Bishlama shavua rishon lo meshammeshet emar yoledet zachar hi shavua sheni emar yoledet nekeva hi
Shavua shelishi emar yoledet nekeva bezov hi
Ella shavua revii af al gav deka chazya dam teshammesh deha dam tahor hu lav mishshum dela azlinan batar rubba
Ella may la yadana may teuvta emar hirchika ledatah
Hach shevua chamishi detahor hu teshammesh
Hach shavua revii kol yoma veoma maspekinan besof leda uvitchillat nidda veesrin utmanya gufeh emar techillat nidda hi uvaaya lemetav shiva leniddatah
Beesrim vechad teshammesh
Rabbi shimon hi deamar asur laasot ken shemma tavo lide safek leurta teshammesh kesheraata baerev
Umatbilin otah tishim vechamesh tevilot shavua kamma matbilin otah belelavata emar yoledet zachar hi
Shavua sheni matbilin otah belelavata emar yoledet nekeva hi bimama bimame emar yoledet zachar bezov hi
Shavua shelishi matbilin lah bimama bimame emar yoledet nekeva bezov hi
Belelavata bet shammay letamayehu deamri tevulat yom aroch bae tevila

a: Mikkede yeme tohora kamma hau shittin veshita dal shavua shelishi deatbelinan lah pashu lehu shittin neche chada shittin neche chada utlatin vachamesh tishin vearba haveyan tishin vachamesh may avidtayehu
Amar rav yirmeya middifti kegon shebbat lefanenu ben hashshemashot deyahavinan lah tevila yattirta
Ulvet hillel deamri tevulat yom aroch la bae tevila telatin vachamesh may avidtayehu
Esrim utmanya kedaamaran hach shavua chamishi matbelinan kol lelya velelya emar sof nidda hi
Asra shavuin lema li bitmanya ufalga saggi
Ayede ditna palga deshavua massek leh veayede ditna shavua tame tena name shavua tahor
Vehaika tevilat zava
Delifne tashmish kachashev dilachar tashmish la kachashev
Ulvet shammay dechashev dilachar tashmish nichshov name tevilat zava beleda kamayere beziva la kamayere
Vehaika yoledet bezov yoledet bezov kachashev ziva geredta la kachashev
Shavua kamma deatya lekamman latbelah beoma dilma kol yoma veoma shelimu lah sefurim didah
Ha manni rabbi akiva hi deamar baenan sefurim befanenu
Sof shavua kamma latbelah chad beshavua la kamayere
Yoma kamma deatya lekamman latbelah dilma shomeret yom keneged yom hi bezava gedola kamayere bezava ketanna la kamayere
Shema minah telat shema minah rabbi akiva hi deamar baenan sefurim befanenu
Ushma minah rabbi shimon hi deamar aval amru chachamim asur laasot ken shemma tavo lide safek
Ushma minah tevila bizmannah mitzva verabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer dayyah litvila baacharona vela amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva
Matni hammappelet leom arbaim enah chosheshet levalad leom arbaim veechad teshev lezachar velinkeva ulnidda

Rabbi yishmael omer yom arbaim veechad teshev lezachar ulnidda yom shemonim veechad teshev lezachar velinkeva ulnidda shehazzachar nigmar learbaim veechad vehannekeva lishmonim veechad vachachamim omrim echad beriyyat hazzachar veechad beriyyat hannekeva ze vaze arbaim veechad
Gema lamma huzkar zachar
I lime tuma ha katane nekeva vei lime tohora
b: Ha katane nidda
Sheim tire yom sheloshim vearbaa vetachzor vetire yom arbaim veechad tehe mekulkelet ad arbaim ushmona
Vechen leinyan nekeva sheim tire yom shivim vearbaa vetachzor vetire yom shemonim veechad tehe mekulkelet ad shemonim ushmona
Rabbi yishmael omer yom arbaim veechad teshev lezachar ulnidda ku tanya rabbi yishmael omer time vetiher bezachar vetime vetiher binkeva
Ma keshettime vetiher bezachar yetzirato keotze vo af keshettime vetiher binkeva yetziratah kayyotze bah amru lo en lemedin yetzira mittuma

Amru lo lerabbi yishmael maase bikleoppatra malkat alekkesanderos shennitchayevu shifchoteha hariga lammalchut uvdakan umtzaan ze vaze learbaim veechad amar lahen ani mevi lachem reaya min hattora veattem meviin li reaya min hashshotim
May reaya min hattora ilema time vetiher bezachar vetime vetiher binkeva ku ha kaamri leh en danin yetzira mittuma
Amar kera teled hosif lah hakkatuv leda acheret binkeva
Umay reaya min hashshotim emar nekeva kedim veiabbur arbein yomin kamme zachar
Verabbanan samma denaftza ashkinhu verabbi yishmael ika gufa dela mekabbel samma

Amar lahem rabbi yishmael maase bikleppatra malkat yevanim shennitchayevu shifchoteha hariga lammalchut uvdakan umtzaan zachar learbaim veechad unkeva lishmonim veechad amru lo en meviin reaya min hashshotim
May tama hach dinkeva iyyatara arbein yomin vahadar iabbar
Verabbi yishmael leshomer masrinhu verabbanan en appotroppos laaraot ema shomer gufeh ba aleha
Vedilma i karuhu lehach dinkeva bearbein vechad hava mishtachcha kezachar amar abbaye besimanehon shavin
Vachachamim omrim echad beriyyat zachar veechad beriyyat nekeva vechu chachamim hayenu tanna kamma
Vechi tema lemistemah resha kerabbanan veyachid verabbim halacha kerabbim peshita
Mahu detema mistabbera tama derabbi yishmael dekamsayei leh kerae ka mashma lan

Daresh rabbi simlay lema havalad dome bime immo lefinkas shemmekuppal umunnach yadav al shette tzedaav shette atzilav al shette archubbotav ushne akevav al shette agvotav verosho munnach lo ben birkav ufiv satum vetabburo patuach veochel mimma sheimmo ochelet veshota mimma sheimmo shota veeno motzi rei shemma yaharog et immo vechevan sheyyatza laavir haolam niftach hassatum venistam happatuach sheilmale ken eno yachol lichot afilu shaa achat
Vener daluk lo al rosho vetzofe umabbit missof haolam vead sofo shenneemar behillo nero ale roshi leoro elech choshech veal titmah shehare adam yashen kan veroe chalom beaspamya

Veen lecha yamim sheadam sharuy betova yoter meotan hayyamim shenneemar mi yitteneni cheyarche kedem kime eloha yishmereni veezehu yamim sheyyesh bahem yerachim veen bahem shanim heve omer ellu yarche leda
Umlammedin oto kal hattora kullah shenneemar vayyoreni vayyomer li yitmoch devaray libbecha shemor mitzotay vechye veomer besod eloha ale oholi
May veomer vechi tema navi hu dekaamar ta shema besod eloha ale oholi
Vechevan shebba laavir haolam ba malach vesotro al piv umshakkecho kol hattora kullah shenneemar lappetach chattat rovetz

Veeno yotze mishsham ad shemmashbiin oto shenneemar ki li tichra kol berech tishshava kol lashon ki li tichra kol berech ze yom hammita shenneemar lefanav yichreu kol yorde afar tishshava kol lashon ze yom halleda shenneemar neki chappayim uvar levav asher lo nasa lashshave nafsho velo nishba lemirma

Uma hi hashshevua shemmashbiin oto tehi tzaddik veal tehi rasha vaafilu kol haolam kullo omrim lecha tzaddik atta heye beenecha kerasha veheve yodea shehakkadosh baruch hu tahor umshartav tehorim unshama shennatan becha tehora hi im atta meshammerah betohora mutav veim lav hareni notlah mimmecha
Tana deve rabbi yishmael mashal lechohen shemmasar teruma leam haaretz veamar lo im atta meshammerah betohora mutav veim lav hareni sorfah lefanecha
Amar rabbi elazar

a: May kera mimmee immi atta gozi may mashma dehay gozi lishana deishtevoe hu dichtiv gozzi nizrech vehashlichi
Veamar rabbi elazar lema valad dome bime immo leegoz munnach besefel shel mayim adam noten etzbao alav shokea lechan ulchan

Tanu rabbanan shelosha chodashim harishonim valad dar bemador hattachton emtzaiyyim valad dar bemador haemtzai acharonim valad dar bemador haelon vechevan shehiggia zemanno latzet mithappech veotze vezehu chevle ishsha
Vehayenu ditnan chevle shel nekeva merubbin mishshel zachar
Veamar rabbi elazar may kera asher usseti vasseter rukkamti betachtiyyot aretz darti lo neemar ella rukkamti
May shena chevle nekeva merubbin mishshel zachar ze ba kederech tashmisho veze ba kederech tashmisho zo hofechet paneha veze en hofech panav

Tanu rabbanan shelosha chodashim harishonim tashmish kashe laishsha vegam kashe lavalad emtzaiyyim kashe laishsha veyafe lavalad acharonim yafe leishsha veyafe lavalad shemmittoch kach nimtza havalad melubban umzoraz
Tana hamshammesh mittato leom tishim keilu shofech damim mena yada ella amar abbaye meshammesh veholech veshomer petayim Adonai

Tanu rabbanan shelosha shuttafin yesh baadam hakkadosh baruch hu veaviv veimmo aviv mazria halloven shemmimmennu atzamot vegidim vetzippornayim umoach shebberosho veloven shebbaayin immo mazraat odem shemmimmennu or uvasar usarot veshachor shebbaayin vehakkadosh baruch hu noten bo ruach unshama uklaster panim uriyyat haayin ushmiat haozen vedibbur pe vehilluch raglayim uvina vehaskel
Vechevan shehiggia zemanno lehippater min haolam hakkadosh baruch hu notel chelko vechelek aviv veimmo manniach lifnehem amar rav pappa hayenu deamri inashe putz milcha ushdi bisra lechalba

Daresh rav chinana bar pappa may dichtiv ose gedolot ad en cheker veniflaot ad en mispar bo ure shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam middat basar vadam noten chefetz bechemet tzerura ufiha lemala safek mishtammer sefek en mishtammer veilu hakkadosh baruch hu tzar haubbar bime ishsha petucha ufiha lematta umishtammer
Davar acher adam noten chafatzav lechaf moznayim kol zeman shemmachbid yored lematta veilu hakkadosh baruch hu kol zeman shemmachbid havalad ole lemala

Daresh rabbi yose haggelili may dichtiv odcha Adonai al ki noraot nifleti niflaim maasecha venafshi yodaat meod bo ure shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam middat basar vadam adam noten zeronim baaruga kol achat veachat echad veechad ole bemino veilu hakkadosh baruch hu tzar haubbar bime ishsha vechullam olin lemin echad
Davar acher tzabba noten sammanin layyora kullan olin letzeva echad veilu hakkadosh baruch hu tzar haubbar bime ishsha kol achat veachat echad veechad ole lemino
Daresh rav yosef may dichtiv odcha Adonai ki anafta bi yashov appecha utnachameni bamme hakkatuv medabber

Bishne bene adam sheyyatzu lischora yashav lo kotz leechad mehen hitchil mecharef umgaddef leyamim shama shettava sefinato shel chavero bayyam hitchil mode umshabbeach lechach neemar yashov appecha utnachameni
Vehayenu deamar rabbi elazar may dichtiv ose niflaot gedolot levaddo uvaruch shem kevodo leolam afilu baal hannes eno makkir benisso

Daresh rabbi chanina bar pappa may dichtiv orchi verivi zerita vechol derachay hiskanta melammed shello notzar adam min kol hattippa ella min habbarur shebbah tana deve rabbi yishmael mashal leadam shezzore bevet haggeranot notel et haochel umanniach et happesolet
Kidrabbi avahu derabbi avahu rame ketiv vattazreni chayil uchtiv hael hamazzereni chayil amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam zeritani vezeraztani
Daresh rabbi avahu may dichtiv mi mana afar yaakov umispar et rova yisrael melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev vesofer et reviiyyotehem shel yisrael matay tavo tipa shehatztzaddik notzar hemenna
Veal davar ze nismet eno shel bilam harasha amar mi shehu tahor vekadosh umshartav tehorim ukdoshim yatzitz bedavar ze miyyad nismet eno dichtiv neum haggever shetum haayin
Vehayenu deamar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv vayyishkav immah ballayela hu melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu siyyea beoto maase shenneemar yissaschar chamor garem chamor garam lo leyissasochar
Amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi amme ishsha mazraat techila yoledet zachar ish mazria techila yoledet nekeva shenneemar ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar

Tanu rabbanan barishona hau omrim ishsha mazraat techila yoledet zachar ish mazria techilla yoledet nekeva velo pershu chachamim et haddavar ad shebba rabbi tzadok ufersho elle bene lea asher yalda leyaakov befaddan aram veet dina vitto tala hazzecharim bannekevot unkevot bazzecharim
Vayyihu vene ulam anashim gibbore chayil dorche keshet umarbim banim uvne vanim vechi beyado shel adam leharbot banim uvne banim ella mittoch
b: Shemmeshahin atzman babbeten kede sheyyazriu neshotehen techilla sheyehu benehem zecharim maale alehen hakkatuv keilu hem marbim banim uvne banim vehayenu deamar rav kattina yacholni laasot kol banay zecharim amar rava harotze laasot kol banav zecharim yivol veyishne
Veamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi amme en ishsha mitabberet ella samuch levistah shenneemar hen beoon cholalti
Verabbi yochanan amar samuch litvilatah shenneemar uvchet yechematni immi
May mashma dehay chet lishana dedakkoye hu dichtiv vechitte et habbayit umtargeminan vidakke yat beta vei baet ema mehacha techatteeni beezov veethar
Veamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi amme kevan shebba zachar baolam ba shalom baolam shenneemar shilchu char moshel eretz zachar ze kar
Veamar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme ba zachar baolam ba kikkaro beyado zachar ze kar dichtiv vayyichre lahem kera gedola
Nekeva en immah kelum nekeva nekiyya baa ad deamra mezone la yahavi lah dichtiv nokva secharcha alay veettena
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi shimon ben yochay mippene ma amra tora yoledet mevia korban amar lahen beshaa shekkoraat leled kofetzet venishbaat shello tizzakek levalah lefichach amra tora tavi korban
Matkef lah rav yosef veha mezida hi uvacharata talya milta veod korban shevua baaya etoye
Umippene ma amra tora zachar leshiva unkeva learbaa asar zachar shehakkol semechim bo mitcharetet leshiva nekeva shehakkol atzevim bah mitcharetet learbaa asar
Umippene ma amra tora mila lishmona shello yehu kullam semechim veaviv veimmo atzevim
Tanya haya rabbi meir omer mippene ma amra tora nidda leshiva mippene sheragil bah vekatz bah amra tora tehe temea shiva yamim kede shettehe chaviva al balah kishat kenisatah lachuppa
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi dostay berabbi yannay mippene ma ish mechazzer al ishsha veen ishsha mechazzeret al ish mashal leadam sheavda lo aveda mi mechazzer al mi baal aveda mechazzer al avedato
Umippene ma ish panav lematta veishsha paneha lemala kelappe haish ze mimmekom shennivra vezo mimmekom shennivret
Umippene ma haish mekabbel piyyus veen ishsha mekabbelet piyyus ze mimmekom shennivra vezo mimmekom shennivret
Mippene ma ishsha kolah arev veen ish kolo arev ze mimmekom shennivra vezo mimmekom shennivret shenneemar ki kolech arev umarech nave
Hadaran alach hammappelet chaticha
Matni benot kutim niddot mearisatan vehakkutim metammeim mishkav tachton kaelon mippene shehen boale niddot
Vehen yoshvot al kol dam vadam
Veen chayyavin alehen al biat mikdash veen sorfin alehem et hatteruma mippene shettumatan safek
Gema hechi dame i deka chazyan afilu didan name vei dela kachazyan didhu name la
Amar rava bereh derav acha bar rav huna amar rav sheshet hacha vemay askinan bistama dechevan deika miuta dechazyan chayeshinan uman tanna dechayesh lemiuta

a: Rabbi meir hi detanya katan uktanna lo choltzin velo meyabbemin divre rabbi meir
Amru lo lerabbi meir yafe amarta sheen choltzin ish katuv bapparasha umakkeshinan ishsha leish uma taam en meyabbemin
Amar lahen katan shemma yimmatze saris ketanna shemma timmatze ayelonit venimtzeu pogin beerva shello bimkom mitzva
Verabbanan zil batar rubba diktannim verov ketannim lav sarisim ninhu zil batar rubba diktannot verov ketannot lav ayeloniyyot ninhu
Emar deshamatte leh lerabbi meir miuta dishchiach aval miuta dela shechiach mi shamatte leh

Ha name miuta dishchiach hu detanya amar rabbi yose maase been bul vehitbiluha kodem leimmah veamar rabbi maase bevet shearim vehitbiluha kodem leimmah veamar rav yosef maase befumbedita vehitbiluha kodem leimmah

Bishlama derabbi yose udrabbi mishshum terumat eretz yisrael ella derav yosef lema li veha amar shemuel en terumat chutz laaretz asura ella bemi shettuma yotza miggufo vehane mile baachila aval bingia la
Amar mar zutra lo nitzrecha ella lesuchah shemen shel teruma detanya velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael asher yarimu la lerabbot et hassach veet hashshote
Shota lema li kera shetiyya bichlal achila ella lerabbot et hassach kashshote veibaet ema mehacha vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav
I hachi didan name
Anan dedarshinan ishsha veishsha vechi chazyan mafreshinan lehu la gezaru behu rabbanan inhu dela darshi ishsha veishsha vechi chazyan la mafreshi lehu gezaru behu rabbanan
May ishsha veishsha detanya ishsha en li ella ishsha tinoket bat yom echad lenidda minnayin talmud lomar veishsha
Alma ki merabbe kera bat yom echad merabbe urminhu ishsha en li ella ishsha tinoket bat shalosh shanim veom echad levia minnayin talmud lomar veishsha
Amar rava hilcheta ninhu veasmechinhu rabbanan akkerae he kera vehe hilcheta ilema bat yom echad hilcheta bat shalosh shanim veom echad kera kera setama ketiv
Ella bat shalosh shanim veom echad hilcheta bat yom echad kera umeachar dehilcheta kera lamma li
b: Lemaote ish meodem
Veha detanya ishsha en li ella ishsha bat asara yamim leziva minnayin talmud lomar veishsha lema li ligmar minnidda
Tzericha dei ketav rachamana benidda hava amena nidda mishshum dechi chazay chad yoma baaya lemetav shiva aval zava dei chazay chad yoma beshomeret yom keneged yom saggi lah ema la tzericha
Velichtov rachamana bezava vela bae benidda vaana yadana deen zava belo nidda in hachi name veella kera lema li lemaote ish meodem
Ha maetteh chada zimna chad lemaote mishshichvat zera vechad lemaote middam
Vechen leinyan zecharim detanya ish ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot tinok bin yom echad shehu metamme beziva divre rabbi yehuda

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer en tzarich hare hu omer lazzachar velannekeva lazzachar kol shehu zachar ben shehu gadol ben shehu katan velannekeva kol shehi nekeva ben gedola ben ketanna im ken ma talmud lomar ish ish dibbera tora chilshon bene adam
Alma ki merabbe kera ben yom echad merabbe urminhu ish en li ella ish ben tesha shanim veom echad minnayin talmud lomar veish
Amar rava hilcheta ninhu veasmechinhu rabbanan akkerae he hilcheta vehe kera ilema ben yom echad hilcheta uven tesha shanim veom echad kera kera setama ketiv
Ella ben tesha shanim veom echad hilcheta uven yom echad kera vechi meachar dehilcheta hi kera lema li lemaote ishsha milloven
Lema li lemichtav bizcharim ulma li lemichtav binkevot
Tzerichi dei ketav rachamana bizcharim mishshum dimtammu biriyyot kivyamim aval nekevot dela metammu biriyyot kivyamim ema la
Vei ketav rachamana binkevot mishshum dekamtammu beones aval zecharim dela metammu beones ema la tzericha
Hakkutim metammein mishkav tachton kaelon may mishkav tachton kaelon ilema dei ika asara matztzaot veyatev alayehu metammu metamme lehu peshita deha dares lehu
Ella sheyehe tachtono shel boel nidda keelono shel zav ma elono shel zav eno metamme ella ochlin umashkin af tachtono shel boel nidda eno metamme ella ochalin umashkin
Elono shel zav menalan dichtiv vechol hannogea bechol asher yihye tachtav yitma may tachtav

a: Ilema tachtav dezav mivveish asher yigga bemishkavo nafka ella hannogea bechol asher yihye hazzav tachtav umay nihu elon shel zav
Vehannose name yitma umay nihu nisa may tama vehannissa ketiv
Nitteko hakkatuv mittuma chamura vehevio lide tuma kalla lomar lach sheeno metamme ella ochalin umashkin
Emar nitteko hakkatuv mittuma chamura delo metamme adam letamme begadim aval adam o begadim litamme amar kera yitma tuma kalla mashma
Vetachtono shel boel nidda menalan detanya uthi niddatah alav
Yachol yaale leraglah talmud lomar yitma shivat yamim
Uma talmud lomar uthi niddatah alav sheyyachol lo yetamme adam uchli cheres talmud lomar uthi niddatah alav ma hi metammea adam uchli cheres af hu metamme adam uchli cheres
I ma hi osa mishkav umoshav letamme adam letamme begadim af hu ose mishkav umoshav letamme adam letamme begadim talmud lomar vechol hammishkav asher yishkav alav yitma

Sheen talmud lomar vechol hammishkav asher yishkav alav yitma uma talmud lomar vechol hammishkav asher vego nitteko hakkatuv mittuma chamura vehevio lide tuma kalla lomar lecha sheeno metamme ella ochalin umashkin
Parech rav achay ema nitteko hakkatuv mittuma chamura vehevio letuma kalla dela litamme adam letammoye begadim aval adam uvgadim litamme amar rav assi yitma tuma kalla mashma
Ema uthi niddatah alav kalal vechol hammishkav parat kelal ufrat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat mishkav umoshav in mide acharina la
Amar abbaye yitma shivat yamim mafsek hainyan have kelal ufrat hamruchakin ze mizze vechol kelal ufrat hamruchakin ze mizze en danin oto bichlal ufrat
Rava amar leolam danin vechol ribuya hu
Matkef lah rabbi yaakov ema kehi ma hi lo chillakta bah ben maggaah lemishkavah letamme adam ultamme begadim lechumra af hu lo tachlok bo ben maggao lemishkavo letamme adam ultamme begadim lekulla
Amar rava alav lehatino mashma
Mippene shehen boale niddot vechu attu kullehu boale niddot ninhu amar rabbi yitzchak magdelaa binsuot shanu
Vehen yoshvot al dam vechu tanya amar rabbi meir im hen yoshvot al kol dam vadam takkana gedola hi lahen
Ella sheroot dam adom umashlimot oto ledam yarok
Davar acher yom shepposeket bo sofarto leminyan shiva
Matkef lah rame bar chama vetisperennu vaanan name nispereh dekayema lan miktzat hayyom kechullo
Amar rava im ken shichvat zera desatra beziva hechi mashkachatte lah veha miktzat hayyom kechullo
I dachazay befalga deoma hachi name hacha vemay askinan dachazay samuch lishkiat hachamma
Velekum velema leh likra ki ketiva samuch lishkiat hachamma ketiva in al korchach shivkeh likra deihu dachek umoke annafsheh
Bae rame bar chama poletet shichvat zera mahu shettistor beziva roa hayeta vesoteret
b: O dilma nogaat hayeta vela satra
Amar rava lefum churpa shabbeshta nehi name desatra kema tistor tistor shiva dayya kevoalah
Tistor yom echad veachar tithar amar rachamana achar achar lechullan shello tehe tuma mafseket benehem
Velitamach zav gufeh hechi satar letohorato amar rachamana shello tehe tuma mafseket benehen
Ella may it lach lememar shello tehe tumat ziva mafseket benehen hacha name shello tehe tumat ziva mafseket benehen

Veen chayyavin alehen al biat mikdash vechu rav pappa ikla litvach amar i ika tzurba merabbanan hacha ezil akabbel appeh amara leh hahi savta ika hacha tzurba merabbanan verav shemuel shemeh vetane matneyata yehe raava detehve kevateh

Amar middekamvarchi li begaveyh shema minah yere shamayim hu azal legabbeh rema leh tora rema leh matneyata ahadade tenan en chayyavin alehen al biat mikdash veen sorfin alehen et hatteruma mippene shettumatah safek alma missefeka la sarfinan teruma
Urminhi al shishsha sefekot sorfin et hatteruma al sefek bigde am haaretz
Amar rav pappa yehe raava delitachil hay tora lishlama hacha vemay askinan bechuti chaver
Kuti chaver boel nidda meshavet leh
Shavkeh vaata lekammeh derav shimi bar ashe amar leh may tama la meshannet leh bechuti shettaval veala vedaras al bigde chaver vaazul bigde chaver ungau bitruma
Dei mishshum tumat am haaretz ha tevel leh vei mishshum boel nidda safek baal bekarov safek lo baal bekarov
Veim timtze lomar baal bekarov safek hishlimattu yarok safek lo hishlimattu vehave sefek sefeka veassefek sefeka la sarfinan teruma
Vetipok leh mishshum bigde am haaretz deamar mar bigde am haaretz midras lapperushin amar leh bechuti arom

Matni benot tzaddukin bizman shennahagu lalechet bedarche avotehen hare hen kechutiyyot parshu lalechet bedarche yisrael hare hen keyisreeliyyot rabbi yose omer leolam hen keyisreeliyyot ad sheyyifreshu lalechet bedarche avotehen

Gema ibaya lehu setama may ta shema benot tzaddukin bizman shennohagot lalechet bedarche avotehen hare hen kechutiyyot ha setama keyisreeliyyot ema sefa pershu lalechet bedarche yisrael hare hen keyisreeliyyot ha setama kechutiyyot ella meha leka lemishma minah
Ta shema ditnan rabbi yose omer leolam hen keyisreeliyyot ad sheyyifreshu lalechet bedarche avotehen mikkelal detanna kamma savar setama kechutiyyot shema minah
Tanu rabbanan maase betzadduki echad shessipper im kohen gadol bashshuk venitteza tzinnora mippiv venafla lechohen gadol al begadav vehoriku panav shel kohen gadol vekadam etzel ishto
Amra lo af al pi shenneshe tzaddukim hen mityarot min happerushim umarot dam lachachamim
Amar rabbi yose bekiin anu bahen yoter min hakkol vehen marot dam lachachamim chutz meishsha achat shehayeta bishchunatenu shello herat dam lachachamim umeta
Vetipok leh mishshum tzinnora deam haaretz amar abbaye betzadduki chaver amar rava tzadduki chaver boel nidda meshavet leh ella amar rava

a: Regel hava vetumat am haaretz baregel ketohora shavveuha rabbanan dichtiv vayyeasef kol ish yisrael el hair keish echad chaverim hakkatuv asaan kullan chaverim
Matni dam nochrit vedam tohora shel metzoraat bet shammay metaharim uvet hillel omrim kerukkah uchmeme ragleha
Dam hayyoledet shello tavla bet shammay omrim kerukkah uchmeme ragleha uvet hillel omrim metamme lach veyavesh
Umodim beoledet bezov shehi metammea lach veyavesh

Gema velet lehu levet shammay dabber el bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish ish ki yihye zav bene yisrael metammein beziva veen haggoyim metammein beziva aval gazru alehen sheyehu kezavin lechol divrehem
Amri lach bet shammay hahu bizcharim itmar dei binkevot hechi laaved litamme lach veyavesh asito keshel tora litamme lach vela litamme yavesh chillakta beshel tora
I hachi rukkah umeme ragleha name kevan deavdinan hekera bedamah mida yedia derukkah umeme ragleha derabbanan
Velaaved hekera berukkah umeme ragleha ultammoye ledamah rukkah umeme ragleha dishchichi gezaru behu rabbanan damah dela shechiach la gezaru beh rabbanan
Amar rava zovo tame afilu levet shammay kiro tahor afilu levet hillel
Zovo tame afilu levet shammay deha ika lemebad hekera bekiro
