Kiro tahor afilu levet hillel avud beh rabbanan hekera ki hechi dela lisrof aleh teruma vekadashim
Velaaved hekera bezovo ultammoye lekiro zovo dela tele bemaase gezaru beh rabbanan kiro ditle bemaase la gezaru beh rabbanan
Lema mesayya leh nochrit sheppalta shichvat zera miyyisrael temea uvat yisrael sheppalta shichvat zera min hannochri tehora may lav tehora gemura la tehora middeorayeta temea midderabbanan
Ta shema nimtzeta omer shichvat zera shel yisrael temea bechol makom
b: Vaafilu bime goya veshel nochri tehora bechol makom vaafilu bime yisreelit chutz mimme raglayim shebbah
Vechi tema hachi name tehora middeorayeta aval temea midderabbanan attu me ragleha middeorayeta mi metammeu ella shema mina tehora afilu midderabbanan shema mina
Amar mar shichvat zera shel yisrael temea bechol makom afilu bime goya tifshot devae rav pappa devae rav pappa shichvat zera shel yisrael bime goya mahu
Betoch shelosha la kamibaya leh lerav pappa ki kamibaya leh leachar shelosha may
Yisrael dedayegi bemitzot chavil gufayehu umasriach goyim dela dayegi bemitzot la chavil gufayehu velo masriach o dilma kevan deachli shekatzim urmasim chavil gufayehu umasriach teku
Dam tohora shel metzoraat bet shammay ku may tama devet hillel amar rabbi yitzchak lazzachar lerabbot metzora lemayenotav velannekeva lerabbot metzoraat lemayenoteha
May mayenoteha ilema shear mayenoteha mizzachar nafka ella ledamah letamme dam tohora shellah
Uvet shammay nekeva mizzachar la atya deika lemifrach ma lezachar shekken taun peria ufrima veasur betashmish hammitta tomar bannekeva dela
Uvet hillel lichtov rachamana binkeva vela bae zachar vaana amena uma nekeva sheenah teuna peria ufrima veenah asura betashmish hammitta rabbi rachamana mayenoteha zachar lo kol shekken
Im eno inyan lezachar tenehu inyan linkeva veim eno inyan lemayenoteha tenehu inyan ledamah letamme dam tohora shellah
Uvet shammay zachar minnekeva la ate deika lemifrach ma linkeva shekken metammea meones tomar bezachar dela
Uvet hillel kayemi bimtzora ufarchi mile dezav uvet shammay shum tuma parchi
Veibaet ema amri lach bet shammay hay lezachar mibe leh lezachar kol shehu zachar hay ben gadol ben katan uvet hillel nafka lehu mizzot torat hazzav ben gadol ben katan
Amar rav yosef ki fashet rabbi shimon ben lakish bezav bae hachi reiyya rishona shel zav katan mahu shettetamme bemagga zot torat hazzav vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara amar rachamana

Kol sheshshichvat zera shello metammea reiyya rishona shello metammea vehay kevan deshichvat zera shello lo metammea reiyya rishona name lo tetamme o dilma kevan deilu ihu chaze tarte mitztarfa metammeya
Amar rava ta shema zot torat hazzav ben gadol ben katan ma gadol reiyya rishona shello metammea af katan reiyya rishona name metammea
Bae rav yosef reiyya rishona shel metzora mahu shettetamme bemassa mekom ziva mayan hu umtamme o dilma lav mayan hu
Amar rava ta shema zovo tame hu limed al hazzov shehu tame bemay ilema bezav gereda

a: Laacherim gorem tuma leatzmo lo kol shekken ella peshita bezav metzora
Umiddeitzterich kera lerabboye biriyya sheniyya shema minah mekom ziva lav mayan hu

Amar leh rav yehuda middiskarta lerava mimmay dilma leolam ema lach bezav gereda udkaamratte laacherim gorem tuma leatzmo lo kol shekken sair hammishtalleach yochiach sheggorem tuma laacherim vehu atzmo tahor

Amar abbaye may tibbee leh veha hu deamar zot torat hazzav ben gadol ben katan vechevan denafka leh mehatam iyyatar leh lazzachar lerabbot metzora lemayenotav velannekeva lerabbot metzoraat lemayenoteha
Veakkesheh rachamana metzora lezav gamur ma zav gamur metamme bemassa af reiyya rishona shel metzora metamme bemassa
Amar rav huna reiyya rishona shel zav metammea beones shenneemar zot torat hazzav vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara ma shichvat zera metamme beones af reiyya rishona shel zav metammea beones
Ta shema raa reiyya rishona bodkin oto may lav letuma la lekorban
Ta shema bashsheniyya bodkin oto lemay ilema lekorban aval letuma la ikkeri kan mibbesaro velo mechamat onso ella lav letuma umiddesefa letuma resha name letuma
Mide irya ha kidita veha kidita
Ta shema rabbi eliezer omer af bashshelishi bodkin oto mippene hakkorban mikkelal detanna kamma mippene hattuma kaamar
La dechulle alma lekorban vehacha beettim ka mipalgi rabbanan la darshi ettim verabbi eliezer daresh ettim
Rabbanan la darshi ettim hazzav chada zovo tarte lazzachar bashshelishi akkesheh rachamana linkeva
Verabbi eliezer daresh ettim hazzav chada et tarte zovo telat barvii akkesheh rachamana linkeva
Ta shema rabbi yitzchak omer vahalo zav bichlal baal keri haya velamma yatza lehakel alav ulhachmir alav lehakel alav sheen metamme beones ulhachmir alav
b: Shehu ose mishkav umoshav
Emat ilema biriyya sheniyya hecha hava bichlal baal keri ella peshita biriyya rishona vekatane lehakel alav sheeno metamme beones
Vetisbera lehachmir alav shehu ose mishkav umoshav biriyya rishona bar mishkav umoshav hu

Ella hachi kaamar rabbi yitzchak omer vahalo zav bichlal baal keri haya biriyya rishona velamma yatza biriyya sheniyya lehakel alav ulhachmir alav lehakel alav sheeno metamme beones ulhachmir alav shehu ose mishkav umoshav

Amar rav huna zov dome leme vatzek shel seorim zov ba mibbesar hammet shichvat zera ba mibbesar hachay zov dehe vedome leloven betza hammuzeret shichvat zera keshura vedoma leloven betza sheenah muzeret
Dam hayyoledet shello tavla vechu

Tanya amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay i attem modim benidda shello tavla veraata dam shehi temea amru lahem bet shammay lo im amartem benidda sheafilu tavla veraata temea tomru beoledet sheim tavla veraata shehi tehora
Amru lahem yoledet bezov tochiach sheim tavla veraata leachar yeme sefira tehora lo tavla veraata temea
Amru lahem hu haddin vehi hatteshuva
Lememra difligi vehatnan umodim beoledet bezov shehi metammea lach veyavesh
La kashya kan shessafra kan shello safra
Vehatanya yoledet bezov shessafra velo tavla veraata halchu bet shammay leshitatan uvet hillel leshitatan
Itmar rav amar mayan echad hu hattora timmeattu vehattora tiharattu
Velevi amar shene mayanot hem nistam hattame niftach hattahor nistam hattahor niftach hattame
May benayehu ika venayehu shofaat mittoch shiva leachar shiva umittoch arbaa asar leachar arbaa asar umittoch arbaim leachar arbaim umittoch shemonim leachar shemonim
Lerav resha lekulla vesefa lechumra
Lelevi resha lechumra vesefa lekulla
Metivi dam hayyoledet shello tavla bet shammay omrim kerukkah uchmeme ragleha uvet hillel omrim metamme lach veyavesh
Ka salka datach defaska bishlama lerav deamar mayan echad hu mishshum hachi metamme lach veyavesh ella lelevi deamar shene mayanot hen ammay metamme lach veyavesh
Amar lach levi hacha vemay askinan beshofaat i beshofaat may tama devet shammay kasavri bet shammay mayan echad hu
Bishlama lelevi hayenu deika ben bet shammay uvet hillel ella lerav may benayehu
Ika benayehu yome utvila devet shammay savri beome tela rachamana uvet hillel savri beome utvila
Ta shema umodim beoledet bezov shehi metammea lach veyavesh salka datach hacha name defaska
Bishlama lerav deamar mayan echad hu mishshum hachi metamme lach veyavesh ella lelevi deamar shene mayanot hen ammay metamme lach veyavesh
Amar lach hacha name beshofaat i beshofaat lemay itzterich
Levet shammay itzterich af al gav dekaamri bet shammay mayan echad hu uvome tela rachamana hane mile beoledet geredta dishlimu lehu yome aval yoledet bezov devae sefira la
Ta shema deotah titma lerabbot et boalah
Deotah titma lerabbot hallelot deotah titma lerabbot hayyoledet bezov shetztzericha shetteshev shiva yamim nekiyyim bishlama lerav deamar mayan echad hu mishshum hachi baaya shiva yamim nekiyyim

a: Ella lelevi deamar shene mayanot hen lema li shiva bemashshehu saggi
Hachi kaamar tzericha shettifsok mashshehu sheyyaalu lah leshiva nekiyyim
Ta shema yeme iburah olim lah lime menikutah vime menikutah olim lah lime iburah
Ketzad hifsika shettayim bime iburah veachat bime menikutah shettayim bime menikutah veachat bime iburah achat umechetza bime iburah veachat umechetza bime menikutah olin lah leshalosh onot
Bishlama lerav deamar mayan echad hu mishshum hachi bae hefsek shalosh onot ella lelevi deamar shene mayanot hen lema li hefsek shalosh onot bemashshehu saggi
Hachi kaamar tzericha shettifsok mashshehu kede sheyyaalu lah leshalosh onot
Ta shema veshavin beroa achar dam tohar sheddayyah sheatah
Bishlama lelevi deamar shene mayanot hen mishshum hachi dayyah sheatah ella lerav deamar mayan echad hu ammay dayya sheatah tetamme meet leet
Deleka shehut
Uttamme mippekida lifkida kevan dimet leet leka mippekida lifkida name la gezaru bah rabbanan
Ta shema yoledet bezov shessafra velo tavla veraata halchu bet shammay leshitatan uvet hillel leshitatan
Bishlama lerav deamar mayan echad hu mishshum hachi metamme lach veyavesh ella lelevi deamar shene mayanot hen ammay metamme lach veyavesh
Amar lach levi ana daamari ketanna deshavin
Veibaet ema beshofaat veha safra katane
Hacha beoledet nekeva bezov askinan deshavua kamma paska shavua batra la paska vekasavar yeme ledatah sheen roe bahen olin lah lisfirat zivatah
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe amar lan rav shemen missichra ikkela mar zutra leatrin udrash hilcheta kevateh derav lechumra vehilcheta kevateh delevi lechumra
Rav ashe amar hilcheta kevateh derav ben lekulla ben lechumra daresh marimar hilcheta kevateh derav ben lekulla ben lechumra vehilcheta kevateh derav ben lekulla ben lechumra
b: Matni hamkashsha nidda kishsheta shelosha yamim betoch achad asar yom veshafta meet leet veyalda hare zo yoledet bezov divre rabbi eliezer
Rabbi yehoshua omer layela vaom kelile shabbat veomo sheshshafta min hatztzaar velo min haddam
Kamma hi kishuyah rabbi meir omer afilu arbaim vachamishshim yom rabbi yehuda omer dayyah chodshah rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim en kishuy yoter mishshette shabbatot
Gema attu kol hamkashsha nidda hi
Amar rav nidda leoma ushmuel amar chayeshinan shemma tishpe
Verabbi yitzchak amar hamkashsha enah kelum vehakatane hamkashsha nidda
Amar rava bime nidda nidda bime ziva tehora vehatanya hamkashsha bime nidda nidda bime ziva tehora
Ketzad kishsheta yom echad veshafta shenayim o shekkishsheta shenayim veshafta yom echad o sheshshafta vekishsheta vechazra veshafta hare zo yoledet bezov

Aval shafta yom echad vekishsheta shenayim o sheshshafta shenayim vekishsheta yom echad o shekkishsheta veshafta vechazra vekishsheta en zo yoledet bezov kelalo shel davar koshi samuch lalleda en zo yoledet bezov shofi samuch lalleda hare zo yoledet bezov
Chananya ben achi rabbi yehoshua omer kol shechal kishuyah bashshelishi shellah afilu kol hayyom kullo beshofi en zo yoledet bezov
Kelalo shel davar leetoye may leetoye dachananya
Mena hane mile detanu rabbanan damah damah mechamat atzmah velo mechamat valad
Atta omer mechamat valad o eno ella mechamat ones keshehu omer veishsha ki yazuv zov damah hare ones amur ha ma ani mekayyem damah damah mechamat atzmah velo mechamat valad
Uma raita letaher et havalad ultamme beones metaher ani bavalad sheyyesh tohora acharav umtamme ani beones sheen tohora acharav
Adderabba metaher ani beones shekken ones bezav tahor hashta miha beishsha kayeminan veones beishsha la ashkechan
Veibaet ema may datach letahore beones ultammoye bevalad en lach ones gadol mizze
I hachi nidda name nema zava zovah mechamat atzmah velo mechamat valad
Atta omer valad o eno ella ones keshehu omer veishsha ki tihye zava hare ones amur ha ma ani mekayyem zava zovah mechamat atzmah velo mechamat valad
Amar resh lakish amar kera teshev yesh lecha yeshiva acheret shehi kazo veezo zo koshi bime ziva veema zo koshi bime nidda
Ella amar avuh dishmuel amar kera utmea shevuayim keniddatah velo kezivatah mikkelal dezivatah tahor veezo zo koshi bime ziva
Vehashta dichtiv vetama shevuayim keniddatah damah lema li i lav damah hava amena keniddatah velo kezivatah vaafilu beshofi ka mashma lan
Shela bar avina avad ovada kevateh derav ki ka nach nafsheh derav amar leh lerav assi zil tzanneeh vei la tzayet garyeh hu savar gaddeyeh amar leh
Batar denach nafsheh derav amar leh hadar bach dahadar beh rav amar leh im ita dahadar beh ledidi hava amar li la tzayet gaddeyeh amar leh vela mistefe mar middelekta

Amar leh ana isi ben yehuda dehu isi ben gur arye dehu isi ben gamliel dehu isi ben mahalalel asita dinchasha dela shalet beh rikba amar leh vaana shela bar avina buchna defarzela dimtabbar asita dinchasha
Chalash rav assi ayeluh bechammime appekuh mikkarire ayeluh bekarire appekuh mechammime nach nafsheh derav assi

a: Azal shela amar lidvethu tzevit li zevadta dela lezil velema leh lerav mile ilavay tzevita leh zevadta nach nafsheh deshela chazo defarcha asa mehay purya lehay purya amri shema minah avadu rabbanan peyasa
Bae rava koshi mahu shettistor beziva
Davar hamtamme soter vehay name metamme kime nidda hu o dilma davar haggorem soter vehay lav gorem hu
Amar leh abbaye ones beziva yochiach sheeno gorem vesoter
Amar leh laye hay name gorem hu ditnan raa reiyya rishona bodkin oto sheniyya bodkin oto shelishit en bodkin oto
Ulrabbi eliezer deamar af bashshelishit bodkin oto hachi name kevan dela garem la satar amar leh lerabbi eliezer hachi name
Ta shema rabbi eliezer omer af bashshelishit bodkin oto barviit en bodkin oto may lav listira
La letammoyeh lehahi tipa bemassa
Ta shema bashshelishit rabbi eliezer omer bodkin oto barviit en bodkin oto lekorban amarti velo listira
Ella lerabbi eliezer tifshot dedavar sheeno gorem soter lerabbanan may
Ta shema detane avuh derabbi avin ma garam lo zovo shiva lefichach soter shiva ma garam lo kiro yom echad lefichach soter yom echad
May shiva ilema dimtamme shiva hay ma zovo tame shiva mibbae leh ella lav davar haggorem soter davar sheeno gorem eno soter shema minah
Amar abbaye naktinan en koshi soter beziva vei mashkachatte tanna deamar soter hahu rabbi eliezer hi
Tanya rabbi marinus omer en leda soteret beziva ibaya lehu mahu shettaale abbaye amar enah soteret veenah ola rava amar enah soteret veola
Amar rava mena amena lah detanya veachar tithar achar achar lechullan shello tehe tuma mafseket benehem
I amratte bishlama ola hayenu dela mafseka tuma ella i amratte enah ola afsik leh leda veabbaye amar lach shello tehe tumat ziva mafseket benehem
Amar rava mena amena lah detanya mizzovah mizzovah velo minnigah mizzovah velo milledatah veabbaye amar lach teni chada mizzovah velo minnigah vela titne velo milledatah

Verava hay may i amratte bishlama mizzovah velo milledatah ayede deitzterich leh leda tena nigah attu leda ella i amratte mizzovah velo minnigah hay mivvechi yithar hazzav mizzovo nafka mizzovo velo minnigo
Veabbaye chad bezav vechad bezava utzrichi dei ketav rachamana

Kishsheta shelosha yamim vechu
Ibaya lehu shafta mizze umizze mahu rav chisda amar temea rabbi chanina amar tehora
Amar rabbi chanina mashal lemelech sheyyatza vachayalotav lefanav beyadua shechayalotav shel melech hen
Verav chisda amar kol shekken devae nappesh chayyalot tefe
Tenan rabbi yehoshua omer layela vaom kelele shabbat veomo sheshshafta min hatztzaar velo min haddam tama demin hatztzaar velo min haddam ha mizze umizze tehora teuvta derav chisda

Amar lecha rav chisda la mibbaya mizze umizze ditmea defaski lehu chayyalot ligmare aval min hatztzaar velo min haddam emar ki hechi demiddam la paska mikkoshi name la paska veha tunba bealma hu dinkat lah ka mashma lan
Tenan kishsheta shelosha yamim betoch achad asar yom veshafta meet leet veyalda hare zo yoledet bezov
Hechi dame ilema kidkatane lema li shalosh bitre bekoshi vechad beshofi saggi
Ella lav hachi kaamar kishsheta shelosha veshafta mizze umizze o shekkishsheta shenayim veshafta meet leet hare zo yoledet bezov utuvta derabbi chanina
Amar lach rabbi chanina la leolam kidkatane veha ka mashma lan deaf al gav dematchel kishuy bashshelishi veshafta meet leet temea leappoke merabbi chanina
Kamma hi kishshuyah rabbi meir omer vechu hashta chamishshim mekashsheya arbaim mibaya amar rav chisda la kashya kan lechola kan livria
Amar rabbi levi en havalad metaher ella yamim haruyin lihot bahen zava verav amar afilu beyamim haruyin lisfirat zava amar rav adda bar ahava ultameh derav

a: Afilu yamim haruyin lisfirat setirat zava
Tenan kamma hu kishshuyah rabbi meir omer arbaim vachamishshim yom
Bishlama lerav mashkachatte lah kerav adda bar ahava ella lelevi kashya
Amar lach levi mi katane tehora bechullan bime nidda nidda bime ziva tehora
Lishana acharina amri amar rabbi levi en havalad metaher ella yamim haruyin lihot bahen zava gedola may tama damah yamim rabbim ketiv
Abba shaul mishshemeh derav amar afilu yamim haruyin lihot bahen zava ketanna may tama yeme vechol yeme hatam ketivi
Tenan kamma hu kishshuyah rabbi meir omer afilu arbaim vachamishshim yom kashya letarvayehu mi katane tehora bechullan kishsheta bime niddatah nidda bime zivatah tehora
Tanya haya rabbi meir omer yesh mekashsha mea vachamishshim yom veen ziva ola bahen ketzad shenayim belo et
Veshiva nidda ushnayim shel achar hannidda vachamishshim shehavalad metaher
Ushmonim shel nekeva veshiva nidda ushnayim shel achar hannidda
Amru lo im ken yesh mekashsha kol yameha veen ziva ola bahen
Amar lahen may datayechu mishshum nefalim en koshi linfalim
Tanu rabbanan yesh roa mea yom veen ziva ola bahen ketzad shenayim belo et veshiva nidda ushnayim shel achar hannidda ushmonim shel nekeva veshiva nidda ushnayim shel achar hannidda
May ka mashma lan leappoke mimman deamar i efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam ka mashma lan deefshar liftichat hakkever belo dam
Rabbi yehuda omer dayyah vechu tanya rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon dayyah chodshah veyesh baddavar lehakel ulhachamir
Ketzad kishsheta shenayim besof shemini veechad bitchillat teshii vaafilu bitchillat teshii yalda hare zo yoledet bezov
Aval kishsheta yom echad besof shemini ushtayim bitchillat teshii vaafilu besof teshii yalda en zo yoledet bezov

Amar rav adda bar ahava shema minah kasavar rabbi yehuda shipura garem ini veha amar shemuel en ishsha mitabberet veoledet ella lematayim veshivim veechad yom o lematayim veshivim ushnayim yom o lematayim veshivim ushlosha
Hu deamar kachasidim harishonim detanya chasidim harishonim lo hau meshammeshin mittotehen ella birvii beshabbat shello yavou neshotehen
b: Lide chillul shabbat birvii vetu la ema mervii veelach
Amar mar zutra may tamayehu dachasidim harishonim dichtiv vayyitten Adonai lah heraon heraon begimatriyya matan veshivim vechad hau

Amar mar zutra afilu leman deamar yoledet letisha enah yoledet limkuttaim yoledet leshiva yoledet limkuttaim shenneemar vayehi litkufot hayyamim vattahar channa vatteled ben miut tekufot shenayim miut yamim shenayim

Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim en koshi yoter mishshette shabbatot amar shemuel may tamayehu derabbanan dichtiv vetama shevuayim keniddatah keniddatah velo kezivatah mikkelal dezivatah tehora vechamma shevuayim
Tanu rabbanan yesh mekashsha esrim vachamishsha yom veen ziva ola bahen ketzad shenayim belo et veshiva nidda ushnayim shelleachar nidda vearbaa asar shehavalad metaher
Vei efshar shettitkashshe esrim veshishsha yom belo valad velo tehe yoledet bezov
Belo valad bitlata name saggi amar rav sheshet ema bimkom sheyyesh valad amar leh rava veha belo valad katane

Ella amar rava hachi kaamar i efshar shettitkashshe esrim veshishsha yom bimkom sheyyesh valad velo tehe yoledet bezov uvimkom sheen valad ella nefel bitlata name haveya zava may tama en koshi linfalim
Matni hamkashsha betoch shemonim shel nekeva kol damim shehi roa tehorin ad sheyyetze havalad verabbi eliezer metamme
Amru lo lerabbi eliezer uma bimkom shehechmir bedam hashshofi hekel bedam hakkoshi mekom shehekel bedam hashshofi eno din shennakel bedam hakkoshi
Amar lahen dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon mimma hekel aleha mittumat ziva aval temea tumat nidda
Gema tanu rabbanan teshev lerabbot hamkashsha betoch shemonim shel nekeva shekkol damim shehi roa tehorin ad sheyyatza havalad verabbi eliezer metamme
Amru lo lerabbi eliezer uma bimkom shehechmir beshofi shellifne havalad hekel beshofi shelleachar havalad mekom shehekel bekoshi shellifne havalad eno din shennakel bekoshi shelleachar havalad
Amar lahem dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon mimma hekel aleha mittumat ziva aval metammea tumat nidda
Amru lo hare anu meshivin lecha lashon acher uma bimkom shehechmir beshofi shellifne havalad hekel bekoshi sheimmo makom shehekel beshofi shelleachar havalad eno din shennakel bekoshi sheimmo
Amar lahem afilu attem meshivin kol hayyom kullo dayyo labba min haddin lihot kanniddon mimma hekel aleha mittumat ziva aval metammea tumat nidda
Amar rava beha zakkinhu rabbi eliezer lerabbanan lav amritu damah dama mechamat atzmah velo mechamat valad hachi name vetahara mimmekor dameha dameha mechamat atzmah velo mechamat valad
Ema bime nidda nidda bime ziva tehora amar kera teshev yeshiva achat lechullan
Matni kol achad asar yom bechezkat tohora

a: Yashva lah velo badka shagga neensa hezida velo badka tehora
Higgia sheat vistah velo badka hare zo temea rabbi meir omer im hayeta bemachave vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka hare zo tehora mippene shecharada mesalleket et haddamim
Aval yeme hazzav vehazzava veshomeret yom keneged yom hare ellu bechezkat tuma
Gema lemay hilcheta amar rav yehuda lomar sheenah tzericha bedika veha middekatane sefa yashva velo badka mikkelal dilchattechilla baaya bedika
Sefa atan lime nidda vehachi kaamar kol achad asar bechezkat tohora vela baaya bedika aval bime niddatah baaya bedika yashva velo badka shagga neensa hezida velo badka tehora
Rav chisda amar la tzericha ella lerabbi meir deamar ishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh hane mile bime niddatah aval bime zivatah bechezkat tohora kayema
I hachi ammay amar rabbi meir yotzi velo yachzir olamit dilma atya lekalkole bime nidda
Ha middekatane sefa higgia sheat vistah velo badka mikkelal divishsha sheyyesh lah veset askinan chassore michassera vehachi katane kol achad asar bechezkat tohora vesharya levalah uvime nidda asura
Bamme devarim amurim beishsha sheen lah veset aval yesh lah veset mutteret utzricha bedika yashva velo badka shagga neensa hezida velo badka tehora higgia sheat vistah velo badka temea

Ha middesefa rabbi meir resha lav rabbi meir kullah rabbi meir hi vehachi kaamar im lo hayeta bemachave vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka temea sherabbi meir omer im hayeta bemachave vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka tehora shecharada mesalleket et haddamim
Rava amar lomar sheenah metammea meet leet
Metivi hannidda vehazzava vehashshomeret yom keneged yom vehayyoledet kullan metammeot meet leet teuvta
Rav huna bar chiyya amar shemuel lomar sheenah kovaat lah veset betoch yeme zivatah amar rav yosef la shemia li ha shemateta
Amar leh abbaye atte amarte nihalan veaha amarte lan hayeta lemuda lihot roa yom chamishsha asar yom veshinta leom esrim ze vaze asurin leshammesh shinta paamayim leom esrim ze vaze asurin

Vaamarte lan alah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel la shena ella chamishsha asar litvilatah shehen esrim ushnayim liriyyatah dehatam bime niddatah kae lah aval chamishsha asar liriyyatah devime zivatah kae la kava
Amar rav pappa amritah lishmata kammeh rav yehuda middiskarta mikba la kava mechash mahu denechush lah
Ishtik vela amar leh vela mide amar rav pappa nechze anan hayeta lemuda lihot roa leom chamishsha asar veshinta leom esrim ze vaze asurin
b: Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel la shena ella chamishsha asar litvilatah shehen esrim ushnayim liriyyatah
Veshinta leom esrim veshiva dechi hadri veatu esrin vetarte kayema lah betoch yeme zivatah vekatane ze vaze asurin alma dechayeshinan lah
Vekasavar rav pappa esrin vetarten meesrin vetarten manenan nidda ufitchah meesrin veshiva manenan
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa mimmay dilma esrin vetarten name meesrin veshiva manenan dechi hadri veatu esrin vetarten kayema lah betoch yeme niddutah
Vehachi name mistabbera dei la tema hachi hay tarnegolta deramya yoma vechavsha yoma veramya yoma vechavsha yoma vechavsha tere yome veramya chad yoma
Ki hadra nakta kedilkammeh nakta o kidmeikara nakta al korchach kedilkammeh nakta

Amar leh rav pappa ella ha deamar resh lakish ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme zivatah veen ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddutah verabbi yochanan amar ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddutah hechi dame
Lav kegon dachazay resh yarcha vechamsha beyarcha veresh yarcha vechamsha beyarcha vehashta chazay bechamsha beyarcha uvresh yarcha la chazay
Vekaamar ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddutah alma meresh yarcha manena
Amar leh la hachi amar rabbi yochanan kegon dachazay resh yarcha veresh yarcha veesrin vechamsha beyarcha veresh yarcha deamrinan dame yattiri hu deittosafu bah
Vechen ki ata ravin vechol nachote yamma amruha kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua
Hadaran alach benot kutim

a: Matni yotze dofen en yoshvin alav yeme tuma vime tohora veen chayyavin alav korban rabbi shimon omer hare ze keyalud
Kol hannashim metammeot babbayit hachitzon shenneemar dam yihye zovah bivsarah aval hazzav uvaal keri enan metammein ad shettetze tumatan lachutz
Haya ochel bitruma vehirgish shennizdazeu evarav ochez baamma uvolea et hatteruma umtammein bechol shehu afilu keen hachardal uvfachot mikken
Gema amar rabbi mani bar pattish may tamayehu derabbanan amar kera ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar ad shetteled bimkom shehi mazraat
Verabbi shimon hahi daafilu lo yalda ella keen shehizria immo temea leda
Verabbi shimon may tameh amar resh lakish amar kera teled lerabbot yotze dofen
Verabbanan hay mibbee leh lerabbot tumtum veanderoginos desalka datach amena zachar unkeva ketiv zachar vadday nekeva vaddait velo tumtum veanderoginos ka mashma lan
Verabbi shimon nafka leh middetane bar levay detane bar levay leven leven mikkol makom levat levat mikkol makom
Verabbanan hay mibbee leh lechayyev al kol ben uven ulchayyev al kol bat uvat
Verabbi shimon nafka leh middetane tanna kammeh derav sheshet zot torat hayyoledet melammed shemmevia korban echad al veladot harbe yachol tavi al leda veal ziva keechat
Ella yoledet deachla dam veoledet deachla chelev bechad korban tisge lah
Ella yachol tavi al leda shellifne melot veal leda shelleachar melot keachat talmud lomar zot verabbanan af al gav dichtiv zot itzterich leven o levat
Salka datach amena bitre ibure dechad have nefel aval bechad ibbura kegon yehuda vechizkiyya bene rabbi chiyya emar bechad korban saggi lah ka mashma lan
Amar rabbi yochanan umode rabbi shimon bekadashim sheeno kadosh may tama gamar leda leda mibbechor ma hatam peter rechem af kan peter rechem
Veligmar leda leda meadam ma hatam yotze dofen af kan yotze dofen
Mistabbera mibbechor hava leh lemelaf shekken immo meimmo adderabba meadam hava leh lemelaf shekken pashut mippashut
Ella mibbechor hava leh lemelaf shekken im behemat kadashim piggul notar vetame
Adderabba meadam hava leh lemelaf shekken pashut zachar kadosh bemattana hanach nefishan
Amar rav chiyya bereh derav huna mishshemeh derava tanya dimsayya leh lerabbi yochanan rabbi yehuda omer zot torat haola hi haola hare ellu shelosha miutin
b: Parat lenishchata ballayela veshennishpach damah vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim sheim alta tered

Rabbi shimon omer ola en li ella ola keshera minnayin lerabbot shennishchata ballayela veshennishpach damah vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim vehallan vehayyotze vehattame vehannotar veshennishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo

Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulhotzi et ellu

a: Achar sheriba hakkatuv umiet amarta merabbe ani et ellu shehaya pesulan bakkodesh umotzi ani et ellu shello haya pesulan bakkodesh
Katane mihat yotze dofen dela may lav yotze dofen dekadashim amar rav huna bereh derav natan la yotze dofen divchor
Bechor mippeter rechem nafka
Ella may dekadashim meimmo immo nafka
Hay may i amratte bishlama dekadashim hayenu deitzterichi tere kerae chad levehemat chullin deolid derech dofen veakdeshah
Vechad levehemat kadashim deolid derech dofen vekasavar valdot kadashim bahavayatan hen kedoshim ella i amratte divchor mippeter rechem nafka
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane harovea vehannirba vehammuktze vehanneevad vehakkilayim
Hane mehacha nafka mehatam nafka min habbehema lehotzi harovea vehannirba min habbakar lehotzi et hanneevad min hatztzon lehotzi et hammuktze umin hatztzon lehotzi et hannogeach
Vetu kilayim mehacha nafka mehatam nafka shor o chesev o ez shor perat lechilayim o ez perat lenidme
Ella itzterichu tere kerae chad levehemat chullin vechad levehemat kadashim hacha name itzterich tere kerae
Tanu rabbanan hamkashsha shelosha yamim veyatza valad derech dofen hare zo yoledet bezov verabbi shimon omer en zo yoledet bezov vedam hayyotze mishsham tame verabbi shimon metaher
Bishlama resha rabbi shimon letameh verabbanan letamayehu ella sefa bemay peligi amar ravina kegon sheyyatza valad derech dofen
b: Vedam derech rechem veazda rabbi shimon letameh verabbanan letamayehu
Matkef lah rav yosef chada dehayenu resha veod mishsham mekom valad mashma
Ella amar rav yosef kegon sheyyatza valad vedam derech dofen
Uvmakor mekomo tame kamipalgi mar savar makor mekomo tame umar savar makor mekomo tahor
Amar resh lakish ledivre hamtamme baddam metamme baishsha ledivre hamtaher baddam metaher baishsha verabbi yochanan amar af ledivre hamtamme baddam metaher baishsha

Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay minnayin sheen ishsha temea ad sheyyetze madveha derech ervatah shenneemar veish asher yishkav et ishsha dava vegilla et ervatah et mekorah heera melammed sheen ishsha temea ad sheyyetze madveha derech ervatah
Amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia makor shenneekar venafal laaretz temea shenneemar yaan hishshafech nechushtech vattiggale ervatech
Lemay ilema letumat shiva dam amar rachamana velo chaticha ella letumat erev
Amar rabbi yochanan makor shehizzia kishte tipe margaliyyot temea lemay ilema letumat shiva chamishsha damim temein baishsha vetu la ella letumat erev vedaveka tarte aval chada ema mealma atya
Kol hannashim metammein babbayit hachitzon he nihu bayit hachitzon amar resh lakish kol shettinoket yoshevet venirat
Amar leh rabbi yochanan oto makom galuy hu etzel sheretz ella amar rabbi yochanan ad ben hashshinayim
Ibaya lehu ben hashshinayim kelifnim o kelachutz ta shema detane rabbi zakkay ad ben hashshinayim ben hashshinayim atzman kelifnim
Bematnita tana mekom disha may mekom disha amar rav yehuda mekom shehashshammash dash
Tanu rabbanan bivsarah melammed shemmetammea bifnim kevachutz veen li ella nidda zava minnayin talmud lomar zava bivsarah
Poletet shichvat zera minnayin talmud lomar yihye verabbi shimon omer dayyah kevoalah ma boalah eno metamme ad shettetze tuma lachutz af hi enah metammea ad shettetze tumatah lachutz
Vesavar rabbi shimon dayyah kevoalah vehatanya verachatzu vammayim vetamu ad haarev amar rabbi shimon vechi ma ba ze lelammedenu im leinyan nogea beshichvat zera hare kevar neemar lematta o ish
Ella mippene shettumat bet hassetarim hi vetumat bet hassetarim enah metammea ella sheggezerat hakkatuv hi
La kashya kan bimshammeshet kan befoletet
Poletet tipok leh deha shimmesha beshettavla leshimmushah
Lememra dimshammeshet betumat erev saggi lah veha amar rava meshammeshet kol shelosha yamim asura leechol bitruma shei efshar lah shello tiflot
Hacha vemay askinan shehitbiluha bammitta mikkelal dechi kaamar rava deazla ihi becharah vetavla dilma bahade dekaazla shedete

a: Vechi tema dilma ishteyar i hachi chayeshinan shema nishtayyer mibbee leh
Ella lerava name shehitbiluha bammitta vela kashya kan bemithappechet kan besheenah mithappechet

Verava akkera kae vehachi kaamar ki ketav rachamana verachatzu vammayim vetamu ad haarev besheenah mithappechet aval bemithappechet kol shelosha yamim asura leechol bitruma shei efshar lah shello tiflot
Bea mineh rav shemuel bar bisna meabbaye poletet shichvat zera roa haveya o nogaat haveya
Nafka minah listor ultamme bemashshehu ultamme bifnim kevachutz
Ma nafshach i shemia leh matnitin lerabbanan roa haveya ulrabbi shimon nogaat haveya
Vei la shemia leh matnitin mistabbera nogaat haveya
Leolam shemia leh matnitin vealliba derabbanan la kamibaya leh ki ka mibaya leh alliba derabbi shimon
Ultamme bifnim kevachutz la kamibaya leh ki kamibaya leh listor ultamme bechol shehu may
Ki kaamar rabbi shimon dayyah kevoalah hane mile letammoye bifnim kevachutz aval listor ultamme bechol shehu roe haveya o dilma la shena
Ika deamri leolam la shemia leh matnita vehachi kamibaya leh middeachmar rachamana abbaale kerayin besinay roa haveya
O dilma la gamrinan missinay dechiddush hu deha zavin umtzoraim dachamiri vela achmar behu rachamana
Amar leh roa haveya ata shayeleh lerava amar leh roa haveya ata lekammeh derav yosef amar leh roa haveya hadar ata lekammeh deabbaye amar leh kullechu berukka chada tafitu
Amar leh shappir amri lach ad kan la kaamar rabbi shimon dayyah kevoalah ella letamme bifnim kevachutz aval listor ultamme bechol shehu roa haveya
Tanu rabbanan hannidda vehazzava vehashshomeret yom keneged yom vehayyoledet kullan metammeot bifnim kevachutz
Bishlama kullehu lechayye ella yoledet i bime nidda nidda i bime ziva ziva
La tzericha sheyyarda litbol mittuma letohora
Vechi ha deamar rabbi zera amar rabbi chiyya bar ashe amar rav yoledet sheyyarda litbol mittuma letohora veneekar mimmenna dam bayerida temea baaliyya tehora
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera bayerida ammay temea tuma belua hi amar leh zil shayeleh lerabbi avin deasbarit nihaleh vecharkesh li beresheh be midresha
Azal shayeleh amar leh asauha kenivlat of tahor shemmetammea begadim bevet habbelia mi dame
b: Hatam en lah tuma bachutz hacha ki nafek levaray litamme hacha name kesheyyatza lachutz
I yatza lachutz may lememra mahu detema miggo demahane tevila ledam deika gavay tahane name lehay ka mashma lan
Shematin iprik ella yoledet i bime nidda nidda i bime ziva ziva
Hacha bemay askinan beleda yabbishta leda yabbishta may metamme bifnim kevachutz ika
Kegon shehotzi valad rosho chutz lapperozdor vechidrav oshaya deamar rav oshaya gezera shemma yotzi havalad rosho chutz lapperozdor

Vechi hahu daata lekammeh derava amar leh mahu lemimhal beshabbeta amar leh shappir dame batar dinfak amar rava salka datach dehahu gavra la yada dishre lemimhal beshabbeta azal batreh amar leh ema li izi gufa deovada hechi hava

Amar leh shemait valad detzavetz appanya demaale shabbeta vela ityelid ad shabbeta amar leh hay hotzi rosho chutz lapperozdor hu vehave mila shello bizmannah vechol mila shello bizmannah en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat
Ibaya lehu oto makom shel ishsha balua have o bet hassetarim have

Lemay nafka minah kegon shettachava lah chavertah kezayit nevela beoto makom i amratte balua have tuma belua la metammea vei amratte bet hassetarim have nehi divmagga la metammeya bemassa miha metammeya
Abbaye amar balua have rava amar bet hassetarim have amar rava mena amena lah detanya ella mippene shettumat bet hassetarim hi
Vetumat bet hassetarim lo metammea ella sheggezerat hakkatuv hi
Veabbayye chada veod kaamar chada detuma belua hi veod afilu im timtze lomar tumat bet hassetarim hi enah metammea ella sheggezerat hakkatuv hi
Ibaya lehu mekom nivlat of tahor balua have o bet hassetarim have

Lemay nafka minah kegon shettachav lo chavero kezayit nevela letoch piv i amratte balua have tuma belua la metammeya ella vei amratte bet hassetarim have nehi name divmagga lo metamme bemassa miha metamme
Abbaye amar balua have verava amar bet hassetarim have amar abbaye mena amena lah detanya yachol tehe nivlat behema metammea begadim abbet habbelia talmud lomar nevela utrefa lo yochal letoma vah
Mi sheen lah tuma ella achilatah yatzta zo shettemea kodem sheyyochlenna
Vetete bekal vachomer minnivlat of tahor uma nivlat of tahor sheen lah tuma bachutz yesh lah tuma bifnim zo sheyyesh lah tuma bachutz eno din sheyyesh lah tuma bifnim
Amar kera bah bah velo beacheret
Im ken ma talmud lomar vehaochel
Liten shiur lenogea ulnose keochel ma ochel bichzayit af nogea venose bichzayit
Amar rava sheretz bekummeto tahor nevela bekummeto tame
Sheretz bekummeto tahor sheretz bingia hu dimtamme uvet hassetarim lav bar magga hu nevela bekummeto tame nehi divmagga la metamme bemassa miha metamme
Sheretz bekummeto vehichniso laavir hattannur tame peshita mahu detema tocho amar rachamana

a: Velo toch tocho ka mashma lan
Amar resh lakish kane bekumto shel zav vehesit bo et hattahor tahor kane bekumto shel tahor vehesit bo et hazzav tame
May tama deamar kera vechol asher yigga bo hazzav veyadav lo shataf bammayim zehu heseto shel zav shello matzinu lo tuma bechol hattora kullah
Veappekeh rachamana bilshon negia lememra deheset ungia keyadav ma hatam meabbaray af hacha meabbaray
Aval hazzav uvaal keri enan metammein vechu zav dichtiv ki yihye zav mibbesaro ad sheyyetze zovo mibbesaro baal keri dichtiv veish ki tetze mimmennu shichvat zara
Haya ochel bitruma vehirgish vechu ochez vehatanya rabbi eliezer omer kol haochez baamma umashtin keilu mevi mabbul laolam
Amar abbaye bematlit ava rava amar afilu tema bematlit rakka kevan daakar akar veabbaye chayesh dilma ate leosofe verava leosofe la chayesh
Vehatanya lema ze dome lenoten etzba baayin shekkol zeman sheetzba beayin madmaat vechozeret umadmaat
Verava kol ichamome vahadar ichamome beshata la shechiach
Amar shemuel kol shichvat zera sheen kol gufo margish bah enah metammea may tama shichvat zera amar rachamana biruya lehazria
Metivi haya meharher ballayela veamad umatza besaro cham tame targema rav huna bimshammesh mittato bachalomo dei efshar leshammesh belo hargasha
Lishana achrina amar shemuel kol shichvat zera sheeno yore kechetz enah metammea may ika ben hay lishana lehay lishana ika venayehu neekra behargasha veyatza shello behargasha
Milta difshita leh lishmuel mibaya leh lerava devae rava neekra behargasha veyatzta shello behargasha mahu
Ta shema baal keri shettaval velo hetil mayim lichsheyyatil mayim tame shane hatam derubbah behargasha nefak

Lishana achrina amri lah amar shemuel kol shichvat zera sheeno yore kechetz enah mazraat azroe hu dela mazrea ha tammoye metammeya shenneemar ki yihye vecha ish asher lo yihye tahor mikkere afilu keri baolam
Bae rava goy shehirher veyarad vetaval mahu
Im timtze lomar batar akira azlinan hane mile lechumra aval hacha dilkulla la amrinan o dilma la shena teku
Bae rava zava shenneekru meme ragleha veyarda vetavla mahu
Im timtza lomar batar akira azlinan hane mile shichvat zera dela matze naket lah aval meme ragleha dematze naket lah la o dilma la shena teku
Bae rava goya zava shenneekru meme ragleha
b: Veyarda vetavla mahu
Im timtze lomar batar akira azlinan af al gav dematze naket lehu hane mile yisreelit ditmea deorayeta aval goya zava ditmea derabbanan la o dilma la shena teku
Umtammein bechol shehen amar shemuel zav tzarich kachatimat pi haamma shenneemar o hechtim besaro mizzovo
Vehaanan tenan metammein bechol shehen hu deamar kerabbi natan detanya rabbi natan omer mishshum rabbi yishmael zav tzarich kachatimat pi haamma velo hodu lo
May tama derabbi yishmael deamar kera o hechtim besaro mizzovo
Verabbanan hahu mibbae leh lach metamme veeno metamme yavesh
Verabbi yishmael hahu merar nafka
Verabbanan hahu leminyana hu daata zovo chada rar besaro tere et zovo telat limed al zav baal shalosh reiyyot shechayyav bekorban
O hechtim besaro mizzovo tame miktzat zovo tame limed al zav baal shette reiyyot shemmetamme mishkav umoshav verabbi yishmael minyana mena leh nafka leh midderabbi simay
Detanya rabbi simay omer mana hakkatuv shettayim ukrao tame shalosh ukrao tame ha chetzad shettayim lattuma veshalosh lakkorban
Ulman denafka leh tarvayehu mizzot tihye tumato bezovo ish ish ki yihye zav mibbesaro may aved leh mibbae leh ad sheyyetze mibbesaro
Zovo tame lema li limed al hazzov shehu tame
Amar rav chanilay mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon shichvat zera leroe bemashshehu lenogea bechaadasha vehaanan metammein bechol shehen tenan may lav lenogea lo leroe

Ta shema chomer beshichvat zera mibbesheretz vachomer besheretz mibbeshichvat zera chomer besheretz shehashsheretz en chaluka tumato ma sheen ken beshichvat zera chomer beshichvat zera shehashichvat zera metamme bechol shehu ma sheen ken besheretz
May lav lenogea la leroe
Veha dumya desheretz katane ma sheretz bingia af shichvat zera bingia amar rav adda bar ahava shum sheretz katane veshum shichvat zera katane
Vesheretz la metamme bemashshehu veha anan tenan haevarim en lahem shiur pachot mikkezayit besar hammet ufachot mikkezayit besar nevela ufachot mikkaadasha min hashsheretz
Shane ever dechulleh bimkom adasha kae deha ilu chasar purta ever mi kamtamme
Shichvat zera dachaluka tumato may hi ilema ben yisrael lidgoyim hachi name ika achbar deyam veachbar deyabbasha
Ella ben katan legadol
Amar rav pappa ketannae minnayin lerabbot nogea beshichvat zera talmud lomar o ish
Ufligi tannae bealma deika deamri dun minah uminah veika deamri dun minah veoke beatrah
Leman deamar dun minah uminah ma sheretz bingia af shichvat zera bingia uminah ma sheretz bechaadasha af shichvat zera bechaadasha
Ulman deamar dun minah veoke beatrah ma sheretz bingia af shichvat zera bingia veoke beatrah ma shichvat zera laroe bemashshehu af lannogea bemashshehu
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa mimmay demeo ish desheretz kamrabbe leh dilma meo ish asher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara kamrabbe leh udchulle alma dun minah uminah
Shayelinhu letannae ika detane kerav pappa veika detane kerav huna bereh derav natan
Matni tinoket bat yom echad mittammea benidda bat asara yamim mittammea beziva
Tinok ben yom echad mittamme beziva umittamme bingaim umittamme bitme met vezokek leyibbum ufoter min hayyibbum umaachil bitruma ufosel et min hatteruma

a: Venochel umanchil vehahorgo chayyav vahare hu leaviv ulimmo ulchol kerovav kechatan shalem
Gema menahane mile detanu rabbanan ishsha en li ella ishsha bat yom echad lenidda minnayin talmud lomar veishsha
Bat asara yamim leziva mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ishsha en li ella ishsha bat asara yamim leziva minnayin talmud lomar veishsha
Tinok ben yom echad ku mena hane mile detanu rabbanan ish ish ma talmud lomar ish ish lerabbot ben yom echad shemmetamme beziva divre rabbi yehuda

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer eno tzarich hare hu omer vehazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva lazzachar kol shehu ben gadol ben katan lannekeva kol shehi ben gedola ben ketanna im ken ma talmud lomar ish ish dibbera tora chilshon bene adam
Umittamme bingaim dichtiv adam ki yihye veor besaro adam kol shehu
Umtamme bitme met dichtiv veal hannefashot asher hau sham nefesh kol dehu
Vezokek leyibbum dichtiv ki yeshvu achim yachdav achim shehaya lahem yeshiva achat baolam
Ufoter min hayyibbum uven en lo amar rachamana veha it leh
Umaachil bitruma dichtiv vilid beto hem yochlu velachmo keri veh yaachilu belachmo
Ufosel min hatteruma vezera en lah amar rachamana veha it lah
May irya zera afilu ubbar name dichtiv kinureha perat limubberet
Utzrichi dei ketav rachamana vezera en lah mishshum demeikara chad gufa vehashta tere gufe aval hacha demeikara chad gufa vehashta chad gufa ema techol ketav rachamana kinureha
Vei ketav rachamana kinureha mishshum demeikara gufa serika vehashta gufa malya aval hacha demeikara gufa serika vehashta gufa serika ema techol tzericha

Kerae ittarutz ella matnitin may irya ben yom echad afilu ubbar name amar rav sheshet hacha vemay askinan bechohen sheyyesh lo shette nashim achat gerusha veachat sheenah gerusha veyesh lo banim mishsheenah gerusha veyesh lo ben yom echad min haggerusha
Defosel beavde aviv milleechol bitruma ulappoke midderabbi yose deamar ubbar name posel ka mashma lan ben yom echad in ubbar la
Nochel umanchil nochel mimman meaviv umanchil leman leachiv meaviv i bae meavuh lerte lertu vei bae mineh lerte lertu
Amar rav sheshet nochel benichse haem lehanchil leechav min haav vedaveka ben yom echad aval ubbar la may tama dehu mayet beresha veen habben yoresh et immo
b: Bakkever lehanchil leechav min haav
Ini veha hava ovada ufarkes ad telat pirkuse amar mar bereh derav ashe mide dehave azzenav halletaa dimfarkeset

Mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava amar lomar shemmemaet bechelek bechora veamar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava ben shennolad achar mitat haav eno memaet bechelek bechora may tama veyaldu lo baenan
Besura matnu hachi befumbedita matnu hachi amar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava bechor shennolad leachar mitat aviv eno notel pi shenayim may tama yakkir baenan veha leka
Vehilcheta kechol hane lishane demar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava
Vehahorgo chayyav dichtiv veish ki yakke kol nefesh mikkol makom
Vahare hu leaviv ulimmo ulchol kerovav kechatan shalem lemay hilcheta amar rav pappa leinyan avelut
Keman dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar kol sheshshaha sheloshim yom baadam eno nefel ha lo shaha safek have hacha vemay askinan dekim leh shekkalu lo chodashav
Matni bat shalosh shanim veom echad mitkaddeshet bevia veim ba aleha yavam kenaah vechayyavin aleha mishshum eshet ish
Umtammea et boalah letamme mishkav tachton kaelon
Nisset lakkohen tochal bitruma ba aleha echad min happesulin pesalah min hakkehunna ba aleha echad mikkol haaraot haamurot battora mumatin aleha vehi petura
Pachot mikken kenoten etzba baayin
Gema tanu rabbanan bat shalosh shanim mitkaddeshet bevia divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim bat shalosh shanim veom echad may benayehu amri deve rabbi yannay erev rosh hashshana ika benayehu
Verabbi yochanan amar sheloshim yom bashshana chashuvin shana ika benayehu
Metivi bat shalosh shanim vaafilu bat shette shanim veom echad mitkaddeshet bevia divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim bat shalosh shanim veom echad

a: Bishlama lerabbi yochanan ki hechi deika tanna dekaamar yom echad bashshana chashuv shana hachi name ika tanna deamar sheloshim yom bashshana chashuvin shana
Ella lerabbi yannay kashya kashya
Pachot mikken kenoten etzba baayin ibaya lehu hane betulin mezal azli veatu o dilma ittetzode hu dela mittatzdi ad leachar shalosh
Lemay nafka minah kegon shebbaal betoch shalosh umatza dam uvaal leachar shalosh velo matza dam i amratte mezal azli veatu shehut hu dela haveya lehu
Ella i amratte ittetzode hu dela mittatzdi ad leachar shalosh ha acher ba aleha may
Matkef lah rav chiyya bereh derav ika uman lema lan demakka shebbetoch shalosh enah chozeret lealtar shemma chozeret lealtar veha vadday acher ba aleha

Ella nafka minah kegon shebbaal betoch shalosh umatza dam uvaal leachar shalosh umatza dam i amratte mezal azli veatu hay dam betulin hu ella i amratte ittetzode hu dela mittatzdi ella ad leachar shalosh hay dam nidda hu may

Amar rav chisda ta shema pachot mikkan kenoten etzba baayin lema li lemitne kenoten etzba baayin litne pachot mikkan velo chelum may lav ha ka mashma lan ma ayin madmaat vechozeret umadmaat af betulin mezal azli veatu
Tanu rabbanan maase beostani bitto shel asvirus ben antoninus shebbata lifne rabbi amra lo rabbi ishsha bechamma niset amar lah bat shalosh shanim veom echad
Uvchamma mitabberet amar lah bat shettem esre shana veom echad amra lo ani nisseti beshesh veyaladti besheva oy leshalosh shanim sheibbadti bevet abba
Umi miabbera vehatane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman shalosh nashim meshammeshot bemoch ketanna meubberet umnika
Ketanna shemma titabber vetamut meubberet shemma taase ubbarah sandal menika shemma tigmol et benah veyamut
Veezohi ketanna mibbat achat esre shana veom echad vead shettem esre shana veom echad pachot mikkan o yater al ken meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet divre rabbi meir
Vachachamim omrim achat zo veachat zo meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet umin hashshamayim yerachamu shenneemar shomer petayim Adonai
Ibaet ema asher besar chamorim besaram veibaet ema asher pihem dibber shave viminam yemin shaker
Tanu rabbanan maase beishsha achat shebbat lifne rabbi akiva amra lo rabbi nivalti betoch shalosh shanim ma ani lichhunna amar lah keshera atte lakkehunna
Amra lo rabbi emshol lecha mashal lema haddavar dome letinok shettamnu lo etzbao bidvash paam rishona ushniyya goer bah shelishit motztzah amar lah im ken pesula atte lakkehunna

Raa hattalmidim mistakkelim ze baze amar lahem lama haddavar kashe beenechem amru lo keshem shekkol hattora halacha lemoshe missinay kach pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim keshera lakkehunna halacha lemoshe missinay veaf rabbi akiva lo amarah ella lechadded bah et hattalmidim
Matni ben tesha shanim veom echad shebba al yevimto kenaah veen noten get ad sheyyagdil
Umtamme benidda letamme mishkav tachton kaelon
Ufosel veeno maachil batteruma ufosel et habbehema meal gabbe hammizbeach veniskelet al yado veim ba al achat mikkol haaraot haamurot battora mumatin al yado vehu patur
Gema velichsheyyagdil beget saggi lah vehatanya asu biat ben tesha kemaamar baggadol
Ma maamar baggadol tzarich get lemaamaro vachalitza lezikato af biat ben tesha tzarich get lemaamaro vachalitza lezikato
Amar rav hachi kaamar
b: Lichsheyyagdil yivol veyitten get
Matni bat achat esre shana veom echad nedareha nivdakin bat shettem esre shana veom echad nedareha kayyamin uvodkin kol shettem esre
Ben shettem esre shana veom echad nedarav nivdakin ben shelosh esre shana veom echad nedarav kayyamin uvodkin kol shelosh esre

Kodem lazzeman hazze af al pi sheamru yodin anu leshem mi nadarnu leshem mi hikdashnu en nidrehem neder veen hekdeshan hekdesh leachar hazzeman hazze af al pi sheamru en anu yodin leshem mi nadarnu leshem mi hikdashnu nidran neder vehekdeshan hekdesh
Gema vechevan ditna bat achat esre shana veom echad nedareha nivdakin bat shettem esre shana veom echad nedareha kayyamin lema li salka datach amena bodkin leolam ka mashma lan

Vechevan detane bat shettem esre shana veom echad nedareha kayyamin bodkin kol shettem esre lema li salka datach amena hoil veamar mar sheloshim yom bashshana chashuvim shana hecha divdakna sheloshim velo yada lehaflot ema tu la livdok ka mashma lan
Velitne hane tarte bave bat shettem esre shana veom echad nedareha kayyamin uvodkin kol shettem esre bat achat esre veom echad nedareha nivdakin lema li
Itzterich salka datach amena setama bishtem esre baaya bedika beachat esre la baaya bedika vehecha dechazenan lah dacharifa tefe mibadka livdekah beachat esre ka mashma lan
Kodem hazzeman hazze veachar hazzeman hazze lema li salka datach amena hane mile hecha dela kaamri inhu aval hecha dekaamri inhu nismoch alayehu ka mashma lan
Tanu rabbanan ellu divre rabbi rabbi shimon ben elazar omer devarim haamurim betinoket betinok amurim devarim haamurim betinok betinoket amurim
Amar rav chisda may tama derabbi dichtiv vayyiven elohim et hatztzela melammed shennatan hakkadosh baruch hu bina yetera baishsha yoter mibbaish

Veidach hahu mibbae leh lechidresh lakish deamar resh lakish mishshum rabbi shimon ben menasya vayyiven elohim et hatztzela asher lakach min haadam leishsha vayevieha el haadam melammed shekkilleah hakkadosh baruch hu lechava veheviah etzel adam harishon shekken bichrakke hayyam korin lekallaita bannayeta
Verabbi shimon ben elazar may tameh amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak mittoch shehattinok matzuy bevet rabbo nichneset bo armumit techilla
Ibaya lehu toch zeman kelifne zeman o kilachar zeman
Lemay hilcheta i lindarim lav kelifne zeman damya velav kilachar zeman damya
Ella laonashin may rav verabbi chanina deamri tarvayehu toch zeman kelifne zeman rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi deamri tarvayehu toch zeman kilachar zeman
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vesimanach vezot lefanim beyisrael
Metiv rav hamnuna achar zeman hazze af al pi sheamru en anu yodim leshem mi nadarnu leshem mi hikdashnu nidrehem neder vehekdeshan hekdesh ha toch zeman kelifne zeman
Amar leh rava ema resha kodem hazzeman hazze af al pi sheamru yodim anu leshem mi nadarnu leshem mi hikdashnu en nidrehem neder veen hekdeshan hekdesh ha toch zeman kilachar zeman
Vela hi rava katae hu savar rav hamnuna mimmishna yetera kadayek veaddedayek missefa leduk meresha
Vela hi rav hamnuna miggufa dematnitin ka dayek ha leachar zeman hechi dame i dela ayeti shette searot katan hu ella lav deayeti shette searot

a: Vetama dilachar zeman hu degamra lah lemilteh ha toch zeman kelifne zeman
Veod metiv rabbi zera ish ki yafli lindor neder ma talmud lomar ish lerabbot ben shelosh esre shana veom echad sheaf al pi sheeno yodea lehafli nedarav kayyamin
Hechi dame i dela ayeti shette searot katan hu ella lav deayeti shette searot vetama deven shelosh esre veom echad hu dehave leh ish ha toch zeman kelifne zeman teuvta

Amar rav nachman ketannae ben tesha shanim shehevi shette searot shuma mibben tesha vead shettem esre shana veom echad shuma rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer siman ben shelosh esre shana veom echad divre hakkol siman
Ha gufa kashya amratte mibben tesha vead shettem esre shana veom echad shuma ha shelosh esre shana gufa siman vahadar tane ben shelosh esre shana veom echad siman ha shelosh esre shana gufa shuma
May lav tannae hi demar savar toch zeman kilachar zeman umar savar toch zeman kelifne zeman
La dechulle alma toch zeman kelifne zeman veidi veidi betinoket veresha rabbi vesefa rabbi shimon ben elazar
Veibaet ema ha veha betinok veresha rabbi shimon ben elazar vesefa rabbi
Veibaet ema ha veha rabbi ha betinok ha betinoket veibaet ema ha veha rabbi shimon ben elazar ha betinok ha betinoket
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer siman amar rabbi keruspaday bereh derabbi shabbetay vehu sheodan bo
Tanya name hachi ben tesha shanim veom echad shehevi shette searot shuma mibben tesha vead shettem esre shana veom echad veodan bo shuma rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer siman

Amar rava hilcheta toch zeman kelifne zeman rav shemuel bar zutra matne lah lishmata derava behay lishana amar rava ketanna kol shettem esre shana memaenet veholechet mikkan veelach enah memaenet veenah choletzet
Ha gufa kashya amratte enah memaenet alma gedola hi i gedola hi tachlotz
Vechi tema mesappeka leh umi mesappeka leh vehaamar rava ketanna shehiggia lichlal shenoteha enah tzericha bedika chazaka hevia simanin
Hane mile bistama aval hacha divdaku vela ashkachu la
I hachi temaen choshshin shemma nashru

Hanicha leman deamar choshshin ella leman deamar en choshshin may ika lememar deitmar rav pappa amar en choshshin shemma nashru rav pappe amar choshshin hane mile leinyan chalitza aval leinyan meun choshshin
Mikkelal deman deamar choshshin choletzet veha choshshin bealma kaamar
Ella leolam dela badkuha badkan ulinyan chalitza chayeshinan vechi kaamar rava chazaka lemeun aval lachalitza baaya bedika
Amar rav dimi minnehardea hilcheta choshshin shemma nashru
Vehane mile hecha dekiddeshah betoch zeman uvaal leachar zeman deika sefeka deorayeta aval meikara la
Amar rav huna hikdish veachal loke
Shenneemar ish ki yafli lindor velo yachel devaro kol sheyyeshno behaflaa yeshno beval yachel vechol sheeno behaflaa eno beval yachel
Metiv rav huna bar yehuda lerava lesayyoe lerav huna
b: Lefi shemmatzinu shehishva hakkatuv hakkatan kaggadol lizdon shevua ulisar ulval yachel yachol yehe chayyav al hekdesho korban
Talmud lomar ze haddavar
Katane mihat leisar ulval yachel chayyav ema leisur bal yachel
Isur bal yachel ma nafshach i mufla samuch leish deorayeta milka name lilke vei mufla samuch leish lav deorayeta isur name leka leotan hammuzharim alav
Shema minah katan ochel nevelot bet din metzviyn alav lehafrisho hacha vemay askinan kegon shehikdish hu veachlu acherim

Hanicha leman deamar hikdish hu veachlu acherim lokin ella leman deamar en lokin may ika lememar deitmar hikdish hu veachlu acherim rav kahana amar en lokin rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu lokin
Midderabbanan ukra asmachta bealma

Gufa hikdish veachlu acherim rav kahana amar en lokin rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayehu lokin bemay kamipalgi mar savar mufla samuch leish deorayeta umar savar mufla samuch leish midderabbanan

Metiv rav yirmeya yetoma shennadra balah mefer lah i amratte bishlama mufla samuch leish derabbanan atu nissuin derabbanan umvatteli nidra derabbanan ella i amratte deorayeta atu nissuin derabbanan umvatteli nidra deorayeta
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel balah mefer lah mimma nafshach i derabbanan derabbanan hu i deorayeta katan ochel nevelot hu veen bet din metzviyn alav lehafrisho
Veha ki gadla achla bahafara kammayeta
Amar rabba bar levay balah mefer lah kol shaa veshaa vehu shebbaal
Veha en baal mefer bekodmin kidrav pinchas mishshemeh derava deamar rav pinchas mishshemeh derava kol hannoderet al daat balah hi noderet
Amar abbaye ta shema katan shello hevi shette searot rabbi yehuda omer en terumato teruma rabbi yose omer ad shello ba leonat nedarim en terumato teruma mishshebba leonat nedarim terumato teruma

Savruha kasavar rabbi yose teruma bazzeman hazze deorayeta i amratte bishlama mufla samuch laish deorayeta ate gavra deorayeta umtakken tivla deorayeta ella i amratte derabbanan ate gavra derabbanan umtakken tivla deorayeta la kasavar rabbi yose teruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan
Vesavar rabbi yose teruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan vehatanya beseder olam asher yarshu avotecha virishtah
Yerushsha rishona ushniyya yesh lahen shelishit en lahen
Veamar rabbi yochanan man tena seder olam rabbi yose
Rabbi yose tane lah vela savar lah hachi name mistabbera detanya isa shennidmea o shennitchammetza bisor shel teruma

a: Chayyevet bechalla veenah nifselet bitvul yom divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda rabbi yose verabbi shimon potrin min hachalla

Savruha man deamar teruma deorayeta challa deorayeta man deamar teruma derabbanan challa derabbanan i amratte bishlama kasavar rabbi yose challa bazzeman hazze derabbanan ate dimmua derabbanan umafka challa derabbanan
Ella i amratte challa deorayeta ate dimmua derabbanan umafka challa deorayeta
Vedilma kasavar rabbi yose teruma bazzeman hazze deorayeta vechalla derabbanan
Vechidahdar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi vekaamri afilu leman deamar teruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan challa deorayeta
Shehare sheva shekkibbeshu vesheva shechilleku nitchayevu bechalla velo nitchayevu bemaaser

Veamena lehu ana afilu leman deamar teruma bazzeman hazze deorayeta challa derabbanan detanya i bevoachem yachol mishshennichnesu lah shenayim ushlosha meraggelim talmud lomar bevoachem beviat kullechem amarti velo beviat miktzatchem
Vechi assekinhu ezra la kullehu seluk
Matni mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha pagga bochal vatzemel pagga odah tinoket bochal ellu yeme neureha
Bezo uvazo amru aviha zakkay bimtziatah uvmaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha tzemel kevan shebbagra shuv en leaviha reshut bah

Ezehu simanin rabbi yose haggelili omer mishsheyyaale hakkemet tachat haddad rabbi akiva omer mishsheyyattu haddaddim ben azzay omer mishshettashchir happitomet rabbi yose omer kede sheyehe noten yado al haoketz vehu shokea veshohe lachazor
Gema pagga odah tinoket kedichtiv hatteena chanta faggeha bochal ellu yeme hanneurim keditnan hatteenim mishsheyyivchalu veamar rabba bar bar channa amar rav mishsheyyalbin rashehen
Veibaet ema mehacha vattiktzar nafshi bahem vegam nafsham bachala vi tzemel keman deamar yatzta melea
Veezehu simanim rabbi yose haggelili omer mishsheyyaale hakkemet amar shemuel lo mishsheyyaale hakkemet mammash ella kede shettachzir yadeha laachoreha veniret kemi sheyyaale hakkemet tachat haddad
Shemuel bedak beamteh vihav lah arbea zuze deme voshtah shemuel letameh deamar shemuel leolam bahem taavodu laavoda netattim velo levusha
Shemuel meyached lehu rav nachman machlef lehu rav sheshet masar lehu learvaye veamar lehu izdeharu miyyisrael
Rabbi yose omer ku may oketz amar shemuel uktzo shel dad

Tanu rabbanan ellu hen simane vagrut rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer mishsheyyitkashkeshu haddaddin rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer mishsheyyachsif rosh hachotem mishsheyyachsif azkinah lah ella amar rav ashe mishsheyyaftzil rosh hachotem rabbi yose omer mishshettakkif haatara rabbi shimon omer mishshennitmaech
b: Hakkaf

Vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer shelosha simanin natnu chachamim baishsha millematta uchnegdan millemala pagga millemala beyadua shello hevia shette searot bochal millemala beyadua shehevia shette searot tzemel millemala beyadua shennitmaech hakkaf
May kaf amar rav huna makom tafuach yesh lemala meoto makom kevan shemmegaddelet mitmaech veholech shaalu et rabbi halacha kedivre mi shelach lehu amar lahen kedivre kullan lehachmir

Rav pappa verav chinana bereh derav ika chad matne aha vechad matne achatzer tzorit ditnan ezohi chatzer tzorit shechayyevet bemaaser rabbi shimon omer chatzer hatztzorit shehakkelim nishmarim betochah
May chatzer hatztzorit amar rabba bar bar channa amar rabbi yochanan shekken betzor moshivin shomer al petach hechatzer rabbi akiva omer kol sheechad poteach veechad noel petura
Rabbi nechemya omer kol sheen adam bosh leechol betochah chayyevet rabbi yose omer kol shennichnasim lah veen omrim lo ma atta mevakkesh petura
Rabbi yehuda omer shette chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo happenimit chayyevet vehachitzona petura
Shaalu et rabbi halacha kedivre mi amar lehu lahen halacha kedivre kullan lehachmir
Matni bat esrim shana shello hevia shette searot tavi reaya shehi bat esrim shana vehi ayelonit lo choletzet velo mityabbemet
Ben esrim shana shello hevi shette searot yaviu reaya shehu ben esrim shana vehu saris lo choletz velo meyabbem ellu divre bet hillel bet shammay omrim ze vaze ben shemone esre
Rabbi eliezer omer hazzachar kedivre bet hillel vehannekeva kedivre bet shammay shehaishsha memaheret lavo lifne haish
Gema urminhi echad li ben tesha shanim veom echad veechad li ben esrim shello hevi shette searot
Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav vehu shennoldu bo simane saris amar rava dayeka name dekatane vehu saris shema minah
Vechi lo noldu lo simane saris ad kamma tane rabbi chiyya ad rov shenotav
Ki atu lekammeh derabbi chiyya i kechish amar lehu avreuh i bari amar lehu achchashuh dehane simanim zimnin deatu mechamat kechishuta zimnin deatu mechamat beriuta
Amar rav hilcheta bechulle pirka meet leet veulla amar ditnan tenan udla tenan la tenan
Bishlama leulla hayenu dekatane hacha yom echad vehacha la katane ella lerav litne

Veod tane rabbi yose ben kipar omer mishshum rabbi eliezer shenat esrim sheyyatzu mimmenna sheloshim yom hare hi kishnat esrim lechol devareha vechen hora rabbi belod shenat shemone esre sheyyatzu mimmenna sheloshim yom hare hi kishnat shemone esre lechol devareha
Bishlama derabbi udrabbi yose ben kipar la kashya ha kevet shammay ha kevet hilel ella lerav kashya
Tannae hi detanya shana haamura bakkodashim shana haamura bevatte are choma shette shanim shebbisde achuzza
Shesh shanim shebbeeved ivri vechen shebbabben veshebbabbat kullan meet leet
Shana haamura bakkodashim mena lan amar rav acha bar yaakov amar kera keves ben shenato shenato shello velo shana shel minyan olam
Shana haamura bevatte are choma menalan amar kera ad tom shenat mimkaro mimkaro shello velo shana shel minyan olam shette shanim shebbisde achuzza menalan amar kera bemispar

a: Shene tevuot yimkor lach peamim sheatta mocher shalosho tevuot bishte shanim
Shesh shanim shebbeeved ivri menalan amar kera shesh shanim yaavod uvashsheviit uvishviit name yaavod
Shebbabben veshebbabbat lemay hilcheta amar rav gidel amar rav leinyan arachin verav yosef amar lefirkin deotze dofen
Amar leh abbaye mi peligatte amar leh la hu amar chada vaana amena chada vela peliginan
Vehachi name mistabbera dei salka datach peligi man deamar laarachin la amar leotze dofen vehaamar rav hilcheta bechulle pirkin meet leet
Ella leman deamar laarachin may tama la amar leotze dofen dumya dehanach ma hanach dichtivan af hane name dichtivan
Veidach hay shebbabben veshebbabbat shebbazzachar veshebbannekeva mibbee leh
Amar rav yitzchak bar nachmani amar rabbi elazar halacha kerabbi yose ben kipar sheamar mishshum rabbi eliezer amar rabbi zera ezke veesak veagmar lishmata mippummeh demarah
Ki selek ashkecheh lerabbi elazar amar leh amratte halacha kerabbi yose ben kipar amar leh mistabbera amari middechulleh pirkin tane yom echad vehacha la katane shema minah mistabbera kevateh
Hadaran alach yotze dofen
Matni ba siman hattachton ad shello ba haelon o choletzet o mityabbemet
Ba haelon ad shello ba hattachton af al pi shei efshar rabbi meir omer lo choletzet velo mityabbemet
Vachachamim omrim o choletzet o mityabbemet mippene sheamru efshar lattachton lavo ad shello ba haelon aval i efshar laelon lavo ad shello ba hattachton
Gema af al pi shei efshar vahalo ba ba lerabbi meir af al pi shei efshar lerabbanan
Velitne ba haelon rabbi meir omer lo choletzet velo mityabbemet vachachamim omrim o choletzet o mityabbemet vaana yadana mishshum dei efshar hu
I la tena af al pi shei efshar hava amena rov nashim tachton ate beresha umiut elon ate beresha verabbi meir letameh dechayesh lemiuta verabbanan letamayehu dela chayeshi lemiuta
Vehane mile bistama aval hecha devadkan vela ashkechan emar modu leh rabbanan lerabbi meir deelon kadem
Ka mashma lan dei efshar vadday ate umintar hu dintar
Bishlama lerabbi meir hayenu dichtiv shadayim nachonu usarech tzimmeach ella lerabbanan ipcha mibbae leh hachi kaamar kevan sheshshadayim nachonu beyadua shessearech tzimmeach
Bishlama lerabbi meir hayenu dichtiv basot mimmitzrayim daddayich lemaan shede neurayich ella lerabbanan ipcha mibbae leh
Hachi kaamar kevan shebbau daddayich beyadua shebbau neurayich veibaet ema may shede kulleh bedadde ketiv vehachi kaamar hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael
b: Ikrafu daddayich la hadarte bach ishtedo daddayich name la hadarte bach

Dechulle alma miha attachton samchinan menalan amar rav yehuda amar rav vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael amar kera ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashin shebbattora ma ish besiman echad af ishsha besiman echad
Veema o hay o hay keish ma ish tachton velo elon af ishsha tachton velo elon
Tanya name hachi amar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok kach hau mefarshin beyavne veamru kevan shebba tachton shuv en mashgichin al elon
Tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer benot kerakkim tachton memaher lavo mippene shergilot bemerchatzaot benot kefarim elon memaher lavo mippene shettochanot berechayim

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer benot ashirim tzad yamin memaher lavo shennishof beeppikrisutan banot aniyyim tzad semol memaher lavo mippene sheshshoavot kadde mayim alehen veibaet ema mippene shennosin achehen al gissehen

Tanu rabbanan tzad semol kodem letzad yamin rabbi chanina ben achi rabbi yehoshua omer meolam lo kadam tzad semol letzad yamin chutz meachat shehayeta bishchunati shekkadam tzad semol letzad yamin vechazar leetano
Tanu rabbanan kol hannivdakot nivdakot al pi nashim vechen haya rabbi eliezer moser leishto verabbi yishmael moser leimmo

Rabbi yehuda omer lifne happerek ulachar happerek nashim bodkot otan toch happerek en nashim bodkot otan sheen massiin sefekot al pi nashim rabbi shimon omer af toch happerek nashim bodkot otan veneemenet ishsha lehachmir aval lo lehakel
Ketzad gedola hi shello temaen ketanna hi shello tachlotz
Aval en neemenet lomar ketanna hi shettemaen ugdola hi shettachlotz
Amar mar rabbi yehuda omer lifne happerek ulachar happerek nashim bodkot otan bishlama lifne happerek bae bedika dei mishtachchi leachar happerek shuma ninhu
Ella leachar happerek lema li bedika vehaamar rava ketanna shehiggia lichlal shenoteha enah tzericha bedika chazaka hevia simanin ki amar rava chazaka lemeun aval lachalitza baaya bedika
Toch happerek en nashim bodkot otan kasavar toch happerek kilachar happerek dame
Ulachar happerek deika chazaka derava samchinan annashim uvadki toch happerek deleka chazaka derava la samchinan annashim vela badki nashim
Rabbi shimon omer af toch happerek nashim bodkot otan kasavar toch happerek kelifne happerek uvaaya bedika dei mishtachchi leachar happerek shuma ninhu
Veneemenet ishsha lehachmir aval lo lehakel hay man katane lah ibaet ema rabbi yehuda veattoch happerek

a: Veibaet ema rabbi shimon ulachar happerek velet leh chazaka derava
Mippene sheamru efshar ku ha tu lema li ha tana leh resha
Vechi tema mishshum deka vae lemistemah kerabbanan peshita yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim
Mahu detema mistabbera tama derabbi meir deka mesayya leh kerae ka mashma lan veibaet ema mishshum deka bae lemitne kayyotze vo
Matni kayyotze vo kol keli cheres shehu machnis motzi veyesh shemmotzi veeno machnis
Kol ever sheyyesh bo tzipporen yesh bo etzem veyesh sheyyesh bo etzem veen bo tzipporen
Kol hammittamme midras mittamme teme met veyesh shemmittamme teme met veeno mittamme midras
Gema machnis pasul leme chattat ufasul mishshum gistera motzi kasher leme chattat ufasul mishshum gistera
Amar rav assi shonin kele cheres shiuro bechones mashke velo amru motzi mashke ella leinyan gistera bilvad may tama amar mar zutra bereh derav nachman lefi sheen omrim have gistera legistera
Tanu rabbanan ketzad bodkin keli cheres leda im nikav bechones mashke im lav yavi areva melea mayim venoten kedera letochah im kenasah beyadua shekkones mashke veim lav beyadua shemmotzi mashke
b: Rabbi yehuda omer kofef ozne kedera letochah umetzif aleha mayim veim kones beyadua shekkones mashke veim lav beyadua shemmotzi mashke
O shoftah al gabbe haur im haur maamidah beyadua shemmotzi mashke veim lav beyadua shemmachnis mashke

Rabbi yose omer af lo shoftah al gabbe haur mippene shehaur maamidah ella shoftah al gabbe haremetz im remetz maamidah beyadua shemmotzi mashke veim lav beyadua shekkones mashke haya tored tipa achar tipa beyadua shekkones mashke
May ika ben tanna kamma lerabbi yehuda amar ulla kinus al yede haddechak ika venayehu
Kol ever sheyyesh bo tzipporen vechu yesh bo tzipporen metamme bemagga uvmassa uvohel yesh bo etzem veen bo tzipporen metamme bemagga uvmassa veeno metamme beohel
Amar rav chisda davar ze rabbenu haggadol amaro hammakom yihye beezro etzba yetera sheyyesh bo etzem veen bo tzipporen metamme bemagga uvmassa veeno metamme beohel
Amar rabba bar bar channa amar rabbi yochanan uchsheenah nisperet al gav hayyad
Kol hamtamme midras vechu kol dachaze lemidras mittamme teme met
Veyesh shemmittamme teme met veen mittamme midras leetoye may leetoye sea vetarkav
Detanya vehayyoshev al hakkeli yachol kafa sea veyashav aleha o tarkav veyashav alav yehe tame
Talmud lomar asher yeshev alav hazzav mi shemuchad lishiva yatza ze sheomrim lo amod venaase melachtenu
Matni kol harauy ladun dine nefashot rauy ladun dine mamonot veyesh sherauy ladun dine mamonot veeno rauy ladun dine nefashot
Gema amar rav yehuda leetoye mamzer
Tenena chada zimna hakkol kesherin ladun dine mamonot veen hakkol kesherin ladun dine nefashot vehavenan bah leetoye may veamar rav yehuda leetoye mamzer chada leetoye ger vachada leetoye mamzer
Utzrichi dei ashmeinan ger mishshum derauy lavo bakkahal aval mamzer deen rauy lavo bakkahal ema la
Vei ashmeinan mamzer mishshum dekaate mittippa keshera aval ger dekaate mittippa pesula ema la tzericha
Matni kol hakkasher ladun kasher lehaid veyesh shekkasher lehaid veeno kasher ladun
Gema leetoye may amar rabbi yochanan leetoye some beachat meenav umanni

a: Rabbi meir hi detanya haya rabbi meir omer ma talmud lomar al pihem yihye kol riv vechol naga vechi ma inyan rivim etzel negaim makkish rivim lingaim ma negaim bayyom dichtiv uvom heraot bo af rivim bayyom
Uma negaim shello besome dichtiv lechol mare ene hakkohen af rivim shello besome umakkish negaim lerivim ma rivim shello bikrovim af negaim shello bikrovim

I ma rivim bishlosha af negaim bishlosha vedin hu mamono bishlosha gufo lo kol shekken talmud lomar vehuva el aharon hakkohen o el achad mibbanav hakkohanim ha lamadta sheafilu kohen echad roe et hannegaim
Hahu samya dahava beshivavuteh derabbi yochanan dahava kadayen dina vela kaamar leh vela mide hechi aved hachi vehaamar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna
Utnan kol hakkasher ladun kasher lehaid veyesh kasher lehaid veen kasher ladun veamrinan leetoye may veamar rabbi yochanan leetoye some beachat meenav
Rabbi yochanan setama acharina ashkach ditnan dine mamonot danin bayyom vegomrin ballayela
Umay ulmeh dehay setama mehay setama ibaet ema setama derabbim adif veibaet ema mishshum dekatane lah gabbe hilcheta dedine
Matni kol shechayyav bammaasrot mittamme tumat ochalin veyesh shemmittamme tumat ochalin veeno chayyav bammaasrot
Gema leetoye may leetoye basar vedagim uvetzim
Matni kol shechayyav bappea chayyav bammaasrot veyesh shechayyav bammaasrot veeno chayyav bappea
Gema leetoye may leetoye teena veyarak sheeno chayyav bappea ditnan kelal amru bappea kol shehu ochel venishmar vegidulo min haaretz ulkitato keechad umachniso lekiyyum chayyav bappea
Ochel lemaote sefiche setes vekotza venishmar lemaote hefker vegidulo min haaretz lemaote kemehim ufitriyyot ulkitato keechad lemaote teena umachniso lekiyyum lemaote yarak
Veilu gabbe maaser tenan kol shehu ochel venishmar vegidulo min haaretz chayyav bammaasrot veilu lekitato keechad umachniso lekiyyum la katane
Im hau bahem shumim uvtzalin chayyavin ditnan malbenot betzalim shebben hayyarak rabbi yose omer pea mikkol achat veechat vachachamim omrim meachat al hakkol
Amar rabba bar bar channa amar rabbi yochanan ulshin shezzeraan mittechila livhema venimlach alehen laadam
b: Tzerichot machshava lichsheyyittalshu kasavar machshevet chibbur lo shemah machshava

Amar rava af anan name tenena shelosha asar devarim neemru benivlat of tahor veze echad mehen tzericha machshava veenah tzericha hechsher alma machshevet chayyim lo shemah machshava hacha name machshevet chibbur lo shemah machshava
Rabbi zera amar hacha begozal shennafal min harum askinan dela hava kamman delachshov aleh
Amar leh abbaye tarnegolet shebbeyavne may ika lememar amar leh tarnegol bara hava
Achichu aleh tarnegol bara of tame hu veof tame mi kamtamme amar lehu abbaye gavra rabba amar milta la techichu aleh betarnegolet shemmarda umay bara deibray mimmarah
Rav pappa amar tarnegolta deagma havay rav pappa letameh deamar rav pappa tarnegola deagma asir tarnegolta deagma sharya
Vesimanach ammoni velo ammonit darash marimar tarnegolta deagma asira chazuha rabbanan dedarsa veachla vehayenu geruta
Tanu rabbanan gozal shennafal laggat vechishshav alav lehaaloto lechuti tame lechelev tahor rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer af lechelev tame
Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri kal vachomer im metamme tuma chamura shello bemachshava lo yetamme tuma kalla shello bemachshava
Amru lo lo im amarta betuma chamura shekken enah yoredet lechach tomar betuma kalla shekken yoredet lechach
Amar lahen tarnegolet shebbeyavne tochiach sheyyoredet lechach vetimmeuha shello bemachshava amru lo mishsham reaya kutim hau sham vechishshevu aleha laachila
Bemay askinan ilema bichrakkim lema lah machshava vehatnan nivlat behema tehora bechol makom venivlat of tahor vehachelev bakkerakkim en tzerichin lo machshava velo hechsher
Ella bichfarim umi ika leman deamar dela baaya machshava vehatnan nivlat behema temea bechol makom venivlat of tahor bakkefarim tzericha machshava veenah tzericha hechsher
Amar rabbi zeera bar chanina leolam bichrach vegitto measattu vaasaattu kichfar
Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri kal vachomer im metammea tuma chamura shello bemachshava lo tetamme tuma kalla shello bemachshava
Amru lo lo im amarta betuma chamura shekken enah yoredet lechach
May enah yoredet lechach amar rava hachi kaamri leh lo im amarta

a: Betuma chamura shekken enah osa kayyotze bah tomar betuma kalla sheosa kayyotze bah
Amar leh abbaye kol dechen hu uma tuma chamura dekila deenah osa kayyotze bah metammea shello bemachshava tuma kalla dachamira deose kayyotze bah eno din shemmetammea shello bemachshava
Ella amar rav sheshet hachi kaamar lo im amarta betuma chamura shekken enah tzericha hechsher tomar betuma kalla shetztzericha hechsher
Umi tzericha hechsher vehatnan shelosha devarim neemru benivlat of tahor tzericha machshava veenah metammea ella bevet habbelia veenah tzericha hechsher
Nehi dehechsher sheretz la baaya hechsher mayim baaya
May shena hechsher sheretz dela baaya kidtana deve rabbi yishmael hechsher mayim name la tive kidtana deve rabbi yishmael
Detana deve rabbi yishmael al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea
Ma zeraim sheen sofan letamme tuma chamura tzerichin hechsher af kol sheen sofan letamme tuma chamura tzerichin hechsher yatzta nivlat of tahor shessofah letamme tuma chamura sheen tzarich hechsher
Ella amar rava veitema rav pappa shum tuma chamura beolam shum tuma kalla baolam
Amar rava umode rabbi yochanan leinyan maaser demachshevet chibur shemah machshava amar rava mena amena lah ditnan hassea vehaezov vehakkornit shebbechatzer im hau nishmarin chayyavin
Hechi dame ilema dezarinhu mittechilla laadam tzericha lememar ella lav dezarinhu mittechilla livhema vekatane im hau nishmarin chayyavin
Amar rav ashe hacha bechatzer shealu meelehen askinan ustama leadam kayemi vehachi kaamar im hechatzer meshammeret peroteha chayyavin veim lav peturin
Metiv rav ashe kol shechayyavin bammaasrot mittammein tumat ochalin veim ita ha ika hane dekachayyavin dechayyavin bemaaser veen mittammein tumat ochalin
Amar rava hachi kaamar kol min shechayyav bemaaser mittamme tumat ochalin
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane sefa kol shechayyav bereshit haggez chayyav bammattanot veyesh shechayyav bammattanot veen chayyav bereshit haggez
Veim ita haika terefa dechayyevet bereshit haggez veenah chayyevet bammattanot
Amar ravina ha manni rabbi shimon hi ditnan rabbi shimon poter et hatterefa mereshit haggez
Amar rav shimi bar ashe ta shema hammafkir et karmo vehishkim babboker uvtzaro chayyav bapperet uvaolelot uvashshichcha uvappea ufatur min hammaaser
Veha anan tenan kol shechayyav bappea chayyav bammaasrot ella lav shema minah min katane shema minah
Tenan hatam modim chachamim lerabbi akiva bezorea shevet o chardal bishnayim ushlosha mekomot shennoten pea mikkol echad veechad
b: Veha shevet demichayyav befea umichayyav bemaaser ditnan kol shechayyav bappea chayyav bammaaser
Umiddechayyav bammaaser mittamme tumat ochalin alma kol mile daavid letama mittamme tumat ochalin dehay shevet letama avida
Urminhi hakkoshte vehachimum verashe vesamim vehattia vehachiltit vehappilpelim vechallat charia nikkachin bechesef maaser veen mittammein tumat ochalin divre rabbi akiva
Amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri im nikkachin bechesef maaser mippene ma en mittammein tumat ochalin veim enan mittammein af hem lo yillakchu bechesef maaser
Veamar rabbi yochanan ben nuri nimnu vegamru sheen nikkachin bechesef maaser veen mittammein tumat ochalin
Amar rav chisda ki tanya hahi beshevet haasuya lechamach

Amar rav ashe amritah lishmata kammeh derav kahana amar la tema beshevet haasuya lechamach ha setama likdera ella setam shevet lechamach asuya ditnan hashshevet mishshennatna taam bakkedera en bah mishshum teruma veenah mittammea tumat ochalin

Ha ad shello natna taam bakkedera yesh bah mishshum teruma umittammea tumat ochalin vei salka datach setama likdera ki lo natna name setama likdera ella lav shema minah setama lechamach asuya shema minah
Matni kol shechayyav bereshit haggez chayyav bammattanot veyesh shechayyav bammattanot veeno chayyav bereshit haggez
Kol sheyyesh lo biur yesh lo sheviit veyesh sheyyesh lo sheviit veen lo biur
Gema kegon ale halluf shote vehaddandanna yesh sheyyesh lo sheviit veen lo biur ikar halluf shote veikar haddandanna

Dichtiv velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha tihye chol tevuatah leechol kol zeman shechayya ochelet min hassade atta maachil livhemtecha babbayit kala lachayya min hassade kalle livhemtecha shebbabbayit vehane la kalu lehu
Matni kol sheyyesh lo kaskeset yesh lo senappir veyesh sheyyesh lo senappir veen lo kaskeset kol sheyyesh lo karnayim yesh lo telafayim veyesh sheyyesh lo telafayim veen lo karnayim
Gema kol sheyyesh lo kaskeset dag tahor yesh sheyyesh lo senappir veen lo kaskeset dag tame mikkede anan akkaskeset samchinan senappir dichtav rachamana lema li
I la ketav rachamana senappir hava amena may kaskeset dichtiv senappir vaafilu dag tame ketav rachamana senappir vekaskeset
Vehashta dichtav rachamana senappir vekaskeset menalan dekaskeset levusha hu dichtiv veshiron kaskassim hu lavush
Velichtov rachamana kaskeset vela bae senappir amar rabbi avahu vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael yagdil tora veyadir
