Matni kol hattaun beracha leacharav taun beracha lefanav veyesh shettaun beracha lefanav veen taun beracha leacharav
Gema leetoye may leetoye yarak ulrabbi yitzchak dimvarech ayyarak leetoye may leetoye mayya
Ulrav pappa dimvarech ammayya leetoye may leetoye mitzot velivne mareva dimvarchi batar desalliku tefilayehu asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lishmor chukkav leetoye may leetoye

a: Rechane
Matni tinoket shehevia shette searot o choletzet o mityabbemet vechayyevet bechol mitzot haamurot battora
Vechen tinok shehevi shette searot chayyav bechol mitzot haamurot battora verauy lihot ben sorer umore mishsheyyavi shette searot ad sheyyakkif zakan
Hattachton velo haelon ella sheddibberu chachamim belashon nekiyya
Tinoket shehevia shette searot enah yechola leman rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyirbe hashshachor
Gema vechevan ditnan chayyevet bechol mitzot haamurot battora o choletzet o mityabbemet lema li
Leappoke midderabbi yose deamar ish katuv bapparasha aval ishsha ben gedola uven ketanna ka mashma lan dei ayeti shette searot in i la la may tama ishsha keish
Vechevan ditna vechen hattinok shehevi shette searot chayyav bechol hammitzot haamurot battora lema li

Vechi tema mishshum dekavae lemitne verauy lihot ben sorer umore tenena chada zimna ematay hu ben sorer umore mishsheyyavi shette searot vead sheyyakkif zakan hattachton velo haelon ella sheddibberu chachamim belashon nekiyya
In hachi name ella ayede defaresh mile detinoket kamfaresh name mile detinok
Tinoket shehevia ku amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar halacha kerabbi yehuda
Umode rabbi yehuda sheim nivala leachar shehevia shette searot shuv enah yechola lemaen
Chavrohi derav kahana sevur lemebad ovada kerabbi yehuda veaf al gav denivala

Amar lehu rav kahana lo kach haya maase bevitto shel rabbi yishmael shebbat levet hammidrash lemaen uvnah murkav lah al ketefah veoto hayyom huzkeru devarav shel rabbi yishmael bevet hammidrash uvachta veravta bechiyya gedola bevet hammidrash
Amru davar sheamar oto tzaddik yikkashel bo zaro

Deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi yishmael vehi lo nitpasa asura ha nitpasa mutteret veyesh lecha acheret sheaf al pi shello nitpasa mutteret veezo zo shekkiddusheha kiddushe taut sheaf al pi shebbenah murkav al ketefah memaenet veholechet lah
Venimnu vegamru ad matay habbat memaenet ad shettavi shette searot perush vela avud ovada

Rabbi yitzchak vetalmidi derabbi chanina avud ovada kerabbi yehuda veaf al gav denivala azal rav shemen bar abba amrah kammeh derabbi yochanan azal rabbi yochanan amrah kammeh derabbi yehuda nesia shaddar ballasha veappekuha

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukva lo sheyyarbe hashshachor mammash ella kede sheyyihu shette searot shochvot venirot kemi sheyyirbe hashshachor al hallavan rava amar shette searot hammakkifot missafa lesafa
Amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna shette searot sheamru tzarich sheyehe beikaran gummot rav malkiyyo amar rav adda bar ahava gummot af al pi sheen searot
Amar rav chanina bereh derav ika shappud shefachot vegummot rav malkiyyo belorit efer mikle ugvina rav malkiyya
Rav pappa amar matnitin umatnita rav malkiyya shematata rav malkiyyo vesimana matnita malketa
May benayehu ika benayehu shefachot

Amar rav ashe amar li mar zutra kashe bah rabbi chanina missura la lishtemit tanna leashmoinan gummot i ashmoinan gummot hava amena ad sheyehu shette searot bishte gummot ka mashma lan daafilu shette searot begumma achat

Umi ika kehay gavena vehachtiv asher bisara yeshufeni vehirba fetzaay chinnam veamar rava iyyov bisara cheraf bisara heshivuhu bisara cheraf amar lefanav ribbono shel olam shemma ruach seara avra lefanecha venitchallefa lecha ben iyyov leoyev bisara heshivuhu vayyaan Adonai et
b: Iyyov min hasseara vayyomar elav shote shebbaolam harbe nimin barati berosho shel adam ulchol nima venima barati lo gumma bifne atzmah shello yihu shettayim yonkot miggumma achat sheilmale shettayim yonkot miggumma achat machchish meor enav shel adam gumma begumma lo nitchallef li iyyov beoyev nitchallef li
La kashya ha begufa ha beresha
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel shette searot sheamru afilu achat al hakkaf veachat al habbetzim

Tanya name hachi shette searot sheamru afilu achat begabbah veachat bichresah achat al gabbe kishre etzbeoteha shel yad veachat al gabbe kishre etzbeoteha shel regel divre rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar akko sheamar mishshum rabbi shimon verabbanan amar rav chisda ad sheyehu shette searot bemakom echad
Tanu rabbanan ad matay habbat memaenet ad shettavi shette searot divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyirbe hashshachor rabbi yose omer ad shettakkif haatara ben shelakot omer ad shettechalkel

Veamar rabbi shimon metzaani chanina ben chachinay betzayeddan veamar kesheatta maggia etzel rabbi akiva emor lo ad matay habbat memaenet im yomar lach ad shettavi shette searot emor lo vahalo ben shelakot heid bemaamad kullechem beyavne ad shettechalkel velo amartem lo davar
Keshebbati etzel rabbi akiva amar li kilkul ze eni yodea mahu ben shelakot eni makkir ad matay habbat memaenet ad shettavi shette searot

Matni shette searot haamurot bappara uvannegaim vehaamurot bechol makom kede lachof roshan leikaran divre rabbi yishmael rabbi eliezer omer kede likrotz batztziporen rabbi akiva omer kede sheyehu nitalot bezug
Gema amar rav chisda amar mar ukva halacha kedivre kullan lehachamir
Matni haroe ketem hare zo mekulkelet
Vechosheshet mishshum zov divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim en bichtamim mishshum zov
Gema man chachamim rabbi chanina ben antignos hi detanya rabbi chanina ben antignos omer ketamim en bahen mishshum zov ufamim shehakketamim meviin lide ziva
Ketzad lavsha shelosha chalukot habbedukot lah umatza alehem ketem o sheraata shene yamim vechaluk echad hen hen hakketamim hammeviin lide ziva
Hashta shelosha chalukot delav miggufah kachazya chayeshinan shene yamim vechaluk echad mibaya
Mahu detema kol ki hay gavena mevia korban veneechal ka mashma lan

Amar rava beha zakkinhu rabbi chanina ben antignos lerabbanan may shena pachot mishshelosha gerisin bemakom echad dela chayeshinan deamrinan bitre yome chaziteh shelosha gerisin bemakom echad name nema tarte ufalga miggufah chazeteh veidach aggav zuhama dam maacholet hu
Verabbanan kevan deika lefalloge bigris vaod lechol yoma la talenan
Verabbi chanina ben antignos shelosha gerisin bemakom echad hu dela chayeshinan ha bishlosha mekomot chayeshinan ha amratte bishlosha chalukot in bishlosha mekomot la

Ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu ledidi bishlosha chalukot in bishlosha mekomot la ella ledidchu odo li mihat dehecha dachazay shelosha gerisin bemakom echad deamrinan tere ufalga miggufah chazeteh veidach aggav zuhama dam maacholet hu
Verabbanan kevan deika lefalloge bigris vaod lechol yoma la talenan
Tanu rabbanan haroe ketem im yesh bo kede lechallek shelosha gerisin shehen kigris vaod chosheshet veim lav enah chosheshet
Rabbi yehuda ben agra omer mishshum rabbi yose achat zo veachat zo chosheshet

a: Amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yehuda ben agra beshello badka vedivre chachamim beshebbadka

May badka umay lo badka amar rava ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi vekaamri hacha vemay askinan kegon shebbadka atzmah velo badka chalukah veaf atzmah lo badka ella ben hashshemashot derabbi yehuda uvven hashshemashot derabbi yose lo badka
Derabbanan savri beven hashshemashot derabbi yose lelya hu veha badka beven hashshemashot derabbi yehuda verabbi yose letameh deamar ben hashshemashot sefeka have
Veamena lehu ana ilmale yadeha beeneha kol ben hashshemashot yafe attem omrim achshav shemma im silluk yadeha raata veamru li ki kaamrinan keshennatna yadeha beeneha kol ben hashshemashot
Amar rabbi nirin divre rabbi yehuda ben agra keshello badka may lo badka
Ilema devadka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar af al gav devadka betarvayehu chayesha ha badka
Ella peshita delo badka la bidrabbi yehuda vela bidrabbi yose aval badka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose la chayesha
Alma ben hashshemashot derabbi yose lerabbi lelya hu ema sefa vedivre chachamim keshebbadka may badka
Ilema devadka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose mikkelal derabbanan savri af al gav delo badka betarvayehu la chayeshinan ha lo badka
Ella peshita devadka ben bidrabbi yehuda uven bidrabbi yose aval badka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose chayeshinan
Alma ben hashshemashot derabbi yose lerabbi sefeka have kashya derabbi adderabbi

Hachi kaamar nirin divre rabbi yehuda ben agra lerabbanan dela badka kelal lo bidrabbi yehuda velo bidrabbi yose sheaf chachamim lo nechleku alav ella devadka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose aval hecha delo badka kelal modu leh
Urminhu haroa ketem liriyya merubba chosheshet liriyya muetet enah chosheshet zo divre rabbi yehuda ben agra sheamar mishshum rabbi yose

Amar rabbi ani shamati mimmennu sheachat zo veachat zo chosheshet umin hattaam hazze amar li uma ilu nidda shello hifrisha betahora min hammincha ulmala lo tehe bechezkat temea venirin devarav keshebbadka
May badka ilema devadka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose mikkelal derabbi yehuda ben agra savar af al gav delo badka la bidrabbi yehuda vela bidrabbi yose la chayesha veha lo badka
Ella peshita devadka ben bidrabbi yehuda uven bidrabbi yose mikkelal derabbi yehuda ben agra savar badka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose la chayesha
Alma ben hashshemashot derabbi yose lerabbi yehuda ben agra lelya hu kashya derabbi yehuda ben agra adderabbi yehuda ben agra
Bishlama belo rabbi la kashya hatam devadka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose hacha devadka name bidrabbi yehuda uvidrabbi yose ella bidrabbi kashya
Tere tannae vealliba derabbi yehuda ben agra hay tanna savar shalem ben hashshemashot derabbi yehuda
b: Vahadar chayel ben hashshemashot derabbi yose vehay tanna savar ben hashshemashot derabbi yose meshach shayech bidrabbi yehuda
Tanu rabbanan haroa ketem metammea atzmah vekadashim lemafrea divre rabbi
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer kadashim metammea atzmah enah metammea shello yehe kitmah chamur meriyyatah
Veha matzinu kitmah chamur meriyyatah leinyan kadashim
Ella tane hachi rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af kadashim enah metammea shello yehe kitmah chamur meriyyatah lechol davar
Tanu rabbanan raata ketem veachar kach raata dam tola kitmah biriyyatah meet leet divre rabbi
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer yomo amar rabbi nirin devarav middevaray shehu metakkenah vaani meavvetah
Metakkenah auote meavet lah amar ravina efoch
Rav nachman amar leolam la tefoch shehu metakken hilchoteha lide ziva
Vaani meavet hilchoteha lide ziva
Bae mineh rabbi zera merabbi assi ketamim tzerichin hefsek tohora o la ishtik vela amar leh vela mide
Zimnin ashkecheh deyatev vekaamar tola kitmah biriyyatah meet leet divre rabbi
Amar resh lakish vehu shebbadka verabbi yochanan amar af al pi shello badka
Amar leh mikkelal dichtamim tzerichin hefsek tohora amar leh in veha zimnin saggiin beay minach vela amarte vela mide dilma aggav shitfach atya lach amar leh in aggav shitfay atya li
Matni haroa yom achad asar ben hashshemashot techillat nidda vesof nidda techillat ziva vesof ziva
Yom arbaim lazzachar veom shemonim lannekeva ben hashshemashot lechullan hare ellu toot
Amar rabbi yehoshua ad sheattem metakkenim et hashshotot bou vetakkenu et happikkechot
Gema techillat nidda vesof nidda techillat nidda vesof ziva hi
Amar rav chisda hachi kaamar haroa yom achad asar ben hashshemashot techilat nidda vesof ziva
Uvashshevii leniddatah sof nidda utchillat ziva
Amar rabbi yehoshua ad sheattem metakkenin et hashshotot ku hane

a: Shotot ninhu toot ninhu ella teni toot
Detanya yom echad tame veom echad tahor meshammeshet shemini velelo immo
Vearbaa lelot mittoch shemona asar yom veim hayeta roa mibbaerev enah meshammeshet ella shemini bilvad
Shene yamim temein ushne yamim tehorin meshammeshet shemini ushnem asar veshishsha asar veesrim
Utshammesh name bitshasar amar rav sheshet zot omeret gargeran ditnan asur
Rav ashe amar nehi dechad asar la bae shimur asiri miha bae shimur
Shelosha yamim temein ushlosha yamim tehorin meshammeshet shene yamim veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam
Arbaa yamim temeim vearbaa yamim tehorin meshammeshet yom echad veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam

Chamishsha yamim temeim vachamishsha yamim tehorin meshammeshet shelosha yamim veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam shishsha yamim temein veshishsha yamim tehorin meshammeshet chamishsha yamim veshuv enah meshammeshet laolam
Shiva yamim temein veshiva yamim tehorin meshammeshet revia yameha mittoch esrim ushmona yamim
Shemona yamim temein ushmona yamim tehorin meshammeshet chamishsha asar yom mittoch arbaim ushmona
Hane arbesar hau
Amar rav adda bar yitzchak zot omeret yeme niddatah sheen roa bahen olin lisfirat zivatah deibaya lehu
b: Yeme leda sheenah roa bahen mahu sheyyaalu lisfirat zivatah
Amar rav kahana ta shema raata shenayim velashshelishi hippila veenah yodaat ma hippila
Hare zo sefek ziva sefek leda
Mevia korban veeno neechal vime ledatah sheen roa bahen olin lah lisfirat zivatah
Amar rav pappa shane hatam kevan deika lememar yoledet zachar hi vechol hane shiva yattire dekayahavinan lah salki lah lisfirat zivatah
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa beoledet zachar ika lesappoke beoledet nekeva leka lesappoke ella lav shema minah olin shema minah
Tisha yamim temein vetisha yamim tehorin meshammeshet shemona yamim mittoch shemona asar
Asara yamim temein vaasara yamim tehorim yeme shimmushah kime zivatah vechen lemea vechen leelef
Hadaran alach ba siman

Matni dam hannidda uvsar hammet metammein lachin umtammein yeveshin aval hazzov vehannia veharok vehashsheretz vehannevela veshichvat zera metammein lachin veen metammein yeveshin veim yecholin lehishsharot velachzor lichmot shehen metammein lachin umtammein yeveshin
Vechamma hi sheriyyatan befoshrin meet leet rabbi yose omer besar hammet yavesh veeno yachol lehishsharot velachzor lichmot shehaya tahor
Gema mena hane mile amar chizkiyya deamar kera vehaddava beniddatah madveha kemotah ma hi metammea af madveha metammea
Ashkechan lach yavesh menalan amar rabbi yitzchak amar kera yihye bahavayato yehe

Veema hane mile belach venaasa yavesh yavesh meikaro menalan vetu ha ditnan hammappelet kemin kelipa kemin afar kemin saara kemin yavchushin adummim tatil lammayim im nimmochu tame menalan yihye ribbuya hu
I ma hi osa mishkav umoshav letamme adam ultamme begadim af damah name ose mishkav umoshav letamme adam ultamme begadim attu dama bar mishkav umoshav hu
Ultamach even menuggaat bat mishkav umoshav hi deitzterich kera lemaote detanya yachol tehe even menuggaat osa mishkav umoshav letamme adam letamme begadim
Vedin hu uma zav sheeno metamme bevia ose mishkav umoshav letamme adam letamme begadim even menuggaat shemmetammea bevia eno din shemmetammea mishkav umoshav letamme adam letamme begadim
Talmud lomar hazzav hazzav velo even menuggaat tama demaatah kera ha lav hachi metammea
Uminah lav mi amratte hazzav velo even menuggaat hachi name amar kera asher hi yoshevet alav hi velo damah

a: I ma hi metammea beeven mesama af madveha name metammea beeven mesama
Amar rav ashe amar kera vehannose otam otam miuta hu
Uvsar hammet menalan amar resh lakish amar kera lechol tumato lechol temaot happorshot mimmennu
Rabbi yochanan amar o veetzem adam o vekaver adam dumya deetzem ma etzem yavesh af kan yavesh
May benayehu ika benayehu deipperich ipperoche
Metivi besar hammet shehufrach tahor hatam deakmach vehave afra
Metivi kol shebbammet metamme chutz min hashshinayim vehassear vehatztzipporen uvishat chibburan hakkol tame
Amar rav adda bar ahava dumya deetzem ma etzem shennivra immo af kol shennivra immo vehaika sear vetzipporen shennivreu immo uthorin

Ella amar rav adda bar ahava dumya deetzem ma etzem shennivra immo veen gizo machlif af kol shennivra immo veen gizo machlif yatzu hashshinayim shello nivreu immo yatzu sear vetzipporen sheaf al pi shennivreu immo gizo machlif

Vahare or degizo machlif utnan haggeluda rabbi meir machshir vachachamim poslin vaafilu rabbanan la kafasli ella deaddehache vehache shalet bah avera umita ulolam gizo machlif utnenan ellu sheorotehem kivsaran or haadam
Ha itmar alah amar ulla devar tora or adam tahor umay tama amru tame gezera shemma yaase adam orot aviv veimmo shetichin lachamor
Veika deamri hare or deen gizo machlif utnan vachachamim poslin vaafilu rabbi meir la ka machshar ella dekarir bisra vechaye ulolam en gizo machlif veamar ulla devar tora or adam tahor

Ki itmar deulla assefa itmar vechullan sheibbedan o shehilech bahen kede avoda tehorin chutz meor adam veamar ulla devar tora or adam ki ibbeddo tahor uma taam amru tame gezera shemma yaase adam or aviv veimmo shetichin
Vahare basar degizo machlif vetame amar mar bar rav ashe basar naase mekomo tzalleket
Aval hazzov zov menalan detanya zovo tame limed al hazzov shehu tame

Vahalo din hu laacherim gorem tuma leatzmo lo kol shekken sair hammishtalleach yochiach sheggorem tuma laacherim vehu atzmo tahor af atta al titmah al ze sheaf al pi sheggorem tuma laacherim hu atzmo tahor talmud lomar zovo tame limed al hazzov shehu tame
Veema hane mile bemagga aval bemassa la mide dehave ashsheretz amar rav bivi bar abbaye bemagga la itzterich kera dela gara mishshichvat zera
b: Ki itzterich kera lemassa veema bemassa metamme adam uvgadim uvmagga adam metamme begadim la letamme mide dehave ammagga nevela
La salka datach detanya acherim omrim hazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva makkish zovo lo ma hu lo chillakta ben maggao lemassao letamme adam ultamme begadim af zovo ken
Vehashta denafka lan mehazzav et zovo zovo tame lema li
Amar rav yehuda middiskarta itzterich salka datach amena sair hammishtalleach yochiach sheggorem tuma laacherim vehu atzmo tahor vei mishshum hazzav et zovo leminyana hu daata
Zov chad zovo tarte uvashshelishi akkesheh rachamana linkeva
Ketav rachamana zovo tame vehashta deamar rachamana zovo tame hu derosh beh name hay
Veharok rok menalan detanya vechi yarok yachol af al pi shello naga talmud lomar battahor ad sheyyigga battahor
En li ella rukko kicho venio ume haaf shello minnayin talmud lomar vechi yarok
Amar mar yachol af al pi shello naga mehecha tete
Salka datach amena nelaf rok rok mivama ma hatam af al pi dela nega af hacha name dela nega ka mashma lan
Veemar hane mile bemagga aval bemassa la mide dehave ashsheretz amar resh lakish tana deve rabbi yishmael amar kera battahor ma shebbeyad tahor timmeti lach
Veema bemassa metamme adam uvgadim bemagga adam letamme begadim la letamme mide dehave ammagga nevela
Amar resh lakish vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael amar kera battahor tohora shettiharti lecha bemakom acher timmeti lecha kan veeze ze magga nevela
Veema kemassa desheretz im ken nichtov kera baadam may battahor shema minah tarte

Ume haaf may me haaf amar rav benigrarin derech happe lefi shei efshar leme haaf belo tzichtzuche harok verabbi yochanan amar afilu benigrarin derech hachotem alma kasavar mayan hu verachamana rabbeyeh
Verav nachshov name dimat eno deamar rav hay man devae delistamme leeneh lichchol miggoy velevi amar hay man devae delemut lichchol miggoy
Veamar rav chiyya bar gurya may tama derav dela amar ha man devae delemut hoil veyachol legorran ulhotzian derech happe verav nehi dezihara nafek dimata gufa la nafek

Ta shema tisha mashke hazzav hen hazzea vehallecha serucha veharei tehorin mikkelum dimat eno vedam maggefato vachalev haishsha metammein tumat mashkin birviit aval zovo rukko umeme raglav metammein tuma chamura veilu me haaf la katane
Bishlama lerav la katane dela pesika leh lemitne zimnin deate derech happe vezimnin deate derech hachotem ella lerabbi yochanan litne
Ultamach kicho venio mi katane ella tena rok vechol deate meribbuya hacha name tena rukko vechol deate meribbuya
Dimat eno dichtiv vattashkemo bidmaot shalish vedam maggefato dichtiv vedam chalalim yishte ma li katleh kulleh ma li katleh palgeh chalev haishsha dichtiv vattiftach et nood hechalav vattashkehu
Meme raglav menalan detanya zovo tame vezot lerabbot meme raglav letuma vahalo din hu uma rok habba mimmekom tohora tame meme raglav habbain

a: Mimmakom tame eno din sheyehu temein dam hayyotze mippi haamma yochiach shebba mimmakom tame vetahor af atta al titmah al ze sheaf al pi shebba mimmekom tuma yihye tahor talmud lomar zovo tame vezot lerabbot meme raglav letuma
Dam hayyotze mippi haamma menalan detahor detanya yachol yehe dam hayyotze mippiv umippi haamma temein talmud lomar zovo tame hu hu tame veen dam hayyotze mippiv umippi haamma tame ella tahor
Veefoch ana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay dumya derok ma rok shemmitaggel veotze af kol shemmitaggel veotze yatza dam sheen mitaggel veotze
Vahare chalav shebbaishsha shemmitaggel veotze veamar mar chalav shebbaishsha metamme tumat mashkin tumat mashkin in aval la tuma chamura

Ella amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay dumya derok ma rok mitaggel veotze vechozer venivla af kol mitaggel veotze vechozer venivla yatza dam sheeno mitaggel veotze yatza chalav shebbaishsha sheaf al pi shemmitaggel veotze eno chozer venivla
Venelaf mizzovo ma zovo sheen mitaggel veotze metamme af kol amar rava mizzovo leka lemelaf shekken gorem tuma laacherim
Vehashsheretz amar resh lakish sheretz sheyyavash veshildo kayyemet tame vehaanan tenan metammein lachin veen metammein yeveshin amar rabbi zera la kashya ha bechullan ha bemiktzatan
Detanya amar rabbi yitzchak berabbi bisna amar rabbi shimon ben yochay bahem yachol bechullan talmud lomar mehem
I mehem yachol bemiktzatan talmud lomar bahem ha ketzad kan belach kan beyavesh
Amar rava hane zevuge demachoza ki shildan kayyemet temein veamar resh lakish sheretz shennisraf veshildo kayyemet tame
Metivi nimtza sheretz saruf al gabbe hazzetim vechen matlet hammehuha tehorin shekkol hattemaot kishat metziatan amar rabbi zera la kashya ha bechullan ha bemiktzatan
Detanya amar rabbi yitzchak berabbi bisna mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay bahem yachol bechullan talmud lomar mehem
I mehem yachol bemiktzatan talmud lomar bahem ha ketzad kan besaruf kan besheeno saruf
Metammein lachin zav dichtiv rar besaro kicho venio verukko dichtiv ki yarok hazzav keen rok
Sheretz bemotam amar rachamana keen mita shichvat zera haruya lehazria nevela dichtiv ki yamut keen mita
Im yecholin lehishsharot bae rabbi yirmeya techilato vesofo befoshrin o dilma techilato af al pi sheen sofo
Ta shema detanya kamma hi sheriyyatan befoshrin yehuda ben nakosa omer meet leet techilato af al pi sheen sofo rabban shimon ben gamliel omer tzerichin sheyehu poshrin meet leet

Rabbi yose omer besar hammet ku amar shemuel tahor milletamme bichzayit aval metamme tumat rakav tanya name hachi rabbi yose omer besar hammet sheyyavash veen yachol lishrot velachazor kemot shehaya tahor milletamme bichzayit aval tame tumat rakav
Matni hashsheretz shennimtza bammavoy metamme lemafrea ad sheyyomar badakti et hammavoy hazze velo haya bo sheretz o ad sheat kibbud
Vechen ketem shennimtza bechaluk metamme lemafrea ad sheyyomar badakti et hechaluk hazze velo haya bo ketem o ad sheat hakkibbus
Umtamme ben lach ben yavesh rabbi shimon omer hayyavesh metamme lemafrea vehallach eno metamme ella ad sheat sheyehe yachol lachazor velihot lach
Gema ibaya lehu ad sheat kibbud chezkato baduk o dilma chezkato mitkabbed
Umay nafka minah deamar kabbud vela beduk i amratte chezkato baduk ha la bedik i amratte chezkato mitkabbed ha mitkabbed
b: I name deishtechach begumma i amratte chezkato baduk man devadek begumma name badek i amratte chezkato mitkabbed gumma la mitkabbeda
Vechen hakketem vechu ibaya lehu ad sheat kibbus chezkato baduk o dilma chezkato mitkabbes
Lemay nafka minah deamar kabus vela beduk i amratte chezkato baduk ha la bedik i amratte chezkato mitkabbes ha mitkabbes
I name deishtechach besitra i amratte chezkato baduk man devadek besitra name badek i amratte chezkato mitkabbes besitra la mitkabbes

May ta shema detanya amar rabbi meir mippene ma amru hashsheretz shennimtza bemavoy metamme lemafrea ad sheyyomar badakti et hammavoy hazze velo haya bo sheretz o ad sheat kibud mippene shechezkat bene yisrael bodkin mevootehen bishat kibbudehem veim lo badku hifsiduhu lemafrea

Umippene ma amru ketem shennimtza bechaluk metamme lemafrea ad sheyyomar badakti et hechaluk velo haya bo ketem o ad sheat hakkibbus mippene shechezkat benot yisrael bodkot chalukehen bishat kibbusehen veim lo badku hifsidu lemafrea
Rabbi acha amar tachzor utchabbesennu im nidcha marito nidchu marav beyadua shelleachar kibbus veim lav beyadua shellifne hakkibbus
Rabbi omer eno dome ketem shelleachar hakkibbus lechetem shellifne hakkibbus shezze makdir veze maglid shema minah chezkato baduk shema minah
Umtamme ben lach vechu amar rabbi elazar lo shanu ella sheretz aval ketem lach name metamme lemafrea emar yavesh haya umayya neful aleh
Sheretz name emar yavesh haya umayya neful aleh im ita dehachi hu immartute imartat

Matni kol hakketamin habbain merkam tehorin rabbi yehuda metamme mippene shehem gerim vetoin habbain mibben haggoyim tehorin mibben yisrael umibben hakkutim rabbi meir metamme vachachamim metaharim mippene shello nechshedu al kitmehen
Gema kafasek vetane afilu mittarmod amar rabbi yochanan zot omeret mekabbelin gerim mittarmod
Ini veha rabbi yochanan vesavayya deamri tarvayehu en mekabbelin gerim mittarmod
Vechi tema zot vela sevira leh vehaamar rabbi yochanan halacha kistam mishna
Amorae ninhu vealliba derabbi yochanan
Mibben yisrael vechu verabbanan i deyisrael metahari deman metammu
Chassore michassera vehachi katane mibben yisrael tame mibben hakkutim rabbi meir metamme dechutim gere emet hen vachachamim metaharin dechutim gere araot hen
I hachi shello nechshedu al kitmehen gere araot mibbae leh
Ella hachi kaamar mibben yisrael umibben hakkutim temein dechutim gere emet hen hannimtzain beare yisrael tehorin shello nechshedu al kitmehem veatznoe matznei lehu
Hannimtzain beare kutim rabbi meir metamme denechshedu al kitmehem vachachamim metaharin shello nechshedu al kitmehen
Matni kol hakketamim hannimtzaim bechol makom tehorin chutz min hannimtzaim bachadarim uvisvivot bet hattemaot
Bet hattemaot shel kutim metammein beohel mippene shehem kovrin sham et hannefalim rabbi yehuda omer lo hau kovrin ella mashlichin vechayya gorarto
Neemanim lomar kavarnu sham et hannefalim o lo kavarnu neemanim lomar al habbehema im bikkera im lo bikkera neemanim al tziyyun kevarot
Veen neemanin lo al hassechachot velo al happeraot velo al bet happeras
Ze hakkelal davar shechashudim bo en neemanin alav

a: Gema may derush lo tassig gevul reacha asher gavlu rishonim benachalatcha
Kol sheyyesh lo nachala yesh lo gevul kol sheen lo nachala en lo gevul
Neemanim lomar kavarnu veha let lehu velifne iver lo titten michshol amar rabbi avahu bechohen omed sham
Vedilma kohen tame hu denaket teruma bideh vedilma teruma temea hi dekaachel minah
I hachi may lememra mahu detema la bekii bitzira ka mashma lan
Neemanin al habbehema vechu veha let lehu velifne iver lo titten michshol amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan begozez veoved
I hachi may lememra mahu detema la bekii betinuf ka mashma lan
Neemanin al tziyyun vechu veaf al gav demidderabbanan hu kevan dichtiva mizhar zehiri beh dichtiv veraa etzem adam uvana etzlo tziyyun
Aval en neemanin lo al hassechachot vechu sechachot ditnan ellu hen sechachot ilan hammesech al haaretz peraot ditnan avanim peruot hayyotzot min haggader
Bet happeras amar rav yehuda amar rav shemuel menappeach adam bet happeras veholech

Rav yehuda bar amme mishshemeh derav yehuda amar bet happeras shennidash tahor vetana hachoresh bet hakkevarot hare ze ose bet happeras vead kamma hu ose melo maana mea amma bet arbaat sein rabbi yose omer chamesh
Vela mehemni vehatanya sade sheavad bah kever neeman kuti lomar en sham kever
Lefi sheeno meid ella al gufo shel kever ilan shehu mesech al haaretz neeman lomar en tachtav kever lefi sheeno meid ella al gufo shel kever
Amar rabbi yochanan bimhallech uva al pene kullah
I hachi may lememra mahu detema retzua nafka ka mashma lan
Ze hakkelal ku ze hakkelal leetoye may leetoye techumin veyen nesech
Hadaran alach dam hannidda
b: Matni haroa ketem al besara keneged bet hatturpa temea veshello keneged bet hatturpa tehora al akevah veal rosh gudalah temea
Al shokah veal parsoteha mibbifnim temea mibbachutz tehora veal hatztzedadin mikkan umikkan tehora
Raata al chalukah min hechagur ulmatta temea min hechagur ulmala tehora raata al bet yad shel chaluk im maggia keneged bet hatturpa temea veim lav tehora
Hayeta poshatto umitkassa bo ballayela kal makom shennimtza bo ketem temea mippene shehu chozer vechen bappulos
Gema amar shemuel badka karka olam veyashva aleha umatza dam aleha tehora shenneemar bivsarah ad shettargish bivsarah
Hay bivsarah mibe leh shemmetammea bifnim kevachutz im ken lema kera bevasar may bivsarah shema minah ad shettargish bivsarah
Veakkatti mibe leh bivsarah velo beshafir velo bachaticha tarte shema minah
Ta shema haishsha shehi osa tzeracheha veraata dam rabbi meir omer im omedet temea veim yoshevet tehora
Hechi dame i deargisha yoshevet ammay tehora ella lav dela argisha vekatane omedet temea
Leolam deargisha veemor hargashat me raglayim havay omedet hadur me raglayim lemakor veayeti veayeto dam veoshevet tehora
Ta shema ed shehaya natun tachat hakkar venimtza alav dam im agol tahor veim mashuch tame
Hechi dame i deargisha agol ammay tahor ella lav dela argisha vekatane mashuch tame
La leolam deargisha veemor hargashat ed havay mashuch vadday miggufah ata agol tahor
Ta shema nimtza al shello temein vechayyavin bekorban nimtza al shellah otom temein vechayyavin bekorban nimtza al shellah leachar zeman temeim missafek ufturin min hakkorban
Hechi dame i deargisha leachar zeman ammay peturin min hakkorban ella lav dela argisha vekatane nimtza al shellah otom temein vechayyavin bekorban la leolam deargisha veema hargashat shammash hava
Ta shema nimtzeta atta omer shelosha sefekot baishsha al besara safek tame safek tahor tame al chalukah safek tame safek tahor tahor uvmaggaot uvhesetot hallech achar harov
May hallech achar harov lav im rov yameha temein temea veaf al gav dela argisha
La im rov yameha behargasha chazya temea deemor argisha velav addatah
Amar mar al besara safek tame safek tahor tame al chalukah safek tame safek tahor tahor
Hechi dame i mechagor ulmatta al chalukah ammay tahor veha tenan min hechagur ulmatta tame vei mechagor ulmala al besarah ammay tame vehatnan raata dam al besara shello keneged bet hatturpa tehora

Ibaet ema mechagor ulmatta veibaet ema mechagor ulmala i baet ema mechagor ulmatta kegon sheavra beshuk shel tabbachim al besara miggufah atay dei mealma atay al chalukah mibe leh ishtechoche al chalukah mealma ata dei miggufah ata al besara mibe leh ishtechoche
Veibaet ema mechagor ulmala kegon deizdekara al besarah vadday miggufah atay dei mealma atay al chalukah ibi leh ishtechoche al chalukah mealma atay dei miggufah atay al besara ibi leh ishtechoche

Katane mihat al besarah safek tame safek tahor tame veaf al gav delo hirgisha veod tenan haroa ketem al besara keneged bet hatturpa temea veaf al gav delo hirgisha amar rav yirmeya middifti mode shemuel shehi temea

a: Midderabbanan
Rav ashe amar shemuel hu deamar kerabbi nechemya ditnan rabbi nechemya omer kol davar sheeno mekabbel tuma eno mekabbel ketamim
Bishlama lerav ashe hayenu dekaamar karka ella lerav yirmeya may irya karka afilu gelima name la mibaya kaamar
La mibaya gelima dela mibbedak shappir veika lememar mealma ata ella afilu karka demibbedak shappir deika lememar miggufah atya tahor
Al akevah veal rosh gudalah temea vechu bishlama akevah avid denaga beoto makom ella rosh gudalah may tama vechi tema zimnin denaga baakevah umi mechazzekinan tuma mimmakom lemakom
Vehatanya hayeta lah makka betzavarah shettuchal litlot tola al ketefah sheenah yechola litlot enah tola
Veen omrim shemma beyadah netalattu veheviattu lesham ella shane rosh gudalah devahade defasa avid demitreme
Vela mechazzekinan tuma mimmakom lemakom vehatanya nimtzet al kishre etzbeoteha temea mippene sheyyadayim askaniyyot hen
May tama lav mishshum deamrinan badka bechad yeda venaga beidach yeda la shane yedah dechullah avida denaga
Al shokah veal parsoteha mibbifnim vechu mibbifnim ad hecha amri deve rabbi yannay ad makom chavak

Ibaya lehu mekom chavak kelifnim o kelachutz ta shema detane rav kattina ad mekom chavak vachavak atzmo kelifnim rav chiyya bereh derav aveya matne lah behedya amri deve rabbi yannay ad makom chavak vachavak atzmo kelifnim
Bae rabbi yirmeya kesher mahu keshura mahu tipin tipin mahu lerochav yerechah mahu
Ta shema al besarah safek tame safek tahor tame al besarah may lav ki hay gavena la dilma daavid kirtzua
Hahi itta deishtechach lah dema bemashtita atay lekammeh derabbi yannay amar lah tezil vetete
Vehatanya en shonin bitharot ki amrinan en shonin lekulla aval lechumra shonin
Hayeta poshatto vechu tanya amar rabbi eliezer berabbi yose davar ze horeti bair romi leisur uchshebbati etzel chachamim shebbaddarom amru li yafe horetah
Tanu rabbanan arukka shellavsha chalukah shel ketzara uktzara shellavsha chalukah shel arukka im maggia keneged bet hatturpa shel arukka shettehen temeot veim lav arukka tehora uktzara temea
Tanya idach badka chalukah vehishilattu lachavertah hi tehora vachavertah tola bah amar rav sheshet ulinyan dina tenan aval leinyan tuma hi tehora vachavertah temea
b: May shena meha detanya shette nashim shennitasseku betzippor echad veen bo ella kesela dam venimtza kesela al zo uchsela al zo shettehen temeot shane hatam deika sela yattira
Tanu rabbanan lavsha shelosha chalukot habbedukin lah im yechola litlot tola vaafilu battachton en yechola litlot enah tola vaafilu baelon
Ketzad avra beshuk shel tabbachim tola afilu battachton lo avra beshuk shel tabbachim af baelon enah tola
Matni vetola bechol davar shehi yechola litlot shachata behema chayya vaof nitasseka bichtamim o sheyyashva betzad haasukin bahen harga maacholet hare zo tola bah
Ad kamma tola rabbi chanina ben antignos omer ad kigris shel pol veaf al pi shello harga vetola bivnah o bevalah im yesh bah makka vehi yechola lehiggalea ulhotzi dam hare zo tola

Maase beishsha achat shebbat lifne rabbi akiva amra lo raiti ketem amar lah shemma makka hayeta bich amra lo hen vechayeta amar lah shemma yechola lehiggalea ulhotzi dam amra lo hen vetiharah rabbi akiva
Raa talmidav mistakkelin ze baze amar lahem ma haddavar kashe beenechem shello amru chachamim haddavar lehachmir ella lehakel shenneemar veishsha ki tihye zava dam yihye zovah bivsarah dam velo ketem
Ed shehu natun tachat hakkar venimtza alav dam agol tahor mashuch tame divre rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok
Gema tenena leha detanu rabbanan maase vetala rabbi meir bekilor verabbi tala bisraf shikma
O sheyyashva yashva in lo yashva la
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan avra beshuk shel tabbachim safek nitaz aleha safek lo nitaz aleha tola safek avra safek lo avra temea
Harga maacholet harga in lo harga la matnitin manni rabban shimon ben gamliel hi detanya harga tola lo harga enah tola divre rabban shimon ben gamliel vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach tola
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel lidvaray en ketz uldivre chaveray en sof
Lidvaray en ketz sheen lecha ishsha shettehora levalah sheen lecha kol mitta umitta sheen bah kamma tipe dam maacholet
Ledivre chaveray en sof sheen lecha ishsha sheenah tehora levalah sheen lecha kol sadin vesadin sheen bo kamma tipe dam

Aval nirin divre rabbi chanina ben antignos middevaray umiddivrehem shehaya omer ad kamma hi tola ad kigris shel pol velidvarav anu modim ulrabbanan deamri tola ad kamma amar rav nachman bar yitzchak tola befishpesh vead ketormos
Tanu rabbanan pishpesh ze orko kerochbo vetamo kerecho berit keruta lo shekkol hammollo meriach bo orko kerochbo leinyan ketamim
Tamo kerecho leinyan teruma ditnan o shettaam taam pishpesh befiv hare ze yiflot mena yada tamo kerecho veakkatti mena yada berit keruta lo shekkol hammollo meriach bo
Amar rav ashe ir sheyyesh bah chazirim en choshshin lichtamim amar rav nachman bar yitzchak veha derokeret keir sheyyesh bah chazirim damya
Ad kamma hi tola vechu amar rav huna kigris enah tola pachot mikkigris tola verav chisda amar kigris tola yater mikkigris enah tola
Lema bead vead bichlal ka mipalgi derav huna savar ad velo ad bichlal verav chisda savar ad vead bichlal
Amar lecha rav huna ika ad vead bichlal veika ad velo ad bichlal vehacha lechumra vehacha lechumra
Verav chisda amar lach bealma ema lach lechumra amrinan lekulla la amrinan vehacha kidrabbi avahu deamar rabbi avahu kol shiure chachamim lehachmir chutz mikkigris shel ketamim lehakel
Ika deamri lah leha shemata beappe nafshah rav huna amar kigris keyater mikkigris verav chisda amar kigris kefachot mikkigris vekamipalgi bead vead dehacha kidamrinan metivi

a: Hau aleha tipe damim lematta vetipe damim lemala tola beelon ad kigris may lav kigris millematta la kigris millemala
Itmar nimtza aleha kigris vaod veoto od retzufa bo maacholet rabbi chanina omer temea rabbi yannay omer tehora rabbi chanina omer temea ki talya bechigris bechigris vaod la talya
Rabbi yannay omer tehora hane mile hecha delo retzufa bo maacholet aval hecha dirtzufa bo maacholet mochcha milta dehay vaod dam maacholet hu pash leh kigris kevan divalma talya hacha name talya
Bae rabbi yirmeya nitasseka bechigris venimtza aleha bechigris vaod mahu tive lerabbi chanina tive lerabbi yannay

Tibbee lerabbi chanina ad kan la kaamar rabbi chanina hatam temea ella delo nitasseka aval hacha denitasseka talya o dilma afilu lerabbi yannay deamar tehora hane mile hecha dirtzufa bo maacholet aval hecha deen retzufa bo maacholet lo talya
Ta shema nitasseka beedom en tola bah shachor bemuat en tola bo merubba hechi dame lav ki hay gavena
La kegon denitasseka bechigris venimtza aleha shene gerisin vaod i hachi may lememra
Mahu detema shekol kigris tzippor shedi be mitze zil hacha leka shiura zil hacha leka shiura ka mashma lan
Amar rava nimtza aleha min echad tola bo kamma minin metivi nitasseka beadom en tola bo shachor nitasseka shane
Ika deamri amar rava nitasseka bemin echad tola bo kamma minin metivi nitasseka beadom en tola bo shachor ki kaamar rava deitassaka betarnegolet deit bah kamma mine dema
Maase beishsha vechu vehatanya lo amru chachamim et haddavar lehakel ella lehachmir
Amar ravina lo lehakel al divre tora ella lehachmir al divre tora uchtamim atzman derabbanan
Ed shehu natun ibaya lehu mi peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok o la
Ta shema ketem aroch mitztaref tippin tippin en mitztarfin manni i rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok lema li tzeruf haamar mashuch kol shehu tame
Ella lav rabbanan shema minah peligi la leolam rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok vechi amar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok beed aval bechetem la
Ta shema deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok halacha mikkelal difligi shema minah
Hadaran alach haroa ketem
b: Matni haishsha shehi osa tzeracheha veraata dam rabbi meir omer im omedet temea veim yoshevet tehora rabbi yose omer ben kach uven kach tehora
Ish veishsha sheasu tzorchehen letoch hassefel venimtza dam al hammayim rabbi yose metaher verabbi shimon metamme sheen derech haish lehotzi dam ella shechezkat damim min haishsha
Gema may shena omedet deamrinan me raglayim hadur lemakor veayeti dam yoshevet name nema me raglayim hadur lemakor veayeti dam
Amar shemuel bimzanneket mezanneket name dilma batar detammu mayya ata dam
Amar rabbi abba beoshevet al sefat hassefel umzanneket betoch hassefel venimtza dam betoch hassefel deim ita devatar detammu mayya ata al sefat hassefel ibi leh leishtechoche
Amar shemuel veamri lah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose vechen ori leh rabbi abba lekala halacha kerabbi yose
Ish veishsha vechu ibaya lehu ish veishsha omdin ma li amar rabbi meir
Ki amar rabbi meir bechad sefeka aval bisfek sefeka la metamme o dilma la shena
Amar resh lakish hi hi mimmay middela katane rabbi meir verabbi yose metaharin
I hachi hashta rabbi meir bisfek sefeka metamme bechad sefeka mibaya lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose daafilu bechad sefeka metaher
Veaddemipalgi bechad safek lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose liflegu bisfek sefeka lehodiacha kocho derabbi meir koach dehetera adif leh
Verabbi yochanan amar ki kaamar rabbi meir bechad sefeka aval bisfek sefeka la amar im ken litne rabbi meir verabbi yose metaharin in hachi name veayede desalek merabbi yose patach bidrabbi yose
Verabbi yose bechad sefeka metaher bisfek sefeka mibaya mahu detema hane mile diavad aval lechattechilla la ka mashma lan
Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan ish veishsha sheasu tzorchehen letoch hassefel venimtza dam al hammayim rabbi meir verabbi yose metaharin verabbi shimon metamme
Ibaya lehu ishsha yoshevet ma li amar rabbi shimon ki amar rabbi shimon beomedet didchik lah alma aval yoshevet la o dilma la shena
Ta shema detanya yoshevet tola omedet enah tola divre rabbi meir rabbi yose omer ben kach uven kach tola rabbi shimon omer ben kach uven kach enah tola
Ibaya lehu ish veishsha yoshvin ma li amar rabbi shimon ki amar rabbi shimon omedet didchik lah alma veoshevet dechad safek aval bisfek sefeka la amar o dilma la shena
Ta shema kevan deamar rabbi shimon chezkat damim min haishsha la shena omdin vela shena yoshvin
Matni hishila chalukah lenochrit o lenidda hare zo tola bah
Shalosh nashim shellavshu chaluk echad o sheyyashvu al safsal echad venimtza alav dam kullan temeot
Yashvu al safsal shel even o al haitzteva shel merchatz rabbi nechemya metaher shehaya rabbi nechemya omer kol davar sheeno mekabbel tuma eno mekabbel ketamim
Gema amar rav benochrit

a: Haroa
Mimmay dumya denidda ma nidda dekachazya af nochrit deka chazya
Amar rav sheshet ki nayem veshachev rav amrah leha shemata detanya tola benochrit rabbi meir omer benochrit haruya lirot vaafilu rabbi meir la kaamar ella biruya lirot aval roa la itzterich
Amar rava vetisbera rabbi meir lechumra rabbi meir lekulla
Detanya enah tola benochrit rabbi meir omer tola veella kashya hach taretz hachi vehi sheroa rabbi meir omer biruya lirot veaf al pi sheenah roa
Tanu rabbanan tola beshomeret yom keneged yom bashsheni shellah
Uvsoferet shiva shello tavla lefichach hi metukkenet vachavertah mekulkelet divre rabban shimon ben gamliel rabbi omer enah tola lefichach shettehen mekulkalot
Veshavin shettola beshomeret yom keneged yom barishon shellah
Uvoshevet al dam tohar uvivtula sheddameha tehorin
Lefichach derabban shimon ben gamliel lema li mishshum derabbi
Lefichach derabbi lema li mahu detema hahi deishtechach ketem gabbah titkalkal idach lo titkalkal kamashma lan
Amar rav chisda tame vetahor shehalchu bishne shevilin echad tahor veechad tame banu lemachloket rabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel
Matkef lah rav adda ad kan la kaamar rabbi hatam ella detarvayehu ki hadade ninhu hacha may nafka lan minah
Verav chisda sof sof ihi tevila baaya
Itmar amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina tame vetahor vaafilu tahor vetaluy shehalchu bishne shevilin echad tame veechad tahor tole tame betaluy vetahor betahor ledivre hakkol
Bea mineh rabbi yochanan merabbi yehuda bar levay mahu litlot ketem bechetem alliba derabbi la tibbee lach
Hashta uma hatam deka chazya miggufah amratte enah tola hacha demealma ka ate lo kol shekken
Ki tibbee lach alliba derabban shimon ben gamliel hatam hu deka chazya miggufah talya hacha demealma kaate la talya o dilma la shena
Amar leh en tolin ma taam lefi sheen tolin
Etiveh en tolin ketem bechetem hishila chalukah lenochrit o leoshevet al hakketem hare zo tola bah
Ha gufah kashya resha amratte en tolin sefa amratte tolin ha la kashya ha rabbi veha rabban shimon ben gamliel
Ika deamri ha veha rabbi ha barishon shellah ha bashsheni shellah
Rav ashe amar ha veha rabban shimon ben gamliel vela kashya
b: Kan lemafrea kan lehabba
Mikkol makom kashya amar ravina la kashya hachi kaamar hishila chalukah lenochrit baalat ketem hare zo tola bah
Veha o leoshevet al hakketem katane hachi kaamar o leoshevet al dam tohar baalat ketem tola bah
Shalosh shellavshu ku shehaya rabbi nechemya ku amar rav matna may tama derabbi nechemya dichtiv venikkata laaretz teshev kevan sheyyashva laaretz nikkata
Amar rav huna amar rabbi chanina metaher haya rabbi nechemya afilu baachore keli cheres peshita
Mahu detema ligzor gabbo attu tocho ka mashma lan
Amar abbaye metaher haya rabbi nechemya bematlaniyyot sheen bahen shalosh al shalosh dela chazyan la laaniyyim velo laashirim
Darash rav chiyya bar rav matna mishshemeh derav halacha kerabbi nechemya amar leh rav nachman abba tane maase ba lifne chachamim vetimmeum veatte amratte halacha kerabbi nechemya
May hi detanya shette nashim shehau tochanot berechayim shel yad venimtza dam tachat happenimit shettehen temeot tachat hachitzona hachitzona temea vehappenimit tehora benatayim shettehen temeot
Haya maase venimtza dam al sefatah shel ambati veal ale shel zayit beshaa shemmassikot et hattannur uva maase lifne chachamim vetimmeum
Tannae hi detanya rabbi yaakov metamme verabbi nechemya metaher vehoru chachamim kerabbi nechemya

Matni shalosh nashim shehau yeshenot bemitta achat venimtza dam tachat achat mehen kullan temeot badka achat mehen venimtzet temea hi temea ushtehen tehorot vetolot zo bazo veim lo hau reuot lirot roin otan keilu hen reuot
Gema amar rav yehuda amar rav vehu shebbadka atzmah beshiur veset
Savar lah kevar peda deamar kol shebbalah bechattat tohoroteha temeot
Balah beasham taluy tohoroteha teluot balah patur tohoroteha tehorot
Verabbi oshaya amar afilu balah bechattat tohoroteha teluot
Bishlama hatam emar shammash akkeveh ledam aval hacha im itah dehave dahava dam man akkeveh

Amar rabbi yirmeya mashal derabbi oshaya lema haddavar dome leyeled vezaken shehau mehallechin badderech kol zeman shehau badderech yeled shohe lavo nichnesu lair yeled memaher lavo veamar abbaye mashal derabbi oshaya lema haddavar dome leadam shennoten etzba baayin kol zeman sheetzba baayin dima shoha lavo natal haetzba dima memaheret lavo
Vetolot zo bazo tanu rabbanan ketzad tolot zo bazo ubbara vesheenah ubbara tola ubbara besheenah ubbara
Menika vesheenah menika tola menika besheenah menika zekena vesheenah zekena tola zekena besheenah zekena betula vesheenah betula tola betula besheenah betula
Hau shettehen ubbarot shettehen menikot shettehen zekenot shettehen betulot zo hi sheshshaninu lo hau reuot lirot roin

a: Keilu hen reuot

Matni shalosh nashim shehau yeshenot bemitta achat venimtza dam tachat haemtzait kullan temeot tachat happenimit shettayim happenimiyyot temeot vehachitzona tehora tachat hachitzona shettayim hachitzonot temeot vehappenimit tehora

Ematay bizman sheavru derech margelot hammitta aval im avru derech aleha kullan temeot badka achat mehen venimtzet tehora hi tehora ushtayim temeot badku shettayim umatzu tehorot hen tehorot ushlishit temea shelashtan umatzu tehorot kullan temeot
Lema haddavar dome legal tame shennitarev ben shene gallim tehorim uvadku echad mehen umatzu tahor hu tahor ushnayim temeim shenayim umatzu tehorin hem tehorin ushlishi tame
Shelashtan umatzu tehorin kullan temeim divre rabbi meir sherabbi meir omer kol davar shehu bechezkat tuma leolam hu betumato ad sheyyivada lecha tuma hechan hi
Vachachamim omrim bodek ad shemmaggia lesela o livtula
Gema may shena resha dela mefalleg umay shena sefa dekamfalleg amar rabbi amme bimshullavot
Badka achat vechu lema leh lemitne lema ze dome
Hachi kaamar lehu rabbi meir lerabbanan may shena bedam dela peligitu umay shena begal difligitu
Verabbanan bishlama hatam ema orev netalah ella hacha hay dam mehecha ata

Tanya amar rabbi meir maase beshikma shel kefar sava shehau machazikin bah tuma uvadku velo matzu leyamim nashva bo haruach vaakarattu venimtza gulgolet shel met techuva lo beikaro amru lo mishsham reaya emar lo badku kol tzarko

Tanya amar rabbi yose maase bimara shel shichin shehau machzikin bah tuma uvadku ad shehiggiu lekarka shehayeta chalaka ketzipporen velo matzu leyamim nichnesu bah poalim mippene haggeshamim venittezu bekardummotehen umatzu machteshet melea atzamot amru lo mishsham reaya emar lo badku kal tzarko

Tanya abba shaul omer maase besela bet choron shehau machazikin bah tuma velo yachlu chachamim livdok mippene shehayeta merubba vehaya sham zaken echad verabbi yehoshua ben chananya shemo amar lahen haviu li sedinim heviu lo sedinim ushraan bemayim ufrasan alehem mekom tohora yavesh mekom tuma lach uvadku umatzu bor gadol male atzamot
Tana hu habbor shemmile yishmael ben netanya chalalim dichtiv vehabbor asher hishlich sham yishmael et kol pigre anashim asher hikka beyad gedalya
Vechi gedalya haragan vahalo yishmael haragan ella mittoch shehaya lo lachosh laatzat yochanan ben kareach velo chash maale alav hakkatuv keilu haragan
Amar rava hay lishana bisha af al pi dilkabbole la mibbee mechash leh mibbee

Hanhu bene galila dinfak alayehu kala diktul nafsha ato lekammeh derabbi tarfon amaru leh latmerinan mar amar lehu hechi naaved i la atmerinchu chazu yatayechu atmerinchu ha amur rabbanan hay lishana bisha af al gav dilkabbole la mibbee mechash leh mibbee zilu attun tammaru nafshayechu
Vayyomer Adonai el moshe al tira mikkede sichon veog ache hao deamar mar sichon veog bene achiyya bar shamchazay hao may shena meog dekamistefe umay shena missichon dela kamistefe
Amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi shimon ben yochay mitteshuvato shel oto tzaddik atta yodea ma haya belibbo amar shemma taamod lo zechut shel avraham avinu
Shenneemar vayyavo happalit vayyagged leavram haivri veamar rabbi yochanan ze og sheppalat middor hammabbul
Tanu rabbanan beged sheavad bo ketem maavir alav shiva sammanin umvattelo rabbi shimon ben elazar omer
b: Bodko shechunot shechunot
Avda bo shichvat zera chadash bodko bemachat shachuk bodko bachamma tana en shechuna pechuta mishshelosh etzbaot
Tanu rabbanan beged sheavad bo kilayim hare ze lo yimkerennu legoy velo yaasennu mardaat lachamor aval ose mimmennu tachrichin lemet amar rav yosef zot omeret mitzot betelot leatid lavo
Amar leh abbaye vei tema rav dimi veha amar rabbi mani amar rabbi yannay lo shanu ella lesofdo aval lekovro asur amar leh lav itmar alah amar rabbi yochanan afilu lekovro
Verabbi yochanan letameh deamar rabbi yochanan may dichtiv bammetim chofshi kevan shemmet adam naasa chofshi min hammitzot
Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda beged sheavad bo kilayim tzovo umuttar amar leh rava lerafram bar pappa mena leh lesava ha
Amar leh matnitin hi ditnan bodek ad shemmaggia lesela vei leka emar orev netalah hachi name amra vechitana bahadade la salek lehu tziva vechevan dela yedia emar mintar netar
Amar rav acha bereh derav yeva mishshemeh demar zutra hay man dirme chuta dechitana biglima deamra venattekeh vela yada i netik i la netik shappir dame
May tama middeorayeta shaatnez ketiv ad sheyyihye shua teviy venuz verabbanan hu digzaru beh vechevan dela yada i nattekeh shere
Matkef lah rav ashe emar o shua o teviy o nuz vehilcheta kemar zutra middeappekinhu rachamana bachada lishana
Tanu rabbanan beged tzavua metamme mishshum ketem rabbi natan bar yosef omer eno metamme mishshum ketem shello tikkenu bigde tzivonin leishsha ella lehakel al kitmehen
Tikkenu may takkeninhu ella shello hutteru bigde tzivonin leishsha ella lehakel al kitmehen hutteru mikkelal daasiri
In ditnan bappulmus shel aspasyanus gazru al atrot chatanim veal hairus bikkeshu ligzor al bigde tzivonin amri ha adifa kede lehakel al kitmehen
Matni shiva sammanin maavirin al hakketem rok tafel ume gerisin ume raglayim veneter uvorit

a: Kimonya veashlag
Hitbilo veasa al gabbav teharot heevir alav shiva sammanin velo avar hare ze tzeva hatteharot tehorot veeno tzarich lehatbil avar o sheddeha hare ze ketem vehatteharot temeot vetzarich lehatbil
Ezehu rok tafel kol shello taam kelum me gerisin leisat gerisin shel pol chalukat nefesh me raglayim shehechmitzu
Vetzarich lechaskes shalosh peamim lechol echad veechad heeviran shello kesidran o sheheevir shiva sammanin keachat lo asa velo chelum
Gema tana neter alekkesanderit velo neter antippatrit
Borit amar rav yehuda ze ahala vehatanya habborit vehaahal ella may borit kavrita

Urminhi hosifu alehen halbetzin vehalleonin habborit vehaahal vei borit kavrita mi it leh sheviit vehatnan ze hakkelal kol sheyyesh lo ikar yesh lo sheviit vechol sheen lo ikar en lo sheviit ella may borit ahala vehatanya habborit vehaahal tere gavene ahala
Kimonya amar rav yehuda shelof dotz veashlag amar shemuel sheeltinhu lenachote yamma vaamaru ashlaga shemeh umishtechach bene nikve marganita umappeki leh beramtza defarzela
Hitbilo veasa ku tanu rabbanan heevir alav shiva sammanin velo avar tzappon veavar tohorotav temeot
Tzappon tzeva name meabbar ella heevir alav shishsha sammanin velo avar heevir alav tzappon veavar tohorotav temeot sheim heevir shevii mittechila shemma avar
Tanya idach heevir alav shiva sammanin velo avar shenaan veavar tohorotav tehorot
Amar rabbi zera lo shanu ella hatteharot shennaasu ben tichboset rishona lashsheniyya aval teharot shennaasu achar tichboset sheniyya tohorotav temeot shehare hikpid alav veavar
b: Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe mide bikfida talya milta
Amar leh in detanya rabbi chiyya omer dam hannidda vadday maavir alav shiva sammanin umvattelo
Veammay ha dam nidda hu alma bikfeda talya milta hachi name bikfeda talya milta
Tenan hatam charasin shennishtammesh bahen zav shebbalu mashkin venaflu laavir hattannur vehussak hattannur hattannur tame shessof mashke latzet

Amar resh lakish lo shanu ella mashkin kallim aval mashkin chamurin tame af al pi shello hussak hattannur rabbi yochanan amar echad mashkin kallin veechad mashkin chamurin im hussak hattannur in i la la
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish hitbilo veasa al gabbav teharot veheevir alav shiva sammanin velo avar hare ze tzeva vetohorotav tehorot veen tzarich lehatbil
Amar leh hannach lichtamim derabbanan
Vehatane rabbi chiyya dam hannidda vadday maavir alav shiva sammanin umvattelo
Amar leh rabbi lo shana rabbi chiyya mena leh
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish reviit dam shennivla babbayit habbayit tame veamri lah habbayit tahor vela peligi ha bechelim demeikara ha bechelim devassof
Nivlea bichsut im mitkabbeset veotze mimmenna reviit dam temea veim lav tehora
Amar rav kahana mikkulle reviiyyot shanu kan shane dam tevusa derabbanan
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan kol habbalua sheeno yachol latzet tahor ha yachol latzet tame veaf al gav dela nafek
Amar rav pappa kol hecha deen yachol latzet velo hikpid alav divre hakkol tahor yachol latzet vehikpid alav divre hakkol tame
Ki peligi deyachol latzet velo hikpid alav mar savar kevan deyachol latzet af al gav delo hikpid alav umar savar af al gav deyachol latzet

a: Im hikpid alav in i la la

Ezehu rok tafel tana kal shello taam kelum mibbaerev sevar rav pappa kammeh derava lememar keman deamar la team mide beurta amar leh rava mi katane baerev mibbaerev katane leappoke hecha dekadem veachel

Amar rabba bar bar channa amar rabbi yochanan ezehu rok tafel kol sheavar alav chatzot layela uvshena lememra divshena talya milta vehatnan yashan kol hayyom en ze rok tafel neor kol hallayela hare ze rok tafel hatam bemitnamnem
Hechi dame mitnamnem amar rav ashe nim vela nim tir vela tir dekaru leh veane vela yada leahdore sevara vechi madkeru leh middechar
Tana hishkim veshana pirko en ze rok tafel vead kamma amar rav yehuda bar shela amar rav ashe amar rabbi elazar kol sheyyatza rov dibburo shel shalosh shaot
Me gerisin leisat gerisin shel pol vechu lema mesayya leh leresh lakish deamar resh lakish rok tafel tzarich sheyehe im kol echad veechad dilma havla defumma mealle
Matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda detanya rabbi yehuda omer me gerisin roteach veover sheyyitten letocho melach

May mashma dehay over lishana deakdome hu amar rav nachman bar yitzchak deamar kera vayyarotz achimaatz derech hakkikkar vayyaavor et hakkushi abbaye amar mehacha vehu avar lifnehem veibaet ema mehacha vayyaavor malkam lifnehem va berosham
Me raglayim shehechmitzu tana kamma chimutzan shelosha yamim
Amar rabbi yochanan kol shiure chachamim bichtamim tzarich shiur leshiuran deyeled o dezaken deish o deishsha mechussim o megullim bimot hachamma o bimot haggeshamim
Vetzarich lechaskes shalosh peamim bae rabbi yirmeya amtoye veetoye chad o dilma amtoye veetoye tarte may teku
Heeviran shello kesidran tanu rabbanan hikdim sheniyyim larishonim tane chada sheniyyim alu lo rishonim lo alu lo vetanya idach rishonim alu lo sheniyyim lo alu lo
Amar abbaye idi veidi sheniyyim alu lo velo rishonim umay rishonim rishonim lichsidran ushniyyim lehaavaratan

Matni kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset dayyah sheatah veellu hen havvesatot mefaheket umatteshet vechosheshet befi cheresah uvshippule meeha veshofaat uchmin tzemarmorot ochazin otah vechen kayyotze bahen vechol shekkava lah shalosh peamim hare ze veset
Gema tenena chada zimna kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset dayyah sheatah hatam bivesatot deome hacha bivesatot degufa
Kidkatane ellu hen vesatot hayeta mefaheket meatteshet vechosheshet befi cheresah uvshippule meeha veshofaat
Shofaat ha shafa veazla amar ulla bereh derav illay
b: Beshofaat dam tame mittoch dam tahor
Uchmin tzemarmorot vechu vechen kayyotze bahen leetoye may amar rabba bar ulla leetoye ishsha sheroshah kaved aleha veevareha kevedim aleha verotetet vegosa
Amar rav huna bar chiyya amar shemuel hare amru leyamim shenayim livesatot achat lema shello manu chachamim shelosha

Lema shello manu chachamim leetoye may amar rav yosef leetoye roshah kaved aleha veevareha kevedin aleha verotetet vegosa amar leh abbaye may ka mashma lan matnitin hi deha parshah rabba bar ulla ella amar abbaye leetoye achla shum veraata veachla betzalim veraata kassa pilpelim veraata
Amar rav yosef la shemia li ha shemata

Amar leh abbaye atte amritah nihalan veaha amritah nihalan hayeta lemuda lihot roa yom chamishsha asar veshinta leom esrim ze veze asurin shalosh peamim leom esrim huttar yom chamishsha asar vekava lah yom esrim sheen ishsha kovaat lah veset ad shettikbaenna shalosh peamim
Vaamarte lan alah amar rav yehuda amar shemuel zo divre rabban gamliel bar rabbi sheamar mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel aval chachamim omrim raata enah tzericha lo lishnot velo leshallesh
Veamrinan lach lishnot amratte lan leshallesh mibaya vaamarte lan lishnot bivesatot leshallesh beyamim
Venema zo divre rabban shimon ben gamliel ha ka mashma lan shemuel derabban gamliel berabbi kerabban shimon ben gamliel sevira leh
Matni hayeta lemuda lihot roa bitchillat havvesatot kol hatteharot sheasta betoch havvesatot temeot besof havvesatot kol hatteharot sheasta betoch havvesatot tehorot
Rabbi yose omer af yamim veshaot vesatot hayeta lemuda lihot roa im hanetz hachamma enah asura ella im hanetz hachamma rabbi yehuda omer kol hayyom shellah

Gema tana ketzad amar rabbi yose yamim veshaot vesatot hayeta lemuda lihot roa miyyom esrim leom esrim umishshesh shaot leshesh shaot higgia yom esrim velo raata asura leshammesh kol shesh shaot rishonot divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose mattir ad shesh shaot vechosheshet beshesh shaot
Avru shesh shaot velo raata asura leshammesh kol hayyom kullo divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose mattir min hammincha ulmala
Hayeta lemuda vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer kol hallayela shellah
La kashya ha dirgila lirot bitchillat yemama veha dirgila lirot besof lelya
Tane chada rabbi yehuda osrah lifne vistah umattirah leachar vistah vetanya idach osrah leachar vistah umattirah lifne vistah
Vela kashya ha dirgila lemichze besof lelya ha dirgila lemichze bitchillat yemama
Amar rava halacha kerabbi yehuda umi amar rava hachi vehatanya vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumatam mikkan amar rabbi yirmeya azhara livne yisrael sheyyifreshu minneshotehen samuch levistan
Vechamma amar rava ona may lav ona achariti la otah ona
Vetarte lema li tzericha dei ashmoinan ha hava amena hane mile litharot aval levalah la ka mashma lan
Vei mehahi hava amena samuch levistah ona achariti ka mashma lan otah ona
Matni hayeta lemuda lihot roa yom chamishsha asar veshinta lihot roa leom esrim ze vaze asurin shinta paamayim leom esrim ze vaze asurin

Shinta shalosh peamim leom esrim huttar chamishsha asar vekava lah yom esrim sheen ishsha kovaat lah veset ad shettikbaenna shalosh peamim veenah mittaheret min haveset ad shetteaker mimmenna shalosh peamim

a: Gema itmar raata yom chamishsha asar lechodesh ze veom shishsha asar lechodesh ze veom shiva asar lechodesh ze rav amar kava lah veset ledilug ushmuel amar ad shetteshallesh bedilug

Nema rav ushmuel biflugta derabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel kamipalgi detanya niset larishon vamet lashsheni vamet lashshelishi lo tinnase divre rabbi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lashshelishi tinnase larvii lo tinnase
La dechulle alma kerabban shimon ben gamliel vehacha beha kamipalgi rav savar chamishsha asar mimminyana ushmuel savar kevan delav bedilug chazeteh lav mimminyana hu
Etiveh hayeta lemuda lihot roa yom chamishsha asar veshinta leom shishsha asar ze vaze asurin shinta leom shiva asar huttar shishsha asar veneesar chamishsha asar veshiva asar
Shinta leom shemona asar hutteru kullan veen asur ella mishshemona asar veelach kashya lerav amar lecha rav lemuda shane
Udkaare lah may kaare lah lemuda itztericha leh mahu detema kevan dilmuda vaakarteh bitre zimne akra leh ka mashma lan
Metivi raata yom esrim veechad bechodesh ze yom esrim ushnayim bechodesh ze yom esrim ushlosha bechodesh ze kava lah veset serga leom esrim vearbaa lo kava lah veset teuvta dishmuel
Amar lach shemuel hacha vemay askinan kegon dirgila lemichze beom esrim veshinta leom esrim veechad dayeka name deshavkeh leom esrim venakteh leom esrim veechad shema minah
Sheen haishsha kovaat lah veset ad shettikbaenna vechu amar rav pappa la amaran ella lemikbeah aval lemechash lah bachada zimna chayesha
May ka mashma lan tenena hayeta lemuda lihot roa yom chamishsha asar veshinta leom esrim ze veze asurin
I mehatam hava amena hane mile hecha dekayema betoch yeme niddatah aval hecha dela kayema betoch yeme niddatah ema la ka mashma lan
Veenah mittaheret min haveset vechu amar rav pappa la amaran ella dikvateh telata zimne ditzrichi telata zimne lemikereh aval tere zimne bachada zimna miakar
May ka mashma lan tenena en haishsha kovaat lah veset ad shettikbaenna shalosh peamim mahu detema chada lechad tere letarte utlata litlata ka mashma lan
Tanya kevateh derav pappa hayeta lemuda lihot roa yom esrim veshinta layyom sheloshim ze vaze asurin higgia yom esrim velo raata mutteret leshammesh ad yom sheloshim vechosheshet leom sheloshim
Higgia yom sheloshim veraata higgia yom esrim velo raata vehiggia yom sheloshim velo raata vehiggia yom esrim veraata huttar yom sheloshim
b: Veneesar yom esrim mippene sheorach bizmanno ba

Matni nashim bivtulehem kigfanim yesh gefen sheyyenah adom veyesh gefen sheyyenah shachor veyesh gefen sheyyenah merubbe veyesh gefen sheyyenah muat rabbi yehuda omer kol gefen yesh bah yayin vesheen bah yayin hare ze dorketi
Gema tana dor katua tane rabbi chiyya keshem shehasseor yafe laisa kach damim yafin laishsha tana mishshum rabbi meir kol ishsha sheddameha merubbin baneha merubbin
Hadaran alach haishsha
Matni tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot veniset bet shammay omrim notnin lah arba lelot uvet hillel omrim ad shettichye hammakka
Higgia zemannah lirot veniset bet shammay omrim notnin lah layela harishon uvet hillel omrim ad motzae shabbat arbaa lelot
Raata veodah bevet aviha bet shammay omrim notnin lah beilat mitzva uvet hillel omrim kol hallayela kullah shellah
Gema amar rav nachman bar yitzchak vaafilu raata mimmay middeka mefalleg besefa ben raata ben beshello raata mikkelal deresha la shena hachi vela shena hachi
Tanya name hachi bet hillel omrim ad shettichye hammakka ben raata ben lo raata

Ad shettichye hammakka ad kamma amar rav yehuda amar rav kol zeman shennocheret ki amritah kammeh dishmuel amar li nechira zo eni yodea ma hi ella kol zeman sheharok matzuy betoch happe mechamat tashmish

Nechira dekaamar rav hechi dame amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak ledidi mipparsha li mineh derav omedet veroa yoshevet veenah roa beyadua shello chayeta hammakka al gabbe karka veroa al gabbe karim uchsatot veenah roa beyadua shello chayeta hammakka al gabbe kullam veroa al gabbe kullam veenah roa beyadua shechayeta hammakka
Higgia zemannah vechu itmar shimsha bayyamim rav amar lo hifsida lelot velevi amar hifsida lelot
Rav amar lo hifsida lelot ad motzae shabbat tenan velevi amar hifsida lelot may arba lelot dekatane arbaa onot
Ulrav lema li lemitne arbaa lelot orach ara ka mashma lan dedarkah devia ballelot ullevi litne arbaa lelot ad motzae shabbat lema li ha ka mashma lan dishre lemival lechattechilla beshabbat
Kedishmuel deamar shemuel pirtza dechuka muttar likanes bah beshabbat veaf al pi shemmashshir tzerorot
Itmar baal velo matza dam vechazar uvaal umatza dam rabbi chanina amar temea verabbi assi amar tehora

Rabbi chanina amar temea deim itah dahava dam betulim meikara hava ate verabbi assi amar tehora dilma itremi leh kedishmuel deamar shemuel yacholni livol kamma beilot belo dam veidach shane shemuel derav guvreh
Amar rav bogeret notnin lah layela harishon vehane mile shello raata aval raata en lah ella beilat mitzva vetu la
Metivi maase venatan lah rabbi arbaa lelot mittoch shenem asar chodesh hechi dame ilema deyahev lah kullehu bime katnut

a: Ad shettichye hammakka tenan

Ella deyahev lah kullehu bime naarut naarut shenem asar chodesh mi ika veha amar shemuel en ben naarut levagrut ella shishsha chodashim bilvad vechi tema betzir mehachi hu deleka ha tefe ika ha bilvad kaamar
Ella deyahev lah shettayim bime katnut ushtayim bime naarut ha bea mineh rav chinana bar shelemya merav higgia zemannah lirot tachat balah mahu
Amar leh kol beilot sheatta boel enan ella achat vehashshear mashlimin learbaa lelot

Ella deyahev lah achat bime katnut ushtayim bime naarut veachat bime bagrut i amratte bishlama bogeret bealma yahavinan lah tefe ki hechi deahanay katnut bime naarut lemivtzar lah chada ahanay name naarut levagrut lemivtzar lah chada
Ella i amratte bogeret dealma la yahavinan lah tefe la litev lah ella beilat mitzva vetu la
Leolam deyahev lah achat bime katnut veshalosh bime naarut mi savratte kol telata yarche chada ona kol tere yarche chada ona
Minyamin saksenaa hava shakel veazel leatreh dishmuel sevar lemebad ovada kevateh derav afilu raata amar la paleg rav ben raata ben lo raata
Kedem shechev beorcha kare shemuel aleh derav lo yeunne latztzaddik kol aven

Amar rav chinana bar shelemya mishshemeh derav kevan shennitteku shinnav shel adam nitmaatu mezonotav shenneemar gam anochi natatti lach nikon shinnayim bechol arechem vechoser lechem bechol mekomotechem
Raata veodah tanu rabbanan raata veodah bevet aviha bet hillel omrim kol hallayela shellah venotnin lah ona shelema vechamma ona shelema peresh rabban shimon ben gamliel layela vachatzi yom
Umi baenan kulle hay urminhi hare shehau gittav uvet baddav temeot uvikkesh laasotan betahora ketzad hu ose haddappin vehallulavin vehaadashin medichan
b: Haakalim shel netzarim veshel bitzbutz menaggevan shel shifa veshel gemi meyashnan vechamma meyashnan shenem asar chodesh rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mannichan miggat laggat umibbad levad
Hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu charfe veafle

Rabbi yose omer harotze letaher miyyad magilan berotchin o choltan beme zetim rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi yose mannichan tachat hatztzinor shemmemav mekallechin o bemayan shemmemav rodfin vechamma ona kederech sheamru beyen nesech kach amru bitharot
Kelappe leya bitharot kayeminan ella kederech sheamru bitharot kach amru beyen nesech

Vechamma ona amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan o yom o layela rabbi chana sheuna veamri lah rabbi chana bar sheuna amar rabba bar bar channa amar rabbi yochanan chatzi yom vachatzi layela
Veamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak vela peligi ha bitkufat nisan vetishri ha bitkufat tammuz vetevet
Hacha name ema gabbe nidda chatzi yom vachatzi layela veha layela vachatzi yom kaamar ella i layela denisan vetishri i chatzi yom vachatzi layela detevet vetammuz
Veibaet ema shane ketubba demaggehi bah tefe ad dechatmi
Rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu halacha boel beilat mitzva uforesh
Metiv rav chisda maase venatan lah rabbi arbaa lelot mittoch shenem asar chodesh
Amar leh rava haddore appircha lema li otev mimmatnitin hu savar maase rav
Mikkol makom lerav ushmuel kashya inhu daavadu kerabbotenu detanya rabbotenu chazru venimnu boel beilat mitzva uforesh
Amar ulla ki hau bah rabbi yochanan veresh lakish betinoket la hao masseki minah ella kidmassek taala mibbe cherava umsayemi bah hachi boel beilat mitzva uforesh
Amar lo rabbi abba lerav ashe ella meatta baal nefesh lo yigmor biato amar lo im ken libbo nokfo uforesh
Tanu rabbanan vechullan shehau shofot dam uvaot mittoch arbaa lelot leachar arbaa lelot mittoch hallayela leachar hallayela kullan tzerichot livdok et atzman
Uvchullan rabbi meir machmir kedivre bet shammay
Ushar reiyyot shebben bet shammay uvet hillel hallech achar mare damim
Shehaya rabbi meir omer mare damim meshunnim hen ze mizze ketzad dam nidda adom dam betulim eno adom dam nidda zihum dam betulim eno zihum dam nidda ba min hammakor dam betulim ba min hatztzedadin
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar rabbi yose amar rabbi yochanan zo divre rabbi meir aval chachamim omrim kol mare damim achat hen
Tanu rabbanan haroa dam mechamat tashmish meshammeshet paam rishona ushniyya ushlishit mikkan veelach lo teshammesh ad shettitgaresh

a: Vetinnase leacher

Niset leacher veraata dam mechamat tashmish meshammeshet paam rishona ushniyya ushlishit mikkan veelach lo teshammesh ad shettitgaresh vetinnase leacher niset leacher veraata dam mechamat tashmish meshammeshet paam rishona ushniyya ushlishit mikkan veelach lo teshammesh ad shettivdok atzmah

Ketzad bodeket et atzmah mevia shefoferet uvtochah michchol umoch munnach al rosho im nimtza dam al rosh hammoch beyadua shemmin hammakor hu ba lo nimtza dam al rosho beyadua shemmin hatztzedadin hu ba
Veim yesh lah makka beoto makom tola bemakkatah veim yesh lah veset tola bevistah
Veim haya dam makkatah meshunne middam reiyyatah enah tola veneemenet ishsha lomar makka yesh li bammakor shemmimmenna dam yotze divre rabbi
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer dam makka habba min hammakor tame verabbotenu heidu al dam hammakka habba min hammakor shehu tahor
May benayehu amar ulla makor mekomo tame ika benayehu
Shefoferet afgore mafgera afsode mafseda lah amar shemuel bishfoferet shel avar ufiha ratzuf letochah
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan vetivdok atzmah bevia shelishit shel baal harishon amar leh lefi sheen kol haetzbaot shaot
Amar leh vetivdok atzmah bevia rishona shel baal shelishi lefi sheen kol hakkochot shaot
Hahi daatay lekammeh derabbi amar leh leabbadan zil baatah azal baatah venafal mimmenna chararat dam amar rabbi nitrappea zot

Hahi itteta daatay lekammeh demar shemuel amar leh lerav dimi bar yosef zil baatah azal baatah vela nefal mimmenna minah vela mide amar shemuel zo memallea venofetzet hi vechol hammallea venofetzet en lah takkana
Hahi daatay lekammeh derabbi yochanan dechol emat dahavat salka mittevilat mitzva havat kachazya dema amar lah shemma dimat irich alta bich lechi vehibbaali lo al gabbe hannahar

Amar rabbi zera benot yisrael hechemiru al atzman sheafilu root tippat dam kechardal yoshvot aleha shiva nekiyyim
Adbereh rava lerav shemuel vedaresh kishsheta shene yamim velashshelishi hippila teshev shiva nekiyyim kasavar en kashave linfalim vei efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam

Amar rava ishsha

Veamar rava tavla vealta venimtza aleha davar chotzetz im samuch lachafifa tavla enah tzericha lechof velitbol veim lav tzericha lechof velitbol
