Amar leh rav adda lerav chinana missura lav hachi hava ovada bidvethu deabba mari resh galuta deikut azal rav nachman bar yitzchak lefayyosah vaamara leh may iteh hashta

a: Tisge ayeti limchar vida may kaamra leh amar dude chasratte tashtake chasratte avde chasratte
Derash rava ishsha chofefet beerev shabbat vetovelet bemotzae shabbat amar leh rav pappa lerava veha shelach ravin beiggarteh ishsha lo tachof beerev shabbat vetitbol bemotzae shabbat
Utmah al atzmecha heach chofefet bayyom vetovelet ballayela ha baenan techef lachafifa tevila veleka

Hadar oki rava amora aleh udrash devarim sheamarti lifnechem taut hen beyadi beram kach amru mishshemeh derabbi yochanan ishsha lo tachof beerev shabbat vetitbol bemotzae shabbat utmah al atzmecha heach chofefet bayyom vetovelet ballayela ha baenan samuch lachafifa tevila veleka
Vehilcheta ishsha chofefet bayyom vetovelet ballayela vehilcheta ishsha lo tachof ella ballayela ella kashya hilcheta ahilcheta
La kashya ha deefshar ha dela efshar
Matni nidda shebbadka atzmah yom shevii shacharit umatza tehora uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha ulachar yamim badka umatza temea hare hi bechezkat tehora
Badka atzmah beom shevii shacharit umatza temea uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha ulachar zeman badka umatza tehora hare zo bechezkat temea
Umtammea meet leet umippekida lifkida veim yesh lah veset dayya sheatah

Verabbi yehuda omer kol shello hifrisha betahora min hammincha ulmala hare zo bechezkat temea vachachamim omrim afilu bishnayim leniddatah badka umatza tehora uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha ulachar zeman badka umatza temea hare zo bechezkat tehora
Gema itmar rav amar zava vadday velevi amar zava safek
Aheya ilema aresha hare zo bechezkat tehora katane
Ella assefa bishlama sefek zava amrinan ella zava vadday name hare badka umatza tehora

Ella ki itmar derav velevi shemata beappe nafshah itmar nidda shebbadka atzmah beom hashshevii shacharit umatza temea uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha ulachar yamim badka umatza temea rav amar zava vadday velevi amar zava safek
Rav amar zava vadday kevan demeikara nimtzet temea veachshav nimtzet temea temea vadday velevi amar sefek zava emar pesaka bene uvene
b: Vechen tane levi bematnita achar hayyamim ben badka umatza tehora ben badka umatza temea hare zo sefek zava
Umtammea meet leet lema tihve teuvta derava deamar rava lomar sheen haishsha metammea meet leet betoch yeme zivatah
Velav otvineh lerava chada zimna hachi kaamrinan lema tihve teuvta derava name meha
Amar lach rava ki katane metammea meet leet aresh pirkin kae araata veodah bevet aviha
Salka datach amena kevan demafseki lehu yamim tehorin kitchillat niddatah damya velo tetamme meet leet ka mashma lan
Im yesh lah veset nema tihve teuvta derav huna bar chiyya amar shemuel deamar rav huna bar chiyya amar shemuel lomar sheen haishsha kovaat lah veset bime zivatah
Amar lecha rav huna bar chiyya ki amrinan en ishsha kovaat lah veset bime zivatah dela baaya telata zimne lemikar deamrinan dameha mesullakin vechevan dedameha mesullakin dayyah sheatah
Rabbi yehuda omer tanya amru lo lerabbi yehuda ilmale yadeha munnachot beeneha kol ben hashshemashot yafe atta omer
Achshav emar im silluk yadeha raata ma li hifrisha betahora bashshevii min hammincha ulmala ma li hifrisha betahora barishon
Barishon mi ika leman deamar

In vehatanya amar rabbi shaalti et rabbi yose verabbi shimon keshehau mehallechim badderech nidda shebbadka atzmah yom shevii shacharit umatza tehora uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha ulachar hayyamim badka umatza temea mahu
Amru liv hare zo bechezkat tohora shishshi chamishi revii shelishi sheni may amru liv la shena
Barishon lo shaalti vetaiti shello shaalti attu kullehu lav bechezkat tuma kayemi vechevan difsak pesak rishon name kevan difsak pesak
Umeikara may savar hoil vehuchzak mayan patuach

Matni hazzav vehazzava shebbadku atzman beom rishon umatzu tahor uvayyom hashshevii umatzu tahor ushar yamim shebbentayim lo badku rabbi eliezer omer hare hen bechezkat tohora rabbi yehoshua omer en lahem ella yom rishon veom shevii bilvad rabbi akiva omer en lahem ella yom shevii bilvad
Gema tanya amar lo rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua lidvarecha atta mone beserugin vehattora amra achar tithar achar achar lechullan shello tehe tuma mafseket benehen
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua veatta i atta mode bezav sheraa keri uvnazir shehilech sechachot ufraot shemmone beserugin vehattora amra vehayyamim harishonim yippelu
Verabbi eliezer bishlama hatam letoma vah amar rachamana sheenah soteret ella yomah vei mishshum ichallofe zav bevaal keri la michallaf
Nazir shehilech al gabbe sechachot ufraot name middeorayeta ohel mealleya baenan verabbanan hu digzur verabbanan bidorayeta la michallaf
Aval hacha i chayeshinan dilma chazay besafek ate leichallofe bevadday
Tane rabbi yose verabbi shimon amri nirin divre rabbi eliezer middivre rabbi yehoshua vedivre rabbi akiva middivre kullan aval halacha kerabbi eliezer
Ibaya lehu hazzav vehazzava shebbadku atzman yom rishon veom shemini umatzu tahor ushar hayyamim lo badku

a: Lerabbi eliezer mahu techillatan vesofan baenan vehacha techillatan ika sofan leka o dilma techillatan af al gav sheen sofan
Amar rav hi hi techillatan af al pi sheen sofan verabbi chanina amar techillatan vesofan baenan hacha techillatan ika sofan leka
Metivi veshavin bezav uvzava shebbadku atzman yom rishon veom shemini umatzu tahor sheen lahem ella shemini bilvad man shavin lav rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua
La rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva
Amar rav sheshet amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav nidda shehifrisha betohora bashshelishi shellah sofarto leminyan shiva nekiyyim
Nidda sefira lema lah ella ema zava shehifrisha betohora bashshelishi shellah sofarto leminyan shiva nekiyyim
Amar leh rav sheshet lerav yirmeya bar abba rav kechutae amrah lishmateh deamri yom shepposeket bo sofarto leminyan shiva
Ki kaamar rav levar mishshelishi bar mishshelishi peshita la tzericha kegon delo badka ad shevii
Veashmeinan hatam techillatan af al pi sheen sofan vehacha ka mashma lan sofan af al pi sheen techillatan
Demahu detema techillatan af al pi sheen sofan hu deamrinan deokminhu achezkayehu aval sofan af al pi sheen techillatan la ka mashma lan
Ini veha ki ata ravin amar metiv rabbi yose berabbi chanina toa
Vela yadana may teuvteh dekayema lan shavua kamma deatya lekamman belelavata matbelinan lah bimama la matbelinan lah
Vei salka datach la baenan sefurin lefanenu bimama name natbelinah dilma yoledet zachar bezov hi veavda lah sefurin ella lav shema minah baenan sefurin befanenu
Velav mi okemna kerabbi akiva deamar baenan sefurin lefanenu
Umna temra dilrabbanan la baenan sefurin lefanenu ditnan toa sheamra yom echad tame raiti matbilin otah tesha tevilot
Sheva lenidda utre leziva ben hashshemashot tame raiti matbilin otah achat esre tevilot
Achat esre may avidtayehu amar rav yirmeya middifti kegon shebbat lefanenu ben hashshemashot
Vehaveyan tamne lenidda utlat leziva
Lo raiti kol ikar matbilin otah chamesh esre tevilot amar rava hay dina dela dina dayeni begallache deit leh tora lire chad yoma delet leh tora lire tere yome

Itremi lehu yatma bar armalta yahavi leh tore azal nachsinhu amar lehu deit leh tora lishkol chad mashka delet leh tora lishkol tere mashche amri leh may hay dekaamratte amar lehu sof dina kitchillat dina techillat dina lav man delet leh adif sof dina name man delet leh adif
Hacha name uma hecha deamra raiti saggi lah i betesha tevilot i beachat esre tevilot hecha dekaamra ihi la raiti baaya chamesh esre tevilot
Ella ema hachi raiti veeni yodea kamma raiti i bime nidda raiti o bime ziva raiti matbilin otah chamesh esre tevilot atay kamman bimama yahavinan lah shav lenidda
b: Vetamne leziva atay kamman belelavata yahavinan lah tamne lenidda veshav leziva
Ziva tamne baaya ella ide veide shav lenidda vetamne leziva
Belelavata tamne lenidda bae
Ziva difsika leh dela shena ki atya kamman bimama la shena ki atya kamman belelya chashiv lah nidda dela pesika leh dechi atya kamman belelavata bae tamne bimama la kavae tamne la kachashev lah
Vei salka datach sefurin lefanenu baenan kol hane tevilot lema li tispor shav vahadar titbol ella lav shema minah rabbanan hi deamri la baenan sefurin lefanenu

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe lav tarotze kamtartzinan lah taretz veema hachi safarti veeni yodaat kamma safarti im bime nidda safarti veim bime ziva safarti matbilin otah chamesh esre tevilot
Safarti veeni yodaat kamma safarti chad yoma miha i efshar dela safra chasra lah tevila
Ella ema eni yodaat im safarti im lo safarti
Matni hazzav vehazzava vehannidda vehayyoledet vehammetzora shemmetu metammein bemassa ad sheyyimmok habbasar nochri shemmet tahor milletamme
Bet shammay omrim kol hannashim metot niddot uvet hillel omrim en nidda ella shemmeta nidda
Gema may bemassa ilema bemassa mammash attu kol met mi la metamme bemassa
Ella may bemassa beeven mesama
Dichtiv vehetayit even chada vesumat al pum gubba
May tama amar rav gezera shemma yitallefe
Tana mishshum rabbi eliezer amru ad sheyyibbaka kereso
Nochri shemmet ku tanya amar rabbi mippene ma amru nochri shemmet tahor milletamme bemassa lefi sheen tumato mechayyim middivre tora ella middivre sofrim
Tanu rabbanan shenem asar devarim shaalu anshe alekkesanderiyya et rabbi yehoshua ben chinana shelosha divre chachma shelosha divre haggada shelosha divre vurut shelosha divre derech eretz
Shelosha divre chachma hazzav vehazzava vehannidda vehayyoledet vehammetzora shemmetu ad matay metammein bemassa amar lahen ad sheyyimmok habbasar
Bat meshullachat ma hi lechohen
Mi amrinan kal vachomer uma almana lechohen gadol sheen isurah shave bakkol benah pagum zo sheisurah shave bakkol eno din shebbenah pagum o dilma ma lealmana lechohen gadol shehi atzmah mitchallelet
Amar lahen

a: Hi toeva veen baneha toavin
Shene metzorain shennitarvu korbenotehen ze baze vekarav korbano shel echad mehen umet echad mehen hashsheni ma tehe alav
Amar lahen kotev nechasav laacherim vehave ani umevi chattat haof habba al hassafek
Vehaika asham amar shemuel keshekkarav ashamo
Amar rav sheshet gavra rabba kishmuel lema ki hay milta keman i kerabbi yehuda deamar asham kava vechevan dekavao leh asham baashirut la matze mayete chattat bedallut
Ditnan metzora shehevi korban ani veheeshir o ashir veheeni hakkol holech achar chattat divre rabbi shimon
Verabbi yehuda omer hakkol holech achar asham rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer hakkol holech achar tzipporim
Vei kerabbi shimon deamar chattat kava af al gav dela kerav asham nayete acher deha shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar layete velitne
Detanya amar rabbi shimon lammochorat mevi ashamo veluggo immo umaamido beshaar nikanor umatne alav veomer im metzora hu hare ashamo veluggo immo veim lav asham ze yehe shalme nedava
Veoto asham taun
b: Shechitato batztzafon vetaun mattenat behonot usmicha unsachim utnufa vechaze vashok veneechal lezichre chehunna leom valayela
Velo hodu lo chachamim lerabbi shimon mippene shemmevi kadashim levet happesul
Shemuel savar lah kerabbi shimon bachada uflig aleh bachada
Shelosha divre aggada katuv echad omer ki lo echpotz bemot hammet vechatuv echad omer ki chafetz Adonai lahamitam kan beosin teshuva kan besheen osin teshuva
Katuv echad omer ki lo yissa fanim velo yikkach shochad vechatuv echad omer yissa Adonai panav elecha kan kodem gezar din kan leachar gezar din

Katuv echad omer ki vachar Adonai betziyyon vechatuv echad omer ki al appi veal chamati hayeta hair hazzot lemin hayyom asher banu otah ad hayyom hazze kan kodem shennasa shelomo et bat paro kan leachar shennasa shelomo et bat paro
Shelosha divre burut ishto shel lot mahu shettetamme amar lahem met metamme veen netziv melach metamme
Ben shunammit mahu sheyetamme amar lahen met metamme veen chay metamme
Metim leatid lavo tzerichin hazzaa shelishi ushvii o en tzerichin amar lahen lichsheyyichu nechkam lahen ika deamri lichsheyyavo moshe rabbenu immahem

Shelosha divre derech eretz ma yaase adam veyechkam amar lahen yarbe bishiva vimaet bischora amru harbe asu ken velo hoil lahem ella yevakkeshu rachamim mimmi shehachochma shello shenneemar ki Adonai yitten chochma mippiv daat utvuna
Tane rabbi chiyya mashal lemelech basar vadam sheasa seuda laavadav umshagger leohavav mimma shellefanav
May ka mashma lan deha bela ha la saggi
Ma yaase adam veyitashsher amar lahen yarbe bischora veyissa veyitten beemuna amru lo harbe asu ken velo hoilu ella yevakkesh rachamim mimmi shehaosher shello shenneemar li hakkesef veli hazzahav
May ka mashma lan deha bela ha la saggi
Ma yaase adam veyihu lo banim zecharim amar lahem yissa ishsha hahogenet lo

a: Vayekaddesh atzmo bishat tashmish
Amru harbe asu ken velo hoilu ella yevakkesh rachamim mimmi shehabbanim shello shenneemar hinne nachalat Adonai banim sachar peri habbaten
May ka mashma lan deha bela ha la saggi
May sachar peri habbaten amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina bischar shemmeshahin atzman babbeten kede shettazria ishto sheyyazriu neshotehen techila noten lo hakkadosh baruch hu sechar peri habbeten

Bet shammay omrim vechu may tamayehu devet shammay i nema mishshum dichtiv vattitchalchal hammalka veamar rav melammed sheppersa nidda hacha name aggav biatuta demalacha demota chazya vehaanan tenan shecharada mesalleket et haddamim ha la kashya pachda tzamet biatuta merappeya
Ella ha ditnan bet shammay omrim kol haanashim metim zavin uvet hillel omrim en zav ella mi shemmet zav
Ikkeri kan mibbesaro velo mechamat onso

Ella tama devet shammay kidtanya barishona hau matbilin kelim al gabbe niddot metot vehau niddot chayyot mitbayeshot hitkinu sheyehu matbilin al gabbe kol hannashim mippene kevodan shel niddot chayyot
Barishona hau matbilin al gabbe zavin metin vehau zavin chayyin mitbayeshin hitkinu sheyehu matbilin al gabbe kol haanashim mippene kevodan shel zavin chayyim
Matni haishsha shemmeta veyatza mimmenna reviit dam metammea mishshum ketem umtammea beohel

Rabbi yehuda omer enah metammea mishshum ketem mippene shenneekar mishshemmeta umode rabbi yehuda beoshevet al mashber vameta veyatza mimmenna reviit dam shehi metammea mishshum ketem amar rabbi yose lefichach enah metammea beohel
Gema mikkelal detanna kamma savar af al gav deneekar dam mishshemmeta metammea mishshum ketem
Amar rabbi zeeri makor mekomo tame ika benayehu
Umode rabbi yehuda
Mikkelal detanna kamma savar beohel name metamme amar rav yehuda dam tevusa ika benayehu
Detanya ezehu dam tevusa peresh rabbi elazar berabbi yehuda harug sheyyatza mimmennu dam ben bechayyav ben bemoto safek bechayyav yatza safek bemoto yatza safek bechayyav uvmoto zehu dam tevusa
Vachachamim omrim birshut hayyachid sefeko tame birshut harabbim sefeko tahor
Ella ezehu dam tevusa harug sheyyatza hemennu reviit dam bechayyav uvmoto vaadayin lo pasak safek rubbo bechayyav umiuto bemoto sefek miuto bechayyav verubbo bemoto zehu dam tevusa
Rabbi yehuda omer harug sheyyatza mimmennu reviit dam vehaya muttal bammitta vedamo metaftef legumma tame mippene shehattippa shel mita meorevet bo vachachamim metaharin mippene
b: Sherishon rishon nifsak shappir kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi yehuda rabbi yehuda letameh deamar en dam mevattel dam
Rabbi shimon omer tzaluv al haetz sheddamo shotet laaretz venimtza tachtav reviit dam tame rabbi yehuda metaher sheani omer tippa shel mita omedet lo al gav haetz
Verabbi yehuda nema ihu lenafsheh sheani omer tippa shel mita omedet al gav hammitta shane mitta dimchalchala
Matni barishona hau omrim hayyoshevet al dam tohar hayeta meara mayim lefesach
Chazru lomar hare hi kemagga teme met lekadashim kedivre bet hillel bet shammay omrim af kitme met
Gema meara in nogaat la alma chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh kekodesh damu
Ema sefa chazru lomar hare hi kemagga teme met lekadashim lekadashim in lechullin la alma chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh lav kekodesh damu
Matnitin manni abba shaul hi detanya abba shaul omer tevul yom techila lakkodesh letamme shenayim velifsol echad
Matni umodim shehi ochelet bemaaser vekotza lah challa umakkefet vekora lah shem
Veim nafal merukkah umiddam tohorah al kikkar shel teruma shehu tahor
Bet shammay omrim tzericha tevila baacharona uvet hillel omrim enah tzericha tevila baacharona
Gema deamar mar taval veala ochel bemaaser
Vekotza lah challa chullin hattevulin lechalla lav kechalla damu
Umakkefet deamar mar mitzva litrom min hammukkaf
Vekora lah shem salka datach amena nigzor dilma ate leminnegga bah meabbaray ka mashma lan
Veim nafal merukkah ditnan mashke tevul yom mashkin hayyotzin mimmennu kemashkin kemashke hannogea bahem veellu veellu enan metammein chutz mimmashke hazzav shehu av hattuma
Bet shammay may benayehu amar rav kattina tevul yom aroch ika benayehu
Matni haroa yom achad asar vetavla laerev veshimmesha
Bet shammay omer metammein mishkav umoshav vechayyavin bekorban

a: Uvet hillel omrim peturim min hakkorban
Tavla bayyom shelleacharav veshimmesha et betah veachar kach raata bet shammay omrim metammein mishkav umoshav ufturin min hakkorban
Uvet hillel omrim hare ze gargeran umodim beroa betoch achad asar yom vetavla laerev veshimmesha shemmetammein mishkav umoshav vechayyavin bekorban
Tavla bayyom shelleacharav veshimmesha hare ze tarbut raa umaggaan uvilatan teluyin
Gema tanu rabbanan veshavin bitvilat layela lezava sheenah tevila veshavin beroa betoch achad asar yom vetavla laerev veshimmesha shemmetammea mishkav umoshav vechayyavin bekorban
Lo nechleku ella beom achad asar yom shebbet shammay omrim metammein mishkav umoshav vechayyavin bekorban uvet hillel potrin mikkorban
Amru lahen bet shammay levet hillel may shena yom achad asar miyyom toch achad asar im shava lo lattuma lo yishve lo lakkorban
Amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay lo im amarta betoch achad asar yom shekken yom shelleacharav mitztaref immo leziva tomru beom achad asar sheen yom shelleacharav mitztaref immo leziva
Amru lahem bet shammay hashu middotechem im shava lo lattuma yishve lo lakkorban veim lo shava lo lakkorban lo yishve lo lattuma
Amru lahem bet hillel im havenuhu lide tuma lehachamir lo neviehu lide korban lehakel

Veod middivrechem attem noshchin sheattem omrin tavla yom shelleacharav veshimmesha veachar kach raata metamme mishkav umoshav uftura min hakkorban af attem hashu middotechem im shava lo lattuma yishve lo lakkorban
Veim lo shava lo lekorban lo yishve lo lattuma ella lehachmir velo lehakel hacha name lehachmir velo lehakel
Amar rav huna mishkavah umoshavah shebbashsheni bet shammay metammein af al pi shettavla af al pi shello raata may tama kevan deilu chazya metammea hashta name metammeya
Amar rav yosef may ka mashma lan tenena tavla yom shelleacharav veshimmesha et betah veachar kach raata bet shammay omrim metammea mishkavot umoshavot uftura min hakkorban
Amar rav kahana raata shane
Amar rav yosef vechi raata may have reiyya denidda hi
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef rav kahana hachi ka kashya leh bishlama hecha deraata gazrinan reiyya denidda attu reiyya dezava ella hecha dela raata may nigzar bah
Veod tenan haroa reiyya achat shel zov bet shammay omrim keshomeret yom keneged yom uvet hillel omrim kevaal keri
b: Vetanya hammesit et hariyya bet shammay omrim tolin uvet hillel metaharin
Mishkavot umoshavot shebben reiyya rishona liriyya sheniyya bet shammay tolin uvet hillel metaharin
Vekatane resha haroa reiyya achat shel zov bet shammay omrim keshomeret yom keneged yom alma shomeret yom keneged yom levet shammay tolin
La tema shomeret yom keneged yom ella ema kevoel shomeret yom keneged yom
May shena ihu dela metamme mishkav umoshav umay shena ihi dimtammeya leh
Ihu dela shechichi beh damim la gezur beh rabbanan ihi dishchichi bah damim gezur bah rabbanan
Umay shena mishkav umoshav dimtammeya leh umay shena boel dela metammeya leh
Mishkav umoshav dishchiach metammeya leh boel dela shechiach la metammeya
Tenan tavla yom shelleacharav veshimmesha hare zo tarbut raa
Maggaan uvilatan teluyin may lav divre hakkol hi
La bet hillel hi detanya amar lahem rabbi yehuda levet hillel vechi lazo attem korin tarbut raa vahalo lo nitkaven ze ella livol et hannidda nidda salka datach
Ella ema livol et hazzava zava salka datach ella ema livol shomeret yom keneged yom
Itmar asiri rabbi yochanan amar asiri kitshii ma teshii bae shimur af asiri bae shimur
Resh lakish amar asiri keachad asar ma achad asar la bae shimur af asiri la bae shimur

Ika dematne lah aha amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya lerabbi akiva afilu atta merabbe bashshemen bashshemen kal hayyom kullo eni shomea lecha ella chatzi log shemen lattoda urviit yayin lannazir veachad asar yom shebben nidda lenidda halacha lemoshe missinay
May halacha rabbi yochanan amar hilchat achad asar resh lakish omer hilchot achad asar
